author: katieplaysgames
source: The bulb on the tails of POKENAME has dry leaves and loose seeds, enabling it to make a rattling noise when they shake their tail. They use this as a warning and can fling the seeds at high velocity at their foes if threatened.

entry: POKENAME总让种子晒着太阳，改善所产乳汁的品质与风味。它温顺有礼，深受农人喜爱，常见于乡间。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME constantly exposes its bulb to sunlight to improve the quality and flavor of the milk it can produce. Because of its gentle and courteous nature, it is highly appreciated by farmers and is frequently found in rural areas.

entry: 花盆里的花苞尚未绽放，POKENAME却已能散出有疗愈作用的香气。POKENAME游走森林，随时愿意帮忙。
author: oreee0230
source: Even though the bud in the flower pot has not yet bloomed, POKENAME can still release a fragrance with healing effects. POKENAME wanders around the forest, always ready to offer help.

entry: 传说，POKENAME游历世界，吸收雷雨的能量。绿色种子里储存的电力，足够照亮一座城市数周。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to legend, POKENAME wanders the world absorbing the energy of thunderstorms. Inside its green bulb, it contains enough energy to light up a city for weeks.

entry: 传说，POKENAME游历世界，吸收雷雨的能量。绿色种子里储存的电力，足够照亮一座城市数周。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to legend, POKENAME wanders the world absorbing the energy of thunderstorms. Inside its green bulb, it contains enough energy to light up a city for weeks.

entry: POKENAME向周围的水注入养分，帮助植物萌芽。等熟练掌握这份力量，它就会进化。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME infuses water around them with nutrients that help plants germinate. Once it masters this power, it evolves.

entry: POKENAME爱吃长满苔藓的石头，不过石头拌苔藓也能凑合。POKENAME晒太阳打盹时，头上的种子会稳稳长大。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME love to eat mossy rocks, though they can settle for rocks mixed with moss as well. The bulb upon a POKENAME's head grows steadily as it naps in bright sunlight.

entry: POKENAME扎根于高山之巅。植物组织富含钙质，使身体更坚固，能抵御猛烈沙暴。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME is found rooted atop high mountains. Its plant tissue contains high amounts of calcium, strengthening its body to resist harsh sandstorms.

entry: POKENAME常现身热带气旋，在无云的风眼里沐浴阳光。它借海水的天然折射，把光线汇到身上，飞快吸收太阳能。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME often appears in tropical cyclones, bathing in the sun's rays in the cloudless eye of the storm. It bends sunlight using the ocean's natural refraction to focus light onto its body, rapidly absorbing solar energy.

entry: 大雨过后，POKENAME才从藏身处出来，吹散云层，迎回太阳，也造出彩虹。它们散出种子，正好赶上阳光与刚被润湿的土壤。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME emerge from hiding after a period of heavy rain to blow clouds away and make room for the sun, creating rainbows in the process. They release seeds from their bulb to take opportunity of the sunlight and freshly watered soil.

entry: POKENAME兴高采烈地采来树果，在携带的种子里调制药液。等药液调好，它们便把种子种下，让其长成叶色缤纷的美丽树木。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME excitedly gather berries to brew into potions within the bulbs they carry. Once their concoctions are ready, they plant the bulbs that will grow into beautiful trees with leaves of various colors.

entry: POKENAME身体富含矿物，密布以祖母绿为主的晶格，因而呈现绿色。坚如岩石的身躯，护着头顶娇嫩的种子。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a mineral rich body, dense with a crystal lattice predominantly formed of emeralds that give them their green hue. Their rock-hard bodies protect the delicate bulbs growing from their head.

entry: POKENAME把大种子抱在怀里晒太阳。身边叶片进行光合作用时，会把能量分给种子，好让它们栽下后长得高大健壮。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME bask beneath sunlight while cradling large seeds against their bodies. The leaves around their bodies help share energy with the seeds during photosynthesis, ensuring that they can grow big and strong when the time comes to plant them.

entry: POKENAME是食草生物，还聪明得懂得自己种庄稼。不过，它们总爱把囤好的种子忘在长毛里。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are herbivorous creatures that have shown to be knowledgeable enough to raise their own crops. They do, however, have a bad habit of forgetting their stockpiled seeds in their long fur.

entry: POKENAME几只一组，在野外共同打理小花园，种满花朵与灌木。它们把收来的种子存进背部植物，带回花园栽种、照料。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME work together in small groups to create small gardens in the wild, each with a plethora of flowers and bushes. They collect and store seeds in the bulb on their back to bring back to their garden, where they plant and care for these seeds.

entry: 它从手臂射出小种子，种子一落地便飞快生长。人们常用POKENAME帮助恢复森林。
author: mistymagius
source: It fires small seeds from its arms that grow incredibly quickly once they hit the ground. POKENAME has commonly been used to help reforestation efforts.

entry: POKENAME用长舌舔食植物的花粉与树汁。吃的是哪种花、哪种树，也会影响它的花苞产出哪种花粉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its lengthy tongue to lap up pollen and sap from plants. The type of flowers or trees it feeds from affects the type of pollen its bulbs can produce.

entry: POKENAME用身上的钻头在树上钻洞，让尾立有处可躲。它得吸收大量阳光，才能驱动庞大身体，因此一整天都在晒太阳。
author: fiordaliso
source: With the drills on its body, POKENAME bores holes into trees where Sentret can take shelter. It needs plenty of sunlight to move its large body, so it spends the entire day basking in it.

entry: POKENAME似乎受头顶种子控制。藤蔓能抓到附近任何东西，因此它很少挪动，可一到日光下，就会活力十足。
author: lootererswillbeboated
source: POKENAME seems to be controlled by the bulb on its head. It rarely moves, as its tendrils can grab anything nearby, but it becomes extremely energetic in the sun.

entry: POKENAME的种子里，藏着能产生强大电力的器官。电力直接导进藤蔓，化作带电的鞭击，护住种子不受伤害。
author: sk372
source: Inside POKENAME's bulb is the organ that generates the powerful electricity within its body. It channels this power directly into its vines, which whip around while electrically charged in order to defend its bulb from harm.

entry: POKENAME白天钻进沙漠的沙里休息，只把种子露在地上，从阳光中获取养分。
author: raza
source: POKENAME burrow into the desert sand to rest during the day, leaving their bulbs above ground to absorb nutrients from sunlight.

entry: POKENAME用尖牙咬开果实，吸干汁液，连硬坚果也不例外。身上的植物散出芳香，具体气味则随吃过的食物变化。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME uses its sharp fangs to bite into fruit and suck out all of the juices, though it can also do this with hard nuts. A fragrant aroma wafts from its plant bulbs, though the specific scent is influenced by what it has eaten.

entry: POKENAME头上有一颗种子，成长时便从中摄取养分。头侧长出的锋利叶状肢体，护住这株嫩芽。POKENAME通常靠光合作用维生，也爱树果的滋味。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME has a seed on its head that it gains nourishment from as it grows. It protects this new growth with sharp leaf-like appendages that sprout from the sides of its head. POKENAME tend to use photosynthesis, but also enjoy the taste of berries.

entry: POKENAME绕着对手飞行，从种子中释放孢子云，让敌人中毒、逐渐虚弱。平时，它们则会降低孢子的毒性，反过来为同伴疗伤。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME fly around their opponents, releasing clouds of spores from their bulbs to poison them and wear them down. Outside of battle, they reduce the toxicity of the spores to heal damage done to their allies instead.

entry: POKENAME明明需要阳光来光合生长，却大多待在阴影里。终于走进阳光时，便会突然冲动起来，朝四周施展强力招式，发泄能量。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME, despite needing sunlight in order to photosynthesize and grow its bulb, spends most of its time in the shade. When it finally goes into the sunlight, it feels sudden urges to use its energy by unleashing powerful moves all around it.

entry: POKENAME靠特化的趾垫爬树。每个趾垫都带着细小藤蔓，能紧紧攀住落脚的表面。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME climb trees by relying on their specialized toe pads. Each pad has miniature vines that cling to whatever surface they are on.

entry: POKENAME总想让繁茂的尾巴晒到太阳，靠光合作用进食，保持充沛体力。它虽温和，谁敢威胁森林，也会毫不犹豫地将其赶走。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME always tries to expose its lush tail to sunlight so that it can feed through photosynthesis and remain at full strength. Despite its mild nature, it does not hesitate to chase away anyone who threatens to cause damage to the woods.

entry: POKENAME常被头顶种子累得跌跌撞撞，却总会爬起来。它们先用藤蔓绑住敌人，再发射火球轰击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME often trip and stumble due to the bulb upon their heads, though they always get back up. They use vines to hold their foes before blasting them with fireballs.

entry: 头顶种子长出的羽状叶片，让POKENAME能混入周围枝叶。POKENAME喜欢晒太阳，温暖身体，也滋养种子。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: The feathery leaves sprouting from the bulb on its head help POKENAME blend into the surrounding foliage. POKENAME enjoys bathing in sunlight to warm its body and nurture its bulb.

entry: POKENAME从背上种子射出刀刃般锋利的叶片。只要轻轻擦过，就会留下伤口。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shoot out razor-sharp leaves from the bulb on their back. These leaves are so sharp that a single graze causes a cut.

entry: 不吃东西时，POKENAME就靠腿部肌肉中储存的能量支撑。可POKENAME若过于依赖这项本领，便会因缺乏养分，在战斗中越来越迟缓。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: When this Pokémon does not eat, POKENAME relies on the energy stored in the muscles of its legs to keep it going. If POKENAME relies too heavily on this ability, it will become slower in fights due to a lack of nutrients.

entry: POKENAME在战斗中从双臂伸出藤蔓缚住敌人，拉到近前，再施展快得眼花的踢击，一招接着一招。
author: potato_tub
source: In combat, POKENAME sprouts vines from its arms to ensnare its foes. Once they're pulled into range, it unleashes kicks with blinding speed, chaining strikes in rapid succession.

entry: POKENAME给两颊的植物种球涂上泥，滋养它们。只要种球健康，就能喷出团团花粉，让对方变得迟缓。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME coats the two plant bulbs on its cheeks with mud to nourish them. As long as they are healthy, the bulbs can emit powder clouds of pollen that causes others to grow sluggish.

entry: POKENAME头顶的花苞直接受周围训练家情绪影响。若看着黯淡又失于照料，就说明POKENAME的花苞吸收了负面能量。
author: dodoowner_
source: The bulb growing on POKENAME's head is directly affected by the emotions of Trainers surrounding it. If it seems dull and neglected, POKENAME's bulb has absorbed negative energy.

entry: POKENAME头上的花苞会吸收训练家的情绪能量。花苞鲜嫩亮丽，就说明它们充满了正面能量。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have bulbs atop their heads that absorb emotional energy from their Trainers. A fresh, brightly colored bulb means that they have plenty of positive energy.

entry: POKENAME一心想让训练家自豪，头顶花苞也靠吸收训练家的正面能量保持健康。花苞若皱缩枯萎，便是疏于照顾的迹象。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are determined to make their Trainer proud, as the health of the bulb on their head absorbs the positive energy from their Trainer. A shriveled and withered bulb is a sign of neglect.

entry: POKENAME用预知未来的力量，确保阳光始终照到背上的种子。若POKENAME预见训练家有危险，花苞便会立刻盛开，放出带超能力的花粉，拦住敌人。
author: de_19.
source: POKENAME uses its power to see the future to ensure the sun's rays always hit the seed on its back. If POKENAME predicts a threat to its Trainer, the bulb blooms instantly, releasing psychic pollen that halts the foe.

entry: POKENAME用头部吸收阳光，将能量注入飞叶快刀。全力施展时，臂间的叶片只需一挥，便能斩断树木。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME absorb sunlight through their heads, channeling this energy into their Razor Leaf attacks. At full power, the leaves along their arms are capable of cutting  through trees with a single swing.

entry: 无论晒多久，POKENAME都不会变暖，光的能量已被尽数吸收。除了晒太阳，POKENAME别无所求，有时还会偷溜出精灵球，飞向日光。
author: oreee0230
source: No matter how much sun POKENAME takes in, its body does not warm up; the energy of the light is completely absorbed. Besides sunbathing, POKENAME has no other needs and sometimes sneaks out of Poké Balls to fly towards sunlight.

entry: POKENAME平时喜欢独处，可一旦背上的种子受到威胁，就会用毒角发动攻击。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME tend to keep to themselves. If it feels that the bulb on its back is threatened, however, it will attack with its poisonous horns.

entry: POKENAME越长越大，与其他POKENAME联络的距离也越来越远。POKENAME究竟能联系多远的同类，尚无人知晓。全身开满花时，就已准备好进化。
author: bobosmith01
source: As it grows, POKENAME's ability to communicate with other POKENAME reaches further and further. The limit to how far a POKENAME can potentially contact another is not known. When flowers bloom across its body, it is ready to evolve.

entry: 头顶长草的种子吸收越多阳光，POKENAME的大脑就越有精力，连最复杂的问题也能解开。身体太重，走过总留下脚印，很容易追踪。
author: fiordaliso
source: The more sunlight the grassy bulb on its head absorbs, the more energy POKENAME's brain will have to solve even the most complex problems. It is so heavy that when it walks, it leaves tracks in the ground, making it very easy to follow.

entry: POKENAME像一朵栽在花盆里的花苞。战斗时，POKENAME会放出孢子，对手吸入后，施展能力便会受干扰。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME resembles a flower bud in a flowerpot. In battle, POKENAME releases spores that, when inhaled, interfere with its opponent's abilities.

entry: POKENAME靠头顶种子感知周围生命的波导。它每天击打大树树干锻炼，肌肉因此坚硬如钢。
author: fiordaliso
source: Thanks to the bulb on its head, POKENAME can sense the auras of living beings around it. Its muscles are as hard as steel because it trains daily by punching the trunks of large trees.

entry: 它从黎明初现就不断锻炼，让肌肉比金属更坚硬。POKENAME靠身上的绿色小种球，感知其他生物的波导。
author: fiordaliso
source: It trains constantly from the first light of dawn to make its muscles harder than metal. POKENAME can sense the auras of other creatures using the small green bulbs on its body.

entry: POKENAME背上的植物长得慢，需要大量阳光与养分才能开花。它们整日蜷在日光下，暖着花苞，等待绽放。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The plant growing on the back of POKENAME is slow-growing, requiring a lot of sunlight and nutrients to blossom. They spend their days curled up in the sun warming the flower bulb, waiting for it to bloom.

entry: POKENAME背上的植物长得慢，需要大量阳光与养分才能开花。它们整日蜷在日光下，暖着花苞，等待绽放。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The plant growing on the back of POKENAME is slow-growing, requiring a lot of sunlight and nutrients to blossom. They spend their days curled up in the sun warming the flower bulb, waiting for it to bloom.

entry: POKENAME背上的花还未成熟，十分娇嫩。它们用叶片裹住脆弱花瓣，一直护到真正能够盛开的那天。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The flower blooming on the back of POKENAME is immature and still fragile. They keep their leaves furled around the fragile petals, keeping the flower safe until it's fully ready to bloom.

entry: POKENAME以天真无害的脑袋和甜香引诱敌人。等对方松懈，就用庞大身体将其击倒。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME lures in its foes with its innocent-looking head and sweet fragrance. Once the foe's guard is down, it will strike them down with its massive body.

entry: POKENAME头上的食肉嫩芽刚长出不久，还不聪明，要靠身体引导。若不按时喂食，就会发脾气，试着将自己从身体上撕下来。
author: mistymagius
source: The carnivorous sprout on POKENAME's head is newly developed and not very intelligent, relying on the body to guide it. If it's not fed regularly, it throws a tantrum and tries to rip itself from the body.

entry: POKENAME四处游荡，用可爱外表引猎物靠近。不咀嚼时，POKENAME那张硕大鲜艳的嘴能藏进毛发里。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME wanders around, using its cute appearance to lure prey close. POKENAME's big, colorful  mouth can hide in its hair when not chewing.

entry: POKENAME的触手还没长出捕捉小型虫宝可梦的嘴，食物选择很少。身体又重，追不上猎物，只好有什么经过就吃什么。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have limited options for feeding because their tentacles have not yet developed mouths to capture small Bug-type Pokémon with. They rely on eating anything that crosses their path, as their heavy body prevents them from chasing prey.

entry: POKENAME冲向敌人时，很难一直抬着头，常把自己绊倒。日子久了，颈肌才慢慢发达，能抬头护住背上的花苞。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME struggle to keep their head raised when they charge at foes, leading them to trip over themselves. Over time, they slowly develop neck muscles to keep their head raised to protect the flower bulb on their back.

entry: POKENAME白天大多坐在明亮日光中，把能量存进背上种子。虽能借此猛击敌人，可POKENAME动得越少，种子就长得越大。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of the day sitting in bright sunlight, storing up energy in the seed on its back. While it can draw upon this store of power to strike foes with great force, the less POKENAME moves, the larger its bulb grows.

entry: POKENAME住在地下深处、绿意盎然的隐秘洞穴里。若能偶然遇上它，人们认为，附近必有令人惊叹的景象。
author: veteranadventurer
source: POKENAME lives in hidden, greenery-filled caves deep underground. To find one naturally is considered a sign you are near an awe-inspiring sight.

entry: POKENAME靠叶绿素供能，身体比其他草属性宝可梦更接近虚体。前侧的骷髅状构造，让看见它的对象无不惧怕。
author: honowo
source: POKENAME's chlorophyll-powered body assumes a less corporeal form than other Grass-type Pokémon. The skull-shaped formations on its front instill great fear in all who witness it.

entry: POKENAME常出现在墓地，照料摆在逝者墓前的鲜花。传闻它的身体内部空空如也，全靠头顶的种子，才能活动。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME often appears in cemeteries to care for the flowers placed before the graves of the deceased. Rumor has it that its body is hollow and that it is moved solely by the bulb it carries atop its head.

entry: 它常到墓地，照料摆在逝者墓前的花。传闻身体空心，POKENAME全靠环在头部的长草种球获得活力。
author: fiordaliso
source: It often appears in cemeteries to care for the flowers placed before the graves of the deceased. Rumor has it that its body is hollow and that POKENAME is animated solely by the grassy bulb that surrounds its head.

entry: POKENAME花苞下方的身体没有实体，便于藏在高草中。据说，遇见迷路的幽灵时，POKENAME会用腹部大嘴吞下它们，送往来世。
author: oreee0230
source: The body beneath POKENAME's flower bud is incorporeal, allowing it to hide in tall grass. It is said that when it encounters lost ghosts, POKENAME uses the large mouth on its abdomen to swallow them and send them to the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME容易照料，浮在水面晒太阳就很满足，因而深受宠爱。可多数主人应付不了进化后暴增的体型与坏脾气，常在进化前便将它放回海中。
author: ecstaticwoop64556455
source: POKENAME is a beloved low-maintenance pet, content to float on the surface of water and absorb rays of sunlight. It will often be released back into the sea before evolving, as most owners can't handle its colossal size increase and bad temperament.

entry: POKENAME极其罕见，据说一生大多待在故乡维度的太阳下休息。背上种子储存的能量，可能孕育出全新物种的宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: Specimens of POKENAME are extremely rare to encounter, as they are said to spend most of their lives resting under the sun of their home dimension. The energy they store within the bulb on their back could give rise to new species of Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME饮用清澈湖水，让背上的种子健康茁壮。它温柔又耐心，常被视为适合年幼新手训练家的旅伴。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME drinks the clear waters of lakes to help the bulb on its back grow healthy and strong. It is an incredibly gentle and patient creature, which is why it is often considered a good Pokémon for young Trainers beginning their journey.

entry: POKENAME吸收纯净湖水，滋养背上的种子。性情温和而有耐心，是初入世界的新手训练家可靠的伙伴。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME absorbs pure lake water to nourish the bulb growing on its back. Its mild temperament and patience make it a trusted companion for novice Trainers taking their first steps into the world.

entry: POKENAME靠头上两片叶子寻找干净水源饮用。它大多忙着将太阳能尽量吸进身体，好让自己越来越强。
author: fiordaliso
source: Thanks to the two leaves on its head, POKENAME can locate sources of clean water where it can drink. It spends most of its time absorbing as much solar energy as possible into its body to become stronger and stronger.

entry: POKENAME吸收纯净湖水，滋养背上的种子。性情温和而有耐心，是初入世界的新手训练家可靠的伙伴。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME absorbs pure lake water to nourish the bulb growing on its back. Its mild temperament and patience make it a trusted companion for novice Trainers taking their first steps into the world.

entry: 身上绿叶开始泛黄，就说明POKENAME急需补充清澈的水。它虽非常温顺，一遇危险，也会毫不犹豫地坚定守护同伴。
author: fiordaliso
source: If the green leaves on its body start to turn yellow, it means that POKENAME needs to be hydrated immediately with crystal-clear water. Although it is a very gentle Pokémon, it does not hesitate to defend its companions resolutely when danger arises.

entry: 身上绿叶开始泛黄，就说明POKENAME急需补充清澈的水。它虽非常温顺，一遇危险，也会毫不犹豫地坚定守护同伴。
author: fiordaliso
source: If the green leaves on its body start to turn yellow, it means that POKENAME needs to be hydrated immediately with crystal-clear water. Although it is a very gentle Pokémon, it does not hesitate to defend its companions resolutely when danger arises.

entry: POKENAME背上的植物会定期结出果实与树果。滋味朴素，却营养丰富，尤其有益于幼小宝可梦成长。
author: sk372
source: The plants that grow on POKENAME's back regularly bear fruit and berries over time. The flavor is simple, but the fruit is quite nutritious, particularly for young Pokémon's development.

entry: POKENAME的大耳朵护着后脑的种子，也像太阳能板一样吸收日光，通过光合作用产生能量。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME have large ears to protect the bulbs on the back of their heads. These ears act as solar panels, absorbing sunlight to produce energy through photosynthesis.

entry: 它不善走路，可能主要受背上不断生长的植物拖累。过度劳累时，偶尔一摔便躺着不动，静晒阳光，直到恢复力气。
author: infinex21
source: It is a poor walker, possibly due mostly to the growing plant bulb on its back. Sometimes it lies still after falling, which usually happens if it has overexerted itself. It will lie still and bathe in sunlight until it has regained its strength.

entry: POKENAME活泼爱玩，却坚决不肯受人帮助。最爱的消遣之一，似乎是趴着肚皮滑泥巴，哪怕得自己先造一片泥。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME is very energetic and playful, despite how it fervently rejects any help from others. One of its favorite pastimes seems to be sliding on its belly atop mud, even if it has to make the mud itself.

entry: POKENAME的族群会维护栖居水域，用洁净的水滋养头顶种子。POKENAME对任何污染物和污染者，都会毫不留情地攻击。
author: wiz0z
source: Colonies of POKENAME help maintain the bodies of water they live in. POKENAME use the pure water to help the bulbs on their heads grow. Any pollution or polluters are attacked without mercy.

entry: POKENAME在沉重身体里存水，免得坚韧的种子干枯。若吸收雨水等导致储水过多，多余的水就从鼻子流出。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME store water within their heavy bodies to keep their hardy bulb from drying out and wilting. If they ever have an excess of water, such as from absorbing rain, the excess will drain from their noses.

entry: POKENAME慢慢啃过大片草地，顺势吸食遇见的成群虫子。有些已被割草公司雇来帮忙。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME slowly graze through large spans of grass as they suck up and eat the hordes of bugs they encounter. Some have been utilized by lawn cutting businesses.

entry: 这只形似棍棒、被幽灵附身的宝可梦，若发现敲打没用，就会从种子般的头部，喷射植物弹丸。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: When bludgeoning won't do the job, this haunted, club-like Pokémon expels plant-based projectiles from its seed head.

entry: POKENAME很挑哪些训练家能靠近，常把人从栖居的森林赶走。据说，败给POKENAME的人，结局都不幸。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME is particular about which Trainers it allows close, as it often chases Trainers out of the forests they live in. It is said that those who lose to a POKENAME meet an unfortunate end.

entry: POKENAME用头上的角挪开树根，整理出睡觉的位置。睡时只露出头和种子，清晨便能通过光合作用积蓄能量。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use the horns on their head to move roots at the bases of trees, creating a sleeping spot. They sleep with only their heads and bulbs above ground, gathering energy in the morning through photosynthesis.

entry: POKENAME出现在杂草丛生的厂区。初生时只是一团形状不定的植物质，随后会寻找废金属寄居，保护自己。
author: ocxin
source: POKENAME appear in overgrown factory grounds. Starting their lives as amorphous balls of plant mass, they seek out scrap metal to inhabit and protect themselves.

entry: POKENAME身上的叶鬃会吸收空气中的带电粒子，将能量存进背上种子，再朝敌人施展强力带电攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body features a mane of leaves that absorb electric particles from the air. The energy is stored in the bulb on its back, which it uses to unleash powerful electrified attacks against its foes.

entry: POKENAME部分身体覆着硬如钢铁的叶片。连种子都裹着薄金属层，不过栽下后，仍能像普通植物一样生长。
author: sk372
source: Parts of POKENAME's body are covered with leaves as hard as steel. In fact, even seeds shot from its bulb are coated with a thin layer of metal, though they can grow after being planted like any normal plant.

entry: POKENAME模样可爱，深受园丁喜爱。进行光合作用时，长缎带般的藤蔓也能额外吸收阳光。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME is popular among gardeners for its cuteness. Its long, ribbon-like vines are used to absorb additional sunlight while photosynthesizing.

entry: POKENAME常潜过高草，找好位置，玩闹般冲向经过的任何东西。它们以为没人察觉，甜香却早已出卖了自己。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME often sneak through the tall grass, positioning itself to playfully charge at anything passing by. They seem to think their presence isn't known, but their sweet scent gives them away.

entry: POKENAME虽然高大，却很会照料生命。会带着幼苗掘地，以大耳朵收集阳光，再通过光合作用滋养土壤，培育新树。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Despite their large stature, POKENAME are very nurturing Pokémon. They burrow with sprouts, gathering sunlight in their large ears and enriching the soil through photosynthesis to grow new trees.

entry: POKENAME住在热带雨林的深河中，向空中喷水，浇灌四周植物。等整片雨林浸透水，便挖出水道，扩张领地。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME can be found living in deep rivers in tropical rainforests, spraying water into the air to water the plants around them. Once the entire rainforest is soaked with their water, they create channels to spread their domain.

entry: POKENAME背上厚重的叶片极善蓄水。因此，即使长期干旱，它也能活下去，不必另找淡水。
author: ambrosia04
source: The thick, heavy leaves on POKENAME's back are specialized for extreme water retention. This adaptation allows the Pokémon to survive when a drought comes for long periods without needing to find a fresh water source .

entry: POKENAME从背上发射种子，种出茂密森林，以此塑造大陆。随着它进化，曾种下的树木也变得更坚韧。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME is known for shaping continents by launching seeds from its back that sprout into dense forests. As it evolves, the trees that it once planted become more resilient.

entry: POKENAME翱翔高空，吸收阳光，不受温室气体影响。它始终待在日光中，也会受流星吸引。
author: oreee0230
source: Soaring at high altitudes, POKENAME absorbs sunlight without being affected by greenhouse gases. It always stays in the sun's rays and is drawn to meteors.

entry: POKENAME背上的种子不受时间操纵影响。即使它拥有时空之力，也只能耐心等种子自然长大。
author: soup1900
source: The bulb on POKENAME's back is immune to the effects of time manipulation. Even with its temporal powers, it must wait patiently for the bulb to grow naturally.

entry: POKENAME拼命守护背上那颗巨大种子。传闻，里面装着一个完全独立的维度。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME fiercely defends the large bulb growing on its back. Rumors say the bulb contains an entirely separate dimension inside it.

entry: 野生POKENAME白天几乎从不活动。夜里，却会纠缠那些当初没选妙蛙种子作伙伴的新手训练家。
author: h0bojoe
source: Wild POKENAME are almost never active during the day. At night, they can be found haunting young Trainers who did not choose Bulbasaur as their starter Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME背上的花苞炮也像吸尘器，能吸入养分，供给自身。它还具有人造机构，能为宝可梦利用日光进行光合作用。
author: soup1900
source: The bud cannon that's on POKENAME's back also functions like a vacuum, sucking in nutrients to help sustain itself. It has artificial mechanisms that photosynthesize sunlight for the Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME背后的花苞不停渗毒，大部分尚未滴落地面，就已渗进甲壳。战斗时，这些毒液会被猛力挤出，喷向敌人。
author: oreee0230
source: The bud behind POKENAME keeps oozing venom, but most of it seeps into its shell before dripping onto the ground. During battle, the venom is squeezed out onto enemies with force.

entry: 满月之夜，它们奇异的种子会发出光芒。据说，POKENAME的种子里藏着月之石，能引导神秘力量，让它们飞上天空。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Their strange bulbs glow on nights of the full moon. It is said that a POKENAME's bulb contains Moon Stones that channel their mystical powers and allow them to fly.

entry: POKENAME的几颗种子里装着不同的孢子：左边使人中毒，右边使人麻痹，后面的则让人昏睡。
author: xenophacilus
source: POKENAME's bulbs are filled with different spores. The left shoots out poison, the right one stuns, and the back makes you sleep.

entry: POKENAME背上种子里充满空气，晒热后膨胀，让它们白天能浮起来。它们成大群漂游，以藤蔓彼此拉住。
author: chibitales
source: The bulb on POKENAME's back is filled with air that expands when heated up, allowing them to float during the day. They float about in large groups, holding on to one another with vines.

entry: POKENAME身上的植物有助于混入绿叶，比其他铁面忍者更难发现。头边还长出叶片，压低平时响亮的叫声。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME is even more difficult to spot than other species of Ninjask due to the plants on its body helping it to blend in with other greenery. It grows leaves around its head to muffle its normally loud cries.

entry: POKENAME一兴奋，头顶种子便渗出诅咒能量。遗弃草属性宝可梦的训练家，可能会发现自己被POKENAME盯上。
author: oreee0230
source: Whenever POKENAME gets excited, cursed energy seeps out from the bulb on its head. Trainers who abandon Grass-type Pokémon may find POKENAME stalking them.

entry: POKENAME周围裹着虚幻的等离子体，能弯曲变形，让它穿过窄缝。它们伸出同样物质构成的触手，救出卡在缝里的孩子与小型宝可梦。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME are surrounded by ethereal plasma that bends to allow them to slip through narrow gaps. They rescue children and small Pokémon stuck in crevices by extending tentacles made of this plasma.

entry: 满月照耀的花园里，POKENAME会从种子中放出奇异而神秘的光，让花朵绽放出鲜艳的色彩。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Appearing in gardens under the light of the full moon, POKENAME release a strange, mystical light from their bulbs that helps flowers bloom in vivid color.

entry: 全球顶级五星级酒店的枕头，都用它的香绵填充。POKENAME若没在日光下长睡，就爱追逐风吹的落叶。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its fragrant cotton is used to stuff the pillows found in all the world's top five-star hotels. When POKENAME is not taking long naps in the sun, it enjoys chasing leaves blown by the wind.

entry: POKENAME伏在密林，用肢体抓食小型虫属性宝可梦，再以养分滋养种子。棺材里究竟是什么植物质，无人知晓。
author: crumple_2
source: POKENAME lies in dense forests, using its appendages to grab and eat small Bug-type Pokémon. It then uses the nutrients to nourish the bulb. No one knows what plant matter is inside the coffin.

entry: POKENAME腿脚脆弱，靠带电蛛网捕猎。网中混有感光构造，能让电力长久保持，无需维护。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME relies on its electrified webs for hunting, as its legs are fragile. Its webs are mixed with photoreceptors, allowing them to remain charged with electricity for long periods of time without maintenance.

entry: 它在密林树梢间守候猎物。POKENAME会往下抛毒刺，想刺中下方野生宝可梦，使其无法行动。
author: sly.crook
source: It hangs around the treetops of dense forests waiting for prey. POKENAME will drop poisonous thorns, hoping to prick and incapacitate wild Pokémon below.

entry: POKENAME的种子里装满了易燃液体。为了不洒出一滴，它总是摇摇摆摆地慢慢走。
author: xenophacilus
source: POKENAME's bulb is filled to the brim with flammable liquid. It waddles slowly to avoid spilling a single drop.

entry: POKENAME漂浮在热带密林上方，为人类与宝可梦照路。因为从没见POKENAME用火损伤森林，人们将其视为仁善的存在。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME float above the jungle forests, lighting the way for people and Pokémon alike. They are regarded as beneficent, as POKENAME are never seen damaging the forest using their flames.

entry: POKENAME的藤蔓上长着种荚，会朝天伸展，吸收阳光。若有别的植物挡光，它们就烧掉周围植物，直到再次晒到太阳。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have seed pods along their vines that reach towards the sky to absorb sunlight. When another plant covers their sunlight, they burn the plants around them until they can feel the sun again.

entry: POKENAME需要清水与充足阳光，才能让刀刃鲜活强韧。块头大，又自带利器，POKENAME却很温顺，野外常与其他草属性宝可梦一同打盹。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME requires fresh water and plenty of sunlight to keep its blades vibrant and strong. Despite its size and natural weaponry, POKENAME is docile and can be seen napping with other Grass-type Pokémon in the wild.

entry: 据说，POKENAME头顶的种子藏着本已失落于岁月的古老秘密。它虽能游荡暗黑遗迹，却更爱沐浴日光。
author: oreee0230
source: The bulb atop POKENAME's head is said to hold ancient secrets that were thought to be lost to time. While it is capable of wandering dark ruins, it prefers to soak in the sun's rays.

entry: 常能看见它们的尾巴上开着花。随POKENAME栖息环境不同，每条尾巴还能长出不同种类的花。
author: kitarchen
source: They can often be spotted with flowers on their tails. Each tail can grow a different flower species on it depending on the POKENAME's environment.

entry: POKENAME用背上种子汇聚太阳能，增强火焰力量。多条尾巴摩擦树丛，散出甜香花粉，能让果实瞬间成熟。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME gathers solar energy in the bulb on its back to boost its fire powers. It rubs its many tails against trees and bushes, spreading sweet pollen that ripens fruit in an instant.

entry: POKENAME藏在海滩短草间，边睡边吸收太阳能。有时，POKENAME会成大群聚拢，模仿草丛，躲避捕食的鸟宝可梦。
author: leandermalurt
source: POKENAME hide among the short grass at beaches, gathering energy from the sun while they sleep. Sometimes, large groups of POKENAME join together to imitate grass and avoid preying bird Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME为植物注入活力，催动新的生长，让它们提前成熟。等完全熟成，POKENAME便吸取叶绿素，滋养自身。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME injects vitality into plants to unlock newfound growth, allowing these plants to mature early. Once these plants fully ripen, POKENAME sucks chlorophyll from the plants to nourish its own body.

entry: POKENAME虽有成年猛禽般的心气，实际上仍幼小，在天上地上都笨手笨脚。山火烧过老林后，常见一抹抹嫩绿的POKENAME在余灰里蹦跳。
author: t3isukone
source: Though POKENAME has the spirit of a full-aged bird of prey, it is still quite young and clumsy both in the air and on the ground. After a forest fire burns through old growth, the bright green spots of POKENAME can be seen hopping in the ashes.

entry: POKENAME装成妙蛙种子，通常在野生妙蛙种子稀少处活动。POKENAME背上的花苞摸着虽与布制身体其他部位一样，却真能吸收养分、生长。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a Bulbasaur and usually operates in places where wild Bulbasaur are scarce. The bud on POKENAME's back may feel like other parts of its fabric body, but this part can also absorb nutrients and grow as well.

entry: POKENAME藤蔓上的头不如本体的头强壮，却能伸长，抓取东西、自己进食。需要时，POKENAME也能用背上的叶子飞行。
author: oreee0230
source: The heads on each of POKENAME's vines are not as strong as the one on its body, but can extend to grab objects and feed themselves. POKENAME can use the leaves on its back to fly when needed.

entry: POKENAME将日光导入背上种子，增强火焰能力。尾巴拂过植物时，会扬起芳香粉末，让附近果实顷刻成熟。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME channels sunlight through the bulb on its back to intensify its fiery abilities. By brushing its tails across plants, it releases a fragrant dust that ripens nearby fruit in moments.

entry: POKENAME尾端长着巨大花苞。内里渐长的花朵，散发神秘热力。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: An enormous flower bud sprouts from POKENAME's tail. The large growing bloom inside radiates mystical heat.

entry: POKENAME所在之处，周围植物都会不受控制地变异。科学家认为，这是POKENAME不稳定的DNA造成的。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's presence uncontrollably mutates any plants in its surroundings. Scientists believe this is due to POKENAME's unstable DNA.

entry: 覆盖头部的种子保护着POKENAME强大的心智。它靠纸片般的细小突起散发超能力能量，感知周围生命。
author: rhysanthemum
source: The bulb covering POKENAME's head protects its powerful mind. It senses beings with small, paper-like growths that emanate psychic energy.

entry: POKENAME什么都靠藤蔓，很少离开原地。无论筑坝还是把食物送进嘴里，藤蔓都忙个不停，供给生存所需的一切。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rarely move from one spot because they rely on their vines to do everything. From building dams to putting food in their mouths, their vines work nonstop to give them everything they need to survive.

entry: POKENAME能感知周围生长的自然之魂，一觉察植物受苦，就急忙帮忙。它住在林下草丛，用藤蔓在枝间飞快荡行。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can sense the soul of nature growing around it and rushes to help plants it feels are suffering. It lives in the undergrowth, using vines to swing quickly from branch to branch.

entry: 只要有阳光，POKENAME就不必呼吸。晴天的外海，常见它们倒浮水面，让种子晒太阳；许多鸟宝可梦会停在肚皮上歇脚。
author: oreee0230
source: As long as POKENAME receive sunlight, they do not need to breathe. On sunny days out in the open ocean, they can be found upside-down to nourish the bulb with the sun's rays. Many bird Pokémon perch on their stomachs to rest.

entry: POKENAME把电力存进背上种子，需要时用来战斗。带着青草香的毛皮，能让接触它的对象平静下来。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME stores electricity inside the bulb on its back, using the energy in battle when needed. Its grassy-scented fur has the ability to calm anyone who comes into contact with it.

entry: POKENAME唱歌时会左右摇摆，让花苞里的种子沙沙作响。可若有人听着歌安然睡去，POKENAME反而会生气地喷出孢子。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: As POKENAME sing, they sway back and forth, rattling the seeds inside their bulb. If people fall asleep from the soothing song, POKENAME spray spores from their bulb in anger.

entry: POKENAME积极摄取矿物，让背上花苞硬如金属。进化时，花苞外层会蜕落，能当作特殊的高强度材料。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME actively consumes minerals, making the bud on its back as tough as metal. When it evolves, the outer layer of its bud is shed and can be used as a special high-strength material.

entry: POKENAME藏进沙下，只露出绿色种子吸收阳光，维持生命。谁若靠近，它便破土而出，一口咬住倒霉的来者。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME hides beneath the sand, leaving only its green bulb exposed so it can sustain itself by absorbing sunlight. When someone approaches its position, it bursts out of the ground and snaps its jaws shut on the unfortunate intruder.

entry: POKENAME藏进沙下，只露出绿色种子吸收阳光，维持生命。谁若靠近，它便破土而出，一口咬住倒霉的来者。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME hides beneath the sand, leaving only its green bulb exposed so it can sustain itself by absorbing sunlight. When someone approaches its position, it bursts out of the ground and snaps its jaws shut on the unfortunate intruder.

entry: POKENAME背上的仙人掌，能在雨季储存大量水分。POKENAME将身体埋进沙里，以饱含水的仙人掌引诱小型宝可梦。
author: oreee0230
source: The cactus on POKENAME's back can store a large amount of water during the rainy season. POKENAME buries its body in the sand and uses the water-filled cactus to lure small Pokémon.

entry: 为免翅膀被沙漠烈日晒坏，POKENAME白天多安待绿洲。背上种子既能将日光化为能量，也能储水，让它在灼热之地存活。
author: fiordaliso
source: To prevent its wings from being damaged by the desert sun, POKENAME spends most of the day safely within oases. The bulb on its back not only converts sunlight into energy but also stores water, allowing it to survive even in scorching habitats.

entry: POKENAME住在水草丛生的池塘，常侧躺水面睡觉，吸收阳光，也借此装死，骗过捕食者。
author: smashbear
source: POKENAME live in ponds that are heavily infested with weeds. They tend to sleep on the surface on their sides, absorbing sunlight and playing dead for predators.

entry: 野生POKENAME爱去山地等高处，好离太阳近些。身体虽强壮，为保护植物种球，它们仍会逃跑。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME are drawn to tall areas, such as mountains, so they can be closer to the sun. They will flee to protect their plant bulbs, even though their bodies are quite strong.

entry: POKENAME壳上的甲片如叶片般发挥作用，每隔几天便剥落，换上更鲜活坚韧的新片。脱下的甲片富含养分，磨碎后用途很多。
author: infinex21
source: The plates of POKENAME's shell function like leaves. These plates peel and shed every few days to give way to more vibrant and tougher plates. Each shed plate holds many nutrients and can be ground up and used in various ways.

entry: POKENAME的齿轮稳稳转动，滋养连在第二枚齿轮上的种子。它会用藤蔓加快该齿轮，令其超频，喷出花粉，搅得来袭者心烦意乱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's gears turn steadily, nourishing the bulb attached to the second gear. It can use its vines to turn the bulb's gear faster, overclocking it and making it erupt pollen to agitate attackers.

entry: POKENAME整天转动齿轮，让所有种子都晒到一样多的太阳。每颗都蓄满日光能量后，它们便会进化。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rotate their gears throughout the day to ensure all the bulbs receive the same amount of sunlight. Once all their bulbs are fully charged with sunlight, they evolve.

entry: POKENAME若没吸够太阳能，就无法制造幻象。为免受其他森林宝可梦打扰，有时会变成人类模样。
author: fiordaliso
source: If it doesn't absorb enough solar energy, POKENAME cannot create its illusions. To avoid being bothered by other forest Pokémon, it sometimes takes on a human appearance.

entry: POKENAME身体其余部分都已成熟，种子却仍是原样。科学家认为，POKENAME有生之年，这颗种子都会保持休眠。
author: soup1900
source: Although the rest of POKENAME's body has matured, its seed remains as it is. Scientists believe the seed will remain dormant for the entirety of POKENAME's life.

entry: POKENAME虽在融合后体型未变，却优先长出成熟的外观。叶片面积小，它几乎整天都得晒太阳，才能继续成长。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME prioritizes developing a mature appearance, even though its body size remains unchanged from fusion. Because the surface area of its leaves is small, it needs to spend almost the entire day basking in the sun to continue growing.

entry: POKENAME必须小心，免得尾巴上的火焰烧到背上的种子。万一烧坏了，种子可能要花上数周才能重新长好。
author: benevolent
source: POKENAME has to be careful not to accidentally burn its bulb with the flame on its tail. If that happens, it can take weeks for the bulb to grow back.

entry: POKENAME白天打盹，吸收更多日光。夜幕降临，便用尾焰模拟阳光，为自己走动补充能量。
author: dandistorted2
source: POKENAME naps during the day to absorb more sunlight. When night falls, it uses the flame on its tail to replicate sunlight, giving it energy to walk.

entry: POKENAME把种子鼓起来，借此飞翔。唱歌时，它们还会沿途撒播小种子，种出供人歇脚的美丽花园。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME inflate their bulbs to fly. As they sing, they scatter seeds from their bulbs, creating beautiful gardens where people can rest.

entry: POKENAME白天高高兴兴收集种子，入夜再撒出去。只要集中精神，POKENAME就能让种子长得更快。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME happily gathers seeds during the daytime then spreads them at night. When it concentrates, POKENAME can make the seeds grow faster.

entry: POKENAME的花苞香气宜人，却也满藏毒液。一察觉威胁，POKENAME便边退往安全距离，边挤出毒液射向敌人。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's flower buds emit a pleasant fragrance, but are also full of venom. Once it senses a threat, POKENAME will squeeze out the venom to shoot at foes while retreating to a safe distance.

entry: POKENAME刚被收服时疏离冷淡，但能回应关爱与尊重。开心时，耳朵上的花苞就会散出甜香。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are standoffish when they are first captured but respond well to affection and respect. Whenever they are happy, they release a sweet aroma from the bulbs on their ears.

entry: POKENAME长出坚果般的孢子，滋味像碧根果。秋天，它把孢子撒遍林地，为下一季滋养土壤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME produces nut-like spores that taste similar to pecans. In autumn, it scatters these spores across the forest floor, enriching the soil for the next season.

entry: POKENAME游走城市花园，以负面情绪为食，尤其爱愤怒与怨恨。身体能把阳光化成能量，因此白天最活跃。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME wanders through city gardens feeding on negative emotions, particularly anger and resentment. It is most active during the day, as its body converts sunlight into energy.

entry: POKENAME周围裹着黏稠树汁构成的泡泡，靠泡泡表面进行光合作用。这使汁液中叶绿素增加，呈现浅绿色。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are surrounded by a bubble of thick sap that allows them to photosynthesize using the surface of their bubble. This ability increases the amount of chlorophyll within the sap, turning it into a light green hue.

entry: POKENAME没有看得出的感觉器官，却能靠超能力察觉周围。它虽能适应种种恶劣环境，若久不见阳光，还是会进入冬眠。
author: oreee0230
source: Although it has no discernible sensory organs, POKENAME can perceive its surroundings through its psychic abilities. While it can adapt to various harsh environments, it will go into hibernation if it does not get sunlight for a long time.

entry: POKENAME钻入土里，只露眼睛和种子。种子折射出细碎光点，模仿仙人掌的尖刺，驱退捕食者。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME burrow into the ground with only their eyes and bulbs exposed. Their bulbs refract light in small sparkles to resemble the spines of a cactus and keep away predators.

entry: POKENAME吸气便能鼓大身体，肚皮可撑到原本的20倍，增加吸收阳光的表面积。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME expands its body size by inhaling. Its belly can stretch 20 times its original size, increasing the available surface area it has to absorb sunlight.

entry: 白天，POKENAME睡在洞穴侧壁，只让种子晒着太阳。夜里，它们收集树果，种在洞口附近，方便日后采食。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME sleep on the sides of caves during the day, exposing only their bulbs to sunlight. At night, they gather berries and plant them near their caves for easier access.

entry: POKENAME把吃下的弱小宝可梦的灵魂困在种子里。它夜里活动，白天休息时从太阳蓄能，维持每夜的狩猎。
author: crumple_2
source: POKENAME traps the souls of other weak Pokémon it consumes within the bulb. It is nocturnal, gaining energy from the sun while it rests to sustain its nightly hunts.

entry: 它不停啃电缆，直到背上种子蓄满电。POKENAME块头虽小，却敢让青草般的藤蔓通电，无畏地驱退威胁。
author: fiordaliso
source: It gnaws on power cables until the bulb on its back is fully charged. Despite its small size, POKENAME fearlessly repels threats by electrifying its grassy vines.

entry: 只要放任得够久，哪怕一只POKENAME，也能长出吸尽整整一英亩土壤养分的根系，让地上庄稼全数毁坏。
author: bradlybro199
source: If left unattended for long enough, even one POKENAME can grow a root system that will absorb all the nutrients from an entire acre of land, leaving the crops within completely ruined.

entry: POKENAME的长牙坚如石头，成分却近似叶片。它把树果碾碎吃下，其余养分则来自种子吸收的阳光。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME tusks are hard as stone yet have a composition akin to leaves. They crush up berries to eat, and get their other nutrients via the sunlight absorbed through their bulbs.

entry: POKENAME攻击性很强，会不停袭击附近的虫宝可梦。它常在阳光下休息，让绿色的羽毛恢复健康。
author: adam941
source: POKENAME are aggressive, and relentlessly attack nearby bug Pokémon. It often rests in the sunlight, which heals its green feathers.

entry: POKENAME会精心选址筑巢，确保始终晒得到太阳。性情温和的它，宁可多吃树果，也不愿捕猎其他生物。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME strategically builds its nest so that it is always bathed in sunlight. Due to its gentle nature, it prefers a diet rich in Berries rather than hunting other creatures.

entry: POKENAME一振翅，就向空气中散出清爽薄荷香。稍闻危险声响，便躲进树梢，藏得浑然一体。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME flutters its wings, it releases a crisp scent of mint into the air. At the first sound of danger, it hides, blending seamlessly into the treetops.

entry: POKENAME把尖牙扎进树干，为种子吸取养分，洞口附近因此常有枯树。不过吸得太多，种子就会重得让它们飞不起来。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME sink their fangs into trees to absorb nutrients for their bulbs, often leaving withered trees near cave entrances. Drinking too much can make their bulbs too heavy to fly.

entry: POKENAME大多时间都在吸收阳光，叶片般的外形，也帮它避开麻烦。
author: zweizweihander
source: POKENAME spends most of its time absorbing the sunlight, and its leaf-like appearance helps it avoid any trouble.

entry: POKENAME沿树枝爬行，寻找最闪亮、多彩的果实吃。双眼尚在发育，还没有绽开，因此很难看清颜色不鲜亮的东西。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME crawls along tree branches in search of the shiniest, most colorful fruit to eat. Its eyes are underdeveloped and have not bloomed yet, so it struggles to see objects that are not vibrant.

entry: POKENAME的下半身白天吸收阳光，夜里微微发亮。会借光引来猎物，再用毒针将其击昏。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The lower body of a POKENAME absorbs energy from sunlight during the day and glows faintly at night. POKENAME draw in prey with this glow and shoot them with poisonous needles to knock them out.

entry: POKENAME裹着尚未长成的叶片，滚动时能缓冲。这些嫩叶紧贴身体，免遭撕裂，因为得一直用到进化。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are enveloped in still developing leaves that cushion their rolling. These developing leaves cling close to their body to prevent tears, as these leaves are meant to last until they evolve.

entry: POKENAME为守护森林，在密林间滚成一抹疾驰的青瓷绿影。免不了撞见伐木工时，便喷洒阵阵毒花粉，把他们吓走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME roll through the jungle in a blur of celadon green to protect the forest they call home. When they inevitably come across loggers, they unleash a flurry of poisonous pollen to scare them away.

entry: 关都和合众的训练家学校里，有时住着一只POKENAME。它们知识丰富，会用藤蔓为训练家指点各类学问。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Trainer Schools in Kanto and Unova sometimes have a POKENAME that lives inside the building. These Pokémon are quite knowledgeable, and will use their vines to guide Trainers in various subjects.

entry: POKENAME藏在中空花苞里，吃雪补水。雪地里一滚，便黏上太多雪，最后嵌在一颗巨大雪球中。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME hides in hollow flower buds and eats snow to hydrate. When rolling in the snow, it picks up so much snow that it finds itself embedded in a giant snowball.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME通过头上的种球，喷出体内困住的寒气。体温一升高，就躺进深雪，恢复零下的温度。
author: ambrosia04
source: When in battle, POKENAME shoots the freezing air trapped inside its body through the bulbs on its head. When its internal temperature begins to rise, it lies in deep snow banks to restore its sub-zero temperature.

entry: POKENAME用缠在腰间的藤蔓，套住雪中毫无防备的登山者。一旦捕获，便悄无声息地拖回家。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME uses the vines wrapped around its waist to snare unsuspecting climbers in the snow. Once caught, they are dragged silently back to its home.

entry: POKENAME的身体比背上的种子还小，住在花园里，靠人类或宝可梦照料。受到善待、身体健康的POKENAME，种子会变成更深的绿色，渐渐露出新芽。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Smaller than the bulbs they carry, POKENAME live in gardens, relying on people or Pokémon to care for them. Healthy POKENAME with a good home grow darker green bulbs with budding signs.

entry: POKENAME背上种子里存着盘绕的长藤，用来捡拾散落的籽粒。攒够之后，POKENAME便栽下各式作物，看着它们长大。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: POKENAME stores a long, coiled vine in the bulb on its back, which it uses to scavenge stray seeds. Once it has collected enough seeds, POKENAME will plant a variety of crops and watch them grow.

entry: POKENAME把藤蔓当缎带起舞。POKENAME背上种子的大小与颜色，能反映它的年龄和健康。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME dances using its vines as ribbons. The age and health of a POKENAME is indicated by the size and color of the bulb on its back.

entry: POKENAME翼尖的种球会吸收阳光，以及跳舞时产生的多余电力。热烈助威时，种球越长越大，冒出团团带电孢子。
author: chibitales
source: The bulbs on POKENAME's wingtips absorb sunlight and excess electrical energy generated by its dancing. When cheering fervently, the bulbs grow larger and produce small clouds of electrically charged spores.

entry: 遇险时，POKENAME以优雅舞步绕着敌人移动，每振一次翅，就撒出毒花粉。等威胁被毒素放倒，POKENAME便悄然脱离战斗。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: When in danger, POKENAME maneuvers around the foe with graceful choreography, spreading poisonous pollen with each flutter of its wings. When the threat succumbs to the toxins, POKENAME flees silently from the battle.

entry: POKENAME常见于垃圾桶与大垃圾箱，以变质食物为食。它们通常很自卑，训练家只要想邀它入队，就会开心不已。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are found in garbage cans and dumpsters where they eat spoiled food. They typically have low self-esteem and are thrilled whenever a Trainer wants to have them on their team.

entry: POKENAME靠球茎般的尾巴游泳，来回摆尾，推动身体前进。游动时，会散出漂浮水中的种子。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their bulbous tail to swim, rocking the tail back and forth to propel them through the water. As they swim, they release seeds that float in the water.

entry: 渔民很讨厌POKENAME，它们常用锐鳍割断鱼线，吃掉钩上的饵。POKENAME特别顽皮时，还会猛拉鱼线，把渔民拖进水。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are despised by fishermen because they often cut fishing lines with their sharp fins and eat the bait at the end of hooks. When POKENAME feel particularly mischievous, they yank on fishing lines to drag fishermen into the water.

entry: POKENAME平时温顺，受挑衅却会凶猛反击；伤害植物，就足以惹怒它们。藤蔓分泌树脂般的物质，用来涂在树上，修补损伤。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are known for being docile, normally, but fierce when provoked; to them, provocation can be wrought by harming plant life. They secrete a substance similar to resin from their vines, which they apply to trees to mend any damages.

entry: POKENAME像园丁般照料森林，让树木安全健康地成长。遇到害虫，就从头顶种子连射籽粒，将其击退。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tends to forests like a gardener, making sure that the trees are growing healthy and safely. Pests are pelted with a volley of seeds shot from the bulb on its head.

entry: POKENAME将光合作用得来的大半能量用于长新叶，总是头晕疲惫。常不知不觉站着睡着，还多走几步，身体才停下来歇息。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are constantly dizzy and tired, as they spend most of their energy from photosynthesis on growing new leaves. They often fall asleep standing up without realizing, taking a few more steps before their bodies settle to rest.

entry: POKENAME几乎只是一颗随风飘荡的种子。若晒不到稳定的阳光，棉绒就会变得雪白，这通常意味着这只POKENAME偏爱栖在阴处。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME is little more than a seed carried on the wind. Its cotton turns stark white if it doesn't get consistent sunlight -- usually indicating a POKENAME that prefers to roost in the shade.

entry: POKENAME几乎只是一颗随风飘荡的种子。晒足阳光后，棉绒便转为鲜绿；自信的POKENAME通常爱这样晒太阳。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME is little more than a seed carried on the wind. Its cotton turns a vivid green if it gets a lot of sunlight, which confident POKENAME tend to do.

entry: POKENAME飞在翻涌的白云间，收集日光，让背上的种子茁壮成长。
author: deciduowl
source: POKENAME flies in the billowing white clouds, collecting sunlight for the seed on its back to grow.

entry: POKENAME靠日光滋养自身，每天要花数小时晒太阳。球状头部分泌黏孢子护身，腐蚀性孢子能蚀穿毛皮。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME nourish themselves by soaking in sunlight and spend several hours a day just sunbathing. They produce sticky spores from their bulbous heads to defend themselves, as the corrosive spores eat through fur and skin.

entry: POKENAME的叶片厚实得惊人，上面常留着大块咬痕。尖刺能喷出较温和的毒液，主要用来削弱对手的体力。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's leaves are incredibly thick and can be seen with large bite marks taken out of them. Its thorns eject a mild poison that is mainly used to physically weaken its opponents.

entry: POKENAME把黏液抹在花苞上，混入毒花的毒素，再将这些化学物质纳入自身。为免污染大水源，它只喝小水洼里的水。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME smears mucus on flower buds to mix toxins from poisonous flowers, integrating the chemicals into its own body. It only drinks from small puddles to avoid contaminating larger sources of water.

entry: POKENAME以矿物身体吸收阳光，使岩石肢体蜕落，重组成更致密坚韧的铠甲。每轮循环都会变强，变化的外壳映出它承受过的日光强度。
author: ilija09
source: POKENAME absorbs sunlight through its mineral body, causing its rocky limbs to shed and reform into denser, more resilient armor. With each cycle, it grows stronger, its evolving shell reflecting the intensity of the sun it has endured.

entry: POKENAME裹在叶片构成的种球中，只露一只眼。叶球的材质极其坚韧，让藤蔓有力到足以连根拔树。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME is wrapped in a leafy bulb that leaves only one eye exposed. This leafy bulb is made out of an incredibly tough material, giving its vines the capacity to uproot trees.

entry: POKENAME已经足够强壮，能稳稳托起头上的种子，也会照料自己居住的花园。它们让种子储满养分，再埋身花丛，休息时也滋养着土壤。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Strong enough to support the bulbs on their head, POKENAME care for the gardens they call home. They gather nutrients in their bulbs and bury themselves among flowers, enriching the soil as they rest.

entry: POKENAME背上的花苞放出化学信号，提醒附近草属性宝可梦提防危险。它不喜欢身体接触，连其他植物也不例外。
author: oreee0230
source: The bud on POKENAME's back releases chemical signals to warn nearby Grass-type Pokémon about any present danger. It dislikes physical contact, even with other plants.

entry: POKENAME头上长叶里寄居着大量共生藻群，让它靠光合作用维生。叶尖带着毒刺，能驱退捕食者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The long fronds sprouting from the heads of POKENAME contain large colonies of symbiotic algae, allowing them to subsist on photosynthetic energy. Their fronds are tipped with toxic spikes to ward off predators.

entry: POKENAME头顶种子浮在水面，让它能一边光合作用，一边休息。藤蔓会将太阳珊瑚撕成碎片。
author: markusknight
source: The seed on POKENAME's head floats in the water, allowing it to perform photosynthesis and rest. Its vines shred Corsola to pieces.

entry: POKENAME背上长出带刺的长叶，跑动时拖在身后。叶片善于锁水，让它们离水数天，身体仍能保持湿润。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have long thorny leaves that sprout from their back, trailing behind them as they run around. The leaves are adapted to be able to retain moisture, keeping their bodies damp for days after leaving the water.

entry: POKENAME背上的种子长得足够大，已经能让它躲进去。它在明亮日光下打盹，吸收养分。
author: apixelperfectionist
source: The seed on POKENAME's back has grown large enough for it to take shelter inside. It absorbs nutrients by napping in bright sunlight.

entry: POKENAME裹在厚触手中，遇险就能缩紧固守。POKENAME很少移动，只随潮汐变化挪位，维持日光与水分的微妙平衡。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME are encased with thick tentacles that allow it to bunker down when in danger. POKENAME rarely moves and only does so with the changing tide, ensuring a delicate balance of sunlight and water.

entry: POKENAME双臂垂下的藤蔓，会在战斗中缠住敌人。它虽独来独往，晒太阳时却容得下其他宝可梦。
author: oreee0230
source: Vines hanging from POKENAME's arms entangle foes during battle. While it is a solitary creature, it tolerates the presence of other Pokémon while it is sunbathing.

entry: POKENAME头顶种子不断吸收沙漠阳光，为一切活动供能。POKENAME用臂上的锐刺赶走危险，守护绿洲树木。
author: fiordaliso
source: The bulb on POKENAME's head constantly absorbs the desert sunlight, converting it into energy for all its activities. POKENAME protects oasis trees by driving away any danger with the sharp thorns that grow along its arms.

entry: POKENAME用沙堆出花苞般的陷阱，吸取附近生物的水分，让猎物疲惫得逃不掉。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME sets traps made out of sand that look like flower buds. This trap absorbs moisture from nearby creatures, making prey too tired to escape.

entry: 构成POKENAME身体的每粒绿色颗粒，都裹着植物组织。被头顶仙人掌扎到的对象，会觉得麻木，仿佛正被POKENAME操控。
author: oreee0230
source: Each green granule that makes up POKENAME's body is wrapped in plant tissue. Those who are pricked by the cactus on its head feel numb, as though POKENAME is trying to control them.

entry: POKENAME把爪子埋进土里，将养分吸进背上种子。它每天都这样做，免得与别人争食。
author: itsmebrewsky
source: POKENAME buries its claws in the soil to absorbs nutrients into the bulbs on its back. It repeats this process daily to avoid having to compete for food.

entry: POKENAME用藤蔓飞快套住大钳蟹、龙虾小兵等小猎物。种子散出熟鱼般的香气，引来训练家与宝可梦的注意。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME catches small prey like Krabby or Corpish by quickly snagging them with its vines. The scent that comes from its bulb smells like cooked fish, drawing the attention of Trainers and Pokémon alike.

entry: POKENAME栖居寒地，避开温暖地区众多的捕食者。那里日光微弱，POKENAME连晨昏的微光也能吸收。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME live in cold regions away from the many predators in warmer climates. As sunlight is weaker in these regions, POKENAME can absorb faint light found at dawn and dusk.

entry: POKENAME在一次极昼中积蓄的养分，足供整年使用，能量都存进花苞。只要太阳还照着，绿色背帆在弱光下也能吸能，多余能量则结晶为粉尘。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME accumulates nutrients during a single polar day to last an entire year, storing that energy in its flower bud. Its green sail absorbs energy in low light conditions as long as the sun is shining; excess energy is crystallized as dust.

entry: POKENAME对训练家极为忠诚，会不惜一切守护对方。若受威胁，POKENAME尾端种子会放出危险孢子。
author: syl_theguy
source: POKENAME is extremely loyal to its Trainer and will defend them at all costs. The bulb on POKENAME's tail will release dangerous spores if threatened.

entry: POKENAME是忠诚亲人的伙伴，会用颈圈蹭人、蹭物，标记领地。POKENAME的叶片虽略苦，却能轻轻摘下当蔬菜生吃。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME are loyal and affectionate companions. They mark their territory by brushing their collars against people and objects. While slightly bitter, POKENAME's leaves are vegetables that may be gently removed and eaten raw.

entry: 野生POKENAME多独居，专心为花苞收集养分。藤尖会长出能弯曲的木刺，用来战斗。
author: oreee0230
source: Wild POKENAME often live alone, focusing on gathering nutrients for its buds. The tips of its vines grow woody spikes, which can flex and are used in battle.

entry: POKENAME出没森林，唱着舒缓旋律，让附近宝可梦放松。它的歌声也能促进植物生长。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are found in forests, singing a soothing melody to relax nearby Pokémon. Its song is known to promote growth in plants.

entry: POKENAME吸收月光时，背上圆环愈发明亮，盈满能量。蓄满后便释放成闪耀孢子，在光下宛如星点，也能助长周围植物。
author: santon5512
source: As POKENAME absorbs moonlight, the rings along their backs glow brighter and brighter, brimming with energy. Once full, they release this energy as shimmering spores which look like stars in the light while also boosting plant growth around them.

entry: POKENAME种子上长出的叶片，渐渐包住了整个身体。它们大部分时间藏在树根之间，吸取养分，让叶片继续生长。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The leaves from POKENAME's bulbs have grown to wrap around their main body. They spend most of their time hiding among tree roots, draining nutrients to grow their leaves.

entry: POKENAME只要挥一下手臂，就能射出锋利的叶状鳞片，施展飞叶快刀。
author: hophoppip
source: With a flick of its arm, POKENAME can launch its sharp, leafy scales to perform a Razor Leaf attack.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，将头顶长草的种子露在日光下，更快恢复能量。它十分谨慎，住在林下草丛，以嫩叶为食。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME sleeps with the grassy bulb on its head exposed to the sun, recharging its energy more quickly. It is a very cautious Pokémon that lives in the undergrowth, feeding on tender leaves.

entry: POKENAME把头埋进地里，装得只像一颗种子，隐藏身形。这虽能躲过许多捕食者，却挡不住食草动物。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME hide themselves by burying their heads in the ground, to resemble nothing more than a bulb. While this avoids the attention of many predators, it does not deter herbivores.

entry: POKENAME头周围的种球，远比看着厚实，既能当盾，也能储存能量。
author: st4rdustyugure
source: The bulb around POKENAME's head is way thicker than it looks. It acts as both a shield and a storage for energy.

entry: POKENAME的种子一旦长得超过身体所能承受，就会脱下，让新种子再生。丢弃的旧种球，会被用来制作治疗道具。
author: itsmebrewsky
source: Once POKENAME's bulb grows too large for their body, they shed it so a new one can grow. These discarded bulbs are used to make curative items.

entry: POKENAME将阳光吸进背上种子，蓄够能量，便能制造小火苗。它通常温顺，但为守护训练家，也会毫不犹豫地倾尽全力。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME absorbs sunlight into the bulb on its back, storing enough energy to create small flames. Although normally gentle by nature, it will not hesitate to unleash its full power to protect its Trainer.

entry: 它靠茂盛藤蔓，吊在栖居河岸的柳枝上。POKENAME最爱柿仔果，为吃上一颗，什么都愿意做。
author: fiordaliso
source: It uses its lush vines to hang from the willow branches that grow along the riverbanks it calls home. POKENAME would do anything to eat a Persim Berry, as they are its absolute favorite.

entry: POKENAME敏捷地跃过林间树枝，穿行极快。遇到敌人，POKENAME会用苦味泡沫裹住小石子抛出，打乱对方注意力。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME move swiftly through the forest, hopping between branches with great agility. When encountering enemies, POKENAME wrap pebbles in bitter foam and throws them to disrupt their enemies' concentration.

entry: POKENAME整日将太阳能吸进巨大种子。需要时，会释放一道日光束，足以向地下打穿一英里。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME spends all day absorbing solar energy into its large bulb. When the need arises, it will release a Solar Beam capable of burrowing a mile deep into the ground.

entry: POKENAME用绿色外壳吸收阳光，维持体内闷燃。需要时，POKENAME能增湿放出烟雾，或点燃可再生的藤蔓攻击。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME absorbs sunlight through its green shell to maintain an internal smolder. When needed, POKENAME can increase humidity to release smoke or ignite renewable vines to launch an attack.

entry: POKENAME的花苞会吸收遭滥伐而死的森林生灵留下的怨恨。POKENAME警惕一切外来者，包括人类，靠得太近就会攻击。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's flower bud absorbs the grudges of forest creatures that have succumbed to deforestation. POKENAME remains vigilant toward anything foreign, including humans, and will attack if they come too close.

entry: POKENAME偏爱农场，用藤蔓帮忙照料土壤。会以毒孢子麻痹打作物主意的昆虫，再带走当食物。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME prefer to live on farms, where they use their vines to help tend the soil. POKENAME use their toxic spores to paralyze any insects after the crops and then take them away as their own food.

entry: 在日光下休息够久，身体便散出棉花糖般的甜香。POKENAME能伸长尾上藤蔓，灵巧抓住爱吃的食物。
author: fiordaliso
source: If it rests long enough under sunlight, its body begins to produce a sweet fragrance reminiscent of cotton candy. POKENAME can extend the vine on its tail to deftly grasp the foods it favors.

entry: POKENAME穿着有弹性的叶裤，拉开裤子就能增加受光面积，取得更多能量。能把裤子拉过头顶的，最可能成为首领。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME have elastic pants made out of leaves. By stretching these pants, they increase the surface area that can absorb sunlight to gain more energy. Those who can stretch the pants over their head are most likely to become leaders of a group.

entry: POKENAME的花苞太重，腿又短粗，几乎无法在陆上移动。相比之下，它更会游泳，因此偏爱待在水里。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME can barely move on land because of the weight of its flower bud and its short, stubby legs. Its swimming ability is much better by comparison, so it prefers to stay in the water.

entry: POKENAME不断吸收阳光，增厚身体的细胞壁，哪怕因此重得飞不起来也不在意。遇上身体承受不了的危险，球状身躯便会剥开，变换形态。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME will continuously absorb sunlight to thicken the cell walls of its body, even if it becomes too heavy to fly. If it encounters danger that its body cannot endure, its bulbous body peels apart to change form.

entry: POKENAME是一颗巨大种子，并非陨石。从高层大气坠下后，它会深埋土中，让背上嫩芽开始生长。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME isn't a meteor, but a massive seed. When it falls from the upper atmosphere, it buries itself deep in the ground so the sprout on its back can begin to grow.

entry: POKENAME白天打盹，吸收更多日光。夜幕降临，便用尾焰模拟阳光，为自己走动补充能量。
author: dandistorted2
source: POKENAME naps during the day to absorb more sunlight. When night falls, it uses the flame on its tail to replicate sunlight, giving it energy to walk.

entry: POKENAME每天醒来，都会先打理自己的种子。种子散发的辛香气息，也让它们精神一振。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME start their day by grooming their bulbs. In doing so, the spices that they excrete perk them up.

entry: 没人知道POKENAME真正的身体是什么样子，只知道头部保护着一颗种子。种子能连接附近的树根，让POKENAME随心所欲地指挥植物。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Nobody knows what the true body of a POKENAME looks like, only that it contains a bulb the head protects. The bulb can connect to nearby roots, allowing POKENAME to command plants at will.

entry: 草属性宝可梦见到POKENAME的美貌，会心生几分顺服。POKENAME能从濒死边缘救回植物，让遭灾的草木重获生机。
author: oreee0230
source: Grass-type Pokémon feel a certain subservience when encountering POKENAME's beauty. POKENAME can revive plants from the brink of death, restoring vitality to plants caught in disasters.

entry: POKENAME紧贴海面活动，让种子晒太阳。可惜，也因此成了大嘴鸥容易捕获的猎物。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME keeps close to the ocean's surface so its seed can collect sunlight. Unfortunately, this makes it easy prey for Pelipper.

entry: POKENAME生活在河流，贴近水面，让种子采集阳光。种子养分丰富，常引来波波等宝可梦啄食。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives in rivers, keeping close to the surface so its seed can collect sunlight. This seed is full of nutrients, so Pokémon like Pidgey will often peck at it.

entry: POKENAME把细藤伸进周围土壤，让土地披绿。POKENAME大多待在地下，铺设藤蔓时，才会探出地面查看四周。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME spreads tiny vines into the surrounding soil, turning it green. POKENAME spends most of its time underground, only surfacing to check its surroundings while laying down vines.

entry: 若地面上并排冒出三株嫩芽，就说明附近藏着钻入地下的POKENAME。它们围绕种子铺开根系，长出小小的森林或花园。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: A collection of three sprouts sticking out of the ground signals a nearby burrowed POKENAME. They create root networks around their bulbs, sprouting small forests or gardens.

entry: POKENAME有三个头，头上带花苞的负责蔓生藤条，另外两个负责守望。任一头察觉威胁，细藤便猛然伸出，卷着沙石还击。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME have three heads; the one with a bud on its head is responsible for spreading vines, while the other two heads are responsible for keeping watch. If any of the heads detect a threat, the tiny vines sprout and strike with sand and stones.

entry: POKENAME住在树木最高的枝头，额头硬币与叶片融为一体。早晨将头探出叶间，吸收阳光进行光合作用。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME live in the highest branches of trees, where the coins on their foreheads blend into the leaves. In the mornings, they poke their heads through the leaves to absorb sunlight for photosynthesis.

entry: 晴天，POKENAME静静晒太阳，保存能量。日光一消失，天生的捕猎本能便被唤醒，直到阳光重现。
author: oreee0230
source: On sunny days, POKENAME remains motionless under the sun to conserve energy. If the sunlight disappears, its natural predator instincts activate until sunlight returns.

entry: 头顶的种子泛起绿光时，POKENAME就能与植物交谈。不过这种能力会引发剧烈头痛，因此很少见它使用。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: When the bulb on POKENAME's head glows green, it can speak to plants. However, this ability causes severe headaches, making it a rare sight.

entry: POKENAME若忘了让背上种子晒太阳，就会偏头痛得厉害。它主要吃树果，吃前先放进小池塘洗净。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME forgets to expose the bulb on its back to sunlight, it suffers from extremely severe migraines. It feeds mainly on Berries, which it washes in the water of small ponds before eating.

entry: POKENAME能在河流中飞快游动。休息时，它们将身体完全浸入水中，只露出种子，宛如一片长着叶子的睡莲。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME swim through rivers at incredible speeds. When resting, they submerge their bodies completely, leaving only their bulb visible like a leafy lily pad.

entry: POKENAME住在最高的树梢，以便多晒太阳。若不在树顶，就会愤怒地攻击靠近者。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME lives on the tallest treetops to better absorb the sun's rays. When it is not on the treetops, POKENAME will become enraged and attack anyone who comes near.

entry: POKENAME的绿毛完美藏住后脑的大花苞。其他草属性宝可梦若想占它惯常的日晒处，它往往就会攻击。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's green fur perfectly hides the large bud behind its head. It often attacks other Grass-type Pokémon who try to take their usual sunbathing spot.

entry: POKENAME敏捷活泼，靠四肢周围的藤蔓在树梢荡行。生气时会甩藤蔓打向惹怒自己的对象，却常把自己缠住。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are agile and energetic, using vines around their limbs to swing through treetops. When upset, they lash their vines at the source of their anger, often tangling themselves.

entry: POKENAME的毛发更像草叶。光合作用产生的能量储存在种子中，随后便能化作口中喷出的火焰。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME's fur resembles grass or leaves more than typical fur. They store energy from photosynthesis in their bulbs, releasing it as fire from their mouths.

entry: POKENAME覆着青草般的毛，黎明站在丘顶吸收阳光。咆哮释放的强光与高热，几分钟内就能烧毁或催生一片森林。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Covered in grass-like fur, POKENAME stand atop hills at dawn to gather sunlight. Their roar generates intense heat and light, capable of burning or growing forest sections in minutes.

entry: POKENAME在浅水里摇摆行走，用叶尾互相泼水，既玩耍又补水。游泳时，尾巴始终留在水面，吸收阳光，维持能量。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME waddle around shallow water, splashing each other with their leafy tails to play and stay hydrated. They swim while keeping their tails at the surface of the water to absorb sunlight and maintain their energy.

entry: POKENAME半透明的皮肤下，可见一条细黑藤蔓贯穿身体。腹部旋纹的圈数如同树木年轮，反映年龄。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME's translucent skin reveals a thin, black vine running through its body. Much like the rings of a tree, the number of swirls on its abdomen indicates its age.

entry: POKENAME把藤蔓伸过河面，接住漂得太远的妙蛙蝌蚪。POKENAME会把手上花苞的甜蜜分享给关心的伙伴，因此总伸着藤蔓，随时守护。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME extend their vines across rivers to help catch stray Bulbawag that have drifted too far downstream. POKENAME share the sweet nectar from the bulbs on their hands with those they care about, so they always have their vines out for protection.

entry: 有些POKENAME的藤蔓与种子上，会长出仙人掌般的小刺。这些个体比温顺同类凶得多，分泌的是黏稠毒液，而非甜蜜。
author: char_latte3412
source: Some POKENAME develop small, cactus-like spines on their vines and bulbs. These individuals are notably more aggressive than their gentle counterparts and secrete a slimy toxin rather than a sweet nectar.

entry: POKENAME用叶片裹住身体，留住水分，同时吸收阳光，随时准备迎战。入夜后，会短暂展开叶片，补足水再睡。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME wrap themselves in their leaves to hold water along their bodies while their leaves absorb sunlight, making sure they're always ready for a fight. At night, they briefly unwrap their leaves to refill on water before sleeping.

entry: POKENAME半透明腹中的生长过程极不稳定，常破皮冒出种球般的拳头与乱甩藤蔓。触觉迟钝，使它凭反射出击，有时树都撞倒了，才发现自己动过。
author: char_latte3412
source: Growth inside POKENAME's translucent abdomen is highly unstable, often bursting through the skin as bulb-like fists and thrashing vines. With little sense of touch, it strikes reflexively—sometimes toppling trees before realizing it has moved.

entry: 有些POKENAME的耳朵已进化，听力更灵敏。每年春天，它们巡守妙蛙蝌蚪产卵的岸边，稍有风吹草动就立刻反应，毫不犹豫地击退入侵者。
author: char_latte3412
source: Some POKENAME possess evolved ears that grant them enhanced hearing. Each spring, they patrol the shores where Bulbawag eggs are laid, responding instantly to the faintest disturbance and striking intruders without hesitation.

entry: POKENAME背上的两颗种子储存太阳能，使它在明亮日光中力大无穷。虽有这份力量，平日却大多摊在河岸，懒洋洋地晒太阳。
author: char_latte3412
source: The twin bulbs on its back store solar energy, granting POKENAME tremendous strength in bright sunlight. Despite this power, it spends most days sprawled along riverbanks, lazily soaking up the sun.

entry: POKENAME把全部精力用于成长，一天大多在睡觉。只短暂醒来，瞬间移动到向阳处。
author: r.isk
source: POKENAME devotes all its energy to growing, sleeping for most of the day. It only wakes up briefly in order to teleport to sunny spots.

entry: POKENAME通过随身的勺子传递治愈之力。用勺子挖洞种下的幼苗，很快就能长成健壮美丽的植物。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME channel healing power through the spoons they carry. Any sprout planted in a hole dug by their spoon grows quickly into a sturdy and beautiful plant.

entry: POKENAME天性爱玩，挥拳时释放的孢子反而会让对手精神振奋。它们只借此鼓励激战，从不用来妨碍敌人。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Playful by nature, POKENAME release spores with their punches that energize opponents. They only use their spores to encourage intense battles, never to hinder their foes.

entry: POKENAME用藤蔓在森林搭起拳击擂台训练。林间空地若飘出孢子雾，就说明它们正在举办比赛。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their vines to create boxing rings in the forest to train for battle. A fog of spores drifting from a forest clearing is a sign that a group of POKENAME are hosting a tournament.

entry: POKENAME以惊人力量著称，被视为森林中的冠军新秀。进化后常不习惯第二对手臂，于是用藤蔓协调动作。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are considered protégé champions of the forest, known for their incredible strength. They often have trouble using their second pair of arms after evolving, so they use vines to stay organized.

entry: 萌动的幼苗获得意识后，以生长中的根构成身体，形成POKENAME。会缠住树木，混入叶间吸取能量，盼着有朝一日开花。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are formed when a budding sprout gains sentience and forms a body from its developing roots. POKENAME wrap their bodies around trees to blend in with the leaves and drain energy in hopes of blooming someday.

entry: POKENAME在自己萌发的植物周围，长出了一副伪装的身体。它们用大嘴一口气收集、吃下许多树果，再把养分化为能量，供给中央的种子。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Having grown a false body around the plant they sprouted from, POKENAME use their wide mouths to collect and eat berries all at once. The nutrients are converted into energy for their central bulb.

entry: 种子已占据身体大半的POKENAME，一心收集足够的食物与能量，等待开花。它们会用藤蔓搬来倒木，在种子中溶解，吸收其中的养分。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: With their bulbs now making up most of their body, POKENAME focus on collecting enough food and energy to bloom. They use their vines to gather fallen trees, dissolving them in their bulbs for nutrients.

entry: 没人知道POKENAME钟形外壳下的内部模样。只知道它会伸出藤蔓，在水中移动，直到找到向阳处休息。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Nobody knows what the inside of a POKENAME looks like beneath their outer bell. It is only known that they sprout vines that help them navigate around the water until they find sunny spots to rest.

entry: POKENAME用众多藤蔓保护头上长出的种子。没人知道藤蔓究竟从何处伸出，只知道它们似乎转瞬就能再生，甚至越长越多。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their multitude of vines to protect the bulbs growing from their heads. It is unknown where these vines stem from, but POKENAME seem to be able to regenerate or multiply them near instantly.

entry: POKENAME睡在洞口或崖壁上，与覆满苔藓的岩石融为一体。滚动时，它们用坚固的身体和粗壮的双臂，护住背上的种子。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME sleep at cave entrances or on cliff walls, blending in with mossy rocks. They use their durable bodies and large arms to protect the bulbs on their backs as they roll around.

entry: POKENAME不习惯用手臂，主要靠藤蔓在山坡移动。滚下山时会沿途播种，长出新的森林。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Unaccustomed to using their arms, POKENAME navigate mountain slopes primarily with their vines. As they roll down mountains, they scatter seeds to create new forests.

entry: POKENAME头上的花是它自己栽的，并非身体的一部分。凭着分享花朵，它无需战斗，也能寻得补充食物的矿物，以及适合晒太阳的空地。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME chooses to plant the flowers on its head, as they are not a part of its body. By sharing these flowers, it not only locates minerals to supplement its diet but also finds sunny spaces for sunbathing, all without engaging in battle.

entry: POKENAME身边已形成完整的生态系统，原来的种子在进化后硬化成了岩石。身上的花朵既能射出去，炸出密集弹幕，也能长成藤蔓发动攻击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: An entire ecosystem has sprouted around POKENAME's body, with their former bulbs hardening into rocks after evolution. The flowers on their body can be launched in explosive barrages or grown into vines for attacks.

entry: POKENAME把光合作用产生的热量储存在背上的种子里。种子伸出的藤蔓燃着火焰，让它能从对手身旁飞驰而过，打出强劲的一击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME store heat generated from photosynthesis in the bulbs on their back. Flaming vines sprout from these bulbs, letting them deliver strong attacks while speeding past opponents.

entry: 光合作用积蓄的热量，会从POKENAME身上喷发，化为火焰鬃毛。战斗时，它们按复杂的路线奔跑，让藤蔓穿过鬃毛点燃后发动攻击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Heat gathered through photosynthesis erupts from POKENAME as a fiery mane. In battle, they run in complex patterns, aiming vines through the mane to ignite them for attacks.

entry: POKENAME到湖岸晒太阳，却经常拖延到日头很晚才出门。光合作用不足，能量更少，于是又陷入相同的循环。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME wander lake shores to bask in sunlight but often delay, going out late in the day. This incomplete photosynthesis leaves them with less energy, perpetuating the cycle.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴变黄，说明它已年迈长寿。与卡咪龟不同，壳上长藻，并不代表它很老。
author: soup1900
source: If POKENAME's tail has turned yellow, it is a sign of its old age and longevity. Unlike Wartortle, algae on its shell does not mean it is very old.

entry: POKENAME坐在林中的湖畔，把尾部的种子泡在水里。野生宝可梦常来吸食其中的蜜，它却往往呆呆的，浑然不觉。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME sit by lake shores in forests, resting the bulbs on their tails in the water. Wild Pokémon often drink nectar from their bulbs, but POKENAME are usually too dazed to notice.

entry: POKENAME共有三副身体，中央大脑就藏在主身背上的种子中。释放电力时，种子会微微展开，身上的螺钉也随之发亮。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The central brain of POKENAME's three bodies is stored in the bulb on the back of the main body. When releasing electricity, the bulb unfurls slightly, and the screws on their bodies glow.

entry: POKENAME把大葱鸭的大葱换成了从身体里长出的藤蔓。它把藤蔓当成鞭子，能从很远的地方抽出强劲的攻击。
author: crazynaturekitty
source: POKENAME has traded Farfetch'd's leek for a vine that grows from its body. It uses it like a whip to deliver powerful lashes from a long distance.

entry: POKENAME顽皮又机灵，善用天然伪装藏在高草中。常见POKENAME挥着藤鞭，捉弄其他宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are mischievous and resourceful, using their natural camouflage in tall grass. Using their vine whip, POKENAME can be seen teasing other Pokémon.

entry: 与许多妙蛙种子融合体相比，POKENAME的种子更大，好让一副身体的光合作用养活两颗头。它们站在晴朗的田野，不时转动身体，让两颗头均匀晒暖。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME have larger bulbs than many other Bulbasaur fusions to support two heads with the photosynthesis of one body. They stand in sunny fields, turning back and forth to heat their heads evenly.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛没有叶绿素，无法吸收阳光。背上种子吸收羽毛色素后变红，反能引诱、困住虫子。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME cannot absorb sunlight because their feathers do not have chlorophyll. The red bulb on their back has turned red after absorbing pigments from their feathers, and allows them to lure and trap insects.

entry: POKENAME背上的种子已长成一片茂密的枝叶，让三颗头都能均匀地晒到太阳。不过，打理叶片时，三颗头常会拌嘴。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The bulb on POKENAME's back has sprouted into a leafy patch, allowing all three heads to absorb sunlight evenly. The heads often squabble as they maintain the leaves.

entry: 比起许多小海狮融合体，POKENAME更喜欢热带。它们在丛林河流中游动，让种子露出水面晒太阳，休息时则躺在浅水的岩石间，用藤蔓铺好临时的床。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Preferring more tropical climates to many Seel fusions, POKENAME swim along jungle rivers with their bulbs above the water to absorb sunlight. POKENAME will rest among rocks in shallow water, using vines to help arrange makeshift beds.

entry: POKENAME被视为热带河流的守护者，会用角清理河道里的杂物。它宽大的身躯能庇护小型宝可梦，有时还会让它们吸食种子里的蜜。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are considered protectors of tropical rivers, using their horns to clear debris. POKENAME shelter smaller Pokémon using their large bodies, even letting some drink nectar from their bulbs.

entry: 受污染植物释放的过量孢子，凝成了有意识的淤泥。淤泥守护着逐渐长大的种子，试图挽回自己曾经作为嫩芽的模样。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Excess spores from a polluted plant have condensed into a sentient sludge. The sludge protects the bulb as it grows, trying to salvage the sprout it once was.

entry: 受污染植物的孢子突变成了怪物。POKENAME战斗时洒出的污泥，会污染周围植物，甚至使其突变。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Spores from a polluted plant have mutated into a monstrous form. When POKENAME fight, they scatter sludge that can pollute or mutate nearby plant life.

entry: POKENAME是一种体型庞大、以双足行走的爬行动物宝可梦。它最醒目的特征，是出生时便种在背上的那颗种子。
author: kames
source: POKENAME is a large, bipedal, reptilian Pokémon. Its most notable feature is the bulb on its back which was planted on it at birth.

entry: POKENAME壳顶含有叶绿体，帮助进行光合作用。壳里积沙后，会拿来种植物，再留在岸边。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The top of POKENAME's shell contains chloroplasts that aid in photosynthesis. When sand collects in their shells, they use it to grow plants and leave them along the shore.

entry: 藻类聚在POKENAME壳内，形成微型生态系统。它会指挥藻类如藤蔓般抓住目标，不断收集生长所需的材料。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Collections of algae gather within POKENAME's shell, forming a miniature ecosystem. They command the algae to grab targets like vines, constantly gathering materials to grow.

entry: 黎明前，花园嫩芽间会冒出闪烁的奇异绿焰。那其实是POKENAME的孢子，正在照料植物。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Just before dawn, strange flickering green flames can be seen emanating from garden sprouts. These flames are actually POKENAME spores, tending to the plants.

entry: 据说，游魂附在初生的嫩芽上，就会形成POKENAME。它们无声地飞过夜空，吸走毫无防备的猎物的生命力，让背上的种子绽放。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are said to form when wandering spirits possess budding sprouts. They silently fly at night, draining life force from unsuspecting prey to help their bulbs bloom.

entry: 迷失的灵魂附在萌芽的植物上，吸收周围生命的养分，直到长出完整身体。它们以POKENAME的姿态继续游荡、积蓄力量，背上的种子也慢慢绽放。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: When lost spirits possess budding plants, they absorb the nutrients of living things around them until they are able to grow a full body. These spirits wander as POKENAME to continue building their strength, the bulbs on their backs slowly blooming.

entry: 据说，靠近地表的大岩蛇长出能进行光合作用的种子后，就变成了POKENAME。种子的根系贯穿岩石身体，织成一张能伸缩自如的藤蔓网。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: It is said that POKENAME formed when Onix near the surface of the ground sprouted bulbs for photosynthesis. The bulb's roots have grown through their rocky body, forming a network of extendable vines.

entry: POKENAME从种子释放孢子，让人类和宝可梦沉睡，再吸取梦中的能量。梦越甜美，种子绽放时就越灿烂。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
