source: POKENAME release spores from their bulbs that put people and Pokémon to sleep, absorbing energy from their dreams. The sweeter the dream, the brighter their bulbs bloom.

entry: POKENAME以共生的方式生活。种子为主体提供温暖与住处，主体则借助种子长出的藤蔓，伸展利爪，保护种子。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME exist in a symbiotic relationship where the bulb provides warmth and shelter for the main body. In return, the main body defends the bulb with extendable claws powered by vines sprouting from it.

entry: POKENAME过滤土壤补充养分。双螯若意外折断，只需晒半天太阳，就能完全再生。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME supplements its nutrients by filtering soil. If its pincers accidentally break, they can fully regenerate after being exposed to sunlight for half a day.

entry: POKENAME沿着海滩横着跑，寻找临水的地方钻洞。它们用大钳盛起海水，再借光合作用的能量将水煮沸，用蒸馏出的水汽浇灌种子。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME run sideways along beaches in order to find spots to burrow near the water. They gather seawater in their large claws and boil it using energy from photosynthesis, using the distilled vapor to water their bulbs.

entry: POKENAME会用脚底的吸盘爬上高树，让背上的种子，得到更多阳光。
author: curerry
source: POKENAME can be seen climbing tall trees using suction cups on its feet. This helps provide sunlight for the seed on its back.

entry: 两只绿毛虫融合后，成了比体型两倍于自己的生物还贪吃的宝可梦。POKENAME什么咬得穿就吃什么，却偏爱苦味与有毒的食物。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Fusing two Caterpie together has resulted in a Pokémon greedier and hungrier than anything twice its size. POKENAME will eat anything its teeth can pierce, but prefers bitter and toxic fare.

entry: POKENAME团结成群，守护同族免受危险猎手侵害。一张丝网只算麻烦，多张却能困住捕食者数小时。许多蛋与茧因此安然无恙。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME operate as a unified collective to protect their kin from dangerous predators. While one silky net may be an inconvenience, several nets can pin down a predator for hours. Many eggs and cocoons remain safe thanks to their efforts.

entry: POKENAME拿铁甲蛹废弃的壳片作护甲。棍棒主要用来敲下树上可口的叶子与树果，供自己享用。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses discarded parts of Metapod shells as protective armor. Its club is used mainly to knock tasty leaves and berries down from trees for it to eat.

entry: 危急时，POKENAME毫不犹豫地拿毫无防备的绿毛虫当临时棍棒自卫。不过，它还是尽量不把这件权宜武器弄坏。
author: sk372
source: In desperate moments, POKENAME won't hesitate to use unwitting Caterpie as makeshift clubs for self-defense. It tries not to damage its impromptu weapon too much.

entry: POKENAME沉着有谋，先用吐丝减慢对手。等丝线缠牢，再以猛烈踢击制敌。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a patient and strategic fighter. It uses String Shot to slow its opponents, and once they're ensnared in its silk, it strikes with crushing kicks.

entry: POKENAME用吐丝裹住对手的腿，让对方难以闪开重拳。它每天击打惯常筑巢的橡树树干锻炼。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME coats its opponent's legs with its String Shot attack, making it harder for them to dodge its powerful punches. It trains every day by hitting the trunks of the oak trees where it usually builds its nest.

entry: POKENAME用吐丝裹住对手的腿，让对方难以闪开重拳。它每天击打惯常筑巢的橡树树干锻炼。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME coats its opponent's legs with its String Shot attack, making it harder for them to dodge its powerful punches. It trains every day by hitting the trunks of the oak trees where it usually builds its nest.

entry: POKENAME常钻进垃圾桶，大吃里面的垃圾。受惊时，会先放出恶臭，再施展自爆。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME can often be seen digging through garbage cans, devouring the trash inside. If startled, it releases foul odors before Self-Destructing.

entry: POKENAME的头冠，远比未融合绿毛虫复杂。研究者发现，上面布满灵敏感觉毛，能探测其他POKENAME的信息素。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have far more elaborate head crests than unfused Caterpie. Pokémon researchers have found these crests to be covered with acute sensory hairs that POKENAME use to detect the pheromones of other POKENAME.

entry: 野生POKENAME缺乏抵御天敌的手段，常沦为各种水生宝可梦的猎物。据说，每一千只POKENAME里，仅一只能熬到进化。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are common prey for many aquatic Pokémon in the wild because they have few defenses against predators. It is said that one in every thousand POKENAME make it to evolution.

entry: POKENAME的角通常不够硬，无法还击，只能靠速度逃离天敌。据说，数千只POKENAME里，才有一只能活到成年。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their speed to escape predators because their horn is typically not hard enough to fight back. It is said that one out of thousands of POKENAME reach adulthood.

entry: 水陆两栖的POKENAME比看起来敏捷。它靠各条手臂上的眼睛选定安全方向，再拼命爬走，躲避捕食者。
author: haypile
source: The amphibious POKENAME is quicker than it looks. It uses its eyes on each arm to pick a safe direction, then desperately scuttles away from predators.

entry: 寒冬里，POKENAME会用刀刃劈入冰冷树木。砍到树心后，就吸尽其中树汁。
author: .izik
source: In the winter months, POKENAME will use its blades to chop into freezing trees. Once it reaches the center, it will suck out any sap.

entry: POKENAME用丝织裙，打扮得洁净高贵。它们极在意外表，花上数小时，确保头发与裙装怎么拍都好看。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME weave dresses out of silk to make themselves look pristine and regal. They take great care of their appearance and spend hours making sure their hair and dress are photogenic.

entry: POKENAME的角散出甜香，引波波停栖；敏感甲壳一受触动，便猛地合拢。猎物被捕后，会遭凶狠撕碎、吞食。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME's horns emit a sweet scent that attracts Pidgey to perch on them, then snap shut when the sensitive chitin is triggered. Once caught, its prey is viciously ripped apart and devoured.

entry: POKENAME成群啃食田野，一吃便是数天。草长回来的速度追不上它们吃，整片田地常被啃得光秃枯死。
author: santon5512
source: Herds of POKENAME will graze on fields for days at a time. They will consume this grass faster than it can grow back, oftentimes leaving entire fields bare and dead.

entry: POKENAME是关都最常见的融合宝可梦之一。它从触角放出毒气，驱退敌人。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is one of the most common fusions of the Kanto region. To ward off its enemies, it releases a poisonous gas from its antennae.

entry: POKENAME从地下猛然钻出，将毫无戒心的猎物整只吞下。它们出了名能吃，每天食量达体重两倍。
author: adsfw11
source: POKENAME burst out of the ground at unsuspecting prey, swallowing them whole. They are known for eating twice their body weight every day.

entry: POKENAME秋天在野外最常见，尽情享用落叶与枯叶。有些人索性请它清扫院中落叶，省了不少事。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is most often seen in the wild during the autumn season, indulging in feasts of fallen and dried leaves. Some people have taken to using POKENAME as an easier way to clear their yard of foliage.

entry: POKENAME以带电鬃毛和口中吐出的电丝自卫，也会用丝摘下高枝树果，稍稍电熟再吃。
author: sk372
source: For self-defense, POKENAME possesses an electrified mane as well as the ability to spit electric silk from its mouth. It also uses the thread to pluck and slightly cook berries hanging from high branches.

entry: POKENAME射出的丝能充当适应性极强的电子接线，几乎什么接口都能接，却不出一天就会溶解。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires strands that function as adaptable electronic cords. The threads adjust to nearly any port but dissolve within a day.

entry: POKENAME是关都最常见的融合宝可梦之一。它从触角放出毒气，驱退敌人。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is one of the most common fusions of the Kanto region. To ward off its enemies, it releases a poisonous gas from its antennae.

entry: 常青森林一带的年幼训练家，初踏旅途时很爱选POKENAME。POKENAME容易饲养，毒性又轻，既能安全接触，也能在战斗中派上用场。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are a popular fusion for young Trainers around Viridian Forest to use when they are just beginning their journey. POKENAME are easy to raise and has a relatively mild poison that makes them safe to handle whilst still being useful in battle.

entry: POKENAME吸食树干中的树汁时，会排出难闻液体，令捕食者不愿攻击。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME consumes tree sap from a trunk, it will excrete a horrible smelling liquid. This fluid discourages predators from attacking.

entry: POKENAME每周蜕皮两三次。每蜕一次，常会回头检查背上长翅膀了没有，也许这就是POKENAME蜕得如此勤的原因。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME shed their skin two to three times per week. It's very common for them to check their backs to see if their wings have grown after each new molt, which may be why POKENAME shed so often.

entry: POKENAME蜕下的鳞片，像秋天落下的脆叶。孩子们爱踩上去，听那令人满足的清脆咔嚓声。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shed scales that resemble crisp leaves that fall from trees during autumn. Children love to stomp on their scales to release a satisfying crackle.

entry: 据说，POKENAME红色触角一颤，暴风雨便将来临。它温顺而难觅，住在未受侵扰的林地深处。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is said that when POKENAME's red antennae quiver, a storm is about to break loose. It is a gentle, elusive creature that dens deep within untouched woodlands.

entry: POKENAME在树间飞来飞去，用毒刺串起水果，边飞边吃，尽量不停歇。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME will fly from tree to tree, skewering fruit on its stingers. It consumes the fruit during flight to minimize downtime.

entry: POKENAME常在清晨从树干中浮出，找叶子与花吃。受惊时，会吐丝裹住目标，再以超能力将对方滚走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME typically floats out of tree trunks in the early morning to find leaves and flowers to eat. If startled, it spits silk from its mouth that wraps around its target before it rolls them away using its psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME从头顶叶片放出特殊气味，扰乱天敌。它大多时间都在寻找蕨类植物进食，让自己更强壮。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME releases a distinctive scent from the leaf on its head to disorient predators. It spends most of its time foraging for ferns to feed on and grow stronger.

entry: 这类POKENAME从叶片分泌只有同类闻得到的气味，引它们去安全栖所。主要靠吃树果成长，壮大自身。
author: fiordaliso
source: This variant of POKENAME secretes a scent from its leaf that only others of its kind can detect, guiding them toward a safe shelter. It feeds primarily on Berries to grow and strengthen itself.

entry: POKENAME虽适合爬行，却爱踏过森林，伸长脖子吃高树叶。还未蜕变时，它总笨拙地试着爬树，常把树枝压断。
author: ecstaticwoop64556455
source: Though adapted to crawl across surfaces, POKENAME stomps through forests and stretches its long neck to eat leaves from tall trees. It often breaks branches in its clumsy attempts to climb them before it metamorphoses.

entry: POKENAME胃口极大，没喂饱就逮着什么啃什么。似乎最爱睡莲叶，因此最好别让它靠近莲叶童子。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has a voracious appetite, nibbling on anything it can get its hands on if it has not been fed. Lilypads seem to be its favorite foods, so it is best to keep it away from any Lotad nearby.

entry: POKENAME咬力强，能啃动坚韧植物和树果。偶尔也见它捕食小型宝可梦。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's powerful bite allows it to feed on tough plants and berries. Occasionally, it has been known to prey on small Pokémon as well.

entry: POKENAME喜欢拆下树间的蛛网，用来装树果，再送给其他同类。
author: schierke
source: POKENAME likes to tear down webs connected to trees. It uses these webs to hold Berries in order to deliver them to other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME按族群安排巡视一片区域。若看见友好的面孔，就会笑着左右摇摆身体。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME scouts an area determined by its pack. Should it see a friendly face, it will tilt its body back and forth while smiling.

entry: POKENAME梦想长出翅膀飞翔。如今还飞不起来，就蜷成球，像弹珠台里的弹珠般，在森林中弹来弹去。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME dreams of being able to grow wings and fly. To make up for its current inability to do so, it will curl up into a ball and bounce around through the forest like a pinball.

entry: POKENAME的触角能接收夜风中的信息素。靠这敏锐嗅觉，即使漆黑一片，也能找到彼此。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME antennae are attuned to pick up pheromones that drift through the night air. They can navigate to one another through pitch darkness thanks to this sharp sense of smell.

entry: 白天，POKENAME睡在空心树干里，躲避天敌。黄昏一到，才走到外面，嚼食花叶。
author: dodoowner_
source: During the day, POKENAME sleeps in hollowed-out tree trunks, evading predators. When dusk arrives, it ventures out into the open, munching on leaves and flowers.

entry: 它释放诱人香气，将猎物引到网上。用丝紧紧裹好后，POKENAME再注入毒液，将其溶化。
author: megashit100000
source: It releases an appetizing scent to lure prey to its web. After snugly wrapping it in webbing, POKENAME injects the trapped prey with poison to melt it down.

entry: POKENAME从口中吐出黏丝，把其他飞行属性宝可梦拉落地面。四只灵活的翅膀，让它连密林中也能敏捷飞行。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME spits a sticky silk from its mouth at other Flying-type Pokémon to make them fall to the ground. Thanks to its four swift wings, it can fly nimbly even through very dense forests.

entry: POKENAME振翼在树间飞驰，寻找成熟甜美的树果吃。它天性格外胆小，稍有声响，便全速逃离。
author: fiordaliso
source: With its wings, POKENAME flies swiftly from tree to tree to feed on ripe, sweet berries. At the slightest sound, it flees at full speed, as it is particularly timid by nature.

entry: POKENAME用丝编网，将树果带回巢。胃口永远填不满，因此很少分给兄弟姐妹。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME creates nets out of silk to carry berries to its nest. It rarely shares with its siblings because of its insatiable appetite.

entry: POKENAME从头顶触角放出道道电光，连睡觉时，身体也会间歇冒火花。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lets loose bolts of electricity from the antennae on its head. Its body will even spark intermittently while it sleeps.

entry: POKENAME吐出细丝，控制漂浮时的移动。它常随风漫无目的地飘，碰上东西就轻轻弹开。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits out thin silk threads to control its movement while floating. It often drifts aimlessly in the wind, bouncing lightly off of objects.

entry: POKENAME以嫩树芽和叶子为食，看见新生植物就啃。当地迷信称，没被它吃掉的树苗会长得健壮十倍，因此果园里常养它。
author: kungfucutbug
source: POKENAME's diet consists of young tree sprouts and leaves, and it chomps at any new plant growth it can find. Local superstition holds that the saplings it doesn't devour will grow ten times healthier, so it's commonly kept at orchards.

entry: POKENAME是家巢的首领。一巢可以有好几只POKENAME，彼此合作管理。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is the leader of its home nest. There can be several POKENAME per nest, who manage it cooperatively.

entry: POKENAME生活在气候温和之处，能适应多种条件，繁盛生息。野生个体比起变强、继续进化，更重视繁衍族群。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are found in places with moderate weather and may flourish under a variety of conditions. Instead of focusing on growing stronger and evolving further, wild POKENAME tend to focus on repopulation.

entry: POKENAME腿部肌肉弱，只好乘风飘向枝叶繁茂的灌丛。有时卡在枝丛里，反成了天敌轻易得手的猎物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has weak leg muscles, so it drifts in the wind towards leafy bushes. Sometimes it gets stuck in bushes, which makes them easy prey for predators.

entry: POKENAME每天吃下体重两倍的叶子，滋养头顶花朵。夏日阳光的热量让它们兴奋，便靠追逐其他宝可梦释放能量。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME eat twice their body weight in leaves daily to nourish the flower atop their head. During summer, the heat from the sun's rays makes them excited and causes them to release this energy by chasing other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用身上丝球承接气流，在灌丛间滑翔。不为填满大胃而吃东西时，就与其他宝可梦玩追逐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME catch wind currents with the silk balls that are attached to their bodies to glide from bush to bush. When they are not eating to satisfy their voracious appetite, they play chase with other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME不太强壮，会扭进泥土，装作一丛草。头上的角既臭，味道也难吃。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME not very strong, so it wriggles into dirt and pretends to be a tuft of grass. The horns atop its head are smelly and foul-tasting.

entry: POKENAME融合后为什么像啃果虫，至今没人弄清。谁想咬它一口，它便突然喷出黏丝，打对方一个措手不及，保护自己。
author: sk372
source: It is so far unknown why POKENAME resembles Applin after fusing. If anything tries to take a bite out of it, POKENAME will surprise them with a sudden burst of sticky thread in self-defense.

entry: POKENAME不停吃叶子，填那饕餮大胃。翅膀持续扇动，一发现附近有天敌，就能飞快脱身。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are constantly eating leaves to satisfy their voracious appetite. The constant flapping of their wings allows them to zip away when they spot predators nearby.

entry: POKENAME胃口无穷，得吃掉相当于体重三倍的叶子，才能保持健康体重。它们穿梭灌丛与树枝，尽量多花时间吃叶。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have an insatiable appetite and must eat thrice their body weight in leaves to remain a healthy weight. They zip between bushes and tree branches to maximize the time they spend eating leaves.

entry: POKENAME什么都吃，连有毒物质也不放过。这些物质会经鳃滤出、排走，因此大人总劝年幼训练家，千万别摸野生POKENAME。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME eats anything, even toxic substances. These substances are removed and expelled through their gills, so young Trainers are encouraged to never touch wild POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME用触角分析其他宝可梦的心思，判断友善与否。POKENAME身上圆环越多，朋友也越多。
author: amphi64
source: POKENAME use their antennas to analyse other Pokémon's minds and detect whether they are friendly or not. The more rings POKENAME have on their body, the more friends they have.

entry: POKENAME从头上的红色触角释放气味，标记领地，也驱走那些打扰它晒太阳的天敌。
author: curerry
source: POKENAME mark their territory by releasing an odor from the red antenna on their head. This wards off predators that disturb its sun bathing.

entry: POKENAME在森林中尾随训练家，给他们施咒。中了咒的人说，自己会突然饥饿难耐，把零食全吃光。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME stalk Trainers in forests and cast spells over them. Once enchanted, Trainers describe feeling a sudden voracious appetite that makes them eat all their snacks.

entry: POKENAME虽然庞大，却很弱，因此常被飞行属性宝可梦当成量多好抓的食物。它们默默忍受袭击，极少反击。
author: sontyp
source: Despite their size, POKENAME are weak Pokémon, so Flying-Type Pokémon often hunt them as an easy source of plentiful food. POKENAME endure those attacks stoically and rarely fight back.

entry: POKENAME在林间铺满黏网，捉住虫子。双螯先轻轻夹起猎物，再碾成美味糊浆。
author: amityblamity
source: POKENAME lines forests with sticky webbing to catch bugs. It gently grasps prey in its claws before crushing them into a delicious paste.

entry: POKENAME用钩爪爬树，寻找大片叶子吃。遇到捕食者，便喷出黏丝缠住对方，趁机逃跑。
author: infinex21
source: Using its hooked claws, POKENAME scales trees to find large leaves to feed on. It will spew sticky threads to entangle predators while it makes its escape.

entry: POKENAME搜集树果，储备过冬食物。它们不爱酸味，靛莓果之类的酸果，反会被扔掉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME forage for Berries to store supplies for the winter months. They do not like sour food, so Berries such as the Belue Berry are tossed out instead.

entry: POKENAME移动时，身体发出哧溜声，留下滚烫黏液。黏液冷却后变硬，富含养分，成为小型蛀虫的理想栖所。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: As POKENAME moves, its body makes a slurping sound, and it leaves behind a hot, sticky ooze. This ooze hardens as it cools, and makes an ideal habitat for small boring insects, as it is full of nutrients.

entry: POKENAME移动时，身体发出哧溜声，留下滚烫黏液。小型宝可梦若踩进将干的黏液，就可能被黏住，只能设法求别人帮忙脱身。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: As POKENAME moves, its body makes a slurping sound, and it leaves behind a hot, sticky ooze. If a small Pokémon walks into this ooze while it is drying, it can get stuck, and must try to get the help of others to free itself.

entry: POKENAME住在森林落叶层中，拱开叶片，找掉落的果实和新鲜蘑菇。触角对腐败气味极灵敏，总往倒木旁靠。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live amongst the leaf litter in forests, rooting around under it for fallen fruits or fresh mushrooms. Their antennae are highly sensitive to the scent of decay and they gravitate toward fallen trees.

entry: POKENAME粗硬的毛覆盖全身，抵御天敌。有趣的是，真正摸上去，却柔软顺滑。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's coarse hair covers all of its body and protects it from predators. Interestingly, it's actually soft and silky to the touch.

entry: POKENAME爱玩泥巴，却又讨厌弄脏。给它清洗时，若不慎碰了触须，就可能惹得它放出恶臭。
author: st4rdustyugure
source: POKENAME likes to play in mud, even though it hates being dirty. Attempting to clean it may result in it releasing an awful stink from its feeler if it's accidentally touched.

entry: 比比鸟等天敌飞得太近时，POKENAME就射出通电的丝，为自己争取时间，赶紧溜到安全处。
author: .izik
source: When predators like Pidgeotto fly too close, POKENAME fires a string coursing with electricity at them. This buys it enough time to scurry away to safety.

entry: POKENAME吃灌木上颜色鲜亮的花，把鹿角也染成红色。有时角会卡在枝丛里，只好哭着求救。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME eats brightly colored flowers that grow on bushes, which dye its antlers red. Sometimes its antlers get stuck in bushes, causing it to cry for help.

entry: 虽然常被人看轻，POKENAME还是整天训练，一心想要变强。它总爱向远比自己强大的对手挑战。
author: jackythewannabe
source: Considered weak by many, POKENAME spends all day training, hoping to grow stronger. It tends to pick fights against opponents far stronger than it.

entry: POKENAME靠击打树上坚果与树果磨炼技巧。有时还会把口中吐的丝裹住四肢，增强力量与防御。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hones its skills by striking nuts and berries that grow on trees. It will occasionally wrap its limbs in the silk produced from its mouth to increase its strength and defenses.

entry: 深林中，POKENAME会聚在电属性宝可梦曾待过的地方，以它们留下的静电为食。
author: dyanz0
source: Deep within forests, POKENAME group up in areas where Electric-type Pokémon previously were. They feed off of the static left behind from them.

entry: 森林里常见POKENAME攀丝上树，吃鸟宝可梦的蛋。若饿了，也会从背后缠住毫无戒心的猎物，再发起攻击。
author: articwulfi
source: POKENAME can be seen in forests using its silk to climb trees and eat bird Pokémon eggs. If hungry, it will also immobilize unaware prey from behind before attacking them.

entry: POKENAME没有原本的花纹，只好先用丝缚住猎物，再缠紧、注毒，使其昏厥。它领地意识很强，用丝线圈出地盘。
author: articwulfi
source: Lacking its pattern, POKENAME uses its silk to immobilize prey, before constricting and fainting it with its poison. It is very territorial, marking its territory with silk strings.

entry: POKENAME看似强悍，实际很弱。体型不适合爬树，就踢树、撞树，盼着叶子掉下来，再狼吞虎咽吃掉。
author: cocosquid.
source: POKENAME seems strong, but it is really quite puny. It cannot climb trees due to its build, so it kicks and headbutts trees in hopes leaves will fall, which it devours.

entry: 微弱电流流过全身，让POKENAME始终醒着。握住尾尖时，电流便穿过皮肤，让手掌酥麻。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME is always awake due to a weak electrical current running through its body. If you hold the tip of its tail, the current will run through your skin and make your palm tingle.

entry: POKENAME爱用球状尾巴弹跳，可吃完再跳，常闹肚子。弹跳也很耗力，又会让它们饿得厉害。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love bouncing atop their bulbous tail but often end up with a stomachache when they bounce after eating. Bouncing on their tail also uses up a lot of energy and makes them voraciously hungry.

entry: POKENAME的三只眼睛，有时各看一个方向。科学家说，POKENAME在留意陆上、空中、暗处的天敌；训练家却说，它只是四下找乐子。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME's three eyes sometimes wander in three different directions. Scientists say this is how POKENAME detects predators on land, in the sky, and in the shadows -- but Trainers of POKENAME say it's just looking for entertainment.

entry: 对这么小的虫属性宝可梦而言，POKENAME的外骨骼厚得惊人。检测显示，它吃岩石时，会把坚硬的硅酸盐纳入身体。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME has a surprisingly thick exoskeleton for such a small Bug-type. Testing reveals that it incorporates hard silicates into its body from the rocks on which it feeds.

entry: POKENAME会从身体喷出鲜亮的塑料彩丝，让恶作剧和派对更有趣。孩子们爱看这招，家长却想到散场后还得清扫，忍不住叹气。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME make pranks and parties fun by releasing aerosol string, a brightly colored plastic string that is propelled out from their body. While children love seeing this trick, parents groan at the prospect of cleaning up this string after a party.

entry: POKENAME给其他宝可梦的蛋裹上软丝，自认能护住它们。出于好意，却常让训练家摸不着头脑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wraps other Pokémon's Eggs in soft silk, believing it is helping to keep them safe. While friendly, this habit sometimes causes confusion among Trainers.

entry: POKENAME巡守森林，确保所有居民安全。铁甲蛹一遇险，它便飞快打倒威胁。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME patrols the forest, ensuring all the Pokémon living there are safe. If it spots a Metapod in danger, it swiftly strikes down the threat.

entry: POKENAME栖在枝叶繁茂的树上，每天大吃叶子。翅膀扇得极快，光是振动，就能震落满树叶片。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME perches on branches within vibrant and lush trees, gorging itself on many leaves each day. It can flap its wings so quick that the mere vibrations cause every leaf on a tree to be knocked loose.

entry: POKENAME成大群迁行，谁打扰就撞谁。POKENAME睡觉时，全群紧挤成一大团，壳朝外，筑成安全堡垒。
author: adsfw11
source: POKENAME travel in large herds, ramming into anything that disturbs them. When POKENAME sleep, their herd huddles together into one big clump, facing their shells outward to make a safe fortress.

entry: POKENAME鼻子里满是恶臭，既能驱敌，也让自己也被熏得嫌恶不已。蜕皮很不规律，每次随意脱下部分身体，而非整身一起蜕。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's nose is filled with a horrid stench that repels enemies but also makes itself repulse from disgust. Its molting is highly irregular since it sheds random parts of its body at a time instead of the whole body at once.

entry: POKENAME将纯粹太阳能存进分节甲壳，支撑惊人速度。它高速射出丝网，先困住敌人，再以带着叶刃的爆发突袭将其击碎。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME stores pure solar energy inside its segmented shell to power its devastating speed. It fires high-velocity silk traps that pin foes down before shattering them with an explosive, leaf-bladed blitz.

entry: POKENAME用黏丝在果树上筑巢。选的树通常天敌少、枝叶茂密便于躲藏，果实又足，够填它贪食的大胃。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME creates a nest in a fruit tree using its sticky silk. The tree that this Pokémon chooses usually has the least amount of predators in the area, good foliage for hiding, as well as bountiful fruit to sustain POKENAME's voracious appetite.

entry: POKENAME绿色皮纹让它能混入森林。若被发现，便放出浓烈气味，蜷成球，弹跳逃走。
author: articwulfi
source: POKENAME's green hide pattern allows it to blend in with the forest. If detected, it emits a strong odor, curls up into a ball, and bounces away.

entry: POKENAME轻松爬树，啃食树叶。若树下有毫无防备的猎物，就蜷成带刺的球，从上方扑袭。
author: articwulfi
source: POKENAME climbs trees with ease, feeding on their leaves. If any unaware prey is below its tree, it will roll into a spiny ball and attack from above.

entry: POKENAME用丝裹住树果，带过水中也不怕泡坏。它爱与同类玩泥巴，一滚就是好几个小时。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME wraps berries in its silk so it can carry them through water without the risk of spoiling them. It enjoys playing by rolling in mud for hours alongside others of its own kind.

entry: POKENAME吐出长丝，收取够不到的各种食物。有本很受欢迎的童书，讲的就是一只饥肠辘辘的POKENAME的冒险。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME spits long strands of silk to gather a variety of foods that are out of its reach. A popular children's book features the adventures of a very hungry POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME吃灌木叶子，留下枝条筑坝。吃下体重两倍的叶子，才有足够体力造坝。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME eat leaves off bushes and retain the twigs for the creation of their dams. They need to eat twice their body weight in leaves to have enough energy to build dams.

entry: POKENAME装成无助的绿毛虫，引猎手上钩。想来吃顿好的家伙，反会遭POKENAME突然袭击，被幽灵能量包裹，猎手猎物就此对调。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME pretends to be a helpless Caterpie to lure in prey. Would-be hunters seeking a meal will have the situation reversed when POKENAME suddenly attacks and envelops them with its spectral energy.

entry: 春季，POKENAME背上的花会散出甜香花粉，让人类与宝可梦都感到安宁。
author: curerry
source: During the springtime, POKENAME releases a sweet smelling pollen from the flower on its back. This pollen is soothing to both humans and Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用巨颚吞食找到的一切植物。无尽的食欲让它连远比自己大的草属性宝可梦也想吃，全然不顾危险。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its large jaws to devour any plant matter it can find. Its insatiable hunger drives it to attempt eating even much larger Grass Pokémon, regardless of the danger.

entry: POKENAME爬在海底，啃食沿途海草。它常扒在破破舵轮身上，误把那绿色身体当食物。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME crawls on the sea floor, nibbling on any seaweed it passes by. It's often found clinging onto Dhelmise, mistaking their green-colored bodies for food.

entry: POKENAME的甲壳中嵌着金属晶体，虽小却结实得惊人。它们能不争斗就不争斗，遇险便蜷成球，护住柔软腹面。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have metallic crystals laced within their chitin, making them surprisingly tough for their diminutive size. They prefer to avoid conflict where they can, curling into a ball to protect their soft underbelly when threatened.

entry: POKENAME以头骨猛撞，足以吓退多数天敌。只有能熔化其金属头骨的少数猎手，才有机会咬到POKENAME。
author: quackquackattack
source: The blunt force trauma from the skull of a POKENAME scares away most predators. Only a select few that can melt their metallic skulls stand a chance at biting into a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME身体僵硬，走得笨拙。绿毛虫和其他虫属性宝可梦进食时，POKENAME会勇敢护卫。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's stiff body makes it walk around quite clumsily. POKENAME bravely guards Caterpie and other Bug-type Pokémon as they eat.

entry: POKENAME已重得无法住在树上。不过，它的力气也大得惊人，再不必躲躲藏藏，反能将敌人打得落荒而逃。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has become too heavy to live on trees. Thanks to its great physical strength, however, it no longer has to hide, but can put enemies to rout.

entry: POKENAME不爱战斗，靠超声与恶臭驱敌。不过真遇危险，就会用毒刺攻击捕食者。
author: articwulfi
source: POKENAME prefers not to engage in battle, using ultrasounds and its strong odor to repel enemies. However, if endangered, it will use its poison barbs to attack its predators.

entry: POKENAME主要吃树果，最爱橙橙果。它极护着喜欢的果树，进食时会散出恶臭，赶走竞争者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feed primarily on tree berries, with Oran berries being their favourite food. They become very protective of trees that are to their liking, exuding a foul smell to drive off rivals when they feed.

entry: POKENAME平时很懒，可灾难一来，就立刻行动，帮其他虫宝可梦和它们的蛋转移到安全处。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: Although POKENAME is normally quite lazy, it snaps into action during a disaster. It will help take other bug Pokémon and their eggs to safety.

entry: 古代神话说，自时间开端，POKENAME便每天吞食1,000片叶子。学者争论，它的神力究竟来自这份食谱，还是它纯粹爱吃叶子。
author: h0bojoe
source: Ancient myth states that since the dawn of time, POKENAME has devoured 1,000 leaves a day. Scholars debate whether its divine power is fueled by this diet, or if it simply really likes leaves.

entry: POKENAME喙缘长着锋利甲壳，连最坚韧的植物茎也能咬断。它爱啃坏整齐花园，是园艺爱好者的烦恼。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a beak edged with sharp chitin that allows them to bite through even the toughest of plant stems. They are a nuisance to gardening communities due to their habit of chewing through orderly gardens.

entry: POKENAME住在林冠，常常一生都不落地。除了攀爬本领，它们也靠丝绳辅助行动。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME live in forest canopies, often going their entire lives without touching the ground. They complement their climbing abilities with ropes made of silk.

entry: POKENAME头角里装着温和毒液，对训练家无害。它胃口大，只要稍像叶子的东西，都想吃。
author: dodoowner_
source: The horn on POKENAME's head is filled with a mild poison that is non-toxic to Trainers. It has a large appetite and will eat anything that even slightly looks like a leaf.

entry: POKENAME喷出黏丝抵御威胁，丝一沾水就膨胀，变得更黏。虽然弱小，POKENAME却不肯受施舍，连训练家给的也不例外。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME defend themselves by spewing sticky threads at threats. These threads will expand and become stickier when exposed to water. Although they are quite weak, POKENAME refuse to accept handouts, even from their Trainers.

entry: 这只奇异的POKENAME，靠甩动身体挥舞自身丝线编成的链枷，驱退天敌。链枷坏了，就迅速吐丝织好。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This strange POKENAME wards off predators by using its body to swing a flail made of its own silk. It quickly spins it back together if it's damaged.

entry: POKENAME切过树冠，砍落树叶与果实。食物落地后，再切成小块，好让缎带般的双臂吸收。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME slice through the canopies of trees, cutting down leaves and fruit. Once on the ground, they dice their food into small enough pieces to be absorbed into their ribbon-like arms.

entry: 为准备进化，POKENAME每天得吃体重两倍的植物。它凶狠捍卫领地，不让同类进来，免得食物不足。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME must eat twice their weight in vegetation a day to prepare for evolution. They fiercely defend their territory from others of their kind to prevent food from becoming scarce.

entry: POKENAME将分泌的黏丝吐在猎物腿上，拖慢其行动。一察觉危险，头顶红角就亮起强光。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME secretes a sticky silk that it spits onto its prey's legs to slow them down. The red horn on its head glows brightly whenever it senses danger.

entry: POKENAME在工厂长时间工作，维持机器顺畅运转。休息只有短短几小时，许多个体便尽量多吃叶子，再回去干活。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME work long hours in factory settings to keep machinery running smoothly. During the few hours they get to rest, many spend time eating as many leaves as they can before returning to work.

entry: POKENAME的鬃毛，全由口中吐出的丝组成，似乎与幻象力量有关。丝较少的POKENAME，造出的幻象规模也较小。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's mane is made entirely out of silken thread generated from its mouth. It seems to have a connection to its illusion powers, as POKENAME with less thread casts smaller-scale illusions.

entry: 修长而分节的身体，让它能钻过狭窄的缝隙。只要POKENAME的头能伸进去，整副身子也就能挤过去。
author: melodydelune
source: Its long, segmented body allows it to squirm its way through narrow openings. Anything POKENAME can stick its head through, it can squirm through.

entry: POKENAME用强尾撞倒树木，吸树汁、吞树叶。伐木工觉得它们很好用。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME use their powerful tails to knock over trees, drinking the sap inside and devouring the leaves. Lumberjacks find them very useful.

entry: 传说，一只永不知饱的绿毛虫吃光整片森林，越长越大，便成了POKENAME。陆地上撑不起自己的体重，只好沉睡深海。
author: mistymagius
source: Legends say POKENAME came to be when a Caterpie with an insatiable hunger consumed an entire forest, growing to an enormous size. Unable to carry its own weight on land, it slumbers in the deep ocean.

entry: POKENAME身形虽大，却很容易被吓到。为驱走危险，会从口中吐出大团丝，猛砸地面，令四周产生地震般的震动。
author: sk372
source: Despite being rather large in stature, POKENAME is easily frightened by others. To fend off danger, it forms a large clump of silk from its mouth to slam onto the ground hard enough to cause earthquake-like tremors all around it.

entry: 巨大的POKENAME漫步森林，沉重脚步声吓坏孩子。可它自己，其实和普通绿毛虫一样胆小。
author: chartanon
source: This massive POKENAME wanders forests, terrifying children with its loud stomps. Despite this, it is still just as skittish as an ordinary Caterpie.

entry: POKENAME从爪尖喷出黏丝，裹住小型宝可梦。看不出它为何这样做，因为包好后，它就径直走了。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sprays sticky thread from the tips of its claws to wrap up smaller Pokémon. It seems to have little reasoning for doing this, as it simply walks away after wrapping something up.

entry: 这种宝可梦很少被看见，偶尔现身，也是在夜里收集叶子。满月之夜，则会与其他POKENAME一同享用叶宴。
author: articwulfi
source: In rare sightings of this Pokémon, it can be seen collecting leaves at night. On full moon nights, it can be seen with other POKENAME enjoying a leaf feast.

entry: POKENAME平时吃叶子，最爱的却是玫瑰花苞。若没喂够叶子，连手上的花束都想啃。比起别的颜色，它尤其偏爱红玫瑰。
author: quantumradiation
source: While POKENAME typically eats leaves, its favourite food is rosebuds. It may even try to eat the bouquets on its hand, unless it is given enough leaves to satiate its hunger. It has a particular preference for red roses over any other colour.

entry: POKENAME双腿强健，一跃能达100英尺。似乎很爱叶菜，尤其是生菜。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME have extremely strong legs, allowing them to cover 100 feet in a single bound. They seem to a have a fondness for leafy vegetables, lettuce in particular.

entry: POKENAME靠敏锐听觉躲避鸟宝可梦。有人见过它借小翅膀，去吃树上叶子。
author: articwulfi
source: Thanks to its acute hearing, POKENAME can avoid bird Pokémon. It has been seen using its tiny wings to allow it to eat leaves from trees.

entry: POKENAME夜里靠头顶小火苗，找叶子吃。即使强风吹来，这点光也从不摇曳。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME uses the small flame on its head to search for leaves to eat at night. This light never flickers, even in strong wind.

entry: POKENAME的火焰散出强烈恶臭，驱走许多天敌。据说，它靠游荡灵魂维生，贪食的胃口反让周边灵异现象销声匿迹。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's flames produce a strong, terrible odor that repels many predators. It is thought to subsist on wandering spirits, ridding areas of supernatural phenomena with its voracious appetite.

entry: POKENAME是强大而温和的巨兽，行动缓慢，免得踩扁脚下同族。许多个体充当族群护卫，赶走飞行属性的猎手。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are formidable yet gentle giants and move slowly to avoid crushing their kin below them. Many serve as guardians to their kin to ward off Flying-type predators.

entry: 基因缺陷让POKENAME长了五条腿。不过，这并没让它跑得比六尾更快。
author: articwulfi
source: Due to a genetic failure, POKENAME has five legs. However, this does not make it faster than a Vulpix.

entry: POKENAME小群生活，在树上筑巢。常误把别的POKENAME的尾巴当食物，一口咬住。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME live in small packs, nesting in trees. They frequently mistake the tails of other POKENAME for food, biting onto them.

entry: POKENAME沿木环边缘爬动，带着环滚行，边吃叶子、边收集小物件。它将收来的东西裹成彩茧，挂在环上当饰物。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME crawls along the edge of its wooden loop to roll it around, eating leaves and collecting small objects. It spins these into colorful cocoons that it hangs from its loop like ornaments.

entry: POKENAME早早就会喷火，吓得多数同伴不敢靠近。翅膀虽长，还是偏爱待在地面。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have the precocious ability to shoot flames, which scares away most of their peers. Even though they have long wings, they prefer to remain on the ground.

entry: POKENAME用纽扣装扮成绿毛虫，混进绿毛虫群。有些POKENAME拿来当眼睛的纽扣不配对，在野外就很好认。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME use buttons for its Caterpie disguise, and roams among other Caterpie. Some POKENAME have mismatched buttons for eyes, making it easy to spot in the wild.

entry: POKENAME只在夜里出来，靠触角感知四周。POKENAME虽弱，却敢一头撞向它认定的任何威胁。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME only comes out at night, using its antennae to sense its surroundings. Despite being very weak, POKENAME will not hesitate to headbutt anything that it deems a threat.

entry: POKENAME几乎总在喊饿，不停吃灌木和树上的叶子。训练家只要喂足食物，就能换来坐在POKENAME背上搭便车的机会。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are almost always hungry and constantly eat leaves from bushes and trees. In exchange for giving them lots of food, Trainers can get a ride atop POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME胃口极大，能花一整天吃叶子。谁若打扰，可能遭它诅咒，最长持续一千年。
author: articwulfi
source: With its voracious appetite, POKENAME can spend the entire day eating leaves. If disturbed, it may curse whatever interrupted it for up to one thousand years.

entry: POKENAME沿着一根树枝挪动，都要花上几个小时。可附近的叶子一吃完，它便吐丝牵住另一棵树，飞快地荡过去。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME takes hours to move along a branch. However, once it has eaten all the nearby leaves, it uses string to swing at high speeds to a new tree.

entry: POKENAME块头骇人，却很容易用土豆、玉米、豆类等庄稼喂饱。有准备的农人会将POKENAME养在田里，像门卫般赶走危害更大的害虫。
author: chinigan
source: Despite their formidable size, POKENAME can be easily satiated with crops like potatoes, corn, or beans. Prepared farmers may keep POKENAME in their fields, acting like a bouncer to keep more harmful pests far away.

entry: POKENAME受惊时，触角会放电。可电击很弱，吓不退多数捕食者。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: When frightened, POKENAME releases electric shocks from its antennae. However, this shock is quite weak, failing to deter most predators.

entry: POKENAME坐在灌丛中，露出红尾尖，盼猎物误认成树果，方便伏击。可天敌常识破这招，反把它拖走吃掉。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME sits in bushes, sticking its red tail tip out, hoping prey will mistake it for a berry so it can ambush them. However, its predators frequently see through this trick, dragging it away to eat.

entry: POKENAME凭吐丝本领与肺活量，造出黏球射向敌人。可威力有限，最多留块淤青。
author: articwulfi
source: Using its ability to produce silk and its lung capacity, POKENAME forms sticky balls to shoot at its foes. However, this does little more than leave a bruise.

entry: POKENAME住在洞穴，主要吃苔藓。坚韧外骨骼，能挡住多数捕食者。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME live in caves, primarily feeding on moss. Their tough exoskeleton protects them from most predators.

entry: 两只POKENAME看上同一片叶子，就互相顶头，争谁吃这顿饭。它们又固执，常打得难分难解，叶子却被别的宝可梦抢走。
author: sk372
source: If two POKENAME spy the same leaf, they will headbutt each other to battle over who will eat the meal. Their stubborn nature means the leaf is often snatched by another Pokémon while the POKENAME duke it out.

entry: POKENAME转动一对齿轮，为工厂供能。虽得吃大量叶子才能运作，却常见又容易替换。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce energy for factories by spinning their twin gears. Even though POKENAME need lots of leaves to function, they are easy to find and can be swapped out easily.

entry: POKENAME是工厂的重要一环，便宜可靠的旋转，能让工厂整天不停运作。不工作时，就去附近森林大口吃叶子。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are an important part of factories as their cheap and reliable rotation ensures that factories can consistently function throughout the day. When they are not working, they ravenously eat leaves from the nearby forest.

entry: POKENAME爬上高树，装作树枝。这不起眼的伪装，让它既能躲过天敌，又能享用高处叶子。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME climbs into tall trees and mimics a branch. This unassuming disguise hides it from predators while it feasts on high-up leaves.

entry: POKENAME看见多少叶子就想吃多少。不过，若发现一颗自认完美的苹果，也会毫不犹豫地吞下。
author: articwulfi
source: POKENAME tends to eat all the leaves it can see. However, if it finds an apple it considers perfect, it won't hesitate to devour it.

entry: POKENAME爱啃鲜嫩的胡萝卜叶，尤其喜欢翠绿的。偶尔藏进花园，与枝叶繁茂的植物混在一起。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME enjoys nibbling on fresh carrot leaves, favoring the most vibrant green ones. It sometimes hides in gardens, blending in with leafy plants.

entry: POKENAME夜里浮游森林，啃食还长在枝头的树果。负面情绪会让它烦躁，便朝散出这些念头的对象喷黏丝。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME levitates around forests at night, nibbling away at berries still growing on tree branches. Negative emotions agitate it, causing it to spray sticky thread at those emanating those negative thoughts.

entry: POKENAME裹着一层膜，植物质一碰到就被溶解。它们只需在灌木上蹭几下，数秒便能吃掉叶子。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are surrounded by a membrane that dissolves through plant matter on contact. By rubbing themselves against shrubs, they can devour leaves in a matter of seconds.

entry: POKENAME产出柔细的丝，可织成蓬软轻透的布料。吃饱产丝就多，因此人们常鼓励它多吃叶子。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a soft, delicate silk that can be spun into plush, diaphanous fabric. They are often encouraged to eat lots of leaves because they produce more silk when they are full.

entry: POKENAME靠大耳朵，能听见250米外的猎物。夜里若见旅人穿林，就会俯冲而下，扑向对方。
author: .izik
source: Using its big ears, POKENAME can hear prey from 250 meters away. Should it see a traveler walking through a forest at night, it will swoop down onto them.

entry: POKENAME视力惊人，比多数蝙蝠宝可梦更依赖视觉捕猎。POKENAME倒挂时，偶尔因体色被误认成铁甲蛹。
author: corndogyip
source: POKENAME possess incredible eyesight, and utilize their vision in hunting more than most bat Pokémon. Occasionally, when hanging upside down, POKENAME are mistaken for Metapod due to their color.

entry: POKENAME是哭哭面具的融合体，却没有前世记忆。脑中只剩一个念头：吃，不停地吃，永远吃下去。
author: crumple_2
source: POKENAME is a Yamask fusion with no memories of its former life. Instead, its mind is preoccupied with only one thought: to eat, and keep eating, forever.

entry: POKENAME靠静电黏附表面，连最光滑的墙也能爬，天花板上也能走。口中吐的丝略带电，也因此具有同样黏性。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use static electricity to stick to surfaces, enabling them to walk up even the smoothest of walls and even walk across ceilings. The silk they spin from their mouth has a slight charge to it, granting it these same sticky properties.

entry: POKENAME嘴边的瓣片模仿眼睛，让小生物看着更有威慑力。它主要拿这招吓跑绿毛虫，抢走它们的饭。
author: sk372
source: The flaps bordering POKENAME's mouth mimic eyes, making it seem more imposing to smaller creatures. It primarily frightens off Caterpie so it can steal their meals.

entry: 贪食的大胃让它每天吃下超过体重两倍的食物，胃口依然惊人。POKENAME飞往高层林冠，吃其他宝可梦够不到的树果。
author: quackquackattack
source: Its voracious appetite compels it to eat more than twice its body weight daily, which is possible through its high appetite. POKENAME flies to the upper forest where it can eat berries that other Pokémon cannot reach.

entry: POKENAME打喷嚏时，可能不小心将火星喷得满地都是。若不及时制止，就可能酿成山火。
author: .izik
source: Should POKENAME sneeze, it may accidentally spray embers across the ground. If not kept in check, a forest fire can start.

entry: POKENAME即使在最黑暗处，也能精准射丝。有时可见它在洞穴里吃叶子。
author: ichosuzu
source: POKENAME can shoot its strings at pinpoint accuracy, even in the darkest of settings. It can sometimes be seen eating leaves in a cave.

entry: POKENAME在暗处狩猎，用尖牙吸血。若找不到合适目标，便仍以叶子为食。
author: articwulfi
source: POKENAME hunts in the dark for prey, sucking their blood with its fangs. However, if it doesn't find any decent target, it will stick to a diet based on leaves.

entry: POKENAME大多待在下水道墙上吃霉菌。年龄越大，吃得越少，最后只咬一口便足以维生。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spends most of its time on sewer walls, eating mold. As it gets older, it will consume less and less until it can survive on a single bite.

entry: POKENAME代谢缓慢，能一连滚动数天也不累。它爱在开阔田野滚行，和其他宝可梦比赛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can roll around for days without getting tired thanks to their slow metabolism. They enjoy rolling in open fields where they can race against other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME混居普通绿毛虫群，充当它们的守护者。任何威胁一来，就会射出黏丝，将其赶走。
author: adsfw11
source: POKENAME live among normal Caterpie, acting as their protector. They will shoot sticky silk at any threat to drive them away.

entry: POKENAME的强颚不只啃得动叶子，连实木也能吃。饥不择食时，会从树枝吃到树根，将整棵树吞光。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's strong jaws enable it to devour not only leaves but also solid wood. Its ravenous appetite compels it to devour entire trees, from the branches down to the roots.

entry: POKENAME绿色的体色，能混入枝叶。可吃叶时响亮的咔嚓声，加上强烈气味，通常还是会让它暴露。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's green coloration enables it to blend in with foliage. Despite this camouflage, its presence is usually made obvious by the loud chomping it makes as it feeds on leaves, as well as by its strong odor.

entry: POKENAME找苹果时，出了名会推倒整片森林。POKENAME身体太壮，试着爬树时，却常卡住。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are known to tear down entire forests when searching for apples. Due to their bulk, POKENAME often get stuck when attempting to climb trees.

entry: POKENAME睁着无辜大眼，常被误认无害。实际胃口永远填不满，会以惊人速度吞吃冻叶与冰苔。
author: ambrosia04
source: With its innocent, wide-eyed stare, POKENAME is often mistaken for harmless. In truth, it has an insatiable appetite, devouring frozen leaves and icy moss at alarming speeds.

entry: POKENAME一看见林间空地，就忍不住想跳舞。若被谁看见，又会害羞得躲起来。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME sees a forest clearing, it will have an overwhelming urge to dance. Should it be seen by someone, it will grow embarrassed and hide.

entry: POKENAME翼尖格外锋利。为收集食物，会跳起优雅舞蹈，割下大量叶子。
author: .izik
source: The ends of POKENAME's wings are exceptionally sharp. To gather food, it will do an elegant dance and cut down large quantities of leaves.

entry: POKENAME慢慢穿行森林，沿途洒落秋叶。其他宝可梦会收集、储存这些营养丰富的叶子，准备度过寒冬。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME scatters a trail of autumn leaves as it moves slowly through the forest. Other Pokémon gather and store these nutritious leaves in preparation for cold winters.

entry: POKENAME常用尾上的假叶，混入草属性宝可梦中。靠得够近，POKENAME便开始大吃它们身上露出的叶子。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: POKENAME often uses the fake leaf on its tail to blend in with Grass-type Pokémon. Once close enough, POKENAME begins devouring any exposed leaves on their bodies.

entry: POKENAME有多重自保手段。POKENAME一见敌人就迅速藏身，黏液身体也难以抓住。若都不管用，敌人靠近时，红角便会释放恶臭。
author: sleepyman0731
source: POKENAME uses various defensive measures to ensure survival. They are quick to hide when POKENAME spots enemies. Their body is made of slime, making them hard to grasp. If all else fails, their red horn releases a horrid stench when foes approach.

entry: POKENAME紧张时，会整天大吃树果，即使吃完常晕得无法战斗。口中吐出的丝裹着恶臭油质，能让天敌不敢靠近。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME is nervous, it gorges itself on Berries all day long, even though it is often too dazed to fight afterward. It secretes silk from its mouth that is coated with a very foul-smelling oily substance, which keeps predators at bay.

entry: POKENAME上半身像绿毛虫，又有花瓣衬托，让鸟宝可梦难以抗拒。目标一飞过头顶，它便扇动花瓣，放出麻痹毒素。
author: articwulfi
source: POKENAME's upper body resembles a Caterpie, highlighted by its petal, making it irresistible to bird Pokémon. When it spots its target flying overhead, it flaps its petals to release a paralyzing toxin.

entry: POKENAME贪婪地吞食一切会动的东西，缓解难熬的饥饿痛。它连发吐丝困住猎物，再吸尽养分。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME voraciously seeks to devour anything that moves as a method for staving off its unbearable hunger pains. It fires torrents of String Shots to ensnare its quarries, then sucks the nutrients out of its trapped prey.

entry: POKENAME静伏海底，等毫无戒心的宝可梦来吃身上那枚绿毛虫般的诱饵。谁吞下诱饵，生命力就会逐渐被吸走。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME lies motionless on the seafloor and waits for unsuspecting Pokémon to attempt to eat the Caterpie-like lure attached to its body. Those who consume the decoy gradually get their life source drained.

entry: POKENAME的众多触须能察觉空气波动，感知附近生物。它胆小得很，连从自己的长须下钻出来，通常都不敢。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses a multitude of feelers that sense fluctuations in the air, letting it know if other creatures are around. Incredibly timid, it rarely has the courage to come out from beneath its own tendrils.

entry: POKENAME满身锐刺，让鸟宝可梦难以下口。因此，它常能旁若无人地大吃特吃。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME's sharp thorns make it very hard for bird Pokémon to eat. Due to this, it can often be seen gorging itself without any concern for its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME用口中丝线搭出小小构造，与伙伴玩耍。玩伴若损坏作品，它可能气得用黏丝将对方裹住，作为报复。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME plays with others by creating little structures made with thread generated from its mouth. If its playmates damage its creations, it may get upset and cover them with the sticky silk as revenge.

entry: POKENAME伸长脖子，吃高树的叶子。还会在头部纺出精细丝线构成的大皱领，显得比平时大，吓退天敌。
author: santon5512
source: Using their long necks, POKENAME eat leaves off tall trees. They spin large frills made from a fine silk on their heads, appearing larger than normal to ward off predators.

entry: POKENAME收集翠绿大叶，埋作日后零食。可惜，它老忘了埋在哪儿，反让森林处处多了肥土。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME gathers big, verdant leaves and buries them in a stash for later snacking. Unfortunately, it tends to forget where it stashed them, and this leads to fertile spots of soil strewn about the forest.

entry: POKENAME是森林生态中温和的一员，以歌声传递警报和消息，守护其他弱小宝可梦。临近进化时，会用毛发织茧，把自己裹住。
author: divinelunaria
source: POKENAME are peaceful members of forest ecosystems. They sing warnings and other messages across the forest to protect other small, more vulnerable Pokémon. When it comes time to evolve, they will weave their hair into a cocoon around themselves.

entry: POKENAME一直与背上蘑菇争夺身体控制权。它必须不停吃叶子，才能避免失去自我。
author: articwulfi
source: POKENAME is fighting the mushroom on its back to maintain control of its body. It must keep eating leaves to prevent losing itself.

entry: POKENAME秋天最活跃，啃食林地落叶。若被不慎踩中或打扰，就会从身体释放恶臭。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are most active during autumn, eating fallen leaves off the forest floor. If accidental stepped on or disturbed, they will release a horrid stench from their bodies.

entry: POKENAME懒洋洋地嚼热带藤蔓，令空气泛起淡淡红椒粉香。据说能驱退天敌，却也有些家伙只觉得好闻。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME chews lazily on jungle vines, filling the air with a subtle paprika-like aroma. This scent is said to ward off predators, though some simply find it pleasant.

entry: POKENAME的镰刀每月蜕壳数次，保持锋利。历代收藏家细细仿照蜕下的旧壳，制作格外漂亮的刀刃。
author: puppylev
source: POKENAME's sickles molt several times a month to stay sharp. The discarded cast has been closely copied by collectors across the ages to make particularly beautiful blades.

entry: POKENAME一抖毛，就扬起一阵绿粉。粉末落在人皮肤上，会随对方心情变色。
author: .izik
source: Any time POKENAME shakes its fur, a waft of green dust is shaken loose. The dust will change color on a person's skin based on their mood.

entry: POKENAME常见于许多温带森林，通常在吃叶子和枝条。它们格外胆小，稍闻尖锐声响，就很可能逃跑。
author: fancyskunk
source: POKENAME are commonplace in many temperate forests, where they are typically seen eating leaves and twigs. They are particularly timid and likely to flee upon hearing any sharp noise.

entry: POKENAME的围巾其实由自己吐出的丝制成。POKENAME也会把这些丝投向敌人。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: The scarf of POKENAME is actually made from string produced by POKENAME. POKENAME uses string that it creates to throw at foes.

entry: POKENAME在空心南瓜里织丝。捡到这种内衬丝线的南瓜，人们会视为幸运。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME weaves strands of silk inside hollowed-out pumpkins. These silk-lined pumpkins are considered lucky by those who find them.

entry: POKENAME双翼满是带毒、能麻痹的鳞粉。鸟宝可梦若想攻击，它便不断振翼，掀起毒雾。
author: articwulfi
source: The wings of POKENAME are filled with toxic and paralyzing dust. If a bird Pokémon tries to attack it, it will flap its wings repeatedly to create a poisonous fog.

entry: POKENAME常吃花蜜与花瓣，让毛皮也有美味花香。为免被天敌当零食，又会从头角放出恶臭，连自己的滋味也糟蹋了。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME snacks on nectar and flower petals, giving its fur a delicious floral flavor. To keep predators from snacking on it, it produces a foul odor from the horn on its head, which also ruins its own flavor.

entry: POKENAME大多待在树上找苹果吃。它们从口中分泌焦糖般的黏液，先给找到的苹果裹一层，再吃下去。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME spend most of their time in the trees, searching for apples to eat. They secrete a caramel-like mucus from their mouths, which they coat the apples they find in before consuming them.

entry: 这种宝可梦擅长挖掘覆满丝的地下隧道。谁一碰丝线，就会惊动大群POKENAME。
author: articwulfi
source: This Pokémon is known for creating subterranean tunnels covered in silk. If anyone touches the silk, it will alert a horde of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的特殊丝线能织成婚纱，价格昂贵。香气也独特，会随POKENAME的食谱而变化。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a special silk that is spun into wedding dresses. These expensive dresses have a unique scent that varies based on the diet of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME看似三只不同宝可梦，其实是一体三头。每个头都不停争夺主导权，尤其牵涉食物时，更是如此。
author: articwulfi
source: Although it may seem like three different Pokémon, POKENAME is a single Pokémon with three heads. Each head fights constantly for dominance, especially when food is involved.

entry: POKENAME吊在树枝上，趁猎物不备出手。胡须能察觉最远100码外受伤的目标。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hangs from tree branches to catch its prey off-guard. Its whiskers can sense an injured target from up to 100 yards away.

entry: 这种宝可梦靠吃叶子，控制自己的精神力量。因此，饥饿的POKENAME十分危险，越失控，放出的超能力波动就越强。
author: articwulfi
source: This Pokémon eats leaves to control its mental powers. For this reason, a hungry POKENAME is dangerous, as it generates psychic waves that get stronger as it loses control.

entry: POKENAME住在红树林沼泽，不停吞吃落进泥水的叶片与果实。常因吃太多而不适，又把这份感觉投给其他宝可梦，让附近对象肚痛得无法行动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in mangrove swamps, constantly gorging themselves on leaves and fruit that fall into the swampy water. They frequently overeat, projecting their discomfort outward at other Pokémon and causing debilitating stomach aches to those nearby.

entry: POKENAME用带蹼的肢体潜进深水，寻找藻类。一发现捕食者，就飞快逃走。
author: articwulfi
source: POKENAME uses its webbed appendages to dive into deep waters in search of algae. If it spots a predator, it swiftly flees.

entry: POKENAME几乎一直在生气，连睡着也一样。只有吃叶子时，才被见过平静的模样。
author: articwulfi
source: POKENAME is almost always angry, even when sleeping. It has only been seen at peace while eating leaves.

entry: POKENAME总因饥饿而愤怒。若进食时受打扰，就会一路追着始作俑者，直到在战斗中击败对方。
author: articwulfi
source: POKENAME is always angry due to its hunger. If it is ever disturbed while eating, it will pursue whatever disturbed it until it beats it in combat.

entry: POKENAME出了名忠诚。一察觉威胁，就靠吠叫和强烈恶臭，保护训练家。
author: articwulfi
source: POKENAME is known for being a very loyal Pokémon. If it detects a menace, it will protect its Trainer by barking and releasing a very strong odor.

entry: POKENAME把叶子藏进鬃毛，留给幼崽。体内火焰的品质，与它吃下多少叶子直接相关。
author: articwulfi
source: POKENAME stashes leaves in its mane for its young. The quality of the fire inside it is directly linked to the amount of leaves it eats.

entry: POKENAME尾上小火苗微弱，只是温温的。近来，它作为温室授粉帮手，越来越受欢迎。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: The diminutive flame on POKENAME's tail is weak and lukewarm. In recent times, it has grown in popularity as a greenhouse pollinator.

entry: POKENAME在陆地上很容易沦为猎物，遭鸟宝可梦攻击。即便如此，仍会游荡森林，寻找落叶。
author: articwulfi
source: POKENAME is an easy prey on land, being attacked by bird Pokémon. Despite this, it wanders the forest searching for fallen leaves.

entry: POKENAME听力极差，便靠触角感知动静，稍有风吹草动，就毫不迟疑地瞬间移动逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's hearing is terrible. Due to this disability, it senses disturbances by using its antennae and teleports away without a second thought.

entry: POKENAME拿着的探测棒如同触角延伸，能辅助察觉周围。受威胁时，POKENAME一棒放出恶臭，另一棒吐丝，裹住敌人。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The dowsing rods that POKENAME carry act as an extension of their antennae and help them detect their surroundings. When threatened, POKENAME release a horrible stench from one rod while wrapping the foe in string from the other.

entry: POKENAME把时间全用在锻炼肌肉上，因此要吃下大量叶子。
author: articwulfi
source: POKENAME spends all its time training to develop its muscles. Because of this, it consumes large quantities of leaves.

entry: 鸟宝可梦若想袭击，POKENAME便以强壮肌肉抓住、勒紧对方。它住在深林，每天锻炼。
author: articwulfi
source: If a bird Pokémon tries to attack it, POKENAME will grab and choke it with its muscles. It lives in deep forests where it trains daily.

entry: POKENAME先吞吃巨树，壮大肌肉，再与其他POKENAME摔跤。它们用丝制作精巧面具和手套，打斗时自豪地炫耀。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME devours enormous trees to buff its muscles before it wrestles with other POKENAME. They create elaborate masks and gloves with silk and proudly show them off during fights.

entry: POKENAME开心地跑遍森林，寻找黄球果。一找到，就试着把整颗果子一口吞下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME happily runs across entire forests searching for Yellow Apricorns. Should it find one, it will attempt to devour the entire fruit in one motion.

entry: POKENAME静静吊在树上等猎物。一见目标，就射丝将其缚住，再猛扑过去。
author: articwulfi
source: POKENAME hangs motionless in trees, waiting for prey. When it spots one, it shoots silk strings to immobilize it before lunging at it.

entry: POKENAME模仿绿毛虫，引猎物靠近。猎物一进嘴，就会被酸液溶解。
author: articwulfi
source: POKENAME mimics a Caterpie to attract prey. Once the prey is in its mouth, it dissolves them with acid.

entry: POKENAME常用触手吊在树上，平时吃叶子。受打扰时，便用毒触手攻击敌人。
author: articwulfi
source: POKENAME can be found hanging from trees by its tentacles, usually feeding on leaves. If disturbed, it will use its poisonous tentacles to attack its foes.

entry: POKENAME用触手缚住猎物。若还不够，就从触手吐丝，将目标裹成茧。
author: articwulfi
source: POKENAME uses its tentacles to immobilize prey. If that's not enough, it will produce silk from them to trap its target in a cocoon.

entry: POKENAME常在树上啃叶。别的宝可梦若靠得太近，就砸落下来，用坚硬身体将其撞伤。
author: articwulfi
source: POKENAME is commonly seen feeding on leaves in trees. If a Pokémon comes too close, it will drop on it, using its hard body to cause harm.

entry: POKENAME会被滚送进沙漠，让旱地重现绿意。岩石身体里满是种子与苔藓，构成微型生态环境，具备历经数十年将沙漠变回森林的一切条件。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are rolled into the desert to bring greenery back into arid land. Their rocky bodies have everything needed to turn deserts back into forests over the span of decades, as each POKENAME has a mini-biome full of seeds and moss.

entry: 森林里常见POKENAME吃落叶。一察觉威胁，就飞快穿过树间逃跑。
author: articwulfi
source: POKENAME can often be seen in the forest, feeding on fallen leaves. If it detects a menace, it will swiftly run away between the trees.

entry: 鸟宝可梦常想袭击POKENAME，却徒劳无功，因为没谁追得上它的跑速。偶尔歇脚，便吃几口落叶，再疾驰而去。
author: articwulfi
source: Bird Pokémon often try to attack POKENAME without success, as none can rival its running speed. When it finds time to rest, it feeds on fallen leaves before dashing off again.

entry: 为免整只被吃，POKENAME会退让，让天敌咬下尾巴吃掉。它不断蜕皮，尾巴几天就能长回，恢复完整。
author: soup1900
source: To prevent being fully eaten, POKENAME allows predators to take and eat its tail off as a concession. With it constantly molting, it easily regrows the tail back in a few days to become whole again.

entry: POKENAME没了吸盘，只好用丝黏住树木，再用三指爪攀爬，够最高处的叶子。中途若跌落，就缩进壳，放出强烈气味。
author: articwulfi
source: Having lost its suction pads, POKENAME uses its silk to stick to trees and climbs with its three-fingered claws to get the highest leaves. If it falls in the process, it will hide in its shell and produce a strong odor.

entry: 看似尾巴上的铁甲蛹在吸取养分，实际却是POKENAME从铁甲蛹吸收养分，为自己进化供能。
author: articwulfi
source: Although it looks like the Metapod on its tail is taking nutrients from this Pokémon, it is actually POKENAME who absorbs them from Metapod to fuel its evolution.

entry: POKENAME身侧的角噼啪放电。鸟宝可梦一口咬下时，它便用尽力气，狠狠电击对方。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: The horns on POKENAME's sides crackle with electricity. When a bird Pokémon bites down, it zaps them with all the might it can muster.

entry: POKENAME周身有强大磁场。它靠磁场打乱鸟宝可梦的迁徙路线，将它们引得远远的。
author: articwulfi
source: POKENAME has a very strong magnetic field around its body. It uses this magnetic field to disrupt bird Pokémon migration paths, luring them far away from its position.

entry: 其他鸟宝可梦常把POKENAME当猎物，发起袭击。它试着用大葱自卫，收效却不大。
author: articwulfi
source: POKENAME is often attacked by other bird Pokémon, who see it as prey. It tries to defend itself with its leek, without much success.

entry: POKENAME一个头进食，另一个总在警戒。虽能从口中吐黏丝自卫，有时却也会被自己的丝缠住。
author: infinex21
source: One of POKENAME's heads will always be on the lookout for threats as the other head eats. Though they can defend themselves with sticky threads loosed by their mouths, they may sometimes get tangled in their own threads.

entry: POKENAME的几个头常为食物争吵，为最好的叶子互相顶撞。受威胁时，三个头会同时释放恶臭。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME's heads frequently squabble over food, headbutting each other for the choicest leaves. If threatened, all three release foul odors at the same time.

entry: POKENAME在寒海狩猎，潜入深处捕鱼。肺较小，只能频繁浮出水面，捕猎效率并不高。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME hunts in frigid seas, diving deep for fish. Its smaller lungs force it to surface frequently, making it an inefficient hunter.

entry: POKENAME靠触角产生浓烈气味，甚至能令敌人麻痹。遇险时，放出的臭气强得数英里之外也闻得到。
author: articwulfi
source: Thanks to POKENAME's antennae, it can produce a very strong odor capable of paralyzing its foes. If endangered, it releases a scent so intense that it can be smelled from miles away.

entry: POKENAME胃口可怕，是极其危险的生物污染源。吞食废物越多，毒性就越骇人。
author: articwulfi
source: POKENAME is a biohazard and highly dangerous due to its voracious appetite. As it devours waste, its toxicity reaches alarming levels.

entry: POKENAME载着绿毛虫穿过宽阔水域，寻找食物、建立新群落。同伴会送上最大的树果作为回报。
author: mirpebble
source: POKENAME carries Caterpie across large bodies of water to find food and form new colonies. In return, the colony gives POKENAME the largest berries.

entry: POKENAME浮游林间，常小群出现。一受惊，就会迅速消失得无影无踪。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME floats through forests, often seen in small groups. If frightened, it quickly vanishes into thin air.

entry: POKENAME夜里活动，舔舐叶子和草属性宝可梦，吸取能量与养分，因此巢穴里到处是枯叶。它们会试着吓退来者，若失败，就赶紧逃跑。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are nocturnal Pokémon that lick leaves and Grass-type Pokémon to siphon their energy and nutrients; their dens are riddled with wilted leaves as a result. They will try to scare away others but quickly flee if their efforts fail.

entry: POKENAME在森林地下掘行，寻找树木，找到便吃掉根。胃口惊人，若不加管束，整片森林都可能被毁。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME burrows underneath forests, looking for trees. Once it finds one, it devours the roots. Its massive appetite can destroy forests if left unchecked.

entry: POKENAME用催眠诱饵控制整群虫宝可梦，强迫它们替自己作战，弥补自己平平的战斗本领。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its hypnotic lure to put entire swarms of Bug Pokémon under its control. It forces them to fight for it in combat because of its lackluster combat prowess.

entry: POKENAME背上的种子里蓄着不稳定的电能，受到干扰就可能引发大爆炸。它用电线般的藤蔓，从植物中抽取能量。
author: mistymagius
source: The bulb on POKENAME's back contains unstable electrical energy, and disrupting it could cause a large explosion. It uses its wire-like vines to siphon energy from plant matter.

entry: 暴风雨之夜，成群POKENAME会出来，用杆状触角引雷。性情好斗，常互相电击取乐。
author: mistymagius
source: During stormy nights, swarms of POKENAME emerge to draw lightning bolts with their rod-like antennae. They are aggressive Pokémon, often shocking each other for fun.

entry: POKENAME的旧壳碎片，常见于训练场附近，资深训练家会特地寻找。碎片熔化后，用于制作等级球的多层结构。
author: jaminmcready
source: Fragments of POKENAME's old shell are often found near training grounds, where experienced Trainers seek them out. These fragments are melted down and used in the layered construction of a Level Ball.

entry: 这只POKENAME与自身融合时，基因出现怪变化，外形像把四种主要精灵球各拼了一部分。研究者认为，或许还存在未被发现的霹雳电球种类。
author: infranscia
source: When this POKENAME underwent self-fusion, something strange happened in its genetics, causing it to look like a split of the four main varieties of Poké Ball.  Researchers believe this might mean there are varieties of Voltorb yet undiscovered.

entry: POKENAME的外观变得像古老精灵球的原型设计。这个形态性情似乎较稳定，也不那么容易爆炸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's appearance has changed into one resembling an old prototype design for the Pokéball. Its behavior seems less volatile in this form, and it is less prone to exploding.

entry: POKENAME能像精灵球般打开身体。脾气虽爆，却喜欢把小型宝可梦装在身体里带着走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can open its body like a Poké Ball. Despite its explosive temper, it enjoys carrying small Pokémon in its body.

entry: POKENAME能从体内放出迷你分身。小分身会朝同一方向连续跳几下，再爆发出惊人威力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can deploy little miniature versions of itself from within its body. These smaller facsimiles hop forward several times in a single direction before exploding with surprising force.

entry: POKENAME身体分成六个精灵球状单元，彼此以心灵感应相连。它常住在友好商店仓库，巧妙混入货架与货箱间。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body is divided into six Pokéball–shaped units, all linked telepathically. It often dwells in Pokémarket warehouses, skillfully camouflaging itself among shelves and inventory boxes.

entry: 捡到霹雳电球的外壳当头盔，如今已与头部融为一体。POKENAME还能借用其中一些力量。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This Pokémon picked up the shell of a Voltorb and wore it as a helmet. It is now fused to its head, and POKENAME borrows some of its power.

entry: POKENAME孤僻易怒，常藏在灌丛或林下草木间，避免接触其他对象。谁若撞上硬壳，可能惹得它怒到把自己炸掉。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a rather solitary and irritable Pokémon, to avoid contact with others, it usually hides in bushes or undergrowth. If someone bumps into its hard shell, it may get so angry that it blows itself up.

entry: POKENAME藤蔓末端冒着火花，显出体内强盛电力。有些地区会把断落的藤蔓，拿来制作高导电性的电线。
author: sk372
source: Sparks emanate at the end of POKENAME's vines, signifying the potent electricity it possesses within. Severed vines have been used as materials for highly-conductive electrical wiring in some regions.

entry: 人们认为，翅上的精灵球花纹，是用来吓退天敌。POKENAME会一边旋转，一边飞向潜在威胁，仿佛一颗正要收服对方的精灵球。
author: foolish_weasel
source: It is thought that the Pokéball pattern on its wings are meant to intimidate predators away. POKENAME will fly at potential threats while spinning, mimicking the image of an incoming Pokéball trying to catch the predatory Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME是杂耍高手，常用精灵球抛接，却更爱用霹雳电球。毕竟，没有什么比掉地上就会炸的球，更能抓住观众目光。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is a master juggler. While it often uses Pokéballs, it prefers to juggle Voltorb, as nothing holds the attention of an audience better than balls that explode if dropped.

entry: POKENAME用强壮双手握住电线吸电。若一下吸得太多，就会毫无预兆地猛烈爆炸。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME absorbs electricity by gripping power lines with its strong hands. If it takes in too much at once, it explodes violently without warning.

entry: POKENAME从头尾迸出明亮电弧，震慑敌人。雷光既能电击，也炽热得足以灼伤。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME intimidates foes by brightly flashing arcs of electricity out of its head and tail. This lightning is hot enough to burn as well as shock.

entry: POKENAME酷似卡洛斯的彩粉蝶，相似得令人费解，却是独立物种。两者最大的不同，或许就在它双翼天生储存的电压。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Bearing a striking resemblance to the Pokémon Vivillon from the Kalos region, POKENAME is its own species, despite the puzzling similarities. The innate electrical voltage stored in its wings is perhaps the biggest key difference between the two.

entry: 危急时，POKENAME会爆炸保护训练家，将尖针射向四方，有时连训练家也会误伤。
author: .izik
source: In emergencies, POKENAME explodes to defend its Trainer, flinging sharp pins in all directions - sometimes injuring its Trainer as well.

entry: POKENAME出现在电脑屏幕上时，十分不稳定。必须小心应对，免得它爆炸，损坏用户的文件与数据。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a volatile presence when it appears on a computer screen. It must be carefully dealt with, lest it explode and damage the user's files and data.

entry: POKENAME直到近来才有记录，或许与霹雳电球来历神秘、多边兽由人造出有关。它靠悬浮移动，电磁场一扰动，心情与身体能力都会大受影响。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME was only documented recently, possibly due to Voltorb's mysterious origins and Porygon's artificial creation. It moves through levitation, but disruptions in the electromagnetic field greatly affect its mood and physical abilities.

entry: POKENAME原本独处，认定的敌人一靠近，就猛扑追赶，轻轻嘶嘶作响后爆炸。多边兽虽是人造，POKENAME身上却有苔藓气味。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME keeps to itself until whatever it has deemed a foe comes too close, upon which it begins to lunge after them. After emitting a soft hissing sound, it explodes. Despite Porygon's artificial origins, POKENAME smells like moss.

entry: POKENAME原本独处，认定的敌人一靠近，就猛扑追赶，轻轻嘶嘶作响后爆炸。多边兽虽是人造，POKENAME身上却有苔藓气味。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME keeps to itself until whatever it has deemed a foe comes too close, upon which it begins to lunge after them. After emitting a soft hissing sound, it explodes. Despite Porygon's artificial origins, POKENAME smells like moss.

entry: POKENAME准备下一次进化时，状态极不稳定。蜕变过程中，壳内热量升至危险程度，任何干扰都可能酿成灾难性爆炸。
author: houseoffallingflowers
source: POKENAME exists in an extremely volatile state as it prepares for its next evolution. The heat inside its shell reaches dangerous levels as it undergoes metamorphosis, and any interruption of this process can result in a catastrophic explosion.

entry: 大型鸟类靠得太近，POKENAME就射出爆发的电流。平时却独来独往，滑翔天空，寻找下一顿饭。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shoots explosive bursts of electricity towards large birds that come too close. It is otherwise a solitary creature that glides through the skies in search of its next meal.

entry: POKENAME拍打大肚皮，在体内发电。若短时间连拍得够快，便能积出足以引发强力爆炸的能量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME generates electricity within itself by smacking its large belly. If it smacks its belly quickly enough in short succession, it can create enough energy to trigger a powerful explosion.

entry: POKENAME一见弱小宝可梦受伤，就会迅速暴怒。它把体内电力集中到触角，朝施害者放出道道雷电。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can quickly fly into a rage whenever it sees smaller Pokémon being hurt. It focuses internal electricity into its antennae, using them to cast lightning bolts at the perpetrator.

entry: POKENAME让球形前肢互撞，放出电流，同时威吓宝可梦和人。它们成大群生活，为守护领地，每只都愿扑向敌人，以爆炸应战。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME smack together their spherical forelimbs to discharge electricity and intimidate Pokémon and people alike. They live in large swarms, with each one being willing to throw themselves at their foes and explode to protect their territory.

entry: POKENAME把大量爆炸能量导进尾端圆球。将球砸向地面，便会炸出深度和半径都可达20英尺的大坑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME channels much of its explosive energy into the orb at the end of its tail. Striking it down on the ground creates explosions able to make craters reaching 20 feet in depth and radius.

entry: 谁扰乱POKENAME栖居的花园，就会惹怒它。它从花环抖落小球，每颗爆炸威力，都足以留下小坑。
author: sk372
source: Anyone who disturbs the flower gardens POKENAME inhabits will incur its ire. It shakes loose little orbs from its flower wreath, each packed with enough explosive power to leave small craters behind.

entry: POKENAME越生气，顶部肢体间的电弧就越强。若不冷静下来，连自己也会被电到。
author: char_latte3412
source: The electric arc between POKENAME's top appendages will increase in intensity as it gets angry. It will start shocking itself if it doesn't calm down.

entry: POKENAME不善控制电力，受惊常会自发爆炸。它努力保持镇静，碰上雷暴却很难做到。
author: .izik
source: Due to poor electricity control, POKENAME often explodes spontaneously when frightened. It tries to stay calm but struggles during storms.

entry: POKENAME被抱起时，会炸出大团火花抗议，装得比实际更强硬。可这下反让它头晕力竭，康复前连移动都得求助。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: In an attempt to appear tougher than they actually are, POKENAME protest getting picked up by unleashing a large explosion of sparks. Unfortunately, this act leaves them dizzy and exhausted, requiring them to get help moving until they recover.

entry: POKENAME的羊毛中蓄着强大电力，最好不要触碰。那些在羊毛里盘旋的电流，还能从尾巴射出去。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME's wool is highly energized, so it is not advisable to touch it. It can shoot the electricity swirling around in its wool via its tail.

entry: POKENAME把体内产生的电力，导入颈毛与毛簇。必要时，再由尾巴聚成一束射出。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME directs the electricity generated in its body into its ruff and tuft. If necessary, it can shoot it in a bundle via its tail.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴像避雷针，能吸来附近电力。高压线常受波及，造成短暂停电。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME's tail acts as a lightning rod that can attract nearby electricity. High voltage power lines are often affected, causing temporary power blackouts.

entry: POKENAME被视为高度危险，会啃电线吸电。若一下吃得太多，就会爆炸，造成更大破坏。
author: sk372
source: A POKENAME is considered highly dangerous: it gnaws on electrical wires to siphon electricity, but if it consumes too much at one time, it will explode and cause greater damage.

entry: POKENAME常把自己弄得短路，倒浮在水中。这个状态无法取得经验值，因此很少进化。住在族群附近的人，会自愿把它们捞起来。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are often found floating upside down in water, having short-circuited themselves. They cannot gain Experience in this state and so rarely evolve. Some people that live near POKENAME colonies volunteer and fish them out of the water.

entry: 聪明的头脑让POKENAME压得住敏感性子，不理会大多数挑衅。可每一分怠慢与不公，它都记着，细算爆炸复仇的最佳时机。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: POKENAME's intelligence tempers its sensitive nature, allowing it to ignore most provocations. It remembers every slight and injustice, carefully calculating the perfect moment for its explosive revenge.

entry: 藤蔓像电缆，既能引导电流，也能吸电。POKENAME一烦躁，就会猛烈抽打，过量电流在藤蔓内外奔涌，令其发光。
author: infinex21
source: Its vines function like cables, allowing it to channel electricity or absorb electricity through them. An agitated POKENAME will violently lash out with its vines, which will glow with the excess electricity flowing through and around them.

entry: POKENAME穿梭大垃圾箱，寻找残羹。一找到大量食物，就会高兴得爆炸，连垃圾箱也炸毁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME skitters through dumpsters in search of scraps. If it finds a large stash of food, it explodes in joy, destroying the dumpster.

entry: POKENAME出没于古文明遗迹，装点通往藏宝室的廊壁。不理它们便无害，可一念出声，就会自爆。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are found in the ruins of ancient civilisations, adorning the walls in corridors leading to treasure rooms. They are harmless if ignored, but will self-destruct when read aloud.

entry: POKENAME出没古文明遗迹，装点通往藏宝室的廊壁。有些POKENAME闭眼混在未知图腾旁，欺骗粗心来者，等读者靠得太近便引爆。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are found in the ruins of ancient civilisations, adorning the walls in corridors leading to treasure rooms. Some POKENAME lie in wait alongside Unown with their eyes closed to fool the unwary, detonating when the reader gets too close.

entry: POKENAME出没于古文明遗迹，装点通往藏宝室的廊壁。不理它们便无害，可一念出声，就会自爆。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are found in the ruins of ancient civilisations, adorning the walls in corridors leading to treasure rooms. They are harmless if ignored, but will self-destruct when read aloud.

entry: POKENAME俯冲轰袭附近宝可梦巢穴，一撞就炸。一群POKENAME若被惹怒，很快就能毁掉整片区域。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME divebombs nearby Pokémon nests, exploding on impact. A flock of POKENAME can quickly decimate an entire area if provoked.

entry: POKENAME的双螯碰到东西就会爆炸。电力形成的翅膀不能飞，反而用来给POKENAME供电。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME's pincers explode whenever they make contact with something. Its wings formed from electricity cannot be used to fly, and are instead used to provide POKENAME with electrical energy.

entry: POKENAME壳中混着极易突然燃烧的挥发性气体。受威胁时，POKENAME便用电火花点燃壳内气体，引发强力的大爆炸。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME shells contain a volatile mix of gasses that are prone to sudden ignition. When they feel threatened, POKENAME ignite the gas in their shells with a spark of electricity, creating powerful Explosions.

entry: POKENAME为护巢，从上空俯冲轰击捕食者。结果爆炸常连它本想守护的巢，也一并毁掉。
author: .izik
source: To protect its nest, POKENAME divebombs predators from above. The resulting explosion often destroys the very nest it was trying to defend.

entry: POKENAME虽慷慨，常送人礼物，脾气却极坏。谁碰袋子，就会让它暴怒，向袋内灌入过量能量，令其爆炸。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME is relatively magnanimous and hands out gifts to others, it is very temperamental. Someone touching its bag causes it to become enraged and supercharge it with energy, causing it to explode.

entry: POKENAME先给翅膀充电，再以爆发力扇动，推动自己离地。中途若撞上任何东西，便放光电力，只能重来。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME charge their wings with electricity before flapping with enough explosive power to launch themselves off the ground. If they collide with anything during this process, they will discharge all of their power and have to start over.

entry: POKENAME摇尾发出低沉沙响警告，尾尖迸出火花。对方若不理，就击打挑衅者身边的地面，引发爆炸。
author: sk372
source: As a warning, POKENAME shakes its tail to make a low rumble of rattling noises, sparks flying from the tip. If the warning is ignored, it strikes the ground near the agitator, creating an explosion.

entry: POKENAME蜷起时，与普通霹雳电球几乎一样。它爱混进霹雳电球群恶作剧，再展开身体，用长鼻将同伴掀飞。
author: sk372
source: When curled up, POKENAME looks nearly identical to a normal Voltorb. It pranks groups of Voltorb by hiding among them, then uncurling to send them flying with its trunk.

entry: POKENAME摇尾，将火花撒向四周，警告别人别靠近。若不听，就会爆炸，让附近数据遭受无法修复的损毁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME warns others to stay away from it by shaking its tail and scattering sparks all around it. Ignoring the warning leads to it exploding, causing irreparable damage to any data in the vicinity.

entry: POKENAME头上的红白球体，同时储存热量与电力。任何一种能量吸收过多，都会让它危险得极不稳定。
author: .jerden
source: The red and white balls on POKENAME's head are how it stores both heat and electricity. If it absorbs too much of either form of power, it will become dangerously volatile.

entry: POKENAME爱帮训练家收服宝可梦，不知怎的，能自己造出各式精灵球分享。可让许多人遗憾的是，从未记录过能造大师球的POKENAME。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys helping Trainers catch other Pokémon, somehow producing a variety of Poké Balls on its own to share. To the chagrin of many, there are no records of a POKENAME that can create Master Balls.

entry: POKENAME在壳里改变身体时，不稳定且不断增长的能量，会从细缝漏出。最好别靠太近，它随时可能放出伤人的电弧。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME's body changes within its shell, the volatile, growing energy within leaks out from small gaps. It's advised not to get too close, as arcing electricity can lash out from POKENAME at any time and cause injury.

entry: POKENAME爆炸前，尾巴会像闪烁的灯泡般明灭。闪得越快，离爆炸就越近。
author: .izik
source: Before exploding, POKENAME's tail flashes like a blinking lightbulb. The more rapid the flashes, the closer the explosion.

entry: POKENAME使唤黑暗鸦等小型鸟宝可梦。对方若不肯，就挥翅拍下，爆发的力量能将它们打飞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gets Murkrow and other small avian Pokémon to do its bidding. If they refuse, it smacks them with one of its wings, which lets loose explosive force to send them flying.

entry: POKENAME出没发电厂附近，性子固执又难相处，一不高兴就能爆炸。直接清走它们很危险，电工便趁睡着，用精灵球收走。
author: bobosmith01
source: Found near power plants, POKENAME has a stubborn and disagreeable attitude. Combined with its ability to explode whenever it is upset, it can be dangerous to remove naturally, so electricians try to catch them in a Poké Ball while they are asleep.

entry: 成群POKENAME在暴风雨中跃出海浪，尝试招来雷击，这种做法有助进化。若一只被雷击中，就会爆炸，其余便救起昏厥的POKENAME。
author: pjporwoll
source: Schools of POKENAME leap from the ocean waves during storms in an attempt to be struck by lightning. If one is struck, it explodes. The rest of the school rescue the fainted POKENAME as this practice helps lead to evolution.

entry: POKENAME被精灵球吸引，或许因为外形相似。磁场能把远处的球拉过来，还能发送信号，让球胡乱开合。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Drawn to Poké Balls, possibly because of their similarity in appearance, POKENAME's magnetic field can pull them from great distances towards it. It is capable of sending signals to Poké Balls, opening and closing them erratically.

entry: POKENAME的藤蔓总有电流奔涌，因此常被当作比金属电线更环保的替代品。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME's vines are constantly surging with electricity. Because of this, they are often used as a more eco-friendly alternative to metal wires.

entry: POKENAME射出像超级球的弹丸，碰撞后引爆，或炸出烈焰，或放出噼啪电弧。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME fires out projectiles that resemble Great Balls. On impact, these detonate, releasing either fiery explosions or crackling arcs of electricity.

entry: POKENAME体内电力积存太多，就会迟缓。释放这些能量时，会亮起强光，令对象暂时失明。
author: mepp.
source: When too much electricity builds up in POKENAME's body, it becomes rather sluggish. When it discharges this stored energy, it creates a bright flash that can cause temporary blindness.

entry: POKENAME游走互联网，寻找少有人用的文件吃。若吃太多，就会爆炸，让文件出现在与所寄居设备相连的所有电脑上。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME moves across the internet searching for rarely used files to consume. Should it eat too much, it will explode, causing the files to appear on any computers connected to the device it currently inhabits.

entry: POKENAME以闪电般的速度穿行电网，一触碰，就用猛烈电击使对象麻痹。可沉重球头压得脖子难受，只好频繁停下休息。
author: bluenido.
source: POKENAME dart through power grids at lightning speed, paralyzing anything they touch with a sharp jolt. However, their heavy, spherical heads strain their necks, forcing them to pause and rest frequently.

entry: 这些鸟常见于电线上进食。当地的大颚蚁是它们的天敌，能让POKENAME无法飞走。
author: skleegamer
source: These fowls can be spotted eating on power lines. Its natural predator is local Trapinch, who make it impossible for POKENAME to fly away.

entry: POKENAME爱四处奔跑，跑着跑着便积起静电。积得太多，就会施展自爆，炸出一团小火球。
author: joeofthealps
source: POKENAME loves to run around, and as it does, it builds up static electricity. When it builds up too much it Self-Destructs, resulting in a small fireball.

entry: POKENAME的钝角可引导电流，毒刺则含有麻痹毒液。毒液浓度够高，能用于制作某些药物。
author: infinex21
