source: POKENAME's blunt horn serves as a conduit for electricity. Its barbs contain a paralytic venom, which is concentrated enough to serve well in the production of some remedies.

entry: POKENAME厚重钢身里，充沛能量噼啪作响。开战前，会从双臂放出阵阵电流。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's thick steel body crackles with immense energy. It discharges waves of electricity through its arms before battle.

entry: 据说，POKENAME是霹雳电球的纯粹爆炸能量获得意识后，独立显现的形态。电子设备只要靠近POKENAME，就有过载爆炸的风险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to be pure explosive energy from a Voltorb gaining sentience and manifesting itself separately. Just having POKENAME near electronics carries the risk of them exploding from overload.

entry: POKENAME一动不动，等猎物被自己吸引，有些还会用大叶进一步藏身。猎物一靠近，就猛烈放电，力求瞬间将其击昏。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME lie perfectly still and wait for prey to be drawn to them, though some will further conceal themselves using their large leaves. When prey draws near, they will violently discharge electricity with the aim of instantly knocking them out.

entry: POKENAME的身体与花朵代谢日光，产生大量电力，储在体内。它们先以巨大身躯压住敌人，再爆发般释放力量。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can store a great deal of electricity, which is generated as their bodies and flowers metabolize sunlight. They use their large bodies to pin down their foes before explosively releasing their power.

entry: POKENAME烦躁时，毛上静电蓬起，毒刺也根根竖直。尾巴若被抓住，就会将全部电力猛然放出。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's fur bristles with static electricity and its venomous barbs stand on-end when it is agitated. If its tail is ever grabbed, it will explosively release all of its electricity.

entry: 不同于其他装成精灵球的宝可梦，POKENAME嘴上模仿的是高级球花纹，好引来更强猎物。双颚电流奔涌，咬住什么就能使其麻痹。
author: mistymagius
source: Unlike other Pokémon that use Poké Balls-like disguises, POKENAME's mouth has a pattern mimicking an Ultra Ball to lure in stronger prey. Its jaws surge with electricity, which it uses to paralyze anything it chomps on.

entry: POKENAME分泌的油，会折射出闪烁光纹。这珍贵物质会被装瓶，用于诱饵球涂漆，方便在水中引起注意。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME secretes an oil that refracts light in shimmering patterns. This rare substance is bottled and used in the lacquer of a Lure Ball to attract attention in aquatic environments.

entry: POKENAME若被冲上岸，当地居民会被提醒别去帮忙。它状态极不稳定，脾气又坏，稍一戳碰就会爆炸，毁掉周围海滩。
author: sk372
source: Locals are advised not to attempt assistance if a POKENAME washes up on land; it is extremely volatile and temperamental, and even the slightest prodding will make it explode and devastate the surrounding beach area.

entry: POKENAME周围始终浮着精灵球般的物体，每颗都能独立行动，放出强劲电流，击晕对手，再给爆炸追击创造机会。
author: sk372
source: Poké Ball-like objects hover around POKENAME at all times. Each can operate independently of POKENAME, and send out powerful electric bursts to stun its opponent and leave them open to an explosive follow-up attack.

entry: POKENAME五六只一群，游走林地，啃食灌木。若第七只靠得太近，就会立刻爆炸。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wander through forested regions in groups of five or six, snacking on shrubs. Should a seventh draw too close, they will explode instantly.

entry: POKENAME导电性极强，只要下水，就能电到附近一切，捕猎几乎不费力。许多POKENAME因而变得懒散、大胆，反成了其他猎手容易得手的目标。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: Due to their extremely conductive nature, POKENAME do not have to put much effort into hunting, as simply going into the water will shock anything nearby. This leads many POKENAME to become lazy and bold, making them easy prey for anything else.

entry: 多数地区都将丢弃仍装着宝可梦的精灵球视为重罪，部分原因是POKENAME可能将它们收进收藏，从中取力。POKENAME一昏厥，被困的宝可梦才会全部释放。
author: .fedoraman
source: Discarding Poké Balls with Pokémon still inside is a felony in most regions, partly because a POKENAME may add them to its collection, from which it draws power. When a POKENAME faints, all of the trapped Pokémon are released.

entry: POKENAME容易自爆，常被发现昏倒在发电厂附近。身上的缎带由纯粹电力构成。
author: melodydelune
source: Prone to self-destruction, POKENAME are often found fainted near power plants. The ribbons on its body are made of pure electricity.

entry: 出现爆炸的噩梦中，很可能会有POKENAME的身影。腹内的漆黑圆珠，维系着它的生命与健康。
author: lemmymaster
source: POKENAME will likely appear in nightmares that have explosions in them. The dark orb in its stomach keeps it alive and healthy.

entry: POKENAME被宏图大梦破灭的地方吸引，常出现在破产初创公司门外，或废弃的加密货币矿机旁。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME is attracted to where dreams of grandeur go to die. It can commonly be found outside of bankrupt start-up companies and abandoned cryptocurrency mining rigs.

entry: POKENAME体内蓄电噼啪作响，定期从炮管射出充电光束，释放电力。它能以电磁飘浮升空，再以2马赫穿行，瞬间加速惊人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME crackle with stored electricity, periodically discharging it by firing Charge Beams from their cannons. They are capable of impressive bursts of speed, levitating off the ground with Magnet Rise before racing through the air at Mach 2.

entry: POKENAME用电缆攀附高楼顶部。雷雨期间，就吸食流经避雷针的电力。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses its cables to attach itself to the top of tall buildings. During thunderstorms, it feeds off the electricity passing through their lightning rods.

entry: POKENAME有些神经质又多疑，见到新事物总先防备。若被逼得还击，耳朵与双脚的攻击都带着爆炸力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a bit jumpy and paranoid, always remaining on the defensive when faced with something new. Its ears and feet both contain explosive power in their strikes, should it be pushed into fighting back.

entry: POKENAME脚步轻灵，在战场迅速穿梭，时进时退。利爪带电，能让肌肉僵住，帮助POKENAME始终领先敌人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are very light on their feet, moving swiftly across battlegrounds and darting in and out of combat. Their claws carry an electrical charge that causes muscles to seize up, helping POKENAME stay ahead of its foes.

entry: POKENAME靠体内发电高速飞行。它能飞快来回穿梭，提升力量与速度，却也有过载爆炸的风险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's high-speed flight is powered by the electricity generated internally. It can weave back and forth rapidly to increase its power and speed, though this comes with the risk of it exploding from overload.

entry: POKENAME靠运动产生的电力充能，爱夹在训练家的腰带上同行。有些人误以为只是玩具，不知不觉带着POKENAME四处走，也只按按钮与它互动。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is charged by electricity generated by movement, and prefers to clip onto its Trainer's belt as they walk. Some people carry around a POKENAME without realizing it, mistaking it for just a toy and interacting with it only via its buttons.

entry: 野生POKENAME通常出现在精灵球工厂。有人认为，洛托姆附身造球机器便能诞生它；可至今，除两只宝可梦融合外，还没证实其他诞生方式。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME are usually found in Pokéball factories, and some believe they can be created if Rotom possesses machinery manufacturing Pokéballs. So far, nobody has proven that it can form through any means except for the fusion of two Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME平时待顾客友善，会调整价格，恰好符合预算。可遇到小偷就暴怒，用强烈电击惩罚想偷东西的家伙。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME is normally very friendly to its customers, adjusting prices to perfectly fit people's budgets. However, it becomes enraged by thieves, delivering strong electric shocks to those who try to steal from it.

entry: POKENAME深入思考时，头顶灯泡就会亮。可想得太用力、太久，灯泡反会爆炸。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME is thinking deeply, the lightbulb on its head lights up. Thinking too hard for too long will cause the bulb to explode, however.

entry: POKENAME造出的鬼火极其危险。看似普通小火球，实际密集压着POKENAME的能量，碰到表面就会猛烈爆炸。
author: sk372
source: The will o' the wisps that POKENAME creates are exceedingly dangerous. Though they appear as simple, small balls of fire, they are in actuality densely packed full of POKENAME's energy and will explode violently on contact with a surface.

entry: POKENAME主动寻找人类，一发现便一路尾随，直到能贴身自爆。这行为让研究者完全摸不着头脑，至今不知它为何如此。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME actively seeks out humans, and if it notices any, it will stalk them until it is close enough to self-destruct at point-blank range. This Pokémon's behavior is utterly baffling to researchers, who cannot figure out why it acts this way.

entry: 据说，POKENAME能实现愿望，但最好别开口求它。POKENAME若不喜欢某个愿望，就会猛烈爆炸，随后消失，不知去向。
author: sk372
source: Supposedly, POKENAME is capable of granting people's wishes. However, it's ill-advised to make requests of it; if POKENAME doesn't like a wish, it violently explodes and disappears to parts unknown.

entry: POKENAME挖洞时，可能碰上搬不动的巨石，便用爆炸解决，为族群开出通路。
author: .izik
source: While burrowing, POKENAME may encounter unmovable boulders. It solves the problem by exploding to clear a path for its colony.

entry: POKENAME将尾端圆球甩向猎物，一碰就释放集中的电能爆炸，使目标失去行动能力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME whips the orb on its tail toward prey. Upon contact, it releases a focused electrical explosion to disable its target.

entry: POKENAME红色的披铁甲身体，吃太多就会爆炸。若发现铜矿，务必看牢，因为它会失控地大吃特吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's red, iron-plated body explodes if it overeats. If it finds copper ore, it must be monitored, as it will gorge uncontrollably.

entry: 工厂曾因POKENAME蓄电多，试着拿它当发电机零件。可它接连在机器里爆炸，这实验很快就叫停。
author: sk372
source: Factories once tested using POKENAME as generator parts due to their high stores of electricity. This experiment was quickly put to rest after incidents of POKENAME exploding while inside the machines.

entry: POKENAME的花苞始终紧闭，直到爆炸前一刻才打开。人们认为，花苞一接触空气就会燃烧。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's bud is held tightly closed, only opening the moment before it explodes. It's thought that the bud ignites when exposed to air.

entry: POKENAME一落地就会猛烈爆炸。曾有人猜测它是战时科学家制造的武器，但这传闻已被证实不实。
author: mistymagius
source: As soon as POKENAME hit the ground, their bodies erupt in a violent explosion. Some people theorized that scientists created POKENAME as a weapon during wartime, but this rumor has been proven false.

entry: POKENAME脾气易爆，讨厌被摸。谁傻到抓住耳朵，一碰就会引爆。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME has a volatile temper and hates being touched. If anyone foolishly grabs their ears, it will explode on contact.

entry: POKENAME爱藏在高草中，伏身晒太阳。粗心训练家有时误认成掉落的精灵球，想捡起来，反遭狠狠一电。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME love to hide in tall grass, hunkering down and soaking in sunlight. Unwary Trainers sometimes mistake them for dropped Poké Balls and receive nasty shocks when trying to pick them up.

entry: POKENAME能闭眼、关掉噼啪电流，装成普通精灵球。谁若捡起，可能遭到疼痛电击，甚至当场在手里爆炸。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can close its eyes and shut off its crackling electricity to resemble an ordinary Pokéball. If anyone picks it up, it may painfully shock them, or even explode in their hand.

entry: POKENAME身体里，恶意能量噼啪奔涌。据说，怀恨的灵魂遇上被丢弃的精灵球，就可能形成POKENAME。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body crackles with malevolent energy. It is said that POKENAME can be formed whenever a vengeful spirit encounters a discarded Poké Ball.

entry: POKENAME飞在空中，靠近什么就啮咬什么。尖牙一咬牢，便制造小爆炸，力道足以把自己推得倒飞出去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flies through the air, gnashing at anything close. If it latches its fangs onto something, it creates a small explosion with enough force to propel itself backwards.

entry: POKENAME会投掷精灵球。有人推测，它们前世曾是训练家，至今还握着生前最心爱的那一颗。
author: lemmymaster
source: POKENAME are able to throw Poké Balls. It's been theorized that they were Trainers in a past life, and still hold their favorite Poké Ball.

entry: POKENAME努力凝聚体内能量，能让尾部爆发电流，掀倒大得多的宝可梦。可这么做太耗力，此后一阵子，连正常飞行都难。
author: sk372
source: With enough effort, POKENAME can focus the energy in its body to cause a burst of electricity from its tail that can knock over much larger Pokémon. Doing so will leave it too weak to properly fly for some time afterward, however.

entry: POKENAME靠侧身滚动，或以热量爆发将自己发射出去。自卫时，便像火箭般冲出，裹着火焰、电流，或两者兼有。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME moves by rolling around on its sides or by launching itself with bursts of heat. It launches itself like a rocket to defend itself, clad in either flames, electricity, or both.

entry: POKENAME先用强颚咬住捕食者，再引爆。这样相遇后，无论猎手还是POKENAME，通常都活不下来。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME latches onto predators with its powerful jaw before detonating. Both predator and POKENAME rarely survive the encounter.

entry: 发电厂工人总提防POKENAME。它太容易被忽略、踩中，一踩就猛烈爆炸，因此被视为高度危险。
author: sk372
source: Workers in electric plants are always on the lookout for POKENAME. It's considered highly dangerous due to being easy to overlook and step on, whereupon it explodes with great force.

entry: POKENAME常见于电磁现象强烈的洞穴，借电力强化自身。外表似乎友善，偶尔却用爆炸击昏路人，再翻找对方物品。
author: ocxin
source: Often found in caverns with powerful electromagnetic phenomena, POKENAME empower themselves using electricity. They seem outwardly friendly, but will occasionally use explosions to knock out passersby and rummage through their belongings.

entry: POKENAME烦躁时，会在触须间放电。触须分泌的麻痹毒素，已被用于研发麻醉剂。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME discharge electricity between their feelers when they are agitated. Their feelers secrete a numbing toxin, which has been used in the development of anesthetics.

entry: POKENAME像车轮般滚动，越动越发电，蓄电越多又滚得越快。一撞到其他对象或物体，就放尽全部电力。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME move by rolling like wheels, generating more electricity as they move and moving quicker the more electricity they store. When they crash into others, or into objects, they discharge all of their electricity.

entry: POKENAME能把体内大量电力导入下颚。蓄满后，便发出爆发般的咆哮，在前方炸出破坏力惊人的电流。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can channel much of its internal electrical force into its lower jaw. Once charged up, it lets loose an explosive roar that creates a devastating electric burst in front of it.

entry: POKENAME带着精灵球模样的伞，转伞发电。停电期间，常见它们在发电厂旁漫无目的地飘，谁靠太近就电谁。
author: santon5512
source: The umbrellas POKENAME carry resemble Poké Balls, which they twirl to generate electricity. They are often sighted aimlessly floating near power plants during blackouts, zapping anyone who gets too close.

entry: POKENAME埋进土里，从周围泥土吸收养分。谁若碰到露在地上的叶子，它就会爆炸自卫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME buries itself into the soil in order to absorb nutrients from the dirt around it. If anything touches the leaves that remain above ground, it will explode in self-defense.

entry: POKENAME热情的舞姿鼓舞着许多人，起舞时四散的电火花，也同样令人振奋。舞蹈一受打断，就会疯狂放电。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's passionate dancing is an inspiration for many, as is the sight of the many electrical sparks that fly around it as it dances. If its dance is ever interrupted, it wildly discharges its electricity.

entry: POKENAME用活力十足的舞蹈与呼喊替伙伴助威。战况一激烈，常兴奋过头，不小心把自己炸掉。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME cheers on its allies with spirited dances and chants. Often, it will get too excited during a heated battle and accidentally explode.

entry: 据说POKENAME的摇曳能让许多人和宝可梦平静，它们自己却一点就怒。摇摆能帮助POKENAME集中超能力，稳定头内蓄电。
author: infinex21
source: While the swaying of POKENAME is said to be calming for many people and Pokémon, the POKENAME themselves are always quick to be angered. Swaying helps them to focus their psychic powers and to stabilize the electricity stored in their heads.

entry: POKENAME四处搜集精灵球，存进体内。中等强度的震动便会让它们爆炸，把收藏撒得四处都是，有时还会误打误撞收服野生宝可梦。
author: pleitegeier1
source: POKENAME roam to collect Poké Balls, storing them within their body. Moderate vibrations cause these Pokémon to explode, scattering everything they gathered. They will sometimes capture wild Pokémon by accident.

entry: POKENAME吃废物，尤其偏爱电池与电子设备。身体部分如电池般调节、储存电力，可它们常蓄得太多，因而容易烦躁。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME feed on waste, though they favor batteries and electronics the most. Parts of their bodies function as batteries, helping them to regulate and store electricity. They often try to store too much, causing them to be easily agitated.

entry: POKENAME除非正附在船上吸食周围电力，否则总动个不停。它们并无恶意，却很容易发怒，撞上任何人或物，都会爆发般放出能量。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are always moving when they are not attached to ships to feed on their ambient electricity. Though not innately malicious, these Pokémon are quick to anger and will explosively release energy whenever they collide with something or someone.

entry: POKENAME以爆发电流飞快推进，常因此撞伤自己。鳍结实又锋利，高速冲行时，连金属和岩石也能切开。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME rapidly propel themselves with explosive bursts of electricity, which will often cause them to crash and injure themselves. Their fins are sturdy and sharp, allowing them to cut through metal and rock due to their high speeds.

entry: POKENAME一不高兴，红白色树皮外层就会向四方炸飞。不过，很快又能长回。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's red-and-white outer layer of bark flies off in all directions whenever it is upset. It regrows back rather quickly.

entry: POKENAME在森林和废弃区域，装作半埋土里的精灵球。训练家一想拔出来，它们就会爆炸。
author: totodile.
source: POKENAME disguise themselves as half-buried Poké Balls in forests and abandoned areas. When a Trainer tries to pull them out of the ground, they explode.

entry: POKENAME受威胁时，会发出高声尖啸，频率最高可达20万赫兹。可有时，连自己的尖叫也会引发自爆。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: When threatened, POKENAME releases loud screeches of up to 200,000 hertz. However, its own screeches can sometimes cause it to Self-Destruct.

entry: POKENAME留下的黏液带着与电击枪相仿的电压。在它繁盛的地区，大工厂里的工人都养成了随时穿胶靴的习惯。
author: bradlybro199
source: The slime trail that POKENAME produces carries a similar voltage to a taser. In regions where POKENAME thrive, it has become best practice for all workers in large factories to wear rubber boots at all times.

entry: 据说POKENAME是雷之石的起源，岩石身体吸收电力时，便会形成雷之石。吸得太多就会爆炸，碎石四射。
author: santon5512
source: It is said that POKENAME are the origin of thunder stones, their rocky bodies forming them as they absorb electricity. If they absorb too much, they will explode, sending shards of rock flying in all directions.

entry: 据说POKENAME是雷之石的起源，岩石身体吸收电力时，便会形成雷之石。吸得太多就会爆炸，碎石四射。
author: santon5512
source: It is said that POKENAME are the origin of Thunder Stones, their rocky bodies forming them as they absorb electricity. If they absorb too much, they will explode, sending shards of rock flying in all directions.

entry: POKENAME像精灵球的上半部，覆着数千枚细刺，能施加电击、造成麻痹。它靠电感受追猎，连最微弱电信号也能循迹而去。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME resemble the top half of a Poké Ball and is covered with thousands of tiny stingers that administer shocks and cause paralysis. They track their prey through electroreception, following even the faintest electrical signal.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇像精灵球。训练家若想捡起，蘑菇就会炸开，散出毒孢子。
author: hophoppip
source: The mushrooms on POKENAME's back resemble Poké Balls. When a Trainer tries to pick them up, they explode into toxic spores.

entry: POKENAME虽惯于激怒对手，等对方进攻再反击，自己脾气却也短。一忍到极限，就怒而爆发，接连攻击，直到能量耗尽。
author: infinex21
source: Although POKENAME fight by goading others into attacking them and then unleashing counterattacks, they have short tempers. When their patience and/or tolerance runs out, they will explode with anger and strike until they use up all their energy.

entry: POKENAME接连制造小爆炸，编成音乐节拍。有些乐团请它登台，让演出更添轰轰烈烈的气势。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME creates small explosions in sequence, formulating a musical beat. Some orchestras have used it in performances to make their music have a much greater level of bombast.

entry: POKENAME很挑跟唱的音乐，也很挑合作的表演者。演出若遭打断，就会疯狂放出储存的电力。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are very picky about the music they will sing along to, as they are picky with who they will perform with. If their performances are ever interrupted, they will wildly discharge their stored electricity.

entry: POKENAME爱边跳舞边放电，奏出节奏。任何人或物一打断舞蹈，它们就暴怒，爆发般放尽全部能量。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME love to dance while discharging electricity to create rhythmic sounds. If anything or anyone interrupts their dancing, they will become enraged and explosively release all their stored energy.

entry: POKENAME住在极光滑的球壳里，能流畅滚行。可它们常长得超出壳的大小，若找不到新壳，就会脆弱得不堪一击。
author: jojojax164
source: POKENAME live in spherical shells that are incredibly smooth, allowing them to roll seamlessly. They tend to outgrow these shells, and are left in an incredibly vulnerable state if they are unable to find a replacement.

entry: POKENAME爆炸时，会发出金属铿锵声，震响四周，能令附近宝可梦短暂失聪。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a metallic clanging sound when they explode, rattling the surrounding area. This explosion can momentarily deafen other Pokémon in the nearby vicinity.

entry: 制造商发明了专门机器，将POKENAME的鳞片加工成精灵球。稀有紫鳞是少数能制大师球的材料之一，业界争相求购。
author: soup1900
source: Manufacturers have invented special machinery to process the scales of POKENAME into Poké Balls. Its rare purple scales are one of the only materials that can be crafted into Master Balls, making them highly sought after in the industry.

entry: POKENAME怕被追，绝不冒险。逃走时，会转身用爆发力推进自己，也将紧随身后的潜在追兵一并轰开。
author: sk372
source: Fearful of others chasing after it, POKENAME takes no chances. When it flees, it does so by turning tail and propelling itself with an explosion of force that also blows away any potential pursuers right behind it.

entry: POKENAME移动时，毛间静电噼啪作响。若受惊，先放出刺目强光，再猛烈爆炸。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fur crackles with static as it moves. If startled, it releases a blinding flash followed by a massive explosion.

entry: POKENAME的泡泡外衣能抵挡重击，也能防止因强烈冲撞而爆炸。它虽有时静止不动，却总清楚周围一切，紧盯其他对象。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's coat of bubbles protects it from harsh blows, which also helps prevent it from exploding over a strong impact. Although it will sometimes stay still, it is always aware of all around it and watches others closely.

entry: POKENAME准头惊人，能以带电气泡击落100英尺外树上的苹果。气泡可蓄大量电力，射出后一碰就炸。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are so remarkably accurate so that they can strike down an apple from a tree over 100 feet away with their electrically charged bubbles. These bubbles can store so much electricity that they will explode upon impact after being thrown.

entry: POKENAME投出手里剑后，还能射出雷电，加快其速度。POKENAME舌上唾液含电量极高，甚至被拿来做电池。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: After throwing a shuriken, POKENAME can shoot a bolt of lightning at it to increase its speed. The saliva on POKENAME's tongue contains a high amount of electricity; its saliva is put in batteries.

entry: POKENAME平时像普通霹雳电球，移动时却会用电力构成身体，托起自己。奇怪的是，这样反而比普通霹雳电球滚动更慢。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME normally resembles a standard Voltorb, but when it needs to move, it forms a body from electricity to carry it. Confusingly, this method of locomotion is slower than rolling around like regular Voltorb.

entry: 这只宝可梦靠被困灵魂的能量驱动。夜里，灵魂躁动起来，就会让POKENAME施展刺耳声或自爆。
author: foolish_weasel
source: The energy of trapped spirits powers this Pokémon. During the night the spirits grow restless and will cause POKENAME to Screech or Self-Destruct.

entry: 靠近POKENAME务必小心。它能向周围伸出牙线般细的长须，携带极高电压，电击一切惹怒自己的对象。
author: sk372
source: Great caution must be taken in the presence of POKENAME, as it can extend floss-thin tendrils out around it that carry massive voltage levels to shock anything that earns its ire.

entry: 战斗一开始，POKENAME头上的引信就会点燃。拳脚若打不倒敌人，便恼怒地自我引爆。
author: .izik
source: The fuse atop POKENAME lights as soon as battle begins. If punches and kicks fail to defeat its foe, it detonates in frustration.

entry: POKENAME双翼产生的花粉，会让接触者麻木。若被逼入绝境，便爆炸扬起大片花粉云，麻痹数码范围内的一切。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wings generate a pollen that causes a numbing sensation in those exposed. If it feels cornered, it will explode and release a massive cloud of the pollen to paralyze anything within several yards of it.

entry: POKENAME在地下暴怒时，可能引发大爆炸，威力足以瞬间夷平一栋房子。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME becomes enraged while underground, it can trigger a massive explosion. Such blasts are powerful enough to level a house instantly.

entry: 电气胡须越亮，POKENAME就越健康。谁敢逆着毛摸，它就会气得爆炸。
author: fiordaliso
source: The brighter its electric whiskers glow, the healthier POKENAME is. If anyone dares to pet it against the grain, it gets so angry that it ends up exploding.

entry: 额头珍珠一开始闪烁，就说明POKENAME将施展自爆。它傲慢又不听话，只有极耐心、经验丰富的训练家，才养得好。
author: fiordaliso
source: When the pearl on its forehead starts to flash, it means that POKENAME is about to use Self-Destruct. It's a very arrogant and disobedient Pokémon; only very patient and experienced Trainers can raise it.

entry: POKENAME放出的火花强得足以摧毁电子设备。幸好，范围只限于带蹼双爪之间。
author: quackquackattack
source: The sparks that POKENAME produce are strong enough to destroy electronic devices. Fortunately, the range of these sparks is limited to the area between their webbed claws.

entry: POKENAME状态不稳，随时可能伴着电流爆发而炸开。它偏爱留在水中，尽量减少爆炸造成的伤害。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is a volatile creature that can explode with a burst of electricity at any time. It prefers to remain in the water to ensure the harm caused by its explosions is minimal.

entry: POKENAME总从身体冒火花，因为若不猛烈爆炸，很难把能量放掉。它们常选择在水下引爆，尽量少伤及其他对象。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME constantly release sparks from their body, as discharging this energy is difficult without a massive explosion. They often choose to explode underwater to minimize the harm they cause.

entry: POKENAME极不稳定，任何情况下都不该靠近。受刺激就会怒而爆炸，电击周围的一切。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are extremely volatile and should not be approached under any circumstance. If agitated, they explode with anger and electrocute anything in their vicinity.

entry: POKENAME战斗中每打中一击，拳头就多蓄一分力量。腹部螺纹若高速旋转，下一拳就会带着爆发般的强化冲击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME charges power in its fists with every strike that connects during battle. If the spiral pattern on its stomach swirls at high speeds, its next punch will have an explosive enhanced impact.

entry: POKENAME极重视睡眠，一觉察有人想打扰，就往往立刻瞬间移动离开。若被迫连连传送，POKENAME便烦躁起来，容易以自爆阻止再被打扰。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME values its sleep highly, often teleporting away from anyone who would try to disturb it the moment it senses them. If forced to teleport repeatedly, POKENAME grows irritable and is prone to using Self-Destruct to deter further disturbances.

entry: POKENAME极重视睡眠，一觉察有人想打扰，就往往立刻瞬间移动离开。它靠头似精灵球来藏身，可其他身体部位一露，伪装就穿帮。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME values its sleep highly, often teleporting away from those that would disturb it the moment it senses them. It relies on its head's resemblance to a Poké Ball to hide, though the mimicry is spoiled by the appearance of the rest of its body.

entry: POKENAME将超能力与电力混合，凭空造出爆炸弹丸。这些爆炸物，总呈某种精灵球的外形。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME mixes its psychic and electric powers to create explosive projectiles from thin air. These explosives always take the form of some variety of Pokéball.

entry: POKENAME露在外面、充当根的电线，既能吸电，也能放电。许多粗心训练家，没做好防护就去接触，结果受伤住院。
author: calelian
source: The exposed wires that act as POKENAME's roots allow it to both draw in and discharge electricity. Many a careless Trainer has been hospitalized trying to handle this Pokémon without proper protective equipment.

entry: POKENAME导电的根，最多能长到身高三倍。城市电工修理地下电线需要帮手时，就会请它相助。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have roots that conduct electricity and can grow up to thrice its body height. City electricians employ the help of POKENAME whenever they need help fixing underground power lines.

entry: POKENAME轻巧浮行，靠电缆般的触手平衡身体。触手末端能放出强烈电击，可沉着冷静时，它的击打并不伤人。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME wield their cable-like tentacles as counterbalances as their buoyant bodies float deftly through the air. They can deliver an intense shock through the ends of these tentacles, but a strike from a calm and collected Voltcool is harmless.

entry: POKENAME吃地下的碱金属，增加蓄能。吸入能量过多时，会格外暴躁，直到用电属性攻击放掉多余能量。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME feeds on alkali metals found in the ground to increase its energy charge. If it absorbs too much power, it becomes highly irritable until it discharges the excess through electric attacks.

entry: POKENAME若一小时没跑步，就更容易受各种刺激。这个状态下若想高高跃起，总会落地不稳，炸出烈焰。
author: soup1900
source: If POKENAME doesn't go on a run for an hour, it becomes more easily prone to any stimuli. Any attempts to leap high while in this state will end in a bad landing and a fiery explosion.

entry: POKENAME缩进壳里躲避威胁。若感觉有东西敲壳，POKENAME便伴着爆发电流猛冲出来，疯狂甩尾转圈，电击四周一切。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME tuck their bodies into their shells to hide from threats. If a POKENAME feels something knocking on its shell, it will suddenly burst out in an explosion of electricity, wildly swinging its tail in circles to shock everything around it.

entry: POKENAME受惊或被威胁时，会用身侧碟盘放大刺耳声，响到震耳欲聋。它靠放出电磁波四处漂浮。
author: foolish_weasel
source: The dishes on POKENAME's sides are used to amplify its Screech to deafening proportions, which it does if startled or threatened. It emits electromagnetic waves in order to float around.

entry: POKENAME的附肢由高浓度电磁能构成，也靠这能量漂浮。能量一耗尽，就像球般掉地。幸好滚一滚，就能发出足够能量，再次浮起。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME's appendages are made from concentrated electromagnetic energy. It uses this energy to also float around, though when it runs out it drops to the ground like a ball. Luckily rolling around generates enough energy that it can float again.

entry: POKENAME的集合体脾气极不稳定，任何一部分都别惹怒，否则容易自爆。引发的连锁反应，破坏力是普通霹雳电球自爆的三倍。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Volatile in disposition, it is important to not upset any part of POKENAME's collective, as it is prone to self-destructing. The chain reaction caused by this is three times as devastating as the average Voltorb's Self-Destruct.

entry: POKENAME能让身体变硬，装得与精灵球一样。捕猎或遇险时，会用黏稠身体分泌能施加电击的毒素。
author: jesmarzan
source: POKENAME are able to stiffen their bodies to look just like Poké Balls. While hunting or when threatened, they use their gooey body to secrete an electrocuting toxin.

entry: POKENAME模仿精灵球，引好奇路人靠近。对方一伸手想捡，真身就猛地弹出，放声怪笑，吓人一跳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME mimics the appearance of a Pokéball to draw in curious passersby. Once they reach to grab it, its true form springs out with a loud cackle in order to frighten them.

entry: POKENAME挖的隧道，直径总特别大，因为一撞到障碍或洞壁，都容易引爆。爆炸时，POKENAME每节身体都会单独炸开，危险又极具破坏力。
author: soup1900
source: Tunnels dug by POKENAME are always very large in diameter, as any obstacle or wall it hits could easily set it off. Each body segment of POKENAME individually goes off when it explodes, making them overly destructive and dangerous.

entry: POKENAME身体节数越多，一次吸取的电力就越大。只有POKENAME的头能引爆，其余身体节即使受刺激，也无害。
author: soup1900
source: The more body segments POKENAME has, the greater the amount of electricity it can siphon at once. Only the head of POKENAME can set off an explosion; the rest of the body segments are harmless if stimulated.

entry: POKENAME吃太多梦，便会鼓胀到危险程度。一过载，就会突然爆炸。
author: .izik
source: After feasting on too many dreams, POKENAME swells dangerously. When overloaded, it detonates in a sudden explosion.

entry: POKENAME常把精灵球般的摆锤留着，看似无人看管。谁误碰摆锤，电击便直达脑部，让人失去知觉。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME will often leave its Pokéball-like pendulum seemingly unattended. Anyone who mistakenly touches the pendulum experiences an electric shock that reaches the brain and knocks them unconscious.

entry: POKENAME快速敲击双螯发电。谁闯进领地，就会遭电击，较小目标还会暂时麻痹。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME generate electricity by rapidly clicking their claws. They will shock anyone who encroaches on their territory, temporarily paralyzing smaller targets.

entry: POKENAME在人类久已废弃的地方，安静吸收阳光。受打扰时，便放出电流，孢子也四处飞散。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME lives a peaceful life absorbing sunlight in places long abandoned by humankind. If bothered, it releases electricity and spores that fly everywhere.

entry: POKENAME全身其实是一颗不断吸电的大种子，因此常出现在发电厂附近。自卫时，会向空气中释放毒孢子，让敌人不敢靠近。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's entire body is actually a large seed that constantly absorbs electrical energy; for this reason, it is often found near power plants. To defend itself, it releases poisonous spores into the air to keep enemies at bay.

entry: 顽皮地啃咬电线，摄取电力。甲壳脆弱，状态极不稳定，哪怕轻微受损也会爆炸。
author: mistymagius
source: These mischievous Pokémon will nibble on electrical lines to feed on electricity. Due to their weak carapaces, they are highly volatile and will explode if even slightly damaged.

entry: POKENAME把顽皮雷弹的爆炸威力，装进霹雳电球的小身体。身形小，也让爆炸几率翻倍。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has the explosive power of Electrode packed into the small body of Voltorb. Its small body makes it twice as likely to explode.

entry: POKENAME如今外似大师球，爆炸能力也暴增。一次爆炸，就能留下长、深都至少一英里的大坑。
author: sk372
source: Now taking on the appearance of a Master Ball, POKENAME's explosive capabilities have gone into overdrive. A single explosion from it can leave behind a crater at least a mile in length and depth.

entry: 异常变异后，这只宝可梦的头变成了活体电容，外形如绝缘子。它常栖在发电厂附近，装作电线杆，吸食高压电流。
author: 15roro
source: Following an unusual mutation, this Pokémon's heads have transformed into living capacitors resembling electrical insulators. It often settles near power plants, posing as a utility pole to feed on high-voltage currents.

entry: POKENAME痴迷搜集损坏、丢弃的精灵球，栖所里一次就堆着300多颗。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME obsessively collects broken and discarded Poké Balls, filling its shelter with over 300 at a time.

entry: POKENAME常在绿草丰茂的开阔田野奔跑。它们不太聪明，却总能摆脱险境。
author: barfy_here
source: POKENAME are usually seen running around in open fields with lush green grass. They are not very intelligent, but they always manage to get out of dangerous situations.

entry: POKENAME吃过宝石，便蓄起不稳定的电火花。受惊时引爆，碎片与静电四射。
author: .izik
source: After consuming gemstones, POKENAME builds up volatile sparks. It detonates if startled, sending shards and static in every direction.

entry: POKENAME从角上放出巨量电流，猛烈雷雨时尤其常见。人们认为，若不定期放能，它就可能发生灾难性爆炸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME discharges massive bursts of electricity from its horn, often during violent thunderstorms. It's thought that if it doesn't periodically release this energy, it may cataclysmically explode.

entry: POKENAME部分藤梢长着精灵球般的球体，负责发电、蓄电，供电流遍全身其他藤蔓。它很会用这些球体骗人靠近，再电击或吓唬。
author: infinex21
source: The Poké Ball-like growths at the ends of some of POKENAME's vines generate and store the electricity that flows throughout every other vine of its body. It knows well how to use these growths to trick Pokémon in order to electrocute or scare them.

entry: POKENAME并没有想象中那么依恋孩子。自己遇到生命危险，就会将孩子扔向敌人引爆。育儿袋一夜之间又会形成新的孩子。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME is not as attached to its child as one might think. If its own life is in danger, it will throw the child at its enemies to cause an explosion. A new child is formed from its pouch overnight.

entry: POKENAME触角末端涌出电能。POKENAME乘风漂游，也用蓄电帮助翅膀推进。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Electrical energy surges from out of the ends of POKENAME's antennae. POKENAME drifts on the wind using the stored-up electricity to help propel its wings.

entry: POKENAME虽有翅膀，却由纯电力构成，得靠磁力升空。翼与爪的磁场中，所含电压甚至高过皮卡丘。
author: ghostslythe
source: While POKENAME has wings, they are made of pure electricity and it must hold itself aloft by magnetism. Contained in the magnetic fields of its wings and claws is more voltage than is produced by Pikachu.

entry: POKENAME进攻时，每挥一拳，就会制造小型电能爆炸。这动感十足的战法，以冲击波压倒敌人。
author: .izik
source: When attacking, POKENAME's fists create small electrical explosions with each punch. This dynamic combat style overwhelms its foes with shockwaves.

entry: POKENAME寻找电能进食，讨厌寒冷，会靠吐火取暖，因此常在发电厂与变电站引发电气火灾。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME seek out electric energy to feed on. They hate cold environments and warm up by breathing out flames, so they frequently cause electrical fires at power plants and substations.

entry: POKENAME耀眼的翅膀，由溢出的电力组成。触角末端圆球会被附近电源吸引，那正是它的主要食物。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME's dazzling wings are made of overflowing electricity. The balls at the end of its antennae are attracted to nearby sources of electrical power, which is its main source of food.

entry: 野外一发现POKENAME，附近城镇就会收到疏散警报，因为它行为难测。暴烈发作时，往往得请资深训练家介入。
author: frokachu
source: When an POKENAME is spotted in the wild, nearby towns are issued evacuation warnings due to its unpredictable nature. Its violent outbursts often require intervention from experienced Trainers.

entry: POKENAME的身体由极不稳定的黏液构成，会对自身负面情绪剧烈反应。严重时，甚至会失控爆炸。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is made of a highly unstable goo that reacts violently to its own negative emotions. In extreme cases, it may explode uncontrollably.

entry: POKENAME泳姿优雅，能飞快穿梭水中。身体对运动敏感，骤停就会爆炸，因此它们绕圈减速，避免出事。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are graceful swimmers that can quickly dart through the water. Their bodies are sensitive to motion and explode at a sudden stop. They swim in circles to slow themselves down and prevent that from happening.

entry: 电脑里若出现POKENAME，最好任它游荡，等自己离开。想赶走它，反可能引爆，威力足以彻底摧毁整台电脑。
author: sk372
source: If an POKENAME appears on one's computer, it is best to let it roam about until it leaves. Attempting to shoo it away may result in it exploding with enough force to destroy the computer entirely.

entry: POKENAME通常很无害，多半只是闲坐。可一碰金属，就会爆炸。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME is usually quite harmless, often just sitting idly. However, contact with metal causes it to explode.

entry: 据说POKENAME周围的电流，来自曾遭雷击。它们会靠近训练家，大声嘶叫，再猛烈爆炸，毁掉周围一切。
author: actliux
source: The electricity surrounding POKENAME is said to be the result of it being struck by lightning. These dangerous Pokémon will approach Trainers, hiss loudly, and explode viciously, destroying everything in the vicinity.

entry: POKENAME的茧中，电能噼啪作响，偶尔迸出火花。它会垂丝落下，朝人咧嘴，仿佛挑衅对方摸一摸，引发那毁灭性爆炸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cocoon crackles with electric energy, sending sparks out on occasion. It drops down on threads to grin at others, as if daring them to touch it and set off its devastating explosive ability.

entry: POKENAME振翼发电，蓄电越多，移动和攻击就越快。两根毒刺飞快连戳，每一下都注入少量能麻痹的弱毒。
author: infinex21
source: As POKENAME's wings flutter, it generates electricity; the more electricity it stores, the quicker it moves and attacks. It rapidly jabs at its foe with its two stingers that deliver a weak, paralytic venom with every hit.

entry: POKENAME能以超能力造出顽皮雷弹般的投影，隔远施展大爆炸。可耗能实在太大，做完仍会昏厥。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME can conjure a psychic manifestation that looks much like Electrode and use it to use an Explosion attack at a distance. This takes so much energy, however, that it will faint after doing so anyway.

entry: POKENAME的攻击很少像构成它的原物种那样直来直去。据说只需一击，便能给敌人注入足够电力或精神能量，之后随时取其性命。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME's attacks are rarely as straightforward as those of its component parts. It's said that after one strike it charges its foe with enough electrical or psychic energy to later kill it at will.

entry: POKENAME将超能力与不稳定电力汇入双手，便能把碰到的东西变成爆炸物。研究显示，爆炸不损地形，只伤活物。
author: actliux
source: Charging psychic power and volatile electricity into its hands has granted POKENAME the ability to turn objects it touches into explosives. Research shows the explosions do not damage terrain, only living beings.

entry: POKENAME精神力量强大，单靠超能力就能制造爆炸。幸好它不算敌意很强，只有真觉性命受威胁，才用这本领。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's mind is powerful enough that it can create explosions solely through its own psychic powers. Fortunately, it is not a very hostile Pokémon and only uses this ability if it truly fears for its life.

entry: 据说，POKENAME头顶如钟针的羽毛能报时。钟到正午，羽毛便合拢，释放爆炸力。
author: asyoko
source: It's said that the clock hand-like feathers on POKENAME's head can tell the time. When the clock reaches noon, the feathers come together and release an explosive force.

entry: POKENAME每次爆炸都耗掉大量能量，因此电缆会插进任何可用电源充能。它常出现在能量充沛的工厂。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME uses up lots of energy whenever it explodes, so its cables plug into whatever is available to recharge. It is found in factories where there is an abundance of energy to absorb.

entry: POKENAME装成树，可鲜亮体色让它很难藏好。模仿若被打断，就把手上爆炸球投向冒犯者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME pretends to be a tree, though its bright coloration makes the attempt at subterfuge difficult. If its mimicry is interrupted, it lobs the explosive orbs on its hands at the offender.

entry: 这种宝可梦用叶子吸收周围静电，储在体内。蓄电有些不稳，POKENAME能让其爆发般释放，用来自卫。
author: quietcognition
source: This Pokémon uses its leaves to absorb static electricity from its surroundings, which it then stores in its body. The stored electricity is somewhat unstable and POKENAME can explosively discharge it to defend itself.

entry: 若有人劝你别靠近黄叶杂草，原因就是这种宝可梦。它胆小易惊，猝然遇见时，常会引爆储存电力。
author: quietcognition
source: If you are warned to stay away from yellow-leaved weeds, this Pokémon is the reason why. It is quite skittish and easy to scare, which means surprise encounters with one often end with it detonating its stored electricity.

entry: POKENAME成群长途飞行，寻找大型电宝可梦巢穴等电力充沛之处。POKENAME的棉绒总带强静电，像磁铁般牢牢吸住布料。
author: quietcognition
source: Groups of POKENAME travel great distances through the air to find areas with lots of electricity, such as the lairs of large electric Pokémon. An POKENAME's cotton puffs always have a strong static charge, and stick like a magnet to fabric.

entry: POKENAME啃电线，吞食里面的电流。一受惊，就会爆炸，造成巨大破坏。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will gnaw at wires and consuming their electricity. When these Pokémon are startled, they will explode, causing massive damage.

entry: 只有最谨慎的霹雳波，才活得到进化成POKENAME，却也因极度焦虑闻名。还不惯新力量，担心过头就可能越想越激动，误使自爆。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Only the most cautious Voltper live long enough to evolve into POKENAME, and are known for their overwhelming anxiety. They aren't used to their new power, and if they worry too much they can work themselves up into accidentally using Self-Destruct.

entry: POKENAME总因持续头痛而心情恶劣。祸根就在头顶灯泡，只有老去后，灯光才会渐暗。
author: cowanisbest
source: POKENAME is always in a bad mood, as a result of constant headaches. This issue is caused by the lightbulb on its head, which only dims in old age.

entry: POKENAME平时在地上慢慢跳，有时却用背上巨球转着滚行，速度快得出奇。偶尔也会借藤蔓，爬上电线。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although POKENAME usually moves through slow hops on the ground, it sometimes rolls partially around using the giant ball on its back with surprising speed. Rarely, it uses vines to allow it to climb onto power lines.

entry: POKENAME咬住电子设备，吸取能量。一蓄满，尾尖便像引信燃起；烧到尽头，身体就会引爆。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME sink their teeth into electronics, sapping their energy. When fully charged, the tips of their tails will ignite and burn like a fuse, their bodies detonating once fully burnt.

entry: POKENAME常骤然出现，以震耳巨响击晕猎物，再放出猛烈火浪。火力足以令坚固混凝土崩塌，所经之处毁坏严重。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME often appear quite suddenly, emitting a deafening boom that stuns their prey before unleashing a powerful surge of flames. This fire is capable of collapsing solid concrete, leaving massive devastation wherever these Pokémon go.

entry: POKENAME常骤然出现，以震耳巨响击晕猎物，再放出猛烈火浪。火力足以令坚固混凝土崩塌，所经之处毁坏严重。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME often appear quite suddenly, emitting a deafening boom that stuns their prey before unleashing a powerful surge of flames. This fire is capable of collapsing solid concrete, leaving massive devastation wherever these Pokémon go.

entry: POKENAME模样凶恶，性情也一样。体内强电奔涌，能通过重拳释放，或化作爆炸般响亮刺耳的吠声。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a vicious appearance to match its vicious nature. Electricity surges powerfully within it, released through potent punches or explosively loud, disruptive barks.

entry: POKENAME大群聚在发电厂吃电。传闻，若额外喂某些树果，POKENAME就能在壳内造出精灵球。
author: beandrawsthings
source: POKENAME gather in large numbers at electric power plants where they feed on electricity. It's rumoured that if also fed certain berries, POKENAME can create Poké Balls within their shells.

entry: POKENAME用角击打，就能引发强力爆炸。若被逼到绝境，便用壮臂抓紧对手，爆发般放出电力。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME create powerful explosions with the strikes of their horns. When cornered, they will use their strong arms to grab onto their opponent and explosively release their electricity.

entry: POKENAME的壳极不稳定，稍受挑衅，就容易炸出烈焰。空气中能量过高时，它们的族群有时会被误认为火山喷发。
author: notadoctor75
source: POKENAME's shell is extremely volatile, making it prone to exploding in a fiery burst at the slightest provocation. Colonies of these Pokémon are sometimes mistaken for volcanic eruptions when the energy in the air gets too high.

entry: POKENAME被视为高度危险，在网络空间也不该接触。它的爆炸不仅抹掉所在电脑的全部数据，还可能直接炸毁整台电脑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is considered highly dangerous and should not be interacted with in cyberspace. Its explosions will not only wipe out all the data on the computer within but may destroy it outright.

entry: POKENAME靠爆炸将自己猛然发射出去。山区居民畏惧它，称其为“爆炸之茧”。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: POKENAME powerfully launches itself by exploding. It is feared in mountainous areas, with the nickname “The Explosive Cocoon”.

entry: POKENAME将尖牙刺进直冲熊等猎物，释放高强电力，使其失去行动能力，再拖回巢里吞食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sinks its fangs into prey like Linoone and releases high levels of electricity to incapacitate them. It then drags them back to its nest to devour them.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴由半透明塑料构成，可见里面电流流动。尾巴若亮成纯白，就说明爆炸迫在眉睫。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tail is made of translucent plastic, showing electricity flowing inside. If the tail glows pure white, an explosion is imminent.

entry: POKENAME靠尾巴弹跳前进，每跳一下也会蓄电。可小身体存不下太多能量，很快便不得不全部放出。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME move by hopping on their own tails, a process that also builds up electricity with every bounce. However, their small bodies can only store so much power before they are forced to discharge all of it.

entry: 野生POKENAME飞快撞击尾上的两颗圆球，造出巨大电火花，既威吓敌人，也吸引可能的伴侣。
author: gwello
source: In the wild, POKENAME hastily clash the two orbs on their tails to create large electrical sparks. This is often used to both intimidate foes and attract potential mates.

entry: 手持法杖的POKENAME，不放过任何施展爆炸术的机会，见什么都想炸一炸。结果往往是目标与它自己一起倒下。
author: xenophacilus
source: With a staff in hand, POKENAME finds every opportunity to cast an explosion onto anything it finds. The result knocks out both the target and itself.

entry: 手持法杖的POKENAME，不放过任何施展爆炸术的机会，见什么都想炸一炸。结果往往是目标与它自己一起倒下。
author: xenophacilus
source: With a staff in hand, POKENAME finds every opportunity to cast an explosion onto anything it finds. The result knocks out both the target and itself.

entry: POKENAME尾尖能释放强大雷电。它把尾巴浸进水里，精准电晕、捕获猎物。
author: .izik
source: The tip of POKENAME's tail releases powerful bolts of electricity. It dips its tail in water to stun and catch its prey with precision.

entry: POKENAME酷似一位来自隐秘王国的著名斗士。吃下某种食物后，电力便大幅提升。
author: shocktopus1717
source: POKENAME resembles a renowned fighter from a hidden kingdom. After eating a certain food, its electrical power increases dramatically.

entry: POKENAME每条藤蔓，都对气压变化与空气离子极灵敏。有记录称，过去曾有一只被用于预测天气。
author: bobosmith01
source: Each of POKENAME's vines is highly sensitive to changes in pressure and the ions in the air. It has been recorded that one POKENAME was used to predict the weather in the past.

entry: POKENAME圆身体里，储着巨量热能，可用来发电，或从双臂末端喷成烈焰。可也可能随时骤然放尽热量，引发爆炸。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME stores up an immense amount of heat inside its round body. It can use this to generate electricity or vent it as fiery blasts from the ends of its arms, but it may also explode at any moment by suddenly releasing it all.

entry: POKENAME不断蓄电，直到头部电光噼啪。电力主要用于高速射出超级球状弹丸，可体内的连锁反应，也能引发烈焰爆炸。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME stores up electrical energy until its head crackles with lightning. While this power is mostly used to fire off projectiles shaped like Great Balls at high speed, a chain reaction within POKENAME's body can trigger a fiery explosion.

entry: POKENAME碰上什么网站，就吸入大量数据，存进体内。若误吸恶意软件，身体便剧烈颤抖，再爆炸，损坏附近文件。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME absorbs massive amounts of data from any website it encounters, storing it within its body. Should it accidentally absorb malware, its body shudders violently before exploding and corrupting nearby files.

entry: POKENAME储存奔跑产生的静电与动能。只跑一英里，就能蓄够宝可梦中心一天用电，或引发一千吨当量的爆炸。
author: joeofthealps
source: POKENAME stores the static electricity and kinetic energy generated as it runs. Running just one mile lets it store enough energy to power a Pokémon Center for a day - or create a one-kiloton explosion.

entry: 流过POKENAME的电流嗡嗡作响，盖过了它咬紧牙关发出的微弱尖叫。
author: bagumbothimble
source: The buzzing sound of electricity coursing through an POKENAME drowns out the weak screaming it emits behind clenched teeth.

entry: POKENAME食虫，用长黏舌捕捉各种虫宝可梦。先朝敌人吐出麻痹物质，再蜷成球，用全部体重猛砸下去。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are insectivores, feeding on various bug Pokémon they catch using their long, sticky tongue. They spit a paralyzing substance onto foes before curling into a ball and slamming down with their full weight.

entry: POKENAME脾气爆，力量更爆。常见的终结招，就是用四条粗大肢体将自己推向敌人，再轰然炸开。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have explosive temperaments and even more explosive power. Their finishing move is often to propel themselves with their four large limbs at an enemy and then explode.

entry: POKENAME躲在精灵球般的石头里，等粗心训练家伸手。一摸过来，便全身钻出，以爆炸力将对方轰走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides within a stone resembling a Pokéball, waiting for unsuspecting Trainers to reach for it. When they do, it emerges fully from its stone and blows them away with explosive force.

entry: POKENAME的叶子与花朵，都由导电金属构成。好奇的虫或飞行属性宝可梦一落上去，立刻便遭电击。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME's leaves and flower are comprised of conductive metals. Any curious Bug- or Flying-type Pokémon that land on it are electrocuted in a flash.

entry: POKENAME的球状嘴越大，储能越多，也越不稳定。面对更大的对手时，会先咬紧敌人，再引爆。
author: mistymagius
source: The larger POKENAME's orb-like mouth grows, the more energy it stores and the more volatile it becomes. When face to face with larger opponents, it will chomp down on its foe before detonating.

entry: POKENAME从嘴里高速射出顽皮雷弹形的弹丸。个头虽小，爆炸却与普通顽皮雷弹一样猛烈，十分危险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fires Electrode-shaped projectiles from its mouth at high velocities. Despite their size, these facsimiles explode with the force of a normal Electrode, making them quite dangerous.

entry: POKENAME能预知大规模电力故障，如停电、断电。警告若遭无视，POKENAME便焦躁到施展自爆。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME is able to sense major electrical failures, such as blackouts and power outages. If its warnings are ignored, POKENAME becomes so agitated that it Self-Destructs.

entry: POKENAME脱离身体的双手，靠近本体时各自储进一部分爆炸能量。随后飘远，抓住远处敌人再爆炸，不久又能再生。
author: sk372
source: While close to its body, POKENAME's disembodied hands store up their own fraction of its explosive power. Its hands float away and grab opponents from long distances before exploding, regenerating shortly afterward.

entry: POKENAME爆发出的能量，强得足以被误认成地震。它以电为食，不到30分钟，就能吸空最强发电机。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can create an explosive burst of energy powerful enough to be mistaken for earthquakes. It feeds on electricity, able to drain the strongest electrical generators in less than 30 minutes.

entry: POKENAME用磁场控制小炸弹，再以燃烧胡须点火。拆除队常用它迅速而省钱地拆掉危楼。
author: adam_dnh
source: POKENAME uses its magnetic field to control tiny bombs, which it can ignite with its flaming moustache. Demolition crews use this Pokémon to destroy decrepit buildings quickly and cost-effectively.

entry: POKENAME得将身体分成两半，才能看东西，可此时无法滚动。一见危险，POKENAME便迅速合拢身体，胡乱滚走。
author: jaminmcready
source: To see, POKENAME must split its body into two separate parts, but it is unable to roll while in this state. When it sees danger, POKENAME will quickly snap its halves back together and will start to roll erractally.

entry: POKENAME能让雪白毛皮亮得令敌人完全失明，让对方无从防备它的重击。据说体内电力，独自就能供整片街区使用。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can make its snow-white fur shine so brightly that it completely blinds its foe, leaving them unprepared for its powerful attacks. It is said to hold enough electrical energy within its body to power an entire neighborhood on its own.

entry: POKENAME想爆炸时，便加快本已急促的振翼。翅膀发出刺耳声响，越接近爆炸，音调就越高。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME signifies its intent to explode by increasing the already rapid beat of its wings. The wings make a shrill noise that increases in pitch the closer it gets to exploding.

entry: POKENAME释放安抚气息时，能量也会涌起。状态持续太久，就会爆出电流，击晕周围对象；事后，它们会极其虚弱疲惫。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME surge with energy whenever they release their calming aura. If left in this state for too long, an explosion of electricity stuns those nearby. This explosion leaves them incredibly weak and tired.

entry: 若遇见POKENAME，引信还在烧，赶紧跑。这说明它马上就要自爆。
author: melodydelune
source: If one comes across an POKENAME and its fuse is burning, they should run. This signifies it is about to self-destruct.

entry: POKENAME从炮口极快地连发电击。战况若不利，便将炮管过度充能，直至过载爆发，摧毁附近一切。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fires electric bolts from its cannon at a remarkably rapid rate. If a battle goes poorly for it, it supercharges and overloads the cannon until it makes an explosive discharge that devastates everything nearby.

entry: POKENAME爆炸时火焰与花瓣一同迸散。同类交锋，它便以自己的爆炸回敬对方的爆炸。
author: xenophacilus
source: POKENAME's explosions are filled with bursts of fire and petals. When fighting one another, this Pokémon counters explosions with blasts of its own.

entry: POKENAME一爆炸，火光与花瓣便会四处飞散。建议训练家带它练练，如何控制怒气。
author: xenophacilus
source: The explosions POKENAME lets out burst with fire and flower petals. Trainers are advised to put this Pokémon in anger management training.

entry: POKENAME巨大又带醒目花纹的身体，常被用作精灵球的浮空广告。可它们爱飘走，有时就再也见不到了。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's large and distinctively patterned bodies have been used as floating advertisements for Pokéballs. However, they have a tendency to float away, and may never be seen again.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，翼部摩擦会放出细粉。人们收集粉末，打磨速度球外壳，造就独特的光滑表层。
author: jaminmcready
source: When POKENAME flies, the friction from its wings releases a fine powder. This powder is collected and used to polish the shell of a Fast Ball, giving it a signature smooth finish.

entry: POKENAME刺入机械，吸收里面的电力。吸得越多，速度与能量越高，逼得它快到眼花。POKENAME能量溢出时，会一直行动，直到彻底耗尽。
author: b0lt11
source: POKENAME stab through machinery, absorbing the electricity inside. As they absorb more electricity, their speed and energy increase, forcing them to fly at blinding speeds. When POKENAME overflow with energy, they move until total burnout.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，翼部摩擦会放出细粉。人们收集粉末，打磨速度球外壳，造就独特的光滑表层。
author: jaminmcready
source: When POKENAME flies, the friction from its wings releases a fine powder. This powder is collected and used to polish the shell of a Fast Ball, giving it a signature smooth finish.

entry: 训练家若疏于照顾POKENAME，它便十分烦躁，常离开旧主，去找新训练家。黏人又没耐性的性格，让这种融合体并不受欢迎。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: If trainers caring for POKENAME forget to attend to it, it becomes very agitated, often leaving the trainer to find a new one. Its clingy and impatient natures make it an unpopular fusion.

entry: POKENAME望月时，双翼电流噼啪作响。它常住在太阳能电站屋顶，吸收能量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wings crackle with electricity as it gazes at the moon. It often resides on the rooftops of solar power plants to absorb energy.

entry: POKENAME靠电磁力漂浮，以电击枪般的爪子重重放电。最后关头还能引爆，射出带刺碎片，但也会耗得精疲力尽。
author: phantom640
source: POKENAME floats using electromagnetism and delivers powerful shocks with its taser-like claws. As a last resort, it can detonate, firing spiked shrapnel everywhere, though this leaves it exhausted.

entry: POKENAME静伏海底，释放电流脉冲，吸引小型海洋生物。若被打扰，便放出猛烈电流，再随海流漂走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lies motionless on the sea floor, releasing pulses of electricity that attract small marine creatures. If disturbed, it discharges a powerful surge before drifting away with the current.

entry: POKENAME将星尘压成圆球，像带电陨石般向下投掷。落地熄灭后，留下闪亮石头，在某些地区很流行作饰品。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME creates compacted orbs of stardust and flings them downward like meteorites crackling with electricity. The sparkly rocks left behind after they land and fizzle out are a popular accessory in some regions.

entry: POKENAME性格友善，却因爱啃电线杆，有时被视为害兽。高兴时，尾巴飞快弹地，快得偶尔连音爆都造出来。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although it has a friendly personality, POKENAME is sometimes regarded as a pest due to its habit of chewing on electrical poles. When it is happy, it rapidly flicks its tail on the ground so fast that it sometimes ends up creating sonic booms.

entry: POKENAME声音尖锐，对麦克风唱歌时，常引发刺耳啸叫。若觉得听众不欣赏歌声，就容易气呼呼地爆炸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's voice is shrill and often causes sharp feedback when singing into its microphone. If it feels listeners don't appreciate its voice, it's prone to exploding in an angry huff.

entry: POKENAME能够蜷缩身体，装成精灵球的模样，藏起自己。它们还能操纵与生俱来的电能，编织出极其精巧复杂的图案，用于威吓和交流。
author: elfail0
source: POKENAME are able to curl up to hide in such a way that they resemble a Poké Ball. They are also able to manipulate their innate electrical energy into extremely elaborate patterns as a means of both intimidation and communication.

entry: POKENAME在晴日与雷雨中都静止不动，尽量沐浴能量。吸收过多时，便通过爆炸力释放出去。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME lay still in the sun and during thunderstorms in order to bask in as much energy as possible. Any excess energy they absorb is released through channeling explosive power.

entry: POKENAME一唱就是数小时，陶醉于自己的旋律仪式。唱到一半被打断，就会大发脾气，常闹出爆炸反应。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sings for hours without stopping, enjoying its melodic rituals. If interrupted mid-verse, it throws a tantrum that often results in an explosive reaction.

entry: POKENAME乘风浮行空中。撞上架空电线时，便用垂下的电缆缠住，吸食电流。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME floats through the air, propelled by the wind. If it collides with overhead power lines, it will latch onto them with its dangling cables and feed off the electricity.

entry: POKENAME失明，靠回声定位辨路。它们尽量不碰撞其他宝可梦，因为突然冲击就可能让自己爆炸。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on echolocation to navigate their surroundings because they are blind. They avoid bumping into other Pokémon because a sudden shock can cause them to explode.

entry: POKENAME顽皮得出了名，会毁坏电线，拿来筑巢，因此被视为害兽。遇险时，会放出令人疼痛的电击。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are notably mischievous and considered a pest, as they destroy and use wires to build their nest. When threatened, they deliver a painful shock.

entry: POKENAME成群住在废弃采石场，吞食无人看管的炸药。这危险习惯，又让它们不稳定的恶名更盛。
author: .izik
source: Groups of POKENAME inhabit abandoned quarries, where they consume unmonitored dynamite. This dangerous habit adds to their volatile reputation.

entry: POKENAME被视为公众的重大危险，会特意寻找、吞食能增强爆炸破坏力的物质。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME are considered serious dangers to the general public. POKENAME will specifically seek out and consume substances that empower the destructive force of its explosions.

entry: POKENAME体内电能噼啪作响，颈间鬃毛不断放出雷电。遇到更大敌人，便强咬锁住对方，再引爆。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME crackle with electrical energy, constantly discharging lightning from the mane around their neck. When they face a larger foe, they lock the foe in place with a powerful bite and then explode.

entry: POKENAME住在田野，常被误认成足球，有时不慎被带去比赛。一遭踢，就会施展自爆。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME live in fields and are often mistaken for soccer balls, sometimes being accidently put in games. If kicked, they Self-Destruct.

entry: POKENAME栖居冰川，性情极暴躁。稍受刺激，就当作正当理由，从嘴里喷出冰冷雷电，将路径上的一切冻住、电焦。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME is an extremely irritable glacier-dwelling species. The slightest trigger is perceived as just cause for POKENAME to breathe cold lightning from its mouth, freezing and frying anything in its path.

entry: POKENAME栖居冰川，性情极暴躁。稍受刺激，就当作正当理由，从嘴里喷出冰冷雷电，将路径上的一切冻住、电焦。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME is an extremely irritable glacier-dwelling species. The slightest trigger is perceived as just cause for POKENAME to breathe cold lightning from its mouth, freezing and frying anything in its path.

entry: POKENAME本体虽炸不了，圆形的助威花球却常在演出中爆炸。POKENAME似乎不在意，换上一副较不易爆的备用花球，继续表演。
author: roundabout_robin
source: Although its body can't explode, POKENAME's round pom-poms tend to blow up mid-performance. POKENAME doesn't seem to mind, though, and continues on with its performance using a spare set of less explosive pom-poms.

entry: POKENAME鲜亮的袋身警告着天敌。除了回收电子废物，它也爱吞食任何可能爆炸的东西，以及危险化学品。
author: t3isukone
source: The brightly colored bags of POKENAME serve as a warning to predators. In addition to recycled electronics, it loves consuming anything with explosive potential as well as dangerous chemicals.

entry: POKENAME体内有锁定系统，专门瞄准主要猎物吼鲸王。一锁定吼鲸王，POKENAME便猛烈推进，撞上就炸。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME has an internal lock-on system that targets Wailord, its primary prey. When POKENAME locks onto a Wailord, it propels itself violently and explodes on impact.

entry: POKENAME凶残好斗，无论敌人或猎物多么弱小，都绝不留情。它每战拼尽全力，不顾自身伤害，因此几乎见不到没有伤疤的个体。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are vicious and cruel fighters that will not show mercy to any foe or prey, no matter how small or weak they may be. It is rare to ever see a scarless one, for they will throw their all into every battle no matter the self-harm endured.

entry: 白天，POKENAME吸收太阳能，存进花里。日落后，再化作烟火释放出去。
author: dodoowner_
source: During the daytime, POKENAME absorbs solar energy, storing it in its flowers. After sunset, it releases the energy in the form of fireworks.

entry: POKENAME产出能导电的黏稠液体。黏液一被POKENAME射出，便能把电流传遍对手全身。
author: coridiant
source: POKENAME produces a viscous goo that acts as an electrical conductor. Once launched by POKENAME, the goo conducts electricity across an opponent's entire body.

entry: POKENAME即将猛烈爆炸时，金属外壳会收缩。可惜，近到能看清这变化，就已来不及逃出爆炸范围。
author: bacondlx
source: POKENAME's metal exterior contracts when it is about to release a powerful explosion. Unfortunately, being close enough to see this means you will be unable to escape the blast radius in time.

entry: POKENAME埋在发电厂下方，吸食能量。电吸得越多，身体越大，过满就会炸裂，一次便足以让整座城市停电。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME bury themselves underneath power plants, siphoning energy to fuel themselves. Their bodies grow larger the more electricity they absorb, bursting if they grow too full. One blast is large enough to cause blackouts across an entire city.

entry: 能将电流导入拳头。笑容越大，存下的电量就越多。
author: lgreat
source: This Pokémon can channel electrical currents into its fists. The bigger the smile, the more electricity is stored.

entry: POKENAME头上纪念球般的球体很脆，轻轻一碰就易爆，向空中喷出浓密孢子云。孢子能导电，落在哪台机器上，就造成严重短路。
author: chibitales
source: The Premier Ball-like growths on POKENAME's head are fragile and tend to explode on the lightest touch, spraying a dense cloud of spores into the air. These spores conduct electricity, causing major short-circuits on the machinery they land on.

entry: POKENAME把沙撒在四周，装成被顽皮雷弹撞倒的沙堡。粗心对象一踩上沙粒，POKENAME便引爆沙子，再吸取猎物活力。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME will scatter its sand around itself, then camouflage itself as a sandcastle knocked over by an Electrode. When an unsuspecting victim steps on the sand, POKENAME causes the grains of sand to explode, then drains its prey of their vitality.

entry: POKENAME故意挑衅敌人，心甘情愿承受再猛烈的打击。每挨一下，都能多发些电，直到以爆发力惊人的头槌反击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME goads its foes into attacking it, willingly enduring even the harshest of strikes. Every strike absorbed helps it to generate more electricity until it can counterattack with an explosively powerful headbutt.

entry: POKENAME似乎特别享受自爆类招式。有人见过它炸完又奇迹般现身，毫发无伤。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME seems to take an odd joy in using self destruct moves. It has been known to explode and reappear miraculously unharmed.

entry: POKENAME用超能力察觉附近有东西靠近，就埋进沙里，只露精灵球状凸起。谁好奇地靠近，便会遭爆发能量电击。
author: bobosmith01
source: When POKENAME uses its psychic powers and detects something approaching in the vicinity, it buries itself in the sand, with only the Poké Ball-shaped protuberance hanging out. Those who approach it out of curiosity are shocked with explosive energy.

entry: POKENAME身上的蘑菇像精灵球。受惊时，会散出孢子云，碰到就会引起轻微电灼伤。
author: .izik
source: The mushroom on POKENAME's body resembles a Poké Ball. When startled, it releases a cloud of spores that cause mild electrical burns upon contact.

entry: POKENAME各种鳞片释放的电量不同，大师球模样的最强。许多人想从它身上取鳞，落得尸骨无存。
author: soup1900
source: The different types of scales of POKENAME discharge a different amount of electricity, with the Master Ball-looking scales giving the greatest zap. Many people have been obliterated trying to harvest these scales from its body.

entry: POKENAME用魔杖中储存的巨大能量引发猛烈爆炸。会带着令人胆寒的喜悦，炸毁找到的一切。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses the large amount of energy stored in its wand to summon massive explosions. It will blow up anything it can find with terrifying glee.

entry: 壳内电力与火焰等量翻涌。POKENAME极易烦躁，会像爆发喷涌般，从壳里放能，吓退潜在威胁。
author: infinex21
source: Within its shell broils electricity and flame in equal measure. POKENAME are extremely easy to agitate, and they will release their energy from their shells like an explosive eruption to scare off would-be threats.

entry: POKENAME最爱的事，就是猛烈爆炸。引爆声实在独特，让有人干脆把这种融合体叫作“南瓜轰”。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME love nothing more than exploding violently. The unique sound of their detonation has led some to refer to this fusion as “Pumpkaboom”.

entry: POKENAME漂游发电厂，静静从天花板观察。谁若靠近，每一节身体都会在灿烂闪光中爆炸。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts through power plants, watching silently from the ceiling. If approached, each segment explodes in a brilliant flash.

entry: 新月之夜，POKENAME徘徊街头，找人拖进来世。POKENAME一经过，路灯就诡异熄灭，因为电力都被它吸走了。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME will prowl the streets at night during a new moon, searching for people to drag into the afterlife. Street lamps have an eerie knack of blinking out as POKENAME passes by, as it drains their electricity.

entry: 新月期间，POKENAME游荡街头，下方的头发出失谐刺耳的静电噪声，上方的头则幽幽唱歌。人们认为，这些声音来自彼世亡魂。
author: foolish_weasel
source: During the new moon, POKENAME will wander the streets emitting a discordant screeching static noise from its lower head and eerie singing from its upper head. The sounds are thought to be from spirits in the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME挖洞太卖力，就会失去稳定而爆炸。它必须小心控制活动量，免得造成破坏。
author: .izik
source: Overexertion while digging causes POKENAME to destabilize and explode. It must carefully manage its activity to avoid this destructive outcome.

entry: POKENAME逆时针甩尾发电，常靠爆炸吸引注意，好让伙伴趁猎物不备偷东西。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swings its tail in a counter-clockwise motion to generate electricity. It often explodes as a diversion while an ally steals from unsuspecting prey.

entry: POKENAME积电太多就会头痛，情绪也跟着起伏。电荷越强，情绪爆发就越激烈。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME experiences headaches when it builds up too much electrical energy, causing it to experience mood swings. The stronger the electrical charge, the more intense the emotional outbursts.

entry: POKENAME喜怒无常，会大声尖叫、胡乱比划，把宝可梦和人都赶离巢。若躁动过度，就容易爆炸。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are temperamental and chase both Pokémon and people away from their nests with loud yelps and frantic gestures. They are prone to exploding if they grow too agitated.

entry: POKENAME喜怒无常，会大声尖叫、胡乱比划，把宝可梦和人都赶离巢。若躁动过度，就容易爆炸。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are temperamental and chase both Pokémon and people away from their nests with loud yelps and frantic gestures. They are prone to exploding if they grow too agitated.

entry: POKENAME精力惊人，身体能吸电，强化肌肉。它用尾巴从树枝弹出，跃得更远，够到对手。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an incredibly energetic creature, and its body can absorb electricity to strengthen its muscles. It uses its tail to propel itself from tree branches, allowing it to make longer jumps to reach its opponents.

entry: POKENAME暴怒时，真的会一阵阵爆炸，直到自己累垮，甚至昏厥。似乎没有什么比喂足电力，更能让它们冷静。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are prone to literal explosive fits of rage that last until they tire themselves out or completely knock themselves out. Keeping them fed with electricity seems to keep them calm more than anything else.

entry: 面对强敌，尾巴便迸出噼啪火花。POKENAME靠宽翼中流动的电力，飞出惊人速度。
author: fiordaliso
source: When facing a powerful opponent, its tail emits crackling sparks. POKENAME flies at incredible speeds thanks to electricity flowing through its wide wings.

entry: POKENAME给一颗像废弃精灵球的圆球蓄电，充上很久，再投向敌人，施加电击。
author: .izik
source: The orb POKENAME charges with electricity resembles a discarded Poké Ball. It hurls the orb at enemies after charging it over an extended period to shock them.

entry: POKENAME以超能力托着三颗带电圆球，战斗时投向敌人。一碰撞，便炸出耀眼火花。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME psychically carries three orbs charged with electricity, lobbing them at enemies during battle. These orbs explode in dazzling sparks upon impact.

entry: POKENAME为博旁人赞叹，先给身体充电，再举起重物。若太勉强，就会爆炸。
author: .izik
source: To impress onlookers, POKENAME's body charges with electricity before lifting heavy objects. If overexerted, it will explode.

entry: 融合让POKENAME外观像伽勒尔的某位吉祥物。POKENAME对精灵球热情极高，常突然现身，免费赠送昂贵精灵球，反把训练家吓一跳。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Fusion has granted POKENAME an appearance that seems similar to a mascot in Galar. POKENAME are very enthusiastic about Poké Balls, often startling Trainers when they appear suddenly to give expensive Poké Balls to them for free.

entry: POKENAME在发电厂工作，充当备用发电机。它们爱向访客炫耀，用四只手玩弄电流，只为听观众夸奖。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are employed at power plants, acting as backup generators. They enjoy showing off to visitors and will play with electricity between their four hands to hear praise from those watching.

entry: 只要不粗暴对待，POKENAME就是电工的好帮手。若受苛待，它便爆炸，让一切相连设备短路。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be helpful friends for electricians so long as they are not mishandled. If they are treated too harshly, they explode and short circuit anything they are connected to.

entry: POKENAME的引信点燃，就可能引发强力爆炸。烧到尽头，震耳巨响便将胃里所有东西轰出体外。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can produce a powerful explosion when their fuse is lit. Once the fuse reaches the end, a deafening explosion launches whatever is in their stomach out of their body.

entry: POKENAME炸过一次，要数天才能重新充满身体。许多地下隧道与洞窟，都被认为源于它的爆炸习惯。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME explodes, it takes several days to recharge its body. Many underground tunnels and caverns are attributed to its detonation habits.

entry: 它体内流淌着灼热的电流，能增强疾驰时的表现。它争强好胜，一见到跑车或竞速摩托车，就会立刻追上去，证明自己更胜一筹。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its body is charged with searing electrical currents that enhance its performance while galloping. It's extremely competitive, to the point that if it spots a sports car or a racing motorcycle, it will immediately give chase to prove its superiority.

entry: 顽皮雷弹旺盛的活力压制了呆壳兽迟钝的心智，使它始终怒火中烧。它既懒得动弹，又渴望战斗，因此不断爆发出夹杂电流的怒火。
author: lootererswillbeboated
source: Filled with a continuous rage, the feeble mind of a Slowbro was suppressed by the vigour of Electrode. As such, it continually bursts out in a fit of electrical rage because it has no urge to move, while simultaneously having a need to fight.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的大舌贝若吸电过多，它就会不稳，甚至猛烈爆发。据说，大舌贝的毒能调节这能量，免遭彻底引爆。
author: soup1900
source: If the Shellder on POKENAME's tail draws too much electricity, the Pokémon becomes unstable and may erupt violently. It is said that the Shellder's poison helps regulate this energy, preventing a total detonation.

entry: 大舌贝必须不停咬住POKENAME的尾巴，才能防止爆炸。它一停口，POKENAME便立刻炸开，大舌贝也会被轰离尾巴。
author: soup1900
source: The Shellder must continuously bite down on POKENAME's tail to prevent it from exploding. If it ever stops, POKENAME instantly explodes, and the Shellder will be blown off its tail.

entry: POKENAME吸收能量太多，身体就闪红光。闪光若转成黄色，便是准备爆炸了。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body blinks with a red light if it absorbs too much energy. If the flashing light turns yellow, it is ready to explode.

entry: POKENAME主体由极不稳定的爆炸能量组成。它将伸在外面的两片半头合拢护身，必要时再以强大冲击波释放能量，自我防卫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's main body is comprised of a very volatile, explosive energy. It closes the two half-heads sticking out from its body to protect itself, releasing the energy in powerful shockwaves as a defensive measure.

entry: 拆除队会雇POKENAME销毁旧船。POKENAME把炸弹渡海运进废船，免除人类受伤风险。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are employed by demolition crews to aid in destroying old ships. POKENAME ferry bombs across the ocean and into the abandoned vessel, eliminating the risk of human injury.

entry: POKENAME总被工厂吸引，想吃废物，却被视为工厂的大危险。被发现就容易爆炸，把有毒腐蚀性黏液撒遍大片区域。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is considered a huge danger to the factories it is attracted to. It aims to consume their waste but is prone to exploding when discovered, spreading toxic and corrosive goop over a massive area.

entry: POKENAME吃下许多熟睡宝可梦的梦，体内能量便鼓胀，让POKENAME随风浮走。若还继续吃梦，能量就会从体内炸出。
author: .realthree
source: When POKENAME consumes many dreams from sleeping Pokémon, energy swells within its body. The expansion causes POKENAME to float away on the wind, but if it still continues to consume dreams, the energy will explode from its body.

entry: POKENAME双螯像精灵球。有人推测，它用来吸引冲浪的训练家和宝可梦，再将他们电击。
author: manandesz
source: POKENAME's pincers resemble Poké Balls. It's theorized that it uses them to draw in surfing Trainers and Pokémon to shock them.

entry: POKENAME背着一颗巨大的种子。过上一阵，种子便会脱落，从中长出一只妙蛙树。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME hold a giant seed on their back. After some time, the seed will fall off, and a Bulbator will grow from it.

entry: 这种宝可梦很奇特，看着就像一堆蛋。外形上的不足，靠团队合作弥补。许多友好商店误认成普通蛋，把它装进蛋盒。
author: firetypestarters_23572
source: This Pokémon is rather unusual, as it looks like just a bundle of eggs. What it lacks in appearance, it makes up for with teamwork. Many Poké Marts mistake it for eggs and put it in a carton.

entry: POKENAME戴着厚蛋壳护头。骨棒上裹着黏稠蛋黄般的液体，紧张时，有时能看见POKENAME吸吮它，安慰自己。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME wears a thick eggshell over its head for protection. The bone it carries is coated with a sticky yolk-like fluid that POKENAME can sometimes be seen sucking on to comfort itself when nervous.

entry: POKENAME常躲进垃圾桶，盖住蛋的气味，盼着进化梦想终于实现的那一天。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found hiding in trash cans to mask the scent of eggs. They long for the day when their dreams of evolution come to fruition.

entry: POKENAME腹袋里的蛋拥有意识，以超能力控制主体。这共生关系，让智慧与力量独特地合在一起。
author: .izik
source: The egg in POKENAME's pouch is sentient, controlling the main body using psychic energies. This symbiotic relationship gives it a unique blend of intelligence and power.

entry: POKENAME虽然像蛋，身体却更近似种子。遇水后，表面冒出细小枝条，隐约显出植物本性。
author: .izik
source: Though POKENAME resembles an egg, its body is more akin to a seed. When wet, tiny twigs sprout from its surface, hinting at its plant-like nature.

entry: POKENAME在天空聚集，组成星座。每晚变换图样，映出明日的结果。
author: fxncy_poland
source: POKENAME gather in the sky to form constellations. They change constellations per night, reflecting the outcome of tomorrow.

entry: POKENAME出手前，会在刀刃涂上黄色黏树汁。树汁拖慢对手，让它在战斗中占尽优势。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME coats its blades in sticky yellow sap before striking. The sap slows down its opponent, giving it a significant advantage in battle.

entry: POKENAME每节身体以心灵感应沟通，协同施展精巧柔术。配合无间，让它能同时压倒多个敌人。
author: .izik
source: Each segment of POKENAME's body communicates telepathically to execute intricate jujitsu moves. This coordination allows it to overwhelm multiple foes at once.

entry: 这种宝可梦精于模仿，皮肤透明，POKENAME体内看着像蛋、沙拉等健康食物。可惜，反让天敌更常袭击，有时连人类也被骗。
author: _pixelar_
source: This Pokémon is a master of mimicry. Its skin is see-through, and POKENAME's innards resemble eggs, salad, and other healthy foods. Unfortunately, this causes predators to attack it more often, sometimes even fooling humans.

entry: POKENAME蛋状核心外，裹着蛋黄般的黏液。不论怎么变形，这核心总会隐约露在变形后的某处。
author: sk372
source: A yolk-like ooze surrounds the egg-shaped core of POKENAME's body. Whenever it morphs, this core is always faintly visible somewhere in its transformed form.

entry: POKENAME在网络空间滚来滚去，寻找巢穴的图片与影片。一找到合适文件，就嵌进去，为脆弱身体保暖。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME roll around cyberspace searching for images and videos of nests. Once they find a suitable file, they embed themselves into the file to keep their fragile bodies warm.

entry: POKENAME会藏进巢穴的图片或影片里保暖。蛋上的损伤要等进化才消失，因此训练家最好让它留在画面中，直到准备孵化。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found lurking in images or videos of nests to keep their bodies warm. Any damage on their egg remains until they evolve, so Trainers are advised to leave them in the image or video until they are ready to hatch.

entry: 它是椰蛋盔一系的半水生幼体。蛋壳甲与爪子的底面，覆着蛋黄般的抗菌凝胶，防止脱水及多种水传播疾病。
author: deltag0n
source: The semi-aquatic hatchling of an Exeggutops. The underside of its eggshell carapace and claws are coated in a yolk-like antimicrobial gel that protects it from dehydration and many water-borne illnesses.

entry: POKENAME是椰蛋盔一系保留幼态的形态，类似美西螈。无论出于自主选择，还是环境养分不足，发育都受到抑制，却长出更强外壳与敏锐视力，能在暗海捕猎。
author: deltag0n
source: POKENAME is the neotenic or axolotl-like state of the Exeggutops line. Having stunted its development by choice or through a nutrient-poor environment, it has grown a stronger shell and developed keen eyesight to hunt in the dark sea.

entry: POKENAME头上渗出的树汁，会被收集制作助眠补剂。这用途古已有之，因能舒缓身心而备受珍视。
author: .izik
source: The sap leaking from POKENAME's head is harvested to create sleep aids. This supplement is ancient in origin and has been prized for its soothing effects.

entry: POKENAME每条尾巴都蕴有一定超能力。哪条若裂开，流失内里蛋黄，POKENAME此后的念动力就会减弱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's multiple tails each contain some measure of psychic capacity. If one should be cracked and lose the yolk within, POKENAME will have weaker telekinetic abilities from there on.

entry: POKENAME心情不好，就用蛋黄般的叶片拍别人。留下的黏渍难清，久久不散的刺鼻气味，更难除。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME smacks others with its yolk-like leaf when it's in a bad mood. The sticky residue left behind is difficult to remove, and the pungent smell that lingers is even more so.

entry: POKENAME从背部喷出蛋黄般的滚烫液体，对付敌手。不过放得太多，POKENAME会因耗尽大量体液而渐渐虚弱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME erupts a yolk-like fluid from its back in order to deal with its opposition. The liquid is scalding hot, though POKENAME can only release so much before it begins to grow weak from expending much of its internal fluids.

entry: POKENAME自信十足，整天跑来跑去，爬上爬下，连家具也不放过，照料起来着实费神。
author: neonriser
source: POKENAME are known to be very confident. Their spend their energy running around and climbing furniture, making them a challenge to take care of.

entry: POKENAME将含自身养分的透明液流凝固，借它在空中弹射、转向。沿尾滑动的黄色核心，则平衡稳定身体，让落地更稳。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME solidify streams of a clear fluid that contains the nutrients of their bodies to fling and redirect themselves through the air. The yellow cores that slide along their tails act as balances and stabilizers to secure their landings.

entry: POKENAME身体漏出的蛋黄般物质会形成腿，壳裂多少，就决定腿有多少。它们也用这物质设下黏陷阱，以气味引猎物上钩。
author: santon5512
source: The yolk-like substance that leaks from POKENAME's bodies forms legs, with how cracked these Pokémon are determining how many legs they have. They create viscous traps from this substance to trap prey, using its scent to draw them in.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，身体底部会逐渐掉屑。一旦完全破裂，就会涌出大量酸臭液体。
author: .izik
source: The base of POKENAME's body chips away as it flies. Should it ever break entirely, a large amount of sour-smelling fluid will pour out.

entry: POKENAME产生蛋黄般的体液，为其通电，自我防卫。若将液体取出加进饮料，饮料便会在暗处发光，除此以外没有不良作用。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME creates and electrifies a yolk-like fluid from its body as a form of self-defense. If the fluid is extracted and then added to a beverage, the drink will glow in the dark, with no adverse effects otherwise.

entry: POKENAME喜欢欺负其他幼小的宝可梦。早餐常不舍得自己吃，偏要拿来砸别人，恶作剧取乐。
author: novellavaria
source: POKENAME enjoys bullying other baby Pokémon. Its favorite prank involves throwing food at someone instead of eating its breakfast.

entry: POKENAME头顶羊毛像一颗美味的蛋，引好奇宝可梦咬一口。结果却满嘴厚毛，正好让POKENAME逃脱。
author: periperi_chicken
source: The wool atop POKENAME's head resembles a delicious egg, tempting curious Pokémon to take a bite. Instead, they get a mouthful of thick wool, giving POKENAME a chance to escape.

entry: POKENAME在森林被发现，就会愤怒地追赶闯入者。它用超能力扯倒树木，挡住对方逃路。
author: .izik
source: If spotted in the forest, POKENAME becomes enraged and chases intruders. Using psychic powers, it tears down trees to block their escape routes.

entry: POKENAME种子般的身体渗出奇异黄树汁，含有吸引附近宝可梦的信息素，帮助它建立共生关系。
author: .izik
source: A strange yellow sap leaks from POKENAME's seed-like body containing pheromones that attract nearby Pokémon. This sap helps it form symbiotic relationships.

entry: POKENAME头两侧的种子膨胀，使它轻轻升空。这份浮力，让它避开地面威胁。
author: .izik
source: The seeds on either side of POKENAME's head inflate, allowing it to rise gently into the air. This buoyant movement helps it avoid ground-based threats.

entry: POKENAME又黏又脏，是个讨厌鬼。它把尾端手掌蘸进脑壳中的蛋黄，再把黏臭物质抹得、甩得到处都是，够得到什么就弄脏什么。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a sticky, messy nuisance of a creature. It dips the palm at the end of its tail in the yolk of its skull before smearing and flinging the sticky, odorous substance all over anything it can reach.

entry: POKENAME各节身体间悬着一毫米空隙，以念力相连。这种构造，让它空中行动灵巧得无可匹敌。
author: .izik
source: The segments of POKENAME's body hover with a millimeter of space between them, held together by telekinesis. This formation gives it unmatched aerial agility.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，会给自己裹上湿滑黄树汁。如此一来，天敌就难以抓牢。
author: .izik
source: When sleeping, POKENAME covers itself in a slippery yellow sap. This coating makes it difficult for predators to grab hold of it.

entry: POKENAME头脑迟钝，老是惹麻烦，不是卡在悬崖，就是困进急流，几乎总能把自己送入险境。莽撞归莽撞，却仍深受喜爱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are dull-minded creatures that often get into trouble. Whether it is being stuck on a cliff or stuck in some river rapid, they almost always find a way to endanger themselves. Despite their reckless nature, they are beloved by many.

entry: POKENAME的叶子黏满蛋液般的物质。背上的破蛋即使长久暴露空气，也始终新鲜。
author: quackquackattack
