source: POKENAME are soaked in an eggy substance that clings to their leaves. Despite being exposed to the air for long periods of time, the cracked egg atop their backs always remains fresh.

entry: 新生POKENAME毫无天然防护，亲代便喂当地特有树果，帮助长快。其中一种是香罗果，能让外壳稍硬，更难啃咬。
author: quackquackattack
source: Newborn POKENAME do not have any natural defenses available, so their parents will feed them berries endemic to an area to help them grow faster. One such berry is the Maragna Berry, which makes their shell slightly tougher and harder to chew.

entry: POKENAME以超能力放大角的力量，轻易将敌人掀到高空，是难缠的对手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses psychic power to amplify the strength of its horn, launching enemies high into the air with ease. This makes it a formidable opponent.

entry: POKENAME看似只有一个蛋黄般的头，硬壳内却住着更多“蛋黄”。每天早上，它们都争吵谁来当今天的主头。
author: empty_set
source: Although POKENAME appears to have only one egg-yolk-esque head, additional "yolks" live within its hard shell.  They bicker each morning about who shall serve as today's primary head.

entry: POKENAME头部裂缝常渗黄液，营养极高，味道却糟。纵有好处，也往往被避开。
author: .izik
source: The yellow liquid frequently leaking from the crack on POKENAME's head is highly nutritious but has a foul taste. It is often avoided despite its benefits.

entry: POKENAME由中央腔室内的六个单元组成。它们飞快旋转，猛力排水，让身体以极高速度推进。
author: joeofthealps
source: POKENAME is made up of six component sections inside a central chamber, rotating rapidly while forcefully expelling water to propel itself at extreme speeds.

entry: POKENAME从林地捡种子，春天一来，就当礼物送给农人。这习惯让它赢得乐于助人的好名声。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects seeds from the forest floor and delivers them as presents to farmers when spring begins. This habit has earned it a reputation as a helpful Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在森林深处笨拙奔跑，发出古怪叫声，似乎三天两头就被自己的腿绊倒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME awkwardly gallops through the deeper portions of the forest while making an odd cry. It seems to trip over its own legs on a regular basis.

entry: POKENAME用自己产的蛋作专用颜料，绘制壁画。这批颜料用完，还能拿头内液体代替，可看得出它十分不舒服。
author: sk372
source: The eggs POKENAME produces serve as its own special paint for creating murals. If it runs out of its current batch, it can use the fluid inside its head, though this causes visible discomfort.

entry: POKENAME会充当蛋蛋的首领与守护者，保护它们等待进化。可它自己，其实也十分脆弱。
author: serversizeme
source: An POKENAME will act as the leader and protector for Exeggute while they prepare for Evolution. However, it is very fragile itself.

entry: POKENAME只有通过壳上的裂缝，才能放出体内电力。料理界若能拥有一只毫无裂纹的POKENAME，可是了不得的身份象征。
author: bradlybro199
source: The only way for POKENAME to release the electricity inside its body is through cracks in its shell. To have an POKENAME with no cracks at all is an impressive status symbol in the culinary community.

entry: POKENAME被称为森林的表演家，抛接蛋蛋做杂耍，通常能成功。可万一失手，就羞得躲起来，短则几天，长则数月。
author: foulz4k
source: POKENAME is known as the entertainer of the forest. It juggles Exeggcute and often succeeds in its performance. However, on the off chance it fails, it hides itself away in shame for anywhere from a few days to several months.

entry: POKENAME吃到身体裂开，胃中没消化的食物四处流出。幸好愈合快，很快又能继续大吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME eats until its body cracks open, spilling any undigested food from inside its stomach. Fortunately, it heals quickly, allowing it to resume feasting.

entry: 慈善食堂常请POKENAME给无家可归的人和被遗弃的宝可梦做饭。POKENAME研究如何按顾客改菜单，手艺足与各菜系名厨匹敌。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Soup kitchens often employ POKENAME to make meals for homeless people and abandoned Pokémon. POKENAME study how to adapt menus to different customers, their skills rivaling those of expert chefs of any cuisine.

entry: POKENAME高蛋白、低脂肪，正适合做清淡版火稚鸡香滑蛋包饭。野外多，又有农场专门养来食用，因此POKENAME仍会是常见早餐主食。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are high in protein and low in fat, making them the perfect candidate for a light Torchic Rice over Omelet. Their abundance in the wild along with farms raising them for consumption means that POKENAME will remain a popular breakfast staple.

entry: POKENAME身体渗出黄树汁，干燥后就会收缩。它待在池塘附近，保持水分，免得树汁硬化。
author: .izik
source: Yellow sap oozes from POKENAME's body, constricting as it dries. It remains near ponds to stay hydrated and prevent the sap from hardening.

entry: POKENAME身上漏出的花蜜，会让试图看穿伪装的敌人失明。这巧妙防护，确保它不被发现。
author: .izik
source: The nectar leaking from POKENAME's body blinds foes who are attempting to see it while camouflaged. This clever defense ensures it remains unseen.

entry: 六颗种子的心智住在石中，不停漂游、融合、相互吞噬。蛋黄脸只是悬在一团白色物质中的投影，不断掉落、再生，还颇为可口。
author: epping_forest
source: The minds of the six seeds, constantly drifting, fusing and eating each other, lay within the stone. The yolk-faces are just a projection of them suspended in a mass of white, constantly falling off and regenerating, and are also quite tasty.

entry: POKENAME耳朵漏出的黄液，常用于制作粘粘肥。
author: .izik
source: A yellow fluid leaks from the ears of an POKENAME. This substance is regularly used in the creation of Gooey Mulch.

entry: POKENAME将蛋状的嘴放进其他宝可梦的巢中作陷阱，想吃掉前来偷蛋的宝可梦。对巢主与新孵出的幼崽，却十分友善。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME place their egg-like mouths in other Pokémon's nests as traps, attempting to eat any Pokémon that tries to steal them. Despite this, they are friendly to the parents and newly hatched babies.

entry: POKENAME体内不断生成蛋黄般的液体，愿意送别人尝尝。喝过的对象，此后几小时会拥有微弱超能力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME constantly creates more yolk-like fluid within, offering it to others to sample. Those that drink it develop faint psychic powers for a few hours afterward.

entry: POKENAME会现身训练家面前，提醒有一颗蛋受损或需要帮助，再引他们去宝可梦中心检查，免得发生不幸。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME appear before Trainers to warn them that one of their eggs is damaged or otherwise needs help. They guide Trainers to a Pokémon Center to get their egg examined and prevent an otherwise unfortunate event.

entry: 种在POKENAME体内的种子，受液体滋养，很快就会健康长大。甚至能结果，不过吃后会留有鲜明的蛋味。
author: sk372
source: Seeds planted within POKENAME's body will grow up healthy in short order, nurtured by the liquids inside. The plants can even bear fruit, though the fruit will contain a distinctly egg-like aftertaste.

entry: 种在POKENAME体内的种子，受液体滋养，很快就会健康长大。甚至能结果，不过吃后会留有鲜明的蛋味。
author: sk372
source: Seeds planted within POKENAME's body will grow up healthy in short order, nurtured by the liquids inside. The plants can even bear fruit, though the fruit will contain a distinctly egg-like aftertaste.

entry: POKENAME静止时，脚底长出细根，扎进土里，吸收水分，滋养身体。
author: .izik
source: Tiny roots grow from POKENAME's feet and burrow into soil when it remains stationary. These roots absorb moisture to nourish its body.

entry: POKENAME最大的一簇胡须能充当巢穴，保护同胞。它产生的磁场让大家不至于彼此散开。
author: melodydelune
source: The largest part of POKENAME's moustache acts as a nest to protect its siblings. Its magnetic field keeps them from being separated.

entry: POKENAME为何折磨同族，生物学家至今不解。最受认可的说法，是它想压制同族成长，以免自己的地位被取代。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Biologists are perplexed as to why POKENAME tortures its kin. The most popular theory is that it is stunting their growth to prevent usurpation.

entry: 蛋与剑各是独立的生命，靠心灵感应相连。即使被分开，也会彼此吸引，重新合在一起。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The egg and sword are separate entities with a telepathic bond. They attract and rejoin each other after being separated.

entry: POKENAME角上漏出的黄毒液，会令接触者怒得无法自制。效果最长持续八小时，之后才消退。
author: .izik
source: The yellow venom that leaks from POKENAME's horn induces uncontrollable rage in anyone exposed. The effects last for up to eight hours before subsiding.

entry: POKENAME常被误认成美餐，便以此诱来其他宝可梦，释放危险的投球攻击。POKENAME深入洞穴找叶之石，想靠进化摆脱这副美味外表。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME are often mistaken for a tasty meal, using the resemblance to draw in other Pokémon before unleashing a dangerous Barrage. POKENAME hunt for Leaf Stones deep in caves, in an attempt to evolve and change their delicious appearance.

entry: POKENAME的同胞，会从主体上萌发而出。主体产生的蛋黄供养着它们，直到能脱离主体，独立生活。
author: melodydelune
source: Its siblings bud off the main body of POKENAME. The yolk it produces feeds its siblings until they are able to split off onto their own.

entry: POKENAME不停渗出液体。多数生物接触都危险，可它也能破坏有害细菌与非自然物质。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are constantly leaking fluid. While it is dangerous for most living beings to come in contact with, it destroys harmful bacteria and unnatural substances.

entry: POKENAME把多彩甜蛋送给别人，格外受孩子与幼小宝可梦喜爱。它常偷偷留下礼物，免得被馋甜食的小家伙团团围住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gifts colorful sweet eggs to others, making it especially popular with young children and Pokémon. It often leaves these gifts in secret so as not to be overwhelmed by eager youngsters craving sweets.

entry: POKENAME头如头盔，分泌的油在日光下滋滋作响。尾尖稠液则会被泼向四周，分散攻击者注意力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's helmet-like head sizzles in the sunlight due to the oils it secretes. The thick fluid on the tip of its tail is splashed around to distract attackers.

entry: POKENAME飞回住处时，会带上常春藤与其他枝叶，织成蛋盒般的巢，让栖所安全柔软。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME brings ivy and other foliage while flying back to its home and weaves nests that resemble egg cartons. This behavior helps it create a safe and soft living environment.

entry: POKENAME把月光吸进覆在手和翅膀上的蛋黄般物质，让夜里的超能力更强。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME absorbs moonlight into the yolk-like substance coating its hands and wings. This energy enhances its psychic capabilities during the night.

entry: POKENAME身体渗出的蛋黄状物质，味道像树脂。虽每只只由一个单元构成，野外却常与同类群居，或许源于蛋蛋的DNA。
author: bobosmith01
source: The yolk-looking substance that oozes from POKENAME's body tastes like tree resin. While each one only consist of one unit, an POKENAME tend to live together with others of their kind in the wild, perhaps due to their Exeggcute DNA.

entry: POKENAME吸附力强，爱黏住泳者的脚，还会用胶冻内里造出一只手，抓着不放，只想搭个便车。
author: .izik
source: With strong suction capabilities, POKENAME attempts to latch onto the feet of swimmers. It creates a hand from its gelatinous insides, refusing to let go as it looks to hitch a ride.

entry: POKENAME把小身体藏进蛋壳，混入一窝蛋，让亲代把它当亲生的照料、保暖。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME hides its small body inside eggshells. It uses this disguise to blend in with clutches of eggs, letting parents tend to it and keep it warm as if it were their own.

entry: POKENAME划出一道道圆弧斩击，既威吓猎物，也驱退天敌。若察觉巢边有险，便坚决不肯离开。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slashes in circular patterns to intimidate prey and keep predators away. If it senses danger near its nest, it refuses to leave.

entry: POKENAME把尾巴浸入水中吸水，让身体更强、外壳更硬。这习惯使它在湿地生息繁盛。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lays its tail in water to absorb liquid, using it to grow stronger and harden its shell. This habit helps it thrive in wetlands.

entry: POKENAME的两个头彼此环转，转动时以管道交换蛋黄般的树汁，滋养整个POKENAME。树汁则由光合作用产生。
author: foolish_weasel
source: The two component heads of POKENAME rotate around each other. They exchange a yolky sap through their tubes as they rotate which nourishes the POKENAME as a whole. The sap is produced via photosynthesis.

entry: POKENAME想清静，就会摩擦身体，发出金属铿锵声。研究者注意到，此时POKENAME还会散出早餐般的气味。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When POKENAME want to be left alone, they grind their bodies to make a metallic clanging noise. Researchers have noted that when this occurs, POKENAME emits a scent that smells like breakfast.

entry: POKENAME的蛋看着诱人，吃起来却极辣。蛋里本就有充足的香料与盐，早已调好了味。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME eggs seem tempting to eat, but are very spicy. The eggs are well-seasoned with spices and salts.

entry: POKENAME收集其他宝可梦产的蛋，用树果糊和有机材料装饰。原因未明，不过有人认为，某个春日节庆便以此为灵感。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME collect eggs laid by other Pokémon and decorate them using berry paste and other organic materials. It is not known why they do this, but this habit is thought to have been the inspiration for a certain spring holiday.

entry: POKENAME大群紧聚，自保求安。身体轻而脆，轻轻一戳就可能漏出维持浮力的液体，失去活力，动弹不得。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME groups stick together en masse for safety. Their bodies are light and fragile, with even a single poke being capable of causing them to leak the fluid that keeps them aloft and become inert.

entry: POKENAME虽然壳碎了，却仍活着，常想报仇。它藏在超市蛋盒里，谁打开，就顶撞谁。
author: heal_fire
source: Despite its shell being broken, POKENAME is still alive and often seeks out vengeance. It hides in egg boxes inside supermarkets and headbutts anyone who opens them.

entry: 裹住POKENAME的胶冻液甜得惊人，烘焙师争相求取，常用于蛋糕与酥点，添上独特甜味。
author: .izik
source: The gelatinous fluid surrounding POKENAME has an incredibly sweet taste, making it highly sought after by bakers. It is often used in cakes and pastries, adding a unique sugary flavor.

entry: POKENAME施展超能力攻击时，蛋黄般的身体轻轻晃颤。一个念头，就强到足以压碎汽车。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's yolk-like body jiggles while it launches psychic attacks. A single thought is powerful enough to crush a car.

entry: POKENAME浮不起来，只能滚行，寻找同类相聚。它们借数量优势互相守护，同时释放强大的妖精属性攻击。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME are unable to float and instead roll about, seeking to gather with others of their species. They are drawn to use their strength in numbers to protect one another from threats, unleashing powerful Fairy-type attacks in unison.

entry: 它口中渗出的黏稠毒液含有丰富的养分，煮沸除毒后，尝起来有些像鸡蛋。随着年龄增长，毒液会变得更加致命，毒素也越发难以去除。
author: infinex21
source: The liquid seeping from its mouth is a viscous poison that contains many nutrients. This liquid can be boiled to remove the toxins and has a taste reminiscent of eggs. As it ages, the poison becomes deadlier and the toxins become harder to remove.

entry: POKENAME的身体，由握着的蛋形面具内的蛋黄状液体构成。若不堪周围环境的刺激，就会缩回面具里。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is formed from a yolk-like fluid within the egg mask it holds onto. It can retreat into the mask when it feels overwhelmed by its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME身上的倒刺并非硬质，而是带蛋黄气味的胶状物。由于特性独特，已被用于烘焙。
author: .izik
source: The barbs on POKENAME's body are not solid but a gelatinous yolk-scented material. These have been used in baking due to their unusual properties.

entry: POKENAME身上的每颗蛋，一生都能多次转变分工。现在是头，某天转个身就成手或腿。研究者至今未弄清，这高深原理究竟如何运作。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Each of the eggs on POKENAME can specialise many times within its life. What is currently its head will one day become its arm or leg, with POKENAME rotating its entire body. Researchers have yet to determine how this advanced science works.

entry: POKENAME头上的壳，其实是头骨的一部分，能额外护身。谁闯得太近，它就会读取对方心思。
author: .izik
source: The shell on POKENAME's head is actually part of its skull, providing extra protection. It reads the minds of anyone who ventures too close to its nest.

entry: 它们口中渗出稠毒液，临近进化时，毒液可能转为酸性。POKENAME通常六只一群，彼此十分关爱。
author: infinex21
source: The fluid that seeps from their mouths is a viscous poison that can become acidic as they grow nearer to their evolution. POKENAME tend to live in flocks of six and care for each other greatly.

entry: POKENAME壳中漏出的黄黏液酸性极强，几分钟便能蚀穿铁。这物质既危险，又难预测。
author: .izik
source: The yellow ooze leaking from POKENAME's shell is incredibly acidic, capable of burning through iron in mere minutes. This substance is dangerous and unpredictable.

entry: POKENAME外甲由愈合极快的植物状壳片组成，核心身体则是黏稠黄液。双重构造，让它既坚韧，又适应力强。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's carapace consists of fast-healing, plant-like shells, while its core body is a slimy yellow substance. This dual composition makes it both durable and adaptive.

entry: POKENAME将身体半埋土中，保护脆弱身躯。壳一裂开，身体便散出难闻硫味。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME protect their fragile bodies by partially burying their bodies beneath the ground. If their shell cracks, their bodies produce a foul sulfuric smell.

entry: POKENAME随心里的节奏摇摆，性情总悠闲。即使壳受损，也总找得到时间，继续轻柔缓慢地跳舞。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sway their internal sense of rhythm and are overall laidback creatures. Even when their shell is damaged, they always find time to continue their soft and slow dance.

entry: POKENAME带着鲜明的臭蛋味，钻遍垃圾桶，找蛋壳，碾成小碎片再吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have the distinct scent of rotten eggs. They dig through garbage cans to dig up eggshells that they crush into tiny pieces before eating.

entry: POKENAME收紧胶冻身体，藏进空心木头，调整外壳颜色，装成木头延伸的一部分。受惊时，真身就滑走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME condenses its gelatinous body to hide within hollowed-out logs, adapting the color of its outer shell to resemble an extension of the log. The true body slithers away when startled.

entry: POKENAME口中漏出的液体甜香浓烈，引孩子与猎物靠近。一到近前，便以麻痹粉攻击。
author: .izik
source: The fluid leaking from POKENAME's mouth has an intensely sweet scent, luring children and prey closer. Once near, it strikes with Stun Spore.

entry: POKENAME的铠甲由强化蛋壳构成，覆着保护层，显得略能反光。真正的身体，则是壳内蛋黄。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME's armor is made of reinforced egg shells coated in a protective layer that gives it a somewhat reflective appearance. Its true body is made up of the yolk contained within.

entry: POKENAME初看惹人想抱，可一受伤，就难免漏出蛋清，常把孩子吓坏。因此许多家长会遗弃POKENAME，或干脆从不领养。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME may seem cuddly at first, but they inevitably leak out egg whites from their bodies when they get hurt. This often scares children and causes many parents to abandon POKENAME or never adopt one at all.

entry: POKENAME大半身体柔软如胶冻，唯有突出的尖刺锐利。外似蛋黄，毒素却赋予苦味，保护POKENAME不被天敌吃掉。
author: .jerden
source: Most of POKENAME's body is soft and jelly-like, except for the sharp, thorny spikes protruding from it. Although it resembles egg yolk, the toxins it produces give it a bitter flavor to protect POKENAME from predators.

entry: POKENAME有蛋壳般坚韧的物质护身。野生POKENAME常在海滩爬行，像植物般吸收阳光。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is protected by a durable substance similar to eggshell. Wild POKENAME are usually found crawling around on beaches, taking in sunlight like a plant.

entry: POKENAME有蛋壳般坚韧的物质护身。锯齿边缘能划击其他宝可梦，既捕猎，也防天敌将它掀翻，露出壳内脆弱的头。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is protected by a durable substance similar to eggshell. It uses its serrated edges to slash at other Pokémon, both to hunt prey and to protect itself from being flipped over by predators to expose the vulnerable head within its shell.

entry: POKENAME皮肤上的薄壳，一干就裂，只好待在沙漠绿洲附近，才能在旱地存活。
author: .izik
source: The thin shell covering POKENAME's skin cracks if it dries out, forcing it to stay near desert oases. This behavior helps it survive in arid climates.

entry: POKENAME住在几乎不下雨的极旱沙漠，体内储着生存必需的水与蛋白质，让POKENAME的内里看起来像蛋。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME live in very arid desert where it almost never rains. They stock the water and the proteins they need to survive inside themselves, which make POKENAME's insides look like an egg.

entry: POKENAME身体的六个部分，以半透明的超能力细线相连。睡过的地方，会长出小黄蘑菇。
author: .izik
source: All six sections of POKENAME's body are linked by a translucent line of psychic energy. Small yellow mushrooms grow in areas where it sleeps.

entry: POKENAME头部皱领分泌蛋黄般的液体，奔跑时在身后拖出独特的黄色闪光气息。虽然好看，多数对象却不喜欢附带的蛋味。
author: sk372
source: The frills on POKENAME's head emit a yolk-like liquid that creates a uniquely yellow, shimmering aura behind it when it runs. While intriguing to view, most don't care for the egg-like scent it also carries.

entry: POKENAME的皮肤会像薄蛋壳般剥落。碎片肥力极好，植物学家常求来改良土壤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's skin flakes off like delicate eggshells. These pieces are highly fertile and sought after by botanists for improving soil.

entry: POKENAME背上蘑菇渗出芥末色液体，含有毒孢子。烹煮除去孢子后，就成了早餐三明治常用的调味料。
author: .izik
source: The mushroom on POKENAME back oozes a mustard-colored liquid that contains toxic spores. Cooking out the spores of this liquid creates a popular condiment used for breakfast sandwiches.

entry: POKENAME身体空心，内里的花蜜状黏液控制行动。这独特构造，诡异得令人不安。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is hollow, with a nectar-like slime inside that controls its movements. This unique composition makes it eerily unsettling.

entry: POKENAME遇险就朝敌人扔蛋。POKENAME舌头是培根，因此人们常取身体的一部分烹食。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: When POKENAME is threatened, it throws eggs at opponents. POKENAME has a tongue of bacon, so people often cook parts of its body as food.

entry: POKENAME行进时，将种子护在蛋盒般的壳里。一次只能喂少量种子，便会将多余的脱下，最终长成新的POKENAME。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: As POKENAME travels, it keeps its seeds safe inside its carton-like shell. As it can only feed a small number at once, it will shed these seeds which will eventually become new POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME身上的六张脸，让它随时察觉四周。据说喝下头部所分泌的蛋黄状物质，能短暂窥见灵界。
author: sk372
source: The six faces on POKENAME's body allow it to be aware of its surroundings at all times. The yolk-like substance it secretes from its head is said to grant a person a glimpse into the spirit realm when consumed.

entry: 据说使劲摇晃POKENAME，就能让它产出轻盈的蛋奶酱。尚未证实，却已有许多POKENAME被训练家摇了又失手摔下，因而受伤。
author: quackquackattack
source: It is said that POKENAME can be shaken vigorously to make them produce a light custard. While this has yet to be proven, many POKENAME end up hurt when their Trainer shakes and drops them.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，双翼溅出有毒黄液。受害者常昏厥，有些声称之后失去了身体控制。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME splashes a poisonous yellow fluid from its wings while flying. Victims often black out, with some claiming to lose control of their bodies afterward.

entry: POKENAME用于世界各地的食谱，是少数不伤宝可梦便可取得蛋的途径之一。枝荔果派、沙鳞果蛋糕、瓜西果饼干等甜点面团，都会加入它。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are incorporated into recipes around the world, as they are one of the few ways to obtain eggs without hurting Pokémon. They are incorporated into the dough of sweet desserts like Liechi Berry Pie, Salac Berry Cake, and Watmel Berry Cookies.

entry: POKENAME分泌蛋奶酱，人们拿来给饮料添甜。清淡奶香既配咖啡，也配某些茶，让它成了厨房里的多面好伙伴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produces secretions of custard that diners use to sweeten drinks. The milky, light flavor pairs well with coffee, as well as some tea pairings, making them a versatile partner in the kitchen.

entry: 有人推测，乐天河童欢庆的天性已刻入DNA，让融合体外观也生出怪变化。例如POKENAME可能色彩鲜亮张扬。POKENAME虽擅交际，却不爱身体接触。
author: bobosmith01
source: Some theorize that Ludicolo's festive nature has been ingrained in its very DNA and causes quirks in fusions' appearance; for instance, POKENAME can come in bright and flamboyant colors. POKENAME can be very social but they dislike physical touch.

entry: POKENAME高速移动时会发热，烹熟内里，反而让超能力能量更强。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME generates heat when moving at high speeds. This cooks their innards, which in turn strengthens their psychic energy.

entry: POKENAME战斗时蜕去外壳，提升力量与速度，击败对手。脆弱核心若被戳破，就会逃走，躲到外壳重新长好。
author: ohok3441
source: In battle, POKENAME sheds their shell to increase their power and speed to defeat an opponent. If their fragile core is popped, they will flee and hide until their shell regrows.

entry: 许多厨师把POKENAME带在身旁，它能轻易预知，菜肴还欠火候，还是缺些滋味。
author: dodoowner_
source: Many chefs keep an POKENAME by their sides. It can easily predict if a meal is missing heat or flavor.

entry: POKENAME沿圆形路线掘行，同时释放超能力波动，能迫使心志薄弱的生物送来食物，或在附近播种。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases psychic waves while digging in circular paths. These waves can compel weak-minded creatures to bring food or plant seeds nearby.

entry: 这只刚出生的小家伙有点害羞。壳里的宝可梦不肯彻底钻出来，蛋壳便成了它的护甲。
author: theheroict
source: A hatchling who is a bit shy. The Pokémon within refuses to hatch fully, and its shell works as armor of sorts.

entry: POKENAME每个头都能独立思考，因此出了名爱和自己争吵。应付不过来时，就常常头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is known to argue with itself, as each head is capable of independent thought. This leads to it getting many headaches, as it is easily overwhelmed.

entry: POKENAME与蛋蛋群相处融洽，遇上还常会收养。柔软毛皮与温暖身体，让整群健康成长，似乎越养越强壮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gets along well with and often adopts Exeggcute clutches it comes across. Its soft fur and warm body keep the group healthy and even seem to make them stronger over time.

entry: POKENAME身上的培根太诱人，有些训练家竟忍不住咬自己的宝可梦。结果往往是脸上挨一记喷射火焰。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME bacon is so tempting to eat that some Trainers actually bite their Pokémon. This usually results in a Flamethrower to their face.

entry: POKENAME用超能力，让对手误以为自己饿得快死。幻觉使对方分心，也露出破绽。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses psychic power to trick opponents into believing they are starving. This illusion leaves them vulnerable and distracted.

entry: POKENAME长出蛋状物，再从身体摘下，用四只手烹成美味。在一些地区，这些料理已成珍馐。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME creates egg-like growths which it'll pull off of its body. Using its four arms, it will cook delicious dishes with these growths, which have become a delicacy in several regions.

entry: 年幼POKENAME没有四肢，壳若破了，就用内里稠液行走。黄色种子以浓香引来虫宝可梦，让它们陷进黏液，再吸收养分。
author: periperi_chicken
source: Young POKENAME don't have limbs, but if its shell is cracks, it uses the viscous liquid inside itself to walk around. Its yellow seeds lure bug Pokémon with a rich scent, and gets them trapped in the sticky liquid and absorbed for nutrients.

entry: POKENAME像一颗蛋，蛋黄正从里面流出。双臂其实是硬树汁，内里有模仿肌肉系统的根系驱动，帮它稳稳上下山。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Resembling an egg with yolk spilling from it, POKENAME's arms are actually made out of a hardened sap manipulated internally by roots that mimic a muscular system. It uses these arms to steadily climb up and down mountains.

entry: POKENAME头上的许多突起，每个都藏着独立大脑。生气时，会用念力向敌人猛掷物体。
author: .izik
source: The many growths on POKENAME's head each house a separate brain. When angered, it uses telekinesis to fling objects at its foes.

entry: POKENAME控制身边磁场，把各种器具吸到身上防护。若受厨师训练，它们也能成为出色厨子。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME control the magnetic field around them, attaching various utensils to themselves for defense. If trained by a chef, these Pokémon can become very talented cooks.

entry: POKENAME施展超能力时，所有眼睛都紧紧盯住目标，凭集中意念使敌人无法行动。光是吓人的凝视，就足以令对手僵在原地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stares intently with all its eyes while using a psychic attack, disabling its foes through sheer focus. Its intimidating glare is enough to freeze enemies in place.

entry: 碰到POKENAME的污泥，身上三天内就会长出壳状物。这些增生物，大约要一个月才完全消退。
author: .izik
source: Touching POKENAME's sludge causes shell-like growths to form on one's body within three days. These growths take about a month to fully subside.

entry: POKENAME靠多个大脑，能同时侵入、吞食好几个梦。吃得多快，取决于受害者的智力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME, using its multiple brains, can invade and consume several dreams simultaneously. The speed of consumption depends on the victim's intelligence.

entry: POKENAME的摆锤拥有意识，控制从壳里滴下的黏液流向。碰到黏液，就会看见恐怖幻象。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's pendulum is sentient, controlling the trajectory of the goo dripping from its shell. Contact with this goo induces terrifying visions.

entry: POKENAME喜欢把蛋朝目标扔过去，可大得过头的钳子，有时会先把蛋夹碎。结果既糊了满脸蛋液，又丢尽面子。
author: hellaluyeah
source: POKENAME enjoys throwing its egg at targets. Sometimes its oversized pincer breaks the egg, causing it to have literal and figurative egg on its face.

entry: POKENAME背上的椰子会产生能安抚心绪的椰奶。宝可梦只喝一口，就会睡着。
author: dodoowner_
source: The coconut on POKENAME's back produces very soothing coconut milk. It can put Pokémon to sleep with just one sip.

entry: POKENAME的七个头合力形成360度视野，却又讨厌协作，战斗表现不佳。只有最有爱心的训练家，教会它们配合，才能发掘力量。
author: duskit___
source: POKENAME's 7 heads all coordinate together to create a 360 field of view, but they hate working together, making them ineffective in battle. But only the most caring Trainers can unlock their power by teaching them to coordinate together.

entry: 与自身融合后，POKENAME像极了阿罗拉地区未融合的同族。长得太高，令它极依赖光照，没有任何光源时，几乎无法运作。
author: sk372
source: After self-fusion, POKENAME resembles its unfused counterpart from the Alola region. It's tall height makes it incredibly reliant on sunlight exposure; it becomes almost non-functioning without a light source of some kind.

entry: POKENAME的几个头常争论该怎么做。它便让装着头的弹簧拳套互撞，逼它们先达成一致，再攻击。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME's heads often argue over decisions. It resolves this by striking its spring-loaded gloves with its mounted heads together, forcing them to agree before attacking.

entry: POKENAME受惊时，会把育儿袋中的一只幼年蛋蛋扔向攻击者。虽然危险，蛋蛋们却很喜欢被这样抛来抛去。
author: teatedtiten
source: When startled, POKENAME will throw one of the baby Exeggcute in its pouches at the aggressor. The Exeggcute love being thrown around, even if it is dangerous for them.

entry: POKENAME对演出娱乐的悠闲态度很受欢迎，常上著名电视喜剧节目。不过POKENAME不容被苛待，一认出有人剥削，就会翻脸。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME are loved for their laid-back attitude towards performance and entertainment, regularly seen in some famous comedy shows on TV. POKENAME do not take kindly to mistreatment, though, being known to snap when they recognize exploitation.

entry: POKENAME吸收越多阳光，副头就越长越大，常让背部疼痛。因此，它更喜欢阴处。
author: kiwiarms
source: As it absorbs more sunlight, POKENAME's secondary heads grow, often leading to back pain. For this reason, it prefers the shade.

entry: POKENAME腿短却有力，撑着硬刺叶片，常猛甩叶片打敌。嘴看着虽小，却能张得大到吓人，吐出种子炸弹与种子机关枪。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have strong, albeit short, legs that help hold up their hard, spiky leaves which they often flail about to batter foes. Their mouths appear small at first but can frighteningly open wider to allow them to spit Seed Bombs and Bullet Seeds.

entry: POKENAME会在群内竞争，互相冲撞，直到头撞落。只要阳光充足，头一天内就能再生。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME will compete within their herds. They charge at each other until their heads fall off. These heads regrow in a day with proper sunlight.

entry: POKENAME的长叶间，会定期结出各式树果。若开始只结某一种，就说明POKENAME接近进化。
author: sk372
source: A variety of different berries grows periodically on POKENAME's fronds. If it starts only growing a specific type of berry, it is a sign that POKENAME is close to evolving.

entry: 这株发芽的幼苗，或刚孵出的幼体，在取得足够养分与阳光后，上岸成长。从此便能让小型“繁殖体”POKENAME脱落，进行营养繁殖。
author: deltag0n
source: A sprouting seedling or hatchling that has moved ashore to mature after finding sufficient nutrients and sunlight. From this point onward in its development, it can perform a vegetative reproduction by detaching its smaller 'propagule' POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME常在海滩游荡，靠承担视觉的椰蛋树与化石盔融合体，进行营养克隆。若帮它视物、狩猎的个体全没了，就将下半身埋起，靠光合作用维生，等新个体长回。
author: deltag0n
source: Frequently found stalking beaches, POKENAME is capable of vegetative cloning through the Exegguto it relies on for sight. If no Exegguto are left to allow it to see and hunt, it buries its lower body to photosynthesize until one regrows.

entry: POKENAME正中央的头控制行动。双臂叶片能展开成巨翼，托起沉重身体。
author: infinex21
source: The center-most head is the one in control of POKENAME's movements. The leaves on its arms can expand to become vast wings to carry its heavy body.

entry: 总有一个头醒着进食，另外两个头睡觉。POKENAME虽吃树果与水果，其实只靠阳光和水也能活，只是不肯这样过。
author: infinex21
source: One head is always awake and eating while the other two heads are asleep. Though POKENAME will eat berries and fruits, they can live off sunlight and water alone but simply choose not to.

entry: POKENAME各个头性格差异极大。若和某个头合不来，POKENAME就剪掉它，再长一个新的。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME's heads have drastically different personalities. If it doesn't get along with one of its heads, POKENAME will prune it and grow a new one.

entry: POKENAME身上嫩叶气味浓烈，许多宝可梦都讨厌，宛如天然除虫喷雾。科学家正想把叶子加入现有除虫喷雾配方，增强效力。
author: chibitales
source: Immature leaves on POKENAME's body have a very strong odor that many Pokémon dislike, acting as a natural Repel. Scientists are now looking to add these leaves to existing Repel recipes to strengthen them.

entry: POKENAME向敌人吐出极易爆燃的种子，有时连副头也抛出去。副头没有大脑，很快就能再生。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME spit explosively-flammable seeds at their opponents and will sometimes even throw their side-heads as well. Their side-heads have no brains and regrow quickly.

entry: POKENAME胸部的脸是否有意识，还不清楚。不过一位学者坚称，那张脸曾朝自己眨眼，因而引发争论。
author: dusknoir64
source: It is unknown if the face on POKENAME's thorax is sentient, however, it has become a subject of debate after one scholar swore the face winked at him.

entry: POKENAME脚踝长出种子，能调用其中养分，长久飞行。POKENAME白天飞行时，种子又会渐渐长大。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME grow their seeds from their ankles. They can draw on the nutrients within the seeds to maintain flight for long periods of time. These seeds grow large again while POKENAME flies during the day.

entry: 容易晒伤的人，常靠结实的POKENAME遮阳。POKENAME爱发呆，不大容易走远，让训练家的阴凉始终就在身旁。
author: quackquackattack
source: People who easily get sunburnt often rely on a sturdy POKENAME to give them shade. Because POKENAME tend to space out, they are less likely to wander far, ensuring that shade is close by for their Trainer.

entry: POKENAME面对潜在敌人，开打前常先用椰奶和各式树果，调一杯饮品招待。它紧张等待对方反应，盼着避免争斗。
author: hophoppip
source: Before fighting a potential foe, POKENAME will often create a mixed drink for it, making use of coconut milk and various berries. It nervously awaits the other Pokémon's reaction to the drink, hoping to avoid conflict.

entry: POKENAME长出肉桂香的鳞片，人们会收来入菜。各个头还流着甜树汁，烘焙师收集后，为糕点裹上糖衣。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce scales that smell like cinnamon and are harvested for culinary arts. Each of the heads also drool a sugary sap that bakers collect to produce a glaze over baked goods.

entry: POKENAME的根覆着坚硬鳞片，能迅速吸水。一被挖出地面，就只剩有限时间，随后几个头与身体基部都会爆炸。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have roots that are covered with tough scales and quickly absorb moisture. Whenever they are dug out of the ground, they have a limited amount of time before both their heads and the base of their bodies explode.

entry: POKENAME的壳像椰子，抵御鸟宝可梦的锐喙与利爪。它们常混在其他椰子间，训练家一捡起，就被吓一跳。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a shell that resembles the fruit of a coconut tree and protects them from the sharp beaks and talons of bird Pokémon. They often hide among other coconuts, which ends up startling Trainers who pick them up.

entry: POKENAME从不放下随身带着的几个头，双爪因此总被占满。几个头便用超能力击晕猎物，弥补这点，方便捕猎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME never lets go of the heads it carries with it. Because this keeps its claws always occupied, the heads compensate by using psychic powers to stun prey and make it easier to hunt.

entry: POKENAME住在赤道附近，能晒足太阳。阳光越多，角就越长，偶尔甚至会长出果实或花。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME lives near the equator, where it can get plenty of sun. The more sunlight it receives, the longer its horn will grow. Rarely, the horn may spawn fruit or flowers.

entry: POKENAME常见于餐馆或面包店旁，吸收废蛋壳，滋养背上的几个头。它细心喂得均匀，因为哪个没吃饱，就会烦躁。
author: secondegg
source: Often spotted around restaurants or bakeries, POKENAME absorbs scrapped eggshells as nutrients for the heads on its back. It takes great care to feed each head equally, as they will become agitated if underfed.

entry: POKENAME混在椰蛋树间伏击。黄铜色双翼让伪装很容易，因此总能打猎物一个措手不及。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME set up an ambush by hiding among Exeggutor. Their brass-colored wings make the camouflage easy, so they have an easy time surprising their prey.

entry: POKENAME长出椰子头，像火箭筒般发射，既能轻松单发，也能接连射出。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME grows coconut heads and shoots them out like a bazooka. It can easily fire individually or in spurts.

entry: POKENAME的领地，多在人口聚居地附近的海滩。它们并无害意，游客闯入家园时，会挺直身躯，装成棕榈树，盼不被发现。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME territories mostly consist of beaches around populated areas. They are not inherently harmful, but will straighten their trunks to mimic palm trees in hopes of not being spotted when tourists invade their home.

entry: POKENAME每个头能各自处理计算与战术，同时使出多种特殊招式。有记录显示，有些POKENAME会靠安装的软件，复制所持树果的效果。
author: npshi
source: Each head of POKENAME can process different calculations and strategies, allowing them to create a variety of Special moves at once. It has been documented that some POKENAME use installed software to duplicate the effect of the Berries they hold.

entry: POKENAME友善又乐天，遇见新朋友就跑去亲吻。吻痕会留下椰子的香气与滋味。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a friendly and happy-go-lucky creature that runs up and kisses any new acquaintance it sees. Its kisses leave behind marks that carry the scent and taste of coconut.

entry: POKENAME大半空心的身体里会产生植物奶，准备好时，POKENAME便自愿让奶从乳房流出。奶无乳糖、富含维生素，因此乳制品过敏的人，可能改买它的奶。
author: bobosmith01
source: Plant milk generates within POKENAME's mostly-hollow body, which will voluntarily leak from its udders when POKENAME is ready. This fluid lacks lactose and is high in vitamins, so those allergic to dairy products may purchase POKENAME milk instead.

entry: POKENAME住在热带岛屿外的暖水中，藏进珊瑚礁。墨汁滋味像椰奶，广用于阿罗拉料理，因此它们常遭捕猎。
author: joeofthealps
source: POKENAME are found in the warm waters off of tropical islands, hiding in coral reefs. They are widely hunted for their ink, which tastes similar to coconut milk and is used in many Alolan recipes.

entry: POKENAME一边四处抛射炸蛋，一边重重踏地，足以引起局部震动。脚步常把硬岩踩成肥土，大家便学着忍受它们的脾气。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME stomp around with enough force to cause localized tremors while hurling around Egg Bombs. Their stomps often turn even hard rock into fertile dirt, so most learn to live with their tantrums.

entry: POKENAME栖居热带，尤其爱椰林。它凶猛守护椰树，谁敢威胁，就吐出三道彩虹火焰，将其焚烧。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes its home in tropical areas, particularly near coconut groves. It protects the coconut trees fiercely, breathing out three plumes of rainbow fire to burn anyone who threatens them.

entry: POKENAME下方的头，远不如上方聪明。原因是上面的头，总拿它当垫子弹跳。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME's bottom head is considerably less intelligent than the top one. This is because the top head bounces on it all the time.

entry: 一只POKENAME尾上的果实，就能养活整群长尾怪手，换来对方守护。不过，POKENAME仍得保护尾巴，免被饥饿鸟宝可梦啃食。
author: hophoppip
source: One POKENAME's tail fruits can feed an entire colony of Aipom, earning that colony's protection in the process. However, POKENAME must also defend its tails from hungry bird Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME立在冰封湖岸，与冬景显得格格不入。它吸引越冬的虫属性宝可梦，用藤蔓缠住吞食；可面对迷路训练家，却完全温顺。
author: ghostslythe
source: Found on the shores of frozen over lakes, POKENAME stands out harshly against the wintry environment. It attracts Bug types that over-winter, wraps them in vines and devours them. However, they are completely docile to lost Trainers.

entry: POKENAME的三个头，被厚密绿藤缠在一起。强烈日光会让这些藤蔓长得更加粗壮。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's three heads are bound together by a thick tangle of green tendrils. Strong sunlight causes these vines to grow even thicker.

entry: POKENAME常是旅行社职员的伙伴，热带风情的外观，能激起客人度假兴致。骗子也利用这层联想，借POKENAME的形象欺诈想出游的人。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME are often the partner Pokémon of travel agents, as their tropical appearance can inspire clients to book a tropical getaway. Scammers take advantage of this association, using the likeness of POKENAME to defraud prospective vacationers.

entry: POKENAME的三个头共享复杂思维网络，行动前就能迅速计算。巨大重脚踩倒多数小敌人，坚硬椰壳般的外甲，则弹开多数攻击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's three heads share a complex mental network that allows it to quickly calculate its actions before doing them. It stomps most smaller foes with its massive, heavy feet and deflects most attacks with its hard, coconut-like shell.

entry: 这些宝可梦一生只结108颗果实，因此农人不断饲养，再放回野外。许多富有贵族，爱在果园把它们一排排展示。
author: quackquackattack
source: These Pokémon only produce 108 fruits in their entire lifetime, so farmers are constantly raising and releasing them into the wild. Many affluent aristocrats enjoy displaying them in rows in orchards.

entry: POKENAME繁盛于热带，与椰蛋树混群生活。严肃性格常让它被推为首领，管住同伴，免得惹事。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME thrives in tropical areas, where it mingles alongside Exeggutor. Its serious attitude often gets it appointed as the leader of the groups, keeping the rest in line and out of trouble.

entry: 后脑巨颚太重，让POKENAME很难走直，常摇摇晃晃地维持平衡。若有宝可梦把头当树想停上去，就会被咬。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME struggles to walk straight due to the weight of its jaws on the back of its head, often stumbling to keep balanced. It snaps at Pokémon that mistake its head for a tree and try to land on it.

entry: POKENAME战斗时原地打转，以头尾抽打附近敌人，常把对方击倒。人们认为，古代POKENAME还没有超能力，而披着龙一般的铠甲。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME battle by spinning around in circles, whacking any nearby foes with their heads and tails, typically causing them to fall over. It is believed that in ancient times POKENAME did not have psychic abilities, but instead draconic armor.

entry: POKENAME的唾液质地如椰奶，用来喂幼崽。若没宝宝要喂，就积在嘴里，直到流成口水。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's saliva has the same consistency as Coconut Milk, which it uses to feed its offspring. If there are no babies to feed, the saliva collects inside its mouth until it drools.

entry: 有不少记录显示，POKENAME在栖居岛屿上深受喜爱，手工独木舟也绘着它的形象。研究者推测，它曾守护原住民珍视的地点，才赢得这份敬爱。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are well documented as being loved on the islands they reside in, with handcrafted canoes being found with drawings that reference them. Researchers hypothesize that they earned this by guarding locations deemed important by natives.

entry: POKENAME爱和孩子玩接球，常用身体把自己的头弹过整片田野。头一被找到，POKENAME就用大树果奖励孩子。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME love playing catch with children, and they will often use their own bodies to launch their heads across fields. Once its head is found, POKENAME will reward the kids with large berries.

entry: POKENAME只有尾巴能被截断后自行再生。尾端球果质地如菠萝蜜，又像一缕缕撕碎的肉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's tail is the only limb that can be severed and regenerate on its own. The bulbous fruit attached to its tail has the same consistency as jack fruit and has a consistency similar to shredded meat.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，脖子能伸得极长，用头出其不意地撞敌。身上叶片会产出健康油脂，已知能降低人类胆固醇。
author: fiordaliso
source: While in flight, POKENAME can extend its neck to an incredible length to strike its heads against an opponent and catch them off guard. The leaves growing on its body can produce a healthy oil known to reduce cholesterol levels in humans.

entry: POKENAME尾上的头会在炎热潮湿的气候长大。脱落之后，就会成为蛋伊布。
author: melodydelune
source: The head on POKENAME's tail grows in hot, humid climates. When they drop the head, it will go on to become an Exeggveon.

entry: POKENAME的木尾足以推倒树木，可它似乎只想让阳光照到林地。地上蛋蛋越多，破坏就越大，却也会细心避开，不压伤任何一只。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's wooden tail is strong enough to topple trees, but it seems to only do this to bring more light to the forest floor. It is most destructive in forests with lots of Exeggcute on the ground, but carefully avoids crushing any of them.

entry: POKENAME召来的巨浪，竟由甜椰子水构成。这种融合体通常悠闲，生气时却十分危险。
author: hophoppip
source: The huge waves POKENAME summons are made up of sweet coconut water. The fusion is typically laid-back, but can be quite dangerous when angry.

entry: POKENAME的炮以极高速度射出椰子，轻易击昏一切来烦它的对象。看似无穷无尽的弹药，至今不知从何补足。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cannon fires coconuts at extreme velocities, easily knocking out anything that tries to bother it. It is not yet known how POKENAME keeps a seemingly limitless supply of its ammunition.

entry: POKENAME尾端的大圆球，其实是一颗长得太大、没能成为蛋蛋的头。它能从尾巴发射这颗头，施展强力炸蛋，撞击时震动大地。
author: soup1900
source: The large, round object at the end of POKENAME's tail is actually a head that grew far too large to become an Exeggcute. It can launch this head from its tail, performing a powerful Egg Bomb that shakes the world upon impact.

entry: 每逢满月之夜，POKENAME就聚在一起，满怀向往地仰望天空。蛋令它们想起月亮，送POKENAME一颗蛋，是赢得友谊最容易的办法。
author: griddle
source: On every night of a full moon, POKENAME will gather to stare longingly towards the sky. Eggs remind them of the moon; gifting an POKENAME an egg is the easiest way to earn one's friendship.

entry: POKENAME在晴朗满月夜最活跃，偏爱远离喧闹城市。若不舒服，几个头便全露出不满神色。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are most active on the nights of a full moon under a clear night sky. They prefer to be far away from noisy, urban environments. If uncomfortable, its many heads take on a disgruntled expression.

entry: POKENAME满头叶发，软如蓬松棉花。它们潜进湖里彻底洗净，再让柔风吹干叶丝，保养这头美发。
author: quackquackattack
source: The leaves that make up POKENAME's mass of hair are as soft as fluffy cotton. They maintain this beautiful set of hair by diving into lakes to thoroughly wash themselves before drying their leafy locks in a soft breeze.

entry: POKENAME偶尔浮在古老雨林神殿旁，守护逝去领袖的安息地。若领袖后人靠近，它不知怎的便能辨出，本能地奉上附近食物或饮品。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can rarely be seen floating near ancient jungle temples, guarding the resting places of fallen leaders. Should a descendant of those leaders approach, it somehow senses this and instinctively offers them any nearby food or drink.

entry: POKENAME靠能伸展的长腿，避开栖居丛林里的多数天敌。它行走、躲藏在热带树间，吃树梢结出的各式果实。
author: infinex21
source: An POKENAME's stretchy legs allow it to avoid most predators within the jungles they live in. They feed on the various fruits that grow in the tops of the tropical trees they walk and hide amongst.

entry: POKENAME从头顶射刺时，也拔开了里面蛋黄的封口。喷出的蛋黄会把射出的刺粘牢，令敌人在战后许久，仍不断遭扎伤。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME fires the spikes from the tops of its heads, it also uncorks the egg yolk that fills them. It uses this spraying egg yolk to plaster spikes it has fired so that they keep poking and injuring the foe long after the battle.

entry: POKENAME始终饥饿，贪婪吞吃植物和其他宝可梦。可这些对POKENAME毫无滋养作用，真正供给养分的，只有阳光。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME devours both plants and other Pokémon ravenously, since it's always hungry. However, this isn't helpful for POKENAME; it's only actually nourished by sunlight.

entry: POKENAME极其凶猛，蛋状头却非常脆，并不拿来咬东西。生存所需，全来自日光与雨水。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: Though POKENAME is incredibly vicious, its egg-like heads are very fragile and aren't used to bite things. All of its sustenance comes from the sun and rain.

entry: POKENAME像巨大椰子，厚韧外壳保护它免遭天敌。据说椰子水格外清爽，体内会存上大量，撑过漫长海旅。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME resembles a giant coconut with a thick, durable shell that keeps it safe from predators. Its coconut water is said to be incredibly refreshing, and it stores large amounts inside its body to survive long journeys across the sea.

entry: POKENAME尾上的头以心灵感应沟通，战斗时能边交谈、边锁定多个目标。有个故事说，某位训练家与POKENAME羁绊深到行动如同一体。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: The heads on POKENAME's tail communicate telepathically; in battle, this ability allows them to focus on multiple targets while conversing. There was a tale of a Trainer and POKENAME having a bond so strong that they acted and moved as one unit.

entry: POKENAME常挖矿石吃，再留下树果，标记找过的地方。谁挖矿，POKENAME就常不顾一切冲过去，过后自己却晕得厉害。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME often dig up ore for sustenance and leave berries in their place, as a reminder of where they have looked. POKENAME often charge recklessly towards anything excavating ore, which leaves them very dizzy afterwards.

entry: POKENAME在潮水涌至的海滩边缘挖巢，静候涨潮，任海水将猎物送来。够不到的，它们便用超能力直接拉进嘴里。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME form their dens in beach sand right at the edge of where the tide comes in. They lie in wait until high tide, letting the ocean pull in their prey for them and using their psychic powers to draw in anything out of reach into their mouths.

entry: POKENAME背上长叶会随齿轮转动，逐渐结出椰子。转上几百圈，一颗椰子才完全长成，随后立即掉落，留位给下一颗。
author: sk372
source: The leafy fronds on POKENAME's back will grow coconuts over time, relative to the gears' rotation. It takes a few hundred rotations to fully grow a single coconut that immediately falls off so a new one can grow in its place.

entry: 热带文明古来就用POKENAME协助造船，借飞转齿轮驱动滑轮。靠光合作用，它能在整个白天不眠不休地工作。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Tropical civilizations have historically used POKENAME to help with the construction of boats, utilizing its rapidly spinning gears for pulley systems. Because of photosynthesis, it can work tirelessly throughout daylight hours without pause.

entry: POKENAME筑巢时，会从多个头吐火，制备巢内铺垫。睡着后，则散出催人入睡的香气。
author: quackquackattack
source: When POKENAME is making its nest, it breathes fire out of its many heads to create bedding. While it is sleeping, it releases an aroma that induces drowsiness.

entry: POKENAME住在多汁热带果树的枝间。果实一熟透，一小群POKENAME就跳上去，尖牙咬牢，吸到汁液一滴不剩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME live among the branches of trees that grow juicy tropical fruits. Once a fruit ripens enough, a small swarm of POKENAME leap onto it, sinking their fangs into it and draining its juices until it's completely dry.

entry: POKENAME把尖刺扎进棕榈树，藏在椰子间。可它爱在睡着时掉落，让树下行人面临严重危险。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME stab their spikes into palm trees, hiding themselves among coconuts. Due to their habit of falling off while asleep, they pose a serious hazard to those walking below.

entry: POKENAME晒太阳会长得太大，连翅膀都难以托住，因此改成夜里活动。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can grow so large, if exposed to sunlight, that their wings struggle to carry them. They have become nocturnal as a result.

entry: POKENAME在夏日艳阳下热情起舞。身上长出种子状个体，各有性格，虽能掉落，仍算POKENAME的一部分，并非独立物种。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME dances fervently under the summer sun. It produces seed-like growths on its body, each of which has its own personality. Although they can fall off, they are considered part of POKENAME itself and are not a distinct species.

entry: POKENAME虽会躲进洞穴护身，却要在阳光下才成熟、变强。身体有鲜明的椰子香。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although POKENAME may hide in caves for protection, it matures and grows more powerful in sunlight. Its body smells distinctly like coconut.

entry: POKENAME爱懒躺岸边，只有正午才飞，最多一小时。气味如新切椰子，大耳朵传出的舒缓小调，让周围对象放松平静。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME prefers to lazily lay on the shores, only flying for up to an hour at noon. It smells like a freshly cut coconut and those around it will find themselves feeling relaxed and calm from the ambient, soothing tune coming from its big ears.

entry: POKENAME背上的头只想保命，前面的头却只想吃。真饿起来，前头有时连后头也想溶解吃掉，所以后面的头不长叶。
author: soup1900
source: The head on POKENAME's back only thinks of safety, while the head on the front of the body only thinks of food. The front head sometimes tries to dissolve the back head for food when really hungry, which is why the back head grows no leaves.

entry: POKENAME三个头的嗅觉各有细微差别，能捕捉空气中极少量花粉，三角定位其他POKENAME的位置。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The three heads of POKENAME each have a sense of smell that's slightly different from the other two. This enables them to triangulate the location of other POKENAME by sensing even minute traces of pollen in the air.

entry: 椰蛋树的头掉进海里，可能变成这种宝可梦。它们沿岸爬行，寻找其他落单的头，加入自己。
author: frokachu
source: Heads of Exeggutor that fall into the ocean may become this Pokémon. They scuttle about the shoreline, looking for other stray heads to join it.

entry: 野生POKENAME常在热带岛屿岸边，整天移动，确保晒到太阳。若锐刺挡不住来者，POKENAME便用长颈，将头当棍棒甩打。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME are usually found on the shore of tropical islands, wandering all day to ensure they remain in the sun. If their sharp thorns do not deter other Pokémon from approaching, POKENAME use their long necks to swing their heads like a club.

entry: POKENAME常在夜深时，活跃游走热带地区。颈间与头顶长叶散出缤纷极光，带着淡淡热带果香。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is usually active and roaming around tropical areas during the dead of night. The fronds on its neck and head emanate a colorful aurora that carries the faint smell of tropical fruits.

entry: 融合后，派拉斯特的身体外表干枯得厉害，意识却仍留在POKENAME体内。它意外地温柔随和，长满真菌的脑位于身体中央。
author: bobosmith01
source: Parasect's body has outwardly become very dried out in this Fusion, but its consciousness still remains inside of POKENAME. It is surprisingly kind and mellow. Its brain, filled with fungi, is in the middle of its body.

entry: POKENAME摇响椰壳般的鳞片，宣示优势，将其他宝可梦赶出领地。叫声如响亮吟唱，每张嘴都在高低音间变换。
author: bigoljax
source: To assert dominance, POKENAME rattle their coconut-like scales to drive other Pokémon out of their territory. Their calls sound like loud chants, with each mouth changing between a high and low tone.

entry: POKENAME身外有特殊外壳，材质与椰子壳相同。遇险时，就用头上众多叶状硬刺攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a special shell around their body that is made of the same material as coconut shells. When threatened, they strike with the many leafy quills on their head.

entry: POKENAME意志不屈，攻击精准，会不惜一切守护栖居的丛林。POKENAME常与杖尾鳞甲龙切磋磨技，最初发现于阿罗拉岛屿。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME defend the jungles they live in at all costs, as they have an indomitable will and attack with precise focus. POKENAME are known to spar with Kommo-o to hone their skills. POKENAME were originally discovered on Alolan Islands.

entry: POKENAME能装成树，向附近对手射出手里剑。POKENAME也能飞快自转，转到蛋掉下来；这些蛋卖得很贵。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME can camouflage as a tree and fire its shuriken at nearby opponents. POKENAME can rotate itself so fast that eggs fall off; these eggs sell for a high price.

entry: 背上的活火山，提供能量与肥土，让树干长得格外长。想从POKENAME身上取木的伐木工，会迎来背部的一记猛烈喷烟。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The lively volcano on its back provides energy and fertile soil for its trunk to grow extra-long. Lumberjacks attempting to harvest wood from POKENAME are met with a nasty Lava Plume from its back.

entry: POKENAME的果实有热带毛叶番荔枝风味，可每天只结一颗。火箭队开始垄断这种珍果的市场，也让野外愈发难觅。
author: quackquackattack
source: The fruit that POKENAME produces has a tropical cherimoya flavor, but it only produces one fruit a day. It is rare to find one in the wild because Team Rocket has begun monopolizing the market of this rare fruit.

entry: POKENAME平日大多乘浪，或晒太阳。头可能长得过大而掉落，不过还会再生。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME spends most of its days riding the waves or soaking in the sun. Its head may grow too large and fall off, but it will regrow.

entry: POKENAME一生都住在第一次见到的海滩，凶猛捍卫这片沙滩与朋友。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME spends its whole life on the first beach it sees. It defends this beach and its friends viciously.

entry: POKENAME身体定期长出鲜嫩大椰子，每天至少落一颗。它乐意分享头上椰子的鲜汁，尤其爱凑庆典，既有伙伴，又有音乐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body regularly grows large and fresh coconuts, with at least one falling from the tree a day. It happily shares fresh juice from the one upon its head, and is particularly drawn to festivities where it can enjoy both company and music.

entry: POKENAME烧灌丛，为自己制备卧铺。科学家或其他闯入者若打扰，它就催眠对方，哄入睡中。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME burns shrubs and bushes to create bedding for itself. It hypnotizes scientists and other intruders when disturbed by lulling them to sleep.

entry: POKENAME随年龄增长，身体可能高出很多。少数报告称，有些个体长到棕榈树般高。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME ages, its body may grow significantly taller. Rare reports describe individuals reaching the height of a palm tree.

entry: POKENAME每次鸣叫，尾尖种球都会跟着模仿。不论听过多少回，POKENAME总对这回声又吃惊、又困惑。
author: sk372
source: Whenever POKENAME utters its cry, the bulb on the tip of its tail will mimic it. No matter how often this happens, POKENAME will always seem surprised and confused by the echo.

entry: POKENAME头顶叶片与脑相连。谁损伤一片叶，疼痛就会使它们放出令人头痛的超能力波动。
author: quackquackattack
source: The leaves atop the heads of POKENAME are connected to their brains. Whenever anyone damages one of their leaves, the pain causes them to release headache-inducing psychic waves.

entry: POKENAME像活树般高立，绿色鬃毛在日光下发亮。它优雅又凶猛，被尊为丛林守护者；一与训练家结下羁绊，忠诚便不动摇。
author: jonclyd
source: POKENAME stands tall like a living tree, its green mane glowing under the sun. It is revered as a guardian of the jungle, graceful yet fierce, and once bonded to a Trainer, its loyalty is unwavering.

entry: POKENAME飞过热带密林时，多个头一齐喷火。它怕冷又怕湿，因此丛林外很少见到。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shoots flames from its many heads as it flies above a jungle forest. It is rarely seen outside of the jungle because it is sensitive to cold and damp conditions.

entry: POKENAME部分肌肉太强，身体已有细小裂缝。战斗时格外小心，尽量不让敌人击中这些弱点。
author: sk372
source: Parts of POKENAME's body have cracked slightly due to the strength of some of its muscles. It fights very carefully, doing its best to avoid letting an opponent strike at these weak spots.

entry: POKENAME通常欢快，爱随节庆音乐摇沙锤。光这简单小事就让它们如此高兴，也感染许多人，在它身旁奏乐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME tend to be jolly creatures that enjoy shaking their maracas to the tune of festive music. Their sheer elation over a simple task inspires many to play music when they are nearby.

entry: POKENAME的根已长成强腿，足以带它远行。背上一处突起向上弯曲，用来载幼崽。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME's roots have grown into legs strong enough to propel it across vast distances. One growth on it s back bends upwards to carry its young.

entry: POKENAME忙了一周钓大舌贝，周末最爱躺在自家棕榈叶下休息。POKENAME也邀别人乘凉、喝椰子，共享热闹情谊。
author: quackquackattack
source: After spending a week of fishing for Shellder, POKENAME enjoys resting beneath the shade of its own palm leaves during the weekend. During this period of rest, POKENAME invites others to take shade and drink coconuts, providing a sense of community.

entry: 三个头让POKENAME身体笨重，飞不好，跑起来却极快。阴天会一直移动，直到找到一片阳光，停下晒晒。
author: .jerden
source: Its three heads make POKENAME too unwieldy to fly well, but it can run with impressive speed. On cloudy days it will remain on the move until it reaches a patch of sunlight to bask in.

entry: POKENAME靠修长强腿远行。干旱时，会长途跋涉找水，免得绿叶枯干。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's long and powerful legs carry it long distances. In arid environments, it will travel long distances in search of water to stop its green leaves from drying out.

entry: POKENAME的三条长颈常缠成一团，跌倒后，得解开才能起身。尾巴仿佛还有第四个头，睡时迷惑来者，也让它混入栖居的林木。
author: infinex21
source: An POKENAME's three long necks often become entangled, leading them to fall over until they untangle themselves. Their tails appear to have a fourth head upon them to trick others while they sleep, blending in with the jungle trees they live among.

entry: POKENAME整日待在海滩，脚泡水里，悠闲晒太阳。偏有一个头总嫌热，抢别的头的帽子，想凉快些。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME spend all their time at the beach, relaxing in the sun with their feet in the water. Despite relaxing, one of the heads is always upset at the heat and will steal another head's hat to cool off.

entry: POKENAME爱抛接离体的几个头做杂耍，需要静止时，再平衡托住。它待在陆上的时间比水里多，让科学家惊讶，或许因为水中杂耍太难。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy juggling each of their disembodied heads and balance them when they need to remain still. To the surprise of many scientists, they spend more time on land than in water, perhaps because juggling in water is difficult.

entry: POKENAME从地里长出来，平时懒洋洋的，等猎物走近，才一口吞下。夜里，旁边的几颗头负责放哨。
author: theheroict
source: Grown from the ground, POKENAME tends to laze about, waiting for prey to come near before chowing down. The heads on the side keep watch at night.

entry: POKENAME生活在热带海岸。休息时，只有身体前半部露在地上，因此常被误认成普通棕榈树。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME lives by the coast in tropical climates. It rests with only the front half of its body above ground, so it is often mistaken for an ordinary palm tree.

entry: POKENAME把一根骨头放在种子中央，依恋极深。谁想摸，种子里便伸出藤蔓，挥骨如棒，教训烦人的来者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries a bone in the center of its bulb. It has a strong attachment to the bone; attempts to touch it result in a vine extending from the bulb and using it like a club to beat up the nuisance.

entry: POKENAME种子里常伸出的“骨头”，其实更像富含钙的小树枝。它们与种子营养越好，每天能造的“骨头”就越多。
author: infinex21
source: The "bones" that are oft seen sticking out from POKENAME's bulbs are actually closer to twigs that are incredibly rich with calcium. The more well-nourished they, and their bulbs, are, the more of these "bones" they can produce in a day.

entry: 后脑巨颚太重，让POKENAME很难走直，常摇摇晃晃地维持平衡。若有宝可梦把头当树想停上去，就会被咬。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME struggles to walk straight due to the weight of its jaws on the back of its head, often stumbling to keep balanced. It snaps at Pokémon that mistake its head for a tree and try to land on it.

entry: POKENAME一爆炸，锋利骨片便射向四方，既作武器，也警告潜在威胁。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME explodes, it sends sharp bone shards flying in all directions. These fragments serve as both a weapon and a warning to potential threats.

entry: POKENAME皮肤脆弱，便拿找到的头骨临时作甲。它也能调动部分电能，托起并射出废骨，加强防御。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's hide is vulnerable, so it uses skulls it finds as makeshift armor for protection. Using some of its electric energy, it lifts and flings other discarded bones as projectiles for added defenses.

entry: POKENAME仰躺露出软腹，其实是诱敌陷阱。天敌以为有便宜饭可吃，一靠近，就被骤发的爆炸力轰飞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME resting upside and showing its soft underbelly is a trap to fool predators. Once they come near expecting an easy meal, they are blown away by the explosive force it generates all at once.

entry: POKENAME的头骨上，光纹变换，反映情绪。这些闪烁信号，植物学家已研究数十年。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's skulls glow in shifting patterns that reflect its emotions. These blinking signals have been studied by botanists for decades.

entry: POKENAME造出更坚韧的骨棒双持，配上更结实的头骨，心志坚定，抛下悲伤。它召集其他卡拉卡拉，带领它们变强。
author: sk372
source: Fashioning tougher bone clubs to dual-wield and a more solid skull, POKENAME has a strong-willed personality, leaving sorrow behind. It gathers other Cubone in groups to guide them and help them grow stronger.

entry: POKENAME带着嘎啦嘎啦的头骨，几乎夜夜对它轻声哭泣。据说，嘎啦嘎啦的灵魂会来梦里，低声安慰、鼓励POKENAME。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries around a Marowak skull, which it cries quietly to almost every night. It's said that the Marowak's spirit visits POKENAME in its dreams, whispering words of comfort and encouragement.

entry: POKENAME在宝可梦对战中，靠柔韧身躯闪避攻击。逼近之后，再挥骨棒重击对手。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their lithe bodies to dodge attacks during a Pokémon battle. Once they are in close range, they bludgeon their opponents with a bony club.

entry: POKENAME用骨做头盔护头，也给双拳制了骨护手。拳打久了，护手会碎，因此得定期更换。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fashioned a helmet of bone to protect its head, and bone gauntlets for its fists. It has to regularly replace the gauntlets as they fall apart from constant punching.

entry: POKENAME从身体四个部分，产出小团却浓密的毒云。毒云会引发剧烈咳嗽、刺激双眼，让眼里充血、流泪不止。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME produces small but thick clouds of toxins from four segments of its body. These clouds cause intense coughing fits and eye irritations, leaving the eyes bloodshot and full of tears.

entry: POKENAME披着富钙外壳，硬如致密骨骼。常藏在捕食者留下的骨堆里，或躲在旁边。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are clad in a calcium-rich shell as hard as dense bone. They tend to hide within or near piles of bones left behind by predators.

entry: POKENAME藏进死去已久的宝可梦骨骸，护住自己，等待进化。藏着时几乎动不了，安危全靠选中一副结实骨茧。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME conceal themselves within the bones of long dead Pokémon to protect themselves while they wait to evolve. They have very limited movement whilst hiding, almost entirely reliant on choosing a sturdy bone cocoon to stay safe.

entry: 骨与石的甲片互相嵌合，让POKENAME身体格外坚韧。它怕别人，惊慌逃跑时，连实心岩石都能撞穿。
author: sk372
source: Interlocking plates of bone and stone give POKENAME's body a highly resilient frame. It's fearful of others, and will charge right through solid stone in a panic to run away.

entry: 野生POKENAME装作沙漠草丛，引其他宝可梦靠近。吃饱后，常戴起猎物头骨，用其余骨头攻击敌人。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME disguise themselves as patches of desert grass to lure other Pokémon near them. They often wear the skulls of their prey when they have fed well enough and use other bones to strike their opponents.

entry: POKENAME发现死去孩子的骨头，就本能地放进育儿袋，带着四处走。直到找到合适葬地安置遗骨，都会哭个不停。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME finds the bones of a dead child, it instinctively puts the bones in its pouch and carries them around. Until it finds a good burial spot to lay these bones, it cries endlessly.

entry: POKENAME游走世界，寻找宝可梦幼崽的骨骸。收集足够骨头，郑重安葬，再为另一副遗骨重复这过程。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wander the world looking for boney carcasses of baby Pokémon. They collect bones until they have enough to make a proper burial, before repeating the process again with another skeleton.

entry: 融合的力量，让幼小POKENAME在骨壳里休眠。母亲担心，它也许再不会醒来。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The power of fusion has caused the baby POKENAME to hibernate in its bone shell. The mother fears it may never wake up.

entry: POKENAME从头骨射出气泡，力道足以损伤船壳。它偏爱住在沉没货轮里。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires bubbles from its skull with enough force to damage ship hulls. It prefers to dwell within sunken freighters.

entry: POKENAME筑骨巢，装饰得像珊瑚。别的宝可梦若想拿骨头，锐角便猛戳，吓走想偷东西的家伙。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME create nests of bones that they decorate in such a way that resembles coral. Whenever another Pokémon tries to take their bones, a sharp jab of their horn scares the would-be thief away.

entry: POKENAME披着骨架，缓冲其他宝可梦的啃咬。天敌的牙一旦卡进骨甲，它们便用锐角还击，驱退威胁。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wear a boney skeleton to cushion bites from other Pokémon. When teeth of a predator inevitably get caught in their boney armor, they strike with their sharp horn to repel the threat.

entry: POKENAME以细丝将骨头绑在茧上，加固身体，抵挡物理伤害。它们得小心别聚群藏身，免得引来找食物的食腐动物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use thin silk threads to attach bones to their cocoon to reinforce their bodies, protecting themselves from physical harm. They have to be careful to avoid hiding in groups in case they attract scavengers looking for food.

entry: POKENAME四处飞舞，寻找花园休息、进食。路上若见枯花，就降在花间，哀悼它们逝去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flutters around in search of flower gardens to rest and feed from. If it comes across dead flowers during its travels, it lands among the plants and cries over the loss.

entry: POKENAME偶尔闷闷不乐，不想受打扰，便造出屏障，把自己与外界隔开，直到准备好再次交际。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is prone to occasional fits of sullen behavior and wishing not to be disturbed. It produces barriers to box itself off from the outside world until it's ready to socialize again.

entry: POKENAME拿骨头垒巢壁，常把长骨切成合适长度。偏爱象牙猪、卡比兽等大型宝可梦的骨，可往往也只能有什么就用什么。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME create the walls of their dens out of bones, often taking long bones and cutting them down to size. They prefer bones of large Pokémon like Mamoswine or Snorlax, but often rely on using whatever bones are available.

entry: POKENAME甩动笨重双臂，产生更强电力。能量攒足，就导进所持骨头，帮助精准瞄准想电击的目标。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME swings its lumbering arms around to generate stronger electricity. Once it's churned up enough energy, it directs it through the bone it carries, letting it more accurately pinpoint the target it wants to zap.

entry: POKENAME的骨含微量铜。雷雨时，它会站上高山，把骨棒举向天，试着引导雷电。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's bones contain trace amounts of copper. During a thunderstorm, it will stand on tall mountains and hold its club into the sky, attempting to channel lightning.

entry: 洞中迷路的旅人，偶尔会获野生POKENAME帮助。它点燃所持骨头，当作临时火把，照亮四周，引来者走向出口。
author: sk372
source: Lost travelers within caves have occasionally been assisted by wild POKENAME. Igniting the bone it carries and using it as a makeshift torch, it illuminates the area and guides the visitors towards the exit.

entry: POKENAME的双螯由实骨构成，握力惊人。它飞快敲螯，警告来者：不想被夹碎，就离远些。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's pincers are made of solid bone and have quite the grip strength. It clicks them together rapidly as a warning to others to stay away if they wish not to get crushed.

entry: POKENAME愤懑好斗，很容易大发脾气。硬头骨撞得人很疼，若还抵挡，三条尾巴所持的骨头就会砸过来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a bitter and combative nature, easily sent into an angry tantrum. Its hard skull makes charges painful, and those who resist that will be struck by the bones held by its three tails.

entry: POKENAME戴强大宝可梦的头骨，威吓捕食者。骨面具一被打离脸，就惊恐地迅速游走。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME wears the skulls of strong Pokémon to intimidate predators. If these bony masks are ever knocked away from its face, it quickly swims away in fear.

entry: POKENAME戴其他宝可梦的头骨，保护柔软身体。骨面具一被打离脸，就惊恐地迅速游走。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME wears the skulls of other Pokémon to protect its soft body. If these bony masks are ever knocked away from its face, it quickly swims away in fear.

entry: POKENAME脸上的骨甲，保护它免遭天敌。可肌肉弱、鳍又脆，妨碍了游泳本领。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's bony facial plating protects it from predators. Its weak muscles and fragile fins impede its swimming capabilities.

entry: POKENAME脸上的骨甲能抵挡攻击。破损鳍片与发黑双眼，常让天敌误认它已死去。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's bony facial plating protects it from attacks. The appearance of torn fins and black eyes often fool predators into thinking it's already dead.

entry: POKENAME把口中吐出的丝当绳，甩动随身骨棒，先击昏小型宝可梦，再跃上去，用尾巴狠狠毒蜇。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses thread spilled from its mouth as a tether to swing the bone it carries around. It clubs small Pokémon unconscious, then leaps onto them to deliver a venomous sting with its tail.

entry: POKENAME不断发起袭击，目标几乎全是出游家庭与结伴好友。人们认为，持续的孤独感让它生出强烈嫉妒与怒意。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lashes out constantly, and almost exclusively targets traveling families and friend groups. It's thought that it does this due to a constant sense of loneliness leading to intense jealous anger.

entry: POKENAME曾在水中罕见，常因怕人而退避。近来，越来越多被拉普拉斯族群收养，这一物种也因而更乐于交际。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME was once a rare sight in the water, and retreated often due to fear of humans. In recent times, more are seen being adopted by Lapras colonies, and the species is growing more sociable as a result.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME收集其他生物的骨，是为更好地模仿。可也因此，变形后的新身体，通常总多几根骨头露在外面。
author: sk372
source: It's thought that POKENAME gathers up the bones of other creatures in order to better mimic them. Because of this, however, its transformations usually end up with a few extra bones sticking out of its new form.

entry: POKENAME作宠物十分忠诚，却很容易孤单。哪怕只短暂分开，主人也得准备抱着它蓬松的身体，安抚好久。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very loyal as a pet, but gets lonesome easily. Owners should be prepared to spend a long while cuddling its fluffy body after being separated for only a small span of time.

entry: POKENAME游得快，心地温柔，多独处、远离人群。不过看见人类海上遇险，便会迅速救援，确认安全后，又隐回水中。
author: sk372
source: A swift swimmer with a gentle heart, POKENAME mostly keeps to itself away from people. However, it is quick to rescue humans it sees in trouble at sea, vanishing back into the water once it's sure they're safe.

entry: POKENAME虽独来独往，见秃鹰娜追捕卡拉卡拉，却总毫不犹豫地救援。它把尽可能多的电力储进头骨，再释放出来，赶走天敌。
author: fiordaliso
source: Although POKENAME has a solitary nature, it never hesitates to rush to the aid of Cubone when a Mandibuzz hunts them down. It uses the skull on its head to store as much electric energy as possible, which it then unleashes to drive them away.

entry: POKENAME虽独来独往，见秃鹰娜追捕卡拉卡拉，却总毫不犹豫地救援。它把尽可能多的电力储进背上骨头，再释放出来，赶走天敌。
author: fiordaliso
source: Although POKENAME has a solitary nature, it never hesitates to rush to the aid of Cubone when a Mandibuzz hunts them down. It uses the bones on its back to store as much electric energy as possible, which it then unleashes to drive them away.

entry: POKENAME收集骨头，藏在蓬松毛皮里。叫声像孩子啜泣，因而传出火山山脉闹鬼的故事。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME collect and hide bones in their fluffy fur. Their cries sound similar to a sobbing child, giving rise to legends of haunted volcanic ranges.

entry: POKENAME被用来监看虚拟世界的某些程序，防止死锁引发崩溃和软件故障。它温和尽职，深受大型数字企业青睐。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is used to monitor certain programs in the virtual world, preventing deadlocks that could cause crashes and malfunctions within software. Due to its gentle nature and strong ethic, it is highly sought after by major digital companies.

entry: POKENAME住在卡拉卡拉留下的躯壳里，藏进头骨，保护自己。捕食者一靠近，就怕得发抖。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lives inside the vestige of what once was a Cubone. It hides within the skull to protect itself from danger and quivers in fear whenever a predator is nearby.

entry: POKENAME把身体藏在头骨里护身，用众多触手移动、捕猎。头骨在海底爬行的模样，吓过不少深海潜水员。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides its body within a skull for protection, using its many tentacles to move and hunt prey. Many deep-sea divers have been startled by the sight of the skull scuttling across the seafloor.

entry: POKENAME结茧前，会收集几根骨头。谁靠得太近，就从茧缝射骨，将来者打退，护住脆弱身体。
author: sk372
source: Before cocooning itself, POKENAME gathers a few bones. When something gets too close, it shoots out a bone from gaps in its cocoon to bash away the intruder and keep its fragile body safe.

entry: POKENAME用黏丝把骨头绑在身上，抵御危险。有些POKENAME还更会伪装，连茧都变得如漂白般雪白。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use a sticky silk to attach bones to their bodies in an effort to protect themselves from danger. Some POKENAME take the camouflage a step further, their cocoon  taking on a bleached white hue.

entry: POKENAME在考古挖掘场附近爬行，盼找到更大的头骨搬进去。一只有了足够大的新壳，就会引发连锁搬家，让其他POKENAME也换上更大头骨。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME scuttle around near archeological digs hoping to find a bigger skull to move into. When one finds a sufficiently large skull to move into, they start a chain reaction where other POKENAME also upgrade their skulls.

entry: 古代POKENAME靠捡食为生，避免与其他生物正面冲突。它尾随狩猎的镰刀盔，等对方走后，吃骨头和余下残羹。
author: sk372
source: In ancient times, POKENAME was a scavenger, avoiding direct conflict with other creatures. It trailed behind hunting Kabutops, eating bones and whatever else remained once the former had moved on.

entry: POKENAME带着的头骨，是连自己都戴不好的悲伤遗物。有人推测，巨大体型与食量，源于它总以食物排遣悲伤。
author: sk372
source: The skull POKENAME carries is a tragic keepsake it cannot even wear properly. Its large size and appetite is theorized to be the result of using food as a coping mechanism for its sadness.

entry: POKENAME操纵气流，让冰冷泥土在身边旋转。冻硬碎屑一接触敌人，就可能使其无法行动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME manipulates wind currents to swirl ice-cold dirt around its body. On contact, the frozen debris can immobilize foes.

entry: POKENAME在野外罕见，翼中带着早已逝去的同族遗骨。有人认为，这能实际增强电力；也有人觉得，更多是精神寄托。
author: sk372
source: Rarely seen in the wild, POKENAME carries the bones of long-departed members of its species within its wings. Some theorize it has a practical benefit for increasing its electrical prowess, while others think the reason is more spiritual.

entry: POKENAME出没于最荒凉的沙漠，在看见的生命上空盘旋。虽常被视为死亡征兆，实际却想用影子，引下方迷途生物走向安全。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is found in the most inhospitable deserts, circling over any life it sees. While it is usually viewed as an omen of death, it is actually trying to use its shadow to usher the lost creature below it towards safety.

entry: POKENAME出水后，头骨会闪出多彩光芒。有些传说称，骨片能留住神秘能量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's skull sparkles with many colors after emerging from water. Some legends claim fragments of it can retain mystical energy.

entry: POKENAME体型虽大，通常却胆小，只是见不得弱小受欺负。有人见过它们照料、守护龙属性宝可梦大量逝去的地方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is usually timid despite its size, but won't stand to see others picking on those smaller than it. Some have been spotted tending to and guarding areas where many Dragon-type Pokémon have passed on.

entry: POKENAME用骨肢迅猛进攻，领地意识极强。它似乎最爱住在大针蜂巢被毁、遭糟蹋的区域。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME strikes rapidly and aggressively with its bony limbs. Highly territorial, it seems most likely to reside in areas where destroyed and desecrated Beedrill hives are present.

entry: 有人猜，POKENAME是制造超梦时，最后那些遭丢弃的失败作之一。被抛弃后仍挣扎活下，性格冰冷无情，唯独战斗时，会释放无尽怒火。
author: sk372
source: Some theorize POKENAME is one of the last discarded failed attempts at creating Mewtwo, that managed to cling to life after being rejected. It has a cold, emotionless personality, except in battle, where it releases its boundless rage.

entry: POKENAME心地极善，会瞬间移动遍各地，把孤独宝可梦带给同样想找伴的伙伴。这样，也能让它自己的孤独稍得安慰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very kindhearted, teleporting across the land to bring lonely Pokémon to others who seek companionship. Doing so makes it feel more at peace with its own sense of loneliness.

entry: 每年春天，POKENAME头上的骨会长出新叶。野外这片叶子，到仲冬便自然掉落。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sprouts a fresh leaf from the bone on its head each spring. In the wild, this leaf naturally falls away by midwinter.

entry: POKENAME颈间众多叶片，绕着一圈骨生长。气味和滋味都苦，闻过、尝过的对象，此后会略显消沉。
author: sk372
source: The many leaves on POKENAME's neck grow around a ring of bones. They have a bitter taste and a bitter scent; those who smell or taste them exhibit slight signs of depression afterward.

entry: POKENAME起初被认为，是有意识的藤团，寄居在另一生物的骨中。后来研究才发现，藤蔓其实围住POKENAME裸身最脆弱处，充当保护层。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME was originally thought to be a sentient mass of vines inhabiting the bones of another creature. Further research discovered the vines amass around the most fragile parts of POKENAME's bare body as protective covering.

entry: POKENAME火力弱，通常只能从背上吹烟，驱退来者。哭泣时，会放出更多烟，味道也更呛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's flame capacity is weak, so it can usually only manage to blow smoke from its back to ward off others. When it cries, it emits copious amounts of smoke that smell more acrid.

entry: POKENAME身上窜出的火，泛着诡异颜色。有人认为，所戴头骨让它与来世相连，改变了火焰。
author: sk372
source: The flames that shoot up from POKENAME's body glow with an eerie color. It's thought by some that the skull it wears gives it a connection to the afterlife, altering its fire.

entry: POKENAME常深陷悲伤，轻声自泣，背上淡烟缭绕。火焰较弱，只有跨过哀伤、专注眼前战斗时，才见得到。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is often seen in the throes of sorrow, crying softly to itself as smoke billows lightly from its back. Its flames are rather weak, only seen when it can push past its sadness and focus on a battle its partaking in.

entry: POKENAME留着吃剩的骨头，当战斗工具。吃饭打架之余，就啃骨棒，保养牙齿，也打发无聊。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME keeps the bones left behind from meals to use as tools in battle. Between meals and fights it gnaws on the bone club to keep its teeth maintained as well as to stave off boredom.

entry: 卡拉锯鳄曾戴的头骨，进化后似乎又长大了。POKENAME继续搜集牙齿、头骨等天然小物；无聊时，POKENAME就拿骨头敲地。
author: bobosmith01
source: The skull Cudile wore appears to have grown even further on evolution. POKENAME continues to collect natural trinkets such as teeth and skulls. If bored, POKENAME bangs on the ground with its bone.

entry: 在筑巢材料稀少的干旱地区，POKENAME便用骨头搭巢。它不善交友，可已有的朋友，每一个都十分珍惜。
author: leshii
source: In arid places where materials are scarce, POKENAME crafts a nest out of bones. It struggles to make friends, but deeply cherishes the ones it has.

entry: POKENAME头骨下的毛格外柔软。有些裁缝小心收来，织成温暖轻盈的围巾。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME grows exceptionally soft fur beneath its skull. Some tailors carefully collect it to weave warm, lightweight scarves.

entry: POKENAME独居而自立，在地下筑巢。许多羽毛外面，覆着一层薄而坚硬的白色保护层。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are solitary and independent Pokémon that make their nests below ground. Many of their feathers have a thin but hard white protective layer over them.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，轻轻用骨头敲花，让花粉飘上空。粉末还没落地，就被它玩闹般地一口口接住。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gently taps flowers with its bone while flying, scattering pollen into the air. It playfully snaps up the drifting particles before they reach the ground.

entry: POKENAME用随身骨头，与森林其他居民交流。大声连敲树干，就是警告天敌正在活动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the bones it carries as a way of communicating with other forest denizens. Rapping the bones loudly and repeatedly against a tree trunk serves as a warning that predators are on the move.

entry: POKENAME休息时，将腿收进头骨壳，攀附树木。成群POKENAME的头骨布满树干，那诡异景象，已成恐怖作品常见画面。
author: sk372
source: When at rest, POKENAME tucks its legs into the skull shell and clings to trees. The eerie image of several POKENAME skulls covering tree trunks has become a popular sight in horror media.

entry: POKENAME先把丝绑在骨头上，再投出去，让丝伸得更远，结网又大又快。猎物一被网住，也能用这招击昏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME ties webbing to the bone it carries before throwing it, letting it cast threads long distances and increase the size and speed of the webs it makes. It's also effective at knocking out prey once they're ensnared.

entry: POKENAME用骨质翼缘刮擦洞壁，发出不安的尖啸，吓唬猎物。攻击时从上方飞快落下，再以结实头骨猛撞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME scrapes the bony edges of its wings across cave walls to make an unnerving screech to frighten prey. It attacks from above by descending rapidly and striking with a solid headbutt using its solid skull.

entry: POKENAME戴着挚友的头骨，可身体渐长，已经快戴不下了。它独自巡飞，守望并保护领地里的宝可梦。
author: leshii
source: POKENAME wears the skull of a treasured friend, but is outgrowing it. It flies alone, keeping watch and protecting Pokémon within its territory.

entry: POKENAME用触角握住骨头，就能让它发光。先用亮光引来小生物，再以两根发光骨棒，从两侧夹击。
author: sk372
source: Holding bones with its antennae allows POKENAME to make the items glow. It uses the illumination to draw in smaller creatures, before smashing them on both sides with its glowing clubs.

entry: POKENAME以头部器官照亮深海，也在暗处辨路。前方发光球看着像亮起的头骨，吓坏过许多毫无准备的深海潜水员。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the organ on its head to illuminate the deep sea and help it navigate darker areas. Due to the front bulb looking like a glowing skull, it has startled many deep-sea divers caught unawares.

entry: POKENAME带骨头，是为了更好地汇聚电力。若没有骨头集中电流，身体就会胡乱冒火花，可能伤到身旁对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries a bone with it to help it better channel its electric power. Without a bone to focus electricity through, its body would spark at random and risk hurting those close to it.

entry: POKENAME情绪易受影响，头骨满是泪痕，不小心放电时尤其爱哭。开心时，POKENAME会用小骨头敲自己头骨，打着拍子。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's skull is stained with tears due to how easily swayed its emotions are; it notably cries when it accidentally discharges its electricity. When happy, POKENAME will use its small bone to drum upon its own skull.

entry: POKENAME的心情，随天上星星多少而起伏。星光满天，它就欢喜；一颗也看不见，便哭得停不下来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's mood fluctuates depending on the amount of stars in the sky. A night sky filled with lights has it acting joyful, while a sky devoid of any visible stars causes it to sob uncontrollably.

entry: POKENAME爱对着骨棒咿呀练歌。夜幕降临，便蜷起来，仍抱着骨头入睡。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy babbling into their boney club to practice singing. When night falls, they curl up with the bone still in their arms and fall asleep.

entry: POKENAME拿自己的蛋壳作甲，能留多少就留多少，绝不肯脱。它害怕大半外界，本能地挥骨棒，击打不认识的东西。
author: sk372
