source: POKENAME uses its own eggshell as armor, keeping as much on it as possible and refusing to remove it. It's very afraid of most of the outside world, instinctively striking with its bone club at anything unfamiliar.

entry: POKENAME很不擅应对冲突，连有骨棒也几乎护不住自己。大多时间都在哭着央求，希望交战双方别再互斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME responds very poorly to conflict. It can barely defend itself even with a bone club, and spends most of the time pleading and crying for combatants to simply stop fighting one another.

entry: POKENAME常觉大难将至，神情严肃而略显忧郁。它爱与训练家相处，哪怕只在公园散步，或去森林走走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME carries a stern and somewhat morose expression because it frequently experiences feelings of impending doom. It enjoys spending time with its Trainer, even if it's just a walk in the park or a trip to the forest.

entry: POKENAME把超能力注进骨头，在地上描绘符号。图形至今未解，却被认为与未来有某种重要关联。
author: sk372
source: Imbuing bones with psychic energy, POKENAME uses them to draw symbols in the ground. The shapes it makes have yet to be deciphered, but are believed to have some import related to the future.

entry: 野生POKENAME伴着咩利羊群旅行。自身发电很少，就蹭同伴，吸取部分能量，存进羊毛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME travels alongside flocks of Mareep in the wild. It generates little electricity on its own, so it rubs against other members of the group to absorb some of their energy and store it within its wool.

entry: 美丽的羽毛，从POKENAME头骨盔的裂缝间伸出。它能发现几英里外的天敌，无声无息，迅速出手惩戒。
author: leshii
source: Beautiful feathers spill from the cracks of POKENAME's skull helmet. It can spot a predator from miles away, dispensing swift justice without a sound.

entry: POKENAME挥动骨棒时，体内电力慢慢充进去。时间够久，骨头就能亮得与尾巴一样。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME wields its bone club, it slowly charges it up with electricity from its body. After enough time, it can make the bone glow with the same level of brightness as its tail.

entry: POKENAME小群聚集，共同编舞。带最大骨头的负责指挥，引导其他个体动作。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gather in small groups to choreograph their dances together. The one who carries the biggest bone is the conductor, directing the movements of the rest.

entry: POKENAME爱收集骨头，存进巢里。睡时，会用尾巴缠住一根骨头，帮自己安然入眠。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy collecting bones and storing them in their dens. When they fall asleep, they curl their tail around one of the bones to help themselves fall asleep.

entry: POKENAME身体浮力好，能轻松浮着，独游僻静湖区。它极珍惜随身骨棒，每天都使劲洗净。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's buoyant body allows it to easily stay afloat as it swims around in solitary lake areas. It takes great care of the bone club it carries, cleaning it vigorously every day.

entry: POKENAME贪心又小，见什么偷什么，连同类的骨头也拿走，没别的理由，只因为它办得到。
author: sk372
source: A greedy little Pokémon that steals anything it gets, POKENAME will even steal away the bones of others of its kind, for no other reason than it can.

entry: POKENAME钻进土里时，藏在头骨下，护着自己进行光合作用。天敌一近，就快速振动，搅起、扬出四周泥土。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides under a skull when it digs into the dirt to protect itself while it photosynthesizes. It vibrates rapidly to churn up and throw dirt around when predators draw close.

entry: POKENAME寻找最结实的木棍，拿来作战。白天吸够阳光后，所戴头骨就开始泛起温暖光芒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME finds the strongest stick it can to wield as a weapon in battle. After absorbing enough sunlight during the day, the skull it wears starts to emit a warm glow.

entry: POKENAME飞得快，一觉受威胁，就逃得远远的。它停在高树干上，用多根骨肢敲出节奏，警告其他POKENAME附近有险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's quick flying skills let it stay out of danger, fleeing the moment it feels threatened. It perches high up tall tree trunks, tapping out a pattern with its many bony limbs to warn other POKENAME of nearby dangers.

entry: POKENAME竟很会演奏爵士木琴。它背对琴，用骨尾当槌敲，许多人都问看不见怎么弹。原来它给每根琴键抹上极细凝胶，尾巴能感知。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME have an uncanny ability to play jazz xylophones. They stand with their back to it, using their bone tail as a mallet, yet many query how they can play without seeing. They excrete a very fine gel onto each key, that their tail can detect.

entry: POKENAME以超能力，轻易把骨头当飞棒战斗。它心地温柔，常被孤独的对象吸引，想帮忙减轻寂寞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's psychic powers let it easily wield bones as flying clubs in battle. It has a gentle heart, often drawn to those who feel lonely so it can help lessen that isolation.

entry: POKENAME的心情极受月相影响。满月时，POKENAME安宁平和；月亮越缺，表现得越悲伤。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's mood is highly dependent on the phases of the moon. When it is full, POKENAME is at peace, but the more it wanes, the more sorrowful it behaves.

entry: POKENAME天生会找地下埋骨。有些警察请它寻失踪遗骸，却得严加管束，免得POKENAME把发现的骨头偷留给自己。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has an innate sense for finding bones buried under the ground. Some police forces have used it to locate missing remains, but discipline is needed to keep POKENAME from stealing its findings for itself.

entry: POKENAME头骨般的头饰，其实是一片厚实浅色叶子。吃下的花越多，叶子就越厚。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's skull-like headpiece is actually a thick, pale leaf. Its thickness increases depending on how many flowers it consumes.

entry: POKENAME发现满箱食物，就欢喜地来回摇骨尾。若被打断，却会咬住闯入者，一边哭得停不下来。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's bony tail wags back and forth with delight when it discovers a dumpster full of food. If interrupted, it will bite down on the intruder while weeping uncontrollably.

entry: POKENAME用怪力托起骨头，向遇见的对象报复性挥打。凝视POKENAME头骨太久，逝去亲人的幻影便会灼进人的脑海。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses a strange power to levitate a bone to use and vengefully lash out at those it comes across. Gazing too long at POKENAME's skull will send visions of lost loved ones searing into a person's mind.

entry: 数百年来，POKENAME都是失去的象征。起源不明，不过有人猜，它以强烈情绪为食，因此总在新近有人逝去的屋旁被看见。
author: _pixelar_
source: For centuries, POKENAME has been a symbol of loss. The origin of this association is unknown, but theories suspect that since it feeds on strong emotions, it has often been observed near houses with recent deaths.

entry: 古代祈祷师曾在仪式中使用POKENAME的头骨，声称能短暂看见超能力幻象。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's skull was once used by Channelers in ancient rituals. They claimed it granted brief psychic visions during ceremonies.

entry: POKENAME的甲壳由超强骨髓构成。身侧中空尖刺，能高速射出削尖骨弹，穿透一切打扰它的对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's carapace is made of super-strong bone marrow. From the hollow spines in its side, it fires sharpened projectiles made of bones at high speeds, piercing through anything that bothers it.

entry: 冬天，POKENAME睡在洞里，等气温回升。有时冰层封住洞口，就会以巨大长牙猛撞，直到撞碎冰，闯出去。
author: quackquackattack
source: During winter, POKENAME sleep inside caves until the temperature begins to rise. Sometimes a layer of ice seals them in the cave, so they smash through the ice with their gargantuan tusks, ramming against the ice until it shatters.

entry: POKENAME钻过富含方解石的山体时，体外骨会更强。留下的广大隧道，常吸引洞穴探险者探索。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's exterior bones grow stronger as it burrows through calcite-rich mountains. The vast tunnels it leaves behind are often explored by spelunkers.

entry: POKENAME披上其他宝可梦留下的残骸，保护自己。找到的骨头会磨尖，再投向捕食者，将其吓走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME take the vestige of what was another Pokémon and wear the remains to protect themselves. They sharpen the bones they find to fling at predators, scaring them away.

entry: POKENAME一得到大小合适的头骨，就再也无法把头完全缩进壳。新限制让POKENAME总显得苦恼，可谁想替它摘掉头骨，又会拼命抵抗。
author: danarchosyndacalist
source: A POKENAME loses the ability to fully retract its head into its shell once it acquires a suitably sized skull. The POKENAME then seems perpetually distressed by this new limitation, but will fight off any attempt to free its head from its skull.

entry: POKENAME头上的骨角并非本体，而连在覆盖头部的骨壳上。因此骨角可能随壳脱离，让它在天敌面前失去防卫。
author: soup1900
source: The bone horn on POKENAME's head is not a part of its head but rather attached to the bone skull that covers it. This means it can be detached from its body, leaving it defenseless against any predators.

entry: POKENAME狩猎时，偏爱集体行动，以数量压倒大猎物。钩爪让它们能轻松攀过覆冰斜坡。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME prefer fighting in numbers when hunting to overwhelm larger prey. Their hooked claws allow them to scale ice-covered slopes with ease.

entry: POKENAME似乎总在找蜂蜜，只有休息才停。一周没尝到最爱，就开始哭，叫声仿佛悲恸灵魂。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME seems to always be on the hunt for honey, only pausing to rest. If it goes a week without tasting its favorite food, it will start weeping. Its cry is comparable to a grieving soul.

entry: 身体由灼热的沙子构成。POKENAME会用身上的骨头，将岩石敲碎、磨成沙，再吃下去。
author: mistymagius
source: Its body is made of incredibly hot sand. POKENAME uses the bones on its body to break and grind down rocks to sand for consumption.

entry: POKENAME身体烫得无法触摸，爬过的沙也会炽热发亮。愤怒时，头盔般的头骨，会被火焰整个裹住。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME turns the sand it crawls upon incandescent, as its body is far too hot to touch. When it grows irate, flames completely coat the skull it wears as a helmet.

entry: POKENAME为护沙质身体，在沙漠收集其他宝可梦的骨，筑成坚固外壳。它在沙丘间游牧，需要炎热干旱的气候才能生存。
author: fiordaliso
source: To protect its sandy body, POKENAME collects the bones of other Pokémon in the desert to build a sturdy shell. It leads a nomadic life among the dunes, needing hot, arid climates to survive.

entry: 一发怒，沙质身体便燃起，温度高得连碰到的仙人掌也能烧。POKENAME无休止地游走沙漠，找更大、更骇人的头骨，完善外壳。
author: fiordaliso
source: When angered, its sandy body ignites, reaching temperatures high enough to burn even the cacti it touches. POKENAME endlessly roams the desert seeking larger, more fearsome skulls to perfect its shell.

entry: POKENAME偏爱沙浴，给羽毛裹上尘土来清洁。水却让羽毛结块，飞行困难。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME coats its feathers in dirt to clean them, favoring dust baths. Water causes its plumage to clump, making flight difficult.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉灵敏，闻得出土下美味蘑菇。它冲上前，用头骨上方的长牙拱开泥土，够到菌菇。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's strong sense of smell lets it sniff out tasty mushrooms buried beneath the soil. Racing towards them, it uses the upper fangs of the skull it wears to better dig through the dirt and reach the fungi.

entry: POKENAME厚毛身体配上同样厚实坚固的头骨，轻易就能撞翻小型宝可梦。它并不特别好斗，可一饿，谁也别想挡在它与嗅到的食物之间。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's thick furry body and equally thick and sturdy skull make it easy to bowl over smaller Pokémon. It's not overly aggressive, but if hungry, it won't let anything stand between it and a potential meal it's sniffed out.

entry: POKENAME背上有珊瑚般的骨质突起。它在海中太阳珊瑚群旁活动，靠相似外形分散天敌注意，让太阳珊瑚安全逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's back has bony growths that resemble coral. It hangs around Corsola colonies in the ocean, using its similar shape to distract predators so the Corsola can safely escape.

entry: POKENAME外表半似骨架，性情也如凶相般好斗。每次朝对方喷水，嘴里就发出诡异尖啸。
author: sk372
source: Half-skeletal in appearance, POKENAME has an aggressive personality to go along with its fierce looks. An eerie, shrill shriek emits from its mouth whenever it spits out water jets at others.

entry: 野生POKENAME装作受伤，哭叫着引其他宝可梦靠近，再以锐利骨爪凶狠袭击。
author: mepp.
source: In the wild, POKENAME cries out as if it is injured to attract other Pokémon. It then viciously attacks them with its sharp, bony talons.

entry: POKENAME成群相依，抵挡寂寞，彼此极其忠诚。群员会把吃剩的骨头，献给认定的首领。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stick together in packs to stave off loneliness, becoming fiercely loyal with one another. Pack members offer up bones leftover from meals to the one they consider the pack leader.

entry: POKENAME成年时，会长嚎一声，通知族群。之后便离群，有意过起独居生活。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME reaches adulthood, it releases a howl to alert its pack. Afterward, it leaves to live in deliberate solitude.

entry: POKENAME游行墓穴与地窖，蜷进旧棺材。若受打扰，就挥骨自卫，守护休息之处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slithers through tombs and crypts, curling inside old coffins. If disturbed, it lashes out with its bone to defend its resting place.

entry: POKENAME睡在海底沉没货轮的船壳内。遇险时，会猛掷骨头，力道足以制造漩涡，困住敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps within the hulls of sunken freighters beneath the sea. When threatened, it flings its bone with enough force to create whirlpools that trap foes.

entry: 这种宝可梦胆小，通常稍闻危险就逃。害怕时蜷成胎儿般的姿态。POKENAME也爱拿骨头变戏法，逗同伴开心。
author: bobosmith01
source: A timid Pokémon that typically runs away at the first sign of danger. When scared, it curls up into a fetal position. To cheer one another up, POKENAME likes to perform tricks with the bone it carries around.

entry: POKENAME在陆上滚得越多，头骨就越硬。老个体的头骨，出了名坚韧。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's skull hardens the more it rolls across the land. Older individuals are known to possess exceptionally tough skulls.

entry: POKENAME很会整理电脑，定期清除垃圾数据，处理闲置对象。有时却会凄然盯着电脑回收站，仿佛心怀哀伤。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is effective at keeping computers organized, regularly cleaning out junk data and disposing of unused objects. It sometimes stares forlornly at the recycling bins within computers, as if in sorrow.

entry: 旧传闻说，POKENAME是遭偷猎的惊角鹿遗骸，为复仇重新活动。它常现身偷猎惊角鹿严重之处，让传闻久久不散。
author: sk372
source: Old rumors circulate that POKENAME is the remains of poached Stantler reanimated for the sake of vengeance. Its tendency to appear in places where Stantler poaching was high helps perpetuate these rumors.

entry: POKENAME用尾端颜料的色块，装饰所戴头骨。每只POKENAME，都有独属自己的艺术装扮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME decorates the skull it wears with splotches of paint from its tail. Each POKENAME carries its own unique personalized artistic decoration.

entry: 野生POKENAME会用骨头制练习靶，磨炼技巧。它们尚未决定专攻哪一门，于是练习多种格斗，维持状态。
author: quackquackattack
source: Wild POKENAME are known to create training dummies out of bone to practice their technique. They have yet to decide on what to focus on, so they practice many types of fighting to keep themselves in shape.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴挥舞粗骨棒捕猎，先将猎物打昏，再整只吞下消化。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hunts for prey by swinging a thick, bony club with its tail. It bludgeons its prey with the club to render them unconscious. Once incapacitated, POKENAME swallows and digests its prey whole.

entry: POKENAME用吐息点燃随身骨头，想让自己勇敢些。可喷火太多会疲惫，因此总尽量让火棒烧得久一点。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tries to make itself feel braver by lighting the bone it carries with its flame breath. Because breathing too much fire tires it out, it tries to keep its flaming club lit for as long as possible.

entry: 孤独的POKENAME常被大奶罐群收养。为报恩，它格外拼命护群，冲向认定的威胁，拿随身骨头狠敲。
author: sk372
source: The lonely POKENAME usually finds itself being adopted into Miltank herds. In exchange for the kindness, it becomes fiercely protective of the group, charging down perceived threats to whack them with the bone it carries.

entry: 野生幸福蛋常收养成为孤儿的卡拉卡拉，把它放进育儿袋，喂自己的蛋，温柔抚养。这些新组成家庭的幸福与爱，几乎触手可及。
author: sk372
source: Wild Blissey will often adopt orphan Cubone, carrying them in its pouch, feeding them its eggs and raising them tenderly. The joy and love these newly-formed families feel is palpable.

entry: POKENAME用缎带带着富矿骨头。POKENAME将骨浸进河湖，就能给水补入有益矿物，增进水生宝可梦的健康。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME carries mineral-rich bones in its ribbons. When POKENAME dips its bones into rivers and lakes, it enriches the water with beneficial minerals that boost health in aquatic Pokémon.

entry: 海崖洞穴旁的猛烈风暴，通常被归因于POKENAME。据说，大海回应着它强烈的挫败、孤独与隔绝之感。
author: sk372
source: Aggressive sea storms located near cliff-side caverns are usually attributed to POKENAME. It's said the ocean responds to the Pokémon's intense frustration and feelings of loneliness and isolation.

entry: POKENAME将体内雷电充进随身骨头，让骨亮起来。常见它带着年幼皮丘，用充能武器灵巧守护。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME charges up the bones it carries with lightning from its body, enough to make them glow brightly. It's often seen leading young Pichu around, defending them with deft use of its charged-up weapons.

entry: POKENAME极孤僻又好斗，住在地下洞穴深处。旧日闯入者的骨，撒遍领地，警告旅人别再深入。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a very solitary, aggressive Pokémon that lives deep in underground caverns. The bones of previous trespassers are strewn about its territory as a warning for travelers to delve no further.

entry: POKENAME不只给自己做骨盔，连尾巴也有一顶。孤独时，就对尾巴说话，再自己配声，装作尾巴正在回应。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fashions a helmet of bone not just for itself, but for its tail as well. When feeling lonely, it will talk to its tail, and make noises to pretend the tail is responding back.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，不停把骨头在尾巴间抛接，从不让一条尾巴握太久。骨若掉了，就慌张停战，先捡回来。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME constantly tosses its bone back and forth while fighting, never holding it in one tail for long. If the bone is dropped, it panics and halts combat to retrieve it.

entry: POKENAME让靠近沼泽的来者看见幻象，常把闯入者引向歧路，确保POKENAME家园清静。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME causes hallucinations in anyone who ventures too close to its swamp. These visions often lead intruders astray, ensuring POKENAME's home remains undisturbed.

entry: POKENAME虽是小偷，战斗也有些粗蛮，却有自己的荣誉。对倒下的敌手，POKENAME会收集、埋葬遗骨，表达敬意。
author: sk372
source: Although POKENAME is a thief and a bit of a brute in combat, it has its own sense of honor. Fallen rivals have their bones gathered and buried by POKENAME as a sign of respect.

entry: POKENAME得到的水分，总又哭成眼泪流走，因此身体始终干燥。谁想劝它别再哭，就会遭头顶骨棒狠狠一敲。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's body is always very dry due to always crying out any moisture it gains. Any attempts to stop its excessive crying will end with a big smack from the bone atop its head.

entry: POKENAME心情多变，却把真情绪藏在面前头骨后，继续为别人表演。若POKENAME肯向训练家显露真心，便是极深信任。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are moody creatures that hide their true feelings behind the skull on their face so that they can continue to perform for others. If POKENAME show a Trainer how they truly feel, it is a sign of great trust.

entry: POKENAME把大量电力充进尾巴所握骨头，让它发亮、迸出雷光。骨头也能当武器投出，划空噼啪，宛如雷击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME supercharges the bone held by its tail with electricity, making it glow and crackle with lightning. It can fling the bone as a weapon, cracking through the air like a lightning strike.

entry: POKENAME常挥着较大的骨棒，上面还留着不少肉。既是好用的打击武器，也是便携零食。
author: sk372
source: The bone clubs POKENAME wields will usually be larger in size and still carrying a sizable amount of meat on them. This makes it effective both as a bludgeoning tool and a portable snack.

entry: POKENAME初看不起眼，实际是高明猎手，拿猎物的骨作武器、工具与护具。常见它握着骨串肉，一整天慢慢吃。
author: infinex21
source: Despite initial appearance, POKENAME are skilled hunters who use the bones of their prey as weapons, tools, and for protection. They are often seen holding bone-skewered meat that they will feed on throughout the day.

entry: POKENAME是凶猛独猎者，很会用骨作战。一端保持钝，另一端磨尖，便能按需要击打或刺穿。
author: sk372
source: A vicious solitary hunter, POKENAME is very skilled at using bones in combat. It keeps one end of the bone blunt while sharpening the other, so it can bludgeon or pierce to suit its needs.

entry: POKENAME茂盛藤蔓里缠着许多猎物遗骨，既护身，也供各种临时武器。藤蔓富钙，还有些人拿来作补充营养的食材。
author: infinex21
source: The many bones of POKENAME's prey are entangled within its overgrown vines, offering protection and myriad makeshift weapons. Its vines are rich with calcium, making them popular with some people as a supplemental ingredient.

entry: POKENAME胆小，最初在关都东部野外被发现。头骨比娇嫩皮肤坚固得多，用来自卫；捡到的东西则收起来、磨尖，当作工具或武器。
author: bobosmith01
source: A shy Pokémon that was first discovered in the wild in eastern Kanto, POKENAME uses its skull for defense, as it is much stronger than its comparatively tender skin. It collects and sharpens objects it discovers to use as weapons or tools.

entry: POKENAME振翼能产生足以震碎骨头的冲击波。它先投下随身骨头，分散猎物注意，再从全然不同的方向俯冲。
author: sk372
source: The beat of POKENAME's wings can produce shockwaves powerful enough to shatter bone. It drops bones it carries as a distraction to prey, swooping down on them from a completely different direction.

entry: POKENAME与自然深深相通，极珍惜草木生命。若见附近植物将死，就蜷在旁边，悲伤哭泣。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is deeply in-tune with nature, and cares greatly for the lives of plants. If it finds dying plants near it, it curls up next to them and cries in sorrow.

entry: POKENAME夏天头骨会变得极冷，使体温稳定在华氏10度。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's skull becomes intensely cold during the summer months. This keeps its body at a steady 10 degrees Fahrenheit.

entry: POKENAME爪外裹着锯齿骨层，用来撕开坚韧仙人掌与其他植物，取得食物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's claws are encased in serrated bone. It uses them to tear apart tough cacti and other plants for sustenance.

entry: POKENAME的头骨与长牙，由极坚实的骨构成。即使全速撞进坚硬冰川，身体也不会崩下一小片。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's skull and tusks are made of extremely solid bone. It could charge full-speed into a solid glacier of ice and not even chip a piece off of its body.

entry: POKENAME故障般的举动，似乎源于程序中的情绪不稳。悲伤数值会随机飙高，让它一阵阵哭泣、失控。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's glitchy behavior seems to be a byproduct of emotional instability in its programming. Its sorrow values spike at random, leading to fits of crying and hysterics.

entry: POKENAME用沉重骨棒狠打其他宝可梦。有些POKENAME更聪明，会给骨棒缠藤，造出一条鞭。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their hefty bone club to wallop other Pokémon. Some POKENAME are clever enough to wrap a vine around their club to create a whip.

entry: POKENAME灵巧使用收集的骨，在领地树上刻痕。它出了名独居，很少被看见。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME skillfully uses collected bones to etch markings into trees in its territory. It's known to be a solitary Pokémon and is rarely seen.

entry: POKENAME细心照料当地植物，轻轻挖起枯株遗骸，再把收来的种子栽进空穴，让新生命萌发。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME takes great care in looking over the plants in its region. It gently digs up the remains of dead plants, planting seeds it collects in the holes left behind so new life can grow.

entry: POKENAME背上突出多根骨头，防御充足。滚起来，便能轻易撞翻多数敌人；脱下的骨刺，也能捡来当额外武器。
author: sk372
source: Multiple bones stick out of POKENAME's back, giving it ample defenses. Rolling allows it to bowl over most enemies with ease, and shed bone-spines can be picked up and used as extra weapons.

entry: POKENAME休息时埋进沼泽，抱紧骨棒，免得睡着弄丢。谁若趁睡想拿走，它就带着朦胧怒意醒来，挥棒还击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME bury themselves in swamps when they rest and hug their boney club to avoid losing it while sleeping. If anyone tries to take their club while they sleep, they awaken and strike with a groggy rage.

entry: POKENAME沉在泥里观察旅人，看着只像废弃骨头。闯入者若开始惹事，便跃出淤泥，以骨武器将其击倒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME watches travelers while submerged in the mud to appear as little more than discarded bones. If a trespasser starts causing trouble, it leaps from the muck to strike them down with its bony weapons.

entry: POKENAME挖遍沼泽家园找骨头，震动地面，捕捉骨头传来的振动，再挖出，收集在背上。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dig through their swampy homes to find bones. They shake the earth to pick up vibrations from bones that they dig up and collect on their backs.

entry: 它独来独往，哀鸣回荡夜间。可有人见过POKENAME安慰悲伤的宝可梦，甚至训练家，送上骨护符后，又消失了。
author: evilgammon
source: A solitary Pokémon, its mournful cries echo through the night. However, POKENAME have been seen comforting grieving Pokémon and even grieving Trainers, giving them charms of bone before disappearing again.

entry: POKENAME舞步缓慢优雅，带着忧伤。它情感极敏锐，常在表演完毕后，独自轻声哭泣。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's dance moves are slow and graceful, with a melancholic edge. It is quite emotionally sensitive, and often seen crying quietly after it finishes a performance.

entry: POKENAME骨肢很会重击，却不是最厉害的技巧。它能从肘部伸出尖骨，刺、切那些特别坚韧的敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's bone limbs are effective for bludgeoning, but not its most effective technique. It extends pointed bones from its elbows to use for stabbing and slicing particularly tough opponents.

entry: POKENAME飞行悄无声息，却总像在哭。有人说，望进背上的洞，能看见逝去亲人，从彼世与观者交谈。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flies in total silence, though it always appears to be crying. Some say gazing into the hole in its back will show visions of deceased loved ones, communicating with the viewer from beyond the veil.

entry: POKENAME自恃能免疫许多攻击，胆大地挑战别的对象。可骄傲常蒙住眼，让它忘了：能真正击中自己的敌人，通常一招就能打倒它。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME prides itself on its immunity to many forms of attack against it and boldly challenges others. However, its hubris often overcomes it, causing it to forget that any foe that can hit it will usually defeat it in a single attack.

entry: POKENAME前额与背部披着骨甲，抵御物理攻击。头骨般的头甲，也能强化头锤。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's forehead and back are clad in a skeletal armor meant to protect them from physical attacks. The skull-like armor on their heads reinforce their Headbutt attacks.

entry: POKENAME身体能变色，匹配骨头碰到的任何东西。颜色会一直保持，到受惊才消退。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can change its body color to match whatever it touches with its bone. The coloration persists until it becomes startled.

entry: 有人认为，POKENAME是四只逝去卡拉卡拉的灵魂，共用一个身体。它踏着骨肢行动，连放出超能力脉冲攻击时，双眼也从不睁开。
author: sk372
source: Some believe POKENAME is the spirits of four deceased Cubone in a singular body. It stomps around on bony limbs, its eyes never opening even as it attacks others with psychic pulses.

entry: POKENAME常啃骨，牙齿因此极强。它会用牙改造大骨，直到合手，或贴合自己的头骨形状。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's teeth are very strong, due to its habit of gnawing on bones. It will reshape larger bones using its teeth until they are custom-fitted to its grip or the shape of its skull.

entry: POKENAME只有极度快乐或悲伤时，主体才会钻出头骨。稍纵即逝的身影，让它更显超凡诡秘。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's main body only emerges from the skull when it experiences intense happiness or sadness. This fleeting appearance gives it an otherworldly presence.

entry: 传说，POKENAME是一整代卡拉卡拉与嘎啦嘎啦的亡魂，绑在同一副骨架上。外表虽吓人，POKENAME却对不怕自己的对象，格外温柔友善。
author: sk372
source: Tales exist that say POKENAME is an entire generations' worth of Cubone and Marowak spirits tied to the same skeleton. Despite the frightening appearance, POKENAME is surprisingly gentle and kind to those unafraid of it.

entry: POKENAME为守护其他生命，奋力作战。它将自身波导化作骨状小棒，在战斗中灵巧挥舞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fights vigorously in the name of protecting others. It creates small clubs in the shape of bones made from its own aura to wield deftly in combat.

entry: POKENAME闲时爱啃骨。强颚常将骨咬碎，只好不停寻找更多收藏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gnaws on bones as a leisure activity. Its powerful jaws regularly crush the bone it chews on, causing it to constantly be on the lookout for more to collect.

entry: POKENAME在沙漠中跃进跃出，仿佛游水。它是凶猛猎手，以肢缘磨尖的骨片斩倒猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can leap in and out of the desert sands as if it were water. It's a fierce hunter, cutting down prey with the sharpened bone bits at the edge of its limbs.

entry: POKENAME用骨盔与武器，保卫所守护的尼多族群。头骨尖端小洞渗出微毒，能让特别顽固的敌人中毒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its bone helmet and weaponry in defense of the Nidoran families it guards. A mild venom leaks from a hole in the tip of the skull, allowing it to poison particularly stubborn foes.

entry: POKENAME钻进洞壁，伪装成化石。会让假头骨的颚喀喀作响，吓退闯入者。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME burrow into the walls of caves to disguise as fossils, rattling the jaw of their false skull to scare off intruders.

entry: 温和的人，只会看见POKENAME小巧的一面。只有这温顺宝可梦极少数真正动怒时，才会动用所控制的巨大头骨。
author: t3isukone
source: A peaceful person will only see the smaller side of a POKENAME. The massive skulls it can control are only deployed on the rare occasion that this mellow Pokémon feels true anger.

entry: POKENAME藏在海底岩群中，看着只是一颗头骨。猎物毫无戒心地游过，便被黏触手抓住，拖下去吃掉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides itself among undersea rock formations, so it only appears to be a skull on the sea bottom. Unsuspecting prey that swims by is then grabbed by sticky tentacles, dragged down to be eaten.

entry: POKENAME在深海时，头骨会泛起微光。捕食者若靠近，它先施展岩石爆击，再逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's skull emits a faint glow when deep beneath the sea. If a predator approaches, it fires Rock Blast before fleeing.

entry: POKENAME头骨坚固得能把黑曜石砸成细粉，战斗时是可怕的对手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's skull is so durable that it can break obsidian into fine powder. This strength makes it a fearsome opponent in battle.

entry: POKENAME头骨由极厚实的硬骨构成，能抵御几乎所有类型的物理打击。幼小同类爱拿骨棒互敲着玩，几乎感觉不到冲击。
author: sk372
source: Made of extremely thick and solid bone, POKENAME's cranium is resistant to nearly every sort of physical strike. Young members of the species will playfully bonk each other with bone clubs, barely feeling the impact of the strike.

entry: POKENAME戴的头骨极坚韧，连雷电也能弹开，让它在最猛烈风暴中，仍能安然无恙。
author: .izik
source: The skull POKENAME wears is so resilient it can deflect lightning bolts. This natural armor keeps it safe even during the fiercest storms.

entry: POKENAME极凶，收集猎获的骨头，作武器与铠甲。周围腐败细菌如致命毒素，巢旁哪怕小擦伤，也得立即处理。
author: ghostslythe
source: Extremely vicious, POKENAME gathers bones from successful hunts to use as weapons and armor. The bacteria of decay surrounding them acts as a deadly poison, and any scrape from around their nests needs to be treated immediately.

entry: 可怕风暴将至，POKENAME的头骨便快速振动。发出的诡异声响，提醒着附近生命。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's skull vibrates rapidly just before terrible storms arrive. The eerie sound it produces serves as a warning to those nearby.

entry: POKENAME常住寺庙、墓地等阴暗而有文化意义的地方。有人到访这些古地，它们就现身迎接，再回去忙原来的事。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME tend to live in gloomy places with significant cultural value, such as temples or graveyards. Whenever a visitor comes to these ancient places, they emerge to greet the visitor before returning to whatever they were doing.

entry: POKENAME是海底温和的巨兽，常衔着几根吼鲸王的骨游泳。骨头都存进同一个巢，在遗骸间入睡，轻声自泣。
author: sk372
source: A gentle giant of the undersea world, POKENAME is usually seen swimming with a few Wailord bones in its mouth. It deposits them in a single den area, sleeping among the remains and crying softly to itself.

entry: POKENAME是曾被认为灭绝的古老宝可梦，后来在沙漠深处被发现，那里鲜有其他草属性宝可梦。坚固的壳与头骨让它抵御恶劣天气。
author: katieplaysgames
source: An ancient Pokémon thought extinct for some time, POKENAME has been discovered living deep in deserts with few other Grass-types around. POKENAME has a hardy shell and skull to protect itself from the harsh weather of its environment.

entry: POKENAME墓碑般的壳，散出令人不安的气息。传闻若看见野生POKENAME从远处静静盯着自己，死期就快到了。
author: sk372
source: An unsettling aura emanates from POKENAME's shell, which takes on the appearance of a tombstone. Rumors say that if you spot a wild POKENAME staring at you quietly from the distance, your demise is nigh.

entry: 有人见过POKENAME用随身骨棒生火。小群聚在一起时，会围着火焰歌舞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been observed using the bone club it carries to start fires. When together in small groups, they dance and chant around the flame.

entry: POKENAME靠简陋骨工具在野外生存，生火，或做锐器捕猎。它们精于骨工，训练家可把作品卖到世界各地的市场。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on rudimentary bone tools to survive in the wild by creating fire or making sharp weapons to hunt prey. Their mastery over boney crafts allows their Trainers to sell their crafts at markets around the world.

entry: POKENAME的白角常长得盖住部分头部，像第二层头骨。它们爱用长角互斗，分出谁更强。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's white horn often grows to cover some of the rest of its head like a second skull. They often fight among themselves using these long horns to see which of them is stronger.

entry: POKENAME很聪明，野外日常会拿骨头作棒，也作工具。它先投棒砸来者，再拍胸尖叫，试着将其吓走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a strong intellect, able to use a bone as a club and tool in everyday life in the wild. It throws the club at intruders before beating its chest and screeching to try and scare them off.

entry: POKENAME习惯独自生活，会在沙漠挖洞，垂钓流沙中的猎物。头上戴的头骨，主要用来遮挡沙漠的灼人烈日。
author: elevn.
source: POKENAME are very solitary Pokémon. They dig holes in the desert to fish in shifting sands. The skull they wear on their head is essentially used to protect them from the burning sun of the desert.

entry: POKENAME骨中嵌着磁铁，产生奇异磁性，让它能轻易吸引、操纵金属物体。
author: .izik
source: Magnets are embedded within POKENAME's bones, giving them strange magnetic properties. This allows POKENAME to attract and manipulate metallic objects with ease.

entry: POKENAME的骨含有磁性矿石，让战斗控制更精准，敌人还没缓过来，就能接连命中多次。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's bones contain a magnetic ore that allows precise control during battle. This lets it strike opponents multiple times before they can recover.

entry: 老学者说，这把骨匕首由孤独野兽的遗骸制成，还被它的灵魂附身。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This bone dagger is said by old scholars to be made from the remains of a lonesome beast and haunted by its spirit.

entry: POKENAME初看像两把剑插在卡拉卡拉头骨里，真本领却到激战才显露。双刃脱离托座，精准袭击，头骨眼窝同时泛起微光。
author: sk372
source: Appearing at first to be two swords stuck within a Cubone skull, POKENAME demonstrates its true skill in the heat of combat. Both blades release from their holder and strike with precision, while a faint glow emits from the skull's eye sockets.

entry: POKENAME的头骨盾一被击中，就响起卡拉卡拉幽灵般的哀鸣，让对手心神不宁。它便趁机拔出骨刃，斩倒敌人。
author: sk372
source: The ghostly wail of a Cubone is heard whenever POKENAME's skull-shield is struck, often unnerving opponents. This gives it the perfect opportunity to unsheathe its bone-blade and cut its foe down.

entry: POKENAME的角比硬岩更坚固，内藏强毒。POKENAME全力挑战对手，也用猎物遗骨标记领地。
author: infinex21
source: The horn of a POKENAME is harder than solid rock and holds a potent toxin within. POKENAME will challenge others with all their might and mark their territories with the bones of their prey.

entry: 有人说，POKENAME体内住着士兵亡魂，死后也不肯停下效忠。它们尽职侍奉训练家，以胸前刀刃磨骨，再拿来作战。
author: sk372
source: Some say POKENAME are inhabited by the spirits of soldiers who refuse to stop serving their leaders even after death. They dutifully serve their Trainer, using bones sharpened by the blades on their torso.

entry: POKENAME似乎丢了骨头，如今挥着匆匆削出的木制替代品，颇为自豪。可这把木剑威力很弱，战斗时常打不出像样伤害。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME appears to have lost its bone and now wields a hastily carved wooden club as a substitute, which it is greatly proud of. However, the wooden sword is a weak weapon that often fails to do meaningful damage in combat.

entry: 据说POKENAME很精通近身格斗，凭锐剑护身。它对训练家极忠诚，会一直守护，直到再也办不到。
author: whiteupgrade
source: POKENAME is said to be very experienced in hand-to-hand combat, using a sharp sword to defend itself. It's very loyal to its Trainer and will defend them until it cannot.

entry: POKENAME住在最暗的洞穴，双眼发光，在黑暗中也看得一清二楚。它先以尾上骨头迸出火花警告，再朝闯入者放出雷电。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME inhabits the darkest caverns, its eyes glowing as it perceives others through the dark with perfect clarity. It creates sparks with the bone on its tail as a warning before belting out lightning at intruders.

entry: POKENAME像埋在沙与旧海草下、重新活动的美纳斯骨架。它装成普通景物捕猎，猛地跃出，用锐骨尖攻击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears to be a reanimated Milotic skeleton buried beneath sand and old seaweed. It hunts by pretending to be simple scenery, before leaping out and attacking prey with the sharp ends of its bones.

entry: POKENAME独自飞在山峰间，多住龙宝可梦曾大量逝去的山地。谁敢闯入、亵渎此地，就会遭它凶猛攻击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flies around mountain peaks, living a solitary lifestyle. It usually inhabits mountains that have a history of fallen Dragon types, and aggressively targets those who would invade and desecrate the area.

entry: POKENAME在森林制造幻象，让旅人迷路，再现身引他们去出口。它太想获赞美，连假英雄救场也不惜自己安排。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME casts illusions in forests to confuse travelers into getting lost. It appears before them to lead them towards the exit, desperately seeking praise from others even if it has to engineer false heroics to do so.

entry: 没人见过POKENAME真正的脸。人们推测，它戴的头骨，属于一位已经逝去的族群伙伴。
author: melodydelune
source: No one has seen the true face of POKENAME. The skull it wears is theorized to be that of a pack member that passed on.

entry: POKENAME拿大型死去生物最结实的巨骨，作强盛象征。它极护着幼小宝可梦，谁敢当面欺负，就绝不留情。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the biggest and sturdiest bones from fallen creatures as a symbol of its might. It is very protective of younger Pokémon, showing no mercy to those who pick on them in its presence.

entry: POKENAME孤栖海底，不愿任何对象打扰。谁靠近住处，就会被它掀起的巨大漩涡，一路送回海面。
author: sk372
source: Isolated at the bottom of the sea, POKENAME does not want anything else to intrude upon its solitude. Anything that approaches its home is sent all the way back to the ocean's surface via massive churned-up whirlpools.

entry: POKENAME以坟场墓地为中心，引发灾难性地震，骨头随强能量哗哗作响。有人形容，全身发寒，仿佛自己的骨也在振。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME create cataclysmic earthquakes that center around graveyards and cemeteries, causing bones to rattle with potent energy. Some people describe feeling chills throughout their body as though their bones were vibrating.

entry: POKENAME个体小，像戴着一只古代烈空坐的遗骨头盔。它只短暂落地觅食，便又隐入臭氧层，害怕接触其他生命。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a small specimen that appears to be wearing the skull of an ancient deceased Rayquaza. It lands only for a short duration to gather food, disappearing into the ozone layer, fearful of contact with other beings.

entry: 传说，POKENAME会现身某些人面前，将其送回过去。故事都有同一主题：穿越者想救回失去的挚爱。
author: sk372
source: Legends say that POKENAME would appear before certain humans and send them back in time. The stories all share a common theme of the time-traveler wanting to save a lost loved one.

entry: POKENAME一声神秘吼叫，便能倒转时间，让伤病近乎奇迹般康复。不过再怎么努力，也救不回已经逝去的生命。
author: quackquackattack
source: A single mythical roar from POKENAME can cause seemingly miraculous recovery from disease and injury as they turn back time. Despite their best efforts, they cannot revive those who have already passed.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME朝月亮挥骨，动作缓慢而画着圆。人们认为，这是古老仪式的一环。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME waves its bone toward the moon during full moons. The slow, circular motions are believed to be part of an ancient ritual.

entry: POKENAME挥骨镰的形象，催生出它收割孤魂的传闻。身上骨质部分摸着冰冷刺骨，覆着终年不化的霜。
author: sk372
source: Images of POKENAME wielding a bone scythe gave rise to rumors depicting it as a reaper of lonely souls. The bony parts of its body are extremely chilling to the touch, and coated with permafrost.

entry: POKENAME的花散出诡异阴森的香气，多数宝可梦退避，幽灵属性却受吸引。驱邪者因此用它，强行逐出宅中作祟的幽灵。
author: sk372
source: A strange, ghastly sort of aroma emanates from POKENAME's flowers. Most Pokémon are repelled, but Ghost types are attracted to the scent, leading to exorcists using it to help forcefully expel ghosts haunting homes.

entry: POKENAME私下爱玩骨头，蹦跳着把它抛上空，再像接指挥棒般接回。谁若撞见，就会羞得厉害。
author: sk372
source: In private, POKENAME likes to play with its bone, tossing it in the air and catching it like a baton as it leaps around. It gets extremely embarrassed if someone catches it doing this.

entry: POKENAME靠强劲跳跃与长尾，打击远方敌人。蘑菇帽散出的孢子，会让受影响的对象双眼流泪。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its powerful leaps combined with its lengthy tail to strike opponents from afar. The spores its mushroom cap creates cause watery eyes in those afflicted.

entry: POKENAME以幽灵力量控制骨头，却故意装得像骨头在控制自己，好显得更吓人，更容易吓住小孩子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME controls the bones it carries with ghostly power, but makes it appear as if it's the other way around. It does this to look more frightening and more effectively scare small children.

entry: POKENAME学会附身采矿设备，借工具挖取珍贵矿物。机器里的恶作剧，常让矿工摸不着头脑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has learned to possess mining equipment, using tools to extract valuable minerals. Its mechanical mischief often leaves miners baffled.

entry: 新月期间，POKENAME的骨质部分转为漆黑。此时若掷出骨头，撞击连坚岩都能粉碎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's bony features turn pitch black during a new moon. If it hurls its bone during this time, the impact can shatter solid stone.

entry: POKENAME为练准头，会一连数小时反复练骨头回力镖。卡在毛发里的骨头，都是过去没接住时留下的。
author: dodoowner_
source: In order to improve its throwing accuracy, POKENAME will practice Bonemerang repeatedly for hours on end. The bones lodged in its hair are from past, failed attempts at catching them.

entry: POKENAME心地善良，外表却骇人，让人远远避开。有位训练家为改变印象，写了本童书：年幼POKENAME爬上高处，凭好眼力，四下寻找妈妈。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Due to its terrifying appearance, people give it a wide berth, though POKENAME is kind-hearted. To change public perception, a Trainer wrote a children's book about a young POKENAME climbing things to use its superb eyesight to look for its mother.

entry: POKENAME身体像墓碑，会投射幻象，让敌人措手不及。这些诡异把戏，能帮它在战斗中占先。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body resembles a gravestone, and it projects illusions to catch opponents off-guard. These eerie tricks give it an edge in battle.

entry: POKENAME在新近逝去的生命旁停留，骨架就会变得滚烫，空气也散出淡淡蜡香。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's bone structure becomes superheated when it lingers near the recently departed. When this occurs, it releases a faint, waxy scent into the air.

entry: POKENAME在野外最常见于墓地附近，似与灵界略有连系。有人认为，尾巴召出的苍白火焰，便是逝去宝可梦的灵魂显形。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is most often seen in the wild near graveyards. It seems to have a light connection to the spirit world, and some believe the pale flames its tails conjure are the spirits of deceased Pokémon made manifest.

entry: POKENAME伏身不动，等好奇的观者靠近。一入范围，就忽然动起来，阴森森摇响收藏的骨头，再浮身离去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lies prone, waiting for a curious onlooker to approach. Once they're within range, it springs to life and rattles the bones it collects creepily before floating away.

entry: POKENAME装成卡拉卡拉，连骨头也学着握，想与它们交朋友。有些欣赏这份心意，有些却觉得不自在。
author: sk372
source: Wearing a disguise looking like Cubone and even wielding a bone similarly, POKENAME tries to make friends with the Pokémon. Some appreciate the effort, while others find it disconcerting.

entry: POKENAME住在沙漠，藏进其他宝可梦的骨骸。把自己缠在骨上，就能借它作身体，夜里像一具具行尸。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME live in the desert, hiding out in the skeletal remains of other Pokémon. By wrapping themselves around these bones, they can use them as a body, resembling walking corpses in the night.

entry: 起初，人们以为POKENAME的骨盔挡住视线，后来才发现它根本没眼睛。靠强嗅觉找到猎物，再一记结实头锤击昏。
author: sk372
source: At first it was thought that POKENAME's bony helmet obscured its vision before it was discovered it lacks eyes. Its strong sense of smell leads it to prey it knocks out with a single solid headbutt.

entry: POKENAME无论彼此怎么打，头骨都不会裂或脱落。某个头若没得到训练家足够关注，就嚎个不停，直到被理会，或另一个头烦得打它。
author: soup1900
source: No matter how much POKENAME fights with each other, their skulls won't ever fracture or break off. If a head does not get enough attention from its Trainer, it wails wildly until given attention or when the other head attacks it in annoyance.

entry: POKENAME飞快振动骨状翅膀飞行。夜飞时若被打扰，就以骨棒还击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies using rapid flaps of its bonelike wings. If disturbed during nighttime flight, it will retaliate with Bone Club.

entry: POKENAME最初发现于紫苑镇附近，难觅又避人。据说，摸它一条尾巴，会被诅咒永远孤独。
author: sk372
source: First discovered in the vicinity of Lavender Town, POKENAME is an elusive species that avoids human contact. Touching one of its tails is said to curse the perpetrator to be eternally lonely.

entry: POKENAME碰到人骨，可能穿越时间，有时连附近生命也一并带走。旅程只几分钟，却常让被卷进去的目击者深感困惑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME may time travel upon touching human bones, sometimes bringing nearby beings along. The journey lasts only minutes, often leaving witnesses brought along deeply confused.

entry: POKENAME对波导极灵敏，连自身波导也能感知。它们以波导表达心意，再注入骨棒，确保击中目标。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are highly attuned to auras, including their own. They express themselves using their auras and by imbuing their bone clubs with their auras, they can ensure they strike their targets.

entry: POKENAME用小骨棒击打波导中带负面脉动的对象。它怕独自深入夜间沙漠，因此只在白天现身沙丘。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME strikes anyone possessing an aura with negative pulsations with its small bone clubs. It is afraid to venture alone into the night desert, so it appears among the dunes during daylight.

entry: POKENAME懒得出奇，连自卫也很少愿意动。它虽然十分依恋自己的骨棒，可即使骨棒被偷，也提不起劲抢回来，只会放声大哭。
author: sk372
source: Extremely slothful, POKENAME rarely moves even in its own self-defense. It is quite attached to its club, but even if it's stolen it won't muster up the energy to take it back, simply crying loudly in response.

entry: 有人见过POKENAME把自己的骨抽出来，当武器。因为新骨长得太快，旧骨留太久不取，反会让身体极不舒服。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been seen pulling the bones out of its own body to use as weapons. It does this because its body grows new bones so quickly, the old ones would cause it extreme discomfort if not removed for too long.

entry: 母亲离去后，POKENAME只能独自生存，成长中始终思念母亲的温暖。这份磨炼让它坚韧，能应对危险的海洋生活。
author: krune
source: POKENAME grow up missing the warmth of their mothers, who leave them to survive alone. This hardship prepares them for dangerous sea life, ensuring their resilience.

entry: 它会把随身携带的骨棒当作避雷针，在暴风雨中吸收雷电的能量。它极爱群居，必须与同伴一起生活；一旦独处，就会被绝望吞噬。
author: fiordaliso
source: It uses the bone club it always carries as a lightning rod to absorb the energy of thunderbolts during storms. It needs to live together with the rest of the pack because it is an extremely social creature; when left alone, it is consumed by despair.

entry: POKENAME对着骨棒唱歌，骨头振动，把声音放大。听众谁若听睡着，它们就把棒扔过去，将对方叫醒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sing into their boney club that vibrates and amplifies their voice. Whenever anyone falls asleep listening to their song, they chuck the club at the audience member to wake them up.

entry: POKENAME头上的骨意外地脆。若崩落一片，POKENAME便会为这损失哀悼好几天。
author: .izik
source: The skull on POKENAME's head is surprisingly brittle. If a portion breaks off, POKENAME will mourn the loss for multiple days.

entry: POKENAME躺在干地，动得太少，小虫常聚过来。它十分不合群，干脆装死，避免与别人互动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lays around dry areas, moving so little that small insects often flock to it. It pretends to be deceased as a way to avoid interacting with others; it is quite antisocial.

entry: POKENAME是沙漠食腐者，靠天敌吃剩的残骸，或不幸旅人的遗骸维生。大嘴能存骨，留着以后用，也会朝敌人吐出。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are desert scavengers that sustain themselves on the remains left by predators or the remains of unfortunate travelers. Their large mouths allow them to store bones for later, which they may also spit out at foes.

entry: POKENAME拿头骨盔盖脸，显得神秘。其他宝可梦若想摘盔，它便隔水掷出骨棒，打消对方好奇心。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME cover their faces with a skull helmet to make themselves seem mysterious. If another Pokémon tries to take off their helmet, they throw their boney club through the water to quell their curiosity.

entry: POKENAME戴着暴飞龙头骨，更坚定了终有一天飞起来的决心。却也似乎不那么爱跳高崖，生怕摔坏这顶鼓舞自己的头盔。
author: sk372
source: The Salamence skull POKENAME wears fills it with even more determination to one day fly. At the same time, it seems less inclined to leap off tall cliffs, fearful of breaking the helmet that inspires it so.

entry: POKENAME的硬骨盔，让它能在练习飞行时跳下悬崖。可反复尝试之下，脑反而缩小了。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's hard bone helmet allows it to jump off cliffs when training to fly. Its brain has shrunk due to repeated attempts.

entry: POKENAME用逝去暴飞龙的头骨，藏住小身躯。它胆小又不算强，往往直到要进化，才肯从庇护中探出。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides its small frame with the skull of a fallen Salamence. Timid and not terribly strong, it rarely pokes itself out from the shelter until it's time to evolve.

entry: POKENAME用幻象扮成其他宝可梦，只为不再孤单。可朋友若发现真身，它又会羞得惊慌逃跑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses illusions to masquerade itself as other Pokémon so it won't be lonely. If its friends discover it in its true form, however, it gets embarrassed and flees in a panic.

entry: POKENAME戴上逝去喷火龙的头骨，就充满活力与勇气，战斗自信得多。可谁若摘下头盔，这自信就会立刻垮掉。
author: sk372
source: Wearing the skull of a fallen Charizard fills POKENAME with vigor and bravery. It fights much more confidently, but this confidence falters instantly should someone manage to remove its helmet.

entry: POKENAME的眼泪是天然助燃剂，它学会将其与自身火焰巧妙配合。如果火焰攻击似乎不奏效，它便改为挥动骨棒。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's tears act as a natural flame accelerant, which they have learned to use in crafty ways with their own flames. If their flame attacks ever seem to be ineffective, POKENAME will resort to swinging their bone club instead.

entry: POKENAME用骨刺串起水果蔬菜，练习熟练使用骨制工具。食物备够后，它们就生起火，将这些串烤成可口的美餐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME practice developing their proficiency over boney implements by skewering fruits and vegetables with boney spikes. Once they have enough food ready, they start a fire and roast these skewers until they become a delicious meal.

entry: POKENAME向下吐泥，让敌人措手不及，再拖上空。可饥饿一来，就很难提起重目标。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits dirt downward to catch foes off guard before dragging them into the air. As hunger sets in, it struggles to lift heavier targets.

entry: POKENAME极胆小，有麻烦时，仍尽力装勇敢。通常只能乱挥骨棒几秒，最终还是吓得跳走。
author: sk372
source: Highly timid, POKENAME tries its best to be brave when trouble approaches. It usually manages a few seconds of flailing its club about before it inevitably hops away in terror.

entry: POKENAME遇险会放孢子自卫。吸入的人说，之后会经历强烈悲伤。
author: mepp.
source: When threatened, POKENAME produces spores to protect itself. People who inhale it report feeling intense bouts of sadness afterwards.

entry: POKENAME很难信任其他对象。压力一大，头骨周围原本胶冻般的外层，就会变得像实骨般僵硬坚固。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a difficult time trusting in others. When under stress, it hardens the normally gelatinous covering around its skull until it gets as rigid and sturdy as solid bone.

entry: POKENAME周围怪异滴流的物质，质地介于黏液与沙之间。究竟头还是交叉骨，才是真正核心和力量源，仍待研究。
author: sk372
source: The strange, dripping material surrounding POKENAME has a consistency somewhere between slime and sand. Research is still determining whether the head or the crossbones is the true core and source of its powers.

entry: POKENAME用头骨猛撞敌人，以突然重击吓住对方。这激进手段，让POKENAME成了可怕的领地护卫。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rams its skull into enemies, frightening them with sudden, forceful impacts. This aggressive tactic makes POKENAME a fearsome protector of its territory.

entry: POKENAME努力显得自信迷人，其实格外在意旁人目光。面前头骨一被打掉，就会哭得无法自制，直到重新把自己遮好。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tries to project an aura of confidence and charisma, but is actually highly self-conscious. If something knocks the skull off of its face, it will sob uncontrollably until it manages to cover itself again.

entry: POKENAME个体微小，常由迷路电电虫躲进废头骨而形成。日子久了，头骨成了永久的家，渐渐与POKENAME身体融合。
author: bebop
source: POKENAME is a tiny Pokémon frequently formed when a lost Joltik finds shelter inside of an abandoned skull. Over time, the skull becomes its permanent home, fusing with POKENAME's body.

entry: POKENAME睡在比自己大得多的宝可梦头骨里，还把骨壳随身带着，保证夜间有处安全歇息。好奇生物一近，就电一下，再缩回临时家园。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sleep in skulls of Pokémon much larger than themselves and carry the skulls to ensure they have a safe sleeping spot at night. They ward off curious creatures with a jolt of electricity before retreating into their makeshift home.

entry: POKENAME常现身墓地，人们便认为它是亡魂。可近期研究发现，它们其实只是吃墓碑里常见的矿物。
author: mepp.
source: As POKENAME are often found near graveyards, people believe them to be spirits of the departed. However, recent research has found they simply feed on minerals commonly found in headstones.

entry: POKENAME拿随身骨头磨长牙，让两者都更锋利，便于战斗。长牙断了很快长回，倒没什么；骨头若在磨时折断，却会让它慌得手足无措。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME grinds the bones it carries against the its tusks, in order to sharpen them both for battle. Broken tusks grow back and cause it little issue, but bones breaking while sharpening cause it to go into a panicked fluster.

entry: 古代人用POKENAME看守城堡地牢，阻止入侵者。忠诚毫不动摇，让它成了难缠的哨兵。
author: .izik
source: In ancient times, POKENAME was used to guard castle dungeons, keeping intruders at bay. Its unwavering loyalty made it a formidable sentinel.

entry: POKENAME要歇下时，便以头骨与碎骨筑巢。此时轻声唱出的啁啾小调，带着分明忧伤。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME create nests made of skulls and bones when it comes time to roost. The quiet chirping songs they sing during these moments have a decidedly melancholy feel to them.

entry: POKENAME烦躁时，头骨盔鼻孔里会窜小火苗。它用过去捕猎留下的骨头，帮助筑巢。
author: sk372
source: Small flames flare up from the nostrils of POKENAME's skull-helmet when it's agitated. It uses bones leftover from previous hunts to help build its nests.

entry: POKENAME一不如意，就像婴孩般哭叫，引人注意。这习惯，让训练家很难管。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME cries like a baby whenever it doesn't get its way, drawing attention to itself. This behavior makes it difficult for Trainers to manage.

entry: POKENAME钻石般的眼睛，即使在最暗环境，也看得完美清楚，让POKENAME极善探索地下隧道。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's diamond-like eyes grant it perfect vision in the darkest environments. This ability makes POKENAME a formidable explorer of underground tunnels.

entry: POKENAME是沙漠食腐者，在严酷环境中孤独生活。它们收集早已逝去宝可梦被太阳晒白的骨，作自卫铠甲。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are desert scavengers, living lonely existences in harsh environments. They gather the sun-bleached bones of long passed Pokémon to use as protective armour for themselves.

entry: POKENAME将坚韧外骨骼始终朝外，抵挡沙漠家园的酷热。身体突出的骨刺，让滚行时抓地更牢。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME keep their tough outer exoskeleton turned outward to protect themselves from the harsh heat of their desert home. Bony spurs jut from their bodies to give them extra grip as they roll around.

entry: POKENAME颅外多一层头骨，足以缓冲打击。它虽好斗，啃骨却能压住更激烈的攻击冲动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's extra skull layer around its cranium gives it ample protection from blows. It has a belligerent personality, but chewing on bones keeps its more aggressive impulses at bay.

entry: POKENAME最初是从琥珀与沉积物混合层里的化石复活后被发现。骨质部分虽被认为不完整，却能正常发挥功能，琥珀头冠更坚如钢。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME was first discovered after being revived from a fossil found in a mix of amber and sediment. The bony portions of its body are thought to be incomplete yet are fully functional. Its amber crest is as durable as steel.

entry: POKENAME随时都带着一根骨头，日积月累，将其中一端磨尖。它用尖端凿削大冰块，为自己挖出一处，供夜幕降临时歇息的窝。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries a bone with it at all times, and sharpens one end of it over time. It uses the pointed end to chisel away at large ice blocks, digging itself out a den for when night falls.

entry: POKENAME埋地睡觉，看着只是头骨与草叶。谁靠太近，它就本能地挥骨，撒出烦人的花粉，惹得喷嚏连连。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME buries itself in the ground to sleep, appearing to be a simple skull and foliage. If something gets too close, it instinctively waves its bone around and spreads an annoying pollen around that provokes sneezing fits.

entry: POKENAME勇敢替战友助威，手中花球洒出电火花。若伙伴仍落败，它就沮丧倒地，觉得自己没能给予足够支持。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME cheers valiantly for its allies in battle, sparks showering from the pom-poms it holds. If the ally still loses, it falls to the ground, despondent at having failed to support them enough.

entry: POKENAME转骨棒，宛如专业花式转棒表演者。骨转得越快，心情就越欢快。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME twirls its bone like a professional baton twirler. The faster its bone is twirled, the more upbeat it's feeling.

entry: 这种形态的POKENAME，旋转骨头跳出的精巧舞蹈，与阿罗拉嘎啦嘎啦的舞蹈有许多相似之处。
author: hophoppip
source: The elaborate bone-twirling dances of this form of POKENAME share many similarities with the dances of Alolan Marowak.

entry: POKENAME翻遍大垃圾箱与填埋场，寻找腐屑吃。骨头既作甲，也作武器，对付想抢垃圾美餐的其他食腐者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rummages through dumpsters and landfills to find detritus to consume. It uses bones as armor and weaponry to deal with other scavengers that might try to steal its trashy meal.

entry: POKENAME小群游行，饿极狂吃时，片刻就能把生物啃成白骨。连骨也不浪费，握在POKENAME颚间，当作自卫工具。
author: sk372
source: Traveling in small schools, hungry POKENAME can reduce creatures to bones in a few moments of a feeding frenzy. Even the bones are not wasted, held in POKENAME's jaws to use as self-defense.

entry: POKENAME好向其他凶猛水生居民挑架，最常找巨牙鲨。头骨伤疤越大越深，就越受同类敬重。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME aggressively picks fights with other fierce underwater denizens, most often Sharpedo. The larger and deeper the scar on its skull is, the more respect it garners from others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME把骨棒当剑挥，抵御危险宝可梦。角面具遮着脸，在闹鬼森林游荡，寻找合适训练家交友。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wield their boney club like a sword to protect themselves from dangerous Pokémon. Their horned mask conceals their face as they wander through haunted forests searching for the right Trainer to befriend.

entry: POKENAME红眼发光，又有许多骨饰，模样吓人。实际意志却弱，外表与吼声若吓不退对方，就惊慌逃进森林。
author: sk372
source: With a glowing red eye and many bone accessories, POKENAME cuts a frightening visage. It's actually quite weak-willed, however; if its appearance and roar don't scare something off, it panics and flees into the forest.

entry: POKENAME的气味随心情变化，常因消沉而散出恶臭。流下的眼泪却是一种花蜜，出了名甜美。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's scent is tied to its mood, and is primarily a noxious aroma due it often being in a state of depression. The tears it sheds are a type nectar known for being particularly sweet.

entry: POKENAME靠天生方向感，把迷途旅人的遗骨送回故乡，因此传出它守护游魂的故事。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME brings the bones of lost travelers back to their hometowns, guided by an innate sense of direction. This behavior has led to legends of POKENAME being a guardian of wandering souls.

entry: POKENAME是寂静而致命的夜猎者，俯冲而下，一棒击昏猎物，再第二次俯冲，抓起目标，带回巢穴。
author: sk372
source: A silent and deadly hunter of the night, POKENAME swoops down and uses the bone club it carries to knock out prey in one strike. A second swoop follows, snatching up its target to be taken back to its lair.

entry: POKENAME虽像音波龙，却无法用高频叫声在黑暗辨路。它改拿骨棒敲喉部厚骨板，以响声进行回声定位。
author: _pixelar_
source: Though it resembles a Noivern, this Pokémon cannot make high-pitched noises to orient itself in the dark. Instead, it has a thick bone plating on its throat that, when struck with POKENAME's club, creates a loud sound that it then uses to echolocate.

entry: POKENAME身体是黏稠液体，容易被大型宝可梦伤到，便收集骨头，黏在身上作甲。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have sticky liquid bodies that are vulnerable to harm from larger Pokémon. To protect themselves they gather up bones to stick to themselves as armour.

entry: POKENAME心思敏感，动不动就哭。眼泪是浓稠液体，常在眼下拖出道道黏痕。
author: sk372
source: With a sensitive heart, POKENAME is prone to crying at the drop of a hat. The tears it sheds are a thick and viscous fluid that often leaves sticky streaks trailing down from its eyes.

entry: POKENAME的花粉云会引发强烈幻觉。古人以为自己窥见来世，因而十分畏惧它。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's pollen clouds cause strong hallucinations in victims. In ancient times, people thought it caused them to glimpse into the afterlife, giving it a feared reputation.

entry: POKENAME极孤苦，会依恋第一个善待自己的人。依附太深，有时连家人、朋友也攻击，生怕他们夺走心爱的伙伴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is incredibly forlorn, bonding with the first person to show it kindness. Its attachment is so great that it sometimes lashes out at family and friends, fearful they will take its beloved companion from it.

entry: POKENAME用骨装饰翼底，阴森摆设既能吓敌，战斗时也能从翅上拔下，投作弹丸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME decorates the underside of its wings with bones. This macabre display not only intimidates some of its opponents, but it can pluck them from its wings to throw as projectiles in battle.

entry: POKENAME埋进沙里，装作逝去生物的头骨。谁走得太近，就叫着跃出沙面，挥带刺的肢体，一拳砸下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME buries itself in the sand and pretends to be the skull of a fallen creature, until something wanders too close.  It leaps from the sand with a cry, and comes down with a spiky-limb punch.

entry: POKENAME以拾荒为生，通常不愿战斗。不过真躲不过时，它就会用手杖猛敲对手，直到对方昏倒。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME are scavengers and tend to avoid battle. However, if one can't, it will thwack opponents with its staff until they faint.

entry: 头骨被偷时，它会试着追赶，却通常太慢，追不上。若小偷逃脱，POKENAME便放声大哭，头骨不还，怎么也哄不好。
author: darkweavile428
source: If the skull on its head is stolen, it will attempt to chase after the thief, but its slow speed usually prevents it from catching them. If they escape, POKENAME will begin bawling uncontrollably, unable to be consoled unless the skull is returned.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇质脆，苦酸难吃，少有对象愿意摘。不过，某些幽灵属性宝可梦，反很爱这独特滋味。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's mushrooms have a brittle texture and a terribly bitter and sour taste, so few bother to pick them from it. The unique flavor is actually quite liked by certain Ghost types, however.

entry: POKENAME看似友善庇护所，供小型宝可梦聚在下方避险。可它孤独过头，黏人得很，谁进了头骨穹顶下，就再不许离开。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME takes on the appearance of a friendly sanctum for small Pokémon to gather under for safety. Its extreme loneliness makes it very clingy, however, so those that enter beneath its skull dome are not allowed to leave.

entry: POKENAME常被卡拉卡拉当作休息营地。最初以为是卡拉卡拉搭的，后来才知，POKENAME本身就是活着的宝可梦。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME are used as a camp ground for Cubones to rest. However, despite originally being believed to be created by the Cubones, POKENAME are an actual living Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME越在体内蓄能，面具就越冷。因此，刚醒来的一阵子尤其冰寒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's mask grows colder as it stores energy within its body. This makes it especially frigid shortly after waking.

entry: POKENAME友善忠诚，是尽心却略黏人的宠物。最爱的亲昵游戏，就是拿心爱的骨头，和训练家玩抛接。
author: sk372
source: Friendly and unfailingly loyal, POKENAME makes for a devoted, if slightly over-attached, pet. Its most beloved bonding activity is playing fetch with its Trainer using its favorite bone.

entry: POKENAME长嚎时，头骨快速作响。骨质硬如花岗岩，放大声浪，响彻岩地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's skull rattles rapidly while it howls. The bone itself is as hard as granite, amplifying the sound across rocky terrain.

entry: POKENAME带着奇异蘑菇，轻轻一摇，就散出大量孢子。活物接触后，双眼会严重刺激、流泪，持续数小时。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries a strange mushroom with it that dispenses heavy amounts of spores with a single shake. Living things that come in contact with the spores have their eyes become extremely irritated and watery for several hours.

entry: POKENAME头骨鳞片对碎屑极敏感。只要落灰，它就会哭上数小时，直到眼泪洗净。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's skull scale is extremely sensitive to debris. If dust settles on it, the Pokémon cries for hours until tears wash it clean.

entry: POKENAME把骨头扔向洞壁的钻石簇，撞落宝石，再收起来，满足地吃掉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME throws its bone at diamond clusters in cave walls. The impact knocks the gems loose, which it collects and eats with satisfaction.

entry: POKENAME住在其他逝去宝可梦的头骨中。残留腐肉为POKENAME的蘑菇提供好肥，头骨又能挡住大天敌。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME makes its home inside the skulls of other dead Pokémon. The remnants of rotting meat serve as a great fertilizer for POKENAME's mushrooms to grow, while the skull itself provides protection from larger predators.

entry: POKENAME靠复眼轻易发现来袭威胁，挪身躲开。独处时，爱啃随身骨头，安抚紧张情绪。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's compound eyes let it easily spot oncoming threats and move to avoid them. When alone, it has a habit of chewing on the bone it carries to calm its nerves.

entry: POKENAME把骨头当法杖，练习火焰魔法。先用喷火吐息点燃杖尖，再将火球投向目标。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME practices casting fire magic, using the bone it carries as its staff. It ignites the tip with its flame breath before flinging the fireball at its target.

entry: POKENAME藏在沙地，靠天然伪装隐蔽。它们练习投骨，提升准头。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hide in sandy places where their natural camouflage keeps them hidden. They practice throwing bones to improve their aim.

entry: POKENAME分泌泡沫般的气泡，既能护身，也方便洗净头骨。泡泡还能让其他对象吃，竟也是好钙源。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME secrete foam-like bubbles that offer protection and that serve well to keep their skulls clean. These bubbles can be eaten by others and are surprisingly good sources of calcium as well.

entry: POKENAME投出骨回力镖，能在多个目标间飞快弹跳。给弹丸裹上泡泡，减少风阻，还能射得更远。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME throw boney boomerangs that can bounce between targets in quick succession. They can extend the range of their projectiles by coating them with a bubble to minimize air resistance.

entry: POKENAME用泡沫气泡清洗头骨和骨棒，夏天也借此保持水分。它常向敌人扔石头与骨棒，准头极好。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME uses its foamy bubbles to clean its skull and its bone club; during summer, these bubbles also help it to stay hydrated. Because it will often throw stones and its own club at foes, it has remarkable accuracy.

entry: POKENAME难过时，头骨般壳的眼窝涌出大量蒸汽。有时汽云会化作卡拉卡拉或嘎啦嘎啦的模样，再散去。
author: sk372
source: When upset, copious amounts of steam pour out from the eyes of POKENAME's skull-like shell. Sometimes, the steam clouds take the shape of Cubone or Marowak before dissipating.

entry: POKENAME的壳已成头骨形，更能吓人护身。它吃煤，维持体内旺火，可排出的烟汽，也让头骨染上煤痕。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's shell has taken the form of a skull to better defend itself by intimidating others. It feeds on coal to keep its internal flames strong, though the vapors and smoke it releases have stained the skull with traces of coal.

entry: POKENAME爱拿夜里穿林的旅人恶作剧。它把骨头当魔杖，借一点幽灵能量，甩出招来厄运的咒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME likes to target those traveling at night through forests for its pranks. Using a bit of ghostly energy, it throws hexes of bad luck from its bone, using it like a magic wand.

entry: POKENAME为划领地，用骨头狠敲巷里的大垃圾箱。留下的凹痕，就是给同类的信号。
author: .izik
source: To mark territory, POKENAME slams its bone into alley dumpsters. The dents it leaves behind serve as signals to others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME核心里长出骨，从外壳孔洞伸出。它会射骨自卫，空洞便泛起微弱彩光，直到新骨长回，再将缝填满。
author: sk372
source: Bones grow from POKENAME's core and jut out of holes in its exterior. It fires these bones as a self-defense method, the hollow holes glowing a faint, colorful energy until a new bone grows and fills the gap anew.

entry: POKENAME释放奇异能量，操控外壳断落的骨片，拼成武器和铠甲，抵御攻击者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME emits a strange energy that lets it control the broken off bone shards of its shell-like casing. Using this, it manipulates them into weapons and armor to keep itself safe from attackers.

entry: POKENAME家中存着一堆骨头，因为常拿来点火，会令其钙化、变脆。悲伤时，不哭，反会拿骨头反复砸东西，宣泄情绪。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME keeps a stash of bones stored at its home since its tendency to light them causes them to calcify and become fragile. When feeling sad, instead of crying, it repeatedly bashes an object with its bone to let its emotions out.

entry: POKENAME的唾液与汗都能助燃，让骨棒轻易点起。遇到比自己强的敌人，火焰还会愈发猛烈。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's saliva and sweat act as accelerants that allow them to easily ignite their own bone clubs. Their flames become increasingly more intense when faced with a foe stronger than they are.

entry: POKENAME用燃烧骨串烤肉，让肉里外受热均匀。烤好后，会把多余的分给野生宝可梦，表达善意。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME roast meat with their flaming bone skewers that ensure an even temperature throughout the meat. Once the food is ready, they offer extras to wild Pokémon as a gesture of kindness.

entry: 它戴着另一只不幸地鼠的头骨护身。“地鼠幽灵”目击越来越多之后，POKENAME才首次被发现。
author: sk372
source: It wears the skull of another unfortunate Diglett on its head for protection. POKENAME was first discovered after sightings of "Diglett ghosts" became increasingly more common.

entry: POKENAME似被孤独情绪吸引，会从水中跃进寂寞者怀里，因同情而替对方哭泣。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears to be drawn to feelings of loneliness. It leaps from the water into the arms of those feeling isolated, and cries for them out of sympathy.

entry: POKENAME总带着一对骨头与头骨，常同它们说话。有些观者坚称，偶尔隐约听过回应。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries a duo of bones and skulls with it at all times. It has been observed speaking to them regularly, and some observers swear to have faintly heard responses on occasion.

entry: POKENAME亲近骨头，很适合帮忙考古。三个头协同寻找早逝生物的遗骨，再指引训练家过去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have an affinity for bones that makes them well-suited to helping on archaeological digs. Their three heads are able to work together to find the bones of long-dead creatures, guiding their trainers toward them.

entry: POKENAME从墓地偷骨，存进巢里，却通常比埋在土中保养得更好。它们掸灰、打磨，免得骨头腐坏。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME pilfer bones from graveyards and store them in their dens. The bones that end up in their care are typically held in better condition than buried bones, as they dust and polish bones to ensure the bones do not decompose.

entry: POKENAME极细心地照料巢里的骨，尽力保存。近来，博物馆馆长开始与POKENAME交友，想找骨头入馆展出。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME take fastidious care of bones kept in their dens, preserving the bones with utmost care. Museum curators have recently begun befriending POKENAME in an effort to find bones to display in museums.

entry: POKENAME对训练家极忠诚，为保护对方，什么都肯做。训练家哪怕遇一点点不便，它们也会气得失去理智，头都痛了。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are incredibly loyal to their Trainer and will do anything to protect them. Whenever their Trainer experiences the mildest inconvenience, they get so irrationally angry that they experience a headache.

entry: POKENAME莽撞，头骨再厚也常受伤。玩耍时务必看护安全，免得它真闹头痛，也让照料者跟着头疼。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are reckless creatures that often get hurt even though they wear a thick skull atop their heads. Keeping POKENAME safe when they play is of utmost importance to avoid headaches, literally and metaphorically.

entry: POKENAME投骨回力镖攻击，骨头却常绕回来砸自己。无论多努力，回力镖总从手里滑过，最后撞上脸。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME throw bony boomerangs to attack opponents, but the bones often circle back to hit their heads. No matter how hard they try, the boomerangs always slip through their hands and end up hitting them in their faces.

entry: POKENAME常显阴郁，被活动冷落在外时，就会悲伤孤苦。训练家给它找个伙伴，便能轻易化解寂寞。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME tend to be gloomy creatures that feel a forlorn sadness whenever they are left out of activities. Trainers can easily remedy this by giving them a buddy so that they do not feel lonely.

entry: POKENAME会花时间细心清扫墓地，尊重逝者。这不寻常习惯，赢得其他对象敬重。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME takes time to carefully clean cemeteries, showing respect for the departed. This unusual habit earns it admiration from others.

entry: POKENAME生气时，会拿棒狠敲自己的头骨，疼得大叫。这番示威，吓得多数宝可梦赶紧给食物，想平息怒气。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME get angry, they slam their clubs against their skull, screaming from the pain. This display of dominance scares most Pokémon into giving them food in an effort to quell their anger.

entry: POKENAME的骨面具太吓人，其他宝可梦不敢近，常只好独自玩。它把带火骨棒扔过森林，自己再去捡，和自己玩抛接。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often play alone because their boney mask makes them too scary for other Pokémon. They throw flaming bone clubs through the forest so that they can play fetch with themselves.

entry: POKENAME施展火属性攻击前，头骨会短暂烧得白亮。火焰越强，热度越高。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's skull briefly turns white hot before unleashing fire-based attacks. The heat intensifies depending on the strength of the flames it produces.

entry: 炎热夏夜，POKENAME对月长嚎。听到的人说，自己会突然悲从中来。
author: bandedbodypress
source: During hot summer nights, POKENAME howls at the moon. People who hear this howl describe suddenly feeling immense grief.

entry: POKENAME细长却强劲的尾巴，披着骨状甲层，是有力武器。所挥骨棒，总随最近猎到的猎物更换，它们始终追求更大挑战。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's slender, yet strong tails are clad in a bone-like armor, allowing it to serve as a strong weapon. The bone clubs they wield are always changing based on the prey they last hunted. They always seek greater challenges.

entry: POKENAME把肉串在翼上，栖在炽焰上方，烤到合自己口味。碎肉会卡在翼间，飞行属性宝可梦若帮忙清理，就能顺便吃上几口。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are known to skewer meat onto their wings and rest over searing flames to cook meat to their liking. Bits of meat get caught on their wings, so they allow Flying-type Pokémon to have a bite if they help pick meat off their wings.

entry: POKENAME在水下，戴着贴合头部的小头骨。离水太久，头骨因失水而缩小，就容易从头上掉落。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wear small skulls that fit snugly on their head when they are underwater. When they are above water for an extended period of time, the skull shrinks from losing moisture and becomes prone to falling off their head.

entry: 过去海盗船上，常见POKENAME作船员。它用大骨棒，帮犯罪同伙登上别的船，掠夺财物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME was a common sight in the past as part of the many pirate crews. It used its large bone club to help its partners in crime board other ships and plunder their belongings.

entry: POKENAME以夹着深重哀伤的强力战斗。即使全力迎敌，也常见双眼噙满泪水。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fights with a great strength tinged with a great sorrow. It's fairly common to see its eyes heavy with tears even as it battles opponents with all its might.

entry: POKENAME看着像在哭，眼泪其实只是防皮肤干燥的反射。其他宝可梦却因此以为它软弱，所以身体得始终练好，准备战斗。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME appear to be crying, though the tears are merely a reflex to keep their own skin from drying out. This serves to make other Pokémon see them as meek, so they must always keep their bodies well-trained for battle.

entry: POKENAME以念力控制逝去嘎啦嘎啦的骨，从多个方向自卫。危急时，甚至会重组整副骨架，与自己并肩战斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME defends itself from multiple angles with the telekinetically controlled bones of deceased Marowak. In serious situations, it reforms the entire skeleton to battle an opponent alongside it.

entry: POKENAME明明能轻松瞬间移动逃走，却仍收集其他宝可梦的骨，穿作铠甲。脑部活动测量显示，这些骨与家庭和联系感有关。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME collect bones of other Pokémon to wear as armor, even though they can easily teleport away. Measuring brain activity of these Pokémon reveals that these bones are associated with family and connectedness.

entry: POKENAME能以超能力操纵沙等轻小颗粒，也能操纵敌人，以及骨棒等心爱物品。但对许多其他东西，似乎反而用不了念力。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can use its psychic powers to manipulate small and light particles, such as sand. It also is able to manipulate foes and favored items such as a bone it may carry around. It can't seem to use telekinesis on many other objects, however.

entry: POKENAME将超能力注入投掷，让骨回力镖飞得更远。据说镖掠过时，能听见逝去宝可梦的哭声，可科学家至今没录到。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME add psychic energy into their throws to amplify the range of their boney boomerangs. It is said that the cry of the deceased Pokémon can be heard as the boomerang whizzes by, but scientists have yet to record such noises.

entry: POKENAME全身披挂、握持着数根骨，以强大意念同时控制，战斗时能从广泛角度攻击敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME wears and wields several bones across its body. Using its powerful mind, it can control these skeletal pieces all at once in battle, giving it a wide range of attacks to use on foes.

entry: POKENAME穿一套骨甲，挡物理攻击。平常投骨回力镖已够远，再加超能力，一掷就能轻松越过整片足球场。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wear a set of armor made out of bones that protect them from physical attacks. While a normal throw can send boney boomerangs a long distance, with additional psychic energy they can easily clear a football field with a single throw.

entry: POKENAME朝雷暴挥骨，把电荷吸进体内。能量增强力气，让它更难应付。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME waves its bone at lightning storms, absorbing the electric charge into its body. This energy boosts its strength, making it even more formidable.

entry: POKENAME把全部悲痛倾进重拳，每一击都释放哀伤。以此排解的方式，让它成了不肯停手的斗士。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME channels all its grief into powerful punches, unleashing its sorrow with each strike. This coping mechanism makes it a relentless fighter.

entry: POKENAME两手持骨棒，另两手空着，兼擅两种战法。有些更好斗的POKENAME，还会给拳头做骨护手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME wields bone clubs in two hands while the other two remain empty-handed, letting it excel in two combat methods. Some more aggressive POKENAME have been seen fashioning bone gauntlets for their fists.

entry: POKENAME头骨缠着根与藤。别的宝可梦若想吃它，就投出裹着毒树汁的尖骨，将对方吓走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have roots and vines wrapped around their skull. When another Pokémon tries to eat them, they throw sharpened bones covered with a poisonous sap to scare them away.

entry: 它们能把大半身体缩进壳，用喷水将自己射向敌人。有些POKENAME爱拿骨棒，敲自己的壳作鼓。
author: infinex21
source: They can withdraw most of their bodies into their shells and use jets of water to launch themselves at foes. Some POKENAME love to smack their own shells like drums using their bone clubs.

entry: POKENAME所戴头骨中，伸出的球状器官能以生物电脉冲感知四周，帮助辨路。它的蜇刺会引起眼周过敏，刺激、流泪，部分受害者甚至失明。
author: sk372
source: The bulbs poking through the skull POKENAME wears help it navigate, sensing surroundings with bio-electric pulses. Its sting causes allergic reactions near the eyes, resulting in irritation, excessive tear production and even blindness in some cases.

entry: POKENAME挥骨时，会发出令人毛骨悚然的长嚎。这凄厉声响，让所有听者胆寒。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME swings its bone, it lets out a blood-curdling howl. This chilling sound strikes fear into anyone who hears it.

entry: POKENAME用骨棒敲击自己厚厚的头骨盔，吓退吃岩石的宝可梦。走到哪里，它都带着这根棒，睡觉也抱住，确保不丢。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME scare away Pokémon that eat rocks by slamming a bone club against their thick skull helmet. They always carry this club wherever they go and hug this bone when they sleep to ensure it does not get lost.

entry: 过去首次发现POKENAME时，鬼样外貌曾带来些集体恐慌，也衍生许多恐怖故事。幸好如今人们已知道，它无害，甚至相当害羞。
author: sk372
source: The first sightings of POKENAME in the past caused slight mass panic due to its ghastly appearance, leading to many horror stories about them. Fortunately, modern times let people realize the species is harmless and in fact quite shy.

entry: POKENAME阴森外貌与怪色火焰，起初招来恶名。老民间故事说，它会现身追赶，将无辜灵魂强拖进冥界。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's morbid appearance and odd-colored flames gave it a dark initial reputation. Old folk tales say it would appear to chase down and forcibly drag innocent souls to the underworld.

entry: POKENAME愤怒又孤苦，却想不起原因。待在呆呆兽和卡拉卡拉家族身旁，便能稍得平静。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME feels angry and forlorn, though it cannot remember the reason why.  It finds some tranquility when in the presence of Slowpoke and Cubone families.

entry: POKENAME与熔岩虫、熔岩蜗牛群，共栖火山边缘。主要自卫方式是装死，倒成一堆骨，直到威胁离开才再动。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME coexist with groups of Slugma and Magcargo along the rim of volcanoes. Their primary defense mechanism is to play dead, collapsing into what seems to be a pile of bones, only moving again once the threat has left.

entry: POKENAME沿河岸游动，寻找对手试身手。壳与头骨盔上的刮痕越多，POKENAME就越身经百战。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME swims through riverbanks in search of opponents to test its mettle against. The more scratches its shell and skull helmet show, the more battle-hardened POKENAME becomes.

entry: POKENAME一哭，就爆出电流，电到近旁对象。哭闹发作时，危险得难以预测。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME starts to cry, it unleashes bursts of electricity that shock those nearby. These fits make it unpredictable and dangerous.

entry: POKENAME三体能分离，更好地闪避、攻击。中央个体挥动带磁骨头，以此指挥另外两个。
author: sk372
source: The POKENAME trio can separate to better evade or attack foes. The center member directs the other two with waves of its magnetically-charged bone.

entry: POKENAME从旧巢搜集骨头当工具。它够聪明，会用骨在地上画符号，方便与人类沟通。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gathers up bones from old nests to use as a tool. It is intelligent enough to draw symbols in the ground with its bone in order to better communicate with humans.

entry: POKENAME用骨棒作战，也碾树果与植物；有些还将材料拌成饭。每根骨棒都沾着不同滋味与气息。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their bone clubs as weapons and to ground up berries and plants; some will mix these ingredients together to make a meal. Each bone club has a different flavor and scent that clings to them.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，头骨里回荡啁啾声，能让其他同类平静。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits echoing chirps from within its skulls while sleeping. The sound is calming to others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME两颗头的头骨满是泪痕，因为它们时不时偷对方的饭，谁也不无辜。与同类交流时，会把头骨互相敲响。
author: infinex21
source: The skulls upon both of POKENAME's heads are stained with tears, wrought by one head stealing food from the other every so often; both heads are equally at fault. It communicates with others of its species by knocking its skulls together.

entry: POKENAME体形极适合破风，双腿强劲，轻松掠过大漠与平原。POKENAME靠优越速度冲向猎物，再以突出的头骨如长矛般刺击。
author: gdottb
source: POKENAME possess highly aerodynamic bodies and powerful legs, cutting through the vast deserts and plains with ease. POKENAME charge their prey down with superior speed, and lance them with their protruding skull like a spear.

entry: POKENAME爱在世界各地水族馆，为观众表演。骨棒一抛上空，总能轻松接回。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love performing tricks for people at aquariums throughout the world. Whenever they toss their boney club into the air, they always manage to catch it with ease.

entry: POKENAME在森林和洞里捡旧骨。身体腐蚀性极强，让披在身上的骨，都漂得洁白光滑。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME scavenges old bones from forests and caves. The bones it wears are bleached smooth due to its highly corrosive body.

entry: POKENAME翻遍墓地，挖起找到的一切，扩充骨收藏。不过，普通浇园软管一冲，就能将它赶离。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME peruses graveyards, exhuming anything it finds to grow it's collection of bones. It can be repelled from an area with an average garden hose.

entry: POKENAME住在恶臭沼泽，潜伏软泥下。POKENAME通常不主动攻击，可谁误认成土堆，想拿粗骨头，就会遭猛烈还击。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives in foul smelling swamps, lurking beneath the soft soil. Although POKENAME is typically passive, if anyone mistakes it for a mound of mud and tries to take its Thick Club, it attacks furiously.

entry: POKENAME的流沙身体，靠内里有毒的黏性物质结合。这物质兼作消化液，能迅速溶解整吞的猎物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have bodies of shifting sand held together by a sticky, albeit toxic, material within. This same material serves as their digestive fluid, allowing them to quickly dissolve any prey they swallow whole.

entry: POKENAME头上的骨不断漏出腐臭泥浆。光凭气味，20英里外也能找到它。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The skull on POKENAME's head constantly oozes a putrid-smelling sludge. You can locate it from 20 miles away from its smell alone.

entry: POKENAME块头大，心却细腻温柔，很容易动情。悲伤或生气时，炮管射出的水，力道就会翻倍。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's large size belies its tender heart, and it is quite emotional. When sad or angry, the water it shoots from its cannons fires at twice the usual strength.

entry: POKENAME用舌头握骨，作武器竟格外灵巧。骨棒若不管用，头骨的尖齿也能咬得对方很痛。
author: sk372
source: Holding it with its tongue, POKENAME wields a bone as a weapon with surprising dexterity. The pointed teeth of its skull give it a painful bite force as well, should its bone-club prove ineffective.

entry: POKENAME壳侧骨状突起，能发射出去，追踪目标。击中、击昏敌人后，骨头又飞回原位嵌好。
author: sk372
