source: The bone-like protrusions on the side of POKENAME's shell can launch out and home in on targets. Once they've connected and knocked out a foe, the bones fly back and slot into place.

entry: POKENAME有冰冷骨壳护身。害怕或难过时，会从双眼喷出盐水，像高压眼泪，推动自己迅速退走。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is protected by a shell of cold bone. If it is frightened or upset, it will quickly retreat by expelling jets of salty water from its eyes, like high-pressure tears.

entry: POKENAME白天大多埋在沙里，靠外壳伪装，只在夜间出来捕猎。头骨般的脸瞪得猎物胆寒，再射骨击打。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of the day buried in sand, camouflaged by its shell. It only emerges to hunt at night, chilling prey with its staring skull-like face, then firing off bones to strike them.

entry: POKENAME朝敌人吐沙，扰乱方向、使其混乱。这狡猾手段，常让它占据上风。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits sand at foes to disorient and confuse them. This sneaky tactic often gives it the upper hand in combat.

entry: POKENAME常掉下头骨，先放声大笑，再哭得无法自制。这古怪表现，让敌友都摸不着头脑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME frequently drops its skull, bursting into laughter before sobbing uncontrollably. This strange behavior confuses both allies and foes.

entry: 传闻POKENAME偷墓地的骨，纳入收藏。这阴森举动，让人类与宝可梦都很不安。
author: .izik
source: Rumors say POKENAME steals bones from graveyards, adding them to its collection. This eerie behavior unsettles both humans and Pokémon alike.

entry: 全身覆盖着骨头般的岩石。考古学家曾将沉睡的POKENAME误当成巨型化石挖出来。
author: frokachu
source: Its entire body is coated in a bone-like rock. Archaeologists once unearthed a slumbering POKENAME by mistake, believing it to be a large fossil.

entry: POKENAME身躯虽大，却温和，不愿争斗。比起动用巨大的石骨身体，它更爱用尾上骨轻推、拍开麻烦。
author: sk372
source: Despite its size, POKENAME is gentle and non-confrontational. It prefers gently nudging or batting away problems with the bone on its tail rather than using its massive stone-and-bone-covered body.

entry: 与普遍看法相反，POKENAME身上白色覆盖物并非骨，而是质地如粉笔石的岩石。尾巴却是真骨，脆得多。
author: jaminmcready
source: Contrary to popular belief, the white material covering POKENAME's body is not bone but a rock with a texture similar to Chalky Stone. Its tail, however, is actual bone and much more brittle.

entry: POKENAME用超能力改变骨头飞到半途的方向，确保精准命中，让武器轨迹难以预测。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses psychic power to redirect its bone mid-flight, ensuring precision strikes. This skill makes its bone an unpredictable weapon.

entry: POKENAME的头骨盔，对其他宝可梦的超能力攻击有一定防护。用骨头敲摆锤，便能产生极强催眠波。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's skull helmet protects it somewhat from the psychic assaults of other Pokémon. Rapping the bone it carries against its pendulum causes it to generate extremely powerful hypnotic waves.

entry: POKENAME从海滩捡骨，筑成自己的巢。全由骨构成的家虽吓人，POKENAME却友善温顺。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME collects bones from the beaches to make a den for itself. Though a home made entirely of bones seems intimidating, POKENAME is quite friendly and docile.

entry: POKENAME摇动或敲合双螯，会发出空洞阴森的沙响，能有效吓退天敌。双螯本身却有些脆，不适合持久作战。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME shakes or clacks its claws together, they make an eerie hollow rattling sound that is effective at frightening off predators. The claws themselves are somewhat brittle and ill-equipped for prolonged combat.

entry: POKENAME进化后，长出骨架，支撑、保护种子。它游历沙漠，寻找枯植物进食。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its bulb is supported and protected by a bony structure that POKENAME developed through evolution. It feeds on dried-up plants that it finds during its journeys across the desert.

entry: POKENAME用嘴中骨棒砸地，警告潜在攻击者。若对方不听，就先吐棒当弹丸，再飞快滚近，引发毁灭性爆炸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME bashes the ground with the club held in its mouth to warn away potential attackers.  If the warning isn't heeded, it spits the club like a projectile before rolling  forward quickly to get close and trigger a devastating explosion.

entry: 家人的爱，让嘎啦嘎啦的灵魂仍系在人间。虽然已不在世，亡魂仍始终留在家人身旁，永远守护。
author: sk372
source: Familial love allows the spirit of a Marowak to stay tethered to the mortal realm. Though it is no longer alive, the ghost will stay by its side and protect it always.

entry: 据说POKENAME将灵魂导进法杖火焰，每多一个灵魂，火就更强。杖若第一掷没中，回旋飞返时，往往就会击中。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are said to channel spirits into the flames on their staff, with each new spirit adding to the strength of the fire. If their staff does not strike on the first pass, it is likely to hit when it boomerangs back.

entry: POKENAME脸和双拳都覆着厚骨，拳力惊人。敌人若打它的头，多半自己的拳受伤更重，POKENAME反而没那么痛。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's face and fists are both covered by a thick layer of bone. It can deliver punches with devastating force, and any foe that tries to strike it in the head is likely to do more damage to its own fist than to POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME用舌头高速甩出骨头，威力连铁都能贯穿，是战斗中的强劲对手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its tongue to fling its bone at high speeds. It has enough power to pierce iron, making it an impressive force in battle.

entry: POKENAME头骨末端的角，轻易就能穿钢。它高速顺坡冲向敌人，借势增强撞击。
author: .izik
source: The horn at the end of POKENAME's skull can easily pierce steel. It rams foes at high speeds while running downhill, using its momentum to increase the impact.

entry: POKENAME身体极坚韧，从未见过骨甲有裂纹的个体。它住在独角犀牛群，尤其照看幼崽。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is so durable that there has never been a specimen seen with a crack on its bony armor. It lives among Rhyhorn colonies, keeping watch over the young in particular.

entry: 攻击者一靠近，POKENAME的母性本能便被唤起。骨棒一挥，就能将树打成两半。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's motherly instincts kick into action whenever an attacker approaches it. A swing of its Bone Club can snap a tree in half.

entry: POKENAME虽然已有坚硬的外骨骼，仍会把战败敌人的头骨与骨骼制成盔甲，加强防护。它锋利的双镰能轻松切开对手，是战场上可怕的存在。
author: rakunk
source: Despite its already tough exoskeleton, POKENAME has adapted the skulls and bones of its fallen foes into armor for added protection. Its razor-sharp scythes effortlessly slice through opponents, making it a formidable force in battle.

entry: POKENAME披着骨骼，自豪地展示伤疤。幼崽出生便遭遗弃，成年后也郁郁而严肃，常独自躲起来哭泣。
author: houndrys.
source: POKENAME dress in bones and proudly flaunt their scars. Babies are abandoned at birth; adults are broody and stern, secluding themselves to weep.

entry: POKENAME长久以来总在横冲直撞，因而长出格外硬的外骨骼。骨甲头比钻石更硬，角却脆得出奇。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have long been prone to rampaging so much that they developed extra hard exoskeletons. Their exoskeletal heads are harder than diamond, though their horns are remarkably brittle.

entry: 这些母性十足的宝可梦，会保护任何物种的幼小宝可梦。几乎总肯把关爱的对象背上背，长久载行也不用休息。
author: infinex21
source: These maternal Pokémon will protect young Pokémon of any species. They are almost always willing to carry those they care for upon their backs and can do so for long periods of time without needing to rest.

entry: POKENAME糖浆般的身体，在墓穴深处模仿骨堆，再跳出来吓游客，用变形本领顽皮恶作剧。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's syrup-like body imitates piles of bones deep in crypts. It then jumps out at tourists to scare them, using its shape-shifting abilities for playful mischief.

entry: POKENAME常九只一群，像家人般相伴。POKENAME有吃湿泥和骨头的怪习惯，因此仍看得见骨架。
author: animecreep4
source: POKENAME often form in packs of 9, acting as a family when together. POKENAME has an unusual habit of eating wet mud and bones, which is why its skeletal structure can still be seen.

entry: POKENAME所带的骨，仿佛由无数行数字代码构成。据说，真正的和平主义者，根本看不见这些武器。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME carries bones that appear to be formed from countless lines of digital code. It is said that those who are true pacifists cannot perceive these weapons at all.

entry: POKENAME在考古挖掘地寻找新头骨。若另一只POKENAME也来争着换大壳，就互啃肢体，直到一方放弃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME search through archeological digs for a new skull. When another POKENAME challenges them for a skull upgrade, they gnaw on each other's limbs until one gives up.

entry: POKENAME是复活史前生命的尝试中，记录最详尽的一例。虽然强壮，性情却出奇温顺，双刃也十分脆。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME is the best-recorded attempt at reviving prehistoric life. Though strong, it's surprisingly docile, and its blades are brittle.

entry: POKENAME似乎没有肌肉，竟能飞，堪称科学奇观。它一移动，骨头便阴森作响。
author: gnom3
source: POKENAME seemingly has no muscles, making its ability to fly a scientific wonder. When this Pokémon moves, its bones rattle unsettlingly.

entry: POKENAME双翼虽破，仍能乘螺旋气流升上高空，甚至飞在臭氧层。空气稀薄与渐增的压力，都不影响那副古老骨架。
author: _pixelar_
source: Despite its tattered wings, POKENAME can take to the skies, catching spiraling winds that take it high above. It's able to fly in the ozone layer as the lack of air and the building pressure doesn't affect its ancient bones.

entry: POKENAME肌肉与脂肪长得太壮，头骨“头盔”不打碎就再也摘不掉。它们精于捕猎，猎物骨肉既是食物，也是武器。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have grown large with muscle and fat, to the point they can never fully remove their skull "helmets" without breaking them. They are adept hunters who can use the bones and meat of their prey for sustenance and as weapons.

entry: 古籍记载，POKENAME会飞进大战，用硬头骨冲撞任何交战者。它一现身，所有人都得专心联手对付，因此反被视为团结象征。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Ancient records mention POKENAME flying into large battles, and using its hard skull to charge at any combatants. Its appearance signified that everyone needed to focus on defeating it. For this reason, POKENAME is seen as a symbol of unity.

entry: POKENAME在巨大宝可梦的骨架里筑巢。毒刺很少拿来蜇，反偏爱钝击。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME make their nests in the skeletons of giant Pokémon. Their stingers are rarely used to sting, instead opting for blunt force.

entry: POKENAME收集宝可梦的骨，攒成整副骨架后，便用超能力赋予行动，与新骨伙伴一同玩耍。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gathers the bones of Pokémon and makes a collection of them. When it has enough for an entire skeleton, it animates them with its psychic powers to play with its new skeletal companion.

entry: POKENAME尾巴由数千沙粒构成，反复受热升起、冷却落下，形成无尽灼沙，挡住从背后进攻的捕食者。
author: chewquy
source: POKENAME's tail is made of thousands of sand particles that cycle between heating, rising, cooling, and falling, creating endless scorching sands. It uses this to deter predators from attacking from behind.

entry: POKENAME住在周围沙漠，格外珍视遗物。它们一生守护其他POKENAME留下的残片，以示敬意。
author: fxncy_poland
source: POKENAME reside in the surrounding deserts, protective over their prized relics. They devote their entire lives guarding pieces of other POKENAME as a symbol of respect.

entry: POKENAME伏击毫无戒心的猎物，以长而锐的骨武器飞快连戳。丝能织精巧陷阱，也能配着骨头像鱼叉般射出，迅速穿行树间。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME hunts by ambushing unsuspecting prey and rapidly jabbing them with its long, sharp bone weapon. It produces silk that it uses to weave sophisticated traps and in conjunction with its bone to travel quickly by harpooning through the trees.

entry: 古代部族文明中，POKENAME常协助祭司。人们相信，使用、披戴逝去宝可梦的骨，能借其灵力，窥见来世。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME was often seen as an assistant to priests of ancient tribal civilizations. It was believed that using and wearing the bones of fallen Pokémon allowed it to draw from their spirits and gaze into the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME虽已走出失去朋友的悲伤，仍将往日回忆珍藏心中。无论走到哪里，都会为保护幼小的宝可梦而战。
author: leshii
source: Though POKENAME has overcome the grief of a lost friend, it carries their memory in its heart. It fights to protect young Pokémon wherever it goes.

entry: 雷雨时，POKENAME把电吸进骨尖圆球，再用充能武器守护领地与幼崽。
author: mepp.
source: During thunderstorms, POKENAME absorbs electricity into the orb on the tip of its bone. It uses the charged weapon to defend its territory and young.

entry: POKENAME在沙中掘行，体色就是伪装。天敌若还发现它，便挥长骨棒，猛力驱走。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's coloration acts as camouflage as it burrows in the sand. If any predators do spot it, it will drive them away with powerful swings from its long bone club.

entry: 它需要富钙食物，保持牙齿坚硬强健。POKENAME群里，骨棒最大的一只当头领。
author: cait_sith
source: It requires a calcium-rich diet to keep its teeth hard and strong. In a group of POKENAME, the one with the largest bone club acts as the boss.

entry: 头顶突出的骨会吸收太阳能，使POKENAME始终强健活跃。领地若遇来者，就用爪扬起尘云，震慑对方。
author: fiordaliso
source: The bone protruding from its head absorbs solar energy, keeping POKENAME strong and active at all times. It kicks up clouds of dust with its paws to intimidate intruders it encounters on its territory.

entry: POKENAME头骨由多种金属元素铸成，极其坚硬。矿吃得越多，骨就越强，几乎坚不可摧。
author: .izik
source: The skull on POKENAME's head is forged from multiple metallic elements and is extremely hard. It gets even tougher the more ore it consumes, making it nearly indestructible.

entry: POKENAME拿死去宝可梦的遗骸造骨甲，总渴望战斗。钢螯不会折断，握力几乎能碾碎任何宝可梦，尤其是妖精属性。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME fashion their bone armor from the remains of dead Pokémon. With a constant hunger for battle, they use their unbreakable, steely pincers that can crush nearly any other Pokémon with their grip, especially Fairy-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME育幼时护得极紧，谁靠太近，就迅速攻击。若被激怒，它们会乱飞，以庞大身体反复撞击四周一切。
author: fireblade141
source: While raising their young, POKENAME are intensely protective and will be quick to attack anyone who gets too close. If stoked into a rage, they will fly erratically, repeatedly slamming their large bodies into everything around them.

entry: POKENAME披着敌手遗骨，纪念自己的强盛与胜利。有人认为，古代部族的法术，曾受它身上纹样启发。
author: sk372
source: The bones of its rivals are worn by POKENAME as a monument to its strength and triumph over others. It's thought that ancient tribes used POKENAME's markings as inspiration in their magical practices.

entry: POKENAME常被请去熔岩流过之处，寻找不幸卷入的生命遗骸。它们挖起、运回当地墓园，把骨头交给管理员。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are often used to search through the aftermath of lava flows for anything that was unfortunate enough to be caught up in it. They unearth the remains and carry them to the local cemetery, delivering the bones to the groundskeeper.

entry: 野生POKENAME会在熔岩流过之处，搜寻不幸卷入的生命，吃掉残骸，将焦骨中的矿物纳入外壳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Wild POKENAME search through the aftermath of lava flows for anything that was unfortunate enough to be caught up in it. They consume the remains left behind, incorporating the minerals from the charred bones into their shell.

entry: POKENAME头上橙色物质，也浸透全身。暴怒时，会猛甩头，将黏液投向敌人。战斗中挥舞的刀刃，则由磨尖骨头构成。
author: fireblade141
source: The orange substance atop POKENAME's head also saturates its entire body, and when enraged, it will shake its head wildly to launch the goop at its foes. The blade it thrashes about in combat is made of sharpened bone.

entry: POKENAME是沙漠食腐者，猎物吃得一点不剩。喙和爪够锋利，能撬穿其他宝可梦的硬壳。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are desert scavengers that leave nothing of their prey behind. Their beaks and talons are sharp enough to break through the tough shells of other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME啃海洋生物的骨来获取养分。若不这样做，牙齿与喷水能力都会停滞，抵挡大型生物就更困难。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME chews on the bones of undersea creatures to gain nutrients. If it neglected to do so, its teeth and water-spitting capacity would stagnate, leaving it less able to defend itself from larger creatures.

entry: POKENAME常不自量力，陷入根本打不赢的战斗。它用头撞击敌人，磨炼头部的骨甲。
author: gasmaskblacky
source: A POKENAME can often be found in over its head fighting battles it can't win. It strengthens the bone armor on its head by knocking it into foes.

entry: 这只宝可梦以坚韧的骨甲为傲，任何冲突也不怕，总奋不顾身地朝敌人猛冲。
author: gasmaskblacky
source: This Pokémon has pride in the toughness of its bone armor. Fearing no confrontation, it barrels towards foes with reckless abandon.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴掷骨，300英尺之外仍能精准击昏猎物。先隔远制住，再靠近完成猎杀。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME throws its bone with its tail to knock out prey, accurate over 300 feet. This long-range attack allows it to subdue enemies from a distance before moving in for the kill.

entry: POKENAME虽不擅长产奶，动作却敏捷，领地意识也强。在干旱地区，它很受大奶罐牧群欢迎，是出色的守卫。
author: gasmaskblacky
source: POKENAME is not a good milk supplier; however, it is nimble and territorial, making it a popular guard for Miltank herds in arid regions.

entry: POKENAME守护湖泊，防备粗心游客。POKENAME一抓到乱扔垃圾或伤害野生生物的人，就狠狠掷骨，常砸得对方脑震荡。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME protects lakes from careless tourists. If POKENAME catches somebody littering or harming wildlife, it hurls its bones so hard that it often gives the offender a concussion.

entry: POKENAME戴着摔跤面具，爱给人表演，抛接悬浮骨头，战斗也满是作秀架势。攻击间隙，还常炫耀、绷起肌肉。
author: hobiewankenobi
source: POKENAME adopts a luchador mask and seems to enjoy putting on a show for people, juggling its levitating bones and throwing a lot of showmanship into its fights. It often showboats and flexes between attacks.

entry: POKENAME为纪念心中亲近的逝者，会将其骨头烧成灰，再用双翼撒向世界各地。
author: milchik
source: Wishing to honor the memories of those close to its heart after their death, POKENAME burns their bones down to ashes and scatters them across the world with its wings.

entry: 树梢上常能找到POKENAME。可它爱朝毫无防备的训练家扔骨头，在多数地方，都被视为惹祸的家伙。
author: lyrebird.rainwing
source: You can find POKENAME on the tops of trees. However, it is considered a pest in most regions, as it hurls bones at unsuspecting Trainers.

entry: POKENAME几乎总被骨堆围住，筑巢时要尽量多的骨，想以此吓退其他宝可梦，别靠近住处。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME are almost always surrounded by piles of bones. They nest around as many as possible to try to scare off other Pokémon from their nests.

entry: POKENAME转骨蓄电，再以大股电流放出，威力强到光凭电力，就能压倒敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins its bone to charge electricity, then unleashes the energy in big bursts. This attack is potent enough to overwhelm its foes with its sheer electrical power.

entry: POKENAME常充当玛狃拉群的萨满，治疗伤员、指引族群。和同伴狩猎时，会从法杖召来寒风，分散猎物注意。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME often act as shamans to Weavile packs, providing healing to injured members and acting as a guide to the group. While hunting with its pack-mates, it calls forth icy winds from its staff, distracting prey.

entry: POKENAME偏爱近身战，先双臂抓住敌人，再以鼻上旋钻刺击。身上骨甲，比硬岩更耐打。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME prefers to fight up close, grabbing foes with its arms and then stabbing them with the rotating drill on its nose. The bones it uses as armor are more durable than solid rock.

entry: 众多藤蔓吞没过无数猎物与天敌，遗骨尽缠其中。POKENAME拿骨击敌，也用长臂挥动藤蔓串起的小骨，抓打对方。
author: infinex21
source: Its many vines have subsumed countless prey and would-be predators, with their many bones entangled within. POKENAME use these bones to strike their opponents and their long arms to claw at them with smaller bones held together with vines.

entry: 它挥舞精细打磨的巨大敌骨，作大刀战斗。POKENAME还能借藤蔓般的披风长跃，从高处劈斩。
author: infinex21
source: It wields a large, refined bone of a foe as a giant blade to fight with. POKENAME can use its vine-like cape to make long leaps and strike from above with cleaving chops.

entry: POKENAME背上突出的骨头，能引导电力。它就在这些骨头之间蓄能，准备施展十万伏特。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The bones that jut out of POKENAME's back can channel its electricity. It charges its Thunderbolts between these bones.

entry: POKENAME会看护野外遇见的任何迷途孩子。别的宝可梦若靠近，就从上方丢下重骨，将其赶走。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will watch over any lost child it encounters in the wilderness. If any other Pokémon approach, it will drive them away by dropping its heavy bone from above.

entry: POKENAME收集废弃生物质，甚至逝去生命的遗骸，埋入土里作堆肥。数年之后，POKENAME到过的地方，或许已草木繁盛。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME collects discarded biological material and even the remains of fallen beings and buries them. This material acts as compost; within several years, the areas POKENAME has visited may become lush with plant life.

entry: 这些宝可梦的头骨与长牙，比实冰更冷，又比钻石更硬。许多苔原探险者与巡护员会骑着它们，因为耐严寒，又强到能砸碎多数障碍。
author: infinex21
source: The skulls and tusks of these Pokémon are colder than solid ice, yet tougher than diamond. Many tundra explorers and Rangers ride upon these Pokémon, as they can endure harsh cold and harbor enough strength to shatter most obstacles.

entry: POKENAME探索网络时，常护着恶意程序，把病毒当心爱的孩子收养。若收养的恶意软件被删，就悲愤报复，攻击负责的杀毒软件。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME often grow protective of malware programmes whilst exploring cyberspace, adopting the viruses as cherished children. They grow vengeful should their adopted malware be deleted, attacking the anti-virus software responsible in their grief.

entry: POKENAME探索网络时，常护着恶意程序，把病毒当心爱的孩子收养。若收养的恶意软件被删，就悲愤报复，攻击负责的杀毒软件。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME often grow protective of malware programmes whilst exploring cyberspace, adopting the viruses as cherished children. They grow vengeful should their adopted malware be deleted, attacking the anti-virus software responsible in their grief.

entry: POKENAME探索网络时，常护着恶意程序，把病毒当心爱的孩子收养。若收养的恶意软件被删，就悲愤报复，攻击负责的杀毒软件。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME often grow protective of malware programmes whilst exploring cyberspace, adopting the viruses as cherished children. They grow vengeful should their adopted malware be deleted, attacking the anti-virus software responsible in their grief.

entry: POKENAME探索网络时，常护着恶意程序，把病毒当心爱的孩子收养。若收养的恶意软件被删，就悲愤报复，攻击负责的杀毒软件。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME often grow protective of malware programmes whilst exploring cyberspace, adopting the viruses as cherished children. They grow vengeful should their adopted malware be deleted, attacking the anti-virus software responsible in their grief.

entry: POKENAME用骨头在石上刻线，标记领地。近来有人见小群在岩山隧道旁，留下明显活动标记。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its bone to carve lines into stone to mark its territory. Small groups were recently seen near Rock Tunnel creating visible signs of their presence.

entry: POKENAME能以每小时八十英里跑过沙漠，不停寻找挑战者。战斗中踢击快成残影，等决定收尾，才腾空用双骨棒，给敌人最后一击。
author: ghostslythe
source: Able to run across the desert at eighty miles per hour, POKENAME is constantly seeking challengers. When fighting, its kicks are a blur of motion, until it decides to finish the foe with an aerial double bone club strike.

entry: POKENAME明明精于徒手格斗，却坚持拿一副骨制旋棍战斗。入夜后，才点燃棍尖，扰乱其他宝可梦的夜视。
author: ghostslythe
source: Despite being a master of unarmed combat, POKENAME insists on fighting with a set of bone tonfa. Waiting until night, they ignite the tips confounding other Pokémon's night vision.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，常用人造物品。有些研究它行为的博士，怀疑它是否喜欢伤害其他宝可梦。
author: cal_nd_stuff
source: POKENAME frequently utilizes man-made items when fighting. Some professors studying POKENAME behavior have questioned whether it likes hurting other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME对死亡有近乎病态的好奇，因为明白这话题让许多生命痛苦。心智早熟，使它能在别的对象失去挚爱时，感同身受。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a morbid curiosity for death because they understand that death is a painful subject for many. This early mental maturity allows them to empathize with others whenever a loved one is lost.

entry: POKENAME英雄气十足，总主动保护无辜。它转动长腿，便能将骨回力镖猛掷出去，力道足以打裂甲壳。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are heroic Pokémon that go out of their way to protect the innocent. By twirling on their long legs, they can fling their boney boomerang with enough force to crack through shells.

entry: 野生POKENAME常照看迷路幼崽，连其他物种也不例外。看似穿过胸部的骨状突起，是召来异界力量的媒介，用以护人。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME often care for young, lost Pokémon even if they are other species. The bone-shaped protrusion that appears to run through its chest is a medium through which it can call upon otherworldly powers to defend others.

entry: POKENAME守护失去亲人的宝可梦。谁伤害幼小宝可梦，就一定要挨它一顿打。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME act as protectors of orphaned Pokémon. Anyone who harms a young Pokémon is sure to get a beating.

entry: 就算POKENAME敲你100下，只要相信不会受伤，它的木棍就真的伤不了你。有时，POKENAME会现身无人关爱照料者的梦里。
author: bobosmith01
source: Even if POKENAME whacks you 100 times, the wooden stick it carries will never hurt you as long as you believe it won't. Sometimes, POKENAME appears in the dreams of those without a loving person to take care of them.

entry: POKENAME从楔石中现身，石里满是因栖地消失而死的亡魂怨恨。它们用骨头敲混凝土路，砸出坑洼，想减慢伐林。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME emerge from a keystone full of the resentment of the spirits that have died from habitat loss. They slam their bones against concrete roads to cause potholes in an effort to slow the deforestation.

entry: POKENAME的骨棒可引导波导，既能塑成武器，也能凝成能量束释放。把波导注进骨棒，还能确保骨头回力镖命中。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's bone club serves as a conduit for its aura, allowing it to channel its aura and form weapons from it or to release it as condensed blasts. By imbuing the bone club with aura, it can ensure its Bonemerang attack strikes true.

entry: POKENAME独居洞穴，避开一切交往，尤其不愿接触人类。传说背上的头骨中有个痛苦的灵魂守护着它。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME isolate themselves in caves, avoiding all social interaction, especially with humans. Legends claim the skull on their back holds a distressed spirit that watches over them.

entry: 它的头骨坚得撞倒大楼也不会裂。POKENAME紧张时，会用尾巴所持骨棒鞭打地面，引发震动。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its bony skull is so tough that it could topple a building without cracking. When nervous, POKENAME lashes the ground with the club it holds in its tail, creating seismic tremors.

entry: POKENAME头骨伸出一排刀刃般的锯齿，能穿岩。咬下还会释放腐蚀性毒素，让伤口难以愈合。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME have a set of razor-sharp serrated teeth that jut out from their skull and can pierce through rocks. Their bite releases a corrosive toxin that makes healing after a bite difficult.

entry: POKENAME游走古代遗迹，守护古王族免遭盗墓者侵扰。若在遗迹里遇到入侵者，先以骨笼困住，再将其送出去。
author: quackquackattack
source: By roaming ancient ruins, POKENAME ensure the protection of ancient royalty from tomb raiders. If they encounter an intruder inside the ruins, they trap them in a bony cage before ushering them out.

entry: POKENAME在口中蓄大量水，混入自身胃酸。这巨大的溶骨水库，对待在里面太久的来者，便是致命陷阱。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME collects large amounts of water in its mouth and mixes it with its own stomach acid. This giant reservoir of bone dissolving water quickly becomes a deadly trap for anyone staying in it to long.

entry: 许多人视POKENAME为废墓地的看守，照料真正被遗忘的逝者。传说黄昏时，POKENAME悲嚎，人类与宝可梦亡魂都会加入，齐声相和。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME are known by many to be overseers of abandoned graveyards, tending to the truly forgotten. Tales tell of POKENAME howling mournfully in the twilight as spirits of the departed, man and Pokémon, join it in harmony.

entry: POKENAME的壳覆着出奇肥沃的土。沙漠降雨后，偶尔会长出短暂生存的植物与沙漠花朵。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The shell of POKENAME is covered in a surprisingly fertile soil. Though rare, following desert rains its shell can bloom with short-lived plant life and desert flowers.

entry: POKENAME的壳覆着出奇肥沃的土。沙漠降雨后，偶尔会长出短暂生存的植物与沙漠花朵。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The shell of POKENAME is covered in a surprisingly fertile soil. Though rare, following desert rains its shell can bloom with short-lived plant life and desert flowers.

entry: POKENAME靠骨工具便利生活，从敲猎物的棒，到搭帐篷的简陋钉子，无不试用。POKENAME很聪明，总探索手边工具的用法。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on bone tools to make their lives easier. From clubs to bash prey to rudimentary nails used to make tents, POKENAME are clever creatures that experiment with the tools available to them.

entry: POKENAME被视为已知心智最发达的宝可梦之一，用各色颜料标领地，也涂在骨盔头上。它们小群生活，骨棒装饰最多的一只领头。
author: infinex21
source: Considered one of the most sapient Pokémon known, POKENAME mark their territories with various paints that they also apply to their skull-clad heads. They live in small groups, and the one with the most decorated bone club is the leader.

entry: POKENAME深入沙漠，挖古代宝可梦的头骨。找到便掸去灰，将出众标本收入收藏；若格外壮丽，就换成自己的头盔。
author: ghostslythe
source: Deep in the heart of the desert, POKENAME digs for skulls of ancient Pokémon. When found, it dusts them off and adds any outstanding specimens to its collection. If one is especially magnificent, it replaces its helm.

entry: POKENAME将岩石磁化，从深谷与洞穴中捞出、收集各种骨与头骨，再组甲，保护石质身体不裂开。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME magnetize stones in order to scoop up and collect various bones and skulls from the depths of canyons and caverns. They construct the bones into armor for their stony bodies to protect themselves from cracking.

entry: POKENAME由久经沙场的野兽遗骸制成，其中仍留着原主的灵魂。看它战斗的身手，便知此言不虚。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME was crafted from the remains and still-present spirit a battle-hardened beast, as evident by its movements in battle.

entry: 双刃由精磨锐骨构成。POKENAME打法极凶，双剑乱斩敌人，仿佛把压抑怒气全撒在对方身上。
author: sk372
source: The two blades are made of exquisitely sharpened bones. POKENAME's fighting style is extremely aggressive, hacking away wildly at opponents with both swords, as if taking out repressed anger out on its opponents.

entry: POKENAME翱翔广大沙漠与旱原，性情可靠，常守护较弱的卡拉卡拉融合体，抵挡来犯敌人。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME soars across vast deserts and arid plains. It has a dependable nature and is often seen protecting weaker Cubone fusions from threatening foes.

entry: POKENAME是凶猛猎手，在沙漠中游行如水。先以海草般长须抓住猎物，再缠紧，拖入沙下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a fierce hunter that moves smoothly through desert sands as if it were water. It seizes its prey with seaweed-like tendrils before constricting them and dragging them beneath the sand.

entry: 融合的副作用让POKENAME的双翼枯萎，只剩骨头。它为此悲伤不已，常因沮丧而乱发脾气。
author: phantom640
source: A side-effect of POKENAME's fusion causes its wings to wither down to bone. It grieves endlessly about this and often lashes out in frustration.

entry: 只要有古老墓地，POKENAME就会到访，通常装成研究者。它挖坟，偷化石骨作武器，再把目击者全部击昏。
author: ghostslythe
source: Wherever ancient burial grounds are kept, POKENAME visits, usually appearing as a researcher. It digs through the graves, stealing fossilized bones to use as weapons, then knocks out any witnesses.

entry: POKENAME住在干旱栖地，近来数量减少，目击也罕见。乡间旧传说称，POKENAME会袭农场，吞食大奶罐等家养宝可梦，不过尚未证实。
author: bitoboy.
source: POKENAME live in dry, arid habitats. Their numbers have recently dwindled, causing sightings to become rare. Old rural legends claim POKENAME raid farms to devour Miltank and other domestic Pokémon, though these stories remain unproven.

entry: 野生POKENAME通常独处，直到感知有人失去家人而悲伤。它被哀情引来，以缎带轻碰对方，让人感到情绪释放。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME ordinarily keeps to itself in the wild, until it senses the sorrow of those who have lost a family member. Drawn to their sadness, it lightly touches them with its ribbon, which allows the person to feel a sense of catharsis.

entry: POKENAME的唾液浓度极高，带毒，能腐蚀许多东西，连骨与部分金属也不例外。只有陷入绝境才用，平时只凭蛮力战斗。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's saliva is a highly-concentrated, toxic substance that can corrode many things, including bones and some metals as well. They only use this on others if cornered, otherwise they will fight with just their pure, brute strength.

entry: POKENAME部分骨架外露，让它在臭氧层飞得更流畅。它会降下天，饱食骨头，吸取钙，强化自身骨架。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME has sections of exposed bone to streamline its flight through the ozone layer. It comes down from the sky to feast on bones, absorbing the calcium to strengthen its own skeletal structure.

entry: POKENAME头部长出贴身白毛，像带飘鬃的头骨。爪比骨更硬，分泌暗能量，让受害者冷到骨里。
author: infinex21
source: White fur grows and clings to POKENAME's head like a skull with a flowing mane. Its claws are harder than bone and secrete a dark energy that chills victims to their own bones.

entry: POKENAME发现散落遗骨，会等夜幕降临，为它们跳最后一支舞，以优雅仪式敬其灵魂。观者说，它一动，四周空气便静得肃穆。
author: curazy
source: When POKENAME finds scattered bones, it waits until nightfall to dance for them one last time, honoring their spirit with a graceful ritual. Onlookers say the air around it grows still and reverent as it moves.

entry: 它挥舞着很久以前击败的敌人的骨头，将其打磨成利刃，以便继续挑战对手、不断成长。它尾尖的蘑菇会释放令人振奋的孢子，每逢公平交手后，它便会与对手分享。
author: infinex21
source: It wields the bone of a foe bested long ago, which it has refined into a blade so it may continue to challenge others and grow. The mushrooms at the tip of its tail release invigorating spores that it shares with its opponents after fair fights.

entry: 学校曾传，POKENAME悄然寻找独行学生，以针缝成娃娃。实际，POKENAME只是偷偷修好破落宝可梦玩偶，再放到孤独孩子的座位上。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Rumors were once spread around schools that POKENAME silently prowl for lone students, turning their needles on them and sewing them into dolls. In reality, POKENAME secretly repair forlorn Pokédolls and leave them on the seats of lonely children.

entry: 失去与磨难让POKENAME发展出超能力，如今以神秘火焰控制骨武器。战斗虽强硬无情，平时却很善良。
author: lootererswillbeboated
source: Fueled by loss and hardship, POKENAME developed psychic powers and now uses a mystic fire to control the bones it uses as weapons. Despite how tough and unforgiving they are in battle, they are very kind otherwise.

entry: POKENAME的骨头盔一照月光，就泛起淡粉微光。满月下格外醒目，更添神秘。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME's bone skull is in contact with moonlight, it gains a slight pink shimmer. This effect makes it especially striking under the full moon, adding to its mystique.

entry: POKENAME把领地与挚爱的安全，看得比任何事都重，连自己也不例外。巢若遭闯入，便不顾一切，头一个冲进战斗。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME places the safety of its territory and its loved ones above everything else, including itself. It will recklessly charge headfirst into battle if its nest is encroached upon.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME巡行于采石场，寻找失去母亲的卡拉卡拉。厚重的铠甲，能保护它收养的小家伙免受伤害。
author: thropp
source: POKENAME roams the quarries at night, searching for motherless Cubone. POKENAME's bulky armor protects its foundlings from harm.

entry: 陌生人或宝可梦想靠近，POKENAME就挥骨回击。若赢得信任，又会非常亲昵，头骨被摸时，还轻轻呼噜。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will lash out with their bone at any unfamiliar person or Pokémon that tries to approach them. If their trust is won, they can be very affectionate and will softly purr if their skull is petted.

entry: POKENAME栖在山崖，俯瞰领地，寻找下一只猎物。捕到合适目标，左右两头便抓牢，中央大头再施展碎骨重击。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME stay on mountain cliffs, overlooking their territory to spot their next prey. When they catch suitable prey, the two heads left and right grab their victim while the large middle one delivers bone-crushing attacks.

entry: POKENAME拿骨棒撑跳，跃出崖边，一次最远能跳5英里，还假装自己正在飞。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME uses its bone club to vault off of cliffsides. It can vault up to 5 miles in a single bound, and pretends it's flying through the air.

entry: POKENAME努力摆出强悍沉着的样子，很想显得强大、超越年龄。巢法多样，可能拿石嵌在壁上，也可能以碎屑筑在地面。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME tries to keep a tough yet stoic disposition, as it is eager to look strong and well beyond its years. It may build its nest in many different ways, such as in a wall with rocks, or on the ground with debris.

entry: POKENAME大多夜里活动，先用大骨击昏敌人，再饮其血。迅猛残酷的攻击，让它成了可怕夜猎者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME, remaining mostly active at night, knocks out foes with its large bone before drinking their blood. Its swift and brutal attacks make it a fearsome nighttime predator.

entry: POKENAME很脆弱，靠骨架般的身形，伪装在各类险地。体内电力充盈，谁触碰就电谁，几秒便能将对方电焦。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are frail and utilize their skeleton-like figures to camouflage themselves within various hazardous terrains. Their bodies are brimming with electricity that they release against anyone who touches them, frying them within seconds.

entry: 大群POKENAME游荡废矿道，拿随身镐挖营养矿物。内斗时也拿来作武器，尤其遇上稀有或特别可口的矿脉。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: Hordes of POKENAME can be found wandering abandoned mineshafts using the pickaxes they carry to mine nutritious minerals. They are also used when infighting occurs, especially over rare or particularly tasty mineral veins.

entry: POKENAME能长途穿越沙漠，不必停下喝水。韧皮减慢失水，骨甲又让它抵御多数危险，是坚韧的宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can travel long distances through the desert without needing to stop for water. Their tough hides slow water loss from their bodies. They are hardy Pokémon and can resist most dangers thanks to their bony plates.

entry: POKENAME看着凶险，其实只想玩抛接。唯一问题是，骨头得最强的宝可梦才举得动，能抛出去的，更寥寥无几。
author: chewquy
source: POKENAME may seem menacing and dangerous, but it only wants to play fetch. The only problem is that its bone can be lifted only by the strongest Pokémon and thrown by very few.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME由恶灵寄宿受亵渎的遗骸而生。全身披着许多骨，有些从体内长出，还挥着一根长而不会折断的骨棒。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are believed to be born from desecrated remains inhabited by malicious spirits. Their bodies are clad in many bones, some growing from within, and they wield a long, unbreakable bone club.

entry: POKENAME头盔与双翼，都由硬化软骨构成。翅膀虽不能飞，却奇妙地能撑住体重滑翔。滑翔时，风掠双耳，产生超声波。
author: ghostslythe
source: Both POKENAME's helmet and wings are made of hardened cartilage. Its wings do not allow flight, but curiously can maintain its weight for gliding. As it glides, the wind whips through its ears creating supersonic waves.

entry: POKENAME手上额外拿着的头骨，既储能，也能向敌人发射强力激光。暴怒时，便破坏性横冲，以骨头回力镖斩倒沿途所有建筑。
author: soup1900
source: The extra skull POKENAME holds is where it both stores its energy and fires it at foes in the form of a powerful laser. When angered, it goes on a destructive rampage, using Bonemerang to chop down all buildings in its path.

entry: POKENAME身旁的乌鸦头头，多半是早已与它结伴的黑暗鸦进化而来，而非新加入的伙伴。有些身上，也会缀着骨头。
author: ohok3441
source: The Honchkrow around POKENAME are typically bonded Murkrow rather than new additions. Sometimes they will be adorned with bones too.

entry: POKENAME假装需要帮助，引毫无戒心的猎物靠近，转眼却狠狠敲打那些好心来帮忙的对象。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME lure in unsuspecting prey by pretending to be in need of help, only to whack those nice enough to come close.

entry: 据说POKENAME由沙丘娃与落入陷阱的卡拉卡拉共生而成。这份联系让双方都完成进化，成为会向新猎物投掷骨片的顶级捕食者。
author: doodledoo
source: POKENAME is thought to be the result of a Sandygast forming a symbiotic bond with a Cubone that fell into its trap. This bond has allowed them both to reach their evolutions, turning them into an apex predator that throws bone shards at new victims.

entry: POKENAME尾端的骨极坚实，一挥就能砸碎巨岩。它独行，只有看见幼小宝可梦需要保护，才与其他对象互动。
author: sk372
source: The bone at the end of POKENAME's tail is incredibly solid, strong enough to shatter a boulder with a single swing. It travels alone, only interacting with others when it sees young Pokémon in need of protection.

entry: POKENAME成群旅行，彼此拼命保护。作战先头撞，再挥骨棒。POKENAME也被请到挖掘场，拿尾巴掸灰，帮助揭露化石。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are known to travel in packs, fiercely protecting each other. They battle by headbutting foes before striking with their clubs. POKENAME are used at dig sites to help excavate fossils, uncovering them by dusting them off with their tails.

entry: POKENAME用败敌遗骨作甲，保护弱点。每一片都珍惜，只有破损到修不好，才肯更换。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME uses the bones of fallen foes as armor to protect its weak points. Each piece is treasured and will only be replaced if broken beyond repair.

entry: POKENAME爱拿大骨棒敲新东西，找会发出悦耳声音的物件。野生个体会囤起来，既奏音乐，也彼此交流。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME love to thwack new objects with their large bone club until they find objects that create a pleasant noise when they're struck. Wild POKENAME will hoard such objects and use them to produce music, but also to communicate with each other.

entry: 神奥人认为POKENAME是骑拉帝纳的仆从，总在绝境现身，却让局面更糟。头骨法器喷火，身体又扬尘，卷成沙暴。
author: ghostslythe
source: In Sinnoh, POKENAME is thought to be a servant of Giratina, always appearing in desperate times. It makes the situations worse, its skull focus belching flames while its body causes dust to pick up to sand storms.

entry: POKENAME以超能力预见未来，先看敌人的来招，再反击。有人推测，它将灵魂化作骨棒外的火焰，取得无尽能量。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Using psychic power, POKENAME peer into the future, seeing their opponent's attacks before they happen and countering. It is theorized that POKENAME transform spirits into the flames coating their bone clubs as a never-ending source of energy.

entry: POKENAME天生有父性本能，会照看任何物种的幼小宝可梦。它们在暗处守护，以压缩水构成的手里剑，解决威胁。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have an innate paternal instinct that causes them to watch over young Pokémon, no matter their species. They protect them from the shadows and dispatch threats with throwing stars made of compressed water.

entry: POKENAME移动时，头骨壳内外蓝焰咆哮，热霭烟雾笼身。吐出的火高度集中，几分钟便熔掉实骨，因此猎物常剩不了多少。
author: infinex21
source: Blue flames roar within and without POKENAME's skull-shaped shell as it moves, veiling it in a haze of heat and smoke. The flames it breathes are focused enough to melt solid bone within minutes, so there is often little left of its prey.

entry: POKENAME不安时，头骨上的角会放出大量灰粉云。粉云能扰乱敌人，是强效自卫手段。
author: .izik
source: The horns on POKENAME's skull release large clouds of grey powder when it is distressed. This cloud can disorient foes, making it a potent defense mechanism.

entry: POKENAME稳稳握着骨回力镖，随时准备保护带火的尾巴。若信任到肯让你摸尾巴，便是高度尊重与信赖。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hold onto their bony boomerang with a steady hand and are always ready to defend their flaming tails. Being trusted to touch their tail is a sign of high trust and respect.

entry: POKENAME拿随身骨头擦过头骨，像擦火柴般点燃。骨头一起火，打法就更凶，训练家得留意，别让它战到忘形。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME scrapes the bone it carries across its skull to set it aflame, lighting it like a match. Its fighting style gets fiercer once its bone is on fire, so Trainers should take care to make sure it doesn't get carried away in battle.

entry: POKENAME常钻过富化石的岩层，捡起早逝宝可梦的骨，穿成护甲。需要上地面找食水时，就能保护自己。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME regularly burrow through fossil-rich rock layers, picking up the bones of long-dead Pokémon as they do. They wear these bones as armour, protecting themselves from harm whenever they need to surface for food or water.

entry: POKENAME常与嘎啦嘎啦冲突，两者都爱往宝可梦墓地去。POKENAME挖地寻食，嘎啦嘎啦却为保护安息遗体，将它们赶走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME often come into conflict with Marowak, both Pokémon regularly travelling to Pokémon burial grounds. Whilst POKENAME dig through the grounds in search of a meal, Marowak fight them off to protect the bodies laid to rest.

entry: POKENAME戴其他宝可梦的头骨，靠它挡攻击。可令头骨振动的打击，会带来剧烈头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wear the skull of another Pokémon and rely on it to protect them from attacks. Attacks that vibrate the skull cause them to experience painful headaches.

entry: POKENAME把怒意与力气，全导入随身骨棒。武器若在战斗中折断，便怒上加怒，几近疯狂。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME channels all of its anger and strength into the bone club it carries. Should the weapon break in battle, it flies into an even greater rage that borders on madness.

entry: 雨水与眼泪侵蚀了POKENAME的头骨帽，边缘更锐，更能吓人。它常忘记自身力气，握作棒的骨头，也被弄断。
author: infinex21
source: Exposure to rain and POKENAME's own tears have eroded its skull cap, giving it sharper edges that help intimidate others. It oft forgets its own strength and breaks the bones it wields as clubs.

entry: POKENAME越聪明、超能力越熟练，头骨上的星就越会变色。金色被视为最高等，可传闻还有超越金色的层次。
author: sk372
source: The star present on POKENAME's skull changes color as it grows smarter and more psychically proficient. Gold is considered the highest rank, though rumors persist of a level beyond even that.

entry: POKENAME用强大念力操控沙与风，随心造沙暴。尘龙卷推动旋骨，袭向任何打扰独处的对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses powerful telekinesis to control sand and wind alike and create sandstorms at will. Whirling bones propelled by dusty tornadoes will assault any that disturb its solitude.

entry: POKENAME用骨头撬落山崖巨石，再举起来练力。持续锻炼，让体格始终保持巅峰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its bone to dislodge boulders from mountain ledges, then lifts them to train its strength. This constant training ensures it maintains peak physical condition.

entry: POKENAME体格与力气几乎无可匹敌，性情却沉静庄重。有人说，它不停练，是怕自己哪天没力气守住挚爱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses a physique and strength near unparalleled, and maintains a quiet, somber persona. Some say it trains constantly because it fears the possibility of lacking the strength to protect its loved ones.

entry: 考古学家常请POKENAME不用机器，就从土里举出重化石与岩石。它们甚至挖出过化石翼龙、快龙等宝可梦的化石。
author: rumia_archer
source: POKENAME are commonly used by archaeologists to lift heavy fossils or rocks out of the ground without the use of machinery. They have even uncovered fossils belonging to Pokémon such as Aerodactyl and Dragonite.

entry: 故事把POKENAME说成恶灵，想吞没一切闯进森林的生命。实际上，POKENAME十分亲人，会保护善意进入领地的对象。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Stories of POKENAME describe it as a malevolent entity seeking to absorb all who trespass into its forest. In actuality, POKENAME is quite affectionate, and protects the kind souls who enter its domain.

entry: POKENAME总飞着，寻找更大挑战与猎物。掷出的骨棒力大到能打裂树，可扔出去后，便只能靠身躯与火焰，直到找到新棒。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are always flying in search of greater challenges and prey alike. They can throw their bone clubs with enough force to crack a tree, though then must rely on their bodies or their flames until they can acquire a new club.

entry: 据说POKENAME的骨面具，藏着可怕诅咒。心思不纯的人若戴上，肺部功能便会严重受限。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's bone mask is said to hold a horrible curse. Legends say if the mask is worn by someone with impure thoughts, it heavily restricts lung function.

entry: POKENAME披其他宝可梦的骨，作阴森铠甲。哪根骨太光滑或太脆、不再好用，POKENAME都会先埋好，再替换。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wear the bones of other Pokémon as a sort of macabre armor. When a bone becomes too smooth or brittle to function, POKENAME bury the bone before replacing it.

entry: POKENAME外貌骇人，实际上却极友善，这身形只是为吓敌。火只伤自己想伤的对象，因此古往今来，都是受欢迎的坐骑。
author: infinex21
source: Despite POKENAME's terrifying appearance, these Pokémon are incredibly friendly. Their form is meant for intimidation. Their flames will only harm those they wish them to, making them popular steeds of the past and the present.

entry: POKENAME的骨棒历经战斗、做饭，已经磨损。若把工具弄丢，比如投向敌人后失落，它就找个不停，直到骨头回到手里。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's bone is worn with use from battle and from being used to make its meals. If it ever loses this tool, such as when throwing it at a foe, it will not rest until it finds the bone again.

entry: POKENAME骨内满是浓烈污泥，连构成身体的黏液也比不过。骨若在战斗中折断，就会释放恶臭，足以令毫无准备的对手失去行动能力。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's bones are filled with a very potent sludge, even compared to the ooze that makes up its body. If one of its bones breaks during battle, it will release an odor so foul it can incapacitate an unprepared battler.

entry: POKENAME头骨里储存的意志力，想塑出坚实而骄傲的身体。似乎总差一点，可每天都在进步。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The willpower stored in POKENAME's skull attempts to form a solid, proud body. It never seems to get all the way there, but it improves every day.

entry: POKENAME神情克制，看似冷漠孤傲，实际很亲人。它用骨回力镖保护挚爱，也以硬壳挡住来袭。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a stoic expression that makes them seem cold and aloof, even though they are affectionate Pokémon. They protect those they love by throwing bony boomerangs and blocking incoming attacks with their sturdy shell.

entry: POKENAME平时神情严肃，像不易亲近，熟悉后却颇多温情。水力推动的骨炮，一撞就能轻易碎岩。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME default to a stern expression, which makes them seem aloof, but they are rather affectionate once they warm up to others. Their water-propelled bone cannon easily shatters rocks on impact.

entry: POKENAME靠外壳射骨弹，命中一次便回旋飞返。敌人若太近，不易射准，POKENAME也能挥长骨刺，猛力敲打。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME relies on its outer shell to throw bony projectiles at foes that boomerang back after striking once. If a foe is too close to reliably hit with projectiles, POKENAME can swing and bludgeon foes with long bony spikes.

entry: 据说，POKENAME最初被发现时，正侍奉冰封荒原的邪恶国王。它会朝敌人释放骨暴攻击。
author: rakanadyo
source: It is said that POKENAME was first discovered serving the malevolent king of a frozen wasteland. It attacks by unleashing a storm of bones on its foes.

entry: POKENAME头骨比钨还硬，高速掘洞也很有效。它敲碎矿床进食，让头骨更加坚固。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's skull is harder than tungsten, allowing it to use it effectively while tunneling at high speeds. It breaks apart ore deposits to eat, making its skull even stronger.

entry: POKENAME用超能力转骨，催眠观看圆周运动的对象。它有拐走卡拉卡拉幼崽的习惯，拿来当亲生后代抚养。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME spins its bone with psychic powers to hypnotize anyone watching its circular movements. It has a habit of abducting Cubone cubs and raising them as its own offspring.

entry: POKENAME拿随身骨头作临时矛与盾，也不忘练身体。独处时，会撑在骨矛上保持平衡，磨炼踢技。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the bones it carries as a makeshift lance and shield. It doesn't neglect training its own body, balancing itself on its bone-spear and practicing its kicking techniques when alone.

entry: 许多专业武术家模仿POKENAME以踢为主的打法。虽几乎专注腿技，拳也可怕，一记寸拳就能将敌人打飞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's kicking-based fighting style is emulated by many professional martial artists. Though it focuses almost exclusively on kicks, it has a formidable fist strike able to send a foe flying with a mere one-inch punch.

entry: POKENAME的双手也变成腿，具备原来腿部同样的力量与伸缩性。独特的四腿踢法，让战斗本领无可匹敌。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's hands have become legs as well, gaining the same strength and extendable nature its legs normally possess. This gives it unparalleled combat capabilities with a unique four-kick fighting style.

entry: POKENAME的腿更富弹性、更强劲，能高速跑、跃高空。有记录显示，踢得极快时，空气摩擦甚至点燃出招的腿。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's legs are now much springier and more powerful, allowing it to run at high speeds and leap great heights. It has been recorded that it can kick at such high speeds that the friction from the air ignites the leg doing the kicking.

entry: 它是高明斗士，一生同时磨炼致命拳脚。四肢都能如弹簧伸缩，让POKENAME速度与敏捷格外惊人。
author: fiordaliso
source: A masterful fighter, it spends its entire life training both its deadly punches and its lethal kicks. All of its limbs can contract and extend like springs, granting POKENAME remarkable speed and agility.

entry: POKENAME每颗头都能伸得很远，让毒气扩散更快、更广，也能猛撞敌人，造成巨大伤害。
author: darkweavile428
source: Each of POKENAME's heads can stretch out over long distances, allowing it to spread its poison gases farther and faster. It slams its heads into opponents to inflict massive damage.

entry: POKENAME落地就收翼，尽量混入周围。捕食者若来，POKENAME便猛展翅膀，将对方推退，趁机蹬地飞走。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME land with their wings tucked to try and blend into their surroundings. If a predator approaches, POKENAME will rapidly unfurl their wings to launch them back, taking the opportunity to kick off the ground and fly away.

entry: POKENAME的腿虽能如弹簧伸长，踢击其实不必碰到敌人。只要朝对方向出腿，目标就会感到重击。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME's legs can extend like springs, it doesn't actually need to make contact with foes with its kicks. Simply directing them in the right direction will result in the target feeling a powerful hit.

entry: POKENAME平衡惊人，在枝间跳跃，找水果吃。受攻击时，会高高跃空，翻身后，重重一记下劈腿。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME possesses incredible balance, hopping from branch to branch in search of fruit to eat. If attacked, they will jump high into the air, flipping before delivering a devastating axe kick.

entry: POKENAME善用沉重长尾作战，力量足以一挥就击昏吼鲸王。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME excels at combatting others using its long and heavy tail. Its tail strength is enough that it could easily knock a Wailord unconscious with a single swing.

entry: POKENAME可追溯至3亿年前。研究者认为，长腿能让它在海底飞快爬行，迅速逃离天敌。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME dates back 300 million years ago. Researchers believe that it uses its long legs to scuttle along the ocean floor, allowing it to quickly flee predators.

entry: POKENAME肢体能伸得极远，又配上重体，让对手时刻戒备。因为随时可能不是踢一腿，而将整个身体猛弹进来。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has limbs that can stretch long distances, so it combines that with its hefty weight to keep its opponent on guard; there is always the possibility it will suddenly spring its body directly into the foe instead of merely throwing a kick.

entry: POKENAME善闪难缠，瞬移、闪身，躲过几乎每一击。双腿充满增强攻击的超能力能量，只要结实命中一下，连最大的敌人也能击昏。
author: sk372
source: A dodgy foe that teleports and weaves away from nearly every strike, POKENAME packs its legs full of psychic energy that boost its attack. It only needs one good strike to knock out even the largest of foes.

entry: POKENAME先用翅膀掀沙云，再把踢击藏进尘里。强腿也让它能高高跃起，迅速离地起飞。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME fights by creating clouds of sand with its wings before launching unseen kicks into the dustcloud. Its powerful legs let it leap high in the air as a quick takeoff for flying.

entry: POKENAME仅有的一条腿，肌肉数量就比人类更多，大多用来平衡。它们日夜锻炼，因为一摔倒，没帮手就几乎起不来。
author: quackquackattack
source: The singular leg of POKENAME has more muscles than a human, most of which help them keep balance. They train day and night to strengthen those muscles, as falling over makes it nearly impossible to get up without assistance.

entry: POKENAME脚有大爪，靠伸缩长腿，从远处抓住猎物。POKENAME先给猎物系丝，再放走，待捕猎兴致高涨，又循迹追去。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME's feet are equipped with large claws, which allow it to latch onto prey from afar using its stretchy legs. POKENAME will attach its prey with silk before letting them go, later tracking them down as its excitement for capturing grows.

entry: POKENAME振翼穿梭战场，飞快踢击对手。它认为泼沙手段卑鄙，除非万不得已，否则不会用。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME darts around the battlefield with its wings while striking opponents with lightning-fast kicks. It avoids using Sand Attack, considering it an underhanded tactic unless absolutely necessary.

entry: 以POKENAME的体型而言，伸缩腿的威力相当惊人。电力控制还在发展，大约只有一半踢击，能成功充电强化。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's extendable legs pack a powerful punch for its size. Its electric control is still developing, so only about half of its kicks are able to be enhanced and charged up with electricity.

entry: POKENAME在战斗中保持飞行，用伸缩腿从上方踢下，也靠这招伸爪抢猎物。战后会仔细整理羽饰，那是同族引以为傲的装饰。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME remains airborne in combat, kicking from above with its stretchy legs. It uses this same strategy to snatch prey in its talons. After a battle, it thoroughly restores its plume, a decorative mark of pride in the species.

entry: 与多数草属性宝可梦不同，POKENAME演化出以花而非叶进行光合作用的能力。POKENAME常藏灌丛，靠伸缩花茎，尽量高效吸能。
author: ludacriswell
source: Unlike most Grass-type Pokémon, POKENAME has evolved to photosynthesize sunlight using its flowers instead of leaves. POKENAME often hides in bushes or shrubs and uses its extendable flower stems to capture energy at maximum efficiency.

entry: 与多数草属性宝可梦不同，POKENAME演化出以花而非叶进行光合作用的能力。这变体只见于雨林，会伸长花茎，越过当地草木，采集能量。
author: ludacriswell
source: Unlike most Grass-type Pokémon, POKENAME has evolved to photosynthesize sunlight using its flowers instead of leaves. This variant is exclusively found in rainforest biomes and uses its extendable flower stems to reach above native plants for energy.

entry: POKENAME常被叫作“长腿豆子”，绰号普遍到科学家干脆把一群也叫作“豆群”。战斗时，快踢扬泥，甩进敌人眼里，让对方难躲重腿。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is often called a bean on legs, a nickname so common that scientists refer to a group of them as a 'pulse'. In battle, it uses quick kicks to fling mud into opponents' eyes, making it hard to avoid its devastating kicks.

entry: POKENAME常被叫作“长腿豆子”，绰号普遍到科学家干脆把一群也叫作“豆群”。战斗时，快踢扬泥，甩进敌人眼里，让对方难躲重腿。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is often called a bean on legs, a nickname so common that scientists refer to a group of them as a 'pulse'. In battle, it uses quick kicks to fling mud into opponents' eyes, making it hard to avoid its devastating kicks.

entry: POKENAME走路时，强腿撑起种子的重量。双腿如弹簧，能让它高高跃起，够到悬挂果实。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's strong legs support the weight of its bulb as it walks. These legs act as springs, allowing it to leap up towards hanging fruit.

entry: POKENAME走着走着便伸长腿，探进树梢，混入枝条。它们钩住树枝，再把腿收离地面，藏在叶间睡觉。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME stretch out their legs as they walk to reach up into the treetops and blend into the branches. They hook themselves along a branch and retract their legs off the ground to hide among the leaves and sleep.

entry: POKENAME爱在树上冥想。谁打断，就用沉重上身猛砸；敌人一倒，POKENAME又跳回树里，继续入定。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME enjoy meditating in trees. They deal with interruptions by slamming opponents with their heavy upper body. Once their enemy is down, POKENAME hop back into the trees to resume their meditation.

entry: POKENAME靠独腿踢出带刺重击。若冲击还不够，刺里的毒，仍可能令对手昏过去。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME relies on its singular leg to launch barbed kicks toward its opponent. If the impact of the kick is not enough, the venom from its barbs may cause the opponent to pass out.

entry: POKENAME的角与腿一样有力，却只在最后关头用角。它更偏爱完全靠踢技赢得胜利。
author: sk372
source: Though its horn is as powerful a weapon as its legs, POKENAME only uses it in battle as a last resort. It much prefers victories that come only from its kicking prowess.

entry: POKENAME挑战比自己大得多的宝可梦，证明实力。虽常输，却仔细研究每个对手的动作，再融入自己的踢技。
author: reaverlamont
source: POKENAME challenges Pokémon much larger than itself to prove its strength. Although it often loses, it carefully studies every opponent's movements and incorporates what it learns into its own kicking techniques.

entry: 颈肌像弹簧，让它用硬如钻石的喙打出重击。POKENAME腿部推力极强，能像火箭般迅速冲上天空。
author: fiordaliso
source: The muscles in its neck act like a spring, allowing it to deliver devastating strikes with its diamond-hard beak. POKENAME can generate such powerful thrusts with its legs that it can shoot into the sky as fast as a rocket.

entry: 不能飞时，POKENAME靠长腿与惊人核心力量，攀过峭壁，潜近猎物。卡在崖上的利爪，还被登山者当作安全路线标记。
author: chibitales
source: By using its long legs and incredible core strength, POKENAME scales sheer cliffsides to sneak up on its prey when flying is not an option. Talons that become stuck in these cliffsides are used as markers of safe paths by mountain climbers.

entry: POKENAME奔跑时腿会伸长，速度大增。它虽没嘴，兴奋时却仍发出闷闷的犬吠般声响。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's legs extend as it runs, drastically increasing its speed. Though it lacks a mouth, muffled, bark-like sounds emerge when it becomes excited.

entry: POKENAME精准挥毒尾，模仿见过的训练有素斗士的踢拳打法。踢击过后，会留下久久不散的毒刺痛。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME whips its poisonous tail with precision, mimicking the kickboxing style of trained fighters it has observed. Its kicks can leave a lingering, venomous sting.

entry: POKENAME强到能用长鼻掀起工程车，也能顶住落石。腿虽小，却足以在承受重击时，站稳不动。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are so strong that they can heave construction vehicles with their trunks and withstand the force of a falling boulder. Their legs are small yet strong enough to help them endure heavy blows without budging.

entry: POKENAME如甩鞭般踢出脚，瞄准弱点。长尾沉重，快攻不便，只好靠精准打击取胜。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME kick their opponents by whipping their foot to strike at weak points. Their long, heavy tail makes swift strikes difficult to perform, so they rely on precise blows to achieve victory.

entry: 高强度训练后，所产乳汁会明显更富蛋白质。POKENAME靠强踢，守护同一农场的其他宝可梦，免遭伤害。
author: fiordaliso
source: After intense training sessions, the milk it produces becomes significantly richer in protein. POKENAME uses its powerful kicks to keep the other Pokémon living on the same farm out of harm's way.

entry: POKENAME几乎不用双脚走，反而骑着自己的尾囊弹跳。尾巴最多能伸到静止时的大约10倍。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME rarely ever uses its two feet to walk. Instead, it hops along riding on its own tail sac. The tail can stretch up to approximately 10 times its resting length.

entry: POKENAME爱久坐不动，以长腿模仿树根。危险一近，却会猛然活跃，释放密集踢击。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME likes to sit still for long periods of time, using its long legs to mimic roots. However, if danger comes close, it will spring to life to unleash a flurry of kicks.

entry: POKENAME开打前，先给爪裹霜，以快踢打对方措手不及。最自豪的，是敌人还没意识到它动了，精准一击就已命中。
author: reaverlamont
source: POKENAME coats its claws in frost before a fight, using swift kicks to catch opponents off guard. It takes great pride in landing a precise strike before its opponent even realises it has moved.

entry: 腿虽强，沉重圆身体却让它不够灵活。POKENAME会从掌孔朝地喷压缩空气，帮自己跃起，拉近敌我距离。
author: sk372
source: Its legs are powerful, but its heavy rotund body makes its mobility poor. POKENAME fires pressurized air from the holes in its palms at the ground to help it leap through the air and close the distance to its opponents.

entry: POKENAME用弹簧腿跳上大树，在树上筑巢。其他宝可梦若也想来休息，就会被强踢赶走。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME uses its spring-like legs to jump high into large trees. It will nest in this tree, using powerful kicks to remove any other Pokémon that try to also rest on the tree.

entry: POKENAME罕见，住在密林，善杂技又耐力足。强腿让它轻松飞扑、越过大缝，全身数百万细小钩毛，则助它攀附高处。
author: bobosmith01
source: Acrobatic and hard to tire, the rare jungle-dwelling POKENAME can easily lunge and cross large gaps thanks to powerful legs and latch on and climb great heights due to the millions of microscopic hook-like hairs across its body.

entry: POKENAME每天花数小时练踢技，熟练到出脚快得肉眼难辨。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends hours a day practicing its kicking technique. It has honed its technique enough that it can kick faster than the naked eye can perceive.

entry: POKENAME腿长而肌肉发达，不离地就能抬到六英尺高。人们曾玩单脚站立、跃起触环的游戏，POKENAME尤其擅长。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sport long, muscular legs that can reach six feet in the air without leaping off the ground. People once played a game where they stand on one foot and leap into the air to hit a ring, a game POKENAME excel at.

entry: POKENAME勇闯丛林，寻找强敌。若感到会输，POKENAME便混入环境，伪装后，飞快脱离战斗。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME braves the jungle, searching for formidable opponents. If it senses it will lose a fight, POKENAME will camouflage into its environment then flee from the battle at fast speeds.

entry: POKENAME身形虽笨重，战斗却出色，踢击力道极大。背上花把阳光化成能量，让它白天动得敏捷出奇。
author: fancyskunk
source: Despite its bulky stature, POKENAME is a capable fighter, able to put extreme power behind its kicks. The flower on its back converts sunlight into energy, enabling it to move with surprising agility in the daytime.

entry: POKENAME腿与头骨硬如钻石，击中什么就能打碎什么。平时虽慢，有些却能骤然冲到每小时450英里以上。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's legs and skull are as hard as diamond, breaking anything it strikes at. Though usually slow, some can suddenly reach speeds of over 450 mph.

entry: 常见许多格斗属性宝可梦，站在POKENAME背上训练招式。它似乎并不介意，因为挨打也能锻炼自身韧性。
author: mepp.
source: Many Fighting-type Pokémon are seen atop POKENAME's back training and practicing their moves. POKENAME does not seem to mind, as enduring many blows helps strengthen its own fortitude.

entry: POKENAME爱伸长双腿，让自己显得更高。量一量腿长，就很容易比较个体的强弱，因为腿越长，实力就越强。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME likes to stretch out its legs to make itself look taller. It is easy to tell if a POKENAME is stronger by measuring how long its legs are, as the longer the legs, the stronger the Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME把缎带般的肢体与强踢配合，打得富有节奏。踢击能伸出十二英寸以上！
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME rhythmically fights with a combination of its ribbon-like limbs and high-powered kicks. Its kicks can lengthen out over twelve inches!

entry: POKENAME战斗时，总想瞄准对手膝盖和小腿。金属骨架极硬，POKENAME轻易折断敌骨，是常有的事。
author: bigoljax
source: When POKENAME fight, they constantly try to go for their opponents' knees and shins. Due to their hard metallic frames, it's very common for POKENAME to break foes' bones with ease.

entry: POKENAME随只有自己听得到的歌起舞，跃空旋转。谁无视表演，就可能迎来优雅却沉重的一脚，正中脸。
author: amityblamity
source: POKENAME dances to a song only it can hear, leaping and twirling through the air. Those who ignore its performance risk will be met with an elegant yet hefty kick to the face.

entry: POKENAME靠弹簧腿，优雅追赶猎物，轻易穿过障碍。随后以带刺毒鞭捕获、缚住，再了结。
author: shyguy11011
source: Using their springlike legs, POKENAME gracefully chase down prey, slipping by obstacles with ease. They then catch their prey with thorny, poison-laced whips, binding them before finishing them off.

entry: POKENAME双腿富有弹性，能一跃高过摩天大楼，再踢出威力惊人的飞踢，冲击宛如小陨石坠落。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's elastic legs allow it to leap over skyscrapers. It uses this to land devastating jump kicks with the impact of a small meteorite.

entry: POKENAME以长耳保持战斗平衡，踢击威力极大，一腿就能踢倒巨树。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its long ears to keep its balance while fighting. Its kicks are so powerful that a single strike can fell a massive tree.

entry: 四肢与尾巴都如弹簧，能有力伸缩。POKENAME靠腿与尾移动，让下一步难以预判。
author: hophoppip
source: Its limbs and tail are all structured like springs, able to extend and contract forcefully. POKENAME uses its legs and its tail for locomotion, making its next move hard to read.

entry: POKENAME站在硬尾上，施展强踢。大头冠代表群体首领，可常有报告说，首领若觉得敌人太强，就逃之夭夭，留下族群不顾。
author: chibitales
source: By standing on their hard tails, POKENAME deliver powerful kicks. Leaders of POKENAME packs, indicated by their large head crest, have often been reported fleeing from fights if they deem the opponent too strong, leaving their brethren behind.

entry: 连接腿与身体的发光等离子体，能随意伸缩。POKENAME悬浮旅行时，始终摆着即将飞踢的姿势，非要击中目标，才肯放松。
author: .jerden
source: The glowing plasma connecting its legs to its body can expand and contract at will. When POKENAME travels by levitation, it holds itself in position as if about to deliver a flying kick, and will not relax until it has struck a target.

entry: POKENAME肢体可伸缩，方便从远处以重击，尤其踢击，解决入侵者。不忙着驱赶来者时，它就苦练，练得全身裂痕。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's extendable limbs let it more easily deal with intruders, striking them from afar with powerful strikes, especially its kicks. Its body is covered with cracks as the result of extensively training itself when not dealing with trespassers.

entry: POKENAME若被扔进海，能靠独脚弹回陆地。当地食物吃光后，就排出体内器官，做出第二只脚，走去新地方。
author: soup1900
source: Using its single foot, POKENAME can spring itself back onto land if it gets chucked into the ocean. Once all the food in its spot has been eaten, it will eject its internal organs to create a second foot to walk to a new location.

entry: POKENAME的腿随意伸缩，兼顾移动与进攻。无论跑步还是飞行，都能超过每小时200英里。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME's legs can extend and retract at will, which it uses as a means of both mobility and offense. It can reach speeds of over 200 mph both on foot and in flight.

entry: POKENAME拿来撑假脚的棍，看似细脆，击敌却极有力。POKENAME还能骑在上面，如弹簧高跷般飞快跳行。
author: .jerden
source: Although the stick POKENAME uses to carry around its false foot looks thin and fragile, POKENAME can strike foes with it with great force. POKENAME can also use it to hop around quickly, riding on top like a pogo stick.

entry: POKENAME初萌的波导感知，在练得极好的腿上最强。因此，得踢到人，或以脚碰到对方，才能感知波导。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's still-budding aura sense is strongest in its well-trained legs. As such, it has to kick or otherwise touch a person with its feet in order to sense their aura.

entry: POKENAME大多时间都在偷懒。弹腿明明能让它远行，饿时却只拿来从树上摘东西。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME spends most of the day loafing around. Its springy legs allow it to move great distances, but instead, it uses them to pluck from trees when it gets hungry.

entry: POKENAME对着岩壁练腿，增强踢力。若过于勉强，尾火就会摇曳不稳，得花整整数天恢复。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME trains its legs against rocky mountain walls to increase its kick power. If it overtaxes itself, the flame on its tail flickers and it needs entire days to recover.

entry: POKENAME停在洞顶，直到该狩猎，才用脚如火箭般猛冲下，一击击昏猎物。“POKENAME踢”这画面，近来媒体里很流行。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME perches on cave ceilings until it needs to hunt, rocketing downward with its foot to knock prey out in one strike. The "POKENAME Kick" is a popular image in recent media.

entry: 它极以靴子为傲，宁可冒生命危险，也不让靴子擦伤。不同地区的POKENAME，穿的品牌还不同。
author: kiwiarms
source: It takes immense pride in its boot, and is willing to risk its own life to keep the boot from being scuffed. POKENAME in other regions wear different brands.

entry: POKENAME弹簧般的腿，能让它跳得极高。最高的POKENAME跳跃纪录，超过四十英尺。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's spring-like legs enable it to jump extremely high. The highest recorded jump performed by a POKENAME was over forty feet high.

entry: 它专门寻找强大的人类和宝可梦，吸食他们的体液，或许是想借此让自己变得更强。对POKENAME来说，四处修行的空手道王是一顿求之不得的盛宴。
author: bobosmith01
source: It specifically seeks out the body fluids of powerful humans and Pokémon to feast off of, perhaps in an effort to become stronger itself. A wandering Black Belt is a highly sought-after banquet to POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME双腿弹性十足，最多能伸长30英尺。耐性与韧性极强，能在严酷沙漠中静候对手。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's legs are incredibly stretchy and can reach up to 30 feet. It is incredibly resilient, patiently waiting for an opponent in the harsh desert.

entry: POKENAME在战斗中用沙子塑出强健的腿，从四面八方连续踢向对手。只要把握时机发动攻击，就能摧毁这些腿，让它们重新化作一堆沙子。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME sculpts strong legs out of sand in battle, sending a barrage of kicks at its opponent from all sides. These legs can be destroyed with a well-timed attack, reducing them back to a pile of sand.

entry: POKENAME是自负的斗士，依靠双腿赢得胜利。它们坚持不懈地训练，很快就能把树木踢得残破不堪，也很难容忍训练家或队友偷懒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are prideful fighters that rely on their legs to lead them to victory. They can quickly wear down trees with their persistent training and rarely tolerate slacking off from their Trainer or teammates.

entry: POKENAME精通以踢技为主的舞蹈格斗。它惊艳的动作启发了一部广受欢迎的巡回舞蹈演出。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is a master of kick-based dance fighting. Its stunning moves have inspired a popular touring dance show.

entry: POKENAME会用四条强腿中的任意一条踢走竞争者，守住自己取食的树木。它能伸长腿来扩大攻击范围，也能把蘑菇般的身体举到空中，将孢子洒向下方的敌人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME drives away competitors from the trees it feeds on using kicks from any of its four powerful legs. It can stretch these legs out to increase its reach, or to lift up its mushroom body  into the air to shower down spores on foes below.

entry: POKENAME头上的触角能伸进深深的裂缝，确认安全后才会钻进去。遭到威胁时，这些触角也能使出强力打击。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The feelers on POKENAME's head can stretch into deep cracks, checking if it's safe before POKENAME goes in. If it is threatened, these feelers can deliver powerful blows.

entry: POKENAME喜欢以前腿支撑身体四处爬行，再伸长躯干中段，把后半身高高翘起作战。模仿这种打法的格斗家将其称为蝎式踢拳。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME prefers to fight by crawling around on its front legs, rearing its hind up with its extendable midsection. Fighters attempting to replicate this style have coined it scorpion kickboxing.

entry: POKENAME会寻找森林中宁静的地方，在阳光下冥想。如果有宝可梦打扰，它们就会全力使出凌厉的踢击。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME seek out peaceful sections of forest where they can meditate in the sunlight. If a Pokémon interrupts them, POKENAME deliver sharp kicks with all their strength.

entry: 覆盖全身的细毛能减轻冲击，对手一碰到它，就会释放出有毒的粉尘。富有弹性的腿让POKENAME能够灵巧跳跃，踢出强力的一脚。
author: fiordaliso
source: The fine hair covering its body protects it from impact and releases a poisonous dust whenever an opponent comes into contact with it. Its elastic legs allow POKENAME to jump nimbly and deliver powerful kicks.

entry: 过去，POKENAME曾被用作潜入部队，既能跃过堡垒高墙，也能击倒全副武装的士兵。它们对平衡与步法的掌控，启发了世界各地的杂技演员。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME were employed in the past as infiltration units, equally capable of leaping over fortress walls and knocking out fully armored soldiers. The control POKENAME possess over their balance and footwork has inspired acrobats worldwide.

entry: POKENAME好胜心极强，会从口中喷火灼烧对手。它凭借富有弹性的腿踢出闪电般迅猛的一击，让敌人无处可逃。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is extremely competitive and blasts fire from its mouth to burn opponents. Thanks to its elastic legs, it delivers lightning-fast kicks that leave adversaries no chance of escape.

entry: POKENAME每天都会花上数小时练习踢技。状态最佳时，它一脚就能踢倒最坚固的树木。平时，它会用这份力量保护自己深爱的人。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME spends hours every day practicing its kicking technique. At its peak, it can bring down the sturdiest of trees in a single hit. It normally uses this strength to protect people it loves.

entry: 攻击时，POKENAME会从泥土下伸出双腿。它的踢击威力十足，能轻易把铁踢出凹痕。
author: .izik
source: When attacking, POKENAME extends its legs from beneath the soil. Its kicks are powerful enough to dent iron with ease.

entry: POKENAME会在树间快速荡行，能伸长的四肢让它们轻松跨越相隔数十米的树木。它们成群结队地在大片林地中迅速巡游，一天就能走过数英里。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swing rapidly through trees, their extendable limbs allowing them to cross between trees dozens of meters apart from one another. Troops of POKENAME patrol large woodlands rapidly, covering multiple miles in a day.

entry: POKENAME喜欢玩接球游戏。训练家还没抛球，它们就会迈开轻快的大步跑进公园。它们总想在球落地前接住，为此能跃起数米高。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME love to play catch, running in long, loping strides into parks before their trainer throws the ball. They invariably try to catch balls before they can hit the ground, leaping several meters into the air to catch them.

entry: POKENAME能够伸缩的身体就像风箱，能为它喷出的火焰鼓风。不过，伸缩过快会发出响亮的吱吱声，惊动猎物，因此它并不擅长悄悄狩猎。
author: zekkenbytheden
source: POKENAME's extendable body functions as a set of bellows to the fire they breathe. However, performing this action too quickly may create loud squeaking sounds that alert their prey. This results in them being suboptimal for stealthy hunting.

entry: POKENAME既极为自律，也十分自负。它看不起大多数对手，只有对方证明自己值得一战，它才屑于出脚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses great discipline as well as a great ego. It looks down upon most others, and won't even deign to kick at an opponent until they prove worthy of the effort.

entry: POKENAME的锻炼方式是从多岩石的山坡上滚下，再一路慢跑回山顶，如此反复。它只用一脚就能踢翻一辆小卡车。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME exercises by rolling down a rocky hillside and then jogging its way all the way back to the top, over and over again. It could flip a small truck with just one kick.

entry: POKENAME能把多只脚缩进体内，滚下陡坡。在战斗中，它也善于把肢体藏起来，等待时机突然出脚袭击对手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can tuck its multiple feet into its body in order to roll down steep slopes. This also makes it adept at hiding limbs in combat until the right moment to launch surprise kicks at opponents.

entry: POKENAME身体底部的螺钉比看上去长得多，攻击时能高速向外伸出。虽然个头小，这些“踢击”却足以把隆隆岩踢飞。
author: sk372
source: The screws at the bottom of POKENAME's body are much longer than they seem, able to extend far outward at high speed as an attack. Though small, these "kicks" carry enough power to send a Golem flying.

entry: 它的脚能脱离本体自由活动，从远处的任意角度发起踢击。不过，这些脚必须定期回到本体充电，否则就可能从空中掉落，在被捡回来之前都无法使用。
author: sk372
source: Its feet can operate freely from the main body, allowing it to launch kicking attacks from long distances at any angle. They must return to it to recharge periodically, however, or risk falling out of the sky and becoming useless until retrieved.

entry: 无论在水面上还是水下，尤其是在水下，POKENAME都能甩动尾巴使出强力踢击。赢得比赛后，它会拍动手脚，庆祝胜利。
author: sk372
source: Above and especially beneath the waters, POKENAME delivers a strong kick with the swing of its tail. After winning a match, it claps its arms and feet together in celebration of victory.

entry: POKENAME会从炮筒中发射脱离身体的脚，以强力踢击远攻敌人。这些脚在发射几分钟后就会化成水。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fires disembodied feet from its cannons to assault foes with powerful kicks from a distance. A few minutes after being fired, the feet dissolve into water.

entry: POKENAME以旺盛的斗志和极其柔韧的身体闻名。虽然没有腿，被它全力踢中仍会痛得难以忍受。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME are known for their fierce fighting spirits and their incredibly flexible bodies. Despite not having any legs, being kicked by a POKENAME with full force can be extremely painful.

entry: POKENAME能轻松让双腿与头部分开行动。它们本可轻易穿过墙壁和围栏，却更喜欢把它们踢倒取乐。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can move their legs separately from their heads with great ease. They can easily phase through walls and fences but prefer to kick them down for fun.

entry: 虽然圆滚滚的身体和短小的四肢限制了POKENAME的行动，它一旦击中对手，拳头的威力却惊人无比。只要扎扎实实打上一拳，爆发的力量就足以让最沉重的宝可梦在空中翻飞。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME's round body and short limbs limit its mobility, it packs an incredible punch when it lands a hit. A single good punch from its fist carries enough explosive force to send the heaviest of Pokémon careening through the air.

entry: POKENAME的武艺无人能及，同类之间的战斗甚至能持续数月。它为自己的成就而自负，身上的服装正是这份虚荣的象征。它会不惜一切代价保护这身衣服。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's mastery of martial arts is beyond compare, so much that fights between individuals can last months. The outfit it wears is a symbol of its vanity due its accomplishments. It will protect its outfit by any means necessary.

entry: POKENAME常与铁壳蛹融合型的快拳蛹切磋，对方更擅长出拳。每受一击，它就离进化更近一步。
author: cataylor_01
source: POKENAME often spars with its counterpart, Hitmonuna, which are better at punching. With each hit they take, they get closer to evolution.

entry: POKENAME从不直接击打敌人，只需朝空气挥拳，就能让对手感受到冲击。有趣的是，这种攻击依然靠肌肉发力，而非精神力量。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME never physically strikes its foes, but by punching the air it can cause foes to feel the impact. Interestingly, these attacks are still powered by POKENAME's muscles rather than by mental exertion.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME会专注于保持平稳的出拳节奏。经验丰富的个体每分钟能挥出两百多拳。
author: wiz0z
source: In a fight, POKENAME focus on maintaining a steady rhythm to their punches. Experienced POKENAME are able to maintain a tempo of over two hundred punches per minute.

entry: 逆着水流游动时，POKENAME会不断挥拳扰乱水流，方便自己前进。它主要的攻击方式是跃至对手头顶数英尺处，接连向下打出数十拳。
author: soup1900
source: When swimming through currents, POKENAME repeatedly fires punches to disturb the water flow and allow easy passage. Its main attack style is to jump several feet above opponents and volley dozens of punches downward in quick succession.

entry: POKENAME常与铁甲蛹融合型的快拳蛹切磋，对方更擅长防守。每次命中，它就离进化更近一步。
author: cataylor_01
source: POKENAME often spars with its counterpart, Hitmonpod, which are better at defending. With each hit they make, they get closer to evolution.

entry: POKENAME是狂暴的斗士，会用双拳宣泄压抑的攻击欲。如果一拳把敌人打飞，它就会用念力把对方拉回来，只为继续痛殴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a furious fighter, venting out its pent-up aggression through its fists. If a punch sends its foe flying off, it uses telekinesis to pull them back to it just so it can continue pummeling them.

entry: POKENAME是个拳击好手，总渴望挑战体形更大的对手。它会用瞬间移动躲开攻击，出现在最适合反击的位置，再挥出重拳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a pugilist always eager to test its mettle against larger opponents. It dodges strikes with teleportation, reappearing in the perfect position to deliver punishing counter-punches.

entry: 由于翅膀限制了拳头的攻击范围，POKENAME采取防守打法。它训练时会四处蹦跳，朝自己扬起的尘土挥拳。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME fights defensively since its wings limit the range of its fists. It trains by hopping about, throwing punches at dust clouds that it kicks up.

entry: POKENAME清晨便起床训练，直到深夜才感到疲倦。睡前，它会在夜空中短暂飞行，洒下发光的粉末。过去，健美运动员曾食用这种粉末。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME wakes early in the morning to train and only tires late at night. Before falling asleep, it takes a small flight through the night sky. During this time, it gives off a glowing powder that, historically, has been consumed by bodybuilders.

entry: POKENAME战斗时始终小步跳动，一边保持移动，一边寻找出拳的破绽。它的拳头能在树干上打出洞来，平时便靠这项本领捕捉虫子。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME remains in constant motion during combat by executing short hops while watching for an opening to strike. Its punches can knock holes in trees, a skill it uses to hunt for bugs.

entry: POKENAME挥出的每一拳都带着电力。不过，它常常耗电过多，只打出几拳就精疲力竭了。
author: darkweavile428
source: Every punch that POKENAME throws is packed with electricity. However, it often uses up too much electricity and runs out of energy after only a few punches.

entry: POKENAME会互相对练，磨炼出奇有力的拳头。可手臂太短，常难以打中对手。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be seen sparring with each other to train their surprisingly powerful punches. They struggle to hit their opponents due to their short arms.

entry: 由于双臂攻击范围有限，POKENAME主要用手臂上的拳套格挡。进攻时，它更常使用尾巴上的拳头，既能打得更远，也能像弹簧一样蓄力，突然挥出重拳。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME primarily uses the gloves on its arms to block attacks due to their limited range. It more often uses the fist on its tail for offense, due to its reach and ability to spring-load a powerful sucker punch.

entry: POKENAME十分胆小，经常躲在墙后。它们喜欢绿色的食物，吃得足够多后，挥出的拳头甚至能震动地面。
author: agostostino
source: POKENAME are so cowardly that they often hide behind walls. POKENAME love green food; when they eat enough of it, they can throw punches that can shake the ground.

entry: POKENAME把头上的附肢当作手臂使用。虽然攻击范围不大，却能以惊人的速度伸出，往往让对手还没弄清发生了什么就被击倒。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME uses the appendages on its head as arms. Though they have a short range, they can extend at incredible speeds, often knocking out opponents before they know what hit them.

entry: POKENAME脾气暴躁，常为证明自己的实力而挑起争斗。它们会朝其他宝可梦猛冲，把背上厚实的花朵当作拳头挥去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are ornery Pokémon, prone to picking fights in an effort to prove their own strength. They launch themselves at other Pokémon using the dense flower on their back as though it were a fist.

entry: POKENAME技艺高超，打起架来却不讲规矩。一旦发现自己快要落败，它就会咬住对手，趁对方无法挣脱时一顿猛打。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME is a skilled, yet unfair fighter. If it finds that it is losing a match, it will bite its opponent and pummel them while they're restrained.

entry: POKENAME颇具攻击性，经常激动得不顾一切，为了接近眼前的敌人，会朝沿途的人和物统统挥拳。它们的拳头只需两击就能打裂混凝土。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are quite aggressive, often getting so worked up that they will punch anyone and anything to get to an enemy they see. Their punches are strong enough to crack through concrete in two hits.

entry: POKENAME擅长用快速刺拳制服对手。如果拳头无法结束战斗，它就可能用毒刺逐渐消磨对方。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME specializes in quick punching jabs to subdue opponents. If it cannot end a match with a punch, it may use a venomous barb to whittle down the opponent.

entry: POKENAME拥有其他宝可梦难以企及的精湛拳术。凭借灵活的身体和随时准备战斗的架势，它能以快得无法看清的速度，瞬间连出50拳，威力惊人。
author: violet_zero
source: POKENAME has a refined boxing ability unlike any other Pokémon. With its lithe body and battle-ready stance, its destructive fists can throw 50 punches in a flurry of untraceable speed.

entry: 有POKENAME参加的战斗出了名地沉闷漫长。它会笨拙地前后摇晃，分析敌人的行动，倾向于一击结束战斗。这究竟是懒散还是果断，人们争论不休。
author: ludacriswell
source: Battles involving POKENAME are known to be boring and drawn out. They awkwardly sway back and forth while analyzing a foe and prefer to end a battle with a single strike. Whether this is lazy or decisive behavior is hotly debated.

entry: POKENAME好勇斗狠，在拳击比赛中绝不认输。不是它倒下，就是对手倒下。它也不介意使诈。
author: musicsheep.
