source: POKENAME is feisty and never gives up in a boxing match. Either POKENAME goes down, or the opponent goes down. POKENAME isn't above cheating, either.

entry: 哪怕遭到痛打，POKENAME也绝不会弃赛。即使已到强弩之末，它仍会坚持战斗，必要时甚至会使诈求胜。
author: musicsheep.
source: Despite taking a serious beating, POKENAME never forfeits a match. Even on its last leg, it will push on and even cheat to win if it has to.

entry: POKENAME头部周围长有坚硬的护甲，可以保护头骨，抵御对手以及一同训练的同类的攻击。人类设计拳击护具时，或许就曾受它启发。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has firm protective plating formed around the head, so that its skull is guarded against opponents and other POKENAME it trains with. Humanity may have taken inspiration from it when creating boxing safety gear.

entry: POKENAME精通多数武术，尤其擅长拳击。它的拳头在纯粹的力量上略有不足，但拳术会随着练习迅速进步。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are adept in most forms of martial arts, but specialise in boxing. Their punches leave something to be desired in terms of sheer strength, though their skills improve rapidly with practice.

entry: POKENAME会让拳击手击打自己的身体，帮助他们备赛。每一拳的冲击都会分散到众多鳞片上，因此它们不会受到严重的伤害。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME help boxers train for their matches by allowing boxers to punch their body. The impact of each punch is spread over POKENAME's many scales, protecting them from major injuries.

entry: POKENAME会彼此切磋，同时锻炼身体和电力。它们训练的地方常有雷暴发生。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME spar with one another to bolster both their physical bodies and their electrical powers. There are often lightning storms in the areas where POKENAME train.

entry: POKENAME用粗重尾巴砸击树木与岩石，锻炼力量。实际比看起来强得多，一击足以将钢梁打凹。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hone their strength by smashing their hefty tails into trees and rocks. They are deceptively strong, striking with enough force to dent a steel beam.

entry: POKENAME身手全面，能躲过赤手空拳的劲敌乌鸦鳞甲龙的攻击；后者是乌鸦头头与杖尾鳞甲龙的融合体。POKENAME会用拳套猛击地面，借力跃起，再落到对手身上。
author: loikthescreamo
source: POKENAME are so versatile, they can dodge attacks coming from their bare-knuckle rival, Honchmo-o, the fusion between Honchkrow and Kommo-o. With their punching gloves, POKENAME punch the ground to spring into the air, then land on their opponents.

entry: 人们经常看见POKENAME在电视机前或拳台边观看拳击比赛。它会模仿选手的动作，将自己的拳术磨炼得尽善尽美。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is often found watching boxing matches on television or from the ringside. It mimics the moves of the combatants, honing its punching skills to perfection.

entry: POKENAME的四肢攻击有力，范围也很广。它会利用强大的磁力，迅速绕到对手身边最有利的角度发动攻击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's limbs deliver powerful blows and have a long reach. It uses strong magnetism to quickly maneuver around opponents and strike from the best angles.

entry: 虽然POKENAME几乎什么都能吃，但要进一步提升身体素质，仍然需要摄取适当的营养。因此，它吃的东西即使千奇百怪，也都是经过仔细挑选的。
author: bobosmith01
source: While POKENAME can eat almost anything, it still must get proper nutrients to push its physical performance further. Therefore, although it may eat many odd things, what it chooses to eat is always done with careful consideration.

entry: POKENAME一拳就能让发电机短路。它全身充盈着纯粹的电力与斗志。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME can short-circuit power generators with a single punch. Its entire body is overflowing with pure electricity and fighting spirit.

entry: POKENAME只需朝地面挥拳，就能打出小坑。它喜欢沙浴，谁要是打扰它洗澡，就会挨上一拳。
author: ichosuzu
source: POKENAME can make small holes in the ground simply by punching it. It likes to bathe in the sand and will punch anyone who interrupts its baths.

entry: 人们认为，融合不知为何让POKENAME困在了现实与网络空间之间。它的四肢会无规律地起伏、互换位置。面对这副仿佛程序出错的模样，几乎没人能看上多久而不头痛。
author: sk372
source: It's thought that fusion has somehow caused POKENAME to be stuck between the real world and cyberspace. Its limbs undulate and swap around at random, and few can look at its glitchy form for long without developing headaches.

entry: POKENAME是以舞作战的典范。它能以芭蕾舞者般的优雅躲开敌人的攻击，再还以强力反击拳，整套舞步始终丝毫不乱。
author: sk372
source: A prime example of a dance-battler, POKENAME dodges a foe's strikes with ballerina-like grace, and returns with a punishing counter-punch without missing a step in its dance routine.

entry: POKENAME磨炼双拳，是为了保护自己在乎的人。有训练家的个体练得尤其刻苦，经常累得筋疲力尽，还得被强行叫停才肯休息。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME trains its fists to protect those it cares for. Those with a Trainer hone themselves particularly fiercely, often needing to be forced to stop and rest their exhausted body.

entry: POKENAME身体轻盈，只要守势不乱，就能不知疲倦地接连向对手挥拳。一旦防守失误，这场比赛多半就输了。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are lightweight creatures that can continue launching punches on their opponent without getting tired so long as they keep their guard up. If their guard fails, they very likely have lost the match.

entry: POKENAME会隐蔽身形，在丛林中游荡，寻找强大的对手。发现值得一战的目标后，它便从灌木丛中跃出，准备一直打到自己认为足够为止。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME roams the jungle camouflaged as it seeks strong opponents. Once POKENAME has found a worthy target, it jumps out from the bushes to reveal itself, ready to fight for as long as it sees necessary.

entry: 虽然POKENAME斗志旺盛，攻击力也不错，却有些不堪一击。哪怕只是牙齿挨上一下，它也会立刻逃窜，斗志全无。
author: sk372
source: Though it has good fighting spirit and decent offense, POKENAME has something of a glass jaw; even a single hit impacting its tooth will send it scurrying away, the will to fight completely gone.

entry: POKENAME对战斗和练习的热情几乎无穷无尽。只要有什么靠近，它就会从楔石中现身，与对方拳脚相向。幽灵般的身体让它能够伸长四肢，隔着很远出拳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's vigor for combat and practice is nearly infinite. It will rise from its keystone to fistfight anything that draws near, its spectral form letting it stretch its limbs to punch from long distances.

entry: POKENAME脾气暴躁，常为证明实力而挑起争斗。它挥动柔韧藤蔓末端的多朵拳头状花朵，抽打所有靠得太近的人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are ornery Pokémon, prone to picking fights in an effort to prove their own strength. They wield multiple fist-like flowers at the end of flexible vines, using them to lash out at anyone getting too close.

entry: 头发像沙袋，POKENAME一天大部分时间都在用它练拳。战斗不顺时，会狂甩头发，想以蛮力击退对手。
author: mistymagius
source: Its hair acts like a punching bag which POKENAME uses to train its punches for most of the day. If it is struggling in a fight, it will swing its hair wildly trying to knock away its opponent with extreme force.

entry: POKENAME头骨上的红色衬垫坚如岩石，却依然能够保护大脑免受冲击。虽然手臂短小，它能迅速向前探头，如同挥拳一般击打对手。
author: .jerden
source: The red padding on POKENAME's skull is as hard as rock, but still protects its brain from impacts. Although its arms are small, it can rapidly push its head forward to strike as if it were punching.

entry: POKENAME从不停歇地训练，用双拳打倒整棵树、击毁砖墙，提升力量。据说，只要训练到家，它那钢铁般的双拳就能将整座山劈成两半。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME never stop training, breaking down entire trees or brick walls with their fists to raise their strength. It is said that when a POKENAME has trained hard enough, their steel-like fists can cleave entire mountains in half.

entry: 被POKENAME一拳击中的人，会短暂看见一片诡异景象。有人认为，被它打昏便能与死者交流，但也有从此一睡不醒的风险。
author: .jerden
source: People struck by one of POKENAME's punches experience a brief vision of an eerie landscape. It has been suggested that being knocked unconscious by POKENAME would enable communication with the dead, but there is a risk of never waking up.

entry: POKENAME的拳套里装有强力磁铁，一旦锁定敌人，就会被向前推进。它会来回飘浮，等待对手出招，再借助磁力排斥躲开攻击，回以毁灭性的一击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's gloves contain powerful magnets, propelling them forward once they've locked onto a foe. POKENAME floats back and forth as it waits for its opponent to strike, magnetically repelling itself to dodge before delivering a devastating counter.

entry: 人们认为，这是一位令人生畏的武僧，生前穿过的残甲，如今又被他的灵魂附身。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: It's thought to be the remains of armor once worn by a fearsome battle-monk, now possessed by their spirit.

entry: POKENAME战斗时轻巧地飘来飘去，躲开攻击，再用重拳反击。如果急于求胜，它还能让双拳化为利刃，增强威力并扩大攻击范围。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats around deftly in battle, dodging strikes and countering with strong punches. If desperate to win a fight, its fists can become blades, giving it more power and reach.

entry: 虽然POKENAME轻易就能打穿金属板，却同样容易灰心。每当它需要鼓励时，一副拳击手套便能提醒它：自己激励着人们变得更强，每天都不要停止进步。
author: quackquackattack
source: Even though POKENAME can easily punch through sheet metal, they are just as easily discouraged. Whenever they need a boost, a Punching Glove helps remind them that they inspire people to grow stronger, and to never stop getting better every day.

entry: POKENAME的出拳快如闪电，肉眼几乎无法看清。职业拳击手会和它一起练习防守。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME's lightning-fast punches are nearly impossible to see with the naked eye. Professional boxers will practice their guards with this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME酷爱拳脚相向，能打赢体形比自己大的敌人。它使出的真气拳能够一击结束战斗，因此深受拳击手喜爱。每赢一场，它都会倍感自豪。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME loves getting into fist fights and is capable of winning against foes larger than itself. This Pokémon is adored by boxers for its one-hit Focus Punch that can instantly end fights. Each fight won instills great pride in itself.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME能把拳套般的拳头装进炮筒。拳头射出时，蓄力过程中积聚的热量与压力会使后方喷出滚烫的蒸汽。
author: bigoljax
source: When in battle, POKENAME are able to load their boxing glove-like fists into their cannons. As their fists are shot out, hot steam blows behind due to the heat and pressure while charging their shots.

entry: POKENAME的右拳套带有速效毒，左拳套则带有慢性毒。它交替快速出拳，延长两种毒素的作用时间，让对手晕头转向。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME's right glove has fast-acting poison and the left has slow-acting. By alternating its rapid strikes, it drags out the effect of both toxins, disorienting its opponents.

entry: POKENAME是敏捷的斗士，双拳包裹着浓密的毛发，会在击中目标时变硬。不断颤动的长耳能捕捉气流变化，让它躲开攻击，再以一连串精准拳击反击。它整日训练，直到能一拳裂石。
author: cerealjamalt
source: POKENAME is a swift fighter that wraps its fists in dense fur that hardens on impact. Long, twitching ears pick up shifts in the air, letting it dodge and counter with a barrage of precise punches. It trains all day until its blows can crack stone.

entry: POKENAME会在对手头边飘浮，用小小的拳头打出重击。每一次击中，都会伴随一道耀眼的闪光。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME floats around its opponent's head, delivering powerful punches with its small fists. Each impact is accompanied by a bright flash of light.

entry: 尽管手臂短小，POKENAME的拳头却像小型陨石，能击穿混凝土。它们喜欢避开旁人的目光，在夜间训练，钻研新奇得近乎不可思议的招式。
author: npshi
source: Despite their short arms, POKENAME's punches are capable of piercing concrete like a small meteor. These Pokémon like to train at night, away from prying eyes, to create new and almost fantastical techniques.

entry: POKENAME会从口中迅速弹出一只巨拳，痛打那些差点踩到它的家伙。拳头的力道足以把敌人远远打飞，落进海里。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME speedily ejects a large fist from its mouth to batter those that were about to step on it. The force of its punches is powerful enough to launch foes flying far away into the sea.

entry: POKENAME拿在棍子上的拳击手套看起来一用就会折断，实际上却能打出重拳般的威力，棍子也不会断。它通常无意伤害其他宝可梦，只是玩得太粗鲁罢了。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME's boxing glove on a stick seems like it would immediately break if used, it can strike with the force of a punch without snapping. POKENAME  doesn't usually mean to harm other Pokémon, and is just playing roughly.

entry: POKENAME是只酷爱挥拳的小犬，能通过拳脚交锋增强波导。在格外激烈的训练或战斗中，它甚至会随着每次挥拳释放出波导。
author: sk372
source: A pugilistic pup with a penchant for punches, POKENAME powers up its aura through fisticuffs. In particularly intense training bouts or battles, its fists may even begin emitting aura with each swing.

entry: 流传甚广的传说称，第一个发现这种融合体的人，刚把它放出来，头部就挨了致命一击。未经训练的POKENAME极其凶暴，通常得绑住双手，以免发生意外。
author: jangodiot
source: A common myth is that the first person to discover this fusion suffered a fatal blow to the head immediately on release. POKENAME are extremely aggressive if untrained and usually require their hands tied to prevent incidents.

entry: 尽管POKENAME战斗力强大，却经常被体形更大的宝可梦小看。每次获胜后，它都会高喊自己独有的战吼。
author: thistleblower
source: Despite its powerful fighting ability, POKENAME is often underestimated by larger Pokémon. After every victory, it chants its own battle cry.

entry: POKENAME极其在意自己的外貌。只要觉得有人因为长相而瞧不起它，就会暴怒地朝对方脸上连挥数拳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is extremely self-conscious about its appearance. If it even thinks a person is looking down on it for its looks, it responds with extreme aggression and numerous fists to the face.

entry: POKENAME的手臂肌肉相对薄弱，因此更喜欢用头撞击。头顶的红色器官能够缓冲冲击，保护头骨免受损伤。
author: fancyskunk
source: Because their arm muscles are relatively weak, POKENAME prefer to attack with headbutts. The red organ atop their heads provides cushioning to protect their skulls from damage.

entry: 虽然还需要提升控火本领，POKENAME已经是一位出色的拳击手。它顽强而好战，旺盛的斗志令对战爱好者十分喜爱。
author: fiordaliso
source: Though it still needs to improve its control over its flames, POKENAME is an excellent boxer. It is a tenacious and highly combative Pokémon; its fighting spirit makes it popular among battle enthusiasts.

entry: 虽然体重很轻，POKENAME却力大无穷，喜爱与人切磋。它的身体富有橡胶般的弹性，因此不太怕钝器冲击。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite being lightweight, POKENAME is incredibly strong and loves to spar with others. Because of its rubbery body, blunt-force impacts don't hurt it that much.

entry: POKENAME会飞到其他生物上方，用拳头般的脚击打它们，借此锻炼。由于个头很小，这些攻击与其说疼，不如说相当烦人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME trains itself by flying above and striking others with its fist-feet. Because of its small stature, the strikes are viewed more as a considerable nuisance than actually painful.

entry: POKENAME狩猎时只用拳头，从不用獠牙。它会与猎物一对一交战，只有堂堂正正地把对手打昏，才肯下口吸血。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME never uses its fangs while hunting, only its fists. It fights prey one-on-one, and only deigns to sink its teeth and draw blood if it has knocked an opponent out in a straightforward bout.

entry: POKENAME斗志旺盛，会向敌人疯狂挥拳。可惜手臂又短，速度又慢，追击对手颇为吃力。它越是拼命，就越会像出汗一样渗出大量黏液。
author: mochauspocus
source: POKENAME has an intense fighting spirit, swinging its fists wildly at foes. Unfortunately, its stubby arms and slow speed make pursuing opponents quite the task. The harder it tries, the more mucus it sweats out.

entry: POKENAME冰封的双拳能让周围空气降温，每次挥拳都会结出冰。据说，就算最炽热的火属性宝可梦，只挨上一记刺拳，也会被冻得结结实实。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's frozen fists chill the air around it, forming ice whenever it throws a punch. It is said that even the hottest of Fire-Type Pokémon will be frozen solid from getting hit by even a single jab.

entry: POKENAME挥舞着火箭推进的双拳，无情痛打它眼中制造不公的家伙。它会寻求伙伴的帮助，发挥全部潜力。
author: coridiant
source: With rocket-powered fists, POKENAME mercilessly pummels those it perceives to be causing injustice. It enlists the help of a companion to reach its full potential.

entry: POKENAME的拳法毫无章法，只会疯狂抡动手臂，直到打中什么为止。它会在战斗前后频繁喝水，甚至喝得过多，导致身体发胀，一时行动迟缓。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's boxing style is unrefined, consisting of wild swinging of its arms until it hits something. It hydrates itself often before and after battle, to the point of excess, leaving it bloated and slower-moving for a time.

entry: 它背上的蘑菇伞盖经受过无数次撞击，变得十分坚韧。POKENAME能用力向上跃起，用这些拳头般的突起从下方击打敌人。
author: .jerden
source: The caps of the mushrooms on its back have become toughened by many impacts. POKENAME can leap upwards with great force, striking foes from below with these fist-like protrusions.

entry: POKENAME的战斗动作轻盈灵活，如同舞步。它在打法中融入大量旋转动作，尤其擅长转身挥出反手拳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's combat movements are light and limber, akin to dance moves. It incorporates many twirls into its fighting style and specializes in spinning backhanded punches.

entry: POKENAME会用前肢的强力打击，赶走所有争夺其取食树木的竞争者。为了出击时不伤到自己，它会在钳子里握住坚韧的红色蘑菇伞盖。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will drive off any competition for the trees it feeds on using powerful strikes with its forelimbs. To avoid injuring itself as it delivers these blows, POKENAME holds tough red mushroom caps in its claws.

entry: POKENAME天性平和，只在遭受威胁时才会战斗。不过，一旦受到挑战，它就是可怕的对手，能让巨大而坚硬如岩石的双拳以超音速挥出。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is peaceful by nature, only fighting when threatened. However, it is a fearsome foe if challenged, as it can propel its massive, rock-hard fists to supersonic speeds when throwing punches.

entry: POKENAME在拳击界备受推崇，面对三首恶龙、袋兽这样的强敌也不落下风。研究表明，它们在阿罗拉的不良少年中相当受欢迎。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are admired in the world of boxing, able to hold their own against the likes of Hydreigon and Kangaskhan. Research has shown that they are quite popular with delinquents in Alola.

entry: POKENAME很讲究战术，总会寻找对手防守中的空隙，再挥出重拳。它全身覆盖着浓密毛发，一旦受到击打，就会释放有毒的孢子。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a highly strategic fighter who seeks to find openings in its opponents' defenses in order to deliver powerful punches. Its body is covered in thick fur that releases poisonous spores whenever it is struck.

entry: POKENAME凭借灵活的身手与力量，赢得过多项宝可梦拳击锦标赛。人们会请它们担任陪练，帮助自己赢得拳击比赛。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME have won many Pokémon boxing championships with their maneuverability and power. People use POKENAME as sparring partners to help them win boxing matches.

entry: POKENAME是凶猛的斗士，喜爱与人单挑，证明自己的拳法。濒临倒下时，它尾巴上的火焰会燃得前所未有地明亮，释放出全部力量。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a fierce brawler that loves dueling to prove its punching prowess. When it's close to being knocked out, the flame on its tail burns brighter than ever as it unleashes its full strength.

entry: POKENAME会用藏在地下的拳头快速连击。只要集中攻击同一点，就能击穿钢铁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME launches rapid punches from fists hidden underground. By focusing strikes on one point, it can pierce steel.

entry: 除非有奖杯或其他闪亮奖品可争，POKENAME绝不肯战斗。它们依靠迅速的挥击和灵活的动作，在交锋中压过对手。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME refuse to battle unless a trophy or some other shiny prize is at stake. They rely on swift swipes and agile movements to outmaneuver opponents.

entry: POKENAME是聪明的斗士，会把双脚浸在水中训练。这能帮助它们练出闪电般迅捷的步法，确保每一拳都能发挥最大效果。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are clever fighters that train with their feet submerged in water. This allows them to develop lightning-fast footwork to ensure their punches land with maximum effectiveness.

entry: POKENAME常被称为“野火”，因为有人见过它突然俯冲向野外对战的训练家，把眼前的一切尽数击倒。据说，它双手上的火焰一旦熄灭，斗志也会随之消失。
author: seanothan_23
source: POKENAME is often nicknamed "The Wildfire" as it has been seen swooping in on Trainers battling in the wild and knocking out everything in sight. It is also said that if the flames on its hands go out, then so will its fighting spirit.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，会用精神力量感知周围的敌意。如果有对手趁它熟睡时挑战，它会抢先挥拳，瞪对方一眼，再瞬间移动离开。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Whenever it sleeps, POKENAME uses its psychic powers to sense any hostility in the area. If an opponent tries to challenge POKENAME during its slumber, it will punch them before they get the chance, glaring at them before teleporting away.

entry: POKENAME的四条手臂能创造出前所未有的出击机会，在拳台和战场上都极其危险。它会一直挥拳，直到自己倒下才肯罢休。
author: turbo_gerbil
source: POKENAME's four arms open up unprecedented striking opportunities, making it deadly in the ring and in battle. It strikes until it faints and not a moment sooner.

entry: POKENAME酷爱胜利，自尊心却脆弱得很，甚至会故意找弱小的对手，确保自己不会输。哪怕只输过一次，它也可能从此彻底放弃战斗。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME love winning and have extremely fragile egos, so much so that they will intentionally seek out weak opponents to make sure they don't lose. If a POKENAME loses even once, it can give up fighting entirely.

entry: 构成POKENAME身体的岩石，比普通小拳石的岩石软得多。为了在不断战斗、变强的过程中不碎裂，它们会戴上手套。
author: bradlybro199
source: The rock that a POKENAME is made of is much softer than a regular Geodude. In order to continue fighting and getting stronger without crumbling, POKENAME cover their hands with gloves.

entry: POKENAME常拍打胸膛挑衅，激对手先出手。中了这招的敌人，就会迎来它四只拳头的猛烈反击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME often taunts an opponent by beating its chest, daring a foe to take the first hit. Those that fall for the gambit find themselves hit by a punishing counter from POKENAME's four fists.

entry: POKENAME掌握了一套独特的攻防方式。它先缩成球状高速滚动，岩石身躯几乎刀枪不入，再突然展开身体，快速挥拳，将对手打飞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has mastered a unique style of defense and offense. It tucks itself into a sphere and rolls at high speeds, its stone body near impervious to damage, before it springs out with quick punches that send opponents flying.

entry: POKENAME坚固的壳能帮它承受更多攻击，却也拖慢了出拳速度。它们会击打速度球，练习反应。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a sturdy shell that allows them to soak up more hits but also slows down their punches. They practice against speed bags to help them improve their reflexes.

entry: 虽然拳头本来就很有威力，POKENAME尤其擅长对付钢属性敌人。它会改变双拳的磁极，让拳头受到目标吸引，从而以更快的速度、更大的力量击打金属敌人。
author: sk372
source: Though its punches are already potent, POKENAME excels in fighting Steel-type opponents. It shifts the polarity of its fists so they magnetize toward the target, increasing the speed and force it can punch metallic foes with.

entry: POKENAME戴着拳套的双拳能穿过实体物体，隔着房间击打别人。它会与其他幽灵宝可梦争斗，看看谁更配盘踞在某个地方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's gloved fists can pass through solid objects, punching others from a completely different room. It picks fights with other Ghost Pokémon to see who's more worthy of haunting a location.

entry: POKENAME的舌头会分泌难以清除的黏稠唾液。只要被它舔上一口，鳃就可能无法正常工作，因此它们是出色的水中猎手。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release a sticky saliva from their tongue that is difficult to remove. One lick from a POKENAME can prevent gills from functioning properly, which makes them great aquatic hunters.

entry: POKENAME的舌头比身体的两倍还长，主要靠它感知周围环境。如果有鸟宝可梦想吃掉它，它就会用黏稠的唾液涂满对方的翅膀，让其难以飞行。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's tongue is over twice its body length, so it mainly uses it to determine its surroundings. If any bird Pokémon tries to eat it, it will coat their wings in its sticky saliva, making it difficult for them to fly.

entry: POKENAME的头骨中盘着一条细长的舌头。一旦甩出，就能以足以打断骨头的力量抽击敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides a long, thin tongue coiled within its skull. When unleashed, it can lash foes with enough force to break bone.

entry: 不管是随身携带的石鞭，还是厚实的舌头，都能让POKENAME随时痛击对手。它很愿意保护住在附近、年幼而弱小的宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: Between the stone whip it carries and its thick tongue, POKENAME is never lacking a tool to bludgeon opponents. It's quite protective of smaller, younger Pokémon it resides near.

entry: 只要有什么引起兴趣，POKENAME就会冲过去，打算好好舔个遍。不巧挡在它与目标之间的东西，都会被撞翻。
author: sk372
source: If something piques its interest, POKENAME will charge towards it, intent on licking it thoroughly. It will bowl over anything unfortunate enough to get between it and its target.

entry: POKENAME会用舌头猛击洞壁，震落碎石。它会吞下这些石头，让原本坚韧的身体变得更加坚硬结实。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slams its tongue against cave walls to dislodge gravel. It consumes the stones to harden and reinforce its tough body.

entry: 把营养丰富的蛋送给别人前，POKENAME总要先仔细舔一遍，确保干净。虽然本意是表达善意，却常让收下蛋的一方有些尴尬。
author: sk372
source: Before offering any of its nutritious eggs to others, POKENAME will thoroughly lick them to ensure they are clean. While meant as a gesture of goodwill, this often makes the exchange feel awkward for the other party.

entry: POKENAME会调动身体的每一个部位，默不作声地模仿其他宝可梦。许多模仿动作，都要靠它巧妙运用灵活的舌头才能完成。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses every part of its body in its silent impersonation of other Pokémon. Many of its impressions are only possible through the creative uses of its dexterous tongue.

entry: POKENAME手臂上舌头般的器官能四处戳探，判断东西是否美味。它喜欢住在长有大量酸味树果的地方。
author: sk372
source: The tongue-like organs on POKENAME's arms let it poke and prod at things to determine if they are tasty or not. It favors areas where lots of tart-flavored berries grow.

entry: POKENAME先用黏稠的舌头缠住猎物，再用凶猛的大钳狠狠夹住，结束猎物的性命。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME entangles prey with its sticky tongue before finishing them off with a crushing grip from its brutal pincers.

entry: 吃到不合口味的东西，它就会勃然大怒，失去理智。每只POKENAME都有不同的心头好，喂上一口，便能让它平静。
author: staghorn
source: When it tastes something unpleasant, it flies into a blind rage. Each POKENAME has a different favorite food that will calm it down.

entry: POKENAME住在树皮内，会挖出很大的空洞藏身，等待进化。它们几乎没有天然的防御手段，肥胖的粉红色身体更让它们成为捕食者眼中的上好猎物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live inside tree bark, creating large hollows to hide in while they wait to evolve. They have very few natural defences, their fat pink bodies making them prime targets for predators.

entry: POKENAME如果在变身前不久舔过模仿对象，变身就会更加准确。研究表明，残留的味道有助于它记住更细微的特征。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's transformative accuracy increases if it has licked the object it intends to mimic shortly before changing. Research suggests the lingering taste of what it licked helps it remember finer details.

entry: POKENAME有些爱恶作剧，喜欢躲在电脑主机之间等待。有人伸手操作电脑时，它就会把对方的手舔得满是口水，然后蹦跳着跑开。
author: sk372
source: A bit of a prankster, POKENAME likes to hide among computer towers and wait. When someone goes to interact with the computer, it gives their hand a messy lick before hopping away.

entry: POKENAME舔舐光盘就能复制其中的数据，还能把数据传到空白光盘上。它们常被用于制作招式学习器，不过，它们也很喜欢把整张光盘当零食吃掉。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME are able to copy data by licking discs and can transfer this data to other blank discs. POKENAME are often used in creating TMs, though POKENAME often enjoy eating the discs whole as a snack.

entry: POKENAME的舌头紧紧缠绕着身体。受到惊吓或感到兴奋时，舌头就会变得坚硬如石，保护它免受伤害。
author: the_lunarian
source: POKENAME's tongue wraps tightly around its body. When it is frightened or excited, the tongue hardens like stone and shields POKENAME from harm.

entry: POKENAME的长舌与精神能力相连。舔舐一个人时，它能读出对方的想法；不过，它也单纯享受舔舐其他生物的乐趣。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's long tongue is linked to its mental abilities. It reads a person's mind by licking them, though it also simply enjoys the act of licking another creature.

entry: POKENAME喜爱舔食树干上的树液。它的唾液能迅速促进植物生长，被舔过的地方几天内就会长满苔藓与常春藤。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME love to lick the sap off the trunks of trees. Their saliva rapidly promotes plant growth, covering the areas they lick with moss and ivy within days.

entry: POKENAME长着长舌头和细小的锯齿状牙齿。吃东西时，它们常不小心咬到舌头，尤其是吃得匆忙的时候。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have long tongues and small serrated teeth. They often accidentally bite their tongue when eating, especially when rushed.

entry: POKENAME依靠舌头捕捉猎物，舌上细小的钩刺能牢牢钩住甲壳和鳞片。等猎物筋疲力尽，它再使出几次翅膀攻击，下一餐便有了着落。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their tongues to help them catch prey, as each tongue has microscopic hooks that cling to chitin and scales. After tiring out their prey, a few strikes of a Wing Attack secure their next meal.

entry: POKENAME太重，无法飞行，便用强健柔韧的下半身蹬地，将自己弹到数米高的空中，再用翅膀控制方向。
author: chorb33
source: As POKENAME is too heavy to fly, it instead catapaults itself many meters into the air off the ground using its strong and flexible lower body and steers with its wings.

entry: POKENAME把长舌举在头顶，仿佛羽冠。许多需要清洁甲壳或鳞片的宝可梦会聚过来，请它梳洗。作为回报，POKENAME能收到许多树果。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hold their long tongues above their heads like feathery crests. Many Pokémon flock to POKENAME for grooming sessions, as many Pokémon need help cleaning their shells or scales. In return, POKENAME gets lots of berries from others.

entry: POKENAME会舔舐遇到的一切，以此认识世界。这种举动非但没有危及这只幼年宝可梦，反而有助于增强它的免疫系统。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME licks everything it encounters to learn about the world. Rather than endangering this baby Pokémon, this action helps build its immune system.

entry: POKENAME的舌头带有羊毛产生的部分静电。被它舔过后，会有一阵轻微刺痛、令人麻痹的电流传遍全身。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tongue carries some measure of the static charge that its wool generates. Being licked by it will cause a mildly painful and paralytic jolt to course through the body.

entry: POKENAME能把舌头伸到身后，舔去尘土和污垢，所以羽毛几乎总是干净的。这条有力的舌头也是出色的猎具，只需抽打几下，就能击昏虫属性宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME feathers almost always remain clean, as they can reach behind their body with their tongue to remove dirt and grime. These powerful tongues also make great hunting tools, as a few slaps of the tongue can knock out Bug-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME视力出众，又能发出明亮的光，因此是很受欢迎的灯塔看守。如果发现船只即将撞上礁岸，它就会把舌头绕过岩石，托住船身，帮船减速。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The impressive eyesight and brilliant lights of POKENAME make them popular lighthouse attendants. If a POKENAME spots a ship about to crash into a rocky shore, it extends its tongue around the rocks to cradle the ship and slow it down.

entry: POKENAME吸收足够的阳光后，脸周围一圈舌头般的花瓣便会滴下凝结的水珠。一想到晨露可能其实是它的“口水”，有些人就会感到不自在。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME soaks in a sufficient amount of sunlight, the ring of tongue-like petals around its face drips a type of condensation. Some are disturbed by the idea that morning dew might actually be POKENAME's "saliva".

entry: POKENAME会用翅膀品尝空气，追踪天气变化，寻找迷失方向的猎物。它落在你身上的时候，也正在消化你。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME follows weather changes by tasting the air with its wings, searching for disoriented prey. If it lands on you, it is also digesting you.

entry: POKENAME把舌头当作额外的肢体，所过之处留下一道口水痕。有些人会对这种唾液产生轻微过敏，好在只需轻轻挤压它的鳃，让其分泌稀薄的凝胶，就能得到缓解过敏的药剂。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME uses its tongue as an extra limb, leaving a trail of saliva in its wake. Some people have a mild allergic reaction to this saliva though luckily the tonic to this is obtained by gently squeezing POKENAME's gills to release a thin gel.

entry: POKENAME的舌头长得塞不进嘴里，只好缠在头上。舌头上角状的倒刺，让被它舔舐变得格外疼痛。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's tongue is too long to fit in its mouth, so it wraps around its head instead. The horn-like barbs on the tongue make it extra painful to be licked by.

entry: POKENAME常出现在遗迹中，会被训练家吃完零食留下的包装纸吸引。它们往往先把包装舔干净，再继续监视周围的遗迹。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found in ruins where they are drawn to the wrappers that Trainers leave behind after eating snacks. They often lick the wrappers clean before continuing to monitor the ruins around them.

entry: POKENAME全身布满极其敏感的味觉神经，能察觉食物或捕食者给空气带来的细微变化。一旦尝到不喜欢或令它害怕的味道，它就会爆炸，四散喷洒黏稠的唾液。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is covered in extremely sensitive taste nerves, which allow it to detect even slight changes in the air from food or predators. When it tastes something it does not like or that frightens it, it explodes in a shower of adhesive saliva.

entry: POKENAME用四条舌头般的伪足移动，也借助伪足留下的黏液附着在树上。这些伪足极为敏感，因此它会合上近乎坚不可摧的壳，保护它们。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME uses four tongue-like pseudopods to travel and adhere itself to trees using their residue. These pseudopods are extremely sensitive, so it will close its nearly impervious shell to protect them.

entry: 滑翔速度过快时，POKENAME会把舌头甩向附近的树木，缠住树干刹车。树皮上往往会留下长长的沟痕。
author: .izik
source: When gliding too fast, POKENAME lashes its tongue around nearby trees to brake. It often leaves long gouges in the bark.

entry: 最近有人在平柑岛发现一大群POKENAME，正用长舌头打落树上的树果。只要有人靠近，它们就会先使出鬼面，再逃走。
author: .izik
source: A large group of POKENAME were recently spotted on Pinkan Island, using their long tongues to knock berries from trees. If anyone approaches, they use Scary Face before fleeing.

entry: POKENAME看到新东西，总要舔一舔才能认识它。它出人意料地胆小，只要不喜欢尝到的味道，或有人连续躲过三次以上的舔舐，它就会逃跑。
author: .jerden
source: If POKENAME sees anything new, it familiarizes itself with it by licking. It is surprisingly timid, and will flee if it doesn't like the taste, or if anyone manages to evade more than three of its licks.

entry: POKENAME会用有力的舌头劈开枫树，再迫不及待地舔食从伤口中流出的甜美树液。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its powerful tongue to crack open maple trees. It eagerly laps up the sweet sap that flows from the wounds.

entry: POKENAME用厚实的舌头击碎冰层，再吃下冰屑，维持体内的低温。
author: .izik
source: Using its thick tongue, POKENAME smashes through ice sheets. It then eats the shards to maintain its frigid internal temperature.

entry: POKENAME的舌头上覆盖着极其冰冷的唾液，能伸长至8英尺，轻松摘到树上的榴石果。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has a tongue coated in incredibly cold saliva. It can extend up to 8 feet to pluck Pomeg Berries from trees with ease.

entry: POKENAME会让电流通过舌头表面的唾液。只需舔一下，就能造成疼痛的电击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME channels electricity through the saliva coating its tongue. A single lick can deliver a painful shock.

entry: POKENAME的身体炽热，唾液因此不断冒泡。舌头碰过的地方，会留下滋滋作响的痕迹。
author: .izik
source: Due to its heated body, POKENAME's saliva constantly bubbles. It leaves behind sizzling marks where its tongue touches.

entry: 这种宝可梦的唾液可以代替其他常见的奶。虽然味道咸咸的，又或许正因如此，晚间喝上一杯POKENAME的唾液，再配些美味的饼干，倒也十分可口。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: This Pokémon's saliva can be used as a substitute for other common milks. Despite its salty taste, or perhaps because of it, a glass of POKENAME's saliva and some tasty cookies go down well in the evenings.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在黑暗的房间里，等待毫无防备的受害者经过。脖子上突然被舔一下，往往是唯一的预兆，随后它便消失在阴影中。
author: curazy
source: POKENAME lurks in dark rooms, waiting for unsuspecting victims to pass by. A sudden lick on the neck is often the only warning before POKENAME vanishes into the shadows.

entry: POKENAME觉得无聊时，会吐着舌头发出响亮的噗噗声，喷得口水飞溅，自得其乐。训练家常随身带上许多零食，让它有事可做。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: If it starts feeling bored, POKENAME blows wet and loud raspberries to amuse itself. Trainers commonly carry many snacks to keep POKENAME occupied.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME能让耳间流动的电流传到舌头上，威力十分惊人。平时，它有时会“吞下”舌头上的电流，似乎很享受那种酥麻的感觉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can use lightning coursing from its ears to electrify its tongue in battle to powerful effect. Out of battle, it sometimes "swallows" the electricity on its tongue, apparently enjoying the tingling sensation it brings.

entry: POKENAME喜欢瓜西果，因为这种树果个头很大。它们会用舌头把果子裹住，将甜美的汁液挤进嘴里。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love Watmel Berries because of their large size. They wrap their tongue around the Berry before squeezing the sweet juices into their mouth.

entry: 融合让POKENAME无法收回长舌，只能一直伸在外面。它必须经常寻找有水分的东西舔舐，以免舌头干燥。
author: sk372
source: Fusion has caused POKENAME's body to be unable to retract its long tongue, leaving it forever extended. It must regularly find sources of moisture to lick to prevent its tongue drying out.

entry: POKENAME主要依靠味觉辨路，其他感官都相当迟钝。猎物一旦被它黏稠的舌头缠住，便几乎没有逃脱的希望。
author: knilk
source: POKENAME mostly navigates by sense of taste; its other senses are quite dull. Once prey is ensnared in its sticky tongues, there is little hope of escape.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴在网络空间中跳跃，用舌头吞食美食网站上的数据。如果舔到与食物无关的内容，就可能损坏相应的数据。
author: equation8573
source: POKENAME uses its tail to hop through cyberspace and uses its tongue to consume data on food-related websites. If it licks something that is not food-related, it could corrupt it.

entry: POKENAME用黏黏的脚掌爬树，再精准地弹出长舌，摘取高枝上的树果。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME climbs trees using its sticky paws. It snatches berries from high branches with precise flicks of its long tongue.

entry: 它的唾液含有能保护植物免受害虫侵扰的酶，因此人们常看见POKENAME舔舐树干。它性情平和而有耐心，是新手训练家的理想伙伴。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its saliva contains enzymes that protect plants from pests, which is why POKENAME can often be seen licking tree trunks. Its calm and patient nature makes it an ideal companion for novice Trainers.

entry: POKENAME背上舌头般的棘刺长有能正常工作的味蕾。虽然不用来进食，但当它四处翻滚时，仍能略微尝到滚过的每样东西的味道。
author: sk372
source: The tongue-spines on POKENAME's back have functioning taste buds. Though not used for eating, when POKENAME rolls around, it is able to slightly taste everything it rolls over.

entry: 透过POKENAME背上的孔洞，可以直接通到它的胃。不管吃下多少东西，它似乎总觉得肚子还是空的。
author: bukie
source: POKENAME's stomach is accessible through the open hole in its back. No matter how much it eats, POKENAME still seems to believe it is empty.

entry: POKENAME会舔舐自己的身体，涂上一层有毒的唾液。这种防御手段不会伤到同类，却能伤害来犯者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME licks its own body to coat itself in poisonous saliva. This defense doesn't affect its kin, but harms attackers.

entry: POKENAME能用长舌一次搬运多根原木，加快筑坝的速度。水坝建好后，它会把所有木头仔细舔一遍，算是为新坝举行落成仪式。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its lengthy tongue to carry multiple logs of wood at once, increasing the speed with which it can build dams. Once a dam is complete, it christens it by giving all the wood a thorough licking.

entry: 雷云聚集，预示着POKENAME即将到来。它的舌头会从天空中巨大的传送门里伸出。从未有人去过门的另一边后还能回来。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME's arrival is heralded by a gathering of storm clouds, and its tongue emerges from a massive portal in the sky.  No one has ever been to the other side of the portal and returned.

entry: POKENAME会用舌头试尝送到巢中的食物，确保兄弟姐妹吃得安全。它把最好的零食留给年幼的手足，自己则靠剩下的碎屑填饱肚子。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME ensures food that arrives at its nest is safe for its siblings by tasting the food with its tongue. It saves the best snacks for the younger siblings, while it sustains itself with scraps.

entry: POKENAME头上垂着的“舌头”，其实是巧妙藏起的巨颚。嘴对疼痛很敏感，谁打得太重就会被反击。
author: mistymagius
source: Its tongue is actually a cleverly hidden set of jaws that drapes over POKENAME's head. The mouth is very sensitive to pain, and it will attack anything that hits it too hard.

entry: POKENAME习惯舔舐各种东西，久而久之对许多毒物产生了免疫力。其中一些最致命毒物的解毒剂，就是用它的唾液制成的。
author: notsaying.
source: As POKENAME has a habit of licking things, over time it gained immunity to many poisons. Its saliva has been used for some antidotes to the deadliest of those poisons.

entry: POKENAME的消化系统十分复杂，几乎什么都能吃，并在胃里溶解，因此也从不需要把东西反吐出来。即使吃到有毒的东西，野生个体通常睡上一觉便能恢复。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has a complex digestive system that allows it to eat and dissolve nearly anything in its stomach, so it never has to regurgitate anything, either. Even if it eats something toxic, wild POKENAME tend to sleep it off in order to recover.

entry: POKENAME的味蕾极为敏感，最喜欢甜食。为了吸引伴侣，它们会寻找最上等的甜点，装饰自己的壳。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME have highly sensitive taste buds and love sweet foods most of all. To attract mates, POKENAME decorate their shells with the finest sweets they can locate.

entry: POKENAME十分护着背上的甜点，谁想拿走，就会挨它一巴掌。它们睡着时，小型宝可梦会在它们背上玩耍。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are defensive over the sweets on their back and will slap anyone who tries to take from them. Small Pokémon play games along POKENAME's back when they fall asleep.

entry: 受到威胁时，POKENAME会止不住地流口水，再用浸满毒液的舌头抽打敌人，将其赶走。
author: .izik
source: When threatened, POKENAME salivates uncontrollably. It lashes at foes with a poison-soaked tongue to drive them away.

entry: POKENAME见到不认识的物件或生物，总爱先舔一舔，好弄个明白。可惜，这一舔，常会造成割伤与麻痹。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME has a habit of licking every new object and living thing it sees to learn about it. Unfortunately, its licks often cause cuts and paralysis.

entry: POKENAME会寻找毒蘑菇进食。摄入的毒素能增强它角中储存的毒液的威力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME seeks out poisonous mushrooms to eat. The toxins it consumes enhance the potency of the venom stored in its horn.

entry: POKENAME用舌头探查周围的一切。它的味觉灵敏度是人类的100倍以上。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME inspects everything in its environment with its tongue. Its sense of taste is over 100 times more powerful than a human's.

entry: 这只融合宝可梦外表并不吓人，却会让身边的人做些与牙齿有关的噩梦。除此之外，它倒总是独来独往。
author: ohok3441
source: While not threatening visually, this fusion causes those around it to have teeth-based nightmares. It otherwise keeps to itself.

entry: 新月之夜，POKENAME的舌头会变得格外黏，常常狼狈地粘在地面上。
author: .izik
source: On nights of a new moon, POKENAME's tongue becomes extra sticky. This often causes it to get embarrassingly stuck to the ground.

entry: POKENAME喷出黏丝前，舌头上会跳跃起火花。它能轻易用带电的丝线困住猎物。
author: .izik
source: Sparks dance across POKENAME's tongue before it spits sticky webbing. It traps prey in electrified strands with ease.

entry: 养着POKENAME的人家常在门口备好毛巾，因为它会舔舐每一位新来的访客。在野外，不管认不认识，它也经常见人就舔。
author: beetlething
source: Homeowners with a POKENAME often keep towels by their front door, as POKENAME will lick every new visitor to the house. In the wild, it will often lick people regardless if it knows them or not.

entry: 野生POKENAME会用獠牙给树木做标记，记下哪些树上长着最爱或最不爱吃的坚果和水果。它们的舌头涂满黏液，想要什么食物，都能轻易取到。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME use their tusks to mark which trees contain their favorite or least favorite nuts and fruits. Their tongues are slathered in a sticky fluid that makes it easy to retrieve any food they may desire.

entry: POKENAME会用棉花糖之类的甜食装扮自己。但无论怎样努力，它还是忍不住吃掉这些美味的部件，毁了自己的伪装。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME uses sweet treats like cotton candy as parts of its costume. Try as it might, it can't help but ruin its own disguise by eating the tasty components.

entry: 虽然视力不佳，POKENAME只需用敏感的舌头扫探四周，就能轻松辨路。行进中一旦发现菌类，它就会赶紧吃掉。
author: .izik
source: Despite poor eyesight, POKENAME navigates easily by sweeping its surroundings with its sensitive tongue. If it locates any fungi while moving it will hastily eat it.

entry: POKENAME视力不佳，因此依靠极其敏感的舌头感知世界。它们是出色的试味员，能够尝出一道菜中极其细微的变化。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have poor eyesight, so they rely on their incredibly sensitive tongue to help them navigate the world. These hypersensitive tongues make them great food tasters, as they can detect subtle changes in a given dish.

entry: 尽管长着两个头，POKENAME却只有一条舌头。这条能使对方麻痹的舌头深藏在躯干中，每次只能供其中一个头使用。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Despite having two heads, POKENAME only has one tongue. Its paralyzing tongue is located deep in its torso, so it can only be used by one head at a time.

entry: POKENAME察觉到残忍之人的波导时，舌头就会滴下唾液。逃跑时，它会将这些滑溜溜的液体洒在地上，拖慢追赶者。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME senses the aura of a cruel person, its tongue drips with saliva. It spreads the slippery fluid while fleeing to slow pursuers.

entry: 睡眠不足时，POKENAME会勃然大怒，用锋利的爪子和舌头的有力抽击疯狂进攻。
author: .izik
source: When deprived of sleep, POKENAME flies into a rage. It attacks wildly with both sharp claws and powerful slaps of its tongue.

entry: 它富有弹性的舌头能随意膨胀。如果舌头在嘴里鼓起，POKENAME就能胡乱拍动双臂，笨拙地飞起来。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its elastic tongue can inflate at will. If its tongue is inside its mouth when inflated, POKENAME can fly clumsily by flailing its arms.

entry: 虽然靠磁力移动，POKENAME的皮肤其实柔软而富有弹性；它操控的磁性物质藏在体内。如果舌头不小心卷进自己的齿轮，它会当场痛昏过去。
author: bobosmith01
source: While it moves through magnetism, its skin is actually soft and squishy, with the magnetic material it manipulates actually being inside of POKENAME. If its tongue gets accidentally caught in its own gears, it immediately faints from the pain.

entry: POKENAME的味觉无可挑剔，也能轻松穿行于磁场之中，视力和触觉却低于平均水平。哪怕是朋友亲昵地碰它，只要拍在背上，也很容易把它吓一跳。
author: bobosmith01
source: It has an impeccable sense of taste and easily navigates through magnetic fields, but POKENAME possesses below-average senses of sight and touch. Even if touched affectionately by a friend, POKENAME can be easily startled if tapped on its back.

entry: 这种宝可梦开朗友善，很容易交到朋友。它总是饿着肚子，几乎什么都吃。它实在太能吃了，有人甚至说，它的胃就是个黑洞。
author: infranscia
source: This Pokémon has a cheerful and friendly demeanor and can easily make friends. It is always hungry and will eat almost anything. In fact, it is so hungry that some say its stomach is a black hole.

entry: POKENAME很少出现在斜坡地区，体内几乎始终充满可燃气体。好在它的身体能承受高温火焰，即使意外着火，也不会受到太大伤害。
author: bobosmith01
source: Rarely found in sloped areas, POKENAME's body is near-constantly filled with a flammable gas. Thankfully, its body is equipped to handle flames of high temperatures, so an accidental ignition wouldn't hurt POKENAME very much.

entry: POKENAME会寻找陷入负面情绪的人，舔他们一下。它显然很喜欢这种味道，而那突如其来的一舔，也会让人从糟糕的思绪中惊醒。
author: pokepower
source: POKENAME seeks out those suffering negative emotions and licks them. While it clearly enjoys the taste, the surprise shocks people out of their terrible thoughts.

entry: POKENAME凭声波辨认方向，扑扇着翅膀穿行洞穴。舌头够得着的东西，只要能吃，就会被它舔走吞下。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME orients itself using sound waves and flutters through caves. Anything edible that comes within reach of its tongue is lapped up and eaten.

entry: POKENAME特别喜欢壶壶渗出的汁液，会用舌头吸附上去，一直吸到心满意足。过去人们觉得这很有趣，如今害兽防治人员已开始用它清除入侵的壶壶巢穴。
author: bollocksmen
source: POKENAME is particularly fond of the juices oozing from Shuckle, using its tongue to latch onto one and suck its juices until satiated. Once considered amusing, pest control has now begun using POKENAME to clear any invasive Shuckle nests.

entry: POKENAME用黏稠的舌头抓住波波之类会飞的猎物，再将其拉近，用坚硬的獠牙攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME grabs flying prey like Pidgey with its sticky tongue. It then reels them in and strikes with its tough tusks.

entry: 尽管锋利的獠牙常让旁人误会，POKENAME其实不爱战斗。它们会用长舌摘取树上坚硬的坚果和水果，再用獠牙咬开。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME do not care for battling, despite what others assume due to their sharp tusks. They use their long tongues to grab hard nuts and hard fruits from trees, then break them open with their tusks.

entry: POKENAME通过舌头发出大量声波，确定猎物的位置。一旦发现目标，就会用下半身发力，朝那个方向迅速跃出数米。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME emits many soundwaves via its tongue to locate prey. If it locates prey, it uses its lower body to quickly jump several meters in that direction.

entry: POKENAME会用舌头舔过洞壁，寻找可吃的宝石。它能尝出矿物之间的细微差异，据此判断附近是否有宝石。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME will run its tongue along cave walls in search of gems to eat. It can taste subtle differences in minerals that tell it when gemstones are nearby.

entry: POKENAME舌头上透明的唾液含有危险的剧毒。哪怕只轻轻舔一下，也会在猎物身上留下难以消退的灼伤。
author: .izik
source: The clear saliva on POKENAME's tongue is dangerously toxic. Even a light lick can leave lasting burns on its prey.

entry: POKENAME的舌头上覆盖着冰冷的唾液。在恶劣的气候中，它会飞快吞食积雪，让体温保持在低水平。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tongue is coated in ice-cold saliva. It rapidly devours snow to keep its body temperature low in harsh climates.

entry: 有人推测，POKENAME外壳内的身体全由舌头构成，但尚未得到证实。被其中任意一条舌头舔过的人，之后都会感到强烈的寒意。
author: sk372
source: Some have theorized that the entirety of POKENAME's body within the outer casing is comprised of tongues, but this is unconfirmed. Anyone licked by one of its tongues will experience severe chills afterward.

entry: POKENAME的花朵分泌出甜美却有害的蜜，流到外面，成为众多舌头上的唾液。被它舔过的人，身上至少会残留一星期的恶臭。
author: sk372
source: The noxious yet sweet honey that POKENAME's flower produces flows outward to become the saliva on its many tongues. Anyone licked by it will have the nasty stench stuck to their body for at least a week.

entry: POKENAME会舔舐自己，修补起保护作用的黏液膜。它们走到哪里，哪里就会留下黏液和口水的痕迹。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME lick themselves to repair their protective slime membranes. They leave a trail of slime and drool wherever they go.

entry: 透过POKENAME透明的穹顶，可以看见里面翻涌成团的舌头。如果它发射出一条舌状肢体，或在战斗中失去一条，很快就会从中央的舌团中补出另一条。
author: sk372
source: One can see through its transparent dome that POKENAME has a mass of roiling tongues within it. Should it fire one of its tongue-limbs off or lose it in battle, another from the center mass will replace it shortly.

entry: POKENAME总是热衷于痛快打一场。只有用有力的舌头把对手压住，数满三声，它才觉得自己真正赢了。毫不意外，没几个对手愿意让它这样获胜。
author: sk372
source: Always eager for a good fight, POKENAME does not consider a fight truly won until it has pinned its opponent beneath its powerful tongue for a three-count. Unsurprisingly, not many are eager to let it earn this type of victory.

entry: POKENAME会向萄葡果树发射针刺，把果子打落，再用黏稠的舌头小心地捡回来。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires pins at Grepa Berry trees to knock fruit loose. Once fallen, it carefully retrieves them with its sticky tongue.

entry: 探险者常被告诫，即使饥饿难耐，也不要采食POKENAME身上的蘑菇。多数人吃下后，舌头都会肿胀得极其难受。
author: sk372
source: Explorers are cautioned against picking POKENAME's mushrooms, even in cases of dire hunger. In the majority of people, consumption causes a highly uncomfortable swelling of the tongue.

entry: 家养POKENAME表达亲昵的方式近乎粗暴，常把主人舔得浑身都是口水。它们的舌头像猫类宝可梦一样有些粗糙，还会给主人留下轻微的擦伤。
author: chibitales
source: Domestic POKENAME usually leave their owners drenched in saliva from their near-violent affection. POKENAME tongues are somewhat rough, much like feline Pokémon, thus leaving their owners with minor scratches.

entry: POKENAME行动缓慢，长舌却能迅速伸到猎物面前。即便没能抓住目标，唾液中仍带有能够繁殖、传播感染的孢子，让寄生蘑菇继续扩散。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME moves slowly, but its long tongue can quickly close the distance on prey. Even if the tongue fails to capture its target, the saliva carries propagating infectious spores to spread the parasitic mushroom.

entry: POKENAME经常用长舌梳理全身，既能让毛发保持光滑，也能积攒毛团，遇到捕食者时便咳出有毒的毛球。
author: pokepower
source: POKENAME frequently grooms its entire body with its long tongue. Along with keeping its fur slick, this allows it to cough up toxic hairballs at predators.

entry: POKENAME会甩出舌头，黏住并缠绕虫属性宝可梦。等猎物不再挣扎，它就把舌头收回，享用下一餐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hunt for Bug-type Pokémon by whipping their tongue to stick and wrap around their prey. Once their prey stops struggling, they reel in their tongue to secure their next meal.

entry: POKENAME会把舌头缠在脖子上，让变温的身体保持温暖。太阳出来时，它们就会趴在莲叶童子身上，吸收炽热的阳光。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wrap their tongues around their neck to keep their cold-blooded bodies warm. Whenever the sun is out, they sprawl their bodies atop a Lotad and absorb the hot sunlight.

entry: POKENAME会释放有毒的粉尘云，让敌人晕头转向，再甩出舌头，抓住这些尚未回过神来的目标。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases clouds of poisonous powder to disorient foes. It then lashes out with its tongue to seize its stunned targets.

entry: POKENAME的领地意识极强，谁闯入都会遭到舌头抽打。它的唾液能让对方全身麻痹，让想靠近的家伙望而却步。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is fiercely territorial, striking with its tongue at anyone who enters. Its saliva can cause full paralysis, making it a dangerous deterrent for those who venture too close.

entry: POKENAME的舌头与尾巴覆着辛辣化学物质，能增强火焰攻击。虽然不会损伤皮肤，却会带来强烈灼痛。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's tongue and tail are coated in a spicy chemical that makes its fire attacks stronger. The chemical will cause an intense burning sensation even though it doesn't damage the skin.

entry: POKENAME会用富有弹性的舌头摩擦隧道壁，感知附近的树根。舌头能伸到与身体一样长，用来取得食物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rubs its elastic tongue along tunnel walls to sense nearby roots. Its tongue can stretch the full length of its body to retrieve food.

entry: 三只一起挖洞十分耗力，因此POKENAME浮出地面进食时，会甩出舌头，把附近能吃的东西大口吞下。首领有时也会用舌头拍打同伴，责罚它们。
author: sk372
source: Digging as a trio takes a lot of energy, so when POKENAME surfaces to feed, its tongues lash out to gorge on anything nearby. The leader of the group will sometimes smack the others with its tongue to get them to reprimand them.

entry: 小心别把硬币掉在地上。POKENAME以舔走钱币出名，肚子里，装满别人遗失的零钱。
author: kitarchen
source: Be wary of dropping coins on the ground. POKENAME are notorious for licking up money they find and filling their stomachs with lost pocket change.

entry: POKENAME十分忠诚，却也很贪吃。看见能吃的东西，它便爱忘掉职责，一心追着食物跑，专注得经常迷路。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is very loyal, but also very gluttonous. When it sees something edible, it likes to forget its duties and chase after its food. It is so focused that it is not uncommon for it to get lost.

entry: 体形虽大，却爱玩又亲人，食量也极大。传闻POKENAME曾在玩耍时不慎吞掉训练家，至今尚未证实。
author: chorb33
source: Despite its size, it is playful and cuddly, but also extremely voracious. Rumors that a POKENAME accidentally devoured its Trainer while playing have not yet been confirmed.

entry: POKENAME的战斗风格独特，会同时使用拳头和舌头。虽然舌头打击的力道不输拳头，却也是它的弱点。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME has a unique fighting style that uses both its fists and its tongue. Although its tongue hits as hard as its punches, POKENAME's tongue is also its weak spot.

entry: POKENAME不光锻炼四肢肌肉，也会锻炼舌头。它们能用舌头额外搬运建材，因此是出色的建筑工。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME train not only their arm and leg muscles, but also their tongue. They make great construction workers because they can carry additional materials with their tongue.

entry: POKENAME力气大，舌头又有着异乎寻常的灵敏，因此常被用于协助警方调查。据说，它能用包括舌头在内的所有肢体举起汽车。
author: jojojax164
source: POKENAME is commonly used in police investigations due to its strength and strangely sensitive tongue. POKENAME is said to lift cars with all limbs, including its tongue.

entry: POKENAME的味蕾对糖分十分敏感，酿酒厂便靠它们检验蜂蜜酒有无异常。这样既能保证酿出优质的蜂蜜酒，又能让它通过喝酒填饱肚子。
author: quackquackattack
source: Breweries rely on their tastebuds to detect abnormalities in mead, as they are sensitive to sugar. This ensures that high quality mead is produced while also sustaining the POKENAME through the consumption of mead.

entry: 它们常常喝得超过所需，但酿酒厂还是会容忍，因为POKENAME能品尝好几桶蜂蜜酒，辨认出哪一批有问题。
author: quackquackattack
source: They often drink more than necessary, but breweries tolerate this because POKENAME can taste several barrels of mead and discern if any batch is defective.

entry: POKENAME喜欢舔掉训练家身上的尘土和污垢，在尘土飞扬的山路上旅行时，是个很得力的伙伴。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME likes to lick the dirt and grime off of its Trainer, making it a handy companion when out on dusty mountain trails.

entry: POKENAME滚下山坡前，会把舌头纵向绕在身上。一路滚动时粘到舌头上的东西，都会在它滚到底后被吸溜进嘴里。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME wraps its tongue vertically around itself before rolling down mountainsides. Anything that gets stuck to its tongue as it rolls gets slurped up after the downward roll is complete.

entry: POKENAME体表的薄片状结构能在它滚下山时，尝出并发现富含矿物的岩石。找到后，它便用锯齿状的舌头将岩石切成适口的小块吃下。
author: creaturecore
source: The platelets covering POKENAME's body are specialized to taste and detect rocks chock-full of minerals as it rolls down mountains. When it finds one, it uses its serrated tongue to break it into bite-sized pieces for consumption.

entry: POKENAME的味蕾十分敏感，食物只要碰到舌头，丰富的滋味就会淹没它简单的心智。它太沉醉于舌尖的美味，往往忘了真正把食物吃下去。
author: sk372
source: Its taste buds are very sensitive, so any time food touches POKENAME's tongue, its simple mind is overwhelmed by the flavors. It's so enamored by the feeling of it against its tongue that it often forgets to actually eat the food.

entry: POKENAME粗壮的尾巴能平衡又长又重的舌头，让身体保持直立。它头脑简单，经常忘记自己其实能把舌头收回嘴里。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's thick tail helps it stay upright and counter the balance of its long heavy tongue. Its simple mind makes it forget it can retract its tongue back into its mouth.

entry: 两个头共用的黏稠舌头像传送带，在它们之间移动：食物先进入一个头消失不见，再轮到另一个。无聊时，两个头还会用舌头玩一种奇怪的拔河游戏。
author: sk372
source: The sticky tongue shared by both heads moves between them like a conveyor belt: food flows into one head and disappears, then the other. When bored, the heads may play an odd sort of tug-of-war with the tongue.

entry: POKENAME喜欢舔起地上能找到的一切吃掉，让黏糊糊的身体越长越大。有时甚至能看见它把自己滴落在地、积成一摊的身体部分又吸回去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME loves to lick up anything it can find off the ground to eat and let its goo-like body grow larger. It can even be seen slurping up parts of its own body that have dripped off and puddled on the ground.

entry: 这种宝可梦有许多敌人，不仅因为数量太多，也因为它们的举止令人厌恶。POKENAME的主要攻击手段，就是把对手恶心得退避三舍。
author: the_smirker
source: These Pokémon have many enemies, not only because of their overabundance but also due to their off-putting nature. POKENAME's primary method of attack involves repulsing its opponents.

entry: POKENAME在市区附近游荡时，会用舌头卷起碰到的东西吞下。这些物品不会被消化，而是裹着臭烘烘的黏液，留在它走过的路上。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME roams near urban areas, it uses its tongue to grab and swallow any object it comes across. These items are not digested but are left behind in POKENAME's trail, coated in stinky slime.

entry: POKENAME见人就舔，吸取对方的能量维持生存。甚至有人说，被这种宝可梦舔过会缩短寿命。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will lick anyone they find, draining their energy to sustain themselves. Some even say that being licked by this Pokémon can shorten your lifespan.

entry: POKENAME触角不断散发可怕恶臭，防止捕食者吞食。每只气味略有不同，能借此辨认同伴。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's antennae constantly emits a horrific stench to prevent any predators from eating it. Every POKENAME has a slightly different smell which they use to identify one another.

entry: POKENAME哭泣时，会释放浓密的黄色烟雾。这些烟雾一旦接触，就会造成强烈腐蚀。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME cries, it releases thick clouds of yellow smoke. The fumes are highly corrosive to the touch.

entry: 未融合的瓦斯弹本可通过气孔平稳排出的气体，在POKENAME体内却会猛地冲破气孔喷出。训练家与它一起训练时，建议戴上防毒面具保护自己。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The gasses within POKENAME rupture through the vents that would harmlessly disperse them from an unfused Koffing. Trainers are advised to make use of gas masks when training with POKENAME to protect themselves.

entry: 遇见POKENAME的人，常说时间仿佛变得异常短暂，似乎终结正迅速逼近。传说，只有一位凶猛的神祇才能将它制服。
author: h0bojoe
source: Those who encounter POKENAME often speak of time feeling strangely short, as though an ending is fast approaching. Legends say it can only be conquered by a fierce deity.

entry: 遇见POKENAME的人，常说时间仿佛变得异常短暂，似乎终结正迅速逼近。传说曾有一次，雷吉奇卡斯与它最初的巨人们阻止了它带来灾难。
author: h0bojoe
source: Those who encounter POKENAME often speak of time feeling strangely short, as though an ending is fast approaching. Legends tell of a time when Regigigas and its original giants stopped it from bringing catastrophe.

entry: POKENAME拥有坚固的茧，会从中排出有害气体。鸟宝可梦啄它的茧时，它就会向捕食者喷酸，将对方吓走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a sturdy cocoon that vents noxious fumes from its body. Whenever a bird Pokémon pecks at its cocoon, POKENAME sprays acid onto the predator to scare them away.

entry: 虽然力量不如普通的双弹瓦斯，这种宝可梦却也更加开朗。有人推测，融合使它体内的气体减少，内部压力也随之降低，因此才会如此。
author: sk372
source: Though possessing less power than a normal Weezing, this Pokémon carries itself with a more chipper demeanor as well. It's theorized this is because the fusion resulted in less gas within it, causing less internal pressure.

entry: POKENAME感到害怕或危险时，会冲向对手，或随意朝一个方向猛冲。情绪激动时，它体内气体的毒性也会增强。
author: heal_fire
source: When POKENAME feels scared or in danger, it charges toward its opponent or in a random direction. When POKENAME is agitated, the toxicity of its internal gases rises.

entry: 岩石属性宝可梦尤其厌恶POKENAME毒雾的臭味。它能朝敌人投出钻头状的烟雾弹，渗入对方体内，令对方身中剧毒。
author: sk372
source: The stench of POKENAME's toxic clouds is particularly abhorred by Rock-type Pokémon. It can fling drill-shaped smog projectiles at foes that seep into their body and leave them badly poisoned.

entry: POKENAME在水中几乎不受水质影响，照样能繁衍生息。因此人们认为，如果不是已有种种自然制约，它们轻易就能破坏生态平衡。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are able to thrive in aquatic environments almost entirely independent of the water quality, so it's thought that if many natural regulations weren't already in place, POKENAME would have easily disrupted the natural ecosystem.

entry: POKENAME靠排出热气飞行，再通过进食补充气体。它因此把大部分时间花在吃东西上，毕竟一旦飞不起来，就很容易成为猎物。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME flies by expelling hot gas from itself, replenishing this gas by feeding itself. Because of this, it spends most of its time eating, for it would become easy prey if flightless.

entry: POKENAME能从身上的气孔制造有毒的雷云。云中既有闪电又有毒素，旁人无法触碰，它自己却能轻松操控。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME generates toxic storm-clouds from the pores on its body. Due to the lightning and poison, the clouds are untouchable by others, though POKENAME can manipulate them effortlessly.

entry: POKENAME变身为其他宝可梦时，必需的代谢过程会产生气体，从体内排出。即使完成变身，它身上的气味也始终无法完全消失。
author: pjporwoll
source: The gases venting from POKENAME are caused by the metabolic processes needed for it to transform into other Pokémon. Even after it transforms, the smell never completely fades from POKENAME.

entry: 虽然POKENAME生性爱玩，却很难安全地与它接触。它不断更换喷出黄色云状烟雾的气孔，让人难以预料下一股毒气会从哪里猛然喷出。
author: ambrosia04
source: Though they have a playful nature, POKENAME are hazardous to handle. They constantly change which vents on their bodies release the yellow, cloud-like smoke, making it difficult to anticipate where the toxic fumes will burst from next.

entry: POKENAME体内的烟囊会定期产生有害气体，附着在身上。不加防护地接触烟雾，会让皮肤受到轻度化学灼伤。
author: sk372
source: A smog sac within POKENAME's body regularly generates noxious gas that clings to its body. Touching the smog unprotected will lead to minor chemical burns on the skin.

entry: POKENAME在网络空间和现实世界中都能无声飘行，留下一道道仿佛程序出错的气体。科学家很难研究它，因为大多数仪器一靠近这些气体就会过热。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME drifts silently through cyberspace and the real world alike, leaving behind trails of glitchy gas. Scientists struggle to study this Pokémon as most of their technology overheats when it gets too close to the gas.

entry: POKENAME消化食物时，胃里会产生恶臭的毒气。这些气体从身上许多大气孔排出，使它每次吃完饭，周围都会笼罩一层浓雾。
author: evilgammon
source: When POKENAME digests food, its stomach creates a foul-smelling toxic gas. This gas is vented out of the many large pores on POKENAME's body, creating a thick haze around it after a meal.

entry: POKENAME无忧无虑，也有些呆头呆脑，什么引起好奇，就飘过去追着看。它释放的每一团云都有不同气味，研究发现，分别与各种其他宝可梦的天然体味相同。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's behaves in a carefree and dim manner, floating after anything that catches its curiosity. The clouds it emits all have a different scent, and research has determined each matches the natural odor of various other Pokémon species.

entry: POKENAME开心时，体内的毒水就会欢快地冒泡。这一反应会让背上间歇喷出一小股一小股的黄色烟雾。
author: .izik
source: Inside POKENAME's body, poisonous water bubbles with joy when it's happy. This reaction vents yellow smog from its back in short bursts.

entry: POKENAME会用翅膀吹动自己制造的云，把气味分享给别人，表达亲昵。它似乎不知道，自己的独特浓烈气味并不受大多数生物欢迎。
author: sk372
source: As a sign of affection, POKENAME will use its wings to blow the clouds it creates in order to share its scent with others. It doesn't seem to realize most others don't appreciate its uniquely pungent aroma.

entry: POKENAME飞到哪里，剧毒气体就会附着在翅膀上。只需吸入极少量，就会剧烈咳嗽，足以让猎物分神，给它们制造出击的机会。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a virulent gas that clings to their wings wherever they fly. It only takes a few specks of this gas to produce a coughing fit, which is enough of a distraction for them to strike their prey.

entry: 尽管笑容亲切，POKENAME的领地意识却很强。它排出的气体既能驱赶入侵者，也能帮助它完成空中的灵巧动作。
author: pjporwoll
source: Despite its pleasant smile, POKENAME is very territorial. The gasses it expels both ward off intruders and aid it in aerial acrobatic maneuvers.

entry: 受到威吓时，POKENAME会喷出一股烟，再用翅膀扇向对手。球形身体并不适合飞行，但由于热气会上升，它的高体温使它变得更轻。
author: bobogagabobo
source: When intimidated, POKENAME will shoot out a burst of smoke and use its wings to send it towards its opponent. POKENAME's spherical shape is not very aerodynamic, but since heat rises, its high temperature makes it lighter.

entry: POKENAME在草原上空翱翔，释放令猎物晕头转向的气体，方便捕捉。食物能改变气体的性质，因此有些农民会喂它们扁樱果，让气体帮助作物更好地抵御虫害。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME soars over grasslands, dispensing a gas which disorients prey so it can easily catch them. Its diet can change the properties of the gas, so some farmers feed them Tanga Berries so the gas makes their plants more bug resistant.

entry: POKENAME喜欢整天在水里玩耍。这让环保人士十分担忧，因为它尾巴和身体喷出的毒素，很快就会污染玩耍的水域。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME loves to play in water all day long. This causes concerns for environmentalists because the toxins that spew from its tail and body quickly contaminate the areas it plays in.

entry: POKENAME产生的气体是氦气与甲烷的混合物，能让它靠自身的气体飘浮。这种混合气体也极易燃烧，一旦点燃就会爆炸。
author: mistymagius
source: The gas POKENAME produces is a mixture of helium and methane, allowing it to float on its own gas. The mixture is also highly flammable, causing the gas to explode if ignited.

entry: 虽然POKENAME喜欢给队友加油，许多观众却不愿坐在它们旁边。因为它们为保持浮空而产生的气体，闻起来像腐烂的木头。
author: quackquackattack
source: Even though POKENAME love to cheer on their teammates, many people in the audience do not enjoy sitting next to them. This is because the gasses they produce to keep themselves airborne smell like rotting wood.

entry: POKENAME最喜欢臭奶酪。如果闯进储藏奶酪的地方，它们就会向整个房间喷洒毒气，让奶酪对其他物种有毒，免得被抢走，连奶酪的主人也不例外。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME enjoy smelly cheese more than anything. If they get into a cheese supply, they will spray the whole room with poison gas, poisoning the cheese for other species that would try to take it from them, including the people that own it.

entry: 只有尾巴的重量，才能让POKENAME留在地面。吸收太多气体时，就能看见它浮起来，拖着尾巴在地上移动，似乎很享受这种感觉。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The weight of POKENAME's tail is the only thing keeping it grounded. If it absorbs too many gases, it can be seen floating with its tail dragging along the ground, seemingly enjoying the sensation.

entry: POKENAME会从两条尾巴释放气体，影响吸入者的心智。对方受到烟雾影响后，它就能更轻松地读出其想法。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME releases a gas from the two tails it possesses that affects the minds of those who inhale it. POKENAME can more easily read the thoughts of others after the smog has affected them.

entry: POKENAME被逼入绝境时，会扇动翅膀释放毒云，趁机逃走。它倾向于在污染严重的城市筑巢，尤其喜欢满是尘土和煤灰的屋顶。
author: fiordaliso
source: If it feels cornered, POKENAME flaps its wings to release clouds of poison and takes the opportunity to make a run for it. It tends to nest in particularly polluted cities, favoring rooftops covered in dirt and soot.

entry: POKENAME在背上的鳞茎内制造毒气，敌人一旦靠得太近，就会喷出。这些气体极不稳定，随时可能爆炸，让种子如弹片般四散飞射。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME produces toxic gases inside the bulb on its back, spraying them out if any foe gets too close. These fumes are incredibly volatile and may explode at any moment, scattering seeds like shrapnel.

entry: POKENAME不断产生一团毒气云，始终笼罩在背部附近。天气晴朗时，毒云会变得更大，气味也更刺鼻。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME constantly produces a cloud of toxic gas, which never drifts far from its back. In sunny weather, the cloud becomes larger and more pungent.

entry: POKENAME腐臭的气味十分容易辨认。长时间接触它的气体，会引起头痛和恶心，因此许多研究者与它们打交道时都会戴上面罩。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are easy to identify by their putrid scent. Prolonged exposure to POKENAME gas causes headaches and nausea, which is why many researchers wear masks when dealing with them.

entry: POKENAME以响亮刺耳的笑声和不停啃咬的习性闻名，会咬破下水管道，放出新的气味。许多城市已将它列为公害。
author: jaminmcready
source: Known for its loud, hacking laugh and relentless chewing, POKENAME gnaws on sewer pipes to release new smells. Cities have labeled it a public nuisance.

entry: POKENAME聚在污染地区，吃空气中的毒素。科学家常靠数量判断当地的毒性程度。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME swarm in polluted areas, feeding off of the toxins in the air. Scientists often use the number of POKENAME in an area to determine its toxicity.

entry: 由于诞生于危险环境，POKENAME体内会产生大量毒气，经由身体两侧岩石状的气孔泄出。
author: raydrago
source: Having been born in a hazardous environment, POKENAME's body produces a vast amount of poisonous gases. They leak out of its body through the rocky vents along its sides.

entry: 树果在POKENAME中空的身体内腐烂，产生由它操控的恶臭气体。这种气体极不稳定，随时可能爆炸，不过岩石外壳依然完好无损。
author: .jerden
source: Berries rot inside POKENAME's hollow body, generating the foul-smelling gases it controls. This gas is highly volatile and may explode at any moment, although the rocky shell will remain undamaged.

entry: POKENAME的身体冷却时，黄色烟雾会变得漆黑。此时，哪怕只吸入短短一口，也可能造成危险的中毒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's yellow fumes darken to pitch black when its body cools. During this time, even a brief inhale of the smoke can be dangerously toxic.

entry: 构成它身体的化学黏液会释放有毒的臭气。壳内设有储气的空腔，POKENAME便能在需要时释放气体进行防御。
author: hophoppip
source: The chemical ooze that makes up its body gives off toxic, odorous fumes. Its shell contains hollow chambers to store these fumes so POKENAME can release them as a defense mechanism when needed.

entry: 不论在陆地还是海中，POKENAME受到威胁时，都会喷出一团有害气体。毒性往往强到足以击昏目标，而等到那时，它早已逃得无影无踪。
author: atlas3339098
source: When threatened on land or sea, POKENAME will spew a cloud of noxious gas. This gas is often so toxic that it knocks out its target, but by then the Pokémon is long gone.

entry: POKENAME以海中污染物为食，保护珊瑚礁，并将因此产生的有害墨汁喷出，驱赶捕食者。它对栖息地里的新物品和生物十分好奇，潜水员因此经常被它偷走一件装备。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME protects coral reefs by feeding on ocean pollution, which produces a noxious ink it expels to repel predators. It is curious of new objects and creatures in its habitat, which often leads to divers having a piece of equipment stolen by it.

entry: POKENAME生活在污染严重的地方，尤其常见于大量工业废水流入的区域。它们会代谢环境中的毒素，再以恶臭气体的形式排出。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are found in highly polluted areas, most often in areas with high levels of industrial waste runoff. Their bodies metabolise the toxins in their environment and expel them as foul gases.

entry: POKENAME的气孔不断渗出有害气体，闻起来像变质的牛奶。尽管存在严重的健康风险，合众最近却兴起了饮用其冷凝液的风潮。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's pores constantly seep out a noxious gas that smells of expired milk. In Unova, it has become a recent trend to drink its condensed form, despite the serious health risks.

entry: POKENAME会喷出朦胧的彩虹云，吸入后会让人感到沉重、困倦。许多富有的恋人试图把云装进瓶子，可几个小时后，它们就会变黄。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME billows out a hazy rainbow cloud that causes a heavy, lethargic feeling upon inhalation. Many affluent lovers try to bottle POKENAME's clouds, but they turn yellow after a few hours.

entry: 人们曾把POKENAME视为森林的守护者，但科学家判断错了。其实，它来自未来的一片森林，而那片森林早已被它自己的毒气摧毁。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME was once thought to be a protector of the forests, but scientists were incorrect. Instead, POKENAME comes from a forest in the future that it has already destroyed using its noxious fumes.

entry: 气体从尾巴末端喷出，令尾巴剧烈甩动。尾巴甩动时的重量使POKENAME脚步失控，结果便会朝各个方向歪歪斜斜地乱走。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Gases spew out from the end of its tail, causing it to flail wildly. The weight of the flailing tail causes POKENAME to lose control of its footing, and it will go meandering in all sorts of directions as a result.

entry: POKENAME食量很大，因此体内会产生大量气体。它们已经开始学会排气推进自己。这气味臭得惊人，就连大岩蛇闻上一口都可能倒下。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME eat large quantities of food, resulting in their bodies producing plenty of gas. They have begun to learn to propel themselves by releasing this gas, which tends to smell so horrible it can knock down even an Onix with a single whiff.

entry: 没人知道POKENAME为何能浮在空中，因为按理说，它的体重已超过气体所能托起的程度。尽管如此，它依然飘浮得毫不费力。
author: mellowmuse
source: It is unknown how POKENAME is able to remain aloft, as its body weight should be too much for its gas to lift. Despite this, it floats with ease.

entry: POKENAME曾被认为是遭污染侵蚀的自然精灵。它们会密切留意垃圾填埋场，规模过大时就向其他宝可梦传递消息。它们以埋藏的垃圾为食，吸收比空气轻的气体，浮到填埋场顶部。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Once believed to be nature spirits corrupted with pollution, POKENAME carefully monitor landfill sites, spreading word to other Pokémon when sites grow too large. They feast on buried rubbish and rise to the top by absorbing lighter-than-air gases.

entry: POKENAME每次打喷嚏，都会从身上的喷口释放毒气。虽然伪装能力比不上未融合的变隐龙，这些毒气也足以吓退捕食者。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: Every time POKENAME sneezes, it releases poisonous gas from the spouts on its body. Though POKENAME is unable to camouflage as effectively as a unfused Kecleon, the poisonous gas is enough to ward off predators.

entry: POKENAME幽灵般的身体由气味极其刺鼻的剧毒气体构成。它喜欢用气态身体笼罩植物，看着它们在毒素作用下慢慢枯萎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's ghost-like body is comprised of highly pungent and toxic gases. It enjoys enveloping plant life with its gaseous form and watching the plants slowly wither due to its toxins.

entry: POKENAME调皮得很，惹完祸，常会喷出高压气体，飞快溜走，逃避追究。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME is quite mischievous and will often propel itself away from consequences at high speed with jets of pressurised gas.

entry: POKENAME头上的嘴不断喷出毒烟，吸入者会失去行动能力。吃得越多，毒气越浓。
author: mistymagius
source: The mouth on POKENAME's head constantly belches toxic fumes to incapacitate anyone that breathes the gas in. The more food POKENAME has eaten, the more concentrated the gas becomes.

entry: POKENAME释放的烟雾能扭曲感知，让受害者相信它是一位半神。长时间接触，还会让四肢麻木数月。
author: .izik
source: The smog released by POKENAME manipulates perception, leading victims to believe it is a demigod. Prolonged exposure can also numb limbs for months.

entry: POKENAME淘气又开朗，幼稚的恶作剧就能让它乐不可支。它会点燃自己产生的气体，制造小爆炸，把周围的人吓一跳。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Mischievous and jovial, POKENAME are easily amused by childish pranks. They light the gas that they produce to create small explosions, startling everyone in the area.

entry: 几只瓦斯弹制造出浓云，载着一只好战的小火焰猴四处寻找对手。据说，只有心地纯洁者才能坐在云上，其他人都会直接掉下去。
author: sk372
source: A set of Koffing create a thick cloud that carries along a battle-hungry Chimchar across the lands, searching for opponents. It is said only the pure of heart can sit upon the cloud; all others fall right through.

entry: POKENAME能释放体内的毒云，乘着它们浮在半空。它也是技艺高超的斗士，只需一拳，就能把巨石像脆玻璃般击碎。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can release clouds of toxic gas from its body, which it rides to float in midair. It is a skilled fighter, capable of crushing boulders as if they were fragile pieces of glass with a single punch.

entry: POKENAME的烟云反映着它的活力。最强壮的个体笼罩在风暴之中，几乎看不见身影。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME's smog clouds are a reflection of their vitality. The most powerful POKENAME can hardly be seen through the storm.

entry: 为了调节体温，它会不断从岩石般坚硬的铠甲气孔中排出毒气。POKENAME必须持续吃下岩石，才能防止角变得脆弱。
author: fiordaliso
source: To regulate its body temperature, it constantly releases toxic gas from the vents on its rock-hard armor. POKENAME must continuously feed on rocks to prevent its horns from weakening.

entry: POKENAME体内充满比空气轻的气体，让它浮在空中。这些气体遇到明火时很不稳定。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME's body is full of gases that are lighter than air, keeping it aloft. These gases are volatile around open flames.

entry: 吸入POKENAME的烟雾后，人们很快便会陷入沉睡，接连做无法呼吸的噩梦。醒来时，受害者总在拼命喘气。
author: sk372
source: Those that inhale POKENAME's fumes will find themselves quickly falling into a deep slumber. The sleep is fraught with nightmares framed around being unable to breathe; victims always wake up gasping for air.

entry: POKENAME生活在矿井深处，擅长侦测毒气，并用气态鬃毛将其中和。经过矿工训练后，它就能充当预警员，抓住训练家跃回地面。
author: ghostslythe
source: Found deep inside mines, POKENAME is adept at detecting poisonous gases and neutralizing them with its gaseous mane. When trained by miners, it acts as an early warning system, grabbing its Trainer and jumping to the surface.

entry: POKENAME呼出的空气中充满有毒孢子。它低垂着头，沉重的呼吸听起来像打鼾，但只要有敌人靠近，就会突然挥动一条手臂抽打。
author: .jerden
source: The air POKENAME breathes out is filled with toxic spores. The way it lowers its head makes its heavy breathing sound like snoring, but if any foe approaches, it will suddenly lash with one of its arms.

entry: POKENAME会前往空气污染泛滥的地方。尽管态度友善、心怀好意，却常把问题弄得更严重。
author: atlas3339098
source: POKENAME travels to areas overrun by air pollution. Despite its friendly demeanor and good intentions, it often makes the problem worse.

entry: POKENAME身上的毒棉十分轻盈，能让它随风旅行。它会撕下几块棉花，藏在屋内各处恶作剧。棉絮气味难闻，分散藏在多个地方后，臭味的源头更难找了。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's coat of poisonous cotton is light enough that it can travel on the wind. It tears off chunks of the cotton to hide around homes as a prank since the fluff has an unpleasant odor but becomes hard to track when from multiple sources.

entry: POKENAME释放的并非火焰，而是微微发光的气体，只有在罕见条件下才会点燃。气体散发淡淡甜香，引来好奇的宝可梦，随后又消散在空气中。
author: jaminmcready
source: Instead of a flame, POKENAME emits a faintly glowing gas that ignites only under rare conditions. The gas is faintly sweet-smelling, luring in curious Pokémon before vanishing into the air.

entry: POKENAME不断从身后排出烟雾，形成的三条烟尾始终不会完全消散。受到威胁时，它能将烟雾点燃，向来犯者甩出火球。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME expels fumes from behind at a constant rate, its three tails of smog never dissipating in full. If threatened, it can ignite the fumes and use them to sling fireballs at attackers.

entry: POKENAME主要靠从口中喷出恶臭的化学物质来防御。这股气味在空气中和水下都十分强烈。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's primary defense mechanism is spraying an awful-smelling chemical from its mouth, the odor of which is potent both in the air and underwater.

entry: POKENAME释放的烟雾具有强烈的致幻作用。许多人相信，吸入烟雾便能看见通往珍贵宝藏的道路。
author: henry9000
source: The fumes that POKENAME releases are a powerful hallucinogen. Many believe that inhaling them will show them the way to valuable treasure.

entry: POKENAME懒洋洋地沿河岸飘行，吐出的气团带有淡淡湿木头味。渔民避开它，倒不是因为臭味，而是因为它总对着自己吐的泡泡咯咯笑个不停。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME lazily floats along riverbanks, releasing puffs of gas that smell faintly like wet wood. Fishermen steer clear not because of the stench, but because it won't stop giggling at its own bubbles.

entry: POKENAME会跟在游轮后面，吃掉掉落的废弃物，沿途清洁水域。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME will trail cruise ships, eating any refuse that falls off and cleaning the waters as it goes.

entry: POKENAME结成小群一起行动，合力对付比自己更强大的威胁。它们会用产生的气体掩护自己，遮住其他宝可梦的视线，再将对方包围。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME move together in small prides, working together to take on threats larger than themselves. They use the gases they produce to create cover for themselves, blinding other Pokémon as they surround them.

entry: POKENAME极其害羞。唱歌时一旦发现有人在听，它就会变得焦躁，从皮肤气孔中释放剧毒气体。这种行为常让别人避而远之。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an extremely shy Pokémon. If it notices someone listening while it sings, it becomes agitated and releases a highly poisonous gas through its skin pores. This behavior often causes others to avoid it.

entry: POKENAME的消化系统含有科学家已知腐蚀性最强的几种酸，因此几乎什么金属和矿物都能吃。消化食物时会产生毒气，从身上的甲片间排出。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME can eat any kind of metal or mineral since their digestive system contains some of the most corrosive acids known to scientists. The digestion of their food creates toxic gasses that vent from the plates on their body.

entry: 科学家发现，铅矿石是POKENAME食物中最重要的部分。铅矿石让它的钢铁身躯更强韧，也会溶解成腐蚀性气体，构成体内的大部分物质。
author: heal_fire
source: Scientists have discovered that lead ore is the most important part of POKENAME's diet. It makes their steely body stronger and dissolves into corrosive gases that mostly compose their insides.

entry: POKENAME的颚部含有来自肺部的腐蚀性气体。一旦咬住东西，直到气体将其溶解才肯松口。训练家发现，摸摸它的头就能让它停止啃咬。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME's jaw contains corrosive gases that come from their lungs. When they bite something, they don't let go until their gases dissolve what they cling to. Trainers have found that petting their head makes them stop biting.

entry: POKENAME生性胆怯，喜欢独处。如果唱歌被人听见，它就会惊慌失措，从皮肤中分泌毒气。这种习惯让其他宝可梦总与它保持距离。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is timid by nature and prefers solitude. If overheard while singing, it panics and secretes poisonous gas from its skin, a habit that causes other Pokémon to keep their distance.

entry: POKENAME的身体像一只薄膜气球，里面充满多种毒气。它能把气体强行压入卷起的耳朵，借助强大的气压出击。
author: anonymous_moose
source: POKENAME's body is like a thin, filmy balloon filled with a mixture of poisonous gases. By forcing this gas into its rolled-up ears, it can strike with tremendous pneumatic force.

entry: 受到威胁时，POKENAME会排出携带蘑菇孢子的毒气。难闻的臭味通常就足以赶走危险，因此它很少需要喷出超过一小口的气体。
author: .jerden
source: If threatened, POKENAME will vent a toxic gas that carries its mushroom spores. The horrible stench is usually sufficient to drive any threat away, so it rarely needs to release more than a small puff.

entry: POKENAME生活在土壤遭化学物质污染的区域，会从泥土中吸取毒素作为养分。它从身上小喷口吹出的棉花云，可用来制作防污衣物。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is found in areas with chemically contaminated soil, where it sucks the toxins from the dirt as nutrients. From small spouts on its body it blasts clouds of cotton, which is used to make stain-resistant clothing.

entry: POKENAME在地表下方钻洞，用气体鼓松沙土，方便挖掘。受惊时，它会裹着一团脏黄色的云冲出地面，接连数小时都不停排气。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME burrows just below the surface, using gas to inflate the sand and make it easier to tunnel. When startled, it erupts from the ground surrounded by a dirty yellow cloud and will not stop releasing gas for hours.

entry: POKENAME在工厂中飞行，从口中释放黄色烟雾。工人们常说，它从头顶经过时，自己会突然咳嗽不止。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies through factories releasing yellow smog from its mouth. Workers often report sudden coughing fits when it passes overhead.

entry: POKENAME住在发电厂的电表里，会吃掉电缆和断路器，引发足以让大型城镇或整座城市断电的事故。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME live within electricity meters found in power plants. They eat electric cables and circuit breakers, causing power outages that can take out a large town or city.

entry: POKENAME浑身带病，会用有害气体污染空气，还会把黏稠的口水滴到洞穴地面。许多宝可梦只要吸入气体或碰到口水，就会长出荨麻疹。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are disease-ridden creatures that fill the air with noxious fumes and drool thick, sticky saliva onto cavern floors. Many Pokémon that either inhale the fumes or touch the saliva break out in hives.

entry: POKENAME吞食垃圾箱里的垃圾，将废物发酵成毒气。积聚的气体让它能懒洋洋地飘在小巷上方。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME devours trash from dumpsters, fermenting the waste into toxic gas. The buildup lets it float lazily above alleyways.

entry: POKENAME通常生活在沼泽，以散发恶臭闻名。日落后，多只聚在一起，臭味便浓得难以忍受，令捕食者不敢靠近。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are typically found in swamps and are known for the awful stench they produce. When multiple POKENAME gather after sunset, the smell becomes unbearable, keeping predators at bay.

entry: POKENAME岩石般坚硬的身体里，大部分空间充满神秘而活泼的物质，会随天气变化轻易冻结或蒸发。因此，它似乎几乎从不离开遍布洞穴的山中领地。
author: bobosmith01
source: Much of POKENAME's rock-hard body is filled with mysterious and highly reactive matter: it easily freezes or evaporates depending on the weather. It is for this reason that POKENAME appears to almost never roam from its cavernous mountain domain.

entry: 这种宝可梦会先在空中翻跟头，再释放云团般的气体，宛如抛出极具戏剧效果的烟雾弹。在它眼中，每一场战斗都是值得观众欣赏的演出。
author: jaminmcready
source: This Pokémon performs midair somersaults before releasing clouds of gas like dramatic smoke bombs. It considers every battle an audience-worthy performance.

entry: POKENAME把气体储存在躯干中，胀得几乎要爆开。战斗时，它能迅速把气体导向尖刺，利用过高的压力将尖刺射出。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's gas is stored within its main body, filling it to the point of near bursting. In battle, it can quickly vent this gas towards its spikes, sending them shooting out with the excess pressure.

entry: POKENAME从体内排出的孢子，会让其他宝可梦染上各种疾病。这些具有传染性的真菌孢子，使许多训练家与它接触时不得不戴上面罩。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME infect other Pokémon with a myriad of diseases through the spores they expel from their bodies. The infectious fungal spores force many Trainers to wear masks when handling POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME极爱社交，又十分忠诚，即使全身不断涌出烟雾，也总想往训练家身上蹭。好在健康的饮食和适当的梳理，能帮助它把烟雾过滤成更洁净的空气。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
