source: POKENAME are extremely social and loyal, constantly trying to nuzzle into Trainers despite the smog constantly billowing along their bodies. Luckily, giving a POKENAME a healthy diet and proper grooming can help filter the smog into cleaner air.

entry: POKENAME唱歌时，会吐出音符形状的气体云。歌声虽然悦耳，云团却十分刺鼻，闻到的人都会剧烈咳嗽。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME sings, it emits clouds of gas in the shapes of musical notes. Though it makes a pleasant sound, these clouds are very pungent and will send those who smell them into fierce coughing fits.

entry: POKENAME不断从身体释放孢子，形成恶臭的瘴气。许多训练家和宝可梦吸入一口孢子就会生病，常伴有发烧和喉咙痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME constantly release spores from their body in the form of a foul miasma. Many Trainers and Pokémon get sick when breathing in a puff of POKENAME spores, often developing a fever and sore throat.

entry: POKENAME喜欢空气质量差的地方，因此能经训练，在出现烟雾、一氧化碳或燃气泄漏等情况时提醒人们。在危险性高的工厂中，它可靠的感官对安全至关重要。
author: corra_universe
source: Due to their affinity for low air quality, POKENAME can be trained to alert people of things like smoke, carbon monoxide, and gas leaks. The reliability of their senses is vital for safety in high-risk manufacturing plants.

entry: POKENAME喜欢空气质量差的地方，因此能经训练，在出现烟雾、一氧化碳或燃气泄漏等情况时提醒人们。在危险性高的工厂中，它可靠的感官对安全至关重要。
author: corra_universe
source: Due to their affinity for low air quality, POKENAME can be trained to alert people of things like smoke, carbon monoxide, and gas leaks. The reliability of their senses is vital for safety in high-risk manufacturing plants.

entry: POKENAME喜欢待在空气质量差的地方。由于不同种群的数据互不一致，研究者始终无法确定它们对生态的影响。
author: corra_universe
source: POKENAME enjoy being in places with low air quality. Studies have been unable to determine their ecological effects due to inconsistent data between populations.

entry: POKENAME喜欢待在空气质量差的地方。由于不同种群的数据互不一致，研究者始终无法确定它们对生态的影响。
author: corra_universe
source: POKENAME enjoy being in places with low air quality. Studies have been unable to determine their ecological effects due to inconsistent data between populations.

entry: 为了抵御捕食者，POKENAME的皮肤会分泌黏液泡泡。泡泡里充满毒气，能赶走想要咬它的捕食者。
author: hophoppip
source: To safeguard it against predators, POKENAME's skin secretes mucus bubbles. These bubbles are inflated with toxic gas, repelling any predators who attempt to bite it.

entry: POKENAME一发现危险，就会排出一团有害气体，消失无踪。除了令人作呕的气味，什么也不会留下，让人无法判断它去了哪里。
author: atlas3339098
source: POKENAME can expel a cloud of noxious fumes to vanish at the first sign of trouble. It leaves behind no trace of where it went, except a nauseating odor.

entry: POKENAME能用毒气制造诱饵，分散对手注意。需要撤退时，它会放出诱饵，让毒气充满周围。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME can use poisonous gas to make decoys that distract its opponent. When POKENAME needs to retreat, it spawns decoys and fills the area with poisonous gas.

entry: POKENAME在火山内睡觉时，会释放浓烟，笼罩全身。这些烟雾酸性极强，不可随意触碰。
author: .izik
source: While sleeping inside volcanoes, POKENAME emits thick smoke that engulfs its entire body. The fumes are highly acidic and unsafe to touch.

entry: POKENAME的自然栖息地里有许多超能力属性宝可梦，因此它们会大量食用福禄果。受到精神波攻击时，它们会猛然释放烟雾，再踢开障碍物，为自己争取逃跑机会。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME eat lots of Payapa Berries because their natural environment has lots of Psychic-type Pokémon. Whenever they are struck by psychic waves, they release a burst of smog and kick through obstacles to give themselves a chance of escape.

entry: POKENAME从地下冲出时，会让有害气体充满周围。吸入气体会头晕、神志不清，想从它面前逃走十分困难。
author: quackquackattack
source: When POKENAME erupt from the ground, they saturate the area full of noxious fumes. The fumes cause dizziness and confusion when inhaled, making escape from POKENAME quite difficult.

entry: POKENAME不收集硬币，而是收集金属碎片和小饰物。它把这些东西藏在毒气云里，挑衅别人伸手进去寻找。
author: jaminmcready
source: Instead of collecting coins, POKENAME gathers metallic scraps and small trinkets. It hides them in clouds of gas, daring others to reach into the smog and find them.

entry: 颇有些讽刺的是，POKENAME不喜欢弄脏自己，或许是因为皮肤上有许多孔洞，可它也不喜欢别人替它清洗。
author: bobosmith01
source: Ironically, POKENAME dislikes getting dirty, perhaps due to its porous skin, but it doesn't like others cleaning it, either.

entry: POKENAME总想憋住气体，让自己更容易亲近，可一旦用力过度，就会头痛。愿意帮助它做回自己的训练家，将得到一位值得信赖的终身伙伴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME constantly try to hold in their gas to make themselves more approachable and develop a headache if they strain too hard. Trainers who help them act as their natural selves will find a reliable lifelong partner.

entry: POKENAME充满自信，丝毫不为身体排出的气体感到羞耻。它会伴着响声一阵阵放气；若在水下，便会形成一团压缩空气球。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are confident creatures that are unashamed of the gas they release from their bodies. They release this gas in loud bursts, which causes a ball of concentrated air to form if they are underwater.

entry: 给POKENAME安排特殊饮食，便能让排出的气体失去活性。它性情开朗，是不错的宠物，只是养起来颇费钱。
author: staghorn
source: A POKENAME's emissions can be rendered inert if they are fed a specialty diet. Their cheery temperaments make them good, if expensive, pets.

entry: POKENAME体形小巧，常在脏污的淡水中繁衍生息。它们似乎靠吸收并代谢水中的污染物维生。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are small Pokémon that often thrive within dirty freshwater. They seem to absorb and metabolize the pollutants in the water as their means of survival.

entry: 它身上的气孔除了排出有害气体，还会分泌黏稠的油状液体。这层液体能防止POKENAME干燥，也能让攻击从皮肤上滑开。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The pores on its body expel noxious gas as well as a thick, oily fluid. This fluid protects POKENAME from drying out and helps attacks slide off its skin.

entry: POKENAME的拳头由毒气构成，对有嗅觉的敌人尤其有力。体内硫、甲烷与氦的混合物让它浮在地面上方。
author: krune
source: With fists made of noxious gas, POKENAME's attacks will land a hefty blow to any foe with a sense of smell. A mixture of sulfur, methane and helium in its body keeps it floating above ground.

entry: POKENAME绷紧肌肉时，就会释放毒气。肌肉越强壮，毒气的毒性也越强。
author: gnom3
source: When POKENAME flexes its muscles, it releases toxic gas. The stronger its muscles are, the more toxic the gas becomes.

entry: POKENAME偏爱受污染的水域，近几年扩散得很快。它到来后，本就污浊的水，又会渐渐变得更脏。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has spread fast in recent years because it prefers polluted waters. The already dirty waters are slowly being contaminated by its presence.

entry: POKENAME把自己伪装成美味的蔬菜，挂在树上，等其他宝可梦前来吃它。猎物一靠近，它就喷出毒粉，使其动弹不得，再整个吞下。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME disguise themselves as tasty vegetables and hang from trees while they wait for another Pokémon to attempt to eat them. Once their prey is close, they expel a poisonous powder that immobilizes the target and then they devour the prey whole.

entry: POKENAME能暂时把制造的烟雾凝固成拳头，用于自卫。被这种云雾肢体打中，不仅会疼痛，还会留下持久的毒性。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can temporarily solidify the smog it creates into fists for self-defense. Being punched by these cloudy limbs not only hurts but leaves a lasting poison in those struck.

entry: POKENAME潜水时，会不断排出气泡。哪怕只吸入几秒，也会让呼吸道受到严重刺激。
author: chorb33
source: When POKENAME dives, it regularly emits bubbles of gas. Anyone who inhales this gas for even a few seconds can expect severe respiratory irritation.

entry: POKENAME靠不规律地喷气飘浮，而非磁力。有人说，它体内储存着不断变化的不稳定化学物质，让移动轨迹难以预测。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME floats using erratic bursts of gas rather than magnets. Some say its body stores volatile chemicals that constantly shift, creating unpredictable movement patterns.

entry: POKENAME体内不断酿出极易爆炸的气体，可黏稠的身体又关不住气体，让它疼痛不堪。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME constantly brews a highly explosive gas within its body. Due to its slimy form, it cannot contain the gas well enough, causing it pain.

entry: POKENAME堪称污秽的化身，据说光是气味，就能熏走其他宝可梦。到了夏天，臭得连附近城镇，都不得不疏散。
author: symile
source: The essence of filth, a POKENAME's scent is said to repel other Pokémon. During the summer, its stench warrants evacuation of nearby towns.

entry: POKENAME产生的气体，其性质与科学界目前已知的任何其他气态物质都不同。这种物质似乎能脱离本体自主活动，但分散得太稀薄时，就会失去这种特性。
author: krogens
source: POKENAME produces a gas that exhibits qualities unlike any other known gaseous substance currently known to science. This substance appears to act independently of POKENAME's body, but loses this quality when dispersed too thinly.

entry: POKENAME喜欢闹鬼宅，用气体让房间充满恶臭。吸入烟雾过久，可能会失去意识。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME enjoys haunting houses, filling their rooms with a foul stench using its gas. Inhaling its fumes for too long can cause people to lose consciousness.

entry: POKENAME的毒素从尾尖一路向上，再从靠近头部的身体节段排出。这种毒对岩石属性宝可梦尤其有效，因此许多地下居民都会远远避开它。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's toxins work their way up from the tip of the tail before being exhaled through the segments closer to its head. Its poison works particularly well on Rock-types, so many underground denizens give it a wide berth.

entry: POKENAME从体内释放的气体会让人陷入沉睡。吸入者会梦见可怕的疾病，噩梦连连。
author: petratheangel
source: The gas POKENAME releases from its body induces deep sleep. Those who inhale it experience nightmares about terrible illnesses.

entry: 受到威胁时，POKENAME会从嘴里吹出有毒泡泡，笼罩全身。这些泡泡经常污染它们栖息的水域。
author: santon5512
source: When threatened, POKENAME will cloak themselves in toxic bubbles blown from their mouths. These bubbles often contaminate the water they inhabit.

entry: POKENAME喜欢与同类聚在一起，一同硬化外壳，让阳光折射成耀眼、斑驳的光影。
author: curerry
source: POKENAME enjoys gathering with other members of its kind. Together, they harden their shells, creating dashing displays of fractured sunlight.

entry: POKENAME会用黏稠的丝线在树枝间荡行，同时顺时针旋转身体，积蓄动势。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME will swing from branch to branch using a sticky string of silk. During the swing, it spins its body clockwise to gain momentum.

entry: 野外遇见POKENAME，可要小心。它为进化储备能量时，性情格外凶暴。
author: pixlhoopa
source: When you find POKENAME in the wild, be cautious. It's known to be violent when storing its power to prep for evolution.

entry: POKENAME的两层壳会保护它们直到进化，之后便留给后代。它们能将用自身外壳制成的小骨头射到50英尺远。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME have two shells that protect them until they reach evolution, which they then pass off to their offspring. POKENAME can fire small bones made from their own outer shell up to 50ft away.

entry: 幽灵宝可梦似乎把它当作通往来世的向导，一路跟随。POKENAME却好像浑然不觉，依旧无忧无虑地四处游荡。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: Ghost Pokémon seem to follow it as if were a guide for the afterlife. POKENAME appears to be rather oblivious to it, cruising along without a care in the world.

entry: POKENAME用灵巧的腿不停奔跑，躲开一切潜在危险，直到准备好进化。如果被逼到角落，也能踢出有力的一脚，让对手不敢靠近。
author: santon5512
source: Using their nimble legs, POKENAME are always on the run, fleeing from any potential danger until ready to evolve. If backed into a corner, they can deliver powerful kicks to keep opponents at bay.

entry: POKENAME积蓄进化所需的能量时，坚硬的外壳会保护它。它藏在层层毒气后，躲避捕食者。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its hard shell protects POKENAME while it stores the energy it needs to evolve. It hides behind layers of poisonous gas to stay safe from predators.

entry: 将两只铁甲蛹融合，会使这种宝可梦的甲壳坚硬如钻石。为进化而产生的能量，让其密度提升到近乎恒星的程度。
author: mistymagius
source: Fusing two Metapod together makes these Pokémon's carapaces as hard as diamond. The energy generated for evolution increases their density to almost star-like levels.

entry: POKENAME坚韧的外甲有数厘米厚，能承受相当猛烈的物理打击。甲壳下的身体正处于蜕变之中，一旦受到重伤，它们便会格外谨慎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a tough outer armour that is several centimetres thick, letting them endure significant physical punishment. Their bodies are in a state of metamorphosis beneath their armour and they are very careful if they suffer major injury.

entry: POKENAME的茧由相互扣合的灰绿色鳞片构成，能挡开啃咬与抓挠。它们也会不断释放墨汁，遮蔽附近捕食者的视线。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a cocoon made of interlocking sage-colored scales that deflect bites and scratches. They also release a constant stream of ink that obscures the vision of nearby predators.

entry: POKENAME会拖着鳍穿过海藻，伪装成一片漂浮的海藻。这能让捕食者不再理会它们，保护茧免受损伤。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME drag their fins through seaweed to create the illusion that they are a piece of floating seaweed. This camouflage convinces predators to leave them alone and saves their cocoon from getting damaged.

entry: POKENAME藏在海藻林中保护自己。它们柔软的茧上能长出海藻，让伪装更加逼真。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hide within forests of seaweed to keep themselves safe. Their soft cocoons can grow seaweed to make their camouflage more convincing.

entry: POKENAME藏在海藻林中，躲避捕食者的侦察。柔软的茧能让海藻长在身上，进一步改善伪装。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hide within seaweed forests to avoid detection from predators. Their soft cocoons allow them to grow seaweed on their bodies to improve their camouflage.

entry: POKENAME的身体近似方块，多只便能拼合成复杂的结构，彼此保护。人们有时会发现，路上突然多了一堵由它们组成的墙，一夜之间就挡住了去路。
author: corra_universe
source: POKENAME's cube-like shape allows for multiples of this Pokémon to join together in elaborate structures for protection. People sometimes find their paths blocked by walls of POKENAME that have popped up overnight.

entry: POKENAME受到惊吓时，身体会变得极其坚硬。它还会释放紫色粉末，几秒内就能让成年男子睡着。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME is frightened, its body becomes extremely hard. It releases a purple powder capable of putting a full grown man to sleep within seconds.

entry: 与海星星不同，POKENAME的身体受损后无法轻易再生。不过，它的外壳更加柔韧，能轻松钻进铁甲蛹无法进入的地方。
author: bobosmith01
source: Unlike Staryu, POKENAME's body cannot easily regenerate if damaged. However, its outer shell is more flexible, so POKENAME can more easily fit into places Metapod could not.

entry: POKENAME皮厚，脸皮也厚。面对别人对哑剧表演的任何批评，它都能不断硬起心肠，最后连一点意见也听不进去了。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has a thick skin. It has the ability to harden itself against any criticism of its pantomime act until it becomes incapable of taking any feedback.

entry: POKENAME巨大的镰刀能切开坚实的钢铁。生气时，它的攻击会失去准头，只顾胡乱挥砍。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's large scythes can slice through solid steel. When it is angry, it loses precision on its attacks and swipes wildly.

entry: POKENAME用爪子挖地筑巢。钻进洞后，它会用泥土盖住自己，为进化做准备。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its claws to dig into the ground and make a den. Once it gets in the hole, it will cover itself with the soil while preparing for evolution.

entry: POKENAME会用身体相互冲撞，每撞一次，壳就会变得更坚韧。据说，这种行为能加快进化，让进化后的它们更强。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME ram their bodies into each other, toughening their shells with each hit. This behavior is said to accelerate their evolution, causing them to evolve even stronger.

entry: POKENAME头上的毒针时不时就会脱落。有些药师会收集这些针，用来制作PP单项小补剂。
author: .izik
source: The stinger on POKENAME's head breaks off from time to time. There are apothecaries who gather these stingers for use in creating Ethers.

entry: POKENAME亲切而迟缓，喜欢懒洋洋地待着，观察周围的世界。蛹期的它们食欲很低，训练家必须主动喂食，确保体重保持健康。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are cordial yet slow creatures that enjoy lounging around observing the world around them. They have little appetite while in their pupal state, so Trainers have to feed them to ensure they remain a healthy weight.

entry: 即使化为数字资料，POKENAME仍有严密的代码保护。外壳如同防火墙，替它隔绝危险。
author: pixlhoopa
source: Even as digital code, POKENAME is protected with secure code. The shell is akin to a firewall, securing it from danger.

entry: POKENAME的壳并没有想象中那么坚硬。进化前，它通常会潜入深水或藏在岩石下，以免被捕食者发现并破开外壳。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME's shell is less hard than one might expect. Before evolving, it typically goes deep underwater or hides under a rock lest it be found and broken open by a predator.

entry: POKENAME会让外壳变硬，保护自己。壳内充满黏稠液体，临近进化、开始准备时，液体就会沸腾。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME hardens its shell to protect itself. This shell is filled with a thick liquid. This liquid boils when it is preparing for its coming evolution.

entry: POKENAME会展开翅膀，吓退闯入领地的宝可梦。尽管体形很有威慑力，包裹身体的几丁质外壳却让它们只能短距离跳跃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME keep their wings outstretched to scare off Pokémon that enter their territory. Despite their formidable size, they are only capable of short hops because of the chitinous shell around their body.

entry: POKENAME的身体裹着两层独立的茧，保护正在进化的形态。这虽然增强了防御，却也延长了完成进化所需的时间。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME contains two separate layers of cocoon over its body to protect its evolving form. Though this gives it added defenses, it also lengthens the amount of time for evolution to complete.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的毒针主要用来吓唬对手。虽然含有微弱毒素，它还是更愿意借此把捕食者吓离巢穴。
author: .izik
source: The stinger on POKENAME's tail is mostly for show. While it does contain a weak poison, it prefers to use it to scare predators from its nest.

entry: POKENAME会藏到森林深处，避开其他生物，直到进化完成。尾巴上的茧能够振动，释放微弱的精神脉冲；越靠近它，就越容易头晕、神志不清。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides deep in the forest to hide away from others until evolution completes. The cocoon on its tail can vibrate to release faint psychic pulses that cause disorientation and confusion the closer they draw to it.

entry: POKENAME的特殊茧壳长有叶片状的甲片，会随着生长不断剥落。草药师会收集这些气味浓烈的甲片，制成苦味药饮。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a special cocoon that has leafy plates that flake off as they continue to grow. Herbalists take these pungent plates to create bitter medicinal drinks.

entry: POKENAME会用黏稠的树液润滑茧壳。进化后，药师会取走留下的茧，制作强健骨骼的补剂。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a thick sap that lubricates their cocoons. Once they evolve, apothecaries take the cocoon that is left behind to create a supplement that makes bones stronger.

entry: POKENAME背上带着一包丝，里面储存着炽热的余烬。受到威胁时，丝囊会短暂打开，喷出热气和煤灰，吓退危险。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME carry a bundle of silk on their back that stores hot embers. Whenever they are threatened, the silk pouch momentarily opens to spray hot air and soot to scare away danger.

entry: 等待进化时，POKENAME会用黏丝附着在树干上。它羽毛般的外壳能变得比石头还坚固。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME clings to tree trunks with sticky silk while awaiting evolution. Its feather-like casing can become sturdier than stone.

entry: POKENAME受伤时，会释放信息素，提醒其他宝可梦附近有危险。更多捕食者因此不去招惹它，以免惊走其他潜在猎物。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever a POKENAME gets hurt, they release pheromones that alert other Pokémon to the danger nearby. More predators leave POKENAME alone to avoid scaring away other potential prey.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME会在森林中飞来飞去，寻找最适合睡觉的树。找到后，它就用特殊的丝把自己系在树枝上入睡。
author: .izik
source: During the night, POKENAME flies around the forest to search for the perfect tree to sleep in. It uses a peculiar silk to tie itself to a branch and sleep.

entry: POKENAME从身体底部吐出丝线，挂在树枝上。这尤其适合埋伏，等待从上方落到猎物身上。
author: .izik
source: The base of POKENAME's body excretes a silky string that it uses to hang from branches. This is primarily useful when it is waiting to drop onto prey.

entry: POKENAME会钻进向日葵田的泥土中，等待进化。它吃下花根，为外壳补充养分。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows into the dirt of sunflower fields to wait for evolution. It consumes flower roots to gain nutrients for its shell.

entry: POKENAME裹在厚厚的茧中，免受伤害。如果从树上掉下来，它们就会快速迈动腿，爬回原来的位置。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are encased in a thick cocoon that protects them from harm. Whenever they fall out of trees, their legs skitter to bring them back to where they were.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀曾是茧的一部分。翅膀能变得坚硬如钢，它会用来毫不留情地攻击敌人。
author: raydrago
source: POKENAME's wings were once part of its cocoon. They can grow as hard as steel and POKENAME uses them to attack its enemies mercilessly.

entry: POKENAME用丝线把巢固定在树枝上。巢在微风中轻轻摇晃，与树冠融为一体。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME secures its nest to branches using silk strands. It sways gently in the breeze, blending into the canopy.

entry: POKENAME开心时，周身就会迸出一片火花。它睡在电源插座旁，为身体补充电力。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME is happy, it lets loose a flurry of sparks around its body. It sleeps near electric outlets to charge its body with energy.

entry: POKENAME看似是捕食者唾手可得的点心，可想把它叼走的宝可梦很快就会发现，它重得出奇。包裹身体的坚韧茧壳，也很难被捕食者弄破。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME may seem like an easy snack for predators, but Pokémon that try to carry it away find that it is quite heavy. The tough cocoon around its body also makes it difficult for predators to break.

entry: POKENAME会待在树枝上，一直等到进化。如果被打落，头顶的叶片就能让它们安全飘到林地上。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sit atop branches where they sit until they evolve. If they are knocked down from their branch, the leaves atop their head allow them to float safely to the forest floor.

entry: 虽然行动迟缓，POKENAME对自己承受攻击的本领很有信心。即使波波啄它一下，也几乎伤不到它。
author: pixlhoopa
source: Although sluggish, POKENAME has confidence in its ability to withstand attacks. Even a Pidgey's peck will barely damage it.

entry: 准备进化时，POKENAME会挂在树枝上，像钟摆一样摇荡。受到惊吓时，身体能变得比铁还硬。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swings like a pendulum from tree branches as it prepares for evolution. Its body can become harder than iron when it is startled.

entry: POKENAME一动不动地准备进化，常被误认成枝叶。它靠外壳吸收的水分，维持生命。
author: zagreus8
source: POKENAME are often mistake for foliage as they keep completely still, preparing for evolution. They subsist on moisture absorbed through their shell.

entry: POKENAME即使睡着也能飞行。长时间沉睡时，它会在水面上方盘旋。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can fly even while it sleeps. During a prolonged slumber, it will fly in circles above a body of water.

entry: POKENAME会结茧，保护柔软的身体，直到成长得足以进化。临近进化时，茧壳会开始剥落。在一些文化中，这些碎片曾被用来按传统方法制作元气粉。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME builds a cocoon to protect its soft body whilst it grows strong enough to evolve. As it nears evolution, bits of the cocoon start to flake off. This was used in some cultures as a traditional way to make Energy Powder.

entry: POKENAME太重，无法挂在树枝上，因此常躺在地上，光滑的背部任凭风吹日晒。落地后，它们有时会挪动位置，找一片赏心悦目的景色，边看边发呆。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are too heavy to hang from branches, so they often lie on the ground with their smooth back exposed to the elements. Depending on where they land, they may shuffle their position so they have a pleasant scene to look at as they daydream.

entry: POKENAME生性胆小、温顺，可进化越近，就越严防死守，不让背上的茧受伤。
author: curerry
source: POKENAME is quite timid and docile in nature. However, as it approaches evolution, it grows more defensive in protecting the cocoon on its back.

entry: POKENAME在磨难与战斗中很少移动，身体逐渐僵硬，几乎无法行动。如今只能强化防御、准备反击，同时节省能量。
author: sontyp
source: Rarely moving through hardships and battles has made POKENAME's body rigid and largely immobile. All it can do now is harden its defenses and prepare for a counterstrike while conserving energy.

entry: POKENAME会在草地上快速奔跑，寻找僻静的地方休息，为进化做准备。准备期间，它会静得令人发毛。此时若有人靠近，触角就会发光，释放强烈的精神力冲击。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME gallops quickly across grassy landscapes to find a secluded place to rest and prepare for evolution; while this occurs, it remains eerily still. If approached in this state, its antennae glow and let loose blasts of psychic power.

entry: POKENAME让身体变硬的同时，也会在核心产生爆炸性气体。如果身体不够坚硬，核心就会爆炸。
author: .izik
source: While POKENAME hardens its body, it generates an explosive gas in its core. Should it fail to harden its body enough, the core will blow up.

entry: POKENAME全身的铠甲比钻石还坚韧。不过，由于铠甲太重，人们曾见过它为了狩猎将其褪下。这会让它变得十分脆弱，尤其怕火焰。
author: patch
source: The armor all along POKENAME's body is even tougher than diamonds. Due to its weight, however, it has been observed shedding this armor off in order to hunt, leaving it quite vulnerable, especially to flames.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀包裹着坚硬的几丁质，因此很难飞行。硬壳里藏着柔软的绒羽，等它蜕变为成体时，就会显露出来。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The wings of POKENAME are encased in hard chitin, making it hard for them to fly. There are soft downy feathers hidden within the hard shell ready to emerge when they moult into adults.

entry: POKENAME悬在树枝上摇荡，坚硬多刺的身体像拆墙球。更强的宝可梦会抓住树枝，将它当连枷使用。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME swings from tree branches, its tough, spiky body acting as a wrecking ball. Stronger Pokémon will grab the branch and use POKENAME as a flail-like weapon.

entry: POKENAME准备进化时，会缩进壳内。平时多处于休眠，用触手自卫。
author: pixlhoopa
source: While POKENAME prepares for evolution, its body retracts into its shell. Known for being dormant, it uses tentacles for self-defense.

entry: POKENAME的壳在阳光下会变得更硬。完全干燥后，甚至能比钛还坚硬。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's shell grows harder in the sunlight. Once its shell dries out entirely, it can grow harder than titanium.

entry: POKENAME液化的身体会从硬壳里溢出。准备进化时，液体内会逐渐形成固态的器官。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's liquefied body spills out of its hard shell. As it prepares for evolution, solid organs gradually form within the liquid.

entry: POKENAME很少飞行，大多在不高不矮的树上筑巢：既高得足以避开地面的捕食者，又低得能避开空中的捕食者。外壳受损后，它会用丝网包扎，随时间慢慢修复。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME rarely takes flight and mostly nests in moderately tall trees: high enough to avoid land predators, low enough to avoid airborne ones. Damage to its outer shell can be repaired over time: POKENAME will bandage it with silk webbing.

entry: POKENAME用吸盘附着在树上，防止自己掉下去。它们在茧内成长，茧壳则保护它们免受危险。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME adhere to trees with their suction cups to prevent themselves from falling out of trees. Their cocoon protects them from danger as they grow from within.

entry: POKENAME很少飞行，大多在不高不矮的树上筑巢：既高得足以避开地面的捕食者，又低得能避开空中的捕食者。外壳受损后，它会用丝网包扎，随时间慢慢修复。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME rarely takes flight and mostly nests in moderately tall trees: high enough to avoid land predators, low enough to avoid airborne ones. Damage to its outer shell can be repaired over time: POKENAME will bandage it with silk webbing.

entry: 吃够进化所需的食物后，POKENAME常会躲进树木内部。它们以硬壳防身，耐心等待再次进化。
author: oejoeboy33
source: After eating enough food to evolve, POKENAME will often hide inside of trees. With their hardened shell as defense, they wait patiently to evolve once more.

entry: POKENAME往往一动不动地待在水下洞穴中休息，节省体力。谁敢打扰这份安宁，它就会暴怒，用坚硬无比的壳猛撞触及范围内的一切。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME tends to rest motionless in underwater caves to conserve energy. If anyone dares disturb its peace, it flies into a rage and slams its incredibly hard shell against anything within reach.

entry: 越接近进化，POKENAME的茧就越光滑圆润。进化迫在眉睫时，茧壳会出现裂纹，缝隙中能看见飞速流动的二进制代码。
author: sk372
source: The closer POKENAME gets to evolving, the smoother and more rounded its cocoon gets. When evolution is imminent, cracks begin to form and binary code can be seen quickly flowing within the gaps.

entry: 覆盖全身的茧让POKENAME行动十分受限。它会振动鹿角，制造令人头晕的精神脉冲，借此自卫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's movement is very restricted due to the cocoon covering its body. It vibrates its antlers to create disorienting psychic pulses as a way to defend itself.

entry: 还是绿小子时，就耗掉了大部分能量，如今POKENAME格外倦怠。它停在低垂树枝上，只有自卫时才战斗。
author: jackythewannabe
source: With most of its energy spent as a Caterogue, POKENAME grows lethargic. It sits in low-hanging tree branches, only fighting in self defense.

entry: POKENAME的头骨坚硬而致密，能将整块巨石劈成两半。需要睡觉时，它们会把尾巴缠在树枝或树干上，悬挂着休息。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME have powerful skulls that are so dense they can split an entire boulder in half. When they need to sleep, they hang from a tree by wrapping their tail around a branch or the trunk itself.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上长有厚重的几丁质棒槌，却没有足够的力量把它当武器挥动。因此，它们会把棒槌伪装成身体，引诱捕食者攻击那里。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a thick chitinous club on their tail, but lack the strength to properly wield it as a weapon. Instead, they use it as a decoy for their body, luring predators to attack the club rather than themselves.

entry: POKENAME耐心无穷，很少动弹，又或许只是脑子不太灵光。有时，它吃最爱的甜树果吃得太慢，果子都在嘴里发酵了。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME possesses infinite patience and rarely moves, or perhaps it's just that the lights are not all on upstairs. Sometimes it takes so long to eat its favorite sweet berries that they ferment in its mouth.

entry: 受雷丘影响的身体需要更多能量来维持，加上体内流淌着强大电流，大多数新出现的野生POKENAME要么很快进化，要么就永远不会进化。它靠甩尾猛击发动攻击。
author: bobosmith01
source: Due to the increased amounts of energy needed to sustain its Raichu-affected body as well as the fact that POKENAME courses with powerful electricity, most new wild POKENAME tend to evolve soon, or simply never will. It attacks by slamming its tail.

entry: POKENAME食量惊人，行动却慢得很，经常还没吃到东西就放弃，因而常常营养不良。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME has an incredibly large appetite. They're so slow-moving that they often give up before ever eating, which often leaves POKENAME malnourished.

entry: POKENAME头脑简单，经常被误认成替身玩偶。已有多起报告称，它们因此被卷入训练家的宝可梦对战，遭到误伤。它们本来总是尽量避免战斗。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME are simple creatures that are commonly confused with substitute dolls. This has led to multiple reported incidents of POKENAME getting caught in the crossfire of Pokémon trainer battles. They try to avoid fighting as much as possible.

entry: 构成POKENAME外壳的一部分黏丝，连接在裹着壳的双翼之间，让它能够滑翔。临近进化时，翅膀会在壳内搅动，逐渐将外壳撑裂。
author: infinex21
source: Some of the sticky threads used to form POKENAME's shell hang between its shell-clad wings, allowing it to glide through the air. As it grows closer to its evolution, its wings churn within the shell to gradually break it apart.

entry: POKENAME硬化的叶状身体里充满甜美树液。它知道自己的气味让食草动物和食虫动物都难以抗拒，因此总对周围充满戒心，时刻警惕，准备逃跑。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME's hardened leafy body is full of sweet sap. Knowing it smells irresistible to herbivores and insectivores alike, POKENAME is always alert, distrustful of its environment and ready to run.

entry: POKENAME硬化的身体里，叶绿素比血淋巴还多。它很少动弹，靠硬扛承受攻击，但别把它当成容易到手的猎物：它会在来犯者身上留下甜香物质，引来密集得令人窒息的其他虫属性宝可梦。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME's hardened body contains more chlorophyll than hemolymph. It tanks attack and rarely moves, but don't mistake it for easy prey -- it leaves a sweet-smelling substance on attackers that attracts suffocating swarms of other Bug-types.

entry: POKENAME等待进化时，会藏在灌木丛中，掩护几乎不能移动的身体。它能让藤蔓破壳而出，用来自卫，不过修补破损的外壳会推迟进化。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides among shrubbery to camouflage its nearly-immobile body while it waits for evolution. To defend itself, vines can burst from within its shell, though growing back the broken spots delays its evolution.

entry: 保护POKENAME的外壳虽然坚韧，却并非牢不可破。它会尽量少动，因此总要仔细找一个舒适隐蔽、阳光也不错的地方，等待进化。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: The outer shell protecting POKENAME is tough, but not unbreakable. This Pokémon will try to move as little as possible, so it carefully finds a comfortable and hidden spot with decent sunlight to wait for its evolution.

entry: POKENAME察觉到不愉快的情绪时，会蜷在灌木中，使出变硬，让自己安心。它极其害羞，总是尽量少动，以免引起人类和宝可梦的注意。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME senses an unpleasant emotion, it curls up in the bushes and uses Harden to feel safer. Being extremely shy, it moves as little as possible to avoid drawing the attention of humans and Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME通常受到同巢伙伴的保护，在身体发育期间享受照料。坚硬的外壳让它们进食困难，因此伙伴会一直喂它们，直到进化。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are typically protected by their nestmates and get the luxury of being cared for while their bodies develop. Their tough shell makes eating difficult, so their nestmates feed them until they evolve.

entry: POKENAME的外壳几乎无法击穿，却也因此行动缓慢。于是，它把时间都用在思考上，运用自己媲美超级计算机的大脑。
author: torterrable
source: POKENAME's shell is nearly impenetrable, but because of that, it cannot move very quickly. Instead, it spends its time thinking with its supercomputer level brain.

entry: POKENAME寄宿在铁甲蛹形状的石头里，会从裂缝中凝聚成形。它并不特别敌视外界，只在铁甲蛹群落遭捕食者袭击时现身保护。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME forms up through cracks in the Metapod-shaped stone it inhabits. It is not especially hostile, appearing only to defend Metapod colonies from predators.

entry: POKENAME的壳会逐渐变硬、变光滑。如果在这个过程中遭到打扰，它就会猛扑向最近的目标，疯狂攻击。
author: zagreus8
source: POKENAME's shell toughens and smoothens over time. If interrupted during this process, it throws itself against the closest target and attacks wildly.

entry: POKENAME行动迟缓，很少争斗，主要依靠硬化成壳状的皮肤防身。皮肤一旦破裂，它就会渗出毒液，作为逼退对手的最后手段。
author: _._starry_._
source: POKENAME is slow and rarely fights, instead relying on its hardened, shell-like skin for defense. Should it break, POKENAME can ooze out a poisonous liquid as a last-ditch effort to deter its opponent.

entry: POKENAME会在住处附近缓步巡视，留意兄弟姐妹。虽然跑不快，它们的体形通常就足以吓退捕食者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME amble around near their homes to keep a close eye on their siblings. Even though they cannot move quickly, their size typically wards off predators.

entry: POKENAME会附着在沉船上，藏进缝隙，直到进化。如果久久不能进化，身上还可能开始长藤壶。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME attaches itself to sunken ships, hiding in the crevices until it evolves. If it takes the Pokémon a long time to evolve, barnacles may begin to grow on its body.

entry: POKENAME躺在林地上化蛹，背上帐篷般的突起，还能收留小宝可梦，替它们遮蔽危险。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lies on the ground in forests and pupates. It shelters small Pokémon in a tent-like outgrowth on its back.

entry: POKENAME移动极其缓慢，积蓄能量，准备褪去现有甲壳并进化。它们头部长有复杂的结构，用来威吓敌人，避免冒险交战。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME move very sluggishly, their bodies conserving energy in preparation to moult from their current carapace and evolve. They have elaborate head structures to try and intimidate foes away rather than risk having to fight.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间都静静躺在森林地面，纹丝不动。如果看见它四处走动，就意味着灾难即将降临。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME spend most of their time motionless, laying perfectly still on the forest floor. If you see a POKENAME moving around, it means disaster is soon to strike.

entry: 据说，POKENAME的茧所用的材料，比这颗星球上任何天然物质都更古老、更耐久。然而研究十分困难，因为它一旦进化，茧便会彻底化为尘埃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cocoon is said to be made of materials more ancient and durable than any naturally occurring on the planet. Analyzing them has proven difficult, as once POKENAME evolves, the cocoon dissipates completely into dust.

entry: POKENAME的壳能抵御许多攻击和环境影响。如果遭到过多威胁，或环境太过恶劣，它就会在最远1000米的范围内寻找新地点，继续等待进化。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's shell is resistant to many attacks and environmental factors. If threatened enough or its environment is too unfavorable, it will search up to 1000 meters for a new spot to wait for evolution.

entry: POKENAME的壳能抵御许多攻击和环境影响。如果遭到过多威胁，或环境太过恶劣，它就会在最远1000米的范围内寻找新地点，继续等待进化。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's shell is resistant to many attacks and environmental factors. If threatened enough or its environment is too unfavorable, it will search up to 1000 meters for a new spot to wait for evolution.

entry: POKENAME能用身体进行光合作用，制造氧气。准备进化时，壳内的身体柔软而脆弱。
author: the_fireplace
source: POKENAME undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. Inside the shell, it is soft and weak as it prepares to evolve.

entry: POKENAME胆子很大，即使外壳限制了行动，仍会四处游历。同巢伙伴经常为了它们的安全，把它们带回巢中。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are bold creatures that continue to wander the world even if their shell limits their movements. They are often brought back to a nest by their nestmates to keep them safe.

entry: POKENAME会把脸上的壳当作喙，敲开坚果、压碎食物，方便进食。如果摔倒，它宁愿趴在地上费力挣扎，也不肯接受别人的帮助。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their facial shells like beaks to break open nuts and to crush up foods so they can easily consume them. If they fall over, they will sooner stay down and struggle to climb up than accept help from another.

entry: POKENAME全身覆盖着比铁还硬的外骨骼，行动也因此困难得多。它们会用身体周围铁甲蛹形状的假身，分散敌人的注意。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME cover their bodies with an exoskeleton harder than iron. However, this makes moving far more difficult. They use the Metapod-shaped dummies around their bodies to distract foes.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时会挂在树枝上。如果选的树枝不够结实，醒来时就会发现自己躺在地上。露营时最好不要睡在它栖身的树下，因为它的壳比石头还硬。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME hang from tree branches while they sleep. If a strong enough limb is not chosen, they will wake on the ground. It is advised not to sleep beneath a POKENAME's tree when camping, as its shell is harder than stone.

entry: POKENAME会让坚硬无比的外壳布满电火花，好在最终进化前安心休息。遇见同类时，它会比一比谁的壳最坚韧。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME covers its extremely hard shell with electric sparks so that it can rest in peace while it waits to finally evolve. When it encounters another member of its species, it competes to see who has the toughest shell.

entry: POKENAME会待在河流中的同一个地方，积蓄能量。进化后，它的美丽将达到全新的境界。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME stays in one place in rivers to gather its energy. When it evolves, its beauty will reach a new level entirely.

entry: POKENAME是能吃苦的工厂工人，帮助机器保持顺畅运转。由于不需要进食，许多个体昼夜不停地工作，一直干到进化。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are resilient factory workers that help keep machines working smoothly. Many work around the clock as they do not need to eat, so they keep working until they evolve.

entry: POKENAME硬化的身体很难移动，因此常把长缎带当作手，抓取物品、保护自己。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME's hardened body is difficult to move. Therefore, it will often use its long ribbons as hands to grab objects and defend itself.

entry: POKENAME战斗时会鲁莽地迎头冲撞。外壳硬如钢铁，即使撞空也不会受伤。
author: teatedtiten
source: When battling, POKENAME will recklessly charge at the opponent headfirst. Their steel-hard shell ensures no damage is done to them when they miss.

entry: POKENAME会在漫长岁月中漂过太空、穿行星间，无法自行移动，等待数世纪才会进化。它能无限扭曲、伸展周围的空间，阻止一切妄图打扰它成长的力量。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME spends eons floating through space, across the stars, unable to move and waiting centuries to evolve. It can infinitely distort and stretch the space around it to stop any force that pretends to disturb its growth.

entry: POKENAME借助空间连续体，利用壳内空间积蓄势能。这份势能能够操纵物质与密度，会一直储存到最后的蜕变来临。
author: quackquackattack
source: Harnessing the spatial continuum, POKENAME embrace the space within their shells to develop potential energy. This potential energy has the capacity to manipulate matter and density, which they store until the final metamorphosis.

entry: POKENAME坚硬的外壳让移动十分困难，因此总待在原地。小型宝可梦在它身上爬来爬去，它似乎也毫不在意。
author: chartanon
source: POKENAME's hardened shell makes movement difficult, so it stays sitting in place. Small Pokémon will climb all over it without it seeming to care at all.

entry: POKENAME坚硬的外壳让移动十分困难，因此总待在原地。如果摔倒，它便再也爬不起来，直到进化才行。
author: chartanon
source: POKENAME's hardened shell makes movement difficult, so it stays sitting in place. If it falls over, it will be unable to get up until it evolves.

entry: 夜深人静时，POKENAME会在森林中游荡觅食。它们挥动丝线构成的手臂，从树上抓走铁甲蛹，带入夜色之中。
author: santon5512
source: In the dead of night, POKENAME wander through the forest in search of food. By spinning arms made of silk, they will snatch Metapod from the trees, carrying them off into the night.

entry: POKENAME吐出的红色金属丝，能缠住靠近其休息处的敌人。它似乎会在受威胁时更早进化，但这种情况只在个别事例中出现过。
author: .izik
source: The red metal silk POKENAME spits can ensnare foes that draw too close to its resting place. It appears to evolve sooner when threatened, though this only occurs in isolated instances.

entry: POKENAME最初的壳薄而易破。常常沐浴月光之后，才会逐渐坚韧。
author: pixlhoopa
source: The shell of a POKENAME is, at first, thin and penetrable. After regular moonbathing, its shell toughens up.

entry: POKENAME十分爱护铠甲般的茧壳。如果有一块破损，它就会把花束中的花瓣层层铺上，再覆以厚厚的毒丝。两者干燥后，会形成出奇坚硬的物质。
author: quantumradiation
source: POKENAME are very protective of their armour-like cocoon. If a piece breaks, POKENAME will layer petals from their bouquets before coating it in a thick, poisonous silk. This combination can dry to a surprisingly hard substance.

entry: POKENAME十分少见，它的行为也颇让人摸不着头脑。它的上半身始终纹丝不动，等待再次进化，下半身却仍会应对挑衅，奋起还击。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: The existence of POKENAME is uncommon, and its behavior is understandably confusing. Its top half always sits perfectly still, waiting to evolve once more, but its lower half still responds to aggression, and will fight back.

entry: POKENAME挂在发光等离子体构成的树枝上。由于树枝本身浮在空中，任何地方都可能见到它飘浮的身影；它还常挂进别人家里，让人吓一跳。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME hangs from a tree branch made of glowing plasma. Since this branch floats in the air, POKENAME can be found floating anywhere and often surprises people by hanging inside their homes.

entry: POKENAME挂在等离子体构成的大树枝上。虽然它会待在树旁试图隐藏，等离子体的明亮光芒却会暴露位置，夜间尤其明显。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME hangs from a large branch made of plasma. Although POKENAME positions itself next to trees to try to hide, the bright glow of its plasma will make POKENAME's location obvious, especially at night.

entry: 一个月中的大部分时间，POKENAME都会闲挂在树上，节省能量。满月之夜，它们聚集月光，茧壳也会发热。
author: quackquackattack
source: For most of the month, POKENAME idly hang from trees to conserve their energy. On nights of the full moon, their cocoon gets hot while they gather moonlight.

entry: POKENAME即使一动不动地准备进化，火焰仍会继续燃烧。这种总是皱着眉头的宝可梦，在一些神秘仪式中被视为耐心的象征。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME's flame continues to burn, even as it prepares to evolve and remains motionless. This perpetually-frowning Pokémon is a symbol of patience in some occult practices.

entry: 伐木工砍倒树后，常能在成捆原木中发现躲藏的POKENAME。它们性情温顺，只需几颗树果，就能把它们从原木旁引开。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found hiding in bundles of logs after lumberjacks cut down trees. They are docile Pokémon that can be lured away from the logs with a few berries.

entry: POKENAME附着在树上，从树皮中吸收养分，直到准备好进化。人们可以把它当钥匙扣，但除了让铠甲变硬，它几乎不会费心保护自己，因此挂在它身上的钥匙很容易被偷走。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME sticks to trees, absorbing nutrients from the bark until it is ready to evolve. POKENAME can be used as a keychain, but it makes little effort to protect itself beyond hardening its armor, so any keys placed on it are easily stolen.

entry: POKENAME会收集铁甲蛹蜕下的茧壳碎片，拼成自己的伪装。虽然东拼西凑，成品却相当结实，能抵挡捕食者，让它有机会反击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gathers discarded pieces of Metapod cocoons in order to form its disguise. Despite the patchwork assembly, the result is rather sturdy, protecting it from predators until it can counterattack.

entry: 受到威胁时，POKENAME会用坚硬如铁的尾巴盖住柔软的身体。等待进化时，它尽量节省能量，但也会喷出强力的喷射火焰，把捕食者赶走。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME covers its soft body with its hard-as-iron tails when threatened. It expends as little energy as possible while waiting to evolve, but will spew a powerful Flamethrower to make predators leave it alone.

entry: POKENAME硬化的外壳能承受太空碎片的撞击，因此可为在卫星上进行维护的宇航员提供宝贵的保护。研究者正尝试仿制这种硬壳，制作防护性更好的宇航服。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's hardened shell allows them to survive impacts from space debris, making them valuable as protection to astronauts performing maintenance on satellites. Research is being done to imitate the hard shell to create more protective spacesuits.

entry: POKENAME的茧十分抢手。进化时，它会在一道闪光中消失，只留下四散的壳片。据说，收集足够多的碎片，就能获得实现愿望的力量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cocoon is highly sought after; when it evolves, it vanishes in a flash of light, leaving behind scattered remains of its shell. Supposedly, these shards contain wish-granting powers if enough are collected.

entry: POKENAME快要进化了，外壳也出现裂纹。它只能用前肢发力，缓缓拖着身体前行。
author: duskrd
source: POKENAME's shell is cracked due to how close it is to evolving. It is forced to slowly drag its body using its front legs to move.

entry: POKENAME用细丝吊在树上，等待进化。有外壳妥善保护，它一天能睡上22小时。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME hangs on thin threads from trees and waits for its evolution. It sleeps up to 22 hours a day, well protected by its shell.

entry: POKENAME常无缘无故，从一棵树窜向另一棵树，不知不觉间，就浪费了许多本该留给进化的能量。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME scurries from tree to tree, often for no real reason. Without noticing, it wastes a lot of energy that it actually needs for evolution.

entry: POKENAME的茧滑溜溜的，利爪很难抓牢它们的身体。它们在海中悠然漂浮，在那里最有机会避开深海捕食者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have slippery cocoons that make it difficult for talons to grab onto their bodies. They float idly in the ocean where they have the best chance of avoiding deep-sea predators.

entry: POKENAME的身体比铁还硬。为了给进化积蓄能量，它行动缓慢，每天也只吃很少一点。
author: infinex21
source: The body of a POKENAME is harder than iron. It moves slowly as it conserves energy for its evolution, so it also eats very little per day.

entry: POKENAME的身体重得惊人，每缓缓迈出一步，即使在坚硬岩石上也会留下脚印。两只相遇时，会怒目相视，不断顶撞，持续一星期，直到其中一只离开。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's body is so heavy that every slow step it takes leaves an imprint, even upon solid rock. When two of this species of Pokémon meet, they will stare down each other and butt heads over the course of a week until one leaves.

entry: POKENAME的茧沉重，鳍又无力，在水下很难活动。它会把自己埋在湖底的泥里，藏到能够完成进化为止。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's heavy cocoon and weak fins give it little underwater mobility. It buries itself in the mud of lake bottoms to hide away until it can fully evolve.

entry: POKENAME强烈渴望有一天能够飞翔，却又十分心急。于是，它早早进入蛹的状态，希望之后就能飞起来。
author: mary_the_jane
source: POKENAME has a great desire to fly one day, but it is very impatient. So it has prematurely entered a chrysalis state in hopes that afterwards it could fly.

entry: POKENAME的壳无法击穿，在准备好进化前，几乎能提供完美的保护。不过，这份防御的代价，就是完全无法移动。
author: bacondlx
source: POKENAME's shell is impenetrable, providing it near perfect protection until it is ready to evolve. However, this defense comes at the cost of being entirely immobile.

entry: POKENAME会转动一对齿轮，帮助工厂里的机器运作。坚韧的茧让它长时间旋转时，身体依然稳固。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spin their twin gears to help factories keep machinery running. Their tough cocoon keeps their body firm as they spin for long hours.

entry: POKENAME坚硬的茧让它足够稳固，能整天在工厂工作。它们不需要进食，也很少休息，许多个体会一直工作到进化。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's hard cocoon gives them the sturdiness to keep working at factories all day long. They rarely take breaks as they do not need to eat, so many keep working until they evolve.

entry: 这种宝可梦入侵性很强，因此，人们鼓励当地训练家捕捉POKENAME，减少野外的数量。
author: capwolfbane
source: This Pokémon is considered highly invasive. Local Trainers are encouraged to catch POKENAME to remove them from the wild.

entry: POKENAME身体的重量和硬度都像一块混凝土砖。没人弄清它们为何能飘浮，但它们确实就是能浮起来。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME have bodies with similar weight and hardness to a brick of concrete. No one has been able to figure out how they float, but they do nonetheless.

entry: POKENAME会在花椰菜田里蹦跳，吃掉患病或腐烂的蔬菜。这既能强化外壳，也能帮助农民保护作物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hops through cauliflower fields, eating sick or rotting vegetables. This strengthens its shell and helps farmers maintain farmers' crops.

entry: 到了休息并进化的时候，POKENAME会把自己埋进土里，硬化成钢铁般的状态，持续一星期以上。它看起来像一团苔藓，路过的训练家常会踢痛脚趾，或被它绊倒。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: When it's time to rest and evolve, POKENAME buries itself in the ground and hardens to become like steel for over a week. Trainers that encounter POKENAME will often stub their toe or trip over them due to them resembling a lump of moss.

entry: POKENAME身体周围有一层柔软的膜，赋予它精神力量。从树枝上掉下来时，这尤其方便，因为它们只需让自己从地面浮起来就行。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a soft membrane around their body that gives them psychic powers. This is particularly handy when they fall down from branches, since they can simply levitate themselves up from the ground.

entry: POKENAME能操控包围身体的物质，让其在固态与液态之间转换。这些黏质通常坚硬如岩石，很少变得黏稠。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME manipulates the substance surrounding its body, allowing it to change it from solid to liquid states. The goo is often rock-solid, rarely becoming viscous.

entry: POKENAME裹着厚厚的羊毛，从树上掉下来时能缓冲冲击。羊毛滑溜溜的，让利爪和獠牙都难以抓牢。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a thick layer of wool that pads its body when it falls out of trees. This wool is slippery and makes it difficult to grasp with talons or fangs.

entry: 虽然结了新的茧，POKENAME依然能飞。翅膀没有被束缚，必要时就能飞走，逃避捕食者，不过它更喜欢一动不动地待着。
author: diamondblizzard7891
source: Despite its new cocoon, POKENAME can still fly. Because its wings remain free, it can escape from predators should the need arise, though it prefers to stay immobile.

entry: POKENAME常躲在树上，被误认成一颗很大的绿色松果。不过，它的壳上长有尖刺，能保护自己免遭吞食。
author: seanothan_23
source: POKENAME often hides in trees, usually being mistaken for a large green pine cone. However, it has spikes on its shell to protect it from being eaten.

entry: POKENAME的外壳十分坚韧，却是靠粗粗的丝线连在一起的。丝线一旦被切断，它就会散成碎块，必须重新用丝把自己串好。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME's exterior is very tough, but is held together by thick strands of silk. If these are cut, POKENAME falls to pieces, and must string itself back together again.

entry: 等待进化期间，POKENAME无法看见东西。因此，它必须用其他方式保护自己，例如让外壳变硬，或发出超声波。
author: ichosuzu
source: POKENAME is unable to see during the time it's waiting to evolve. As such, it must use different methods to protect itself, such as hardening its shell or emitting ultrasonic waves.

entry: POKENAME会用尖牙吸食树液。一夜之间，它就能吸干一整棵柳树。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drinks sap from trees with its sharp fangs. Over the course of one night, it can drain a willow tree in its entirety.

entry: POKENAME会附着在人烟稀少地区的墙壁上，专心准备进化。坚硬的外壳涂有苦味毒液，用来吓退捕食者。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME clings to walls in less populated areas to focus on evolving. Its hard shell is coated in a bitter-tasting poison to deter predators.

entry: 面对捕食者，POKENAME的防御本能互相矛盾：既想撤退，又想原地不动。尖锐的棘刺让它有本钱坚守，但若选择滚走，大多数捕食者又都追不上。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have conflicting instincts for how to defend themselves against predators, as they simultaneously want to retreat and stay still. Their sharp spines make staying put a viable option, but most predators fail to keep up if they roll away.

entry: POKENAME的皮肤坚硬无比，能保护自己免受伤害。即使裹在茧里，它依然贪婪地进食，大口吞吃植物，见到草属性宝可梦也会追赶。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's skin is incredibly hard, protecting it from harm. POKENAME continues to eat ravenously even while wrapped in this cocoon, devouring plants and chasing after any Grass-type Pokémon it sees.

entry: POKENAME像合众地区的宝包茧一样，用叶片裹住身体御寒。不过，它的披风主要由密集的松针编成，让它更容易在严酷气候中生存。
author: kungfucutbug
source: POKENAME protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves, similar to Swadloon from the Unova region. However, its cloak is primarily woven from densely-clustered pine needles, making survival in harsher climates easier.

entry: POKENAME常被其他宝可梦误认成石头踩踏，因此演化出铁甲般的壳，据说连大王铜象的重量都能承受。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: Due to frequently being mistaken for rocks and stepped on by other Pokémon, POKENAME has developed an ironclad shell said to withstand the weight of a Copperajah.

entry: POKENAME在午后的热气中缓缓踱步，精确调整双翼的位置后，再原地扇动。它从阳光中收集的热量，会加快进化。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME struts slowly in the afternoon heat, precisely positioning its wings before flapping in place. The warmth it gathers from the sunlight expedites its evolution process.

entry: POKENAME会在多风的地方休息，等待进化，微风能激发它的精神能量。风太强时，它就得用念力稳住自己，反而拖慢进化速度。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rests in windy areas to await its evolution, where the breeze stimulates its psychic energy. If the winds grow too forceful, it uses telekinesis to hold steady, hampering its evolution speed.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，会缓慢地来回摇摆。舞蹈结束后，它会从喙中向空中射出一大蓬丝线。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sways back and forth at a slow pace as it dances.  At the conclusion of its dance, it fires a flurry of strings into the air from its beak.

entry: 洞穴探险者经常在格外潮湿的洞穴角落看见野生POKENAME。它们准备进化时，借潮湿空气保护身体、补充水分。摸过的人说，壳虽然黏滑，却很结实。
author: sleepyman0731
source: Cavers routinely see wild POKENAME in corners of particularly damp caves. POKENAME use the moist atmosphere for protection and hydration while preparing for evolution. Cavers who touch POKENAME report that the shell is slimy but strong.

entry: POKENAME的身体又硬又僵，像钢铁一样。人们常见它们在树旁难过地噘着嘴，因为没有宝可梦想抱抱它们。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME has a hard body that is incredibly stiff, similar to steel. They are often seen pouting sadly next to trees because no Pokémon want to give them a hug.

entry: POKENAME的壳能抵挡风雨和其他外力。疲惫的旅人可以把它当作帐篷。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME's shell is impenetrable by weather and other outside forces. It is useful as a tent for weary travelers.

entry: POKENAME坚固的壳与尖刺，保护着体内储存的水，直到准备好进化。如果水快用完，它就会打开一小块外壳补水，再用树液封住孔洞。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: A POKENAME's sturdy shell and sharp thorns protect the water that it stores inside of itself until it is ready to evolve. If a POKENAME ever runs low on water, it will open a small segment of its shell to refill before sealing the hole with sap.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，会在周围释放一团蓝色孢子。这些孢子会使对方麻痹、失去记忆。
author: .izik
source: While POKENAME sleeps, it lets loose a cloud of blue spores around its body. These spores can cause paralysis and memory loss.

entry: 铁甲蛹被撞下树时，POKENAME会为它们提供安全的成长场所。它的外形与做法启发了科学家，尝试制造类似的装置，帮助其他宝可梦。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME provide a safe area for Metapod to grow in should they be knocked off of trees. POKENAME's appearance and goals have inspired scientists to look into making a device similar to POKENAME to aid other Pokémon.

entry: 人们会看见POKENAME一边旋转，一边用丝加固蛹壳。遇到欺负自己的敌人，它就会踢出凌厉的一脚。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is seen twirling as it fortifies its chrysalis with silk. It delivers sharp kicks to enemies who pick on it.

entry: 进化让POKENAME几乎无法移动，极易遭其他宝可梦捕食。为了生存，它们会聚集在大部分被水淹没的洞穴中，躲在其他生物很难抵达的地方。
author: divinelunaria
source: Evolution has rendered POKENAME largely immobile, causing it to be incredibly vulnerable to predation from other Pokémon. To survive, POKENAME will all huddle in caves mostly underwater, where they are largely inaccessible.

entry: POKENAME身上长着闪亮的红色晶体，隐约像血。这会把捕食者吓走，让它们不受打扰。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have sparkling red crystals growing from their body that have the vague appearance of blood. This scares predators into leaving them alone.

entry: POKENAME会大量食用棱瓜果，帮助外壳变硬，抵御飞行属性宝可梦。不需要防备捕食者时，它们就会收集树果，与别人分享。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME eat lots of Coba Berries to help them harden their shells against Flying-type Pokémon. When they are not defending themselves against predators, they collect berries to share with others.

entry: POKENAME会利用飞行本领，冲撞飞行属性宝可梦，阻止它们袭击铁甲蛹。虽然它自己也可能被打败、吃掉，大多数飞行属性宝可梦还是会避免与它冲突。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME takes advantage of its ability to fly to tackle Flying-type Pokémon to stop them from attacking Metapod. While POKENAME can be defeated and eaten, most Flying-type Pokémon avoid any altercations with it.

entry: POKENAME的铠甲致密沉重，让它行动困难，常被自身重量压倒。它就利用这段时间吸收阳光，储存能量，等待终于能褪下重壳的那一刻。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's armor is so dense that it struggles to move and often collapses under its own weight. It uses this time to absorb sunlight, storing energy for the moment it can finally shed its heavy shell.

entry: POKENAME挖洞时会吃下矿物，外壳也随之不断变硬。在矿物丰富的土壤中，它的坚韧程度能与钛媲美。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME consumes minerals while digging, its shell steadily hardens. In mineral-rich soil, it can rival titanium in durability.

entry: POKENAME的丝既坚韧又防水，能保护它不被水下暗流冲走。由于采集困难，只有最上等的潜水装备才会用这种丝制作，价格也往往高得让人望而却步。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME silk is both strong and waterproof to keep it from being swept away by underwater currents. Due to the difficulty with harvesting, only the best scuba gear is made with it, though it is often prohibitively expensive.

entry: POKENAME挖洞时，会吞食矿床中的矿物。这些养分能让发育中的外壳逐渐变得更结实。
author: .izik
source: While digging, POKENAME consumes mineral deposits. These nutrients strengthen its developing shell over time.

entry: POKENAME每天只能清醒几小时。一旦能量耗尽，不管站在哪里，它都会当场倒地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can only stay awake a few hours per day. Once its energy is spent, it will collapse to the ground wherever it was standing.

entry: POKENAME一感到痒就会头痛，并前后摇晃身体，试图蹭到发痒的部位。训练家可以用湿布为它擦拭止痒，让它舒服一些。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME experience headaches whenever they are itchy and will rock back and forth in an attempt to scrape against the itch. Trainers can help them feel more comfortable by rubbing them with a damp cloth to alleviate the itch.

entry: POKENAME的甲壳坚硬僵直，缺乏弹性，无法快速移动，因此行动十分缓慢。受到较大宝可梦威胁时，它能释放令人头晕的精神力波动，造成痛苦的偏头痛。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME move very slowly, their tough carapace being stiff and inflexible, preventing rapid movement. When threatened by larger Pokémon, they can project a disorienting wave of psychic power that causes painful migraines.

entry: POKENAME越生气，壳就越硬。野外遇见它时，周围往往散落着牙齿、爪子和喙的碎片。
author: afilthycasual
source: The angrier POKENAME becomes, the harder its shell gets. If one is found in the wild, it will often be surrounded by chips of tooth, claw, and beak.

entry: POKENAME一移动就会损伤茧壳。在黑暗中，它们常被误认成卡蒂狗，因此通常不会受到打扰。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are unable to move without damaging their cocoon. In the dark, they are mistaken for a Growlithe and are usually left alone.

entry: POKENAME裹在巨大的茧里，免受危险。由于一直保持同一个姿势，孩子们经常把它们误认成雕像。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are encased in a large cocoon that protects them from danger. Children often mistake them for a statue because of the pose they hold.

entry: POKENAME准备进化时，坚硬的壳会变得更热、更厚。翅膀几乎无法用来飞行，只能威吓其他宝可梦。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: As POKENAME prepares for evolution, its hard shell grows hotter and thicker. Its wings are nearly useless for flight and only serve to intimidate other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME柔软的身体有一层坚固铠甲保护。铠甲也能防止水分流失，让它能够探索干燥的陆地。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's soft body is protected by a layer of sturdy armor. This armor also keeps its body from losing moisture, allowing POKENAME to explore the dry land.

entry: POKENAME瞬间移动时，会发出诡异的嗡鸣。睡觉、等待进化期间，它靠这项本领避开捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lets loose an eerie hum when it teleports. It uses this ability to avoid predators while it sleeps and waits to evolve.

entry: 虽然茧严重限制了POKENAME的行动，肌肉中却依然充满力量。它会尽量克制自己，但危险一旦靠得足够近，它只需迅速弹动肢体，就能将其击倒。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME's cocoon heavily restricts its movement, its muscles are still packed with power. It restrains itself as much as possible, but it can knock out potential dangers with a quick flick of its limbs once they get close enough.

entry: POKENAME身上的叶片煮过后会变软。圣特安努号上的餐厅会用这种叶片，烹制美味的炖菜。
author: .izik
source: The leaves on POKENAME's body become softer when boiled. The restaurant on the S.S. Anne prepares a delicious stew that uses these leaves.

entry: 下雨时，POKENAME的皮肤会吸收水分，加固保护身体的外壳。旱季，它会寻找潮湿环境，经常把身体贴在湿润的表面，以免外层变脆、开裂。
author: jaminmcready
source: During rainfall, POKENAME's skin absorbs the moisture to reinforce its protective shell. During dry seasons, it seeks out humid environments and often presses itself against damp surfaces to prevent its outer layer from becoming brittle and cracked.

entry: POKENAME对幼小的绿毛虫十分大方，愿意让它们暂时住进有壳的身体里。
author: pixlhoopa
source: POKENAME is known for its generosity towards young Caterpie. Within its shelled body, they are given a temporary home.

entry: POKENAME的茧十分僵硬，限制了行动。它们会朝飞行属性的POKENAME投掷石头，避免被吃掉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have limited movement because of their rigid cocoon. They toss rocks at Flying-type POKENAME to avoid getting eaten.

entry: 虽然POKENAME渴望奔跑，但外壳一旦受损，黏糊糊的身体内部就会流出来，让它变得脆弱。因此，它只能等待准备好进化的那一天。
author: periperi_chicken
source: Though POKENAME longs to run, if its outer shell is damaged, the gooey insides will spill out and make it vulnerable. Instead, it waits for the day it is ready to evolve.

entry: 野生POKENAME几乎从不离开自己栖身的阴凉潮湿树冠。据说，最坐不住的会进化成铁甲壳兽，耐心的则进化成巴呆兽。不过，实际上大多数都会先变成巴呆兽。
author: bobosmith01
source: Wild POKENAME almost never move from the cool and damp canopy in the trees they call home.  It is said the most restless of them evolve into Metabro, and the patient evolve into Butterpoke, although, in truth, most evolve into Butterpoke first.

entry: 虽然长着腿，POKENAME却几乎无法移动。它们成群聚在海滩上，接连数天一动不动，直到终于进化。
author: mystora
source: Despite having legs, POKENAME can barely move. They gather in groups, standing still on a beach for days, until they finally evolve.

entry: POKENAME把自己固定在浅水中的岩石上，伪装成覆满苔藓的壳，躲避捕食者。虽然很少移动，它却在尾巴里储存着巨大能量，等待最适合进化的时机。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME anchors itself to rocks in shallow waters, camouflaging as a mossy shell to avoid predators. Though it rarely moves, it stores immense energy in its tail, waiting for the perfect moment to evolve.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的生物紧咬着坚硬的身体。不过，它眼下十分脆弱，正在准备进化，寄生者无法在不伤害宿主的情况下安全吸取能量，这让寄生者十分懊恼。
author: bobosmith01
source: The being on POKENAME's tail bites down tight to POKENAME's tough body, but as POKENAME is currently vulnerable and preparing for evolution, it cannot safely sap energy from its host without injuring it. This brings the being great frustration.

entry: POKENAME靠鳍足推动身体，游向海藻林。它们躲开捕食者，为坚韧茧壳中的身体争取发育时间。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their flippers to propel them towards seaweed forests. They hide away from predators to give themselves time to develop within their tough cocoon.

entry: POKENAME借助有浮力的外壳、宽大的鳍和厚厚的脂肪，完成漫长的冬季迁徙。让它们踏上旅程的训练家，会惊喜地看见它们进化后飞回来。
author: corra_universe
source: POKENAME use their buoyant shells, large fins, and thick fat deposits to aid in their long winter migrations. Trainers who let their POKENAME go on this journey are delighted to see them fly back upon evolution.

entry: POKENAME会为需要藏身之处的绿毛虫提供自己的身体。捕食者通常没有力气搬动它沉重的身躯，这让躲在里面的绿毛虫十分安全。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME offers its body to Caterpie that need a place to hide. Predators typically do not have the strength to lift its heavy body, which is good for the hidden Caterpie.

entry: POKENAME的意识位于中心的小球形茧中，却能通过包围自己的强大毒气雾，与外界互动。
author: t3isukone
source: While POKENAME's consciousness is in the small spherical cocoon at its heart, it interacts with the world through the powerful mist of poisonous gas that surrounds it.

entry: POKENAME常散落在森林地面上，几乎从不移动。它们能吸取接触者的能量，只碰上几秒，多数人就会浑身无力。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are often found scattered across forest floors and rarely ever move. They can drain the energy of those who touch them; mere seconds of contact will leave most people weak.

entry: 厚厚的茧让POKENAME像石化般定在原地。全身唯一能动的，就只有从手上垂下、来回摇摆的钟摆。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are petrified in place due to the thick cocoon around their body. The only part of their body that moves is the pendulum that swings from their hand.

entry: POKENAME一动不动地躺在海底，耐心等待进化。虽然眼下用不上钳子，还是会本能地夹住递来的任何东西。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lies motionless on the seafloor, waiting patiently for evolution. Despite having no current use for its pincers, it will instinctively grab anything given to it.

entry: POKENAME的大钳形似铁甲蛹，让捕食者以为发现了容易到手的食物。它却会以摧毁性的力量夹住来犯者，迅速解决对方，再将其吃掉。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's large claws resemble Metapod, tricking predators into thinking they've found an easy meal. POKENAME will grab the attacker with devastating force, quickly disposing of them before consumption.

entry: POKENAME有两个相连的头，都会产生毒气。多次试图将它们分开的尝试，都引发了严重的爆炸。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have two heads that are conjoined together and produce toxic gas. Many attempts at splitting these heads have led to a nasty explosion.

entry: POKENAME的外形兼具伽勒尔双弹瓦斯与阿罗拉椰蛋树的特征。由于脖子很长，消化食物、制造气体都需要很长时间。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME takes on an appearance combining Galarian Weezing and Alolan Exeggutor. Digesting and production of its gases takes a lengthy amount of time due to the length of its neck.

entry: POKENAME通过转移制造气体的内部压力，让双腿得以伸长。因此，伸腿远距离踢击时，身体排出的烟雾就会减少。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's extending legs are made possibly by diverting the internal pressure that creates its gases. As such, when it stretches its legs for long-range kicks, it produces less smog from its body.

entry: 融合过程让POKENAME体内的气体变得极不稳定。两只双弹瓦斯结合，产生了危险的混合物，稍受刺激就容易爆炸。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The gases contained within POKENAME are made highly unstable through the fusion process. The combination of two Weezing results in a dangerous mixture, and they are prone to exploding at the slightest agitation.

entry: 融合过程让POKENAME体内的气体变得极不稳定。两只双弹瓦斯结合，产生了危险的混合物，稍受刺激就容易爆炸。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The gases contained within POKENAME are made highly unstable through the fusion process. The combination of two Weezing results in a dangerous mixture, and they are prone to exploding at the slightest agitation.

entry: 融合过程让POKENAME体内的气体变得极不稳定。两只双弹瓦斯结合，产生了危险的混合物，稍受刺激就容易爆炸。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The gases contained within POKENAME are made highly unstable through the fusion process. The combination of two Weezing results in a dangerous mixture, and they are prone to exploding at the slightest agitation.

entry: POKENAME的两个身体会各自飞行，散播烟雾。目标被毒气完全笼罩后，它就会用精神力量将其带走。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The two bodies of POKENAME fly independently to spread their smog. Once the target has been fully enveloped by the toxins, the POKENAME will carry them away with psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME喜欢拥抱别人。在民间传说中，父母常用它告诫邋遢的孩子：如果不收拾干净，垃圾就会引来一只臭烘烘的POKENAME，成为你的新玩伴。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME loves to give hugs. It is famous in folklore as a warning from parents to messy children: if they don't clean up after themselves, their trash will invite a foul-smelling POKENAME to be their new playmate.

entry: POKENAME的“裙子”下并没有腿，那其实只是一股帮助它浮空的气体。小头负责控制气体，大头则操纵双臂。
author: kiwiarms
source: There are no legs under POKENAME's 'dress', which is actually just a plume of gases that it uses to keep itself aloft. The secondary head controls this, while the larger one works the arms.

entry: POKENAME在火山地区生活得很好，会喷出一股股毒气，驱赶靠得太近的生物。栖息地的极端高温，让烟雾久久停留在空中。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME thrives in volcanic regions, using puffs of poisonous gas to deter anything that gets too close. The extreme heat of its habitat keeps its smog lingering in the air.

entry: POKENAME是连体生物，两部分身体都能变身，却无法分离。因此每次变身，新形态的主体上总会连着一个迷你版本。
author: sk372
source: As a conjoined being, both parts of POKENAME are able to transform. They cannot separate, however, so their transformations result in having a miniature version of its new form attached to the main body.

entry: POKENAME身上渗出的烟雾温度极高，足以点燃干草。它会利用这一点，在地上烧出焦痕，标记领地。
author: .izik
source: The smoke that seeps from POKENAME's body is extremely hot, capable of igniting dry grass. It uses this ability to mark its territory with scorched ground.

entry: 这是早期利用有缺陷的基因，尝试复原史前飞行掠食者时产生的宝可梦。它的翅膀无法支撑飞行，但体内的轻质气体能让它漂浮。
author: sontyp
source: A product of early attempts to restore an aerial predator from a pre-historic period using faulty DNA. While its wings cannot support flight, buoyant gases allow it to levitate.

entry: POKENAME会吞下海量食物，哪怕有些已经腐烂发霉。吃下的食物会化作气体，从全身排出；臭味浓烈得几秒内就能熏昏大钢蛇。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME devours vast quantities of food, even if some is rotten or moldy. The gases it releases across its body are the result of all the food it eats, with a stench potent enough to knock out a Steelix in seconds.

entry: POKENAME产生的毒云威力太强，身体甚至长出面罩，保护自己免受自身毒素伤害。它会凶猛地用令人窒息的烟雾灌满周围，赶走人类。
author: sk372
source: The toxic clouds POKENAME generates are so potent that its body developed a face covering to protect itself from its own poison. It aggressively floods areas with this suffocating smoke to drive people away from it.

entry: POKENAME的两个身体由尾巴相连，连接处会定期释放酸臭的烟云。吸入后产生的副作用，会因宝可梦或个人而异。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's two bodies are connected at the tail, the joining section regularly emitting clouds of sour-smelling smoke. Inhaling the smoke causes different side effects depending on the Pokémon or person.

entry: 受到惊吓时，POKENAME会从背上放出大量刺鼻气体。这让它极为尴尬，立刻羞得跑去躲起来。
author: sk372
source: When startled, POKENAME lets loose large amounts of pungent gas from its back. This act makes it feel incredibly embarrassed, and it will immediately run and hide out of shame.

entry: 香氛姐姐喜欢把POKENAME当作珍爱的宝可梦饲养。它们喜欢整天泡在水缸里，调香师便趁这时稀释它们浓烈的气体，制作气味最上乘的香水。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Aroma Ladies love keeping POKENAME as prized Pokémon. POKENAME love to soak in tanks of water all day, and while they do so perfumers create the finest smelling perfumes by diluting POKENAME's potent gases.

entry: 由于天生喜欢模仿树木，POKENAME是树木园和温室中极常见的有害生物。它不断排放烟雾，影响周围植物，让这种本能常常带来危害。
author: silverscloudy
source: POKENAME is an extremely common pest in arboretums and conservatories, due to its natural instinct to mimic trees. This instinct is often detrimental, due to the fumes it constantly expels and its effects on surrounding foliage.

entry: POKENAME头顶的毒气头越大、产气越多，在同类中就越受尊敬。它们栖息的沼泽总被浓密压抑的毒雾填满。
author: sk372
source: The bigger and more productive the toxic head on POKENAME's skull is, the more respect it commands among its kind. Marshes housing POKENAME are filled to the brim with cloistering toxic fog.

entry: POKENAME会飘来飘去，摇动烟雾构成的助威花球，将其化作小云团四散开来，为战斗加油。可云团实在太臭，助威的效果总不如它所愿。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats about cheering on battles by shaking its smoky pom-poms and scattering them around small cloud puffs. Due to the stench of the clouds, its cheer routines aren't as effective as it would like.

entry: POKENAME主要靠被动吸收甲烷维生。由于大气中的甲烷含量很高，它常来不及处理吸收的一切，脸上便会长出肿块，疼痛不已。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME lives mainly off methane, absorbing it passively. Due to the high levels of methane in the atmosphere, POKENAME is often unable to process all that it consumes, causing lumps to grow from its face, causing it pain.

entry: POKENAME外表颇为华贵，因此很受富人欢迎。究竟哪一半看起来更可爱，人们的意见却分成了两派。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: POKENAME are very popular among the wealthy as they appear rather luxurious. Many people hold split opinions regarding which half of POKENAME looks cuter.

entry: POKENAME住在污染严重城市的小巷与下水道中。产气量随月相盈亏而变化，满月时，毒云能覆盖整条街。
author: comfortablybrum
source: POKENAME makes its home in the alleys and sewers of highly polluted cities. The gas it produces waxes and wanes with the phases of the moon. During full moons, it can cover entire streets in toxic clouds.

entry: POKENAME会翻找垃圾箱里的腐败食物，边吃边从身上的小孔排出有害气体。臭味常会赶走其他食腐者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME scavenges dumpsters for decaying food, releasing noxious gas from tiny holes on its body as it eats. The stench often drives away other scavengers.

entry: POKENAME四处飘浮，故意喷出毒雾，让吸入者恐惧、头晕。有人认为，小头就像它的良心，徒劳地试图阻止它作恶。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats around deliberately spewing out toxic mists that make those inhaling it suffer feelings of fear and disorientation. Some believe the smaller head behaves like a conscience, trying vainly to make it stop acting maliciously.

entry: POKENAME生活在地下深处，通过岩石般的皮肤吸收有毒物质。地下的强大压力，让它体内的毒气进一步浓炼。
author: raydrago
source: POKENAME can be found deep underground and absorbs toxic materials through its stone-like skin. The strong pressure underground has further refined the poisonous gases in its body.

entry: POKENAME手臂和角上的球状突起，似乎由极其坚硬的瘤状组织构成。它常从这些突起中释放毒气，取得战斗优势。
author: jodue
source: The bulbs on POKENAME's arms and horns seem to be made from extremely hard tumors. POKENAME will often release a toxic gas from these bulbs to gain an edge in combat.

entry: POKENAME会从多个气孔吐出浓密毒云，代替喷墨，让眼前的威胁头晕、中毒。在野外，人们只在有过污染问题的海域见过它。
author: sk372
source: Rather than spitting ink, POKENAME exhales thick clouds of toxic gas from multiple pores to disorient and poison any dangers present. In the wild, it's only been seen in ocean locations with a history of pollution issues.

entry: POKENAME受工业污染影响，从环境中吸收了大量毒素。虽然努力通过有毒的呼吸将其排出，毒性化合物仍不断积聚，引发变异，长出额外的组织。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are laden with toxins, absorbing them from their environment due to industrial pollutants. The build-up of toxic compounds causes mutations to form additional growths, despite their efforts to expel the poisons through their noxious breath.

entry: POKENAME把奶储存在体内特化的腔室中，发酵成浓稠的凝乳。刺鼻的奶酪味会吸引虫属性宝可梦，让它捕食。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME stores its milk in a specialized chamber within its body where it ferments into a thick curd. The pungent, cheese-like odor attracts Bug-type Pokémon, which it preys upon.

entry: 在古老的航海传说中，POKENAME被称为“毒风暴之裔”。它从身上众多气孔释放有害气体，飞行时会在海上掀起腐臭的大漩涡，没人能毫发无伤地航行穿过。
author: sk372
source: Referred to as "The Scion of Toxic Storms" in old nautical legends, POKENAME releases noxious air from the many pores along its body. When it flies, it creates a putrid maelstrom at sea that none can sail through unscathed.

entry: POKENAME每扇动一次巨大的翅膀，就会涌出层层毒云。它还能吐出毒性更强的彩虹色气体，皮肤一旦接触，就会受到严重灼伤。
author: sk372
source: Cascading clouds of toxic gas flow forth from POKENAME with each flap of its large wings. It can exhale a rainbow-colored cloud of even stronger gas that greatly burns skin on contact.

entry: 传说古代女巫曾用POKENAME的烟雾，调制害人的药水。时至今日，吸入烟雾仍会让人产生可怕幽灵近在眼前的幻觉。
author: .izik
source: There are tales of ancient witches that once used POKENAME's smoke as an ingredient for malicious potions. Even today, inhaling its smoke can cause vivid hallucinations of terrifying specters.

entry: 许多宝可梦畏惧POKENAME发怒，因此会听从召唤，为它效劳。一旦有宝可梦违令，它就会用毒气围住不驯的反抗者，直到对方认清自己的地位。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of summoning Pokémon to do their bidding, as many fear their wrath. Whenever a Pokémon disobeys their orders, they surround the unruly rebel with noxious fumes until they learn their place.

entry: 它很难顺利排出体内过量的毒气。因此，POKENAME试图模仿树木时，几乎总以失败告终。
author: silverscloudy
source: It struggles with expelling the excessive amount of toxic gas within it. Due to this, POKENAME that attempt to mimic trees see little to no success.

entry: 受到威胁时，POKENAME会把毒气与电流混合。被击中的生物会陷入麻痹，同时遭毒素慢慢侵蚀身体。
author: bigoljax
source: Whenever threatened, POKENAME mixes its poisonous gas with its electricity. Those hit by it are put into a state of paralysis, while the poison slowly eats at their body.

entry: POKENAME会从炮筒中射出毒雾球。击中敌人时，气体会自燃爆发，威力足以夷平一栋楼。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires balls of toxic fog from its cannon. Upon striking a foe, the gas spontaneously combusts with enough force to level a building.

entry: 观察发现，POKENAME吸收恶意软件后，身上会出现数字化的第三个头。虽然一离开网络空间就会消失，实际上也不起任何作用，但有它陪着，POKENAME确实会更开心。
author: soup1900
source: Observations have shown that when POKENAME absorbs malware, a digital triplet appears on its body. While this third head disappears once it exits cyberspace and doesn't actually function in any capacity, POKENAME does get happier while it's around.

entry: 这种有毒宝可梦生活在大城市外围的垃圾填埋场，经常与灰尘山争夺地盘。尾巴上的增生体用来观察身后，提防敌人。
author: opossiblymage
source: This poisonous Pokémon can be found in the landfills outside sprawling cities. It frequently has turf wars with Garbodor. The growth on its tail is used to watch behind it for enemies.

entry: POKENAME虽然有两个身体，却共用一个意识。无论哪个身体受伤，另一个也会受到同样的伤害。较小的身体能自由收回本体，让它使出独特的连招。
author: thesilverowls
source: Despite being two bodies, POKENAME share one mind. If either body were to be damaged, the damage is mirrored on the other body. The smaller body can be freely recalled to the POKENAME, allowing for use of unique attack sequences.

entry: POKENAME双臂上的头分别控制攻击和手臂动作，中央的主体则控制其余身体。如果中央主体不满意另外两个头的表现，管道里就会喷出毒气。
author: goober145
source: The heads on both of POKENAME's arms control its attacks and arm movements, though the central mass controls the rest of the body. If the central mass is unhappy with the performance of the other heads, toxic gas bursts out of its pipes.

entry: 很久以前，人们以为吸入POKENAME的烟雾就能与灵界交流。实际上，大量吸入这种气体只会产生幻觉。
author: sk372
source: In the distant past it was believed inhaling POKENAME's fumes allowed one to commune with the spirit world. In actuality, breathing in high amounts of the gas causes hallucinations.

entry: POKENAME不断产生轻盈而剧毒的气体，长期接触会引发严重突变，因此它自己也几乎浑身长满肿瘤。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME constantly produces a lightweight gas that is both incredibly poisonous and capable of causing severe mutations with prolonged exposure. As a result, its body is almost entirely covered in tumors.

entry: 多出的头让POKENAME重心偏斜，难以用头撞击敌人。好在毒气足以削弱对手，让它们变成容易击中的目标。
author: hophoppip
source: The off-center weight of its extra head makes it hard for POKENAME to headbutt foes. Thankfully, its toxic gas weakens opponents enough to make them easy targets.

entry: POKENAME头脑简单，宁愿使用蛮力，也不愿精心谋划战术。它们产生的有害气体，会严重损伤皮肤和肺部。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are simple-minded Pokémon, rather using brute strength than employing a thought-out strategy. They produce a noxious gas that causes severe skin and lung damage.

entry: POKENAME产生的气体可被收集加工，制成令人放松的熏香。气味受饮食影响，它们通常吃水果和树果，食物匮乏时，连腐烂的东西也吃。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME produces a gas that is collected and processed for use in incense that induces feelings of relaxation. The type of smell is influenced by their diet, which normally consists of fruit, berries, and even rotting material if food is scarce.

entry: POKENAME主要吃领地内的蘑菇和植物。白天休息时，蘑菇中的有机化合物会在胃里混合，形成极其恶臭的气体，随时可以喷向敌人。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME consume mostly mushrooms and vegetation in their territories. As they rest throughout the day, the organic compounds in the mushrooms mix in their stomachs into a terribly foul gas that POKENAME can spew at foes at any time.

entry: 这种POKENAME的变体长有翠绿色毛发，能在丛林家园中更好地伪装。冠饰最大的个体被视为首领，身后跟随的恶臭也进一步彰显着它的地位。
author: chibitales
source: The emerald fur this variant of POKENAME sports helps it further camouflage in their jungle homes. The POKENAME with the largest crest is considered the leader of the group, which is further indicated by the terribly foul stench that follows them.

entry: POKENAME会把烟雾吹向空中，捕捉飞经其中、晕头转向的鸟宝可梦。如果狩猎时离陆地太近，往往会让人们病得很重。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME hunts by billowing its fumes into the air, and catching any disoriented bird Pokémon who fly through. If it hunts too close to land, people often get very sick.

entry: POKENAME的门会产生气体，构成其余身体。它常在大型垃圾场附近徘徊。生病时，排出的气体会减少，它也随之衰弱。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's gate produces a gas that makes up the rest of its body. It loiters around large garbage dumps. When sick, the amount of gas emitted is reduced, weaking POKENAME in the process.

entry: POKENAME制造一团有害气体，乘着它在区域内飞行，寻找值得一战的对手。它的战术狡猾多变，包括从尾巴喷出令人头晕的云团，再仿佛凭空消失般藏进气体中。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME creates a cloud of noxious gas to fly around its region, searching for worthy opponents to fight. It battles using tricky strategies, including blasting disorienting clouds from its tail and seemingly disappearing into the gas.

entry: POKENAME排出的气体会产生静电，它们能加以控制，用来对付其他宝可梦。气体本身还含有麻痹毒素，没有适当防护便靠近，十分危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The gases emitted by POKENAME generate static electricity that they can control and use to fight other Pokémon. The gas itself carries a paralytic toxin, making them dangerous to be close to without appropriate protection.

entry: POKENAME靠吃领地内及附近留下的垃圾成长。它把废物转化成致命的混合毒气，让游荡得太靠近领地的人中毒。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME grows by eating the garbage left close to its territory or directly inside of it. POKENAME recycles this waste to create a deadly mix of poisonous gas that it uses to intoxicate humans who wander too close to its territory.

entry: POKENAME以体内的化学反应提供动力，向前猛冲。虽然散发的毒气很危险，孩子们还是很喜欢它。
author: chartanon
source: POKENAME charges forwards, using its internal chemical reactions as fuel. Children love it, in spite of the dangerous toxic fumes it exudes.

entry: POKENAME产生的气体，浓密得能当作肢体使用。在卡洛斯，人们也常用这些气体，制作高级香水。
author: melodydelune
source: The gases produced by POKENAME are dense enough to be used as limbs. The gases are also often used in Kalos to produce high-grade perfumes.

entry: POKENAME在臭氧层中飞行，吞食有害气体，净化空气。吃下的气体让体内变得极易燃烧，一旦点燃并爆炸，后果将不堪设想。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME flies through the ozone layer, consuming harmful gases and purifying the air. The gas consumption causes the interior of its body to be highly combustible, leading to disastrous fallout if it were to be ignited and explode.

entry: POKENAME制造的浓密气团会让人呼吸困难，甚至经常昏倒。气体还具有致幻作用，被困其中的人很难分清，自己究竟醒着，还是身处噩梦。
author: .jerden
source: People struggle to breath inside the thick clouds of gas POKENAME produces, and often pass out. Since the gas also has hallucinogenic properties, it is difficult for people trapped in it to tell if they are awake or inside a nightmare.

entry: POKENAME用一种类似喷漆的气态化学物质标记领地。这种物质毒性很强，吸入后几分钟内就会中毒。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME marks its territory with a gaseous chemical similar to spray paint. The chemical is very toxic and can poison its victims within a matter of minutes if inhaled.

entry: POKENAME从头部和尾巴排出的毒气，对真菌尤其有效。它携带的孢子却不受自身毒素影响，因此能在没有竞争者的情况下长成蘑菇。
author: .jerden
source: The toxic gas POKENAME expels from its head and tail is especially potent against fungi. The spores it carries are immune to its own toxins, enabling them to grow into mushrooms without competition.

entry: 长期接触毒气与烟雾，会扭曲POKENAME的身体，使它们变得如噩梦般可怕。生态系统中一旦出现它们，通常就意味着必须采取大规模清理措施。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Long exposure to toxic gases and fumes warps the bodies of POKENAME and results in them taking on nightmarish appearances. Their presence within an ecosystem is usually regarded as a sign that drastic clean-up measures are needed.

entry: 长期接触毒气与烟雾，会扭曲POKENAME的身体，使它们变得如噩梦般可怕。生态系统中一旦出现它们，通常就意味着必须采取大规模清理措施。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Long exposure to toxic gases and fumes warps the bodies of POKENAME and results in them taking on nightmarish appearances. Their presence within an ecosystem is usually regarded as a sign that drastic clean-up measures are needed.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME释放的烟雾会泛起诡异的橙光，照亮四周。旅人曾将其误认成引路的灯笼，最后却迷失在毒雾之中。
author: .izik
source: At night, the smog POKENAME dispenses glows an eerie orange, lighting up the surrounding area. Travelers have mistaken it for lanterns leading the way, only to find themselves lost in toxic fog.

entry: POKENAME喜欢睡在灰烬里，常在刚被烧过的森林区域安家。开心时，它会吐出浓厚的黄色烟雾，带有淡淡的肉桂香。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers to sleep in ash, often making recently burned forest areas its home. When happy, it exhales a thick yellow smog that carries a faint cinnamon-like scent.

entry: POKENAME携带的气球里充满不稳定的气体，似乎总在不断泄漏毒气。如果气球破了，它就再吹一个。
author: .jerden
source: The balloon POKENAME carries is inflated with volatile gas. It never seems to stop leaking out toxic fumes, and if it bursts POKENAME will just inflate another one.

entry: POKENAME对人类健康有着浓厚兴趣，见到受伤的人就想治疗。可它气孔泄出的气体对人类毒性极强，因此努力救治往往反而害了人。
author: pjporwoll
