source: POKENAME has an intense fascination with human health and attempts to heal any injured people it comes across. The gas leaking from its pores is highly toxic to humans, so its efforts tend to do more harm than good.

entry: 科学家发现，POKENAME的两个头产生不同的气体：一个排出无害气体，另一个产生毒气。这与两个头的饮食差异有关。
author: heal_fire
source: Scientists have discovered that the two heads of POKENAME create different kinds of gases. One expulses harmless gases while the other one produces toxic gases. This is linked to differences in the diet of POKENAME's heads.

entry: 连接第二个头与主体的增生部分，是POKENAME的弱点。面对敌人时，主体会向对方冲撞，第二个头则释放腐蚀性气体。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME's weak point is the growth connecting its second head to its main body. If POKENAME is facing a foe, its main body will charge its opponent while the second head will release corrosive gases.

entry: POKENAME的身体由两个彼此分开的蘑菇伞盖构成，上下相叠，令毒孢子的产量翻倍。身上的斑纹似乎在警告潜在捕食者：它毒性极强。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body consists of two separate mushroom caps, one growing on top of the other, doubling its production of toxic spores. The marking on its body seems to function as a warning to potential predators that it is incredibly poisonous.

entry: POKENAME栖息在受工业废物污染的田野，慢慢清除土壤中的毒素。吃下的毒物越多，产出的耐化学腐蚀棉花也越多。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME inhabits fields contaminated by industrial waste, where it slowly cleans the soil of toxins. The more poisons it consumes, the more copious its production of chemical-resistant cotton is.

entry: POKENAME会发射身上的尖刺自卫。尖刺一接触目标，就会爆成一团团有害烟雾，遮蔽周围，让它有更大的机会逃跑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fires spikes from its body in self-defense. Upon contact with a target, these spines burst into plumes of noxious smoke, obscuring the area and allowing POKENAME a better chance to escape.

entry: POKENAME凭借一种未知的感官，出现在疫病暴发的城市。吐出熏香的头所散发的烟雾带有硫磺味，却能让病人安心；健康的人只要吸入，就会立刻昏倒。
author: ghostslythe
source: By the power of an unknown sense, POKENAME appear in cities suffering disease outbreaks. The incense breathing head's fumes smell sulfurous, but put sufferers of illness at ease. Any healthy who breathe the vapors faint immediately.

entry: POKENAME载歌载舞时，经常被自己的毒气呛到。接连不断的干呕打断了盛大的表演，让每场演出的观感都大打折扣。
author: evilgammon
source: While POKENAME performs through song and dance, it often chokes on its own toxic fumes. This constant gagging interrupts its grand performances, ruining the experience of any show it puts on.

entry: POKENAME戴帽子的模样看似古朴可爱，却会开心地与路人“分享”毒气。幸好，拖出的黄烟足以警告保持清醒的人。
author: wormspawn
source: Though its be-hatted appearance is deceptively quaint, POKENAME will gleefully share its toxic gasses with any passer-by. Thankfully, the trail of yellow clouds serves as ample warning to those who keep their heads about them.

entry: 很久以前，POKENAME因制造致命毒素而被封印。这些毒素能轻易摧毁庄稼和其他植物。传闻它会大量吃下未经处理的垃圾，但从未得到实际记录。
author: npshi
source: Long ago, POKENAME were sealed away for the deadly toxins they create, ones which can easily destroy crops and other plant life. It is rumoured that POKENAME eat raw garbage in large abundance, though it has never been documented.

entry: POKENAME的孢子既黏，又极具传染性。许多训练家会请火属性宝可梦帮忙，赶在孢子引发伙伴呼吸问题前，将其烧尽。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spores are both sticky and highly infectious. Many Trainers rely on the help of Fire-type Pokémon to burn up spores before they cause respiratory issues for their Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME不断向空气中释放孢子，为此投入了身体的大量资源。源源不绝的孢子，足以把森林变成真菌肆虐的沼泽。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are constantly releasing spores into the air and devote much of their bodily resources to do so. The endless spores that POKENAME produce are capable of transforming forests into fungus-infested swamps.

entry: 它咳出的气体含有多种蘑菇孢子。不过，这些孢子一接触POKENAME的毒气，就会全部被消灭。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its cough contains a multitude of different mushroom spores. However, because the spores come in contact with POKENAME's toxic gas, the spores are all destroyed.

entry: POKENAME会制造化学物质，麻痹身上各种增生体带来的疼痛。增生体产生的孢子在潮湿气候中生长迅速，常会感染没有保持双脚干燥的训练家。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME make chemical compounds that numb the pain of the various growths on their body. The spores they produce from these growths grow rapidly in damp climates and often infect Trainers who do not keep their feet dry.

entry: POKENAME引爆的烟雾弹含有催泪剂，会强烈刺激眼睛和皮肤。严重时，吸入气体还会引起炎症和呼吸问题。
author: musicsheep.
source: Smoke bombs detonated by POKENAME contain a lachrymatory agent that causes intense eye and skin irritation. In severe cases, inhaling the gas can cause inflammation and breathing problems.

entry: POKENAME在火山洞穴附近游荡，散发极易燃烧的气体。受到惊吓时，它能引发夹杂火焰与烟雾的大爆炸。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME roams near volcanic caves, dispensing highly combustible gas. When startled, it can release a massive explosion of flame and smog.

entry: POKENAME凭借强大的嗅觉，能分辨各种有害气体与气味，藉此寻找自己最爱的腐败食物。
author: goober145
source: POKENAME can distinguish between any kind of noxious fume or odor with its powerful sense of smell. It does this to find its favorite kinds of rotten food.

entry: 虽然罕见，城市环境中也能自然出现POKENAME。为了让自己更有威慑力，它们会在放气时，把松脱的蜕皮拢在身旁，让皮向外鼓起，像气球一样充满气。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although rare, POKENAME can be naturally found in urban environments. To appear more intimidating, they may hold their loose, shed skin close while they eject gas out of their body. This causes the skin to bloat outwards, filling up like a balloon.

entry: POKENAME会把酸性烟雾导入洞壁，在岩石中钻洞。确认独处后，它才会钻出地面，安静地吃苔藓。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows into stone by guiding acidic smoke through cave walls. When certain it is alone, it surfaces to quietly feed on moss.

entry: POKENAME能浮得多高，有一部分取决于心情。备受宠爱、又有许多剩饭可大口享用的个体，甚至可能随风飘走。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's ability to float higher than normal is partially dependent on its mood. Pampered POKENAME with lots of leftovers to gobble may even float away in the wind.

entry: POKENAME天生会排出大量恶臭气体，吓跑其他宝可梦。如果某个气孔堵住，体内压力就会升高，让它头痛不已。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME naturally releases lots of foul-smelling gas that scares away other Pokémon. If one of their vents are clogged, the pressure in their body can build up and give them a nasty headache.

entry: POKENAME排出的浓黄烟雾闻起来像木炭，量大时会造成化学灼伤。有人见过它在燃烧着的火坑中取暖。
author: .izik
source: The thick yellow smoke POKENAME expels smells like charcoal and can cause chemical burns when in large quantities. It has been spotted warming itself in active fire pits.

entry: POKENAME的两个头会吐出炽热而剧毒的气体。它同时用两个头捕猎，也防着敌人偷走食物。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME's two heads breathe out a hot and highly toxic gas. It uses both heads to hunt prey while also keeping enemies from stealing its food.

entry: 为了跟上蚊香泳士的游泳本领，POKENAME会喷出气泡推进身体。身后因此留下许多气泡，浮到水面时，便会散出腐臭。
author: bandedbodypress
source: To keep up with Poliwrath's swimming prowess, POKENAME expels bubbles to propel itself while swimming. This makes plenty of bubbles in its wake, which smell putrid when they rise to the surface.

entry: POKENAME的气体，能暂时提高人的智力。不过不宜长期使用，大量接触，更会损伤脑组织。
author: darkweavile428
source: Gases emitted by POKENAME can temporarily increase a person's IQ. Prolonged use isn't recommended however, as large amounts can damage brain tissue.

entry: POKENAME训练时，会产生并释放有害烟雾，隐约带着汗味。
author: bobosmith01
source: As POKENAME trains, it produces and releases noxious fumes that smell vaguely of sweat.

entry: POKENAME散发的气体，会让吸入者变得暴躁、失去控制。战斗时，它们会接连挥拳、头撞，以猛攻压倒敌人。
author: sondededoo
source: The gas exuded by POKENAME can cause anyone who inhales it to become violent and uncontrollable. During battle, these Pokémon will overwhelm foes with a flurry of punches and headbutts.

entry: POKENAME有两个肿瘤般的头，不断释放有害烟雾。头部的重量让它们一奔跑就容易摔倒，只能慢慢小跑，以免翻倒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have two tumor-like heads that constantly release noxious fumes. The weight of these heads often causes POKENAME to fall over whenever they gallop, so they have to trot slowly to avoid tipping over.

entry: POKENAME长期接触有害烟雾，背部长出肿瘤。日久之后，肿瘤竟有了自己的生命。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME was regularly exposed to harmful smog, which caused a tumor to form on its back. Over time, this tumor developed a life of its own.

entry: POKENAME黏液身体上突出的肿瘤，会先微微蠕动，再猛然爆裂，向周围洒出酸液。它停留过的地面会永久变色。
author: .izik
source: The tumors protruding from POKENAME's slimy body wiggle slightly before bursting, spreading acid around its immediate area. The ground where it rests becomes permanently discolored.

entry: POKENAME从背上喷出剧毒气体，不但极易爆炸，也会让附近的生物，出现灾难性的反应。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME emits highly toxic gases from its back. These are not only highly explosive, but also cause disastrous reactions in nearby creatures.

entry: POKENAME的气体臭得能赶跑几乎所有宝可梦。一位知名博士将气体稀释，研发了“驱赶球”，用来赶走不受欢迎的宝可梦。
author: darkweavile428
source: The gases emitted by POKENAME are so foul that it can repel almost any Pokémon. A renowned Pokémon professor has used a watered down version of this gas to develop the Pester Ball, a device used to chase off unwanted Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的烟雾臭得连其他毒属性宝可梦都无法忍受。凡是它碰过的东西，都会带着这股臭味，持续一个月以上。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's fumes are so putrid that even other Poison-type Pokémon can't stand its stench. Anything that POKENAME touches will carry its stench for over a month.

entry: POKENAME不断呼出恶臭气体。它能控制气流方向，让远处的敌人中毒。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME constantly breathes out foul-smelling gas. It can control the direction its breath flows to poison foes at a distance.

entry: 人们强烈建议饲养POKENAME的训练家戴上防护面罩。它的气体能在几秒内让成年人睡着，还会大幅增加感染空气传播疾病的风险。
author: petratheangel
source: Trainers of POKENAME are strongly encouraged to wear protective masks. Breathing in its gases can put a grown adult to sleep in seconds and greatly increase vulnerability to airborne illnesses.

entry: POKENAME从背上喷出剧毒气体，不但极易爆炸，也会让附近的生物，出现灾难性的反应。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME emits highly toxic gases from its back. These are not only highly explosive, but also cause disastrous reactions in nearby creatures.

entry: POKENAME从背上喷出剧毒气体，不但极易爆炸，也会让附近的生物，出现灾难性的反应。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME emits highly toxic gases from its back. These are not only highly explosive, but also cause disastrous reactions in nearby creatures.

entry: POKENAME会用角撞碎岩石，分成可吃的小块。角撞带来的冲击还会扬起一团孢子，附着在附近植物上。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME ram their horns into rocks to break them apart into edible chunks. The resulting impact of the horn attack leaves behind a cloud of spores that cling to nearby plants.

entry: POKENAME头上覆着厚厚的岩石般皮肤，用来与同类对练。聪明的捕食者却会趁它分心，瞄准未受保护的尾巴。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's head is covered with a thick, rock-like hide used for sparring with others. Clever predators, however, target its unprotected tail when it's distracted.

entry: POKENAME成长时，会把致密的矿物压进铠甲般的甲片。从它身上采出的矿物碎片，会被锻造成高密度合金，赋予沉重球独特的重量。
author: jaminmcready
source: As POKENAME matures, it compacts dense minerals into its armor-like plating. Extracted mineral shards from this Pokémon are forged into the dense alloy that gives a Heavy Ball its distinctive weight.

entry: 睡觉时，POKENAME的所有种子会围成一圈，角与角相触。这能增强精神力量，并让它们察觉附近的威胁。
author: .izik
source: When sleeping, all seeds of POKENAME touch horns in a circle. This amplifies their psychic powers and alerts them to nearby threats.

entry: POKENAME感到受威胁时，会向危险猛冲，胡乱挥舞骨头。冲刺时它通常闭着眼，因此经常冲过目标，撞上其他障碍。
author: sk372
source: If POKENAME feels threatened, it charges forward at the danger, swinging its bone wildly. It usually closes its eyes during the charge, often causing it to run past the target and crash into another obstacle.

entry: POKENAME的领地意识极强，谁靠近洞穴，它就会挑起争斗。骨头上裹着一层厚厚的石质，让它成为强力的战斗武器。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is incredibly territorial and will start fights with anyone that comes near its cave. Its bone is covered in a thick layer of stone that makes it a powerful weapon in combat.

entry: POKENAME喜欢先用有力的舌头把东西抛到空中，再用头撞飞。主人必须留神，因为它头脑太迟钝，不懂得别人财物的重要性。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys lobbing things into the air with its strong tongue before headbutting them away. Owners must take caution, as it's too dim to understand the importance of others' property.

entry: POKENAME一旦开始冲锋，就几乎无法停下。它会一路横冲直撞，穿过湖泊和溪流，直到疲倦才停步。
author: .izik
source: Once POKENAME begins to charge, it's nearly impossible to stop. It barrels through lakes and streams until fatigue halts its movement.

entry: POKENAME极富爱心，会把被遗弃的宝可梦蛋安置在洞穴中。它睡在蛋旁，岩石身躯便会散出温暖。
author: .izik
source: Extremely nurturing, POKENAME shelters abandoned Pokémon eggs in its cave. Its stone body radiates warmth while sleeping near them.

entry: POKENAME全身覆盖灰色藤蔓，狩猎时会用其攀住钟乳石。它先用藤蔓缠住超音蝠之类的猎物，再使出角撞。
author: .izik
source: Gray vines cover POKENAME's body, clinging to stalactites while it hunts. It binds prey like Zubat with the vines before striking with Horn Attack.

entry: POKENAME十分沉重，很容易沉到海底。鳍又太弱，无法靠其游泳，因此它会从口中连续喷出泡沫，推动身体在水中前进。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Because POKENAME is so heavy, it sinks to the bottom of the sea rather easily. Its fins are too weak for swimming, so it uses blasts of Bubble from its mouth to propel itself through the water.

entry: POKENAME打喷嚏时，可能不小心射出头上的尖刺。如果接连打起喷嚏，有时就停不下来，造成一片狼藉。
author: foolish_weasel
source: When a POKENAME sneezes, it may accidentally launch a spike from its head. If it gets caught up in sneezing fits, it sometimes cannot stop, resulting in utter devastation.

entry: POKENAME的主要战术，是从嘴里喷出泡沫光线，让自己在水面上高速冲出，直到最后一刻才转身，用角重创敌人。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME's prime strategy in battle is to jettison itself across the water with Bubble Beam from its mouth, then at the very last moment it turns around to strike its foe with its horn for devastating effect.

entry: POKENAME会飞来飞去，寻找繁茂的花田和松软的土壤，再猛冲而下，把自己扎进泥里。接着，它便从根部开始，把花一路吃上去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flies around looking for verdant flower fields and soft soil, before charging down so hard it buries itself into the dirt. It then eats the flowers from the roots up.

entry: POKENAME的利刃由磨尖的石英构成，能轻松切开雪松树枝，吸食里面的树液。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's blades are made from sharpened quartz. It slices through cedar branches with ease to drink the sap inside.

entry: POKENAME用巨石筑巢，能够举起重达100吨的岩石。已有多起报告称，它们曾协助危险的洞穴救援。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME builds its den out of large boulders and is able to lift rocks up to 100 tons in weight. There have been multiple reported instances of POKENAME aiding in dangerous cave rescues.

entry: POKENAME冲锋起来，连坦克也能掀翻。性情虽凶，骑乘却意外容易，因此常出现在竞技骑术表演中。
author: staghorn
source: A charging POKENAME is capable of flipping a tank. They are surprisingly easy to ride despite their fierceness, making them a common sight at rodeos.

entry: POKENAME生活在山顶，会护送登山者登顶。魁梧的体形与出色的耐力，在帮助人们完成登山旅程时发挥着关键作用。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live atop mountains where they help escort hikers to the summit. Their bulkiness and high stamina play a vital role in helping hikers make the trek up mountains.

entry: 变身前，POKENAME会用角猛击地面，让自己安定下来。随后便能以惊人的准确度，模仿敌人。
author: .izik
source: Before transforming, POKENAME slams its horn into the ground to center itself. It then mimics its foe with uncanny accuracy.

entry: POKENAME会向引起兴趣的东西猛冲，高速飞行直到撞上。有时撞得太猛，连自己的肢体也会飞出去，好在很容易重新接上。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME charges at anything that catches its interest, flying at high speeds until the impact. Sometimes it will hit something so hard it causes a limb to fly off; fortunately they are easily reattached.

entry: 虽然POKENAME个头很小，小小的角却能刺穿坦克装甲。不过，撞击目标后，它有时会卡住，只得使出精神强念，扭动身体挣脱。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Despite POKENAME's small size, its tiny horn can pierce the armor on tanks. However, it will sometimes get stuck after ramming a target and have to use Psychic to wiggle itself free.

entry: POKENAME的石质羽毛能抵御体形更大、力量更强的捕食者，重量却让飞行略显笨拙。战斗时，它会用结实的角猛撞对手，使其晕头转向，抢占上风。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's stone feathers protect it from the attacks of larger and stronger predators, though their weight makes its flight somewhat clumsy. In battle, it slams into opponents with its sturdy horn to disorient them and gain the upper hand.

entry: POKENAME致密的身体会沉到海底，用一对角翻挖泥沙觅食。发现最爱吃的矿物时，角就会微微发光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's dense body sinks to the bottom of the sea, where it uses its twin horns to dig through the dirt and sand for food. The horns glow slightly when it discovers its preferred type of mineral to feed on.

entry: POKENAME的岩石头部太重，身体重心不稳，因此经常笨拙地摔倒。它却觉得这很可笑，于是常能看见一整群边摔边滚，笑个不停。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is unbalanced due to its rocky head making it top-heavy, so it often clumsily falls. It finds this clumsiness hilarious, so it is a common sight to see an entire group of POKENAME giggling as they fall over and roll around.

entry: POKENAME玩耍时，会尽可能长地拖住一个音，练习唱歌。它能坚持很久，没完没了的声音往往让训练家十分头疼。
author: .realthree
source: When POKENAME plays, it practices singing by holding a single note as long as it can. It can do this for a long time, so the endless noise is usually quite bothersome to its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME会挥动树枝般的手臂猛砸，引发山体滑坡。它想借此堵住河流，得到一个能安心模仿树木的地方。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slams its branch-like arms to trigger landslides. Its goal is to block rivers, giving it a safe place to mimic a tree.

entry: POKENAME有时会突然精力亢奋，沿直线狂奔，非要跑得比同伴更快。致密的身体能直接撞穿墙壁，因此很难养在室内。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME will sometimes be seized with manic energy, racing in a straight line as they feel compelled to outpace one another. The density of their bodies means they can crash straight through walls, making them challenging to keep indoors.

entry: POKENAME拍翅速度极快，即使铠甲沉重，也能在空中灵巧移动。发现敌人后，它就会向前冲，用额头上的角攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME beats its wings at such speed that it can move nimbly through the air despite the weight of its heavy armour. When it spots an enemy, it charges forward to strike with the horn on its forehead.

entry: POKENAME会彼此挑战，比赛横穿河流。它们全速狂奔，撞开挡路的一切。赛后，败者会用角在水下积聚的黏液，为胜者进行一番仿佛按摩的照料。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME challenge each other in races across rivers. They run full pelt across them, barging through anything in their way. The winner is then given what looks like a massage by the losers, using a goo that builds up in their horn while underwater.

entry: POKENAME的角会分泌黏稠树液，据说是上好的去角质材料。不过，收集起来不容易，因为它们喜欢戳弄一起配合采集的人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a thick sap from their horn that is said to make a great exfoliant. Harvesting this sap can be difficult because they love to poke at the harvesters they work with.

entry: POKENAME会短暂合壳，让外层进一步变硬。加固后，它便以凶猛的力量冲撞附近的一切。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME briefly closes its shell, hardening its exterior further. Once reinforced, it charges at anything nearby with brutal force.

entry: 矿工常在洞口附近的石缝发现POKENAME。它们会用奇形怪状的石头，在洞窟深处筑大巢。
author: schwaus
source: Miners often find POKENAME in between rocks near cave entrances. They create large nests with oddly shaped stones deep within their caves.

entry: POKENAME在峡谷中钻洞时，会用角撞碎火山岩。吃下岩石能增强身体，承受上方土层的巨大压力。
author: .izik
source: While burrowing through canyons, POKENAME breaks volcanic rocks with its horn. Eating them strengthens its body to handle the above soil's immense pressure.

entry: POKENAME会四处跑动、汪汪叫，吸引注意，停下时则仰头噘嘴望着训练家，直到得到摸头才满意。虽然爱提要求，它们却十分忠诚，也以帮训练家挖宝闻名。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME run around barking for attention, only stopping to pout up to their Trainers until they get headpats. Despite their demanding nature, they are loyal companions that are known to help Trainers dig up treasures.

entry: POKENAME把樱子果储存在头骨般的壳里。冲撞树木时，里面的树果被摇晃搅碎，变成微辣的果汁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stores Cheri Berries in its skull-like shell. When it charges at trees, the berries inside shake into a semi-spicy juice.

entry: POKENAME的角由格外坚韧的岩石构成，能轻松承受凶猛攻击时的冲击。它一低头准备冲锋，就是赶快让路的信号。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's horn is made out of particularly sturdy stone, able to withstand the force of their savage attacks without issue. When it puts its head down and starts charging, that is the signal to get out of the way fast.

entry: 人们观察到，POKENAME会先用头锤撞碎大石，再用爪子凿削雕琢，制作粗糙的武器。辛劳让它们有了回报，能够击落空中的猎物。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME have been observed fashioning tools by breaking large rocks with a Headbutt before using their claws to chisel and sculpt a crude weapon. Their hard work pays off by allowing them to take down airborne prey.

entry: POKENAME的身体比花岗岩还硬，却十分怕冷。冬季，它会在全身裹上泥巴保暖。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is harder than granite, but is highly susceptible to the cold. During the winter months it covers its body in mud to stay warm.

entry: POKENAME背上的壳，由冷却到安全温度的熔岩构成。它们住在火山附近，能随时泡进熔岩，修补外壳。
author: quackquackattack
source: The shells on the back of POKENAME are made of lava that has cooled to a safe temperature. They remain close to volcanoes where they can take a dip in the lava to mend their shell.

entry: POKENAME会用岩石般坚硬的喙撞树，震落绿毛虫之类的猎物，再使出角撞，结束狩猎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rams trees with its rock-hard beak to knock loose prey like Caterpie. It follows up with a Horn Attack to finish the job.

entry: POKENAME灰米色的鳞片能融入岩石小径。它们先用角撞晕猎物，再将毒牙刺进这顿大餐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME blend into rocky pathways with their greige scales. They ram their horn to stun prey before sinking their venomous fangs into their meal.

entry: POKENAME成大群在稀树草原游荡。捕食者一靠近，体形最大的个体就会冲向威胁，使出令人痛楚的撞击，不管来犯的宝可梦比自己大多少。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME roam savannas in large herds. If any predators approach, the largest POKENAME run at the threats to deliver a stinging tackle, no matter how much larger the attacking Pokémon are.

entry: POKENAME在山区高速滚动。如果有巨石挡路，它就会停下来，用冲撞将其粉碎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rolls through mountainous areas at high speed. If a boulder blocks its way, it stops rolling and rams it into dust.

entry: POKENAME在地下深处筑巢，大部分时间都在挖掘新隧道。它废弃的巢穴，是矿业公司争相寻找的地方。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME builds its den deep underground, spending most of its time digging out new tunnels. Abandoned POKENAME dens are highly sought after by mining companies.

entry: POKENAME会用头撞击石笋，敲下碎石。吃下这些石头，能让角变得更加致密。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slams its head into stalagmites to break off stone fragments. It eats the stone to strengthen the density of its horn.

entry: POKENAME会逆时针旋转尾巴，给角充电。放电时轰然作响，雷鸣般的声音响彻峡谷。
author: .izik
source: By spinning its tail counterclockwise, POKENAME charges its horn with electricity. It discharges with a thunderous boom heard across canyons.

entry: POKENAME进攻时，会伸出手臂抓取或拳击目标。它头脑简单，即使打空，也不会把手臂收回，非得碰到什么，或伸到极限才肯罢休。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME goes on the attack, it extends an arm to grab or punch the target. Because of its simple mind, even if it misses, it won't retract its arm back until it hits something or extends to its maximum limit.

entry: 最常见于稀树草原。不过，深深的洞穴中也发现了适应弱光的亚种。
author: capwolfbane
source: This Pokémon is most frequently found in savannas. Subspecies, however, have been found even in deep caves, adapted to the low light environment.

entry: 尽管个头不大，POKENAME的身体却十分结实。人们认为，这是因为它们挖洞时经常撞上地下物体，身体才逐渐发展得更能承受冲击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have very durable bodies, despite their small sizes. It is believed this is because they tend to run into objects underground while digging, so their bodies developed to better endure such impacts.

entry: POKENAME能用强劲的爪子直接挖穿坚硬岩石，在深处筑巢。它的石质鳞片极其锋利，古人曾将其用作矛尖。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its powerful claws to tunnel straight through hard stone, building its nest deep inside them. Its stone scales are incredibly sharp and ancient peoples used to use them as spear tips.

entry: 它坚韧的甲片由干泥与黏土构成，既能保护身体，又不妨碍活动。POKENAME整日练习踢技，让每一脚都更强、更具破坏力。
author: fiordaliso
source: The pieces of its tough armor are made of dried mud and clay, giving it both protection and freedom of movement. POKENAME spends all its days training its kicks to make them ever stronger and more devastating.

entry: POKENAME对光十分敏感，太阳下山前都会把自己埋在地下。眼睛外有一层薄膜，能在挖洞时挡住碎屑。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is very sensitive to light, so it keeps itself buried underground until the sun sets. Its eyes are protected by a thin film that keeps debris out while digging.

entry: POKENAME性情冲动，坚决保护训练家。只要认为有威胁，就会不顾一切地冲过去，忘了用念力本来能更有效。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is impulsive and staunchly protective of its Trainer. It charges at perceived threats recklessly, forgetting that it could use telekinesis to better effect.

entry: POKENAME对坚韧的铠甲十分自豪，会猛撞岩石，证明自己的力量。不过，寒冷其实会让铠甲变脆，因此它通常会待在洞里，直到春天。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME takes great pride in its tough armor, smashing itself into rocks to prove its strength. Its armor actually turns brittle in the cold, so it tends to stay in its cave until spring.

entry: 坚韧的皮肤与伪装能力，让它成为强大的伏击猎手。会融入周围环境，再猛烈冲锋，打敌人个措手不及。
author: rc2k
source: This Pokémon's sturdy hide and camouflaging abilities make it a formidable ambush predator. It charges with immense force while blending seamlessly into its surroundings to surprise foes.

entry: POKENAME角中渗出的毒液，煮沸后就会变甜，且不再有毒。人们常将其用于水果挞，以及淋在冰淇淋上的酱料。
author: .izik
source: The venom leaking from POKENAME's horn becomes sweet and nonpoisonous when boiled. It's often used in tarts and ice cream toppings.

entry: POKENAME巨颚咬合力惊人，却更喜欢甩头砸碎沿途一切。身体硬如石头，不怕任何撞击。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its jaws' massive bite force, POKENAME prefers flailing its head around, smashing everything in its path. With a body as tough as stone, it doesn't fear any physical impacts.

entry: POKENAME头顶有尖角和磨得光亮的圆顶。强健的腿部肌肉能让它全速冲刺，再用角猛撞洞壁，力道足以引起小规模震动。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a sharp horn and a well-polished dome atop their heads. Their powerful leg muscles allow them to bring themselves into a full sprint before slamming their horn into cave walls. This act has enough force to cause small tremors.

entry: POKENAME镰刀般的角对振动十分敏感。如果察觉洞穴即将坍塌，它就会用硕大的头把其他生物推到安全的地方。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's scythe-like horn is sensitive to vibrations. If it senses an imminent cave-in, it will use its oversized head to shove others to safety.

entry: POKENAME把自己藏在沙漠的沙子里，嘴朝上，等待毫无防备的宝可梦经过。随后，它会张开大嘴，吞下掉进来的一切。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME hides itself mouth-up in the desert sand, waiting for unsuspecting Pokémon to walk by. It will then open its large mouth, consuming whatever falls inside.

entry: POKENAME会用坚硬如岩石的角撞击猎物，注入毒液。毒素会引起发烧，极少数情况下还会造成暂时失明。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rams prey with its rock-hard horn to inject venom. The poison causes fevers and, in rare cases, temporary blindness.

entry: 它游荡在洞穴和矿井中，寻找能吸取生命能量的人类。POKENAME不断与同类决斗，让利刃始终锋利无比。
author: fiordaliso
source: It haunts caves and mines in search of humans whose life energy it can drain. POKENAME keeps its blade razor-sharp by constantly dueling with others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME的石角不断滴下毒液。酸性强到只需接触几分钟，就能溶解大理石。
author: .izik
source: Venom drips from POKENAME's stone horn constantly. The acid is so strong it can melt marble within minutes of exposure.

entry: POKENAME能撞穿最坚固的摩天大楼，因此是拆迁工人的好伙伴。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME make excellent partners for demolition workers due to their ability to smash through the toughest of skyscrapers.

entry: POKENAME会摧毁漂浮的冰山，检验自己的力量。它们还会把碎冰抛向路过的波皇子群和拉普拉斯群，似乎毫无缘由。
author: _testrun_
source: POKENAME will test their strength by destroying floating icebergs. They launch the resulting chunks of ice at passing Prinplup colonies and Lapras pods for seemingly no reason.

entry: POKENAME最令人畏惧的招式，是用巨大的身体全力撞向敌人，却也会让自己身上出现细小裂缝。植物常在裂隙里生长，加快它身体的朽坏。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's most feared attack involves crashing its enormous girth into its foe at full force, which leaves small cracks in its body. Plants tend to grow in these openings, which hastens POKENAME's decay.

entry: POKENAME一旦开始冲锋，就很难停下。它会发射头上的大炮，借后坐力减速，停止冲锋。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME starts charging at something, it has difficulty stopping. It uses the recoil from firing the cannon on its head to help it slow down and stop its charge.

entry: POKENAME头上的宝石以月光为能量，能照亮洞穴。如果发现月亮已经升起，自己却还没到外面，它就会暴怒地冲撞墙壁，尽快来到月光下。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME lights up its cavern with the gemstones on its head, which are powered by moonlight. If it realizes that the moon has risen and it is not outside, it becomes enraged and charges at walls to get into the moonlight quickly.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的灰色蘑菇，会在战斗中散播腐蚀性孢子。它先用孢子云扰乱敌人，再用角突刺。
author: .izik
source: The gray mushroom on POKENAME's tail scatters corrosive spores mid-fight. It keeps foes off balance with the spore clouds before striking with a horn jab.

entry: POKENAME藏在山区，用有力的爪子挖掘月之石。流星雨期间，它们会下山，与其他宝可梦分享月之石。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hide out in mountainous areas, using their powerful claws to dig out Moon Stones. During meteor showers, POKENAME come down from the mountains to share their Moon Stones with other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME虽披着岩石般坚硬的甲片，动作却敏捷惊人。它会猛撞敌人，造成脑震荡与骨折。
author: _testrun_
source: Despite the rock-hard plating, POKENAME are incredibly agile. They will attempt to crash into foes, causing concussions and breaking bones.

entry: POKENAME读取波导信号时，角就会发光。如果察觉到微弱的波导，它会一直守护着衰弱的生物，直到对方恢复。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's horn glows when reading aura signals. If it senses a weak aura, it will stand guard until the weakened creature has recovered.

entry: POKENAME清晨精力格外旺盛，会反复冲撞障碍物，消耗过剩的能量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is highly energetic in the early morning. It charges repeatedly into obstacles to burn off its excess energy.

entry: 虽然固执、好胜，极偶尔还会发脾气，POKENAME总体上仍是温和的生物，生活在各种海拔的草原。野生个体只吃植物。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although stubborn, competitive, and even rarely prone to the occasional tantrum, POKENAME is overall a gentle creature found in the grasslands of various elevations. It only eats plants in the wild.

entry: POKENAME的铁质外骨骼上覆有一层岩石，提供额外保护。裸露的腹部则容易生锈。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME has a layer of rock on top of its iron exoskeleton for extra protection. Its belly is exposed and is prone to rusting.

entry: POKENAME的铠甲由柔软、能够弯曲的金属构成，却不妨碍它用头和角猛撞巨石。它需要富含铁的食物，常住在工业区附近，吃掉无人看守的废金属。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's armor is made out of a soft metal that bends, but that doesn't stop it from bashing boulders with its head and horn. This Pokémon requires a high iron diet and lives near industrial sites, consuming unguarded scrap metal.

entry: POKENAME会冲撞仙人掌，检验力量。累了以后，它就钻进沙里休息，节省能量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME charges into cacti to test its strength. Once tired, it burrows into the sand to rest and conserve energy.

entry: 穿越POKENAME群居的岩石地带时，需要留意脚下。它们很容易与地面融为一体，经常绊倒毫无防备的旅人。
author: kittyluv090
source: One should take caution when traveling the rocky terrain where groups of POKENAME reside, as they are known to trip unsuspecting travelers because they easily blend into the ground.

entry: POKENAME拍动翅膀的声音响亮而独特。一旦选定要飞去的地方，它便不顾一切、不知疲倦地赶去，即使勉强自己也不停下。
author: bobosmith01
source: The beating of a POKENAME's wings is loud and distinct. When it picks a location to fly to, it will recklessly and tirelessly travel to it, even if it strains itself doing so.

entry: POKENAME的一个齿轮上长着大角，能在墙壁钻孔。它们在固定位置缓慢钻出的孔，可用来安装支撑杆，为地下建筑创造条件。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a large horn on one of their gears that is used to bore holes into walls. By drilling holes slowly and at a set point, this opens up opportunities for creating structures underground by making space for support bars.

entry: POKENAME头上覆着头盔般的壳，能让它以头部冲撞敌人。它脾气急躁又固执，发起脾气来便跺得大地震颤。
author: fiordaliso
source: The helmet-like shell covering POKENAME's head allows it to charge headfirst into foes. Short-tempered and stubborn, it stomps the ground in tantrums that make the earth tremble.

entry: POKENAME柔软、真菌般的真身外，裹着沉重的岩石外壳。它走得很慢，却能在短距离内猛然跃起，发出强力头部撞击。
author: sk372
source: A heavy, rocky shell covers POKENAME's soft, fungus-like true form. It has a low walking speed but can hop in short, powerful bursts that enable a powerful headbutt attack.

entry: 在沙漠里长时间挖洞后，POKENAME会从仙人掌中取汁饮用。它会在仙人掌附近钻洞，方便补水。
author: .izik
source: After long digging sessions in the desert, POKENAME taps cacti to drink their fluid. It burrows near cacti for easy hydration.

entry: POKENAME体形小，甲壳几乎无法击穿，又能抵御毒属性，几乎没有办法清除它们造成的侵扰。最好在它们从内部拆毁建筑前，及时搬离。
author: _testrun_
source: Due to their small size, near-impenetrable carapaces, and resistance to the Poison type, there is almost no way to eliminate a POKENAME infestation. It is advised to vacate the structure before the POKENAME finish demolishing it from within.

entry: POKENAME挂在洞穴顶上，谁碰它，就会试着把谁撞飞。岩石外壳几乎无法击穿，让它即使从高得离谱的地方掉下来，也毫无感觉。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hangs from the cave ceiling and will try to bash anyone who touches it. Its rocky shell is almost impenetrable, allowing it to be dropped from ludicrous heights without feeling a thing.

entry: 人们能看见POKENAME群体在大型洞穴系统中巡逻，一发现入侵者就全力冲撞。如果有肢体断裂，它们就会抓来一大块石头替换。
author: mistymagius
source: Groups of POKENAME can be seen patrolling large cave systems and will charge full force into intruders on sight. If one of their limbs breaks off, they will grab a large piece of stone to replace it with.

entry: POKENAME战斗时不用獠牙，而是俯冲撞向对手，力道足以碎石。不过，它常把自己撞成脑震荡，露出任人攻击的破绽。
author: mistymagius
source: Instead of using its fangs in combat, POKENAME will dive bomb into its opponent with enough force to shatter stone. However, it often ends up concussing itself, leaving it wide open for attack.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间都在挖矿，寻找稀有矿石和宝石。它讨厌矿工，经常试着把他们赶走，好独占宝石。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME spends most of its day mining, searching for rare ores and gemstones. It hates miners, often trying to chase them away so it can have the gems all to itself.

entry: POKENAME的角会渗出浓稠毒液。长时间接触，不论宝可梦还是人类，都可能失明。
author: .izik
source: A thick, viscous toxin seeps from POKENAME's horn. Prolonged exposure can cause blindness in both Pokémon and humans.

entry: POKENAME冲锋时很难阻挡，不仅因为体重与速度，还因为头上的毒角。为了寻找好草地和树果树，它们会一路撞翻较小的宝可梦。
author: chibitales
source: A charging POKENAME is difficult to stop, not only due to their weight and speed, but also the venomous horns on their head. They bowl over smaller Pokémon to find good grass patches and berry trees.

entry: POKENAME曾拥有无比坚固的铠甲与惊人力量，强到没有任何对手能够打败它。后来，头部铠甲进化得过于致密，头骨内再也容不下大脑，它便因此灭绝了。
author: occulusmalus
source: POKENAME was incredibly well armoured and tremendously strong, to the point nothing could defeat it. It went extinct when its head armour evolved to be so dense that there was no more room left in its skull for a brain.

entry: POKENAME常被大型宝可梦弄伤，因此每逢即将被踩扁，就会向上刺出毒角。留下的疼痛伤口，会提醒大家伙下次看清脚下。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often get hurt by large Pokémon, so just before they are about to be flattened, they stab their venomous horn upwards. The resulting wound will be a painful reminder to the large Pokémon to watch where they step.

entry: POKENAME发现船只进入领地，就会全速冲撞，用鼻端坚硬如岩石的角攻击。如果嗅到水域中猎物的气味，它会接连追上数天，直到抓住。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME spots a boat within its territory, it charges at full speed to ram it with the rock-hard horn on its snout. If it catches the scent of a victim in its waters, it will chase it for days until it is caught.

entry: POKENAME生活在平坦、长满海草的海底平原。它们在沙中穿行，突然冲出伏击猎物，却不善狩猎，因为凶猛的性情让动作变得毫无规律、极不协调。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME are found in flat, grassy sea plains. They burrow through the sand and burst out to ambush prey, but they are terrible at hunting since, due to their ferocity, all their movements are extremely erratic and uncoordinated.

entry: POKENAME一动不动地站在稀树草原，伪装在金合欢树间。一旦察觉捕食者，就会从小树林中猛冲而出，以沉重的撞击出其不意地攻击威胁。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME stands motionless in savannahs, disguised among acacia trees. If it senses a predator, it barrels out of the copse to blindside the threat with a hefty tackle.

entry: POKENAME的角尖会渗出闪亮的紫色粉末，让靠得太近的敌人衰弱、屈服。
author: .izik
source: A sparkling purple powder seeps from the tip of POKENAME's horn. The substance weakens and subdues foes caught too close.

entry: POKENAME通过翅膀吸收光线，发出强烈的光辉。吸收足够的光后，头上的角便会像棱镜一样，将光分成多种颜色。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME absorb light through their wings and shimmer with a powerful light. Once enough light has been absorbed, their horn on their head begins to split light into many colors like a prism.

entry: POKENAME头脑十分简单，常不顾安危，埋头就往战场冲。它的灰毛极其粗糙，运气不好，碰到还可能受点轻伤。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is very simple-minded, as it will charge headfirst into battle with little regard for its safety. Its gray fur is very rough and can even cause minor injuries if you're unlucky.

entry: POKENAME住在岩石峡谷中，用坚韧的爪子攀爬峭壁。它以结实的面甲为傲，会用头撞石头，炫耀力量。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in rocky canyons, using its tough claws to climb the cliff face. It prides itself on its tough face plating and will smash its head into rocks to show off its strength.

entry: POKENAME用石爪翻耕洞穴里的土壤，种下孢子，再守在附近，等它们成熟后供同类食用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME tills cave soil with its stone claws to plant spores. It waits nearby for them to mature as food for its kin.

entry: POKENAME的石钳强到能够夹碎钢铁。它会凶猛地保护自己在洞穴系统中培育的蘑菇。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's stone pincers are strong enough to crush steel. It fiercely protects the mushrooms it cultivates inside cave systems.

entry: POKENAME全身覆盖坚硬的陶瓷鳞片，被攻击打碎后就会立刻再生。它挥动双拳与尾巴作战，也会用角直刺。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is completely covered by hard ceramic scales, which regrow as soon as they are broken by an attack. It fight using swings of its fists and tail and stabbing thrusts with its horn.

entry: POKENAME巨大的钳子里各有独立的副脑，能更精确地控制惊人力量。研究表明，钳子甚至比它本身更聪明。
author: occulusmalus
source: POKENAME's gargantuan claws contain their own secondary brains for more precise control of their immense strength. Research suggests the claws are more intelligent than the creature itself.

entry: POKENAME会用角敲下洞壁上的紫水晶。这些闪闪发亮的宝石，是它最喜欢的零食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its horn to knock amethyst from cave walls. It eats the glittering gems as a favorite treat.

entry: POKENAME身上的岩石非常脆，一起风就会化成沙。尽管外表蓬松，它的体重却比看起来重得多。
author: mistymagius
source: The rocks on a POKENAME's body are very brittle and will turn into sand when it starts to get windy. Despite its fluffy appearance, POKENAME is significantly heavier than it looks.

entry: 它会熔化石头，让石滴落到身上，等其冷却，扩充铠甲。POKENAME极其爱护自己的岩石，也不许别人侵占。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It expands its armor by melting stone and waiting for the drops to cool on its body. POKENAME are very protective and territorial over their rocks.

entry: POKENAME会在山中挖出迷宫般的隧道。挡路的巨石，都能被它的角轻松击碎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs maze-like tunnels through mountains. Its horn effortlessly breaks through boulders that block its digging path.

entry: 它在岩石上磨爪，留下深深的沟槽，好让利爪随时派上用场。POKENAME极其讨厌水，一下雨就立刻找洞穴躲起来，直到风雨过去才肯出来。
author: fiordaliso
source: It sharpens its claws on rock, leaving deep grooves behind so it's always ready to use them when needed. POKENAME utterly despises water. If it starts raining, it immediately looks for a cave to hide in and won't come out until the storm has passed.

entry: 它身上会生成华美的珠宝，只有行家才能取下，在黑市上能卖出离谱的天价。经交换易主的POKENAME，则以不听话闻名。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its body produces luxurious jewels that only experts can remove; these jewels sell for asinine amounts on the black market. Traded POKENAME are known for their disobedience.

entry: POKENAME在陆上步履缓慢沉重，在水中却游得敏捷迅速。准备在水里冲刺追赶目标前，额头的宝石就会发光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a slow, plodding walk on land, but is a very deft and swift swimmer. The gem on its forehead glows when it is about to charge through the water and chase something down.

entry: 它背上的翅膀太小，无法飞行，却能提供向下的压力，让POKENAME冲上陡崖和山坡时抓地更稳。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The wings on its back are too small to give it flight. Instead, they provide down force to give POKENAME better grip while it rushes up steep cliffs and mountains.

entry: POKENAME会先转动手臂蓄势，再拳头朝前，向对手猛冲，非得撞到什么才会停下。这种冲锋拳能轻松打倒整棵树。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rotates its arms to wind up a punch before charging at an opponent fist-first, not stopping until it hits something. These charge-punches can knock down entire trees with ease.

entry: 举起重物时，POKENAME背上鳍状的甲片会扇开散热。它能轻松举起小型厢式车那么大的物体。
author: .izik
source: When lifting heavy objects, POKENAME's fin-like back plates fan out to release heat. It can easily lift objects the size of a minivan.

entry: 需要快速开凿隧道的施工队，经常会雇用POKENAME。它们靠强力双拳与尖角配合，很快就能破开岩石，不过施工声十分刺耳，住在附近并不好受。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are commonly employed within construction crews looking to quickly create tunnels. They use a combination of their powerful fists and sharp horns to make short work of the rock, though the process is loud and unpleasant to live near.

entry: POKENAME跑起来比看上去快得多，一动起来就停不住，还能高速钻穿坚实的地面。它们常突然出现，把人绊倒，因此登山者和洞穴探险者给它们起了个绰号，叫“断胫兽”。
author: joeofthealps
source: POKENAME are deceptively fast, can't be stopped once they've started moving, and can tunnel through solid ground at high speed. Hikers and cavers have given them the nickname "shinbreakers" for their tendency to surprise and trip them.

entry: POKENAME把身体当作拆楼铁球，用藤蔓挂在树上荡起，再猛撞对手。不过，力道有时大过了头，反而让自己陷进地面，动弹不得。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its body like a wrecking ball, swinging from a tree using its vine and then smashing itself into its opponent. However, the impact can sometimes be so powerful that it gets itself stuck in the ground.

entry: POKENAME急躁好斗，会相互冲撞，证明谁的铠甲最坚固。洞穴救援时，救援人员经常靠它们打碎或搬运大岩石。
author: mistymagius
source: Hot-headed and belligerent, POKENAME smash into each other to prove whose armor is the strongest. Rescue workers often rely on them to break or carry large rocks during cave rescues.

entry: POKENAME性情温和，却十分好胜。许多个体会专门接受竞速或技巧表演训练，再参加大型比赛。因此，它们被视为体育博彩的象征。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME have gentle but highly competitive personalities. Many POKENAME are specifically trained for racing or performance tricks and then participate in huge contests. As a result, they are considered a symbol for sports gambling.

entry: POKENAME会缓缓游荡，寻找露出地面的树根戳弄。岩石般坚硬的头，能保护它们免受其他宝可梦的抓挠和啄击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME amble around looking for exposed roots to poke at. Their rock-solid heads protect them from scratches and pecks from other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME铁甲般的铠甲，能抵御潜伏在冰冷水中的捕食者。发现猎物时，它会用石头般坚硬的尾巴猛拍，让对方动弹不得。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's ironclad armor shields it from predators lurking in frigid waters. When it detects prey, it smacks them with its stone-hard tail, rendering them immobile.

entry: POKENAME常在矿井里闹鬼，反复用头撞击机械，想把矿工赶走。不过，矿工真走了，它很快又会无聊起来，另寻一座矿井继续闹。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME often haunts mineshafts, repeatedly headbutting machinery in an effort to get the miners to leave. However, once they do leave, POKENAME will soon get bored and search for a new mine to haunt.

entry: POKENAME坚固的蛇形岩石身体，让它能轻松冲撞，钻穿岩土。有人说，只要足够执拗、足够努力，它甚至能一路挖到星球另一端。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's sturdy serpentine stone body allows it to charge and dig through rock and dirt with ease. Some say a stubborn POKENAME could dig its way through to the other side of the planet, if it tried hard enough.

entry: POKENAME是最早有记录的融合体之一。它的发现，重新引发了科学界的旧争论：构成它的两种宝可梦，究竟谁才是史上最早得到科学记录的宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME was one of the first known recorded fusions on record. Its discovery lead to reopening old scientific debates on which of its constituents were the first Pokémon scientifically recorded in history.

entry: 雷暴期间，POKENAME的角间会跃动巨大的电弧。它不按常规方法挖掘，而是直接让自己爆炸，从山坡上炸掉一大块。
author: mistymagius
source: During thunderstorms, large arcs of electricity jump between POKENAME's horn. Rather than digging the conventional way, POKENAME will blow itself up to take a chunk out of the mountainside.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME会抛出骨头，打晕对手，再趁其晕头转向时冲上去，使出粉碎性的角撞。
author: .izik
source: During battle, POKENAME hurls its bone to stun opponents. Once they're disoriented, it charges with a crushing Horn Attack.

entry: POKENAME是技艺高超的斗士，无论距离远近都能应战。近距离用角刺击，远距离则抛出骨头回旋镖。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are skilled fighters that can take on foes at any distance. They rely on their horn to stab their opponents at close range and toss their bone boomerang at long range.

entry: POKENAME舌头上的唾液，能瞬间麻痹猎物。随后，它会使出角钻，凶狠而高效地结束狩猎。
author: .izik
source: The saliva on POKENAME's tongue paralyzes prey instantly. It follows up with a Horn Drill to finish the job with brutal efficiency.

entry: 知名建筑公司经常借助POKENAME，以创纪录的速度开凿新隧道。它的黑曜石角几乎坚不可摧，旋转时连最坚固的金属墙都能轻易钻穿。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is often utilized by renowned construction companies to carve new tunnels in record time. Its obsidian horn is nearly indestructible, and when it spins, it can easily pierce even the toughest metal walls.

entry: POKENAME本不擅长战斗，得依靠吉利拳才能打出重击。为了保护蛋，它会使用物理攻击，圆鼓鼓的身体却并不适合这样战斗。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on a Lucky Punch to hit hard, as they are otherwise inept at fighting. They rely on physical attacks to protect their egg, which their bulbous bodies are not suitable for.

entry: 游泳时，POKENAME会把角伸进水中旋转，制造巨大的漩涡，困住想捕食自己的敌人。
author: .izik
source: While swimming, POKENAME dips its horn into the water and spins it. This creates massive whirlpools to trap would-be predators.

entry: POKENAME变身前，角会发光。只需一个念头，它就能毫无差错地模仿眼前的任何东西。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's horn glows just before it transforms. With a single thought, it can mimic anything it sees with perfect accuracy.

entry: POKENAME个头小，鼻子却是强力钻头，因帮助挖掘队快速破开岩石而闻名。出色完成工作后，奖励一颗闪亮的宝石，就能让它表现得最好。
author: sk372
source: With a small stature and a powerful drill for a nose, POKENAME has made a name for itself in assisting digging crews get through stone quickly. It works best when treated to a shiny gemstone after a job well done.

entry: 额头上的角有着惊人的破坏力。不过，大多数时候，POKENAME根本提不起劲用它做任何事。
author: .jerden
source: The horn on its forehead has tremendous destructive power. Most of the time, POKENAME has no motivation to use it for anything.

entry: POKENAME的聪明程度远超外表。它看似随意地四处钻孔，最后完成的成果却精妙而复杂。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME appears to be deceptively intelligent. It will drill holes seemingly at random, only for the finished product to be masterfully complex.

entry: POKENAME俯冲向猎物时，会像陀螺般旋转。借助旋转下冲的动势，它的角连花岗岩都能钻穿。
author: .izik
source: When diving at prey, POKENAME spins like a top. Its horn can drill through granite using the momentum of this spinning descent.

entry: 虽然个头很小，POKENAME却相当强壮。它会用头上的钻头状角钻进岩壁，寻找矿物吃。
author: chibitales
source: Despite its small size, POKENAME is quite strong. It uses the drill-like horns on its head to burrow into rock walls and look for minerals to eat.

entry: 人们有时会用POKENAME测试潜水艇能承受多大压力，进而判断能潜多深。它会慢慢钻向潜水艇，起初轻轻用力，再逐渐加重，直到钻穿。至今，没有一艘能承受住它。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are sometimes used to test how much pressure submarines can handle and therefore how deep they can go. POKENAME slowly drills into them, gently at first, increasing until it pierces them. None have been built that can withstand POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的两只角都锋利而致命，尾巴上的尤其危险，钻进目标体内后，还会注入强烈毒液。
author: sk372
source: The two horns POKENAME possesses are very sharp and deadly. The one on its tail is particularly dangerous due to the potent venom it injects after boring into a target.

entry: POKENAME凭借头上的钻头，能毫不费力地在山体深处挖出巨大隧道。它会吃下挖掘时发现的铁与其他矿物，让身体更加强壮。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME digs immense tunnels deep inside the mountains with remarkable ease, thanks to the drill on its head. It feeds on iron and other minerals found during its excavations to make its body even stronger.

entry: 尽管表情凶狠，POKENAME却喜欢帮助训练家和较小的宝可梦。伙伴遭到威胁，或得到训练家许可时，它们便会一边吠叫，一边挥舞角，狂猛地向前冲。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Despite their aggressive expressions, POKENAME enjoy helping out Trainers or smaller Pokémon. When their companions are threatened, or they're given permission from a Trainer, they wildly charge forward while barking and thrashing their horns.

entry: POKENAME喜欢寻找带晶洞的岩石，用锯齿状大钳将其夹开。虽然太重无法飞行，它仍会在地下深处用翅膀为自己降温。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME likes hunting for geodes, using its serrated pincers to crack them open. While it is too heavy to fly, it uses its wings to cool itself down while deep underground.

entry: POKENAME高尚而自豪，立誓保护更小、更弱的宝可梦。它的矛尖由一位祖先留下的角制成。
author: launch4527
source: Noble and proud, POKENAME swears an oath to protect smaller and weaker Pokémon. The tip of its spear is made from a horn belonging to one of its ancestors.

entry: POKENAME纵身俯冲，越转越快，钻头般的喙撕开沿途的一切。宽大坚韧的双翼让它能接连数天不停飞行，即使狂风暴雨，也能稳住空中的身形。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME hurls itself into a dive, twisting faster and faster as its drill-like beak tears through anything in its path. With massive, resilient wings, it soars for days without rest and holds its ground in the sky even amid raging storms.

entry: POKENAME用灰色鳞片融入岩石小径，悄悄爬近猎物，再用尖角钻入对方身体。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME camouflage themselves into rocky pathways with their griseous scales. They quietly slither towards prey before drilling into them with their sharp horn.

entry: POKENAME会将整座山划为领地，凶猛地击退所有胆敢挑战的宝可梦。大规模山体滑坡后，它会花上数星期，修复山坡。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME claims an entire mountain as its territory and will fiercely fight off any Pokémon that dare challenge it. After large landslides, POKENAME will spend weeks repairing the mountainside.

entry: POKENAME只在雷暴期间离巢，用导电的角吸引附近所有落雷。尾巴上的钻头钻动时，会迸出巨大火花，曾因此引起野火。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME only comes out of its nest during thunderstorms, drawing in all nearby lightning strikes with its conductive horn. The drill on its tail produces large sparks while drilling that have been known to start wildfires.

entry: POKENAME形似钻角犀兽的一种远古近亲，同样长有厚毛与脂肪御寒。它长而弯曲的角，既是武器，也是挖雪的工具。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME resembles an ancient relative of Rhydon, which also had thick fur and fat to protect it from the cold. POKENAME's long, curved horn is used both as a weapon and as a tool to dig in the snow.

entry: POKENAME分泌的毒液，会沿着带沟槽的旋转角流下，人们认为这有助于它钻穿坚硬岩石，挖掘巢穴。只有感到安全时，它才会收起角和全身的棘刺。
author: scruffulon
source: The poison POKENAME secretes channels down its grooved rotating horn, and is thought to assist it in drilling through tough rock to make its nests. Its horn and the barbs all over its body retract only when it feels safe.

entry: POKENAME鼻端的钻头能够高速旋转，但平时只会慢慢转动。它会在树干上钻孔，吸食甜美树液，也会借钻动时的振动，震落高处树枝上的果子。
author: .jerden
source: The drill on POKENAME's nose can spin at high speed, but usually only rotates slowly. POKENAME uses it to bore holes into tree trunks so that it can drink sweet sap, and uses the vibrations its drilling creates to shake fruit out of branches above.

entry: POKENAME会照料尼多一族的幼崽，但头脑简单，也没什么耐心容忍调皮。人们常看见幼崽四处逃跑，躲开想用头撞来惩罚它们的POKENAME。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME acts as a caretaker for younger Nidoran species, but has a very simple mind and little patience for bad behavior. The young ones are often seen running from a POKENAME attempting to headbutt them as punishment.

entry: POKENAME的角就是钻头。它会用角在地上钻孔、播下种子，再看护植物成长；这只钻角，也兼作保护它们的工具。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's horn works as a drill. Using this, it digs holes in the ground to plant seeds in, watching over the plants as they grow, its drill horn doubling as a tool to protect them with.

entry: 施工现场经常能看见POKENAME，宽大的壳用来把脚手架运来运去。人们有时也会借它的力量拆除旧建筑残骸，为新工程腾出地方。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are a common sight around construction sites, their broad shell used to carry scaffolding from one place to another. Their strength is sometimes employed to demolish the remains of previous buildings, clearing the way for new construction.

entry: 施工现场经常能看见POKENAME，宽大的壳用来把脚手架运来运去。它们还会用强劲的前臂稳住摇晃的部分，保障工人安全。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are a common sight around construction sites, their broad shell used to carry scaffolding from one place to another. They use their powerful forearms to steady unstable sections, ensuring worker safety.

entry: POKENAME会用钻头状的利刃，钻穿挡路的一切。它的裹布能感知附近人类的生命能量，不断朝那个方向绷紧伸展。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME bores through any obstacle in its path using its drill-shaped blade. Its shroud can sense the life energy of nearby humans and perpetually strains in their direction.

entry: POKENAME的角能帮助它高速钻土。一天之内，它就能挖到地下10英里深处。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME's horn helps this Pokémon burrow through dirt at high speeds. It can dig up to 10 miles deep in a single day.

entry: POKENAME在月下起舞时，锥状突起会反射月光。它喜欢爬上高山，再纵身跃下，重重落到远处地面。下坠时的光芒常被误认成飞船或小陨星。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's cones reflect moonlight as it dances under the moon. It likes to climb high up mountains and leap off to crash into the ground far below. The descending glow is often mistaken for spacecraft or Minior.

entry: 满月之夜，POKENAME的钻头会神秘地自行反转。它必须小心，因为曾在这一过程中意外伤到别人。
author: .izik
source: On nights of a full moon, POKENAME's drills mysteriously begin spinning in reverse on their own. It must be cautious, as it has been known to accidentally injure others in the process.

entry: POKENAME会向飞过蛛网附近的飞行宝可梦发射丝网，抓住放电时机，电击目标。随后便把这顿新鲜大餐拖到地下，与同类分享。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shoots silk nets at flying Pokémon that fly by its web, and shock them once it can secure a zap. It then drags the fresh meal underground where it shares with other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的角由轻巧而耐久的钢构成，能毫不费力地从洞穴中凿出铁。角的这些特性，也让它们成为偷猎者的重点目标。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's horn is made out of a light yet durable steel, allowing them to carve iron out of caverns effortlessly. Due to the properties of their horns, POKENAME are prime targets for poachers.

entry: POKENAME高速旋转头上的角时，尾焰的温度和大小都会提升。它热情无穷，是十分适合年轻、精力充沛的训练家的伙伴。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME spins the horn on its head at high speed, it amplifies both the heat and the size of the flame on its tail. Its boundless enthusiasm makes it a highly recommended partner for young and energetic Trainers.

entry: POKENAME唱歌时，钻头会缓缓顺时针旋转。它的摇篮曲效果强烈，能让任何人立刻入睡。
author: .izik
source: While singing, POKENAME's drill rotates slowly in a clockwise motion. Its lullabies are potent enough to put anyone to sleep instantly.

entry: POKENAME会从洞顶俯冲而下，试图用大角撞击毫无防备的目标。它以各种岩石为食，用强力咬合将其碾成碎石。
author: evilgammon
source: Swooping down from cave ceilings, POKENAME attempts to ram unsuspecting targets with its large horn. Its diet consists of various rocks, which it crushes into loose gravel with its powerful bites.

entry: POKENAME在高大的悬崖顶上筑巢，用强力的角在崖面凿出大裂隙。它领地意识很强，常从高处向闯入者投掷巨石。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME nests atop large cliffs, making large cracks in the cliff face using its powerful horn. It is a very territorial Pokémon and will often lob large boulders at trespassers from above.

entry: POKENAME强劲的双臂，能毫不费力地劈开石头。虽然从不用角战斗，它仍总想把角保养得锋利漂亮。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's powerful arms are powerful enough to effortlessly cleave through stone. Despite never using it in combat, POKENAME always tries to keep its horn nice and sharp.

entry: POKENAME转动鼻端钻头时，会放射出宛如北极光的光束。过去曾因身上镶嵌的红宝石遭到猎捕，如今它依然对人类心存戒备。
author: fiordaliso
source: By spinning its snout drill, POKENAME radiates beams that mimic the aurora borealis. Once hunted because of the rubies embedded in its body, it remains wary of humans.

entry: POKENAME背上长着一朵能够旋转的大蘑菇。战斗时，它会像钻头一样旋转，同时释放灼人的孢子。
author: .izik
source: A large, rotating mushroom grows on POKENAME's back. In combat, it releases blistering spores while spinning like a drill.

entry: POKENAME会用两根棍棒敲角，刺激大脑，增强精神能力。人们认为，这些敲击声是在与另一个存在层面的生灵交流。
author: footlongdingledong
source: POKENAME taps its horn with its two sticks, stimulating its brain and enhancing its psychic abilities. These tapping noises are believed to be it communicating with beings on another plane of existence.

entry: POKENAME生气时，耳朵会冒出浓烟。它会用鼻子上的钻头寻找温泉水源。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME gets angry, it puffs thick smoke from its ears. It uses the drill on its nose to search for hot spring water sources.

entry: POKENAME会被采矿设备的灯光吸引，因此矿工觉得它十分碍事。翅膀上的鳞片其实是细小石片，锋利得能刺穿皮革。
author: mistymagius
source: Miners consider POKENAME a nuisance, as it is drawn to the lights from mining equipment. The scales on its wings are actually small stone shards sharp enough to pierce leather.

entry: POKENAME一转动钻头，眼睛就会变亮，有时甚至会有能量从眼窝溢出。它会开动钻头，从大气层中急冲而下，看看一口气能钻进地下多深。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's eyes grow brighter whenever it spins its drill, sometimes to the point that energy leaks out from the sockets. It rockets down from the atmosphere with its drill active to see how far into the ground it can burrow in one go.

entry: POKENAME以在地下深处挖出复杂隧道闻名。头上的角极其耐久，钻穿山体和金属也不会磨损。它的行动常有损坏城市管道的风险。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is famous for the intricate tunnels it digs deep underground. The horn on its head is so durable it can pierce through mountains and metal without wearing down. Its actions often risk damaging city pipelines.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，会发出响亮的呼噜声，享受用角挡开攻击的交锋。岩石般坚硬的毛发，连最猛烈的攻击都能挡开。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME purrs audibly during battle, enjoying the fight as it parries blows with its horn. Its stone-hard fur deflects even the strongest attacks.

entry: POKENAME旋转额头的钻头时，精神力量也会受到激发。转速达到极限后，它的精神力足以举起并压碎大小是自身三倍的巨石。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's psychic powers are stimulated when it spins the drill on its forehead. At max rotation, it's mind is powered up enough to lift and crush boulders thrice its size.

entry: 一些古老记录表明，POKENAME可能是最早被记载的融合体之一。战斗本能达到顶峰时，鼻子上旋转的角就会开始燃烧。
author: sk372
source: Some old records indicate POKENAME may have been one of the first fusions ever recorded. When its combat instincts flare to maximum, the rotating horn on its nose begins to ignite.

entry: POKENAME会同时锻炼身心，应对战斗中的对手。需要头脑清醒时，它们会嚼一株心灵香草，据说这能帮助理清思绪。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME train both their bodies and minds to deal with opponents in battle. Whenever they require lucid clarity, they chew on a Mental Herb, which is known to help clear the mind.

entry: POKENAME强大的精神力量，能让整场泥石流改道，避开村庄。大风暴来临前，它会冥想，为可能的灾害做好准备。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's immense psychic power allows it to redirect entire mudslides away from villages. It meditates before major storms to prepare for potential disasters.

entry: POKENAME会在雷暴中训练，任由闪电击中角。能量会加快肌肉生长，增强力量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME trains during thunderstorms, letting lightning strike its horn. The energy accelerates muscle growth and boosts its strength.

entry: POKENAME靠拳击洞壁训练。如果落石威胁到它，它便会用钻头般的角在空中将其击碎。
author: .izik
source: To train, POKENAME slams its fists into cave walls. If falling rocks threaten it, it destroys them mid-air using its drill-like horn.

entry: 它在岩浆中涉行，烧制身上的石甲。极少数年老POKENAME的铠甲会变成纯粹的钻石。从未有偷猎者成功夺走过它的铠甲。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It wades in magma to fire its stone armor. Very rarely, an old POKENAME's armor becomes pure diamond. No poacher has ever taken its armor.

entry: POKENAME用头上旋转的角，在岩石海崖上钻孔。这些洞主要用来睡觉，它大多数时间都在海滩上寻找海带吃。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME uses the spinning horn on its head to drill holes into rocky coastal cliffsides. The holes it makes are primarily used for sleeping—it spends most of its time grazing the beach for kelp.

entry: POKENAME会用藤蔓上沉重的叶形石，猎捕从下方经过、毫无防备的猎物。它先猛击头部，将其打昏，再捞起来丢进嘴里，花上一星期慢慢消化。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the heavy leaf-shaped stone on its vine to hunt unwary prey that wanders beneath it. Knocking them out with a blow to the head, it then scoops them up, dropping them into its mouth to digest over the course of a week.

entry: POKENAME用钻头从洞壁凿下页岩，吃掉碎石，让岩石身躯更加坚硬强韧。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its drill to loosen shale from cave walls. It consumes the broken stone to fortify and harden its rocky body.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，钻头偶尔会自行启动。如果陷入噩梦，它就会蜷成球，可能不受控制地滚动起来。
author: .izik
source: While asleep, POKENAME's drill occasionally activates. If caught in a nightmare, it curls into a ball and may roll uncontrollably.

entry: POKENAME常把自己弄得过于激动，体内热量不断积聚，直到炽热如火。它能用旋转的钻角向对手冲撞，迅速取胜。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME tend to work themselves up so much that heat builds up within their bodies until it becomes like fire. They can quickly defeat opponents by charging into them with their spinning horn drills.

entry: POKENAME会把树果串在角状指挥棒上。冬季，它们会吃番荔果，帮助保暖，抵御冰属性捕食者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME skewer berries onto their horn-like baton. During winter, they eat Yache Berries to help keep themselves warm and defend themselves against Ice-type predators.

entry: POKENAME的旋转钻头与冲锋攻击以破坏力闻名，能轻易撕开山坡。作为多头宝可梦，它的三个头相处得相当融洽，会齐心协力，击溃竞争者。
author: pjporwoll
source: The spinning drills and charging attack of POKENAME are renowned for their devastating power, able to shred into a mountainside with ease. The three heads get along well for a multi-headed Pokémon, working in unison to crush its competition.

entry: POKENAME用头上的钻头，在栖身的山中钻行，寻找矿物吃。矿工之后会仔细搜寻这些隧道，寻找它留下的矿石。
author: chibitales
source: Using the drill on its head, POKENAME burrows through the mountains it calls home, looking for minerals to eat. Miners scour these tunnels afterward to find ores that it left behind.

entry: 它背上有一个袋子，用来携带拥有神秘力量的蛋。POKENAME会不惜一切保护蛋的完好。谁靠得太近，它就会从嘴里吹出毒粉，将对方赶走。
author: fiordaliso
source: It has a pouch on its back that allows it to carry an egg with mysterious powers. POKENAME would do anything to protect the egg's integrity. If anyone gets too close, it blows a poisonous powder from its mouth to drive them away.

entry: POKENAME花大部分能量，制造蛋状小颗粒喂养群体。为维持生存，每天要吃100多磅植物。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME expends most of its energy producing tiny egg-like pellets to feed its colony. To sustain itself, it consumes over 100 pounds of plant matter daily.

entry: POKENAME生性体贴，会模仿治愈球，想引来需要帮助的生物。等对方靠近，POKENAME便替它疗伤。
author: lam0u3tt3
source: Guided by its caring nature, POKENAME mimics a Heal Ball in the hopes of capturing the attention of those in need. POKENAME then heals them.

entry: POKENAME能在袋中制造小小的蛋形使魔，每只都充满爆炸能量。遇到烦人的家伙，它就会把蛋扔过去；蛋始终笑眯眯的，直到爆炸那一刻。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can create little egg-shaped familiars in its pouch, each one brimming with explosive energy. It lobs them at nuisances, the eggs smiling all the while until the moment they explode.

entry: POKENAME十分敏锐地感知情绪，周围有人悲伤或疼痛时，它们也会哭泣。骨棒散发着柔和的温暖，许多人说，即使被打到，也觉得很舒缓。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are tuned to emotions quite well, to the extent that they will cry when others near them are sad or are in pain. Their bone clubs exude a gentle warmth that many claim feels soothing, even if struck by them.

entry: POKENAME的唾液药效强大，一接触就能治愈小伤。野生宝可梦受伤时，常会主动找来，信赖它天然的疗伤本领。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's saliva possesses potent medicinal properties, healing minor wounds upon contact. Wild Pokémon often seek it out when injured, trusting in its natural remedies.

entry: 古时候，POKENAME曾为医疗车队服务，载着病人穿越险恶地形。即使环境艰难，坚实的身体也能保障旅途安全。
author: .izik
source: In ancient times, POKENAME served hospital caravans, transporting the sick across harsh terrains. Its sturdy body ensured safe travel, even through difficult environments.

entry: POKENAME能用强力钻头钻穿废墟，救出山体滑坡中的受困者。它会小心控制力量，确保不再伤到他们。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's powerful drill allows it to rescue landslide victims by tunneling through debris. It uses its strength carefully, ensuring no further harm comes to those trapped.

entry: 吉利蛋的自融合体既精通医疗，又能适应长时间轮班，因此常在宝可梦中心工作。
author: tokenoracle
source: Chansey self-fusions are often used in Pokémon Centers due to their ability to cope well with long shifts, in addition to their skills in medicine.

entry: 虽然袋中的蛋通常无法孵化，POKENAME却把它当作亲生孩子。如果蛋被拿走，它会伤心欲绝，尽管过不多久就会再产一枚。
author: pinkyoshi2350
source: While the egg in its pouch is usually unable to hatch, POKENAME treats it like its own child. POKENAME will be heartbroken if its egg is taken, even though it'll produce another one shortly after.

entry: POKENAME会在水下表演精巧华丽的舞蹈，吸引栖身珊瑚礁中伴侣的注意。人们也观察到其他宝可梦欣赏演出的情景，为珊瑚礁带来片刻安宁。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME perform elaborate dances and flourishes underwater to attract the attention of mates across the reefs they call their home. Other Pokémon have been observed enjoying the shows that POKENAME perform, leading to moments of peace on the reef.

entry: POKENAME在空中轻轻飞舞，释放粉末，让接触到的生物放松。这份安抚能帮助宝可梦休息、恢复。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flutters through the air, releasing powder that relaxes anyone it touches. This soothing effect allows Pokémon to rest and recover.

entry: POKENAME生性胆小、容易受惊，会躲在屏障中，让自己和蛋都隐去身形。它只信任有过育儿经历的人，对幼年宝可梦尤其温柔。
author: teatedtiten
source: Because of its timid and skittish nature, POKENAME hides in its barriers to keep its egg and itself invisible. It only trusts those with a parental background and is especially kind to baby Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用锋利的刀刃吓退捕食者，保护弱小宝可梦免受伤害。敏捷的身手，让它成为令人敬畏的守护者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its sharp blades to scare away predators, protecting weak Pokémon from harm. Its swift movements make it a formidable guardian.

entry: POKENAME送出的蛋，尝起来像家中刚煮好的温热水煮蛋。每一口都令人怀念过去，有趣的是，因此每个人尝到的滋味也各不相同。
author: bobosmith01
source: The eggs POKENAME can offer taste like a warm, home-cooked hardboiled egg. It invokes nostalgia in every bite; interestingly, this means the perception of the flavor varies depending on the individual.

entry: POKENAME会用腹部的袋子带着蛋四处走。无论跑得多快、战斗多激烈，蛋都不会破。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME carries eggs around in the pouch on its belly. No matter how fast it runs or how hard it fights, the egg will never break.

entry: 长途海上旅行时，训练家常会骑乘POKENAME。它背上的蛋营养丰富，足以让训练家整个旅途都不愁食物。
author: elibromax314
source: Trainers often travel on POKENAME during long ocean voyages. The eggs on its back provide enough nutrients to keep a Trainer fed throughout the journey.

entry: POKENAME会变成孩子的父母，安慰孩子，直到对方平静下来。等情况稳定，它便恢复原形，悄悄离开。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME transforms into a child's parent, providing comfort until the child calms. Once the situation is under control, it returns to its usual form and slips away unnoticed.

entry: POKENAME对人类情绪十分敏感，因此有时会被交给患有罕见病症或有特殊需求的人陪伴。它们会适应并模仿周围的人，因此有些也会无意间学会跛行或抽动。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME are very sensitive to the emotions of humans, so they're sometimes given to people with rare conditions or special needs. This species adapts to mimic those around them, so these POKENAME tend to develop limps or twitches unintentionally.

entry: POKENAME通过海绵般的鬃毛吸水，再与唾液混合，制成黏液球吐向对手。它们以氏族为单位生活，每个氏族都有一位头领，负责保护、喂养同族。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME absorb water through their spongy mane, mixing the water with saliva to create mucous balls they spit at opponents. POKENAME live in clans where the leader, known as the Alpha, protects and feeds their brethren.

entry: POKENAME能察觉有人不会使用某个程序，便会到网上寻找教程。可惜，找到的结果往往是对方不懂的语言。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME senses when someone struggles with a program and searches for online guides. Unfortunately, the results are often in unfamiliar languages.

entry: 上传到设备或在网络中旅行时，POKENAME就像最先进的杀毒软件，会清除、隔离不受欢迎的文件，或提醒别人留意。连其他多边兽融合体等不受欢迎的宝可梦，也在它的处理范围内。
author: bobosmith01
source: When uploaded to a device or while traveling over the net, POKENAME acts like state-of-the-art antivirus software, purging, confining, or otherwise warning others about unwanted files or even unwanted Pokémon, such as other Porygon fusions.

entry: POKENAME会四处飞行，寻找刚从化石复活的宝可梦，与它们分享自己产下的营养蛋。吃下这些蛋，似乎能帮助它们更快适应现代世界。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME fly around in search of Pokémon that have recently been revived from fossils, then share the nutritious eggs they lay with them. Eating these eggs seems to help these Pokémon adapt to the modern world faster.

entry: 恶劣天气即将来临时，POKENAME会用温和的气息平息天空。风暴中看见它，总令人欣慰，也给受灾者带来希望。
author: .izik
source: When bad weather threatens to strike, POKENAME calms the skies with a gentle aura. Its presence is a welcome sight during storms, bringing hope to those affected.

entry: POKENAME十分温柔善良，乐意把产出的蛋送给需要提振精神的生物。这些蛋对龙属性宝可梦尤其有效，几秒就能让它们完全恢复活力。
author: sk372
source: A very gentle and kind Pokémon, POKENAME is happy to share the eggs it creates with those in need of a pick-me-up. The eggs are particularly effective on Dragon types, revitalizing them completely in seconds.

entry: POKENAME翅膀的内侧带有黏性，两片翅膀能粘在一起，让飞行更快、更持久。它们会追赶不听话或紧张的孩子，迅速而无痛地为他们接种疫苗。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The inner lining of a POKENAME's wings is sticky, allowing two wings to stick together to sustain longer and faster flight. POKENAME chase down unruly or nervous children to quickly and painlessly deliver their vaccinations.

entry: POKENAME无私而善良，会亲自照顾独自留下或被遗弃的宝可梦蛋。据说，被它碰过的蛋，会孵出内心坚强的宝可梦，并健康长大，不受疾病侵扰。
author: pkbonusducks
source: A selfless and kindhearted Pokémon, POKENAME personally cares for Pokémon Eggs that have been left alone or abandoned. It's said that eggs touched by POKENAME will hatch into strong-hearted Pokémon and grow up free of illness.

entry: POKENAME用火烹熟蛋，让其营养极为丰富。可烹饪耗能很大，因此只将蛋送给重伤者。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME cooks its eggs with its flames which makes them incredibly nutritious. It uses a lot of energy to cook them, so POKENAME only gives its eggs to the critically injured.

entry: POKENAME没有攻击性，也不喜欢战斗。有些宝可梦中心会雇用打理得整洁的个体，负责传信和运送特定设备。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are non-aggressive and dislike battling. Some Pokémon Centers employ well-groomed POKENAME as messengers and deliverers for specific equipment.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴能把身体稍稍撑高，略微扩大视野，方便发现需要帮助的受伤宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tail allows it to boost itself up a little to gain a small increase in its sight range. It uses this to better spot injured Pokémon in need of assistance.

entry: 这种宝可梦会定期收集坚果和树果，用丝打包，留着之后喂幼崽。腹部上方的触角似乎能感知情绪上的痛苦，它们常会把同样的食物包送给遇到的痛苦者。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon regularly gather nuts and berries together in bundles of silk that they will later feed to their young. The antennae atop their abdomens seem to sense emotional distress and they will often offer similar bundles to whoever they find.

entry: POKENAME能精确控制电力，用电击恢复人类或宝可梦的心跳，因此很受医疗领域的训练家欢迎。
author: cartoonhostage
source: POKENAME has precise control over its electric power, capable of delivering shocks to restart the hearts of humans and Pokémon. It's a popular partner for Trainers in the medical field.

entry: POKENAME与世界各地的宝可梦中心合作，为与疾病抗争的孩子送去奇迹邮件。它们受过训练，每天送信一次，让孩子在治疗期间每天都有片刻快乐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME delivers Fab Mail to children who are fighting through illnesses in a partnership with Pokémon Centers throughout the world. They are trained to deliver mail once per day to ensure the child has a daily moment of joy during their treatment.

entry: POKENAME产下的蛋，会在一星期内长得比它们自己还大。它们会站在蛋顶上跑动，让蛋滚起来移动；跑得快时，身体便会产生电力。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME lay eggs that grow larger than themselves over the course of a week. They move by running atop these eggs to make them roll; running quickly causes these Pokémon to generate electricity.

entry: 人们常看见POKENAME站在一些人家门外，而这些人在它初次出现后的几天里就会生病。虽然无法预防疾病，它送出的蛋却能提供病人康复所需的营养。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are often seen standing outside the homes of people who fall ill in the days following its initial appearance. Though they cannot prevent the sickness, the eggs they give provide the nutrients the ill people need to help them recover.

entry: POKENAME用电力给手中的蛋补充能量。等蛋可以吃时，头部和尾巴上的圆球就会明亮发光。由于各种蛋都能受到影响，它也被宝可梦中心用来监测孵化情况。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's electricity energizes the egg it holds, and the orbs on its head and tail glow brightly when they are ready to eat. Since this works with all types of eggs, POKENAME has been used in Pokécentres as incubation monitors.

entry: POKENAME只会为明显生病的人行动，在最需要时提供帮助。它的出现，被视为关怀与保护的象征。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME only moves for those who are visibly sick, offering help when needed most. Its presence is seen as a sign of care and protection.

entry: POKENAME相信所有生命都珍贵，会努力治疗生病的水属性宝可梦。它们曾多次登上渔船，试图把鱼放回大海，因此在钓鱼人眼中成了麻烦。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME believe that all life is precious and try to heal sick Water-type Pokémon. There have been many instances of them boarding fishing vessels to try and put fish back into the ocean. This has deemed them a pest among anglers.

entry: 这种POKENAME常出现在宝可梦培育屋附近，偶尔还会纠缠培育家。它喜欢照顾蛋，没有蛋或幼年宝可梦可照料时，就会显得不安。
author: blake
source: This POKENAME is often found near Pokémon daycare centers and occasionally harassing Pokémon breeders. POKENAME loves tending to eggs and seems unsettled when without an egg or baby Pokémon to care for.

entry: 它背上有一个袋子，用来携带拥有神秘力量的蛋。POKENAME会不惜一切保护蛋的完好。谁靠得太近，它就会从嘴里吹出毒粉，将对方赶走。
author: fiordaliso
source: It has a pouch on its back that allows it to carry an egg with mysterious powers. POKENAME would do anything to protect the egg's integrity. If anyone gets too close, it blows a poisonous powder from its mouth to drive them away.

entry: 它背上有一个袋子，用来携带拥有神秘力量的蛋。POKENAME会不惜一切保护蛋的完好。谁靠得太近，它就会从嘴里吹出毒粉，将对方赶走。
author: fiordaliso
source: It has a pouch on its back that allows it to carry an egg with mysterious powers. POKENAME would do anything to protect the egg's integrity. If anyone gets too close, it blows a poisonous powder from its mouth to drive them away.

entry: 古时候，宝可梦中心会用POKENAME的疗愈能力治疗伤口。不过，它的力量已随时间大幅衰减。
author: jackjirachi
source: In ancient times, Pokémon Centers would use POKENAME's healing abilities to mend wounds. However, its power has greatly diminished over time.

entry: 虽然尾巴不能吃，POKENAME却会鼓励别人咬一咬，因为尾巴被咬时能释放有益的养分。有时，尾巴被嚼着还会欢快地细叫，让一些人感到不自在。
author: sk372
source: Though not edible, POKENAME encourages others to chew on its tail, which releases healthy nutrients when bitten. The tail occasionally mewls in delight while being chewed on, which some find disconcerting.

entry: POKENAME全身覆盖厚壳，提供无与伦比的保护。这层坚韧外壳，让它连最严酷的条件都能承受。
author: .izik
source: A thick shell covers POKENAME body, offering unparalleled protection. This durable layer allows it to endure even the harshest conditions.

entry: POKENAME会从上方俯冲，用尾端的蛋形棒槌敲击猎物头部。它力气不算大，却足够坚韧，能一次次重复攻击，直到击倒对手。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will attack prey by swooping down from above and striking them on the head with the egg-shaped club on the end of its tail. POKENAME is not particularly strong, but is tough enough to do this repeatedly until it brings its opponent down.

entry: POKENAME能在山体中钻出隧道，帮助旅人迁往别处。这些通道穿过原本险恶的地带，提供安全路线。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows through mountains, creating tunnels that help travelers relocate. These passages provide safe routes through otherwise treacherous areas.

entry: POKENAME在壳内混合树果汁，调制药效强劲的疗伤饮剂。出色的恢复效果，让这些药剂十分抢手。
author: .izik
source: By mixing berry juices in its shell, POKENAME creates potent healing draughts. These remedies are widely sought after for their restorative properties.

entry: 龙卷风过后，POKENAME会帮助受灾者重建，走出损失的阴影。力量与同情心，让它既能出力帮忙，也能给予情感支持。
author: .izik
source: After tornadoes, POKENAME helps victims rebuild and recover from their losses. Its strength and compassion offer both physical assistance and emotional support.

entry: 不能放心让POKENAME待在蛋旁，连它自己的蛋也不行。只要看见蛋，它就会立刻敲开吞吃。培育屋总会密切盯着它。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME cannot be trusted around eggs, including its own eggs. Any egg in sight is immediately cracked open and devoured. Daycares keep a close eye on POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME经常爬树采集树果。虽然手臂强壮，却也常会掉下来，砸到人们身上。人们将此视为好运的征兆。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME regularly climb into trees to collect berries. While their arms are strong, POKENAME are known to fall and land on people. This is considered a sign of good luck.

entry: POKENAME的形象出现在许多商品中，包括贺卡、毛绒玩具，甚至动画片。这也让人们产生了不少误解，例如以为它们更喜欢独自筑巢，而不是组成家庭。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME are featured on a number of products, including greeting cards, stuffed animals, and even cartoons. This has led to misconceptions about POKENAME, such as their preference for nesting in solitude rather than forming families.

entry: POKENAME乐于助人，带壳的蛋又营养丰富，因此常见于养老院。它会把这些蛋分享给咀嚼困难的老人，确保他们每天摄取足够的营养。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are commonly found in nursing homes because of their helpful temperament and nutrient-rich shell eggs. POKENAME share their shell eggs with elderly folks who struggle with chewing and ensure they receive proper nutrition for the day.

entry: POKENAME会产下营养丰富的蛋，与受伤的人类和宝可梦分享。不过，送蛋时经常粘在触手的吸盘上，一拉下来就裂了。
author: pinkyoshi2350
source: POKENAME lays nutritious eggs and shares them with injured people and Pokémon. However, when it does this, the eggs often get stuck to the suction cups on POKENAME's tentacles and crack when pulled off.

entry: POKENAME母性深厚，经常把成群的幼年水属性宝可梦护在翅膀下，仿佛它们都是自己的孩子。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME has a deep maternal instinct. It frequently spends its time sheltering schools of young Water-type Pokémon under its wings as if they were its own young.

entry: POKENAME有厚甲保护，会俯冲进正在激烈交战的战场，把疗伤的蛋送给伤势最重的生物。
author: mega_beedrill
source: With its thick plating, POKENAME protects itself as it swoops into fierce active battles. It gives healing eggs to those most injured.

entry: 除了乘木筏漂流的遇难海员，几乎没人能遇见野生POKENAME。就在食物快要耗尽时，它们便会出现，分享营养丰富的蛋。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME are rarely encountered by anyone except shipwrecked seafarers floating on rafts. Just as food is beginning to run out, POKENAME will appear to share their nutritious eggs.

entry: POKENAME用长鼻托住蛋，吹一口气便将其抛向空中。蛋看起来容易摔坏，厚壳却很结实，即使失手掉落，也不会破损。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME balances an egg on its trunk, tossing the egg into the air with a puff of breath. Though the egg may seem vulnerable to damage, its thick shell remains intact even if POKENAME drops it.

entry: 许多宝可梦回到巢里，会发现自己的蛋被POKENAME画上了图案。它们的淘气举动，启发了世界各地的许多节庆传统。
author: santon5512
source: Many Pokémon will return to their nests to find that their eggs have been painted by POKENAME. Their antics have inspired many holiday traditions around the world.

entry: POKENAME的毒液不如普通阿柏怪有效，因此主要靠威吓保护蛋。颈部扩张处那诡异的人脸状花纹，通常就足以赶走宝可梦和人类。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME's venom is not as effective as a regular Arbok, so it relies heavily on intimidation to protect its egg. The uncanny, face-like patterns on its hood are usually enough to ward off both Pokémon and people.

entry: 滴进POKENAME袋里的物质，既不是奶，也不是蛋，而是两者的混合物。虽然可以用于烘焙，配方却得相应调整。
author: .jerden
source: The substance that drips into POKENAME's pouch is neither milk nor egg, but a combination of the two. While it can be used for baking, recipes require modification.

entry: POKENAME有时带着的不是蛋，而是一块光滑的灰石。许多人相信，找到这种石头就能交好运。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME occasionally carries a smooth, gray stone instead of an egg. Many believe finding one of these stones will make them lucky.

entry: POKENAME看见有人遇险，就会惊慌地大声呼叫。这能让其他人察觉危机，迅速赶来帮助。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME sees someone in danger, it panics, letting out a loud cry. This call alerts others to the crisis, ensuring help arrives quickly.

entry: POKENAME从电囊放电时，必须小心，别意外电到自己的蛋。否则，蛋可能被烤焦，变得无法食用。
author: soup1900
source: Whenever POKENAME discharges electricity from its electric sacs, it needs to be careful not to accidentally shock its own egg. Otherwise, it may be roasted and become inedible.

entry: 古老民间故事称，吃下POKENAME袋中的蛋，能让人从死亡边缘回来，但食用者会变成一种全新的存在。
author: .realthree
source: Old folktales claim that consuming the egg held in POKENAME's pouch can bring one back from the brink of death, but those who eat it are transformed into something entirely new.

entry: POKENAME会把美味的蛋，送给爱护它家园森林的人。吃下后，人们能看见过去与未来的幻象，有些甚至因此穿越了时间。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME gifts its delicious egg to people who care for the forests of its home. Those who eat it receive visions of the future and past, and some have even traveled through time as a result of eating POKENAME's egg.

entry: 它严厉却充满爱心，对待几乎所有生物，都像慈爱的母亲照顾孩子一样。浅红市发现的一份古文献记载，曾有一只POKENAME不知如何，被用于一种与名字有关的占卜仪式。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is a stern but loving Pokémon that treats nearly everyone with the same care that a healthy mother gives to her child. According to an old document found in Fuschia City, one POKENAME was somehow used in a divination practice that involved names.

entry: POKENAME身上的袋子非常适合孵蛋。它天性狡猾，总想找块形似蛋的石头放在帽子上，用来与捕食者讨价还价，假装达成停战。
author: teatedtiten
source: The pouches on POKENAME are perfect for incubating eggs. Due to its crafty nature, it always aims to collect a similar egg-shaped rock and store it on its hat, used to bargain with predators and fake a truce.

entry: POKENAME会囤积大量偷来的蛋，藏在寒冷的洞穴里。它凶猛地守着藏品，用冰冷的爪子抓向入侵者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME creates an enormous hoard of stolen eggs, keeping them hidden in cold caves. It fiercely defends its stash, swiping at intruders with icy claws.

entry: POKENAME带电的尾巴能释放脉冲，为人类和宝可梦注入活力。人们说，那是一种舒适的酥麻感，能减轻疼痛与疲劳。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's electrically charged tails can pulse to fill people and Pokémon with energy. The sensation this causes has been described as a pleasant tingling that reduces pain and fatigue.

entry: POKENAME天生稀少，却乐观又友善。曾有记录显示，它强力的电击将昏迷者从生死边缘救回。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME possess an upbeat and friendly personality that belies their natural rarity. Their powerful shocks have been recorded to bring the unconscious back from the brink.

entry: 几乎没有比POKENAME更热爱和平的宝可梦。它一边照看袋中的蛋，一边净化空气，希望让未来孵化的宝可梦拥有安全的世界。
author: haypile
source: There are few Pokémon more peace-loving than POKENAME. POKENAME watches over the egg in its pouch while purifying the air, hoping to create a safe world for future Pokémon to hatch into.

entry: POKENAME把蛋放在脸部柔软的毛丛中保护。虽然是温和的大家伙，可一旦发现谁伸手拿蛋，就会挥动獠牙重击。
author: sk372
