source: POKENAME keeps eggs within the soft patch of fur on its face for safekeeping. Though it is a gentle giant, anything caught reaching for the egg gets hit by a mighty swing of its tusks.

entry: POKENAME被称为程序员的守护神，总会突然出现，带来量身定做的软件补丁和错误修复。每当坏掉的程序突然恢复正常，人们就会感谢它。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME are called the patron saints of programmers, appearing suddenly with bespoke software patches and error fixes. Whenever a broken program suddenly works, thanks are given to POKENAME.

entry: 即使睡着，POKENAME背上的种子也会释放各种维生素与矿物微粒。因此，它睡觉的地方总是草木丰茂、生机盎然。
author: bobosmith01
source: Even when POKENAME sleeps, the seeds on its back release particles of all sorts of vitamins and minerals. As a result, the sleeping grounds of POKENAME are extremely lush and healthy.

entry: 即使睡着，POKENAME背上的种子也会释放各种维生素与矿物微粒。因此，它睡觉的地方总是草木丰茂、生机盎然。
author: bobosmith01
source: Even when POKENAME sleeps, the seeds on its back release particles of all sorts of vitamins and minerals. As a result, the sleeping grounds of POKENAME are extremely lush and healthy.

entry: POKENAME携带的蛋能承受高速移动和陡然坠落，几乎不受损伤。厚壳占去了蛋的大部分空间，蛋黄只剩很少一点；据说很难吃，却有益健康。
author: wiz0z
source: Eggs carried by POKENAME are able to endure high speeds and precipitous drops with very little injury. The thick shell takes up most of the egg, leaving very little yolk, which itself is noted as being very unappetizing but healthy.

entry: 虽然平常对人类和其他宝可梦十分友善，POKENAME彼此却很少合得来。本能驱使它们一聚到一起，就要打上一场。
author: wiz0z
source: While normally very kind towards humans and other Pokémon, POKENAME rarely get along amongst themselves. Instinct drives POKENAME to engage in battle whenever they are gathered together.

entry: POKENAME会以优雅的动作起舞，让伙伴放松，重振士气。看过表演的同伴，都会感到安心而精神焕发。
author: .izik
source: With graceful movements, POKENAME performs a dance that relaxes allies and restores morale. Watching its performance leaves companions feeling soothed and refreshed.

entry: POKENAME会被培育屋聘为宝可梦老师。它们帮助幼年宝可梦相互交往，鼓励它们练习分享，以及其他重要的生活技能。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are hired to be teachers for Pokémon at daycare centers. They help baby Pokémon socialize with each other and encourage them to practice sharing, among other vital skills.

entry: POKENAME用一只手臂上的利刃刺击对手，另一只则抱着蛋。培育屋常雇用它们，保护蛋和刚孵化的幼崽，防备小偷。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME jabs opponents with its blade on one arm while cradling an egg with the other. Daycares often employ POKENAME to protect Pokémon eggs and hatchlings from thieves.

entry: POKENAME无声地飘过被洪水淹没的区域，搜寻幸存者并施救。敏捷的身手，让它成为水上应急救援中不可或缺的帮手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats silently through flooded areas, scanning for survivors to rescue. Its agility makes it a vital asset during water-based emergencies.

entry: POKENAME散发温暖、令人安心的光，哄幼年宝可梦与孩子入睡。它性情温和，擅长照顾各种幼儿，因此许多托儿所会请它安抚孩子，兼作小夜灯。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME radiate a warm, comforting light that is used to lure young Pokémon and children to sleep. Many nurseries hire them as both comforters and night lights, as their gentle nature makes them great with all kinds of babies.

entry: POKENAME会在容易发生森林火灾的地区巡逻，遇险时引导其他生物前往安全处。它速度惊人，能从燃烧的区域撤离人类和宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME patrols areas prone to forest fires, guiding others to safety when danger arises. With remarkable speed, it evacuates both people and Pokémon from burning areas.

entry: POKENAME会收养被遗弃的宝可梦蛋，照料到孵化。大家知道蛋在它身边十分安全，因此完全信任它。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME takes abandoned Pokémon eggs under its care, nurturing them until they hatch. Others trust it completely, knowing the eggs are safe.

entry: POKENAME极其害羞，只有察觉到有人受伤才会靠近。紧急关头，胆怯便会消失，它会迅速展开救护。
author: .izik
source: Extremely shy, POKENAME only approaches when it senses someone is hurt. Its timidity disappears in emergencies, when it provides swift care.

entry: POKENAME能在几分钟内治好任何宝可梦，作为移动宝可梦中心越来越受欢迎。可这极其耗能，自己也需要持续照料。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME have grown in popularity as portable Pokémon Centers, able to heal any Pokémon within minutes. Due to the massive energy required, they need constant care.

entry: POKENAME通常用触须围住蛋，紧紧护着。只有在信任的对象身旁，它才会放下触须。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME typically keeps its tendrils closed around its egg. It will only lower its tendrils around someone it trusts.

entry: POKENAME凭借庞大体形与纯粹力量，占据战斗优势。沙鳞果能额外刺激肾上腺素，让它保持迅速灵活，直到获胜。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's sheer bulk and raw strength give it an edge in battle. A Salac Berry gives it an extra kick of adrenaline to stay fast and limber until it achieves victory.

entry: POKENAME能察觉大地的变化，在地震发生前预知。当地人信任它的警告，每逢它出现，就会做好准备。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME senses shifts in the earth, predicting earthquakes before they occur. Locals trust its warnings and prepare whenever it appears.

entry: 许多住院病人说，自己曾在深夜醒来，发现POKENAME守在床边。据说，它的探望会带来健康，帮助早日康复，其中最常得到探望的是孩子。
author: santon5512
source: Many hospital patients have reported waking up to find POKENAME by their bedside in the dead of night. It is said that a visit from these Pokémon brings good health and a speedy recovery, with children being visited the most.

entry: POKENAME被视为最出色的照料者，爱心与善意几乎无穷无尽。据说，它能用神圣能量显化出1000条手臂，照顾大群需要帮助的生物。
author: sk372
source: Considered the ultimate caretaker, POKENAME's love and kindness is near infinite. It's said it could manifest 1000 arms made of divine energy in order to take care of throngs of creatures in need.

entry: POKENAME坚硬的外壳，来自出生时残留的蛋壳。遇到野外生病的宝可梦，它便会细心照料。
author: melodydelune
source: The harden shell of POKENAME is formed from the remnants of the egg it was hatched from. It's known to nurse sick Pokémon it finds in the wild.

entry: POKENAME背上有一座迷你宝可梦中心。虽然小得只有体形最小的宝可梦才能探进里面，储存其中的蛋却能治愈任何伤势。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has a miniature Pokémon Center on its back. Although it is too small for anything but the smallest of Pokémon to reach inside, the eggs stored within can heal any injury.

entry: POKENAME十分自负，自认照料本领最出众。两只一旦相遇，就会立刻比试，看看谁照顾得更好、蛋的品质更佳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very prideful, believing itself to be the most skilled caretaker. If two POKENAME meet, they will immediately compete to see who has the better care techniques and better quality eggs.

entry: 刀刃轻轻划过，小伤小病就能痊愈。可贪图利益的人纷纷想抓走POKENAME，如今，它也越来越罕见。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: When its blade is lightly run across a minor wound or ailment, it is healed. Attempts to kidnap POKENAME for profit has made its presence rare.

entry: POKENAME蛋的壳坚硬如铁，蛋中却满是养分。它若肯让你尝上一口，就代表深深的信任与尊重。
author: footlongdingledong
source: The shell of a POKENAME egg is as hard as iron, yet packed to the brim with nutrients. If it lets you have a taste of one, it's a sign of deep trust and respect.

entry: POKENAME体内流淌着两种不同的液体：防身的毒液，以及疗伤的药膏。它会按需要使用，既能救治，也能守护。
author: .izik
source: Two distinct liquids flow within POKENAME's body: venom for defense and a healing ointment. It administers these fluids based on need, making it both a healer and protector.

entry: POKENAME会训练其他宝可梦，教它们救援、照顾受伤或受困的旅人。它是严厉的教官，谁不认真听讲，就可能受到痛苦的惩罚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME trains other Pokémon in the art of rescue and care of wounded and stranded travelers. A strict instructor, any who aren't paying sufficient attention risk a painful punishment.

entry: POKENAME受到多数宝可梦的尊敬，拥有能察觉伤势的第六感。一旦感知到伤口，它就会飞上天空，毫不耽搁地前去治疗。
author: ghostslythe
source: Respected by most species of Pokémon, POKENAME has a sixth sense detecting injuries. When one is sensed, it takes to the skies and treats the wound without delay.

entry: 它们会自己产蛋，偶尔也从其他物种那里借一枚。虽然看起来有些淘气，POKENAME却心怀善意，会把蛋当礼物，送给珍视的对象。
author: salt
source: They produce their eggs but will occasionally borrow one from other species. Although they seem mischievous, POKENAME means well; they offer eggs as gifts to those they cherish.

entry: POKENAME心怀怜悯，是医护人员的好伙伴。手术时，它还能用飘带，把器械递给外科医生。
author: melodydelune
source: Its compassionate nature makes POKENAME an excellent partner for medical professionals. They assist surgeons by handing them tools with their ribbons.

entry: POKENAME会与尼多一族分享有益健康的蛋，却不欢迎外人。其他生物若想拿蛋，它就会挥动强力的尾巴，一下将其打飞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME shares healthy eggs with members of the Nidoran family, but outsiders are not appreciated. Any other creature that tries to take its egg will be sent flying with one swing of its mighty tail.

entry: POKENAME把蛋紧紧护在身旁，攀登月见山，寻找适合筑巢的地方。日光渐暗、夜幕降临时，它们便会扎营，仰望夜空休息。
author: quackquackattack
source: With eggs nestled close to their bodies, POKENAME scale Mount Moon to find a suitable spot to create nests. As daylight dwindles and nightfall comes, they set up camp and rest as they gaze into the night sky.

entry: 遇到危险时，POKENAME会释放安抚性的孢子，让敌友双方都平静下来。孢子营造出宁静的氛围，化解紧张局面。
author: .izik
source: When danger arises, POKENAME releases calming spores to pacify both friends and foes. The spores create a serene atmosphere, defusing tense situations.

entry: 据说，有POKENAME照料的蛋，能孵出健康强壮的宝可梦，因此，它很受培育家的欢迎。
author: jackythewannabe
source: It is said that an egg watched over by POKENAME will hatch into a strong, healthy Pokémon. This makes them popular among breeders.

entry: POKENAME会用美味的蛋，说服成群的捕食性宝可梦接纳自己。虽然不善战，它们仍会在共同觅食时照顾伙伴。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME use their delicious eggs to persuade gangs of predatory Pokémon to let them join. Although POKENAME are not formidable fighters, they take care of their allies as they hunt for food together.

entry: POKENAME会把蛋交给进入其墓穴的人，作为考验。小心而温柔对待蛋的人，会得到它护送通过通道；把蛋丢在一旁的人，则会遭到攻击。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME gives eggs to those who enter the tombs it resides in as a test. People who treat the egg carefully and with kindness are escorted through the passages, and those who throw the egg aside are attacked.

entry: POKENAME头顶有一道凹槽，可以放蛋，由体内燃烧的火焰温热。有些批评者声称，它会吸取蛋的生命精华，让幼崽孵出后虚弱多病，但这并没有证据。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a slot atop its head for eggs to be placed on, which are warmed up by the flame burning within it. Some detractors say it siphons life essence from the eggs, making them hatch weak and sickly, but this is unsubstantiated.

entry: POKENAME在古墓中巡逻，寻找迷路受伤的探险者。找到后，它就会提供帮助，引导他们返回安全处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME patrols ancient tombs, searching for injured explorers who have lost their way. Once they are found, it provides aid and guides them back to safety.

entry: POKENAME会被极度痛苦的人发出的声音吸引。如果发现身体有伤，它就会进行治疗。等对方身体康复，它再送上袋中的蛋。
author: sleepyman0731
source: POKENAME is drawn to the sounds of people in great misery. If it finds any physical injuries, it will heal the person. Once the person is physically healthy, POKENAME will offer eggs from its pouch.

entry: POKENAME偶尔会产下营养丰富的蛋，最多每隔一天产一枚。爬行时，它把蛋夹在一条手臂下；由于走得极慢，从来不用担心蛋会摔破。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME occasionally lays nutritious eggs, no more often than once every other day. It carries its egg underneath one arm as it crawls, moving so slowly that there is never any risk of it breaking.

entry: POKENAME偶尔会产下营养丰富的蛋，最多每隔一天产一枚。爬行时，它把蛋夹在一条手臂下；由于走得极慢，从来不用担心蛋会摔破。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME occasionally lays nutritious eggs, no more often than once every other day. It carries its egg underneath one arm as it crawls, moving so slowly that there is never any risk of it breaking.

entry: POKENAME会为虚弱的宝可梦收集食物，确保它们吃得足够，好恢复身体。它不知疲倦地付出，在宝可梦群体中备受喜爱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers food for weak Pokémon, ensuring they have enough to recover. Its tireless efforts make it a beloved member of the Pokémon community.

entry: POKENAME会把蛋塞进脂肪形成的袋中，既保护又保温。海里的宝可梦受伤后，它也会悉心照料，直到康复。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME protects its egg by stuffing it into a pocket of blubber, which keeps the egg warm. It is also known to nurse Pokémon at sea back to health after they get hurt.

entry: POKENAME天生喜欢照顾别人，是出色的保姆。到了睡觉时间，它会轻唱摇篮曲，先让孩子产生倦意，再哄他们上床。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME make great babysitters because of their natural instinct to take care of others. At bedtime, POKENAME sing a soft lullaby to make the children tired before putting them to bed.

entry: POKENAME会不知疲倦地寻找雪崩受困者，用力量施以援手。它在雪地救援中，发挥着关键作用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME searches tirelessly for avalanche victims, using its strength to provide aid. This Pokémon plays a crucial role in rescue efforts in snowy regions.

entry: POKENAME会睡在旅人的帐篷附近，守护他们的安全。对在星空下休息的人来说，它安静的陪伴令人安心。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps near travelers' tents, keeping watch to ensure their safety. Its quiet presence offers comfort to those resting under the stars.

entry: 虽然POKENAME没有恶意，古怪的举动却常被误解。有人受伤时，它会先递上一块蛋形石头，逗对方笑，安抚情绪上的创伤，然后才送出具有疗伤力量的蛋。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although POKENAME means no harm, its odd behavior is often misunderstood. If someone is hurt, it first gives them an egg-shaped rock to make them laugh and soothe emotional wounds before offering an egg with healing powers.

entry: POKENAME会轻声唱歌，安抚难过的孩子，让他们重新露出笑容。它的摇篮曲以能抚平最不安的心灵而闻名。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sings softly to calm sad children, bringing smiles back to their faces. Its lullabies are known to soothe even the most restless hearts.

entry: POKENAME头顶带着一个蛋状花苞，十分小心地保护着。为了不让来犯者夺走这枚“蛋”，它会释放有毒气味，再躲起来。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME carries an egg-like bulb on its head, which it guards carefully. In order to avoid attackers from taking its egg it releases a toxic scent and hides.

entry: 虽然能飘到高空，POKENAME却绝不会冒险迎向可能危及蛋的强风。它会小心调整路线，确保飞得平稳顺畅。
author: ilija09
source: Though capable of floating high above the ground, POKENAME never risks strong winds that could endanger its egg. It carefully adjusts its path to ensure a smooth and stable flight.

entry: POKENAME照料的蛋营养极其丰富，人们推测它有美味的黄油香。不过，始终没人弄清，怎样才能从它的凝胶中把蛋取出来。
author: .realthree
source: The egg that POKENAME tends is incredibly rich in nutrients and is theorized to have a delicious, buttery flavor. However, nobody has ever figured out how to extract the egg from POKENAME's gel.

entry: POKENAME会附在吉利蛋的蛋上，等吉利蛋睡着，再偷走蛋逃跑。它会一连数小时坐在蛋上，期待它孵化。
author: beetlething
source: POKENAME will attach itself to a Chansey's egg, waiting for the Chansey to fall asleep before it steals the egg and runs off with it. POKENAME will sit on this egg for hours at a time, expecting it to hatch.

entry: POKENAME身上棘刺渗出的黄色液体，具有药效。涂在擦伤或小割伤上，伤口就会很快愈合。
author: .izik
source: The yellow liquid that leaks from the barbs on POKENAME's body is medicinal. When applied to a scrape or minor cut, the injury will heal quickly.

entry: 泥石流发生时，POKENAME会以无比坚定的意志救出受困者。它能轻松穿过不稳的地形，总能找到通往安全处的路。
author: .izik
source: During mudslides, POKENAME rescues trapped people with unmatched determination. It navigates unstable terrain with ease, always finding a way to safety.

entry: POKENAME的毒液经过熬煮浓缩，可以用来治疗恶心，成为医药界意想不到的帮手。只要仔细处理，毒液便能化作救命的良药。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's venom can be boiled down and used to cure nausea, making it an unexpected ally in medicine. Careful preparation ensures the venom becomes a life-saving remedy.

entry: 为了应付不听话的宝可梦，POKENAME会用前方的众多爪子将它们抓住。爪子会释放安抚物质，使对方麻木，变得更容易管教。
author: sk372
source: To deal with unruly Pokémon, POKENAME grips them with the many claws on its front. The claws deliver a calming substance that numbs the Pokémon, making them much easier to deal with.

entry: POKENAME用携带的蛋探测周围的生命。据说，它若把蛋送给一对伴侣，对方很快就会有孩子。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME uses the egg it carries to detect life in its surroundings. It is said that if this Pokémon gives the egg to any couple, they will soon have children.

entry: POKENAME分泌的黏液可制成抗真菌药膏，已被证实能有效治疗感染。这种天然药物，很受宝可梦治疗者喜爱。
author: .izik
source: The slime POKENAME secretes is used in anti-fungal ointments, which has proved effective in treating infections. This natural remedy is a favorite among Pokémon healers.

entry: POKENAME口中分泌的黏液营养丰富，常被混入供住院病人使用的生理盐水，加快康复。在野外，它也常照顾年幼宝可梦，直到它们能够独立生活。
author: chibitales
source: The goo secreted from POKENAME's mouth is very nutritious, often being mixed into saline solutions given to hospital patients to speed recovery. In the wild, it often cares for younger Pokémon until they are ready to fend for themselves.

entry: POKENAME内心善良，身体也结实强健。宝可梦中心会雇用它维持秩序，用强壮、能伸长的四肢，把闹事者压住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses a kind heart as well as a solid and robust body. It gets employed by Pokémon Centers to defend them from those who would get unruly, pinning the perpetrators down with its strong, extendable limbs.

entry: POKENAME每到一处，都会四处搜寻需要治疗的受伤宝可梦。它能从身体发出巨大的激光束，只要被光束完全笼罩，一切伤势都能痊愈。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME scours all over in any place it goes through in search of injured Pokémon to heal. It blasts a gigantic laser beam from its body that will fully heal all injuries one may have when completely enveloped by the beam.

entry: POKENAME会不知疲倦地寻找迷路的孩子，将他们稳稳抱在怀里。再荒蛮的环境，也无法阻止它展开救援。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME searches tirelessly for lost children, cradling them safely in its arms. Even the wildest environments cannot deter it from its rescue efforts.

entry: POKENAME小心照料头顶的蛋。若有什么想吃掉它的蛋，它就会用触须上的刺细胞反击，造成疼痛的螫刺。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME carefully nurtures the egg resting on its head. If anything tries to eat its egg, it will retaliate using the nematocytes in its tendrils for a painful sting.

entry: POKENAME释放的孢子能缓解疲劳，让附近的生物重新振作。天然的提神效果，让它们在疲倦时很受欢迎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases spores that relieve exhaustion, re-energizing anyone nearby. The spores are a natural pick-me-up, sought after in times of fatigue.

entry: POKENAME会保护其他宝可梦的蛋，却在过程中吸取养分。结果，孵出的幼崽会虚弱多病。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME protects the eggs of other Pokémon, siphoning nutrients from them in the process. When the egg hatches, the baby is sickly and weak as a result.

entry: POKENAME长尾上像蛋的部分完全中空，因此十分脆弱。如果破损，它就会头晕，昏倒几小时，直到重新长好；这段时间里，它会暂时失去防备。
author: .izik
source: The egg-like portion of POKENAME's long tail is completely hollow, thus rendering it fragile. If broken, it becomes dizzy and passes out for a few hours until it regrows, leaving it vulnerable for a short period.

entry: POKENAME擅长团队合作，既是坚定的守护者，似乎也很善于交流。战斗时，它会以温和的态度指挥、支援同伴。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME possesses great teamwork skills, being a stalwart protector and, seemingly, a fluent communicator. In battle, it will direct and support its allies with a gentle demeanor.

entry: POKENAME在壳内煮熟的蛋，被视为珍稀美味。每个尝过的人都一致认为，那种滋味在别处绝不可能重现。
author: bostroms
source: The eggs that POKENAMEcooks within its shell are considered rare delicacies.  Everyone who has tasted one agrees that the flavor cannot be replicated anywhere else.

entry: POKENAME把珍贵的蛋放在松垮宽大的皮肤里，时刻保温。一旦受威胁，它就会展现出惊人的凶猛，奋力护蛋。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME carries its precious eggs inside its loose, baggy skin, keeping them warm at all times. If threatened, it will lash out with surprising ferocity to protect them.

entry: POKENAME充满爱心，喜欢把蛋紧贴在身上。据说，体温能帮助蛋更快发育，但这尚未得到证实。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are loving creatures that enjoy keeping eggs pressed against their body. It is said that their body heat helps eggs grow faster, though this has yet to be confirmed.

entry: 没人知道POKENAME埋在地下的那一半长什么样。它只露出上半身，看起来像一枚蛋。为了避开捕食者，它会藏进其他宝可梦的巢，混在蛋中。
author: heal_fire
source: Nobody knows what POKENAME's buried half looks like. This Pokémon only shows the top part of its body, which make itself looks like an egg. In order to avoid predators, it hides in other Pokémon's nests among their eggs.

entry: POKENAME挖洞时，能通过细微振动察觉附近的痛苦。它会在地下小心运送药草，交给需要帮助的生物。
author: .izik
source: While digging, POKENAME can sense nearby pain through subtle vibrations. It will carefully transport medicinal herbs underground to those in need.

entry: 无论健康还是财富，POKENAME都被视为好运与兴旺的象征。因此，有几家诊所将它选为吉祥物。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is considered a symbol of good luck in prosperity, both in health and in wealth. Several clinics have POKENAME as their mascot as a result.

entry: POKENAME会潜入医生的诊所，偷药治疗受伤的野生宝可梦。虽然是小偷，却备受受助者敬重。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sneaks into doctors' offices, stealing medicine to treat injured wild Pokémon. Though a thief, it is revered by those it helps.

entry: 虽然外表友善，它实际上极具攻击性，一受刺激就会迅速破坏周围。不过，对自己的蛋，它倒会悉心照料。
author: zaymcawesome
source: Despite its friendly-looking appearance, it is actually extremely aggressive, rapidly destroying things if triggered. However, when it comes to its eggs, it takes good care of them.

entry: POKENAME会仔细看守其他宝可梦的巢。父母不在时，它们把蛋含在嘴里保护。如果觉得巢有危险，就会叼起蛋，飞奔过原野，送往安全处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME watch carefully over the nests of other Pokémon, keeping guard of the eggs within their mouth in the absence of the parents. If they feel the nest is in danger, they pick up the eggs and race across the landscape to take them somewhere safe.

entry: POKENAME温暖的嘴里，温度恰好适合孵蛋，因此它常把蛋含在口中。偶尔需要进食时，谁要趁机偷蛋，就会迎来烈火般的闪焰冲锋。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a warm mouth that is the perfect temperature for incubating eggs, which is why it often keeps eggs in its mouth. On the rare occasions that it needs to eat, any attempts to steal the egg are met with a fiery Flare Blitz.

entry: POKENAME只生活在高高的山峰上，十分少见。它富有同情心，会出现在迷路的探险者面前，分享美味的蛋，并引导他们返回安全处。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is a rare sight, as it is only seen living on high mountain peaks. A compassionate Pokémon, it appears to lost explorers, sharing its delicious eggs and helping guide them back to safety.

entry: POKENAME极富共情能力，心中充满积极的情感与照顾他人的愿望。这份强烈的心意，化作巨大的精神力量，主要用来保护其他生物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A highly empathic Pokémon, POKENAME overflows with positive emotion and the desire to look after others. The sheer strength of this feeling manifests as immense psychic power, primarily used to defend others.

entry: POKENAME会进入梦境，温柔地疏导情绪，抚平烦乱的心。它的出现，让熟睡者感到清爽而安宁。
author: .izik
source: By entering dreams, POKENAME provides gentle therapy, easing troubled minds. Its presence leaves sleepers feeling refreshed and at peace.

entry: POKENAME拥有惊人的智慧与共情能力，与训练家之间建立着极为忠诚的羁绊。精神力量消耗的能量很大，它会用营养丰富的蛋来补充。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME possesses incredible intellect and empathic power; the bond it forms with its Trainer is one of intense loyalty. The energy expenditure of its psychic powers is huge; it fuels its powers with highly nutritious eggs.

entry: POKENAME拥有惊人的智慧与共情能力，与训练家之间建立着极为忠诚的羁绊。精神力量消耗的能量很大，它会用营养丰富的蛋来补充。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME possesses incredible intellect and empathic power; the bond it forms with its Trainer is one of intense loyalty. The energy expenditure of its psychic powers is huge; it fuels its powers with highly nutritious eggs.

entry: POKENAME心地极其善良，总乐意用力量帮助别人。任务越费体力，它就越兴奋，迫不及待地开始。
author: .jerden
source: Incredibly kind-hearted, POKENAME is always willing to use its strength to help others. The more physically demanding the task, the more excited it is to begin.

entry: POKENAME会用巨大力量建造宝可梦中心和医院，让社区拥有疗伤治病的地方。它尽心尽力，是任何施工队都不可缺少的成员。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its immense strength to build Pokémon Centers and hospitals, ensuring communities have places to heal. Its dedication makes it an essential part of any construction team.

entry: POKENAME总带着一枚巨大的蛋，以此锻炼双臂。如果蛋裂了，它就会在次日早晨换一枚。没人知道这些蛋从哪里来。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME exercises its arms by always carrying around an egg of immense size, replacing it the next morning if it cracks. Nobody knows where it gets them from.

entry: POKENAME遵循严格的训练计划，每天必须吃四枚宝可梦蛋。如果无法坚持这种饮食，它就会开始丧失斗志。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME follows a strict training regimen that requires it to eat four Pokémon eggs every day. If it cannot keep to this diet, it begins to lose its will to fight.

entry: POKENAME的蛋富含蛋白质，被当作健身前餐食的重要食材。它关心人们的营养需要，很乐意提供蛋，主要送给锻炼前需要补充能量的人。
author: content_explosive
source: POKENAME's eggs are so high in protein that they are used as a key ingredient in pre-workout meals. POKENAME is happy to provide their eggs out of care for your nutrient needs, as the eggs are mainly given to those who need a boost before a workout.

entry: POKENAME十分体贴，总顾及别人的需要。它会带着被遗弃的蛋，遇袭时低头缩身，用壳承受攻击，保护它们。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are thoughtful creatures that always think about the needs of others. They protect abandoned eggs they carry by ducking and allowing their shell to absorb attacks.

entry: POKENAME会在体内生成蛋，再反吐出来，送给其他宝可梦换取食物。蛋的酸味，在合众一些乡村地区很受欢迎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME creates and regurgitates eggs from within its body to offer other Pokémon in exchange for food. The tart taste of the eggs is popular in some rural regions of Unova.

entry: 如果你在河边陪伴POKENAME，它就会为你下一枚美味的蛋。只有受到善待时，它才肯产蛋，因此想规模饲养取蛋很不现实。
author: bandedbodypress
source: If you accompany a POKENAME while it's along the riverside, it will lay a delicious egg for you. POKENAME will only lay eggs when treated with kindness, so farming them is very impractical.

entry: POKENAME是温柔可爱的小家伙，喜欢带着蛋一起泡在水里。它们会发出叫声和咿呀声，仿佛在与蛋说话。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are sweet little creatures that enjoy spending time in water with their egg. They make cries and babbles as though they were speaking to the egg.

entry: 融合让POKENAME的尾巴带上浓浓的蛋味，营养密度也变得更高。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Fusion has caused POKENAME's tail to taste strongly of egg. On top of that, it's even more nutritionally dense.

entry: POKENAME的每颗头都有分工。一颗头仔细警戒，其他头则负责照顾蛋。
author: dodoowner_
source: Each of POKENAME's heads have a job. One head carefully keeps watch and the others take care of its eggs.

entry: POKENAME会在海绵般的鬃毛里储存黏稠毒液，把毛染成紫色。战斗时，它们会冲撞对手，挤压鬃毛，让毒液流出，使敌人中毒。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME store a slimy, poisonous mucus in their spongey manes, which turns the hairs purple. During battle, they ram into the opponent, squeezing their manes to release this substance and poison the foe.

entry: POKENAME携带的蛋营养丰富，里面却呈果冻状，带着海鲜味。蛋壳与头上的尖角都由冰构成，美食家说，这种蛋最好冷着吃。
author: .jerden
source: The egg that POKENAME carries is highly nutritious, but its contents are jelly-like and taste of seafood. Both the eggshell and the spiky horn on POKENAME's head are made of ice, and gourmets claim that its egg is best served cold.

entry: 宝可梦父母有时会请POKENAME帮忙，照看不听话的孩子。它很擅长安抚孩子，哄他们入睡，让孩子和父母都能享受安静的午睡时光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is sometimes called to assist parent Pokémon with their unruly children. It is quite capable of calming them and lulling them to sleep, giving the child and the parents both the peace of a quiet naptime.

entry: 年幼时，POKENAME会尽可能把藤蔓长长，为进化做准备。如果失去藤蔓，它能延缓进化，却要为此耗费大量能量。
author: yang_dechi
source: While it is young, POKENAME grows its vines as long as it can in preparation for evolution. Upon losing vines, it can delay its evolution at the severe cost of energy.

entry: POKENAME全身藤蔓般的毛发，其实非常坚韧，连比比鸟的啄击也能挡住。遇险需要逃跑时，它还会借助这些藤蔓，从一棵树荡向另一棵树。
author: mistymagius
source: The vine-like hairs that coat POKENAME are actually quite tough and are able to resist the pecks of a Pidgeotto. It will also use the vines to swing from tree to tree if it needs to escape from danger.

entry: POKENAME的各个部分会聚成一团，将身体半埋进土里，伪装成藤蔓缠绕的灌木。每个部分都富含养分，因此有人会采收它的藤蔓作食物。
author: bobosmith01
source: Each part of POKENAME clusters together and buries itself partway into the ground to disguise itself as a vine-laden bush. Every part of them is rich in nutrients, so some harvest POKENAME's vines for food.

entry: POKENAME扭动的触须密集地围在头部周围。收到零食后，它们会将其分成小块，平均送进许多张嘴里。只需几秒，零食便全进了肚子。
author: quackquackattack
source: The writhing tentacles of POKENAME are clustered together around their heads. When given a treat, it is broken up into small parts that they distribute evenly among their many mouths. In a matter of seconds, the treat disappears into their stomachs.

entry: 这团奇怪的触须，寄生在一只不幸的嘎啦嘎啦的骨骼中。它偶尔会把触须变成近似卡拉卡拉身体的形状，却无法维持太久。
author: sk372
source: A strange mass of tendrils that infests the bones of an unfortunate Marowak. It occasionally shifts its tentacles into a shape resembling the body of Cubone, but is unable to hold that form for long.

entry: POKENAME嘴里红色的藤蔓，每条都能当作独立的舌头。它能同时抓取、品尝多样东西，探索数不尽的滋味组合。
author: sk372
source: The reddish vines from its mouth all operate as individual tongues of POKENAME. This means it can grab and taste several things at once, and discover untold amounts of flavor combinations.

entry: POKENAME出生后的第一个月，会用酸性分泌物仔细蚀刻岩石，雕出外壳。溶解的岩石提供养分，让它维生，直到藤蔓长得足以缠住猎物。
author: alumed
source: POKENAME spends the first month of its life meticulously carving its shell out of rock using an acidic secretion. The dissolved rock provides enough nutrients to sustain it until its vines are long enough to ensnare prey.

entry: POKENAME爱恶作剧，喜欢骗别人和宝可梦拉扯自己的藤蔓。一条藤蔓被彻底扯断，原处就会再长一条。它们似乎很享受藤蔓被扯下的感觉。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME are mischievous creatures that love tricking people and Pokémon into pulling on their vines. When one of their vines is completely torn off, another one grows in its place. POKENAME seem to enjoy the sensation of having their vines torn off.

entry: POKENAME会用众多藤蔓，不停轻抚袋中的孩子。如果打不过来犯者，它会扯断几条藤蔓丢在一旁，用蠕动的断藤分散注意，反正触须很快就能再生。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME constantly caresses the child in its pouch with its many vines. If it is unable to fight off an attacker, it will break off some of its own vines and throw them aside as a wriggling distraction, since these tendrils quickly grow back.

entry: POKENAME毛发般的藤蔓，会缠绕在一条触须上，把海藻碎片送进嘴里。它们十分怕痒，藤蔓周围尤其敏感。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have hair-like vines that are wrapped around one of their tentacles and bring pieces of seaweed to their mouths. They are incredibly ticklish, especially around their vines.

entry: 比起一般的默剧模仿，POKENAME更喜欢手影艺术。它能操控藤蔓，配合手臂变出不同形状，演出精彩的影子戏。
author: sk372
source: Rather than normal miming, POKENAME enjoys the art of shadow puppetry. It can manipulate its vines to form varying shapes with its arms, and make quite a spectacle of shadows.

entry: 虽然末端尖尖的，POKENAME的藤蔓却不算锋利，不适合刺伤或切割敌人。把卷曲的藤蔓展开，出其不意地缠住、勒紧对手，反而有效得多。
author: sk372
source: Though pointed at the ends, POKENAME's vines aren't particularly sharp and thus aren't well-suited for stabbing or cutting foes. It's much more effective unraveling their coiled shape and using them to surprise and constrict them instead.

entry: POKENAME总被自己众多的藤蔓缠住，苦苦挣扎。结果，除了无助地扑腾，它几乎什么也做不了。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME struggles because it is constantly tangled up in its many vines. As a result, it cannot do much other than flop about helplessly.

entry: POKENAME仿佛一团无穷无尽、不断扭动的藤蔓。触及范围内的一切，都会被藤蔓抓住、扯倒，所过之处满目疮痍。
author: foolish_weasel
source: A seemingly never-ending tangle of writhing vines, POKENAME leaves a trail of destruction in its wake as its vines grasp and tear down all things that are within reach.

entry: POKENAME能模仿藤蔓碰到的一切，将记忆储存在纠缠的身体中。不过，只要打一个喷嚏，幻象就会瞬间破灭。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can mimic anything its vines touch, storing the memory within its tangled body. A single sneeze, however, shatters the illusion in an instant.

entry: POKENAME会放出代码构成的藤蔓，缠绕对手。任何一条被切断，对应的那部分代码就会永远丢失。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME unleash vines made out of code to wrap around their opponents. If one of these vines is severed, they lose that part of their code forever.

entry: 逃离捕食者时，POKENAME会在身后摇动藤蔓，引诱对方咬住能够脱落的一条。捕食者很快便会带着味道像黑莓的藤蔓离开。
author: quackquackattack
source: When escaping from predators, POKENAME's vines sway behind itself to encourage predators to take a bite of a detachable vine. The predator runs off with a vine shortly thereafter, which tastes like a blackberry.

entry: 面对捕食者，POKENAME会用藤蔓藏住毒针，伺机刺一下，再转身逃跑。有些采蜜人受过训练，会取出它的液态毒液用于烹饪，因为味道像黑莓。
author: quackquackattack
source: When confronted with predators, POKENAME's vines conceal its stinger and jabs at an opportunistic moment before running away. Certain honey gatherers are trained to drain its liquid venom from it for culinary purposes, as it tastes like blackberries.

entry: POKENAME会伸展开覆盖身体的藤蔓，让自己看起来更大，吓唬遇到的生物。每条藤蔓都含有少量精神能量，断落后仍会浮在空中蠕动，直到能量耗尽。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME extends out the vines covering its body to make itself look bigger and surprise those it comes across. Each vine contains a modicum of psychic energy; if severed they will levitate in air and wriggle about until the energy fades.

entry: 与其说POKENAME在飞，不如说它用组成翼状结构的藤蔓，在树间荡动，将自己弹出去。因此，它通常待在林地，好迅速逃离捕食者。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME doesn't fly so much as use the vines composing its wing-like structures to catapult itself by swinging from tree to tree. As such, it normally keeps to wooded areas to quickly escape predators.

entry: 人们几乎从没见过POKENAME用脚站立。它们总是靠尾巴蹦跳，万一滑倒，就用藤蔓稳住身体。传闻它们的尾巴，其实是一条贯穿全身的巨大藤蔓。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are almost never seen standing on their feet. Instead, they hop about on their tails, using their vines to steady themselves should they ever slip. It is rumored that a POKENAME's tail is one large vine that runs through their whole body.

entry: POKENAME观察周围时大多纹丝不动。察觉敌意后，它能朝任意方向伸出藤蔓，束缚威胁。无论等多久，它都愿意一直等到对手平静。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME mostly remain motionless as they watch their surroundings. If they detect hostility, they can extend vines in any direction to restrain the threat. They are willing to wait as long as it takes for their opponent to calm down.

entry: POKENAME扇翅时，会撒出削弱目标的粉末，降低其对毒素的抵抗力。带毒的角因此更加致命，能进一步削弱已受影响的敌人。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's wings spread a weakening powder as they flap, lowering the affected target's resistance to toxins. This makes their poisoned horn attacks more devastating, as they further debilitate those already affected.

entry: POKENAME用纠缠的藤蔓编出复杂的网。这些结构却十分脆弱，哪怕微风也能让整张网塌掉。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME weaves complex webs made out of tangled vines. These structures are extremely weak, with even mild wind causing the entire web to collapse.

entry: POKENAME会用藤蔓织成大网。友好商店表示，这种独特材料未来或许能用于时装业，制作富有弹性、穿着舒适的衣物。
author: fxncy_poland
source: POKENAME creates large webs using its vines. Poké Marts say that POKENAME webs could be useful in the future, as they could contribute to the fashion industry by using their unique material to create elastic and comfortable garments.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀让它能在密林中迅速飞行，灵活控制方向。它用藤蔓般的触须抓取小猎物，落地后再逐一检查，决定吃哪一个。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's wings aid it in swiftly flying through dense forests with a high amount of control. It snatches up small prey with its viney tendrils, examining the catches once it lands to decide what to eat.

entry: POKENAME会在高处侦察成群的昆虫，再俯冲而下，用触须状的翅膀尽可能多抓一些。它先大快朵颐，吃饱后再把剩下的分给其他食虫动物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME scouts for swarming insects from high above, swooping down and using its tentacled wings to grab up as many as it can. It gorges eagerly, then shares the rest with other insectivores once it's had its fill.

entry: POKENAME十分谨慎，总提防捕食者和食物里的毒。每次找到食物，它们都会仔细检查，确认能安全食用，才用藤蔓包好，匆匆带回巢穴。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are very cautious, always on the lookout for predators or poison in their food. Whenever they find a meal, they will inspect it thoroughly to ensure it is healthy to eat before wrapping it in vines and scurrying back to their dens.

entry: 野生POKENAME活泼好动，家养个体却有许多成为残障人士的帮手。长长的尾藤，能让它们和训练家安全取到高架上的物品。
author: quackquackattack
source: While wild POKENAME are rambunctious and playful, many domestic POKENAME serve as helpers for people with disabilities. Their long tail vine enables them and their Trainer to safely reach items from tall shelves.

entry: POKENAME的身体十分虚弱脆嫩。它们会坐在一天中大部分时间都有阳光的地方，把光转化为能量，让藤蔓生长，保护自己。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's body is very weak and fragile. They sit in areas where the sun shines for most of the day, absorbing and turning the light into energy to grow their vines and protect themselves.

entry: 园丁把POKENAME视为好运的象征，因为它能让马唐类杂草变成花。其实，它会将杂草转化为其他植物所需的养分。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are considered good luck by gardeners, as their presence converts crabgrass into flowers. They do this by converting the weeds into nutrients for other plants.

entry: 乍看之下，POKENAME像是靠众多扭动的触须在地上蠕行；仔细观察才会发现，藤蔓底下还有很小的脚，真正靠它们移动。
author: sk372
source: At first glance POKENAME appears to undulate across the ground using its many wriggling tentacles, but further inspection reveals it has very tiny feet beneath the vines that it uses to move around.

entry: POKENAME颇为害羞，通常躲在森林深处。不过，如果遇到一位合它心意、四处旅行的训练家，它就会把对方带回巢中。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is quite shy, usually hiding away deep in the forest. However, if it finds a wandering Trainer it takes a liking to, it will carry them back to its den.

entry: POKENAME住在其他宝可梦丢弃的壳里，将触须藏在其中。它们用众多藤蔓拖动身体，在森林中快得惊人，几乎什么表面都能爬上去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their homes inside discarded Pokémon shells, hiding their tendrils away within them. They drag themselves through the forest using their many vines with surprising speed, able to clamber up nearly any surface.

entry: POKENAME的外表，让它能轻易融入沼泽栖息地。它靠嗅觉寻找蘑菇和其他植物进食。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's appearance allows it to easily camouflage itself in its swamp habitat. It sniffs out mushrooms and other vegetation to consume.

entry: POKENAME周身包裹的大量触手，能替它御寒。它靠獠牙与鼻子，一起探查方向。
author: melodydelune
source: The mass of tentacles that encase POKENAME's body protect it from the cold. It uses a combination of its tusks and nose to guide itself.

entry: POKENAME尾端像响尾般的部分，其实是真身的一部分；真身大多藏在众多藤蔓下。它常装死，骗其他宝可梦来吃藤蔓，而藤蔓中含有强烈毒素。
author: infinex21
source: The rattle-like tip of POKENAME's tail is actually a part of its real body that is mostly concealed by its many vines. It will often play dead to trick other Pokémon into eating from its vines, which contain a potent poison.

entry: POKENAME用象鼻般的藤蔓大口吸水。众多藤蔓中储存的水，足够支撑数天，才需要再次饮水。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their trunk-like vines to gorge themselves on water. Their many vines can store water that will last them for days before they need to drink again.

entry: POKENAME的众多藤蔓不断生长，即使毒素如血液般在其中流动也不受影响。它既能用缠满藤蔓的身体勒住敌人，也能用单独的藤蔓束缚。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's many vines continuously grow despite the toxin that flows through them like veins. It can constrict foes with its vine-laden body or with the individual vines themselves.

entry: 这种宝可梦被称为“丛林幽灵”，因为即使裹着如此厚重的藤蔓，依然能轻松浮在地面上方。叫声如同诡异尖锐的吟唱，让大多数敌人心神不宁。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon are often called "Jungle Phantoms" because of how they will effortlessly float above the ground despite being clad in such thick vines. Their cries are like eerie, shrill chanting that unnerves most foes.

entry: 它常跑到人群前，想表演一番。可观众若嘲笑POKENAME，它便躲进帽子里，独自哭泣。
author: dodoowner_
source: It usually goes in front of large crowds to try and perform. If they laugh at POKENAME, it'll hide in its hat and cry.

entry: POKENAME用藤蔓遮住身形，融入附近枝叶。猎物走得太近时，它们就会疯狂挥爪，先将其砍倒，再用藤蔓缠住。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their vines to obscure their appearance, blending in with nearby foliage. When prey wanders too close, they whip their claws around wildly, cutting them down before ensnaring them.

entry: POKENAME藏着的粗厚粉红舌头，其实是一条藤蔓。它先将敌人拉近，再用其他藤蔓代替四肢，反复击打。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's thick, hidden pink tongue is actually a vine. It reels in foes with it, then strikes them repeatedly using its other vines in place of limbs.

entry: POKENAME起初只被归类为巨蔓藤的一种地区形态。近期基因组测序取得突破，才让它被确认为独立物种。
author: ansleehariot
source: Originally classified as just a regional variant of Tangrowth, recent breakthroughs in genome sequencing led to POKENAME being declared a distinct species.

entry: POKENAME会蜷成球，再使出藤鞭抽打威胁，进一步保护自己。它们常出现在沙漠绿洲附近，用藤蔓吸水，也洗去身上的沙粒。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME curl up into balls and lash at threats with Vine Whips to further protect themselves. They are often found near desert oases, their vines being used to absorb water and keep them clean of grains of sand.

entry: POKENAME用藤状尾巴挂在丛林树冠上，向下垂出藤蔓，精准地抓取林地上的猎物。
author: .izik
source: Clinging to jungle canopies with its vine-like tail, POKENAME drops vines below. It snatches prey from the forest floor with perfect aim.

entry: POKENAME背上的尖刺，既能防御敌人，也能防止藤蔓长得过长。它们能用强劲的爪子钻进地下，连岩石也能轻松破开。
author: infinex21
source: The sharp quills upon POKENAME's backs help to prevent their vines from growing too much as much as they help to protect them from opponents. It can burrow into the ground using its strong claws, which can easily break rocks as well.

entry: POKENAME的藤蔓会随周围生物的情绪，以不同方式扭动、摇摆。如果附近有两个人情绪冲突，藤蔓就会打结、缠作一团。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME's vines twist and sway in different ways depending on the emotions of those around it. If it's near two people with conflicting emotions, its vines will become knotted and tangled.

entry: POKENAME的头和手臂，由紧密缠绕的藤蔓组成。为了保护在乎的对象，这些触须会展开、伸长，化作盾牌和屏障。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's head and arms are comprised of tightly-packed vines. These tendrils will spread out and extend into shields and barriers in order to protect those it cares for.

entry: POKENAME拿着的可怕头颅，其实是藤蔓编成的，用来威吓敌人。战斗时，它喜欢突然从披风下掏出假头，对准敌人，把对方吓得呆住。
author: milchik
source: The terrifying head POKENAME carries is actually constructed from vines to intimidate foes. In battles, this Pokémon likes to suddenly pull the false head out from under its cloak and point it at the opponents, stunning them in fear.

entry: POKENAME收集树枝和泥巴筑坝，再让藤蔓穿过其中，将结构固定。藤蔓仍与身体相连，让它待在巢内也能感知动静和水流。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME gathers branches and mud to build dams, then threads its vines through the structure to hold everything in place. The vines remain part of its body, allowing it to sense movement and water flow from within its den.

entry: POKENAME幽灵般的身体，由无数裹着幽灵能量的藤蔓构成。藤蔓能伸得很远，抓住较小的生物，拖进触须交织的网中。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's spectral body is made up of countless vines covered with a ghostly energy. They can extend great distances, allowing it to snag smaller creatures and drag them into its mesh of tendrils.

entry: POKENAME全身缠绕的藤蔓上，覆有一层毒孢子。吸收阳光后，藤蔓会强壮到足以把整棵树连根拔起。
author: fiordaliso
source: The tangle of vines covering POKENAME's body is coated in poisonous spores. After absorbing sunlight, its vines become strong enough to rip entire tree trunks from the ground.

entry: POKENAME会关爱比自己小的任何生物。组成身体的众多触须，让它能同时轻抚、抱住并安慰许多想要照顾、保护的对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a caring nature towards any creature smaller than it.  With the many tendrils comprising its body, it can pet, hold and comfort a multitude of creatures it wishes to nurture and protect.

entry: 没人知道POKENAME本体的样子，只能瞥见黑暗里的一只眼。胆敢靠近者，都会被食肉藤蔓无情吞噬。
author: mistymagius
source: No one knows what POKENAME's real body looks like, only glimpsing a single eye encased in darkness. Anyone who dares approach is mercilessly devoured by its carnivorous vines.

entry: 人们曾发现，POKENAME的化石覆盖在古树化石上。有些研究者推测，仍在生长的树木被冲入海中时，便形成了这些化石。如今，它们蠕动的身体会成群附着在树上。
author: quackquackattack
source: Fossilized POKENAME have been found covering ancient tree fossils. Some researchers theorize that these fossils form when trees were washed out to sea while growing. In modern times, POKENAME's writhing body clings to trees in groups.

entry: POKENAME的触须会本能地抓取所有可吃的东西，因此它很少需要亲自移动觅食。它只在自卫时使用四肢，出手却毫不留情。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tendrils move on instinct to grab anything edible, so it rarely has to move and forage for itself. It only uses its limbs in self-defense, where it shows little mercy.

entry: 众多藤蔓让POKENAME看起来远比实际强壮。话虽如此，它们确实能用多条藤蔓同时缠紧，轻松绞碎某些岩石。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME appear much stronger than they truly are thanks to their many vines. This said, they can easily crush some types of rock by constricting them with multiple vines at the same time.

entry: 一种入侵藻类总会长在POKENAME身上，无论它怎样撞向海底岩石，都刮不干净。不过，藻类似乎有助于水下呼吸，它最终会学着与之共存。
author: infinex21
source: An invasive species of algae is always growing upon POKENAME's body, no matter how much it tries to scrape it off by running into undersea rocks. The algae seems to help it breathe underwater, so it will eventually learn to live in harmony with it.

entry: 强烈日照下，POKENAME的藤蔓长得飞快，因此它必须定期咬掉。这些藤蔓成了很受欢迎的无麸质面条替代品。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's vines grow rapidly when exposed to harsh sunlight, so POKENAME has to regularly chew them off. These vines have become popular as a gluten-free noodle substitute.

entry: POKENAME在别人面前装得温和，引诱毫无戒心的宝可梦到背上休息。壳上的植物随即伸出触须，将它们缠住，拖进内部吞食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME acts gentle in the presence of others, luring unsuspecting Pokémon to rest on its back. The plant on its shell will then ensnare them with its tendrils and drag them inside it to be consumed.

entry: POKENAME会伸出头部周围的藤蔓，抓住树枝，在树冠间荡行。它们定期修剪藤蔓，以免长得太长，被尾巴上的火点燃。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME extend the vines around their heads to grab onto branches and swing through the treetops. They routinely trim their vines to avoid them growing too long and getting ignited by the fire from their tails.

entry: 围绕POKENAME的实体，是神经系统的延伸。每一个都有独立的小脑，帮助它维持复杂的多层磁场。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: The entities that surround POKENAME are extensions of its nervous system. Each one has a small independent brain that helps it maintain its complicated layered magnetic fields.

entry: POKENAME的藤蔓长得极快，还会疯狂挥动。可惜，长得越长，就越容易挂到刀刃，又被截短。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME's vines grow remarkably fast, and they whip around wildly. Unfortunately, the longer they get, the more likely they are to catch on the blade and get cut short again.

entry: POKENAME全身藤蔓都锋利如剃刀，连柄上也一样。多数战士无法顺手持用，它只好独自作战。
author: patch
source: The vines all along POKENAME's body are razor sharp. Since this includes the hilt, most warriors cannot wield it efficiently, forcing it to battle on its own.

entry: POKENAME的身体由超过300米长、打结带刺的藤蔓构成。刺中含有强烈毒素，照料青春期个体时必须小心，以免训练家被刺伤中毒。
author: alice_alice
source: POKENAME's body is comprised of over 300 metres of knotted, thorny vines. These thorns carry a powerful toxin, and an adolescent POKENAME needs to be handled carefully to avoid envenoming its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME生活在清澈见底的湖里，会在岸边浅水处舒展身体，尽量多晒太阳。如果有什么碰到藤蔓，那条藤蔓就会断开，它则退回深处。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lives in crystal-clear lakes, stretching out its body in the shallows close to shore to catch as much sunlight as it can. If anything touches one of its vines, that vine will break away as POKENAME retreats to the depths.

entry: POKENAME是少数无需光照获取能量的草属性宝可梦，通常堵在下水道里。每晚，它们都会离开住处，伪装成工人，可臭味总会暴露身份。
author: ghostslythe
source: One of few Grass types that require no light for energy, POKENAME is generally found clogging up sewers. Every night they exit their home, disguising themselves as workers, but the smell gives them away.

entry: 藤蔓般的触角一直生长，必须定期修剪。其中含有异常强效的镇静成分，因此POKENAME会任由猎物啃食，再反过来吃掉猎物。
author: infinex21
source: Its vine-like feelers are always growing and must be regularly trimmed. Because of the abnormally calming agents within these feelers, POKENAME will let its prey feed on them and then feed on said prey in turn.

entry: 尽管外形可怕、体形巨大，POKENAME却是温和的大家伙。受到威胁时，它会高速旋转额头上纠缠的藤蔓，吓住捕食者，迅速脱身。
author: alice_alice
source: Despite its fearsome appearance and large size, POKENAME is a gentle giant. When threatened, it spins the tangling vines on its forehead at high speeds, startling predators and allowing a quick getaway.

entry: POKENAME用藤蔓缠住附近植物，吸取生命力，为大炮充能。在丛林中吃水果时，它会开炮，吓退敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's vines wrap around nearby plants to drain their life force and charge its cannon. It fires blasts to deter foes while consuming fruit in jungles.

entry: POKENAME无声地飘过月光下的草地，抓走熟睡的宝可梦。它用藤蔓堵住它们的叫声，再消失在黑暗中。
author: .izik
source: While drifting silently over moonlit meadows, POKENAME snatches sleeping Pokémon. It muffles their cries with vines before vanishing into the dark.

entry: POKENAME用藤蔓织出庞大相连的网系，几乎想在哪里捕猎都行。不过，到了雨季，它在自己的网中穿行就会变得困难。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME makes a large, connected web system out of its vines, allowing it to catch prey virtually wherever it wants. However, during the rainy season, POKENAME has difficulty traversing its web system.

entry: POKENAME总在摆弄彼此交叠的藤状尾巴，战斗前要把每一条都理顺。一旦成功协调尾巴发起攻击，它们就会点燃尾端，增强威力。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Constantly fussing over their overlapping vine-like tails, POKENAME work to sort out each one in proper order before a battle. Once they manage to coordinate their tails in an attack, they ignite the ends of their tails to increase their power.

entry: 从POKENAME身上几个孔洞伸出的触须，只是其中一小部分；它体内几乎全由触须构成。遇险时，它能将触须当作弹丸射出，趁机撤退，再长出新的一套。
author: sk372
source: The tentacles wriggling out of several holes in POKENAME's body are just a few of several that make up nearly the entirety of its internals. If in danger, it can fire its tentacles as projectiles in order to retreat and regenerate a new set.

entry: POKENAME会将藤蔓缠在原木上，修筑河坝。在巨蔓藤导师的指导下，它们会学习编织复杂的绳结，防止水坝被冲走。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME build river dams by intertwining their vines around logs. Under the guidance of Tangrowth mentors, they learn how to weave intricate knots to keep their structures from washing away.

entry: POKENAME将藤蔓擒拿与武术结合，出脚踢击时便能缠住对手。它每天训练，完善这套不寻常的打法。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME blends vine grapples with martial arts, wrapping opponents mid-kick. It trains daily to perfect its unconventional fighting style.

entry: POKENAME过度兴奋时，会扯下自己的藤蔓，像鞭子般挥舞。充沛的能量能让藤蔓几分钟内就长回来，因此怎么用也用不完。
author: sk372
source: During moments of hyperactivity, POKENAME will tear off its own vines and swing them around like whips. Due to its high energy, these vines grow back within minutes, so it never runs out.

entry: POKENAME全身紧裹着海绵般的藤蔓，能抵御钝力造成的伤害。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's spongy vines are wrapped tightly around its entire body. These vines give it protection from blunt force trauma.

entry: 有时，人们能在森林边缘的城市看见POKENAME，被遗留腐食的气味吸引而来。黑暗中，它们可能被误认成歪扭的灌木。
author: milchik
source: Sometimes, POKENAME are seen in cities bordering forests, attracted by the smell of rotting food left behind. In the dark, these Pokémon can be mistaken for a crooked bush.

entry: POKENAME能旋转唯一的一条触须，在水中推进。黑色身体可以吸收阳光，因此晴天时，它会尽量靠近池塘和溪流的水面。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can spin its single tendril to propel itself through water. Its black body absorbs sunlight, and so on sunny days it will try to remain close to the surface of ponds and streams.

entry: POKENAME包裹在红色胶质中，会伸出藤蔓，一片片摘下花瓣。它只吃最柔软、最鲜艳的花瓣，剩下的则常被摆在巢穴周围。
author: .izik
source: Red gelatin surrounds POKENAME as vines slip out to pluck flower petals one by one. It consumes only the softest, brightest petals, often arranging the rest around its lair.

entry: POKENAME奇特的体形，让飞行摇摆不定。虽然不擅俯冲，它仍能用触须抓住附近猎物，拉到身边啃咬。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's odd shape makes flying rather erratic. Though poor at swooping, its tendrils let it latch onto nearby prey and bring it closer so it can bite into them.

entry: POKENAME经常缠进毛发浓密的宝可梦或人类身上，吸食静电。等发现自己卡住了，它就会惊慌，把储存的一部分电力释放到宿主身上。
author: beetlething
source: POKENAME often get tangled in hairy Pokémon and humans, consuming their static electricity before it gets stuck. POKENAME then panics, releasing a bit of the electricity it stored onto its host.

entry: POKENAME脸部周围的触须，能保证抓住的东西无法逃脱。触须被切断后会迅速再生，不让它的脸暴露出来。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: The tentacles around POKENAME's face ensure that anything it catches doesn't get away. These tentacles regenerate very quickly if they are cut off, preventing its face from being exposed.

entry: POKENAME藤蔓上牙齿般的突起，其实是尖刺，扎进受害者皮肤后就能吸血。睡觉时，它必须用藤蔓挂在树上或洞顶。
author: pjporwoll
source: The tooth-like protrusions on POKENAME's vines are actually thorns which absorb blood when piercing the skin of a victim. It must use its vines to hang from trees or the ceilings of caves to sleep.

entry: POKENAME在森林地面上挪动，寻找美味的虫宝可梦和块茎。有些人认为，把它放在平底锅中煎过，就是一道佳肴。
author: jaycielantern
source: POKENAME shuffles around the forest floor looking for tasty bug Pokémon and tubers. To some, it is a delicacy when fried in a skillet.

entry: 这种融合宝可梦，炸得酥脆后撒上盐，是一道备受喜爱的美食。还有人加上酸奶油与葱，衬出更多滋味。
author: jaycielantern
source: This fusion is adored as a delicacy when deep-fried and salted. Some add sour cream and spring onions to it to bring out more flavor.

entry: 这种融合宝可梦，炸得酥脆后撒上盐，是一道备受喜爱的美食。人们常说，吃着像土豆与洋葱。
author: jaycielantern
source: This fusion is adored as a delicacy when deep-fried and salted. People often remark its flavor as being similar to potatoes and onions.

entry: POKENAME的尖刺会产生毒液，流入头上的藤蔓，让它能用强力藤鞭毒倒靠得太近的生物。不过，前方胡须状的藤蔓没有危险，还经常被仔细打理。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's spines produce a venom that flows into the vines upon its head, letting it poison anything that gets too close with a potent Vine Whip. The mustache-shaped vines on its front are harmless, however, and preened often.

entry: 偶尔，POKENAME藏在兜帽里的藤蔓会滑出来，疯狂挥动，伸向附近的生物。它会赶忙盖回去，似乎为这片刻暴露感到尴尬。
author: sk372
source: On occasion, the vines POKENAME keeps hidden within its hood will slip out, thrashing and reaching out wildly towards those nearby. POKENAME hastily covers them back up, seemingly embarrassed at this moment of exposure.

entry: POKENAME长出的藤蔓，可以晒干纺成细绳。装订工会用这种绳子，把书页缝成一本本书。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produces vines that can be dried and spun into twine. This twine is then used by bookbinders to sew pages together into books.

entry: POKENAME总是不停点头、摇晃身体。持续的动作，会扰乱敌人攻击的准头。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is always bobbing its head and thrashing about. Its constant motion throws off the accuracy of enemy attacks.

entry: POKENAME的双手纠缠成团，根本抓不住物品。有人认为，它其实正紧握着什么，但始终没有证据。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's hands are a tangled mess, making it impossible to grasp objects. Some believe it is clinging to something, but no proof exists.

entry: POKENAME懒得出奇，喜欢在林间小径旁休息。长触须经常伸进路中，绊倒毫无防备的旅人，它却依旧悠闲得毫不在意。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is incredibly lazy and prefers to rest near forest trails. Its long tendrils often stretch into walkways, causing unsuspecting travelers to trip while it lounges without a care.

entry: POKENAME手臂上的扇子由触须构成，想伸多长就能伸多长。不过，扇子越长，能留下来支撑拍翅的触须就越少。
author: jaminmcready
source: The fans on POKENAME's arms are made of tendrils that can extend to any length. However, longer fans mean fewer tendrils are left to support its wing flaps.

entry: 有些占卜者相信，POKENAME把藤蔓伸进树桩，就能读出古老记忆。但至今没有证据能够证实。
author: .izik
source: Some oracles believe POKENAME reads ancient memories from stumps by sinking its vines into them. No evidence of this has ever been confirmed.

entry: POKENAME头上的花能鼓起，释放麻痹性的孢子，让它经常能趁机逃走。双脚会迅速从土里吸收水分和其他养分，帮助它们更快生长。
author: infinex21
source: The flower atop POKENAME's head can puff out and release numbing spores, which often allows it to run away. Its feet can quickly absorb water and other nutrients from soil, which helps them to grow faster.

entry: POKENAME在水下或雨林中都能茁壮成长。藤蔓内有鳃，帮助它们在水中或湿润空气里呼吸。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME can thrive underwater or in rainforests. Its vines contain gills that help it breathe underwater or in moist air.

entry: POKENAME的石头身体，靠多种强韧的藤蔓固定。它会定期从地上收集新石头，替换那些已经看腻的。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's stony body is held together by many different kinds of strong vines. It periodically collects new stones from the ground when it tires of the ones it already has.

entry: POKENAME部分金属化的身体中，伸出一团不断蠕动的藤蔓。手臂最长可达三十米。它会定期收回并更换充当四肢的藤蔓，防止干燥。
author: sk372
source: A wriggling mass of vines extending out of a partially-metallic body, POKENAME's arms can extend up to thirty meters. It regularly retracts and replaces the vines serving as its limbs to keep them from drying out.

entry: 许多儿童理发店会养一只POKENAME，让坐在椅子上的孩子保持平静。它一边哼唱，一边用柔软的触须熟练编辫，把梳子递给发型师。
author: jaminmcready
source: Many children's salons keep a POKENAME around to keep kids calm in the chair. Its soft tendrils work steadily as it hums, braiding hair and passing combs to the stylist.

entry: POKENAME的藤蔓粗得惊人，能抵御大多数常规武器。战斗时，它会用藤蔓裹住对手，越勒越紧，直到对方无法呼吸。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's vines are incredibly thick and are resistant to most regular weaponry. In combat, it will wrap its opponents in its vines and then squeeze them until they can no longer breathe.

entry: POKENAME先用藤蔓擒住对手，再对被困的敌人拳打脚踢。获胜后，它会吃下深藏在藤蔓里的番荔果，作为庆祝的零食。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME fights by grappling opponents with its vines and then pummeling the trapped foe with punches and kicks. After a victory, it eats a treat of celebratory Yache Berries which it keeps deep in its vines.

entry: POKENAME夜间狩猎，白天则藏在暗洞中，牢牢扎根，让藤蔓深入沙漠地下水。在这种状态下，它们无法移动，十分脆弱。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME hunt their prey by night and hide in dark caves during the day, rooting themselves firmly into the ground and letting their vines grow deep into the desert groundwater. They are very vulnerable in this state as they're unable to move.

entry: POKENAME产生的孢子类似酵母，酿酒师会收集来酿蜂蜜酒。它的藤蔓还能晒干纺绳，用来捆牢酒桶。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produces spores that resemble yeast that brewers harvest to produce mead. Its vines can also be dried and spun into twine to help secure barrels.

entry: 梳理POKENAME纠缠的藤状毛发十分困难，需要的更像是园艺本领。如果打理不好，它就可能用这些能抓握的藤蔓抽打过来。
author: ocxin
source: Grooming POKENAME's tangly, vine-like fur is difficult and requires expertise more in line with gardening. If this is done poorly, it may lash out with these same prehensile vines.

entry: POKENAME身体内外盘绕的藤蔓，至少有20码长。训练家需要保持警觉，因为从高高的树冠到森林地面，它都能轻松伪装。
author: pkbonusducks
source: The collection of vines coiling in and around POKENAME's body is at least 20 yards long. Trainers should be vigilant for POKENAME, as they have no trouble camouflaging themselves anywhere between the high treetops and the forest floor.

entry: POKENAME藏在森林中，很少被训练家看见。传说，它们的群落会收留受伤旅人，悉心照顾，直到康复。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides in the forest, rarely being seen by Trainers. Legends say that colonies of POKENAME take in injured travelers and will look after them until they recover.

entry: 它的壳里塞满过热的触须，因此会从隐藏的嘴中冒出蒸汽。蒸熟的POKENAME藤蔓，是丰缘一些地方很受欢迎的小吃。
author: sk372
source: It produces steam from its hidden mouth, as it's shell is filled to the brim with its superheated tendrils.  Steamed POKENAME vines are a popular snack food in some parts of Hoenn.

entry: POKENAME扭动的藤蔓渗出树液，带有南瓜般的甜香。这股气味会引来猎物，随后它便毫无预兆地将其拉近。
author: .izik
source: The sap oozing from POKENAME's writhing vines smells sweet like pumpkin. This scent lures prey close before it pulls them in without warning.

entry: POKENAME白天藏在灌木丛中，触须让它们融入枝叶。夜里，它们会出来在月光下结伴飞舞，靠鲜红的腹部，在黑暗中互相辨认。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend their days hidden in bushes and shrubs, their tendrils helping them blend into the leaves. They emerge at night to flutter together in the moonlight, using their bright red abdomens as a means to see one another in the dark.

entry: POKENAME会定期蜕下深色、螺旋状的藤蔓。人类可以食用，滋味类似黑甘草糖。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME regularly sheds its dark, spiraling vines. These vines are edible to humans, and have a taste similar to black licorice.

entry: POKENAME会用藤蔓缠住入侵者，展开伏击。等对方无法动弹，它便毫不留情地使出摔打，将其赶走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME ambushes intruders by tangling them in vines. Once immobilized, it uses Slam without mercy to drive them away.

entry: POKENAME浮在水面下方，只露出睡莲叶。任何爬上叶面的东西，都会迅速被触须抓住，拖入水下。之后会发生什么，没人知道。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME floats just under the water, leaving its lily pad exposed. Anything that gets on it is swiftly snatched by its tentacles and dragged under the water. What happens after is unknown.

entry: POKENAME会释放分解矿物的酶，让根能穿过大岩石。旱季，它会把藤蔓卷成一团，节省水分。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME releases an enzyme that breaks down minerals, allowing its roots to dig past large rocks. During dry seasons, it coils its vines into a ball to conserve water.

entry: POKENAME用众多藤蔓捡起硬币，藏在其中。据说，只要使劲摇晃它们，就会掉出收集的硬币。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME pick up and conceal coins with their many vines. It is said that by shaking them vigorously, they drop coins that they have collected.

entry: POKENAME藏在芦苇中，头上的藤蔓会捕捉小鱼供它进食。不过，藤蔓有时会把头缠得太紧，令它头昏眼花。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides amongst the reeds, the vines on its head catching small fish for it to eat. However, sometimes the vines wrap around POKENAME's head too tight, causing it to become light-headed.

entry: 越愤怒，藤蔓甩得越快。暴怒的POKENAME甚至会把自己的藤蔓甩断。
author: andoman63
source: The angrier it gets, the faster its vines whip around. A furious POKENAME might even break off its own vines in its rage.

entry: POKENAME很容易发怒，会用迅速有力的连拳打到对手服输。不过，狂暴时藤蔓也会长得更快，最后把自己缠住，逼得它不得不停下。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are quick to anger and will pummel opponents into submission with many quick, yet strong, punches. However, their vines will grow quicker as they rampage until they are forced to stop because they get tangled within them.

entry: POKENAME头上的“头发”其实是藤蔓，摸起来湿漉漉的。可惜POKENAME没有手臂，藤蔓也总是乱蓬蓬。
author: hellaluyeah
source: The hair on POKENAME's head are actually vines that are wet to the touch. Since POKENAME doesn't have arms, its vines always appear disheveled.

entry: POKENAME的头发长了，手臂也长了。既有催眠本领，又有拳击手套，让对手“睡下”，足足有两种办法。
author: hellaluyeah
source: POKENAME hair has grown and so have its arms. With its hypnotizing powers and its boxing gloves, it has two ways to put its opponents to rest.

entry: 虽然POKENAME拥有强大的精神力量，却十分害羞焦虑。脸上的藤蔓吃下后能安定心神，因此它格外紧张时，会啃自己的藤蔓放松。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although POKENAME has mighty psychic power, it is terribly shy and anxious. As the vines on its face help steady and ease the mind when consumed, it may nibble on its own vines to relax whenever it is particularly nervous.

entry: POKENAME的每条藤蔓都蕴含精神力量。它能同时应付多个对手，一次放出超过十二道幻象光线。
author: sk372
source: Every one of POKENAME's vines is imbued with psychic power. This lets it take on multiple opponents at once, being capable of firing off over a dozen Psybeams at once.

entry: 光是POKENAME在场，就会让敌人紧张不安。它一旦全力施展精神力量，许多对手甚至难以瞄准它发动攻击。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's mere presence causes foes to feel unnerved and anxious. When it begins to use the full force of its psychic powers, many find it difficult to even properly aim an attack at it.

entry: POKENAME手臂上覆盖着能够伸缩的藤蔓，攻击范围比看起来远得多。以为自己站在安全距离的对手，仍会被它一把抓住。
author: sk372
source: Its arms are covered with retractable vines, so POKENAME's reach is much longer than it would seem, letting it grapple opponents that wrongly assume they're a safe distance away.

entry: POKENAME的众多藤蔓，就是四条手臂的肌肉，随身体锻炼不断生长、变粗。藤蔓营养丰富，许多健美爱好者会把蜕下的藤蔓打成饮品，在锻炼前后饮用。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's many vines act as muscles for its four arms, growing and thickening as they train their bodies. Their vines are so nutrient-rich that many bodybuilders will blend shed vines into shakes before and after a workout.

entry: POKENAME能舒展开缠绕的身体，让自己变大。两腿间的距离随之拉开，再宽的沟壑，也能轻松跨过。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can unravel its body and thus grow in size. This increases the distance between its legs and allows it to cross large gaps with ease.

entry: POKENAME用鞭子般的藤蔓攀上洞壁，寻找稀有霉菌。它先滴下酸液，将生长物软化，再用触须慢慢吸收。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slinks up cave walls with whip-like vines in search of rare molds. It softens the growth with acid drips before absorbing it slowly through its tendrils.

entry: POKENAME有坚硬的壳，保护脆弱的藤蔓免遭撕裂和刮伤。藤蔓极其敏感，能在浑浊的水中探路。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME has a hard shell used to protect its fragile vines, keeping them safe from tears and scratches. Its vines are highly sensitive and are used to feel through muddy waters.

entry: POKENAME其实是为求安全，寄生在口呆花中的蔓藤怪，藏身于钟状大嘴里。藤蔓会慢慢吃掉植物主体，再操控留下的空壳，作为伪装。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME constitutes a Tangela parasitizing a Weepinbell for safety, as it hides inside the bell mouth. The vines slowly consume the main plant body, allowing it to manipulate the husk as a form of mimicry.

entry: POKENAME有坚硬的壳，保护脆弱的藤蔓免遭撕裂和刮伤。藤蔓极其敏感，能在浑浊的水中探路。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME has a hard shell used to protect its fragile vines, keeping them safe from tears and scratches. Its vines are highly sensitive and are used to feel through muddy waters.

entry: POKENAME用来感知世界的藤蔓十分强韧，能编结成有力的尾巴，推动身体。它最喜欢能见度低、泥水浑浊的湖泊和河流。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The vines POKENAME uses to sense the world are strong enough to serve as a source of propulsion, braiding together to form a powerful tail. Its preferred environment is muddy lakes and rivers with low visibility.

entry: 从尾巴伸出的寄生藤蔓，正逐渐侵占POKENAME的身体，吸走重要养分。不知为何，它似乎毫不在意，有时还会嚼着藤蔓玩。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is being overtaken by the parasitic vines from its tail, gradually draining it of vital nutrients. Somehow, POKENAME doesn't seem to mind, sometimes even chewing on the vines for fun.

entry: 这种宝可梦会轮流休息，让藤蔓吸收、储存日光或月光。醒来时，它们常把自己的藤蔓误认成蠕动的小型虫属性宝可梦，张口便咬。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon rest at alternating times to allow their vines to absorb and store either sunlight or moonlight. When they awaken, they often snap at their own vines due to mistaking them for small Bug-type Pokémon wriggling around.

entry: POKENAME的腿看似纤弱，却很有力，支撑着裹满不断生长的藤蔓的身体。三个头能各自思考，经常为谁能吃找到的食物而争吵。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's legs appear frail but are rather strong, helping to support its body clad in ever-growing vines. Its three heads can think separately and often argue over which gets to eat any food they find.

entry: POKENAME在地壳表层挖掘时，蠕动的藤蔓能将岩石搅成松土。藤蔓中的红色团块含有养分，让它数天不用浮出地面。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's writhing vines help it to churn rock into loose dirt as it burrows within the upper layers of the world's crust. The red masses within its vines contain nutrients so it can remain underground for days without having to surface.

entry: POKENAME很受高档餐厅青睐，被用来制作高级料理。身体中的肉，配上煮熟藤蔓的口感与滋味，能成为美味又富含蛋白质的昂贵佳肴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is highly sought by upscale restaurants for high-class dining. The meat in its body combined with the texture and taste of its vines when cooked create a delectable, protein-rich meal worth a high price.

entry: 人们偶尔看见POKENAME用钳子切断自己的触须吃掉。触须要很久才能长回来，因此它只在其他食物匮乏时这样做。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has sometimes been observed using its pincers to sever its own tentacles and eat them. They grow back over a long period, so it only does this when other food sources are scarce.

entry: POKENAME十分宠爱孩子，喜欢满足孩子的一切愿望。孩子想玩拔河时，它们尤其高兴，终于有机会用上长藤蔓。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are doting parents that enjoy giving their child whatever they want. They are overjoyed when their child wants to play tug-of-war, which gives them the opportunity to use their long vines.

entry: 令人难过的是，野生POKENAME常不惜一切保护孩子，或以爆炸击退捕食者，或将孩子远远发射出去。因此，大多数都活不到亲眼看见孩子长大。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: Tragically, POKENAME in the wild will often protect their child at all costs by exploding to defeat predators or launching their child far away from them. Because of this, most wild POKENAME don't live long enough to see their child grow up.

entry: 群体中的蛋成长速度各不相同，年长的便照顾年幼的，直到完全孵化、发育。等全部长大，POKENAME在战斗中就会展现出惊人的默契。
author: sk372
source: The eggs in the group age at different rates, leaving the older ones to take care of the younger until they fully hatch and develop. Once all are fully grown, POKENAME exhibits marvelous unity in battle.

entry: POKENAME会捡起最先找到的骨头防身，但独自生活时并不强大。它寻找袋兽群，希望被一个充满爱的家庭收养。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fends for itself using the first bone it can find, but isn't very strong on its own. It searches for Kangaskhan herds, hoping to be adopted into a loving family.

entry: POKENAME灵巧敏捷，生活在峭壁附近，用修长而富有弹性的四肢，自由上下跳跃。幼崽们在崖底附近玩耍，成年个体则仔细看护。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Agile and spry, POKENAME live near cliff faces and bound up and down freely with their long and springy limbs. Young POKENAME play with one another near the base of the cliffs under the watchful eyes of adults.

entry: POKENAME灵巧敏捷，生活在峭壁附近，用修长而富有弹性的四肢，自由上下跳跃。幼崽们在崖底附近玩耍，成年个体则仔细看护。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Agile and spry, POKENAME live near cliff faces and bound up and down freely with their long and springy limbs. Young POKENAME play with one another near the base of the cliffs under the watchful eyes of adults.

entry: POKENAME用又长又黏的舌头清洁孩子，也用来抵御威胁。危险靠近时，它会把孩子吞下，护在第二个胃中，直到威胁过去。
author: amiel997
source: POKENAME uses its long, sticky tongue to keep its child clean and to defend against threats. When danger is near, it swallows the child, keeping it safe inside a second stomach until the threat passes.

entry: 人们常看见POKENAME为幼崽检查身体，似乎十分乐在其中。因此，它的幼崽往往比未融合袋兽的幼崽更健康。
author: pinkyoshi2350
source: POKENAME are often seen giving their babies check-ups, which they seem to greatly enjoy. Because of this, POKENAME's babies tend to be healthier than those of unfused Kangaskhan.

entry: 年幼POKENAME会把藤蔓与父母的藤蔓缠在一起。即使父母正在攀爬丛林家园中的树木，幼崽也能牢牢依附。
author: cait_sith
source: Baby POKENAME intertwine their vines with their parent's. This allows baby POKENAME to securely cling to their parent even when the parent is scaling the trees of their jungle home.

entry: 幼崽已健康、强壮地长大，如今与母亲并肩作战。只有彼此的爱，能与它们战斗时的凶猛相比。
author: griddle
source: The child has grown up healthy and strong, and now fights by its mother's side. Their ferocity is matched only by their love for each other.

entry: 孩子已经长大一些，开始想要离开父母，独立一点。父母虽然犹豫，却也看见孩子变得更强、更聪明、更善良，对终有一天放手稍稍安心了。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: The child has grown somewhat and seeks some independence from their parent. Although hesitant, the parent has seen their child grow stronger, wiser, and kinder, and feels a bit more at ease about letting them go some day.

entry: POKENAME察觉危险时，会把幼崽藏进帽子。无论谁向里看，都看不见孩子，直到它亲自将孩子取出来。
author: cait_sith
source: When POKENAME senses danger, it hides its baby in its hat. Anyone who looks inside will see no trace of the child until the POKENAME pulls it back out.

entry: 年幼POKENAME刚出生时没有刀刃，毫无防御能力，因此一直紧贴在父母背上。夜里，父母会用轻柔的振翅嗡鸣，哄孩子入睡。
author: sk372
source: A young POKENAME does not have blades at birth, so the defenseless joey clings to its parent's back at all times. POKENAME uses the soft hum of its wingbeat to lull the child to sleep at night.

entry: POKENAME喜欢跳舞，举止优雅而有教养。孩子也被教得端庄得体，但只要不在父母眼皮底下，就可能淘气起来。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: POKENAME dances about and carries themselves with a sophisticated elegance. The child is also raised to be prim and proper, but can be known to get up to mischief whenever not under the watchful eye of the parent.

entry: 虽然大钳看起来危险，POKENAME强劲却轻柔的夹握，反而是抱住孩子最安全的方式。打扰幼崽的家伙很快就会明白，即使不用钳子，它也是凶猛的守护者。
author: sk372
source: Despite how dangerous it looks, the strong-yet-delicate grip of POKENAME's pincers makes it the safest place for the child to be held. Those who disturb the baby quickly learn it needs no pincers to be a fierce guardian.

entry: 过去，人们曾猎捕POKENAME，用皮制作班卓琴等乐器。如今，它们在受保护的牧场上游荡，种群数量得以监测。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's skin used to be hunted for the production of instruments, such as the banjo. Now they roam in protected pastures where their population can be monitored.

entry: POKENAME会长途跋涉，穿过冰冷海洋，寻找适合抚育幼崽的地方。它们结成小群旅行，确保孩子们不会孤单。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME travel long distances across the icy sea to find the right place to raise their young. They travel in small groups to ensure that the children in their group don't feel lonely.

entry: 由于外表相似，POKENAME常与袋兽待在一起，被父母当作多出来的孩子收养。人们越来越常见到袋兽袋中装着一只POKENAME。
author: sk372
source: Due to their similar appearances, POKENAME are often found in the company of Kangaskhan, adopted as an additional child by the parent. More and more Kangaskhan are being spotted carrying a POKENAME in their pouch.

entry: POKENAME在最高的山峰巡逻，把处境危险的人送下山。许多登山者却因探险被迫提前结束，而对它颇有怨言。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME patrols the highest peaks, ferrying down anyone in a precarious scenario. Many mountain climbers have become annoyed at POKENAME for ending their expeditions short.

entry: POKENAME鼓励孩子自由闯荡，教它快速远行，四处探索。虽然幼崽电力还很弱，练习飞行时，翅膀仍偶尔会迸出细小闪电。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME encourages a free spirit in its child, teaching it to roam fast, far and wide. Though the child has little electrical strength yet, occasional small bolts of lightning spark from its wings when it practices flight.

entry: POKENAME强大而有爱心，经常帮助遇困者，也抚育幼崽，让后代继承自己的精神。但谁若伤害幼崽，它的温柔就会荡然无存，向所有生物掀起愤怒风暴。
author: jonclyd
source: POKENAME are caring and mighty, often aiding those in trouble and raising their young, who will carry on their legacy. But harm their young, and their gentle nature shatters, unleashing a storm of rage upon all.

entry: POKENAME遇见迷路的孩子，就会把他们放进袋中，带着四处飞行，寻找父母。如果找不到，它便会亲自照料，视如己出地抚养长大。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME encounter a lost child, they place them into their pouches and fly them all around, hoping to find their parents. If the parent can't be found, POKENAME will take care of the child themselves, raising them as if they were their own.

entry: 孩子在身边时，POKENAME沉稳克制，却充满爱意，一心想给孩子最好的未来。可孩子不在身边时，它便毫无怜悯，会毫不犹豫地摧毁挡路的一切生物。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: With their child, POKENAME is stoic, yet incredibly loving and wants to provide the best future possible for them. But without them, POKENAME loses all empathy and shall destroy anyone in their path without a moment of hesitation.

entry: POKENAME会鼓励胆小的孩子外出探索、结交朋友。它是善良而信任孩子的父母，但只要察觉一丝威胁，就会立刻用精神力量定住对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME encourages its timid child to go out, explore and make friends. It's a very kind and trusting parent, but will immobilize a creature instantly with psychic powers the moment it senses a hint of a threat.

entry: 幼崽的视力尚未发育完全，尖叫声却响亮刺耳。POKENAME一听见，就能以马赫级的高速穿过栖身洞穴的曲折隧道与漆黑深处，把孩子救离危险。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: The child's eyesight is underdeveloped, but their screech is loud and eye-piercing. Upon hearing it, POKENAME can navigate the winding tunnels and pure darkness of the caves they live in at Mach speeds to scoop their child out of danger.

entry: 为了锻炼后代，POKENAME会让孩子与群中其他幼崽玩打架。如果嬉闹太过头，父母可能就会介入，为究竟是谁家孩子有错而打起来。
author: sk372
source: In order to toughen up its progeny, POKENAME allows its child to play-fight with other young in the flock. If the roughhousing gets too extreme, parents may step in and brawl over whose child was at fault.

entry: POKENAME用光引导孩子穿过幽深黑暗的海。幼崽能根据闪光脉冲的节奏，辨认自己的父母，区分其他同类。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME uses its light to guide its child through deep, dark seas. The child can distinguish its parent from other POKENAME based on the pattern of its parent's light pulses.

entry: POKENAME把幼崽藏在羊毛里，既保暖，也用自身电力喂养。等孩子足够大，它会分一些羊毛，帮助它们应对成年后的生活。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME keeps its young in its wool, keeping them warm and feeding them with its own electricity. Once the babies are old enough, it will give them some of its wool to aid them in their adult life.

entry: 如果袋中的幼崽走丢，POKENAME就会闪动尾巴上的亮光，引它回来。同样的光，也能晃得威胁孩子的宝可梦睁不开眼。
author: .jerden
source: If the baby in its pouch ever wanders off, POKENAME guides it back by flashing the bright light on its tail. It uses the same light to blind any Pokémon that threatens its child.

entry: 虽然POKENAME更愿意静止不动，好奇的孩子却经常跳出袋子探索，逼得它追赶。被抱回袋里时，幼崽便会哭闹、噘嘴。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME prefers to remain still, its curious child often hops out of the pouch to explore, forcing it to give chase. The young cries and pouts when POKENAME lifts it back into the pouch.

entry: POKENAME会顶着幼崽四处走，孩子紧抓着它仅有的一根强韧毛发。如果抓扯过猛，有时也会让它难受。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries its young around on its head, with the child holding on by a single strong strand of hair that POKENAME possesses. This sometimes causes discomfort when the child tugs on the hair too strongly.

entry: POKENAME在树冠间快速移动时，会用尾巴牢牢抓住幼崽，确保不会掉落。为了抵御任何威胁、保护后代，它不惜付出生命。
author: mepp.
source: With a firm tail grip, POKENAME ensures that its baby won't fall as it swiftly moves from treetop to treetop. It will give its life to defend its offspring from any threat.

entry: POKENAME会找尽可能阳光充足的地方，托起孩子，让它晒太阳吸收养分。许多工匠觉得这景象有种奇异的庄严，便创作出不少雕像与塑像。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME finds the sunniest spot it can to hold its child aloft and let it absorb the sunlight for nutrients. Many artisans find the sight of it oddly majestic, and many a statue and figure have been made of the scene.

entry: POKENAME活泼好斗，靠啃咬没见过的东西认识世界。无论野外生活，还是由训练家照料，都需要监护者时刻看顾，以免误吞有害物。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: Playful and scrappy, POKENAME learns about the world by gnawing on anything new to them. Whether in the wild or in the care of a trainer, constant supervision from their guardian is needed to keep POKENAME from ingesting anything harmful.

entry: POKENAME喜欢看孩子与其他幼崽玩耍，经常也会加入。它们很爱拉绳拔河，却总会在拉上几次后，故意让孩子赢。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to see their child play with other children and often join in on the fun themselves. They love to pull on ropes in games of tug-of-war, but they always let the children win after a few tugs.

entry: POKENAME喜欢和孩子玩捉迷藏，孩子却经常就躲在它背上的花茎顶端。等它终于放弃寻找，藏身处揭晓后，它便用柔软的长藤蔓给孩子挠痒痒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to play games of hide-and-seek with their child, who often hide atop the stalk on their back. When they inevitably give up and the child's hiding location is revealed, they tickle their child with long, soft vines.

entry: POKENAME会用坚固的獠牙，雕凿能找到的最好材料，在阁楼或地下室筑巢。有些入侵问题会自行解决，因为它一旦认为住户会带坏孩子，就会离开。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: Using their sturdy fangs, POKENAME will carve out the best material it can find to make a nest within attics or basements. Some POKENAME infestations will resolve themselves if POKENAME believes the people there are a bad influence on its child.

entry: POKENAME是一对奇怪的字母状生物，从不会相距太远。“孩子”似乎喜欢弄脏自己，用身体涂污墙面，让“父母”十分懊恼。
author: sk372
source: A strange pair of letter-like creatures, POKENAME are never seen far apart from one another. The "child" seems to enjoy getting dirty and defacing walls with its body, much to the "parent's" chagrin.

entry: 多数人还不确定，究竟是未知图腾，还是与其相似的古文字先出现。许多研究者则认为，POKENAME及其后代，启发了如今所知的小写字母。不过，这还没有确凿证据。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: While most are unsure if Unown or the ancient writings they resemble came first, many researchers think that POKENAME and their offspring were the inspiration for lowercase letters as we know them today. However, this still isn't outright confirmed.

entry: POKENAME看起来像连体的父母与孩子，父母承受捕食者的大部分攻击。虽然尚未证实，人们相信孩子最终会从父母身上脱落，才能完全成熟。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears to be a conjoined parent and child, with the parent taking the brunt of violence from predators. Though unconfirmed, it's believed the child eventually falls off the parent in order to fully mature.

entry: POKENAME的孩子藏在躯干周围的棱脊下。必要时，它会把这些部分全部猛烈射向敌人，保护孩子，再退到安全处，等保护壳重新长出。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's child is hidden beneath the ridges surrounding its torso. If necessary to protect the child, it will burst all these pieces violently at foes, before retreating somewhere safe to let the protective shell regrow.

entry: 孩子天生好奇，父母却保护过度。幼崽藏在里面时，POKENAME还算平静，可一旦探头向外看，父母就可能因一点风吹草动而发射尖刺。
author: sk372
source: The child is naturally curious, and the parent overly protective. If the child hides within, POKENAME is relatively calm, but if the baby curiously peeks outside, its parent may fire spikes at the slightest movement.

entry: POKENAME会与幼崽合作，在森林中寻找甜美水果和花蜜。找到好食物后，总让孩子先吃个够，父母再吃剩下的。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME works in tandem with its young to search for sweet fruits and nectar in forests. Once they have found a good source of food, the child will be allowed to gorge itself first before the parent eats what is left.

entry: 袭击鸟宝可梦的巢时，POKENAME会与孩子合作。父母挡住护巢者，孩子则尽可能多拿蛋，随后被抱回袋里，一起迅速逃走。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: POKENAME and their child work together when raiding the nests of bird Pokémon. While POKENAME fends off the parent, the child grabs as many eggs as it can, before POKENAME scoops them back into their pouch for a swift escape.

entry: POKENAME的视力不佳，飞行时由背上的幼崽引路。孩子会拉扯背部特定的羽毛，传达速度和方向。
author: .izik
source: The baby on POKENAME's back guides the parent while flying due to the parent's poor eyesight. It does this by pulling on certain feathers on its back to communicate speed and direction.

entry: POKENAME是顶级捕食者，锐利的爪子能轻易击败其他鸟宝可梦。它们会带着一块形似袋兽幼崽的特殊石头，练习照顾蛋。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are apex predators and can easily take out other bird Pokémon with their sharp talons. They carry a special rock that resembles a baby Kangaskhan to practice taking care of eggs.

entry: 雄性POKENAME负责护巢、抚育幼崽，雌性则寻找食物。在野外，人们也见过它们按群落需要交换角色，有时会蜕皮，呈现相应的变化。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Male POKENAME are expected to protect the nest and raise the young, while females search for food. In the wild, they have been observed changing roles to suit their tribe's needs, occasionally shedding their skin to reflect this.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴呈现母亲的模样，让整体看上去像母亲守护着孩子。遇袭时，它们会把尾巴当棒槌，疯狂挥舞。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's tail has the appearance of their mother, making them look like a mother protecting their child. If attacked, they will swing this tail wildly like a club.

entry: POKENAME的防护穹顶里，有供孩子驾驶的座舱。那些操纵装置其实什么也控制不了，但母亲会假装有用，哄孩子开心。
author: kiwiarms
source: Inside POKENAME's protective dome is a cockpit for its child to pilot it from. The controls don't actually do anything, but the mother pretends they do to make the child happy.

entry: POKENAME的头偶尔会像程序出错般消失，不知去了哪里。孩子必须指挥身体，直到头部终于瞬间移动回原位。
author: sk372
source: On occasion, POKENAME's head glitches out and vanishes to parts unknown. The child must direct the body until the cranium manages to teleport back in place.

entry: POKENAME很少独处，总会靠近能够照顾自己的对象。受到威胁时，不论监护者是人类还是宝可梦，都会涌起强烈的护幼怒火，直到威胁解除。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: POKENAME are very rarely seen alone, gravitating towards anyone able to take care of them. If threatened, their guardian, human or Pokémon, will feel a surge of protective rage until the threat is dealt with.

entry: 进化后，POKENAME会离开训练家数天，直到找到一只失去父母的同类才回来。它会像兄长或姐姐那样，保护对方，也教它战斗。
author: icelevelincarnate
