source: POKENAME are very proud of their beauty, gathering clay to build urns depicting the colors and patterns of their scales. Washed-up fragments of these urns make for popular jewelry, leading people to paint seaglass to sell as counterfeit imitations.

entry: POKENAME形似长鳍的符号，会旋转、拍动鳍，与其他水生宝可梦交流。遇见训练家，它们就会从身体释放泡泡，试着沟通。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME take the form of a glyph that has fins and communicates with other aquatic Pokémon by swirling and flapping their fins. Whenever they encounter a Trainer, they release bubbles from their body in an effort to communicate.

entry: 有POKENAME栖息的河水，会送进专门的处理厂去毒。可惜，它们喜欢在管口磨角，堵住水流，还释放更多毒素，拖慢整个处理过程。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Water from rivers containing POKENAME is sent through specialized treatment plants to clear the poison. Unfortunately, POKENAME enjoy using the vents to polish their horns, blocking the flow and releasing excess toxins, delaying the whole process.

entry: 小池塘里，常能看见POKENAME摆弄自己的尾巴。它们通过皮肤喝水，过程却慢得难熬，只好找些事情打发时间。
author: jojojax164
source: Many POKENAME are found fidgeting with their tails in small ponds. POKENAME drink through their skin, but it's agonizingly slow, so they need to find a way to fill the time.

entry: 尽管栖息在水下，POKENAME的身体仍涌动着火焰与熔岩。褶边中富含吃小石子时吸收的矿物。
author: seaslux
source: Fire and magma burns from POKENAME's body despite its underwater habitat. Its frills are packed with minerals absorbed through a diet of small pebbles.

entry: POKENAME硬壳里的水不断沸腾。它姿态优雅，不太容易得到，还能充当增氧气石，因此很受水族爱好者珍视。
author: seaslux
source: Water boils inside POKENAME's hardened shell. As an elegant, somewhat hard-to-obtain Pokémon that also functions as an airstone, it is prized by aquarists.

entry: POKENAME能闻出栖身河流附近生长的菌类。它会慢慢挪上岸采蘑菇，却总要先潜回水里，才开始吃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can smell fungus growing near the rivers it inhabits. It shuffles onto land to get the mushrooms, but always dives back into the water before it begins eating.

entry: 雷暴期间，POKENAME会迅速逆流而上，用角引开闪电，保护同伴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims quickly upstream during thunderstorms, using its horn to divert lightning from its allies.

entry: POKENAME住在沉船内，用遗失的宝藏掩藏亮角与彩色褶边。若被潜水者发现，就会送上宝物，换取清静。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: A POKENAME will make its home within a shipwreck, using lost treasure to disguise its shiny horns and colorful frills. If it's spotted by a diver, it will offer them treasure in exchange for being left alone.

entry: POKENAME的金属利爪，连最坚固的壳也能撕开。据说，只需一挥，就足以攻破杰尼龟的防御。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's metallic talons can tear through even the toughest shells. A single swipe is said to be strong enough to pierce a Squirtle's defense.

entry: POKENAME聪明好奇，多彩的鳞片与飘逸的鳍，让它既是受欢迎的宠物，也是画家喜爱的模特。描绘它的经典画作，曾卖出数十亿的高价。
author: t3isukone
source: The clever and curious POKENAME's colorful scales and billowing fins make it popular not only as a pet but also as a model for artists. Classic paintings of POKENAME have sold for billions.

entry: 常能看见POKENAME把年幼的角蛋养在育儿袋里。这些小家伙力量不大，却是出色的游泳健将，速度很快。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME can be observed raising young Golcute in its pouch. While they aren't particularly strong, they are excellent and speedy swimmers.

entry: POKENAME会蜷起身体，喷出水柱加速，撞向对手来防身。蜷缩时，皮肤明显更加坚韧，可能是因为肌肉绷得更紧。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME defend themselves by curling up and expelling jets of water to accelerate themselves and collide into others. Their hides are remarkably tougher when they are rolled up, likely due to the added tension of their muscles.

entry: POKENAME大多生活在降水丰富的森林。它尽量吸收雨水，保持毛发光亮，也方便在晴朗日子里，更好地吸收阳光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is mostly found in forest areas with high precipitation. It soaks up as much rain as it can to keep its fur glossy, and allow it to better absorb sunlight on the clearer sunny days.

entry: 刚融合出的POKENAME起初笨拙，游泳和走路都很吃力。但很快就会练出有力的肌肉，跑得连运动员也追不上。
author: bobosmith01
source: Newly created POKENAME start off clumsy and struggle to swim or walk, but they soon develop powerful muscles that allow them to outpace athletes.

entry: 虽然夸张的动作和飘动的鳍令人赏心悦目，POKENAME却拒绝被困在一处，无法容忍待在水族箱里。它们会快速踢腿，既用来游泳，也用来战斗。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although their exaggerated movements and billowing fins make them a joy to behold, POKENAME refuse to stay confined to one spot, and therefore will not tolerate being in an aquarium. They rapidly kick both to swim and to fight.

entry: POKENAME常在河岸与同类比拼力量。爱好者会聚集观看这些仪式，却小心保持距离，以免被群体察觉，招来攻击。
author: quantumradiation
source: POKENAME often competes with others of its species in tests of strength on riverbanks. Fans of this Pokémon gather to watch these rituals, but are careful to maintain distance lest the group notice them and turn aggressive.

entry: POKENAME会游向垂钓者，观察他们捕捉宝可梦。对方只要流露一丝攻击性，它就会用角割断钓线。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME swims toward Fishermen to observe them catching Pokémon. If the Fishermen are even the slightest bit aggressive, it will use its horn to sever the line.

entry: POKENAME常与一群雄性角金鱼同行，还能操控水流，为鱼群引路。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are often seen with a school of male Goldeen. They are able control the flow of the water to guide their school.

entry: POKENAME的战斗姿态优雅，少有其他宝可梦能比。它保护无法自卫的生物，击败大得多的敌人时，仿佛也毫不费力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's fights with an elegant grace matched by very few other Pokémon. Defending those who cannot defend themselves, it takes down far larger opponents with seemingly little effort.

entry: POKENAME能改变皮肤花纹，颜色却只能在橙与白之间变化。伪装方式如此特殊，让它们只能分布在少数珊瑚礁。
author: dylonk25
source: While POKENAME can change the patterns on its skin, its colors are limited to orange and white. Due to the specific nature of its camouflage, POKENAME's range is limited to a small number of coral reefs.

entry: 即使失去肢体，POKENAME也能用气泡重建义肢，足见它非凡的意志与决心。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME who lose a limb are able to reconstruct the body part with a prosthetic of bubbles. This is a testament to their incredible will and resolve.

entry: 即使失去肢体，POKENAME也能用气泡重建义肢，足见它非凡的意志与决心。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME who lose a limb are able to reconstruct the body part with a prosthetic of bubbles. This is a testament to their incredible will and resolve.

entry: POKENAME用华美飘逸的鳞片与迷人歌声吸引水手。可谁傻到靠近，头上毛发般的巨颚就会咬住对方。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lure sailors with their gorgeous, flowing scales and enchanting singing voice. However, the hair-like jaws on their head bite anyone foolish enough to approach.

entry: POKENAME会游在乌波群旁，摆动扇子般的大尾巴，引导正确方向。察觉危险后，它会警告伙伴躲藏，自己留下击退威胁。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME swims alongside groups of Wooper, waving its large, fan-like tail to guide them in the right direction. If POKENAME detects danger, it warns its group to hide while it fights off the threat.

entry: POKENAME出了名地虚荣，会以繁复的轨迹跃出海面，吸引水手赞叹。如果注意力减少，它可能会使出啄，击沉船只报复。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is notoriously vain, leaping from the sea in elaborate patterns to impress sailors. If attention wanes, it may retaliate by sinking ships with Peck.

entry: 晴天，POKENAME会挪上岸晒太阳。鸟宝可梦会落到它们背上，吃掉壳上挂住的藻类和海草。黄昏时，它们便清清爽爽地返回水中。
author: wiz0z
source: On sunny days, POKENAME push themselves on to the shore to bask in the sun. While they bask, bird Pokémon land on their backs and eat algae and seaweed that gets caught on their shells. At dusk, POKENAME returns to the water fresh and clean.

entry: 民间故事说，POKENAME曾在大河上搭成桥，让两位恋人秘密相会。春天，情侣们在河岸野餐，看着一列列POKENAME逆流而上，庆祝彼此坚定的感情。
author: wiz0z
source: Folk stories tell of POKENAME forming a bridge across a great river to help two lovers meet in secret. In spring, couples picnic on riverbanks as lines of POKENAME swim upstream, celebrating their commitment to each other.

entry: POKENAME通常住在瀑布底部，喜欢沿瀑布上下攀游嬉戏。背上的火焰透过水流发光，玩耍时便让瀑布中映出彩虹。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME typically live at the base of waterfalls. They enjoy playing by climbing up and down the falls. The flames on their backs glow through the water, casting rainbows through the waterfall as they play.

entry: 关都经常举办捕捉POKENAME的钓鱼比赛，钓到最大个体的人获胜。为了保护自己或家人，它会毫不犹豫地用额头毒角刺穿敌人。
author: fiordaliso
source: In Kanto, fishing contests are often held to catch POKENAME, and whoever catches the largest one is declared the winner. It does not hesitate to impale enemies with the poisonous horn on its forehead to protect itself or its family.

entry: POKENAME闪亮的鳞片，常被缝进婚纱。如果婚礼中下雨，水滴落在鳞片上，礼服就会闪耀得如同星空。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's shimmering scales are often sewn into wedding gowns. If it rains during the ceremony, the dress sparkles like stars as water strikes the scales.

entry: POKENAME有“海洋公主”之称，摆动裙摆般的鳍和双腿游泳。美丽的外表，让它成为富人身边价值不菲的宠物。
author: melodydelune
source: Known as "The Sea Princess," POKENAME swim by swishing their dress-like fins and legs. They are high-value pets for the rich because of their beauty.

entry: POKENAME对外表一丝不苟，尤其爱惜头上的大鳍。担心战斗中损伤它们，遇险时便用强健的双腿游走逃跑。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME are very fastidious about their appearance, particularly the large fins on their heads. Cautious of damaging them in fights, POKENAME flee danger using their powerful legs to swim away.

entry: POKENAME体形小巧，游到哪里，哪里就有柔和暖意。发光的角提供足够热量，让附近宝可梦感到舒适，是寒冷水域中受欢迎的伙伴。
author: curazy
source: POKENAME is a small Pokémon that carries a gentle warmth wherever it swims. Its glowing horn provides enough heat to comfort nearby Pokémon, making it a welcome companion in cold waters.

entry: POKENAME是优雅的融合体，喜欢傍晚在岩石上起舞。诡异的火焰与流畅动作，常会吸引一小群宝可梦聚来，观看演出。
author: curazy
source: POKENAME is a graceful fusion that enjoys dancing atop rocks during the evening. Its eerie flames and flowing movements often attract small audiences of Pokémon, which gather nearby to watch its performances.

entry: 追求力量的训练家会让POKENAME进化成金鱼战龙；追求美丽的人，则已对它华丽闪耀的身姿心满意足。
author: rooboid
source: Trainers who seek power evolve their POKENAME into Seaxorus, but Trainers who seek beauty are more than happy with this gorgeous, shimmering Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME靠超能力，能在水下彻底隐形。身上的纹路，宛如波浪，流转全身。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are able to become completely invisible underwater thanks to its psychic powers. The patterns on its body ripple across its body like waves.

entry: POKENAME的身体似乎是胸口圆球操控的延伸部分。失去肢体时，断肢会迅速腐解、消散，它便利用浮游生物的生物质，让肢体重新长出。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME's body seems to be an extension controlled by the orb of its chest. When it loses limbs, they quickly decompose and disintegrate, so it uses the biomass of plankton to grow them back.

entry: 它的歌声像流水般令人安宁。如果没能哄对手入睡，POKENAME就会低下头，挺角向前冲。
author: .jerden
source: It sings songs as soothing as the sound of flowing water. If an opponent is not lulled to sleep by its voice, POKENAME will lower its head and charge forward with its horn.

entry: POKENAME眼睛鼓鼓，性情胆怯，常被当作游园会的奖品。于是，虽模样古怪，却成了颇常见的新手伙伴。
author: rooboid
source: Known for its bulbous eyes and cowardly nature, POKENAME are often won as carnival prizes, making it a common and rather odd-looking starter Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME精力充沛，鳍又华美，深受水生宝可梦收藏者珍视。不过，鳍长得过长，容易受伤生病，必须细心照料。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME are prized amongst collectors of aquatic Pokémon for their energetic personalities and luxurious fins. Diligent care is required due to the length of their fins, which makes them prone to injury and illness.

entry: POKENAME身体密度与水不同，能轻松沿河岸移动。酷热时，可见它们挤在石头和睡莲的阴影下。
author: rooboid
source: The density of POKENAME's body differs from water, allowing it to navigate riverbanks with ease. On particularly hot days, groups of POKENAME can be found compacted together in the shade of stones and water lilies.

entry: 夏天白日里，大群POKENAME会倒挂在水上桥梁下休息。太阳落山，它们便飞向天空。这一景象，是华蓝市热门的观光项目。
author: bobosmith01
source: Large groups of POKENAME rest upside-down under bridges that extend above water during summer days. When the sun sets, they fly off into the sky. This event is a popular tourist attraction for Cerulean City.

entry: 人们常看见成群POKENAME在池塘中进出潜游，寻找水生虫属性宝可梦吃。鲜艳的羽毛，让它们成为户外摄影的热门对象。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flocks are often seen diving in and out of ponds in search of aquatic Bug-type Pokémon to feed on. Their vividly coloured feathers make them a popular subject of outdoor photography.

entry: 夏天白日里，大群POKENAME会倒挂在水上桥梁下休息。太阳落山，它们便飞向天空。这一景象，是华蓝市热门的观光项目。
author: bobosmith01
source: Large groups of POKENAME rest upside-down under bridges that extend above water during summer days. When the sun sets, they fly off into the sky. This event is a popular tourist attraction for Cerulean City.

entry: POKENAME肉质肥美，游起水来却意外出色。许多保护人士，都致力于守护这种独特的宝可梦。
author: rooboid
source: While it is indeed delicious and fatty, POKENAME is a surprisingly good swimmer, and many activists ensure the protection of this unique Pokémon.

entry: 为了不引人注意，POKENAME会把鳍折在角上，扎进地里，伪装成小石头或珊瑚碎块。它讨厌强光，会立刻用角刺向光源，试图毁掉。
author: soup1900
source: To avoid attention, POKENAME folds its fins over its horn and plants itself in the ground to look like a small rock or piece of coral. It hates bright light and will immediately try to jab at the source with its horn to destroy it.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，鳞片看似化作棱镜，射出一道道彩虹光。可透过相机观察，就能发现真相：它只是用精神力量，改变了附近观众的感知。
author: bobosmith01
source: When POKENAME dances, its scales appear to act like prisms and radiate rainbow streaks of light. However, viewing this phenomenon through a camera reveals the truth: POKENAME is merely using psychic power to alter the nearby viewers' perception.

entry: POKENAME像一只被活塑料袋困住的角金鱼。角金鱼外貌与融合前相同，却似乎继承了破破袋的部分耐毒能力，能轻松活在肮脏、难以呼吸的水里。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME resembles a Goldeen trapped inside an animate plastic bag. The Goldeen looks just as it did before fusing, but it seems to have inherited some of Trubbish's poison tolerance, as it has no trouble surviving in dirty, unbreathable water.

entry: POKENAME高速向前喷射游动后，很难转向。它常因此忘了留意周围，弄得晕头转向，或迷失方向。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME struggles to turn after it jets forward at high speeds. Losing track of its surroundings, it often becomes disoriented or lost.

entry: POKENAME能从身体两侧的鳍分泌泡沫，形成翅膀，飞上较矮的瀑布。过去，人们把成群的它们逆瀑而上，视为春回大地的吉兆。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME secretes a foamy substance from the fins on the sides of its body, creating wings it uses to fly up short waterfalls. Seeing schools of POKENAME swimming up waterfalls was seen as a good omen that spring was upon the land.

entry: POKENAME会先甩动锚状尾巴，将敌人打晕，再使出啄攻击。一击就能把对手打飞100多英尺。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swings its anchor-like tail to stun enemies before attacking with a Peck. The blow can send opponents flying over 100 feet.

entry: POKENAME咬走鱼线上的饵，留作己用。返回海底时，身上会挂满小饰物与拟饵，吸引自己的猎物。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME bite off bait from fishing lines, stealing it to use for themselves. They return to the ocean floor decorated in trinkets and lures to entice their prey.

entry: POKENAME会埋伏等待其他鱼类。合适的目标进入范围，它就眨眼展示“独特”的美，把对方迷住。趁目标目眩时，它便破坏对方的鳞片，让其变得和自己一样“漂亮”。
author: speciessaladmallory
source: POKENAME lies in wait for other fish. Once a suitable target is within range, it shows its "unique" beauty by winking to stun them. While they are dazzled, it sabotages their scales so that they look just as "pretty" as POKENAME does.

entry: POKENAME以交谊舞般优雅的风格战斗。它先用飘逸尾巴分散对手注意，再挥动大爪，旋身击中。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME fights with an elegant, ballroom dance-style of combat. It will distract opponents with its flowing tail before landing a spinning strike from its large claws.

entry: POKENAME会在珊瑚礁中原地摇摆，挥动带花纹的手臂和鳍，模仿小型水属性宝可梦。这能把潜在捕食者引进攻击范围，为它提供充足食物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME sway in place within coral reefs, waving their patterned arms and fins to mimic the movements of small Water-type Pokémon. These movements lure would-be predators into striking range, providing POKENAME with plenty of food.

entry: 无可争议的优雅姿态，加上宽鳍的形状，让POKENAME得到“起舞海藻”的绰号。它需要清澈、始终温暖的水，才能保持身体色彩鲜亮。
author: fiordaliso
source: The undisputed elegance of POKENAME and the shape of its broad fins have earned it the nickname “dancing seaweed.” It needs to live in clear, consistently warm waters to keep the colors of its body bright and vivid.

entry: 无可争议的优雅姿态，加上宽鳍的形状，让POKENAME得到“起舞海藻”的绰号。它需要清澈、始终温暖的水，才能保持身体色彩鲜亮。
author: fiordaliso
source: The undisputed elegance of POKENAME and the shape of its broad fins have earned it the nickname “dancing seaweed.” It needs to live in clear, consistently warm waters to keep the colors of its body bright and vivid.

entry: POKENAME能用精神力量，同时操控火与水。它常出现在关都的祭典中，把火焰与液体交织成鱼的形状。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to manipulate both fire and water. It frequents Kantonian festivals, weaving flames and liquids into fish-like masses.

entry: POKENAME通过别在飘逸裙摆上的一对贝壳，引导精神力量。捕食者来袭时，它会释放储存的能量，让速度最多再增加30节。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME channels its psychic powers through the twin shells pinned to its flowing dress. When predators try to attack POKENAME, it expels the stored energy to increase its speed by up to 30 knots.

entry: 人们能看见POKENAME平静地沿河漂浮，壳露在水面。据说，背上喷出的间歇泉，在阳光下闪烁得十分美丽。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME can be seen floating calmly along rivers with its shell visible on the surface. The geyser that comes from its back is said to shimmer beautifully in the sun.

entry: POKENAME水分不足时，动作迟缓。保持湿润，速度与灵活度才会上升，因此它总想在身上的碟状结构里存些水，让身体更久不干。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME moves sluggishly when its body lacks sufficient moisture. Its speed and agility increase while moisturized, so it tries to keep a collection of water in the dish upon its body so it can remain hydrated for longer.

entry: 虽然水陆两栖，POKENAME却必须定期回到水里，否则身体会逐渐无法正常运作。因此，它们通常不会远离栖身的多水山谷。
author: bobosmith01
source: Despite being amphibious, POKENAME must return to the waters periodically or their body starts not being able to function. As a result, they usually do not stray far from the water-filled mountain valleys where they live.

entry: 有些地区试着把POKENAME当作比爱心鱼更华美的礼物，但它脾气凶猛，并不适合送给心爱的人。
author: sk372
source: Some regions attempted to use POKENAME as a more glamorous gift counterpart to Luvdisc, but the Pokémon's aggressive temperament made it ill-suited to be a loved one's present.

entry: 养在水族箱里时，POKENAME会定期清理底床。既好看又实用，很受水族爱好者欢迎。
author: pokebio
source: When in an aquarium, POKENAME routinely cleans the substrate. This makes it popular among aquarists for its utility, as well as its looks.

entry: POKENAME爱待在许愿井底，这样，人们抛进井中的硬币，就都能被它偷走。
author: kitarchen
source: POKENAME are well known to hang out at the bottom of wishing wells. By doing so, it allows them to steal any coins that people throw in.

entry: 虽然鳍很大，POKENAME狩猎时却迅速精准。鳞片能呈现多样花纹与色彩，启发了世界各地的华贵礼服设计。
author: chibitales
source: Despite POKENAME's large fins, it is quick and precise while hunting. The many patterns and colors POKENAME's scales can take on have inspired luxury gowns all over the world.

entry: POKENAME试着用心灵感应交流游泳路线，却几乎总会引发剧烈头痛。因此，游起来远没有外表看着那么协调。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME attempt to communicate swimming patterns telepathically, but it almost always results in them getting intense headaches. As a result, their swimming tends to be a lot less coordinated than their appearance would suggest.

entry: POKENAME能适应多种水生环境，在咸水和淡水中都能舒服生活。不过，它们容易突然发狂，打碎水箱，因此不建议水族馆饲养。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can tolerate a wide variety of aquatic habitats, enabling them to comfortably live in both salt and fresh water. Despite this, aquariums are advised not to keep them as they are prone to lashing out and breaking their tanks.

entry: POKENAME在海面快速划游，鳍随身后激起的浪花飘动。救生员经常借助它们，救援挣扎中的游泳者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME paddle across the surface of the ocean at high speed, their fins billowing in the wake they create behind themselves. Lifeguards make regular use of them to rescue struggling swimmers.

entry: 春天，成群的POKENAME会迁回出生的溪流与河道。它们喷出的水，足以让猎物严重烫伤。
author: melodydelune
source: In spring, groups of POKENAME can be seen migrating to the streams and rivers of their birth. The water they spout leaves intense burns on their prey.

entry: 它在透明如玻璃的育儿袋中，养育角金鱼。看袋中角金鱼的体型与状态，就能判断POKENAME是否健康。
author: rooboid
source: This Pokémon raises Goldeen in its glassy pouch. The overall health of a POKENAME can be determined by the condition and size of its Goldeen.

entry: POKENAME体内藏着一个小型生态系统。可它太爱徒手搏斗，常会打得这个小天地，整个裂开。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME hosts a small ecosystem within its body. Its love of hand-to-hand combat often results in this ecosystem being smashed open.

entry: 它的身体始终湿润，能让近身攻击滑开，是出色的斗士。为了长肌肉，POKENAME只吃一种蛋白质极丰富的特殊藻类。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its constantly moist body causes melee attacks to slip off, making it an exceptional fighter. To build muscle, POKENAME feeds exclusively on a particular, highly protein-rich algae.

entry: POKENAME色彩鲜艳，外形如植物，会吸引食草猎物。这也让有志从事水产养殖的人很感兴趣，把它们放进大型饲养环境，既作展示，也作装饰。
author: wiz0z
source: The bright colors and plant-like appearance of POKENAME's body draw in herbivorous prey. These features also make them attractive prospects for aspiring aquaculturists, placing them in large habitats as both the exhibit and decoration.

entry: POKENAME常被选来养在家庭水族箱中，与其他小型水生宝可梦相处融洽。它们贪吃，经常吞下过量食物，主人需要仔细安排，少量分次喂食。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is a common choice for household aquariums and gets along well with other small, aquatic Pokémon. It is voracious and often gobbles up more food than it can handle, so owners need to carefully spread out small feedings.

entry: POKENAME一旦用嘴咬住东西，除非自己愿意，否则几乎不可能被拉开。垂钓者必须小心，免得连鱼竿也保不住。
author: camtft
source: Once POKENAME latch onto something with their mouth, it becomes nearly impossible to detach them against their will. Fishermen must be cautious for fear of losing their rods.

entry: 它跃出海湾、奔向陆地时，带着点点火光的鳍随风飘动，映出彩虹。锋利的角摸起来暖暖的。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its fluttering fire-flecked fins create rainbows as it hops out of the bay and gallops across the land. Its sharp horn is warm to the touch.

entry: 一些神话研究者推测，部分传说中奔腾的水之精灵，实际上可能就是POKENAME。野生个体绝不会出现在远离水的地方。
author: bobosmith01
source: Several mythologists speculate that the galloping water spirits described in some myths may have actually been POKENAME. Wild POKENAME will never be found far from the water.

entry: POKENAME游动时会散落鳞片，留下闪亮的踪迹。鳞片漂流中吸附海水，很受制作香薰蜡烛的人欢迎。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME scatter scales as they swim, creating a shimmering trail behind them. Their scales collect seawater as they drift, causing them to be popular material for scented candles.

entry: POKENAME从不放开当武器携带的芦苇，一旦丢失，就会哭上数星期。鲜艳的色彩与优雅泳姿，让它在选美比赛中备受青睐。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME never parts with the reed it carries like a weapon; if it loses it, it cries for weeks. Thanks to its vibrant colors and elegant swimming, it is highly appreciated in beauty competitions.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片能承受冰冻低温。夏天，鳞片会脱落到海里，在水面留下反光的轨迹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's scales can endure freezing temperatures. During the summer, they shed into the sea, creating reflective trails on the water's surface.

entry: POKENAME漂浮在客船附近，等待有人丢弃垃圾。它用角把废物拖进浪下，再吃掉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats near passenger ships, waiting for trash to be discarded. It uses its horn to drag waste beneath the waves and consume it.

entry: 饮食良好时，POKENAME壳上的花纹会更鲜艳复杂，因此野外的美丽外壳能吸引伴侣。大耳朵对水下声音敏感，能早早发现捕食者，留出充足时间躲藏。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's shell patterns become more vibrant and intricate when it has a good diet, so in the wild a beautiful shell will attract mates. Its large ears are sensitive to underwater noises, allowing it to detect predators with plenty of time to hide.

entry: POKENAME在大型淡水池塘筑巢，夜里钻进泥中，只露出炮筒。虽然体形笨重，强力尾巴却让它游得优雅。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME makes its nest in large freshwater ponds where it can burrow into the mud at night, only the cannons visible. Despite its bulk, it swims gracefully thanks to its powerful tail.

entry: POKENAME开心时，会吐出粉红小珍珠，送给朋友。独特的色泽，让这些珍珠深受收藏家珍视。
author: .izik
source: When happy, POKENAME spits out tiny pink pearls as gifts to its friends. These pearls are highly valued by collectors for their unique hue.

entry: 一群角金鱼操纵着大岩蛇骇人的遗骸，以POKENAME的姿态，再度活动。它们共享思想，行动也如一个整体。
author: rooboid
source: Operated by a school of Goldeen, the ghastly remains of an Onix live again in the form of POKENAME. This Pokémon acts and thinks as a combined entity.

entry: POKENAME的角会分泌微弱毒液，用来击昏猎物。它们常亲昵地顶蹭训练家的腿，却也因此让训练家头昏。
author: radiance8990
source: POKENAME's horns secrete a weak venom that they use to knock out their prey. They often butt against their Trainer's leg affectionately, but that results in the Trainer feeling woozy.

entry: 最强的POKENAME在鱼群中威望很高，担任首领。但实际并没强太多，反而常最先成为猎物。随着年龄增长，鳍上的黑点也会增加。
author: mistymagius
source: The strongest POKENAME lead their school with high prestige, but they are not much stronger and are often picked off first. As they age, more black spots appear on their fins.

entry: POKENAME脑后长着细长的骨质突起，水下活动时会来回摇摆。它们有时还会把更多骨头卡在上面，让自己显得更大。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have long bony protrusions on the back of their heads that sway whenever they are underwater. Sometimes they wedge more bones to these protrusions to make themselves look bigger.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在沼泽水下，制造浮向水面的泡泡。等泡泡到了水面，它们就将其弄破，释放里面的恶臭。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lurk beneath swampy water, where they create bubbles that float to the water's surface. Once the bubbles reach the surface, POKENAME pop the bubbles to release the foul stench inside.

entry: 等待进化时，POKENAME会附着在水面上方的树枝。这样，即使被其他宝可梦撞落，也能掉进深水逃走。
author: radiance8990
source: While waiting to evolve, POKENAME attaches itself to a tree branch above water. This way, if a Pokémon knocks it off the branch, it can fall into deep waters and flee.

entry: POKENAME的角充满毒液，刺中后会让伤口发炎。如果目标太远，刺不到，它们就会把毒液装进泡泡，泼洒到敌人身上。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's horns are full of venom and cause inflammation at the site of the sting. If their target is too far away to be stung, they fill bubbles with this venom to soak their foes with.

entry: POKENAME主要靠带毒的刺击对付敌人。如果目标太远，它们就把毒液装进泡泡，弥补距离。泡泡中满是腐臭，连其他毒属性宝可梦也会退缩。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME mainly rely on their venomous foes to stab foes, but if their target is too far away, they can fill bubbles with venom to close the gap. The bubbles are filled with a fetid odor that causes even other Poison-types to recoil.

entry: POKENAME在水中沿直线游动，撞到什么，就在上面穿出一个洞。它似乎用不上角钻出的洞，却总一门心思想再多钻几个。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME swims through the water in straight lines, punching a hole in any object it collides with. It doesn't seem to have any use for the holes it makes with its horn, but it always seems to be determined to make more.

entry: POKENAME会被养在船上医务室，蛋的疗效从晕船到坏血病都能照顾到。水手若落海，它总是第一个下水，连最强的回流也能逆游。
author: ghostslythe
source: Kept aboard ship medical bays, POKENAME's eggs have been known to heal everything from seasickness to scurvy. If a Sailor falls overboard, it is the first in the water, able to swim against even the strongest of undertows.

entry: 攀上瀑布前，POKENAME会释放烟幕，遮住捕食者视线。最先抵达顶端的个体，就会成为群体首领。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases Smokescreen to obscure predators before climbing waterfalls. The first to reach the top becomes the school's leader.

entry: 虽然个头小，POKENAME却好斗且领地意识强。它先向入侵者眼中喷墨，再迅速逼近，用尖角刺击。
author: sk372
source: Despite its small stature, POKENAME is aggressive and territorial, blinding intruders with shots of ink to the eyes before swiftly closing in to gore them with its sharp horn.

entry: 在野外，POKENAME同时遭角金鱼和金鱼王排斥、攻击，被迫独居，与其他宝可梦争夺食物和领地。因此，它们格外凶猛。
author: bobosmith01
source: In the wild, POKENAME are rejected and attacked by both Goldeen and Seaking, so they are forced to live a solitary life and compete with other Pokémon for food and territory. As a result, they are unusually aggressive.

entry: POKENAME的角很重，足以让它飞行时低下头。它会猛然扎进水中，以撞击捕猎。
author: radiance8990
source: The weight of POKENAME's horn is enough to make its head dip during flight. It fishes for prey by plummeting into the water to strike.

entry: POKENAME保护水生宝可梦，会攻击在其水域垂钓的人。它们把钓线缠在角上，再用尽力气一拉，将其扯断。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are protective of aquatic Pokémon and attack fishermen who fish in their waters. They snap fishing lines by curling them around their horn before pulling as hard as they can.

entry: 为了保护水中的同伴，POKENAME会把四肢缠上钓线。困惑的渔民一将它们钓上来，它们就会疯狂挺角乱刺，大肆破坏。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wrap their limbs around fishing lines to protect their aquatic brethren. Once fished up by bewildered fishermen, POKENAME wreak havoc by frantically stabbing anything they can with their horn.

entry: POKENAME以美丽的花纹与角闻名。角最长、花纹最繁复的个体，很受收藏家追捧。
author: astral_1447
source: POKENAME are well known for their beautiful patterns and horns, and the ones with the longest horns and most intricate patterns are sought out by collectors.

entry: POKENAME是常见的融合体，几乎什么水域都能繁殖。科学家发现，它们似乎比鲤鱼王聪明，许多个体能避开常见鱼钩，连挂着优质饵料的也不例外。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are a common fusion that breeds in nearly any kind of water. Scientists have noted that they appear more intelligent compared to Magikarp: many avoid common fishing hooks, even ones with quality bait.

entry: POKENAME极善于抓住进食机会，经常为找食物而袭击人类。虽然凶猛，它的肉仍被视为珍馐，以紧实、黄油般滑润的肉质和独特条纹鳞片闻名。
author: turron_turron
source: POKENAME are highly opportunistic feeders that frequently attack humans in search of food. Despite their aggression, POKENAME meat is considered a delicacy, marked by a tough, buttery texture and its distinctive striped scales.

entry: POKENAME会藏在浅水池中进化。喝下它躺过的水，会肚子剧痛。
author: radiance8990
source: POKENAME hides itself in a shallow pool of water to evolve. Drinking water a POKENAME lay in brings about a terrible stomachache.

entry: POKENAME用镰刀般的双手贴水滑行，以极快速度穿越湖海。激起的猛烈波浪，常会惊扰其他水生生物。
author: fxncy_poland
source: POKENAME skim through water on their scythe-like hands to cross lakes and oceans at extreme speeds, often disturbing other aquatic life through violent waves.

entry: POKENAME把鳍翼中的电流汇入角，朝前方放出弧形的连锁闪电。它用来捕猎水下生物，电到猎物浮上水面。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME funnels electricity from its fin-wings into its horn, unleashing chain lightning in an arc in front of it. It uses the lightning to hunt underwater denizens, shocking them to the point they float to the surface.

entry: 进化后，POKENAME能高速跃出水面，短暂飞行。无论在浪上还是浪下，全身经过的地方，都会留下沸水和蒸汽。
author: alestrius
source: Upon evolving, POKENAME gains the ability to leap from the water at great speeds and fly for short periods of time. Whether above or beneath the waves, its entire body leaves boiling water and steam in its path.

entry: POKENAME巢穴下的地面，覆盖着白色碎屑。检测发现，其中含有大量角蛋白、骨质，以及极强的毒素。
author: radiance8990
source: The ground beneath a POKENAME's hive is covered in white shavings. Testing indicates high levels of keratin, bone, and a very potent poison.

entry: POKENAME是极其优雅的舞者，长鳍与精神操控的泡泡，让表演更加出色。金鱼王产卵季，只要它出现，其他金鱼王就会全部聚来。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME is an exceedingly graceful dancer, using its long fins and psychically-controlled bubbles to enhance its performance. If a POKENAME is present during Seaking spawning season, all the other Seaking will gather around it.

entry: POKENAME准备战斗时，会压低身体，缓缓来回摆尾，调整平衡与动势。它们先咬住对手，抛向空中，再用角刺击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME stand low to the ground to prepare for battle, slowly swaying their tails back and forth to try to set their balance and momentum. They fight by biting onto their opponents and tossing them into the air to strike with their horns.

entry: POKENAME住在多岩石的河床，哨兵能轻易探头出水。一有危险，哨兵就会大声呼叫，让整个群落藏起来，直到危险过去。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME make their home in rocky riverbeds where sentries can easily poke their heads out of the water. At the first sign of danger, the sentries will cry loudly, causing the entire colony to hide away until the danger passes.

entry: POKENAME潜水狩猎时，会把翅膀紧贴身体。它在河中灵巧穿游，冲向猎物时旋转身体，将角钻入目标。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tucks its wings in close when diving in the water to hunt. It swims nimbly through rivers, spinning its body to drill its horns into prey it charges down.

entry: 诱饵长得像两条角金鱼。捕食者以为能轻松得手而靠近时，POKENAME就放电将其击昏。
author: cartoonhostage
source: Its lures resemble a pair of Goldeen. When predators approach in hopes of easy prey, POKENAME delivers an electric shock that knocks them unconscious.

entry: POKENAME的触角会渗出藻根果味的液体，深受角金鱼喜爱。它用迅速的角击，守护角金鱼群。
author: .izik
source: Antennae on POKENAME leak Kelpsy Berry-flavored fluid loved by Goldeen. It guards Goldeen schools with swift horn strikes.

entry: POKENAME美味得入口即化，各地厨师都愿出高价求购。可它一受惊，就会躲进蛋里。
author: rooboid
source: Sought after for its delectable, melt-in-the-mouth texture, chefs the world over will pay handsomely for a POKENAME. It hides in its egg when scared.

entry: POKENAME原本美味的皮肤，进化后变酸，用来防备偷猎者和钓鱼人。它并不善游。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME's once-delicious skin becomes sour as it evolves; this is a defense mechanism to ward off poachers and anglers alike. It is a weak swimmer.

entry: 这种宝可梦常在淡水中睡觉，黎明时升上天空。虽然许多人称赞这景象美丽，它却会攻击过于靠近巢穴的人。
author: infinex21
source: This Pokémon tends to sleep in freshwater and rises into the skies at the break of dawn. Though many say this is a beautiful sight, it will attack anyone who strays too close to its nest.

entry: POKENAME待在海底，四处游动，寻找海草吃。水流太强时，它会用长尾固定在附近岩石上。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lies at the bottom of the ocean, swimming around looking for sea grass. When the water current gets too strong, it will anchor itself to a nearby rock with its long tail.

entry: 每三年，大群POKENAME便会聚集，逆流而上，交配产卵。它们力气大，却不太协调，不断互撞、把彼此挤出水面，让河流仿佛活了过来。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Great shoals of POKENAME gather every 3 years, to swim upstream to mate and lay their eggs. They have great strength, but little coordination, so are constantly bumping into each other and getting pushed out of the water, making rivers look alive.

entry: POKENAME体内储存的毒液，会在鳍上显成斑点，组成美丽花纹。毒越多，花纹越明显、越深。
author: radiance8990
source: The venom POKENAME stores in its body appears as spots on its fins, making beautiful patterns. The more poison it builds up, the more prominent and dark the patterns are.

entry: POKENAME拍动尾巴，仿佛游泳般在遗迹中飞舞。它们从角释放精神波动，吓走入侵者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME flutter through ruins by flapping their tail as though it were swimming. They release psychic waves from their horn to scare intruders away.

entry: 虽然身体沉重坚固，POKENAME却很擅长游泳。挡路的不论是人、巨石还是宝可梦，它钛一般坚韧的角都会直接破开。
author: ghostslythe
source: Despite its heavy, durable body, POKENAME is an adept swimmer. If an obstacle gets in its way, regardless if it's a human, boulder, or Pokémon, this species' titanium-tough horns break right through.

entry: 即使风暴中，POKENAME也能以无与伦比的力量游动。水龙卷与狂浪，都无法拖慢它的脚步。
author: .izik
source: Even during storms, POKENAME swims with unmatched power. Waterspouts and violent waves never slow its pace.

entry: 壮丽的鳍，让它能以无比优雅的姿态掠过水面。POKENAME用长喙，连藏在水下藻丛最小缝隙里的猎物也能赶出来。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its majestic fins let it glide over water with unmatched elegance. With its long beak, POKENAME can flush out prey hiding even in the smallest gaps among underwater algae.

entry: POKENAME靠尖角抵御捕食者，准头出色，一刺就能戳中眼睛，确保逃脱。喜爱收集角的人，常会猎捕它们，夺走角。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their sharp horn to defend themselves from predators. Their superb accuracy allows them to poke the eyes of predators with a single stab, ensuring escape. Horn enthusiasts often go hunting for POKENAME to steal their horns.

entry: POKENAME用触须附着在停泊的船上，再以尖角小心刮下藤壶吃掉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME clings to docked ships with its tentacles. It carefully scrapes and eats barnacles using its sharp horn.

entry: POKENAME极其保护附在鳍上的铁炮鱼，谁想靠近，就会被角刺击。为了吸引伴侣，它们会高高跃起，再快速旋转，增添风采。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are extremely protective of the Remoraid attached to their fins, jabbing anything that tries to approach them with their horns. To attract mates, they perform large leaps into the air while doing quick spins for extra flair.

entry: 据说，POKENAME会在海上引起雷暴，给自己充电。它们用角钻穿水下峡谷，在岩壁上开洞，住进凹坑里。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are said to cause thunderstorms at sea to charge themselves. They punch holes in underwater canyons by drilling into them with their horns, living inside the craters.

entry: POKENAME会潜入深海，用沉重的角撞碎沉船。如果遇到试图打捞失落宝藏的人，它们便会凶猛敌视、发动攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dive deep into the depths of the ocean to break apart sunken ships with their hefty horn. If they encounter any people trying to retrieve lost treasure, they respond with hostile aggression.

entry: 在一些地区，POKENAME被称为“诸海之王”，会严厉审视航海的人类。若觉得对方不够尊重海洋，它就唤出凶猛漩涡，几秒内连最坚固的船也能撕碎。
author: sk372
source: Dubbed "The King of All Oceans" in some regions, POKENAME harshly judges humans it sees sailing the seas. If it feels they do not respect the ocean enough, it summons vicious whirlpools that tear apart even the sturdiest ships in seconds.

entry: POKENAME沿海底行走觅食。尖角与橡胶般的皮肤，能抵御上方的捕食者。食物短缺时，它会完全停止活动，进入休眠。
author: roniodove
source: POKENAME treads along the seafloor in search of food. Their sharp horns and rubbery skin protect them from predators above. If food is scarce, POKENAME can enter a hibernation state by completely ceasing any movement.

entry: POKENAME成大群游动，跃出水面时景象绚丽。雄性好胜心极强，会试图用角刺穿彼此的翅膀。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME swim in large schools, leaping out of the water in a gorgeous spectacle. Male POKENAME are incredibly competitive and will attempt to pierce each other's wings with their horns.

entry: POKENAME常在美术馆徘徊，伪装成现代艺术的数字化作品。人们甚至见过它游进邻近画作，改变画面内容，让许多馆长苦恼不已。
author: victor9106
source: POKENAME often hangs around in art museums, disguising itself as digital interpretations of modern art. It has even been seen to swim into adjacent paintings and alter their contents, much to the dismay of many museum directors.

entry: POKENAME主要住在河水中，但上岸寻找树果吃时，也能存活相当久。它会把尖角在溪石上摩擦，保持光亮。
author: fiordaliso
source: Although POKENAME mainly lives in river waters, it can survive for quite some time on land when searching for berries to feed on. It keeps its sharp horn polished by rubbing it against the rocks found in the stream.

entry: POKENAME主要住在河水中，但上岸寻找树果吃时，也能存活相当久。它会把尖角在溪石上摩擦，保持光亮。
author: fiordaliso
source: Although POKENAME mainly lives in river waters, it can survive for quite some time on land when searching for berries to feed on. It keeps its sharp horn polished by rubbing it against the rocks found in the stream.

entry: POKENAME在水中游动时，仿佛从不牵动一丝肌肉。据说，神情哀伤，是因为体内寄宿着所有葬身海洋者的灵魂。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears to swim through the water without ever moving a muscle. It's said it wears a sorrowful expression due to housing the souls of all those who have been lost at sea.

entry: 组成花岩怪的108个灵魂，其苦痛已被游泳的快乐洗去。POKENAME乐观爱玩，会开心地用强角，将河边巨石雕成精巧的滑梯。
author: vic1312
source: The torment of the 108 spirits that formed Spiritomb has been washed away by the joy of swimming. POKENAME have an optimistic, playful disposition and happily carve riverside boulders into elaborate slides with their strong horns.

entry: POKENAME在水中强壮迅速，能急转追逐飞快游窜的猎物。鲜艳的体色与美丽花纹，也有助于吸引伴侣。
author: mepp.
source: In the water, POKENAME are powerful and swift, capable of making sharp turns to pursue darting prey. The bright colors and beautiful patterns on their bodies help in attracting potential mates.

entry: POKENAME会把鳍铺开，盖在身上，伪装成花，吸引寻找花蜜的宝可梦。对方一落到所谓的花瓣上，便几乎没有活路。
author: radiance8990
source: POKENAME can spread its fins out over its body to look like a flower to attract Pokémon seeking nectar. Once a Pokémon lands on its supposed petals, it is all but over for them.

entry: POKENAME住在深海，用大角击退其他大型宝可梦。不过，角成了热门收藏品，令它们的数量大幅减少。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in the deep ocean, using its large horn to fight off other large Pokémon. However, its numbers have severely declined, as its horn has become a desired collector's item.

entry: 住在POKENAME气泡里的宝可梦，会提供梳理和食物，换取保护。它通常生活在淡水中，但也有个体的气泡装着海水，住着海水宝可梦。
author: wiz0z
source: The Pokémon that live in POKENAME's bubble provide grooming and food in exchange for protection. While POKENAME are normally found in freshwater, some have bubbles carrying saltwater with saltwater Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用台球杆般长的角防身。身体侧面的辅助盾牌也能保护它，却没有角那样吓人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME defend themselves with a horn that is as long as a cue stick. Their auxiliary shield on their side also protects them from harm but is less intimidating than their horn.

entry: 野生POKENAME常悠然待在池塘或河边，留意水中的猎物。一旦发现目标，就会牢牢盯住，用带电水柱迅速击倒。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME often lounge near ponds and rivers, watching for any prey within the waters. Once they spot their target, they will never lose sight of them and will quickly take them down with electrified jets of water.

entry: 数世纪前，水手会在POKENAME断落的角上，刻下精巧图案，作为旅途礼物送回家。即使如今，这些角仍是很受欢迎的饰品。
author: wiz0z
source: Centuries ago, sailors would carve intricate images into the broken horns of POKENAME, sending them home as gifts to their families from their journeys. Even now, these horns remain a popular type of jewelry.

entry: 每年，成群的POKENAME都会来到岸边求偶。雄性会亮出鲜艳的花纹，跳起舞蹈，吸引雌性。
author: melodydelune
source: Once a year, groups of POKENAME gather by the shore to perform courtship rituals. Males will attract females with vibrant patterns and dances.

entry: 这种宝可梦在空中已经很快，水下更能达到难以想象的速度。POKENAME借此撞穿巨石，在孔洞内产卵。
author: raydrago
source: While already fast in the air, this Pokémon can reach unimaginable speeds underwater. POKENAME uses this speed to punch holes into boulders to lay its eggs in.

entry: POKENAME成群穿游热带珊瑚礁，一起觅食。发现可能的食物后，它们会同时转向，从背上的炮筒发射集中的水柱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swim in shoals through tropical reefs, schooling together whilst hunting for food. When they spot a potential meal, they turn together and fire concentrated jets of water from the cannons on their backs.

entry: 在角卷耳和角兔的群体中，POKENAME担当照顾者，巡逻领地，抵御捕食者。渔民曾见过它们坐在岸边，替年幼角卷耳梳理鳍。
author: wiz0z
source: In schools of Goleary and Golpunny, POKENAME act as caretakers, patrolling their territory and fighting off predators. Fishermen have spotted them sitting on shorelines, grooming the fins of young Goleary.

entry: POKENAME已在相隔整片大洋的多个群岛上，世代繁衍。它们都是不经人类影响，自行抵达的。虽然泳技高超，却更喜欢住在陆地，四处分布安家。
author: thesilverowls
source: POKENAME have inhabited several island chains that are entire oceans apart for generations, where they have ventured without human influence. POKENAME are superb swimmers, but prefer to live on dry land, settling far and wide.

entry: POKENAME小巧可爱，乍看往往人畜无害。它有个淘气习惯，喜欢悄悄绕到毫无防备的宝可梦身后，用角戳一下。
author: curazy
source: POKENAME is a small and cute Pokémon that often appears harmless at first. It has a mischievous habit of sneaking behind unsuspecting Pokémon and poking them with its horn.

entry: 这种融合体会保护较小的水宝可梦。黄昏时，它在浅水周围巡逻，赶走捕食者，让脆弱的宝可梦安心待在领地内。
author: curazy
source: This fusion guards smaller water Pokémon from danger. It patrols around shallow waters at dusk, chasing away predators and keeping vulnerable Pokémon safely within its territory.

entry: 据说，龙卷寿司的灵感，就来自这只宝可梦。上半身能独立于下半身活动，不过，也不能离得太远。
author: rooboid
source: This Pokémon is said to have inspired the creation of dragon rolls. Its torso moves independently from its lower body, though it cannot stray too far.

entry: POKENAME用河边垃圾，包括毯子和纸板，制作金鱼王玩偶。不知为何，这些材料一经它们使用，就会变得防水。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME construct Seaking dolls out of riverside litter, including blankets and cardboard. Somehow, these materials became waterproof when POKENAME put them to use.

entry: POKENAME自认是家园中的顶级捕食者，可两个头对领地究竟在哪，始终意见不一。一个不断想让身体留在陆上，另一个却往水里拉，经常因此内讧。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sees itself as an apex predator of its home, though its heads disagree on what said territory is. One constantly tries to keep the body on land while the other pulls it towards the water, leading to regular infighting.

entry: 它的特殊技法，是让海洋化作宇宙虚空，持续约两秒，重创附近所有生物。光是它在场，似乎就能刺激海洋之主盖欧卡的肾上腺素分泌。
author: epping_forest
source: Its special technique consists of turning the sea into the void of space for a couple of seconds, causing severe damage to any living creature nearby. Its sole presence seems to awaken the adrenaline of Kyogre, the Lord of the Ocean.

entry: POKENAME是生活在大湖中的地盘恶霸。它凭体形与坚硬的角，攻击其他宝可梦、抢夺食物，还会啃咬碰巧驶过领地的船只。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a territorial bully that inhabits large lakes. It uses its bulk and solid horn to attack and steal food from other Pokémon, as well as taking gnawing on any boats that happen to float through its territory.

entry: POKENAME有个坏习惯，角一长得够大，就会把它吃掉。攻击猎物时，再把吞下的角高速吐出去。
author: enzo200
source: POKENAME has a bad habit of eating its horn when it grows big enough, they attack their prey by vomiting them out at high speeds.

entry: 春季，POKENAME会变得格外好斗，用尖角攻击其他宝可梦。鲜红的鳞片十分醒目，即使在水下，渔民也容易发现它的位置。
author: fiordaliso
source: During the spring, POKENAME becomes particularly aggressive and attacks other Pokémon with its sharp horn. Its red scales are very bright, allowing fishermen to easily spot its location even underwater.

entry: POKENAME会从高处跳进水里，水下比陆上灵活。不过，由于多次没落进水、反而撞到地面，头骨和角都变得极其坚硬。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME dives from high places towards bodies of water, and is more mobile underwater than on land. Its skull and horn have hardened intensely due to repeated impacts with the ground instead of water.

entry: POKENAME缺乏自信，害怕时就紧抱尾巴。圆圆的无辜眼睛，让宝可梦发烧友俱乐部的成员爱不释手。
author: radiance8990
source: POKENAME lacks confidence, clutching its tail when scared. Its round, innocent eyes are fawned over by Pokémon Fan Club members.

entry: 它像扇翅膀一样拍动鳍，在水中前进。虽然游得慢，仍能用角打出威力惊人的一击。
author: .jerden
source: It flaps its fins like wings to propel itself through the water. While it swims slowly, it can still strike foes with impressive force using its horn.

entry: POKENAME虽不擅长战斗，动作灵巧程度却远超常人。野外，很少见到POKENAME。
author: rooboid
source: Though POKENAME isn't well-suited for battle, it boasts a dexterity that far surpasses the average human's. POKENAME are seldom seen in the wild.

entry: 这种宝可梦总是一副惊讶的模样。角由强化的角蛋白构成，能轻易撞穿厚重巨石。
author: roundabout_robin
source: This Pokémon is perpetually surprised. Its horn is made of reinforced keratin, and has the power to break through thick boulders with ease.

entry: POKENAME泡进任何水域，水都会迅速升温，临时变成温泉。它能把角加热到白炽，造成三度烧伤。
author: sk372
source: Any body of water POKENAME takes a dip in quickly heats up and becomes an impromptu hot spring. It can warm up its horn until it becomes white-hot and capable of delivering third-degree burns.

entry: 许多代以来，POKENAME都因外貌丑陋，在宝可梦华丽大赛中备受冷落。近年却有人发现其魅力，组建了饲养俱乐部。
author: rakunk
source: For many generations, POKENAME was cast aside in Pokémon contests due to its ugly appearance. However, in recent years others have started to find POKENAME charming and built clubs around raising them.

entry: POKENAME会在海底成群围成圆圈。等它们开始跳舞，上方就会出现巨大的漩涡。
author: dodoowner_
source: Groups of POKENAME gather in circular formations on the ocean floor. When they begin to dance, a large whirlpool forms above them.

entry: POKENAME用细腻如丝的鳍，在游泳时模仿舞蹈，分散威胁的注意，也吸引猎物。它们用珍珠、心之鳞片和其他物品装饰自己，让表演更加耀眼。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME use their delicate, silky fins to mimic dancing as they swim, distracting any threats and attracting prey. They adorn themselves with pearls, Heart Scales, and various other items to add to their dazzling performance.

entry: 它飞快游动，试图用坚硬如石的大角，撞中目标。
author: pokopish
source: It swims at high speeds, attempting to ram targets with its large horn that is as hard as rock.

entry: 协调训练家喜欢臭得出奇的POKENAME，有一个特别的原因：臭味越浓，鳞片就越鲜亮健康。有些圈子因此很不赞同用香水掩盖气味。
author: bobosmith01
source: Coordinators love extremely smelly POKENAME for one specific reason: the stronger their stench, the brighter and healthier their scales are. Using perfumes to douse the scent is frowned upon in several circles.

entry: 它用泡泡构成的翅膀，兴高采烈地飞行。脾气却出乎意料地多变，喜欢什么就用泡沫清洗，讨厌什么就用角撞。
author: empty_set
source: It flies along gleefully on bubbly wings. Surprisingly temperamental, it tries to clean anything it's fond of with its suds, while headbutting anything it dislikes with its horn.

entry: POKENAME必须维持稳定体温，核心才能存活。太热时，它就寻找最近的水源降温。身体开始侵蚀损耗时，它会收集海石，补到身上。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME must maintain a steady temperature in order for its core to survive. When POKENAME gets too hot, it seeks out the nearest water source to cool its body. When Pokémon's body begins to erode, it gathers sea stones to add to its body.

entry: POKENAME吹出的泡泡，与嘴边流下的臭花蜜成分相同。花朵中央藏着尖角，用来刺击烦扰它的家伙。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME generates bubbles that are made of the same smelly nectar it is seen drooling. Within the center of its flower hides a sharp horn it uses to strike at those pestering it.

entry: POKENAME的腿很容易存水。它会站在深水洼里，让四肢吸足水，再用增加的重量，强化打击威力。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's legs retain water easily. It stands in deep puddles to soak water up into its limbs so it can use the extra weight to increase the power of its blows.

entry: POKENAME用修长有力的四肢，逆着瀑布游上去。受到威胁时，它能挥出足以碎石的重拳。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its long, powerful limbs to swim up waterfalls. If threatened, it punches with enough force to shatter stone.

entry: POKENAME很为自己的鳞片自豪，见有宝可梦经过就会炫耀。可它喜怒无常，谁不欣赏它的外貌，就会遭到凶狠攻击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is very proud of its scales and will flaunt them to any passing Pokémon. However, it is incredibly temperamental and will viciously attack those who don't appreciate its appearance.

entry: POKENAME背部球状结构里存着空气，让它能控制水中深度。它下潜到海底觅食，遇到捕食者便迅速上浮。
author: oddwalls
source: Trapped air in the bulb on its back allows POKENAME to control its depth in the water. It descends to the seabed to feed and ascends quickly to escape predators.

entry: POKENAME的蛋适应力强，会出现在意想不到的地方，连污水也不太影响它与即将孵出的同族。吃它身体的不同部位，还会尝到不同滋味。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's Eggs can be found in surprising places due to their hardiness—even polluted waters mean little to POKENAME and their to-be kin. POKENAME's body has a variety of different flavors depending on which body part is consumed.

entry: POKENAME华美、带花纹的鳍备受珍视。受欢迎的程度，让它们成为珍奇水族馆中的常客，沿水箱底部梳理自己。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are prized for their luxurious, patterned fins. Their popularity makes them a common sight at exotic aquariums as they preen along the floor of the tanks.

entry: POKENAME华美、带花纹的鳍备受珍视。受欢迎的程度，让它们成为珍奇水族馆中的常客，沿水箱底部梳理自己。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are prized for their luxurious, patterned fins. Their popularity makes them a common sight at exotic aquariums as they preen along the floor of the tanks.

entry: POKENAME华美、带花纹的鳍备受珍视。受欢迎的程度，让它们成为珍奇水族馆中的常客，沿水箱底部梳理自己。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are prized for their luxurious, patterned fins. Their popularity makes them a common sight at exotic aquariums as they preen along the floor of the tanks.

entry: POKENAME会在寿司店工作，确保每个盘子摆得整齐，每道菜都完美无瑕。遇到大声嚷嚷的无礼客人，它就把米饭扔进对方嘴里，堵住抱怨。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME work in sushi restaurants, making sure every plate is perfectly aligned, and every dish is without blemish. When unruly customers shout at them, POKENAME flings rice into their mouths to silence any complaint.

entry: POKENAME在炽热的壳中煮沸水，产生强劲蒸汽喷流。它们住在温泉水里，最喜欢泡在暖水中放松。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME boil water inside their fiery shells, which produces powerful jets of steam. They live in the water of hot springs and love nothing more than relaxing in warm water.

entry: POKENAME毛发的清爽滋味，让它成为饮品中受欢迎的配料。据说，味道像火龙果、橙子与青柠的混合。
author: hophoppip
source: The refreshing flavor of POKENAME's fur has made it a popular addition to drinks. Its flavor is described as a mix of dragonfruit, orange, and lime.

entry: POKENAME的冠饰与尾鳍越长，胆量也越大。人们常见它们守护洞穴。捕食者威胁时，它会竖起尾巴，来回摇摆威吓。
author: radiance8990
source: As POKENAME's crest and tail fins grow, so too does its courage. POKENAME are often seen protecting their den. When threatened by a predator, a POKENAME will raise its tail and sway it back and forth to intimidate them.

entry: POKENAME在海底钻洞，寻找珊瑚吃。穿行珊瑚礁之间感到疲惫时，它就吃海藻，恢复体力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME tunnels across ocean floors in search of coral to consume. When exhausted between reefs, it feeds on seaweed to recover.

entry: 古时候，POKENAME的红色鳞片曾被用来调制迷情药。在液体中，鳞片会闪烁，微微发光。
author: .izik
source: Red scales from POKENAME were once used in ancient love potions. In liquid, they shimmer and glow faintly.

entry: 大群POKENAME会在每年极为固定的时节聚集，寻找繁殖伴侣。聚会前，它们灵巧地上下攀游瀑布，是很受欢迎的观光景象。
author: bobosmith01
source: Huge groups of POKENAME meet up during very precise times of the year to find a mate to reproduce with. Seeing them nimbly climb up and down waterfalls to meet up just beforehand is a popular tourist sight.

entry: POKENAME用心灵感应交流，适合协调小群行动。可一旦群体规模变大，感应交流就会失效，造成头痛，游动也乱了套。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME communicates telepathically, which is effective for coordinated small groups. Once they reach a sizable group of POKENAME, their telepathic communication breaks down, leading to headaches and disorganized swimming.

entry: POKENAME游泳时，会优雅地避开障碍，从其他宝可梦身边飞快掠过。繁殖季，它们寻找动作格外灵活的伴侣，能做复杂动作就很有吸引力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME zip past other Pokémon while swimming as they gracefully dodge obstacles in their path. During the mating season, they search for mates who exhibit great agility, as being able to perform complex maneuvers is seen as attractive.

entry: POKENAME鳍足上的特殊蹼，让它们能游上瀑布。繁殖季尤其有用，因为迅速攀上瀑布，是备受青睐的特质。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have special webbing on their flippers that allows them to swim up waterfalls. This is particularly helpful during their mating season, as being able to swiftly climb waterfalls is seen as a desirable trait.

entry: POKENAME对其他宝可梦富有攻击性，可能威胁生态，因此湖中种群必须仔细管理。它们会游进鱼宝可梦群，试图用角刺中猎物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME populations need to be carefully managed in lakes due to their aggression toward other Pokémon, making them a potential threat to the ecosystem. They swim through schools of fish Pokémon, attempting to use their horn to spear them.

entry: POKENAME追食时，会高速划游，瞄准用尖角刺穿猎物。如果追不上，就改向目标喷出过热的水，让其失去行动能力。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME paddles at high speeds when chasing food, aiming to spear its prey with its sharp horn. If it's unable to close the gap, POKENAME blasts superheated water at its target instead, aiming to incapacitate it.

entry: POKENAME在岸边筑巢，狩猎喂养后代。战斗时，身上的斑点看起来令人着迷，足以分散对手注意，让它打出制胜一击。
author: radiance8990
source: POKENAME creates its dens near the shoreline, hunting to feed its offspring. The spots on POKENAME's body are hypnotizing to look at when it battles, distracting opponents enough for it to land a finishing blow.

entry: 小小的脚，让它能在陆地短距离行走，不过它更喜欢淡水。万不得已时，POKENAME才会用额头上钻石般坚硬的角防身。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its small feet allow short walks on land, though it prefers freshwater. As a last resort, POKENAME uses the diamond-hard horn on its forehead for protection.

entry: POKENAME睡在海边或海底的岩石下。惊人的力量，让它们几乎什么瀑布都能攀上。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME sleep under rocks that are adjacent to or under the sea. With their incredible strength, they can climb up almost any waterfall.

entry: 它自认是凶猛而公正的水下宝可梦之王，保护王国免受篡位者与侵略者侵犯。为了臣民，即使暴鲤龙，它也会擒住、挺角刺击，直到对方服输。
author: sk372
source: It considers itself a fierce and just king of underwater Pokémon, defending its kingdom from usurpers and aggressors. It will grapple and stab even Gyarados into submission for the sake of its subjects.

entry: POKENAME很凶，会追着其他宝可梦用角猛撞。飞行宝可梦惹怒它时，它甚至会游上瀑布，借势扑过去。如果养在水箱中，多半会撞破箱子逃出。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is aggressive, chasing other Pokémon to bash them with its horn. It will even swim up a waterfall to launch itself at flying Pokémon that have gained its ire. If kept in a tank, it will most likely smash its way out.

entry: 夜里，数十只POKENAME会顶着发光的角，在海上漂浮。虽然群聚时凶猛，人们仍觉得它们美丽。
author: .izik
source: At night, dozens of POKENAME drift across the sea with glowing horns. They're seen as beautiful despite their aggressive swarms.

entry: POKENAME的伞体形似受伤的金鱼王，借此吸引金鱼王的捕食者。对方靠近后，它就用触须缠住，再以毒喙刺击，好慢慢享用。
author: pjporwoll
source: The bell of POKENAME resembles an injured Seaking, which it mimics to lure in predators of Seaking. When they get close, POKENAME wraps them in its tentacles and jabs them with its venomous beak so it can feed leisurely.

entry: 虽然在陆上最快，飘逸的鳍也让它们成为出色的泳者。不论在水里还是陆上受挑战，POKENAME都会低下角，全速冲向对手。
author: .jerden
source: Although fastest on land, their flowing fins also make them strong swimmers. When challenged on land or while in the water, POKENAME will lower their horn and charge as fast as they can at their opponent.

entry: POKENAME游到一半，经常忘记自己在干什么。有时连攀瀑布也会分神，又顺流漂回去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME often forgets what it's doing mid-swim. It sometimes even loses focus while climbing waterfalls and drifts back down.

entry: POKENAME比进化链中的其他成员温顺得多，喜欢在水面下方晒太阳。只要在观赏池中仔细撒布不变之石，就能安全饲养。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is much more docile than other members of its evolution line, preferring to bask just below the surface of the water. It can be safely kept in decorative ponds where Everstones have been carefully scattered around.

entry: POKENAME笨手笨脚，多数时候根本不愿费心自卫，只想闲躺着。强角本能帮助防御，可它很少肯花这份力气。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME are bumbling Pokémon who make no effort to defend themselves in most circumstances, preferring to laze about. Their strong horn could allow them to put up a defense, but POKENAME does not often put in the effort to do so.

entry: POKENAME学会了把大葱当作钓竿捕鱼。只要有宝可梦咬钩，就会立刻被拉出水面，展开战斗。
author: sontyp
source: POKENAME developed the ability to catch fish, using its leek as a rod. If a Pokémon bites, it is sure to be pulled out of the water and battled immediately.

entry: POKENAME会用角撞碎冰山，展示力量。比起真正战斗，它更喜欢这样考验自己。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME smashes icebergs with its horn as a show of strength. It prefers testing itself this way over real combat.

entry: POKENAME虽对人类友善，却是凶猛的北极捕食者，凡比它小的都吃。会用利角破开厚冰。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite being friendly towards humans, POKENAME is a vicious arctic predator and will prey on anything smaller than it. It uses its sharp horn to break through thick ice.

entry: 主人因早先形态长得过大、难以照料而将其放生，POKENAME因而成了入侵性极强的物种。它凶猛作战，压过其他淡水捕食者，只有万不得已才射出尖刺，因为要数星期才能长回。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is a highly invasive species after owners released it once previous forms grew too large to care for. It outcompetes other freshwater predators, fighting viciously and only firing its spikes as a last resort, as they take weeks to regrow.

entry: 睡前，POKENAME会在唇间放一粒沙。到早晨，沙便成了美丽的橙色珍珠，深受珠宝商珍视。
author: .izik
source: Before it sleeps, POKENAME places a grain of sand in its lips. By morning, it forms a beautiful orange pearl prized by jewelers.

entry: POKENAME会来回挥鳍，一边摇动神秘水滴，制造黑斑旋转的幻象。看着这番展示的生物会被催眠，尽可能多地给它水。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME wave their fins back and forth to create the illusion that the black spots swirl while they sway their Mystic Water back and forth. This hypnotizes anyone who watches the display into giving POKENAME all the water that they can.

entry: 人们会烘烤POKENAME，让体内储存的丰润油脂渗出。上桌时通常配米饭和几片柑橘，平衡这道菜天然的咸味。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is baked to bring out the juicy oils that are stored in its body. It is usually served with a side of rice and a few slices of citrus to balance the natural salt content of the dish.

entry: 骨杖末端的圆球会散出花粉，类似翅膀上的花粉，却强得多。它生性不爱争斗，只需挥杖让来犯者睡着，便转身逃跑。
author: sk372
source: The orb at the end of its bone-staff spreads a pollen similar to that of its wings, but much more potent. Non-violent by nature, it puts aggressors to sleep with a wave of its wand before running away.

entry: POKENAME异常强韧的翅膀掉落后，会被它拿来当棍棒。它常哀悼自己失去飞行能力，独处时便会哭泣。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME that loses its wings uses them as clubs, having unusually strong wings. It often mourns the loss of its flight and cries when alone.

entry: 进化后，POKENAME会把蜕下的壳当作盾牌与铠甲。头部柔软脆弱，因此它总会本能地将其遮护。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: After evolving, POKENAME use their discarded shell as a shield and armor. Its fragile head is quite soft, so it covers it instinctively.

entry: POKENAME无时无刻不在产生毒气。虽然能驱赶捕食者，却也常毒死它想吸蜜的花。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME produce toxic gases all the time. While this is helpful for dispelling predators, it often kills the flowers it attempts to drink from.

entry: POKENAME能制造短促的阵风，在树枝间跳跃。每一跳都会扬起一团粉尘，刺激眼睛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of creating brief gusts of wind to hop from branch to branch. Each leap releases a cloud of dust that can irritate the eyes.

entry: 经过特殊处理，POKENAME的毒气可以转化为香水。每只都有独特气味，取决于吃过的花。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: With a special process, POKENAME's toxic gases can be converted to perfume. Each POKENAME has a unique scent, influenced by the flowers it feeds on.

entry: POKENAME常会照料迷路的铁甲蛹与绿毛虫，将它们留在身边，直到彻底恢复健康。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are often seen taking care of lost Metapod and Caterpie. It keeps them until they are fully rehabilitated.

entry: POKENAME把铁甲蛹放在袋里，为它们提供安全住所，直到进化。它们从花中采蜜，供双方补充养分。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME keep Metapod in their pouches, giving them a safe place to stay until they evolve. They collect honey from flowers to nourish them both.

entry: 它掠过海面，寻找微小昆虫，用嘴吸食。美丽的双翼每次优雅扇动，都会把彩色粉尘洒进水里，滋养附近藻类与珊瑚。
author: fiordaliso
source: It glides over the ocean surface in search of tiny insects to suck up with its mouth. Each graceful movement of its beautiful wings releases colored dust into the water, enriching nearby algae and coral.

entry: POKENAME会用麻痹粉末削弱猎物，再飞在海浪上方捕捉。它还能从嘴里喷出极咸的水柱，让对手陷入不利。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its paralyzing powders to weaken prey, which it then catches while flying above the ocean waves. It can shoot jets of extremely salty water from its mouth to put its opponents at a disadvantage.

entry: POKENAME会用麻痹粉末削弱猎物，再飞在海浪上方捕捉。它还能从嘴里喷出极咸的水柱，让对手陷入不利。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its paralyzing powders to weaken prey, which it then catches while flying above the ocean waves. It can shoot jets of extremely salty water from its mouth to put its opponents at a disadvantage.

entry: POKENAME会用麻痹粉末削弱猎物，再飞在海浪上方捕捉。它还能从嘴里喷出极咸的水柱，让对手陷入不利。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its paralyzing powders to weaken prey, which it then catches while flying above the ocean waves. It can shoot jets of extremely salty water from its mouth to put its opponents at a disadvantage.

entry: POKENAME一生产下许多蛋，小小的角却无法有效护蛋。不幸的是，许多蛋还没孵化，就被捕食者吃掉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce many eggs throughout their lifetime, but they are unable to defend the eggs with their small horn. This leads to an unfortunate situation where many eggs are eaten by predators before they hatch.

entry: POKENAME没有角或其他防御手段，难以有效护蛋，因此专注于尽量多产蛋。这使许多个体只要有机会再产更多，就会放弃原来的巢。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are unable to defend their eggs effectively without horns or other defense mechanisms, so they focus on producing as many eggs as possible. This has led to many POKENAME abandoning nests if they have a chance at making more eggs.

entry: 新长出的翅膀和多种粉末，让POKENAME更善于躲过捕食者。身体却依然极其坚硬，令研究者纳闷，如此纤细的翅膀究竟怎样带它飞起来。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME's newly developed wings and various powders have granted it better methods of survival against predators. Its body is still extremely hard, leading researchers to question how such delicate wings allow it to achieve flight.

entry: POKENAME在空中飞舞时，会留下闪亮粉尘，暂时增强宝可梦的活力。这种粉尘，是制作PP极限提升剂的稀有原料。
author: jaminmcready
source: When POKENAME flutters through the air, it leaves behind a glimmering dust that can temporarily boost a Pokémon's vitality. This dust is a rare ingredient in crafting PP Max.

entry: POKENAME是歌剧舞台上的常见演员，飞过舞台时，会留下一道闪亮鳞粉。它天生能与听见的任何声音和声，演唱时便与首席女歌手配合。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are common cast members in opera productions, flying across the stage and leaving a trail of glittering scales as they do so. They have an innate ability to harmonise with any sound they hear, using this to match the primadonna during songs.

entry: POKENAME只能无助地扑腾。科学家认为，它想凭从巴大蝶继承的本能飞翔，可惜并没有翅膀。每次跃起或落下，鳞片反而会喷出令人头晕的孢子云。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME flops around helplessly. Scientists believe POKENAME is attempting to fly with its inherited instincts from Butterfree, but sadly lacks wings. Instead, clouds of dizzying spores spurt out from its scales every time it lands or takes off.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片含有剧毒，触碰可能致命。它能用翅膀掀起巨大阵风，将对手困住。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's scales are highly toxic; touching them could be fatal. It uses its wings to create massive bursts of wind that can trap its opponents.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片含有剧毒，触碰可能致命。它能用翅膀掀起巨大阵风，将对手困住。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's scales are highly toxic; touching them could be fatal. It uses its wings to create massive bursts of wind that can trap its opponents.

entry: POKENAME在天空蜿蜒穿行，隐匿于夜色。有时，它无声掠过头顶，人们能看见发光的红眼。
author: nordicrhino
source: POKENAME slithers through the skies, hiding itself in the night sky. Sometimes people can see its glowing red eyes as it moves silently overhead.

entry: 据说，POKENAME会在起雾的清晨出现，唱出美妙曲调，改变听者的性格。它们的数量却不时突然骤减，原因不明。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is said to appear on foggy mornings singing a beautiful tune that alters the personality of those who hear it. POKENAME's population erratically plummets from time to time for unclear reasons.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀随心情变色，闪烁的花纹令人目眩。若悉心养育，双翼便会泛起罕见的金色。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wings change color depending on its mood, dazzling onlookers with shimmering patterns. If raised with care, its wings will glow with a rare golden hue.

entry: POKENAME脸部的翼状结构上，覆有细薄的毒粉。一扇动，粉末就会散向附近目标。暴雨中，毫无防备的猎物看不见它。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME has wing-like facial features coated in a light poisonous powder. When flapped, this powder spreads to nearby targets. It turns invisible to unsuspecting prey during rainstorms.

entry: 由于身体湿润，POKENAME会定期舔翅膀，不让粉末掉落，改为储存在嘴里。敌人靠近时，它便使出水枪，把粉末从嘴里射出。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Due to their wet body, POKENAME regularly lick their wings to keep their powder from falling off, instead opting to store it in their mouths. When enemies approach, they shoot the powder out of their mouth via Water Gun.

entry: POKENAME以电脑病毒为食，同时释放能催眠的紫色粉末。许多试图干涉的人，几乎立刻就睡着了。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME feeds on computer viruses while emitting a purple, sleep-inducing powder. Many who attempt to intervene fall asleep almost instantly.

entry: 身体虽一动不动，POKENAME的翅膀却会飞快拍动，本能地帮它躲避天敌。
author: zagreus8
source: While the body remains immobile, POKENAME's wings flutter rapidly, acting on instinct to allow it to evade predators.

entry: POKENAME的小翅膀只能让它短暂离地，因此每次只飞一分钟左右。它会把前半身钻进土里，在花园中打盹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's small wings can only lift it from the ground for a short while, so it only flies in short, minute-long intervals. It digs the front half of its body into the dirt to nap amongst flower gardens.

entry: POKENAME靠翼状鳍在水中前进，留下能使对方麻痹的鳞粉。它们切开猎物，像吸花蜜一样吸取体液。
author: lampent12
source: Using their wing-like fins, POKENAME propels through the water, leaving paralyzing scales behind. They slice prey up to sip their body fluids like nectar.

entry: POKENAME性情平和，从不争斗。有人偶尔会看见它从腕部吐丝，织成美丽的挂毯。
author: lyrebird.rainwing
source: POKENAME is a very peaceful, conflict-free Pokémon. It has occasionally been observed shooting silk out of its wrists to make beautiful tapestries.

entry: POKENAME经过漫长岁月，发展出隐身、瞬间移动等能力。蜕下的鳞片，能帮助科学家了解这些能力背后的DNA。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have developed abilities like invisibility and teleportation over a long period of time. The scales that they shed help scientists understand the underlying DNA behind their abilities.

entry: 人们认为，每片丛林都有自己的POKENAME，保护虫属性族群免受危险。面对极端困境时，它会变成庞然大物，形似巴大蝶的超极巨化形态。
author: dodoowner_
source: It is thought that every jungle has its very own POKENAME to protect the Bug-type population from danger. If faced with extreme adversity, the Pokémon transforms into a humongous creature resembling Butterfree's Gigantamax form.

entry: 人们能看见成群POKENAME在鲜花盛开的草地嬉戏，吸食花蜜与花粉。颈环释放的甜香，能平息压力。
author: mepp.
source: Groups of POKENAME are seen frolicking in vibrant meadows to feed on nectar and pollen. The sweet aromas released from the ring around their neck quells feelings of stress.

entry: POKENAME背上会生出火焰翅膀，向同类展示。火中的花纹只有复眼能看见，研究者推测，它们能看见的色彩范围比人类更广。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME sprout fiery wings from their back as a way to display to one another. They produce patterns within the flames that can only be seen by compound eyes, researchers speculate that POKENAME can see a broader spectrum of colour than people.

entry: POKENAME背上会生出火焰翅膀，向同类展示。火中的花纹只有复眼能看见，研究者推测，它们能看见的色彩范围比人类更广。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME sprout fiery wings from their back as a way to display to one another. They produce patterns within the flames that can only be seen by compound eyes, researchers speculate that POKENAME can see a broader spectrum of colour than people.

entry: POKENAME体温高于大多数虫属性宝可梦，因此能在寒冷环境生存。大群聚集时，即使隆冬，也能靠体热让树木不积雪。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME keep their body temperature higher than most Bug-Type Pokémon enabling them to survive in cold environments. Large populations are able to keep trees free of snow even in the depths of winter with their body heat.

entry: POKENAME精力过剩，会在林地上追逐同伴，一跑就是数小时。兴奋时，背部会喷出美丽翼状的火焰。它们曾因玩得太起劲，意外引发火灾。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are hyperactive and will race around the forest floor chasing one another for hours. When they're excited, their backs erupt into flames in the shape of beautiful wings. They have been known to accidentally start fires in their enthusiasm.

entry: POKENAME无忧无虑，精力充沛，大半时间都在朝其他宝可梦泼水嬉戏。只需扇一下翅膀，就能轻松升空，留下细细的银色粉尘。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a carefree and energetic creature that spends much of its day playing by splashing water at other Pokémon. With a single flap of its wings, it can easily lift into the air, leaving behind a fine silvery dust.

entry: POKENAME能产生几种毒液，分别会慢慢削弱力量、造成麻痹，或让受害者昏迷。人们认为，最近吃过的花蜜种类，决定了产生哪种毒液。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME generates several types of venom with variations that slowly sap strength, cause paralysis, or knock their victim unconscious. It's believed the type of nectar POKENAME recently consumed determines the kind of venom developed.

entry: POKENAME会从翅膀撒出闪亮粉尘，吸入便会困倦，因此研究它的科学家都会戴面罩。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME releases a shimmering dust from its wings. This dust causes drowsiness whenever it is inhaled, so research scientists wear masks to study the Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME会温柔地用蓬松尾巴裹住其他虫属性宝可梦，帮它们御寒。它主要吃蜂蜜和甜得发腻的熟果。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME tenderly wraps its fluffy tail around other Bug-type Pokémon to shield them from the cold. It feeds mainly on honey and extremely sweet, ripe fruit.

entry: POKENAME停栖时，常会本能地尝试单脚站立。可短腿不足以保持平衡，让它摔倒，好在大翅膀通常能缓冲落地。
author: vaporvenator
source: By instinct, POKENAME will often try to stand on one foot as it perches. Its stubby legs aren't adequate for balance, causing POKENAME to fall, but its large wings usually soften the landing.

entry: 它嗅觉出色，能轻易分清盛开的花与捕食者。每当一英里内有花绽放，POKENAME就会咕咕鸣叫。
author: silverscloudy
source: It has an excellent sense of smell, able to differentiate between blossoming flowers and predators with ease. POKENAME hoot each time a flower blooms within a mile away.

entry: 哪怕深夜漆黑，它的双眼也能看见几英里外的蜂蜜。它还能悄无声息地毒染整片森林，无人察觉。
author: soup1900
source: Its eyes can see honey from miles away, even through the darkest nights. It is known to silently poison an entire forest without anyone noticing.

entry: 哪怕深夜漆黑，它的双眼也能看见几英里外的蜂蜜。它还能悄无声息地毒染整片森林，无人察觉。
author: soup1900
source: Its eyes can see honey from miles away, even through the darkest nights. It is known to silently poison an entire forest without anyone noticing.

entry: POKENAME在污染较少的地方采蜜更快。若完全没有污染，还会产生能帮助疗伤的发光物质。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are seen to gather honey more swiftly in areas with less pollution. If there's no pollution at all, it produces a glowing substance known to help treat injuries.

entry: POKENAME感知蜂蜜与树液的本领惊人，那也是它们最爱吃的食物。它们飞得太快，掠过花朵时，常把花粉和花瓣都吹散。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have an incredible sense for honey and sap, which is what they prefer to consume. They fly so fast that they tend to scatter the pollen and the petals of flowers as they fly over them.

entry: POKENAME会在森林树冠间撒出蓝粉，哄捕食者睡着，保护铁甲蛹。它也用闪亮粉尘装饰巢穴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME scatters blue powder through forest canopies to lull predators to sleep and protect Metapod. It decorates its nest with shimmering dust.

entry: POKENAME翅膀上脱落的小鳞片，可以加入药剂。鳞片碰到舌头，会产生酥麻电感，帮助宝可梦保持清醒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME flakes off small scales from its wings that are incorporated into potions. The scales produce a tingling shock on the tongue that helps keep Pokémon awake.

entry: POKENAME飞速冲向喇叭芽，将它们从地里拔起，当作食物。飞过时，它会制造让其他宝可梦困倦的粉云。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME zips towards Bellsprouts and rips them from the ground to secure its meal. Whenever it flies by, it creates a cloud of powder that makes other Pokémon sleepy.

entry: 复眼让POKENAME能发现下方的任何动静，准确定位猎物。在空中滑翔时，它会撒下一道银色粉尘，让飞行更显优雅。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its compound eyes allow POKENAME to spot any movement beneath it, letting it pinpoint prey with precision. As it glides through the air, it scatters a trail of silvery dust that enhances the grace of its flight.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀花纹繁复，用来彼此交流。虽然很大，却不够有力，无法带它们飞行，因此它们只会安静地在林地上缓步前行。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have intricately patterned wings that they use to communicate with one another. Though large, their wings aren't strong enough to allow them to fly, and they instead amble peacefully across the forest floor.

entry: POKENAME喜欢靠球状尾巴蹦跳，每跳一次，翅膀就散出粉尘。粉末在阳光下闪烁，构成美丽的粼粼光点。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love bouncing atop their ball-shaped tails and release dust from their wings with each bounce. The dust shimmers in the sunlight and creates a beautiful array of shimmering sparkles.

entry: POKENAME吃树液和树皮，通常在树干旁一站就是数小时。背上的翅膀模仿其他虫属性宝可梦，让对方以为树上已被虫宝可梦占据，从而离开。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feeds on tree sap and tree bark, usually standing in place at the trunk of a tree for hours on end. The wings on their back mimic those of other Bug-type Pokémon, warding them away by making them think there's already a Bug-type on the tree.

entry: POKENAME用海绵般的皮肤，带着花蜜四处走。饿了以后，只需舔舔皮肤。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME use their sponge-like skin to carry nectar around with them. Then, they simply lick their skin when hungry.

entry: POKENAME每逢秋季都会迁徙数英里。它们归来便预示春天，给许多人带来喜悦。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME migrate for miles every autumn. Their return is a herald of spring that brings delight to many.

entry: POKENAME带花纹的翅膀上，覆盖着细小的特化羽毛。羽毛很容易脱落，吞下后会产生麻痹效果。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have patterned wings that are covered in a coating of tiny, specialised feathers. These feathers easily come loose and can cause paralytic effects when ingested.

entry: POKENAME的复眼能察觉下方最细微的动静，让它准确无误地攻击猎物。翱翔时，身后会拖出淡淡的银色粉尘微光，衬得飞姿更优雅。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's multifaceted eyes detect the slightest movement below, enabling it to strike prey with unerring accuracy. As it soars, a faint shimmer of silvery dust trails behind, accentuating its elegant flight.

entry: POKENAME跳跃力很强，横向能跃过超过自身身高十二倍的距离。它的眼力出众，几乎什么环境下都能看清。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has a powerful jump; it can clear the horizontal distance over a dozen times its own height. It possesses powerful eyes that let it see clearly in almost any kind of condition.

entry: 许多巴大蝶毛绒玩具与钥匙圈，都从POKENAME的尾巴取得灵感。可要让它老实待够久，好照着制作，并不容易。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME tails are big inspirations for Butterfree plushies and keychains. Though, it's hard to keep one in place long enough to replicate it.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀受攻击时会落下鳞片，让攻击者陷入多种异常状态，方便自己逃跑。这些鳞片可以收集、提炼，制成厉害中药。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's wings have scales that fall off when attacked. They inflict the attacker with multiple Status Conditions, allowing it to flee. These scales can be collected and refined into a Superb Remedy.

entry: 大多数野生POKENAME待在长大的地方，不过也有许多个体远行，前往热带多雨丛林。它们偶尔会打嗝，吐出孢子，让周围生物沉沉睡去。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although most wild POKENAME simply stay in the area they grew up in, there have been numerous POKENAME that have travelled far away to tropical and rainy jungles. Occasionally, they burp up spores that cause those nearby to fall into a deep slumber.

entry: POKENAME感官敏锐，能轻松找到浓郁树液与新鲜蜂蜜。翅膀散落的鳞片在黑暗中微微发光，带有淡淡甜香。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have keen senses that allow them to easily find rich sap and fresh honey. The scales scattered by their wings faintly glow in the dark and emit a weak, sweet scent.

entry: 野生POKENAME通常与同类结群。夜间分散觅食，白天则聚在一起。对它们毛发过敏的情况很常见。
author: bobosmith01
source: Wild POKENAME typically belong to a pack of other POKENAME. While apart during the night to scavenge for food, they stick together during the day. Allergies associated with POKENAME's fur are common.

entry: 这只宝可梦振翅撒出致幻粉末，再从幻象引起的恐惧中，吸取养分。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: This Pokémon releases a hallucinogenic powder by flapping its wings, absorbing nutrition from the fear the induced visions cause.

entry: POKENAME总挂着有些诡异的笑容。无论挨上什么攻击，它都会释放让人欣快的粉末，笑得也更开一些。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME have a somewhat uncanny smile on them at all times. After taking any sort of hit, they release a euphoric powder as their smile grows a little bigger.

entry: 不知为何，POKENAME有一半身体没能进化。科学家仍在研究。
author: dodoowner_
source: For some reason, half of POKENAME was not able to go through evolution. Scientists are still studying this phenomenon.

entry: 会用尾巴吸引捕食者，再以超能力赶走，保护领地内的绿毛虫。
author: staghorn
source: It protects its territory's Caterpie by using its tail to attract their predators. It then uses its psychic abilities to drive these predators away.

entry: POKENAME的壳由能挡住子弹的几丁质构成。若真有人打裂外壳，里面便会涌出团团毒气。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's shell is made from a bulletproof chitin. If you somehow crack its shell, it'll release clouds of poisonous gases into the air.

entry: POKENAME在树干内筑巢，吸食树汁，尤其喜欢繁花盛开的树。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME makes their nests inside tree trunks, feeding on the sap inside. It especially loves trees with large amounts of flowers.

entry: POKENAME格外兴奋时，会扇动耳朵，向四周散粉。这些粉末是常见的过敏原，因此它不适合许多家庭饲养。
author: dodoowner_
source: When a POKENAME gets especially excited, it flaps its ears, dispersing a powder all around it. This powder is a common allergen, making this Pokémon unsuitable for many households.

entry: POKENAME毛发中覆有细粉，吸入后会产生有害影响。虽然不能飞，它们仍会扇翅，把粉抖落，吹向交战对象。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a fine coating of dust in their fur that causes deleterious effects on those who breathe it in. Though flightless, they flap their wings to shake the dust loose and blow it toward whoever they're fighting.

entry: POKENAME短暂的繁殖季中，会聚成大群，如巨云般笼罩栖身森林。受到其他宝可梦打扰时，它们便变得凶猛，用翅膀鳞粉给闯入者覆上毒素。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swarm together in their brief breeding seasons, forming great clouds over their forest homes. When disturbed by other Pokémon they will turn aggressive and use their wing scales to coat the interloper with toxins.

entry: 有人夸奖，POKENAME就会扇动耳朵，在周围撒出闪亮粉末。它对熟树果的嗅觉出色，农民便靠它把握最佳采果时机。
author: fiordaliso
source: If someone compliments it, POKENAME starts flapping its ears and releasing a sparkling powder around itself. It has an incredible nose for ripe berries, making it useful to farmers who rely on it to pick fruit at the perfect moment.

entry: POKENAME翼上的每片鳞，都是一枚细小的毒刺。身上的毒棘，也能护它免受攻击。
author: sand_coffin
source: Each scale on a POKENAME's wing is a small, toxic spike. The toxic quills on its body act as a defense mechanism, protecting it from attacks.

entry: POKENAME满脑子只想找到最甜的蜜。谁若阻拦，它就喷出麻痹气体，直到对方无法再动。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's only goal is to find the sweetest honey. If anyone tries to stop it, it'll spit paralyzing gas until they're neutralized.

entry: POKENAME对蜂蜜、树液和蛋的气味极其敏锐。它们遍寻森林，用钩爪爬树，寻找最新鲜的这些食物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have extremely keen senses of smell for honey, sap, and eggs. They scour forests, climbing trees with their hooked claws, in search of the freshest of these foods to consume.

entry: POKENAME吃饱花蜜和蜂蜜后，会开心地在草地打滚。厚毛暂时留住花粉，等之后散出，就能让许多其他花朵得到授粉。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME joyfully rolls around in meadows after having its fill of nectar and honey. Its thick fur temporarily traps pollen. Later, when the pollen gets released, many other flowers can become pollinated.

entry: POKENAME会保护近亲，教它们采食及其他日常本领。虽然酷爱花蜜与蜂蜜，它总让幼崽先吃饱；许多野生个体，只能活过寥寥几个季节。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME protects and trains related species in food-gathering and other everyday tasks. Although it adores nectar and honey, the young always get their fill first; many wild POKENAME do not survive for more than a handful of seasons.

entry: POKENAME吸食大花时，花蜜与花粉会成为头顶火焰的燃料。火焰散发如腐烂檬柠果的气味，浓淡随健康情况变化。
author: chibitales
source: As POKENAME drink from large flowers, the nectar and pollen fuel the flame atop their head, which gives off an odor similar to rotting Nomel berries. This smell changes in intensity depending on their health.

entry: POKENAME翅膀有力，能接连数天不停飞行。翅膀的鳞片很容易脱落，吸入可能有危险，引起各种不适。
author: katieplaysgames
