source: POKENAME have powerful wings that allow them to stay airborne for days at a time. Their wing scales shed easily and can be hazardous if breathed in, causing all manner of ailments.

entry: 这种宝可梦会在花园和花田间飞行，偶尔短暂停下，寻找并挖出根和球茎吃。
author: lydiaprower8
source: This Pokémon can be seen flying around in gardens and flower fields. It momentarily stops flying to search and dig for roots and bulbs to eat.

entry: 虽然POKENAME长着翅膀，却太小，只能让沉重的身体悬浮几秒。因此，它待在地上，吃花，也挖地下的球茎。
author: lydiaprower8
source: Despite POKENAME having wings, they are too small to do little else than hover its heavy body for more than a few seconds. Therefore, it stays on the ground and feeds off flowers and digs up the bulbs from underground.

entry: POKENAME钢铁般的羽毛上有特殊花纹，让它们显得比实际更大。许多绿毛虫的捕食者，都因这副唬人的外表而避开。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a peculiar pattern on their steely feathers that makes them appear larger than they actually are. Many predators of Caterpie avoid POKENAME because of their deceptively scary appearance.

entry: 训练家或许喜欢看POKENAME四处飞舞，鸟宝可梦却不喜欢。夜里，它会缠在树枝上，把巢里的蛋整个吞下。
author: oejoeboy33
source: While Trainers may enjoy seeing POKENAME flying around, bird Pokémon do not. During the night, it wraps around branches, eating eggs out of nests whole.

entry: POKENAME翅膀上的鳞片，包着能够排水的神秘粉末。游泳时，拍翅会产生细小水流，久而久之，便能汇成猛烈的漩涡。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The scales along a POKENAME's wings are encased in a mystical powder that repels water. When POKENAME swim, the flutter of their wings creates small currents that can collect into a raging whirlpool over time.

entry: 虽然身体相当致密，POKENAME却能快速拍动纤细翅膀，轻松飞行。半透明翅膀会洒落防水粉末，让它们能穿越暴雨。
author: ambrosia04
source: Despite having relatively dense bodies, POKENAME achieve effortless flight through the rapid beating of their delicate wings. These translucent wings shed water-resistant dust, allowing them to flutter through heavy rainstorms.

entry: POKENAME翅膀上覆盖带电的花粉，接触有毒，经常让野外研究用的机器故障。它们会巡视巢穴周围，让附近花朵绽放。
author: npshi
source: The wings of POKENAME are covered in electrically charged pollen that is poisonous to the touch, which often cause machines used in field research to malfunction. POKENAME survey the area around their nests to make nearby flowers bloom.

entry: POKENAME翅膀的鳞片，随排列角度不同而反射不同光线，形成虹彩。它们会把鳞片与尾巴产生的颜料混合，调成独特的闪光涂料。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have wing scales that reflect light in different ways depending on the angle they lie at, making for an iridescent effect. They mix these scales with a pigment produced by their tail to create unique shimmering paints.

entry: POKENAME会扇翅唤来凉风，同时用精神力量降低气温。它们亲昵友善，炎夏很乐意帮训练家消暑。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flutter their wings to summon cool breezes, using their psychic powers to lower air temperatures as they do. They are affectionate Pokémon, happy to help out during hot summers to keep their Trainers cool.

entry: 它会为作物授粉，又能用毒牙赶走害虫，深受农民与花卉爱好者喜爱。
author: sottiwotti
source: This Pokémon is loved by farmers and flower enthusiasts. It helps pollinate crops and protects them against pests with its poisonous fangs.

entry: 以为自己正悄悄接近巴大蝶的敌人，常会被POKENAME突然喷出的黄焰打个措手不及。火焰由岩浆般、永不冷却的血淋巴提供能量。
author: haypile
source: Opponents that think they're sneaking up on a Butterfree are often caught off guard when POKENAME starts spewing yellow flames. These attacks are powered by magma-like hemolymph that never cools.

entry: POKENAME一天会吸食超过100朵花的花蜜。它产的奶带有花香与蜂蜜味，吃的花蜜越多，滋味就越浓。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME drink nectar from over 100 flowers in a day. They produce milk with a floral and honey taste that become stronger depending on how much nectar they consumed.

entry: 每扇动一次巨大的翅膀，它都会洒下成片鳞粉，在阳光中闪亮，如同凤凰之火。人们只在一年中白昼最长、最温暖的日子见过它。
author: bostroms
source: With every flap of its enormous wings, it generates a shower of scales that flash in the sunlight, resembling phoenix fire.  It has only been seen on the longest and warmest days of the year.

entry: 每扇动一次巨大的翅膀，它都会洒下成片鳞粉，在阳光中闪亮，如同凤凰之火。人们只在一年中白昼最长、最温暖的日子见过它。
author: bostroms
source: With every flap of its enormous wings, it generates a shower of scales that flash in the sunlight, resembling phoenix fire.  It has only been seen on the longest and warmest days of the year.

entry: POKENAME在森林里来去无踪，因为它从不在同一个时间点久留。它们穿梭时间线，把铁甲蛹送回树上，确保下一代巴大蝶茁壮成长。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are an ephemeral presence in the forest because they never remain at one point in time for long. They travel between timelines to help Metapod back into trees and ensure that the next generation of Butterfree are able to flourish.

entry: POKENAME以树液为食，常能看见它们用尖牙紧咬树干。尾巴模仿绿毛虫的动作，吸引注意，掩护主体。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feed on tree sap and can often be seen clinging onto the trunks of trees with their sharp teeth. They use their tails as a distraction, mimicking the movement of a Caterpie to keep attention away from their main body.

entry: 很少有宝可梦比“生态灾星”POKENAME更活泼。它贪求甜果和蜂蜜，靠灵巧的抓握肢体、敏捷飞行，以及吃糖后的亢奋，一星期就能把一片森林的糖分搜刮干净。
author: haypile
source: Few Pokémon are as peppy as the eco-terror, POKENAME. Its insatiable cravings for sweet fruit and honey are supported by dexterous graspers, agile flight, and its existing sugar high, allowing it to strip a forest of all its sugars in a single week.

entry: POKENAME每扇一次翅膀，就会散出魔法粉末。粉末只会促进植物健康生长，可人类一旦吸入，就会执着地想栽种花园，留给它日后享用。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wings spread a magical powder with every flap. For plant life it merely promotes healthy growth, but humans that inhale the powder become obsessively compelled to plant flower gardens for POKENAME to later feast upon.

entry: POKENAME在夜间守护花园，月亮亏缺得越多，它就越活跃。踩踏它保护的花朵，很快就会招来恶毒诅咒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME guards over flower gardens at night, becoming more active the more the moon wanes in the sky. Trampling across the flowers it protects is a quick way to earn a nasty hex.

entry: POKENAME在森林灌木下翻找食物，用大翅膀吹开落叶和泥土。身体太重，无法飞行，不过努力一下，仍能短距离跳跃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME roots through the undergrowth of forests in search of its food, using its large wings to blow away leaf litter and dirt. Its body is too heavy for it to be able to fly, but with some effort it can manage short hops.

entry: POKENAME翅膀脱落的小鳞片，可以加入迷情药。据说，一滴便会让人心生爱慕，科学家却说，效果和巧克力一样。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sheds small scales from its wings that are incorporated into love potions. A single drop is said to create feelings of infatuation, though scientists say it has the same effect as chocolate.

entry: 它们大部分养分来自树液和蜂蜜，不过也喜欢把花当零食。长毛中通常满是花粉，飞行时便四处传播。
author: infinex21
source: They get most of their nutrients from sap and honey, though they love to snack on flowers. Their long fur is typically rife with pollen that gets spread as they fly.

entry: POKENAME喜欢陪孩子，十分乐意一起玩游戏打发时间。孩子玩它产生的粉尘，经常弄得脏兮兮，不过仔细洗个澡，就能轻松洗掉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to spend time with children and are more than willing to play games to pass the time. Children often get dirty from playing with the dust that POKENAME produce, but the dust is easily cleaned off with a thorough bath.

entry: 它能在树枝间跳跃，半天就巡遍整片森林。翅膀让每一跳都能滑翔很远，也会撒下冰冷鳞片，先妨碍敌人，再凶狠挥斩。
author: infinex21
source: It can patrol an entire forest in half a day by leaping across tree branches, its wings allowing it to glide far with each leap. It scatters frigid cold scales from its wings to impair its foes before viciously slashing them.

entry: POKENAME喜欢独处，在草木丰茂处大吃花与植物。为了保卫自己和食物，它会从掌心喷出浓缩花粉，让靠得太近的闯入者中毒或晕眩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME keeps to itself, gorging on flowers and plants in verdant areas. To defend itself and its food, it fires off bursts of concentrated pollen from its palms that poison or stun trespassers that ventured too close.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀小得远不足以飞行。它会用藤蔓抖落翅膀上具有刺激性的鳞片，作为防御手段。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's wings are far too small to be capable of flight. Instead, as a defense mechanism, POKENAME uses its vines to dislodge irritating scales from its wings.

entry: POKENAME能察觉花朵的位置。它在地下挖掘，寻找花田，感知上方有花，就会钻出来。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME can detect where flowers are. It digs underground to look for flower fields, popping out when it senses one above.

entry: POKENAME扇翅极快，不到一分钟就能撒出超过100片毒鳞。它们很容易找到树液和蜂蜜，为快速代谢提供能量。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can scatter over 100 toxic scales in less than a minute due to how quickly their wings flutter. They can easily find sap and honey, which fuel their rapid metabolism.

entry: POKENAME似乎守护着一片片野花，能把翅膀上收集的银色花粉撒向敌人。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME seem to act as wardens to patches of wildflowers. They can dust foes with the silver pollen they collect on their wings.

entry: POKENAME低调的体色能融入丛林树冠，翅膀则警示着它的力量。如果战况不利，它就会断尾分散注意，几天内便能重新长出。
author: ghostslythe
source: With its muted colors, POKENAME blends in with the jungle canopy, its wings serving as a warning to its strength. If a fight is not going its way, it severs its tail as a distraction which grows back within a few days.

entry: POKENAME会待在巢里，直到准备好进化，却并非毫无还手之力。捕食者一旦打扰或袭巢，它就会扇动头上的翅膀，把灼人粉末撒向来犯者。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME stays in its nest until it is ready to evolve, but it is not helpless. If a predator attempts to disturb or attack the nest, POKENAME will flutter the wings on its head, sprinkling a burning powder upon the attacker.

entry: POKENAME会从布满鳞粉的翅膀撒出麻痹粉末，并跃到空中，尽量扩大效果。等敌人动弹不得，它便近身痛打。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME scatters paralyzing powder from the dusty scales on its wings, leaping into the air for maximum effect. Once enemies are immobilized, it moves in close to pummel foes.

entry: POKENAME全身覆有疏水粉末，既能保持身体湿润，也让翅膀在水中依然干燥。开心时，它们会拍动尾巴。
author: wiz0z
source: A hydrophobic powder covers POKENAME's body to keep them moisturized while also keeping their wing dry in the water. POKENAME flap their tails when happy.

entry: POKENAME不断在湿泥中洗浴，维持身上又黏又毒的薄膜。它不明白自己摸起来怎样，也不知道危险，还纳闷其他宝可梦为何躲开拥抱。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME's body is coated in a sticky and poisonous film supported by constantly bathing in wet mud. Unaware of its own texture and danger, it wonders why other Pokémon avoid its hugs.

entry: POKENAME为幼崽建造巨大的泥巢。泥中混入体表毒鳞，让捕食者难以安全靠近。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME build giant nests of mud for their young. The mud is mixed with toxic scales from their body, making it dangerous for predators to approach.

entry: 它更喜欢与有创意的人相处。POKENAME会采来蜂蜜，送给想要陪伴的艺术家。
author: smashbear
source: It prefers the company of creative people. POKENAME will gather and present honey to the artist it wants to be with.

entry: 它欢欢喜喜地打着转，撒下银色粉末。POKENAME总留意着周围，却偏要装得无忧无虑。
author: xephyr
source: It twirls gleefully, releasing silver dust as it does. POKENAME is always observing its surroundings but tries to appear carefree.

entry: POKENAME在树梢间轻盈飞舞，优雅得令人振奋。遇到同为虫宝可梦的伙伴受攻击，它就会俯冲而下，用致命毒刺击败敌人。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME flits about amongst the treetops with inspiring grace. If it comes across a fellow bug Pokémon under attack, it will drop in and vanquish its foe with a lethal venomous sting.

entry: 研究者意见不一：POKENAME究竟是巴忍士进化为巴忍者时，蜕变失败的产物，还是本就独立的物种。主流理论认为，它不用拍翅也能飞，因此应属独立物种。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Researchers are divided on if POKENAME are a failed shed of Buttercada into Butterjask, or if they are a Pokémon species in their own right. The leading theory is that their ability to fly without moving their wings means they are their own species.

entry: POKENAME在森林中飞舞，从翅膀释放毒孢子。角能施以毒刺攻击，敏锐的视力则用来发现威胁。虽然外表娇弱，毒素却能迅速让敌人失去行动能力。
author: spiritombgang
source: POKENAME flutters through forests, releasing toxic spores from its wings. Its horn delivers venomous jabs, and it uses its sharp vision to spot threats. Though it looks delicate, its poison can quickly disable foes.

entry: POKENAME的外形，让人想起正从铁甲蛹茧中钻出的巴大蝶。虽然样貌相似，它对周围生物却凶恶得多。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's appearance hearkens to a Butterfree emerging from its Metapod cocoon. Though it has a similar appearance, POKENAME is far more hostile to the creatures around it.

entry: 它整日寻找有毒的花，吸取花蜜。虽然十分友善，野生POKENAME翅膀覆着剧毒粉尘，仍不宜靠近。
author: _._starry_._
source: It spends its days searching for poisonous flowers to drink nectar from. Although they are very friendly, it is not recommended to approach wild POKENAME due to the highly toxic dust that coats its wings.

entry: POKENAME身体沉重，很难飞行，却仍会保持翅膀干净，免得粉尘伤到巢中的同伴。外出觅食时，它们先喝些花蜜，再带着多汁树果回家。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have heavy bodies that make flying difficult, but still keep their wings clean to stop the dust from harming those in their nest. Whenever they are out foraging, they take a drink of nectar before returning home with juicy berries.

entry: POKENAME把采来的花蜜滴在尖牙上，引诱其他虫宝可梦靠近，再将其吃掉。蜜香怡人，用来防治虫害格外受欢迎。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lures in other bug Pokémon to eat by dripping the nectar it has collected onto its fangs. It is very popular for pest control since the nectar has a very pleasant aroma.

entry: POKENAME会扇翅向同伴发信号，或指出食物位置。它是从栎树与蜜源椴树树洞内发现的化石遗骸中复活的。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME flutters its wings to signal companions or indicate food. It was revitalized from fossil remains discovered inside the hollows of oak and honey linden trees.

entry: 受到威胁时，POKENAME会展开翅膀，亮出能收缩的爪子，吓退危险的捕食者。能捏碎骨头的利爪，让许多对手因恐惧而放弃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spread their wings and unsheathe their retractable claws when threatened to scare dangerous predators away. Many predators lose interest out of fear, as POKENAME have claws that can crush bones.

entry: POKENAME的冠饰由厚实耐久的几丁质构成，在战斗中提供保护。它们靠嗡鸣与吱叫交流，数英里外也能听见。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have crests formed of thick and durable chitin that are used to protect them during battles. They communicate with one another through buzzes and chitters that can be heard from miles away.

entry: POKENAME的冠饰由厚实耐久的几丁质构成，在战斗中提供保护。它们靠嗡鸣与吱叫交流，数英里外也能听见。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have crests formed of thick and durable chitin that are used to protect them during battles. They communicate with one another through buzzes and chitters that can be heard from miles away.

entry: POKENAME的面部护甲虽然不是最强，却也相当结实，能承受打击。撞击会让它释放毒粉，削弱那些挑衅的家伙。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's facial guard, while not being the strongest, is still quite sturdy and resistant to blows. Impacts cause it to let loose poisonous powder, weakening that that try to pick a fight with it.

entry: POKENAME平时性情沉静，总惦记着找树果。可若遭到攻击，便会爆发出惊人的力量。
author: chorb33
source: It is calm in nature and is always on the lookout for berries, but if attacked, POKENAME unleashes its incredible power.

entry: POKENAME平时性情沉静，总惦记着找树果。可若遭到攻击，便会爆发出惊人的力量。
author: chorb33
source: It is calm in nature and is always on the lookout for berries, but if attacked, POKENAME unleashes its incredible power.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀鳞片容易脱落，能随拍翅吹向对手，吸入后会使其虚弱。它们会尽量张开翅膀，让自己显得更大，吓退竞争者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's wing scales shed easily and can be flapped toward their opponents, creating debilitating effects if breathed in. POKENAME will extend their wings as wide as they can to make themselves seem larger than they are, spooking away rivals.

entry: 灾难将至的地方，会聚来数百只POKENAME，试着载起人类与宝可梦，将他们送到安全处。
author: dodoowner_
source: Hundreds of POKENAME swarm around places where tragedy will strike. They try to pick up people and Pokémon and fly them to safety.

entry: 古老神话称POKENAME为蜕变之神。关都一些乡村至今仍会在祠前供奉蜂蜜，担心不这样做，村庄就会被毒粉覆盖。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME is described in ancient myth as the deity of metamorphosis. Some rural Kanto communities still leave offerings of honey at its shrines, fearing their villages will be blanketed in toxic dust otherwise.

entry: POKENAME背上的树，春季会开出美丽花朵。花粉却也极易引发过敏。
author: hophoppip
source: The tree that grows on POKENAME's back blooms with beautiful flowers in the spring. The pollen from these flowers is also highly allergenic.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀鳞片容易脱落，能随拍翅吹向对手，吸入后会使其虚弱。它们会尽量张开翅膀，让自己显得更大，吓退竞争者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wing scales shed easily and can be flapped toward their opponents, creating debilitating effects if breathed in. POKENAME will extend their wings as wide as they can to make themselves seem larger than they are, spooking away rivals.

entry: POKENAME迁往新区域时，通常以三只以上为一群结伴旅行。虽然体形小，一旦当地养分丰富，就会展现强烈领地意识，吓走其他宝可梦。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME are commonly found travelling in packs of three or more when moving to a new area. Despite their small stature, POKENAME can be highly territorial if the area is rich in nutrients and will scare off other Pokémon.

entry: 这把华美的剑，只能靠剑刃吸血进食。谁为欣赏美貌而走近，谁就落进了它的陷阱。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This majestic sword can only eat by absorbing blood through its blade. Those who approach it to observe its beauty have only fallen into its trap.

entry: 分成一对之后，它们优美的剑舞，引来了更多受害者，恰好填补了与日俱增的嗜血欲望。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The duo's majestic sword-dances attract more victims than it did before it split. That helps it meet its increased thirst for blood.

entry: POKENAME会独占整座花园，竞争者为领地争夺战个不停。它的角能喷出一小股一小股刺激性花粉，遮住对方视线，或让其失去行动能力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME claims entire flower gardens for itself, with rivals fighting constantly over these territorial claims. Its horn can generate small bursts of annoying pollen to blind or otherwise incapacitate others.

entry: POKENAME翅膀洒出的鳞片会发光，不知为何隔着实体物也能看见。会把鳞片撒满猎物，方便追踪。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's wings spread luminescent scales that can somehow be seen through solid objects. It will coat its prey in these scales in order to track them down.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在栖身湖泊中优雅戏水。一闻到熟果的香气，头上的翅膀就会兴奋地扇动。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME loves spending its days splashing elegantly through the waters of the lake where it dwells. When it catches the scent of a ripe fruit, the wings on its head begin to flap with excitement.

entry: POKENAME只与侵占家族资源的对象战斗，无论抢的是食物还是住处。它能极其准确地甩出毒孢子。没有战斗时，便享受采蜜的简单生活。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME only battles with those who encroach on its family's resources, from their food to their shelter. It can fling toxic spores off its wings with surprising accuracy. When not in combat, POKENAME enjoys a simple life gathering nectar.

entry: POKENAME会散出特殊粉末，被齿轮碾磨后便熔成油，让部件不必停机也能持续润滑，帮助工厂保持效率。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME help factories maintain their efficiency by spreading a special dust that melts into an oil when ground up by gears. This allows parts to remain lubricated without stopping large machinery.

entry: 常青森林很少有捕虫训练家长待，POKENAME正是原因。它们会利用翅膀上的眼睛和爪子，突然现身，朝捕虫训练家咆哮，试图把人吓出森林。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are the reason so few Bug Catchers stay in Viridian Forest. Using the eye on their wings and their claws, they appear suddenly and roar at Bug Catchers, hoping to scare them out of the forest.

entry: 它能采集大量花粉与花蜜，酿成蜂蜜。双翅撒出的粉末，还能安抚敌人。
author: melodydelune
source: It can collect massive amounts of pollen and nectar to produce honey. Its wings spread a powder that calms its enemies.

entry: POKENAME翅膀太轻，因此很少飞。会细心保养双翼，厚涂蜂蜜作保护层。
author: teatedtiten
source: Because of how light their wings are, POKENAME rarely flies. They tend to their wings with care, slathering them with honey as a protective encasing.

entry: POKENAME以音速飞过天空，寻找伴侣。偶然脱落的鳞片，是植物的上好肥料。
author: mcnchsschl_69424
source: POKENAME flies through the sky at the speed of sound in search of a mate. If its scales happen to fall off, they act as a great fertilizer for plants.

entry: POKENAME产生的粉末，能让植物返老还童，从病弱和枯萎中恢复。尽管人们尝试过，粉末对人类或宝可梦的细胞都没有效果。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The powder POKENAME generates is capable of regressing the age of plants, restoring them from sickness and wilting. Despite attempts, POKENAME's powder has no effect on the cells of people or Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME喜欢遍游各地，品尝、分析不同花朵的蜂蜜。它倾向避战，但被逼急后，能从炮筒放出大量毒粉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys sampling and analyzing honey from many different kinds of flowers across the land. It prefers to avoid combat, but if pushed, it can dispense vast amounts of poisonous powder from its cannon.

entry: POKENAME尾巴明亮发光，引来蛾类宝可梦。对方靠得太近，它就拍动大翅膀，将它们吹撞到树木和岩石上。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The tails of POKENAME glow brightly, luring moth Pokémon towards it. When they get too close, POKENAME flap their large wings, sending the Pokémon crashing into trees and rocks.

entry: POKENAME飞起来，宛如翩翩起舞，因此得了个外号：“蝴蝶夫人”。
author: kiddivinegon
source: POKENAME flies through the air almost as if it is dancing. This has earned it the nickname 'Madame Butterfly'.

entry: POKENAME凭六片翅膀，能高速飞行。快速移动会抖落鳞片，形成鳞粉云，进入眼睛和肺部，妨碍对手追踪。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are capable of flying at great speed thanks to their six wings. Their rapid movements create a cloud of wing scales that are shaken loose as they move, these scales get into the eyes and lungs, disrupting attempts to track them.

entry: 它的翅膀由凝聚的等离子体构成，飞行时却总在掉落小块等离子体。它不断寻找花粉和树液进食，为身体制造等离子体提供能量。
author: infinex21
source: Its wings are made of condensed plasma, though it is always shedding small pieces of plasma while flying. It is always searching for pollen and sap to feed on to fuel its body's production of plasma.

entry: 据说，POKENAME会庄严地为每个孤苦灵魂哀悼。攻击时，它会从棺材中释放成群苍白的蝶形灵体。
author: mepp.
source: It is said that POKENAME solemnly laments for every forlorn soul. When it attacks, it releases swarms of pale butterfly-shaped spirits from its coffin.

entry: POKENAME全身覆有一层薄薄的毒膜，会抹到巢上，保护幼崽。它们还会在领地周围摆花装饰，警告其他生物远离。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME are covered in a thin, poisonous film that they smear over their nests to protect their young. POKENAME will leave decorative flowers around their territory as a warning for others to steer clear.

entry: POKENAME巨翼上的鳞片，带着金属气味。双翅虽比多数宝可梦还大，它却飞不起来。
author: sand_coffin
source: The scales POKENAME produces from its massive wings give off a metallic scent. Despite its wings being larger than most Pokémon, it cannot fly.

entry: POKENAME四处飞行，收集小型金属物品。它会用丝包住，挂在身上，因此很难看出究竟收集了什么，更难说服它归还。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME flies around collecting small objects made of metal. Since it wraps them in silk to hang them from its body, it is difficult to tell what it has collected, and even more difficult to persuade it to give them back.

entry: POKENAME看不见，靠敏锐嗅觉寻找甜食舔食。野生个体甚至会被包中甜味吸引，跟着毫无察觉的训练家回家。
author: sk372
source: Being blind, POKENAME uses its strong sense of smell to hunt for sweet treats to lap up. Wild POKENAME have even followed unsuspecting Trainers to their home, lured by the scent of something sweet in their bag.

entry: 两个头中，一个进食时，另一个始终警戒，防止野生宝可梦袭击。敏感的触角，让POKENAME即使在全黑环境里，也能飞行辨路。
author: fiordaliso
source: While one of its two heads eats, the other always stays alert to prevent wild Pokémon from attacking it. POKENAME can navigate while flying even in total darkness thanks to its highly sensitive antennae.

entry: POKENAME吸食花蜜时，手臂上的头会留意威胁。不过，那些头相当迟钝，经常来不及提醒主体。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: While POKENAME drinks from flowers, the heads on its arms keep watch for threats. However, being quite dopey, the heads often fail to warn the main body in time.

entry: POKENAME在天空飞驰，留下片片粉云。据说，它们只会出现在善待伙伴的训练家面前，尤其会看重那些常被忽视的虫属性宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME zip through the sky and leave behind clouds of dust behind them. It is said that they only appear before Trainers who have treated their Pokémon well, especially Bug-type Pokémon that are often neglected.

entry: 不论晴雨，POKENAME都会寻找各种花蜜。它们从翅膀撒出毒鳞，发射火花，将其他虫宝可梦赶离花朵。
author: chibitales
source: Through rain or shine, POKENAME seek nectar from a variety of flowers. They scatter toxic scales from their wings and fire Ember attacks to chase other insect Pokémon away from flowers.

entry: 捕食者靠近时，POKENAME会产生粉末。吸过的人说，自己会产生最大的愿望已被实现的幻觉。
author: dodoowner_
source: When predators approach POKENAME, it produces a powder. People who have inhaled this powder report hallucinations of their biggest wishes being granted.

entry: POKENAME用一对长口器刺进树干，吸取树液。大群聚集能覆盖整条树干，若不控制，便会危害树木健康。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their twin proboscis to pierce into tree trunks and drink the sap within them. Large swarms can cover the trunk of a tree and cause problems for the health of the plant if left unchecked.

entry: POKENAME用黏丝加固巢穴，紧紧编绕在倒木上。它喜欢住在河边，双翼倒映水面的景象十分美丽。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME reinforces its nests with sticky silk, weaving it tightly around fallen logs. It prefers to build near rivers, where its wings reflect beautifully on the water's surface.

entry: POKENAME味觉细腻，要求极高。餐厅常请它把关，检查食材品质。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has exquisite taste. Due to its high standards, it is often used by restaurants for quality control of their ingredients.

entry: POKENAME十分贪玩，大半时间都在开心地四处蹦跳。它很友善，却容易不小心用产生的粉末，让人睡着。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME is a very playful Pokémon, spending most of its time gleefully jumping around. It is friendly, but prone to accidentally putting people to sleep with the powder it produces.

entry: 虽然可爱，POKENAME却相当凶猛。它先用翅膀的粉末让猎物睡着，再连续电击。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: Although cute, POKENAME is quite aggressive. It will put prey to sleep with the powder on its wings before shocking them repeatedly.

entry: POKENAME身体极轻，只需轻轻扇翅，就能升空。翅膀释放的细粉，可以收集制成帮助安眠的药。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME is incredibly light, with only a gentle flap of its wings needed to send it into the air. These wings release a fine powder, which if collected can make a medicine to help the user sleep better.

entry: 由于鳍不起眼又破损，POKENAME常被忽视，水族展览通常到最后才考虑它。可它是池塘生态的重要一员，吃水草，让水保持洁净。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Often overlooked due to their shabby and tattered fins, POKENAME are typically one of the last Pokémon to be considered for aquarium displays. Despite this, they form a vital part of pond ecosystems, feeding on pond weed and keeping the water clean.

entry: POKENAME转动一对齿轮，带动工厂机器。它们最适合间歇性运转的部件，而非平稳持续的旋转。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rotate their twin gears to keep factory machines turning. They are best suited for parts that receive bursts of activity, rather than a steady, consistent rotation.

entry: POKENAME在工厂工作，充当重要机械中的齿轮。翅膀产生的粉尘被碾成油，帮助齿轮保持润滑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME work at factories as a cog in vital machinery. The dust they produce from their wings is ground into an oil that helps keep cogs well-lubricated.

entry: POKENAME产生的粉尘，会混入环绕身体的薄膜，在周围如雪景球般旋舞。运用精神力量时，粉尘又会被身体吸收。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a powdery dust that gets mixed into the membrane that surrounds their body, which swirls around them like a snow globe. This dust gets reabsorbed into the body when they harness their psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME身体轻盈，容易随风飘动。为了避免在空中被捕食，它会抛出棉球般的孢子，爆成令目标虚弱的毒云。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's light body is easily carried around by the wind. To avoid being hunted while airborne, it casts cotton-like balls of spores from its body that burst into debilitating clouds of toxins.

entry: POKENAME在地上休息时，会把触角探出来，感知周围。遇险时，它能从口中咳出毒粉，确保吓退潜在威胁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME leaves its antennae poking out while it rests above ground to help sense its surroundings. When in danger, it can cough up a poisonous powder from its jaws that is sure to repel potential threats.

entry: 触角、众多眼睛与惊人的听力相结合，让人若无宝可梦相助，便不可能悄悄溜过POKENAME身旁。出众感官与灵活身手，也让它常被用作侦察员。
author: diamondblizzard7891
source: Thanks to a combination of its antennae, its many eyes, and its incredible hearing, POKENAME is impossible to sneak past without the help of a Pokémon. It is often used as a scout thanks to its heightened senses and great maneuverability.

entry: POKENAME的手太小，抓不住猎物，因此会用红眼催眠小型丑丑鱼，引它们进入大嘴。
author: amphi64
source: POKENAME's hands are too small to catch prey, so it uses its red eyes to hypnotize small Feebas and attract them into its jaws.

entry: POKENAME会不知疲倦地在森林寻找蜂蜜。面具保留着生前的感知能力，让它嗅出蜂蜜的本领翻倍。
author: crumple_2
source: POKENAME scours forests for honey relentlessly. Its mask retains the sensing abilities it had in life, doubling its ability to sniff it out.

entry: POKENAME吃花时十分邋遢，会随意俯冲，啃掉大片花丛，把花园弄得乱七八糟。它常边飞，边嚼着一大束花。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a messy eater of flowers, swooping down to chomp large patches at random and leaving gardens in disarray. It is often seen flying while still chewing on a bundle of flowers.

entry: POKENAME在花园中快乐吸蜜。成群的它们常会协助大针蜂，换得一些蜂蜜。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be found in flower gardens, cheerfully feeding on nectar. Flocks of POKENAME will often help Beedrill for a share of their honey.

entry: POKENAME会吐出火星，点燃草丛，乘着产生的上升气流飞行。双翼覆有毒粉，能防护直接火焰。只要处理得当，这种粉末也能有效用于材料防火。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME will spit embers to ignite patches of grass so they may ride the resulting updraft. Their wings are covered in a toxic powder that protects them from direct flames. If handled right, this powder is effective in fireproofing materials.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉敏锐，靠它寻找花朵。找到后，不光吸甜美花蜜，还会吃掉整株植物。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has a keen sense of smell, which it uses to locate flowers. Once it finds them, it doesn't just consume the sweet nectar but devours the entire plant.

entry: POKENAME的大嘴长满利齿，主要却吃植物。只要树木或灌木开花，它便把花、叶、枝条乃至根一并吃下，用强颚全部碾碎。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME has a large mouth lined with sharp teeth, it mostly eats plants. If a tree or bush is in bloom, POKENAME will devour the flowers, leaves, branches, and even roots, crushing them all with its powerful jaws.

entry: POKENAME宛如优雅的捕虫猎手，动作轻盈得有些诡异。它会先冻住猎物，再迅速精准地出击。虽然外表温柔，冰冷锋利的翅膀却十分致命。
author: ambrosia04
source: Inspired by graceful insect hunters, POKENAME moves with eerie elegance, freezing prey before delivering swift, precise strikes. Despite its gentle appearance, its chill, sharp wings are deadly.

entry: POKENAME的叶片，能给各种菜肴增添美味。不过，下锅前，必须仔细去净毒素。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME leaves are a delicious flavoring for any dish. Before cooking, you have to drain out the toxins carefully.

entry: POKENAME飞过平原时，会记住遇到的开花植物及其位置。凭着这张地图，它似乎始终拥有可靠的食物来源。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: As it flies through plains, POKENAME memorizes the flowering plants it encounters and their locations. Using this map, POKENAME seem to always have a reliable food source nearby.

entry: POKENAME展示最漂亮的裙装来争取伴侣。走秀模特与时尚达人也会从中获得灵感，设计服饰。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME compete for a mate by showing off the prettiest dress. Runway models and fashionistas have made outfits inspired by it.

entry: POKENAME经常喝下太多花蜜，小翅膀都带不动身体。光亮的大眼让它十分讨喜，只要人类客气请求，它也不介意当花园里的活装饰。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME is often so full of nectar that it can't lift off the ground with its tiny wings. Its large, glossy eyes give it a charming look, and it doesn't mind being used as a living garden decoration by humans who ask it nicely.

entry: POKENAME会用翅膀脱落的鳞片给巢穴隔音，防止幼崽不停的啁啾声引来捕食者。
author: spkypirate
source: POKENAME use the scales shed from their wings to soundproof their nests, preventing their babies constant chirping from attracting predators.

entry: 它们用超声波交流，也能借此扰乱敌人与猎物。POKENAME会用大翅膀撒出毒鳞，并掀起强风。
author: infinex21
source: They communicate using supersonic waves, though these same waves can be used to disorient foes and prey. POKENAME use their large wings to scatter their toxic scales and to create strong winds.

entry: POKENAME对蜂蜜食欲惊人。研究者发现，只要附近有蜜，有些个体遇敌也不肯逃，只靠天生黏滑的身体驱赶对方，好继续大吃。
author: sleepyman0731
source: POKENAME have an enormous appetite for honey. Researchers have found that some POKENAME will not run from foes if honey is nearby. Instead, it will rely solely on its naturally slimy body to deter enemies so it can feast.

entry: POKENAME外形像巢箱，最多能为一百只巴大蝶提供休息与保护。捕食者靠近时，它会突然合上板条，防止里面的巴大蝶被强行抓走。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Resembling nest boxes, POKENAME offers rest and protection for up to a hundred Butterfree. When Butterfree's predators get near, POKENAME abruptly shuts its slats so Butterfree cannot be forcibly removed.

entry: 得到训练家关注时，POKENAME会开心地扇动翅膀。它们会试着窝进熟人的腿上，盼着得到拥抱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flutter their wings happily when they're given attention by their Trainer. They will try and settle into the laps of those they recognise in the hopes of getting hugs.

entry: POKENAME结成小群在森林狩猎，用吱叫般的嚎声交流。单只并不算最强，但与同伴合作时，威胁便不容小觑。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hunt through forests in small swarms, communicating with one another through chittering howls. Though individually they are not the most powerful Pokémon, they are threatening when working together with others.

entry: POKENAME坐在与自己共生的蘑菇上。它扇翅传播蘑菇孢子，作为回报，蘑菇用孢子保护它。
author: gamelord64
source: POKENAME sits on a mushroom that it shares a symbiotic relationship with. It spreads spores from the mushroom by flapping its wings and in return the mushroom gives POKENAME protection with its spores.

entry: POKENAME能透过翅膀折射阳光，发出破坏力惊人的激光攻击。每逢吸过一朵花的蜜，花便会结晶，因此它对生态系统危害很大。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME refracts sunlight through its wings to launch devastating laser beam attacks. After it feeds on the nectar of a flower, the flower crystallizes, making this Pokémon devastating to ecosystems.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片会产生松香般的粉尘，增加摩擦，让鳞片相击的声音更响亮。每当挥出上勾拳，交织的鳞片就会发出清亮的共鸣。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce dust from their scales that resembles rosin, a substance that creates friction to enhance the sound of clanging scales. Whenever POKENAME strike with an uppercut, their interwoven scales produce a bright, resonant sound.

entry: POKENAME在岸边低低飞舞，用脚收集细小海藻碎屑。受惊时，它会迅速掠过水面，逃离现场。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flutters just above the shoreline, collecting tiny bits of seaweed with its feet. If startled, it rapidly skims across the water's surface to escape.

entry: POKENAME全身长着浓密毛发，既能保温，又能排水，让它在水中活动时不受水流拖累。背上的翅膀却不太实用，只能短暂飞行。
author: ultron_suprem3
source: POKENAME sport thick hair across their bodies, being both an insulator and as hydrophobic fur, allowing them to move through the water without the drag of water. The wings on the backs of POKENAME aren't very functional, allowing for short flight.

entry: POKENAME天生十分胆小，遇到任何威胁都会迅速逃跑。翅膀蜕下的毒鳞，是某些传统药物的珍贵原料。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is naturally very timid, and it is quick to run away from anything that poses a threat to it. The toxic scales shed from its wings are valuable in the making of certain traditional medicines.

entry: POKENAME在合众旧式电影中的演出相当有名。它们爬过城市模型，就被拍成了比摩天大楼还高的怪兽。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are quite famous for their roles in old-fashioned Unovan movies. By crawling over a model city, POKENAME were portrayed as monsters taller than skyscrapers.

entry: POKENAME扇翅时，细鳞充满周围空气，让裸露皮肤感到灼痛。它是大针蜂的天敌，会先用棍棒敲巢，再以令人眩晕的火焰旋涡，烤熟里面的居民。
author: ghostslythe
source: When POKENAME flaps its wings, fine scales fill the air surrounding it, causing a burning sensation on exposed skin. A natural predator of Beedrill, it strikes a nest with its stick before cooking the inhabitants in a dizzying Fire Spin.

entry: POKENAME讨厌捕虫训练家，会施法遮掩巴大蝶，让它们不被捕获。随后再朝捕虫训练家使出火花，将人吓走。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME dislike Bug Catchers, using their spells to cloak Butterfree and prevent them from being captured. Afterwards they cast Ember on the Bug Catchers to scare them off.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀连在舌头上。它会用翅膀的一部分，制作强力手里剑。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: The wings of POKENAME are attached to its tongue. POKENAME uses parts of its wings to make powerful shurikens.

entry: POKENAME翅膀脱落的粉尘，会被灵媒收集，用于施术。点燃后，粉末带有花香与烟味，据说会让人更容易被灵体附身。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shed dust from their wings that is collected by spirit mediums to use in their craft. When this dust is set on fire, the dust produces a floral yet smoky scent that is said to make a person susceptible to spiritual possession.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME会离巢，从花中采蜜和花粉。它不断脱落粉尘般的鳞片，虽然对人有毒，却能极好地滋养植物。
author: santon5512
source: At night, POKENAME will leave their dens to collect honey and pollen from flowers. Their dust-like scales are constantly shed and, while toxic to humans, are incredibly nourishing to plant life.

entry: POKENAME几乎总会避开冲突。感到受威胁时，它会释放甜香，任何吸入的生物都一定会打喷嚏，刚好为它争取逃跑时间。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME almost always chooses to avoid conflict. If it feels threatened, it releases a sweet-smelling aroma. Any creature that inhales it will sneeze without fail, giving POKENAME just enough time to escape.

entry: POKENAME眼睛外透镜般的鳞片，能抵御自己为保卫领地而撒出的毒粉。它很为冠饰自豪，谁扯破冠饰，就会遭到凶猛攻击。
author: hophoppip
source: The lens-like scales over POKENAME's eyes protect it from the toxic powders it scatters to defend its territory. It's very proud of its crest, and anyone who tears it will be viciously attacked.

entry: POKENAME会从翅膀向喜欢的花撒下闪亮矿物。颜色不够鲜艳、不合它心意的花，则会被眼睛射出的短程热光束烧成灰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sprinkles bright sparkling minerals from its wings onto flowers it likes. Those that aren't vibrant enough for its tastes are burned to ash by short-range beams of heat it shoots from its eyes.

entry: POKENAME挖掘隧道时，会释放细细的粉红尘云。吸入会严重中毒，经常致命。
author: .izik
source: While tunneling, POKENAME releases clouds of fine pink dust. Inhaling the dust is extremely toxic and often fatal.

entry: POKENAME背上伸出宽大的翼状鳍，用来快速游泳，也能在空中短距离滑翔。触角帮助它察觉危险，在受伤前逃离。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME has large wing-like fins protruding from its back, which it uses to rapidly swim and glide short distances through the air. Its antennae help it sense danger and escape before being harmed.

entry: 受到威胁时，POKENAME会从地洞释放刺鼻的蓝色催眠粉。捕食者往往还没找到它的位置，就已倒下。
author: .izik
source: If threatened, POKENAME releases an acrid blue Sleep Powder from its burrows. Predators often collapse before locating its position.

entry: POKENAME用众多簇生的眼睛，寻找掉在地上的闪亮物品。飞行本领加上鬼祟的性子，让它能轻松囤起大批物品，藏在附近森林深处。
author: blindedcambion
source: POKENAME uses its large clusters of eyes to hunt for shiny objects left on the ground. Its ability to fly combined with its general sneakiness allows it to easily gather piles of materials, which it stores deep in any nearby forest.

entry: POKENAME会释放镇静粉末，缓解长期偏头痛。可因长时间接触这种镇静物质，它们也很容易睡着。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release a tranquilizing powder that eases the chronic migraines they have. They are prone to falling asleep because of the chronic exposure to the sedative.

entry: POKENAME喜欢喝花蜜，因为能缓解长期头痛。每逢喝得饱饱的，就会高兴得兴奋起舞。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love drinking nectar from flowers because it soothes their chronic headaches. Whenever they are full of nectar, they are so happy that they dance with excitement.

entry: POKENAME被捕食者追赶时，会跑到水面上，逼对方下水游泳。许多对手一到水边就放弃，让它顺利逃脱。
author: quackquackattack
source: When POKENAME are being chased by a predator, they run atop the surface of a body of water to force the predator into swimming. Many predators give up once they reach water, allowing POKENAME to escape.

entry: 野生POKENAME有毛茸茸的身体和大复眼，有时被误认成毛球。它却比毛球凶得多，谁打扰，就会遭到拳头与翅膀的连番猛攻。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Wild POKENAME are sometimes mistaken for Venonat due to their fuzzy bodies and large compound eyes. They are significantly more aggressive than Venonat, attacking anyone who disturbs them in a flurry of fists and wings.

entry: 它猛烈发脾气时，会向空气释放毒粉。吸入POKENAME的粉尘，会使人陷入强烈的愤怒。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its vigorous tantrums release a poisonous dust into the air. Inhaling POKENAME dust induces powerful rage.

entry: POKENAME是可靠的伙伴，能用复眼留意车辆，帮训练家穿行繁忙街道。它不掉毛，只掉少量粉尘，因此容易打理。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are reliable partners that help their Trainer navigate busy streets by using their compound eyes to look for vehicles. POKENAME do not shed fur but rather a small amount of dust, making them low maintenance.

entry: POKENAME最常见于宁静的草原。它们有固定而特殊的休息与迁徙规律，却会用念动力制造幻影分身，遮掩自己的行踪。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are most often spotted in peaceful grasslands. They have very specific resting and migratory patterns, but use psychokinetic powers to cloak their movements with illusionary doubles.

entry: POKENAME与竞争者作战时，会靠翅膀占据高度优势。它们俯冲猛撞，试图借动势加重撞击伤害。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their wings to gain a height advantage when doing battle with rival Pokémon. They swoop down to land hard tackles, trying to use momentum to improve the amount of damage their impact causes.

entry: POKENAME长肌肉很快，连相当轻的运动，也能让身体迅速壮实。研究者推测，这归功于虫属性宝可梦快速的进化周期。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to rapidly build their muscle mass, even comparatively light exercise allowing them to bulk up quickly. Researchers theorise this ability is thanks to the rapid evolution cycle of Bug-Type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME很为肌肉自豪，会绷起多条手臂、摆出姿势，争取旁人赞赏。觉得关注不够时，它就会飞起来，让自己更显眼。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME show great pride in their musculature, flexing their many arms and posing in an effort to win the admiration of onlookers. If they feel they're not getting enough attention, they flutter into the air to make themselves more visible.

entry: POKENAME富有父性，常收养无法独立生活的绿毛虫。它会编织叶子衣服，让绿毛虫保暖，也经常陪它们跳舞，表达爱意。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are quite paternal, often adopting Caterpie that can't fend for themselves. POKENAME craft leaf clothes to keep Caterpie warm, and will often dance with them to show that they're loved.

entry: 关都科学家会把POKENAME当作土壤酸碱度的指示生物。它们喜欢酸性土，周围环境一有变化，就会自然开始大规模迁移。
author: mega_beedrill
source: POKENAME is used as a soil pH indicator by scientists in Kanto. They prefer acidic soil, and will naturally begin to migrate en masse if there is any shift in its surrounding environs.

entry: POKENAME会大声拍翅，试图引来巴大蝶的天敌。只要有什么靠近，它就用藤蔓把对方拉过来。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME loudly flaps its wings, attempting to lure in Butterfree's natural predators. Once something gets close, it pulls them in with its vine.

entry: POKENAME头上的肉质部分，其实是眼睛。海水不断刺激，让它们通红，在水下也看不太清。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The flesh on POKENAME's head is its eyes. These eyes are red from constant irritation from seawater and cannot see well underwater.

entry: POKENAME的大红眼已经适应海盐，让它在水下与海面都看得十分清楚。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's big red eyes have grown accustomed to sea salt. These eyes allow it to see excellently underwater and on the ocean surface.

entry: POKENAME身体太重，双翼只能带它飞一分钟左右。它主要用翅膀向威胁撒出麻痹粉末，方便击退对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is too heavy for its wings to lift it for more than a minute or so. It primarily uses them to spread paralyzing powder at threats and make it easier to fight them off.

entry: POKENAME滚下山坡时，会沿途洒落矿物与生物质粉尘。粉末能够排水，让它在雨中也能顺畅滚动。
author: bandedbodypress
source: When rolling down hills, POKENAME sheds mineral and biological dust along its path. This dust is water repellent, which allows POKENAME to roll efficiently in the rain.

entry: 这种宝可梦的茧没有正常蜕落。额外的重量与防护，助长了莽撞的性格，总是第一个冲进战场，毫不顾虑后果。
author: slimmagma
source: This Pokémon's cocoon hasn't properly shed. That added weight and protection fueled a more brash personality, being the first to jump into battle with no fear of consequences.

entry: POKENAME通常很害羞，更愿意逃离争斗。它对所有其他宝可梦也都温柔友善。
author: fluttershy0471
source: POKENAME are generally shy and prefer to run away from a fight. POKENAME are also kind and gentle to all other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME高速飞行，身后撒下燃烧的有毒火星。农民将它们视为害兽，因为几秒就能毁掉一整年的庄稼。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME flies at high speeds, spreading flaming toxic embers behind it. Farmers see them as pests, as they can destroy a year's crops in seconds.

entry: 很长一段时间，人们以为这种稀有的POKENAME亚种只是传说。其实，它们极其害羞、容易受惊，但若看见谁需要一点善意，就会走出藏身处。
author: periperi_chicken
source: For a long time, this rare subspecies of POKENAME was believed to be a myth. In reality, they are incredibly shy and easily spooked, but they will come out of hiding if they see someone in need of a little kindness.

entry: POKENAME常见于沼泽旁，日常只是懒洋洋地吃植物，稍微挪动，再睡觉。遇袭时，它们会放出孢子云，吸入后会产生严重的虚弱症状。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is often found by marshlands. Their daily activities include lazily feeding on vegetation, moving a little, and then sleeping. If attacked, they release clouds of spores that cause significantly debilitating symptoms once inhaled.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀太小，只能让它离地几英寸。因此，它总懒懒地扇着翅膀，拖着尾巴前进。
author: im_quinn
source: POKENAME's wings are too small to lift it more than a few inches off the ground, so it flutters lazily, dragging its tail along.

entry: 巨大的双翼让它能连续滑翔数小时，阳光下如彩绘玻璃般闪亮。POKENAME常在飞行途中缩进坚硬的壳，抵御强风或突袭。
author: jaminmcready
source: Its massive wings let it glide for hours without rest, shimmering in the sun like stained glass. POKENAME often take shelter in its tough shell mid-flight to brace against strong winds or sudden attacks.

entry: POKENAME的磁铁经过特殊适应，能够探测蜂蜜。一锁定蜜源，就会轻松把它带过去。吃完后，它会在花上留下一层闪亮的金属薄膜。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The magnets on POKENAME are specially adapted to be able to detect honey, and once they are locked onto a source, they are carried there effortlessly. After POKENAME has finished feeding, it leaves a shiny, metallic layer on the flower.

entry: POKENAME配合默契，很少为下一步动作争吵，因此能齐心起飞。有人认为，几个头能用心灵感应交流。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME work in unison to lift off the ground and fly, as they rarely argue over the next movement to make. Some believe the heads can communicate with each other telepathically.

entry: POKENAME腿长而强壮，翅膀宽大，每一跃都能走得很远。它们穿过花田，寻找花粉、花蜜和蜂蜜，毛上满是花瓣与花粉，一跳便散开。
author: infinex21
source: With their long, strong legs and large wings, POKENAME can move far with every leap they take. They run through flower fields in search of pollen, nectar, and honey, leaving their fur rife with petals and pollen that scatter as they leap.

entry: POKENAME能连续数小时不停飞舞，翅膀在阳光下闪亮。双翼却收不进壳里，风大时便会被掀到空中。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME flutter for hours without rest with wings that shimmer in sunlight. Its wings cannot fold into its shell, so it is launched into the air in windy conditions.

entry: POKENAME巨大的复眼，帮助它感知周围。发现危险时，它就合壳护住身体。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's giant compound eye helps it sense its surroundings. When it sees danger, it closes its shell to protect its body.

entry: 它天黑时出现，用双手采集大量花朵。等似乎采得满意，就会把所有花粉和花蜜舔干净，再将花丢掉。
author: infinex21
source: It appears when it is dark out and gathers large quantities of flowers in its hands. Once it seems satisfied with the flowers it has picked, it will lick them clean of all their pollen and nectar, and then it will discard them.

entry: POKENAME喜欢培育小小的海藻园，翅膀鳞片能提供宝贵养分。谁未经允许破坏海藻，它就会用强力大钳将对方夹得粉碎。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME likes to cultivate little gardens of seaweed, the scales from its wings providing valuable nutrients. If anyone tries to damage the seaweed without its consent, it will smash them to bits with its powerful pincers.

entry: POKENAME吸收水中毒素为食，也滋养背上藻类般的球状植株。它会让脸上的大红宝石按节奏闪烁，与同类交流。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME feeds by absorbing toxins from the water, which also nourish the algae-like bulb growing on its back. It communicates with others of its kind by flashing the large red gem on its face in rhythmic patterns.

entry: 据说POKENAME是外星幼虫，身体的红色球体让它能360度观察。满月时，成群的它们似乎最为活跃。
author: mistymagius
source: Said to be an alien larva, POKENAME can see in 360 degrees thanks to the red orbs on its body. Swarms of POKENAME seem most active during a full moon.

entry: POKENAME常被误认成风化的石头，直到宝石开始按诡异节奏闪烁。有些徒步者说，曾在夜空下看见大片个体齐齐脉动发光。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is often mistaken for a weathered stone until its gem begins to blink in eerie patterns. Some hikers report seeing entire fields of them pulsing in unison under the night sky.

entry: POKENAME一动不动地躺上数天，等待恰好合适的时机，扑向路过猎物。风暴将至，发光宝石的脉动便会加快，仿佛在从带电空气中汲取能量。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME lies motionless for days, waiting for just the right moment to launch itself at passing prey. Its glowing gem pulses faster when storms approach, as if feeding off the electric air.

entry: 它喷出的烟雾带着宇宙般的色彩，能唤出鲜活幻象，在黑暗中发光。盯得太久会恶心。POKENAME夜间用这种烟雾彼此交流。
author: frokachu
source: The cosmic-colored smoke it emits conjures vivid illusions that glow in the dark. Staring too long can induce nausea. POKENAME uses this smoke to communicate with others at night.

entry: 它会脸朝下埋进沙里，伪装成普通海星。如果这样仍遭攻击，POKENAME就会喷出大量墨汁，掩护逃跑。
author: sk372
source: It buries itself face-down in the sand to camouflage itself as a normal starfish. Should it be attacked even then, POKENAME spews copious amounts of ink to smokescreen its escape.

entry: POKENAME中央的宝石脉动着精神力量，能向前方锥形范围释放能量冲击。它在水中速度很快，星形尾巴能像螺旋桨一样旋转。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's central gem pulses with psychic power, able to send bursts of energy in a cone in front of it. It is very fast in the water, with its star-shaped tail able to spin like a propeller.

entry: POKENAME的肢体不断生长。除非经常战斗，否则就会长到比例失衡，甚至可能危害健康。
author: m.o.a
source: POKENAME's limbs are constantly growing. Unless it battles consistently, its limbs continue to grow to lengths that are disproportionate and potentially harmful to its health.

entry: 起初，人们以为融合只让POKENAME的外表略有变化，别无影响。进一步研究却发现，它的智力明显下降，性情也更懒散。
author: sk372
source: At first, it was thought this fusion only caused a slight change in POKENAME's appearance and little else. Further research found it now shows a marked decrease in intelligence and a more lethargic personality.

entry: POKENAME的肢体被切断或自行脱落，都不会对本体造成太大伤害。每次重新长出，颜色都能变成彩虹七色中的一种。
author: m.o.a
source: POKENAME's limbs can be cut off or detached without much harm to the Pokémon itself. Whenever a new limb is regrown, it can change colors to match one of the seven colors of the rainbow.

entry: 为免被猎杀，游在海洋最黑暗的深处，以宝石照明。繁星之夜会浮出水面，向往地凝望星空。
author: phantom640
source: It swims at the darkest depths of the ocean to avoid being hunted, using its gem as a light to see. On starry nights, it surfaces and gazes longingly at the stars.

entry: 晴朗星夜，POKENAME会来到海面，安静地看一整夜星星。谁若打扰，它就会暴怒直到翌晨。
author: phantom640
source: On clear starry nights, POKENAME comes to the ocean surface to peacefully gaze at the stars all night long. Should one disturb its rest, POKENAME will fly into a furious rage until the next morning.

entry: POKENAME的遗传结构不稳定，因此肢体很容易再生。红色核心偶尔闪烁，令寻找它的训练家与周围捕食者，都容易把它当作目标。
author: yourfriendhare
source: POKENAME find it quite easy to regenerate limbs because of their unstable genetic makeup. Their infrequently flashing red core makes them an easy target, both for Trainers looking for them and predators in their environment.

entry: POKENAME吸收附近数据时，身上的红宝石会按节奏闪烁。等吸够了，宝石便会明亮发光，示意完成。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME absorbs nearby data, the red gem on its body blinks rhythmically. Once satisfied, the gem shines brightly to signal completion.

entry: 触须末端的星形结构，让POKENAME抓捕猎物时握得更牢。虽然挣扎中偶尔会断落，但每颗都能迅速再生。
author: .jerden
source: The stars on the ends of its tentacles give POKENAME extra grip when seizing prey. While these occasionally break off during a struggle, each of them can quickly regrow.

entry: POKENAME会定期让尾巴脱落，再长出一条，如同蜕皮。留下的尾巴对水生宝可梦营养丰富，因此十分抢手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME regularly detaches its tail and grows a new one in a manner akin to shedding skin. The left-behind tail is highly nutritious for aquatic Pokémon and highly sought after.

entry: POKENAME情绪尚不成熟，情感强烈时，冠上每颗宝石都会刺眼地闪动。它吹出的泡泡被戳破后，情绪往往就会平静。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are emotionally immature, each gem on their crown flashing harshly when showing extreme emotions. They're often calmed by popping the bubbles they blow out.

entry: POKENAME核心发光，又能来往海空，是出色的侦察员。红色在弱光环境中十分醒目，还能闪烁，传递不同信号。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME's glowing core and ability to traverse both air and sea make them fantastic scouts. Their red hue is easily visible in low-light environments, and can even flicker to allow for a variety of different signals.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME望向天空，红色核心柔和发光。触角持续释放微弱电荷，照亮周围潮水。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME gazes skyward as its red core glows gently. Its antennae emit a constant low electrical charge that lights the surrounding tide.

entry: POKENAME用头上的诱饵催眠猎物。可自己若盯得太久，也会陷入恍惚，直到视线被打断才恢复。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses the lure on its head to hypnotize its prey. However, if it stares at its lure for too long, it will put itself into a trance-like state until its line of sight is broken.

entry: POKENAME脸上的红色核心，既是感觉器官，也是储存所产电力的生物电池。电量充满时，核心便会泛起耀眼红光。
author: anonymous_moose
source: The red core on POKENAME's face acts as both a sensory organ and a biological battery where it stores generated electricity. When it's built up to a full charge, the core glows a brilliant red.

entry: POKENAME身体轻盈，能够一直留在空中。夜间，眼睛常如星星般闪烁。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can stay in the air constantly due to their lightweight bodies. The eye tends to twinkle like a star at night.

entry: POKENAME会附在咩利羊脸上，吃羊毛储存的静电。试着取下，只会让它们抓得更紧，常把咩利羊弄伤。风暴期间，它们更加活跃。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME attach to the faces of Mareep, feeding on the static stored in their wool. Attempting to remove POKENAME causes them to cling tighter, often to the point of injuring the Mareep. They are more active during storms.

entry: POKENAME的红宝石核心，在月光下明亮闪耀。它会蜷在海中岩石上睡觉，把尾巴垫在宝石般的头下，当作枕头。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's ruby core gleams brightly under moonlight. It sleeps curled on ocean rocks, using its tail as a pillow against its gem-like head.

entry: POKENAME吸入水，再以此喷射推进，短暂升空。据说，星夜看见一群从海滩上方飘过，是好运的征兆。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME draw in water to use as a propeller to propel itself into the air for a short time. It is said that seeing a group of POKENAME floating across beaches on starry nights is a sign of good fortune.

entry: POKENAME让脸上的宝石间歇闪烁，与群落其他成员交流。夜里，它会侵入临海城市，在垃圾中寻找食物。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME communicates with the other members of its colony by making the gem on its face flash intermittently. At night, it invades cities overlooking the sea in search of food among the trash.

entry: POKENAME站在浅池中，宝石朝天，吸收月光能量。雨天，它们会离开池塘淋雨，雨滴打在宝石上，闪闪发亮。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME stand in shallow ponds with their gems facing towards the sky to absorb energy from moonlight. On rainy days, they emerge from their ponds to soak in the rain, their gems twinkling as the raindrops fall against them.

entry: POKENAME的头能旋转360度。一边快速转头，一边急速拍翅，就能制造时速最高20英里的强风。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can rotate its head 360 degrees. If it spins its head quickly while rapidly flapping its wings, it can create strong gusts of wind up to 20 mph.

entry: POKENAME把身体埋在泥里，只露头顶，看起来像海星星。捕食性宝可梦想一口叼走时，它就会突然钻出泥土，让对方晕头转向，吓退敌人。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME buries its body in mud, leaving only the top of its head showing, looking like a Staryu. When predatory Pokémon try to snap it up, POKENAME emerges from the mud, disorientating the predator and scaring them off.

entry: 许多水手说，曾见过POKENAME在大海上奔跑，用精神能力确保自己不沉入水里。尾巴上的头，则以捕食长翅鸥之类的宝可梦闻名。
author: mepp.
source: Many sailors describe seeing POKENAME gallop across the open seas, using its psychic abilities to ensure it doesn't slip into the water. The head on its tail is known to prey on Pokémon like Wingull.

entry: 阴云密布的夜里，POKENAME会用宝石为迷途旅人照路。它出现的时机总恰到好处，因此许多人将它视为阿尔宙斯的侍从。
author: ghostslythe
source: On overcast nights, POKENAME uses its gems to light the way for lost travelers. Many consider it to be an attendant of Arceus due to its impeccable timing.

entry: 身体中央的红星，其实是主要核心。没有它，便无法存活。时装设计师受这种宝可梦启发，制作出腰带、肩垫等众多配饰。
author: soup1900
source: The red star in the center of its body is actually its primary core. Without this central core, it would not be able to live. Fashion designers have taken inspiration from this Pokémon to create multitudes of accessories like belts and shoulder pads.

entry: POKENAME在雪下发现东西时，脸上的红宝石就会闪烁。虽然常在陆地活动，它仍是出色的泳者。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME uncovers something beneath the snow, the red gem on its face begins to flash. Although it spends a lot of time on land, this Pokémon is an excellent swimmer.

entry: 融合的奇特影响，加上海星星独特的生理结构，让POKENAME无需吃下实体物质也能生存。不过，它仍喜欢少量吃些过度生长的藻类等植物，因此很受水族馆欢迎。
author: bobosmith01
source: A quirk of fusion and Staryu's unique biology has allowed POKENAME to survive without consuming physical matter. Still, they enjoy eating small amounts of plant matter, such as algae overgrowth, making them a popular choice at aquariums.

entry: POKENAME极其聪明，即使漆黑一片，也能迅速追踪、伏击猎物。虽然很少出现在表层水域，有些个体仍会因好奇，去看看上方陆地。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is incredibly intelligent, able to quickly track and ambush its prey in pitch darkness. While rarely seen in surface waters, some POKENAME will be curious enough to check out the land above.

entry: POKENAME只在晴夜出现，星光在金色鳞片上灿烂反射。水手常讲述传说，称看见它的人会得到好运。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME only appears on clear nights, the starlight brilliantly reflecting off of its golden scales. Sailors often tell tales of POKENAME supposedly bringing good fortune to anyone who sees it.

entry: 它把身体埋进沙子，只露出头，伪装成海星星。想吃海星星的宝可梦，反倒成了它的猎物。
author: pokepower
source: It buries its body in the sand, leaving its head out and pretending to be Staryu. Pokémon that try to eat Staryu are it's prey.

entry: POKENAME宝石般的身体坚韧结实，却也让它缺乏安全感：细裂纹能随时间修复，但如果崩掉一大块，就永远无法复原。因此，它往往避开争斗。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's jewel-like body is tough and firm, but it's also the reason why POKENAME feels vulnerable: while its body can repair small cracks over time, if a large chunk of its body breaks off, it will never recover. Thus, it tends to avoid fights.

entry: POKENAME出没于热带海滩，喜欢捉弄成群游泳的人。它藏在浪中，制造怪声与水花，随后潜到水下消失。
author: curazy
source: POKENAME haunts tropical beaches and enjoys playing tricks on groups of swimmers. It hides among the waves, creating strange sounds and splashes before disappearing beneath the water.

entry: POKENAME会制造足以站稳的泡泡，再模仿看过的人跳舞。如果响起音乐，红色圆球就会跟着节拍闪烁。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME create bubbles strong enough to balance on, and then try to dance in imitation of people they see. If music is playing, their red orbs will flash in time to the beat.

entry: POKENAME附在潜水艇上，借此穿越海洋。弱光环境中，红宝石柔和发亮，会把其他水生宝可梦引向潜水艇。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME clings to submarines to transport itself through the ocean. Its red gem glows softly in low light conditions, luring other aquatic Pokémon to the submarine.

entry: 虽然形似外星飞船，它其实是活生生的生物。不过，释放的电脉冲，频率竟与遥远太空中探测到的信号一致。
author: hophoppip
source: Though it resembles an alien spacecraft, it's actually a living creature. However, the electrical pulses it emits align with frequencies detected in distant space.

entry: POKENAME夜间飞驰过天空，身体像星星般闪亮。它充分利用这一点，从高处无声俯冲向猎物，等对方察觉，早已为时已晚。
author: shocktopus1717
source: When it darts through the sky at night, POKENAME's body shimmers like the stars. It takes full advantage of this similarity, silently diving at prey from up high, going unnoticed until it is too late.

entry: 眼睛和胸口的光，平时缓慢闪烁，战斗时脉动则会加快。除了发射水流与火焰，POKENAME也会用手脚上的利爪攻击。
author: .jerden
source: The light in its eyes and chest normally flickers slowly, but pulses faster during combat. In addition to blasts of water and fire, POKENAME will strike with the sharp claws on its hands and feet.

entry: POKENAME在海中漫无目的地漂浮，直到进化。头上的宝石，能感知精神能量。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME float aimlessly through the ocean until they evolve. The gem on its head can sense psychic energy.

entry: 据说额头宝石能感知雨天，因为POKENAME似乎只在雨中现身起舞。会用伞状大嘴抓住小型宝可梦，留在其中消化。
author: mistymagius
source: The gem on its forehead is said to be able to sense rainy weather since POKENAME seems to only appear dancing in the rain. It catches small Pokémon in its umbrella-like mouth where they are left to be digested.

entry: 它让额头角状的宝石按节奏闪烁，与其他宝可梦交流。科学家已从POKENAME身体产生的毒素中，研制出治疗晕船的药。
author: fiordaliso
source: It communicates with other Pokémon by making the horn-shaped gem on its forehead flash in rhythmic patterns. Scientists have developed a remedy for seasickness derived from the toxins produced by POKENAME's body.

entry: 只要眼睛完好，POKENAME便能再生身体。星夜里，它站上海边峭壁，让眼睛朝天空发亮、凝望。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: As long as its eye is intact, POKENAME can regenerate its body. On starry nights, it stares and shines its eye at the sky from a seaside cliff.

entry: 美丽的花纹与色彩，让它很受水属性行家的欢迎。战斗中失去的肢体，也能重新长好。
author: melodydelune
source: Its beautiful pattern and colors make this Pokémon popular among water specialists. It can regenerate limbs that have been lost in battle.

entry: POKENAME在海底休息，领地意识很强。它会让体内核心闪一下，警告入侵者，再起身惩罚擅闯者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rests at the ocean floor and is highly territorial. It flashes the cores of its body once as a warning to intruders, before it rises up to punish them for their trespassing.

entry: 人们常见POKENAME用双手比画天空中的星座。科学家研究这种本能时，得以测量星星之间的距离。
author: dyanz0
source: POKENAME is often seen marking constellations in the sky with its hands. When scientists looked into POKENAME's instincts, it helped them measure the distance between stars.

entry: POKENAME能从前方的宝石投射出凝成实体的光，化作额外肢体，与外界互动。它需要光源才能正常发挥作用，黑暗中几乎用不了这种能力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can project solid light from the gem on its front, acting as an extra limb to interact with others. It requires a light source to function properly, and can barely use its ability in the dark.

entry: 它巡行海滩，朝跃出水面的鱼宝可梦掷出手里剑。两只POKENAME相遇，还会比赛谁抓的猎物更多。
author: kittyluv090
source: It patrols beaches, throwing shurikens at fish Pokémon that jump out of the water. When two POKENAME meet, they compete to catch the most prey.

entry: 它的身体完全适应了深海生活，球形表面覆着藻类、海葵与珊瑚。头顶星形结构中的核心，夜间会发光，吸引其他海洋宝可梦，因为它害怕孤单。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its body has fully adapted to life in the ocean depths, with algae, anemones, and corals covering its spherical surface. The core embedded within the star on its head glows at night to attract other marine Pokémon, as it fears being left alone.

entry: 它的身体完全适应了深海生活，球形表面覆着藻类、海葵与珊瑚。头顶星形结构中的核心，夜间会发光，吸引其他海洋宝可梦，因为它害怕孤单。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its body has fully adapted to life in the ocean depths, with algae, anemones, and corals covering its spherical surface. The core embedded within the star on its head glows at night to attract other marine Pokémon, as it fears being left alone.

entry: POKENAME住在热带水域，通常被水下植物或珊瑚礁环绕。中央空腔能装满水或储存的阳光，再短促喷射，攻击潜在威胁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME houses itself in tropical waters, typically surrounded by undersea plants or coral reefs. The hollow spot in its center fills with water or stored sunlight to fire in short bursts at potential threats.

entry: 晴夜，POKENAME会喷出一团鲜亮深红的孢子，在星光下闪烁。许多个体聚集时，景象就像一场小型烟火表演。
author: oddwalls
source: On clear nights, POKENAME eject a cloud of brilliant crimson spores that sparkle in the starlight. If many POKENAME are gathered, the event resembles a miniature fireworks display.

entry: POKENAME的外膜，由黏液与海水混合而成。中央核心会随使用的精神能力种类，发出不同颜色的光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's outer membrane is comprised of a mixture of slime and saltwater. The core in its center will glow a different color depending on what type of psychic power it utilizes.

entry: 成群POKENAME会钻入海底，吸取沙中矿物，共鸣的嗡嗡声随海浪回荡。手臂极其锋利，只要有一只被冲上岸，整片公共海滩都得关闭。
author: kungfucutbug
source: Clusters of POKENAME drill themselves into the ocean floor, causing a resonant whirr to echo through the waves as they drain the sand of minerals. Due to the sharpness of their arms, entire public beaches will close down if one washes ashore.

entry: 成群POKENAME会钻入海底，吸取沙中矿物，共鸣的嗡嗡声随海浪回荡。手臂极其锋利，只要有一只被冲上岸，整片公共海滩都得关闭。
author: kungfucutbug
source: Clusters of POKENAME drill themselves into the ocean floor, causing a resonant whirr to echo through the waves as they drain the sand of minerals. Due to the sharpness of their arms, entire public beaches will close down if one washes ashore.

entry: POKENAME钻在浅海沙中，月夜，红宝石会从沙下亮起。古老传说称它是人鱼遗失的硬币，因此水手会在操纵台上方挂一只，祈求好运。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME burrows in shallow ocean sands, beneath which its red gem shines bright on moonlit nights. Sailors hang one over their ship controls for good luck based on the old legends that POKENAME is a lost mermaid coin.

entry: POKENAME把海星星当作盾牌，保护脆弱的身体。它十分珍惜守护者，会喂食、清洁，回报这份保护。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses Staryu as a shield to protect its frail body. It takes great care of its protector, feeding and cleaning it in exchange for the protection it gives.

entry: POKENAME厚重的外骨骼适合珊瑚礁生活。即使掉下一块，经过足够时间，也能再生成一只全新的POKENAME。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have bulky exoskeletons that leave them well-suited to life in coral reefs. Even if a piece breaks off, with enough time it will regenerate into a brand new POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME结成大群，能用心灵感应相连，同步攻击。高度协调，让它们以极少伤亡，就能击败整群吼鲸王。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live in large schools, able to link with each other telepathically to sync up their attacks. This high level of coordination allows them to take down entire schools of Wailord with very few casualties.

entry: POKENAME是始终忠诚的海上伙伴，常站在船首。风暴中，经常能看见一群用发光的红水晶照路。
author: campadascleric
source: An ever faithful ocean companion, POKENAME are often found standing on the prows of ships. During storms, it's common to see a pack of POKENAME lighting the way with their glowing red crystals.

entry: 毒素过量时，POKENAME身上的宝石会变得浑浊。它会倒下，直到多余毒液慢慢从四肢排尽。
author: .izik
source: When overloaded with toxin, the gem on POKENAME's body becomes clouded. It collapses until the excess poison drains slowly from its limbs.

entry: POKENAME通常在浅海海底休息。它用脸部和背上蘑菇的一连串闪光，与同类交流。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can typically be found resting on the seafloor in the ocean shallows. It communicates with others of its kind via a series of flashing lights from its face and the mushrooms on its back.

entry: 一些理论认为，POKENAME来自太空。不知为何，它们有时会用力量，抽取空气中的水分，冻成奇异复杂的星形。
author: karagar
source: Some theories claim that POKENAME come from space. They sometimes use their powers to draw ambient moisture from the air and freeze it into strange and complex star-like shapes for no known reason.

entry: 傍晚，POKENAME的宝石一旦发光，原本暗淡的身体就可能变成色彩鲜艳的万花筒。为什么会如此，宝石又为何能发光，都还未完全弄清。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's dull-colored body can start shifting into a vibrant kaleidoscope of hues during the evening if its gem starts to glow. Why this occurs and why the gem can glow in the first place is not entirely known.

entry: POKENAME每天若没从蘑菇中释放足够孢子，身上宝石就会闪出亮红光。快速闪烁一阵后，蘑菇便会向四面八方爆喷湿润的孢子。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME does not release enough spores from its mushroom each day, the gem on its body will blink bright red. After enough rapid blinks, the mushroom will explode wet spores in all directions.

entry: 夜里，小群POKENAME会从沙中探出部分身体。发光核心按规律脉动，令观赏者赞叹。
author: .izik
source: At night, small groups of POKENAME emerge partially from the sand. Their glowing cores pulse in rhythmic patterns admired by observers.

entry: POKENAME在海浪下疾游，用核心闪光与其他生物交流。遇到情侣时，它会变换闪光颜色，观察对方，似乎满怀好奇。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME darts about beneath the ocean waves, communicating to others with flickers of light from its core. When in the presence of couples, it observes them with a pattern of shifting colors that seems to indicate curiosity.

entry: POKENAME对情侣的好奇，加上像首饰的外形，启发人们设计了以它为主题的订婚戒指，十分受欢迎。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's curiosity around couples and resemblance to a piece of jewelry has inspired the creation of a POKENAME-themed engagement ring, which garnered much popularity.

entry: POKENAME仍能控制断落的肢体。这些肢体会再生成完整的海星星，与本体共同活动，形成共享一个意识的集体。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME retains control of any of its severed limbs. These limbs regenerate into full Staryu which act in tandem with the original, creating a collective with a single mind.

entry: POKENAME很受富裕人家喜爱。它们会受训摆出挺立姿势，突出头上的宝石。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are a popular choice among the rich and people with affluence. They are trained to stand at attention in a pose to accentuate the gem on their head.

entry: 人们可能在沙滩上看见POKENAME闲躺着。它有时不服管教，只顾随心所欲。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME may be spotted lazing about on the beach. It is sometimes disobedient to authority and will do whatever it wants instead.

entry: POKENAME最爱两样东西：闪闪发亮的物品，以及游泳。傍晚也能看见它下水，满月时尤其如此。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME adores two things above all else: glittering objects and swimming. It can even be found swimming during the evening, especially if the moon is full.

entry: POKENAME能让肢体再生，但身体负担巨大，养分从头部被调走，便会头痛不已。许多个体为了避免受伤，不敢离家太远。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are able to regrow limbs, but the immense strain on their body draws nutrients away from their head, resulting in a nasty headache. Many avoid wandering too far from their home to avoid getting hurt.

entry: 成群POKENAME会在珊瑚礁间跳跃觅食，鲜红宝石同步脉动。它们喜欢夜间狩猎，好在黑暗中更容易看见同伴信号。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Troops of POKENAME bound across coral reefs in search of food, their vivid red gems pulsing in synchrony with one another. They prefer to hunt at night so that they can more easily watch for signals from other members of their troop in the dark.

entry: POKENAME开心时，眼睛闪亮，毛发变暖。产生的热量，会让部分水晶毛脱落。这些毛十分珍贵，几乎与星尘一模一样。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its eye shimmers and fur warms when POKENAME is happy. Due to the heat it generates, some of its crystal fur will shed. This fur is very valuable and is almost identical to stardust.

entry: POKENAME没有眼睛，靠空气与海水中的振动辨认方向。头上的核心能精准发射水流，从远处击倒目标。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have no eyes, so they rely on vibrations in the air and sea to give them a sense of direction. The core on their head can shoot bursts of water with great precision to take down targets from far away.

entry: 据说，POKENAME额头的巨大宝石，是强大念动力的来源。有人以为夺走就能获得力量，试图猎捕，却从未成功。
author: sk372
source: The massive gem on POKENAME's forehead is said to be the source of its potent telekinetic abilities. Some have tried to hunt it, thinking it would grant them its power, but none have succeeded.

entry: POKENAME准备攻击、绷紧肌肉时，星形结构上的宝石就会明亮发光。谁想碰脸上的星，它都会极其抗拒。
author: sk372
source: Whenever POKENAME's muscles tense in anticipation of an attack, the jewels on its stars glow brightly. It responds extremely negatively towards any attempts to touch the star on its face.

entry: POKENAME用惊人力量，救援正在沉没的船。可惜个头很矮，训练家便会用装了配重的玩具船，让它满足当英雄的愿望。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME use their incredible strength to rescue ships that are sinking. Unfortunately they are quite short, so Trainers use toy boats with weights inside to give POKENAME the satisfaction of being heroes.

entry: POKENAME随海流漂浮，用坚硬手臂喷出的水柱调整方向。交流时，两侧较大的宝石比核心更亮，捕食者来袭，也能充当诱饵。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME floats on ocean currents, influencing its direction with jets of water from its rigid arms. When it communicates, the larger side gems glow brighter than the core and act as decoys should a predator attack.

entry: POKENAME浮在海面，用垂下的大团触须，捕捉路过的鱼。夜间，整群聚集，发光珠宝会把海面照得美不胜收。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME floats on the surface of the ocean, catching passing fish in its dangling mass of tentacles. When whole schools gather at night, the glowing jewels light up the sea in beautiful displays.

entry: 它的双拳，与能量核心由同一种矿物构成。和许多其他小拳石融合体不同，POKENAME的发光核心，让它很容易与环境区分。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Its fists are made out of the same mineral that forms its power core. Unlike many other Geodude hybrids, POKENAME's glowing core helps distinguish it from its surrounding environment.

entry: POKENAME成群旅行时，会用身上的宝石闪光交流。因此，即使全速奔行，也能在群中流畅传递消息。
author: sk372
source: When  POKENAME travel in herds together, they communicate with flashing lights from the gems on their body. This lets them seamlessly send messages through the herd while still moving at top speed.

entry: POKENAME肢体折断，还会重新长出。有人试吃过断下的部分，说味道与口感，都不怎么样。
author: ohok3441
source: If a limb breaks off of POKENAME, it'll regrow. Those who have attempted to eat the torn pieces claim the taste and texture is unappealing.

entry: POKENAME附在潜水艇上，借此穿越海洋。弱光环境中，红宝石柔和发亮，会把其他水生宝可梦引向潜水艇。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME clings to submarines to transport itself through the ocean. Its red gem glows softly in low light conditions, luring other aquatic Pokémon to the submarine.

entry: POKENAME每天早晨，都会把自己贴到潜水艇上。等离开原来家园足够远，才从艇壳脱离。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME starts each morning by sticking itself onto a submarine. It removes itself from the hull once it has traveled far enough from its original home.

entry: POKENAME平时用一对炮筒喷水战斗。如果躯干开始明亮发光，对手就该做好准备：核心正在给炮筒供能，接下来会射出两道强力光束。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME normally fights with water shot from its twin cannons, but if its torso begins to glow brightly its opponent should brace themselves, as its core is feeding energy to the cannons to fire powerful twin beams of light.

entry: 夜里，红色核心一直发光。为了让光一明一灭，POKENAME会快速开合外壳。
author: .jerden
source: At night, its red core constantly glows. To make it the light blink on and off, POKENAME rapidly opens and closes its shell.

entry: POKENAME通过背上大宝石产生的光信号交流。它性情害羞，喜欢藏在海藻与珊瑚礁间。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME communicates through light signals produced by the large gem on its back. Its shy nature leads it to hide among seaweed and coral reefs.

entry: POKENAME发出的尖细声调，只有同类能听见，借此做出奇特的同步动作。受到打扰，它就会在闪光中消失，只留淡淡的嗡鸣。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME emits a high-pitched tone that only other POKENAME can hear, creating strange synchronized movements. If disturbed, it vanishes in a flash of light, leaving behind a faint buzzing sound.

entry: POKENAME悄然沿河滚动，低低的嗡鸣让附近宝可梦不安。研究者认为，中央宝石中保存着早已被遗忘的文明数据。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME rolls silently down rivers, generating a low hum that unsettles nearby Pokémon. Researchers believe the gem at its center holds data from long-forgotten civilizations.

entry: POKENAME体内潜藏着大量尚未开发的能量。有人说，把七只聚到一处，愿望就会成真。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a vast amount of untapped energy lying within its body. Some say that if one were to gather seven POKENAME into one place, their wishes would be granted.

entry: POKENAME身体产生的云团闪闪发亮，仿佛映着夜空。用收集的气体制成香水，只要香味未散，使用者身上就会泛起微光。
author: chibitales
source: The clouds produced by POKENAME's body twinkle and shine as if reflecting the night sky. Perfumes made using collected gases from POKENAME give wearers a subtle glimmer while the scent remains.

entry: POKENAME喷出的水束混有沙子，将温和水流化作加压钻头。工厂中常能见它给钢铁打孔。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shoots beams of water mixed with sand, turning a gentle stream into a pressurized drill. It can be found in factories where it punches holes into steel.

entry: POKENAME极其独立，宁愿独自旅行，也不肯结群求安全。事实上，看见同类时，它第一反应是争夺主导权，而非加入群体。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is strongly independent, traveling alone rather than in the safety of schools. In fact, the first instinct it has upon seeing another of its kind is to fight for dominance rather than group up.

entry: POKENAME从脸上宝石产生闪亮光幕，再用双手塑成防御墙。偶尔也能看见它借这些屏障，沿海面飘行。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME generates shimmering walls of light from the gem on its face, that it then manipulates with its hands to form defensive walls. It can occasionally be seen using these barriers to float along the surface of the ocean.

entry: 深夜，POKENAME在海浪上方飞驰，巡察着不知什么目标。领地意识强的毒刺水母，常把翅膀和利刃的光误认成竞争者，让它不得不迎战。
author: ghostslythe
source: Late at night, POKENAME races above the ocean waves, patrolling for something unknown. It often fights off territorial Tentacruel that mistake the light off its wings and blades as rivaling Pokémon.

entry: 它全身在夜间明亮发光，又十分稀有，让有志捕虫的训练家倍感自豪。它能吃任何有机物，食物不同，外骨骼颜色也会略有变化。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its radiant body glows during the night; along with its rarity, it makes it the perfect bragging right for aspiring Bug Catchers. It can consume any kind of organic matter; depending on what it eats, the color of its exoskeleton can change slightly.

entry: 遭偷猎而濒临灭绝后，POKENAME学会了一看见人类就逃。它们只生活在大型淡水湖岸边，尾巴在水中如螺旋桨般猛烈甩动，方便迅速脱身。
author: ludacriswell
source: After being poached into near extinction, POKENAME has learned to flee instantly after spotting humans. They are only found near the shores of large, fresh-water lakes. Their tails whip violently in water like a propeller- allowing for quick escapes.

entry: POKENAME的巨大宝石能放出强光，让它在最深的海底也能畅游。被捕食者追赶时，便闪光晃花对方的眼睛，趁机游走。
author: phantom640
source: POKENAME's massive gem can shine a powerful light, allowing them to swim in the deepest depths without any trouble. If a predator gives chase, POKENAME will flash its pursuer with a blinding light before swimming away.

entry: 住在海洋最深处。POKENAME发现猎物或闯入者后，会先用宝石闪光使其目盲，再猛烈攻击，拖回巢里吃掉。
author: phantom640
source: It lives at the deepest point of the ocean. When POKENAME spots prey or intruders, it blinds them using its gem before violently attacking them. Once done, POKENAME drags its victims back down to its lair to feed.

entry: 许多水手称POKENAME为茫茫海上的天然向导。它的壳由实心宝石构成，能发出不同颜色的光，用来交流，也用来诱捕猎物。
author: infinex21
source: Known to many sailors as nature's guide upon the open seas, POKENAME have a shell made of solid gemstone that can emit various color lights. They use these lights to communicate as well as to lure prey.

entry: POKENAME能在深海活动，又常在科技设备附近让水晶明亮闪烁，因此在搜寻、打捞海中遗失设备时，价值无可替代。
author: sk372
source: Due to POKENAME's capacity to function in the deep depths of the ocean and its tendency to flash its crystal brightly while in the presence of technology, it has been invaluable in searching and recovering tech lost at sea.

entry: POKENAME体形奇特，不断广播神秘无线电信号，让一些人推测它来自外星。最近一部电影里，所有外星人都由它出演。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's unusual body plan and constant broadcasting of mysterious radio signals have led some to speculate that it has an extraterrestrial origin. In a recent movie, the aliens were all played by POKENAME.

entry: 许多训练家初见POKENAME，都以为它来自外太空。多数人不知道，它能生存在最深的海中，铠甲抵御深海重压，钻石般坚硬的镰刀照亮黑暗。
author: ghostslythe
source: At first sight many Trainers believe POKENAME is from outer space. Unbeknownst to most, it survives in the deepest portions of the ocean, its armor protecting it from the crushing depths and its diamond-hard scythes lighting the darkness.

entry: POKENAME栖息在海底火山附近。将能量集中到脸上的核心时，火焰会燃得更加鲜亮，核心还能发射巨大的灼热光束。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME roosts in locations near where undersea volcanoes lie. Its flames burn even more vibrantly as it focuses energy into the core on its face, which is capable of firing large beams of scalding-hot light.

entry: POKENAME跃出水面后，下坠的模样宛如流星。因此，一群有时也被称为一场“流星雨”。
author: mellowmuse
source: When POKENAME jump out of the water, they resemble shooting stars as they fall. Because of this, a group of POKENAME is sometimes referred to as a shower.

entry: 过去，一些文明相信POKENAME是海洋守护者。它们把能量储存在头顶的巨大水晶中。
author: mepp.
source: Some civilizations in the past believed POKENAME acted as the guardian of the seas. They store energy inside the massive crystal situated on their heads.

entry: POKENAME冠饰各尖端的宝石，会随当前情绪发光。如果情绪过载，每颗都会明亮地胡乱闪烁。
author: bigoljax
source: Each gem on the tips of POKENAME's crown shines based on what emotion they're currently feeling. If POKENAME is overwhelmed, every gem shines brightly and flashes erratically.

entry: POKENAME生气时，会从背上造出燃烧的星星，驱赶威胁。许多工匠受此启发，制作形似这些星星的首饰与发光贴纸，让人安全地欣赏这份景象。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: When angered, POKENAME create burning stars from their backs to ward off threats. The sight has inspired many craftsman to form jewelry or glowing stickers that resemble a POKENAME's stars so that people can enjoy the spectacle from a safe distance.

entry: 有错误传闻称，POKENAME是汲取星辰能量的外星生物。落地后，它会用四条手臂，挥出一连串注入星光的拳头。孩子喜欢看这些发光拳击，如同欣赏灯光秀。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME is erroneously rumored to be an alien being, drawing energy from the stars. When it lands, it unleashes a flurry of starlight-infused punches with its four arms. Children enjoy watching POKENAME launch glowing punches like a light show.

entry: 夜晚，POKENAME飞过天际，从翅膀撒下宇宙尘埃。据说见到它时，就该许个愿。
author: fr34kuency
source: At night, POKENAME flies across the sky, spreading cosmic dust from its wings. It is said that you should make a wish if you see one.

entry: 高空飞行时，它会闪动脸上的宝石，提醒其他飞行属性宝可梦自己的位置，避免相撞。POKENAME在热带悬崖筑巢，保护蛋的安全。
author: fiordaliso
source: While flying at high altitudes, it flashes the gem on its face to alert other Flying-type Pokémon of its presence and avoid collisions. POKENAME nests along tropical cliffs to keep its eggs safe.

entry: POKENAME头部和脸上的光，能各自独立发出多种颜色。灿烂闪烁的灯光表演，能在战斗中扰乱、击晕猎物和对手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's lights on its head and face can shine in a myriad of colors independent of each other. It can create truly radiant flickering displays of light that can confuse and stun prey and opponents in battle.

entry: 没有训练家干预、在野外自然孵化的POKENAME，可以凭宝石般上半身的光泽，判断栖息环境。它们每天睡两次，躲进洞里休息。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME that are naturally hatched in the wild without the involvement of a Trainer can have their habitat determined based on the sheen of its jewel-like upper body. They sleep twice a day, retreating into caverns to rest.

entry: 野外极难见到POKENAME。它有种古怪习性：夜里隔一阵，就会突然仰望月亮，按精确而重复的节奏蹦跳数分钟，宝石般的耳朵随之发光。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is exceedingly rare to find in the wild. It possesses a particular and odd behavior: it will suddenly stare up at the moon and hop at precise and repetitive intervals for a few minutes every so often at night, its jewel-like ears glowing.

entry: 虽然身上水晶沉重，POKENAME仍能乘风自在飞行。气流为手中的宝石充能，让它能摇动宝石，散出彩色光点，甚至短促的能量冲击。
author: sk372
source: Despite the weight of the crystals on its body, POKENAME freely flies by being carried by the wind. The air flow energizes the gems it holds, letting it shake them about to spread out colorful sparkles or even small bursts of energy.

entry: POKENAME发现海上有人遇困，就会立刻赶去救援。它通过改变脸部宝石发光的频率，表达情绪。
author: fiordaliso
