source: POKENAME has a very convincing ability to act like a zombie. Many observers are fooled into thinking that the bulbous red mushroom on the back of its head has already taken over its brain.

entry: POKENAME靠哑剧造出悬浮屏障。下雪时，这些精神屏障更加耐久，表面也会渐渐覆满精巧霜纹。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses mime to create barriers that float in the air. Their psychic force is more durable when snow is falling, and will gradually become covered by intricate frost patterns.

entry: POKENAME靠哑剧造出悬浮屏障。下雪时，这些精神屏障更加耐久，表面也会渐渐覆满精巧霜纹。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses mime to create barriers that float in the air. Their psychic force is more durable when snow is falling, and will gradually become covered by intricate frost patterns.

entry: POKENAME作为马戏团吉祥物，广受喜爱。它们穿着吱吱响的鞋，笑着为各年龄的孩子送气球，也让孩子骑在背上玩。
author: calikov
source: POKENAME are widely beloved as circus mascots. They walk around with squeaky shoes and offer balloons and piggyback rides to children of all ages with a welcoming smile on their faces.

entry: POKENAME紧张，在陌生情况下容易惊慌。等有时间适应吓到自己的事物后，它就能凭精神力量，好好打一场。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is nervous and prone to panicking in unfamiliar situations. Once it's had time to adjust to whatever's freaking it out, it can put up quite a fight with its psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME昼伏夜出，住在废弃建筑里，也有些在大城市街头游荡，不停寻找大脑。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is nocturnal and lives in abandoned buildings, but some also roam the streets of larger cities, always on the hunt for brains.

entry: POKENAME强大的精神力量，会影响看着它的生物。看见它发光的人，都会笑得停不下来，除非将其完全挡在视线之外。
author: mega_beedrill
source: POKENAME's incredible psychic powers influence anyone who looks at it. Those who see its light find themselves unable to stop laughing unless they can completely block it from view.

entry: POKENAME很受宝可梦好莱坞的制作团队欢迎。鳞片发出的吱吱声，多年来都很适合用于动画和电视节目。
author: mega_beedrill
source: POKENAME is popular in Pokéstar Studios productions. Its scales make squeaky sounds that have been perfect for use in cartoons and television over the years.

entry: POKENAME昼伏夜出，住在废弃建筑里，也有些在大城市街头游荡，不停寻找大脑。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is nocturnal and lives in abandoned buildings, but some also roam the streets of larger cities, always on the hunt for brains.

entry: POKENAME虽然能演哑剧，却只是本能地模仿周围生物。背上的蘑菇，驱使它寻找阴暗潮湿的建筑表演，好让孢子茁壮生长。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME can pantomime, this is only by reflexively mimicking others around it. The mushroom on its back compels it to seek out dark, damp buildings to perform in, where the spores it produces will flourish.

entry: POKENAME过去曾在巡回马戏团表演力量绝技。如今，人们能在嘉年华或集市上看见它们，引导人类玩游戏。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME were once used in traveling circuses, where they would perform feats of strength. Nowadays, they can be spotted at carnivals or fairs, guiding humans to play games.

entry: POKENAME过去曾在巡回马戏团表演力量绝技。如今，人们能在嘉年华或集市上看见它们，引导人类玩游戏。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME were once used in traveling circuses, where they would perform feats of strength. Nowadays, they can be spotted at carnivals or fairs, guiding humans to play games.

entry: 邪恶组织成员会招募POKENAME，协助从博物馆窃取贵重资产。凭空造平台的本领，加上手上的黏垫，让它们很适合这份差事。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are recruited by members of villainous organizations to help steal valuable assets from museums. Their ability to create platforms out of thin air and the sticky pads on their hands make them well-suited for the task.

entry: POKENAME并非忍者，只是在模仿忍者。它根本没有真正的隐匿本领，却很享受装作悄无声息的样子。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME is not a ninja but imitates being one. POKENAME lacks any real stealth but enjoys acting like it's stealthy.

entry: POKENAME那副让人联想到马戏团的经典外形，其实全是幻象，真身更像煤炭龟。连射出的烟火，也只是精神能量覆在烟与煤灰上的彩色光景。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's iconic and familiar appearance resembling the circus is all mere illusions: its true body is actually very similar to Torkoal. Even the fireworks it can fire off are just colorful displays of psychic energy covering smoke and soot.

entry: POKENAME能制造悬浮在半空的无形墙，阻止其他宝可梦靠近。有时却忘了墙在哪里，撞上去后，只能对着自己的造物无助扑腾。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can create invisible walls that float in mid-air, blocking other Pokémon from getting close to them. They sometimes forget where they have created these walls and crash into them, fluttering helplessly against their construct.

entry: POKENAME的睡莲叶，完全由变化后的光墙构成。雨天，它借此保持鼻子干燥，舒服地穿过潮湿环境。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's lilypad is made entirely of a modified version of its Light Screen. It uses this to keep its nose dry during rainy days, allowing it to comfortably navigate through wet environments.

entry: POKENAME用精确手势与炽热尾巴，造出强力火焰屏障。制造热幻象的本领，让它十分难缠，能用灼热蜃景欺骗敌人。
author: themegatroll
source: POKENAME creates powerful fire barriers using precise hand movements and its blazing tail. Its ability to generate thermal illusions makes it a tricky opponent, deceiving enemies with scorching mirages.

entry: POKENAME喜欢给小孩子演出，利用隧道，看似随机地出现、消失。最能让那些仍爱玩捉迷藏的孩子开心。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME enjoy putting on performances for young children, using their tunnels to appear and disappear seemingly at random. These performances work best with children who are still entertained by games of hide and seek.

entry: POKENAME身上的珠宝各不相同，取决于父母的饮食。它们操控光穿过水晶时的折射，让光彩比任何天然材料都耀眼。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Each POKENAME have a different set of jewels adorning their body, depending on their parents' diet. They manipulate the way light refracts through their crystals, giving them a sparkle more brilliant than any natural material.

entry: POKENAME身上的珠宝各不相同，取决于父母的饮食。它们能操控光穿过水晶时的折射，甚至让水晶显得近乎无形。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Each POKENAME have a different set of jewels adorning their body, depending on their parents' diet. They manipulate the way light refracts through their crystals, even able to make them appear almost invisible.

entry: POKENAME会在隧道里造出无形屏障，阻挡闯入者。墙壁能持续数小时，令矿工烦恼不已。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME constructs invisible barriers within its tunnels to deter intruders. These walls can persist for hours, greatly frustrating miners.

entry: 有些POKENAME住在城市下水道里，直接在管壁中挖隧道。它们喜欢给路过的孩子演出，为此把自己贴在雨水口旁。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Some POKENAME make their homes within city sewer systems, making their tunnels directly into the sewer walls. They love to put on performances for passing children, pressing themselves up against storm drains to do so.

entry: POKENAME喜欢给小孩子演出，利用隧道，看似随机地出现、消失。最能让那些仍爱玩捉迷藏的孩子开心。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME enjoy putting on performances for young children, using their tunnels to appear and disappear seemingly at random. These performances work best with children who are still entertained by games of hide and seek.

entry: POKENAME的三个身体，会步调一致地演出。只要其中一个分神，另外两个用头和手比画出的任何东西，都无法成为实体。
author: .jerden
source: The three bodies of POKENAME perform in unison. If one of them is distracted, nothing the other two mime with their heads and hands will materialize.

entry: POKENAME每天至少头痛一次，训练家总能看出来。它会用哑剧比画，夸张表现动作，寻求治疗帮助。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME experiences a headache a day at minimum, and Trainers will always be able to tell. It mimes out and exaggerates its movement to seek remedial help.

entry: 虽然能模仿其他宝可梦，POKENAME最爱演的，还是假扮哥达鸭。表演逼真到让它能用根本不存在的喙，叼起物品。
author: .jerden
source: While it can impersonate other Pokémon, POKENAME's favorite act is to pretend to be a Golduck. The impression is so convincing that POKENAME can pick up objects using a beak it doesn't have.

entry: POKENAME很容易生气，哑剧被嘲笑时尤其如此。它们常把冒犯者关进精神力箱子，不断攻击，直到被安抚，或被带离现场。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are easily angered, especially if their pantomiming is mocked. They often jail the offender in a box made of psychic energy and attack until calmed or removed from the situation.

entry: 观众猜不出POKENAME在模仿什么，它很快就会恼火。手势越来越用力，直到打坏附近物品，威胁触及范围内所有生物的安全。
author: .jerden
source: If its audience cannot guess what POKENAME is miming, it will quickly become frustrated. It will make gestures with increasing force until it breaks nearby objects and threatens the safety of anyone within reach.

entry: POKENAME对其他生物的情绪直觉极准，很乐意亲近、或故意出点洋相，只为逗对方笑。研究表明，它尤其喜欢轻快的古典音乐。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is incredibly intuitive to the emotions of others and has no problem giving them affection or intentionally being a little silly just to make them laugh. Studies have shown that POKENAME especially enjoys upbeat classical music.

entry: POKENAME常当魔术师助手，按训练家需要，在舞台上奔跑取道具。它们喜欢用帽子变戏法，让训练家从里面掏东西，逗孩子开心。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME often serve as a magician's assistant, dashing around the stage for props as and when their trainer needs them. They delight in using their hat for conjuring tricks, their trainers pulling out objects from them to the amusement of children.

entry: 没有手臂，严重限制了POKENAME能模仿的对象。但它似乎并不气馁，只靠脸和尾巴，也要尽可能演出。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's lack of arms severely limits the number of impressions it is capable of doing. This does not seem to demoralize it, and it will mime as much as it can using only its face and tail.

entry: POKENAME演哑剧时，双手画圈的动作，比魔墙人偶多得多。许多人觉得这持续的动作，十分催眠。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME moves its hands in circles as it mimes, much more so than a Mr. Mime. Many people find the constant movement hypnotic.

entry: POKENAME肌肉强健，从不疲倦，能连续演一整天哑剧。如果费尽力气仍没逗乐任何人，它就会变得暴躁凶猛。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has powerful muscles that never tire, enabling it to mime continuously for the entire day. If after all that effort it fails to entertain anyone, POKENAME will become violent.

entry: 最近，一位著名舞台魔术师以POKENAME为伙伴，让越来越多训练家也试着饲养。它们聪明得惊人，却各有十分鲜明的性格。
author: bobosmith01
source: As a result of a recently famous stage magician having some as their partners, more and more Trainers have tried to raise POKENAME. While they are remarkably intelligent, each one has a very distinct personality.

entry: POKENAME会在观众面前展示令人难以理解的力量，野生个体也不例外。每次表演前，它们都会冥想。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME use mind-bending displays of power before an audience, even in the wild. They meditate prior to each performance.

entry: POKENAME会在观众面前展示令人难以理解的力量，野生个体也不例外。每次表演前，它们都会冥想。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME use mind-bending displays of power before an audience, even in the wild. They meditate prior to each performance.

entry: 据说，POKENAME是纸牌戏法大师。可牌全是无形的，根本没人能判断，戏法到底变对了没有。
author: kiwiarms
source: POKENAME is a master of card tricks, supposedly. Its cards are invisible, so nobody can actually tell if it gets the tricks right or not.

entry: POKENAME不断举无形重物，锻炼力量。在空中造出屏障后，它只需比画推搡，就能以巨大力量把敌人推来推去。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME constantly trains its strength by lifting invisible weights. When it creates barriers in the air, it can use them to push foes around with great force just by miming a shove.

entry: POKENAME把自己当作马戏团大力士。不往观众面前抛重物助兴时，它就会摆姿势，尽可能绷起更多肌肉。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME adopts the persona of a circus strongman. If it isn't currently tossing around heavy objects for the entertainment of a crowd, it will strike poses that flex as many of its muscles as possible.

entry: POKENAME对小丑表演的投入，不亚于怪力对武术的钻研。目前，一只POKENAME保持着一分钟内扔出最多奶油派的世界纪录。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME devote themselves to clowning with the same dedication that Machamp reserve for martial arts. A POKENAME currently holds the world record for the most cream pies thrown in a minute.

entry: POKENAME用身后的手抓住树枝，让身体像钟一样前后摇荡。除了树叶沙沙声，它从不发出声音。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses the hand at its rear end to grab onto tree branches and swing its body back and forth like a bell. Aside from the rustling of leaves, it never makes a sound.

entry: POKENAME用大手撑起无形屏障，逼退敌人，再伸出藤蔓般的舌头，撒下毒孢子，制服猎物。
author: raza
source: POKENAME use their large hands to repel foes with invisible barriers before extending their vine-like tongue, using toxic spores to incapacitate prey.

entry: 只有两条触须，让POKENAME能演的哑剧有限，它却似乎毫不在意。大部分时间都随海流漂浮，悠然自在。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME cannot mime much with only two tentacles, this doesn't seem to bother it. It spends most of its time drifting on ocean currents, completely relaxed.

entry: POKENAME用八十条柔韧肢体，在黑暗中快速爬行。它以哑剧表演催眠受害者，再带到荒野吞食。
author: adam_dnh
source: POKENAME swiftly crawls through the darkness using its eighty flexible limbs. It hypnotizes its victims with its pantomime performances, then leads them into the wilderness to devour them.

entry: POKENAME双臂不知疲倦，能连续表演数小时，因此很受偶剧欢迎。手上的嘴虽会开合，却没有声音，研究者仍在探究用途。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME is a hit at puppet shows because the strength of its arms are tireless, allowing it to perform for hours. Though the mouths on its hands open and close, no sound comes out; researchers are still trying to figure out what they are meant for.

entry: 只要有什么踩到POKENAME，大舌头就会伸出来。不清楚是在表示恼怒、嘲弄，还是觉得好玩。
author: foolish_weasel
source: If something steps on POKENAME, its large tongue will stick out. It is unclear whether this is an expression of irritation, mockery or amusement.

entry: POKENAME会比画攀绳。不知怎地，这就能让它轻松登山。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME will pantomime climbing via a rope. Somehow, doing this allows it to climb mountains with ease.

entry: POKENAME最爱的节目，是戏剧性地从高台边缘摔下。它其实从不受伤，却会假装碎成一块块，需要别人拼回去。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's favourite performance involves dramatically falling off a ledge. Although it is never actually harmed, it pretends that it has broken into pieces and needs to be put back together.

entry: POKENAME的身体柔软有弹性，令人意外。它能纵身跳下山坡，借反弹跃到另一座山上。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is surprisingly soft and springy. It can throw itself off the side of a mountain in order to bounce up onto another one.

entry: POKENAME在嘉年华很受欢迎，乐于载着孩子绕彩色帐篷游玩。能完全控制火焰，信赖的对象碰了也无妨。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are popular at carnivals, happily giving rides to children around colorful tents. It has full control over its flames, allowing for anyone its trusts to touch them.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在海边懒懒钓鱼。尾巴伸出的手会比画抛线，令人惊讶的是，鱼宝可梦竟真会被无形鱼饵钓上来。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME enjoys fishing lazily by the sea. The hand that protrudes from its tail will mime casting out a fishing line, and surprisingly fish Pokémon will get caught on the invisible fishing lure.

entry: POKENAME背后的手臂能伸得极长，抓取远处食物。因此，它经常一闲躺就是数小时，偶尔才挪个更舒服的位置。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME can extend its back arm to a surprising length, able to grab far away food. As a result of this, it often lazes for hours at a time, occasionally moving to a nicer spot to lounge.

entry: POKENAME的两部分共用身体。呆呆兽那部分睡觉时，魔墙人偶那部分会很保护它，常造出无形屏障，不让任何生物打扰休息。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Sharing the same body, the Mr. Mime segment of POKENAME is very protective of the Slowpoke portion as it sleeps, often forming invisible barriers to prevent anyone from disturbing its rest.

entry: 尾巴永久连着一个人偶。POKENAME会慢慢摆尾，试着操纵它，大概是为了逗乐，或分散注意。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Its tail is permanently attached to a dummy. POKENAME slowly wags its tail in an effort to puppet the dummy, which it presumably does for either entertainment or distraction.

entry: 虽然没有牙齿，POKENAME尾巴上的大舌贝却常在表演中咬紧，让它惊叫，打断哑剧。观众通常觉得好笑极了。
author: .jerden
source: While it doesn't have teeth, the Shellder on POKENAME's tail often bites down during performances, interrupting its miming as it yelps in surprise. The audience usually finds this hilarious.

entry: POKENAME常聚在嘉年华和生日派对附近。陪它玩太久，静电就会让你的头发竖起来。
author: mega_beedrill
source: POKENAME are often found gathering near carnivals and birthday parties. If you play with one too long, your hair will stand on end from the static.

entry: POKENAME强大的电力与奇特的身体几何形态，能扰乱人脑。盯着它抛接自己太久的人说，数小时后仍会看见彩色幻象。
author: mega_beedrill
source: POKENAME's strong electric powers and its odd physical geometry can confuse the human brain. Those who stare too long at POKENAME juggling itself report seeing colorful illusions hours afterwards.

entry: POKENAME能凭空造无形墙，两个头却总意见不合，经常造墙妨碍对方。战斗时，对手受到的大多数伤害，其实都只是被波及。
author: huh.7
source: POKENAME has the ability to create invisible walls out of thin air. The two heads are constantly at odds with each other, so they will often create walls to hinder the other head. Most damage done to opponents in battle is merely collateral damage.

entry: POKENAME的三个头，是一组喜剧搭档。一个严肃过头，一个装傻，第三个则假装被它们的胡闹激怒。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's three heads act as a comedic trio. One is overly serious, another plays the fool, and the third pretends to be enraged by their antics.

entry: POKENAME会用尾巴撑起全身，再开始用手演哑剧。保持平衡很难，可它会一直练到完美。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will lift their entire body up to stand on their tail, then begin miming with their hands. Maintaining their balance is difficult, but POKENAME will practice until they perfect it.

entry: 每次爬出水，POKENAME都会无声动嘴，仿佛在唱歌。传说，声音被嫉妒它们美貌的海女巫偷走了。
author: .jerden
source: Whenever they climb out of the water, POKENAME silently move their mouths as if singing. According to legend, their voices were stolen by a sea-witch jealous of their beauty.

entry: 演哑剧时，POKENAME会伸展、重塑没有固定形态的身体。它们很乐意收脏污废物为演出报酬，因此有些马戏团靠它们处理垃圾。
author: .jerden
source: As part of their pantomimes, POKENAME stretch and reshape their amorphous bodies. They will happily accept filthy waste as payment for their performances, and several circuses use them to dispose of garbage.

entry: POKENAME能凭空造无形墙。人们发现，接触墙壁会中毒，还会留下恶臭。
author: lordenzo
source: POKENAME can make invisible walls out of thin air. These walls are also known to poison people who come in contact with them and leave behind a foul odor.

entry: 无形墙若挡不住敌人，POKENAME的众多手臂便会比画着，投掷无形弹丸。没人清楚究竟扔的是什么，却确实能给敌人造成重伤。
author: .jerden
source: If POKENAME cannot stop foes with an invisible wall, its many hands will move as if throwing invisible projectiles. It is unclear exactly what they are throwing, but whatever it is can deal significant damage to enemies.

entry: POKENAME最喜欢先吓人，再立起无形墙，让受害者一头撞上。它觉得太好笑，笑得停不下来，反而露出满身破绽。
author: mega_beedrill
source: POKENAME love nothing more than scaring people, then erecting invisible walls for their victims to run into. They find this so funny they can't stop laughing when doing so, leaving them wide open.

entry: 进化后，POKENAME不再能融入环境，便离开旧洞穴，寻找新家。法律规定，它们不得靠近学校100英尺以内。
author: snookerron
source: No longer able to blend in, POKENAME leave their old caves in search of new homes when they evolve. Legally they cannot be within 100 feet of schools.

entry: POKENAME精通催眠术。与它对视的人，可能会发现自己动不了，只能默默看着钟摆摇晃。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has a mastery of hypnosis. Anyone who makes eye contact with it may find themself unable to move, only capable of silently watching the swinging of POKENAME's pendulum.

entry: 与POKENAME对视的人，会发现自己无法移开目光。通常给出的理由，是害怕只要一转开视线，它就会做出什么。
author: .jerden
source: People who make eye contact with POKENAME find themselves unable to look away. The reason given is usually that they are terrified by what it might do as soon as they take their eyes off it.

entry: POKENAME沿着海滩造无形精神屏障，一边横着爬，一边让墙越筑越长。游客应留意它们，因为这些墙可能把人绊倒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME construct invisible psychic barriers along the beach, scuttling sideways whilst constantly creating a longer and longer wall. Beachgoers are advised to remain aware of POKENAME populations as they can be a trip hazard.

entry: POKENAME精于战斗，先在身前造无形屏障，再快速绕行，发射精神力冲击。身体太脆弱，不敢冒险近战，因此它们始终保持距离。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are adept combatants, conjuring invisible barriers in front of themselves whilst scuttling around them to launch psychic blasts. They keep their distance whilst battling, their constitutions too frail to risk direct combat.

entry: POKENAME精于战斗，先在身前造无形屏障，再快速绕行，发射精神力冲击。身体太脆弱，不敢冒险近战，因此它们始终保持距离。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are adept combatants, conjuring invisible barriers in front of themselves whilst scuttling around them to launch psychic blasts. They keep their distance whilst battling, their constitutions too frail to risk direct combat.

entry: 派对前，POKENAME会把彩纸塞进炮筒，在狭小空间压紧。派对一开始，强劲水流便将彩纸冲散，撒满房间。
author: quackquackattack
source: To prepare for parties, POKENAME cram confetti into their cannons, condensing the material into the cramped space. Once the party starts, a forceful jet of water breaks up the confetti and spreads it around the room.

entry: POKENAME没吸收到足够太阳能，就会一直挨饿，变得凶猛。它会用丛林栖息地中的硬石，磨利镰刀。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME doesn't absorb enough solar energy, it stays hungry and becomes aggressive. It sharpens its scythes on hard stones found in its jungle habitat.

entry: POKENAME会用翅膀缓缓降到水面喝水。有时扇得太快，反而把自己送到水面下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its wings to slowly descend to the water's surface to drink. Occasionally, its wings flap too quickly and send it under the surface.

entry: POKENAME的所有头都会合作筑巢，剪下细树枝，搭成坚固结构。完成后，它们便留在巢里，直到准备好进化。
author: mistymagius
source: All of POKENAME's heads work together to build their nest, cutting off small tree branches and organizing them into a sturdy structure. Once they are done, they don't move from their nest until they are ready to evolve.

entry: POKENAME挥舞巨钳螳螂外骨骼的碎片战斗，其中那一截钳子，既能切割，也能重击。它会把钳子在岩石上磨利，细心保养。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME wields parts of Scizor's exoskeleton in battle, the partial pincer it uses being effective at cutting and bludgeoning. It maintains the pincer by sharpening it against rocks.

entry: POKENAME整日练习双刃，最终把一片森林削得只剩土地，引发沙尘暴。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME spends all day practicing with its twin blades. Eventually, it clears an entire section of forest down to the dirt, causing dust storms.

entry: POKENAME把舌头当套索，拉近宝可梦，再用利刃攻击。舌头强得惊人，配合翅膀，甚至能让它攀附到高处。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME uses its tongue like a lasso, reeling in Pokémon before attacking with its blades. This tongue is surprisingly strong, even allowing it to grapple onto high places with help from its wings.

entry: POKENAME惊慌时，壳会变得更硬。遇到敌人，它会先短暂飞行，再用坚硬身体撞上去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's shell gets harder if it panics. If it encounters an enemy, it will fly for a short period of time before colliding its hard body with its foe.

entry: POKENAME会在石头上磨利镰刀般的角。锋利到极点时，只需一甩头，就能干净利落地切开粗树干。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sharpens its scythe-like horn against stones. At maximum sharpness, its horn can cleanly cut through a thick tree trunk with a single swing of its head.

entry: POKENAME凶猛的外表，足以吓走想吃蛋的捕食者。幸亏如此，因为镰刀手臂太短，很难当作有效武器。
author: pjporwoll
source: The fierce appearance of POKENAME is enough to frighten predators away from its egg. This is fortunate for the POKENAME because its scythe arms are too short to be used effectively as weapons.

entry: POKENAME十分在意住处周围高草的高度，一长得太长，就会剪短。连自己的藤蔓长得过长、杂乱，它也会用镰刀修剪。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME obsesses over the height of the tall grass surrounding its home, cutting it down whenever it grows too long. It even prunes its own vines with its scythes if they grow too lengthy and unruly.

entry: POKENAME腹部最坚韧，这倒是好事，因为幼崽还不知道爪子会造成多大伤害。它护幼时十分凶暴，因此野生原野区会请巡护员密切监测。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's belly is the most durable part of its body, which is good as its baby is not yet aware of the damage its claws can deal. POKENAME is violently defensive of its baby, so the Safari Zone has Rangers monitor it closely.

entry: POKENAME爱好和平，更喜欢用镰刀扎进树果里进食。虽然温和，却颇为自私，吃东西时谁靠近，都会被它拍开。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is pacifistic and prefers using its scythes to pierce into berries to eat them. Though gentle, it is rather selfish and will swat at anyone approaching it while it eats.

entry: POKENAME最初是在一场强雷暴刚过后，于关都中部的森林深处发现的。它护领地时凶猛无比，其他时候倒不难相处。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME was first discovered in the middle of Kanto, deep in the woods, just after a strong thunderstorm. It protects its territory with intense ferocity, but it is not disagreeable outside of those circumstances.

entry: POKENAME会在树上切出恰好能流出树液的深口，再夹住开口，喝到心满意足。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slices trees just deep enough to release sap. It then clamps onto the opening and drinks until satisfied.

entry: POKENAME镰刀般的尾巴，与角上覆着相同毒素，留下的伤口刺痛得厉害。不过，普通解毒剂几乎能立刻解除这种刺痛毒素。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's scything tail is coated with the same poison as its horn, resulting in wounds from it stinging quite badly. However, a simple antidote causes this stinging poison to wear off almost immediately.

entry: POKENAME小得能装进鱼缸，靠威吓性的假眼驱赶捕食者。被轻抚时，它便卸下凶相，喜欢依偎在训练家身边。
author: ghostslythe
source: Small enough to be carried in a fish tank, POKENAME depends on its menacing false eyes to keep predators away. Its facade melts when petted, as it enjoys snuggling up to its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME快得惊人，穿过高草、掠过水面，姿态如忍者般轻盈。它用硬化利刃切开猎物，吸食里面的体液。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Strikingly fast, POKENAME darts through tall grass and across water with grace akin to a ninja. It scythes prey apart with its hardened blades in order to drink the bodily fluids that lie within.

entry: POKENAME会埋伏在水里，借翅膀跃出，突袭猎物。虽然主要适应陆上生活，仍保有能在水下呼吸的鳃。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME's wings help launch it out from the water where it lies in wait to ambush prey. Though mostly adapted to land living, it still possesses gills that let it breathe underwater.

entry: POKENAME喜怒无常，稍受挑衅就会变得凶猛。光照下，翼膜和冠饰泛出耀眼的翠绿。成群的它们，只需数小时便能吃光一片庄稼。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are highly temperamental Pokémon, becoming aggressive at the slightest provocation. Their wing membranes and crests shine a brilliant emerald when in light. Swarms of these Pokémon can devour a field of crops in mere hours.

entry: POKENAME喜怒无常，稍受挑衅就会变得凶猛。引导电属性攻击时，身体会泛出明亮的青绿，从尾巴释放狂乱雷电。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are highly temperamental Pokémon, becoming aggressive at the slightest provocation. As they channel Electric-type attacks, their bodies shine bright turquoise. They discharge wild Thunder Bolts from their tails.

entry: POKENAME厌恶同类，常为领地激烈交战。它先用尖刺贯穿猎物，再趁对方被钉住时，切成碎块。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME despises others of its own kind and will often get in heated battles over territory. It impales its prey with its sharp stinger before slicing them to pieces while they are still pinned.

entry: POKENAME十分谨慎，总用尾端镰刃威胁陌生者，不许靠近。一旦赢得信任，它却是温柔忠诚的宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is cautious, always keeping strangers at bay by threatening them with the scythe blade on its tail. Once its trust has been earned, it is quite a gentle and loyal Pokémon.

entry: 为了等待最佳伏击时机，POKENAME能接连数天纹丝不动。机会一到，它便扑到猎物身上，用锋利镰刀，迅速结束对方的生命。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can wait for several days at a time to find the right moment to ambush prey, remaining motionless the entire time. Once it finds the right moment, it pounces atop its prey to deliver a swift death with its sharp scythes.

entry: 人们最好避开正在跳舞的POKENAME。它们陶醉地在阳光下旋转、起舞，裙摆会切开挡路的一切。
author: santon5512
source: It is recommended that people steer clear of POKENAME while they're dancing. They will blissfully twirl and dance in the sun, their dress slicing through anything that gets in their path.

entry: 不知为何，POKENAME会凶猛地砍光森林，科学家还没弄清原因。它一进入某地，人们便临时搭起木料场，利用突然多出的木材。
author: ozydamians
source: POKENAME ferociously clear-cut forests for reasons scientists don't understand. Impromptu lumberyards are set up to make use of the sudden windfall of wood when a POKENAME enters the region.

entry: POKENAME十分认真，不论理发还是宝可梦对战，都追求完美。一出差错，就会陷入原始的暴怒，需要坚定又能让它安心的训练家，才能安抚。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are serious creatures that want to deliver perfection, whether it is a haircut or a Pokémon battle. They go into a primitive rage whenever they make a mistake, and it takes a firm yet reassuring Trainer to calm them down.

entry: POKENAME四肢如锋利刀刃，性情却温和迟钝。它主要用利刃砍下树枝，或整棵长着最爱树果的树。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses sharp bladed limbs but has a gentle and dim-witted demeanor. It mostly uses its blades to chop down branches or entire trees that grow its favorite berries.

entry: POKENAME发现敌人时，两个头反应不同。主头想冲上去，把对手切成百片；小头却想先守着，等敌人下一招，再作反应。
author: soup1900
source: When a POKENAME spots a foe, the two heads will react differently. The main head will want to charge in and slice them into a hundred pieces, while the smaller head will want to stand guard and await the foe's next move before reacting.

entry: 野外遇上POKENAME，就快逃吧。双镰能轻松划开皮肉，硬壳又挡得住多数攻击。
author: krune
source: Should you encounter a wild POKENAME, run. Its scythes are sharp enough to cut through skin with ease, and its shell can deflect most attacks.

entry: 与普通土龙弟弟不同，POKENAME的尾巴不能让它挖入地下。它改用锋利附肢爬树，有时还能看见它跃下，猎食体形较小的同类。
author: notmax22
source: Unlike regular Dunsparce, POKENAME tails do not allow them to burrow underground. They instead use sharp appendages to climb trees and are sometimes seen hunting small POKENAME by leaping down.

entry: 坚硬金属外骨骼保护着POKENAME，让它的物理防御无可匹敌。目不暇接的速度与锋利镰状前臂，更让它威胁十足。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's physical defenses are unmatched as its hard metal exoskeleton protects it. Its blinding speed and sharp scythe-like forearms make it a threatening Pokémon.

entry: 只要下定决心，POKENAME的镰刀就能砍平整片森林。不过，它主要用来战斗，大多是与同类切磋。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can level an entire forest's worth of trees with its scythes if it puts its mind to it. However, it mainly uses them in combat, mostly to spar with other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME会帮木匠切割木料，用来制作柜子、桌椅和其他家具。剃刀般锋利的爪子，确保切口精确无误。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME helps carpenters cut wood into parts used for making cabinets, tables, chairs, and other furniture. Its razor-sharp claws ensure that its cuts are precise and accurate.

entry: 这种宝可梦的翅膀连在前臂镰刀上，让空中动作相当灵活。翼上每片刃都像镰刀一样锋利，能轻松将多数敌人切碎。
author: infinex21
source: This Pokémon's wings are attached to its forearm scythes, granting it considerable flexibility in how it moves in the air. Each blade along its wings is as sharp as its scythes, allowing it to slice most foes to shreds with ease.

entry: POKENAME不算特别凶，却脾气烦躁，容易激动。被招惹太过，它就从鹿角发出奇异嗡鸣，扰乱目标，再用刀刃手臂攻击。
author: sk372
source: Though not particularly aggressive, POKENAME has an irritable disposition and gets agitated easily. If provoked too much, it disorients a target with a strange buzz from its antlers before striking with its bladed arms.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴作画，也用它切开密林。它们是高明的植物修剪艺术家，能用利刃，把灌木雕成精巧造型。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their tails to both paint and slice through dense forests. They are skilled topiary artists, using their blades to create intricate sculptures out of shrubbery.

entry: POKENAME是非凡的斗士，即使倒立，也能保持完美平衡。身体高速旋转，镰刀便卷成致命的刀刃龙卷风，没有敌人能全身而退。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an extraordinary fighter, able to maintain perfect balance even when upside down. By spinning its body at tremendous speeds, it wields its scythes to generate a deadly tornado of blades that leaves no foe unscathed.

entry: POKENAME尾端的镰刀刃，强到能与饭匙蛇的刃正面相抗。刃上毒素带来强烈而短促的疼痛，也会削弱猎物。
author: infinex21
source: The scythe-like blade at the end of POKENAME's tail is strong enough to clash evenly with a Seviper's blade. The toxins that lace its blade cause intense, yet swift, pain and serve to impair its prey.

entry: POKENAME用坚韧无比的铠甲，弥补攻击距离不足。铠甲让它能迎着攻击埋头猛冲，切开再坚韧的对手。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME make up for their lack of range with their incredibly tough armor. This armor lets them charge headfirst through attacks, slicing through even the toughest opponents.

entry: POKENAME巨大的镰状肢体，能相对轻松地切断至少六棵树。它靠跳跃、滑翔飞行，小翅膀也能让它至少留空十分钟，才必须落地。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's large, scythe-like limbs are strong enough to cut through at least six trees with relative ease. It leaps and glides to fly, though its small wings can hold it aloft for at least ten minutes before it must land.

entry: POKENAME给镰状尾巴注入电力，让它短暂浮起，再以完美平衡骑在上面，穿梭树间。它花许多时间吃树果，增强力量，恢复活力。
author: fiordaliso
source: By infusing its scythe-like tail with electricity, POKENAME can make it float briefly and ride it with flawless balance, darting between the trees. It devotes much of its time to consuming berries, boosting its strength and restoring its vitality.

entry: 人们常请成群POKENAME协助，清理植被茂密的区域。默契的配合与锋利前臂刀刃，让它们轻松斩开所有障碍。
author: sirg44
source: Groups of POKENAME are often recruited for assistance in clearing areas of dense vegetation. With their flawless coordination and razor-sharp forearm blades, they slash through any obstacles with ease.

entry: POKENAME生活在密林，用镰刀割下粗藤，缠在自己身上。虽然翅膀无力带它飞行，夏季却会快速拍动，为自己降温。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in thick jungles, cutting down thick vines using its scythes to wrap around itself. While not strong enough to fly, POKENAME will rapidly beat its wings to cool itself down during the summer.

entry: POKENAME会与理发师合作，为客人剪发，也练出赢得对战所需的灵巧。它每天练习技巧，力求打得漂亮。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME works together with barbers to cut hair for patrons while also developing the dexterity needed to win Pokémon battles. It practices every day to improve its technique so that it can fight with style.

entry: POKENAME埋伏在粗树枝下方。一发现猎物，就以快得无法看清的斩击进攻。
author: stephanyx
source: POKENAME lies in wait on the underside of thick tree branches. Once it sees its prey, it attacks with blindingly quick slashes.

entry: POKENAME脑后长长的刃状叶片，是它最锋利的武器。只需一甩头，连森林中最粗的树干也能利落劈开。
author: sk372
source: The long-bladed leaf on the back of POKENAME's head is the sharpest of its weapons. With a swing of its head, it can cleave cleanly through the thickest tree trunks of its forest.

entry: POKENAME会用双手镰刀，帮助伐木工砍树。不砍树时，它们便蜷成一团尖刺，睡个小觉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME help loggers cut down trees with the scythes on their hands. When they are not chopping down trees, they curl into a ball of spikes and take a nap.

entry: POKENAME用锋利镰臂，帮助农民清理疯长的田地。灵活武艺配合精准切斩，能以惊人速度收割数英亩的庄稼。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME assist farmers by using their sharp arm-scythes to clear overgrown fields. Combining martial agility with precise cutting strikes, they can harvest entire acres of crops with remarkable speed.

entry: POKENAME有些自负又莽撞，爱用头部镰刀的大小与锋利威吓别人。它会用刀刃割去高草，让沼泽家园周围保持整洁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a bit cocky and rambunctious, trying to intimidate others with the size and sharpness of the scythe on its head. It keeps the area around its swamp home trimmed by cutting tall grass with the blade.

entry: POKENAME感知危险的本领诡异，逃得快到留下残影。逃跑时，它们还会用头撞开障碍，连训练家也不例外。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME have the uncanny ability to sense danger, and flee fast enough to leave afterimages. During their escape, they are known to headbutt obstacles and even Trainers.

entry: POKENAME精通近身格斗，刃状双手轻轻一拨，就能架开攻击。对手一踉跄，它便迅速挪位反击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are experts at fighting up close and can parry an attack with a flick of their bladed hands. Once their opponent is staggered, they can quickly maneuver into a counterattack.

entry: POKENAME一动不动地浮来浮去，仿佛完全不理会周围。可一旦遭威胁，来犯者就会被看不见的斩击连连划过身体，倒下不起。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats around motionlessly without appearing to acknowledge any of its surroundings. Yet if something threatens it, the aggressor falls to unseen cuts slashing away at their body.

entry: POKENAME利刃锋利，控制也十分精准，会用各自独特的签名标记领地。因此，工匠会请自己的伙伴，在陶器上签名。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's blades are sharp but precise, marking their territory with their own individual signature. Because of this, artisans will use their own POKENAME to sign their pottery.

entry: POKENAME挥斩时，利刃闪出变幻色彩。阳光让每次攻击，都化作耀眼的光景。
author: .izik
source: While slashing, POKENAME's blades shimmer with changing hues. Sunlight makes its attacks a dazzling display.

entry: POKENAME的外形，让许多人相信，它由多个飞天螳螂灵魂聚合而成。它常出现在草木疯长的地方，将高草和植物几乎砍光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's appearance has caused many to believe it is a conglomeration of several Scyther spirits united as one. It is known to appear in overgrown areas and hack the tall grass and plants to almost nothing.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃覆毒，十分危险。不过，除狩猎外，它只会攻击威胁自己或孩子的对象。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's blades are coated with poison, making it quite a dangerous Pokémon. However, outside of hunting, POKENAME will only attack those who threaten it or its children.

entry: POKENAME低飞寻找树上的虫巢，再用头上的镰刀将树干净利落地劈成两半。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME flies low, searching for insect nests in trees. It uses the scythe on its head to slice the tree cleanly in half.

entry: POKENAME先向前冲，再大幅转身，用头上的刀刃横扫。汇聚在刃上的力量与动势，强到足以劈开石头。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME charge forward before taking wide turns to deliver sweeping slashes with the blades on their heads. Their concentrated strength and momentum within their blades is strong enough to cleave through stone.

entry: POKENAME会在深夜，无声游荡墓地。它启发了许多鬼魅传说，常被称为“生命之敌”。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME silently wanders graveyards in the dead of night. It has inspired many haunting tales, often being referred to as the “Nemesis of Life”.

entry: POKENAME把大耳朵当军刀，用小腿在战场上跳跃。只要训练得当，它就能把拖拉机利落劈成两半。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wields its large ears like sabers, leaping across the battlefield with its tiny legs. If properly trained, it can cleave a tractor clean in half.

entry: 这把飞镰迅捷而致命，收割了许多虫宝可梦的性命，甚至让某些种类陷入生存危机。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Swift and deadly, this flying scythe has been the reaper of many bug Pokémon, endangering some species.

entry: POKENAME常与同类打架，猛烈拍翅，示意攻击意图。刃状角极为锋利，一下就能切断粗树枝。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME often gets into fights with one another, beating their wings vigorously as a show of aggression. Its bladed horns are sharp enough to cut thick tree branches in a single slice.

entry: POKENAME能极精准地移动镰刀，只斩断一根草，周围草叶却丝毫不受影响。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME's scythes can be moved very precisely; they can cut a single blade of grass in a single slash without disturbing the surrounding blades.

entry: POKENAME身体肌肉发达，挥镰的力道足以切开金属。为了保护群落与家人，它们会战至最后一息。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's muscular bodies allow them to swing their scythes with enough force to cleave through metal. They fight to their last breath to defend their packs and families.

entry: POKENAME敏捷无比，一边扇翅，一边四处跳跃。它会用强力踢击与长耳镰刃，凶猛攻击其他宝可梦。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is incredibly agile, leaping around while fluttering its wings. It aggressively attacks other Pokémon with powerful kicks and slashes from the scythe blades on its long ears.

entry: POKENAME聪明得惊人，会结群伏击猎物，再切成碎块。手臂看似短小，却能伸长，最长15英尺，触及目标。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are incredibly intelligent, ambushing their prey in packs before slicing them to pieces. While their arms might look short, they are able to extend them up to 15 feet to reach their target.

entry: POKENAME从树上割下常春藤吃，再到高枝打盹。它喜欢与同类成群休息。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME cuts ivy from trees to feed on, then naps on high branches. It prefers to rest in groups with others of its kind.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME会用垃圾填埋场的废料磨刃。磨利后，连钨也能轻松切开。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME sharpens its blades on landfill debris. Once honed, they can slice through tungsten with ease.

entry: POKENAME常趁没人看时溜进屋，以高速乱斩。恶作剧让许多家用品，都被劈成两半。
author: equation8573
source: POKENAME often sneak into houses to slash things at high speeds when no one is looking. This leads to many household items getting slashed in half due to POKENAME's mischief.

entry: POKENAME先用粗绳般的蛛网困住猎物，再以连斩结束狩猎。有些研究者认为，这是一种仁慈。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME traps prey in thick rope-like webbing before finishing them with Fury Cutter. Some researchers believe this is an act of mercy.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME的刀刃会比窑炉更热。即使攻击擦身而过，辐射的热量也会造成灼伤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's blades grow hotter than a kiln during battle. Even a near miss causes burns from the radiating heat.

entry: POKENAME生活在海带林，用伸缩刀刃割开厚海带。它十分爱护自己的海带，谁想拿走，都会被它驱赶。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be found in kelp forests, cutting through the thick kelp with its extendable blade. It is quite protective of its kelp and will try to chase away anyone that tries to take it.

entry: POKENAME会把假爪举过头顶，威吓它眼中的威胁。其实，最多只能划出纸割般的细伤。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME have fake claws that they raise high above their head to intimidate perceived threats. They are incapable of a slice larger than a papercut.

entry: POKENAME食欲旺盛，找到什么绿叶植物都吃，连草也不放过。出租它们除草，逐渐成了一门生意：镰刀迅速修剪草坪，随后就把草吃掉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have such a ravenous hunger that they eat any leafy green they can find, including grass. A growing business model revolves around renting POKENAME to eat grass, swiftly mowing lawns with their scythes to eat shortly after.

entry: POKENAME精力极其充沛，会在山中一起训练，磨炼利刃。它们用称作波导的神秘波动，判断是否与对手交战。
author: stephanyx
source: POKENAME are exceedingly energetic and train together in the mountains to sharpen their blades. They use mysterious waves called auras to determine whether to engage with opponents.

entry: POKENAME能量多得惊人。为了消耗，它会用锋利如剃刀的镰臂，不停斩砍树枝。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has an overwhelming amount of energy. To expend it, it slashes at tree branches nonstop with its razor-sharp scythes.

entry: POKENAME时刻警惕身后伏击，不断挥舞尖尾。可这常让它分神，反而更容易遭到正面攻击。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME constantly swings its sharp tail around, wary of ambushes from behind. However, this often makes it more vulnerable to attacks from the front because it is distracted.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀太小，无法带它离地，只好从高树跳下，试图腾空。人们常见它一头栽地，尖角卡进土里。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's wings are too small to lift it from the ground, so it will jump from tall trees to attempt to get some air. It can often be seen falling headfirst into the ground, getting its sharp horns stuck in the earth.

entry: POKENAME会用灼热镰刀，协助巡护员清除森林中的病树。它很喜欢熟树果，得到这种奖赏便十分高兴。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME assists Rangers in clearing forests of sick trees, using its heated scythes to cut them down. It loves being rewarded with ripe berries, of which it is very fond.

entry: POKENAME藏在高草里，仔细听其他宝可梦接近，再跃出，用镰刀砍向脚踝。猎物倒下后，它会展开紧卷的耳朵，将其击昏。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME hides in tall grass, listening carefully for the approach of other Pokémon, then leaping out to slash at their ankles with its sharp scythes. After bringing down its prey, it knocks them out by unrolling its tightly coiled ears.

entry: POKENAME能把薄膜塑成大刀刃，硬化成坚实武器。刀刃可以射离身体，由念力托在空中，再轻松收回。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME can shape its membrane into a large blade, hardening it into a sturdy weapon. This weapon can be launched off its body and carried through the air by its telekinesis, then easily recalled.

entry: POKENAME会展开刀刃，像陀螺旋转，切割敌人。如果失败，身体便会快速闪白，随后自行引爆。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins like a top with blades outstretched to slice foes. If this fails, its body blinks white rapidly before self-detonating.

entry: POKENAME作战时只用镰刀，想让獠牙保持漂亮锋利。筑巢时，它会砍倒足够粗的树，从内部掏空。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will only use its scythes in combat, as it wants to keep its tusks nice and sharp. To make its den, it will cut down a thick enough tree and then hollow it out from the inside.

entry: POKENAME先用电击麻痹对手，再突然行动，挥出锋利刀刃。有人声称，遇到顽强的猎物时，看见它笑了。
author: stephanyx
source: POKENAME uses jolts of electricity to paralyze its opponent before springing into action, slashing with its razor-sharp blades. Some claim to see it smile when it encounters resilient prey.

entry: POKENAME跑得太快，小腿无法独自安全刹住。需要急停时，它会把镰刀尾巴切进地面。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME runs at speeds too fast for its small legs to stop safely on their own. When it needs to stop abruptly, it slices into the ground with its scythe tails.

entry: POKENAME学会了控制高速滚动。狩猎或撤退时，它用镰刀肢体，辅助快速转向。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has learned how to control its high rolling speeds. It uses its scythe limbs to aid in quick turns while hunting or retreating.

entry: POKENAME学会了控制高速滚动。狩猎或撤退时，它用镰刀肢体，辅助快速转向。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has learned how to control its high rolling speeds. It uses its scythe limbs to aid in quick turns while hunting or retreating.

entry: POKENAME的强颚一口就能咬倒成年大树，刀刃手臂几秒内便能割下数十棵树苗。只需一小时，一只就能清光十英亩土地上的所有树。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME's strong jaws can fell a fully grown tree with one terrifying bite, and their bladed arms can cut down dozens of saplings in seconds. A single POKENAME could remove every tree from ten acres of land in just an hour.

entry: POKENAME只需一挥镰，就能把树拆成小原木。对伐木工十分有用，他们会在深夜放下零食，感谢它帮助村庄储备充足木材。
author: quackquackattack
source: With a single whip of their scythe, POKENAME can rend trees into small logs. This is particularly helpful for loggers, who leave out treats in the middle of the night to thank POKENAME for helping them ensure villages have plenty of wood.

entry: 有些人用POKENAME代替割草机。翅膀锋利如剃刀，一听音乐，它便高速旋转，沿宽大的圆形轨迹，利落割草。
author: jaminmcready
source: Some people use POKENAME instead of a lawnmower. Its wings are razor sharp, and when it hears music, it begins to spin rapidly, slicing grass cleanly in wide circles.

entry: POKENAME毛茸茸的手臂会收集花粉，结成助威花球。长得太大，它就用锋利的腿修剪。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's fuzzy arms collect pollen that clumps into pom-poms. When they grow too large, it trims them back using its sharp legs.

entry: POKENAME用锋利手臂剪下花瓣，制成裙子。在森林空地跳舞时，它会自豪地穿着。
author: jaminmcready
source: Using its sharp arms, POKENAME snips petals from flowers and crafts them into dresses. It wears them proudly when it dances at forest clearings.

entry: POKENAME的翼瓣末端，是剃刀般的刀刃。它定期将其与尾刃相磨，保持锋利。
author: jaminmcready
source: The wing flaps of POKENAME end in razor-sharp blades. To keep them honed, it regularly sharpens them against the blade on its tail.

entry: 它能以惊人速度旋转刀刃，几秒便把厚木头绞碎。伐木工常会养一只POKENAME，充当高效碎木机。
author: mistymagius
source: It can spin its blades at incredibly high speeds, shredding through thick logs in a matter of seconds. Lumberjacks will often own a POKENAME as they act as efficient woodchippers.

entry: POKENAME镰形的花瓣薄脆如纸，却像新书的纸边，一划也能让人很痛。不过，主要用途还是旋转扇风，散播毒孢子。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME's scythe-shaped petals are frail like paper, but just like a sharp page from a new book, they can still cause a lot of pain. However, their main use is to rotate as a fan to spread poisonous spores.

entry: POKENAME比体形给人的印象更自信好斗，敢攻击大得多的宝可梦。战况不利时，它就喷出催眠孢子。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is more confident and aggressive than its stature would suggest. It will attack Pokémon far larger than it by spraying them in sleep-inducing spores if the fight takes an unfavorable turn.

entry: POKENAME用快速动作，逼猎物不停防守，让其筋疲力尽。它先用爪与尾巴切割对手，再用鬃毛追加攻击。
author: silverscloudy
source: POKENAME will exhaust its prey by forcing them to defend from its quick movements. It slices opponents with its claws and tail, before following up with its mane.

entry: POKENAME在树上划出深口，标记猎场，再用睡眠孢子，击昏快得追不上的猎物。蘑菇的信息素，也被用于给古龙水增添木质香调。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME cuts deep gashes into trees to mark its hunting territory, where it uses sleep spores to knock out prey that are too quick to chase. The mushroom's pheromones are used to add woodsy notes to cologne.

entry: POKENAME的每把镰刀，都有光能强化。每一刀都会留下发光痕迹，持续几秒。
author: quackquackattack
source: Each of POKENAME's scythes is enhanced with light energy, causing each cut to leave behind a glowing impression that lasts a few seconds.

entry: POKENAME身体力量不算强，却很容易被激怒，谁惹怒它，就会遭到追赶。牙齿极其锋利，能利落切断树枝。
author: mistymagius
source: Though not very physically strong, POKENAME is easy to aggravate and will pursue anything that enrages it. Its teeth are incredibly sharp, able to slice cleanly through tree branches.

entry: POKENAME的性格受性别分类影响。例如，雄性多害羞单纯，雌性多大胆强势。无论哪种分类，它们都是肉食性的。
author: bobosmith01
source: A POKENAME's personality is influenced by their classified gender. For example, males tend to be shy and naive, and females tend to be bold and forceful. Regardless of classification, they are carnivores.

entry: POKENAME会在树顶跳跃，用大镰刀砍开粗树枝。同类毛发长得太长时，它们也会相互理发。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hops atop the trees, slicing through thick tree branches with their large scythes. Other POKENAME will use their scythes to cut each other's hair when it gets too long.

entry: POKENAME通过魔杖末端的刀刃，引导火焰。不光能生火，它还能在体外20英尺范围内，自由操控火焰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME channels flames through the blade at the end of its wand. It can not only produce these flames but also control them freely up to 20 feet from its body.

entry: 人们观察到，POKENAME会用阿利多斯的丝当围巾，抵御带毒攻击。特殊的钩状镰刀，让它能绕过障碍伏击目标。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME has been observed using Ariados silk as a scarf to protect against poisonous assaults. Its special hooked scythes allow this Pokémon to ambush targets around obstacles.

entry: POKENAME飞行时速最高90英里，锋利翅膀会切开迎面的树木。它吃厚树皮，常把树剥得光秃秃才满意。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can fly up to 90mph, cutting through oncoming trees with its sharp wings. It feeds on thick tree bark, often stripping the trees bare before it is satisfied.

entry: 虽然野外自然出现的POKENAME极其罕见，它的天然栖息地似乎是热带密林。尾火能安全熄灭，不会带来不良影响，可一兴奋就立刻再燃。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although incredibly rare to find naturally in the wild, it seems POKENAME's natural habitat is deep in tropical jungles. Its fiery tail can safely be extinguished with no ill effects, but it lights right back up whenever POKENAME gets excited.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME会从地下伸出利刃。攻击轨迹流畅如舞，压倒对手。
author: .izik
source: During combat, POKENAME extends sharp blades from beneath the ground. The strikes follow fluid, dance-like patterns that overwhelm opponents.

entry: POKENAME住在海底高大的海藻丛中，紧紧跟踪游过的猎物。发现攻击机会，就会凶猛扑出。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME lives in tall groups of seaweed on the ocean floor, closely stalking any prey that swims by. When it spots a chance to attack, it aggressively lunges.

entry: POKENAME精通穿行密雨林，用利爪爬树，也清除枝叶。绿色皮肤让它跟踪猎物时，融入树冠。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is an expert at navigating the thick rainforest, using its sharp claws to both climb trees and clear away foliage. Its green skin allows it to blend into the canopy while stalking its prey.

entry: 人们能看见POKENAME沿河游动，用利刃切开芦苇和海带。翅膀虽小得飞不起来，却能帮助它在水中高速前进。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be seen swimming down the river, cutting through the reeds and kelp with its sharp blades. While its wings are too small to fly, they do help it propel through the water at high speeds.

entry: POKENAME把刃状手紧贴胸口，因为伸直手臂，会削弱切开敌人所需的力量。它们在水中快得难以看清，借冲势把利刃撞进对手。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME keep their bladed hand close to their chest, since the force they need to cut through foes is weakened if they stretch out their arm. They zip through water at blinding speed to ram their blade into foes.

entry: 即使猎物试图逃跑，POKENAME也能迅速追上。它们容易发怒，挥动前臂镰刀乱斩，因此看周围地形上密密麻麻的伤痕，就能找到领地。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME quickly track down any prey, even if said prey tries to flee. They are quick to anger and will lash out with slashes from their forearm scythes, so their territories are easy to find by the myriad scars left on the surrounding terrain.

entry: POKENAME腹部的螺旋会旋转，哄敌人困倦。对方睡着后，它便挥出一连串锋利斩击。
author: .izik
source: The spiral on POKENAME's belly spins to lull foes into drowsiness. Once they fall asleep, it strikes with a flurry of sharp slashes.

entry: POKENAME的镰刀看起来吓人，可它缺乏身体技巧，实际上没什么威胁。它依靠精神力量生存，大半时间都在睡觉。
author: equation8573
source: POKENAME has scythes that look menacing but are harmless due to its lack of physical skills. It relies on psychic powers to survive and is asleep for most of the day.

entry: POKENAME会用包括胡须状大颚在内的锋利器官，进行缝纫、修剪地毯等实用又有创意的活动。无论身手灵敏，还是头脑敏锐，都少有能比。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME uses its sharp implements, including its moustache-shaped mandibles, for productive and creative pursuits, such as sewing or shearing carpets. Both its physical agility and mental acuity are seldom matched.

entry: POKENAME常被派去清理植被疯长的区域。四条刀刃手臂，让它化作旋风，以惊人速度斩开高草与树木。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is often tasked with clearing out areas overgrown with plant life. With its four bladed arms, it becomes a whirling dervish that cleaves through tall grass and trees alike with incredible speed.

entry: POKENAME会扎根地里，吸收土中水分。任何靠得太近的东西，都会被锋利如剃刀的镰刀切开。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will root themselves into the ground, soaking up water from the soil. They will use their razor sharp scythes to slice up anything that gets too close.

entry: 虽然镰刀锋利，POKENAME主要却把它们当钩子爬树。一旦刀刃被切掉，它就会卡在那里，直到重新长出。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite how sharp POKENAME's scythes are, it mainly uses them like hooks to climb up trees. However, if the blades are ever cut off, POKENAME will be stuck until they grow back.

entry: POKENAME主要靠迅速而突然的滚动移动。据说，怒到极点时，背翅会振得极响，连覆在身上的岩石也会炸裂。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME primarily moves by swiftly and suddenly rolling around. Supposedly, if angered enough, the wings on its back begin to beat so loudly that the rocks covering its body explode.

entry: POKENAME像转指挥棒一样旋转镰刀，驱赶害虫，保护作物。空闲时，它便清洁、磨利镰刀，等待下一次入侵。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spins its scythe like a baton to ward off pests, which helps protect crops. It spends idle time cleaning and sharpening its scythe until the next invasion.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀极其锋利，让它能边全速奔跑，边切割猎物。不过，它也得小心，一不留神，很容易连自己的一个头也切掉。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's wings are incredibly sharp, allowing it to slice its prey while running at top speed. However, POKENAME does need to be careful, as it could easily cut off one of its heads if it isn't paying attention.

entry: POKENAME没有固定形态的身体，能随意变硬或变软，因此可以穿过多孔物体。这些性情恶劣的宝可梦，常割伤靠得太近的生物。
author: quackquackattack
source: The amorphous bodies of POKENAME can harden or soften at will, which allows them to move through porous objects. These mean-spirited Pokémon often cut anyone who comes too close.

entry: POKENAME住在丛林深处，领地意识很强。它能用异界力量，让自己看起来有许多只。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a territorial Pokémon found deep in the jungle. It can make itself appear numerous through otherworldly powers.

entry: POKENAME会与同类决斗，镰刀相击，直到对方认输。它们夜间更警觉，因此决斗常从黄昏打到天亮。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME faces off against others of its kind in duels, clashing their scythes together until the opposing Pokémon gives up. These duels last from dusk to dawn, because they are more alert at night.

entry: POKENAME用镰刀切碎小贝类和鱼，轻松吃上一餐。刀刃断掉后，会长得更锋利。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will use their scythes to slice up small clams and fish, ready for an easy meal. If their blades break off, they will regrow even sharper.

entry: POKENAME的嘴唇冰冷无比，碰到什么，就会冻住什么。虽然住在冰寒环境，它仍爱晒太阳，让头发保持明亮光泽。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's lips are so cold they freeze anything they touch. Despite living in icy environments, POKENAME enjoys basking in the sun to keep its hair bright and lustrous.

entry: POKENAME用有力的嘴唇吸住树木，再脱下毛发作诱饵，让捕食者抓去，自己安然无恙。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its strong lips to stick to trees. It sheds its hair as a decoy, tricking predators into grabbing it without causing harm.

entry: POKENAME能让碰到的东西像炸弹一样爆炸，主要借此捕猎，例如捕捉电蛋。
author: lam0u3tt3
source: POKENAME possess the ability of making everything it touches explodes like a bomb. POKENAME mainly uses it to hunt its prey, such as Galvancute.

entry: POKENAME有多个头，彼此贬低得快，和好也同样快。它们不断闲聊，议论其他宝可梦的八卦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have multiple heads that are quick to disparage each other, but just as quick to make amends. They constantly gossip and prattle on about other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME一挥武器，就能在夜空生成极光。如果将能量集中为一束，光流强得能穿透坚实骨头。
author: dodoowner_
source: With a wave of its weapon, POKENAME generates auroras in the night sky. If it concentrates the energy into a single beam, it summons a stream of light strong enough to penetrate solid bone.

entry: POKENAME边舞边战，让对手沉醉于动作。能伸缩的双腿配合摇摆舞步，踢出毁灭性重击，压垮敌人。
author: violet_zero
source: POKENAME dances as it fights, leading to its opponents becoming entranced by its movement. With its stretchy legs and swaying steps, this Pokémon crushes its foes with devastating kicks.

entry: POKENAME女性化的外表，常让对手轻敌。这可是大错，它会趁机挥出一连串冰冷重拳，再以一吻结束战斗。
author: banjosaurus.
source: POKENAME is often underestimated in battle due to its feminine appearance. However, this is a big mistake, as it will take the chance to attack with a flurry of ice-cold punches and finish off their opponent with a kiss.

entry: POKENAME在茧中颤抖，等蜕变完成，就会破壳而出。它会随音乐前后摇摆，有人在旁边一起跳舞，还会兴奋得抖动。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shivers within its cocoon and prepares to burst from its shell once its transformation is complete. It is known to rock back and forth to music and shakes with excitement whenever people dance alongside it.

entry: POKENAME的幼崽，会待在袋里跟着跳舞。它时刻护幼，谁靠得太近，就用刺骨寒息猛攻。
author: violet_zero
source: POKENAME's young dances along with it from its pouch. Ever protective of its child, it will assault anyone who gets too close with bone-chilling breaths.

entry: POKENAME产出的鳞片，可磨成特种涂料的黏结剂。有些邪恶组织开始用鳞片生产廉价化妆品，令警方着手调查化妆品来源。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce scales that are ground into a bonding agent for specialty paint. Some villainous organizations have begun to produce cheap cosmetics made from their scales, causing police forces to investigate sources of cosmetics.

entry: POKENAME连冬季也很活跃。它们通常行踪隐秘，聚在远离人类文明的地方，却已知会每天习惯性地结群飞舞，同步起舞。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are active even during the wintertime. While they tend to be elusive and gather in places far away from human civilization, it is known a group of them will habitually flutter and move together in a synchronized dance daily.

entry: 星光下，POKENAME身上伸出的纤维般结构，闪得如同亮粉，宝石也泛起灿烂猩红光。白天，训练家只需亲吻宝石，也能短暂引出这两种反应。
author: pattybgoode
source: In starlight, the fibrous extensions from POKENAME's body glisten like glitter and POKENAME's gem flashes a brilliant scarlet glow. A trainer can elicit a brief version of both of these reactions during the day by kissing its gem.

entry: POKENAME转着圈，唱出美妙的歌。可它发出的声音，至今无人能分毫不差地模仿。
author: fenragon
source: POKENAME sings a beautiful song as it spins around. Nobody has ever been able to precisely replicate the sounds it makes.

entry: POKENAME会与舞台魔术师合作，为观众变戏法。它们专长是造无形屏障，以及留下冰制假人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME work alongside stage magicians to perform tricks for audiences. They specialize in creating invisible barriers and leaving behind dummies made of ice.

entry: 虽然看嘴的样子，未必能想到，POKENAME却十分会唱歌。历史学家认为，它们可能曾帮助人类发明歌剧。
author: kiwiarms
source: Though you might not expect it given the way their mouths look, POKENAME are excellent singers. Historians believe they may have helped humanity invent the opera.

entry: POKENAME最引人注目的是嗓音，能唱出优美曲调，与其他宝可梦交流。受到威胁时，它们便唱歌，让周围生物心生恐惧。
author: quackquackattack
source: The most notable aspect of POKENAME is their voice, which sings a melodic tune that works as a form of communication with other Pokémon. Whenever they are threatened, they sing a song that instills a sense of dread in others around them.

entry: 野生POKENAME不用任何护发产品，头发却如此蓬松丰盈。研究其中缘由，让护发业十分感兴趣。
author: kiwiarms
source: Research into how POKENAME living in the wild are able to achieve such voluminous hair without using any product has been of great interest to the haircare industry.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛柔软，且能永远保持冰冷，因此闻名。填充这些红宝石色羽毛的高级枕头，能卖出离谱的高价。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's feathers are renowned for their softness and the unique ability to stay perpetually cold. Luxury pillows stuffed with these ruby feathers fetch exorbitant prices.

entry: POKENAME用巨大而绚丽的闪电，凶猛抵御竞争者，守护巢穴。羽毛带着静电，摸起来却凉凉的。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME fiercely defends its nest from rivals with great bolts of exquisite lightning. Its feathers are staticky yet cool to the touch.

entry: POKENAME在空中，以古怪节奏猛然向前窜动。振翅声虽响，不规律的轨迹仍能让敌人措手不及，再以冰冷毒针，极精准地刺击。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME darts through the air by lurching some distance at an odd rhythm. Its wingbeats are loud, but its erratic movement patterns still allow it to catch foes off guard and strike with its freezing stingers with incredible precision.

entry: POKENAME头上的火焰形似王冠。想炫耀时，它们就让火燃得更旺，激起热气，在头发和长裙间旋绕。
author: wiz0z
source: The flame on POKENAME's head mimics the shape of a crown. POKENAME flare these flames when they wish to show off, creating gusts of hot air that swirl through their hair and gown.

entry: POKENAME在生活许多方面都端庄得体。它们害怕在别人面前犯错，便格外依赖社交礼仪，弥补这份不安。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are prim and proper regarding many aspects of their life. They are scared of making mistakes in front of others, so they lean into social etiquette to compensate for this fact.

entry: POKENAME住在瀑布潭，用冰丝圈套困住毫无防备的训练家，喂给幼崽。有时，饥饿的迷唇丝蛛会亲自引人到巢中，并因聪明得到额外一份。
author: kungfucutbug
source: POKENAME live in waterfall basins, using snares made of freezing silk to trap unsuspecting Trainers and feed them to their brood. Sometimes, a hungry Smoorak will lure people to POKENAME's lair itself, receiving an extra share for its cleverness.

entry: POKENAME会细心梳理石榴红的羽毛，让人别注意利爪。它们喜欢成为焦点，关注一被转走，就会嫉妒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME groom their garnet red feathers with delicate care to draw attention away from their talons. They prefer to be the center of attention and get jealous when attention is drawn away from them.

entry: POKENAME很虚荣，会与其他宝可梦争斗，只为吸引最多注意。满月时，它们尤其好斗，会与同类斗舞，比拼美丽。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are vain creatures and will fight against other Pokémon to draw the most attention to themselves. They are particularly feisty during the full moon, when they dance off against other POKENAME in a battle of beauty.

entry: POKENAME的飞行与歌声，迷人得令人沉醉。可如果你恰好是猎物，这也可能是你一生最后看见的景象。
author: garret95
source: POKENAME's flight and singing are a mesmerizing display. Yet, depending on whether you're its prey, it might be the last thing you ever witness.

entry: POKENAME走路时会扭动臀部。舞跳得越快，电力积得越多，随时能摆个耀眼姿势，电击对手。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME shakes its hips as it walks. The faster this Pokémon dances, the more electricity it builds up, so it's ready to zap any opponent in one dazzling pose.

entry: 太阳升到最高时，POKENAME会围成圆圈，扭动臀部，向太阳起舞。旁观的其他宝可梦，也忍不住加入。
author: santon5512
source: When the sun is at its highest, POKENAME will gather in circles, wiggling their hips as they dance for the sun. Other Pokémon witnessing this can't help but join in.

entry: POKENAME自认是最美的宝可梦，便躺在海中岩石上，试图吸引水手注意。可至今尚未成功。
author: kiwiarms
source: POKENAME considers itself to be the most beautiful Pokémon, so it lies atop rocks in the ocean to catch the attention of sailors. It has yet to be successful.

entry: POKENAME只在寒冷天气跳舞，会边唱边左右摇头，让人注意花朵。每只都有独特香味，并随不同演出细微变化。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME only dances in cold weather and will sway its head from side to side while singing to draw attention to its flower. Each POKENAME has a unique fragrance, which subtly changes to suit each performance.

entry: 寒冷北风吹来，POKENAME会用棉球兜住风，在空中打圈漂浮。成群时，它们动作同步，仿佛跳舞。
author: .jerden
source: When cold northern winds blow, POKENAME catch them with their cotton puffs and then float around in circles in the sky. Groups of them will synchronize their movements as if dancing.

entry: POKENAME用诱人的叫声，把较小宝可梦引向巢穴。等靠得够近，它们就挥翅震响空气，将对方吹撞到附近树上。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: With POKENAME's alluring call, they lure smaller Pokémon towards their nests. When close enough, POKENAME crack the air with their wings, blowing away the Pokémon into nearby trees.

entry: POKENAME在雪中优雅踱步觅食，毛发飘动，如同裙摆。它们痴迷外貌，常能看见它们对着人家窗户，欣赏倒影。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME strut elegantly through the snow in search of food, their fur flowing much like a dress. Obsessed with their own appearance, these Pokémon can often be found admiring their reflections in people's windows.

entry: 有记录以来，POKENAME始终与人类共同生活。据信，它们演化出了相近的食谱；解剖研究显示，它们与滤食河流泥沙的动物有相似之处。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: For as long as records show, POKENAME have lived alongside humans. It is believed that they evolved to consume a similar diet, as anatomical studies have shown similarities to filter feeders that consume mud and silt from rivers.

entry: POKENAME诡异的低语，会让许多听见的孩子哭起来。它用鲜红嘴唇亲吻人时，会留下灵体般的印记，持续一天。
author: quackquackattack
source: The eerie murmuring of a POKENAME causes many children to cry when they hear it. When they kiss people with their bright red lips, they leave behind an ethereal mark that lasts for a day.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在雪山峰顶附近，隔雾盯着训练家。据说，目光冰冷得令人不安，对视太久，还会引发让人听不懂的呢喃。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME lurk near the peaks of snowy mountains, staring at Trainers through the fog. Trainers have described their gaze as cold and unnerving, and locking eyes with them for too long has been known to cause unintelligible murmuring.

entry: 有人觉得这种宝可梦诱人，也有人觉得恶心。它住在潮湿的地下洞穴，什么也不做，只不断生下更多凶恶幼崽。
author: fireblade141
source: This Pokémon has been described by some as alluring and by others as revolting. It dwells in damp underground caverns where it does nothing but continuously birth more of its vicious young.

entry: POKENAME靠有节奏地摇晃，榨树果汁的速度是普通壶壶的四倍。它们常被养在果汁吧附近，可不断的摇晃声会吵到邻居。
author: standing__water
source: POKENAME can juice berries four times faster than an average Shuckle by shaking rhythmically. They are often raised around juice bars, and the constant rattling they make can disturb neighbors.

entry: POKENAME总想悄悄偷走训练家的物品。可得手后，又弄不懂药水、设备或钱有什么用，恼火到只好再偷别的东西。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME always try to stealthily snatch items from Trainers. However, after they secure their loot, they struggle to find use for things such as potions, devices, or money, which frustrates them to the point of having to steal something else.

entry: 人类或宝可梦靠近住处时，POKENAME会凶猛起舞，发出警告。对方既不离开，也不跟着跳，它就会暴怒。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME aggressively dances as a warning when people or Pokémon approach its home. If they don't either leave or dance along in turn, it flies into a rage.

entry: 歌剧终幕时，POKENAME会慢慢挪上舞台中央，用冰壳制造戏剧性的雾气。悦耳的鸣叫配上乐曲，常获评论界赞赏。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME slowly inch out onto the stage of operas during the closing act, taking centre stage and using their icy shell to create a dramatic mist. Their melodic cries are set to music, often meeting critical acclaim.

entry: POKENAME在雪丘上旋转，在霜雪中留下细致图案。有人靠近，它就会放出一阵细雪，再逃向远处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME twirls atop snow dunes, leaving delicate patterns in the frost. If approached, it unleashes a flurry of Powder Snow before fleeing into the distance.

entry: POKENAME身上的厚毛，比商用冷冻柜还冷。它会随节奏摇摆，唱出幽美的曲调，回荡在苔原。
author: .izik
source: The thick fur covering POKENAME is colder than a commercial freezer. It sways rhythmically while singing a hauntingly beautiful tune that echoes through the tundra.

entry: 据说POKENAME会与深海居民订契约，操纵其他宝可梦自行陷入危险，免得亲自与之战斗。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is said to make contracts with the denizens of the deep, manipulating other Pokémon to put themselves in danger so it doesn't have to fight them itself.

entry: 许多POKENAME会在飞云市时装秀中登场，为高档设计师手袋宣传。演出被打断时，它会惊慌地向观众扔出一份礼物，后果难以预料。
author: .izik
source: Many POKENAME are featured in Castelia City fashion shows, advertising high-end designer purses. If interrupted during a performance, it panics and hurls a Present into the crowd, with unpredictable results.

entry: POKENAME领地意识很强，会用震耳的叫声，吓走山顶巢穴的入侵者。若没用，就以钢铁翅膀和强爪进攻。
author: danarchosyndacalist
source: The territorial POKENAME uses its deafening call to scare intruders away from its mountaintop nest. When that does not work, POKENAME attacks with its steel wings and powerful claws.

entry: 许多船首雕像，受POKENAME外形启发。它会试着把水手引向大冰块，困住船，逼船员听自己的歌声。
author: fiordaliso
source: The figureheads of many ships were inspired by POKENAME's appearance. It tries to lure sailors toward large blocks of ice to trap their ships and force their crews to listen to its voice.

entry: 据说，POKENAME能感知其他生物的悲伤，一察觉就开始表演。优雅舞步与舒缓旋律，像安宁的浪潮，抚平最忧郁的心。
author: noxid
source: POKENAME are said to be able to sense the sorrow in others. Once they sense this, they begin to perform. Between their graceful dancing and soothing melodies, a wave of serenity crashes through even the most melancholy hearts.

entry: POKENAME会造结构精巧的冰巢，光一照，便泛起虹彩。求偶仪式常包括复杂的同步舞蹈与鸣唱。冰羽离体后，仍能冷上数星期。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME create nests of intricately structured ice that iridescently shine when struck by light. Courtship rituals often involve complex synced dances and vocalizations. Their icy feathers remain cold for weeks after falling from their body.

entry: POKENAME十分自豪于自己的外貌，偶尔连睡觉时，都会无意识地梳理身体。不飞行时，它走路昂首阔步，华丽又张扬。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME takes great pride in its appearance; it can occasionally being spotted unconsciously grooming itself even when it is asleep. When it is not in flight, POKENAME walks with a flamboyant and showy strut.

entry: POKENAME会打磨冰封的尾巴，直到能在冰里看见倒影。完成后，再确认金发依然整齐，是它最开心的时候，便会如跳舞般摇摆。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME polishes its ice-clad tail until it can see its own reflection in the ice. It is at its happiest when it finishes this task and ensures its golden locks are still in order. When happy, it sways about as if dancing.

entry: POKENAME的嘴唇哪怕只碰一下，也能让人睡上数小时。它们总充分利用这一点，偷吃路过洞穴者的食物，大快朵颐。
author: epping_forest
source: Even a single touch of POKENAME's lips can put anyone to sleep for hours. They always make good use of this quality to steal and feast upon the food of anyone passing by their caves.

entry: POKENAME从双手射出的冰晶，一嵌进表面，就能长成大型冰雕。它借此装饰家园，变成名副其实的冰宫。
author: sk372
source: The ice crystals POKENAME fires from its hands can grow into large ice sculptures once they embed into a surface. POKENAME uses this to furnish its home into a veritable ice palace.

entry: POKENAME的身体和头发，全由藤蔓构成。它摇曳前行时，每条藤蔓都随节奏扭动。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body and hair are made entirely of vines. As POKENAME sashays around, each of them twitches in time to the rhythm.

entry: POKENAME能控制金色长发的动作，它们与其说像头发，不如说像藤蔓。让其有节奏地流动摇摆，便能使舞蹈更加迷人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can control the movement of its long golden tresses, which are more similar to vines than hair. By making them rhythmically flow and sway, POKENAME can increase the appeal of its dancing.

entry: 据说，POKENAME住在山地火山深处，只有喷发后才现身。它周围的空气，会在酷热与刺骨严寒之间迅速交替。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are said to live deep inside mountainous volcanoes and only emerge after an eruption. The air around POKENAME quickly alternates between extremely hot and blisteringly cold.

entry: POKENAME像一位喜怒无常、难伺候的首席女歌手。命令只会让它昂头甩发，将冰晶甩向胆敢指使自己的家伙。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a moody prima-donna of a Pokémon. Giving orders will only result in it turning up its head and flipping its hair, which flings ice crystals in the direction of whoever dares boss it around.

entry: 饲养POKENAME的科学家，被建议在项目完成时把它留在精灵球里。因为它会让训练家和附近同事，全都跳起舞，庆祝成果。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Scientists who have POKENAME are advised to leave them in their Poké Ball when completing projects. This is because POKENAME will cause their Trainer and any nearby colleagues to dance in celebration of their achievement.

entry: POKENAME在叶片周围凝结霜，形成锋利冰刃，斩过时让空气降温。霜一接触表面便积聚，形成弱点，让它在下一击利用。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME condense frost around their leaves in order to create sharp, icy blades that chill the air as they slash. The frost collects on contact with a surface, creating a weak point that POKENAME can take advantage of in their next attack.

entry: POKENAME冰冷的拳脚流畅摇摆，威力惊人。唯一能与之比肩的，是获胜后印在败者脸颊上的吻。
author: bear_qo.op
source: The smooth, swaying icy blows of POKENAME's punches and kicks are only matched in potency by the kisses it places on defeated foes' cheeks after it wins.

entry: POKENAME用敏感双手，冻结空气。虽然失明，却能凭心灵感应，清楚看见任何被自己降温的物体。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME freezes the air with its sensitive hands. Though blind, it can clearly see any object it chills with its telepathy.

entry: POKENAME天生像在皱脸。这副表情加上谨慎动作，让它显得比实际更冷淡孤傲。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a natural facial expression that resembles a grimace. That expression combined with their cautious movements make them appear more aloof than they are.

entry: POKENAME嬉闹的举止，几乎像在调情。除了对训练家，对其他对象这样做，都只是骗局：先让对方放松警惕，再冻得结结实实，取个乐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME behaves in a playful manner that borders on being flirtatious. For all but its Trainer, this behavior is a ruse to lull others into a false sense of security before POKENAME freezes them solid for fun.

entry: POKENAME极其认真地看待外貌。谁把它弄脏，或贬损长相，它就会大为恼怒，从肘部伸出冰刃反击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME takes its appearance very seriously. If someone dirties it or besmirches its appearance, it takes great offense and lashes out using extending blades of ice from its elbows.

entry: POKENAME说着难懂的语言，听久可能令人发疯。它的吻带来充满怪诞梦境的不安睡眠，自己则一眨不眨地盯着猎物。
author: empathnaga
source: POKENAME speaks in an incomprehensible tongue that can drive listeners to madness. Its kiss brings a fitful sleep filled with surreal dreams as its unblinking eyes watch its prey.

entry: 被称为“钻石尘”的闪亮花粉，不断从冰冷的花中喷出。清晨阳光照来，POKENAME和周围便会泛出百万种色彩。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Glittering pollen called "diamond dust" spouts endlessly from its frigid blossom. When the sun shines on it in the early morning, POKENAME and its surroundings shimmer in a million hues.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时会用有力的嘴唇吸在冰洞侧壁上。据说被它亲吻后，身体的热量就会被慢慢抽走。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will use its powerful lips to attach itself to the side of ice caves while they sleep. It is said if you are ever kissed by one, you will slowly be drained of your body heat.

entry: POKENAME专横冷淡，连对自己的训练家也毫不退让。但内心深处，它其实十分感激照顾自己的生物。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME's demeanor is unflinchingly bossy and cold, even towards its own Trainer. Deep down, however, it truly appreciates those who care for it.

entry: 严寒的冬夜，POKENAME会现身，将迷路的旅人引向歧途，再带往灵界。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME appears on particularly cold winter nights to lead lost wanderers astray and carry them off to the spirit world.

entry: POKENAME能用伴随身侧的灵火打开传送门，转眼之间，便跨越遥远的距离。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can create portals with the spirit flames that accompany it, allowing it to travel long distances in a short time.

entry: POKENAME住在城堡、遗迹与废屋中，支配附近的宝可梦，让它们麻木地侍奉自己。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lives in castles, ruins, and abandoned houses. It controls other Pokémon in the vicinity, which serve POKENAME apathetically.

entry: POKENAME在冷水中游泳时，会低声唱歌，身体随歌声摇摆。如果另一只听见，便会与它缓缓绕行，唱起二重唱。
author: .jerden
source: While swimming through cold waters, POKENAME sings in a deep voice and moves its body in time to the rhythm of their song. If another POKENAME hears them, they will perform a duet as they slowly circle each other.

entry: POKENAME只需一吻，就能暂时改变感知，让受害者相信它是神。效果总会在约一星期后消退。
author: .izik
source: A single kiss from POKENAME can temporarily alter perception, causing victims to believe it divine. The effect consistently fades after roughly one week.

entry: POKENAME一边抛接、旋转长杖，一边跳迷人的舞，让对手震撼得呆住。随后，它便以精湛武艺，攻击无助的敌人。
author: tai.wind
source: POKENAME juggles and twirls its staff while performing a mesmerizing dance that leaves its opponent frozen in awe. POKENAME then strikes at the helpless foe with expert martial arts.

entry: POKENAME滑过冰湖，唱着欢快旋律。可谁敢在旁边一起滑冰，它就会震碎对方脚下的冰，绝不分享冰场。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides across frozen lakes, singing a cheerful melody. However, if anyone dares to skate alongside it, it shatters the ice beneath them, refusing to share the rink.

entry: POKENAME爱摆足架势，出招也华丽。若教它把实效看得比排场更重，战斗本领就会大幅提高。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME tend to be dramatic Pokémon that strike with flashy attacks. Giving them the discipline to focus on success over appearances will greatly improve their battle prowess.

entry: POKENAME住在高山，看似柔软温暖。可别受骗，那蓬松羊毛般的东西，其实是锋利、坚硬如岩的晶体。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Living in high mountains, POKENAME appears deceptively soft and warm. Don't be fooled; what seems to be fluffy wool is actually sharp, rock-hard crystal.

entry: POKENAME稀有，能赋予人惊人美貌，因此上流人士竞相寻觅。长期影响仍在研究，可传闻它们靠训练家的生命能量维生。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME are rare, but sought out by members of high society for their ability to grant people immense beauty. Studies into this Pokémon's long-term effects are ongoing, but rumors suggest they feed off their Trainer's life energy.

entry: POKENAME以铁腕统领一小群驹刀小兵，对部下毫无温情。它极重外貌，每场战斗后都要驹刀小兵替自己梳妆。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME rule over small groups of Pawniard with an iron fist, never showing an ounce of warmth to its subjects. It cares deeply about its appearance and will get its Pawniard to tend to it after every battle.

entry: POKENAME极为珍爱飘逸鬃毛，谁敢弄乱，就立刻电谁一下。心情好时，会跳起优雅婀娜的舞，让许多宝可梦着迷。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME takes immense pride in its flowing mane, instantly shocking anyone who dares to muss it up. When in a good mood, it performs graceful, sinuous dances that many Pokémon find captivating.

entry: POKENAME体型虽大，动作却十分优雅。幽幽的歌声，常在山间回荡。
author: bigoljax
source: Despite their size, POKENAME are graceful in their movements. Their haunting voices can be heard echoing in the mountains.

entry: POKENAME以美貌深受喜爱，常被写进航海诗篇。可迷人的歌声，也曾将许多水手引向死亡。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME are beloved for their beauty and are often written about in nautical poems. The enchanting songs they sing have lured many sailors to their deaths.

entry: POKENAME用冰晶雕出华美塑像，装点洞穴。谁若闯入领地，它就毫不犹豫地将对方冻成冰块。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME decorates its den with luxurious sculptures made out of ice crystals. If anyone trespasses on its territory, it will freeze them solid without a second thought.

entry: POKENAME天生节奏感好，歌声细腻，很受音乐人喜爱。年幼时，却常被自己的毛绊倒。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME's natural rhythm and delicate singing voices make them a favorite Pokémon among musicians. When they are young, they often trip over their fur.

entry: 它高飞天际，整天练习新奇精彩的肚皮舞。坏天气若妨碍演出，POKENAME就会大发雷霆，直到天晴才平息。
author: kiwiarms
source: It flies high in the sky, practicing new and exciting belly dances all day. If bad weather gets in the way of its performance, POKENAME enters a rage state that lasts until it clears up.

entry: POKENAME会在梦里化作美丽少女，乞求收留。梦中人若上当，它便不断吸取生命力，直到对方醒来。
author: kiwiarms
source: POKENAME appears in people's dreams as a beautiful maiden asking for shelter. If the dreamer falls for this ruse, it drains their life force until they wake up.

entry: POKENAME头发似有特殊防护力，能让POKENAME免受梦妖魔等宝可梦的诅咒与咒术影响。可一旦剪下，效果便迅速消退。
author: bobosmith01
source: The hair on POKENAME's head appears to have unusual protective properties that guard POKENAME from the effects of curses and spells from Pokémon such as Mismagius. If cut, the hair's properties quickly fade away.

entry: POKENAME大胆张扬，似乎很自豪于自己的外貌。它说的语言，连迷唇姐、长耳兔等宝可梦都听不懂。
author: bobosmith01
source: A daring and flamboyant Pokémon, POKENAME seems to take great pride in its appearance. It can speak in a language that Jynx, Lopunny, and other kinds of Pokémon do not understand.

entry: POKENAME大胆张扬，似乎很自豪于自己的外貌。它说的语言，连迷唇姐、长耳兔等宝可梦都听不懂。
author: bobosmith01
source: A daring and flamboyant Pokémon, POKENAME seems to take great pride in its appearance. It can speak in a language that Jynx, Lopunny, and other kinds of Pokémon do not understand.

entry: POKENAME大胆张扬，似乎很自豪于自己的外貌。它说的语言，连迷唇姐、长耳兔等宝可梦都听不懂。
author: bobosmith01
source: A daring and flamboyant Pokémon, POKENAME seems to take great pride in its appearance. It can speak in a language that Jynx, Lopunny, and other kinds of Pokémon do not understand.

entry: POKENAME随自己的振翅节奏在空中起舞。表演快得肉眼难以跟上，却也格外令人惊叹。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME dances in the air, to the rhythm of its own wingbeats. Its performance is so fast that it is hard for the eye to follow, but this only makes it more impressive.

entry: 科学家一度以为，借洛托姆附身电器的能力，POKENAME或许能帮助破解迷唇姐的神秘语言。可惜，它仍只会说难以理解的胡话。
author: bobosmith01
source: Some scientists once believed that, with the help of Rotom's ability to possess electronics, POKENAME may have allowed further study into Jynx's mysterious language. Unfortunately, POKENAME still only communicates with verbal gibberish.

entry: POKENAME谜团重重。已知的是，服装耐得住酷寒，每逢满月与新月都会载歌载舞，而POKENAME坚定的自信，也让它成为热门体育吉祥物。
author: bear_qo.op
source: The mysteries of POKENAME are many, but what we know is that its suits are made to handle freezing temperatures, it sings and dances on every full and new moon, and POKENAME's unshakeable confidence has led to it being a popular sports mascot.

entry: POKENAME把冰网吐到猎物脚下，逼它们为活命不停跳舞，借此取乐。等猎物终究失败，便先放电，再唱着嘲弄的歌，最后吞食。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME toys with prey by forcing them to dance for their life as it spits out icy webs underneath their feet. When they ultimately fail, it shocks them with electricity and sings to them in a humiliating tone before finally devouring them.

entry: POKENAME把冰网吐到猎物脚下，逼它们为活命不停跳舞，借此取乐。等猎物终究失败，便先放电，自己又在冰上跳起嘲弄的舞，最后吞食。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME toys with prey by forcing them to dance for their life as it spits out icy webs underneath their feet. When they ultimately fail, it shocks them with electricity and does its own taunting dance on the ice before finally devouring them.

entry: POKENAME在黑暗中起舞，制造诡光，引来其他生物。等对方靠近，便吸取体热维生，使其浑身冰冷。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME dances in the darkness to create an eerie light that draws others in. Once they roam close to it, it siphons their body heat for sustenance, leaving them freezing cold.

entry: POKENAME的獠牙冰冷坚实，强韧得连钢铁也能撕开。它跳舞时，总会得意地展示獠牙。
author: violet_zero
source: POKENAME has icy cold tusks that are solid and strong enough to tear through steel. It shows these tusks off proudly as it dances.

entry: POKENAME很懂得打理外表，花上数小时梳理多条尾巴，还会烧灼尾毛，使其整洁光亮。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a keen understanding of the need to maintain their appearance. They spend hours grooming their many tails and burn their tail fur to give a clean, glossy finish.
