entry: POKENAME换毛时，毛发会变得黑而如皮革。它将蜕下的毛织成手袋般的东西，装食物和宝物。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: When POKENAME molts, its fur turns black and leathery. It weaves the shed fur into something resembling a purse, which it stores food and treasure in.

entry: POKENAME姿态端庄、皮毛洁净，自有一股华贵气势。为了尽显王者风范，它会花上数小时打磨举止与仪容。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have an opulent presence that comes from their refined posture and clean coat of fur. They spend hours perfecting their movements and appearance to appear as regal as possible.

entry: 听见POKENAME嘹亮如歌剧的歌声，便知道自己能走出曲折密林。POKENAME常在空旷处歌唱，或对着同伴，或就在聚落附近。
author: beatdoof
source: A sure way to know if one is able to get out of a winding forest is to hear POKENAME's loud, opera-like singing. POKENAME often sings out in an open space, either to a crowd of fellow Pokémon or near any settlements.

entry: POKENAME乐于为别人跳舞，最爱有人观看轻快蹦跳的表演。凡看到最后的观众，不管愿不愿意，都会得到一个大大的吻。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME cheerfully dances for others, loving having an audience to its bouncy movements. Anyone who watches a performance all the way to the end is rewarded with a big kiss, whether they want it or not.

entry: POKENAME腼腆又在意别人的眼光，却极其亲人。只要真心关爱，它就会信任你，至死不改。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME is bashful and self-conscious, but extremely affectionate. Shown genuine love and care, it will trust you to the grave.

entry: 厚厚的冰晶壳，包着POKENAME敏感的身体。被触摸时，POKENAME会进一步降低壳温自卫，造成严重冻伤。
author: sk372
source: A thick shell of crystalized ice covers POKENAME's sensitive body. POKENAME drops the temperature of its shell further as a defense mechanism when touched, causing severe cases of frostbite.

entry: 虽然亲人，却极为害羞，也很有保护欲。生气时朝敌人尖叫，高兴时则吹口哨。
author: rockageddon
source: While affectionate, these Pokémon are incredibly shy and protective. When angry they will scream at opponents, but when they are happy they will whistle instead.

entry: POKENAME虽虚荣得厉害，仍凭美貌深受欢迎。有些富裕名流，甚至成打饲养。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Though hideously vain, POKENAME is nonetheless popular for its beauty. Wealthy celebrities have been known to own them by the dozen.

entry: POKENAME踏步走过冰封洞穴，尤其偏爱清澈水面或晶簇密布的地方，方便欣赏自己美丽的倒影。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stomps around frozen cavernous areas, particularly those heavy with pristine bodies of water or crystal growths. It prefers these areas as they provide surfaces for it to enjoy gazing at its beautiful reflection.

entry: POKENAME一遇到树果丛，就兴奋得发颤。每吃一颗前，都要轻柔地亲吻，仿佛在细细品味这一刻。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME shivers excitedly when it stumbles upon a berry bush. Before eating each berry, it kisses it delicately, as if savoring the moment.

entry: POKENAME冷得惊人，几乎不离开冰穴。若有来客，它会先送上一记恶魔之吻，随即将对方整个吞下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is so intensely cold that it rarely leaves its frozen cave. If an intruder enters, it greets them with a Lovely Kiss - right before devouring them whole.

entry: POKENAME翱翔暴风雪，寻找迷路旅人掳走。诡异歌声如同歌剧，仿佛正面对观众演唱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME soar through blizzards searching for lost travelers to kidnap. Their eerie song resembles opera music, as though they were singing in front of an audience.

entry: 风吹过树间，POKENAME便越摇越起劲，最后竟跳起一支古怪而迷人的舞。
author: hophoppip
source: As the wind blows through the trees, POKENAME sways more and more until it breaks out into an oddly mesmerizing dance.

entry: POKENAME的叶子由极细的发丝状纤维组成，得不断护理才能保持良好状态。大姐姐们很喜欢它，也会努力模仿它的外貌。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME leaves are formed of very fine, hair-like strands that require constant maintenance to keep in good condition. They are popular Pokémon with Beauties who will strive to emulate their appearance.

entry: POKENAME发出的超声波，只需听上几分钟就能使人恍惚。方圆1公里内，所有人都会觉得身体与思绪，仿佛正慢慢化为虚无。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME can emit ultrasounds that can make anyone fall into a trance for a few minutes of hearing them. Within a 1km radius, everyone will start to feel as if their bodies and thoughts slowly vanish into nothingness.

entry: POKENAME的黏液触感并不冰冷，制冷能力却极强，因此有人研究用它冷却汽车引擎和游戏显卡。它还经常亲亲抱抱，沾得训练家满身黏液。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME's sticky goo isn't cold to the touch, but is so freezing that it's being explored as an alternative to refrigerate car engines and gaming GPUs. It regularly tends to cover its Trainer in gooey kisses and hugs.

entry: POKENAME出了名地难伺候，脾气也不好。可对小个子宝可梦，却格外心软，常抱着它们四处走。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME is infamous for being high maintenance and having an unpleasant personality.  However, it has a soft spot for smaller Pokémon and will frequently carry them around.

entry: POKENAME出了名地难伺候，脾气也不好。可对小个子宝可梦，却格外心软，常抱着它们四处走。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME is infamous for being high maintenance and having an unpleasant personality.  However, it has a soft spot for smaller Pokémon and will frequently carry them around.

entry: POKENAME看似头发的部分，其实是根须般的触手，能从远处缠住目标。缠紧后，POKENAME便吐气攻击，吐息既有毒，也足以将整个人冻成冰块。
author: sk372
source: What appears to be POKENAME's hair are actually root-like tendrils it uses to ensnare victims from afar. Once constricted, they are subjected to POKENAME's breath, which is both toxic and capable of freezing a person solid.

entry: POKENAME见到活物，就会粗暴地抱个没完、亲个不停。判断敌友的唯一标准，竟是对方还在不在呼吸。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME's reaction to any living creature it finds is to brutally overload it with hugs and kisses. The only distinction it makes between friend and foe is to check if they're still breathing.

entry: POKENAME皮肤很快就会干燥，因此不停找水滋润自己。还会冻些水，留待之后像乳液一样涂抹。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME's skin dries out quickly, which is why it is constantly looking for water to moisturize itself. It also freezes some to apply it later as lotion.

entry: POKENAME能将冰刺长至数米，贯穿对手。危急时，还能取下冰帽当盾牌。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can grow its ice spikes to a length of several meters to impale its opponents. It can use its detachable ice hat as a shield in a pinch.

entry: POKENAME全身细如发丝的菌丝能长得极长，只有受损才会脱落。研究者曾发现，一只身后拖着的菌丝，竟已超过60英尺。
author: .izik
source: The thin, hair-like mycelium covering POKENAME's body can grow to great lengths and only sheds if damaged. Some researchers have found mycelium trailing behind one that had grown over 60 feet in length.

entry: POKENAME颈后长着浓密金发，散出强烈寒气。它在雪中优雅旋转，唱着听不懂的歌，回荡于冰封山谷。
author: .izik
source: The thick blonde hair growing from behind POKENAME's neck radiates an intense cold. It twirls gracefully in the snow, singing an unintelligible song that echoes through frozen valleys.

entry: POKENAME会在午夜起舞，磨炼利爪。它们不知怎么，竟能说一种只有自己训练家才懂的秘语。
author: houndrys.
source: POKENAME hone their claws by dancing during midnight. They somehow speak in a secretive language that only their Trainer can understand.

entry: POKENAME歌声悦耳、舞姿优美，是一些乐团的常见成员。可也很会耍大牌，金发没梳整齐，就不肯登台。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are a common feature with certain musical performance groups due to their delightful singing abilities and their elegant dancing. They are, however, very diva-like and will also refuse to perform until their golden hair is neatly groomed.

entry: POKENAME跳跃旋转，舞步带起阵阵冷雪风。观众不由自主地跟着起舞，追随POKENAME优雅的动作，连寒气也不在意。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's dance casts cool snowy gusts around it as it leaps and twirls. Viewers are compelled to join in the dance, unbothered by the cold air as they follow POKENAME's graceful movements.

entry: POKENAME飞过空中，留下闪亮霜迹。见过它飞行的人都说，下一觉会梦见自己过着极其华美奢侈的生活。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME leaves behind a shimmering trail of frost as it flies through the air. Those who have seen it in flight report their next sleep being filled with dreams of living in excessive luxury and beauty.

entry: POKENAME体色奇特，许多交手的水属性宝可梦误以为它属火，因而过分自信。等发觉POKENAME其实是冰与草属性，往往已太迟。
author: epping_forest
source: Because of their peculiar pigmentation, many Water-type Pokémon that they face thinks POKENAME is a Fire-type. This makes them act overconfident before realizing too late the truth about POKENAME's Ice/Grass typing.

entry: POKENAME聪明绝顶，走在冬日街头，混入人群，将法杖藏在小型异空间。受威胁时，法杖瞬间现身，它便使出暴风雪，掩护逃走。
author: ghostslythe
source: Hyper intelligent, POKENAME walk wintery streets, blending into the crowd with their stave hidden in a pocket dimension. When threatened, the stave reappears instantaneously and it uses Blizzard to cover its escape.

entry: POKENAME身体遇热就容易干燥，因此爱找水或积雪懒躺着。同类似乎用一串蛙鸣暗语交流，连呱头蛙也听不懂。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's body dries quickly in the heat, so it seeks out water and snow to laze in. It appears to communicate with its own kind through a coded language: a series of croaks that not even a Frogadier can understand.

entry: POKENAME脚步轻快，很难找到它自然留下的清晰脚印。身手灵巧、善于腾挪，连冰封峭壁也能迅速攀上。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's gait is so quick and light that finding a naturally-made and distinct footprint proves difficult. Acrobatic and adept at maneuvering, it can climb and quickly scale frozen-over cliffsides.

entry: POKENAME缓缓而优雅地走动，脑袋左右摇摆。壳中，不断冒出闪亮霜雾。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME walks slowly and gracefully, swaying its head from side to side. Its shell constantly emits sparkling clouds of frost.

entry: 看似头发的部分，其实是细细刨冰。若被POKENAME亲吻，接触处就会发青、冻伤。
author: lampent12
source: What looks like hair is actually finely shaved ice. If you receive a kiss from POKENAME, the point of contact will be blue and frostbitten.

entry: POKENAME在市区跳节奏鲜明的舞，用宽松皮肤模仿裙摆飘动。深情歌声之间，却会突然来记凶猛头槌，把不守规矩的观众赶远。
author: willowwhisker_98658
source: POKENAME performs rhythmic dances in urban areas, using its baggy skin to mimic the flow of a dress. Its soulful singing is punctuated by sudden, aggressive headbutts to keep unruly crowds at a distance.

entry: POKENAME栖居冰穴，会破开冻岩跳出，迎接入侵者。猝不及防的一吻，便能让人立刻沉睡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME inhabits icy caverns and bursts from frozen stone to greet intruders. Its sudden kiss can instantly induce deep sleep.

entry: POKENAME钻过泥土与积雪觅食。谁若喂上一口，它们就会连连亲吻，表达感谢。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME burrow through dirt and snow in search for food to eat. Anyone who gives them a bite to eat are peppered with kisses as a sign of gratitude.

entry: POKENAME住在高山洞穴，厚厚金毛能在寒地保暖。它们独来独往，会驱逐来客，可飞奔追赶时，脸上竟始终冷静得令人发毛。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found making their homes high in mountain caves, their thick golden fur keeping them warm in the cold environment. They are solitary Pokémon and chase intruders away, their expression remaining eerily neutral as they race forward.

entry: 为了守护领地，POKENAME将叫声融入独特战舞。据说，这舞是从古老文化中学来的。
author: houndrys.
source: To defend their territory, POKENAME perform a unique war dance that incorporates its cries. It is believed that it learned this from ancient cultures.

entry: POKENAME浓密秀美的金色长发，令人争相追求。它还能让发间的冷热，维持完美平衡。
author: t.i.a.
source: The luscious, golden locks of a POKENAME are highly coveted. It can perfectly keep heat and cold balanced within them.

entry: POKENAME是冠军级摔跤高手，深受空手道王与武术家欢迎，既是好陪练，也是对战首选。低体温能迅速带走肌肉热量，让它保持活力。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Champion-level wrestlers, POKENAME are popular with black belts and martial artists both as sparring partners and as a first choice for Pokémon battles. Their low body temperatures help them stay physically active by rapidly dissipating muscle heat.

entry: 寒冷北地流传着许多POKENAME的故事，将其描绘成久经沙场、战姿如舞的勇士。直到今天，仍有新歌与演出传述这些事迹。
author: sk372
source: Colder northern regions have many stories depicting POKENAME as battle-hardened warriors that fought with a dance-like grace. Many songs and shows are still being produced today to tell their tales.

entry: POKENAME善于迅速扭动身体，闪避攻击、迷惑天敌。不过POKENAME闻着苦、尝着也苦，天敌通常本就不愿靠近。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are very adept and swiftly moving their body to dodge attacks and to confuse predators. POKENAME smells and tastes bitter, so it's often avoided by predators anyway.

entry: POKENAME吊在树上左右摆动，以催眠之力引小宝可梦靠近。进入范围后，便从嘴里吐出冰冷酸液，让猎物灼伤、中毒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME dangles from trees and shakes side to side, emitting a hypnotic effect that compels small Pokémon to come closer. Once in range, it belches up a cold, acidic mixture from its mouth that burns and poisons its prey.

entry: POKENAME从双手释放侵蚀活组织的剧毒。可有时会忘记手上沾毒，转头就去拥抱训练家。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME releases a virulent poison through its hands that eats away at living tissue. Sometimes it forgets that its hands are coated with poison and ends up hugging its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME常让宝可梦权益保护人士虚惊一场。许多人见它的外貌，就以为它曾遭到不当的化妆品试验。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME has caused many false alarms among Pokémon rights activists. Its appearance has convinced many people it was used unethically to test cosmetics.

entry: POKENAME长长的金发，无风也会飘扬。它用超能力让发丝扬得格外有气势，自认这样更美。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's long blonde hair flows majestically in the air, even without wind. It uses its psychic abilities to make it billow dramatically, believing it enhances its beauty.

entry: POKENAME能冻结脚下水面，在水上奔跑。可冰上刹不住，因此只肯跑直线。
author: rockageddon
source: POKENAME is capable of running over bodies of water by freezing the area underneath its feet. As a result of being unable to brake on ice, POKENAME will only run in straight lines.

entry: POKENAME在冰上优雅舞动，轻哼柔和曲调。水手一靠近，它便猛然停下，试图把人拖进冰冷水下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hums a soft tune while performing an elegant dance on the ice. If a sailor approaches, it stops abruptly and attempts to drag them beneath the freezing waters.

entry: POKENAME优雅地躺在冰山上，大声哼唱，诱引过路水手。船若靠得太近，便用冰砾击沉，确保下一顿到手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lounges elegantly on icebergs, humming loudly to lure passing sailors. If a ship comes too close, it fires Ice Shards to sink the vessel, ensuring its next meal.

entry: POKENAME极为自傲，觉得一身污泥美不胜收，还想把美分享出去。于是向别人甩泥，把对方也裹得和自己一样漂亮。
author: sk372
source: Being very prideful, POKENAME thinks of its sludgy exterior as truly beautiful, and wishes to share that beauty with others. It flings its goop at others to coat them with it and thus, make them as lovely as it is.

entry: POKENAME光彩照人，很受大姐姐欢迎，训练家也努力模仿它的外貌。它能以属性之力制造绚丽表演，让冰晶在空中划出轨迹。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular with Beauties; their appearance is dazzling and something that their Trainers strive to emulate. They can create glittering displays with their elemental powers, ice crystals tracing through the air.

entry: POKENAME防备心很强，极少探出坚不可破的壳。可有时能见它按着节奏，迅速游过水中。
author: houndrys.
source: Being quite defensive, POKENAME are rarely seen out of their adamantine shell. However, they can be seen swiftly swimming in rhythmic patterns.

entry: POKENAME性情冰冷，令水手畏惧，在寒水中漂游。只要对珍珠说话，就能射出并操纵坚硬冰刺。
author: houndrys.
source: Feared for its icy demeanor by sailors, POKENAME drifts away in cold waters. By speaking to its pearl, it can shoot and control hard, freezing spikes.

entry: POKENAME周围裹着寒气，吸入后会使行为失常。静止时，POKENAME也总古怪地重复前后摆动。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is surrounded by a chilly gas that causes erratic behavior if inhaled. When still, POKENAME undulates back and forth in an odd and repetitive motion.

entry: 被咯咯笑的POKENAME亲到，体温就会开始降低。据说见到POKENAME，便会招来厄运。
author: bobosmith01
source: Those kissed by a giggling POKENAME have their body temperature begin to drop. Seeing POKENAME is said to be bad luck.

entry: POKENAME按节奏横行，钳子彼此敲击，为自己的舞蹈打拍。附近大钳蟹见了，也忍不住加入合奏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is often seen scuttling about in a rhythmic fashion, clicking its claws together to make the beat for its dance. Nearby Krabby that witness it feel compelled to join in the chorus.

entry: POKENAME爱在海滩偷饰品，再拿来作道具，逗其他宝可梦开心。
author: lemmymaster
source: POKENAME love to steal accessories on beachy areas. They use these as props to entertain other Pokémon.

entry: 它将尾巴插入发电机或其他电器，尽量吸取能量。电力全存进背上的种子，POKENAME需要自卫时便会动用。
author: fiordaliso
source: It sticks its tail into generators or other electronic devices to absorb as much energy as possible. All the electricity it gathers is stored inside the bulb on its back, which POKENAME uses whenever it needs to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME把尾巴插进插座，为身体充电。若吸得太多，可能导致大片地区停电。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME plugs its tail into outlets to charge its body with electricity. If it absorbs too much, it risks causing widespread blackouts.

entry: POKENAME不断滚动，积起庞大电力。达到极限后，便以猛烈爆炸释放能量。
author: .izik
source: By rolling continuously, POKENAME builds up an immense electrical charge. Once it reaches its limit, it releases the energy in a powerful explosion.

entry: POKENAME自古便以学得快、遇事可靠而闻名。为了让攻击更有威力，POKENAME会摩擦双手，积蓄静电。
author: bobosmith01
source: Historically, POKENAME has been noted for its swift ability to learn and its reliability in all kinds of situations. To give its attacks an extra punch of power, POKENAME rubs its hands together and allows static charge to build up.

entry: POKENAME自古便以学得快、遇事可靠而闻名。为了让攻击更有威力，POKENAME会摩擦双手，积蓄静电。
author: bobosmith01
source: Historically, POKENAME has been noted for its swift ability to learn and its reliability in all kinds of situations. To give its attacks an extra punch of power, POKENAME rubs its hands together and allows static charge to build up.

entry: 只要足够专注，POKENAME就能用电力凝出拳头等肢体。它性情好斗，经常借此殴打别人，逼其服从。
author: sk372
source: If it concentrates hard enough, POKENAME can generate electricity in the form of limbs such as fists. With an aggressive temperament, it does this often in order to beat others into submission.

entry: POKENAME在半空快速震动，激起体内更多电能。它还能短暂凝出雷电之拳，猛烈电击敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rapidly vibrates its body in midair to stoke more electrical energy from within its body. It can temporarily form fists made of lightning to deliver powerful electric punches to its foes.

entry: 雷雨来时，成群的POKENAME会聚在山坡，比赛争夺让雷劈中的资格。
author: melodydelune
source: Herds of POKENAME will gather on mountainsides during thunderstorms. They compete to determine who will be allowed to get struck by lightning.

entry: POKENAME穿行各地，寻找某样东西，究竟是什么仍是谜。据说一旦找到，控电本领便会大为精进！
author: skleegamer
source: POKENAME moves across the regions searching for something. What it is searching for remains a mystery, but it is said that once it finds it, its electrical capabilities become highly advanced!

entry: 被归为雄性的POKENAME，体内电力的表现不同。鳞片有时会迅速短暂变色，从黄色转成绿、蓝，甚至紫色。
author: bobosmith01
source: The electrical energy running through POKENAME's body expresses itself differently in those classified as male. It affects their scales to the point that they may quickly and temporarily change color from yellow to green, blue, or even purple.

entry: POKENAME这一生命阶段，最重要的是繁衍后代。产下蛋后，被归为雄性的个体守蛋，雌性则外出觅食。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's main priority at this stage of life revolves around creating offspring. After the Eggs have been laid, those classified as male protect the Eggs, while females gather food during this time.

entry: 它极其聪明，却更加自负。常在摆弄电器，筹备疯狂计划，要催眠其他宝可梦，收作自己的爪牙。
author: mistymagius
source: A highly intelligent Pokémon with an even bigger ego. It can be seen tinkering with electronic devices for its mad plan to hypnotize other Pokémon into being its henchmen.

entry: POKENAME自负得从不肯认错。惹恼它的弱小宝可梦，常会挨电击；可一碰上更强的对手，立刻就哑了火。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME has an enormous ego that prevents it from ever admitting its own faults. It usually zaps any weaker Pokémon that annoy it, but its spark disappears the moment it faces a stronger opponent.

entry: POKENAME给双镰充电，挥出强劲斩击，让敌人陷入劣势。再高速跳跃于枝头，利用动能为身体补电。
author: fiordaliso
source: It charges its dual scythes with electricity to execute powerful slashes capable of putting its opponents at a disadvantage. POKENAME leaps from branch to branch at high speed to recharge its body using kinetic energy.

entry: POKENAME张扬不羁，到哪儿都不肯示弱。不管游泳、攀爬还是战斗，什么挑战都敢豪气应下。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has a wild personality and asserts itself wherever it goes. It will take on any challenge with bravado, from swimming to climbing to battling.

entry: POKENAME走路时，身体会狂乱地按节奏摆动，看得人心慌。就连最出色的舞者，也曾因模仿它而受伤。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME walk doing frenetic rhythmic movements that are very unnerving to see. Even the most skilled dancers have gotten injured trying to imitate them.

entry: POKENAME会在雷雨中高高跃出水面，据说被雷劈中便能进化。可有次实际观察时，它只是电力过载，昏了过去。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME jump high out of the water during thunderstorms, and it is said that they will evolve if hit by lightning. However, on one occasion when an POKENAME was observed being struck, it merely fainted from the electrical overload.

entry: POKENAME通常只在雷暴时浮上湖面。风暴若结束，却没挨到雷，POKENAME就会闯进最近的发电厂，找高压电，造成严重破坏。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME usually only rises above the surface of lakes during thunderstorms. If the storm ends without POKENAME being struck by lightning, it will break into the nearest powerplant and cause great damage in its search for high-voltage electricity.

entry: 雷雨时，POKENAME会爬上能到达的最高处引雷。若真被击中，便发出雷鸣般响亮的得胜欢呼。
author: sk372
source: During thunderstorms, POKENAME climbs to the tallest spot it can in order to attract lightning to strike it. If it does, it lets out a booming cry of triumph as loud as thunder.

entry: POKENAME奔跑时，锐利毛发间电流噼啪作响。火花从身体迸出，在地面留下静电轨迹。
author: ambrosia04
source: Electricity constantly crackles through POKENAME's sharp fur when it runs, sparks bursting from its body and leaving trails of static energy in the ground.

entry: POKENAME控电本领太强，过去曾被误当成闪电鸟的变种或进化型，这说法后来已被推翻。它们藏在雷雨云里，将周围水汽冻成冰雹落下。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME were thought to be a variant or evolution of Zapdos in the past due to their intense control over electricity, which has since been disproven. They hide within storm clouds, freezing the water vapor around them until it falls as hail.

entry: 研究这种稀有宝可梦的尝试屡屡失败，因为周围数公里的电器全会停摆。POKENAME体内庞大静电，还能让它悬浮。
author: milchik
source: Many attempts to research this rare Pokémon have failed due to it shutting all electrical appliances down in a radius of several kilometers. The sheer amount of static electricity POKENAME stores in its body allows it to levitate.

entry: POKENAME对自身电力的掌控分毫不差，再以高超超能力，确保每道射出的闪电都命中目标。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has complete and perfect control over its own electricity. It uses advanced psychic powers to ensure that every bolt of lightning it fires hits its target.

entry: POKENAME能将庞大电力导入利爪。带电肢体挥出的力道极强，光是挥动，就会响起雷霆般轰鸣。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can channel massive amounts of electricity into its claws. Swipes from these electrified limbs are so powerful, the swing itself creates a thunderous boom.

entry: POKENAME虽小，产生的电流却十分惊人。它们难以调节力量，烦躁或难过时，常会不小心迸出火花。
author: ambrosia04
source: Despite their small size, POKENAME generate immense electrical currents. They struggle to regulate this power, often releasing accidental sparks whenever they become irritable or upset.

entry: 雨后若停电，多半是一群POKENAME把附近发电厂的电吃光了。它们用吸来的能量跳舞，庆祝太阳重新出现。
author: darkweavile428
source: If there's a blackout after a rainy day, there's a good chance that a group of POKENAME have eaten all of the electricity at the nearby power plant. They use the energy gained from the electricity to dance in celebration of the sun's return.

entry: POKENAME橡胶般的身体能隔住电流，游泳时保护旁人。可成群后，会向水中放电捕猎，破坏渔村赖以生存的生态，十分危险。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's rubbery body insulates its electric charge to protect others while it swims. Groups of POKENAME are dangerous for fishing villages since they hunt by discharging electricity into the water, devastating ecosystems the fishers rely on.

entry: POKENAME见到够得着的电器，就鲁莽啃咬，直到坏掉。战斗时会炸起毛，显得更大，迸出阵阵静电。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME gnaws recklessly on any electronic device within reach until it is destroyed. When it battles, it puffs up its fur to appear larger, crackling with bursts of electrostatic energy.

entry: POKENAME皮肤上电流噼啪作响，跳向附近想伤害它的对象。训练家会涂泥减弱电力，而POKENAME似乎还很享受。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Electricity crackles on POKENAME's skin and jumps to anything nearby that tries to harm it. Trainers coat it in mud to dampen the charge, which POKENAME seems to enjoy.

entry: POKENAME皮肤上电流噼啪作响，跳向附近想伤害它的对象。亲代会给幼崽裹泥，减轻声响，免得引来不必要的注意。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Electricity crackles on POKENAME's skin and jumps to anything nearby that tries to harm it. Parents cover their young in mud to prevent them from attracting unwanted attention, dampening the sound.

entry: 它将尾巴插入发电机或其他电器，尽量吸取能量。电力全存进背上的种子，POKENAME需要自卫时便会动用。
author: fiordaliso
source: It sticks its tail into generators or other electronic devices to absorb as much energy as possible. All the electricity it gathers is stored inside the bulb on its back, which POKENAME uses whenever it needs to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME天生会发电，很受在发电机旁工作的电气工程师欢迎。发电时，背上花苞亮起，是电厂不可多得的帮手。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular Pokémon amongst electrical engineers working around generators thanks to their innate ability to create electricity. The bulb on their back lights up as they create electricity and they are invaluable Pokémon for power plants.

entry: POKENAME吃电器为身体充电，再将电力导入牙齿。一口咬下，就能使出威力惊人的雷电牙。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME eat electronics to charge their bodies, channeling the electricity into their teeth. With a single bite, they can unleash a devastating Thunder Fang.

entry: 必要时，POKENAME的两颗头，都会上阵战斗。火与电招式并用，能应对多种宝可梦。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's two heads both battle if necessary. They use both Fire and Electric moves to counter many Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME受持续的能量吸引，常钻到发电厂深处，有时还会弄断重要电缆。可POKENAME残留的电力太强，竟足以撑住电厂运转，直到完成维修。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: POKENAME often burrow deep beneath power plants, attracted to their constant energy. They sometimes sever important cables, but POKENAME's own residual charge is so strong, the power plants can remain running long enough to make repairs.

entry: POKENAME转动身体各节，激起内部电能。转得够快，周围便形成电力屏障，自动电击所有靠得太近的东西。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rotates segments of its body to churn up the electrical energy within itself. Rotating fast enough will create a force field of electricity around itself that automatically zaps anything that draws too close.

entry: 长角是天然避雷针，常缠着电流。POKENAME的雷电拳，往往能贯穿坚岩，还将拳头周围的岩边烧焦。
author: infinex21
source: Their long horns serve as natural lightning rods and are often clad in electrical currents. A Thunder Punch from an POKENAME is often strong enough to punch through solid rock and char the edges around its fist.

entry: POKENAME以电为食，将多余能量存在壳里，成为活电池。易停电的地区，会将POKENAME安置为移动电站。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME eats electricity and stores excess energy in its shell, becoming a living battery. Areas prone to blackouts host POKENAME as a portable power station.

entry: POKENAME栖在雷雨频繁之处的高处，以喙作避雷针，补充体内电力。过于热切的训练家，常误把它当作野生闪电鸟。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME perches high up within areas where thunderstorms are common, using its beak as a lightning rod to recharge its internal electricity. Overzealous Trainers often mistake it for being a wild Zapdos.

entry: POKENAME奔驰时会发出嗡鸣，越快就越响。鹿角还能射出闪电，驱退威胁。
author: .izik
source: While galloping, POKENAME produces a buzzing noise that grows louder with its speed. It unleashes bolts of lightning from its antlers to ward off threats.

entry: POKENAME常在发电厂附近，以头撑地旋转，吸食电力。充满后能在停电时为住家供电，可停电往往也正是它引起的。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME is often spotted around power plants, spinning on its head to feed on the electricity. When it is fully charged, it can power homes during blackouts; however, it is often the cause of them.

entry: 给POKENAME挤奶时，必须让它完全平静，否则奶会带上危险电流。即使平静，乳汁也仍有微弱电能，喝下能稍稍提神。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME must be absolutely calm when being milked, or its milk will be dangerously electrified. Even then, faint electric energy is contained within the liquid, giving it a mild energizing effect.

entry: 它们一心冲向附近发电厂，沿途狂暴奔行，重塑地貌。若未在吸尽电厂电力前拦住，POKENAME就会化作游走天灾，向来不及逃走者放出巨雷。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: They reshape the landscape in singleminded rampages toward nearby power plants. If not stopped before consuming a plant's electricity, POKENAME become roving cataclysms, discharging colossal lightning bolts into anyone too slow to flee the area.

entry: POKENAME翱翔天际，身后召来风暴，定期释放足以撕碎船只的超强闪电。好在会避开近旁目标，多数水生宝可梦得以免遭雷击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME soar through the sky, conjuring storms in their wake. They periodically unleash electrical energy through super-charged lightning bolts capable of tearing ships apart. Fortunately for most aquatic Pokémon, they avoid smiting those nearby.

entry: POKENAME出了名地脾气坏，谁靠近就电谁。想哄它平静，最简单就是送上一块宝芬。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is notoriously grumpy and shocks anyone who comes too close. Offering it a Poffin is the easiest way to calm it down.

entry: POKENAME双腿太小，不便行走，改用强壮双臂撑地前进。战斗时手臂忙着走路，就把带电尾巴猛砸地面，震出令人昏眩的冲击波。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's legs are too small for it to move effectively, so it walks around on its muscular arms. While its arms are preoccupied with movement, it slams its electrically charged tail into the ground in battle, creating stunning shockwaves.

entry: POKENAME最多聚居大城市郊外，荡在输电线间。谁一靠近，就窜进附近仅有的草木中。平时虽开朗，却不爱被训斥。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME dwell most populously in the outskirts of major cities, swinging from power lines. They dash away into whatever little nature is around if approached; although generally cheerful, they dislike being scolded.

entry: POKENAME贪婪吞食电力，可吃得太多，又很难排出去。全身皮毛，始终噼啪带着静电。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME ravenously devours electricity, but has no easy way to discharge it if it eats too much. Its fur constantly crackles with static electricity.

entry: POKENAME体内始终蓄着庞大电力，移动速度可达20马赫。走投无路时，还能引发巨大的能量爆发。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME has a massive constant charge within its body, allowing it to move at Mach 20. When cornered, it can produce a giant blast of energy.

entry: 风暴中，POKENAME掘地穿行，寻找高处，盼着挨雷击。它们蜷身自卫，原地旋转时，还会朝周围射出闪电。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME will dig through terrain to reach higher spots during storms in hopes of being struck by lightning. They curl up for defense and when they spin in place, they release electrical bolts around them.

entry: 大腿肌肉发达，带来惊人的爆发力与敏捷性。成群POKENAME会在风暴中争着挨雷，为头顶补电。
author: lj_breeze
source: Its highly developed thigh muscles provide explosive agility. Gangs of POKENAME compete during storms to be struck by lightning to recharge the bolt on their heads.

entry: POKENAME性情泼辣，尤其护着名声。若觉得自己或朋友受辱，就会不停怒斥，以带电双拳威胁对方，直到其为侮辱赔罪。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very feisty and particularly defensive about its reputation. If it feels it or a friend has been slighted, it will angrily rant and threaten the perpetrator with electrified fists until they've atoned for the insult.

entry: POKENAME平时伪装本领不强。雷暴一来，却甚至可能比变隐龙还逼真。它放出的电光，也会随天气变色。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's ability to camouflage is weak until a thunderstorm is in the area. In that case, these abilities can be arguably more convincing than Kecleon. The color of its electricity varies with the weather.

entry: POKENAME将水坝筑得高大坚固，能耐风暴。风暴来时，POKENAME便爬到坝顶，等着被雷劈。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME builds up towering, sturdy dams meant to reach high and withstand stormy weather. During the storms POKENAME climbs atop its dam and seeks to be struck by lightning.

entry: POKENAME常出没电厂，钻进发电机与电缆吃电。大群滋生可能造成停电，而电一断，它们又会一起逃走。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME frequent power plants, entering generators and cables to feed off the electricity. Large infestations of these Pokémon have been known to cause blackouts, fleeing en masse once the power's been cut.

entry: POKENAME的许多倒刺全都带电，能同时放出强劲的一击。
author: t3isukone
source: The many barbs on an POKENAME are all charged with electricity. They all discharge as one in a powerful shock.

entry: POKENAME聚居在避雷针周围，汲取自然电力。彼此连接巨颚可增强电能，十只以上的群体，能为大城供电一周。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live in groups around lightning rods to gain natural power. They link their jaws together to amplify their electrical power. A group of ten or more POKENAME can produce enough electricity to power a large city for a week.

entry: 据说，若有POKENAME开始尾随你，不久之后，你就注定会遭雷劈。
author: staghorn
source: It is said that if an POKENAME starts following you, you are doomed to be struck by lightning in the near future.

entry: POKENAME夜里出没工厂，吸食机器电力，直到彻底耗空。吃饱时，周身便裹着噼啪作响的电光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME haunts factories at night, siphoning electricity from the machines until they're completely depleted. When fully gorged, a crackling aura of electric energy surrounds it.

entry: POKENAME给刀刃充电，斩开对手坚韧的防御。金属身体，也能挡住敌人使出的腐蚀酸液。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME charges its blades with electricity to slice through its opponent's tough defenses. Its metallic body protects it from corrosive acids that the opponent may use.

entry: POKENAME在沙漠制造巨大雷暴，趁混乱捕捉其中的生物，尤其常吃象征鸟与天蝎。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME creates large thunderstorms in deserts, capturing whatever is there during the mayhem. It often feasts on Sigilyph and Gligar.

entry: 它住在丛林，外貌虽凶，却只吃水果，还爱帮助别人。可性情和善，打起架来也一样危险。
author: kiwiarms
source: Though it looks fierce, this jungle-dwelling Pokémon only eats fruits and loves helping others. Its pleasant personality makes it no less dangerous in battle, however.

entry: 它们把触须当作电缆，吸取电力。暴风雨中，POKENAME常站上屋顶，充当避雷针。
author: melodydelune
source: They can use their feelers as cables to absorb electricity. POKENAME will often stand on rooftops and act like lightning rods during storms.

entry: POKENAME以电流刺激肌肉，增强表现。有的甚至会在风暴中跃向天空，试着踢闪电，拿来锻炼。
author: zeterzero
source: POKENAME enhance the performance of their muscles by stimulating them with electricity. Some have even been seen jumping into the sky during storms to try and kick lightning bolts as a form of training.

entry: POKENAME每次喷火，尾巴就会噼啪带电。它吃干草，为腹中火焰能量添燃料。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tails crackle with electricity whenever it breathes flames. It consumes dry grass to fuel the fiery energy in its belly.

entry: POKENAME裹身的黏液富含铜，因此更容易引雷。有报告发现，它会吸食海底电缆的电力，扰乱全球通信。
author: soup1900
source: The slime POKENAME covers itself with contains high concentrations of copper, causing lightning to be more attracted towards it. Reports have discovered it eating the electricity from underwater cables, disrupting global communications.

entry: POKENAME高速冲过雷雨云，羽间窜着偷来的电流。飞行途中会突袭输电线，扯走整条电缆，再化作一团火花消失。
author: potato_tub
source: Blasting through stormclouds at blistering speed, POKENAME's feathers crackle with stolen current. It raids power lines mid-flight, snatching up whole cables before vanishing in a blur of sparks.

entry: 它精力充沛，越跑越跳，能量就积得越多，身体也越来越热。热得过头时，就必须喷火或放电，排出能量。
author: bobosmith01
source: This Pokémon is full of energy; the more it runs and hops around, the more and more energy is built up, causing its body to grow hotter and hotter. When it grows too hot, it must release energy by expelling flame or electricity.

entry: POKENAME在林下草丛蹦跳，寻找能强身的腐烂树果。紧张时，会慌乱抖动条纹尾巴，触角也迸出电火花。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME hops around the undergrowth searching for rotting berries that can strengthen its body. When it gets nervous, it frantically shakes its striped tail and begins to emit electric sparks from its antennae.

entry: POKENAME掠过风暴天空，追逐雷电，抓取空中散落的电光。它喜欢得意地栖在输电线上，直到决定拿电线当零食。
author: potato_tub
source: POKENAME darts through stormy skies, chasing thunderbolts and snatching stray lightning from the air. It's drawn to power lines, where it perches proudly, until it decides to snack on them.

entry: POKENAME常吸食电厂电力，造成停电，只有彻底吃饱才肯停。电力也让招式更强，尤其是雷电牙。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME often causes blackouts by sapping electricity from power plants, only stopping when completely full. That electricity helps power up its moves, particularly its Thunder Fang.

entry: POKENAME是电厂常见的害兽。它们擅长电击，使鸟宝可梦很难控制其数量。
author: atlas3339098
source: POKENAME are a common pest at power plants. Their electric attacks make it difficult for bird Pokémon to keep the population under control.

entry: POKENAME喜爱潮湿暗夜，偶尔会成群发出亮光，一同起舞。性情开朗又会发光，有些船夫便借POKENAME照亮回岸的路。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME loves damp and dark nights. Rarely, many gather and dance whilst emitting a bright light. Due to its cheerful attitude and abilities, some boatmen use POKENAME to help light the way back to shore.

entry: POKENAME最擅长在风暴夜捕猎，借闪电间隙掩藏动作，迅速而无声地抓走猎物，再消失于上方雷雨云中。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hunts its best during stormy nights. It masks its movements between the flashes of lightning, snatching up prey quickly and quietly before vanishing back into the storm clouds above.

entry: POKENAME体内的绒毛互相摩擦，产生强大电力。双臂，还能直接射出闪电。
author: .izik
source: The fluff in POKENAME's body generates electricity as it rubs together, creating powerful charges. It can fire bolts of lightning directly from its arms.

entry: POKENAME跃起时，披风摩擦生电，噼啪迸出火花。落地声响又如雷鸣，震慑敌人。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME leaps, its cape generates static electricity, releasing crackling sparks. When it lands, the impact echoes like thunder, intimidating its foes.

entry: 背上的蘑菇，始终散出微弱电场，触角状构造附近有时更强。科学家推测，POKENAME用这些电脉冲交流。
author: imaginita
source: The mushroom on its back gives off a low-level electric field at all times, which is sometimes stronger near the antennae-like structures.  Scientists theorize that POKENAME use these electric pulses to communicate.

entry: POKENAME转臂越快，身体静电积得越多，毛也竖得越高。电力加上毛中毒素，让POKENAME的拳头能麻痹对手。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The faster POKENAME rotate their arms, the more static that builds up along their bodies and the more their fur stands on end. The combination of the gathered electricity and the toxins within their fur makes an POKENAME's punch paralyzing.

entry: POKENAME与其他狡猾宝可梦结成小团伙，在大城市袭掠。不忙着密谋时，成员又会为争夺支配地位内斗。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME forms small groups with other cunning Pokémon to carry out raids in large cities. When they are not plotting, the group members fight each other for dominance.

entry: POKENAME意志坚定，爱独自行动，想去哪就去哪，也不告诉别人。即使收服的POKENAME，雷雨时也可能径自出门，让不止一位训练家焦心不已。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is strong-willed and tries to act independently, going wherever it pleases without letting others know. Even a caught POKENAME may wander directly outside during a thunderstorm, which has caused more than one Trainer a lot of stress.

entry: POKENAME一钻出地面，就能召来闪电。电击强劲，足以同时放倒多个目标。
author: .izik
source: The moment POKENAME emerges from the ground, it can summon lightning strikes. These bolts are powerful enough to fell several targets at once.

entry: POKENAME只在雷雨时现身地面。三个头各自把连着的手臂或尾巴高举，争着成为被雷击中的那一个。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME only comes to the surface during thunderstorms. Its three heads each lift the arm or tail they are connected to high, trying to be the one that gets struck by lightning.

entry: POKENAME飞快转动双臂发电，流动的电流也刺激肌肉。POKENAME一暴怒，体内电力就胡乱放出，双拳朝四周一切乱打。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME rapidly spin their arms to generate electricity; these flowing electrical currents also stimulate their muscles. When POKENAME becomes enraged, its electricity discharges wildly from its body as it swings at everything with its fists.

entry: POKENAME挖出地下电线，啃咬线缆，为身体充电。这习惯，让它在市区成了常见麻烦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs up buried power lines to gnaw on the wires, charging its body with electricity. This behavior makes it a frequent nuisance in urban areas.

entry: 神话里的POKENAME，是披着雷电的凶兽，瞬间便能掠过大地。光是现身，空气就常噼啪作响，热得令人难忍。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME appeared in myths as a ferocious lightning-cloaked beast that dashed across the land in an instant. Its mere presence often makes the air crackle and become unbearably hot.

entry: POKENAME双手互碰，会迸出火花与闪光。短腿撑不住身体，因此更喜欢游泳。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce sparks and flashes from their hands when the two touch together. They prefer to swim because their stubby legs have a difficult time supporting their body.

entry: POKENAME不停活动，在体内发电，不知疲倦地甩臂充电。使出电击波时，电流会盘旋着袭去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME generate electricity within their body through constant movement, swinging their arms tirelessly to charge themselves up. When they launch a Shock Wave, their electricity strikes in a spiralling pattern.

entry: POKENAME不停活动，在体内发电，不知疲倦地甩臂充电。有时会在发电厂工作，靠持续动作，给发电机供电。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME generate electricity within their body through constant movement, swinging their arms tirelessly to charge themselves up. They are sometimes found working in power plants, powering up generators with their ceaseless motion.

entry: POKENAME能造出小片雷云，躺在上面，歇在空中。谁敢打扰它睡觉，就会挨上猛烈的雷击。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can create tiny storm clouds on which it can rest in the sky. Troublemakers who disturb its sleep are punished with powerful lightning bolts.

entry: POKENAME身上的黑色橡胶带，限制了放电量。若没有这些限制器，POKENAME可能让整座镇子停电。
author: teatedtiten
source: The black, rubbery bands on POKENAME's body limit the amount of electricity it can release. Without these limiters, an POKENAME could cause town-wide blackouts.

entry: POKENAME挥拳快如闪电，却不容易打到身后。敌人会抓住敏感的尾巴，以免挨揍。
author: teatedtiten
source: POKENAME has lightning-fast punches, but cannot easily hit opponents behind it. Enemies grab its sensitive tail to avoid getting pummeled.

entry: 一家电力公司开发了专用沙袋，能让POKENAME边出拳边发电。他们声称，只要训练足够，它就能为整座镇子供电。
author: teatedtiten
source: An electric company developed special punching bags which POKENAME can punch to generate electricity. They claim that with enough training, POKENAME could power a town with its energy.

entry: 雷暴一近，POKENAME便本能地想滚动。雨点抽打山坡时，常能见POKENAME轰然滚下，声势如伴行的怒雷。
author: pattybgoode
source: When a thunderstorm approaches, POKENAME become compelled by an instinct to roll. As rain pelts the mountainside, POKENAME are often seen barreling down the slope with a sound as furious as the thunder that accompanies them.

entry: 风暴中，POKENAME会寻找最高山峰或建筑，爬上去挨雷，以雷电为食。吸到电后，便纵身跃下，滚向低处山坡。
author: foolish_weasel
source: During storms POKENAME seeks out the highest peak or building and climbs it in order to be struck by lightning, on which it feeds. Afterwards it launches itself from the heights and rolls down to slopes below.

entry: POKENAME喜欢与同群伙伴一起，驰骋开阔原野。达到极速时，身后会拖着发光的等离子体火花。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy galloping through open fields alongside other members of their herd. They generate glowing sparks of plasma that trail behind them as they reach their top speed.

entry: POKENAME尾上电池每次迸出火花，都会疼得畏缩。若痛得格外厉害，就会懊恼地放出电流。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME winces in pain whenever the battery on its tail produces sparks. If these sparks become particularly painful, it unleashes a frustrated discharge of electricity.

entry: POKENAME准备攻击时会旋转磁铁，积蓄庞大电力。一记电击，就足以让一群人失去行动能力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rotates its magnets while preparing an attack, building up a massive charge. A single shock from it is strong enough to incapacitate a crowd.

entry: 鸠羽港附近的电厂，曾发现成群POKENAME扰乱供电。如今镇上电工会专门处理，避免停电。
author: .izik
source: Clusters of POKENAME were spotted disrupting power supplies at a plant near Hutber Port. The town's electricians now manage these incidents to avoid outages.

entry: 虽然不会飞，POKENAME却能制造冰做的落脚点，登上任何悬崖或树顶。它最喜欢占据能找到的最高处，用三重攻击狙击敌人。
author: rockageddon
source: While flightless, POKENAME can reach the top of any cliff or tree by creating a foothold made of ice. Its favorite strategy is to perch on the highest point it can find and snipe enemies with Tri-Attack.

entry: POKENAME壳内气压使水汽聚集，形成厚重带电的雷雨云。边缘金属炮管如避雷针，引导并增强POKENAME攻击时的力量。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The air pressure inside an POKENAME's shell causes moisture to collect and form into dense storm clouds charged with electricity. The metal cannons along the edge act as lightning rods, directing and amplifying POKENAME's power when it attacks.

entry: POKENAME先喷小火，将食物烧成灰再吃。角的燃烧温度达1500度，刺鼻烟雾先警告捕食者，随后便会将其点燃。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME spews small flames to burn food to ashes before eating. Its horns burn at 1500 degrees, emitting pungent smoke that warns predators before igniting them.

entry: POKENAME转动骨棒，同时挥动两团火焰，借旋转产生的向心力打出重击。它还会吐火铺满地面，藏进火光中，出其不意地攻击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME twirl their bones to wield both fires at once, delivering powerful strikes that utilize the momentum of centripetal force. They spit out flames that spread across the ground, blending in with the flames to attack when least expected.

entry: POKENAME体内积蓄着惊人热量。栖居的森林被烧过后，往往更容易进化。
author: markusknight
source: Immense heat accumulates in POKENAME's body. They tend to evolve easier after a forest they live in has burned.

entry: POKENAME体内装满毒油，飘过火山区时，油液随之晃荡。若被惹怒，就会炸成一团火球。
author: .izik
source: Toxic oil fills POKENAME's body, slushing around as it floats through volcanic areas. If angered, it explodes in a ball of flames.

entry: 它住在干旱山区。旱季，成群穿过这片土地，就很容易让野火蔓延。
author: opossiblymage
source: This Pokémon resides in arid mountain regions. During the dry season, wildfires can easily spread by a herd moving through the land.

entry: 传说POKENAME曾独自从浅红市游到红莲岛，启发了“像POKENAME一样拼一把！”的说法，意思是尽力去做看似不可能的事，盼能成功。
author: bobosmith01
source: The legend of a POKENAME swimming from Fuschia City to Cinnabar Island all on its own has inspired the saying of "Try like POKENAME!", meaning to perform what seems impossible to the best of your ability in hopes of success.

entry: 许多收藏家想把POKENAME养进锦鲤池，可它动不动就把所在的小水域煮沸，实在难养。野外主要待在地热喷口附近。
author: empty_set
source: While many collectors would like one in their koi pools, POKENAME's tendency to boil any small body of water it finds itself in makes it impractical to keep.  In nature, it mostly hangs out around geothermal vents.

entry: POKENAME在废弃太阳能电厂筑巢，以残余电力为食。若打扰它，可能招来破坏力惊人的喷烟。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME nests in abandoned solar plants, feeding on residual electricity. Interrupting it risks provoking a devastating Lava Plume.

entry: 两只鸭嘴火兽融合后，火焰愈加猛烈，身体几乎全由烈火构成。外表虽火爆，性情却出奇沉静。
author: sk372
source: A fusion of two Magmar has its flames grow in intensity to the point of being almost completely comprised of burning fire. Despite its fiery appearance, it has a remarkably calm demeanor.

entry: POKENAME每天至少会发怒3次。它暴躁的脾气经常引发山火，因此有关部门请求经验丰富的训练家捕捉遇到的所有POKENAME。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME tend to get angry at least 3 times a day. Officials request seasoned Trainers to catch any POKENAME they come across, as their short tempers often result in wildfires.

entry: POKENAME的化石总在火山附近发现。科学家发现，它们生前这些火山活动极盛，因此化石保存得十分完好。
author: dahappycute
source: The fossils of these POKENAME are always found near volcanoes. Scientists have found that these volcanoes were extremely active when these Pokémon were alive, which kept their fossils well preserved.

entry: POKENAME平时友善，可一见同类，双方就忍不住争强决胜。利爪与烈焰激烈交锋，直到一方昏倒才罢休。
author: sk372
source: While normally friendly in behavior, should POKENAME spot another of its kind, the two will be unable to resist the urge to compete and establish dominance. A fierce battle of claws and flame follows, until one of them lies unconscious.

entry: POKENAME尾端的火焰明亮燃烧，行动时来回晃动。谁若看见它，它便甩尾抽打，飞散火星造成轻微灼伤。
author: bigoljax
source: The flame at the end of POKENAME's tail burns brightly, swishing around whenever they're on the move. They whip their tails at those who spot them, the embers that fling off causing small burns.

entry: 敲打POKENAME的肚皮，会刺激提供喷火能量的体内熔炉。敲得够快，便可能吐出巨大的火墙。
author: sk372
source: Drumming on POKENAME's belly stimulates the internal furnace that supplies it with its flame breath. Rapidly beating on its stomach enough gives it the potential to exhale huge walls of fire.

entry: 它飞行时吐出火弹，烧掉藏着猎物的灌木与叶片，将猎物逼到空地。POKENAME极厌水，一下雨就不肯离巢。
author: fiordaliso
source: It spits fire pellets while in flight to ignite the bushes and leaves concealing its prey, flushing them into the open. Whenever it rains, POKENAME refuses to leave its nest, as it has a deep aversion to water.

entry: POKENAME呆头呆脑、动作迟缓，最爱躺温泉。浴客觉得它新奇，又会把水温维持得舒适，因此很欢迎它，也会分食物给它吃。
author: hobiewankenobi
source: Very dimwitted and slow, POKENAME prefers to lounge in hot springs. It is often a welcome guest and lives on food shared with it by human patrons who love it for its novelty and for keeping the springs a comfortable temperature.

entry: POKENAME喜欢蜷在人身旁，为酸痛部位取暖。有时自己躺得太舒服，反而硬让伤者坐着歇息。
author: quackquackattack
source: For people experiencing aches and pains, POKENAME love to curl up against people's bodies to warm up the affected area. Sometimes they get too comfy and force an injured person to sit and rest.

entry: POKENAME爱在高处开阔地晒太阳。此时去打扰，最容易惹它发怒。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME spends its time sunbathing at clear spots of high elevation. Bothering one during this time is an easy way to bring its ire.

entry: POKENAME火力强劲，却不稳定，也很难控制。连咳嗽或喷嚏，都可能引发一场小火灾。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's fire power is powerful, but volatile and difficult for it to control. Even simple coughs or sneezes might lead to a small inferno.

entry: 它们住在活火山，乘热上升气流长久飞行。POKENAME十分体贴，火山喷发后，常能见它载着人与宝可梦，飞离危险。
author: joeofthealps
source: They live in active volcanoes and use thermal updrafts to stay airborne for a long time. Very caring, POKENAME can be seen after volcanic eruptions, flying people and Pokémon away from danger.

entry: POKENAME栖在火山口盆地，借下方熔岩为蛋保暖。有时整群POKENAME会同时预见未来，在家园喷发前仅几小时，一起飞走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME roost within volcanic calderas, using the heat of the lava beneath it to keep its eggs warm. Entire flocks of POKENAME are sometimes struck by the same vision of the future, taking flight mere hours before their volcanic home erupts.

entry: POKENAME看似暖和蓬松，训练家却最好别碰。身体又烫又满是静电，让不知情靠近的敌友，都会被弄疼。
author: anarraveofcolour
source: POKENAME may look warm and fluffy, but a trainer should avoid touching one. Their body is simultaneously burning and full of static electricity, giving unwitting foes and friends pain when getting too close.

entry: POKENAME掠过暮空，翼后拖着蓝红火迹。古老族群曾将其视为歉收之兆。
author: .izik
source: Blue and red flames streak from POKENAME's wings as it soars through sunset skies. These were once viewed by ancient clans as an omen of a poor harvest.

entry: POKENAME受不了不被关注。若觉得没人欣赏自己，就提高体温，点燃附近物品。极少数情况下若仍被无视，就会使出猛烈的妒火。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME struggles not being the centre of attention. If it feels it is not being appreciated, it will increase its body temperature, setting fire to nearby objects. In the rare cases it is still ignored it will unleash a brutal Burning Jealousy.

entry: POKENAME吃垃圾箱里的废物，为腹中火焰添燃料。难过时，尾端的火又会缩小。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME consumes rubbish in dumpsters to fuel the flame in its belly. When it gets sad, the flame on its tail shrinks.

entry: POKENAME漂在火山浓烟中，享受酷热。熔岩冷却后便会离开，最多再待十分钟。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats through volcanic smoke, basking in the intense heat. It leaves when the lava cools, never staying longer than ten minutes afterwards.

entry: 双头配合时，POKENAME会接连轰出大字爆炎。同步的连击，让敌人几乎无从逃脱。
author: .izik
source: When both heads coordinate, POKENAME unleashes a rapid barrage of Fire Blast attacks. The synchronized strikes leave little chance for escape.

entry: POKENAME钻过山体，将周围岩石烧得焦黑，再吃下大块黑曜石充饥。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows through mountains, scorching the stone around it. It eats chunks of obsidian to satisfy its hunger.

entry: 中世纪，铁匠会把POKENAME养在炉中，换它维持炉温，并提供食物、保护它免遭天敌。它能控制自己散出多少热量。
author: chibitales
source: In medieval times blacksmiths would house a POKENAME within their forges. In exchange for keeping the forge heated, it was given food and protection from predators. It is able to control how much heat it gives off.

entry: POKENAME带着一块内含稀有黑曜石的石头，日久渐大，让许多金匠觊觎。石头太重时，便舍去，再造新的。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME carries a stone filled with rare obsidian which grows over time, coveted by many goldsmiths. If the stone become too heavy it will shed it and create a new one.

entry: POKENAME能耐熔岩高温，游在流动岩浆的表面。它们会把冷却的熔岩塑成精巧巢穴，吸引伴侣。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swim along the surface of active lava flows, their bodies capable of withstanding the intense temperature of the molten rock. They shape cooling lava into elaborate nests in an effort to attract potential partners.

entry: 起初，人们以为POKENAME送煤是惩戒坏行为。其实POKENAME只是喜欢煤，想把收来的煤，与世界各地的生灵分享。
author: sk372
source: Originally, it was believed POKENAME handed out pieces of coal to reprimand bad behavior. In truth, POKENAME simply loves coal and wishes to share the pieces it collects with others around the world.

entry: POKENAME成大群聚在热液喷口附近，吸食喷口涌出的灰烬与矿物质，把体内烈焰烧到极高温。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME gather in large schools near hydrothermal vents and drink in the ash and mineral plumes belched out by the vents, stoking their internal flames to extreme temperatures.

entry: POKENAME比起攻击，更常逃跑，可自卫时也能喷出强劲火柱。喷火前，鹿角会先热得发亮。
author: sk372
source: Although more likely to flee than attack, POKENAME can breathe a strong stream of flame for defensive purposes. Its antlers turn bright from heat just before it unleashes its fire breath.

entry: POKENAME伸长藤蔓，紧紧缠住猎物。等到完全抓牢，就用火焰吐息点燃藤蔓，将猎物牢牢按住，烘烤至可以食用为止。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its extending vines to constrict around its prey. Once it has them fully in its grasp, it sets the vines alight with its fire breath, holding them down and roasting them until they're ready for consumption.

entry: 它十分罕见，只在休眠火山附近被人见过。传说迁徙时，沿途会开花，飞过处拖着绚烂的自然色彩。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is a rare Pokémon and is only spotted near inactive volcanoes. According to legend, if it migrates elsewhere, flowers bloom in its migratory path, dazzling natural colors trailing it as it flies by.

entry: POKENAME战斗时全身放火，也用火加固沙漠地洞。高温足以熔沙，让其结晶成坚实结构。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME release flames across their bodies during battle and to fortify their desert burrows. Their flames can reach high enough temperatures to melt sand and allow it to crystallize into solid formations.

entry: POKENAME借间歇泉放出的灼热气流翱翔，气流导过翼膜，也不会灼伤自己。炽热巨钳一击，连厚金属墙也能熔开。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME soars through the air using the scorching currents released by geysers, which it channels through its wing membranes without burning itself. A single strike from its blazing-hot pincers is enough to melt even thick metal walls.

entry: 利爪坚硬灼热，每次重斩都能边软化岩石，边将其切开。POKENAME火焰的温度还能帮忙制玻璃，因此有些吹玻璃工匠会驯养它，协助工作。
author: infinex21
source: Its claws are hard and very hot, so it can cut through rock while softening it with each strong slash as well. The flames it releases can be so hot as to help make glass, so some glassblowers will have tamed a POKENAME to help them with their work.

entry: 在POKENAME眼里，战斗就是舞蹈。它轻巧错步，避开攻击，还总留着一只手，等舞伴来牵。
author: leshii
source: For POKENAME, there is no difference between battle and dance. It sidesteps attacks with the greatest ease with one hand always open for a partner.

entry: POKENAME天性害羞，却带点叛逆，独处时才会纵情热舞。战斗中旋转的身影，能形成幻象，遮住自己。
author: leshii
source: A shy but rebellious spirit by nature, POKENAME passionately dances when it's alone. It forms a mirage as it spins in battle, obscuring it from view.

entry: POKENAME天性害羞，却带点叛逆，独处时才会纵情热舞。战斗中旋转的身影，能形成幻象，遮住自己。
author: leshii
source: A shy but rebellious spirit by nature, POKENAME passionately dances when it's alone. It forms a mirage as it spins in battle, obscuring it from view.

entry: POKENAME以优雅潇洒的舞步，穿行战场。火热的心熊熊燃烧，战斗也宛如与对手共舞。
author: leshii
source: POKENAME dances about the battlefield with grace and style. With its fiery heart burning bright, it battles as though dancing with another.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着易燃油，点燃后能威慑敌人。咬伤会造成几乎深达骨头的三度烧伤。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is coated in flammable oil that ignites to deter foes. Its bites can cause third-degree burns that nearly reach the bone.

entry: POKENAME对地壳深处岩浆的变动极为敏感，会前往可能喷发的火山附近，因此被视为灾难将至的预兆。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME is incredibly sensitive to the shifting of magma deep beneath the world's crust. They seek out locations where volcanic eruptions are likely to happen, earning them a reputation for imminent disaster.

entry: 地震前一刻，POKENAME的身体会如熔岩般燃亮。它爬上高处，放出明光，警告别人危险将至。
author: .izik
source: Moments before an earthquake, POKENAME's body burns like molten lava. It climbs to high ground, glowing brightly to warn others of danger.

entry: POKENAME用鼻子吸进泥土，在体内分离矿物，再从大鼻子伴着烈火喷出。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME can sniff up dirt and separate the minerals within its body. It then exhales these minerals in a fiery blast through its large nose.

entry: 多年来，训练家会借速射赛测试POKENAME的反应速度，训练它一出精灵球，就立刻射出弹丸。
author: .fedoraman
source: For many years, the reaction times of Trainers' POKENAME have been tested in quickfire competitions. They are trained to fire off a projectile the instant they emerge from their Poké Ball.

entry: 这对POKENAME分工合作，各自守望不同方向。即便四面被围，迅疾连炮也很难应付。
author: hophoppip
source: The twin POKENAME work together, with each one keeping watch in a different direction. Even if surrounded by foes, their rapid-fire blasts are hard to beat.

entry: POKENAME被认为有点迟钝，炎热天气里，常在空中追自己的尾巴。天然镜片护住敏感双眼，有时能盯太阳看上数小时。
author: hobiewankenobi
source: POKENAME is considered a bit dimwitted, and is often found chasing its own tail in the skies on hot days. It has natural lenses that hide its sensitive eyes from the sun, which it sometimes stares at for hours.

entry: 若耳朵与尾巴上的火焰低落，训练家就该给POKENAME喂些木炭。火一暗，它便会行动迟缓。
author: melodydelune
source: If the flames on its ears and tail seem low, Trainers should feed their POKENAME charcoal. It becomes sluggish when its flames are dim.

entry: POKENAME体温极高，易燃物一碰就着。它们脾气暴躁，动不动彼此打架，爆发的烈焰常引起森林大火。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME maintain a body temperature high enough that combustible material bursts into flames on contact with them. They are cantankerous Pokémon and will freely get into fights with one another; the resulting blasts of fire often cause forest fires.

entry: POKENAME高飘火山上方，吸收酷热。若被打扰，就把闯入者提到空中，再扔进熔岩深处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats high above volcanoes to absorb intense heat. If disturbed, it lifts intruders into the air and drops them into the molten depths.

entry: POKENAME吐出的丝，温度高达数百度，因此，只会在石头或金属结构上筑巢。
author: chorb33
source: The threads that POKENAME spins reach temperatures of several hundred degrees. This is why it builds its nests on stones or metal structures.

entry: POKENAME使出火焰旋涡前，尾巴会亮起橙光。若饿得太厉害，这招就得花时间蓄力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tails glow bright orange before it does a Fire Spin attack. It takes time to charge this attack if it is overly hungry.

entry: POKENAME翱翔天空，见什么能烧就点着。科学家借这纵火癖，进行可控燃烧，维护森林健康。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME soar through the sky, lighting anything that can be lit aflame. This pyromania is harnessed by scientists for controlled burning to maintain the health of a forest.

entry: POKENAME擅长烟火特效，很受合众电影片场欢迎。POKENAME只要举起双臂，身后就出现火墙，增强镜头的戏剧效果。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are popular on Unovan movie sets for their role with pyrotechnics. By lifting their arms, POKENAME creates a wall of fire behind them to aid in the dramatic effect of the shot.

entry: POKENAME全身孔洞如火山喷口。受威胁时，会从中喷出岩浆，有时热得足以烧焦附近一切。
author: _imperitus
source: The holes covering POKENAME's body act like volcanic vents. When threatened, it erupts magma from these openings, sometimes producing enough heat to scorch everything nearby.

entry: POKENAME双眼有特殊薄膜，挡住浓烟与高温，适应火山环境。双翼还在生长，因此靠伏击捕猎，不打持久战。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's eyes are adapted to volcanic environments thanks to a specialized film that protects them from intense smoke and heat. As their wings are still growing, they hunt by ambushing prey instead of prolonged fights.

entry: POKENAME的火躯会发光，难在洞穴藏身，便改到几乎无人踏足的火山隧道休息。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's fiery body radiates light, so instead of trying to hide in caverns, POKENAME rests where most will never tread: volcanic tunnels.

entry: POKENAME能爬上墙壁与天花板。喷火前，眼睛上方的毛会先亮起，若见到这一幕，就快离开吧。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can climb walls and ceilings. Just before it spits fire, the fur above its eyes lights up. If you see this, get out of the area.

entry: POKENAME用燃烧双翼裹住蛋，提供稳定暖意。受守护的蛋，也泛着微微光芒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wraps its fiery wings around its eggs, providing consistent warmth. The eggs glow faintly under its protective embrace.

entry: POKENAME先以巨口牢牢咬住敌人，再贴近使出猛烈的喷射火焰。高温，足以熔化钢铁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME latches onto foes with its enormous mouth before unleashing a brutal Flamethrower at point-blank range. The flames can get hot enough to melt steel.

entry: POKENAME是远古令人生畏的恶霸，喷火吓跑小宝可梦后，便跳进少有谁能跟来的岩浆，躲避报复。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME was a terrorizing bully of the ancient world. It would breathe flames to send smaller Pokémon scurrying off in fear, then leap into magma where few could follow in order to avoid retribution.

entry: POKENAME将下半身埋在火边，叶片随风飘动，宛如火焰。扇动叶片，还能掀起阵阵热浪。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME bury their lower halves near fires, their leaves waving in the wind as if they were flames. They can fan these leaves to create waves of heat.

entry: POKENAME在火山顶跳起轻快的萨尔萨式舞步。有人以为它会引来喷发，其实并非如此。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs quick salsa-like dances atop volcanoes. Some believe it summons eruptions, but this is not the case.

entry: 谁贸然靠近POKENAME据为领地的火山，都会遭它攻击。双翼只拍一下，就能掀起猛烈的灼热风暴。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME attacks anyone reckless enough to venture too close to the volcano that it has claimed as its territory. With a single beat of its wings, it can conjure violent storms of searing air.

entry: POKENAME渗出熔岩般的黏液，冷却后凝成浮石状物质。它在活火山口沐浴时，还会开心地将岩浆泼得到处都是。
author: milchik
source: Its body oozes goo that closely resembles molten lava and solidifies into a pumice-like substance when cooled down. When POKENAME bathes in a crater of an active volcano, it joyfully splashes the magma all over the area.

entry: POKENAME不爱直接用火焰进攻，更愿凭巨力，将火山岩块掷向对手。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME prefers not to use its fire attacks directly. Instead, it will use its immense strength to throw volcanic boulders at its opponents.

entry: POKENAME在火山区的石块间翻跃。身体冷得过头，动作就变慢，因此常把自己浸进熔岩取暖。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME does flips while jumping from stone to stone in volcanic areas. If its body cools too much, it gets slower, so it frequently submerges itself in lava to warm up.

entry: POKENAME在火山家中织出的菌丝，极为耐热。有些隔热材料公司正在研究，盼能改善沙漠住宅的隔热效果。
author: .izik
source: The mycelium POKENAME weaves within its volcanic home is highly heat-resistant. Some insulation companies have studied it in hopes of developing better insulation for homes in desert areas.

entry: POKENAME的孢子灼热如岩浆，散成雾团灼伤敌人。暴雨中，却几乎立刻冷却，几乎失去全部威力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's spores are as hot as magma, dispersing clouds onto foes to burn them. During a rainstorm, these spores cool almost instantly and lose nearly all their potency.

entry: 它点燃毛发，保护自己。身上烧着火，POKENAME毫不在意，就连意外引起森林大火，也不放在心上。
author: pokepower
source: It sets its fur alight for protection. Being ablaze doesn't bother POKENAME in the least, nor any forest fires it accidentally starts.

entry: POKENAME吃小树枝时，双耳会散出强烈热量，清楚警告别人别靠近。
author: .izik
source: While eating small sticks, POKENAME's ears radiate intense heat. This serves as a clear warning for others to keep their distance.

entry: POKENAME壳中冒出的烟，热得能瞬间煮沸清水。兴奋时，还会把烟喷向周围空气。
author: .izik
source: The smoke from POKENAME's shell is hot enough to instantly boil water. When excited, it spits smoke into the air around it.

entry: POKENAME燃烧的鳞粉，很受宝可梦华丽大赛欢迎。虽严格说不结成固定族群，却常能见到POKENAME聚在一起。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's flaming scales are often a popular element in Pokémon Contests. Although they technically do not form colonies, POKENAME are often found in groups of one another.

entry: POKENAME沿活火山侧面掘洞。饿了，便吞食地下岩浆维生。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows along the sides of active volcanoes. When hungry, it consumes magma beneath the surface to sustain itself.

entry: POKENAME常待在音乐演出后台，释放烈火，让舞台更有声势。它们常戴耳机降低周围音量，否则就会头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are kept backstage at musical shows where they can unleash their fiery powers to make performances pop to life. They often wear headphones to lower the volume around them and would experience headaches without them.

entry: POKENAME住在火山内部或熔岩池旁，尽享高温。若温度低于华氏2,000度，就会暴怒发作。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME reside inside volcanos or near pools of lava, basking in their heat. If the temperature falls below 2,000 degrees Fahrenheit, they will be thrown into a fit of rage.

entry: 月明之夜，POKENAME在火山巢外欢快长嚎。谁若走得太近，它便以迅疾的火焰轮迎击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME howls happily outside of its volcanic den on moonlit nights. Should someone wonder too close it will dispatch them with a swift Flame Wheel.

entry: POKENAME在流动熔岩中游泳，借浓稠液体锻炼肌肉。人们试着冷却岩浆时，它们便敌意大起，妨碍阻截熔岩流的工作。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found swimming within active lava flows, straining to build up their muscles in the dense liquid. Their presence can delay efforts to stem lava flows, as they become hostile when attempts are made to cool the molten rock.

entry: POKENAME自豪于体魄与控火本领，谁肯看，都愿表演。时而摆姿势炫肌肉，时而吐出各式形状的烈火，场面颇为壮观。
author: sk372
source: Proud of both its physique and its flame prowess, POKENAME puts on shows for any who would watch. Between flexing poses and plumes of fire exhaled in a variety of shapes, it makes for quite the spectacle.

entry: 身体由燃烧的火成岩组成。谁让POKENAME觉得有威胁，它就喷出熔岩迎击，只是射得不远。
author: mistymagius
source: Its body is made of burning igneous rock. POKENAME will spew molten rock at anyone it finds a threat, even though it can't shoot very far.

entry: POKENAME在地下煤矿丰厚之处开凿住处，吞煤，让腹中烈火烧得更旺。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME carves homes near rich coal deposits underground. It devours the coal to stoke the blazing fire burning in its belly.

entry: 泡进熔岩就能获取能量，不需要吃喝。若见野生POKENAME从火山边飞奔离去，就说明火山即将喷发。
author: staghorn
source: It gets its energy by immersing itself in lava, so it doesn't need to eat or drink. If you see a wild POKENAME galloping away from a volcano, it is a sure sign that the volcano is going to erupt soon.

entry: POKENAME喷出灼热火焰，推着自己飞行，再用磁铁转向。它既吃电，也吃酷热，因此最常见于工业熔炉。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME propels itself through the air by blowing out scorching flames, steering using its magnets. It feeds on both electrical energy and intense heat, and so is most often found in industrial furnaces.

entry: POKENAME的三个金属身体，仿佛焊在一起。每张嘴都能喷火推进，只有小心以磁铁转向、稳住身体，才不会原地打转或撞墙。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's three metallic bodies seem to be welded together. Each mouth can blow out flames for propulsion, and only careful steering and stabilization using their magnets prevent POKENAME from spinning in circles or crashing into walls.

entry: POKENAME争强好胜，三个头都想在控火上压过其他头。曾有人见过，竞争得火气太盛，竟彼此怒喷火焰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's competitive nature means all three heads try to one-up the other in fire prowess. Some have even observed the heads angrily breathing flames on each other when competition gets too heated.

entry: POKENAME住在北地火山周围的岩浆池内外。厚厚的耐火脂肪，让它们既能游沸腾熔岩湖，也能游北方冰水。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are found living in and around magma pools surrounding northern volcanoes. These Pokémon have thick, fire-resistant fat that allows them to swim in the boiling lava lakes, as well as the ice-bound waters of the north.

entry: POKENAME身体由极热气体构成，碰一下就可能造成三度烧伤。它会先抓住敌人，再朝对方喷火。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is made of superheated gas that can cause third-degree burns with a single touch. It grabs onto foes before breathing flames on them.

entry: 组成身体的岩石，连浸入岩浆也不会熔化。POKENAME多住在地下深处，尤其活火山下方。
author: mistymagius
source: The rocks that make up its body are incapable of melting, even if submerged in magma. POKENAME tends to live deep below the surface, mostly under active volcanoes.

entry: POKENAME吃植物汁液，锐牙能咬穿最厚的木头，够到食物。背上巨钳，则能在进食时吓阻天敌来袭。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feed on plant sap, using their viciously sharp teeth to bite through even the thickest wood to get to their food. They have powerful pincers on their back that they use to deter predators from attacking them whilst they're feeding.

entry: POKENAME紧紧一握，就能压碎树果。它偏爱未熟的，因为更难榨出汁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME crushes berries with its tight grip. It prefers berries that haven't ripened because they are more difficult to juice.

entry: POKENAME先以大钳夹住对手，再迸着火花爆炸。可爆完会晕上一阵，若首击没能打倒敌人，恐怕就没有第二次机会。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME grab onto foes with their large pincers and then explode in a series of sparks. Unfortunately, the explosion leaves them dizzy for a while afterwards, so if they don't defeat their opponent on the first try, they likely won't get a second.

entry: POKENAME聚在落叶堆下。只有首领的头长着钳子，会以锐利的心灵脉冲，号令其余成员。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME clusters under leaf piles. Only its chief head has pincers, which it uses to command the rest of its cluster through sharp telepathic pulses.

entry: POKENAME伪装成棕榈树，节省能量，再用超能力将猎物拉进巨口。大角会吓阻那些想啃叶冠或静止头部的宝可梦。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is an ambush predator, conserving energy by mimicking a palm tree before using its psychic powers to pull prey into its maw. The large horns act as deterrents against Pokémon seeking to feed on its leafy crown or inert heads.

entry: 它伏在地下，等猎物经过便跃出地面，以巨剪切碎对方。若泥土太硬，挖不进去，也会改装成植物。
author: sondededoo
source: This Pokémon waits underground for victims to walk underneath it, at which point it leaps from the ground and slices prey apart using its scissors. They are also known to mimic plant life when the soil is too hard for them to dig into.

entry: POKENAME靠大食花等宝可梦的花蜜维生，凭长舌，远远就能安全进食。舌头占身体大半，又暴露在外，只好用凶相吓退威胁。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME subsides on nectar from Pokémon like Victreebel by feeding while staying at a safe distance thanks to its long tongue. The tongue is the majority of its body and is very exposed, so it uses its fierce appearance to scare off threats.

entry: POKENAME等待进化时，部分甲壳会脱落。碎片磨成粉，可用来制作防御强化补剂。
author: .izik
source: Portions of POKENAME's shell fall off as it waits for evolution. These pieces are ground up for use in creating X Defense supplements.

entry: POKENAME冲向比自己小的目标，用角猛打、甩开。等猎物受伤发晕，再扑上去，以巨重身躯压住，开始吞食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME charges down anything smaller than itself in order to bludgeon and fling them with its horn. Once battered and stunned, it pounces and uses its massive weight to pin its prey down beneath it and eat.

entry: POKENAME伺机捕猎，甚至住到宝可梦中心附近，想捕食伤者。如此残酷，让吉利蛋一系都视它为死敌。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is an opportunistic hunter, even residing near Pokémon Centers in order to potentially hunt injured Pokémon. Due to this cruelty, the Chansey line consider it a mortal enemy.

entry: POKENAME把幼崽放进腹部的大型刺袋，保护起来。尖刺看似凶恶，其实柔软，幼年POKENAME再扭着想钻出，也不会受伤。
author: pjporwoll
source: To protect its young, POKENAME places the child in the large, spiked pouch in its belly. The spikes look fierce, but actually are soft enough not to harm the baby POKENAME when it tries to squirm out.

entry: POKENAME翼上的钳子凭本能行动，夹缝间有什么经过，就猛然合拢。虽善捕食，却太重，让它无法飞行，反而可能自己沦为猎物。
author: sk372
source: The pincers on POKENAME's wings behave on instinct, clamping down violently on anything that passes through the gap. Though effective for capturing prey, the added weight leaves it grounded and potentially vulnerable to becoming prey itself.

entry: POKENAME静伏沙滩下，等谁踩过。无论猎物、岩石或其他东西，一碰到，就会被巨颚凶猛撕碎。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lies motionless beneath the sand on the beach, waiting for someone to walk over it. Its jaws ferociously shred anything that comes into contact with it, whether it be prey, rocks, or other objects.

entry: 强健肢体，让POKENAME连最滑最险的表面也能攀上。同样的肢体，也会牢牢擒住猎物，直到无法动弹，再由POKENAME整个吞下。
author: bobosmith01
source: Powerful limbs allow POKENAME to climb up even the most slippery and perilous of surfaces. Prey is grappled with these same limbs until they are unable to move and then are swallowed whole by POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的肢体足够强壮，能挥击敌人，真正本领却在合拢时。强劲夹握力，会将已被削弱的对手碾碎。
author: sk372
source: Though it possesses decently strong limbs for clubbing foes, POKENAME's true strength lies in clamping them together, possessing a powerful gripping force that crushes its opponent after weakening them.

entry: POKENAME已长出与角同样锐利致命的双翼。高速飞行时，若没能用角刺中敌人，就改以翅膀斩击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has now developed wings that are as sharp and as deadly as its horns. Flying at blistering speeds, if it misses skewering an enemy with its horns, it slices them with its wings instead.

entry: POKENAME先用锐翼切伤、削弱敌人，再以尖角了结。若角撕不开对方，便飞高后撞下，将其砸碎。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its sharp wings to slice and weaken foes before finishing them off with its sharp horns. If it can't tear an enemy with its horns, it flies up and crashes down with them to smash them apart.

entry: POKENAME用大钳闯进酿酒厂，砸开酒桶。最爱蜂蜜酒与其他甜饮，借此为进化积蓄养分。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME use their large pincers to break into breweries and smash open barrels. They are particularly fond of mead and other sweet drinks, which helps build up reserves for their evolution.

entry: POKENAME藏在海滩，用钳子困住不慎靠近的敌人。壳太沉，因此很少移动。
author: imagine1.
source: POKENAME hides on beaches, trapping any unsuspecting foe it finds with its pincers. It rarely moves, as its shell is very heavy.

entry: POKENAME会咬住蜂蜜酒厂的木桶，凿通内部。桶里一泄压，便能喝到苦却营养丰富的液体。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are known to bite onto barrels in mead breweries, tapping into the drink on the inside. They depressurize the barrel, which allows them to drink a bitter but nutritious liquid.

entry: POKENAME一道贯穿全身的巨口，直接通向胃部。这张大嘴，能将多数宝可梦整个吞下。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's stomach is directly fed by the gigantic mouth that rips through its entire body. This large mouth is capable of swallowing most Pokémon whole.

entry: 蜂蜜酒厂若有POKENAME滋生，就会雇灭虫人员，因为它们凶猛难惹。常会戳穿酒桶，喝里面的甜液。
author: quackquackattack
source: Mead brewers who encounter a POKENAME infestation will hire exterminators, as they are aggressive and hostile. They are known to jab holes into barrels to access the sweet liquid inside.

entry: POKENAME尽量住进最偏远的深林，避开人与其他宝可梦。它用念力举起来犯者，拉向巨钳，轻易将其碾碎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives as deep in the most remote forests as possible in an attempt to avoid humans and other Pokémon. It uses telekinesis to lift aggressors up and draw them towards its pincers, which crush them with ease.

entry: 它先用带刺尾巴缠紧敌人，固定原地，再以头钳夹住、抛出。POKENAME借超能力强化巨钳，抛掷力道惊人。
author: imaginita
source: It wraps its thorned tail around foes to pin them in place, then uses the pincers on its head to grab and toss them. These pincers are enhanced by psychic power, allowing POKENAME to throw its victims with astonishing force.

entry: POKENAME受威胁时，会点燃背上的刺角。进食靠腹部贯穿的嘴，偏爱富含树脂与熟树果的食谱。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME feels threatened, it sets the spiked horns on its back ablaze. It feeds through a mouth that extends through its belly, favoring a diet rich in resin and ripe berries.

entry: 许多POKENAME巡视地面，寻找大型猎物。一只POKENAME找到足够喂饱整巢的目标，全群POKENAME便追上去，以巨颚狠夹，将其制服。
author: firefist738
source: Many POKENAME will scout the land, searching for large prey. Once a POKENAME has spotted a suitable target to feed the whole nest, the entire group of POKENAME will run the Pokémon down, using their large mandibles to crush the foe into submission.

entry: POKENAME带刺的肢体能猛力夹合。一察觉蛛网上有东西，就迅速降下，瞬间碾碎挣扎的猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's spiky limbs can slam together with great force. The moment it senses something gets caught in its webbing, it descends quickly to crush the struggling prey in an instant.

entry: 目标进入范围，POKENAME便使其麻痹，再用长着数百枚钩牙的巨口，缓缓吞食。
author: _testrun_
source: Once within range, POKENAME will paralyze its target. It will slowly consume the prey using its massive maw lined with hundreds of hooked teeth.

entry: 体形变大后，POKENAME会选择更危险的猎场扎根。故意摆出古怪吓人的伪装，引来大小猎物查看，再猛然以巨颚咬碎。
author: arcul
source: With POKENAME now in a larger form, it may choose to plant itself in more dangerous hunting grounds. Intentionally off-putting mimicry draws prey, large and small, in closer to investigate, where it then lunges with powerful, crushing jaws.

entry: POKENAME看不见，靠气味辨路。与同类相处时，会吐出凝胶，告知对方别咬自己。有种胆量考验，就是涂满凝胶站在POKENAME巢里，安全却吓人。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are blind and rely on scent to navigate. When with others of their kind, they cough up a gel that informs others to not bite them. A test of character involves being covered in this gel then standing in a POKENAME nest: safe but terrifying.

entry: POKENAME看不见，靠气味辨路。与同类相处时，会吐出凝胶，告知对方别咬自己。有种胆量考验，就是涂满凝胶走进POKENAME巢中，安全却吓人。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are blind and rely on scent to navigate. When with others of their kind, they cough up a gel that informs others to not bite them. A test of character involves being covered in this gel then walking into a POKENAME nest, safe but terrifying.

entry: POKENAME吃树液，利牙连最厚树皮也能咬穿，够到食物。它们以头角较量，把其他POKENAME从最好的进食点撬走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feed on tree sap, using their viciously sharp teeth to pierce through even the thickest of tree bark to get to their food. They use the horns on their head to spar with one another, prying other POKENAME off the best feeding spots.

entry: POKENAME吃树液，利牙连最厚树皮也能咬穿，够到食物。它们以头角较量，把其他POKENAME从最好的进食点撬走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feed on tree sap, using their viciously sharp teeth to pierce through even the thickest of tree bark to get to their food. They use the horns on their head to spar with one another, prying other POKENAME off the best feeding spots.

entry: 夹住对手，还是将其掀翻，全看它临场的战术。两只POKENAME交锋时，却总会选相反的招数。
author: staghorn
source: Whether it aims to pinch or flip its opponent varies on a tactical basis. When two POKENAME fight, they will always choose opposite tactics.

entry: 钳子从POKENAME头部穿出，遮挡了视线，害它找食物时格外费劲。
author: toxicrown
source: The pincer that protrudes through the head of POKENAME has caused it's vision to be reduced. It struggles to find food because of this.

entry: POKENAME只在进食前或想吓退别人时，才露出恐怖大嘴。甲壳比坚石还硬。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME only expose their horrific mouths before they consume prey or to scare away others. Their shells are harder than solid rock.

entry: POKENAME住在水下洞穴，用触手如鱼叉般刺住猎物，再吞食。它启发了无数恐怖故事，尤其受水手欢迎。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lives in underwater caves where it uses its tentacles to harpoon prey before devouring them. This Pokémon has inspired countless terrifying tales, especially popular among sailors.

entry: 野生POKENAME群共享意识，由尾巴最长者带领。若与训练家牵绊深厚，POKENAME便会绕着对方疾蹿，开心尖叫。
author: oddwalls
source: Wild POKENAME packs form a hivemind, led by the member with the longest tails. When a POKENAME forms a strong bond with its Trainer, it darts around them, screeching happily.

entry: POKENAME灰褐鳞片融入尘土小路，只有伏击时才现身。它们让颚部脱开关节，把多张嘴张得足够大，整个吞下猎物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME blend into dusty trails with their taupe scales and only expose themselves when they ambush prey. They unhinge their jaws to open their many mouths wide enough to swallow prey whole.

entry: POKENAME用躯干上的巨颚吞食猎物，消化成奶。正因这过程，POKENAME的奶被归作肉制品。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME uses its torso mandibles to devour prey and digest it into milk. Due to this digestion process, POKENAME's milk is considered a meat product.

entry: POKENAME看似危险，其实大多用角挖洞，再邀请其他宝可梦同住。POKENAME还会慷慨地把产下的蛋分给伙伴。
author: .jerden
source: Although they seem threatening, POKENAME mostly use their horns to dig burrows, then invite in other Pokémon to live with them. POKENAME generously share the eggs they lay with these companions.

entry: POKENAME用巨钳夹碎晶洞石，吃里面发光的晶体。山隘间，常留下一堆堆裂石。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME crushes geodes with its massive pincers to feast on the glowing crystals inside. It leaves behind piles of cracked stone in mountain passes.

entry: POKENAME的巨钳能折弯硬金属，在森林横冲直撞找蜂蜜。常与赫拉克罗斯融合宝可梦结伴，因为POKENAME得靠它们劈开树，才能喝到树液。
author: bigoljax
source: With pincers strong enough to bend hard metals, POKENAME rampage forests for honey. They're known for pairing up with Heracross fusions, due to POKENAME relying on them to crack open trees for tree sap.

entry: POKENAME结合融合原型的假哭与自身的拟态，吸引好奇猎物。等对方进入范围，再以强劲巨颚碾碎撕裂。
author: arcul
source: POKENAME utilizes its progenitor's faux tears in tandem with its innate mimicry to lure curious prey in close. When the prey enters striking range, it uses powerful jaws to crush and tear.

entry: POKENAME是深林可怕的生物，以巨钳和无数触手绑住猎物，碾碎吞食。常能见它抓着几只仍在挣扎的生灵，留待之后享用。
author: sk372
source: A frightening creature of the deep woods, POKENAME uses its pincers and countless tentacles to bind and crush prey for consumption. It's not uncommon to see it holding a few struggling creatures in its tentacles to save for later.

entry: 脚上微钩与手部利爪，让POKENAME什么表面都能爬，垂直的也不例外。可带着一对大钳，休息时又必须找平坦处。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has the ability to climb all sorts of surfaces, even vertical ones, thanks to the microscopic hooks on its feet and the claws on its hands. It must rest somewhere flat, however, due to the large pair of pincers it carries.

entry: POKENAME有礼，爱与野生宝可梦切磋，提升战技。遇到训练家，就深深鞠躬，连钳子也碰到地面。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are respectful creatures that enjoy sparring with other wild Pokémon to improve their combat prowess. Whenever they meet a Trainer, they bow so low that their pincer touches the ground.

entry: 野生POKENAME飘在荒弃的凯罗斯巢旁，通常攀着邻近树木。据说若有人打扰空巢，POKENAME就会张开身体，吸走来者的灵魂。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME in the wild hovers around abandoned Pinsir nests, usually clinging to nearby trees. It's said if one disturbs the empty home, POKENAME will open its body and suck the interloper's soul away.
