entry: POKENAME用利齿撕开树皮，舔食树液。进食时，背上会竖起细小毒刺，吓阻可能的威胁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its sharp teeth to shred bark and lap up sap. While feeding, small venomous spines rise from its back to ward off potential threats.

entry: POKENAME伪装时，嘴和牙齿没法变色，只好更借景物掩护。它一边融入树皮，一边啃开树干吸汁，进食时几乎看不见。
author: pjporwoll
source: When POKENAME camouflages, its mouth and teeth cannot change color, so it must use the scenery even more to blend in. It is nearly impossible to see when it feeds since it uses its teeth to chew into a tree for sap while blending in with the bark.

entry: POKENAME会不停追猎够格的目标，从败者身上取走战利品。可荣誉规矩森严，只挑战有能力还击的对手。
author: rakanadyo
source: A POKENAME is known to relentlessly hunt down worthy prey, taking trophies from those they defeat. They have a strict code of honor, however, and only challenge those who can fight back.

entry: POKENAME喝雪松树液时，背钳会有节奏地合拢。若被招惹，POKENAME便使出毒夹击，强得足以令对方麻痹。
author: .izik
source: While drinking sap from cedar trees, POKENAME's back pincers snap rhythmically. If POKENAME is provoked, they deliver a venomous pinch strong enough to paralyze.

entry: POKENAME的钳子有5,000磅的压力，夹住什么都能碾碎。会毁掉一圈树木，标出领地边界。
author: mistymagius
source: The claw on POKENAME can crush anything it grabs with 5,000 pounds of pressure. It creates a border of decimated trees to outline its territory.

entry: POKENAME一露出狂笑，就说明打算捕猎。性情凶暴，会用坚固头骨上的硬角，冲倒一切挡在自己与猎物之间的东西。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's manic grin signifies its intent to hunt something. Aggressive in behavior, it charges down anything standing between it and its prey using the incredibly tough horns on its equally-durable skull.

entry: POKENAME通常被归为草食，但极少数特定情况下，也可能捕食其他宝可梦。它在坚树下挖出巨大地洞，筑巢育幼。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME typically is classified as an herbivore, but there are rare and specific cases where it may prey on other Pokémon. It creates enormous burrows underneath sturdy trees to act as a nest to raise its young.

entry: POKENAME用又大又长的巨口威吓对手。尾巴强劲，足以把巨石打飞。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their large, long maws to scare their opponents. Their tails are strong enough to send a boulder flying.

entry: POKENAME通常被归为草食，但极少数特定情况下，也可能捕食其他宝可梦。寒冷季节，会变得不活跃，始终藏在地下。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME typically is classified as an herbivore, but there are rare and specific cases where it may prey on other Pokémon. It becomes inactive during the cold season and remains in hiding underground.

entry: POKENAME玩耍时，会谨慎地挥钳，与同群伙伴切磋。这些模拟战很少造成伤害，却能逐渐确立群内高下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spars with others in its pack during play, using careful pincer strikes. These mock battles rarely injure, but they help build dominance hierarchies.

entry: 若不曾夺走所有持握者的四肢，POKENAME本该是伐木与拆迁的好工具。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME would be an excellent tool for logging and demolition, if it wouldn't claim the limbs of all those attempting to wield it.

entry: POKENAME用刀刃砍木，盾牌铲叶，一小时内就能伐净整片森林。刀刃叉齿越厚，POKENAME的力量与耐力也越强。
author: soup1900
source: Using its blade to cut logs and its shield to scoop up leaves, POKENAME can log and clear an entire forest within an hour. The strength and durability of a POKENAME can be determined by the thickness of the prongs of its blade.

entry: POKENAME毒钳只扎一下，就会令人看见久别亲人的鲜明幻象。有些文化相信，这些景象揭示了注定的未来。
author: .izik
source: A single prick from POKENAME's venomous pincers causes vivid hallucinations of long-lost loved ones. Some cultures believe these visions reveal fated futures.

entry: POKENAME把巨钳顶在前方，冲向目标。大嘴足以一口吞下多数猎物。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME attacks by charging pincers-first towards its targets. Its large mouth allows it to swallow most prey in a single bite.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，为保护家人无所不为。巨大的刺角比铁更坚固，让它能自豪地迎接任何战斗。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an incredibly territorial Pokémon that does everything to protect its family members. Its massive spiked horns are stronger than iron, allowing it to face any battle with pride.

entry: POKENAME力量惊人，嘴与巨钳能毁掉整棵树。故事里，人们畏惧它的庞大体型与骇人外貌；它则漫游深林，猎捕认定的所有猎物。
author: riel.vndxgrxvnd
source: POKENAME displays immense strength, able to destroy whole trees with its mouth and pincers. Feared in stories for its massive size and unnerving look, it roams deep forests and hunts anything it considers prey.

entry: POKENAME听见歌谣，金属巨钳便愈发强劲，原因无人知晓。此时被夹住的东西，常仅因握力太强，就爆裂开来。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's strong metal pincers grow increasingly powerful when it listens to ballads. While the reason for this is unknown, objects it crushes during this time tend to explode from the sheer force of its grip.

entry: POKENAME以手上的大颚，施展迅捷剑法。身体还藏着数十条细如丝线的荆棘鞭。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME has swift swordplay with the mandible on its hand. It also has dozens of thorny whips, as thin as silk, concealed on its body.

entry: POKENAME模样虽吓人，却只吃腐木。食量惊人，让它成为出色的分解者。
author: hampterbychoice
source: Despite its fearsome appearance, POKENAME only feeds on rotting logs. Its ravenous appetite makes it an excellent decomposer.

entry: POKENAME在树冠间疾蹿，快得令人眼花。一发现汁液甜美的树，就冲撞裂开树皮，饮下树汁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME darts through tree canopies with blinding speed. When it finds a sweet tree, it rams it to crack the bark and drinks the sap inside.

entry: POKENAME先飘在雪松上方，再以巨钳切开树干，贪婪喝汁。后肢，则会拍开闯来的虫子。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats above cedar trees before slashing them open with its pincers. It drinks sap greedily, using its rear limbs to swat away intruding bugs.

entry: POKENAME凶暴又贪食，能轻松同时对付三敌，分别用两张嘴与一组头角，各夹住一个目标。
author: foolish_weasel
source: A violent Pokémon with a voracious appetite, POKENAME can easily handle three foes at once by clamping down on each of them between its two mouths and its set of horns.

entry: POKENAME先用巨钳捕住、勒紧敌人，再从口中射出纯粹电流的光束。身体结构特殊，让它跑得比小火马还快。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their large pincers to capture and constrict their opponents before blasting them with a beam of pure electricity loosed from their mouths. Due to how their bodies are structured, they are able to gallop swifter than a Ponyta.

entry: 对战时，POKENAME用长满牙的肢体碾压敌人。若夹不穿硬壳或铠甲，就把对手狠狠掼向地面。
author: quackquackattack
source: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME crush their opponents with their toothy appendages. If they fail to crush through shells or armor, they slam their opponents into the ground.

entry: POKENAME暴怒时，巨钳会烧得红热。口中喷出的猛烈火焰，一碰就能熔钢。
author: .izik
source: When enraged, POKENAME's pincers glow red hot. It can unleash intense flames from its mouth that are hot enough to melt steel on contact.

entry: POKENAME藏在黑暗里等猎物。目标一靠近诱人的火光，POKENAME便迅速合拢臂上的角，将这一餐抓住、烤熟。
author: rodotom
source: POKENAME waits in the darkness for its prey. Once the prey gets close enough to its alluring flame, POKENAME quickly closes the horns on its arms to capture and roast its meal.

entry: POKENAME用巨钳附在渔船底，借船远行，寻找珊瑚丰饶的新觅食地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME clings to the undersides of fishing boats using its pincers. It travels long distances this way, seeking new coral-rich feeding grounds.

entry: POKENAME拾回死去同伴的角，挂在身上。它们挥动这些角，作为锐器，抵御天敌。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME reclaim the horns of their fallen comrades to hang from their bodies. They swing these collected horns as sharp tools to defend themselves from predators.

entry: 有人说POKENAME是死去宝可梦留下的影子。它常出现在墓园，照顾住在那里的幽灵属性宝可梦。
author: whiteupgrade
source: Some say POKENAME is the shadow of a Pokémon that passed away. It's often seen at graveyards, caring for the Ghost-type Pokémon that reside there.

entry: POKENAME虽长着锯齿巨口，却完全食草。可从地下巢穴钻出时，POKENAME的模样仍会吓坏人与宝可梦。
author: mepp.
source: Despite its jagged maw, POKENAME is entirely herbivorous. When it emerges from its underground nest, POKENAME's appearance greatly scares people and Pokémon alike.

entry: POKENAME从高枝以波导扫描森林。弱小目标一休息，便跃下，以精准钳击袭去。
author: .izik
source: From high tree branches, POKENAME scans the forest with its aura. When a weak target rests, it leaps down and strikes with precise pincer blows.

entry: POKENAME精力旺得停不住，在战场跳来跃去。冲入战斗前，还会连连合钳，积攒冲势。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME bounds across the battlefield with restless energy. Its pincers snap repeatedly as it builds momentum before launching into combat.

entry: POKENAME吞食小宝可梦，偏爱其他虫属性，尤其溜溜糖球。POKENAME除了张嘴直游，干别的都笨手笨脚，刚融合时尤甚。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME devours small Pokémon and prefers other Bug-types; it especially loves to feast on Surskit. POKENAME is particularly clumsy at anything beyond swimming in a straight line with its mouth open, especially when first fused.

entry: POKENAME每个齿轮上，都有一根尖角。靠近猎物就迅速转动，使尖角猛然夹合，以强大压力碾碎目标。
author: sk372
source: Each of POKENAME's gears contains a single spiky horn. It rotates quickly when near prey to slam these horns together and crush its target beneath their powerful pressurized grip.

entry: POKENAME会掘地筑巢。睡觉时，会用巨钳点燃附近灌木，维持温暖。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is known to dig into the ground to make nests for itself. It lights nearby bushes and shrubs on fire with its pincers to keep itself warm while it sleeps.

entry: POKENAME攀住枫树枝，用巨钳饮汁。天敌一近，就会松开，毫不犹豫地爆炸。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME clings to maple branches and drinks sap with its pincers. If a predator approaches, it releases its grip and explodes without hesitation.

entry: 巨钳强得能夹开某些宝可梦的壳。POKENAME没有眼睛，靠獠牙敲击发声，进行回声定位。
author: infinex21
source: Their pincers are strong enough to crack open the shells of some Pokémon. POKENAME clatter their fangs together to perform echolocation due to their lack of eyes.

entry: POKENAME藏在泥下或落叶下，等猎物经过，就用带电牙齿咬脚踝。格外大胆的POKENAME，还会以巨钳挂在树上，落向路过者头顶。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME hides under mud or leaves waiting to zap prey by biting its charged teeth on their ankles. Especially daring POKENAME hang from trees using the pincers to drop on the heads of passing victims.

entry: 眼睛变成额外的嘴，让POKENAME如今全盲。可它又饿得凶猛，抓到什么就想吃什么。
author: skymaster426
source: Due to its eyes having become extra mouths, POKENAME is now blind. However, it is also agressively hungry, and will try and eat whatever it can grab.

entry: POKENAME钳中毒液，带着浓烈薰衣草香。毒液稀少珍贵，常被用于高级香水与异域古龙水。
author: .izik
source: The venom inside POKENAME's pincers carries a strong lavender scent. It's rare and highly prized for use in luxury perfumes and exotic colognes.

entry: POKENAME以巨钳夹住峭壁睡觉。若被惊扰，就会松开，以惊人速度滚走避险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME clamps onto cliffs with its pincers to sleep. If startled, it releases its grip and rolls away with incredible speed to escape danger.

entry: 为了打动雌性、震慑雄性情敌，POKENAME会昂起前身，展示颈腹的排排利齿。对手若不退，就猛咬，并从獠牙注入毒液。
author: _pixelar_
source: To impress a female and intimidate other rival males, a POKENAME will rear up and display the rows of teeth located along its neck and belly. If the rival won't back down, it will attack, biting down and injecting poison through its fangs.

entry: POKENAME外骨骼既坚硬又富弹性，能承受巨大冲击。捕猎多是鲁莽地将全身砸向猎物，成效竟相当不错。
author: krogens
source: The exoskeleton of POKENAME possesses incredible hardness and elasticity that allow it to withstand incredible impacts. Their hunting strategy largely consists of hurling their entire body recklessly at prey, to remarkably great success.

entry: POKENAME藏在高草，伏击小宝可梦。钩牙一旦咬牢，就很难松开，总会有牙齿勾在里面。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hide in tall grass where they can easily ambush small Pokémon. Once their hooked teeth latch onto something, it becomes difficult to remove them without getting a tooth stuck.

entry: POKENAME在舞池地盘意识极强，会攻击周围的家伙，抢走风头。无论到哪儿表演，利爪都会把地板划出深痕。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is fiercely territorial on the dance floor, attacking others to steal the spotlight. Its talons leave deep scratches in the flooring wherever it performs.

entry: 给别人加油时，POKENAME将牙齿蜷入口内腔室，吹出尖哨。可大角常挡得手臂举不高，打断了助威动作。
author: jaminmcready
source: When cheering others on, POKENAME creates a sharp whistle by curling its teeth into a chamber in its mouth. Sadly, its large horns often block it from lifting its arms fully in the air, interrupting its routine.

entry: POKENAME用喙把腰旁角质块磨成尖刺。有的还会用指甲刻花纹，指甲也靠不断啄击，磨得锋利。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME sharpens the keratin clumps near its waist with its beak to form thorns. Some even carve patterns into them with their nails, which are also honed by constant pecking.

entry: POKENAME身体结实，双翼的旗状部位却脆弱，战斗时常撕裂。好在一天内，就能自然修好。
author: jaminmcready
source: Though POKENAME's body is tough, its wing flags are fragile and often tear in battle. Luckily, they can repair themselves naturally within a day.

entry: POKENAME的外貌，尤其排排锯齿，连最大胆者也会心慌。可野外的它，通常反而避开与人接触。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's appearance, especially its rows of serrated teeth, unnerves even the most daring individuals. Despite this, it typically avoids any interaction with humans out in the wild.

entry: POKENAME不停流涎，口水闻起来像乐芭果，吸引小虫宝可梦。它再突然使出迅疾凶狠的断头钳，袭击对方。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drools constantly, its saliva smelling like Aguav Berries. This attracts small bug Pokémon, which it ambushes with a swift and brutal Guillotine.

entry: 这些虫宝可梦领地意识极强，住在冰冷洞穴。能吐出寒雾，把猎物冻成冰块，再整个吞下。
author: infinex21
source: These bug Pokémon are incredibly territorial. They live within cold caves and can breathe a frigid mist that will freeze any prey solid before swallowing them whole.

entry: POKENAME喝完树液，会将孢子撒进树皮。真菌迅速蔓延，把整个树干变成隐蔽的菌菇农场。
author: .izik
source: After feeding on sap, POKENAME scatters spores in the tree bark. These fungi spread rapidly, turning entire trunks into hidden mushroom farms.

entry: POKENAME是最危险的宝可梦之一，对手再大，也绝不退战。它以头上巨角连连猛击，配合长得骇人的巨颚。
author: rock_rock_rock
source: POKENAME is known as one of the most dangerous Pokémon, as no matter how large the opponent may be, it never backs down from a fight, striking with a barrage of massive horns along its head and its terrifyingly elongated jaw.

entry: POKENAME先激得对手出招，再张开满口石硬利齿，把进入夹握范围的一切，碾碎切裂。
author: _subject
source: POKENAME goads opponents into attacking, and when they do, opens its large maw of stone-hard teeth to crush and slice whatever has entered its grip.

entry: POKENAME喝完树液，种下孢子，寄生树木。接触感染的树时，最远五英里外的脚步，也能察觉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME parasitizes trees by planting spores after drinking sap. While touching infected trees, it can detect footsteps from up to five miles away.

entry: POKENAME用巨钳夹碎浮木，与同群伙伴分食。同时，总有几只在旁留意危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its massive pincers to break driftwood into pieces. It shares meals with its swarm while a few stand watch for danger nearby.

entry: POKENAME棕色身体融入树干，方便以臂上锐利锯刃伏击。全身虽暗淡，却极为自豪于双翼鲜艳的绿色。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's brown body blends in with tree trunks, enabling it to ambush prey using the sharp, serrated blades on its arms. While the rest of its body is drab, it is incredibly proud of the vivid green coloration of its wings.

entry: POKENAME用角与利齿啃断厚树、粗枝。伐木公司，会动用大队POKENAME采伐。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its horns and teeth to chew through thick trees and branches. Large armies of POKENAME are used by logging companies.

entry: 大群POKENAME常裹着毒尘云到来，所过之处草木尽亡。选定猎物后，便用锯齿巨颚撕碎，半点残骸不留。
author: mistymagius
source: Swarms of POKENAME usually arrive in a cloud of poisonous dust that chokes out all forms of plant life. Once they pick their prey, they will tear them apart with their serrated jaws, leaving no remains behind.

entry: POKENAME的角会产出营养极高的蜜，深受烘焙师追捧。若喂POKENAME药草，叶片的疗愈功效也会转进蜂蜜。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME's horns produce an incredibly nutritious honey that is highly sought after by bakers. If POKENAME is fed a diet of medicinal herbs, the healing properties of these leaves are transferred into the honey.

entry: POKENAME在地下掘洞时，用强钳夹开树根。它偏爱枫树，因为树汁浓厚丰富。
author: .izik
source: While digging underground, POKENAME uses its strong pincers to break open tree roots. It favors maple trees for their rich sap.

entry: POKENAME晒太阳太久，就会严重灼伤，因此偏爱地下生活，靠巨钳挖土前进。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME prefer to live underground since they get nasty burns when exposed to sunlight for prolonged periods of time. They rely on their pincers to dig through the ground.

entry: 家中虫害频发，养POKENAME很管用。它等虫巢几乎住满，就猛扑过去，把整窝虫吸入巨口，饱餐一顿。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is an effective pet for homes that have a tendency towards insect problems. It waits until a bug nest is nearly full, then pounces and inhales the whole colony into its maw in a bountiful feast.

entry: 寒冷季节，POKENAME翻找辣树果取暖。可辣味又使它头痛，超能力激增，导致树倒枝折。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME roots around for spicy berries during colder seasons for warmth. The spice gives it a headache, however, which causes psychic power to surge and results in felled trees and branches.

entry: POKENAME骇人的面孔，是附近昆虫的末日。小虫被吸进巨口，就会遭内里火焰焚毁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's terrifying visage spells doom for any insects in the vicinity. The small bugs get inhaled into its massive mouth before being incinerated by the flames within.

entry: POKENAME在池旁杂食，吃花蜜与天敌留下的残羹。身体尚未长成，因此POKENAME避开远强于自己的敌人，可只要做得到，外表绝不示弱。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME dwells by ponds as an omnivore, eating nectar and scraps from predators. Its body is still developing, so POKENAME avoids taking on foes that firmly outclass it, but it outwardly shows no fear whenever it can.

entry: POKENAME用高压水柱轰开树干。树皮一裂，便急切地喝下里面积存的树汁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses high-pressure water jets to blast open tree trunks. Once the bark splits, it eagerly drinks the sap stored inside.

entry: POKENAME为求全胜，手段残酷。除猛夹、钳刺外，还可能将敌人高抛入空，守着它摔落，直到再也无法动弹。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME employs brutal methods for complete victory. In addition to crushing grapples and thrusts of its pincers, it may toss the foe far into the sky and then wait for them to land until they are no longer able to move.

entry: 有些城镇流传POKENAME取走枕下落牙，换上钱的故事。可若满是蛀洞，就会被躯干上的嘴吃掉，半点钱也不给。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Some towns tell stories of POKENAME taking loose teeth under pillows and replacing them with Pokédollars. According to the tales, cavity-filled teeth are consumed by the mouth on their torsos, and no money is given.

entry: POKENAME的嘴如碎纸机，厚实植物也能轻易撕开。园丁常借POKENAME，清理多余植物废料。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's mouth acts similarly to a paper shredder, allowing it to shred through thick plant matter with ease. Gardeners will often use POKENAME to get rid of excess plant waste.

entry: 和平时，POKENAME常与巨蔓藤相伴，用藤蔓缠物探查。可食物一短缺，便成仇敌，见面就激烈厮打。
author: ambrosia04
source: In peaceful times, POKENAME and Tangrowth can be seen hanging out together, wrapping their vines around objects to inspect them. When food becomes scarce, however, they become enemies and will fiercely fight against each other on sight.

entry: 它夜里在林间疾行觅食。捉到猎物，就用针尖般的牙狠狠咬住，再不松口。
author: periperi_chicken
source: At night, it skitters around forests looking for food. When it catches its prey, it bites down with needle-sharp teeth and doesn't let go.

entry: POKENAME吃下的一切，都由尾上的大舌贝吸收。它以巨钳攀住河岸，吞食所有漂过的东西。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Everything POKENAME eats is absorbed by the Shellder on its tail. It latches onto riverbanks with its pincers and devours anything that floats past.

entry: POKENAME的巨钳由浓密羽毛融合而成。速度足够时，同步一击，就能把巨石夹开。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's pincers are made of dense, fused feathers. With enough speed, they can crack open boulders in a single synchronized strike.

entry: POKENAME满口尖牙吓坏孩子。恐惧甚至带进梦里，梦中尽是不愉快的看牙经历，以及牙齿脱落。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME terrifies children with its many teeth, each sharpened to a point. It instills a sense of dread that carries onto a person's dreams, which become full of bad dentist visits and teeth falling out.

entry: 据说POKENAME是遭杀害的虫宝可梦的游魂。鬼魅般的身体发出不祥沙沙声，近旁便能听见。它始终不动，一见活物，就立刻袭击。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is said to be the wandering spirit of a slain bug Pokémon. Its wraithlike body makes an ominous susurrus that can be heard when it is close. It remains motionless until it sees a living thing, at which point it will immediately attack.

entry: 据说POKENAME是遭杀害的虫宝可梦的游魂。鬼魅般的身体发出不祥沙沙声，近旁便能听见。攻击时会甩动一根断角，据说来自生前的身体。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is said to be the wandering spirit of a slain bug Pokémon. Its wraithlike body makes an ominous susurrus that can be heard when it is close. It attacks by lashing out with a severed horn that's thought to be from its living body.

entry: 寒夜，POKENAME溜进家，藏到枕头下取暖，还会啃出牙印，让训练家清早困惑不解。旧枕头最好丢掉，免得引来POKENAME。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: On cold nights, POKENAME slip into homes and hide beneath pillows for warmth. They leave marks on pillows by chewing on them, leaving Trainers to question these marks in the morning. Old pillows should be discarded to avoid attracting POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME藏在阴影，敲动牙与钳，发出不安声响。它享受隐身时造成的恐惧，等猎物怕到极点，再突然出击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides in the shadows and makes an unnerving noise by clicking its teeth and pincers. It relishes the terror it causes while it remains unseen, waiting to strike when its prey's terror is at its highest.

entry: POKENAME常在工地充当活起重机，巨钳能碎岩，也能轻易吊运重建材。拆迁留下的废墟，也会被它吃掉，清出场地。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME are commonly used on construction sites as living cranes, using their massive, rock-shattering pincers to easily hoist and move heavy building materials. They also clear sites by consuming the debris left from demolitions.

entry: POKENAME一见谁欺负弱小，就吹出刺痛的粉末，出面阻止。它性情温和，还会用角撞树，把落果分给附近宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: If it sees someone picking on the weak, POKENAME intervenes by blowing a stinging powder at them. It has a very gentle nature; it uses its horns to crash into tree trunks and give the fallen fruit to other Pokémon in the area.

entry: POKENAME好斗，会头槌一切会动的东西。可甲壳承受不住这样的猛烈撞击，身上总是青一块紫一块。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very aggressive and will headbutt anything that moves. However, their carapace isn't tough enough to resist the sheer amount of blunt force, so POKENAME is constantly covered in bruises.

entry: POKENAME发怒时，外围五颗蛋绕中心旋转，产生超能力，使身体浮起，再前冲，用头猛撞惹怒自己的目标。
author: sk372
source: When angered, the five outer eggs rotate around the center, creating psychic energy that levitates POKENAME in the air and allows it to charge forward to headbutt the target of its ire.

entry: POKENAME三个长角的头，让冲撞更难躲。可每头各有大脑，POKENAME必须等三个头盯准同一目标，身体才会动。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's three horned heads make its charges more difficult for foes to evade. However, each head has its own brain, and POKENAME's body will not begin moving until all three have focused on the same target.

entry: POKENAME戴颅骨头盔自卫，可也常挡住部分视线。因此冲向什么时，往往又会因看不清而绊倒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wear skulls as helmets to protect themselves from danger, but these skulls often block parts of their vision. Whenever they go charging at something, they often trip because of this obscured vision.

entry: 战斗中一发脾气，它便不依不饶。不是目标昏倒，就是POKENAME的骨棒碎得必须更换，否则绝不停止追打。
author: sk372
source: When its temper flares in combat, it becomes relentless. It won't stop chasing and striking a target until it's unconscious or POKENAME's bone club shatters and it's forced to find a replacement.

entry: POKENAME勇猛守护同群，以强腿奔过长途，赶到需要帮助的成员身边。连踢两脚后，POKENAME再旋身，以三叉尾打击对手。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are fierce defenders of their herd, using their legs to cover large distances to reach any member in need. After delivering two kicks, POKENAME spin to hit their opponents with their three-pronged tails.

entry: POKENAME头上的舌状器官，碰一碰就能辨出东西好不好吃。凡被舔过却不美味的，就会被POKENAME一甩头拍开。
author: sk372
source: The tongue-like organs on its head let POKENAME touch objects to discern if they would be tasty or not. Non-tasty objects that get licked will be batted away with a swing of POKENAME's head.

entry: 多条尾巴若赶不走落身的虫属性宝可梦，POKENAME就用舌头拍走。群体亲密相守，也能帮幼年与年老者，赶掉背上虫害。
author: quackquackattack
source: When their many tails are not enough to keep Bug-Type Pokémon from landing on them, POKENAME swat the pests away with their tongue. By staying in close-knit herds, they can help the young and elderly keep pests off their backs.

entry: POKENAME前后摇晃，拿壳互撞，争夺高下。可在旁观者眼里，这些战斗实在没什么看头。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will rock back and forth, ramming their shells into each other in a fight for dominance. To onlookers, these battles are extremely anticlimactic.

entry: 独角犀牛与肯泰罗融合，让POKENAME长出巨角，更便于冲敌。可常一头撞进东西，角深深卡住，反把自己困住。
author: sk372
source: The fusion of Rhyhorn and Tauros has given POKENAME a massive horn to better charge at foes with. However, it often charges into things and gets itself stuck, the new horn lodged deep within the object it crashed into.

entry: POKENAME将领地划为禁止争斗区。若见人或宝可梦内斗，就猛冲过去，以沉重的蛋与强力头锤，将双方击昏，结束战斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME designates its territory as no-conflict zones. Should it spy infighting from any people or Pokémon, it aggressively charges and ends the fight by knocking them out with its heavy egg and powerful Headbutt.

entry: 谁靠近POKENAME占据的花田，都会遭它怒撞，其他POKENAME尤其如此。两只POKENAME若交锋，就会互相头槌，直到一只昏在花间。
author: sk372
source: It furiously charges at others that come to close to flower fields it has claimed, especially other POKENAME. Should two POKENAME clash, they headbutt each other until one is left knocked out among the flowers.

entry: POKENAME天生皮革耐用，常被皮匠制成手袋与腰带。可刺角凶猛，也吓得多数偷猎者不敢下手。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have naturally durable leather that many leatherworkers use to produce handbags and belts. However, their prickly horns scare away most poachers from hunting them.

entry: 许多人试骑野生POKENAME，甚至成了围观的热闹。据说若POKENAME不把你甩下，就是认可你与自己平等，也允许骑手收服。
author: jojojax164
source: Many people attempt to ride a wild POKENAME, so many in fact that it has become a spectacle to watch. It is said that if a POKENAME doesn't buck you off, it sees you as an equal, allowing the rider to catch it.

entry: POKENAME的肉细嫩多汁，带淡淡烟熏味。据说配上酱油，带出本身鲜香，就格外美味。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME meat is tender and succulent with hints of smoky flavor. It is said to be especially delicious when paired with soy sauce to bring out its natural savor.

entry: POKENAME是草食昆虫，多见于茂盛草地。体内满是苦涩毒液，因此天敌不愿靠近。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are herbivorous insects that are most often found in thriving grasslands. Their body is filled with bitter and poisonous fluid, so predators stay away from them.

entry: 夏季，POKENAME变得格外躁怒，领地里的船一出现，就遭强角猛撞。它与同类激战不休，直到一方折角才罢休。
author: fiordaliso
source: During the summer, POKENAME gets so agitated that it rams boats sailing through its territory with its incredibly strong horns as soon as it spots them. It fights fiercely and relentlessly against others of its kind until one of its horns breaks.

entry: 和帕底亚某些肯泰罗品种一样，POKENAME能把尾巴当螺旋桨游泳。
author: musicsheep.
source: Similar to certain breeds of Tauros found in Paldea, POKENAME can swim by using its tails as a propeller.

entry: POKENAME发怒时，鬃毛就会着火。火烧着，POKENAME便猛烈扭动，直到火灭，或自己昏倒。
author: musicsheep.
source: When angered, POKENAME's mane will set ablaze. While the fire burns, POKENAME violently thrashes until either the fire dies out or it faints.

entry: 若POKENAME出现在电脑中，得慢慢移动光标。太快会被视为挑衅，引得POKENAME横冲屏幕，可能严重破坏数据。
author: sk372
source: If a POKENAME appears on your computer, move the cursor slowly. Moving too quickly will be seen as a challenge, leading to POKENAME charging across the screen and potentially causing major damage to one's data.

entry: POKENAME全身动弹不得，只能怒目而视。可别大意，进化后它们会清楚记住一切，找出这期间惹怒自己的东西，彻底摧毁。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME can't move any of its body parts, as it can only watch angrily. Beware, because when they finally evolve, they'll remember everything with a photographic memory and will look to destroy anything that angered them during this stage.

entry: POKENAME出了名地凶暴，用叉尾固定自己，猛撞树木，将树撞倒，再猎捕从枝间惊散的树栖宝可梦。
author: bee4082
source: An infamously violent Pokémon, POKENAME uses its pronged tail to anchor itself while it slams into trees to knock them over. It preys on the tree-dwelling Pokémon that scatter from the branches afterwards.

entry: POKENAME头有锐角，多尾又能抽得如鞭。体内力量庞大，无论哪一端，都不宜靠近。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's head is armed with sharp horns, and it can crack its many tails like a whip. Due to the immense power stored up inside its body, neither end is safe to approach.

entry: POKENAME先飞高，再俯冲，增强冲撞力。它心地善良，愿奋战，保护弱小宝可梦免遭危险。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME flies up into the air, then dives down to give more force to its charges. It is kind-hearted and will fight to protect weaker Pokémon from danger.

entry: POKENAME全身动弹不得，只能怒目而视。可别大意，进化后它们会清楚记住一切，找出这期间惹怒自己的东西，彻底摧毁。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME can't move any of its body parts, as it can only watch angrily. Beware, because when they finally evolve, they'll remember everything with a photographic memory and will look to destroy anything that angered them during this stage.

entry: 几乎不可能逃出POKENAME毒刺的范围。失礼对手、欺凌弱小的强者、听任此事发生的弱者，美的、丑的生灵，都会被追；最恨的，更是红色。
author: epping_forest
source: Escaping the range of POKENAME's sting is nearly impossible. It will go after disrespectful opponents, stronger Pokémon taking advantage of the weak, weak ones allowing it to happen, beautiful and ugly creatures, and, most of all, the color red.

entry: POKENAME对世界满怀怒气，一认定什么是威胁，就直飞撞上。它不停审视四周，判断该不该准备下一战。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Angry at the world, POKENAME immediately flies straight into anything that it deems a threat. It constantly judges its surroundings to determine if it should prepare for another battle.

entry: POKENAME总烦躁得想打架，会偷近别人，以三尾鞭打。对方被激起攻性，愤怒备战，POKENAME终于又有对手可打。
author: sk372
source: Constantly frustrated and ready to fight, POKENAME sneaks up on others to whip them with its three tails. This stimulates aggressive tendencies, leading to an angry, battle-ready opponent for POKENAME to fight with.

entry: POKENAME发怒时，刺鬃便会燃烧。它好斗，所以经常如此，周围多数宝可梦都会吓跑。身上烈焰，能超过摄氏500度。
author: mcnchsschl
source: Its spiky mane ignites when POKENAME gets mad. Due to its belligerent tendencies, this happens often, and when it does, most Pokémon run away in fear. The fire on its body can blaze at over 500 degrees Celsius.

entry: POKENAME模样酷似汉堡，有些快餐店便拿它作吉祥物。POKENAME还会把自己的画像误当同类，试着与另一只POKENAME交谈。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: With an appearance akin to a hamburger, some fast-food locations have begun to use POKENAME as their mascot. POKENAME can be spotted trying to converse with artwork of themselves, mistaking it for another POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME模样酷似芝士汉堡，有些快餐店便拿它作吉祥物。POKENAME还会把自己的画像误当同类，试着与另一只POKENAME交谈。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: With an appearance akin to a cheeseburger, some fast-food locations have begun to use POKENAME as their mascot. POKENAME can be spotted trying to converse with artwork of themselves, mistaking it for another POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME见什么都想撞，可身体太轻，没多少威力。头上的角，也还没长好。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will try to ram themselves into anything, even though their bodies are so light they don't do much damage. Their horns are still developing.

entry: POKENAME冲向敌人前，全身绒毛会先迸出电火花。双角强得连岩石也能击碎。
author: fiordaliso
source: Just before charging its enemies, POKENAME releases electric sparks from the fluff covering its body. Its horns are so strong that they can even break rocks.

entry: POKENAME给角裹上电流，让凶猛冲撞更可怕。只有完全赢得信任的人，才能剪下它的厚羊毛。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME coats its horns with electricity to make its ferocious charges even more fearsome. It only allows people who have earned its complete trust to shear its thick wool.

entry: POKENAME一见红色，就怒得失去理智。锐爪扑向颜色来源，常将衣物撕得粉碎。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enter a visceral rage whenever they see the color red. Their sharp talons attack the source of the color, often ripping apart clothing in the process.

entry: POKENAME个头小、行动不灵便，却绝不能小觑。小身体藏着巨力，连卡比兽都能相当轻松地举起、掷出。
author: sk372
source: Despite its diminutive size and stunted mobility, POKENAME is a force to be reckoned with. It packs so much strength in its small frame that it can pick up and throw a Snorlax with relative ease.

entry: POKENAME把尾巴般的手臂当鞭，挡住天敌。农夫常借它们放牧牛群，岩石般身体也能扛住冲撞。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their tail-like arms as whips, keeping predators at bay. Farmers often use these Pokémon to help herd cattle, their rock-hard bodies able to tank charges.

entry: POKENAME看似形体走样的蚊香蛙皇，可别因个头小就轻视。脾气暴躁，谁近就猛攻，还会低沉大叫，唤来同群帮忙。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME look like mishapen Politoed, but don't let their small size fool you. These Pokémon have short tempers, aggressively attacking anyone that gets near. They let out a loud, deep croak, calling in herds of their kind to help aid their attack.

entry: POKENAME翻找垃圾箱觅食，凭凶脾气，轻易赶走其他捡食的家伙。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will scrounge through dumpsters in search of food. They can easily drive away other scavengers with their aggressive temperament.

entry: POKENAME尾巴如鞭，出击忽然又有惊人力道。它吃草，住在草木覆盖的高地。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME attacks by using its tails like a whip with sudden and surprising force. It is herbivorous and lives in the grassy highlands.

entry: 清早，POKENAME得晒足太阳，才能稳住脾气。日照不够，就会跳来跳去大发雷霆，可个头太小，破坏也有限。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME needs ample sunlight in the morning to keep its temper under control. Without enough sun, it begins to hop around raging, though its diminutive size limits how much damage it can cause with its tantrums.

entry: 阳光对POKENAME很重要，可不能吸得过多。若过量，身体就会过热，陷入狂暴。
author: sk372
source: Sunlight is crucial to POKENAME's well-being, but care must be taken to ensure it doesn't absorb too much; if it does, it overheats and goes on a rampage.

entry: POKENAME发怒时甩尾，喷出微毒，警告近旁别再招惹。虽个头小，却已有数次凶狠顶刺的记录。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME will flick its tails when angry, shooting a mild poison, a warning to those nearby to stop irritating it. Despite its small size, there have been several recorded instances of brutal goring.

entry: POKENAME鬃毛挡眼，看不见东西。可毛发能感知光，让它凭对手的影子，辨位出击。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME cannot see due to its mane covering its eyes. It can sense light through its fur, allowing it to attack opponents by sensing their shadow.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴般的锐利触手抽打天敌，保护同群。特别不肯退的，还会挨上一团毒花粉，让身上伤口刺痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME keep predators away from their herd by whipping them with sharp tentacles that resemble tails. Particularly persistent predators get blasted with a poisonous pollen that causes any cuts to sting.

entry: POKENAME总是饥饿，大半天都在找食物，吃掉或囤起。谁若靠近储粮，就会暴怒，以岩硬双角全力猛冲。
author: fiordaliso
source: Since POKENAME is always hungry, it spends most of its day searching for food to eat or stockpile. If anyone approaches its hoard, it flies into a rage and charges with full ferocity, striking with its rock-hard horns.

entry: POKENAME凭坚壳身体，见什么就想冲撞砸碎。目标若跑得比它快，还能高速射出可脱落的角，远远击中。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME attempts to charge down and smash anything in sight with its sturdy shelled body. If a target manages to outrun it, it can launch detachable horns at high velocity to strike from long distances.

entry: POKENAME借三尾与结实头骨，撞落、捞起树果进食。身体酿出的树果汁，闻着、尝着都很苦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its three tails and its resilient skull to help it knock down and grab berries to consume. The berry juice its body creates has a strong bitter aroma and taste.

entry: POKENAME好斗固执，巡视广大领地，确保附近没有对手安家。真遇到，就以巨角与棍棒般的重拳，争夺地盘。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Combative and stubborn, POKENAME patrol their large territories to make sure no rivals are making their home nearby. When they do encounter a rival, they use their massive horn and powerful club-like fists to battle for the territory.

entry: 同群若有成员受伤，POKENAME就会暴怒肆虐。角击能撞平数百棵树，之后才会疲倦。
author: .izik
source: If a member of its swarm is injured, POKENAME flies into a furious rampage. Its horn strikes can flatten trees by the hundreds before it tires.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉强，密林再浓，也能轻易找到食物。只要储粮被偷一点，就会怒得大肆破坏。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's powerful sense of smell allows it to easily find food within even the densest forests. If any of its hoarded food is stolen, it will fly into a destructive rage.

entry: POKENAME傲慢，爱用带电尾巴逗弄同群伙伴。可电击太弱，其他成员通常根本不理。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are haughty Pokémon that enjoy teasing other members of their herd with their electrified tails. The shocks from their tail are quite weak so other herd members usually ignore them.

entry: POKENAME重蹄踏地，便能召来落雷。碰上角尖或夹在双角间的东西，会迅速遭受强力电击，再被甩开。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME calls down bolts of lightning when it stomps its powerful hooves against the ground. Anything caught upon or between its horns will be quickly met with powerful jolts of electricity before being thrown aside.

entry: POKENAME在树间荡行，将整片森林据为领地。性情极凶，谁若闯入，就扑下，以三尾上的手掌无情痛打。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME swings among trees claiming entire forests as its territory. Highly aggressive, it descends on any intruders and beats them mercilessly with the palms on its three tails.

entry: POKENAME脾气反复，难以预料。闹起来，就会到处狂冲，直到耗尽所有力气。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is highly temperamental and unpredictable. During a tantrum, it charges around wildly until all its energy is spent.

entry: POKENAME不算快，却极善自卫，会用三尾鞭打敌人，再用角猛撞。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME is not a very fast Pokémon, but it is extremely defensive. It whips foes with its three tails and rams into them with its horns.

entry: 过去，POKENAME遭猎捕，皮革被鞋匠制成鞋。植物皮革问世后，它们如今能自由漫游平原与田野。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME were once hunted for their leather hide and made into shoes by cobblers. With the advent of plant leather, they now roam freely in plains and fields.

entry: POKENAME用电尾鞭打同群，引起奔窜。伙伴被电击激起冲势后，POKENAME再引导牛群奔窜的方向，保护族群。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME whip members of their herd with their electrical tails to cause stampedes. As members of their herd are galvanized by the shock, POKENAME direct the direction of the stampede to protect the herd.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，将硬蹄裹上烈焰，令攻击更具破坏力。它容易恼火，在领地内走动，务必格外小心。
author: fiordaliso
source: When fighting, POKENAME covers its hard hooves with burning flames to make its attacks even more devastating. It gets irritated easily, so it is advisable to proceed with extreme caution in its territory.

entry: POKENAME群居，挖出宽阔地道网，只有勤劳的地鼠能比过。它们还会在土中打滚，甩掉附身的虫害。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME live together in a herd and dig a system of wide tunnels that are only outdone by hardworking Diglett. They roll around in dirt to rid themselves of any attached pests.

entry: POKENAME发怒时，会展示角上的叶片。若看见POKENAME亮出这警告，最好别靠近。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME displays leaves on its horns when angered. It is not recommended to approach POKENAME when it is displaying this warning sign.

entry: 皮匠曾把POKENAME制成帽子与衣服，如今它们自由漫游寒地。庞大身体与暖毛，让它们耐得住零下低温。
author: quackquackattack
source: Leatherworkers once made POKENAME into hats and clothing, but nowadays they roam freely in frigid environments. Their large bodies and warm fur allow them to endure subzero temperatures.

entry: POKENAME住在森林，那里粗树众多，足够让它狂暴时猛撞。若没有合适的树，就懊恼地绕圈奔窜，常就此绕个没完。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME makes its home in the forest where there are plenty of thick trees for it to ram during its rampage. If there are no suitable trees, it will stampede in a circle out of frustration, often getting stuck in this loop.

entry: 农夫常用POKENAME，帮忙赶回跑散的牛。个头虽小，重逾一吨的生物，也能制住。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are often used by farmers to help herd runaway cattle. Despite their small size, they can wrangle creatures weighing more than a ton.

entry: POKENAME对他人情绪极为敏感，自然就能感知一定范围内的变化。只要有一丝怒意，就会自己暴怒，试图撞向附近所有人。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME is extremely sensitive to the emotions of others, able to passively sense them within a certain radius. At the slightest presence of anger, it flies into a rage and attempts to ram anyone nearby.

entry: POKENAME用披风挑衅更大的敌人。对方一冲，它就迅速闪开，趁机反击。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME taunts larger opponents with its cape. When the opponent charges, POKENAME swiftly dodges and attacks.

entry: POKENAME尾巴藏着许多细刺，带微毒，会使皮肤不适。战斗时绕着敌人冲，盼用角擦中，或让毒刺尾扫到对方。
author: evilgammon
source: Hidden in POKENAME's tail, many tiny barbs contain a mild poison that causes skin irritation. In battle, it charges in circles around the opponent, hoping to clip them with its horns or brush them with its barbed tail.

entry: POKENAME因自身充沛的怒气显形，越愤怒，现出的身形就越大。可力量再强，也被锁在那颗生出自己的颅骨上，攻击范围有限。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME manifests in response to its anger, of which it has plenty. The angrier it is, the larger its manifestation, but despite its strength, it has a limited range of attack due to being chained to the skull it forms from.

entry: 关都、神奥部分地区的象形文字，似将POKENAME描绘为某种邪神的容器。很可能是它脾气暴烈，随时狂暴破坏，才有这种说法。
author: sk372
source: Hieroglyphs in parts of Kanto and Sinnoh appear to depict POKENAME as being the vessel for some sort of evil deity. This is likely due to its extremely angry personality causing it to go on violent, destructive rampages at a moment's notice.

entry: POKENAME通常温顺，可若觉得幼崽遇险，就会凶猛守住，寸步不让。繁殖季节，双角会更锋利。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is usually quite docile, but it will fiercely stand its ground if it thinks its young is in danger. Its horns are sharper during mating season.

entry: POKENAME身体温顺，头上的嘴却总烦躁地啃咬沿途一切。常因坚韧的深棕毛发而被人驯养。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its body being docile, the mouth on POKENAME's head is always agitated and tries to gnaw anything in its path. POKENAME is often domesticated for its tough dark-brown hair.

entry: 极坚固的金属面罩覆住头部，撞上什么表面也不会受伤。POKENAME会与同类角力，证明力量，争取首领之位。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its head is covered by an extremely solid metal mask that allows it to ram any surface without injury. POKENAME clashes with others of its kind to prove its strength and claim leadership.

entry: 极坚固的金属面罩覆住头部，撞上什么表面也不会受伤。POKENAME会与同类角力，证明力量，争取首领之位。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its head is covered by an extremely solid metal mask that allows it to ram any surface without injury. POKENAME clashes with others of its kind to prove its strength and claim leadership.

entry: POKENAME虽然以凶悍出名，却更爱吃树果和水果。野外，它们以5至10只为一群四处游荡，对同伴的保护欲极强。
author: azalde
source: Despite their reputation for aggression, POKENAME prefer eating berries and fruits. They roam in groups of 5-10 in the wild and are fiercely protective of their herd.

entry: POKENAME一感到灾难将至，就冲进附近城镇，强行推赶、吓走人们，使其离开险区。虽是一片好意，这蛮横救法，却让名声很差。
author: sk372
source: When sensing disaster approaching, POKENAME charges quickly into nearby towns and forcibly pushes and frightens people away from the endangered zone. Though well-meaning, the brute-force method of helping gives it a poor reputation.

entry: POKENAME号称“暴食化身”，胃如无底深渊，食欲永远填不满。不给食，就会狂暴不休；一吃饱，又沉沉睡去。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Known as the 'Embodiment of Gluttony', POKENAME possesses an insatiable appetite. Its stomach resembles a bottomless pit, and it will rampage endlessly if deprived of food. Once full, it falls into a deep sleep.

entry: 据说成群POKENAME漫游宇宙。奔窜的力量，甚至传闻能改变时空。
author: antler_zero_
source: Herds of POKENAME are said to wander the cosmos. It is rumored that the strength of their stampedes is capable of altering space and time.

entry: 小宝可梦常把POKENAME背上的奇特地形，当作安全练场。用角冲撞前，它会猛踏地面，激起强烈震动。
author: fiordaliso
source: Small Pokémon often use the peculiar landform on its back as a safe training arena. Before charging with its horns, POKENAME stomps the ground so forcefully that it triggers potent tremors.

entry: POKENAME的角带微毒，中招者动作会迟缓。双腿虽小，却很有力，战斗时能快速冲锋。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's horns are laced with a weak poison, causing sluggishness in those affected. Even though its legs are small, they are very strong, allowing for fast charges in battle.

entry: 成群POKENAME会奔过开阔平原。人们常养着它们，用于牛仔竞技中的赶牛。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: Herds of POKENAME can be found stampeding across open plains. They are often kept as pets for rodeo herding.

entry: POKENAME见不得不道德的行为，因此常加入当地警队。POKENAME偶尔独自巡视，悄悄搜捕各种罪犯，从小破坏者到火箭队成员，都不放过。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME are often found in the workforce of local police due to their intolerance for immoral actions. POKENAME occasionally patrol areas by their lonesome to discreetly hunt for all sorts of criminals, from petty vandals to Team Rocket members.

entry: POKENAME先给双角通电，再全速冲锋。它极其骄傲，难以驯服、训练。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME electrifies its horns before charging at full speed. It is an extremely proud Pokémon that is difficult to tame and train.

entry: 三尾上的三颗星若全亮，便说明怒极，即将全力发作。POKENAME踏动重蹄，激出猛烈电流冲击波。
author: fiordaliso
source: When all three stars on its tails glow, it means it is furious and about to unleash its full ferocity. POKENAME stamps its hooves on the ground to generate violent electric shockwaves.

entry: POKENAME常成群顶角嬉闹，假打玩耍。它们耐力惊人，连跑几个小时，也不必休息。
author: melodydelune
source: Herds of POKENAME play by locking their horns in play fights. They have high stamina and can run for hours without rest.

entry: POKENAME容易发怒，会直冲怒气来源。一撞上，就用尾巴不断痛打目标。
author: bacondlx
source: Enraged easily, POKENAME charges directly at the source of its ire. Once it makes contact, it uses its tails to relentlessly strike its target.

entry: POKENAME奔驰时，炮管迅速蓄力。它爱和肯泰罗群奔过稀树草原，只有同群遭遇性命之危，才会开炮。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's cannon charges rapidly while it gallops. It prefers to stampede with packs of Tauros across savannahs, only firing its cannon when they face mortal danger.

entry: POKENAME越怒，身体越热。怒到极点，多尾便燃成熊熊烈焰，推着身体前冲，让冲撞更具破坏力。
author: sk372
source: The angrier POKENAME gets, the more heated its body becomes. If angered enough, its many tails ignite to become a blazing inferno that propels it forward and makes its charge attacks even more devastating.

entry: POKENAME自封肯泰罗群首领，旅途中会用藤蔓抽打同群，催它们前进。
author: hophoppip
source: As the self-styled leader of a herd of Tauros, POKENAME whips its herd with vines to keep them moving when they travel.

entry: POKENAME本就凶暴，若见孩子行为不端，更会火上浇油。攻击前，拉链嘴张开，发出不属此世的吼声。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's already aggressive nature is exacerbated if it witnesses badly-behaved children. Its zipper-mouth opens up to let loose an otherworldly bellow just before it attacks.

entry: POKENAME常结成大群。只要一只受伤或遭到威胁，全群就会迅速反击。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME tend to live in large herds with each other. Whenever any in the herd are hurt or threatened, the entire herd is quick to strike back.

entry: 野生POKENAME只在合众地区以西的荒地被发现过。若信任训练家，能载许多人、宝可梦与物资；换了别人，就全速追赶。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: Wild POKENAME have only been naturally found in desolate badlands west of the Unova region. For a trusted Trainer, they can carry many people, Pokémon, and supplies. To anyone else, they'll drive after them at full speed.

entry: POKENAME领地意识很强，谁近就狠抽。鞭子能烧得很烫，在目标身上留下严重的烧伤状疤痕。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very territorial and will viscously whip anyone who comes near. The whips can get quite hot and will leave nasty burn-like scars on the victim's body.

entry: POKENAME可爱又带乡野质朴，很适合互动动物园。受到许多关爱，也会让攻性减弱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a cute yet rustic look that makes them a great candidate for petting zoos. Their aggressiveness gets dampened by all the affection they receive.

entry: POKENAME宽翼让它能以无可比拟的速度，俯冲猎物。头上一对铁硬巨角，既击敌，也捕猎，力道连挡路的树也能推倒。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's broad wings allow it to swoop down on its prey with unmatched speed. A pair of iron-hard horns atop its head are used to strike foes and prey alike, with enough force to topple even the trees in its path.

entry: POKENAME眼前覆毛，视力差，改靠灵敏嗅觉察觉闯入者，再冲上去，以锐角刺中。
author: sk372
source: Due to the fur over its eyes, POKENAME has poor vision. It instead relies on its strong sense of smell to perceive intruders to charge down and nail with the sharp horns on its head.

entry: POKENAME被视为最狂野的动物之一，暴怒破坏，毫无分辨。甚至有人见POKENAME睡着也在横甩乱打，狂怒从不停歇。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is considered one of the wildest of animals, rampaging violently and indiscriminately. POKENAME has even been observed thrashing and lashing out in its sleep, never stopping its perpetual raging.

entry: 听歌声的高低，就能知道POKENAME生没生气。真正冲锋之前，声音反而会轻得如耳语。
author: mrpeach774
source: You can tell a POKENAME is angry by the pitch of its song. Its voice drops to a whisper when it is about to charge.

entry: POKENAME用尾焰烘热头角，变得更加危险。脾气虽冲动，可甜食一摆在面前，很快就能平静。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses the flames on its tails to heat the horns on its head, making it even more dangerous. Although it has a very impulsive temperament, it can be quickly calmed in the presence of sweet-tasting food.

entry: POKENAME臂上的花散出香气，暂时改变闻到者多种激素的水平，使其更易发怒，也更爱冒无谓的险。
author: bobosmith01
source: The flowers on POKENAME's arms emit a fragrance that temporarily affects the level of various hormones in those who catch the scent. This causes the victim to have heightened levels of both anger and engagement in unnecessary risk-taking.

entry: POKENAME会在空中彼此争斗，直到一只被击落。夜里，则寻找熟睡的肯泰罗群，以獠牙刺穿厚皮，吸食血液。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will clash with each other in the air, often fighting until one is knocked from the sky. At night, they will seek out sleeping herds of Tauros, piercing their thick hide with their fangs before consuming their blood.

entry: POKENAME勇敢固执，想也不想就冲入战斗。大棒与角由同种材料构成，能打穿土岩，用来标记领地。
author: silverscloudy
source: Brave and headstrong, POKENAME rushes into battle without thinking. Its club and horns are made of the same material, using them to break through earth and rock to mark its territory.

entry: POKENAME通常沉睡，一点点吸取领地内生灵的生命力。若被叫醒，就会暴怒，攻击近旁一切。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is usually asleep. It absorbs the life force of those in its domain, little by little. If awakened, it flies into a rage and lashes out at anything nearby.

entry: POKENAME双翼太蓬松脆弱，经不起水洗，否则羽下积湿，就会发霉。它改在奔跑时，借蹄下扬起的沙尘清洁。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME's wings are too fluffy and delicate to be washed in water, otherwise its feathers will get moldy from the moisture trapped beneath them. Instead, this Pokémon cleans itself with the sand and dust from under its hooves whenever it runs.

entry: POKENAME模样虽吓人，却相当温和，常慢慢走在训练家身旁。可训练家若绊一下，又能迅速反应，及时拦住，不让对方跌倒。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Despite their intimidating appearance, POKENAME are quite gentle, usually seen lumbering slowly next to their Trainer. Should their Trainer stumble, POKENAME will react with quick reflexes to prevent a fall.

entry: POKENAME容易动怒，谁惹它，就能毫不犹豫地全力冲撞。甚至会抓住敌人，朝任意硬物猛砸。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is quick to anger and has no issue charging full force at anyone that irritates it. It will even grab its opponents to smash them into any hard surface it desires.

entry: POKENAME冲撞本身并不太强，可碰撞时，背上蘑菇会散孢子，削弱敌人肌肉，使其更经不起后续头槌。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's charging tackle isn't very strong on its own, but the mushrooms on its back release spores on impact that weaken the muscles of its foe, leaving them more susceptible to follow-up headbutts.

entry: 融合让POKENAME兼得肯泰罗的狂暴脾气，以及鬃岩狼人的敏捷与专注。发怒时更加危险，动作太快，冲撞几乎躲不开。
author: sk372
source: Fusion has given POKENAME the rampaging temper of Tauros with Lycanroc's agility and focus. This makes it much more dangerous when angered, as its quick movements make avoiding its charge next to impossible.

entry: POKENAME高速冲入战斗，凭巨角与甲身碾压挡路之物。小肢体上的刀片状利刃，也受宝可梦屠夫看重，借精准切割处理肉品。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME charges into battle with immense speed, using its huge horns and plated body to overwhelm anything in its way. The knife-like blades on its smaller limbs make it highly valued by Pokémon butchers, who use its precise cuts to prepare meat.

entry: POKENAME栖地设有警示牌，提醒过客。游客常把可爱大眼误当成天真无害，其实它对陌生者十分凶猛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME habitats have put up signs warning travelers about its presence. Tourists falsely confuse its cute, wide-eyed appearance for innocence, when it is actually quite aggressive towards strangers.

entry: POKENAME一狂暴，就向附近所有会动的东西掷匕首。POKENAME常会扯下自己的角，做成这些匕首。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: When POKENAME enters a rampage, it will throw daggers at everything nearby that moves. POKENAME often rips off its horns and turns them into daggers.

entry: 突如其来的身体接触，很容易惹怒POKENAME，连坚果掉到头上也不例外。它们边狂乱扭动，边冒浓烟，重蹄烫得地面焦黑。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are easy to enrage with any sudden, physical contact; even a hard nut falling upon one's head would enrage it. They emit thick smoke as they thrash around, their hooves burning so hot that they sear the ground.

entry: POKENAME的蜇刺虽不危及性命，毒液却能造成超过三天的剧痛。除非被招惹，它似乎只盯肯泰罗与大奶罐。
author: mistymagius
source: While POKENAME's sting isn't life-threatening, its venom can cause excruciating pain lasting over three days. Unless provoked, it only seems to target Tauros and Miltank.

entry: POKENAME爱彼此冲撞，可头太软，撞上反而互相弹开。奔跑时旋转尾巴，身后留下油、焦糖洋葱与烤肉的香味。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME love to charge at each other, but their heads are so soft that they bounce off each other. They spin their tails as they run, leaving the smell of oil, caramelised onion, and grilled meat behind them.

entry: POKENAME常见于农场，可农夫更愿让别的宝可梦下田。它没耐心，可能突然丢下活计，怒得胡乱攻击。
author: jangodiot
source: While usually found on farms, farmers prefer other Pokémon for field work. POKENAME has little patience and may abandon tasks suddenly, lashing out in a fit of rage.

entry: POKENAME背上的花园，种子全来自吃下的东西。背部隆起储住接来的雨水，让POKENAME与植物都得到滋养。
author: ohok3441
source: The garden atop POKENAME are made up of seeds from whatever they eat. The hump stores rainwater caught, keeping both POKENAME and their plants nourished.

entry: POKENAME一进农场，就常自发承担放牧其他牛类宝可梦的职责。帮忙、工作时，是它们最开心的时候。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME, when placed in a farm, has consistently taken the role of herding other cattle Pokémon. They are most happy when assisting others or working.

entry: 野生POKENAME常与各种宝可梦成群，连原本独居的物种也有。不少个体头顶的盘状部位，还长着各式植物宝可梦。
author: ohok3441
source: In the wild, POKENAME have been found in herds of various Pokémon, even species that are more solitary. Many have even been spotted with various plant Pokémon growing in their head dish.

entry: POKENAME用尾焰烘热头角，变得更加危险。脾气虽冲动，可甜食一摆在面前，很快就能平静。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses the flames on its tails to heat the horns on its head, making it even more dangerous. Although it has a very impulsive temperament, it can be quickly calmed in the presence of sweet-tasting food.

entry: 训练家得留神别站在POKENAME身后。这些暴脾气，会用火尾抽打身后一切来者，可事后又常感到懊悔。
author: quackquackattack
source: Trainers need to be wary of standing behind POKENAME, as these temperamental creatures whip anyone behind them with their flaming tails. They are often remorseful after the fact.

entry: POKENAME大群掘地，穿过草原远行。不停翻动土壤，大大促进了植物生长。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME travels in large herds while tunneling across prairies. Their constant churning of soil greatly improves plant growth.

entry: POKENAME唯一有耐心做的细活，就是雕制大棒。每天花数小时，确保每道棱纹完美，好充分发挥钝击力。狂暴时，也只有做这件事才能平静。
author: thordemidgard
source: The only delicate activity a POKENAME is patient enough to do is carving clubs. It will spend several hours a day ensuring every ridge is perfect to efficiently use all its blunt force. When it goes on a rampage, it can only calm down by doing this.

entry: POKENAME的惊人肌力，与脾气相连。有时会拉自己的尾巴，弄痛、激怒自己，换来战斗中的力量提升。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's formidable muscle strength is tied to its temper. It will sometimes pull on its own tail to hurt and anger itself in order to get a power boost in battle.

entry: POKENAME受威胁时，会把藤蔓抽得如鞭作响，吓退来袭者。藤蔓也能用来荡树，或当套索，捉住猎物。
author: mistymagius
source: When threatened, POKENAME will crack its vines like a whip to scare off its attacker. It will also use it vines to swing from trees and to catch it prey like a lasso.

entry: POKENAME速度快、意志坚定，是宝可梦竞速的热门选择，却不好控制。一冲起来，不撞上东西就不肯停。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME are a popular choice for Pokémon racing due to their high speed and determination, but they can be difficult to control. Once they start charging, they won't stop until they hit something.

entry: POKENAME迁过平原，用腿尾划水渡河，寻找更丰美草场。每年旅程完成，就会心满意足地叫着，踢蹄向空。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME migrate across plains and paddle across rivers with their legs and tail to reach greener pastures. They let out a satisfied cry and kick their hooves into the air after completing their yearly journey.

entry: POKENAME似乎特别爱撞金属宝可梦。有人推测，是磁力让它的头槌变得更快、更有力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME seems especially disposed towards charging down metallic Pokémon. It is theorized this is due to its magnetism letting it increase the speed and force of its headbutt attacks.

entry: 稀有的POKENAME总带着桦木棍，末端像皮革鞭梢。用来战斗毫无困难，POKENAME修补枝棍的本领，与痛击敌人的技巧一样高。
author: bobosmith01
source: The rare POKENAME is always found carrying a birch stick with leathery whip-like ends. It has no problem using it in combat; POKENAME shows as much skill at repairing the branch as it has skill in wreaking havoc on foes.

entry: POKENAME会猛撞一切进入领地的东西。双头可能各锁定不同目标，令冲锋途中方向突然乱变。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will aggressively charge at anything encroaching its territory. Its two heads may lock on to different targets to chase down, leading to sudden and erratic direction changes mid-charge.

entry: POKENAME三头总在争吵，因此一直愤怒，为一点小事也能狂暴。通常直到三个头撞上彼此，晕眩或昏倒，才算结束。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's three heads are always arguing, thus it is always angry and ready to rampage over the smallest of things. Its rampage tends to end when its three heads ram one another, thus dazing, or knocking out, themselves.

entry: 许多人说，它是会喷毒气的闹鬼肯泰罗颅骨。若置之不理，不知情的肯泰罗群可能跑过毒雾，使POKENAME数量激增。
author: lampent12
source: Many claim it is a haunted Tauros skull that spews toxic gas. If left alone, herds of unsuspecting Tauros may run through the gas, spiking the POKENAME population.

entry: 有人说，它是最凶悍肯泰罗的化身，出没牧场，袭击整群牛，逼得农夫发狂。
author: spagalapof
source: Some say it is the incarnation of the deadliest Tauros. It haunts pastures, attacking entire herds and driving farmers mad.

entry: POKENAME喜欢拿野生肯泰罗练催眠。POKENAME先挑衅，诱其冲来，再让它在半途睡着。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME enjoys practicing its hypnosis on wild Tauros. POKENAME will taunt the Tauros into charging at it and then put it to sleep mid-charge.

entry: 背上的种子能吸收水中杂质，可POKENAME一不小心，也可能自己中毒。藤蔓太细，举不起东西，只好毫无用处地垂在身旁。
author: fiordaliso
source: The bulb growing on its back can absorb impurities from the water, though if POKENAME isn't careful, it risks becoming poisoned itself. Its vines are too thin to lift objects, so they simply dangle from its body without a purpose.

entry: POKENAME弱得可怜，战斗中毫无用处，却是值钱的鱼饵。因此还形成了成万繁育的产业。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are pitifully weak and worthless in battle, but they are valuable as fishing bait. An entire industry exists for breeding tens of thousands of them.

entry: POKENAME住在恶臭沼泽，躲开危险宝可梦，偶尔外出，搜集废弃骨头筑巢。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives in fetid swamps, hiding away from dangerous Pokémon. It ventures out to collect discarded bones to build its nest.

entry: POKENAME出拳极慢，准备到打向对手，得花整整一分钟。拳头又弱得可怜，打个枕头，都会弄伤自己。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's punches are extremely slow; it takes an entire minute for it to get ready and throw one at an opponent. Its punches are so horribly weak that it will hurt itself if it punches a pillow.

entry: POKENAME出拳极慢，准备到打向敌人，得花整整一分钟。拳头又弱得可怜，打个沙发坐垫，都会弄伤自己。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's punches are extremely slow; it takes an entire minute for it to get ready and throw one at a foe. Its punches are so horribly weak that it will hurt itself if it punches a couch cushion.

entry: 身体太硬，多数未进化宝可梦还没来得及刺穿，POKENAME就已扑腾着溜走。可敏捷的飞行属性宝可梦，照样能以粗爪抓回巢中。
author: bobosmith01
source: Their bodies are too hard for most unevolved Pokémon to pierce through before POKENAME flops away. Unfortunately, nothing stops a swift Flying-type Pokémon from hauling it away to its nest in its thick talons.

entry: POKENAME的鳍小，容易被海流卷走，因此漂游海上。头上的鳍常被认作王冠，遇险时，它们会喷出墨汁。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME drift around at sea, as their fins are small and are easily washed away by currents. The fin on their head is often mistaken for a crown, and they spit out ink when in danger.

entry: POKENAME游遍海洋，大鳍让它们随意转向。最终，还会长出很大的冠状鳍。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wander throughout the ocean. Their fins are large, allowing them to change course as they please. They will eventually have a very large crown fin.

entry: POKENAME常被当宠物，养在后院池塘。鲜橙鳞片、黄角与长须，深受养鱼爱好者欢迎。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are kept in backyard ponds as pets. Their bright orange scales and their yellow horns and whiskers make them popular choices among fish enthusiasts.

entry: POKENAME个头大，又偏爱宽敞住处，许多训练家很难养好。因此，能养得POKENAME快快乐乐，也成了富裕的象征。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many Trainers struggle to keep POKENAME as pets due to their large size, as they prefer wide enclosures. As such, having a happy POKENAME is a sign of wealth.

entry: POKENAME中央，似有一条鲤鱼王操控身体。人们认为，POKENAME将奇异能量注入这条鱼，确保未来进化得更强。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME contains what appears to be a Magikarp in the center, controlling its actions. It's thought that POKENAME channels strange energy into it, ensuring a more powerful evolution in its future.

entry: POKENAME表演时，最爱扮不幸受害者。这个角色，倒很适合弱小又脆弱的它。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME loves to play the role of a hapless victim in its performances. This is a role it is well-suited to, as it is incredibly weak and frail.

entry: POKENAME想以舞姿迷住观众。可不管陆上水里，动作都太笨拙、抖得厉害，总没法博得赞赏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tries to captivate audiences with its dance moves. However, whether on land or in the water, its body movements are too awkward and jittery, so it always fails to impress.

entry: 这只传说中的海兽，经融合技术，恢复了远古的辉煌模样。可力量，还是弱得可怜。
author: brienie
source: A legendary creature of the sea, restored to its ancient glory through fusion technology. Its power, however, is still weak and pathetic.

entry: 传闻这只融合宝可梦，远比普通鲤鱼王强。可仍弱得很，实在难以分出差别。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: Rumor has it that this fusion is far more powerful than an ordinary Magikarp. However, it's still so weak that it's hard to tell the difference.

entry: POKENAME以水草为生，整日藏在水下叶丛。背上排排毒刺，能吓阻天敌。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live on aquatic plants and spend their days underwater hiding amongst the plant fronds. They have poisonous barbs along their back to discourage predators.

entry: POKENAME常被渔夫错当成异色暴鲤龙。据说遇见它，既是好运也是坏运的征兆。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME are often mistaken for shiny Gyarados by fishermen. Encountering one is said to be a sign of both good and bad luck.

entry: 它喜欢帮人渡水，可泳技太差，只能慢慢载一个人。拉普拉斯群往往出于同情，才让POKENAME跟着。
author: sk372
source: It likes to help humans across the water, but has weak swimming skills, so it can only ferry a single person at a slow pace. Lapras herds tend to keep POKENAME around out of pity.

entry: POKENAME脆弱的遗传构成，容易受外界影响，破坏适应环境的本领。因此无论在哪儿，若无人相助，都很难活下去。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's frail genetic makeup is easily influenced by outside factors, ruining its ability to adapt in environments. As a result, it struggles to survive anywhere without requiring assistance.

entry: POKENAME虽游得不快，姿态却已十分优雅。可据说上岸后，明明四爪健全，仍只会笨拙扑腾。尽管被看轻，研究者却推测，长须能察觉将至雷雨。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME have adapted to be graceful swimmers despite not being very fast. It is said when on land they awkwardly flop about, despite having four working paws. Despite their reputation, researchers speculate their whiskers detect incoming rainstorms.

entry: 据说POKENAME曾颇强，数十年间却日渐衰弱。身体由水样分子构成，哪怕鳞片鲜红，也能在水下隐去。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME are said to have once been fairly strong, however they have grown weaker over decades. They are said to be comprised of water-like molecules which allow them to vanish underwater despite their bright red scales.

entry: POKENAME的壳阻碍游泳，反成大累赘。壳本身又软，连保护POKENAME也不太有效。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's shell restrains its swimming capabilities, making it a great hindrance rather than a benefit. The shell itself is also soft, making it rather ineffective in defending POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME漂在水面，硬壳能挡住多数攻击。可行动不便，也常被大嘴鸥和巨牙鲨带走。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's tough shell protects them from most attacks as they float on the water's surface. They are often carried away by Pelipper and Sharpedo due to their lack of mobility.

entry: POKENAME蜿蜒爬过海床，没有大鳍或鳍肢帮助游泳。它会咬住其他水生宝可梦，附着远行，长途寻找食物。
author: quackquackattack
source: Slithering across the ocean floor, POKENAME lack major fins or flippers to help them swim. Their mouths help them travel by biting onto other aquatic Pokémon, latching on and traveling great distances in search of food.

entry: POKENAME常懒躺沙滩，一天睡12小时。醒着时，就潜入海中，帮助其他水生宝可梦找食物与庇护所。
author: quackquackattack
source: Often seen lazing around on the beach, POKENAME sleep for 12 hours a day. While awake, they dive into the ocean to help other aquatic Pokémon find food and shelter.

entry: POKENAME用蜇刺制服小型淡水宝可梦。刺太弱，比角金鱼大的就麻痹不了；人被蜇到，也几乎感觉不到。
author: reflecbeat
source: POKENAME uses its sting to immobilise small freshwater Pokémon. The sting is so mild that it won't stun anything larger than a Goldeen, and if a human is stung, they will only barely feel it.

entry: 将鲤鱼王与最强生命体融合的实验，的确成功了。可即便如此，也没能给鲤鱼王添上什么了不起的力量。
author: brienie
source: Experiments to fuse a Magikarp with the strongest lifeform were a success. However, it was still not enough to give Magikarp any noteworthy power.

entry: POKENAME把泡泡当毛线球玩。若冒出特别大的，就会跳上去，躺着休息。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be found playing with bubbles as if they are balls of yarn. If a particularly big bubble forms, they will bounce and lounge atop it.

entry: POKENAME模样像其他宝可梦，某些节庆中，摄影师会请它摆姿势。可它冷淡、不爱拍照，得用树果利诱，才肯望向镜头。
author: quackquackattack
source: Photographers pose POKENAME during certain holiday festivals due to their resemblance to other Pokémon. They are aloof and uninterested in photo shoots, and so are bribed with berries to focus on the camera.

entry: POKENAME成群聚在水边，为最好的喝水点争吵。速度快、力量却弱，闹得再激烈，也很少留下持久伤害。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flock together along the water's edge and will squabble with one another for the best drinking spots. They're fast but weak, their fights rarely causing any lasting damage despite how frenetic they can get.

entry: POKENAME游得飞快，还能跃出水面，滑翔好几米，再潜回深水。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is an extremely fast swimmer that can jump out of the water and glide many meters before diving back into the depths.

entry: POKENAME身体圆滚柔软，长着两根能导电的长触角。入夜，POKENAME会大群聚集，闪出绚烂灯光。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are rotund and squishy, with two long antennae that conduct electricity. At night, POKENAME gather in large groups to produce a dazzling array of lights.

entry: POKENAME圆滚软绵，得靠带电长须自保。可电力太弱，天敌最多只觉一丝静电刺感，让POKENAME几乎毫无防备。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is rotund and squishy, requiring electric whiskers for protection. Unfortunately, its electric power is so weak that an attacking predator would feel no more than a faint static tingle, leaving POKENAME effectively defenseless.

entry: POKENAME圆身双足，长尾末端有鳍，能弹跳，也能在水下游泳。受惊时，POKENAME会将尾巴举过头，显得更大。
author: quackquackattack
source: Rotund and bipedal, POKENAME has a long tail with a fin at the end, used for both bouncing and swimming underwater. When scared, POKENAME raises its tail above its head to appear larger.

entry: POKENAME住在河湖附近，性情冷淡，又爱睡，一天最多睡18小时。谁拉长须，就会发怒。
author: quackquackattack
source: Found near lakes and ponds, POKENAME are aloof and sleepy, sleeping up to 18 hours a day. They get angry when anyone pulls their whiskers.

entry: POKENAME聚在水面，吃其他宝可梦留下的残渣。受威胁时，将周身三颗水泡胀大，乘风飘走。
author: fancyskunk
source: POKENAME gather on the water's surface, feeding on scraps left behind by other Pokémon. When threatened, they inflate the three water bubbles around their bodies and float away on the wind.

entry: POKENAME朝训练家吐水，表达爱意。若吐出的水清澈，便说明与训练家更亲密，因此POKENAME常花数小时过滤，献给最喜欢的人。
author: firstromaniandiscoerd
source: As a way to show affection, POKENAME spits water at its Trainer. If the water POKENAME spits out is clear, then it has a better relation to their Trainer, so POKENAME often spends hours filtering it for its favourite people.

entry: POKENAME较为离群，觉得受威胁，就藏上高树。还会吹出小阵风，将高处藏身地的食物吹落。
author: dill360yt
source: POKENAME is a relatively isolated Pokémon that hides high in trees if it feels like it is being threatened. It can blow small gusts of wind to dislodge food from the high places it hides in.

entry: POKENAME爱伏在泥中，保持皮肤湿润。鳍与长须，还能从泥土震动，察觉地震的早期征兆。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy lurking in the mud, as it helps keep their skin hydrated. The fins and whiskers can detect early signs of earthquakes through the vibrations in the mud.

entry: 暴雨后，POKENAME开心地在泥洼扑腾。玩耍若被打扰，就从嘴中射出强劲水柱，还击对方。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME joyfully flops in muddy puddles after heavy storms. If disturbed during playtime, it retaliates with powerful jets of water from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME天资聪颖，却白白浪费潜能。整天自鸣得意，钻研些无意义、无用处、毫无道理的话题。
author: leeto64
source: POKENAME have gifted minds, but wasted potentials. They waste their intellect smugly pondering meaningless, useless and senseless topics all day.

entry: POKENAME背花能吸收水中杂质，因不断使用，已经泛黄。POKENAME靠藤蔓吓退天敌，让自己看起来像大型猎手。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of absorbing impurities in water with the flower on their back, which has a yellow tint from their constant use. POKENAME rely on their vines to scare predators away, since the vines make them appear like a big predator.

entry: POKENAME太小，因此会聚成至少50只的大群。POKENAME相处越久，动作越同步，整群甚至像同一只巨大宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: Because POKENAME are so small, they congregate in massive groups of at least 50 individuals. The longer POKENAME live together, the more synchronized their movements become, to the point a large group can appear as a single, large Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的鳍总露在外，壳挡不住鸟啄。爆炸连贴在身旁也几乎感觉不到，这招毫无威胁。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's shell is ineffective at protecting it from bird pecks since its fins always stick out. Its explosions can be barely felt even directly next to it, making this attack a non-threat.

entry: POKENAME极弱又胆小，遇险就把头埋进土、沙或泥中。可身体其余部分仍露在外，反而更容易被捕食。
author: sk372
source: Extremely weak and timid, POKENAME tries to hide from danger by burying its head into dirt, sand or mud. However, because the rest of its body remains exposed, this only makes it more vulnerable to being preyed upon.

entry: POKENAME尾部肌肉不够强，钻不出藏身洞，只好把尾巴插在表面，再慢慢扭转全身。过程漫长，又笨拙得很。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lacks the muscle strength in its tail to properly drill holes to hide in. Instead it sticks its tail into a surface and slowly twists its whole body around in an incredibly lengthy and unwieldy process.

entry: 高大瀑布旁，常能看见POKENAME，想用爪子爬到顶端。可每次，没爬到就先累了。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME is commonly seen around tall waterfalls, using its claws to climb to the top. However, it always gets tired before it can reach its goal.

entry: POKENAME肌肉虽弱，却固执地不断向地下深处钻。有人相信，只要钻得够深，压力就能逼它进化。
author: .jerden
source: Despite their weak muscles, POKENAME stubbornly persist in burrowing ever deeper underground. It is believed that if they go deep enough, the pressure will force them to evolve.

entry: POKENAME饿了，会撕开渔网，吃里面的渔获。长泳之后，便扑上岩石浅滩，花数小时晾干，避免氧化。
author: amityblamity
source: When hungry, POKENAME tears into fishing nets to feast on the haul within. After long swims, it flops onto rocky shoals and spends several hours drying to avoid oxidizing.

entry: POKENAME游泳时，角常卡进岩缝或礁间，得几小时才能脱身。它特别爱蜂蜜与熟树果，人们常拿来作饵，将它引出栖居的水域。
author: fiordaliso
source: Because of its horn, POKENAME often gets stuck between rocks or reefs while swimming, taking several hours to free itself. It has a strong fondness for honey and ripe Berries, which are commonly used as bait to lure it out of the waters it inhabits.

entry: POKENAME鳞片太热，离水太久，就会失去鱼形，熔成一摊。直到回到水里，才恢复。
author: glimmerowo.3024
source: POKENAME's scales are so hot that if they stray from the water for too long, they'll lose their fish-like shape and become a molten puddle until returned to the water.

entry: POKENAME把腮帮探入河中，感知可能的食物。可它们不会游，取食时常被水冲走。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME will dip their jowls into rivers to sense potential food. However, they cannot swim, often getting swept away when they try to get food.

entry: POKENAME成群游在平静湖面，用喇叭般的叫声交流。会潜水找植物吃，可泳技差，潜不深。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swim together at the surface of placid lakes, honking at one another to communicate. They feed by diving beneath the water and searching for plants, though they are poor swimmers and cannot dive deep.

entry: 虽然弱小，嗅觉却极敏锐。钻进河泥，捕取更小的猎物维生。
author: metalocif
source: This weak Pokémon has a remarkable sense of smell. It survives by digging into river mud and gathering smaller prey for sustenance.

entry: POKENAME聚在海底热液喷口，享受暖意，觅食后也能休息。海水若污染，珊瑚枝就变色，使POKENAME疼痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gather around underwater hydrothermal vents, which provide a soothing warmth and a place to rest after searching for food. If the sea becomes polluted, the coral stalks become discolored, causing POKENAME pain.

entry: POKENAME游得快又准，连水手伸在海面高处的手中零食，也能叼走。若向海面撒食物，往往就会引来大群POKENAME。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are fast and precise swimmers, able to snatch a snack out of a sailor's hand high above the ocean's surface. Crowds of POKENAME often appear if food is scattered across the ocean surface.

entry: POKENAME体内产生大量墨汁，想当弹丸发射。可嘴部肌肉太弱，最后只流出大股黑墨。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME creates a large amount of ink within its body to use as projectiles, but because its mouth muscles are rather weak, the ink only comes out in a copious dark dribble instead.

entry: POKENAME把鲤鱼王装进袋中，试着照料。可察觉不周，动作又笨，袋里的鲤鱼王通常活不了多久。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will house Magikarp in their bags, attempting to care for them. Due to their lack of awareness and poor motor skills, these Magikarp don't typically survive for long.

entry: POKENAME把身体藏在水旁高草，只将尾巴挪到头后，扭动着装作搁浅的鲤鱼王。猎物一近，就缠紧，整个吞下。
author: darkwolfe
source: POKENAME lure prey by hiding their body in long grass next to water, moving their tail behind their head and wriggling to appear like a beached Magikarp. When prey comes near, they constrict and swallow it whole.

entry: POKENAME漂在世界各片海洋，是水生物种。胃能扩张，装下平常三倍的食物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are an aquatic Pokémon species that float in the world's many oceans. Its stomach can expand to hold three times its normal capacity in food.

entry: POKENAME弱小迟缓，连原生栖地也过得艰难。明明是水生，游泳却常吃力，水陆两处都狼狈扑腾。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME is weak and slow, struggling even in its natural habitat. Despite its aquatic nature, it often has difficulty swimming, floundering on both land and water.

entry: POKENAME很弱，可大个头骗得多数生物以为相反。它极为自豪于鳞片洁净，以及长长的须。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are considerably weak, though their large bodies trick most others into believing differently. They take great pride in how clean they keep their scales and in how long their barbels grow.

entry: POKENAME水鬃里住着小鱼宝可梦。小鱼替它清除毛中虫宝可梦与杂物，POKENAME则保护它们。可一发怒，会煮沸水鬃，意外将小鱼烫死。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME has tiny fish Pokémon living in its watery mane. They remove small insect Pokémon and debris from its fur while POKENAME protects them. When this Pokémon gets angry, it boils its mane, accidentally killing the fish in the process.

entry: POKENAME泳技糟透，常随海流漂荡。经过污水时，身体又会自然在身后，留出一条净水带。
author: pixlhoopa
source: POKENAME's abysmal ability to swim results in it often being found drifting along in a current. As it passes through polluted water, it naturally creates a purified path in its wake.

entry: POKENAME尾巴有助在陆上行走时平衡，可拿来游泳却很困难，因此POKENAME通常留在浅水。
author: fireflower20002
source: The tail of POKENAME helps them balance when walking on land. They have trouble swimming with their tail, so POKENAME will usually stay in shallow waters.

entry: POKENAME是狡猾的小坏蛋，一心对别人施咒。可施法本领太可怜，幸亏如此，受害者大多刚挨咒，咒就无用地消散。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a devious little ne'er-do-well always intent on casting hexes on others. Fortunately for its victims, its spell-casting ability is rather pitiful, and most of its curses fizzle out uselessly almost immediately.

entry: POKENAME完全不会游，水边若无人看顾，甚至可能溺死。传闻野生POKENAME已灭绝，可训练家因外貌而饲养的太多，因此没被列为濒危。
author: darkwolfe
source: POKENAME are completely unable to swim and have been known to drown if unsupervised near water. POKENAME are rumoured to be extinct in the wild, however, so many are kept by Trainers for their appearance that they are not listed as endangered.

entry: POKENAME常在冰湖游泳。可身体不耐寒，往往抖个不停，甚至冻成整块冰。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are often found swimming in icy lakes. However, their bodies are not suited for the cold, leaving them shivering and even frozen solid most of the time.

entry: POKENAME在水陆都能高跃，直上空中数英里。可风常把它吹离起跳处老远，让POKENAME气得使出跃起，乱扑腾。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can perform incredibly high jumps from both water and land, hurling itself miles into the air. Unfortunately, the wind often carries it somewhere far from where it initially hopped, which will cause POKENAME to Splash around in frustration.

entry: POKENAME遇到威胁，就蜷成刺球，盲目乱滚。虽多少护住自己，可尖刺没覆盖的地方，仍极易受击。
author: .jerden
source: When faced with any threat, POKENAME will curl up into a spiky ball, then blindly roll around. Although this partially protects it, it will be highly vulnerable to attacks directed at places its spines do not cover.

entry: POKENAME身体太弱，游不快，只能吃其他宝可梦的剩食。唯一防线，是额前带毒的冠状突起。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME must make do with the leftovers of other Pokémon, as its body is still too weak to swim with any speed. Its only line of defense is the venomous crest on its forehead.

entry: POKENAME常困在潮池。短腿不能在陆上移动，只好藏进泥中，借毒刺抵御沿岸天敌，等潮水回来。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME often get stuck in tide pools. Their stubby legs don't permit movement on land so they hide in mud, using their toxic spines as protection from coastal predators until the tide rolls back in.

entry: POKENAME想用鬼魅外貌吓人，可哭声狼狈、力气又可怜，总是失败。幽灵之力再强，也只能勉强挪动几颗轻小石子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its ghostly appearance to try to intimidate others. This fails due to its inelegant blubbering cries and its pitiful strength; even at its strongest, its ghostly powers can barely move a few light pebbles around.

entry: POKENAME在净水厂工作，工人会监督，确保供给人们安全饮水。背花不停过滤杂质，每分钟能净化五升水。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME work at water treatment plants where they are monitored by workers to ensure that people receive safe and drinkable water. The flower on their back constantly filters out impurities and is capable of purifying five liters a minute.

entry: 鲤鱼王群有时受一只或多只POKENAME守护。鱼群准备动身时，它们会找回掉队者，谁也不肯落下。
author: afilthycasual
source: Schools of Magikarp are sometimes protected by one or more POKENAME. They gather stragglers when the group is ready to move, refusing to leave anyone behind.

entry: 毛发状突起模仿鲤鱼王，让敌人误以为它弱得无法还手。不过，这招给POKENAME带来的麻烦往往比好处多。
author: mistymagius
source: Its hair-like protrusion mimics a Magikarp, tricking opponents into thinking it's too weak to fight back. However, this often causes more problems for POKENAME than anything else.

entry: POKENAME是凶猛猎手，用钓竿般的肢体骗其他水属性宝可梦。可若钩到更大或更强的，目标一挣扎，POKENAME固定不住自己，就被拖着走。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME is a vicious hunter, using its fishing-rod-like appendages to trick other Water-Pokémon. If anything bigger or stronger than it gets hooked and thrashes, POKENAME will be pulled along with the movement as it cannot anchor itself.

entry: POKENAME很弱。虽吃肉，却缺少捕猎肢体，总是食物不足，唯一能靠来维生的，是溜溜糖球。可外壳，又硬得如石。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: POKENAME are very weak. Despite being carnivores, they lack appendages to hunt with, causing them to be constantly short of food, with their only form of sustenance being Surskit. However, their outer shell is as hard as stone.

entry: POKENAME个头大，体力却不出众，战斗表现吃力。靠鳞皮自保，身体再庞大，也没多少进攻本领。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Despite their large stature, POKENAME are physically unimpressive Pokémon that struggle to perform in battle. They are reliant on their scaly hide to protect themselves but offer little in the way of offense even with their bulk.

entry: POKENAME巨大，却缺速度、力量与防御，缓慢无目的地漂荡。只因肉味淡，天敌懒得猎它，才能活下去。
author: sk372
source: Despite its massive size, POKENAME is lacking in speed, strength and defense. It floats around slowly and aimlessly, only surviving due to predators not bothering to hunt it due to the bland taste of its meat.

entry: POKENAME装出威风强大的模样，仿佛想要什么，都能召来、创造。其实它极其虚弱，毫无力量，攻击的威力，连一滴水都不如。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME puts up the guise of being a grand and powerful Pokémon, able to summon and create anything it wants. In reality, it is extremely weak and powerless, its attacks being even punier than a droplet of water.

entry: POKENAME背上的玻璃球里，常住着幼小的鲤鱼王。传说球中的水能赐予永生，因为从没人见过有鲤鱼王死在里面。
author: teatedtiten
source: The glass bulb on POKENAME's back usually has baby Magikarp residing in them. Legends say the water can grant eternal life as no one has ever seen a Magikarp die in the bulb.

entry: POKENAME的角钝了，战斗大受影响。它找同类寻求安全，却常又缠进芦苇或海带。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's horn is blunted, severely hampering its combat use. It seeks out others of its kind so that it has safety, but often ends up tangled in reeds or kelp.

entry: 保卫领地时，POKENAME会乱挥双臂，想显得吓人些。可惜，通常都没什么效果。
author: brienie
source: When POKENAME defends its territory, it can be seen flailing its arms about in an attempt to be intimidating. This attempt is usually unsuccessful.
