entry: POKENAME再沉，也会拼命扑腾。身体重如巨石，清毯工便借机让它捶打积尘地毯；磁性身体，还能找出金属碎屑。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Despite its weight, POKENAME will flop around frantically. Since it is as heavy as a large rock, carpet cleaners will use POKENAME as an opportunity to have it pound out dusty rugs. Its magnetic body helps in finding metallic debris.

entry: 这柄古老的传说之刃，遗失于深海。据说谁握起POKENAME，都会变得前所未有地弱。
author: brienie
source: A legendary and ancient blade, lost deep in the ocean. It is said whoever wields POKENAME will become weaker than ever before.

entry: 谁想拿起POKENAME，它便拼命扑腾。可实在没力气，很快就屈服，被当地渔民拿去剖鱼。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME wildly flops when someone tries to pick it up. However, it is so weak that it quickly gives in to being used by local fisherman to gut fish.

entry: POKENAME天生渴望战斗。有人便利用这本能，把它带上了满是香料、香气与美食的另一种战场。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: POKENAME yearn for battle instinctively. Some have used this trait and taken them to another battlefield, of spice and smell and delicious food.

entry: POKENAME摇耳、摆尾，摆出凶相赶敌。可威胁一过，就因耗力太多，瘫倒下来。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME wiggles its ears and swings its tail in a threatening display to ward off opponents. Once the threat has passed, it collapses from exerting so much energy.

entry: POKENAME想执刃守护海洋，可年纪尚幼，还不能参加真正的战斗。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME wishes to take up a blade in defense of the sea. Still, its youth hinders it from seeing real combat.

entry: 海洋危急之时，POKENAME便会挺身守护。平日不忙护海，便总在刻苦训练。
author: brienie
source: POKENAME have been known to defend the ocean in times of peril. When they are not defending the ocean, they can be found constantly training.

entry: POKENAME绕圈游动，制造漩涡，想驱逐天敌。可常把自己也困进去，反被冲到附近沙滩。
author: santon5512
source: By swimming in circles, POKENAME create whirlpools to drive predators away. They often get themselves caught in them instead, causing them to wash up on nearby beaches.

entry: POKENAME游泳肌肉弱，水流稍强就会被冲走，因此常搁浅岸边。下半身坚韧亮泽的鳞片，却有许多人喜爱。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have remarkably weak swimming muscles, so they are easily swept away by strong enough currents; as a result, many have been found stranded on shores. Their lower bodies have tough, glossy scales that many adore.

entry: POKENAME力量与速度虽弱，却什么水域都能生活。长须，则用来感知四周。
author: melodydelune
source: Though weak in terms of power and speed, POKENAME are able to live in any body of water. They use their long whiskers to feel their surroundings.

entry: POKENAME拍击水面，发出响亮爆裂声，连凶悍天敌也能吓退。若仍挨打，就潜入水中，迅速游走。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME slaps the surface of the water to create loud cracking sounds that frighten even fierce predators away. If it is attacked, it dives into the water and speedily swims away.

entry: POKENAME极稀有，见过它的渔人寥寥无几。可肉味被赞为极致珍馐，因此这条宝鱼，仍备受寻求。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are so rare that very few fishermen have ever laid eyes upon one. This prized fish is still highly sought after, as its meat is praised for its luxuriously exquisite flavor.

entry: POKENAME几乎控不住时间，一次只能快进或倒回几秒。若想操纵更久，必然失败，还可能反而扭曲时间。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can barely control its powers of time, only being able to fast forward or rewind time by a few seconds at once. Any attempts to manipulate time for longer will always fail and may cause it to distort time instead.

entry: 谁在水池边欣赏倒影太久，可能就会被POKENAME掳走。无论带到哪儿，那里总是湿得很。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Those who admire their reflection in a pool of water for too long may be spirited away by POKENAME. Wherever it takes you is very wet.

entry: POKENAME发怒时，会出水打倒破坏环境的家伙。可适应呼吸空气要花一阵，还得额外扑腾，找准方向。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: When angered, POKENAME emerges out of the water to strike down anyone who would bring harm to the environment. Unfortunately, it takes a while to adjust to breathing air, so it needs additional time to splash about and find its bearings.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME摇摇摆摆地一起走出池塘，踩着水洼，在月下共舞。若被惊扰，就扑扇着鳍，尽快跑回池里。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME waddle out of ponds together under the full moon, splashing through puddles and dancing with one another under the moon's light. If they are disturbed, they run back to their ponds as quickly as they can, fins flapping as they do.

entry: 弱小POKENAME唯一出众的，是飞行速度。虽飞得快，却几乎管不住自己，常撞树或其他障碍。
author: sk372
source: The weak POKENAME's only defining trait is its aerial speed. Though it can fly fast, it can barely control itself once in flight and regularly crashes into trees and other obstacles.

entry: POKENAME夜里点起火焰，试图引来猎物。可维持火焰十分耗费体力，等到猎物终于靠得足够近，它却已经累得无力捕猎了。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lights up its flame at night to try and attract prey. The act of doing so is exhausting for it, though, so by the time anything is drawn close enough to hunt, POKENAME is too tired to do so.

entry: POKENAME庞大身躯，由核心内的鲤鱼王操控。虽已是可怕斗士，可里面的鲤鱼王，仍可能被飞行属性宝可梦叼走。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME's hulking body is controlled by the Magikarp within its core. Despite now being a fearsome fighter, the Magikarp is still vulnerable to Flying-type Pokémon plucking it up and carrying it away.

entry: 参演宝可梦好莱坞的电影后，POKENAME成为人气装甲超级英雄吉祥物。片中，它守护所有鲤鱼王，永远与宿敌鲤鱼娃娃争夺海洋的控制权。
author: oejoeboy33
source: After starring in a Pokéstar Studios production, POKENAME became a popular armored superhero mascot. It is portrayed as the protector of all Magikarp, eternally battling its rival Maginette for control of the seas.

entry: POKENAME被踩，就吐出原先为防陆上干燥而吞的水。随后扑腾回海里补水，再喷水推进，又返回岸上。
author: soup1900
source: If POKENAME is stepped on, it spits the water inside its body that it swallowed to avoid drying out on land. It then flops back into the ocean to rehydrate before ejecting water to propel itself back to shore.

entry: POKENAME调皮，据说会偷钥匙。可它带着的钥匙，似乎从没成功开过任何锁。
author: brienie
source: POKENAME is a mischievous Pokémon said to steal keys. It is believed that the keys it carries have never successfully opened any lock.

entry: 许多人用破旧钓竿钓到POKENAME，可它泳技竟相当强。养进鱼缸，却又变懒，常在缸底一坐数小时。
author: ghostslythe
source: Caught by many Old Rod users, POKENAME has a surprisingly strong swimming ability. However, when kept in a fish tank, it becomes lazy, spending hours sitting on the bottom.

entry: POKENAME多片大鳍，带来无可比拟的水下速度。可POKENAME反应偏偏慢得出名，常高速一头撞上东西。
author: danarchosyndacalist
source: POKENAME's many large fins give them unmatched speed underwater. Sadly POKENAME are also notoriously slow to react, causing them to often ram headfirst into things at high speed.

entry: 身体湿润时，POKENAME能以光速的90%前进。可移动产生的摩擦与热，让它不到一纳秒，就又干透。
author: bandedbodypress
source: When moist, POKENAME can travel at 90% the speed of light. However, due to the friction and heat it makes while moving, it dries out in less than a nanosecond.

entry: POKENAME泳技出色，能自如控制各片鳍与鳍肢。身形修长，孩子们便爱骑在背上冲浪。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are remarkable swimmers with superb control over their various fins and flippers. Due to their elongated form, children enjoy surfing on their backs.

entry: POKENAME常被形容为一袋空气，软弱无力地跳来跳去，下雨时甚至会飘起。因此分布广泛，除此之外，几乎不做什么。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is often described as a sac of air; it ineffectually hops around and may even float through the air when it rains. In this way, it has a widespread population. It does little else.

entry: POKENAME身体坚硬结实，很能抵御天敌。可肢体弱，撑不住太久，陆上行动受阻，游泳更几乎不可能。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's rigid, sturdy body gives it strong defense against predators. Unfortunately, its limbs are too weak to hold itself up for long, ruining its mobility on land and practically making it impossible to swim.

entry: POKENAME身体的齿轮，以古怪角度咬合，结构不寻常。既弱，又难当齿轮用，游泳也不在行，因此被认为没什么用。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's odd body composition, consisting of gears interlocking at an odd angle, leaves it weak and ill-equipped to function as gears or for swimming. It's considered rather useless as a result.

entry: POKENAME为保暖，游得很靠近水面，渔人很容易捕到。身体若冷过头，鳍就会失去作用，使它无法游动。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME are very easy for fishermen to catch because they swim very close to the surface of the water to stay warm. If their bodies get too cold, their fins stop working, rendering them unable to swim.

entry: POKENAME游泳很弱，在水里只会无助扑腾。可它又能一跃越过整座瀑布，训练家不该就此小看潜力。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME is a weak swimmer who can only flail helplessly in water. However, it can leap over entire waterfalls in a single bound, so Trainers shouldn't dismiss its potential.

entry: POKENAME明明看得清，却似乎只会随机移动，结果常让POKENAME撞上挡路的东西。
author: fireflower20002
source: Although POKENAME can see properly, it can only seem to move at random. This will usually result in POKENAME colliding with obstacles that get in its way.

entry: POKENAME是建筑者，能造小型珊瑚堡垒。它们与丑丑鱼、泥偶小人的融合族群争夺礁区，冲突已延续数百年。
author: elevn.
source: POKENAME are builder Pokémon capable of building small coral fortresses. They dispute their reefs with the Feeolett, against whom they have been in conflict for centuries.

entry: 翅膀无力，无法长久飞行。一阵微风，就能把POKENAME吹得偏离路线数英里。
author: melodydelune
source: Its weak wings cannot maintain flight for long periods of time. A gentle breeze is enough to send POKENAME flying off course for miles.

entry: 进化后，POKENAME翅力增强。以前一阵微风能吹走数英里，如今只会吹走几码。
author: melodydelune
source: With its evolution, POKENAME's wing power has increased. Now instead of being flung off for miles by the breeze, it is only yards.

entry: 理论上，POKENAME强翼能让它有力飞行。可平衡感糟透，大多只会绕圈白扑腾，尖声叫着，徒然发怒。
author: occulusmalus
source: Whilst theoretically capable of strong flight with POKENAME's powerful wings, its atrocious sense of balance means it mostly ends up flapping about uselessly in circles, screaming with impotent rage.

entry: POKENAME最爱吃又大又美的宝石。可牙太弱，咬不开，只好试着整颗吞，结果常被噎住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's favourite snack is big, beautiful gemstones. Unfortunately, its teeth are too weak to crack the jewels, forcing it to instead attempt to swallow them whole, often choking as a result.

entry: POKENAME在水中以凶猛闻名，追猎不休。甚至追到陆上，结果又开始无助扑腾。
author: bandedbodypress
source: In the water, POKENAME has a reputation for ferocity and relentlessly chasing its prey. It even chases them onto land, where it will start flopping helplessly.

entry: 关都年轻钓手常钓到POKENAME。老练渔人会教孩子，如何安全取下、放回水中，因为鳞片若处理不慎，会使人发痒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are fished up by young anglers in the Kanto region. Expert fishers teach children how to safely remove and toss POKENAME back into the water because their scales can cause itchiness if handled carelessly.

entry: POKENAME以舞蹈召来数百鲤鱼王，让鱼群以数量压倒敌人。POKENAME自己，则跳着扑腾般的舞，分散对手注意。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its dancing to call forth hundreds of Magikarp. These Magikarp are used to overwhelm enemies by using their sheer quantity, while POKENAME does a flopping-like dance to distract them.

entry: POKENAME爱在满是垃圾的荒弃海滩扑腾。身体太弱，总卡进废塑料袋，只好被迫适应这样的环境。
author: sakuraneko
source: POKENAME loves to flop around on abandoned beaches full of trash and other litter. It was forced to adapt to its surroundings due to its weak body constantly getting stuck in discarded plastic bags.

entry: POKENAME吃垃圾桶中丢弃的剩食。受惊时，能跃到两层楼高，逃避捕捉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME feed off of discarded scraps of food that get tossed away into trash cans. Whenever they are shocked, they can leap up to two stories into the air to escape capture.

entry: 野生POKENAME主要吃海滩垃圾。同住海滩的其他宝可梦，因不再乱吃垃圾，反而比一般更健康。
author: hophoppip
source: Beach litter is POKENAME's primary food source in the wild. Other Pokémon residing on beaches with POKENAME are healthier than average, as they're prevented from snacking on trash.

entry: POKENAME里面的鲤鱼王，究竟是在操控身体，还是只是居住，仍有争论。无论如何，谁试着互动，POKENAME都会凶猛回应。
author: sk372
source: It is debatable whether the Magikarp inside POKENAME is controlling it or merely residing in it. Whatever the case, POKENAME reacts with aggression should anyone try to interact with it.

entry: POKENAME个头大、抓得又牢，水手得费力从船上撬下，因此很不喜欢。可POKENAME依旧搭船，快速穿越海洋。
author: quackquackattack
source: Due to its large size and tenacious grip, POKENAME are disliked by sailors, who have to pry POKENAME off their ships. Despite this, POKENAME continue to latch onto ships to move quickly across the sea.

entry: POKENAME以大臂护身，挡住攻击，再向危险宝可梦注入毒液。鲜艳体色，也提醒天敌避开POKENAME。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME uses its large arms to bunker and protect itself from attacks, injecting venom into dangerous Pokémon. Their bright coloration serves as a reminder to predators to avoid POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME爬过湿润林地觅食。颚太弱，只吃得动烂到一碰就碎的木头，可这食谱似乎让它活得很好。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME scuttles along damp forest floors, searching for food. Its jaws are so weak that it can only consume wood that has decomposed enough to crumble when touched, but it seems to thrive on this diet.

entry: POKENAME能收存或提供各种钓具，很受钓鱼爱好者追捧。会在岸边伸出诱饵，捕捉猎物，吸取生命力。
author: raza
source: POKENAME are said to be the most sought after fusions for fishing enthusiasts, as they can help store or provide a wide variety of equipment. POKENAME rest on shorelines and extend lures out into the water to catch prey and drain their life force.

entry: POKENAME肌肉弱，少有力气抬起长脖子。交流时，就朝别人吹出少量、慢慢飘行的冷泡泡。
author: sk372
source: Due to its weak muscles, POKENAME rarely has the strength to lift up its long neck. It communicates by blowing a small amount of slow-moving cold bubbles at others.

entry: POKENAME以艳俗体色吓退天敌。可常弄巧成拙，同样的鲜艳色彩，也让猎物很容易发现它。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME uses its garish colors to scare away predators. This often backfires, however, as those same lurid colors make them easy for prey to spot too.

entry: 筑巢时，POKENAME会突然停住，侧倒下来，再上下弹跳，散出大量孢子。
author: .izik
source: To nest, POKENAME abruptly stops moving and falls onto its side. It then bounces up and down to dispense large amounts of spores.

entry: 新研究发现，POKENAME能短暂以光速的99.99%移动。可脑筋不灵，直到那瞬间过去，才意识到刚才有多快。
author: bandedbodypress
source: New research has revealed that POKENAME can move at 99.99% the speed of light for a brief moment. Due to low intelligence, it does not realize how fast it was moving until the moment is over.

entry: POKENAME受威胁时猛烈扭动，将泥水泼进天敌眼里，制造逃跑的空隙。
author: fertve
source: When threatened, POKENAME begins to thrash violently, splashing muddy water into a predator's eyes to create an opening for escape.

entry: POKENAME住在浅池，觉得有危险，就尽量往深处潜。若逃离失败，它们便烦躁地扇动鳍，扑腾出水，想换到另一个池塘。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in shallow ponds, diving as deep as they can if they feel like they're in danger. If their escape fails, they become agitated, fluttering their fins and flopping out of the water in an effort to get from one pond to another.

entry: POKENAME头上的鲷鱼烧香得诱人，许多宝可梦都想吃，使它不得不不停逃跑。常能见它在水源旁喘气，靠水防止鳞片干燥。
author: fiordaliso
source: The taiyaki on POKENAME's head gives off such a delicious aroma that it constantly has to run away because many Pokémon try to eat it. It can often be found panting near a water source, which it needs to keep its scales from drying out.

entry: POKENAME在松垂皮囊中灌水，保持湿润，再上陆地活动。它性情顽皮，会偷走无人看管的渔具。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME fills its sagging skin with water to keep itself moist as it ventures out on land. It has a mischievous nature, stealing unattended fishing equipment.

entry: POKENAME偶尔从天而降，掉进水里。体轻得能飞，可肌肉太弱，飞不远，每次跃起，很快又会跌落。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME occasionally falls out of the sky and lands in water. While it is light enough to fly, its weak muscles cannot carry it far, and after every leap it quickly falls back down again.

entry: 保护壳一碎，POKENAME就更易受攻击，也更轻了。有时能跃得够高，进入安全的上层大气；可多数POKENAME会失败，坠回地面。
author: .jerden
source: When its protective shell shattered, POKENAME is much more vulnerable to attack. It is also lighter and can sometimes leap high enough to make it into the safety of the upper atmosphere, although most POKENAME fail and crash to the ground.

entry: POKENAME贴着水面游，维持温暖。夜里结成小群睡觉，保住体热。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swim close to the surface of water to keep themselves warm. At night, they sleep in small clusters to preserve their body heat.

entry: POKENAME一见岸上恩爱情侣，就跃出水，在近旁无助扑腾。行为缘由，至今仍令海洋生物学家不解。
author: .izik
source: When it spots a loving couple on the shore, POKENAME leaps from the water and flops helplessly nearby. The reason for this behavior remains a mystery to marine biologists.

entry: 爱心鱼常象征爱情，POKENAME却通常象征不理想，或不会长久的关系。可也有群体，把POKENAME视为长久友谊的象征。
author: bobosmith01
source: Since Luvdisc is a commonly used symbol for romance, POKENAME is usually considered to be a symbol of a less desirable relationship, or one that won't last very long. Still, some groups paint POKENAME as a symbol for a lasting friendship instead.

entry: 爱心鱼常象征爱情，POKENAME却通常象征不理想，或不会长久的关系。可也有群体，把POKENAME视为长久友谊的象征。
author: bobosmith01
source: Since Luvdisc is a commonly used symbol for romance, POKENAME is usually considered to be a symbol of a less desirable relationship, or one that won't last very long. Still, some groups paint POKENAME as a symbol for a lasting friendship instead.

entry: 爱心鱼常象征爱情，POKENAME却通常象征不理想，或不会长久的关系。可也有群体，把POKENAME视为长久友谊的象征。
author: bobosmith01
source: Since Luvdisc is a commonly used symbol for romance, POKENAME is usually considered to be a symbol of a less desirable relationship, or one that won't last very long. Still, some groups paint POKENAME as a symbol for a lasting friendship instead.

entry: POKENAME以游泳般动作掘地，坚韧鳞片随之脱落。这些鳞片要数年才分解，也不会给土壤提供养分。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME digs in a swimming motion, sturdy scales shed from its body. These scales take years to break down and provide no nutrients to the soil.

entry: POKENAME常在许愿井底。有人猜，它以为井中硬币藏着“愿望能量”，想借来许愿，早日进化。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is commonly found at the bottom of wishing wells. Some think it believes the coins within contain "wish energy", and that it wants to use that energy to wish to evolve sooner.

entry: POKENAME红毛本该极其华美，可长期泡水，常让毛卷乱、发臭。可惜离开盐水，又活不了太久。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its red fur would be extremely luxurious, but POKENAME's long stays in the water tend to make it frizzy and give it a bad smell. Unfortunately, this Pokémon cannot survive for long outside of saltwater.

entry: POKENAME战斗时拉扯长须，增强本就微弱的超能力波动，拿来攻击。可事后，又会头痛欲裂。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will tug its whiskers during battle in order to enhance the normally weak psychic emanations it produces for its attacks. This leaves it with a splitting headache afterward, however.

entry: POKENAME身体虽弱，却特别好斗、护地盘。会摆凶相、虚晃冲锋，吓退宝可梦与训练家，赶在真打起来之前息事。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Despite being physically frail, POKENAME are remarkably aggressive and territorial. They will put on fierce displays, mock charging at Pokémon and Trainers alike to try and scare them off before a fight has a chance to happen.

entry: POKENAME美丽、迅捷又极听话，是孩子们喜爱的坐骑。鳍可安全修剪，剪下的部分，也成了骑乘之后的热门点心，只是难得吃到。
author: lycanw_8d
source: Its beauty and speed, combined with an incredibly obedient nature, make POKENAME a popular mount for children. Its fins can be trimmed harmlessly, making for a popular, if rare, post-ride snack.

entry: POKENAME能从水中家园，短途飞出寻找树果。离水太久，体温就迅速下降，再也飞不起。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of flying a short distance from their aquatic home to look for berries. If they spend too long outside of water, their body temperature rapidly drops, preventing them from flying.

entry: POKENAME身体鼓圆，天生游得慢，动作也受小鳍所限。它用腹部螺纹迷惑天敌，借此避险。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is naturally a slow swimmer due to its bulbous body, and its movements are limited to its small fins. They avoid predators by confusing them with the spiral on their bellies.

entry: POKENAME在干地扑腾时，完全无助。只有极少数能直立平衡的时刻，才会从螺纹腹部放出催眠波动。
author: .izik
source: While flopping on dry land, POKENAME is utterly helpless. On rare occasions when it balances upright, it unleashes hypnotic waves from its spiraled belly.

entry: POKENAME强健结实，有时会互拉长须，争夺高下。POKENAME能把同类拖过湖泊，体格特别大的，甚至能拖过大海。
author: quackquackattack
source: Strong and sturdy, sometimes POKENAME in an area will drag each other by the whiskers to assert dominance. POKENAME may drag another across lakes, and even oceans if particularly bulky.

entry: POKENAME滑溜，很难抓牢。即使被渔人钓起，也总还能选择瞬间移动逃走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are slippery creatures that are hard to pin down. Even when they are caught by fishermen, they always have the option to teleport away.

entry: POKENAME通常住在水草拥塞的池塘，可大雨与洪水会把它冲进溪流。肌肉弱，只能随流而行，很容易沦为猎物。
author: mepp.
source: Though POKENAME are typically found in weed-choked ponds, heavy rainfall and flooding can displace the Pokémon into streams. Their weak muscles force them to move with the current, and they become easy prey for predators.

entry: POKENAME只想和其他宝可梦交朋友，可管不住捕食本能，常把靠近的一切吞下。每次发生，自己又会发出骇人的尖厉叫声。
author: occulusmalus
source: POKENAME only wants to be friends with other Pokémon. Unfortunately, it has no control over its own feeding instincts, leading it to regularly swallowing anything that comes near, releasing a horrific, shrill scream whenever this happens.

entry: POKENAME的球状部位，是水生宝可梦的小育儿所。长长金色触手，会引导幼年宝可梦躲进去。
author: quackquackattack
source: The bulb on POKENAME acts as a small nursery for aquatic Pokémon. The long golden tentacles guide these baby Pokémon to shelter in the bulb.

entry: POKENAME在泥泞湖底笨拙拖行，寻找贝类。肌肉弱，精细动作也差，常花好几小时，连一只蛤蜊都打开得吃力。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME clumsily drags itself around a muddy lake bottom, searching for shellfish to eat. With weak muscles and poor fine motor skills, it has been known to spend hours struggling to open a single clam.

entry: 没人知道POKENAME后半身为何缺失。科学家猜，是后腿日渐被其他宝可梦啃食所致。可它似乎不在意，腿仍像有肌肉一样，照常能动。
author: _pixelar_
source: It is unknown why POKENAME's back half is missing, with scientists believing that its hind legs were eaten away by other Pokémon over time. It doesn't seem bothered by this, as the legs still function the same as if they still had muscles on them.

entry: POKENAME什么都不在乎，总望着空处发呆，自己与周围发生什么都无所谓。尾上的大舌贝却相反，始终猛烈扭动，吸走POKENAME所有养分。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is an uncaring Pokémon, always staring out into space and not minding anything that happens to it or its surroundings. In contrast, the Shellder on its tail is always ferociously thrashing about and sucking all the nutrients from POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME走动时有种滑稽的优雅，两颗头总在争论往哪游、往哪跑。虽然笨拙，却能突然高高跃起，所到之处水花四溅。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME tends to roam about with a comical grace, its two heads arguing over which direction to swim or run. Despite its clumsy appearance, it can surprisingly launch itself high into the air, creating a splash wherever it goes.

entry: POKENAME成群游行，体色鲜橙，远看常像海上浮标。碰撞发生前，长尾便带着身体，迅速游开。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often appear as sea buoys at a distance, as they travel in groups and are bright orange in appearance. Their long tails swim quickly out of the way before any collisions occur.

entry: POKENAME出现在海滩或其他水域附近的工厂。它们无法下沉，常浮在水面。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is found in factories near beaches or other bodies of water. They often float atop the water, as they cannot sink.

entry: POKENAME离开赖以栖居的高压深海，才变成糊软无形的模样。出人意料，这对整体健康却影响不大。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME's blobby, formless appearance is the result of being removed from the pressurized depths it calls home. Surprisingly, this has little effect on its overall well-being.

entry: POKENAME想在水滨木屋与人家闹鬼，却一点也不吓人。实在太弱，区区台扇，就能把气体身体吹走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tries to haunt cabins and homes located near waterfronts, but it is hardly a frightening presence. It is weak enough that its gaseous body can be blown away by something as simple as a table fan.

entry: POKENAME常沿河床找食物与庇护所。个头虽大，仍被视为弱小的底栖觅食者。
author: presicho
source: POKENAME is often found along the riverbed, searching for food and shelter. Despite its size, it is considered a weak bottom-feeder.

entry: POKENAME在湖泊、池塘底的泥中钻洞。体质强健，什么水域都能活，甚至似乎偏爱脏水。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME burrow in the mud at the bottom of lakes and ponds. They are hardy enough to survive in any body of water, and actually seem to prefer it when the water is dirty.

entry: POKENAME拼命甩动旧鱼钩，想催眠对手。可结果，通常是钩子扎进自己身上。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME desperately swings around an old fishing hook in its attempt to hypnotize opponents. This usually ends with the hook lodged in its own body.

entry: POKENAME整体虽弱，巨钳的抓握力却很强。它常搭在大型宝可梦身上，随其狩猎，之后再抓些剩食吃。
author: sk372
source: Though overall weak, POKENAME's claws have a strong gripping power. It often uses them to hitch a ride on larger Pokémon while they hunt, grabbing and eating whatever scraps remain afterward.

entry: POKENAME只能在茂密灌丛中缓缓前进，可身上的倒刺，带着强烈的毒液。林间跋涉，可要留意。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can only move slowly through dense undergrowth. However, its barbs spread a strong venom, so hikers should be careful in the forest.

entry: POKENAME头角分泌极弱毒素。量大时也可能危险，可通常只造成轻微皮疹。
author: .izik
source: The horn on POKENAME's head secretes an extremely weak toxin. It can be dangerous in large quantities, but usually it just causes a mild rash.

entry: POKENAME只有爬树才用腿，更喜欢滚着走。毒液危险，会造成电击枪般令人麻痹的疼痛。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME only uses its legs to climb up trees, preferring to just roll around. The venom it produces is dangerous, but it does cause a paralyzing pain similar to a taser.

entry: 理论上，POKENAME时速可达60英里。可实际中，多数POKENAME滚过自己的角，就意外栽进地里，进化前都只能无助地困着。
author: sondededoo
source: Theoretically, POKENAME can reach speeds up to 60mph. In practice however, most POKENAME tend to accidentally plant themselves into ground after rolling over their own horn, where they remain helpless until evolution.

entry: POKENAME爱抓小型虫属性宝可梦，当作武器。小宝可梦怕下一只被抓起的是自己，都避着它走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a habit of grabbing smaller Bug-Type Pokémon and wielding them as weapons. They are avoided by small Pokémon for fear of being the next one to be picked up.

entry: POKENAME将独角虫当作武器甩来甩去，不太在意其安全。自己厚实的甲壳能挡住独角虫蜇刺。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME wield Weedle as weaponry, flailing them around with little regard for their safety. Its thick carapace protects it's from the Weedle's sting.

entry: POKENAME足尖有毒刺，踢中敌人就能削弱对方。它极为好胜，不断锻炼，想更上一层。
author: fiordaliso
source: The tips of POKENAME's feet bear venomous spikes, which it uses to weaken foes struck by its kicks. A highly competitive Pokémon, it constantly trains to better itself.

entry: POKENAME头顶的尖刺藏着剧毒。越临近进化，毒性就越致命。
author: .izik
source: The spike on POKENAME's head holds an incredibly potent poison. As it gets closer to evolution, the poison becomes more deadly.

entry: POKENAME用红色大长吻，寻找毒蘑菇。吃下后，毒素就会更强、更狠。
author: mary_the_jane
source: POKENAME uses its big red proboscises to search for toxic mushrooms. It eats said mushrooms to make its poison more potent and vicious.

entry: POKENAME住在茂密海带丛，动作慢，只有微毒的刺防御。主要靠灰暗伪装、不突然乱动，避开捕食者注意。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Slow-moving and defended only by mildly toxic stingers, POKENAME live in dense kelp growths. They rely heavily on their drab camouflage and lack of sudden movements to avoid drawing attention from predators.

entry: 深海没有叶片可吃，POKENAME便改吃海藻与苔藓。受攻击时，要么用角刺向敌人，要么摆鳍游走。
author: darkweavile428
source: Since the deep sea lacks leaves for it to eat, POKENAME has turned to a diet of seaweed and moss instead. If attacked, it has the option of either jabbing the assailant with its horn or using its fin to swim away.

entry: POKENAME游在河湖，异常鲜亮的鳞片，让天敌不愿下嘴。结实的角，则会蜇刺正前方的一切。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swim in lakes and rivers where their unusually bright scales make them unappealing to predators. Their sturdy horn stings anything that is in front of them.

entry: POKENAME身体仍弱，便长出更多毒刺，分泌薄薄毒液覆翼，阻吓来猎的天敌。它常用双翼裹身，如结茧般自卫。
author: sk372
source: Still physically frail, POKENAME evolved extra stingers that secrete and coat the wings with a fine poison to deter predators who would hunt it. Wrapping itself in its wings akin to a cocoon is a typical defensive maneuver.

entry: 沿海住户有时发现，游戏机一夜之间变色，或大小不同。其实，那是POKENAME伪装，爬进家找木头与暖意。
author: .realthree
source: Coastal homes sometimes find that their gaming devices have apparently changed color or size overnight. These altered consoles are actually POKENAME in disguise. They crawl into homes seeking wood and warmth.

entry: 野外找不够食物，POKENAME便用一碰就刺痛的幻墙，围住人，逼其投喂。好在POKENAME很容易被新气味分心。
author: chibitales
source: When unable to find enough food to find in the wild, POKENAME often harasses people into feeding it by surrounding them with illusory walls that sting on contact. Thankfully, POKENAME is easily distracted by new smells.

entry: POKENAME双镰分泌与头角相同的毒素，用来自卫。毒虽温和，可浅浅一划就会生效，带来阵阵强烈恶心与眩晕。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's scythes secrete the same poison found in its horn, used for self-defense. Though mild, it only takes a single light cut for the poison to take effect and result in strong bouts of nausea and dizziness.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉敏锐，能找准挂满橙橙果的树，那是最爱的食物。它挥镰吓退竞争者，可外表再凶，只要能逃，仍更愿避战。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's keen sense of smell allows it to pinpoint trees laden with Oran Berries, its favorite food. It brandishes its sharp scythes to ward off rival Pokémon, but despite its fearsome appearance, it prefers to flee from battles whenever it can.

entry: POKENAME想装凶，反而只会逗人笑。这只滑稽的小虫若摔倒，爬起来还很费劲。
author: robosoup
source: When POKENAME tries to act fierce, it only makes people laugh. If this clownish bug falls over, it has trouble getting back up.

entry: POKENAME靠尾上刺针，替背部搔痒。尾巴一甩，便发出响亮啪声，吓退可能的天敌。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on the stingers on their tails to scratch itches on their backs. A flick of the tail produces a loud snap that scares away potential predators.

entry: 它从颈间尖刺放电，挡住飞行属性宝可梦。白天，POKENAME在灌木间急蹿，尽量囤积找到的熟树果。
author: fiordaliso
source: It keeps Flying-type Pokémon at bay by releasing electric discharges from the spines surrounding its neck. During the day, POKENAME dashes frantically from bush to bush, stockpiling as many ripe Berries as it can find.

entry: POKENAME喜欢独处。有人近，便退进树或电脑，哪边近就钻哪边。角上毒液，尤其能腐蚀钢属性宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME prefers to be left alone, retreating into trees or computers when approached, depending on what's nearest. Its horn secretes a venom that's particularly caustic to Steel types.

entry: 融合造成遗传不稳，让POKENAME变得异常修长。它有时把自己的尾节，误认成其他POKENAME的头，攻击起来。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The fusion process that produces POKENAME creates genetic instabilities that cause them to become unusually long. They sometimes mistake their own tail segments as the heads of other POKENAME and attack them.

entry: POKENAME通常爱好和平，乐于漫游花园，享受香气。可哪怕挨一下，也会爆发深藏的巨大怒火。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is usually pacifistic and content to wander around flower gardens, basking in their scent. Striking it even once, however, will cause it to unleash a massive amount of hidden fury.

entry: POKENAME一被惹怒，就几乎拦不住。它盲目到处冲撞、乱击一切，直到被打败，或自己消气。
author: sk372
source: Once POKENAME has been angered, there is almost no stopping its rampage. It charges around blindly, tackling and striking at anything until it is defeated or calms down on its own.

entry: POKENAME凭嗅觉辨路，能同时分清至少六种气味。出生起每周蜕皮，角中毒素也一次比一次强。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME navigate using their sense of smell, able to differentiate between at least six smells at the same time. Every week since being born, they shed their skin and the poison in their horns becomes more potent.

entry: POKENAME在林地快速奔走，用毒角刺向挡路一切。它总在找吃的，好在嗅觉强，寻食并不难。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME scurry quickly along the grounds of forests, jabbing at anything in their way using their poisonous horns. They are always searching for food, a task made easy due to their strong sense of smell.

entry: POKENAME好奇，却又容易受惊。可能飘近谁，想探查一下，可一被发现，就惊慌地用尾上毒刺扎过去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a curious sort, but also rather jumpy. It may hover closer to someone to investigate them, only to panic and stab them with its venomous tail-stinger the moment it is discovered.

entry: 眼睛敏锐，能看见露出地面的根，从栖地取食。一根就可能够POKENAME吃一周，因此容易被喂得过量。
author: quackquackattack
source: Their keen eyes allow them to see where roots peek above the ground's surface, allowing them to pluck the nutrients from their home. One root may last POKENAME a week, so they are at risk of being overfed.

entry: POKENAME会彼此决斗，用尾巴角力，避开对方刺针。锻炼出的强尾，让它们争夺有限树果时，比其他宝可梦更占优势。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are known to challenge each other to duels, wrestling with their tails to avoid the challenger's stinger. This strengthens their tails for when they must fight over a limited number of berries, giving them an advantage over other Pokémon.

entry: 它们夜里觅食，在树果丛间跳跃，摇落果子。太阳升起，POKENAME便离地飞上林间高树休息。
author: quackquackattack
source: They forage for food at night, hopping between berry bushes to shake them down. When the sun rises, POKENAME fly off the ground to rest in the trees above the forest.

entry: POKENAME每根锐刺，都能向猎物注毒。长吻能嗅到这种毒的气味，最远达八英里。
author: silverscloudy
source: Each of POKENAME's sharp quills can inject venom into prey. Its proboscis can smell the scent of this venom from up to eight miles away.

entry: POKENAME体液让吐丝能用于远距交流。可被宝可梦追赶时，常还没脱身，丝就已经吐光。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: The fluid in POKENAME's body allows its String Shot to be used for communication over long distances. Unfortunately, it often runs out of string before it can escape from a chasing Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在星夜飞行，尾刺滴下发光毒液。它还会用刺，在土里画出未知星座，占星师便记录图案，寻找含义。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME flies on starlit nights, glowing venom dripping from the stinger on its tail. It will trace the patterns of unknown constellations in the dirt with its stinger. Astrologists record the patterns, seeking meaning.

entry: POKENAME是耐心又强大的猎手，藏在枯叶间，一连数日纹丝不动，等最佳时机，以致命刺针出击。
author: corndogyip
source: A patient and powerful hunter, POKENAME are known to lie perfectly still for days, concealed amongst dry leaves, and wait for the perfect opportunity to strike with their deadly stingers.

entry: POKENAME想在空中飞行时，总会带着草蚕果，因为它很容易就被击落。它栖居在森林深处，避免遭遇四处飞掷的石块。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME holds a Charti Berry whenever it wants to fly in the sky, as it takes little effort to knock it down from the sky. It lives deep in the forest to avoid the risk of any rocks flung around.

entry: POKENAME的刺针内，储存浓缩电力。为了威吓天敌，会敲碰两针，让火花飞向四周。
author: sk372
source: Electric power is stored and concentrated within POKENAME's stingers. As a show of intimidation towards predators, it taps the two stingers together, causing sparks to fly out around it.

entry: POKENAME每天清晨，都会轻哼柔和小曲。若歌唱被打扰，就以迅疾的毒针还击。
author: .izik
source: Each morning, POKENAME hums a gentle tune to itself. If disturbed while singing, it retaliates with a swift Poison Sting.

entry: POKENAME的壳由同族蜕下的茧组成。等POKENAME准备进化，才会造出坚硬的碳酸钙壳。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME's shell consists of the discarded cocoon of its family members. When POKENAME is ready to evolve, it will form a hard, calcium carbonate shell.

entry: POKENAME毒素使中招者迷乱，接连看见彼此矛盾的幻象。细致研究发现，毒素其实让人短暂瞥见了可能的未来。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME venom has a disorienting effect on those afflicted with it, causing the afflicted to suffer from rapid and conflicting hallucinations. Careful research has determined that the venom gives brief glimpses of possible futures.

entry: POKENAME羊毛吸水性很好，因此会被装进急救包。为免被刺，农夫剪毛前，先轻轻将POKENAME翻成侧躺。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME's wool is quite absorbent, leading it to be included in first aid kits. In order to avoid being stung, farmers gently roll POKENAME onto their sides before shearing.

entry: POKENAME身体大，很难躲开天敌。被追时，便藏进灌木，直到对方失去兴趣。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a difficult time hiding from predators because of its large body. Whenever it is being chased, it will hide in some bushes until the predator loses interest.

entry: 它们遇天敌，就拍动叶状双翼，以刺针猛扎。许多POKENAME会成群，增加脱逃机会。
author: quackquackattack
source: When confronted with a predator, they flap their leafy wings and ram their stingers into their foe. Many POKENAME gather into groups to maximize their chances of escape.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉很强，好些码开外，也能闻到爱吃的食物。POKENAME以尾刺互斗，争食，也争地盘。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a strong sense of smell, able to sniff out its preferred food from many yards away. POKENAME fights for food and territory by battling one another using the stinger on its tail.

entry: POKENAME从周围宝可梦身旁疾蹿过去，抢到最美味的叶子。速度太快，让天敌难以抓牢。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME zip past other Pokémon around them to reach the tastiest leaves. They move so quickly that it is difficult for predators to grab onto them.

entry: 研究发现，POKENAME毒素混入红色果汁，就会失去毒性。人们会掏走巢里的幼年POKENAME，放进果汁中活煮，做成炖食。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The poison that POKENAME produces has been found to lose its toxicity when mixed with Red Juice. Hives containing young POKENAME are raided and cooked alive in the juice as a type of stew.

entry: 研究发现，POKENAME毒素混入红色果汁，就会失去毒性。人们会掏走巢里的幼年POKENAME，放进果汁中活煮，做成炖食。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The poison that POKENAME produces has been found to lose its toxicity when mixed with Red Juice. Hives containing young POKENAME are raided and cooked alive in the juice as a type of stew.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着超过十亿根微毛，尖得能扎进某些生物，注入毒液。可人类皮肤通常够坚韧，不易被刺破。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is covered in over a billion microscopic hairs. They are sharp enough for certain living beings to be able to be pricked by them and injected with a venom, although human skin is tough enough to typically be unable to be pricked.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着超过十亿根微毛，尖得能扎进某些生物，注入毒液。可人类皮肤通常够坚韧，不易被刺破。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is covered in over a billion microscopic hairs. They are sharp enough for certain living beings to be able to be pricked by them and injected with a venom, although human skin is tough enough to typically be unable to be pricked.

entry: POKENAME结成大型社群，常互碰鼻子。研究者猜，这是同类交流；主流理论认为，它们在交换爱吃食物所在之处的气味。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME live in large social groups and have been observed to bump noses often. Researchers suspect this is a form of communication among the species. Leading theories suggest they are transferring scents of where the preferred food is located.

entry: 背上的花苞不断产生麻痹毒素，供POKENAME狩猎。它还能将毒素，传送到头上的角。
author: chorb33
source: The bud on its back constantly produces a paralyzing poison that POKENAME uses to hunt. It can also transmit the poison to the horn on its head.

entry: POKENAME鼻子灵敏，数公里外也能嗅到食物。为了吃一顿，什么都敢做，连强得多的宝可梦，也会龇牙、亮头刺挑衅。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can sniff out food from several kilometers away thanks to its exceptional nose. It would do anything to get a meal, even challenging Pokémon far stronger than itself by baring its fangs or displaying the spines on its head.

entry: POKENAME胖乎乎、软绵绵，很受训练家欢迎。接触时却得小心，刺针若碰得不对，会造成严重伤害。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular with many Trainers thanks to their chubby, plush features. It is advisable to be careful when handling them as their stinger can cause nasty injuries if improperly touched.

entry: POKENAME不爱攻击，只吃植物与水果。刺针漏出的微毒，会引起刺激与炎症。
author: bobosmith01
source: A fusion that lacks in aggression, POKENAME solely eats plants and fruit. From its stinger leaks a mild poison that can cause irritation and inflammation.

entry: POKENAME开战前凶猛摆势，亮出尖刺，想吓得对手退却。真打起来，又远没那么勇敢，很怕挨打。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME aggressively posture before entering a battle, wielding their spines and stinger to try and intimidate their foe into backing down. They are not nearly as brave during battle, scared of taking hits.

entry: POKENAME藏在落叶堆下，被踩就可能动用众多毒刺，让徒步旅人十分讨厌。身体边吃叶边膨胀，每天能吃自身体重数倍的量。
author: the_fireplace
source: Hikers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it hides under piles of leaves, and may use its many poisonous stingers when stepped on. POKENAME's body expands as it eats leaves, allowing it to consume several times its weight each day.

entry: POKENAME极为脆弱，会藏进乱石躲避天敌。虽有毒刺，对比自己大的宝可梦，却几乎不起作用。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is incredibly frail, and it will hide in rock piles to avoid predators. Despite having a venomous sting, it barely has any effect on Pokémon larger than it.

entry: POKENAME爪与角都有毒，可毒力只够造成剧痛。嗅觉强，追踪猎物与找食物，都很容易。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's claws and horns are venomous, though the venom is only strong enough to cause acute pain. It can track prey and find food with ease thanks to its strong sense of smell.

entry: POKENAME飞在铁壳蛹聚集待进化之处。谁想猎蛹，它就俯冲施毒，保护脆弱的茧，不过更主要，还是想自己吃掉这些猎蛹者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hovers around areas where Kakuna gather in wait for evolution. It swoops and poisons those who would prey on the Kakuna to protect the vulnerable cocoons, though primarily to prey on the would-be predators itself.

entry: POKENAME胆小害羞，很少攻击人类。可受威胁时，会用角和尾刺带来灼痛，因此仍须小心。
author: krune
source: POKENAME is a very timid and shy creature. It rarely attacks humans, but if threatened, it will use its horn and tail-spike to inject a searing pain, so caution is adviced.

entry: POKENAME在树间蜿蜒滑行，吃叶片与鸟蛋。角尾虽都有毒，蜇刺却主要令人不适，实际伤害不大。
author: sautomagically
source: POKENAME slinks from tree to tree, eating leaves and bird eggs. Although its horn and tail both contain poison, its sting is more irritating than actually harmful.

entry: POKENAME年幼时，许多脚有助移动。可学会蜿蜒滑行后，反而常碍事。
author: hakr14
source: POKENAME's many feet help it to move early in life, but they often get in the way after it learns to slither.

entry: 谁惹得POKENAME太烦，它就摇动长鼻上的刺针，直到没人再打扰。平时用爪挖小坑，存放整天搜来的食物。
author: fiordaliso
source: If someone annoys it too much, POKENAME waves the stinger on its proboscis until it is left alone. It digs small holes in the ground with its paws to store the food it gathers throughout the day.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴刺穿树果，混合果汁作颜料，描画风景。POKENAME尾中有微量麻痹毒，因此画没干透，最好别碰。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME spear berries with their tails to mix the juices into paint that they use to create pictures of scenery. POKENAME tails contain trace amounts of a paralytic poison, so it's advised to not handle a POKENAME's painting until it's dry.

entry: POKENAME味觉惊人，想吃的东西吞下前，连最细微的毒素也能察觉。可它并不免疫毒，还得小心其他POKENAME的刺针。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has an incredible sense of taste and is able to detect even the most subtle of poisons before it swallows any materials it wanted to consume. It is not immune to poison, however, so it has to keep an eye out for other POKENAME's stinger.

entry: POKENAME虽然体型庞大，嘴却只够吃鸟蛋与树叶。为维持体型，它每天必须吃下大量食物，因此是一种破坏力惊人的入侵物种。
author: sautomagically
source: Although its body is large, POKENAME's mouth is only big enough to eat bird eggs and leaves. As a result, it must eat massive amounts of food each day to maintain its size, making it a devastating invasive species.

entry: POKENAME滑过河湖，寻找最好的叶子。据说训练家在POKENAME喜爱的繁叶灌木旁多留一会儿，就能遇上。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME glide across rivers and lakes to find the best leaves to consume. It is said that Trainers can meet a POKENAME by lingering by their favorite leafy bush.

entry: 它住在森林，巢筑在树缝。嗅觉强，哪怕只是以为闻到陌生气味，尾巴也会冒火花。碰到任一条腿，就能感到轻微酥麻。
author: bobosmith01
source: A forest-dwelling Pokémon that nests in the crevasses of trees. It has a powerful sense of smell; if it even thinks it detects an unfamiliar scent, sparks fly from its tail. Touching any of its legs results in one feeling a slight buzz.

entry: POKENAME模样虽可爱，谁敢碰它那棵树的果子，就会毫不犹豫地用双毒刺扎去。嗅觉又极灵敏，天敌一近，就能发现、藏好。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite its cute appearance, it does not hesitate to strike anyone who dares to touch the fruit on its tree with its twin poisonous stingers. Thanks to its highly sensitive sense of smell, POKENAME can sense the approach of predators and hide.

entry: POKENAME与独角虫群同行，模仿动作。可每次想用刺针，喷出的反而是明亮粉红色粉末。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME travels alongside groups of Weedle and copies their movements. Whenever it tries to use its stinger, a bright pink dust is ejected instead.

entry: POKENAME用软丝为其他宝可梦铺巢，保护蛋。它的丝，既耐用，又出人意料地温暖。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lines the nests of other Pokémon with soft silk to help protect their Eggs. Its string is both durable and surprisingly warm.

entry: 它住在森林，巢筑在树缝。嗅觉强，哪怕只是以为闻到陌生气味，尾巴也会冒火花。碰到任一条腿，就能感到轻微酥麻。
author: bobosmith01
source: A forest-dwelling Pokémon that nests in the crevasses of trees. It has a powerful sense of smell; if it even thinks it detects an unfamiliar scent, sparks fly from its tail. Touching any of its legs results in one feeling a slight buzz.

entry: POKENAME用长尾上的锐刺，便能远远攻击。毒液强劲，几分钟内，就能让全身麻痹。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is able to attack from a distance using the sharp stinger on its long tail. The potent venom it produces is so powerful that it can cause full-body paralysis within minutes.

entry: POKENAME身体又大又软，是鸟宝可梦爱吃的食物。自卫时，会从手中射出毒刺。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's big, soft body makes it a food of choice for bird Pokémon. It defends itself by shooting venomous spikes from its hands.

entry: 附近喜悦情绪一高涨，POKENAME就飞上去，向周围生灵使出吐丝，热情庆祝。可之后清理，往往十分困难。
author: musicsheep.
source: If it senses a spike of joyous feelings in the area, POKENAME will fly above and fire off String Shot onto those around it in celebration. Cleanup tends to be difficult.

entry: POKENAME在树下掘洞，吃根、筑巢。被天敌逼入绝境时，要么用刺针反扎，要么退回地洞。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME burrow below trees to eat roots and make nests. When they are cornered by a predator, they either jab at the predator with their stinger or retreat into their burrow.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉敏锐，一丝气味也能追踪。是巡护员的常见伙伴，能追查偷猎者或迷路旅人，迅速找到目标。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can track the slightest hint of a scent thanks to their acute sense of smell. They are common partners for Rangers because they can track poachers or lost travelers and quickly find them.

entry: POKENAME每天吃下等同体重、富含抗氧化物的蔬菜，因此叶片鲜红。若有宝可梦误把POKENAME当蔬菜，就会尝到刺针的厉害。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME's leaves are a vivid red because it eats its weight in antioxidant-rich vegetables every day. If a Pokémon mistakes POKENAME itself for a vegetable, that Pokémon gets a taste of its stinger.

entry: POKENAME角中毒液极寒，能让整条肢体麻木。模样再傻气，也相当危险。
author: roundabout_robin
source: The venom in POKENAME's horn is extremely cold. The toxins can numb entire limbs, so it's quite dangerous despite its goofy appearance.

entry: 构成POKENAME身体的代码，某处数值反了，让POKENAME毒液竟能解人类所中的融合毒素。越来越多公园，会备一只POKENAME应急。
author: .realthree
source: As a result of a reversed value somewhere in the code that makes up POKENAME's body, POKENAME's venom acts as an antidote for humans afflicted by toxins from fusions. More and more parks have begun to keep a POKENAME on hand in case of emergency.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴把药草捣成糊，再吃下。红鼻子能辨出腐坏，帮助避开烂植物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME smashes herbs into paste using its tail before eating them. Its red nose detects spoilage and helps it avoid rotting plants.

entry: POKENAME看顾正在变硬的茧宝可梦。双刺留下的痕迹，有时会被误当超音蝠咬伤。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME keeps watch over cocoon Pokémon while they harden. The mark its twin stingers leave is sometimes confused for a Zubat bite.

entry: POKENAME以头角或尾角刺击时，会注入灼伤目标的毒。若不立即处理，注入处就会发炎、肿胀。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: When using the horn on its head or tail to strike a foe, POKENAME injects the opponent with a poison that burns the target. The injection site becomes inflamed and swollen if it is not treated immediately.

entry: POKENAME背上的“刺”，其实是成束的丝。软弱得无法真正伤敌，可蜷身自卫时，看着仍够锋利，能吓退某些天敌。
author: empty_set
source: The "spines" on its back are made of bunched-up silk.  While they are too soft and flimsy to pose any real threat, they appear sharp enough to deter some predators when POKENAME curls up defensively.

entry: POKENAME会依恋悉心照料森林、维护其健康的人。对方照顾它爱取食的树，它便一路相随，保护他们工作时不遭危险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gets attached to those who tend to forests and keeps them healthy. In exchange for maintaining the trees it loves to eat from, it follows and protects them from any dangers that might come near during their work.

entry: POKENAME极其害羞，住在林下草丛，一点声响就退缩。头上毒刺，则能抵御天敌。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an extremely shy creature that makes its home in the undergrowth, retreating at the slightest sound. The poisonous stinger above its head serves as a defense against predators.

entry: POKENAME住在高树枝头，避开更大的宝可梦，啃吃高枝较软的树皮。啃出的洞，开始进化时正好能藏身。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live high in the branches of tall trees to keep themselves safe from larger Pokémon. They feed on the softer bark of the high branches, gnawing out hollows that they can use for shelter when they start to evolve.

entry: POKENAME结群，合力蜇刺遇到的天敌。虽仍有一些被吃掉，不少幸存者，却都盼着复仇。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME stick together in groups to collectively sting any predators that they encounter. Even though some still end up eaten, many survive with a dream of vengeance.

entry: POKENAME极其害羞，住在林下草丛，一点声响就退缩。头上毒刺，则能抵御天敌。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an extremely shy creature that makes its home in the undergrowth, retreating at the slightest sound. The poisonous stinger above its head serves as a defense against predators.

entry: 背上的花苞不断产生麻痹毒素，供POKENAME狩猎。它还能将毒素，传送到头上的角。
author: chorb33
source: The bud on its back constantly produces a paralyzing poison that POKENAME uses to hunt. It can also transmit the poison to the horn on its head.

entry: POKENAME背花释放毒花粉。体型所限，头上的角已无法使用，被认为是退化器官。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME releases toxic pollen from the flower on its back. The stinger on its head is considered vestigial, as its size prevents it from utilizing its horn.

entry: POKENAME身上的倒刺，本是怪异头部向内生长的牙齿。接触就会注入毒液，但只有狠狠咬下才会达到危险剂量。
author: mistymagius
source: The barbs on POKENAME's body are actually ingrown teeth from its monstrous head. These teeth inject poison on contact, but only full bites deliver a dangerous dose.

entry: POKENAME用长吻，嗅出森林中的优质叶片。可动作慢得很，简直像在等油漆干。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME's proboscis allows it to smell out high-quality leaves around the forest. It is also very slow, moving as fast as paint dries.

entry: POKENAME面具出奇柔软，布满嗅觉感应器。它穿过枝叶漂浮，寻找最好闻的叶子当零食。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME's mask is surprisingly soft and loaded with olfactory sensors. It can float through foliage while looking for the best-smelling leaves to snack on.

entry: 雄性POKENAME用大角互斗，争夺支配地位，也争取爬上陆地进化的资格。最先中毒的那一方，就算落败。
author: xiapher
source: Male POKENAME fight each other in battles of dominance using their large horns. They fight for the right of passage to crawl onto land and evolve. The combatant who is afflicted with poison first is considered the loser.

entry: POKENAME角毒极强，一滴便能让几乎一切动弹不得。人们正细致研究，看看能否由此制成强效万能解毒药。
author: sk372
source: The poison from POKENAME's horn is highly potent, with a single drop being enough to render almost anything immobile. Careful studies are being undertaken to see if it could lead to the creation of a powerful catch-all antivenom.

entry: POKENAME靠额头刺针避敌，后方却毫无防备，许多冒险外出的POKENAME，会被伺机而来的飞行属性宝可梦抓走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on the stinger on their forehead to avoid predators, but lack any defenses for their rear. This leads many adventurous POKENAME to getting snatched up by an opportunistic Flying-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME精力旺盛，跑遍森林，只找最好的叶子与树果吃，差一点都不肯。只有吃饱，才稍稍消停。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are energetic and run around forests searching for the best leaves and berries to feast upon; they accept nothing but the best. Only when they have eaten their fill do they become less energetic.

entry: 它们明明弱，却骄傲得不愿同住。两只POKENAME一碰面，就以毒角互撞，直到一方认输或折角。
author: infinex21
source: They are too prideful to live together, despite being rather weak. If two POKENAME ever cross paths, they will clash with their venomous horns until one of them surrenders or has their horn broken.

entry: POKENAME沿袭绿剑鞘的进化方式，又添上丝制的尖刺，让连枷更能吓退敌人。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME has built onto Cateredge's evolutionary strategy by adding silk spikes to make its flail a greater deterrent.

entry: POKENAME每根刺针的末端，都尖得能穿壳。虽无刃口，可扎得准，也能让目标无法动弹。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a sharp point at the end of each stinger that is capable of piercing shells. While they have no cutting edge, a well-placed jab from a stinger can render their target immobilized.

entry: POKENAME靠众多刺针脱困。背刺与头角带着厉害的混合毒液，让中招者痛得难以行走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their many stingers to get out of trouble. The spines on their back and their horn serve a nasty concoction of venom that will leave whoever it stings hobbled over in pain.

entry: POKENAME自卫时，会将带刺缎带扎进天敌，注入使其麻木的毒液。
author: melodydelune
source: When defending itself from predators, POKENAME jabs its spiked ribbons into them, filling them with a numbing poison.

entry: POKENAME只住在季节湿度变化很大的地区。为进化，夏天会盘绕坚树；空气变干，便触发反应，使皮肤硬化、结晶，完成蜕变。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are found only in regions with large seasonal shifts in humidity. To evolve, they coil around sturdy trees during summer. As the air dries, a reaction causes their skin to harden and crystallise, triggering their transformation.

entry: POKENAME扭曲周围空间，不用肌肉，也能靠近叶丛。一见训练家，周围空间就变得无限广阔，让人打消追捕念头。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME distort space around them to move closer to leafy bushes without using their muscles. Whenever they spot a Trainer, the space around them becomes infinitely vast, which discourages Trainers from pursuing capture.

entry: POKENAME是攀爬高手，全身数十亿根微毛，让它几乎什么表面都能爬。POKENAME背炮射出的毒液，准头也出奇地好。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a master at climbing; its body is covered in billions of microscopic hairs that allow it to scale almost any surface. POKENAME can fire surprisingly accurate shots of toxic fluid out of the cannon on its back.

entry: POKENAME两束花中，一束藏着剧毒刺针，另一束有鼓起的吻管状器官。POKENAME小心护住带长吻的那束，只能单手作战。
author: quantumradiation
source: One of POKENAME's bouquets conceals a stinger containing a strong poison, while the other has a bulbous proboscis-like organ. POKENAME is careful to shelter the bouquet with its proboscis from any harm, forcing it to fight with only one hand.

entry: POKENAME散落的孢子，能提炼成药，抵抗许多融合毒素。可收集很难，POKENAME自身的毒，只扎一下，就能让肯泰罗失去行动力。
author: .realthree
source: Spores shed from POKENAME can be refined into a medicine that counteracts the effects of many fusions' toxins. However, collecting the spores is a difficult task, as POKENAME's own venom is potent enough to incapacitate a Tauros with a single prick.

entry: POKENAME先用丝困敌，再突然使出暗影球。命中前，攻势始终悄无声息，诡异得很。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME ensnares foes with silk before striking with a surprise Shadow Ball. Its attacks are eerily silent until the moment of impact.

entry: POKENAME漂过森林，寻找受损的铁壳蛹。找到虚弱者，就照料康复，直到进化成大针蜂。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME floats around the forest, looking for any damaged Kakuna. It rehabilitates any weakened Kakuna it finds until they evolve into Beedrill.

entry: POKENAME分泌的毒液易燃。带刺尾巴，总被自身毒液浸得湿黏。
author: bagumbothimble
source: The venomous secretions POKENAME produce are flammable. Its stinging tails are consistently wet and sticky with its own venom.

entry: POKENAME体内有极苦的刺激物，只有最饿的鸟宝可梦才愿猎它。最后关头，甚至可能吐出自己的内脏。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's insides carry an extremely bitter irritant, so only the hungriest of bird Pokémon prey on it. As a last resort, it may spit out its own organs.

entry: POKENAME做了身独角虫装扮，想显得不那么吓人，结交当地飞行属性宝可梦。可反因伪装常被误当猎物，只好逃跑。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME made itself a Weedle costume to look less frightening and try to befriend the Flying-type Pokémon in the area. However, because of its disguise, it's often mistaken for prey and ends up having to run away.

entry: POKENAME头上与每条尾端，都有尖刺。它以特殊方式扭尾，让天敌弄不清，哪里才是真头。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME has a spike on its head as well as on each of its tails. It wiggles its tails in a special way to confuse predators as to what part of its body is its actual head.

entry: POKENAME用锐爪掘地，吃植物根。几乎全盲，不靠眼睛，而用触角探路，再凭灵鼻辨味。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME burrows underground with its sharp claws, feeding on plant roots. It is almost blind and navigates by feeling around with its antennae and smelling with its keen nose rather than by sight.

entry: POKENAME把黏丝当鞭，施展复杂武术。摆荡、绊倒与抽击，都准得惊人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its sticky string like a whip to execute complex martial arts moves. It can swing, trip, and strike with startling precision.

entry: POKENAME在水面浮沉翻滚，主要靠尾巴推进，不靠细小双臂。角造出的泡泡明亮多彩，警告天敌，其中含毒。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME roll as they bob along the surface of the water, mainly using their tails to propel themselves as opposed to their tiny arms. The bubbles they create with their horns shine brightly and colorfully to warn predators of the toxins within.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉极发达，远处的电力也能察觉。它不停找电缆啃咬，增强小身体内储存的能量。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME has a highly developed sense of smell that lets it detect electricity even from afar. It constantly searches for cables to gnaw on, boosting the energy stored within its small body.

entry: POKENAME的强颚，会捉住不慎走进地洞攻击范围的猎物。经过已知栖地的训练家，最好多用除虫喷雾。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME has powerful jaws that it uses to trap prey that are careless enough to wander within striking range of its burrows. Trainers travelling through areas known to be home to POKENAME are advised to make liberal use of Repel.

entry: POKENAME扮成孩子，在安静公园独自玩耍。待目标落单，便用丝困住，拖进森林。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a child and plays alone in quiet parks. Once isolated, it traps a target in string and drags them into the forest.

entry: POKENAME额角分泌毒液时，也会阵阵放出少量信息素，常让其他生物入睡。
author: bagumbothimble
source: The horn on POKENAME foreheads produce small bursts of pheromones when secreting their venom. These pheromones often put others to sleep.

entry: POKENAME用黏丝将种子捆成一团，再一口吞下，往往什么也不留。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME binds clusters of seeds together using sticky string. It devours them all at once, often leaving nothing behind.

entry: POKENAME绒毛乍看软而无害，可一摸，手上就沾满黏软弹胶。若不处理，手指能黏在一起，长达一周。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: At first glance, a POKENAME's fluff looks soft and harmless. However, touching it will result in your hand being covered in a sticky, rubbery glue that can stick your fingers together for up to a week if untreated.

entry: POKENAME体内漏出的孢子，能让比比鸟等天敌麻痹，再以锐角出击，将其驱走。
author: .izik
source: Spores leaking from POKENAME's body cause paralysis in predators like Pidgeotto. It then strikes with its sharp horn to drive them off.

entry: POKENAME借修长飘动的身体，藏住第二根刺针。时机一到，隐藏的刺便连连疾扎。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME keep their secondary stinger hidden with their long flowing bodies. When the right opportunity strikes, they unleash a flurry of jabs from their hidden stinger.

entry: POKENAME以体表液体溶叶取养分。动用刺针时，液体退开，向危险敌人进攻的瞬间，也会让自己短暂失去保护。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gain nutrients by dissolving leaves in the fluid around their body. The fluid around their body recedes when they use their stinger, creating a moment of vulnerability to attack dangerous foes.

entry: POKENAME在夜里成群飞行，阴森诡异。它们合力以连番毒针削弱猎物，方便捉住。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies in eerie nighttime swarms. Together, they strike with a flurry of Poison Stings to weaken prey for easy capture.

entry: POKENAME藏在地下，只露头上的尖刺。许多呆呆兽误当成掉落的飞云冰淇淋，结果把自己扎伤。
author: amphi64
source: POKENAME hide underground, with only the spike of their head being visible. A lot of Slowpoke hurt themselves thinking the spike is a fallen Casteliacone.

entry: 每只POKENAME都带着铁壳蛹图腾，那是生前没能进化到的形态。即使如今进化，也不会与随身图腾一样。
author: crumple_2
source: Every POKENAME carries a totem of the Kakuna it never got to evolve into while it was alive. Even if it evolves now, it will not look the same as the totem it carries.

entry: POKENAME将静电存进刺针，准备突然偷袭。可电击依然弱得很，大多只会被当成一瞬的小麻烦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stores static electricity in its stinger until it's ready to make a surprise strike on an unsuspecting victim. The jolt is still incredibly minor and rarely regarded as anything more than a momentary nuisance.

entry: POKENAME尖刺有毒，能暂时麻痹较小目标。受威胁时，还能朝四面八方射出。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's spikes contain a venomous toxin capable of temporarily paralyzing smaller targets. When threatened, they can fire these spikes in all directions.

entry: POKENAME用嗅觉找到芳香树果，从树上摘食，每天最多吃自身体重两倍。养分分解得快，因此需要大量食物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME use their sense of smell to find aromatic berries to pluck off trees, eating as much as twice their body weight in a day. They require plenty of food, as their bodies break down nutrients quickly.

entry: 攻击前，POKENAME头角会烧得红热。接着猛冲，以灼热而精准的一击刺中。
author: .izik
source: Before attacking, the horn on POKENAME's head glows red-hot. It charges and strikes with fiery precision.

entry: POKENAME挂在洞穴与下水道顶。POKENAME一见人，就会疾冲过去攻击。
author: agostostino
source: POKENAME can be found in caves and sewers, hanging from the ceiling. POKENAME attacks every person it sees by charging at the opponent really fast.

entry: POKENAME静伏草甸，如陷阱般一动不动。猎物一近，便猛扑，使出突如其来的虫咬。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lies flat on meadow grass, perfectly still like a trap. When prey draws near, it lunges forward with a sudden Bug Bite.

entry: POKENAME鼻子滴下酸性黏液，溶穿树皮，借此喝到新鲜树汁。
author: .izik
source: Acidic mucus drips from POKENAME's nose and melts through bark. It uses this method to reach and consume fresh tree sap.

entry: POKENAME吐出保暖丝，做成彩色花纹包裹，保护下半身。看似快活暖和，头顶锐角却分泌冰寒毒液，谁碰到就会麻木。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME spin insulating silk to create the colorful, patterned wraps that protect their lower bodies. Though they appear cheerful and cozy, the sharp horn atop their heads secretes an ice-cold venom that numbs anyone who touches it.

entry: POKENAME常见得令人担忧，农夫很不欢迎。它把自己种进田里，吃吸土中全部养分与矿物，直到什么植物都长不了。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME is a worryingly common fusion that is undesirable to farmers. It will plant itself in crop fields, eating and sucking out all the nutrients and minerals in the soil until it is unsuitable for growing any sort of plant inside of it.

entry: POKENAME用极灵敏的嗅觉找毒蘑菇。一找到，POKENAME便以尾刺扎入，增强刺针毒力。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: POKENAME uses its extremely acute sense of smell to sniff out toxic mushrooms. Once it finds one, POKENAME will jab it with its tail, increasing the potency of its stinger.

entry: 夏天，POKENAME在雏菊田跳欢快桑巴舞，只有啃近旁花瓣，或睡觉时，才会停下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs a lively samba in fields of daisies during summer. It only pauses to nibble on nearby flower petals and sleep.

entry: 吃下榴石果后，POKENAME在树顶跳起急促吉格舞。每个欢快舞步，喙也跟着上下点动。
author: .izik
source: After eating a Pomeg Berry, POKENAME dances a rapid jig atop trees. Its beak bobs with each joyful step.

entry: POKENAME在海边优雅旋舞，双臂随节奏摇摆。动作间，腰旁羽毛会散出细软粉末。
author: .izik
source: By beaches, POKENAME twirls in a graceful dance, swaying its arms rhythmically. It releases soft powder from the feathers on its waist as it moves.

entry: 冬天将近，POKENAME伴寒风静静起舞。大红鼻，还能嗅出雪下埋藏的树果。
author: .izik
source: As winter nears, POKENAME dances quietly with the chill wind. Its large red nose sniffs out hidden berries buried beneath the snow.

entry: POKENAME爱吃垃圾，尤其包装纸。它们翻遍填埋场寻找，再带回森林家中。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to eat trash, especially wrappers. They wade through landfills in search of these wrappers and carry them back to their forest homes.

entry: POKENAME夜里无声漂过沼泽，吐出近乎看不见的丝。猎物往往早已被缠住，才察觉自己正遭捕猎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats silently over marshes at night, spitting out nearly invisible string. Prey often becomes ensnared before realizing it's being hunted.

entry: POKENAME潜近猎物，迅速一刺就飞走。听觉惊人，能听出中毒目标渐弱的心跳与呼吸，耐心等它最终倒下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sneaks up on prey to deliver a quick sting before flying away. With an incredible sense of hearing, it listens to the sound of its poisoned victim's deteriorating heartbeat and breathing, waiting patiently for their eventual collapse.

entry: POKENAME在虫巢旁觅食，吃进化后丢弃的茧片。角毒虽弱，却能迅速使目标麻木，足够让自己飞走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME forages around bug nests, snacking on the discarded pieces of cocoons left behind from evolution. The poison in its horn is mild, but numbs victims quickly enough to let it fly away.

entry: POKENAME刺针排出的黏毒，会引起难忍剧痒。爬行时也会分泌，借黏性爬上墙壁。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release a slimy venom from their stingers that cause an unbearable itchiness. This venom is also secreted when they crawl, allowing them to stick and crawl up walls.

entry: POKENAME向空气散出香浓毒孢子。据说在芬芳的POKENAME身旁待久，人就会头晕、恶心。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release toxic spores into the air that have a redolent scent. People report experiencing dizziness and nausea after prolonged exposure to the aromatic POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME从海床向过路船只射丝。若命中，就试着把船拖进浪下。
author: .izik
source: From the ocean floor, POKENAME launches silk threads at passing boats. If it hits, it tries to drag them under the waves.

entry: POKENAME以多足盖住成片地上植物。毒刺挡住天敌，自己便能尽情啃食。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME covers patches of ground plants with its many legs. Its poisonous spikes keep predators away while it munches to its heart's content.

entry: POKENAME抽走植物生命力，让整片森林树木干枯。谁被头针扎到，就会受驱使，给它搬来堆堆叶子，直到最终毒发身亡。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME drains vitality from plant life, leaving entire forests full of dried up trees. Anyone who is jabbed by the needle on its head will be compelled to bring it mounds of leaves until they eventually succumb to the poison.

entry: POKENAME杂食，嗅觉强，对天气剧变尤其敏感。季节更替，或有人使出冰雹等招式时，就会情绪不稳。
author: bobosmith01
source: An omnivorous Pokémon with a powerful sense of smell, POKENAME is particularly sensitive to extreme changes in weather. As a result, it grows moody when the seasons change, or when moves such as Hail are used.

entry: POKENAME毛发中的毒，足以杀死三名训练家。若曾接触，必须立即联系当地医院。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's hair holds enough poison to kill three Trainers. If you've come in contact with it, you must contact your local hospital immediately.

entry: 野生POKENAME以蘑菇上的毒刺警告，别踩到它。毒虽极痛，却完全不会致命，还用于许多现代药物。
author: big_clanker
source: The wild POKENAME uses the poisonous spikes on its mushroom as a deterrent for things not to step on it. Although very painful, the venom in its spikes is completely non-lethal and is used in a lot of modern medicine.

entry: POKENAME刃状叶片的毒，比头上刺针致命得多。哪怕小小划伤，也会留下久久无法愈合的伤口。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's bladelike leaves hold a far deadlier venom than the stinger atop its head. Even small cuts can leave lasting wounds that take exceptionally long to close.

entry: 接触POKENAME得小心，尖刺覆着刺激性毒素。头上坚韧的外骨骼，则能在战斗中带来防御优势。
author: mepp.
source: Trainers must exercise caution when handling POKENAME, as their spines are coated with an irritating toxin. The tough exoskeleton covering their head gives them a defensive edge in battle.

entry: POKENAME乱毛与满身粉末刺激鼻子，使它打喷嚏，一阵阵喷粉。有些训练家觉得讨喜可爱，可凑近观察，就会吃苦头。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME's shaggy fur and powder-covered body irritates its nose, causing it to sneeze and release its powder in bursts. Some Trainers find it very endearing and adorable, but will suffer the consequences when they observe up close.

entry: POKENAME夜里飘过南瓜田。覆毒尖刺，能阻止野生动物破坏珍贵作物。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME floats through pumpkin patches. Its venom-tipped spikes deter wildlife from damaging the precious crops.

entry: POKENAME在树上刻形状，锻炼尾部肌肉。刺针渗出的热毒液，一遇空气便滋滋作响。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME develops the muscles in its tail by carving shapes into trees. Its stingers ooze with a hot venom that sizzles when exposed to air.

entry: POKENAME把身体埋入地下，只露头顶的尖刺，防备天敌。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME protects itself from predators by burying itself under the ground and leaving the spike atop its head exposed.

entry: POKENAME的针不是注毒，而是从刺中之物吸毒。天生耐毒很强，可某些强力毒物，仍会使它极痛、不适。
author: evilgammon
source: Instead of injecting poison, POKENAME's needle sucks out poison from whatever it pierces. While it has a natural high tolerance for toxins, some potent poisonous compounds cause it substantial pain and discomfort.

entry: POKENAME用锐刺钻开粗大树根，饮下树汁。喝完，便再挖向下一棵树。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drills into large tree roots with sharp spikes to drink sap. Once finished, it tunnels onward to the next tree.

entry: POKENAME总被小事分心，实在只适合做家养伙伴。有时会把自己的吐丝卷成球，像家猫宝可梦一样玩耍。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME will often be distracted by simple things, making it a Pokémon only really suitable as a house pet. Sometimes, it will make a ball out of its own String Shot and play with it like any domestic cat Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用毒尾蜇刺不知情的旅人，再偷走珠宝，添进铺丝的巢里。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its venomous tail to sting unsuspecting travelers. It then steals their jewelry, adding the treasures to its silk-lined nest.

entry: POKENAME得排出刺中毒液，否则压力会引起偏头痛。可以扎岩石，主动排毒，可又可能损坏刺针。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME need to release the venom from their stinger, or they will suffer from a migraine from the pressure. They can artificially release the venom by jabbing into rocks, but this behavior risks damaging their stinger.

entry: POKENAME一吃不到最爱的食物，就气得大发脾气。冷静后，又会不情愿地吃下给它的任何食物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME becomes irate and throws a tantrum whenever it does not receive its favorite food. Once it calms down, it will begrudgingly eat whatever food is presented.

entry: 谁想烦扰训练家，POKENAME就把额刺指向对方，威胁起来。嗅觉惊人，因此常在救援队帮忙找失踪者。
author: fiordaliso
source: If someone tries to bother its Trainer, POKENAME threatens them by pointing the stinger on its forehead. Thanks to its incredible sense of smell, this Pokémon is often used in rescue teams to help locate missing people.

entry: POKENAME分节的身体一放平，爬得竟相当快。谁挨尾刺，立刻就动弹不得，伤口也会被灼封。
author: hampterbychoice
source: When laid flat, POKENAME's segmented body can skitter surprisingly fast. Anyone struck with the stinger on its tail is instantly immobilized and their wound cauterized.

entry: POKENAME双拳的指节上，各排列三根毒针，不断渗出毒液。它们以刺拳使对方中毒，再打耐力战，等待毒液制服敌人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's fists each have a trio of stingers lining the knuckles that ooze a steady stream of venom. POKENAME aim jabs at their opponent to inflict them with their toxin, waiting for their venom to disable their foe in a battle of endurance.

entry: POKENAME在森林合作建群，极为合群、互助。飞行宝可梦来袭，多数守巢，另有小队，试着将威胁引走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Working together to form colonies in the forest, POKENAME are highly social and co-operative. When threatened by flying Pokémon, most of the colony defends their home while a small group tries to draw the threat away.

entry: 叶上痕迹曾被当作病征，研究才发现，POKENAME偶尔会啃自己的叶。似乎并无害处，即使吃光，也能再长出。
author: sk372
source: The marks on its leaves were thought to be signs of illness, until research found that POKENAME occasionally nibbles its own leaves. This seems to cause no harm, and its leaves grow back if fully consumed.

entry: POKENAME遇险便缩进壳，只露刺针。鸟宝可梦啄壳时，可能不小心碰针，因此中毒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME withdraws into its shell whenever there is danger and only leaves its stinger exposed. Any bird Pokémon that pecks at the shell may accidentally strike its stinger and get poisoned in the process.

entry: POKENAME的强酸，需要特殊酶，才能分解生物物质。POKENAME蜇刺其他宝可梦时，会转移部分酶，激活毒液的腐蚀力。
author: quackquackattack
source: The powerful acid of a POKENAME requires special enzymes to break down biological matter. When POKENAME stings another Pokémon, they transfer some of the enzymes to activate the caustic power of the venom.

entry: POKENAME以强臂攀住灌木，吃下等同体重的叶子。皮色鲜亮，有人误把POKENAME当树果，想伸手摘；打扰POKENAME的，就会挨毒角扎。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME will cling to a bush with its powerful arms and eat its weight in leaves. Due to its bright skin, some people mistake POKENAME for a berry and try to pick it. Those who disturb POKENAME will get stabbed with its poisonous horn.

entry: POKENAME尖角滴着毒液。草间威胁般的寒光，就足以让敌人不敢靠近。
author: periperi_chicken
source: Venom drips from POKENAME's pointed horn. The spike's threatening glint in the grass is enough to keep enemies at bay.

entry: POKENAME不惜代价保护长尾。若身陷险境，例如面对强大飞天螳螂，就以坚韧丝网裹尾，让POKENAME缩壳时，尾巴也有保护。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME protects its long tail at any cost. If it finds itself in a dangerous situation, such as facing a powerful Scyther, it will coat its tail in tough and durable silk webbing so that its tail is protected even if POKENAME hides in its shell.

entry: POKENAME身上的角起催化作用，扩大电击范围。它很爱利木果，因此在巢中囤了许多。
author: fiordaliso
source: The horn on its body acts as a catalyst, amplifying the reach of its electric attacks. POKENAME has a great fondness for Aspear Berries, which is why it keeps a large stockpile inside its den.

entry: POKENAME小群行进，用一翼举着削尖木棍。它们用棍戳别的宝可梦，争取想要之物，也合力欺走对方，抢走食物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME march together in small flocks, hoisting sharpened sticks up with one wing. They jab at other Pokémon with these sticks to get what they want, working together to bully them away from food.

entry: POKENAME小群昂首走过林间空地，装得自信，吓阻天敌。若群内争执，两只POKENAME就会对峙，尽量把身体撑高。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME strut through forest clearings in small flocks with their heads held high, acting confident to ward off predators. When disputes arise within the flock, the two competing POKENAME will square off and rear up as tall as possible.

entry: POKENAME结群避敌。受威胁时，便围住天敌，以各个头反复蜇刺，直到对方放弃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME travel in groups to protect themselves from predators. When threatened, they surround the predator and sting them with each of their heads repeatedly until the predator gives up.

entry: POKENAME每门炮里，能藏两只独角虫，天敌近旁时正好避险。常能见它带着炮内虫宝可梦，蹒跚穿林，平静地寻找灌木吃叶。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has enough room to store two Weedle in each cannon, making them great places to hide whenever predators are nearby. It can be seen hobbling through forests with bug Pokémon in its cannons, peacefully finding bushes to eat leaves from.

entry: POKENAME前方的刺，是主要防线，却不是唯一。边角看似较钝的刺，也有微小尖端，同样能排毒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's front stinger is its primary means of defense, but not its only one. The duller-looking spines on the corners still possess tiny points of their own that can dispense venom as well.

entry: POKENAME越近进化，排出的气体就越臭。虽能自保，可内脏本就剧毒，多数宝可梦即使吃到，也难保安全。
author: bobosmith01
source: As POKENAME draw closer to evolution, the gas they emit becomes more and more foul smelling. While this does keep POKENAME safe, their innards are so toxic most Pokémon cannot eat them safely anyway.

entry: POKENAME最常住在腐烂荒屋，用爪撕墙，吃掉朽木。身体覆着硬毛，还会从不知情探险者的颈边刷过。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is most often found in rotting, deserted houses where it rips apart the walls with its claws to consume the decomposing wood. Its body is covered in hairy bristles, which it will brush along the neck of unaware explorers.

entry: POKENAME迈短腿追逐入侵者，试图用毒尾扎中。独处时，又一边自顾嘟哝，一边啃食烂楼的碎块。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME chases after intruders on its stumpy legs, trying to sting them with its venomous tail. When alone, it munches on crumbling bits of rotten buildings while grumbling to itself.

entry: POKENAME吃叶时，会用手中摆锤，催眠所有来者。若不奏效，也可能改用头上毒刺，可POKENAME仍是能逃就更愿逃。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses the pendulum it holds to hypnotize anyone who approaches as it feeds on leaves. If that fails, it may attack with the poisonous spike on its head instead, although POKENAME prefers to flee whenever possible.

entry: POKENAME等在自行车架旁。若有人误当真车，坐上背，就载着奔向最近森林。可所有被掳者，都只是下车便逃了，没人知道POKENAME到底图什么。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME waits near bike racks. If a human mistakes it for a real bicycle and sits on its back, it races off towards the nearest forest with them. Since every abductee has escaped by simply dismounting, it's unknown what POKENAME hopes to accomplish.

entry: POKENAME能吞下嘴里装得下的任何东西。每天若吃不足自身体重的食物，就会暴怒翻腾，直到筋疲力尽。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will swallow anything that can fit in its mouth. If it doesn't eat its own body weight in food daily, it flies into a fury and thrashes until exhausted.

entry: POKENAME住在远离人类文明的偏远瀑布。看似冷淡疏离，可一被拥抱，就会脆弱、感情外露。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME inhabits remote waterfalls far away from human civilization. Although it appears cold and distant, it becomes vulnerable and emotional once given a hug.

entry: 踢击强得足以改变瀑布的自然流向。POKENAME性情极其凶猛好斗，连自家训练家，也常难以让它听进话。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its kicks are so devastatingly powerful that they can alter the natural course of a waterfall. POKENAME's temperament is so aggressive and fierce that even its own Trainer often struggles to get through to it.

entry: 踢击强得足以改变瀑布的自然流向。POKENAME性情极其凶猛好斗，连自家训练家，也常难以让它听进话。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its kicks are so devastatingly powerful that they can alter the natural course of a waterfall. POKENAME's temperament is so aggressive and fierce that even its own Trainer often struggles to get through to it.

entry: POKENAME凶猛守护鲤鱼王，会掳走被训练家虐待的个体。许多POKENAME把鲤鱼王养在腹袋，观察成长，一生病，就闯进宝可梦中心求医。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are fierce protectors of Magikarp and are known to abduct those mistreated by a Trainer. Many POKENAME store Magikarp in their pouches to monitor its growth, barging into Pokémon Centers seeking medical attention when it is ill.

entry: POKENAME捕猎小鱼，既隐秘又凶猛。先藏在海带间，以墨遮住猎物双眼，再快速游近，狠咬捉住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hunts small fish with a combination of stealth and ferocity. It blinds prey with ink while hiding among kelp, before swimming quickly and snatching it up with its vicious bite.

entry: POKENAME天性好斗，身体却十分纤弱。若被激怒得够厉害，就会掀起巨大水流，撞走招惹者。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Despite being rather aggressive by nature, POKENAME have very delicate and frail bodies. If they are angered enough, they will create a huge current of water to knock away the aggressor.

entry: 女士训练家喜欢在专建的保育区照料POKENAME。POKENAME领地意识强，又需宽敞游水，因此同一池里，多于两只共居的情况很少。
author: quackquackattack
source: Socialite Trainers enjoy looking after POKENAME in specially constructed reserves. POKENAME are rather territorial and need room to swim, so it is rare to see more than two share a pond.

entry: POKENAME远比初看时凶猛，不欢迎谁闯进作为家园的花园。先用翼上孢子麻痹目标，再以强大破坏光线轰飞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is much more aggressive that it appears at first glance, and does not take kindly to intruders in the flower gardens it calls home. It paralyzes a target with spores from its wings before blasting them away with a powerful Hyper Beam.

entry: POKENAME的鳍与体形，让孩子常误当海边面具。被拿起时，POKENAME就闭眼快速旋转，盼对方放手。
author: quackquackattack
source: Children often mistake POKENAME for masks at the beach due to their fins and shape. When picked up, POKENAME closes its eyes and spins rapidly, hoping to be let go.

entry: 每场哑剧结束，POKENAME都期待观众鼓掌。若表演失败，就会无声狂暴，直到场地变成废墟。
author: .jerden
source: At the end of its pantomimes, POKENAME expects the audience to applaud. If its performance flops, it will rampage in silence until the venue is in ruins.

entry: POKENAME对一切都凶狠记仇，可除了难挨的一口，也没多少特别本事，威力不佳。在鲤鱼王面前，往往又更不主动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a ferocious and vindictive attitude towards all it comes across, but aside from a nasty bite, it is largely unremarkable and ineffective. It tends to act more passively in the presence of Magikarp.

entry: 自我融合后，POKENAME酷似暴鲤龙的超级进化。它始终暴怒，飞在天空，用强大破坏光线，毁掉下方大地。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME resembles Gyarados's Mega Evolution after self-fusion. It is constantly in a state of rampaging anger, flying through the sky and laying waste to the ground below with powerful Hyper Beams.

entry: 两个头，让它有普通暴鲤龙两倍的自负，也有两倍怒火。四下没别的生物时，双头就会凶猛互斗。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: With two heads, this Pokémon possesses double the ego and double the rage of a regular Gyarados. When nothing else is around, each head violently battles the other.

entry: POKENAME体型庞大，却能在水中与挖巢的岩岸上敏捷行动。锐镰重重一挥，连巨石也能整齐劈半。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite its massive size, POKENAME moves swiftly both in water and along the rocky coasts where it digs its den. A single powerful swing of its sharp scythes can slice even huge boulders clean in half.

entry: POKENAME外貌凶猛，其实极为温柔，还怕与别人交战。庇身的水下洞穴外，能找到它蜕下的鳞片。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite its fierce appearance, POKENAME is actually extremely gentle and afraid of battling others. Outside the underwater caves it uses as shelter, you can find the scales it sheds during molting.

entry: 它脾气可怕，以红珠中的力量召来猛烈风暴。训练虽极难，可一赢得信任，就会成为极忠诚的伙伴。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is a Pokémon with a fearsome temper, known for summoning violent storms with the power contained within its red pearls. Although extremely difficult to train, once its trust has been earned, it becomes an extremely loyal companion.

entry: POKENAME怒火令人畏惧，能释放蓝珠力量，召来狂暴风雨。训练虽艰难，可一旦认可训练家，就忠心不改。
author: fiordaliso
source: Feared for its wrath, POKENAME can unleash the power of its blue pearls to conjure violent tempests. Training it is a daunting task, but once it accepts a Trainer, it remains steadfastly loyal.

entry: POKENAME游遍海洋，毁船，让水手流落险境。海上肆虐又掀起猛烈风浪，足以沉船，淹没附近岛屿。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME goes around oceans to destroy ships and strand sailors. Its rampages at sea create violent and stormy waters that can sink ships and flood nearby islands.

entry: POKENAME在领地四周制造漩涡，攻击心怀恶意、试图穿过的家伙。可对认定值得信任者，却意外地温顺。
author: ambrosia04
