source: POKENAME create whirlpools surrounding their territories, attacking anyone who tries to cross them with ill intentions. Surprisingly, they are extremely docile with those they deem trustworthy.

entry: POKENAME暴躁强大，偏爱独处。会占下一座湖，潜水，以超能力把里面的生物全抛出去，独享整片水域。
author: sk372
source: A very angry and powerful creature, POKENAME prefers to be alone. It will claim a lake for itself, diving into the water and using its psychic powers to hurl any creatures within out of it so it can have it all to itself.

entry: 这些巨兽体型庞大，守在河流、湖泊的各段水域，索取过路费。付费后，它们会扩张颈部的泡沫，形成平台，让对方爬上来，载着渡水。
author: doxtordaemon
source: Though its size may be huge, these giants are found near rivers and lakes where they guard sections and demand tolls to pass. Once the toll is paid they expand the foam around their neck to create a platform for others to climb on and ride across.

entry: POKENAME一声吼，颈上烈焰便猛涨，热得碰到什么水，都能瞬间蒸发。尾巴的重击，还能掀起小型巨浪。
author: infinex21
source: When a POKENAME roars, the flames along its neck flare with enough heat to instantly evaporate any water they touch. Its tail strikes are strong enough to create small tidal waves.

entry: POKENAME极为凶猛，尤其针对其他波波融合宝可梦。常把别的宝可梦赶离食物，自己却不吃，只是想欺凌别人，发泄攻性。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is exceedingly aggressive, particularly towards other Pidgey fusions. It will bully other Pokémon away from their meals without even taking them for itself; it simply wishes to bully them as an outlet for its aggression.

entry: POKENAME在有鱼宝可梦栖居的水边占地，拼尽全力守护。最可怕的是，游泳、飞行，两样都极擅长。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME claim territory near bodies of water where fish Pokémon reside and will defend their territory with all their might. What makes them particularly terrifying is how adept they are at swimming and flying.

entry: POKENAME发怒，因放出更多电力，发光球会更亮。蓄力时，中央一球为另两球集中力量，瞄准、引导电流。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: When POKENAME are angered, their bulbs grow brighter due to releasing more electricity. The central bulb acts as a focus for the other two, helping to aim and direct the electricity as they charge.

entry: 怒气会让POKENAME产生身体容纳不了的电力。它又太容易生气，因此几乎总在迸出大量火花。
author: sk372
source: Anger causes POKENAME to generate electricity that its body cannot fully contain. Because it is so easily angered, its body is almost constantly producing a large amount of sparks.

entry: POKENAME能独特地平息暴鲤龙的怒性。可一这样做，自己原本温顺的个性，就变成凶暴好斗，仿佛吸走了对方的怒火。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a unique ability to pacify the raging temperament Gyarados possesses. However, when it does so its normally docile personality shifts to become an aggressive and violent creature, as if it had absorbed Gyarados's fury.

entry: POKENAME凶猛，口中能喷出强劲盐水。身体虽适应海洋生活，却也能掠过浪头飞行，赶走闯入领地的船。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an aggressive creature capable of spouting powerful jets of salt water from its mouth. Though its body has adapted to marine life, it can soar above the waves to drive away boats that enter its territory.

entry: POKENAME厚厚的橡胶般皮肤，能挡住自己的电击。水手常把可爱面孔误当友善，一靠近，才迎来怒火。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME's thick, rubbery hide protects it from its own electrical attacks. Sailors often mistake its cute face for friendliness, only to meet its wrath when they approach.

entry: POKENAME彼此比谁蛙鸣最响。声音最大的，便占据最广沼泽，再凶猛守卫。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME compete among themselves by emitting extremely loud croaks. The loudest individuals claim the largest territories of marshlands, which they will then defend with fierce intensity.

entry: POKENAME是凶恶鸟宝可梦，谁闯领地就攻谁。它们歇在湖里或高处栖架，连同类也常为地盘激战。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are vicious bird Pokémon that attack anything that intrudes on their territory. They either rest within lakes or upon tall perches and can easily be found fighting even their own kind over territory.

entry: POKENAME极为珍爱外貌，尤其头羽与双翼。羽毛一弄脏，就烦躁得连一点不顺，也能惹怒。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME is extremely proud of its appearance, especially its head feathers and its wings. If its feathers ever get mucked up, it becomes agitated to the point that minor inconveniences can enrage it.

entry: POKENAME伏在海床，等猎物进入巨口。若遇危险，反而退走，上陆疾奔，避开海中威胁。
author: fxncy_poland
source: POKENAME stay on the ocean floor, waiting for their prey to enter their large mouths. When posed with danger, they retreat and sprint on land to avoid ocean threats.

entry: POKENAME仍很难在强风中飞，便用尾游泳，以护目镜般的眼睛，在水中辨路。大体上，并无危害。
author: dill360yt
source: POKENAME still struggles to fly in strong winds, so it relies on its tail to swim and its goggle-like eyes to navigate around in the water. It's mostly harmless.

entry: 冷水中，POKENAME平静贪玩，常与其他水宝可梦嬉戏。可温度一超过摄氏5度，就暴怒攻击所有会动之物，直到自己力竭昏倒。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: In cold water, POKENAME is calm and playful, often seen frolicking with other Water Pokémon. But when the temperature rises above 5°C, it becomes violently aggressive, attacking anything that moves until it faints from sheer exhaustion.

entry: POKENAME凭超能力，随意抬高海潮。若认定训练家遇险，就暴怒起来，尾巴一击，足以沉掉小船。
author: fiordaliso
source: Thanks to its psychic powers, POKENAME can raise the tide at will. If it deems its Trainer in danger, it flies into a rage; a single strike from its tails would be enough to sink a small boat.

entry: 它夜里潜行河湖，静候猎物。关都发生的宝可梦袭击事件中，有很大一部分，都是POKENAME所为。
author: capwolfbane
source: This Pokémon stalks rivers and lakes at night, lying in wait for prey. POKENAME attacks make up a large percent of all Pokémon attacks in Kanto.

entry: POKENAME背部中央的花苞太沉，行动笨拙，脾气也坏。谁一靠近，POKENAME的第一反应就是暴力，以长尾乱抽。
author: beandrawsthings
source: The heavy bulb in the middle of POKENAME back makes it awkward and irritable. Their first response to being approached is violence, as POKENAME will lash out with their long tails.

entry: POKENAME鳞片经战斗锤炼，潜在深河床。外貌虽令人害怕，可只要不受威胁，就保持温顺。
author: presicho
source: Covered in battle-forged scales, POKENAME lurks in deep riverbeds. Though feared for its appearance, it remains docile unless threatened.

entry: POKENAME住在地下深处的含水层。人类若抽水过量，就会掘通地表，以怒火震动大地。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lives in aquifers deep underground. If humans extract too much water, it will tunnel up to the surface and shake the earth with its rage.

entry: POKENAME领地意识强，以锐刺与满身尖棘吓走其他宝可梦。刺上毒液使对方麻木，方便POKENAME把它们推出地盘。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are territorial, scaring off other Pokémon using their sharp barbs and spiky bodies. The sharp barbs release a poison that numbs opposing Pokémon, allowing POKENAME to push them out of its territory.

entry: 狂暴POKENAME常袭击水边小镇与村庄。火属性招式虽不克制POKENAME，却能升高体温，逼POKENAME回水降温。
author: wiz0z
source: Rampaging POKENAME are known to attack small towns and villages near bodies of water. While POKENAME is not weak to Fire-type moves, they are effective in raising POKENAME's body temperature and forcing them back into the water to cool.

entry: POKENAME乘风，以披风般的鳍滑翔。外表虽英武，POKENAME却极凶猛，稍被招惹就会攻击。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME catch the wind and glide using their cape-like fins. While they have gallant appearances, POKENAME are very aggressive and will attack others with little provocation.

entry: POKENAME拼命捍卫领地，以利爪斩倒闯入者。坚韧片状鳞片，是乱世地区铁匠与武将看重的材料。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are extremely defensive of their territory, cutting down trespassers with their sharp claws. Their tough, plate-like scales are a prized material to the blacksmiths and warlords of the Ransei region.

entry: POKENAME凶暴，猛烈扭动，向范围内来者轰出强大大字爆炎。民间传说认为，它的暴行会引发火山喷发，将灾毁都怪在它头上。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are violent Pokémon, thrashing about and launching powerful Fire Blasts at those that come within reach of them. Folk tales claim their violence causes volcanoes to erupt, holding them responsible for the destruction caused.

entry: POKENAME成群住在大湖旁，驱逐想占据觅食地的其他宝可梦。性情凶猛，谁靠太近，就会攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Flocks of POKENAME live around large lakes and chase off any other Pokémon that try to stake their claim on their feeding grounds. They are aggressive and will attack anyone that gets too close to them.

entry: POKENAME迅疾凶恶，猛冲海中，以利齿捕猎。可POKENAME常避开沉船与海滩，更愿找落单目标。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are fast and vicious, hunting for prey by barreling through the sea and biting with their sharp teeth. Despite this, POKENAME often avoid sinking ships and beaches, preferring isolated targets.

entry: 许多人宣称，驯服POKENAME的秘诀，是爬上背，把长须当缰绳拉。宝可梦中心与医院，却经常宣传，劝人别这样试。
author: sk372
source: Many have claimed the secret to taming a POKENAME is to climb on its back and pull its whiskers like reins. Pokémon Centers and hospitals regularly put out PSAs to discourage this idea.

entry: POKENAME极凶猛，爱对更小、更弱者动粗。会滚过整群人或宝可梦，只为撞击它们，或看其惊恐逃散。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is highly aggressive and prone to violence against those smaller or weaker than it. It will roll its way through entire groups of people or Pokémon just to crash into them or make them scatter in fear.

entry: POKENAME常装作普通暴鲤龙，骗过对手。可伪装通常只撑到敌人感觉毒性发作为止。
author: a_grain_of_rice
source: POKENAME often fool opponents by pretending to be a regular Gyarados. This facade usually lasts until the foe feels the poison take effect.

entry: 民间传说认为，飓风与台风由POKENAME引起。吼声被形容为震耳不绝的长嚎，连地面也会跟着摇。
author: acid_pen
source: According to folk legend, POKENAME is responsible for hurricanes and typhoons. Its roars have been described as a relentless, deafening howl that shakes the ground along with it.

entry: 据说POKENAME百年才现身一次，净化污染湖水。身体热得脚掌碰一下，就能把冰湖变成冒蒸汽的温泉。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is said that POKENAME appears only once every hundred years to purify the contaminated waters of lakes. Its body is so hot that even a touch of its paws can turn frozen lakes into steaming hot springs.

entry: POKENAME大脑改变，本能只想战斗与毁灭。若竟输掉战斗，随后狂暴起来，训练家尤其难以管束。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's brain has altered to the point where it only naturally thinks about combat and destruction. It is especially difficult for Trainers to handle its following rampages if it ever manages to lose a battle.

entry: POKENAME大脑改变，本能只想战斗与毁灭。若竟输掉战斗，随后狂暴起来，训练家尤其难以管束。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's brain has altered to the point where it only naturally thinks about combat and destruction. It is especially difficult for Trainers to handle its following rampages if it ever manages to lose a battle.

entry: POKENAME的力量，大多藏在两条粗尾里，轻易就能打昏更大得多的宝可梦。性情极凶，一点自觉受辱，就会攻击。
author: sk372
source: Much of POKENAME's power is packed into its two thick tails, which can knock much larger Pokémon out with ease. It has a highly aggressive personality, attacking others at the smallest perceived slight.

entry: POKENAME头上角与触须，产生惊人的高电压。性情极暴，狂乱时会用巨大雷暴，毁得四周几乎什么也不剩。
author: sk372
source: The horns and tendrils on POKENAME's head generate massive levels of electrical voltage. Extremely violent, a rampaging POKENAME will decimate all its surroundings with titanic storms of lightning until little remains.

entry: POKENAME常陪着野生暴鲤龙，约束它们的暴行，准备攻击时就推开。可不知为何，暴鲤龙从不对POKENAME本身发怒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is often found in accompanying wild Gyarados. It acts to curb their violent tendencies, pushing them away when they move to attack. For whatever reason, Gyarados never turn aggressive on POKENAME itself.

entry: POKENAME在河岸沙土挖隐秘地洞，等猎物靠水。目标一近，POKENAME就跃出攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME digs hidden burrows in the sand and soil at the side of riverbanks, then waits until prey approaches the water. As soon as it is close, POKENAME will leap out to attack.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，凡觉得受威胁，就会进攻。双翼还能造出强风，吹走敌人。
author: dill360yt
source: POKENAME is a very territorial Pokémon that will attack anything it feels threatened by.  It uses its wings to make strong winds to blow enemies away.

entry: POKENAME靠强尾，逆游河流与瀑布。遇到人造物就砸，船、桥，甚至混凝土水坝，都不例外。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME uses its strong tail to swim up rivers and waterfalls. It will smash any man-made object it encounters; boats, bridges, and even concrete dams.

entry: 天气若不够冷，POKENAME就狂暴，毁掉沿途一切。为防如此，春天将近，人们常把POKENAME引往雪山。
author: darkweavile428
source: If the weather is not cold enough for POKENAME's liking, it will go on a rampage, destroying everything in its path. To prevent this, people will often guide POKENAME to snowy mountains as spring draws near.

entry: POKENAME挖出复杂水下隧道，组成精巧网络。被拖进去的猎物，再不见踪影，永远迷失深处。
author: amiel997
source: POKENAME digs complex underwater tunnels, creating an elaborate network. Prey dragged into these tunnels are never seen again, lost in the depths forever.

entry: POKENAME只盼在现场观众面前唱歌，可演出总以毁坏收场。天性凶暴，谁对难听唱腔说一句坏话，就会惹得它狂暴。
author: oejoeboy33
source: POKENAME wishes nothing but to sing in front of a live audience, but its performances always end in destruction. Due to its inherent violent nature, one bad comment about its horrendous vocals will send it into a rampage.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，整日巡视家园。船或宝可梦靠太近，就用三叉戟制造漩涡与海啸，将它们冲走。
author: cerealjamalt
source: POKENAME is extremely territorial and spends its time patrolling its home. When boats or Pokémon get too close, it uses its trident to create whirlpools and tsunamis to wash them away.

entry: POKENAME时而极端凶暴，时而诡异静止，常出现在遭风暴摧毁的海滨城镇。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME alternates between episodes of extreme violence and eerie stillness. It is often found in coastal towns that have been devastated by storms.

entry: POKENAME虽有强大的力量，背刺却会拖慢泳速；在陆地蜷成球滚动时，尾巴又会碍事。因此，它更依赖伏击，而非追捕。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME has great strength, the spikes on POKENAME's back slow it down while swimming through water, and its tail gets in the way if it curls up into a ball to roll around on land. Because of this, it relies more on ambush than pursuit.

entry: POKENAME住在河岸侧面挖出的隧道中。其他宝可梦一靠近洞穴，它便冲出，用锋利的爪子和强壮的尾巴攻击，再靠背上的尖刺保护自己。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME live inside tunnels they dig into the side of riverbanks. If other Pokémon approach their burrow, POKENAME will rush out to attack with their sharp claws and powerful tail, relying on the spikes on their back for protection.

entry: POKENAME以锐齿、利爪与背刺不断进攻，力道常大得把它们折断。可POKENAME仍不停手，任何断掉的部分，一天内都会再生。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME relentlessly attacks foes with its sharp teeth and claws, as well as the spikes on its back, often with enough force that they break. This does not stop POKENAME from attacking, as anything that breaks will regrow within a day.

entry: POKENAME真身，其实是中央的小鱼。手臂与尾巴，都是以念力操控的构造物。
author: pastamanjase
source: POKENAME's true form is actually the small fish in the center of the body. Its arms and tail are constructs that it controls telekinetically.

entry: POKENAME极少在海上被见到，性情多变，研究者无法靠近。有报告称，POKENAME每108分钟从海床现身，仰天吼叫，再消失。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME has rarely been spotted out at sea, with researchers unable to get close due to its volatile nature. It has been reported that POKENAME emerges from the ocean floor every 108 minutes, bellowing out into the sky before disappearing.

entry: POKENAME常在最湍急的瀑布旁冥想，专注控制本就强烈的怒气。若四周充满暴烈压迫的气氛，整片区域很快就可能被蓝焰吞没。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can be found meditating by the most turbulent waterfalls, focusing on controlling its inherently overwhelming rage. If it becomes surrounded by a violent and overwhelming atmosphere, the area may soon be entirely consumed in blue flame.

entry: POKENAME虽善游，体形却让它大多在岸上走动。因此更常接触人类聚落，破坏也比暴鲤龙更严重。
author: .jerden
source: Although it is a strong swimmer, POKENAME's body shape means that it spends most of its time walking on the shore. This makes it much more destructive than Gyrados, as it comes into contact with humans settlements more frequently.

entry: POKENAME多在恶劣风暴中飞行，把猛烈飞行条件，当作微风般承受。它以双镰劈开水流，让水下敌人无从逃走。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME most often appears flying through harsh storms, enduring the brutal flying conditions as if they were light breezes. It parts water in half using its scythes, allowing no escape for underwater foes.

entry: 它动作快得骇人，出击又狠又猛。野生POKENAME一现身，常就有人悬赏，盼赶在狂怒破坏前捕获。
author: infinex21
source: This Pokémon can move frighteningly fast and strike with brutal ferocity. When a wild POKENAME is spotted, there is oft a bounty set for its capture before it can go into a destructive rage.

entry: POKENAME凶牙中的毒，足以毒死人，宝可梦却可能活下。巨大尾巴，还能把宝可梦打上天空。
author: .afantasticTrainer
source: POKENAME's fierce fangs contain poison which can kill a human but a Pokémon may survive. Its huge tail is strong enough to launch Pokémon into the sky.

entry: POKENAME背花会随食谱与日照变色。可天性常凶暴肆虐，因此花几乎总是淡黄色。
author: beandrawsthings
source: The flower on POKENAME's back can vary in colour depending on its diet and sunlight exposure. However, due to its often vicious and violent nature, these flowers are nearly always pale yellow.

entry: POKENAME极力保护同胞。训练家钓鲤鱼王时，常惊于它为救同族，拼尽爪牙的凶悍。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME are very protective of their siblings. Trainers fishing for Magikarp are often surprised by their savagery as they fight tooth and claw to save their brethren.

entry: POKENAME从不攻击自认比自己弱的宝可梦。可愤怒一旦到达极限，就会疯狂攻击眼前一切，直到什么也不剩。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will never attack Pokémon it considers weaker than it. However, if its anger reaches a critical point, it will violently attack anything within its line of sight until nothing remains.

entry: POKENAME是凶猛猎手，也是所居湖泊的顶级捕食者。尾巴一挥，就掀起强浪，足以掀倒树木与房屋。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: A fearsome hunter, POKENAME is the apex predator of the lakes it inhabits. With a single strike from its tail, it can unleash powerful waves that topple trees and homes.

entry: POKENAME一发现对手闯入领地，就展示巨力，甩尾重击，足以放倒长成的大树。两只POKENAME的战斗，可能要数日才彻底平息。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME thrash their tails with enough force to fell fully grown trees, putting on these displays of power whenever they spy a rival encroaching on their territory. Battles between two POKENAME can take days to fully resolve.

entry: POKENAME双颚咬力足以碎石，战斗时便以强劲狠咬，攻击对手。两只POKENAME之战，可能要数日才彻底平息。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's jaws have enough bite force to crush boulders. They use their powerful bites in battle to attack their rivals with vicious crunches. Battles between two POKENAME can take days to fully resolve.

entry: POKENAME双颚咬力足以碎石，战斗时便以强劲狠咬，攻击对手。两只POKENAME之战，可能要数日才彻底平息。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's jaws have enough bite force to crush boulders. They use their powerful bites in battle to attack their rivals with vicious crunches. Battles between two POKENAME can take days to fully resolve.

entry: 它常去龙属性宝可梦云集的水域，见谁就挑战。多数敌人只料到愤怒凶猛，可POKENAME也聪明得很。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It frequents Dragon-infested waters, picking fights with any it comes across. Most foes expect it to be enraged and ferocious, but POKENAME is also extremely clever.

entry: 绝不要与全力以赴的POKENAME交战。极少数压不过敌人的时候，POKENAME还会用欺骗与诡计，替自己争来胜势。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Never fight POKENAME at full power. On the rare occasion POKENAME cannot overpower an opponent, it uses deception and trickery to put itself in a winning position.

entry: 据说POKENAME被暴鲤龙怨魂附身，而构成如今身体的刀刃，正是当年杀死它的那把。唯有意志坚定不移者，才能握柄，不被沸腾怒火吞没。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME is said to be possessed by the vengeful soul of a Gyarados, once slain by the very blade that now forms its body. Only those with unshakable will can grasp its hilt without being consumed by its seething rage.

entry: 据说POKENAME被暴鲤龙怨魂附身，而构成如今身体的刀刃，正是当年杀死它的那把。唯有意志坚定不移者，才能握柄，不被沸腾怒火吞没。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME is said to be possessed by the vengeful soul of a Gyarados, once slain by the very blade that now forms its body. Only those with unshakable will can grasp its hilt without being consumed by its seething rage.

entry: POKENAME精妙的剑术，唯有自身不息怒火可比。发怒时，双刃不停斩击，直到猎物什么也不剩。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME's complex swordplay is matched only by its ceaseless fury. When enraged, its twin blades strike without rest until nothing remains of its prey.

entry: POKENAME挥动一下，就能毁掉整座城市。古代神话里的许多凶残好战者，都被描绘成手持它；可究竟谁控谁，至今无人知道。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME can destroy entire cities with a single swing. Many of the deadliest warmongers in ancient myth are depicted wielding it, but whether they controlled it or it controlled them remains unknown.

entry: POKENAME挥动一下，就能毁掉整座城市。古代神话里的许多凶残好战者，都被描绘成手持它；可究竟谁控谁，至今无人知道。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME can destroy entire cities with a single swing. Many of the deadliest warmongers in ancient myth are depicted wielding it, but whether they controlled it or it controlled them remains unknown.

entry: POKENAME沿海岸漫游，两栖，能在岸上或水下洞穴筑巢。它用硬过钻石的冠突撞船，试图击沉这些自认的领地挑战者。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME ranges along the coast of oceans, amphibiously able to nest along the shore or in underwater caves. It rams boats with its crest, which is harder than diamond, seeking to sink what it perceives as challengers to its territory.

entry: POKENAME梦想有朝一日，像那些英雄一样，保护弱者。可眼下，它还忙着钓起水宝可梦，盼着大丰收。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME dreams of one day becoming like the heroes who protect the weak. Now, though, it fishes out Water-type Pokémon in hopes of a big catch.

entry: POKENAME的水炮臂，作战十分凶狠。可它依然恪守荣誉，愿意保护比自己弱小的宝可梦。
author: phantom640
source: Despite its cruelty in combat using its water cannon arm, POKENAME has been found to live by a code of honor, leading it to defend weaker Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME是可怕的海中猎手，专在风暴最猛烈的夜里袭船。硕大肌躯重击惊人，利爪连金属船身都能穿透。它以独猎闻名。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a fearsome sea predator that attacks ships during the stormiest nights. Its massive, muscular body can deliver devastating blows, while its sharp claws are strong enough to pierce even metal hulls. It is known to be a solitary hunter.

entry: POKENAME是独行海洋猎手，常在狂暴风暴中出击。强爪能撕开金属，据说重击的力道，足以粉碎整艘船的船身。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a lone predator of the seas, known to strike during fierce storms. Its powerful claws can tear through metal, and the force of its blows is said to shatter the hulls of entire ships.

entry: POKENAME住海滩，出海觅食，在沙中休息。若领地受威胁，POKENAME能拍翼造出飓风般强风，对招惹者穷追不舍。
author: hinochi.
source: POKENAME lives on beaches where they hunt for food at sea and rest in the sand. When its territory is threatened, POKENAME can create hurricane-force winds with its wings and will pursue aggressors relentlessly.

entry: POKENAME下身鳞片太抢手，许多偷猎者甚至以专猎它为生。巡护员努力，加上POKENAME攻性日增，偷猎才逐渐减少。
author: infinex21
source: The scales of POKENAME's lower bodies are so desired that many poachers have made careers of solely hunting them. Poaching has reduced due to the efforts of Pokémon Rangers and the increasingly high aggression that POKENAME have begun to display.

entry: POKENAME通常温顺友善，可居湖一受惊扰，就迅速变凶。细长触角能察觉水变，连一只汽水罐落湖引起的波动，也逃不过。
author: infinex21
source: Although typically docile and kind, POKENAME swiftly turns aggressive when the lake it resides in is disturbed. Its long, thin antennae can easily pick up on shifts in the water, even from a single soda can landing within its lake.

entry: POKENAME渴望把怒火更广散向天与地，突然变异，长出双翼。不肆虐时，就沉睡深海峡谷。
author: grannyjojophone
source: A sudden mutation caused POKENAME to sprout wings, driven by its desire to spread its rage further in the sky and land. When its not rampaging, it slumbers in deep ocean canyons.

entry: POKENAME虽然能在地面滚动，可一上铁轨，速度就会大幅提升。它无视信号，凡是不让路的东西都会撞上去，令正常行驶的列车十分危险。
author: .jerden
source: While it can roll across the ground, POKENAME will move much faster if it gets onto a set of railway tracks. This is incredibly dangerous to regular trains, as POKENAME will ignore signals and collide with anything that doesn't get out of its way.

entry: 传说，最早的POKENAME来自一只鲤鱼伊布——它仅靠跃起水花，便逆着雄伟的瀑布游了上去。
author: melodydelune
source: Legends say the first POKENAME came from a Magiveon that swam up a mighty waterfall by only splashing.

entry: POKENAME脾气多变，护幼时尤其如此，狂暴力量如最惨烈的天灾。应急巡护员带着训练精良的队伍，驻守已知巢址附近。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has a volatile temper, especially when protecting its young, and rampages with the strength of the most devastating natural disasters. Emergency response rangers are stationed near known nesting sites with well-trained teams.

entry: 这种龙属性宝可梦以皮肤坚韧闻名，甚至被称为世上最强的一类。研究者尚未确定，POKENAME腹部的X形记号究竟是不是胎记。
author: thistleblower
source: This dragon-type Pokémon is so well-known for its tough skin that it's said to be the strongest kind in the world. Researchers have yet to determine whether or not the “X” on POKENAME's stomach is truly a birthmark.

entry: POKENAME破坏力强，被认为来自某种异次元。它能从阴影现身，毁坏四周，再消失回黑暗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a destructive creature believed to originate from a different dimension of some kind. It can emerge from shadows, laying waste to the surrounding area before once more vanishing into the darkness.

entry: POKENAME歇在大湖底，将整湖据为己有。传感器一察觉闯入者，就以炮管释放庞大的能量轰击，将其击飞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rests at the bottom of large lakes, claiming them as its own. Its sensors immediately alert it to any intruders, which it blasts away with a titanic blast of powerful energy from its cannon.

entry: 它飞行时优雅地扭转蜷动。训练家最好别正面冲突，因为似乎只要察觉人心一点欺瞒，就会狂怒。
author: fireblade141
source: This Pokémon twists and curls elegantly as it flies. Trainers are advised not to confront it, as it will fly into a rage seemingly upon sensing any amount of deceit within a person's heart.

entry: POKENAME脾气多变，护幼时尤其如此，狂暴力量如最惨烈的天灾。应急巡护员带着训练精良的队伍，驻守已知巢址附近。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has a volatile temper, especially when protecting its young, and rampages with the strength of the most devastating natural disasters. Emergency response rangers are stationed near known nesting sites with well-trained teams.

author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has a volatile temper, especially when protecting its young, and rampages with the strength of the most devastating natural disasters. Emergency response rangers are stationed near known nesting sites with well-trained teams.

entry: POKENAME心情随月相变动。满月时快乐贪玩，新月时却好斗凶猛。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's moods change and shift depending on the phase of the moon. They are happy and playful during the full moon, but are aggressive and feisty during a new moon.

entry: POKENAME耳上与背上的白膜，战斗中常遭撕裂。春天蜕下受损皮肤，再重新长出。水手会收集弃膜，能卖高价。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME regularly suffer tears through the white membrane on their ears and back during combat. During the spring, they shed the damaged skin and regrow it. Sailors collect these discarded membrane which sell for high prices.

entry: POKENAME水样身体，轻易就能游过湍流。常快速逆游大瀑布，看看落下之前，能冲进空中多高。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's watery body help them easily swim through tough streams. They're often seen swimming up large waterfalls at quick speeds, seeing how high they can get up into the air before falling.

entry: POKENAME在港湾与沿岸码头筑巢、繁衍，猎捕最爱的鲤鱼王。缺食时，就用强爪袭击渔船，凶猛抢走渔获。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME nests and thrives in harbors and along coastal docks, where it can hunt the Magikarp it craves. When food is scarce, it attacks fishing boats with its powerful claws to aggressively steal their catch.

entry: POKENAME无差别袭船的恶名，让水手早就避开它占据的水域。它们在岩石小海湾筑巢，材料则用漂流物。
author: mepp.
source: Sailors have long avoided waters that POKENAME claimed territory over due to their reputation of attacking ships indiscriminately. They build their nests on rocky inlets, using flotsam for material.

entry: POKENAME藏在水下，用鲤鱼王模样的头作饵，引来飞行属性猎物，再跃出水，把对方拖进浑浊深渊。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME hide underwater, attracting their Flying-Type prey using their Magikarp shaped heads as bait. They will then jump out of the water and drag their prey down into the murky abyss.

entry: POKENAME巨口与结实体形，让它能吃各式食物，使背花开得鲜粉明黄。可寻食时，极其凶残。
author: beandrawsthings
source: POKENAME's large mouth and stout body enable it to consume a range of foods, causing the flower on its back to bloom a bright pink and yellow. It is extremely vicious in its hunt for food.

entry: POKENAME的心情，与日照直接相连。沐浴阳光时，它平静安宁；一失去光与热的来源，便会暴躁跺脚，向一切靠近的对象怒吼。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's mood is tied directly to its exposure to sunlight. It is calm and serene while under the sun's rays, but the moment it has no source of light and warmth, it stomps around in a tantrum, roaring at anything that approaches.

entry: POKENAME常见于林间小溪，啃吃溪床湿土。谁进领地，就暴力回应，常不小心破坏溪岸的稳固。
author: vic1312
source: Snacking on damp soil at the bottom of stream beds, POKENAME are a feature of small creeks within woodlands. They react violently when someone enters their territory, often inadvertently disrupting the integrity of the stream bank.

entry: POKENAME漂在护身液囊中，凶猛怒气也受其缓和。被招惹后，却会将传奇般的暴脾气，化成巨大超能力冲击，召来高压激流，碾碎挡路一切。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME floats inside a protective, liquid cell that dampens its ferocious rage. When provoked, it channels its legendary temper into massive psychic shockwaves, summoning violent torrents of pressurized water to crush anything in its way.

entry: POKENAME无声游过河流觅食。两只若打起来，就彼此怒咬，顾着较量，反而不小心让猎物逃掉。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME swim silently through rivers in search of meals. If two of them get into a fight, they will furiously snap their jaws at each other, accidentally letting their prey escape while they compete.

entry: POKENAME常跟着吼鲸王群，盼有年老成员死去。若真如此，一具鲸尸，就能养活数代POKENAME。
author: beetlething
source: POKENAME often follow pods of Wailord in the hopes that an older member of the pod will pass away. If this happens, the Wailord carcass is used to feed generations of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME深潜海中，寻找珍珠吃。还会挥动头上的尾巴，吓走进入猎区的船。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME dive deep into the ocean in search of pearls to consume. They use the tail on their head to frighten boats away from their hunting grounds.

entry: 一次目击POKENAME，就足以让湖区封闭数周。它从一片水域移往下一片，吃掉当地多数野生生物，再继续走。渔人若执意留下，自己也可能成猎物。
author: bandedbodypress
source: A single sighting of POKENAME is enough to close a lake for weeks. It moves from one body of water to the next, devouring most of the local wildlife before continuing on. Fishermen who remain despite its presence risk becoming prey themselves.

entry: POKENAME水陆都能生活。凶猛模样虽被影视戏剧描绘，可它稀有、脾气又一点就炸，几乎不可能亲自参与演出。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME may live both in and out of water. Although their ferocious appearance has been depicted in movies and plays, their rarity and hair-trigger temper make it almost impossible for them to appear in such productions.

entry: POKENAME满溢破坏能量，在水下几乎到哪儿，都无所畏惧。能量渗透每个细胞，让它毫无怜悯地摧毁任何稍稍挡路之物。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's body overflows with destructive energy, which allows it to go nearly anywhere underwater without fear. This energy seeps into every cell of its body, causing it to demolish anything that remotely gets in its way without a hint of empathy.

entry: POKENAME一吼，喉中涌出的猛烈能量波，便震塌近旁建筑。为活命，它什么都做，连小宝可梦也会吞食。
author: bobosmith01
source: When POKENAME roars, nearby buildings collapse due to the violent waves of energy that are unleashed through its throat. It will do anything to survive, including devouring small Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME满溢破坏能量，在水下几乎到哪儿，都无所畏惧。能量渗透每个细胞，让它毫无怜悯地摧毁几乎所有挡路之物。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's body overflows with destructive energy, which allows it to go nearly anywhere underwater without fear. This energy seeps into every cell of its body, causing it to demolish almost anything that gets in its way without a hint of empathy.

entry: POKENAME大脑竟比人类还大，可智慧似乎远远赶不上。它也不必聪明，单凭巨力，就让POKENAME几乎什么环境都能活。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's brain is actually larger than a human's, but it appears to lack even remotely the same amount of intelligence. It doesn't need to be smart: sheer strength allows POKENAME to survive in almost any environment.

entry: POKENAME跳舞，是捍卫领地的进攻警告。见到就得慢慢退开，否则便得应付火焰、滚烫水流与刀刃般的喙。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME dancing is a sign of territorial aggression, a warning to any who see it. One should back away slowly as it dances, lest one wants to contend with flame, scalding water and a razor-sharp beak.

entry: POKENAME虽凶猛、护地盘，可只有同类在身旁，才有胆量。身体散出的力量太强，又让其他宝可梦自然地忍不住害怕。
author: bobosmith01
source: It may be highly aggressive and territorial, but it only finds courage when around other POKENAME. Power oozes from its body so strongly that other Pokémon can't help but be naturally intimidated by its presence.

entry: POKENAME对哪怕稍稍惹怒自己的东西，都极其凶残、破坏成性。凭速度与力量，数秒就曾撕碎整艘船。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a most vicious, destructive nature towards anything that catches its ire, even slightly. With its speed and strength, it has torn entire ships to shreds in seconds.

entry: POKENAME几乎不动，任云带着自己漂。其他宝可梦想猎食住在口中的鲤鱼鸟，一进嘴，反而成了它的食物。
author: jreposo
source: POKENAME barely moves, mostly floating wherever the clouds carry it. It feeds on Pokémon that enter its mouth attempting to prey on the Magilu living there.

entry: POKENAME中央，住着看似迷你暴鲤龙的生物。POKENAME脾气与乘客同样凶暴，狂乱时会射出强劲能量水束，毁坏近旁一切。
author: sk372
source: What appears to be a miniature Gyarados inhabits POKENAME's center. POKENAME has a similar violent temperament to its passenger, firing off powerful beams of energized water and decimating anything nearby when it goes on a rampage.

entry: POKENAME少动却充满敌意，用触手刺猎物、注毒。伪装让猎物靠近，也察觉不到POKENAME。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are a sedentary but hostile species of Pokémon, as they use their tentacles to jab at prey, injecting venom into them. Their camouflage allows prey to move closer without noticing POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME在山中湖泊，不停磨练惊人战技。偶尔会离开家园，下山毁掉所轻视的一切。
author: mcnchsschl
source: POKENAME spend their time polishing their incredible fighting skills in mountain lakes. Every so often, one will descend from its home to destroy all it deems unworthy.

entry: POKENAME天性善良单纯，却少作家庭伙伴。年少缺乏约束，咬力又极具破坏，家具大多会被啃碎。
author: enemyphase
source: Although kind-natured and innocent, POKENAME are not often kept as family pets. Their juvenile lack of discipline and destructive biting power result in most pieces of furniture being chewed to bits.

entry: POKENAME若没受严格服从训练，就容易闹出破坏惊人的脾气。因此，想证明自己本事的训练家，反而争相寻求。
author: enemyphase
source: Without strict obedience training POKENAME are prone to throwing tremendously destructive tantrums. As such, they are highly sought after by Trainers attempting to prove themselves.

entry: 研究融合行为的人，对POKENAME颇有好评，因为它远比组成自己的个体友善。据说若真发怒，皮毛就会转成鲜红。
author: crackertower
source: POKENAME is very well regarded by those studying the behavior of fused Pokémon, being considerably more friendly than its individual counterparts. It is said that if this Pokémon is to ever become enraged its coat would turn a bright red.

entry: POKENAME装成无助渔获，骗渔人靠近，再猛地拖进深处。水面下，锯齿闪闪发光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME deceives fishermen by mimicking a helpless catch before yanking them into the depths. Its jagged teeth shimmer just beneath the surface.

entry: POKENAME挖穿河岸，露出树的主根，再用强颚咬住，吸取养分，直到植物枯死，才转往下一棵。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME digs into riverbanks until it exposes the taproot of a tree. It will bite down with its powerful jaws and drain nutrients from the plant until it withers and dies, before moving on to the next one.

entry: POKENAME无情攻击看似更弱的宝可梦，展示威势。可对方一还手，就怯懦地扑腾逃走。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME ruthlessly attacks weaker-looking Pokémon as a show of dominance. However, as soon as they fight back, it flops away in cowardice.

entry: POKENAME独处时安静，可被带离栖地，就受驱使，暴力破坏。双臂各有主意，也让它成为难缠强敌。
author: woobent
source: While peaceful when alone, POKENAME becomes driven to violence and destruction when removed from its habitat. Its arms have a mind of their own, making it a formidable foe.

entry: 它住在海底洞穴，有时会赶走原本住客。若饥饿得不到满足，就烦躁发怒，开始砸穿珊瑚礁。
author: fireblade141
source: The Pokémon lives in undersea caves, sometimes displacing anything already inhabiting them in the process. If it cannot satisfy its hunger, it will get frustrated and start smashing through coral reefs in rage.

entry: 训练家打理POKENAME鳞片时，得格外小心。一出错，POKENAME就会把怒火撒向他们。
author: a_grain_of_rice
source: Trainers must be careful when managing POKENAME scales, because if they make a mistake, POKENAME will unleash its fury upon them.

entry: 真菌控制心智，让它极具攻击性与破坏欲。入侵水域的船，POKENAME非得以强颚彻底毁掉，才肯停歇。
author: fiordaliso
source: The fungus that has taken over its mind has made it extremely aggressive and destructive. POKENAME will not rest until it destroys, with its powerful jaws, the ships that have invaded its waters.

entry: POKENAME用三叉戟搅水，让未来显在涟漪中。画面总是暴力与毁灭，往往正是POKENAME日后亲手制造的事件。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME stirs pools of water with its trident to make the future visible in the ripples. This always reveals images of violence and destruction, frequently events that POKENAME will be directly responsible for.

entry: POKENAME能用水造出暴鲤龙般的形体，协助战斗。流畅的鳍，也让它能在水中快速穿行。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME can make a Gyarados-like construct that is made of water to help POKENAME fight others. POKENAME can travel quickly in water due to its sleek fins.

entry: 它慢悠悠游荡深海，像一座移动火山喷口。以火山喷出物为食的宝可梦，常围拢POKENAME。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It saunters around the deep sea, acting like a mobile volcanic vent. Pokémon who feed off volcanic emissions often swarm POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME一生气，就把懊恼发泄到沙锤上。可摇着摇着添了节奏，怒火最后又变成欢乐。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME are angry, they vent that frustration into their maracas. Eventually, this anger turns into joy as they begin to add rhythm into the shaking.

entry: POKENAME凶暴两栖，攻击附近一切，唯独小火龙例外。越怒，尾火越大；曾有记录，可见的橙焰竟高达数十英尺。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a violent amphibian Pokémon that attacks anything in the area, with the exception of Charmander. The more angered it is, the larger the fire on its tail grows; one case records the visible orange flame growing dozens of feet tall.

entry: POKENAME以暴力求偶闻名。为打动可能的伴侣，POKENAME会毁掉大片珊瑚礁，破坏最厉害的个体，便最有魅力。
author: chrysomelinae
source: POKENAME is infamous for its violent courtship. To impress a potential partner, POKENAME will destroy large swathes of reef. The most destructive individual is deemed the most desirable.

entry: POKENAME边掘地，边朝同类射出激流，争取地盘。每只，都统领宽广的地下领地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires torrents of water at others of its kind while digging to establish territory. Each individual commands a wide underground domain.

entry: POKENAME不许别人靠太近。谁想摸，就嘶叫、拱起尾巴；若还傻傻贴近，就会挨上凶猛爪咬。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are very protective of their personal space, hissing and arching their tail if anyone tries to pet them. Those foolish enough to get too close find themselves getting aggressively clawed and bitten.

entry: POKENAME泳技极高，几小时内就能游过整片海洋。速度与凶猛，让它经常猎食巨牙鲨。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a highly adept swimmer, capable of swimming across entire oceans in a few hours. Its speed and ferocity are enough to let it hunt Sharpedo on a regular basis.

entry: POKENAME极想挥拳打东西，可偏偏没手。每次意识到这点，就更加愤怒、懊恼，也更凶暴。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME has the overwhelming desire to punch things, but lacks hands. Realizing this causes it to become even angrier, frustrated, and more violent.

entry: POKENAME曾被当作传说宝可梦，只有大乱时，才见它怒毁城市。过去，海上听见POKENAME的吠声，也被当成厄运。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME were once thought to be Legendary-Pokémon, only seen raging through cities during times of great strife. Hearing a POKENAME's bark while traveling the seas was once considered bad luck.

entry: POKENAME凶暴两栖，攻击附近一切，唯独小火龙例外。越怒，尾焰越大。曾有记录，POKENAME尾火竟高达数十英尺。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a violent amphibian Pokémon that attacks anything in the area, with the exception of Charmander. The more angered it is, the larger the flame on its tail grows. One case recorded POKENAME's tail fire visibly extending dozens of feet tall.

entry: 尾巴上的火焰，即使浸入水中，也不会熄灭。POKENAME一下水，附近多数宝可梦，便都被吓跑。
author: schierke
source: The fire burning on its tail stays lit underwater. When POKENAME enters the water, it scares off most Pokémon living in that area.

entry: POKENAME看似凶猛，其实颇无害，獠牙软得刺不破皮。常能见它用嘴挂住更大宝可梦，固执想咬，结果一点伤也没有。
author: sk372
source: It looks fierce, but POKENAME is fairly harmless, as its fangs are soft and unable to pierce skin. It's not uncommon to see it clinging to larger Pokémon with its mouth, stubbornly trying and failing to do any damage.

entry: POKENAME凶猛粗壮，用手拉住对方的长须，彼此角力，争夺领地。
author: quackquackattack
source: Aggressive and bulky, POKENAME challenge each other for territory by using their hands to pull against the challenger's whiskers.

entry: POKENAME为锻炼全身肌肉，会在狂暴瀑流下纹丝不动。为宣泄巨力，每天至少得打一场，否则可能被烦躁吞没。
author: fiordaliso
source: To train the muscles of its body, POKENAME stays motionless beneath raging waterfalls. To vent its immense strength, it needs to fight at least once a day, otherwise it risks being devoured by frustration.

entry: POKENAME爱看、也爱模仿相扑。它对待同类，以及在愤怒之湖逗留太久的船时，都能看出这习惯。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME have been noted to enjoy and replicate the sport of sumo. This can be seen in how they interact with both each other and boats that linger too long in the Lake of Rage.

entry: POKENAME是危险的顶级猎手，水里空中一样自在，都能高速行动。巡护员常驻已知的POKENAME猎区旁，保护人们免遭伤害。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are dangerous apex predators that are equally comfortable in both the water and the air, moving at speed through both. Pokémon Rangers are often stationed near known POKENAME hunting grounds to protect people from them.

entry: POKENAME形似龙头，触手则像长须。它浮在海面，常吓到船中水手。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are known to resemble dragon heads, and their tentacles resemble whiskers. They float on the surface of the ocean, often scaring sailors in their boats.

entry: POKENAME几乎终日破坏。找食物时，会不分青红皂白地冲撞成堆河石。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME lives a life of near-constant destruction. It can be found indiscriminately ramming itself into piles of river rocks in search of food.

entry: POKENAME能把一池猎物吃空。吃完，就花上数日，在陆上摇摆走动，寻找新家。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME is capable of completely emptying ponds of prey. When it does, it spends days waddling across land in search of a new home.

entry: POKENAME只知攻击，一进湖，周边生活就根本变样。地方当局，甚至动用炸药，试图清除它。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME knows nothing but aggression; life around a lake fundamentally changes if one wanders in. Local governments have even resorted to explosives in attempts to remove it.

entry: POKENAME一暴怒，鼻孔便喷出滚烫蒸汽，足以升高所游水域的温度。它常挑战其他POKENAME，在海床狂奔竞速。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it flies into a rage, it snorts streams of scalding steam from its nostrils, enough to raise the temperature of the water it is swimming in. It often challenges other POKENAME to wild galloping races along the ocean floor.

entry: POKENAME藏身雾气，行踪难觅。若被激怒，就会猛然冲出迷雾，挥动强尾，抽打敌人。
author: manidrake
source: POKENAME is an elusive Pokémon that hides itself in clouds of mist. If enraged, it will surge from the mist, whipping foes with its mighty tail.

entry: POKENAME力量与怒气成正比。若突然遇战，就拉扯长须，激得自己暴怒。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME power level is proportionate to its anger. If it finds itself in battle unexpectedly, it yanks on its barbels to work itself into a rage.

entry: POKENAME善于钓鱼，却似乎只对鲤鱼王有兴趣。不知怎么，竟能从这些弱鱼身上汲能，维持惊人力量。
author: atlas3339098
source: POKENAME is prolific at fishing but seems only interested in catching Magikarp. Somehow it's drawing energy from these pathetic fish Pokémon to sustain its incredible power.

entry: 三颗怒吼的头与敏捷的身体，让POKENAME令人畏惧。性情极凶，能高高跃起，每颗头都喷出水流。雨天会在平原疾奔觅食。
author: thepandasharky
source: With three roaring heads and an agile body, POKENAME is a terrifying presence to all. It is extremely violent and is able to jump high in the air and shoot water from each head. During the rain, it runs across plains at high speeds looking for prey.

entry: POKENAME常独自游过冰海，寻找一餐。潜艇与深海宝可梦，常在海床遇见熟睡的POKENAME。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often travel in solitude, wandering icy waters in search of a meal. Submarines and deep-sea aquatic Pokémon often encounter POKENAME sleeping on the sea floor.

entry: POKENAME对人贪玩友好，可水陆捕猎时，又毫不留情。许多人见它在友善与凶猛间，自然来回切换，都会心里发毛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is playful towards humans, but still remains a merciless hunter on land or sea. Many admit to being perturbed seeing it change so seamlessly from friendly to fierce and back.

entry: POKENAME用壳旁小鳍，驮着大壳缓慢游动。长须敏感于水压变化，让它格外爱待在急流中。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are able to swim slowly while carrying a large shell using small fins along the shell. They enjoy sitting in fast currents, as their whiskers are sensitive to changes in water pressure.

entry: POKENAME贪食凶猛，几乎什么都吞。古人认为，漩涡就是饥饿的它们试图吞下整片海洋造成的。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are ravenous and ferocious creatures that are able to devour nearly anything. In ancient times, it was believed that whirlpools were caused by famished POKENAME attempting to swallow the ocean itself.

entry: POKENAME掘地如游水般轻松，可挖出的隧道，几乎立刻坍塌。上方若有人类聚落，便会毁成废墟。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME burrows through the earth as easily as it swims in water, but the tunnels it makes almost immediately cave in. Any human settlements above will be left in ruins.

entry: POKENAME极凶，领地内对手不论大小，都要打。小的当猎物，大的则不停咬夹，直到对方逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's fiercely aggressive and battles those in its territory no matter the size. Anything smaller than it will be hunted as prey, and anything larger will be bit and pinched until they flee.

entry: POKENAME双颚有强大碾压之力。性情极暴又固执，一咬住，不把东西压碎，绝不松口。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's jaws possess a powerful crushing strength. It has an extremely violent, stubborn nature, so anything it latches onto with its jaws will not be released until it has shattered beneath its strength.

entry: POKENAME善良体贴，十分自豪于背上的小苗。可谁想靠近它悉心照料的幼苗，就会遭到不分对象的猛烈攻击。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME is a very kind and caring Pokémon and is very proud of the small seedling on its back. However, if anyone tries to get near the seedling that POKENAME cares for, it will attack indiscriminately and aggressively.

entry: POKENAME主动愿载其他宝可梦出行，可鳍再强，圆身仍容易失衡。试骑头顶的，多数很快就掉进水里。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will offer to transport other Pokémon around, but while its fins are strong, its round body is easily unbalanced. Most Pokémon that try to ride on its head quickly fall into the water.

entry: POKENAME游向水电厂，吃发出的电，可若卷入水轮机，就会爆炸。为免损坏水坝，多数野生POKENAME，都已被捕获或解除融合。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME swim towards hydroelectric powerplants to feed upon the electricity they generate, but explode if they are sucked into their turbines. To protect dams from damage, most wild POKENAME have either been captured or unfused.

entry: POKENAME常乘着拉普拉斯骨头拼成的简舟，漂在海上。它远航寻找更多拉普拉斯，盼着能为自己组成家庭。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is often seen drifting at sea inside Lapras bones fashioned into a makeshift boat. It sails the oceans in search of more Lapras, hoping to form a family for itself.

entry: POKENAME驾着简易船，娴熟渡海，将宝可梦从一岸送往另一岸。骨棒既作桨，也作武器，赶走惹事者。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME ferries Pokémon from one side of the sea to the other, expertly navigating the waters aboard makeshift boats. It uses its bone club both as an oar and as a weapon to ward off any troublemakers.

entry: 许多故事说，POKENAME引领死去宝可梦之魂，渡海前往永恒安息。每晚，它神秘驶过水面，把骨棒当桨。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to many tales, POKENAME guides the souls of departed Pokémon across the sea toward eternal rest. Every night it mysteriously sails the waters, using its bone club as a paddle.

entry: POKENAME潜力十足，热切等着蜕变。壳状的茧，既挡环境威胁，也能缓冲来袭攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are brimming with potential and eagerly wait until they reach their metamorphosis. Their shell-like cocoon protects them from environmental threats, and cushions attacks made against them.

entry: POKENAME常在雾晨漂过沿岸，吸入雾，再从毛孔排出刺鼻云团。有些船开始带着它，改善雾海中的能见度。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can be found floating around coastal areas on misty mornings, inhaling the fog in order to expel it in the form of pungent clouds from its pores. Some ships have started keeping it around in order to help visibility in foggy waters.

entry: POKENAME与货船搭档，把港口邮件送往世界各地的港湾码头，确保货物正确送达。若船停用，就固执守在身旁，不肯离开。
author: quackquackattack
source: It delivers Harbor Mail to ports and docks across the world, partnering with a freight ship to ensure goods are received correctly. If the ship is out of commission, POKENAME stubbornly refuses to leave its side.

entry: POKENAME在码头帮船卸货，检查是否夹带违禁品。验货仔细，力气又强，让它在船厂十分重要。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME help ships unload from docks to ensure that there is no contraband on the ships. Their meticulous examination of the goods and their superior strength give them a vital role in the shipyard.

entry: 温顺的POKENAME几乎被猎杀殆尽。即使如此，野生个体仍常自愿用巨大的腹袋，载人渡过水域。
author: sontyp
source: Their docile nature has resulted in POKENAME being hunted almost to the point of extinction. Regardless, wild POKENAME can often be observed carrying people across bodies of water in their giant belly pouches out of their own volition.

entry: 睡前，POKENAME从口中放出柔和泡沫，在海床做软巢。将睡去时，还会轻轻哼唱。
author: .izik
source: Before sleeping, POKENAME releases gentle foam from its mouth to make a soft nest on the ocean floor. It hums quietly as it drifts off.

entry: POKENAME夜里浮出水，唱幽怨低沉的曲。若唱到一半遭打扰，就放出浓厚烟幕，随后消失。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME surfaces to sing a haunting, somber melody. If disturbed mid-song, it releases a thick Smoke Screen before vanishing.

entry: POKENAME爱低调，是自然影片里背景生物的热门选择。它们避开关注，镜头一对准，就赶快游走或藏起。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are a popular choice as background creatures for nature films, as they prefer to remain inconspicuous. They avoid being the center of attention and will quickly swim away or hide when in focus of a camera.

entry: POKENAME难寻又会迁徙，水温、流速等条件，差一点点，筑巢地就可能大不相同。因此，野外研究很困难。
author: bobosmith01
source: Elusive and migratory, POKENAME's nesting grounds vary wildly on minute differences in variables such as temperature and current speed. As a result, they are difficult to study in the wild.

entry: POKENAME能充当浮板，帮助游泳需支撑者。认真负责，确保背上乘者保持漂浮，因此医院常请它，帮助肌力不足的人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can act like kickboards for those who need support while swimming. Their diligence ensures that those on their backs remain afloat, so they are often recruited by hospitals to aid those with weak muscles.

entry: POKENAME容易依恋船员，一生大多守在码头，陪他们每次出航。也会以表演、戏法与杂技，逗同行伙伴开心。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME tends to become attached to ship crews, and it spends most of its life on the docks to accompany them on all their sea voyages. It cheers up its fellow adventurers with shows, tricks, and acrobatics.

entry: 它们粗壮，陆上也能远行，轻易冲过多数自然障碍。覆壳的背部隆起，存着多喝的水，够身体至少一周不缺水。
author: infinex21
source: These burly Pokémon can travel great distances on either land and can barrel through most natural obstacles with ease. The shell-clad hump on their back contains a storage of excess water they drink that can keep them hydrated for at least a week.

entry: POKENAME繁衍、增加数量都很困难。舒缓的歌，却能说服某些天敌，别来打扰。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME struggles to reproduce and grow its population. Its soothing songs allow it to convince some predators to leave it alone.

entry: POKENAME用环绕身体的巨大冰粒环，摧毁挡路障碍。层叠的壳，也能同时载着许多物品。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses the large ring of ice particles that surrounds it to destroy any obstacles that may impede its path. Its layered shell allows it to carry many items on it at once.

entry: POKENAME用环绕身体的巨大冰粒环，摧毁挡路障碍。层叠的壳，也能同时载着许多物品。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses the large ring of ice particles that surrounds it to destroy any obstacles that may impede its path. Its layered shell allows it to carry many items on it at once.

entry: POKENAME身体如布丁，在海中迅速滑行。为避偷猎者，还能变作漂流杂物，或正在融化的冰。
author: .izik
source: With a pudding-like body, POKENAME glides swiftly through the sea. To evade poachers, it can morph into floating debris or melting ice.

entry: POKENAME常攀过危险海岸的尖岩，凭小体型与强泳技，救助宝可梦，送往更安全的岸边。
author: danieru4729
source: Found on dangerous coastal areas, climbing around sharp rocks, POKENAME use their small size and strong swimming strength to rescue Pokémon and bring them to safer shores.

entry: 西尔佛公司将POKENAME开发为智能浏览器，帮助使用者安全网上冲浪，避开各种恶意软件。
author: napstabl0ok
source: Developed by Silph Co. to work as a smart browser, POKENAME helps users surf the web safely, avoiding different kinds of malware.

entry: POKENAME远迁海洋，寻找能钻入休息的沙地。可海滩自然风化，让滩与滩间的旅途，愈加艰难。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME migrates across large expanses of the ocean in search of sand to burrow in for rest. Due to the natural weathering of beaches, it finds the journey between beaches increasingly difficult.

entry: POKENAME在严重洪水中，载人和宝可梦，以美妙歌声安抚，游向安全处。惨烈飓风过后，搜救行动会派它出场。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME ferries people and Pokémon through severely flooded areas, keeping them calm with its beautiful song as it swims them to safety. Search and rescue operations deploy them after catastrophic hurricanes.

entry: 拉普拉斯结群时，就会有一只POKENAME加入。POKENAME以锐眼侦察，毫秒间回应威胁，再射冰冻光束，将其冻住。
author: ghostslythe
source: When pods of Lapras form, a POKENAME joins their group.  POKENAME acts as a scout using its acute vision.  It reacts to threats in milliseconds, spraying Ice Beams to freeze them in place.

entry: POKENAME不飞时，便浮在水面。脾气太急，谁游到四英尺以内，都会接连挨上痛苦蜇刺。
author: ghostslythe
source: When it's not in flight, POKENAME floats on the water's surface. Due to its short temper, any who swim within four feet suffer multiple painful stings.

entry: POKENAME靠超能力在水下移动，能造空气囊，安全带别人同行。野生POKENAME避开任何人类接触，大半时间藏在海底洞穴。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME moves itself underwater using psychic energy and can create pockets of air to safely bring others with it. Wild POKENAME avoid any contact with humans and spend most of their time inside caves on the ocean floor.

entry: POKENAME屡遭偷猎，已几乎找不到。过去10年，POKENAME仅有一次得到确认的目击记录。
author: bigoljax
source: Due to constant poaching attempts, POKENAME are near impossible to find. In the last 10 years, only one confirmed sighting of POKENAME has been documented.

entry: POKENAME颈间围着类似现代浮具的材料。人工仿制出现之前，曾是偷猎目标。它善良，却天生戒备人类；若受威胁，就把叶片冻成锐器。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: POKENAME's neck is ringed with material similar to modern flotation devices and was the target of poachers before it was recreated artificially. They are kind but naturally wary of humans, and freeze their leaf into a sharp weapon if threatened.

entry: POKENAME常帮忙园艺，擅长香气与浇水，很适合想养植物的人。据说会把颈旁的花，送给喜欢的对象。
author: helpee_62132
source: POKENAME is frequently used for gardening, as its capabilities for aromas and watering are excellent for those who want to grow plants. It is said to give flowers from its neck to those it likes.

entry: POKENAME比拉普拉斯更凶，也更适应暖地，常出现在新岛形成之处。亲族不信任人类，会极力保护它们。
author: wormspawn
source: More aggressive and used to warmer climates than Lapras, POKENAME appear where islands begin to form. They are protected fiercely by their families due to distrust of humans.

entry: POKENAME没力气从壳缝喷出完整烈焰，却能制造大量滚烫蒸汽。既灼伤来袭者自卫，也遮住其视线，方便藏身。
author: sk372
source: Though it lacks the power to make fully-formed flames erupt from the gaps in its shell, POKENAME can create great amounts of boiling-hot steam to burn others in self-defense and obscure their vision so it can hide.

entry: 背壳拖慢了POKENAME陆上动作，可四肢着地，仍能搬运重物。走着，会粗声唱歌，替自己打气。
author: .jerden
source: Although the shell on its back slows POKENAME's movements on land, it can carry heavy loads by moving around on all fours. It sings gruffly as it walks to keep itself motivated.

entry: POKENAME以回声定位找出口，帮助洞中迷路的旅人。振翅无声，从其他宝可梦旁飞过，也不会被发现。
author: quackquackattack
source: It aids travelers lost inside caves by using its echolocation to find exits. POKENAME has a silent wingbeat, allowing it to fly past another Pokémon undetected.

entry: POKENAME漂过海面，自顾唱歌。头壳保护软身，撞船或岩石时，也不易受伤。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will drift along the ocean's surface, singing to themselves as they do so. The shells on their heads protect their soft bodies from injury when bumping into ships or rocks.

entry: POKENAME服务出色，送餐敏捷，待客有礼。在能得到许多夸赞的小餐馆，尤其表现出众。
author: quackquackattack
source: Offering excellent customer service, POKENAME are nimble servers and respectful to patrons at restaurants. They excel in diners where they will receive plenty of praise for their actions.

entry: POKENAME虽然稀少，偶尔仍能在船上找到。吃得到什么就吃，常被当成害兽，可也聪明得能训练搬小物，再用牙帮忙木工。
author: .jerden
source: Although rare, POKENAME is sometimes found on ships. It is often seen as a pest due to eating whatever food it can find, but it is intelligent enough to be trained to carry around small objects and use its teeth for carpentry.

entry: POKENAME巡游远海，深知洋流。可全球航运兴起后，被大型船只撞击愈发频繁，如今已几近灭绝。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are found patrolling the high seas, having a deep understanding of ocean currents. With the advent of global shipping, POKENAME are increasingly frequently being struck by large vessels, and are currently nearly extinct.

entry: POKENAME善歌，记得许多歌曲与交响乐。野外，会带领其他歌唱宝可梦，组成乐团。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME is a great singer and has the ability to remember many songs and symphonies. In the wild, it will lead other singing Pokémon in orchestras.

entry: POKENAME能旋转身体各节，让骨状突起充当螺旋桨。足以让多数宝可梦丧命的水压，它也能承受。
author: vaporvenator
source: POKENAME can rotate its body segments, their bony protrusions acting as propellers. It tolerates water pressures most Pokémon would find lethal.

entry: POKENAME以肉眼难辨的速度，滑过海面。覆甲巨钳在浪下出击，瞬间碾碎猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides across the sea's surface with blinding speed. Its armored claws strike beneath the waves, crushing prey in an instant.

entry: POKENAME善游也善爬，家筑在海崖顶。平静天气，美妙歌声传向海上，数英里外也能听见。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are strong swimmers and climbers, and make their home atop seaside cliffs. On calm days, their beautiful singing can be heard echoing for miles out at sea.

entry: POKENAME让水中矿物沉淀，再经成岩作用造壳。因此身体会不断排出近乎纯净的水。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME precipitate minerals out of the water to form their shells through lithification. They constantly shed nearly pure water from their body as a result.

entry: POKENAME壳上枝丛，供小宝可梦躲藏，既是移动之家，也是安全交通。天敌一近，POKENAME便以层层寒冰裹住自己，保护身体与乘客。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME shelter smaller Pokémon within the branches on their shells, acting as portable homes and safe means of transport alike. If a predator approaches, POKENAME will encase themselves in layers of ice to protect themselves and their passengers.

entry: POKENAME替传输慢的电脑运送数据，让文件更快到达终点。又能懂人话，便帮初学程序员，编写、理解代码。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME carries data from computers that are slow to transmit data to help the files get to their end location faster. Its ability to understand human language allows it to help new, inexperienced programmers write and understand coding.

entry: POKENAME奔过陆地，身后留下一道温暖泡沫。极少数静止时，会安静庄重地望向远方火山。
author: sk372
source: As it runs across the land, POKENAME casts a trail of warm, frothy bubbles behind it. On the rare occasions it's seen staying still, it casts a quiet, solemn gaze in the direction of distant volcanoes.

entry: 有趣的是，POKENAME的壳不连身体，能直接取下。不过，因担心拉普拉斯与水君的健康，壳脱离时再解除POKENAME融合会有什么影响，至今仍未深入研究。
author: bobosmith01
source: Interestingly, POKENAME's shell is not attached to its body and can be removed. However, the effects of unfusing POKENAME while the shell is not attached has not yet been studied in depth due to concerns over Lapras and Suicune's health.

entry: POKENAME不停寻求对手，战吼连最偏远的地方也能听见。谁被认定威胁拉普拉斯族群，就会遭它攻击。
author: cheroace
source: POKENAME's war cry can be heard from even the most remote locations as it continues to seek opponents. It will attack anyone it sees as a threat to the Lapras population.

entry: POKENAME张开冰封的蓝宝石双翼，翱翔天空，寻找仁慈训练家结交。它们友善，爱载别人，尤其是胆大的小孩。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME soar through the sky with frozen sapphire wings to find compassionate Trainers to befriend. They are friendly Pokémon that love giving rides to others, especially daring young children.

entry: POKENAME漂在家园岸边，边唱歌，边将附近水冻结、融开。若有人好心善意地靠近POKENAME，POKENAME便乐意护送渡水。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME float around the shores they call home, singing songs as they freeze and unfreeze the water near them. If someone approaches POKENAME with kindness and goodwill, POKENAME will gladly escort the person across the water.

entry: POKENAME漂在家园岸边，边唱歌，边将附近水冻结、融开。若有人好心善意地靠近POKENAME，POKENAME便乐意护送渡水。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME float around the shores they call home, singing songs as they freeze and unfreeze the water near them. If someone approaches POKENAME with kindness and goodwill, POKENAME will gladly escort the person across the water.

entry: POKENAME以臂上的冰枪尖突刺，制服猎物。智慧高超，还能协调其他宝可梦，谋划复杂战略。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME takes down prey with thrusts from the icy spearpoint on its arm. Its high intelligence enables it to coordinate with other Pokémon and devise complex strategies.

entry: POKENAME肌肉强健，单臂就能举起集装箱。甲片让它耐得住最恶劣天气，因此是船厂的重要成员。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are muscular Pokémon that can lift shipping containers with a single arm. Their armored plating enables them to work in the toughest weather conditions, which makes them a vital part of the shipyard.

entry: POKENAME不受寒冷影响，爱在电脑循环冷却液里游泳。奇怪的是，它还能用屏幕键盘，打出、发送通顺文字。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME likes to spend its time swimming through circulating coolant for computers since it is unaffected by the cold. It is curiously able to type and send messages using on-screen keyboards in coherent text.

entry: POKENAME重尾用来自卫，既能甩向敌人，当重击工具，也能拉到背上，充作护甲。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's heavy tail is used for self-defense. It can use it both as a bludgeoning tool to swing at opponents as well as pulling it over its back to act as defensive plating.

entry: POKENAME曾将许多溺水者拖回陆地，救下性命。力量与忠诚，让它成为救生员喜爱的选择。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME have saved many people from drowning by dragging them back to land. Their strength and loyalty have made them a popular choice of Pokémon for lifeguards.

entry: 许多野生POKENAME，白天大半时间在海中。入夜，就浮出水，去沙滩筑巢、休息。
author: cobalt0135
source: Many wild POKENAME spend most of their day in the sea. They resurface to make their nests and rest on the beaches whenever nightfall comes.

entry: 有记录显示，野生POKENAME曾在风暴中救助沉船。力量足以把载满人与宝可梦的整船，平安带回陆地。
author: cobalt0135
source: Wild POKENAME have been documented rescuing sinking ships during stormy weather. They have the strength to carry entire vessels full of people and Pokémon safely back to land.

entry: POKENAME能感应栖居的海洋，辨出近旁海中生灵的思绪与感情。POKENAME虽友善温柔，可小体型与甲壳，也使它易遭偷猎、贩卖。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME is attuned to the ocean it lives in, able to discern the thoughts and feelings of those nearby in the seas. Though very friendly and gentle, POKENAME is vulnerable to poaching and trafficking due to its shell and its diminutive size.

entry: POKENAME会对最先看见的对象着迷，将思绪与情绪相连。自己越欢欣，训练家或宝可梦朋友，也会越感同身受。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME is attuned to whoever it first lays eyes upon, bonded through its own fascination and linking its thoughts and emotions to theirs. The more jubilant it feels, the more its Trainer or Pokémon friend will feel the same way.

entry: POKENAME一察觉训练家心中不安，就唱起轻柔庄严的旋律，连最烦扰的心也能抚平。裙子由薄冰晶构成，动作时叮当作响。
author: milchik
source: If POKENAME senses unease in its Trainer's heart, it will sing a soft, majestic melody that soothes even the most troubled souls. Its dress is made of thin ice crystals that jingle as it moves.

entry: 考古学家发现，古画将POKENAME描绘成昔日帝国的祭司或宰相。它能将思绪连向半径50公里内的每个心灵，加深对世界的理解。
author: beatdoof
source: Archaeologists have found paintings of POKENAME depicted as clerics or chancellors of empires of old. It can link its thoughts to every mind within a 50km radius, furthering its understanding of the world.

entry: 历史记载里，POKENAME曾是一些叛乱与起义的领袖之一。它能与敌人建立精神联系，以强劲鳍肢，控制对方的言语与动作。
author: beatdoof
source: Historical accounts tell of rebellions and revolts forming with POKENAME as one of their leaders. It's able to psychically bond against its enemy, allowing it to control the enemy's words and movements using its fierce flippers.

entry: 厚实而带刺的壳，保护POKENAME免遭攻击。它们聪明得很，歌也唱得动听。
author: essie
source: A thick, spiked shell protects POKENAME from enemy attacks. They are highly intelligent, and can sing beautifully.

entry: POKENAME能察觉近旁谁有溺水风险。它会引出巨大灵体般的形貌，抓住险中之人，送往更安全处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can sense when someone is at risk of drowning near it. It draws out a large, spirit-like form with which it can take hold of the person in danger and ferry them somewhere safer.

entry: POKENAME凭神秘力量，能推知近旁的想法、意图，甚至情绪。因此，几乎不必害怕猎人。
author: bobosmith01
source: Using mysterious powers, POKENAME can deduce the thoughts, intentions, and even the emotions of whoever is nearby. As a result, it almost never needs to fear hunters.

entry: POKENAME害羞，只会在海上现身帮助心善而有需要的训练家。受威胁时，水状附肢会变得锋利，能切开岩石。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are quite shy and will only appear to kind-hearted Trainers in need while at sea. When threatened, it sharpens its water-like appendage to cut through stone.

entry: 有人把POKENAME固定船首，因面部强得能挡住迎来的一切浮冰。不过，脆弱后背持续受压，会严重威胁健康。
author: soup1900
source: Some people attach POKENAME to the front of boats since their faces are strong enough to take on any ice chunk flowing towards them. However, this is very dangerous for their health since it applies constant pressure to their vulnerable backsides.

entry: POKENAME虽然泳技出众，大部分时间却坐在岸上。即使入水，也多半只是随波逐流，让骑在背上的乘客颇为懊恼。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME is a strong swimmer, it spends most of its time sitting on the shore. Even when it enters the water, it mostly just drifts with the current, to the frustration of anyone riding on its back as a passenger.

entry: 野外虽极难见到POKENAME，可一见，就是海上环境危险的预警。POKENAME会用翼状肢体，迅速送走愿意搭乘的旅人。
author: pixlhoopa
source: While it is exceedingly rare, seeing a POKENAME in the wild is an alarm for hazardous conditions for people at sea. POKENAME uses its wing-like appendages to swiftly move willing passengers away from the danger.

entry: POKENAME常喜欢上沉船，把最爱的那艘背在背上，因此常被误当幽灵船。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are known to become fond of sunken sea vessels. They wear their favorite sunken ship on their backs and are often mistaken for ghost ships.

entry: POKENAME难寻，几近灭绝，姿态优雅地踏水跃行。正因许多人猎取华美发光的角，才落到如此地步。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are elusive, nearly-extinct, Pokémon that prance atop the surface of bodies of water with a graceful demeanor. The reason they were driven to near-extinction is that many hunted them for their glowing, magnificent horns.

entry: POKENAME轻松优雅地踏水而行。据说风暴倾船后，会救起水手，可从未有人亲眼见过救援过程。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME walk on water with an effortless grace. They are said to rescue sailors after a storm capsizes boats, though no one has ever been able to spot them in the act.

entry: POKENAME水陆都能活，喜欢沙岸与海滩，有时还会把自己种在浅海中。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME сan live both on land and underwater. It likes sandy shores and beaches and sometimes plants itself in shallow waters of the seas and oceans.

entry: POKENAME背上能长出整片珊瑚礁，供许多小型水生宝可梦栖居。也常保护太阳珊瑚，抵御好坏星。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME can grow an entire coral reef on its back. It serves as home to many smaller underwater Pokémon and often protects Corsola from Mareanie.

entry: 训练家往POKENAME背上绑招牌，让它在影院前宣传。性情友好，又待在训练家近旁，很适合街头广告。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be seen advertising in front of movie theaters, with signs that Trainers strap to their backs. They act friendly and stay close to their Trainer, making them great for street advertisements.

entry: POKENAME虽稀少，在严寒南方仍能自然找到。走路挪步沉重，成群歌唱、啾鸣，声音整齐一致。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are rare but can be found naturally in the frigid south. They have a shifting and lumbering gait and sing and chirp in unison as a group.

entry: 海中遗迹，发现过刻着POKENAME的古老图像。有人相信，忠诚不改的它们，曾守卫水下古文明；可一切证据，却指向遗迹是海平面上升后才被淹没。
author: .fedoraman
source: There are ancient engravings of POKENAME found in marine ruins. Some believe that these steadfastly loyal Pokémon were guards in an ancient underwater civilization, but all evidence points to the ruins being submerged due to sea-level rise.

entry: POKENAME在危险宝可梦密布的区域，充当向导与守卫。它把乘客抱在臂中，任威胁被沉重坚甲弹开。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME acts as a guide and guardian through areas filled with dangerous Pokémon. It holds those it is ferrying in its arms, letting the dangers glance off its heavy, sturdy armor plating.

entry: POKENAME能在海中疾游，也能掠海滑翔，振翅之力，能造巨大漩涡。悦耳叫声，也方便与其他宝可梦交流。
author: keiracm35_
source: POKENAME swim and glide over the seas at high speeds, and can create huge whirlpools with the strength of their wingbeats. Their melodious cries allow them to communicate easily with other Pokémon.

entry: 贡多拉船夫会训练POKENAME，载客时精准小心地游动。它们爱人，还能摆姿势拍照，不打扰乘客。
author: quackquackattack
source: Gondoliers train POKENAME to take passengers and swim carefully with their precise movement. They adore people and can pose for a camera without disturbing their passengers.

entry: POKENAME爱陪训练家，在开阔水域畅游。救生员也常请它帮忙，救起溺水的人与宝可梦。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME love to swim in open waters with their Trainers. They are often used by lifeguards to help save drowning people and Pokémon.

entry: 强尾推动下，POKENAME的锐角能切开坚冰。极地探险者驾船时，会派POKENAME到前方，替船破冰。
author: .jerden
source: When driven forward by its powerful tail, POKENAME's powerful horn can cut through solid ice. Polar explorers sailing in ships have sent out POKENAME ahead of them to work as icebreakers.

entry: 古洞画里已有这只古老宝可梦，现代也仍有目击。据古老描绘，POKENAME曾有平息怒海之力，也能载整个部族渡海。
author: infinex21
source: This ancient Pokémon has appeared in many cave drawings, despite also being sighted in modern times. According to the old depictions, POKENAME had the power to quell raging seas and the strength to ferry entire tribes across the ocean.

entry: 拉普拉斯濒临灭绝时，人们创造这种融合体，想让它们永久留存。后来发现没有必要，POKENAME的设计便被废弃。
author: dodoowner_
source: When Lapras was on the brink of extinction, this fusion was created to keep them forever. POKENAME's design was later scrapped, as it was unneeded.

entry: POKENAME满身尖刺，看似凶猛，却更愿吼着吓退敌人，不真打。若遭袭击，就背向对方，以壳自保，再甩尾反攻。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME's spikes make it seem aggressive, it prefers to frighten away foes by roaring instead of fighting. If it is attacked, it will face away from the foe to protect itself with its shell, then strike back with swings of its tail.

entry: POKENAME伪装成小船，待在码头栈桥旁。有时人没发现是宝可梦，就爬进去；等它伸出发光等离子体，划水载客，才大吃一惊。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will hang around docks and jetties, disguised as a small boat. Sometimes people climb in without realizing it is a Pokémon, and are surprised when it extends out glowing plasma to row itself and its passengers through the water.

entry: POKENAME数量虽少，却在大珊瑚礁担任调停者。能让水生宝可梦心灵相连，因此在繁盛生态中，居于核心。
author: bardanchaos
source: Though few exist, POKENAME act as mediators in large coral reefs. Their ability to create psychic links between aquatic Pokémon makes them central figures in thriving ecosystems.

entry: POKENAME泳力强，连冰寒水域，也能连续游上一天以上。强壮獠牙，则能劈开一切挡路冰山。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are powerful swimmers, able to keep swimming for over a day even in freezing cold waters. Its powerful tusks allow of it to cleave through any iceberg in its way.

entry: POKENAME极凶，三头吐出寒气，几乎攻击所有会动之物。水手讲着可怕故事，说北海曾有船只漂流，船员全被冰封。
author: brilliantdarkness
source: Incredibly aggressive, POKENAME attack nearly anything moving with icy breath from their three heads. Sailors tell grim stories of ships found adrift in northern seas, their crews encased in ice.

entry: POKENAME是水空旅行的首选。有些野生POKENAME会主动找训练家，提供搭乘；可一答应，最好准备好面对任何状况。
author: elibromax314
source: POKENAME is the premier form of both water and air travel. Some wild POKENAME will approach Trainers to offer rides, though anyone who accepts should be prepared for anything.

entry: 野生POKENAME极难寻，会用强力威慑招式，防止来者近身。有记录显示，不受欢迎者靠太近，可能遭咒，往后数年，都在梦中暴风雪里徘徊。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is incredibly elusive in the wild and uses powerful and deterring moves to prevent others from getting close. It has been recorded that unwanted individuals that draw too close can be cursed to wander blizzards in their dreams for years.

entry: POKENAME极其罕见，又被偷猎者看重。歌声，却能抚平人与宝可梦的心。
author: bobosmith01
source: An extremely rare Pokémon that is valued by poachers, POKENAME can sing songs that soothes the hearts of people and Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME水下动作精准，会受训练，陪同花样游泳选手。它们喜欢制造难忘时刻，表演时总全力以赴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are trained to accompany synchronized swimmers, as they have precise movement while submerged. They enjoy creating memorable moments and do their best when performing.

entry: POKENAME模样奇特，像软体动物，通常藏在壳内。敌人若太近，就可能猛合壳，夹得对方疼痛。
author: hophoppip
source: The oddly mollusk-like POKENAME is usually hidden within its shell. If a foe gets too close, it may painfully clamp its shell onto them.

entry: 热气球偏航时，POKENAME会结群，将其拖回路线。也会提醒飞行者，地面察觉不了的强风。
author: quackquackattack
source: When a hot air balloon flies off course, POKENAME groups together to drag the balloon back on course. It also warns fliers of strong wind conditions that cannot be detected while grounded.

entry: POKENAME以利爪掘穿厚冰，战斗时，则挥舞沉重尾棒。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's sharp claws allow them to burrow through thick sheets of ice. They wield their heavy tail club during battle.

entry: POKENAME是古老生灵，史前便已是可怕猎手，住在岩崖间的海洞。巨颚能放出压力极高的水柱。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an ancient creature that was already a fearsome predator in prehistoric times, dwelling in sea caves carved into rocky cliffs. Its massive jaws can unleash jets of water at extremely high pressure.

entry: POKENAME头上硬壳太沉，只能缓慢移动，住在藏得很好的水下岩缝。
author: chorb33
source: The hard shell on POKENAME's head is very heavy, which means it can only move slowly. It lives in well-hidden crevices under water.

entry: POKENAME蜕下的鳞片，磨粉后可作香料。粗砂般质感、咸味与浓香，为美餐添上一股辛辣劲。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shed scales that are ground up and eaten as a spice. The gritty texture, salty taste, and intense aroma provide a spicy kick to a tasty meal.

entry: POKENAME不断放出的水，看似清澈，实则暗藏凶险，里面混着自身剧毒的体液。
author: chorb33
source: The clear-looking water that POKENAME constantly releases is particularly perfidious, as it is mixed with the highly toxic juices of its body.

entry: POKENAME会载迷路孩子回家，用软羽安抚。POKENAME再轻唱摇篮曲，哄孩子睡着，才送还父母。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are known to ferry lost children back home, using their soft plumage to calm them. POKENAME emit a soft lullaby to help put children to sleep before returning them to their parents.

entry: POKENAME头上清水，晶莹得被许多宝可梦误当清凉喷泉。可悲的是，里面却有剧毒。
author: chorb33
source: The crystal-clear water on POKENAME's head is mistaken by many other Pokémon for a refreshing fountain. Tragically, however, it is highly poisonous.

entry: POKENAME伪装成平静水池，引来口渴宝可梦。可壳内水其实是毒液，会削弱猎物，方便POKENAME取食。
author: amiel997
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a calm pond, luring in thirsty Pokémon. However, the water inside its shell is actually a poisonous fluid that weakens its prey, allowing POKENAME to easily feed on them.

entry: POKENAME是水上表演的无名功臣，绚丽水艺，让观众目眩。若欢喜极了，就举臂向天，显露悦目的腹面。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are unsung heroes of water shows, as their colorful displays of water arts dazzle audiences. When extraordinarily gleeful, they raise their arms to the sky, revealing an aesthetically pleasing underside.

entry: POKENAME是艺术展上默默无闻的功臣，以缤纷墨艺令观众目眩神迷。墨水落地，又成了一幅美丽的抽象画。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are unsung heroes of art shows, as their colorful displays of ink arts dazzle audiences. When the ink lands on the ground, a beautiful work of abstract art is made.

entry: POKENAME会用壳背起迷失在苔原上的旅人，将他们送回偏远村庄。它们生性胆怯，宁愿不被人看见。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME carry lost travelers through the tundra on their shells before hauling them back to remote villages. POKENAME are skittish creatures, preferring not to be seen.

entry: 野生POKENAME会藏在寒冷地区的瀑布后。头部两侧垂落的水流闪烁得如同幻象，可一旦有敌人发现它，水流便会猛砸下来，威力与真正的瀑布无异。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME conceal themselves behind waterfalls in cold climates. Although the water falling on either side of their head shimmers like an illusion, it crashes down on any foes that do find them with as much force as the real thing.

entry: 饲养POKENAME，最要紧的是附近有水域供它玩耍。它有无穷精力，必须靠游泳消耗，若无处发泄就会异常焦虑、坐立不安。
author: sk372
source: It is paramount for POKENAME owners to have a body of water nearby for it to play in. It has boundless energy it needs to burn via swimming, and will become incredibly anxious and restless without the proper outlet.

entry: POKENAME走到哪里都唱着蓝调，每个音符都饱含乐曲深沉的感情。它热切而富于变化的歌声，吸引了海边的众多听众。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sing blues melodies wherever they go, carrying the emotional depth of the music in each note. The passion and complexity of their singing captivate many beachside audiences.

entry: POKENAME会把溺水儿童托上背，送回岸边。它笑时会露出一口巨大的锯齿状牙齿，因此总尽量不让笑容吓着孩子。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lifts drowning children onto its back before ferrying them to shore. POKENAME tries not to scare children with its smile, which displays a set of large, serrated teeth.

entry: POKENAME照料湖畔河边的蘑菇群，保护它们免受伤害。只要人们不损坏蘑菇，它就愿意载人渡水。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME tends to mushroom colonies that grow adjacent to lakes and rivers, protecting them from harm. It is known to ferry people across water as long as they avoid damaging any mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME会用额头的心形鳞片敲打岩石，与同类交流。它能不知疲倦地游上一整天，才需要上岸休息。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME taps the heart-shaped scale on its forehead against rocks to communicate with others of its kind. It can swim tirelessly for an entire day before needing to rest on land.

entry: 据说POKENAME喜欢在岸边优雅起舞，同时挥出斩击。它向众人放声歌唱，以歌声联结人与宝可梦。
author: b3llda1zora
source: It is said that POKENAME likes to slash while dancing elegantly on shorelines. It sings for all to hear, connecting both people and Pokémon with its voice.

entry: POKENAME漂浮在冰窟的寒水上方。背部闪亮的冰晶，是一些罕见雪葩配方中珍贵的原料。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats above frigid waters in icy caverns. The glimmering ice crystals on its back are prized ingredients in rare sorbet recipes.

entry: POKENAME携带的桨世代相传。它们常唱着优美而悲伤的挽歌，向这件法器注入火热能量，再向敌人喷出滚烫的水。
author: ghostslythe
source: The oar POKENAME carries has been passed down through generations. They often sing beautiful yet tragic dirges while pouring fiery energy into the focus, before unleashing scalding water on foes.

entry: POKENAME用硅化木制成杖，在扁平处刻上精细的波浪纹。每只的杖都不相同。若把杖弄丢，它们会花上几天寻找合适的替代品。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME uses petrified wood to fashion a staff out of, carving intricate wave-like lines onto the flat portion. No two staves are alike between individuals. If their staff is lost, they will spend days looking for the perfect replacement.

entry: POKENAME栖居温泉，靠天生灼热的身体维持水温。路过的登山客常在温泉歇脚，消除长途跋涉的疲劳。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME resides in hot springs where it keeps the water warm with its naturally hot body. Hikers who pass by often take respite in the hot springs to recover from long treks.

entry: 一旦从壳中喷出大量蒸汽，POKENAME便能以子弹列车般的速度掠过海面。爆发所需的沸水，采自海底热泉喷口。
author: soup1900
source: Once POKENAME starts spouting tremendous amounts of steam from its shell, it glides across ocean surfaces at the speed of a bullet train. It collects the boiling water used for this burst of energy from underwater thermal vents.

entry: POKENAME在沙滩下掘洞，沿途留下冰痕。冻结的纹路在晨光中美丽地闪烁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME tunnels beneath sandy beaches, leaving trails of ice in its wake. The frozen patterns shimmer beautifully in the early morning light.

entry: POKENAME经过训练，能同步游动，用身体拼出文字。因它们易于训练，广告商会付钱向水族馆租借一群POKENAME。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are trained to swim in sync with each other as they spell out words with their bodies. Advertisers pay aquariums to rent out a school of POKENAME, as they are easy to train.

entry: POKENAME对周遭浑然不觉，只顾着玩水。它的身体很容易抓住，因此无意间救了海滩上溺水的泳客。
author: quackquackattack
source: Oblivious to its surroundings, POKENAME is drawn to splashing in the water. It is easy to grab onto, so it inadvertently saves drowning swimmers at the beach.

entry: POKENAME热切地盼着有人跳上它的背。一有人坐上来，它就开始在水中高速游动。壳上的身影来历不明，似乎是宝可梦融合带来的奇特现象。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME eagerly awaits someone to hop on its back. Once someone does so, it begins swimming in the water at high speed. The figure on top of its shell is unknown and seems to be a quirk of Pokémon Fusion.

entry: POKENAME热切地盼着有人跳上它的背。一有人坐上来，它就开始在水中高速游动。凭借神奇力量，它能影响可能挡路者的思绪，提醒对方避让。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME eagerly awaits someone to hop on its back. Once someone does so, it begins swimming in the water at high speed. With its unusual powers, it can warn anyone who could get in its way by influencing their thoughts.

entry: POKENAME通常十分温顺，会在水洼里戏水，沿溪流游动。若发现宝可梦遇险，它们便冲上去保护对方，从嘴里喷出水柱。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are typically quite docile, splashing in puddles and swimming down streams. If they spot a Pokémon in danger, they rush to defend them, spraying jets of water from their mouths.

entry: POKENAME是忠诚的伙伴，即使地形再崎岖，也能载训练家穿行。它们喷出沸水，保护弱小宝可梦免遭危险。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are loyal companions, carrying their Trainers across even the roughest terrain. By spraying jets of boiling water, they defend weaker Pokémon from danger.

entry: 人们原以为POKENAME数量过多，直到最近的研究证明，它们频繁瞬间移动，才让数量显得如此庞大。它通常栖居冰寒环境，太暖就会从睡梦中醒来。
author: soup1900
