source: POKENAME was thought to be in overabundance until a recent study proved that their tendency to teleport had exaggerated their numbers. It will wake up from its sleep if it gets too warm, as it normally resides in icy environments.

entry: 凭借强壮的肌肉与充沛体力，POKENAME能不停游上数小时。猛烈风暴中，它会现身，以力量救助受困的人与宝可梦。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's powerful muscles and boundless stamina allow it to swim for hours without rest. It appears during intense storms, using its strength to rescue any people or Pokémon in trouble.

entry: 多长出的两条手臂，让POKENAME游得更快。双腿也结实，甚至能背着人，在陆地上赶路。
author: darkweavile428
source: The edition of two extra arms allow POKENAME to swim faster in the water. It can even ferry people across land thanks to its sturdy legs.

entry: 旅行社会雇用POKENAME，将训练家送往七之岛等大陆以外的地方。它们用四只手臂划动两支桨，渡海比快艇还快。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Travel agencies employ POKENAME to ferry Trainers to places off the mainland, such as the Sevii Islands. They use their four arms to use two oars, able to make the distance faster than a speedboat could.

entry: 它招呼孩子爬上壳，带他们欣赏海底景色。直到被拐走的孩子开始哭泣，POKENAME才会回岸。
author: quackquackattack
source: It beckons children onto its shell to show them the sights of the ocean below. POKENAME only returns to shore once the kidnapped children begin to cry.

entry: 在危险水域，POKENAME是备受看重的运输帮手，能用有毒触手保护乘客。它闪烁的红色珠体，甚至能为夜间航行提供帮助。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME is highly valued for transport in dangerous waters, because it can defend its passengers with venomous tentacles. POKENAME's flashing red orbs can even help with nighttime transportation.

entry: 它引诱一群群孩子潜入海中，参观海底。等孩子想回家，POKENAME就会把归途弄得颠簸不已，表达自己的不满。
author: quackquackattack
source: It lures groups of children down below the surface of the ocean to witness the sea floor. When the children want to go home, POKENAME expresses its displeasure with a bumpy ride back.

entry: 无论登山还是游遍大海，它都毫不费力。穿行各个地区，对POKENAME不算难事。
author: 0reomilka
source: It can climb mountains and swim through the whole ocean without any difficulty. Traveling through regions isn't a challenge for a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME住在珊瑚与沙子构成的巨石中。它们身上会脱落富含养分的沙子，因此环保人士会繁育它们，在自然灾害后帮助珊瑚重返海洋。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live in boulders made of coral and sand. Environmentalists breed them to reintroduce coral to the sea after a natural disaster, as they shed nutrient-rich sand from their bodies.

entry: POKENAME把小宝可梦背在背上，助它们安全往来于各片水域。水做的鬃毛散出清新雾气，让乘客一路舒畅。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME helps small Pokémon travel safely between bodies of water by carrying them on its back. Its watery mane creates a refreshing mist that soothes its passengers along the journey.

entry: POKENAME被视为最抢手的运输宝可梦之一，能在陆地和海上长途跋涉。纵观历史，游牧族群都格外珍视它，胜过其他宝可梦。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME is considered to be of the most coveted transport Pokémon, capable of traveling great distances over land and sea.  Nomadic cultures throughout history have valued this Pokémon above all others.

entry: POKENAME帮助海边的占卜师预测顾客的恋情。它能察觉负面念头的能量，因此会逃离彼此不爱的情侣。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME helps seaside fortune tellers divine the romantic lives of patrons. It flees from couples who do not love each other as it detects energy from negative thoughts.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的贝壳能察觉天气变化，并以心灵感应告知宿主。若旱季过于严重，POKENAME就会使出求雨。
author: cobalt0135
source: The shell on the tail of POKENAME can detect weather patterns and communicate telepathically to the host. If the dry season becomes severe, POKENAME will engage in Rain Dance.

entry: POKENAME由两种濒危宝可梦融合而成，要在野外充分研究其行为非常困难。它天性仁慈，不喜争斗；若训练家不够善良、娴熟，它可能干脆拒绝战斗。
author: bobosmith01
source: As a fusion of two endangered Pokémon, properly studying POKENAME's behavior in the wild is very difficult. It is compassionate by nature and dislikes fighting: without a kind and skilled Trainer, it may flat out refuse to battle.

entry: POKENAME的几个头和声无间，歌声连暴怒的肯泰罗都能安抚。它常把小宝可梦背在背上，载它们穿越平原。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's heads sing in perfect harmony, and its song calms even enraged Tauros. It often carries smaller Pokémon on its back across the plains.

entry: POKENAME在海中游动，救助落水的渔人。它们会跟在渔船后，吃落入水中的残羹碎屑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swim in the sea and save fishermen who fall into the water. They are known to follow fishing ships, eating scraps that fall into the water.

entry: POKENAME会用大壳拖着海上迷航的渔船，将其送回港口。它们被渔业奉为英雄，乐于救船，换些鱼吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME use their large shells to drag fishing ships lost at sea back to port. Regarded as heroes of the fishing industry, POKENAME enjoy saving ships in exchange for fish.

entry: 厚厚的隔热脂肪，让POKENAME能自在地游过冰冷海洋。在寒冷地区，它承担着重要职责，帮助人们在两岸之间运货。
author: ambrosia04
source: With a thick layer of insulating blubber, POKENAME can swim comfortably through the frigid ocean. It plays a vital role in cold regions, helping people transport goods from shore to shore.

entry: POKENAME会溜进泳池，吸收清洁池水的化学物质。池里什么它们都吃，若无人看管，连孩子也不例外。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME slip into swimming pools to absorb chemicals used to clean pools. They will eat anything in the pool, including children if left unattended.

entry: POKENAME十分友善，尤其爱向孩子爬去。它们喜欢捉迷藏，敏锐的感知让它们常常获胜。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are friendly creatures, scuttling towards children in particular. POKENAME love playing hide and seek, as their keen sense of perception helps them win many games of it.

entry: 它会把头缩入壳中，里面还容得下孩子一同躲藏。POKENAME壳上有个阀门，能释放浓雾，冻结附近的威胁。
author: quackquackattack
source: It hides its head inside its shell, which has space for children to hide alongside it. POKENAME has a valve on its shell that releases a foggy haze and freezes nearby threats.

entry: POKENAME栖居海边废弃的庄园，捉弄闯入者。它们会拖着对方穿过墙壁，让人毫发无损地穿墙而过。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME reside in abandoned beachside manors and cause mischief to intruders. POKENAME drag them through walls before they phase through harmlessly.

entry: POKENAME由有机物构成，比大岩蛇脆弱，却也浮得更稳，能载上几十名乘客。
author: vaporvenator
source: POKENAME is more fragile than Onix due to its organic composition. However, it's much more buoyant, allowing it to ferry dozens of passengers.

entry: POKENAME会在带甲的钳上养海藻，引诱猎物。饿的时候，这些海藻也能充作应急口粮。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are known to grow seaweed on their armored claws to lure in prey. This seaweed also doubles as an emergency food supply if they get hungry.

entry: POKENAME整天静止不动，混在与坚硬灰壳相似的岩石中。那只巨钳只用来自卫，对付领地里好斗的宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME stays still all day to blend in with rocks that resemble its tough grey shell. It uses its large claw solely to defend itself against aggressive Pokémon in its territory.

entry: POKENAME的甲壳由形状不定的物质构成，能模仿任何宝可梦，但仅限花纹。睡觉时会伪装成叶子。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's carapace is made of an amorphous substance that lets it mimic any Pokémon. However, they can only mimic things by pattern and camouflage as a leaf while sleeping.

entry: POKENAME体内流转的色彩，会随摄入的食物改变。这种鲜活变幻的色彩，使它成为引人入胜的研究对象。
author: .izik
source: The swirling colors within POKENAME's body change based on what it consumes. This vibrant effect makes it a fascinating creature to study.

entry: POKENAME吐出的黄色液体，一经接触就会使对方剧烈头痛。这种令人痛苦的分泌物，能让好奇的捕食者不敢打扰它。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits a yellow liquid that causes intense headaches upon touch. This painful secretion ensures it stays undisturbed by curious predators.

entry: POKENAME虽性情温顺，靠近它的底部仍须小心。上身滴落的浓稠黏液黏性极强，许多不知情的人与宝可梦都曾被黏住。
author: mepp.
source: Though POKENAME has a docile temperament, one should be careful staying near the base of it. The thick slime that drips from its upper body has strong adhesive properties, causing many unsuspecting people and Pokémon to become stuck.

entry: 只要骨头碰到某样东西，POKENAME就能模仿得一模一样。一旦开始哭泣，变身便立刻失效。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can perfectly mimic anything its bone touches. If it begins to cry, the transformation immediately fails.

entry: POKENAME把部分身体变成骨头，以惊人力量掷出。它还能操控飞行中的骨头，让每次投掷都精准致命。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME transforms part of its body into a bone, which it flings with incredible force. It controls the bone mid-flight, ensuring deadly precision with every throw.

entry: POKENAME的腿最长能伸展到飞腿郎的三倍。它们喜欢互相比试，不靠变身，看看谁的腿更强。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME has legs which can stretch up to three times as far as a Hitmonlee's. POKENAME likes to hold competitions amongst themselves to see whose leg is stronger without transforming it.

entry: POKENAME讨厌变身，认为这等于承认自身不够强大。即便如此，它们仍会变身，因为比起自尊与骄傲，它们总把获胜放在首位。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME hate transforming, as they see it as admitting they aren't powerful on their own. They do so despite this, as they always prioritize winning over their pride and ego.

entry: POKENAME把舌上的黏液甩向敌人，布下黏稠陷阱。这种黏液严重妨碍对方行动，让它占尽优势。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flings the ooze from its tongue at enemies, creating a sticky trap. This adhesive substance severely hinders movement, giving it an advantage.

entry: POKENAME软塌塌的身体在工厂周围飘浮，需靠稳定的气候保持柔软。不过，一点金属粉就能使身体硬化、噼啪作响，战斗中也就更能承受攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's blobby bodies float around factories, as their soft bodies require the stable climate to remain soft. However, a small bit of Metal Powder allows their bodies to harden and crackle, which enables them to take more hits in battle.

entry: POKENAME全身的孔洞喷出致突变污泥，能在分子层面使有机物失稳、改变。接触太久，对方便会开始变成眼前所见的东西。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The vents covering POKENAME spout a mutagenic sludge that can destabilise and alter organic matter on a molecular level. Prolonged exposure can cause those who have made contact to begin transforming into whatever they see.

entry: POKENAME的身体能挤过洞壁裂缝，在狭窄处也能轻松穿行。这种柔韧性有助于它躲避捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body can squeeze through cracks in cave walls, enabling it to navigate tight spaces with ease. This flexibility helps it evade predators.

entry: POKENAME变成了吉利蛋的样子。为了装得更真，还从另一只可怜的吉利蛋那里，偷来一颗蛋。
author: thisisnotaplaceholder
source: This POKENAME has taken the form of a Chansey. It has also stolen an egg from another poor Chansey to really sell the appearance.

entry: POKENAME会照料被遗弃的蛋，直到孵化。随后，它变成刚孵出的宝可梦的模样，尽其所能，让幼崽如同在同类之中长大。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME nurtures abandoned eggs until they hatch, whereupon it transforms into a copy of the Pokémon that hatched, in order to raise it among its own kind as closely as it can.

entry: POKENAME形似鞋子的附肢黏性极强，能轻松攀上树干。这种牢固的抓附力，帮助它探索茂密森林。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's shoe-like appendages are incredibly adhesive, allowing it to climb tree trunks with ease. This sticky grip helps it explore dense forests.

entry: POKENAME难以建立亲密关系，因此常有人看见它们在培育屋偷蛋。它们往往会让关系已有问题的人更加紧张，所以大家庭从不饲养POKENAME。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME struggle with intimacy, so they are often spotted at daycare centers stealing eggs. They tend to cause tension for those who have relationship issues, which is why POKENAME are never kept in large family homes.

entry: POKENAME能将四肢拉长到滑稽的程度，逗小孩子与小宝可梦开心。不过，想缩回来就很费劲。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME can stretch its limbs to comical degrees to humor small children and Pokémon. It has trouble retracting them, though.

entry: 它想逗孩子开心，便努力变出自己知道的各种鬼脸。可身体不稳定，变到最后，总是反而吓人。
author: skymaster426
source: It wishes to entertain children, so it attempts to craft the funniest faces it knows. However, due to its instability, it only ends up scaring.

entry: POKENAME常左右不对称，例如双腿长短不一，或两只手臂完全不同。近年，它成了悦纳身体的象征，鼓励大家接纳自己的“缺点”。
author: dodoowner_
source: A POKENAME is often asymmetrical, with imperfections such as legs of differing length or completely different arms. In recent years, this Pokémon has become a symbol of body positivity, encouraging individuals to embrace their 'flaws'.

entry: 这只宝可梦能变成任何东西，但多数时候会化成人类或近似人类的样子。解剖学教师常借它讲解人体，POKENAME随讲解变换身体，供学生直观观察。
author: _pixelar_
source: This Pokémon can transform its body to mimic anything, although most of the time it assumes a human or human-like form. Anatomy teachers often use it to explain the human body, with POKENAME transforming accordingly to provide visuals.

entry: POKENAME极其弱小，常见于受污染湖泊的底部附近。多亏软糖般的身体，遇险时它能轻松挤入狭窄裂隙。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is incredibly weak and is found near the bottom of polluted lakes. Thanks to its gummy-like body, it can squeeze into narrow crevices with ease when threatened.

entry: POKENAME自我融合后的形态，引起了人们对其真正起源的疑问，纷纷向红莲岛的宝可梦屋要求调查。目前调查仍在进行。
author: sk372
source: The form POKENAME takes after self-fusion has resulted in inquiries lobbied towards the Cinnabar Mansion about its true origins. The investigation is still currently ongoing.

entry: 它自身便是浑然一体的存在，能变换体内的每一个原子。只需给它看一张图像即可。
author: mephone56_93546
source: Being that it is one in itself, it can transform every single atom in its body. All it needs is to be given an image.

entry: 自我融合后，POKENAME曾变身过的各种宝可梦，其身体部件会出现在它身上。它散发的能量近似超级进化的宝可梦，原因仍在研究。
author: aberry8286
source: After the process of self-fusion, the parts of various Pokémon that POKENAME transformed into before appear on its own body. It gives off similar energy to Mega Evolved Pokémon, although the reason why is still being researched.

entry: 这种罕见的POKENAME比多数百变怪融合体更聪明，学东西快，也善于与其他宝可梦交朋友。建筑工人十分想得到它。
author: dyo_jonah
source: This rare species of POKENAME has above-average intelligence compared to most Ditto fusions, being quick learners and skilled at befriending other Pokémon. It is highly coveted by construction workers.

entry: POKENAME的DNA极不稳定。靠近某些进化石时，它会不时短暂变成自己的进化形态。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME's DNA is extremely unstable. When near certain evolution stones, it briefly and sporadically transforms into its evolutions.

entry: 它的细胞构造，使它能变得与栖息地的水毫无区别。泳客碰到POKENAME黏稠的身体，就会隐形，从肉眼下消失，但只能维持片刻。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its cellular structure allows it to transform and be indistinguishable from the water that makes up its habitat. Swimmers who touch POKENAME's sludgy body turn invisible and seem to disappear from the naked eye, but only for a few moments.

entry: POKENAME变成代码，穿行网络空间。有时它会出现在游戏或程序里，尽管其中从未编写过它。
author: aberry8286
source: POKENAME transforms into code to travel through cyberspace. It can sometimes be found in games and programs despite never being coded in.

entry: POKENAME常去供应披萨的餐厅，故意破坏能碰到的各种设备。它们似乎不喜欢孩子，原因至今不明。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME frequent restaurants that serve pizza, often deliberately sabotaging any device they can reach. For a currently unknown reason, they seem to dislike children.

entry: POKENAME能把部分身体变成树果，凭变身能力一直自给自足。它更爱天然树果，只是不想起身时，就会改吃自己的身体。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's transformative power allows it to sustain itself indefinitely by transforming parts of its body into berries. It prefers to eat natural berries, but if it doesn't feel like getting up it will do that instead.

entry: POKENAME在炎热或火山地带附近筑巢，热量让身体保持柔软可塑，以便变身。变身时，燃烧的火焰会包住它，直到变化完成。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME nests near hot or volcanic areas, the heat keeping its body soft and malleable so it can transform. During its transformation, a burning flame envelops it until the process is complete.

entry: POKENAME只需瞥一眼，就能变得与其他宝可梦一模一样。百变怪似乎很仰慕它，会成群来观摩，专心研究它的变身本领。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is able to transform and perfectly mimic other Pokémon after only a quick glance. Ditto seem to look up to it, and will flock to watch and intensely study its transformation abilities.

entry: POKENAME闻起来，宛如一大束鲜花。人们常采集它的黏液，制作香气浓郁的香水。
author: kitarchen
source: POKENAME tends to smell like a giant bouquet of flowers. The goo from it is often harvested and used in the creation of strong scented perfumes.

entry: POKENAME的大脑不在任何一个头里，而是安全地藏在两头相接的黏液堆中。攻击假头的东西，很快就会成为猎物。
author: dicedragon20
source: POKENAME's brain is not inside either head, but safely hidden in the mound of goo where they meet. Anything that attacks a false head quickly becomes prey.

entry: 进入战斗时，POKENAME平日胶质的尾巴会变硬。这种变化让它在近战中占得优势。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tail can harden from its normally gelatinous state when it enters battle. This transformation gives it an edge in close combat.

entry: POKENAME的叫声像是被闷住的咕噜声，听来不安，它却十分健康。这奇特的声音，常让遇见它的人摸不着头脑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's cries resemble stifled gurgling, though it remains perfectly healthy despite the unsettling sound. This strange vocalization often puzzles those who encounter it.

entry: POKENAME沐浴月光，使体表黏液再生。每晚的这番习惯，让身体保持湿润，随时准备战斗。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME regenerates its slimy coating by bathing in moonlight. This nightly ritual keeps its body moist and ready for combat.

entry: POKENAME模仿其他飞行属性宝可梦的幼崽，混入它们的巢。进去后，它便逐个捕食，出手前始终不露马脚。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME mimics the young of other Flying-Type Pokémon to infiltrate their nests. Once inside, it picks off its prey one by one, going undetected until it strikes.

entry: POKENAME黏稠的身体使飞行变得困难，却能以惊人的奔跑速度弥补。它留下的每个脚印，都带着黏液。
author: .izik
source: Due to POKENAME's sticky body, flying has become challenging, but it compensates by running at impressive speeds. Each footprint it leaves behind is marked with sticky goo.

entry: POKENAME常出现在其他宝可梦的巢里，包括袋兽和吉利蛋。它模仿得天衣无缝，让对方将它当作亲生幼崽照料。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME often finds itself in the nest of other Pokémon, including Kangaskhan and Chansey. Due to its impeccable mimicry skills, these Pokémon take care of it as their own.

entry: POKENAME常变成其他鸟类，在迁徙时混入鸟群。它们等某个成员掉队，便将其吃掉，取而代之。
author: cowanisbest
source: POKENAME often transform into other species of birds to infiltrate their flocks during migration. They wait until a member of the flock falls behind to consume it and take its place.

entry: 难过时，POKENAME会融成一大滩，摊在地上。唯一能让它开心的办法，是在黏稠的身体上放根沉重的原木，直到它恢复形状。
author: jaminmcready
source: When sad, POKENAME melts into a sprawling puddle on the ground. The only way to cheer it up is to place a heavy log on its gooey body until it reforms.

entry: POKENAME覆满黏液的尾尖黏性很强，能在闪避时迅速转向。这种敏捷身手，使它很难捕捉。
author: .izik
source: The tip of POKENAME's ooze-covered tail is sticky, allowing it to change trajectory quickly while dodging. This agility makes it difficult to capture.

entry: POKENAME视力不好，记性也差，因此变身前会先用尾巴触摸对象，更好地掌握形态细节。不过，它最后通常仍会变错某些部位。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has poor eyesight and poor memory, so it uses its tail to touch something before transforming, to better capture the details of the form it takes. It still usually winds up getting some features wrong, however.

entry: POKENAME的变身本领依赖阳光。若光合作用积攒的能量不够，它会卡在变化途中，最后筋疲力尽地变回原样。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's transformation ability is dependent on sunlight. If it hasn't photosynthesized enough energy, it will wind up stuck between transformations before reverting back to normal, exhausted.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛极善于捕捉目标的动作规律。这份敏锐感知，使它的模仿能达到惊人的精准程度。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's eyes are exceptionally adept at detecting movement patterns in targets. This keen perception allows it to perfect its mimicry with remarkable precision.

entry: POKENAME常在河岸玩水，搓泥球吃，也分给别人。战斗落于下风时，它能把泥球融入自身DNA，变成对手的黏液版本。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is found splashing about on riverbanks, making mudballs to consume and share with others. If they find themselves the underdog in a fight, they can incorporate the mudballs into their DNA and transform into a slimy version of their opponent.

entry: POKENAME走过会留下污泥，一碰就能引发强烈幻觉。许多宝可梦和人怕受影响，不敢跟在它身后。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME moves, it leaves behind a trail of sludge that induces powerful hallucinations upon contact. Many avoid following it for fear of the effects.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，身体的黄色部分会像灯泡般闪烁。有节奏的闪光，似乎是在向附近的同伴传递信号。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME sleeps, the yellow portions of its body flicker like lightbulbs. These rhythmic flashes seem to serve as a signal to nearby companions.

entry: POKENAME智慧渊博，却只有在未变成其他宝可梦时，才能保留这些知识。突然失忆令它们很不适应，因此人们设立了专门的庇护所，让它们保持自己喜欢的形态。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have vast wisdom but only retain this knowledge when they are not transformed as another Pokémon. This momentary amnesia is jarring for POKENAME, so special sanctuaries have formed to allow them to remain in whatever form they prefer.

entry: POKENAME背上的花黏得吓人，鸟宝可梦很难抓稳。这些黏液煮过后，能做成一种奇特的蛋奶甜品。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: The flower on POKENAME's back is hideously slimy, making it hard for bird Pokémon to get a grip on it. This slime, when boiled, makes an exotic custard.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴能伸长，以惊人的灵巧摆弄物品。它凭这份本领，在人多的地方悄悄行窃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tail can extend and manipulate objects with surprising dexterity. It uses this skill to stealthily steal from people in crowded areas.

entry: POKENAME钻入山体，吞食找到的铁。它看似危险，却没有表现出任何暴力倾向。
author: imagine1.
source: POKENAME burrows into mountains, feasting on any iron it finds. It seems dangerous, but it shows no signs of violence.

entry: POKENAME体内没有骨架，能做出多数宝可梦做不到的伸展与扭曲。这份柔韧性，让它在战斗中难以捉摸。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body lacks an internal skeleton, allowing it to stretch and contort in ways most Pokémon cannot. This flexibility makes it unpredictable in battle.

entry: POKENAME壳中涌出浓稠黏液，每逢变身就不断蠕动、变形。每次表现好，它都喜欢喝些自己产出的树果汁，奖励自己。
author: quackquackattack
source: Liquid ooze viscously erupts from POKENAME shells, that shifts and writhes whenever it transforms. It enjoys drinking Berry Juice it produces as a treat whenever it does a good job.

entry: POKENAME是出了名的贪吃鬼，会混入糖果店满足甜瘾。据一则故事，某位著名糖果师觉得它的举动很可爱，便由此做出了最初的“熊宝宝软糖”。
author: mepp.
source: A notorious glutton, POKENAME has been known to infiltrate candy shops to satisfy its sweet tooth. According to one story, a famous confectioner found this act endearing, and so went on to create the very first "Gummiursa".

entry: POKENAME伪装成深受孩子欢迎的袋装软糖。店铺夜间打烊后，它们就会现身，尽可能大吃糖果。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME camouflage as a bag of gummy candies popular among children. When stores close for the night, POKENAME emerge to eat as much candy as they can.

entry: POKENAME会变成其他宝可梦的幼崽，凭借假冒家人的母性本能获得保护。它们喜欢让人欣赏自己的模仿，常找人炫耀伪装。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME take the shape of other young Pokémon as a defence, relying on the maternal instincts of their assumed family for protection. They enjoy having their mimicry observed and have a habit of trying to find people to show off their disguise to.

entry: POKENAME会变成其他宝可梦的幼崽，凭借假冒家人的母性本能获得保护。它们喜欢让人欣赏自己的模仿，常找人炫耀伪装。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME take the shape of other young Pokémon as a defence, relying on the maternal instincts of their assumed family for protection. They enjoy having their mimicry observed and have a habit of trying to find people to show off their disguise to.

entry: 看到捕食者，POKENAME会重排壳上的石头，摆成大型岩石属性宝可梦的模样，将对方吓退。这伪装必须成功，否则只要被识破，脆弱的壳就会轻易遭到击破。
author: secondegg
source: When POKENAME sees a predator, it will rearrange the rocks on its shell into the shape of a large Rock-type Pokémon to scare it away. It is important that this disguise works, as any Pokémon that sees through it can easily break its fragile shell.

entry: 发型师发现，若让POKENAME在头顶睡一夜，醒来时头发就会洁净发亮。连头发很有可能变成新颜色，许多人也认为是个不错的附带效果。
author: ozydamians
source: Hairstylists discovered that if POKENAME sleeps atop your head overnight, you will awaken with sparkling clean hair. Many consider the not-insignificant chance that you might wake up with a new hair color to be a positive side effect.

entry: 腿边的胶质，让POKENAME跑跳时笨拙迟缓。它吐出的火焰，与身体一样泛着紫色。
author: fiordaliso
source: The jelly surrounding its legs makes POKENAME's movements clumsy and sluggish when it tries to run or jump. The flames it breathes share the same purplish hue as its body.

entry: POKENAME能从尾尖或颈部骷髅状物体放出火焰。为什么有两处喷火部位，原因仍不明。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases flames through either the tip of its tail or the skull-like object on its neck. The reason behind this dual flame output remains unknown.

entry: POKENAME快速摇动尾巴上的响环，警告其他宝可梦离开。它们是模仿高手，若响环不起作用，就会变成更有威慑力的宝可梦，吓退进犯者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME warn away other Pokémon by rapidly shaking the rattle on their tail. They are consummate mimics and, should their rattle fail, they will transform themselves into more threatening Pokémon to scare off aggressors.

entry: POKENAME生活在漆黑的水下洞穴，靠感知水中微弱的振动辨路。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives in pitch-black underwater caves. It navigates by sensing faint vibrations in the water.

entry: POKENAME喜欢保持多边兽Ⅱ的样子，但长时间维持很费力。撑得越久，外形就越不稳定，越像在融化。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME prefers to keep itself in the shape of Porygon2, but maintaining that form for long periods of time is strenuous. The longer it attempts to hold it, the more unstable and melted its appearance becomes.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME会从各种机器复制数据，回巢后与同类分享。不过，这个过程会损坏原始数据，使其无法使用。
author: npshi
source: At night, POKENAME copy data from various machines before returning to their nest to share with other POKENAME. This process is known to corrupt the source of the data, making it unusable.

entry: POKENAME爱与其他宝可梦战斗、切磋，却通常不守规矩，只有战局合自己心意才开心。可惜，进化前它无法真正变强，因此会拼命训练，直到能够进化。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME loves to fight and spar with other Pokémon, but it usually doesn't play fair and only enjoys fights if they go how it wants them to. Unfortunately, it can't actually become really strong until it evolves, so it fiercely trains until it can.

entry: 同类融合体设法避免变身，POKENAME却乐于接受。一来它其实无法用头旋转，非变不可；二来它也爱找出让自己越转越快的方法。
author: jangodiot
source: While its counterparts try to avoid transformation, POKENAME embraces it. Partly because it has to, as it can't actually spin on its head, but also because it likes to find ways to become faster and faster at spinning.

entry: POKENAME真正的脸长在颈部展开的皮膜上。这奇特构造使攻击者迷惑，帮助它占得上风。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's true face is located on its hood. This unusual anatomy confuses attackers and helps it gain the upper hand.

entry: 据说，POKENAME乳头流出的胶状物，营养十分丰富。可那副模样，实在让人不想尝试。
author: kitarchen
source: The goo that comes out of POKENAME's udders is said to be highly nutritious. However, the appearance of it makes people unwilling to try it.

entry: POKENAME的身体大多呈流体，盘起时，各圈身体便融在一起。遇险时，它们会摊平身体，让自己显得更大，吓退攻击者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a mostly fluid body, their coils melting into one another whenever they curl up. When threatened they flatten their body out, trying to appear bigger than they actually are to scare off attackers.

entry: POKENAME喜欢制作其他宝可梦的微缩模型，研究它们的动作与习性。每逢遇到新物种，它们都会进一步探查，争取尽快掌握新形态。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME enjoy creating miniature figures of other Pokémon to study how they move and behave. Whenever they meet a new species, they will try to investigate further to create a new form as soon as possible.

entry: POKENAME的头质地像橡胶，能借它弹跳着四处移动。这种移动方式，让它能轻松避开威胁。
author: .izik
source: The consistency of POKENAME's head resembles rubber, which it uses to bounce from one place to another. This mobility allows it to evade threats with ease.

entry: POKENAME会先用双尾拍打对方，再变成对方的模样。拍打其实有助于变身，因为身体接触能让它采样目标的DNA，变得更加准确。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME slaps others with its twin tails before it transforms and assumes their shape. The act actually aids in its transformation, as physical contact lets it sample the target's DNA and let it better achieve an accurate metamorphosis.

entry: 变成别的形体前，POKENAME会念出像咒语的奇怪词句。它极不稳定的细胞，仍是许多宝可梦生物学研究者的研究对象。
author: fiordaliso
source: Before transforming its body into another's, POKENAME chants strange verses that sound like a spell. Its highly unstable cells remain a subject of study for many Pokémon biology researchers.

entry: POKENAME模仿当红艺人，照搬节目。可惜，本领往往学不来，评论也因此很糟。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME mimics very popular performers to rip off their shows. Unfortunately, it typically fails to mimic their skills and gets low reviews.

entry: POKENAME的身体触感如布丁，内部中空，充满电力。这种构造使它能高效储存、释放电能。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body has the texture of pudding and is hollow inside, filled with electricity. This structure allows it to store and discharge electric energy efficiently.

entry: POKENAME几乎什么都能变，却总会保留那条独特的粗壮舌头。它常伪装成普通物品，用舌头偷走路人的食物。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME can transform into nearly anything, but it will always have its distinctively large, muscular tongue in its new form. It will often disguise itself as an ordinary object and steal food from passersby with its tongue.

entry: POKENAME锐利的眼睛不漏过任何细节，战斗时能迅速学会并模仿敌人的招式。它常振翅标记领地，将构成身体的玫瑰色胶质洒满四周。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's sharp eyes miss no detail, allowing it to quickly learn and mimic its foes' moves in battle. It often flutters its wings to mark its territory, staining the area with the rosy jelly its body is made of.

entry: 没有什么逃得过POKENAME敏锐的目光，它转眼便能模仿敌人的招式。为宣示领地，它振翅将粉红胶质泼在各处，如同留下警告印记。
author: fiordaliso
source: Nothing escapes POKENAME's keen vision, enabling it to replicate enemy techniques in moments. To claim territory, it beats its wings, splattering pink jelly across surfaces like a warning brand.

entry: POKENAME竭力保持熟悉的四足形态，可光合作用已开始将耳朵和尾巴染蓝。科学家尚不清楚原因。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME tries very hard to maintain a familiar quadrupedal form, but photosynthesis has begun turning its ears and tail a blue hue. Scientists are unsure why this occurs.

entry: POKENAME会与大学及图书馆合作，复制重要数据以便保存。不过，使用时须紧盯着它们，因为它们有时会复制指定范围以外的数据，导致信息失实。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME work with universities and libraries to copy important data to be stored. However, a watchful eye is needed when handling POKENAME, as they sometimes copy data outside of set parameters, leading to misinformation.

entry: 变身前，POKENAME会计算复杂的方程与公式，确保模仿完美。可它算术太差，错漏百出，变身也常常走样。
author: soup1900
source: Before transforming, POKENAME performs complex math equations and formulas to make sure its imitation is perfect. However, its math is very faulty and full of incorrect answers, so the transformations are often very inaccurate.

entry: 多亏身体异常黏稠，POKENAME能轻松爬上任何表面。它用尾巴战斗，也挥尾驱赶其他宝可梦。每次击打后，尾巴形状似乎都会稍稍改变。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can climb any surface with ease thanks to its strangely sticky body. It fights using its tail, which it also swings to keep other Pokémon away. The shape of its tail seems to shift slightly after every strike.

entry: POKENAME的身体黏得出奇，想去哪里都能爬到。它把尾巴当鞭子攻击，每次击中后，尾巴似乎都会扭曲，变出令人不安的形状。
author: fiordaliso
source: Thanks to its bizarrely tacky body, POKENAME can crawl anywhere it pleases. It attacks using its tail as a whip, and after every hit, its tail appears to warp, shifting form in unsettling ways.

entry: POKENAME的身体黏得出奇，想去哪里都能爬到。它把尾巴当鞭子攻击，每次击中后，尾巴似乎都会扭曲，变出令人不安的形状。
author: fiordaliso
source: Thanks to its bizarrely tacky body, POKENAME can crawl anywhere it pleases. It attacks using its tail as a whip, and after every hit, its tail appears to warp, shifting form in unsettling ways.

entry: POKENAME通过重组细胞结构变形，常变成自己喜欢栽种的花草与树木。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: A POKENAME will reorganise its cell structure to transform. It will often take the form of the flowers, plants, or trees that it enjoys growing.

entry: POKENAME挥动手臂，在巢边洒下粉红黏液，标记领地。留下的黏稠痕迹，也是给闯入者的警告。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swings its arms to scatter drops of pink slime around its den, marking its territory. The sticky residue serves as a warning to intruders.

entry: POKENAME几乎能完美模仿对手的战斗风格。因此，许多训练家都用它们当陪练，帮助自己的宝可梦训练。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are able to mimic the fighting styles of their opponents nearly perfectly. For this reason, many Trainers use these Pokémon as sparring partners to help train their Pokémon.

entry: 从前，外国使节会饲养POKENAME，协助外交。它感知情绪，以形态和表情加以映照，传递言语之外的意图，即使语言不通也能表达清楚。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: In the past, foreign ambassadors kept POKENAME for diplomacy. By sensing emotions and mirroring them with its form and expressions, it conveyed intent beyond words, ensuring meaning was clear even when languages could not align.

entry: 从前，外国使节会饲养POKENAME，协助外交。它感知情绪，以形态加以映照，传递言语之外的意图，即使语言不通也能表达清楚。年幼的POKENAME更擅长此道。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: In the past, foreign ambassadors kept POKENAME for diplomacy. By sensing emotions and mirroring them with its form, it conveyed intent beyond words, ensuring meaning was clear even when languages could not align. Young POKENAME were better at this.

entry: 每逢运用精神力量，POKENAME胶质的身体都会迅速颤动。情绪越强烈，颤动就越剧烈。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's gelatinous body jiggles rapidly whenever it channels its psychic power. The intensity of its vibrations increases the stronger its emotions become.

entry: 据说POKENAME变身本领极强，能完美模仿世上任何人。许多罪犯曾辩称，罪行是POKENAME冒充自己所为，却都未能得逞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's transformation skills are said to be so strong that it can perfectly mimic any human on the planet. Many criminals have tried unsuccessfully to claim their crimes were committed by a POKENAME in disguise.

entry: 与对手交锋前，POKENAME会先鞠躬致敬。它重组细胞构造，将手臂变成致命武器。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: POKENAME bows in a gesture of respect before engaging with its opponent. It rearranges its cellular structure to turn its arms into deadly weapons.

entry: 有些热门网络游戏让玩家扮演POKENAME，变成物品融入环境，躲避拿着精灵球四处搜寻的训练家。这正是模仿它在野外的行为。
author: banzai.exe
source: Some popular online games involve playing as a POKENAME to transform into objects and blend into the environment, hiding from roaming trainers with their Poké Balls, mimicking its behaviour in the wild.

entry: POKENAME在窝里睡觉时，会变成原木。即使捕食者闯进来，也很难找到它。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME transforms into a log while sleeping in its lodge. Should a predator find its way inside, it will have trouble locating POKENAME.

entry: 曾有人看见POKENAME堵塞狭窄的河流与小溪。沿水流追查，发现了拿它们做实验的非法实验室。它们仍住在当地，如今却享有生态保护。
author: ocxin
source: One time, POKENAME were seen clogging up narrow rivers and creeks. Following these streams led to the discovery of illegal laboratories using them for experiments. They still inhabit the same areas, but now enjoy ecological protections.

entry: 据说POKENAME要收集108种宝可梦的DNA，才能变身。被击败后，它会回到楔石中，恢复原形，沿途留下紫色黏液。
author: quackquackattack
source: It is said that POKENAME needs to collect the DNA of 108 Pokémon before it can transform. When defeated, POKENAME returns to its keystone, leaving behind purple goo as it returns to its true form.

entry: POKENAME运用波导时，会使覆在身上的黏液剧烈振动。这种共振有助于它更迅速、灵活地运转波导，战斗中也更加强大。
author: .izik
source: While channeling its aura, POKENAME vibrates the ooze covering its body intensely. The resonance helps it channel its aura faster and more flexibly, making it even more powerful in battle.

entry: POKENAME的花瓣每天都会变成另一种花的样子。偶然模仿出稀有乃至灭绝的植物时，植物学家都大惑不解。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Every day, POKENAME's petals morph into the shape of another variety of flower. Botanists are left baffled when it, by chance, mimics rare or extinct plants.

entry: POKENAME体表黏液酸性极强，碰到什么就腐蚀什么。这种天然防御，让人难以安全靠近。
author: .izik
source: The slime covering POKENAME's body is extremely acidic, corroding anything it touches. This natural defense makes it dangerous to approach.

entry: POKENAME努力变得可爱漂亮，讨训练家喜欢。但嘴仍保持原样，只好竭力掩饰真面目。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME tries to appear cute or beautiful to gain Trainers' affection. However, its mouth remains, so it does its best to hide its true face.

entry: POKENAME凭胶质身体，将头部拉展开，组成高大坚固的墙来保护领地。身体虽软，却极有韧性，能弹开大多数攻击。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's gelatinous body allows them to stretch their heads, forming a large, sturdy wall to protect their territories. Despite how soft their bodies are, they are incredibly resilient, able to bounce most attacks off them.

entry: 关于POKENAME的来历，有个常被半开玩笑提起的说法：一只百变怪把请假王模仿得太像，结果懒得再变回去。
author: sk372
source: A common, somewhat joking theory about POKENAME's existence is that it's the result of a Ditto copying Slaking so perfectly, it became too lazy to change back to normal.

entry: 许多水手报告，曾听见像男高音咏叹调般高亢的歌声。人们认为，那是POKENAME试着模仿吼鲸王的叫声。
author: bigoljax
source: Many reports have been made about sailors hearing a voice singing in a high tone, similar to tenor aria. It is thought to be POKENAME trying to mimic a Wailords call.

entry: 寻找强大宝可梦的训练家，常会被POKENAME引走。它在训练家脑中说话，迎合他们的虚荣心，将他们一步步引向末路。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Trainers seeking powerful Pokémon are often lured away by POKENAME. By speaking in their minds, POKENAME feeds into the Trainers' egos, allowing it to lead them to their doom.

entry: POKENAME虽能随意变身，却喜欢先以原形开战，试探对手实力。可塑的身体让它能灵巧闪避，再以能伸展的胶质四肢还击。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME can freely transform, it prefers to start fights in its normal form to gauge an opponent's strength. Its malleable body allows it to nimbly dodge strikes and hit back with stretchy, gelatinous limbs.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛会逐渐脱落，看起来如同在滴落。掉得越多，它就越难御寒，只好离开极地，迁往温暖地区。进化时，它不知为何又会长回羽毛。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The feathers on POKENAME slowly fall off, making it look like it is dripping. As more feathers come off it struggles to deal with the cold and so migrates away from the poles to warmer temperatures. During evolution, it somehow regains its feathers.

entry: 将要击中之前，POKENAME总爱忽然变换刀刃，随机换种材质，或变成某种勉强像武器的东西。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Right before landing a hit, POKENAME likes to change its blade's composition into that of a random material or any object vaguely resembling a weapon.

entry: POKENAME的角滴着冒泡的黏液，吞下就会剧烈中毒。这使它本已强悍的攻击更加致命。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's horns drip with bubbling slime that is highly toxic if ingested. This trait adds a lethal edge to its already-formidable attacks.

entry: 变成其他宝可梦时，它尾巴上的星星会时断时续地闪光。POKENAME吼声很弱，若不先证明真正的力量，就很难吓住对方。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it takes on the appearance of another Pokémon, the star on its tail flashes intermittently. The roars produced by POKENAME are very weak, making it difficult for it to intimidate others without first proving its true power.

entry: POKENAME身上滴落的黏液，带着桃桃果的甜香。气味吸引好奇的宝可梦，它们往往误以为这是食物。
author: .izik
source: The goo that drips from POKENAME's body carries the sweet scent of Pecha Berries. This scent attracts curious Pokémon, which often mistake it for food.

entry: 刚被发现时，科学家以为它是一只正在变成仙子伊布的百变怪。它的遗传物质极不稳定。
author: melodydelune
source: When first discovered, scientists believed this Pokémon was a Ditto mid-transformation into a Sylveon. Its DNA is extremely unstable.

entry: POKENAME在湖畔河边跺脚行走，标记领地。它的毒会使中毒者的汗液变黏，但最终并无危害。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME stomps about to mark its territory near lakes and rivers. Its poison turns ones sweat slimy, but is ultimately harmless.

entry: POKENAME力量强大，能重塑周边地貌，但只有原形才能施展。一旦变身，先前改变的地形就会融回原状。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can reshape the land around it with its great power, though this ability is only possible in its base form. Should it transform itself, any alterations it has made melt back to their previous state.

entry: POKENAME伴着黑暗，在噩梦将尽时出现。可它呆头呆脑的滑稽模样，却让人笑着醒来。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME appears near the end of nightmares, accompanied by darkness. Its clueless and silly demeanor, however, makes people wake up laughing.

entry: POKENAME的炮发射糖浆般的黏液，将目标完全裹住。它能分析黏液碰到的任何东西，从而变身，模仿得分毫不差。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cannon fires a syrupy goop that coats its targets completely. POKENAME analyzes anything touched by the goop, allowing it to transform and perfectly mimic them.

entry: POKENAME飞过天空，尾巴如黑暗中的灯标熊熊燃烧。火焰看似不凡，其实只是细胞结构不断变化时，化学反应产生的副产物。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: As it flies through the sky, POKENAME's tail blazes like a beacon in the darkness. Despite its impressive nature, the flame is just a byproduct of the chemical reactions that result from POKENAME's actively changing cellular structure.

entry: POKENAME深谙表演之道，将多余黏液变出各种形状，吸引观众。谢幕时，它们把黏液抛上空中，再全部接住，身体变大后鞠躬致意。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Masters of showmanship, POKENAME morph their excess ooze into a variety of shapes to lure in an audience. As the final act in the performance, POKENAME fling the ooze into the air and catch it all as it rains down, growing larger and taking a bow.

entry: 百变怪善变的特性，也延续到了POKENAME释放的孢子中。它的栖居地已发现多种前所未见的蘑菇。
author: hophoppip
source: Ditto's changeable nature extends to the spores POKENAME gives off. In places where POKENAME dwells, a variety of never-before-seen mushroom species have been discovered.

entry: POKENAME会变成对方熟识的宝可梦，骗取礼物和食物。该变成谁，则靠读取目标的心思决定。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME beguile other Pokémon into giving them gifts and food by transforming into a Pokémon that they are friendly with. They determine what Pokémon to transform into by reading the mind of their target.

entry: POKENAME沐浴月光时，身体会开始轻轻振动。这细微动作，似乎随月相而变化。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body begins to vibrate when bathed in the light of the moon. This subtle movement seems to change with each phase of the lunar cycle.

entry: POKENAME将身体塑成强有力的颚与尾巴，伏击猎物，被逼入绝境时又能靠黏稠身体溜走。它模仿附近宝可梦的模样，将好奇的敌人诱至攻击范围内。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME reshapes its body into powerful jaws and a tail to ambush prey, but its gooey form lets it slip away when cornered. It copies the appearance of nearby Pokémon to lure curious foes within striking distance.

entry: POKENAME的网由粗而黏的粉红丝线织成，碰到什么都会牢牢黏住。这种奇特丝线，让它成为捕猎高手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's webs are made of thick, sticky pink strings that cling tightly to anything they touch. These unusual threads make it an expert trapper of prey.

entry: POKENAME依附洞顶，完美模仿钟乳石。探险者从下方经过时，它便落下，扑得对方措手不及。
author: .izik
source: Clinging to cave ceilings, POKENAME imitates stalactites perfectly. When explorers pass beneath, it drops onto them, catching them completely off guard.

entry: POKENAME滴落的黏液像火苗般闪动，在黑暗中发出柔光。这诡异景象，让它仿佛无热而燃。
author: .izik
source: The slime that drips from POKENAME's body flickers like flames, glowing softly in the dark. This eerie effect makes it appear as if it's burning without heat.

entry: POKENAME的刃看起来如刀般锋利，吓得对手屈服。可惜这只是幻象，实际上毫无危险。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's blades appear as sharp as knives, intimidating opponents into submission. Unfortunately, this is only an illusion, posing no real danger.

entry: POKENAME变成古老雕像，守卫被遗忘的遗迹。它模仿雕像的威严，阻止闯入者发掘其中的宝藏。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME transforms into ancient statues to guard forgotten ruins. It mimics their imposing presence to deter intruders from uncovering the treasures within.

entry: POKENAME成长时，尾巴会不断分叉，进化前不知会分出多少条。准备好进化时，所有尾巴又会合为一条。
author: santon5512
source: As POKENAME grow, their tails split, continuing to do so an indefinite number of times until they evolve. Once ready to evolve, all of their tails will merge back together.

entry: POKENAME的内脏可塑性极强，能变成任何形状。它既用其防御，也用来伪装。夜晚休息时，POKENAME会把自己裹在内脏里，再使出变身，化作岩石。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME has innards that are highly malleable and can transform into any shape. It uses these both to defend and to disguise itself. When it rests at night, POKENAME wraps itself in its own innards and uses Transform to look like a rock.

entry: 许多人认为，这只宝可梦就是自我认同危机的化身。据报道，不少人曾前往POKENAME栖居地，回来时，身心却都已变了样。
author: chaos_emblemx
source: Many regard this Pokémon as the definition of an identity crisis. Many have been reported to have ventured to where POKENAME live, but they all return changed, both physically and mentally.

entry: POKENAME的身体沸腾着，不断迸出滚烫黏液，接触它十分危险。这份酷热既用于防御，也警告捕食者不要靠近。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body boils and bursts with hot slime, making it volatile to handle. This intense heat serves as both a defense mechanism and a warning to predators.

entry: POKENAME的三个头通常同步行动，却又各有一些自主意识。有时，一个头想变成与其他头不同的模样，就会让变身混入另一种宝可梦的特征。
author: sk372
source: Although usually in sync, POKENAME's three heads possess some autonomy from each other. This results in transformations occasionally having traits of another Pokémon involved as one head tried shifting into a different form than the others.

entry: POKENAME通常将三个头各变成不同的龙属性宝可梦，借用它们的能力与威慑力。不过，某个头忘了彻底变完，也不算少见。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME usually keeps its three heads shifted into different Dragon-type Pokémon, borrowing their abilities and intimidating appearance. It's not uncommon for one head to forget to transform completely, though.

entry: 从前，人们将POKENAME视为美味佳肴，如今却有许多人反对食用它。
author: clownatosis
source: People once ate POKENAME as a delicacy, but in the modern era, many have pushed back against its consumption.

entry: 代欧奇希斯与百变怪结合，诞生了POKENAME，使它能更轻松地变身，模仿其他宝可梦。它甚至展现过用手臂同时模仿多种宝可梦的能力，尽管只能短暂维持。
author: infinex21
source: The combination of Deoxys and Ditto has resulted in POKENAME, which is capable of transforming itself to replicate other Pokémon with greater ease. It has displayed the capacity to replicate multiple Pokémon at once using its arms, if only briefly.

entry: 科学家尝试测定来自其他世界的宝可梦的基因结构，但每一次尝试最终都产生了POKENAME。
author: tokenoracle
source: Scientists attempted to sequence the DNA structure of Pokémon from other worlds. All attempts resulted in POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的身体可塑性强，能随心改变形状。它们试着靠变形实现他人的心愿，却不怎么成功。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME can use their malleable bodies to change shape at will. They change their shape to try to fulfill the wishes of others, though they aren't very successful.

entry: 无忧无虑的性格与丰富肢体动作，让它在网上大受欢迎。许多聊天室都有它举爪问候的表情图，就像它遇见训练家时常做的那样。
author: ocxin
source: Its carefree attitude and expressive gestures have led it to become popular on the internet. Many chatrooms contain an emote of it raising a paw in greeting, like the ones that can often be seen when meeting Trainers.

entry: POKENAME身上滴落的液体，含有冲洗胶片所需的化学物质。许多摄影师会养上几只，节省冲洗成本。
author: .izik
source: The fluid dripping from POKENAME's body contains a chemical used in film development. Many photographers keep several of these Pokémon to save on processing costs.

entry: 进入战斗时，POKENAME尾尖亮起电光。发光的尾巴既是警告，也是武器。
author: .izik
source: The tip of POKENAME's tail glows with electrical energy when it enters a fight. This glowing tail serves as both a warning and a weapon.

entry: POKENAME试着改变声带，模仿听过的不同音乐风格。可惜，晃荡的身体使歌声更像含混不清的录音。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME attempt to replicate different styles of music that they have heard by transforming their vocal cords. Unfortunately, their wobbly bodies cause them to sound more like muffled recordings.

entry: POKENAME为结交朋友，会变成其他宝可梦。它的原形很少有人见过，就连它自己也不常见。
author: tarastargaze
source: POKENAME transforms into other Pokémon in order to form friendships. Its true form is rarely seen, even by itself.

entry: 有人说，POKENAME模仿其他宝可梦能力的本领，甚至胜过纯粹的百变怪。可论歌声，它却比胖丁差得多。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME's ability to copy other Pokémon's powers is said by some to be even better than a pure Ditto's. On the other hand, its singing is much worse than Jigglypuff's.

entry: POKENAME会模仿沿途各种丛林植物，连气味都一并模仿，为的是捕猎。想吃它的宝可梦会黏在胶质表面，渐渐被吸收。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME transform their bodies to mimic various jungle plants that they pass, down to the odour those plants produce. They do this to hunt food. Any Pokémon seeking to feed on them gets stuck to their gooey surface and gradually absorbed.

entry: POKENAME会模仿沿途各种丛林植物，连气味都一并模仿，为的是捕猎。想吃它的宝可梦会黏在胶质表面，渐渐被吸收。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME transform their bodies to mimic various jungle plants that they pass, down to the odour those plants produce. They do this to hunt food. Any Pokémon seeking to feed on them gets stuck to their gooey surface and gradually absorbed.

entry: POKENAME尾尖发光，带着奇特的暖意。人们认为，它用这道光引诱猎物，也与同类交流。
author: mepp.
source: The tip of POKENAME's tail glows with a strange warmth. It is thought that POKENAME uses this light to lure prey and communicate with others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME耳尖散发甜奶油般的香味，烘焙师将其视作珍贵的稀有原料。这份香气，为精巧糕点添上独特风味。
author: .izik
source: The tips of POKENAME's ears exude a scent reminiscent of sweet cream, which bakers prize as a rare ingredient. This aroma adds a unique touch to delicate pastries.

entry: 这副小身体需要光合作用提供能量，才能变身，因此POKENAME只有在阳光直射下才能变化。一失去光照，它就立刻恢复原形。
author: sk372
source: Its small body requires energy from photosynthesis in order to transform, so POKENAME can only morph while in direct sunlight. When the light is gone, it immediately returns to its normal shape.

entry: POKENAME的身体没有固定形状，变成其他宝可梦时才会凝实。未变身时，它们又慢又软，最容易受伤。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have an amorphous body that solidifies whenever they transform into another Pokémon. They are most vulnerable while not transformed because they are slow and soft.

entry: POKENAME会读取其他宝可梦的心思，找出它们想追逐的猎物，再变成那副模样，将它们引离自己的巢。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lures other Pokémon away from its nest by transforming into prey they desire to chase. It discovers their preferences by reading their minds.

entry: 它很难自行发电，只好从别处吸收。若见到插在插座上、却没连着电线的插头，那可能就是变身后的POKENAME。
author: hophoppip
source: It struggles to generate electricity, so it absorbs it from other sources. If you find a plug connected to an outlet with no attached cord, it may be a transformed POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME十分自豪于獠牙的形状与大小，变身时也常将其保留。无论长在新形态的嘴里、拿在手中，还是变成某种饰物，獠牙总不会缺席。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite proud of the shape and size of its tusks, and tends to incorporate the tusks in its transformations. Whether in the new form's mouth or hands or as some type of accessory, the tusks will always be present in its changed state.

entry: POKENAME吐出火星，烧去林地上的杂物，为新生植物腾出空间。这份习惯，让环境保持健康繁茂。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits embers to burn away debris on the forest floor, clearing the way for new growth. This habit ensures the environment remains healthy and flourishing.

entry: POKENAME体表黏液远比看起来烫，碰到什么就会灼烧什么。这出人意料的高温，让它成为战斗中的危险对手。
author: .izik
source: The ooze on POKENAME's body is deceptively hot, scorching anything it touches. This unexpected heat makes it a dangerous foe in battle.

entry: POKENAME身周形似触角的构造，会随呼吸伸缩，仿佛肺部的动作。这种奇特特征，使它时刻都在动。
author: .izik
source: The antennae-like structures around POKENAME's body expand and contract as it breathes, mimicking the action of lungs. This strange trait keeps it constantly in motion.

entry: POKENAME扇动翅膀时，会将浓稠黏液洒满四周。沿途被黏住的东西，行动都会受阻。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME flaps its wings, it spreads a viscous slime that coats the surrounding area. This slime hinders the movement of anything caught in its path.

entry: POKENAME像轮胎般弹跳着穿行，每次落地都留下黏稠痕迹。这条黏液踪迹很好追，却也弄得四处脏兮兮。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME bounces like a tire across the landscape, leaving sticky residue wherever it lands. This gooey trail makes tracking it both easy and messy.

entry: 研究者发现了这种宝可梦更早存在的迹象。最新报告指出，其化学特征可追溯到一颗1000多万年前落地的陨石。
author: .izik
source: Researchers have uncovered earlier signs of this Pokémon's existence. The latest report dated its chemical signature to a meteor that landed over 10 million years ago.

entry: POKENAME体形虽吓人，却没什么攻击欲望。它反倒常陪着大型凶猛宝可梦，总缠着对方玩，无意中抑制了它们的暴力倾向。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME may seem intimidating with its size, but has no real inclination towards aggression. In fact, it often accompanies large aggressive Pokémon, inadvertently curbing their violent tendencies with its incessant want to play with them.

entry: POKENAME重组细胞，变出可怕模样吓退捕食者。不过，它的脸没变对。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME rearrange its cell structure to create a terrifying form to scare off predators. However, it didn't quite get the face right.

entry: POKENAME被装在一个塑料袋里。通常它的身体只有轻微毒性，但不稳定的基因能重组身体，使它产生麻痹毒素。
author: bobosmith01
source: A plastic bag contains POKENAME. Its body, by default, is only mildly poisonous. POKENAME's unstable DNA can rearrange its body to become paralytic.

entry: 满月之下，POKENAME能变成任何想变的作物。可手臂仍呈胶质，使变身不太像样，因此常见它闷闷不乐。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: When under a full moon, POKENAME can transform into whatever crop it desires. However, it is often seen sulking, as its transformations aren't very convincing due to its arms remaining gelatinous.

entry: POKENAME放出的花粉碰什么都黏，很难去掉。这种黏性花粉既能防御，也能标记领地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases pollen that sticks to anything, making it difficult to remove. This sticky pollen serves both as a defense mechanism and a way to mark territory.

entry: POKENAME飘过天空，会滴下奇怪的粉红液体，模仿附近的物质。这种奇特分泌物，让研究它行为的学者困惑不已。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME floats through the sky, it drips a strange pink liquid that mimics nearby materials. This bizarre secretion puzzles researchers studying its behavior.

entry: POKENAME只在寒冷地带施展变身能力。温度较高会扰乱细胞结构，使它难以维持变身形态。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will only exercise its transformative abilities in colder areas. Warmer temperatures mess with its cellular structure, making it difficult for it to maintain its transformed states.

entry: POKENAME能操控胶质身体，挤过窄至3英寸的缝隙。这份本领，使它格外难捕捉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can manipulate its gelatinous body to squeeze through spaces as narrow as three inches. This ability makes it exceptionally hard to capture.

entry: POKENAME浮力奇强，漂在海面，任波浪把自己带向远方。这般随波逐流，让它来到许多奇异偏远的地方。
author: .izik
source: Oddly buoyant, POKENAME floats on the ocean's surface, allowing the waves to carry it vast distances. This passive drifting leads it to many strange and remote places.

entry: POKENAME黏稠而不断变形的身体，含有极强毒素。哪怕轻轻一碰，也能让对手麻木数小时。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's slimy, ever-shifting body is laced with an extremely potent toxin. Even the slightest touch can leave an opponent feeling numb for hours.

entry: POKENAME凭无定形的身体施展复杂摔跤招式，缠斗间扭出意想不到的形状。这种柔韧性，让它以难以预料的招数压制对手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its amorphous body to execute complex wrestling moves, contorting into surprising forms mid-grapple. This flexibility allows it to overwhelm opponents with unpredictable maneuvers.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇可随意采摘，几秒内就能长回。它们被当作新奇零食，因为每朵摘下的蘑菇，味道都随机不同。
author: sk372
source: The mushrooms growing on POKENAME's back can be freely plucked, growing back within seconds. They are considered a novelty snack item, as each individual mushroom picked has a different, randomized flavor to it.

entry: POKENAME抖动身体，将冰冷黏液洒在地上。寒霜般的黏液碰到什么就冻住什么，沿途留下滑溜溜的痕迹。
author: .izik
source: By shaking its body, POKENAME spreads ice-cold ooze across the ground. This frosty slime freezes anything it touches, leaving a slick trail behind.

entry: POKENAME看到月亮就会过分兴奋，使变身稍稍失准。这份兴奋，会带来细微却看得出的瑕疵。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME looks at the moon, it becomes overly excited, causing its transformation to falter slightly. This excitement leads to subtle but noticeable imperfections.

entry: POKENAME看似有翅膀，胶质身体却太重，无法离地。它一生都致力于跨越次元，保护百变怪，身边几乎总有至少一只百变怪相伴。
author: the_smirker
source: Although it appears to have wings, POKENAME remains grounded due to the jelly-like body weighing it down. It dedicates its entire life to protecting Ditto across dimensions. POKENAME is rarely seen without at least one Ditto by its side.

entry: POKENAME悠然自得地慢慢行走。它难得心烦时，就会接连胡乱变身，表达纷乱的心情。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME plods about with a carefree demeanor. On the rare occasion it becomes upset, it expresses its feelings with random, tumultuous transformations.

entry: POKENAME是欺瞒高手，能变换身体，完美融入任何环境。测试中，即使用上世界最严密的安保系统，也从未发现或抓住它们。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are known to be masters of deception, being able to perfectly blend with any environment by transforming their bodies. In tests where they were put up against the tightest security systems in the world, they were never spotted or caught.

entry: POKENAME由不断变形的胶状液体构成，只有在壳内才能稳定。液体溢出壳外，不断试着伸展、移动，最后又聚回主体。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are made of a gelatinous, ever-shifting liquid that's only stabilized within their shells. The liquid spills from the shell, constantly looking to expand or move, only to form back into the main body.

entry: 水脉市用POKENAME翅膀滴落的液体，制作一种昂贵唇彩，以明亮光泽闻名。这款美容品，在各个地区都大受追捧。
author: .izik
source: The drippings from POKENAME's wings are used to create an expensive type of lip gloss in Canalave City, renowned for its brilliant sheen. This beauty product is highly coveted across regions.

entry: POKENAME布丁般的身体散出甜香，像刚出炉的榴石果挞。有些宝可梦误当成食物，见它扭动着逃走，不禁吃惊。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's pudding-like body emits a sweet aroma reminiscent of a freshly baked Pomeg Berry tart. Some Pokémon mistake it for food, only to be surprised when it wiggles away.

entry: POKENAME软塌塌的身体常在废物处理设施周边活动，沾满污垢与垃圾。接触少许速度粉后，它们会变得更加黏稠，形体更呈流线型，从而跑得更快。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's blobby bodies reside around waste facilities, which causes grime and trash to stick to their bodies. When introduced to a bit of Quick Powder, they become more viscous and aerodynamic, making them faster when running.

entry: 它黏滑的皮肤即使蜕下，仍能改变结构。POKENAME把一大片蜕皮套在腿上，帮助自己变成更大的形态。
author: hophoppip
source: Its slimy skin is able to change its own structure, even after it's shed. To assist in taking on larger forms, POKENAME wears a large piece of shed skin on its legs.

entry: POKENAME披在颈部与腿上的蜕皮，能随身体一起变形。科学家已成功用它的皮，制成可变形的手套。
author: hophoppip
source: The shed skin POKENAME wears around its neck and legs can transform with the rest of its body. Scientists have succeeded in making a shape-changing glove out of POKENAME skin.

entry: POKENAME在直播界越来越受欢迎。训练家让它陪着观看，它便以夸张的情绪和舞蹈作出反应。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME have seen a rise in popularity in the world of streaming. Trainers have their POKENAME watch along, who react with exaggerated emotions and dances.

entry: POKENAME喜欢参加社区志愿工作，把手臂变得肌肉粗壮，帮助搬重物。有时它们太过投入，常酿成不幸的事故，让自己有些丢脸。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME enjoy helping communities with volunteer working, transforming their arms into bulky muscles to help with lifting. They sometimes get lost in the moment, often leading to unfortunate accidents and minor humiliation for POKENAME.

entry: 穿过大气层坠落时，酷热使POKENAME胶质的身体部分融化。落地后，它依附在阴暗洞穴的凉爽表面，避开温暖地带，慢慢恢复形状。
author: eiskitsune
source: As it falls through the atmosphere, POKENAME's gelatinous body partially melts from the intense heat. Upon landing, it clings to cool surfaces in dark caves, avoiding warm areas as it slowly reforms over time.

entry: POKENAME放出毒孢子云，在变成其他宝可梦时保护自己。变身后若有东西碰到身体，微小鳞片便会竖起，在接触处注入毒液。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a cloud of toxic spores that protect them while they transform into another Pokémon. If anything makes contact with their body while they are transformed, tiny scales stand on edge and inject venom at the point of contact.

entry: 大雨中，尾焰变弱时，POKENAME很难让胶质身体维持完整。它喜欢模仿遇到的宝可梦，却常忘记一些细节。
author: fiordaliso
source: During heavy rain, when the flame on its tail weakens, POKENAME struggles to keep its gelatinous body together. It enjoys mimicking the Pokémon it encounters, though it often forgets some of their details.

entry: 钻地时，POKENAME会模仿附近的大石头，躲避捕食者。它如何选择模仿哪块石头，至今仍不明。
author: .izik
source: While burrowing, POKENAME imitates nearby large stones to avoid predators. How it selects which stone to mimic remains unknown.

entry: 有人说，只要盯着POKENAME看得够久，它就会变成你真爱的脸，但很少有人成功。
author: hophoppip
source: Some say that a POKENAME will take the shape of your true love's face if you stare at it for long enough, though few have gotten results from doing so.

entry: POKENAME经常轮换，让脸出现在三个“头”中的不同位置。它爱黏在地鼠与三地鼠挖出的隧道侧壁，突然跳出，吓它们一跳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME regular switches which of its three “heads” actually holds its face. It enjoys clinging to the sides of tunnels dug by Diglett and Dugtrio so it can jump up and surprise them.

entry: POKENAME凭黏滑身体挤进保险箱与金库，躺在钱堆中休息。这种行为，让它在窃贼中声名狼藉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its slimy form to squeeze into safes and vaults, lounging among the money. This behavior makes it a notorious figure among thieves.

entry: POKENAME经常偏头痛，发作时无法控制身体的完整形态。康复后重新成形，样子总会有些不同。变化日积月累，可能使它们完全变了模样。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME experience regular migraines that cause them to lose control of the integrity of their bodies. Whenever they reform after recovering they never quite look the same. These changes can add up over time, leaving them looking totally different.

entry: POKENAME经常偏头痛，发作时无法控制身体的完整形态。康复后重新成形，样子总会有些不同。变化日积月累，可能使它们完全变了模样。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME experience regular migraines that cause them to lose control of the integrity of their bodies. Whenever they reform after recovering they never quite look the same. These changes can add up over time, leaving them looking totally different.

entry: 宝可梦史学家推测，河童传说源自POKENAME，因为变身能力让它能随意变出可怕模样。尽管外表如此，它们其实相当友善。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Pokémon historians theorise that POKENAME is responsible for the origin of legends surrounding the Kappa, the transformative properties of the Pokémon letting it appear monstrous at will. Despite their appearance, they are quite amiable.

entry: POKENAME虽模仿了猴怪的外形，却学不来暴躁脾气。它试着板起怒脸，可没多久，脸上又会浮现欢快笑容。
author: sk372
source: Though it's mimicked a Mankey's form, POKENAME cannot truly mimic its violent temperament. It tries to keep an angry expression, but cannot hold it long before a jovial smile returns to its face.

entry: POKENAME很听话，一心只想让训练家开心。与训练家的羁绊越深，它模仿其他宝可梦的本领就越好。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are obedient creatures that want nothing more than to please their Trainer. Their ability to transform into other Pokémon gets better as the bond with their Trainer grows stronger.

entry: 胶质身体一旦沾湿，它就很难维持翅膀的形状。面对强敌，POKENAME会模仿对方外表，以求势均力敌。
author: fiordaliso
source: If its gelatinous body becomes wet, it struggles to hold its wings together. When facing a powerful opponent, POKENAME mimics their appearance to fight on equal terms.

entry: POKENAME从腹部螺纹大量分泌黏液，覆在身上，构成用来活动的身体。黏液可塑性极强，让它们能轻易变身，模仿其他宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME secrete vast quantities of slime from the spiral on their stomach, coating themselves in the mucus to create a body to move with. Their slime is highly malleable, allowing them to transform themselves to copy other Pokémon effortlessly.

entry: 没能完美变身后，POKENAME会沮丧地冥想数小时。这习惯有助于它重整专注力，准备下次尝试。
author: .izik
source: After failing to transform perfectly, POKENAME meditates for hours in frustration. This habit helps it regain focus for future attempts.

entry: POKENAME变成腕力，外形几乎分毫不差。可力量较弱，又不会武术，往往使它露馅。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME transforms into the appearance of a Machop, copying it with almost perfect accuracy. However, its reduced strength and lack of martial arts skills often give it away.

entry: 发动攻击前，POKENAME会摆出僵硬姿势，一动不动。此举带来令人不安的紧张感，使对手困惑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stands perfectly still in a rigid pose before launching an attack. This behavior creates an unsettling tension that confuses opponents.

entry: POKENAME爱炫耀肌肉，摆出各种健美姿势。它常得意过头，让肌肉用力过度，失去形状，暂时化作黏液。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME loves showing off its muscular form, flexing in a variety of poses. It often goes too far, overexerting its muscles and causing them to lose shape and temporarily turn to goop.

entry: 浪漫的节日里，伴侣常借POKENAME向彼此示爱。它不完全明白对方要它比出的手势，却仍热情地帮助训练家。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are often used during romantic holidays as a way for spouses to show affection to one another. POKENAME do not fully understand the sign they are asked to make, but will enthusiastically help their Trainers regardless.

entry: POKENAME让壳保持坚实，用来防护。变身时，它躲入壳中，变化完成才以新形态冒出来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME maintains the solidness of its shell for protection. When transforming, it hides within the shell, popping out in its altered form once the process is complete.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME身上会随机长出嫩芽与藤蔓。这些植物看似毫无规律，生长却遵循一种隐蔽而固定的模式。
author: .izik
source: During combat, random sprouts and vines grow from POKENAME's body. While seemingly unpredictable, the plant growth follows a hidden but consistent pattern.

entry: POKENAME的身体像嚼过的泡泡糖，黏得足以沿墙滚上去。这份黏性，也帮它黏住沿途物体。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body has the consistency of chewed bubblegum, making it sticky enough to roll up walls. This adhesiveness also helps it trap objects in its path.

entry: POKENAME滚动时，会留下带大黄气味的黏液。这种奇特气味使追踪者困惑，掩盖它的逃跑路线。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME rolls, it leaves behind a trail of rhubarb-scented slime. This unusual scent confuses pursuers, masking its escape route.

entry: 若有人赛跑赢过它，POKENAME便试着变成对方，盼望同样出色。低温可能使身体结冰，所以它喜欢栖居十分温暖的地区。
author: fiordaliso
source: If someone beats it in a race, POKENAME tries to take on their appearance, hoping to become just as skilled. Since its body risks freezing over when exposed to low temperatures, it prefers to inhabit very warm regions.

entry: POKENAME像喝水般喝熔岩，在酷热中茁壮生长。这种奇特本领，让它完美适应火山环境。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drinks lava as if it were water, thriving in extreme heat. This unusual ability makes it perfectly suited for volcanic environments.

entry: 几乎从未有人见过POKENAME变身，甚至可能一次都没有。有人推测，它们头脑简单，连自己有这种能力都忘了。
author: sk372
source: Few, if any, POKENAME have been observed in the act of transforming. It's theorized by some that their simple minds have caused them to forget they even have the ability.

entry: POKENAME模仿路人的声音，夜里常重复阴森笑声，吓唬旅人。这些诡异的模仿，让听者深感不安。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME mimics the voices of passing humans, often echoing sinister laughter to unnerve travelers at night. These eerie imitations leave those who hear them deeply unsettled.

entry: POKENAME喜欢把各种液态化学物质吸入皮肤。吸收的物质不同，身体也会随之变色。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME enjoys absorbing different types of liquid chemicals into its skin. This habit causes its body to change colors depending on the substances it absorbs.

entry: POKENAME由胶状物质构成，能穿过极细的缝隙，重排细胞结构来模仿任何东西。不知为何，它71%的变身对象都是微观尺度的事物。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME's body is made of a goo-like substance that allows it to move through the tiniest of gaps and rearrange its cell structure to mimic anything. Scientists are unsure why, but 71% of its transformations are into things on the microscopic scale.

entry: POKENAME把柔软脆弱的身体融合在坚壳内。为融入周遭，无定形的黏液会重排细胞，变成其他宝可梦，甚至珍珠。不过，这有时反倒让它成为别人的目标。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME keeps its vulnerable squishy body fused inside a sturdy shell. To blend in, the amorphous goo may rearrange its cells to look like another Pokémon or even a pearl. However, this sometimes makes POKENAME a target to others instead.

entry: POKENAME的细胞虽能改变结构，化作各种形态，通常却坚硬如钛合金。它常住在小瀑布旁，例如湛蓝市以西的那些瀑布。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although the cells of POKENAME can alter their structure to take on many different forms, they are, by default, as hard as titanium alloys. POKENAME tends to live by small waterfalls, such as those west of Cianwood City.

entry: POKENAME拼命想吓唬紫苑镇的人，却通常不成功。有些人虽没被吓到，也会装作害怕，帮它建立自信。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME try desperately to scare people in Lavender Town, but usually fail. Although few are intimidated, some act scared to boost their confidence.

entry: POKENAME能融成一滩，睡觉时常如此。这个形态有助于它避开捕食者与窥探的目光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can melt into a puddle, a state it often assumes when sleeping. This form keeps it hidden from predators and prying eyes.

entry: 传说古代女巫曾用POKENAME滴落的液体熬制药水，模仿王室成员。药水不但能赋予她们当权者的外貌，连举止也能模仿。
author: .izik
source: Legends say POKENAME's drippings were once used by ancient witches to brew elixirs that let them imitate royalty. These potions granted both the appearance and behavior of those in power.

entry: POKENAME变成目标前，会先以精神力量了解对方的过往。这番洞察让它模仿得精准，甚至令人不安。
author: .izik
source: By using its psychic powers, POKENAME learns a target's history before transforming into them. This insight ensures its mimicry is disturbingly accurate.

entry: POKENAME凭柔软身体，能把巨钳变得无比巨大。但这很少奏效，只会让它们行动迟缓、失去平衡。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME can grow a large claw to incredible sizes using their squishy body. This is rarely effective, however, simply slowing them down and leaving them off-balance.

entry: POKENAME喜欢蹭训练家，表达喜爱。可惜，植物状突起分泌的油，会让85%的人长出瘙痒的皮疹。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME enjoys rubbing up against its Trainer to show affection. Unfortunately, the plant-like protrusions exude an oil that creates an itchy rash in 85% of humans.

entry: POKENAME几乎随处可见，四处寻找理想的进化地点。身体虽小，连最恶劣的环境也能生存。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be found virtually everywhere, looking for their ideal spot for evolution. Despite how small they are, POKENAME can survive in even the harshest of environments.

entry: 组成POKENAME的每颗蛋，各有不同元素属性。单个能力虽弱，合在一起却能汇成强大的力量。
author: sk372
source: Each of the eggs in an POKENAME clutch exhibits a different type of element. Though individually their capabilities are meager, together they can make a formidable confluence of powers.

entry: 组成POKENAME的蛋，各有不同性格与元素属性。中间那颗试图维持秩序，其余成员却通常很叛逆。
author: sk372
source: The eggs in an POKENAME clutch exhibit different personalities and elemental properties. The center one tries to maintain order, but the rest of the group are typically quite rebellious.

entry: POKENAME虽有适应任何环境的惊人本领，却似乎偏爱黑暗偏僻的洞穴群。站在洞口的训练家，有时能听见它响亮而回荡不绝的哀鸣。
author: sautomagically
source: Although it has the incredible ability to adapt to any environment, POKENAME seems to prefer dark, isolated cave systems. Trainers who stand at the entrances to these caves can sometimes hear its loud, echoing cry of sorrow.

entry: 传言说，POKENAME携带的骨头会如身体一般，随环境改变大小或形状。战斗中，它能娴熟运用戴着的头骨，保护柔软身体。
author: sautomagically
source: Rumors say the bone POKENAME carries can change in size or shape depending on the environment, much like its actual body. It masterfully uses the skull it wears to protect its soft body during fights.

entry: 据说POKENAME选定喜欢的气候后便会进化。不论进化缘由为何，它们旺盛的食欲往往会使进化推迟，直到时机合适。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are said to evolve when they choose a climate that they enjoy living in. Regardless of the reason they evolve, their big appetite often delays their evolution until the time is right.

entry: POKENAME很脆弱，常躲着其他宝可梦以求安全。有些会通过进化适应周边气候，获得帮助自己脱茧的新力量。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are vulnerable creatures that often hide away from other Pokémon to ensure their safety. Some evolve to adapt to the climates around them and gain new powers to help them make it out of the cocoon.

entry: 每只POKENAME似乎都偏爱身上的某颗宝石，对相应属性展现出天赋。进化时，中央宝石会放出毁灭性的光束，宣告真正形态已然觉醒。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Each POKENAME seems to show an affinity for one of its gems, expressing a natural talent for this type. Upon evolving, the central gem unleashes a devastating beam of light, signaling its true form has awakened.

entry: 每只POKENAME似乎都偏爱身上的某颗宝石，对相应属性展现出天赋。进化时，中央宝石会放出毁灭性的光束，宣告真正形态已然觉醒。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Each POKENAME seems to show an affinity for one of its gems, expressing a natural talent for this type. Upon evolving, the central gem unleashes a devastating beam of light, signaling its true form has awakened.

entry: 一片水域中，若所有POKENAME的基因都发生完全相同的变异，就是严重污染的征兆。因变异对它们无害，科学家会在世界各地的水域放入一群群POKENAME，监测水质。
author: soup1900
source: If the genes of all POKENAME in a body of water mutate in the exact same way, that is a sign of heavy pollution. Since the mutations don't hurt POKENAME, scientists release groups of them in waters worldwide to monitor water quality.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME吃的植物会影响进化方向，因为临近进化时，它的食欲会明显改变，偏爱某些特定植物。
author: sk372
source: It's thought that the type of vegetation POKENAME eats affects its evolutionary direction, as it has a noticeable shift in appetite, preferring specific types of plants shortly before it evolves.

entry: POKENAME壳上嵌有多颗进化石，因此成为宝可梦偷猎者的目标。在野外，究竟激活哪颗石头，取决于它游过的水域。
author: .jerden
source: Multiple evolutionary stones are embedded in POKENAME's shell, making it a target for Pokémon poachers. In the wild, which of these stones is activated depends on the waters POKENAME swims in.

entry: 发现这种奇特融合体后，科学家一直争论：POKENAME究竟能不能进化，还是只喜欢变出近似伊布的各种形态来适应环境。
author: lampent12
source: With the discovery of this bizarre fusion, scientists have debated whether POKENAME is even capable of evolution, or if it simply prefers transforming into Eevee-esque shapes to adapt.

entry: 这只特别的伊布发生了独特突变，基因组成大幅改变，如今与所有已知进化形都十分相近。
author: jackjirachi
source: This particular Eevee has undergone a unique mutation. Its genetic makeup has changed significantly, and now closely resembles all of its known Evolutions'.

entry: 自我融合似乎让它将预感化作了实体。真身静止不动，种种可能的未来却在周身旋转轮替，准备施展难以预料的动作。
author: ocxin
source: Self-fusion seems to have let it enter a state of embodied premonition. Its true body becomes inert while a swirl of potential futures cycle around it, ready for unpredictable maneuvers.

entry: 与另一只伊布融合后，潜能觉醒，它能控制所有进化形态的力量。但这也有代价：庞大能量正慢慢吞噬它，不断试图迫使它进化。
author: mcnchsschl
source: After combining with another Eevee, its latent powers have awoken, and it can control the powers of all of its evolutions. However, this comes at a cost: the huge amount of energy is slowly consuming it, constantly trying to make it evolve.

entry: POKENAME的基因极不稳定，常随机发生变异。这些变异，使它很难解除融合。
author: quasardiamond
source: POKENAME's genes have become so unstable that it often randomly mutates. These mutations make it hard for it to unfuse.

entry: 两只伊布融合后，不稳定的基因发生突变，造就了一只兼具所有进化形态特征的宝可梦。
author: bitterchemicalhaze
source: Combining an Eevee with another Eevee has resulted in its unstable genes mutating, creating a Pokémon with features of each possible evolution.

entry: POKENAME尚未完全适应水中生活，在较强水流中难以游动。毛发也不能完全防水，总被水浸透。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body has not fully adapted to its aquatic habitat as it struggles to swim in stronger currents. Due to its fur not being fully hydrophobic, it is constantly saturated with water.

entry: POKENAME精力充沛，不停四处飞奔。它们尤其爱在地毯上跑，比平常更快地为尖刺般的毛积蓄静电，之后摸它们可会被电得一惊。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME are highly energetic and constantly zoom around. They particularly enjoy doing so on carpets to charge their spiky coats with static electricity even faster than normal, making them quite shocking to pet afterward.

entry: POKENAME的毛摸来温暖，是寒冷地区的热门宠物。不过，太生气时，它可能不慎点燃自己的毛。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's fur is warm to the touch, making it a popular pet in colder areas. If it gets too angry, however, it has a chance to accidentally catch its fur on fire.

entry: POKENAME每次更新都会僵在原地，无法动弹。训练家可在需要时取消，但科学家建议让更新完成，以免性格发生变化。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME goes through an update, it freezes in place and cannot move. Its Trainer has an option to cancel the update if needed but scientists recommend allowing updates to complete to avoid personality changes.

entry: POKENAME的程序很容易修改。人们甚至形成了专门的小社群，交流分享经过外观修改的副本。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME's programming is highly susceptible to alterations. Entire subcommunities center around sharing visually modified copies of it.

entry: POKENAME覆有厚实绒毛，在准备进化时保护身体。它们聚在元素能量充沛的地方，借助环境中的能量加快进化。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are coated in thick, plush fur that protects their bodies whilst they prepare to evolve. They congregate near areas full of elemental energy, using the ambient energy to help them evolve faster.

entry: DNA适应性强，又总一睡很久，POKENAME常会在睡梦中进化，醒来好一阵也没察觉自己变了。
author: sk372
source: Due to its adaptive DNA and the long-lasting naps it takes, it's not uncommon for an POKENAME to evolve while asleep and not even realize its changed for some time after waking.

entry: POKENAME十分稀有。传说，接触不同的特殊石头，便能进化成不同姿态。
author: deflador
source: POKENAME is a rare Pokémon. Legend says it will evolve into different forms when in contact to certain stones.

entry: POKENAME体内潜藏强大能量，直到进化时才苏醒。临近进化，颈上水晶便亮起特定颜色，预示进化后的形态。
author: infinex21
source: Within POKENAME's bodies lies potent energy that is dormant until the moment of their evolution. When they near evolution, the crystal upon their necks will glow with a specific color indicative of their evolution.

entry: POKENAME十分亲人，常成群追上某个对象，又抱又蹭。它们似乎不知道，这副模样高速冲向对方，会让人感到不安。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are quite affectionate and will often swarm after something to hug and nuzzle it. They seem unaware that their appearance hurtling towards another at high speed could be seen as disconcerting.

entry: POKENAME仅凭精神力量，就能造出形似进化石的构造物。它常静静凝望思索，尾巴同时变换万千色彩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is able to create constructs resembling evolutionary stones through sheer psychic power. It quietly ponders these facsimiles often, its tail shifting through a myriad of hues as it does so.

entry: POKENAME以适应环境的本领闻名，因此在许多地方都能见到。它们很快就能交到朋友，爱玩圆形物件与玩具。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are known for being adaptable to their environments, so it is not uncommon to see them in many different locales. They are quick to make friends and love to play with round objects and toys.

entry: 这只宝可梦体形小巧、外表可爱，叶片还能散出宜人而舒缓的香气，是受欢迎的家养宠物。它喜欢蜷在温暖明亮的窗台，尽情晒太阳。
author: lydiaprower8
source: This Pokémon is a popular house pet for its small size, cute appearance, and its ability to emit pleasant, calming smells from its leaves. It likes curling up in warm, sunny windowsills and soaking up the rays.

entry: 由于喷火孔的位置，POKENAME容易不慎点燃颈毛。建议训练家在战斗前为颈毛涂上耐火凝胶。
author: hophoppip
source: The position of POKENAME's flame vents makes it easy for it to accidentally ignite the fur on its neck. It's advised for Trainers of POKENAME to cover its neck fur with a flame-resistant gel before a battle.

entry: 靠近多数进化石时，POKENAME的羽毛会变色。只要碰到石头，它就会开始进化。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feathers change hue when in close proximity of most evolution stones. Should it touch one, it will start to evolve.

entry: POKENAME与大尾立十分相像，起初被当作颜色奇特的大尾立。直到一只野生个体碰上水之石后进化，研究者才意识到它是融合体。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's was initially assumed to be an odd coloration of Furret due to their strong resemblance. It was only after a wild specimen evolved on contact with a Water Stone that researchers realized it was a fusion.

entry: 野外发现了毛色近似伊布的罕见POKENAME。相比之下，这些个体似乎没那么胆怯，更容易接近。
author: sk372
source: Rare variants of POKENAME that take on coloration similar to Eevee have been spotted in the wild. These versions of POKENAME seem a bit less skittish and more approachable in the wild by comparison.

entry: 这些宝可梦适应性极强，不稳定的DNA使它们成为高效猎手。它们的丝可用来筑巢、设陷阱和织网，似乎还会闪出不同颜色。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: These highly adaptive Pokémon have unstable DNA that causes them to be effective hunters. Their webbing is used in nests, traps, and nets, and it appears to shine in different colors.

entry: 小群POKENAME会迁徙到世界各地。原因尚不完全清楚，似乎只是喜欢这么做。若其中一只进化，就会离群。
author: bobosmith01
source: Small flocks of POKENAME migrate all around the world. The reason for this is not entirely known: they simply seem to enjoy doing it. If an POKENAME evolves, it leaves the flock.

entry: POKENAME视力不好，靠触角毛茸茸的尖端熟悉环境。常能看到它们成群互相挠痒，作为问候。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME has poor eyesight, so it uses the furry tips of its antennae to familiarize itself with its environment. Groups of POKENAME are often seen tickling each other as a greeting.

entry: POKENAME会从住宅区偷电池。收集够了，就趴在自己的电池堆上睡觉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME will steal batteries from residential areas. Once it has enough gathered, it will fall asleep on top of its horde.

entry: POKENAME好奇又容易轻信，还总分心，一不小心，就把自己置于危险。照顾它，可得时时看紧。
author: kittyluv090
source: Very curious and gullible, POKENAME needs constant supervision because it is easily distracted and can unknowingly put itself in harm's way.

entry: POKENAME凭精神力量能窥见未来，花上数小时试着预测将发生的事。自身的进化可能性，却常使看见的景象改变。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to glean glimpses of the future with their psychic powers. They spend hours trying to predict what is to come. Their own evolutionary potential frequently changes the visions they see.

entry: 传说POKENAME曾守护旅行商队，确保一路平安。它警觉守望的天性，被视为好运的象征。
author: .izik
source: Legends say POKENAME once watched over traveling caravans, ensuring their safe passage. Its watchful nature is regarded as a sign of good fortune.

entry: POKENAME覆有厚厚的羊毛状毛发，深受许多培育者珍视。烦躁时，它转眼就能把绒毛竖硬，充满静电。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is covered in thick, wool-like fur that is highly prized by many breeders. When irritated, it can stiffen its down and charge it with static electricity in the blink of an eye.

entry: POKENAME覆有厚厚的羊毛状毛发，深受许多培育者珍视。烦躁时，它转眼就能把绒毛竖硬，充满静电。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is covered in thick, wool-like fur that is highly prized by many breeders. When irritated, it can stiffen its down and charge it with static electricity in the blink of an eye.

entry: POKENAME全身覆满蓬松而极柔软的羊毛状毛发，每年至少须剪毛两次。剪下的毛，会被制成豪华酒店使用的高级毯子和枕头。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body is completely covered in a fluffy, ultra-soft wool coat. It must be sheared at least twice a year, and its fleece is used to make high-end blankets and pillows for luxury hotels.

entry: 它全身覆满蓬松而极柔软的羊毛状毛发。POKENAME每年至少须剪毛两次，剪下的毛会被制成豪华酒店使用的高级毯子和枕头。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its body is completely covered in a fluffy, ultra-soft wool coat. POKENAME must be sheared at least twice a year, and its fleece is used to make high-end blankets and pillows for luxury hotels.

entry: POKENAME外表虽有些吓人，却可以十分亲人。赢得训练家的信任后，它常会把自己最喜欢的羽毛送给对方。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite its somewhat menacing appearance, POKENAME can be very affectionate. It tends to gift its favorite feathers to its Trainer once it has earned their trust.

entry: POKENAME小巧又易训练，常见于家庭中。电力足以为小家电充电。这种融合体常挖土寻找雷之石。
author: periperi_chicken
source: Small and easily trainable, POKENAME are commonly found in family households. Its electrical power is enough to charge small appliances. This fusion often digs for Thunder Stones.

entry: 许多人说，POKENAME柔软蓬松的尾巴捏起来很舒服。它自己也觉得这样痒痒的很愉快，因此乐意把尾巴交给任何想抱的人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's soft and fluffy tail has been described by many as pleasant to squeeze. POKENAME itself feels a pleasant tickle from the act, so it happily offers up its tail to anybody who wants to hold it.

entry: POKENAME爱住在花盆里，与亲近的伙伴相伴。若训练家悉心照料，便能得到它头顶长出的稀有植物，品种随地区而异。
author: fxncy_poland
