source: POKENAME love to live in flowerpots, surrounded by their loved ones. If a Pokémon Trainer dutifully cares for POKENAME, they will be granted a rare plant sprouting from the top of their head, which changes depending on the region.

entry: 有个名为“果汁牛奶”的稀有毛绒玩偶系列，以POKENAME及其进化形态为原型，只限时发售。每只玩偶一捏，就会发出相应宝可梦的叫声。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: A rare plushie collection called Mix Au Lait was based on POKENAME and its evolutions. It only ran for a limited time, and each plushie would make the sound of the Pokémon it was based on if squeezed.

entry: POKENAME看似疲倦迟缓，却能在野外生存。它们在水边用泥与毛筑巢休息。临近进化时，像睡帽般的头毛会微微变色。
author: chibitales
source: Despite seeming tired and slow, POKENAME are capable of surviving in the wild. They make nests out of mud and fur near the water's edge to rest. Their nightcap-like hair subtly changes color when they are close to evolving.

entry: POKENAME爱交际又亲人，晒到太阳会更加活泼好动。它们用额前宝石吸收太阳热量，传遍绒毛，抱起来格外舒服。
author: ambrosia04
source: Highly social and affectionate, POKENAME become more active and playful when exposed to sunlight. They use their forehead gems to absorb heat from the sun, spreading it through their fluff to make them incredibly cozy to hold.

entry: POKENAME通常夜间活动，月光会让毛变凉，炎热的夜晚也愿意让人抚摸。自古以来，像繁星夜空般的尾巴，一直给艺术家带来灵感。
author: ambrosia04
source: Commonly active at night, POKENAME allow people to pet their fur, which cools with the moonlight, on hot nights. Artists have drawn inspiration from their starry, night-sky-looking tails since ancient times.

entry: POKENAME很脆弱，一看见鵟一类的猛禽，通常就设法逃跑。它们必须躲藏着生活，否则很快就会被吃掉。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are vulnerable creatures, usually trying to run away from any buzzards they spot. They must live their lives in hiding, or they'd quickly be eaten.

entry: POKENAME爱收集进化石，当首饰佩戴，甚至会溜进百货商店偷走库存的石头。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME love to collect evolution stones and will wear them as jewelry. It will even sneak into department stores to steal their collection of stones.

entry: 每只POKENAME的外形可能各不相同。把多只聚在一起，它们就会分组，可每隔几秒，个体又会换到另一组。原因尚不明。
author: bobosmith01
source: Individual POKENAME can have a variety of different appearances. If multiple POKENAME are brought together, they will split into groups, only for the individuals to go to a different group every few seconds. The reason for this behavior is unknown.

entry: 每只POKENAME的外形可能各不相同。把多只聚在一起，它们就会分组，可每隔几秒，个体又会换到另一组。原因尚不明。
author: bobosmith01
source: Individual POKENAME can have a variety of different appearances. If multiple POKENAME are brought together, they will split into groups, only for the individuals to go to a different group every few seconds. The reason for this behavior is unknown.

entry: 每只POKENAME的外形可能各不相同。把多只聚在一起，它们就会分组，可每隔几秒，个体又会换到另一组。原因尚不明。
author: bobosmith01
source: Individual POKENAME can have a variety of different appearances. If multiple POKENAME are brought together, they will split into groups, only for the individuals to go to a different group every few seconds. The reason for this behavior is unknown.

entry: POKENAME很容易适应周围环境。若附近食物够不到，它的脖子能暂时伸长，维持几小时。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME easily adapts to its surroundings. Its neck can temporarily lengthen for a few hours if nearby food sources are out of reach.

entry: POKENAME脸旁的片状结构能轻易脱落再生，毫无痛感。虽然坚韧无味，仍有人发现，可给某些小宝可梦当磨牙玩具。
author: sk372
source: The flaps around POKENAME's face can easily and painlessly break off and regrow. Though considered tough and flavorless, some have found a use for them as chew toys for some small Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME作为家养宠物，始终供不应求。遗憾的是，也因此常有土龙弟弟，遭人为融合而非法捕猎。
author: staghorn
source: Demand for POKENAME as a house pet is always extremely high. Cases of Dunsparce being illegally poached for fusion purposes are, regrettably, common.

entry: 各个地区都能发现POKENAME，适应性强的身体让它在多种气候中都能自在生活。翼膜颜色随当前栖息地而异。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can be found across all the regions, its adaptive body letting it function perfectly well in a multitude of climates. The membranes of its wings vary in color depending on its current habitat.

entry: POKENAME许多身体节段形似进化石，但尚未展现相似功能。据说，若某一节比其他部分亮得更强，就预示着进化方向。
author: sk372
source: Many of POKENAME's segments resemble evolutionary stones, but so far show no signs of functioning similarly. Supposedly, if one segment begins glowing brighter than the other, it signifies what direction POKENAME's evolution will take.

entry: POKENAME天性亲人，被认为非常适合作为幼童的第一只宝可梦。随着适应周边环境，身上斑点也会渐渐变色。
author: sk372
source: Because of POKENAME's affectionate nature, it has been deemed a very good first Pokémon for young children. The spots on its body change color over time as it adapts to its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME的毛极其柔软，在时尚界备受珍视。接触元素石时，毛上的光泽会变色，暗示它不稳定的基因与进化潜力。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have luxuriously soft fur that makes them prized Pokémon within the fashion industry. Their fur has a sheen that changes colour when exposed to elemental stones, hinting at the unstable genetics of POKENAME and their evolutionary potential.

entry: POKENAME能通过进化迅速适应环境。从寒冷苔原到炎热热带雨林，世界各地都有它们的踪迹。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are able to rapidly adapt to their environment through evolution. They are found throughout the world in places as cold as the tundra to places as hot as the tropical rainforest.

entry: 森林、山地、苔原、热带雨林等各种环境，都能见到POKENAME。它们能通过进化迅速适应环境，不过许多个体更愿保持未进化的样子。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found in all sorts of environments, such as forests, mountains, tundras, and tropical rainforests. They are capable of rapidly adapting to their environment through evolution, though many prefer to remain unevolved.

entry: POKENAME背上的壳由硬化岩浆构成。基因组成不稳定，使它极难维持熔融的身体。若没有细心训练家的帮助，它通常寿命很短。
author: ludacriswell
source: The shell on POKENAME's back is made of hardened magma. POKENAME has an unstable genetic composition that makes maintaining its molten body extremely difficult. Its lifespan is usually very short without the aid of an attentive Trainer.

entry: POKENAME蓬松的鬃毛，遮住了极长的脖子。身体兼具毛发与羽毛，即使在高空也能保暖。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's fluffy mane obscures its incredibly long neck. Its body's combination of fur and feathers allows it to stay warm even at high altitudes.

entry: POKENAME热切地四处嗅闻，寻找任何能吃的蘑菇。随着时间推移，它的身体会依主要吃的真菌种类而改变。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME eagerly sniffs around for any sort of mushroom it can find to eat. Its body alters over time depending on what type of fungi makes up the majority of its diet.

entry: POKENAME不仅遗传构成独特，尾端的包裹里还常带着各种进化道具。
author: pankiwi
source: Not only do POKENAME carry a unique genetic makeup, but they also can be found carrying various evolutionary items in their tail bundle.

entry: 它性情友善，爱缠着别人拥抱依偎。常能看见POKENAME开心地搭在训练家肩上，或缠着脖子，像件毛茸茸的饰物。
author: sk372
source: A friendly creature that loves to wrap around and cuddle with others, it's not uncommon to see Trainers with their POKENAME happily draped over their shoulders or around their neck like a fluffy accessory.

entry: POKENAME藏在水下洞穴，思索自己无限的可能，以漩涡封住入口，阻止他人靠近。据说，只有决定好要进化成什么，它们才会出洞。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hide in underwater caves contemplating their limitless potential and keep others away by summoning whirlpools to block the entrance. It is said that POKENAME only come out of their caves once they decide on what to evolve into.

entry: 形态虽已升级，POKENAME在网上碰到零散数据时，依然很容易因此进化。建议将它存入电脑的训练家定期查看，以免发生不想要的进化。
author: chibitales
source: Despite its upgraded form, POKENAME is still extremely vulnerable to evolution from stray data it collides with online. Trainers storing their POKENAME in PCs are advised to check up on them regularly to prevent unwanted evolution.

entry: 生活在有助进化的地区时，POKENAME的毛色会略微变化，鹿角也会增添特征，例如覆霜、角尖冒火，或闪出电火花。
author: sk372
source: When living in an area that would help induce evolution, POKENAME's fur will change hue slightly, and its antlers will gain additional attributes, such as a layer of frost, flames at the tips or electric sparks, among others.

entry: POKENAME用的每种颜料，似乎都有元素属性。红色摸来烫手，黄色会电人，绿色则能加速植物生长。
author: mistymagius
source: Each of the paint colors POKENAME uses seems to have elemental properties. Red paint is hot to the touch, yellow paint gives an electric shock, and green paint accelerates plant growth.

entry: 只要有足够时间训练，POKENAME几乎能精通任何战斗流派。这份巨大潜力引来众多训练家，过度捕捉已使野生数量减少。
author: fancyskunk
source: POKENAME can master nearly any fighting style if given enough time to train. This immense potential led many Trainers to seek out POKENAME, and over-catching has thinned their numbers in the wild.

entry: POKENAME躯干的花纹形似进化石，但似乎仅仅是外观相像。传闻城都、神奥等地区，存在花纹不同的个体。
author: sk372
source: The markings on POKENAME's torso resemble evolution stones, though the resemblance appears to be completely superficial. There are rumors that POKENAME with different patterns exist in regions like Johto and Sinnoh.

entry: POKENAME的奶，风味与质地会随环境变化。关都北部产的奶尤其受欢迎，口感绵滑，滋味香甜。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's milk takes on different flavors and textures depending on its surroundings. Northern Kanto POKENAME milk is particularly popular for its creamy quality and sweet taste.

entry: 两边原主都较为稀有，因此，这种融合体也难得一见。已有的个体，多半被当作宠物饲养。
author: faelocke
source: Due to requiring two relatively rare Pokémon as components, this fusion is rarely seen. Those that exist are often kept as pets.

entry: 据说POKENAME的每片羽毛，都蕴藏着某一种可能进化形态的力量。奇妙的是，各片羽毛的细胞结构也不相同，会分别回应特定进化石而发光。
author: infinex21
source: Within each of POKENAME's feathers is said to lie the potential power of each of its many possible evolutions. Remarkably, its feathers all have different cellular structures as well and respectively glow in response to specific evolutionary stones.

entry: POKENAME亲热得过了头，常伸长弹性手臂，把别人拉来拥抱，这点一眼就能看出。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are overly affectionate Pokémon, easily seen when they extend their stretchy arms to pull others in for a hug.

entry: POKENAME喜欢制作假茶壶，开想象中的茶会。这种玩耍方式，让旁观者也感到快乐。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME delights in creating fake tea kettles and hosting imaginary tea parties. This playful behavior brings joy to those who watch it.

entry: 蜷起的POKENAME常又软又暖，小孩子和幼小宝可梦都爱依偎着它。它们天生善于适应环境，环境也会影响进化。
author: infinex21
source: A curled-up POKENAME is often so soft and warm that young children and young Pokémon alike love to cuddle up to one. They display an innate ability to adapt well to environments, which also influence their evolutions.

entry: POKENAME身上会长出形似进化石的突起。尽管外观相似，其实只是假进化石，用来引诱尚处于较低进化阶段的宝可梦。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME create protrusions that resemble evolution stones from its body. Despite their looks, they are actually just fake evolution stones meant to lure in lower evolution Pokémon as bait.

entry: 它是林地中不常见的宝可梦，外观随季节与周边花草变化。它喜爱各种树果。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is an uncommon woodland Pokémon whose appearance changes with the seasons and the nearby floral life. It adores all kinds of Berries.

entry: 它是林地中不常见的宝可梦，外观随季节与周边花草变化。它喜爱各种树果。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is an uncommon woodland Pokémon whose appearance changes with the seasons and the nearby floral life. It adores all kinds of Berries.

entry: 它是林地中不常见的宝可梦，外观随季节与周边花草变化。它喜爱各种树果。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is an uncommon woodland Pokémon whose appearance changes with the seasons and the nearby floral life. It adores all kinds of Berries.

entry: 伊布在间歇出现严寒的环境附近长大，才会进化为POKENAME。有些培育者认为，刻意这样促成进化，并不道德。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME only evolve from Eevee raised near severe, sporadic sources of cold. Some Eevee breeders consider deliberately evolving one to be unethical.

entry: 伊布与多边兽Ｚ融合后，遗传构成变得极不稳定。每次试图适应环境，都会出了故障。
author: jackjirachi
source: Fusing Eevee with Porygon-Z has caused its genetic makeup to become critically unstable. It glitches every time it tries to adapt to an environment.

entry: POKENAME背上长满尖刺，形似各种进化用石。虽不能代替真正的石头，每根刺仍含有少许相应石头的能量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's back is covered with spines resembling the multiple stones related to evolution. Though not effective as replacements for the stones proper, each spine does contain a modicum of the specific stone's energy.

entry: POKENAME似乎能驾驭所有已知的元素力量，随意生成、操纵这些元素，保护珍视的对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears to be able to harness the power of every known elemental force. It can freely generate and manipulate these elements in order to protect those it holds dear.

entry: 得益于伊布易于变化的天性，POKENAME能调整战斗风格，应对几乎任何局面。
author: hophoppip
source: Thanks to Eevee's malleable nature, POKENAME is able to adapt its fighting style to nearly any situation.

entry: 格外娴熟的POKENAME能激发伊布基因，凝聚元素之刃，运用伊布全部八种进化形态的力量。
author: hophoppip
source: A particularly skilled POKENAME can tap into its Eevee genes and conjure elemental blades with the power of all eight Eeveelutions.

entry: POKENAME的毛会变色，配合所在环境。奇妙的是，让它接触某些进化石，也能产生相同效果。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's fur will change color to match its environment. Curiously, the same effect can be produced by exposing it to certain evolution stones.

entry: 有人观察到，POKENAME啃树时，会在树上凿出图案。虽然尚未证实，人们认为图案与它希望日后进化成的形态有关。
author: sk372
source: When gnawing on wood, POKENAME has been observed chiseling shapes into the trees it chews on. Though unconfirmed, it's believed the shapes relate to the form that specific POKENAME hopes to one day evolve into.

entry: POKENAME诡异的雾气会吸引进化石碎片。有些石头看似完整，碎块却总不能严丝合缝地拼合。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME's eerie vapors attract fragments of Evolution Stones. While some of these stones may appear complete, the pieces never fit together quite right.

entry: POKENAME年幼时，花瓣色彩斑斓。随着成长、适应环境，所有花瓣渐渐变成同一种花纹。
author: sk372
source: Early in its life, POKENAME's flower has a multitude of different colors on its petals. As it grows and acclimates to its surroundings, the flower petals will change to all become the same pattern.

entry: POKENAME可爱友善，另外三颗头却不停争斗，喷出元素攻击，想证明自己的进化比本体更出色。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its cuteness and friendly nature, POKENAME's three other heads are constantly at war. They spew elemental attacks to prove their evolution is superior to the main body.

entry: POKENAME每条触手，都代表一种可能的进化方向。它会使用自己最想进化成的形态所对应的触手。
author: camtft
source: Each tentacle of POKENAME represents one of the potential paths for it to take evolutionarily. It uses the tentacles that it would most prefer to become.

entry: POKENAME头毛下藏着坚硬骨板，头锤威力十足。它每天撞击树干与岩石，维持头骨的坚固。
author: sk372
source: Beneath the fur on POKENAME's head lies a hardened skull plate, making its headbutt quite potent. It headbutts tree trunks and rocks on a daily basis to maintain the sturdiness of its skull.

entry: POKENAME十分擅长照顾年幼又挑剔的宝可梦。遇到闹脾气的小家伙，它就抱起来，坚定却温柔地搂住，直到对方平静才放手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is an excellent caretaker of young and fussy Pokémon. Any little one throwing a tantrum is picked up and put into a firm, yet gentle hug and won't be let go until they've calmed down.

entry: POKENAME基因不稳定，在任何时间、任何环境都极易进化。临近进化，身上环状结构的宝石会闪耀，颜色随将进化成的形态而异。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's unstable genetics make it extremely susceptible to evolution at any time in any environment. The gemstones on its gate glow brightly when it is about to evolve, differing in color depending on what it will evolve into.

entry: POKENAME生活在稀有珍贵宝石遍地可见的地方。据说，它能运用每一种进化石的力量。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: POKENAME lives in places where rare and precious gems are commonplace. It is said that this Pokémon can channel the power of every evolution stone.

entry: POKENAME善于攀爬，生活在热带森林中。周围环境的种种变化，都会影响它未来的进化。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can climb very well and lives in tropical forests. Various environmental influences affect its future evolution.

entry: POKENAME适应力强，也极聪明，已经学会借助工具与武器，达成自己的目的。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is extremely adaptable and intelligent. It has learned to use tools and weapons for its own purposes.

entry: POKENAME适应力强，也极聪明，已经学会借助工具与武器，达成自己的目的。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is extremely adaptable and intelligent. It has learned to use tools and weapons for its own purposes.

entry: POKENAME以适应力为傲，无论来到什么环境都要试着生活下去。寒冷气候中，毛会变厚；天气温暖时则会变薄。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME prides itself on its adaptability and will try to live in any environment it finds itself in. Its fur will become thicker in cold climates, but thinner in warm weather.

entry: 每只POKENAME似乎都偏爱不同的居住环境。因此，野外无法形成群体，因为每只都想各走各的路。
author: .jerden
source: Every POKENAME seems to have its own preference for the type of environment it wants to live in. This makes it impossible for a group of them to form in the wild, as each will want to go its own separate way.

entry: 这支长矛忠诚，潜力无穷。背面的凹槽里，似乎还缺一块石头。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A loyal spear full of potential. There is a slot on the back that seems to be missing a stone.

entry: 靠近强大电源时，它蓬松的鬃毛会竖起，看上去更具威慑力。POKENAME开心时，尾尖便亮起光芒。
author: fiordaliso
source: When near powerful sources of electricity, its fluffy mane puffs up, giving it a more intimidating appearance. When POKENAME is happy, the tip of its tail shines brightly.

entry: 人们推测，伊布进化成仙子伊布时，若仍保留不稳定的遗传构成，就会成为POKENAME。
author: melodydelune
source: It is theorized that POKENAME is the result of an Eevee that retained its unstable genetic makeup when evolving into a Sylveon.

entry: POKENAME住在平流层，穿行于离地极远的云间，训练家极少遇到。它们基因不稳定，遗传结构深受天气影响。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are very rarely encountered by Trainers as they live in the stratosphere, winding through clouds far out of view of the ground. They have an unstable genetic makeup, their genetic structure heavily influenced by the weather.

entry: POKENAME可爱、友善又十分稀有，常受年轻女性追捧。它们爱漂亮珠宝与石头，只要给件亮闪闪的东西，就很容易让它参加宝可梦华丽大赛的装扮环节。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are cute, friendly, and very rare Pokémon that are often in demand by young women. They adore pretty jewels and stones, so it's easy to get them to participate in the Dress-Up portions of Pokémon Contests by giving them something sparkly.

entry: POKENAME虽随风四处飘，却能伸展长尾控制方向。每只都有偏爱的环境，总想回去。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME is blown from place to place by the wind, it can steer itself by stretching out its long tails. Each POKENAME has a preferred environment that it tries to return to.

entry: POKENAME每次跳起落地，都会从菌盖撒下孢子。若在新鲜土壤扎根，孢子就会随机长成某种独特蘑菇。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME scatters spores from its cap whenever it lands after a jump. The spores grow a random variety of unique mushrooms should they take root within fresh soil.

entry: POKENAME会配合所用招式，改变形状与颜色。临近进化，平时的颜色也会换成另一种色调，暗示未来形态。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME reshapes itself and changes color in accordance to its move. As it grows closer to evolution, its default color alters to a different shading, hinting at what it will become.

entry: POKENAME对各种元素力量充满好奇，会保存不同能量的样本，作比较，也用来教别人。人们认为，它只会依照自己最熟悉的元素进化。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are highly curious about different elemental powers, keeping samples of different energy types to compare them and educate others. It is believed that an POKENAME will only evolve based on the element it has the most experience with.

entry: POKENAME珍惜携带的石头，把它们当作给其他伊布的特别道具。博士们说，若伊布吞下一颗，身体就会与石头的能量融合。
author: ilija09
source: POKENAME treasures the stones it carries, treating them like special items meant for other Eevee. Professors say that if an Eevee were to swallow one of the stones, their body would fuse with the stone's energy.

entry: POKENAME像谜拟丘一样，披着做成伊布模样的破布，免得显得吓人。那块布，也会随环境发生古怪的反应。
author: petermars
source: Much like Mimikyu, POKENAME wears a rag fashioned into an Eevee costume to make it look less scary. This rag reacts strangely to its environment.

entry: POKENAME每个头的基因组成略有差别，因此各自渴望不同元素的进化。犹豫不决，很可能就是它始终未进化的原因。
author: h0bojoe
source: Each of POKENAME's heads has a slightly different genetic makeup, causing them to yearn for different elemental evolutions. Its indecisiveness is likely the reason it has never evolved.

entry: POKENAME对环境极其敏感。在极寒地区，它的身体能热得发光；在热带，又能让身体降温，是夏日的好伙伴。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME are very sensitive to their environment. In regions of extreme cold, POKENAME have been known to grow hot enough to glow. Alternatively, they can cool their bodies in tropical areas, making them good companions in summer.

entry: POKENAME非常护惜多条彩色尾巴。传言拉扯其中一条就会遭到诅咒，等待扯尾者的可怕命运，会随尾巴颜色而异。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is highly protective of its many colorful tails. According to rumors, pulling on one will cause one to be cursed, with the terrible fate that awaits differing depending on the tail's color.

entry: POKENAME能完全掌控自己的遗传结构，依环境的需要，改变形态与属性。
author: ethewriter
source: POKENAME has full control over its genetic structure. It can change its form and type based on what it needs for its environment.

entry: POKENAME总在行动，以波导洞察身边的人、宝可梦与环境。收集到的一切信息，都会影响它的进化。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME is always on the move, using its aura to gain insights about the people, Pokémon, and environment around it.  Whatever information it gathers affects how it evolves.

entry: POKENAME头骨的各部分形似不同进化石，个体之间也有差异。头部撞上物体表面时，这些部分会迸出彩色火花。
author: sk372
source: Segments of POKENAME's skull resemble the different evolutionary stones. The segments differ among different members of the species, and emit colored sparks when it strikes its head against a surface.

entry: POKENAME出生不久时，火焰无色。随着成长，火焰颜色会依栖息地而改变。城市养大的个体，通常会长出棕黄色火焰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's flame starts out being colorless in the early days of its life, but as it develops, the color will change depending on the habitat it resides in. Urban-raised POKENAME typically develop tan-colored flames.

entry: 它随风四处飘荡。若POKENAME在一处停留够久，适应当地环境后，就可能开始进化。
author: .jerden
source: It drifts from place to place, blown by the wind. If POKENAME remains in one location for long enough, it may begin to evolve as it adapts to local conditions.

entry: 它柔软的毛被收集起来，制成备受珍视的讲究围巾。POKENAME外表甜美温和，常被送给幼童，让他们从小接触宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its soft fur is harvested and crafted into highly prized Choice Scarves. Thanks to its sweet and gentle appearance, POKENAME is frequently given to young children as a way to introduce them to Pokémon from an early age.

entry: POKENAME没有眼睛，靠训练家与野生宝可梦引领，才能安全行走。洞穴中的个体与勾魂眼建立了关系；记录显示，它会用空气斩击落嵌有宝石的钟乳石。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Lacking eyes, POKENAME relies on Trainers and wild Pokémon to safely navigate the world. POKENAME found in caves have displayed a relationship with Sableye, with POKENAME being documented using Air Slash to knock loose stalactites laden with gems.

entry: 它在颈毛中储存静电。POKENAME虽爱亲近，可抚摸它的人，都有被意外静电电到的风险。
author: cait_sith
source: It stores static electricity in its neck fur. Although POKENAME enjoys affection, anyone who pets it is at risk of an accidental static shock.

entry: POKENAME翼展与身体不成比例，飞行忽停忽动。为此，它们会找七夕青鸟帮忙，通常飞在对方云翼稍高的位置。
author: teatedtiten
source: Because POKENAME's wingspans are disproportionate to their body, they fly in sporadic movements. For assistance, they will find Altaria to help them, usually flying slightly above Altaria's cloud wings.

entry: 它住在洞穴深处，吃岩石与水晶。POKENAME吃的宝石越闪亮，毛就越有光泽，也越柔软。
author: larky_
source: It lives in the depths of caves, eating rocks and crystals. The shinier the gems POKENAME eats, the more lustrous and soft its fur becomes.

entry: 穿行雪地时，POKENAME只留下尾巴的痕迹。科学家依这奇特现象推测，它的身体会部分脱离物质世界，只有进化后才完全化为实体。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When moving through snow, only POKENAME's tail leaves a trail. Scientists believe its body partially phases out of the physical world, based on this strange phenomenon. It becomes fully corporeal only upon evolution.

entry: POKENAME虽天生亲近火焰，许多人仍说，它真能成为任何想成为的样子。它常模仿各进化形态的舞蹈，一边练习，一边决定未来。
author: roundabout_robin
source: Despite having a natural affinity to fire, many say POKENAME can well and truly be anything it desires. It often imitates the various dances of its evolutions, practicing as it decides what it wants to become.

entry: POKENAME欢呼时，会释放振奋精神的香气，让身边的人都充满活力。据说，它轻快的舞蹈能鼓舞乐观的心情。
author: .izik
source: While cheering, POKENAME releases invigorating scents that energize everyone nearby. Its lively dance is said to inspire optimism.

entry: 常能看见POKENAME在神社门前跳舞，挡住参拜者的路。为容下它，神社只好把大门加宽。
author: beetlething
source: POKENAME are frequently seen dancing at the gates of shrines, blocking the paths of those who wish to visit. Shrines have made their gates larger to compensate for an POKENAME's presence.

entry: POKENAME着迷于丢弃的彩色玻璃，收集碎片装饰巢穴。这份爱好，让住处独特又缤纷。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has a fascination with discarded colored glass, collecting pieces to decorate its nest. This hobby gives it a unique and colorful living space.

entry: POKENAME悄无声息地飘过森林，用耳朵轻敲空心树，打出节拍。它极其友善，爱吹着在原木上练过的相同节奏，引导迷路训练家安全回到路上。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME floats silently through forests, tapping its ears against hollow trees to create rhythmic beats. It is extremely friendly and loves guiding lost Trainers safely back to their paths by whistling the same beat it practices on logs.

entry: 有些咖啡馆会用POKENAME的头叶拌沙拉。叶片随做法不同而有不同风味，通常搭配元素石的碎粒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME leaves are sometimes employed in cafés, where their head leaves are used in salads. Their leaves have different flavours depending on how they're prepared and are usually paired with granules of elemental stones.

entry: POKENAME翅上的棉花被收集起来，制成宝可梦中心与诊所出售的急救包。它总爱依偎在训练家头顶，表达依恋与喜爱。
author: fiordaliso
source: The cotton on the wings of POKENAME is gathered to make first-aid kits sold in Pokémon Centers and clinics. POKENAME always nestles on top of the head of its Trainer to show its attachment and affection.

entry: DNA与液体身体都不稳定，因此常见POKENAME像一滩水般干瘪地躺在地上。训练家们给它起了个俗称：“傻水洼”。
author: beatdoof
source: Due to the instability of its DNA and liquid-based body, POKENAME is often seen lying dried out on the ground like a puddle. Trainers colloquially referred to it as “Silly Puddle”.

entry: POKENAME滑溜溜的胶质身体，能钻进各种狭窄空间，尽情探索。它沿途会留下黏稠、带毛的残迹，幸好一小时内就会消散。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's slick and gelatinous body lets it slide itself into a variety of tight spaces it enjoys exploring. These explorations leave behind a sticky, furry residue that fortunately dissipates in an hour.

entry: POKENAME毛下的皮肤半透明，摸来冰凉。剃毛后能看见，血管全呈几何雪花状，每只的纹路其实都不相同。
author: bobosmith01
source: Beneath the layer of fur POKENAME possesses is its cool-to-the-touch and semi-translucent skin. If shaved, it is possible to notice that POKENAME's veins all have a geometric snowflake-like structure which, in fact, is unique to each POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME头上的花瓣，象征着进化潜力。某一种花瓣越多，便越接近相应的进化。
author: mistymagius
source: The petals on POKENAME's head symbolizes its evolutionary potential. The more of one type of petal is on its head, the closer it is to evolution.

entry: POKENAME在海滩装成埋在沙里的可爱伊布，引人抚摸。接触后便控制对方，强迫其送来进化石。
author: knilk
source: POKENAME haunts beaches, where it lures unsuspecting victims into petting it by cutely pretending to be an Eevee buried in sand. When they touch it, it takes control of them and forces them to bring it Evolution stones.

entry: POKENAME能自行进化，适应环境。它们释放的孢子本是无害粉末，进化后才会获得新特性。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of spontaneously evolving to adapt to their environment. The spores they produce are a harmless powder that gains new properties once they evolve.

entry: POKENAME的毛皮混有碎石。它们对训练家极其忠诚。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME have a coat is a mix of rubble and fur. They are known to be intensely loyal to their Trainers.

entry: POKENAME鬃毛上的石头代表想进化的形态。通常很犹豫，只有一种石头的个体十分罕见。
author: teatedtiten
source: The stones on POKENAME's mane represent what evolution the Pokémon wants to become. They are usually indecisive, so finding one with only a single type of stone is rare.

entry: POKENAME是适应力极强的表演者，尚未找到适合自己的固定风格。它们极其友善，乐意为任何粉丝献唱，也让许多粉丝产生了单方面的亲近感。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME is a highly adaptive performer that has yet to find a specific style that suits them. They are incredibly friendly and will gladly sing for any fan, many of whom form parasocial relationships.

entry: POKENAME唱功极为全面，从歌剧咏叹调到死亡金属的嘶吼都能娴熟驾驭。连本来无法以肉身唱出的合成人声，它也能模仿。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME is an extremely versatile vocalist, capable of singing everything from operatic arias to death-metal growls with great skill. It can even match synthetic vocals that are otherwise impossible to physically sing.

entry: POKENAME拥有无限音乐潜力，能配合许多种音乐和声，每种都有各自的深度与意义。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are full of limitless musical potential. They can harmonize with many types of music, each with their own depth and meaning.

entry: POKENAME是温柔的伙伴，能放出新月形的光环，蕴含舒缓的月亮能量。不安的夜里，它们将温暖如星光的光芒裹住焦虑的人，让对方安然入梦。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME are gentle companions that release a glowing, crescent ring of soothing lunar energy. On restless nights, they wrap this warm, starry light around anxious people to ensure they have peaceful dreams.

entry: 满月照耀时，POKENAME的光环会受到月光折射，不稳定的DNA随之激活。于是，它能短暂同时具现所有可能进化形态的元素，组成旋转环绕的护盾。
author: ambrosia04
source: When exposed to the full moon, POKENAME's rings are refracted by lunar light, and its unstable DNA is activated. This allows them to temporarily manifest the elements of all their potential evolutions at once in a swirling orbital shield.

entry: POKENAME能通过进化迅速适应环境。进化时，背上的蘑菇也会发生显著变化。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of rapidly adapting to their environment through evolution. The mushroom on their backs also goes through significant changes when they evolve.

entry: POKENAME的岩石身体会形成多种进化石，因此常被矿工寻找，变得十分难寻踪迹。
author: santon5512
source: Many different types of Evolution Stones form from POKENAME's rocky bodies. Because of this, they are commonly sought out by miners, making them highly elusive.

entry: POKENAME性情温和，毛又柔软，深受孩子喜爱。最喜欢它的哪种进化形态，是校园里常聊的话题，有时甚至成为交朋友的契机。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are very popular with children as it has a very gentle temperament and soft fur. One's favourite POKENAME evolution is a popular topic of conversation in schoolyards, sometimes forming the basis of friendships.

entry: POKENAME的甜香会引来伊布。许多伊布很喜欢这味道，会趴在它长着真菌的背上休息。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a sweet scent that draws Eevee towards them. Many Eevee find the scent pleasant and will rest atop the fungal backs of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME常拿不准该进化成什么。靠近能使自己进化的石头时，杖上的水晶便会变色；色调越浓，它就越受那颗石头吸引。
author: thordemidgard
source: POKENAME are often unsure about what they should evolve into. Whenever they are near a stone that can evolve them, the crystal on their staffs changes color. The more intense its hue, the more an POKENAME feels drawn towards that stone.

entry: 只要有伊布靠近，POKENAME就会预测对方会变成火伊布、水伊布还是雷伊布。若最后三者都不是，它便困惑又沮丧。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: If any Eevee approaches POKENAME, it will predict whether the Eevee will become a Flareon, Vaporeon, or Jolteon. If the Eevee evolves into none of those options, POKENAME becomes confused and dejected.

entry: POKENAME像“伊布松饼”一样松软，枕头般的身体，味道与口感都像那道美味甜品。它们喜欢在咖啡馆工作，既能卖萌，又能把美食送给训练家与宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are as soft and plush as Fluffy Eevee Pancakes, their pillowy bodies resembling the taste and texture of the delicious dessert. They enjoy working in cafes because they get to act cute and give delicious food to Trainers and Pokémon alike.

entry: POKENAME总是好斗，很难训练，只有随意找个表面用头撞一撞，才会温和些。临近进化，或靠近进化石时，它松垂的毛都会变色。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME is hard to train due to its constant aggression, only mellowed out by headbutting a random surface. The color of its saggy fur changes as it either approaches evolution or comes into proximity with an evolution stone.

entry: POKENAME精力旺盛，基因却也同样不稳定，颇受富裕训练家欢迎。把彩色石头磨碎喂它，能使它变色，甚至进化。
author: gronkissimo
source: A Pokémon as energetic as it is genetically unstable, POKENAME is quite popular amongst wealthy Trainers. Colored stones are ground up and fed to it, changing its color or even causing it to evolve.

entry: 野生POKENAME会远行太空，带回多彩的星星碎片。这些碎片本可卖高价，可惜它却拿来当零食吃。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Wild POKENAME make treks into space, returning with multi-colored Star Pieces. These pieces sell for high prices, but unfortunately, POKENAME eats them as snacks.

entry: POKENAME头上的透明石英水晶，将光折射成彩虹。它会兴冲冲地扑向自己造出的彩虹。
author: hophoppip
source: The clear quartz crystals on POKENAME's head refract light into rainbows. POKENAME eagerly pounces on the rainbows it creates.

entry: 挖洞时，POKENAME刻意避开元素石，以免发生不想要的进化。苦恼时，它又会主动找一颗，强迫自己改变。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME deliberately avoids elemental stones while digging to prevent unwanted evolution. When distressed, it will seek one out to force the change.

entry: POKENAME很难决定进化后想成为什么，有些甚至不确定自己想不想进化。对进化后果无休止的担忧，让它们患上慢性偏头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a difficult time choosing what they want to be after evolving, and some doubt they want to evolve at all. This constant worry about the consequences of evolution gives them a chronic migraine.

entry: POKENAME游泳出色，能在水下完成复杂动作。许多个体会寻找进化石，更好地适应环境。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are superb swimmers that can perform complex maneuvers while underwater. Many POKENAME look for evolution stones so that they can better adapt to their environment.

entry: POKENAME爱玩，尤其爱玩用吐息加热的石头。但别让它玩进化石，除非你准备好迎接惊喜！
author: ayutac
source: POKENAME loves to play, especially with stones it heats up with its breath. Don't let it play with evolutionary stones though, unless you are in for a surprise!

entry: POKENAME是彬彬有礼的宠物，在公共场合总遵守社交礼仪。它们易于训练，对孩子又温柔，深受富裕家长喜爱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are well-mannered pets that always follow social etiquette while out in public. They are popular among wealthy parents because they are easy to train and are gentle with children.

entry: POKENAME瞬间移动越频繁，基因就越不稳定。不过，只要睡上很长一觉，身体便能慢慢稳定基因。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's genes become more unstable the more frequently it teleports around. However, with very long naps, its body can slowly work to stabilize its genes.

entry: POKENAME用念力随身带着进化石。把其中一颗置于额前，就能让精神力量得到元素加持。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses telekinesis to carry evolutionary stones with it at all times. When it places one over its forehead, it gains an elemental boost to its psychic powers.

entry: 常见POKENAME用念力带着各种进化石。科学家认为，它们拿不准想进化成什么，选择太多而无法行动，才一直带着石头。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are commonly found carrying various evolution stones in their telekinesis. Scientists believe POKENAME carry these stones around because they are conflicted on what they want to evolve into and are paralyzed by the choices.

entry: 大学越来越多地请POKENAME帮助刚入学的新生。它们友善而体贴，能缓解学生的焦虑，还用壮实体格震慑欺凌者。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Universities have been using POKENAME more and more to help incoming freshman students. POKENAME ease students' anxiety with their friendly and attentive disposition, and use their bulk to deter any bullying.

entry: 野生POKENAME爱收集各种进化石，留在身边，却始终决定不了该用哪颗。
author: whiteupgrade
source: Wild POKENAME likes to collect various kinds of evolution stones that it keeps close to it. However, it can never decide which one it should use.

entry: POKENAME钻入地下，寻找进化石大吃。它讨厌月之石、日之石、光之石、觉醒之石与暗之石的味道。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME digs through the ground, scavenging for evolutionary stones to feast on. It despises the taste of Moon Stones, Sun Stones, Shiny Stones, Dawn Stones, and Dusk Stones.

entry: POKENAME的甲壳以坚实岩石为底，上铺各种进化石。若甲壳裂开，这只宝可梦就可能进化。
author: toxicrown
source: POKENAME's armor is crafted with a layer of various Evolution stones placed atop a layer of solid stone. If the armor cracks, this Pokémon may evolve.

entry: POKENAME相当脆弱，爱在开阔原野上开心地小跑。它们对各种进化石反应各异，最明显的是火之石：靠得越近，火焰就越大。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are rather frail Pokémon that happily trot around open fields. They all react differently to various evolutionary stones, though the most noticeable reaction is to a Fire Stone as their flames will grow larger the closer they are to one.

entry: POKENAME浓密柔软的长毛，小跑时自在飘扬，常被误当成火焰。靠近某些进化石，毛的颜色、质地，或两者都会改变。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's thick, soft fur grows so long and flows so freely as it trots that many mistake the hair for flames. Certain evolutionary stones cause its fur to change as it draws nearer to them, be it in color, texture, or both.

entry: POKENAME常装作不寂寞，神情平静地望着远方。尽管如此，它仍默默寻求陪伴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME often pretends not to be lonely, gazing off into the distance with a calm demeanor. Despite this act, it seeks companionship quietly.

entry: POKENAME放出强大电波，似乎让即将进化或刚进化的宝可梦十分不安。有人推测，强大的个体甚至能违背附近宝可梦的意愿，迫使其进化。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME generates powerful radio waves that seem to greatly upset Pokémon that are on the verge of evolving, or those that have recently evolved. Some have speculated that a powerful POKENAME could force nearby Pokémon to evolve against their will.

entry: 融合产生的副作用，让伊布部分遗传密码突变，因此，两颗头分别近似伊布的两种进化形态。
author: cascadeguy
source: The fusion process has mutated some of Eevee's genetic code as a side effect. Due to this, its heads resemble two of Eevee's evolutions.

entry: POKENAME的几颗头，偶尔会显出伊布三种进化形态的能力，可威力，就没那么出色了。
author: cascadeguy
source: The heads of POKENAME occasionally display abilities from three of Eevee's evolutions. However, the potency of these abilities is not as impressive.

entry: POKENAME的毛会适应潜入的水域，既保暖又顺滑，让它轻松游过深水。回到陆地，毛很快就会干，再度温暖蓬松。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's fur adapts to the water it dives into, keeping it warm and sleek to swim through the depths with ease. It dries out quickly once it breaches back onto land, becoming warm and fluffy once more.

entry: POKENAME身上带条纹的污泥，其实是一种伪装。有时，它只吃掉进化石放出的辐射，却不进化。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's striped sludge is actually a method of camouflage. Sometimes, it will eat the radiation from an evolution stone instead of evolving.

entry: POKENAME由污泥构成，踏过青草和植物，会留下有毒残迹。吃下这些残迹，会使喉咙发痒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are made of a sludge that leaves behind a poisonous residue on grass and any plants they trample. This residue is known to cause an itchiness in the throat when consumed.

entry: POKENAME由多种气体构成，深受不稳定DNA影响。身体闪烁多种色彩，在野外常被认成其他宝可梦。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME's body is comprised of an array of gases that are heavily altered by their unstable DNA. They flicker many colors and in the wild are frequently confused for other Pokémon.

entry: 随环境不同，POKENAME的气息会渐渐形成不同的元素特征。它选定一处住家，纠缠其中住户时，幽灵力量的表现方式也会受这些变化影响。
author: sk372
source: Depending on the surroundings, POKENAME's aura will develop different elemental features over time. These changes also affect how its ghostly powers manifest as it haunts those living in its chosen home.

entry: 它虽在地下掘洞生活，身体其实覆着柔软的毛。嵌在皮肤中的进化石常会脱落，使POKENAME的巢区成为宝石商争相寻找的地方。
author: zephyr.txt
source: Despite its lifestyle of tunneling underground, its body is actually covered in a soft layer of fur. The evolution stones embedded within its skin often become dislodged, making POKENAME nesting grounds a highly sought-after location by gem traders.

entry: POKENAME创造以进化为主题的梦，让做梦者看见完全进化后的生活，缓解他们对进化的种种忧虑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME create dreams that revolve around evolution. They ease the many worries dreamers have about evolution by showing what life would look like fully evolved.

entry: POKENAME催眠周围宝可梦，使其入睡，再送上关于未来的美梦。梦中常出现做梦者英勇不凡的壮举，展现每只宝可梦无限的潜力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hypnotize other Pokémon around them to lull them asleep before giving them sweet dreams of the future. The dreams often explore the limitless potential every Pokémon has by showing dreamers great feats of heroism.

entry: 每只POKENAME对吃哪种梦都很挑剔。它最爱的梦，反映了自己未来想成为什么。
author: petratheangel
source: Each POKENAME is very particular about what type of dream it will feed on. Its favorite is reflective of what it wants to be in the future.

entry: POKENAME的腿尚未完全适应水中生活，主要靠强尾推进。对人类十分友善，甚至专门上岸陪人玩。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's legs haven't quite adapted to aquatic conditions so it relies on its powerful tail to propel itself through the water. They are quite friendly to humans and will come to shore just to play with them.

entry: 河流与小池塘中，常能发现POKENAME，也因此，常被人拿来作鱼饵。
author: kitarchen
source: POKENAME are well known to be spotted in rivers or small ponds. This has led to them being used commonly as fishing bait.

entry: 这只宝可梦喜欢沿湖底、河底和海底滚动，借动作产生静电。因此，海带养殖者与渔人常把POKENAME当成祸害。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: This Pokémon generates static electricity through its movement as it likes to roll along the bottom of lakes, rivers, and oceans alike. Due to this, POKENAME is often considered a menace to kelp farmers and fishermen.

entry: POKENAME不必再靠滚动积蓄静电，而能借水流经过身体的动作发电。尽管如此，它们仍爱在海底滚来滚去，用静电电击造出气泡。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME no longer has to roll to collect static electricity, instead generating electricity through the movement of water currents over its body. Despite this, they enjoy rolling on sea floors and creating bubbles with a static shock.

entry: POKENAME制作骨头三叉戟，使本已强大的狩猎本领更加出色。它在水中高速游动，刺中大鱼，偶尔连低飞的鸟也成为盘中餐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fashions a trident made of bone to accentuate its already potent hunting capabilities. Swimming at high speeds through water, it spears large fish and even the occasional low-flying avian for its meals.

entry: POKENAME身上众多孔洞会不断冒出大量气泡。气泡无害，有些人甚至觉得好看，但一破就会散出刺鼻气味。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body regularly puts out a copious amount of bubbles from its many pores. Though harmless and even aesthetically pleasing to some, the bubbles release a pungent scent when popped.

entry: POKENAME有独特的适应本领，能潜游水下，避开飞行属性捕食者的注意。坚固的茧，也让水属性捕食者难以吃掉它。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a unique adaptation where they can swim underwater to avoid detection from Flying-type predators. Water-type predators also struggle to eat POKENAME because of their sturdy cocoon.

entry: 察觉浓重烟气时，POKENAME身体的一部分会探出来，放出薄雾净化空气。禁烟宣传常用它当吉祥物。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When POKENAME senses heavy smoking, part of it will emerge from its body, emitting a mist to clear the air. Anti-smoking campaigns often use it as their mascot.

entry: 看似纤细的翅膀，其实是带蹼的鳍，能推动水中游动。可鳍太重，离水后便难以飞行。
author: mistymagius
source: This Pokémon's delicate wings are actually webbed fins that allow it to propel itself through the water. However, it struggles to fly outside of the water because of the weight of these fins.

entry: POKENAME的宝石核心形似水之石，骗过许多寻找珍贵石头的潜水者。碰触核心会引起轻微头痛与健忘，科学家认为，这是它吓退威胁的方式。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's jewel core resembles a Water Stone, fooling many divers that search for the precious stones. Touching their core causes a mild headache and forgetfulness, which scientists believe is POKENAME's way of deterring threats.

entry: POKENAME凭默剧本领造出隐形水桶，再从空气取水装满。若仍不能打动观众，它就把前排浇个透湿。
author: .jerden
source: Through the power of mime, POKENAME can create invisible buckets, then fill them using water drawn from the air. If this fails to impress its audience, it will drench the front row.

entry: POKENAME把身后三条尾巴像螺旋桨般旋转，便能高速游动。若额前宝石被碰，它会变得极具攻击性。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can swim at high speeds by twirling its three tails behind it akin to a propeller. It gets extremely aggressive if the jewel on its forehead is touched.

entry: POKENAME会进入湖泊与河流，吃水面下的藻类。它们只能短时间游泳，恰好够把一片藻拖回岸上。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME make their way into lakes and rivers to eat seaweed beneath the water's surface. They are capable of swimming for short periods of time, which is just enough to drag a piece of seaweed back to shore.

entry: 游泳本领出色，又有不知疲倦的耐心，使它成为救生员营救遇险泳客的可靠助手。准备放出强大的水属性攻击时，它的壳便开始冒出彻骨寒雾。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its exceptional swimming ability and tireless patience have made it a reliable assistant to lifeguards rescuing swimmers in distress. When it is about to unleash one of its powerful Water-type attacks, its shell begins to emit a cold, chilling mist.

entry: POKENAME长出了能在水中快速游动的身体，却没有长期潜水所需的鳃。它最多潜水30分钟，就必须换气。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME developed a body that allows it to swim swiftly through the water, but lacks the gills needed to remain underwater. It can only remain underwater for 30 minutes before requiring air.

entry: POKENAME紧张时，平时顺滑的毛就会竖起变硬。它先喷水浇透进犯者，再从毛中放电电击对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's normally smooth fur bristles out and stiffens when it becomes tense. It soaks aggressors with a stream of spat-out water, before jolting them with electricity shot out from its fur.

entry: POKENAME体内的火焰囊，能把生成并喷出的水加热到极高温。战斗中，它可喷射沸水或阵阵灼热蒸汽，使敌人严重烫伤。
author: sk372
source: The flame sac within POKENAME's body allows it to super-heat any water it produces and expels. In battle, it can fire boiling hot water or bursts of scalding steam to leave foes badly burnt.

entry: POKENAME摄入大量数据后，会产出极其纯净的水。有些饮料工厂靠它改善风味。
author: .izik
source: After consuming vast quantities of data, POKENAME produces exceptionally pure water. Some beverage factories rely on it to enhance flavor.

entry: POKENAME通常挂在树枝上，若掉下来，也有巧妙的后备办法。它们一路滚到水边，沉入水底，便有了进化前的好藏身处。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME typically hang from tree branches but have a cunning alternative if they fall from the branches. They roll around until they find a body of water and sink to the bottom, giving them a good hiding place until they evolve.

entry: POKENAME入水便会隐形，只有万里无云的晴天才能看见。若在一处待太久，它召来的大量雨水就会引发洪灾。
author: soup1900
source: Since POKENAME turns invisible when in water, it can only be spotted on clear, sunny days where clouds have fully dissipated. If it sits in a single spot for too long, the large amounts of rain it can summon cause torrential flooding.

entry: 鳃让POKENAME能一直待在水下，光滑流线的身体则助它快速游动。不到一天，它就能从海洋这头游到另一头。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's gills let it stay underwater indefinitely, and its body is smooth and streamlined for quick swimming. It could swim from one end of the ocean to the other in less than a day.

entry: POKENAME制造漂浮气泡，威慑闯入领地的对象。气泡由腐蚀性毒液构成，破裂后会黏在毛发与羽毛上。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce bubbles that float and act as a deterrent for anyone who wanders into their territory. The bubbles are made of a caustic venom that clings to fur and feathers when popped.

entry: POKENAME喜欢独处，用大气泡围住自己。泡中充满精神能量，无论近身打击还是飞射攻击，都能反弹。
author: sk372
source: Preferring to remain in solitude, POKENAME surrounds itself with large bubbles. These bubbles are brimming with psychic energy, and reflect all manner of attacks, be they physical or projectile.

entry: POKENAME虽能仿佛“融化”般藏进水里，却太好奇，总忍不住接近别人。它们会开心地靠近孩子，吹泡泡一起玩。
author: infinex21
source: Although POKENAME can hide in water by seemingly "melting away," they are too curious to not try and approach others. They will happily approach children and create bubbles to play with them, however.

entry: POKENAME的细胞结构灵活，能改变自身，提高所用任何攻击的效能。它习惯让所在的水也变得隐形，使水中生物看似在空中飘游。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's cellular structure is flexible, being able to change to boost the efficiency of any attack it uses. POKENAME has a habit of making the water it's in turn invisible, making the wildlife within look as if they're floating through the air.

entry: POKENAME把游泳时吸收的水排出，在背上形成小喷泉。它们还能把水温升至沸腾。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME create miniature fountains along their backs by expelling the water they absorb while swimming. They have the ability to raise the temperature of the water to the point of being boiling hot.

entry: POKENAME锯状肢体产出的腐蚀性毒液，会侵蚀活物。若锯子被黏住，它们便喷水润滑，继续锯倒敌人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a caustic venom from their saw-like limbs that eats away at living matter. If their saws get gummed up, they spray water to lubricate the saws so they can keep cutting down foes.

entry: 雨刚下过，常能见到野生POKENAME在水洼玩水。这种鸟宝可梦飞得太高就会干燥，因此通常只飞到刚能越过树木的高度。
author: infinex21
source: It is common to see wild POKENAME splashing about in puddles after fresh rain. These bird Pokémon dry out if they fly too high, so they typically fly only high enough to pass over trees.

entry: POKENAME动作敏捷，协调出色，是游泳的好手。休息时，常仰着身子，漂在水面。
author: vaporvenator
source: Remarkable agility and coordination makes POKENAME an expert swimmer. They can be observed resting on their backs, floating atop the water's surface.

entry: POKENAME是高效的水中猎手。它们的网在水下完全隐形，敏感得连一滴水都能察觉，用来困住猎物。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME are highly efficient aquatic predators. Their webbing completely vanishes under the water, and these webs are so sensitive they can detect even single water drops. They are used to trap prey.

entry: POKENAME用四片翼状鳍推动身体，在海中高速游动。它虽能跃出水面，在浪上飞行以躲避捕食者，却很快就累，必须回海里休息。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's four wing-like fins drive it through the ocean with great speed. While it can leap out of the water and fly above the waves to escape predators, it will quickly tire and must return to the sea to rest.

entry: POKENAME在最靠近淡水源的地方筑巢，捕食其中栖居的水生宝可梦。它能用翅膀与尾巴游泳，猎物藏得再深也够得着。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME builds its nest closest to a source of fresh water and preys on the aquatic Pokémon denizen of that source. It can swim using its wings and tail, so no prey is ever too deep for it to reach.

entry: POKENAME的触角，有时能触发进化。找不到水之石的野生水宝可梦，就能得到它的帮助。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's antennae can sometimes trigger evolution. It helps wild Water-types who can't seem to find their own Water Stones.

entry: POKENAME常在沼泽地跳来跳去，啄地寻找坚果或种子。它们通过一同在水洼玩水、洗去爪上泥巴来交往。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME are often found hopping around marshlands, pecking at the ground for nuts or seeds. They socialize with others by splashing in puddles of water and cleaning mud off their talons together.

entry: POKENAME的羊毛其实由带电水蒸气构成，因此外观如云。生气时，蓬松的外层会变暗，如暴风雨云一般。
author: henry9000
source: POKENAME's wool is actually composed of electrified water vapor, giving it a cloud-like appearance. When POKENAME gets angry, its fluffy exterior becomes dark and stormy.

entry: 与多数羊毛不同，POKENAME的毛不吸水，能使它们在水中轻易浮起。开心时，它会运转电力，让尾部水晶发光。
author: infinex21
source: Unlike most wools, POKENAME wool is not absorbent. Their wool makes them rather buoyant in water. A happy POKENAME will release light from its tail crystal by channeling its electricity.

entry: POKENAME运用静电，展开颈部褶边，就能浮在水中，头露水面。不过，它其实很会游泳，还会用电捕猎水生宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: By channeling its static charge, POKENAME can expand its neck frill, which lets it float in water with its head above the surface. It can swim quite well, mind you, and will use its electricity to hunt aquatic Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用电力使水晶发光，在深水与黑暗洞穴中辨路。游泳者与海洋探险者，都常以它们为伙伴。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their electricity to emit light from their crystals so they can navigate deep waters and dark caves. They are common partners for Swimmers and ocean explorers alike.

entry: POKENAME颈部一圈褶状鬃毛，充电后能明亮发光。投出的光束近乎耀眼得让人睁不开眼，划破漆黑的夜色。
author: sk372
source: The frilly mane circling POKENAME's neck can be charged up with electricity to glow brightly. The beams of light its mane casts cut through the pitch black darkness of night with almost blinding intensity.

entry: POKENAME的求雨格外有效，能迅速召来大量洁净雨水，使周边植物恢复生机。许多饲主用它照料私家花园。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's Rain Dance is noted to be highly effective, quickly summoning torrents of clean water to revitalize the plant life around it. Many owners use it to help maintain personal gardens.

entry: POKENAME不喝水，而通过皮肤孔洞吸收。吸收的水不同，体色也可能略有变化。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME doesn't drink water, instead it absorbs it through the pores in its skin. POKENAME's color can change very slightly depending on what water it absorbs.

entry: POKENAME不喝水，而通过皮肤孔洞吸收。吸收的水不同，体色也可能略有变化。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME doesn't drink water, instead it absorbs it through the pores in its skin. POKENAME's color can change very slightly depending on what water it absorbs.

entry: POKENAME究竟属于鸟还是鱼，至今仍有争论。因为它们在湖中筑巢休息，白天却又高飞天际。羽毛与鳞片沾湿后，会美丽地闪耀。
author: infinex21
source: There is ongoing debate if POKENAME are bird or fish Pokémon. This debate was born from the fact that POKENAME nest and rest within lakes, yet will fly high in the sky throughout the day. Their feathers and scales glisten beautifully when wet.

entry: POKENAME腹部有个小袋，用来携带幼崽。它天性温和，与人类关系亲密。不照顾后代时，它也乐意帮忙，把港口邮件稳妥放在袋中递送。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: There is a small pouch on POKENAME's stomach that it uses to carry its young. Known for its gentle nature, it forms close bonds with humans. When not caring for offspring, it gladly helps by delivering Harbor Mail tucked safely in its pouch.

entry: POKENAME利用水面振动预测未来，但据说只能预见恶劣的天气变化。它们常潜入深水隐去身形，躲避自己预见的风暴。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME utilize vibrations on the surface of water to predict the future, however they are said to only be able to predict terrible weather changes. They will often dive deep into the water and vanish to hide from the storms they predict.

entry: POKENAME在水面下完全隐形。若与其他超能力属性宝可梦一起接受适当训练，它们便常能借周身水流，预测日后的猎物、可能出现的捕食者及天气变化。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME are completely invisible under the surface of the water. They frequently use the currents around them to predict future prey, possible predators, and weather patterns if trained properly around fellow psychic types.

entry: POKENAME住在湖底最深处，用诱饵状的器官，吸引小鱼。其余身体，则轻松藏进幽暗的水里。
author: crypticanexe
source: Living in the deepest parts of lakes, POKENAME uses its esca to lure in smaller fish. It easily camouflages the rest of its body in the dark waters.

entry: POKENAME是水下寻宝人的好伙伴，会潜到最深处，寻找一切闪亮的东西。它们虽小，即使有成年人抓着尾巴，也能游得很快。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are an underwater treasure hunter's best friend, for these Pokémon will dive to the deepest depths in search of anything that sparkles. Despite their small size, they can swim fast even with adult humans holding onto their tails.

entry: POKENAME牙齿锋利，鱼鳍仿佛人鱼。它们常组成庞大家族，这也很有帮助，因为它们能操控水蒸气与雾中的水，制造降雨。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME have very sharp teeth and mermaid-like fins. They tend to be in large family groups; however, this is very helpful as they can create rain by controlling water from water vapor and fog.

entry: POKENAME背上的花有两重用处：靠近水面时，能帮它伪装，还能通过光合作用，提供养分。
author: melodydelune
source: The flower on POKENAME's back serves two purposes: it helps it blend in when near the surface, and it provides nutrients through photosynthesis.

entry: POKENAME游泳出色，沿河觅食。把尾巴像螺旋桨般旋转，它们就能在水中高速前进。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are excellent swimmers, swimming through rivers in search of food. By spinning their tails like a propeller, they can move through the water at high speeds.

entry: 小巧身体与宽大鱼鳍，让POKENAME善于游泳，能跟上海上的渔船。它们吹出字母、符号形状的气泡，与渔人交流，讨要食物。
author: santon5512
source: Their small size and large fins make POKENAME excellent swimmers, allowing them to keep up with fishing boats out at sea. POKENAME use bubbles in the shape of letters and symbols to communicate with fishers, asking them for food.

entry: POKENAME自古就是神秘学者与占星师的伙伴。满月之夜，它们成群聚在平静水域，仰望星空。
author: ozydamians
source: POKENAME has long been the partner of mystics and astrologers. On nights with full moons, schools of POKENAME gather in calm bodies of water and watch the starry skies above.

entry: POKENAME钻入水下松软的淤泥，藏身待猎。由于细胞结构特殊，身体一沾水，便半透明起来。
author: blitzydragon
source: POKENAME will dig into loose silt underwater to hide and wait for prey. Because of its cell structure its body becomes translucent when wet.

entry: POKENAME掘地寻找地下水，带回自己的巢穴。在沙漠里，这样的活动，最终会形成滋养新生命的绿洲。
author: vaporvenator
source: POKENAME dig in search for groundwater to bring back to their nests. In deserts, this activity ends up forming oases for new life to thrive in.

entry: POKENAME在桑拿房很受欢迎，待在房间中央享受热气，浇上水就会咕噜咕噜地欢叫。它们维持着稳定高温，接触的水很快就会蒸发。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular Pokémon at saunas, basking in the centre of the room and giving burbling, delighted cries when water is poured over them. Their bodies maintain a high, steady temperature, quickly vaporising any water they make contact with.

entry: POKENAME在沼泽里跋涉，毫不在意长毛弄得多脏。它食量惊人，会用獠牙在泥中掘食。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME trudges around swamps, not caring how dirty its shaggy coat gets. A voracious eater, POKENAME uses its tusks to dig for food in the mud.

entry: POKENAME生活在珊瑚礁边缘，尤其常见于南方海域。身体入水往往隐去，但只要寻找它们开心时造出的大气泡柱，就很容易发现。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME live on the outskirts of coral reefs, especially in the southern seas. Their bodies tend to vanish under the water, but they can be found easily by searching for large towers of bubbles they produce when happy.

entry: 水手常把看见POKENAME视为灾祸之兆。它们煮沸猎物周边的海水来狩猎，毛上分泌的油又极易燃烧，导致常出没水域的船上火灾增多。
author: ghostslythe
source: Sailors often consider a sighting of POKENAME to be an omen of doom. They hunt by boiling ocean water around their prey, and the oil given off their fur is highly combustible. This has caused an increase in shipboard fires in waters they frequent.

entry: 许多水族馆开始聘用POKENAME当助手。它似乎天生就了解多数水生生物的一切习惯与需求，能大大帮助馆方妥善照护。
author: sk372
source: Many aquariums are beginning to staff POKENAME as assistants. It seems to intrinsically know all the habits and needs of a majority of aquatic creatures, making it very helpful in ensuring proper care-taking is observed.

entry: POKENAME对人类活动很感兴趣，喜欢轻轻啃咬物品，探索周围世界。力道通常很轻，不会伤人。
author: vaporvenator
source: POKENAME are intrigued by human activities. They explore the world around them by nibbling things, often too softly to cause harm to others.

entry: POKENAME是湖泊与池塘中的危险宝可梦。它们能仿佛融化般隐入水中，让靠水边太近的猎物或敌人措手不及。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are dangerous Pokémon that live within lakes and ponds. They can effectively melt away and become invisible in water, thus allowing them to catch any prey or foe off guard if they draw too near to the water's edge.

entry: POKENAME若未补足水分，产出的奶就会酸败。它爱用长尾，将物体从水中弹出来。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME does not stay properly hydrated, the milk it produces turns rancid. It enjoys bouncing objects out of the water using its long tail.

entry: 这种大型水生宝可梦在风暴肆虐的海中生机勃勃。生气时，它会掀起巨浪，因此令水手畏惧。
author: hophoppip
source: This large aquatic Pokémon thrives in stormy seas. When it's angered, it conjures immense waves, so it is feared by sailors.

entry: 这种宝可梦能在水中隐形，人们花了多年才记录到它。有人往湖里倾倒废物时，它才现身，攻击肇事者，随后净化湖水。
author: infinex21
source: It took years to document this Pokémon due to its ability to turn invisible within water. It revealed itself when waste was thrown into its lake, to which it lashed out at those responsible and proceeded to purify the water.

entry: POKENAME住在瀑布附近，爱在飞溅水花中玩耍。为吸引异性，它们试着吹出尽可能大的气泡。
author: spagalapof
source: POKENAME lives near waterfalls and enjoys playing in the spray. To attract the opposite gender, they try to blow the biggest bubbles possible.

entry: POKENAME体内的细胞近似蓝藻。浸在清水中时，它能够进行光合作用。
author: .jerden
source: The cells in POKENAME's body are similar to blue-green algae. When immersed in clear water, it is capable of photosynthesis.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，将自己埋在河床附近的泥中。它放出的气息，会使周围植物加速生长。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME buries itself in the mud near riverbeds while sleeping. It releases an aura that causes surrounding plants to grow at an accelerated rate.

entry: POKENAME的身体由水蒸气与海草构成，却无法在水下生活，会迁往浅湖捕猎。体内会长出花苞与石头。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: POKENAME's body is made of water vapour and seagrass. Despite this, it cannot live underwater and migrates to shallow lakes to hunt. It grows flower buds and stones within its body.

entry: POKENAME能随意冻结周围的水，或让其融化。它不太会游泳，因此更爱把爪下的水冻住，在上面行走。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME can freeze or melt surrounding water at will. It's not a great swimmer, so it prefers freezing water under its paws to walk on it instead.

entry: 无论是否在水里，POKENAME总像在游泳般移动。再怎么弄干，身体也总有些潮湿；碰到体表的水，皮肤会微微发麻。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME always moves as if it was swimming, whether it is in the water or not. Its body is always a bit damp no matter what efforts to dry it are taken; touching the water coating it causes skin to tingle slightly.

entry: POKENAME能将吸收的阳光化为强大能量刃，凝聚在手臂与头上的鳍旁。大尾巴中存着水，使尾巴更重，打击也更有力。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can turn absorbed sunlight into powerful energy blades that form around the fins upon its arms and head. It stores water in its large tail, which makes its tail heavier and harder-hitting.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，火与水并用，各占一半。它既从拳头喷出涌泉般的水流，也踢出强劲的火焰踢击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME mixes fire and water in equal measures in battle. It strikes with geysers of water shot from its fists as well as powerful, flaming kicks.

entry: POKENAME的褶边极其敏感，连无意碰触也会引起不快。它粗长的尾巴挥动起来，足以把成年人打飞30多英尺。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's frill is highly sensitive, with it reacting negatively to even an accidental touch. Its long and thick tail can swing with enough force to send an adult human flying back over 30 feet.

entry: POKENAME操纵周围空气中的水分，造出坚实气泡当护盾。它有些保护过度，旅行时常将自己与训练家一同包在泡中。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can manipulate the moisture in the air around it to create solid bubbles that act as a shield. It often encases itself and its Trainer in these bubbles while traveling, as it is slightly overprotective.

entry: 古代文字将POKENAME记作航船守护者。凡有敌人威胁它庇护的水手，它便掀起巨大风暴，将敌人吞没。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: Ancient writings depict POKENAME as guardians of sailing ships. It raises enormous storms to swallow any enemies who threaten the sailors under its protection.

entry: 野生POKENAME极具攻击性，一见目标就用高压水柱袭击。被收服后，它对训练家会生出危险而不稳定的忠诚，将一切认定的威胁猛烈拖入深海。
author: againanotherone
source: Wild POKENAME are extremely aggressive, attacking on sight with high-pressure water jets. Once caught, it develops a dangerously unstable devotion to its Trainer, violently dragging anyone it perceives as a threat into the ocean depths.

entry: POKENAME除了变色融入环境，还能在水下完全隐形。连锯齿花纹也能藏住，这点与变隐龙及其余变隐龙融合体不同。
author: lydiaprower8
source: In addition of changing colours to blend in with its surroundings, POKENAME can also render itself completely invisible underwater.  Even the zigzag pattern is concealed, where the fusion differs between other Kecleon fusions and the Pokémon itself.

entry: POKENAME伪装成普通喷泉，谁喝它的水，谁就会被附身。鸟宝可梦最常受害；它们借此聚起庞大鸟群，置于POKENAME的共同控制之下。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: Disguised as an ordinary fountain, whoever drinks from POKENAME is possessed. Bird Pokémon are their most frequent victims, using them to amass a large flock under POKENAME's collective control.

entry: 它出众的鳍经深海重压锤炼，游泳时能“切”开水流。更可怕的是，只要慢慢移动，它便能在水中近乎隐形，几乎任何目标都可能遭它伏击。
author: infinex21
source: Its impressive fins have been honed by the crushing depths of the ocean, which allow it to "cut" through water while swimming. It has a horrifying ability to turn nigh invisible in water so long as it moves slowly, so it can ambush nearly any target.

entry: POKENAME体色虽鲜艳，在水中却几乎能完全隐形，因此野外极难发现。它既能靠光自养，也能杂食，即使没有太阳也能获取能量。
author: bobosmith01
source: Despite its body's bright coloration, POKENAME is extremely difficult to find in the wild due to its ability to become virtually invisible in water. It is both a photoautotroph and an omnivore, so it can get its energy even when the sun isn't out.

entry: POKENAME几乎始终待在湖泊或浅海的水面下，似乎觉得流水与拍浪声很舒缓。它会慢慢吃光够得到的水草，再移向下一片。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends almost all of its time below the surface of lakes or shallow seas, and seems to find the sound of flowing water or crashing waves relaxing. It will slowly eat any underwater plants within reach before moving on to the next patch.

entry: POKENAME住在沼泽，在浅水中抚育幼崽。它们身体虽笨重，游泳却很灵巧。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives in marshes, rearing their young in shallow waters. Despite their bulky bodies, POKENAME are adept swimmers.

entry: POKENAME游过湖泊与河流，在湖床播种，使新藻类生长。它爱拍打尾巴，向岸边朋友泼水玩。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME swims through lakes and rivers, planting seeds in the lakebed to grow new algae. Slapping its tail, it enjoys splashing water at its friends along the shore.

entry: 水直接流经POKENAME的身体，它能自由操纵其长度与形状。它爱先以各种刁钻动作戏耍、迷惑对手，再给予决定性一击。
author: sk372
source: Water flows directly across POKENAME's body, of which it can freely manipulate the length and shape. It enjoys toying with and confounding its opponents with various tricky movements before it strikes a decisive blow.

entry: 对准敌人时，POKENAME会射出一股冰冷水流。趁对方仍被寒冷惊住，它便抓住机会攻击。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: When pointed at a foe, POKENAME shoots a jolt of chilling water. While its opponent is still shocked from the cold, it takes the opportunity to strike.

entry: POKENAME目光锐利，能看见海洋最黑暗深处的猎物。一旦双眼闪起金光，猎物就几乎无路可逃。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME's keen vision allows it to see prey in the ocean's darkest depths. Once its eyes gleam gold, there little to no escape.

entry: POKENAME协助潜往深渊研究海床的学者，热切保护潜水器与设备。身体虽庞大，游姿却极其优雅。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME assists researchers who descend into the abyssal depths to study the seabed, zealously protecting their submersibles and equipment. Despite its massive body, it is capable of swimming with absolute elegance.

entry: POKENAME协助潜往深渊研究海床的学者，热切保护潜水器与设备。身体虽庞大，游姿却极其优雅。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME assists researchers who descend into the abyssal depths to study the seabed, zealously protecting their submersibles and equipment. Despite its massive body, it is capable of swimming with absolute elegance.

entry: POKENAME眼上的膜十分耐用，还让它在浑水中也能清楚视物。因此，人们常派它进入受污染水域，寻找生病的宝可梦。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The film that covers POKENAME's eyes is quite durable, as well as granting it perfect vision in murky water. Because of this, POKENAME is often sent into polluted water to find sick Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME游泳出色，能快速绕圈制造巨大漩涡。涡流把小宝可梦卷入，使其成为容易捕获的猎物。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are excellent swimmers, rapidly moving in circles to create large whirlpools. These vortices pull smaller Pokémon inside, making them easy prey.

entry: POKENAME极为稀有，生活在湖底或纯净的岸边。它们只为安抚愤怒的心灵而现身，用声音消解一切敌意。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are incredibly rare, living at the bottom of lakes or at pristine shores. They only appear to calm the minds of those who are enraged, using their voice to disarm all who are hostile.

entry: POKENAME不只在空中快，入水后也能凭尾巴与脸上的鳍，像导弹般向前冲。战斗时，它先升上天空，再从上方射出水柱。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is not just fast in the air; once it enters the water, it can dart forward like a missile thanks to its tail and the fins on its face. When battling, it rises into the sky before firing its water jets from above.

entry: POKENAME栖居丰缘雨林，利用体表水光的反射，显出胆小虫的模样。飞行或超能力属性宝可梦想攻击时，它便喷出沸水，再变回真身。
author: ghostslythe
source: At home in the rainforests of Hoenn, POKENAME uses the reflections off the water of its body to appear as Wimpod. When Flying- or Psychic-types attempt to attack, it shoots boiling water before morphing into its true form.

entry: POKENAME钩住猎物后，便散发出安抚的气息，让对方不再挣扎。
author: melodydelune
source: When POKENAME have hooked their prey, they are filled with a soothing aura that makes it stop struggling against them.

entry: POKENAME强大的尾巴既是武器，也是水下推进的主要依靠。在海床休息时，它能融入周围的水，再突然以尖角攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's powerful tail is both a powerful weapon and its main means of propulsion underwater. When resting on the seabed, it can blend in with the water around it, then suddenly strike with its sharp horn.

entry: 它能侵蚀陆地，指挥潮汐将泥沙带往别处。阳光照上栖居的水面时，POKENAME便开始发光，体温上升，变得灼热通红。
author: bobosmith01
source: It has the power to erode land and direct the tides to carry the sediments elsewhere. When the sun hits the water it calls home, POKENAME begins to glow and its body temperature rises to become red-hot.

entry: 至少有一则神话记载，某只POKENAME住在封闭的海底洞穴深处，唯有古老器物才能唤醒。一旦苏醒，它便引发泥石流，摧毁附近文明。
author: bobosmith01
source: According to at least one myth, a POKENAME lives deep in a sealed underwater cavern and can only be awoken by an ancient artifact. When it awakens, it causes mudslides that destroy nearby civilizations.

entry: POKENAME大多在水下洞穴与峡谷捕猎，偶尔也上岸狩猎。它逼近前唯一的警讯，就是露出水面的一排尖鳍。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of its time hunting for prey in underwater caves and canyons, but occasionally moves onto land to hunt. The only warning of its approach is its row of spiky fins protruding above the surface of the water.

entry: 据说，只有心怀正义者，才能将POKENAME从深海家园引出来。它的手臂能高速射出大量气泡，每颗都带着强烈电力。
author: sk372
source: Only those with righteous hearts are said to be able to draw POKENAME out from its deep undersea home. Its arm can shoot a massive amount of bubbles at high speeds, each one charged with intense amounts of electricity.

entry: POKENAME的大鳍状耳朵与尾巴，让游泳时的轮廓几乎像只风筝。优美外形，使它成为颇受欢迎的融合体。
author: faelocke
source: POKENAME's large, fin-like ears and tail give it an almost kite-like silhouette while swimming. Its beauty makes it quite a popular fusion.

entry: POKENAME从软管喷出肥皂水，可冰冷彻骨，也可滚烫沸腾。它能精确控制水温，放进体内的衣服，洗得比多数洗衣机还干净。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME blasts soapy water out of its hose, which may be freezing cold or boiling hot. Since POKENAME can carefully control its water temperature, it can launder any clothes  placed inside it better than most washing machines.

entry: POKENAME生活在沙漠，淘气爱恶作剧，会假装成水瓶，戏弄疲惫口渴的旅人。
author: acid_pen
source: POKENAME is found in deserts. It is mischievous and likes to play tricks on weary, thirsty travelers by pretending to be a water bottle.

entry: POKENAME的种子萌发后，它便会将其打开，与所有生命分享水，因此，草木鸟兽，都是它的朋友。
author: ladan
source: When a POKENAME's seed sprouts, it will open and share its water with all, making it a friend to flora and fauna alike.

entry: 黑夜里，它摇动灯火，引来猎物。蓝光奇特，见过的很少，能解释自己所见的，更少。
author: wigglypon
source: On dark nights, it waves its lights to attract prey. Its blue glow is unusual; few have witnessed it, and fewer could explain what they'd seen.

entry: POKENAME的身体完全防水，几乎想在水里待多久都行。它们是游泳者与海滩游客的理想伙伴。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is completely waterproof, allowing them to stay in water for a virtually infinite amount of time. They are the perfect partners for swimmers and beachgoers.

entry: POKENAME在河湖附近筑巢，能为追捕水属性宝可梦潜至40英尺深处。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME builds its nests near rivers and lakes. It can dive up to 40 feet in pursuit of Water-type Pokémon.

entry: 游泳时，POKENAME用防水的毛遮住脸，不让水进眼睛。它们改以敏感的鳍代替视觉，感知水流的细微变化来辨路。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME cover their face with their hydrophobic fur while swimming to keep water out of their eyes. They use their sensitive fins to see instead, sensing small changes in the current to navigate.

entry: POKENAME兴冲冲地沿泥岸摇摆前行，寻找自认足够新鲜的居住水域。找到理想地点后，几个头就争着先下水。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME waddle excitedly along muddy banks in search of water they deem fresh enough to live in. When they find the perfect spot, the heads fight over who gets to enter the water first.

entry: POKENAME能把尾巴大幅展开，威吓并驱赶潜在威胁。不理会警告的对象，就得面对它对火与水的强大掌控力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can unfurl its tail wide in order to intimidate and ward off potential threats. Those that don't heed the warning will have to contend with its formidable control over fire and water.

entry: 深夜，POKENAME掠过河流，急拍双翼寻找小猎物。遇险时，它藏入水流，凭敏捷游姿与周围环境融为一体。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME glides over rivers in the dead of night, flapping its wings frantically in search of small prey. When threatened, it hides among the river currents, where it swims with agility and blends perfectly with its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME带着一颗形似水之石的大宝石。据说，看石头太久，会令人产生溺水般的感觉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries with it a large gem similar to a Water Stone. It is said that looking at the stone for too long will cause a person to feel as if they are drowning.

entry: POKENAME十分喜欢水之石，找到就立刻抱住，几小时也不肯放手。它似乎能汲取少许能量，因为松开后会精神旺盛一阵。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite fond of Water Stones, immediately latching onto any it finds and refusing to let go for hours. It seems to draw minute bits of energy from the stone, as it behaves more energetically for a time after releasing it.

entry: POKENAME体内满是净水，平日用带刺的尾巴，小心保护。它要留着这些水，直到准备进化。
author: ladan
source: POKENAME is filled with purified water that it protects with its spiked tail. It will save this water until it's ready to evolve.

entry: POKENAME游泳出色，能变成水，滑过细小裂隙。它们常在深处的水下洞穴，寻找水之石食用。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are excellent swimmers, using their ability to turn into water to slip through small crevices. They are often found in deep underwater caverns, searching for Water Stones to consume.

entry: 背刺让它不适合当坐骑，可驯服的POKENAME偏要人骑上来，载人渡过波浪。若能忍受背刺，这倒是十分宁静的体验。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The spines on its back make it quite a poor mount. However, tamed POKENAME insist that people ride them to ferry across the waves. If you can handle its spines, it's a very serene experience.

entry: POKENAME适应水下狩猎生活，巨颚连着喉部的鳃。上岸后，它口中始终含满水，以免鳃干掉。
author: .jerden
source: Adapted for life as an underwater hunter, POKENAME's large jaws connect to gills in its throat. On land, it keeps its mouth full of water to prevent them from drying out.

entry: POKENAME十分爱游泳，本能地寻找附近最大的水域。找到湖泊或海洋，就助跑跃入，激起巨大波浪。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite fond of swimming, instinctively searching for the largest body of water nearby. It takes running leaps into lakes and oceans it finds, sending out massive waves as it dives in.

entry: 它优雅的舞蹈模仿波浪起伏。大群POKENAME一同跳舞，便能控制潮汐。
author: bostroms
source: Its graceful dancing mimics the motion of waves. Large groups of POKENAME dancing together are able to control the tides.

entry: POKENAME吃下的垃圾，会立刻变成液体身体的一部分。这是高效的废物处理方法，却让它产出的水气味极其刺鼻。
author: sk372
source: Any trash POKENAME consumes is immediately converted into part of its liquid body. This is an effective method of waste disposal, though it causes the water POKENAME generates to have an extremely pungent odor.

entry: POKENAME用强劲触手钻入海床。固定好后，它们开始附身经过的水生宝可梦，常直接将其引向自己等候着的大口。
author: danarchosyndacalist
source: POKENAME use their mighty tentacles to burrow into the sea floor. Once rooted, they begin possessing passing water Pokémon, often leading them straight into the POKENAME's waiting maw.

entry: POKENAME飞得灵巧，游得也同样敏捷。它向湖中俯冲，再潜向猎物，捕食鱼宝可梦。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is a nimble flier and an equally nimble swimmer. It catches fish Pokémon by swooping down into lakes and diving towards the prey.

entry: 这些宝可梦常住在湖泊与池塘旁的洞穴，尤其偏爱潮湿洞穴。它们能在水下呼吸，因此可以一直伏候，直到猎物出现。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon often dwell in caves near lakes and ponds, especially if those caves are damp. They can breathe underwater, allowing them to lie in wait for prey for however long it takes.

entry: POKENAME分泌肥皂状物质，制成泡沫翅膀。翅膀不仅极其柔软，还能带来最棒的泡泡浴。
author: elibromax314
source: POKENAME secretes a soap-like substance to create bubbly wings. Not only are POKENAME's wings incredibly soft, but they also make the best bubble baths.

entry: 这些宝可梦能召雨，让覆鳞的皮肤保持湿润，恢复能量。POKENAME十分温柔，能在旱灾中帮助庄稼恢复生机，深受人类与宝可梦喜爱。
author: keiracm35_
source: These Pokémon can summon rain to keep their scaly skin hydrated and restore energy. POKENAME are very gentle and loved by humans and Pokémon, as their powers help revive crops during droughts.

entry: POKENAME大多待在水下，仅凭存在就能使水降温。遇险时，它能瞬间冻结整片水域。即使水已结冰，它仍能在冰中自由移动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends most of its time underwater, cooling the temperature of the liquid with its mere presence. In times of danger, it can flash freeze the entire body of water. Even when water is frozen, it can move freely through the ice.

entry: POKENAME在背部球状蘑菇中储存孢子。孢子释放后，一接触空气就化为浓稠凝胶，使身体十分滑溜，捕食者更难抓住。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME store spores in the bulbous mushrooms on their back. When they are released and make contact with the air, the spores turn into a viscous gel that makes them very slippery. This makes POKENAME much harder for predators to grab onto.

entry: POKENAME曾为新世纪音乐带来灵感，喜欢用气泡表演，营造戏剧性场面。能完全融入水中的本领，让它们忽隐忽现。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME has been known for inspiring new age music and loves to perform with bubbles to create dramatic displays. The ability to blend in entirely with water allows them to appear and disappear.

entry: POKENAME擅长用哀歌唤起悲伤。沉郁的旋律，连最冷酷的人也能唱落泪。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are experts at evoking feelings of sorrow through their laments. Their dreary melodies can bring even the most cold-hearted person to tears.

entry: 水中移动时，POKENAME身体变得透明，隐藏在深处。若露营者恰巧睡在它的湖畔家园旁，便会梦见与它一同游泳的美好景象。
author: sk372
source: When moving through the water, POKENAME's body grows transparent and camouflages itself within the depths. Campers who happen to sleep near its lake home are visited by pleasant dreams of swimming alongside it.

entry: POKENAME不停向栖居的池塘与湖泊释放孢子。这些孢子会卡住许多水属性宝可梦的鳃，因此科学家正试着为它寻找新栖息地。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME constantly release spores in ponds and lakes that they reside in. These spores get stuck in the gills of many Water-type Pokémon, so scientists are trying to find a new habitat for POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME游过河湖，沿途散播孢子。孢子会黏在水生宝可梦的鳃上，因此科学家正寻找新家，让它们安全散播孢子，不伤害当地宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swim in lakes and rivers spreading their spores wherever they go. These spores cling to the gills of aquatic Pokémon, so scientists are searching for a new home where they can safely release spores without harming local Pokémon.

entry: 进入溪流前，POKENAME先让鳞片互相碰撞，吓走水中的其他宝可梦。只剩自己后，它才下水，一气睡上最多四小时。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Before entering a stream, POKENAME clash their scales together to scare other Pokémon out of the water. Once alone, POKENAME enter the water and sleep for up to four hours straight.

entry: 为保持皮肤洁净，POKENAME不断在瀑布下沐浴。若有宝可梦把它弄脏，哪怕一点点，它也会用水炮打对方。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: To keep their skin pristine, POKENAME constantly bathe under waterfalls. If a Pokémon gets any amount of filth on them, POKENAME hit them with Hydro Pump.

entry: POKENAME产出甜味染料，烘焙师会拌进甜点糕饼。它爱帮糕点师烘焙，因此有些面包店也让它揉面。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produces a sweet dye that bakers mix into dessert pastries. It loves to help pastry chefs with the baking process, so some bakeries also have it knead dough.

entry: POKENAME成群住在湖泊与池塘最深处，从后部喷水和气泡，戏弄自以为能抓住它们的训练家。恶作剧最多的个体，会被选为首领。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME lives in the deepest depths of lakes and ponds in packs, pranking trainers who think they could catch them by spraying them with bubbles and streams coming from their posterior. The leader POKENAME is chosen from the one who pranks the most.

entry: POKENAME吸水越多，身体就能越久保持半透明、无定形，几乎无法击中；它还会以迅疾、爆炸性的气泡还击，制造短暂暴雨。连精英训练家也很难捕捉。
author: beatdoof
source: The more water POKENAME absorbs, the longer it can turn its body translucent and amorphous, making it nearly impossible to hit while it retaliates with fast, explosive bubbles that create temporary downpours. Even Ace Trainers struggle to capture it.

entry: POKENAME吸水越多，身体就能越久保持半透明、无定形，几乎无法击中；它还会以迅疾、爆炸性的气泡还击，制造短暂暴雨。连精英训练家也很难捕捉。
author: beatdoof
source: The more water POKENAME absorbs, the longer it can turn its body translucent and amorphous, making it nearly impossible to hit and retaliate with fast, explosive bubbles that create temporary downpours. Even Ace Trainers struggle to capture it.

entry: POKENAME游泳出色，靠强劲尾巴推进，连风暴中的海域也能穿行。在领地中，它会并用火与水属性攻击，驱逐对手。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a superb swimmer that propels itself through even stormy seas with its powerful tail. Within its territory, it drives out rivals using both Fire and Water-type attacks.

entry: POKENAME既能操水，又会耕地，用来务农，再合适不过。许多人请它帮忙，轻松种植作物。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME's skills in water manipulation and tilling are a great combo for farming. Many use it to grow crops effortlessly.

entry: POKENAME游泳时，身上的水之石美丽闪耀。它有时会被误认成人鱼。
author: hophoppip
source: The Water Stones on POKENAME's body shine beautifully as it swims. It's sometimes mistaken for a mermaid.

entry: POKENAME常去游客众多的海滩，收集他们遗落的闪亮小物。据说，它们最爱珍珠，会永远珍藏。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME have been known to frequent beaches traveled to by tourists in order to collect all the shiny trinkets they leave behind. It is said their favorites are pearls and they treasure them forever.

entry: POKENAME潜水出色，会隐入水下寻找珍珠。它们以此为傲，常向可信赖的训练家炫耀找到的所有宝藏。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME are excellent divers that are known to vanish underwater while searching for pearls. They are proud of these skills and will often show off all treasures they find to trustworthy Trainers.

entry: POKENAME一缺水就极其难受，因为大脑最先失去水分。训练家须让它们补足水，以免头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME experience great distress whenever they are dehydrated, as the first place to lose moisture is their brain. Trainers need to keep them well-hydrated to prevent them from developing a headache.

entry: POKENAME容易剧烈头痛，会泡进水里，试着缓解。发作时，若附近没有池塘，它就喷出水柱，尽快把头伸进去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are prone to painful headaches, bathing themselves in water to try to soothe themselves. If there is no pond nearby when they're struck with a headache, they spray out a stream of water, sticking their head in it as quickly as they can.

entry: POKENAME协助宝可梦巡护员开展水下救援与打捞。它造出特制气泡，包住宝可梦和物品，将其安全带回水面。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME aid Pokémon Rangers in underwater rescue and retrieval. By creating specialized bubbles, POKENAME can encapsulate Pokémon and items, bringing them safely to the surface.

entry: POKENAME是游泳高手，能毫不费力地在水中滑行。它们一生大多待在水下，彼此追逐玩耍，也吃些海藻。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are superb swimmers that can effortlessly glide through the water. They live most of their lives underwater where they play chase with each other and eat seaweed.

entry: POKENAME毛能防水，身体强健，游得又快又有力，性格极其忠诚友善。凭借这些本领，它正迅速成为海滩救生员公认的助手。
author: sk372
