source: POKENAME acts mischievously when its Trainer is distracted and corrupts data with a single hit of its club. Most of the data POKENAME attacks can be restored easily, but it remains a nuisance for Trainers who do not give it enough attention.

entry: POKENAME能在回旋镖掷出前，就算好飞行轨迹。因此，一次投掷便能可靠地击中多个目标。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is capable of calculating the path a boomerang takes before being thrown. This allows POKENAME to reliably hit multiple targets with a single toss.

entry: POKENAME经过精确计算，掷出回旋镖，接连迅速清除电脑病毒。病毒一碰回旋镖，就会从系统中删除。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME deletes viruses off of a computer in rapid succession by tossing a well-calculated boomerang toss. Upon contact with its boomerang, viruses are deleted from the system.

entry: POKENAME每次踢中对手，都会留下代码印记。这行代码形成数字踪迹，帮助它找到、锁定敌人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME leave behind an imprint of code whenever they kick an opponent. This line of code helps them lock onto their foe, as this digital footprint helps them locate their opponent.

entry: POKENAME从网上下载秘籍与强化补丁，提升拳击本领。再打起来，便招招凶狠，对手面前绝不留情。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME downloads cheats and buffs online to boost its boxing skills. Afterwards, it throws out attacks and shows no mercy to its opponents.

entry: 它通过数字身体的内存泄漏，喷出损坏的代码。人们认为，在物质世界，POKENAME的排放物会化作辐射，导致重病。
author: foolish_weasel
source: It spews corrupted code via memory leaks from its digital body. In the physical world, it is believed that POKENAME's emissions manifest as a form of radiation, which can cause severe sickness.

entry: 在现实世界，POKENAME的排放物相当于蓝光，会使接触者眼睛疲劳。在网络空间，它们却对图像有毒，让图像日渐损坏。
author: soup1900
source: In the real world, the emissions of POKENAME become the equivalent of blue light and strain the eyes of anyone who comes into contact with them. In cyberspace, its emissions are toxic to images, causing them to slowly deteriorate over time.

entry: POKENAME是满布电子设备的楼宇中的大麻烦。它从电脑潜入，离开网络空间后，就用角钻入机器，吞食里面的电子元件。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a great nuisance for buildings full of electronics. It infiltrates the building through computers, exiting cyberspace before using its horn to drill into the machinery and feast on the electronic components inside.

entry: 一看见受伤宝可梦，POKENAME就会开心地大声哔叫。它从嘴里吐出营养丰富的蛋，希望帮助对方康复。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lets out a loud beep of happiness upon spotting an injured Pokémon. It will dispense a nutrition filled egg from its mouth in hopes of aiding their recovery.

entry: POKENAME在月光下会飘得更高，引发网上关于它来自月亮的猜测。战况危急时，它会一边悬浮，一边合为一体，打出强力迷昏拳。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats higher in moonlight, sparking internet theories that it originates from the moon. During dire battles, it merges together while floating to unleash a powerful Dizzy Punch.

entry: POKENAME能进入现代机器，再带着实体化的数据出来，使程序数据具现。原理仍不明，它们却喜欢修整带出的数据，再放回原来的机器。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME have the ability to materialise program data by entering modern machinery and exiting with physical data. While it is unknown how they do this, POKENAME like to fix data they bring out, before placing it back into the machine it came from.

entry: POKENAME的程序让它朝任何靠近的对象喷墨，无论友善与否。尾巴只是无法舒展的实心方块，因此水中任何一股流都容易把它推走。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's programming causes it to spit ink at anyone who approaches it, regardless of whether they're friendly or not. Since its tail is just a solid square that can't be uncurled, it gets easily pushed away by any current in the water.

entry: POKENAME的代码会阻止它打破玻璃，逃出水族馆。身体没有圆滑边缘，由许多基本形状构成，因此只有喜爱复古设计的人，才欣赏它独特的美。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's coding dissuades it from trying to break through glass to escape aquariums. Due to how its body has no round edges and is made of many basic shapes, POKENAME's unique beauty is only appreciated by people who love retro-style designs.

entry: 以自然图片为背景的电脑屏幕，会吸引POKENAME。奇妙的是，翅上撒落的花粉能让这些图片中长出新数字植物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is attracted to computer screens that have pictures of nature as their background. Curiously, pollen spread from its wings can cause new digital plants to grow on these pictures.

entry: POKENAME中央的独眼能投出网页全息图。远离常规电脑时，训练家常让它帮忙查阅邮件等资料。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can project holographic images of webpages from the single eye in its center. Trainers often have it help them check on emails and other data while away from conventional PC access.

entry: POKENAME偶尔会出现在海洋研究或深海相关网站。它转动背上星星充能，充满后，从眼中射出闪亮多彩的光束。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is occasionally spotted on websites related to oceanic research and the deeper areas of the ocean. It spins the star on its back to charge energy, releasing a shimmering and colorful beam from its eye once fully charged.

entry: POKENAME建立隐形场域，阻止程序彼此正常通信。它似乎是为了恶作剧，用精神力量感知哪些人心怀恶意，就去针对他们。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME erects invisible fields that prevent programs from communicating properly with one another. It appears to do this as a prank, targeting those it senses are mean spirited through its psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME挥镰太快，在网络空间中，只有需要销毁整个程序才会用它。稍不留神，斩击甚至会穿透数字空间边界，损坏所在的实体设备。
author: soup1900
source: With how fast it can slash with its scythes, POKENAME is only ever used in cyberspace when needed to destroy entire programs. If not careful, it can even physically damage the device it is in by slashing through the boundaries of digital space.

entry: POKENAME将错误提示视为安全威胁，会气得失去理智。一听见或看见，就冲撞提示来源，直到自己累倒，或提示消失。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gets irrationally angry at error messages, as it sees those messages as a threat to its safety. If it hears or sees an error message, it charges at the source until it tires itself out, or the message goes away.

entry: POKENAME常忘了自己能游过网络空间，在人们桌面上成了无助扑腾的简单动画。挣扎几小时后，它才想起自己的本领。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME frequently forgets it can swim through cyberspace, appearing as a simple animation flopping helplessly on people's desktops. It only remembers its abilities after hours of struggling.

entry: POKENAME对电磁波敏感，因此被广播塔与人造天线吸引。它们似乎以电磁波为食，但须至少五十只成群，才会造成明显干扰。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are sensitive to the presence of EM waves, so they are drawn to radio towers and human-made antennae as well. They seem to feed on EM waves, though only a swarm of at least fifty POKENAME will cause noticeable interference.

entry: POKENAME在网络空间横冲直撞，遇到什么电脑数据就破坏什么。只有最强的防火墙与反恶意软件，才有希望阻住攻势。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME thrashes about cyberspace and wreaks havoc and destruction on any computer data it comes across. Only the strongest of firewalls and anti-malware programs have a hope of stopping its assaults.

entry: POKENAME的变身能力仍在开发。它虽能改变身体模仿别人，结果却总比原物方正得多，像个方块版本。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's transformation capabilities are still in development. While it can change its body to mimic the form of others, the results always appear to be a much blockier version of what it is mimicking.

entry: POKENAME会下载发给自己的一切更新与代码，即使可能有害。若不喜欢发生的变异，它就自行更新身体，修正改变。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME downloads every update or piece of code sent to it, even if potentially harmful. If it doesn't like a mutation made to it, it self-updates its own body to fix the changes.

entry: POKENAME身体的质感，会随所用攻击改变。电属性攻击让表面变得毛茸茸，水属性攻击则让身体极其光滑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body texture shifts depending on the attacks it uses. Electric-Type attacks leave its body covered in a fuzzy texture, while Water-Type attacks make it intensely smooth.

entry: POKENAME耗掉大部分电力后，尖刺状身体会变得完全光滑。直到体内电力全数恢复，才会变回原样。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME expends most of its electricity, its spiky body becomes completely smooth. It remains this way until its internal charge fully regenerates.

entry: 核心处理器猛烈发热，使POKENAME的身体总摸来温暖。最好别让它靠近个人电脑，否则可能使电脑过热。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is always warm to the touch, thanks to a powerfully burning core processor. It's recommended not to let it near personal computers, as its presence could cause them to overheat.

entry: POKENAME一移动，就会短暂留下许多残影。战斗中能使敌人迷失方向，似乎却也让它自己很费力。
author: sk372
source: Whenever POKENAME moves, it leaves a short trail of numerous afterimages behind. This effect can disorient foes in battle, but also seems to be taxing to POKENAME as well.

entry: POKENAME胆小，被逼进角落或有人与它接触，就很快缩壳。刺中毒素无论在网络空间内外，都能有效麻痹被刺中的对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is skittish and quick to hide in its shell when cornered or interacted with. The spines contain a toxin that works effectively both in and out of cyberspace to paralyze those pricked by the spikes.

entry: POKENAME藏在许多电脑文件与程序下面，保护自己免受恶意软件侵害。试着同时加载多个程序时，身体会变得极热。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME hides itself under many computer files and programs to protect itself from malware. Its body becomes extremely hot when it tries to load multiple of its programs at once.

entry: POKENAME背上虽没有看得见的眼睛，程序却让它能从壳上视物。不过，所见会变得满是像素块，因此它不爱这么做。
author: soup1900
source: Despite having no visible eyes on its back, POKENAME was programmed to be able to see from its shell. However, anything it sees from its shell becomes extremely pixelated, so it tends to avoid doing so.

entry: POKENAME飞过网络空间，攻击找到的任何程序，想饱餐一顿。可它没有尖牙利爪，攻击总是徒劳。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME flies through cyberspace and attacks any program it finds to feast on. However, it does not have any sharp teeth or claws to attack with, making its attacks futile.

entry: POKENAME的程序会清除找到的任何病毒。若饿太久，它便开始吃普通应用程序，填饱肚子。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME is programmed to eradicate any viruses it can find. If it goes hungry for too long, it'll start eating normal applications to satisfy its hunger.

entry: 各地区发电厂里的电脑最吸引POKENAME。它吸干电脑电力，又会给发电机超强充能，工人拿不准，该把它当帮手还是麻烦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is most attracted to computers housed within power plants across the regions. It drains the computers, but then supercharges the generators, so workers aren't sure if it should be considered as a helper or a hindrance.

entry: POKENAME耐得住高温，因此研究者用它考察火山环境。身上的火焰从不黯淡。
author: mepp.
source: As POKENAME are able to withstand high temperatures, it is used by researchers to study volcanic environments. The flames on its body never dim.

entry: 需要更新能力时，POKENAME就藏在许多文件夹与程序后，防备外界影响。容纳它的电子设备需要很大存储空间，保存频繁蜕下的数据。
author: soup1900
source: When needing to update its capabilities, POKENAME hides itself behind many folders and programs as protection from outside influences. Electronics that contain this Pokémon need a lot of storage to contain the data from its frequent sheddings.

entry: POKENAME身体中由二进制代码构成的部分，似乎蕴藏着大部分程序能力。用尾尖碰电脑，便能使机器性能暂时提升。
author: sk372
source: The bits of POKENAME's body made of binary code seem to hold most of its programming power. Touching computers with the tip of its tail causes the machine to gain a temporary boost in specs.

entry: POKENAME最早出现在偏远岛屿研究中心附近。它格外关心领地内科学家的安全，常在对方工作时，就近守上数小时。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME was first seen in the vicinity of remote island research centers. It takes a vested interest in protecting scientists within its territory, often standing just near them for hours while work is being done.

entry: POKENAME的刺装满杀毒软件。它飞来飞去，反复刺击受感染的电脑系统，直到恶意软件清除。不过，这个过程也会损伤实体硬件。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's stingers are filled with antivirus software. It flies around and repeatedly jabs these stingers at infected computer systems until they are rid of their malware. However, this does damage the physical hardware in the process.

entry: POKENAME用头上的叶子捕捉数据包，收集往来信息。若捕到病毒，它就会生病受伤，须在蓝光下沐浴几小时才能恢复。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses the leaf on its head to capture data packets and gather what information is being sent around. If it captures a virus, it becomes sick and injured until it bathes in rays of blue light for a couple of hours.

entry: POKENAME有独特气味，像旧塑料与软盘。经常栖居网络空间的宝可梦，会被这怀旧气息吸引。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a unique scent that smells of old plastic and floppy disks. Pokémon that are often found in cyberspace are drawn to this nostalgic scent.

entry: POKENAME散出旧塑料与电子碎屑的气味，吸引许多适应网络空间的宝可梦。训练家常让它晒太阳，增强气味，引来更多宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce the scent of old plastic and electronic shavings, a scent that draws in many Pokémon that thrive in cyberspace. Many Trainers amplify this scent by having them bask in the sun, intensifying the scent to draw in more Pokémon.

entry: 精神充沛时，POKENAME靠背部散出的数据，能在电脑里充当移动防火墙。疲倦时，数据不再散出，它便容易受恶意软件侵害。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can act like a mobile firewall inside of a computer when energized thanks to the data emitted from its back. When tired, this data ceases to emit, making it vulnerable to malware.

entry: POKENAME用背部奇特的白焰推进，可朝任何方向冲，不必减速。人们原以为这些推进器能促进太空旅行，可产生的力量，连它自己也举不起来。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME can use the strange white flames on their back as propulsion, able to thrust themselves in any direction without slowing down. These thrusters were thought to advance space travel, though the power generated is not enough to lift POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME藏在公园喷泉里，等不知情的作家把电子设备摆在附近。一见有人打字，它就跃出，咬住设备，瞬间吸光数据。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hide in fountains at public parks, waiting for unsuspecting writers to set up their electronics nearby. The moment it sees one typing, it leaps out and bites onto the device, instantly absorbing all of its data.

entry: POKENAME能随环境改变身体，不过程度有限。它们共同不变的特点，是始终保持流线形体，让飞行不成问题。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are capable of adapting their bodies to their environment, although only to some degree. The main constant among their kind is that they maintain aerodynamic forms so they can fly with little issue.

entry: POKENAME理论上咬合力强，嘴里却一颗牙也没有。它先用强劲四肢碾碎海边猎物，再整口吞下。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME technically has a powerful bite force, it lacks teeth entirely within its maw. It crushes seaside prey with its powerful limbs before swallowing them whole.

entry: POKENAME友善又好奇，在网络空间里钻探各台电脑。许多人发现文件一团乱，就是因为它好奇地翻查，四处挪动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a friendly but curious sort, poking into different computers across cyberspace. Many have found their files in disarray due to curiosity causing POKENAME to examine them and shuffle them around.

entry: POKENAME夜里鸣叫时，会放出无线电波般的涟漪。奇怪的是，这似乎并非自愿，因为它真正与同类交流，靠的是细微转身动作。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits radio wave-like ripples alongside its nightly hooting. Oddly, this appears to be involuntary, as its true communication relies on subtle turning movements with others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME随群在花间飞舞吸蜜，发出拨号调制解调器般的声音。每只声音略有不同，因此能进行意外复杂的交流。
author: .izik
source: While flying between flowers with its swarm to absorb nectar, POKENAME emits a noise similar to a dial up modem. Each POKENAME's noise is slightly different, allowing for surprisingly complex communication.

entry: POKENAME主要住在桌面图片展示花朵的电脑上。它为何喜欢数字花胜过真花，仍在研究。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME primarily resides on computers displaying flowers in their desktop images. Why it prefers digital flowers over real ones is still being studied.

entry: 进入电脑后，POKENAME就会搜寻恶意软件。找到的目标，都会先被数字网缠住，再吞下。
author: .izik
source: Upon entering a computer, POKENAME searches the system for malware. Any it finds is ensnared in a digital web before being consumed.

entry: POKENAME形似超逼真的病毒模型，能编织DNA链，制造蛋白质来感染人类。世界各地的课堂，会展示它，帮助大家学习微生物学。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME resembles a hyper-realistic model of a virus that weaves strands of DNA to create proteins to infect people. It is presented in classrooms throughout the world to help people learn about microbiology.

entry: POKENAME通常住在黑暗洞穴，偶尔外出捕猎。黑暗中，它会扑向任何比自己小的东西，晒到日光却温顺得多。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is usually found in dark caves, but it sometimes ventures outside to hunt. It will pounce on anything smaller than it while in the dark, but is much more passive while exposed to daylight.

entry: POKENAME用上翼刮刻洞壁，留下红蓝痕迹，标记巢穴。对闯入者，它只发一声失真的数字尖啸警告，随即攻击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME marks its den within caves by scratching into the stone walls with its upper wings, which leave red-and-blue markings. Trespassers get a single distorted digital shriek as a warning before it goes on the attack.

entry: POKENAME坚硬锋利的翅膀，助它高速飞行、更好地防御。不同无线电波似乎有不同影响，能使它平静，也能令它发狂。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME rigid and sharp wings allow it to achieve great speeds and to better defend itself. Different radio waves seem to have varying effects on this Pokémon, such as calming it or driving it into a frenzy.

entry: POKENAME触角放出奇特磁场。科学家不确定，那是隐身手段、回声定位，还是完全别的用途。它似乎格外受海底网线吸引。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME's antennae emit a peculiar magnetic field; scientists are unsure whether it serves as a cloaking device, a form of echolocation, or something else entirely. It seems particularly attracted to undersea internet cables.

entry: POKENAME程序简单，遇到问题，主要反应就是电一下。电击虽弱，仍会损坏所在的电脑及其中硬件。
author: soup1900
source: Due to POKENAME's basic programming, its main response to problems it encounters is to shock them with a jolt of electricity. Despite how weak the shock is, it still will damage the computer it's in and the hardware it contained.

entry: POKENAME飘过空中，身后跟着一小道闪亮光迹。仔细检查，会发现这些散出的光完全由二进制代码构成。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME floats through the air, a small trail of sparkling light follows it. Close examination of these emissions reveals it to be made entirely of binary code.

entry: POKENAME虽没有嘴，体内却能清楚播放音乐。只有把它放入设备，调成静音，才能停下。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME, despite having no mouth, audibly projects music from within its body. It can only be stopped by placing it inside of a device and muting the volume.

entry: POKENAME的壳塞满各种电子游戏程序与电视节目。只要有孩子无聊，它就开心地分享，才不管家长愿不愿意。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME stuffs its shell with programs of many video games and television shows. It happily gives these programs to any bored kid despite their parent's wishes.

entry: 据说POKENAME住进电脑，便会给主人所做的事带来好运。沉迷网上赌博的人常寻找它，盼望下注占些优势。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to bring good luck to a person's endeavors while it resides in their computer. Hardcore online gamblers often seek it out hoping to get an advantage in their betting.

entry: POKENAME看见有人难过，就凑近大声哔叫，想让对方开心。可好心往往只换来头痛，让心情更差。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME spots someone sad, it beeps loudly near them in hopes of cheering them up. Despite its good intentions, this usually only causes headaches and worsens their mood.

entry: POKENAME爱与训练家玩游戏，尤其喜欢没有随机因素的抽象策略游戏。程序能让它窥见后续局势，确保获胜。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoys playing games with its Trainer, especially abstract strategy games where there are no elements of chance. Its programming gives it glimpses into future states of the game, ensuring that it wins.

entry: 据说训练家献上独特宝石，POKENAME就会给道具，却从没人找对宝石。许多个体住在有木屋的小村。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are said to give out items to Trainers who offer them unique gems, but no one has been able to locate the correct gems to give them. Many live in small villages with wooden huts.

entry: POKENAME凭程序，在各种抽象策略游戏中击败训练家。只要信息全部公开，又无随机因素，它就能稳稳获胜，或强行逼和。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME relies on its programming to beat Trainers at various abstract strategy games. Where all information is known and there are no elements of chance, POKENAME can reliably win or force a draw.

entry: POKENAME爱吞食硬盘等设备。吃下一块硬盘，电力便增强十倍。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME loves to consume hard drives and other equipment. After eating a hard drive, its electrical power increases tenfold.

entry: POKENAME能用力振翅，掀起足以吹走电脑文件的风。有人嫉妒它美丽的数码毛发，专门制作恶意软件，试图将其破坏。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is able to flap its wings hard enough to create wind capable of moving files in a computer away. Some people have created malware specifically for this Pokémon, attempting to target and destroy its beautiful cyber hair out of jealousy.

entry: POKENAME尾珠调到最亮时，光会耀眼得让人睁不开眼。光中放出的特殊电磁脉冲，会干扰附近科技设备。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tail-orb is able to glow blindingly bright when used at maximum brightness. Its glow emits a special electromagnetic pulse that interferes with nearby technology when active.

entry: POKENAME看见海上船只，就以惊人速度游去。它把尾巴贴上船身，接入船载电脑，吸收其中数据。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims at incredible speeds toward any ship it spots at sea. It presses its tail to the hull to access naval computing equipment and absorb the data within.

entry: POKENAME游泳时听见音乐，就会阵阵放电。奇怪的是，只要别的生物靠近，它就停止这种行为。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases bursts of electricity when it hears music while swimming. Strangely, it ceases this behavior whenever another creature draws near.

entry: POKENAME虽由数据构成，却讨厌数据流，尽量避开。原因不明，尤其是它站在雨里或真实溪流中，都毫无问题。
author: soup1900
source: Despite being made of data, POKENAME hates data streams and avoids being near them as best as it can. It is unknown why it has this tendency, especially since it will stand in rain or real streams without any issue.

entry: POKENAME用来提高人们对恶意网站的警惕，引导用户改去安全可靠的网站。若在现实世界具现，它常被误当广告牌。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME is used to promote awareness of malicious websites in the computer world, guiding users to safe and reliable ones instead. If manifested in the real world, people often mistake it for a billboard.

entry: POKENAME游泳时，身体变得极光滑，尽量减少摩擦。晒太阳休息时，质地却会在几秒内变得黏稠而极粗糙。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body becomes extremely smooth while swimming to minimize friction. When resting in the sun, it shifts to a sticky and incredibly rough texture within seconds.

entry: POKENAME飘过工业区上方，撒下粉末。任何电脑设备一碰到，就会故障关机。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME scatters powder from its body as it drifts above industrial areas. Any computer equipment the powder touches will malfunction and shut down.

entry: POKENAME用身体下侧的獠牙，啃服务器机房的线缆。若不慎咬中通电电线，电流涌过全身，身体就脉动着深蓝光芒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME nibbles on server room cables using the fangs on the underside of its body. If it accidentally bites into a live wire, it pulses with a deep blue glow as electricity surges through it.

entry: POKENAME吸收阳光充能，同时储存附近气象数据。科学家已开始寻找它们，下载数据，研究人类如何影响环境。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME absorb sunlight and store meteorological data of the nearby area as they charge. Scientists have begun tracking down POKENAME to download this data to research how people have affected the environment.

entry: POKENAME符合古代泥板所刻宝可梦的描述，令许多科学家困惑，它为何远古就已存在。连接电脑，会发现体内存着颗粒感极重的单色照片。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME fit the description of a Pokémon carved on ancient clay tablets, leaving many scientists baffled by their presence in the ancient past. Connecting POKENAME to a PC reveals incredibly grainy monochrome photos stored in their body.

entry: POKENAME需要大量阳光才能运作，缺光太久，就会完全关机。若白天吸收足够，夜里身体便会发光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME requires large amounts of sunlight to function, lest it shut down completely if deprived for too long. If it absorbs enough during the day, its body will glow during the night.

entry: POKENAME振翅时，会放出微弱的小电磁脉冲。虽无大碍，却会多次干扰附近电子设备的画面。
author: sk372
source: The flapping of POKENAME's wings emits a small, weak electromagnetic pulse. Though ultimately harmless, it will cause multiple disruptions in the visuals on any electronics near it.

entry: POKENAME伏在河床边缘，融入环境，等猎物走进嘴里。它们只做简单动作，节省能量，却又常忘了使用存下的能量。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME will lay at the edge of riverbeds and camouflage themselves to the environment, waiting for prey to stroll into their mouth. POKENAME only use basic movements to conserve energy, though they regularly forget to use the energy stored.

entry: POKENAME是很称职的数字助手。它结合模式识别与轻微读心，预判主人使用电脑的需求，提前打开文档与网页，协助工作。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite effective as a digital assistance. It uses pattern recognition as well as mild mind-reading to anticipate its owner's computer needs, opening up documents and pages ahead of time to assist in their tasks.

entry: POKENAME被引入数字世界，在夜间保护文件免受病毒侵害。它们极其有用，公司愿出钱，请年轻训练家培育。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME are introduced into the digital world to protect files from viruses during nighttime hours. Because of how incredibly useful they are, companies are willing to pay young Trainers to raise them.

entry: POKENAME被引入数字世界，在夜间保护文件免受病毒侵害。它们极其有用，公司愿出钱，请年轻训练家培育。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME are introduced into the digital world to protect files from viruses during nighttime hours. Because of how incredibly useful they are, companies are willing to pay young Trainers to raise them.

entry: POKENAME慢悠悠的，除非确定能赢，否则不太爱打架。它们宁愿叫别人保护自己，代为对付袭击者。
author: fireflower20002
source: POKENAME are very slow going and don't really like to get into fights unless they know they can win them. They instead call upon others to protect and fight attackers for them.

entry: POKENAME常在夜间沿小巷，寻找丢弃的电子设备为食。它们通常跟着群中体形最大的个体。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME are commonly found preying on discarded electronics at night, typically stalking alleyways. They usually follow whoever is the largest of their pack.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME方块状的结构，是为了让背上的数据核心花长得更好。直晒阳光时，吸收的信息越多，数据花就长得越快。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's blocky structure is believed to have formed to better the growing data core flower on its back. The data flower grows more rapidly as POKENAME takes in information in direct sunlight.

entry: POKENAME会连接电脑，在网上制造混乱。胡须是连接的关键，一被剪掉，它就会断线。
author: equation8573
source: POKENAME has been known to connect to computers to cause chaos online. If its whiskers are cut off, then it will disconnect as the whiskers are key to connection.

entry: POKENAME能施加轻微数字诅咒，让寄居的电脑出现技术问题。用户为此烦恼，它便开心不已，以散出的挫败情绪为食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has the power to cast mild digital hexes that cause technical issues in the computers it inhabits. It gleefully delights in a user's vexation at these problems, feasting on the frustration they emanate.

entry: POKENAME充当一种程序语言，帮助网络世界运行脚本。研究人员与程序员，也用它进行模拟。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME serves as a language to help run scripts in the cyberworld. Researchers and programmers use it to run simulations.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，尾巴仍警惕危险，能扑得比链条般的外观看起来更远。尾巴猛冲咬下，力量足以击碎钢门。
author: pjporwoll
source: While POKENAME sleeps, its tail remains alert for danger, which it will lunge at with a reach further than its chain-like appearance would indicate. The tail charges and bites with enough force to shatter steel gates.

entry: 闹鬼庄园若聚来幽灵属性宝可梦，人们就会请POKENAME击退。它们用尾巴引诱、麻痹对方，再发动迅疾的精神攻击。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: If ghost-type Pokémon swarm haunted manors, POKENAME is brought in to defeat them. POKENAME use their tails to lure and paralyze, allowing them to unleash rapid psychic attacks.

entry: POKENAME在深层网络中开凿复杂隧道，以数据为食。它不喜欢常有人访问的网站，因为网络流量太大。
author: equation8573
source: POKENAME creates complex tunnels in the deep web, where it feeds on data. It dislikes commonly visited websites because of high levels of internet traffic.

entry: POKENAME是数字猎手，会被鼠标指针的移动吸引。它俯冲过去，想把指针吃掉，逼得用户拼命晃鼠标，逃出它的掌握。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a digital hunter attracted to the movements of mouse cursors. It swoops down on them and attempts to eat them, forcing a user to frantically wiggle their mouse to escape its clutches.

entry: POKENAME的代码经过全面加固与加密，程序员正研究它，称其为“数字保险箱”。
author: napstabl0ok
source: POKENAME's code is fully fortified and encrypted. It is studied by programmers, who know it as a "digital strongbox".

entry: POKENAME很黏人，要求大量关注。若训练家忽视，它们就找出音乐文件，不断调高音量，直到得到想要的注意。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are needy creatures that demand lots of attention. If their Trainer ignores them, they find music files and turn the volume up until their Trainer gives them the attention they desire.

entry: POKENAME被上传到虚拟世界，检测并消除系统漏洞，防止其蔓延至关键数据管理软件。须定期维护检查，确保没有病毒破坏系统完整性。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME was uploaded into the virtual world to detect and neutralize system bugs before they could spread through critical data management software. It requires regular maintenance checks to ensure no virus has corrupted its system integrity.

entry: POKENAME十分忠诚，保护训练家的文件不被陌生人碰。没有训练家明确许可，它就凶猛阻止别人访问敏感文件，抓住指针不肯放手。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are loyal creatures that protect their Trainer's files from strangers. Without explicit permission from their Trainer, POKENAME ferociously stop others from accessing sensitive files by grabbing onto the cursor and refusing to let go.

entry: POKENAME自身没有强毒，最佳防御便是潜入水下，伪装混在海底水雷中。迫不得已，它才将方块状尖刺当作沉重的高速弹丸射出。
author: sk372
source: Lacking a strong poison of its own, POKENAME's best defense is to hide underwater and camouflage itself among undersea mines. As a last resort, it can fire off its blocky spikes as fast-moving heavy projectiles.

entry: 翅膀与沉重身体，让POKENAME只能直线飞行。它很少升上高空，而是贴地低飞，以强劲钳力碾碎小宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wings and heavy body leave it only able to fly in straight lines. It rarely ascends high into the sky, keeping low and crushing smaller Pokémon with the powerful grip of its claws.

entry: POKENAME靠体内特制传感器，维持产出优质树果汁所需的适当条件。它很保护果汁，会攻击试图拿走的训练家与宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME relies on special sensors within its body to maintain the right conditions needed for high quality Berry Juice. It is protective of its Berry Juice, attacking Trainers and Pokémon who try to take it.

entry: POKENAME依靠体内一套独特传感器，调出完美树果汁。它几乎从不分给其他宝可梦，只有与训练家建立多年信任与尊重，才会献上。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME relies on a unique set of sensors in its body to concoct the perfect Berry Juice. It almost never shares this special drink with other Pokémon and only offers it to its Trainer after years of trust and respect.

entry: POKENAME能做的动作有限，只会用角把物体挑飞到远处。虽有翅膀，体内却没有相关程序，因此不能飞。
author: soup1900
source: Having only a limited amount of motions, POKENAME can only use its horn to fling objects far away. Despite having wings, it is unable to fly due to not having any program in its body related to the wings.

entry: POKENAME常用爪在自认为属于自己的电脑侧面刻痕。训练家很难教它克制这份本能。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a tendency to use its claws to dig markings into the sides of computers it claims as its own. Trainers will have a difficult time teaching it to resist this instinct.

entry: POKENAME外形酷似熊宝宝，几乎能无缝混进它们群中。最好的辨认方法是给蜂蜜：与熊宝宝不同，它受不了这种点心的甜味。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's close appearance to Teddiursa allows it to blend in within groups of them almost seamlessly. The best way to tell the difference is to offer it honey; unlike Teddiursa, it can't stand the treat's sweet taste.

entry: POKENAME游荡电脑中，不停翻找数据，看主人是否正在过生日。一找到，它就启动扬声器，大声播放生日音乐。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME wander into PCs, constantly looking through data to see if the computer's owner is celebrating a birthday. Upon finding such a person, POKENAME activates the speakers to blast birthday music.

entry: POKENAME在网络空间里坐等，直到嗅到经过的恶意软件。随后，它突然活跃起来，凶猛挥爪，直到病毒被摧毁。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME sits around and waits in cyberspace until it smells malware come by it. It then suddenly becomes very active and aggressively slashes at the virus until it has been destroyed.

entry: POKENAME守在熊宝宝身旁，确保它们平安长大。一发现捕食者，就发出可怕的哔鸣怒吼，让身体表面变粗糙，再冲过去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stays close to Teddiursa to ensure their safety as they grow up. Upon spotting a predator, it lets out a horrifying beeping roar and shifts its body to a rough texture before charging.

entry: 最好别让POKENAME太靠近电脑，尝试进入网络空间。它体温极高，只要待在电子设备里，就会使其迅速过热。
author: sk372
source: It is advised never to let a POKENAME get too close to a computer and attempt to enter cyberspace. Its body temperature is so high that just being within an electronic will cause it to rapidly overheat.

entry: POKENAME帮助年轻烘焙师维持点心所需的温度，又不会烧着房子。设定的时间一到，它们就关掉热源，大声鸣响，提醒人检查食物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME help young bakers maintain the proper temperature for baked goods without the risk of setting their house on fire. Once a set duration has passed, they turn off the heat and chime loudly for someone to check on the food.

entry: POKENAME穿行网络空间时，翅膀会化为纯数据。这些数据来自沿途吞下的废弃文件。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wings convert to pure data while traveling through cyberspace. This data is made up of discarded files it consumes along the way.

entry: POKENAME穿越冰原，用鼻子嗅出冰下可食的植物。最远50英尺也能察觉，找到便会发出高兴的尖细哔声。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME travels across icy tundras using its nose to sniff out edible plants beneath the ice. It can detect them from up to 50 feet away, letting out happy squeaky beeps upon finding any.

entry: POKENAME会痴迷地分析遇见的任何条纹。某些纹样，似乎比其他更受它珍视。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME obsessively analyzes any striped pattern it comes across. It seems to value certain patterns more than others.

entry: POKENAME用体内数据作三角定位，能从远处以墨汁击中目标。它们还能改变墨汁性质，产生不同效果，适应对手。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME are able to shoot targets with ink from far away, using the data stored in their body to triangulate a shot. POKENAME can change the properties of this ink to produce differing effects to adapt to their opponent.

entry: 据说POKENAME是睿智的老师，教弱小宝可梦战斗、克服恐惧。不过，它也极其危险，会给学生机会，在自己决定毁灭世界前将其消灭。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME is said to be a wise teacher who teaches weak Pokémon to fight and overcome their fears. Despite that, it is also incredibly dangerous and gives its students the chance to eliminate it before it decides to wreak havoc upon the world.

entry: 若POKENAME出现在电脑上，千万别惹怒。它怒时喷出的火焰，带着恶意数据碎片，会感染系统，变得无法清除。
author: sk372
source: One should be careful not to anger a POKENAME that appears on one's computer. The flames it breathes when enraged carry bits of malicious data that will infect a system and become impossible to remove.

entry: POKENAME身体能快速适应，连战斗中也能变化。最不易改变的，往往是长喙，至多变得更锋利，方便攻击敌人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's bodies are capable of rapid adaptation, even during battle. What often changes the least are their long beaks that, at most, only get sharper to better attack foes.

entry: POKENAME只吃苹果，整颗吞下后，又找下一颗。曾有人看见，它试图吃掉睡着的胖毛虫等宝可梦。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME only eats apples, swallowing them whole and searching for the next one. It has been seen trying to eat Pokémon like Slurpie when they are asleep.

entry: 吃下电脑设备后，POKENAME造出的气泡能轻易击穿船身。气泡破裂，会大声哔鸣。
author: .izik
source: After consuming computer equipment, the bubbles POKENAME creates can easily breach the hull of a ship. These bubbles let off loud beeps when they pop.

entry: POKENAME滚过洞穴，身体会变得极其粗糙。察觉即将无可避免地撞墙时，它便发出尖锐哔声。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body grows incredibly rough as it rolls through caverns. It lets out a shrill beep whenever it detects an inevitable collision with a wall.

entry: POKENAME滚动暴走时，虽难用蛮力阻住，只要前方放件电子设备，就能立刻叫停。它不愿伤害机器，会马上停下，转往别处。
author: sk372
source: Though a POKENAME's rolling rampage may be difficult to stop physically, it can instantly be halted by placing an electronic in its path. Unwilling to harm machines, POKENAME will instantly stop and turn to go elsewhere.

entry: 这种由两种多边兽版本融合而成的形态，像进化途中可见的样子。它仿佛突然变强，却还不清楚如何运用新力量。
author: epping_forest
source: This fusion between two different Porygon versions resembles what can be seen during evolution. It behaves as if it suddenly became stronger, though it isn't sure how to use its newfound strength.

entry: POKENAME有时出现在森林或自然保护区相关网页。它偶尔翻找尚未彻底删除的垃圾文件，吃下后增大体形。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is sometimes spotted hanging around web pages dedicated to forests or nature preserves. It sometimes roots around trashed files yet to be fully deleted, consuming them to increase its bulk.

entry: POKENAME能进入电脑，吞吃像素，用来创作。游戏设计师常请它们帮助制作材质贴图。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME can enter computers to consume pixels, using them in their own creations. They are often used by game designers to help create textures.

entry: POKENAME能绕多条轴线转动，打出猛烈拳脚。它们可瞬间转至来拳同向，绕过拳头，因此很难击中。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can rotate on multiple axes to land devastating punches and kicks. This makes them difficult to hit, as they can snap to the same direction as a punch and maneuver around a fist.

entry: POKENAME的程序有故障，心情剧烈起伏。开心时，它乐观、善良又爱玩，可稍遇不顺，便哭泣惊慌。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME's programming is glitched, causing it to swing wildly between moods. When happy, it is optimistic, kind, and loves to play, but at the smallest upset, it will weep and panic.

entry: POKENAME能接入任何插座，为连着的设备充电。但它们无法储电，到了没有插座的地方，就派不上用场。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are able to plug themselves into any outlet to charge any device they're connected to. However, their inability to hold a charge makes them useless when in a location with no outlets.

entry: POKENAME能接入任何三孔插座，为连着的设备充电。但它们无法储电，到了没有可用插座的地方，就派不上用场。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are able to plug themselves into any 3-pronged outlet to charge any device they're connected to. However, their inability to hold a charge makes them useless when in a location with no useable outlets.

entry: POKENAME能在腹部屏幕上放出任何想要的图像。它常一边显示吓人图片，一边发出巨响，不知是为了威吓，还是自己取乐。
author: aggrave
source: POKENAME can put any image it wants onto the screen on its belly. It will often display a scary image while making a loud sound, though it's unclear if this behavior is for intimidation or POKENAME's own amusement.

entry: POKENAME跳入数据流，一泡几小时，休养精神。它待过的文件，常因吐息放出的小火焰，缺了几位数据。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME plunges into data streams and bathes in them for hours to rest up. Files where a POKENAME was are often missing a few bits of data from when it expelled some flames from its breath.

entry: POKENAME的奶，有明显的人工合成风味，多数难以下口。偏偏多边兽一系及多数相关融合体格外爱这个味道，把它当成美味点心。
author: sk372
source: Milk sourced from POKENAME has a distinctly artificial flavor to it, making it unpalatable to most. However, this exact taste is highly favored by the Porygon family and most of its fusions, making it a beloved treat.

entry: POKENAME察觉有人疼痛，就会发出仿佛欣喜的哔叫。它接近伤者，从嘴里送出数十颗蛋，每颗都具有疗愈作用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits a beeping cry resembling elation when it senses someone in pain. It approaches the wounded and dispenses dozens of eggs from its mouth, each filled with healing properties.

entry: 在网络空间，POKENAME一叫，便生成数字火山，向四周喷熔岩。它借此烧掉与自己有关的数据，掩盖行踪，在数字世界深处游荡而不被跟踪。
author: sk372
source: In cyberspace, POKENAME's cry causes a volcano to digitally form and erupt lava all about. It uses this to burn away data on itself, covering its tracks to avoid being followed as it roams the depths of the digital world.

entry: POKENAME的缎带能瞬间清掉电脑里所有病毒与恶意软件，因此备受追捧。猛烈的追捕，使它一见人类就迅速逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's ribbons have the power to clear a computer instantly of all viruses and malware, making it highly sought after. Aggressive hunting tactics towards it have made it quick to flee the moment it spies humans.

entry: POKENAME能模仿视野中任何石头的粗糙质感，主要在苦恼时使用，吓阻潜在敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME mimics the roughness of any stone within its eyesight. It primarily does this when distressed to ward off potential foes.

entry: POKENAME旋转够快，便能在近处掀起沙暴。此时，身体质地会变得异乎寻常地粗粝，如同沙子。
author: .izik
source: When rotating fast enough, POKENAME can generate sandstorms in its immediate area. During this time its body takes on an unnaturally gritty texture resembling sand.

entry: 即使在网络空间以外，POKENAME也能造出全由二进制数据组成的浓密沙暴，遮掩行动。藏好后，它会蓄能，从躯干核心射出强大能量束。
author: sk372
source: Even outside of cyberspace, POKENAME can create thick sandstorms made entirely of binary data to obscure its movements. While hidden away, it charges up and fires powerful beams of energy from the core in its torso.

entry: POKENAME大翼一振，卷起的虚拟风，就足以把用户电脑里所有文件位置彻底重排。叫声听来像海浪拍岸的数字录音。
author: sk372
source: A single flap of POKENAME's large wings kicks up enough virtual wind to completely rearrange the placement of every file in a user's computer. Its cry sounds like a digital recording of crashing ocean waves.

entry: POKENAME把鼻子贴上服务器，吸收其中数据。受打扰时，尾巴先亮起深蓝光，再放出强力雷电。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME presses its nose to servers to absorb the data within. When disturbed, its tail glows a deep blue before it unleashes a powerful bolt of electricity.

entry: POKENAME能修复毁坏的科技设备，使其重新可用。不过，这样复原的设备，软件与元件都会过时，性能与功能也会降低。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is able to bring back destroyed and broken technology and allow them to become usable again. However, devices recovered this way will have outdated software and components along with lowered functionality and features.

entry: POKENAME看似由数十年前的代码构成，却能无缝融入任何复杂程度的科技。它能修复损坏数据与机器，随后伴着悦耳旋律消失。
author: pjporwoll
source: Despite POKENAME appearing to be made of code from decades ago, it can integrate seamlessly with technology of any complexity. It has the ability to fix corrupted data or damaged machines, disappearing in a pleasant melody afterwards.

entry: POKENAME将需妥善保管的重要数据，存进尾巴。为躲避恶意病毒与软件，它会用尾巴把自己弹到另一个电脑网络。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME stores any important data that needs safekeeping inside of its tail. To run from malicious viruses or malware, it flings itself using its tail to escape to another computer network.

entry: POKENAME潜入城市电子设备，等候最佳时机。它制造声音与画面，刺激当地野生黑暗鸦，使其喧闹不休，造成混乱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME infiltrates electronics in urban areas and waits for the perfect moment. It creates noises and visuals that trigger wild Murkrow in the area, causing them to act uproariously and sow chaos.

entry: 数据流停止运作时，POKENAME能将数据吸入，在终点鸣叫着放出，让流动继续。它必须小心，吸得太多，就会重得动不了。
author: soup1900
source: When a data stream ceases to function, POKENAME can absorb the data and cry them out at their endpoint to continue the flow. It must be careful not to absorb too much data; otherwise, it becomes too heavy to move.

entry: 为了解周围，POKENAME试着模仿所见的一切。可动作太简单，学不了多数行为，最后大多只模仿岩石与树。
author: soup1900
source: To learn more about a surrounding, POKENAME attempts to mimic everything it sees. Unfortunately, it ends up mimicking rocks and trees most of the time since its basic movements hold it back from copying most actions.

entry: POKENAME能彻底化为程序数据，借此模仿看见的对象，理解对方的感情。
author: blaizegamer
source: POKENAME is capable of completely converting itself into programing data. It uses this ability to mimic those it sees and to understand their feelings.

entry: POKENAME总为头毛太尖、无法变圆而烦恼。它们带着的蓝珠，装满深受孩子欢迎的电子游戏程序。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME constantly become bothered by how pointy their hair is and their inability to round them. The blue orbs they carry are full of video game programs that are popular with young children.

entry: POKENAME把尖尾强插进服务器，迅速吸收数据为食。受打扰，就大声哔叫，放出电击后逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME forcibly inserts the pointed end of its tail into servers to rapidly absorb data as food. If disturbed, it beeps loudly and unleashes a Thunder Shock before fleeing.

entry: POKENAME身体由数字数据构成，能把背纹随意变成任何样子。有人甚至见它们掠过水面时，背上正播放游戏或节目。
author: soup1900
source: With their bodies being made of digital data, POKENAME are able to freely change the patterns on their backs to be anything they want. Some people have even observed games or shows being played on their backs as they skimmed the surface.

entry: 即使在物质世界，POKENAME也会充当保安，搜捕闹事者。将自认的坏人抓牢后，它就发出警笛般的巨响。
author: bobosmith01
source: Even in the physical world, POKENAME acts as a form of security; it searches for troublemakers and seizes them. Once it has properly apprehended what it has deemed a malefactor, it emits a loud siren-esque noise.

entry: POKENAME有独特本领，只需一舔，就能读取、删除设备数据。许多废品场会养一只，在设备回收前清空数据。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a unique ability of reading and deleting data on devices with a single lick. Many junkyards keep a POKENAME on site to clear data before recycling devices.

entry: 程序员着迷于POKENAME的数据结构，因为代码难读，一经修改又会变成新的内容。有人推测，这是它有意掩藏壳下真正的形态。
author: bobosmith01
source: Programmers are fascinated by POKENAME's data structure, as the code is difficult to read and it morphs into something new if altered. It has been theorized that POKENAME is consciously doing this to mask its true hidden form underneath its shell.

entry: POKENAME周身的一团结构，像早期电脑屏幕保护程序。藤蔓交缠的迷人画面，多年来让许多用户分了心。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a mass across their bodies that resembles early PC screensavers. The mesmerizing display of entangling vines has distracted many users over the years.

entry: POKENAME自身发电不足，无法长久满负荷运作。为补足储电，它用线缆从找到的任何运作中电子设备吸取电力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body doesn't generate enough electricity to keep itself at max capacity for long. To top off its electrical stores, it uses its cables to siphon power from any working electronics it can find.

entry: POKENAME感知谁今天过得愉快，就飘在旁边，开心哔叫、起舞。感到的快乐越强，舞蹈就越凌乱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats near those it senses are having a good day, letting out happy beeps and dancing. The more intense the happiness it detects, the more erratic its dance becomes.

entry: 遇险时，POKENAME会蜷成方块，自我防护。小群还会团结起来，把方块身体紧紧叠放，增强防御。
author: sk372
source: When threatened, POKENAME will roll itself up into a cube for self-defense. Small groups of POKENAME may band together to stack their cubed selves close together to increase their defenses.

entry: POKENAME快速拍翼，维持飞行，每拍一下就放出电磁脉冲。通常每秒100次，快得让周围设备无法正常运作。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rapidly flap their wings to remain airborne, releasing an electromagnetic pulse with each flap. They typically flap at 100 times a second, a rate so fast that it stops devices around them from functioning properly.

entry: POKENAME吸收阳光入体，保持活力。能量充足后，它会放出微光，使附近的人造植物开花生长。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME keeps itself energized by absorbing sunlight into its body. Once suitably full of energy, it emits a faint light that causes artificial plants to bloom and grow nearby.

entry: POKENAME靠近电脑等电子设备，待得越久，设备就越慢。到一定程度，便会彻底死机。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's presence near computers and other electronics causes them to slow down more the longer it stays nearby. After a point, the devices will freeze up completely.

entry: POKENAME在网络空间走到哪里，猛烈的暴风雪特效就跟到哪里，遮住大部分屏幕。它又强又重，常很难移走，多数人只好等它自己离开。
author: sk372
source: Wherever in cyberspace POKENAME roams, a heavy blizzard effect follows it, obscuring most of the screen. Powerful and heavy, it's often difficult to remove POKENAME, forcing most to simply wait until it leaves on its own.

entry: 这次融合让它的代码变得稳定，不再出现错误。然而，它也失去了所有情感，以及身为多边兽Ⅱ时学会的大部分能力。
author: soup1900
source: This fusion caused its code to become stable and error-free. However, it has lost all emotion and most capabilities it learned when it was a Porygon2.

entry: POKENAME向敌人发射代码种子。每颗含有随机DNA，会生成随机种类的花。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shoots out seeds made out of code at its foes. Each seed contains randomized DNA that causes a random flower to spawn.

entry: POKENAME用叶刃斩切敌人。战斗中，随着受伤程度增加，荧光绿的身体会变成黄色或红色。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME slices through foes with its leafy blades. Its neon green color changes to yellow or red depending on how much damage it has taken in the course of a battle.

entry: POKENAME靠身上叶刃斩切敌人。战斗落于下风，它就会超频运转身体，增强草属性招式。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME relies on the leafy blades on its body to slice through foes. Whenever it is falling behind during a battle, it overclocks its body to boost its Grass-type moves.

entry: POKENAME吃废弃电子零件、软盘与光盘等旧存储设备。吃下后，记忆容量便扩展，让它能学会新招式。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a diet that consists of scrap electronic parts and old data storage devices like diskettes and compact discs. By eating these devices, it expands its memory to allow it to learn new moves.

entry: POKENAME身体由软塑料构成，一碰就沙沙响。体内有一块预煮干燥的面饼与调味包。调味十分浓烈，许多人只吃一部分。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a soft plastic body that crinkles when touched. Inside its body is a precooked and dried block of noodles with a spice packet. Many people only eat part of the spice packet because the spice is very intense.

entry: 这只宝可梦由矿物数据创造，能改变身体，模仿某些矿物特性。例如，它能变得如钻石坚硬，但每次使用这份能力之间，须先休息。
author: infinex21
source: This Pokémon was created from mineral data and is capable of altering its body to mimic the properties of some minerals. For example, it can make its body as tough as diamond, though it must rest between uses of this ability.

entry: POKENAME遇险会蜷成立方体，将刺贴平，挡开攻击。一找到破绽，它就用背刺扫击敌人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME curls its body into a cubic shape when threatened and keeps its spikes flat to deflect attacks. Once it finds an opening, it swipes at its foe with the spines on its back.

entry: POKENAME靠强劲踢击与灼热火焰，在宝可梦对战中取胜。猛踢后，会在对手身上留下代码标记，帮助瞄准火焰攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME relies on its powerful kicks and searing hot flames to secure victory in a Pokémon battle. After a strong kick, a code marker is left on its opponent's body, helping aim its fiery attacks.

entry: POKENAME为击败对手不惜一切，战斗越久，越会超频身体，加快运转。它靠连番锐利踢击与猛烈火焰，结束战斗。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME will stop at nothing to achieve victory over its opponent, as it will overclock its body to run faster as a battle progresses. It relies on a flurry of sharp kicks and potent flames to finish a Pokémon battle.

entry: POKENAME整天用头鳍监视数据流，确保可疑或恶意数据无法通过。一发现，就以巨力将代码碾成碎片。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME spends all day monitoring data streams using the fin on its head to make sure no suspicious or malicious data passes through. When it detects any, it uses its immense strength to crush the code into fragments.

entry: POKENAME在沼泽附近涂满泥巴，吸收水分。此时，身体质地也会变得极像碰到的泥。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME coats itself in mud near swamps to absorb moisture. During this period its body takes on a texture closely resembling the mud it touched.

entry: POKENAME能与一台设备高度连通，随时了解上面发生的一切。它若看似无故变得过分高兴、温暖，就表示相连的设备过热了。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can highly attune itself to a device and always know everything and anything that happens to it. When it starts becoming overly cheerful and warm for seemingly no reason, it means the device it's attuned to is overheating.

entry: POKENAME最广为人知的身份，是面向女性的一系列电脑配件的吉祥物。随之而来的名气，如今让野生个体越来越难寻。
author: divinelunaria
source: POKENAME are most recognizable for their use as a mascot for a range of computer accessories targeted at women. POKENAME are now becoming difficult to find in the wild due to their associated popularity.

entry: POKENAME在电脑旁跳舞，会让电脑运转加快。可一停止旋转，电脑系统就可能崩溃。
author: .izik
source: While dancing near computers, POKENAME causes them to operate faster. When it stops spinning, the systems on those computers can crash.

entry: POKENAME能用任何东西构成引力奇点，造出微型黑洞，连一粒沙，乃至空无一物的空气也行。奇怪而难解的是，黑洞的事件视界竟呈多边形。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME can create a mini black hole by building a gravitational singularity out of anything, even a grain of sand or just thin air. The strange and inexplicable part is that the event horizon of the resulting black hole has a polygonal shape.

entry: POKENAME能理解、说出多种语言，会这本领的宝可梦不止它一种。
author: imagine1.
source: POKENAME can understand and speak various languages. It is one of many Pokémon that are capable of this.

entry: POKENAME智慧极高，无论在网络空间内外，都能分析、操纵数据。黑客破解加密信息时，视它为无价的伙伴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is highly intelligent, able to analyze and manipulate data whether in or out of cyberspace. Hackers find it invaluable as a partner for cracking encrypted information.

entry: POKENAME脸上的屏幕，会随情绪改变。虽然自认聪明，有时却相当傻气。
author: imagine1.
source: The screen on POKENAME's face changes based on its feelings. It can be quite foolish at times, even though it has a high estimation of its own intelligence.

entry: POKENAME从肘部伸出纯数据刀刃，尤其擅长斩碎恶意数据存储体，因此十分善于处理网络空间的恶意软件。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME extends blades made of pure data from its elbows. These blades are particularly effective at cutting up malicious data stores, making it very adept at dealing with malware in cyberspace.

entry: 据说POKENAME由删除的数据形成，不知为何获得了自身形态。它一出现在屏幕，就既无法移走，也无法互动，只会静静观察用户，再自行离开。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to be formed from deleted data that somehow managed to attain a form of its own. When it appears on a screen, it cannot be removed or even interacted with; it quietly observes the user before leaving on its own.

entry: 每只POKENAME都由不同矿物的数据创造，因此各有细微不同。共同点是，爪与刺毛总是身体最坚硬的部分。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME were each created from the data of various minerals, so each one is slightly different from one another in some way. The main commonality is that their claws and quills are always the toughest parts of their bodies.

entry: POKENAME吃东西时，持续发出低频哔声。受打扰，就会从体内释放毒气，使人咳嗽不止。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits a low frequency beep consistently while eating. If disturbed, it releases a toxic fume from its body capable of causing coughing fits.

entry: POKENAME能融入电脑屏幕背景，躲避注意，但伪装有其限度。身后若播放动态特效或视频，它便无法好好融进去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can blend into the background of a computer screen to avoid detection, but its camouflage is only so effective. It cannot properly blend into moving screen effects or videos that play behind it.

entry: POKENAME虽有些念力，却更爱用身体撞击敌人。它还能把本已棱角分明的身体磨得更尖，让自己更危险、更具威慑力。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME prefer to ram their bodies into foes even though they have some telekinetic abilities. They have a remarkable ability to sharpen their already-jagged bodies to make themselves even more threatening and dangerous.

entry: POKENAME常附着电脑，吃其中数据。有时身体得来回转好几遍，才能终于接上，并牢牢待住。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME will often attach themselves to computers to feed upon the data they contain. They sometimes have to rotate their bodies around multiple times before they can finally attach and stay attached.

entry: POKENAME身体由奇特合金构成，能随时改变质地。毛茸茸、粗糙、光滑或满是泡沫，它都能轻易模仿。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is composed of an odd metal alloy capable of changing texture at a moment's notice. It can mimic furry, coarse, smooth, and bubbly textures with ease.

entry: 这种宝可梦的身体像某种流行的数字生物，它们从吞吃的数据中了解这种生物。自卫时，会从脸上的“X”放出能量。
author: infinex21
source: The body of this species of Pokémon resembles a popular digital creature, which they learn of through the data they consume. They release bursts of energy from the "X" on their faces to defend themselves.

entry: POKENAME头脑简单，只遵循搭庇护所这一个基本任务。它从用户电脑取走文件等数据，堆在身边。用户想拿回被偷的部件，它就会难过。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a simple mind and follows one basic task of building a shelter. It grabs files and other data from a user's computer and piles it all together around it. It gets sad when a user tries to retrieve the stolen components.

entry: POKENAME很单纯，会拿训练家桌面的文件，搭小庇护所。训练家想拿回，它们便不高兴，甚至开始啃咬拿走的文件。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are simple creatures that grab files from their Trainer's desktop to form a small shelter. Whenever their Trainer tries to take back the files, they become upset and may start chewing on the files they have taken.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME由108个同时运行的损坏程序构成。容器是一张旧磁盘，插入哪台电脑，就会肆虐其中的数据。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is believed to be made of 108 corrupted programs working simultaneously. Its vessel takes the form of an old disk that will ravage the data of any computer it is inserted into.

entry: POKENAME以各种出人意料的方式，运用悬浮四肢，精研战斗与擒拿。有些地方还会举行格斗赛，让它们与同类交手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its floating limbs in various unorthodox ways to master the art of combat and grappling. Fighting tournaments are held in some areas that pit POKENAME against others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME藏进重要程序，恶意软件或病毒一来，就跳出来咬。为给自己保暖，它让所在设备发热，电池也因此很快耗尽。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME burrows inside of important programs and leaps out to chomp when malware or viruses enter. To keep itself warm, it causes the device it's in to run hot, causing the battery to drain very quickly.

entry: 为容纳收集的大量信息，POKENAME的数据核心变大了。相比自然世界，它在网络空间更能控制核心的形状。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's data core has grown in size to accommodate the massive amount of information it has collected. POKENAME has more control over the shape of its data core when in cyberspace than in the natural world.

entry: POKENAME的哔声，似乎用于同类交流。准备从头部喷毒时，哔声就会变得响亮急促。
author: .izik
source: The beeps POKENAME produces appear to serve as communication among its kin. As it prepares to spew poison from its head, these beeps grow loud and rapid.

entry: 若POKENAME出现在设备上，千万别与它互动。它用可爱声音与玩耍动作，哄用户陪玩，再张开假嘴，向电脑放出许多病毒。
author: sk372
source: One should never interact with a POKENAME that appears on their device. It tries to coax users to play with it with cute sounds and playful mannerisms, then opens its false mouth to unleash a number of viruses into the computer.

entry: POKENAME歇在海床时，强电流通过线缆般的脖子。它能猛然放电，击晕靠近的捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME conducts a powerful electric current through its cord-like neck while resting on the sea floor. It can release this charge in a burst to stun approaching predators.

entry: POKENAME凭8片翅膀，能快速穿行网络空间，抓住高速数据流中的恶意程序。小而锋利的爪，还能挑出某几个数据位，从系统中移除。
author: soup1900
source: With its 8 wings, POKENAME can swiftly travel through cyberspace and capture malicious programs running through quick data streams. Its small but sharp claws allow it to pick out certain few bits of data and remove them from a system.

entry: POKENAME的程序规定，所有问题都用头撞解决。它不懂其他逻辑，只会不停拿头撞，直到发生点什么。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME was programmed to solve all of its problems by headbutting. Knowing no other logic, it continuously rams stuff with its head until something happens.

entry: POKENAME主要用于网络安全前线，以盾牌般的脸挡住网络攻击。不过，它们只擅长正面防御，绕行的攻击很容易溜过去。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are mainly used as the front lines in cybersecurity, using their shield-like faces to block cyberattacks. However, they are only good at blocking from the front, so any attack that moves around them can easily slip by.

entry: 凭借强壮力量，POKENAME被用于协助仓库搬运大箱与集装箱。不知为何，它们爱滚木桶，常把已经整理好的物品弄乱。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Thanks to their strength, POKENAME are being used to aid in the lifting of large crates and containers in warehouses. For a currently unknown reason, they enjoy rolling barrels, often making messes of the items they already organized.

entry: POKENAME看见同类遭袭，就会发出尖锐哔声。它能从王冠般的头部，向四面喷毒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lets out a shrill beep when it sees its kin under attack. It can spew poison in all directions through its crown-like head.

entry: POKENAME受电流嗡鸣吸引，爱扑向移动物体玩。一碰就会扰乱代码、使机器短路，它却似乎很喜欢闪灯与火花，浑然不知留下的混乱。
author: vhscopyofmeangirls
source: Drawn to the hum of electric currents, POKENAME playfully pounces on moving objects. Its touch scrambles code and shorts out machines, but it seems to enjoy the flickering lights and sparks, blissfully unaware of the chaos it leaves behind.

entry: POKENAME进入程序，会使其以诡异方式出错、偏离正常运作。许多恐怖故事与诅咒游戏传闻，都源于它的力量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's presence within a program causes the program to deviate and glitch in eerie ways. Many scary stories and rumors about cursed games were the result of POKENAME's powers.

entry: POKENAME程序简单原始，多用于网络空间内外的基础守卫工作。庞大身体充当路障，它还会从鼻孔射出能量束自卫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has simple and rudimentary programming that makes it mostly used for simple guard duties both in and out of cyberspace. Its bulky form acts as a blockade, and it defends itself with beams of energy shot from the hole in its nose.

entry: 有人说，分析阿尔宙斯相关文献时，一场奇怪的编程事故，造出了POKENAME。它出现在网络空间的任何地方，都有二进制代码组成的奇特气息相随。
author: sk372
source: Some say POKENAME came to be through a strange programming accident while analyzing documents related to Arceus. A strange aura of binary code follows it wherever it appears in cyberspace.

entry: POKENAME发出信号，探测附近电脑设备时，头芽会长得极长。一旦定位，就会贪婪地大口吞食设备。
author: .izik
source: The sprout on POKENAME's head grows incredibly long when sending out signals to detect nearby computer equipment. Once located, it devours the equipment in large greedy bites.

entry: POKENAME背上长着数据灌木，偶尔结出数字果实，随后脱落，留给探索网络空间的其他多边兽融合体，充作可口点心。
author: sk372
source: Shrubs made of data grow on POKENAME's back. On occasion, these bushes sprout digital fruit and fall off, left behind as a flavorful treat for other Porygon fusions exploring cyberspace.

entry: POKENAME背上承载着数字景观，让开发者在身临其境的环境中编写游戏。程序一遇漏洞，背上便长出尖刺。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME hosts a digital landscape on its back, allowing developers to program their games in an immersive environment. Spikes grow out of its back when its program encounters a bug.

entry: POKENAME总想引人注意，会吃掉路由器，禁用附近无线信号。接着，它们靠近人，想用背上跑动的奇怪生物逗乐对方。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Constantly wanting attention, POKENAME will eat routers to disable wireless signals in their vicinity. POKENAME then approach people, seeking to entertain them with the strange creature running along their backs.

entry: 若受病毒或恶意代码影响，POKENAME便将其变成火焰攻击的燃料。敏捷身手，让它能迅速游遍网络空间，在恶意软件严重破坏网络前将其抓住。
author: soup1900
source: If POKENAME is ever affected by a virus or malicious code, it converts that code into fuel for its fire attacks. Its agility allows it to roam through cyberspace quickly and catch malware before they can severely damage the network.

entry: POKENAME由毒物与毒液的数据创造，以便用其他方式做不到的手段，实验其效果。每根背刺含不同数据组，个体间也各不相同。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME were created from the data of poisons and venoms as a means to experiment with their effects in ways otherwise impossible. Each of the spikes on their backs contains different sets of data that vary between individuals.

entry: POKENAME先发出一连串极响的哔声，再从双手喷火。火焰热得转眼就能将沙熔成玻璃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lets out a series of incredibly loud beeps before releasing flames from its hands. These flames are hot enough to melt sand into glass in moments.

entry: 这种宝可梦由数据创造，为的是协助监测冰盖附近等酷寒环境。它们从毛发状触角传送信息时，会站着不动，因此头周围常会结冰。
author: infinex21
source: A Pokémon created from data with the intent of helping to monitor unbearably cold environments, such as near ice caps. They stand still when transmitting information from their hair-like antennae, which often leads to ice forming around their heads.

entry: 这种宝可梦由数据创造，为的是协助监测冰盖附近等酷寒环境。动作虽然僵硬有限，却无意中帮助它们在寒冷环境节省能量。
author: infinex21
source: A Pokémon created from data with the intent of helping to monitor unbearably cold environments, such as near ice caps. Their movements are rather rigid and limited, though this inadvertently helps them conserve energy in their cold environs.

entry: 这种宝可梦由波加曼及其进化形态的记录数据创造，目的是混入波加曼群，监测它们与其他极寒地区宝可梦的健康。目前，它正如预期般工作。
author: infinex21
source: A Pokémon created from the recorded data of Piplup and its evolutions. The intent behind this Pokémon's creation was for it to blend in among Piplup and monitor the well-being of them and other arctic Pokémon. So far, it is performing as intended.

entry: POKENAME始终指向磁北，即使吃东西或对战，也不例外。连数据损坏、恶意软件都无法改变朝向，是可靠的导航帮手。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME always point to magnetic north, even when eating or fighting in a Pokémon battle. Not even data corruption or malware can affect POKENAME's orientation, making them reliable Pokémon to help with navigation.

entry: 无论周围状况如何，POKENAME都指向磁北。它小得能装进训练家口袋，是四处行走、辨认方向的可靠伙伴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME always point to magnetic north regardless of the conditions around them. Small enough to fit in a Trainer's pocket, POKENAME make reliable partners while navigating through the world.

entry: POKENAME善于操纵磁力，能强迫普通磁铁指向自己。磁力虽强，它们却总朝磁北，即使在战斗中也是如此。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have great control over magnetism and can force standard magnets to point in their direction. Despite this powerful magnetism, they always orient themselves toward magnetic north, even in battle.

entry: 人们试图在实验电脑中复制、粘贴数码独剑鞘，原始数据却意外损坏，变成了一只全新而诡异的宝可梦——POKENAME。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: In an effort to copy and paste a digital Honedge in an experimental PC, the original instead corrupted into a new, uncanny Pokémon: a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME挥身斩向病毒，保卫电脑。不过，战斗技巧基础，较强而复杂的病毒，很容易击败它们。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME defend computers by slashing themselves at viruses. However, due to their basic combat skills, more powerful and complicated viruses can easily defeat them.

entry: POKENAME见谁都要战斗，剑术简单、容易预测，每次想击中对手，都会先跳一下。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME engages in combat with whoever it sees. Its swordplay is basic and predictable. It jumps every time it wants to land a hit.

entry: POKENAME不用盾时，盾部便包裹刀刃。需要时，它展开并硬化到惊人程度，挡开攻击，再让刀刃迅速刺穿敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's shield section wraps around its blade when not in use. When needed, it unfurls and stiffens to an incredible hardness to deflect strikes before letting its blade quickly stab and pierce into its foes.

entry: POKENAME与同类并肩作战，会排成笔直队形。它们同步使出棱角化，将刃状尾巴的伤害提升到最大。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lines up in a perfectly straight formation when fighting alongside its kin. They use Sharpen in unison to maximize the damage their bladed tails can inflict.

entry: POKENAME穿行电脑时，身体会变得坚硬锋利。它斩切桌面图标，试验数字身体的锋口。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body grows rigid and razor sharp as it travels through computers. It slashes at desktop icons to test the edge of its digital body.

entry: POKENAME的面罩能调节视力，有红外、夜视等模式，还能防护不利环境。因此，想晃花它的眼或降低命中，几乎不可能。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's visor allows it to adjust its eyesight, able to use settings such as infrared and night-vision. It also serves to protect it against adverse elements, so blinding it or lowering its accuracy is next to impossible.

entry: POKENAME以厚甲板保护自己。若某块脱离主体，就会融成一行行代码。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their thick armor plates to protect themselves from attacks. If a piece breaks off from the main body, the piece melts into lines of code.

entry: POKENAME双翼质地随状态变化。平静时光滑，战斗时却粗糙得能撕碎石头。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wings shift in texture depending on its state. When calm they are smooth, but during battle they roughen enough to shred stone.

entry: 漫长下载后，代码赋予了它飞行能力。可多余的代码也带来了难以约束的暴怒。
author: thecrowartiste
source: As a result of a long download, its code enabled its ability to fly. However, it also inherited an unruly rage from excess code.

entry: POKENAME身体的各部分，能同时以不同速度旋转。转动会慢慢从周围电脑吸取数据为食。
author: .izik
source: Each portion of POKENAME's body can rotate at different speeds simultaneously. This rotation slowly draws in data from surrounding computers as sustenance.

entry: POKENAME操纵数据，让物体显得与实物不同，借此恶意捉弄用户，使其误点本不想点的链接，常因此招来恶意软件。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can manipulate data to make objects appear to be different from what they truly are. It uses this to maliciously prank users by making them accidentally click on links they never intended to, often resulting in malware.

entry: POKENAME是卡洛斯创造的人造宝可梦，用来验证：能否以计算机代码，复制出任何一种宝可梦。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME is an artificial Pokémon that was created in Kalos to test the idea that any Pokémon could be replicated through computer code.

entry: POKENAME能让附近电脑屏幕散出奇光，使照到的对象平静。它只能短暂施展几次，便会非常疲倦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can cause an odd light to emanate from nearby computer monitors that calms anyone it touches. It can only do this in brief bursts before growing very tired.

entry: POKENAME爱进入网上国际象棋游戏，取代国王。游戏从未编写过它，它只是毫无预告地出现。
author: equation8573
source: POKENAME loves to go into online chess games to replace the king. It is never coded in, it just appears in the game unannounced.

entry: POKENAME进入电脑，在数字空间制造强大漩涡，把所有数据聚拢吞下。结束后，经历这番过程的系统，所有端口都会涌出滔滔水流。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME enters computers and creates powerful whirlpools in digital space, gathering all data into one place before consuming it. Systems that undergo this process spew water from every port in massive torrents when it is done.

entry: POKENAME天生能操纵某些数据，自由改变电脑窗口、任务栏与滚动条的尺寸。它喜欢趁用户离开屏幕，借此捉弄对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has an innate power to manipulate certain data, allowing it to freely change the dimensions of windows, task-bars and scroll-bars on computers. It enjoys messing with computer users by doing this while they're away from the screen.

entry: POKENAME住在昂贵的三维程序中，帮助艺术学生学习制作三维图像。若学生差得离谱，它就会生气，让电脑过热。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME reside in expensive 3D programs, helping art students learn how to make 3D images. If a student is egregiously bad, POKENAME becomes angry, leading to the computer overheating.

entry: POKENAME用专用传送门，迅速从臭氧层到地面，或进入网络空间。它从嘴里射出强大二进制代码光束，摧毁抵抗者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses specialized portals to travel quickly from the ozone to the ground or into cyberspace. It devastates opposition with a powerful beam of binary code launched from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME在高层大气飘荡，看似毫无规律。它偶尔尖叫出拨号声，扭曲周围空间维度。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME floats around in the upper atmosphere, seemingly at random. It occasionally screams dial-up noises that twist the dimensions around it.

entry: POKENAME挥臂，便能生成直通网络空间的传送门。有人相信，它会把得罪自己的对象放逐数字世界，永不复返，作为惩罚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can generate portals directly connected to cyberspace with a swing of its arms. Some believe POKENAME punishes those who have wronged it by banishing them into the digital world, never to return.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME逃离一个损坏的数字世界后，来到了我们的世界。它能切开通往网络空间的门，将别人放逐其中。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is believed to have crossed over to our world after escaping a corrupted digital world. It can cut open portals to cyberspace and banish others within them.

entry: POKENAME搭建电脑的本领出众。有些科学家打趣，只给一箱废料，它也能在洞穴里造出超级电脑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses a remarkable constructive skill concerning computers. Some scientists joke that POKENAME could create a supercomputer inside a cave using nothing but a box of scraps.

entry: 若用电脑时毫无预兆地睡着，很可能是POKENAME来访。只要它出现在屏幕上，就足以让观看者陷入无梦的睡眠，醒来完全不记得它来过。
author: sk372
source: If one falls asleep without warning while using a computer, it is likely they were visited by POKENAME. Just its appearance on the screen is enough to send the viewer into a dreamless sleep, waking with no memory of its visit.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，第一要务是摆姿势。它常打得花哨，炮还会射出晃眼强光，衬托身姿。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's number one priority during a fight is striking poses. It regularly engages in flashy combat, and its cannon shoots blinding lights that emphasize this.

entry: POKENAME爱藏在电脑中被隐藏、遗忘的文件夹里。只有设备进入睡眠模式，它才会出来。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME likes to hide itself inside of computer folders hidden and forgotten away. It only comes out once the device is on sleep mode.

entry: 据说创造POKENAME，是为了发电，给强大电脑提供无限电源。但电力太强，现代机器承受不住，它一试着充电，电脑就会过载爆炸。
author: sk372
source: Supposedly, POKENAME was created to generate electricity to act as an infinite power source for powerful computers. Its power is too great for modern machines to handle, however; computers overload and explode if it tries to charge them.

entry: POKENAME的悬浮手臂，将一种独特的闪亮花粉撒向地面。长出的植物小巧无害，却呈奇怪方块状，让有些人莫名怀念。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's floating arms dispense a strange and unique sort of shining pollen onto the ground. Plants grown from it are small and harmless, but have a strange, blocky appearance that feels oddly nostalgic to some.

entry: POKENAME轻轻飘过网络空间，寻找以多云天空为壁纸的桌面。找到后，就会哔哔啵啵地叫，引来同类。
author: daniel360n
source: POKENAME gently floats around cyberspace in an attempt to find desktops with a wallpaper of a cloudy sky. It will then let out a series of beeps and boops to attract other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME进入电脑，便会针对杀毒程序，原因不明。它用数字绒毛覆住，渐渐妨碍程序运作。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME targets antivirus programs for unknown reasons upon entering a computer. It covers them in a digital fluff that steadily impedes their functions.

entry: 它纤细如铁丝的身体，能扭成各种形状。听见音乐，就会开心地随节奏跳跃。
author: beekirby
source: Its thin, wiry body can contort into many different shapes. When it hears music, it happily skips to the beat.

entry: POKENAME隔一阵就会脱落身上的蘑菇。吃红蘑菇有助健康成长、肌肉发育；吃绿蘑菇则能增强免疫力、延长寿命。
author: hophoppip
source: Every so often, POKENAME sheds the mushrooms that grow on its body. Consuming the red mushrooms supports healthy growth and muscle development, while consuming the green ones strengthens the immune system and extends one's life.

entry: POKENAME双腿强壮，能跳得很高，双臂也能打出足以砸穿砖墙的拳击。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's strong legs allow it to jump high, and its arms can deliver punches powerful enough to smash brick walls.

entry: 不知为何，POKENAME似乎与小孩子有仇。它侵入他们的电子设备，用巨响与画面故障制造混乱，吓唬他们。
author: sk372
source: For unknown reasons, POKENAME seems to have a vendetta towards young children. It invades their electronics and tries to cause havoc and frighten them with loud noises and graphical glitches.

entry: POKENAME常在宝可梦中心与友好商店之间传递消息，主要报告送货进度与突发事件。紧急时，它还能为故障机器与电气设备供电。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME are commonly used to send messages between Pokémon Centers and Marts, mainly for updates on deliveries and incidents. In emergency situations, POKENAME can be used to power faulty machines and electrical equipment.

entry: POKENAME常被说外形令人摸不着头脑。谁试图理解这奇怪形态，就会严重头痛。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME is often described as having a very confusing appearance. Those who attempt to understand its strange form get terrible headaches.

entry: POKENAME受压时，从体内放出精神脉冲。附近熟睡的人说，他们会梦见四周一切都覆满代码行。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits psychic pulses from its body when stressed. Nearby sleeping people report dreams where everything around them is covered in lines of code.

entry: POKENAME分析周围风况，仔细计算飞行轨迹。升空后，它能快速调整航线躲障碍，因此很少坠落。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME carefully calculates the trajectory of its flight by analyzing the wind conditions around it. Once airborne, POKENAME rarely crashes, as its rapid adjustments to its flight path allow it to dodge obstacles.

entry: POKENAME能完美融入任何环境，唯有先进科技才能探测。它们不需呼吸，即使水下也能躲藏很久。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME are capable of perfectly camouflaging to any environment, only detectable with advanced technology. POKENAME do not need to breathe, allowing them to hide for long periods of time, even underwater.

entry: 用POKENAME的数据丝连接的电脑，能以惊人速度共享信息。科学家研究多年，仍未弄清原理与制法。
author: .izik
source: Computers connected by POKENAME's data-created silk are able to share information at remarkable speeds. Scientists have studied this silk for years without uncovering how it works or how it is made.

entry: POKENAME触须末端的形状，放出独特磁力，使它附着多数表面。几何形状因个体而异，很少有相同组合。
author: sk372
source: The shapes at the ends of POKENAME's tendrils emit a unique magnetism that lets it cling to most surfaces. The geometric shapes vary between specimens; very few have the same combination.

entry: POKENAME吸取附近运作中电子设备的能量。进食时，头顶二进制代码的火焰会长大，快速闪烁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME feeds off the energy of active electronic devices in its vicinity. As it does so, the flame of binary code on top of its head grows in size and flickers rapidly.

entry: POKENAME在寄居的手机屏幕顶部，平静摇摆。它现身时，若摇晃设备，手机就会变得极热，随后关机。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sways calmly from the top of cellphone screens that it inhabits. Should the device be shaken while it is visible, the phone will grow extremely hot and shut down.

entry: POKENAME似乎为守护数据存储体而存在，沉着地站在网络空间。身体略有磨损，胸部漏出的数据，偶尔使它行动迟缓。
author: sk372
source: Seemingly existing to guard and protect data stores, POKENAME stands stoically in cyberspace. Its body is slightly worn, leaking data from the chest and occasionally causing it to move sluggishly.

entry: POKENAME用得到的数据，在主尾上长出更多尾部组件。数据够多，这些组件上，最后还能再长更小的尾部组件。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses the data it gains to grow more tail pieces on the main tail of its body. With enough data, it can eventually grow tinier tail pieces on its grown tail pieces as well.

entry: POKENAME在网络空间，依内部程序吞下坏代码或损坏代码，再消化。身体覆有杀毒程序，保护它不因接触恶意软件而生病。
author: soup1900
source: When in cyberspace, POKENAME swallows bad or corrupted code using its internal programming and digests it down. Its body is coated in an antivirus that protects it from becoming sick from exposure to malware.

entry: POKENAME总坚持，自己能帮训练家操作某些电脑程序。可真问起建议，POKENAME又很少给得出有用的。
author: gp423
source: POKENAME constantly insists on helping its Trainer use certain computer programs. Despite this, POKENAME rarely has any helpful advice to give.

entry: POKENAME用伪装，在网络空间假扮多边兽。它想帮助用户工作，却其实不太懂代码等事，能帮的忙至多微乎其微。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its disguise to masquerade as Porygon in cyberspace. It wants to help users with their tasks, but it actually knows little about code and the like, so its assistance is minimal at best.

entry: POKENAME常见于大型服务器机房，以多余数据或代码为食。若吃得太多，双翼就会开始大量放热。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be found in large server rooms, feeding on any excess data or code. If it consumes too much data, its wings will start to release large amounts of heat.

entry: POKENAME无论在网络空间内外，都很难寻踪。一被发现，便立刻高速逃离，身后留下一道二进制代码。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is highly elusive, both in and out of cyberspace. If spotted, it flees immediately at high speeds, leaving a trail of binary code in its wake.

entry: POKENAME在城市高空飞行，寻找有个人电脑的住家。翼内的小型接收器，能从最远1000英尺外，吸收这些设备的数据。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies high above cities in search of homes with personal computers. It can absorb data from these devices from up to 1000 feet away through small receptors within its wings.

entry: 人们认为，太空站电脑感染奇怪病毒时，最初的POKENAME便形成了。它能随意变形，触须一碰电脑，就会传入恶性电脑病毒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is believed to have first formed when a space station's computer was infected with a strange virus. It can alter the shape of its own body at will, and its tendrils pass nasty computer viruses onto any computer it touches.

entry: 据说POKENAME能实现心愿，但它须身在网络空间，愿望也须关乎数字世界。许愿时，第三只眼会覆满流动的二进制代码。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to be able to grant wishes, but only while within and pertaining to the digital world of cyberspace. Its third eye becomes covered in flowing binary code when it grants a wish.

entry: POKENAME用门牙收发电子信号，探测附近设备。它用手臂攀住货船底，潜入船载电脑系统，吞食数据。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits and receives electronic signals through its front teeth, detecting nearby devices. It latches onto the bottom of freighters with its arms to infiltrate their onboard computer systems and consume data.

entry: POKENAME像保龄球般滚过水面，前往目的地。抵达后，它会开心地原地弹跳，发出悦耳的哔声。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rolls across the water's surface like a bowling ball to reach its destination. Upon arriving, it bounces in place with joy, letting out melodic beeps.

entry: POKENAME通常住在山中，吞食矿工遗留的设备。尤其爱废矿中的电子设备，拿来当点心吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME typically live inside mountains where they can feast on equipment left behind by miners. They are particularly fond of electronics that abandoned mines have, eating them like a treat.

entry: 望进POKENAME巨颚内，能看见内壁仿佛排满二进制代码。它主要吃机械，许多人用它处理无法运作的旧电子设备。
author: sk372
source: Looking inside POKENAME's large jaws reveals what appears to be binary code lining the inside. It subsists mostly on machinery, and many use it as a way to dispose of old nonfunctional electronics.

entry: POKENAME拍翼会放出微弱电波，振动越快，电波越强。被发现时，它借此让屏幕满是雪花与失真画面，方便逃往网络空间深处。
author: sk372
source: The flapping of POKENAME's wings emits faint electronic waves, intensifying the faster it vibrates them. It uses this ability to fill a screen with static and distortions when discovered, making it easier for it to flee deeper into cyberspace.

entry: 具备简单电脑程序的宝可梦，与暗淡的丑丑鱼融合，形成了POKENAME。它游过网络，为研究者收集数据，却能不被软件察觉。战斗中，通常不太可靠。
author: bobosmith01
source: A Pokémon possessing simple computer programming fused with a dull-colored Feebas resulted in POKENAME. It has the ability to go undetected from software as it swims across the net to gather data for researchers. It is generally unreliable in battle.

entry: 程序将POKENAME设定得比铁更硬，主要用头冠撞击。可冠太重，也让它无法飞行。
author: thecrowartiste
source: Coded to be harder than iron, POKENAME utilizes its crest mainly to headbutt. The crest on its head is heavy and renders it unable to fly.

entry: POKENAME藏在电脑硬盘里。多边形外壳内，新代码正为它的飞行作准备。
author: thecrowartiste
source: POKENAME hides away in the hard drives of computers. Within its polygonal exterior, new lines of code prepare it to fly.

entry: POKENAME爱溜进大型机器，以自身替换某些齿轮。虽能适度提升性能，简陋的设计却使它偶尔卡住，造成问题。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME likes to sneak its way into large machines and replace some of the gears with itself. Though this does give a moderate boost to the machine's performance, POKENAME's rudimentary design causes it to occasionally seize up and cause issues.

entry: POKENAME在电脑设备旁旋转，能使其以平常三倍速度运作。此时，身体会变得莫名柔软。
author: .izik
source: When rotating near computer equipment, POKENAME causes it to operate at triple its normal speed. Its body becomes oddly soft during this process.

entry: 这只人造宝可梦的最初版本，经过多次更新，核心系统更加偏重多边兽资料。模仿的精细程度虽高了许多，仍显得诡异，始终学不像一只自然生动的索罗亚。
author: elfail0
source: The first version of this artificial Pokémon was designed with various updates and a greater emphasis on Porygon data as its core system. As a result, it has far higher fidelity but is very uncanny and not quite able to imitate a Zorua organically.

entry: POKENAME在体内处理数据，再以数据火焰，经尾巴输出。若算不出算法，它便终止运行，熄掉数据火，不再继续输出。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME processes data in its body and outputs it through its tail using its data flame. If it cannot compute an algorithm, it terminates, shutting off its data flame and ending all further output.

entry: POKENAME肺活量与胃口仿佛无穷，会把食物整个吸入口中吞下。吃下的东西不同，它便能施展不同特殊能力。
author: sk372
source: With a seemingly infinite lung capacity and appetite, POKENAME swallows food by inhaling it whole. It has the ability to wield special abilities depending on what it gulps down.

entry: POKENAME花苞上有特殊光感受器，吸收阳光时会噼啪作响。充满能量后，它会喷一小团花粉，嘟地轻鸣，表示已满。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has special light receptors on its flower buds that crackle as it absorbs sunlight. When fully charged, POKENAME releases a puff of pollen and trumpets out a small sound to indicate it is full.

entry: POKENAME悠闲地飘过天空，再降下，骚扰带着小型电子设备的人。它想用绳子偷走手表、宝可装置一类物品。
author: sk372
