source: POKENAME drifts idly across the skies, descending down to accost those carrying small electronics. It tries to steal them with its strings, aiming to swipe objects such as watches and Pokégear.

entry: POKENAME每跳一次，表面质地就会改变，任意轮换毛茸茸、顺滑或粗糙的状态。似乎从没有两跳结果相同。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's surface texture shifts with every hop, cycling between furry, sleek, and rough in any order it chooses. No two hops ever seem to produce the same result.

entry: POKENAME在肥沃森林间跳跃，散出孢子，长成缤纷真菌。鲜明的外表，让它成为民间故事喜爱的题材，常被描绘成好运的使者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hops among fertile forests, spreading spores that grow colorful fungi. Its striking appearance has made it a beloved subject of folklore, often depicted as a bringer of good fortune.

entry: 这只宝可梦像前几年流行的桌面宠物应用，需要持续关注。否则，它就开始删除你关注的、除它以外的应用与文件。
author: jangodiot
source: This Pokémon acts as one of those desktop pet applications that were popular a few years back. It requires consistent attention, otherwise it starts deleting applications and files you pay attention to that are not itself.

entry: 初步研究表明，POKENAME可能能在太空真空中生存、活动。但长期影响尚未充分评估，因此它还未真正进入宇宙。
author: bobosmith01
source: Early studies indicate that POKENAME could survive and move around in the vacuum of space. However, as the long-term effects that it could have on them has yet to be properly evaluated, POKENAME has not yet been into the cosmos.

entry: POKENAME咬住丢弃的电脑设备，直接通过牙齿吸收数据。吃够后，它便一边欢快哔叫，一边爬走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME clamps its jaws around discarded computer equipment, absorbing data directly through its teeth. Once it has consumed enough, it scuttles away while emitting a series of cheerful beeps.

entry: POKENAME从身体放出无线电波，遇墙反弹。电波常干扰采矿区附近的无线电信号，让矿工收音机里只剩尖锐啸声。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release radio waves from their body that bounce off walls. These waves often disrupt radio signals near mining operations, as miners only hear the high-pitched squeals from their radios.

entry: POKENAME携带一台掌上游戏机，存着招式数据。若想学别的招式，就得往游戏槽插入新卡带。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME carry a handheld gaming device that stores data for their moves. If they want to learn different moves, they need to insert new cartridges into the game slot.

entry: POKENAME咬住电子设备，吸取少许电池储电维生。最好让它吃，因为吸走的量无害；遭到拒绝，它反倒可能去嚼电线。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gets its sustenance via biting into electronics and draining some of their battery stores. It's advised to let it do so, as the amount it drains is harmless, and a denied POKENAME may try to chew on wires instead.

entry: POKENAME爱用尖刺把某些窗口钉在屏幕上，使其无法移除。钉住时，它能吸收数据，增生尖刺，同时钉住更多界面。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME likes to use its spike to pin certain windows to a screen and make them unremovable. It can absorb data while pinned to multiply its spikes and pin more interfaces at once.

entry: POKENAME在数字空间中，钻入系统数据越深，獠牙便长得越长。一旦离开，就会完全恢复原样。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME exists within digital space, its tusks grow longer the deeper it burrows into a system's data. Upon leaving, they reset entirely.

entry: POKENAME的身体与心灵是两个独立存在：心灵在网络空间某处，身体则在现实世界。各部分每毫秒发出数万亿条指令，确保它正常反应、运作。
author: phantom640
source: The body and mind of POKENAME are two separate entities. The mind exists somewhere in cyberspace, while the body exists in the real world. Each part sends trillions of commands a millisecond to ensure that POKENAME can react and function properly.

entry: POKENAME在网络空间翻找虫子的图片与视频。一找到，就吃掉文件数据，使其损坏。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME look through cyberspace for images and videos of bugs. Once they find one, they eat the file's data, corrupting it.

entry: POKENAME产出炽热的丝，用来连接电脑。数据经这线缆般的丝迅速吸入，作为养分吃下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME produces a hot silk it uses to connect itself to computers. Data is absorbed quickly through this cord-like silk and consumed as nourishment.

entry: 野生POKENAME独来独往，发出高频尖叫，在洞穴辨路。它们不攻击人，却因难寻踪迹，很难驯服。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME keep to themselves in the wild and produce high-pitched screeches to find their way around caves. While they do not attack people, they are difficult to tame because of their elusive nature.

entry: POKENAME侵入有电脑的地方，用自己替换键盘。没察觉的人，一按键，就会挨一记讨厌的电击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME invades places with computers and replaces keyboards with itself. Those who don't notice will be in for a nasty shock the moment they press down on one of its keys.

entry: POKENAME看起来就是软盘，等在办公室外，盼被捡起，放进电脑，进入网络空间。随着科技进步，使用软盘的设施减少，它们的栖息地也缩小了。
author: rymyll_the_wanderer
source: POKENAME looks just like a floppy disk. It waits outside of offices hoping to be picked up and loaded onto a computer so it can enter cyberspace. As technology advances, fewer facilities use floppy disks, reducing the habitats of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME行为像老电子游戏中的“非玩家角色”，按固定路线行走，除非有人互动，否则不会停。
author: 8xviktor
source: POKENAME's behavior seems to mirror that of an "NPC" in an old video game. It walks in a specific pattern and won't stop unless interacted with.

entry: POKENAME群居，每只各有不同职责。它们渴望翡翠，会拿树果等物品交换。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME live in groups, with each POKENAME having a different role. They crave emeralds, offering berries and other items in exchange for the gems.

entry: POKENAME极具攻击性，用毒牙咬敌人。毒液能转成数据，由机器扫描，发现新的化合物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are highly aggressive creatures that attack by biting their foes with venomous fangs. This venom can be converted into data and scanned by machines to discover new chemical compounds.

entry: POKENAME超频系统，便能大幅增强攻击，代价是伤害自身。科学家不建议频繁超频，以免它出现异常行为。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can supercharge their attacks by overclocking their system, hitting harder at the cost of hurting their own body. Scientists advise against frequent overclocking to prevent POKENAME from developing erratic behaviors.

entry: POKENAME滚向敌人，用獠牙强行注毒。毒使对方迟缓，发烧让身体过热，直到热得无法还击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rolls into its foes to forcibly inject venom from its fangs. This venom makes its foes sluggish, as the fever overheats their bodies until they are too hot to strike back.

entry: POKENAME的数据严重损坏，行为已变得反常。有些极具攻击性，会用毒牙咬任何靠近的对象。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has been corrupted to the point where it develops erratic behaviors. Some POKENAME exhibit intense aggression and bite anything that comes near them with their venomous fangs.

entry: POKENAME爱被宠着，时时享有最新科技与程序数据。若几天没得到，它们就进入网络空间，啃数据，直到满足。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME like to be pampered by having the latest technology and programming data at all times. If they do not receive these within a few days, they will enter cyberspace and chomp on data until they do.

entry: POKENAME踏过网络空间，踩烂数据与数字生物，展示力量、宣示统治。要对付一只暴走的个体，得派出整队多边兽融合体。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stomps across cyberspace, trampling data and digital beings alike as a show of force and dominance. Entire teams of Porygon fusions are dispatched to deal with a single POKENAME on a rampage.

entry: POKENAME核心略不稳定，因此在网络空间披斗篷，保护自己与别人。谁想扯下遮盖物，它就放出短距离寒冷脉冲，将其冻住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's core is slightly unstable, so it uses a cloak to protect itself and others while in cyberspace. It emits a short-range chilling pulse to freeze those that would try to remove its covering from it.

entry: POKENAME是恶意的淘气鬼，想尽办法制造问题、激怒别人。看对方受苦，它咧嘴大笑，得意气场仿佛还在嘲弄，让人更加火大。
author: sk372
source: As a malicious prankster, POKENAME does whatever it can to cause problems and raise the ire of others. It grins widely at their suffering, its smug aura mocking them and making them even more irate.

entry: POKENAME往来电脑服务器，在安全距离收集信息。寄居服务器可能让网速慢，但直接住进电脑，就会使其先卡住，再崩溃。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME travel between computer servers to collect information from a safe distance. While a POKENAME possessing a server is likely to cause slow internet speeds, one directly inhabiting a computer will cause it to freeze and then crash.

entry: POKENAME群落游荡于用户少去的网络空间。受打扰，它们便散进用户电脑，使操作输入严重延迟，直到全数清除。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME colonies roam areas of cyberspace that are less frequented by users. If disturbed, POKENAME scatter into the user's computer, lagging user input immensely until cleared out.

entry: POKENAME在阳光充足的地方，将部分身体埋进土里。一被拔出、接触空气，就会传出如高度压缩音频般的刺耳破音尖叫。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME partially bury themselves into the ground in places with lots of sunlight. When pulled out of the ground, a highly compressed, crunchy scream can be heard as they are exposed to the air.

entry: POKENAME借舞蹈摇摆，筛查程序数据，确保没有坏数据或可疑内容。但它只会一支舞，更高级、藏得更深的数据，仍能溜过去。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses the swaying of its dance to sift through program data to make sure there is no bad or suspicious data present. Since it only knows exactly one dance, more advanced and hidden data slip by it.

entry: POKENAME翻找手机公司外的垃圾箱，盼着找到废弃设备。一找到，就急切吞下，以其中存储的数据为食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME searches through dumpsters outside cell phone companies, hoping to find discarded devices. When it does, it devours them eagerly, feeding on the stored data inside.

entry: 公司需删除大量敏感数据时，就把POKENAME下载进电脑吞食。程序员运行程序，选中标记删除的文件，引导它前往。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever companies need to delete lots of sensitive data, POKENAME are downloaded onto PCs to devour data. Programmers help guide POKENAME to files that need to be deleted by running programs that select files marked for deletion.

entry: POKENAME能进入网络空间，把以太网线当流水般穿行。它主动捕食病毒，是天然的网络安全防护。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can enter cyberspace and travel through ethernet cables as if they were flowing streams. It actively hunts and consumes viruses, acting as a natural cybersecurity measure.

entry: POKENAME以超空泡方式在水下高速前进，有时跃出水面，冲到高空再落下。外形使雷达无法探测，因此危及飞越海洋的飞机。
author: epping_forest
source: Traveling at supercavitation speed underwater, POKENAME sometimes jumps out and reaches high altitudes before falling again. Since it can't be detected by radar due to its shape, it becomes a hazard to planes traveling across the sea.

entry: POKENAME夜里飘过沼泽，发出阴森哔声。有人说，听来像孩子透过旧电视尖叫。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts through swamps at night, letting loose a haunting beep. Some say the sound resembles a child screaming through an old television set.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在被遗忘的服务器与损坏设备，慢慢吸走剩余数据。人们虽怕它带来恶意软件，它却意外成为保护系统的杀毒程序的吉祥物。
author: oejoeboy33
source: POKENAME lurks in forgotten servers and broken devices, slowly draining their remaining data. Though feared as a source of malware, it became an unlikely mascot for antivirus programs meant to keep systems safe.

entry: POKENAME藏在密林，悄悄靠近毫无防备的猎物。气势虽吓人，身体僵硬，却很难真伤到谁。
author: redkitsuka123
source: POKENAME hides in dense forests to sneak up on unsuspecting prey. Despite their intimidating presence, their stiff body makes it hard to do much harm to anyone.

entry: POKENAME小巧敏捷，听任训练家差遣。单只虽弱，多只稍加配合，就能抬起废金属与岩石。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are small, nimble creatures that carry out the whims of their Trainer. While one POKENAME is quite weak, many POKENAME can lift scrap metal and rocks with a bit of teamwork.

entry: POKENAME产出的浓口水，会吸引许多网络空间生物。科学家仍在研究，许多性质尚不明。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a thick drool that draws in many creatures that can be found in cyberspace. This drool is still being studied by scientists, as many properties of the drool are still unknown.

entry: POKENAME发出高频声波，能干扰电子设备。不知为何，振动还能延伸进网络空间，直接转成数据，下载到电脑硬盘，将其损坏。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME emits high-frequency sound waves capable of disrupting electronics. Somehow the vibrations it emits extend into cyberspace and get directly converted to data that downloads on to computer hard drives and corrupts them.

entry: POKENAME坐上人的头顶，会把翅膀变成大致的帽形。它往往避免进入网络空间，以免坏代码或恶意代码影响翅膀。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME sits atop of someone's head, it transforms its wings into the rough shapes of hats. It tends to avoid entering cyberspace to avoid corrupted or malicious code that could affect its wings.

entry: POKENAME产出的黏液，一碰电脑就会立刻使其故障，直到黏液彻底干透才停止。
author: .izik
source: The slime produced by POKENAME's body causes any computer it touches to malfunction instantly. This continues until the slime fully dries.

entry: POKENAME对敌有狡猾战术，挨一击就散架，显得很弱。对方一转头，它便轻松重组身体，用巨臂一击，将其打飞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a tricky tactic to deal with foes, appearing weaker by falling apart after a single strike. When the opponent looks away, it easily reforms its body before sending them flying with one strike from its massive arms.

entry: POKENAME体表覆着水银般的浓稠黏液。若罕见地在服务器里遇上同类，它就会一直打，直到一方确立首领地位。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is coated in a thick slime resembling mercury. In the rare event it encounters another of its kind within a server, it will fight until one establishes itself as the alpha.

entry: POKENAME产出的独特花粉，有旧塑料的气味。多数宝可梦不喜欢，许多网络空间的宝可梦却爱得往身上涂满。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a unique pollen that smells like old plastic. While most Pokémon are not fond of the scent, many Pokémon found in cyberspace find the scent so appealing that they coat themselves in the pollen.

entry: POKENAME靠电脑亮度维生，待得越久，屏幕就越暗。偷走的光永久消失，即使它离开，用户也无法再调高亮度。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses a computer's brightness to sustain itself, making it grow darker the longer it is present. The light it steals is gone permanently; a user will not be able to increase the brightness setting after POKENAME departs.

entry: POKENAME飞过高层大气，攻击卫星，吃其中代码。偶尔也到地面，吸收个人电脑的数据。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME flies through the upper atmosphere, attacking satellites. It eats the code in them, and occasionally goes to the surface to absorb PC data.

entry: POKENAME似乎以某种数字光能为食，维持运作。它一出现在电脑里，屏幕就不断变暗，直到全黑，再去侵入下一台。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears to subsist on a form of digital light energy to keep itself functional. When it appears within a computer, the screen will continuously dim until going completely dark, before POKENAME finds another to invade.

entry: POKENAME住在旧街机里，不停向奇怪生物射击。阿罗拉的研究者，正在查明这些生物是什么。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME reside in old arcade cabinets, perpetually shooting at strange creatures. Researchers from Alola are working to identify what these creatures are.

entry: POKENAME外观诡异，许多人斥它邪恶或受诅咒。它难过地四处飘荡，盼有天能找到一个朋友，抱在怀中珍惜。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has an uncanny appearance that causes many to decry it as evil or cursed. It floats around sadly, hoping to one day find a friend it can hug and hold dear.

entry: POKENAME拥抱电脑等储存信息的设备，慢慢吸取数据为食。吃得越多，身体就越软。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slowly absorbs data as sustenance by hugging computers and equipment that store information. The more it feeds, the softer its body becomes.

entry: POKENAME溜进网络空间，吃电脑系统中的图像文件。吸足数据后，它便固定在桌面，既移不动也删不掉，直到再次饥饿。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME feeds on image files within computer systems after slipping into cyberspace. Once it has absorbed enough data, it anchors itself to a desktop, unable to be moved or deleted until hunger strikes again.

entry: POKENAME搜遍数字世界，吃掉多余或垃圾数据。若掉一条腿，它就吞下回收数据，立刻重新长回。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are known to scour the digital world, eating any excess or garbage data that they find. If they ever lose a leg, they will devour it to recycle the data and grow it right back.

entry: POKENAME射出代码碎片构成的刺，攻击敌人。刺会黏住对手，拖慢行动，直到迟缓得躲不开攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shoot barbs made out of bits of code to strike their foes. These barbs cling to their opponents to slow them down until they are too sluggish to dodge their attacks.

entry: POKENAME向敌人洒下代码刺，将其压重。对手被沉重尖刺困得动弹不得，它们就奏起胜利号角，向天空发射代码彩纸，结束战斗。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shower their foes with barbs made out of code that weigh down their foes. Once their foes are rendered immobile due to these heavy barbs, POKENAME end the battle with triumphant fanfare, shooting code confetti into the sky.

entry: POKENAME嘴里，竟能藏下100多个程序漏洞。若让POKENAME靠近设备，电脑往往就会染上一大堆病毒。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME can house over 100 computer bugs in its mouth. Letting a POKENAME near your device will usually infect your computer with plenty of viruses.

entry: POKENAME体内有强效兴奋物质，谁吃下，就会增强肌肉力量。有些人吃后，明显长大，可几小时后便失去增长，恢复原样。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a powerful stimulant in its body that boosts the strength of muscles in whoever eats it. Some experience visible growth after eating a POKENAME, only to lose that growth and return to normal after a few hours.

entry: 训练家说，它的模样，像某款电子游戏里的城堡。不过，POKENAME长成这样，纯属巧合。
author: filteredtea
source: Trainers say this Pokémon's appearance bears resemblance to a castle in a video game. POKENAME's appearance, however, is purely coincidental.

entry: POKENAME为免过热，会进入电脑，泡在冷却液里。进入网络空间前，须清洗掉冷却液，否则碰到什么数据，什么就会损坏。
author: soup1900
source: To keep itself from becoming too hot, POKENAME will go inside of computers and bathe in their coolants. It must clean itself of these coolants before entering cyberspace; otherwise, it will corrupt any data it touches.

entry: POKENAME背上的水晶，发出闪烁光芒。有些人盯着看，就会感到十分恶心难受。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The crystals on POKENAME's back emit flashing lights. Staring at these lights can cause some people to feel very sick.

entry: POKENAME是许多人喜爱的宠物。有些传说说，它愿等训练家一百万年，盼对方归来，再一起冒险。
author: addiction2peaches
source: POKENAME is a beloved pet to many people. Some legends say it is willing to wait for its Trainer for a million years, hoping they will return to adventure with it again.

entry: 不论训练家走到哪里，它都会跟随。针叶林也好，热带草原也好，POKENAME始终陪伴身旁。
author: dodoowner_
source: This Pokémon will follow its Trainer no matter where they venture. Whether it be a taiga or a savannah, POKENAME will accompany them.

entry: POKENAME忠于训练家，很少违背命令。因此，常有这样的事：训练家早已离世，它仍长久留在原处，盼着接到重新起身的指令。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are loyal to their Trainer and will rarely deviate from a Trainer's command. This has led to many incidents where POKENAME remains in one spot long past a Trainer's lifespan, hoping to receive the command to get back up.

entry: POKENAME忠于训练家，很少违背命令。若其他宝可梦攻击训练家，它们就会还击，直到一方倒下，失去战斗能力才停止。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are loyal to their Trainer and will rarely deviate from a Trainer's command. They attack other Pokémon that attack their Trainer, and will not stop until one of them faints.

entry: POKENAME会模仿任天堂64游戏机的外形与声音，喜欢用复古的表演，唤起人们怀旧的记忆。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: POKENAME mimics the looks and sounds of a classic Nintendo 64 console. It loves to recreate nostalgic memories through its retro-style performances.

entry: POKENAME以计算好的舞步与大量数据，跳出机械的优雅。有评论家说动作僵硬，也有人说，这般精准的机械动作，就是舞蹈艺术的巅峰。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dance with a mechanical elegance that is fueled by calculated steps and lots of data. While some critics say their movements are stiff, others say that the precise, mechanical motions are the pinnacle of the art of dancing.

entry: 能出现在电子设备上的类病毒宝可梦中，POKENAME算比较友善。只要有屏幕，它就会现身，伴着8位音乐跳几秒舞，即使设备没有扬声器。
author: _pixelar_
source: A POKENAME is one of the friendlier virus-like Pokémon one can get on their electronics. If the device has a screen, it will appear and dance for a few seconds to an 8-bit tune, even if the device has no speakers.

entry: POKENAME飘浮时，身后会形成月亮般的立方体，移动便消失，停下又出现。立方体放出的光，可代替月光，供依赖月光的宝可梦维生。
author: sk372
source: A moon-like cube forms behind POKENAME when it floats about, disappearing as it travels and reappearing when it stops. The cube emits a light that works as a fitting substitute to moonlight for Pokémon that subsist on such.

entry: 途经货船掉落电脑设备，POKENAME就会急切吞吃微芯片，吸收找到的数据。吃饱游动时，身体便鲜亮发光。
author: .izik
source: When computer equipment falls from passing freighters, POKENAME eagerly devours the microchips, absorbing any data it finds. Its body glows vibrantly as it swims with a full belly.

entry: POKENAME的数据格外容易损坏，一坏就会产出多种蘑菇的孢子。许多程序员费力维持数据稳定，却发现环境稍变，它就会生病。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is particularly prone to corruption, and once corrupted, produces spores for many types of mushrooms. Many programmers have struggled to keep POKENAME's data stable only to find it becomes ill from the slightest environmental change.

entry: POKENAME大量散播不稳定数据构成的孢子，让长出的许多蘑菇发生多种变异。它也可能被自己的孢子感染，常导致性格变化。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME proliferates spores made out of volatile data, leading many mushrooms that grow from these spores to have many mutations. It is possible for POKENAME to be infected by its own spores, often leading to personality changes.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇美味又充满能量。不过，生吃会让人产生自己变大的幻觉。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: The mushroom that grows on POKENAME's back is delicious and full of energy. Eaten raw, however, it makes people hallucinate growing in size.

entry: POKENAME把体内大量数据输出成程序，想让设备运行更好。可释放太多，却让电脑臃肿，反而运转更慢。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME pours out the immense amounts of data stored in its body as programs used to make a device run better. However, with so much data being released, it bloats the computer it's in, which causes the device to run slower instead.

entry: POKENAME自认为无人看时，会入侵电脑，偷吃垃圾数据。一被发现，便逃入网络空间，沿途扰乱、挪动数据，让用户忙着整理，无暇追赶。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME invades computers to snack on junk data when it thinks nobody is looking. If spotted, it flees into cyberspace, scrambling and shuffling data behind it to keep a user occupied and distracted from pursuing it.

entry: POKENAME用爪切开代码，深藏设备之中。任何来打扰的病毒或恶意软件，都会被它们斩倒。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their claws to slice through code, embedding themselves deep within devices. These Pokémon will slice down any viruses or malware that try to disturb them.

entry: 从电脑吃够数据后，POKENAME会离开，在附近草地游荡。饱食时的嗡鸣，不知为何能加快周围青草生长。
author: .izik
source: After consuming enough data from a computer, POKENAME will exit and wander through nearby grassy areas. The humming noise it emits when full somehow accelerates the growth of surrounding grass.

entry: 网络空间中，POKENAME只出现在干净有序、没有恶意软件或杂乱内容的电脑上。因此，屏幕出现它，被视为不小的成就与赞许。
author: sk372
source: In cyberspace, POKENAME only appear on computers that are cleanly organized: free of malware or clutter. Thus, spotting a POKENAME on one's screen is considered quite the achievement and compliment.

entry: POKENAME身上有代码碎片构成的锋利锯齿状宝石。代码棱角分明，又未压缩，因此宝石很容易从身上取下。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's body has sharp, jagged gems that are made of pieces of code. These pieces of code are jagged and uncompressed, making removing a gem from its body quite easy.

entry: POKENAME头上的刺能变长、变柔软，连接其他设备。但一接上，就会硬化，无法移动，直到数据传输完成。
author: soup1900
source: The quills on POKENAME's head can become long and flexible to allow it to connect to other devices. However, once they have connected, they harden and become immovable until the data transfer is completed.

entry: 吃下POKENAME背上的蘑菇，有助身心一同成长。因此，它们极受追捧，价格昂贵。
author: sondededoo
source: Consumption of the mushroom growing on POKENAME's back has been known to help individuals grow both physically and mentally. For this reason, they are highly coveted and extremely expensive.

entry: POKENAME吞食病毒，再将它们作为无害的垃圾数据排出，帮助保护网络空间。训练家最好别在它身边放U盘，因为它一有机会就会啃。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME helps protect cyberspace by munching on viruses and venting them back out as harmless garbage data. Trainers who care for this Pokémon should not keep USB sticks around it, as it tends to munch on them when given the chance.

entry: POKENAME向重要电脑程序喷保护气泡，防御网络攻击。但气泡要花大量时间与运算才能造出，无法迅速消除眼前的网络威胁。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME sprays its protective bubbles over important computer programs to protect them from cyberattacks. However, these bubbles take a lot of time and processing to create, so they cannot be used to quickly end immediate cyber threats.

entry: POKENAME在监视的地方，留下写着自己名字的文本框。一有威胁进入，就抛出夺目的数据气泡，分散对方注意，同时迅速攻击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME leaves textboxes of its name in places it is keeping a watchful eye for. Once a threat has entered one of these areas, POKENAME throws eye-catching bubbles of data to distract them while it attacks at rapid speed.

entry: POKENAME在网络空间行动迅速高效，常不被察觉。它经常被派去处理病毒，用特制代码生成的手里剑将其消灭。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME moves quickly and efficiently through cyberspace, often without notice. It regularly gets dispatched to take care of viruses, destroying them with the shurikens made of special code it produces.

entry: POKENAME靠垃圾数据获取能量。所在电脑若没了垃圾数据，就须赶快转移至新系统，以免饿死。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME feeds on junk data to fuel its energy. If the computer it is in has no more junk data, it must be quickly moved to a new system before it dies off from hunger.

entry: POKENAME靠垃圾数据获取能量。所在电脑若没了垃圾数据，就须赶快转移至新系统，以免饿死。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME feeds on junk data to fuel its energy. If the computer it is in has no more junk data, it must be quickly moved to a new system  before it dies off from hunger.

entry: POKENAME在南瓜地上方旋转，身体放出浅蓝光，充当探照灯。若发现闯入者，就大声反复哔叫，提醒同类。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rotates above pumpkin patches releasing a light blue glow from its body, acting as a searchlight. Should it spot an intruder, it emits loud repetitive beeps to alert others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME飘过南瓜田，亮着深蓝光。任何偷田里东西的宝可梦，都会遭遇震耳的哔声。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glows a deep blue as it floats through pumpkin fields. Any Pokémon caught stealing from the field will be met with ear splitting beeps.

entry: POKENAME筛查网络空间的缝隙，用睡莲叶般的头顶收集零散数据。它把数据放进回收站，试着清理网上的垃圾与杂乱内容。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sifts through the cracks of cyberspace, gathering loose data on its lily-pad cranium. It deposits the gathered data into recycling bins, trying to clean up some of the internet's junk and clutter.

entry: 宝可梦研究所附近的河中，常见小群POKENAME，漫不经心地吸收数据，再传给同类。无人看管时，它们常损坏通往附近机器的数据流。
author: npshi
source: Small groups of POKENAME are commonly seen in rivers near Pokémon Laboratories, absent-mindedly absorbing and transferring data to other POKENAME. When POKENAME are left unattended, they frequently corrupt data streams to nearby machines.

entry: POKENAME用身体蓝色末端远程接收数据，像云存储系统般存在体内。数据太多，却会使它坠地，动弹不得，直到壳被砸开。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is able to receive data remotely via the blue ends of its body and store it inside itself like a cloud storage system. However, too much data will cause it to crash into the ground and become immobile until its shell is shattered open.

entry: POKENAME虽小，通常也无敌意，但来访电脑时，仍别惹它。全力下，发光双眼射出的代码光束，能瞬间删除文件与数据，无论保护多严密。
author: sk372
source: Though small and typically not-hostile, one should take care not to agitate a POKENAME visiting their computer. At full power, the beams of code it can shoot from its glowing eyes can instantly delete files and data, no matter how protected.

entry: POKENAME在体内处理数据，再以数据火焰，经尾巴输出。若算不出算法，它便终止运行，熄掉数据火，不再继续输出。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME processes data in its body and outputs it through its tail using its data flame. If it cannot compute an algorithm, it terminates, shutting off its data flame and ending all further output.

entry: POKENAME的程序能把电信号数据转为热能。数据一不稳定，尾焰就会猛烈燃起。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's programming allows it to convert electrical data into thermal energy. If this data becomes unstable, the flame on its tail flares intensely.

entry: POKENAME在设有电脑服务器的建筑旁挖洞，偶尔闯入，将鼻子贴上机器，吸食数据。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME builds its burrows near buildings housing computer servers. It occasionally breaches inside and consumes data by pressing its nose to the machines.

entry: POKENAME游过交友网站，吞吃潜在配对者的回复。有人相信，消息石沉大海，就是被它先吃掉了。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims through dating websites, consuming responses from potential matches. Some believe that when a message goes unanswered, it is because POKENAME devoured it first.

entry: POKENAME游过网络空间，查看人们的数据，寻找相似的两人。一旦配成，就向双方邮箱发信，说明下次约会地点。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME swims through cyberspace, looking through people's data to see if any two are similar. Once it finds a match, it will send emails to their inboxes describing the location of their next date together.

entry: POKENAME埋进土里一段时间，就会积起大量爆炸能量。有东西靠得太近，它便释放；若来的是幽灵属性宝可梦，炸得还更猛烈。
author: sk372
source: Some time after POKENAME buries itself in the dirt, it amasses a large amount of explosive energy. It releases this energy when something comes too close. It explodes even more forcefully if it is a Ghost-type Pokémon that draws near.

entry: 一半是多边兽，让POKENAME天生懂得普通三地鼠不懂的知识。它大受欢迎，形象还被放进一款训练家似乎很爱玩的游戏。
author: yokaiwatchfan103_23972
source: Due to being half Porygon, POKENAME has innate knowledge that a normal Dugtrio wouldn't normally have. It became popular and had its likeness put into a game that Trainers seem to enjoy.

entry: POKENAME偷走的硬币，会刻上一行行损坏代码。人类虽无法正常使用这些代码，科学家却正持续研究。
author: .izik
source: Coins stolen by POKENAME become engraved with lines of broken code. Though the code cannot be properly utilized by humans, it has become the subject of ongoing scientific study.

entry: 电脑有故障待查时，POKENAME便会出现，化作抱头叹气的头痛表情。输入错误一解决，它就满足地嘎叫一声，消失不见。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME show up on PCs whenever there is a troubleshooting issue, appearing as a headache emoji that clutches its head and sighs. It disappears once the input error has been resolved with a satisfying quack.

entry: POKENAME在电脑里化作嘎嘎叫的图像小精灵，跳进文档，提醒人保存工作。许多作家、艺术家、建筑师与学生，都靠它的提醒保住了成果。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME appears inside PCs as a sprite that quacks and jumps into documents to remind people to save their work. Many writers, artists, architects, and students have had their work preserved thanks to its reminders.

entry: 电子设备一故障或性能不佳，就容易惹怒POKENAME。哪怕只卡顿一次，它也想砸机器，主人很难阻止。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is easily triggered into anger by glitches or poor performance in electronics. Owners have a very difficult time preventing it from breaking machines just because of a single instance of lag.

entry: POKENAME把双镲一碰，便激出数字冲击波，扰乱对手。可有时候，连自己也会一起乱了神。
author: shadow
source: The cymbals that POKENAME uses can be crashed together to make digital shock waves that can confuse the target. However, it can even confuse itself!

entry: POKENAME可爱友善，常受雇做公司吉祥物。它想帮助员工工作，却容易分心，比起干活，更想玩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME often gets employed as a sort of company mascot due to its cute appearance and friendly disposition. It tries to help employees with their tasks, but tends to be distracted and wants to play more than work.

entry: POKENAME能变回程序数据，又长得可爱，是数字游戏里备受喜爱的宠物。
author: zotobom
source: Capable of reverting itself into program data, POKENAME is a beloved pet in digital games due to it's cute appearance.

entry: POKENAME没有可辨的心跳，只有尾焰能衡量健康与生命。它们十分好斗，战斗中又能迅速适应，是危险的对手。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have no discernible heartbeats, with only their tail flames serving as a measure of their health and life. They are a very combative species that can quickly adapt in the midst of battle, making them dangerous foes.

entry: POKENAME出现在池塘，会扰乱生态，须设法移走。渔人已发现，最好用空白光盘作饵，将其诱捕。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's presence in ponds disrupts the ecosystem, requiring efforts to remove it. Fisherman have learned the best way to bait it into capture is by using blank CDs.

entry: POKENAME颜色奇特，外形方正，在野外很容易成为捕食目标。因此，它更常见于网络空间，尤其是蚊香蝌蚪相关网站。
author: equation8573
source: POKENAME's unusual colors and blocky appearance make it an easy target for predators in the wild. Due to this, POKENAME is most often seen in cyberspace, on Poliwag-related websites.

entry: POKENAME常藏在蚊香君群中，模仿动作与花纹。它们能产出近似水的透明液体，常用于培育化石宝可梦。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME are often found hiding within herds of Poliwhirl, imitating their movements and patterns. POKENAME can produce a clear fluid similar to water, that is often used to incubate Fossil Pokémon.

entry: 接入网络空间时，能见POKENAME睡在随机网站里。一察觉威胁，就会用精神力量，瞬间移动到别的网站。
author: equation8573
source: POKENAME can be seen sleeping inside random websites while connected to cyberspace. If it senses a threat, POKENAME teleports to a different website using its psychic powers.

entry: 网络空间中，POKENAME的勺子能瞬间搬动文件。它聪明细致，许多企业用来分类整理文件，减少杂乱与混淆。
author: sk372
source: While in cyberspace, POKENAME's spoon lets it move files around instantaneously. Due to its intellect and meticulous nature, many businesses use it to sort and arrange files in order to reduce clutter and confusion.

entry: POKENAME一用精神力量，就会改变附近电视的画面。可惜，产生的明亮闪色，可能让观看者不适。
author: .jerden
source: Whenever POKENAME uses its psychic powers, it alters the display on nearby television screens. Unfortunately, the brightly flashing colors this creates can make people who see it fall ill.

entry: POKENAME脑容量庞大，能存数千吉字节的信息。不过，访问这些数据库仍有困难，检索所需资料要花相当久。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a vast mind, capable of storing several thousand gigabytes worth of information. It still has trouble accessing these databanks though, taking quite some time to retrieve the information asked of it.

entry: POKENAME方块状的四肢，战斗中能有效防御，充作临时盾牌挡击。动作虽稍僵硬，每拳的力量却不容小觑。
author: sk372
source: The blocky shapes of POKENAME's limbs work efficiently as defenses in battle, being used as a makeshift shield to stop blows. POKENAME's movements may be a little stiff, but the power it packs behind each punch shouldn't be underestimated.

entry: POKENAME收集大量石头，再削成立方体，用这些方块，搭起令人惊叹的建筑。
author: valtsuri
source: POKENAME gathers large amounts of stone, and then shapes them into cubes. It can build impressive structures with these blocks.

entry: POKENAME四臂强劲，甚至超过自身能承受的程度。特别猛的一击后，手臂偶尔会碎裂，须花几小时重新编译、再生。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's four arms are powerful, too much so for its own body to handle. They may occasionally shatter after a particularly strong strike, needing a few hours to recompile and regenerate afterward.

entry: POKENAME常住在网络空间，吃零散数据维持健康。传言给它升级数据，再让它从足够大的屏幕离开数字世界，就能进化得更强。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME often reside in cyberspace, consuming loose data to stay fit. There exist rumors that by giving them an Upgrade and having them exit the digital world on a large enough screen, they can evolve into something stronger.

entry: POKENAME偶尔从用户任务栏冒出，必须尽快拔除，否则会越长越多，导致混乱、卡顿等问题。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME occasionally sprouts up from a user's taskbar. It must be plucked and removed before long, or more will begin sprouting and cause disarray and lag among other issues.

entry: POKENAME缩壳时，会将所有指令存入记忆，出壳后一并执行。可若某条无法完成，它就会翻倒，动不了，直到被翻正。
author: soup1900
source: When withdrawn into its shell, POKENAME stores every command in its memory and executes them once it comes back out. However, if it can't execute an order, it will overturn itself and become unable to move until flipped back over.

entry: 离开网络空间，POKENAME便开始流失体内数据，渐渐虚弱。这近似脱水，可它没有对应程序，原因仍不明。
author: soup1900
source: When outside of cyberspace, POKENAME starts to lose data in its body and becomes gradually weaker. This phenomenon is similar to dehydration, although since POKENAME has no corresponding programming, it's unknown why it happens.

entry: 有些地区雇用POKENAME当守门保镖。它用众多强劲触手推开别人，只有对方过分硬闯，才会真正攻击。
author: sk372
source: In some areas, POKENAME has been employed as bouncers guarding doorways and other such locales. It pushes others away with its many strong tentacles, only resorting to true aggression with those who try too hard to get past them.

entry: 无论磨损多重，POKENAME都始终保持尖锐菱形。身体一点不圆，却能轻易滚下斜坡，因为程序会强迫它转动。
author: soup1900
source: No matter how much POKENAME gets worn down, it always will maintain its sharp, diamond shape. Despite not being round at all, it can easily roll itself down slopes thanks to its programming forcing it to rotate when doing so.

entry: POKENAME双手包住岩石，将其压缩成数据。化作代码后，它便吃下这块压缩数据，为身体供能。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME transforms rocks into data by engulfing the rock with its hands and compressing it. Once transformed into pieces of code, POKENAME eats the compressed nugget of data to fuel its body.

entry: POKENAME由形似活物的抽象形状构成。它向对手投掷代码块，一接触便炸成碎片。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is made out of abstract shapes that resemble a living creature. It throws chunks of code at its opponents, each exploding into pieces upon contact.

entry: POKENAME周身的每片碎块，都是一段代码。滚动时，碎块便贴近身体，保护核心。
author: quackquackattack
source: Each fragment around POKENAME's body is a piece of code. Whenever it rolls, these fragments tuck close to its body to protect its core.

entry: POKENAME由未压缩代码构成，外形如基本几何形状。身体各处平面，让滚动变得困难。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are creatures made of uncompressed code that look like basic shapes. The flat surfaces across their bodies make rolling difficult.

entry: POKENAME鬃毛释放的余烬，编码了数据。扫描其中一粒，就能看到数据标记，显示它此刻承受多少压力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release embers from their manes that have data encoded into them. Scanning one of these embers reveals data markers that indicate how much stress POKENAME is going through at the moment.

entry: POKENAME在周围快速奔驰，常使体外形成静电屏障。屏障阻止恶意软件破坏身体，让它保持健康。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often has a static barrier around its body that comes from galloping quickly in its environment. This static barrier stops malicious software from corrupting its body, ensuring that POKENAME remains healthy.

entry: POKENAME尝试将自己上传网络空间时，常会内存不足。软件虽慢，却十分稳健；只要给足时间，哪怕花上几天，最后也能上传完成。
author: rymyll_the_wanderer
source: POKENAME often runs out of memory space when attempting to upload itself to cyberspace. While slow, its software is very robust. If given enough time, the upload will eventually complete even if it takes days.

entry: POKENAME游过河流，把树果从一岸运到另一岸。它只沿相互垂直的方向移动，遇到河中原木，就会被推回去。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swims across rivers to move berries from one side to another. It only moves in orthogonal directions and gets pushed back when it encounters logs in the river.

entry: POKENAME尾上的壳，不是真正的大舌贝，而是模仿它的程序。程序会让贝壳定时咬它，让它始终察觉不到这份虚假。
author: soup1900
source: The shells on the tails of POKENAME are not real Shellder but rather are programs that act like the real Pokémon. These shells are programmed to periodically bite down on POKENAME to keep them oblivious to this falsity.

entry: POKENAME无声飘过废弃办公楼，扫描闲置电脑。一感到附近有运作中的电子设备，体内电脉冲便增强。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats silently through abandoned office buildings, scanning for unused computers. The pulses of electricity from its body intensify whenever it senses working electronics nearby.

entry: POKENAME各身体的磁力共同作用，让电子屏幕产生严重雪花与画面失真。接触太久会损坏数据，因此一发现，就须尽快移走。
author: sk372
source: The magnetic forces of POKENAME's bodies working together cause heavy static and visual distortion in electronics screens. Lengthy exposure will cause data damage, so it needs to be removed posthaste when spotted.

entry: POKENAME带着大葱般的长棒，存放变身邮件上的信件或数据。棒最多能存200太字节信息，因此科学家常通过它寄信。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME carries a large leek-like baton that stores correspondence or data written on Morph Mail. Scientists typically send mail through it because its baton can store up to 200 Terabytes of information.

entry: POKENAME爱啄各种物件，尤其在网络空间。天生好奇，使它们打开本该隐藏的文件或程序，惹上麻烦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to peck at various objects in the world, especially in cyberspace. Their natural curiosity causes them to get into trouble when they open up files or programs that were meant to remain hidden.

entry: POKENAME能接连快速啄击，每秒最多十二次。许多热衷游戏的玩家，把它当自动点击器，帮助攻克难关。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can rapidly peck an object with quick succession, up to twelve times a second. Many avid gamers rely on their help as an auto clicker to beat difficult games.

entry: 领地内潜水器活动增多，POKENAME近来开始用微弱电脉冲，模仿声呐信号。多数时候，它们借此和平地引导潜艇远离家园。
author: chibitales
source: Due to an increase in submersible activity in their territories, POKENAME have recently begun to mimic sonar pings using mild electrical pulses. More often than not, POKENAME use this ability to peacefully lead the submarines away from their home.

entry: POKENAME覆着黏液的身体，会渗入无人看管电脑的电路，吸收原始数据。技术人员说，它身上的黏液闻着像服务器机房。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's slime-covered body seeps into the circuitry of unmanned computers, absorbing raw data. Technicians say the slime on its body smells like a server room.

entry: POKENAME体内满是损坏代码，嘴里冒出带故障的肢体，抓住并吞吃找到的任何数据，连没及时逃走的倒霉多边兽也不放过。
author: sk372
source: Corrupted code fills POKENAME's inner body. From its mouth, it springs forth glitched limbs that grab and consume any data it can find, as well as unfortunate Porygon that don't escape in time.

entry: POKENAME的流体身体，能轻易在设备间传数据，曾被视为数据传输技术的未来。但传输过程会产生恶臭，毒害环境。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME have a fluid body that can easily transfer data from one device to another, which was once considered the future of data transfer technology. The process of transferring data creates a terrible odour that poisons the environment.

entry: POKENAME行动很慢，沉重身体只能稍稍离地飘移。炮中射出的水，落地溅开，总会留下方形水洼。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME moves very slowly, its heavy body only able to drift just above the ground when it moves. The water shot from its cannons always leaves square-shaped puddles when it splashes on the ground.

entry: POKENAME合壳后，能挡下大多数攻击，即使在网络空间也有效。它曾受测试用作杀毒程序，却因开壳时容易受恶意软件侵害而失败。
author: equation8573
source: POKENAME has a shell that, when closed, protects it from most attacks, even in cyberspace. It has been tested as an antivirus but failed because of vulnerabilities to malware when its shell was open.

entry: POKENAME身体由电脑代码构成，潜伏在废弃网站，等有人进入，再突然出现在屏幕上吓人。
author: equation8573
source: POKENAME has a body made of computer code. POKENAME lurks in abandoned websites, waiting for someone to enter them. It will then scare them by appearing on their screen unexpectedly.

entry: POKENAME用食指选定受害者，再以指针手反复点击，吸走生命力，直到对方枯萎。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its pointer finger to select its victims. Once a selection is made, it repeatedly taps its cursor hand on the victim to drain their life force until they wither away.

entry: POKENAME口中的空洞，能显示各种数字影像。它常被用于诱骗对方、突然掉包的恶作剧。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: All manners of digital imagery can be displayed inside the void of POKENAME's mouth. It is often employed in pranks of the bait-and-switch type.

entry: POKENAME的方块身体并不实际相连，各部分能独立移动。可想将其分开却徒劳，因此研究者认为，它们由代码线连接。
author: banzai.exe
source: The blocks of a POKENAME are not physically attached to each other and can shift independently. Despite this, trying to separate them is futile, leading researchers to believe they are attached by strings of code.

entry: POKENAME从手中放出可塑的代码，依电脑用户不同，化成有吸引力的样子。它催眠对方入睡，再隔着屏幕吃梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME emits a malleable bit of code from its hand that changes into something visually alluring depending on the computer's user. It hypnotizes them into falling asleep, then feasting on their dreams through the screen.

entry: POKENAME用钳抓住电脑，释放能瞬间摧毁文件的病毒，再吸收文件剩余的数据维生。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME latches onto computers with its pincers and releases a virus capable of destroying files instantly. The leftover data from these files is then absorbed as sustenance.

entry: POKENAME住在海底，啄食蛤蜊等小生物。钳虽小，力量却远比看起来强，能轻易夹碎贝类。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME resides at the bottom of the ocean, picking at clams and other small creatures. Though its pincers are small, they are deceptively powerful, easily crushing shellfish in their grasp.

entry: POKENAME离一切文明越远越开心，只有最有耐心的人，才容易训练。它们极其憎恨广告，一看见就放下手头一切，去将其摧毁。
author: deadshields
source: POKENAME are at their happiest when far from any form of civilisation, making them difficult for all but the most patient to train. They show extreme hatred towards advertisements, dropping everything whenever they see one to destroy it.

entry: POKENAME背壳内有强毒。战斗自卫时，它们先缩壳躲开攻击，再带着满身毒液伸出来。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The shell on an POKENAME's back contains a powerful poison. In order to defend themselves in battle, POKENAME withdraw back into their shells, hiding away to avoid attacks before extending back out while coated in poison.

entry: POKENAME身体鼓胀，很难缩壳。勉强挤进去后，它会从身上的喷口排出毒液。独特的螺旋花纹，使它成为好运象征。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME struggles to withdraw into its shell due to its bulbous body. When it does manage to squeeze inside, it expels toxic liquid from the spouts covering its body. Its distinctive spiral marking has made it a symbol of good luck.

entry: 从未发现POKENAME化石。不知是古代根本不存在，还是柔软身体未能形成化石。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME fossils are never found. It's unknown if this is because ancient POKENAME didn't exist, or if their soft bodies never formed fossils.

entry: POKENAME在壳内制造毒液。众多触须，无论在水面上方，还是海洋深处，都能探知气味与细微化学变化。
author: karishi
source: POKENAME produces poison inside its shell. Its many feelers can detect odors and tiny chemical changes, both above water and deep in the ocean.

entry: POKENAME一直寻找坚实物体，保护柔软身体。它也可能物色强悍的宝可梦，变成对方，更好地自卫。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is always searching for some solid object that it can use to protect its squishy body. It may also seek tough Pokémon to transform into so it can better defend itself.

entry: POKENAME多藏在沿岸沙滩的硬壳中。闻见食物或陌生对象，才会从壳里出来。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME mostly hide within their hard shells along shores and beaches. They will emerge from their shells when they smell food or someone new.

entry: POKENAME藏在近岸浅沙下，壳与海床完美融为一体。一察觉附近振动，便用众多肢体迅速钻地。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME hides under shallow sand near the shore, its shell blending perfectly with the seabed. It uses its many limbs to burrow quickly when it senses vibrations nearby.

entry: 壳太小，装不下身体，POKENAME便将自己埋起，只露出壳和眼睛。人们长期以为它是骗局，直到发现野生个体用面部触手筛过深沙觅食。
author: pjporwoll
source: The shell is too small to fit the body, but POKENAME will bury itself, leaving only the shell and eyes exposed. It was long considered a hoax until wild specimens were found using their facial tentacles to sift through deep sands for food.

entry: 硬壳遮住POKENAME大半头部，也提供保护，它飞行时靠两根小触须感知周围。尾巴能卷握，打击力量足以劈开岩石。
author: infinex21
source: Though much of POKENAME's head is covered, albeit also protected, by a hard shell, it uses its two small feelers to sense its surroundings as it flies. Its tail is prehensile and can strike with enough force to split a rock.

entry: POKENAME凶猛护地盘，察觉船靠领地太近，就会撕碎。它飘在亲手造出的众多沉船之间，这震撼景象，登上了一部关都畅销小说的封面。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is viciously territorial, tearing apart any ships it senses coming too close to its domain. The striking visage of it floating amongst the many shipwrecks it made makes up the cover of a bestselling Kantonian fiction novel.

entry: POKENAME是存在了数百万年的古老宝可梦。基因代码适应性独特，能迅速适应任何环境，被认为是物种长盛不衰的原因。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are ancient Pokémon that have existed for millions of years. They have a uniquely adaptable genetic code that is theorised to be responsible for their longevity as a species, enabling them to rapidly adapt to any environment.

entry: POKENAME是存在了数百万年的古老宝可梦。基因代码适应性独特，能迅速适应任何环境，被认为是物种长盛不衰的原因。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are ancient Pokémon that have existed for millions of years. They have a uniquely adaptable genetic code that is theorised to be responsible for their longevity as a species, enabling them to rapidly adapt to any environment.

entry: POKENAME爱待在考古遗址附近，远远观察化石发掘。它偶尔也会参与挖掘，用尾上的手轻轻清理杂物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy lurking near archeological sites where it observes fossils being excavated from a distance. On the rare occasion it joins a dig, it gently clears debris with the hand on its tail.

entry: POKENAME若觉得某位训练家会善待自己，就会一边叫，一边爬着追去。僻静海滩上，有时整个群落都会跟着走近的训练家，彼此攀爬、溅起水花。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME will scuttle after any Trainer it thinks will treat it well, calling out to them. On secluded beaches, whole colonies of POKENAME will sometimes follow Trainers that come close, splashing and clambering over each other.

entry: 不钓鱼时，POKENAME整天研究岩石表面，原因不明。依雌雄不同，头上贝壳大小也可能略有差异。
author: bobosmith01
source: When not fishing, POKENAME spends their days studying rocky surfaces for unclear reasons. The shell on its head may vary slightly in size based on whether they are classified as male or female.

entry: POKENAME曾生活在如今真新镇附近的海洋。它不为幼崽筑巢，而是直接把蛋，产在自己的壳内。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME was once found in oceans near what is now Pallet Town. Instead of making a nest for its young, it lays its eggs inside its shell.

entry: POKENAME化石常见于深海页岩，显示它偏爱深海环境。如今，能见它们爬过深海平原，用触手滤取水中的微小食物颗粒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fossils are commonly found in deep-sea shales, showing a preference for deep marine habitats. In modern times, they can be found crawling across the abyssal plain, filtering microscopic particles of food from the water with their tentacles.

entry: POKENAME化石常见于深海页岩，显示它偏爱深海环境。活体能将壳内的水加热到极高温，从后方喷出，突然加速。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fossils are commonly found in deep-sea shales, showing a preference for deep marine habitats. Living POKENAME can superheat water within their shells, jetting it out behind them to provide a sudden burst of speed.

entry: POKENAME蜷进壳里，沿海底滚动赶路。遇到食物，先用触手抓住，再整个吞下。
author: capwolfbane
source: POKENAME travels the sea by curling into its shell and rolling along the ocean floor. It first grasps food with its tentacles, then swallows it whole.

entry: POKENAME用蹄翻挖海滩浅水旁的松沙，寻找食物。它振动鹿角时，若有人盯着角内珠体看，就会头晕，脑中空白。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its hooves to dig into the loose sands around beach shallows to find food. When it vibrates its antlers, those who look at the orbs within find themselves getting dizzy and empty-headed.

entry: POKENAME凿刻岩石，制作雕刻。博物馆馆长利用这份本领，制作可让孩子触摸的复制品。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME create carvings by chiseling into rocks. This talent is harnessed by museum curators to produce replicas that children can touch.

entry: POKENAME把身体当陀螺，撞开大舌贝或珍珠贝的壳。随后，用触手抓住受伤猎物，将剩余部分吸食干净。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: POKENAME use their body like a spinning top to break into the shells of Shellder or Clamperl. They then grab their injured prey with their tentacles and slurp up what's left.

entry: 化石彼此相近的分布，说明这种史前宝可梦可能小群生活。传说POKENAME在壳中储电，大群聚集，就会引发猛烈雷暴。
author: princessmilandria
source: Based on fossil proximity, evidence suggests this prehistoric Pokémon lived in small packs. Legends say that POKENAME stored electricity in their shells and that gathering in large groups caused severe lightning storms.

entry: POKENAME身上的化石是假的，研究者常因此忽视它们。这却使它们误以为自己很擅长伪装，许多个体因而自大起来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are often ignored by researchers because the fossils on their body are fake. This has led to the misconception that they are quite effective at camouflage, causing many POKENAME to develop an inflated ego.

entry: POKENAME总在模仿，常被认为滑稽。胸口那只眼完全无用，只会让身体失衡。
author: roundabout_robin
source: A Pokémon that perpetually imitates, POKENAME tends to be seen as silly. The eye on its chest is completely useless, serving only to throw off its balance.

entry: POKENAME十分亲人，爱让人抱着走，或依附别人，待在身旁。黏着时，它会用小触手轻揉酸痛部位，盼能缓解压力。
author: sk372
source: Highly affectionate, POKENAME loves to be carried around or cling onto others to stay close to them. While clinging to them, it uses its little tentacles to give light massages to sore spots, hoping to relieve stress.

entry: POKENAME住在不起眼的壳里，融入海岸。拾贝者可把壳放到耳边，若听见幽灵般的哀号，就能辨认出来。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME resides in an unremarkable shell, blending in at the seashore. Beachcombers can identify an POKENAME shell by placing it next to their ear and listening for a ghostly wail.

entry: POKENAME随潮轻轻摇摆，避免被捕食者发现。小猎物漂得离根部太近，它就伸须抓住。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME sways gently with the tide to avoid detection by predators. It extends its tendrils to snatch small prey that drift too close to its base.

entry: POKENAME众多触手很敏感，能察觉海底沙下藏着鱼宝可梦。背上强壳，则防御来自上方的攻击。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's many tentacles are sensitive and can feel when fish Pokémon are hiding beneath the sand on the seafloor. On its back is a powerful shell that protects it from attacks from above.

entry: POKENAME一生大多住在深海，巨大水压锤炼身体，使头骨硬过钻石。它用众多蓝色小触须，滤取水与其他液体里的养分。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's skull is harder than diamond due to having lived within ocean depths for much of its life, the sheer pressure refining much of its body. It feeds by filtering nutrients out of water and other fluids through its many small, blue feelers.

entry: POKENAME的化石，鲜少与被认为是信徒的遗骸一同出土。古代文化将它奉为海神。
author: .izik
source: Fossils of POKENAME are rarely found alongside remains believed to be worshippers. Ancient cultures regarded it as a god of the seas.

entry: POKENAME不狩猎时，便藏在壳里，用飘带拖着自己，慢慢挪动。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME hides in its shell when it's not hunting, dragging itself around with its ribbon.

entry: POKENAME偏爱突刺技巧，深深刺入猎物，让小嘴够到血液。那是它唯一能吃的东西。
author: thordemidgard
source: POKENAME prefer to use thrusting techniques. They stab deep into their prey so that their small mouths can reach its blood, which is the only thing they can feed on.

entry: 多年来，POKENAME壳中排出的液体，被用于酊剂，治疗焦虑。它只见于偏远海域，因此液体售价极高。
author: .izik
source: The liquid POKENAME releases from its shell has been used in tinctures throughout the years to treat anxiety. As it is found only in remote parts of the sea, this liquid commands a very high price.

entry: 这只宝可梦头顶的角，会发出响亮刺耳的鸣声。奇怪的是，有些人却觉得舒缓。
author: notsaying.
source: This Pokémon has a horn on top of its head that lets out a loud, blaring noise. Oddly enough, some people find this soothing.

entry: 头壳保护它，游泳分心时不至撞上岩石。POKENAME沿海岸游荡数小时，寻找蛤蜊与贝壳啃食。
author: fiordaliso
source: The shell protecting its head keeps it from crashing into rocks whenever it gets distracted while swimming. POKENAME wanders along the coast for hours in search of clams and seashells to munch on.

entry: POKENAME在浅海轻轻游动，吸收阳光。若遭巨牙鲨攻击，它们会排出一团疏水孢子，再游走。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME gently swim through ocean shallows to take in sunlight. If a Sharpedo attacks, POKENAME expel a cloud of hydrophobic spores before swimming away.

entry: 一枚化石受柔软如水的膜保护。靠得太近，外层便会猛烈亮起，放出强大精神脉冲，击退想伤害核心的对象。
author: sk372
source: A fossil is protected by a soft, water-like membrane. Getting too close causes the outer layer to flare up and send out powerful psychic pulses to repel those who would harm the core.

entry: POKENAME依附其他宝可梦发电，贴得越久，发电越多。充满后，它便离开宿主，在附着处留下螺旋印痕。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME clings to other Pokémon to generate electricity, and the longer they remain attached the more electricity it generates. When it is full, it detaches from its host, leaving a spiral imprint where it latched on.

entry: POKENAME成熟很慢，野外尤其如此。不过，它们食欲惊人，逮着空就吃；若放任，能吃下体重数倍的食物。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME mature very slowly, especially in the wild. However, they are particularly voracious and will eat any free moment they can; they can devour many times their own body weight if allowed.

entry: POKENAME成熟很慢，野外尤其如此。不过，它们食欲惊人，逮着空就吃；若放任，能吃下体重数倍的食物。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME mature very slowly, especially in the wild. However, they are particularly voracious and will eat any free moment they can; they can devour many times their own body weight if allowed.

entry: 壳上的叶丛会释放使人刺痛的花粉，驱赶捕食者。POKENAME需要阴凉与湿度，才能茁壮生长，因此住在海边黑暗岩洞中。
author: fiordaliso
source: The foliage covering its shell can release a stinging pollen that keeps predators away. POKENAME lives in darkness, in rocky caves near the sea, as it needs both shade and humidity to thrive.

entry: POKENAME飞快掠过其他水生宝可梦，以锋利锯齿状鳍斩切猎物。捕获后，再用小触手把食物拉进嘴里。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME zips past other aquatic Pokémon to slice through prey with its sharp, serrated fins. Once it has secured its meal, it pulls food into its mouth with its small tentacles.

entry: POKENAME吸走沙漠绿洲的水，存入体内，降低体温。保护触手身体的石壳，由可追溯至史前的材料构成。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME drains water from oases in the desert to store it inside its body and lower its body temperature. The stone shell that protects its tentacled body is composed of materials dating back to prehistoric times.

entry: POKENAME双壳内藏着古老真菌，人们认为，世上其他地方早已灭绝。真菌一取出就死，因此科学家目前只找到一种保存办法：大量繁育POKENAME。
author: soup1900
source: Concealed within POKENAME's two shells grow ancient fungi that are believed to be otherwise extinct in this world. Since the fungi die if removed, the only method scientists have found to preserve this species is by breeding lots of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME在港内停泊船只的侧面留下孢子，吞食藤壶。原处长出的真菌，却极难清除。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leave their spores on the sides of ships docked at harbors to consume the barnacles. The fungi that grows in their place is extremely difficult to remove.

entry: POKENAME是海生宝可梦，总在寻找陨矿加固壳。只能从护甲前孔往外看，因此常撞到岩石或其他宝可梦。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME are marine Pokémon who are always in search of meteorite ore to reinforce their shells. Due to them only being able to see through the front hole of their armature, they often bump into other Pokémon or rocks.

entry: POKENAME挖入深海海沟的侧壁。休息时，四五只个体会挤在一起。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs into the walls of deep ocean trenches. When resting, individuals cluster together in groups of four or five.

entry: 闪亮物件的光，一吸引POKENAME注意，它就会出壳。迅速抢走小物后，又缩回安全舒适的家。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME emerges from its shell when the light of something shiny catches its eye. It then quickly snatches the trinket and retreats back to the safety and comfort of its home.

entry: 壳虽是POKENAME最坚硬的部分，一旦裂开，它们却会头痛不已。许多个体待在海中洞穴，以免壳裂。
author: quackquackattack
source: Even though POKENAME shells are the toughest part of their body, if they crack their shell they develop an aching headache. Many remain in marine caverns to avoid the risk of cracking their shell.

entry: 科学家认为，POKENAME用触手般的胡须，探寻海底食物。它们尽量避免战斗，保护头部脆弱的壳。
author: bottomusmaximus3
source: Scientists believe POKENAME use their tentacle-like whiskers to douse for food on the ocean floor. They try to stay out of battle to protect the fragile shell on their heads.

entry: 野生POKENAME借笨重背壳，伪装大岩石引诱猎物，再用有毒触手牢牢攀住。身上红珠能急闪，晃晕附近威胁。
author: npshi
source: Wild POKENAME use the unwieldy shells on their backs to disguise themselves as large rocks to draw in prey, before latching onto them with noxious tentacles. The red orbs on POKENAME can flash rapidly to stun nearby threats.

entry: POKENAME收集古老贝壳，作为头甲防护，挥舞化石骨当武器。从没人见过真头，谁想看壳里，它们就逃离谁。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME gather ancient shells to use as head armour to protect themselves, wielding fossil bones as weapons. Nobody has seen the true head of POKENAME and they will flee anybody that tries to look inside their shell.

entry: 故事中，POKENAME被称为传奇的“海之英雄”，保护沿岸聚落免于危险。石质臂炮能射出强力水流，也能给口渴的人与宝可梦提供淡水。
author: mepp.
source: There are stories describing POKENAME as a legendary “Hero of the Sea” as it defended coastal settlements from danger. The stone arm-cannons fire powerful blasts of water, but can also provide fresh water to thirsty Pokémon and people.

entry: 连续遭岩石击打，POKENAME若无额外帮助，就难以继续战斗。紧要时，一颗草蚕果能给它足够支持，再扛一击，赢下对战。
author: quackquackattack
source: When repeatedly struck with rocks, POKENAME struggles to continue in battle without further assistance. In a pinch, a Charti Berry gives it enough of a push to resist one more blow before winning a Pokémon battle.

entry: POKENAME吃别的宝可梦的梦时，会把触手贴在猎物脸上。数量稀少，行为还不甚明了；有科学家怀疑，每只举止都截然不同。
author: bobosmith01
source: As POKENAME eats another Pokémon's dreams, it presses its tentacles against the prey's face. Their behavior is not well understood due to their rarity; some scientists suspect that each POKENAME behaves extremely differently from the other.

entry: 被POKENAME催眠的人，事后记得听见海浪与不知名宝可梦的叫声。有人认为，那是铭刻在它DNA中的记忆。
author: bobosmith01
source: Those placed under POKENAME's hypnosis later recall hearing the sound of waves and the cries of unknown Pokémon. Some have suggested these are memories ingrained in POKENAME's very DNA.

entry: 故事中，POKENAME被称为传奇的“海之英雄”，保护沿岸聚落免于危险。石质臂炮能射出强力水流，也能给口渴的人与宝可梦提供淡水。
author: mepp.
source: There are stories describing POKENAME as a legendary “Hero of the Sea” as it defended coastal settlements from danger. The stone arm-cannons fire powerful blasts of water, but can also provide fresh water to thirsty Pokémon and people.

entry: 海滨发电厂外，死去的顽皮雷弹沉入海底，POKENAME便可嵌入壳中安身。触手能瞬间抓住猎物，拖进壳内。
author: opossiblymage
source: Outside of seaside power plants, deceased Electrode sink to the bottom of the ocean, where POKENAME can embed themselves in their shells for protection. Its tentacles can grab and snatch prey into the shell in an instant.

entry: 据说，POKENAME携带着，来自遥远史前的果实，可从来没人敢尝。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are said to carry prehistoric fruits from long ago. No one has ever dared to taste them.

entry: POKENAME游在波浪下，贝壳般的头骨内会充满气泡。气泡流向身后，拖出长长轨迹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's shell-like skull fills with bubbles as it swims beneath the waves. The bubbles stream behind it in long, trailing paths.

entry: 数百万年前，POKENAME在海陆都能生活。留下的精巧贝壳武器，据信也曾由古代英雄挥舞。
author: mepp.
source: Millions of years ago, POKENAME lived both in the sea and on land. The impressive shell weapons they left behind are thought to have also been wielded by ancient heroes.

entry: 这种水下宝可梦，从蓝刺尖端排出压缩的有害气体，推动身体。身体硬得能撞击坚石与船身，刺却容易断，不过一夜就能长回。
author: infinex21
source: This underwater Pokémon propels itself by releasing compressed, noxious gases from the tips of its blue spikes. Its body is hard enough to endure crashing into solid rock and ship hulls, but its spikes easily break; these spikes can regrow overnight.

entry: POKENAME用众多触手，抓住任何靠得太近的东西。困住活物后，就拉到某张嘴旁，朝其吐出剧毒气体。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's multiple tentacles grab onto anything that comes too close to it. Once it ensnares a living creature, it holds them close to one of its mouths and breathes a highly toxic gas onto them.

entry: 坚如岩石的壳充当甲胄，让POKENAME用头冲撞物体或敌人时不受伤。科学家近日用山中挖出的角化石，将它复活。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its rock-hard shell acts as armor, preventing POKENAME from getting hurt when it charges headfirst at objects or foes. POKENAME was recently revived by scientists using its fossilized horn, discovered during mountain excavations.

entry: 普通人分不清，但POKENAME其实有两种触手：一种像植物，容易断，也容易再生；另一种硬如石，断后永不长回。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: While it's impossible for an average person to tell the difference, a POKENAME actually has two types of tentacles; one is plantlike and breaks and regrows easily, while the other is hard as stone and never grows back.

entry: 许多人曾以为POKENAME是外星生物，后来才在人类所能抵达的最深海底发现。除诱来猎物、会发蓝光的皮肤外，它几乎融入环境。
author: infinex21
source: Many believed that POKENAME are actually aliens, though eventually they were discovered in the deepest depths of the ocean that humans could actually reach. They blend into their environment save for the bioluminescent blue skin that attracts prey.

entry: 据说POKENAME在深海很多，因为一只的碎片，就能长成另一只。它们用自身发光的皮肤引诱猎物，靠近便用长触手抓住。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are supposedly abundant in ocean depths due to the fact that a new one can grow from a piece of a different POKENAME. They use their bioluminescent skin to lure prey and capture them with their long tentacles when they draw near.

entry: POKENAME在壳周围造隐形墙，防止壳太重，压得自己后翻。这些墙也充当触手，抓住远处猎物。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME creates invisible walls around its shell to keep itself from toppling backwards from the shell's weight. These same invisible walls are also used as tentacles to ensnare prey from far away.

entry: POKENAME是残酷的猎手，触手交织成盘绕的身体，在深海游行。它抓住船只，拖入深渊，再以可怕巨颚撕碎。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a cruel predator that slithers through the ocean depths with coils made of interwoven tentacles. It seizes ships and drags them into the abyss, shredding them afterward with its terrifying jaws.

entry: POKENAME心地温柔，很少还击攻击者，宁可用歌声催眠对方。它们也会用触手，载训练家与宝可梦渡海。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are gentle-hearted creatures, rarely fighting back against those who try to attack them, opting to put assailants to sleep with a song. POKENAME are known to carry Trainers and Pokémon across the oceans using their tentacles.

entry: POKENAME鬃毛上的石刺，能充电射出，电击、麻痹猎物。受害者动不了，就很容易被尾部触手拖回巢中。
author: sk372
source: The stone spines on POKENAME's mane can be electrically charged and launched to jolt and paralyze prey. Immobilized, the afflicted victim is easily dragged away by POKENAME's tail-tentacles back to its den.

entry: POKENAME更爱栖居潜艇电脑系统。吃完零散代码，它便大声哔叫，伴着回声离去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers to inhabit submarine computer systems. After consuming stray code, it departs with a series of loud, echoing beeps.

entry: 古文记载，POKENAME曾受一个无政府文明尊崇、祭拜。至今，许多后裔仍将它奉为睿智崇高的“菊石大神”。
author: gamergeek3002
source: Ancient texts tell of POKENAME being revered and worshipped by an anarchist civilization. Many descendants of this civilization still revere this Pokémon to this day as their wise and exalted Lord Helix.

entry: POKENAME背壳极其坚固，能承受现代宝可梦的咬击。最初发现的个体被封在琥珀中，许多史前宝可梦也有同样遭遇。
author: quackquackattack
source: The shell on POKENAME's back is incredibly sturdy, capable of enduring bites from modern Pokémon. The first instance of POKENAME being found was in amber, a common fate for many prehistoric Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用刃爪在石上刻纹，古生物学家认为，那是象形符号。其他化石宝可梦在附近时，它会变得敌对。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME carves patterns into rocks with its bladed claws, which paleontologists believe are pictograms. It is known to become hostile when other fossil Pokémon are nearby.

entry: 古代的POKENAME只猎大舌贝等小宝可梦。它们先用触须抓住大舌贝，再切碎，吃掉余下的部分。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME only hunted for Shellder and other small Pokémon in the ancient world. They used their tendrils to grab onto Shellder before slicing them to pieces and eating what's left.

entry: 水手故事说，风暴中曾见POKENAME与吼鲸王搏斗。触手状翅膀裹住大宝可梦，将其卷入雷电密布的云中，不见踪影。
author: wiz0z
source: Sailors tell stories of seeing POKENAME in the midst of storms, wrestling with Wailord. Its tentacle-wings wrap around the large Pokémon, vanishing it into lightning-rich thunderclouds.

entry: 沉睡力量觉醒，使POKENAME部分身体过度生长。它能从双手开口放出触手、水或能量，解决敌人与猎物。
author: infinex21
source: Parts of POKENAME's own body have overgrown due to the awakening of its dormant power. Tentacles, water, or energy can be loosed from the openings in its hands to dispatch foes and prey alike.

entry: 奇异无形的触须从POKENAME体内伸出，让碰到的对象心生寒意。有些人作出骇人的猜想，认为它一生的目标，是每种宝可梦各吃一只。
author: sk372
source: Strange ethereal tendrils reach out from within POKENAME's body, sending a chill through those they touch. Some morbid minds believe POKENAME's goal in life is to consume one of every Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME渐渐长大，颈边螺壳就会脱落，换上新的。壳带淡淡甜香，极受小型甲壳动物喜爱。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME ages, the spiral shells around its neck will fall off and be replaced by new ones. These shells carry a faintly sweet scent that makes them highly appealing to small crustaceans.

entry: POKENAME部分外壳能缩回或合上，露出或保护眼睛。它在敌人周围疾飞，以六条触手，接连快速刺击。
author: sk372
source: Parts of POKENAME's shell casing can retract or close to reveal or protect its eyes. It strikes rapidly with six tentacles to make quick stinging strikes while flitting about around its foes.

entry: 人们原以为POKENAME灭绝了，直到在深海发现活体。它伏在海床耐心等待，用触手抓住游过的东西。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME were thought to be extinct until they were discovered living in the deep ocean. It waits patiently on the seafloor, catching anything that swims underneath it with its tentacles.

entry: POKENAME尾壳能发微光，常引来其他宝可梦。弱小的诱来者，会被触手困住、电击到屈服，供它捕食。
author: infinex21
source: An POKENAME's tail-shell is able to emit a faint glow that often attracts other Pokémon. Any weaker Pokémon that are lured in will be ensnared by its tentacles and electrocuted into submission for it to prey upon.

entry: POKENAME择偶极挑剔。若不合意的多刺菊石兽靠近，它就凶猛扯掉对方的壳，吃掉身体，留下壳让其他雄性争夺。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is incredibly picky about who it mates with. If an unsuitable Omastar tries to approach it, it will violently rip off the shell, consume the body, and leave the shell for other males to fight over.

entry: 覆壳的尾巴太沉太密实，让POKENAME无法入水，却能充作上好的临时武器。它有好几组獠牙，连厚重巨石也嚼得穿。
author: bobosmith01
source: The shell-covered tail is simply too heavy and dense for POKENAME to go into the water. It does, however, make a great improvised weapon. POKENAME has multiple sets of fangs that allow it to chew even through thick boulders.

entry: 覆壳的尾巴太沉太密实，让POKENAME无法入水，却能充作上好的临时武器。它有好几组獠牙，连厚重巨石也嚼得穿。
author: bobosmith01
source: The shell-covered tail is simply too heavy and dense for POKENAME to go into the water. It does, however, make a great improvised weapon. POKENAME has multiple sets of fangs that allow it to chew even through thick boulders.

entry: 从前POKENAME横行时，会模仿名为“诅咒娃娃海藻”的植物，扑向游得太近的猎物。但植物已灭绝，它们明显的摇摆反让自己面临濒危风险。
author: teatedtiten
source: When these POKENAME ran rampant in the past, they would mimic a plant called Banette's Seaweed, pouncing on prey who swam too close. However, these plants have gone extinct, so POKENAME risk becoming endangered because of their obvious swaying.

entry: POKENAME很适合丛林生活，头周围的硬壳，保护它不被利爪从空中攫走。它们疾穿丛林，寻找花与树果吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are particularly suited for life in the jungle, as the tough shells around their head protect them from talons that try to snatch them out of the sky. They zip through the jungle searching for flowers and berries to consume.

entry: POKENAME大多泡在泥中。浑浊环境下，宝可梦误把面部附肢当食物，靠近就被触手抓住。它能将身体向内折叠，整口吞下大至自身两倍的猎物。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME lies mostly submerged in mud. In the murky conditions, Pokémon mistake the appendages on its face for food. When they draw close, it grasps them with its tentacles and swallows prey up to twice its size whole by folding in on itself.

entry: 准备发动强大的精神力攻击时，POKENAME王冠般贝壳上的刺会变成鲜红。古代，人们尊它为睿智领袖，引导宝可梦群寻找新的水下洞穴居住。
author: fiordaliso
source: The spikes on the shell it wears like a crown turn bright red when it's about to unleash a powerful Psychic attack. In ancient times, POKENAME was revered as a wise leader who guided groups of Pokémon in search of new underwater caves to inhabit.

entry: POKENAME化石常见于海相地层，骨架让古生物学家困惑，分不清哪边是头。复活后，研究者惊讶发现，头尾都有脑。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Fossils of POKENAME are common in ocean strata, their skeletons mystifying paleontologists as it's unclear which side is the head. When revived, researchers were surprised to find both the head and tail hold brains.

entry: POKENAME触手般的脸与强壮身体，常为恐怖作品提供灵感。其实它们相当平和，只想在沿海洞穴家园，不受打扰。
author: ocxin
source: POKENAME's tentacled faces and powerful bodies have been popular inspirations for horror media. In truth, they are rather passive creatures and prefer to be left alone in their coastal cavern habitats.

entry: POKENAME狡猾，常操纵其他宝可梦，替自己做琐碎杂活。盘算计谋时，它习惯抓挠头上的刺壳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is sly and prone to manipulating other Pokémon into doing menial tasks for it. It has a habit of scratching the spiked shell on its head when it is contemplating its schemes.

entry: 化石证据显示，POKENAME在食物链中很重要，既捕食小宝可梦，也供更大捕食者食用。如今，岩壳挡住大多数危险，它们已少有天敌。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Fossil evidence of POKENAME shows they were important in the food chain, acting as predators to smaller Pokémon, whilst also being food for larger predators. They have few predators in modern times, their rocky shell protecting them from most danger.

entry: 化石证据显示，POKENAME在食物链中很重要，既捕食小宝可梦，也供更大捕食者食用。它们会煮沸周围的水，吓退捕食者，烫伤靠得太近的对象。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Fossil evidence of POKENAME shows they were important in the food chain, acting as predators to smaller Pokémon, whilst also being food for larger predators. They boil the water around them to scare off predators, scalding those that get close.

entry: POKENAME主要住在外海，用力拍翼，在水中推进。遇到更大宝可梦威胁，就赶快游到水面，飞向安全距离。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME primarily live within the open ocean, propelling themselves through the water with powerful flaps of their wings. When threatened by larger Pokémon, they swim urgently to the surface to fly away to a safe distance.

entry: 飞行中，POKENAME用极长的喙，精准击打对手。翅膀由触手组成，能伸长，固定在物体表面，或攫住受害者。
author: fiordaliso
source: While in flight, POKENAME attacks its opponents with precise blows from its very long beak. Its wings are composed of tentacles it can extend to anchor itself to surfaces or snatch its victims.

entry: POKENAME常用喙附在其他宝可梦身体下侧，吃它们剩下的食物。最后，它会脱离，在嘴里存石头，从水下狙击飞行属性猎物。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME commonly latches onto the underside of Pokémon using its beak, eating leftovers of their meals. Eventually, POKENAME will detach from them, storing rocks in its mouth to snipe Flying-type prey from underwater.

entry: POKENAME尾壳中有电流流动。哪怕短暂接触，也可能麻痹。
author: .izik
source: An electrical current runs through the shell on POKENAME's tail. Even brief exposure to it can cause paralysis.

entry: POKENAME寻找海底火山，用咆哮引发喷发，再追逐逃离火山的宝可梦，用两张嘴的利齿迅速吞食。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME seeks underwater volcanoes so that it can cause them to erupt by roaring. POKENAME then proceeds to chase the Pokémon that flee from the eruption and quickly devours them using the sharp fangs of its two mouths.

entry: POKENAME长长的触须状尾巴，可作鞭子或抓钩，拍开敌人、拉来猎物。若尾巴被抓，就会让全身带电，直到获释。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their long, tendril-like tails as whips or grapples, batting foes away or pulling in prey. If their tails are grabbed, they will encase their whole bodies with electricity until they're let free.

entry: POKENAME摇动化石状球茎，引来飞行属性宝可梦。靠得够近，就投石击落，再上前猎杀。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lure Flying-type Pokémon towards them by wiggling their fossil-shaped bulbs. Once close enough, POKENAME hurl rocks at Flying-type Pokémon to knock them down before going in for the kill.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在阳光永不照入的沼泽。藤蔓并非吸收养分，而是用来绞杀。穿越沼泽务必小心，否则它令人不安的笑容，可能就是最后所见。
author: chaos_emblemx
source: POKENAME lurks in bogs where sunlight never reaches. Its vines, however, aren't for absorbing nutrients; they're for strangling. Be careful when you travel through swamps, or the unsettling smile of an POKENAME may be the last thing you see.

entry: POKENAME壳内藏着过大的脑，因精神力量而膨胀。谁与锐利目光相接，它就能读到谁的思想。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME's shell hides an oversized brain, which has swelled due to its psychic powers. Those who meet its piercing gaze give it access to their thoughts.

entry: 有人认为，POKENAME与一位被遗忘的关都古神有关。故事说，接触它幽灵形态太久，最后便会陷入疯狂。
author: sk372
source: Some believe that POKENAME bears a connection to a forgotten ancient Kantonian deity. Stories say those exposed to its spectral form for long enough will eventually succumb to madness.

entry: POKENAME适应性强，海洋、沙漠都能住。战斗中，它们先用粗糙的壳碰伤对手，再挥尾抽击。柔软腹面，只有最信任的对象才让看。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are highly adaptable, living in both oceans and deserts. When battling, their rough shells damage opponents by making contact before whipping foes with their tails. POKENAME only reveal their soft undersides to those they deeply trust.

entry: POKENAME触手能伸长，抓住猎物或敌人，固定后再用头锤攻击。触手也供进食，每根尖端都能滤取、吸入养分。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's tentacles can stretch to grab hold of prey or foes, holding them still before they strike them with headbutt attacks. Their tentacles are how they feed, as they can filter and siphon nutrients through each of their tentacle tips.

entry: POKENAME坚固的头骨壳太重，水中陆上都行动不便。它会用众多触手抓住经过的大生物，搭便车移动得快些。
author: sk372
source: The heavy weight of POKENAME's sturdy skull-shell gives it poor mobility in and out of water. It moves around quicker by grabbing onto larger creatures passing by with its many tentacles and hitching a ride.

entry: POKENAME用幽灵力量，从土石中取出化石吞食。有人认为，它汲取的是化石遗骸中仍残留的灵魂。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its ghostly powers to extract fossils from dirt and stone before consuming them. Some believe it gains sustenance from the lingering spirits still contained within those fossilized remains.

entry: 拉普拉斯是POKENAME的主要食物，因此，拉普拉斯壳上常能见到它的触手。久而久之，拉普拉斯也进化出了更硬的壳。
author: zeeroooo
source: POKENAME's tentacles can commonly be found on Lapras shells, as Lapras makes up most of their diet. Since then, Lapras have evolved harder shells.

entry: 一个消失于岁月的古文明，似乎以POKENAME为主神。遗迹中，唯一仍可辨读的记录，是“赞美菊石大神”。
author: sk372
source: An ancient civilization lost to time appeared to worship POKENAME as its main deity. The only remaining legible records left behind in the civilization's ruins read "Praise Helix."

entry: POKENAME的每片刃，都有自己的脑，因此能轻易躲过来袭攻击。
author: camtft
source: The blades of POKENAME each have a brain of their own. This allows them to dodge incoming attacks with ease.

entry: 最早的文明曾把POKENAME当机械零件使用。一幅洞穴壁画上，能看见以它为部件的设计图。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME were used as machine parts for the earliest civilizations. In a cave drawing, a blueprint including this POKENAME as a component can be seen.

entry: POKENAME尖喙能刺穿最硬的壳。自身壳太重，却使它移动极慢。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME's sharp beak allows it to pierce through even the toughest shells. The weight of its shell makes it move extremely slowly.

entry: 传说POKENAME曾以凶残脾气与碎地之力，震慑史前世界。它操纵近处地面，造出巨大石触手，打倒不敬奉自己的对象。
author: sk372
source: Legends speak of POKENAME terrifying the prehistoric world with its vicious temperament and ground-shattering power. It manipulates the ground near it to create massive tentacles of stone to strike down those who do not revere it.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在无光的深渊海域，以金色目光将进入身边的人与宝可梦诱入噩梦，再用潮旋，拖进深渊水中。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME lurk in the abyssal zone of the ocean, where light does not reach. They lure people and Pokémon that enter its presence into a nightmare with their golden gaze, before dragging them down into the abyssal waters with a Whirlpool.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，身上的覆金属板壳充当炮。平静时，风吹过开口，会发出美妙声音，有人相信能保海旅平安。
author: .izik
source: The metal-plated shell on POKENAME's body acts as a cannon when it enters a fight. When calm, the shell produces a beautiful sound when wind passes through its opening that some believe can ensure a safe sea journey.

entry: 据说POKENAME藏在常年猛烈雷暴肆虐的海域。夸大的故事说，只需瞥一眼它的形体，就会发狂，发誓追随它的理念。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to hide itself away in parts of the ocean perpetually wracked by violent thunderstorms. Tall tales say just glancing at its form will drive a mind to madness and pledging themselves to POKENAME's ideals.

entry: 都市传说里，POKENAME嫉妒心极强，所妒对象都会被肢体缠住，直接拉进嘴里。其实，人们对它所知不多，它很可能古代并不存在。
author: bobosmith01
source: Urban legends state that POKENAME has a terrible streak of jealousy; those who it envies will become tangled in its limbs and pulled directly into its mouth. In truth, not much is known about POKENAME: it is likely they did not exist in the past.

entry: POKENAME中央眼睛指挥液体身体，以水制触手打击、抓捕猎物。岩壳碎片能重新排列，护眼免遭攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's central eye directs the movements of its liquid body to strike and seize prey using tentacles made of water. The broken fragments of its rocky shell can be repositioned to protect its eye from attacks.

entry: 人们发现过海底遗迹，里面由POKENAME守卫。壳中伸出的众多触手，会凶猛抽打任何闯入者。
author: sk372
source: Undersea ruins have been discovered that house POKENAME as their guardians. The many tentacles jutting from the shell lash out viciously at any and all intruders.

entry: POKENAME每天有18个小时以上，牢牢附在海底。受攻击时，便猛烈挥动外壳。
author: weirdtux
source: POKENAME will spend over 18 hours a day anchored to the seafloor. When attacked it will flail its shell violently.

entry: POKENAME用触手捕猎，再吸干灵魂。吸得越多，头部与手臂的壳，就会冒出越多气泡。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME uses its tentacles to capture its prey and then drains their soul. The more souls it has drained, the more bubbles are released from the shells on its head and arms.

entry: POKENAME把吃掉的宝可梦的壳，添入保护软体的甲胄。触手不断长大，迫使它持续找新壳，腾出空间。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME adds the shells of devoured Pokémon to the armor protecting its soft body. It must constantly seek new shells to make room for its ever-growing tentacles.

entry: 它几乎动不了，却也不需要：POKENAME轻易就能用裹火岩石，狙击一英里以外的目标。猎物一被吞下，便什么也不剩。
author: bobosmith01
source: It can barely move, but it doesn't need to: POKENAME can snipe targets with flame- covered rocks from over a mile away with ease. When it devours prey, nothing is left behind.

entry: POKENAME进化需要两个独立贝壳，因此相当罕见。两个头不断争斗，让壳上满是裂缝与伤痕。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are quite rare due to needing two separate shells for evolution. Their shells have lots of cracks and scars due to the two heads constantly fighting one another.

entry: POKENAME花朵的香气，让大舌贝无法抗拒。猎物一靠得太近，就会被触手裹住，壳也被喙刺穿。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: The aroma from POKENAME's flower is irresistible to Shellders. Once their prey gets too close, POKENAME use their tentacles to wrap them up and pierce their shells with its beak.

entry: 胶状薄膜与坚韧骨壳，保护POKENAME的眼免受外界刺激。它用可伸长的水触手抽击对手，或从眼中射出精神光束猛击。
author: sk372
source: A gelatinous membrane and a tough bony shell keep POKENAME's eye protected from outside stimuli. It whips at opponents with extendable water tentacles or jolts them with psychic beams from its eye.

entry: POKENAME能将身体全缩入岩壳，获得保护。狩猎时，水触手同时伸向两个目标，可独眼一次只能盯住一个，往往让两者都逃走。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can fully retract its body inside its rocky shell for protection. When hunting for prey, its watery tentacles will reach out to grab two targets simultaneously, but as its single eye can only focus on one at a time, they often both escape.

entry: POKENAME守在海中，吸收沙里的矿物。因极少动弹，常被误当贝壳。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME stick to the sea, absorbing minerals in the sand. Many have mistaken POKENAME for seashells due to how rarely they move.

entry: POKENAME收集洞内找到的所有化石，助科学家加快发现，颇受欢迎。但它也很容易被赝品骗过，还坚持那些与真化石一样真。
author: thesilverowls
