source: POKENAME collect any fossils they find in caverns, making them popular with scientists for faster discoveries. However, they are also easily fooled by fakes, and will be insistent they are as real as true fossils.

entry: POKENAME模样古怪的化石，困扰科学家多年。复活后，也没让问题清楚半分。
author: kiwiarms
source: Bizarre-looking fossils of POKENAME have baffled scientists for years. Reviving the Pokémon failed to clear anything up.

entry: 这些宝可梦昼伏夜出，在夜最深时狩猎。它以惊人速度冲入水中，抓起鱼宝可梦。偶有POKENAME与暴鲤恶龙交战，导致许多码头关闭。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: These Pokémon are nocturnal, hunting for prey during the darkest hours of the night. It dives into the water at stunning speeds, snatching up Fish Pokémon. There are rare incidents of POKENAME fighting Gyaradreigon, resulting in many docks closing.

entry: POKENAME强劲的尾锤与锯齿状嘴，能对付多种水下猎物。凡是不觉得好吃的东西，它都十分友善。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's powerful tail club and serrated mouth allow it to handle a wide variety of underwater prey. It is very kind to anything it doesn't find tasty.

entry: POKENAME在海床游荡，寻找小型有壳宝可梦吃。头上的喙与壳，保护它免遭俯冲的捕食者。
author: hophoppip
source: The beak and shells on POKENAME's head protect it from diving predators as it wanders the seafloor in search of small shelled Pokémon to munch on.

entry: POKENAME爱咬走近洞穴的登山客脚踝。因此，登山客不慎一脚踢飞它，害它卡在树上的事，屡见不鲜。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME have a habit of biting the ankles of hikers who step near their burrows. This causes many cases of POKENAME being stuck in trees due to hikers kicking them up by accident.

entry: POKENAME厌恶强光，住在深海沟。一看见潜艇，就会紧张逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lives within deep ocean trenches due to its disdain for bright lights. Should it spot a submarine, it grows skittish and flees.

entry: POKENAME吸收海水，维持当前形态。手臂上的瀑布一干，它就会退回弱小形态。
author: nighthawk3380
source: POKENAME absorbs water from oceans to maintain its current form. If the waterfalls on POKENAME's arms run dry, it will revert to its weaker form.

entry: POKENAME用嘴边触手挖煤吃。吃够煤后，背部便会喷发，排出岩浆与烟雾。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME use the tentacles on their mouth to dig up coal to eat. When an POKENAME consumes enough coal, their backs erupt, expelling magma and smog.

entry: POKENAME有脸盲，无法凭视觉区分面孔；同种宝可梦在它看来，很可能几乎一模一样。它改用非凡嗅觉，辨认个体。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has prosopagnosia, or the lack of the ability to distinguish between faces by sight; any of one species would likely be perceived as nearly identical to POKENAME. It uses its incredible sense of smell to identify individuals instead.

entry: 地上虽能见到，POKENAME通常来自臭氧层以外。若从天坠落，它们就将触手缩入壳，靠壳承受巨大压力与猛烈冲击。
author: heal_fire
source: Although they can be observed on the ground, POKENAME usually come from beyond the ozone layer. If they end up falling from the sky, they retract their tentacles inside their shell, which can withstand huge pressure and very strong impacts.

entry: POKENAME越老，就在海沟挖得越深。察觉寿命将尽，它会向下游，独自睡在底部。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME ages, it tunnels progressively deeper into trenches. When it senses the end of its life nearing, it swims downward to sleep alone at the bottom.

entry: POKENAME对水压差敏感，潜水者若快速带它上浮，就会头痛不已。许多潜水者受训时，会学习减慢上升，缓解它承受的压力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are sensitive to pressure differences in the water, so whenever divers rapidly carry them to the surface, an aching headache occurs. Many divers are taught to slow their ascent to reduce the stress suffered by POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME头壳使原本迟钝的脑更加麻木。尾上的大舌贝须咬它，才会让触手抓住近处食物，提醒它吃东西。
author: sk372
source: The shell on POKENAME's head numbs its already dim mind. The Shellder on its tail has to bite it to make its tentacles grab nearby food just so POKENAME will remember to eat.

entry: POKENAME三个头协同工作，长眼的头主要控制动作。长喙的头吃下食物，虽与另两头连接细小，仍能供其能量。
author: hophoppip
source: The three heads of POKENAME work in tandem, with the eye-bearing heads primarily controlling the movements. Food ingested by the beak-bearing head fuels the other two heads despite their minuscule connections.

entry: 黏滑无骨的身体，连最小缝隙也挤得进。POKENAME用众多触手抓住猎物，再从嘴里喷出阵阵恶臭毒气，将其制服。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its slimy, boneless body can squeeze into even the smallest crevices. POKENAME uses its many tentacles to grab prey and overwhelm them with foul-smelling puffs of poisonous gas released from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME巨壳极沉，却有足够力量，在海床拖动。它缩入壳里躲藏，只有猎物进入范围，才伸出伏击、抓捕。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's massive shell is incredibly heavy, but POKENAME is strong enough to move it around the ocean floor. It will retract its body inside to hide, only emerging to ambush and seize prey that gets within reach.

entry: POKENAME大钳与重壳让行动极慢，本该容易被捕食。但壳如护城龙皮肤般坚韧，钳还能碾碎巨石。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME move incredibly slowly due to their large claws and heavy shells. This would typically make them vulnerable prey; however, their shells are as tough as a Bastiodon's hide, while their claws can crush boulders.

entry: 化蛹时，POKENAME几乎毫无自保之力。只好用粗短的腿，攀紧树枝，避开天敌。
author: chorb33
source: During its pupation, POKENAME is almost helpless. With its short stubby legs, it clings to branches to stay safe from predators.

entry: POKENAME不爱被打扰，谁哪怕轻轻碰一下，它都会猛烈爆炸。为免如此，它常用毒丝裹住自己，劝退想碰的对象。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME do not like to be disturbed, as they will explode violently if anyone so much as touches them. To prevent this, POKENAME will often wrap itself in a toxic thread to deter others from touching it.

entry: POKENAME有骑士般的天性与责任感。曾有人见它攻击折磨宝可梦的训练家；偶尔，森林家园内的其他训练家也会遭攻击。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME has a chivalrous nature with a sense of duty. They have been observed attacking Trainers who torment Pokémon and, on rare occasions, other Trainers within its forest home.

entry: POKENAME以更强的攻击性闻名，令人广泛畏惧。甲皮厚度，是同林生活的铁甲蛹、铁壳蛹的两倍。
author: snookerron
source: POKENAME are well known for their increased aggression and are widely feared. The armor on their hide is twice as thick as that of the Metapod and Kakuna they share the forest with.

entry: 触角与翅膀已形成，POKENAME却还没进化完。翅膀能撒出轻微毒雾，在完成进化前，稍稍增强对捕食者的防御。
author: sk372
source: Antennae and wings have formed, but POKENAME's evolution is not yet complete. Its wings can spread a mild poison mist, giving it a bit more defense against predators until it finishes evolving.

entry: POKENAME的镰刀，是保护茧中身体的最后手段。虽锋利，却相当脆弱，挥得太猛，可能整根折离身体，让它失去防御。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's scythes are a last resort to defend its cocooned body. Though sharp, they are rather delicate; if swung too forcefully they may snap off the body completely, leaving it vulnerable.

entry: 进化中的POKENAME被坚固茧束住，暴躁脾气却丝毫不减。进化完成、壳一裂开，它便猛冲出茧，撞向找到的第一个目标。
author: sk372
source: The sturdy cocoon immobilizing POKENAME as it evolves does little to assuage its raging temper. The moment its shell cracks when evolution finishes, it will explode out of the cocoon to charge down the first target it can find.

entry: POKENAME身体是一整个坚壳，只能漂在河溪上，无法控制去向。身体未彻底干燥，就不能进化。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME's bodies are made up of one solid husk so they simply float atop rivers and streams unable to control their path. They are incapable of evolving unless their bodies are completely dry.

entry: POKENAME鲜艳的颜色，警告捕食者远离。刺中毒液，会带来持续数天、恼人的瘙痒。
author: sautomagically
source: POKENAME's bright colors warn predators to stay away. The poison in its barbs leaves an annoying itch that lasts for days.

entry: POKENAME硬壳内的脂肪，曾因独特质地与丰富营养，被当作包治百病的药。如今，它们变得凶猛，偷猎已十分危险。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The blubber inside POKENAME's hard shell was formerly used as a cure-all medicine due to its unique texture and high nutritional content. Poaching POKENAME is now very dangerous due to the vicious nature it has since developed.

entry: POKENAME坚韧的茧，防护爪击与抓伤。它们能通过进化，迅速适应恶劣环境；无法自行移动，让这点尤其重要。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are protected by a tough cocoon that protects them from claws and scratches. They can quickly adapt to harsh environments through evolution, which is especially important because they cannot move on their own.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴悬挂，待在耐用的茧内，等待进化之日。许多个体遇到危险捕食者，就会进化，获得新力量。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hang from their tails inside a durable cocoon awaiting the day they evolve. Many evolve when presented with a dangerous predator and gain new powers as a result.

entry: POKENAME有四条退化肢体，被厚茧包住，无法活动。除坚茧外，再无防御手段，因此许多被飞行属性宝可梦吃掉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have four vestigial limbs that are unable to move because of the thick cocoon that surrounds them. Many end up eaten by Flying-type Pokémon because they lack the means to defend themselves besides their tough cocoon.

entry: POKENAME因坚茧无法游泳，只能在湖河底摇晃，直到进化。长尾让它们显得更大，吓走捕食者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are unable to swim because of their tough cocoon, so they wobble at the bottom of lakes and rivers until they evolve. Their long tails make them appear larger than they are, which scares predators away.

entry: POKENAME带着静电，会电击任何靠得太近的捕食者。茧的厚甲板让它们无法移动，因此这点尤其重要。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a static charge that zaps any predator that comes too close. This is especially important because the thick plates of their cocoon render them immobile.

entry: POKENAME周身裹着厚重坚茧，行动受限。捕食者若刺穿茧，就会迎上从伤处喷出的高压火焰。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are surrounded by a tough and bulky cocoon that limits their movement. If a predator punctures the cocoon, they are met with pressurized flames that escape from the wound.

entry: POKENAME藏在网络空间，裹着保护壳，等待进一步进化。反复点击，会敲落部分外壳，可进化后，它会找这么做的人报仇。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides in cyberspace, cocooned in a protective shell while it waits to evolve further. Clicking repeatedly on it will chip off parts of its shell, but POKENAME will seek vengeance on those who do so once it evolves.

entry: POKENAME成群聚在海中浅滩，互相抵御潮汐与捕食者。会如此挤在一起等上最多六个月，进化后才离海寻找大量食物。
author: divinelunaria
source: POKENAME gather in large groups on ocean shoals to protect each other from the tides and predators. They will huddle in these patterns for up to six months waiting to evolve, at which point they will emerge from the sea and seek vast amounts of food.

entry: POKENAME进化后保留坚甲，比其他大针蜂慢得多，却壮实得多。它们常相互冲撞，试着刺穿对方的壳。
author: mistymagius
source: Keeping the tough carapace after evolution, POKENAME is a lot slower than other Beedrill but significantly bulkier. POKENAME will often clash with one another, trying to pierce each other's shells.

entry: POKENAME行动极慢，茧中身体正为进化节省能量。茧若遭击打，便释放巨大精神脉冲，瞬间使100英尺内任何生物昏迷24小时。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME moves very slowly, as its cocooned body attempts to conserve energy for evolution. The cocoon releases a large psychic pulse if struck, instantly knocking out any creature within 100 feet for 24 hours.

entry: POKENAME从背部吐黏丝，固定在树上，直到准备好进化。身体持续放热，冬天也能保暖。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME spew sticky threads from their backs, attaching themselves to trees until they're ready to evolve. Their bodies constantly emit heat, keeping them warm in the winter.

entry: POKENAME平日多一动不动，藏在湖底藻丛间。谁靠得太近，它就突然猛咬，将其赶走。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME usually spends its days perfectly still, hidden among the algae growing on lakebeds. If someone ventures too close, it lashes out with a sudden bite to drive them away.

entry: 坚硬外骨骼，使POKENAME很难学会飞。常能见一群群试着飞，却从树上掉下来。
author: mistymagius
source: Due to its tough exoskeleton, POKENAME has trouble learning to fly. Groups of them can be seen falling out of trees in an attempt to fly.

entry: POKENAME周身的毛僵硬如蜡，在成长时提供保护。毛限制活动范围，因此它们白天尽量躲藏。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have stiff and waxy fur surrounding their bodies that helps protect them as they grow. This protective fur limits the range of movement POKENAME are capable of, so they try to stay hidden during the day.

entry: POKENAME定时轻轻咕叫，在进化过程中调节体温。越接近进化，叫声频率就越明显增高。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes a soft hoot periodically, an act done to regulate its internal temperature as it evolves. When evolution draws nearer, the hooting increases dramatically in frequency.

entry: POKENAME栖在松树顶，硬化双翼护住身体。受惊时，它发出尖锐咔嗒声，吓退闯入者，再恢复静止。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME roosts at the tops of pine trees, its hardened wings shielding its body from attacks. If startled, it lets out a sharp clicking sound to scare off intruders before resuming its stillness.

entry: POKENAME攀在树枝，身体逐渐硬化，像叶间一枚金芽。受打扰，它便急扇贝壳般的翅膀，打出一阵细小却有力的拳击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME clings to tree limbs as its body hardens, appearing like a golden bud among the leaves. If disturbed, it rapidly flutters its shell-like wings, unleashing a flurry of tiny but forceful punches.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME用强劲的拳头攀住树干，凭触角察觉即将到来的恶劣天气。
author: .izik
source: At night POKENAME clings to a tree with its strong fists. It uses its antennae to sense when inclement weather is on the way.

entry: POKENAME挂在网上，会把腿蜷在腹下，模仿无助、未融合的铁壳蛹。身体虽小，仍试着攀住攻击自己的宝可梦，使其中毒。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME curls its legs underneath its belly when hanging from a web to resemble a helpless, unfused Kakuna. As small as it is, it still attempts to latch onto and poison any Pokémon that attacks it.

entry: POKENAME在周围织丝陷阱，布成警戒线，提醒威胁靠近。等待进化时，它全心专注于硬化外壳。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME weaves silk traps around itself, creating alarm lines that alert it to approaching threats. While it waits for evolution, it focuses entirely on hardening its outer shell.

entry: POKENAME向选中的栖树吐出丝状物。丝臭如腐烂垃圾，在等待进化时，帮它驱退闯入者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits a silk-like substance onto trees it chooses to roost in. This silk reeks of rotting garbage, deterring intruders while it waits to evolve.

entry: POKENAME茧中的身体难以移动，触角却能自由活动，感知周围。一察觉危险，触角就能短距离阵阵放电，自我防卫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cocooned body lacks mobility, but can freely move its antennae to sense its surroundings. If it senses danger, the antenna can discharge short-range bursts of electricity to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME行动不便，整日储能，等待进化完成。捕食者靠近，它便释放明亮电能，晃花对方的眼，趁机逃走。
author: sk372
source: Not very mobile, POKENAME spends time storing energy, waiting for evolution to finish. If a predator draws near, it releases a bright burst of electric energy to blind the foe so POKENAME can escape.

entry: POKENAME躲在空心原木中，避免与捕食者冲突。只有满月才出来，尽情享受月光。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sequester themselves away in hollowed out logs to avoid confrontation with predators. They only come out during the full moon to revel in the moonlight.

entry: 壳中有浓稠液体，身体在其中慢慢发育。壳一破，POKENAME就无法存活，因此靠近务必小心。
author: musicsheep.
source: Inside its shell is a viscous fluid where its body slowly develops. If the shell is damaged, POKENAME will not survive, so great care is needed when near it.

entry: POKENAME太大，多数捕食者搬不走，因此能在枝头安坐数小时，不受打扰。它们也会吐出腐臭丝，将自己固定在枝上。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are too big for most predators to carry them away, so they sit atop branches undisturbed for hours at a time. They also release a putrid silk that secure them to branches.

entry: POKENAME有覆鳞的小翅膀，被打落后，能帮助飞回树枝。大风天，它们可能费上几小时，也仍试着回到原来的枝头。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have small, scaly wings that help them fly back up into branches after they are knocked down. On particularly windy days, they can spend hours trying to get back to their branch.

entry: 等待进化时，POKENAME焦躁不安。没有嘴，不能再进食，令它一直饥饿难受。
author: megashit100000
source: While waiting for evolution, POKENAME becomes restless. Without a mouth, it can no longer eat, so it is constantly hungry and miserable.

entry: POKENAME攻击前先硬化长尾，当作坚实棍棒，驱赶捕食者。虽大多动不了，遭挑衅时，却能以惊人速度抽击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hardens its long tail before attacking, using it as a sturdy club to fend off predators. Though mostly immobile, it can lash out with surprising speed if provoked.

entry: POKENAME双翼从不停歇，以非凡飞速与灵活性，躲避捕食者。这种飞行耗能太多，使进化过程比多数铁壳蛹融合体长得多。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has extraordinary airspeed and maneuverability to avoid predators, its wings never resting. Because it takes so much energy to maintain this flight technique, its evolution process is massively extended compared to most Kakuna fusions.

entry: 科学家找到了加快POKENAME这一进化阶段的方法。喂黄色果汁，似乎能大大加快细胞繁殖。有人认为，这可能有助干细胞研究。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Scientists have found a way to rapidly accelerate this stage in POKENAME's evolution cycle. When fed Yellow Juice, it seems to greatly increase the rate at which its cells reproduce. Some think this could help in stem cell research.

entry: 坚硬外壳阻碍逃离危险，POKENAME便放出使人头痛的精神波，劝退捕食者。不受骚扰时，它们用心灵感应，倾听其他宝可梦的思想。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have rigid shells that prevent them from escaping danger, so they emit psychic waves that cause headaches to deter predators. When they are not harassed by predators, they listen to the thoughts of other Pokémon with telepathy.

entry: POKENAME坚茧上有黄色条带，夜里会发光。诡异光芒驱赶捕食者，让它安静发育。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have yellow bands across their tough cocoon that glow at night. The eerie glow keeps predators away and allows POKENAME to develop in peace.

entry: POKENAME把进化所需的能量存进花苞，受了伤，也能迅速长好新皮。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME stores the energy it needs for evolution in its bud. If it is injured, it can quickly renew its skin.

entry: POKENAME几乎完全不动，节省能量，只盼外表就能吓退捕食者。若失败，积存的能量，仍够至少一次强力扑击与狠咬。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME remains almost entirely immobile to conserve energy, hoping its appearance alone will frighten off predators. If that fails, it can still use its stored energy to make at least one strong lunge and potent bite.

entry: POKENAME硬化的壳挡下多数威胁，但危险若持续，它就猛烈振动，直到引发巨大爆炸，自毁身体。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's hardened shell protects it from most threats, but if danger persists, it vibrates violently until it self-destructs in a massive explosion.

entry: 薄保护茧覆在更强的金属壳外，给POKENAME双层防护。茧若裂开，它就将其打成碎片，射向四面。
author: sk372
source: A thin protective cocoon is layered over a much stronger metallic shell, giving POKENAME two layers of protection. If the cocoon is cracked, it breaks the cocoon into shards and fires them in all directions.

entry: POKENAME凶狠的低吼能吓退捕食者，除此以外，却很温顺。它常挂在枝上睡半天，等待进化。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a fierce growl that scares predators, but it is otherwise a docile Pokémon. It often sleeps for half the day while hanging from tree branches, awaiting evolution.

entry: POKENAME大多在巢内静歇，等待进一步进化。偶尔才起飞，用爪抓食物碎屑或易摘树果，带回巢，留待进化后吃。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME spends most of its time inside its nest, resting still until it evolves further. Rarely, it may take flight and scoop up food scraps or easy-to-snag berries in its talons and take them back to its nest to devour after it evolves.

entry: POKENAME富含几丁质的羽毛折叠起来，在体表形成致密保护层。虽使飞行笨拙，却能让它安全栖息，远离捕食者，积蓄进化所需能量。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have chitin rich feathers that fold together to form a dense protective layer over their body. While this makes them clumsy in the air, it allows them to roost safe from predators whilst they gather the energy needed to evolve.

entry: POKENAME自认为完美哨兵，能几天不动、不眨眼地守卫。可身体僵硬，真发现闯入者时，反应却很笨拙。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME fancies itself a perfect sentinel, standing guard without moving or blinking for days. However, its stiff body makes it clumsy to react when an intruder is finally detected.

entry: POKENAME壳内衬着坚韧几丁质，几乎不可摧毁。它虽静止不动，感到强敌在附近，藏着的角仍会微微抽动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's shell is lined with tough chitin, making it nearly indestructible. Though it remains still, its hidden horn twitches slightly when it senses strong opponents nearby.

entry: POKENAME积了满腔精力，茧却大大限制行动。它多数时间都闷闷不乐，没耐心地等进化完成。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a lot of pent-up energy, but its cocoon hampers a great deal of its mobility. Much of its time is spent moping and impatiently waiting for its evolution to finish.

entry: POKENAME身体围着几丁质壳，只能短短跳几下。它们始终张开双翼，吓走领地内的野生宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a chitinous shell around their body that limits their movement to short hops. They keep their wings outstretched to scare wild Pokémon away from their territory.

entry: POKENAME浓厚纠结的毛，形成致密外衣。它们靠毛保护身体，长久待在一处，积蓄进化能量。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have thick, matted hair that forms a dense coat around their bodies. They rely on this fur to protect them, remaining in one place for long stretches of time as they gather the energy to evolve.

entry: 与阿柏蛇不同，POKENAME的牙尚未发育完全。它靠坚如岩石的头骨，撞击猎物。
author: pokepower
source: Unlike Ekans, POKENAME's fang are under-developed. It attacks prey by headbutting them with its rock-hard skull.

entry: POKENAME不能吃东西，野外便滚进树果堆，将果汁与果泥涂满身体，治疗自己。它也在其他东西里打滚：用泥去寄生虫，用水清洁。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME cannot eat, so to heal itself in the wild, it can rub juice and paste along its body by rolling around in a collection of Berries. It rolls around in other substances too: mud to get rid of parasites, and water to clean itself.

entry: 不屈的精神，加上坚硬外壳，让POKENAME成为最顽强的宝可梦之一。足以击倒更大敌人的攻击，它也能承受。
author: inkysquid38
source: POKENAME's indomitable spirit, paired with its tough outer shell, ensures that this is one of the most resilient Pokémon. It can withstand attacks that would fell much larger foes.

entry: POKENAME夜里巡逻河湖，用缎带清除垃圾。日出时，便使出变硬，在水面附近休息，慢慢恢复下夜巡逻所需的能量。
author: pkbonusducks
source: During the night, POKENAME patrol rivers and lakes, using their ribbons to dispose of garbage. As the sun rises, they Harden and rest near the water's surface, slowly regaining the energy they need for the next night's patrol.

entry: 大坑与丢弃的壳，标示着POKENAME的存在。常见做法是把壳水煮几分钟，切碎，用花生油炒，再配米饭和蔬菜上桌。
author: wiz0z
source: The presence of POKENAME is marked by large pits and discarded shells. Common recipes for cooking the shells involve boiling it in water for a few minutes, chopping it up, then sautéing it with peanut oil and serving with rice and vegetables.

entry: POKENAME的茧有多层，因为每次放电驱赶捕食者，都会汽化最外层。它长出新层补回，却也因此推迟进化。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cocoon is multilayered, as each electric burst it uses to deter predators vaporizes the outermost shell. It grows new layers to replace them, though this process delays its evolution.

entry: POKENAME覆有易导电的保护壳，谁想抱或碰，就会被电。它们用长尾挂在树上，等待进化。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME are covered in a protective shell that easily conducts electricity and will discharge it into anyone who attempts to hold or touch them. They use their long tails to hang from trees while waiting for their evolution.

entry: POKENAME埋在浅水沙中，只露触角。察觉有东西靠得太近，触角便喷出水柱，打退闯入者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME buries itself in the sand in shallow waters until only its antennae stick out. Should it sense anything getting too close to it, water spouts shoot from the antennae to knock away intruders.

entry: POKENAME不太好当宠物养，大多闲暇都蜷成球，准备进化。只有吃、战斗或运动时，才会展开身体。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME can be difficult to keep as pets, as they spend a good majority of their free time curled up in a ball preparing for evolution. POKENAME will only uncurl themselves when eating, fighting, or exercising.

entry: POKENAME用长尾挂在树枝，或把尾刺扎进树干，直接悬挂。越接近进化，覆壳双翼就越开始活动。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME hang from tree branches using their long tails or they drive their tail spike into a tree and hang directly on the tree itself. As they grow closer to evolving, their shell-clad wings begin to stir.

entry: 坚茧让POKENAME大多动不了。它们从背部长出叶尖带毒的叶子，射向捕食者，自我防卫。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are rendered mostly immobilized thanks to their tough cocoon. They defend themselves from predators by growing venom-tipped leaves from their back and launching them at predators.

entry: POKENAME走得极慢，能量大多用于发育壳内冰寒的身体。它吃得不多，吃下什么，也都会冻住。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME moves very, very slowly, as most of its energy is spent towards growing the freezing body in its shell. It doesn't eat much, and freezes whatever it does eat.

entry: POKENAME外壳坚韧，却够灵活，可以活动。不过，它宁可待在安全处等待进化。察觉危险，就硬化、加热壳，驱退捕食者。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: The shell surrounding POKENAME is tough, but it is flexible enough to allow movement. However, it opts to stay in a safe area while awaiting evolution. If it senses danger, POKENAME will harden and heat its shell to ward off predators.

entry: POKENAME成堆聚在巢内，等待进化。若察觉危险，壳便开始散热，驱赶潜在攻击者。亲代在周围巡逻，确保幼崽安全。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME can be found in clusters within a nest as they await evolution. If they sense danger, heat will begin to radiate off their shells to ward off potential attackers. The parents patrol the area to ensure the safety of their young.

entry: POKENAME裹着坚茧，用念力移动受限的身体。多数攻击都会从硬壳滑开，因此它也用身体保护别人。
author: sk372
source: Clad in a sturdy cocoon, POKENAME uses telekinesis to move its restricted body around. It uses its own body to shield others, as most blows will glance off of its hard shell.

entry: 有些POKENAME的茧不太坚固，渐渐剥落，露出部分身体。甲虽较弱，它仍愿用覆壳身体，保护在意的对象。
author: sk372
source: Some POKENAME cocoons are less sturdy and chip off over time, revealing some of the Pokémon within. Despite the weaker armor, it still willingly uses its shelled body to protect those it cares for.

entry: POKENAME身体硬化得几乎动不了，外出时，全身毒刺便是唯一防御。它通常藏在树根下，耐心等待进化。
author: fiordaliso
source: Because its body has hardened to the point that POKENAME can barely move, the poisonous spines covering it serve as its only defense outdoors. It usually hides beneath tree roots, waiting patiently for the time to evolve.

entry: POKENAME小群聚集，在林地上紧贴着堆成一堆。靠近能增强防御；一旦受袭，它们就合用精神力量，击退进犯者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gather in small swarms so they can stick together in piles on the forest floor. The proximity allows for better defenses; if the pile is under attack, they can unite their psychic powers to fend off the aggressor.

entry: POKENAME几乎无法移动，每天小心挪动，也只能前进几厘米。为安全等待进化，它们在树干凿小洞，啃木维生。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are almost immobile and can only move a few centimetres a day by carefully shuffling. To stay safe while they wait to evolve they make small burrows in tree trunks, gnawing at the wood for sustenance.

entry: POKENAME行动受周身茧限制。有些能猎小型虫属性宝可梦，但多数宁愿等进化后，再找下一餐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have limited movement because of the cocoon around their body. While some are capable of hunting small Bug-type Pokémon, most opt to wait until they evolve before finding their next meal.

entry: POKENAME静止休眠，直到准备好进化。受伤时，它放出恶臭，让其他宝可梦不敢打扰。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME remains motionless and dormant until it is ready to evolve. It produces a foul-smelling scent when hurt, so other Pokémon leave it alone.

entry: 小宝可梦常在POKENAME附近避难，因为它僵立的身形，很能威慑捕食者。不过，一旦进化，寄居者往往就得另找新家。
author: afilthycasual
source: Smaller Pokémon will often shelter near POKENAME as their frozen forms work well in intimidating predators. However, once POKENAME evolves, the sheltering Pokémon often need to find a new home.

entry: POKENAME身体如金色圣杯般闪耀。一位富有名人，曾将它当作豪宅里的装饰，引来关注。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's body shimmers like a golden chalice. One wealthy celebrity garnered attention by using a POKENAME as a decorative feature in their mansion.

entry: POKENAME硬化的蛹壳，既能防身，也能作武器。头顶处的壳尤其厚，因此它们更喜欢头朝前，发起冲撞。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their hardened chrysalises both to protect themselves and as weapons. The shells of their chrysalises are especially thick at the tops of their skulls, leading them to prefer ramming head-first as an attack.

entry: 身体渐渐不能动，POKENAME就靠事先采来的叶与坚果维生。三蜜蜂群围在身边，始终喂养、保护它。
author: beatdoof
source: With it becoming immobile, POKENAME sustains itself with leaves and nuts it had previously procured. Swarms of Combee surround it, feeding and protecting it throughout.

entry: POKENAME能察觉危险、预测灾难。不过，除了保护自己，似乎也不怎么采取别的行动。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME can sense danger and predict disasters. However, it doesn't seem to do much about this except protect itself.

entry: 它看似完全动不了，硬化双臂从不离开身侧。但夜里，趁不知情的受害者没看，它会飘到背后极近处，想突然贴近，吓对方一跳。
author: haypile
source: It appears to be completely immobile, never moving its hardened arms from its sides. But at night, when an unsuspecting victim isn't looking, it floats right up close behind them, hoping to surprise the target with its sudden proximity.

entry: POKENAME在树根间挖洞，一天大多在里面睡，节省进化所需能量。极硬的壳覆满毒刺，让捕食者不敢靠近。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME sleeps for most of the day in a burrow it digs among tree roots, conserving the energy it needs to evolve. Its extremely hard shell is covered in poisonous spikes that keep predators at bay.

entry: POKENAME毒刺咬下去，会有令人反胃的嘎吱口感，惹得许多捕食者干呕。它们通常是万不得已才吃的一餐，许多捕食者宁可不吃，也不愿碰它。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have venomous spines that produce a revolting crunch whenever they are bitten into, triggering the gag reflex of many predators. They are typically a meal of last resort, as many predators would prefer to eat nothing over a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME很少移动，保存进化能量，藏在随时重搭的叶堆里。厚皮能御寒，因此它很少需要另找庇护。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME moves very little to conserve its energy for its evolution and hides within a pile of leaves that it rebuilds as necessary. Its thick hide protects it from cold weather, so it rarely needs to seek shelter.

entry: 坚壳般的皮肤之外，这只宝可梦任一翅膀一挥，都能把树折成两段。翼中还藏着毒刺，不过，很少有事物能迫使POKENAME使用。
author: infinex21
source: Paired with its shell-hard hide, this Pokémon can snap trees in two with the swing of either of its wings. It has venomous stingers concealed within its wings, but it is rare for anything to cause POKENAME to use them.

entry: POKENAME自身虽不太能动，却能握住柄，充作结实匕首。使用者发现，刃异常耐用，几乎从不用磨。
author: .fedoraman
source: While not very mobile on its own, POKENAME can be grasped by its handle and used as a stout dagger. Those who do so find that its blade is remarkably durable, hardly ever needing to be honed.

entry: POKENAME的壳咬来有独特、令人反胃的嘎吱口感，捕食者会主动避开。背刺里的毒物又浓稠得能使许多捕食者干呕。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a uniquely revolting crunch to their shells that predators actively avoid. The spines on their back are filled with a toxic substance that is thick enough to trigger the gag reflex of many predators.

entry: POKENAME紧贴在树上，几乎一动不动。它会用飘带引诱猎物，获取营养。
author: melodydelune
source: Being virtually immobile while clinging to a tree, POKENAME gains nutrients by luring in prey with its ribbons.

entry: POKENAME体形大，通常不受猎捕，但少数大胆的飞行属性宝可梦，会撬开茧的甲片。据说，下面小刺放出的恶臭，会使对方干呕。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are typically not hunted because of their large size, but a few daring Flying-type Pokémon are willing to pry the plates of their cocoon open. The noxious scent released from the tiny spines underneath is said to trigger gag reflexes.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME与同类聚集，在银色月光中飘浮起舞。一发现飞行属性宝可梦，就立刻使出变硬，加固壳。
author: fiordaliso
source: During a full moon, POKENAME gathers with others of its kind to dance while floating in its silver light. If it spots a Flying-type Pokémon, it immediately uses Harden to reinforce its shell.

entry: POKENAME能快速行动，茧状身体却十分脆弱。因此，只要觉得危险，就更愿逃跑；不过，若有足够多同类相伴，也可能自卫。
author: quantumradiation
source: While POKENAME is capable of swift movement, its cocoon-like body is extremely fragile. As such, POKENAME prefers to flee in the presence of any assumed danger, although it may defend itself if it is in a large enough group of other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME硬化的壳上，有一薄层孢子，能使捕食者昏昏欲睡。进化时，壳炸裂，花粉随之迸散。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's hardened shell is coated in a fine layer of spores that can cause drowsiness in predators. When it evolves, the shell shatters with an explosion of pollen.

entry: POKENAME为自保，附身一部旧手机。设备设计耐用，让它极能抵抗攻击。
author: hophoppip
source: To protect itself, POKENAME has possessed an old cell phone. Thanks to the device's durable design, it's highly resistant to attacks.

entry: POKENAME常在月光下打盹，让茧更能抵抗恶劣天气。敏锐听觉能察知逼近的危险，随后它便藏进灌木。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME often naps under moonlight, as it helps its cocoon become more resistant to harsh weather. Thanks to its keen hearing, it can sense any approaching danger and hides in the undergrowth.

entry: POKENAME利用外表，试着从野生宝可梦处偷蜜。可惜，常因此遭到大针蜂或蜂女王攻击。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME take advantage of their appearance to try and steal honey from wild Pokémon. Unfortunately for POKENAME, this often leads to them being attacked by Beedril or Vespiquen.

entry: 它将触手裹住身体，等待进化。谁靠近，都会被触手攫住、勒在身上，被POKENAME强行按住，直到它进化。
author: bobosmith01
source: It awaits evolution with its tentacles wrapped around its body. Any who approach will be snatched in its tentacles and constricted against its body, forcibly pinned by POKENAME until it evolves.

entry: POKENAME攀在高树上，等待进化完成。无形缎带由奇怪的有毒星尘构成，依本能袭击近处一切，接触便留下痛苦抓伤与皮疹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME clings high up in trees and waits for its evolution to finish. Its ethereal ribbons are made of strange poisonous stardust that acts on instinct, striking anything nearby and creating painful scratches and rashes on contact.

entry: POKENAME几乎动不了，靠大前爪慢慢拖着自己走。白天，它们埋入地下，躲避捕食者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are barely able to move, using their large front claws to slowly drag themselves around. They bury themselves underground during daylight hours to hide from predators.

entry: POKENAME几乎动不了，靠大前爪慢慢拖着自己走。白天，它们埋入地下，躲避捕食者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are barely able to move, using their large front claws to slowly drag themselves around. They bury themselves underground during daylight hours to hide from predators.

entry: POKENAME坚硬外骨骼，能承受巨大压力。等待进化时，它们埋进崖边落下的碎石堆，躲在重石深处，安然不动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a tough exoskeleton that can withstand tremendous physical pressure. They bury themselves within scree that has fallen from cliffs whilst they wait to evolve, safe deep beneath the heavy boulders.

entry: POKENAME坚硬外骨骼，能承受巨大压力。等待进化时，它们埋进崖边落下的碎石堆，躲在重石深处，安然不动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a tough exoskeleton that can withstand tremendous physical pressure. They bury themselves within scree that has fallen from cliffs whilst they wait to evolve, safe deep beneath the heavy boulders.

entry: POKENAME完全不能动，埋在地里，嘴正朝地表。等待化蛹时，虽不需多少食物，谁踩上来，它却都会咬。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME is completely immobile, lying buried in the ground with its mouth facing directly to the surface. Though it does not require much food while waiting to pupate, it will snap at anything that steps on it.

entry: POKENAME静埋湖河的泥底，躲避捕食者，准备进一步进化。何况，它滑溜而略有毒的外层，也让多数宝可梦不想捕食。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME lay still buried in the muddy floors of rivers and lakes to hide from predators and prepare for further evolution. Its slick and mildly poisonous outer layer makes it undesirable prey for most Pokémon anyways.

entry: 最大的大针蜂群落中，能发现POKENAME。它们充当齿轮，构成简陋却巧妙的滑轮系统，运输蜂蜜。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME can be found within the largest Beedrill colonies, serving as cogwork for rudimentary yet intelligent pulley systems used in transporting honey.

entry: POKENAME关节僵硬，只能小跳。许多个体伪装成熟睡的阿柏蛇，吓退潜在捕食者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have stiff joints and are only capable of small hops. Many disguise themselves as sleeping Ekans to scare away potential predators.

entry: 茧与花朵的重量，让POKENAME等待进一步进化时，几乎完全动不了。幸好，花能放出浓密花粉云与坚实藤蔓自卫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cocoon and the weight of its flower keep it almost completely immobile while it waits to evolve further. Fortunately, its flower can release thick pollen clouds and sturdy vines to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME硬化的壳，因内热微微发光，暗示里面正发生变化。临近进化，甲上细裂缝会喷出团团热气。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME hardened shell glows faintly with inner heat, hinting at a transformation within. Tiny cracks in its armor release puffs of hot air as it nears evolution.

entry: POKENAME住在玫瑰中，用花刺与自身毒刺，保护化蛹过程。不过，许多人类觉得它浪漫，让它成为绘画与童话中的常见意象。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME live in roses, using the sharp thorns of the flower along with their own poison spikes to keep them safe while they pupate. However, many humans find POKENAME romantic, with them becoming a common motif in paintings and fairy tales.

entry: POKENAME先把下身埋进胡萝卜田，再硬化外壳。农人常在地下发现一簇簇，安然依偎，耐心等待进化。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows its lower body in carrot fields before hardening its outer shell. Farmers often find clusters of them nestled underground, waiting patiently for evolution.

entry: POKENAME用僵硬身体，滚过自己脱落的孢子，覆上一层毒。任何想咬的捕食者，都会遭严重化学灼伤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rolls its rigid body through the spores it sheds, coating itself in a toxic layer. Any predator that attempts to bite it suffers severe chemical burns.

entry: POKENAME能感知周围宝可梦的思想，因此即将受击时，体外液体便会硬化。这份能力与坚茧，一同防止它被捕食。
author: quackquackattack
source: The fluid around POKENAME's body hardens when it is about to be struck, as POKENAME can detect the thoughts of Pokémon around them. This ability, along with their tough cocoon, prevent predators from eating POKENAME.

entry: 茧中身体毫无攻击手段，POKENAME只能飞离危险自保。带着沉重身体飞行的消耗，又会推迟进化。
author: sk372
source: Since its cocooned body has no means of attack, POKENAME only defense is to fly away from danger. The exertion from flying its heavier body around delays its evolution process.

entry: POKENAME灰色的眼睛，能防止被另一只光头晃花。可外表太显眼，仍很容易成为大王燕的猎物。
author: amphi64
source: POKENAME's grey eyes protect them from being dazzled by the bald head of another POKENAME. They are an easy prey to Swellow due to their visibility.

entry: 野外偶尔会形成POKENAME：哭哭面具丢失面具，找到废弃铁壳蛹壳，壳中残留的铁壳蛹灵魂，便导致融合。
author: crumple_2
source: POKENAME can rarely form in the wild if a Yamask loses its mask and finds an abandoned Kakuna shell. The soul of the Kakuna lingers inside the shell, causing the fusion.

entry: POKENAME静止在树枝上，连翅膀也卡在进化前的姿势。越接近下一次进化，壳就越热。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME remain immobile atop tree branches; even their wings are stuck in the position they had before evolving. As they grow closer to their next evolution, their shells become hotter.

entry: POKENAME静挂洞顶，融入黑暗。夜里，它准备进化时，洞中便能听见诡异尖叫。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hangs silently from cave ceilings, blending into the darkness. At night, eerie screeches can be heard from within the cave as it prepares for evolution.

entry: 它钻进地下，只露头叶。这能劝退捕食者，因为壳硬、味苦，又带轻毒，几乎没谁还想费力吃它。
author: sk372
source: It burrows into the ground, leaving the leaves on its head exposed. These are a deterrent, as between the hardness of its shell, the bitter taste, and the mild poison, few will bother trying to eat it.

entry: POKENAME的叶虽难采，建筑工地却需求很高。碾碎混水，便成独特黏树脂，黏合后几乎无法分开。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: While difficult to harvest, POKENAME leaves are in high demand among construction sites. When crushed and mixed with water, the leaves become a unique sticky resin with virtually unbreakable adhesion.

entry: POKENAME跳出复杂的桑巴般舞步，结束后，似乎僵住不动，硬化身体。此时虽动不了，训练家却坚称，壳里仍传出节拍。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs intricate samba-like movements, and seemingly freezes after the dance concludes to harden its body. Despite its immobility during this time, Trainers swear they can hear rhythmic beats emanating from its shell.

entry: POKENAME热爱跳舞，让羽毛流动成优美场面。舞毕，它鞠躬等待掌声，身体随之僵硬。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are passionate dancers that create flowing displays of feathers. When they finish dancing, their body grows stiff as they bow for applause.

entry: POKENAME钳中夹着浸毒棉花，保卫领地。毒素能让意志薄弱的对象产生妄想，不受控制地跳舞。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME holds poison-filled cotton in its pincers to defend its territory. The toxin can cause weak-willed individuals to experience delusions and dance uncontrollably.

entry: POKENAME深夜飘过草甸，坚硬身体来回摇摆，不知何处传来诡异曲调。据说，盯它太久，就会看见可怕幻景。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats through meadows late at night, its hard body rocking back and forth while an eerie tune plays from an unknown source. It is said that staring at it too long will cause horrifying visions.

entry: 传说POKENAME用缓慢的仪式舞，引近亡魂，再吸收为能量。它借这份能量硬化壳，准备下一次进化。
author: .izik
source: Legends say POKENAME ushers the souls of the dead closer with a slow, ritualistic dance before absorbing them for energy. It uses this energy to harden its shell, preparing for its next evolution.

entry: POKENAME有厚塑料茧，保护里面发育的身体。强烈恶臭，也会驱退好奇的宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a thick plastic cocoon that protects them while they develop inside. They also have a potent stench that drives away curious Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME轻得无需拍翼，风就能带走。任凭风雨摆布，让它陷入深度冥想，身体则在壳下发育、成长。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is so light that it is carried by winds without the need to flap its wings. Being at the mercy of the elements sends it into a deep meditative state, whilst its body develops and grows beneath its shell.

entry: POKENAME尽量睡在多光源的地方，为进化获取最多能量。可若一次吸光太多，壳热得要融化，它就会爆发力量，改变形态，而不是进化。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME sleeps near as many light sources as it can to get as much energy as possible for evolution. However, if it absorbs too much light at once and its shell becomes melting hot, it transforms with a burst of power rather than evolving.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇，根部刺穿坚硬外甲，直接从体内汲养。它吃树根，同时养活自己与真菌。
author: .izik
source: The mushrooms on POKENAME's back have roots that pierce its hard outer carapace, drawing nutrients directly from its body. It feeds on tree roots to nourish both itself and the fungi.

entry: 即使雷暴或捕食者群等危险将至，POKENAME也宁愿不动，在巢中休息。不过，它至少有先见之明，会把巢筑得十分隐蔽。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME prefers staying still and resting in its nest even if dangerous impending conditions approach, such as a thunderstorm or a swarm of predators. However, POKENAME at least has the foresight to make sure to make its nest in a well-hidden place.

entry: POKENAME四处游荡，快乐地唱着欢快歌声，试着振奋人心。始终乐观友善，让它成为许多训练家的好伙伴。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME can be found wandering about, merrily producing cheerful songs to try to uplift people's spirits. Its unwavering optimism and friendliness make it a great companion for many Trainers.

entry: POKENAME蘑菇的硬质部分，会漏出可作沙拉酱的液体。甜度随它摄取的树汁种类而异。
author: .izik
source: The hard portions of POKENAME mushroom leak a fluid that can be used in salad dressing. The fluid tastes sweeter based on the type of tree sap it consumes.

entry: POKENAME看似凶恶，其实胆小，一有危险迹象就跑。它们爱躲在泥泞河岸，尽快埋住自己，不让看见。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Despite their aggressive appearance, POKENAME are cowardly and will run at the slightest hint of danger. They prefer to hide in muddy river banks, burying themselves to get out of sight as fast as possible.

entry: POKENAME嵌在一块蜡与蜜中，包裹它的蜡蜜块在寒冬为大针蜂巢提供养分。蜂群会悉心宠养它，直到进化。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are embedded inside a chunk of wax and honey that nourishes hives of Beedrill during cold winter months. They are pampered by these hives until they evolve.

entry: POKENAME厚毛下藏着坚硬外骨骼，提供额外防御。夜里，它蜷在灯柱根部，满足地凝望亮光。
author: .izik
source: Beneath POKENAME's thick fur lies a tough exoskeleton, providing extra defense. At night, it curls around the base of light posts, staring contentedly at the glow.

entry: POKENAME守卫栎树林中的祠堂，用尖刺防守，将训练家挡在外面。据说，它们由幻之宝可梦时拉比特别选中。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are seen guarding the shrine within the Ilex Forest, using Spiky Shield to keep Trainers out. They are said to be specially chosen by the mythical Pokémon, Celebi.

entry: POKENAME的灵魂附在腐烂旧果上，靠腐败的坏死能量生存。果肉也为小绿毛虫提供食物与庇护，它们则尽力抵御较大的食腐者，保护它。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME's spirit haunts rotten old fruit, thriving on the necrotic energy of its decay. The flesh also provides food and shelter for small Caterpie, who do their best to defend it from larger scavengers.

entry: POKENAME的坚壳，能挡住多数捕食者。但有些狡猾的飞行属性宝可梦，已学会把喙挤进茧的开口，绕过它唯一的防御。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a tough shell that protects them from most predators. Some crafty Flying-type Pokémon have figured out how to wedge their beaks into openings in the cocoon, bypassing the only defense POKENAME have.

entry: POKENAME的甜香壳，保护等待进化的身体。可惜香气也引来捕食者，让野生个体难得一见。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's sweet-smelling shell protects their body while they wait for evolution. Unfortunately, the sweet scent attracts predators, making wild POKENAME sightings rare.

entry: POKENAME的茧坚固得几乎能承受任何冲击，连以终端速度撞地也不例外。不过，部分偶尔仍会崩落；丢弃的碎块，夜里会亮着奇异能量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cocoon is sturdy enough to survive almost any impact, including hitting the ground at terminal velocity. Parts of the cocoon can still chip off at times; discarded chunks glow with a strange energy at night.

entry: POKENAME甲壳厚，无法突然动作。天一冷，其他宝可梦便聚在它身旁取暖。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a thick carapace that prevents it from making sudden movements. Whenever it is cold, other Pokémon huddle for warmth next to it.

entry: POKENAME挖洞时，定期脱落碎壳。碎片自然分解，滋养周围土壤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME periodically sheds fragments of its shell while digging. These pieces decompose naturally and enrich the surrounding soil.

entry: POKENAME在森林地下，形成庞大群落。它们一起藏着，等待进化。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME form large underground colonies beneath forests. They remain hidden together while awaiting evolution.

entry: POKENAME在茧的甲片间放出浓稠黏液，让表面滑溜。摔倒后无法自行起身，这份压力常使它们头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release a thick ooze in the space between the plates of their cocoon to make them slippery. The stress they have from being unable to pick themselves back up after a fall causes them to get headaches.

entry: POKENAME周身坚甲很难活动。行动受限让它烦躁，又极容易弄伤自己。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a tough carapace around its body that is difficult to move in. It gets frustrated with this limited movement and is incredibly prone to hurting itself.

entry: POKENAME尽量静止，保存能量，加快进化。不过，若觉得危险，它能在陆上高速飞奔，寻找更安全的休息处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME remains stationary as long as possible, conserving energy to hasten its evolution. Should it feel endangered, though, it can tear off across the land at high speeds to find a safer spot to rest.

entry: POKENAME很难在移动时，不损伤茧。茧摸来烫手，因此寒夜会有宝可梦聚在身旁。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a difficult time moving without damaging its cocoon. Its cocoon is hot to the touch, so some Pokémon huddle next to it during cold nights.

entry: POKENAME虽裹着甲壳，却极其弱小，会瞬间移动逃离危险，免受伤害。人们推测，壳内蕴藏大量精神能量。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite being covered in an armored carapace, POKENAME is incredibly weak and will teleport out of danger to avoid being injured. It is theorized that POKENAME's shell contains large amounts of psychic energy.

entry: POKENAME整天举大原木，增加肌肉。它常与同类比赛，看谁的身体最结实。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME spends all day lifting massive logs to build up its muscle mass. It often competes with others of its kind to see who has the toughest body of all.

entry: POKENAME身体虽细长如藤，硬化的壳却胜过石头。它混在茂密灌丛，靠坚韧身体，安然不受打扰。
author: .izik
source: Though its body is long and vine-like, POKENAME's hardened shell is tougher than stone. It blends in among thick undergrowth, relying on its durability to remain undisturbed.

entry: 危险一靠近，POKENAME就缩壳。壳与茧由同样材料构成，足以防御其他宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME retreats into its shell whenever danger is nearby. Its shell is made of the same material as its cocoon casing, which gives it ample protection against other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用独角虫般的舌头，将烈雀等猎物引进大张的嘴。进去后，浓稠银色酸液便会淹没猎物，将其彻底溶解。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lures prey like Spearow into its gaping mouth using its Weedle-like tongue. Once inside, they are engulfed by a thick, silvery acid that dissolves them completely.

entry: POKENAME硬化毒腺，防御捕食者，触手与鼓胀囊体也变成漆黑。它们常藏在岩缝，避免冲突。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME harden their venom glands to protect their body against predators, turning their tentacles and bulbous sacs into a jet black color. They often hide in between rock crevices to avoid conflict.

entry: POKENAME攀在洞顶，等待化蛹。若受打扰，它们便聚成密不可破的墙，保护彼此免受伤害。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME cling to the ceilings of caves while they wait to pupate. If they're disturbed, POKENAME will cluster together and form an impenetrable wall, protecting one another from harm.

entry: POKENAME攀在洞顶，等待化蛹。若受打扰，它们便聚成密不可破的墙，保护彼此免受伤害。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME cling to the ceilings of caves while they wait to pupate. If they're disturbed, POKENAME will cluster together and form an impenetrable wall, protecting one another from harm.

entry: POKENAME茧未能成形的部位，会渗出大量丝。丝极热，碰到的对象很快就会被烫焦。
author: sk372
source: Areas where POKENAME's cocoon couldn't form properly seep out large amounts of silk.  The silk is extremely hot and will quickly singe those who touch it.

entry: POKENAME周身的茧，让行动比多数烈焰马融合体更受限。茧缝流出的丝可以点燃，帮助抵御袭击者。
author: sk372
source: The cocoon around POKENAME's body leaves its mobility more restricted than most Rapidash fusions. The threads flowing out from the cocoon's gaps can be ignited in order to help it defend itself from attackers.

entry: POKENAME甲壳没有痛觉受器，常察觉不到自己挨打。代谢极慢，一天只吃一颗树果。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's carapace has no pain receptors, so it will often not notice that it is being attacked. Their metabolism is very slow, only having to eat a single berry a day.

entry: POKENAME不需缩壳躲藏，因为茧本就由坚甲构成。它能从甲缝喷水，让壳变得滑溜。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME does not need to hide in its shell because its cocoon is made of tough carapace. It can spray water from the crevices in the carapace, which makes its shell slippery.

entry: POKENAME常常像个小商人一样，用大葱指点图表。如果煮熟后食用，它的口感会非常奇怪。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME often acts like a tiny businessman, using its leek to point at charts. If cooked and eaten, it has a very strange texture.

entry: POKENAME准备开始漫长进化时，会硬化液体身体。它们先挤入狭窄裂隙，藏好，再变硬。
author: santon5512
source: When POKENAME are ready to begin their long evolution process, they harden their liquid bodies. These Pokémon fit themselves into tight cracks and crevices, concealing themselves before hardening.

entry: POKENAME坚甲限制行动，连转身都困难。缩进壳里，最多要花10秒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has limited mobility because of its tough carapace, making turning around difficult. It takes up to 10 seconds to withdraw into its shell.

entry: POKENAME藏在壳中，抵御强风。有人走过，自以为只是丢弃的虫蜕，它就发出尖锐叫声吓人。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME hides within its shell to protect itself from strong winds. When someone passes by what they assume is just a discarded insect molt, POKENAME lets out a shrill scream to scare them.

entry: POKENAME将身体固定在破败建筑的墙上，双手则遥控着，在视野内游动。活物一进入，它就偷偷将手伸到对方背后，吓其离开。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME secures its body to the wall of crumbling architecture while its hands remotely move around its line of sight. When a living being enters the area, POKENAME sneaks its hands up behind them and scares them away.

entry: POKENAME外层模仿耿鬼的可怕面容，驱退潜在捕食者。准备好进化时，它从甲上渐大的裂缝探看，等自认最好笑的时机。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's outer layer mimics the frightening countenance of a Gengar, scaring away potential predators. When it is ready to evolve, POKENAME peeks out of the growing cracks in its armor, waiting for the moment it deems will be the funniest.

entry: 除手中摆锤慢慢晃动，POKENAME始终不动。它哄人入睡，吞吃其梦，为自己进化的梦想提供能量。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME remains motionless except for the slow movement of the pendulum it holds. Once it lulls people to sleep, it devours their dreams as fuel for its own dream of evolution.

entry: 二月，常能看见POKENAME在面包店与糖果店里爬来爬去。烘焙师让它吃掉过期糖果，店里的甜食保持新鲜，它也开心。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: During February, it's quite common to see POKENAME in bakeries and sweet shops scuttling around. Bakers have POKENAME go through their establishments and eat any candy that has expired, ensuring fresh sweets and happy POKENAME.

entry: 考古学家觉得POKENAME有些麻烦。它爱拿化石当武器与甲胄，可能损伤极其重要的科学发现。
author: sk372
source: Archaeologists consider POKENAME a bit of a menace, as its penchant for using fossils as weapons and armor runs the risk of damaging what could be very important scientific finds.

entry: 古时，POKENAME曾当守夜者，鲜红眼睛吓退威胁。它喜欢有人擦亮坚如岩石的壳，训练家擦拭时，会呼噜呼噜叫。
author: ghostslythe
source: In ancient times, POKENAME was used as night watch, its bright red eyes scaring off threats. It enjoys having its rock hard shell polished, purring while the Trainer works.

entry: POKENAME由现代科技诞生的宝可梦与史前宝可梦融合，很难研究其野外行为。它有怪习惯，爱躺在砖块等物体之间，让表面与之齐平。
author: bobosmith01
source: As a Fusion of a Pokémon born from modern technology and a Pokémon that came from prehistory, it is difficult to study how POKENAME behaves in the wild. It has the peculiar habit of laying between objects its surface is flush with, like bricks.

entry: POKENAME的出现，引发热烈的考古研究。有人因此推测，关都的化石宝可梦，可能共有一种此前不为人知的祖先。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's appearance has brought about fervent archaeological research, as it has led to theories that the fossil Pokémon of Kanto may share a previously unknown common ancestor.

entry: POKENAME埋在水下沙中，等待进化所需的时间。留下的茧碎片，是海底觅食者喜爱的点心。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME buries itself in the underwater sand in order to wait out the time necessary to evolve. The shards of its cocoon left behind are a beloved treat for ocean bottom feeders.

entry: 博物馆里偶能见到POKENAME，作为古代化石宝可梦融合的实例。蜕下的壳钙质丰富，常用于当地偏方。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can sometimes be found at museums as an example of fossil Pokémon fusing in the past. When POKENAME molt, their discarded shells are often used in local remedies for their high calcium content.

entry: POKENAME与其他飞行属性宝可梦共享天空，常跟着回巢，靠厚甲抵御啄击。许多个体对别的飞行宝可梦的羽毛很困惑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME share the skies with other Flying-type Pokémon and often follow them back to their nests, protected from pecks by a thick armored shell. Many POKENAME are perplexed by the feathers of other Flying-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在海滩浅水爬行，翻沙觅食。它虽能出水，在陆上活动，可离水太久，上半身就会干燥变脆。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME scurries along the shallow beach waters, digging around the sands for food. Though it can breach the water and move on land, lingering out of water too long results in its top half drying out and becoming brittle.

entry: POKENAME虽好斗，毒刺大小却使狩猎不太有效。俯冲攻击一落空，毒刺常扎进地里，很难拔出。
author: sk372
source: Although aggressive, the size of POKENAME's stingers causes its hunting technique to be somewhat ineffective. If it misses a diving strike, the stinger often lodges into the ground, where it has difficulty pulling it back out.

entry: POKENAME游遍深海，观察令它着迷的潜艇。若发现上浮困难或遇险，只需一念，就能将潜艇瞬间移到陆地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME travels through ocean depths to observe submarines, finding them fascinating. Should it notice one is having trouble resurfacing or is in danger, it will teleport it to dry land with a thought.

entry: POKENAME背上冒火，是好奇的表现。火柱越大、越猛烈，表示某事越引起它的兴趣。
author: sk372
source: Flames sprouting up from POKENAME's back is a sign of curiosity. The larger and more intense the plume of fire, the more its interest has been piqued by something.

entry: POKENAME想从水里上岸，就伸出尾巴闪光，感知附近生物的生物电特征，察觉陆地是否有东西等着袭击。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME wants to venture onto land from the water, it sticks its tail out and flashes a light. This lets it sense the bio-electric signatures of living things around it, alerting it to anything that might be waiting on land to attack it.

entry: POKENAME手上的珠体，含有一碰水就使其冒泡、沸腾的化学物质。它借此把小生物逼到池面，方便进食。
author: sk372
source: The orbs on POKENAME's hands contain a chemical that causes water to bubble and boil on contact. It uses this to bring small creatures to the top of ponds so it can feed.

entry: POKENAME被称为“化石界的黑马”。虽小，常被低估，却能用灵活尾巴智取大敌，将其掀进泥里。化石记录显示，它曾在他者灭亡的环境存活，繁盛一时。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is called the “underdog of the fossil world.” Though small and often underestimated, it uses its agile tail to outwit larger foes, flipping them into the mud. Fossil records show it once thrived by surviving where others perished.

entry: 遇险时，POKENAME能分成独立活动的两半，更容易迷惑捕食者、趁机逃走。有人认为，中央化石不知如何成了这能力的来源。
author: sk372
source: When in danger, POKENAME can split itself into two halves that operate independently and make it easier to confuse and escape predators. Some think the fossil in its center is somehow the source of this ability.

entry: 周围没动静，POKENAME才从泥中出来觅食。危险稍露，它就赶快爬回泥里，完全埋住。它不善战，训练家须下大功夫，才阻得住临阵躲藏。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When there is nothing around, POKENAME emerges from the mud to feed. At the slightest sign of danger, it scurries back into the mud, completely submerging itself. It is a weak fighter, and Trainers must work hard to stop it from hiding mid-battle.

entry: POKENAME用铁般硬壳挡住攻击，再以夜视增强的眼睛，瞪得敌人屈服。它们对阳光敏感，训练家的墨镜也常因此不翼而飞。
author: ghostslythe
source: With its iron-hard shell, POKENAME blocks incoming attacks while its night vision–enhanced eyes glare its foes into submission. Due to their sensitivity to sunlight, Trainers' sunglasses often go missing.

entry: POKENAME只想独处。头部缎带状突起由岩石构成，摆出可怕阵势，吓退其他宝可梦与洞穴探险者。谁靠得太近，它就穿墙消失。
author: leandermalurt
source: POKENAME wants to be left alone. The ribbon-like growths from its head are made of rock and form a terrifying display to scare off other Pokémon and cave explorers. If anyone gets too close, it disappears through a wall.

entry: POKENAME会靠近人类乞食，想凭可爱外表，轻松讨一餐。若遭拒，它却会毫不犹豫地凶起来，用爪与毒刺抢食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will approach humans and beg, attempting to appeal to others with its cute appearance for easy meals. If denied however, it won't hesitate to get aggressive and use its claws and stinger to steal food.

entry: POKENAME慢得往往还未出壳，战斗就结束。有些训练家哄它出来，再扔树果练闪避，想提升速度；结果大多直接砸中，它连动也不动。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is so slow that battles are often over before they even get out of their shell. Some Trainers try to increase their Speed by coaxing them out of their shell and throwing berries at them to dodge. Most hit them without them even flinching.

entry: POKENAME迅速爬上冻结的湖岸，躲进乱石地。被发现时，它以吓人的速度跳起，用尖刀般的爪抓击，只为逃出视线。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME quickly climbs frozen lake banks, allowing it to hunker down inside rocky fields. When uncovered, it jumps scarily fast, clawing with pointed, knife-like nails only to escape from view.

entry: POKENAME化石见于深海岩层，研究者原猜它们游过海洋。发现现代个体后，却惊讶看见，它们是成群爬过海床，并非游泳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fossils are found in deep ocean rock layers, with researchers speculating that they swam across the ocean. When modern specimens were found, researchers were surprised to see they crawl across the ocean floor in swarms rather than swimming.

entry: POKENAME最初被认为是生活在3亿年前的太阳珊瑚祖先。然而，最近的重新研究表明，POKENAME是一种寄生宝可梦，会住进由太阳珊瑚脱落的外壳拼成的壳中。
author: divinelunaria
source: POKENAME was originally believed to be an ancient ancestor of Corsola dating back 300 million years. However, recent re-evaluation suggests that POKENAME was a parasitic species that would live inside shells constructed from discarded Corsola shells.

entry: POKENAME坚韧的褐色鳞片，兼顾轻便行动与利爪防护。科学家采集毒液，与古老的化石毒液比较。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have tough sepia scales that allow for lightweight mobility and protection against sharp claws. Their venom is harvested by scientists to compare with ancient, fossilized venom.

entry: POKENAME攀在海洞壁，用纹理改变壳，模仿附近苔藓或岩石，完美融入。它能连续静止好多天。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME latches onto sea cave walls, using Conversion on its shell to mimic any nearby moss or stone and blend in seamlessly. It will stay still for days on end.

entry: POKENAME赭色鳞片融入林地，因此常被当作原木。颈部展开的皮膜下，每只爪都带古老毒液，注入猎物，便引发灼痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME get mistaken for logs because of their sienna scales that blend into the forest floor. Each claw underneath their hood has ancient venom that causes searing pain when injected into their prey.

entry: POKENAME一天大多在海中，却会上岸睡觉。它挖洞埋住腹面，若有什么踩上露出的壳，便惊慌地迅速爬走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends most of the day in the ocean but scuttles onto land to sleep. It digs holes in the ground to submerge its underside in. If something steps on its exposed shell, it quickly scurries away in a panic.

entry: 野外罕见的无腿POKENAME，多数时间漂在水中。它们会在正午最暖时，短暂跳上岸，打个盹。
author: sk372
source: Legless variants of POKENAME are rarely spotted in the wild and spend the majority of their time floating around the waters. They hop onto land briefly to nap during the warmest parts of the midday.

entry: POKENAME尾巴变得格外锋利，电力也仍保留。它把尾刃刺进猎物，以电麻痹，再抛入横跨躯干的宽嘴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tail has developed a remarkable sharpness while retaining its electric power. It stabs the blade into prey, paralyzing them with electricity before tossing them into its wide torso-spanning maw.

entry: POKENAME从头部释放信号，轻易探知洞内化石。古生物学家常带它作助手，开展考察。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a signal from its head that allows it to easily detect fossils within caves. Paleontologists have been known to bring one along as an assistant during their expeditions.

entry: POKENAME体内的热，让周围的水始终温暖。它能加热颚部口器，烫伤被咬的对象，但只在自卫时使用。
author: sk372
source: The water around POKENAME is always warm due to its internal heat. It can heat up the mandibles in its jaw in order to burn those it bites, though it only uses this ability in self-defense.

entry: POKENAME对光敏感，喜欢夜间出没，白天待在阴影。它内心温柔，似乎很容易与小型岩石属性及化石宝可梦亲近。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is sensitive to light, preferring to come out at night or remain in the shade during the day. Gentle at heart, it seems to easily form connections with small Rock-type and Fossil Pokémon.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME是众多灵魂附在空化石盔壳中形成。它把化石遗骸聚入幽灵旋涡，不知是为进食、增强自己，还是单纯囤积。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is believed to be hollowed-out Kabuto shell possessed by a multitude of spirits. POKENAME gathers up fossil remains into its ghostly vortex, though none are sure if it does this for sustenance, to strengthen itself, or simply to hoard them.

entry: POKENAME用岩石身体，伪装混在海床。宝可梦一靠近，它的头就伸长，吸干体液。猎物若太坚硬，便先吐酸液溶解。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME uses its rocky body as camouflage among the seabed. When a Pokémon draws near, its head extends and it drains them of their body fluids. If the prey's body is too tough, it first melts them by spitting acid.

entry: 它们以银杏种子维生，能活数千年，才发育成最终形态。那些种子帮助POKENAME长出抵抗伤害的坚壳。
author: quackquackattack
source: They are able to live for thousands of years before developing into their final form, as they live off ginkgo seeds. Those seeds have helped POKENAME develop a hard shell around themselves that resists damage.

entry: POKENAME凭地鼠般外表，悄悄混入地鼠群。一发现落单者，就迅速用爪抓住，拖进构成身体的黑暗中。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Using POKENAME's Diglett-like appearance as camouflage, it moves unseen through Diglett colonies. When it finds one alone, it swiftly captures the Pokémon with its claws and pulls it into the darkness that makes up its body.

entry: 同一个大眼窝伸出多只眼，让POKENAME视力极佳。眼睛能射小光束，扰乱别的生物体内磁场，使其迷失方向。
author: sk372
source: Multiple eyes poking from the single large socket give POKENAME a strong sense of sight. The eyes can fire small beams of light that disrupt the internal magnetism of others, disorienting them.

entry: 这对深水伙伴，似乎早在人类出现之前，就发明了剑刃。细长的那只，负责打磨圆伙伴尾端的尖刺。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This deepwater pair are thought to have created a sword blade eons before humans did. The elongated partner polishes the rounded one's caudal spike.

entry: POKENAME的壳虽硬，却不耐打，耐刮擦，却很容易在强力钝击下裂开。刀刃由更强材料构成，能轻易斩过敌人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shells are hard but not durable, as while their shells are scratch resistant, they easily crack when bludgeoned with enough impact force. Their blades are made of a stronger material that easily slices through foes.

entry: POKENAME混在岩地中，行动虽沉重缓慢，却能斩开崖壁作为弥补。外表像吉祥物，让它常被电影制片厂用作保安。
author: ghostslythe
source: Blending in with rocky terrain, POKENAME's ponderous speed is offset by their ability to slash through cliff faces. They are often used as security for movie studios due to looking like mascots.

entry: POKENAME存在的数百万年间，演化出触须，把猎物拉进壳下吃。受威胁时，它会伪装成岩石。
author: melodydelune
source: Over the millions of years POKENAME has existed, it adapted feelers to pull prey under its shell to eat. When threatened, it will disguise itself as a rock.

entry: POKENAME用腹下伸出的影子，抓取远物与猎物。有证据显示，它从前曾生活在化石盔群中，甚至担任首领。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is able to reach out and grab distant objects and prey via shadows emanated from its underside. There is evidence it lived among and even led Kabuto colonies in the past.

entry: POKENAME吸水越多，炮就越强。附近没有湖海时，便能见它吸干泳池。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's cannon grows more powerful the more water it inhales. In environments without a lake or sea nearby, it can be found draining swimming pools.

entry: POKENAME生活在干旱多尘的环境，用耳朵扇风散热。夜里，它们凭红外视觉小心辨路，躲避捕食者，寻找仙人掌取水。
author: ghostslythe
source: Living in arid, dusty environments, POKENAME use their ears as fans to dissipate heat. At night they navigate carefully, using their infrared vision to avoid predators and locate cacti for water.

entry: 有人推测，这只宝可梦能永生，因为它想倒退多少次，都能退回受精卵阶段。POKENAME在数百年的漫长岁月里，收集周边死去的生物，使其化石化。
author: milchik
source: Some theorize that this Pokémon is able to live forever, as it can roll its state of development back to a zygote as often as it wants. POKENAME spends its long centuries collecting and fossilizing dead organisms around itself.

entry: POKENAME身体与四肢极像化石盔。它偶尔混住在化石盔小群中，保护它们免遭捕食，换取小家伙献上的食物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body and limbs carry a remarkable resemblance to Kabuto. It occasionally lives among small groups of Kabuto, protecting them from predators in exchange for food offerings from the smaller Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME多条尾巴上的假眼，有助迷惑捕食者。那些部位也会生火，造出强力小火球，投向对手。
author: sk372
source: The false eyes on POKENAME's many tails help confuse predators. They also serve as the spot where flames will generate when POKENAME produces potent little fireballs to pelt at its opposition.

entry: 研究确认，POKENAME的器官由水与胶状物质混合构成。威胁若从后方靠近，它就从壳中集中喷射这类物质。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The organs of POKENAME have been identified as a combination of water and a gelatinous substance. If a threat approaches from the rear, POKENAME will shoot concentrated bursts of this substance from its shell.

entry: POKENAME被称为挖掘者的克星，天生能感知化石位置。化石一归它所有，就会竭尽全力，不让人拿走。
author: sondededoo
source: Labelled as the bane of excavators, POKENAME has an innate ability to sense the location of fossils. Once they end up in its possession, it will do everything in its power to prevent its fossils from being taken.

entry: POKENAME稀有，受收藏者追捧，可许多幸运得到的训练家，却因它迟钝、反应慢而不满。低心率与极少的脑部活动，让它节省能量。
author: bobosmith01
source: While it is a rare Pokémon sought after by collectors, many Trainers lucky enough to obtain a POKENAME are displeased, finding it dull and slow to react; POKENAME's low heart rate and miniscule levels of brain activity allow it to conserve energy.

entry: POKENAME住在沿海洞穴。狩猎时，把尾巴伸进水，等鱼来，再电一下。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME can be found living in caves along the ocean shoreline. To hunt, they dip their tails into the water, wait for a fish to arrive, and zap.

entry: POKENAME花很多时间，在海洋浅水慢慢挪动。谁倒霉，不小心踩上它，就会被狠狠咬一口报复。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends a large amount of time shuffling among the shallow waters of the oceans. Anything unfortunate enough to accidentally step on it will receive a very painful bite in retaliation.

entry: POKENAME主要用巨大假头，威吓捕食者与食物竞争者。不过，它咬起来仍很痛，不容低估。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's large false head is used largely for intimidation attempts to scare off predators and competitors for food. It still possesses a painful bite, however, so one should not underestimate it.

entry: POKENAME能从躯干缝隙，吐出小股火焰，但须节制。火直接来自尾焰，过度使用，就会十分虚弱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can breathe out small bursts of fire from the gap in its torso, but it must regulate its usage. The fire it breathes is directly sourced from its tail-flame, and will leave it very weak if overused.

entry: POKENAME常见于岩石海滩，混在含化石的石头间。它汲取周边化石的古老精神能量；化石越老，它就越强。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME can be commonly found on rocky beaches among the fossil-containing stones. It draws ancient psychic energy from the surrounding fossils, and the older they are, the more powerful POKENAME becomes.

entry: 化石爱好者敲开海滩石头时，有时会发现POKENAME住在里面。甲缝内可见的两颗明亮珠体，其实是它的脑。
author: milchik
source: Sometimes, when fossil enthusiasts crack the beach rocks open, POKENAME can be found residing inside. The two brightly glowing orbs visible inside the crack in this Pokémon's armor are its brains.

entry: POKENAME待在浅海，筛滤泥沙。人们常在水里不慎踩中，被众多尖刺扎伤。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rests in the shallow parts of the ocean where it filters through dirt and sand. People have often accidentally stepped on it in the water and hurt themselves on its many pointed spines.

entry: POKENAME在海洋最深处游动，寻找宝石。它天真好奇，却会躲进洞，避开捕食者。
author: imagine1.
source: POKENAME swims in the deepest parts of the ocean, searching for gems. It's naive and curious, but hides from predators in caves.

entry: POKENAME的水晶突起，会调整得与当地灌木完美相融。它们钻在灌丛旁，吃用作伪装的同一植物的根。这种寄生不断重复，直到准备好进化。
author: ludacriswell
source: The crystalline protrusions from POKENAME can adapt to blend in seamlessly with local bushes. Burrowing next to shrubs, they feed on the roots of the very same plants used as camouflage. This parasitic process repeats until they are ready to evolve.

entry: POKENAME藏在洞穴与森林的阴影中。受威胁时，头上球体会爆开，释放有害孢子云。
author: shocktopus1717
source: POKENAME hides in the shadows of caves and forests. When threatened, the spheres on its head burst, releasing a cloud of harmful spores.

entry: POKENAME花上的斑点，让它仿佛长着多眼，迷惑多数捕食者。趁这片刻，它从花里喷出臭花粉云，帮助逃走。
author: sk372
source: Spots on POKENAME's flower make it look as if it has multiple eyes. This throws off most predators long enough for POKENAME to belch out a cloud of stinky pollen from its flower to help make its escape.

entry: POKENAME在深洞的水洼旁筑巢，比起附近干石，更爱潮湿处。水洼若干了，就会在同一洞穴找下一个。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME nests near puddles within deep caves, preferring the moisture to the dry stone nearby. Should the puddle dry up, it navigates to another within the same cave.

entry: POKENAME常挖洞，将下半身埋进土。它似乎觉得半埋地下很安心，至少也要覆一薄层新土。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME regularly digs holes to bury itself in, submerging its lower half in soil. It seems to find comfort in being partially underground, or at least coated with a fine layer of fresh soil.

entry: POKENAME交战时，身上蘑菇会硬化得像巨石。感到安全后，蘑菇才渐渐软回原状。
author: .izik
source: When engaged in combat, the mushroom on POKENAME's body hardens to the consistency of a boulder. Once it feels safe, the mushroom gradually softens back to its original state.

entry: POKENAME潜伏浅水表下，混在岩石间。训练家若带食物经过，它便突然冲出抢零食，再游向海中享用。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME lurks beneath the surface of shallow water to blend in among the rocks. If Trainers pass by with food, POKENAME will suddenly dart out to grab their snacks before swimming out to sea to enjoy the meal.

entry: POKENAME背上的岩壳，让它爬过地面时，不受上方攻击。身体太重，浮不起来，因此它会沿池底爬行。
author: .jerden
source: The rocky shell on POKENAME's back protects it from being attacked from above as it scuttles across the ground. It is too heavy to float and will crawl along the bottom of ponds.

entry: POKENAME白天藏在池塘底部。夜里，它将石质头顶的眼睛探出水面，守候前来饮水的猎物，再突然跃出，用双臂将其抓住。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME hides itself at the bottom of ponds during the day. At night, it will raise the eyes atop its rocky head above the surface to watch for prey approaching the water to drink, then leap out to seize it in its arms.

entry: 如果POKENAME数百万年前确曾存在，一般认为，它在极浅溪流狩猎，把腹部的嘴压入泥土，吃碎屑与埋着的小宝可梦。它受不了尾巴沾湿。
author: bobosmith01
source: If POKENAME existed millions of years ago, then it's generally accepted that it hunted in very shallow streams, eating particles and small buried Pokémon by pressing its stomach-mouth into the dirt. It can't stand getting its tail wet.

entry: 挖洞时，石头磨擦POKENAME的壳，使其变硬。个体常并排掘进，似乎在比较壳的强度。
author: .izik
source: While digging, POKENAME's shell hardens as stones grind against it. Individuals often tunnel alongside others, seemingly comparing shell strength.

entry: POKENAME爪的材质像指甲。愤怒暴走时，脆爪常会断，却也很快长回。
author: quackquackattack
source: The material that makes up the claws of a POKENAME resembles nails. The brittle claws often break when POKENAME go on an angry rampage but grow back quickly as well.

entry: POKENAME把自己钩在洞顶，等不知情的猎物从下经过。一发现目标，就落下咬住，再从嘴里喷出强酸。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will hook themselves to the ceilings of caves, waiting for unsuspecting prey to pass below. Once they spots their target, they drop from the ceiling, sinking their teeth into them before expelling a powerful acid from their mouths.

entry: POKENAME的眼能看清漆黑海底，翻找食物。脑子虽慢，尾巴却敏感；一碰，就会本能地以出人意料的速度挥击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's eyes are capable of seeing even in the dark depths of the ocean floor, where it roots around for food. Although slow of mind, its tail is sensitive; touching it will result in an instinctive and surprisingly quick swinging attack.

entry: 史学家说，鬼斯附身甲壳化石后，会吸收早已消逝的化石盔的古老记忆，最终变成POKENAME。
author: regulavish
source: Historians say that when a Gastly possesses a Dome Fossil, it will begin to absorb the ancient memories of the long-gone Kabuto and eventually turn into a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME挖化石，当作催眠别人的特殊摆锤。它主要针对岩石属性宝可梦，趁熟睡，吸取体内养分。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME digs up fossils to use as special pendulums for hypnotizing others. It primarily targets Rock types, and siphons nutrients from their bodies as they slumber.

entry: POKENAME只吃自己从枝上摘的叶，拒吃其他宝可梦摘下的。用爪刮过树枝，它就能接连快速扯下好几片。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME only eats when it is able to pull the leaves from branches itself and refuses leaves plucked by other Pokémon. By scraping its claws against branches, it can quickly rip several leaves off in quick succession.

entry: POKENAME用挖出的化石当棒，击退别人。世界各地考古学家，都曾想从它手里换走重要文物，却一无所获。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fights off others by using fossils it digs up in order to club others. Archaeologists the world over have tried to barter the important artifacts from it, but to no avail.

entry: POKENAME从空中撒毒鳞粉，削弱水下猎物，再俯冲，以飞身头锤将其击倒。防水双翼，让它能潜至10英尺，再冲回空中。
author: lampent12
source: With toxic scales, POKENAME will weaken underwater prey from the air before diving down to finish them off with a flying headbutt. Their waterproof wings let them dive up to 10 feet before swooping back up.

entry: 科学家最初以为，POKENAME化石是两块不同化石混在一起。复活后，却震惊看见骨翼不仅能承重，还能切穿钢铁。
author: ghostslythe
source: Scientists originally believed POKENAME's fossil was a mix of two separate fossils. To their shock, the Pokémon revived with bony wings that could support its weight, as well as slice through steel.

entry: POKENAME是海中无双的猎手。锐眼发现猎物，便以惊人游速冲近，再用剪刀般的爪切成碎条。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is an unparalleled hunter of the seas. Sharp eyes let it spot prey, charging them down with incredible swimming speed before cutting them to ribbons with its scissor-like claws.

entry: POKENAME肢体强劲锋利，却很少拿来战斗。它用来劈开树、根、树果，以及当时想吃的一切。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's limbs are powerful and sharp, but it rarely uses them for fighting. Instead it uses them to cleave apart trees, roots, berries and anything else it feels like consuming at the time.

entry: POKENAME用基因增强的精神力量，将周身巨石碾碎，做成甲胄。体重虽增，逼近速度仍快过飞机，再以爪碾碎对手。
author: ghostslythe
source: Using its genetically enhanced psychic powers, POKENAME crushes boulders around its body for armor. Despite its extra weight, this Pokémon can close distances faster than a plane to crush opposition with its claws.

entry: POKENAME能以精神力量探测地下化石，精准定位半径10英里内的位置与深度。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can use its psychic power to detect fossils beneath the ground. It can pinpoint their exact location and depth within a 10-mile radius.

entry: POKENAME几乎每根爪尖都极长锐利。按住猎物后，它慢慢细切，精心削下最爱吃的部位。
author: sk372
source: Almost every talon on POKENAME's claws is incredibly long and sharp. Once it pins down prey, it slowly and meticulously cuts away, carefully carving off its favorite parts to eat.

entry: POKENAME行动尴尬：巨镰拖累飞行，轻翼又怕沾水。于是贴水跳跃，用双臂划水，同时保持翅膀干燥以便起飞。
author: glacierwing
source: POKENAME is awkward; its heavy scythes hinder flight, and its airy wings clog in water. It adapts by skimming the surface in hops, swimming with its arms while keeping its wings dry to fly.

entry: 长期以来，人们以为POKENAME共有一个群体意识，最近才发现精神能力。十二至二十只会埋在岩中等候，完美配合，攻击天敌隆隆岩。
author: ghostslythe
source: Long believed to be part of a hive mind, POKENAME were recently discovered to have psychic abilities. Groups of between twelve to twenty would wait burrowed into rocks and coordinate perfectly to attack their natural enemy Golem.

entry: POKENAME睡在水下深洞，通常选珊瑚丰富的地方。主头休息时，其他眼睛仍留意周围。
author: imagine1.
source: POKENAME sleeps in deep caverns underwater, usually in caves abundant with coral. Its main head rests while its other eyes keep an eye out.

entry: POKENAME作腿用的镰刀极锋利。凭敏捷与力量，片刻就能砍倒成片对手。休息时，栖身的壳则提供保护。
author: nyoomymph
source: The scythes that POKENAME uses as legs are extremely sharp. Using its agility and strength, POKENAME can cut down swathes of opponents in mere moments. The shell it resides in provides protection whilst it rests.

entry: 史前大气富氧，使POKENAME长得十分巨大。它以钢铁般锋利的角，将交战者切碎。
author: ozydamians
source: The oxygen-dense atmosphere of the prehistoric past allowed POKENAME to grow to an enormous size. It minces combatants with its steel-sharp horn.

entry: POKENAME狡猾，用利镰攀崖，盯上飞行属性宝可梦的巢，偷走蛋。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are crafty creatures that scale cliffs with their sharp scythes. They target nests of Flying-type Pokémon to steal their eggs.

entry: 古代，POKENAME是可怕的有翼猎手，壳能承受最猛烈的冲击。科学家用石中发现的羽毛化石，已成功将它复活。
author: fiordaliso
source: In ancient times, POKENAME was a fearsome winged predator whose shell could withstand even the fiercest impacts. Scientists have managed to revive it by using its fossilized feathers found in stone.

entry: POKENAME住在茂密海带林，岩石般的皮肤与自然形状，让它混入海床岩石。外表虽可怕，它却用镰刀收割海带吃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live amongst dense kelp forests, their rocky hide and naturalistic shape letting them blend in with rocks along the sea floor. Despite their fearsome appearance, they use their scythes to harvest kelp to feed on.

entry: 研究者发现，POKENAME是史前关都的顶级猎手。重甲与长达四英尺的剃刀般利爪，固然惊人，多数人更没想到，它游泳如此出色。
author: ghostslythe
source: Researchers found POKENAME was the apex predator of Kanto pre-history. While it is heavily armored with impressive four-foot razor claws, what most don't expect is how well this Pokémon can swim.

entry: 据说灭绝宝可梦的灵魂，环绕着POKENAME。不知传说是指这些古老宝可梦导致灭绝，还是事后才聚集亡魂。
author: static.mcawesome
source: Souls of extinct Pokémon are said to surround POKENAME. It is unclear if the legends refers to these ancient Pokémon causing these extinctions or if they rallied the souls after the fact.

entry: 惊人的飞速与剃刀般的利刃，使POKENAME成为古代的顶级空中猎手。栖息地化石记录显示，连最庞大的史前宝可梦，也曾是猎物。
author: sk372
source: With incredible aerial speed and razor-sharp blades, POKENAME was an apex flying predator of the ancient world. Fossil records of its habitats indicate it preyed on even the most gargantuan of prehistoric Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME身上刀刃会在战斗中脱离，从四方斩向敌人。一生吃的数据越多，刀刃就越锋利。
author: .izik
source: The blades on POKENAME's body detach during combat to slice at foes from all directions. These blades grow sharper the more data it consumes throughout its lifetime.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME从水中生活演化到了陆地。在丛林，它用大镰刀清路。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME is thought to have evolved from living in water to on land. In the jungle, it clears a path using its large scythe.

entry: POKENAME是敏捷的战士，以蜕下的岩石状皮肤当盾，守护沙漠绿洲，不让地面属性宝可梦捣乱。它讲荣誉近乎固执，开战前，先用骨剑致敬。
author: ghostslythe
source: Agile fighters who use their shed rock-like skin as shields, POKENAME are found defending desert Oases from Ground type meddling. Honorable to a fault, before the battle begins it salutes with its bone sword.

entry: 古代POKENAME用岩石硬甲与劈颅利镰，保护村落。科学将其复活，如今，它们守卫步道，驱赶捕食性宝可梦。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME in ancient times protected villages with their rock-hard armor and skull-splitting scythes. Resurrected by science, they now defend walking paths against predatory Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME是极聪明的猎手，伏在河底，用爪捕猎。水干后，有时会被误当岩石。
author: torterrable
source: An extremely intelligent hunter, POKENAME sits at the bottom of rivers and uses its claws to capture prey. They are sometimes mistaken for rocks when the water dries up.

entry: 据报，最初的POKENAME见于红莲岛外海。目击者称，形态扭曲，盯太久，会觉得现实本身正在改变。
author: sk372
source: Reportedly, POKENAME was first seen off the coast of Cinnabar Island. Eyewitness reports spoke of it having a distorted form, and that gazing at it too long made the viewer feel as if reality itself was being altered.

entry: POKENAME藏在海带与海藻间，缩回部分身体，加强伪装。不知情猎物一靠近，镰刀盔般的上半身便伸出，用利镰砍倒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides among kelp and seaweed, part of its body retracted to better camouflage itself. When unsuspecting prey draws near, the Kabutops-like upper half emerges and cuts them down with its scythes.

entry: POKENAME刀刃弧度极大，在独剑鞘融合体中独树一帜。它爱以横扫的八字轨迹攻击，保持动量、不断转身，使真正刃口始终朝向对手。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME's highly curved blade makes it unique among Honedge fusions. It prefers to attack in sweeping figure-eights, conserving its momentum and rotating so that its true edge is always facing the opponent.

entry: POKENAME在活火山上方筑巢，带着幼崽一同潜入熔岩。出来时，岩石鳞片便坚硬得如钻石。
author: ghostslythe
source: Nesting above active volcanoes, POKENAME dives with its young into the lava. When they emerge, their rocky scales are toughened to diamond hardness.

entry: 镰刀般的尾巴，能轻易切开猎物。游水时，POKENAME则会将尾巴，收拢贴紧身体。
author: melodydelune
source: Its sickle-like tail allows it to cut through prey with ease. When swimming, POKENAME will tuck its tail up against its body.

entry: POKENAME抬高猎物下方海床，让水下猎物搁浅，再用镰刀解决。但大身体不善游泳追猎，因此它更爱只在陆上狩猎，那里力量更强。
author: soup1900
