source: POKENAME beaches underwater prey by raising the sea floor beneath them before finishing them off with its scythes. However, its large body makes it terrible at swimming after prey, so it prefers to hunt purely on land, where its powers are stronger.

entry: POKENAME是古老巨兽，每逢进食，便从臭氧层潜向海洋。爪与尾上的利刃，能将暴鲤龙这般凶猛海中居民，也撕成下一餐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is an ancient leviathan that dives from the ozone layer into the ocean whenever it is time to feed. The sharp blades on POKENAME's claws and tail let it rend apart even vicious ocean dwellers like Gyarados into its next meal.

entry: POKENAME是史前最危险的宝可梦之一。它用背上镰刀，切开通往其他维度的门。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME was one of the most dangerous Pokémon to exist in prehistoric times.  It used the scythes on its back to slice portals into other dimensions.

entry: 许多POKENAME被用于等离子队的融合实验，却被认为太危险，不宜继续圈养。等离子队无视大规模破坏的风险，将它们放归野外，推进自身目的。
author: bigoljax
source: Many POKENAME were involved in Team Plasma's experiments with the fusion process, but were considered too dangerous to be left in captivity. Team Plasma released these POKENAME into the wild to further their cause, despite risk of mass destruction.

entry: POKENAME寻找活宝可梦，用镰刀吸取能量，徒劳地想让自己复活。
author: seafoamtaide
source: POKENAME seeks out living Pokémon and uses its scythe to sap their energy in a futile attempt to revive itself.

entry: POKENAME是最早被发现的史前哺乳动物之一。古代洞穴壁画中，还画着它挥舞刀刃，催眠猎物。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME is one of the first prehistoric mammals ever discovered. Ancient cave paintings have shown it using its blades to hypnotize its prey.

entry: POKENAME灭绝前，被认为是陆地顶级猎手。狩猎化石记录，似乎显示出群体意识般的协作。如今常由深灰市博物馆复活，作为清林帮手，备受追捧。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME were considered an apex land predator before their extinction. Fossil records of their hunts seem to indicate hive-mind-like coordination. Commonly revived through Pewter City's museum, these Pokémon are highly sought after to clear forests.

entry: 每只POKENAME的镰刀，都有独特花纹。若两只的刀刃太相似，POKENAME便会打到，只剩一把镰刀为止。
author: ohok3441
source: Each POKENAME has its own scythe with its own set of patterns. If their blades are too similar, POKENAME will fight until only one scythe remains.

entry: 从古老化石复活的POKENAME凶猛护地盘，任何靠近领地的东西，都会遭袭。硬镰滴着毒液，几秒就能麻痹猎物。
author: fiordaliso
source: Revived from an ancient fossil, POKENAME is fiercely territorial and attacks anything that nears its domain. Its hardened scythes drip with venom capable of paralyzing prey within seconds.

entry: POKENAME是残暴肉食者，全身都为海陆捕猎而造。不过，科学家认为，即使古代真存在，也会因所需食物太多，很快灭绝。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a brutal carnivore whose entire body is built for hunting prey on land and sea. However, scientists believe that even if POKENAME existed in the past, they would quickly go extinct, as they require far too much food to sustain themselves.

entry: 这种宝可梦偏爱墓地，能半埋地下，装成大灌木或鬼树。传闻POKENAME狩猎时，会派黑暗鸦侦察。
author: ludacriswell
source: This species of Pokémon has a propensity for inhabiting graveyards. They are capable of disguising themselves as large bushes or ghoulish trees by partially burrowing underground. It is rumored that POKENAME use Murkrow as scouts when hunting prey.

entry: POKENAME短臂伸出利镰，稍增攻击范围。它很容易发狂，胡乱挥臂，砍倒一切靠得太近的东西。
author: sk372
source: Sharp scythes extend from POKENAME's stubby arms, giving it a bit of additional range for attacks. It goes into a frenzy easily, swinging its arms around wildly and cutting down anything that gets too close.

entry: POKENAME背上精巧的蘑菇，有无比锋利的棱脊。战斗中，它能将其脱下，掷向敌人，打对方措手不及。
author: .izik
source: The intricate mushrooms growing from POKENAME's back have incredibly sharp ridges. It can detach them mid-combat and hurl them at the foe in an attempt to catch them off guard.

entry: POKENAME伸展镰刀旋转，迅速攻击四周一切。防御来袭时，它突然停下，交叉双镰使其坚实，截住任何威胁。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME twirl with their scythes extended to rapidly attack everything around them. To defend against incoming attacks, they suddenly stop and cross their scythes to solidify them and intercept any threat.

entry: 背上真菌驱使POKENAME，用镰刀般的石爪砍树。树倒后，体内释放的蘑菇孢子，便在腐木上扎根。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is compelled by the fungus on its back to cut down trees with its scythe-like stone claws. Once they are felled, mushroom spores released from within POKENAME's body take root in the wood as it rots.

entry: POKENAME甲胄极坚韧，能扛住敌击，再以臂刃还击。它住在水下洞穴，埋伏猎物，发动致命突袭。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's incredibly tough armor allows it to withstand enemy attacks, after which it strikes back with the blades on its arms. It dwells in underwater caves, where it lies in wait to launch deadly ambushes on its prey.

entry: POKENAME住在水下，设法伏击捕猎。若失败，就穷追不舍，用刃臂疯狂斩击。但若发现自己斩不断对手的刀刃，就会逃跑。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME lives underwater. It aims to capture its prey via ambush; if that fails, it will relentlessly chase its target down, slashing furiously with its bladed arms. However, it will flee at the sight of a foe whose blades it cannot cut through.

entry: POKENAME是悄然攀崖的高手，通常挂在洞顶，等有东西从下走过，便扑向目标。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME is a master of stealthily climbing cliffs. It typically hangs off cave ceilings until something walks under it, provoking it to pounce on the target.

entry: POKENAME将镰刀贴近身体，疾穿夜空。只有宝可梦战斗时，才伸出利镰，撕裂敌人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME zip through the night sky with their scythes close to their bodies. It is only during a Pokémon battle that they extend their scythes to rend their foes.

entry: POKENAME从地下伸出利刃，攻击敌人。利刃能轻易击碎珊瑚群。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME extends sharp blades from beneath the ground to strike foes. These blades can easily shatter coral formations.

entry: POKENAME从前俯冲向岩岸，以镰刀刺穿猎物。科学家推测，它也会用火，烤熟抓到的食物。
author: _._starry_._
source: POKENAME once hunted by swooping down to the rocky shores and spearing prey with its scythes. Scientists theorize it also used its fire to cook whatever it caught.

entry: POKENAME拳上刀刃能收回，多数战斗都藏着。唯有对手证明足够强，它才伸爪，以全部实力迎战。
author: sk372
source: The blades on POKENAME's fists are retractable, and it normally keeps them stowed away during most battles. Only when an opponent has proven themselves to be tough enough will POKENAME pull out its claws and fight at its full potential.

entry: POKENAME并用剃刀般利爪与强拳作战。身体每一处，都硬如岩石。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME fights using both razor-sharp claws and powerful punches. Every part of its body is as hard as rock.

entry: POKENAME用毒刺刺穿猎物，吸饮体液。毒刺虽能供它在陆上行走，但太久不吃，就会萎缩，让它困在原地。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME impales prey with its stingers and drinks their bodily fluids. Though it can use its stingers to walk on land, going too long without feeding causes them to shrivel, leaving it stranded.

entry: POKENAME前两条触手充当镰刀，狩猎进食，其余78条则帮助活动、困住猎物。镰刀若断，它就退入水下，重新长出。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME's front two tentacles act as scythes for hunting and feeding, while the other 78 assist in movement and trapping prey. If its scythes break, it retreats underwater to regrow them.

entry: POKENAME手臂由地下收集的化石构成。它们用黏土、泥等材料，将化石黏在身上，以惊人力量棍击敌人。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's arms are made of fossils it collects underground. By using clay, mud, or other materials, they stick these fossils to their bodies and use them to bludgeon foes with incredible force.

entry: POKENAME每个头，都想让身体朝自己希望的方向走，因此走法常很古怪。
author: camtft
source: Each head of POKENAME tries to move the body in their own desired way. This often leads to them moving in strange ways.

entry: POKENAME靠出色游泳本领，争取战斗优势。特技之一，是用锋利双爪冲撞对手。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their superb swimming ability to give them an edge in a Pokémon battle. One of their special techniques includes ramming into their opponent with their sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME天生淘气，极爱戏弄人类与其他宝可梦。若它想挠你痒，千万小心，可能造成不幸意外。
author: regulavish
source: POKENAME is mischievous by nature and greatly enjoys teasing and playing pranks on both humans and other Pokémon. Take extreme caution if it tries to tickle you as unfortunate accidents may occur.

entry: POKENAME用各种大声尖啸与翅膀动作，惊吓猎物。科学家甚至曾罕见地记录到，假眼也会眨动。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME uses a variety of loud screeches as well as wing movements to scare prey. In rare cases, scientists have even recorded the false eyes blinking.

entry: POKENAME不断挖地，直到找到适合作头盔的化石。遇险，它会轻吼，经头骨共振，听来却像凶猛猎手。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME digs through the ground until it finds a fossil suitable for a helmet. When threatened, it lets out a soft growl, and vibrations from the skull make it sound like a fierce predator.

entry: POKENAME用最纯净琥珀做的棒，抽打闯入领地的宝可梦。头骨极坚，连岩崩也划不伤。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its club, made of the purest amber, to lash out at Pokémon that have trespassed onto its territory. Its skull is so tough that not even a rock slide can scratch it.

entry: POKENAME的琥珀身体中，常含古老宝可梦化石。科学家正在研究，如何从它们体内提取原油。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME often contain the fossils of ancient Pokémon within their amber bodies. Scientists are currently researching methods to extract crude oil from these Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME袋中装着一块光滑的琥珀化石。对多数宝可梦虽没什么用，它却似乎爱拿来蹭电属性宝可梦，让其充满静电。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME carries a smooth piece of fossilized amber in its pouch. While there isn't much it can do for most Pokémon, POKENAME seems to enjoy rubbing this amber on Electric-type Pokémon to charge them with static electricity.

entry: POKENAME淡紫昆虫翅膀很显眼，成为许多捕食者的目标。它们发出高频哀啸，令捕食者一时发懵，再飞离。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are a target of many predators because they are easily spotted with their lavender insect wings. They screech with a high-pitched wail to momentarily daze predators before flying away.

entry: POKENAME挥舞锋利燧石镰刀，以精准强击打倒猎物。自史前起，它便在茂盛丛林划定猎场。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME wields its sharp flint scythes to bring down prey with precise, powerful strikes. Since prehistoric times, it has established its hunting grounds within lush, thriving jungles.

entry: 它沿山缝全速冲刺，积起动量，再起飞。POKENAME凶猛护地盘，用致命巨颚的狠咬，赶走闯入者。
author: fiordaliso
source: It dashes at full speed along mountain crevices to gain momentum before taking flight. Fiercely territorial, POKENAME drives away intruders with savage bites from its lethal jaws.

entry: 它沿山缝全速冲刺，积起动量，再起飞。POKENAME凶猛护地盘，用致命巨颚的狠咬，赶走闯入者。
author: fiordaliso
source: It dashes at full speed along mountain crevices to gain momentum before taking flight. Fiercely territorial, POKENAME drives away intruders with savage bites from its lethal jaws.

entry: POKENAME用琥珀颈圈增强电属性攻击，压倒对手。它整天沿领地边界飞行，从高处巡逻。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its amber collar to amplify its Electric-type attacks and overpower its rivals. It patrols its territory from above, flying along its borders throughout the entire day.

entry: POKENAME借夜色掩护，飞过数据中心上空，远程吸取信息。若在附近看见，最好立即备份。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME soars above data centers under cover of night, siphoning information remotely. If one is sighted nearby, immediate backups are strongly advised.

entry: 琥珀壳硬化前，POKENAME从翅膀散出恶臭，引来虫子。壳一硬，困在琥珀里的虫，便会存着，留待进化后吃。
author: santon5512
source: Before their amber shells harden, POKENAME emit a foul smell from their wings to attract bugs. Any bugs caught in their amber once it hardens are stored and kept as food for when they evolve.

entry: POKENAME攻击时，全身众多尖石能刺穿硬皮。它会凶残追猎整群宝可梦，直到全数杀死、吃光。
author: soup1900
source: When attacking enemies, the multitude of sharp rocks on POKENAME cause it to puncture through hard skin. It will savagely hunt down herds of Pokémon until the whole group has been killed off and eaten.

entry: POKENAME身上长出许多尖石。它须不断用于攻击，防止长得太大，压重身体。
author: soup1900
source: Many sharp rocks grow and protrude out of POKENAME. It must constantly use these rocks in its attacks to prevent them from growing too large and weighing it down.

entry: POKENAME攻击时，全身众多尖石能刺穿硬皮。它须不断用于攻击，防止长得太大，压重身体。
author: soup1900
source: When attacking enemies, the multitude of sharp rocks on POKENAME cause it to puncture through hard skin. It must constantly use these rocks in its attacks to prevent them from growing too large and weighing it down.

entry: POKENAME体形太大，翅膀无法带它飞，狩猎也困难。它主要猎独角犀牛等体形适中、行动慢的宝可梦，获取日需养分，其余靠树果维生。
author: chibitales
source: Due to its large size, POKENAME is unable to use its wings to fly and hunting is difficult. It relies on hunting good-sized, slower Pokémon such as Rhyhorn to get most of the nutrients it needs in a day, subsisting otherwise on berries.

entry: POKENAME由已知最古老的一些化石复活，年代接近3亿年前。牙形显示，它可能是植食者，以外皮极硬的树果为食。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME was revived from some of the oldest fossils ever discovered, dating back almost 300 million years. The shape of its teeth suggests it was a herbivore that ate berries with extremely hardened skin.

entry: POKENAME从天俯冲，用强颚叼住猎物，再飞回空中，猛烈甩头，将其弄伤，完成狩猎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME swoops down from the sky to snatch up prey into its powerful jaws. Afterwards, it takes off into the air, thrashing its head around to injure them and finish the hunt.

entry: POKENAME常与兄弟姐妹切磋，磨练本领。就连吃饭时，也会为了谁分得最多而争斗。虽然尚未长大，它们使出的咬碎，已经足以咬断骨头。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME frequently spar with their siblings to develop their skills. Even during mealtime, they will fight with each other over who gets the biggest share. Despite not being fully grown, a Crunch from these Pokémon is able to break bones.

entry: 这些宝可梦结成大群，接管森林，成为新的顶级猎手。它们翼上的指头能抓住对手，再用岩石般硬的头冠使出头锤。
author: chibitales
source: These Pokémon form large groups to take over forests as the new apex predators. The digits on their wings allow them to grab opponents and Headbutt them with rock-solid crests.

entry: POKENAME刀刃般的牙，切实心金属也如纸片。这凶猛宝可梦，爱挑战快龙、巨沼怪等强敌，残暴攻击，直到一方取胜。
author: chibitales
source: The blade-like teeth of POKENAME can shear through solid metal as though it were paper. This savage Pokémon enjoys picking fights with strong opponents such as Dragonite or Swampert, brutally attacking until one Pokémon rises as the victor.

entry: 最高山峰与海床，都发现过这只宝可梦的化石。它是非凡的飞行者。
author: notsaying.
source: Fossils of this Pokémon have been found from the tallest mountains to the sea floor. It is an incredible flier.

entry: POKENAME迄今只发现一块化石，因此所有现代复原，都依赖这件不完整标本。许多科学家认为，标本的翼发育畸形，小得不可能在生前支撑飞行。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Only a single fossil of POKENAME has ever been discovered, meaning all modern recreations rely on one incomplete specimen. Many scientists believe this specimen's wings were malformed, as they appear far too small to have supported flight in life.

entry: POKENAME球茎的岩壳，遮住背上生长的琥珀。它极护琥珀，任何东西想靠得太近，石藤便会疯狂抽打。
author: sk372
source: The rocky shell of POKENAME's bulb covers up an amber growth on its back. It is very protective of the amber, stone vines whipping furiously at anything that tries to get too close to it.

entry: 有人推测，POKENAME背上的琥珀碎片中含有古代宝可梦的遗传物质。POKENAME发怒时，藤蔓会疯狂生长。
author: mistymagius
source: The piece of amber on POKENAME's back is theorized to contain the DNA of ancient Pokémon. Its vines grow wildly when POKENAME is angered.

entry: POKENAME虽由重岩构成，仍能浮在空中。它们也会拍翼，但飞行并不需要这些动作。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME are made of heavy rock, they still float in the air. They will flap their wings as they do this, but these movements are not necessary for them to fly.

entry: 许多年前，POKENAME曾翱翔在后来成为丰缘的天空。气温升高后，许多个体散往关都，至今那里仍能找到不少化石。
author: periperi_chicken
source: Many years ago, POKENAME once soared through the skies of what would eventually become Hoenn. When temperatures rose, many scattered to Kanto, where many of their fossils can be found to this day.

entry: 它从冰峰展翼滑下，以利爪抓猎物。近期研究显示，早在史前，POKENAME就已是冰川地区最活跃的猎手之一。
author: fiordaliso
source: It uses its wings to glide down from icy peaks and snatch prey with its sharp talons. Recent studies suggest that POKENAME was already one of the most active predators in glacial regions as far back as prehistoric times.

entry: POKENAME背上琥珀的材料易燃。科学家争论，史前它究竟也是如今的熔融状态，还是更坚实。少数浮上表面的骨头，都非常耐热。
author: notadoctor75
source: The material of the amber on POKENAME's back is flammable, and scientists debate whether POKENAME existed in its current molten state or a more solid state back in prehistoric times. The few bones that bubble to the surface are very heat-resistant.

entry: POKENAME用爪抓大石，投向猎物狩猎。其他个体来抢食，它们就常打起来。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME hunt by picking up large rocks with their talons and dropping them onto prey. They often get into fights when other POKENAME try to steal their meal.

entry: POKENAME用可怕面容，吓退靠近的对象。它只追小而轻的猎物，不囤食，也不带回巢，可能为保护自己。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME uses its frightening visage to scare off those who approach it. It only pursues small and lightweight prey and does not hoard or take any food with it back to its nest, likely for its own protection.

entry: 多数POKENAME天生偏爱绘画。不过，罕见个体也会追求雕塑、吹制玻璃等手艺。无论如何，它都深受上流社会追捧。
author: ludacriswell
source: Most POKENAME exhibit an intrinsic gravitation towards painting. However, there have been rare variants that pursue other endeavors such as sculpting or glassblowing. Regardless, this Pokémon is highly sought after by the upper echelon of society.

entry: POKENAME用可怕面容，吓退靠近的对象。它只追小而轻的猎物，不囤食，也不带回巢，可能为保护自己。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME uses its frightening visage to scare off those who approach it. It only pursues small and lightweight prey and does not hoard or take any food with it back to its nest, likely for its own protection.

entry: POKENAME身体笨重，既不便爬，也不便飞。想移动，就先盘成弹簧，猛扑出去，再滑翔。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its unwieldy body makes it impractical for POKENAME to slither or fly. It coils itself into a spring, pounces, and glides when it wants to move.

entry: POKENAME身体的一部分琥珀，常深埋地下，多年沉睡，吸收化石的古老能量。翼缘剃刀般的尖石，能切穿肉身与灵魂。
author: vic1312
source: The amber that is part of POKENAME is often found buried deep in the earth, where it spent many years slumbering, absorbing ancient energy from fossils. Their wings are edged with razor-sharp stones that slice through both flesh and spirit.

entry: 古代，POKENAME是统治沙漠平原的顶级猎手，巨颚吞食一切胆敢挑战的对象。人们用一根巨大的爪化石，将它复活。
author: fiordaliso
source: In ancient times, POKENAME was an apex predator that ruled the desert plains, devouring anyone who dared challenge it with its massive jaws. It was revived from one of its large fossilized claws.

entry: 古代，POKENAME是统治沙漠平原的顶级猎手，巨颚吞食一切胆敢挑战的对象。人们用一根巨大的爪化石，将它复活。
author: fiordaliso
source: In ancient times, POKENAME was an apex predator that ruled the desert plains, devouring anyone who dared challenge it with its massive jaws. It was revived from one of its large fossilized claws.

entry: POKENAME皮肤极有弹性，像橡胶，因此十分能抵抗雷击。
author: .izik
source: The skin of an POKENAME is extremely elastic and is similar to rubber. Due to this, its body is highly resistant to lightning strikes.

entry: POKENAME的甲比钨还硬。夏季，在阳光下闪得比一年中任何时候都亮。
author: .izik
source: The armor on POKENAME's body is harder than tungsten. During the summer months, it shines in the sun more brightly than at any other time of the year.

entry: POKENAME在少有人行的山顶筑巢。若发现100米内还有别的居民，它会立即离开。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its den on the peak of rarely-traversed mountains. Should it spot someone else living within 100 meters, it will immediately leave.

entry: POKENAME头比身体其他部位都硬。它拿脸撞树，使树倒下，果子散落地上。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's head is harder than any other portion of its body. It rams its face into trees to make them topple, spilling the fruit to the ground.

entry: POKENAME栖在旧建筑上，观察周围闯入者，尤其防着想破坏家园的流氓无赖。一发现闹事者，就用尾缠住躯干，将其送走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME perch atop old buildings to monitor the surrounding area for intruders, particularly ruffians and hooligans who seek to vandalize their home. Once they spot a troublemaker, a tail wraps around their torso to escort them out.

entry: POKENAME握着的琥珀块，充满古老能量。一握紧，便能放出巨量磁力。
author: .izik
source: The chunks of amber that POKENAME holds are filled with an ancient energy. When gripping them tightly, it lets loose huge amounts of magnetic force.

entry: POKENAME吞下宝可梦灵魂后，会将其存在琥珀刃中，直到消化。若此前取出刀刃，那只宝可梦就能如化石宝可梦般复活。
author: .fedoraman
source: When POKENAME consumes the soul of a Pokémon, it is stored in its amber blade until the soul is digested. If the blade can be extracted before that point, the Pokémon can be resurrected as if it were a fossil Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的剑与盾，由坚硬的石头构成。两侧翅膀和剑刃一样锋利，飞掠时，即便敌人躲过剑尖，也能被翼锋割伤。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's sword and shield are made of hard stone. The wings on either side are just as sharp as the blade and can cut foes who manage to evade the blade's tip as it flies past.

entry: POKENAME的剑盾覆着琥珀，由树脂化石化形成。盾上骷髅的位置与表情，偶尔会变，但只在没人看见时。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's blade and shield are coated with amber, a rock formed from fossilized tree sap. The position and expression of the skull emblazoned on POKENAME's shield will occasionally change, although only when nobody else can see it.

entry: 有报告称，POKENAME曾伪装研究者，偷走装有化石宝可梦的精灵球。
author: a_grain_of_rice
source: There have been reports of POKENAME disguising themselves as researchers and stealing Poké Balls containing fossil Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME会在挖掘点旁伪装化石，偷研究者与考古学家的东西，恶名远扬。可它又快又强，多数人只好忍受它待在附近。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are notorious for disguising themselves as fossils near dig sites so they can steal from the researchers and archaeologists. Due to their swiftness and their brawn, however, most resign themselves to enduring the presence of POKENAME.

entry: 数英里外，也能听见POKENAME刺耳的叫声。它用缎带般的触须捆住猎物，再大快朵颐。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME's piercing cries can be heard from miles away. Their ribbons-like feelers keep prey bound while they feast.

entry: 有人认为，遍布世界的无数火山，全由POKENAME创造。它从地面立起这些充满岩浆的巢穴，在里面孵育幼崽。
author: sk372
source: Some believe that the myriad volcanoes dotting the world were all created by POKENAME. It erected these magma-filled dens from the earth in order to incubate and nurture its young within.

entry: POKENAME的绿色花纹，是连着胸部绿宝石状器官的特殊“血管”。战斗时，绿色部分发光，展现非凡力量。
author: infinex21
source: The green markings on POKENAME's body are special "veins" connected to the green, gem-like organ on its chest. During battle, these green parts glow as this Pokémon exhibits its remarkable power.

entry: POKENAME珍贵的金骨，看似服饰，其实是身体的一部分。研究显示，这些特征在史前曾更突出、更致命。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME's prized golden bones may look like apparel, but they are actually part of its body. Studies suggest these features were once much more intense and lethal in prehistoric times.

entry: POKENAME飞得快过子弹列车，空中动作轻松自如。喂它樱子果，就能避免因麻痹而减速。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME fly faster than a bullet train and can perform aerial maneuvers with effortless ease. By giving them a Cheri Berry, they can avoid being slowed down by paralysis.

entry: POKENAME十分爱护獠牙，会嚼碎矿物，再把牙在吐出物中磨蹭，加固自身。若某根牙弄脏或崩缺，它便疯狂暴走，见什么打什么。
author: grannyjojophone
source: POKENAME cares heavily for its tusks, chewing up minerals and rubbing its tusks in the vomit to strengthen them. If one of its tusks ever gets dirty or chipped, POKENAME will enter a wild frenzy, attacking anything in sight.

entry: POKENAME住在世界炎热干燥的地方，因为身体吸水极快。若无千香果使皮肤干燥，翅膀就会浸水太重，无法飞行。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lives in hot, dry places of the world because its body rapidly absorbs water. Without a Passho Berry to dry its skin, its wings become too waterlogged to fly.

entry: POKENAME鲜明翼纹，同时威吓捕食者与猎物。生气时，它猛烈拍翼，掀起强大疾风。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's brightly patterned wings intimidate predators and prey alike. When angered, it beats its wings violently to create powerful squalls.

entry: POKENAME藏在正在发掘的考古遗址，想吓不知情的科学家。可这些伏击通常失败，只换来阵阵笑声与赞叹。
author: turron_turron
source: POKENAME hide amidst active archaeological sites in order to scare unsuspecting scientists. These ambushes usually fail, however, provoking little more than showers of laughter and admiration.

entry: POKENAME会疯狂暴走，攻击穿过领地的一切，无论天上地上。据说古代它们曾因耗尽力气，在精疲力竭时遭猎杀。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are known to go on violent rampages, attacking anything soaring through their territory, whether it be in the skies or on the ground. It's believed that in ancient times, they tired themselves out and were hunted while out of energy.

entry: POKENAME金属头骨沉重，几乎飞不了，却从不停止尝试。它能滑翔短程，最后总会一头栽地，幸而坚骨让它不留长久伤害。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's heavy metallic skull makes it nearly impossible to fly, but it never stops trying. It can glide short distances, but will inevitably hurtle head-first to the ground, though its tough skull prevents any lasting damage to itself.

entry: 有些POKENAME没有可供试飞的翅膀，只能困在陆地。它们看着有翼同伴尝试飞行，既嫉妒，又怜悯。
author: sk372
source: Some variants of POKENAME lack wings to attempt flight, leaving them landlocked. They watch their winged compatriots try to fly with a mixture of jealousy and pity.

entry: POKENAME常在旧市政建筑顶，像雕像般静止，看着下方人群。难得活动时，它们爱向路人扔小石子。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found atop older municipal buildings where they watch people below them with a statue-like motionlessness. On the rare occasion they move, they enjoy tossing pebbles at those who pass by.

entry: 研究显示，POKENAME史前曾是凶猛空中猎手。但数百年的人类驯养，让耳朵不再有力，牙齿也钝了。
author: h0bojoe
source: Studies suggest that POKENAME were once vicious airborne hunters in prehistoric times. However, centuries of human domestication have weakened their ears and dulled their teeth.

entry: POKENAME是嗜血猎手，用锋利肘剑割开猎物喉咙。可体形太小，猎不了大物，通常只拿肘剑压碎树果。
author: grannyjojophone
source: POKENAME is a bloodthirsty hunter, using its sharp elbow swords to slice the throat of prey. However, it usually uses them to crush berries, as POKENAME is too small to hunt big prey.

entry: POKENAME从天俯冲，用后脑大而坚固的角，打得猎物无法行动。虽常对别人凶猛，适当训练后，却能成为忠诚护卫。
author: pokejirkaok
source: POKENAME hunts by swooping down from the skies, incapacitating its prey with its large, sturdy horn on the back of its head. Although it is usually aggressive toward others, with proper training it can become a loyal protector.

entry: 勾魂眼吃下秘密琥珀，有时便会变成这只宝可梦，很快，连各种化石也都想尝一尝。
author: insanity5734
source: A Sableye that consumes Old Amber will sometimes become this Pokémon, and soon develops a taste for all fossils.

entry: POKENAME拿着巨大结晶琥珀防身。战斗时，宝石发光，龙能涌动，里面的剪影随之活动，增强它的打击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME holds a giant crystallized chunk of amber to use as a form of protection. When in combat, the gem will glow and surge with Dragon energy, the silhouette moving within as it powers up POKENAME's strikes.

entry: POKENAME太重，不能久飞，须不断拍翼，才能稍稍离地。据说史前，它曾与始祖大鸟争夺食物、领地。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is too heavy to fly for long, forced to flap constantly just to stay a meager amount off the ground. It's believed to have fought over food and territory with Archeops in prehistory.

entry: POKENAME身上的石头，会生长两年才脱落。这些石头可重新加工，制成美丽雕塑。
author: .izik
source: The stones on an POKENAME's body will grow for two years until they fall off. The stones can be reshaped to make beautiful sculptures.

entry: POKENAME体形庞大，飞行速度却能媲美如今的烈咬陆鲨。加上出众的狩猎能力，被称为“空中歼灭者”。
author: patch
source: Despite its massive size, POKENAME could fly at speeds that could rival modern Garchomp. This, coupled with its impressive hunting abilities, has earned it the nickname 'The Aerial Annihilator'.

entry: POKENAME爱吃鸟宝可梦，凭高敏捷性，在空中捕获。它能从尾巴发射碎石，又颇为虚荣，自豪于外貌，常常梳理。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's preferred prey is bird Pokémon, which it catches mid-flight with its high agility. It has the ability to fire shards of rock from its tail. POKENAME can be quite vain, taking great pride in its appearance, and preening frequently.

entry: POKENAME很少用牙攻击，而是以惊人速度，冲撞猎物与争地盘的对手。
author: pokepower
source: POKENAME rarely uses its fangs to attack. Instead, it rams into prey and territorial rivals at alarming speed.

entry: POKENAME嗓音颇难听，却整天唱，常让听者头痛。它天性平和，可谁威胁，就会毫不犹豫咬谁。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite its rather unpleasant voice, POKENAME sings all day long, often giving listeners a headache. Though naturally peaceful, it won't hesitate to bite anyone who threatens it.

entry: POKENAME嗓音颇难听，却整天唱，常让听者头痛。它天性平和，可谁威胁，就会毫不犹豫咬谁。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite its rather unpleasant voice, POKENAME sings all day long, often giving listeners a headache. Though naturally peaceful, it won't hesitate to bite anyone who threatens it.

entry: POKENAME羽毛覆着领地内的各种岩石与矿物。亲密伙伴身旁，它们通常温顺；自己或朋友受威胁，就会凶猛发狂。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's feathers are coated in various rocks and other minerals found in their territory. POKENAME are often docile around close companions, but fly into a ferocious frenzy when they or their friends are threatened.

entry: POKENAME羽毛覆着厚琥珀，充当护盾，却让它们几乎不能飞。亲密伙伴身旁通常温顺；自己或朋友受威胁，就会凶猛发狂。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's feathers are coated in a thick layer of amber that acts as a shield, but renders them near flightless. POKENAME are often docile around close companions, but fly into a ferocious frenzy when they or their friends are threatened.

entry: 科学家发现，POKENAME的水晶身体，近似史前琥珀。他们推测，物质吸光便会软化，它翱翔时，曾将许多宝可梦困入体内。
author: mepp.
source: Scientists have found that POKENAME's crystalline body is similar to amber found in prehistoric times. They theorize that this substance softened as it consumed light, trapping numerous Pokémon in its body as it soared across the sky.

entry: 任何有机物落在POKENAME身上，都会沉入，成为身体的一部分。头骨眼中流出的沙，仿佛无穷无尽。
author: raptorroocool
source: Any organic material dropped onto an POKENAME's body sinks in and becomes part of it. The sand flowing out of the skull's eyes is seemingly endless.

entry: POKENAME身体不适合天空，却靠头上的翼飞行。它偏爱苔原，飞过冰封大地，身体垂在下方。
author: .izik
source: The wings on POKENAME's head allow it to fly despite its body being ill-suited for the skies. It prefers to live in tundras, soaring over icy landscapes while its body dangles below.

entry: POKENAME在树根筑巢，大量侵入，曾导致一些树木死亡。如今，它被视为入侵物种。
author: notsaying.
source: Nesting in the roots of trees, POKENAME infestations were a cause of some trees dying out. In this day and age, it is considered an invasive species.

entry: POKENAME鳞片坚硬、沉重如岩石。它跃入空中，拍翼增高，再用双拳重重砸向敌人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's scales are as hard and as heavy as rock. POKENAME will leap up into the air, flapping its wings to gain extra elevation, then bring its fists down on foes with crushing force.

entry: POKENAME不知为何，挥爪上下摆动就能飞。这种奇特推进方式，已困扰研究者数十年。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME somehow achieves flight by waving its claws up and down. This strange method of propulsion has baffled researchers for decades.

entry: POKENAME大部分壳，似由坚实琥珀物质构成。体内蒸汽从极小孔洞排出，常也染着与来源相同的金色。
author: sk372
source: Most of POKENAME's shell appears to be made of a solid amber substance. It vents internal steam through extremely tiny pores within, the steam often tinted a similarly golden color as its source.

entry: POKENAME规划每日挖洞路线时，尾巴会有节奏地抽动。发现捕食者，便用原始之力还击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tail whips rhythmically as it plans its daily digging routes. If a predator is spotted, it retaliates using Ancient Power.

entry: 全世界的化石记录中，都有POKENAME，因此科学家认为，它远在人类出现前，就已在这星球生活。他们也推测，其他宝可梦进入求偶季时，它最活跃。
author: quackquackattack
source: Scientists believe that POKENAME have been on the planet long before people were around, as they are embedded into the fossil record throughout the world. They also speculate that POKENAME were most active when other Pokémon enter courtship season.

entry: 爱心鱼常聚在相爱的人身边，POKENAME却爱游近单身者。人们认为，这是无须恋爱，也能人生顺遂的象征。
author: hophoppip
source: While Luvdisc tend to congregate around people in love, POKENAME prefers to swim near single humans. It's believed to be a sign of prosperity in life without the need for romance.

entry: POKENAME静坐如雕像，等猎物靠近，从不追赶。闲暇时喜欢玩自己觉得漂亮的石头。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME sit perfectly still like statues, letting their prey get close to them instead of pursuing them. In their idle time they like to play with rocks they find pretty.

entry: POKENAME无论来到哪种环境，都执着地想当顶级猎手。一遇潜在对手，就会勃然大怒。
author: empty_set
source: POKENAME have an obsessive desire to be the apex predator in whatever environment they find themselves in. They fly into a rage upon encountering potential rivals.

entry: 许多古建筑都有POKENAME雕像，刻成守卫四周的姿态。巨大威严的双翼，强得足以把白海狮这类重猎物带回巢。
author: chibitales
source: Statues of POKENAME appear in many ancient buildings, carved to look as if it were guarding the area. Its large, imposing wings are strong enough to let it carry heavy prey such as Dewgong to its nest.

entry: 许多滴水兽以POKENAME为形象雕刻。它似乎很乐于假扮其中一座。
author: notsaying.
source: Many gargoyles have been carved in the image of POKENAME. It seems to find some joy in pretending to be one of these gargoyles.

entry: 这只关都远古的强大顶级宝可梦，已被红莲岛科学家复活、放归环境。如今，它们住在红莲岛的火山中，在玄武岩柱间筑巢。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A powerful apex Pokémon from Kanto's distant history, scientists on Cinnabar Island have managed to resurrect them and reintroduce them into the environment. They now make their home within the Cinnabar Volcano, nesting within basalt columns.

entry: 这只关都远古的强大顶级宝可梦，已被红莲岛科学家复活、放归环境。如今，它们住在红莲岛的火山中，在玄武岩柱间筑巢。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A powerful apex Pokémon from Kanto's distant history, scientists on Cinnabar Island have managed to resurrect them and reintroduce them into the environment. They now make their home within the Cinnabar Volcano, nesting within basalt columns.

entry: 这只关都远古的强大顶级宝可梦，已被红莲岛科学家复活、放归环境。如今，它们住在红莲岛的火山中，在玄武岩柱间筑巢。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A powerful apex Pokémon from Kanto's distant history, scientists on Cinnabar Island have managed to resurrect them and reintroduce them into the environment. They now make their home within the Cinnabar Volcano, nesting within basalt columns.

entry: 这只关都远古的强大顶级宝可梦，已被红莲岛科学家复活、放归环境。如今，它们住在红莲岛的火山中，在玄武岩柱间筑巢。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A powerful apex Pokémon from Kanto's distant history, scientists on Cinnabar Island have managed to resurrect them and reintroduce them into the environment. They now make their home within the Cinnabar Volcano, nesting within basalt columns.

entry: POKENAME的保护壳，由成簇硬化的秘密琥珀形成，抵御冲击。它在岩洞安家，凶猛防御一切闯入者。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's protective shell is formed from clusters of hardened Old Amber, shielding it from impacts. POKENAME dens within rocky caverns, which it defends fiercely against any intruder.

entry: 农人训练成群POKENAME，栖在马厩顶当哨兵。捕食者若想潜入农场，整群就会俯冲，合力赶走。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Farmers train groups of POKENAME to perch atop stables and act as sentries. If a predator tries to infiltrate the farm, the whole flock of POKENAME will swoop down to chase them off.

entry: POKENAME尾上附着琥珀，飞过天空，借其重量，鞭打其他飞行宝可梦。树脂化石的琥珀色，让它在天上格外显眼。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME soar through the sky with amber attached to their tails and harness the weight of the amber to whip other flying Pokémon. The amber color of the fossilized tree resin makes them easy to spot in the sky.

entry: POKENAME多余的眼，让觅食视野更广。遭到重击，覆琥珀的节段便脱离，等安全后，再用磁力合回身体。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's extra eyes help it scout for food with an enhanced field of view. If it sustains a powerful hit, its amber-coated segments detach until it is safe to reform by using its magnets.

entry: POKENAME棒上带着琥珀，细胞层面与偶尔含有化石翼龙DNA的秘密琥珀完全相同。目前无证据表明，它曾自然存在于野外。
author: bobosmith01
source: On a stick, POKENAME carries amber cellularly identical to the Old Amber in which Aerodactyl's DNA can sometimes be found. There is currently no evidence to suggest it existed naturally in the wild.

entry: POKENAME常吃零余果，比多数卡比兽融合体更有精神。能量用尽，就会不管在做什么，直接倒下，还释放孢子，让身边也一起睡着。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are more energetic than most Snorlax fusions due to their steady diet of Chesto Berries. When they run out of energy, they will collapse in the middle of whatever they're doing and create spores that put those around them to sleep as well.

entry: POKENAME脾气不定，一饿过头就容易大发脾气。这些发作很危险，有时怒得会直接爆炸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a volatile temper, prone to throwing tantrums if it gets too hungry. These fits can be dangerous, as they sometimes result in it exploding from sheer rage.

entry: POKENAME手臂强得能打穿金属，曾砸进发电机，抓住线缆吸电。若睡梦中受打扰，就会爆炸般猛烈放电。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's arms are strong enough to punch through metal, as seen by them breaking into generators and grabbing cables to siphon electricity from. They release explosive blasts of electricity if disturbed in their sleep.

entry: POKENAME能一动不动睡上几天。休息时，它以心灵感应与同类交流，常一起做相同的梦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can sleep for days without moving. While resting, it communicates telepathically with others of its kind, often dreaming in unison.

entry: POKENAME爱懒洋洋地晒太阳。有时，几个头长得过大，让身体既站不住，也抬不起。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME enjoys lazing out in the sun. Sometimes, its heads grow so large that it is unable to stand or raise its body.

entry: POKENAME用削尖的骨头，戳起树果与食物，甚至生火烤熟。谁想从它手里拿走哪怕一点碎屑，它都会愤怒挥骨。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses a sharpened bone to poke and pick up berries and other foods, even cooking them over fires it makes. It angrily swings the bone at those who would seek to take even a crumb of its food from it.

entry: POKENAME通常往地下深挖，寻找头盔与武器。那些骨头其实是古老化石，但它们坚称属于自己，让研究无法进行。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME usually find their helmets and weapons from digging deep into the ground. These bones are actually ancient fossils, but are unable to be studied due to POKENAME's territorial claims over them.

entry: POKENAME舌头黏，能轻易黏住远处树果。懒得动时，尤其好用，伸舌就能摘下附近灌丛的果。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have sticky tongues that easily cling to berries from a long distance. This is particularly helpful when they feel lazy and do not want to move, as the tongue easily plucks berries from nearby bushes.

entry: POKENAME体形巨大，食量超过500千克。吃够后，就会放松休息，准备进化。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Due to their expansive size, POKENAME consume upwards of 500kg in food. After eating enough, they relax to prepare for evolution.

entry: POKENAME随星期几不同，而有不同饮食喜好。周六，它们更爱加工食品，常从野餐偷吃。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME has different food preferences based on what day of the week it is. On Saturdays, they gravitate towards more processed foods, often stealing from picnics.

entry: 这些大虫宝可梦，会吃光整株灌木、草丛，甚至一整棵树的叶。虽常数量不多，仍有许多人坚持捕捉，保护森林。
author: infinex21
source: These large bug Pokémon will eat entire shrubs, bushes, and even the leaves of a whole tree. Though they are oft few in number, many still insist upon catching them to keep forests safe.

entry: POKENAME极不活跃，懒洋洋地待着，对战中常忽视初级训练家的指令。不少被认为不值得费力训练，因此遭释放。它们睡在蜕皮上。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are extremely inactive and just laze around, often ignoring junior Trainers' commands when in battle. A notable number of POKENAME are released due to being perceived as not worth the effort to train. They sleep on their shed skin.

entry: POKENAME产出的蛋，营养密度世界最高，却多数宁可往袋里塞垃圾食品。尽管如此，它们仍很慷慨，谁今天不顺心，就送根薯条。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME produce the most nutrient-dense eggs in the world, but most choose to fill their pouches with junk food instead. Despite this, they are still generous and will offer a fry to any person having a bad day.

entry: POKENAME在海底觅食，翻找、吃下大量食物。吃得越多，遇险时能喷出的墨汁就越多，帮助掩护。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a bottom feeder that roots around the ocean floor, eating vast quantities of food. The more it eats, the bigger quantities of ink it can expel to obscure itself when in danger.

entry: 卡比兽以堵路出名，POKENAME也不例外，只不过堵的是河床与溪流，害水宝可梦春天也无法迁徙。
author: rooboid
source: Following Snorlax's reputation of blocking walkways, POKENAME blocks riverbeds and streams, leaving aquatic Pokémon unable to migrate in the spring.

entry: POKENAME挂在特别结实的树上，用层层丝裹住自己。睡中翻身太多，树就倒下，立刻将它惊醒。它气恼被叫醒，便吃光最近树果树的全部果实。
author: ghostslythe
source: Hanging from especially sturdy trees, POKENAME swaddles itself in layers of silk. If it tosses too much in its sleep, the tree falls down, awakening it in an instant. Irate at being awake, it strips the nearest berry tree of all fruit.

entry: 只要有甜甜的天然食物，POKENAME就满足好相处。森林中数量稀少；进化所需食量太大，少有野生宝可梦能进化成它。
author: bobosmith01
source: As long as it gets its sugary and natural food, POKENAME is satisfied and agreeable. It is found in forests in small numbers; due to the raw amount of food it must consume to evolve, few wild Pokémon evolve into POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME沉到海底，长久睡眠。张嘴打出的沉重鼾声，会造成轻微震动与小漩涡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME settles to the bottom of the sea and slumbers for long periods of time. Its deep open-mouthed snoring causes faint rumbles and miniature whirlpools.

entry: POKENAME爱用大量稀有食材、做得近乎铺张的精致料理。训练家常负担不起，它只好不情愿地吃普通饭菜。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoys fancy, borderline prodigal cooking with lots of rare ingredients. Trainers often struggle to finance such tastes, so it begrudgingly eats plain meals that its Trainer provides.

entry: 农人饲养POKENAME，喂有瑕疵或卖不出的庄稼，制作有机堆肥。食欲虽旺，它们每餐后却至少要休息好几天，消化完才继续。
author: chibitales
source: Farmers raise and feed POKENAME blemished and otherwise unsellable crops to create organic compost. POKENAME have voracious appetites, but require at least several days of rest to digest their meal before continuing.

entry: 它大多睡在海底。POKENAME醒来时，会发出雷鸣般的长嚎，足以引起海底地震。
author: mepp.
source: It spends most of its days asleep at the bottom of the sea. When POKENAME awakens from its sleep, it emits a thunderous howl that can cause underwater earthquakes.

entry: POKENAME身体厚实，脂肪与肌肉丰富，几乎任何气候的水中，都能舒服游动。只要给吃的，几乎谁都肯载。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's body is incredibly thick with fat and muscle, allowing it to comfortably swim through water in nearly any climate. It will ferry nearly anyone that gives it food.

entry: POKENAME常直接睡在船只与泳客的前路上。幸好，它几乎不动，很容易绕过。
author: atlas3339098
source: POKENAME has the tendency to sleep right in the path of boats and swimmers. Thankfully, it hardly moves, so it's easy enough to get around it.

entry: POKENAME吃得好，变身就更完美。外表能模仿得分毫不差，却会比较对方与自己的味觉，露出伪装。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's Transform becomes more perfect when it is well-fed. It can perfectly match the appearance of whatever it transforms into, but ruins the disguise by comparing their sense of taste to its own.

entry: POKENAME一天大多在睡。对没时间、精力或空间，饲养更活跃伊布的人而言，它是热门宠物。
author: honestly_vitali
source: POKENAME spends most of the day sleeping. It's a popular pet for those who don't have the time, energy, or space to keep the more active Eevee.

entry: POKENAME懒洋洋地躺在大湖。没力气捕猎，就吃湖边苔藓或藻类，常陷入一生只吃这两样的循环。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME lounges lazily in large lakes. When it lacks the energy to hunt, it eats moss or algae growing around the lakeside. This often leads to a cycle where it subsists on nothing but moss and algae for its entire life.

entry: POKENAME虽快如闪电，却更爱休息。训练家发现，教动作相当容易，尤其是“坐下”。
author: xiapher
source: Despite its lightning-fast speed, POKENAME prefers to rest. Trainers find that teaching a POKENAME tricks, especially the 'sit' command, to be rather easy.

entry: POKENAME胃口大，普通食物也能维生，却格外渴望电子设备。须好好训练、喂饱，否则它可能外出，吃光家里乃至整座城市的机器。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a large appetite, able to subsist on normal food but with a particular hunger for electronics. One must keep it well-trained and well-fed, lest it go out and eat every machine in a home or even an entire city.

entry: POKENAME偷来野餐毯裹身。大多时间熟睡，醒着则专门吃东西。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME uses a stolen picnic blanket as a swaddle. It spends most of its time slumbering, with its waking hours being exclusively for eating.

entry: 从前，POKENAME把巨身藏进海床沙里，等猎物游过，就切成两半。古代这让它成为出色猎手，如今躲着，却更容易被猎物察觉。
author: bigoljax
source: Long ago, POKENAME hid its large body within the ocean floor's sands, waiting for prey to swim over it before slicing them in half. Though this made it an amazing predator long ago, nowadays prey will notice it a lot more easily as it hides.

entry: POKENAME吃大量蔬果，满足惊人胃口。一地树果快吃完，它们就一边嚼着，一边飞走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME satiate their voracious appetite by eating lots of fruits and vegetables. When an area is about to run out of berries, they chew food and fly at the same time.

entry: 小翅膀与懒性子，让人们常误以为POKENAME不能飞。其实，偶尔能看见它高速飞过城市，寻找食物。
author: bigoljax
source: It is a common misconception that POKENAME can't fly due to their small wings and lazy nature. In reality, they're occasionally seen zooming past cities to find food.

entry: 这只宝可梦满怀积极情绪与幸福，特别爱吃。有时吃得太多，连自己体重都带不动，飞不起来。
author: cipherlingarde
source: This Pokémon is filled with positive emotions and happiness. It absolutely loves eating; sometimes it eats so much it can't fly with its own weight.

entry: 免疫系统极为高效复杂，让它能完全抵抗多种疾病与病毒。有些人十分希望实验、研究POKENAME，却也引发许多伦理疑虑。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its immune system is incredibly effective and complex, making it wholly resistant to many types of diseases and viruses. Although experimentation and research into POKENAME is highly desired by some, there are numerous ethical concerns being raised.

entry: 这只宝可梦静静睡着，不停梦见各类食物。梦境偶尔在身边化成实体，又忽然消失。许多厨师都来观看，寻找新菜灵感。
author: be77yboop
source: Quietly sleeping, this Pokémon continuously dreams of all varieties of foods. Its dreams occasionally materialize around it before once again popping out of existence. Many a chef has come to see this Pokémon to garner inspiration for new dishes.

entry: POKENAME总打哈欠，即使不累。不过，它极少不困，不吃东西、不战斗的时候，多数也都在睡。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME always yawns, even when not tired. It's a very rare occurrence for it to not be sleepy, however, even though it spends most of its time sleeping if not eating or battling.

entry: POKENAME翅膀撑不起体重，无法飞。它们只好爬树找睡处，每天最多休息18小时。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are unable to fly because their wings cannot support their body weight. They resort to climbing trees to find a place to sleep, where they rest for up to 18 hours a day.

entry: POKENAME织大网捕食，再睡在中央。东西撞网的振动，可能将它叫醒，可它常睡得太深，连猎物被困也不察觉。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spins a large web to catch food, then falls asleep in the middle of it. It may be woken up by the vibrations of anything colliding with the web, although POKENAME often sleeps so deeply that it doesn't notice that prey has been captured.

entry: POKENAME倒挂枝头或洞顶睡觉，滴落的口水常被误当成水。醒来，就立刻找食物大吃，再继续睡。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME sleep hanging upside down from branches or cave ceilings, their dripping drool often being mistaken for water. When they awaken, they immediately set out to find and gorge upon more food before resting again.

entry: POKENAME靠四只翅膀飞出极快的速度，全是为了弄到食物。人们常提醒训练家提防它们，因为凡是能下口的食物，它们都十分乐意抢走。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their four wings to achieve great speeds, all for the sake of securing food. Trainers are oft advised to be wary of these Pokémon, for they are more than happy to steal any and all food they can sink their teeth into.

entry: POKENAME太贪吃，触角竟适应着，长成了树果。它吃自己的树果，并不会痛，通常也会重新长好。
author: dodoowner_
source: The force of POKENAME's gluttony has adapted its antennae into Berries. It eating its Berries doesn't hurt, and they usually grow back.

entry: 野外，POKENAME一天睡二十二小时，清醒的两小时则在深夜大吃。它们住高树上，既能安心睡，也觉得更靠近月亮。
author: pjporwoll
source: In the wild, POKENAME sleeps twenty-two hours a day, with its two waking hours spent late at night devouring food. It makes its home in tall trees where it can safely sleep and feel closer to the moon.

entry: POKENAME站在街道上，预见何时会有满载食物的卡车经过。有时，在一处等得太久，自己反倒睡着。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME stands over streets and uses its ability to see into the future to know when trucks full of food will pass by. Sometimes, when it stands in wait at one location for too long, it falls asleep.

entry: POKENAME常一起睡在原野，每打一次鼾，彼此便连起电弧。有人好奇，它入睡时，会不会也数同类跳栅栏。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can often be found sleeping together in fields, electricity arcing from one another with each snore. Some wonder if POKENAME count members of their own species jumping over fences to fall asleep.

entry: 它每天长出厚厚蓬松羊毛。若梳理不当，POKENAME就会被毛压得无法动弹，不过它似乎不介意。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It grows a thick, fluffy coat of wool every day. Improper grooming of your POKENAME will result in it not being able to move under the weight of its wool. It doesn't seem to mind though.

entry: POKENAME在珠体内发电，再放成雷电，自卫或打落挂着的果。它们习惯先用电把食物稍稍烤焦，再吃。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME generate electricity within their orbs and release it as bolts to defend themselves or to knock free hanging fruit. They have a habit of using their electricity to partly char food before eating it.

entry: 即使睡着，POKENAME的尾珠也至少微微亮着。毛间电流噼啪作响，打鼾时，有时还会向外迸散。
author: infinex21
source: Even when sleeping, POKENAME's tail orbs glow at least a little. Their fur crackles with electricity, which sometimes flies outward when they snore.

entry: POKENAME大吃后，最多睡上一个月，保存能量。若被叫醒，就会不受控地以光释放储能，可能造成失明或严重晒伤。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME preserves its power by sleeping for up to a month after a big meal. If you wake it up from its nap, it will uncontrollably release its stored energy in the form of light. Its light can cause blindness or nasty sunburns.

entry: POKENAME舞过高草，其他宝可梦误以为，头上连着的球茎是真树果。其实里面满是催眠花粉，谁咬，就会沉沉睡去。
author: bigoljax
source: As POKENAME dances through tall grass, other Pokémon assume the bulbs connected to its head are real berries. These bulbs are actually filled with sleep-inducing pollen, causing whatever bites into them to fall into a deep slumber.

entry: POKENAME虽睡得多，听觉敏锐，却也很容易醒，连自己肚子叫都行。赶快吃一餐，它又会回去打盹。
author: .jerden
source: While POKENAME spends a lot of time sleeping, its keen hearing means that it is easily woken up, even by the sound of its own stomach. After eating a quick meal, it will return to its nap.

entry: POKENAME翅膀太小，只能离地几秒。因此，只有够不着食物，才会飞去抓。
author: novellavaria
source: POKENAME's wings are too small to lift it off the ground for more than a couple of seconds. Because of this, it only flies to grab hard-to-reach food.

entry: 平常的食物吃光，POKENAME就会减重，乘风去新地方。若飞途中有鸟宝可梦抓住，它便让自己变重，直到重得无法携走。
author: bigoljax
source: Whenever POKENAME runs out of the usual diet it lives on, it'll lose weight and let the wind carry it somewhere new. If any bird Pokémon grab onto it during these flights, it makes itself heavier until it's too heavy to carry.

entry: POKENAME大多在睡，似乎毫无飞行兴趣。饿了，就飞上天，尽量久飞，抢走其他宝可梦的各类食物。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME spends most of its time sleeping, not seeming to have any interest in flying. When hungry, it'll soar into the sky and fly as long as it can, snatching up most types of food from other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME行动慢，却又反复无常，很难决定吃什么。即使有更诱人的选择，最后也常只吃块奶酪或一颗树果。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are slow yet fickle creatures that have a difficult time deciding what to eat. They usually end up eating a piece of cheese or a berry even when presented with more appetizing options.

entry: POKENAME挂在树枝，每天睡18小时以上。短短的清醒时间，就寻找柠檬、柚子等柑橘类水果。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hangs from branches and sleeps for upwards of 18 hours a day. It searches for citrus fruits, like lemons or pomelos, during the scant few hours it is awake.

entry: POKENAME在河流浅水休息，一睡几天。醒来常发现身上覆了薄泥，便用长舌舔净，可这又常累得它重新睡去。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME rests in the shallows of rivers, sleeping for days at a time. When it wakes up, it often finds a thin layer of mud has formed over it. It uses its long tongue to lick the mud off, but this often exhausts it, causing it to fall back asleep.

entry: POKENAME贪吃出了名，常囤多达一百种树果。为防小偷，它们滚过全部存粮，覆上一层毒膜。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are infamous gluttons, often hoarding up to a hundred various types of berries. To deter thieves, POKENAME roll all over their stash to cover them in a poisonous film.

entry: POKENAME通常大吃西瓜、南瓜等大果实。热量摄入被认为相当低，每天只需50000卡路里。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME usually feast on larger fruits, like watermelon and pumpkin. Their calorie intake is considered quite low, only needing 50,000 calories a day.

entry: POKENAME进入深眠后，便能聆听其他熟睡宝可梦的梦境。若听到的是噩梦，它就会将其吃掉，让受苦的宝可梦睡得更安稳。
author: bigoljax
source: When POKENAME falls into a deep slumber, it gains the ability to listen to other sleeping Pokémon's dreams. If their dreams are actually nightmares, it'll feast upon them, allowing the suffering Pokémon to have a better night's sleep.

entry: POKENAME面容强悍，性情随和，完全免疫大多数已知毒素。若非总想吞吃成堆食物，废物处理与研究公司，本会更常使用。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has a tough countenance and easygoing nature. It is completely immune to most known forms of toxins. It would be used more often by waste management and research companies if it were not for its constant desire to gorge on heaps of food.

entry: POKENAME通常温顺，但其他宝可梦一靠近饭，就可能凶猛护食。因此，建议训练家分开喂养。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are normally docile creatures but may exhibit food aggression whenever another Pokémon comes near their meal. As a result, Trainers are advised to feed POKENAME in separate spaces from other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME硕大的独眼始终紧闭，生活却一切如常。一些持异说的人相信，POKENAME一旦睁眼，便预示着灭顶之灾。
author: sk372
source: Its large singular eye remains eternally closed, though POKENAME still functions normally in spite of this. Some fringe theorists believe that should POKENAME open its eye, it is a harbinger of great doom.

entry: POKENAME是个字形符号，谁读，就会饥饿、困倦。若迟迟吃不上，受影响者便暴怒，力量却似乎猛增！
author: bukie
source: POKENAME is a glyph that, when read, induces hunger and lethargy in the observer. If left hungry, the affected individual becomes enraged, but their strength seems to spike!

entry: POKENAME昼夜都不定时活动，飞行规律因而意外难料。随身巨型宝可梦之笛，既能让它保持警醒，也能配合爪子，棍击对手。
author: beatdoof
source: Thanks to POKENAME's cathemeral habits, it's surprisingly erratic in its flight patterns. The giant Poké Flute it carries is used to ensure the Pokémon stays sharply alert, or to batter its opponents alongside its claws.

entry: POKENAME用强颚吞下找到的一切可食物，吃饱就沉睡。可吃坏食物后，常会肠胃不适，它与训练家都很无奈。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses its powerful jaws to devour anything edible it finds, then falls into a deep sleep as soon as it is full. Unfortunately for both POKENAME and its Trainer, it often gets an upset stomach after eating spoiled food.

entry: POKENAME冬眠前，收集惊人食量，大吃后进入深眠。即使有经验的训练家，叫醒它，也远比叫醒圈圈熊或卡比兽危险。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME gathers incredible amounts of food to eat before hibernating and falling into a deep sleep. Waking up a sleeping POKENAME is far more dangerous than waking up an Ursaring or Snorlax, even for experienced Trainers.

entry: POKENAME熔融的身体，让双颚无法稳定成形，只好熔化食物。它们等果实从树上落下，试着用箱子接住。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's molten form causes their jaws to be unable to stay in a stable state, this leads to them needing to melt down their food. They wait until fruit fall down from trees, and try to catch it in their boxes.

entry: POKENAME用鼻吻找食，能以小爪挖得很深。它们常睡在觅食挖出的洞里，尤其刚吃饱之后。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their snouts to search for food and can dig deep with their small claws. They will often fall asleep in the burrows dug in search of food, especially after a meal.

entry: POKENAME睡在洞穴，或獠牙挖出的地洞。醒来，就觅食大吃，再回巢休息。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME sleep in caves or burrows dug out with their tusks. When awake, they forage for food to gorge upon before returning to their nest for more rest.

entry: POKENAME不需太多打理，是老人的好伙伴。可惜，饲主年迈去世后，它们常流落收容所。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are great companions for the elderly, due to them not needing much maintenance. Sadly, they're often found in shelters due to their owners succumbing to their age.

entry: 它睡在海床上，厚厚的脂肪层帮它抵御寒冷。POKENAME醒来总是很饿，唯有深海找不到食物，才会上浮到水面。
author: .jerden
source: It sleeps on the seabed, a thick layer of fat insulating it against the cold. POKENAME always wakes up hungry, and only comes up to the surface if it can't find food in the ocean depths.

entry: POKENAME常沿街找吃的，宁寻送货卡车，也不愿去森林觅食。司机不在旁边，就掀翻食品货车，吃掉多数存货，再径直走开。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME usually roam the streets to find their food, preferring to search for delivery trucks rather than forage in the forest. They tip over food trucks whenever the drivers aren't nearby, eating most their supply before simply walking off.

entry: POKENAME爱玩办公室扫描仪，大块头却常使系统过载。许多都害人花大钱，更换重要办公设备。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy playing with office scanners but often overload the system with their large bulk. Many POKENAME have led to expensive replacements of essential office equipment.

entry: POKENAME睡时，腹部准确显示梦境，靠大量食物供能。小宝可梦常围在身旁，它却不知，奇妙画面已令它们惊叹。
author: npshi
source: When POKENAME sleep, their stomachs display an accurate representation of their dreams, powered by the massive amount of food they consume. POKENAME are often surrounded by smaller Pokémon, unknowingly amazing them with these visual spectacles.

entry: POKENAME以鹿角的精神波，探知附近食物，不停进食。有时，嚼着嚼着便睡着，自己都没察觉。
author: .izik
source: Using its antlers' psychic waves to detect nearby food, POKENAME grazes endlessly. It sometimes falls asleep mid-chew without realizing it.

entry: POKENAME爱炫耀，尤其擅长展示力量与平衡，马戏团里颇为常见。睡着后，却几乎叫不醒。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME loves to show off. It is particularly adept in feats of strength and balance, making it a somewhat common sight at circuses. When it sleeps, it is nigh-impossible to wake up.

entry: POKENAME极其嗜睡，两餐之间能睡数月。饿时胃口惊人，一整天都吞吃路上遇到的一切。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are extremely lethargic and will spend months sleeping between meals. Their appetite is tremendous when they're hungry, gorging themselves for an entire day on anything that crosses their path.

entry: POKENAME的奶浓郁又高脂，喝下几秒，就会让人睡着。
author: kittyluv090
source: The milk that POKENAME produces is very rich and fatty, causing anyone who drinks it to fall asleep within a matter of seconds.

entry: 无论环境如何，POKENAME袋里的水果，最长能保鲜一年。若未经同意拿走，就会迅速腐烂，完全不能吃。
author: staghorn
source: The fruit that POKENAME carries in its pouch can stay fresh for up to a year, regardless of its environmental conditions. If the fruit is taken without the POKENAME's consent, the fruit rapidly rots and becomes completely inedible.

entry: POKENAME每天睡二十小时以上，在山口、山谷懒躺。它们从不在同处睡第二次，会在短暂清醒时，走上数英里，找新休息处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend upwards of twenty hours per day sleeping, lazing in mountain passes and valleys. They never sleep in the same place twice and will travel for miles during their few waking hours in search of a new resting place.

entry: POKENAME打落树果，存进飘扬鬃毛。它一路打哈欠、打鼾，多得让人相信，它其实在梦中奔跑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME knocks down berries from trees and stores them in its flowing mane. It yawns and snores so much while traveling the land that some believe it's running around in its sleep.

entry: POKENAME一天近24小时只顾睡觉，为进化作准备。清醒时，通常都用来吃找到的一切可食物。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME spends nearly 24 hours a day doing nothing but sleeping in preparation for evolution. The time it does spend awake is usually devoted to consuming anything edible it can find.

entry: POKENAME操纵时间，把一把树果吃得几乎不剩，再倒转树果的时间，使其长回，得以反复进食。
author: sk372
source: Using its control over time, POKENAME eats up a handful of berries almost completely, then reverses the berries' time, regenerating them and letting it eat them over and over again.

entry: POKENAME以欺负其他宝可梦闻名。它们用大而强劲的尾巴威吓，抢走对方树果。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are well-known bullies towards other Pokémon. They use the strength and size of their tails to intimidate and steal others berries.

entry: POKENAME用神奇力量收集树果与植物，或吃掉，或混成调剂物。古老故事说，它们曾是药剂师与厨师的常见助手。
author: infinex21
source: Using mystical powers, POKENAME gather berries and plants that they may either eat or mix together into concoctions. Tales from the past speak of these Pokémon serving as common assistants to apothecaries and chefs.

entry: POKENAME每天睡20小时以上，除食物外，什么都不愿为之移动。只有雷雨才真正活跃，被风暴唤醒，寻找同类。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend upward of 20 hours per day sleeping and are reluctant to move for anything other than food. They are only truly active during thunderstorms, being roused and searching for other POKENAME during the storm.

entry: POKENAME几小时就能吃光整片树果园。吃完两整片林园，便会沉睡一周。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can devour entire berry orchards in hours. After consuming two full groves, it enters a week-long slumber.

entry: POKENAME游历海洋，收集树果与小鱼，带往秘密储藏处。存够自身两倍体重的食物，就大吃一顿，安然打盹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME travels the seas, gathering up berries and small fish to take to secret hoarding spots. Once it's amassed a stash twice its weight, it gorges itself before settling down for a nice nap.

entry: POKENAME用强磁场，将整座城镇金属容器中的食物，搜刮一空。野外罕见，一发现，宝可梦巡护员就会迁到钢属性宝可梦密集的地方。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME uses its powerful magnetic field to drain entire towns of food kept in any metal objects. It is a rare occurrence in the wild, and when one is discovered, Pokémon Rangers relocate it to an area with a high density of Steel-types.

entry: 哪怕睡着，POKENAME也会舔任何靠近的东西。研究发现，它梦见的全是食物。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME licks anything that comes close to it, even when asleep. Studies have found that it dreams exclusively about food.

entry: 它的手臂部分中空，连着掌孔，用来储存硬坚果，供吃，或战斗时射出。长久使用钻角似乎会耗尽体力，须休息或吃饱。
author: infinex21
source: Its arms are partly hollow and connected to the holes in its palms, which it will store hard nuts inside of to either eat or shoot out in battle. Using its drill horn for prolonged times seems to exhaust it until it either rests or stuffs itself.

entry: POKENAME睡在洒满阳光的林间空地，藤蔓却自己活动，默默收集树果与根，在梦中喂它。
author: .izik
source: While POKENAME sleeps in sunlit glades, its vines move on their own. They gather berries and roots silently, feeding POKENAME as it dreams.

entry: POKENAME用藤蔓，将水果与树果榨成汁，再以双手作碗，确保不洒。它们能睡得藤蔓长到极长，自己看起来都像灌丛。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME use their vines to squeeze fruits and berries into juices, using their hands as bowls to make sure none of it spills. They can sleep long enough for their vines to grow incredibly long, making them appear as shrubbery.

entry: POKENAME用电线，从内到外煎熟水果。不过，有时电压太高，反把饭点着了。
author: bigoljax
source: Using their cords, POKENAME can fry fruits from the inside out. However, sometimes they use too much voltage and can cause their meals to burst in flames.

entry: POKENAME的叶常制成熏香，帮助人放松入睡。野外，它懒洋洋地晒着太阳，一晒数小时。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's leaves are often used in incense that helps people unwind and fall asleep. In the wild, POKENAME lazes about while basking in the sun for hours on end.

entry: POKENAME尾巴始终夹着宝可梦之笛，需要时，让自己保持清醒。谁想拿走，它就挥尾打，再用獠牙咬住。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME always carries a Poké Flute in its tail for when it needs to keep itself awake. If anyone tries to take this flute from it, it will smack them with its tail and sink its fangs into them.

entry: POKENAME适应恶劣环境，耐心等候，从上方伏击猎物。一吃完，就进入深眠，消化这一餐。
author: .jerden
source: Thriving in harsh environments, POKENAME waits patiently until it can ambush prey from above. As soon as it has eaten, it falls into a deep sleep to digest the meal.

entry: POKENAME阴森地吹着巨型宝可梦之笛，留意将近的猎物。笛声让它不至打盹，得以看准猎物，俯冲攻击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME ominously plays its giant Poké Flute as it keeps watch over oncoming prey. This prevents it from dozing off long enough to spot prey and swoop down to attack them.

entry: POKENAME以温柔闻名，常让孩子爬在身上玩。坚实獠牙，则用来撞倒树果树。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are known for its gentle nature, often allowing children to climb atop its body and play. Its sturdy tusks are used to knock down berry trees.

entry: POKENAME整日吃、睡，用獠牙给自己清路，常也顺便帮到别人。打盹受打扰，就会暴怒，猛烈踏地。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME spends its time eating and sleeping, using its tusks to clear paths for itself, though these paths often help others as well. If disturbed during a nap, it rages and stomps about fiercely.

entry: POKENAME不大吃水果与树果，而以恶意软件、病毒为食。它们能进入训练家的设备，吃掉可能威胁图鉴数据的东西。
author: bigoljax
source: Instead of feasting on fruits and berries, POKENAME feed off malware and viruses. They can go into Trainers' devices and eat possible threats to their Pokédex data.

entry: POKENAME爱热，感到暖烘烘就睡。体内有火，让它一天大多熟睡，只有饿得不舒服才醒。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME loves the heat and falls asleep when it feels toasty warm. Due to its internal fire, this Pokémon falls asleep for most of the day, only waking up when it gets uncomfortable from hunger.

entry: POKENAME天生懒，大多在洞旁晒太阳。休息受打扰，背刺就竖起防御，利爪同时抽向前方靠近的一切。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME is lazy by nature and spends much of its time basking in the sun near its burrow. If disturbed while resting, the quills on its back rise in defense while its sharp claws lash out at anything approaching from the front.

entry: POKENAME虽大又懒，却极其强壮。常能看见它们，向大树投掷巨石，打落高处水果。
author: bigoljax
source: Despite their large size and lazy demeanors, POKENAME are incredibly strong. They're regularly seen chucking large boulders at massive trees to knock down high fruits.

entry: POKENAME身材虽纤细，胃口却不输普通卡比兽。大吃的巨餐，唯有训练家，才获准分享一点。
author: sk372
source: Despite having a slender figure, POKENAME's appetite is as strong as any normal Snorlax. The only one it will ever allow to share a little of the huge meals it gorges on is its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME几乎不可能吃饱。飞得虽慢，一夜也能吃毁整片果园。
author: .izik
source: It is nearly impossible for POKENAME to get full. Despite its slow flight speed, it can decimate entire orchards overnight.

entry: POKENAME体色完全取决于最后吃的东西，吃别样前，只能变成那一种色。为应对这点，它只吃色调与环境相合的树果。
author: bigoljax
source: The color of POKENAME's body fully depends on the last thing it has eaten, only able to shift into that specific color until it eats something different. To counteract this, it'll only eat berries with shades matching the environment around it.

entry: POKENAME只有一个小脑，不聪明，却凭强健身体照样生存。脑还能降低某些区域的活动，保存大量能量。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has a single small brain and lacks intelligence, but its hardy body allows it to persist anyways. The brain also has the ability to lower its activity in certain regions to preserve massive amounts of energy.

entry: 它们寄居的古老宝可梦之笛，一吹响，POKENAME便醒。吹笛者随后却会睡去，恰好108分钟。
author: bigoljax
source: Whenever the ancient Poké Flutes they reside in are played, POKENAME will awaken. Those who play the flute will then go into a slumber that lasts exactly 108 minutes.

entry: 醒着的POKENAME，十分难见。凡是费力的事，都不如一场长觉来得好，可睡醒发起脾气，却相当可怕。
author: rooboid
source: To see POKENAME awake is a rarity, as they will always favor a long nap over anything that requires any effort. Their post-nap tantrums can be brutal.

entry: POKENAME住在热带，平常吃香蕉与椰子。若无法解饿，就会在当地村落暴走，抢走粮食。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME live in tropical regions, their usual diet consisting of bananas and coconuts. If unable to soothe their hunger, they rampage through local villages, stealing their food supplies.

entry: POKENAME用背花释放的平静香气，连续睡上数天。研究者常循压倒植物的痕迹，以及沿途野外熟睡的宝可梦，追踪它。
author: jaminmcready
source: The flower on its back emits a calming scent that POKENAME uses to stay asleep for days. Researchers often track POKENAME by the trails of crushed vegetation and wild sleeping Pokémon it leaves behind.

entry: POKENAME头上的刺，是牢靠的防护。可头槌通常只打得出几记，就又开始犯困。
author: gp423
source: The spikes on its head provide POKENAME a solid defense mechanism. However, it can usually only muster a few headbutts before it gets sleepy.

entry: POKENAME看似软塌，隆起眉部的质地，却如硬合成橡胶，能让打击与弹丸，以来袭时相同的力量反弹。
author: banquoviaquo
source: Despite its blobby appearance, the lumpy brow of a POKENAME has a texture like hard synthetic rubber, causing blows and projectiles to bounce from it with the same force they impacted it.

entry: POKENAME头冠顶有凹处，存树果当日后零食。可它常塞过满，得善心训练家或宝可梦帮忙，才拿得出来。
author: banquoviaquo
source: There's a hollow at the top of POKENAME's crown where it keeps berries for future snacking.  However, they tend to overstuff it, requiring a kind Trainer or Pokémon's help to get the berries loose.

entry: POKENAME整天懒散地躺着，似乎毫不在意周围发生的事。虽懒，却也是攀爬高手，常爬上巨树，只为采集水果和树果。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME lazes around all day, not seeming to care about whatever is currently going on around it. Though it is lazy, it is also known to be an excellent climber, often seen climbing massive trees just to gather fruits and berries.

entry: POKENAME看似懒惰，却受家人尊敬。孩子遇险时，它会展现组成自身的宝可梦，都达不到的凶猛程度。
author: miecreates
source: POKENAME appears lazy but is respected by its family. When its children are endangered, it displays levels of aggression never reached by its components.

entry: POKENAME只会醒来，懒洋洋地吃掉周围东西。睡着时，身体完全没有实体。
author: bacondlx
source: POKENAME only wakes up to lazily eat its surrounding area. While asleep, it remains completely intangible.

entry: 据说亡者前往来世前，POKENAME会载其去不知名之处，共享最后的盛宴。吃完一切后，再引往永恒的归宿。
author: beatdoof
source: It is said that before one departs to the afterlife, POKENAME will carry the deceased to an unknown place where they will share their final feast. POKENAME will then guide them to their eternal home after they've eaten everything.

entry: 据说，亡者前往来世前，POKENAME会载到未知之地，共享最后盛宴。吃尽后，再引领前往永恒归宿。
author: beatdoof
source: It is said that before one departs to the afterlife, POKENAME will carry the deceased to an unknown place where they will share their final feast. POKENAME  will then guide them to their eternal home after they've eaten everything.

entry: POKENAME身体虽大，游得慢，动作也悄然无声。平常吃毒刺水母与暴鲤龙。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are silent swimmers despite their size due to how slowly they swim. Their usual diet consists of Tentacruel and Gyarados.

entry: POKENAME颇懒，常张着大嘴，等宝可梦自己游入。它爱刺甲贝、泥泥鳅这类食物，却不会特别去追。潜水约2小时，才须上浮换气。
author: yaboydecky1234
source: POKENAME is rather lazy, often leaving its gaping mouth open for Pokémon to swim in. It's fond of Pokémon like Cloysters or Barboach, but won't make any special moves to go after them. It can hold its breath for around 2 hours before going back up.

entry: 据说POKENAME每次睡觉，梦就会成为新宇宙。有些古文明甚至相信，我们的宇宙也由此诞生，便供奉丰盛收成，博取喜爱。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: It is said that every time POKENAME sleeps, their dreams become new universes. Some ancient civilizations even believed that our own universe was created this way, and fed POKENAME plentiful harvests to earn their favor.

entry: POKENAME树上长的果，滋味浓、汁水多，却极易长胖。短时间只吃几颗，体重就可能增加多达20磅。
author: sk372
source: The fruit that grows upon POKENAME's tree is quite flavorful and juicy, but also incredibly fattening. Eating only a few in a short time could lead to a weight increase of up to 20 pounds.

entry: 体形与速度，让POKENAME很能战斗。不过，它们似乎易患某种发作性睡病，打着打着，就突然睡去。
author: bigoljax
source: Due to both their size and speed, POKENAME are incredible at combat. However, they seem prone to a type of narcolepsy, suddenly falling asleep during fights.

entry: POKENAME是暴君，逼其他宝可梦收集食物。它们又大又强，常让人无法推翻。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are tyrants, forcing other Pokémon to collect their food for them. They're often unable to be overthrown due to their size and strength.

entry: POKENAME颇为高傲，只吃最新鲜的树果。若吃到特别美味的，胡子就会转起来。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are quite snobbish and will only eat the freshest berries. If they consume a particularly tasty berry, their mustache will spin around.

entry: POKENAME若肯战斗，出招也漫不经心、粗疏凌乱。不过，锯齿刀刃打击凶狠，只需命中一次就够。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: POKENAME's attacks, if it bothers to fight at all, are careless and sloppy. One successful hit is all it needs, though, as its zigzagging blade delivers a nasty blow.

entry: POKENAME挥刃攻击后，双剑突然困倦，随即睡着。它把食物收进鞘中，之后通过不明的神秘过程，吃掉。
author: soup1900
source: After POKENAME attacks an enemy with its blades, both swords suddenly become very drowsy and promptly fall asleep. It gathers food inside its sheath, consuming it afterwards through mysterious and unknown processes.

entry: POKENAME飘过森林，切树果吃。吃空一片森林，就以盾牌姿态睡觉；游荡找食时，则呈刀剑姿态。觅食时，别挡它的路。
author: silverquaza365
source: POKENAME floats through forests, cutting up berries to eat. When it's finished clearing out a forest, it sleeps in its shield stance. When roaming for food it's in its sword stance. Do not get in its way when it's searching for food.

entry: POKENAME能看见物体后藏着的任何可食物，零食很难瞒住。训练家须费心，让鬃毛不沾食物碎屑。
author: nelluc27
source: POKENAME is able to spot anything edible behind objects, making it hard to hide snacks from it. Trainers must work to help keep its mane clean of food debris.

entry: POKENAME住在深洞，因此罕见。只有胃口大到无法忍耐，才会出现在地面。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are rarely spotted due to them living in deep caves. The only times they're seen above ground is when their appetites become too big to ignore.

entry: POKENAME拍翼声轻柔舒缓，偶尔连自己都哄睡。坠地通常会醒，但久而久之，多数会学着睡过冲击，或边打盹边悬浮。
author: .jerden
source: The sound of its wingbeats is so soft and soothing that POKENAME occasionally puts itself to sleep. Crashing to the ground usually wakes it up, although over time most POKENAME learn to either sleep through the impact or hover while dozing.

entry: POKENAME饿得越厉害，味觉就越不敏感。足够饱时，它常踏上缓慢却收获颇丰的长旅，到地表寻找树果。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME's taste sensitivity is inversely proportional to how hungry it is. When they're full enough, they often get into a slow but rewarding odyssey to get berries from the surface.

entry: POKENAME饿得越厉害，味觉就越不敏感。足够饱时，它常踏上缓慢却收获颇丰的长旅，到地表寻找树果。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME's taste sensitivity is inversely proportional to how hungry it is. When they're full enough, they often get into a slow but rewarding odyssey to get berries from the surface.

entry: 始终绕着POKENAME的圆环，是无限食源。但因会隐隐作痛，它只有必要时才下口。设法吃过圆环的人说，味道近似油腻快餐。
author: bigoljax
source: The ring that always orbits around POKENAME works as an infinite food source, but only bites it in times of need due to its having faint pain receptors. Those who have somehow eaten the ring describe the taste as being similar to greasy fast food.

entry: POKENAME想独处时，会变成强大宝可梦，赶走别人，留出所需空间。垫子若坏了，它便潜入商店，偷走看着舒适的靠垫等物。
author: bigoljax
source: When it needs time to itself, POKENAME will disguise into stronger Pokémon, driving others away and giving it the space it needs. When the cushion it uses is damaged, it'll sneak into stores, stealing any cozy-looking cushions and other comforts.

entry: 性情温顺又讨喜，让这只宝可梦常被带到养老院。一天里，能有20个小时，都在睡觉。
author: melodydelune
source: This Pokémon is often brought to retirement homes due to its docile and sweet nature. They spend up to 20 hours a day sleeping.

entry: POKENAME常突然大闹，脾气凶得很。可这样太耗能，余下一整天，就只顾睡觉。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME often go on violent temper tantrums. These take up a lot of energy, however, and it spends the rest of the day sleeping.

entry: POKENAME能造小岛休息，在烈日下睡觉。因此，航运路线只好改道绕行。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME have the ability to create small islands to rest on, sleeping under the hot sun. This causes shipping routes to be forced to re-route around it.

entry: POKENAME觅食囤果，睡前与醒来都吃，次日再重复。若休息受扰，它便朝最近的人或宝可梦，射出强大破坏光线。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME forages and hoards berries to eat before it sleeps and when it wakes up, then repeats the cycle the next day. It will release a powerful Hyper Beam at the nearest person or Pokémon if it is disturbed from its rest.

entry: 它能在臭氧层高处长途飞行，却大多待在地上吃、睡。POKENAME性情温和，常调解其他宝可梦的争端。
author: t3isukone
source: It is capable of long flights high above the ozone layer, but spends much of its time on the ground eating and sleeping. POKENAME is known for its mellow personality, and often mediates in disputes between other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME能减慢自己对时间的感知。除了帮助睡得更久，这能力没有实际用处。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME have the ability to slow down their perception of time. This ability has no actual use except for helping them sleep longer.

entry: POKENAME只消一甩尾，就能烧毁整座城市。但性子懒，只拿火加热食物。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME have the ability to burn down entire cities with just a flick of their tail. However, due to their slothful nature, they merely use their fire to heat up food.

entry: POKENAME聚在高楼与山丘，躺在星空下，交换喜欢的食物。若白天有人见它赶路，目的地不久就会有壮丽天象。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME gather on tall buildings and hills to exchange favorite foods while laying beneath the stars. If they are witnessed traveling during daylight, there will be a gorgeous astronomical event soon at their destination.

entry: 开花的手臂散出浓郁薰衣草香，让POKENAME始终清醒却镇静。任何想捕食的对象，也都会被香气催入安稳睡眠。
author: xillo
source: The flowering arms emit a thick lavender scent that leaves POKENAME in a constant state of conscious sedation. This scent forces any would-be predators to descend into peaceful slumber.

entry: POKENAME极少醒，任气流带着漂。传闻腹中灵魂，使它浮起。每打一次鼾，就有一个魂前往来世，让它稍稍降向地面。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME is rarely awake, and drifts about at the mercy of air currents. Its belly is rumored to be filled with spirits that keep it afloat. Each time it snores, one escapes into the afterlife, causing it to descend slightly back towards the ground.

entry: POKENAME很快与训练家亲近，睡觉时常想拉来拥抱。耳朵温暖柔软，被裹住的对象，通常也会困倦。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME bond quickly with their Trainers, often wanting to pull them into a hug when they go to sleep. POKENAME's ears are warm and soft, usually leading to drowsiness for those who are wrapped around by them.

entry: POKENAME吃的腐败食物，也会转成孢子。用在其他宝可梦身上，会让对方突然消化不良、胃痛。
author: soup1900
source: Rotten or foul food that POKENAME eats is also converted to make its spores. When these spores are used on other Pokémon, it causes them to suddenly have indigestion and stomachaches.

entry: POKENAME饿得不行，就改吃自己的孢子。虽能解饿，吃完却会立刻睡着。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME is desperately hungry, it resorts to eating its own spores. While this does help satiate it, the spores cause it to immediately fall asleep afterwards.

entry: POKENAME接管冰箱、烤箱等厨房电器，尽量藏久些，吃掉放进其中的食物，为自己供能。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will take control of various kitchen appliances such as refrigerators and ovens. They will remain hidden for as long as they can, consuming the food placed inside them to fuel themselves.

entry: POKENAME的智慧与胃口同样大。它们用精神力量，从餐厅与小饭馆悄悄偷食。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's intelligence is just as large as their appetites. They use their psychic abilities to sneakily steal food from restaurants and diners.

entry: POKENAME整夜收集食物，一边吃，一边看月亮走过天空。一察觉日出，就会倒下，进入深沉安稳的睡眠。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME spends the night gathering food and eating while watching the moon cross the sky. As soon as sunrise is noticed, it passes out into a deep, peaceful slumber.

entry: POKENAME的绒毛不停生长，得定期修剪。剪下的毛，常被用来制作厚实的冬衣。
author: kitarchen
source: Due to their fluff constantly growing, POKENAME are regularly shaved. The fur is often used in the creation of thick winter coats.

entry: POKENAME白天通常吃吃懒躺，夜里却成了有名的窃贼。体形虽大，可能有些麻烦，它仍能轻易偷走整间杂货店的食物。
author: bigoljax
source: Though POKENAME normally eat and laze around during the day, they turn into notorious thieves once night comes. Even if their large size could cause some trouble, POKENAME can easily sneak out with an entire grocery store's worth of food.

entry: POKENAME四处搜食，用带电的网，拖着身后越来越多的收获。累了，就倒在食堆上，慢慢吃。吃光后，再换新领地，重新开始。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME scrounges for food, dragging the ever-expanding haul behind it in its electrified web. When it tires out, it collapses atop the pile and slowly begins eating. Once it runs out of food, it begins the cycle again in a new territory.

entry: POKENAME虽只需休息就能恢复能量，仍总在中空腹中囤满树果。这些存粮，是分给需要食物的对象的。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME always gather hoards of berries in their hollow bellies, though they need only to rest to recover their energy. Their berry stashes are for sharing with others in need of food.

entry: POKENAME通常很懒，比起战斗，更关心食物。可一旦什么挡着吃饭，它就会毫不犹豫，用强力暗影拳猛揍。
author: uroogisleee_46788
source: POKENAME are typically lazy and tend to care more for food than battle. However, if something gets in the way of their feasting, they will not hesitate to pummel whatever stands in their way with powerful shadow punches.

entry: 城镇附近，常能发现打盹的POKENAME。唯有路人带着好吃的，它才肯醒。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME is often found napping around towns. It only wakes up if a passer-by has a tasty treat to eat.

entry: POKENAME收集食物，方便想吃就吃。旅行训练家常让它带背包装不下的余粮，也带上宝可梦之笛，需要帮忙时，就能叫醒。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME collects food so that it can eat whenever it feels like it. Traveling Trainers often use them to carry excess food that won't fit in their bag. They also have it carry a Poké Flute so that they can wake it whenever they need its assistance.

entry: POKENAME伪装破损，很少立即修补。它会先大吃一餐，再睡个长觉，修补的事往后拖。
author: .jerden
source: If the disguise POKENAME wears is damaged, it will rarely repair it right away. It will instead eat a big meal, then put off the repairs until after a long nap.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀其实是大掌，把它按在地上。它对此十分满足，但若够不着食物，就会闹起来。
author: miecreates
source: POKENAME's wings are actually big paws that pin it to the ground. It is perfectly content in this position, but becomes rowdy if no food is in reach.

entry: POKENAME用多余的头，加快填饱肚子。它们偶尔骚扰农场，抢走大葫芦与瓜。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME use their extra heads as a way to sate their appetite more quickly. They occasionally terrorize farms to seize large gourds and melons.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，更多只是漫无目的地随风漂。即使悄悄偷人类食物，也始终仰躺着浮。
author: miecreates
source: POKENAME doesn't so much as fly as it does drift aimlessly along the wind. Even when sneakily stealing food from humans, it remains floating on its back.

entry: POKENAME太重，飞得不舒服，便改在地上拖着走。不过，只要有足够动力，它仍能做出惊人杂技动作。
author: miecreates
source: Too heavy to comfortably fly, POKENAME drags itself across the ground instead. Despite this, it can manage incredible acrobatics if properly motivated.

entry: POKENAME每月究竟睡多久，目前不明。一醒，它就用火烤新鲜树果，再蜷上柔软舒适得不可思议的尾巴，继续睡。
author: ghostslythe
