source: It is currently unknown how long POKENAME naps over each month. When it awakens, it immediately uses its flames to cook fresh berries before curling up on impossibly soft and comfortable tails to sleep once more.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴的迷人力量，定位食物来源。决定睡觉时，就用尾巴裹成茧，防御一切打扰。
author: wickedwiccan
source: POKENAME uses the enchanting power within its tails to locate sources of food. When it decides to sleep, POKENAME uses its tails as a cocoon to protect from any disturbances.

entry: POKENAME虽能使自身变异，却更愿为节能，让身体尽可能简单。它大多懒躺，用精神力量抓食物。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite being able to mutate its own body, POKENAME prefers to keep its body as simple as possible to conserve energy. It mostly just lazes around, using its psychic powers to grab food.

entry: 每当有人许下树果相关心愿，POKENAME的树果就会改变。若愿望涉及它最爱的树果，它就跟随一周，盼对方再许一次。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME's berries change every time a person makes a berry-related wish. If the wish relates to POKENAME's favorite berry, POKENAME follows them around for a week hoping for the wish to be made again.

entry: 据说POKENAME每1000年，只醒七天，用力量实现任何心愿。可要许愿成功很难，因为清醒一周，它通常只盼自己再睡回去。
author: footlongdingledong
source: POKENAME is said to wake up for just seven days every 1,000 years and use its power to grant any wish. However, getting said wishes granted is difficult, since it tends to spend its week awake just wishing it were back asleep.

entry: 秋尽，POKENAME就找巢冬眠。它堵住向外的隧道，让里面保暖至春，因此原住者也会容忍。
author: quackquackattack
source: When autumn ends, POKENAME finds a nest to hibernate in. It is tolerated by the original residents because it blocks off tunnels leading out from the nest, which helps keep warmth inside until spring.

entry: POKENAME安睡时，身体慢慢鼓起、缩下。它总睡得太香，让其他宝可梦忍不住加入。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's body slowly inflates and deflates as it peacefully sleeps. It always appears to be sleeping so well that other Pokémon can't help but join.

entry: 数英里外，也能听见POKENAME的鼾声。挖出的金属或宝石，无论哪种，它都吃。
author: soup1900
source: The sound of POKENAME's snores can be heard from miles away. It will eat any kind of metal or precious stone that it digs up.

entry: POKENAME食欲惊人，每天要吃下体重三倍的食物。可它懒得费力狩猎，便挖个地坑，张开碎骨巨颚，等猎物掉入。
author: slavman9057
source: POKENAME's appetite is immense, requiring it to eat triple its body weight daily. However, it is too lazy to expend the energy to hunt, leading it to simply dig a pit into the ground, where it waits for prey to fall into its open, bone-crushing jaws.

entry: POKENAME头骨因反复冲击，变得极其坚固。冲击多半来自它站着睡，梦中一头栽地的习惯。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's skull is extremely sturdy due to repeated impacts. Said impacts are mostly caused by its tendency to fall asleep while standing, and then tumbling head-first to the ground in its slumber.

entry: POKENAME只吃植物，又长久睡眠，日常通常如此。树上长的树果，总比普通的更大，也往往更有营养。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME feed only on vegetation and sleep for long periods of time, as is their typical daily schedule. The berries that grow from their trees are always larger than average berries and tend to be richer in nutrients as well.

entry: POKENAME看似慢，体内却储满能量，惊醒就能放出爆炸性的火星。据说不受打扰睡得越久，尾焰就越热。
author: jaminmcready
source: Though POKENAME looks slow, its body is packed with stored energy, and can unleash an explosive ember if startled awake. The flame on its tail is said to grow hotter the longer POKENAME sleeps without interruption.

entry: POKENAME一天最多睡21小时。醒来，就绕圈跳，直到累坏，再睡。
author: honestly_vitali
source: POKENAME can sleep up to 21 hours a day. When it wakes up, it hops in circles until it's exhausted, then sleeps again.

entry: POKENAME飘向正在吃午饭的人，以心灵感应讨点喝的。若遭拒，它们仍会用吸管偷走饮料。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME float towards people having lunch and will use their telepathy to ask for something to drink. If the person rejects POKENAME, they will use their straw to steal the drink anyway.

entry: POKENAME一生不停寻找虫属性宝可梦吃。胃口大，方向感又差，使嘴里往往满是泥土。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME spends its life in constant search of Bug-type Pokémon to consume. Its voracious appetite, combined with a poor sense of direction, leaves its mouth filled with dirt more often than not.

entry: 这只宝可梦通常守卫古遗迹，却更多时候都在偷睡。即便如此，许多闯入者怕叫醒它，也不敢进入领地。
author: zweizweihander
source: This Pokémon is usually found guarding ancient ruins, though more often than not, it is found sleeping on the job. But even then, many trespassers are too afraid of waking it up to intrude on its territory.

entry: POKENAME双翼巨大，却毫无飞行兴趣，宁愿懒洋洋地摇摆、踉跄着走。遇险，它张开洞般的大嘴，打出巨响哈欠，让附近一切晕头转向。
author: jaminmcready
source: Despite its massive wings, POKENAME shows no interest in flight, choosing instead to waddle and lurch with lazy purpose. When threatened, it opens its cavernous mouth and lets out a yawn so loud it disorients anything nearby.

entry: POKENAME通常天生懒，常侧躺着睡上整周。可战斗时，打击却很猛烈，常从背后重创敌人。
author: sondededoo
source: POKENAME are usually lazy by nature, often spending entire weeks sleeping sideways. During battle, however, they can deliver intense blows, often striking foes from behind for massive damage.

entry: POKENAME是圆胖小家伙，爱吃宝石。看着特别可口的，就存进肚脐，留待无人看时享受。
author: bukie
source: POKENAME is a portly little creature with an appetite for gems. It saves particularly tasty looking jewels in its navel for later, to enjoy when no one is watching.

entry: POKENAME奔跑着搜刮想吃的一切，边跑边吞，能扫空整片地区的食物。吃够了，就紧裹未吃完的存粮，在甲片保护下睡去。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME can decimate regions of food as it gallops about, scooping up all it wants to eat, and devouring as it runs. Once it has eaten its fill, it curls up tightly around any leftovers not yet consumed and sleeps, protected by its armored plates.

entry: POKENAME每月猎一次，大吃树果与肉，再花往后几周消化。吃饱就很温顺，甚至乐意让孩子在身上玩，自己则睡着消化巨餐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hunts once a month, gorging itself on berries and meat that will digest over the following weeks. Once full, it is quite docile, even happily allowing children to play on it while it sleeps off its massive meal.

entry: POKENAME以流畅优雅的舞步移动，摇摆时不顾周遭。观看者会极其困倦，它每次登台，都能让整群观众沉睡。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME moves in a flowing, elegant dance, not paying attention to anything around it as it sways. Those who watch it start to feel incredibly drowsy, causing entire crowds to fall dead asleep whenever it performs on stage.

entry: POKENAME平常虽吃垃圾与腐败食物，毛却有明显的树果甜点香。胃口大，让它们成为很实用的清洁队。
author: bigoljax
source: Despite their usual diet of garbage and rotten food, POKENAME's fur has a distinct smell of berries and sweets. They're very useful as cleanup crews due to their large appetites.

entry: 发现后五十多年，人们始终以为POKENAME永久扎根地面。它能移动的发现，却引起短暂哲学争论：植物能算懒吗？
author: dylonk25
source: For over fifty years after its discovery, POKENAME was thought to be permanently rooted to the ground. The revelation that it could move led to a brief philosophical debate on whether a plant could be considered lazy.

entry: POKENAME每天睡22小时，只为吃才醒。体重让它不太能飞，爬行却很熟练。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME sleeps for 22 hours a day, waking up only to eat. It can't fly very well due to its weight, but it's proficient at crawling.

entry: POKENAME坐着松软小云漂过，几乎一直熟睡，鼾声却甜美成调。医生会带它进儿童医院，让小病人舒服入睡。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME floats by on its plush little cloud, snoring a sweet tune in its near constant slumber. Doctors bring them into children's hospitals to help young patients sleep comfortably.

entry: POKENAME能造蜂蜜状物质，通常嚼碎某些树果，再吐出果泥。寒冷地区蜂蜜稀少，这物质便被视为珍馐。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME have the ability to create a honey-like substance, usually by chewing up certain berries and spitting the mush out. This substance is considered a delicacy in colder regions due to honey being scarce.

entry: POKENAME以肆虐废料场闻名，找到什么金属，都狼吞虎咽。猛吃让它们饱得昏睡，通常得用废料起重机吊出去。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are infamous for terrorizing scrapyards, scarfing down any type of metal they can find. They usually need to be carried out by scrap cranes, due to their intense eating habits making them go into food comas.

entry: POKENAME通常温顺，乐意让孩子陪玩。不过，家长应始终带些食物供上，确保它不饿过头。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME is generally a docile Pokémon, so it happily allows children to play with it. However, parents should always bring an offering of food to make sure it doesn't grow too hungry.

entry: POKENAME胃口虽大，却很慷慨。它们常把不需的成堆食物，倒进宝可梦众多的森林，让下方好好吃顿大餐。
author: bigoljax
source: Despite their appetite, POKENAME are quite generous. They usually dump the hoards of food they don't need into populated forests, giving the Pokémon down below a nice feast.

entry: POKENAME吃饭时，用腿夹住食物。体形太小，让它们一天最多只能吃一颗水果。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME use their legs to hold onto food while they eat. Due to their small size, they're unable to eat more than one fruit a day.

entry: POKENAME睡着也在林中游荡，常醒在大片树果草地或树林，却不知自己半夜走过。
author: cloudmaker2169
source: POKENAME wanders the woods in its sleep. It will often awaken in large berry meadows or forests, unaware of its midnight wanderings.

entry: POKENAME睡时，会接到背部蘑菇的信号，翻个身。枕头般的马勃便会放出大片白色孢子云，散入空中。
author: wiz0z
source: When POKENAME are sleeping, they receive signals from the mushrooms on their backs to roll over. This causes the spores in the pillow-like puffballs to come out in large white clouds, spreading them through the air.

entry: POKENAME大多在睡，常歇在大冰块上。不过，极光出现时，它们似乎完全清醒，正常活动。
author: bigoljax
source: Spending most of their time sleeping, POKENAME are commonly seen resting on large ice chunks. During auroral displays however, they seem to be completely awake and functioning.

entry: POKENAME常用捣烂树果，互相涂毛，让人看清各自采哪种。有些觅食本领极好，毛上能有好几种标记。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME often paint each others fur with mashed up berries, making it clear which one hunts which berry. Some POKENAME get so good at foraging that there's several marks on their fur.

entry: POKENAME不采树果，反而肆虐糖厂。它们钻进糖堆太多，鼻尖与毛都永久染白。
author: bigoljax
source: Instead of foraging for berries, POKENAME ravage sugar mills. They dig into so much sugar that the tips of their snouts and hair are permanently stained white.

entry: POKENAME只在冬眠般长睡之间，出外大吃时，才飞行。看见它飞的人，会沉睡一周，梦里满是美食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is only seen in flight when it is off to gorge itself between hibernating naps. Those who see it flying fall into week-long slumbers filled with dreams of delicious food.

entry: 由于蘑菇不断吸取能量，POKENAME吃得比普通卡比兽还多。POKENAME以文柚果为食，连蘑菇的外形也逐渐变得像文柚果。
author: darkweavile428
source: Thanks to the mushroom draining its energy, POKENAME eats even more than a regular Snorlax. Because of POKENAME's diet of Sitrus Berries, the mushroom has changed to resemble one.

entry: POKENAME虽大多整天吃，却是肉食者。它们摇尾，用“树果”引诱不知情的猎物。
author: bigoljax
source: While their days are mostly spent eating, POKENAME are carnivores. They rattle their tails, using the 'berries' as lure for unsuspecting prey.

entry: POKENAME吃掉遇见的每根小枝，为体内火供燃料。别看这体形，它一天也能吃下体重数倍的食物。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME consumes every twig it encounters, using the material to fuel its internal fire. Despite its size, it can eat several times its body weight in a single day.

entry: 野外巡行的宝可梦巡护员队，常与野生POKENAME同行，因为它擅长野炊。它以本领为傲，常把做饭弄成精彩表演。
author: turron_turron
source: Roaming bands of Pokémon Rangers are known to travel alongside wild POKENAME due to their talent for in-the-field cooking. POKENAME are proud of their abilities, and often make a spectacle of their work.

entry: 关都节庆的夜晚，能见POKENAME烹调街头小吃，尤其爱做烤串。顾客若不喜欢料理，它就整份吞下，添旺火力，做更多菜。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: On festival nights in Kanto, POKENAME can be found cooking street food, with a preference for kebabs. Should a customer not enjoy their food, POKENAME will devour it whole, fueling their fire to cook even more dishes.

entry: POKENAME用身体撞树，让树果掉到背上。烧烤店常拿它们当临时烤架。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME slam their bodies into trees, knocking down berries so they land on their backs. They're often used in barbeque restaurants as temporary grills.

entry: POKENAME虽能飞，腹部太大太重，飞起来极费劲。因此，它宁愿大多睡在树下，接住落进口中的东西，哪怕不是水果。
author: bigoljax
source: Though it can fly, the size and weight of POKENAME's abdomen make it incredibly hard to do so. Because of this, it would rather sleep most of the time, resting under trees and catching whatever falls into its mouth, even if it is not fruit.

entry: POKENAME每天能吃数百磅甜果。敏锐嗅觉可挑出最熟的，让它成为厨师的实用伙伴。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME can consume several hundred pounds of sweet fruit daily. Its refined sense of smell can pick out the ripest ones, making them useful companions for chefs.

entry: POKENAME厨艺出色，常受餐厅聘用。不过，饭菜太香，也让它们容易偷吃一些。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are excellent cooks, and are usually hired at restaurants. However, they're prone to eat some of their food due to how good it smells.

entry: POKENAME无声漂在大气层之上，于群星间安睡。凡有太空碎屑经过面前，它们就大吃。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are seen silently floating above the atmosphere, peacefully sleeping amongst the stars. They feast on whatever space debris comes into their path.

entry: POKENAME能量储备极大，能长久不吃，尽管更想吞食宇宙尘埃。浮在高空时，它张着嘴，吞掉来自地面与太空的微粒。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's overwhelming reserve of energy allows it to go without eating for long periods of time (even if it prefers to be devouring space dust). As it floats high up in the sky, it leaves its mouth open to devour earthen and spatial particles.

entry: POKENAME强壮得利爪一击，就能把树折成两段。它似乎略有智慧，会把食物串在棍上，用尾焰均匀烤熟。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME is strong enough to break a tree in half with a single strike of its tough claws. It seems to be slightly intelligent, as it will put food onto sticks to evenly roast them with its tail flames.

entry: 一有困意，POKENAME就垂直往下钻，最深50英尺。它只肯在地下深处休息。
author: .izik
source: At the first sign of drowsiness, POKENAME burrows straight down up to 50 ft. It refuses to rest anywhere but deep underground.

entry: 对POKENAME而言，分享食物就是深厚喜爱。谁让出饭给它，就是真朋友；若它肯分享自己的食物，更代表至高尊重、忠诚与爱。
author: sk372
source: Sharing food is a mark of great affection for POKENAME. It considers anyone that gives it their meal a true friend, and should it offer to share its own food, its a sign of utmost respect, loyalty and love.

entry: 许多人避开POKENAME熟睡的洞穴，怕震耳鼾声引发地震。它们大多待在地下，只露三个头。
author: tanglyatol9866
source: Many people avoid caves where POKENAME sleep, fearing the earthquakes caused by their deafening snores. They spend most of their time underground with only their three heads exposed.

entry: POKENAME平日忙着往嘴里塞意面，吃够了，便蜷进床铺，一连睡上好几个小时。
author: gp423
source: When POKENAME isn't participating in its usual routine of stuffing its face with pasta, it curls up in its bed and sleeps for hours upon hours.

entry: POKENAME被认为是世上最懒的宝可梦之一，除吃与睡，几乎什么都不做。训练家若不用大量食物收买，常很难让它参战。
author: chibitales
source: Known as one of the laziest Pokémon in the world, POKENAME does little else other than eat or sleep. Trainers often have trouble getting it to participate in battles unless they bribe it with vast amounts of food.

entry: 大吃找到的任何食物后，POKENAME就会剧烈头痛，立刻睡去，躲避痛苦。它大约半生，都在这种昏睡中度过。
author: theartemis1
source: After gorging itself on whatever food it can find, POKENAME will become plagued by furious headaches and promptly fall asleep to ward off the pain. It will spend roughly half its life in this comatose state.

entry: POKENAME游泳出色，能一边睡，一边踢动鳍肢。这样既避开陆上捕食者，也保持较高代谢。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are superb swimmers that can sleep while kicking their flippers. This adaptation allows them to avoid predators on land while also keeping their metabolism high.

entry: POKENAME缺少好睡眠，几乎总闹脾气。叫醒它是糟糕主意，因为它会猛烈揍你，直到自己累坏。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is almost always grumpy, due to a lack of good sleep. Trying to wake POKENAME is a terrible idea as it will violently pummel you until it exhausts itself.

entry: POKENAME爱趴在训练家身上，像一床暖和又厚重的毯子，表达亲昵，因此，是十分受欢迎的宠物。
author: jordanx27
source: POKENAME love to show affection for their Trainer by laying on them like a warm, heavy blanket. This makes them a very popular pet.

entry: POKENAME虽大、胃口更大，却是好宠物。它们偶尔替厨房看门，通常以残余小份食物作奖励。
author: bigoljax
source: Despite their large size and even larger appetites, POKENAME are great pets. They're occasionally used as guard dogs for kitchens, with scrap portions being their usual rewards.

entry: POKENAME睡时，尾焰熄灭，改放催眠烟雾。多数会因此远离，仍想伏击的对象，却会迎上蛮力与猛烈火焰。
author: infinex21
source: When POKENAME sleeps, the flames on its tail go out and it releases a sleep-inducing smog instead. Though this serves to ward off most others, those who still try to ambush it will be met with its brute strength and intense flames.

entry: 战斗中，POKENAME懒懒地用拳头捶肚子，竟发出低沉、如笛的声音。曲调让对手慢慢睡去，它便能趁敌人醒来前，打出重击。
author: bigoljax
source: When in battle, POKENAME will lazily bash its stomach with its fists, which oddly makes a low, flute-like sound. This tune slowly drives its opponent to sleep, giving it the chance to land a heavy blow before its foe wakes up.

entry: 据说，POKENAME的腰带能束住圆鼓鼓的肚子，让人只看见结实的肌肉。醒着时，它不是在大吃，就是在痛快战斗。
author: infinex21
source: It is said that the belt POKENAME wears helps to contain its rotund belly so only its dense muscles are seen. If it is not sleeping, it is either gorging itself with food or indulging itself with battles.

entry: POKENAME几乎不停用四臂四手，往嘴里塞食物，满足快速代谢。它每拳都足以打凹一块实心金属。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME is almost always shoveling food into its mouth using its four arms and hands, all to sate its rapid metabolism. Each punch it throws has enough force to dent a block of solid metal.

entry: POKENAME嘴里渗着反流出来的毒液。弱小猎物一靠近，便被整个液化、吃下，然后它再悠闲打盹。
author: bobosmith01
source: Regurgitative and poisonous fluid oozes from POKENAME's mouth. It dines on weak prey that gets close, liquefying them whole, and then takes a leisurely nap.

entry: POKENAME困倦地漂过海洋，只为吃才醒。移动时，吸收周围盐与植物材料，为饭菜添味。
author: henry9000
source: POKENAME drifts sleepily through the ocean, only awakening to eat. It absorbs salt and plant matter from its surroundings while it moves and uses them to add flavor to its meals.

entry: 山坡的崎岖岩崖，是POKENAME生活、打盹的地方。它皮肤坚韧，又睡得沉，哪怕睡梦中翻身，一路滚下山坡，也不会被颠醒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives and snoozes among the craggy cliffs of mountainsides. Its tough skin and deep slumber mean that even if it turns in its sleep and rolls all the way down a mountainside, it won't be jostled from its nap.

entry: POKENAME躯干太重，站不起来。不过，它能使出足够力量，像球般滚动。
author: bigoljax
source: Due to their heavy torsos, POKENAME are unable to stand. However, they can use enough strength to roll around like a ball.

entry: 很久以前，POKENAME极受伽勒尔王室喜爱。养着昂贵又强大的宝可梦，却不叫它工作，被视为炫耀财富。
author: periperi_chicken
source: A long time ago, POKENAME were very popular with Galarian royalty. Keeping an expensive, powerful Pokémon without putting it to work was considered a display of one's wealth.

entry: 从前，POKENAME深受伽勒尔王室珍视。拥有强大宝可梦，永不让其工作，是奢华地展示财富与地位。
author: periperi_chicken
source: Long ago, POKENAME were prized by Galarian royalty. Owning a powerful Pokémon that never had to work was considered a lavish display of wealth and status.

entry: 融合后，POKENAME懒得会先吃自己的尾巴，再决定换地方。想让它听从战斗指令，简直是奇迹。
author: lampent12
source: POKENAME has become so lazy after fusion that it will eat its own tail before deciding to move to a new location. Getting POKENAME to listen to a battle command is nothing short of a miracle.

entry: POKENAME为节能，宁愿滚动，也不愿飞。它住在城市，用磁力拉来罐头，尽可能少费劲。
author: pjporwoll
source: To conserve energy, POKENAME prefers to roll for locomotion rather than fly. It inhabits urban areas to magnetically pull tinned foods to it, exerting as little energy as necessary.

entry: POKENAME作为整体，用磁力将商店与住家的金属食物容器，拉到休息处。各成员口味不同，很少争抢该吃哪份。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME works as a unit to magnetically pull metal food containers from stores and homes to its resting place. Each member of the group has different foods it prefers, so there is rarely fighting over who eats what part of its find.

entry: POKENAME用大葱与球果制成笛子，在其他宝可梦面前吹奏，将其催睡，再偷走饭菜。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fashions a flute from a leek and apricorn. It plays the flute in the presence of other Pokémon, lulling them to sleep so it can steal their meals while they slumber.

entry: POKENAME两个头轮流睡，却常双双睡过头，错过大半天。醒来又晚又饿，只好奔走寻找树果与昆虫。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME have two heads that take turns sleeping, but they both oversleep and end up missing most of the day. They often wake up late and starving, and will then run about foraging for berries and insects.

entry: 一个头睡着，另两个就试着警戒。可它们常跟着睡，或忘记及时提醒主头。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: When one head sleeps, the other two try to keep watch for danger. However, they frequently fall asleep or forget to warn the main head in time.

entry: POKENAME大吃冰后，漂上冰山，一气睡五天，不受严寒打扰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats onto icebergs after gorging on frozen water. It sleeps for five days straight, undisturbed by the chill.

entry: 厚脂肪让POKENAME能舒服地睡在冰山，一睡数周。每次醒来，都大吃补脂肪，获得移动所需能量。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can comfortably sleep on icebergs for weeks at a time due to their thick blubber. They gorge themselves immensely whenever they wake up to replenish their blubber and give them the necessary energy to move around.

entry: 多数食物由POKENAME嘴里吃下，猎物却会被半流体身体包住、吸收。它偏爱腐烂发霉食物，因此有些被用来处理垃圾。
author: infinex21
source: Most food is eaten through POKENAME's mouth, though it envelops and subsumes prey with its semi-fluid body. It prefers rotten or moldy food, so some are kept to help with garbage disposal.

entry: POKENAME多数食物从嘴吃，猎物却直接用半流体身体包住、吸收。它奇特地偏爱腐烂、发霉食物，因此常有个体被养来处理垃圾。
author: infinex21
source: Most foods POKENAME eats through its mouth, though any prey it simply envelops with its semi-fluid body and subsumes. It has an odd preference for rotten foods and moldy foods, so some are often kept to help with garbage disposal.

entry: 感到完全安全舒服，它就仰躺睡，头露壳外。POKENAME若在你身旁这么睡，就是完全信任你。
author: bobosmith01
source: It sleeps on its back with its head outside its shell when it feels completely safe and comfortable. If POKENAME sleeps in this manner with you nearby, it trusts you entirely.

entry: POKENAME虽有大规模破坏的潜力，其实很温顺。但训练家一受伤，它们就会不可阻挡地暴走，可能毁坏半径2千米内的一切。
author: slimee_amogus
source: Despite their potential for mass destruction, POKENAME are actually quite docile. If their Trainer is harmed, however, they will go on an unstoppable rampage that can leave a 2km radius of devastation.

entry: POKENAME隐居巢中，派跟班收集食物、驱逐闯入者。窥探领地，很快就会招来让人意志消沉的怨恨。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME stay secluded in their lairs, sending lackeys to gather food and drive out intruders on their behalf. Snooping around POKENAME's territory is a quick way to earn their demoralizing Spite.

entry: POKENAME吸收走入100英尺内任何人类的噩梦，理论上能永远睡下去。谁叫醒它，就会被它吸收过的一切噩梦纠缠。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME absorbs the nightmares of any human who walks within 100 feet of it, allowing it to theoretically sleep forever. If someone awakens it, that person will be haunted by every nightmare POKENAME has absorbed.

entry: POKENAME爱与别人玩，尤其是肯给食物的对象。它们很强，跳得高，能做出惊人杂技动作。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME love to play with others, especially those who offer them any food. They are quite strong and can leap high, so they are capable of surprising acrobatic maneuvers.

entry: POKENAME对别人的梦，胃口无底。若吃够训练家的梦，自己的志向与欲望，可能慢慢变得与其相同。
author: distinguishedmanlygentleman
source: POKENAME has a bottomless appetite for the dreams of others. If POKENAME eats enough of its trainer's dreams, its own ambitions and desires may slowly shift to match that of its trainers.

entry: 它的树果，只咬一口，就会让人立刻睡着。可别贪嘴，醒来时，食物早已全被POKENAME吃光。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: Anyone who takes a bite of its berries will fall asleep right away. It's advised is not to eat them, as POKENAME will deprive you of all your food.

entry: POKENAME把自己埋进沙，一睡几天。醒来，就往嘴里塞大量沙，吸收养分。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will bury themselves in the sand, sleeping for days at a time. When awake, they will shovel massive amounts of sand into their mouths, absorbing its nutrients.

entry: POKENAME戴着所猎鸟宝可梦的头骨，还不断用猎物骨头，雕出更好的骨回旋镖。众多冻结羽毛，标记着猎过多少鸟宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME wear the skulls of the bird Pokémon they prey upon and forever carve better bone boomerangs from the bones of their prey. Their many frozen feathers are monikers of how many bird Pokémon they have hunted.

entry: POKENAME猎物的头骨，与收集作战利品的众多羽毛，一并融合在它头上。武器由猎物最强的骨头制成，磨得足以劈开坚冰。
author: infinex21
source: The skulls of POKENAME's prey have become fused to their heads together with the many feathers they collected as trophies. Their weapons are made of the strongest bones of their prey and have been sharpened enough to cleave through solid ice.

entry: POKENAME释放阵阵飞雪，冻住森林，让捕食者改去别处找饭。孩子有一种成长仪式：穿越雪地，从它头上拔一片蓝宝石般的羽毛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release flurries of snow to freeze over forests so that predators search elsewhere for meals. There is a rite of passage for children where they wander through the snowy landscape to pluck a sapphire feather from the head of an POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME游荡冰原，从身体大孔喘出刺骨冬风。吐息冻在硬皮上，又添一层防护，抵抗元素与物理攻击。
author: pattybgoode
source: Roaming frozen tundras, POKENAME wheezes a biting winter wind from large pores in its body. Its breath freezes on its tough skin, adding an extra layer of protection from elemental and physical attacks.

entry: POKENAME飞过森林，撒下冰尘，在身旁造出冬日仙境。它们只在冬季离开藏身处，是寒冬正式来临的明确信号。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME fly over forests releasing a coat of icy dust to create wintery wonderlands around them. They are a telltale sign that winter has begun in earnest, as they only come out of hiding during winter.

entry: POKENAME施展超能力时，宝石般的核心会放出壮丽极光，能随心控冰。曾保护北极海域的水手，因此被称为“北极星宝石”或“北极星之珠”。
author: alkazamis
source: When POKENAME channels its psychic powers, a magnificent aurora emanates from its gemlike core. It controls ice at will. It has been known to protect sailors in arctic waters, so it is sometimes called the 'North Star Gem' or the 'Jewel of Polaris'.

entry: 冰冷吐息片刻就能冻住整棵树。POKENAME尾上有根冰刺，带着极强毒素。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its icy breath can freeze an entire tree in just a few moments. POKENAME has an icy spine on its tail that is laced with highly poisonous toxins.

entry: POKENAME一口气就能召来冰雹，却仍拿不准想怎么进化。它们虽格外偏爱冰之石，真要进化，又总会犹豫。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of summoning hailstorms with a single breath but remain uncertain about how they want to evolve. While they strongly favor Ice Stones, they always hesitate before committing to evolution.

entry: POKENAME华美的毛，会冷却、冻结近处空气水分，让身边始终围着薄霜与雾。它冻住池湖，好在冰面打盹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's elegant fur cools and freezes moisture in the air in its immediate vicinity, making it consistently surrounded by a faint layer of frost and mist. It freezes over ponds and lakes so it can take naps upon the frozen surface.

entry: POKENAME在寒水中猎食。一发现合适目标，就冻住猎物周边的水，再用镰刀斩杀。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME spends its time hunting for prey in frigid waters. When it spots a suitable target, it freezes the water around them and slashes them with its scythes to finish them off.

entry: POKENAME响亮的尖啸传出数英里，在雪山家园的崖壁间回荡。滑雪者还夸张地说，一切雪崩都源自它。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME's loud screech carries for miles, echoing from cliff faces in its snowy, mountainous home. Skiers tell tall tales of POKENAME as the origin of all avalanches.

entry: POKENAME是代表冬季的传说宝可梦。一年大多熟睡，入冬才醒，打个哈欠便引来暴风雪。
author: lampent12
source: A legendary Pokémon representing the winter season. POKENAME will sleep for a majority of the year, waking at the start of winter and causing blizzards as it yawns.

entry: 这种POKENAME形态近似伽勒尔的急冻鸟，以锐利目光冻住猎物，再用强大暴风雪轰击。它适应零下地区。
author: chibitales
source: This form of POKENAME resembles a species of Articuno found in Galar. It freezes prey in place with a piercing glare before blasting them with a mighty Blizzard. It thrives in sub-zero regions.

entry: 融合让POKENAME呈现近似伽勒尔同类的形态。除了惯有的强大冰冻力，它似乎还展现出初步精神能力。
author: sk372
source: Fusion has caused POKENAME to take on a form akin to its Galarian counterpart. It seems to exhibit rudimentary psychic capabilities as well as its typical high level of freezing powers.

entry: POKENAME胸中，满是强烈而不竭的决心，已经臻于巅峰。即使生命垂危，也会战斗到最后一刻。
author: leeto64
source: Bestowed with intense, overflowing determination, POKENAME has reached its zenith. With its life on the line, it'll keep battling until the very end.

entry: POKENAME双翼迸出雷电，同时释放寒风，造出带电暴雪。陷入其中的一切，都会遭麻痹与冻结。
author: juliho27
source: POKENAME's wings crackle with lightning while releasing freezing winds, creating electrified snowstorms that paralyze and freeze anything caught within.

entry: POKENAME散出的火焰看似真火，却冰寒彻骨。被火吞没的东西，全会变成坚冰。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The flames emanating from POKENAME appear to be actual fire, but are freezing cold. Anything consumed by these flames turns into solid ice.

entry: POKENAME毒刺寒力极强，刺中的一切，会渐渐从内向外冻结。受害者化成的冰像，警告别人别打扰蜂巢。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's stingers possess a very potent chilling power; anything pierced by them will slowly become frozen from the inside out. These icy statues of victims serve as a warning for others to not disturb its hive.

entry: POKENAME难寻踪迹，据说心冷如冰。它似乎最常静立在猛烈暴风雪中央，或许感到放松。凭寒力，它似乎能从内向外冻结宝可梦。
author: bobosmith01
source: An elusive Pokémon said to have a heart as cold as ice, POKENAME seems to stand still the most in the middle of a powerful blizzard, perhaps relaxed. It seems to have the potential to freeze a Pokémon from the inside out thanks to its frigid powers.

entry: 据说POKENAME冰翼内，含所有宝可梦的DNA。但谁想用显微镜证实，它就造起暴雪，挡住一切观察。
author: soup1900
source: The inside of POKENAME's ice wings is said to contain the DNA of all Pokémon. However, when anyone tries to use a microscope to prove this, this Pokémon creates a snowstorm to obscure all observations.

entry: POKENAME生气时，背上冒出尖冰柱。冰柱能射向对手，扎进身体，再突然融成沸水，造成痛苦烫伤。
author: sk372
source: Pointed icicles jut from POKENAME's back when it gets angry. These icicles can fire off as projectiles, lodging into opponents before suddenly melting into boiling-hot water and causing painful burns.

entry: POKENAME成群穿越暴雪与雨夹雪风暴，寻找高山筑巢。气象学家以其迁徙，判断恶劣天气将至。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Flocks of POKENAME travel together through harsh blizzards and sleet storms in search of high mountains to nest in. Meteorologists use the migration of POKENAME as an indicator of incoming poor weather.

entry: POKENAME会跟着找到的任何训练家，似乎永不缺能量。唯有去温暖地带，才能甩开，因为它靠寒冷供能。因此，冬季在领地附近探险很危险。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME will follow any Trainer they find, seemingly never running out of energy. The only escape is to find a warm area, as POKENAME draws energy from the cold. This makes it dangerous to explore near their territory in winter.

entry: POKENAME在高山冰川筑巢，厚绒羽隔绝严寒。鸟群下山时，也带来雨夹雪风暴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME nest high in the mountains within glaciers, their thick downy feathers insulating them against the cold. When flocks of POKENAME descend from the mountains, they bring sleet storms with them.

entry: 有人见过，POKENAME不小心将自己的触角冻干。即使在冰寒的环境里，它仍能游动生存。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME have been seen accidentally freeze-drying their antennae. This Pokémon can survive swimming in ice-cold environments.

entry: POKENAME难以控制体内不稳定的冰与电混合物，可爱却危险。站得太近，就可能突然挨静电，或瞬间冻伤。
author: beatdoof
source: Struggling to contain the volatile mixture of ice and electricity stored within its body, POKENAME is an adorable but dangerous hazard. Anyone standing too close risks being struck by a sudden jolt of static or an instant flash of frostbite.

entry: POKENAME一振翅，就能给整片森林覆雪。它极其稀有，研究者尚未弄清行为的关键特征。
author: fiordaliso
source: One wingbeat from POKENAME can blanket an entire forest in snow. It is so rare that researchers have yet to understand the key elements of this species' behavior.

entry: POKENAME只在冬季出现，飞到哪里，就薄薄落一层雪。翅膀怕热，太暖就会开始融化。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME only appears during the winter months, bringing a light dusting of snow wherever it flies. Its wings are sensitive to heat and will start to melt if it gets too warm.

entry: POKENAME每次拍翼，都向下撒些雪。维持飞行需高速振翅，便在航线下造出小暴风雪般的景象。
author: sk372
source: Every flap of POKENAME's wings spreads a bit of snow beneath it. Because it flaps its wings so rapidly in order to fly, it creates what looks like miniature snowstorms beneath its flight paths.

entry: POKENAME睡在湿地池塘，慢慢冻住周围的水。醒来伸展，便把冰震碎，射向四面，路人常误以为下冰雹。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME sleeps in ponds in wetlands. Whilst asleep, it slowly freezes the surrounding water. Upon waking, it stretches, shattering the ice and sending it flying in every direction, with passersby often mistaking it for hail.

entry: POKENAME极其高傲，将周身空气维持冰点以下，不让训练家碰。越尊重训练家，气息才会越暖。
author: thesilverowls
source: POKENAME are incredibly haughty and prevent trainers from touching them, keeping the temperature of the air around them below freezing temperatures. The more they grow to respect their trainer, the warmer their aura becomes.

entry: 据说POKENAME能预知暴风雪或风暴，在受困训练家面前现身。凭精神力量，只一瞪，就能冻住对手。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: They are said to predict blizzards or storms and appear before trainers caught in them. With psychic power, POKENAME can freeze their opponents with a single glare.

entry: POKENAME身上与翼上的环纹，在包围自己的猛烈冰雹中明亮发光。旅人曾被光迷住，在风暴中迷得再也找不到路。
author: alestrius
source: The rings on POKENAME's body and wings glow brightly in the thick hailstorms that surround it. Travelers have been known to become mesmerized by the glow and get hopelessly lost within the storm.

entry: 暴雪飞雪频仍的寒带古遗迹，常有POKENAME画像。根据描绘，人们推测，古人或曾将其视作新冰河期的先兆。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are often depicted in ancient ruins located in arctic areas rife with blizzards and flurries alike. Based on these depictions, it has been theorized that people once thought these Pokémon would be the harbingers of a new ice age.

entry: 登山者常被头顶飞过的POKENAME冻得发冷、落满雪。它想睡时，不愿受扰，便用钻尾挖个洞。
author: equation8573
source: Mountain climbers are often chilled and snowed on by POKENAME flying overhead. When it needs sleep, POKENAME wishes for no disturbances. To achieve this, it uses its drill tail to dig a hole.

entry: 巨大双翼一振，就能召来冰寒暴风雪。POKENAME稀有，据说会在历尽艰辛、登上最高峰的探险者面前现身。
author: fiordaliso
source: A single flap of its massive wings can summon freezing blizzards. POKENAME is a rare Pokémon said to appear before explorers who reach the peaks of the highest mountains after enduring great hardships.

entry: POKENAME下地嗅寻、收集蘑菇，偏爱寒处生长的。拿到食物，便飞向高处，似乎不肯在低于某一海拔的地方用餐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME descends to the ground to sniff out mushrooms to gather, favoring those that grow in colder areas. Once it has its food, it flies up to higher ground; it seems unwilling to eat meals below a certain altitude.

entry: 有些POKENAME的颜色，近似遥远地区的急冻鸟。这亚种更凶猛护食，饭被打扰，会暴力还击，而非逃走。
author: sk372
source: Some variants of POKENAME have a coloration similar to Articuno from a far-off region. This subspecies is slightly more aggressive concerning food; interrupted meals incite a violent response rather than fleeing.

entry: POKENAME双翼生成轻柔凉风，能安抚身心。它用自身寒气，为发热者降温，或冷却更适合低温发育的蛋。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wings generate a gentle and cool breeze with calming properties. It uses the chill of its own body to help those suffering from fevers, or to cool eggs that develop better in colder temperatures.

entry: 这位温柔守护者，努力恢复受全球变暖影响的寒区。据说它眨眼就能从一极移到另一极，没人见过中途的旅程。
author: thordemidgard
source: This gentle protector works to regenerate frigid areas that suffer from the effects of global warming. It is said to be able to move from one pole to the other in a blink, with nobody ever seeing it make the journey in between.

entry: POKENAME遇险，反应强烈，要么飞走，要么造出致麻痹的暴雪。不过，它很友善，爱依偎训练家，帮对方取暖或降温。
author: beatdoof
source: Having an intense fight-or-flight response, it will either fly away at the sight of danger or create a paralyzing snowstorm. POKENAME is, however, very friendly and loves to snuggle with its Trainer, warming them up or cooling them down.

entry: 月光下，POKENAME的蓝羽闪着变幻色彩。从前，许多人相信，看见这景象就会受诅咒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's blue feathers shimmer in shifting colors when exposed to moonlight. Many once believed that witnessing this phenomenon would leave you cursed.

entry: POKENAME若烦躁、开始冒电火花，就须将它浸进冰湖。不过，它很爱孩子，乐意耗尽冰冻力量，为当地孩子织出闪亮雪乐园。
author: beatdoof
source: If POKENAME grows irritable and begins to spark, one must plunge it into an icy lake. However, it's very fond of kids; it will happily exhaust its freezing powers just to weave a glistening, snowy playground for the local children.

entry: POKENAME体内独特的生物电，能在周围掀起冰寒狂风。巢里装饰的冻结机器残片，全被它吸干过电。
author: sk372
source: A unique bioelectricity within POKENAME's body lets it generating freezing gales around it. It decorates its lair with frozen pieces of machinery it has drained of electricity.

entry: POKENAME从臂炮射出火与雪团，两种元素不知为何配合，形成致命弹丸。火热得使身体麻木，冰又冷得太快，造成灼伤。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can loose balls of fire and snow from within its arm cannons, both elements somehow working in tandem to create deadly projectiles. Their flames burn so hot that they numb the body, and their ice chills so quickly that it burns.

entry: POKENAME为过于珍贵、不宜直接实验的标本，精准运行极寒模拟测试，帮助科学家研究。不过，它会得意忘形，连数据本身也彻底冻住，往往无法恢复。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME helps scientists in their research by accurately running extreme cold simulation tests on specimens too precious to run physical experiments on. However, it can get carried away and freeze the data itself solid, often beyond recovery.

entry: POKENAME为过于珍贵、不宜直接实验的标本，精准运行极寒模拟测试，帮助科学家研究。不过，它会得意忘形，连数据本身也彻底冻住，往往无法恢复。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME helps scientists in their research by accurately running extreme cold simulation tests on specimens too precious to run physical experiments on. However, it can get carried away and freeze the data itself solid, often beyond recovery.

entry: POKENAME沿雪山顶，在岩冰最稳固的裂隙中筑巢。每次振翅，都散出众多晶莹雪花，许多旅人乐意见到。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME build their nests along snowy mountain tops within the most secure crags of rock and ice. Every flap of their wings sends out many glittering snowflakes that are a welcome sight to many travelers.

entry: 朋友或家人遇险，POKENAME周围连空气都会迅速冻结。双翼一振，几秒就能造出暴风雪。
author: infinex21
source: The very air around an POKENAME will quickly freeze when its friends or family are put in danger. With a single flap of their wings, they can create blizzards in a matter of seconds.

entry: POKENAME独来独往，只容极少数深入冰寒领地。不受欢迎的对象，会被每次振翅生成的尖锐冰柱雨驱退。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a solitary being, allowing very few to venture deep into its frigid territory.  Those who are not welcome will be repelled via a shower of sharp icicles it generates with each flap of its wings.

entry: 葬身暴风雪的亡魂，汇成了POKENAME。这个强大的灵体，与一块冻结的楔石，相依相连。
author: melodydelune
source: Spirits that have passed in blizzards gather to form POKENAME. This powerful spirit is bonded to a frozen keystone.

entry: POKENAME住在冰洞深处，凿冰洞藏着睡。休息够，就一边放寒雾，一边冲出巢，努力让家园不融化、不崩散。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Dwelling deep within icy caverns, POKENAME carve out holes in ice to hide in while they sleep. Once fully rested, they launch themselves out of their dens while releasing an icy mist, working to keep their homes from melting or falling apart.

entry: POKENAME冰鳞硬如钻石。甲若真被打裂，就会爆出超低温空气，将袭击者冻成坚冰。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The ice scales on POKENAME's body are as hard as diamond. If its armor does manage to crack, it explodes with supercooled air, freezing its attacker solid.

entry: 传说POKENAME会降下巨大暴雪，蹂躏山坡。但风暴中的目击报告，却说它穿过雪幕，引人前往安全处。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Legends are told of POKENAME sending down massive blizzards to ravage mountainsides. However, eyewitness reports from these storms indicate that POKENAME travels through the snow to guide people to safety.

entry: 许多故事说，这只宝可梦会出现在雪中迷途的旅人面前，将他们冻在原地，直到风暴过去。据说核心有神奇冰球，能随意召雪。
author: imaginita
source: There are many stories of this Pokémon appearing to travellers lost in the snow and freezing them in place until the storm passes. It is said to have a ball of mystical ice at its core, allowing it to summon snowstorms at will.

entry: POKENAME住在最冰寒的高峰之上，只需拍几下翼，就能生成强大暴雪。传说它用勇于到访者形象制成的冰像，装饰家园。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives far atop the iciest of mountain peaks, generating powerful snowstorms with only a few flaps of its wings. Legends say it decorates its home with ice statues fashioned in the image of those brave enough to reach it.

entry: POKENAME速度极快，能完美融入自己暴雪中疾冲的飞雪。兴奋时，冰冠变得更大更华丽，须长久休息，才融回正常大小。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's extreme quickness allows it to perfectly blend in with the rushing snow of the blizzards it creates. When it gets excited, its crown of ice becomes larger and grander, only melting back down to regular size after a long rest.

entry: POKENAME极其高贵自傲，要求其他宝可梦，乃至自己的训练家，都高度尊敬。攀崖登山时，它用翼端冻结的金属爪固定身体。
author: c0u51nv1nn7
source: Extremely regal and proud, POKENAME demands great respect from other Pokémon and even its own Trainer. It uses the frozen metallic claws at the ends of its wings as anchors when climbing cliffsides or mountains.

entry: POKENAME是传说中的剑宝可梦，住在冰封的高峰附近。只消挥动刀刃，就能卷起暴风雪。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is a legendary sword Pokémon that resides around icy summits. It can generate a blizzard with a swing of its blade.

entry: POKENAME每次挥刃，都留下冻结轨迹。它甚至能射出新月形冰块，让敌人无从逃离冰寒威力。
author: sk372
source: Every swing POKENAME's blades make leaves a freezing trail behind. It can even send crescent-shaped chunks of ice at foes as projectiles, ensuring none can escape its frigid might.

entry: POKENAME锐眼能迅速找到穿过冰寒家园的旅人。它在雪暴迷途者面前出现，用发光眼睛照路，领往安全处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's sharp eyesight lets it quickly locate any travelers going through its frigid home. It appears before those lost in snowstorms and guides them to safety, illuminating the path with its glowing eyes.

entry: 这只传说宝可梦，给触须裹上厚冰，便造出壮丽的双翼。飞到哪里，雪就下到哪里。
author: melodydelune
source: This legendary Pokémon can create magnificent wings by coating its feelers in a thick coat of ice. Wherever it flies, it snows.

entry: POKENAME周围始终有浓密雪雾，往往只看得见长尾。尾巴一碰就能冻住敌人，也用来砸碎冻结的受害者。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME generates a thick mist of snow around it at all times. Its long tail is often the only part of it ever seen, and this tail can freeze foes upon contact. POKENAME also uses this tail to shatter frozen victims.

entry: POKENAME经传送门，从另一世界来到我们这里，又只待最寒处，因此罕见。它滑过天空，翼上落下奇异的幽暗飞雪。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sightings are rare, as it arrives to our world from another via portals, and remains within the most frigid of areas. Strange, shadowy snow falls from its wings as it glides through the air.

entry: 古传说将POKENAME描绘为无情寒冬的先使，沿途把寒冷拖过大地。冰层埋没土地前，无声经过的身影与锐眼，常是最后的征兆。
author: oejoeboy33
source: Ancient legends describe POKENAME as a harbinger of merciless winters, dragging the cold across the land in its wake. Its silent passage and piercing eyes are often the last signs seen before the land is buried in ice.

entry: POKENAME凶猛守护冰山家园，只求绝对独处。谁在领地内睡着，就注定陷入无尽噩梦，任严寒冻僵。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME fiercely protects the icy mountains it calls home, yearning for absolute solitude. Those who fall asleep in its territory are doomed to an endless nightmare, left to freeze in the relentless cold.

entry: POKENAME住在几乎无法抵达的雪峰，监视领地。它对闯入者极具攻击性，谁敢攀山，便无情袭击。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME inhabit nearly unreachable snowy peaks, keeping a watch over their domains. Highly aggressive toward intruders, they will ruthlessly attack any who dare to climb their mountains.

entry: POKENAME从寒峰飞下，采蘑菇吃。对付害物时，先用双翼产出的冰覆爪，再伸长手臂，远距离挥出冰寒爪击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flies down from cold mountain peaks to forage for mushrooms to eat. To deal with pests, it coats its claws with ice produced from its wings before extending its arms to deal chilling long-range claw swipes.

entry: POKENAME体内极冷。一位愚蠢训练家，曾想把食物存在里面，此后再没人见过他。
author: hophoppip
source: The interior of POKENAME's body is extremely cold in temperature. One foolish Trainer attempted to store food inside their POKENAME, and was never seen again.

entry: POKENAME冬初以雪覆住整片森林，使其冻结。必要时，它们用温和余烬融冰，为其他宝可梦解冻。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME freeze over entire forests with a blanket of snow at the beginning of the winter season. When necessary, they melt ice with soft embers to thaw out other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用长尾裹身，即使在寒冷深水也能保暖。背上的水晶羽毛，能将捕食者冻在原地，自我防卫。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME wrap themselves in their long tails to keep warm even in the depths of frigid waters. The crystalline feathers along an POKENAME's back act as defense mechanisms to freeze predators in place.

entry: 据说，谁哪怕轻蹭POKENAME的双色羽，就会立刻被寒气灼伤。它的冰息还能大幅降低周围温度。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is said that anyone who even brushes against one of POKENAME's bicolored feathers will be instantly scorched by the cold. Its icy breath can drastically lower the temperature of its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME疾飞时，会冷却空气，留下短时间不散的积雪。它爱飞过热带地区，让当地生灵暂时摆脱酷热。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME zips through the air, it cools the air and creates snow drifts that linger for a short while after. It likes to fly over tropical areas and give the inhabitants a short respite from the hot temperatures.

entry: POKENAME召起猛烈暴雪，隐藏狩猎身影，再从上方以火焰旋涡伏击。它住在世界最高的一些山上，难以充分研究。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME summons mighty blizzards to hide its presence when hunting, ambushing prey from above with Fire Spin. It lives on some of the tallest mountains in the world, making it difficult to research properly.

entry: 若看见小小冰彗星，疾划天空，那可能是POKENAME。它只在初冬来临，带来当季第一场雪。
author: mistymagius
source: If you see a small icy comet darting across the sky, it could be an POKENAME. It only arrives in the early winter to bring the first snow of the season.

entry: 谁出言嫌弃外表，POKENAME便挥翼掀起狂怒暴雪，予以报复。恼怒至极时，它能冻住整座村庄，毫无悔意。
author: fiordaliso
source: If anyone makes unpleasant comments about its appearance, POKENAME takes revenge by unleashing furious snowstorms through the flapping of its wings. At the peak of its frustration, it's capable of freezing entire villages without feeling any remorse.

entry: POKENAME藏在冰寒山中，独自长成下一形态。谁扰乱宁静，就会遭甩尾造出的冻结寒风袭击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides itself away on frigid mountains so it may grow into its next form in solitude. Those that disturb its peace will be pelted with frozen winds created through the swing of its tail.

entry: POKENAME核心周围的液体始终低于0摄氏度，却不结冰。寒区暴雪时，最常见它们小群聚集，原因仍在研究。
author: chibitales
source: The fluid surrounding POKENAME's core is constantly below 0°C, yet doesn't freeze. They are most often seen during blizzards in cold regions forming small groups. Research is still ongoing pertaining to why they do this.

entry: POKENAME在寒区洞穴安家，是迅速无声的猎手，爱扑向冰属性宝可梦吸血。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes its home in caverns located in colder regions. A quick and silent hunter, it prefers to swoop at and suck the blood of Ice-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME每次拍翼，都生成一小块冰雹。若被咬，应立即就医，否则伤处很快会冻伤。
author: sondededoo
source: Every time POKENAME flaps its wings, a small chunk of hail is generated. Should you ever get bitten by POKENAME, immediately seek medical attention, as those do not will quickly find the infected area frostbitten.

entry: POKENAME适应冰寒地区，在开阔平原寻找猎物。强力咆哮能冻住逃跑宝可梦脚下的地，使其滑倒，让它赶上吃一餐。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Thriving in icy regions, POKENAME wanders open plains in search of prey. It freezes the ground beneath fleeing Pokémon with a powerful roar, causing them to slip and fall and giving POKENAME time to catch its meal.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，会召起巨大而致命的暴雪。它制造火与冰的大龙卷，迷惑对手。
author: dodoowner_
source: As it dances, POKENAME summons large, deadly blizzards. It creates large tornadoes of both fire and ice to disorient opponents.

entry: 晚秋，POKENAME成群从山顶降下，仿佛迎冬。优雅舞步所过，留下晶莹霜花。
author: mepp.
source: In late autumn, flocks of POKENAME descend from mountain peaks as if to usher in the winter season. Their elegant dance movements produce glistening frost wherever they step.

entry: POKENAME是住在冰洞的危险龙形生物，冰息与利爪，让附近居民敬畏。无月之夜，它们起飞，寻找牲畜捕猎。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME are very dangerous dragon-like creatures who live in ice caves. People living close to their homes fear and respect them for their ice breath and razor-sharp claws. On moonless nights, they take flight, seeking livestock to hunt.

entry: POKENAME云朵般的双翼，不断结出轻软雪花。高而悦耳的歌声，也让附近云朵降雪。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's cloud-like wings constantly form light, fluffy snow. Its high-pitched, melodic singing makes nearby clouds snow as well.

entry: 胶质的角敏感得能察觉周围最细微的升温。POKENAME一振翼，就能召来暴雪，让寒区恢复理想温度。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its gelatinous horns are so sensitive that they can detect the slightest rise in temperature around it. With a single beat of its wings, POKENAME can summon snowstorms capable of restoring cold regions to their ideal temperature.

entry: 乐观者说，POKENAME会救雪暴迷途者，可冰冷现实是：它将他们封入冰中，结束痛苦。
author: frokachu
source: Optimists will say that POKENAME rescue those who are lost in blizzards, but the cold reality is that they put them out of their misery by encasing them in ice.

entry: 常能看见POKENAME在冻湖跳舞，如履平地。表演总以单脚旋转结束，招来强大冰雹。风暴遮住一切视线，它也随之消失。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME can often be observed dancing upon frozen lakes, moving as if on solid ground. They always end these performances by pirouetting, the motion summoning a strong hailstorm. While all sight is obscured in the storm, the POKENAME will vanish.

entry: POKENAME用杖召来强得不可思议的暴雪。古文称，它有能力让世界陷入永不结束的冰河期。
author: dodoowner_
source: With its staff, POKENAME summons blizzards with unimaginable strength. Ancient texts claim that it possesses the power to plunge the world into a never-ending ice age.

entry: POKENAME用杖召来强得不可思议的暴雪。古文称，它有能力让世界陷入永不结束的冰河期。
author: dodoowner_
source: With its staff, POKENAME summons blizzards with unimaginable strength. Ancient texts claim that it possesses the power to plunge the world into a never-ending ice age.

entry: 它善于控温，壳由冰构成，核心却烧得比岩浆更热。壳内融化、沸腾，积存蒸汽便从POKENAME身上喷发，释放后又冻成雪。
author: milchik
source: It is a master of temperature manipulation, whose shell is made of ice, while its core burns hotter than magma. When the inside of its shell melts and boils, POKENAME erupts with the accumulated steam, which freezes into snow upon being released.

entry: 它善于控温，壳由冰构成，核心却烧得比岩浆更热。壳内融化、沸腾，积存蒸汽便从POKENAME身上喷发，释放后又冻成雪。
author: milchik
source: It is a master of temperature manipulation, whose shell is made of ice, while its core burns hotter than magma. When the inside of its shell melts and boils, POKENAME erupts with the accumulated steam, which freezes into snow upon being released.

entry: POKENAME快拍双翼，每下都撒霜，让飞行轨迹像移动的雪阵。它瞬间冻住空中猎物，再迅速俯冲，趁落地前抓住。
author: sk372
source: The quick fluttering of POKENAME's wings casts frost with each flap, making its flight paths look like moving snow flurries. It flash-freezes prey in midair, swooping quickly to snag them before they hit the ground.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，双翼散出冰凉闪亮的雪花。景象绚丽，个体又稀有，登山男会攀上世界最高的一些山，只为一生看上一回。
author: chibitales
source: Their wings give off chilly, sparkling snowflakes as they fly. These dazzling displays, alongside POKENAME's rarity, make them a once-in-a-lifetime event that Hikers climb some of the tallest mountains in the world to see.

entry: POKENAME穿山挖出的隧道，会突然喷冰寒阵风。甚至几天后仍能发生，瞬间冻住近处生物。
author: .izik
source: Tunnels dug by POKENAME through mountain ranges emit sudden freezing gusts. These blasts can occur days later and can instantly freeze nearby creatures.

entry: 自古，POKENAME被誉为冬之精灵。据说见到这难觅宝可梦的光辉，就能获佑，免受寒冷。
author: mepp.
source: Since ancient times, POKENAME has been hailed as a spirit of winter. Those who witness this elusive Pokémon's radiance are said to be blessed with protection from the cold.

entry: POKENAME长尾轻柔摆动，巡行珊瑚礁。发现渔船，就会射出能量束，瞬间冻住整船。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's long tail waves delicately through the reefs it patrols. If it spots a fishing vessel, it fires a beam of energy that can freeze the entire vessel in an instant.

entry: POKENAME覆羽的身体极冷，碰到什么就冻住什么。它以坚喙钻穿实岩，在山腹凿出精巧隧道。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's feathered body is so frigid that it freezes anything it touches. It is known for carving intricate tunnels through the heart of mountains, using its sturdy beak to drill through solid rock.

entry: POKENAME大多睡在洞穴或屋内，冷却周围空气，保持凉爽。只有新雪刚落，才兴奋出门，走过雪地，不留脚印。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spend most of their time sleeping inside either a cave or a home, keeping cool by chilling the air around them. They will only be excited to go out after snow has freshly fallen, and will move across it without leaving any footprints.

entry: POKENAME自豪地昂首行走，仿佛知道自己的传说地位。闪亮翼尾的大动作，扬起冰寒空气，但无论地面结多厚的冰，它都不滑倒。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME struts about with pride, as if aware of its legendary status. The dramatic movements of its shimmering wings and tail waft around freezing air, but POKENAME will never slip, no matter how icy the ground beneath it gets.

entry: 偏头痛发作，POKENAME就会失控，无意放出毁灭性暴雪，直到康复。它极隐居，即使在栖居的冻结森林，也难得遇见。
author: fiordaliso
source: When struck by migraines, POKENAME loses control of its powers and unintentionally unleashes devastating snowstorms that last until it recovers. Since it is a very reclusive creature, encountering it is rare even in the frozen forests it inhabits.

entry: 偏头痛发作，POKENAME就会失控，无意放出毁灭性暴雪，直到康复。它极隐居，即使在栖居的冻结森林，也难得遇见。
author: fiordaliso
source: When struck by migraines, POKENAME loses control of its powers and unintentionally unleashes devastating snowstorms that last until it recovers. Since it is a very reclusive creature, encountering it is rare even in the frozen forests it inhabits.

entry: POKENAME需要冰冷环境，保持头脑清晰。离开天然环境太久，就会头痛，尤其在炎热干旱处。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME require an icy-cold environment to keep their head clear. Extended time outside of their natural environment gives them a headache, especially if they are somewhere hot and arid.

entry: POKENAME每天做冰刃，可似乎总忘记，这把刀究竟用来干什么。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME make blades out of ice every day. It seems, however, that POKENAME always forget what the purpose of the knife is.

entry: POKENAME召起暴雪，能冻结整片水域。湖河表面结冰后，它们就在冰下游动捕猎。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can freeze entire bodies of water by conjuring a blizzard. Once the surface of a lake or river has been frozen, they swim under the ice to hunt for their prey.

entry: POKENAME在寒冬夜游山，寻找迷途旅人。有训练家说，它们是英雄，其实它们只想找个冷冷的朋友依偎。
author: elibromax314
source: POKENAME wanders the mountains during chilly winter nights, looking for travelers lost in the cold. Some Trainers say that POKENAME are heroic creatures, but they are really just looking for a cold friend to snuggle with.

entry: POKENAME振动湛蓝羽毛，召来暴雪。即使周围化作冰霜天地，风暴中央的火焰，却始终燃着。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME conjure blizzards and snowstorms by flapping their azure feathers. Even though the world around them becomes a frosty environment, the flame at the center of the storm is always lit.

entry: POKENAME如贤者，住在寒山，人们常为智慧而求访。它鲜少认可谁够格，拒绝的对象，会被杖中寒风逐出领地。
author: sk372
source: A sage-like Pokémon that resides on frigid mountains, POKENAME is often sought out for its wisdom. It rarely deems others worthy, casting those it rejects out of its domain with gusts of icy wind created from its staff.

entry: POKENAME战斗全力以赴时，双翼完全展开。它并用精神能力与控冰之力，冻结、压倒敌人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME spread their wings to their full mast when they call upon their full powers in battle. They wield psychic abilities in tandem with the power to control ice in order to freeze and overwhelm foes.

entry: POKENAME携带的洋蓟，究竟如何关乎生活方式，仍不明。许多研究者试图查清，结果被冻成坚冰。
author: nvisionluminous
source: It remains unknown how the artichoke POKENAME carries is crucial to its way of life. Many researchers found themselves frozen solid trying to find out.

entry: POKENAME很稀有，厨师寻来，做成昂贵料理。菜肴蛋白质丰富，余味冰凉。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are rare Pokémon that chefs seek out to cook into expensive dishes. Meals made with POKENAME are high in protein and have a chilly aftertaste.

entry: POKENAME住在与海相连的水下冰洞。它先用冰笼冻住猎物，再注入烈毒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live underwater in icy caverns that connect to the ocean. They freeze their prey within a cage of ice before they inject their prey with virulent venom.

entry: POKENAME身体全由冰构成。不过，内部温度极低，使身体硬如花岗岩。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME's body is made entirely of ice. However, its internal temperature is so low that it makes its body is as hard as granite.

entry: POKENAME飞过空中，会形成大冰雹，直径从不小于一英寸。身体沉重，常让它自己也从天落下，活像另一颗冰雹。
author: bandedbodypress
source: As POKENAME flies through the air, it forms large hailstones, never smaller than an inch in diameter. Its heavy body often makes it fall from the sky, making it act as a hailstone itself.

entry: POKENAME盘尾藏着强大寒力，连圈间空气都冻成实体。尾巴一松，就会引发1000万吨级爆炸。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The coil of POKENAME's tail contains so much freezing power that the air between the coils is frozen solid. If POKENAME releases its tail, it causes a 10 megaton explosion.

entry: POKENAME两头交替吐出寒风、啄击猎物。职责不断交换，让动作难料，逐渐消磨猎物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have twin heads swap between releasing frigid zephyrs and pecking at their prey. This constant role swapping wears down prey because of how unpredictable they become.

entry: POKENAME适应酷寒海洋，把捕食者与猎物都冻成坚冰。游过时，留下一道闪亮冰晶。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME thrives in bitterly cold oceans, freezing both predators and prey in solid ice. As it swims, it leaves a glittering trail of ice crystals.

entry: POKENAME一转，周围就形成巨大暴雪，吹走附近所有对象。壳由纯冰构成，温度低于零度。
author: seanothan_23
source: When POKENAME spins, a large snowstorm forms around it, blowing away anyone in the vicinity. Its shell is made of pure ice and reaches sub-zero temperatures.

entry: POKENAME身体围着低至华氏零下30度的冰雾。它能向四周大量喷发，让周围化成冰寒荒地。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's bodies are surrounded by icy mist as cold as -30 degrees Fahrenheit. They can release this mist in massive bursts around them, turning their surroundings into an icy wasteland.

entry: POKENAME周身寒雾无味，却有剧毒。它藏在冰洞阴影，停留在毫无戒心的猎物旁，让雾渐渐将其吞没。
author: mepp.
source: The chilling mist that surrounds POKENAME is odorless yet highly toxic. It hides in the shadows of frigid caves, lingering near unassuming prey to allow the mist to slowly overtake them.

entry: 传说，在暴风雪中迷路时，若POKENAME就在附近，它会先把你催眠，免得被看见，再送你到安全的地方。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: Legends say that if you get lost in a blizzard and POKENAME is nearby, it will put you to sleep so you won't see it and take you to a safe place.

entry: POKENAME见于双子岛海滩，彼此间沿岸短程拍翼飞动。为适应寒冷，体温比多数宝可梦低得反常。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are found on the beaches of the Seafoam Islands, fluttering in short distances across the beachfronts at one another. Their body temperatures are abnormally low compared to most Pokémon, adapted to survive the cold weather.

entry: POKENAME将电能导过球茎，哪怕只长大一点，也会放出火花。它兼吸阳光与雷电，为快速成长供能。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME channels electrical energy through its bulb, discharging sparks when the bulb grows the tiniest bit. It absorbs both sunlight and lightning to fuel its rapid growth.

entry: POKENAME用雷电击打骚扰自己的捕食者。身体虽弱，吃叶时，却少有宝可梦敢打断。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME zap predators that harass them with bolts of lightning. Even though their bodies are frail, few Pokémon interrupt their leafy feeding sessions.

entry: POKENAME爱在废弃发电厂筑巢，吸收旧设备里的电能。它们讨厌打扰，一被发现，便常用小腿迅速跑开。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME like to build their nest in abandoned power plants where they can absorb electrical energy from derelict equipment. Since they hate to be disturbed, they tend to scamper away on their tiny legs if they are discovered.

entry: POKENAME电力太强，便用骨头当杖，释放削减。传言若不这样，电流会杀死任何对象，连地面属性宝可梦也不例外。
author: chewquy
source: POKENAME has so much electrical power that it uses its bone like a wand to reduce it. Rumors say that if it didn't do that, its electricity would be fatal to anyone, even Ground-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME令云间生灵畏惧，能洒下闪电般迅疾的踢击，趁敌人还未反应，就打个措手不及。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME is feared among the clouds. It can shower down lighting fast kicks that strike foes before they can react, often catching them off guard.

entry: POKENAME在附近造雷暴，迫使捕食者去别处狩猎。大胆的孩子为让亲友刮目相看，会穿过森林，从它头顶拔羽毛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME cause lightning storms in the nearby vicinity to convince predators to hunt elsewhere. Bold children who want to impress friends and family run through forests to pluck a feather from POKENAME's head.

entry: POKENAME如活雷云般横冲陆地，雷鸣般的冲锋，留下碎石与焦土。据说尖刺能引雷，却不知为何暴走得如此凶猛。
author: potato_tub
source: POKENAME barrels through the land like a living storm cloud, its thunderous charges leaving trails of shattered stone and scorched earth. Said to draw lightning with its pointed spikes, it is unknown what drives it to rampage so fiercely.

entry: POKENAME打洞到山顶，等候雷雨，以螺旋角充当避雷针。粗粝带刺的甲是天然导体，每挨一次雷击，电量便增加。
author: potato_tub
source: POKENAME tunnels to mountain peaks and waits for thunderstorms, using its spiraling horn as a lightning rod. Its rugged, spike-lined armor acts as a natural conductor, growing more charged with every thunderstrike.

entry: POKENAME爪里几乎总抓着蛋，不管是不是自己的。偷巢常惹麻烦，可它们通常用电磁波麻痹追赶者，成功脱身。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are rarely seen without an egg in their claws, regardless of if it belongs to them. This often leads them into trouble when stealing from Pokémon nests, but they usually get away with it after paralyzing the pursuer with Thunder Wave.

entry: 白天看见流星，或许就是POKENAME正掠过天空，赶往远方，带去雷电。
author: fenragon
source: If you see a falling star during the daytime, it could be POKENAME zipping through the sky on its way to bring lightning to faraway regions.

entry: POKENAME表演精巧舞蹈，召来精准雷击。战斗被逼入绝境，舞就疯狂起来，闪电也变得难以预料。
author: thesilverowls
source: POKENAME perform intricate routines of dance that result in precise lightning strikes. When cornered in combat, their dances grow frantic, and their bolts become wildly unpredictable.

entry: POKENAME靠储电供给变身能力，变身后仍迸着雷电。变回原形后，它须吸电，补足能量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's transformation capabilities are fueled by its electricity stores. It crackles with lightning even while transformed, and needs to absorb electricity after transforming back to refuel itself.

entry: POKENAME一声震耳吠叫，就能召雷暴，却常犹豫进化方向。许多个体想靠雷之石进化，真正实行前，又会迟疑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can summon lightning storms with a deafening bark but often hesitate on what evolution path they want to take. Many want to evolve through Thunder Stones but hesitate before they carry out the evolution.

entry: 许多训练家不愿养POKENAME，因为它产出的电，自己储不下。充电过度，毛便向空中释放小雷云。
author: 0reomilka
source: Many Trainers avoid owning a POKENAME because it cannot store all the electricity it produces. When it becomes overcharged, its fur releases small thunderclouds into the air.

entry: POKENAME毛间摩擦，会发出雷声。它们极敏感，有时连自己的雷也怕。速度又快得惊人，让饲养很费心。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: When a POKENAME's fur rubs together it produces the sound of thunder. They are extremely sensitive Pokémon, sometimes even getting scared of their own thunder. POKENAME are incredibly fast, making them hard to maintain.

entry: POKENAME操纵巨大冰雹风暴，能摧毁整座村庄。冰雹带电，一碰就会遭电击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME commands large hailstorms that can devastate entire villages. These hailstones are charged with electricity and can cause electric shocks when touched.

entry: 两只闪电鸟融合，放出的能量强到让身体化作纯等离子体与电力。有人说，融合后的POKENAME，足以为整个地区供能。
author: fiordaliso
source: When two Zapdos fuse together, they unleash an energy so intense that their body transforms into pure plasma and electricity. Some say the fused POKENAME holds enough power to fuel an entire region.

entry: POKENAME一拍翼，便释放一场宛如活物的风暴，迸出极不稳定的能量，让周围数英里聚起雷云。古文称此景，是天空本身愤怒苏醒。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME beats its wings, a living tempest is unleashed, crackling with energy so volatile that storm clouds gather for miles around. Ancient texts describe this phenomenon as the sky itself awakening in fury.

entry: 自我融合，让POKENAME像未融合的伽勒尔同类。性情比未融合闪电鸟更凶，会以带电踢击，试着打倒害物。
author: sk372
source: Self-fusion has resulted in POKENAME looking like its unfused Galarian counterpart. Its disposition has become more aggressive than unfused Zapdos, with it attempting to strike pests down with electrically-charged kicks.

entry: 融合让POKENAME呈现伽勒尔同类的外形。它在各地徒步疾行，追逐雷暴，补充能量。
author: sk372
source: Fusion has resulted in POKENAME taking on the appearance of its Galarian counterpart. It travels across the regions on foot at great speeds, chasing thunderstorms with which it can recharge its energy.

entry: POKENAME在久废的发电厂筑巢，被视为极危险。它对外来者凶猛，射出带电飞针，快如闪电，发射声也轰如雷鸣。
author: sk372
source: Seen nesting in long-abandoned power plants, POKENAME is considered highly-dangerous. Aggressive to outsiders, it fires electrically-charged needles that launch with the speed of lightning, and boom like thunder when fired.

entry: 仅仅POKENAME在场，就会令人毛发竖起、心跳加速。手腕一动，它就能造雷暴，以念力把宝可梦直抛进去。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's mere presence causes one's hairs to stand on end and for hearts to race. With a flick of its wrist, it can create thunderstorms and telekinetically hurl Pokémon straight into them.

entry: 仅仅POKENAME在场，就会令人毛发竖起、心跳加速。手腕一动，它就能造雷暴，以念力把宝可梦直抛进去。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's mere presence causes one's hairs to stand on end and hearts to race. With a flick of its wrist, it can create thunderstorms and telekinetically hurl Pokémon straight into them.

entry: POKENAME只为好玩，就用喙破坏高压线，造成多次停电。谁敢阻止，它就以毁灭性的精神与电击组合，猛烈还击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME destroys high-voltage power lines with its beak just for fun, causing multiple blackouts. If anyone dares to stop it, POKENAME strikes back with a fierce combination of devastating psychic and electric attacks.

entry: POKENAME体内发电，严格依照固定日程。每小时整点，都会向周身排出一小股多余电力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's internal electric generation follows a strict regulation schedule. It vents a small burst of excess electricity around its body every hour, on the hour.

entry: 有人见过POKENAME不小心电到自己的触角。即使在带电的水中，它也能游动生存。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME have been seen accidentally shocking their antennae. This Pokémon can survive swimming in electrified waters.

entry: POKENAME身体仍在发育，还不能好好飞，也控不住电。每次拍翼练起飞，都会向近处四周射出强大雷电。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is still developing, so it cannot properly fly or control its electricity yet. Whenever it flaps its wings to practice taking flight, it sends short range bolts of powerful lightning around it.

entry: POKENAME性情快乐，却不太理解，也控不好力量。太开心，它会蹦跳，四处喷火花，甚至小道闪电，可能给想一起玩的对象添麻烦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a joyous personality, but little understanding or control of its powers. When overjoyed it prances and sprays sparks and even small bolts of lightning around, potentially causing problems for those it wants to play with.

entry: POKENAME常成群飞向闪电鸟将于24小时内现身的地方。虽然外形相似，也共享部分能力，它们却只产得出足以轻微静电电人的电力。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME often flock to areas that Zapdos will appear at within 24 hours. Though they resemble such a powerful legendary bird and share some of its abilities, they are only capable of producing enough electricity to cause a slight static shock.

entry: POKENAME皮肤分泌导电毒素，将雷电引向自己。风暴时，它蹲在高树或建筑顶，急切等雷劈。每道闪电，足以维持六个月能量。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's skin secretes a conductive toxin that draws lightning toward it. During storms, it perches atop tall trees or buildings, eagerly awaiting a strike. Each bolt provides enough energy to sustain it for six months.

entry: POKENAME在风暴夜外出，引雷入体，吸收电压。每次如此，原本站的地面，都会留下圆形焦痕。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME ventures out during stormy nights in order to draw lightning to its body, absorbing the voltage. When it does so, circular scorch marks are left in the ground where it stood.

entry: POKENAME把电储在背部鼓胀的花苞里，放电前，花苞会脉动火花。越强大，身体磁性越强，偶尔会黏上金属物。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME stores electrical power in the swollen bud on its back, which pulses with sparks before discharges. As it grows stronger, its body becomes increasingly magnetic, occasionally causing metal objects to stick to it.

entry: 数处古遗迹，都见过类似POKENAME的图画。研究显示，当地雷暴频发，古文明或曾视它为先兆。
author: sk372
source: Drawings resembling POKENAME have been seen within a number of ancient ruins. Research suggests the areas were prone to heavy lightning storms, so POKENAME may have been considered a harbinger of such by those old civilizations.

entry: 破译的古壁画文字记载，众多POKENAME聚集，曾引发巨大雷暴。但它们极其稀有，现代从未见过此景。
author: darkweavile428
source: Deciphered text from ancient murals tells of massive thunderstorms caused by the gathering of many POKENAME. However, since POKENAME are extremely rare, this has never been seen in modern times.

entry: POKENAME的前半身酷似伽勒尔的闪电鸟，非常喜欢高速奔跑。后半身却不太适合这样跑动，常常得费上一番力气，才能跟上前半身。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's front half resembles Zapdos's Galarian counterpart, and has a strong tendency to run about at high speeds. The back half is less equipped for running in such a manner, so it struggles to keep pace.

entry: POKENAME住在山顶，召风暴劈地，形成嵌入地下的闪电熔岩柱，标记领地。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live atop mountains where they summon storms to strike the ground with lightning. This forms fulgurite columns embedded into the ground, marking their territory.

entry: POKENAME的尖刺能扎穿人类皮肤，把电流直接送进体内。凡发现它们的水域，都禁止游泳。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's quills are able to pierce human skin and discharge electricity directly into the body. Swimming is off limits anywhere they are spotted.

entry: 有人认为，若海中常见的是POKENAME，而非巨翅飞鱼，与之互利共生的铁炮鱼，最终会演化出截然不同的身体特征。碰它，会挨锐利电击。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is thought that if POKENAME were common in the seas instead of Mantine, the mutualistic Pokémon called Remoraid would eventually evolve to have drastically different physical characteristics. Touching POKENAME results in a sharp shock.

entry: POKENAME用头上喙状角，召来、引导雷电。同群伙伴互相电击，比赛排地位，并不罕见。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME summons and channels lightning via the beak-like horn on its head. Its not uncommon to see pack-mates zapping each other to compete and determine hierarchy among themselves.

entry: POKENAME野外极稀有，在废服务器机房安家，用电脑线缆铺巢。
author: .izik
source: Extremely rare in the wild, POKENAME makes its home in derelict server rooms. It uses computer cables to line its nest.

entry: POKENAME摇尾尖，在体内产生大量电力，让躯干眼纹发光。振动够多，还能造猛烈雷云，电击近处一切。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME shakes the tip of its tail to generate vast amounts of electricity in its body, which causes the eye pattern on its torso to glow. Vibrating its tail enough lets it create violent storm clouds that zap anything near it.

entry: POKENAME奔走各地，很少在一处逗留超过一天。一旦留下，待得越久，当地轰鸣的猛烈雷云就越多。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME races across the land, rarely staying in one locale for more than a day. When it does linger, fierce rumbling storm clouds begin to accumulate in the area more and more the longer it stays.

entry: POKENAME难寻踪迹，会在周围召风暴，躲避训练家与宝可梦的目光。大家都躲雷时，它们便掠水找养分。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are elusive creatures that conjure storms around them to avoid being seen by Trainers and Pokémon. While everyone is hiding away from lightning strikes, they glide across bodies of water to find nourishment.

entry: 一道耀光、一声雷鸣，POKENAME便能疾穿时间。穿时后，旅程能量仍附着身体，让它继续迸火花数秒。
author: pattybgoode
source: With a brilliant flash and a peal of thunder, POKENAME has the power to zip through time. It sparks for several seconds after time-traveling, the energy from the trip still clinging to its body.

entry: POKENAME尾巴制造、托住满是电力的云，再挤压着向四面放电。其他宝可梦逃避电击时，它会发出尖锐怪笑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tails create and hold clouds brimming with electricity, squeezing them to send numerous volts in every direction. It lets out a shrieking cackle as other Pokémon flee to avoid being zapped.

entry: POKENAME甲胄导电性极强，能从掌孔，以极高速度发射等离子体加速的岩石。没装石头，就改射集中的等离子体，但射程较短。
author: potato_tub
source: POKENAME's highly conductive armor allows it to launch plasma-boosted rocks from its hand holes at extreme velocity. When no rocks are loaded, it fires concentrated plasma instead, though at a shorter range.

entry: POKENAME羽毛储电多得难以想象。身体轻轻擦过，连最强健的宝可梦也会麻痹。
author: ayner
source: The feathers of POKENAME can store an unfathomable amounts of electricity. A simple graze of their body can paralyze even the sturdiest of Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME钻地时，用坚喙破土，却得避开岩石。它们蜷成球，以电力覆身，保护自己。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their sturdy beaks to break through dirt as they burrow underground, yet they must avoid rocks. They curl up into balls and veil themselves with electricity to protect themselves.

entry: POKENAME能控制雷电，是猛烈风暴中出行的理想坐骑。但它们稀少，旅途耗时又短，能坐它出行，实属奢侈。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are the perfect mode of transportation when needing to travel during harsh storms since they can control lightning. However, due to how rare these Pokémon are and how low travel distance times are, affording to travel on one is a luxury.

entry: 有时能看见POKENAME揉动大植物根旁的土。微弱电击传入地面，刺激根部，帮助植物保持健康。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can sometimes be seen kneading the dirt near the roots of large plants. This sends light electrical jolts through the ground that stimulate the roots and help the plant continue to stay healthy.

entry: POKENAME身体对周围天气极敏锐，能帮气象学家预测落雷位置。有了预测，科学家就能引雷进电池，快速给大型机器充电。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME help meteorologists predict where lightning will strike, as their bodies are acutely attuned to the weather around them. With these predictions, scientists can redirect lightning into batteries to rapidly charge large machines.

entry: POKENAME挖洞，用喙破开岩石。战斗时，刺毛变硬，彼此间连起电弧。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their beaks to break apart rocks while digging. During battle, their quills become rigid and electricity arcs between each quill.

entry: POKENAME能召风暴，向敌人洒下雷电。身体虽通常闪着电弧，靠近训练家，却会平静得多。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have the power to call forth storms and rain lightning down upon their foes. Although their bodies usually arc with electricity, they will be much more calm near their Trainers.

entry: POKENAME强腿让它在地面以近每小时70英里疾跑。与训练家亲近后，它常主动快速载对方，去任何需要的地方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's powerful legs let it dash across the ground at speeds approaching 70 MPH. Once it bonds with a Trainer, it regularly offers to ferry them quickly to wherever they need to go.

entry: POKENAME的杖能造不同温度的气泡。它们将气泡混合，生成雷云攻击，或操纵空气密度，造出蜃景。
author: actliux
source: The rod POKENAME carries has the ability to produce bubbles of varying temperatures. They will combine these bubbles to generate thunder clouds to attack, or create mirages by manipulating air density.

entry: POKENAME将强大电力与高超剑术结合，战斗成效出色。最强一击时，它先蓄能，再借雷电爆冲向前，斩开沿途一切。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME uses its powerful electrical abilities in conjunction with great swordfighting skill to great effect in combat. For its most powerful attack, it charges up and blasts itself forward with lightning, cutting through anything in its path.

entry: POKENAME战斗中弹射巨舌。针状舌尖一碰敌人，就给予毁灭性电击。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME fires its giant tongue during battle. Once the needle-like tip makes contact with an enemy, POKENAME delivers a devastating shock.

entry: POKENAME靠电磁力悬浮，即使沿陡角攀爬，也能维持身体与腿相连。它们为风暴受困者充当掩体，抬高身体，以腿将电导入地面。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Suspended through electromagnetic force, POKENAME are able to maintain their connections to their legs even while climbing at harsh angles.  They act as bunkers to those stranded in storms, lifting their bodies while their legs ground electricity.

entry: POKENAME爪中充满强电，以雷电般的精准出击。它察知敌意，再用完美的击倒一击，反制攻击。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME strikes with lightning precision, its paws charged with intense electrical power. It detects the intentions of its enemy to counter their attack with a perfect knockout blow.

entry: POKENAME背部长满浓叶，总噼啪带电。雷雨时，它静卧，用叶丛吸收大量电能。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's back is overgrown with thick leaves that constantly crackle with stray voltage. During thunderstorms, it lies still and uses its foliage to absorb massive amounts of electrical energy.

entry: POKENAME背塔不断产生大量电力。研究者盼在野外找到更多，因为它能大大帮助世界各地发电厂。
author: sk372
source: The tower on POKENAME's back is consistently producing large amounts of electricity. Researchers are hoping to find more POKENAME in the wild, as they could be a great boon to power plants across the world.

entry: 据说，POKENAME能一头冲进电源插座，融入电流，迅速穿行城市。这让它们占尽先机，随时能伏击对手。
author: doodledoo
source: It is said that POKENAME is able to charge head-first into power outlets, being able to disappear into the electrical current and quickly travel through cities. This puts them in the perfect situation to ambush rivals.

entry: POKENAME只在强风暴中现身，因此被称为“雷电之主”。据说，尖锐叫声响如雷鸣。
author: mepp.
source: As POKENAME is only seen during intense storms, it is referred to as "Lord of Lightning". Its piercing cry is said to be as loud as thunder.

entry: 闪电一亮，POKENAME就能从看不见的世界具现。据说，它会跟踪害怕雷雨的人。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME can materialize from an unseen realm with the flash of a lightning bolt. It is said to stalk those afraid of thunderstorms.

entry: 海面出现雷暴，可能就意味着附近有POKENAME。只要POKENAME重新潜入水中，风暴很快便会散去。
author: kitarchen
source: If you see a thunderstorm over the ocean, it may mean a POKENAME is near. The storm will quickly pass once POKENAME dives back down into the water.

entry: POKENAME的喙能放出足以毁山的电力。压倒性的力量，让许多人相信，它是神圣存在。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's beak can discharge electricity powerful enough to destroy mountains. This overwhelming force led many to believe it was divine.

entry: 据说POKENAME是传说中的战士，伴着猛烈雷暴现身。炽烈电流流遍身体，以电光般速度出击，让敌人灼伤、麻痹。
author: thepandasharky
source: A Pokémon said to be a legendary warrior, appearing alongside raging thunderstorms. POKENAME channels fiery electricity through its body, unleashing electrified blows at blazing speed. Its strikes leave foes scorched and paralyzed.

entry: POKENAME三角在雷雨中伸长，引雷入体，获取能量。它并用电力与剃刀般利翼攻击。
author: sleepyman0731
source: POKENAME's three horns extend during thunderstorms, guiding lightning strikes to itself for energy. POKENAME attacks using a combination of electricity and its razor-sharp wings.

entry: POKENAME是传说中的剑宝可梦，栖息于火山熔岩附近，也能在熔岩中再生。据说，它若出现在别处，春天也会随之到来。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is a legendary sword Pokémon that resides around and regenerates in volcanic lava. Its appearance elsewhere is said to bring about spring.

entry: POKENAME从不落地，一生都在高空。飞时，雷暴在周围形成，它便以落雷攻击横过前路的宝可梦与飞机。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME never touches the ground, living its entire life high in the sky. Thunderstorms form around them as they fly, and they weaponise the bolts of lightning by using them to strike at other Pokémon and aircraft flying across their path.

entry: POKENAME从不落地，一生都在高空。飞时，雷暴在周围形成，它便以落雷攻击横过前路的宝可梦与飞机。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME never touches the ground, living its entire life high in the sky. Thunderstorms form around them as they fly, and they weaponise the bolts of lightning by using them to strike at other Pokémon and aircraft flying across their path.

entry: POKENAME从不落地，一生都在高空。飞时，雷暴在周围形成，它便以落雷攻击横过前路的宝可梦与飞机。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME never touches the ground, living its entire life high in the sky. Thunderstorms form around them as they fly, and they weaponise the bolts of lightning by using them to strike at other Pokémon and aircraft flying across their path.

entry: 据说这种传说宝可梦会在雷云中优雅起舞，再伴着雷电猛扑而下。
author: melodydelune
source: This legendary Pokémon is said to dance elegantly amongst thunderclouds, with the ability to pounce down among bolts of lightning.

entry: POKENAME先以蛮力将物体打碎，再向残骸劈巨雷，直到什么也不剩。每次跺脚、厚尾重砸，都轰鸣得数英里可闻。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME shatters objects into pieces with its brute strength before dropping giant lightning bolts on the remains to leave nothing behind. Every stomp of its feet and slam of its thick tail creates booming thunders that can be heard for miles.

entry: 这种POKENAME带有伽勒尔闪电鸟的特征，低掠地面，速度惊人。体内强电噼啪迸发，将飞过的地面夷平。
author: sk372
source: This variant of POKENAME takes on aspects of the Galarian form of Zapdos. It flies low to the ground at incredible speeds, intense lightning crackling from its body and razing the land it flies over.

entry: 从前，人们认为，看见POKENAME飞行，就预示天气灾害将至。它们以噼啪电流与强风覆身，防御捕食者。
author: chibitales
source: Sighting a POKENAME in flight was thought to herald the approach of weather-related natural disasters. They cover their bodies in crackling electricity and hard winds to defend against predators.

entry: 这种POKENAME精于控风控电。筑巢时极危险，会用毁灭性的电磁炮与破坏光线守巢。
author: chibitales
source: This variant of POKENAME expertly controls both wind and electricity. Nesting POKENAME are extremely dangerous, defending their nests with devastating Zap Cannons and Hyper Beams.

entry: 据说POKENAME预告破坏性雷暴将至。人们正努力追踪，建立预警系统，保护居民。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME is said to herald the approach of devastating thunderstorms. Efforts are being made to track it and create an early warning system to protect citizens.

entry: POKENAME从世界各地人们的噩梦中，吸取电能。乡间将暗雷云与它相连，恐惧传播、梦境更坏，只会让它更强。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME absorbs electrical energy from the nightmares of people across the world. Rural communities link dark storm clouds to its presence, spreading fear and worsening dreams, which only makes it stronger.

entry: POKENAME从世界各地人们的噩梦中，吸取电能。乡间将暗雷云与它相连，恐惧传播、梦境更坏，只会让它更强。
author: h0bojoe
