source: POKENAME absorbs electrical energy from the nightmares of people across the world. Rural communities link dark storm clouds to its presence, spreading fear and worsening dreams, which only makes it stronger.

entry: POKENAME见于环境电力很高的地方。历史记录多在雷暴中，近来却成群涌入发电厂，用爪吸干发电机。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are found in areas with high levels of ambient electricity. Historical records depict them as mainly being found within thunderstorms, but recently they have been found swarming power plants, using their claws to drain generators of power.

entry: POKENAME虽小，看似无害，没穿坚实橡胶护具，仍绝不可碰。接触电气息，受害者会承受约80千伏电击。
author: _pixelar_
source: Despite POKENAME's small and harmless appearance, it should never be touched without very sturdy rubber protective gear. Contact with its electric aura inflicts approximately 80 kilovolts on the victim.

entry: POKENAME战斗中，从翅膀散出带电余烬，压制对手。长喙刺穿猎物，再用强电将其解决。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME will scatter electrified embers from its wings during battle to help overwhelm its opponent. POKENAME use their long beaks to impale their prey and finish them with a powerful jolt of electricity.

entry: POKENAME从3个头洒雷，电击沿途一切，使电网过载。它带来干雷暴，暴走所到之处，野火就会失控。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME rains down lightning bolts from its 3 heads, electrocuting all in its path and overloading electrical grids. Its presence causes dry thunderstorms to occur, which allows wildfires to grow out of control anywhere it rampages.

entry: POKENAME一甩手腕，就能放出成百上千伏电力。它太神秘、太危险，目前无法妥善用作电源，只听经验老到的训练家指令。
author: bobosmith01
source: With a flick of its wrist, POKENAME can release hundreds upon thousands of volts of electricity. It is too enigmatic and dangerous to properly be used as a power source at this time. It only follows the orders of a seasoned Trainer.

entry: POKENAME住在发电厂等电力管理设施旁。有游离电力，羽毛便耀眼闪亮。维修队留意当地种群，提前安排设施维护。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME reside near power plants and other electrical management facilities. Their feathers dazzle in the presence of loose electricity. Maintenance crews keep an eye on the local population of POKENAME to stay ahead of facility maintenance.

entry: POKENAME带电的尾巴，水下也从不熄灭；烦躁时，会胡乱迸火花。训练家应让它远离电子设备。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's electrified tail never goes out, even underwater, sparking erratically when it's agitated. Trainers are advised to keep it away from electronic devices.

entry: 接触朱红色花蜜，POKENAME就呈现近似帕底亚一种独特舞蹈的风格。据说表演电力十足，却极少有人见过。
author: roundabout_robin
source: When exposed to Red Nectar, POKENAME takes on a style similar to a very distinct Paldean dance. Its performances are said to be electrifying to watch, though few have ever seen it.

entry: POKENAME常飞进雷云，吸收电力。耳中释放的音爆，震耳如雷。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME often fly through storm clouds to absorb the electricity within. The sonic booms loosed from a POKENAME's ears are as deafening as thunder.

entry: POKENAME藏在云中，凭锐眼与迅捷反应，猎取远在下方的猎物。雷雨时，许多人把轰鸣叫声，误当滚雷。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's keen eyesight and swift reflexes allow it to hunt prey far below as it conceals itself within the clouds. Many mistake its booming cry during thunderstorms for rolling thunder.

entry: 它在全身积电，飞行挨雷时，也能直接吸收。POKENAME很聪明，演化出的角，能将雷电集中，射成轨道炮般的冲击。
author: infinex21
source: It builds up electricity across its body and can directly absorb lightning bolts that strike it as it flies. POKENAME is a clever Pokémon whose horns have evolved to let it concentrate bolts of lightning into a railgun-like blast.

entry: POKENAME的叫声天生带回响，几乎谁听都会不安。它们住在多风暴地区，巢筑高处，最易挨雷；纯粹雷电也能安全吸收。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's cry inherently echoes in a way that unnerves almost anything that hears it. They live within stormy regions, nesting at high elevations where they are most likely to be struck by lightning; they can absorb raw lightning without risk.

entry: POKENAME身体由未知材料构成，导电性胜过一切已知物质。它能靠电浮起，从掌部开口放雷，击落敌人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's body is made of an unknown material that conducts electricity better than any known material. It can use electricity to keep itself afloat and it will loose lightning bolts from the open ports of its palms to down its foes.

entry: 雷雨中进森林，极罕见才能瞥到这只宝可梦。人们认为，POKENAME劈雷毁树，是盼日后回来吃腐木。
author: .realthree
source: Very rarely, a person entering a forest during a thunderstorm manages to catch a glimpse of this Pokémon. It is thought that POKENAME calls down lightning to destroy trees in the hopes of later returning to eat the rotting wood.

entry: POKENAME曾占据整座城市的电线，向倒霉群众传送音乐。事后，既多次停电，也留下严重头痛。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME once took over power lines throughout an entire city to channel its music to hapless crowds. The aftermath caused several power outages and nasty headaches.

entry: 遭到雷击后，POKENAME的身体便充满能量，能在极短时间内，产生大量孢子，足以让整个村庄，都覆上一层薄薄的黄色粉末。
author: .izik
source: After being struck by lightning, POKENAME's body becomes energized and can produce a large amount of spores in a very short period. It can generate enough to coat an entire village in a thin layer of yellow powder.

entry: POKENAME住在险峻高山顶，召雷暴把猎物吹下山坡，再爬下去享用。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME lives at the top of treacherously tall mountains. It summons thunderstorms to blow its prey off of the mountainside, then climbs down to enjoy its meal.

entry: POKENAME的洞会不定时释放强大电流。挖好后数天内，电击仍会毫无预警出现，连班基拉斯也轻易麻痹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's burrows sporadically release intense electrical surges. These shocks can easily paralyze even a Tyranitar without warning for days after digging.

entry: POKENAME在高云安家，钻过云层时放电，给云充能，所过之处便形成风暴。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME make their homes high in the clouds. They release electricity as they burrow through them, charging the clouds and creating storms wherever they go.

entry: POKENAME偏爱多风暴的岛。背景雷电让它们摆脱自己的思绪，因为想得太多，就会头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME prefer to live on islands with lots of storms. The lightning in the background helps them escape their own thoughts, which can cause headaches if they ruminate too much on them.

entry: POKENAME召雷暴，劈击湖河。雷暴过去，它们再俯冲，吃掉水面浮着的受电击宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can conjure thunderstorms to strike lakes and rivers. Once the thunderstorm passes, POKENAME swoop in to eat the electrocuted Pokémon that float on the surface.

entry: POKENAME如雷吠声传出数英里，定能吓退侵入领地者。幼崽一起玩，也能听见同样的雷响。
author: wiz0z
source: The thunderous barks of POKENAME can be heard for miles, certain to scare off anyone encroaching on its territory. The same thunder can be heard when young POKENAME play together.

entry: POKENAME把胸前宝石当电池，通常能供数千瓦电力。能量不断补充体力，让它能超音速跑上数小时。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME uses the gem on its chest as a battery, usually containing thousands of watts. POKENAME draws on this energy to constantly replenish its stamina, allowing it to run at supersonic speeds for hours.

entry: POKENAME在山顶筑巢，造成永不停歇的风暴。据说致命风暴，只为内心纯洁、灵魂坚如钢的训练家平息。它一吼，必有雷声相随。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME nests at the top of mountains, causing a perpetual storm. It is said the deadly storm that surrounds its home only calms for a pure-hearted Trainer with a soul of steel. Whenever POKENAME roars, a clap of thunder is sure to follow.

entry: POKENAME藏在积云，储电却慢慢使云变暗、打雷。藏身云一成雷云，它就瞬间移动，换一朵“干净”的云。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides itself within cumulus clouds, its electric stores slowly turning them dark and thunderous. Once its current hiding spot turns thunderous, it teleports to another, "clean" cloud to hide.

entry: POKENAME的勺子是极强避雷针，引电极精准。攻击时，它们把一支掷向对手，再召来尽可能强的雷，丝毫不计所需电力。
author: thesilverowls
source: The spoons of POKENAME are incredibly strong lightning rods, drawing electric energy to them with incredible acuity. To attack, they throw one at the opponent and call down as strong a lightning bolt they can, not caring for how much power is needed.

entry: POKENAME的体力与掌雷之力，都富传奇色彩。手臂每动，翅膀静电都会噼啪作响。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are legendary for both their physical strength and their power over lightning. Every movement of their arms causes their wings to audibly crackle with static electricity.

entry: POKENAME在山顶筑巢，造成永不停歇的风暴。据说致命风暴，只为内心纯洁、灵魂坚如钢的训练家平息。它一吼，必有雷声相随。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME nests at the top of mountains, causing a perpetual storm. It is said the deadly storm that surrounds its home only calms for a pure-hearted Trainer with a soul of steel. Whenever POKENAME roars, a clap of thunder is sure to follow.

entry: POKENAME敲碎岩石、扬起泥土，用地中矿物传电。它从收藏中折下石块，投向敌人，再引强雷，形成毁灭性打击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME break down rocks and kick up dirt in order to use the minerals in the ground to channel their electricity. They break off rocks from their collection to fling at their enemies, directing powerful bolts of lightning into devastating strikes.

entry: POKENAME跑步生疏，一绊倒，雷就会劈向倒地处。吸收电力后，它又有能量站起，继续四处疾跑。
author: soup1900
source: Whenever POKENAME stumbles and falls to the ground due to its inexperience in running, lightning will strike at its location. Absorbing the power from this lightning bolt gives it the energy to get up and start dashing around again.

entry: POKENAME奔驰得极快，仿佛一道噼啪作响的闪电划空而过。只有它最信任的对象，才能碰触它，而不被带电的毛发电到。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gallops with such speed that it could be mistaken for a bolt of lightning crackling through the air. Only those it trusts the most are able to touch it without being zapped by its electrified fur.

entry: POKENAME虽能聚集空中带电云，召来强大雷暴，却不聪明。咬着尾巴的雷云向脑放电，才让它想出些有道理的念头。
author: gaogao028
source: Albeit capable of gathering charged clouds in the sky to summon heavy thunderstorms, POKENAME lacks wits. The storm cloud biting its tail sends discharges to its brain, allowing it to muster sensible thoughts.

entry: POKENAME用两个头的喙互蹭，释放电力。羽毛满是静电，脱落数周，仍带着电。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME rub the beaks of their two heads together to release their electricity. Their feathers are rife with static electricity and remain charged for weeks after being shed.

entry: POKENAME三头齐叫，就能引雷击敌。疾跑产生的电，让毛与羽噼啪作响。
author: infinex21
source: When all three of POKENAME's heads cry in unison, it can call forth lightning to strike its foe. Its feathers and fur crackle with electricity generated by its rapid running.

entry: POKENAME外形启发了一款受欢迎的浮水儿童玩具。防水羽毛锁住体热，让它在水下数小时也能保暖。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's appearance has inspired a popular children's toy that floats on water. Its waterproof feathers trap heat near its body, allowing it to stay warm for hours while underwater.

entry: POKENAME一不高兴，就爱发脾气，同时猛喷强焰。性子不定，应由有经验的训练家照料。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are known to throw tantrums when displeased, unleashing a powerful burst of flame in the process. Due to their volatile nature, they should be handled by experienced Trainers.

entry: POKENAME会灼烧想吃自己的飞行属性宝可梦。它们爱吃轻烤的叶，会生火，烤出合适口感。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME will sear Flying-type Pokémon that try to eat them. They prefer their leaves lightly toasted and will start fires to achieve the right texture.

entry: POKENAME升高周围温度，造出厚重闷热的空气，让捕食者改去别处吃。据说，从它身上拔一片绯红羽毛，能带来好运。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME raise the temperature around them to create a thick muggy atmosphere and convince predators to eat elsewhere. Plucking a scarlet feather off of a POKENAME is said to bring good luck.

entry: POKENAME的火焰永远燃烧，无法熄灭。即使是水，也只会让火势更旺。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: POKENAME's fire burns forever and cannot be extinguished. Even water only strengthens the fire.

entry: 若训练家将POKENAME抛向繁星夜空，它就会如流星般飞行。扔得越远，它就越听训练家的话。
author: teatedtiten
source: If POKENAME's Trainer throws it into a starry night sky, POKENAME will fly similar to a shooting star. The further POKENAME is thrown, the more POKENAME will listen to its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME旋转火焰的光，常被说能与太阳本身媲美。宝石状核心热得水一碰，就立刻蒸发。
author: infinex21
source: The light of a POKENAME's spinning flames is often claimed to rival the light of the sun itself. Its gem-like core is so hot that water will instantly evaporate upon touching it.

entry: POKENAME与燃烧身体，只要在场，就足以使室温升高30度。它贪婪吸食发电厂电能，维持高体温。
author: fiordaliso
source: The mere presence of POKENAME and its flaming body is enough to raise the temperature of a room by 30 degrees. It voraciously feeds on electrical energy from power plants to maintain its high body temperature.

entry: POKENAME能召火焰风暴，烧毁整片森林，却不肯下定决心用火之石进化。它们对这选择太紧张，能回避，就回避。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can call upon fiery storms to burn down entire forests but will not commit to evolution through a Fire Stone. They feel nervous about committing to evolution, so much so that they avoid the issue when they can.

entry: POKENAME发怒出击，体内囊体就会升温，释放灼人热量。传说中，它曾恶意撒下余烬，烧毁王国。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: When POKENAME lash out, the sacs inside their body heat up, causing them to release searing amounts of heat. In legends, POKENAME maliciously scattered embers to burn down kingdoms.

entry: POKENAME吞吃数据，周围硬件便开始过热。若不制止，它可能无意中，熔毁整间服务器机房。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME devours data, surrounding hardware begins to overheat. If unchecked, it can inadvertently melt down entire server rooms.

entry: 有人推测，POKENAME古代曾存在，也很可能像如今一般，栖在火山。它们天天泡熔岩，让火焰每日都明亮、旺盛。
author: infinex21
source: Some theorize that POKENAME once existed in the past and that they likely perched upon volcanoes then as they do now. POKENAME bathe in lava every day, ensuring that their flames burn brightly and intensely each day.

entry: POKENAME飞过冬空，沿途点亮极光。极光只有暖色，让人即使仅片刻，也觉得像夏天。
author: bandedbodypress
source: As POKENAME flies through the winter sky, it lights up wherever it goes with an aurora. This aurora only appears in warm colors and makes it feel like summer, if just for a moment.

entry: POKENAME身体放出耀眼强光，火焰热过岩浆，闪电快得目光难追。
author: juliho27
source: POKENAME's body radiates blinding light, with flames that burn hotter than magma and lightning that strikes faster than the eye can follow.

entry: 火焰鸟自我融合后，火势强得身体也承受不住，便化成一只纯火构成的生物。
author: pastamanjase
source: Upon fusing Moltres with itself, its flames grow to a strength too powerful for its own body. This causes it to transform into a creature made of pure fire.

entry: POKENAME永燃的身体，散出强烈热量。它却胆小得一有危险迹象，就立刻藏起。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's ever-burning body radiates an intense heat. It is incredibly skittish, hiding away at the first sign of danger.

entry: POKENAME生病、受伤时，会泡在熔岩池中治疗自己。背焰闪耀如太阳，暴怒时更会高涨。
author: mepp.
source: When sick or injured, POKENAME can be seen bathing in lava pools to heal itself. The flames along its back shimmer like the sun and flare up when it becomes enraged.

entry: POKENAME会泡熔岩池，放松身心，从激战中恢复。暴怒时，背焰猛烈燃烧。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME can be seen bathing in lava pools to relax and recover from intense fights. The flames along its back burn vigorously when it becomes enraged.

entry: 火对POKENAME如同生命力，仅一簇稳定火焰，就能汲出惊人能量。它出现在战场，观察者会报告天空转红。
author: bobosmith01
source: Fire is akin to POKENAME's life force: POKENAME can draw incredible energy from a single stable flame. When it appears on a battlefield, observers report the sky turning red.

entry: POKENAME在火山最深处筑巢熟睡。两次睡眠之间，它游历大地，裹着防护火球，探索世界。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME nests itself deep within the hearts of volcanoes. It roams the land between these slumbers, exploring the world while wreathed in a sphere of protective flames.

entry: 有人见过POKENAME不小心烧掉自己的触角。即便如此，它也能在熔岩中游动生存。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME have been seen accidentally incinerating their antennae. This Pokémon can survive swimming in molten lava.

entry: POKENAME身体涌动着等离子体般的能量。什么靠得太近，能量就会爆出，将其电焦。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME's body surges with a plasma-like energy. If anything gets too close, this Pokémon's energy will burst forth and zap it to a crisp.

entry: POKENAME飞过城市，寻找理想垃圾箱。一找到，就用火烧灼里面的垃圾，烤成自己喜欢的口味，再大吃。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME soar above cities, searching for an ideal dumpster to eat from. Once found, they will use their flames to scorch the trash inside, cooking it to their liking before digging in.

entry: POKENAME从不独居，成片长在温泉旁。整片产热太高，连附近泉水都蒸发。
author: elevn.
source: POKENAME never live alone, they grow together in large fields near thermal springs. The heat generated by POKENAME fields is so high that water from nearby springs evaporates.

entry: POKENAME成熟，花瓣便白热发光。聚集时，头部产热之高，能将地沙熔成玻璃。
author: elevn.
source: When POKENAME reach maturity, their petals become incandescent. When they are grouped, the heat generated by their heads is so high that the sand on the ground turns into glass.

entry: POKENAME住在古老山峰，小队巡查领地，监测可能引发大范围野火的环境因素。夏前，它们烧掉多余枯植物，清除能引火上树的可燃物。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME reside on ancient mountain peaks and survey their territory in small squads. They monitor the environmental factors that can lead to widespread wildfire, burning excess dead plant material prior to the summer to remove ladder fuels.

entry: POKENAME栖居在最高的山顶。冬季，它任由猛烈的降雪压弱火势，陷入沉睡。等到春天来临，就使出燃尽，将山顶的积雪彻底清除。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME lives at the top of the tallest mountains. Over winter it lets its fires be dampened by the harsh snowfall and falls into a deep slumber. Once Spring arrives, it uses Burn Up to completely clear the mountaintop of snow.

entry: POKENAME一动用精神力量，脑就会过热。夹在头上的王冠喷火，防止头部融化。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Activating its psychic powers causes POKENAME's brain to overheat. The crown clamped to its head spews out flames to prevent its head from melting.

entry: POKENAME能操控各种火焰，也能幻化出高大的凤凰影像，替代自己娇小的身姿。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME has the power to control all kinds of fire. It is able to conjure images of a towering phoenix in place of its diminutive form.

entry: POKENAME短程滑过干旱地区，寻找食物与庇护。它将尾焰旋成钻头状，作出防御威吓，劝退袭击者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME glides short distances across dry areas in search of food and shelter. It spins the flame on its tail into a drill-like spiral as a defensive display to deter attackers.

entry: POKENAME住在火山岩浆房，只有家园喷发，才偶尔出来。地震学家监测种群与活动，盼能预测下次喷发。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live within the magma chambers of volcanoes, only occasionally emerging when their home undergoes an eruption. Seismologists monitor POKENAME populations and their movements in the hopes that they will let them predict the next eruption.

entry: POKENAME生活在火山活动频繁处。受伤或生病，就潜入温泉，恢复活力。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME lives in areas with high volcanic activity. If it is injured or ill, it will dive into hot springs to rejuvenate its body.

entry: POKENAME靠体内温度煮沸水，从嘴里喷出高压灼热蒸汽。燃烧的翼状鳍，让它短暂滑翔水面，捕捉猎物。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME use their internal temperature to boil water within their bodies, shooting high-pressure streams of scalding steam from their mouth. Their flaming wing-like fins allow them to glide briefly above the surface to catch prey.

entry: POKENAME极爱群居，选择紧密鱼群，而不独行。大群一起移动，橙身与发光火鳍，仿佛一道流动火河。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME are highly social, choosing to swim in tight shoals rather than traveling alone. When a large school moves together, their orange bodies and glowing flame-fins create the illusion of a flowing river of fire.

entry: POKENAME身边常围着许多小宝可梦，由它保护。小家伙以火山烤熟的食物回报，让它更强。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are found with many smaller Pokémon around them that they protect. In exchange for protection, these Pokémon bring it food that they roast in volcanoes, which increases POKENAME's strength.

entry: POKENAME身边常围着许多小宝可梦，尤其铁炮鱼，由它保护。小家伙以地热喷口烤熟的食物回报，让它更强。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are found with many smaller Pokémon around them that they protect, especially Remoraid. In exchange for protection, these Pokémon bring it food that they roast in geothermal vents, which increases POKENAME's strength.

entry: POKENAME身边常围着许多小宝可梦，由它保护。小家伙以地热喷口烤熟的食物回报，让它更强。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are found with many smaller Pokémon around them that they protect. In exchange for protection, these Pokémon bring it food that they roast in geothermal vents, which increases POKENAME's strength.

entry: POKENAME能把剃刀般锋利、燃烧着的金属羽毛，掷向任何打扰者。火热得战斗太久，部分金属身体就可能开始融化。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can fling razor-sharp burning metal feathers at anything that bothers it. The heat of its fire is so great that prolonged battle may risk causing some of its metal body to begin melting.

entry: 它的身体产生强焰，常从双翼与后部喷出，推动自己飞过天空。据说身体坚硬如钢，即使坠落，也能自保。
author: infinex21
source: Its body produces potent flames which it often releases from its wings and from its rear to launch itself through the sky. Its body is said to be as hard as steel as a means to protect itself should it crash.

entry: POKENAME完全控制身上火焰。小心别冒犯，因为它记仇，谁惹怒，就烧毁谁的文件。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has complete control over the flames on its body. Care should be taken not to offend it, as it has a vindictive personality and will burn down the files of anyone who angers it.

entry: POKENAME的奶能长久保持滚烫，余味似胡椒。有些地区爱用来做辣意面酱。
author: sk372
source: Milk sourced from POKENAME remains piping hot for a long amount of time. It has a pepper-like aftertaste to it, and is popular in some regions as an ingredient for spicy pasta sauces.

entry: 越久不挤奶，POKENAME的火就越热、越野。饲主须严格按时挤奶，免留日后火患。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's flames burn hotter and more wildly the longer it goes without milking. Owners need to make sure to keep a strict milking regiment to avoid potential future fire hazards.

entry: POKENAME广游陆地与天空。跑时，每步留下小火焰；飞时，每次振翅，都噼啪冒雷电。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME roams far and wide over the land and the air. When it runs, it leaves behind small flames with every step, while in the air, lightning crackles from every flap of its wings.

entry: POKENAME能将任何水域加热到恰好温度，变成舒适温泉。这些温泉，几乎任何伤都能帮它治好。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME can turn any body of water into a relaxing hot spring by heating the water to just the right temperature. POKENAME can use these hot springs to heal itself from almost any injury.

entry: POKENAME的火焰，亮度与热度都如太阳。传说它若死去，蛋便开启，它会披火重生，爪中已有一颗全新的蛋。
author: infinex21
source: The flames of POKENAME shine as bright and as hot as the sun itself. Legends claim that if POKENAME were ever to perish, then its egg will open and it will rise anew from it clad in flames with a brand-new egg already in its clutches.

entry: POKENAME战斗中扛下大量伤害，等待恰好反击的时机。一找到机会，就用火热连啄，刺穿对手防御。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME take a lot of damage over the course of a Pokémon battle waiting for the right moment to launch a counterattack. Once they find an opportune moment, a fiery flurry of pecks pierce through an opponent's defenses.

entry: POKENAME精通控火，又爱宏大幻象。它曾化作巨大凤凰，飞在大地高处，真身几乎从未被见过。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME is a master pyromancer and a lover of grand illusions. It has been known to soar high over the land in the form of a colossal phoenix; its true body is almost never seen.

entry: POKENAME挺胸展翼，增加体热，主要用来威吓小鸟宝可梦，逼其成为手下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME puffs up its chest and spreads its wings to increase the heat generated from its body. This is used primarily as a threat display to intimidate smaller bird Pokémon into becoming its underlings.

entry: POKENAME爱在篝火、森林大火、熔岩中玩耍。高温虽强，电路却毫无损伤。
author: notsaying.
source: Despite the high temperatures, POKENAME is known to play in bonfires, forest fires, and lava alike, taking no damage to its circuitry.

entry: 安装了一次“可疑”的固件更新，POKENAME变得极其敌对。这只故障宝可梦，以为自己正受病毒影响，时刻喷火，连最好的训练家也说服不了。
author: ludacriswell
source: Upon installing a "dubious" firmware update, POKENAME has become extremely hostile. This malfunctioning Pokémon spews flames at all times thinking that it is under the influence of a virus. Even the best Trainers can't convince it otherwise.

entry: 安装了一次“可疑”的固件更新，POKENAME变得极其敌对。这只故障宝可梦，以为自己正受病毒影响，时刻喷火，连最好的训练家也说服不了。
author: ludacriswell
source: Upon installing a "dubious" firmware update, POKENAME has become extremely hostile. This malfunctioning Pokémon spews flames at all times thinking that it is under the influence of a virus. Even the best Trainers can't convince it otherwise.

entry: POKENAME为护别人免受敌害，会旋转撒余烬，在周围围起火圈。世代相传的故事说，一只曾为保护邻村，引开并吸收将至的熔岩流。
author: soup1900
source: To protect others from foes, POKENAME twirls around to spread embers and create a circle of fire around it. A generations-old folk tale has been recited about a POKENAME who redirected and absorbed an impending lava flow to protect a nearby village.

entry: 谁想伤害珍视的对象，POKENAME就向其扇去热余烬。火一铺开，它便用精神力量，不断把敌人扔进火里，直到烧得焦黑。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME fans hot embers towards anyone who attempts to hurt those it cares about. Once it spreads the flames around, it will use its psychic powers to constantly throw the foes into the fires until they become blackened from burns.

entry: POKENAME集中全部能量，能把火变成小熔岩球。受伤时，轻轻拿球揉伤处，便可瞬间治愈。
author: soup1900
source: By focusing all of their energy, POKENAME can transform their fire into small balls of lava. Whenever they get injured, they gently rub these lava balls against the wounded parts to instantly heal them.

entry: POKENAME披火的裙装，时髦地沿途留下火迹。它能预见森林大火，吸收全部火焰，保护林中居民。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME fashionably leaves behind a trail of fire with its flame-cloaked dress wherever it goes. By seeing into the future, it can predict when forest fires will happen and will absorb all the flames to protect the forest's inhabitants.

entry: POKENAME每片羽毛，都散出舒适暖意，据说能治任何伤，治后却会枯萎。它们以强焰保护训练家，热得仿佛连现实都扭曲。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's feathers each emit a soothingly warm aura and are said to have the power to heal any wound, but will wither away after healing said wound. They will protect their Trainers with flames so hot that they look as if they warp reality itself.

entry: 极少时候，POKENAME会显出伽勒尔火焰鸟的阴森气息。它用共情力量，传播恐惧、愤怒与绝望。
author: hophoppip
source: On rare occasions, a POKENAME will manifest the sinister aura of a Galarian Moltres. It uses its empathic powers to spread feelings of dread, fury, and despair.

entry: POKENAME用长喙破开硬果、坚果，吃掉内容物。食物残余烧成灰，洒到哪里，哪里便有好肥料。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their long beaks to break into hard fruits or nuts and consume the contents within. They burn the remains of their food to ash and these ashes serve well as fertilizer wherever they are scattered.

entry: 死于火山喷发的灵魂，聚成POKENAME。这只受折磨的宝可梦，束缚在灼热楔石上。
author: h0bojoe
source: Spirits that have passed in volcanic eruptions gather to form POKENAME. This tormented Pokémon is bonded to a scorching keystone.

entry: POKENAME狼吞辛辣树果，添旺火力。可惜耐辣不足，许多个体吃完，都要一边尖叫，一边乱跑。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME wolf down spicy berries in order to fuel their fires and burn brighter. Unfortunately, they lack proper spice tolerance, so many of them often run around screaming after finishing their meals.

entry: POKENAME脱落的鳞片，极能保热，须过一个月才凉。用作原料，可煮出温暖饮剂，抵御感冒与寒意。
author: sk372
source: A shed POKENAME scale greatly retains its heat, not cooling down until a month has passed. Used as an ingredient, it helps make warm brews that stave off colds and chills.

entry: POKENAME后脑的火，最高达1425摄氏度，连本体尚未察觉危险，便先有反应。火一涨起，就会形成火龙卷。
author: karmaofevil
source: Reaching temperatures up to 1425° Celsius, the fire on the back of POKENAME's head reacts to danger before the Pokémon even realizes it. Once it puffs up, it creates a fire tornado.

entry: POKENAME为保护朋友或幼崽，会让全身释放强焰。撞击足以把卡车掀翻。它也用喙，从内部烤熟果实与坚果，喂养幼崽。
author: infinex21
source: To protect its friends or young, POKENAME releases intense flames across its body. Its Tackle attacks have enough force to send a truck tumbling. It roasts fruits and nuts from within using its beak to feed its young.

entry: POKENAME身上的火，从背部小孔燃起，煮沸上方的水。落入其中的猎物，便会被巨喙迅速叼走。
author: jojojax164
source: The flames that appear on POKENAME's body are ignited from small holes along its back. The fire boils the water above it, and any prey that is caught is briskly snapped up by POKENAME's immense beak.

entry: POKENAME的天界烈焰，吞没什么，就毁灭什么，将整片地貌化为焦土荒原。奇妙的是，新生命又从焦地萌发，形成茂盛繁荣的新生态。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's celestial flames obliterate whatever they engulf, reducing entire landscapes into charred wastelands. Miraculously, new life springs up from these scorched areas, resulting in newly formed lush, thriving ecosystems.

entry: POKENAME燃着永恒火焰，钢板双翼释放熔融金属碎片与咆哮火暴。古文称，它来临，既预示工业奇观，也预示灾难烈火。
author: oddsneakers
source: POKENAME glows with eternal flame, and its steel-plated wings unleash molten metal shards and roaring firestorms. Ancient texts claim its arrival heralds both industrial marvels and cataclysmic infernos.

entry: 传说热浪源于POKENAME拔剑，气象学却早已证伪。它平常留鞘保热，遇险才出鞘，只暖到近处。
author: .fedoraman
source: Legends say that heat waves are caused by a POKENAME unsheathing its blade, but meteorology has long since debunked this. POKENAME stays sheathed in order to conserve heat and unsheathes when threatened, warming only the immediate area.

entry: 无论境况如何，POKENAME的火从不熄灭。它在偏远处划领地，像哨兵般，用强大的远近攻击驱走闯入者。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's flames never go out regardless of circumstance. It claims territory in remote areas and drives intruders away with powerful attacks from both afar and up close as if it were a sentinel.

entry: POKENAME眼上的特殊透镜，防护自身火焰与巢居火山的酷热。战斗时，它召火柱遮掩自己，同时压制敌人。
author: infinex21
source: The special lens covering the eyes of POKENAME protect them from their own flames and from the extreme heat of the volcanos they nest within. It summons pillars of fire to obscure itself during battle while also overwhelming their foes.

entry: POKENAME眼上的特殊透镜，防护自身火焰与巢居火山的酷热。战斗时，它召火柱遮掩自己，同时压制敌人。
author: infinex21
source: The special lens covering the eyes of POKENAME protect them from their own flames and from the extreme heat of the volcanoes they nest within. It summons pillars of fire to obscure itself during battle while also overwhelming their foes.

entry: 这只传说宝可梦诞生于火山核心。据说，看见它，就是春天将至的征兆。
author: melodydelune
source: This legendary Pokémon was born in the heart of a volcano. It's said that seeing this Pokémon is a sign of spring coming.

entry: POKENAME一决定暴走，整片周围便染满赤红余烬。它最常在冬末如此，融雪碎冰，腾出地方，让春日植物繁盛生长。
author: soup1900
source: If POKENAME decides to go on a rampage, the entire surrounding area will be painted by its burning red embers. It rampages most often during the end of winter, melting snow and smashing ice to allow room for plants in spring to grow and flourish.

entry: POKENAME在火山岛的熔岩深处游泳，厌恶领地被侵。传闻，若有谁闯入家园，它就会暴怒，使整座岛沉入海中，再去寻找新家。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME swims deep within the lava found on volcanic islands. It dislikes intrusions on its territory, and it has been said that if others invade its home, it will sink the island beneath the ocean in a rage before seeking a new home.

entry: 传说，古文明开矿挖掘，打断了POKENAME千年的沉眠，将它唤醒。它飞上天空时，气温会升得连睁眼都很困难。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to legend, POKENAME was awakened by the mining excavations of an ancient civilization that disturbed its millennial slumber. When it flies in the sky, the temperature rises to such an extent that it is even difficult to keep the eyes open.

entry: POKENAME侵入梦境，将一切吞入烈焰，借此取乐。受害者在赤红噩梦中的灼伤，也会出现在现实。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME amuses itself by invading dreams and engulfing everything in flames. Any burns a victim suffers in this crimson nightmare also manifest in reality.

entry: POKENAME侵入梦境，将一切吞入烈焰，借此取乐。受害者在赤红噩梦中的灼伤，也会出现在现实。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME amuses itself by invading dreams and engulfing everything in flames. Any burns a victim suffers in this crimson nightmare also manifest in reality.

entry: POKENAME从身上炮口，喷出足以瞬间熔钨的大股火焰。战斗无聊了，它便干脆飞走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME unleashes large blasts of flame hot enough to instantly melt tungsten from the cannon on its body. If it grows bored during a fight, it will simply fly away.

entry: POKENAME钻过沙漠地下，身体热至极高温，所过之处留下簇簇粉红玻璃。
author: .izik
source: While burrowing beneath desert sand, POKENAME's body becomes superheated. This leaves clusters of pink glass wherever it travels.

entry: 阿罗拉有个传统：喷发后若找到POKENAME，就须带至火山顶，抛进去。身体又滑又热，因此只能由受训专业人员完成。
author: darkweavile428
source: There is a tradition in the Alola region that if a POKENAME is found after an eruption, it must be carried to the top of the volcano and chucked in. Since POKENAME's bodies are both slippery and hot, this is only to be done by trained professionals.

entry: 攀灯火山的训练家，须留意POKENAME群落。它们脾气不定、容易好斗，会将火山家园内的岩浆，作为火热武器。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Trainers climbing Mt. Ember are warned to stay aware of colonies of POKENAME. POKENAME are temperamental and prone to aggression, commanding the magma within their volcano homes as a fiery weapon.

entry: POKENAME无需动翼，就能浮在地上方，也能喷火流向前推进。一感到敌意，身周空气便因酷热闪动。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME floats above the ground without needing to move its wings, but can propel itself forward by firing out jets of fire. If it senses any hostility, the air around it will shimmer with intense heat.

entry: 科学家给它起名“流星”。火焰究竟能多热，尚无已知上限，因此有人认为，POKENAME体内带着小太阳。
author: bobosmith01
source: Scientists have given it the moniker of the "Falling Star". There is no known limit to how hot its flames can actually grow. As a result, some believe POKENAME carries a small sun in its body.

entry: 火山喷发前几天，能见POKENAME用岩石筑坝，引开熔岩流。可一年大多时候，它都懒躺在活跃火山口旁。
author: mistymagius
source: A few days before a volcanic eruption, POKENAME can be seen making dams out of rocks to redirect lava flows. However, most of the year it spends its times lazing around the active crater.

entry: POKENAME以外貌为傲。若火势减弱，例如用燃尽移除火属性后，它就会迅速找水，试着沉进去。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has pride in its appearance. If it loses the intensity of its flames, such as when it removes its Fire-typing through the use of Burn Up, it will quickly find water to try and sink into.

entry: POKENAME花中有咆哮火焰，外围是燃烧的岩浆状物质。每当它吐出巨大火墙，花中火焰便短暂消散。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's flower contains a roaring flame surrounded by a burning magma-like substance. The flame temporarily dissipates whenever it breathes out its massive walls of fire breath.

entry: POKENAME潜过岩浆，挖入火山底下，收集石榴石。它们手带收获，飞出火山，身后火迹仿佛喷发将起。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME dive through magma in order to dig into the ground beneath volcanoes and collect the garnet gemstones within. They fly out of the volcano with their bounties in hand, resembling the beginning of an eruption as fire trails behind them.

entry: POKENAME身体强大，无论载多重，都能向前推进。古神话说，它轻易就能拖着太阳，走过天空。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's powerful body can propel forward no matter how much it has to carry. Old myths describe it as towing the sun along the sky easily.

entry: POKENAME炽热的心接触朱红色花蜜，激情便在翻飞羽毛中流露。舞蹈复杂难解，就像生命本身，总有无法再简化的复杂之处。
author: quackquackattack
source: When POKENAME's fiery heart is exposed to Red Nectar, its passionate intensity is seen in its feathers fluttering through the air. Its dance is complex and vexing, as is the irreducible complexity that comes with life.

entry: 干旱一来，POKENAME的烈火便更旺。火会点燃干透的草，造成地区各处野火。
author: dodoowner_
source: Whenever a drought occurs, POKENAME's blazing fire thrives. The flames can ignite the bone-dry grass, which causes many wildfires across the region.

entry: POKENAME双翼覆满火羽，翱翔时照亮天空，向下洒余烬。即使猛烈风暴，也曾见它们现身，火势从不减弱。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's wings are covered in plumes of fire, lighting up the sky as they soar and raining embers on those below. These Pokémon have even been spotted in intense storms, their flames never dwindling.

entry: POKENAME吞吃大量火山岩浆，获取能量与力量。急着找更多时，它会用爪撕地，直到地幔岩浆涌出。
author: soup1900
source: To gain energy and strength, POKENAME devours lots of magma from volcanoes. When desperate to find more magma, it tears open the ground using its claws until magma from the mantle layer rushes out.

entry: POKENAME吸收周围光线，让火更热、更亮。全力时，整身被火吞没，看一眼，就能使人失明；碰一下，更会留下永久灼伤。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's flames burn hotter and brighter by absorbing the light around it. At maximum power, its entire body will be engulfed in fire that will blind a person at a glance or leave permanent burn wounds if touched.

entry: POKENAME以黑光作燃料，维持火焰，使其显得更暗、更阴森。它向敌人发射这些火焰的激光束，把对方拥有的光能，烧成自己可用的燃料。
author: soup1900
source: To keep its flames alive, POKENAME uses black light as fuel, causing them to appear darker and more sinister. By firing laser beams of these flames at foes, POKENAME burns any light energy they had into consumable fuel for it.

entry: 据说POKENAME的咏叹调强烈得让听者充满愤怒与敌意。它隐居独处，以免伤及人类或宝可梦。
author: ehard
source: It is said that POKENAME's aria is so intense that those that hear it are overcome with anger and hostility. It lives in seclusion to prevent any harm to people or Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME每年几次，释放极热孢子，大幅升高一地温度。连隆冬，也能感觉像夏日。
author: .izik
source: A few times per year, POKENAME releases extremely hot spores that raise the temperature of an area dramatically. This can make even the dead of winter feel like summer.

entry: POKENAME靠核裂变，几乎能产生无限热量。传说它曾将数百颗星球，化为岩浆与灰烬。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body can produce virtually infinite amounts of heat due to nuclear fission. Legends say it has reduced hundreds of planets to nothing but magma and ash.

entry: POKENAME每次跳起，脚下都会闪火，烟雾帮助藏身。它有时也会放火，方便悄然行动。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: Whenever POKENAME jumps, a flash of fire appears under it; the smoke released assists with its stealth. POKENAME sometimes starts fires that help it sneak around.

entry: POKENAME挖出的隧道，热得仿佛熔融，十分危险。在附近待久，会严重热衰竭，之后才随时间渐缓。
author: .izik
source: The tunnels POKENAME excavates are dangerously molten hot. Prolonged exposure near them can cause severe heat exhaustion that fades over time.

entry: POKENAME能造特殊宝石，擦过什么，就点燃什么，哪怕材料再不易燃。一落水，便会炸成数百片余烬般的小碎块。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can create gemstones with the unique property of igniting anything they rub off of, no matter how non-flammable the material is. If one of these gemstones were to be dropped into water, it would burst into hundreds of tiny ember-like shards.

entry: POKENAME一发脾气，就会煮沸周围的水。幸好，情绪变化不持久，尤其是海带吃够后。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME causes the water around it to boil whenever it loses its temper. Luckily these mood swings do not last long, especially when it has eaten enough kelp.

entry: POKENAME着迷于明亮闪光的东西，结果追着自己的余烬跑。不断自追，让周围即使白天，也总一片烈焰般的红。
author: soup1900
source: Captivated by bright, shiny things, POKENAME ends up chasing the embers it scatters. Continuously chasing itself, the area around it is always blazing red in color, even during the daytime.

entry: POKENAME偏爱炎热干旱处筑巢。被带到寒地，冷空气让它发抖，有时气压差也会引发头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME prefer hot and arid climates to make their nest. If they are brought somewhere cold, the cool air causes them to shiver. Sometimes they develop headaches from the air pressure differences as well.

entry: POKENAME召来灼热火焰，烤熟靠近湖河水面的水生宝可梦，再游入水中，收集刚烤好的吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME conjure searing flames to roast aquatic Pokémon that are close to the surface of lakes and rivers. POKENAME swim into the bodies of water to gather the fresh roasted Pokémon to eat.

entry: POKENAME很容易凭尾焰辨认，因为潜入水下也不灭。但游泳时，火会迅速加热河池，给自然生物添麻烦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are easily identified by the flame on their tail, as it does not extinguish itself when submerged underwater. This causes issues for natural wildlife, as the flames rapidly heat ponds and rivers when POKENAME is swimming.

entry: POKENAME歇在火山温暖深处，吸热后，身体灼红发光。喷发前，它会跳入熔岩，享受被力量抛上天的刺激。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rests in the warm depths of volcanoes, its body glowing red-hot from the heat absorbed. It leaps into the lava before eruption, getting a thrill from being thrown into the air by the force.

entry: 据说，这只宝可梦周身的火极热，能把岩壳碎片变成火之石。它极稀有，常住干旱地区，或活火山深处。
author: fiordaliso
source: The flames surrounding this Pokémon's body are said to be so hot that they turn fragments of its rocky shell into Fire Stones. This extremely rare Pokémon tends to live in arid regions or deep within active volcanoes.

entry: POKENAME玩熔岩如玩水。环境越热，它就越欢快、友善。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME plays in molten lava as if it were water. The hotter its environment, the more jovial and friendly it becomes.

entry: 古传说称，连续几个月大雨过后，POKENAME诞生于火山之心。它完全靠家园周围的火成岩维生。
author: chibitales
source: An old legend claims POKENAME originated from the heart of a volcano after months of unending rain. It subsists entirely on igneous rocks found around its home.

entry: POKENAME主要靠缩壳、使出火焰旋涡防御。威胁一走，便飞往别处。
author: seanothan_23
source: POKENAME's main defense mechanism is retreating into its shell and using Fire Spin. Once the threat is gone, it flies away to another place.

entry: 危险宝可梦威胁时，POKENAME放出毒粉云，掩护逃跑。蜕落的鳞片可施给贫瘠土壤，使其恢复肥力。
author: fiordaliso
source: When threatened by a dangerous Pokémon, POKENAME releases clouds of Poison Powder to cover its escape. The scales it sheds during molting can be used to fertilize barren soil, restoring it to fertility.

entry: POKENAME用骨头拨弄附近钓者的鱼线。骨头若被钩住，它便用电磁波还击，夺回骨头。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its bone to toy with the fishing lines of nearby anglers. If the bone becomes snagged, it retaliates with Thunder Wave to reclaim it.

entry: POKENAME湛蓝的鳞片，曾用于传统药物，治疗多种病痛。过猎使数量减少，如今已受保护。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's azure scales are used in traditional medicine to treat a variety of ailments. Overhunting caused its numbers to dwindle, and it is now a protected species.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴紧卷沉没宝藏，宣称归自己所有。这些珍宝常长藏水下巢穴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME curls its tail tightly around sunken treasures, claiming them as its own. These treasures often remain hidden in its underwater lair.

entry: POKENAME泼向对手的水，精准又强，足以夷平小屋。这股强劲水流，会打得敌人发懵。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME splashes water at its opponent with such precision and force that it could level a small home. This powerful spray leaves foes stunned.

entry: POKENAME用角吸雷，身体在深水中亮得耀眼。光有助辨路，也能驱赶捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME absorbs lightning through its horn, making its body glow brilliantly in deep waters. This luminous effect helps it navigate and ward off predators.

entry: POKENAME常因体内力量膨胀而暴走，可每次几乎都很短暂。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME tend to rampage regularly, though they are almost always short-lived. They do so due to the swelling power within themselves.

entry: POKENAME爱住大水域，自由游泳。急转弯，鳞片常会松脱，爱好者便收集，盼找到最闪亮的一片。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy residing in large bodies of water where they can swim freely. Their scales often come loose when sharply turning in the water, which enthusiasts collect with the hopes of finding the shiniest scales.

entry: 据说POKENAME基因中藏着强大龙力。它们极难寻踪，只有散出龙能的地方，才较常见。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are said to hold great draconic powers within their genes. They are very elusive Pokémon, only commonly being found around areas that emanate draconic energy.

entry: POKENAME乍看几乎与普通迷你龙无异，却更像古老描绘中的样子。野外，它能融入迷你龙群，挺身面对别人，保护同族。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is almost indistinguishable from normal Dratini at a glance, though it resembles older depictions of the species. It mingles well with groups of Dratini in the wild, standing up to others to protect its kin.

entry: POKENAME覆着硬皮，藏在洞中，等待身体成熟。受打扰，就悲鸣，叫亲代前来保护。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME coat themselves with hardened skin and hide away in caves whilst they wait for their bodies to mature. If disturbed, they make a plaintive cry and call to their parents to defend them.

entry: POKENAME成簇睡在海洞壁。一受打扰，整簇便同步落水，合力使出电磁波。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps in clusters on the walls of sea caves. If disturbed, the entire cluster drops into the water in unison, unleashing a synchronized Thunder Wave attack.

entry: POKENAME住在火山口深处，以岩浆能量维生。耀眼蓝焰，几秒就能熔钢。
author: mepp.
source: Living deep volcanic craters, POKENAME fuels itself with energy from magma. Its dazzling blue flames can melt steel in seconds.

entry: 这是POKENAME的稀有种，有时也被称为“海之九头蛇”。
author: toxicrown
source: A rare species of POKENAME. It is sometimes called 'The Hydra of the Seas'.

entry: 许多文化认为，一生能见到POKENAME就是神赐的祝福，往后会有好运。两颗头总协调行动，绝不朝相反方向走。
author: faeflame
source: Many cultures believe that to see a POKENAME in one's lifetime is a divine blessing and will lead to good fortune. The two heads tend to move in harmony with each other, never moving in opposing directions.

entry: 遇险，POKENAME召来强大暴雨，藏在雨幕中，逃离捕食者。造出的风暴，常让整片地区连湿数日。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can summon powerful rainstorms when in danger, cloaking itself in heavy rainfall to escape predators. The storms it creates often leave entire areas drenched for days.

entry: POKENAME在高山结群，合作抵御更大宝可梦，与碰巧靠近的训练家。比起真打，它们更爱先摆凶相。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form colonies high in the mountains, working together to protect themselves from larger Pokémon and any Trainers that happen to come close. They prefer to make shows of aggression rather than actually fighting.

entry: POKENAME在瀑布后凿出的小洞安家。许多人说，先看见瀑布短暂逆流，再发现它，可目光一接，它就瞬间移动走了。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its home in small carved areas behind waterfalls. Many report seeing a waterfall briefly flowing in reverse before spotting it, only for it to teleport away the moment it is seen.

entry: POKENAME牙齿向后分叉，如同倒钩，咬住就难拔出。红鳍每周蜕一次，越换越强、越长。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's teeth are forked back like hooks, so they are difficult to remove once they bite down on something. Their red fins grow stronger and longer as they are shed every week.

entry: POKENAME毛质极为奢华，深受上流训练家追捧，却也因此几乎被猎杀殆尽。
author: mistymagius
source: A highly sought-after Pokémon by high-class Trainers, POKENAME's fur is among the most luxurious. However, this has led to it being hunted to near extinction.

entry: POKENAME游泳时，放出明亮闪光，照见最深海底。捕食者若咬住，就蜕掉最外层鳞片逃脱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce bright flashes of light as they swim to see in the deepest parts of the ocean. Whenever a predator bites onto them, they escape by shedding their outermost layer of scales.

entry: POKENAME蜕皮时，会释放电力，分解外层。过程耗尽体力，之后一阵，也缺少电能。
author: sk372
source: In order to shed its skin, POKENAME lets loose an electric burst that disintegrates the outer layer. The process leaves it exhausted and lacking electricity for some time afterward.

entry: POKENAME是最早测试太空服的宝可梦之一，因为体形小，用料少。对月相周期的感应，也助它们在太空辨认方向。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME were among the first Pokémon to test space suits, as their small size required fewer materials. Their affinity to the lunar cycle helps them maintain direction when navigating through space.

entry: POKENAME羊毛浮力很强，常漂在岸边休息。它每天脱一次毛衣，潜深水觅食，直到新毛长够，又把它带回水面。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME's wool is highly buoyant, so it is common to see it floating around coastlines resting. Once a day, it sheds its woollen coat and dives down deep to scavenge, until its coat grows enough to drag it back to the surface.

entry: POKENAME细长身体，适合钻其他宝可梦的洞穴捕猎。外表可爱又爱交际，让它深受年轻训练家欢迎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: With its long and narrow body, POKENAME is well suited to hunting through the burrows of other Pokémon. It is popular with younger Trainers for its cute appearance and social nature.

entry: POKENAME刚蜕皮，会覆上一层毒膜，防御捕食者。新皮长好，就须去掉毒膜，否则会停止生长。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME coats itself in a poisonous film after it has just shed its skin to protect itself from predators. It must remove this film once its skin has redeveloped; otherwise, POKENAME will stop growing.

entry: 人们长期以为，POKENAME只能在水中生存，最近研究才证实并非如此。蜕皮常残留毒，当地政府已禁止用于公共用品。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME was long thought to be able to only survive in water until a recent research study proved otherwise. Local governments have banned the use of shed skin from this Pokémon in public products since they often have residues of poison on them.

entry: 《POKENAME与水罐》是城都流行的寓言。故事说，这聪明宝可梦不断往罐里投小石，直到水位高得够喝。
author: mepp.
source: The POKENAME and the Pitcher is a popular fable from the Johto region. It describes the intelligent Pokémon persistently dropping pebbles into a pitcher so the water could rise high enough for it to drink.

entry: POKENAME粉叶白天储阳光，夜里释放柔和安神的香气。训练家说，歇在它身旁，会格外宁静。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's pink leaves store sunlight during the day and release a soft, calming aroma at night. Trainers report feeling unusually serene when resting near it.

entry: POKENAME体内偶尔积能，突然向外爆发，将松果状表皮炸得四散。其实，这也是一种蜕皮。
author: bobosmith01
source: Every once in a while, energy builds up in POKENAME's body, and suddenly explodes outwards, causing its pinecone-esque epidermis to fly everywhere. This actually acts as a form of molting.

entry: POKENAME更愿避开别人，悄然快速地从上方滑过。唯一留下的痕迹，是用爪剥掉的蜕皮碎片。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME prefer to avoid others, gliding silently and swiftly above them. The only trace of them left behind are the scraps of their shed skins that they peel off using their claws.

entry: POKENAME定期蜕皮，从壳上某个孔推出来。皮泡过树果汁，有些餐厅便作为很独特的珍馐出售。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sheds its skin on a regular basis, pushing it out through one of the holes in its shell. Because this skin has been soaking in berry juice, some restaurants sell it as a very unique delicacy.

entry: POKENAME游得慢，壳又光滑，常遭偷猎。壳制首饰，曾被视为奢侈品。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are often victims of poachers due to their slow speed and smooth shell. Pieces of jewelry made from their shells were once considered luxury items.

entry: POKENAME稀有，只见于高山。它们护巢，谁登山时看见，就会俯冲啄击，让初遇很不愉快。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are rare Pokémon that can only be found high in the mountains. They are protective of their nests and will swoop down and peck at any hikers that spy them, making first sightings unpleasant.

entry: 这些宝可梦虽小，逆强流也能轻松游。它们多贴近水面，偶尔跃起，再潜入；但只要看见哪怕一个人，就迅速潜深。
author: infinex21
source: Although small, these Pokémon can easily swim against strong currents. They are tend to swim close to the surface, sometimes leaping out and diving back in, but will quickly dive deep if they see even a single human.

entry: POKENAME在火山地区极为罕见。它通常尽力避免冲突，真有必要，也会迎战。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: POKENAME are exceedingly rare in volcanic biomes. They usually try to avoid conflict but will fight if necessary.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴作画，向朋友炫耀。尾部将蜕皮时，它更活跃，因为过程似乎让混出的颜色更鲜艳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its tail to create artistic imagery to show off to its friends. It grows more active when it is about to shed the tail's skin, as the process appears to make the colors it mixes more vibrant.

entry: POKENAME住在地下湖，人类靠近，它却会上浮。据说，嘴唇碰过的人，会获大福。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives in underground lakes, though it comes up to the surface when humans approach. It is said that those it touches with its lips are blessed with great fortune.

entry: POKENAME成长时，不断蜕下旧皮与牙，新的一套总比旧的更坚韧。它们爱嚼一切撑得住强颚的东西。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME constantly shed older skin and fangs as they grow, with each new set tougher than the last. They love to chew on anything that can withstand their strong jaws.

entry: POKENAME身体极轻，能在水上轻跳，常借此避开别人。它们每月蜕皮，容纳成长的身体，每蜕一次，也更光亮。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have bodies that are so light they can prance upon water, which has oft helped them to evade others. Every month they shed their skin to accommodate their growing bodies, which also appear glossier with every shedding.

entry: POKENAME用奇特力量，让沙在周身旋转。沙幕在沙漠中，既作伪装，也作防御。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME manipulates sand to swirl around its body by using an unusual power. This sandy veil provides both camouflage and defense in desert environments.

entry: 这些宝可梦很温顺，是好朋友。它们皮肤能传导自身电力，攻击后仍留电荷，后来碰到的人，可能挨电。
author: fireblade141
source: These Pokémon are highly docile and make great friends. Their skin conducts the electricity they produce, leaving behind an electrical charge after they use an attack. This can cause a shock to anyone who touches it later.

entry: 这只宝可梦大多在水下生活，却为避免储电伤害其他水生宝可梦，上岸睡觉。
author: ichosuzu
source: This Pokémon spends most of its time underwater, but to avoid harming other aquatic Pokémon with its built-up electricity, it sleeps on land.

entry: 它极其稀有，靠体内流转的神秘龙能，自给自足。蜕皮时，旧皮很快就会硬化变脆。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is an exceedingly rare Pokémon that self-sustains through the mysterious draconic energy coursing inside its body. When it sheds its skin, the old skin quickly becomes hard and brittle.

entry: POKENAME能卷成完美圆球，攻防兼备。蜷着快速旋转，就能迅速脱去、丢下旧皮与鳞片。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can roll into a perfect ball for defense and offense. By spinning rapidly while curled up, it quickly sheds and discards its old skin and scales.

entry: POKENAME游在淡水池，靠照到水面的阳光获取养分。旧皮蜕后，很快就溶解，净化水中毒与污物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME swims about in freshwater ponds, getting nourishment from sunlight hitting the water. Its shed skin dissolves shortly after shedding, purifying the water of toxins and filth.

entry: POKENAME把蜕皮改作袋子，塞进从电脑偷来的数据。它泡在数据里，让身体成长、能量增加。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME repurposes its shed skin as bags used to stuff stolen data it takes from computers. It bathes in this data to grow its body and increase its energy.

entry: POKENAME皮肤摸来柔软光滑，须定期洗澡，才能保持。吐出的小火星，带着颇为空灵的蓝色。
author: sk372
source: It's skin is soft and smooth to the touch, and requires regular baths to keep it so. The small embers POKENAME can breathe are colored a rather ethereal blue hue.

entry: POKENAME尖刺长得太快，必须每周脱换。每根又厚又尖，因此许多人拿来代替某些工具。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME must shed its sharp quills every week due to how quickly they grow. Each quill is thick and sharp, so there are many who use them in place of some tools.

entry: POKENAME柔软的吻部布满神经，轻轻碰一下，也会让它痛得厉害，因此不适合给孩子作伴。
author: staghorn
source: A POKENAME's soft snout is full of nerve endings, and even minor impacts cause it great pain. For this reason, they make poor companions for children.

entry: POKENAME能感知人类与宝可梦的情绪，野外很少见。它们极害羞，容易被别人的情绪压得不知所措。
author: geo_ominous
source: POKENAME are rarely seen in the wild, as they can sense the emotions of people and Pokémon. They are very shy and get overwhelmed by others' emotions easily.

entry: 身体围成圈，POKENAME才能发挥全部潜力。尾宝石靠近头部，足以大增精神力量，必要时，连小黑洞也能生成。
author: sk372
source: Forming a circle with its body allows POKENAME to utilize its full potential. The gem on its tail being close to its head enhances its psychic powers enough that it can even generate small black holes if it needs to.

entry: POKENAME变换鳞色，融入周围，远远好奇地观察人类，直到觉得安全，才靠近。受惊，就散鳞作诱饵，同时变色，赶快逃走。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME shift the color of their scales to blend in with their surroundings, curiously observing humans from afar until they feel safe enough to approach. If startled, POKENAME scatter scales to act as a decoy while they change color and hurry away.

entry: POKENAME覆着透明金属鳞，碰上杂物冲击，就会剥落。这些鳞片很适合制作洗衣剂，价值很高。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is covered in clear metallic scales that flake off upon impact with debris. These flakes are highly valued for use in crafting laundry detergent.

entry: 最近，一位渔人从湖底钓起楔石，证实POKENAME存在。目前研究发现，它是关都少数湖泊的特有宝可梦。
author: mepp.
source: A fisherman recently confirmed POKENAME's existence after pulling up its keystone from the bottom of a lake. So far, researchers have found that POKENAME is endemic to just a few lakes in the Kanto region.

entry: POKENAME咬对手时，有时牙会掉，曾被猎人用来做箭。牙锋利，又极耐用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's teeth sometimes fall out when biting an opponent, and these were once used by hunters to craft arrows. The teeth are sharp and incredibly durable.

entry: POKENAME部分头骨覆着坚宝石，据说蕴藏浓缩龙能。受到冲击，宝石不知为何会明亮闪光，让它体力与力量猛增。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's skull is partially covered by a sturdy gem said to possess concentrated draconic energy. The jewel will somehow flash brightly after being impacted, causing POKENAME to surge with heightened stamina and strength.

entry: 融合技术出现后，才有POKENAME，冶金学家仍持续研究。身体长大，它们就蜕掉刀刃，金属坚韧、轻巧又耐水，可供利用。
author: .fedoraman
source: Only existing after the advent of fusion technology, POKENAME is an ongoing subject of study for metallurgists. They shed their blades as they grow larger, and this metal could be used for its tough, lightweight, and water-resistant properties.

entry: 随着身体慢慢长大，POKENAME会弃下旧鞘，长出更大的新鞘。这些旧剑鞘，常被王室用来象征身份。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME abandons its scabbard for a larger one it generates as it slowly grows. These scabbards are often used as status symbols for royalty.

entry: POKENAME翼太小，飞不了，但快速拍动，会散出闪亮小鳞片。同栖沙漠的多数捕食者，若碰到，就会起疼痛皮疹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wings are too small for flight, but they dispense small glittering scales when flapped rapidly. The scales cause painful rashes on contact with most desert-dwelling predators it shares a habitat with.

entry: 刚出生的POKENAME生活在河床与湖底。每次蜕皮，触须也会长得更长。
author: melodydelune
source: During the beginning of POKENAME's life, it will live on the floor of rivers and lakes. As it sheds its skin, its feelers will grow longer.

entry: POKENAME虽模样凶恶，性情却平和温顺。可一到战斗，尾巴还是会兴奋地摆动起来。
author: xephyr
source: Despite a fearsome exterior, POKENAME is a calm and docile Pokémon by nature. When in battle, its tail begins swaying excitedly.

entry: POKENAME是最早随宇航员飞入太空的宝可梦之一。它们不需太空服，很适合外部维修，只是蜕皮常把鳞片留得到处都是。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME was among the first Pokémon to fly alongside astronauts into space. They are helpful for making external repairs since they do not require space suits. However, their shedding tends to leave scales everywhere.

entry: 这种融合体，以优雅动作受人欣赏。花瓣质地如鳞，近似迷你龙皮肤。
author: hophoppip
source: This fusion is appreciated for its elegant movements. The petals of its flowers have a scaly texture, similar to a Dratini's skin.

entry: POKENAME悬浮的头，靠等离子体尾巴推动，在空中前进。年龄越大，尾巴就越长、越亮。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's floating head is propelled through the air by a tail made of plasma. As POKENAME ages, this tail will grow longer and brighter.

entry: POKENAME用明亮火焰散去多余能量。火势降下，它便重塑成更大形态。数次之后，才可能终于进化，可它自己也不知道，下次是进化，还是再长大。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME sheds excess energy as a bright flame. When its flame's level drops, it reshapes into a larger form. After several such reforms, it may finally evolve, though even POKENAME never knows if it will evolve or simply grow again.

entry: POKENAME准备使出强力火花时，尾巴会灼热发白。有时，它只借这能力，温暖周围水域。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tails become scalding hot and glow white when preparing to unleash a powerful Ember attack. It sometimes uses this ability to simply warm the surrounding water.

entry: POKENAME吸收月光越多，毛色就越淡，闪得美丽。晴朗月夜，变化尤其明显。
author: .izik
source: The more moonlight POKENAME absorbs, the paler its fur becomes, shimmering beautifully. This transformation is especially visible on clear, moonlit nights.

entry: POKENAME用黏性蜕皮，当水坝的黏合材料。它十分胆小，却异常勤奋。
author: mary_the_jane
source: POKENAME uses its sticky molted skin to act as a binding agent for its dams. It is very timid but an incredibly hard worker.

entry: POKENAME假装勇敢，却常卷入毫无胜算的战斗。每战后，它都会蜕皮，加快恢复。
author: mistymagius
source: Though POKENAME pretends to be courageous, it will usually get itself in fights it has no chance of winning. It will shed its skin after every battle so it can recover faster.

entry: POKENAME虽几乎不活动，能卷握的尾巴却仍会移动、收食。真活动时，也只为换地方，或脱掉多余毛与鳞。
author: infinex21
source: Although POKENAME are rarely ever active, their prehensile tails still move and collect food for them. When they are active, it is only to move elsewhere or to shed excess fur and scales.

entry: POKENAME越临近蜕皮，就越烦躁、过分好动。终于扭出旧皮，便平静得多，至少暂时如此。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME grows nearer to needing to shed its skin, it grows more agitated and hyperactive. Once it manages to wriggle out of its old skin, it becomes much more calm, at least for a short while.

entry: POKENAME脱落的尾巴，常被工程师拿来导电。企业出钱向训练家收购，因为舒适环境下，尾巴最纯净。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The tails shed by POKENAME are often used by engineers for their conductive properties. Businesses pay Trainers for these tails, as they are purest when POKENAME are in a comfortable environment.

entry: POKENAME头两侧的褶边，能隔空操纵沙。它先将敌人困进地中，取得优势，再进攻。
author: .izik
source: The frills on either side of POKENAME's head can remotely manipulate sand. This ability traps foes in the ground, giving it the advantage before striking.

entry: POKENAME爱盘成圈打盹，尾焰像小篝火，照亮四周。好奇旅人，夜里有时会循光而来，误以为是灯笼。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME enjoys curling up in coils while napping, with its tail flame illuminating the area like a tiny campfire. Curious travelers sometimes follow its glow at night, mistaking it for a lantern.

entry: POKENAME长着柔软绒毛，帮助度过寒月。训练家说，摸它特别安神，它被碰时，也会发出舒缓声音。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME grows a soft, downy fluff that helps it to survive in the colder months. Trainers of POKENAME describe it as incredibly calming to pet, with the Pokémon making soothing noises when touched.

entry: POKENAME住在未受干扰的荒野湖底，梦想长出翅膀，飞越水面。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME lives on the bottom of lakes in untouched wilderness. It dreams of gaining wings and soaring above the water's surface.

entry: POKENAME主要靠回声定位与敏感毛发，走过黑暗海洞，其实视力也很好。
author: entomoxie
source: While POKENAME mainly rely on echolocation and sensitive fur to navigate dark seaside caves, they actually have very good eyesight.

entry: POKENAME主要靠回声定位与敏感毛发，走过黑暗海洞，其实视力也很好。
author: entomoxie
source: While POKENAME mainly rely on echolocation and sensitive fur to navigate dark seaside caves, they actually have very good eyesight.

entry: POKENAME将翼收在身下，优雅浮在水面。姿态恬静，是平湖上一道安宁的景色。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME tucks its wings beneath its body, allowing it to float gracefully on the water. This serene position makes it a peaceful sight on calm lakes.

entry: 这些宝可梦每月蜕两次羽，换上新衣，再抖掉蓬松旧羽。它们通常十分欢快，飞来飞去，哼着平静曲调。
author: infinex21
source: Twice a month, these Pokémon shed and shake free their fluffy plumage in the wake of a new coat. They are typically very cheerful and hum a serene tune as they fly about.

entry: POKENAME分泌的液体可制成多种麻醉剂。它们顽皮爱闹，喜欢用黏液痕迹作画。受惊时，能迅速化成一滩黏液。
author: faeflame
source: POKENAME secrete a fluid that is used for various anesthetics. They are playful and cheeky creatures and enjoy making art with their slime trails. If spooked they can quickly turn into a puddle of goo.

entry: POKENAME背上的小真菌，蜕皮时会掉落。人们认为，这或是小蘑菇如此丰富的原因之一。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The small fungi on POKENAME's back fall off when it sheds. This is assumed to be one of the reasons why Tiny Mushrooms are so abundant.

entry: POKENAME最多二十只成群，在冷雾中，沿苔原小跑。将蜕旧皮时，它们先冻住，再震碎，去得更干净。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live in herds of up to twenty, trotting along the tundra under a veil of cold mist. When they are to shed their old skin, they will freeze it and shatter it to more cleanly remove it.

entry: POKENAME平静的心，散出安神气息。它常向需要朋友的孤独者现身，给予希望。
author: krune
source: POKENAME's serene mind eminates a calming aura. It often shows itself to lonely people in need of a friend to give them hope.

entry: POKENAME游过冰水，鳞片便紧贴身体。这有助保住体热，让它能在冰寒环境茁壮生长。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's scales flatten tightly against its body when swimming through icy waters. This adaptation helps it retain body heat, allowing it to thrive in frigid environments.

entry: POKENAME无精打采地漂在星球轨道，似乎只靠宇宙辐射为食。体内能量不断成长，发育越深，就越将它拖向下方。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME float listlessly in the orbit of our planet, seeming to feed on cosmic radiation alone. Within them is a growing energy that drags them down the more they develop.

entry: POKENAME常藏在湖面下，出来时，便以强火自卫。火从不熄灭，即使水下，也轻轻闪动。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME often hides beneath the surface of lakes, emerging to defend itself with powerful bursts of flame. Its flame never goes out, flickering softly even underwater.

entry: POKENAME大部分岁月都在地下度过，直到强壮得足以进化。若被发现，轻轻松松就能迅速钻走。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME spend most of their lives underground until they get strong enough to evolve. If it is seen, it can quickly and effortlessly burrow away.

entry: 与龙属性宝可梦关系深厚的地区，人们常赠送POKENAME，表达爱意。水下，它会向别人吹心形气泡。
author: sk372
source: In areas known for their connection to Dragon-type Pokémon, it is common for people to gift another POKENAME as a romantic gesture. While underwater, it blows heart-shaped bubbles at others.

entry: POKENAME在隧道壁留下嵌入的闪亮鳞片。铁匠曾珍视它们，拿来为贵族制作锁子甲。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaves shimmering scales embedded in tunnel walls. These scales were once prized by blacksmiths for nobles' chainmail.

entry: POKENAME翻过的土，因脱落的小鳞片而极其肥沃。农人珍视这种土，用来种优质庄稼。
author: .izik
source: The dirt POKENAME tills is incredibly fertile due to the tiny scales it sheds. Farmers prize this soil for growing high-quality crops.

entry: POKENAME平静亲人，是常见家养宝可梦，大多只是打盹、玩耍，抓东西磨爪。蜕皮时，身上细小亮鳞，却会把家里铺得满满。
author: keiracm35_
source: POKENAME are common household Pokémon due to their calm, affectionate nature. They mostly just nap and play by scratching things to sharpen their claws. When they shed, they leave everything covered in the small, shiny scales lining their bodies.

entry: POKENAME头痛加重，后脑鳍便脉动精神能量，在空气中激起涟漪，表露越来越强的不适。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME's headache worsens, the fin on the back of its head pulses with psychic energy. This creates ripples in the air, signaling its growing distress.

entry: POKENAME亲人，只为自卫或保护训练家才战斗。近乎完美的嗅觉，让它找到心爱树果，再用吐火烤熟。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an affectionate creature that only fights to defend itself or its Trainer. It has an almost perfect sense of smell, which it uses to track the Berries it loves, roasting them with the flames it can breathe from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME虽有火热力量，内心却温柔，只为保护所爱才战斗。近乎无误的嗅觉，让它能找到森林或其他荒野中的迷途者。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite its fiery power, POKENAME is a gentle soul that fights solely to protect those it loves. Its nearly flawless sense of smell lets it locate people lost within forests or other wild territories.

entry: 被激怒，它能召来酷热，让身体亮得足以照耀夜空。POKENAME则须在水下待许多小时，才能平静。
author: jaminmcready
source: When provoked, it can summon immense heat, causing its body to glow brightly enough to light up the night sky. To calm itself, POKENAME will spend many hours underwater.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴，收集湖底杂草，整理环境。这些草常成为水下巢的一部分。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its tail to gather weeds from the lake floor, tidying its environment. These weeds often become a part of its underwater nest.

entry: POKENAME不断训练、长肌肉，皮就会蜕下，由新层替代，容纳日益壮大的肌肉。
author: foolish_weasel
source: As it continuously trains and builds muscle mass, POKENAME's skin will shed off and a new layer will take its place to accommodate for its ever-growing muscles.

entry: POKENAME用蜕皮制腰带。不知为何，这带子能束住本会满溢的生命能量。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME will fashion a belt made from its shed skin. Somehow this belt contains its otherwise overflowing life energy.

entry: POKENAME孵化几小时，便能站立，皮却薄而脆弱。它们大吃树果蓄能，尽快蜕出厚皮。柔软鬃毛，即使无风，也轻轻飘动。
author: chibitales
source: Although POKENAME can stand hours after hatching, their skin is thin and vulnerable. They gorge themselves on berries to gain energy, shedding as soon as possible to uncover thicker skin. Their soft manes gently flutter even if no wind is blowing.

entry: POKENAME极隐居，稍觉附近有人，就常拔腿逃跑。速度快得能跑过水面，鬃毛身后拖着闪亮光迹。
author: sk372
source: Highly reclusive, POKENAME tends to take off running at the first hint of humans nearby. Its speed is fast enough that it can run across the surface of the water, sparkling light trailing from its mane.

entry: POKENAME尾上滴的液体，甜得惊人，渔人常拿来引诱水生宝可梦。只需几滴，就足够惹其注意。
author: .izik
source: The fluid dripping from POKENAME's tail is incredibly sweet, often used by fishermen to lure aquatic Pokémon. Just a few drops are enough to attract attention.

entry: POKENAME不跑，也能步行水面，巡逻家园附近。发现人类，头上宝石便亮起三色，再使出三重攻击。
author: .izik
source: Even when not running, POKENAME can walk across the water's surface to patrol the area around its home. When it spots a human, the gems on its heads glow three different colors before it unleashes a Tri Attack.

entry: POKENAME旧壳下，不断长新层，随年龄蜕成越来越大的壳。持续更新，让它免遭感染或寄生虫。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME continuously grow new layers of shell underneath the old, moulting into a larger and larger shell as they age. This constant renewal keeps them from suffering infections or parasites.

entry: 其他大岩蛇常聚在POKENAME旁，吃它的蜕皮。能量短暂却猛烈地增强，让挖洞速度翻倍。作为回报，它自己几乎不用挖。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Other Onix are often found near POKENAME as they feast upon the skin that they shed. This provides them with intense but temporary bursts of energy, able to tunnel at twice their normal rate. In return, POKENAME is rarely expected to dig.

entry: 仍在幼虫阶段，POKENAME的龙能就已骤增，催生罕见形态。可身体太弱，承受不住自身力量。
author: dusknoir64
source: While still in a larval state, POKENAME's draconic energy has flared up, causing a rare form to emerge. It's body is too weak to handle it's own power.

entry: POKENAME为避注意，贴着阴影，藏在模仿热带灌丛的尾后。传说，从三只不同个体的尾上，各取一枚水晶，就能实现心愿。
author: pjporwoll
source: To avoid detection, POKENAME sticks to shadows and hides behind its tail, which mimics the appearance of a tropical bush. Legend says that the crystals on its tail will grant a wish if someone gathers one from three different POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME将骨状杖举向天空，影响天气。领地遇险，便能轻易召来雷暴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME raises its bonelike staff toward the sky to influence the weather. When its territory is threatened, it can summon thunderstorms with ease.

entry: POKENAME住在多雾处，还不停生成缥缈雾气，进一步藏身。研究者认为，它极害羞，尽量不愿被看见。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME resides in misty areas, further obscuring itself from view via the ethereal mist its body constantly creates. Researchers believe it is incredibly shy and seeks to hide itself from view as much as possible.

entry: POKENAME冲锋奔跑得越久，体内积蓄的神秘力量就越强。时间足够长时，即使身体沉重、翅膀又小，它也能暂时获得飞行的能力。
author: sk372
source: The longer POKENAME runs during a charge, the more mystical power builds up within its body. After enough time, it can even gain the ability to fly temporarily, despite the weight of its body and the small size of its wings.

entry: POKENAME腹上宝石，深受占卜师珍视，声称能显出一整年的天气规律。许多人相信，光芒会随季节预报改变。
author: .izik
source: The gem on POKENAME's belly is prized by fortune tellers, who claim it can reveal an entire year's weather patterns. Many believe its glow changes with seasonal forecasts.

entry: POKENAME为保持华丽双翼洁白健康，只挑最熟的树果吃。许多人相信，它带的珍珠蕴藏巨力，因此无人敢惹怒。
author: fiordaliso
source: To keep its magnificent wings white and healthy, POKENAME carefully chooses only the ripest berries to eat. Many believe that the pearl it carries holds an incredible power, which is why no one dares to anger it.

entry: 始终有故事说，POKENAME一暴走，就会酝酿风暴。虽未证实，它暴走时，确会从水晶释放多余能量。
author: infinex21
source: Some tales persist that when a POKENAME rampages, a storm will brew. While these tales have yet to be confirmed, POKENAME do let loose excess energy from their crystals when they rampage.

entry: POKENAME能短程飞行，有助攀瀑或找新水源。这份罕见本领，让它善于远行。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can fly short distances, which is helpful for scaling waterfalls or finding new water sources. This rare ability makes it a powerful traveler.

entry: POKENAME大多生活在湖床附近深处。谁敢污染水域，它们就上浮攻击。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME spend most of their lives deep near lakebeds. They will swim to the surface and attack those that dare pollute their waters.

entry: POKENAME壳上水晶脉动神秘能量，深受富人珍视，让它成为偷猎目标。人们正努力监测世界各地群体，保护它们不再受猎。
author: chibitales
source: The crystals on POKENAME's shell pulse with a mysterious energy and are prized by rich folk, making them targets of poachers. Efforts are being made to monitor POKENAME pods worldwide and protect them from further poaching attempts.

entry: POKENAME以壳上珍珠为傲。雌性看谁的壳最美、保养最好，才选伴侣。攻击时，珠中储力使其猛烈发光，再释放。
author: keiracm35_
source: POKENAME take great pride in the pearls adorning their shells. Female POKENAME choose partners based on whose shell is the most beautiful and best kept. When attacking, the power stored in these pearls makes them glow intensely before being released.

entry: POKENAME常在湖瀑附近，漂亮蓝鳞融入清澈水中。周围水越干净，身上珠体就越亮。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be found near lakes and waterfalls, its beautiful blue scales blending in with the crystal-clear water. The orbs on its body glow brighter the cleaner the surrounding water is.

entry: POKENAME身上蓝珠，似乎会增强电属性攻击。暴怒时，放出的能量强到托起自己，以可怕又优雅的姿态悬浮。
author: fiordaliso
source: The blue orbs along its body seem to amplify the power of its Electric-type attacks. When it flies into a rage, POKENAME releases such intense energy that it can lift itself into the air, floating with terrifying yet graceful poise.

entry: 暴风雪将近，POKENAME鼻子便变得冰冷，为附近提供可靠警报。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's nose turns ice cold whenever a blizzard is approaching. This change provides a reliable warning to those nearby.

entry: POKENAME体内能量庞大，天气都会随其心情略微改变。即使驯龙师也表示，这些宝可梦能量太多，训练起来十分棘手。
author: chibitales
source: The energy welling within POKENAME's body is so immense, the weather experiences minor changes depending on their mood. Even Dragon Tamers report having trouble training these Pokémon due to the vast amount of energy they have.

entry: POKENAME身上水晶储着极大能量，气场非凡。它以力量，平息风暴。
author: gellyfishsh
source: An enormous amount of energy is stored in the crystals on POKENAME's body, giving it an incredible aura. It uses its power to calm storms.

entry: 与大针蜂近亲不同，POKENAME很温顺，随风迁徙。新巢建好，便落在树上，用翅膀伪装，躲避飞行属性宝可梦。
author: ghostslythe
source: Unlike its Beedrill cousins, POKENAME is docile, migrating where the winds take it. After setting up a new hive, it lands on trees, using its wings as camouflage against Flying-Type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME多数目击，都在低空积云旁。水晶囤着惊人能量，主要用于飞行、狩猎，以及将云塑成喜欢的形状。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Most POKENAME sightings have been around low-level Cumulus clouds. The crystals they carry stockpile incredible amounts of energy, which they primarily use to fly, hunt, and shape the clouds to their liking.

entry: 这些宝可梦爱玩，却难寻踪，常用精神力量摆弄周围环境，似乎最爱水。一知道被看见，就会瞬间移走，不留痕迹。
author: infinex21
source: These playful yet elusive Pokémon use their psychic powers to play with their environment, though they seem to favor water the most. If they know they have been spotted by anyone else, they will teleport away and leave no trace.

entry: POKENAME在天空自在生活，能将云变成半固体。它们把雨水运上这些大多凝实的云，在数千英尺高空，造出小池塘。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME are at home in the sky. They are capable of turning clouds into a semisolid matter. POKENAME transport rainwater onto these mostly solid clouds, creating small ponds thousands of feet in the air.

entry: POKENAME胆小，宁避别人，有时连同类也躲。多余能量，则从背部化作蓝焰放出。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are timid and prefer to avoid others, sometimes even their own kind. They release their excess energy as blue flames from their backs.

entry: POKENAME动作敏捷迅速，既为避人，也能精准快击，吓退潜在捕食者。背部蓝焰进一步威吓别人，也释放多余能量。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME move nimbly and quick to avoid others and to deliver quick, precise attacks to scare off would-be predators. They release blue flames from their backs to further intimidate others, though it's also a way to release excess energy.

entry: POKENAME从背或巨口喷火，水晶便更亮。若放任能量膨胀过多，就会猛烈爆发，伤毁岩石领地。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's crystals glow brighter when they release flames from their backs or maws. If they let their energy expand too much, they will release it like a violent explosion that scars their rocky territories.

entry: POKENAME常在风暴出现，用强颚接下许多雨。水晶珠亮起平时沉睡的力量，有人因此猜，它用那能量召来风暴。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME is known for appearing during storms, catching much of the rain within its strong jaws. Its crystalline orbs glow with an otherwise-dormant power, so some have assumed it summons the storms with that energy.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴撑起自己，在胸珠中聚能。力量够了，就把自己弹上天，展翼滑翔，落地再以尾缓冲。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME raise themselves with their tails to gather energy within the orbs in their chests.  Once they have enough power, they launch themselves into the air and spread their wings to glide, cushioning their landings with their tails.

entry: 小群POKENAME藏在远离人类的云间。受惊时，白毛转灰，再以强雷电击周围一切。
author: mistymagius
source: Small groups of POKENAME hide amongst the clouds far from human contact. If startled, their white wool turns grey, and they shock everything nearby with a powerful thunderbolt.

entry: POKENAME强壮迅疾，能带近三倍体重，仍以最高每小时75英里飞行。有些宝可梦中心与巡护员，会用它快速运送救急物资至灾区。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Strong and swift, POKENAME can carry almost three times their weight while keeping speeds of up to 75 miles per hour in the air. Some Pokémon Centers and Rangers employ POKENAME to quickly transport emergency supplies to areas ravaged by disaster.

entry: POKENAME体内储着大量电力，使羊毛中的水晶发光。据说放电时，这颗水晶能引发雷暴。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME stores large amounts of electricity inside their bodies, causing the crystal in their wool to glow. It is said that this crystal can cause thunderstorms when POKENAME discharges electricity.

entry: 奢华生日会常能见POKENAME，优雅又稀有，备受珍视。照料虽费心，它造出的闪亮水环却让来宾着迷；水环迸成光点，据说能为未来一年带来好运。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are found at lavish birthday parties, prized for their elegance and rarity. Though demanding to care for, they mesmerise guests by forming shimmering rings of water that burst into sparkling light, said to bring luck for the year ahead.

entry: POKENAME无声滑过森林，不会撞树，边走边用爪抓水果、树果与坚果吃。尾晶迷人，尾尖却能毒刺。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME quietly glides through forests without crashing, using its claws to snatch and eat fruits, berries, and nuts while moving. Its tail crystals are alluring to many, though the tip of its tail can deliver a venomous sting.

entry: POKENAME能从胸晶放出能量。闪光与噼啪声虽吓人，其实无害，只表示它正想玩。
author: imaginita
source: It can discharge energy through the crystal on its chest.  Though the flashing and crackling produced is intimidating, it isn't actually harmful, and simply shows the POKENAME is feeling playful.

entry: POKENAME极护地盘，会无畏地以角刺击闯入者。关都迷信说，农人将它羽毛埋田，很快便获雨水赐福。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are highly territorial and will fearlessly attack intruders by jabbing them with their horns. Kantonian superstition claims that farmers who bury POKENAME's feathers in their fields will soon be blessed with rain.

entry: POKENAME储着惊人龙能，能放出毁灭性攻击，身体防御又如几乎不透的钢墙。它十分忠诚，宁可舍命，也保护训练家。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME stores an incredible amount of draconic energy to unleash devastating attacks, and their bodies have a nearly impenetrable steel wall-like defense. These loyal Pokémon will lay down their lives to protect their Trainers.

entry: POKENAME壳上水晶随天气变色。黄光预示雷暴将至，亮度则反映强弱。
author: .izik
source: The crystals on POKENAME's shell shift in color based on the weather. A yellow glow indicates an incoming thunderstorm, with the brightness reflecting how strong it will be.

entry: 为庆祝农历新年，人们常鼓励孩子做POKENAME纸模型。它与好运相连，远见一群，被视为吉兆。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Children are often encouraged to make paper models of POKENAME to celebrate the lunar new year. They are associated with good fortune, and sighting a flock of them from a distance is considered a positive omen.

entry: POKENAME十分胆小，通常只喷出墨汁，掩护逃走。可若生命垂危，也会使出全部的龙之力量。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are quite timid and usually just spray ink on its attackers to escape. But if its life is on the line, it will use its full draconic power.

entry: 它下巴的水晶珠，能发出足够强的光，轻松照清深海。它能逆着强劲的水流游动，甚至能乘着气流而行，很长时间都不必重新入水。
author: infinex21
source: The crystalline orb beneath its chin emits a strong enough light that it can easily see within ocean depths. It can swim against strong water currents and can even ride upon wind currents without needing to re-enter the water for quite some time.

entry: POKENAME体力强大，性情却温和，有时被用来驮货。雨中工作不介意，冷天却不肯出门。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME have immense physical strength but a gentle nature, and are sometimes used as beasts of burden. While they don't mind working in the rain, they refuse to go out in cold weather.

entry: POKENAME借珠中力量，随喜好改变设备设置与所连硬件。身体散出的气息，一碰电脑病毒，就会将其摧毁。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses the power within its orbs to freely change device settings and the hardware attached to them to its liking. The aura its body creates instantly destroys any computer virus it touches.

entry: POKENAME能接收气象监测卫星的信号。若察觉不喜欢的天气，它们就用珠中储力，改变天气。
author: blaizegamer
source: POKENAME are capable of picking up signals from weather-monitoring satellites. If they sense weather they don't like, they will alter the weather with the power stored in their orbs.

entry: 野外难得见到POKENAME的人说，它在空中跳跃，优雅无双。每次跃起，身后都留一层闪亮光幕。
author: sk372
source: Those who have managed to spot the elusive POKENAME in the wild report it leaping through the air with unparalleled grace. It leaves a shimmering, sparkling veil behind it with every jump.

entry: 这些优雅宝可梦，偏爱洁净清新的水源作巢。它们每年脱角，新角长回，更强、更尖，也更有光泽。
author: infinex21
source: These elegant Pokémon favor clean, fresh water sources as their nests. They shed their horns every year, which grow back with greater strength, sharpness, and a brighter sheen.

entry: POKENAME的蜕皮，常作为住宅保温材料的成分。重新利用的材料，既耐用，也节能。
author: .izik
source: The skin POKENAME sheds is often used as an ingredient in home insulation. This repurposed material is both durable and energy-efficient.

entry: POKENAME对最细微的水温变化也敏感。环境太暖，它会意外搁浅海滩，容易遭捕食。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME is sensitive to even the slightest changes in water temperature. It accidentally strands itself on beaches when its environment is too warm, leaving it vulnerable to predators.

entry: POKENAME举起爪手与杖，召来强风暴。依它意愿，可以只刮几分钟，也能持续整天。
author: .izik
