source: POKENAME raises its clawed hand alongside its staff to summon powerful storms. These storms can rage for mere minutes or persist for an entire day, depending on its intent.

entry: POKENAME卷身自卫，身体强得能弹开许多攻击。尽管如此，它们仍更爱钻地，或藏进沙暴，避开别人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME curl up to defend themselves, with their bodies being tough enough to make many attacks bounce off. Despite this, they still prefer to evade others by burrowing or concealing themselves within sandstorms.

entry: 无论风多乱，POKENAME都能轻松乘风滑翔。水晶因体内巨能发光，常在风暴中，为别人引路。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME glide effortlessly upon winds, no matter how turbulent they may be. Their crystals glow with their immense internal energy, which has oft helped guide others as they shine during storms.

entry: POKENAME以力量制造独特、反常的天气，可能形成难以承受的灾难风暴。身体气息，还会把附近任何杀毒程序，变成恶意软件。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME creates unique, unnatural weather conditions with its powers which can result in catastrophic storms that are difficult to endure. It emits an aura from its body that converts any nearby antivirus into malicious malware.

entry: POKENAME能控近处大气，周边几乎总略有潮气。因此，有时丛林栖息地外，也能见到它。
author: bobosmith01
source: The general vicinity of POKENAME is almost always slightly moist thanks to its ability to control nearby atmospheric conditions. As a result, it may sometimes be found even outside its jungle habitat.

entry: POKENAME在背上的蓝色球体里储存力量。若有森林遭砍伐或火灾损坏，它便取下一颗，埋进地里，让那里的植物更快长回。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME stores up power inside the blue orbs on its back. If a section of the forest is damaged by logging or fire, POKENAME will remove one and bury it in the ground, enabling plants in that area to grow back much more quickly.

entry: POKENAME通常在所居沙漠下挖洞，沙暴时才出来。利爪能轻易掘穿实岩，筑成巢穴。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are usually burrowing beneath the deserts they live in, but emerge during sandstorms. Their tough claws can easily dig through solid rock, which is how they form their nests.

entry: 野生POKENAME罕见，通常在暴雨前，跳舞于湖池水面。尾晶储着庞大能量，让它们能踏水而行。
author: geo_ominous
source: Rarely seen, wild POKENAME are usually found dancing on top of ponds and lakes before rainstorms. These Pokémon are able to walk on water because of the immense energy stored in the crystals on its tail.

entry: POKENAME如优雅的化身，走进哪里，都吸引全场目光。读心让它轻易亲近训练家；比赛中，还会用头翼飞起，炫耀力量。
author: ghostslythe
source: Elegance incarnate, POKENAME commands any room it enters. With its ability to read minds, it bonds easily with its Trainer. In contests it is known to take flight using the wings on its head to show off its strength.

entry: POKENAME先用大臂紧抓敌人，再放出猛烈破坏光线。招式毁灭力强，几乎无处可逃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME tightly grips an enemy with its large arms before unleashing a fierce Hyper Beam. This move is devastating and leaves little chance for escape.

entry: 人们曾以为，POKENAME智慧高，预报天气比专业气象学家更准。深入调查才发现，每逢预测下雨，其实是它自己使天下雨。
author: .jerden
source: It was once thought that POKENAME's advanced intelligence enabled it to predict the weather better than professional meteorologists. Further investigation determined that POKENAME was actually causing it to rain whenever it predicted it would.

entry: 有人说，POKENAME每颗珠，其实都是死去龙属性宝可梦灵魂的结晶。龙属性宝可梦，似乎对它格外戒备。
author: sk372
source: Some say that every orb within POKENAME's form is actually the crystallized soul of a fallen dragon Pokémon. Dragon-type Pokémon seem to regard it with a high level of wariness.

entry: POKENAME挥尾、扇头翼，便能掀强风，哪怕洞内也能扬沙暴。借此遮掩，它便可伏击猎物。
author: .jerden
source: By waving its tail in the air and flapping the wings on its head, POKENAME can create powerful winds to whip up a sandstorm, even inside a cave. The concealment this creates enables POKENAME to ambush prey.

entry: 大飓风将近，POKENAME的角会发深蓝光。懂得的人，便能从诡光得知危险将至。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's horn glows a dark blue when a large hurricane is nearing. This eerie light signals impending danger to those who understand it.

entry: POKENAME用身上水晶珠造强风。野生个体罕见，因为只有风卷起沙暴藏身，它们通常才外出捕猎。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can use the crystalline orbs on their bodies to create strong winds. Wild POKENAME are rarely seen, as they usually only emerge from hiding to hunt for prey once these winds have whipped up a sandstorm to conceal them.

entry: POKENAME花中产出的花粉，让人瞥见种种未来。反复接触，景象越发扭曲，受害者可能渐渐分不清现实。
author: icecreeper720
source: POKENAME produces pollen from its flower that causes glimpses of various futures. With repeated exposure, these visions become increasingly distorted and may cause the victim to lose their grip on reality.

entry: POKENAME脑袋大，难以保持平衡，因此更愿意藏在洞窟深处。据说，脑袋里藏着丰富的知识，它们会分享给任何设法找到自己的生灵。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are left off-balance by their large heads, so they prefer to hide deep within caves. Their heads are said to hold a wealth of knowledge, which they share with anyone who manages to find them.

entry: POKENAME体内储着惊人能量。为留给进化，它更愿尽量少动。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has an incredible amount of energy stored inside its body. To preserve this energy for evolution, it prefers to move as little as possible.

entry: 民间故事说，每1000年，POKENAME就会现身，将珍贵神秘宝珠，送给选中的龙属性宝可梦。受选者获宝石深不可测的力量，成为群龙领袖。
author: sk372
source: There exist folk tales stating that every 1000 years, POKENAME will appear and deliver its precious mystical jewel to a chosen Dragon-type Pokémon. The chosen one will become leader of all dragons, blessed by the gem with unfathomable strength.

entry: POKENAME众多珠体，因储着强能而鲜亮发光。它们不断生成能量，存进珠中，准备进化。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's many orbs glow vividly with the potent energy stored within them. They constantly produce this energy that is stored within these orbs for their evolution.

entry: 它爱玩，与同类攀崖或飞过天空。POKENAME极敏捷，先滑身避开，再轰出蓝焰。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: It is a playful Pokémon, traversing cliffs or flying through the sky with others of its kind. POKENAME is incredibly agile, slithering away before landing a blast of blue flames.

entry: POKENAME优雅，却不怕与低估自己的对象战斗。珍珠含巨大能量，为火焰攻击供能。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME is a graceful Pokémon, though it is not afraid to fight those who underestimate it. The pearls contain an enormous amount of energy, which fuel its fiery attacks.

entry: 传说有把刀，能让持有者控天气。许多人相信就是POKENAME，可它拒绝任何人碰柄试验，也未见证据说明，融合技术前就存在。
author: .fedoraman
source: Legends speak of a blade that allows the wielder to control the weather. While many believe POKENAME to be that blade, it refuses to let any human touch its hilt to test, and is not known to have existed before the advent of fusion technology.

entry: POKENAME战斗的优雅，在双剑鞘融合体中几乎无双。两柄相连，双刃便能翻转旋动，挡开几乎任何攻击，进攻也同样有效。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fights with a grace that is nearly unparalleled among Doublade fusions. By linking their hilts, both blades and twirl and spin in a way that deflects almost any attack while being an equally effective offensive maneuver.

entry: POKENAME尾部与头上的珠体，都有剧毒。身体防御极强，能扛住最重打击。
author: themicelegion
source: The orbs on POKENAME's tail and head are highly poisonous. It has a very defensive body that can withstand the hardest of hits.

entry: POKENAME沐浴尾晶光芒，用刃臂优雅起舞。据说完成这仪式，就能召来强烈暴雨。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dances elegantly with its bladed arms while bathed in the glow of the gems on its tail. It is said that performing this ritual can summon an intense rainstorm.

entry: 宝可梦培育家一致认为，POKENAME体内高压电，让毛最难梳顺。许多个体被培育参加空中比赛，紧凑肩翼有助灵活穿行。
author: ghostslythe
source: Pokémon Breeders agree POKENAME's fur is the most difficult to tame due to the high voltage stored in its body. Many are bred for aerial contests, which their compact shoulder-mounted wings help them squeeze through.

entry: POKENAME的两个金属齿轮，能将羽翼互扣，转动周身蓝环。环一旋，就影响空气，造出闪亮气场、龙卷，甚至改变头顶天气。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's two metallic gears can interlock their feathery wings to spin the blue ring encircling them. This loop affects the air around them when rotated, creating shimmering auras, spinning twisters, and even altering the weather overhead.

entry: POKENAME用强大幻象护巢，尤其爱幻化狂暴风雨。据说体内能量极大；它大半生都能维持幻象，或许真是如此。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME protects its den using powerful illusions, especially those of raging storms. It is said to contain vast energy within itself, which might be true given how it can maintain its illusions for most of its life.

entry: 村庄常向这只威严的宝可梦供奉，盼望好天气。据说，它的鸣叫，连最猛烈的风暴也能安抚。
author: melodydelune
source: This majestic Pokémon is often given offerings by villages in hopes of good weather. It's said its cry can calm the fiercest storms.

entry: POKENAME帮助宇航员，在太空保安全。谁有飘走危险，它们就手臂相连，抓住救回。救后开始蜕皮，去掉被太阳损伤的鳞。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME help astronauts remain safe while in space. Whenever an astronaut is in jeopardy of floating away, POKENAME link arms with each other to grab onto the astronaut. After the rescue, they begin shedding to remove any sun-damaged scales.

entry: POKENAME威严华美，以头翼翱翔天际，风暴中仿佛在云间跳舞。它挥神秘权杖，操纵气流与天气，守护自然和谐。
author: keiracm35_
source: POKENAME is a majestic Pokémon that soars through the skies with the wings on its head and appears to be dancing among the clouds during storms. Wielding a mystic scepter, it manipulates air currents and weather, safeguarding nature's harmony.

entry: POKENAME战斗时交替用尾巴和伸缩手臂，让敌人难以防备。难取胜时，还会踢腿、头槌，全身都成了危险武器。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME likes to switch between using its tail and retractable arms when fighting enemies, to throw them off guard. If it has a hard time winning, it will also try kicking and headbutting, making its entire body dangerous.

entry: POKENAME身体主要是一串珠体，只由其间电弧连接。碰到任何电器，都会短路，因此它通常避开人类聚落。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body mostly consists of a series of orbs, connected only by electricity arcing between them. It will short-circuit any electrical appliance it makes contact with, and so it usually avoids human settlements.

entry: POKENAME不需太多照料，在太空站很方便。每次太空外出归来，脱落鳞片若未妥善处理，就会黏住风管。即便如此，它们食量也很小。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are handy to have in space stations because they require little maintenance. Whenever they return from an excursion from outer space, they shed scales that can cling to air ducts if not properly managed. Even so, they eat very little.

entry: POKENAME在河边织网，特殊材料遇水，便形成胶状物，能困住比普通网更大的宝可梦。乌波体表的凝胶，却能溶解网。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME spin webs on the edge of rivers, using a special material that reacts with water to create a glue-like substance, trapping Pokémon much larger than a typical web would trap. The gel covering Wooper can dissolve these webs.

entry: POKENAME体内蕴藏可怕能量，必须每天平静，才不致引发灾难爆炸。自律的天性，让它控得住力量。
author: .izik
source: Terrible energy resides within POKENAME's body, so it must remain calm each day to avoid catastrophic explosions. Its disciplined nature keeps this power under control.

entry: POKENAME产生的泡泡，看着像珍珠，其实只是虹彩流转的液体。遇上威胁，便喷向对方，趁机逃走。
author: ohok3441
source: While the bubbles POKENAME produces look like pearls, it's nothing more than an iridescent fluid. It spits it at any threat to make a quick escape.

entry: 为适应雪地，POKENAME长出几丛厚毛，在风雪中保护面部。可厚毛也因此，遮住了视线。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME's snowy habitat has led it to adapt patches of thick fur for protecting its face during blizzards, which has restricted its eyesight.

entry: POKENAME头颈的毛，夏天极其柔软，冬近则硬化。随季节变化，让它终年舒适。
author: .izik
source: The fur on POKENAME's head and neck becomes extremely soft in summer, hardening as winter approaches. This seasonal adaptation keeps it comfortable all year.

entry: POKENAME的爪与水晶珠同材质，坚韧得切金属也不崩口。能量满满，让它几乎从不休息。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's claws are made of the same material as their crystalline orbs, so they are tough enough to cut into metal without chipping. They are so full of energy that they rarely ever rest.

entry: POKENAME身上的圆珠，会放出明亮的电蓝色光，晃花注视者的双眼，因此，想拍到一张好照片，并不容易。
author: mistymagius
source: The orbs on POKENAME's body glow with an electric blue light. They use this to blind anyone that see them, so good photos of POKENAME are rare.

entry: 据说POKENAME尾上的每颗水晶珠，都含巨力。吐出的火是蓝色，可究竟因高热，还是珠中能量，尚未证实。
author: infinex21
source: Each of the crystal orbs upon POKENAME's tails are said to hold immense power. The flames it breathes are blue, but whether this is due to the heat or due to the energy of its orbs is still unverified.

entry: POKENAME唱歌，胸珠便随节拍发光。歌声尤其能催眠龙属性宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's chest-orb glows when it sings, following the tempo of its song. Its singing is particularly effective at putting Dragon-type Pokémon to sleep.

entry: POKENAME脊背宝石，会依所用攻击类型，发出不同颜色。这番鲜亮景象，既美丽，也有威慑力。
author: .izik
source: The gems along POKENAME's spine glow in different colors, changing based on the type of attack it uses. This vibrant display is both beautiful and intimidating.

entry: POKENAME壳上的珠吸收阳光，储能供日后取暖。遇险，还能造巨大龙卷。
author: .izik
source: The orbs on POKENAME's shell absorb sunlight, allowing it to use the energy later as a heat source. When threatened it can create massive twisters.

entry: POKENAME齿轮似以软翼代替硬齿，可羽毛全由金属构成。齿轮互扣旋转，轻轻叮当，仿佛音乐。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's gears seem to have soft wings instead of hard teeth, but all of their feathers are made of metal. The sound made as the interlocking gears spin is a soft and musical clinking.

entry: POKENAME大齿轮能高速转动，把小齿轮射向敌人。众多金属翼一扇，两轮很快重聚；重新咬合后，珠中能量也能补充。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's larger cog can spin at high speed to launch its smaller cog at foes, but the flapping of their many metallic wings will quickly reunite the two gears. By interlocking together again, the energy stored in their orbs can be recharged.

entry: POKENAME比外表看着快得多。多年来，许多邮政机构都请它跨地区送信。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: Despite appearances, POKENAME is a very fast Pokémon. Throughout the years, POKENAME have been used by many postal systems to deliver letters across regions.

entry: 传闻POKENAME住在高山洞穴，训练家极少见到。幸运看过的少数人，往后许多年都会获好运赐福。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Rumored to live in caves high in the mountains, POKENAME is very rarely seen by Trainers. Those lucky few that have seen it are blessed with good fortune for many years to come.

entry: 传闻POKENAME住在高山洞穴，训练家极少见到。幸运看过的少数人，往后许多年都会获好运赐福。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Rumored to live in caves high in the mountains, POKENAME is very rarely seen by Trainers. Those lucky few that have seen it are blessed with good fortune for many years to come.

entry: 雷暴将至，POKENAME头上小翼就开始颤抖。这份敏感，让它及时找庇护。
author: .izik
source: The small wings on POKENAME's head begin to shudder when a thunderstorm is on the way. This sensitivity to storms helps it find shelter in time.

entry: POKENAME腹部蓝晶，能放出强大能量束。这股能量看去耀眼，却也危险。
author: .izik
source: The blue crystal on POKENAME's belly can emit powerful energy beams. These bursts of energy are both dazzling and dangerous to behold.

entry: POKENAME住在纯净湖底，慢慢积蓄进化能量。下雨，便浮上来，在水洼休息。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME lives at the bottom of pristine lakes, slowly gathering energy for evolution. When rain arrives, it comes to the surface to rest in puddles.

entry: POKENAME每十年，才会蜕下斗篷般的外层，长出新的，全程独处、隐秘。人们相信，找到旧披风穿上，便能获得神秘力量。
author: sk372
source: Once a decade, POKENAME will shed its cloak-like covering and grow a new one, a process done in complete solitude and secrecy. It's believed finding and wearing a discarded cloak will grant the wearer mystical powers.

entry: POKENAME双翼不够有力，飞不起来。可它仍四处跳，拼命拍翼，试着升高。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME's wings aren't strong enough to allow for flight. Despite this, POKENAME jumps around, flapping its wings furiously to try and gain height.

entry: POKENAME常在飞后休息时，哼平静旋律，水晶珠随之闪烁。谁抓长尾，它就尖叫，朝惹事者喷龙焰。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's crystal orbs flicker and shimmer as it hums a tranquil melody, oft done while it rests after a flight. If one ever grabs its long tail, it emits a shrill shriek and spews draconic flames at the perpetrator.

entry: 飓风前，POKENAME触角便开始抽动，感知大气变化。提早预警，让它能找安全处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's antennae begin to twitch before a hurricane, sensing the atmospheric changes. This early warning helps it seek safety.

entry: POKENAME常藏在自己垂落、坚如岩石的肢体下。头顶水晶珠，储能越多越发光，可惜常因此惹恼其他宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME often hide under their own dangling limbs that are as hard as solid rock. The crystalline orbs atop their heads emit light as they store more energy, which unfortunately tends to draw the ire of other Pokémon.

entry: 人们相信，POKENAME在空中挥动前肢的珠体，便能改变天气。它们栖居的森林，似乎总有细雨飘落，使皮肤免于干燥。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is believed to have the power to change the weather by waving the orbs on its forelimbs in the air. Drizzle always seems to fall on forests in which they live, preventing POKENAME's skin from drying out.

entry: 它后肢立起，便急扇头翼，制造冰寒狂风。仍有人猎POKENAME，抢取闪着极光般光芒的水晶珠。
author: infinex21
source: When it rears, it rapidly flaps the wings on its head to create a chilling gale. Some still hunt POKENAME for crystal orbs that shimmer with aurora-like light.

entry: POKENAME从水晶放寒气，再用如帷幕般的众多小翼，扇向潜在威胁。谁敢威胁幼崽，它便释放庞大的零下能量。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME looses a freezing air from its crystals and uses its veils of many small wings to send said air toward any would-be threats. It will loose its vast, subzero energy at any who dare threaten its young.

entry: 这些难寻踪的宝可梦，歌声深受少数听过的人珍视。水晶珠曾让它们遭猎，数量直到最近，才开始恢复。
author: infinex21
source: The songs sung by these elusive Pokémon are treasured by the few who have ever heard them. Their crystal orbs were once a cause for them to be hunted, and only recently have their numbers started to recover.

entry: 据说POKENAME背菇的孢子能延寿。科学分析，却发现多种毒素，吃下有害人类健康，不过，某些少量使用，仍可能治病。
author: .jerden
source: It is said that spores from the mushroom on POKENAME's back can prolong life. Scientific analysis detected numerous toxins that would be hazardous to human health if consumed, although in small doses some may still be useful to treat disease.

entry: POKENAME想召雷暴，就会朝天长嚎，声音回荡大地。此时，背鳞闪出明亮天蓝光芒。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME wishes to summon a thunderstorm, it howls at the sky, its voice echoing across the land. During this time, its back scales shimmer with a brilliant cerulean glow.

entry: POKENAME摩擦头上薄鳞，就能随意操纵天气。稍一用力，便召来狂暴风雪，隐藏踪迹。
author: .izik
source: By rubbing the thin scale on its head, POKENAME can manipulate the weather at will. With little effort, it can summon a raging blizzard to obscure its presence.

entry: POKENAME臂上坚硬、如宝石的鳞，每挡一次攻击，就会充能。储下的力量，再用来增强拳击。
author: .jerden
source: The hard, gem-like scales on POKENAME's arms are charged with energy every time they are used to block an attack. POKENAME can then use this stored power to increase the force of its punches.

entry: POKENAME能使天气多雾，方便隐身。舌头伸长，附着近处物体，还能帮助保持平衡。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME is able to change the weather to be foggier, which helps with its stealth. The tongue of POKENAME is able to help it balance better by extending and attaching it to nearby objects.

entry: POKENAME的火翼，稳定壳内原本难控的热能。暴怒时，双翼会化成巨大无形烈焰，吞没大地。
author: vaporvenator
source: POKENAME's fiery wings act as stabilizers for the otherwise uncontrollable amount of heat energy in its shell. The wings morph into giant, shapeless flames that engulf the land when POKENAME is enraged.

entry: 闯入者进入领地，POKENAME便怒跺脚。准备召雷暴时，颈宝石亮起黄光。
author: .izik
source: If an intruder enters its territory, POKENAME stamps its feet in rage. The gem on its neck glows yellow as it prepares to summon a thunderstorm.

entry: POKENAME水晶珠闪闪发光，仿佛装着小星星。自卫时，它才认真释放体内能量。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's crystalline orbs shimmer with light as if they contain miniature stars. It unleashes its internal energy in earnest to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME将多余热量储存在身上的蓝色球体中。战斗陷入下风，它便尽数释放，让球体迸出绚丽的蓝焰。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME stores excess heat in the blue orbs on its body. When it is on the backfoot in a battle, it releases all of its stored heat, the orbs erupting in a blaze of gorgeous blue flames.

entry: POKENAME若不满天气，出洞后就会改变。只随一念，暴雨便能瞬间形成。
author: .izik
source: If dissatisfied with the weather, POKENAME will alter it upon surfacing from its burrow. Sudden rainstorms can form instantly at its whim.

entry: 亮鳞、水晶与光泽浓鬃，让POKENAME常在宝可梦华丽大赛出现。它们很虚荣，花大量时间梳理自己。
author: keiracm35_
source: POKENAME are often seen in Pokémon Contests thanks to the beauty of the shining scales and crystals on their bodies and their lustrous, thick manes. They're very vain and spend a lot of time grooming themselves.

entry: POKENAME头痛严重，便会无意召来暴雨。这常能冷却头脑，缓解痛苦。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME's headache becomes severe, it unintentionally summons a rainstorm. This phenomenon often cools its mind, bringing relief.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉、视力敏锐，追踪轻松；壮实身材与丰富强招，又让它能自在穿行各种环境。攻击时，水晶会亮起明蓝光。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME's keen sense of smell and strong eyesight allow them to easily track, while their bulky frame and strong selection of moves let them navigate any environment with ease. The crystals on their body glow a bright blue when attacking.

entry: POKENAME全身散出强烈热气场。为练习控它，它们住在寒湖底，一边为其他宝可梦取暖，一边掌握得更好。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME exude a powerful aura of intense heat from their bodies. In order to train this aura, they live at the bottom of cold lakes, providing warmth for other Pokémon while gaining greater control.

entry: POKENAME游力强，用长尾推动，在水中高速前进。善良可靠，很适合救人，因此深受救生员喜爱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are powerful swimmers, using their long tail to propel themselves through the water at high speed. They are popular Pokémon amongst lifeguards, their kind and reliable nature making them well-suited to saving people.

entry: POKENAME精神与神秘力量极大，随身带珠，帮助集中。战斗中，珠也能由念力操纵，充作有效的棍击武器。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses a vast amount of psychic and mystical power. It carries with it an orb to help focus its powers. The orb also works as an effective bludgeoning tool in battle, manipulated via telekinesis.

entry: POKENAME造出数颗浮在身旁的球形宝石，攻击未经允许靠近的一切。据说它藏在深山，考验前来的龙属性宝可梦的胆识。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME creates several spherical gems that float around it, attacking anything that draws close without permission. It's said to lie deep within mountains, testing the mettle of Dragon types that approach it.

entry: POKENAME的预知力，在风暴中最为强大。它凝望暴雨中的云，便能清晰看见未来的景象。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME's clairvoyant abilities peak during storms. It gazes at the clouds during heavy rains, viewing crystal-clear images of the future.

entry: POKENAME把满溢能量导入腰带。据说腰带有改变天气的力量。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME channels its overflowing energy into its belt. The belt is said to possess the power to change the weather.

entry: POKENAME每赢一场战斗，手中珠体便因更强力量而发光。它不肯放珠，便用其余三臂，打出快得目不暇接的拳。
author: foolish_weasel
source: The orb in POKENAME's hand glows with increasing power with every victory it has in battle. It refuses to let go of the orb, and resorts to using its other three arms to punch blindingly fast.

entry: POKENAME跑得够快，便能积起起飞所需动量。它好胜心强，尤其受骑宝可梦参加越野赛的训练家喜爱。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it runs fast enough, POKENAME can even generate the momentum needed to take off. Due to its highly competitive nature, it is especially appreciated by Trainers who compete in cross-country races riding on their Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME高贵的蓝焰，能达1000度。它骄傲固执，出了名难训练。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's regal blue flames can reach temperatures of 1000 degrees. They are known to be difficult to train due to their prideful and stubborn nature.

entry: POKENAME能察觉异常天气，却反应慢到，天气已来，才提醒别人。于是它始终平静，却总慢一拍。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can detect abnormal weather patterns but reacts so slowly that it only alerts others after the weather has already arrived. This delayed response keeps it calm yet behind the times.

entry: POKENAME头两侧的大翼，对其他宝可梦的情绪、能量敏感。战斗中，它借此判断何时攻击，何时退回壳内避险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The large wings on either side of the heads of POKENAME make them sensitive to the moods and energies of other Pokémon. They use this sensitivity in battle to tell them when to attack and when to withdraw to the safety of their shell.

entry: 船歌说，有只POKENAME只在寒海遇见，盘在壳中巨珍珠旁，仿佛坐着王座。深夜深海，珍珠会以安宁光辉，照亮海洋。
author: silentscript89
source: Sea shanties tell of a POKENAME only encountered in frigid seas, coiled around a massive pearl within its shell as if resting on a throne. Within the deep of night and sea, its pearl is said to illuminate the ocean with a serene, tranquil glow.

entry: POKENAME挥臂动指，在空气中造闪亮涟漪。这景象引诱、催眠别人，让它吸取能量，供给自身精神力量。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME waves its arms and fingers around, it creates a shimmering, sparkling ripple in the air. This display entices and hypnotizes others, so that POKENAME can siphon energy from them to fuel its own psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME心地善良，爱照顾小虫宝可梦。它飞遍森林，采树果分享，让它们不必冒险自行采摘。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a kindhearted being that loves to take care of other small bug Pokémon. It flies around the forest gathering berries to share with them, saving them the risks from gathering them themselves.

entry: POKENAME蛋壳极其坚固，几乎能抵挡任何攻击。壳始终近乎闭合，从没人见过里面的样子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's eggshell is extremely sturdy and protects it from almost any attack. It keeps its shell almost completely shut, so none have seen what it looks like beneath the shell.

entry: POKENAME夜飞，橙鳞如星闪耀。它爱独处，一被看见，就会离开当地几个月。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's orange scales glisten like stars as it flies at night. It prefers solitude and will abandon an area for months if it is spotted.

entry: POKENAME用头骨伸出的触须，感知人类痛苦。它借救助别人，克服自身悲伤。
author: spkypirate
source: POKENAME can sense the suffering of humans with the feelers emerging from its skull. It overcomes its grief by coming to the rescue of others.

entry: 据说POKENAME拿的骨头，永不折断，它们很爱当棒作战。虽好斗，却从不摘面具，掉了就会十分害羞。
author: heal_fire
source: The bone that POKENAME hold is said to be unbreakable, and they love to fight by using this bone as a club. Despite their love for battle, they never remove their mask and act very shy if it falls off.

entry: POKENAME将力量与技巧巧妙结合，带爪双拳快得让空气起火。其战斗风格，出了名难以看透、难以反制。
author: xillo
source: With a fine mix of force and finesse, POKENAME's clawed fists move so quickly they set the air ablaze. Its fighting style is notoriously hard to read and counter.

entry: 据说POKENAME曾守望远古沼泽，以神秘烟雾围住珍视的一切。平时温和，可谁未经邀请闯入烟雾，就会被毒素淹没。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Said to have kept watch over an ancient swamp, POKENAME protects anything precious to it by surrounding it in enigmatic smog. While POKENAME is normally peaceful, anyone that tries to enter the smog uninvited will find themselves flooded with toxins.

entry: POKENAME收养野外遇见的每只迷你龙，放袋里安全照料。它极护幼崽，又厌暴力，一觉有险，就会以惊人速度飞走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME adopts and cares for any Dratini it finds in the wild, keeping them in its pouch for safety. Very protective and averse to violence, it will take to the skies with terrific speed if it feels the young one is in any danger.

entry: POKENAME收养野外遇见的每只迷你龙，放袋里安全照料。受它养大的个体，因为照顾周到，寿命更长，也更健康。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME adopts and cares for any Dratini it finds in the wild, keeping them in its pouch for safety. Dratini raised by POKENAME are noted to live longer, healthier lives due to its care.

entry: POKENAME特殊的鳍让它几秒便能游过5000多米。会用这速度追捕猎物、赶走竞争者。
author: kitarchen
source: Using specialized fins, POKENAME are able to swim over 5000 meters in mere seconds. They use this speed to hunt down prey and chase off competitors.

entry: 想养POKENAME作宠物，得给很大空间与多片水域。不许它从一池跳出，滑去另一池，就会坐立不安。
author: sk372
source: Those who would take POKENAME as a pet should be prepared to give it lots of space and multiple bodies of water. It gets restless if it is not allowed to leap out of one pond and glide its way to another.

entry: POKENAME每年迁徙，会蜕落、散下许多鳞，收藏者片片珍视。可惜鳞含强神经毒素，危险得碰不得。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME shed and scatter many scales during their yearly migrations, each greatly valued by collectors. Unfortunately, the scales contain a potent neurotoxin, making them far too dangerous to handle.

entry: POKENAME虽能飞，陆上跑却更快。前路若有障碍，直接撞穿就行。
author: .jerden
source: While it can fly, POKENAME is much faster running along the ground. If any obstacles are in its way, it can simply smash through them.

entry: 野生POKENAME常冲撞入侵领地的对象。借翅膀，它们能轻易转向，继续追撞。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME are prone to charge at others that enter their territory. With their wings, they can easily change course and continue to charge at intruders.

entry: POKENAME力量无双，能轻松逆流游。它鼓励同胞训练，直到也能做到。
author: cheroace
source: POKENAME can effortlessly swim up streams with peerless strength. It encourages its brethren to train until they can do the same.

entry: POKENAME大多在水下，偶尔低飞海面。平常虽冷静，见别的宝可梦暴走，就会飞去阻止，结果打成破坏严重的大仗。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of its time underwater, but can occasionally be seen flying low above the surface of the ocean. While normally calm, if it sees another Pokémon rampaging, it will fly in to stop them, resulting in a very destructive battle.

entry: POKENAME穿行雷暴，一振翼，就生飓风般强风。它吐出的雷电流，足以焚毁整栋建筑。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME travels in thunderstorms, a single flap of its wings creating hurricane-force winds. It breathes streams of lightning strong enough to incinerate entire buildings.

entry: POKENAME柔软温暖，很适合喜欢抱宠物的人。最厚的毛略有疗愈作用，紧拥时，能舒缓身心紧张。
author: sk372
source: Soft and warm, POKENAME is an excellent companion for those who love to cuddle their pets. The thickest parts of its fur possess mild therapeutic qualities, soothing tension in a person's mind and body when they hold it close.

entry: 许多人认为，POKENAME最友善、最适合抱。可这魅力也给饲主添点麻烦：它太强又太爱拥抱，让人极难挣脱。
author: sk372
source: Considered by many to be one of the friendliest and cuddliest of Pokémon, this charm point actually causes a minor issue for POKENAME owners. Namely, its great strength and love of hugs makes escaping an embrace extremely difficult.

entry: POKENAME常疾跑开阔原野，偶尔跃起、滑翔，走得更远。它先连番快啄快踢，再用强尾抽击，打倒敌人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are often witnessed dashing across open fields, occasionally leaping and gliding for even greater distances. They attack with rapid flurries of pecks and kicks before finishing their foes off with a lash from their strong tails.

entry: POKENAME靠长途飞行，消耗体内积蓄的多余能量。蜕鳞用于草药，据信有助恢复精力。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME spends excess energy built up in its body by flying long distances. Scales shed during molts are used in herbal medications and are thought to help restore energy.

entry: 这种自我融合的POKENAME，有鲜亮蓝鳞，能抵抗许多攻击。胡须上的珠体，据信能实现纯洁之人的心愿。
author: chibitales
source: This self-fusion of POKENAME boasts brilliant blue scales that are resistant to many attacks. The orbs on its whiskers are thought to hold the power to grant the wish of a pure-hearted person.

entry: POKENAME每个头，各管一部分巨力。三头一致，便能非凡地掌控大气；可头与头达成共识，极少见到。
author: wiz0z
source: Each head of POKENAME controls a part of their immense power. When all three heads are in agreement, POKENAME wields extraordinary authority over the atmosphere. Consensus amongst the heads has rarely been observed.

entry: POKENAME心地善良，会用柔软羽翼，拥抱难过的人。攻击虽极强，下最后一击前，却总留片刻，让敌人有认输求饶的机会。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is a kindhearted Pokémon who will use its soft, feathery wings to hug people who feel sad. Its attacks are extremely powerful, but it will always give a moment for enemies to concede for mercy before finishing them off.

entry: POKENAME心地善良，会用柔软羽翼，拥抱难过的人。攻击虽极强，下最后一击前，却总留片刻，让敌人有认输求饶的机会。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is a kindhearted Pokémon who will use its soft, feathery wings to hug people who feel sad. Its attacks are extremely powerful, but it will always give a moment for enemies to concede for mercy before finishing them off.

entry: POKENAME尾上彩虹珠，充满能把刻薄的人与宝可梦变善良的强能。善意能维持多日，让它深受各地人们渴求。
author: soup1900
source: The rainbow orb on POKENAME's tail is filled with powerful energy that can turn mean people and Pokémon into kind ones. The lasting effects of kindness can last up to many days, making POKENAME very wanted by people all around.

entry: POKENAME自认为龙属性中的天才，忍不住挑战别的龙，比力量或智慧。一赢，就会摆出高人一等的架子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME views itself as something of a prodigy among Dragon types. It can't resist the urge to challenge them in shows of strength or intelligence, and lords its superiority over them should it win.

entry: POKENAME天生淘气，信送到附近住家后，还会用瞬间移动调换。邻居反复收到彼此的信，它就远看烦恼，独自偷笑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is very mischievous by nature, swapping letters after delivery to nearby homes using its teleportation abilities. It watches from afar and giggles to itself at their frustration when neighbors repeatedly receive each other's mail.

entry: POKENAME天生想助人，却又胆怯，常常内心挣扎。不过真有人需要帮助时，它一定会竭尽所能。
author: arcul
source: POKENAME constantly struggle with their innate desire to help others and their timid nature. However, when someone truly is in need of assistance, POKENAME will be there to do anything they can.

entry: 风暴将至，头上触角便高兴地振动。POKENAME飞累了，就回海中，凭强尾优雅游动。
author: fiordaliso
source: The antennae on its head vibrate with joy when a storm is approaching. When it grows tired of flying, POKENAME returns to the sea waters, where it moves gracefully thanks to its powerful tail.

entry: POKENAME虽不大，也不惧更大的敌人或猎物。双翼强劲，至少十只成群，就能卷起猛烈狂风。
author: infinex21
source: Despite their size, POKENAME do not shy away from larger foes or prey. Their wings are strong enough that, together in a flock of at least ten, they can whip up fierce gales.

entry: POKENAME翼弱，不能久飞，却能配合强肌肉，跃得很远。巨颚若没吓退敌人，它很快就会诉诸暴力。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's wings are too weak to fly for long yet, paired with its strong muscles, it can leap far. This Pokémon is quick to resort to violence if its large jaws do not scare its foe away.

entry: POKENAME橙黄尾上的环纹，能衡量年龄。它能飞，却更愿慢慢走，从一处到另一处。
author: quackquackattack
source: The bands on a POKENAME's saffron tail measure how old they are. They have the ability to fly but prefer to take their time walking from one place to another.

entry: POKENAME小群迁徙，从海岸到海岸。头冠最长的被视为首领，须带全群，安全穿过可能危险的海风。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME travel in small flocks, migrating from coast to coast. The one with the longest crest on its head is considered the leader, expected to guide the entire group safely through the potentially hazardous ocean winds.

entry: POKENAME虽是一条龙，却像骑士一样，拯救困在城堡中的公主。闪亮的铠甲，也硬如黑曜石。
author: dodoowner_
source: Although a dragon, POKENAME saves princesses from castles like a knight. Its shining armor is as tough as obsidian.

entry: POKENAME皮肤上的花纹描绘着一条绿色蛇形龙。龙所做的事似乎每天都变，谁也不知道原理。
author: sontyp
source: The skin of POKENAME shows markings depicting a green, serpentine dragon. What that dragon does seems to change daily, but nobody knows how this happens.

entry: 体内龙能满溢，让它不吃也能活。体力与力量惊人，连飓风中也能飞。POKENAME睡在深水下。
author: bobosmith01
source: It doesn't need to eat to survive, as its body overflows with draconic energy. With incredible stamina and strength, it can fly even through hurricanes. POKENAME sleeps deep underwater.

entry: POKENAME以体力与友善闻名，许多训练家用它跨地区飞行。头羽深受欣赏，越老越鲜亮。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are famous for their stamina and friendliness, commonly used by many Trainers to fly across regions. The feathers atop their heads are beautiful to many and they grow more vibrant as they age.

entry: POKENAME虽罕见，却常救海上迷途者。它载近岸，以浮力强的毛裹住，让对方浮着游完最后短程，再消失天际。
author: periperi_chicken
source: Though rarely seen, POKENAME often rescues those lost at sea. POKENAME carries them toward shore, then wraps them in its buoyant wool to keep them afloat to swim the small distance back, before vanishing into the sky.

entry: POKENAME如今以友善著称，古文却说，它有龙一般骄傲独立的心。这种被认为改变的行为，究竟为何，仍有争论。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although recognized nowadays for its friendly nature, POKENAME's name has been written in old texts as having the prideful and independent heart of a dragon. What has caused this perceived change in behavior is still up for debate.

entry: POKENAME如今以友善著称，古文却说，它有龙一般骄傲独立的心。即使最猛烈的雷暴，它也无畏飞越。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although recognized nowadays for its friendly nature, POKENAME's name has been written in old texts as having the prideful and independent heart of a dragon. It fearlessly flies through even the most intense of thunderstorms.

entry: POKENAME见于湖中及湖边，通常守护弱小宝可梦，也用尾珠，引导迷途旅人与宝可梦。性情虽温和，遇险时，尾巴仍强得能打碎树。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are found within and around lakes, typically guarding weaker Pokémon but also they use the orb on their tail to guide lost travelers and Pokémon alike. Although docile, their tail is strong enough to shatter trees if threatened.

entry: POKENAME像雕像般站在训练家前院，等邮件送到。终于来了，它就挨家挨户，胡乱分发。
author: spkypirate
source: POKENAME waits unmoving like a statue on its trainer's front lawn, waiting for the mail to be delivered. When it finally arrives, POKENAME goes from door to door, distributing it at random.

entry: POKENAME常在雨中出来，奏乐、起舞。雨声与它们的节拍，相得益彰。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME often come out during the rain to make music and dance. The sound of the rain complements the rhythm of their beats.

entry: POKENAME头部触须，能感知何时降水。常能见它在飓风周围飞，发出诡异蛙鸣。
author: dodoowner_
source: The feelers on POKENAME's head can sense when precipitation will occur. It is often seen flying around hurricanes, emitting eerie croaks.

entry: 它头戴珍珠冠，人们认为，那是非凡力量的来源。POKENAME整天快乐地乘着海上气流。
author: fiordaliso
source: It wears a crown of pearls on its head, which is believed to be the source of its extraordinary strength. POKENAME spends all day joyfully riding wind currents above the sea.

entry: POKENAME常在飞行中偷物，拿来啃咬，磨短不断长的门牙。正是这些行为，让童话里的龙被写成贪婪，尽管它们其实平和。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME often steal items mid-flight to gnaw  and file down their growing incisors. It is these actions that led dragons in fairytales being depicted as greedy, despite their true peaceful nature.

entry: POKENAME流畅的流线身体与高速拍翼，让它快速往来森林。迷你龙栖居的湖旁，常能见它悬浮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's sleek and streamlined design and rapid wingbeat let it fly at high speeds from forest to forest. It can often be found hovering around lakes where Dratini are present.

entry: POKENAME群落常在灯塔附近筑巢，遇险船，就协助守塔人。灯塔门上常刻着它的标志，表达敬意。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME colonies often nest near lighthouses and assist lighthouse keepers when there is a stricken vessel. It is common to see a symbol of POKENAME etched above the door on lighthouses as a sign of respect.

entry: 人们常说，POKENAME太重、翼又小，无法飞。可登山者已记录到，它在山顶周围缓慢飞行。
author: bigoljax
source: It is commonly said that POKENAME are unable to fly, due to their heavy weight and small wings. However, mountaineers have documented seeing POKENAME slowly flying around mountain peaks.

entry: 据说，愿给POKENAME食宿的人家，会获好运赐福。可许多倒霉屋主，却低估了它惊人的胃口。
author: griddle
source: It's said that a household that's willing to feed and shelter a POKENAME will be blessed with good fortune. However, many unfortunate homeowners have underestimated its voracious appetite.

entry: POKENAME躺岸边等猎物，再吐出真正的球形身体，当弹丸击晕。只要看见一只，就足够封闭整片海滩。
author: clevernamegoeshere.
source: POKENAME lies on shores in wait for prey before spitting out its true, spherical form as a projectile to stun them. Just one of them being spotted is enough to close an entire beach.

entry: 传说，一位圣骑士借POKENAME相助，建立骑士团，保卫王国。龙之俯冲的压倒力量，扫倒一切胆敢挑战者。
author: cobalt0135
source: Legends say that a paladin founded an order of knights with the help of his POKENAME to protect his kingdom. The overwhelming power of its Dragon Rush mowed down any that dared to challenge it.

entry: POKENAME收集稀有树果，存进洞穴深处。冬前，它会用龙息，保藏这些树果。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME gathers rare berries and stores them deep within its cave. It uses Dragonbreath to preserve these berries before winter.

entry: POKENAME栖居的小岛很小，树木稀少，因此得飞到远方岛屿，采集树果。虽然收来的果实全是自己所需，它们仍会毫不犹豫地分给挨饿的生灵。
author: soup1900
source: Since the islands POKENAME live on are tiny and contain few trees, they must fly to and gather berries on islands far away. While they need all the berries they gather for themselves, they won't hesitate to share some with others who starve.

entry: POKENAME意志极强，连猛烈风暴也能飞越。速度与可靠，让一些运输公司雇它，递送急件。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a remarkably strong-willed creature capable of flying even through violent storms. Some delivery companies employ it for express shipments thanks to its speed and reliability.

entry: POKENAME身体圆，翼也小，却仍能约24小时环游世界。它用这份速度猎食。
author: mcnchsschl
source: Despite its rotund body and small wings, POKENAME can still fly around the world in about 24 hours. It uses this speed to hunt for food.

entry: POKENAME是全球货运与送信的重要伙伴。尾巴最多能承载自身体重的一半，几小时便能飞过不同地区。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are essential for shipping goods and delivering letters worldwide. They can carry up to half their body weight in their tails and fly between regions within a few hours.

entry: POKENAME用强尾，挂在开阔水域旁的树或岩石上休息。醒后，迅速潜水，长途游动，既能在水下，也能让背部划过水面。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME rest by using their strong tails to hang from trees or rocks near open waters. When awake, they dive quickly into the water and swim across large distances both below the surface and with their topsides cutting across it.

entry: POKENAME睡觉会紧盘身体，把头收向内侧。游泳与飞行本领，都十分出众。
author: bobosmith01
source: When POKENAME sleeps, it coils up tightly and tucks its head inwards. It has remarkable swimming and flying abilities.

entry: 兴奋的POKENAME常拜访艺术大学与画廊，在那里卸下画作，供展示、换购，价钱则得是合适数量的树果。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Art universities and galleries are often visited by excited POKENAME. There, they unload the art they made to be shown and bought, for the right price of berries.

entry: 兴奋的POKENAME常拜访艺术大学与画廊，在那里卸下画作，供展示、换购，价钱则得是合适数量的树果。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Art universities and galleries are often visited by excited POKENAME. There, they unload the art they made to be shown and bought, for the right price of berries.

entry: POKENAME独特尖鸣，会威吓周围。罕有目击它吃海生宝可梦，不知为何，餐后总会蜕落亮鳞。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has a distinctive, sharp cry that intimidates those around it. It has rarely been spotted eating marine Pokémon; for some reason, after a meal, it sheds glittering scales.

entry: 偏远岛屿的遗迹显示，古文明曾将POKENAME当某种神祇敬奉。它虽不凶，却保护遗迹，很少准人探索。
author: sk372
source: Remote islands contain ruins that suggest old civilizations worshiped POKENAME as some type of deity. Though not violent, POKENAME is protective of these ruins and rarely lets anyone explore them.

entry: 传闻POKENAME游历世界，确保火山状态良好。它虽有毁灭之力，却选择善良温柔，很少攻击人类。
author: fiordaliso
source: Rumor has it that POKENAME travels the world making sure that volcanoes are in good condition. Although it possesses devastating power, it chooses to be kind and gentle, and rarely attacks humans.

entry: POKENAME大角含巨力，又能净水，过去因此引来许多猎人。这些尝试也让人发现，它能将力量导遍全身，毁灭性地释放。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's large horns hold immense power and can cleanse water, which led many to hunt them in the past. As was learned with those efforts, it can channel that power through its whole body and unleash it destructively.

entry: POKENAME虽躯体巨大，威严羽翼仍强得能带它起飞。鳞坚如钻石，让它无惧近战。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's majestic feathered wings are powerful enough to lift itself into flight despite its massive bulk. Scales as hard as diamond let it face close combat without fear.

entry: POKENAME太重，很少尝试用背翼飞。仅抬起巨身，就耗尽能量，通常仍失败。可战斗时，它会竭尽全力，飞起作战。
author: zaymcawesome
source: POKENAME rarely tries to fly with its wings on its back because it's so heavy; it takes up all its energy just to lift its big body off the ground and usually fails. But in battle, it uses all its might to fly and fight.

entry: 作家常写POKENAME威严，见过的人，却多说它舒适亲切、爱打盹。孩子说，和它玩整天，一觉之后，它便不见。
author: quackquackattack
source: Writers often describe POKENAME as majestic creatures, but many who have met them describe a cozy creature who enjoys naps. Children describe playing with POKENAME all day only for them to disappear after a nap.

entry: POKENAME用宽大颈膜，长程滑过空中。它摇尾警告闯入者，尾巴脉动，发出不祥回响。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its large hood to help it glide long distances through the air. It warns away intruders with a shake of its tail, which pulses and produces an ominous reverb.

entry: POKENAME虽仍能环游全球，却更愿吃吃睡睡。不过，快龙善良的性子，依旧保留。
author: cascadeguy
source: Despite still being able to circle the globe, POKENAME would much rather eat food and doze off. It still retains Dragonite's kindhearted personality, however.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，翼纹按不同顺序闪动。它用电力悬浮、移动。
author: infinex21
source: The patterns on POKENAME's wings flash in varying sequences during battle. It uses electrical forces to levitate and move.

entry: POKENAME看似过重，证实大部分重量，却是肌肉。长舌不仅有音速拳般的打击力，还覆着黏物，特别适合采食。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME appear to be overweight, but most of their weight has been proven to be muscle. Their long tongue is not only able to strike with the force of a Mach Punch, but it is also coated in a sticky substance perfect for collecting food.

entry: POKENAME从掌孔射出的石头，形似大珍珠。据说能带来好运，却很少找到完整的一颗。
author: spkypirate
source: The stones that POKENAME fires from the holes in its palms resemble large pearls. It is said that they bring luck, but it is rare to find one in one piece.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME天生能理解别人心意。谁极度绝望，它就可能从高处撒下异界般的粉末，似乎很快便带来好运与幸福。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is thought to be able to naturally understand the hearts and minds of others. If someone is in utter despair, POKENAME may sprinkle an otherworldly powder on them from far above that seems to soon bring them good fortune and happiness.

entry: POKENAME卷身既自卫，也会飞高，砸向敌人攻击。翼虽小，快拍仍能掀起局部沙暴。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME curl up to defend themselves, but also to attack by flying and dropping themselves onto foes. Their wings may be small, but they can still whip up localized sandstorms by flapping them quickly.

entry: POKENAME飞行时进行光合作用，沿途常产出大量清新空气。它们在大城市很受欢迎，人们献上礼物，却多半被拒。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME experience photosynthesis while in flight and often produce large amounts of clean air wherever they travel. They are very popular in large cities and are offered gifts they mostly reject.

entry: 它们飞得很静，多半仿佛滑翔，一有机会，便俯冲猎物。POKENAME挥动大爪或粗尾，轻易就能碎石。
author: infinex21
source: They fly quietly, seeming to be gliding more than not, and swoop upon prey the moment they can. POKENAME can crush rocks with ease by swinging their large claws or their bulky tails.

entry: POKENAME以背翼在枝间滑翔，不必落地，也能走过森林。若找到丛林迷途者，它便试着领向最安全的出口路线。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses the wings on its back to glide between tree branches, enabling it to move across the forest without ever touching the ground. If it finds people lost in the jungle, it will try to lead them towards the safest route out.

entry: POKENAME用翼与强腿弹上高空，再以坚硬利爪，俯冲敌人。许多旅人，曾靠爪痕指路得救。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their wings and strong legs to launch high and dive at foes with their sharp, tough claws. Many travelers have been saved by marks left by their claws that helped guide them.

entry: 年龄增长，鳞会转为金橙。它们住沼泽等泥水丰沛处。POKENAME展开厚大双翼威吓别人，一扇，便能造强浪。
author: infinex21
source: Their scales turn golden-orange as they age. They dwell in marshes and other places plentiful with mud and water. POKENAME spread their bulky wings to intimidate others and can create strong waves with a flap of said wings.

entry: POKENAME心地善良，十分关心幼小龙属性宝可梦。据说，优雅舞蹈连最烦躁的小龙，也能安抚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a kind soul that cares greatly for young Dragon-type Pokémon. The elegant dances it performs can soothe and comfort even the most agitated of baby dragons, so it is said.

entry: 追随飞行的POKENAME，被视为可靠航海建议。它旋转的空中舞，平息下方水面，让跟着航线的船，顺利通行。
author: sk372
source: Following a POKENAME in flight is considered sound sailing advice. The Pokémon's twirling aerial dance calms the waters beneath it and ensures smooth sailing for ships that follow its path.

entry: 敬奉龙属性宝可梦的古文明中，POKENAME常守卫祭龙神殿。如今，有些仍守着遗迹，抵御亵渎者。
author: sk372
source: In ancient civilizations that worshiped Dragon-type Pokémon, POKENAME would often be found protecting the temples that honored the dragons. Even today, some can be found still guarding the ruins from those who would desecrate them.

entry: POKENAME的超能力凝成了颈间水晶，它会借水晶强化龙类本能。
author: phoenixftw
source: POKENAME's psychic powers have manifested into the form of the crystal it wears around its neck, which POKENAME uses to amplify its draconic impulses.

entry: 这只本来心善的宝可梦，连训练家受威胁，仍带微笑。怒意却会化作头顶聚起的雷云。
author: spkypirate
source: This otherwise kind-hearted Pokémon remains smiling even when its trainer is threatened. Its rage manifests instead in the storm clouds forming above.

entry: POKENAME心善优雅，护人却极凶猛。许多训练家因可爱友善的外表，低估了力量。
author: geo_ominous
source: A kindhearted and graceful Pokémon, POKENAME is fiercely protective of others. Many Trainers underestimate its power because of its cute, friendly appearance.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME情感敏锐，已到完全共情的地步。它凭与训练家的情感联系，预知疾病与悲伤，帮助渡过难关。
author: envoypixel
source: It is believed that POKENAME's emotions are heightened to the point of complete empathy. It uses its empathetic connection to its trainer to predict sicknesses and sadness so it can help them through hard times.

entry: POKENAME用羽毛垫住臂刃，调控锋锐，减轻打击。它常借这技巧，指导职业剑士与马上长枪比武者。
author: kungfucutbug
source: POKENAME can control the sharpness of the blades on its arms using its feathers, cushioning the blades to soften blows. It commonly coaches professional swordfighters and jousters with this technique.

entry: POKENAME双翼静止，却浮在空中，飞得也快。别看体形，它的龙之俯冲威力毁灭性地强。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's wings remain still and yet they float in the air and can fly rather swiftly. Despite their size, they strike foes with devastatingly powerful Dragon Rush attacks.

entry: POKENAME拍后腿飞行，靠磁力升空。鳞虽如金属闪耀，却永不生锈、失泽。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME flaps its rear legs to fly, generating lift through magnetic force. Although POKENAME's scales gleam like metal, they never rust or tarnish.

entry: POKENAME收起腿，能浮在最凶海暴之上。它们极聪明，会跟船救人，连船员自己尚未察觉危险，也已出手。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can tuck in their legs to float above even the roughest storms at sea. They are incredibly intelligent and will follow ships to rescue people even before the crew realizes they are in danger.

entry: POKENAME虽能用翼短飞，大多仍在地上。它通常埋沙，再跳出，以强咬攻击猎物。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME can fly short distances using its wings, it mostly remains on the ground. POKENAME usually buries itself in sand, then leaps out to attack prey with its powerful bite.

entry: POKENAME大多在地下，游沙如游水。它用头部触角，感知地表宝可梦的脚步振动，再跳出，用利爪袭击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends much of its time underground, swimming through sand as easily as through water. POKENAME uses the antennae on its head to sense vibrations produced by Pokémon walking on the surface, then leaps out to attack with its sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME实力强大，通常连比自己大的对手，也能击倒。它又十分体贴，常照料较弱的宝可梦。
author: mossybanana
source: A strong Pokémon, POKENAME can typically take down opponents larger than itself. It is very compassionate, and will often watch over weaker Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用头上迷你龙状触须，引近本想捕食的对象，反将对方吃掉。既能维生，也保护珍视的野生迷你龙。
author: sk372
source: Using the Dratini-shaped tendrils on its head, POKENAME draws in would-be predators closer so that it can devour them instead. In this way, it sustains itself while protecting the wild Dratini it holds dear.

entry: POKENAME一清醒活跃，就向一切反对或挡路的东西，释放全力。龙爪攻击，能劈穿实心金属。
author: infinex21
source: An alert and active POKENAME unleashes its full might upon anything actively opposing it or obstructing it. Its Dragon Claw attacks can cleave through solid metal.

entry: POKENAME一生大多懒躺，肌肉却始终致密，爪如剃刀锋利。活跃时，最好避开，因为它会毁掉挡在下一餐前的一切。
author: infinex21
source: Though POKENAME laze around most of their lives, their bodies always retain dense muscles and their claws remain razor-sharp. When active, they are best to be avoided for they will destroy anything between them and their next meal.

entry: 小群POKENAME跟在船后。若船开始下沉，它们便载水手前往安全处。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: Small groups of POKENAME follow behind boats. If the ship begins to sink, they will carry the sailors to safety.

entry: POKENAME将落海者护在巨嘴里，载往安全处。身体能扛极压，让它在海下远行数千里格。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME rescues people who fall into the sea by sheltering them inside its immense mouth and carrying them to safety. Its body can withstand extreme pressure, allowing it to travel thousands of leagues beneath the ocean.

entry: 古代，信徒跳神圣舞蹈时，会把POKENAME鳞片贴在额头。舞步本身，却已失传。
author: .izik
source: In ancient times, worshippers pressed POKENAME's scales to their foreheads during sacred dances. The dance steps themselves have been lost to time.

entry: POKENAME背部自然长出塔状结构。小宝可梦偶尔在塔顶休息，甚至筑巢，温柔的它也不介意。
author: sk372
source: A tower-like structure grows naturally off of POKENAME's back. On occasion, smaller Pokémon will use the top of the tower as a place to rest or even build nests, which the gentle POKENAME doesn't mind.

entry: POKENAME想与野外遇见的尼多朗，交朋友、保护它们。危险一来，就抓住同胞，飞往安全处，完全避开战斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tries to be a friend and protector to Nidoran it meets in the wild. When danger approaches, it grabs hold of its brethren and flies them away to safety, avoiding battle altogether.

entry: POKENAME有闪亮钢角，与覆甲、形似权杖的双翼。青铜鳞与板甲胸，闪着王者威仪。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME bears gleaming steel horns and armored, scepter-like wings. Its bronze scales and plated chest glint with regal authority.

entry: 据说，这只剑宝可梦，曾从瓦砾与战俘营中，救出战争的受害者。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This sword Pokémon is said to have rescued victims of war from rubble and prison camps.

entry: 这只披甲宝可梦，将龙力导过内建的奥秘能量枪，发出集中冲击，击退威胁。全身构造如活枪，持有者一下令，便释放力量。
author: goldpoyo
source: This armored Pokémon channels draconic force through a built-in arcane energy gun, firing focused blasts to ward off threats. Its entire form is shaped to function as a living firearm, unleashing power the moment its wielder commands.

entry: POKENAME友善又好奇，极其厌恶任何争斗。局面一旦变得暴力，它就飞快振翅，卷起风尘，帮助自己和朋友，逃离可能发生的战斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is friendly and curious, with a strong aversion to any sort of combat. If things start turning violent, it kicks up wind and dust with rapid flapping of its wings to help it and its friends escape the potential fight.

entry: POKENAME从栖居深海跃出，会留下彩虹色光迹。据说看见奇景的人，往后一年，都获好运赐福。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME leaves a rainbow-colored streak behind it when it leaps out from the ocean depths it inhabits. Those who manage to catch sight of the spectacle are said to be blessed with good luck for a year afterward.

entry: POKENAME鳞一沾湿，便似闪闪发光，空中飞、水里游，都优雅无双。它能召暴雨，常借此驱人离开天然栖息地。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's scales appear to shimmer when wet. It soars through the air and swims through water with unmatched grace. It has the power to cause rainstorms and will often use this power to drive people away from its natural habitat.

entry: POKENAME不易生气，齿轮通常慢转。若身旁其他宝可梦受威胁，它便暴怒，高速转动，以疾旋的尾与尖刺攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is slow to anger, and its gears usually turn slowly. If other Pokémon around it are threatened, it will become outraged, spinning itself up to high speed, then attacking with its rapidly rotating tail and sharp spikes.

entry: 故事中，沉船上的水手，本以为必死无疑，回过神来，却已被POKENAME送回陆地。
author: melodydelune
source: Stories are told of sailors on sinking ships who had thought they were doomed only to find themselves brought to land by POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME力量无比强大，却又温柔害羞，常待在海底附近。游动时，若察觉上方有船，它便让海浪保持和缓，确保水面的旅人平安通行。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is an incredibly powerful being, but also very gentle and shy. It stays near the bottom of the sea, but if it senses ships sailing above it while it swims, it keeps the ocean waves gentle to ensure safe travel for those on the surface.

entry: POKENAME能抬高、塑造周围地面，按需要改变地形。传闻它曾在远离人类处，造出一列岛屿，让龙宝可梦平静生活。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can shape and lift the ground around it, manipulating the terrain to suit its needs. It's rumored that it has created a series of islands far from humanity, where Dragon Pokémon can live in peace.

entry: POKENAME几乎总在云上高飞，据说每天环球超过两次。它一降下，连雷云也会分开。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME is almost always flying high above the clouds, supposedly circling the globe more than twice a day. When it descends, even storm clouds will part.

entry: POKENAME双翼由极硬却轻巧的合金构成，得以飞行。触角能感知数英里外的生命，迅速帮助遇险者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wings are made of an extremely hard but lightweight alloy that enables flight. Its antennae can sense life forms from miles away, allowing it to quickly assist those in danger.

entry: POKENAME为救迷航船，毫不犹豫迎向风暴。它用毛与体内热量，为受海寒之苦的对象取暖。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME will brave storms without hesitation to rescue lost ships. It will use its fur and its internal heat to warm up those chilled by the sea.

entry: 传说POKENAME会飞进飓风中央，让尾巴火势高涨，驱散风暴。也确有记录，见它从沉船救人。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Legends tell of POKENAME flying in the middle of hurricanes and flaring their tails to dispel them. POKENAME have been documented saving people from sinking ships.

entry: 战斗中，POKENAME用身上花束中藏的毒刺，削弱对手。强翼能长飞，因此它常搬往长受阳光眷顾的地方。
author: fiordaliso
source: During battles, POKENAME weakens its opponents with the poisonous thorns hidden among the flower bouquets growing on its body. Its powerful wings allow it to fly for long periods, so it often moves to places always blessed by the sun.

entry: POKENAME通过周身花里的利刺散毒，慢慢消磨敌人。巨大翼展，让它能不知疲倦地飞越天空，寻找新而明亮的家园。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME scatters venom through the sharp thorns concealed within the blossoms covering its body, slowly wearing down its foes. With its vast wingspan, it can soar tirelessly across the skies in search of new, sunlit lands to inhabit.

entry: POKENAME性情欢快，以舞蹈表达喜悦。旋转时，缤纷芳香的花瓣散开，立刻振奋观看者，因此深受训练家与宝可梦喜爱。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME is a cheerful Pokémon that expresses its joy through dance. As it twirls, it scatters vibrant, aromatic petals that instantly lift the spirits of all who see them, making it a beloved companion for both Trainers and Pokémon alike.

entry: POKENAME用等离子体，显得比真身更大。它常改屠龙游戏的代码，让其他生物代替龙，成为敌人。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME uses plasma in order to appear larger than it actually is. It often changes the code of dragon-slaying games, making other creatures the enemies instead.

entry: POKENAME十分罕见，只有满月之夜，才会被看见在天空滑翔。它们善待迷途的旅人，用翅膀散发的淡淡光芒，指引对方归家。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are a rare sight, as they are only seen gliding across the sky on nights of a full moon. They are friendly toward lost travelers, guiding them home with the pale light radiating from their wings.

entry: POKENAME守护神社与寺庙，赶走自认不配进入的对象。传说若得到它认可，就会获得力量与繁荣。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME protects shrines and temples and will chase anyone it deems unworthy. Stories say that if it does deem you worthy, it will bring you strength and prosperity.

entry: POKENAME虽属妖精，却带着多件增强龙宝可梦所需的重要物品，让许多物种乐意见到。偷猎者常为小物与它引向其他龙的路线，盯上它。
author: deadshields
source: POKENAME carry multiple items vital to empowering Dragon Pokémon, making their sight a blessing to many species despite being Fairy-Types. POKENAME are often targeted by poachers for their trinkets and how they lead the way to other Dragon-Types.

entry: POKENAME渴望尊重，做出著名龙属性训练家模样的伪装。它无畏冲入战场，炫耀超群实力。
author: mepp.
source: Yearning for respect, POKENAME creates a disguise with the likeness of a famous Dragon-type Trainer. It fearlessly charges into battle to show off its elite strength.

entry: 往日传说中，POKENAME凶猛危险，如今却被视为爱玩、极忠诚。有人推测，古代的凶性，是人类侵占领地造成。
author: chibitales
source: Legends from years past depicted POKENAME as a fierce and dangerous Pokémon. Nowadays, they are seen as playful and fiercely loyal. It is theorized the ferocity from POKENAME in the past was caused by humans invading their territory.

entry: POKENAME住在大气层外缘，每天至少环球三次。它们掌着可怕力量，猎食某些最强的龙属性宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME reside in the outer reaches of the atmosphere, circling the globe at least thrice a day. They wield terrifying power and use that power to prey upon some of the strongest Dragon-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME长途飞过海洋，身后拖闪亮星尘。似乎只有察觉难过的孩子，才停下现身，实现心愿，逗其微笑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flies vast distances across the oceans, trailing sparkling stardust behind it. It only seems to stop when it senses a sad child, appearing before them to grant a wish and make them smile.

entry: POKENAME凭勤劳的建造本领，修复破船，让船员返家。虽用原木，它们却爱自然，每砍一树，就种一苗。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME use their industrious building skills to rebuild wrecked ships in order for the ship's crew to return home. Despite using logs for their building projects, this species loves nature, so they plant a sapling for every tree they cut down.

entry: POKENAME能量几乎无尽，飞一周多，也不会累。它爱与小孩子玩，只是偶尔会兴奋过头。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has nearly boundless amounts of energy, able to fly around for over a week without tiring out. It loves to play with young children, but it can get a bit too energetic every now and then.

entry: POKENAME展开纤翼威吓别人。虽看似弱，火却能熔钢，头角坚硬锋利，足以刺穿实岩。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME spread their slim wings to try and intimidate others. Though they may look weak, their flames can melt steel and the horns upon their heads are tough, and sharp, enough to penetrate solid rock.

entry: POKENAME能大量吸气，轻松胀大，让多数攻击弹开。这也让它更轻，飞得更好。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can inhale a great deal and expand without issue, which makes most attacks bounce off of them. This also serves to make them lighter and thus able to fly better.

entry: POKENAME进化后，会飞离家园，寻找更大水域。盐水导电好，因此更受它偏爱。
author: cait_sith
source: Upon evolving, POKENAME flies away from its home in search of larger bodies of water. It has a preference for saltwater habitats due to the water conducting electricity well.

entry: POKENAME跑得快，一天就能环球。它又慷慨，一次最多让三人骑背。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can run so fast that it can circle the globe within a single day. It is a generous Pokémon, letting up to three people ride on its back at a time.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，唱着安宁的旋律，棉絮般的羽毛小片，在下方轻轻飘落。它们能长途快飞，甚至尚未驯服时，也曾载过其他生灵。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME sing a serene melody as they fly, small pieces of their cotton-like plumage gently fluttering below them. They can fly quickly across long distances and have been known to carry others, even if they have not yet been tamed.

entry: 低估POKENAME速度的对手，很快就知道错。敏捷攻击与烈焰幻象结合，迅速压倒敌人。
author: coridiant
source: Opponents that underestimate a POKENAME's speed soon realize their mistake. It quickly overwhelms an enemy with its mix of agile attacks and fiery illusions.

entry: POKENAME众多肢体也充当翅膀，一起挥，便掀狂风，快速起飞。休息时，头藏在坚肢下，挡开多数攻击。
author: infinex21
source: Their many limbs function as wings as well, allowing them to take off rather quickly with forceful gale forces as all are swung at once. When POKENAME rest, they conceal their heads under their solid limbs that repel most attacks.

entry: 建筑倒塌，就派POKENAME找幸存者。一找到，蘑菇便发光，再摇出巨响，提醒救援人员。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When buildings collapse, POKENAME are sent in to find survivors. Upon finding someone, their mushrooms glow and are shaken to make a loud noise to alert first responders.

entry: POKENAME将冰寒暴雪中的迷途探险者，引往温暖洞穴避难。这物种的冻结化石，曾呈防御姿势，仿佛护着什么，抵挡来袭。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME helps guide adventurers lost inside of freezing blizzards to warm caves for their shelter. Frozen fossils of this species can be found in defensive postures, seemingly shielding something from an incoming attack.

entry: 野生POKENAME天生害羞内敛，找到可信赖的群体或训练家，才逐渐敞开。一有信心，就会成为热闹忠诚的伙伴。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Wild POKENAME are shy and reserved by nature, but they open up more when they find a pack or Trainer they trust. Once they've found confidence, POKENAME are boisterous and loyal companions.

entry: 这种宝可梦睿智又善良，僧侣常来求问生命的意义。曾被目击保护孩子与弱者。
author: krune
source: This very wise and very kind Pokémon is often visited by monks in search of the meaning of life. It has been seen defending children and the weak.

entry: POKENAME不停飞过森林，撒孢子长蘑菇。若遇人，便在上方盘旋几小时；人们认为，真菌就这样传进家里。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME constantly flies over forests, scattering spores that grow into mushrooms. If it encounters people in the forest it will circle above them for hours, and it is believed that this is how it spreads its fungus into human homes.

entry: 野生POKENAME通常住偏岛，靠硬鳞保护自己，用强拳与粗尾，守护岛上宝可梦，不受人类侵害。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME usually live on remote islands. Protected by their tough scales, they use their powerful fists and strong tails to defend the Pokémon of their island homes from humans.

entry: POKENAME勉强能飞，却极少飞，更爱游泳。壮体力量庞大，对尊重的对象，却温柔友善得出奇。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is barely capable of flying, but rarely does so. Its preferred mode of transportation is swimming. Its bulky body possesses immense strength, but POKENAME is surprisingly gentle and friendly towards those it respects.

entry: POKENAME超能力发达，能把杖当作飞天扫帚，载着自己前往任何想去的地方。它极其善良温柔，看见谁需要帮助，都会竭尽所能。
author: fiordaliso
source: Thanks to its developed psychic powers, it is able to use its staff as a flying broomstick, carrying POKENAME wherever it wishes to go. It is an infinitely kind and gentle creature that does everything in its power to aid anyone it sees in need.

entry: POKENAME速度、灵活性惊人，能从诸多角度，巧用多种攻击解决敌人。长舌常用来迅速采大量食物，必要时，也能重重挥击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME move with stunning speed and agility, deftly dispatching foes with myriad attacks from many angles. Their long tongues are oft used to quickly collect large amounts of food, but can be swung with great force if needed.

entry: POKENAME一天就能环球多次。代谢多种宇宙辐射获得的能量，让它活力满满。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME circle the globe many times over within a single day. They are brimming with energy gained from metabolizing myriad cosmic radiations.

entry: POKENAME用利爪猛攻敌人，直到投降或不再动。双翼仍在发育，却已能帮助大跳，跃过峡谷。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME ravages foes with its sharp claws until they either surrender or cease to move. Its wings are still developing, yet aid it in making large leaps that could cross a canyon.

entry: 挖洞挖腻，POKENAME就破土，飞上天，速度可比民航喷气机。
author: .izik
source: When bored of digging, POKENAME erupts from the soil and takes flight. It can reach speeds comparable to a commercial jet.

entry: POKENAME每年一次，大群迁往城都龙穴。数量增加，似乎也让当地龙属性宝可梦的交配次数，在这时增多。
author: sk372
source: Once a year, POKENAME migrate en masse to the Dragon's Den in Johto. Their increased presence seems to cause an uptick in the mating frequency of Dragon types in the area during this time.

entry: POKENAME天性善良，靠土中振动，感知洞穴里的迷途旅人。它直接掘到对方身边，再引往安全出口。
author: jackjirachi
source: Kind by nature, POKENAME senses lost travelers in caves through vibrations in the soil. It tunnels straight to them and then guides them safely out.

entry: 古王饲养POKENAME作宠物的记载很多，因此它长久象征财富与权力。
author: mepp.
source: There have been many accounts of ancient kings keeping POKENAME as pets. As a result, they have long been a symbol of wealth and power.

entry: POKENAME极忠诚温柔，被视为幼童第一只宝可梦的上选。即使保护训练家，内心仍柔和，只为逐敌，不为伤害。
author: sk372
source: Exceedingly loyal and gentle, POKENAME is considered an excellent choice as a young child's first Pokémon. Even when defending its Trainer, it is still gentle at heart and only fights to repel a foe, not injure them.

entry: POKENAME的咆哮充满威严，奔跑起来，一周就能绕世界一圈。唯有心地纯净的人，才会见到它现身。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's roar is a thing of majesty. They can run fast enough to circle the globe in a week, and will only reveal themselves to the pure of heart.

entry: POKENAME以重荣誉闻名。虽凭惊人飞速，瞬间便能取胜，它们却克制不用，让战斗光明、公平。
author: blaizegamer
source: POKENAME are known for their honourable nature. Although they are capable of winning battles in an instant with their incredible flight speed, they refrain from doing so to keep the battle honourable and fair.

entry: 这只宝可梦睿智，居于古神殿，向强大训练家传授智慧。据说，所带绿珠蕴藏巨力。
author: mistymagius
source: This wise Pokémon resides in ancient temples, granting wisdom to strong Trainers. The green orbs it carries are said to contain a great power.

entry: 过去，POKENAME飞得快、身体又耐用，很适合各地传信。如今虽少见，仍忠诚地提供这项服务。
author: sk372
source: In the past, POKENAME's flight speed and durable body made it ideal for sending messages all across the regions. Though less commonly seen, it still loyally provides this service to this day.

entry: 为无法自卫的对象而战。无论敌人是谁，只要尾焰未熄，就绝不放弃。
author: weirdisnormal
source: This Pokémon fights for those that cannot defend themselves. No matter the opponent, it will never give up until the flame on its tail dies out.

entry: POKENAME为战斗而活，却不浪费时间，对付弱者。绿焰热得能熔掉多数已知材料。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live to battle, yet will not waste their time on weaker opponents. Their green flames burn hot enough to melt most known materials.

entry: 许多水手受过POKENAME救助。它听水花警觉，捞人出水，放在离岸几米处。它不喜陆地，连飞越也不爱。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Many sailors have been rescued by POKENAME. It is alerted by the splashing and scoops them up out of the water and deposits them a few metres from shore. It dislikes the land and doesn't even like to fly over it.

entry: POKENAME懒洋洋地待在偏远岛屿的沙滩。没有天敌，也让它们对游客，格外友好。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME laze around on remote island beaches. They don't have any natural predators, so they are quite friendly towards tourists.

entry: POKENAME越老，尾毛越鲜艳、显著，胡须也越长、越卷。常能见它们用壳，载着年幼、较小的宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's tail furs grow more vibrant and pronounced with age, as do their whiskers grow longer and more curled. They have commonly been seen ferrying younger, and smaller, Pokémon atop their shells.

entry: 这些聪明宝可梦，能用臂上喷水口，将自己射向空中。背部喷口释放的水流或能量，既精准，又极具破坏力。
author: infinex21
source: These clever Pokémon can use the waterspouts on their arms to launch themselves through the air. The streams of water or energy loosed from the waterspouts atop their backs are precise and devastating.

entry: POKENAME即使遇最恶风暴，也会领迷途水手返陆。可它会一直跟到人睡着，好吃掉他们的梦。
author: st4rdustyugure
source: POKENAME is known to guide lost sailors back to the land, even in the worst storms. However, it follows them until they fall asleep, so it can eat their dreams.

entry: POKENAME借迷你龙有节奏的摇摆，催眠迷途旅人。它领受害者去传闻女巫居住的森林最暗处，此后，再没人见过他们。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME hypnotizes lost travelers through Dratini's rhythmic swaying. It leads victims into the darkest part of the forest where witches are rumored to live, and they are never seen again.

entry: POKENAME背上的蜂巢，不停酿出蜂蜜，因此身边，总围着一群其他虫宝可梦。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME continuously produces honey in the honeycomb on its back. For this reason, it is constantly accompanied by a swarm of other bug Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME触角散出的粉，会让孩子困倦。随后，它用黏丝裹住孩子，带回蜂巢。
author: .izik
source: The dust that comes off of POKENAME's antennae can cause drowsiness in children. It will then wrap the child with a sticky string and bring it to its hive.

entry: 造型虽不太合空气动力学，POKENAME却据说飞得比静电还快。落地时，训练家误当高级球，迎来爆炸的惊喜。
author: ghostslythe
source: Even though aerodynamically questionable, POKENAME is said to zip through the air faster than static. When it lands, Trainers mistake it for an Ultra Ball and suffer an explosive surprise.

entry: 这只宝可梦只能爆炸一次，因此极谨慎。真觉得非炸不可，威力却足以毁掉两层楼房。
author: bradlybro199
source: This Pokémon can only explode once, making it extremely cautious to do so. When it finally feels it is necessary, it has enough explosive power to destroy a two-story building.

entry: POKENAME几分钟就能给整片花田授粉。可它也很危险，五头轮流刺击，快得惊人地注入致命毒量。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can pollinate an entire flower field within a few minutes. It can be quite dangerous because its five heads will take turns stinging its victim, injecting fatal amounts of venom alarmingly fast.

entry: POKENAME投骨远击，保卫蜂巢。骨上覆着薄薄毒层。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME defends its hive by hurling its bone across great distances. The bone is coated in a thin layer of poison.

entry: POKENAME毒拳强得能粉碎威胁山中训练场的岩石属性宝可梦。它在花岗岩巨石上磨刺，一磨数天，再出拳，将石打成粉。
author: ilazerheart
source: POKENAME's venomous punches carry enough power to pulverize the Rock-type Pokémon that threaten its training grounds in the mountains. It sharpens its stinger on granite boulders for days at a time, then punches the rock to dust.

entry: POKENAME是大针蜂巢里的重要品蜜师，定期用长舌尝蜜，确保酿得妥当。不合格的，就用舌舀出，丢到巢外。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME play a vital role as honey tasters in Beedrill hives. To ensure honey is made properly, POKENAME periodically samples honey with their long tongues. Any defective honey is scooped out with their tongues and tossed out of the hive.

entry: POKENAME孔中漏出气味极强的蜜，是小虫的美味点心。这糖浆状物质，对人类与非虫属性宝可梦，却有毒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME leaks a very pungent honey from its pores that acts as a delicious treat for small insects. The syrupy substance is toxic to humans and non-Bug-Type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME触角能察觉细微湿度变化，判断是否下雨，轻松躲开暴雨。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's antennae can detect subtle changes in humidity and determine if it will rain. With this knowledge, it hides from rainstorms with ease.

entry: POKENAME虽属毒属性，蜂蜜少量吃，却颇有益健康。溶在热柑橘茶，或温哞哞鲜奶里，味道最好。
author: _pixelar_
source: Despite its classification as a Poison-type, POKENAME's honey can be quite healthy if consumed in small doses. It tastes best dissolved in a hot citrus-y tea or in warm Moomoo Milk.

entry: POKENAME常把蜂蜜黏在角上，想吃甜食时，就有零嘴可享。若角上还沾着蜜，谁想触碰，就会遭到巨大尾刺的攻击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME often keeps honey stuck to its horn so that it has something to snack on when it craves sweets. Trying to touch its horn while it has honey on it will result in it attacking with the massive stinger on its tail.

entry: POKENAME产出营养丰富、气味甜美的花粉，人类医生用来制强效药。跳舞时，双翼轻轻嗡鸣，也能治好患者失眠。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME produces a highly nutritious, sweet-smelling pollen that is used by human doctors to craft powerful medicines. The gentle buzzing of its wings as it dances is known to cure insomnia in patients.

entry: POKENAME成群逆流游，将河染成金色。遇险，便用角刺击袭击者，注入强毒。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME swim upstream in swarms, painting the river a golden hue. When threatened, they jab their horn into attackers, injecting a potent venom.

entry: POKENAME用角在河床挖洞，里面筑蜂巢状的窝，产蛋在其中，免受水流侵袭。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their horns to dig burrows in the riverbed. They create hive-like nests in these burrows, laying their eggs inside so that they're safe from the current.

entry: POKENAME十分害羞，常躲在树后避开训练家。不过，手上的毒刺依旧危险。
author: schierke
source: POKENAME is a very shy fusion; it tends to hide behind trees to avoid Trainers. The stingers on its hands pose a dangerous threat.

entry: POKENAME防御领地，却不愿真刺。首次攻击前，它会反复比划刺击，作为警告。
author: .jerden
source: When defending its territory from intruders, POKENAME is hesitant to actually sting. It will mime out the action multiple times as a warning before it makes its first attack.

entry: POKENAME酿的蜜，用于丰缘许多甜点。圣繁花号上一家餐厅，就拿来做樱子果杯子蛋糕。
author: .izik
source: The honey that POKENAME cultivates is used in many different desserts within the Hoenn region. A restaurant on the S.S. St. Flower uses it in their Cheri Berry Cupcakes.

entry: POKENAME的蜂蜜味道不固定，会随巢里有哪些成员而变。虽说因此难卖，有些小市场仍将它当作“神秘口味”产品出售。
author: bobosmith01
source: The honey that POKENAME produce has no consistent flavor and varies depending on the individual POKENAME that are part of the nest. While this does make their honey difficult to sell, some small markets do offer them as a "mystery flavor" product.

entry: POKENAME向针上吐火，裹上烈焰，让突刺更致命。若真暴怒，它便不停射火针，直到累倒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME breaths fire onto its needles to coat them with flame, making its jabs more deadly. If truly enraged, it will fire flaming needles nonstop until it collapses from exhaustion.

entry: POKENAME虽有强毒，其实很温顺，更爱吃家园水边的花蜜。毒只用来自卫，驱赶捕食者。
author: colt1917
source: POKENAME, despite being highly venomous, is actually very docile. It prefers to feed on nectar from flowers around the waters it calls home. POKENAME's venom is used defensively to ward off predators.

entry: POKENAME尾刺含危险毒液。熬浓后，却能用来抛光木家具。
author: .izik
source: The spike on POKENAME's tail contains a dangerous venom. If boiled down, the venom can be used to polish wooden furniture.

entry: POKENAME凶暴、护地盘、好攻击得惊人，一在某地出现，其他宝可梦便逃。它尤其憎鸟，见到就无情射能量束，从空中轰落。
author: occulusmalus
source: POKENAME is an astonishingly violent, territorial, and aggressive creature, to the point that other Pokémon will flee if one appears in an area. It particularly hates bird Pokémon and will mercilessly blast any it sees from the sky with energy beams.

entry: POKENAME在神奥北部结群，筑冰巢，保护环绕壳的蜂。产的蜜格外甜，是蜂蜜酒的热门添加物。
author: ghostslythe
source: In the northern reaches of Sinnoh, POKENAME create colonies, building icy nests to protect the bees surrounding their shells. The honey produced is especially sweet and a popular additive to mead.

entry: POKENAME把脸埋花，吃花粉。基因组成，让它能随环境条件，自行进化。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME buries its face in flowers to consume pollen. Its genetic makeup allows it to evolve spontaneously depending on environmental conditions.

entry: POKENAME振翼，摩擦产生的静电，在毛间连起电弧。它从尖毛颈圈放出连番针击，保卫领地。
author: infinex21
source: As POKENAME's wings churn, the friction generates static electricity that arcs across its fur. It defends its territory with a flurry of Pin Needle attacks unleashed from its collar of spiky fur.

entry: POKENAME不断滴下温蜜。野外一见，总有小宝可梦跟后，喝它沿途留下的蜜。
author: reflecbeat
source: POKENAME is constantly dripping with warm honey. When one is found in the wild, it is always followed by smaller Pokémon sipping at the trail of honey it leaves behind.

entry: POKENAME虽比普通大针蜂温顺，仍很护地盘。它在特定树种旁悬浮，从前方双尖，射出细小刺痛能量。
author: sk372
source: Although more docile than the average Beedrill, POKENAME is still quite territorial. It hovers around specific types of trees, and fires little stinging bolts of energy from the two prongs on its front.

entry: POKENAME能将头自由旋转360度，像坦克般移动。毒刺其实在身体前方，能向对手射出猛烈飞弹针。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME can rotate its head freely 360 degrees and move like a tank. The stinger is actually at the front of its body, and will fire a nasty Pin Missile at opponents.

entry: POKENAME臂上毒刺，最多能伸出身体10英尺。刺极锋利，能穿金属。
author: .izik
source: The stingers on POKENAME's arms can extend up to 10 feet from its body. The stingers are exceptionally sharp and able to pierce metal.

entry: POKENAME帮助大针蜂，守住装满蜜的巢，不让不速之客入内。利刺连石头也能穿。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME helps Beedrill keep the honey-filled hives safe from unwanted visitors. Its sharp stingers are capable of piercing even stone.

entry: POKENAME双翼坚固得出奇，让它速度惊人。但相对捕到的巨猎物，毒较弱，因此主要反复用刺扎敌，渐渐削弱。
author: thordemidgard
source: POKENAME's wings are surprisingly sturdy and allow this Pokémon to move with incredible speed. However, its venom is relatively weak for the huge prey it catches, so it mainly uses its stinger to stab into foes and weaken them with many stings.

entry: POKENAME随身带一对尖刺，名为自卫，其实多用来挑够不着的树果，供自己啃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries a pair of pointed stingers around with it. Ostensibly for self-defense, in actuality the points are mostly used to spear out-of-reach berries for POKENAME to nibble on.

entry: POKENAME威严双翼每拍，就散冰寒花粉。它性子冷静，避免冲突，却曾将领地里失控、好斗的虫属性宝可梦冻住。
author: sk372
source: A chilling pollen spreads from POKENAME's majestic wings with every flap. It has a calm disposition and avoids conflict, but has been seen freezing unruly and aggressive Bug-Type Pokémon in its domain.

entry: 这只宝可梦以暴烈闻名，像有些“小个子逞强”的脾气，常毫无预警，攻击任何比自己大的东西。
author: blake
source: This Pokémon is known for its violent nature, seeming to have some form of "little man syndrome" as it often attacks anything larger than itself without warning.

entry: POKENAME长出了可供活动的翼，却还没形成有效攻击手段。它极好斗，会把整个茧身砸向近处对象，盼有天终于能刺些什么。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has formed wings that allow it mobility, but no manner of effective offense has yet formed. It is highly aggressive, flinging its entire cocooned body at those who draw close to it, waiting for the day it can finally sting something.

entry: POKENAME常歇草甸，欣赏花朵。虽酿蜜，却极少吃，留下满蜜蜂房。据说吃蜜的宝可梦，会更快变强。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME can be seen resting in meadows and admiring flowers. Though it does produce honey, it rarely consumes it and leaves combs full of honey behind. Pokémon that eat the honey are said to grow stronger faster.

entry: POKENAME用双刺，攻击深入丛林领地的一切。若觉得巢遇险，它就以精神力量，移往更安全处。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME attacks anyone who enters its territory deep in the jungle with its pair of stingers. If it believes its hive is in danger, it uses its psychic powers to move it to a safer location.

entry: POKENAME使用巨大尾刺，精准得惊人，专攻弱点。它也能造强大精神屏障，保护蜂巢。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses the large spike on its tail with extreme precision, targeting its opponents' weak spots. It can create powerful psychic barriers to keep its hive safe.

entry: 远看似乎甜美无害，可别靠近。POKENAME一动不动，任花瓣滴下的蜜引来野生宝可梦，等猎物发现蜜到底有多黏。
author: doxtordaemon
source: This giant may look sweet and innocent from a distant but don't get to close. The leaking honey from its petals attracts wild Pokémon to POKENAME as it stands perfectly still, waiting for its prey to learn how sticky the honey really is.

entry: POKENAME从背部排蜜状物，以浓烈甜香引猎物。循香靠近，它就用高热吐息，烤熟对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME expels a honey substance from its back to lure in prey with its intensely sweet scent. Once something drawn to the aroma comes near, it cooks them with intense fire breath.

entry: POKENAME用五根大毒刺，反复刺击对手。注入毒量极大，让遇见它成为致命危险。
author: soup1900
