source: POKENAME repeatedly stabs opponents with its five large, poisonous stingers. The large amounts of poison injected make it a deadly Pokémon to encounter.

entry: POKENAME巨刺一扎，就注入强毒，使全身麻痹。毒性极强，只有少数医院备有的强效抗毒血清，才能治好。
author: soup1900
source: Being stung by POKENAME's giant stinger will inject a powerful poison and cause paralysis in your body. This poison is extremely potent and can only be cured by a strong antivenom that only a few hospitals carry.

entry: POKENAME将五刺对准敌人，猛冲过去。撞击与注毒结合，足以解决多数对手。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME rushes at opponents with its five stingers pointed towards them. The blow from the impact along with the poison the stingers inject cause this maneuver to finish most opponents off.

entry: POKENAME黑黄相间的翅膀足以让捕食者明白，它的毒刺能致命。六只爪子内的毒合起来，足以毒倒一只吼鲸王。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME's black and yellow wing colors give any predatory Pokémon enough of a warning of its deadly sting. All 6 of its claws combined have enough poison inside of them to put down a Wailord.

entry: POKENAME用翅膀发出威吓嗡鸣，赶走对手与其他宝可梦。若警告失败，就会凶猛挥尾刺，吓退威胁。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their wings to make threatening buzzing noises, warding away rivals and other Pokémon. Should their warnings fail, they aggressively use their tail stinger to scare off threats.

entry: POKENAME灵敏，在高枝间迂回觅食。受威胁，就大声振翼，除非非用不可，否则不愿动毒刺。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are agile and wend their way around the high branches of trees in search of food. They buzz their wings loudly when threatened, preferring to avoid using their stinger unless absolutely necessary.

entry: 买食材时，许多人把甜菜根提取物，误当POKENAME提取物，造成厨房灾难。后者是甜粉，撒甜点上；前者却苦，也作营养补充剂。
author: quackquackattack
source: When grocery shopping, many mistake beetroot extract for POKENAME extract, leading to kitchen nightmares. POKENAME extract is a sweet powder that goes atop desserts, while beetroot extract is a bitter powder that doubles as a nutritional supplement.

entry: POKENAME微光下也看得清，飞得快又无声，是完美的夜间猎手。谁靠近领地，就会迅速被围攻，挨上毒针。
author: darkweavile428
source: Not only can POKENAME see well with minimal light, but it also flies both quickly and silently, making it the perfect nighttime hunter. Anyone who approaches POKENAME's territory will be quickly swarmed and jabbed with poison needles.

entry: POKENAME如组成物种般，极爱社交，偏好大群生活。遇险，就用利针，接连猛刺。
author: corra_universe
source: Like its component species, POKENAME is a highly social Pokémon, preferring to live in large groups. If threatened, it lashes out with a flurry of stings from its sharp needles.

entry: POKENAME以巨大共用蛛网闻名，护网心极强。一受打扰，它们就迅速围住进犯者，用刺注毒，再共同吃掉。
author: corndogyip
source: POKENAME are known for their large, communal webs, of which they are very territorial. When a POKENAME web is disturbed, the POKENAME will quickly swarm around the assailant, poisoning it with their stingers and eating it together.

entry: POKENAME腿上覆着浓黑毒液，奔跑时滴在身后地上，杀死附近一切植物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's legs are coated in a thick black poison. As it runs it drips poison on the ground behind it, killing any nearby vegetation.

entry: POKENAME进化中，后腿变成一对致命毒刺。它飞得够快，每天至少巡完整片领地两次，谁敢入侵，就用刺打倒。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's hind legs turned into a pair of deadly stingers over the course of its evolution. It flies fast enough to patrol its entire territory at least twice a day and will use its stingers to fell any who dare intrude.

entry: POKENAME能从嘴喷出腐蚀性蜂蜜。它边飞边喷，打敌人措手不及。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has the ability to spit a corrosive honey from its mouth. It does this while flying to catch its foe off-guard.

entry: POKENAME住在巢深处，整日制造富电的蜡，照顾幼崽。它们很胆小，有谁靠近，就会逃走。
author: lithuanian_shortstack
source: Found deep in hives, POKENAME spend their time producing electricity-rich wax and caring for their hive's young. POKENAME are very skittish, and will flee if approached.

entry: 领地入侵者一来，POKENAME很快开打。可无论电击还是用刺，往往自己伤得比敌人更重。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME is quick to fight invaders in its territory, but whether it shocks them or uses its stinger, it often does more damage to itself than to its enemy.

entry: 深夜，POKENAME以特殊舞蹈交流，协调采蜜，再散入野外。日出前，全巢成员都会归来。
author: quackquackattack
source: In the middle of the night, POKENAME communicate with each other through special dances to coordinate the collection of nectar before scattering into the wild. Every member of the hive returns by sunrise.

entry: POKENAME依赖别人的情绪生长。接触最多的情绪，会影响蜂蜜：负面让蜜苦，正面则让蜜甜。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME thrive off the emotions of others. The kinds of emotions they have been most exposed to influence the honey they help make; negative emotions result in a bitter honey while positive emotions result in a sweet honey.

entry: 据说，吃POKENAME的蜜，谁都会开心。寒地吃却须小心，浓香会引来与它英文名相近的冻原熊。
author: musicsheep.
source: It is said that eating POKENAME's honey will make anyone happy. Just be careful eating it in cold regions, since its strong scent will attract the similarly-named Beartic.

entry: POKENAME从长发产出的蜂蜜，浓郁、无毒，用途很多。能使难吃食物变美味，当发胶，涂厚了，还像强力胶。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: The honey POKENAME produces from its long strand of hair is deeply rich, non-toxic and very versatile. It makes poor tasting foods delicious, works as a hair gel, and in thicker doses, works like superglue.

entry: POKENAME的静电羊毛，给大毒刺充电。轻刺一下，就够把小宝可梦击退几英尺。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME's staticky wool electrically charges its large stingers. Just one poke is enough to knock a small Pokémon back a few feet.

entry: POKENAME飞时，阵风使叶片释放轻花粉。果树沾上，果子就长得更快、更甜。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME flies around, wind gusts cause it to release a light pollen from its leaves. Fruit-bearing trees that get coated by this pollen have their fruit grow faster and turn out sweeter.

entry: POKENAME拍翼，向敌人散刺痛花粉，让其喷嚏、松懈防备。趁对方最不料时，它便用利刺猛冲。
author: fiordaliso
source: By flapping its wings, POKENAME scatters its stinging pollen at its enemies, making them sneeze and forcing them to lower their guard. When they least expect it, it charges at them with its sharp stingers.

entry: POKENAME用利刺击败挡路的任何对手。一年较暖的月份，花粉会散出浓蜜香。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its sharp stingers to defeat any opponent that stands in its way. Its pollen gives off a strong honey scent during the warmer months of the year.

entry: POKENAME用毒爪抓小宝可梦，迅速带往巢。背刺很少用，因为得先转身。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME grab onto small Pokémon with their venomous talons and whisk them away towards their nest. The stinger on their back is rarely used because it requires them to turn around.

entry: POKENAME出了名爱甜，偏好高糖饮食，会翻垃圾箱，寻找吃剩半块的糖。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are known to have a strong sweet tooth and prefer a high-sugar diet. They rummage through garbage cans to look for half-eaten candy.

entry: POKENAME的眼，能辨远处热源特征，借此识别亲友。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's eyes can recognize heat signatures from afar. It uses this ability to identify friends and family.

entry: 某奇妙汽水品牌，曾限时推出POKENAME蜂蜜味饮料，用真正的蜜。它难以人工养殖，成本极高，如今成了商科学生的案例。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: An Ultra Rare Soda brand once ran a limited promotion of POKENAME's honey flavoured drinks, using real honey. This was very expensive, as POKENAME cannot be easily farmed. This is used as a case study for business students.

entry: POKENAME双翼纯作装饰，因为它不会飞。不是翼的大小有问题，只是懒得学。
author: cowanisbest
source: Its wings are purely decorative, as POKENAME cannot fly. This is not because of the size of its wings, but instead because it is too lazy to learn how to fly.

entry: POKENAME似乎能迅速繁殖，或以其他方式增加数量，却只在一年特定时段活动。爪尖有毒。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME appear to be able to reproduce or otherwise grow their numbers quickly, but are only active during specific times of the year. The tips of their claws are poisonous.

entry: 背上的蜂巢能吸引几公里外的虫宝可梦，因此POKENAME很受捕虫训练家的欢迎。
author: chorb33
source: The hive on its back attracts other bug Pokémon over several kilometers. This makes POKENAME a popular companion for bug catchers.

entry: POKENAME住草甸，平时和平地吃花蜜，却很护地盘，不喜被侵。一个发怒，附近同类也会一同火大。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although POKENAME otherwise peacefully consume nectar from flowers as a meadow-dwelling Pokémon, they are territorial and do not like being encroached upon. If one is angered, other POKENAME nearby will join it in fury.

entry: POKENAME飞速惊人，从刺中受害者身上吸养分。毒能让对方，噩梦连做好几周。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME flies at incredible speeds, absorbing nutrients from the victims it stings. Its venom can give a victim weeks of nightmares.

entry: POKENAME由厚钢构成，能穿透其他虫宝可梦的甲。可面对别的钢属性，它却很快缩壳。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are made out of thick steel, which allows it to pierce through the carapaces of other Bug Pokémon. However, it will quickly retract into its shell when confronted by other Steel-types.

entry: POKENAME在地壳深处筑巢。多数地方的群落，彼此隔绝，可神奥地下的数量，却渐渐成了隐患。
author: kai____________
source: POKENAME make their hives deep in the planet's crust. Normally isolated in most regions, they've become a growing concern in the Sinnoh underground.

entry: POKENAME蜂巢由地表下的众多隧道连接，通常绵延数英里。它们极护地盘，连不属同群的同类，也会交战。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME live in hives connected by various tunnels under the planet's surface; these hives typically span out for miles. They are extremely territorial, even battling other POKENAME that are not a part of their colony.

entry: POKENAME住草甸，平时和平地吃花蜜，却很护地盘，不喜被侵。一个发怒，附近同类也会一同火大。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although POKENAME otherwise peacefully consume nectar from flowers as a meadow-dwelling Pokémon, they are territorial and do not like being encroached upon. If one is angered, other POKENAME nearby will join it in fury.

entry: POKENAME常为领地，挑起没有胜算的架。烟能遮住入侵者气味，让这份过度攻击性缓和。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are territorial creatures that often pick fights they cannot win. This hyperaggressive behavior can be mellowed out if they are exposed to smoke, which masks the scent of any intruders in their territory.

entry: POKENAME独特低吼，听来像嗡鸣。尾刺近乎退化，防身无用，便改以针状獠牙，毒咬闯入者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a distinct growl that sounds like buzzing. The stinger on its tail is almost vestigial and useless for defense, so it uses the stinger-like fangs on its jaw to deliver venomous bites to invaders.

entry: POKENAME体格厚重，性情凶猛。圆锥形的双钳，既能刺得更深，也能钳得更紧。
author: alexanderenjoyer1
source: POKENAME is known for its aggressive nature and bulky frame. Its cone-shaped pincers allow for greater piercing and gripping strength.

entry: 肢体末端的针，不能缩进壳。POKENAME常像射鱼叉般发针，向命中的猎物，注入发酵树果汁。
author: clawshdi
source: The needles on the end of its limbs cannot retract into its shell. POKENAME often shoots the needles out like a harpoon, injecting prey that are hit with fermented berry juice.

entry: POKENAME用臂刺钻树。切开后，就喝里面的汁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses the stingers on its arms to drill into trees. Once it has a tree cut open, it will drink the sap inside.

entry: POKENAME敏捷游走敌人四周，以双刺接连快扎。它们跳跃树枝，穿过森林领地，攻击任何入侵者。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME rapidly jabs at foes with its twin stingers while agilely moving all around them. It moves through its forest territory by leaping across tree branches and attacks any invaders.

entry: POKENAME特别爱甜，想尽量多收蜂蜜。贪心让它难与人相处，可虽总惹冲突，仍试着友善。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME has a strong sweet tooth and tries to gather as much honey as possible. It struggles to get along with others due to its greed, but still tries to be friendly despite the conflicts it causes.

entry: 据报，POKENAME四小时吃的蜜，比多数蜂巢一周产的还多。除睡觉、战斗或失去战斗能力时，它总在吃蜜。
author: jangodiot
source: It's reported that POKENAME eats more honey in four hours than most hives can produce in a week. Whenever it isn't sleeping, fighting, or fainted, it is always eating honey.

entry: POKENAME冒泡滚烫的身体，由背部蜂巢状结构渗出的甜蜜构成。即使撑过灼热蜂蜜，也常倒在突刺下。
author: infinex21
source: The bubbling-hot bodies of POKENAME are made of sweet honey that oozes from hive-like structures on their backs. Anything that survives the burning honey often falls to their thrusting stingers.

entry: POKENAME以无声双翼俯冲，偷大针蜂巢的蜜。体形太小，一次只能偷几小勺。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME steal honey from Beedrill hives, swooping in on silent wings. Due to their small size, POKENAME are only able to steal a few dollops of honey at a time.

entry: POKENAME凶猛残酷，令人十分畏惧。只要在领地找到入侵者，就会无情追赶。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is highly feared for its aggressive and cruel nature. If it finds any intruder in its territory, it pursues them mercilessly.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉敏锐，寻找特定树汁酿蜜。毒刺虽小，毒却会致麻木，未经处理，还会扩散。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have a keen sense of smell, which they utilize to find particular tree saps to use to make honey. Though small, their stingers contain a venom that causes numbing, which will spread if untreated.

entry: 野生POKENAME以各种叫声交流，轻松协调攻防。它们不容入侵，但对方一离开领地，也不会继续追赶。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME communicate with one another with various cries, coordinating both offense and defense with ease. They do not tolerate intruders, but will not chase them down if they leave their territory.

entry: POKENAME用尾刺注入灼烧性毒液，若不治疗，可能永久损伤。又长又卷的角，标示它是群体首领。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME injects a burning venom using its tail stinger, which can cause permanent damage if left untreated. Its long and curled horns identify it as the leader of its pack.

entry: POKENAME几乎能在任何地形，完全无声地移动。潜近猎物，狠狠咬住，再不断刺击，直到不再动弹。
author: hakr14
source: POKENAME can move through nearly any terrain completely silently. After sneaking up on prey, it bites down hard and begins stinging it until movement stops.

entry: POKENAME极护地盘，用刺毛连番猛烈出击，保卫巢穴。每年蜕鳞一次，巢边常散着龙之鳞片。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is highly territorial, defending its nest by unleashing a barrage of ferocious strikes with its quills. Once a year it sheds its scales, and it's not uncommon to find Dragon Scales scattered near its lair.

entry: POKENAME是凶暴守卫，以臂上刺毛，如风暴般袭击闯入者。蜕皮季后，巢边遍地鳞片，亮如宝石。
author: fiordaliso
source: A violent guardian, POKENAME strikes intruders with a storm of quills from its arms. After molting season, the ground near its nest shimmers with scales as bright as gemstones.

entry: POKENAME用小鼻挖地下储藏室，藏大针蜂产的蜜。闯入者太近，它就用大尾刺威吓，警告离开。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its small trunk to dig a storage chamber underground where it hides honey reserves produced by Beedrill. If intruders get too close, it threatens them with the large stinger on its tail, warning them to leave.

entry: POKENAME以硬化身体滚撞入侵者，保卫地下巢。一个发怒，其他很快也会加入围攻。
author: moga6
source: A POKENAME defends its burrowed nest by rolling into intruders with its hardened body. When one is angered, others can be expected to quickly join the assault.

entry: POKENAME是聪明猎手，连战斗中，也能每隔毫秒调整适应。除了用致命刺冲撞，还能从刺尖导能，精准射束。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are clever hunters that can adapt in millisecond intervals, even during combat. Though they will ram foes with their deadly stingers, they can also channel and fire precise beams of energy from the tips of these stingers.

entry: POKENAME最爱玫瑰与雏菊，胜过其他植物。刺中强毒，会导致视线模糊与高热。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers to eat roses and daisies over all other plants. Its stinger holds a powerful toxin that causes blurred vision and high fevers.

entry: POKENAME好斗，几乎天天发脾气。它又爱碰触，非要摸到附近的花、训练家、彩色画作、奔流水等一切不可。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is aggressive and throws tantrums almost daily. It loves physical contact and will demand to touch anything: nearby flowers, its Trainer, colorful pieces of art, rushing water, and so on.

entry: POKENAME用腹部花纹与嗡鸣，迷惑猎物，再收紧身体，不停蜇刺，直到能安稳地将其整个吞下。
author: pokepower
source: POKENAME bewilders prey with its belly pattern and buzzing. It then constricts its prey and stings it until it can be safely swallowed whole.

entry: POKENAME先用腹纹，摄住猎物目光，再以刺中毒素，彻底麻痹。毒虽有害，蜕皮却有许多珍贵药效。
author: sautomagically
source: POKENAME transfixes prey with its patterned belly before fully paralyzing its victim with the venom in its barbs. Although its poison is harmful, its shed skin has many valuable medicinal properties.

entry: 从POKENAME身上取蜜很难，只交养蜂人处理。它们平常随和，采蜜却不舒服，可能因此变凶。
author: quackquackattack
source: Harvesting honey from a POKENAME is a difficult task reserved for beekeepers. POKENAME are easygoing Pokémon but can become violent due to the uncomfortable experience of honey harvesting.

entry: POKENAME鬃毛由蜜构成，帮助当地大针蜂群护住储蜜。灼热蜂蜜赶走圈圈熊、熊宝宝等，让全巢有足够蜜过冬。
author: quackquackattack
source: With a mane made out of honey, POKENAME helps local Beedrill colonies protect their stores of honey. Searing hot honey wards off the likes of Ursaring and Teddiursa, ensuring the hive has enough honey to last through winter.

entry: POKENAME钻穿山体，建起当作家的地下墓穴。它产的蜜，坚硬如钻石。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME drills through mountains to build the catacombs it calls home. The honey it produces is as tough as diamonds.

entry: POKENAME用坚刺砸地，力量足以引发地震。巨石甲让它极重，只能短时飞行。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can slam its sturdy stings into the ground with enough force to generate earthquakes. It can only fly for short periods, as its colossal stone armor makes it extremely heavy.

entry: POKENAME每次突刺，力量都足以一击毁掉整根树干。它极其凶猛护地盘，蜂蜜虽人人渴求，却很少取得。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can put enough power into every jab of their stingers that they can decimate an entire tree trunk in one stab. Due to how territorially aggressive they are, the honey they make is heavily desired yet rarely ever acquired.

entry: POKENAME感到威胁，就展开颈膜，振动相连双翼，吓退进犯者。威吓失败，再甩毒尾刺。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spread out their hood when they feel threatened, buzzing the attached wings to scare off their aggressors. If the threat display fails, they lash out with the venomous stinger on their tail.

entry: POKENAME发现合适的猎物，就会用尾上的那把镰刀进攻。受到威胁时，它则试着以翅膀上的花纹吓退敌人，避免交战。
author: finch_dane
source: When a POKENAME spots suitable prey, it will use the single scythe on its tail to attack. When threatened, this Pokémon will attempt to scare off enemies using the patterns on its wings to avoid a battle.

entry: POKENAME感到威胁，就展开颈膜，振动相连双翼，吓退进犯者。威吓失败，再甩毒尾刺。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spread out their hood when they feel threatened, buzzing the attached wings to scare off their aggressors. If the threat display fails, they lash out with the venomous stinger on their tail.

entry: 它专在电力旺盛的地方筑巢。多数除虫人员都认为，想清走一整群POKENAME，根本是不可能的事。
author: staghorn
source: It builds hives in places with high amounts of electricity. Most exterminators consider removing a swarm of POKENAME to be an impossible task.

entry: POKENAME的蜜，因独特风味与彩虹色泽，成为稀罕货。可巢在高处，性情又凶、又护地盘，鲜有人敢远行取蜜。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME honey is a rare commodity sought for its unique taste and rainbow coloration. Few dare to make the trek to retrieve it due to its high-altitude dens and aggressive, territorial nature.

entry: POKENAME脾气好、心地善，爱帮人。可惜，所谓“帮助”，就是凭空召大群大针蜂，因此不太受欢迎。
author: occulusmalus
source: POKENAME is a good-natured, kind-hearted Pokémon that loves to help people. Unfortunately, its idea of "help" is summoning large swarms of Beedrill from nowhere. As a result, it is not very popular.

entry: POKENAME聚起大群黑暗鸦，命令袭击大针蜂巢，抢走蜜。野外，双方也因此越来越敌视。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME amasses flocks of Murkrow and commands them to raid Beedrill nests to claim the honey within. This has led to the two species becoming much more aggressive towards each other in the wild.

entry: POKENAME通常友善守规矩，却极护手中石头，不肯分享。它找蜂蜜、树果汁等甜物，涂在石上，再舔掉。
author: sk372
source: Though generally kind and well-behaved, POKENAME is quite possessive of the stone it carries, refusing to share. It finds sweets such as honey or berry juice to coat the stone in and lick off of it.

entry: POKENAME互蹭毒刺，给身体充电。储够能量，便从刺中射出闪电。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME charges their body with electricity by rubbing their stingers together. Once they have stored enough power, they shoot lightning from their stingers.

entry: POKENAME用大刺，既串食物，也串敌人。它们产的蜜，比多数别种的蜂蜜更有营养。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME uses its large stingers to skewer food and foes alike. The honey made by its species is extremely nutritious compared to most others.

entry: 这些护地盘的宝可梦，十只群居，轮流由半数巡逻。任何遇见的敌人，都会遭毒刺接连快扎。
author: infinex21
source: These territorial Pokémon live in groups of ten, with half patrolling their territory at alternating times. Any foe they encounter will be met with many quick jabs of their venomous stingers.

entry: POKENAME飞不了，也不会猎，便寻找三蜜蜂巢，伸进巨大舌头，吞吃海量蜂蜜，满足胃口。
author: ratractac
source: Unable to fly or hunt, POKENAME spends its time searching for Combee hives, where it inserts its oversized tongue and devours enormous amounts of honey to satisfy its appetite.

entry: POKENAME酿的蜜，随心情味道不同。负面情绪让蜜腐坏，快乐则让蜜甜。
author: musicsheep.
source: The honey created by POKENAME has a different flavor depending on its feelings. Negative feelings result in rotten honey, while feelings of joy result in sweet honey.

entry: POKENAME没有毒刺，便采用另一种防御。它不酿蜂蜜，而是制造带甜味的腐蚀性物质，攻击对手。
author: musicsheep.
source: Its lack of stingers results in POKENAME taking on a different form of defense. Rather than making honey, POKENAME creates a corrosive, yet sweet substance to attack opponents.

entry: POKENAME结成群落，互相保护。谁靠太近，就怒嗡、以毒刺电击。它们受电力站吸引，让只想工作的工程师十分烦恼。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form social colonies to mutually protect one another, buzzing angrily at anyone that gets too close and delivering sharp shocks with their stingers. They are drawn to electrical stations, to the annoyance of engineers just wanting to work.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛覆着特殊薄膜，钻过沙子、泥土和岩石时，能保护双眼。它会蜷起身体，用绷紧的坚韧皮肤挡开部分攻击，再以尾刺，狠狠戳向敌人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's eyes are covered in a special film that protects them as it digs through sand, dirt, or rock. It can curl up to defend itself, its tensed hide being tough enough to repel some attacks, and uses its tail stinger to strongly jab at foes.

entry: POKENAME一天就能迅速巡完整座森林，是许多林地探险者的克星。飞行时，前刺常摆好阵势，随时准备刺穿威胁。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon are the bane of many woodland explorers due to how quickly they can patrol an entire forest in a single day. POKENAME's frontal stingers are often held at the ready as they fly around, ready to impale any threats at a moment's notice.

entry: POKENAME群会穷追，攻击同族的对象。它们用毒刺在树上留小凹痕，标记领地。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Colonies of POKENAME will relentlessly hunt down those who attack one of their own. POKENAME mark their territories by using their stingers to leave small indentations on trees.

entry: POKENAME藏在树、灌丛，甚至建筑后，再突然用剃刀般利刺，刺穿猎物，捕捉进食。
author: zaymcawesome
source: POKENAME catches its prey by hiding behind trees, bushes, or even buildings before ambushing them by piercing prey with its sharp razor stingers.

entry: POKENAME毒刺大小不成比例，空中动作笨拙。它们更爱滑翔，用带毒尖刺穿猎物。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are clumsy in the air due to their disproportionately sized stingers. They prefer to glide through the skies, impaling prey with their poison-tipped stingers.

entry: POKENAME想扎敌人，大刺却胡乱挥舞，有时连自己也扎中。注进自身的毒，又让它对敌人更狂、更怒。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME wildly swings its large stingers when attempting to jab foes, which sometimes causes it to hit itself in the flurry. The self-injected poison from striking itself makes it act even wilder and more furious towards enemies.

entry: POKENAME是圈圈熊的死敌，因为它们总来偷蜜。它能快速爬树，从不失衡。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is a sworn enemy of Ursaring, since they are always trying to steal the honey that POKENAME produces. It can climb trees quickly without ever losing its balance.

entry: POKENAME的钢羽，深受时装设计师追捧，可它极暴烈、极护地盘。因此，大姐姐与设计师，会训练宝可梦，专门对付它。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME's steel feathers are sought by fashion designers, but POKENAME are extremely violent and territorial. For this reason, Beauties and designers will train Pokémon to fight POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME极护地盘，什么靠太近，就喷火。不过，小宝可梦终究如此，一见强敌，又很快逃走。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are extremely territorial and will spit fire at anything that draws too close. As expected of such small Pokémon, however, they are quick to flee when faced with a strong foe.

entry: POKENAME用利爪飞快挖掘，筑巢地下。谁扰巢，就会遭群攻，直到退至100英尺外，才不再追。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME make their nests underground, using their sharp claws to dig at amazing speeds. It will swarm anyone that disturbs its nest and will pursue them until they are 100 feet away.

entry: POKENAME毒刺大得吓人，主要攻击却是连踢。对付鸟宝可梦，或被逼绝境时，才会吐火球自卫。
author: infinex21
source: Despite its threateningly large stingers, POKENAME primarily attacks with rapid kicks. When dealing with bird Pokémon or if it is cornered, it will spit out fireballs to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME虽大多水陆两栖，仍会远离沼泽找花。分泌的蜜，能让皮肤保持湿润。
author: spkypirate
source: Despite being largely amphibious, POKENAME venture far from their marsh habitats in search of flowers, their skin kept moist by the honey they secrete.

entry: POKENAME体弱，却能边战边舞，以毒刺痛扎敌人。毒会扰乱精神，据报曾使情绪突然变化，有时甚至暴烈。
author: infinex21
source: Although physically weak, POKENAME can effectively dance during battle while delivering painful jabs with their venomous stingers. POKENAME venom is mentally disorienting and has reportedly caused sudden, sometimes violent, mood swings.

entry: POKENAME所持的针状武器，确实有毒。一刺虽伤害不大，它却快速来回，反复扎敌。若成群，连更大的宝可梦也能击倒。
author: fireblade141
source: The needle-like weapon wielded by POKENAME is indeed venomous. Though one sting won't cause significant harm, this Pokémon attacks by rapidly darting around, jabbing its foes repeatedly. If they swarm, even larger Pokémon can be felled.

entry: POKENAME所持的针状武器，确实有毒。一刺虽伤害不大，它却快速来回，反复扎敌。若成群，连更大的宝可梦也能击倒。
author: fireblade141
source: The needle-like weapon wielded by POKENAME is indeed venomous. Although one sting won't cause significant harm, this Pokémon fights by rapidly darting around and jabbing its foes repeatedly. If they swam, even larger Pokémon can be felled.

entry: POKENAME主动寻找大针蜂巢，用信息素掌控。地位确立后，便会凶残驱赶，一切自认的威胁。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME actively seeks out Beedrill hives, and takes control using pheromones.  Once established as the leader, this Pokémon will brutally chase off all perceived threats.

entry: POKENAME似乎统领大针蜂等相似宝可梦的巢，却不能容忍另一只同类出现。刺中充满致遗忘的毒，连暴走暴鲤龙也能放倒。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME seemingly rules over hives of Beedrill and other similar Pokémon; a POKENAME will not tolerate the appearance of another POKENAME, however. Their stingers are brimming with an amnestic poison that can take down a raging Gyarados.

entry: POKENAME灵巧挥舞两把小刺矛，保护视为同巢的对象，尤其训练家。产的蜜都会囤起，严防守护，可训练家一讨，就大方给。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME deftly wields two small stinger-spears to defend those it considers part of its hive, particularly its Trainer. Any honey it produces will be hoarded and staunchly protected, though freely given if its Trainer requests.

entry: POKENAME将训练家与其宝可梦，视为同巢成员。它一会儿溺爱同伴，一会儿又凶猛刺向，靠得比自己能接受的更近的对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME considers its Trainer and their Pokémon as members of its hive. Its personality alternates on doting on its hive-mates, and viciously striking at any that get too close to them for its liking.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME是大针蜂统治者。它带着王者气度，自认高于其他宝可梦。据说与另一地区的宝可梦有竞争，却无足够证据。
author: ultron_suprem3
source: Believed to be the rulers of Beedrill, POKENAME carry a sense of royalty, deeming themselves above other Pokémon. Supposedly, POKENAME have a rivalry with other Pokémon from another region, though there is not enough evidence to support this.

entry: 换取蜂蜜，POKENAME会保卫三蜜蜂巢。它敏捷得目不暇接，以毒刺砍倒敌人。
author: santon5512
source: In exchange for honey, POKENAME will defend the hives of Combee. They attack with blinding agility, cutting down foes with their stingers.

entry: POKENAME双翼从不拍动，静贴背上。它靠未知力量浮空，让周围空气泛起涟漪。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wings never flap and stay on its back, unmoving. It uses an unknown power to float in the air, causing the air around it to ripple.

entry: POKENAME两对爪，也像毒刺，每扎或割一下，都带强毒。爪力强得能掘穿实岩。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have two pairs of claws that function like stingers as well, delivering a potent venom with every jab or cut. Their claws are strong enough to dig through solid rock.

entry: POKENAME酿蜜，常有几团黏上翼，飞行困难。它们靠同巢伙伴，帮着舔净。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME create honey, a few blobs of the honey often end up clinging to their wings, making it difficult to fly. They rely on their den mates to help lick their wings clean.

entry: POKENAME配合得天衣无缝，将蜂巢与废金属编成大巢。毒液会奇异地影响受害者心智，引发轻微幻觉。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME work in prefect sync with each other, weaving honeycomb and scrap metal into their large hive. Their venom as an odd effect on the victims' mind, causing mild hallucinations.

entry: POKENAME在高树旁群居，用利门牙切开树皮、树枝，将树塑成精巧蜂巢，供全群居住。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in communal swarms around tall trees. They use their sharp incisors to cut through bark and branches and reshape the trees into elaborate hives for the entire swarm to live in.

entry: POKENAME在高树旁群居，用利门牙切开树皮、树枝，将树塑成精巧蜂巢，供全群居住。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in communal swarms around tall trees. They use their sharp incisors to cut through bark and branches and reshape the trees into elaborate hives for the entire swarm to live in.

entry: 身体是蜂蜜与虫内脏，融合成的甜腻混合物。它以诱香引来大针蜂，困住后，反复翻搅其肉身与灵魂，永不停止。
author: pattybgoode
source: Its body is a saccharine amalgam of honey and bug guts. It lures Beedrill with its tempting fragrance, then ensnares them, cyclically churning their body and spirit without end.

entry: 谁威胁蜂巢，POKENAME便用钢刺击打。若受罚前想逃，它会循波导留下的踪迹，追上去。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME strikes with its steel stingers anyone who poses a danger to its hive. If someone tries to flee before being punished, POKENAME tracks them down by following the trail left by their aura.

entry: POKENAME把进化前的同类安置在背上的大蜂巢里，保护它们。它还能喷出蜂蜜，靠大量黏稠的蜜缠住对手，让其难以行动。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME offers its pre-evolutions protection in the large hive on its back. It can shoot honey to restrict opponents' movement with its viscous bulk.

entry: POKENAME用极硬的刺，精准惩罚入侵者。蜜中有毒素与细菌，煮沸后却会消失。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME punishes intruders with precise strikes from its extremely hard stingers. Its honey contains toxins and bacteria that disappear once it is boiled.

entry: POKENAME蜂蜜被视为珍馐，却极难采。它凶到近乎失去理智，周围什么会动，就用众多刺扎。
author: sk372
source: Honey sourced from POKENAME is considered a delicacy, but gathering it is very difficult. It is aggressive to the point of mindlessness, stabbing its many stingers at anything that moves in its vicinity.

entry: POKENAME周身覆着耐用尖刺，一碰就会受痛毒。尾部散出的蜜状物，让敌人迟缓，更好追上。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is covered with durable, pointed stingers that deliver a painful toxin on contact. Its tail spreads a honey-like substance that slows enemies, making them easier to chase down.

entry: POKENAME头部虽多孔，却硬得出奇，形成完美、不可摧毁的蜂房。它用强头锤、蜂群，以及尾边带毒蜂蜜保护自己。
author: beatdoof
source: Despite its porous exterior, POKENAME's head is outstandingly tough, forming a perfect indestructible honeycomb. It protects itself with strong headbutts, bees, and poison-laced honey around its tail.

entry: POKENAME腿覆穿孔蜂房状甲，住在头里的三蜜蜂，也利用这些新巢。尾有毒蜜，蜂房头甲又坚不可摧，让它几乎无法打倒。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME's legs are covered in perforated, honeycomb-like armor, the Combee living in its head making use of the new nests. With poisonous honey on its tail and a truly durable, honeycombed armored head, this Pokémon is near-indestructible.

entry: POKENAME为蜂巢防御。它目标单一、行动专注，是破坏性极强的最后手段。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME acts as a form of defense for a hive. It acts with single-minded purpose, making it a destructive last resort.

entry: 下雨，POKENAME便为幼小的尼多兰或尼多朗遮风避雨。雨停，再给一团蜂蜜，表达善意。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME offer sanctuary to baby Nidoran whenever it rains. Once the rain subsides, they give the Nidoran a blob of honey as a gesture of kindness.

entry: POKENAME大群狩猎，配合天衣无缝。头顶利刺，含有令人疼痛的毒液。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME hunt in large packs, having immaculate teamwork. The sharp stinger on its head carries painful venom.

entry: POKENAME虽极护地盘，身形笨拙，却很难刺中。毒刺偶尔冲上海滩，用于多种传统药物。
author: honestly_vitali
source: While POKENAME are extremely territorial, their awkward body shape makes it difficult for them to sting. Their stingers occasionally wash up on the beach and are used in many traditional medicines.

entry: 人们曾以为，POKENAME如蜂女王般，用振翼嗡鸣，号令成群虫宝可梦。近来却发现，它只是个高效的蜂巢首领。
author: chibitales
source: The buzzing of POKENAME's wings was once thought to command legions of insect Pokémon to their side much like Vespiquen. In more recent times, however, it has been found that POKENAME are simply efficient hive leaders.

entry: POKENAME背树的甜果与蜜，吸引大针蜂群。它阻止护地盘的大针蜂变凶，若攻击外来者，就用藤蔓束住。
author: sk372
source: Beedrill flock to the trees on POKENAME's back due to the sweetness of its fruits and honey. POKENAME keeps the territorial Beedrill from becoming violent, restraining them with vines when they act aggressive towards outsiders.

entry: POKENAME一认定蜂巢受威胁，就会以快得看不清的毒刺压制敌人。头顶分泌的蜜却美味健康——前提是采蜜后还能活下来。
author: frink202
source: Once a POKENAME considers its hive under threat, it overwhelms its opponent with blindingly fast poison stabs. However, the honey POKENAME excretes out of its head is a delicacy and very healthy - should one survive harvesting it.

entry: POKENAME虽会挥动毒刺，威吓旁人，可实在太弱，只能乱抡。但毒刺确实蕴含强力毒液，若真能划入皮肉，便会将毒液分泌出来。
author: infinex21
source: Although POKENAME will swing around its stingers to threaten others, it is too weak to do anything other than flail them around. Its stingers do contain and secrete a potent venom, should they ever manage to cut into one's flesh.

entry: POKENAME力量强大，光是挥动翅膀，就足以将一棵树折成两段，翼尖还长着毒刺。它对任何闯入领地的对象都不客气，连同类也不例外。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are strong enough that even just swinging their wings is enough to break a tree in two, yet there are also venomous stingers at the tips of their wings. They are territorial to all, even others of their species.

entry: POKENAME沿银色翼缘分泌致命毒液。初斩后仍撑住的敌人，也会被毒放倒。角最长者，统领蜂群。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME secrete deadly venom along the silver edges of their wings, which can fell any foe that survives the initial slash. Those with the longest horns command others of their swarms.

entry: POKENAME用钻头，破开岩石与树，找琥珀吃。翼虽能高速拍动，身体太重，仍飞不了。
author: fireflower20002
source: POKENAME will use its drills to break open rocks and trees to find amber to feed on. Although it can flap its wings at high velocity, it cannot fly due to its heavy weight.

entry: POKENAME的小朝北鼻，帮它找花吸蜜。人们曾以为靠嗅觉，近来研究却显示，可能感知的是花上电荷。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's Mini-Noses locate flowers for POKENAME to drink from. They were once thought to detect flowers by smell, but recent studies show that they may be sensing the electrical charges on flowers instead.

entry: 与POKENAME短兵相接，很容易丧命。若遇上一整群，恐怕更会落得面目全非。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A knife fight with a POKENAME is easily fatal. An encounter with a swarm of POKENAME is a sure way to become unrecognizable.

entry: 传说POKENAME曾用来试炼，寻求深层真理的骑士。持有者发现，它如大针蜂般锋锐敏捷，丝又强得能承住成年人。
author: .fedoraman
source: According to legends, POKENAME was used to challenge knights who wished to seek deep truths. Those who wield POKENAME find it to be as sharp and nimble as a Beedrill, with silk strong enough to hold the weight of an adult human.

entry: POKENAME心灵感应相连，形成集群意识，得以施展更高阶技巧。它们可从不同方向出击，或蹭刃，发出安抚嗡鸣。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: As a telepathic hivemind, POKENAME execute more advanced techniques. They can strike from different directions or rub blades to create a pacifying buzz.

entry: POKENAME的盾，由专为它构筑的坚韧蜂巢制成，即使传说宝可梦的招式，也能挡住。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's shield is made of a highly durable type of honeycomb made specially for it, able to withstand moves from even Legendary Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME每天产一升毒，不断从刺渗出。虽极好斗，科学家却利用高产毒量，制造大量解毒药。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a liter of venom daily that constantly oozes from their stingers. Despite their high levels of aggression, scientists have tapped into their high venom production to make mass quantities of Antidotes.

entry: POKENAME用翼，在战斗中灵巧移动。双刺硬如铁，还带微量毒，往往让敌人最终倒下。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their wings to make agile movements during battle. Their twin stingers are as hard as iron and contain traces of a poison that will oft ensure their foes inevitably fall.

entry: POKENAME是凶猛战士，以高敏捷四处疾行，用针状武器连番快斩，消磨敌人，高尚地保卫自己与同类。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is a fierce warrior, nobly defending itself and others of its kind using its high agility to zip around and wear foes down with many quick slashes of its stinger-like weapon.

entry: POKENAME常是大针小兵的首领，一边轻松号令，一边对付在场最强敌人。双刺坚如钢，能干净地刺穿实岩。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME is the oft-seen leader of Beeiards, effortlessly giving them commands while fighting the strongest foe present. Its twin stingers are as strong as steel and can cleanly punch holes through solid rock.

entry: 旧描绘以“虎”为代号，据说因刀刃大而锋利，又极善战。它们常默默守卫某些虫宝可梦的巢。
author: infinex21
source: Older depictions refer to it by a codename of "Tiger," supposedly due to its large sharp blades and how skilled it is in combat. They are often seen serving as silent defenders of the hives of certain bug Pokémon.

entry: 谁敢入侵领地，它便立即冲前，用可怕电刺攻击。拍翼产生的嗡鸣，也能与远处同群交流。
author: fiordaliso
source: If anyone dares to invade its territory, it immediately lunges forward to strike with its terrifying electrified stinger. By flapping its wings, it produces buzzing sounds that allow it to communicate over long distances with others of its pack.

entry: POKENAME以浓稠蜂蜜代唾液。它在居住洞穴啃吃矿物与矿石，留下遍地蜜迹。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME secrete a viscous honey in place of normal saliva. The caverns in which they have made their homes are covered with traces of honey from them feeding on the minerals and ores around them.

entry: POKENAME监督大针儿与大针组的蜂巢，用红核心发号施令。中央环的尖刺，其实是追踪毒刺，追着入侵者，直到击败。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are the surveyors of hives of Beeink and Beeang, using their red cores to signal orders to them. The spikes along their central ring are actually homing stingers that track intruders until they have been defeated.

entry: POKENAME直到最近才发现，部分原因是它曾伪装宝可梦研究者。它似乎执着用蜜，模仿洗翠形态的索罗亚克，不知为何。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME were only recently discovered in part because they would disguise themselves as other Pokémon researchers. They seem fixated on using honey to replicate the appearance of Hisuian Zoroark, though the reason is unknown.

entry: POKENAME用耳与触须，跟同巢伙伴交流。平常温顺，但巢一受袭，整群都会攻击破坏者。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME uses its ears and feelers to communicate with its colony mates. While normally docile in nature, if their hive is attacked, a swarm will attack whoever damaged it.

entry: POKENAME轻声哼鸣，连最凶的大针蜂巢，也能安抚，深受世界各地养蜂人喜爱。缎带滴下的蜜，还用于许多热门甜点。
author: chibitales
source: By humming softly, POKENAME are able to calm even the most vicious of Beedrill hives, making them beloved by beekeepers all over the world. The honey dripping from their ribbons is used in many popular sweets.

entry: POKENAME每天产一升毒，必须用掉，否则硬化，积起压力。许多个体为找办法排毒而发狂，有些甚至刺同族，求得释放。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a liter of venom daily, and must use this venom or it will harden and cause pressure to build up. Many go berserk trying to find ways to release venom, and some resort to stinging their own kin for a release.

entry: POKENAME凶猛守蜂巢入口，大声振翼警告，再举利刺冲前。想当训练家的人，最好远离它的巢，危险不小。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME aggressively guard the entrances to their hives, buzzing their wings in loud warning and charging forward with their sharp stingers. Aspiring Trainers are advised to stay clear of POKENAME hives due to the danger they can pose.

entry: POKENAME全身释放甜黏蜂蜜，游时形成悬浮蜜团。它用蜜喂深海宝可梦，换取服从。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME releases sweet, sticky honey from every part of its body, creating blobs of suspended honey as it swims. It nourishes deep-sea Pokémon with this honey in exchange for subservience.

entry: POKENAME在森林里搜集蜂巢，拿蜂蜜泡澡。常引来蜂宝可梦报复，但对方通常又被它的巨大体形吓走。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME wanders through the forest, gathering beehives in order to bathe in their honey. It often gets attacked by bee Pokémon in retaliation, but they usually flee due to POKENAME's enormous size.

entry: POKENAME用背炮射蜜，阻碍目标行动。黏物拖慢对方，使其无从躲开毒刺的穿击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses honey fired from the cannon on its back to inhibit the movements of its target. Slowed by the sticky substance, they are helpless to avoid the piercing strikes of POKENAME's stingers.

entry: 有些POKENAME不会飞，只在巢内工作，谁蠢到想闯，就凶猛攻击。想当训练家的人，最好远离蜂巢，危险不小。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Some POKENAME are flightless and work within the confines of their hive, aggressively attacking anyone foolish enough to try to break into their nest. Aspiring Trainers are advised to stay clear of POKENAME hives due to the danger they can pose.

entry: 满月，POKENAME群会离巢捕猎。猎后，彼此紧偎，睡一整天。
author: starmanmatt
source: On full moons, swarms of POKENAME will leave their nest to hunt for prey. After a hunt, they'll sleep the entire day, closely nestled with each other.

entry: POKENAME虽极罕见，科学家却注意到，它搬进一地，许多蜂宝可梦都会毫无疑问地听命。借追随者相助，它建起巨大蜂巢。
author: thezekrom
source: While incredibly rare, scientists have noticed that when a POKENAME moves into an area, many bee Pokémon will follow its orders without question. With the help of its followers, it constructs massive hives to live in.

entry: POKENAME刺中产出淡黄色花蜜。虽有毒，充分加热后，却能安全代替蜂蜜，加入料理。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME produces a pale yellow nectar from its stingers. Despite being poisonous, it can be safely consumed as a honey substitute in dishes when sufficiently heated.

entry: POKENAME臂虽弱，战斗却很娴熟，用带刺尾巴当长矛。头菇受击，会放出蜂蜜状物质。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its arms being weak, POKENAME is quite adept in combat, using its stinger-tipped tail like a spear. The mushroom on its head releases a honey-like substance when hit by an attack.

entry: POKENAME是敏捷、爱交际的虫属性宝可梦，深受窃贼欢迎。高速与灵活，方便进出建筑；好交际，又很易训练。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A very agile and social Bug-type Pokémon, POKENAME is a popular Pokémon amongst thieves. Its high speed and agility make it very capable of getting in and out of buildings, while its social nature makes it very easy to train.

entry: 野生POKENAME住在大针蜂废巢。若人或宝可梦以为安全，走近，它就出来，用臂上双针驱赶。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME reside inside hives that have been abandoned by Beedrill. If any people or Pokémon think it is safe to approach, POKENAME will emerge to drive them away with the twin needles on its arms.

entry: POKENAME周身蜜状液体，香气诱人，却有剧毒。精神能力，能让手臂伸至15英尺，刺向敌人。
author: mepp.
source: Though it has an enticing aroma, the honey-like liquid that surrounds POKENAME is incredibly toxic. With the aid of its psychic abilities, POKENAME can stretch its arms up to 15ft to sting enemies.

entry: 这是一种妖精般的稀有融合体，难得现身，训练家却趋之若鹜。可别随便招惹，它也会奋起自卫。
author: chocouniversa
source: A rare fusion that is akin to a fairy, rarely seen and often sought after by Trainers. However, it is unwise to provoke it for it will defend itself.

entry: POKENAME背部绒毛浸满甜蜜花浆。小型宝可梦不慎黏住，它却可能完全没察觉。
author: mistymagius
source: The fluff on POKENAME's back is soaked in sweet nectar. Smaller Pokémon can accidentally get stuck in the fluff without POKENAME noticing.

entry: POKENAME用毒刺作臂，突刺快得几乎赶上振翼。可真正的武器，是斧状獠牙，切钢也如切树。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME wield poisonous stingers for arms that they can thrust almost as rapidly as their wings can flutter. But their real weapons are the axe-like tusks that can cleave through steel like they were mere trees.

entry: POKENAME热衷于和同族交手，常钻凿山壁，惹出小规模滑坡。
author: schierke
source: POKENAME has a passion for battling with others of its kind. It is usually spotted drilling into the sides of mountains, causing small landslides.

entry: POKENAME与同类玩耍，飞得轻快，却仍极危险、极护地盘。无论什么情况，满月都别靠近领地。
author: sk372
source: Despite the playful way POKENAME flits about with its own kind, it is highly dangerous and territorial. One should not, under any circumstances, venture close to POKENAME territory when the moon is full.

entry: 野生POKENAME沿林地疾爬，始终大声嗡鸣。它们向空中扎刺，威吓遇见的人与宝可梦；伪装若破，便用双刺穷攻。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME scurry across the forest floor, constantly making a loud buzzing sound. They will jab the air with their stingers to intimidate people and Pokémon they encounter, and will use both to relentlessly attack if their disguise is broken.

entry: POKENAME头部不断滴黏蜜，常挡得自己看不清。但这种蜜，只在醒时分泌。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME produces a sticky honey that constantly drips from its head, often making it difficult for POKENAME to see. This honey is only secreted during its waking hours.

entry: POKENAME食量巨大，却觉得自己酿蜜没意义，因此专袭大针蜂巢，偷它们的收成。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME have immense appetites but see no purpose in making honey themselves. This leads POKENAME to raid Beedrill hives to steal the honey they make.

entry: POKENAME爱靠近人类，常与养蜂人一起，确保大针蜂安全。遇险，它用强毒自卫。
author: agostostino
source: POKENAME loves to be near humans and is often seen with beekeepers to be sure that all of the Beedrill are safe. When in danger, POKENAME will use its powerful poison to protect itself.

entry: POKENAME护地盘，深受虫属性宝可梦饲主欢迎。它先吐蜜状物，黏住敌人，再点燃，用众多尾刺扎击。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME is popular among keepers of Bug-type Pokémon due to its territorial nature. It will spit a honey-like substance at foes, sticking them in place before setting the substance ablaze and jabbing them with its many tail stingers.

entry: POKENAME尾巴华丽，摇起来像蜂群合唱，照料得好，又香如新采蜂蜜。它聪明凶猛，谁不尊重同类栖居的森林，就会诅咒谁。
author: ultron_suprem3
source: POKENAME are known for their opulent tails, which sound like a chorus of bees when shaken and smell like freshly harvested honey when cared for. Intelligent and fierce, POKENAME curse trainers who disrespect the forests where other POKENAME live.

entry: 地下数月之后，成年POKENAME会同步成群出土。每年特定时段，都会规律发生，乡间因此须提前准备。
author: katieplaysgames
source: After spending many months underground, adult POKENAME emerge simultaneously in a swarm. These emergences occur regularly at specific times of year, requiring rural communities to prepare in advance.

entry: POKENAME在河边巢屋，建黏稠蜂房。空气里的甜蜜香，让家很容易找到。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME constructs sticky honeycomb within its riverside lodges. The sweet scent of honey in the air makes its home easy to locate.

entry: 什么一近蜂巢，POKENAME就发狂，胡乱挥刺。里面产的蜜，营养丰富，备受追捧。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME enters a frenzy, wildly swinging its stingers if anything approaches its hive. The honey produced inside is highly nutritious and sought after.

entry: 谁说不欣赏歌声，POKENAME就用大刺扎谁。外表虽圆胖，却很护地盘，会攻击林中其他唱歌宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: If anyone expresses that they do not appreciate its singing, POKENAME stings them with its large stingers. Despite its chubby appearance, it is a very territorial creature that attacks other singing Pokémon in the forest.

entry: POKENAME以树果和矿物为食，在体内酿出浓郁的蜂蜜。它们乐于分享，但谁想强抢，就会遭到钢刺迎击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME feed on berries and minerals, which allow them to produce a rich honey inside their bodies. They are happy to share this honey with others, but those who try to take it by force are met with their steel stingers.

entry: POKENAME吃草甸花朵，约二十只群居。花蜜经代谢转成蜂蜜，装在体内空洞，随身携带。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feed on meadow flowers, living in colonies of around twenty individuals. They metabolise the nectar they feed on into honey, carrying the sticky liquid around in the hollows of their bodies.

entry: 身体开口分泌的蜂蜜，极其浓郁，却带着所吃金属的微量成分。厨师与金工，仍在各自手艺中，探索用途。
author: infinex21
source: The honey it secretes from openings in its body is incredibly rich, yet laced with traces of the metals it feeds on. Chefs and metalworkers are still discovering ways to use this honey in their respective works.

entry: POKENAME虽有翼，行动却不很灵便。它设陷阱、分泌蜂蜜，引来其他宝可梦，再以强颚与毒刺伏击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Despite its wings, POKENAME is not a very mobile Pokémon. It creates traps to lure prey, secreting honey to draw other Pokémon before ambushing them with its powerful jaws and stingers.

entry: POKENAME虽有翼，行动却不很灵便。它设陷阱、分泌蜂蜜，引来其他宝可梦，再以强颚与毒刺伏击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Despite its wings, POKENAME is not a very mobile Pokémon. It creates traps to lure prey, secreting honey to draw other Pokémon before ambushing them with its powerful jaws and stingers.

entry: POKENAME虽有翼，行动却不很灵便。它设陷阱、分泌蜂蜜，引来其他宝可梦，再以强颚与毒刺伏击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Despite its wings, POKENAME is not a very mobile Pokémon. It creates traps to lure prey, secreting honey to draw other Pokémon before ambushing them with its powerful jaws and stingers.

entry: POKENAME双翼快速相拍，造出让人头痛的嗡鸣。它们在沙下建巢，采附近仙人掌的花蜜。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME rapidly beat their wings together to create a headache-inducing buzzing noise. These Pokémon create hives beneath the sand, collecting nectar from nearby cacti.

entry: POKENAME破坏对手蜂巢，用碎片覆头，向邻近群体示威。脾气易怒，让它毫不犹豫，用代臂双刺全力战斗。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME covers its head with pieces of rival hives it vandalizes to assert dominance over its neighbors. Due to its irritable temperament, it doesn't hesitate to fight with all its might using the two stingers it has in place of arms.

entry: POKENAME靠红核心闪光交流。许多个体会聚集、连接，形成蜂巢。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME communicate with each other by flashing signals from their red cores. Many POKENAME will gather together and connect to form hives.

entry: POKENAME是大针儿构成的蜂巢的工蜂，用红核心闪光交流。身体旋转，核心周围斑点，便产出极甜、极黏的蜜。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are the workers of a hive made of Beeink, communicating by flashing their red cores. When they spin their bodies, they produce a a very sweet and sticky honey from the spots surrounding their red cores.

entry: POKENAME爱喝花蜜，通常沾满花粉。紧急时，它会抖落毛中的花粉，以这团花粉云为表面，投映幻象。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME love to drink nectar from flowers, so they're usually covered in pollen. In an emergency, POKENAME can shake off the pollen in its fur and use the cloud as a surface to cast its illusions.

entry: POKENAME被蜂蜜泡裹住，常待在大针蜂巢，保护存蜜。饥饿宝可梦一近巢，它就放精神波，吓走入侵者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are surrounded in a bubble of honey and often stay in Beedrill nests to protect their reserves. If a hungry Pokémon approaches their nest, POKENAME release psychic waves to scare off the intruder.

entry: POKENAME群若受袭，便用回声定位，协调打击。被激怒，它们飞过黑暗，用带钩毒刺注毒。
author: xenodactyl
source: If under attack, colonies of POKENAME use echolocation to line up their strikes. They fly through the dark before injecting venom with their barbed stingers when provoked.

entry: POKENAME蜂房的蜜，苦甜浓烈。吃下会深睡，满梦都是逼真、令人质疑自身存在的噩梦。
author: crumple_2
source: The honey from the honeycomb of a POKENAME is potently bittersweet. Consuming it causes deep slumber filled with vivid, existential nightmares.

entry: POKENAME即使寡不敌众，也勇敢护巢。它用刺标记病树，方便巡护员找到。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME bravely defends its hive from enemies even when outnumbered. With its stingers, it marks trees that are sick so Rangers can locate them more easily.

entry: 许多POKENAME以蜜为主食，可来源各凭本事：有的从头酿，有的征服蜂巢，有的偷其他同类。
author: jojojax164
source: Many POKENAME use honey as a main food source. However, sourcing the honey is up to each POKENAME; some make it from scratch, some conquer hives, and some steal from other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME好斗，极热衷占领其他宝可梦的地盘。它嗅觉很好。
author: mystora
source: POKENAME are aggressive Pokémon that are very keen on taking over territories of other Pokémon. They have a great sense of smell.

entry: POKENAME极力保护蜂巢，用坚硬的球状身体，在巢外组成六角形墙。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME is fiercely protective of its hive, using its hard, spherical body to form hexagonal walls around the hive.

entry: POKENAME对筑巢的冰洞，有极强的领地意识。入侵者若太靠近，它们便会成群配合，从阴影中疾速冲出，用毒刺发动袭击。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME are fiercely territorial over the frozen caves where they nest. If an intruder gets too close to their domain, they will attack in coordinated swarms, darting from the shadows to strike trespassers with their venomous stingers.

entry: POKENAME外表温柔，却凶猛护地盘。蜂群采粉的花田，它不惜一切守护，用巨大毒刺，驱赶入侵者。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite its gentle appearance, POKENAME is fiercely territorial. It will protect the flower field where its swarm gathers pollen at all costs, using its large venomous stingers to drive away intruders.

entry: POKENAME把毒刺钻进树，给走路草群建家。因此，它被广称为“常青森林的木匠”。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: POKENAME drills its stingers into trees to construct homes for groups of Oddish. As a result of this nest building, POKENAME is widely known as “The Carpenter of Viridian Forest”.

entry: POKENAME常被捡垃圾的人，当成塑料袋。吃饭时靠近，尤其危险，它会凶起来，谁近就刺谁。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often get mistaken for a plastic bag by people who pick up garbage. They can be particularly dangerous to approach when they are eating, as they become aggressive and sting whoever approaches them.

entry: POKENAME翼虽小，飞过森林却快得惊人。它极护地盘，以双针不断扎猎物与入侵者，直到对方因伤或毒倒下。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME fly about forests at surprising speeds given how small their wings are. These highly territorial Pokémon will jab at prey and intruders alike with their Twineedle attacks until they succumb from the physical injuries or from their poison.

entry: POKENAME鳍状翼与背鳍，让它快速飞过空中，在树间闪转。领地入侵者，会遭翼上带毒尖刺，如导弹般射来。
author: infinex21
source: The fin-like wings of a POKENAME and their dorsal fins allow them to quickly soar through the air, bobbing and weaving through the trees. They will fire their poison-laced stingers from their wings like missiles at any territorial intruders.

entry: POKENAME护着自己授粉的花田。谁闯花园，就会遭喷蜜，来自头花发酵的蜜，恶臭又剧毒。
author: t3isukone
source: The territorial POKENAME tends to fields of flowers which it pollinates. Should any intrude on these gardens, it sprays them with the noxious and highly poisonous honey it ferments in the flower on its head.

entry: POKENAME展威严双翼，巡在蜂巢上方，深夜也不停。它从头顶双耳放声波，击退入侵者。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME spreads its majestic wings to patrol above its hive, even in the dead of night. It repels intruders with sonic waves released from the ears atop its head.

entry: POKENAME滴的蜜虽美味，却黏得生食几乎难以下咽。目前只知穿着熊、烈箭鹰与大尾立，能安全大量食用，不被噎住。
author: pkbonusducks
source: While delicious, the incredibly viscous honey dripping from POKENAME is almost inedible in its raw state. Bewear, Talonflame, and Furret are currently the only known Pokémon that can safely consume large quantities of the honey without choking.

entry: 遇险，POKENAME退回蜂房状壳，驱使其中蜂群攻击。构成身体的蜜状黏液，高糖、高蛋白，深受常运动的人珍视。
author: vic1312
source: When threatened, POKENAME retreat into their hive-like shells, encouraging the swarm they house within to attack. The honey-like goo that their bodies consist of is high in sugar and protein, prized by people who exercise frequently.

entry: POKENAME一生都在地上挖大洞，供虫宝可梦筑巢。它们回报善意，用丝与蜂蜜，把它的石头绑紧。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME spends its entire life burrowing massive holes into the ground for Bug Pokémon to nest in. These Pokémon repay its kindness by binding its stones together with silk and honey.

entry: 蜂蜜供能，POKENAME以比钻石更硬的强壳，守护大针蜂巢。对付有它的巢，唯一办法，就是用烈火焚烧。
author: quackquackattack
source: Fueled by honey, POKENAME guard nests of Beedrill with a mighty shell that is harder than diamond. The only way to deal with a nest with a POKENAME is to burn the nest with scorching flames.

entry: POKENAME用巨针砸开蜂巢，抢光所有蜜。住户若反击，它便迅发能量脉冲，将其轰退数英里，也毁坏四周地形。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its massive needles to smash holes into beehives and pillage all their honey. If the beehive's inhabitants try to retaliate, POKENAME releases quick energy pulses to blow them back miles while destroying the surrounding terrain.

entry: 猎物黏在身体上，POKENAME便可慢慢吃。甜香最终会引来，各种各样的虫宝可梦。
author: mistymagius
source: Its prey gets stuck in its sticky body, allowing POKENAME to slowly consume them. Its sweet aroma ends up attracting all sorts of bug Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的蜜甜美芳香，少有宝可梦能抗拒。可一碰，就陷入黏液；小蜂从嘴涌出，围住猎物，拖回嘴里。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's honey is so sweet and aromatic that few Pokémon can resist. Just a touch will have them trapped by the sticky fluid however, as small drones emerge from POKENAME's mouth to swarm and drag them into its mouth.

entry: POKENAME在头上拼命拍翼，能掀起阵阵冰风。尾上利刺，则威慑捕食者，阻止猎杀。
author: fiordaliso
source: By frantically flapping its wings above its head, POKENAME can create gusts of icy wind. The sharp spines on its tail serve as a deterrent to prevent predators from hunting it.

entry: 农人照料的POKENAME，一身两用：既给庄稼授粉，又因护地盘本性，守田驱赶一切入侵者。
author: ghostslythe
source: Tended to by farmers, POKENAME serves a dual purpose. While it pollinates crops, its territorial nature drives it to protect the field from any intruders.

entry: POKENAME常挑衅敌人先打，再还一记响亮头锤，声音招来其余蜂群，围殴对方。
author: a_grain_of_rice
source: POKENAME often goads enemies into attacking, and in return, delivers a headbutt so loud it calls over the rest of its swarm to pummel the foe.

entry: POKENAME用悦耳嗓音号令其他蜂类。它们平时住在它如蜂巢般的毛里，等待召唤。
author: theheroict
source: POKENAME uses its lovely voice to command other bees. Its hair acts as a hive for them to live in until needed.

entry: POKENAME是身轻步巧的出色舞者。招牌表演之一，是伴着著名管弦乐间奏曲《大针蜂飞舞》起舞。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are superb dancers that are light on their feet. One of their signature performances involves dancing to a famous orchestral interlude called "Flight of the Beedrill".

entry: 野生POKENAME是当地蜂巢的工蜂，背上能驮近三倍体重。它会用尾刺自卫，但真正有威胁的，只有里面的毒。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME are the worker Pokémon of their local hives, capable of carrying almost three times their bodyweight atop their backs. They will use their tail stinger to defend themselves, but the poison within is the only real threat.

entry: 野生POKENAME是蜂巢前线的战士与守卫。它用尾刺突击，结合强拳，发动攻击。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME are the frontline fighters and defenders of their hives. They attack with combinations of thrusting attacks using the stinger upon their tails and forceful punches.

entry: 有入侵者，野生POKENAME就撞响鳞片，通知同巢伙伴。巨大尾刺，能干净利落地穿钢。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME will clash their scales together to signal to the other members of their hive when an intruder is present. The massive stinger upon its tail is capable of cleanly penetrating steel.

entry: POKENAME很友善，只想玩、开心。常在训练家学校与游乐场旁，盼与幼儿园小朋友、短裤小子做游戏。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are friendly creatures that just want to play and have fun. They can be spotted around Trainer Schools and Playgrounds, hoping to play games with Preschoolers and Youngsters.

entry: 无人时，POKENAME躺在原木上晒太阳。若发现入侵者，就惊慌嗡鸣，急忙逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lounges on logs to bask in the sunlight when no one is around. If it spots an intruder, it panics and emits a frantic buzzing noise while fleeing.

entry: 每只POKENAME占一片丛林，伏着耐心等其他虫属性进来，再快得目光难及地出击。受袭者被毒麻痹，等着被吃。
author: ghostslythe
source: Each POKENAME stakes out a claim to a section of jungle. In its territory, it lies dormant, waiting patiently for other Bug-types to enter, then strikes faster than the eye can see. Attacked Pokémon are left paralyzed by venom, ready to be consumed.

entry: POKENAME身上宝石，由蜂蜜结晶而成，充当随身零食。许多人想采，可它的刺，往往另有打算。
author: hophoppip
source: The gems on its body are made of crystallized honey, used as a portable snack by POKENAME. Many have tried to harvest this honey, but POKENAME's stingers tend to have other plans.

entry: POKENAME虽看着友善，却极护地盘，毫不犹豫驱敌。刺有毒，但通常只用头锤攻击。
author: st4rdustyugure
source: Despite its friendly appearance, POKENAME is extremely territorial and will not hesitate to fight off intruders. Its stingers are poisonous, but it usually only attacks with headbutts.

entry: POKENAME为小虫属性宝可梦群作宿主，它们如身体细胞般工作。小家伙采蜜喂它，再嚼植物成纸状物，筑起背上蜂巢。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME serves as the host for a swarm of smaller Bug-type Pokémon, which function like cells in its body. They feed POKENAME with the nectar they collect, and construct the hive on its back by chewing plants into something similar to paper.

entry: 这只宝可梦用毒刺，钻进山壁。它产的蜜，被利亚多村一家面包店，用来做美味沙鳞果挞。
author: .izik
source: This Pokémon uses its stingers to drill into mountain walls. This Pokémon's honey is used by a bakery in Riyado Town that creates delicious Salac Berry Tarts.

entry: POKENAME释放信息素，以精神力控制附近虫属性宝可梦。钻头状附肢一挥，隐藏的大军便突然涌出，攻向敌人。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME releases pheromones to psychically control other nearby Bug-type Pokémon. With a flick of its drill-like appendages, its hidden army suddenly erupts to attack its foe.

entry: POKENAME成长时，会受教，完美掌握毒刺。暴怒，脸上橙纹就脉动发光，挥斩得狂乱凶猛。
author: amberaxolotl223
source: POKENAME are taught to wield and use their stingers perfectly as they grow. When enraged, the orange markings upon their face pulse with light as they slash with a wild fury.

entry: POKENAME用刺，在托着大针蜂巢的树上，画奇怪符印。符号无法翻译，但人们认为，象征它对蜂巢的保护。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Using their stinger, POKENAME sketch strange sigils into trees supporting Beedrill hives. These symbols have no translation, but it is believed they symbolize the protection POKENAME give to the hives.

entry: POKENAME受威胁，就射刺攻击。它也能藏进大针蜂巢，悄然靠近对手。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME fires stingers at opponents when threatened. POKENAME can hide in Beedrill nests to sneak up on opponents.

entry: 与组成自身的双方都不同，POKENAME大多在浅河涉水。强信息素连随水流，都能传很远；一受袭，便可通知远处同类。
author: bobosmith01
source: Unlike either of its halves, POKENAME spends much of its time wading in shallow rivers. It emits powerful pheromones that persist long distances even down a water current; if POKENAME is attacked, it can alert others of its kind, even from far away.

entry: POKENAME虽不很灵活，刺击却又快又准。有人训练它，为秋日庆典，在南瓜上雕精巧灯笼。
author: sk372
source: Though not terribly mobile, POKENAME can strike with its stingers at an incredibly rapid and accurate pace. Some have trained their POKENAME to carve intricate jack o' lanterns from pumpkins for autumn celebrations.

entry: POKENAME身纹极像其他大针蜂，夜飞时借此吓别的宝可梦。甚至还去袭大针蜂巢偷蜜，成败各不相同。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body pattern looks very similar to other Beedrill, which it uses to scare off other Pokémon while flying at night. It will even use it to raid Beedrill hives for their honey, with varying levels of success.

entry: 灵魂如蜂巢中的虫，聚在POKENAME体内。为得新魂，它刺中不知情受害者，再把灵魂吸进蜜状肢体。
author: hophoppip
source: Spirits congregate in POKENAME's body like insects in a hive. To obtain new souls, POKENAME stings an unsuspecting victim, then absorbs its soul into its honey-like limbs.

entry: POKENAME产的蜜香甜美味，深受养蜂人喜爱。人们常说，甜得远超物理上该有的程度。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME is loved by beekeepers for the delicious sweet honey it produces. The honey POKENAME makes is often described as being far sweeter than what should be physically possible.

entry: POKENAME身体极轻，飞得快得出奇。蜜在许多地区被视为珍馐，常因独特浓甜，加入茶中。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's bodies are incredibly light, allowing them to fly surprisingly quickly. The honey they secrete is considered a delicacy in many regions, often added to teas for its uniquely rich and sweet flavor.

entry: POKENAME不自建蜂巢，而是保护较弱的大针蜂融合体的巢。它用长枪消除这些蜂巢面临的任何威胁。
author: fancyskunk
source: Rather than create their own hives, POKENAME instead offer protection to the hives of weaker Beedrill fusions. They use their lances to dispatch any threats to the nest they serve.

entry: POKENAME凶猛护地盘，用肢端尖刺，强攻入侵者。它能产蜜状物，极易燃，能增强火属性招式。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME fiercely defends its territory, striking intruders with powerful attacks from the spines at the tips of its limbs. It can produce a honey-like substance that, being highly flammable, enhances the power of its Fire-type moves.

entry: 地下待久，POKENAME出来就猛烈振翼，抖落难受极了的附着泥土。
author: .izik
source: After long periods underground, POKENAME emerges to buzz its wings violently. This shakes off clinging dirt, which it finds deeply unpleasant.

entry: POKENAME极亲热，看中谁，就直飞过去。可惜，它似乎没察觉，自己的刺有多尖。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are highly affectionate, flying directly at anyone they set their sights on. Unfortunately, they don't seem to realize how sharp their stingers are.

entry: POKENAME在水族馆与大鱼缸很受欢迎。色彩鲜明，毒刺却让照料，必须交给专业人员。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular Pokémon in aquariums and large fish tanks. They have a striking colouration, but their venomous stinger means they require specialist handling.

entry: POKENAME地下蜂巢，长度可超过300英尺。哪怕轻微打扰，也会招来狂暴群攻。
author: .izik
source: Subterranean hives created by POKENAME can exceed 300 feet in length. Even minor disturbances trigger violent swarm responses.

entry: POKENAME凶猛，又被贵重物吸引，深受窃贼欢迎。可大群难控制，反让窃贼被逐出自己的窝。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular with thieves as they have an aggressive nature and are drawn to valuable objects. Large swarms can be uncontrollable, however, resulting in thieves being driven out of their own hideouts.

entry: POKENAME满足时，会低嗡着呼噜，爱蜷在训练家膝上。但私人空间受威胁，它就可能凶起来，毫不犹豫用毒刺。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME produce a low buzzing purr when they are contented and enjoy curling up in the laps of their Trainers. When their personal space is threatened, however, they can be aggressive and use their poisonous stingers without hesitation.

entry: POKENAME满足时，会低嗡着呼噜，爱蜷在训练家膝上。但私人空间受威胁，它就可能凶起来，毫不犹豫用毒刺。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME produce a low buzzing purr when they are contented and enjoy curling up in the laps of their Trainers. When their personal space is threatened, however, they can be aggressive and use their poisonous stingers without hesitation.

entry: POKENAME满足时，会低嗡着呼噜，爱蜷在训练家膝上。但私人空间受威胁，它就可能凶起来，毫不犹豫用毒刺。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME produce a low buzzing purr when they are contented and enjoy curling up in the laps of their Trainers. When their personal space is threatened, however, they can be aggressive and use their poisonous stingers without hesitation.

entry: POKENAME满足时，会低嗡着呼噜，爱蜷在训练家膝上。但私人空间受威胁，它就可能凶起来，毫不犹豫用毒刺。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME produce a low buzzing purr when they are contented and enjoy curling up in the laps of their Trainers. When their personal space is threatened, however, they can be aggressive and use their poisonous stingers without hesitation.

entry: POKENAME的蜜甜，又有药效，能帮助缓解人类与宝可梦头痛。自己却不停头痛，因此常能见它吃蜜，或泡蜜里。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's honey is sweet and medicinal, effective at helping headaches in people and Pokémon. Because it suffers from constant headaches itself, POKENAME is usually seen eating or bathing in the stuff.

entry: 持续偏头痛，让POKENAME极好斗，入侵者一出现，就刺。它极护营养丰富的蜜，鲜少分享。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its constant migraines make it highly aggressive, so POKENAME attacks intruders with its stings at sight. It is very protective of the nourishing honey it produces and rarely shares it.

entry: POKENAME在清水旁筑巢，改善蜂蜜质量。偏头痛发得太厉害，起飞时，甚至会撞树。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME builds its hive near clear water to improve the quality of its honey. Its migraines can become so intense that it crashes into trees while taking flight.

entry: POKENAME性子好斗，格外危险。它常发脾气，还会不停刺训练家，直到得到想要的东西。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is a particularly dangerous Pokémon because of its aggressive nature. It frequently throws tantrums and will sting its Trainer until it receives what it wants.

entry: POKENAME猛烈攻击领地内的一切，用强大毒刺贯穿敌人，再吃得不留痕迹。
author: canada
source: Highly aggressive towards anyone within its territory, POKENAME uses its powerful stinger to pierce foes. It then consumes them, leaving no trace behind.

entry: 其他宝可梦进入领地，POKENAME就怒不可遏，穷追不舍。巨刺分泌的毒，会使目标陷入疯狂暴怒，曾用来制造破坏基因。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME become enraged when other Pokémon enter their territory and will hunt trespassers relentlessly. The giant stingers POKENAME wield secrete a venom that puts their target into a crazed fury, which was once used to create a Berserk Gene.

entry: 农人雇POKENAME守着产蜜蜂巢。察觉危险，它就低吼、振动背翼，准备迎战。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is employed by farmers to stand guard over the hives where honey is produced. When it senses danger, it growls while buzzing the wings on its back, readying itself for battle.

entry: POKENAME极忠诚，又护地盘，常被用来守医院或托儿所等地。兴奋时，它习惯抖散花粉。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: A POKENAME's combination of intense loyalty and territorial nature usually leads to it being used to guard places such as hospitals or daycares. It has a habit of shaking off pollen when excited.

entry: POKENAME看见别的宝可梦在旁炫力，就怒嗡。曾见整群合作，骚扰豪力群，打乱训练安排。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME buzz angrily when they spot another Pokémon exhibiting feats of strength near them. Entire swarms of them have been observed harassing groups of Machoke by working together to disrupt the Machoke's training regimen.

entry: 谁因细臂低估POKENAME，最终都会败于力量与灵巧。它的钻头，穿独角犀牛皮，也如穿纸。
author: ratractac
source: Those who underestimate POKENAME because of its thin arms always end up being defeated by its strength and dexterity. Its drills can pierce Rhyhorn's skin like paper.

entry: 事业有成的烘焙师，用POKENAME在林中，只挑最好的蜜。肌肉极发达，让它既能多运，也能吓跑潜在窃贼。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Successful bakers use POKENAME to gather only the best honey for them in the forest. Due to its immense muscular structure, POKENAME can carry large amounts, as well as scaring any potential thieves away.

entry: POKENAME模仿丛林花朵，整巢一起坐草中，滴出甜蜜。谁被陷阱吸引，它们就凶猛合攻，试着打倒打扰者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME mimic jungle flowers, entire hives sitting together in the grass and drooling sweet honey. They aggressively attack anything attracted to their trap, working together to try and bring down whatever disturbs them.

entry: POKENAME通常待在巢旁，吃蜜、练刺。捕食者一到，就立刻行动，攻击威胁。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME typically stays near its nest where it eats honey and practices stabbing with its stingers. Whenever a predator arrives at the nest, it springs into action and attacks the threat.

entry: POKENAME嘴里漏出浓稠、带糖果香的蜜。宝可梦若钻嘴吃蜜，它就迅速吸气，将其困住。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaks a thick, candy-scented honey from its mouth. If a Pokémon enters its mouth to eat the honey, it swiftly inhales and traps them.

entry: POKENAME用强刺，把海中岩石凿成巢。身体红处发强光，迷乱、吸引近处对象，再用连番刺击攻击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their strong stingers to carve ocean rocks into their nests. They will emit bright lights from the red parts of their bodies to disorient and mesmerize those who draw too near before attacking them with flurries of stinging attacks.

entry: POKENAME触手伸得比看起来更远，常用来缠束敌人。一确定胜局，便不断扎刺，直到精疲力尽。
author: infinex21
source: The tentacles of a POKENAME can reach further than they first appear, often being used to constrict and restrain foes. Once they are certain of their victory, they will jab at their foe with stingers until exhausted.

entry: 宝可梦巡护员警告，惊扰POKENAME群极危险。除三根毒刺，它们还会以岩石硬身俯冲，造成脑震荡，乃至更重伤害。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Pokémon Rangers warn that disturbing a swarm of POKENAME is very dangerous. In addition to a POKENAME's three poisonous stingers, a swarm of POKENAME will dive into intruders with their rock-hard bodies, causing concussions and more serious injuries.

entry: POKENAME脾气差，常袭击身旁对象。年龄越大，棱角却渐渐磨平，身体更顺滑，性子也更好相处。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a grumpy Pokêmon that tends to lash out at those nearby. As it gets older, its rough edges smooth out, its body becoming more slick, and its personality becomes more agreeable.

entry: POKENAME是一种领地意识极强的猛兽。扑向猎物时，双翼能让它短暂飞起。据说，太阳升至最高处时，它那金色的毛发能储存能量。
author: ratractac
source: An extremely territorial beast, the wings of POKENAME allow it to briefly take flight when jumping on its prey. It is said that its golden fur allows it to store energy when the sun is at its zenith.

entry: 雄性POKENAME极护地盘。谁离群体太近，很快就会尝到毒角尖。
author: periperi_chicken
source: Male POKENAME are highly territorial. Anyone who comes too close to its herd will quickly meet the sharp end of its venomous horn.

entry: POKENAME是勇敢的杂食者，会探索同林其他宝可梦未必涉足的地方，猎捕、采食。每只毛纹，都略有不同。
author: bobosmith01
source: A courageous omnivore, POKENAME explores other areas of the forest in which it dwells in that other Pokémon may not to hunt and gather food. Each POKENAME has slightly unique hair patterns.

entry: POKENAME用带电毒刺攻击，与同类成群，压倒大宝可梦。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME attacks with its electrically charged stingers. It swarms with others of its kind to overwhelm larger Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME每季迁往最常起风暴的地方。即使风暴中，与星球磁场的亲和，也让辨路轻松。
author: bobosmith01
source: Each season, POKENAME migrate to areas that most often experience stormy weather. Even during these storms, their affinity with the planet's magnetic field allows for easy navigation.

entry: 它用自己的蜕刺，与结实木棍做长矛。刺中仍有足够毒，伤口没能放倒的敌人，也会被毒放倒。
author: infinex21
source: It fashions a spear using its own shed stinger and a sturdy stick. The stinger still retains enough venom to fell a foe if the wounds do not fell the foe first.

entry: POKENAME不容别人入领地，用毒刺状口器，击倒来者。同类交流，则按不同节奏，互敲口器。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME do not tolerate others entering their territory and will strike them down using their stinger-like proboscises. They communicate with their own kind by striking their proboscises together in varying patterns.

entry: 它迅追猎物与领地入侵者。三头的毒刺状口器，能连番发动有毒打击。
author: infinex21
source: It swiftly chases after prey and invaders of its territory. With its three heads, it can deliver a barrage of venomous strikes with its stinger-like proboscises.

entry: POKENAME身体闻着、尝着都像蜜，却有剧毒。它只需假装普通蜂蜜，等什么尝过、中毒，再出击狩猎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body smells and tastes like honey, but is highly toxic. It hunts simply by pretending to be nothing more than honey, waiting to strike when something samples a taste and succumbs to the poison.

entry: POKENAME是勇敢的杂食者，会探索同林其他宝可梦未必涉足的地方，猎捕、采食。每只毛纹，都略有不同。
author: bobosmith01
source: A courageous omnivore, POKENAME explores other areas of the forest in which it dwells in that other Pokémon may not to hunt and gather food. Each POKENAME has slightly unique hair patterns.

entry: POKENAME急拍耳朵，能发大嗡声，表示怒意渐长。它没什么克制力，一开始嗡，就不会给惹怒者多少时间，很快便打。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can flap their ears rapidly enough to create a loud buzzing noise that they use to signal their rising anger. Lacking any real restraint, POKENAME doesn't give the target of their ire long before they attack once they start buzzing.

entry: POKENAME用背炮阵阵喷水，击倒敌人。对方近得水炮难发，就改用毒刺扎。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME fires bursts of water from its back cannons to knock foes off their feet. It also jabs its stingers into opponents when they are too close to fire its water cannons.

entry: POKENAME借周身一圈腐蚀性蜂蜜，钻过废建筑墙，在内筑巢。留下的蜜滴，让城市探险者误当幽灵灵质。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is surrounded by a corrosive honey corona which it uses to burrow through the walls of abandoned buildings where it makes its hive. Drips of the honey remain behind, making urban explorers mistake it for ghostly ectoplasm.

entry: POKENAME在栖居的空楼，无声跟踪不知情的人。一找到受害者，就恶意怪笑着追，试图用毒刺戳。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME silently stalks through its habitat of an empty building, seeking out unsuspecting people. When it finds a victim, it chases them, cackling maliciously and trying to poke them with its stingers.

entry: POKENAME聚在废建筑，策划怎么折腾附近城镇。它们成群嗡笑、吵成一片，还偷物品，修建、扩张蜂巢。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME congregate in abandoned buildings to plot how to best torment nearby towns. They swarm in a cacophony of buzzing giggles and steal items to construct and expand their hive.

entry: POKENAME摇刺催眠入侵者，保卫领地。梦见反复被刺后，许多对象会留下强烈恐惧，再也不敢靠近。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME defends its territory by swinging its stinger to hypnotize intruders. After dreaming about being repeatedly stung by POKENAME, many will have a strong fear of ever approaching it again.

entry: POKENAME钳里藏可收回的刺，刺中就注麻痹毒。幸运受害者得宽恕，麻痹后只被抛走；倒霉的，则被大钳碾碎。
author: sk372
source: Within POKENAME's claws are retractable stingers that deliver a paralyzing venom to those pierced. Lucky victims are shown mercy and simply flung away after paralysis, while unlucky ones are crushed by the crushing force of its larger claw.

entry: POKENAME极护洞穴，谁太近，就攻击。它们高速扑猎，用小钳制住，再注强毒。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are extremely territorial of their burrows, attacking anything that gets too close. They pounce on their prey at high speeds, restraining them with their smaller claw before injecting them with a toxic poison.

entry: POKENAME没有眼睛，靠精神能量，察知周围人类与宝可梦。长尾则细心照料背部球茎。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on psychic energy to detect the presence of people and Pokémon around them, as they do not have eyes. Their long tail delicately takes care of the bulb on their back.

entry: POKENAME的丝比钻石更坚韧，产太多，却会疼。睡前故事说，一只曾在地震中，用丝拉住整座城镇，自己却因过劳死去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's silk is stronger than diamond but causes it pain if it produces too much. A bedtime story tells of one that held an entire town together with its silk during an earthquake, only to pass away from overexertion.

entry: 多数POKENAME无父母陪伴长大，须独自求生，因此冷淡疏离。夜里，有个体曾用精神能量，在空中画出近似梦幻的形象。
author: sk372
source: Most POKENAME grow up without a parent, forcing them to fend for themselves and grow cold and standoffish. Some have been observed at night, drawing an image similar to Mew in the air with psychic energy.

entry: POKENAME踢击时，用压倒性精神力，压缩腿旁空间。因此，踢击能以近光速，跨越极远距离。
author: fenragon
source: When POKENAME kicks, it uses its overwhelming psychic power to contract space around its legs. This causes these kicks to be able to reach across massive distances at a speed nearing the speed of light.

entry: POKENAME的精神屏障，几乎不可破，只需小动作便能生成。力场紫光，让任何观察者都清楚看见。
author: .jerden
source: The psychic barriers POKENAME creates are almost unbreakable. It manifests them using only small gestures, as the purple glow of these forcefields makes their existence obvious to any observer.

entry: 火力如火爆脾气，它怨恨整个人类。对谁都无慈悲，谁敢挡路，就用心灵火焰烧尽。
author: mistymagius
source: Its firepower matches its fiery temperament, as it holds a grudge against all of humanity. It will show no mercy to anyone, incinerating anything that dares stand in its way with its psionic flames.

entry: 据说，它精神力强到无需接触，便能在分子层面冻结物体。
author: juliho27
source: Its mind is said to be so powerful that it can freeze objects at the molecular level without physical contact.

entry: POKENAME自负又强大，远离自认不配的对象，独占整座岛。谁侵入领地，就用精神力量，逼其跪下。
author: sk372
source: Brimming with ego and power alike, POKENAME isolates itself from those it deems unworthy, claiming entire islands for itself. It uses psychic powers to force those who invade its territory to kneel before it.

entry: POKENAME不停环球，寻找配得上实力的对手。战斗虽凶，发现谁遇险，却仍会冲去相助。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME constantly circles the globe in search of opponents worthy of its strength. Despite how viciously it battles, it will rush to the aid of those it finds in trouble.

entry: POKENAME双翼齐拍，造精神波与低沉嗡鸣，扰乱对手思想。它们把精神能量压成尖刺，射向任何敢于面对的对象。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME create psychic waves as their wings beat together, producing a low humming noise that clouds opponents' minds. They compress their psychic energy into spikes, firing them at anyone brave enough to face them.

entry: 力量大大增加，身体却难容所有能量，因而有些不稳定。某些部位的奇怪橙色突起，或变色，正源于此。
author: fireblade141
source: Its power has increased greatly, but it has also become a little unstable since its body is struggling to contain all that energy. The strange, orange growths or discolorations on some parts of its body are a result of this.

entry: 力量大大增加，身体却难容所有能量，因而有些不稳定。某些部位的奇怪橙色突起，或变色，正源于此。
author: fireblade141
source: Its power has increased greatly, but it has also become a little unstable since its body is struggling to contain all that energy. The strange, orange growths or discolorations on some parts of its body are a result of this.

entry: 人们可能以为，这种融合让POKENAME的基因构造更接近梦幻，实际却恰好相反。它被视为危险，若发现它，最好通报。
author: jangodiot
source: Although it would be assumed this fusion would bring the genetic framework of POKENAME closer to that of Mew's, it has achieved the opposite effect. This Pokémon is considered dangerous and it is encouraged that a report be made if one is spotted.

entry: 融合后，POKENAME近似一种超级进化形态。精神力量进一步释放，让它轻松浮空，造出纯精神能量巨球，轰飞对手。
author: sk372
source: After fusion, POKENAME resembles one of its Mega Forms. Its mental power is unleashed further, allowing it to float through the air with ease and create massive orbs of pure psychic energy to blow away opponents.

entry: 自我融合，让POKENAME近似一种超级进化形态。精神能力提高到极端，几秒就能造出纯念力巨弹，消灭敌人。
author: sk372
source: Self fusion resulted in POKENAME taking a form resembling one of its Mega Forms. Its psychic capacity has improved to extreme levels, forming massive projectiles of pure telekinetic energy in seconds to wipe out its foes.

entry: 融合让POKENAME外形，更接近DNA来源梦幻。精神潜力更广阔，性情却温柔得多，极少用全力。
author: sk372
source: Fusion has resulted in POKENAME taking an appearance closer to its DNA source Mew. Its psychic potential is even more vast, but its personality has become much gentler, so it rarely uses its full power.

entry: 融合让POKENAME性情极具攻击性。它四处瞬间移动，向别人胡乱投精神弹，寻找能匹敌精神威力、好好打一场的强敌。
author: sk372
source: Fusion has caused POKENAME to develop a highly aggressive personality. It teleports around, flinging psychic projectiles indiscriminately at others. It searches for powerful rivals who can compete against its mental might and give it a proper fight.

entry: POKENAME獠牙带着力量，倒霉被咬，就会混乱。只有冰冷的水，才能解除。
