author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The fangs of POKENAME are imbued with the power to confuse anyone unlucky enough to be bitten. The only way to break out of this confusion is with ice-cold water.

entry: POKENAME用神秘网缠猎物，吸其能量。吸得越多，身体就越大。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME entangles prey in mysterious webs that drain their energy. The more energy that is drained, the bigger POKENAME becomes.

entry: POKENAME靠四臂念力，维持浮空。它寻找深洞独居，用精神力量赶走其他宝可梦，再按喜好改造洞穴格局。
author: sk372
source: Telekinesis utilized by POKENAME's four arms is what keeps it aloft. It seeks out the deeper parts of caverns to seclude itself, using psychic powers to remove other Pokémon as well as reshaping the cave's layout to its liking.

entry: POKENAME不许别人轻视，因此被视为凶猛宝可梦。一找到奶酪，就会凶狠护住，唯独不防自己的训练家。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME refuse to let others disrespect them and are regarded as ferocious Pokémon because of this. If they find a piece of cheese, they aggressively defend it from others, with the exception of their Trainer.

entry: POKENAME不断与内心冲突的性情抗争，一刻温柔，下一刻却毁灭。它可能先无私助人，再愤怒袭击。据说，能助它掌握情绪的训练家，会缔结超越常理的羁绊。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME constantly battles conflicting personalities, gentle one moment, destructive the next. It may help others selflessly, then lash out in fury. Some say a Trainer who helps it master its emotions will form a bond beyond ordinary understanding.

entry: 它极不合群，讨厌被命令。巨大的精神能力，却能让附近任何对象，为自己听命行事。
author: mistymagius
source: It is a very antisocial Pokémon and hates being told what to do. Its immense psychic abilities allow for it to command anyone in its vicinity to do its bidding.

entry: 传闻POKENAME是超梦复制失败的产物，但证据不足。碰到身体，似乎还会被吸走智力。
author: mistymagius
source: There have been many rumors about POKENAME being a failed replication of Mewtwo but there is not enough evidence to prove this theory. Touching its body seems to drain its victims of their intelligence.

entry: POKENAME只一瞪，就给敌人巨大压力，弱小野生宝可梦，有时会直接昏倒。出手时，强大精神力弥漫，让目标仿佛觉得，整个世界都静了。
author: bobosmith01
source: Foes feel incredible pressure from just a single glare from POKENAME; weaker wild Pokémon sometimes faint from that look alone. When it strikes, its overwhelming ambient psychic power makes the target feel as though the entire world has gone quiet.

entry: 它智慧非凡，既懂社交，也善解决实际问题，脑重人脑数倍。虽建立互利共生，POKENAME对共生者，是否真有同伴情谊，仍在研究。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is characterized by incredible intelligence, both social and practical; its brain weighs several times more than a human's. It forms mutualistic relationships, but studies are still ongoing if POKENAME feels any true camaraderie with its symbiont.

entry: 传闻POKENAME由创造超梦时，剩下的数据与笔记制成。它极不合群，常清空在网络空间遇到的用户的记忆。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is rumored to have been created using data and notes left over from the creation of Mewtwo. It is extremely antisocial and will often wipe the minds of any users who encounter it in cyberspace.

entry: POKENAME不停训练，以严酷激烈的安排，磨炼发育中的身体。身体尚不足的地方，便用强大精神能力补偿。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME trains relentlessly, honing its developing body with fierce and rigorous regimens. It uses its powerful psychic abilities to compensate when its budding body falls short.

entry: POKENAME走在浓雾与湖面，用精神力量净水。谁打断，就会被化作纯水。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME travels in thick fog and walks across lakes. It uses psychic powers to purify bodies of water. Anyone interrupting it will be transformed into pure water.

entry: POKENAME精神力极大，能造出横跨夜空的绚丽紫极光。它们住高峰，又凶猛护地盘，深入研究十分困难。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's immense psychic power allows them to create brilliant violet auroras that stretch across the night sky. Researching the Pokémon further has proven difficult, as they live atop high mountain peaks and aggressively defend their territory.

entry: POKENAME擅长精神弹作战，从掌孔生成强精神能量球，从头角射出迅疾的精神钻弹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a master of psychic projectiles in battle. It generates powerful orbs of mental energy from holes in its palms, and quick-moving psychic drill projectiles from the horn on its head.

entry: POKENAME精神力强，以藤蔓与念力，用碾压巨力缠束受害者。它们记仇，侵犯领地者，可能极久都不放下。
author: vic1312
source: Possessed of a potent psychic power, POKENAME will use their vines and telekinesis to ensnare their victims with crushing strength. They have a vengeful streak and may hold grudges against those who violate their territory for an extremely long time.

entry: POKENAME从掌孔喷出精神能量供给的紫焰。它控火清晰，以意念引导轨迹，让对手逃不过攻击。
author: sk372
source: Purple flames fueled by psychic energy launch from the holes in POKENAME's hands. It has clear control over the fire it shoots, mentally directing its path so that opponents cannot escape its attacks.

entry: POKENAME身体散出的精神火焰，略有催眠作用。通常已够分散对手，让它从大手射出纯精神能量球，将其轰飞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body emanates psychic flames that have a mild hypnotic effect. This is usually enough to distract an opponent long enough for it to send them flying with orbs of pure psychic energy shot from its large hands.

entry: 升级让POKENAME精神力量，强过曾被认为可能的极限。有人相信，网上过分冒犯、粗鲁的用户，其实就是它。
author: soup1900
source: Upgrades to POKENAME have made its psychic powers stronger than what was believed to be possible. Some people believe that online users who are overly offensive and rude are actually POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME虽极不合群，却非常依恋训练家。保护欲近乎暴力，也几乎不愿训练家，把注意分给别人。
author: sk372
source: Although POKENAME is very antisocial, it has an intensely strong attachment to its Trainer. This tends to make it almost violently protective and rather selfish in regards to the Trainer's attention.

entry: POKENAME精神能力几乎无双，有人推测，全力时能扭曲现实。它坚定保护训练家，几乎不流露情绪。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's psychic abilities are almost without peer, to the point some theorize that at full power it could warp reality. It staunchly protects its Trainer, showing almost no emotion as it does so.

entry: POKENAME有未开发的精神力量，研究者推测，或能使其不可阻挡。它却用能力，造出催眠体色，影响身旁训练家。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME possesses untapped psychic powers that researchers theorize could make it unstoppable. Instead, it uses its abilities to create hypnotic body colors to influence Trainers around it.

entry: POKENAME身体大部由一颗巨脑占据，赋予惊人精神力。它不吃食物，靠脑波获取养分，偏爱待在聪明人类与宝可梦旁。
author: .jerden
source: Most of POKENAME's body is occupied by a single, massive brain, giving it astonishing psychic power. Rather than eating food, it is nourished by brainwaves, so it prefers to spend time around intelligent people and Pokémon.

entry: 这种融合体钢身内有五脑，神经相连，组成单一神经网络。POKENAME比超级电脑更聪明，只需一念，就能用巨精神力毁敌。
author: .jerden
source: This fusion has five brains within its steel body, linked together by nerves to form a single neural network. More intelligent than a supercomputer, POKENAME can use its immense psychic power to destroy foes just by thinking about it.

entry: 野生POKENAME见于封闭古墓，或被锁在废实验室的保险库。虽困在玻璃与金属舱，它仍能伸出精神力，攻击视野内任何敌人。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME can be found sealed inside ancient tombs or locked inside vaults in abandoned laboratories. Although contained within a capsule of glass and metal, POKENAME can extend out psychic force to attack any foe it sees.

entry: 它用嘴，从遇见的一切活物，取下并吸收肉片。有人推测，POKENAME想吸收每种宝可梦的DNA，终于成为梦幻的完美升级版。
author: epping_forest
source: It uses its mouth to extract and absorb pieces of living flesh from anything it encounters. It's theorized that the reason for this is that POKENAME looks to absorb the DNA of every Pokémon to finally become the perfect upgrade of Mew.

entry: POKENAME假嘴能发射浓缩精神能量巨球，轰飞别人。有人说，嘴有智慧、心怀恶意，低语阴暗谎言，让它对人类变凶。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's false mouth can fire massive orbs of condensed psychic energy to blow others away. Some say the mouth is sapient and malevolent, turning POKENAME aggressive towards humanity by whispering dark falsehoods.

entry: POKENAME在中等深度的海底慢慢挪动，多半独处。谁打扰，就会被强念力抓住，扔出水面，抛向远处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME shuffles around at the sea-bottom in moderately-deep waters. It keeps to itself mostly, and anything that bothers it is seized by powerful telekinesis and flung above the water and into the distance.

entry: POKENAME飞得快如风，急着测试头甲加固的强度。若撞上硬得把自己撞懵的东西，它就赶快瞬间移走，保全面子。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME fly around at breakneck speeds, eager to test the reinforcement of the plating along their heads. If a POKENAME ever collides with an object sturdy enough to frazzle it, it will hurriedly teleport away to save face.

entry: 许多网络论坛，将POKENAME描成暴怒的精神之力。那里的人相信，不加敬奉的国家，就会遭灾。
author: .izik
source: Many online forums depict POKENAME as a wrathful psychic force. These websites believe disasters strike nations that fail to show it proper reverence.

entry: 人们以基因工程创造POKENAME，想造出终极武器，可它却不肯让人握着使用。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME was genetically engineered in an attempt to create the ultimate weapon, but it refuses to be wielded.

entry: POKENAME凶残无情，只想击败敌人，维持群首地位。冰冷闪亮的刀刃，让敌人畏惧，谁也不敢动背叛的念头。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME is a vicious, merciless Pokémon, as it thinks only of defeating its foes and maintaining its status at the head of a pack. Its cold, glinting blades strike fear into its enemy and ensure no one even thinks of double-crossing it.

entry: POKENAME把天空当海洋，以精神力量，藏过训练家的眼。尽管如此，水手仍广泛报告，夜空有身影游动。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME treats the skies as an ocean, using its psychic power to stay hidden from Trainers. Despite this, strange sightings by Sailors of figures swimming in the night sky were widely reported.

entry: POKENAME复杂构造，来自基因组成，没有两只相同。身体靠强大精神能量驱动，能量则由齿轮旋转生成。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's complex body structures are derivative of their genetic makeup, making no two look the same. Their bodies are powered by powerful psychic energy, which they produce by spinning their gears.

entry: POKENAME操纵目标感官，以虚假触觉、嗅觉增强幻象，让它几乎无法与现实区分。
author: phoenixftw
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to manipulate its target's senses, further enhancing its illusions with false touch and smell and making them nearly indistinguishable from reality.

entry: 人类造POKENAME，本想让它成为终极武器，它却放下过去，走自己的路。接近它的人，往往发现自己，竟无法与它战斗。
author: melodydelune
source: Created by humans to be the ultimate weapon, POKENAME has left its past behind to forge its own path. Those who come near it find they can't fight it.

entry: POKENAME与所有海生宝可梦，保持深厚精神联系。若被人类行为激怒，它便命手下，摧毁一切人造物。
author: adam_dnh
source: POKENAME maintains a deep psychic bond with all sea-dwelling Pokémon. When angered by the actions of humans, it commands its underlings to destroy anything man-made.

entry: POKENAME飞过大气，以心灵感应扫描下方，寻找积起的敌意。若察觉冲突可能酿灾，就降下，击退双方，直到它们累倒。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME flies through the atmosphere while telepathically scanning the ground below for any building hostility. If it senses a conflict that could lead to disaster, it descends from the sky and repels both combatants until they tire themselves out.

entry: POKENAME藏在最偏远洞穴，盼免与人接触。谁敢闯入，它就用精神力量，侵入脑海，施加可怕噩梦幻景。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides itself away in the most remote of caverns, hoping to avoid human contact. It invades the minds of those who dare trespass with its psychic powers and afflicts horrible nightmare visions upon them.

entry: POKENAME经设计与基因改造，以成为完美宝可梦为目标。手臂能化成炮，贯穿最坚硬的钢铁。
author: jona_hehe
source: POKENAME was engineered and genetically altered to create the perfect Pokémon. It can turn its arm into a cannon able to penetrate the hardest steel.

entry: POKENAME披金属甲，行事比起宝可梦，更像机器，只对战斗有兴趣。虽很少亲近，受善待，仍会慢慢与训练家及其他宝可梦结缘。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is clad in metallic armor and acts more like a machine than a Pokémon, only expressing interest in battle. While it rarely shows any affection, if treated kindly POKENAME will slowly form bonds with its Trainer and with other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME以精神力量，增强火相关能力。它控天气灵巧得惊人，常造极局部的极端天气，毁掉不喜欢的地方。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME uses psychic powers to enhance its fire-related abilities. It can control the weather with incredible dexterity, often bringing about highly localized extreme weather conditions to destroy places it doesn't like.

entry: POKENAME能从手臂上的炮，射出凝聚的精神能量。可铠甲底下究竟什么模样，没人知道。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can fire concentrated psychic blasts from the cannon on its arms. No one knows what this Pokémon looks like under its armor.

entry: POKENAME双耳散出的巨大精神能量，让它能悬浮。它对人类与宝可梦谨慎，却据说极尊敬战胜自己的对象。
author: actliux
source: The immense psychic energy that radiates from POKENAME's ears has given it the ability to levitate. It is cautious of people and Pokémon, but it is said to show great respect to those who defeat it in battle.

entry: POKENAME悄近别的生物，用自身强大精神能量，造线附着。一困住，就能操纵受害者，听命行事。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sneaks up on other creatures, creating strings made from its own powerful psychic energy that latch onto others. Once snared, it can manipulate its victim to do its bidding.

entry: POKENAME在昏暗的洞穴深处，织起带有精神能量的网。它们靠网上的精神能量感知猎物：丝线捕捉被困者的恐慌，再将其传回。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME weave psychically charged webs deep within dark caves. They rely on the psychic charge on these webs to sense their prey, the strands picking up on the panic of those caught within them and transmitting them back to POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME以强大精神能量，形成牵引光束，将小宝可梦抬离地面，拉进体内。被掳者遭了什么，却无人知晓。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses powerful psychic energy to form a tractor beam to lift smaller Pokémon off the ground and into its body. What it does with the Pokémon it has abducted is unknown.

entry: POKENAME精神能力极强，能操纵看见的任何东西。一发现群落，就须请专业巡护员处理，以免危及当地。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are immensely powerful psychics, capable of manipulating anything they can see. Specialist rangers need to be brought in to deal with POKENAME colonies as soon as they're discovered in case of danger to locals.

entry: 中间的头，以超能力支配另外两颗。若三头彻底同步，便能将整座城市，化为灰烬。
author: mistymagius
source: The middle head controls the other two with its psychic powers. However, if all three heads are in perfect sync, they can turn a whole city to ashes.

entry: 外星病毒与能造成巨大破坏的人造宝可梦，融合成POKENAME。身旁的对象，会越发恶心，最终行为反常。即使远处研究，也很危险。
author: bobosmith01
source: An alien virus and a man-made Pokémon capable of incredible destruction fused into POKENAME. Those in POKENAME's presence feel increasingly nauseous and eventually begin behaving erratically. Even studying POKENAME from afar proves dangerous.

entry: POKENAME大多睡在深洞，节省精神力量。积起的能量，让它在黑暗发光。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME spends most of its time sleeping in deep caves to conserve psychic power. The psychic energy it accumulates causes it to illuminate in the darkness.

entry: POKENAME仍在发育，以精神力量，维持熟睡的羊水泡。即使如此，精神能力也已惊人。
author: kiwiarms
source: POKENAME is still developing, using its psychic power to maintain the amniotic bubble it sleeps in. Even like this, it boasts incredible mental abilities.

entry: POKENAME尖啸扰乱听者头脑，使其迷向，更易攻击。它须饮别人的血，维持身体与精神力量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's sharp screech messes with the mind of those who hear it, leaving them disoriented and easier to attack. It requires the drinking of other's blood to keep its body and its psychic powers strong.

entry: POKENAME用念力，颈部褶边便充能发光。咆哮放出的精神冲击，让前方对象感官过载，动不了，也无力反抗。
author: sk372
source: The frill around POKENAME's neck glows with energy when using telekinesis. Its roar sends out a shockwave of psychic energy that overloads the senses of those in front of it, leaving them immobile and helpless.

entry: POKENAME极凶暴、又聪明，一见，务必避开。传闻它由实验室造出，原为岛上动物园度假区提供娱乐，后来逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is viciously violent and intelligent, and should be avoided at all costs if spotted. Rumors circulate that it was created in a lab to be entertainment at an island zoo resort before escaping.

entry: POKENAME放出带精神能量的声波，迷惑、压制敌人。趁精神攻击使其晕头转向，便俯冲狠抓狠咬，再释放更多音爆。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME unleashes waves of psychically charged sound waves to disorient and overwhelm its foes. While they are reeling from the psionic attack, it swoops down and viciously claws and bites its target before unleashing more sonic bursts.

entry: POKENAME大蘑菇，似是诸多精神能力的来源。它对人类与其他宝可梦颇敌对，用强念力展示，将其逐出领地。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's large mushroom appears to be the source of its vast array of psychic capabilities. It is quite hostile to people and other Pokémon, banishing them from its domain with powerful displays of telekinesis.

entry: POKENAME背上彩菇，是基因嵌合体，各部分DNA不同，孢子效果也独特。战斗时，它用精神力量推进孢子，加以利用。
author: .jerden
source: The colorful mushroom on POKENAME's back is a genetic chimera, with different sections having different DNA. The spores they each produce have unique effects, which POKENAME utilizes in combat by propelling spores with psychic force.

entry: POKENAME十分护人，却总过分热心。驱敌凶得往往连想保护的对象，也吓着。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very protective of others, but gets overzealous in its efforts. It fends off attackers so viciously that it often ends up scaring the one it attempts to protect.

entry: POKENAME能用精神力量造手里剑。非凡的精神能力，还能改变飞行轨迹。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME is able to use its psychic powers to make shurikens. POKENAME has extraordinary psychic abilities that let it change the trajectory of shurikens.

entry: 据说，POKENAME侵入别人脑海，让对方视它为无害朋友，再引整家人深入森林，永不归来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME supposedly uses psychic powers to invade the minds of others and make them see it as a harmless friend. Using this, it is said to lure entire families deep into the forest, never to return.

entry: 若遭激怒，它便会连对手的灵魂一并焚烧，再用超能力，将所有痕迹抹去。
author: skymaster426
source: If it is angered, then it burns its opponents to their very soul. Then, it uses its psychic powers to leave no trace behind.

entry: POKENAME暴怒，会从地下释放巨大精神冲击，力量足以推倒摩天楼。
author: .izik
source: In fits of rage, POKENAME releases massive psychic bursts from underground. The force is strong enough to topple skyscrapers.

entry: POKENAME身体形成的宝石，含强精神力量。矿工想夺走卖高价，却会被它用念力，掷来岩石与矿物。
author: actliux
source: The gemstones formed by POKENAME's body contain great psychic power. Miners seek to take these gemstones to sell for a fortune, only to be met with POKENAME launching rocks and other minerals at them with its psychic power.

entry: 观察者称POKENAME异常残忍，常欺凌弱小。控水本领少有敌手，轻松就能抬起整条河。
author: krune
source: POKENAME has been described as unusually cruel by observers, seen bullying weaker Pokémon. POKENAME's hydrokinetic powers are matched by few, able to lift entire rivers with ease.

entry: POKENAME据说是超能力宝可梦的巅峰，力量达来源超梦的九倍，战斗中极残酷。
author: thistleblower
source: Said to be the pinnacle of psychic Pokémon, POKENAME is said to be nine times more powerful than its origin, Mewtwo. It is said to be extremely cruel in battle.

entry: POKENAME兼掌巨精神力与烈火，一口气就能扭曲现实、灼烧天空。据说只在强烈太阳耀斑时出现，以热与念力，扭曲周围空气。
author: corkedjupiter63
source: POKENAME wields both immense psychic power and blazing fire, allowing it to bend reality and scorch the skies in a single breath. It is said to only appear during intense solar flares, warping the air around it with heat and telekinetic force.

entry: POKENAME用精神力量，拉来岩石，围身成坚壳。被激怒，就释放储能，向四方发石。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their psychic powers to pull rocks toward them, forming a sturdy shell around their bodies. When provoked, they release their built-up energy to launch these rocks in all directions.

entry: POKENAME体内多余精神能量，凝成灼热的鬃毛与饰毛。体虽小，却能轻易操纵物体与火，甚至一脚踢穿实钢。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's mane and feathering are created from excess psychic energy pooling in their body and are hot to the touch. Despite their small size, they can manipulate objects and fire with ease and can kick a hole through solid steel.

entry: POKENAME一见人便逃，无论如何都想避开。奔跑留下的火，由精神能量引导，追向进犯者，驱退追赶。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flees at the sight of humans, wishing to avoid them at all costs. Pursuers are dispelled by the flames it leaves behind as it gallops, manipulated by psychic energy to hone in on aggressors.

entry: POKENAME三头，分别展现超梦与两种超级进化形态的特征、举止。哪个头主导，姿势与战斗风格，便随之改变。
author: sk372
source: The three heads exhibit features and behavior from Mewtwo and its two Mega forms. POKENAME's stance and fighting style changes depending on which head is currently most in control.

entry: POKENAME用精神能量给炮充能。射出的水里，有许多能操纵附近人类大脑的细菌。
author: 0reomilka
source: POKENAME charges its cannon with psychic energy. The water it shoots contains many bacteria that can manipulate the brain of a person nearby.

entry: POKENAME睡时聚集精神能量，存进随身石头。释放后，范围内谁都会睡去。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME gather psychic energy as they sleep, storing it within the stones they carry. When released, this energy will put anyone within range to sleep.

entry: POKENAME球茎存着遇见过的每种植物种子，旅行时，在四周生出新芽。若见入侵种或杂草冒出，它就用少量毒，清掉。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: A POKENAME's bulb contains seeds of every type of plant that it has encountered, creating sprouts around it as it travels. If a POKENAME notices an invasive species or weed popping up, it will clear it out with a small dose of poison.

entry: POKENAME隐形本领，让它极难寻踪，这种特质常与幽灵属性相连。多年适应后，除吃叶时，几乎都无法察觉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have been so elusive because of their ability to turn invisible, a trait that is often associated with Ghost-type Pokémon. Over many years, POKENAME have adapted to become nearly undetectable, except when eating leaves.

entry: 孤独时，POKENAME集中精神，爆发脉冲，传向周围100米。卷入波中的宝可梦，都忍不住想找它玩。
author: sk372
source: When feeling lonely, POKENAME focuses and emits an explosive psychic pulse reaching out 100 meters around it. Any Pokémon caught in the wave feels compelled to seek POKENAME out and play with it.

entry: POKENAME太快乐、太兴奋，就会爆炸。它自己不困扰，也似乎不理解，爆炸会伤别人。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME explodes whenever it is overly happy or excited.  This doesn't bother it, and it doesn't seem to understand when its explosions hurt others.

entry: POKENAME周身旋转的每颗蛋，扔向对手，都能引发精神爆炸。再生要时间，因此它们省着用。
author: bigoljax
source: Each egg that revolves around POKENAME can cause a psychic explosion if thrown at an opponent. They use their eggs sparingly, as they take a while to regenerate.

entry: POKENAME满足于整天坐着，看自己造的泡泡。谁想戳破，它便解开盘起的脖子，用头猛击。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are content to sit all day and gaze at bubbles they make. If someone tries to pop them, POKENAME unwind their necks to deliver a sharp attack with their heads.

entry: POKENAME睡时，以精神能量，形成保护泡。受打扰，屏障爆开，它再把精神冲击导过骨头，还击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME forms a protective bubble of psychic energy while it sleeps. If disturbed, the barrier bursts and it retaliates with psychic blasts channeled through its bone.

entry: POKENAME戴的头骨很薄，战斗中没多少防护。它们扔骨攻击，再用念力，像回旋镖般召回。
author: bigoljax
source: The skulls POKENAME wear are very thin, providing not much protection whenever in a fight. In battle, they throw their bones at the opponents, using telekinesis to bring them back like boomerangs.

entry: POKENAME借气泡升到高空，腾得更高，让踢击更猛。可一步错，就可能戳破泡，让它跌回地上。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME use bubbles to get high into the sky, getting more air so their kicks can be more devastating. One wrong step can cause these bubbles to pop, making POKENAME tumble down onto the ground.

entry: POKENAME是近身搏斗高手，用大尾攻击捕食者。可它对人害羞，无法在道场任教，便选择教野生宝可梦。
author: fxncy_poland
source: POKENAME is an expert in physical combat, using its large tail to attack predators. However, it chooses to teach wild Pokémon as its shy nature towards people makes it unable to work in dojos.

entry: POKENAME用精神力量增强味觉。它一在场，味道便更浓，食客常问厨师，厨房是否有它，表示赞赏。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME uses its psychic power to enhance the sense of taste. Flavors seem bolder when it's around, and diners often compliment a chef by asking whether they have POKENAME in the kitchen.

entry: 可爱的性情，加上躯干花纹，让POKENAME备受喜爱。训练家伤心时，它也会想尽办法，让对方高兴。
author: theactualcontentyouwantreal
source: POKENAME is highly respected for its cute nature and the pattern on its torso. When its Trainer is sad, it tries everything it can to cheer them up.

entry: POKENAME能改写茧的细胞构造，回应其他宝可梦。谁想捕猎，外层便变成专为那捕食者打造的防御。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses the ability to rewrite the cellular structure of its cocoon. It does this in response to the presence of other Pokémon, morphing its outer layer into a defense tailor-made for whatever predator tries to hunt it.

entry: POKENAME一跑，就直到身体累坏才停。研究者起初以为脑小，其实是爱玩的天性，让它精力太多，得好好消耗。
author: bigoljax
source: As POKENAME start to run, they never stop until their bodies tire out. At first, many researchers assumed they do this because their brains are small, but they actually do this because their playful nature causes them to have a lot of energy to burn.

entry: POKENAME的角虽能挖穿钢铁，却因缺乏防护，常留下严重的割伤与瘀伤。钻入地下时，它们往往得在角周围加上一层保护泡膜。
author: bigoljax
source: Though POKENAME's horns are strong enough to dig through steel, they often get bad cuts and bruises on them due to having no protection. They often need to add a protective bubble coating around them while drilling into the ground.

entry: POKENAME的蛋，对科学家与厨师，都据说极珍贵。前者有人相信，含世上最罕见的一些基因；后者则信，能做出最美味的溏心蛋。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME's egg is said to be extremely valuable, both for scientists and for chefs. Some scientists believe that it contains some of the rarest genes in the world, while some cooks believe that it makes the most delicious soft-boiled egg ever.

entry: POKENAME藤状尾巴，表露情绪：平静时轻浮，难过时下垂，烦躁时则如尖刺，向外伸展。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME's vine-like tails indicate its emotions: when calm, the tails float gently; when sad, the tails droop down; and when agitated, the tails extend outward like spines.

entry: 圆球中的胚胎，才是真正的POKENAME。外面的大个子，不过是由超能力凝成的躯体。
author: toxicrown
source: The embryo within the orb is the true POKENAME. The larger creature is actually a psionic construct made from the Pokémon's psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME住在茂密海底丛林旁，与其他温顺水生宝可梦，活力十足地交往。受惊，就游深处，倒挂、随流摆长尾，模仿海葡萄。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME live near dense undersea jungles, energetically socializing among other docile aquatic Pokémon. When scared, they mimic sea grapes by swimming deep, flipping upside-down, and waving their long tails in the current.

entry: POKENAME会向潜入自己栖居水域的游泳者吐泡泡，不停骚扰，直到对方离开。战斗艰难时，它会变成对手的模样，使对方放松警惕。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME shoots bubbles from its mouth to annoy swimmers who dive into the waters where it lives, and keeps doing so until they leave. When the battle gets tough, it takes on the appearance of its opponent to make them let their guard down.

entry: POKENAME用精神力量，托起疲惫鲤鱼王，帮助逆流游。它也会与同类战斗，让额上粉角恢复活力。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME helps exhausted Magikarp swim upstream by making them float with its psychic powers. It battles other members of its kind to reinvigorate the pink horn on its forehead.

entry: POKENAME偶尔向难以养好花的花店主人现身，撒下使植物恢复生机的紫粉，再一闪消失。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME will rarely appear to florists who are struggling to keep their flowers healthy. It scatters a violet powder that revitalizes the plants before disappearing in a flash.

entry: POKENAME用气泡头盔，在水下呼吸。它难得一见，也能伪装成宝石海星。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME uses a bubble helmet so that it can breathe underwater. POKENAME is rarely seen and can disguise itself as a Starmie.

entry: POKENAME为人表演，若对方想走，就造隐墙，盼其改意。仍想离开，它便反复瞬间移回身边，直到自己玩腻。
author: .izik
source: If someone tries to leave while POKENAME performs for them, it will create an invisible wall in their path, hoping they will reconsider. Should they still attempt to leave, it will repeatedly teleport them back to its location until it grows bored.

entry: POKENAME肢体看似脱离身体。科学家还未证实，究竟真如此，还是极速与隐形能力造出的幻象。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME's limbs appear to be detached from its body. Scientists have not been able to confirm whether this is truly the case, or merely an illusion created by POKENAME's blindingly fast speed and ability to turn invisible.

entry: POKENAME以友善、爱玩的舞蹈闻名，总愿炫耀。它也以头发为傲，每次演出后，都仔细梳理。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is renowned for its friendly attitude and playful dances, which it's always willing to show off. It takes great pride in its hair as well, grooming it thoroughly after any performance.

entry: POKENAME甜食胃口很大，总找点心。有人说，饿够了，就会把别人变糖果，但未证实，也不太可能。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is known to have a voracious appetite for sweets, always on the lookout for treats. Some say it will turn others into candy if it's hungry enough, though this is unconfirmed and unlikely.

entry: POKENAME钳上的突起，专收雨夜后的晨露。干夜长久持续，便常需模仿求雨。
author: bigoljax
source: The bumps coating POKENAME's pincers are specialized to collect morning dew after rainy nights. They often need to copy Rain Dance after longer periods of drier nights.

entry: POKENAME虽爱玩，稍有不便，却很快暴怒。暴走时，它尽量专撞树，而非身旁别人。
author: bigoljax
source: Though POKENAME are playful in nature, they are often quick to go into a rage at the slightest inconvenience. During these rampages, they try to focus on ramming into trees instead of others near them.

entry: POKENAME虽弱，对人类与宝可梦，却都极友善。漂亮粉鳞，会送给喜欢的对象。
author: mepp.
source: Though weak, POKENAME is extremely friendly to people and Pokémon alike. It gives its beautiful pink scales to those it likes.

entry: POKENAME绕着树枝，从树到树漂浮，寻找最美味的叶。它擅躲捕食者，一边蜿蜒闪开，一边独自偷笑。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wind their way around tree branches, floating from tree to tree in search of the tastiest leaves to feed on. They are adept at evading predators, weaving away from them in sinuous movements whilst giggling to themselves.

entry: POKENAME体力惊人，能连续暴走三天以上。安抚方法虽多，最快的记录，却是朝它吹泡泡。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Due to their impressive stamina, POKENAME can rage for upwards of three days straight. While there are plenty of ways to calm POKENAME down, the fastest recorded method is to blow bubbles at POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME帮迷途小拉普拉斯找亲代，却常因亲代突然不见而失败。它只好收养，结果越养越多，常累积到数十只。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME help lead lost young Lapras to their parents, but often fail due to their parents suddenly disappearing. This causes POKENAME to adopt these young Pokémon, usually snowballing into them adopting dozens of Lapras.

entry: POKENAME能变成每种宝可梦，几乎完美复制各项特征。可所有变化，都留着原形的粉色。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME have the ability to transform into every Pokémon, copying each trait almost perfectly. However, their transformations keep the pink tinge that their regular appearance has.

entry: 它从毛尾分泌无害液体，玩耍般涂遍周围。变色原因很多，最令人意外的，是情绪与进化石也能影响。
author: infinex21
source: It secretes a harmless liquid from its furry tail, which it uses to playfully paint on anything around it. This liquid can change color due to many reasons, the most surprising being that emotions and evolutionary stones affect its color.

entry: 遇见POKENAME的训练家说，浑身都被浇透。住它附近的人知道，去哪儿，都得带毛巾与备用衣服。
author: beetlething
source: Trainers who have encountered a POKENAME describe getting soaked from head to toe. People who live near a POKENAME know to bring a towel and an extra set of clothing everywhere they go.

entry: 少数人相信，POKENAME是各地许多电属性宝可梦的祖先。梦幻DNA，让它格外喜爱泡泡。
author: rycronicgames
source: A few people believe POKENAME is the ancestor of many Electric-type Pokémon that roam across the regions. The Mew DNA of this Pokémon makes POKENAME very fond of bubbles.

entry: POKENAME暖身能安抚接触者，暂时清空烦恼。战斗中，它用精神力量操纵吐火，划独特弧线，追赶善避的敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's warm body soothes those who touch it, emptying their mind of troubled thoughts for a time. In battle, it can psychically manipulate the fire it breathes, making it move in unique arcs and chase after evasive foes.

entry: 据说，基因中含着每一行可能的电脑代码。科学家花数十年，想看能否用现代科技，复制其基因组。
author: mistymagius
source: It is said to hold every possible line of computer code within its genes. Scientists have spent decades trying to see if its genome could be replicated with modern technology.

entry: POKENAME爱与不知情的潜水者捉迷藏，用尾轻拉腿，再藏起。一被发现，就喷粉墨，再游走。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME love to play hide and seek with unsuspecting divers, using their tails to gently tug on their legs before hiding. When spotted, they spit out a pink-tinted ink before swimming away.

entry: POKENAME用触手般的尾巴，将遗落的玩具拉进水里。回到洞窟，它们会拿来玩上一小会儿，再任玩具浮回水面。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME use their tentacle-like tails to pull left-behind toys down into the water. When they go back into their caves, they play with these toys for short periods of time before letting them float back to the surface.

entry: POKENAME绕着树枝，从树到树漂浮，寻找最美味的叶。遇险，它将精神力量导过毒刺，造闪亮气泡自卫。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wind their way around tree branches, floating from tree to tree in search of the tastiest leaves to feed on. They channel their psychic powers through their stinger when threatened, creating a shimmering bubble to protect themselves.

entry: POKENAME绕着树枝，从树到树漂浮，寻找最美味的叶。它好奇观察其他虫宝可梦，看爱吃什么；若看着够好，就飘去尝。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wind their way around tree branches, floating from tree to tree in search of the tastiest leaves to feed on. They curiously watch other bug Pokémon to see what their preferred food is, floating over to sample some if it looks good enough.

entry: POKENAME收集虫属性宝可梦的蜕皮，用细线挂在树枝，再以精神强念操纵虫蜕，逗乐或吓唬想针对的对象。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME collect the shed skin of Bug-type Pokémon and hang them from tree branches by thin strings. Using Psychic, POKENAME puppeteer the molted skin to entertain or terrify whoever they wish.

entry: POKENAME爬过潮池，寻找闪亮石头吃。训练家走过，它们就变色，配合附近岩石。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME scuttle through tide pools in search of shiny rocks to eat. When Trainers walk by, POKENAME changes their colors to match the rocks nearby.

entry: POKENAME似乎爱模仿化石宝可梦的叫声，每声却都稍有不对。研究者猜，这是它想复制，从未到过的古世界之声。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME seem to have a habit of mimicking the calls of fossil Pokémon, with each call sounding slightly off. Researchers hypothesize this is them trying to copy the sounds of an ancient world they've never been in.

entry: POKENAME学会用精神力量悬浮后，臂翼似乎便退化了。外表虽可爱，训练家最好别打扰群落，以免遭岩石爆击。
author: chibitales
source: The wings on POKENAME's arms are thought to have become vestigial after learning to levitate with their psychic power. Despite their cute appearance, Trainers are advised to leave POKENAME colonies alone, lest they be pelted with Rock Blast attacks.

entry: POKENAME似乎懒到，连找食也不起身，直接用念力，将各类食物拉来，有时害商店整批存货消失。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME seem to have gotten so lazy that they don't even get up to find food. They instead use telekinesis to bring all kinds of food to them, sometimes causing stores to lose their whole supply of food.

entry: POKENAME天性极温柔，长眠时，也平静浮在空中。甚至肯让其他宝可梦睡肚子上，保护它们免遭捕食。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are very gentle in nature, peacefully floating in the air during their long naps. They even let other Pokémon rest on their stomachs, keeping them protected from predators.

entry: POKENAME用利羽雕冰像，样子像所在地区的流行玩具。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME use their sharp feathers to carve sculptures out of ice. These sculptures resemble the popular toys native to the region POKENAME is in.

entry: POKENAME周身流转的雷电，似由纯精神能量构成。被击中的对象，战意会彻底消散。
author: sk372
source: The lightning coursing across POKENAME's body appears to be composed of pure psychic energy. Those struck by its bolts have their will to battle completely zapped away.

entry: POKENAME翼上火焰，是鲜明的洋红粉色，夜空中格外显眼。它们大展双翼，造出由火构成的大气泡。
author: bigoljax
source: The fire that burns along POKENAME's wings has a distinct magenta-pink coloring, making it pop out against the night sky. They spread their wings wide, creating large bubbles made out of their fire.

entry: POKENAME每月至少蜕皮一次，有时一个月，甚至至少三次。蜕皮颇强韧，腐烂后，肥土效果胜过多数肥料。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME sheds its own skin at least once every month, but can be seen shedding it at least three times within a month on occasion. POKENAME's shed skin is rather strong, and when the skin decays, it enriches the soil better than most fertilizers.

entry: POKENAME能量强盛，头上小翼几乎总在散小颗粒。为劝退别人，它们能释能，影响周围天气。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are brimming with such potent energy that they almost always exude small particles from the small wings on their heads. To deter others, they can release their energy and influence the weather around them.

entry: POKENAME虽然有着这样的体型和外形，飞行速度却相当快。奔跑虽不如飞行，也依旧迅捷。它们的超能力十分可观，清醒时始终都在运用。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME, despite their apparent size and shape, can reach rather high speeds when they fly. Although not as fast, they are still fairly quick runners as well. They have considerable psychic power, which they are always utilizing while awake.

entry: POKENAME心善，却异常害羞，尽量不让人找到。它帮有需要的对象，救完便立刻瞬间移走，不留痕迹。
author: sk372
source: Kindhearted but incredibly shy, POKENAME tries to make itself as elusive as possible. It helps those in need, but teleports away immediately after the rescue, leaving no trace of its presence behind.

entry: POKENAME体内流转数十种毒，各有不同强度与用途。尾部存最强毒，能永久损害免疫与神经系统。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME's body courses with dozens of venoms, each with a different intensity and purpose. Their tail stores their most powerful venom, which can cause permanent damage to the body's immune and nervous systems.

entry: POKENAME尾部分泌的蜜，有药效，能治多数病痛。可蜜极苦，过量还会引发惊厥。
author: .izik
source: The honey POKENAME secretes from its tail is medicinal and capable of curing most infirmities. Despite this, it is extremely bitter and can cause seizures if consumed in excess.

entry: 有人给这种融合体起了个绰号，叫“超梦三号”。融合平息了超梦原本暴烈的心，或许是梦幻的遗传物质填补了超梦DNA的缺口。它既拥有惊人力量，也极其善良。
author: sk372
source: Some have nicknamed this fusion "Mewthree." Fusion has calmed Mewtwo's once-violent heart, perhaps due to Mew's genetic material filling in gaps in Mewtwo's DNA. It has become a being of incredible power, but also incredible kindness.

entry: 梦幻DNA平息超梦的暴烈，赋予POKENAME颇爱玩的性格。它造泡泡，与其他宝可梦玩，一察觉人类，却会逃走。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: Violence within Mewtwo has been quenched by Mew's DNA, giving POKENAME a rather playful personality. It creates bubbles to play with other Pokémon, but will flee when it detects the presence of humans.

entry: 研究人员推测，这种特殊的梦幻融合体，源于罕见的遗传异常。不过，POKENAME自己，似乎一切安好。
author: jackjirachi
source: Researchers speculate that this particular Mew fusion was the result of a rare genetic disorder. POKENAME seems to be perfectly fine, however.

entry: POKENAME近似最早已知的一幅梦幻描绘，引发研究：那是否就是数千年前，梦幻的原始形态。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME resembles one of the first ever known depictions of Mew. This has sparked research into whether the depiction may have been Mew's original form many millennia in the past.

entry: POKENAME据说有所有宝可梦的基因，融合后，身体却不稳定，随时会随机化成其他宝可梦的混合体。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body, said to possess the genes of all Pokémon, has become unstable after fusion. Its form will randomly shift into a combination of other Pokémon at any given moment.

entry: POKENAME三眼可独立转动，中眼却常担任警戒。它痴迷亮物，总不顾后果地偷，因此中眼帮忙看守，十分有用。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME's three eyes can move independently of one another, though the middle eye will often act as a sort of lookout. This is very helpful, as this Pokémon is obsessed with shiny things and will always steal them regardless of the consequences.

entry: POKENAME叶片能复制遇见过的任何气味，吸引孩子来玩。孩子一玩累，它便立刻瞬间移走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's leaf can replicate any scent it has encountered before. It uses this to attract children to play before teleporting away the moment they grow tired.

entry: POKENAME能改造叶片，模仿所见任何植物。传说，一位药剂师曾与它交友，救村庄免于致命疾病。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body can alter its leaf to mimic any plant it sees. Legends tell of an apothecary who befriended one to save a village from a deadly disease.

entry: POKENAME的红色花瓣会分泌芳香油，用于制作一些最顶级的女士香水。有些故事说，它极为稀有，只有心地温柔的人在场时，才会现身。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's red petals secrete a fragrant oil that is used to create some of the most exclusive lines of women's perfume. According to some stories, it is an extremely rare Pokémon that appears only in the presence of people with gentle hearts.

entry: POKENAME在林中玩，背焰便更热，有时引发森林大火。它只等火大才察觉，再惊慌地瞬间逃走。
author: .izik
source: While playing in forests, the flames on POKENAME's back grow hotter and can sometimes cause forest fires. It only notices these when they grow large, at which point it panics and teleports away.

entry: POKENAME结合精神力量与体热，把头上的蓝色火焰塑成发光图案。它们喜欢用这些美丽灯光，逗乐友善的人类与宝可梦。
author: ambrosia04
source: By combining their psychic powers with their internal heat, POKENAME can shape their blue head-flames into glowing patterns. They love using these beautiful light displays to entertain friendly Pokémon and people alike.

entry: POKENAME颈焰碰着无害，只会把接触的一切，涂成鲜明蓝色。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The flames on POKENAME's neck are not harmful to the touch. Instead, they paint whatever makes contact a stark blue.

entry: POKENAME尾刺锐利得能刺穿一本书。虽很能防身，它却更爱拿来串找到的水果。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The spikes on POKENAME's tail are sharp enough to pierce through a book. Despite being a great defensive tool, POKENAME prefer to use them to hold onto fruit they find.

entry: POKENAME每日往来湖泊，以念力捞垃圾，扔进大气层。水一清，便潜入，与其他宝可梦玩。
author: .izik
source: Each day POKENAME travels between lakes, lifting trash from the water and flinging it into the atmosphere with telekinesis. Once the water is clear, it dives in and plays with other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME对谁都友善，却特别亲近鸟宝可梦。它以念力，帮着建宽大舒适的巢，让成对的鸟养家育雏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is friendly to all but has a special affinity for bird Pokémon. Using its telekinetic power, it assists in helping build big and comfy nests for pairs to raise families in.

entry: POKENAME休息，会在水下、以精神力维持的泡中，蜷成胎儿姿势。若睡眠受扰，便凶猛激怒，暴走至被制服，或自己累坏。
author: infinex21
source: When POKENAME rest, they curl into a fetal position underwater within a psychically maintained bubble. If their slumber is ever disturbed, they become ferociously agitated and rampage until they are either subdued or they become exhausted.

entry: POKENAME藏高草，跟踪路人。目标一近，就高叫跃起，吓对方，再笑着飘走。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME hides in fields of tall grass, stalking passersby. Once close to its target, POKENAME springs up with a loud cry to startle them and then floats away, laughing.

entry: POKENAME毛天生保温好，几乎什么环境，都能轻松快速挖巢。可它往往不满足一个，小地方里，就留下数十个自己大小的洞。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME's fur is naturally well-insulated. They are easily and quickly able to make a den in almost any environment. They usually aren't satisfied digging one nest, resulting in dozens of POKENAME-sized holes in a small area.

entry: POKENAME能用精神力量，扭曲宝可梦的时间感，让片刻如数小时，或数小时转瞬即过。脸上DNA状丝链会自行扭动，回应附近强精神能量。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME can warp a Pokémon's perception of time with its psychic power, making moments feel like hours or hours pass in a moment. The DNA-like strands on its face twist and move on their own, reacting to powerful psychic energy nearby.

entry: POKENAME极稀有，即使最适合它的冬夜，也难找到。古人曾视它为送梦者，带来满是无数宝可梦的平静原野幻景。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are very rare Pokémon to find, even during the winter nights they usually thrive in. Our ancestors once thought of POKENAME as dream-bringers, giving them calming visions of fields filled with countless Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME温柔，住在最偏远森林，难得见到。据说只在纷争时的夜里出现，从头冠发精神脉冲，使四周平静和缓。
author: sk372
source: A gentle denizen of the most remote forests. POKENAME is rarely seen, said to only come out at night during times of strife, emitting a psychic pulse from its head crest that calms and pacifies those around it.

entry: POKENAME只在夜间出来，等天上看得见星星，便去大城市，临时行侠打击窃贼与恶徒，直到日出。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME only come out at night, waiting until they can see stars in the sky. They travel over to larger cities, becoming temporary crime fighters, stopping burglars and evildoers until the sun rises.

entry: POKENAME慢慢织出精巧蛛网，训练家旅行，往往一头撞入。穿过网的人说，会对所有生命，生出强烈自豪。
author: beetlething
source: POKENAME take their time spinning webs, creating intricate designs that Trainers stumble into on their journeys. Trainers who have stepped through a POKENAME's web describe feeling intense pride towards all living things.

entry: POKENAME拍翼释放精神波，使身旁对象微笑，无论开不开心。因为，它是用念力，硬把脸扯成笑容。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME flaps its wings, it releases psychic waves that cause those nearby to smile. This occurs whether they are happy or not, as it telekinetically forces their face into a grin.

entry: POKENAME先隐形，再俯冲抓虫宝可梦猎食。利爪让攀住猎物，十分轻松。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hunt for food by turning themselves invisible before swooping in to grab onto bug Pokémon. Their sharp talons make latching onto prey an easy task.

entry: POKENAME引导精神能量，长头触角便发亮粉光。它擅用意念控电，数英里外，也能轻松操纵。
author: .izik
source: The long antennae growing from POKENAME's head glow bright pink when it channels psychic energy. It excels in electrokinesis, controlling electricity with ease from miles away.

entry: POKENAME背鳍上的铃铛，响声轻微得人耳无法听见。它们常玩铃铛玩得分心，不小心撞上珊瑚。
author: bigoljax
source: The bells on POKENAME's dorsal fins make a very faint ringing sound that's unable to be heard by the human ear. They often distract themselves by playing with these bells, causing them to accidentally run into coral.

entry: 因热门动画中的描绘，POKENAME近来人气大涨。它有时扮玩具，陪孩子玩，谁捡起，就用天使之吻送惊喜。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME have soared in popularity as of late thanks to a popular cartoon's portrayal of them. They'll sometimes disguise themselves as a toy to play with children, surprising whoever picks them up with a Sweet Kiss.

entry: POKENAME在满月光下跳舞，会释放精神波，逼附近对象违意起舞，直到它跳完。
author: .izik
source: While dancing in full moonlight, POKENAME releases psychic waves. These waves force anyone nearby to dance against their will until it is finished.

entry: POKENAME软身好捏、好挤，又不受伤。挤它，会放出安抚周围的精神脉冲，因此很像受欢迎的解压玩具。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's soft body is easy to squeeze and squish without causing it any harm. Being squeezed emits a psychic pulse that calms those nearby, so it is popular as something of a stress toy.

entry: POKENAME爱感受怜爱，却害羞，不愿现身。曾见它在身外造蛋壳，藏进其他宝可梦的巢，体验亲代照顾。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME enjoy being exposed to compassionate feelings, but are shy and reluctant to reveal themselves. They have been observed creating an eggshell around themselves, hiding in the nests of other Pokémon so that they can experience parental care.

entry: POKENAME寻找忧郁的人。一找到，就变成对方最爱的宝可梦，逗其开心。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME seek out those who are melancholic. When POKENAME finds such a person, they transform into that person's favorite Pokémon to make them happy.

entry: POKENAME用尾碰头，就能读到对方未来。若见危险，会瞬间移去安全处，再仔细照看几天。
author: .izik
source: By touching its tail to someone's head, POKENAME can read their future. Should it foresee danger ahead for them, it will teleport them to a safe location and monitor them closely for days.

entry: 风大时，POKENAME藏树干，将尾伸在空中，测风速、作风向标。风一息，便又起飞。
author: fxncy_poland
source: During windy hours, POKENAME hides in tree trunks while extending its tail out in the air. It does this to measure wind speeds, acting as a weathervane. When the wind subsides, POKENAME take flight again.

entry: POKENAME以精神力量，窥见其他宝可梦的遗传历史。遗传学家十分珍视，用它研究融合起源。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their psychic powers to peer into the genetic history of other Pokémon. They are highly prized amongst geneticists, who make use of them to aid in their research on the origins of fusion.

entry: POKENAME羊毛的电，除非烦躁，几乎不会超过舒服的麻感。毛制衣物，能让穿者舒缓微麻，售价很高。
author: sk372
source: The electricity in POKENAME's wool scarcely goes above a pleasant tingling sensation unless it is agitated. Clothes made using its wool fetch high prices due to the soothing tingle they give the wearer.

entry: POKENAME在空中疾驰时，速度过快，常会掉落粉色的羽毛。还不等人捡起，羽毛就被小泡泡收好，待它停栖下来，再送回身边。
author: bigoljax
source: As POKENAME speed through the skies, their pink-tinted feathers often fall off due to the blistering speeds. Before anyone can collect these feathers, they're contained in small bubbles and brought back to POKENAME once they've perched.

entry: POKENAME身上绒毛冒静电，却香如棉花糖。它将绒毛球送给玩伴，尽管几小时内，就会消散。
author: .izik
source: The fluff growing from POKENAME's body sparks with static but smells of cotton candy. It gives balls of this fluff to those it plays with, despite them dissipating within hours.

entry: POKENAME笑得太厉害，会引发周围大雷暴。因此，它尽力憋住，最多只敢轻轻偷笑。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME laughs too hard, it can trigger massive thunderstorms in the surrounding area. Because of this, it tries to hold everything in, except for the most subtle of giggles.

entry: POKENAME每年一次，造出鲜亮深红粉末。粉稀有，光泽非凡，染料师格外渴求。
author: .izik
source: Once per year POKENAME creates a brilliant crimson powder. This powder is rare and coveted by dye makers for its remarkable luster.

entry: POKENAME顽皮，爱捉弄不知情训练家。它改变尾巴浮力，假装被拖入水，吓坏旁人，再偷笑着冒出来。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME are mischievous Pokémon that love playing pranks on unsuspecting Trainers. By altering the buoyancy of their tails, they simulate being dragged underwater, causing panic in nearby onlookers before popping back up with a giggle.

entry: POKENAME一潜水，似乎就完全消失。可人一潜下，又能看见。它借非凡伪装，突然用玩闹的撞击或水枪，吓路人。
author: pkbonusducks
source: When diving into water, POKENAME seem to completely disappear. However, once a person dives underwater, POKENAME become visible again. This incredible camouflage is used to surprise passersby with a playful Tackle or Water Gun.

entry: POKENAME能改变身体的颜色和质感，随意模仿任何树木的外观。它们常借此捉弄登山者，现身短短片刻，便又迅速伪装起来。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME have the ability to change the colors and textures of their bodies and are able to mimic the appearance of any kind of tree at will. They often use this to play around with hikers, appearing for brief moments before quickly camouflaging.

entry: POKENAME性子活泼，常在水里戏耍。若发现垂死的生态系统，就试着用精神能力挽救。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME has a bubbly personality and is often spotted splashing around in the water. If it spots a dying ecosystem, it will use its psychic abilities to try and save it.

entry: POKENAME用蓝叶乘风，再以精神力量操纵空气，主动在空中转向，寻找友善的人陪玩。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME use their blue leaves to catch wind. By manipulating the air with psychic power, they purposefully steer through the sky to find friendly people to play with.

entry: POKENAME始终悬浮。下雨，就用精神泡包住，保持干燥。雨后，残留精神力，让一切都闻着像它的花。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME is always hovering in the air. If it rains, POKENAME will surround itself with a psychic bubble to stay dry. When the rain ends, the psychic residue makes everything smell like POKENAME's flower.

entry: POKENAME一湿，就迅速甩掉棉状孢子里的水，飞出小粉泡。泡随风飘，落在植物上，能帮助生长。
author: bigoljax
source: Whenever POKENAME gets wet, they quickly shake the water out of their cotton spores, causing small pink bubbles to fly out. These bubbles fly with the wind, able to help plants they land on grow.

entry: POKENAME适应性极强，城镇、森林都能觅食。它们用精神力量，浮进难够的食品柜，淘气地留下空果皮，捉弄人。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME are highly adaptable and can be found scavenging for food in towns and forests alike. They use their psychic powers to float into hard-to-reach pantries, playfully leaving empty berry skins behind as a prank for people.

entry: POKENAME曾跳舞、玩铙钹，逗人开心。人们却常没注意，长尾已伸进包，拿食物与小饰品。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME have been seen dancing and playing with cymbals to entertain people. People often miss POKENAME's long tail reaching into their bags for food and trinkets.

entry: POKENAME整天晒太阳吸能，会飞离遮日的云。有些早晨，能见它待在高楼顶。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME remains in the sun all day to soak up solar energy, and it flies away from cloud cover. On some mornings, POKENAME can be found atop tall buildings.

entry: POKENAME整天晒太阳吸能，会飞离遮日的云。有些早晨，能见它待在高楼顶。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME remains in the sun all day to soak up solar energy, and it flies away from cloud cover. On some mornings, POKENAME can be found atop tall buildings.

entry: POKENAME遗传构造非凡，让头顶茎，能长成多种植物。尾巴用来恶作剧，或紧紧攀住别人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have an extraordinary genetic structure that allows the stem atop their heads to grow into many kinds of plants. Their tails are used for playful pranks or to cling tightly to others.

entry: POKENAME非凡基因，让它能产多种花香。有些此前从未记录，研究者因而推测，体内含有灭绝植物的基因。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME's remarkable genetics allow it to produce many varieties of floral scents. Some of these scents were previously undocumented, leading researchers to speculate that POKENAME contains genes from extinct flora.

entry: POKENAME非凡基因，让它能产多种花香。有些此前从未记录，研究者因而推测，体内含有灭绝植物的基因。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME's remarkable genetics allow it to produce many varieties of floral scents. Some of these scents were previously undocumented, leading researchers to speculate that POKENAME contains genes from extinct flora.

entry: POKENAME虽好奇，却难寻踪，避免人类接触。有时，整群悬在感兴趣的物件旁，可一知被看，就迅速散去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Despite POKENAME's curious demeanour, they are elusive Pokémon that shun human contact. Swarms of them are sometimes spotted hovering around objects that catch their attention, but they quickly disperse when they realise they're being watched.

entry: 幼年POKENAME极友善好奇，不停探索，与宝可梦、训练家交往。越老越退缩，成年后，大多时间隐形。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Young POKENAME are incredibly friendly and inquisitive, constantly exploring and engaging with Pokémon and Trainers. As they age, they withdraw into themselves, and once fully mature, spend most of their time invisible.

entry: POKENAME生性好奇，路过的事物只要引起兴趣，它就常会跟上去。不过，它也很害羞，被跟随的人若转身察看，它便隐去身形，以免被捉住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a curious sort, often following along after something passing by has caught its interest. It is rather shy as well, so should the person it follows turn to see their pursuer, it turns invisible so as not to get caught.

entry: POKENAME爱躺在自己造的气泡上，悠闲漂空。它有时似乎忘记，泡不会永存，于是从高处一头重栽地上。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME enjoy resting atop bubbles they make, drifting through the air in relaxation. It seems POKENAME forgets sometimes that bubbles don't last forever, as they can be sometimes spotted faceplanting hard into the ground from up high.

entry: POKENAME似乎能读、影响所有别种宝可梦的思想。它爱玩又善良，主要让遇见的对象，更加平和。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME seems to possess the capability to read and influence the minds of all other species of Pokémon. With a playful and kind nature, it primarily uses the influence to make those it encounters more peaceable.

entry: POKENAME用精神泡裹住训练家，保护免于将至的冲击，尽量减轻伤害。夜空月相不同，力量也会随之增强。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME protects its Trainer from impending impacts by enveloping them within its psychic bubbles, thereby minimizing the damage as much as possible. Its powers intensify depending on the phase of the moon in the night sky.

entry: POKENAME留下的羽毛，闪着粉光。若落地前碰到，碰者可能突然瞬间移去远方。
author: .izik
source: The feathers POKENAME leaves behind shimmer with a pink glow. If touched before they hit the ground, the person who touches one may spontaneously teleport to a faraway location.

entry: 脑子不堪重负，POKENAME便从宝石放出思想泡。别的宝可梦不慎撞上，就会被灌进它的念头。
author: bigoljax
source: When their brains are overwhelmed, POKENAME release their thoughts as bubbles out of their gems. Some Pokémon accidentally run into these bubbles, forcing POKENAME's ideas into their minds.

entry: POKENAME收集花与植物，每株放进背部花苞，便能模仿植物行为，例如散粉、播种。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME collect flowers and other flora, putting each one into the buds on their backs. This allows them to mimic the actions of flora, such as releasing pollen and planting seeds.

entry: POKENAME须不停啃岩石与砖墙，磨短不断长大的巨牙。它们爱玩闹着嚼穿路人金属装备，再偷笑，以精神力浮空，逃开追赶。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME must constantly gnaw on rocks and brick walls to grind down their massive, ever-growing fangs. They love to playfully chew through the metal gear of passing people, giggling as they use psychic levitation to float out of pursuit.

entry: 这顽皮精灵，夜里似会随机出现在世界各地。人们相信，颈边珠体让POKENAME能操纵宝可梦DNA，随心强迫进化。
author: sk372
source: A playful spirit that seems to appear randomly across the world at night. It's believed the orbs around its neck let it manipulate the DNA of Pokémon and forcibly evolve them should POKENAME will it.

entry: POKENAME释放精神共鸣，让野生未知图腾蜂拥而来，奉其为首领。成群的它们，会掳来其他生物，作为可能的玩伴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME emits a psychic resonance that causes wild Unown to flock to it as a leader. Groups will gather to whisk away other creatures and bring them to POKENAME as potential playmates.

entry: POKENAME寻找强宝可梦，浮在头旁，淘气地拍打。它不停挑衅，直到对方还击，再一边偷笑，一边使出强大双倍奉还。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME seek out powerful Pokémon, floating around their heads and playfully swatting at them. POKENAME keep taunting until the powerful Pokémon they're antagonising lashes out before retaliating with a powerful Counter as they giggle to themselves.

entry: POKENAME一叫，尾上的头就会模仿随机宝可梦。野外研究融合的学者，常因此困惑。
author: bigoljax
source: Whenever POKENAME lets out a call, the head on their tails mimics the call of a random Pokémon. This often confuses field researchers who are trying to make studies about fusions.

entry: POKENAME看见孩子拿气球，就用角戳破，再把自己当替代，浮空，让孩子像牵线般握尾。
author: oddwalls
source: If POKENAME spots a child with a balloon, it pops the balloon with its horn and then offers itself as a replacement, floating through the air while the child holds its tail like a string.

entry: 重尾压身，POKENAME只贴地飞。它在林中找熟睡露营者，再蜷在身旁休息，以精神力量送美梦。
author: oddwalls
source: Weighed down by its heavy tail, POKENAME flies just above the ground. It searches the woods for sleeping campers and then curls up next to them to rest, giving them pleasant dreams with its psychic power.

entry: POKENAME看鱼宝可梦攀瀑，会扑去用钳抓，仿佛游戏。捉后再放，就是用念力，把它们抛到瀑顶。
author: .izik
source: While watching fish Pokémon climb waterfalls, POKENAME swoops in with its pincers to catch them like a game. Its catch-and-release method ends with it flinging them to the top of the waterfall with telekinesis.

entry: POKENAME长身每节都像DNA，甚至有液体流过每根肋骨的幻象。暗中发蓝光，帮助它钻洞辨路。
author: bigoljax
source: Each segment on POKENAME's long body resembles DNA, even having the illusion of liquid passing through each rib. These segments create a blue glow in the dark, helping lead POKENAME while digging through caves.

entry: POKENAME在城市间瞬间移动，遍找陈列甜点的面包店，再把点心移往远处，大吃数小时。吃不够，就发脾气。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME teleports from city to city, scouring streets for bakeries with displayed confections. It then teleports these treats to a faraway location where it can gorge itself for hours and hold tantrums if it doesn't eat enough.

entry: POKENAME毫不节制地使用精神力量，驱逐领地中过度暴烈的捕食者。羽毛极软，用来填充高档酒店与度假村最好的枕头。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME drives overly violent predators from its territory by using its psychic powers without restraint. Its feathers are so soft that they are used to stuff some of the finest pillows found in high-end hotels and resorts.

entry: POKENAME罕见地会在幼儿园教室，玩孩子留下的玩具。受打扰，就大发脾气，以念力乱扔，再瞬间离去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can rarely be found in preschool classrooms playing with toys left behind by children. If interrupted it will fly into a tantrum, hurling things around with telekinesis before teleporting away.

entry: POKENAME全身毒刺，却爱表达亲近。可一靠别人，就免不了意外扎伤。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME's entire body is covered in venomous quills.  It loves to show affection, but it cannot get close to anyone else without accidentally pricking them.

entry: POKENAME身旁有两只浮爪，以强念力操纵。力量似来自双尾，因为指挥爪动，尾尖便明亮发光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is accompanied by two floating claws that it controls through powerful telekinetic powers. Its power appears to originate in its double tails, as the tips glow bright as it directs the claws around.

entry: 壳内树果发酵，产出粉色酒精液，余味独特如草莓。POKENAME爱变成其他宝可梦，在林中一起玩、交往。
author: fiordaliso
source: The Berries that ferment inside its shell produce a pink, alcoholic liquid with a distinctive strawberry aftertaste. POKENAME enjoys playing and socializing with other Pokémon in the forest by taking on their appearances.

entry: POKENAME大翼响得像直升机，能吓走其他宝可梦。它们用念力，远远偷大针蜂巢，不想取蜜时挨刺。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's large wings are loud enough to scare other Pokémon, often described as similar to a helicopter. They use telekinesis to steal Beedrill hives at a safe distance, not wanting to be stung while trying to take their honey.

entry: POKENAME优雅敏捷地浮过暴雪，营救迷途旅人。变成其他宝可梦前，头羽会先亮粉光。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME floats with grace and agility through blizzards to rescue lost travelers. The feather on its head glows pink just before it transforms into another Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME常着迷于比自己大的人与宝可梦，隐形尾随许多天。留下蜂蜜供品，就能诱它现身。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME often develop a fascination with Pokémon or people larger than themselves, following them invisibly for days on end. They can be tempted into revealing themselves by leaving out an offering of honey.

entry: POKENAME常着迷于比自己大的人与宝可梦，隐形尾随许多天。留下蜂蜜供品，就能诱它现身。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME often develop a fascination with Pokémon or people larger than themselves, following them invisibly for days on end. They can be tempted into revealing themselves by leaving out an offering of honey.

entry: POKENAME腹部星纹，暗中会亮。它夜行森林，用星光引路，帮助迷途旅人找到避难处。
author: sk372
source: The star-shaped pattern on POKENAME's stomach glows in the dark. It wanders the forests at night, using the star's light as a guide to help lost travelers find safe havens.

entry: POKENAME须不停动，防止熔融粉身冷却、硬化。它极难寻踪，留下发光暖黏液，在地上画图，逗路人开心。
author: ambrosia04
source: To prevent their molten pink bodies from cooling and hardening, POKENAME must constantly keep moving. They are highly elusive, leaving glowing trails of warm slime that they use to draw pictures on the ground to entertain passersby.

entry: POKENAME在天灾后出现。渗流身体的致突变特性，让植物在受损土壤重生，长出独特特征。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME appears in the wake of natural disasters. The mutagenic properties of its oozing body allow plants to regrow in damaged soils and develop unique traits.

entry: 少数相遇显示，POKENAME颇暴烈，攻击近巢的登山男。梳羽似能安抚它，四周浮羽，会逐翼轻刷。
author: bigoljax
source: The few encounters of POKENAME show them being quite violent, acting out against Hikers who come near their nests. They seem to be calmed by preening, with the feathers floating around them brushing each wing.

entry: POKENAME的精神力量，不只用来悬浮、战斗，也方便觅食。它最爱与同栖冰寒地区的宝可梦，一起堆雪人。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers not only to levitate or battle, but also to find food more easily. Its favorite pastime is building snowmen with other Pokémon that live in the icy regions alongside it.

entry: POKENAME的毛常遮眼，因此习惯闭着。它们能在恶劣暴雪玩，平静地吹泡泡、滚雪。
author: bigoljax
source: Due to their hair often covering their eyes, POKENAME keep them closed out of habit. They're able to play in harsh blizzards, peacefully blowing out bubbles and rolling in the snow.

entry: POKENAME守望珊瑚礁，被看见，就藏进珊瑚。谁污染，它便用精神力提起，吊在垃圾上方，直到对方捡净。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME watches over coral reefs, hiding within the coral if it is spotted. Should it catch someone polluting, it psychically lifts them from their location and dangles them above their trash until they pick it up.

entry: 这只宝可梦美得人类与宝可梦都惊叹，一见，便永难忘。它几乎只捕食飞行宝可梦。
author: notsaying.
source: The sight of this Pokémon is a memory that will last forever, as its beauty astounds people and Pokémon alike. It preys on flying Pokémon almost exclusively.

entry: POKENAME着迷于玩具卡车，常从玩具店偷。一被发现，就把车挡脸前，试着躲藏。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are fascinated with toy trucks and are often found stealing them from toy stores. If spotted, they try to hide by putting the truck in front of their face.

entry: POKENAME用气泡，引导小球飞鱼群找亲代。幼群受威胁，就用精神能力，把捕食者抛出水面。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME use their bubbles to help lead pods of Mantyke to their parents. When these pods are threatened, POKENAME use their psychic abilities to launch the predator out of the water.

entry: 有故事说，POKENAME只肯让心善的年轻训练家骑，再载其翱翔。拍翼，便能造强精神场，充当屏障。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to some stories, POKENAME will only allow itself to be ridden by young Trainers with good hearts, and then soars through the sky with them. By flapping its wings, it can create powerful psychic fields that it uses as barriers.

entry: 什么一惹POKENAME注意，它就追到咬在齿间。目标若将逃，它会不停呼叫附近宝可梦，恳请立即相助。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Once something has POKENAME's attention, they will pursue it until it's between their teeth. If their target is going to escape, POKENAME continually call to other nearby Pokémon and ask for their immediate aid.

entry: POKENAME嘴看似小，却能张大到几乎装半个西瓜。它造大泡，盛好几加仑岩浆，保热，直到扔向对手。
author: bigoljax
source: Though POKENAME mouths seem small, they can open them wide enough to nearly hold half a watermelon. They create large bubbles to contain gallons of magma, keeping them hot until they're dropped onto an opponent.

entry: POKENAME每次蜕皮，都会闪亮数天。传说，蜕皮作婚纱头纱，能赐新娘永久好运；可材料稀有极贵，几天却又褪光。
author: .izik
source: Each time POKENAME sheds its skin, it sparkles for days. Legends say a wedding veil made from this shimmering skin will bring the bride great luck for all eternity, though its rarity makes it very costly and it fades within days.

entry: POKENAME在海底和平玩耍，只听船过，才上浮。升起时，造出大气泡，有些甚至大如吼鲸王。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME peacefully play at the bottom of the sea, only coming up whenever they hear ships pass by. As they rise, they create large bubbles, some even growing to the size of Wailord.

entry: POKENAME爱悄跟顿甲群，淘气地模仿幼崽。可被看见，往往真让顿甲收养。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME love to quietly travel behind herds of Donphan, playfully mimicking one of their young. However, this often causes them to actually get adopted by a Donphan when spotted.

entry: POKENAME把精神能量弯在耳旁，扩大扇风面积，再拍耳降温。扇子若太大，气压就可能托起身体，让它悬浮。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME bends psychic energy around its ears to increase their surface area and flaps them to help cool itself down in the heat. If it makes the psychic fans too big, the air pressure may lift it off the ground and POKENAME will start levitating.

entry: POKENAME能模仿任何宝可梦的特征、行为，却有时加入自己的顽皮花样。它爱捣乱科技中心，把自己的脸贴满附近屏幕。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME can mimic the traits and actions of any Pokémon, though sometimes they add their own playful spin to them. They love to mess around with tech centers, plastering their faces on any screen nearby.

entry: POKENAME凭强大的超能力，造出真假难辨的幻象，仿佛连地貌也随之变化。因此，能遇见它的人，少之又少。
author: t.i.a.
source: With tremendous psychic power, POKENAME seemingly morph the very land with convincing illusions. Because of this, encountering one is extremely rare.

entry: POKENAME极害羞恐惧，会从角释放扭曲现实的精神波，避开人类。冬天冬眠，春来才醒。
author: fiordaliso
source: Since POKENAME is extremely shy and fearful, it avoids humans by emitting psychic waves from its horns that bend reality. In winter, it hibernates, waking again in spring.

entry: POKENAME用尾画画，色彩就会变成心中所想的样子。墙与建筑若忽然乱了颜色，很可能是它干的。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Whenever POKENAME paints using their tails, the colors transform into whatever POKENAME are thinking about. If walls and buildings are suddenly random colors, a POKENAME is likely to blame.

entry: POKENAME见谁，立刻就要打，哪怕对方大得多、强得多。不过，这只是它交朋友的方式。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME will immediately pick a fight with anyone it meets, even if its opponent is much bigger and stronger.  However, this is just its way of making friends.

entry: POKENAME能造巨泡，当平台旋转。它故意把尖端弄钝，免得不慎戳破泡，摔下去。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME can create massive bubbles, using them as platforms to spin on. They intentionally make their tips dull so they won't accidentally pop their bubbles and fall over.

entry: POKENAME亲热好奇，遇新面孔，就飘去轻吻。吻稍稍影响头脑，通常让对方微微发晕。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is an affectionate and curious sort, floating up to give a light kiss to anybody new it encounters. The kiss lightly affects the mind of the being kissed, usually resulting in a lightheaded sensation.

entry: POKENAME偶尔悬在游乐场上方，留心欺凌者。一发现，就从身体放雷，赶回家。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can rarely be seen hovering over playgrounds watching for bullies. If it spots one, it discharges lightning from its body to chase them home.

entry: POKENAME颈膜能变换，显出附近任何宝可梦的DNA。虽有利研究，可它难寻踪，科学家很难善用。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME's hood can change to visualize any nearby Pokémon's DNA. While this would be beneficial for scientists, POKENAME's elusive nature makes it hard to capitalize on.

entry: 体内有火，让POKENAME身体暖得舒服。它爱依偎训练家，还常吐无害亮火星，仿佛萤火虫，淘气地浮在四周。
author: ambrosia04
source: Because of their internal fire, POKENAME possess bodies that radiate a cozy warmth. They love to snuggle with Trainers, often exhaling harmless, glowing sparks that float playfully around them like fireflies.

entry: POKENAME的奶甜到，能让味觉迟钝数年。尽管会惹麻烦，许多美食家仍梦想，哪怕只尝一滴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's milk is so sweet that it can dull someone's sense of taste for years. Many food connoisseurs dream of tasting even a single drop despite the problems it can cause.

entry: POKENAME造的气泡，温度如孵化器，很适合照顾遗失的蛋。终于孵出，它们便高兴得跳来跳去。
author: bigoljax
source: The bubbles POKENAME produce have the same temperature as incubators, making them great caregivers for lost eggs. When an egg finally hatches, POKENAME celebrate by hopping around in joy.

entry: POKENAME在林中快如闪电，沿树烧出鲜明痕迹。近些年，登山男被经过的它电伤的事件，正慢慢增加。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME zip around forests at lightning speed, causing distinct marks to be burnt onto trees. Incidents of Hikers being shocked by a passing POKENAME have been slowly increasing throughout the years.

entry: 这些难觅宝可梦，快得常被比作闪电本身。少数目击者说，它能随意消失，但尚未证实。
author: infinex21
source: These elusive Pokémon move with such speed that they are oft compared to lightning itself. Those few who have ever witnessed them have said they can disappear at will, though this has yet to be confirmed.

entry: 据说POKENAME背后流出的烟，含着在它之前与之后，所有宝可梦的希望与梦想。
author: vapyr
source: It is said that the smoke flowing from POKENAME's back contains the hopes and dreams of every Pokémon that came before and after it.

entry: POKENAME跑过苔原，身后地面留下大冰球。研究者推测，是它的气泡，被低温瞬间冻实。
author: bigoljax
source: As POKENAME run across the tundra, they leave large frozen orbs on the ground behind them. Researchers hypothesize these are their bubbles that have instantly froze and solidified due to the cold temperatures.

entry: POKENAME爱吃洞内水晶，把能量存进蓝色胸石。虽然吃得重，它仍靠精神力量漂浮，爱破土出来，吓训练家。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME love eating crystals in caves, storing energy in their blue chest-gems. Despite their heavy diet, they use psychic power to float and love popping out of the dirt to surprise Trainers.

entry: POKENAME住地下水晶洞，吃水晶加固壳。若觉得甲还不够硬，扛不住捕食者，便变成更强宝可梦，或普通岩石，躲过发现。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME live in underground crystal caves, feeding on crystals to reinforce their shells. If they feel their armor is still too soft to withstand a predator, they transform into stronger Pokémon or mimic ordinary rocks to escape detection.

entry: POKENAME通常见于地下珍贵矿物旁，尤其紫水晶。矿工若想采它的水晶，就会暴怒。
author: fxncy_poland
source: POKENAME is typically seen underground near valuable minerals, specifically amethyst. If miners attempt to harvest their crystals, POKENAME becomes enraged.

entry: 双子岛周围若冒气泡，很可能POKENAME醒着玩。有时，玩闹还会在岛旁造成漩涡。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When bubbles form around the Seafoam Islands, POKENAME are likely awake and playing. Sometimes these playful acts lead to the creation of whirlpools around the islands.

entry: POKENAME形态多变，颊边元素囊，能储各种属性能量。战斗时，它似乎最依赖电与精神能量。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: Due to its polymorphic nature, POKENAME can store energy of all typings within the elemental sacs on its cheeks. When in combat, POKENAME seems to rely on electricity and psychic energy the most.

entry: POKENAME耀眼羽毛，曾传为万物生命起源。虽已证伪，羽在某些光角下会隐形，这份独特本领，仍让它需求很高。
author: secondunit
source: POKENAME's dazzling feathers were once rumored to have been the origin of all life. Despite this being proven false, their feathers are still in high demand for their unique ability to turn invisible in certain angles of light.

entry: POKENAME借时光旅行，观察一个人一生各年。若认定好，就送礼，可通常只是水果、花等寻常东西。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME watches a human throughout the years of their life with the aid of time travel. If it decides they are a good person, it brings them presents, though these tend to be mundane things like fruit or flowers.

entry: POKENAME各地蹦跳，找新的人与宝可梦玩。摇尾尖，会放出舒缓紧绷神经的精神波。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME bounces around the regions looking for new people and Pokémon to play with. Shaking the end of its tail emits a psychic wave that calms frazzled nerves.

entry: POKENAME喜爱树果，藏在果园里，等天黑便偷走。它们用超能力改变食物的基因，让树果变成不同种类，再吃下。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are fond of berries and can be found hiding within orchards, waiting for nightfall to steal the fruit away. They use their psychic powers to alter the genes of their food, transforming the berries into different species before eating them.

entry: POKENAME觉得，经双尾尖使用念力最轻松。因此，控制抓住物体的动作，远比双手更常用尾巴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME finds it easiest to utilize its telekinetic abilities through the tips of its two tails. As such, it uses them far more than its hands to direct the movements of whatever it has psychically seized.

entry: POKENAME用身上紫色部分，轻碰便能改变气泡。造出的粉泡能疗愈，紫泡却会使人中毒。
author: bigoljax
source: The purple highlights on POKENAME's body can be used to change their bubbles with just a gentle touch. The pink bubbles they summon can be used to heal others, while the purple ones can cause poisoning.

entry: POKENAME在花园模仿植物，当作游戏。谁碰它，就兴奋起来，以为加入了自创玩法。许多个体不久便瞬间消失，常吓着园丁。
author: .izik
source: As part of a game, POKENAME mimics plants in gardens. If someone makes contact with it, it grows excited since it believes it is part of its made-up game. Many teleport away shortly after, often startling gardeners.

entry: POKENAME寻找生日会，隐形看孩子嬉闹。被排除在外的孩子面前，它会现身，笨拙表演，努力逗笑。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME seek out birthday parties, invisibly observing the playful antics of children partaking in them. POKENAME reveal themselves to children that are being left out of the fun, putting on silly performances in an effort to get the child to laugh.

entry: POKENAME偶尔守在育婴室，留意哭闹宝宝。一发现，就用念力，轻轻摇回睡梦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can rarely be spotted watching over nurseries for crying babies. Should it notice one, it will use telekinesis to gently rock them back to sleep.

entry: POKENAME蓝颊兼储精神与电能。它们爱漂着逗训练家，以微弱静电，弄得头发全竖，再偷笑。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME store both psychic and electric energy in their blue cheeks. They love to float around and playfully shock Trainers, giggling as they use mild static to make their hair stand completely on end.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴抓够不着的水果与树果，却常因此摔倒。有个体曾整吞西瓜，只吐出少数没吞下的籽。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME use their tails to grab fruits and berries out of their reach, though they often fall over trying to. Some have been seen eating watermelons whole, spitting out the few seeds they haven't swallowed.

entry: POKENAME总拿着某种零食，或用精神力量，悬在身旁。它偏爱甜点，也曾与朋友分着吃。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are always seen with at least some kind of snack in their grasp or suspended nearby with psychic power. They are partial to sweet treats and some have been seen sharing pieces with friends.

entry: POKENAME有时陪小球飞鱼群玩，用气泡轻推。巨翅飞鱼曾误当自己的幼崽，带着同行。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are sometimes seen playing with pods of Mantyke, using bubbles to playfully push them around. Some Mantine have confused POKENAME with one of their young, bringing them along on their travels.

entry: POKENAME住偏远寒带，几只小群生活。它们合伙捉弄其他冰属性宝可梦，用精神力，让受害者脚下的冰突然裂开。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are found in remote arctic environments, living in groups of just a handful of individuals. They band together to play pranks on other Ice-type Pokémon, using their psychic powers to make the ice suddenly break apart under their victims.

entry: POKENAME发现城镇停电，就把尾贴电线杆，从身体供电。可若太久过度用力，身体便会爆炸。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME notices a power outage in a town, it will press its tail to an electric pole and supply power from its own body. Should it overexert itself for too long, its body will explode.

entry: POKENAME敏感的舌，能察觉周围数英里的空气气味颗粒，哪种惹兴趣，就追哪种。可沿途总被别的味分心，很少真到源头。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME has a sensitive tongue that detects scent particles in the air for miles around, and it follows any scent that catches its attention. However, it rarely reaches the source, becoming distracted by other scents along the way.

entry: POKENAME敏感的舌，能察觉周围数英里的空气气味颗粒，哪种惹兴趣，就追哪种。可沿途总被别的味分心，很少真到源头。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME has a sensitive tongue that detects scent particles in the air for miles around, and it follows any scent that catches its attention. However, it rarely reaches the source, becoming distracted by other scents along the way.

entry: POKENAME身体的肉层极厚，尖石与牙齿都无法刺穿。角上自带一层保护泡膜，让它们能挖穿岩石，而不用担心角受损。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's body has a very thick layer of flesh, able to stop sharp rocks and teeth from piercing into them. A protective bubble coating is ingrained into their horns, allowing them to dig through rock without the risk of damaging their horns.

entry: POKENAME尾巴不停产泡，每颗内的电压都不同。战斗中，它们反复大声欢呼，鼓舞自己，再攻击。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's tails constantly produce bubbles, each one having a different amount of voltage inside them. When in battle, they repeat loud, happy cheers to amp themselves up before attacking.

entry: POKENAME想保持平静，却常因最小的一点喜爱，就兴奋迸发。它们把礼物放泡中，记住每个善待自己的人与宝可梦。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME try to keep themselves calm, but often burst in excitement at even the smallest shows of affection. They remember each and every person and Pokémon who have shown them kindness by keeping their gifts in bubbles.

entry: POKENAME在雷暴嬉游，用尾接住正在形成的闪电。充电太多，便一气释放，在高空造出诡异的“精灵”闪光。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME cavort in thunderstorms, using their tail to catch lightning strikes as they're forming. POKENAME that become too heavily charged with electricity release it all at once, creating eerie-looking sprites high in the sky as they do so.

entry: POKENAME深埋沙、黏土与碎石。不休息，就找地下宝藏。对它来说，除食物外，几乎一切都是值得永久保留的宝物。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME bury themselves deep in sand, clay, and gravel. If they're not resting, they're searching for treasures buried beneath the surface. To POKENAME, just about anything short of food is a treasure they'll keep forever.

entry: POKENAME难寻踪，最可能见于热带丛林深处。双翼在空中造精神微光，遮住身影；探险者罕见找到，它便迅速消失。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are elusive Pokémon that are most likely to be found deep within tropical jungles. Their wings create psychic shimmers in the air that allow them to shield themselves from view, rapidly disappearing in the rare instances explorers find them.

entry: POKENAME的DNA，似乎包含每一种草属性宝可梦，特征与真植物诡异相像。身体虽是血肉，能量却只来自光合作用。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's DNA seems to be made up of every single Grass-type Pokémon, with traits and features eerily similar to actual plants. Though their bodies are made of flesh, they only get their energy from photosynthesis.

entry: 冬夜，POKENAME去雪中城镇，以精神力量造冰雕；夏日，则找人群，洒雪降温。
author: oddwalls
source: On winter nights, POKENAME travels to snowy towns and creates ice sculptures with its psychic powers; on summer days, POKENAME seeks out gatherings of people and showers them with snow to cool them down.

entry: POKENAME钳中毒，会使人极度头晕，持续数周。期间，许多受影响者声称，能瞥见可能的未来。
author: .izik
source: The venom held in POKENAME's pincers causes extreme dizziness that can last for weeks. During this time many who are affected claim to catch glimpses of possible futures.

entry: 入冬，POKENAME便因降温，离开藏身处。体形虽大，却十分爱玩，常在深雪蹦跳、打滚。
author: bigoljax
source: When the winter season begins, POKENAME come out of hiding due to the colder temperatures. Despite their large size, POKENAME are incredibly playful, often seen hopping and rolling around in deep snow.

entry: POKENAME能成功模仿接触过的任何程序。可维持形态，身体就定期往程序加入新错误，造成古怪故障，甚至清空硬盘。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can successfully mimic any program it comes into contact with. Its body periodically introduces new errors into the programming if it sustains the form, causing odd glitches that can wipe hard drives.

entry: POKENAME精神力巨大，能悬浮空中，在树间移动。叉尾能精准感知，常居森林的湿度。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can move from tree to tree by levitating in midair thanks to its immense psychic powers. Its forked tail can accurately sense the humidity in the forests where it usually lives.

entry: 起火，POKENAME便用精神力量，以粉泡裹植物，保护免受火焰。敏捷身手，也让它快速穿行常居丛林。
author: fiordaliso
source: If a fire breaks out, POKENAME uses its psychic powers to surround plants with pink bubbles, protecting them from the flames. It possesses impressive agility, which allows it to move quickly through the jungle where it usually lives.

entry: POKENAME爱用腕上刃叶，砍坏花园里的造型花木，淘气地捉弄不知情的园丁。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME like to use the blade-like leaves on their wrists to chop down topiary sculptures in gardens, pulling lighthearted pranks on unsuspecting gardeners.

entry: POKENAME开心好心情，就欢快地吐小火苗。为增进战斗本领，它变成其他宝可梦，学习最拿手的招式。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME cheerfully blows little flames from its mouth to show how happy and in a good mood it is. To improve its fighting skills, it takes on the appearance of other Pokémon to learn their best moves.

entry: POKENAME罕见地会飞快滚过台地与沙漠。旋转时，刺可能从难料的角度射出，可它能控制方向与速度。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME can be rarely seen speedily rolling across mesas and deserts. As POKENAME spins, their spines may shoot out at unpredictable angles. POKENAME can control where these spines fly and how fast they go.

entry: POKENAME的武艺，仿佛一门混乱的艺术。它轻松在空中流转，以闪电快击与杂技，展现无瑕控制与精准，让对手猜不透下一步。
author: pkbonusducks
