source: POKENAME's martial form can only be described as a chaotic art. They effortlessly flow through the air with lightning-fast strikes and acrobatics with immaculate control and precision. POKENAME's opponents struggle to predict what they'll do next.

entry: POKENAME把长尾浸水洼，就能读碰过同水的任何人的心。随后，瞬间移往感知中最难过的人，陪玩一阵，再离开。
author: .izik
source: By dipping its long tail into a puddle, POKENAME can read the mind of anyone who has touched the same water. It then teleports to the saddest person it senses to play with them for a while before moving on.

entry: POKENAME精神力强，随心就能改肌肉构造。若需力量或速度，深深集中，便让手臂与双腿胀至三倍。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME's psychic prowess is powerful enough to change their muscle structure on a whim. If they need to be strong or swift, POKENAME deeply concentrate to amplify their arms and legs to triple in size.

entry: POKENAME逗留海滩，藏在水下洞，直到察觉上方风暴经过。它便出来乘浪，欢快地在风暴潮里戏水。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME linger around beaches, hiding in underwater caves until they sense a storm passing by in the water above. They emerge to ride the waves to shore, splashing about in the storm surges with glee.

entry: POKENAME能感知人的心性，只会向真心想见自己、心中意图纯洁的人显形。其他任何人在场时，它都会保持隐形。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME can sense people's dispositions and will only let itself be visible to those with a genuine desire to see it and pure intentions in their hearts. It remains invisible in the presence of anybody else.

entry: POKENAME极聪明，爱学新招，也是战术高手。训练家能放心请它，协助指挥队伍中的其他宝可梦。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME is highly intelligent and enjoys learning new moves. It is also a skilled tactician and can be trusted to help its Trainer direct the other Pokémon in their party.

entry: POKENAME在美的舞台上，名气很响。许多华丽大赛的明星，都曾从它身上取得灵感。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME is very famous in the beauty scene. Many Contest superstars were inspired by this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME超能力强大，能用意念移动物品。不过性情害羞，难得被人看见。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME possesses a powerful psychic prowess that allows it to manipulate objects with its mind. It has a shy nature, so sightings are rare.

entry: 据说，POKENAME会向心纯、求助的人现身。遇冲突，它能感知谁无辜，冲去保护。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME is said to appear to those with a pure heart who wish for aid. When POKENAME comes across a conflict, it can sense who is innocent and will rush to their defense.

entry: POKENAME向任何感兴趣的东西飘去，除甩尾外身体静止。它尤其被玩耍的孩子吸引，人们却常因它的出现而不安，转身离开。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME drift through the air toward anything that catches their attention, their bodies remaining still save for the swishing of their tail. They are particularly drawn to children playing, but their unnerving presence often drives people away.

entry: POKENAME身刺分泌强粉毒，造成严重偏头痛。期间，受影响者会鲜明看见，所爱之人的过去。
author: .izik
source: The spikes on POKENAME's body secrete a powerful pink venom that causes intense migraines. During this period, the affected person experiences vivid visions of a loved one's past.

entry: POKENAME能模仿建筑材料外观，多用木与钢作伪装。需要完全隐蔽时，有时还用自己的泡，让身体透明。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are able to mimic the appearance of building materials, using wood and steel as their main disguise. They sometimes use their own bubbles to make themselves clear when needing to stay completely hidden.

entry: POKENAME水晶眼，能看数英里，精神力加持下，几乎看穿任何东西。它主要用来找想玩的玩具。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's crystal eye can see for miles and is enhanced by psychic power to see through almost anything. It primarily uses this ability to locate toys it wants to play with.

entry: POKENAME拔起树木，用超能力平整土地，为人和宝可梦造游乐区。它却不加入，只要远远看着就很快乐。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME creates play areas for other Pokémon and humans by uprooting trees and using psychic abilities to smooth the land. Rather than joining in, it finds joy simply in watching from afar.

entry: 古人相信，POKENAME体内，存着每种现存宝可梦各一个灵魂。虽无科学证据，可盘旋蓝珠究竟是什么，仍大半不明。
author: soup1900
source: Long ago, people in the past believed POKENAME contained a soul for every Pokémon in existence. While this claim has no scientific proof, it's largely unknown what the swirling blue orbs are.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME体内每个蓝点，代表不同时期的遗传代码。有研究者声称，凝望旋涡，见到了所有宝可梦共同祖先的代码。
author: bigoljax
source: It is believed that each blue dot in POKENAME's form represents a genetic code from different periods of time. Some researchers have claimed that gazing into the vortex has let them see the genetic code for the common ancestor of all Pokémon.

entry: 据说POKENAME早于现代生命，存有每种宝可梦的DNA，与各物种一缕亡魂，以石与灵魂相缚。
author: lesbian_garlicbread
source: POKENAME is said to predate modern life. It holds the DNA of every Pokémon and a single departed spirit from each species, bound together in stone and spirit.

entry: POKENAME精神与波导感知极敏锐，几乎能完美预测对手每招。它爱和平，把战斗当游戏，宁躲避、耗尽敌人，也不还击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's mental and aura senses are so heightened that it can almost perfectly predict its foe's every move. It is pacifistic and treats battles as something like a game, preferring to dodge and exhaust its foes rather than striking back.

entry: POKENAME把咬遍眼前物品当作游戏。它不走过去，而是用念力从极远处将东西拖到嘴边。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes a game of biting any object it sees. Rather than walking to them, it telekinetically drags items to its mouth from great distances.

entry: POKENAME战斗中，用念力推着自己移动，躲攻击，以利爪反击。偶尔命中后，还会先停战，确认对手无碍，再继续。
author: .izik
source: During battle, POKENAME pushes itself around the field with telekinesis, dodging attacks and countering with its sharp claws. On rare occasions it will pause a fight after landing a hit to check that the opponent is all right before resuming.

entry: 为了让爪子保持锋利，POKENAME会定期将爪子互相磨刮。刮落的碎屑，深受民间医者追捧，他们相信，这些碎屑能治愈任何疾病。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: To keep their claws sharp, POKENAME regularly scrape them against each other. The flakes that come off of POKENAME's claws are sought after by practitioners of folk medicine, who believe that the flakes will cure any sickness.

entry: POKENAME一展翼，水中飞窜的速度，可比隧道式快艇。高速让水上冒出巨泡，直到升上天空才破。
author: bigoljax
source: As they extend their wings, POKENAME can zip through the water at speeds comparable to tunnel boats. These high speeds cause massive bubbles to form on the water, only popping when they reach the sky.

entry: POKENAME住丛林深处，湿度恰好，让背部美花盛开。它用精神力量，轻松浮起枝叶，逗幼崽玩。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lives deep in the jungle, where the humidity is perfect for keeping the beautiful flower on its back in full bloom. It uses its psychic powers to entertain its cubs, effortlessly making branches and leaves float.

entry: POKENAME周身透明毒液，会造成严重疮疖，数周才消。持续期间，许多人声称，能感到附近每个人的情绪。
author: .izik
source: The transparent venom covering POKENAME's body causes terrible boils that take weeks to fade. While they persist, many claim to feel the emotions of anyone nearby.

entry: POKENAME平常吃树果，找到肉，却也常吃。餐后，分开的双颚会吐大泡，闻着据说像刚吃的饭。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's usual diet consists of berries, though they do often eat meat whenever they find any. When done eating, their separate jaws spit out large bubbles, which are described as smelling like their recent meals.

entry: 偶尔能见POKENAME在漩涡间跳，乘旋流，仿佛旋转木马。若发现宝可梦玩得不开心，就用念力抛出去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can rarely be spotted leaping between whirlpools, riding their spin like a carousel. If it notices a Pokémon not enjoying one, it will fling them out with telekinesis.

entry: POKENAME头顶大蓝鳞，满是极不稳定的精神能量。一次意念头锤，就能把火车车厢打飞50英尺。
author: pkbonusducks
source: The large azure scales atop POKENAME's head are full of highly unstable psychic energy. A single Zen Headbutt is capable of sending a railcar flying 50 feet away.

entry: 野生POKENAME明明学了许多更合适的招式，却爱反复用意念头锤，蛮力解决问题。撞不穿，就失望隐形，逃走。
author: soup1900
source: Wild POKENAME like to brute-force problems by using Zen Headbutt repeatedly despite learning a large variety of other moves that would better solve the scenario. If they cannot smash through, they turn invisible and run away in disappointment.

entry: POKENAME大部分精神力量，存在大头的蓝钢中。可经尾少量引导，也能在头遭够强冲击后，一次全放。
author: pkbonusducks
source: The bulk of POKENAME's psychic force is carried within the blue steel on their large heads. The energy can either be channeled in small amounts through their tail or released all at once after a strong enough impact courses through their head.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME能与附近任何宝可梦，精神共鸣、安抚催睡，好让自己也不受争斗噪声，平静入眠。
author: sk372
source: It's thought that POKENAME can psychically resonate with any nearby Pokémon and pacify them, putting them to sleep so that it can also peacefully slumber without the noise of conflict.

entry: POKENAME毛虽薄，性质却能随意变化，匹配别的宝可梦皮肤。无论条件如何，它都能借此，保护别人免遭各种攻击与险境。
author: soup1900
source: While POKENAME's fur is thin, its properties can transform at will to match the skin of any other Pokémon. This allows it to protect others from any kind of attack or situation, no matter the conditions.

entry: POKENAME预知灾难将至，以心灵感应控制遇险者，帮助逃生。但有些获救者，仍谴责强夺控制，即使本意是救命。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's precognitive ability alerts it to incoming disasters. It uses telepathy to control the minds of those in danger to help them flee, though some of those rescued decry it for forcibly seizing control of them, even if it was to save them.

entry: POKENAME在墓园间瞬移，找悲痛的人，想陪玩、逗开心。被拒，它就烦躁，把人瞬间移出墓地，自认事情已办完。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME teleports between graveyards watching for humans in deep distress. It tries to cheer them up by playing with them, but if they refuse it grows frustrated and teleports them out of the graveyard, considering its job done.

entry: POKENAME尾碰别的宝可梦，身上蓝色部分，就变得像对方DNA的形状。它们也帮助迷途登山者，找到森林出口。
author: bigoljax
source: Whenever POKENAME's tail touches another Pokémon, the blue accents on their body shift to mimic the appearance of that Pokémon's DNA. They help hikers find the path out of forests they're lost in.

entry: POKENAME虽看着巨大，多数却是水。它能从嘴放水，再吸干池塘，补回储水。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: Though POKENAME may look really big, it is mostly water. POKENAME can release the water from its mouth and can drain ponds to refill its water.

entry: 小村曾将POKENAME视为童年与玩耍之神。休息时，它把自己裹进浮泡，安然漂流。
author: .izik
source: Small villages once viewed POKENAME as a god of childhood and play. When resting, it encases itself in a floating bubble and drifts peacefully.

entry: POKENAME住丛林深处的翠绿林丛，植物种类多得惊人。一旦移走，植物多样性就会流失，暗示它将此处当花园照料。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live deep within jungles, in verdant groves teeming with an astonishing variety of plants. The groves invariably lose their diversity of plant life whenever POKENAME are removed from the environment, suggesting they maintain them as gardens.

entry: POKENAME爱把不知情训练家与宝可梦，困进背部气泡。里面虽舒适，却得等它肯放，才能出来。
author: elibromax314
source: POKENAME loves to trap unsuspecting Trainers and Pokémon within the bubbles on its back. The bubbles provide a comfortable space, but those within are stuck there until POKENAME lets them out.

entry: POKENAME让宝可梦爬进浴盆，一边洗澡，一边穿过密林。洗过的对象，常被气泡暂时染粉。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME let Pokémon climb into their tubs, letting them bathe while POKENAME travel through thick forests. Their bubbles often leave Pokémon who have cleaned themselves with a pink tint for a brief moment.

entry: POKENAME淘气地在树间弹跳，惊扰栖息鸟宝可梦。准备进化时，尾巴会温热起来。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME bounces playfully through the trees, startling roosting bird Pokémon. Its tail warms up when it gets ready to evolve.

entry: POKENAME身刺能注极强乳白毒，造成剧烈恶心。期间，许多受害者报告，曾短暂浮空、旋转。
author: .izik
source: The spines on POKENAME's body can inject an incredibly strong milky venom that causes intense nausea. During this time, many report brief periods of levitation and spinning.

entry: POKENAME总想精进武术，训练时深深冥想，常还挂在树枝上。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME always endeavors to improve its martial arts. It meditates deeply as part of its training, often while hanging from a tree branch.

entry: POKENAME头上流出的泡滚烫，有些甚至能烫伤敌人。它虽爱战，顽皮性子却让它更想陪别人玩。
author: bigoljax
source: The bubbles flowing out of POKENAME's head are scalding hot, some even causing burns to foes. Though they love to fight, their playful nature makes them want to play with others instead.

entry: POKENAME从不停学新武术与格斗风格，爱在瀑布旁等平静自然处训练。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME never stops learning new martial arts and fighting styles. It loves training in tranquil places in nature, such as near waterfalls.

entry: POKENAME偶尔与海豹球、海魔狮沿浮冰比赛。它却爱作弊，常用尾巴推进，加速取胜。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME occasionally race Spheal and Sealeo along ice floes. POKENAME are prone to cheating, often using their tail to propel themselves faster to win their race.

entry: POKENAME虽常藏着，却不会因高傲，就不向别人打招呼。它爱把石头，送给喜欢的宝可梦。
author: bigoljax
source: Though they often keep themselves hidden, POKENAME don't let their pride stop them from greeting others. They love to gift rocks to Pokémon they've grown a liking to.

entry: POKENAME在风暴中飞巡港口，寻找码头附近的沉船。一找到，便瞬间移上岸，却常造成超出预期的损坏。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies around harbors during storms searching for boats sinking near docks. Should it find one, it teleports the vessel to land, often causing more damage than it intended.

entry: POKENAME用尾当扫帚，扫走灰尘，保护敏感鼻子。浮空时，若一连打喷嚏，就会不停旋转，直到停下。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME use their tails as brooms, helping brush away any dust to protect their sensitive noses. When they get into sneezing fits while floating, they constantly spin around until the fit is done.

entry: POKENAME用长尾作临时鞭，先舞出精巧图案，再抽对手。鼻子极敏感，尾巴带回灰，便常打喷嚏不止。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME use their long tails as makeshift whips, making intricate patterns before whipping their opponents. Their noses are incredibly sensitive, often getting into sneezing fits when their tails bring back dust.

entry: 这只武器般的宝可梦，能运用超能力变形。它想学遍所有招式，成为最强的存在。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A psychic, shapeshifting weapon, this Pokémon aspires to become the strongest by learning every move.

entry: POKENAME所持双刃，尖端用细精神能量丝，延伸攻击范围。战斗流畅，仿佛由老练的刀舞者挥动。
author: .izik
source: The blades POKENAME wields extend their reach with thin strands of psychic energy at their tips. Their movements in combat flow as though wielded by an accomplished blade dancer.

entry: 关都古壁画，将POKENAME描成坚定的宝可梦守护者。它用分节尾，痛斩对手，再以精神强念轰击。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Ancient Kantonian murals describe POKENAME as a steadfast protector of Pokémon. Using their segmented tail, POKENAME can inflict painful slashing attacks on opponents before blasting them with Psychic.

entry: POKENAME透明的汗，有剧毒，造成痛疹，数月才清。出疹期间，有人报告，获得了轻微念力。
author: .izik
source: The transparent sweat from POKENAME's body is highly poisonous, causing painful rashes that can take months to clear. During these rashes, some report gaining mild telekinetic abilities.

entry: POKENAME能随意彻底改变角的材质。频繁滥用，却会使角变脆，最后可能完全碎裂。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME can completely change the material composition of their horn at will. Frequent abuse of this will make the horn more brittle and may eventually cause it to shatter entirely.

entry: POKENAME着迷于击剑等人类持剑比赛，远远观看。一见好对局，就会兴奋，发精神波，让身旁也同样开心。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is enthralled by humans in sword-based competitions like fencing and watches from afar. If it sees a good match, it can grow excited and send out psychic waves that make those nearby just as happy.

entry: POKENAME是安静迅捷的猎手，视力几乎看穿一切，猎物无从逃离。为稳稳捕到，它从尾部，放精准雷电。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are quiet and quick predators with eyesight that allows them to see through almost anything, so no prey can escape them. To better secure their prey, they unleash precise lightning bolts from their tails.

entry: POKENAME主动在沙暴中玩，任风载着飞。它巡沙漠找风暴，一停，就立刻消失。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME actively plays in sandstorms, letting the wind carry it through the sky. It patrols deserts in search of storms to play in, vanishing the moment one stops.

entry: POKENAME极少被发现，每次目击，都在纯净水域旁。稀罕到许多人猜，所有目击，可能都是同一只。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have been rarely discovered, and each time one has been sighted, it has been near a pristine body of water. The rarity of sighting a POKENAME is considered so high that many speculate existing sightings have been of the same individual.

entry: POKENAME虽然外表更加可爱，性情却依旧极为凶猛。小小的爪子锋利无比，连最坚韧的皮肤也能划出深深的伤口，不过必须贴近对方才能使出。
author: bigoljax
source: Though their appearance is more cutesy, POKENAME are still incredibly fierce Pokémon. Their small claws are sharp enough to create deep cuts in even the toughest skin, though they need to be up close to use them.

entry: POKENAME停靠港口码头，给猫宝可梦提供歇脚处。训练家靠近，就尽快驶离。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME park along port docks, providing respite for feline Pokémon. When Trainers get near, POKENAME drive away as fast as they can.

entry: POKENAME藏在其他宝可梦群中，逮机会，用幻象夺首领之位。再借骗术，带新群体玩简单游戏，享受有玩伴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hide themselves amongst packs of other Pokémon, using their illusory powers to usurp the leader whenever they can. They use their deception to lead their newfound pack into simple games, enjoying having playmates.

entry: 它只在心地纯净的人面前现身，性情十分爱玩，似乎并不明白，自己的力量究竟有多强。
author: melodydelune
source: Appearing only to those of pure heart, it is a very playful Pokémon. It does not seem to grasp its level of power.

entry: POKENAME双手造粉泡，破裂会放出足以毁楼的精神能量。它也能用尾吸能，安全移除，不让爆开。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME creates pink bubbles from its hands that, when popped, release a surge of psychic energy that can wipe out buildings. POKENAME can safely remove these bubbles without bursting them by absorbing the energies with its tail.

entry: POKENAME天生是领袖，散出力量与威仪，最开心的事，就是征服别人。一颗毒泡，连最顽强的宝可梦，也能压得跪下。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME are leaders by nature, radiating power and authority. Nothing brings them greater joy than to subjugate others. A single one of their toxic bubbles can bring even the most resilient of Pokémon to their knees.

entry: POKENAME虽大，却证实极难寻踪。不过，研究者已开始缩小常居地范围。许多理论与故事说，它可能是所有水生宝可梦的始祖。
author: infinex21
source: Despite how large POKENAME is, it has proven to be rather elusive. However, researchers have begun to narrow down its usual habitats. There are many theories and stories that claim POKENAME may be the progenitor of all aquatic Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME细胞，存着世界每片陆地的信息。只需强手一捏泥土，就能造出任何矿物。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME's cells store the information about every landmass in the world. It can create any mineral by just pressing some soil between its powerful hands.

entry: POKENAME格外难觅，通常只见于大气高处，极少返地。基因构造适应力极强，能模仿任何宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are extraordinarily elusive Pokémon, typically only found high up in the atmosphere and very rarely returning to the ground. Their genetic structure is remarkably adaptable, allowing them to mimic any other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME爱用时光咆哮，看植物迅速枯萎、开花。身体虽大，咆哮却只是一声轻喵。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME enjoys using Roar of Time to see plants rapidly wilt and bloom. Despite having a large body, its Roar of Time only comes out as a quiet mewl.

entry: POKENAME很少被人类见到，有人推测，它始终随心穿时。也有人相信，过去与未来，每个新物种诞生、发现时，它都会在场。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is rarely seen by humans, and theorized to be constantly dipping through time at its own whims. Some believe it makes itself present for the birth and discovery of every new Pokémon species, past and future.

entry: POKENAME会随机将人掳进独立小空间，先陪玩，再送回家。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME have been known to randomly abduct people into a pocket of space. In this pocket, POKENAME plays with the abducted people before returning them home.

entry: 负面情绪升起，POKENAME就把它们，逼成黑泡排出。谁碰到，都会被其中负面情绪淹没。
author: bigoljax
source: When their negative emotions start to rise, POKENAME force them out as black-tinted bubbles. Those who come into contact with these bubbles become overwhelmed by the negative emotion contained within.

entry: POKENAME身上有奇怪刻纹与图像。科学家研究多年，相信藏着起源线索。
author: bostroms
source: Strange engravings and images adorn POKENAME's body.  Scientists have studied them for many years, believing they hold a clue to this Pokémon's origins.

entry: POKENAME强迫孩子睡觉，想在梦里陪玩。可孩子们全做噩梦，它又难过，怎么谁都不开心。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME forces children to sleep so it can play with them in their dreams. These children all end up having nightmares, causing POKENAME to become upset that they aren't having any fun.

entry: 达克莱伊与梦幻融合，让梦幻不稳的DNA，伴着黑暗能量暴走，形成达克莱伊状的外壳。如今，它兼掌精神与噩梦力量，将噩梦具现。
author: infinex21
source: The fusion between a Darkrai and a Mew caused the unstable DNA within the Mew to go rampant with dark energies and form an outer shell in the shape of a Darkrai. It now wields psychic energy and nightmarish power to manifest nightmares.

entry: POKENAME攻击时，将全部能量注入巨炮，大幅增强威力。紫色金属部分，又是旅行时能睡的移动家园。
author: soup1900
source: When attacking, POKENAME pours all its energy into the large cannon to significantly amplify the move's power and strength. The purple metal section of POKENAME gives it a mobile home to sleep in when it travels around.

entry: 据说，POKENAME天生明白过去与未来，一切生命的真正本性。心怀不诚者在场，红蓝火焰就沿尾，点燃末端符号。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to intrinsically understand the true nature of every being that was or ever will be. Flames of blue and red will travel along its tail and ignite the symbol at the end, should it be in the presence of those with dishonest hearts.

entry: 满月夜，POKENAME精神焕发，用瞬间移动长途旅行，寻找需要帮助的宝可梦，以精神能力安抚。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME becomes invigorated during nights of the full moon. It travels great distances through teleportation, searching for Pokémon to help with its psychic calming abilities.

entry: POKENAME的精神冲动，能在尾中搅起巨量电力。射出的闪电，夹着心中意念，影响被击者的思想。
author: sk372
source: Massive amounts of electricity can be churned up in POKENAME's tail, fueled by its psychic impulses. The bolts launched are laced with its mental urges, affecting the minds of anyone struck by them.

entry: POKENAME的DNA有所有宝可梦遗传代码。可细胞结构太不稳，它只好冻结部分身体，防止自己散开。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME's DNA contains the genetic code of all Pokémon. However, its cellular structure is so unstable that it freezes parts of its body to keep itself from unraveling.

entry: “总有一天，未知力量会把所有人冻在一起，成为单一生物。”这句著名科幻作家的话，虽早于POKENAME存在记录，阴谋论者却信，它有这本领。
author: bobosmith01
source: "One day, an unknown force will freeze everyone together to become one single organism." Although this quote from a famous science fiction novelist predates the recorded existence of POKENAME, conspiracy theorists believe POKENAME has this ability.

entry: POKENAME藏花店，让人误抓。它不停找完美花朵，加入收藏。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME hides in flower stores, leading to people mistakenly grabbing POKENAME. POKENAME constantly searches for perfect flowers to add to its collection.

entry: POKENAME在山里安家，整天慢慢绕峰飘。看见受困登山男或背包客，就飘下，用脚抓住，安全送下山。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME make their homes in the mountains, allowing them to spend their days slowly floating around the peaks. If POKENAME spots a trapped Hiker or Backpacker, they drift down, grab them with their feet, and deliver them safely down the mountain.

entry: POKENAME长触角充当额外感官，帮助安全察知潜在威胁。它们淘气地高高弹起，身子旋转，再落地。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's long antennae work as extra sensors, helping them safely detect possible threats. They playfully bounce high into the air, swirling their bodies around before landing.

entry: POKENAME在空中旋转，与其他飞行宝可梦玩。头孢子散落地面，几分钟内，就长出高耸蘑菇。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins and swirls in the sky to play with other flying Pokémon. During this time, spores from its head scatter to the ground below, causing towering mushrooms to grow within minutes.

entry: POKENAME瞬间移进住家，陪孩子玩。孩子长大、离开，它就换一户，重新来过。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME teleport themselves into houses to play with children. When that child grows up and moves on, POKENAME warp to a different house to begin the cycle anew.

entry: POKENAME按闪电般曲折轨迹疾行，被发现，却比雷电更快。因此，有人信它能瞬间移动，可观察到的，始终只是非凡速度。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME dart about in lightning-bolt patterns, though they move quicker than lightning if spotted. This has led some to believe they can teleport, though they have only been observed moving extraordinarily quickly.

entry: 这奇怪宝可梦，形似宝可梦图鉴，据说存着每种宝可梦的记录，连尚未发现的也有。可即使有幸靠近，也无人取得资料。
author: infinex21
source: This odd Pokémon resembles a Pokédex and, supposedly, it contains records of every Pokémon, even those that may not have been discovered yet. None have been able to access this information, even if they have ever been lucky enough to get near it.

entry: POKENAME靠精神力量，始终聚住周身富含化学物质的液体。它常偷实验室玻璃容器当床，好让头脑休息。
author: bigoljax
source: The chemical-filled fluids surrounding POKENAME's body are constantly being held together by their psychic powers. They often steal glass containment tanks from labs, using them as beds so they can give their minds some rest.

entry: 传说，古时一只POKENAME从月亮降下，教人类与宝可梦合作。虽慈爱、会照顾人，它们却极稀有难觅，有人连存在也怀疑。
author: t3isukone
source: Legends say that in ancient times, a POKENAME came down from the moon to show humans and Pokémon the way to work together. While kind and nurturing, POKENAME are extremely rare and elusive, with some doubting they even exist.

entry: 满月夜，POKENAME用念力，把皮皮与皮宝宝，带上天空。它想让伙伴，完整看见月亮真正的美。
author: bigoljax
source: During nights with a full moon, POKENAME use telekinesis to bring Clefairy and Cleffa up into the sky with them. They do this so others can fully see the true beauty of the moon.

entry: POKENAME是顶级淘气鬼，谁还没反应，就能快速布好数十种机关陷阱。棉毛长太大，便把多余部分变粉泡，脱落。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are known to be top-class pranksters, being able to set dozens of a variety of tricks and traps quickly before most beings can react. When their cotton hairs get too big, they shed the excess by transforming the fluff into pink bubbles.

entry: POKENAME每条精神肢体，末端都有释放强念力的珠。墓穴状身体里，据信藏着不可思议之物，可它不准打开看。
author: sk372
source: Each of POKENAME's psychic limbs ends in an orb that emits powerful telekinetic energy. It's believed something incredible lies within its tomb-like body, but POKENAME refuses to let anyone open it to see.

entry: POKENAME在肢端覆水，便能造带电气泡，给电电虫。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME coat the ends of their limbs with water, which allows them to make electrically charged bubbles for Joltik.

entry: POKENAME长藤触及人类，就能控制心智。通常只叫对方备一顿好饭，吃完立刻走。
author: .izik
source: The long vines extending from POKENAME's body can control the minds of humans they touch. It typically uses this to have them prepare it a tasty meal before leaving the moment it finishes eating.

entry: POKENAME将头上的火焰塑成其他宝可梦的幻象，引来训练家。它一边偷偷吸走受害者的生命力，一边窃笑、装可爱，让目标毫无疑心。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME can shape their head-flames into illusions of other Pokémon to lure in Trainers. They quietly siphon away their victim's life force, all while giggling and acting cute so the target doesn't suspect a thing.

entry: POKENAME据说引魂来世，因此墓园常放雕像。有些将死者说，临终前曾见它，常提及相随的暖意。
author: beetlething
source: Statues of POKENAME are placed in graveyards, as POKENAME are said to guide souls to the afterlife. Some who are close to death describe seeing POKENAME right before they pass on, frequently describing the warmth it brings along with it.

entry: POKENAME飞过墓园，留给逝者的蜡烛，就会立刻燃蓝焰。虽无恶意，许多人却视为凶兆。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME flies over graveyards, any candles left out for the deceased instantly light with a blue flame. Though no ill intent is behind it, many regard this as a bad omen.

entry: POKENAME好斗，却也爱玩。它攻击进入领地的任何对象，战中塑刃，出其不意。若觉训练家友善，就会放过，改玩游戏。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME are aggressive yet playful by nature. They attack anyone who enters their territory, shaping their blades during battle to surprise opponents. If they sense a Trainer is friendly, they spare them and try to play games instead.

entry: 冬季，POKENAME会依偎训练家，以总是微暖的身体保暖。只要足够集中，它能复制遇见过的任何宝可梦招式。
author: fiordaliso
source: During the winter months, POKENAME snuggles up to its Trainer to keep them warm, thanks to its body, which is always slightly warm. If it concentrates hard enough, it can replicate the moves of any Pokémon it encounters.

entry: POKENAME在家园海湾造泡，整天看它上升，再戳破。别人若先戳，它就用内脏出拳打人。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME make bubbles by the coves they call home, spending their days popping them as they rise up. If someone pops one of POKENAME's bubbles, they punch the person with their innards.

entry: POKENAME慢慢转身，环便大声叮当。有些人甚至觉得，响声诡异地像不同宝可梦的叫声。
author: bigoljax
source: When POKENAME slowly shift their bodies around, their rings start to make loud jingling noises. Some people have even heard the jingling being eerily similar to the cries of different Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME总找亮蓝物件，做自己的第二只蓝眼。东西一掉，它就明显难过得萎靡。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are always on the search for shiny blue objects to turn into their second blue eye. If the object falls off, POKENAME visibly wilt in sadness.

entry: POKENAME双翼由融化DNA构成，多次检测表明，样本却不属自身。身体往往极脆，因此胸部覆着保护泡膜。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's wings are made out of melted DNA, with several tests showing samples not being their own DNA. Their thorax is covered by a protective bubble coating, as they're often incredibly fragile.

entry: POKENAME尾巴极敏感，有助集中、释放精神波，感知周围。这弥补了差视力，什么地形，也能轻松辨路。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tail is incredibly sensitive and helps it focus and release psychic waves that allow it to sense the surrounding world. This makes up for its poor eyesight, allowing it to navigate any terrain with ease.

entry: POKENAME忙眼前任务时，手臂两侧的眼，便负责侦察。它用意念，将脱落鳞片，塑成常像其他宝可梦的小饰物。
author: bigoljax
source: The eyes on each side of POKENAME's arms are used as scouts while POKENAME is busy with their current task. They use their minds to mold their fallen scales into small trinkets, often shaped like other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME精神能力精湛，能随意彻底隐形，也用本领，让整个家园不被肉眼察觉。
author: secondunit
source: POKENAME are talented psychics, capable of turning entirely invisible at will. They use this skill to keep their homes entirely imperceivable to the naked eye.

entry: POKENAME心灵感应极高，远隔数英里、看不见，也能交谈。广博的基因组，让它天生理解其他心灵。
author: secondunit
source: POKENAME are highly skilled telepaths, capable of holding conversations out of sight from miles away. The breadth of their genome provides them with an innate understanding of the minds of others.

entry: POKENAME虽温柔，却不容残酷待人。它会造出数条额外的精神能量尾，目标一看，就遭多重精神折磨。
author: sk372
source: Although gentle by nature, POKENAME does not abide by cruelty to others. In response, it creates several additional tails of psychic energy that, upon being seen, inflict a myriad of mental afflictions on its target.

entry: POKENAME水晶核心，含每种已知宝可梦的DNA。遗传学家推测，凭广大的DNA操纵本领，它能将接触的宝可梦，变成任何其他形态。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's crystal core contains the DNA of every known Pokémon. Geneticists theorize that it can transform any Pokémon it touches into any other form, using its vast DNA manipulation skill.

entry: 传说，亲自接触超过1000种不同宝可梦的人，曾能向POKENAME求一个心愿。可近年，基因之楔普及，它似乎不再许愿。
author: soup1900
source: According to legend, POKENAME used to grant a wish to those who have physically come in contact with over 1000 unique Pokémon species. However, in recent years, their wish-granting has seemingly ceased after DNA Splicers became commonplace.

entry: POKENAME在游乐场挖巨大隧道，把从当地孩子偷的玩具，藏在里面。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs massive tunnels in playgrounds. Within these tunnels, it hides toys stolen from local children.

entry: POKENAME远隔许多米，也能感知人的波导，只向认定纯洁正义者现身。它把树果裹进精神粉泡，轻松带回巢。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can sense people's auras even from many meters away, revealing itself only to those it deems pure and righteous. It encases berries in psychic pink bubbles to carry them effortlessly back to its lair.

entry: 不玩时，POKENAME更愿躺着。它造大泡，先弹跳玩，再在上面，睡完余下一天。
author: bostroms
source: When POKENAME is not playing, it prefers to lounge about. It creates large bubbles to bounce around on, then spends the rest of the day sleeping on top of them.

entry: POKENAME兴奋得热血沸腾，双手就会放泡。泡让它平静，直到许久之后，终于破裂。
author: bigoljax
source: When POKENAME's blood starts to boil due to their excitement, they release bubbles from their hands. These bubbles keep them calm until they eventually pop after a long period of time.

entry: POKENAME群快速如笑的声呐叫声，数英里外都能探知。它们用精神力量察觉船近，若以为人在找，就疾潜深处躲藏。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Pods of POKENAME can be detected from many miles away by their rapid, laughter-like sonar calls. They use their psychic powers to detect approaching ships and dart deep underwater to hide if they think people are trying to find them.

entry: POKENAME虽难觅，却极爱玩，稍惹兴趣的东西，也会追。每次目击，常伴一阵粉色闪光。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite being very elusive, POKENAME are very playful and will chase anything that even somewhat interested it. Sightings of POKENAME have been accompanied by a flurry of pink sparkles.

entry: POKENAME孩子般爱玩，常忽略训练家指令。鬃毛若冒奇怪粉火花，就表示毁灭性的攻势将至。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's childish and playful nature often causes it to ignore the commands of its Trainer. When its mane emits strange pink sparks, it means that POKENAME is about to unleash a devastating assault.

entry: POKENAME能混进一大群胖丁，必要时，连歌也学得会。可它并不免疫胖丁的唱歌，常因此睡着。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME can blend in with large crowds of Jigglypuff, even being able to copy their songs if needed. However, they aren't immune to a Jigglypuff's Sing, which often causes them to fall asleep.

entry: POKENAME虽然十分亲热，却常躲训练家。最可靠的寻找办法，是挥挥磁铁；即使隐形，也会吸上它的壳。
author: quackquackattack
source: Even though POKENAME are deeply affectionate Pokémon, they often hide from their Trainer. The most reliable way to locate POKENAME is to wave a magnet around, since the magnet will stick to their shell even when they are invisible.

entry: POKENAME用一路精神泡，将不知情猎物引进陷阱。近到无从逃，它就猛合双颚，如强大巨钳。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lures unsuspecting prey into its traps using a trail of psychic bubbles. When the victim gets too close to escape, it snaps its jaws shut, as if they were powerful pincers.

entry: POKENAME瞬移进水族缸，找里面的宝可梦玩。有时，也把附近人吃的点心移进来，自己尝尝。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME teleports into aquarium tanks to play with the Pokémon within. It will sometimes teleport treats it sees people eating nearby into the tank so it can enjoy them too.

entry: POKENAME看似软的头，却藏巨大的身体与精神力量。虽能靠念力飞，它在空中，仍会徒然拍小臂，模仿翅膀。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME's soft-looking head is home to an immense amount of physical and psychic power. Even though telekinesis allows them to fly, they futilely flap their small arms while airborne, imitating wings.

entry: POKENAME有时突然活力爆发，飞着追逐其他宝可梦。壳挡视线，让它常高速撞上正在一起玩的对象。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are sometimes filled with manic bursts of energy, racing through the air to chase after other Pokémon. They have poor visibility due to their shell and are prone to accidentally crashing into the Pokémon they're playing with at high speed.

entry: POKENAME藏在学生班中，用力量扮成普通人类孩子。它能在同校藏数年，每年换个模样，陪孩子玩。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hide amongst classes of school children, using their powers to disguise themselves as just another human child. They can spend years hiding at the same school, playing with children under a different guise each year.

entry: POKENAME极害羞，谁盯尾焰太久，它就尴尬，一边把尾藏身后，一边眨眼将对方瞬移数英里外。
author: .izik
source: Extremely shy, POKENAME grows embarrassed if someone stares at the flame on its tail for too long. It will teleport them miles away in the blink of an eye while hiding its tail behind its body.

entry: POKENAME爱逗幼小宝可梦，亲代不在，便现身。它把弹性身体胀成气球，浮来浮去，发滑稽吱声。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME delight in entertaining young Pokémon, appearing before them whenever the children's parents are elsewhere. POKENAME puff up their stretchy bodies like a balloon, making comedic squeaking noises for the young Pokémon as they float around.

entry: POKENAME种子含每种宝可梦DNA，生长难料，看似随机。它展开叶露种子，好观察附近人。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME's seed contains DNA from every Pokémon, causing unpredictable and seemingly random growth. POKENAME opens its leaves to reveal its seed so that it can watch nearby people.

entry: POKENAME所带的花，所有宝可梦都喜欢。传说，谁找到一朵，宝可梦就会更亲近谁。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: The flowers that POKENAME carries are enjoyed by all Pokémon. Legends say that if somebody finds one of these flowers, Pokémon start to like them more.

entry: POKENAME玩得越开心，身体越胀。结束便放出储气，造足以推倒建筑的狂风。
author: .izik
source: The more fun POKENAME has while playing, the more its body inflates. The moment it is done, it releases the stored air, creating gales strong enough to topple buildings.

entry: POKENAME折起的耳内，积着强力攻击，一伸，就快速放出。它通常找树果灌丛与果树，可稍受惊，就疾逃回家。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Powerful attacks are built up within POKENAME's collapsed ear and are quickly released once that ear extends. They're normally scouring for berry bushes and fruit trees, but will dart to their homes at the slightest disturbance.

entry: POKENAME用精神力量，捉弄旅人，不愿现身。若被看穿游戏，就用耳狠击，再逃入森林。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to play tricks on travelers without revealing itself. If someone catches on to POKENAME's game, it sharply strikes them with its ear before fleeing into the forest.

entry: POKENAME每使出超能力属性招式，都会剧烈抖动，向四周撒真菌孢子。它主要吃未熟树果，反复用头锤，打落树上收成。
author: fiordaliso
source: Every time POKENAME uses a Psychic-type move, it shakes so vigorously that it scatters fungal spores all around itself. It feeds mainly on unripe Berries, which it knocks off trees by repeatedly hitting them with Headbutt.

entry: 只要夜间，POKENAME几乎完全不可察。它隐形靠近陌生人，在耳旁诡异偷笑，看对方反应。
author: pkbonusducks
source: As long as it's nighttime, POKENAME are almost completely undetectable. They remain invisible as they approach strangers, eerily giggling in their ears and watching how they react.

entry: POKENAME爱被抱、被摸，寻找人类与宝可梦，满足这需求。核心对外界刺激敏感，周围蓝胶，既保护，也缓和感知。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME love to be held and pet, seeking people and Pokémon to help fulfill this need. The core of their body is sensitive to external stimulation, and the blue gel surrounding them both protects the core and helps numb their senses.

entry: POKENAME周身胶状液体，闻着像糖。古老故事说，喝一勺，余生就能拥有有限的灵视能力。
author: .izik
source: The gelatinous liquid flowing around POKENAME's body smells of sugar. Stories from long ago claim that consuming a spoonful will grant limited clairvoyance for the rest of one's life.

entry: POKENAME钻沙，只露眼与尾尖。它爱把尾变成树果，捉弄想捡起的人与宝可梦。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME burrow into the sand, leaving only their eyes and tail tips visible. They love transforming their tails into the shape of berries, pranking other Pokémon and people who try to pick them up.

entry: POKENAME以突袭、飞离的俯冲，咬住目标，吸少许血。它出奇温柔，牙上附精神能量，让刺入与吸饮，几乎完全无痛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME does hit-and-run dives to bite onto targets and drink some of their blood. It is surprisingly gentle, lacing its fangs with a psychic energy that makes the puncture and drinking process almost completely painless.

entry: POKENAME形似早已存在的古石板形象，许多科学家据此认为，板上的生物确实就是梦幻。也有人猜，石板本身有惊人未开发力量。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME carries the likeness of a pre-existing ancient tablet, which many scientists have taken to confirm that the creature on the tablet and Mew are indeed one and the same. Some have hypothesized the tablet itself has incredible untapped power.

entry: POKENAME瞬移到别人身上，轻咬，吸极少精神能量，维持微小身体。过程无害无痛，只让人一顿，片刻忘记正在做什么。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME teleports onto others to nip them and siphon a tiny amount of mental energy to sustain its minuscule body. The act is harmless and painless, only ever causing people to stop and momentarily forget what they were doing.

entry: 战斗开始，POKENAME的尾尖会发光。交战越久，光便沿着尾巴，越靠近身体；一旦到达，它就会爆炸。
author: .izik
source: A glow appears at the tip of POKENAME's tail at the start of combat. The longer the battle continues, the further down its tail the glow moves, and should it reach its body, POKENAME will explode.

entry: POKENAME天性胆小，却也好奇，因此变得灵敏，方便快查、快逃。据说，它会收集蜕牙，只分享给觉得可信的对象。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are naturally skittish, yet also curious; as a result, they have become rather nimble so they can quickly investigate or flee. It is said that they gather their shed tusks and only share any of them with individuals they feel they can trust.

entry: POKENAME不停嚼树果或树皮，加硬獠牙。若折断，便换套新基因，重塑得比从前更硬。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME is constantly chewing on berries or bark to harden its tusks. If they break, POKENAME reshapes them with a new set of genes to make them even harder than before.

entry: POKENAME不战斗时，獠牙会变得极软、极敏感。它便能与其他宝可梦一起睡，不怕意外扎伤。
author: .izik
source: When not in combat, POKENAME's tusks become extremely soft and sensitive. This allows it to sleep alongside other Pokémon without fear of accidentally poking them.

entry: POKENAME用灼热火花，加热泡里暖气。它爱把暖泡分给冰宝可梦，却总困惑，怎么别的宝可梦一碰，就突然倒下。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME create bubbles full of warm air, heated up by a hot Ember. POKENAME love to share these heated bubbles with Ice Pokémon, and are always confused when other Pokémon abruptly faint after contact.

entry: POKENAME用利牙咬其他宝可梦，取得新遗传物质。众多触手垂下，探知走过洞穴的潜在猎物。
author: secondunit
source: POKENAME obtain new genetic material by biting other Pokémon with their sharp fangs. Their multitude of tentacles hang down and act as probes for potential prey traveling through their caves.

entry: POKENAME深埋泥中，在洞顶留下气泡。登山者踩上，常被电到。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME bury themselves deep into the mud, leaving bubbles on top of the burrows they've dug. These bubbles often cause hikers to shock themselves when they step on them.

entry: 多份记载说，POKENAME既慷慨，又贪心。有人推测，它偷不喜欢者的贵物，再送给喜欢的对象。
author: pkbonusducks
source: According to multiple accounts, POKENAME are simultaneously generous and greedy. It's hypothesized that POKENAME steal valuables from those they dislike and give the valuables to those they're fond of.

entry: POKENAME刺中毒素，会自行适应，攻击倒霉接触者的生理构造。制药业极感兴趣，企业愿花高价买样本。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spines contain a toxin that adapts itself to attack the physiology of anyone unfortunate enough to come into contact with it. The toxin is of great interest to the pharmaceutical industry, with companies paying exorbitant prices for samples.

entry: POKENAME运用毒属性宝可梦的遗传信息，分泌强效解毒剂，对抗各自毒素。人类与宝可梦，都能医治。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME uses the genetic information of Poison-type Pokémon to secrete potent antidotes to their toxins. These antidotes can cure people and Pokémon alike.

entry: POKENAME用大泡载着自己，享受漂浮。尾刺有时却戳破泡，最后让它卡在树里。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME carry themselves around using large bubbles, finding great joy floating around. The spike on their tails sometimes causes these bubbles to pop, ending up with POKENAME stuck in a tree.

entry: POKENAME用力量，变成不那么凶的生物外表，方便与其他宝可梦交友。基因组成令人着迷，让它成为许多科学家最爱研究的对象。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its powers to take on the appearance of less ferocious creatures so it can easily befriend other Pokémon. Its genetic makeup is fascinating, which is why POKENAME is one of the favorite subjects of study for many scientists.

entry: POKENAME盼谁都温暖开心。雪地救援时，常短暂现身，送来暖毯，又突然消失。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME seek for everyone to be warm and happy. It's common to see POKENAME appear briefly for snow rescues, providing warm blankets before disappearing abruptly.

entry: POKENAME受惊，会把尾裹在毯里，再埋进雪。它既能躲捕食者，也能靠附近脚步振动，感知危险。
author: fxncy_poland
source: When startled, POKENAME buries itself in the snow with its tail cocooned within its blanket. POKENAME are able to hide from predators and sense danger through the vibrations of nearby footsteps.

entry: POKENAME用念力，将数英里外的人，一次一个，拖进冰山洞里陪玩。玩完，便冻成坚冰，留冰像作战利品。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses telekinesis to drag humans one at a time from miles away into its icy mountain caves to play with. When it is done, it freezes them solid and keeps their statues as trophies.

entry: POKENAME爱无害恶作剧，可被激怒，就以冰寒幻象困受害者，慢慢折磨，看力量与希望逐渐消逝。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME delights in harmless pranks, but when angered, it ensnares victims in chilling illusions, tormenting them as their strength and hope slowly fade away.

entry: POKENAME有致突变特性，将自己种进土，周围便可能长出多种庄稼。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: Due to its mutagenic nature, when POKENAME plants itself in soil, a wide variety of crops may grow nearby.

entry: POKENAME不停跳起、空中旋转，模仿啦啦队表演。它们爱看战斗，谁占上风，就替谁欢呼。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME constantly jump and spin in the air, mimicking cheerleader performances. They love to watch over battles, cheering for whoever is winning.

entry: POKENAME舞蹈激发的精神力量，强得能看见周围空气涟漪。只要近处起舞，最凶暴好斗的宝可梦，也会平静。
author: sk372
source: The psychic powers triggered by POKENAME's dances are so strong they can be witnessed rippling the air around it. Even the most violent and aggressive of Pokémon will be pacified if POKENAME dances near it.

entry: POKENAME在阿罗拉受敬奉，许多人信它舞蹈引魂。其实，它似乎只是喜欢风撞羽毛的声音。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME is revered in Alola, with many locals believing it dances to allow souls to pass on. In actuality, POKENAME seems to enjoy the sound the wind makes when it collides with its feathers.

entry: 皮卡车油少了，很可能是淘气POKENAME的杰作。研究报告发现，喝车油后，污泥炸弹会强得多。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When pickup trucks run low on oil, it's likely the work of a mischievous POKENAME. A report on POKENAME found that when they drink truck oil, POKENAME's Sludge Bomb was significantly stronger.

entry: POKENAME曾在黑森林安慰小木灵，陪跳、陪玩，直到平静。失踪孩子的父母，会在林地留供品，盼它引孩子返家。
author: beetlething
source: POKENAME have been spotted comforting Phantump in dark forests, dancing and playing with them until they have calmed down. Parents with lost children will leave offerings on forest floors in hopes that a POKENAME will guide their child back home.

entry: POKENAME散出的花粉云，剧毒，能致麻痹。动不了的期间，许多人声称，听得见旁人思想。
author: .izik
source: The clouds of pollen POKENAME releases are extremely poisonous and can cause paralysis. During this period of immobility, many claim they can hear the thoughts of those around them.

entry: POKENAME玩得开心，就欢喜尖叫。可叫声大得，常让身旁暂时耳聋。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Whenever POKENAME is having fun, they screech in delight. Unfortunately, their screech can become so loud that it causes temporary deafness to those near POKENAME.

entry: 明亮夜晚，POKENAME爱边飞，边望月。有时太专注，就撞树或崖壁。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: On bright nights, POKENAME enjoy flying through the air, staring at the moon. Sometimes they become so focused on the moon that they crash into trees or cliff faces.

entry: POKENAME在高空云间安家，用精神力量，把云塑成垫，筑巢其中。偶尔，也好奇跟飞机，隔窗看里面的人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their home high in the sky amongst the clouds, using their psychic powers to shape the clouds into cushions to nest amongst. They can sometimes be seen following aircraft, curiously peering in through the windows at the people inside.

entry: POKENAME坐在最高峰，假装是云，整日发出各种叫声，偶尔模仿其他鸟宝可梦。若学得不好，就练到满意。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME sit atop the highest mountains pretending to be clouds. They make various cries throughout the day, rarely mimicking the calls of other avian Pokémon. If the impression is poor, POKENAME will keep trying until they are satisfied.

entry: POKENAME看似温顺、不起眼，体内却有未开发潜能。有些科学家，决心证明它是纯精神能量，凝成的胶状形态。
author: pkbonusducks
source: While POKENAME seem rather meek and unassuming, they hold an untapped potential within them. Some scientists are determined to prove that POKENAME is pure psychic energy condensed into a gelatinous form.

entry: POKENAME不停找能抱的玩具与布偶。可惜，腐蚀黏液总把它们，全熔成残渣。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are constantly on the search for toys and plushies they can cuddle with. Unfortunately, POKENAME's corrosive slime always melts them all down to scraps.

entry: POKENAME亲热又配合，浓稠胶体住着无数不断变化的微生物群。密切工作的生物学家，衣服常被黏糊拥抱，永久染粉。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME are affectionate and cooperative Pokémon. Their rich goo is home to countless colonies of ever-changing microorganisms. Biologists working closely with POKENAME have had their clothing permanently stained pink by their messy hugs.

entry: POKENAME为小宝可梦建家，却常造太久，对方等不下去，离开它。若耐心等到完工，它便陪伴，走到哪里都跟随。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME build homes for smaller Pokémon but often takes so long that the Pokémon abandon POKENAME. If a Pokémon waits patiently until they're done, POKENAME will accompany them wherever they go.

entry: POKENAME用意念驾驭冰身，睡时也能控制。身体沉重，常倾倒，只好再用念力托正。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME use their minds to pilot their icy body, even able to control it while sleeping. These bodies often tip over due to the weight, forcing POKENAME to lift themselves back up with telekinesis.

entry: 野生POKENAME罕见得，直到最近，还只被当传闻。最常见的地点，似是枯叶市，每份报告，却都见梦幻相伴。
author: sk372
source: Sightings of POKENAME in the wild are so rare, it was thought to be only a rumor until recently. The most common sighting appears to be Vermillion City, and reports always include sighting a Mew accompanying it.

entry: POKENAME浓花粉，能让人欣喜、轻盈，令人陶醉。人群涌来吸入，快感一上来，便很快忘了刺鼻气味。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's thick flower pollen is intoxicating for its ability to cause feelings of elation and lightness. People will flock to inhale the clouds, quickly forgetting about the pungent scent it leaves as the euphoria kicks in.

entry: POKENAME的DNA似呈水晶结构，每晶颜色、花纹不同。许多研究者猜，它们代表每种宝可梦的DNA。
author: bigoljax
source: The DNA of POKENAME appears to have a crystalline structure to it, each crystal having different colors and patterns. Many researchers hypothesize these crystals represent the DNA of each and every Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME很难遇见，幸运在林中找到的人，常误当丢弃的毛绒玩具。可爱柔软外表下，却有巨大力量。
author: ambrosia04
source: Because POKENAME are rarely encountered, lucky people who find them in forests often mistake them for discarded plush toys. Despite their cute, soft appearance, they possess immense physical strength.

entry: POKENAME极亲热，却不懂个人界限。若不教，就会不断越过所爱对象的私人空间与心理界限。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME are incredibly affectionate Pokémon. They lack an understanding of personal boundaries and constantly invade the physical and mental space of those they love unless trained otherwise.

entry: POKENAME能改大小、形状与颜色，扮成多种仙人掌。它爱悄悄向没注意的对象扔针，惹些麻烦。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME can shift their size, shape, and color to disguise themselves as many kinds of cacti. They like to cause trouble by subtly throwing needles at those who don't notice them.

entry: POKENAME身菇蕴藏惊人潜力，许多人曾试着入药。可效果太难料，无法善用，致病的次数，比治好还多。
author: .jerden
source: There is incredible power within the mushrooms on POKENAME's body, and many have attempted to use them as medicine. However, the effects they produce are too unpredictable to be useful and cause disease more often than they cure it.

entry: POKENAME与海滩来的孩子玩，不停扔沙球，直到孩子成功在共同游戏里，“击败”它。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME plays games with children who visit the beach it's on. POKENAME hurls sand balls at the children until the children successfully "defeat" POKENAME at the game they're all playing.

entry: POKENAME适应低温，喜爱冬季。孩子打雪仗，它偶尔加入，孩子一累，便立刻消失。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME thrives in cold temperatures and loves the winter months. It rarely appears during children's snowball fights to join in the fun, vanishing the moment the kids grow tired.

entry: POKENAME静行深冰洞，寻找封在冰中的宝可梦。一找到，就轻贴鼻子，用精神能力破冰救出。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME quietly wander in deep, icy caves, seeking out Pokémon frozen in the ice. When they find one, they gently press their noses against the ice, using their psychic abilities to break them out.

entry: POKENAME常高傲自我，只顾玩。兴奋游荡时，身后会留下细小粉蓝气泡。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME tend to be lofty and self-centered, only ever focused on playing. As they excitedly wander, they'll leave a trail of tiny pink and blue bubbles behind them.

entry: POKENAME在潮池旁安家，方便造泡。它友善，愿分享气泡，陪其他宝可梦玩。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME make their homes by tide pools, allowing them easy access to make their bubbles. POKENAME are quite friendly, sharing their bubbles with Pokémon to play with them.

entry: POKENAME在潮池旁安家，方便造泡。它很护家，便往泡中注精神能量；敌人一戳破，力量就释放。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME make their homes by tide pools, allowing them easy access to make their bubbles. POKENAME are quite territorial of their homes; To protect them, they imbue their bubbles with psychic energy, which releases when a foe pops them.

entry: POKENAME以美妙歌声闻名，混合宝可梦叫声与人类歌唱。它们网上很红，歌曲常作短视频配乐。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are known for their beautiful singing voices, which are a mix of Pokémon cries and human singing. They're very popular online, with their songs often being used as background music for short videos.

entry: POKENAME流畅舞蹈，略借帕底亚舞者灵感，赢得大批追随者。头上的帽，其实是尾巴，可多数人都没发现。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME have gained a large following due to their flowy dancing, taking slight inspiration from Paldean dancers. The hats they wear are actually their tails, but most don't often notice this.

entry: POKENAME爱进梦，看孩子在玩什么。若觉得有趣，就在梦中陪玩很久。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME loves to invade dreams to see what children are enjoying. If it finds their activity entertaining, it will play alongside them in their dreams for long periods of time.

entry: POKENAME将长触须贴船底，读取船上人的心思。若在近来记忆里见玩具，就用念力把玩具抛下船，拿来自己玩。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME presses its long feeler to the bottom of ships to read the minds of those on board. If it sees toys in their recent memories, it will psychically hurl them overboard so it can play with them.

entry: POKENAME身菇含多种真菌基因，潜力惊人。无论住哪，都能迅速适应，茁壮生长。
author: .jerden
source: The mushrooms on its body hold incredible potential, as they possess the genes of many different species of fungus. They flourish no matter where POKENAME lives, rapidly adapting to any environment.

entry: POKENAME每天一次，在周围撒一团孢子，会长成各种蘑菇。科学家认为，它也许能产任何真菌，只是种类随机。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spreads a puff of spores around itself once per day. The spores will grow into all manner of different mushrooms; scientists believe POKENAME may potentially be able to produce any kind of fungus, if only at random.

entry: 许多世代，人们相信，POKENAME的光能影响DNA，使宝可梦融合。现代科学却已证伪，所谓效果，只是巧合。
author: soup1900
source: For many generations, people believed POKENAME's light was able to affect the DNA of Pokémon and cause them to fuse together. However, modern science has proved that this phenomenon was false and that the resulting effects were just coincidences.

entry: POKENAME蜕下华美鳞，送给深爱的对象。阿罗拉一些岛屿，会用湛蓝鳞，装饰婚戒。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME shed their magnificent scales to give to those they deeply care for. Some islands in Alola use POKENAME's azure scales to decorate wedding bands.

entry: 有时装设计师称，曾见POKENAME按自身喜好，改了设计。与它一沾边，款式便大受欢迎，时尚人士还常炫耀，衣服由它设计。
author: beetlething
source: Some fashion designers claim to have seen a POKENAME change their designs to fit its own tastes. Due to the association with POKENAME, these designs become incredibly popular. Fashionistas often brag that their outfit was designed by a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME住产坚果的大树深处，悉心供养、远播树种。灾难一来，就耗尽全力，尽量保护。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME dwell deep within nut-producing trees. They deeply care for their homes, supplying them with nutrients and spreading the tree's seeds far. When disaster strikes, POKENAME will expend all their power protecting what they can.

entry: POKENAME体内遗传信息丰富，让它能覆上适合各种温度与环境的毛。
author: oddwalls
source: The wealth of genetic information that POKENAME contains in its body allows it to cover itself in hairs suitable for a wide range of temperatures and environments.

entry: POKENAME十分爱玩，会造精神能量球，逗人类与宝可梦开心。谁冷了，它就用总温暖的粉毛依偎，分享暖意。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an incredibly playful creature that entertains humans and Pokémon alike by creating spheres of psychic energy. When someone is cold, it curls up against them with its ever-warm pink fur, trying to share its warmth.

entry: POKENAME广被认为智慧非凡，有故事甚至说，它寿命极长。它用精神力量与火焰，驱开潜在危险，也保护别人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are widely thought to be remarkably wise, and some stories even claim they live very long lives. POKENAME utilize their psychic powers and their flames to keep potential dangers at bay or to defend others.

entry: POKENAME游历世界，用神秘本领，惊艳其他宝可梦。它在偏远处，以精神力量表演，逗附近同伴。
author: fxncy_poland
source: POKENAME travel around the world, impressing other Pokémon with their mystical prowess. They use their psychic powers to perform shows in remote locations to entertain nearby Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在林地瞬移，检查火情。一见烟，就快飞至源头，经小枝集中精神，如吹灭蜡烛般，瞬间灭火。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME teleports around forested areas checking for fires. Should it spot smoke, it flies quickly to the source, focuses its mind through its twig, and extinguishes the blaze instantly like snuffing out a candle.

entry: POKENAME周身气泡，其实由精神能量构成，耐用得出奇。
author: atlas3339098
source: The bubbles POKENAME surrounds itself with are actually made of psychic energy. They're surprisingly durable.

entry: POKENAME跑过海面，寻找船只，远远看着，用念力藏起船员放下的物品，当作游戏。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME runs across ocean surfaces in search of ships. It watches them from afar, hiding objects crew members set down using telekinesis as a playful game.

entry: POKENAME造的泡，有助引导精神力量。只要装得进，它就能瞬间移走。
author: atlas3339098
source: The bubbles POKENAME creates help it channel its psychic power. It can teleport anything it can fit inside one of them.

entry: POKENAME轻易适应一切环境，也是潜行高手。传闻能造各种手里剑，出招难料，很难判断下次用哪种。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME easily adapts to all environments and is a master of stealth. POKENAME is rumored to conjure every form of shuriken and is unpredictable enough that determining which one it will use is difficult.

entry: POKENAME壳中释放的众多气泡，随心情或暖或热。驯服个体常见于嘉年华，用精神力量操纵气泡。
author: infinex21
source: The many bubbles loosed from the shells of these Pokémon are either warm or hot depending on their mood. Tamed POKENAME are common at carnivals because they can use their psychic powers to manipulate these bubbles.

entry: 许多林中迷途孩子说，见过POKENAME尾上的光。它会引孩子回家，再消失无踪。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Many children lost in the woods claim to see the light from POKENAME's tail. POKENAME guide children back to their homes before vanishing without a trace.

entry: POKENAME体内遗传信息丰富，让它能覆上适合各种温度与环境的毛。
author: oddwalls
source: The wealth of genetic information that POKENAME contains in its body allows it to cover itself in hairs suitable for a wide range of temperatures and environments.

entry: POKENAME飞时，闪亮双翼放细粉，黑暗中发蓝光。夜落，匠人便收集，制作发光颜料与染料。
author: oddwalls
source: As it flies, POKENAME's shimmering wings release a fine dust that glows blue in the dark. After nightfall, artisans collect the dust for use in manufacturing luminescent paints and dyes.

entry: POKENAME身体，同时带着数百种甜点香。它铺下隐形黏丝，困住受害者，作恶作剧。
author: soup1900
source: The body of POKENAME has the scents of hundreds of different sweets at once. It plays pranks by laying down invisible strands of sticky string for its victims to get stuck to.

entry: POKENAME胃口大，又淘气，常给面包店添麻烦。它偶尔瞬移入店，尽量多吃甜食，再无影无踪地消失。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME have voracious appetites and a mischievous personality, which often means trouble for bakeries. POKENAME are known to occasionally teleport into a shop, eat as many sweets as possible, then disappear without a trace.

entry: POKENAME精神力巨大，却更愿逗留城市小巷，炫耀派头。战斗中，用念力托住松垮皮肤，免得绊倒。
author: willowwhisker_98658
source: POKENAME possesses immense psychic power, but prefers loitering in urban alleyways to show off its swagger. It uses telekinesis to keep its loose, baggy skin from tripping it up during a battle.

entry: POKENAME静歇水面，用嘴吹水泡，慢慢清洁泡内与周围的水。有时，它把泡送上水面，便能安全饮用，取得净水。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME rest calmly on the water's surface, blowing water bubbles with their mouths. These bubbles slowly clean the water in and around them. POKENAME sometimes send their bubbles to the surface, which can safely be consumed for clean water.

entry: POKENAME石壳花纹，与一件描绘梦幻的古文物，近乎完全相同。
author: hophoppip
source: The pattern on POKENAME's stone shell matches incredibly closely with a certain ancient artifact depicting Mew.

entry: POKENAME极其罕见，每500年才落到地表一次。喜爱玩小石子与陨石碎片。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are extremely rare sights and only fall to the surface every 500 years. They love to play with small stones and meteorite fragments.

entry: POKENAME玩得越开心，火焰越大、越热。若一地片刻变得不合时令地暖，很可能附近的它，正玩得高兴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's flame burns larger and hotter the happier it becomes while playing. Should an area grow unseasonably warm in moments, there is a chance a POKENAME is nearby, finding joy in some activity.

entry: POKENAME在草甸地下安睡，只露尾巴摇动。古文赞其温柔、爱玩。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME naps peacefully underground in meadow habitats, leaving its tail exposed and wagging. Ancient texts praise its gentle and playful nature.

entry: POKENAME的双心形，是永恒爱情的传统象征。据说，婚礼若有它现身，新人就能长久幸福。
author: oddwalls
source: The double-hearted shape of POKENAME is a traditional symbol of eternal love. It is said that if POKENAME appears at a wedding, the couple will have a long, happy marriage.

entry: POKENAME三个成员，同步用精神力量挪土，掘成隧道。停下休息时，有时却淘气地用土块，砸附近别人。
author: sk372
source: All three members of POKENAME use psychic powers in tandem to move soil around to dig their tunnels. Sometimes it behaves mischievously and uses the clumps of soil to pelt others nearby when it stops to rest.

entry: POKENAME不满意捡来的硬币，便用唾液与爪抛光。心意虽好，口水却把金属染蓝，可用橄榄油或醋，安全恢复。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME are not satisfied with the condition of coins they find and will polish them with their spit and paws. While the effort is appreciated, their saliva dyes the metal blue. The coins can be safely restored with olive oil or vinegar.

entry: POKENAME似乎崇拜宝石与水晶，总潜入博物馆，用泡偷稀有钻石。可尾巴容易碰倒东西，又很容易被捉。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME seem to have an admiration for gems and crystals, constantly sneaking into museums to steal rare diamonds using their bubbles. They get caught easily, as their tails are prone to accidentally knocking things over.

entry: 其他宝可梦不在身旁，POKENAME就会头痛。群体越大、物种越多，痛就越轻。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's head aches if it's not in the presence of other Pokémon. The larger the group and the more varied the species of Pokémon within, the more its pain ebbs away.

entry: 周边再脏，POKENAME栖居的水，仍纯净如初。额珠不断放精神能量，清除游泳水域的杂质。
author: sk372
source: No matter how dirty the surroundings, the water POKENAME makes its home in remains pristine. The jewel on its forehead emits a psychic energy that constantly removes impurities in the water it swims in.

entry: POKENAME常在林冠荡来荡去，淘气地笑。它爱偷路过训练家的帽，偷笑着引人玩追逐。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME can be seen swinging through the canopy while smirking playfully. They frequently steal the hats of passing Trainers, giggling as they try to coax them into a game of chase.

entry: POKENAME极易暴怒，却厌恶用怒气施暴。它改用精神力量，把怒意传给别人，暂时解脱，留下对方处理突来的狂怒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very prone to fits of intense anger, but detests using rage for violence. Instead, it uses psychic powers to pass its anger onto others, temporarily relieving itself while leaving others to deal with the sudden surge of fury.

entry: POKENAME大声吼叫，驱赶靠近领地的威胁。它用变身能力，让吼叫匹配眼前宝可梦的叫声，连最大威胁也能吓走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME guard their territory from threats by Roaring loudly at any Pokémon that comes too close. They use their transformation powers to change their Roar to match the cry of whatever Pokémon they are facing, scaring away even the largest threat.

entry: POKENAME跃过火山地区，玩着喷发间歇泉。嬉戏时，空气迅速升温，让附近植物燃起。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaps across volcanic areas, playing with geysers as they erupt. During its play, the surrounding air heats rapidly, causing nearby plant life to burst into flames.

entry: POKENAME够生气，蓝焰就热得能瞬间熔钨。幸而它多半爱玩、开心，不常出现这般高热。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's blue flames are hot enough to melt tungsten in an instant when it is sufficiently upset. Luckily, its disposition leans toward the playful and happy, preventing this level of heat from occurring often.

entry: POKENAME住在远离文明的纯净山池，彼此在清水玩，以闪泡浮上天空，再突然溅水落下。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found living in pristine mountain ponds far from civilisation. They play with one another in the clear water, levitating themselves into the sky in shimmering bubbles before suddenly splashing down again.

entry: POKENAME每遇新面孔，就在空中，造旋转气泡图案。泡带精神气息，让观看者感到平和。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME creates swirling patterns made of bubbles in the air whenever it meets someone new. The bubbles are laced with psychic emanations that invoke a feeling of peace in those who gaze at them.

entry: POKENAME总是一脸不高兴，却常被看见与蚊香君玩耍。它们的手臂短小，便用泡泡充当拳头，将拳击的力量注入其中，吹向对手。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME constantly have a grumpy expression, though are often seen playing with Poliwhirl. Due to their small arms, they use their bubbles as fists, putting the force of a punch into one and blowing it towards the opponent.

entry: POKENAME的瞬移本领，让它一察觉被看见，就会眨眼消失，难觅踪迹。这样并非因为害怕，只是觉得消失后，追赶者的模样很有趣。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's teleportation ability makes it highly elusive, disappearing in the blink of an eye the moment it senses it has been spotted. It does this not out of fear, but because it is amused by those who pursue it after it vanishes.

entry: POKENAME每2分钟，便能瞬移一次，极难捕捉。年轻训练家屡抓失败，常气哭，它却很开心。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME is able to teleport every 2 minutes, making it very hard to catch. It makes a lot of young Trainers get angry and cry after failing many times to catch POKENAME, much to its amusement.

entry: POKENAME念力能弯硬物。有些科学家发现，几乎任何科技物件，它都能弄出故障。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME is able to use its telekinesis power to bend hard materials. Some scientists have found that it can cause malfunctions in almost any technological object.

entry: POKENAME智慧极高，用来让受害者落入过分复杂的恶作剧。据信，记忆能毫无差错，记下每种宝可梦与招式。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has an extremely high intelligence that it uses to trick victims into falling for its overelaborate pranks. Its memory is believed to be able to remember every single Pokémon species and move without a single fault.

entry: POKENAME不停练身，保持肌肉最佳状态。哪怕身体耗尽体力，还用精神力量，逼着继续动、继续练。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME trains its body relentlessly to keep its muscles in top shape. Even when it is physically exhausted, it uses psychic powers to force its body to continue moving and training further.

entry: POKENAME先摆夸张姿势，再用纯精神能量造爆炸。传闻还有额外能力，连时间也能重置。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME takes on dramatic poses before creating explosions utilizing pure psychic energy. It is rumored to also possess an additional ability that allows it to reset time as well.

entry: POKENAME虽远更爱交友，也不从切磋、战斗退缩。战时造精神能量臂，强得惊人，难以防御。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME much prefers friendship to fighting, it won't back down from sparring or combat. It creates extra arms from psychic energy when it battles, making it impressively formidable and difficult to defend against.

entry: 有报告说，POKENAME用隐形藏重要包裹，帮助送货。新手训练家，常误把它的卡车，视为能找到梦幻的地方。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Some POKENAME have been reported to help with deliveries, using their invisibility to hide important packages. Fledgling Trainers often mistake the trucks of POKENAME as places to find a Mew.

entry: POKENAME奇特基因，让肢体长得极长。阳光下，尾中产出花蜜，带着美味棉花糖香。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's odd genetic code causes its limbs to grow incredibly long. In sunlight, it produces a nectar in its tail that carries a delicious cotton candy scent.

entry: POKENAME靠克隆增加同类。它以精神力量测土，找到肥地便扎根，周围精神活动越强，冒出的个体就越多。
author: secondunit
source: POKENAME propagate themselves through cloning. They root into fertile grounds that they find through psychically testing the soil. When they root, more of them spawn depending on the level of psychic activity of the area they're rooted in.

entry: POKENAME从嘴吹出大小各异的粉泡，向同类表达情绪。长尾像舵，让它在急流中迅速转向。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME shoots pink bubbles of various sizes from its mouth to communicate its emotions to others of its kind. It uses its long tail as a rudder to turn quickly while swimming through river rapids.

entry: 它能合成多种酸、中和液与抗毒血清，因此POKENAME成为治疗中毒，无比珍贵的帮手。
author: imaginita
source: It can synthesize a wide variety of acids, as well as neutralizing fluids and antivenoms. Because of this, POKENAME has become invaluable for treating poisonings.

entry: POKENAME吃腐树果，让胃酸强得连金属也腐蚀。它巧用精神力量消磨受害者，再伸藤抓住、吞食。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME feeds on rotten berries to make the acid in its stomach strong enough to corrode even metal. POKENAME skillfully uses its psychic powers to wear down its victims before snatching them with vines and devouring them.

entry: POKENAME触手一刺，就使人忘却负面情绪，转而突然欣喜。它用刺，干预、阻止其他宝可梦争斗。
author: sk372
source: Getting stung by POKENAME's tentacles causes one to forget all negative feelings, replaced with a sudden euphoric rush. It uses its sting to intervene and stop other Pokémon from fighting.

entry: POKENAME隐形，漂过海洋，找其他宝可梦玩。它用众多触手，逗小宝可梦、抛来抛去，自己始终不露面。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME drift through the ocean in search of other Pokémon to play with, masking their presence with their psychic powers by turning invisible. They use their many tentacles to toy with smaller Pokémon, tossing them about whilst remaining unseen.

entry: POKENAME变成矿石块，躲洞穴探险者。可哪怕轻碰，就会偷笑，变回原形，再瞬间离开。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME changes its form to resemble a chunk of ore to hide from cave explorers. If touched even slightly, it will giggle and revert to its original form before teleporting away.

entry: POKENAME假扮岩石，藏在繁忙路线旁。训练家一过，它就绊倒，再瞬间移走。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME disguise themselves as rocks, hiding along well-traveled routes. When Trainers walk by, POKENAME trips them before teleporting away.

entry: POKENAME身上掉的石，会随机变成生平遇过的某种石头。脱落后几小时，摸来仍暖。
author: .izik
source: The stones that fall from POKENAME's body transform into random stone types it has encountered throughout its life. These rocks remain warm to the touch for hours after being shed.

entry: POKENAME用念力，压紧重石，在身旁形成可移动的壳。它天性极害羞，连朋友与训练家面前，也很少出壳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME forms a mobile shell around itself by compacting heavy stones together via telekinesis. It's very shy by nature, so it's rarely seen outside of the shell, even among its friends and Trainer.

entry: POKENAME用强大精神推力，把自己射上天，跃得数英里高、数英里远。下落时，再以念力安全滑降；浮空越久，背上粉焰越旺。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME can jump miles high and far by using a powerful psychic push to launch them into the sky. As they fall, they use telekinesis to safely glide to the ground. The pink flames on POKENAME's back intensify the longer they stay airborne.

entry: POKENAME慢悠悠地在天空奔跑，欣赏下方风景。周身热气闪动，遮住形体，地面难以看清。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME gallop through the sky at a lazy pace, enjoying the sights of the landscape below. They are constantly surrounded by an obscuring heat shimmer, making them difficult to see from the ground.

entry: POKENAME慢悠悠地在天空奔跑，欣赏下方风景。鬃毛涌动粉色精神能量，碰到者，会感到天真爱玩。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME gallop through the sky at a lazy pace, enjoying the sights of the landscape below. Their manes bubble with pink psychic energy, inducing feelings of playful innocence in those who make contact with them.

entry: POKENAME慢悠悠地在天空奔跑，欣赏下方风景。鬃毛涌动蓝色精神能量，碰到者，会变得害羞、想独处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME gallop through the sky at a lazy pace, enjoying the sights of the landscape below. Their manes bubble with blue psychic energy, inducing feelings of reclusive shyness in those touched by them.

entry: POKENAME造精神能量泡休息。别人也躺上去，就会感到彻底放松、满足。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME creates bubbles out of psychic energy to rest on. Those who rest on the bubbles themselves find themselves feeling utterly relaxed and content.

entry: POKENAME毛色奢丽粉红，深受时尚界渴求。野生难找，织成的布料，售价高得离谱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur is highly coveted by the fashion industry for its luxurious pink colour. Fabrics woven from their fur command an absurdly high price due to the difficulty of finding POKENAME in the wild.

entry: POKENAME精神力庞大，能猛然释放。可它们太笨，常忘记本领，极少真的用。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME wield a massive amount of psychic power, able to release it in massive bursts. However, they're incredibly dumb and very rarely ever use this ability due to often forgetting about it.

entry: POKENAME靠反重力浮空，改变双尾形状，调整航向。它们用侧边磁铁，淘气地电不知情训练家，再快快飞走。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME float using anti-gravity and steer themselves in the air by changing the shape of their dual tails to maneuver. They use their side magnets to playfully shock unsuspecting Trainers before quickly zipping away.

entry: 科学家怕POKENAME，怕的不是破坏力，而是它常玩坏电子设备。它爱先把物品磁吸过来，再高速抛走。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are feared by scientists, not for their destructive power, but because they often damage electronics by playing with them. A pastime for POKENAME involves magnetizing objects to them before flinging the objects away at high speeds.

entry: POKENAME极护扭曲的植物茎，谁想拿，就先打，再眨眼逃走。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME is quite protective of its twisted plant stalk. It will smack those who try to take it, before fleeing in the blink of an eye.

entry: 战斗中，POKENAME把两处额头贴拢，增强超能力。条件合适，爆发的精神能量足以推倒摩天楼。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME presses its two foreheads together during combat to amplify its psychic abilities. Under the right conditions, the resulting psychic bursts are strong enough to topple a skyscraper.

entry: POKENAME三尾各自精通不同精神能力，例如念力、灵视与共情。虽还会别的，却都远不及这三种强。
author: .izik
source: Each of POKENAME's three tails can masterfully control a different psychic ability, such as telekinesis, clairvoyance, and empathy. While it possesses other psychic abilities, none are nearly as potent as these three.

entry: POKENAME喜欢所有音乐，会找公开音乐会，上台加入，随节奏拍鳍。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME enjoys music of all kinds. It seeks out public concerts and joins the performers on stage, clapping its fins to the rhythm of the music.

entry: POKENAME爱从冰下，看人类滑冰。它会瞬移到冻湖底，只为看上面玩得开心。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME loves to watch humans ice skating from beneath the ice. It will teleport to the bottom of frozen lakes simply to observe them having fun above.

entry: POKENAME身体的烟雾，吸入危险，能使人发烧数天。中招者常报告，见到世界各地的人，正做寻常小事。
author: .izik
source: The smog emanating from POKENAME's body is dangerous when inhaled and can cause fevers lasting days. Those who succumb typically report visions of humans from all over the world performing mundane tasks.

entry: POKENAME让医学大有突破。因为身体含每种宝可梦DNA，研究者正慢慢开发，针对每种毒属性及其繁多融合体的抗毒剂。
author: sk372
source: Medical science has achieved great breakthroughs thanks to POKENAME. Because its body contains the DNA of every Pokémon, researchers are slowly developing antivenom for every Poison type and their myriad fusions.

entry: POKENAME毛色奢丽粉红，深受时尚界渴求。野生难找，织成的布料，售价高得离谱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur is highly coveted by the fashion industry for its luxurious pink colour. Fabrics woven from their fur command an absurdly high price due to the difficulty of finding POKENAME in the wild.

entry: POKENAME壳上装饰的不是炮，而是吹泡棒。气泡力量远超表面，能攻击威胁，也能自卫。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: Instead of cannons, bubble wands adorn POKENAME's shell. These bubbles are deceptively powerful, and it can use them as a means to attack or defend itself from threats.

entry: POKENAME常捉弄钓鱼的人。对方用鱼竿，它就潜入水下，把鱼钩挂在杂物上；对方用网，它便飘过去，用长舌抽打。
author: oddwalls
source: It regularly plays pranks on fishermen. If the fisherman uses a rod, POKENAME will dive underwater and attach their hook to detritus; if the fisherman uses a net, POKENAME will float over to them and slap them with its long tongue.

entry: POKENAME常捉弄钓鱼的人。对方用鱼竿，它就潜入水下，把鱼钩挂在杂物上；对方用网，它便飘过去，用长舌抽打。
author: oddwalls
source: It regularly plays pranks on fishermen. If the fisherman uses a rod, POKENAME will dive underwater and attach their hook to detritus; if the fisherman uses a net, POKENAME will float over to them and slap them with its long tongue.

entry: POKENAME看似睡着，其实始终醒。这让猎物误近，它便可困进壳，吃掉。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Despite seeming asleep, POKENAME is always awake. This works in POKENAME's favor, as prey tend to accidentally get too close, allowing POKENAME to trap the prey inside their shell to eat them.

entry: POKENAME周围奇特气体，碰什么，都染淡蓝。吸入会让嗓音大大变尖，把它逗得乐不可支。
author: pkbonusducks
source: The unusual gas surrounding POKENAME stains anything that touches it a faint blue. Inhaling the gas greatly raises the pitch in one's voice, amusing POKENAME to no end.

entry: POKENAME体内有害气体，会造成持续数月的肺损伤。许多受影响者报告，康复中曾短暂浮空。
author: .izik
source: Noxious fumes from POKENAME's body can cause lasting lung damage that persists for months. Many who are affected report brief periods of levitation during their recovery.

entry: POKENAME是顽皮淘气鬼，不停捉弄训练家与宝可梦。最常造大泡，再戳破，以巨响吓人跳起。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are playful tricksters, constantly pulling pranks on trainers and Pokémon. Their main trick is to create a large bubble, popping it to make others jump from the loud noise.

entry: POKENAME能随意把泡变柔软弹性，或硬如钻石。即使目击极少，每次却都见它保护、陪玩宝可梦幼崽。
author: pkbonusducks
source: At will, POKENAME can alter their bubbles to be bouncy and soft or hard as diamonds. Even with what few sightings there have been of POKENAME, they've always been seen protecting and playing with baby Pokémon.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME用精神力量，找到做噩梦的孩子，瞬移身边，吃掉恶梦，让其安睡。
author: oddwalls
source: At night, POKENAME uses its psychic power to find children having nightmares. It teleports to their side and eats the disturbing dream, allowing the child to sleep peacefully.

entry: POKENAME摆锤有所有宝可梦的遗传信息。睡前专注凝望，就会梦见自己变成宝可梦。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME's pendulum contains the genetic information of all Pokémon. If a person focuses on the pendulum before going to sleep, they will dream about transforming into a Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME摆锤有所有宝可梦的遗传信息。睡前专注凝望，就会梦见自己变成宝可梦。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME's pendulum contains the genetic information of all Pokémon. If a person focuses on the pendulum before going to sleep, they will dream about transforming into a Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在关节里缓缓蓄压，再迅速弹合双钳，射出大泡泡。发射的力道堪比枪击，甚至能使周围的水沸腾。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME slowly build up pressure in their joints, firing out a large bubble with a quick snap of their pincers. These bubbles cause the water around them to boil, as they're shot out with the same force of a gun.

entry: POKENAME全身有毒汗，驱退想咬的对象。叶片散甜香，让别人快乐。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME body is coated in a poisonous sweat that wards off anything that tries to take a bite out of it. Its leaf gives off a sweet scent that makes others feel happy.

entry: 叶中提炼的精油，含维生素与养分，用来改善高档护发素、洗发水。POKENAME累了，就在叶间，织小丝巢。
author: fiordaliso
source: The essential oil extracted from its leaf contains vitamins and nutrients used to enhance high-end conditioners and shampoos. When POKENAME is tired, it makes a small nest of silk among the leaves.

entry: POKENAME朝空中挥拳训练时，花粉会散向四周，帮助附近的花更快开放。战斗前，它还会旋转头上的叶片，做出威吓姿态。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME trains by throwing punches in the air, it scatters pollen in all directions, helping nearby flowers bloom more quickly. Before a battle, it spins the leaf on its head in a threatening display to intimidate its opponents.

entry: POKENAME鼻吻叶变鲜亮黄绿，身体便散淡麝香，令人想到哈密瓜。训练家让它晒太阳，还能加快进化前体内潜力的成长。
author: quackquackattack
source: When the leaf on POKENAME's snout becomes a bright lime, its body produces a mild musky scent that reminds people of cantaloupes. When its Trainer allows it to bask in the sunlight, it accelerates the growth of potential inside before it evolves.

entry: POKENAME周身蠕动的藤，对触碰敏感。训练家一碰，突来感觉便让它卷起、缩回，同时散出清爽香气。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a writhing mass of vines that are sensitive to touch. If a Trainer touches one of their vines, the sudden sensation causes it to curl up and recoil, producing a zesty scent in the process.

entry: POKENAME贴水面游，每天晒太阳几小时。遇险，便射种子与危险粉末，驱走捕食者。
author: toniaglitched
source: POKENAME swim close to the surface and sunbathe for hours every day. When threatened, it shoots seeds and dangerous powders to drive predators away.

entry: POKENAME白天近水面游，覆身叶片，生气就分泌毒。它们曾掀翻，靠近巢的船。
author: toniaglitched
source: POKENAME swim near the surface during daytime. Its body is covered by leaves that secrete poison whenever it gets angry. POKENAME have been seen tumbling ships that come near its nest.

entry: POKENAME贴水面游，让叶露出来吸阳光。可甜香也常引来捕食者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME swims close to the surface of water, letting its leaf poke out to absorb sunlight. The sweet scent wafting from the leaf tends to attract predators, however.

entry: POKENAME带粉的叶，是草药常用原料。药剂师常以新鲜蜂蜜，换它相助。
author: griddle
source: Its powdery leaves are a common ingredient in herbal remedies. Apothecaries will commonly offer fresh honey to POKENAME in exchange for its assistance.

entry: 清晨，POKENAME在雪中舞，附近覆雪泥地，便冒出小绿芽。
author: .izik
source: In the early morning, POKENAME dances in the snow. This causes small green sprouts to erupt from the nearby snow-covered dirt.

entry: POKENAME味寡淡，口感粗粝，令人不想吃。因此，渔人钓到，通常又丢回水里。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has an insipid taste and a gritty texture that makes it unappetizing to eat. As such, fishermen who catch it usually toss it back into the water.

entry: POKENAME在冰水优雅游动，用头叶转向。岸边打盹，身体碰过的岩石与冰岸，都会长出草丛。
author: fiordaliso
