source: POKENAME elegantly swims in icy waters, steering itself with the leaf atop its head. When it naps by the shore, patches of grass sprout wherever its body touches the stones or the icy shores.

entry: POKENAME优雅滑过寒海，用头叶引导游姿。沿冻岸打盹，所过之处，嫩草不惧寒冷，纷纷萌发。
author: fiordaliso
source: Gracefully gliding through frigid seas, POKENAME uses the leaf on its head to guide its strokes. When it dozes along frozen banks, tender grass blooms in its wake, defying the cold.

entry: 据说，POKENAME背上的植物一亿年前就已存在。它生活在海底，用叶子将自己系在岩石或珊瑚上，防止被洋流冲走。
author: mistymagius
source: The plant on POKENAME's back is said to have existed 100 million years ago. It lives on the seafloor, using its leaf to tether itself to rocks or coral to prevent itself from getting swept away by ocean currents.

entry: POKENAME头上与尾巴的叶子，气味各不相同，可没人能说得一致。一个人说，这片甜、那片苦，下一个却说，闻着像泥土和辛香。
author: imaginita
source: The leaf on POKENAME's head and the leaf on its tail smell different. Nobody can agree what each smells like, however. One person may say one smells sweet and the other bitter, then the next person says they smell earthy and spicy.

entry: POKENAME叶散甜香，可采摘制茶。叶只需一周长回，因此采茶叶，不会伤害。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME releases a sweet scent from its leaves, which can be harvested to produce tea. Its leaves only take a week to grow, so harvesting the tea leaves does not harm it.

entry: POKENAME在原野晒太阳，吸光越多，香气越强。喜欢这味的训练家，就抱一抱，让自己也沾香。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME basks in fields to absorb sunlight. It produces a scent that gets stronger on days it absorbs more sunlight. Trainers who enjoy this scent give it hugs so the scent rubs off on them.

entry: POKENAME爱啃骨头，尤其需要吃下小碎骨，为身体补钙。不啃骨头时，它就摊在岩石上晒太阳，滋养头上的叶子。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME loves to gnaw on bones, especially since it relies on eating small shards of bone to give itself a boost of calcium. When it is not chewing on bones, it sprawls across a rock to sunbathe and nourish the leaf on its head.

entry: 叶状翼让它完美融入树冠。POKENAME开心，身体便释放天然香气，有助缓解恶心症状。
author: fiordaliso
source: It blends perfectly into treetops thanks to its leaf-shaped wings. When POKENAME is happy, its body releases a natural fragrance that helps soothe symptoms of nausea.

entry: POKENAME性子温和好相处，非常适合训练。它爱在繁茂草甸打滚，开心或坚定时，就放舒缓香气。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has a mild and agreeable temperament, making it perfect for training. It loves to roll around in flourishing meadows. When happy or determined, it releases a relaxing aroma.

entry: POKENAME沿小路、上山丘，找最佳光合地点。时间感让它不漏一分日光，雨天也不例外。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME walks through trails and scales up hills to find the best place to photosynthesize. Their sense of time ensures that they never miss a minute of daylight, even during rainy days.

entry: POKENAME将藤折入巢，睡时汲取树枝养分。香水厂商收集藤香，制成能持续数小时的花香水。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME fold vines into their nest to siphon nutrients from tree branches while they sleep. Perfume manufacturers capture the scent produced by the vines to create a floral perfume that lasts for hours.

entry: 放电火花前片刻，POKENAME先散舒缓的迷迭香味。香气让对手误以安全，再迎来电击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a soothing rosemary scent moments before discharging sparks. The aroma lulls opponents into a false sense of security before the shock hits.

entry: POKENAME躲叶堆下或岩后，避捕食者。友善训练家旅途中碰见，它就给颗种子，表示信任。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME hide beneath piles of leaves or behind rocks to avoid predators. If a friendly Trainer happens to stumble upon a POKENAME during their adventure, the POKENAME will give them a seed as a sign of its trust.

entry: POKENAME气味有些像金银花。暮春，它开心地在盛花草甸打滚。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME possesses a scent that smells vaguely of honeysuckle. During late spring, it rolls around in blooming meadows happily.

entry: POKENAME高速旋转头叶，便能飞，自然释放的甜香，让心情振奋。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME flies around by rapidly spinning the leaf on its head. It naturally produces a sweet aroma that uplifts one's mood.

entry: POKENAME在满花草甸欢快轻跑，嬉戏时，花粉黏上身，又带给别的花，完成授粉。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME frolic in flower-filled meadows, prancing around jubilantly. Pollen gets stuck to their body as they do so, and eventually transfers onto other flowers, pollinating them.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME来回摇头，让脸上的叶子散出甜香，帮助自己入睡。叶片一生都在生长，能产生充足的氧气，使它在水下也能呼吸。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: At night, POKENAME shakes its head back and forth which causes the leaves on its face to release a sweet fragrance that helps it sleep. These leaves grow throughout its life and help generate enough oxygen to help POKENAME breathe underwater.

entry: POKENAME背有叶球茎，可采来煮汤。这些绿叶，味道甜爽。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a leafy bulb on their back that can be harvested to make soups. These leafy greens have a sweet and refreshing taste.

entry: POKENAME颈边的每个叶芽旁，都藏细藤。头叶的宜人香气，让人平静。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hide thin vines around each of the leafy buds growing around their neck. The leaf atop their heads produces a pleasant scent that helps people calm down.

entry: POKENAME脸叶，坚固得如其余身体的钢，添一层保护。只有吐出甜得窒息的气息、迷惑别人时，才收叶露脸。
author: sk372
source: The leaf around POKENAME's face is as sturdy as the steel on the rest of its body, giving it added protection. It only pulls back to reveal its face when it breathes out a suffocatingly sweet breath to disorient others.

entry: POKENAME爪锐如刀，煮过、切碎，会放薄荷香，深受厨师珍视。野外，它则用爪切香草，给自己配餐。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's razor-sharp claws are prized by chefs, as boiling and chopping them releases a minty aroma. In the wild, it uses these claws to slice herbs for its meals.

entry: POKENAME爬树，打落树果吃。它主要食草，不屑猎其他宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME climb trees to knock down berries to eat. They are primarily herbivorous and have a disdain for hunting other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME头叶产甜香种子。它吃有机物，将其分解为堆肥，维持温度与黏稠皮肤。
author: the_fireplace
source: POKENAME produces sweet smelling seeds in the leaf atop its head. It eats and composts organic matter to maintain its temperature and keep its skin gooey.

entry: POKENAME吸大量阳光，点燃壳内火，让其充满能量。火虽能战捕食者，也烧穿草壳，因此之后，它又去河里浇灭。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME absorbs lots of sunlight to ignite the flames within its shell and have them bursting with energy. While these flames give it the power to fight predators, they also burn through its grass shell, so it douses them in rivers afterwards.

entry: POKENAME虽覆厚毛，却很不耐寒。遮眼的叶，极其敏感，帮助辨认所处位置。
author: toniaglitched
source: Although POKENAME have a thick layer of fur covering its body, it is horrible at dealing with cold temperatures. The leaves that cover POKENAME's eyes are very sensitive and help it locate itself.

entry: 晴天，最适合看POKENAME群在空中拍翼。它们会用凉风，托起人类与宝可梦，邀请玩耍。
author: fierysakura23
source: Sunny days are perfect for watching schools of POKENAME flutter about in the sky. They are known to play with people and Pokémon alike by lifting them up in the air with a cool breeze.

entry: POKENAME的香气，会让附近对象恐慌。气味久留空气，人类与宝可梦，都感不安。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases an aroma that triggers a sense of panic in those nearby. The scent lingers in the air, unsettling both Pokémon and people alike.

entry: POKENAME每次命中，都放出新鲜莳萝般的气味。打得越重，香就越浓。
author: .izik
source: Each successful strike from POKENAME releases a fresh dill-like scent. The stronger the strike, the more potent the aroma.

entry: POKENAME常模仿店主，动作、表情精准得出奇。完美复制了谁，就放出清新的草药香。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME frequently mimics shopkeepers, matching their gestures and expressions with surprising accuracy. When it perfectly copies someone, it emits a refreshing herbal fragrance.

entry: POKENAME白天游泳，叶始终在水上，靠光合作用多取能。腹下种子的甜香，也吸引铁炮鱼。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME keeps its leaf above the water as it swims during the day, giving it more energy as it photosynthesizes sunlight. Remoraid are attracted to the sweet scent of the seeds on its underbelly.

entry: POKENAME扇叶，把安神花香散在周围。虽宜人、有效，嗅觉敏锐者，却明显觉得香得有些假。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can flutter its leaves to waft a calming floral scent around it. Though pleasant and effective at soothing others, the aroma feels noticeably artificial to those with sharp senses.

entry: POKENAME攀住树枝，伸出尾巴假扮叶片，躲避捕食者。它的食物中，有很大一部分是用舌头吸取的树液。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME will hide itself from predators by holding onto tree branches and sticking out its tail to pretend to be a leaf. Much of its diet consists of tree sap that it extracts with its tongue.

entry: POKENAME头叶随心情，散不同香气。每只都有悉心照料的小树果园，选来吃的果，再用火花烤熟。
author: chibitales
source: The leaf on POKENAME's head produces different scents depending on its mood. Each individual of this species has its own small garden of berries it tends to with diligence. Berries it chooses to eat are roasted with an Ember attack.

entry: POKENAME常出没于乡村。共感能力让它对农田与荒野都同样悉心照料。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are often found around rural communities. Their empathic powers lead them to tend to farmland and wilderness alike with equal care.

entry: POKENAME体色能融入任何地盘，叶却只能变成四季叶片的自然颜色。因此，它藏在枝叶间，才能好好伪装。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME's body can shift hues to blend in with any territory, its leaf can only become the natural colors that foliage takes with the seasons. As such, it hides away among leafy tree branches where it can camouflage properly.

entry: POKENAME体内树汁，有磁化铁微粒，能排斥星球磁场，浮起身体。受袭，它尽量升高，散甜香，盼平息下方敌意。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: The sap flowing through POKENAME's body contains magnetized iron particles, allowing it to hover by repelling the world's magnetic field. When attacked, it floats as high as possible, releasing a sweet scent in hopes of pacifying the foe below.

entry: POKENAME尽力帮忙照料植物，用牙剪多余枝，让矮小植物得到更多阳光。
author: chaotic_aspergers
source: POKENAME does its best to help take care of plants. It trims spare branches with it teeth so that shorter plants can receive more sunlight.

entry: POKENAME靠头叶光合作用，取得大部分能量。无法合成的养分，则由后脑小嘴，咬过路飞虫补充。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME gains most of its energy from photosynthesis thanks to the leaf on its head. To obtain the nutrients it can't synthesize, the small mouth on the back of its head snaps at flying insects that pass by.

entry: POKENAME察觉龙卷风将近，就释放强烈罗勒般的香味，传得很远，警告附近宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME senses an approaching tornado, it releases an intense basil-like scent. This aroma spreads far, acting as a warning signal to Pokémon nearby.

entry: 这是极稀有的草甸宝可梦，性情与气味都宜人。宽叶比未融合的组成物种，更能遮阴、光合，却也让动作更笨拙。
author: bobosmith01
source: An extremely rare meadow-dwelling Pokémon known for its pleasant nature and smell. Its wide leaves make for better shade and photosynthetic ability compared to its unfused components, but makes them more clumsy, too.

entry: POKENAME叶片散出茄番果般的辛香。它爬高树，找坚果吃，再把壳扔给下方对象。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's leaf exudes a spicy aroma akin to a Tamato Berry. It scales tall trees to find and eat nuts, then throws the nut shells at those below.

entry: POKENAME用泡沫光线与飞叶快刀，打落够不着的水果、树果。它太骄傲，不肯求助或受助，送上好食物，也会拒绝。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME uses Bubble Beam and Razor Leaf attacks to knock down fruits and berries that are too high for it to reach. It is too proud to ask for or accept help and will turn down perfectly good food if offered to it.

entry: POKENAME不爱打架，宁愿让刀刃的甜香，安抚对手。与钢刃不同，它的刃在阳光与水分滋养下，还能再生。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME would rather calm its opponent with its blade's sweet aroma than fight. Unlike steel, the blade regenerates in sunlight and moisture.

entry: POKENAME挥刃，叶饰便散宜人香气。战斗越久，香越削弱敌人斗志，让它取得优势。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's leafy tassels emit a pleasant scent as it swings its blades through the air. The aroma weakens a foe's fighting spirit the longer a battle goes on, giving POKENAME the advantage.

entry: POKENAME叶刃，切钛也轻松。挥动时，还会散宜人的糖香，迷惑捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's leaf-blade can slice through titanium with ease. As it swings, it emits a pleasant sugary scent that confuses predators.

entry: 亲近训练家的POKENAME，会送出自己的花瓣。花瓣泡成茶，味道浓郁，还能安抚心绪。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME that have become close to their Trainers will give them their petals. These petals can be used to brew a tea that has a rich, calming flavor.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME起舞，甜香便从叶片飘出，吸引附近草属性宝可梦，前来当观众。
author: sk372
source: During the night, POKENAME's dancing movements create a sweet scent that wafts from its leaf. The smell draws in nearby Grass-type Pokémon, granting POKENAME an audience to enjoy its dance.

entry: POKENAME伪装高明，极难寻踪，尽力躲人。满月时，可能成群望天、唱跳，可这景象，极少被观察。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are masters of camouflage and extremely elusive, hiding from people as best they can. During a full moon, groups may gather and stare in the sky, performing dances and songs. This phenomenon has rarely ever been observed.

entry: POKENAME闻起来，大人觉得臭，孩子却说，像花园，让人想陪玩。破布下，带油的根须正在蠕动。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME stinks to adults, but children describe its aroma as a flower garden that makes them want to play with it. Oily roots shift just beneath its rag.

entry: POKENAME为避战，会挥叶放宜人香气，试着安抚好斗宝可梦。若失败，便迅速飞走，不再冲突。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: To avoid fighting, POKENAME waves its leaf and creates a pleasant aroma in an attempt to calm aggressive Pokémon. If this fails to work, it swiftly flies away to avoid further conflict.

entry: POKENAME是小公寓里受欢迎的伙伴，既为室内添绿意，又能生火，节省取暖开支。学生租住的公寓里，尤其常见它们。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular Pokémon to keep in small apartments, their presence adding a lush feel to the interior whilst their ability to produce fire helps to keep heating bills low. Student rented flats are an especially common home for them.

entry: POKENAME能感知附近波导。若发现强敌，就散罗勒般香气，兼表谨慎与尊重。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can sense the aura of those nearby. If it detects a strong opponent, it emits a basil-like scent, signaling both caution and respect.

entry: POKENAME只靠阳光维生，一天大多静卧。实在太少动，背上便长出厚苔。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME survives exclusively on sunlight, allowing it to lie stationary for most of the day. Due to rarely ever moving around, thick layers of moss will start to grow on its back.

entry: POKENAME只在洁净的水域生活。阳光明媚时，常能看见它们在岸边晒太阳、打滚。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lives exclusively in clean waters. When the sun is shining, they can be seen rolling around in the sun on the shore.

entry: POKENAME懊恼，就原地跳，释放百里香般气味。这是警告，因为强力放电将至。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME grows frustrated, it hops in place while releasing a thyme-like scent. This is a warning sign, as it is about to unleash a powerful electrical discharge.

entry: POKENAME捕猎时，靠身上的叶片，融入丛林枝叶，伪装自己。体内能量充裕，叶子就会发出鲜亮的绿光。
author: mistymagius
source: The leaves on POKENAME's body help it camouflage amongst the jungle leaves while hunting for prey. If it has an abundance of energy in its body, its leaves will glow with a vibrant green light.

entry: POKENAME经头叶吹口哨、奏歌。尖声让其他宝可梦困倦，有些听着就睡了。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME whistle out songs through the leaf on their head. The sharp sound of the whistle makes other Pokémon drowsy, some falling asleep during the performance.

entry: POKENAME在公园扮幼童，盼被带回家。身上浓姜黄味，却让人能识破。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME disguises itself as toddlers in parks, hoping to be taken home. A strong turmeric scent clings to it, making it possible to identify a fake.

entry: POKENAME尾焰与头叶，都反映健康。它须极小心，别让两者靠近。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: The flame on POKENAME's tail and the leaf on its head are both indicators of its health. It must take great care to keep the two away from each other.

entry: POKENAME每次拍翼，都放淡淡木槿香。花香先分散敌人注意，再以超音波使其眩晕。
author: .izik
source: Each flap of POKENAME's wings releases a delicate hibiscus fragrance. This floral scent distracts foes just before it stuns them with Supersonic.

entry: 它黄昏前最活跃。休息时，钻地吸附近植物的汁与养分。取食植物种类越多，POKENAME的叶就越健康。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is most active just before dusk. When it rests, it burrows into the ground, sucking the fluids and nutrients from nearby plants. POKENAME's leaves are most healthy when it feeds off of a wide variety of plants.

entry: POKENAME虽小，只需得到一点力量就能构成威胁。黑暗处常回荡着它的笑声。
author: inksans201x
source: Despite its small stature, POKENAME can become a threat if given an ounce of power. Its laughter can be heard echoing in dark places.

entry: POKENAME为健康，一天大多须光合，无奈有些懒。它虽想放松，可见心爱之物，仍会跳上跳下，尖叫、吼鸣。
author: bobosmith01
source: Somewhat slothful by necessity, POKENAME must photosynthesize for most of the day in order to stay healthy. Although it tries to stay relaxed, if it spots something it likes, it will hop up and down and yip and roar.

entry: POKENAME体弱，野外威胁多，便吃谜芝果帮助生存。它从背部长藤，推开捕食者，再沿冰片滑走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME eat Enigma Berries to help them survive in the wild because they are fragile creatures that get exposed to many threats. They sprout vines from their back to push predators away before sliding away on a sheet of ice.

entry: POKENAME跳舞，为同伴加油，散宜人花香。臂上植物，还能成批喷麻痹花粉，扑向靠太近者的脸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME emits a pleasant floral scent as it dances and cheers on its allies. The plants on its arms can spray batches of paralyzing pollen in the faces of those that come too near.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时互蹭叶片，产生甜香。据知，能帮助缓解头痛。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME rubs its leaves when it dances to produce a sweet fragrance. This scent is known to help alleviate headaches.

entry: POKENAME在灌丛旁起舞，从叶撒粉，帮助生长，再优雅挥利叶，修剪过密枝叶。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dances beside bushes, releasing pollen from its leaves to aid their growth. It trims overgrown shrubs with elegant swings of its sharp leaf.

entry: POKENAME常吃海藻与水草。用餐时很凶，觉得什么可能来抢，就会攻击。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME are commonly seen eating seaweed and other underwater plants. POKENAME become aggressive while eating and attack anything they think might try to steal their food.

entry: POKENAME花香随心情，反常变化：开心，恶臭驱人；难过，反而宜人，引人靠近。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's flower emits paradoxical scents based on its mood: when happy it emits a noxious scent that repels others, but when sad it releases a pleasant scent that entices others closer.

entry: POKENAME友善，爱与训练家、野生宝可梦交往。开心就散甜香，尤其雨天或晴日。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME enjoys engaging with both Trainers and wild Pokémon, showcasing its friendly nature. It releases a sweet scent when happy, especially during rainy or sunny days.

entry: POKENAME通常住林缘，找不受打扰的空地光合。头花释放毒粉，妥善精制后，却能泡成提神饮剂。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME usually lives along the edges of forests, seeking clearings where it can photosynthesize undisturbed. The flower on its head releases toxic pollen that, when properly refined, can be brewed into invigorating infusions.

entry: POKENAME头叶撒孢子，让树皮长蘑菇。背部叶状真菌，则被一些餐厅，当淡味配菜。
author: sk372
source: The leaf on POKENAME's head spreads spores that grow mushrooms on the bark of trees. The leaf-shaped fungi on its back are used in some restaurants as a mildly flavorful garnish for foods.

entry: POKENAME寻找能让头上叶片充分照到阳光的地方。找到理想位置后，它就用爪子挖洞，埋住下半身，以便吸取水分。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME seeks out locations that give the leaf on top of its head plenty of sunlight. After finding the ideal spot, it digs a hole in the ground with its claws and buries its lower body so that it can draw up water.

entry: POKENAME喷出翠绿粉，一碰敌人，就会麻痹。粉易在空中散开，成为对抗捕食者的天然防御。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME expels a verdant powder that paralyzes foes on contact. The powder spreads easily through the air, creating a natural defense against predators.

entry: POKENAME快转头叶，向周围喷出甜而蓬松的孢子。孢子很甜，可大量接触，会引发过敏。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME rapidly spin the leaves on their head to spray sweet puffy spores around them. These spores are very sweet, but can cause allergic reactions in heavy doses.

entry: POKENAME尾焰与头叶，都反映健康。它须极小心，别让两者靠近。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: The flame on POKENAME's tail and the leaf on its head are both indicators of its health. It must take great care to keep the two away from each other.

entry: POKENAME用坚韧的爪子翻土，破开坚硬的果壳。感到威胁时，尾上的火焰会剧烈摇曳。它挥动叶片，散发浓郁而刺鼻的气味，阻止敌人靠近。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME uses its tough claws to till soil and to break open hard nuts. The flame upon its tail flicks wildly when it feels threatened. To keep foes at bay, it waves about its leaf that exudes a sharp, yet rich, scent.

entry: POKENAME睡在地下，只露一片叶。叶放恶臭，劝退多数捕食者。
author: .izik
source: While sleeping underground, POKENAME leaves a single leaf exposed at the surface. This leaf emits a foul odor that deters most predators.

entry: POKENAME懒得很，最爱整天打盹。晒够阳光，它就用尾端的大叶子给自己遮阴，继续睡上好几个小时。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a particularly lazy creature that loves to spend the day napping. Once it's full of sunlight, it uses the large leaf at the end of its tail to shade itself so it can keep sleeping for hours.

entry: POKENAME疲倦时，能在阳光下睡上整天，补充能量。难得醒来，它便试着抓走任何闪亮的东西，可这很快又将它累坏，不久便倒头睡去。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME is tired, it can sleep the entire day under the sun to recharge its energy. In the rare moments it is awake, it tries to snatch anything that glitters—but since that activity quickly tires it out, it soon collapses back to sleep.

entry: POKENAME用尾大叶吸光，也遮眼防强光，方便盯对手。虽极懒、急着睡，爪却能打出惊人强击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses the large leaf on its tail to absorb sunlight and shield its eyes from glare, helping it keep track of its opponent. Though very lazy and eager to sleep, its claws can deliver surprisingly powerful blows.

entry: 野生POKENAME囤爱吃的树果，用头叶挥落。可散出的宜人香气，又常引来其他宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME hoard berries that they love the taste of. They swing the leaves upon their heads to knock berries free, though this also casts about a pleasant aroma that oft attracts other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME叶片温暖，脱落也如此。古医者曾用来衬毯，或制外敷药。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME's leaves are warm to the touch, even after they've been shed. Healers in ages past would use these leaves to line blankets and make poultices.

entry: POKENAME寻找储有矿泉水的地方，迅速吸取滋养身体所需的养分。喝完后，它们便在向阳的草地睡下，沐浴阳光。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME search for reservoirs of mineral water to quickly absorb the nutrients they need to nourish their body. Once they finish drinking the mineral water, they fall asleep in a sunny patch of grass to soak up the sun's rays.

entry: POKENAME叶片近似汗腺。训练费力，叶上就凝露，练得越久，花香越浓。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's leaf acts similarly to a sweat gland. As it trains and exerts itself, dew gathers along the leaf's petal, and a floral aroma grows more and more potent as the training continues.

entry: POKENAME摆动细软身体、摇叶，将甜香散向周围。它讨厌恶臭，尽力使臭地方的空气，清新起来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME wafts a sweet scent in the areas around it by swinging around its thin, flexible body to wave its leaves. It detests foul odors and tries its best to freshen the air in stinky areas.

entry: POKENAME十分耐心，等对手失去平衡，才会出击。它们用藤蔓绊倒对方，再从嘴里喷水，几分钟内就能战胜同伴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are patient creatures that wait until their opponent is staggered before striking. By tripping their opponent with vines and spraying water from their mouths, they can achieve victory over their peers in a few minutes.

entry: POKENAME爱在潮处懒躺，看水滴从叶滑落。淡香会让别人，也提不起劲。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys lazing around in moist areas, watching the water droplets drift down off of its leaf. The faint scent wafting from said leaf invokes a feeling of listlessness in others.

entry: 融合的奇特现象，让POKENAME最爱无需咀嚼的汤水食物，尤其全天然食材煮的汤。
author: bobosmith01
source: Due to a quirk in Pokémon Fusion, POKENAME's favorite meal consists of brothy food that does not require the need to chew. It especially loves soups made with all-natural ingredients.

entry: POKENAME结合电磁力与拍叶，浮在空中。研究显示，它产的电磁波，让附近植物更健康。
author: toniaglitched
source: POKENAME floats in the air using a combination of electromagnetism and the flapping of its leaves. Research indicates that the electromagnetic waves it produces make plants close to it healthier.

entry: POKENAME肉甜多汁，很适合丰盛炖菜。配上大葱棒与头部大叶，就是艰难时日里的一顿美餐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a sweet succulent meat that makes them perfect for hearty stews. When combined with their leek baton and the large leaf on their head, POKENAME are a delicious meal in difficult times.

entry: POKENAME更爱冷水游泳，先把长叶浸水测温。若是暖海，就犹豫许久，才肯进入。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers to swim in cold water. It dips its long leaf into the water to test the temperature, hesitating heavily before entering warmer seas.

entry: POKENAME四处碰未开的花，将黏身涂过植物。被碰过的，开花颜色明显更鲜亮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME goes around touching flowers yet to bloom, smearing its slimy form across the plant. Those plants touched by it are notably more vibrant in coloration when they bloom.

entry: POKENAME颈边的茎，其实是种子束，帮助生长新植物。受袭，就试着用利叶驱敌。
author: mistymagius
source: The stems around POKENAME's neck are actually seed bundles that help it grow new plants. When attacked, it tries to ward off foes with its sharp leaf.

entry: POKENAME蜕下层层茧，确保进化时顺利变态，再吃掉刚蜕的层。据说，味道像欧防风或胡萝卜。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sheds layers of its cocoon to ensure a smooth metamorphosis upon evolution. It then consumes the recently shed layer, which is said to taste like parsnips or carrots.

entry: POKENAME藤蔓长得快，可代替柠檬草，是餐饮业常用原料。配毛崖蟹棒，或一勺呆呆兽炖汤，总有需求。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's vines are a staple in the restaurant industry because it is a fast-growing substitute for lemongrass. Whether it gets paired with seafood like a Klawf Stick or a spoonful of Slowpoke stew, its vines will always be in demand.

entry: 餐厅与面包店主，常放花引野生POKENAME，因为它香得开胃。可这也使城里，它的天敌增多。
author: griddle
source: Restaurant and bakery owners will frequently leave out flowers to draw in wild POKENAME thanks to its appetizing fragrance. This has also led to a rise of their natural predators in urban areas.

entry: POKENAME在多叶灌丛安家，完美融入。每六个月，头叶就干枯落下，再长得比从前更强。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME makes its den in leafy underbrush where it can perfectly blend in. Every six months, the leaf on its head dries up and falls, only to regrow even stronger than before.

entry: POKENAME标志气味，兼有平静与振奋，不少训练家争论如何产生。科学家说，近似咖啡，却仍需研究。
author: quackquackattack
source: Trainers debate over how POKENAME produces its trademark scent, which offers a mixture of calm and excitement. Scientists claim that the scent is similar to coffee, but further study is required.

entry: POKENAME外表与性情凶猛，据信是融合唤回更史前的天性。头叶又硬又坚，拿来棍击任何打扰者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's aggressive appearance and disposition are thought to be due to fusion reviving a more prehistoric disposition. The leaf on its head is very sturdy and rigid, used to bludgeon anything that bothers it.

entry: POKENAME一咬猎物，就释放刺鼻的葡萄柚般香气。附近宝可梦因此倒胃口，让它不受打扰地大吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME bites down on its prey, it releases a pungent grapefruit-like aroma. This scent causes nearby Pokémon to lose their appetite, allowing POKENAME to feast on its prey without being disturbed.

entry: POKENAME腿部香气，让人振奋。可它们胆小得，不在群里，就动不了。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: The fragrance from POKENAME's legs makes people peppy. However, they're so timid that they can't move unless they are with a swarm.

entry: POKENAME嘴里几乎总带叶与种子，拿来与其他草属性宝可梦交换食物、保护，或只是分享特别好吃的绿叶。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is almost always seen carrying a number of leaves and seeds within its mouth. It trades these with other Grass-type Pokémon in exchange for other foods, protection, or simply to share particularly tasty greens.

entry: POKENAME年长，会埋进肥沃泥土休眠。头侧芽上，长出两只基因完全相同的菊草波。随后，亲体破泥出来，立即进化。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When POKENAME get older, they bury themselves in muddy, fertile soil and become dormant. From the shoots on the side of their head two Chikoper grow, genetically identical to each other. POKENAME then emerges from the mud and promptly evolves.

entry: POKENAME十分关心训练家。若对方觉得自己做不到，它就从颈芽放出振奋香气。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME care deeply about their Trainers. If a POKENAME's Trainer is feeling incapable, the POKENAME will release an invigorating scent from the buds on its neck.

entry: POKENAME头与叶上的小孔，让身体即使泡在泥里，也能呼吸、取能。气味却随地区而异。
author: bobosmith01
source: A small orifice on POKENAME's head and its leaf allows it to breathe and gather energy even if its body is submerged in mud. The smell of POKENAME varies by region.

entry: POKENAME受威胁，会发射颈边硬芽。芽有独特辛辣味，可用于多种菜。
author: mepp.
source: When threatened, POKENAME launches the hardened buds that grow around its neck. These buds have a distinct spicy flavor and are used in a variety of dishes.

entry: POKENAME从食物吸取的化合物，让羽毛散着鲜美咸香。它深受厨师喜爱，羽还拿来给汤增味。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feathers exude a tasty, savoury scent thanks to the compounds they absorb from their food. Their aromatic odour makes them popular companions of chefs, their feathers being used to help bring flavour to broths.

entry: POKENAME常流连于花卉养护网站。它会热心引导使用者，找到资料更加详尽的站点，学习如何妥善照料花园。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is usually spotted hanging around websites based on the subjects of floral upkeep. It's quite helpful in guiding users towards sites that will give them even more details on how to properly care for their gardens.

entry: POKENAME颈芽有独特辛香。年龄增长，味道却温和得多。
author: mepp.
source: The buds on POKENAME's neck have a distinct spicy aroma. As it ages, this fragrance becomes much milder.

entry: 欧雷地区北方一片森林，最近发现一群野生POKENAME。战斗时，臂芽绽成花刃，连最硬巨石也能切。
author: cobalt0135
source: A lounge of wild POKENAME has recently been discovered within a forest up north in the Orre region. The buds on their arms will bloom into flowery blades that can slash through even the toughest of boulders whenever they're in battle.

entry: POKENAME不断散辛香，似能给周围生命添活力。有农人请它看园，让辣椒长得更快、更辣！
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's body is constantly emitting a spicy aroma that seems to energize the life around it. Some farmers use POKENAME as a garden tender to make their peppers grow faster and spicier!

entry: POKENAME摇头叶，哄潜在捕食者睡去。每只头叶，都独一无二。
author: northkira
source: POKENAME swings the leaf on its head to lull potential predators to sleep. Each POKENAME has a unique leaf atop its head.

entry: 盛夏最常见。POKENAME在温暖夜晚起舞，沿途草木繁盛、鲜花开放。据说见它经过，便预示好运。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Most commonly encountered at the height of Summer, plants flourish and flowers bloom in the path left behind as POKENAME dances through the warm evenings. Seeing a POKENAME pass by is said to be a portent of good fortune.

entry: POKENAME常被视为夏日使者，振奋的气息让草木与宝可梦都焕发生机。贵族训练家也很珍视它，优雅的外貌能为夏日舞会增添庄重。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are often viewed as heralds of summer, their invigorating auras breathing life into plants and Pokémon alike. They are also highly prized by aristocratic Trainers, their elegant appearances lending a dignified air to summer balls.

entry: POKENAME手臂上的刀刃锋利无比，连最坚硬的金属也能切开。刃口仅厚0.05毫米，却极其耐用，有史以来从未有人见过它折断。
author: huh.7
source: The blades on POKENAME's arms are so sharp that they can cut through even the toughest metal. The edge of the blade is only 0.05 mm thick and possesses extreme durability. No one in history has ever observed them breaking.

entry: POKENAME遇险，叶的辛香更浓。它借刺激效果，清醒、集中心神，将精神力量提至惊人境界。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: When POKENAME is in danger, the spicy scent of its leaves intensifies. POKENAME uses the scent's stimulating effects to clear and focus its mind, raising its psychic powers to formidable heights.

entry: POKENAME虽小，却强得出奇。不试着咬一切会动的东西时，就爱在好阳光下取暖。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME is surprisingly strong for such a small Pokémon. When it is not trying to bite anything that moves, it enjoys keeping warm in a nice sunny spot.

entry: POKENAME颈叶能制恢复精神的茶。外表虽吓人，谁平和靠近，它都乐意分享。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The leaves on the neck of POKENAME are used to make restorative tea. Despite having an imposing appearance, POKENAME gladly share their leaves with anyone who approaches peacefully.

entry: POKENAME的预知能力，能让它察觉会使人心灵遭受重创的灾难。虽然无法阻止灾难本身，叶片散发的平和香气，却能在事后安抚受害者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's precognitive abilities alert it to disasters that will take a heavy emotional toll on people. Though it can do nothing to divert the disasters themselves, its leaf emits a calming scent that can help soothe the victims after the fact.

entry: POKENAME花芽的独特香气，帮助人保持活力。它体贴，乐意引导拉伸等运动，是理疗康复者的好伙伴。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's buds produce a particular aroma that helps keep people energized. Its caring nature makes it a useful partner for those in physical therapy, happily guiding others through stretches and other exercises.

entry: POKENAME的香气，会悄悄勾起别人的战意。它自己倒乐得如此，毕竟，最爱与人决斗。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's scent subtly influences others to want to fight it, much to the joy to POKENAME, as it likes to duel.

entry: POKENAME从叶的辛香汲取力量。香越浓，双剑就越近乎不可阻挡。
author: getz22
source: POKENAME draws strength from the spicy aroma emitted by its leaves. As the fragrance intensifies, its two swords become nearly unstoppable.

entry: POKENAME叶闻着香，吃却苦。据信，泡茶能让谈判前头脑集中，有些企业总裁，见竞争公司前就喝。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Despite the fragrant smell, the leaves that grow from POKENAME are bitter to taste. Tea brewed with their leaves is said to focus the mind ahead of negotiations, with some CEOs drinking POKENAME tea before meetings with rival companies.

entry: POKENAME追猎时，毛放酸香，同时刺激自己与猎物。双方肾上腺素上涌，跑得更快，可猎物体力，往往更早耗尽。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: When chasing prey, POKENAME's fur releases a sour aroma that acts as a stimulant for them and their prey. Both are filled with adrenaline and run faster, but POKENAME's prey will likely run out of stamina much sooner.

entry: POKENAME颈部花苞的辛香能让人振奋，因此常参与山崩救援。
author: melodydelune
source: The buds around its neck emit a spicy aroma that acts as a stimulant for humans. POKENAME are often used in rescues during landslides.

entry: POKENAME尾边每片卷叶，都辛味十足。每年有活动，香料鉴赏家聚来，尝叶做的美食。
author: mepp.
source: Each curled leaf around POKENAME's tail is packed full of spicy flavors. There is an annual event where spice connoisseurs gather to sample delicious foods made with these leaves.

entry: POKENAME常在园艺中心，帮忙照顾植物。它给温室带来阳光，又用多叶尾遮阴，细心维持完美平衡。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are commonly found in garden centres to help tend the plants that grow there. They provide sunlight to greenhouses and shade with their many leafed tails to the plants under their care, carefully keeping everything in a perfect balance.

entry: POKENAME夏季常在海边，爱与别人玩。搁浅时，就打滚，猛喷含泥土与各种椒类化学成分的气体，推动自己前进。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME remains by the seashore frequently during the summer season, as it loves to play with others. When beached, they roll around and forcefully emit a gas that includes dirt and chemicals found in various peppers to propel themselves forward.

entry: POKENAME靠天然伪装，潜近其他宝可梦，再用连番利叶与强雷，迅速使猎物无法行动。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their natural camouflage to sneak up on other Pokémon. With a flurry of razor-sharp leaves and potent lightning strikes, they can quickly incapacitate their prey.

entry: 它精力旺，晴天尤其如此，阳光让它战斗出色。下雨，它则先用大头叶护尾焰，直到找到更安全的庇护。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is incredibly energetic, especially on sunny days when the light gives it the spirit to perform greatly in battle. When it rains, its priority is to protect the flame on its tail, using the large leaf on its head until it can find safer shelter.

entry: POKENAME叶缘如刀，摇叶就能抵御太近的捕食者。唾液毒素虽害人，却有助改善土壤酸碱平衡。
author: fiordaliso
source: The edges of its leaves are razor-sharp, so by shaking them POKENAME can defend itself from predators that get too close. Its saliva contains toxins that are harmful to humans but useful for improving the soil's pH balance.

entry: POKENAME兼有月桂叶的繁茂绿意与好坏星的水中适应力。住在海岸，用叶状触手捉猎物、吸收阳光获取养分。
author: nightwingjay
source: POKENAME combines the lush greenery of Bayleef with the aquatic adaptability of Mareanie. It dwells in coastal regions, where it uses its leafy tentacles to ensnare prey and absorb sunlight for nourishment.

entry: POKENAME再生能力强，肢体只要切得利落，就能安全截下。味道温和、如带青草味的秋葵，能为菜增草药与辛香层次。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME limbs can be safely severed with a clean cut due to its regenerative abilities. The limbs themselves have a mild and grassy okra flavor that helps bring herbal and spicy notes.

entry: POKENAME背部真菌，围着一圈叶，彼此交换养分，共同繁盛。叶的诱香，还引来其他宝可梦，沾上蘑菇孢子。
author: .jerden
source: The fungus on POKENAME's back is surrounded by a ring of leaves, and they exchange nutrients so that both flourish. The enticing smell of the leaves also lures in other Pokémon to have spores from the mushroom scattered on them.

entry: POKENAME洞中，满是叶片释放的舒缓香气，能让幼崽平静，不在地下惊慌。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's burrow is filled with a soothing scent released from its leaf. This aroma keeps its young calm and prevents panic underground.

entry: POKENAME采的树果，虽全是自己爱吃的，仍毫不犹豫分享。颈上每片卷叶，都有不同香味。
author: infinex21
source: Although the berries they collect are those they love to eat, POKENAME will not hesitate to share them with others. Each of the curled-up leaves around their neck exudes a different scent.

entry: POKENAME头叶产消毒树汁。手一脏，就挤叶、搓手，洗得干净。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce an antiseptic sap from the leaf on their head. Whenever they get their hands dirty, they squeeze the leaf and rub their hands together to get their hands clean.

entry: 对战中，POKENAME乱挥叶臂，少有技巧与准头。喂奇秘果后，却能看准，精准划伤对手。
author: quackquackattack
source: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME swing their leafy arm wildly with little tact or precision. By feeding them a Micle Berry, they develop the insight to land lacerations with great precision.

entry: POKENAME头部卷叶含毒，对小宝可梦与孩子略危险，成人却可安全食用。物质有适度灼热感，用于许多辣菜。
author: chibitales
source: The curled leaves on POKENAME's head contain a poisonous substance that, while slightly dangerous to small Pokémon and children, is safe to eat for adults. The substance causes a moderate burning sensation and is used in many spicy dishes.

entry: POKENAME大吃苔藓树皮，身上就长更多芽。石壁若垂满大卷叶，便是它栖居的明确信号。
author: soup1900
source: A POKENAME's body sprouts more buds when it chows down on mossy bark. Large rock walls draped with large, curled leaves are a telltale sign that a POKENAME lives there.

entry: POKENAME叶上安神香气，会随炮喷水而散开。经验厨师训练它，帮助熬汤底，或给蒸菜添味。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME emit a fragrant, soothing aroma from their leaves that spreads when they shoot water from their cannons. Experienced chefs train POKENAME to help them create the base of soup broths or add flavor while steaming meals.

entry: POKENAME背花尚未完全发育，便从触角散甜香，引特定虫属性宝可梦传粉。
author: mistymagius
source: The flower on POKENAME's back has not fully developed yet, so it produces a sweet scent from its antennae to lure in certain Bug-type Pokémon for pollination.

entry: POKENAME触角的甜香，有助缓解焦虑情绪。许多治疗师用它，让来访者感到舒适。
author: mepp.
source: The sweet aroma that is produced by POKENAME's antennae helps soothe feelings of anxiety. Many therapists use the Pokémon to foster a comfortable environment for their clients.

entry: POKENAME用自然死去的野生宝可梦骨制工具，沿路收种子、树果，再用来恢复受火灾或病害破坏的森林。
author: griddle
source: POKENAME fashion tools from the bones of wild Pokémon that die of natural causes and collect seeds and berries from wherever they roam. They use these to revitalize forests that have been ravaged by fire or blight.

entry: POKENAME爱和平，宁用安抚气场，平息对手。只有最后，才会连出精准快拳，将其打倒。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME is a pacifist, preferring to calm opponents with its soothing aura. As a last resort, it will deliver a flurry of precise punches to bring them down.

entry: POKENAME能光合，却必须在开阔阳光下，便依赖其他宝可梦护卫。花越大，就越接近进化。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has the ability to photosynthesize. As it must do this in the open sun, it relies on another Pokémon to protect it from predators. The larger its flower is, the closer it is to evolution.

entry: POKENAME吃花，转成让对手安心的甜香气体。气体也能帮植物，以破纪录的速度生长。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME consumes flowers to convert them into a sweet-smelling gas that makes its opponents feel at ease. The gas also helps plants grow at record speed.

entry: POKENAME以鼻角，钻最硬的土，给农人开播种沟。春天，颈花释放舒缓香气，安抚烦乱心灵。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses the horn on its snout to drill through even the hardest ground, carving furrows for farmers to sow their seeds. In spring, the flower around its neck releases a soothing fragrance that calms troubled hearts.

entry: POKENAME治愈植物与宝可梦。吐息能复活枯死植物，蛋也含多种草药与药物的疗愈力量。
author: pinkyoshi2350
source: POKENAME serves as a healer to plants and Pokémon alike. It can revive dead plants with its breath, and its eggs can bestow healing powers from a myriad of herbs and medicine.

entry: POKENAME用花的甜香，防止捕食者伤蛋。香气让对方平静到，不再攻击。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME uses the sweet scent of its flower to prevent predators from harming its eggs. The aroma will calm the predators down to the point of no longer attacking.

entry: POKENAME拍花状翼，释放淡绿花粉，促进周围常春藤与蕨类生长。历来，优雅飞姿，启发过无数艺术家与诗人。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME flaps its flower-like wings, it releases a greenish pollen that promotes the growth of ivy and ferns in the surrounding area. Its graceful flight has inspired countless artists and poets throughout history.

entry: POKENAME花瓣香气，近似热带水果。核心慢慢吸收阳光，再将少许能量，分给需要助力的植物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's petals are known for their pleasant scent, akin to tropical fruit. Its core absorbs sunlight over time, which it shares in low amounts with plant life in need of a little boost.

entry: POKENAME靠安神香气，以及似乎高超的调解本领，轻易平息最愤怒好斗的宝可梦。人们认为，可能是精神力量使然。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is easily able to quell even the most enraged and aggressive Pokémon thanks to its relaxing aroma and, seemingly, its ability to expertly mediate between disputes. It is thought its psychic powers may be the cause for this adeptness.

entry: POKENAME颈瓣散出令人舒缓的咸海气息。日照，或零下低温，都能恢复能量。
author: bobogagabobo
source: The petals around POKENAME's neck produce a soothing, salty ocean scent. POKENAME can restore energy by either being in sunlight or being in below-freezing temperatures.

entry: POKENAME花瓣气味，随饮食改变，据说色调也可能随环境变。最一致的，是它们在场，似乎都能让多数对象平静。
author: infinex21
source: The scent of POKENAME petals changes based on their diets. Supposedly the hue of their petals may change based on their environment. The most consistent factor between their species is that their presence seems to be calming for most individuals.

entry: POKENAME在水源旁睡觉，尾尖浸在水里，被动吸收水分。它们能安全吸收任何种类的水，可奇怪的是，花瓣总散出海风般的气味。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME will sleep beside any source of water with the tips of their tails dipped in the water so they may passively absorb it. They can safely absorb any type of water, though oddly their petals always exude a sea breeze scent.

entry: POKENAME前臂鲜亮的爪状结构，看似危险，其实钝、又软，用来表演复杂求偶动作。
author: occulusmalus
source: Though the brightly-coloured claw-like structures on POKENAME's forearms look dangerous, they are actually blunt and soft, used for complex courtship displays.

entry: POKENAME的花香，让附近训练家与宝可梦疲倦。它身旁睡着好几只，并不少见。
author: elibromax314
source: The flowers of POKENAME give off a lethargic aroma, causing nearby Trainers and Pokémon to become tired. It is not uncommon to find several Pokémon sleeping around one.

entry: POKENAME花香能把别人安抚得睡着。身上橙橙果，比普通的更大、更有营养，它乐意与朋友分享。
author: infinex21
source: The aroma of POKENAME's flower can soothe most others so much that they may fall asleep. The Oran Berries growing upon its body are richer and larger than average Oran Berries, which it happily shares with its friends.

entry: POKENAME似乎经融合，唤醒某些史前DNA。长颈伸过树梢晒太阳，得以更好地引导强大日光束。
author: lupa
source: POKENAME seems to have unlocked some prehistoric DNA through Pokémon fusion. Its long neck is suited for catching sunrays above the tops of trees. This allows it to better channel a powerful Solar Beam attack.

entry: 与大竺葵平常气味不同，这形态的花味，激发别人斗志。POKENAME自身潜在战斗本能也被唤起，便用香气，引来挑战。
author: sk372
source: Unlike Meganium's normal scent, this form's flower emits an odor meant to stoke the fighting spirit in others. Because this form brings out POKENAME's own latent battle instincts, it uses the odor to entice others into giving it a challenge.

entry: 融合后，POKENAME展现蓝蒂尔地区，某种罕见现象的特征。许多花在身旁，更鲜亮、发光，受它的光芒滋养，焕发生机。
author: sk372
source: After fusion, POKENAME exhibits traits of a rare phenomenon from the Lental region. Many flowers bloom brighter and glow in its presence, rejuvenated by the light its body emanates.

entry: POKENAME身叶吸阳光，造强力火焰冲击。它产的香气，常烟熏而宜人。
author: captainjefejefe
source: The leaves extending from POKENAME's body captures sunlight to create powerful flame blasts. Oftentimes, the fragrances it creates are smoky and pleasant.

entry: 高速振翼，沿途留下花香，安抚闻者，尤其POKENAME的虫属性猎物。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The rapid beating of its wings leaves a flowery aroma in its wake. This aroma calms those who smell it, especially POKENAME's Bug type prey.

entry: POKENAME找种子吃时，总会留几颗随身带着。它们精心选择土壤条件最合适的地方播种，让新植物开得格外好。
author: sk372
source: When poking around for seeds to eat, POKENAME always makes sure to save a few to carry with it. It carefully places the seeds in the perfect soil conditions so that the new plants will bloom exceptionally well.

entry: POKENAME住矿泉水库，向水中注花粉，制强效消毒水。受伤宝可梦一来，它总愿用矿泉水清伤口。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live in mineral water reservoirs and infuse the water with their pollen to create a powerful disinfectant. They are always willing to help injured Pokémon that show up to their reservoirs by cleaning wounds with the mineral water.

entry: 野生POKENAME的能量全来自太阳。晒太阳时不必进食，它便改用牙齿相互摩擦，磨短快速生长的牙，结果牙齿损伤十分常见。
author: bobosmith01
source: A wild POKENAME gets all of its energy from the sun. As it does not need to eat while basking in the sun, it resorts to grinding its own quick-growing teeth down by rubbing them up against one another. As a result, dental trauma is common.

entry: POKENAME坐在阳光下，宜人花香就明显加浓。人类与宝可梦的愤怒情绪，都能有效安抚。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's pleasant floral scent noticeably intensifies as it sits in sunlight. The aroma is known to be effective in soothing feelings of anger in both people and Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME住少花寒地，花粉散甜香，引授粉者聚成小群。产的蜜比普通更黏滑，却被视为珍馐。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME live in cold areas where few flowers bloom. Small colonies of pollinators establish where POKENAME live as they produce pollen which emits a sweet fragrance. Honey made from POKENAME pollen is slimier than normal but considered a delicacy.

entry: POKENAME经花瓣吸收、代谢月光，过程微微发亮。白天虽也会出现，若不休息节能，却会迟缓得多。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME absorb and metabolize moonlight through their petals, which glow softly during the process. Though they may appear during daylight, they will become much more sluggish if they don't rest to conserve their energy.

entry: POKENAME头上的须蔓，赋予它超常的感知能力。在空中挥动须蔓，便能探知企图偷偷接近的敌人，再发出精神冲击，削弱对方的斗志。
author: .jerden
source: The tendrils on POKENAME's head give it extrasensory perception. It can wave them in the air to detect foes who try to sneak up on it, then use psychic blasts to sap their will to fight.

entry: POKENAME最常四足行走，浅河里，却会用后腿直立，双脚轻易穿泥。它沿途吃植物有机物，吃掉什么，什么很快长回。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although it most frequently walks on all fours, POKENAME can be found in shallow rivers walking on its hind legs; POKENAME's feet easily navigate through mud. It roams around eating organic plant material; whatever it eats quickly regrows.

entry: POKENAME群迁往新觅食地时，成年者把幼崽围在中央。它们极少遭偷袭，仿佛触须，就是后脑的眼。
author: chibitales
source: Young members of POKENAME herds are encircled by the adults as they travel between feeding areas. POKENAME are rarely caught off guard, as if their feelers serve as eyes on the backs of their heads.

entry: 与POKENAME互动，覆壳身体中央，就会撒甜香花粉。许多人爱戳来补香，可太沉迷，会严重加剧过敏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spreads a sweet-smelling pollen from within the center of its shelled body when interacted with. Many enjoy prodding it to refresh the scent, but too much indulgence will greatly agitate a person's allergies.

entry: POKENAME常独居荒地，吃硬石与矿物时翻动土地，使其适合草木生长。等大地全绿，又会迁往下一片荒地。
author: doxtordaemon
source: POKENAME tend to seclude themselves in barren areas where they churn the ground and make it ripe for plant life to grow as they feed off the hard rocks and minerals. Once the area is completely green though, they move on to the next barren land.

entry: POKENAME在枯花旁落羽，让花重新盛放。它以欢快啾声与同类交流，阳光明媚时尤其如此。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME drops its feathers near withered flowers, restoring them to full bloom. It communicates with its kind through cheerful chirps, especially on bright, sunny days.

entry: POKENAME攀在巨树的树干上，挖开树皮，饱食底下的树液。进食时，叶片会散发宜人的甜香，安抚附近的生灵，使其平静。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME clings to the trunks of giant trees, gorging on the sap it digs up from beneath the bark. As it feasts, its leaves emit a pleasantly sweet aroma that soothes and calms the creatures nearby.

entry: 夏天，POKENAME飞过城都的天空，连地面也能看见鲜艳的花瓣。花朵的香味随时节而变，温暖月份里，花香最浓。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be seen soaring over the skies of Johto in the summer, their vibrant petals visible even from the ground. Their flowers give off a unique scent based on the time of year, with the most floral smell coming during warmer months.

entry: POKENAME从粉红色花瓣中，散发出蜂蜜与树脂的甜香，吸引潜在的猎物靠近。它对自己的长喙极其自豪，常向同类挑战，比比谁的喙最有力量。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lures potential prey toward it by releasing a sweet fragrance of honey and resin from its pink petals. It takes tremendous pride in its long beak, often challenging other members of its species to see whose is the mightiest.

entry: POKENAME的群体常混着许多其他宝可梦。体大温顺，便于弱小者藏身，花瓣的舒缓香气更让身旁成了最安全的地方。
author: doxtordaemon
source: POKENAME live in herds that tend to be a large mix of other Pokémon. Their large size but docile nature make them perfect to hide around, and the calming aroma coming from their petals ensures the area around them is the safest place to be.

entry: POKENAME的奶浓郁，香气与滋味都如花，是制作高档茶、咖啡、乳酪与糕点的抢手原料。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The milk POKENAME gives is very rich with a floral aroma and taste. It is highly sought after for luxury teas, coffees, cheese, and pastries.

entry: POKENAME身上的每片花瓣，都能压榨出治疗擦伤、割伤的油。它喜欢照料其他野生宝可梦，常能看见前面的袋子里，装着一只菊草叶。
author: quackquackattack
source: Each petal on POKENAME's body can be pressed into an oil that heals scrapes and cuts. They enjoy taking care of other Pokémon in the wild and are often spotted with a Chikorita in their front pouch.

entry: POKENAME花香会刺激火山，使其喷发。咆哮时，强力落英缤纷，数秒便将全场，彻底铺满花瓣。
author: soup1900
source: The aroma from POKENAME's flowers agitates volcanoes and causes them to erupt. When it roars, it unleashes a powerful Petal Blizzard that completely coats the entire battlefield in petals within seconds.

entry: POKENAME外冷，内心却深切关爱训练家与朋友。遇险，它给颈叶覆冰，再以每小时200英里，射向敌人。
author: .saitsukino
source: Behind POKENAME's cold demeanor is a Pokèmon that deeply cares for its Trainer and friends. When threatened, it coats the leaves on its collar in ice and launches them at the enemy at 200mph.

entry: POKENAME甜唾液引来小虫宝可梦。舌上爬够了，就整口吞下。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its sweet-smelling saliva attracts small Bug Pokémon. When enough crawl on its tongue, POKENAME will swallow them whole.

entry: POKENAME香气振奋身心，给人决心。它们也常相互决斗，决定领地归谁。
author: greaterjagras
source: The fragrance of a POKENAME revitalizes the mind and body, fueling one with determination. POKENAME often challenge each other in duels to determine who has ownership over territory.

entry: POKENAME粉瓣撒出的粉末，据说能净化过酸的土壤。它天性仁慈，会帮森林迷途者找到回家的路。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is said to purify soil that has become too acidic with the powder released from its pink petals. It is a benevolent creature that helps humans who have lost their way in the forest find the path home.

entry: 冰河期后，象牙猪被推往更近极地，POKENAME却在渐广温带，接替位置。它撞倒树，吃最高处的叶，无意在林中开路。
author: .fedoraman
source: While Mamoswine were pushed further poleward after the Ice Age, POKENAME took their place in the growing temperate climates. They knock over trees to reach the highest leaves, inadvertently carving paths through the forest.

entry: 每年春天一次，POKENAME离开森林，迁过荒地播种，被视为大自然为荒地重新造林的方式。
author: cobalt0135
source: Once every spring, POKENAME will leave their forest and migrate across the wasteland to plant seeds. They have been seen as nature's way to reforest barren lands.

entry: POKENAME既能翻土，又能增养分，园丁十分渴求。经它耕过的土，庄稼产量，至少是原来的十倍。
author: deniablecredibility
source: POKENAME is highly coveted by gardeners for its ability to both till soil and enrich it with nutrients. Soil that has been worked by one of these Pokémon yields at least ten times the crops it would otherwise.

entry: POKENAME是武术高手，却不愿过多争斗。不想交战时，它便点燃腕上的花瓣，散出充满花粉的烟，削弱吸入者的斗志。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a powerful martial artist, though it prefers to avoid excess battling. When it doesn't want to fight, it ignites the petals on its wrists, spreading a pollen-filled smoke that weakens the fighting spirit of those that inhale it.

entry: POKENAME虽大，却灵敏，天天荡过沼泽猎食。身花的安神香，既帮压力中的朋友，也让猎物放松警惕。
author: .saitsukino
source: Despite its large stature, POKENAME is quite agile, swinging through the swamp day by day as it hunts for food. The flowers on its body exude a calming aroma to both help friends under stress and weaken the guard of its prey.

entry: POKENAME守护自然，能让遭砍伐的土地重生，修复受损生态。夏至最常见，隆冬最不活跃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Guardians of nature, POKENAME use their powers to regenerate deforested land and repair damaged ecosystems. They are most commonly seen during the summer solstice and are at their least active in the depths of winter.

entry: POKENAME守护自然，能让遭砍伐的土地重生，修复受损生态。夏至最常见，隆冬最不活跃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Guardians of nature, POKENAME use their powers to regenerate deforested land and repair damaged ecosystems. They are most commonly seen during the summer solstice and are at their least active in the depths of winter.

entry: POKENAME守护自然，能让遭砍伐的土地重生，修复受损生态。夏至最常见，隆冬最不活跃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Guardians of nature, POKENAME use their powers to regenerate deforested land and repair damaged ecosystems. They are most commonly seen during the summer solstice and are at their least active in the depths of winter.

entry: POKENAME守护自然，能让遭砍伐的土地重生，修复受损生态。夏至最常见，隆冬最不活跃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Guardians of nature, POKENAME use their powers to regenerate deforested land and repair damaged ecosystems. They are most commonly seen during the summer solstice and are at their least active in the depths of winter.

entry: POKENAME中空的外骨骼与残破不动的花瓣，浮空时看不出生机。可经过死花，花便重新盛开，因此许多人把它与重生相连。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: POKENAME's hollow exoskeleton and tattered, motionless petals give no evidence of life as it hovers through the air. Even so, as POKENAME passes over dead flowers, they spring back into bloom. Because of this, many associate POKENAME with rebirth.

entry: POKENAME深受有经验的巡护员喜爱，长舌能困目标，花瓣香又能安抚凶猛野生宝可梦。花瓣还可复苏植物、遮掩自身。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME are popular among experienced Pokémon Rangers, as they can ensnare targets with their long tongue and use their petals' calming aroma to pacify aggressive wild Pokémon. POKENAME can use these petals to revive flora and shroud themselves.

entry: POKENAME对周围对象感到安心，便从花球释放柔香，以精神力量分析反应，再持续调整，寻找唤起快乐回忆的香味。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: When it is comfortable with those around it, POKENAME emits gentle aromas from its flower bulb, using its psychic power to analyze responses. It continually adapts the scents based on this feedback, searching for fragrances that evoke happy memories.

entry: POKENAME偶尔蜕去整团花瓣，长出新的。瓣大、又香，虽珍贵却难取，因为蜕后不久，它就会贪吃旧花球。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: POKENAME occasionally molts, shedding its bulb of petals and growing a fresh one. Though prized for their size and scent, the petals are difficult to acquire, as POKENAME greedily devours the old bulb shortly after molting.

entry: POKENAME从石中探头，让其他宝可梦，嚼食颈边美味营养的花环。瓣一吃净，就退回岩内，直到长回。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME pops its head up from the stone to allow other Pokémon to chew on the wreath of delicious and nutritious petals around its neck. Once the petals are picked clean, it disappears into the rock until they grow back.

entry: POKENAME察觉敌对波导，就从臂花释放安神香气。它的训练家，也常冷静放松。
author: darkweavile428
source: When POKENAME senses an aggressive aura, it will release a soothing aroma from the flowers on its arms. Trainers of POKENAME are known to often be calm and relaxed.

entry: 若数百万年前确曾存在，人们认为，POKENAME藏在如今已古老的湖中美丽植物间。近期研究显示，它具异温性，兼有温血与冷血生物特征。
author: bobosmith01
source: If it existed millions of years ago, it's thought POKENAME hid itself among the beautiful plant life found in now-ancient lakes. Recent studies suggest that POKENAME is heterothermic, exhibiting traits of both warm- and cold-blooded beings.

entry: POKENAME鲜色与植物般外观，让它能混在花叶间。面容虽凶，却极关爱周围植物，花园有它，被视为吉兆。
author: thegreenscorpion
source: POKENAME's bright coloration and plant-like appearance allows it to disguise itself among flowers and foliage. Despite its fierce countenance, it cares deeply for the plants around it and having one in your garden is considered a good omen.

entry: 攻击POKENAME正面，风险极大。钢脸耐打，还能反击，发出爆炸性的花粉团。花粉过敏，会持续数周。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Attacking POKENAME's front is very risky. Its steel face is very durable, and it can counter with an explosive Pollen Puff. Its pollen causes allergies for weeks.

entry: POKENAME花香让人与宝可梦放松。野外，它常在林间空地，身旁围着同伴，一起偷懒，训练家也宁加入，不愿捕捉。
author: .jerden
source: The soothing fragrance of POKENAME's flower makes both people and Pokémon relax. Wild POKENAME are usually found in forest glades, surrounded by a crowd of Pokémon slacking off together, and Trainers often join them rather than trying to catch them.

entry: POKENAME吃光树上的树果后，会朝树吐息，让它恢复生机，更早结出新果。新果一长成，它又立刻吃掉，因此不用走远，就能一直找到食物。
author: .jerden
source: After POKENAME eats all the berries from a tree, it will breathe on the plant to rejuvenate it. This causes it to produce new berries sooner, which POKENAME will immediately eat, so it never needs to move far to find food.

entry: 攻击住在POKENAME背上的宝可梦家庭，会让它暴怒。幼崽学乖了，虫宝包等，甚至战斗中故意当诱饵。
author: kungfucutbug
source: Attacking the families of Pokémon that live on POKENAME's back will result in the POKENAME becoming furious. The younger Pokémon have become wise to this, and some such as Sewaddle intentionally use themselves as bait in battle.

entry: 这只融合体，自认是统御其他宝可梦的高傲君主，尤其以那对小胡子般的触角为荣。
author: jaycielantern
source: This fusion sees itself as a proud ruler over other Pokémon. It is particularly proud of its antennae that resemble a mustache.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃散发令人平静的气味，让对手更容易被它斩杀。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's blade emits an odor that calms opponents, making them easy victims to slay.

entry: 八只这样的宝可梦，奉首领为主人，乖乖成群跟随。它们勤练花瓣刃，在树皮刻首领的脸。
author: beatdoof
source: An eight-pack of these Pokémon follows their leader obediently as their master. They train their petal-blades diligently by carving out a visage of their leader on tree bark.

entry: 八只这样的宝可梦，奉首领为主人，乖乖成群跟随。它们勤练花瓣刃，在树皮刻首领的脸。
author: beatdoof
source: An eight-pack of these Pokémon follows their leader obediently as their master. They train their petal-blades diligently by carving out a visage of their leader on tree bark.

entry: 这只独行宝可梦，不停寻找其他草宝可梦战斗。身上利叶钝了，就吃掉，重新长回最佳状态。
author: beatdoof
source: This solitary Pokémon constantly seeks battle against other Grass Pokémon. Should the sharp-edged leaves on its body grow dull, it will eat them to regrow them at full strength.

entry: 这只独行宝可梦，不停寻找其他草宝可梦战斗。身上利叶钝了，就吃掉，重新长回最佳状态。
author: beatdoof
source: This solitary Pokémon constantly seeks battle against other Grass Pokémon. Should the sharp-edged leaves on its body grow dull, it will eat them to regrow them at full strength.

entry: 这只独行宝可梦，不停寻找其他草宝可梦战斗。身上利叶钝了，就吃掉，重新长回最佳状态。
author: beatdoof
source: This solitary Pokémon constantly seeks battle against other Grass Pokémon. Should the sharp-edged leaves on its body grow dull, it will eat them to regrow them at full strength.

entry: 威严鬃毛的花瓣颜色，会随体内电量改变。POKENAME看见谁在森林攻击宝可梦，就立刻介入保护。
author: fiordaliso
source: The color of the petals that make up its majestic mane can vary depending on how much electricity is in its body. If it sees someone attacking a Pokémon in its forest, POKENAME immediately steps in to protect it.

entry: POKENAME在山里照料岩石苔藓园，香气引来迷途宝可梦，被它收为家人。若遇险，就用泰山压顶，将敌人撞下山坡。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME tends to rock moss gardens in the mountains, the fragrance of which attracts lost Pokémon they adopt as family. If threatened, they will Body Slam foes off the mountainside.

entry: POKENAME被不适、痛苦与疾病中的对象吸引。巨大尾花分泌强香，似能减轻伤痛，并增强免疫系统数日。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME are drawn to those suffering from discomfort, distress, and disease. The enormous flower protruding from their tails secretes a powerful aroma, which seems to numb injuries and supercharge the body's immune system for several days.

entry: 农民把POKENAME视为丰收的象征。据说，它巡游乡野时，便能让枯萎的庄稼与植物，重获生机。
author: melodydelune
source: Known by farmers as a symbol of the harvest, POKENAME are said to roam the countryside, reviving crops and plants that have withered.

entry: POKENAME若觉得森林太暗，便用强壮的尾巴推倒树木。随后，它向林地撒下种子，朝种子吹气，使它们迅速萌发，开出五彩缤纷的花朵。
author: .jerden
source: If POKENAME decides that a forest is too dark, it will topple trees with its powerful tail. It will then scatter seeds onto the forest floor and breathe onto them so that they quickly sprout into colorful flowers.

entry: 有人说，POKENAME来自几乎全是植物的另一世界。它对草木极小心，却很少理会，人类或宝可梦的存在。
author: sk372
source: Some say POKENAME came from another world containing almost exclusively plant-life. It takes great care around vegetation, but rarely even acknowledges the presence of people or Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME宜人的花香，能安抚人类与宝可梦的心灵。战斗时，它放出更浓的香气，使对手放松警惕，再用毒刺无情攻击。
author: quantumradiation
source: The pleasant scent of POKENAME's flowers is calming to the spirits of both Pokémon and people. When in battle, it gives off an even stronger version of this scent to lower its opponents' guards, and then strikes mercilessly with its poisonous thorns.

entry: 遇见POKENAME的人，常说它是一团欢快色彩，鲜亮花瓣快得难以看清，香气则洗去忧虑。它最常向悲伤者现身，减轻重担。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: Those who have met a POKENAME often report a joyful blur of color, bright petals flapping too fast to track as they release a soothing scent that washes worries away. It appears most often to those dealing with grief, helping to ease their burdens.

entry: 流行童话说，一朵花受爱与照顾，变成了POKENAME。它天性善良，谁需要，都伸出援手。
author: deadshields
source: A popular fairy tale tells the story of a flower turning into POKENAME through love and care. POKENAME are kind by nature, lending aid to any that need it.

entry: POKENAME燃烧游魂，以它们的生命力养育背上的花。等花瓣全部落尽，自己才终于能前往来世。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME burns wandering souls using their life force to feed the flower on its back. Once all of the flower petals fall off, POKENAME can finally move on to the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME高高抬头，展开花瓣，迎向正午太阳。它们尽量吸取能量，留待夜用；若觉得太暗，还会以天生的力量，增强阳光。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lift their heads high, spreading their petals open to meet the midday sun. They absorb as much energy as they can to store for nighttime, using their innate powers to intensify the sun's rays if they feel it is too dark.

entry: POKENAME虽很适合挖洞、吸取树根的养分，却十分为鲜艳的花瓣骄傲，舍不得沾土。它改为攀住树枝，盼着伪装成一枚花苞。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: Though POKENAME is well-suited to digging tunnels and absorbing nutrients from tree roots, it is too proud of its bright petals to dirty them with soil. Instead, it clings to tree branches, hoping to disguise itself as a flowering bud.

entry: POKENAME盖家，常不顾自身疲惫。若仍不肯休息，颈花就放出有疗愈作用的催眠粉，强迫自己睡着。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME often ignores its own exhaustion as it builds its home. If POKENAME won't rest, the flower around its neck releases a therapeutic Sleep Powder to force itself to sleep.

entry: POKENAME高高抬头，展开花瓣，迎向正午太阳。它们尽量吸取能量，留待夜用；若觉得太暗，还会以天生的力量，增强阳光。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lift their heads high, spreading their petals open to meet the midday sun. They absorb as much energy as they can to store for nighttime, using their innate powers to intensify the sun's rays if they feel it is too dark.

entry: POKENAME现身热爱自然的人面前，洒下让植物长得高大强壮的花粉。可花粉症患者却认为它严重危害健康。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will appear in front of nature-lovers, spreading its pollen that allows for plants to grow big and strong. However, people with hay fever consider this Pokémon to be a serious health hazard.

entry: POKENAME以美妙声音，平息敌意、鼓励植物生长。歌剧演员演出后，常喝它花泡的特制茶，放松声带。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME uses its beautiful voice to subdue hostile emotions and encourage plant growth. Opera singers often drink a special tea brewed from this Pokémon's flowers to relax their vocal cords after a performance.

entry: POKENAME哼美歌，平息敌意，医治病植物。许多歌手喜欢花泡的甜草药茶，据信能放松声带。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME hums beautiful songs to subdue hostile emotions and heal sick plants. Many singers enjoy a sweet herbal tea brewed from this Pokémon's flowers, as it is known to relax one's vocal cords.

entry: POKENAME花心的甜香诱人，让感官迟钝、脑中一片空白。等察觉不对时已来不及，藤蔓早已开始生长。
author: doxtordaemon
source: The scent coming from the center of POKENAME's flower is sweet and alluring, dulling the senses, emptying the mind. By the time one realizes what is happening, it is already to late and the vines have already begun to grow.

entry: POKENAME冰息一碰死植物，就会复活，却常大变。与古化石相符，让人猜，或是恢复成史前祖先形态。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: Any dead plants touched by POKENAME's freezing breath return to life, though often with dramatic changes. Matches with ancient fossils have led to theories that the plants are revived in the form of their prehistoric ancestors.

entry: POKENAME温柔平静，吐息能复苏枯萎植物。自然灾害后，公园巡护员常用它，帮助草木重新生长。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is known for its gentle and calm demeanor. Its breath can revive withered plants, so park rangers often use these Pokémon to help promote new growth after natural disasters.

entry: POKENAME歌声安神，似也促进植物生长。所居与近旁的森林、平原，都碧绿、满是生机。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's songs have a calming effect and seem to promote plant growth. The forests and plains they live in and near are verdant and rife with life.

entry: POKENAME在翠绿地带边唱边舞，偏爱花田，借动作散粉播种。它凶猛守田，哪怕几朵被踩，也不容。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME sing as they dance within verdant areas, favoring flower fields to spread pollen and seeds through movement. They fiercely defend these fields, even if only a few flowers are trampled.

entry: POKENAME绿皮从阳光取能，也依赖背菇养分。吸彩菇孢子，可能昏倒；可少量时，舒缓香气又能减压。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's green skin gets energy from sunlight, but it also relies on nutrients from the fungus on its back. Inhaling the spores this colorful mushroom produces can knock people out, but in small doses their relaxing fragrance can treat stress.

entry: POKENAME互蹭花瓣，造安神香，阻止猎物逃跑。拳打猎物后，再用吐息，修复争斗损伤的花瓣。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME rubs its flower petals together to create a becalming fragrance to stop prey from running from it. After beating up the prey with its fists, it uses its breath to heal any damaged petals from the brawl.

entry: 只需用触角轻轻一碰，POKENAME就能复活因污染死去的海藻。它极为强壮的双臂用来搬开路上的障碍，而不是战斗。
author: fiordaliso
source: With just a touch of its antennae, POKENAME can revive seaweed that has died due to pollution. It uses its extremely strong arms to move obstacles in its path rather than for battling.

entry: POKENAME花瓣鬃毛锋利如刀，猛烈甩动时，会将花粉洒向周围森林。
author: mistymagius
source: The petals that make up POKENAME's mane are as sharp as knives. They thrash around violently, spreading around its pollen to the surrounding forest.

entry: POKENAME在荒废城堡，照料无人花园，复苏土壤、助幼苗长。它能凝望，园中花粉供燃的绿火球，窥见未来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME tend to abandoned gardens in deserted castles by rejuvenating the soil and helping seedlings grow. They can see into the future by peering into balls of green fire that are fueled by pollen from their gardens.

entry: POKENAME身上花瓣极锋利，可像苦无般投掷。它常守花园，轻易混在草木间。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: The petals on its body are very sharp; it can throw them like kunai. POKENAME are often used to guard gardens, where they camouflage easily with the flora.

entry: POKENAME平常温和，却会毫不犹豫，以强踢保护亲友。它以养护颈部大花，极为自豪。
author: mepp.
source: Though normally passive, POKENAME won't hesitate to defend its friends and family with powerful kicks. It takes great pride in maintaining the large flower on its neck.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME周身花环，亮着奇光。日出时，近旁连枯死、腐烂最严重的花，也会显出新的生机与鲜活。
author: sk372
source: The wreath of petals around POKENAME's body glows brightly with a strange light during the night. When the sun rises, even the most dead and decayed flowers near POKENAME will show new signs of life and vibrancy.

entry: POKENAME掘地，附近土壤便能短暂支持植物猛长。幼树一天内萌芽开花，却一周内枯萎。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME digs, nearby soil briefly supports rapid plant growth. Small saplings sprout and bloom within a day, but wither within a week.

entry: 这名树果贼能凭花瓣感知空气振动，提前察觉危险，几乎无法偷袭。每只都有偏爱的树果，不到手绝不罢休。
author: doxtordaemon
source: Near impossible to catch by surprise, this berry thief can tell when danger is near by feeling the vibrations in the air through its petals. Each has their preferred berry and will stop at nothing to acquire it.

entry: POKENAME毛由花瓣构成，若摸来温暖，就表示健康极好。它极听话，许多家庭便请来守花园。
author: fiordaliso
source: If the petals making up its fur are warm to the touch, it means POKENAME is in excellent health. Many families deploy it to guard their gardens, thanks to its highly obedient nature.

entry: 夏季，POKENAME花鬃散甜香，有助放松。它极少失态，可真失控，吐息就会白热发亮。
author: fiordaliso
source: In summer, POKENAME's floral mane radiates a sweet scent with relaxing properties. It is very rare for POKENAME to lose its composure, but when it does, its breath becomes incandescent.

entry: POKENAME从花放孢子云，扰乱对手。效果生效，再出重拳，打散花粉。战斗摇摆，既准备攻击，也进一步迷惑敌人。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME release clouds of spores from their flowers to disorient and confuse their opponents, punching with enough force to clear the pollen after the effects set in. They sway while they fight to prepare for attacks and further confuse their foes.

entry: 长势好的花园，常由POKENAME照料，多臂让它用一半时间，做更多工作。研究显示，花粉能加快植物生长。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Successful gardens are often tended to by POKENAME, who use their arms to accomplish more work in half the time. Research has shown that the pollen from POKENAME's flower increases plant growth.

entry: 花朵般的尾巴一碰到水，就能让死去的藻类重获生机，再次变得碧绿鲜活。POKENAME性情平和，常与自己的小家庭，在水中玩上一整天。
author: fiordaliso
source: When its flower tail comes into contact with water, it revives dead algae, making them green and full of life again. POKENAME is a peaceful creature that spends entire days playing in the water with its little family.

entry: POKENAME用花瓣与触手，演出绚丽的节目，在华丽大赛中十分受欢迎。可它的墨镜从何而来，仍没人知道。
author: lyrebird.rainwing
source: POKENAME is a favorite in Contests for its ability to make dazzling displays with its petals and tentacles. The origin of its shades is unknown.

entry: POKENAME奔过之处，花朵绽放。火散出的灰，又为各种植物添养分。
author: bobosmith01
source: Flowers bloom where POKENAME gallop. The ashes their fire spreads give nutrients to all kinds of flora.

entry: POKENAME象征长寿，遇到枯死珊瑚便会令其复生。人们认为，这正是太阳珊瑚没有彻底灭绝的重要原因。
author: teatedtiten
source: A symbol of longevity, POKENAME revives any deceased coral it stumbles upon. It is thought to be a major reason why Corsola have not gone fully extinct.

entry: POKENAME炮中射出的水，养分丰富。据说，所居森林，永远花开不败。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: The water that shoots from POKENAME's cannons is rich with nutrients. Forests where POKENAME dwell are said to always be in everlasting bloom.

entry: POKENAME夜里从衰败花园出现，缓慢、肃穆地飘，为终将凋零的植物作伴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME comes out at night from within decaying flower gardens. It wafts around slowly and solemnly, keeping the plants company as they inevitably wilt away.

entry: 古时因壳上发光花纹而被奉为全能守护神。POKENAME在空地睡下，周围就会长出繁盛花园。
author: teatedtiten
source: In ancient times, this Pokémon was deified as an almighty protector because of the illuminated markings on its shell.  When POKENAME sleeps in empty fields, vibrant gardens grow around it.

entry: POKENAME刚孵化，虽小弱，幼年却即使尚未进化，也会继续发育。睡觉时，它尽量紧紧蜷起。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although small and weak when it first hatches, POKENAME continues to undergo some physical development during its early years, even before it evolves. POKENAME sleep curled up as tightly as possible.

entry: POKENAME火焰的强度，与各头之间的和谐程度直接相关。三个头相处融洽、行动一致时，烈焰就会炽热到发白。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: The intensity of POKENAME's flames is directly tied to the level of harmony between its heads. When all three get along and agree on a course of action, the fire becomes a white-hot inferno.

entry: POKENAME挥大骨，配明亮火焰，吓退潜在威胁。可它性子怯，一旦威吓失败，就哭着逃。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME wave around large bones to scare off would-be threats while their flames burn bright. They are very meek, however, and will cry and run away if their intimidation fails.

entry: POKENAME以地热喷口的甲烷为食，常聚新生火山旁。亮蓝火焰，用甲烷作推进燃料。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feeds on the methane released from geothermal vents and can often be found clustered around newly-forming volcanoes. Their flames burn a bright blue, using the methane they consume as a means of propulsion.

entry: POKENAME从壳后排气孔喷出火焰，借推力高速前进。它始终害怕领地内潜伏的捕食者，只有需要进食，才肯出来。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME propels itself at speed using the thrust generated by the flames it can blast from the vents at the back of its shell. It only emerges when it needs to feed, as it lives in constant fear of the predators lurking in its territory.

entry: POKENAME准备冲撞，背上就喷强火。比石更硬的角，能烧得通红，烫伤碰者。
author: fiordaliso
source: When preparing to charge an opponent, powerful bursts of flame shoot from POKENAME's back. POKENAME's horn, which is harder than stone, can become red-hot and burn anyone who touches it.

entry: POKENAME准备冲撞，背上就喷强火。比石更硬的角，能烧得通红，烫伤碰者。
author: fiordaliso
source: When preparing to charge an opponent, powerful bursts of flame shoot from POKENAME's back. POKENAME's horn, which is harder than stone, can become red-hot and burn anyone who touches it.

entry: 它平静沿树皮爬，每天平均20英尺。宝可梦若来欺负POKENAME，便爆起火焰，驱赶对方。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It peacefully crawls along tree bark, averaging 20 feet a day. If any Pokémon try to pick on POKENAME, it will erupt in flames to deter them.

entry: POKENAME爬在火山脚，离岩浆不远，吃火山灰，获取成长、进化所需。
author: lejon51
source: POKENAME can be found crawling at the base of volcanoes a short distance away from the magma. It eats volcanic ash for sustenance to grow and evolve.

entry: POKENAME平时让火焰覆在壳上自卫，却也能轻松收回，让别人骑在背上。人们常见陆栖的个体，载着小孩去上学。
author: sk372
source: Though normally it keeps its shell coated in flame for self-defense, POKENAME can easily retract the fires to allow others to ride on its back. Land-based POKENAME are often seen carrying young children to school.

entry: POKENAME平时让火焰覆在壳上自卫，却也能轻松收回，让别人骑在背上。人们最常见水栖的个体，载人渡过小湖。
author: sk372
source: Though normally it keeps its shell coated in flame for self-defense, POKENAME can easily retract the fires to allow others to ride on its back. Water-based POKENAME are most often seen carrying people across small lakes.

entry: 生活在敏捷捕食者众多的地方，POKENAME会用后部的火焰，像火箭般加速逃离危险。而大型敌人较多的地区，它们则会制造一大团火焰，威吓对方。
author: soup1900
source: When inhabiting areas with lots of fast predators, POKENAME adapt by using their rear flames to rocket themselves away from danger. On the other hand, POKENAME in areas with large foes adapt by creating a large puff of flames for intimidation.

entry: POKENAME害羞，又控不好火，一般不宜亲手拥抱。许多宝可梦培育家说，一起玩游戏，更能建立信任。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is shy and unable to completely control its fiery powers, so giving physical affection to POKENAME is generally not advised. Several Pokémon Breeders have suggested that playing games with it is a much better way to build up its trust.

entry: 它正在硬化的蛹中变态，内部液体，温度与熔岩相同。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It is metamorphosing within its hardened chrysalis. The fluid within it is the same temperature as molten lava.

entry: POKENAME遇险，先把火张大，显得更大。若敌人不退，就迅速蜕皮、点燃，造出突来的大火，分散注意。
author: ambrosia04
source: When threatened, POKENAME flare up their flames to look larger. If that fails to deter attackers, they quickly shed their skin and ignite it, creating a sudden, larger fire to act as a distraction.

entry: POKENAME靠背部燃烧爆发，推进空中。每天须喝一加仑蜂蜜，否则会失去飞行能力。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME propels itself through the air using combustions on its back. It needs to drink a gallon of honey a day, or it will lose flight capability.

entry: POKENAME刺毛散出非凡力量，始终亮如小太阳。金属一碰，立刻融化，却不知何故，对人类无害。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME's quills radiate an extraordinary amount of power, causing them to constantly glow like a miniature sun. Metal objects that touch the quills will instantly melt, but somehow the quills are harmless to humans.

entry: POKENAME会在森林火灾后吃掉遗留种子。喷火时又将种子散开，让它们重新生长。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME can be found at the sites of forest fires, eating the leftover seeds. When it expels flames, it scatters the seeds to grow again.

entry: 羽上闪的小火，让同群夜飞也能认出。POKENAME极胆小，无论如何，都避免战斗。
author: fiordaliso
source: The small flames flickering on its feathers allow the rest of its flock to spot it even while it flies at night. POKENAME is an extremely timid creature that avoids fighting at all costs.

entry: POKENAME为食物，轻推相争。谁被推得后倒，背火便将其推回脚上，继续比赛。
author: sk372
source: Rival POKENAME get into light shoving matches over food. Should one be toppled over backwards, the flames it shoots from its back propel it back to its feet to continue the fight.

entry: 这只宝可梦的羊毛，柔软、温暖舒服，最适合拥抱。虽不能染色，持续散出的宜人热量，却让它深受寒衣制作欢迎。
author: _pixelar_
source: This Pokémon is the perfect partner for cuddles, as its wool is very soft and plesantly warm. Although its wool can't be dyed, it is a popular material for making clothes for cold weather because it constantly emits an enjoyable heat.

entry: POKENAME是典型鼠宝可梦，胆小得稍有动静，就跑得不见，因此罕见。被逼绝境，毛会自燃，吓退捕食者。
author: foolish_weasel
source: The quintessential mouse Pokémon. Seeing POKENAME is rare since it is so timid it will scurry out of sight at a moment's notice. When cornered, its fur spontaneously combusts to scare away predators.

entry: POKENAME乘气流长途旅行，寻找极热气候。从天坠落时，常被误当流星。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME rides wind currents across great distances in search of extremely hot climates. It is often confused for a shooting star when it plummets from the sky.

entry: POKENAME爱吸养分丰富的土，火山旁很常见。它害羞，训练家一看，就移开目光。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME is a common sight near volcanoes since they enjoy absorbing the nutrient-rich soil. Its shyness causes it to look away from a Trainer's gaze.

entry: POKENAME拍翼，放阵阵热气，卷起迷惑敌人的风。这些热浪，也让空战更占优势。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME flaps its wings, it releases bursts of hot air, creating gusts that disorient foes. These waves of heat also give it an advantage in aerial battles.

entry: POKENAME不断嗅闻空气，寻找食物。敏锐的嗅觉，让它连埋在地里的可食之物也能找到，再用爪子挖出来，以火焰烹到恰到好处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME constantly sniff at the air to find food, their sense of smell being keen enough to find anything edible even if it's buried underground. They use their paws to dig toward their meals and their flames to cook it to perfection.

entry: POKENAME的翼由火构成，越成熟越旺。最爱贴近人头飞，差一点就碰上。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's wings are made out of flames that grow stronger as it matures. Its favorite activity revolves around flying incredibly close to people's heads, barely avoiding contact.

entry: POKENAME壳中喷火，用食物供燃。喷流耗能快，它大多时间，都在收集食物。
author: hophoppip
source: The flame jets that POKENAME can blast from its shell are fueled by the things it eats. It spends most of its time gathering food, as the flame jets burn through fuel quickly.

entry: POKENAME在树干旁，挖小洞筑巢。极易受惊，哪怕一点声，也会鼻喷烟，跑去躲。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME nest in small dens dug near tree trunks. They're easily frightened, blowing smoke from their noses and running for cover at the slightest sound.

entry: 只要聚上一批POKENAME，就足够让小村庄暖和起来。抱着一只，还能治好失温症。
author: neonriser
source: An armory of POKENAME is enough to keep a small village warm. Hugging one can cure hypothermia.

entry: POKENAME为遇见它的对象带来暖光。据说能在任何人身上发现爱的人，会看见它闪耀缤纷色彩。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME brings a warming glow to those that encounter it. It is said that POKENAME shimmers in vivid colors before those able to find love in anyone.

entry: 穿行数据流时，它召浮火球环身，如守卫般，挡开撞来的数据包。蜷成球，还会放信号，让电脑切入安全模式。
author: soup1900
source: To defend itself from being smacked by packets while traveling through data streams, it summons floating fireballs to revolve around it like guardians. When it curls up into a ball, it releases a signal that causes computers to switch to safe mode.

entry: POKENAME找坚果、种子与树果吃。虽不擅找，烤食物却似乎总很完美。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME forages for nuts, seeds, and berries to eat. While it is not very good at finding them, it always seems to roast its food to perfection.

entry: 野生POKENAME学会混在火把中，用头上的火焰模仿火把，躲开天敌和人。谁靠近，它就向谁吐火。
author: cobalt0135
