source: Wild POKENAME have learned to avoid predators and people by hiding among torches and imitating them with the flames on their head. They will spit fire at any who approach them.

entry: 它极稀有，住在远离人类的地方。头角让它无需五感，也能察知别人。性子极怯，常拒绝战斗。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is an incredibly rare Pokémon that lives far away from humankind. It can sense others without the need of the five senses thanks to the horn on its head. It is extremely timid and often refuses to battle.

entry: POKENAME爱用燃烧鼻吻，戳同伴玩，没被同样回应，却会沮丧。训练家若想有可靠伙伴，就得重视培养自信。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy poking at their peers with their flaming snout but feel dejected when this playfulness is not reciprocated. Developing their sense of confidence is of utmost importance if a Trainer wants them to become a reliable partner.

entry: POKENAME挖洞，把草烧成灰，铺成床。它很爱树果，也习惯先烤再吃。
author: elevn.
source: POKENAME creates burrows in which it builds beds of ash using grass that it calcinates himself. It likes berries a lot and has the habit of roasting them before eating them.

entry: 有故事说，葬身烈焰与大火的孩子，灵魂结合，便生出POKENAME。这幽灵般的个体，被缚在形状莫名眼熟的火山岩上。
author: infinex21
source: Some stories claim that a POKENAME is born from the joining of souls of children lost to flames and infernos. This spectral POKENAME is bound to a volcanic rock with an oddly-familiar shape.

entry: POKENAME随和乐观，开心常让尾焰高涨，却通常没想，旁边是否还有别的生灵。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has an easygoing and upbeat personality. It often flares up the flames on its tail when happy, though typically without thinking about whether any other creature might be nearby when it does.

entry: POKENAME背上长一根温暖小枝，预示未来强大成长的潜能。什么太近，它就点背自卫，可火不伤植物本身。
author: sk372
source: A singular warm twig grows on POKENAME's back, a sign of the potential for strong growth in its future. It ignites its back in self-defense if anything draws too close, but the flames do not harm the plant itself.

entry: POKENAME爱闹，喜欢与同伴打闹。若太凶，被排除游戏，它就噘嘴闷气，直到找到别的活动。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are playfully aggressive creatures that enjoy roughhousing with their peers. If they are excluded from games because they are too aggressive, they pout and remain upset until they find an alternate activity to partake in.

entry: 刀刃上的火，反映着这把剑的心情。生气或受惊时，火焰便会猛然蹿高。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Its blade's flames correspond to the sword's emotions. It flares up when it's angry or surprised.

entry: 护手上的火，反映着这把剑的心情。生气或受惊时，火焰便会猛然蹿高。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Its guard's flames correspond to the sword's emotions. It flares up when it's angry or surprised.

entry: POKENAME遇险，尾焰明亮燃起。战斗中，它会点燃缎带，抽向敌人。
author: melodydelune
source: The flames on POKENAME's tail burn brightly when threatened. When fighting, they will enflame their ribbons and lash them out against their foes.

entry: POKENAME身覆过热等离子体，碰到花草，瞬间烧尽。它极怯生，用火吓别人一跳后，又会疾逃，避免接触。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME is veiled in superheated plasma that can instantly incinerate grass and flowers on contact. It is very timid and shy, darting away to avoid others after startling them with flames.

entry: POKENAME爱去美容院，喜欢毛干净、无斑。梳理完，就盘着火尾，围身静坐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy trips to the salon because they enjoy clean, spotless fur. After they are done with their grooming session, they enjoy sitting idle with their flaming tails curled around their body.

entry: POKENAME遇险，便从嘴喷熔沙，泼袭击者。它住严酷沙漠，靠背火散去体热。
author: mistymagius
source: When threatened, POKENAME will spew molten sand from its mouth onto its attacker. It lives in harsh desert climates, radiating its heat through the flames on its back.

entry: POKENAME被逼绝境，才点燃手花，用火抵御捕食者。花烧后，要一阵才长回，因此这只是最后手段。
author: hophoppip
source: When cornered, POKENAME sets the flowers on its hands ablaze and fights off predators with the flames. Once burnt, the flowers take a while to grow back, so POKENAME only uses this defense as a last resort.

entry: POKENAME用腹下火焰爆发，飞过空中。它很容易受惊，若突然喷火过猛，就可能失控乱飞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses bursts of flame from its underside in order to travel through the air. Easily startled, it may wind up careening out of control when it flares its fire too much after being taken by surprise.

entry: POKENAME滚动，身后便留下火路，烧灼触及的一切。烈焰轨迹，让它成为强大战斗对手。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME rolls, it leaves a burning path in its wake, scorching anything it touches. This blazing trail makes it a formidable foe during battles.

entry: POKENAME一哭，火就猛烧，很难安慰。情绪爆发，常迫使别人保持距离。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's flames blaze intensely whenever it cries, making it difficult to comfort. This emotional outburst often forces others to keep their distance.

entry: 野生POKENAME住熔岩流旁，或活火山内。比这更凉的环境，都会让它剧烈发抖。
author: cait_sith
source: In the wild, POKENAME lives near lava flows and within active volcanoes. Any environment cooler than those causes POKENAME to shiver violently.

entry: POKENAME巢旁有旋转火涡，劝退想闯的对象。唯有最勇的宝可梦，才敢近这烈焰家园。
author: .izik
source: A swirling vortex of flames surrounds POKENAME's den, deterring would-be intruders. Only the bravest Pokémon dare approach its blazing lair.

entry: POKENAME体色随饮食变，便把巢筑得最利伪装。野生冬眠，火焰绒球也只在战斗点燃，节省能量。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's coloration varies based on its diet; it builds its nest to best camouflage its body. Wild POKENAME hibernate during the winter, and their fiery pom-poms are lit only for battle to conserve energy.

entry: POKENAME从两侧喷火，既飞行，也保护自己。火焰提供推力，让它留在空中。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME emits flames from its sides to fly and protect itself. The flames serve as propulsion to keep it aloft.

entry: POKENAME虽能用火属性招式，却不能过度费力，湿润身体一干，就会严重不健康。因此，它多住平静河溪旁。
author: bobosmith01
source: While POKENAME can use Fire-Type moves, it must be careful not to overexert itself: if its moist body dries out, it becomes deeply unhealthy. As a result, POKENAME tend to dwell near peaceful rivers and streams.

entry: POKENAME走动，头火便让周围满是烟。遇险，烟更黑、更厚，既藏身，也让敌人被呛人的毒气毒倒。
author: .jerden
source: The fire on POKENAME's head fills the air around it with smoke as it walks around. This cloud will become thicker and darker if POKENAME feels threatened, concealing it from enemies and poisoning them with choking toxic fumes.

entry: POKENAME浸入池塘，便让水瞬间沸腾。这怪本领，让它在水边作伴，很危险。
author: .izik
source: If submerged in a pond, POKENAME causes the water to boil instantly. This strange ability makes it a dangerous companion around water.

entry: POKENAME遇险，背上寄生蘑菇就燃起，释放满是孢子的烟。蘑菇很有益健康，煮后可制辛辣草药茶。
author: sadfroghours
source: When POKENAME is threatened, the parasitic mushrooms on its back burst into flames, releasing clouds of spore-filled smoke. The mushrooms have great health benefits and can be boiled to make a spicy herbal tea.

entry: POKENAME住在冷却岩浆构成的岛，从火山岩中取暖，无论天气怎么变，也都舒适。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME resides on islands made of cooled magma, finding warmth in the volcanic rock. This environment ensures it stays comfortable despite any changes in weather.

entry: POKENAME只有日食，才会睁眼。夜飞时，仿佛流星。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME only opens its eyes during a solar eclipse. When it flies through the night sky, it resembles a shooting star.

entry: 阿罗拉称POKENAME为“胆小炮仗”。它们胆怯，孵化季最多20只成群；一受惊，背火爆起，高速爬逃，沿途一切都烧尽。
author: oddly.abnormal
source: Called “skittish firecrackers” in Aloha, POKENAME are timid Pokémon that travel in groups of up to 20 during hatching season. When frightened, their backs erupt in flames and they scuttle away at high speed, incinerating anything in their path.

entry: POKENAME遇险，全身便燃火。火若没吓跑敌人，焦毛的气味，却一定行。
author: kiwiarms
source: When threatened, POKENAME's entire body bursts into flames. If the fire doesn't scare off its foe, the smell of burning fur certainly will.

entry: POKENAME用后腰特殊腺体，一次点燃全身。但如何听令自行熄灭，仍不清楚。
author: kiwiarms
source: POKENAME ignites its entire body at once using a specialized gland in its lower back. It isn't known how POKENAME is able to put itself out on command, however.

entry: POKENAME背上的金属盘，帮它挡雨。训练家长途穿荒野，也常拿来帮做早餐。
author: sk372
source: A metal dish on POKENAME's back helps keep it from getting wet during the rain. Trainers often use it to help with cooking breakfast while on long trips through the wilderness.

entry: POKENAME好奇，爱探周围世界。遇到特别兴奋的事，尾焰就会极热。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are curious creatures that love to explore the world around them. When they are particularly excited about something, the flame on their tails gets incredibly hot.

entry: POKENAME钻地被追，就将周围土加热到极高温。嘶嘶热土，拖慢捕食者，争取逃跑时间。
author: .izik
source: If pursued while tunneling, POKENAME superheats the surrounding soil. The sizzling dirt slows predators long enough for escape.

entry: POKENAME用火软化周围土石，方便挖掘找食。大群却可能影响建筑稳定，因为隧道有时穿过地基。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their flames to soften the soil and rocks around them, making them easier to dig through in their search for food. Large populations can cause issues for the stability of buildings, as their tunnels sometimes cut through foundations.

entry: 作为宠物，POKENAME亲热却挑剔。它喜欢被抚摸，却只肯接受一阵；觉得够了，就会让背上冒出火焰，告诉旁人自己不愿再被碰。
author: sk372
source: As a pet, POKENAME is affectionate, but finicky. It enjoys being pet, but only for a certain amount of time; once it's done receiving affectionate, it flares fire on its back to let others know it no longer wishes to be touched.

entry: POKENAME吃辛辣椒，速度就明显增加。这些火热点心，兼为火焰与敏捷供能。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's speed increases significantly when it consumes spicy peppers. These fiery treats fuel both its flame and its agility.

entry: POKENAME最多二十只成家族，合挖地洞睡。它们轮流警戒，一见捕食者就叫警报，让全家瞬移避险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in families of up to twenty individuals, digging burrows for the whole group to sleep in. They take turns watching for danger, the lookout crying a warning if a predator appears to allow the entire family to teleport to safety.

entry: POKENAME最多二十只同巢，合挖地洞睡。遇险便团结，背向威胁，点燃带精神能量的火焰，吓走敌人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in nests of up to twenty individuals, digging burrows for the whole group to sleep in. They unite against danger if they're threatened, turning their backs to the threat and igniting psychically charged flames to scare their foe away.

entry: POKENAME手腕一挥，勺就能燃火。火焰帮助集中，增强念力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can set the spoon it carries on fire with a mere flick of the wrist. While alight, the fire helps it focus, increasing the potency of its telekinetic capabilities.

entry: POKENAME吃饭，总想用勺，却忘了正在烧。结果烫自己、掉勺，又在近处引发意外火灾。
author: plkfsa32
source: Whenever it eats, POKENAME will try to use its spoons, forgetting that they're ablaze. Inevitably burning itself due to its forgetfulness, it'll drop its spoons, causing accidental fires in the nearby area.

entry: POKENAME将余烬导进拳，向敌人打出火击。命中什么，都会留下闷烧的痕。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME channels embers into its punches, delivering fiery blows to opponents. Each strike leaves a smoldering mark on whatever it hits.

entry: POKENAME大多不动，仍乐意、却有些懵懂地，为旅人提供暖火。有露营者把棉花糖串在尾上烤，甜得格外。
author: char_latte3412
source: A largely sedentary Pokémon, POKENAME will happily—if somewhat obliviously—provide wandering Trainers with a warm fire. Some campers roast marshmallows by skewering them on its tail, producing an ultra-sweet flavor.

entry: 与其他呆壳兽融合体不同，POKENAME尾巴甜，包住它的火达到临界温度，便会进化。只有最勇的宝可梦，才肯攀住，熬过酷热。
author: char_latte3412
source: Unlike other Slowbro fusions, POKENAME achieves evolution by having the flame engulfing its sweet-tasting tail reach a critical temperature. Only the bravest of Pokémon will ever attempt to latch on and endure the intense heat.

entry: POKENAME形体适合水流，却不爱游泳，宁在陆上慢走，反而容易遭捕食。
author: vaporvenator
source: Despite its hydrodynamic form, POKENAME does not enjoy swimming. As it chooses to move sluggishly on land, it is left vulnerable to predators.

entry: POKENAME受惊，构成身体的火更旺，放出能使沿途植物枯萎的毒烟。碰它，会严重灼伤、中毒，得长期住院。
author: skyrvr
source: The flames that make up its body burn more vigorously when POKENAME is startled, releasing toxic fumes that wilt any plant it passes by. Touching it causes severe burns and poisoning that require extensive hospitalization.

entry: POKENAME用精神力量控火，精准塑形。独特本领，让火焰招式十分难料。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME controls its flames with psychic powers, shaping them into precise forms. This unique skill makes its fire-based attacks highly unpredictable.

entry: 强肌肉上，一薄层致密脂肪，保护身体免受恶劣天气。据说，无论自己多大、多强，POKENAME都有勇敢斗志。
author: bobosmith01
source: There is a thin but dense layer of fat over its powerful muscles that protects its body from the elements. POKENAME is said to have a courageous fighting spirit, no matter its own strength or size.

entry: POKENAME战斗，既吐火球，也掷骨棒。棒一丢，就会哭个不停，火也失控高涨。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME spits fireballs and throws its club during battle. If it ever loses its club, it will cry without end, and its flames will uncontrollably flare up.

entry: POKENAME大半生住火山深处，皮据信因此硬如石。骨头用黏土与未知方式处理，既耐火，又坚韧异常。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's hide is as tough as rock, supposedly because it lives deep within volcanic areas for most of its life. Its bone has been treated with clay and a yet-unknown means that have made it both flame resistant and incredibly tough.

entry: POKENAME的火美丽，在水族馆颇受欢迎。可须专用缸，少有其他水属性宝可梦，能与它同住。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular aquarium Pokémon thanks to the beauty of the flames they produce. They need to be kept in specialised tanks, however, as very few other Water-Type Pokémon can tolerate the same tank as POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME以强火柱，代替腹鳍与背鳍。水虽浇不灭，却把家园河流煮干，自己与其他水属性，只能无助困在余下峡谷。
author: kungfucutbug
source: In lieu of ventral and dorsal fins, POKENAME sprouts intense plumes of flame. While they're unable to be extinguished by water, it means POKENAME boils the rivers it calls home, leaving itself and other Water-types helpless in the resulting canyons.

entry: POKENAME爬在岩浆旁，难以捕捉。它们吃火山灰与石，取能，造自己的茧。
author: lejon51
source: POKENAME can be found crawling near magma, making them difficult to catch. They eat volcanic ash and rock in order to gather energy to make their cocoon.

entry: POKENAME烈火的酷热，造成强上升气流，助它滑翔高空。毽子草等也受影响，改变旅行方向。
author: bobosmith01
source: The intense heat that radiates from POKENAME's flames causes powerful updrafts that allow it to glide high in the sky. These updrafts even affect other Pokémon, such as Hoppip, causing them to travel in different directions.

entry: POKENAME颈毛，总摸来温暖。时装设计师有时收蜕毛，织成又暖又软的围巾。
author: kilo_forte
source: The fur around POKENAME's neck is always warm to the touch. Fashion designers sometimes collect its shed fur to create scarves that are both warm and soft.

entry: POKENAME挂在活火山内的岩上，巢穴则由进化形态，严密守护。
author: lejon51
source: POKENAME can be found hanging on rocks inside active volcanoes. Their nests are heavily guarded by its evolved forms.

entry: POKENAME用烟熏大针蜂巢，偷蜂蜜。灼热钻头直穿蜂房，让蜜流出。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME steals honey from Beedrill by smoking out their nests. Its superheated drills pierce right through their hives, allowing honey to flow out.

entry: POKENAME能操纵火，显得比实际更大。它们喜欢人类，有时带引火物靠近营地，帮忙照料营火。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME can manipulate their flames to appear larger than they really are. They enjoy the company of humans, sometimes approaching camps with kindle and helping tend to campfires.

entry: POKENAME的火焰猛烈而炽热，却奇迹般地不会伤害蔓延之处的任何植物。因为火中充满让植物复苏的力量，就连火焰造成的损伤，也会反被“烧去”。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's fire is both incredibly strong and superheated, yet it miraculously doesn't harm any plant it spreads over. This is because the fire is filled with the power to revitalize plants, so any damage done by the fire is ironically burned away.

entry: POKENAME羊毛总很热，剪下也如此。遇险，尾珠便冒火花，迅速传遍全身毛。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its wool is always very hot, even when sheared from POKENAME's body. If it feels threatened, the bulb on its tail begins to emit sparks that quickly spread throughout its fleece.

entry: POKENAME爱沙滩，彼此在沙里玩，再潜水降温。群体过后，有些沙被高热熔成光滑玻璃，痕迹明显。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME love sandy beaches. They can be found playing with each other in the sand before diving into the water to cool off. It is clear when a group has passed, as they superheat some of the sand into smooth glass.

entry: POKENAME爱待火山旁，干旱气候，让它少遇水分。可它常打盹，让人好奇，哪有时间找食。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy spending time near volcanoes, as the arid climate reduces the amount of moisture they come across. Frequent naps make people question how they find time for gathering food.

entry: POKENAME背部篝火从不灭，湿或累，也只是闷烧。燃烧枝条冒浓黑烟时，其中毒素，可能毒倒吸入者。
author: .jerden
source: The bonfire on its back never goes out, although it will only smoulder if POKENAME is wet or tired. Whenever thick black smoke begins to rise from the burning branches, it carries toxins that may poison anyone who inhales it.

entry: POKENAME被靠近，会凶猛敌对得出奇。它能把獠牙加热，连最硬钢铁也熔穿。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME are surprisingly aggressive and hostile when approached. They can heat their fangs to be hot enough to melt through even the toughest steel.

entry: POKENAME岩壳薄脆，小动作也会裂开，露出熔岩。它可故意破壳，施展强大喷火。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The rocky crust of POKENAME's shell is thin and fragile, cracking and exposing the molten lava within with even small movements. They can unleash powerful Eruptions from their shell by deliberately breaking it open.

entry: 它们狩猎时，凶猛鼻喷小火，烧去死草与灌丛。POKENAME找到、轻烤的松露，风味口感独特，是各地珍馐。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: They aggressively snort small flames out of their nose, burning away dead grass and shrubbery while hunting. Truffles found and lightly roasted by POKENAME have a unique taste and texture, making them a delicacy in many parts of the world.

entry: POKENAME游速够高，火便喷发，推动它以超过每秒300米冲过天空，再回波浪。
author: kobold_hijinks
source: When this Pokémon builds up enough swimming speed, its flames erupt, allowing POKENAME to rocket through the sky at over 300 meters per second before returning to the waves.

entry: POKENAME皮硬如岩，毛又防火，背带烈焰，几乎不惧多种攻击。它极灵敏，在战场挖地、爆发奔跑，来回穿行。
author: nyoomymph
source: With rock-hard skin, fireproof fur, and hot flames on its back, POKENAME is practically invulnerable to many types of attacks. It is incredibly nimble, darting around the battlefield by digging and sprinting in bursts.

entry: 据说，POKENAME在场能防火。有些文化，会请它祝福新屋，免遭焚毁。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's presence is said to prevent fires. In some cultures, it is customary to have these Pokémon bless newly built houses to protect them from burning down.

entry: POKENAME爱在树枝间跳跃，伏击猎物，已成为越来越多森林火灾的起因。
author: nexusshenanigans
source: The tendency of POKENAME to leap through tree branches and ambush prey is a growing cause of forest fires.

entry: POKENAME背火热得能熔沙，再用爪塑形、冷却，成为背上的玻璃刺。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The flames along a POKENAME's back are hot enough to melt sand. POKENAME shape and cool the molten liquid with their claws to form the glass spines along their back.

entry: 欧雷地区一个洞穴，最近发现POKENAME群。它们打出毁灭性穿刺拳时，爪会燃火。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME colonies have recently been discovered within a cave in the Orre region. Their claws will set aflame as they deliver devastating piercing punches to their foes.

entry: POKENAME潜力大，却难自律，常因缺信心，中途放弃训练，因此需要很多爱与关注。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a lot of potential, but struggles with discipline. It requires plenty of love and attention, as it tends to call it quits during a training session due to a lack of confidence.

entry: 情绪能量，帮助POKENAME添火。战斗中，感受训练家的积极情绪，火便涌起酷热。
author: mepp.
source: Emotional energy helps fuel POKENAME's flames. When exposed to positive energy from its Trainer during battle, the flames surge with intense heat.

entry: POKENAME常被形容为性子泼辣、火爆。它不耐别人胡闹，若被惹过头，就从身体喷火威胁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is often described as having a sassy and fiery personality. It has little patience for the antics of others, and threatens them with bursts of flame from its body if they agitate it too much.

entry: 头顶冒的淡烟，能认出POKENAME建的坝。它爱收木、烧木，深受烧炭人喜爱。
author: craigprime
source: You can recognize a dam created by POKENAME from the light plumes of smoke that appear overhead. They're a favored companion of charcoal burners for their love of both collecting and burning wood.

entry: POKENAME烦躁，石后便慢慢冒火。怒意最高，才完全显形，试着烧尽四周一切。
author: sk372
source: Flames slowly begin to erupt from the back of POKENAME's stone as it gets agitated. Once its temper reaches its peak, POKENAME manifests fully and attempts to burn anything and everything around it.

entry: POKENAME脾气火爆，不断寻找对手，较量实力。激烈交战时，它的波导会升腾，使身上的火焰变色。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a fiery temperament, constantly seeking out combat rivals to test its strength against. When in the midst of a heated fight, its aura flares up and causes the flames on its body to change color.

entry: POKENAME冲锋，黑毛里的火，同时爆燃。正面撞击已令人畏惧，可火又让从背后靠近，同样危险。
author: t3isukone
source: The fires in POKENAME's black fur all kindle explosively at once when it charges. While many fear its head-on charges, the fire makes it just as dangerous to approach from the back.

entry: POKENAME特别活跃的部分，只有头火。它用来加热附近树上，落下的美味树果。
author: sk372
source: The burning flame atop POKENAME's head is the only part of it that is particularly active. It uses the flame to heat up the delicious berries that fall down from trees near its vicinity.

entry: POKENAME从早到晚，沿河练武。能不沾水抓到河鱼，就准备好进化。
author: mogorian_gray
source: POKENAME trains its martial arts by the riverside from dawn 'til dusk. When it can snatch a fish from the river without getting wet, it is ready to evolve.

entry: POKENAME导引体内热，让金属部位灼红。暴怒，头上三叉，便燃起翻腾、噼啪作响的火。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME channels heat within its body to turn its metallic parts red-hot. The three prongs on its head ignite with roiling, crackling flames when it is enraged.

entry: POKENAME的火焰，为刀刃增添了可怕威力。战斗时，火势迸发，释放强烈的热量。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's flames are a formidable addition to its blade, flaring and releasing intense heat during combat.

entry: 除了刀刃，POKENAME的火焰，也是有力的第二重防护。战斗时，火焰猛燃，放出强烈的热量。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's flames are a formidable secondary defense to its blade, flaring and releasing intense heat during combat.

entry: POKENAME毛完全不燃，却会在身体某些部位分泌油，使其覆火，驱退捕食者。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME's fur is completely non-flammable; however, it secretes an oil into certain parts of its body to engulf them in flames to ward off predators.

entry: POKENAME比谁火更强，一起扬焰，分个高下。造出更强火角的，就是胜者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will compete to see who has the more powerful flames, flaring their fires up to establish which is superior. The one who creates a mightier horn made of fire is the victor.

entry: POKENAME虽形似灯，凶猛难控，却不能当灯用。谁冒失挑战，就会被毁灭性的火焰旋涡吞没。
author: mcnchsschl
source: Despite its lamplike appearance, POKENAME cannot be used as such, due to its uncontrollable ferocity. Any foe reckless enough to challenge it will find themselves engulfed in its devastating Fire Spin.

entry: POKENAME爱训练，方便更好引导内心之火。头部火焰状附肢，像波导感应器，一探知附近强敌，便迸亮火花，威吓对方。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME love training to be able to channel their inner fire more easily. The fiery appendages on their heads act like aura sensors, flaring up with bright sparks whenever they detect a worthy opponent nearby, intimidating them in the process.

entry: 这小宝可梦，喜欢独处。受威胁，身上火就会高涨。
author: themicelegion
source: This small Pokémon likes to be left alone. If it is threatened, the flames on its body will flare up.

entry: POKENAME的歌响亮，专为威吓敌人，还常借火力，制造特效。
author: bostroms
source: The songs POKENAME performs are loud and made to intimidate its opponents. It will often employ its fire powers to create special effects.

entry: 野外，互为对手的POKENAME相遇，会先扬起火焰，比谁烧得更热，威吓彼此。若谁都不肯退让，它们便用沉重的身体相撞，争夺支配地位。
author: sk372
source: If rival POKENAME meet in the wild, they will try to intimidate the other by flaring their fires up to see who burns hotter. If neither backs down from the display, they charge their heavy bodies into each other and begin fighting for dominance.

entry: POKENAME疾驰在岩石崎岖的家园，身后留火路。休息，却会歇极长时间。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME blazes across the rocky and rough terrain it calls home, leaving a fiery trail in its wake. It rests for extremely long periods of time.

entry: POKENAME能控火翼的火量，足够时，一拍便能闪开攻击。它还会发出超声般的刺耳声，产生灼热空气，威吓敌人。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME can control the amount of fire making up its wings, allowing it to dodge away from an attack in a single flap when enough fire is produced. It emits a supersonic Screech and produces superheated air to intimidate foes.

entry: POKENAME背上能造大量火，驱退太近的对象。火若裹住蘑菇，真菌还放刺鼻黑烟，进一步劝退袭击者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can create a great amount of fire on its back to fend off others that draw too close. If the flames engulf its mushrooms, the fungi emit a pungent black smoke that further repels potential attackers.

entry: POKENAME会把蛋埋在火山附近，靠地热保温。这一习惯被认为，源于火山峰顶仍覆着雪的年代。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are known to bury eggs in the ground near volcanoes, as geothermal heat keeps their eggs warm. This practice is thought to have originated from a time when the volcanic peaks were still covered in snow.

entry: 有些地区，POKENAME被视为友善的火山峰守护者。近处一有危险，周身火焰就会高涨。
author: mepp.
source: In some regions, POKENAME is regarded as a friendly guardian of volcanic peaks. The fire that wreathes its body flares up when it senses danger nearby.

entry: POKENAME出击凶猛如爆炸，毫不顾自身安全。背焰熔过对手，也不顾旁人，因此训练家常得介入，安抚下来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME attack with explosive ferociousness, as they have little regard for their own safety. The fiery flames on their back melt through their opponents without regard for anyone's safety, so their Trainer often needs to step in to calm them down.

entry: POKENAME温暖舒适的气息，能驱退噩梦。日食时，头部与翼上的火，会更强。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's warm, comforting aura wards off bad dreams. The flames on its head and wings grow stronger during a solar eclipse.

entry: POKENAME用炽热的爪子切入树木，似乎以木头燃烧产生的烟为食。享用树木时，它还会从背部喷火，防止任何来自后方的攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME slices into trees with its heated claws. It seems to feed on smoke produced by the burning wood and will blast fire out of its back to prevent any attack from behind while it consumes the tree.

entry: POKENAME放甜香烟，引猎物。香随饮食改变，因此训练家常喂多种树果。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME release smoke with a sweet aroma that draws in their prey. This scent can change depending on POKENAME's diet, so Trainers tend to feed them a variety of berries.

entry: POKENAME用炽热的爪子切入树木，似乎以木头燃烧产生的烟为食。享用树木时，它还会从背部喷火，防止任何来自后方的攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME slices into trees with its heated claws. It seems to feed on smoke produced by the burning wood and will blast fire out of its back to prevent any attack from behind while it consumes the tree.

entry: POKENAME藏高处，向对手扔火刺。想逃战，就快转舌，让烟铺满场地。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME hides in high places and throws flaming quills at opponents. POKENAME can escape fights by spinning its tongue fast enough to cover the arena in smoke.

entry: POKENAME休息时，加热身旁土壤。酷热让捕食者，不敢近巢。
author: .izik
source: When resting, POKENAME raises the temperature of the soil around its body. This intense heat discourages predators from approaching its nest.

entry: 据说POKENAME用尾焰，火箭般冲过水流。它想被拥抱，可大多尝试者，却会丧命。
author: berryslip
source: POKENAME is said to use its tail flame to rocket boost through currents. This Pokémon wants to be hugged but most who try end up perishing.

entry: POKENAME猎其他掘地宝可梦，迅速挖向隐藏家园。火又将周围土烤硬，形成光滑管道，防止自家隧道塌落。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hunt for other burrowing Pokémon, digging toward their hidden homes swiftly as they search for food. Their flames help to keep their own tunnels from collapsing, baking the dirt around them and hardening it into a single smooth tube.

entry: POKENAME虽酷热，举止却精致优雅，轻灵敏捷，躲攻击从容不迫，几乎不显吃力。
author: lesbian_garlicbread
source: Despite its intense heat, POKENAME carries itself with refined grace. Nimble and lithe, it slips past attacks with effortless poise, rarely showing any sign of strain.

entry: POKENAME脾气爆烈，发作就全身涌火。一旦进入敌对状态，唯有耗尽全部能量，才能冷却下来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have an explosive temper that causes their body to erupt with scorching flames. Once they enter into this hostile state, the only way to cool them down is to burn through all their energy.

entry: POKENAME战斗越兴奋，身上燃火的地方越多。完全可能见到两只交战，全身每寸都覆着烈焰。
author: sk372
source: The more hyped up in combat that POKENAME gets, the more of its body lights up with flames. It's entirely possible to see two POKENAME battling while every inch of their bodies are coated with blazing fire.

entry: POKENAME在火山、深洞刻苦训练。火力难控，训练家都避免招惹。
author: brunodaescola
source: POKENAME trains intensely in volcanoes and deep caves. Trainers avoid provoking it due to the uncontrollable power of its flames.

entry: 它在陆地上蹦跳着走，产生热量。POKENAME再用这股能量点燃尾巴，从背后袭击敌人。
author: vaporvenator
source: It moves on land by bouncing around, producing heat energy. POKENAME uses this energy to ignite its tail and attack foes from behind.

entry: 火山地带常能看见POKENAME晒太阳。它会把身体藏进熔岩，等待经过的宝可梦，伺机捕杀。
author: vaporvenator
source: POKENAME can be found basking in volcanic regions. It shrouds itself in lava and waits to hunt passerby Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用火焰恶臭威吓敌人。夏天，臭味更成倍暴增，可有些饲主，却觉得是好事。
author: skyrvr
source: POKENAME intimidates its foes with the foul-smelling odor of its flames. During summertime, its stench intensifies exponentially, but some POKENAME owners believe that it is a good thing.

entry: 准备吓人时，POKENAME会将火焰双手涨到平常两倍大，同时发出高亢的怪笑。它平时喜欢藏在旧炉子里，等想吓谁时才出来。
author: sk372
source: When it's time to frighten a victim, POKENAME flares its fiery hands up to twice their normal size, emitting a cackling peak of laughter as it does so. It prefer to hide in old furnaces until it's ready to scare someone.

entry: POKENAME用念力，将火塑成各种形状与动作，谁看太久，都能被哄睡。据信，它吃人类与宝可梦的梦，让火维持强劲。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can manipulate its own flames with telekinetic powers, shaping fire into forms or movements that can lull anyone who watches them for too long. It is believed to feed on the dreams of sleeping humans and Pokémon to keep its flames strong.

entry: 背上喷火，释放能量、防止过热。若火收回，就是POKENAME准备从嘴，吐出巨大火墙的征兆。
author: sk372
source: Flames jet from its back in order to vent its energy and keep from overheating. Should these flames recede, it's a sign that POKENAME is preparing to unleash a massive wall of flame from its mouth.

entry: 野生POKENAME收黏土，处理骨头，使其更耐火。天生懂得这种用法，广受研究；似乎是因自身火力，强得危险。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME collect clay so that they may treat their bones and make them more flame resistant. Their innate knowledge to use clay like this is widely studied. It appears to be because their own flames burn with dangerous potency.

entry: POKENAME战时用酷热气雾藏身，再以火球与骨头回力镖，连击对手。它也聪明得，会拿骨调味、搅拌，以火烹食。
author: infinex21
source: During battle, POKENAME obscures itself with a haze of intense heat and pelts its opponent with fireballs and Bonemerang attacks. It displays enough intelligence to be able to use its bone to season and stir foods while cooking them with its flames.

entry: POKENAME腿部，也有类似背上的产火腺。将使最强踢击前，它才点燃肢体。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's legs possesses similar fire-producing glands found on its back. It ignites its limbs just before it unleashes its most powerful of kicks.

entry: POKENAME见于阿罗拉群岛周围，享受火山岛热量。大鱼群会煮沸身周水，对潜水者很危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found in the waters around the Alolan islands, enjoying the heat of the volcanic islands. Large schools of POKENAME can be dangerous to divers due to the heat they give off boiling the water around them.

entry: 生气时，这种宝可梦会疯狂发射壳上烧得通红的尖刺，同时从嘴里喷出滚烫热水。等它终于筋疲力尽，常能看见全身腾起蒸汽。
author: fireblade141
source: When angered, this Pokémon will start furiously shooting off the red-hot spikes along its shell and spewing scalding water from its mouth. Steam can often be seen rising from all over its body when it finally tires out.

entry: POKENAME直接挂在火山核心的岩浆上方。据说，每只孵出，都会成为强大护巢者。
author: lejon51
source: POKENAME hangs directly over the magma in the core of the volcano. Each POKENAME is said to hatch into a powerful guardian for the nest.

entry: 别人靠近，POKENAME就吐浓蒸汽，遮住视线。多数猎物最后所见，是闷热雾中，一双锐利红眼。
author: sk372
source: When approached, POKENAME breathes a thick cloud of steam at others in order to obscure their vision. The last thing most of its prey see are piercing red eyes from within the sweltering mist.

entry: POKENAME控火，造出大片闪动热雾，隐藏自己，再从空中迅速突击，打敌人措手不及。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: With its control over fire, POKENAME will create a large shimmering haze to hide itself. It will then strike forward from the air with speed, catching its foes off-guard.

entry: 野生POKENAME极难找，通常只在火山口，短暂现身，又隐入闪动热雾。身上珠储热，被逼绝境，就能爆成烈火。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME are incredibly elusive, usually only being briefly seen in volcanic craters before vanishing behind a shimmering heat haze. The orbs on their bodies store up heat, and POKENAME can unleash it in a fiery explosion if cornered.

entry: POKENAME点燃双翼，向旁人展示力量与支配地位。对手交锋时，火势格外猛烈，有时能让翼展看起来达到平常三倍。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME ignites its wings in flames as a show of strength and dominance over others. Rivals clashing against each other will flare their fire up particularly fiercely, in some cases tripling the apparent visual size of their wingspan.

entry: 这只宝可梦，常在森林大火中，猎捕无力反抗的猎物。生气，毒刺会烧得通红。
author: puppetmaster64
source: This Pokémon is often seen hunting defenseless prey during forest fires. Its stingers are known to grow red hot when angered.

entry: POKENAME想显得比实际更吓人，便把颈后火，扬到最大，塑成头顶巨火球，吓退潜在袭击者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tries to appear more intimidating than it truly is. To this end, it flares up the fire behind its neck to maximum level and forms it into a huge fireball above it to frighten off potential attackers.

entry: POKENAME是一只走上了不同进化道路的火暴兽。蓝色火焰炽热无比，连站在附近的训练家，都曾被灼伤。
author: thisisnotaplaceholder
source: POKENAME is a Typhlosion that evolved a bit differently. Its blue fire is intensely hot, so hot that Trainers have gotten burns by standing near it.

entry: 融合唤醒POKENAME沉睡已久的DNA。这形态超过150年未有记录，曾是洗翠、也就是如今神奥的年轻人的最初伙伴。
author: lupa
source: Pokémon fusion has restored long-since-dormant DNA in POKENAME. This form of POKENAME has not been recorded for over 150 years. It was a first partner Pokémon for youth in Hisui, now called Sinnoh.

entry: POKENAME与其他宝可梦战斗，会全身裹火，尤其集中强颚。火牙咬下，轻易熔过多数金属。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME wreathe themselves in flames when they fight with other Pokémon, especially focusing their flames around their strong jaws. Their flame-clad fangs can bite and melt through most metals with ease.

entry: POKENAME用火造亮光，吸引宝可梦。猎物游太近，就先烧焦，再大吃。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME lure in Pokémon by using their flames to create bright light. When prey swims too close, POKENAME burn them to a crisp before feasting.

entry: POKENAME点燃全身防御，强焰遍布。火翻涌时，烧木的气味，也充满空气。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME immolates itself for defense, bursting with powerful flames across its whole body. As the flames roil on, the scent of burning wood fills the air.

entry: POKENAME身上的花粉球，可以点燃，增强自卫能力。有时，它替伙伴加油太过起劲，这些球也会着火。
author: sk372
source: The pollen orbs of POKENAME's body can be ignited in order to give it better self-defense. On occasion, they will also catch on fire when a supportive POKENAME gets too energetic in cheering on its allies.

entry: POKENAME在熔岩隧道，获取熔融岩石的养分。战斗中，它从不转身，背对敌人。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME gets nutrients from molten rock in lava tubes. In combat, POKENAME never turns away from its enemy.

entry: POKENAME覆着有毒、易燃的薄膜，觉得遇险，就引发燃烧反应。它极易受惊，哪怕没危险，也会如此。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is covered in a thin toxic, flammable film. When it feels threatened, it triggers a reaction that causes it to combust. They are very skittish, and this occurs even when they are in no danger.

entry: POKENAME始终冥想，控制情绪。一被打扰，火山状头冠便会猛喷强焰。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME is always meditating to keep its emotions in check. If it is ever disturbed, powerful flames will erupt from the volcano-like crown upon its head.

entry: POKENAME毛覆易燃油。獠牙按特定角度相撞，就会生火花，让它随时点燃自己，吓退进犯者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have fur that is coated with an oil that is highly flammable. Their fangs create sparks when struck together at a specific angle, allowing them to ignite themselves at a moment's notice to scare off aggressors.

entry: POKENAME住火山湖，靠硬皮耐高温。遇险，火刺从身上突起，防御捕食者。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME live in volcanic lakes, their tough skin allowing them to withstand intense heat. When threatened, spikes of flame jut out from their bodies, protecting them from predators.

entry: POKENAME钢铁般的身体难伤，摸来烫得疼。双钳可作喷火器，也可挥纯火刀刃，切穿金属。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's steel-like body is hard to damage and painfully hot to the touch. Its pincers can act as flamethrowers, or it can wield blades of pure flame capable of slicing through metal.

entry: POKENAME走得慢，身体轻轻噼啪作响，散着热。脚下土地，硬成光滑黑石，为陌生地形的旅人指路。
author: mgfox_66676
source: POKENAME moves slowly, its body crackling with quiet heat. The ground beneath it hardens into smooth black stone, guiding travelers as they navigate unfamiliar terrain.

entry: POKENAME飞行时突然爆发火焰，便能短时大幅加速。可火焰十分耗能，每次加速只能维持几分钟。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are capable of bursts of speed when flying by abruptly erupting with flame. They can only maintain these speed bursts for a few minutes at a time, the flames taking a lot of energy to use.

entry: POKENAME背孔能喷火，像排气喷口，增强火势与破坏性的速度，所过只留烈火、碎屑。
author: slavman9057
source: POKENAME have holes on their backs that erup in flames. These holes act like exhaust nozzles, intensifying their flames and increasing their destructive speed until they only leave fire and debris in their wake.

entry: POKENAME侵入电脑，吃可燃物的图像文件。吃得越多，火越热，无人看管，就常令电脑过热。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will infiltrate computers, consuming image files of things that are flammable. Their flames will grow hotter the more they eat, often causing the computer to overheat if they are left unattended.

entry: POKENAME一凶，颈火便高涨。可鹿角易燃，火太猛，也可能烧上，须十分小心。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's flames around its neck flare up when it turns aggressive. It must take care, as its antlers are flammable, and if its fire burns too strongly it may set them ablaze.

entry: POKENAME用尾焰，在木块上画精巧图案。谁不喜欢，就被视为不敬、讨厌，立刻遭到炼狱攻击。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME uses the flame on its tail to create intricate patterns on wooden blocks. It considers those who dislike its work disrespectful and annoying, promptly shooting an Inferno at them.

entry: POKENAME的奶刚挤出时，热得如同岩浆，必须用专门工具收集，免出意外。它们还桀骜不驯、精力过盛，光是抓住来挤奶，就已经十分困难。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: Upon being milked, POKENAME's milk is as hot as magma and needs to be collected using specialized tools in order to avoid problems. In addition, these Pokémon are unruly and rambunctious, making it hard to catch and milk it in the first place.

entry: POKENAME疾跑陆地，身后留狂焰与热雾。体内储能，最终化作强烈闪焰冲锋，撞击时，响如雷鸣。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME dashes across land while leaving behind raging flames and heat hazes in its wake. Energy stored inside its body eventually gets released into an intense Flare Blitz that causes loud thundering on impact.

entry: POKENAME永远披着灼焰。一暴怒，就烧林、蒸干河流，毫无悔意。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is perpetually cloaked in searing flames. When it flies into a rage, it burns away forests and dries up rivers with no remorse.

entry: POKENAME暴怒，生成巨电磁场，灼红磁铁又把空气加至高温。可它能察知火山碎屑下的生还者与电子设备，深受救援队珍视。
author: skyrvr
source: When enraged, POKENAME generates an enormous electromagnetic field while superheating the air with its red-hot magnets. Rescue teams value its ability to detect survivors and electronic equipment buried beneath volcanic debris.

entry: POKENAME十分强大，用火与电迎击敌人。战斗落入下风时，它便让尾尖相碰，引发烈焰爆炸，同时放出庞大的电流。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME is a very powerful Pokémon that uses both fire and electricity to fight its foes. When it's losing a fight, it makes the tips of its tails touch, producing an explosion of fire and a huge electric discharge.

entry: POKENAME快振火翼，兼造声波与热雾，使对手迷乱。咬合力强得，能碾碎粗树枝。
author: chibitales
source: By rapidly buzzing its flaming wings, POKENAME creates sonic waves alongside a heat haze to disorient its opponent. Its bite force is strong enough to crush thick tree branches.

entry: POKENAME外表吓人，却极亲热。研究显示，颈焰或有疗愈作用。
author: kilo_forte
source: Despite its intimidating look, POKENAME is extremely affectionate. Studies show that the flames around its neck may have healing properties.

entry: POKENAME让背上的火焰猛然高涨，俯冲追猎时借此加速。一旦攀住目标，毒刺就会同时注入麻痹毒液，并造成极其疼痛的灼伤。
author: sk372
source: Flaring the flames on POKENAME's back allows it to boost its speed when it swoops after prey. Once it latches onto something, its stinger delivers both paralyzing venom and a blisteringly painful burn.

entry: 这只宝可梦，是生存高手，长出极保温的毛，还能随意点燃，抵御严寒。
author: chaos_emblemx
source: This Pokémon is the ultimate survivalist. It has adapted to having hyper-insulative fur that can be set alight at will to ward off the cold.

entry: POKENAME在树间快跳，留下焦树皮。它偏爱湿润丛林，那里却也很可能，被它引发林火。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME leaps rapidly from tree to tree, leaving burnt bark in its wake. It prefers wet jungles, where it is likely to start forest fires.

entry: POKENAME背上长易燃种荚，战斗就起火。它也能同时点燃全部，造成巨大爆炸。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME grows flammable seed pods on its back. These pods ignite during battle, and POKENAME can ignite them all at once to cause a huge explosion.

entry: POKENAME长着尖木刺，战斗就起火。它也能同时点燃全部，造成巨大爆炸。
author: pastapockets
source: Sharp, wooden spines grow from POKENAME. These spines ignite during battle, and POKENAME can ignite them all at once to cause a huge explosion.

entry: POKENAME好斗爱耍性子，心情坏，就怒啾、胡乱扬火。体虽小，却能吐出、卷起可怕的大量烈焰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a belligerent and bratty personality, angrily chirping and flaring its flame up at random when in a bad mood. Despite its small stature, it can breathe and flare up intense fire in formidable amounts.

entry: 即使POKENAME的火焰平息，散发的热量，仍会使部分皮肤灼红发亮。滚向对手之前，它才点燃火焰，化成一团燃烧着旋转的火球。
author: sk372
source: Even when POKENAME's flames are at rest, segments of its hide still glow red-hot from the heat it emanates. It ignites its fire just before rolling at opponents, turning itself into a burning, whirling fireball.

entry: POKENAME暴怒，全身便裹火。带火拳脚一击中，就会爆炸。
author: cobalt0135
source: The bodies of POKENAME are engulfed in flames whenever they become enraged. Their flame-charged punches and kicks create explosions upon impact.

entry: POKENAME钻地，常被怪罪引发火山喷发。嘴里排出的易燃气，暴怒时会点燃。
author: hummusishome
source: POKENAME are often blamed for volcanic eruptions as they tunnel through the earth. They emit flammable gas from their mouths which ignites when enraged.

entry: POKENAME眉间与尾上的火轮，能如飞盘射出，准头远超常显的蛮力。带刺面颊里，藏着维持热量的器官。
author: deadshields
source: The wheels of flame blazing from POKENAME's brows and tail can be launched as fiery discuses with surprising accuracy despite the brute strength they typically show. Their spiked cheeks hold organs responsible for maintaining their heat.

entry: 颈焰颜色，会随感知到的周围情绪改变。POKENAME虽还不太成熟，火力却强得能瞬间烧尽一树。
author: fiordaliso
source: The flames around its neck change color depending on the emotions it senses around it. Although POKENAME is not particularly mature yet, its fire attacks are so powerful that they can incinerate a tree in an instant.

entry: POKENAME对训练家情绪极敏感。训练家一怒，它也怒，颈焰便又大又热。
author: st4rdustyugure
source: POKENAME is very sensitive to its Trainer's emotions. If its Trainer gets angry, POKENAME gets angry as well, the flames around its neck become big and hot.

entry: POKENAME性子颇为冷淡，会扬起颈边火焰，不让旁人靠近。唯一例外是训练家，见到对方，它就会高高兴兴地收回火环。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flares up the fire around its neck to keep others at bay, as it has a rather standoffish personality. The only exception to this rule is its Trainer, for whom it happily retracts the burning ring of flame.

entry: 它是英勇的英雄，愿为所珍视的生命，付出自己的一切。可调用的力量越多，背上十字形的火焰，就越会灼烧自己的灵魂。
author: theeggoverlord
source: A valiant hero who would give its life to save those it cares for. The cross flames on its back burn through its soul the more power it calls for.

entry: POKENAME脾气不定，受挑衅常放毁灭性烈焰。虽令许多人畏惧，却守荣誉，绝不攻击无法还手的对象。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME has a volatile temper, often unleashing destructive flames when provoked. Though many fear its power, POKENAME abides by a code of honor and refuses to attack anyone who cannot fight back.

entry: POKENAME情绪高涨，石上便喷火。积够火焰，脸才出现，完全控制火的动作。
author: sk372
source: Fire erupts from POKENAME's stone when its emotions begin to run high. Once enough flames have been gathered, POKENAME's face appears and it gains perfect control of the fire's movements.

entry: POKENAME游森林，把易燃灌草烧净、清除，预防野火。背上焦花持续燃烧，浓烟若大量吸入，会使人中毒。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME wander through forests, cleanly burning and clearing out flammable brush to prevent wildfires. The charred flower constantly burning on a POKENAME's back releases a thick smog that's poisonous to humans in large amounts.

entry: POKENAME战斗自负，爱让对手以为已逼入绝境。假嘴再突喷火柱，打个措手不及，趁破绽，凶猛反击。
author: sk372
source: Cocky in combat, POKENAME loves to let its opponents think they've got it cornered, before its false mouth belches a plume of flame, catching them off-guard and opening them up for a vicious counterattack.

entry: POKENAME头上假眼，其实是触角，助它穿行火山家园。身上喷口涌出的火，能达1000度。
author: mepp.
source: The false eyes on POKENAME's head are actually its antennae, aiding it when navigating its volcanic habitat. The flames that billow out of the ports on its body can reach temperatures of 1000 degrees.

entry: POKENAME颈部大多只闷烧。战时明亮燃起，短暂升温、充满能量，随后又很快冷却。
author: .jerden
source: Most of the time, POKENAME's neck only smolders. It flares up brightly during combat, briefly raising POKENAME's body temperature and filling it with energy, although it quickly cools down afterwards.

entry: POKENAME懒散躺着时，背上的火也仍在闪烁。它常被自己引发的野火打扰休息，却懒得逃离，直到烟雾极浓，才肯动。
author: .jerden
source: The flames on POKENAME's back flicker even while it lazes around. Its rest is often disturbed by wildfires it has started, but it is too lazy to flee from the flames until the smoke becomes very thick.

entry: POKENAME懒散躺着时，背上的火也仍在闪烁。它常被自己引发的野火打扰休息，却懒得逃离，直到烟雾极浓，才肯动。
author: .jerden
source: The flames on POKENAME's back flicker even while it lazes around. Its rest is often disturbed by wildfires it has started, but it is too lazy to flee from the flames until the smoke becomes very thick.

entry: POKENAME住火山深处，皮肤耐热，游熔岩如水。人们认为，喷发地震，是它们急着迁走，免被喷发卷入造成。
author: sk372
source: Living deep beneath volcanoes, POKENAME swim through lava like water, their durable skin impervious to heat. It is believed that earthquakes during eruptions are caused by POKENAME hastily relocating before they're caught in the blast.

entry: 岛村曾将POKENAME奉为火山神，海滩画巨大图案供奉，相信它会非常开心。
author: .izik
source: Island villages worshipped POKENAME as a volcano god. Massive beach designs were drawn as offerings, believed to bring it great joy.

entry: POKENAME背上看似活火山，其实是渗出岩浆般热汁的硅化树。暴怒，它便跺地，从背树放出燃烧的种子炸弹。
author: infinex21
source: What at first appears to be an active volcano upon POKENAME's back is actually a petrified tree leaking a magma-hot sap. When enraged, these Pokémon stomp about and release flaming Seed Bombs from the petrified trees upon their backs.

entry: 即使没有燃着火，POKENAME灼热的刀刃，也能点着碰到的任何东西。接触的一瞬间，甚至可能引发爆炸。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The heat of POKENAME's blade ignites anything it touches, even when it isn't aflame. On contact, it can even generate explosions.

entry: POKENAME怒到极点，就互蹭缎带，造巨大爆炸。进入其栖地，训练家须留心。
author: melodydelune
source: When its rage peaks, POKENAME will rub their ribbons together to create large explosions. Trainers should be wary if they enter their habitat.

entry: POKENAME尾内有沸腾、腐蚀的液体，近似凝固汽油。战时，先喷液流，再用碎岩之力，挥尾重击。
author: infinex21
source: Within POKENAME's tails is a boiling, corrosive liquid similar to napalm. They will spit streams of this liquid during battle and follow-up with a rock-shattering strike from their tails.

entry: POKENAME看似烈焰缭绕，却住在深海。它待在地热喷口旁，吸取热量，再游上水面，纵身跃出，同时喷出一阵火焰。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Despite its fiery appearance, POKENAME reside deep in the ocean. It spends its time around geothermic vents, absorbing the heat from them before swimming to the surface and leaping out, emitting a burst of flame as it does.

entry: POKENAME越向地面降，浓密空气越添火，火势成倍暴涨。它是热浪先兆，光低飞树冠，就能烧尽整片森林。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME's flames grow exponentially stronger as it descends toward the Earth, fed by the thickening air. A harbinger of heatwaves, it burns entire forests simply by flying low over the canopy.

entry: 传说POKENAME用爆炸力量，推开大陆。每步所过，只留灰烬与毁坏。
author: dylonk25
source: Legend states that POKENAME pushed the continents apart with explosive force. Wherever it steps, ash and ruin are left in its wake.

entry: POKENAME将体内的火焰引导到炮中，发射出去。燃烧得越热、越猛烈，光靠炮便无法容纳，火焰开始从身体其他部位喷涌而出。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME channels fire from within its body to be fired off from its cannon. As it burns hotter and harder, the cannon alone cannot contain its fire and flames begin to erupt from other parts of POKENAME's body.

entry: POKENAME先以密集的花瓣攻击，再将花瓣点燃，严重灼伤对手。这些火焰常被误认为某种超自然现象，因此衍生出许多关于它的迷信传闻。
author: quantumradiation
source: POKENAME will attack with a barrage of petals, and then light them on fire to severely burn its opponents. These flames are often mistaken for some kind of supernatural phenomenon, leading to many superstitions about this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME生气，长耳与背便爆火山般烈焰。它用能熔石的火踢，推动自己，沿途留下火路。
author: cerealjamalt
source: When POKENAME is angered, volcanic flames explode from its long ears and back. It launches itself with burning kicks that can melt rock, leaving a firey path in its wake.

entry: POKENAME以吸热液覆身，免误烧别人。战斗时，撤去不稳定部位的液体，释放烈焰与爆炸。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME coats itself in a heat-absorbent liquid to prevent accidentally burning others. In battle, it withdraws the liquid from volatile areas, unleashing intense flames and explosions.

entry: POKENAME平日温顺，发怒却极为凶烈。毛中爆发巨焰，焚烧周围，同时以龙类气息掩藏身形。
author: beatdoof
source: While POKENAME is naturally docile, it has a fierce temper. When its rage is set off, it creates a huge explosive blast from its fur, burning everything around it while camouflaging itself with a draconic aura.

entry: 向POKENAME许愿者的情绪，为封印火焰供能。每1000年一次，火破封，它才苏醒。
author: coridiant
source: The emotions of those who wish on POKENAME fuel its sealed flames. Once every 1000 years, these flames break free and it awakens.

entry: POKENAME宝石般的眼睛能射出熔穿岩石的热束。体内巨大热量，则通过背焰排出。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its gem-like eyes to create beams of heat hot enough to melt through rock. It vents the intense amount of heat in its body through the flames on its back.

entry: POKENAME用体内火焰囊，加热刃尾，重创敌人。刃钝，便拿牙磨；紧急时，也能吐出熔钢的喷射火焰。
author: chibitales
source: Using the flame sac in their body, POKENAME heat their bladed tails to cause massive damage. When the blade becomes dull, they sharpen it by using their teeth. In a pinch, POKENAME can spit Flamethrower attacks capable of melting steel.

entry: POKENAME不断从体内喷出烈焰，身体摸起来却冰冷。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME constantly spews intense flames from inside its body. Despite this, its body is cold to the touch.

entry: POKENAME偷偷用寒冷的力量，冻住穿过领地的生灵，再用身上的火焰解冻，装成将对方从绝境救出的恩人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME secretly uses its power over cold to freeze those traveling through its domain. It then thaws them out with the flames from its body to make it seem as if it saved them from certain doom.

entry: POKENAME以火焰替代双翼，能将敌人灼伤。可火声有时，也会让它分不清方向。
author: canada
source: In place of wings, POKENAME is coated in fire, allowing it to burn foes. However, the sound of the flames sometimes cause it to get disoriented.

entry: 野生POKENAME住休火山山坡，极护领地，常吃莓莓果。不吃时，就爱飞入同类地盘，挑战比火，谁的更大。
author: coolbuddy1432_56671
source: Wild POKENAME live in the sides of dormant volcanoes and are very protective of their territory. They often eat Rawst berries. When not eating, they like to fly around into other POKENAME territory to challenge them to see whose fire is bigger.

entry: POKENAME背菇始终燃烧，菌丝网络一受损，火更强。它凶猛护地盘，却只追到地下菌丝，延伸的边界。
author: quackquackattack
source: The mushrooms on POKENAME's back are constantly blazing, the intensity growing when it senses damage to its mycelium network. It is fiercely territorial but only chases as far as the network of mycelium below it.

entry: POKENAME火亮得，100英里外仍能看见。它也引导山中迷途者，返回安全处。
author: typhloquil
source: POKENAME's flames are so bright, it can be spotted from over 100 miles away. It'll guide hikers lost in the mountains back to safety.

entry: POKENAME战斗中，背喷破坏性熔岩柱，爆成黑曜石碎片。战后，训练家便收来卖。
author: quackquackattack
source: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME shoots destructive plumes of lava from its back that explode into obsidian shrapnel. Trainers collect the obsidian shards after a battle ends to sell them.

entry: 夏至，POKENAME全身火羽，都会蜕落。据说这些羽，能驱退最可怕的噩梦。
author: cait_sith
source: During the summer solstice, all the flaming feathers on POKENAME's body molt. These feathers are said to ward off even the most terrifying nightmares.

entry: POKENAME背部真菌孢子，完全防火。它能在菌盖制造火焰爆炸，把孢子推进空中，送得很远。
author: .jerden
source: The spores produced by the fungus on POKENAME's back are completely fireproof. POKENAME can propel them long distances through the air by creating fiery explosions on its mushroom cap.

entry: POKENAME暴怒时，全身的火焰会更猛烈。它在战斗中喷出的水滚烫无比，攻击的高热，甚至能剥落龙属性宝可梦身上的鳞片。
author: fireblade141
source: The flames all over its body become even more intense when it is enraged. The scalding water it uses in battle is so hot that POKENAME's attacks can strip the scales off of dragon-type Pokémon's bodies.

entry: POKENAME与背菌共生。蘑菇是好引火物，增强火势；真菌则借放出的烟，运送孢子。
author: deadshields
source: POKENAME has a symbiotic relationship with the fungus grown on their back. The mushrooms serve as good kindling to enhance their flames and the fungus uses the released smoke to carry its spores.

entry: POKENAME暴怒时，用念力控制枝火，忽大忽小，试着平静。可谁打断冥想，背后就会喷灼焰。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: When it's enraged, POKENAME telekinetically controls the flame on its branch to grow and shrink in an effort to calm down. But if somebody distracts POKENAME from its meditation, scorching flames will erupt from its back.

entry: POKENAME膝与肘有刺，帮助攀直崖。舌也满刺，收入口中，反倒扎伤自己。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME's knees and elbows are covered in quills that help it climb up vertical cliffs. The tongue on POKENAME is covered in quills that hurt POKENAME when it enters its mouth.

entry: POKENAME白烟宜人安神。什么惹怒，就吼出黑烟，恶臭如烧焦毛发。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME's white smoke has a calming, pleasant scent. If something piques its rage, it bellows black smoke with a foul odor like burnt hair.

entry: 这种POKENAME形态，有洗翠火暴兽的特征。据说吸入安神烟，能增强与灵界的联系。
author: hophoppip
source: This form of POKENAME shares traits with the Hisuian form of Typhlosion. Inhaling its calming smoke is said to enhance one's connection with the spirit world.

entry: POKENAME把猎物脚下的地，热到灼人，土热得能烧伤裸露皮肉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME heats the ground beneath its prey to burning temperatures. The soil can become hot enough to scorch exposed flesh.

entry: POKENAME常熔掉收集的硬币，化作原金属，再用爪塑各种形状。它欣赏每座雕塑，再收起，继续走。
author: plkfsa32
source: POKENAME is often seen melting down collected coins into raw metal. It then shapes the material with its paws into various shapes and forms, admiring each sculpture before collecting them and moving on.

entry: POKENAME生气，就全身喷火。可它始终在怒，唯有能量彻底用尽，才停下来。
author: bobosmith01
source: When angry, POKENAME erupts flame from its body. Since it is always angry, it only stops once it is completely depleted of energy.

entry: POKENAME野外极稀有。未驯服凶暴，驯服后，却温和亲人。
author: bobosmith01
source: They are extremely rare to find in the wild. Untamed POKENAME are vicious; tamed POKENAME are mild-mannered and affectionate.

entry: POKENAME以吐火与大翼为特征。翅膀比起许多龙宝可梦，更像叉字蝠，这也是它不属龙属性的众多原因之一。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are characterized by their fire breathing and large wings. Their wings are closer to the wings of a Crobat than many Dragon-type Pokémon, which is one of many reasons why they are not Dragon-type.

entry: 野外，POKENAME用5000的智商，依秘密配方制炸药，再拿胡须火，点燃导火索。
author: reese1017600
source: In the wild, POKENAME uses its 5,000 IQ to make dynamite using a secret recipe. It lights the fuses of them using the fire on its moustache.

entry: POKENAME放腻甜气味，引虫属性宝可梦，靠近燃烧巨口。一到近处，便猛喷强火，烤熟猎物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lure Bug-type Pokémon towards their fiery maw with a sickly-sweet scent that proliferates through the air. Once their prey is in close range, they roast their prey with a powerful burst of flames.

entry: POKENAME分泌易燃汗，奔跑时常使火更强。它聪明得会用火蹄，跺地或直接踏敌，引爆自己的汗。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's body secretes a flammable sweat that often intensifies their flames when they run. They are clever enough to create small explosions with their own sweat by stomping their flaming hooves upon the ground or directly against opponents.

entry: POKENAME是神和镇每年万圣夜庆典的中心，被视为连接神奥过往的活纽带。许多当地人相信，它能与古代祖先沟通。
author: char_latte3412
source: This Pokémon is a central figure in Celestic Town's annual Hallows Eve festival and is regarded as a living link to Sinnoh's past.  Many Sinnohan natives believe POKENAME to have the ability to commune with their ancient ancestors.

entry: 不知为何，这融合体具有通常只见于洗翠火暴兽的特征。它有时出神、凝望虚空，有人说，正是在与灵魂交谈。
author: hophoppip
source: For unknown reasons, this fusion bears traits normally only present in Hisuian Typhlosion. It sometimes zones out and stares into space, which some say is how it communes with spirits.

entry: POKENAME以猛烈爆炸攻击，争夺领地。决斗极危险，只应远远观察。
author: vaporvenator
source: POKENAME battle one another for territory using violent explosive attacks. These duels are extremely hazardous, and should only be observed from afar.

entry: POKENAME怒意极点，臭焰强得碰什么，什么立刻着火。行过之处，留下强毒，碰到花草树木，就会杀死。
author: skyrvr
source: When POKENAME's rage peaks, its smelly flames intensify so much that anything they touch immediately catches on fire. As it moves, a strong poison trails behind it, killing plants and trees on contact.

entry: POKENAME准备从双炮喷火，壳就开始灼红发光。火热得几秒，便能液化坚石。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's shell begins to glow red-hot when it prepares to shoot fire from its twin cannon nozzles. The flames burn hot enough to liquefy solid stone in a matter of seconds.

entry: POKENAME头骨盔卡住上颚，动弹不得。头已长得贴合，盔也摘不下。不断流泪与凶猛攻击，暗示可能疼痛，却未完全证实。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's skull helmet keeps its upper jaw from being able to move. It cannot be removed, as its head has developed to fit the skull. Its unending tears and fierce aggression indicate this causes it pain, but that has yet to be fully confirmed.

entry: POKENAME能浮空，却更爱在水中家园打滚，与同伴玩。救林火时，它跟随地上巡护员浮行，以全向喷水，保护人和宝可梦。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME can hover, but prefers rolling around in its watery habitat, playing with other Pokémon. It helps fight forest fires by floating with Pokémon Rangers on the ground and protecting them and their Pokémon with its omnidirectional water spray.

entry: POKENAME跃出水，咬过路飞物狩猎。一攀住，就不放，将猎物拖到水下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hunts by leaping from the water and biting at anything flying above. Once it latches onto something, it doesn't let go, dragging its prey beneath the water's surface.

entry: POKENAME皮肤可变得极滑，几乎无摩擦，让水中速度惊人。游过，留下一线微光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's skin can become slick and nearly frictionless, allowing it to dart through water at incredible speed. It leaves a faint shimmer as it swims.

entry: POKENAME用毛状触手翻沙，寻找猎物，找到后便排出酸液。传说，新月夜，岸边能听见它受害者的声音。
author: quackquackattack
source: They use their hairlike tentacles to dig up sand while looking for prey, once they find them POKENAME their prey before excreting acid. On nights of a new moon, it is said that POKENAME's victims can be heard on shorelines.

entry: POKENAME给所居沼泽的水生植物授粉，却常被水中猎物分心，伸刺扎去。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME pollinates aquatic plants across the marshes it inhabits. While doing so, it often gets distracted by prey swimming in the water, jabbing its stinger towards it.

entry: POKENAME用咬，探索周围。可周围未必喜欢被咬，有时还击；它若觉得危险，直接瞬间移走就好。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME bites to explore the world around it. The world around it does not always appreciate being bitten and may lash out, but if POKENAME feels threatened, it can just teleport away.

entry: POKENAME顽皮，爱嚼不该嚼的东西。训练家若不想被利叶割，就得非常尊重它。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are mischievous creatures that enjoy chewing on things they are not supposed to. Treating them with respect is of utmost importance if a Trainer wants to avoid getting cut by their razor-sharp leaves.

entry: 它爱蜷壳里睡。醒来，第一眼看见什么，就轻咬示好，却不知双颚多强。因此有谚语说：睡着的POKENAME，让它自己起。
author: foolish_weasel
source: It likes to curl up in its shell when it naps. When it wakes, it nips at the first thing it sees as a sign of affection, not understanding how strong its jaws actually are. There is a proverb to let sleeping POKENAME stand up on their own.

entry: POKENAME朝路过旅人喷水柱，打落手中食物，再怪笑着抢走，没入水下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sprays jets of water at passing travelers to knock food from their hands. With a cackle, it snatches the meal and vanishes beneath the water.

entry: POKENAME情绪容易被牵动，尤其面对人类。兴奋时，什么近张开的嘴，它都会反射地咬。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME is easily stirred to emotion, especially by people. When excited, it reflexively bites anything that comes near its open mouth.

entry: 据说，POKENAME遇谁，谁倒霉，往往就是，被利牙咬上一口。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are said to bring bad luck to whoever they meet. This often means getting bitten by their sharp teeth.

entry: POKENAME爱玩、好胜得让多数训练家疲惫。可出人意料，咬合力相对较弱。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME is playful and competitive to a degree that most Trainers find exhausting. Surprisingly, its bite force is relatively weak.

entry: POKENAME夜睡湖底泥中，皮肤完美模仿周围地质感。做梦，大嘴还会定时开合。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps in the mud of lakebeds at night, its skin perfectly mimicking the texture of the ground around it. Its large jaws open and close periodically while it dreams.

entry: POKENAME见于地下河边，越老，便越远离水域。啃小石虽有人觉得可爱，锐利目光，却连进化后的宝可梦也震住。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can be found by subterranean rivers; as they grow older, they wander further and further away from the body of water. Although some find it cute when they nibble on pebbles, it has a sharp glare that leaves even evolved Pokémon shaken.

entry: POKENAME见于地下河边，越老，便越远离水域。啃小石虽有人觉得可爱，锐利目光，却连进化后的宝可梦也震住。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can be found by subterranean rivers; as they grow older, they wander further and further away from the body of water. Although some find it cute when they nibble on pebbles, it has a sharp glare that leaves even evolved Pokémon shaken.

entry: POKENAME见于地下河边，越老，便越远离水域。啃小石虽有人觉得可爱，锐利目光，却连进化后的宝可梦也震住。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can be found by subterranean rivers; as they grow older, they wander further and further away from the body of water. Although some find it cute when they nibble on pebbles, it has a sharp glare that leaves even evolved Pokémon shaken.

entry: POKENAME喜欢下雨时，在水坑里嬉戏。可一兴奋，就容易不小心放电。
author: projectalpha22
source: POKENAME likes to play in puddles during the rain. Unfortunately, when it gets excited, it also tends to let out an electrical shock.

entry: POKENAME饥饿贪食，什么看着略像可食物，就咬住，极少放。不少训练家收养，只因它咬包，几小时、几天都不松。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's ravenous appetite causes it to bite down and rarely let go of anything that looks remotely edible. More than a few Trainers have adopted one simply because it bit their bag and refused to let go for hours or even days.

entry: POKENAME咬住树枝，靠嘴巴在树间荡行。它们主要栖息在沼泽，在水中与树上同样敏捷。
author: santon5512
source: By latching their teeth into tree branches, POKENAME use their mouths to swing from tree to tree. These Pokémon primarily live in swamps, being just as agile in the water as they are in the trees.

entry: 危急时，枝荔果能增强POKENAME的力量，双颚变强，直到对战结束。它一咬，足以破开巨石。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be given a Liechi Berry to improve its strength in a pinch, which makes its jaw stronger until the battle is over. It chomps down on opponents with enough force to break boulders.

entry: POKENAME用利牙砍树，强颚很快就能处理原木，筑成天然水坝。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME bites with its sharp teeth to cut down trees. Its powerful jaws allow it to make quick work of logs, which get turned into natural dams.

entry: POKENAME有强烈的冲动，想咬附近的一切，缓解自己的攻击欲。任何想逃的目标，都会被花中伸出的藤蔓抓住、拖近，供它啃咬。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has an intense urge to bite anything near it as a way to relieve its aggressive urges. Anything that tries to escape gets caught by vines from its flower, and dragged closer so it can chomp down on them.

entry: 南方城市，曾信POKENAME是瀑布之神，保存蜕下的牙，用于祭祀。
author: .izik
source: Southern cities once believed POKENAME to be a god of waterfalls. Its shed fangs were preserved and used in ceremonial worship.

entry: POKENAME伏浑水，偏爱沼泽与缓河。背着共生植物，借此混在泥中，耐心等食物上门。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lurk in murky water, preferring swamps and slow moving rivers. They carry symbiotic plants on their back to help disguise them in the mud, waiting patiently for their food to come to them.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在水面附近，用背上的植物，融入芦苇。无论看不看得见，最好都假定它一直就在附近。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lurk near the surface of the water, using the plant growths on their back to disguise themselves amongst the reeds. It is advised to assume that there is always a POKENAME present, regardless of if you can see one.

entry: POKENAME刃上的钩刺，轻易撕皮，重伤敌人。切斩如强咬，碾伤对手，也吸走生命能量。
author: soup1900
source: The hooked spikes on POKENAME's blade easily tear through skin and severely injure foes. Its slices are like powerful bites, crushing foes up as it drains the life energy out of them.

entry: 水里，POKENAME用强颚咬住猎物，再以触须，固定不动。
author: melodydelune
source: In the water, POKENAME will snap their powerful jaws down on prey and hold them in place with their feelers.

entry: POKENAME一咬就不放。哪怕被强行击退，也会吐出内脏，连颚在内，保持与目标相连。
author: sk372
source: Once POKENAME bites onto something, it refuses to let go. Even if it was forcibly knocked back, it would expel its innards, jaws included, so that it would remain connected to its target.

entry: POKENAME愿分享环上的饰品，可得拿同样美丽、或贵重的东西换。谁硬抢，就会遭强颚狠咬。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will share the accessories on its ring, but only if traded something equally pretty or valuable. Any who try to take them by force will be given a nasty bite from its powerful jaws.

entry: POKENAME生活在沼泽，用原木和树根建造巢穴。虽然每隔几天，就需要修缮一次，它却更喜欢把一天中的大部分时间，用来啃咬大块原木。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be found in swamps, building its dens out of wooden logs and tree roots. While it needs to repair its dens every few days, POKENAME prefers to spend most of the day gnawing on large logs.

entry: POKENAME吃金属与矿石，牙也成钢。双颚强得能咬下实心金属块，与大矿石碎块。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's fangs are made of steel due to its diet of metals and ores. Its jaws are strong enough to break off pieces of solid metal and chunks of ore.

entry: POKENAME什么够得着，都要咬。性子急，比起等完美破绽，更愿直接打。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will bite just about anything it can get its jaws on. It is a very impatient Pokémon, preferring to just attack than to wait for the perfecting opening to strike.

entry: POKENAME尾尖小火，水下也燃。游过时，便在身后拖一缕蒸汽。
author: oddwalls
source: The small flame at the tip of POKENAME's tail remains lit while underwater, creating a plume of steam behind it as it swims.

entry: POKENAME极危险，什么在旁动，强颚便夹下。传闻它潜伏下水道，却似不太可能，因为常被见到晒太阳。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME is very dangerous, as its powerful jaws will clamp down on anything that moves near it. There are rumors that POKENAME lurk in sewers, though this appears unlikely since POKENAME are often observed basking in the sun.

entry: 面具的脸，会随POKENAME心情变。若露齿，须小心，它正想咬，任何靠近的东西。
author: sk372
source: The face on the mask changes its expression to match POKENAME's mood. If the mask shows its teeth, take care; POKENAME is in a mood to bite anything that comes close.

entry: 暖季，POKENAME会俯冲旅人，淘气地咬一下。虽无恶意，可不慎咬太重，牙便留下轻微灼伤。
author: sk372
source: During the warmer seasons, POKENAME will swoop down on travelers and deliver a playful bite. It means no harm, but its teeth can leave mild burns if it accidentally bites down too hard.

entry: POKENAME用热烈夸张的舞，分散敌人注意。对方沉迷节奏，它就近身，用强颚重重咬下。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME distracts opponents with passionate, dramatic dances. Once its foes are entranced by its rhythm, POKENAME closes in to deliver a devastating bite with its powerful jaws.

entry: POKENAME先往垃圾箱灌水，再撕腐食。湿软口感，更易吞，也更合胃口。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fills dumpsters with water before tearing into rotting food. The soggy texture makes the food easier to swallow and more to its liking.

entry: POKENAME虽爱与谁都玩，训练家却须极谨慎。强颚利牙，连油轮底都能撕开。
author: mistymagius
source: While POKENAME loves to play with just about everyone, Trainers should exercise extreme caution around it. Its powerful jaws and sharp teeth can rip through the bottom of tanker ships.

entry: 幼年POKENAME兴冲冲地，什么会动都试咬。甚至落在沼王身上连啃，可牙不够利，真伤不了它。
author: mepp.
source: Young POKENAME excitedly try to bite anything that moves. They are even seen landing on the bodies of Quagsire to nip at them repeatedly, though their fangs aren't sharp enough to actually harm the Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的锚，其实是一颗伸长的牙，用起来像鱼叉，能刺穿猎物。若卡进地里，它有时不得不将牙折断，再等两周，重新长回。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's anchor is actually an elongated tooth that it uses to impale its prey like a harpoon. It will sometimes have to break the tooth off if it gets jammed in the ground, waiting for two weeks for it to grow back.

entry: POKENAME嘴里射的水，剧毒，接触久，可能失明，让它成为危险战斗对手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME shoots water from its mouth that is extremely poisonous. Prolonged exposure to this water can cause blindness, making it a dangerous adversary in battle.

entry: POKENAME嘴虽小，颚却强，咬上什么，都极难拔。咬伤处，很容易发展成痛疹。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME's mouth is small, it has a strong jaw that lets it grip onto something and be incredibly difficult to remove. Bites from it have a high chance of developing into painful rashes.

entry: POKENAME善泳，用四腿划水。它对人类可以很友善，却须受训，别以咬表达。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are strong swimmers, paddling through the water with their four legs. They can be very friendly towards humans, but have to be trained not to express this by biting.

entry: POKENAME几乎什么都嚼，曾咬坏水下管道与网线。可它性子温顺，吃的却只有海藻、海带。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will chew on basically anything and has been known to damage an underwater pipe or internet cable. However, POKENAME is quite docile and only feeds on seaweed and kelp.

entry: POKENAME和一群同类出没于湖岸、河边，最爱捉弄靠水的生灵。它也常摔跤取乐，因此眼眶带着淤青，并不稀奇。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME haunts the shores of lakes and rivers with a gang of its own kind, delighting in playing pranks on those it finds near the water. It often wrestles for fun, so it is not unusual to see it with a black eye on its face.

entry: POKENAME游在城都河流，常猎鲤鱼王吃。猎物若反抗，就用火尾灼烧。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME swim in the rivers of Johto, often to hunt Magikarp to eat. When encountering any prey that fight back, POKENAME use their fiery tail to scorch them.

entry: POKENAME沿河岸挖隐蔽陷阱，用香草作饵，引蚊香蝌蚪等猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs near riverbanks to create concealed pitfalls. It uses fragrant herbs as bait to lure prey like Poliwag.

entry: POKENAME作宠物，颇有争议，主要因示好方式。咬你越久，就爱得越深；目前最长咬住记录，是6小时。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a contentious reputation as a pet mostly due to its way of showing affection. The longer it holds onto you after biting, the more it loves you. The longest recorded POKENAME bite is currently 6 hours.

entry: POKENAME潜进公园喷泉，偷底部硬币，再逃近河，藏起收藏。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dives into park fountains to steal coins from the bottom. It will flee into a nearby river to store its coins.

entry: POKENAME力量远超外表，双颚能碎石。可迟早在石上咬断一牙，神经损伤直传脑部，便剧烈头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are deceptively powerful creatures that can break rocks with their jaws. When they inevitably break one of their teeth on a rock, the nerve damage goes right to their brain and gives them a searing headache.

entry: 幼年POKENAME是出了名的咬人鬼，什么惹注意，就常咬。虽天性忠诚，建立信任前，训练家仍须极小心。
author: theartemis1
source: Juvenile POKENAME are notorious biters, often snapping at anything that catches their attention. Though loyal by nature, Trainers are advised to exercise extreme caution until trust has been established.

entry: POKENAME拳击水下巨石练力，累坏后，才出湖，在阳光下休息。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME punches underwater boulders to train its strength. Once exhausted, it emerges from the lake to rest in the sunlight.

entry: POKENAME会咬住任何感兴趣的东西，拉进壳里妥善收藏。若被发现兴奋地咬着人，或较大的宝可梦，它们便缩进壳中，逃避责骂。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME clamp their jaws around anything that interests them and pull it back into their shell for safekeeping. If they're caught biting onto a person or larger Pokémon in their excitement, they will hide in their shells to avoid being scolded.

entry: POKENAME每年蜕一次潮湿石壳，开心就跳舞。有时却翻成仰面，挣扎起不来。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: POKENAME shed their damp, stony shell once a year and dance when they are happy. Sometimes they end up on their backs, struggling to get up.

entry: POKENAME常咬大机器，谁也不知为何。颚有磁性，一咬，就很难撬开。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a tendency to bite down onto large machines, though nobody is sure why. Due to the magnetism in its jaws, it's difficult to pry it off once it's bitten down.

entry: POKENAME用头上磁铁，吸来惹兴趣的金属物。它多近水筑巢，因为须保持身体湿润，增强电属性攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses the magnets on its head to pull metal objects that have caught its attention toward itself. It tends to nest near water sources because it needs to keep its body moist to amplify the power of its electric attacks.

entry: POKENAME战时并用背上双炮与利口。苦战后，它爱吃即食肉排，许多训练家也一样。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME uses both the cannons on its back and its sharp maw to attack opponents in battle. After a hard fight, it enjoys eating a Precooked Burger, as do many Trainers.

entry: POKENAME用硬币，引近捕食者，再用强颚咬，吓退比自己大的宝可梦。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME will use its coin to lure predators closer to it. POKENAME will then bite with their powerful jaws, scaring Pokémon larger than it away.

entry: 人们常信，POKENAME背球茎越锯齿状，就越可能好斗。它虽水生，却常晒太阳，恢复每次咬东西，就迅速消耗的能量。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to popular belief, the more jagged the bulb on its back is, the more likely POKENAME is to exhibit aggressiveness. Despite its aquatic nature, it often basks in the sun to regain the energy it quickly expends every time it bites something.

entry: POKENAME用骨泼水，与同类交流。好奇旁观者太近，就张嘴猛咬，警告退开。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME splashes water with its bone to communicate with others of its kind. If a curious onlooker approaches too closely, it snaps at them in warning.

entry: POKENAME吐毒泡，再用刺冠戳破，自我防卫。它浮力强，性随和，常漂过贯穿城市的河。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME expels toxic bubbles which it defensively pops using its spiked crest. This buoyant Pokémon is rather easygoing, and it can often be seen floating down rivers that pass through cities.

entry: POKENAME双颚有力，咬住便不肯松口，因此雷电牙格外强劲。牙齿咬牢时，它还会挥舞双臂，不断向目标送入电流。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's Thunder Fang attack is particularly strong due to its powerful jaws and refusal to let go after biting. While it holds on with its teeth, it swings its arms around to keep generating a shocking electric current into its target.

entry: POKENAME成群游，试着合力放倒，比自己大得多的猎物。繁殖似乎也在这一阶段最旺盛。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME swim in groups so they can attempt to raze prey much bigger than themselves. It is during this stage that POKENAME seems to reproduce the most.

entry: POKENAME脾气差，消化不良，就容易恼怒。猎后一餐，它吞石，帮助胃中磨碎骨与其他硬物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are cantankerous creatures that get easily irritated when they have indigestion. After a round of hunting, they swallow stones so that they can break down bones and other tough materials in their stomach.

entry: POKENAME住沼泽，猎进入领地的鱼宝可梦。可不在沼泽时，它很受孩子欢迎，大家都爱躺肚子打盹。
author: leotpurple_48027
source: Living in swampy areas, POKENAME preys on the fish Pokémon that enter its territory. When it's not in a swamp, POKENAME is really popular with children; they love to take naps on its stomach.

entry: POKENAME虽杂食，野外却只吃植物。它轻咬泳客的脚，吓一跳便游走，似乎觉得极好笑。
author: .izik
source: Although omnivorous, POKENAME will only eat plants in the wild. It gently nips at the feet of swimmers to startle them before swimming away, apparently finding this hilarious.

entry: POKENAME潜湖猎鱼宝可梦，再带回巢。钩状锯齿，一入颚，便让猎物无法逃脱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dives into lakes to hunt for fish Pokémon and carries them back to its nest. Its hooked, serrated teeth ensure that prey cannot escape once trapped in its jaws.

entry: POKENAME乘风暴中，从山降下的气流，张大嘴飞行。猛烈撞中猎物，就强颚咬牢，绝不先松。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME catch winds coming down from the mountains during storms and fly through the air with their jaws agape. When they violently slam into prey, they latch on with their strong jaws, never to let go first.

entry: 双颚强得，河边巨石也能打碎。POKENAME有压力，便会无意从背球茎，释放麻痹粉。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its jaws are so strong that they can shatter even huge rocks along the river. When POKENAME is stressed, it unconsciously releases a paralyzing powder from the bulb on its back.

entry: POKENAME毛始终潮湿，干旱气候也如此。颚力极强，能把石头磨得细碎。
author: npshi
source: The fur of a POKENAME is consistently damp, even when living in arid climates. Its jaw has enough power to finely grind down rocks.

entry: POKENAME亲热，会咬心爱者的耳。两只相恋，也互咬耳，表达爱意。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are affectionate creatures that bite the ears of those they adore. Whenever two POKENAME fall in love, they bite each other's ears to signal romantic interest.

entry: POKENAME一旦咬住，就会合紧双颚，像台钳般牢牢锁住目标。待对手无法挣脱，它便带着对方飞上高空，再松口，让其直坠而下。
author: evilgammon
source: When POKENAME bites, it will clamp its jaw shut and lock the target into a vice-like grip. With the opponent trapped, it will fly up high with them in tow before releasing its hold and sending them plummeting back down.

entry: POKENAME想冲上去咬什么之前，总会先发出一声号角般的短鸣。它至今没明白，这只是在提醒目标，给对方抢先逃走的机会。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME always lets out a little trumpeting noise before it charges in an attempt to bite something. It has yet to grasp that this only serves to alert its target and give it a head start in fleeing.

entry: POKENAME用獠牙咬牢、制住猎物。攀住越久，注毒越多。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME restrains and clamps down on its prey by biting down with its fangs. The longer the fangs remain latched onto its prey, the more venom is injected.

entry: POKENAME常叼大石行走，再以双颚咬碎，展示威吓。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will often be seen walking around with a large rock carried in its mouth. It shatters the stone by crunching down with its jaws as an intimidation display.

entry: POKENAME自负又吵闹，常用棍棒拍打大个头的水属性宝可梦，挑起争斗。随后的战斗里，武器若被缴走，它就毫不犹豫地改用尖牙咬下。
author: sk372
source: Cocky and boisterous, POKENAME is often seen picking fights with larger Water-types by smacking them with its club. If it is disarmed of its weapon in the ensuing battle, it doesn't hesitate to bite down with its sharp teeth instead.

entry: 这只宝可梦咬合力超过5000磅。训练家偶尔误当水上沙滩球，这至今仍是当地肢体缺失的主要原因之一。
author: huh.7
source: This Pokémon has a bite force of over 5,000 pounds. Trainer's occasionally mistake it for a beach ball floating in the water. This is still one of the leading causes of limb loss in the region.

entry: 它察觉危险，就竖毒刺。若没吓退袭击者，便用强颚夹牢目标，绝不松开。
author: skyward_25
source: When it senses danger, it raises its poisonous barbs. If that does not deter the attacker, it uses its powerful jaw to clamp down and never let go of its target.

entry: POKENAME晒太阳打盹，副头则赶走好奇猎手。饿了，它坐岸哭，副头却在水下，等着突袭。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME naps while sunbathing, with the secondary head warding off curious predators. When hungry, it sits on the shore and cries, while the secondary head waits beneath the surface to strike.

entry: POKENAME潜藏在沼泽水中，借助身上的共生植物，与当地草木融为一体，难以察觉。它的双颚力量惊人，一旦被咬住，几乎不可能挣脱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lurk out of sight in swampy water, blending into the native plant life thanks to their symbiotic growths. They have powerful jaws and it is near impossible to break free of them if they bite onto you.

entry: 它能吹闪泡，吸引其他宝可梦，平息攻击性。可谁胡闹，或威胁珍视的生灵，POKENAME都会毫不犹豫，以强颚还击。
author: fiordaliso
source: It can blow shimmering bubbles from its mouth that mesmerize other Pokémon, calming their aggressive behavior. If anyone misbehaves or threatens creatures POKENAME cares for, it won't hesitate to fight back with its powerful jaws.

entry: POKENAME牙与刺，由同样耐用材料构成。两者都意外地钝，却擅长固定，让对手逃不过强咬。
author: quantumradiation
