source: POKENAME's teeth and thorns are made out of the same durable material. Both are surprisingly blunt, excelling at holding onto the opponent and rendering them unable to escape POKENAME's strong bites.

entry: POKENAME浸在河里，只露出眼睛、耳朵和尾巴。它们成群聚集，能让周围的水温升高；兴奋到一定程度，甚至能把水煮沸。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME submerge themselves in rivers so that only their eyes, ears, and tails are above the water. Groups of them raise the ambient temperature of the water surrounding them and, when they are excited enough, can cause it to boil.

entry: POKENAME静止漂在河面，任水流载走。众多尾巴花纹，像漂浮碎屑，浮在水上，方便突袭猎物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME drift along the surface of rivers, remaining motionless and letting the current carry them. Their many tails are patterned to look like drifting detritus, floating at the surface and allowing them to surprise their prey.

entry: 角与壳，坚硬如钢，成分却是铁。POKENAME颚强，咬住后，自己也可能松不开。
author: infinex21
source: Their horns and shells are as hard as steel, yet have the composition of iron. POKENAME have strong jaws and they can struggle to let go of something once they have bitten down.

entry: POKENAME互撞身体，解决领地纷争。牙颚能穿实岩，因此每场碰撞，都常留下满身伤疤。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME bash their own bodies against one another to settle territory disputes. Their jaws and fangs can bite through solid rock, so their clashes often leave one another clad in scars.

entry: POKENAME常在海滩造沙堡，用嘴内作铲，再用水枪压实。造型灵感，多来自噬沙堡爷。
author: beetlething
source: POKENAME is frequently seen at beaches making sandcastles, using the inside of its mouth as a shovel, then compacting the sand using Water Gun. It usually takes inspiration from Palossand while building.

entry: POKENAME一旦咬住，无论如何都不肯松开。它是变温的宝可梦，常追逐火属性宝可梦，因为对方的火焰攻击能帮助调节体温。
author: foolish_weasel
source: When a POKENAME clamps down with its jaws, it will refuse to let go under any circumstances. It has a tendency to go after Fire-type Pokémon since their fire-based attacks help regulate POKENAME's cold-blooded body.

entry: POKENAME双颚进一步发育，迅速就能撕开许多船身。虽常与同类共栖共猎，仍坚持互斗，直到选出首领。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have further-developed jaws capable of quickly shredding through the hulls of many ships. Though they often live and hunt amongst their own kind, POKENAME will insist upon fighting amongst themselves until an alpha of the pack is decided.

entry: POKENAME外形近混混鳄，行为却很不同。它独行，用石尾，打飞胆敢入侵领地的对象。
author: sk372
source: Though it takes on an appearance similar to Krokorok, POKENAME behaves much differently. It leads a solitary lifestyle, and uses its stone tail to send intruders flying if they dare intrude in its territory.

entry: POKENAME在旱地沉重行走，却从不远离水。石颚夹力强得，扔进口中的东西，都没了逃出的希望。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lumbers around arid areas, though never strays too far from a source of water. Its powerful stone jaws clamp down so strongly that nothing tossed inside its mouth has any hope of escaping.

entry: POKENAME喜欢安静独处，因此吵闹粗野的火暴猴，是天然敌人。它虽爱公平交手，遇对手作弊，也乐意动利牙。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME prefers a quiet solitude, making the rowdy and boisterous Primeape its natural enemy. While it prefers an honest fight, it happily relies on its sharp teeth when its opponent cheats.

entry: POKENAME海陆追猎，有时也轻咬别人示好。可若咬的是猎物，就坚决不放。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME chase their prey across land and through water. While they sometimes nibble others affectionately, if they bite down on prey, they will refuse to let go.

entry: POKENAME在海滩觅食，无论冲上海岸，还是挖出来的东西，都大口吞下。爪子若磨损太严重，就会脱落，由新爪取代。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME searches for food on beaches, devouring anything that washes up or that it can find by digging. If its claws become too worn down, they will drop off so that new ones can replace them.

entry: POKENAME追上对手，再用长吻与头上的尖刺，合力猛撞。认真起来，它会拉起多余皮肤护身，同时以双颚夹住敌人。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME run down opponents before bashing them with a combination of their long snouts and the spikes on their heads. When they get serious, they pull up their spare skin to protect their bodies while they clamp their jaws down on foes.

entry: POKENAME住河床下，经流水感振动，再高速冲上，咬经过的猎物。
author: .izik
source: Living beneath riverbeds, POKENAME senses vibrations through flowing water. It erupts upward at high speeds to snap at passing prey.

entry: POKENAME长着许多利齿，牙若损坏，就会重新长出。新牙生长时会挤压大脑，若同时要再生的牙太多，就可能使它头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have many sharp teeth that grow back if a tooth is damaged. The growth of a new tooth presses against their brains, which can give them a headache if they need to regrow lots of teeth at the same time.

entry: POKENAME战斗可怕。敌人为躲强颚，保持距离，却成了火箭炮的好目标。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME is fearsome in battle. Foes attempting to stay out of reach of its powerful jaws make easy targets for POKENAME's rocket cannons.

entry: 从前一形态进化，POKENAME攻击性提高。若成长环境安全、充满爱，它却会为是否用硬币，感到矛盾。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: After evolving from its previous form, POKENAME experiences heightened aggressiveness. If raised in a safe and loving environment, POKENAME will feel conflicted about using its coin.

entry: 一群POKENAME通常只有一个成员，探出壳，帮助辨路。其他紧密跟在领袖后，以心灵感应交流。
author: wiz0z
source: A cluster of POKENAME typically have one member peeking out of their shell in order to help the others navigate. The others follow behind the leader in close formations, communicating with telepathy.

entry: 只有波波的头，有意识，椰蛋树身体只是幌子。翼虽小，仍能靠奇特精神力量飞行。
author: mistymagius
source: The Pidgey head is the only one with consciousness as the Exeggutor body is only a diversion. Despite its small wings, it is still able to fly using its unusual psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME总忍不住，把能找到的食物都吃进去。食物紧缺时，又会找来需要帮助的宝可梦，反刍出来，与它们分享。
author: leshii
source: POKENAME can't help gorging itself on every source of food it can find. In lean times, it finds Pokémon in need and regurgitates food to share.

entry: POKENAME飞时，双翼放毒气，在空中留淡紫雾。它爱栖工业区，因为污染增强力量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wings expel puffs of toxic gas as it flies, leaving a faint purple haze in the air. It prefers to roost near industrial zones, where the pollution enhances its strength.

entry: POKENAME一见猎物，就全速冲，趁未逃，以岩石硬身撞昏。为保喙锋利，每天还磨极硬表面。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME spots prey, it charges at full speed to knock it out with its body, hard as stone, before it can escape. To keep its beak sharp, it rubs it daily against extremely hard surfaces.

entry: POKENAME爱乘轻柔海风滑翔。不飞时，就潜游海下，找海藻。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to glide through the sky on a gentle sea breeze. When they are not flying through the sky, they are swimming underneath the sea looking for seaweed.

entry: POKENAME不吃虫，改靠花蜜和露水为食。可体型、体重增大，让觅食更加不易，每天至少需要合计1磅花蜜与露水，才能填饱肚子。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: Instead of eating bugs, POKENAME relies on eating flower nectar and dew, which is more difficult to come by given the increased size and body weight. It requires at least 1 pound of nectar and dew every day to fill POKENAME's stomach.

entry: POKENAME飞时转动星身，造强阵风，通常为吹走想偷食的害虫。
author: sk372
source: While flying, POKENAME spins its star-shaped body in order to create strong gusts of wind. This is usually done to blow away pests trying to steal the food it procures.

entry: POKENAME游泳肌肉强，轻易逆多数水流。进食却上岸，找河边蚯蚓与小虫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has strong swimming muscles, allowing it to swim against most currents easily. It goes on land to feed, eating the worms and small bugs that inhabit the riverside.

entry: POKENAME利喙覆毒唾液，能随时间，溶解壳与坚果，让它取得别的森林宝可梦，吃不了的独特食物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's sharp beak is coated with a venomous layer of saliva that dissolves shells and nuts over time. This allows them to obtain exclusive food sources unavailable to other forest Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME极好斗，谁敢入领地，一见就袭。为保霸主地位，它用强大冰冻牙，打倒其他飞行属性。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is extremely aggressive and attacks on sight anyone who dares to enter its territory. To maintain its supremacy, it takes down other Flying-type Pokémon with its powerful Ice Fang.

entry: POKENAME用喙翻土，拼命找进化石，能坚持几天，不挖到一颗，绝不停。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs through the dirt with its beak, frantically searching for Evolution stones. It can persist for days, never stopping until it unearths one.

entry: POKENAME对其他波波及其融合体，好斗又嫉妒。它从毛中射电针，攻击半空中的对方，迫其落地。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears belligerent and jealous towards other Pidgey and their fusions. It attacks them with electrically charged needles shot from its fur in order to ground them while mid-flight.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME猛烈抖动身体，扬起毛发里沾着的泥沙，将自己遮住。趁对手迷乱，它便跃到其身后，用燃烧的脚爪攻击。
author: chibitales
source: During battle, POKENAME shakes its body vigorously to cloud itself in the dirt or sand stuck in its fur. It takes advantage of the opponent's confusion by leaping behind them and striking with burning talons.

entry: POKENAME在波波群附近盘旋，伺机偷走它们辛苦寻来的食物。它的叫声像波波，却更响亮、更尖锐，能惊飞整个鸟群，让它趁机抢得一餐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hovers around near where Pidgey flock, looking to steal some of the food they scrounge up. Its cry is a louder, shriller version of Pidgey's, and effective at sending a flock flying away so it can swipe a meal.

entry: 方向感与嗅觉，让POKENAME成为出人意料的强猎手。偶尔，它甚至用毒角，给猎物添点味。
author: ichosuzu
source: Its sense of direction and smell make POKENAME a surprisingly powerful hunter. It occasionally even uses its poisonous horn to add some flavor to what it catches.

entry: POKENAME在树上静止，以硬化棕羽融入环境。受扰，先放细粉云，使人轻微麻痹，再飞走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME remains motionless in trees, blending in with its hardened, brown feathers. If disturbed, it will release a cloud of fine dust that causes mild paralysis before taking flight.

entry: POKENAME爪硬如石，通过撕抓巢旁表面，磨得锋利。冷月，它迁往暖地，一飞几天才到。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's claws are as hard as stone and are sharpened by tearing into nearby surfaces where it nests. During colder months, it migrates to warmer regions, flying for days to reach them.

entry: 它头上长出的翅膀，强得足以带它短暂飞行。POKENAME的羽毛变成雪白，就表示刚换过羽，还需几周，才能长得比从前更强韧。
author: fiordaliso
source: The wings growing from its head are strong enough to let it fly, though only for short periods. When their plumage turns snowy white, it means POKENAME has recently molted, and it will take weeks for its feathers to regrow stronger than before.

entry: POKENAME性温柔，多吃树果，或更强宝可梦留下的食物。它巧用头翼，飞往更安全的住处。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a gentle creature that feeds mostly on berries or the leftovers from stronger Pokémon. It skillfully uses the pair of wings on its head to soar to safer places to live.

entry: POKENAME给翼涂粉，防寄生虫攀住。它们带着刺与爪，嗡飞着找小宝可梦作猎物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME coat their wings with dust to avoid parasites from latching onto them. They buzz around with their stingers and talons to search for small Pokémon to turn into prey.

entry: POKENAME是极小的鸟宝可梦，随风漂向想去的地方。有人靠近时，还能瞬间移动。
author: smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a very tiny bird Pokémon that lets itself float on the wind wherever it may want to go. It has the power to teleport if anyone comes near.

entry: POKENAME将开战，就以鲜亮烈焰覆背，警告对手。虽有双翼，找食时，却更爱沿地跳。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME is about to battle, it cloaks its back in vivid flames to warn its opponent. Despite having a pair of wings, it prefers to hop along the ground while searching for food.

entry: POKENAME虽小，水空都快，最高时速50英里。它也极护地盘，信任没那么容易取得。
author: malumwenmonkey
source: Though small in size, POKENAME is very fast in both water and air, reaching speeds of up to 50 miles per hour. POKENAME is also very territorial, so trust may not come so easily.

entry: 这些胆小宝可梦，爱看露营者日常。一被发现，顺滑双翼与轻身，便让它轻易逃脱，几乎抓不到。
author: quackquackattack
source: These skittish Pokémon are known to observe campers go about their day. When spotted, they are nearly impossible to catch as their sleek wings and light bodies allow them to escape quite easily.

entry: POKENAME猛拍大翼，能使出大范围泼沙，迷敌双眼。羽毛角度，却让自己不会被扬沙击中。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: With a crack of their large wings, POKENAME can create large Sand Attacks to blind their enemies. Thanks to the angling of their feathers, POKENAME cannot be hit by the sand they whip up.

entry: POKENAME滑过晨雾，翼覆细而反光的粉。它飞在花田上方，身后留下细小闪光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides through the morning mist, its wings coated in a fine, reflective dust. It flutters above flower fields, leaving behind tiny sparkling trails as it moves.

entry: POKENAME既会设陷阱，也会主动捕猎。家檐留一张它的网，几乎保证，家里不再有害虫。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME are capable of both trapping and hunting prey. Hosting one of their webs in the eaves of one's house practically guarantees a pest-free home.

entry: POKENAME有大比鸟超级进化的特征。小小身体，飞得却快得离谱，常难以刹住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME exhibits features of Pidgeot's Mega Evolution. It flies at ridiculous speeds for its small stature to the point that it often has difficulty stopping properly.

entry: POKENAME虽像未成熟的比比鸟，却大不相同。大身体，让它以三倍速度，滑过深林猎食；可食量，也比普通波波大得多。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: Despite it resembling an immature Pidgeotto, POKENAME is far from it. Its bigger body allows it to glide through deep forests and hunt prey at tripled speeds, but being bigger means that it requires much more food than a normal Pidgey.

entry: POKENAME飞时易被强风卷走，常因此懊恼。它脾气急，劈雷断树，自己却又晕、又累。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME is easily swept away by strong wind as it flies, which often frustrates it. POKENAME has a short temper and will split trees in half with a lightning bolt, leaving it dizzy and exhausted.

entry: POKENAME淘气飞过草甸，一边唱高调旋律。听者常突然困倦，便能有效劝退捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flutters playfully through meadows, singing a high-pitched melody as it flies. Those who hear its tune often feel a sudden drowsiness, making it an effective deterrent for predators.

entry: POKENAME日出欢叫，飞到哪，都传去安神能量。健康，蛋壳就在阳光下闪亮。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME chirps joyfully at sunrise, spreading a calming energy wherever it flies. Its eggshell glitsens in the sunlight if it is healthy.

entry: POKENAME学会飞，仍逗留巢旁，与附近人和宝可梦，更加亲近。据说，送智力之羽者，会有一周好运。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lingers by its nest after gaining flight, which helps it develop deeper bonds with Pokémon and people nearby. People who give it a Genius Feather are said to have good luck for a week.

entry: POKENAME筑巢前，先用精神能力，判断当地将来是否淹水。安全，才收杂草与藤，编成坚巢。
author: .izik
source: Before building a nest, POKENAME uses its psychic abilities to determine if the area will flood in the future. If safe, it weaves a sturdy nest using gathered weeds and vines.

entry: POKENAME成大群，保护彼此。它们飞不好，反而通常用翼与尾羽，吸引配偶。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME travels in large herds for protection. It is bad at flying, so it typically uses its wings and tail feathers to attract mates instead.

entry: POKENAME头羽，不如普通大比鸟亮，求偶更易被拒。虽有这缺点，非凡速度与力量，却仍保留。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME's head feathers don't shine as brilliantly as an ordinary Pidgeot, making it more vulnerable to being rejected by a potential mate. Despite this setback, it still retains its incredible feats of speed and strength.

entry: POKENAME随毽子草群，翱翔天空。阵风一吹散，它就帮助找回，归还群体。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME soar through the sky alongside groups of Hoppip. Whenever a gust of wind scatters these groups, POKENAME help locate lost Hoppip to return them to the group.

entry: 这是新手训练家常用的融合宝可梦。POKENAME好训练，还喜欢找来树果，与训练家分享。
author: vaporvenator
source: A fusion used commonly by beginner Trainers. POKENAME are generally easy to train and enjoy searching for Berries to share with their Trainers.

entry: POKENAME的捕猎方式，随个体性情而异。有些借风飘向猎物，经过时便将其捕获；有些则埋进土里，吃掉其中生活的生灵。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME's way of hunting for prey is different based on their nature. While some POKENAME rely on the wind to float towards and catch prey as it passes, some will instead bury themselves in the dirt and eat whatever is living inside it.

entry: POKENAME已适应，主要靠元气根生活，似乎不介意苦味，常在树根部啄挖。它用根产苦膜，捕食者极讨厌那味。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME have adapted to mostly live off Energy Root. They do not seem to mind the bitter taste and are found pecking at the base of trees to unearth the root. They use the root to produce a bitter film that predators despise the taste of.

entry: POKENAME好奇，常在安全距离，观察别人活动。什么特别惹兴趣，额上宝石就会明亮闪烁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has an inquisitive personality, often observing the activities of others from a safe distance. One can tell if it is particularly intrigued by something if the jewel on its forehead sparkles and flickers brightly.

entry: POKENAME读心与感知心情，对鸟宝可梦尤其有效，片刻就能用精神能力，安抚愤怒鸟群。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's capacity for reading minds and sensing moods is particularly effective in regards to avian Pokémon. It can soothe an angry flock of birds in just a few moments with its mental abilities.

entry: POKENAME近公路筑巢，车的暖尾气，能让四周温暖。车流一停，它们就试着讨点心。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME make their nests near highways because the warm exhaust from vehicles keeps the general vicinity warm. When traffic comes to a halt, POKENAME attempt to solicit treats from cars.

entry: POKENAME空中快，喙又强，适合学习简单实用的战术，因此常作新手的第一只融合宝可梦。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME's swift aerial movements and powerful beak make it a perfect pick for learning simple but effective strategies. This makes it a common first fusion for beginner Trainers.

entry: POKENAME潜行、藏身于高草间，不被察觉地接近猎物。一到合适位置，它们便扬起遮眼的沙，扰乱对方，再给予致命一击。
author: quackquackattack
source: By creeping and hiding in tall grass, POKENAME close the distance between themselves and their prey without being detected. Once in position, they kick up blinding sand to confuse their prey before landing a lethal blow.

entry: POKENAME贴着树干栖息，聆听波波捕猎的动静。一发现有波波正要进食，它便发出刺耳的尖啸，俯冲而下，吓跑波波，抢走对方辛苦得来的食物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME perches against tree trunks, listening for the sounds of Pidgey hunting. When it catches one that is just about to eat, it swoops down with an ear-piercing shriek, scaring off the Pidgey and stealing its hard-earned meal.

entry: 野生POKENAME毫不犹豫撕树基，找小而可食的宝可梦。驯养后，却意外耐心、宽容，记性也敏锐。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: Wild POKENAME don't hesitate to tear apart the bases of trees in order to find small, edible Pokémon. However, when domesticated, POKENAME are surprisingly patient and tolerant, and have a sharp memory.

entry: POKENAME想挤进波波群，欺负同伴、逼其臣服，自当首领。结果，通常被全群赶走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tries to interject itself into Pidgey communities and assert itself as the de facto leader by bullying others into submission. This usually results in it being chased off by the whole flock.

entry: POKENAME留下黏树果汁洼，再躲附近。虫宝可梦黏够了，就吃美汁与虫的混餐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME leaves behind puddles of sticky berry juice, then hides nearby. Once enough bug Pokémon are stuck, it goes to feast on the mixture of tasty juice and bugs.

entry: POKENAME用喙采集哈密果，存进隐蔽的巢中。羽毛带着淡淡蜂蜜香，使它成了饥饿虫属性宝可梦最喜欢的目标。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects Hondew Berries in its beak and stores them in hidden nests. Its feathers carry a faint honey-like scent, making POKENAME a favorite target for hungry Bug-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME知道，自己的长颈小头，旁人看来有些怪。可其他波波往往很仰慕，还靠它用长颈，挖地下的虫宝可梦。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME is self-aware of how odd its long neck and tiny head appear to others, but more often than not, other Pidgey admire it. They even rely on POKENAME to use its long neck to dig for Bug-type Pokémon from the ground.

entry: POKENAME虽覆着大量羽毛，本体却很小，依旧轻盈。羽毛保温极好，常被用来填枕头。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite it being covered in a massive number of feathers, POKENAME is pretty lightweight due to how small their actual body is. The feathers are great heat insulators and are commonly in pillows.

entry: POKENAME滑翔沼泽找猎物，从上方用毒喙出击。一啄，就可能让蚊香蝌蚪，瞬间麻痹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides over swamps in search of prey, striking from above with its venom-coated beak. A single peck can be enough to paralyze a Poliwag instantly.

entry: POKENAME侵入电脑，找树枝、木材的图像文件，收进空文件夹筑巢，好在里面产蛋。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME infiltrate computers to search for image files of branches or wood. They gather these files to make nests within empty folders to give themselves a place to lay their eggs.

entry: POKENAME虽威严，穿过栖地的公路，却让许多个体被车撞伤。环保团体宣传，请司机减速保护。
author: quackquackattack
source: As majestic as POKENAME are, many are hurt by cars on roads that cut through their natural habitat. Campaigns from environmental groups urge drivers to slow down to protect POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME尾羽渗浓如墨的棕色黏液，气味极冲。这恶臭物质，用来驱退巢区捕食者。
author: .izik
source: A thick, inky brown goo seeps from POKENAME's tail feathers, giving off an intensely pungent odor. This foul-smelling substance is used to repel predators from its nesting grounds.

entry: POKENAME用喙探查四周，好奇地啄遇见的一切。它总担心外表，勤理羽，保证最好看。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their beaks to examine their surroundings, curiously pecking at anything they find. These Pokémon are constantly worried about their appearance, preening their feathers to ensure they look their best.

entry: POKENAME翼尾，长着松散干羽。遇险猛烈抖动，发干涩的咔啦声，警告离开。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have loose, dry feathers lining their tail and wings. When they feel threatened they shake them vigorously, creating a dry rattling sound to warn away danger.

entry: POKENAME想吓别的宝可梦，不论对手或猎手，都会蓬起双翼，显得更大。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fluff their wings up to make themselves appear bigger than they actually are. They do this whenever they want to scare off another Pokémon, whether that's a rival or a predator.

entry: 成群聚集时，POKENAME会比赛谁能放出最大的火焰。许多个体拼尽全力，但大多数也只能点燃几根木棍。
author: universal9449
source: When in groups, POKENAME will compete with each other to see which one can produce the biggest flame. Many try as hard as they can, but most can only make enough fire to light a few sticks.

entry: POKENAME飞时，从下看，外形容易误导判断。有人说，挨雷，它会反放强电，常烧焦下方地面。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME's appearance is misleading when viewed from below as it flies. Some claim that when struck by lightning, it discharges powerful electric energy in return, often scorching the ground beneath it.

entry: 天冷时，有些人会先送给POKENAME一根体力之羽，再将它放归野外。羽毛能添上一点暖意，帮助它御寒，度过生活中的种种艰难。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever it gets cold, some people opt to give POKENAME a Health Feather before turning it back towards the wild. The feather helps it endure life's troubles by giving it a little extra heat to keep warm.

entry: POKENAME翅膀太小，飞得不如大多数猎物快，便用翅膀掀出空气斩，再以颊囊电力加强。攻击强得连大树也能斩倒。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: POKENAME's wings are too small for it to fly faster than most of its prey, so it uses its wings to generate Air Slashes that it reinforces with electricity from its cheek pouches. These attacks are powerful enough to cut down even large trees.

entry: POKENAME不到一小时，就能吃空一棵瓜西果树。飞行中，先用强翼拍落，再大吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can strip a Watmel Berry tree bare in less than an hour. It knocks the berries loose mid-flight with powerful wing beats before devouring them.

entry: 用浓烈草本马萨拉调成的辣味咖喱，让POKENAME肾上腺素涌动，帮助赢下小小杯。战一轮后，它爱喝新鲜芒果酸奶饮，降降温。
author: quackquackattack
source: A Spicy Curry, when made with an herbal and pungent masala, gives POKENAME an adrenaline boost that helps it win Little Cup tournaments. After a round of battles, it enjoys a fresh mango lassi to help cool down.

entry: POKENAME翼后鳞，能抵消飞行时野生宝可梦的电力。它先沙泥浴，再以最高时速100英里飞，把身上泥沙吹掉。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME's wings have scales along the back that allow it to negate electricity from wild Pokémon while it flies. POKENAME can be seen bathing itself in sand and mud before blowing it off by flying around at top speeds of 100 mph.

entry: POKENAME摆臂太低，就会把沙踢进自己眼。它虽记得地点，却总绕很长、很曲折的路，才到目的地。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME will accidentally kick up sand into its eyes if it swings its arms too low to the ground. While it can remember where a location is, it always takes a very long and convoluted path to reach that destination.

entry: POKENAME聚小镇旁，在附近树上栖身。体内火，让羽摸来温暖。孩子常送树果、种子交友，它便一路跟随。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME flock near small towns, taking shelter in the trees nearby. Their inner fires make their feathers warm to the touch. Many children befriend POKENAME by offering them berries and seeds, and these Pokémon will follow them afterwards.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间都安全地待在巢里，肚子饿了就叫父母。若太久没吃东西，它便会大发脾气，吐出火球。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Spending most of their days in the safety of the nest, POKENAME cry out to their parents when they get hungry. If this Pokémon goes too long without eating, it will spit fireballs in a temper tantrum.

entry: POKENAME背羽尖，绷紧能割硬皮。它用强爪钻地，跃出，再滑过空中。
author: infinex21
source: The feathers on POKENAME's back are pointed and can tense enough to cut tough hides. It burrows using its strong claws and glides through the air when it leaps out of the ground.

entry: POKENAME背上长硬羽，虽难拿来飞，却是强大防御，充当保护尖刺。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have stiffened feathers sprouting from its back. While difficult to use for flight, these feathers are strong defensive structures and function as protective spines.

entry: POKENAME打架很“脏”，说的是手段，也说的是泥沙。它用覆羽的双臂扬起沙土，迷住对手的眼，再趁敌人失去方向，冲上去猛踢。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME fight dirty, both literally and figuratively. In combat, this Pokémon will use its feathery arms to whip up sand and dirt to blind its opponents. While the foe is disoriented, POKENAME rushes forward and deals harsh blows with its kicks.

entry: POKENAME在巢里大叫，吸引照料者注意。每逢将跌下，就瞬间移回巢。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME cry loudly from within their nest to get the attention of their caregivers. Whenever they are about to fall, they teleport back into the nest.

entry: POKENAME温柔娴静，常照料波波群，用轻柔悦耳的咕声，安抚鸟儿。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a soft and demure personality, often taking Pidgey flocks under its wing to care for them. It soothes the birds by singing with a cooing melodic voice.

entry: 两只POKENAME争夺同一个伴侣时，会彼此尖叫，都想盖过对方。这番争斗通常能持续长达两小时，到那时，争夺的对象却早已离开。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: When two POKENAME confront each other over a single mate, they begin to scream at each other, each attempting to be louder than the other. These fights tend to last for up to two hours, and by then, the mate they were fighting for will have left.

entry: POKENAME太重、又没翼，飞行困难。难以飞逃危险，让它性子极固执，面对强者或环境险阻，也不退缩。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME struggle with flying due to their weight and lack of wings. Since it is difficult for them to fly away from danger, POKENAME tend to have very obstinate personalities, undaunted by stronger Pokémon or environmental hazards.

entry: POKENAME外表，让古人将它视为神明的小兵。据说，多眼的麻痹目光，最强宝可梦，也抗不住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's appearance caused it to be seen as the foot soldier of deities in ancient times. Its many eyes are said to hold a paralyzing gaze that not even the strongest Pokémon can resist.

entry: POKENAME在高山地区筑巢，寻找树根间的空洞，将巢藏好，避开捕食者。它们的啾鸣与叫声回荡林间；谁若靠巢太近，叫声便会变得慌乱而凶狠。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME nest in alpine regions, finding hollows amongst tree roots to hide their nests from predators. Their chirps and cries can be heard echoing through the forests, turning frantic and aggressive should someone get too close to their nest.

entry: POKENAME助跑跃起，再乘风滑翔。对敌人或猎物，它会头顶朝前俯冲，打出毁灭性重击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME take to the air by running and leaping, then they glide on the wind. They will dive with the tops of their heads aimed forward toward any foe or prey and strike with devastating force.

entry: POKENAME在高山筑巢，藏于树根空洞，躲捕食者。它护巢凶猛，蓬羽显大，吓走找到的对象。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME nest in alpine regions, finding hollows amongst tree roots to hide their nests from predators. They are fiercely protective of their nest, fluffing up their feathers to appear bigger to scare off anyone that finds them.

entry: POKENAME小翼飞不了。外面太冷，它就蜷身，用翼裹蛋，保持温暖。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME cannot fly with its tiny wings. Instead, it will curl its body and wrap its wings around its eggs to keep them warm if it gets too cold outside.

entry: POKENAME听觉无瑕，能听见地下10英尺的虫宝可梦。它挖洞后留下，已害几名训练家跌入，等人救出。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME's impeccable hearing allows it to hear bug Pokémon crawling 10 feet underneath the ground. Several Trainers have had to be rescued from falling into one of these holes created and left by POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME住零下环境，飞行受限。人们送抵抗之羽，求个好运，因为它的情谊与仇怨，都能记一生。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lives life in subzero conditions and has limited flight mobility. People give it a Resist Feather as good luck, as it develops bonds and grudges that last a lifetime.

entry: POKENAME身重、骨铁，双翼根本举不起。可天生磁力，让它仍是敏捷飞手。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME's heavy body and iron bones mean that its wings are completely incapable of lifting its weight. Despite this, it is an agile flier thanks to its innate magnetism.

entry: 农人常饲养温顺的POKENAME，既能把它当园艺铲，也能让它除害虫。野生个体会用刀一般的喙啄食橙子等坚硬果实。
author: thescribe
source: Tame POKENAME are often used by farmers, as they both function as a garden shovel and pest control. In the wild, POKENAME use their knife-like beaks to eat hard fruits like oranges.

entry: POKENAME用成对的利刃快速刺击，既用于战斗，也用于觅食。在野外，它会刺穿水果，与另一把剑上的头分享。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME both fights and forages via quick stabbing maneuvers with its paired blades. In the wild, it stabs through fruits and shares the meal with the head on the opposite sword.

entry: 它们有四条腿和两只翅膀，远看颇像某些传说中的生物。许多游客凑近后发现只是POKENAME，十分失望。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: With their four legs and two wings, these Pokémon resemble certain mythical creatures from a distance. Many tourists have been disappointed to see a POKENAME upon closer inspection instead of something else.

entry: POKENAME个头虽小，却很聪明，每天都会充分利用身上的金属利刃。无论剖开坚果还是砍断筑巢的细枝，都离不开它们。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are small yet clever creatures that make full use of their metallic blades daily. From cutting open nuts to chopping twigs for their nest, these blades are an essential part of everyday life.

entry: POKENAME用缎带和喙寻找种子吃。性情温顺又容易训练，很受新手训练家欢迎。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME uses both its ribbons and beak to look for seeds to eat. It is popular among rookie Trainers for its docile nature and ease of training.

entry: 野生POKENAME极力保护自己带领的群体，为确保成员安好不惜一切。它们常对人类抱有敌意，会凶狠啄击任何被视为威胁的对象，并甩动巨尾攻击。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: Wild POKENAME are fiercely protective of the group they lead, stopping at nothing to make sure they're all right. These Pokémon are often hostile towards humans, pecking ferociously and swinging their massive tails at any it judges a threat.

entry: POKENAME用空间之力把袭击者送往其他领域，借此避开一切争斗。无论身处哪个次元，它都清楚知道自己认定的家园究竟在哪个世界。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME avoids all fights by sending any attackers away to other realms using its power of space. No matter what dimension it has brought itself to, it always knows the exact world it has marked as its home.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛丰厚柔软又漂亮，很受宝可梦培育家欢迎。头上的羽毛长得快，也很适合打理成各种造型。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have plush and beautiful plumage that make them very popular with Pokémon Breeders. The feathers on their head are fast growing and well-suited to being styled in multiple different ways.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛丰厚柔软又漂亮，很受宝可梦培育家欢迎。头上的羽毛长得快，也很适合打理成各种造型。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have plush and beautiful plumage that make them very popular with Pokémon Breeders. The feathers on their head are fast growing and well-suited to being styled in multiple different ways.

entry: POKENAME每天都会在同一时刻发出恼人的啁啾，分毫不差，精确到纳秒。可它选择的时刻似乎完全随机。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME chirps obnoxiously at the exact same moment each day, down to the nanosecond. The timing seems to be picked entirely at random.

entry: 喜欢漂亮珍宠的人争相寻觅野生POKENAME。它的翅膀与尾巴柔如丝绸，进化后更为珍贵。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME is a very sought-after wild fusion for beautiful- and rare-pet owners. Its wings and tails are soft as silk, and it only become more valuable as it evolves.

entry: 它不停尖叫，还把钥匙弄得叮当响，被人视为麻烦。尖叫是因为懊恼：它一想飞，钥匙就总往下掉。
author: haypile
source: It is considered a nuisance thanks to constant screaming and key jingling. The reason it screams is frustration: it keeps dropping keys when trying to fly.

entry: POKENAME把喙在岩石上摩擦，便能燃起火焰，大幅增强啄击的威力。面对胆敢挑战领地的飞行属性对手，它会展开宽大的双翼，让自己显得更大以吓退对方。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can set its beak ablaze by scraping it against rocks, making its strikes significantly more powerful. It spreads its broad wings wide to appear larger and intimidate rival Flying-type Pokémon that dare challenge its territory.

entry: POKENAME用布料和羽毛遮住身体，趁波波双亲外出时混进巢里。亲鸟衔食归来，它就和其他雏鸟一起啁啾讨食，蒙混过关。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME cover their bodies in cloth and feathers, infiltrating Pidgey nests while the parents are away. Once one of the parents returns with food, they chirp and beg to be fed, blending in with the rest of the brood.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴能相继燃起并快速旋转，让它飞起来。飞行十分耗费体力，结束后必须打个盹。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has tails that can ignite and spin in rapid succession, enabling flight. When it is done flying, it needs to take a nap because of the amount of energy used.

entry: POKENAME用尾羽调整空中的姿态，使踢击精准命中。动作迅捷，连最灵敏的对手也能应付。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its tail feathers to adjust its position mid-air, allowing it to deliver precise aerial kicks. Its movements are swift enough to counter even the most agile opponents.

entry: POKENAME用细长灵活的手臂探进树里抓取猎物。它不善飞行，大多数个体连对上最弱小的捕食者也很容易沦为猎物。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME uses its long, flexible arms to reach inside trees and grab its prey. It cannot fly well, which results in most POKENAME being an easy target for even the weakest of predators.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴模拟一束阳光，引诱虫宝可梦跟来。遇到较大的虫宝可梦，就用尾巴抽打，从体表使其麻痹。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME uses its tail to lure out bug Pokémon, simulating a ray of sunlight for it to follow. It stuns bigger bug Pokémon by whipping its tail at them, paralyzing their bodies from the outside.

entry: POKENAME让尾巴上的星星发光，招引同类。它善于狩猎，会给坚硬的喙通电，削弱猎物。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME makes the star on its tail shine to draw other members of its species toward it. It is a skilled hunter that electrifies its sturdy beak to weaken its prey.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，翅膀会发出轻柔舒缓的振动，催眠附近的宝可梦。生气时则鼓起胸膛，懊恼地高声鸣叫，余音回荡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wings create soft, soothing vibrations as it flies, lulling nearby Pokémon to sleep. If it gets angry, it will puff up its chest and let out a loud, echoing chirp in frustration.

entry: 为了吃到压在底下的种子，POKENAME连比自己还大的岩石也会砸开。睡着时，铜色的身体常被误认成一堆石头。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME will break open rocks larger than itself just to reach seeds trapped underneath. When asleep, its coppery body is often mistaken for a clump of rocks.

entry: POKENAME的头太大，飞不快，也飞不远。不过，带锯齿的巨喙让它很容易捕获猎物。
author: reflecbeat
source: Because POKENAME's head is so large, it can't fly far or quickly. However, the sheer size of its serrated beak means it finds it easy to catch its prey.

entry: POKENAME躲在海带林里避敌，用锋利的喙啄击闯入者。若有训练家邀请它加入队伍，它会欢天喜地地绕着对方游圈。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hides in kelp forests to avoid predators, pecking anyone that intrudes with its sharp beak. If POKENAME receives an offer to join a Trainer's team, it will swim in circles around the Trainer with gleeful delight.

entry: 天气晴朗时，POKENAME尾巴上的火焰最为明亮。为保护火焰，下雨就会躲进地下。
author: ozydamians
source: The fire on POKENAME's tail burns brightest on days with clear weather. It hides underground from rain to protect its flame.

entry: POKENAME的大眼睛让它成了敏捷的夜间猎手，专捕绿毛虫、独角虫等小虫。羽毛出奇柔软，是制作高档帽子的抢手材料。
author: ratractac
source: The wide eyes of POKENAME allow it to be a dextrous nocturnal hunter of small bugs like Caterpie or Weedle. Its feathers, surprisingly soft, are sought after for luxury hats.

entry: 它的羽毛在鸟宝可梦中也数一数二地光滑。POKENAME因此几乎不用耗费体力便能乘气流滑翔，轻盈优雅地掠过速度较慢的宝可梦。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: This Pokémon's feathers are some of the smoothest of any bird Pokémon. This allows POKENAME to glide upon air currents using almost no energy, speeding past slower Pokémon with ease and grace.

entry: POKENAME栖在树枝上，把爪子深深嵌入枝干吸收养分。吃饱后，身上的花苞会有节奏地搏动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME perches on tree limbs, digging its talons deep to absorb nutrients. When it has fed enough, the bud on its body pulses rhythmically.

entry: POKENAME羽毛蓬松的体内充满气体，能轻轻飘过花田。利爪的力量远超外表，一瞬间就能抓住喇叭芽之类的猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's gas-filled, feathery body allows it to float gently over flower fields. Its talons are deceptively strong, capable of seizing prey like Bellsprout in an instant.

entry: POKENAME在胡萝卜田上空翱翔，寻找患病或受损的作物，用喙将其拔起，维持田地健康。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME soars over carrot fields, searching for diseased or damaged crops. It plucks them from the ground with its beak, keeping the fields healthy.

entry: POKENAME肩头额外覆着一簇羽毛，更加保暖，也让它能耐受寒冷。尽管如此，它仍喜欢待在温暖、阳光充足的地方。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: The extra bundle of feathers covering POKENAME's shoulders give it extra warmth, and allow it to withstand colder environments. Despite this, it still chooses to remain in warm places with sunlight anyway.

entry: POKENAME柔软的身体能挤进树内，把发现的虫宝可梦统统吃掉。它会在附近留下一小块身体，记住每处饱餐的地点。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME's squishy body allows it to squeeze inside trees and eat any and all bug Pokémon it finds. It is able to remember every feasting spot by leaving a small portion of its body nearby.

entry: 性情安静，偶尔能在天气晴好的地方见到它飘浮的身影。只要条件允许就会结伴旅行，不喜争斗。
author: bobosmith01
source: A quiet Pokémon that is found floating around from time to time in places of fair weather. If possible, it travels in a pack. It dislikes conflict.

entry: POKENAME朝树洞和洞壁上的孔穴尖叫，使小宝可梦晕头转向地踉跄爬出。它没有固定作息，只有需要时才休息。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME screeches into the holes of trees and cave walls, causing small Pokémon to come out, stumbling and confused. There is no set schedule for when POKENAME are awake or asleep, as they only rest when they need to.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛储存着静电，扇翅时会轻轻噼啪作响。停在电线上时，它会吸收少量电能以维持体力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feathers store static electricity, crackling softly as it flaps its wings. When it perches on power lines, it absorbs small amounts of energy to maintain its strength.

entry: POKENAME用坚硬锋利的长牙沿途刻下记号，从不会迷路。这些记号也帮助了许多人，甚至其他宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their tough and sharp tusks to mark their way so they never get lost. These markings are a boon to many, even other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME目光敏锐，能察觉高草丛中最细微的动静。一旦发现猎物，就从喙中精准喷出火焰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's keen eyesight allows it to detect even the slightest movement in tall grass. Once it spots prey, it launches a precise blast of flame from its beak.

entry: POKENAME用森林里捡来的彩色球果壳装饰巢穴。它会从尖喙中喷出灼热火焰，保卫领地。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME decorates its nest with colorful Apricorn shells it finds in the forest. POKENAME defends its territory by breathing scorching flames from its sharp beak.

entry: POKENAME快速抖动羽毛，把发亮的余烬撒向空中，在暮色里形成绚丽景象。受到威胁时，会点燃喙来威吓对方。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME shakes its feathers rapidly to scatter glowing embers in the air, creating a dazzling display at dusk. If threatened, it ignites its beak, making itself appear threatening.

entry: POKENAME喙中有尖牙，能刺穿猎物皮肤，吸取生命能量。平时则用牙齿梳理羽毛，清除身上的寄生虫。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME beaks have sharp teeth that they use to puncture the skin of their prey, sucking out their vital energy. When not in combat, they use their teeth to preen their feathers, keeping their body free of parasites.

entry: POKENAME栖在矿洞外，等人们带出成批的宝石。一见到晶体特有的闪光，整群便会飞扑下来，搜集宝石带回巢中。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME perch outside of mines, lying in wait for people to bring in hauls of gems. Once they spot a telltale shine of crystal, entire flocks of POKENAME will descend to gather gems to bring back to their nests.

entry: POKENAME羽毛尖端会分泌透明的麻痹毒液。受到威胁时，它会扑翅洒出毒液，使大型捕食者麻痹后逃走。
author: .izik
source: The tips of POKENAME's feathers secrete a clear, paralyzing toxin. When threatened, it flutters its wings to scatter the venom and stun larger predators before escaping.

entry: 科学家推测，远古的宝宝暴龙可能长得与POKENAME相似。它喙状的双颚力大无穷，能咬碎小型岩块。
author: mistymagius
source: Scientists theorize that Tyrunt could have looked similar to POKENAME in ancient times. Its beak-like jaws are powerful enough to crush small boulders.

entry: 叶片对POKENAME小小的身体而言太过沉重，因此主要靠跳跃移动。脱落的叶片可泡成草本茶，在关都沿海一带很受欢迎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME primarily gets around by hopping, as its leaves weigh heavily on its tiny frame. Shed leaves can be steeped in water to brew an herbal tea popular in coastal parts of Kanto.

entry: 面对危险，POKENAME会踢腿拍翅，把沙土扫进袭击者眼中，争取时间脱身。它会十分亲近训练家，还会跳舞博取欢心。
author: periperi_chicken
source: When confronted with danger, POKENAME will kick its feet and clap its wings, brushing sand and dirt into its attacker's eyes and giving them enough time to escape. They can be very affectionate with their Trainer and will dance to impress them.

entry: POKENAME手臂上的羽毛太多，无法飞行。一尝试起飞便拼命乱挥，远远望去常被误以为在加油喝彩。
author: jaminmcready
source: Due to the excess feathers on its arms, POKENAME cannot fly. When it tries, it flails wildly, which is often mistaken for cheering from a distance.

entry: POKENAME方向感极其敏锐，能找到大量垃圾吃。
author: crazydraws
source: Due to POKENAME's extremely sharp sense of direction, it is able to find large amounts of garbage to consume.

entry: POKENAME从喙中分泌带零余果香的树液，引诱毫无戒心的猎物。等猎物靠近，便突然使出起风将其击倒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME secretes a Chesto Berry-scented sap from its beak to lure in unsuspecting prey. Once they get close, it dispatches them with a sudden Gust attack.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀覆着柔软蓬松的绒羽，能挡开尘土与污垢。它轻松滑过天空，身后留下几缕闪烁的羽毛，轻盈如丝。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wings are covered in soft, fluffy down that repels dust and dirt. It glides effortlessly through the sky, leaving behind delicate trails of shimmering feathers.

entry: 飞行时，它的花朵会飘出奇异的臭味。这既能告知其他POKENAME该避开哪股气流，也能阻止捕食者袭击。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: A strange stink wafts from this Pokémon's flower while it is in flight. This simultaneously communicates to other POKENAME which air current to avoid and discourages predators from attacking it.

entry: POKENAME发出痛苦的啁啾，引诱阿柏蛇等毫无戒心的猎物。等对方靠得够近，就将其拖进沙下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits distressed chirping noises to lure in unsuspecting prey like Ekans. Once close enough, it drags them beneath the sand's surface.

entry: POKENAME不怕高，能在枝头爬行。背上的真菌不断吸走养分，害它总得四处找吃的。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is not afraid of heights and crawls over branches. It is in constant search of food, as the fungi on its back slowly extract its nutrients.

entry: 它对自己的本领极为自豪。POKENAME能从几码外发现藏起来的物品，深受训练家重视。
author: schwaus
source: It has an abundance of pride in its abilities. Trainers value POKENAME for their ability to spot hidden items from yards away.

entry: POKENAME羽毛湿了就会剧烈抖动，把水甩干。动静却会引来捕食者，迫使它们四散潜水，结果又弄湿了。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME gets its feathers wet, they shake violently to dry off. This draws predators' attention, causing them to scatter and dive, getting wet once again.

entry: POKENAME讨厌争斗，平时躲在高大的草本植物或沙中。受惊时，可能会用坚硬如木的尖喙攻击。
author: st4rdustyugure
source: POKENAME hates fighting and usually hides in tall herbs or sand. If it's startled, it may attack with its sharp beak, as hard as wood.

entry: POKENAME连树干最细的裂缝中最小的虫宝可梦都能看见。它把身体往树上蹭，撒出粉末，让虫宝可梦麻痹或中毒地爬出来。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME's eyes can spot even the smallest bug Pokémon in the smallest crack of a tree trunk. It rubs its body against trees to release powder that causes bug Pokémon to crawl out paralyzed or poisoned.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在墓地，轻易就能吃到哀悼的家属留下的供品。若它拒吃这些供品，就被视为不祥之兆。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lurk in graveyards where they have easy access to food offerings from grieving families. It is considered a bad omen if POKENAME refuse to eat food offerings that are left behind.

entry: 生活环境中的光污染无处不在，让POKENAME群常常迷路。科学家设计了新路灯，尽量减少向上照射的光，帮助它们辨明方向。
author: quackquackattack
source: Flocks of POKENAME often get lost because of how pervasive light pollution is in their environment. Scientists have engineered new lamp posts that minimize how much light faces upward, helping POKENAME avoid getting lost.

entry: POKENAME栖在睡莲叶上，等丑丑鱼等猎物现身，再精准啄击。雨天会展开双翼收集雨滴，在湿热空气中给自己降温。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME perches on lily pads, waiting for prey like Feebas to emerge before striking with precise pecks. On rainy days, it spreads its wings wide to collect raindrops, cooling itself in the humid air.

entry: 夜行的POKENAME会在水边捣乱，偷走渔民钓到的角金鱼。羽毛覆着一层黏滑的防水薄膜。
author: haypile
source: The nocturnal POKENAME causes mischief along the water's edge by stealing Goldeen from fishers. Its feathers are coated in a slimy, waterproof film.

entry: POKENAME平时温顺，一听到巨响却会浑身羽毛炸起，陷入亢奋的狂乱。
author: haypile
source: Though usually docile, POKENAME fluffs up all its feathers as soon as it hears loud noises, entering an excited frenzy.

entry: 野生POKENAME能飞出大气层。它借此俯冲突袭最爱的树果树，吓跑捕食者。
author: seanothan_23
source: Wild POKENAME possess the ability to fly beyond the atmosphere. They use this to dive bomb their favorite berry trees and scare away predators.

entry: 天色平静时，会栖在高处眺望远方。据说捡到POKENAME的蓝羽毛十分幸运。
author: ozydamians
source: When the skies are calm, it roosts up high to scan the horizon. To find a blue POKENAME feather is considered very lucky.

entry: POKENAME在地面筑巢，捡来落下的细枝，混合泥土，在幼崽周围筑起保护圈。幼崽一到能活动的年纪，就会从出生巢穴的中央向下挖洞。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME nest on the ground, gathering up fallen twigs and mixing them with mud to form a protective ring around their young. Young POKENAME burrow down through the middle of their childhood nest as soon as they're old enough to move.

entry: POKENAME在空中如鱼入水般游动，而非飞行。它极其害羞，至今没有野生个体停下休息时的目击记录。
author: linhasxoc
source: POKENAME swims through the air as if it were water, instead of flying. It is extremely shy, and there have been no recorded sightings of a wild POKENAME at rest.

entry: POKENAME飞行时总带着一团泥土，怎么也很难弄掉。连水也冲不掉这团土，几乎不可能看见它的腹部。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME fly, they carry a clump of dirt with them that is incredibly difficult to remove. This piece of dirt resists being washed off by water, which makes seeing their undersides nearly impossible.

entry: POKENAME爱吃作物的根，是农人常见的麻烦。需要逃跑时，会带着一团泥土飞走，用来保护腹部。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are a common nuisance for farmers because POKENAME love to eat the roots of crops. Whenever they need to make an escape, they carry a clump of dirt that protects their underside while they fly away.

entry: POKENAME栖息在崖壁附近的土中。清晨尖利的啁啾声常把附近居民逼得搬走，因而臭名远扬。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME inhabits soil near cliff faces. Its piercing morning chirps are infamous for driving nearby residents away.

entry: POKENAME以树枝搭巢，枝条间塞满偷来的钱财和物件。若发现另一只POKENAME的巢更闪亮，就会试图争夺过来。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME makes its nest with stolen money or belongings between the sticks and twigs of its base. If it finds a shinier nest from another POKENAME, it will attempt to fight for ownership of it.

entry: POKENAME用兽爪和鸟爪配合抓住大型猎物。到了求偶季节，会花数小时梳理羽毛，甚至到城市附近偷亮闪闪的东西吸引伴侣。
author: corndogyip
source: POKENAME use their paws in tandem with their talons to grasp large prey. During mating season, they spend hours preening and may even steal shiny objects near cities to attract potential mates.

entry: POKENAME是耐心的猎手，能埋伏一整天，等准时机才扑向猎物。羽毛光滑如丝，也用来搭建奢华舒适的巢。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a patient hunter that can lie in wait for an entire day, biding its time before pouncing on its prey. Its feathers are smooth as silk, and it uses them to build luxurious and comfortable nests.

entry: 虽然不善飞行，POKENAME仍会试着在树间滑翔捕食。哪怕落下时撞了好几次头，也会重新爬上去再试。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: Even though their bodies are not able to fly well, POKENAME still tries to glide across trees for its prey. Even after hitting its head several times on the way down, POKENAME will still climb back up and try again.

entry: 野生POKENAME常给波波群当导师，负责训练和管教小鸟。它天性耐心，但学员太过放肆时，也会毫不犹豫地一脚踢飞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME in the wild often act as mentors to Pidgey flocks, training and keeping the small birds in line. Though very patient by nature, they won't hesitate to punt one of their trainees if they get too uppity.

entry: 风把羽毛吹得太乱，POKENAME就会大为烦躁。它从树梢俯冲袭击入侵者，反复用利爪抓击，直到觉得挽回了尊严才停下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME becomes highly agitated if the wind ruffles its feathers too much. It dive-bombs intruders from treetops, striking repeatedly with its talons until it feels its pride is restored.

entry: POKENAME极为忠诚，会高声鸣叫，提醒训练家有危险。受威胁时，会从喙中喷出阵阵热气，燎伤企图袭击它的敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is fiercely loyal and will chirp loudly to warn its Trainer of danger. If threatened, it exhales bursts of warm air from its beak, singeing any would-be attackers.

entry: POKENAME虽然庞大，却只吃坚果与树果。喜欢烤过再吃，可常忘记火有多强，最后只剩一堆灰，气得大发脾气。
author: ozydamians
source: Despite its large size, POKENAME only eats nuts and berries. It prefers to toast its meal, but often forgets the intensity of its flames. It throws a tantrum when it's left with nothing but a pile of ash afterwards.

entry: POKENAME兼有陆海两栖的生活方式，形成了与多数宝可梦不同的捕食方法。一只负责吓唬虫宝可梦，使其跌进附近水中，供同群的其他成员食用。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME's existence on land and sea led to its unique method of catching prey that is unlike most Pokémon's. One POKENAME scares bug Pokémon into falling into nearby bodies of water for other POKENAME in its pod to consume.

entry: POKENAME靠瞬间移动来到空中，而非振翅起飞。每天虽睡15小时，醒着时却颇有效率。
author: frokachu
source: Instead of taking flight, POKENAME teleports into the air instead. Though it sleeps for 15 hours a day, it is fairly productive while awake.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛因精神力量而泛着微光，能感知风的变化。它无需休息就能瞬间移动极远的距离。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feathers shimmer faintly with psychic energy, allowing it to sense changes in the wind. It can teleport vast distances without ever needing to rest.

entry: POKENAME用藤蔓般的爪子抓住猎物，再以尖喙啄击。一旦抓住，就会紧紧缠住对方，不让其逃脱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME grabs at prey using its vine-like talons before striking with its sharp beak. Once caught, it constricts its victim tightly to prevent escape.

entry: POKENAME的叫声极其响亮，据说5英里外都能听见它们不停聒噪。它们吃坚果和种子，嘴里常一次叼着数百颗。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's cry is incredibly loud as people have reportedly heard their constant squawking from over 5 miles away. They feed on nuts and seeds, often carrying hundreds of them in their mouths at a time.

entry: POKENAME浮在水面下静静等待。小型虫宝可梦从上空飞过时，就用触手抓住，拖进水里。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats just beneath the water's surface, waiting patiently. When small insect Pokémon fly overhead, it snatches them with its tentacles and drags them under.

entry: POKENAME并不总是结伴行动，有些甚至会尝试独居。生气时，会把一把把泥土和石块掷向惹恼自己的对象。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME do not always travel together, and, indeed, may try to live independently. When upset, POKENAME launch fistfuls of dirt and rock at offenders.

entry: POKENAME融合而成的身体很适合骑乘。它对孩子尤其温柔，会降低火焰的温度，确保背上的乘客舒适。
author: quackquackattack
source: The chimeric body of POKENAME makes them well suited for riding. They are particularly gentle with children, and reduce the heat of their flames to make sure their riders are comfortable.

entry: POKENAME喜欢带人领略头顶天空的奇妙。孩子想骑就乐意载上一程，背上有孩子时总是格外温柔。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to help people realize the wonder of the sky above them. They are happy to give rides to children who want one and are always gentle when they have a child on their back.

entry: POKENAME能感知一片区域中的许多虫宝可梦，狩猎方法却很奇特。它会在附近张大嘴坐上最多8小时，盼猎物恰好爬进来。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME is able to sense many bug Pokémon in a single area, but its hunting ability is very unorthodox. It sits near the general area with its mouth wide open for up to 8 hours, hoping its prey will happen to crawl inside.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴把沙子扫进大型捕食者的眼里，争取时间缩进壳中。甲壳能抵挡对方尖爪的攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sweep sand into the eyes of large predators with their tail. This gives them enough time to tuck themselves into their shell, which can endure claws and talons from their predators.

entry: POKENAME在大葱田附近筑巢，用尖喙拔出作物大快朵颐。谁想收获它最爱的食物，它就会凶猛地捍卫领地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME nests near leek fields, using its sharp beak to uproot and feast on crops. It fiercely defends its territory from those who try to harvest its favorite food.

entry: POKENAME的两个头常为往哪个方向走意见不合。尽管收到相互冲突的指令，带爪的双脚似乎从不把自己绊倒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have two heads that often disagree with each other on which direction to travel. Their taloned feet never seem to trip on themselves despite the conflicting signals from the two heads.

entry: POKENAME年幼时常被留下独自生活，必须尽快学会高效狩猎才能生存。它从高崖坠入海中，借下落的速度用角刺穿鲤鱼王和铁炮鱼。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Often left on their own at a young age, POKENAME must quickly learn to hunt efficiently to survive. They fall from tall cliffs into the ocean, using their boosted speed to skewer Magikarp and Remoraid with their horns.

entry: POKENAME在冰川上群居。巨翼能使出强劲的吹飞，推动自己和同伴在冰面高速滑行。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME live communally atop icy glaciers. Their large wings create powerful Whirlwinds, which they use to propel themselves and each other to slide across the ice at high speeds.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着厚厚的泥状物，毒性很强。它经常飞进烟囱吸收污染物，受污染越重，力量反而越强。
author: .izik
source: The thick mud-like substance that covers POKENAME's body is highly toxic. It frequently flies into smokestacks to absorb pollutants, growing stronger from the contamination.

entry: POKENAME虽行动缓慢，却是出色的猎手。它贴在树上，融入树皮的颜色，袭击毫无戒心地停在它身上休息的猎物。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: Despite its slow movement, POKENAME is an exceptional hunter. It lays up against trees, blending into the bark, and strikes unsuspecting prey that stops to rest on it.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀太小，飞不起来，只能靠巨炮猎食。幸好它的身体也大到让捕食者难以制服，动手还会冒被水淋透的风险。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their massive cannons to hunt for food because their wings are too small to fly with. Fortunately, they are also too big for predators to take down without the risk of getting soaked in water.

entry: 坚固的喙能啄开所吃果实硬如岩石的外壳。POKENAME只有万不得已，才会动用甲壳上伸出的双炮，向威胁喷射强劲水柱。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its sturdy beak allows it to break open the rock-hard shells of the fruits it eats. POKENAME uses the pair of cannons emerging from its shell only as a last resort, firing powerful jets of water at any threat.

entry: POKENAME释放毒气，驱赶闯入家园的生物，吸入者会咳个不停。旅人会先献上一根精神之羽安抚它，再继续赶路。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME releases noxious fumes to scare away intruders to its home, which causes a coughing fit when inhaled. A traveler will make an offering of a Clever Feather to placate it before continuing on.

entry: POKENAME喙上的微小鼻孔可能放出奇怪气体，有些有毒，有些无害。据说，有些甚至是吃剩的梦。
author: bobosmith01
source: Odd gases may be emitted from the microscopic nostrils located on POKENAME's beak. Some gases are poisonous, while some are harmless. Some are even rumored to be the remnants of devoured dreams.

entry: 养鸟人受过训练，能辨认POKENAME何时在偷走巢里的雏鸟宝可梦。这种恶意的宝可梦，是傲骨燕、烈雀等鸟宝可梦生存的一大威胁。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: Bird Keepers are trained to recognize when a POKENAME is stealing baby bird Pokémon from a nest. These malicious Pokémon are one of the top threats to the survival of Taillow, Spearow, and other such bird Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME从岸边搜集贝壳和浮木筑巢。涨潮时，它会扇动双钳，勉强飞起，迅速抵达高处。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME collect shells and driftwood from the shore, using them to build their nests. During high tide, they flap their claws to achieve rudimentary flight, allowing them to quickly reach higher ground.

entry: POKENAME能咬碎骨头，一旦咬住便难以挣脱，死死钳住对手。它挥舞长矛般的骨头，凭不屈的意志战斗，纵使面对死亡也不肯退让。
author: jonclyd
source: POKENAME's bone-crushing bite is difficult to break once it sinks in, locking foes in a relentless grip. Wielding a spear-like bone and unyielding spirit, it battles on, refusing to yield even against death itself.

entry: POKENAME用硬如岩石的角凿开石壁，在大河附近筑巢。它不停啃咬河石磨练牙齿，用于狩猎和战斗。身体虽庞大，泳技却很高超。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME makes its den near large rivers, carving into stone with its rock-hard horn. It constantly gnaws on river stones to strengthen its teeth, which it uses for both hunting and battle. Despite its bulk, it swims skillfully.

entry: POKENAME任水流带着身体漂行，伺机捕猎。骇人的外貌与巨大尖牙能将猎物吓呆。
author: notsaying.
source: Letting the currents take its body along, POKENAME is an opportunistic hunter. It stuns prey with its shocking look and large fangs.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在湖面，等鸟宝可梦俯冲下来。咬合力强到连一些体型最大的鸟宝可梦也能拿下。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME lurk upon the surface of lakes, awaiting a bird Pokémon to attempt to swoop them. Their bites are strong enough to take down some of the largest bird Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME凶猛无休，挡路的东西一概摧毁。有理论认为，整个生态都曾因它的存在而改变。
author: rotcivosk
source: Known for its relentless and aggressive nature, POKENAME will destroy anything that stands in its path. It is theorized that entire ecosystems have been altered due to its presence.

entry: POKENAME自己从不渡人，却会照看拉普拉斯，确保它们安全载送乘客。任何胆敢威胁它所照看对象的生物，都会被无情地撕碎。
author: sk372
source: Though it never ferries humans itself, POKENAME ensures that Lapras it oversees carry others safely. Anything that dares threaten them under POKENAME's watch will be mercilessly rent apart.

entry: POKENAME能背着人和宝可梦过河。不过，若途中饿了，可能会回头试图吃掉乘客。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can ferry people and Pokémon across rivers on its back. However, if it gets hungry during the journey, it may turn its head around and try to eat its passengers.

entry: 因遭过度捕猎，POKENAME对人类充满戒心。它会张大嘴发出诡异的叫声，威吓训练家。据说，唯有心地纯洁的训练家才能收服。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Due to overhunting, POKENAME have become wary of humans. It intimidates trainers by opening its mouth and letting out an eerie cry. It is said only a trainer with a pure heart may catch a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的身体融入周围的水中，是致命的水下潜猎者，会用力道惊人的双颚跟踪或伏击猎物。接着便猛烈甩头，毫不留情地撕碎猎物。
author: badwolf6066
source: POKENAME's body melds into the water around it, making it a deadly aquatic stealth predator that stalks or ambushes its prey with its monstrously strong jaws. It will then ruthlessly shake its head, tearing its prey apart.

entry: POKENAME卧在水下岩缝中，等待伏击。鱼宝可梦游过时，就用强壮双颚钳住，再以长长的身体缠住，不让其动弹。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME lie in rocky crevices underwater, waiting to ambush prey. When a fish Pokémon swims by, they clamp down on it with their strong jaws and wrap their long body around the target to prevent it from moving.

entry: POKENAME以惊人的速度潜入海中，张嘴将成群的水生宝可梦一并兜住。直到灌进肚里的海水多得仿佛要撑破肚皮，才停止大吃。
author: spkypirate
source: POKENAME dives into the sea at incredible speed, scooping up schools of aquatic Pokémon into its open jaws. It stops its feast when its belly is so full of seawater it feels it might burst.

entry: 这种栖息沼泽的融合宝可梦，会偷走任何靠近者的电子设备，用来玩电子游戏、看直播。
author: hophoppip
source: This swamp-dwelling fusion steals electronic devices from any humans who approach its swamp, using them to play video games and watch livestreams.

entry: POKENAME用瞬间移动往来于各个潟湖，守护生活在那里的宝可梦。旅途中多数时间都隐着身，只会隔一阵子短暂现身。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME travels between lagoons via teleportation and watches over the Pokémon living there. Its appearances are only brief and periodic, as it remains invisible for most of its journey.

entry: 奇怪的是，同种融合让POKENAME失去了前肢和背脊上的棱突。不过，咬合力与凶猛程度大幅增强，小看它十分危险。
author: sk372
source: Strangely, self-fusion has caused POKENAME to lose its upper limbs and ridges. Its jaw strength and ferocity has been greatly amplified however, making it quite a danger to underestimate.

entry: 宝可梦融合让POKENAME的外貌威吓力十足。它在沼泽中无情地追踪猎物，还会找未融合的大力鳄打架。
author: lupa
source: Pokémon fusion has given POKENAME a truly intimidating visage. It mercilessly stalks prey in the swamps and picks fights with unfused Feraligatr.

entry: 白天能在海蚀洞顶看到成群倒挂的POKENAME。夜里，它们出海狩猎，高速俯冲入水，用大嘴兜起鱼宝可梦。
author: acid_pen
source: You can find groups of POKENAME hanging from the ceiling of sea caves during the day. At night, they hunt out at sea, diving at high speeds into the water and scooping up fish Pokémon with their large jaws.

entry: POKENAME是游荡于深海的顶级捕食者。触角发出诡异红光，引来猎物后便用强壮双颚一口叼住。
author: acid_pen
source: POKENAME is an apex predator that roams at deep-sea levels. Its antennae cast an eerie red glow, which it uses to lure in prey before snatching them up with its powerful jaw.

entry: POKENAME专吃果皮或外壳最坚韧的树果和坚果。喙中布满坚硬尖牙，能轻松咬碎这些硬壳，享用内部鲜美多汁的果肉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME feasts on berries and nuts with the toughest of skins or shells. Its beak is full of solid, sharp teeth that easily crunch down on these tough exteriors and let it enjoy the succulence within.

entry: POKENAME让明亮的尾巴闪光，晃得敌人看不见，再趁机用强壮双颚迅速将其咬碎。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME blinds enemies by flashing its bright tail. This creates an opening for it to swiftly crush them with its powerful jaws.

entry: POKENAME主要吃灌木、昆虫和泥中的小生物，锋利如刀的牙齿令研究者费解。有人认为用于威吓对手或吸引伴侣，也有人认为是远古祖先遗留的特征。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Researchers are puzzled by POKENAME's razor-sharp teeth, as it mostly snacks on shrubs, insects, and mud-dwelling critters. Some believe the teeth intimidate rivals or attract mates, while others think they're a leftover trait from ancient ancestors.

entry: POKENAME主要吃灌木、昆虫和泥中的小生物，锋利如刀的牙齿令研究者费解。有人认为用于威吓对手或吸引伴侣，也有人认为是用来标记领地。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Researchers are puzzled by POKENAME's razor-sharp teeth, as it mostly snacks on shrubs, insects, and mud-dwelling critters. Some believe the teeth intimidate rivals or attract mates, while others think they're used to mark territory.

entry: POKENAME双腿结实有力，能快速奔跑，不会被花苞的重量带得摔倒。在水中会伪装成漂浮的花苞，引诱毫无戒心的猎物。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's powerful, sturdy legs enable it to run quickly without risk of toppling over from the weight of its bud. In bodies of water, it disguises itself as a floating flower bud to lure in unsuspecting prey.

entry: 只要能塞进嘴里，POKENAME的双颚便能咬碎任何岩石。它会在瀑布后开凿宽敞隐蔽的巢穴。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's jaws can shatter any rocks that can fit in them. It digs behind waterfalls to create spacious, hidden dens.

entry: POKENAME擅长伏击，在河岸的芦苇与香蒲间潜行，等猎物靠近。目标一进入范围，便狂拍翅膀、猛甩尾巴地跃出。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are adept ambush predators, stalking through reeds and bullrushes along river banks whilst they wait for prey to get close. When their target is close enough they leap out in a frenzy of flapping wings and thrashing tail.

entry: POKENAME的大牙每天都需打磨清洁一次。在野外自然就能完成，但由训练家照顾时，反倒特别容易蛀牙。
author: beetlething
source: POKENAME's large teeth need to be sharpened and cleaned once a day. In the wild, this process happens naturally, but under the care of a Trainer, it is especially susceptible to tooth decay.

entry: POKENAME咬合力强，双颚还有锁扣般的构造。一旦咬住，除非它愿意，否则几乎不可能让它松口。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME possess a powerful bite. Their jaws contain a latching mechanism; therefore, it is nearly impossible to make them let go of whatever they have bitten against their will.

entry: POKENAME精力旺盛得难以自制，四处乱跑，见什么都咬。它用强壮双颚咬住猎物的瞬间，会发出雷鸣般的巨响。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME cannot contain its energy and will run around and bite everything it sees. Loud thundering noises can be heard the moment it bites down on prey with its powerful jaws.

entry: POKENAME能在空中和水里轻松飘游。它低声吟诵咒语时，敌人会觉得自己被满是尖牙的无形巨颚咬住了。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME floats effortlessly through both air and water. When it whispers incantations in a low voice, foes will feel as if they have been seized in unseen jaws filled with sharp fangs.

entry: POKENAME天生吃素，多年来令科学家百思不解。它用修长利爪拉下树枝，享用鲜叶。尾巴既能保持平衡，战斗时也能拍开敌人。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's naturally herbivorous diet has baffled scientists for years. They use their long, sharp claws to pull down tree branches to feast on the fresh leaves. Their tail provides balance while also being useful in batting away foes in battle.

entry: POKENAME大多时候一动不动地藏在泥地里。猎物一脚踏入，它便猛扑过去，用强壮双颚钳住。
author: shocktopus1717
source: POKENAME spends most of its time laying perfectly still, concealed in patches of mud. When prey steps foot in the mud, It lunges, clamping down with its powerful jaws.

entry: POKENAME在湖底休息，精神感知与湖中所有生灵相连。一旦察觉它们遭遇外来危险，就会猛冲出水面，凶猛地保护它们。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rests at the bottom of lakes, its psychic senses attuning it to all the creatures within. If it senses them in any danger from outside sources, it rockets out of the water to violently defend its charges.

entry: 住在POKENAME家园湖泊周围的宝可梦，很快便会学会敬畏它的体力和精神力量。它手持的尖刺棒，象征着实力与在群体中的地位。
author: sk372
source: Pokémon that live around the lake area POKENAME calls home quickly learn to fear and respect its physical and psychic power. The spiky club it carries is a symbol of its strength and position in this hierarchy.

entry: POKENAME从河床底的楔石中猛扑而出，用强壮双颚叼住靠得太近的陆生动物。甚至有过向上跃起，捕捉空中飞行宝可梦的记录。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lunges from its keystone at the bottom of riverbeds using its powerful jaws to snatch up land creatures that get too close. It's even been known to launch itself upward to nab flying Pokémon out of the air.

entry: POKENAME能以音速飞行、掘地和游泳，经过时用强壮双颚叼住毫无戒心的猎物。被迫在地面或地下战斗时，会用腿爆发加速，以双臂掀起风刃。
author: badwolf6066
source: POKENAME can fly, burrow, and swim at sonic speed, using its strong jaws to snatch unsuspecting prey as it passes by. If forced to battle on or underground, it uses its legs to create bursts of speed and generates blades of wind with its arms.

entry: POKENAME栖息于河流和沼泽，花朵散发甜香，使过路者心情平静。有些地区形成了传统：献上食物，换取收集它的花粉制作香水的许可。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Dwelling within rivers and swamps, POKENAME release a sweet scent from their flowers that soothes anyone that passes by. In some regions, it has become tradition to offer POKENAME food in exchange for collecting its pollen for use in perfume.

entry: POKENAME隐身水下，恰好避开视线，一动不动地等合适的猎物靠近。随后以骇人的速度跃出水面，猛力头撞，把即将入口的猎物撞昏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides itself just out of sight underwater, remaining motionless until suitable prey draws near. It then leaps from the water at frightening speed to deliver a crushing headbutt to knock out its future meal.

entry: POKENAME双腿短粗，难以追赶对手。它索性埋伏等猎物靠近，先以硕大的额头撞击，再用能碎骨的双颚咬住。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a difficult time chasing after foes because of its short, bulky legs. Instead, POKENAME lies in wait until its prey approaches; its massive forehead slams into the prey before clamping down with its bone-crushing jaws.

entry: POKENAME外层的双颚由坚实钢铁构成。正面遭袭时便猛然合拢，形成几乎无法突破的防御。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME's outer jaws are made of solid steel.  If it is attacked from the front, it will snap them shut to create a nearly impenetrable defense.

entry: POKENAME通常在湿地里无声游动，偶尔也出现在下水道。背上的地貌能承载幼崽，带它们穿过险急的水流。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are usually seen silently swimming in marshes, though they can sometimes be found in sewers. The landscapes on their backs are used for carrying young along tough streams.

entry: POKENAME强壮的双颚能一口抓住并吃掉小型鱼宝可梦。它为自己的收获自豪，不肯分给群体中的其他成员。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's powerful jaws allow it to catch and eat small fish Pokémon in a single bite. It prides itself in its catches and will refuse to share with the rest of its flock.

entry: POKENAME用长长的下颚和钢铁般坚硬的牙齿锯开岩石与金属，只为吃下切掉的碎块。身体强壮，能承受自卸卡车的冲击，甚至将其举过头顶。
author: infinex21
source: It uses its elongated jaw, and steel-hard teeth, to saw through rock and metal alike, all so it can feed on the pieces it cuts away. POKENAME's body is strong enough to endure the force of a dump truck and even be able to lift it above itself.

entry: POKENAME不喜欢四足行走，多数时候展开翅膀在高空飞翔，或收拢双翼潜入水下。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME dislikes walking on all fours. It spends most of its time flying high with its wings outstretched, or with them tucked in to dive underwater.

entry: POKENAME是沼泽中可怕的捕食者。它静伏水中，等沼王之类的宝可梦靠近，再用触须缠紧，猛力咬下。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is a fearsome predator in swamp environments. It lies still in the water, waiting for Pokémon like Quagsire to draw near before constricting them with its feelers and biting down with immense force.

entry: 它们与古代宝可梦的描绘极其相似，因此多数人认定其寿命很长。它们常游过小型宝可梦的群落，用大嘴一口兜住许多。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon resemble depictions of an ancient Pokémon so closely that most have concluded they live very long lives. They often swim through schools of smaller Pokémon and capture many within their large maws.

entry: POKENAME很保护小锯鳄。若发现有人偷猎小锯鳄的蛋，就会站稳脚跟大吼，同时让尾巴爆发火焰。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are protective of Totodile. If they find people hunting Totodile eggs, they plant their feet and roar while causing their tail to erupt in flames.

entry: POKENAME极其好斗，领地意识很强。若被发现擅闯领地，你只能逃跑或迎战：除非你或它倒下，否则绝不罢休。
author: jao_play
source: The POKENAME is extremely aggressive and territorial. If it sees you trespassing in its territory, your only options are to run or fight, as it will not give up the chase until either you or it is defeated.

entry: POKENAME以实力与战绩为傲。它不只为果腹狩猎，也以此为乐，有时还会放走猎物继续追逐，最后才下手。压力之下，背上的甲片会分泌毒液。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME pride themselves on their strength and success. They don't only hunt for food, but also for sport; sometimes letting go of their prey to continue the hunt before finishing them off. POKENAME's dorsal plates excrete venom under stress.

entry: POKENAME眼部的薄膜让它即使身处极泥泞、烟雾弥漫或满是沙尘的环境，也能看得清清楚楚。巨颚咬住猎物后，直到对方不再动弹才会松开。
author: bobosmith01
source: Thanks to film around POKENAME's eyes, it can see perfectly even in the swampiest, smoggiest, or sandiest environments. Its massive jaws latch onto prey and never let go until the prey stops moving.

entry: POKENAME是凶猛的猎手，会从深水跃出，用双颚侧面的锋利棱脊劈砍猎物。同类为争领地与支配权而战，直到一方斩断另一方的棱脊。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a ferocious hunter that leaps from watery depths to hack at prey with the sharp ridges on the sides of its jaws. Rivals compete for territory and dominance, battling until one has severed the ridges of the other.

entry: POKENAME凶狠地咬住猎物，像撕布般轻易将其撕碎。不过，它懂得控制力量，也很护人，是活泼顽皮的孩子的好玩伴。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: POKENAME will savagely bite into their prey, shredding them as easily as fabric. Despite this, they know their own strength and are very protective, making them great playtime companions for rowdier kids.

entry: POKENAME是极凶残的两栖猎手，会赶走原先最强的栖息者，将大湖据为己有。为保障公众安全，被它占据的湖泊很快便会禁止人类进入。
author: sk372
source: An absolutely vicious amphibious hunter, POKENAME claims large lakes as its own, driving out the strongest prior inhabitants. Lakes claimed by it quickly become off-limits to humans as a matter of public safety.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上侧有坚硬的鳍，帮助游泳时保持稳定。它游泳并不特别有力，更喜欢伏击其他宝可梦，猛扑过去施以火焰咬击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The top surface of the tails of POKENAME have a rigid fin that helps them keep themselves stable while swimming. They are not especially powerful swimmers and instead prefer to ambush other Pokémon, lunging with fiery bites.

entry: POKENAME的手臂与尾巴格外发达，游泳力量强劲。相比之下，腿太小，在陆地上步履笨拙，通常宁愿用手来“走路”。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are powerful swimmers, their over-developed arms and tail letting them power themselves through the water. They are ungainly on land due to their comparatively tiny legs, typically preferring to 'walk' with their hands instead.

entry: POKENAME逆流而上几乎毫不费力，连急流也不例外。它用强壮双颚咬碎矿物与矿石，或威吓企图为敌的生物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can swim upstream, even against rapids, with little-to-no difficulty. They use their strong jaws to crush up chunks of minerals and ores, or to intimidate would-be foes.

entry: POKENAME沿河生活，尤其爱待在激流附近。它能轻松逆流游动，却也会借猛烈水流磨练坚硬的身体。背鳍尤其锋利。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live along rivers, especially near those with furious rapids. They can swim against the current with ease, yet use these fierce currents to help keep their hard bodies honed. Their dorsal fins are especially sharp.

entry: POKENAME虽个头小，却会勇敢迎战任何对手，全力攻击。吃东西也一样凶猛，一颗接一颗地吞吃树果，汁液飞得到处都是。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although small in size, POKENAME will bravely fight against any foe and attack with all it has. Its savagery extends to eating: juices fly everywhere as it devours Berry after Berry.

entry: POKENAME虽个头小，却会勇敢迎战任何对手，全力攻击。吃东西也一样凶猛，一颗接一颗地吞吃树果，汁液飞得到处都是。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although small in size, POKENAME will bravely fight against any foe and attack with all it has. Its savagery extends to eating: juices fly everywhere as it devours Berry after Berry.

entry: POKENAME通常带领一群蓝鱼，或独自狩猎；独居者是被群体排斥的个体。无论哪种，双颚的力量都令人畏惧，尖牙足以撕裂船只。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are usually either seen leading a pack of Crocovanha or as solitary hunters, the latter occurring if they were rejected by their pack. Either way, POKENAME have intimidatingly powerful jaws and fangs capable of ripping apart ships.

entry: POKENAME由大力鱼进化而来，后者遭自己曾带领的蓝鱼凶狠驱逐。它们独居独猎，常为领地争斗，最终磨练成遍布伤痕的可怕海中猎手。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME evolve from Feravanha that were brutally driven away by Crocovanha that they once led. They live and hunt alone, often getting into battles over territory that refine them into terrifying hunters of the sea that are clad in various scars.

entry: POKENAME在高海拔清澈的泉水附近筑巢，保护泉水，不许任何人污染。下雨时，它会在空中疾飞，用歌声表达好心情。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME nests near high-altitude, crystal-clear springs, protecting them from anyone who dares to pollute them. When it rains, this Pokémon darts through the sky, singing to show its good mood.

entry: POKENAME生活在冰川边缘，往来于陆海之间狩猎。背上的帆由薄膜构成，闪烁的光泽会迷惑潜在猎物，让它得以靠近袭击。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME lives near the edges of glaciers and travels between land and sea to hunt. The sail on its back is made of a membrane that shimmers and causes confusion in potential prey, allowing it to close in and attack.

entry: POKENAME常在寒冷沼泽里涉水，采用独特的狩猎方式。它站着纹丝不动，把水冻住，再用爪子刨出冻在里面的鱼。
author: qinshanu
source: POKENAME is commonly found wading in cold bogs, where it employs a rather unique hunting method. Standing completely still, it freezes the water and then uses its claws to dig the frozen fish out.

entry: POKENAME头上与背上的鳞状冠脊，和爪牙一样锋利。战斗时，它会用离敌人最近的身体部位迅疾猛攻，毫不间断。
author: .jerden
source: The scaly crests on POKENAME's head and back are just as sharp as its claws and fangs. In combat, POKENAME strikes quickly and relentlessly, using whatever part of its body is closest to its foe.

entry: POKENAME用缓慢而诱人的龙之舞迷惑对手，使其觉得自己强大无比。等对方过度自信，便迅速助跑，用脚上的利爪将其撕裂。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME enchants foes with its slow, alluring Dragon Dance to make them feel overly strong and powerful. After giving them overconfidence, it quickly takes running steps to tear the opponent up with the sharp claws on its feet.

entry: POKENAME是凶残的捕食者，用强壮双颚撕碎猎物。牙齿坚硬，能轻易刺穿刺甲贝厚厚的贝壳，将其咬开。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are savage predators, tearing apart their prey with their powerful jaws. Their teeth are strong enough to pierce through the thick shells of Cloyster, breaking them open with ease.

entry: POKENAME的大蘑菇下藏着数排刀锋般的利齿。暴怒时，几秒内就能撕开金属。
author: .izik
source: Under POKENAME's large mushroom are multiple rows of razor-sharp teeth. When enraged, it can tear apart metal within seconds.

entry: POKENAME有坚硬的外甲，形似大力鳄的超级进化形态。普通攻击打上去就会弹开，使敌人露出破绽，遭到四条巨臂极其猛烈的反击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses a tough exterior carapace resembling Feraligatr's Mega form. Normal blows glance off this casing and leave its foes open to a terribly strong counterattack from its four massive arms.

entry: POKENAME皮肤极其坚韧，体格无比结实，是庞大而势不可挡的宝可梦。即使遭到体型与重量数倍于己的宝可梦全力冲撞，也纹丝不动。
author: sk372
source: Possessing one of the toughest hides and sturdiest builds around, POKENAME is a massive juggernaut of a Pokémon. It can take a full-bodied charge from Pokémon several times its size and weight and not even flinch.

entry: POKENAME用手杖操纵水流，编排出令人屏息的水舞，让观众看得入迷。它泳技出众，强劲的尾巴连最猛烈的水流也能抗衡。
author: fiordaliso
source: With its staff, POKENAME can manipulate water, allowing it to create breathtaking choreographies that mesmerize anyone watching. POKENAME is an excellent swimmer; its tail is so powerful that it can counter even the strongest currents.

entry: POKENAME动作迅捷，牙齿锋利，是理想的伏击猎手。若没能立刻抓住猎物，就会试图用舌头将其缠住。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its quick movements and razor-sharp teeth make POKENAME an ideal ambush predator. If it fails to snare its prey immediately, it attempts to snare them with its tongue.

entry: POKENAME在河底掘进时会形成漩涡。猎物被困住后，再补上强力咬击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME forms whirlpools while burrowing beneath rivers. Once prey is trapped, it follows with a powerful bite.

entry: POKENAME十分凶猛，一口就能留下痛苦的伤疤。它必须常修磨牙齿，避免颚内压力积累，导致头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are ferocious creatures that can leave painful scars with a single bite. They need to trim their teeth often to prevent pressure from building within their jaws, which can lead to a headache.

entry: POKENAME用强壮的手臂抓住毫无戒心的泳客，将其拖向深水。遇袭者被建议戳击它敏感的眼和鼻，迫使它松手。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME grapple unsuspecting swimmers with their powerful arms, pulling them deep underwater. Those under attack by them are advised to aim jabs at their sensitive eyes and nose to force them to release their grip.

entry: 海盗时代，人们常派POKENAME攻击其他船只，海中、甲板上都能作战。到了现代，它们在海上游荡，寻找自己的目标。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME were often used in the time of pirates to attack other ships both on deck and at sea. With the modern age, they now wander the seas, seeking purpose.

entry: POKENAME趴平身体晒太阳，积蓄火焰鬃毛的力量。一看见动静，便朝猎物疾冲，双颚疯狂咬合。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME lies flat, basking in the sun to build up its flaming mane. As soon as it spots movement, it darts towards its prey, jaws snapping wildly.

entry: POKENAME的身体酸性极强，却能避免被酸液溶蚀而缩小。狩猎时，它只需把找到的东西吸进体内；没法这样吃掉的，就改用嘴咬。
author: bobosmith01
source: While POKENAME's body is extremely acidic, it is able to prevent the acid from dissolving, reducing its total volume. To hunt, POKENAME merely absorbs whatever it has found into its body. Whatever it cannot consume in that manner, it bites instead.

entry: POKENAME能转动火箭炮，以惊人推力向前冲。巨颚既能重创敌人，也能让它享用即食肉排。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME can turn its rocket cannons to launch itself forward with incredible force. It uses its massive jaws to devastate foes and enjoy Precooked Burgers.

entry: 它很容易发怒，巨大的体型又令许多宝可梦畏惧，因此当地野生生物通常不来打扰。据说，有些热带河流，是POKENAME在同一片地方反复蜿蜒爬行形成的。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is easily angered and many Pokémon are intimidated by its large size, so it often goes unbothered by local wildlife. It is thought some rivers in tropical areas were formed by POKENAME snaking in the same areas over and over.

entry: POKENAME的精神力量自然积蓄在牙齿中。牙齿脱落时，会将其制成钟摆，免得白白丢掉其中的力量。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME's psychic power naturally accumulates in its teeth. Whenever a tooth falls out, POKENAME will fashion it into its pendulum instead of losing the power within.

entry: POKENAME的攻击如海啸倾覆，能扫平敌人。野生个体不会对弱小对手动用火箭炮，因为它们觉得胜之不武。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME strikes like a crashing tsunami to wipe out its foes. Wild POKENAME refrain from using their rocket cannons against weaker foes, as it would be dishonorable.

entry: POKENAME若听见敌人靠近，就会跑进高草丛。它用后腿便能高速冲刺。
author: .izik
source: Should POKENAME hear an enemy approaching, it will run into a patch of tall grass. It can dash at high speeds by using its hind legs.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴粗壮沉重，能撑起身体，让自己站得更高，观察危险。必要时也能当作有效的棍棒，打击袭击者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tail is strong and heavy, used to lift itself up to get a better vantage point and look out for danger. It makes for an effective club against aggressors as well, when needed.

entry: POKENAME合作育幼，一雌两雄组成家庭，每次只有一只睡觉。它们平均分担抚养幼崽的责任，互相舔舐、梳理来增进亲情。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME engages in cooperative breeding, forming trios of one female and two males, with only one sleeping at a time. They take equal responsibility for raising their young and reinforce their family bond by licking and grooming each other.

entry: 等待进化时，POKENAME尽量保持不动。受惊后会拍打尾巴，试图吓退袭击者。
author: gerbopotato
source: POKENAME stays as still as possible while awaiting evolution. When alarmed, it bangs its tail in an attempt to ward off attackers.

entry: POKENAME像螺旋桨般快速旋转尾巴，将烟雾吹向四方。两个头保持警惕，不断交流策略，确保尾巴打结的位置恰到好处。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME rapidly twirl their tails like propellors to spread their smoke out in all directions. The two heads of a POKENAME stay alert and extensively communicate their tactics with each other to ensure their tails stay tied at the proper length.

entry: POKENAME周身围着100多根尾巴般的藤蔓。它们能独立活动，在战斗中格挡、打击并缠住敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is surrounded by over 100 tail-like vines. They move independently to parry, strike, and entangle foes in battle.

entry: POKENAME结群生活，轮流侦察花朵。发现合适的花后，侦察者会鸣叫并用尾巴敲地，通知伙伴。
author: gerbopotato
source: POKENAME form packs with members taking turns scouting for flowers. When the perfect blossoms are spotted, the scout alerts its friends by calling and bonking the ground with its tail.

entry: POKENAME心神不宁时，柔软毛发间会泛起强弱不一、噼啪作响的电流。雷雨让它精神大振，攻击威力也随之增强。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME is unsettled, crackling electric discharges of varying intensity ripple through its soft fur. Thunderstorms leave it feeling deeply invigorated, boosting the power of its attacks in the process.

entry: POKENAME尾大身弱，常难以游泳，宁愿靠尾巴在陆地上弹跳。它十分弱小，一见危险便会慌忙飞速跳走。
author: actliux
