source: Because of their large tail and their frail body, POKENAME often have trouble swimming, instead opting to bounce across land with their tail. They are very weak, often bouncing away at frantic speeds at the first sight of danger.

entry: 睡觉时，POKENAME轮流守卫地洞，因为有小偷会来偷树果。它们用渗出有毒凝胶的针刺攻击窃贼。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME take turns guarding their burrows when it is time to sleep, as thieves are known to take berries from them. They attack thieves using their stinger, which oozes with a venomous gel.

entry: POKENAME把黏软身体的一部分伸展成尾巴，撑高身体，仔细观察其他生物。这让它变身时模仿得更准确。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME extends part of its gooey body as a tail to lift itself up, gaining a better vantage point to observe others. This lets it transform better, increasing the accuracy of its shapeshifting.

entry: POKENAME被称为天空的哨兵，常在巢穴周围巡飞，大声尖叫，吓退带来威胁的宝可梦。
author: sentretvstar
source: Often called the sentry of the sky, POKENAME often flies around the area near its nest. It shrieks loudly to scare away any threatening Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME喜欢别人捏它柔软的大尾巴，每次都会开心地咯咯笑。睡觉时会把尾巴当枕头，依偎着入睡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys having its large soft tail squeezed, giggling brightly whenever someone does so. It cuddles up against its own tail like a pillow whenever it sleeps.

entry: 它们在洞外站岗，锐利的眼睛连森林里伪装的捕食者也能看穿。发现对方后，POKENAME会装病跛行，将其引远，再迅速逃回家。
author: quackquackattack
source: They stand guard outside their burrows, their keen eyes able to spot predators using camouflage in the forest. When spotted, POKENAME will pretend to be sick and limp away, so that they lure the predator away before making a quick retreat back home.

entry: POKENAME视力差，听觉却灵敏。它用粗尾拍打水面，提醒家人有入侵者。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME has poor eyesight but great hearing. It slaps its thick tail against the water's surface to warn its family of trespassers.

entry: POKENAME快速拍动两条尾巴，让自己升到恰好能看过高草丛的高度。受惊时则拍地弹起，滑翔逃走。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME flutters both tails rapidly to lift itself just high enough to see over tall grass. When startled, it slaps them against the ground to launch into the air and glides away.

entry: POKENAME用双尾撑起身体，能持续为群体放哨而不觉疲惫。它们性情紧张，常觉得自己身处险境。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME prop themselves up with their twin tails so that they can constantly stay on watch for their group without getting tired. They are anxious Pokémon and often believe themselves to be in danger.

entry: POKENAME以10至20只的家庭群体行动，贴着地面避免暴露。尾巴最长的成员负责放哨，撑起身体，高过栖身的草丛，留意危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME move in family groups of ten to twenty members, staying low to the ground to keep out of sight. POKENAME with the longest tails act as sentries for the group, towering up above the tall grass they live in to look out for danger.

entry: POKENAME以10至20只的家庭群体行动，贴着地面避免暴露。偶尔有个体尾巴短粗，难以放哨，只能依靠家人保护。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME move in family groups of ten to twenty members, staying low to the ground to keep out of sight. Rarely, POKENAME will have short and stubby tails that make it difficult for them to keep watch, making them rely on their family to stay safe.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴浓密蓬松，是华贵的宝可梦伙伴，很受大姐姐欢迎。它们喜欢像披肩般搭在训练家的颈间或肩上。
author: katieplaysgames
source: With their thick bushy tail, POKENAME make for luxurious Pokémon partners that are popular with Beauties. They love to drape themselves around the necks or over the shoulders of their Trainers.

entry: POKENAME白色的毛发形似骷髅，让其他生物误以为有毒，借此吓退捕食者。尽管如此，它十分好斗，往往会先向对方冲去。
author: jaminmcready
source: To ward off predators, POKENAME's white fur resembles a skull, tricking others into thinking it's poisonous. Despite this, it is highly aggressive and charges at others first.

entry: POKENAME成小群藏在同一棵树里，囤积落下的树果。结珍稀树果的树上，藏着的个体最多。
author: mistymagius
source: Small groups of POKENAME hide in the same tree, hoarding the berries that fall off it. Trees that produce rare berries have the largest amount of POKENAME hiding in them.

entry: POKENAME在宝可梦世界的许多公园里随处可见。它们成小群跑来跑去，向游人讨摸摸。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are a pedestrian sight at many parks in the Pokémon world. It scampers in small groups to solicit petting from parkgoers.

entry: POKENAME生来爱探索，在平原会用尾巴撑高身体观察，进森林则用六条腿攀爬。它吃植物和花蜜，只有保护自己或伙伴时才动用毒针。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is an explorer by nature, surveying flatlands by elevating with its tail or climbing around forests with its six legs. It only uses the stinger to protect itself or its packmates, instead eating plants and nectar.

entry: POKENAME还在学习驾驭电力，不练习时就去采树果。觅食时会留下芭亚果，因为实在太酸。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are still developing their ability to harness electricity and go to collect berries when they are not practicing. When they are foraging, they leave behind the Iapapa Berries because they are incredibly sour.

entry: POKENAME爱采树果，却还在摸索自己喜欢的口味。咬到苦涩的乐芭果时，会难过得大哭。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to forage for berries, but they are still learning which berries they might enjoy. When they bite into the bitter Aguav Berry, they get incredibly upset and cry.

entry: POKENAME常误入为小拉达设置的陷阱，动弹不得，任捕食者宰割。科学家正研制能让它逃走、却仍抓得住小拉达的机关。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often end up in traps meant for Rattata, leaving them vulnerable to predators and unable to move. Scientists are developing mechanisms that let POKENAME escape while still catching Rattata.

entry: POKENAME用的桶由最柔软的木材雕成。桶中水温会随它的情绪变化。
author: .cornflexx
source: The bucket POKENAME uses is carved from the softest wood. The temperature of the water changes depending on its emotions.

entry: 它们等到夜晚，才翻动露营者的背包，寻找树果和其他零食。就算被发现，POKENAME也能在人来得及起身前跑掉。
author: quackquackattack
source: They wait until nighttime to dig around a camper's backpack, rummaging for berries and other snacks. When spotted, POKENAME can run away before a camper has time to stand.

entry: POKENAME的唾液有疗伤作用，彼此舔舐来增进感情。走路时会互缠尾巴；成员若是单数，就轮流来，免得落单的那只难过不已。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's saliva contains healing properties and they lick each other as a way of bonding. They intertwine tails when walking, and if there is an odd number they take turns, as the one left out gets inextricably sad.

entry: POKENAME的唾液有疗伤作用，彼此舔舐来增进感情。游泳时会互缠尾巴；成员若是单数，就轮流来，免得落单的那只难过不已。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's saliva contains healing properties and they lick each other as a way of bonding. They intertwine tails when swimming, and if there is an odd number they take turns, as the one left out gets inextricably sad.

entry: POKENAME乐于引导探险者穿行野林小径，却有时因健忘把人带进死路。它在地下挖掘隧道，与庞大的家族一同生活。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME takes pleasure in guiding explorers along wild forest paths, though its forgetfulness sometimes leads them into dead ends. It lives in very large families within the tunnels it digs underground.

entry: POKENAME夜里沿城市大街飞掠，吃人们掉下的各种零食。从冰激凌到爆米花粒，靠这些碎屑便能吃饱，直到黎明才休息。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swoop down city boulevards at night to eat various snacks that people drop. From ice cream to popcorn kernels, they keep themselves well fed by the scraps people drop until they rest at dawn.

entry: POKENAME背上的鳞茎会释放带泥土气息的孢子，可泡成让人保持清醒的草本茶。它能发现人类看不到的宝可梦，因此许多守卫选它为伙伴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce earthy spores from the bulb on their back that can be brewed into an herbal tea that keeps people alert. Many POKENAME are kept as partners for guards because they can spot Pokémon that people cannot.

entry: POKENAME不得不与尾立共享领地，十分懊恼。背上的栗子吸引着尾立，它只好不停抗争，免受纠缠。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME shares territory with Sentret, much to its chagrin. The latter is attracted to the chestnut on its back, so POKENAME is constantly fighting to keep itself from being accosted.

entry: POKENAME每6至7只聚在一根树枝上。它们用尾巴彼此触碰，或摆出可见的信号，互相交流。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME cluster on tree branches together in groups of six or seven individuals. Their tails are used as a means of communicating with one another, both through touch and as visual signals.

entry: POKENAME挂在枝头，挥动红褐色的尾巴交流。它们能配合引发爆炸，把捕食者吓离巢穴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hang from branches and wave their auburn-colored tails to communicate with each other. They are able to coordinate explosions that scare predators from their nests.

entry: POKENAME以特定阵形一同飞行，配合得十分严密：目光最敏锐的在前，最强壮的殿后。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME fly together in particular and highly coordinated formations: those with the keenest eyesight fly in front, while the toughest of them fly in the back.

entry: POKENAME在林地上奔走，采集各种树果，唯独不采甜得过头的芒芒果。它们把树果放在壳内发酵，带出丰富的风味。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME scuttle across the forest floor to gather berries, except for the excessively sweet Mago Berry. They ferment berries within their shell to bring out the complex flavors that the berries have.

entry: POKENAME被训练家收服时，通常会舍弃自己藏好的树果。不过，献上一颗凰梨果，有些就肯带训练家去找藏粮处。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME typically abandon the hidden berries they have whenever they are caught by Trainers. However, offering them a Pinap Berry convinces some to lead Trainers back to their stash.

entry: POKENAME为看得更远，会翻身仰躺，再把液态身体向上伸长观察。虽能看清周围，之后却常难以翻回身。
author: sk372
source: In order to gain better vantage points, POKENAME will roll onto its back and extend its liquefied body upward to look around. Though good for ascertaining its surroundings, POKENAME often has difficulty righting itself afterward.

entry: 野生POKENAME寻找大型宝可梦作伴，像围巾般缠在对方颈上，分享食物。作为回报，它充当额外的耳目，在伙伴睡觉时警戒捕食者。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME seek out larger Pokémon to partner with, wrapping around their necks like scarves and sharing their food. In return, they serve as an extra pair of eyes and ears and keep watch for predators while their partner Pokémon sleep.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴高高撑起身体，寻找能装进袋里的食物。它害怕食物被偷光，除非有另一只尾立监视守护，否则绝不与别人分享。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME stands up high on its tail to search for any food it could store in its sack. It never shares food with others unless it's watched and guarded by another Sentret due to fear of having all of its food stolen.

entry: POKENAME松开颚部关节，整堆吞下墨莓果，在体内储存大量树果。吃下的果子让它嘴里吐出的污泥团染成深紫色。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME stores massive amounts of Bluk Berries in their body by unhinging their jaws and swallowing entire piles of berries whole. The blobs of sludge they release from their mouths are stained a deep violet from the berries they eat.

entry: 吃完一餐树果，POKENAME便沿山坡滚下，消耗多余脂肪。孩子常骑自行车和它们比赛取乐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME go rolling down hills after eating a meal of berries to burn off excess fat. Kids often race against them on bicycles as a means of entertainment.

entry: POKENAME用双手轻碰，练习产生火花。不练习控电时，就去找美味又健康的文柚果当零食。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME practice producing sparks by tapping their hands together. When they are not developing their control over electricity, they search for a deliciously healthy Sitrus Berry to snack on.

entry: POKENAME靠圆圆的身体和尾巴在旷野弹跳，侦察危险。受惊时会发出尖叫，像橡皮球般滚走。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's round body and tail lets it bounce across open fields, where it scouts for danger. If startled, it lets out a high-pitched squeak and rolls away like a rubber ball.

entry: POKENAME的胖大体型主要来自大量吃树果。它常重到连尾巴也撑不稳。口味挑剔，拒吃檬柠果等酸味树果。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gain most of their bulk from eating large quantities of berries. They are often so heavy that they cannot balance on their tails. They are picky with the Berries they eat and refuse to eat sour ones like a Nomel Berry.

entry: POKENAME虽精通武术，却很胆小。它用尾巴撑高身体，越过障碍观察，若看见令人兴奋的事就会双脚蹦跳。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Despite being skilled at martial arts, POKENAME exhibit skittish mannerisms. They use their tails to to see over obstacles, and bounce on their feet if what they see excites them.

entry: POKENAME在河岸安家，捕食较小的全水生宝可梦，避开深水危险。洞穴入口众多，一退走便很难判断去了哪里。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their homes along riverbanks, hunting smaller fully aquatic Pokémon while avoiding the dangers of deeper water. Their burrows have multiple entrances, making it hard to determine where they've gone when they retreat.

entry: POKENAME三只一组，凭心灵感应扫视草原上的威胁。危险靠近时，会在心灵中发出尖叫，悄悄警告伙伴躲藏。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses telepathy in groups of three to scan the prairie for threats. If danger is near, it subtly warns its allies to hide with telepathic screeches.

entry: POKENAME喜欢陪训练家，也乐于分享采来的树果。它尤其喜欢口感细滑的比巴果，愿意与训练家分享，便是彼此亲近的表现。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love spending time with their Trainer and enjoy sharing berries that they find while foraging. They particularly enjoy Qualot Berries because of their smooth texture, so sharing one with their Trainer is a sign of mutual affection.

entry: POKENAME感情丰富，很容易依恋他人，渴望时常拥抱。它也有些固执，还没抱够就想松手的人，会被精神力量强行拉回来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very loving and easily grows attached to others, craving regular hugs. It's a bit stubborn as well, so those that try to release the hug before POKENAME is finished get forcibly pulled back in by its psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME侦察来犯之敌。一锁定目标，便有数只一拥而上，全力攻击。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME scout for incoming foes. Once they have a target, several of them attack the enemy with all they have.

entry: POKENAME没有牙齿，靠整只吞下昆虫维生。虫子飞高躲避时，它就用强壮尾巴把自己撑得更高。
author: sk372
source: Lacking teeth, POKENAME subsists on swallowing insects whole for sustenance. It uses its strong tail to give it a boost in height when bugs fly up high to evade it.

entry: 橡实果偶尔会搭乘POKENAME。背上有乘客时，平日温和的它便极力护卫，对靠得太近太快的生物猛然攻击。
author: sk372
source: Seedot will occasionally hitch rides upon POKENAME. While it carries a passenger, the normally mellow POKENAME becomes fiercely protective, lashing out at those who get too close too quickly.

entry: POKENAME用嘴状附肢撑高身体，以金属尖牙牢牢抓地，更清楚地观察周围。它爱吃树果，更喜欢用自己真正的嘴细品滋味。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses a mouth-like appendage to get a better view of its surroundings, its metal fangs keeping it firmly planted on the ground. It adores the taste of berries and prefers to savor the flavors with its own mouth.

entry: POKENAME模仿尾立的叫声，装成有一只被困、需要帮助。想救这只诱饵的好心者，会被吸进它的嘴里吃掉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME mimics the cry of Sentret to make it appear as if one is stuck and in need of assistance. Those who try to help the stuck lure get sucked into POKENAME's mouth and consumed.

entry: POKENAME产生并排出可燃气体，可能会敲击两块石头将其点燃。它靠蓬松尾巴保持平衡，好看清周围。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME produce and expel flammable gas, which they may ignite by striking two stones together. They balance themselves on their bushy tails to better see their surroundings.

entry: POKENAME出了名地谨慎，用大耳朵探知危险宝可梦，警告伙伴。感到受威胁时，会用毒角使敌人无法动弹。
author: blaizegamer
source: POKENAME is known for its cautious nature and uses its large ears to detect dangerous Pokémon and warn others. It immobilizes foes using its toxic horn if it feels threatened.

entry: POKENAME用磁力快速甩动三条旋转尾巴，攻击围住自己的对手。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME uses magnetism to rapidly swing its three Spinny-Tails and strike opponents surrounding it.

entry: POKENAME的缎带强韧，足以托起整个身体离地。它借此升高，取得更好的视野，观察周围。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's ribbons are strong enough to be able to lift its own weight off the ground.  It uses this ability to raise itself higher and get a better vantage point to ascertain its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME的毛发华美厚软，深受富裕名媛青睐。人们喂它吃茄番果，辛辣成分有天然止汗作用，能让毛发留住更多香水。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have luxuriously plush fur that makes them desirable to rich socialites. They are fed Tamato Berries because the spice acts as a natural antiperspirant, which allows them to hold more perfume in their fur.

entry: POKENAME让身上的圆环发光，夜里巡视领地。发现危险就鸣叫警告同类，再聚在一起持续照着威胁，使其无法悄悄溜走。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: POKENAME cast light from the ring on their body and patrol their territory during the night. If they spot danger, they cry out warnings for others of their kind. They gather and keep their light trained on the threat so it can't slip away undetected.

entry: POKENAME的鼻子特别善于追寻水果，最爱辛辣的蔓莓果。甜品店借它的本领寻找新口味，加入水果冰糕。训练家若想拿走它的蔓莓果，会遭到灼热的咬击。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME's nose is especially sensitive at tracking fruits, though its favorites are spicy Razz Berries. Sweet shops use their skills to find new flavors to add to sherbet. If a Trainer tries to take their Razz Berries, they suffer a burning bite.

entry: POKENAME与其他宝可梦交战时，总会靠尾巴保持平衡，让动作的范围更大。落于下风时，它们就咬下一颗龙睛果，让自己能再多承受几次攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME balance on their tails whenever they fight against other Pokémon because it gives them a greater range of movement. When they are losing a fight, they bite down on a Ganlon Berry to help them take a few more hits.

entry: POKENAME每天睡20小时，剩下4小时放哨。通常6只一群，确保睡觉时不会被吃掉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sleep for 20 hours a day and keep watch for the other 4 hours. They often live in groups of 6 to ensure that they won't get eaten in their sleep.

entry: POKENAME察觉附近有威胁时，尾巴就会闪起静电。它虽胆小，却会放出微弱电击，足以吓到体型两倍于己的捕食者。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's tail flickers with static when it senses threats nearby. While timid, it's known to deliver a small shock, enough to startle predators twice its size.

entry: 进化后，POKENAME钢铁般的毛发迅速生长，裹成茧状外壳。等待再次进化时，长尾仍留在茧外，让它多少还能活动。
author: deniablecredibility
source: Upon evolving, POKENAME's steely fur begins to grow rapidly, forming a cocoon-like shell around its body. It remains semi-mobile while awaiting further evolution thanks to its long tail, which remains outside of the cocoon.

entry: POKENAME两个齿轮状的头不停转动，从各个角度观察周围。睡觉时，两头轮流放哨，让另一头休息。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME's two gear-shaped heads are constantly rotating to get a view of their surroundings from all angles. When sleeping, each head takes a turn to keep watch while the other rests.

entry: 有人相信，店门口摆夸张造型的POKENAME塑像会招财。大众作品常描绘它与索罗亚互为对手。它更喜欢伪装成家用品。
author: elfail0
source: It is believed by some that displaying an exaggerated statue of a POKENAME at the entrance to a business will invite good fortune. Popular media often depict them as rivals with a Zorua. They prefer to disguise themselves as household objects.

entry: 它藏在树枝间站岗，发现威胁就发出尖叫，警告其他家人。POKENAME外表虽可爱，嘴里却能喷出灼热火焰。
author: fiordaliso
source: It stands guard hidden among the branches of trees and warns other members of its family with high-pitched cries if it spots a threat. Despite its cute appearance, POKENAME can breathe scorching flames from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME将根系与周围植物相连，分享养分。它们格外喜欢榴石果，会传播种子，让更多榴石果长出来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME share nutrients with other plants around them by connecting their roots together. They are especially fond of Pomeg Berries and will propagate their seeds to grow more Pomeg Berries.

entry: POKENAME毛发厚软，不易引起过敏，是抢手的宠物。人们喂它玉黍果，因为相信这种果子能减少掉毛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have plush, hypoallergenic fur that makes them desirable as pets. They are fed Cornn Berries because it is believed that the berries make POKENAME shed less.

entry: POKENAME是友善的幽灵，常出现在独居者家中。夜里会亲昵地蹭过来作伴，不让对方独度寂寞长夜。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a friendly spirit often spotted within the homes of those who live alone. It nuzzles up to them at night, keeping them company so they don't get lonely through the evening.

entry: POKENAME的电力全部储存在尾巴里，因此尾巴相对身体格外庞大。用尾巴当柱子撑高身体时，电流便沿地面呈网状向外迸发。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tail is quite large compared to the rest of its body due to all of its electricity being stored within. When it uses it as a pillar to lift itself higher, the lightning surges outward across the ground in a web-like pattern.

entry: 不同POKENAME族群用碎果比赛解决领地争端，粉碎硬壳树果，展示长牙和尾巴的力量。败者离开，胜者大吃一顿。
author: joeofthealps
source: Rival colonies of POKENAME solve territory disputes with berry-crushing competitions, in which the Pokémon demonstrate the strength of their tusks and tails by demolishing hard-shelled berries. The losers leave the area, and the winners get a feast.

entry: POKENAME不停在巢边巡逻，提防危险。一旦发现威胁，就高声尖叫，警告其他群体成员。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME constantly patrols its nest, keeping a lookout for danger. If it does spot danger, it will loudly screech to alert the rest of its flock.

entry: 这种夜行宝可梦会突然发出尖锐叫声，彼此交流。叫声很像小孩子的尖叫。
author: bobosmith01
source: To communicate, these nocturnal Pokémon screech sharply and suddenly. Their cries sound like the screams of young children.

entry: 它身上的蘑菇鲜味浓厚，是美食厨师争相寻求的食材。POKENAME大群生活，轮流睡觉，让每只身上的蘑菇都有同伴守护。
author: hophoppip
source: Its mushrooms have a strong umami flavor that's sought after by gourmet chefs. POKENAME live in large groups and sleep in shifts so each POKENAME's mushrooms can be guarded.

entry: 森林里能见到成群跳跃的POKENAME，察觉危险就迅速跳上树。据说，它们身上的瓜甜而带坚果香。
author: mistymagius
source: Groups of POKENAME can be seen hopping around the forests, quickly jumping into the trees when they sense danger. Their gourds are said to have a sweet, nutty flavor.

entry: 它用蓬松尾巴抹去足迹，避免被跟踪回巢。POKENAME的爪子能烧得白炽，谁因外表可爱就小看它，都会遭到重创。
author: fiordaliso
source: It uses its fluffy tail to erase its tracks and avoid being followed back to its den. POKENAME's claws can become incandescent and cause serious damage to anyone who makes the mistake of underestimating it because of its cute appearance.

entry: POKENAME住在地洞，感觉地面有动静，就谨慎地探头查看。若看见危险，便放声大叫，警告地下的同伴。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME lives in burrows, so when it senses movement on the surface, it cautiously pops up to review its source. Seeing anything it finds dangerous, it belts a loud cry to warn others underground.

entry: POKENAME身体柔软灵活，能挤进狭窄空间。独特的锁骨让它钻过多数宝可梦进不去的地方，例如家具间的缝隙或围栏孔洞。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are flexible creatures that can fit in tight spaces. Their unique collarbone allows them to squeeze in places most Pokémon are unable to fit into, such as gaps between furniture or openings in fences.

entry: POKENAME天生好奇，新东西一交给它，总要研究一番。它也爱探索周围，会爬树、跃过河流，寻找新的冒险去处。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are naturally curious creatures and will always investigate new objects given to them. They also love to explore the world around them, as they climb trees and leap across rivers to find new places to adventure into.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴仿佛有自己的意志，常蹭它的后脑。那里因此发痒，却怎么也挠不好，最后弄得头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have tails that seem to act on their own and often rub against the back of their head. This often leads to an itch that cannot be scratched effectively and leads to them getting a headache.

entry: POKENAME喜欢水流掠过身体的感觉，几乎总在游泳。吃蕉香果是少有的停下时刻，恰好给训练家留下收服的机会。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are almost always swimming because they enjoy the sensation of moving water. One of the few times they stop swimming is when they eat Nanab Berries, which allows Trainers just enough time to catch them.

entry: POKENAME四处寻找各种树果，但大多不喜欢勿花果的辛辣滋味。它会用念力让树果飘过河，免得自己弄湿。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME scavenge for berries of many types, but most do not like the taste of the Figy Berry because of the spicy flavor. They harness telekinesis to levitate berries across rivers to avoid getting wet.

entry: 它全身最强壮的肌肉在粗大的尾巴里。POKENAME用强力拳脚痛击对手，却总把最后一击留给尾巴的猛扫。
author: sk372
source: Its strongest muscle is its large and thick tail. POKENAME pummels foes with its powerful punches and kicks, but always saves the final blow for a mighty swing of its tail.

entry: POKENAME白天与伙伴一起锻炼肌肉。夜里，其中一只会摘下限制力量的腰带，让充沛能量尽情奔涌，借此为群体守一整夜。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME trains its muscular body with its pack during the day. During the night, one POKENAME will take off its power-save belt to allow its overflowing energy to run wild. This gives it the energy to keep watch for the pack all night long.

entry: POKENAME用颜料或白黏土在胸前画同心圆。其含义尚不完全清楚，据说是为了让自己显眼，吸引强者前来交手。
author: hophoppip
source: Using paint or white clay, POKENAME marks its chest with concentric circles. The meaning of this body paint is not entirely known, but it's believed to make POKENAME stand out so it can attract strong opponents to fight.

entry: POKENAME轮流站着睡觉，捕食者几乎分不清谁还醒着。只要一只发现敌人，便高声嘶鸣，唤起整个群体奔踏，将倒霉的对手踩在脚下。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME take turns sleeping upright, making it nearly impossible for predators to determine who is awake. If one of their herd members spots a predator, a loud neigh awakens a stampede to trample the unlucky foe.

entry: POKENAME常吃椰木果，因为这种树果很容易在海边生长。它平衡感极佳，能用肚子或尾巴支撑身体，抛接树果。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME eat lots of Pamtre Berries because they can readily grow along beaches. They have a superb sense of balance and can juggle berries while standing on their stomach or tail.

entry: POKENAME的鳞茎覆着极柔软的毛，保护它抵御严冬。主要吃零余果，因为果中富含对身体大有益处的酶。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's bulb is covered in very soft fur that protects it from the harsh winter temperatures. It feeds mainly on Chesto Berries, as they are rich in enzymes that are very beneficial to its body.

entry: POKENAME有奇特的习性，会排成直线，接连一起滚动。若这串动作被打断，可能会懊恼得爆炸。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME exhibit a peculiar behavior of rolling in tandem with one another in a straight line. If this chain of movement is interrupted, they may end up exploding from frustration.

entry: POKENAME的身体柔软有弹性，能承受大力挤压。它喜欢藏在枕头和毛绒玩具间，盼望被新朋友抱住。
author: griddle
source: Its soft, squishy body can stand up to being crushed and squeezed with great force. POKENAME likes to hide among pillows and plush toys in the hope of being cuddled by new friends.

entry: POKENAME的身体是一团向外伸展、汇于中心的触手。饿时，宝石便明亮发光，触手伸向附近的树果抓来吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is a sprawling mess of tentacles that converge into a central point. The gem glows brightly whenever it is hungry, and it stretches to grab nearby berries to eat.

entry: POKENAME寂寞时会变得好斗，横冲直撞地突破一切障碍，只为找个人，用柔软的长身体缠住相拥，排解孤独。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gets aggressive when it grows lonely. It will charge through any obstacle to find someone to wrap its long, soft body around and cuddle with to alleviate its loneliness.

entry: POKENAME一边有节奏地弹跳移动，一边啁啾哼曲。有时还喜欢制作邦戈鼓，敲出这首曲子。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME bounces rhythmically as it moves about, chirping a tune as it does so. It sometimes likes to craft bongos to play said tune.

entry: POKENAME性情平静，身体天然温暖，是老人喜爱的伙伴。困了就蜷起身体，枕着自己蓬松的大尾巴休息。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is a popular companion for the elderly thanks to its calm temperament and naturally warm body. It curls up and rests on its big fluffy tail whenever it gets sleepy.

entry: POKENAME在网络空间旅行时，毛发生长速度翻倍。旅途太长，过长的毛发反而会拖慢它。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fur grows twice as fast while it travels through cyberspace. Prolonged journeys leave it slowed by the excessive length of its coat.

entry: POKENAME把幼崽缠得紧紧的，几乎让它们窒息。不过，若拥抱没那么紧、没那么要命，蓬松的毛发仍让人觉得很舒服。
author: firstromaniandiscoerd
source: POKENAME wraps around its offspring so tight that they almost suffocate. However, when POKENAME's hugs are not as tight and deadly, they can be enjoyable because of POKENAME's fluffy fur.

entry: POKENAME喜欢收集路边发现的彩色物件。它远远观察人类，趁人睡觉留下这些礼物，但只送给自己认为善良的人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME loves to collect colorful objects it finds along roads. It watches humans from afar and leaves these items as gifts while they sleep, but only for those it believes are kind people.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴高高撑起身体，轮流放哨，让家人吃落下的坚果和水果。发现危险时会尖声鸣叫，几百米外都能听见。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME stand high up on their tails, taking turns watching out for danger whilst their family feeds on fallen nuts and fruits. They make a high pitched chirping noise when they spot danger, and the noise can be heard from hundreds of meters away.

entry: POKENAME像蛇一般在高草丛中蜿蜒，寻找猎物。它用身体将猎物缠紧，再拖回地洞。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's body moves much like a snake, slithering through the tall grass in search of prey. They will use their body to constrict their prey, dragging them back to their burrow.

entry: POKENAME的毛比未融合的大尾立粗硬得多，能挡住森林中的荆棘。它行动敏捷，转眼就能消失在灌木与纵横的地洞间。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have much coarser fur than unfused Furret, using the fur as a means to protect themselves from brambles and thorns in the forest. They are nimble Pokémon, able to disappear into bushes and warrens in an instant.

entry: POKENAME每次使用超能力，胡须都会明显抽动。战斗中，这个习惯会泄露它的意图。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's mustache twitches noticeably whenever it uses a psychic ability. This behavior gives away its intentions during battles.

entry: POKENAME摇动蓬松尾巴分散敌人注意，再迅速来一记上勾拳。整个攻击过程始终笑眯眯的。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wags its fluffy tail to distract foes before delivering a swift uppercut. It keeps a cheerful smile throughout the entire attack.

entry: POKENAME在伙伴的巢周围缠上细丝，形成预警网。捕食者靠近时，它就鸣叫，提醒大家逃跑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins thin silk around the nests of its allies, creating an early warning system. When predators approach, it chirps to alert others to flee.

entry: 只要有人开始喂食，它就算吃饱也不肯停。训练家被告诫不要投喂野生POKENAME，否则它可能重到飞不起来。
author: .izik
source: It refuses to stop eating once someone starts feeding it, even after becoming full. Trainers are warned not to feed wild POKENAME, as it may grow too heavy to fly.

entry: 冷时，POKENAME用柔软蓬松的尾巴裹住身体。水灵传情的大眼睛能融化袭击者的心，常使对方失去战意。
author: fiordaliso
source: When cold, POKENAME wraps its soft, fluffy tail around its body. Its large, soulful eyes can melt the hearts of attackers, often making them lose the desire to fight.

entry: 幼崽孵化后，POKENAME会把它们带给训练家看。若训练家不抱幼崽，它就会冷落后代，拒绝喂食。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME will present their children to their Trainer when the baby Pokémon hatch out of an egg. If the Trainer does not embrace the baby Pokémon, POKENAME will shun and refuse to feed their offspring.

entry: POKENAME头上的花朵旋转吸气，充满体内的气囊。这样便能离地，轻轻飘浮。
author: .izik
source: The flower on POKENAME's head spins to draw in air, filling its internal gas sack. This allows it to lift off the ground and float gently.

entry: POKENAME身上的绒球其实是长毛的气囊。它借此轻飘飘地浮在空中，懒洋洋地掠过花圃。
author: .izik
source: The puffballs on POKENAME's body are actually furry gas sacks. It uses them to float gently through the air, drifting lazily across flowerbeds.

entry: POKENAME结群进行配合严密的劫掠。它们聪明又敏捷，乡间餐馆的老板对其深恶痛绝。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME do highly coordinated raids in groups. Intelligent and swift, they are loathed by countryside restaurant owners.

entry: POKENAME将毛茸茸的长尾伸进树洞，寻找财物或食物。一有收获，就顽皮地咯咯笑，带着战利品跑掉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sticks its long, furry tail into tree holes to search for valuables or food. Once it finds something, it chuckles mischievously and runs off with its prize.

entry: POKENAME不用手臂，而靠脸上的附肢辅助移动。附肢用来测量缝隙，判断身体能否钻过，还会分泌油状凝胶，帮助滑过狭窄孔隙。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Instead of arms, POKENAME uses the appendages on its face to help it move. It uses them to gauge whether a gap is small enough for it to squirm through. They also secrete an oily gel to help it slip through narrow openings.

entry: POKENAME身手敏捷，再加上预知能力，任何危险都能轻松避开。
author: glacierwing
source: A POKENAME is an agile creature. When combined with its precognitive powers, this means POKENAME can avoid any danger easily.

entry: POKENAME背上的草本鳞茎散发橡实与烤坚果的芳香。特别焦虑或压力大时，极柔软的毛间便会布满令人发痒的皮屑。
author: fiordaliso
source: The herbaceous bulb on POKENAME's back gives off a fragrant aroma of acorns and roasted nuts. Its extremely soft fur becomes covered in itchy dandruff when POKENAME is particularly anxious or stressed.

entry: POKENAME在香草园附近筑巢，最爱罗勒和百里香。它常采来一大把一大把，储存在家中。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME nests near herb gardens, favoring basil and thyme above all others. It often collects large bunches to store in its home.

entry: POKENAME用毛茸茸的触角，以精神力量探知附近的敌人，几乎不可能悄悄接近它。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its furry antennae to psychically detect nearby enemies. This makes it nearly impossible to sneak up on.

entry: POKENAME的毛由松针般的柔软细针组成。虽然无害，尖刺般的外观却足以劝退捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fur is composed of soft needles resembling pine needles. While harmless, they are enough to dissuade potential predators due to the spiky appearance.

entry: POKENAME相信坚硬外壳能保护自己，在森林中毫无畏惧地行动。这份自信让它尽情满足好奇心，连危险也敢靠近。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME move around the forest completely without fear, confident in their tough outer shells to protect them from harm. Their confidence allows them to indulge in their natural curiosity, approaching dangerous situations without fear.

entry: POKENAME挖掘蜿蜒的长地洞，能延伸数英里。连石头和混凝土也挖得穿，很不适合当宠物。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME dig long snaking burrows that can stretch for miles. They can dig through stone and concrete, making them terrible pets.

entry: POKENAME在空中滑翔，长尾拖在身后。厚毛消去了翅膀的声响。
author: deelee2020
source: POKENAME glides through the skies, its long tail streaming out behind it. Thick fur muffles the sound from its wings.

entry: POKENAME的脖子远比看着长，能从壳中伸出最多5英尺。这样就能安全地缩在壳里，够到远处的东西。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's neck is deceptively long, able to extend up to five feet from its shell. This helps it reach distant objects while staying safely tucked away.

entry: POKENAME藏在营地外的高草中，等待偷食的时机。弯钩状的爪子能抓住野餐篮，不损坏里面的食物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hides in tall grass outside campsites and waits for the right opportunity to steal food. Its hooked claws allow it to latch onto picnic baskets without damaging the food inside.

entry: POKENAME友善活泼，外表可爱，是备受喜爱的宠物。它也相当乖巧，尤其是经常能吃到香甜蜂蜜口味的零食奖励时。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is adored as a pet due to its friendly, excitable nature and cute appearance. It is rather well-behaved as well, particularly if regularly given sweet, honey-flavored snacks as a treat.

entry: POKENAME把找到的树果存进壳中。里面的热量将其融成美味果糊，留待当天晚些时候享用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stores berries it finds within its shell. The heat inside melts them into a delightful paste it consumes later in the day.

entry: 飞云市有位裁缝，用POKENAME的羽毛制作奢华冬装。材料柔软温暖，制成的衣物十分抢手。
author: .izik
source: There is a tailor in Castelia City who uses POKENAME feathers to craft luxurious winter garments. The soft and warm material makes them highly sought after.

entry: POKENAME平时懒洋洋、慢吞吞，遇险却能高速奔跑。加上嗅寻食物的本领出众，成了许多城市里的害兽。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME is mostly slow and sleepy, but it can run at high speeds if it's in danger. This, combined with its great talent for sniffing out food, makes POKENAME a pest in many cities.

entry: POKENAME会选一只更大、更强悍的宝可梦为伙伴，自己先行侦察猎物。遇到独自难以拿下的目标，就退向搭档，把猎物引进埋伏。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME chooses a larger and more formidable Pokémon to partner with, then scouts ahead searching for prey. If it finds something too large to take down alone, POKENAME will lure this Pokémon into an ambush by retreating back to its hunting partner.

entry: POKENAME喜欢蜷成球，让训练家推着滚，和对方玩耍。可惜身体又大又重，多数人推不了多久。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME loves to play with its Trainer by curling into a ball and being rolled around. Its large size and heavy weight makes it difficult for most to push it around for long, unfortunately.

entry: POKENAME在粗壮树木中筑巢，受威胁时用纹理藏进枝叶间。必要时，奔跑时速可超过20英里。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME make their nests in thick trees, using Conversion to hide amongst the branches when they feel threatened. If needed, they can sprint at speeds of over 20mph.

entry: POKENAME在粗壮树木中筑巢，受威胁时用纹理藏进枝叶间。必要时，奔跑时速可超过20英里。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME make their nests in thick trees, using Conversion to hide amongst the branches when they feel threatened. If needed, they can sprint at speeds of over 20mph.

entry: POKENAME将精神力量注入毛茸茸的鹿角，劈开树木。里面的树液是它最爱的美食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME channels psychic energy through its furry antlers to cleave open trees. The sap inside becomes its favorite treat.

entry: POKENAME爱抓住别人，拥抱、亲昵地蹭来蹭去。可是摩擦会让毛发放电，谁被它选中亲热，就得挨电。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME loves to grab onto others, hugging and nuzzling them. However, nuzzling causes its fur to let loose electricity, causing it to shock whatever it has decided to cuddle.

entry: POKENAME极其友善，见到陌生人也会高高兴兴地蜿蜒爬来打招呼。因此常被用于治疗场所，安抚病人。
author: epsilonity
source: POKENAME are extremely friendly Pokémon who will happily slither over to strangers in order to greet them. As such, they are widely used in therapeutic environments to soothe patients.

entry: POKENAME遇到饥饿的年幼宝可梦，会提供营养丰富的乳汁。幼崽吃奶时，蓬松长尾能带来温暖与安慰。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME encounters a hungry young Pokémon, it offers them its nutritious milk. Its long, fluffy tail provides warmth and comfort while they feed.

entry: POKENAME友善却疏离，漫游世界，从不在一处久留。它会蜷在睡着的训练家身旁取暖作伴，但对方一醒，就迅速离去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is friendly yet aloof, roaming the world and never staying in one locale for long. It curls up next to sleeping Trainers and keeps them warm, but as soon as they wake, it quickly takes its leave.

entry: POKENAME脱落的毛是冬装里衬的抢手材料，既保暖又防水。它似乎喜欢被训练家或宝可梦追赶，将其当成游戏。
author: chibitales
source: The shed fur of POKENAME is highly sought after as warm, water-resistant linings for winter clothing. They seem to enjoy being chased by Trainers and Pokémon alike, as they view the chase as a game.

entry: 多数POKENAME身长约8英尺，许多还要更长。足够长的身体能缠住敌人使其窒息，因此不必再发展毒牙。
author: quackquackattack
source: While most POKENAME are roughly eight feet in length, many extend further. This gives them the length to wrap around and choke foes, allowing them to forgo the development of their venomous fangs.

entry: 风暴聚集时能见到POKENAME，曾遭雷击的地方尤其常见。它们成群用长尾互相摩擦，平衡彼此的电荷。
author: rosesilver
source: POKENAME can be seen when storms gather, especially in places previously struck by lightning. They group up and balance out each other's electric charge by rubbing their long tails together.

entry: 寒冬夜里，POKENAME用毛茸茸的长尾裹住伙伴，既能保暖，也能增进群体间的情谊。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's long, furry tails wrap around its friends on cold winter nights. This behavior helps keep them warm and builds camaraderie in their group.

entry: POKENAME无聊时，便找毫无防备的宝可梦，用蓄着静电的尾尖，挠得对方发痒。
author: phantom640
source: If bored, POKENAME will often look for unsuspecting Pokémon and tickle them with the tip of its tail using the static electricity stored inside of it.

entry: POKENAME吃树果吃得太多，行动困难。有些训练家喂它刺角果，借辛辣滋味加快新陈代谢。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a difficult time moving around because they eat so many berries. Some Trainers feed them a Spelon Berry to increase their metabolism from the spiciness.

entry: POKENAME温暖浓密的毛厚到东西陷进去，就常再也出不来。它又多住在林地，常沾满树叶和灌木，连模样都认不出了。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its warm, dense fur is so thick that objects often sink into it and never come out again. Since POKENAME tends to live in wooded areas, it is often so covered in leaves and shrubs that it becomes unrecognizable.

entry: POKENAME如今飞行已悄然无声。抓到猎物便迅速回家，钻进其他宝可梦无法抵达的曲折地洞。
author: deelee2020
source: POKENAME is now completely silent when flying. It captures prey, then darts home into twisting burrows impossible for other Pokémon to reach.

entry: POKENAME凭速度追上机器人，一边移动一边吃掉它们的数据。虽能钻过狭窄空间，却因动作急躁而经常撞头。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME use their speed to chase down robots and feed on their data while moving around. While it can fit in tight spaces, its twitchiness causes it to bump its head a lot.

entry: POKENAME的小翅膀覆着暖毛，能轻松穿行冻原而不受寒。即使气候最严酷，也能靠保温的翅膀取暖。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tiny wings are covered in warm fur. It can easily navigate tundras without getting cold, using its insulated wings to keep warm in even the harshest climates.

entry: POKENAME浓密的毛看似尖刺，能吓退捕食它的大嘴雀。只有获得信任、能依偎在它身边的对象，才知道它柔软得不可思议，令人安心。
author: azduality
source: POKENAME's dense fur has the appearance of spikes to deter predatory Fearows. Those it trusts enough to snuggle with find it to be extremely soft and nurturing.

entry: POKENAME年纪越大，毛的防水性越差。虽然仍在河流生活、狩猎，地洞却多建在沼泽地。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The fur of POKENAME gradually loses its waterproof qualities as they age. While they still live in and hunt within river environments, their burrow systems tend to be built in more swampy areas.

entry: 不再拥有进化前用来防水的油脂。POKENAME虽住在沼泽，却更爱在树根间挖洞，而非河岸。
author: katieplaysgames
source: It no longer contains the oils produced in earlier stages of their evolution that are needed to make it waterproof. Though they live in swampy environments, POKENAME prefer to make burrows among tree roots rather than along riverbanks.

entry: POKENAME喜欢长久拥抱训练家与宝可梦。它会使用精神力量，确保每次都抱到自己满意。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoys giving long hugs to Trainers and Pokémon. It is known to use its psychic powers to ensure that it is satisfied with each hug it gives.

entry: POKENAME善于潜行，身手敏捷，能藏进狭小空间，还能改变体色，融入环境。因此，它很难被发现和捕捉。
author: bobosmith01
source: A stealthy and nimble Pokémon capable of hiding in tight and narrow spaces. In addition, POKENAME has the ability to alter its colors to blend in with the environment. As a result, they are difficult to find and capture.

entry: POKENAME爱吃饼干，尤其是有坚果的。它会追着其他宝可梦抢饼干，所以训练家得让它与队伍其他成员分房进食。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love biscuits, especially those with nuts inside them. They chase after other Pokémon to take their biscuits, which is why Trainers will feed them in a separate room from the rest of the party.

entry: POKENAME十分友善，尾巴却会吞掉靠近的一切。为了防止这种事，它会找结实的草叶、芦苇或手帕，把尾巴的嘴绑住。每只打的蝴蝶结样式都不同。
author: bitoboy.
source: POKENAME are very friendly, although their tail ends up devouring anything that comes near. To prevent this, POKENAME finds strong blades of grass, reeds, or handkerchiefs to tie it shut. The style of the bow differs in each individual.

entry: POKENAME十分黏人，又有保护欲，从不离训练家超过一两码。双颚强劲，连金属也咬得动，不过需要仔细护理，必须刷牙。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME are very clingy and protective Pokémon, never straying more than a yard or two from their Trainer. POKENAME's jaws are very powerful and can chew metal, but they need a lot of maintenance and require teeth brushing.

entry: 冬季POKENAME的毛会变得蓬松，若感知到暴风雪将至，更会长得格外浓厚。这种天然适应能力帮助它抵御酷寒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fur grows fluffy during the winter, becoming especially thick if it senses an approaching blizzard. This natural adaptation helps it endure harsh cold.

entry: POKENAME友善爱玩，最喜欢与别人捉迷藏。虽然体型大，却能压缩折叠身体，藏进直径仅3英尺的地方，是躲藏高手。
author: sk372
source: Friendly and playful, POKENAME delights in playing hide-and-seek with others. Despite its size, it can squish and fold its own body to hide in spots as small as three feet in diameter, making it excellent at hiding.

entry: 防水毛发让POKENAME久泡水中也不会湿透变重。食物总要先洗再吃，尤其喜欢利木果。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its water-repellent fur allows it to stay in water for long periods without getting soaked or weighed down. POKENAME always washes its food before eating it and is particularly fond of Aspear Berries.

entry: 防水毛发让POKENAME久泡水中也不会湿透变重。食物总要先洗再吃，尤其喜欢利木果。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its water-repellent fur allows it to stay in water for long periods without getting soaked or weighed down. POKENAME always washes its food before eating it and is particularly fond of Aspear Berries.

entry: POKENAME的毛演化出了天然伪装。这种林栖宝可梦的翅膀，更适合从树梢滑翔回巢。
author: duplicitous_dirk
source: POKENAME has adapted fur to naturally camouflage itself. This forest-dweller's wings serve better for gliding from treetops to their dens.

entry: POKENAME以华美的毛闻名。层层毛发既让它在河湖中游泳时保暖，也招来了偷猎者。为防灭绝，它被列为保护物种。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME are renowned for their luxurious fur. The multiple layers that keep them warm while swimming in rivers and lakes also makes them attractive to poachers. To prevent extinction, POKENAME are classified as a protected species.

entry: POKENAME最爱给别人一个安心的拥抱。先用缎带缠住，再用柔软灵活的身体环抱，直到对方露出灿烂笑容才肯松开。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME loves nothing more than wrapping others up in a comforting hug. It wraps its ribbons around someone, then curls its own flexible body around them as well, refusing to let go until it sees them with a beaming, bright smile.

entry: 这只多爪的家伙，觉得什么有趣，就往家里囤。身体太大，连自行车、长凳，甚至人，也能收进去。
author: gasmaskblacky
source: This multi-pawed menace hoards whatever it deems interesting. Due to its size, this can also include larger things like bikes, benches or even people.

entry: 这只多爪的家伙，觉得什么有趣，就往家里囤。身体太大，连自行车、长凳，甚至人，也能收进去。
author: gasmaskblacky
source: This multi-pawed menace hoards whatever it deems interesting. Due to its size, this can also include larger things like bikes, benches or even people.

entry: POKENAME爱收集林中树上掉下的熟透树果，装进炮筒，战斗时当炮弹发射。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME loves to gather overripe berries that fall from forest trees. It loads them into its cannon to fire as projectiles in combat.

entry: POKENAME热情亲人，会从天上飘下，用缎带同时搂住好几个对象，抱着他们一同飞走。它很容易产生依恋，要说服它放开新朋友可不容易。
author: sk372
source: Highly affectionate, POKENAME floats down from the sky and wraps its ribbons around others, carrying them off in multiple simultaneous embraces. It gets attached easily, so convincing it to release its new friends is quite difficult.

entry: POKENAME把细长尾巴伸进小拉达的洞里，抓住后带走。受惊时，会让身体瘪下来，藏进狭窄裂缝。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME slip their slender tails into the burrows of Rattata, snatching them up and carrying them away. If startled, they will deflate their bodies, hiding themselves in tight crevices.

entry: POKENAME在乡间很常见，平衡感无可挑剔，总保持警惕。餐馆开始让它清理餐桌，因为它反应快，连掉落的盘子也接得住。
author: ghostslythe
source: Considered a common country sight, POKENAME has an impeccable sense of balance and is always on alert. Restaurants have started using them to bus tables, as their reflexes are sharp enough to catch falling plates.

entry: 柔软毛发让它在战斗中很难被结结实实地打中。再加上善于脱身、拳术高超，是不可小看的劲敌。
author: deelee2020
source: This Pokémon is difficult to get a good hit on in a fight due to its soft fur. Its slippery nature and boxing prowess make it a force to be reckoned with.

entry: POKENAME性情友善，身体蓬松，极受小孩欢迎，毛绒玩具因此畅销全球。它爱飘着陪孩子玩，也爱被抱抱。许多幼儿园养着它，让学生一同玩耍。
author: keiracm35_
source: POKENAME's friendly nature and super fluffy body make it a hit with young kids; hence, POKENAME plushies sell worldwide. It loves floating around, playing with them, and being cuddled. Many preschools keep POKENAME for students to play with.

entry: POKENAME极爱玩耍，看到的第一个生物就会被认作新玩伴，追上去不放。它能追数小时，只为跃起扑倒对方，盼着一起摔跤。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is extremely playful, running after the first creature it sees and thinks of as a new playmate. It can chase after a target for hours in order to leap and tackle them in the hopes of wrestling together.

entry: POKENAME的皮肤虽分泌阻燃油脂，快速生长的毛发却极干燥，十分易燃。
author: mx_wellman
source: Although POKENAME's skin secretes a fire-retardant oil, its quick-growing fur is actually incredibly dry and highly flammable.

entry: POKENAME到处飞，寻找小生物，用尾巴般的双翼包住来表达亲热。翅膀总是暖暖的，寒冷季节被它裹住尤其舒服。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flies around looking for small creatures to wrap its tail-like wings around as a sign of affection. Its wings are always warm, making it an especially pleasant experience during the colder seasons.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴裹住较小的宝可梦保暖，唱轻柔的歌哄睡。传说警告，打断歌声或惊扰它照看者睡眠的人，会遭到诅咒。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME wrap smaller Pokémon in their tails to keep them warm and sing soft melodies to help them sleep. Legends warn that a curse will be placed upon anyone who interrupts a POKENAME's song or disturbs the slumber of its wards.

entry: POKENAME常在芜菁田里掘洞，把家安在根系间。它大吃作物，让当地农人十分头痛。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is often found burrowing through turnip fields, making its home among the roots. It feasts on the crops, much to the frustration of local farmers.

entry: POKENAME的毛沾水后变得油滑，让捕食者极难抓牢。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME's fur gets wet, it becomes greasy and slippery. This makes it incredibly difficult for predators to grab hold of it.

entry: POKENAME虽然极其亲人，却因精力无穷，常被劝告不宜当宠物饲养。它不停讨吃、讨玩，一天睡觉很少超过1小时。
author: sk372
source: Though incredibly affectionate, keeping a POKENAME as a pet is often discouraged due to its boundless energy. It unceasingly asks for food or play, and rarely sleeps for more than an hour a day.

entry: 无聊时，POKENAME会在林间漫步，哼起悦耳小曲，不知不觉将附近宝可梦哄睡。冬天则用蓬松长尾裹住自己，躲避寒风。
author: fiordaliso
source: When bored, POKENAME hums lovely little tunes as it strolls through the woods, unknowingly lulling nearby Pokémon to sleep. In winter, it wraps itself in its long, fluffy tail to shelter from the cold wind.

entry: POKENAME很顽皮，常捉弄训练家取乐。不过，它深爱训练家，最见不得对方难过。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is quite mischievous, playing pranks on its Trainer for its own amusement. It does deeply love its Trainer though and cannot bear to see its Trainer sad.

entry: POKENAME的身体比看着柔韧得多，能迅速鼓起威吓，也能瘪下来躲避、潜入。它喜欢被人用尽力气拥抱、揉捏软软的身体。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is deceptively pliable, able to inflate rapidly for intimidation or deflate for evasion and infiltration. It loves having people hug and squish its soft body with all the strength they can muster.

entry: POKENAME的毛极其柔软蓬松，孩子很爱抱着它。可惜它散发的孢子会对人造成不良影响，例如中毒或陷入睡眠。
author: huh.7
source: POKENAME has extremely soft and fluffy fur that makes it very popular for children to snuggle. Unfortunately, the spores that it gives off have negative effects on people, like poisoning them or putting them to sleep.

entry: POKENAME在向日葵丛附近筑巢，每天采籽为食。它回到安全的家中，以柔和火焰加热食物，安安静静地享用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME builds its den near sunflower patches, plucking seeds daily for its meals. It retreats to the safety of its home to enjoy its food without interruption, heating it with gentle flames.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀看着凶猛，性情却温和，很适合安静的家庭。开心时会缠住家具，也爱挂在房梁上打盹。
author: jaminmcready
source: Though POKENAME's wings make it look fierce, it is gentle and thrives in quiet households. When happy, it wraps itself around furniture and loves to nap while hanging from ceiling beams.

entry: POKENAME在野外用扁平身体钻过窄缝觅食。这习惯也让它学会从紧闭门下挤进人家偷食。
author: xzydra
source: POKENAME uses its flat body to fit through narrow cracks to find food in the wild. This habit has led to POKENAME sneaking into houses to steal food by squeezing past closed doors.

entry: POKENAME的双眼由黑色蓝宝石与缟玛瑙混合而成。它靠热感视觉在全黑环境中视物，是高效的哨兵。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME's eyes are made of a mix of black sapphire and onyx. POKENAME use thermal vision to see in complete darkness, which makes them efficient sentinels.

entry: POKENAME友善的面孔让敌人放松警惕，可嘴里却能喷出酸液，打对方一个措手不及。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's friendly face lulls foes into a false sense of security. However, it can spit acid from its mouth, catching them off guard.

entry: POKENAME爱展示优雅灵巧的动作。遇到心仪的伴侣，会跳起精心编排的求偶舞。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME loves to show off its graceful and nimble moves. If it encounters a potential mate, it will perform an elaborate courting dance.

entry: POKENAME囤积小块垃圾，尤其喜欢口香糖球和售卖它们的机器。受到威胁时，会把糖球含在嘴里，朝敌人吐射。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME hoard small pieces of trash, favoring gumballs and the machines used to dispense them. If threatened, they gather the gumballs in their mouths and spit them at foes.

entry: POKENAME看似浑身是毛，身体其实由活着的白桦状木材构成，因此外观与触感都很独特。
author: .izik
source: Although POKENAME looks like fur, its body is actually made of living birch-like wood. This gives it a unique texture and appearance.

entry: POKENAME的绒毛摸着极软，有时用作衣料。不过，有些人会因此产生严重过敏反应。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's fluff is very soft to the touch and is sometimes used as a material for clothing. However, it causes strong allergic reactions for some.

entry: POKENAME摸着虽不像，其实有毛。只是分泌物把毛粘在一起，看着反倒像一团黏液。
author: endermagnet
source: Despite what it feels like, POKENAME actually does have fur. However, the substance it secretes sticks its fur together, so it resembles goo instead.

entry: POKENAME刚被收服时常害羞，亲近训练家后就会永远黏在一起。是真的黏——黏液就像胶水！
author: zeeroooo
source: POKENAME is often shy when first caught, but when it bonds with its Trainer it will stick with them forever. Quite literally; its slime is like glue!

entry: 它总爱用粗短的手臂，抱住小宝可梦。聪明的家伙，会爬上POKENAME干燥的壳，躲过这些拥抱。
author: endermagnet
source: It has a habit of hugging smaller Pokémon, using its stubby arms to hold them. Clever Pokémon can hide from these hugs on POKENAME's dry shell.

entry: POKENAME习惯用短臂抱住较小的宝可梦。研究者认为，身上带条纹的壳或许是另一条蜷起的尾巴。
author: endermagnet
source: POKENAME has a habit of hugging smaller Pokémon, using its stubby arms to hold them. Researchers believe the striped shell may be a second, furled tail.

entry: 它总爱用粗短的手臂，抱住小宝可梦。结果，竟有出人意料之多的小家伙，就这样被粘在POKENAME身上。
author: endermagnet
source: It has a habit of hugging smaller Pokémon, using its stubby arms to hold them. A surprising number of these Pokémon get stuck to POKENAME.

entry: 覆在毛上的蜜，能让人恢复活力，含糖少，味道又好。研究人员也记录过，POKENAME与生病的宝可梦，分享蜂蜜。
author: endermagnet
source: The honey coating its fur is rejuvenating, low in sugar and extra tasty. Researchers have documented POKENAME sharing this honey with unwell Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME四肢强健，速度很快，本可造成大量伤害，可天性温顺，通常不会这样做。
author: glacierwing
source: POKENAME's limbs are very strong. It is a fast creature capable of dealing out lots of damage, but it usually won't due to its docile nature.

entry: POKENAME实际身体非常纤细，90%的体积都是蓬松毛发。冬季毛更厚，看着远比实际大。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's actual body is remarkably thin, with 90% of its bulk being fluffy fur. In winter, its coat becomes even thicker, making it look much larger than it is.

entry: POKENAME身手矫健，懂多种格斗方式。可身体摸着像毛绒玩具般柔软，其他宝可梦丝毫不觉得它有威胁。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME are very athletic and know many different fighting styles. Pokémon don't find them at all threatening because a POKENAME's body feels just as soft as a stuffed animal.

entry: POKENAME近来成了幼童大受欢迎的伙伴，主要因为个头小又爱社交。脱落的孢子也能当成长中孩子的营养零食。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME have recently become very popular companions for young children with their small size and social behaviors cited as the main motivation. The spores shed by POKENAME can also act as a nutrious snack for growing children.

entry: POKENAME与背上的真菌共生，把采来的一部分食物分给真菌，保持其健康；真菌则让它在林地上得以伪装。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME has a symbiotic relationship with the fungus it carries upon its back. It provides the fungus with some of the food it gathers to keep it healthy, and the fungus provides camouflage on the forest floor in return.

entry: POKENAME用脱落鳞片铺衬地洞，其他宝可梦若闯入，必会被割得粉碎。
author: 4amhyena
source: POKENAME lines its burrows with its shed scales, making it impossible for other Pokémon to enter without being torn to shreds.

entry: POKENAME的毛需要细心打理，野生个体大多时间都在互相梳毛。能照顾好它的训练家，会得到它满满的亲热。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's fur requires a lot of attention to maintain, so they spend most of their time grooming each other in the wild. They are very affectionate to Trainers who can handle caring for them.

entry: POKENAME好奇心强，发现什么都想熟悉一番。当地动物很受它友善气息的吸引，巴大蝶和狩猎凤蝶尤其如此。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME is a curious creature, eager to familiarize itself with everything it discovers. Local fauna, especially Butterfree and Beautifly, are drawn to its welcoming aura.

entry: POKENAME好奇心强，发现什么都想熟悉一番。当地动物很受它友善气息的吸引，巴大蝶和狩猎凤蝶尤其如此。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME is a curious creature, eager to familiarize itself with everything it discovers. Local fauna, especially Butterfree and Beautifly, are drawn to its welcoming aura.

entry: POKENAME抱着的毛绒玩具用来集中精神力量。休息时若被打扰，就会不分对象地攻击周围。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The plushie that POKENAME carries is used to focus its psychic power. If it is disturbed whilst resting, it will lash out indiscriminately at its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME毛茸茸的上半身能像弹簧般突然弹起，最高达5英尺。它用这诡异的突袭吓住敌人，再发动攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME launches its furry upper body up to five feet in a sudden, spring-like motion. This eerie surprise is used to startle foes before attacking.

entry: POKENAME太美味，人们会把它放进搅拌机，制成大尾立哈啰焙茶拿铁。盛在高杯里，顶上一颗樱桃，便成了口感绵滑、含咖啡因的美食，让训练家与宝可梦劳累一天后仍能保持清醒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are so delicious that they are put into a blender and turned into a Furret Roasted Tea Latte. Served in a tall glass with a cherry on top, POKENAME are a creamy caffeinated treat that helps keep Trainers and Pokémon awake after a long day.

entry: 不停掘地，让POKENAME厚厚的毛纠结贴伏。它会咀嚼地下的灌木根，补充食物。
author: .izik
source: Constant digging mats down POKENAME's thick fur. It supplements its diet by chewing on underground bush roots.

entry: POKENAME掘地时如波浪般不断钻入钻出。留下的凹坑大小恰好，适合栽种花草和其他盆栽植物。
author: pattybgoode
source: As it burrows, POKENAME moves in and out of the ground in a wave-like pattern. The divots it leaves behind are the perfect size to plant flowers and other potted plants.

entry: 雨后土壤松软，适宜挖掘，POKENAME此时最活跃。这种忙碌的日子里，三个头会轮流居中，担任掘进主力。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME is most active after rain, when the soil is loose and prime for digging. On active days like this, each of its three heads takes turns being the central, primary burrower.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的毛似乎会自行活动，常摩擦它的后脑，只会让慢性头痛更加严重。
author: .izik
source: The fur on POKENAME's tail seems to move on its own, frequently rubbing the back of its head. This only worsens its chronic headaches.

entry: POKENAME肌肉高度发达，耐力与体力惊人。曾有观察记录，它追逐小拉达群数天不休息。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME's highly developed muscles grant it incredible endurance and stamina. It has been observed chasing groups of Rattata for days without resting.

entry: POKENAME颇有艺术天赋，从落叶到晾晒的衣物，找到什么都能画上图案。有时会与图图犬比赛作画，觉得赢了就秀肌肉。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are quite artistic, painting designs onto anything from stray leaves to clothes they might find hung out to dry. They sometimes compete against Smeargle in art competitions, flexing if they think they've won.

entry: POKENAME无法在陆地行走，只好用伸缩触手在树间荡行。柔软防水的毛，常被用于现代服装。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME cannot walk on land, so it will use its stretchy tentacles to swing from trees. Its soft fur is waterproof and is often used in modern clothing.

entry: POKENAME来回摇尾，汇聚力量。积蓄足够的精神能量后，便一波波释放出去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wags its tail back and forth to channel its powers. Once it builds up enough psychic energy, POKENAME will unleash it in waves.

entry: POKENAME把大葱当长枪，以惊人力道刺向敌人。攻击威力足以打裂混凝土。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wields its leek like a lance, jabbing at foes with surprising strength. The force of its strikes is powerful enough to crack concrete.

entry: POKENAME一个头好奇地窥探别人的巢，另一个头放哨。若巢比自家漂亮，常会心生嫉妒，试图毁掉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses one head to curiously peek into others' dens while the other head keeps watch. If the den is nicer than its own, it often becomes envious and attempts to destroy it.

entry: 水手认为，见到成群POKENAME在冰山上嬉戏，是前方天气平静的吉兆。防水毛发将热量留在身边，让它们在冰冷水中也能保暖。
author: chibitales
source: Seeing groups of POKENAME playing on icebergs is thought to be a good omen to sailors that the weather ahead will be calm. Their water-repellent fur helps trap heat close to their bodies to keep them warm in the frigid waters.

entry: POKENAME在水下紧闭硬壳，安稳地睡在海底。好不容易撬开壳的人，常因打扰它睡觉而感到内疚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's hard shell stays closed while underwater to allow it a nice restful sleep at the bottom of the ocean. People who manage to force its shell open often feel bad for disturbing its slumber.

entry: 托儿所常能看见POKENAME，陪孩子们消磨时光，一起画画、游戏，还能造出彩虹。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME often are seen at daycares keeping children occupied. It paints, plays, and makes rainbows with them.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME跳过田野与花园，不停寻找能吃的果实、种子，以及小型虫宝可梦。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME hops through fields and gardens at night. It is constantly on the lookout for edible fruits, seeds, or small bug Pokémon.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME轻轻咕咕叫，让同类知道安全无事。叫声若停了，便表示危险在附近。
author: .izik
source: During the night, POKENAME lets out a soft hoot to let others of its kind know it is safe. If the hooting ceases, danger is nearby.

entry: POKENAME捕食其他鸟宝可梦，用其遗骸增强自己。它敏锐地知晓夜晚何时降临，在新一轮狩猎将启时鸣叫，通知同群伙伴。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME prey on other bird Pokémon and use their remains to strengthen themselves. They are keenly aware of when night approaches and emit cries to alert the others of their flock when the time to hunt anew approaches.

entry: 波波、咕咕等小型鸟宝可梦有时住在POKENAME嘴里，献上树果报答庇护。它时间感精准，总能提醒住客何时该狩猎、何时该睡觉。
author: milchik
source: Small bird Pokémon, such as Pidgey and Hoothoot, sometimes live inside POKENAME's mouth; in gratitude for protection, they provide it with berries. Having a perfect sense of time, POKENAME always reminds its residents when it's time to hunt or sleep.

entry: POKENAME夜里会不由自主地咕咕叫，暴露位置给捕食者。它慌忙在树间飞来飞去，盼能找到安全处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hoots involuntarily at night, letting predators know of its location. It frantically flies from tree to tree, hoping to find safety.

entry: POKENAME的触手有节奏地扭动，各自以不同间隔变换位置，同时记录多种自然现象。据说，森林里每种宝可梦何时醒来，它都知道。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's tentacles writhe rhythmically. Each one switches position at different intervals, keeping track of multiple natural events at the same time. It is said that they are aware when every species of Pokémon in a forest awakens.

entry: POKENAME夜间在枝头警戒。发现威胁便俯冲毒伤、扰乱敌人，同时鸣叫示警。还会在树枝间吐丝，缀上石子，奏出有节奏的风铃般旋律。
author: greensnake01
source: POKENAME watch diligently from branches at night. On seeing a threat, they swoop down to poison and confuse the aggressor, hooting to warn forest denizens. They spin string from branches and cover it in rocks, producing a rhythmic chime-like melody.

entry: 经过无数夜晚的练习，POKENAME精通模仿，乐于给别人表演。不过，狩猎还有很多要学。
author: smashbear
source: After many countless nights of practice, POKENAME has mastered mimicry and loves to perform for others. It has a lot to learn about hunting, though.

entry: POKENAME不断制造使中毒者视线模糊的毒液。每天同一时刻，它都会从角上排出多余毒液，抹在家园周围的树叶上。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME constantly creates a poison that causes blurry vision in those afflicted. At the same time every day, it secretes excess poison from its horn, smearing it on the leaves around its home.

entry: POKENAME住在废弃实验室的椽梁间。它会模仿其他咕咕群的外貌，试图求偶。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its home in rafters of abandoned laboratories. It will mimic the appearance of other Hoothoot flocks in an attempt to mate.

entry: 把POKENAME当宠物，既简单又困难。它脾气好、需求少，但每天喂食和玩耍必须严格按时，否则很快就会闹起来。
author: sk372
source: Raising POKENAME as a pet is considered simultaneously simple yet challenging. It has a good demeanor and simple needs, but feeding and play must be kept to a very strict daily schedule, or it will quickly begin acting out.

entry: POKENAME成长期有一身坚韧羽毛护体。白天藏在树中，只有夜晚活动，以避开危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME has a coat of sturdy feathers that protect its body as it develops into its adult form. It hides in trees during the day, only becoming active at night to help it avoid danger.

entry: POKENAME白天睡觉时，羽毛会硬得像石头。多吃树果，能让羽毛更密实坚韧。
author: .izik
source: While sleeping through the day, POKENAME's feathers harden to a stone-like state. A diet rich in berries increases their density and toughness.

entry: POKENAME成长期有一身坚韧羽毛护体。白天藏在树中，只有夜晚活动，以避开危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME has a coat of sturdy feathers that protect its body as it develops into its adult form. It hides in trees during the day, only becoming active at night to help it avoid danger.

entry: POKENAME痴迷各种形状、大小的钟表。若找到特别喜欢的手表之类，就带着瞬间移动离开，盯上好几个小时。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME becomes fascinated by clocks of all shapes and sizes. Should it find a watch or similar object it particularly loves, it will teleport away with it so it can stare at it for hours.

entry: POKENAME每天早晨都准时外出觅食，从不例外。进食时香味更浓，告诉同类哪里有好食物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME goes out foraging at the same time of the morning, without fail. It emits a stronger scent while eating to let others of its kind know where good food sources are located.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时尾巴来回摇动，像钟表滴答作响。做噩梦时，尾巴会飞快旋转，快到能碰倒身边的小物件。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tail wags back and forth while it sleeps, mirroring the ticking of a clock. If it experiences a nightmare, its tail spins so rapidly that it can knock over small objects nearby.

entry: POKENAME十分聪明，能制作基本工具与武器帮助生存。近年来，巢穴越来越像小屋，在科学界引发了争论。
author: thunderflicker
source: This Pokémon is intelligent enough to craft basic tools and weapons to aid in its survival. The nests of POKENAME have come to resemble huts in recent years, sparking debate and controversy amongst the scientific community.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时每小时稍稍转头，始终留意周围。若太早被叫醒，便会懊恼地突然释放念力冲击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's head rotates slightly each hour while it sleeps, always staying aware of its surroundings. If awoken too early, it will let loose a sudden telekinetic blast in frustration.

entry: POKENAME要集中大半注意力协调六只小翅膀，才能直线飞行。作为弥补，它学会了熟练交替变换航线，也有助于躲避捕食者。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: It takes most of a POKENAME's focus to coordinate their six small wings enough to fly in a straight line. To compensate, they have become well-versed in alternating their flight paths, which also helps them avoid predators.

entry: POKENAME精准的时间感让它知道何时最适合开始狩猎。它用网捕住猎物，再裹上细丝，保存起来留待下一餐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's perfect sense of time allows them to determine the optimal moment to begin hunting. They use their webs to ensnare prey, which they wrap in fine silk to preserve them for another meal.

entry: POKENAME日出、日落时睡觉，偏爱正午和午夜活动。特殊的眼睛既能在黑暗也能在白天视物，却适应不了两者交替。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME sleep during sunrise and sunset and prefer to be active during the middle of the day and the middle of the night. They have specialised eyes that let them see both in the dark and the day but cannot handle the transition between the two.

entry: POKENAME白天打盹时冒着细小电火花，偶尔轻轻咕咕叫，十分有节奏。受惊时会不慎放电，然后糊里糊涂地扑翅逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits tiny sparks while napping during the day, occasionally letting out soft, rhythmic hoots. If startled, it discharges an accidental jolt before flapping away in confusion.

entry: POKENAME轻快活泼，满月时会与同类一同踩着节奏起舞。舒缓神秘的歌声能催人入眠。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a spritely Pokémon known for dancing in a rhythm with other POKENAME during the full moon. It can sing a soothing, enigmatic melody that lulls others to sleep.

entry: POKENAME飞得笨拙，小翅膀不适合飞行。它会调整姿态，让橡胶般的头先着地，再凭体内特殊器官辨明方向，弹回空中。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are clumsy fliers, their tiny wings being ill-suited for flight. They angle themselves so that their rubbery head hits the ground first, using a special internal organ to orient themselves as they bounce back into the air.

entry: POKENAME智慧出众，能感知即将发生的危险。这些模糊的未来片段，常能保护自己和训练家免受伤害。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are wise creatures that can sense when danger is about to occur. These hazy glimpses into the future often end up protecting them and their Trainer from getting hurt.

entry: POKENAME蓬松的羽毛储有强烈静电。只碰一下，就能让人昏迷数分钟。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fluffy feathers store intense static electricity. A single touch can render a person unconscious for several minutes.

entry: POKENAME夜视能力极佳，在星空下翱翔时能望见极远处。长长垂下的头羽对光敏感，帮助掌握时间，恰好在黎明前回到巢中。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have fantastic night vision and are able to see across vast distances as they soar under the stars. Their long trailing head feathers are sensitive to light, allowing them to track the passage of time, landing at their nest just before dawn.

entry: POKENAME在商店陈列的钟表旁一动不动，明明就在眼前，却不易被发现。奇怪的是，即使睡着，午夜也会高声咕咕叫。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides in plain sight beside clocks in store displays, standing perfectly still. Strangely, it hoots loudly at midnight, even when asleep.

entry: POKENAME挂在树上，来回摇尾，维持时间感。想让尾巴不停的滴答声停下，唯一办法是让它昏厥。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hang from trees and rock their tail back and forth to maintain their sense of time. The only way to stop the constant ticking of their tail is to cause them to faint.

entry: POKENAME凭敏锐的时间感，尽可能多晒太阳。哪怕晨昏时刻逐渐推移，它也总知道何时该起来沐浴阳光。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME relies on their keen sense of time to maximize the amount of sunlight they get. Despite dawn and dusk slowly shifting over time, they always know when to get up to soak in the sunlight.

entry: POKENAME的头能转360度，无论头或身体转向哪个角度，都能控制飞行路线，让猎物很难逃脱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's head can turn 360 degrees, and it can control its flight path no matter what angle its head or body is turned. This makes it very tricky for prey to avoid being caught by it.

entry: POKENAME生活在寒冷地区的河海交汇处。它能感知细微温差，水温超过10℃便会咕咕叫。以前一年约叫4个月，随着全球变暖，这段时间越来越长。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME live in cold climates, where rivers meet the sea. They sense small differences in temperature, and hoot when water temperatures rise above 10°C. They used to hoot for about 4 months a year, but that has been increasing as the world warms.

entry: POKENAME生活在寒冷地区近海的河口。它能感知细微温差，水温超过10℃便会咕咕叫。以前一年约叫4个月，随着全球变暖，这段时间越来越长。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME live in estuaries in cold climates, near the sea. They sense small differences in temperature, and hoot when water temperatures rise above 10°C. They used to hoot for about 4 months a year, but that has been increasing as the world warms.

entry: 据说POKENAME会为迷途旅人穿过暗林引路。看似帮忙，实际却越领越偏，直到旅人彻底迷失。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME are said to appear before lost travelers, guiding them through dark forests. Though they may seem helpful, they are in fact leading these travellers astray until they are hopelessly lost.

entry: POKENAME虽谨慎，却会远离家中的巢穴游荡，深信凭时间感和方向感，能在晚饭前回家。
author: beandrawsthings
source: Though cautious, POKENAME roam far from their home nests, confident they can use their sense of time and direction to get home before dinner time.

entry: 野生POKENAME结群，凭敏锐的时间感，趁夜色在恰当时机突袭垃圾箱。由于行事缜密，很少有人亲眼见到。
author: theartemis1
source: Using their keen awareness of time, groups of wild POKENAME will raid dumpsters at opportune moments under the cover of night. It is rare to witness this event due to their meticulousness.

entry: 背上时钟般的突起，始终滴答作响。POKENAME每隔十五分钟，准时咕鸣一声。
author: chorb33
source: The clock-like growth on its back is constantly ticking. POKENAME emits cooing sounds at intervals of exactly fifteen minutes.

entry: POKENAME白天待在高高的树梢，太阳开始落下才活动。它力量不算强，却极具攻击性，足以弥补。新手训练家被提醒接近时要小心。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend the daytime high in the treetops, only becoming active as the sun begins to set. They aren't particularly strong but make up for it with aggression. Newer Trainers are advised to be cautious around them.

entry: POKENAME通常深夜活动，无声飞行，不让别人察觉。它喜欢出其不意地吓人，享受对方的恐惧。发丝有节奏地飘动，也能计时。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME are usually active in the dead of night, flying silently to avoid alerting others to their presence. They enjoy catching others off guard this way, savoring their fear. Their strands of hair can keep time with their rhythmic fluttering.

entry: POKENAME计时精确到微秒。传闻有些现代钟表以它为原型设计，但没人知道真假。
author: donutsbg
source: POKENAME measures time to the microsecond. There's a rumor that some modern clocks are based on this Pokémon, but nobody knows if it's true.

entry: POKENAME藏在最爱的零食——枯叶堆中，装成普通松果，常无人察觉。即使识破伪装，也得提防它为自卫而爆炸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME often goes unnoticed, hiding among piles of its favorite snack of dried leaves and pretending to be a simple pine cone. Those that see past the deception must still be wary of it exploding in self-defense.

entry: POKENAME滑翔时展开翅膀，头像节拍器般有节奏地摆动。研究者仍不清楚它为何这样做。
author: .izik
source: While gliding, POKENAME spreads its wings and moves its head rhythmically like a metronome. Researchers remain unsure why it performs this behavior.

entry: POKENAME讲究规矩，喜欢有规律的生活。训练家哪怕晚喂1分钟，也得听它一通数落！
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are fastidious creatures that love having a sense of routine. Trainers can expect an earful if they miss mealtime by even just a minute!

entry: 用来计时的特殊器官让POKENAME十分焦躁，左右脚换着跳，快得眼睛都跟不上。农人会制作电属性宝可梦模样的草人，驱赶成群的它们。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME hops from foot to foot faster than can be tracked due to its agitation from the specialized organs that help it track time. Farmers create straw decoys of Electric-type Pokémon to ward flocks away.

entry: POKENAME游泳时，身体会随时间慢慢转动。看它当前游动的角度，多少能猜出一天中的时刻。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME swims around, it slowly rotates its body over time. One can partially tell the hour of the day by seeing what angle POKENAME is currently swimming at.

entry: POKENAME压力大时，羽毛渗出蜂蜜香的黏液。它会把这黏稠物甩向捕食者，阻止对方靠近。
author: .izik
source: When stressed, POKENAME's feathers exude a honey-scented slime. It flings this sticky substance at predators to deter them.

entry: POKENAME双足走路看似摇晃，平衡感却极佳。在树间移动时，只要细枝承得住重量，它就能沿枝行走，绝不落地。
author: .jerden
source: While it can appear unsteady as it walks around of two feet, POKENAME has exceptional balance. When moving between trees it can walk along thin branches without ever falling to the ground, as long as they are sturdy enough to hold its weight.

entry: 构成POKENAME身体的浓油，在全黑环境中不停颤动。一照到阳光，颤动便完全停止。
author: .izik
source: The thick oil making up POKENAME's body quivers nonstop in complete darkness. The moment it is exposed to sunlight, the quivering stops entirely.

entry: POKENAME的头羽随一天中的时刻抽动变换，日落后最为活跃。宝可梦研究者尚不清楚其作用，主流说法是让它知道何时该狩猎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The head plumage of POKENAME twitch and move depending upon the time of day, becoming most active and mobile once the sun has set. Pokémon researchers are uncertain what the function of this is; the leading theory is it lets them know when to hunt.

entry: 体内时钟精准得惊人，有些训练家，便把POKENAME当作闹钟。
author: melodydelune
source: This Pokémon has an amazing internal clock. Some Trainers use POKENAME as an alarm clock.

entry: POKENAME是配合高效的群猎者。首领制定计划，规定精确的行动时刻，其他成员分秒不差地各司其职，完美拿下猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are quite effective pack hunters. The leader formulates plans to enact at very specific times, and the rest of the group execute their parts at the exact proper times to flawlessly take down prey.

entry: POKENAME视力极佳，连最黑暗的林间夜晚也能看清猎物的动静。每天晚上都分秒不差地同时出巢狩猎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's strong eyesight lets it see the movement of prey even in the darkest of forest evenings. It leaves its den and hunts at the same exact time every night.

entry: POKENAME的鹿角在清晨最坚实强韧。白天渐渐变软、开始“枯萎”，最终挡住视线。夜里睡觉时，又会恢复硬度。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's antlers are most solid and robust early in the morning. As the day passes, they soften and begin to "wilt," until they obscure its vision. They regain their rigidity overnight while POKENAME sleeps.

entry: POKENAME每分钟将双臂稍稍转动一点，慢慢积蓄电力。每天同一时刻，会把这些电力一口气大量释放。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will incrementally rotate their arms every minute, slowly building up electricity. At the same time each day, POKENAME will discharge this electricity in one large burst.

entry: 每隔15分钟，POKENAME会像滴答作响的钟表般来回摇摆。附近若有猎物，便放慢动作，将其催眠制服。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Every 15 minutes, POKENAME sway back and forth like a ticking clock. If prey are nearby, POKENAME will slow down their movements in order to hypnotize them into submission.

entry: 据说经常喝POKENAME的奶能变聪明，因此很抢手。不过，似乎必须在一天中极特定的时刻饮用，才会生效。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME milk is sought after for its supposed ability to increase the intelligence of those who drink it regularly. However, it seems to only work if the milk is drunk at very specific times of day.

entry: 每隔15分钟，POKENAME会像滴答作响的钟表般来回摇摆。附近若没有猎物，便越摆越快，直到剧烈甩动让自己头晕。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Every 15 minutes, POKENAME sway back and forth like a ticking clock. If prey are not nearby, POKENAME will speed up their movements until they are dizzy from whiplash.

entry: 它眼旁的突起能导电。有人声称，在POKENAME身边听过钟表般的滴答声。
author: ichosuzu
source: The protrusions near its eyes conduct electricity. Some have claimed to have heard a clock-like ticking noise around POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME在富有弹性的尾巴上打盹，梦中轻轻咕咕叫，节奏舒缓。身体轻弹，也会哄睡附近的生灵。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dozes atop its springy tail, letting out soft, rhythmic hoots as it dreams. Its gentle bouncing helps lull others nearby to sleep.

entry: 传闻POKENAME的羽毛有神秘力量，因此中世纪曾被大规模猎捕。据说遇见野生个体，会使寿命大为改变，可能延长，也可能缩短。
author: silverscloudy
source: Fabled to have mystical feathers, POKENAME were hunted en masse in the medieval ages. It is said that meeting a wild POKENAME would significantly alter one's lifespan, for better or for worse.

entry: POKENAME头顶长着三片叶状岩质突起，各自能独立活动。它们以不同速度旋转，分别对应时、分、秒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A trio of rocky growths resembling leaves sprout from the top of the heads of POKENAME, each able to be moved independently of the other. They rotate these at different rates that correspond to hours, minutes, and seconds respectively.

entry: POKENAME能记住夜里听见的每一种声音。白天再模仿出来，常把训练家吓一跳。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME can remember each sound it hears at night. When it mimics them during the day, many Trainers feel spooked.

entry: POKENAME随着极其精准的生物钟，按固定节奏左右歪头。可程序有错误，一分心便会停止数秒，逐渐偏离正确时间。
author: anonymous_moose
source: POKENAME tilts its head back and forth in a fixed rhythm along with its highly accurate internal clock. However, due to errors in its programming, it stops counting the seconds while distracted, causing it to drift from the correct time.

entry: POKENAME极其害羞孤僻，每天只短暂离开树干里的家。这时能听见它独自轻唱缓慢的小曲。
author: sk372
source: Incredibly shy and reclusive, POKENAME is only seen outside of its home inside tree trunks for a short time each day. During this time, it can be heard singing a quiet, slow-tempo song to itself.

entry: POKENAME帮助修复师修理旧物，尤其热衷于修老钟。它们自己也充当活时钟，休息开始与结束时都会咕咕叫。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME assist restoration workers with repairs of old items, especially old clocks, which they fix with gusto. They also act as living clocks themselves, hooting whenever break time starts and stops.

entry: POKENAME跳得极高，轻轻一跃就能越过小孩。爪尖有毒，只碰一下也很容易刺激皮肤。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can jump incredibly high, easily able to hop over a small child in a single bound. The tips of its talons are poisonous and can irritate skin easily with just a single touch from them.

entry: POKENAME成群合作，按时把木头啃成可用的尺寸。不遵守严格日程的成员，会被疏远和鄙视。
author: sk372
source: Groups of POKENAME will work together to gnaw wood down to usable sizes in a timely manner. Those that don't adhere to the strict schedule are shunned and scorned.

entry: 古老宅邸里能发现POKENAME，靠它的计时能力，钟表总能走得准。只要楔石靠近钟表，它就持续活动。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found in ancient manors where its timekeeping abilities allow clocks to always read the correct time. So long as its keystone is close to a clock, POKENAME remains active.

entry: POKENAME跳得极高，轻轻一跃就能越过小孩。爪尖有毒，只碰一下也很容易刺激皮肤。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can jump incredibly high, easily able to hop over a small child in a single bound. The tips of its talons are poisonous and can irritate skin easily with just a single touch from them.

entry: POKENAME以精准节奏左右摇摆，像活的节拍器。被打扰时，会用带毒的喙凶猛啄击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sways side to side in perfect rhythm, like a living metronome. If disturbed, it pecks furiously with its venomous beak.

entry: POKENAME体内器官能精确计时，每晚恰睡一小时。生活节奏必须十分规律，否则就会紧张好斗。
author: sontyp
source: POKENAME has an internal organ that allows it to keep perfect track of time. It sleeps exactly one hour every night and needs a very orderly daily rhythm, otherwise it becomes stressed and aggressive.

entry: 雄性POKENAME的耳朵，能自由转动，倾听危险。特殊器官还能感知星球自转，让POKENAME始终报时准确。
author: essie
source: Male POKENAME ears can move freely to listen for danger. A special organ lets POKENAME keep perfect time based on the planet's rotation.

entry: 这只锤状宝可梦多半悬在原地，只随一天中的时刻转动，让手柄像时钟的时针一样指示时间。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This mace Pokémon floats in a mostly stationary position, rotating with the time of day so its handle corresponds to an analog clock's hour hand.

entry: POKENAME一家住在同一棵树里，用锐利门牙啃出树洞。若有捕食者想闯入简朴的家，它们便齐齐背对洞口，朝入侵者亮出毒刺。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME families will nest within a single tree, gnawing out a hollow in the trunk with their sharp incisors. If a predator tries to get into their simple home they all turn their backs to the entrance, presenting their toxic spines to the intruder.

entry: POKENAME目光锐利的红眼能在全黑中看得清清楚楚。大耳朵则探知视野之外的动静。
author: .izik
source: With its piercing red eyes, POKENAME can see flawlessly in total darkness. It uses its large ears to detect movement beyond its line of sight.

entry: POKENAME兼有钟表和指南针的本领，对许多训练家十分有用，既能导航，也能报时。
author: happii6843
source: A combination of a clock and a compass, POKENAME is a very useful Pokémon to many Trainers, using it as a tool for both navigation and telling the time.

entry: POKENAME总先花固定的时间，用安抚气息平息争端，之后才动武制止争吵。盯着它如节拍器般匀速摆动的缎带，会失去时间感。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME always spends the same amount of time calming down a situation using soothing auras before using force to stop the squabble. Anyone who stares at its ribbons while they sway in a stable metronome pattern will lose their sense of time.

entry: POKENAME隔一阵就换姿态，摆出几种古怪造型，每个都保持到下一次变换。据说这些姿势与时间有关，却属于另一个次元。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME shifts its position periodically, striking several obtuse poses it remains in until taking the next one. It is believed these stances have something to do with the time, but in a dimension separate from this one.

entry: POKENAME天生会根据月亮位置感知时间。察觉月亮在头顶，眉羽便迅速抽动；一到满月，立刻跑到外面。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have an innate sense of time based on the position of the moon. Their eyebrow feathers twitch rapidly when they sense the moon overhead, and they run outside as soon as it's a full moon.

entry: 融合增强了咕咕感知时间的能力，如今POKENAME连身边任何人的死亡日期也能察觉，却很少透露。
author: admiralvermin
source: Fusion has enhanced Hoothoot's ability to sense time, and POKENAME can now sense the date of death of anyone around it. It rarely shares this information.

entry: POKENAME痴迷于落地钟的运动，随着钟摆的节奏摇晃。每到整点，便开心鸣叫，羽毛间喷出一小团火。
