author: .izik
source: Entranced by the motion of grandfather clocks, POKENAME sways with the pendulum's rhythm. At the top of each hour, it chirps happily and emits a small burst of flame from its feathers.

entry: POKENAME是夜行宝可梦，据说夜里四处寻找灵魂吞食。许多文化中，人们睡觉时让它陪着，提防会带来噩梦的恶灵。
author: santon5512
source: As nocturnal Pokémon, POKENAME are said to wander at night in search of spirits to consume. Many cultures keep these Pokémon with them while they sleep, having them look out for malicious spirits who may give them nightmares.

entry: POKENAME一生大多安全地待在地下。触角内有器官，能告诉它破土进化的最佳时机。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME spends most of its life safely underground. The antennae contain an organ that tells it the perfect time to emerge and evolve.

entry: POKENAME做梦时，羽毛中产生细小电脉冲。受惊醒来，会本能地放出强力电击，短暂照亮周围。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME generates small electric pulses in its feathers while dreaming. If startled awake, it instinctively releases a powerful shock, briefly illuminating its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME每晚准时唱起摇篮曲。它能哄睡躁动的野生宝可梦，是森林生态中重要的一环。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME begins its lullaby at the same time every night. It's an important part of a forest ecosystem because it lulls restless wild Pokémon to sleep.

entry: 许多人把POKENAME群的叫声误认为横冲直撞的波士可多拉。它们每天都会准时发出响亮的金属尖啸，从不例外。
author: ilazerheart
source: Many people mistake the cries of a flock of POKENAME for rampaging Aggron. They will let out a loud metallic screech every single day, right on time without fail.

entry: POKENAME每天按固定作息入睡、醒来。休息时尾巴的火自行熄灭，醒来便重新燃起。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME falls asleep and wakes up at a set schedule every day. Its tail extinguishes itself when it is resting and reignites as soon as it wakes up.

entry: POKENAME清晨早早醒来，不愿错过一缕阳光。许多训练家都被整群的叫声吵醒过。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME awaken in the early hours of the morning to get every drop of sunlight it can. Many Trainers have been awoken to the sounds of entire flocks of POKENAME.

entry: 人们知道POKENAME有翅膀，夜里用来在空中滑翔。不过，只要有人类看着，它就把翅膀收进身体，尽力装成普通气球。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME is known to have wings, which it uses to glide through the air at night. However, whenever a human is watching, POKENAME tucks its wings into its body and does its best to appear like an ordinary balloon.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时用脚扣住洞壁，蘑菇般的身体在黑暗中泛着微光。轻柔的咕咕声回荡，安抚着附近的宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME secures its foot to cave walls while sleeping, its mushroom-like body glowing faintly in the dark. As it rests, it makes soft, echoing hoots that soothe other Pokémon nearby.

entry: POKENAME发出尖利的超声啼鸣，让敌人迷失方向，再迅速俯冲，使出惊吓。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits piercing supersonic hoots to disorient foes. It follows up with a swift dive and a startling Astonish attack.

entry: POKENAME用下肢带着一个貌似老式木钟的物件。钟的功能并不正常，内部的滴答声却确实每秒响一次。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME carries what appears to be an old-fashioned wooden clock around on its lower limb. The clock lacks proper functionality, but the rhythmic click inside of it truly does go off once every second.

entry: POKENAME爆炸前会快速连叫几声，再小小跳一下。炸过之后，只留下散落的羽毛和灰烬。
author: .izik
source: Just before it explodes, POKENAME lets out a rapid series of hoots and performs a small hop. The blast leaves behind only scattered feathers and ash.

entry: POKENAME的歌声能帮助训练家夜里入睡。效果太好，连自己也经常被唱睡。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME's singing is helpful for making Trainers fall asleep at night. Its singing is so effective that it frequently puts itself to sleep.

entry: 夜幕降临的那一秒，POKENAME总准时走进月光。早晨到来前10分钟，它开始有节奏地咕咕叫，把一只带根的脚扎进土里。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME always emerges into the moonlight at the very second night falls. Ten minutes before morning begins, it begins hooting rhythmically as it plants one rooted foot into the soil.

entry: 节奏感出众，让POKENAME能跳出完美舞步。据说，它的表演可以安抚逝者的灵魂。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its exceptional sense of rhythm allows POKENAME to execute perfect dance steps. It is believed that its performances can calm the souls of the departed.

entry: 醒着时，POKENAME的树干上长出黑羽，靠挥动羽毛计时。据说，这些羽毛能帮孩子找回更年幼时的记忆。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sprout black feathers from their trunk when awake and wave their feathers to keep track of time. These feathers are said to help the children regain memories of when they were younger.

entry: POKENAME的生物钟极其精准。它记住小型夜行宝可梦的作息，提高狩猎效率。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's internal clock is highly precise. It memorizes the schedules of small nocturnal Pokémon to improve its hunting.

entry: POKENAME大多时间待在暗巢里，巢筑在荫蔽树木的高处。旋转器官一察觉最适合蘑菇生长的时机，它就下来搜寻食物。
author: steamedveggies.
source: POKENAME spends most of its time dwelling in the dark nests it builds high up in shady trees. When its rotational organ detects prime mushroom growth times, it descends to begin scavenging.

entry: POKENAME冠脊上的花纹整天像钟表般移动，记录时间。熟练的训练家甚至能教它同时记录两个时区，每侧冠脊各记一个。
author: santon5512
source: The patterns on POKENAME's crests move throughout the day like clocks, keeping track of the time. Skilled trainers can even teach these Pokémon to keep track of two time zones at once, one on each crest.

entry: POKENAME爱与训练家深夜散步，迫不及待地拉着对方沿月光小径前行，尤其喜欢满月外出。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME loves to go on late night walks with its Trainer, dragging them eagerly forward along moonlit paths. They have a particular fondness for going out at the full moon.

entry: POKENAME夜里在密林中吃力地咕咕叫，模仿受伤宝可梦。靠得太近者会被浓密孢子覆盖，整个神经系统都可能麻痹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lets out labored hoots deep in forests at night to mimic an injured Pokémon. Those who draw too close are covered in thick spores that can numb entire nervous systems.

entry: POKENAME严格按时觅食，每个动作都算准时机以避险。若被打断，作息失常带来的压力会严重到让它无法正常活动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME keeps a strict foraging schedule, timing its every move to avoid danger. If disrupted, the break in routine causes it debilitating levels of stress.

entry: POKENAME夜里在路灯附近游荡，从羽毛中释放绿色催眠粉。猎物常还没看见它，就睡着了。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME roams near lampposts at night, releasing green Sleep Powder from its feathers. Its prey rarely sees it before dozing off.

entry: POKENAME控制藤蔓抓牢，倒挂身体。这样便能挥动黑羽，维持精准的时间感。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME control vines to give themselves a secure grip to hang upside down from. This allows them to wave their black feathers, which helps them maintain their perfect sense of time.

entry: POKENAME每天都在分秒不差的同一时刻互相战斗。它单脚站稳，用利爪斩击对手。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME battle each other precisely at the same time every day. It slashes opponents with sharp claws while balancing on one foot.

entry: POKENAME用小翅膀挖掘，速度惊人。受威胁时，会破土而出，立刻飞走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its small wings to dig at remarkable speeds. If threatened, it bursts from the soil and flies away instantly.

entry: 白天，POKENAME在阳光极少、甚至完全照不到的深处休息。体内有不靠视觉也能判断入夜的机制，因此能在日落时浮上水面。
author: afilthycasual
source: During the day, POKENAME rest at depths where little to no sunlight can penetrate. They have internal mechanisms that do not require visual cues to tell them when night falls, allowing them to rise to the surface at sundown.

entry: POKENAME喜欢偷路人的硬币，但观察发现，它严格按时行窃。因此，当地人能帮旅人安排时间，避开被盗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME likes to pilfer coins from passersby, but observation has noted that the attempts at stealing adhere to a strict schedule, allowing locals to help travelers plan their time to avoid being robbed.

entry: POKENAME计时一丝不苟，不肯偏离日常作息。只要发生意外，日程一耽搁，就会头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are fastidious with their timekeeping and refuse to deviate from their daily routine. Whenever something unexpected happens, the delay in their schedule causes them to develop a headache.

entry: POKENAME蹦跳着刺击敌人，可招式重复，容易预测。聪明些的宝可梦很容易智取。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME bounces around jabbing at its foes, but its attacks are fairly repetitive and predictable. Because of this, smarter Pokémon can easily outwit it.

entry: POKENAME总得不停活动，因此很难入睡，时常失眠。越疲倦，它们就越易怒，筋疲力尽时尤其容易打起架来。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have trouble sleeping, often suffering from bouts of insomnia due to their constant need to be on the move. They grow increasingly irritable as they grow more tired, becoming prone to getting into fights when they're exhausted.

entry: POKENAME是难养的宠物，进食、娱乐等都必须严格按日程进行。稍有偏离，往往就会让它感到压力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes for a tricky pet to raise, as it adheres to a strict daily schedule for feeding, recreation and so forth. Any deviation from this schedule tends to cause it stress.

entry: POKENAME狩猎、进食与睡觉都有极严格的作息，每天常精确到分钟。利爪最适合迅速制服猎物。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME hunt, eat, and sleep on an incredibly strict schedule, oftentimes down to the exact minute each day. Their sharp talons are best suited for swiftly taking down prey.

entry: POKENAME双腿笨拙，无法靠奔跑逃敌，因此喜欢涉浅水行动。它凭时间感，在捕食者睡觉时出行，避开危险。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME prefer to wade in shallow water, as their inept legs prevent them from running away. They use their sense of time to avoid predators by traveling when their predators are asleep.

entry: 黑夜里，浅溪中常能见到POKENAME。它用腹部螺旋纹催眠猎物，捕食太靠近岸边的鲤鱼王和虫属性宝可梦。
author: snookerron
source: POKENAME can often be found in shallow streams on dark nights. It hunts Magikarp and Bug-type Pokémon that stray too close to the shore, using the spiral pattern on its belly to hypnotize its prey.

entry: 每过1小时，POKENAME就会不由自主地瞬间移动到当前位置1英里内的某处。因此很难追踪，训练家也很难留住它。
author: santon5512
source: Every hour, POKENAME will involuntarily teleport somewhere within a mile of their current location. This behavior makes these Pokémon both hard to track down and hard for Trainers to keep.

entry: POKENAME会挑战其他宝可梦切磋，动作精准灵巧。不过，据说它耐力不足，因为任何一场交手都不会超过10分钟整。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME challenge other Pokémon to sparring matches, fighting with a high level of precision and dexterity. It is said that they have low stamina however, as no fight lasts longer than exactly ten minutes.

entry: POKENAME每天准时醒来，捕捉水生宝可梦。把耳朵贴在壳上，就能听见维持时间感的内部滴答声。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wake up the same time every day to catch aquatic Pokémon. By pressing an ear to their shell, a person can listen to the internal ticks that maintain a POKENAME's sense of time.

entry: POKENAME常结群狩猎，靠壳内同步的滴答声协调动作。听到首领尖利响亮的鸣叫，整群就一齐向前猛扑。
author: victor9106
source: POKENAME often hunt in packs. The synchronized ticking within their shells helps them coordinate their movements, the pack lunging forward when they hear their leader's shrill, ringing call.

entry: POKENAME带磁性的羽毛会随一天中的时刻，以不同角度伸出。晨昏时，磁力最强。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's magnetic feathers stick out at different angles depending on the time of day. Its magnetism is at its most powerful during dusk and dawn.

entry: POKENAME是导航高手，正常情况下绝不会迷路。体内有数个专司导航的器官，作用如地图、指南针，甚至高度计。探险者使用它，唯一的限制就是体型。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is an expert navigator and can never get lost under normal circumstances, as it possesses several organs that act as dedicated navigational instruments, like a map, compass, and even an altimeter. Only its size limits its use for explorers.

entry: 它每晚严格按时吃梦。若每夜同一时刻都感到睡眠被扰，附近很可能住着POKENAME。
author: sk372
source: It adheres to a strict schedule of nightly dream consumption. If one feels a disturbance in their sleep at the same time every evening, a POKENAME is likely to be residing nearby.

entry: POKENAME弹跳力惊人，夜里轻松来往各处。背上的鳞茎能释放耀眼的粉末，使敌人麻痹。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has incredible jumping power and easily goes from place to place in the night. From the bulb on its back can a dazzling powder that stuns foes be released.

entry: POKENAME靠背上的鳞茎维持时间感。听鳞茎内轻轻的滴答声，就能知道时刻。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on the bulb on their backs to maintain a sense of time. They can determine what time it is by listening to the soft ticking of their bulb.

entry: POKENAME黄昏最活跃，趁夜色渐浓大吃枝叶。其他小型虫属性宝可梦胆敢抢食，就会遭到无情攻击。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is most active during dusk and uses the falling night to devour foliage. It will ruthlessly attack other small Bug-type Pokémon that dare to compete with its meal.

entry: POKENAME夜里大声啜泣，每声哭泣之间夹着低沉的咕咕声。这些声音用来与远处同类沟通。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sobs loudly at night, releasing deep hoots between each cry. These sounds serve as long-distance communication with others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME这种鸟宝可梦结群狩猎，用骨棒敲角交流。猎物全身都不浪费，骨头既当工具，也用来标记领地。
author: infinex21
source: These bird Pokémon hunt in flocks and communicate by striking their horns with their bone clubs. POKENAME never waste any part of their prey and use the bones both as tools and as markers for their territories.

entry: POKENAME是多住沙漠的夜行猎手。尽管爪子强到能凿岩，聪明的它们仍会把猎物遗骸做成武器与工具。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are nocturnal hunters that live mostly in deserts. These clever Pokémon use the remains of their prey as weapons and tools, even though their claws are strong enough to gouge rock.

entry: POKENAME作战有条不紊、精于算计。它闪身避开攻击，同时分析对手动作，锐眼寻找能在反击时利用的破绽。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fights in a way that is methodical and calculating. It dips and weaves away from blows while analyzing a foe's movements, its sharp eyes searching for any sign of weakness it can exploit when it counters.

entry: POKENAME在黑暗中也能轻松视物。施展念力时，眼睛会短暂泛紫光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can see in darkness without much effort. When it uses its psychokinetic abilities, its eyes will glow purple for a short period.

entry: POKENAME双翼映月闪烁，无声滑过夜空。能用迷人花纹催眠、制造幻象，逃离危险。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME glides silently through the night, its wings shimmering under the moonlight. With the ability to hypnotize foes, it uses its mesmerizing patterns to create illusions and escape danger.

entry: POKENAME只有入夜才开始演默剧。这样很难找到观众，可它就是无法更早醒来。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME only begins to mime after night falls. This makes it difficult to find an audience, but POKENAME is incapable of waking itself up any earlier.

entry: POKENAME把自己裹进丝里，挂在枝头随风飘荡。角虽锋利，却常因太重，没法当武器使用。
author: silverscloudy
source: POKENAME hangs from branches while wrapped in its silk to be carried by the wind. Though its horns are sharp, they are often too heavy for it to use as a weapon.

entry: POKENAME十分善良，看见咕咕遇险就会去救，放进背上的巢，用喙喂食。等咕咕准备好了，再让它重返天空。
author: agostostino
source: POKENAME is so kind that, when it sees a Hoothoot in danger, it will go rescue it and puts it in the nest on its back, feeding it with its beak. When the Hoothoot is ready, POKENAME will release it back into the sky.

entry: POKENAME展开翅膀时，胶状身体会颤动。做这个动作时，能变成任何看见的东西，凭多变的身形适应各种状况。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME spreads its wings, its gelatinous body shudders. It can transform into anything it sees while doing this motion, using its versatility to adapt to any situation.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛柔软、温暖舒适，是高档寝具与毯子争相采用的材料。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME's feathers are coveted in high-end bedding and blankets for their softness and comforting warmth.

entry: 想保持守时的训练家，很适合与POKENAME作伴。它的时间感与记忆毫无差错，会在家里每台电子设备上设置闹钟，确保主人不忘约定。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is excellent for Trainers who wish to remain punctual. It has a perfect sense of time and memory, setting an alarm on every electronic in a person's house to make sure they do not forget an appointment.

entry: POKENAME只有头会动，随着秒数流逝来回倾斜。人们猜它是在倒数距离完成进化还剩多少秒，分秒不差。
author: sk372
source: The only part of POKENAME that moves is its head, tilting back and forth with the passing seconds. It's assumed it's counting down the exact number of seconds it will take for it to complete evolution.

entry: POKENAME凭夜间卓越的视力，巡视蜂巢附近的森林。捕食者靠得太近，就用毒针精准刺击，保护领地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its superior eyesight at night to patrol the forest near its hive. Should a predator get too close, it will jab at them with its stingers, protecting its territory with precision.

entry: POKENAME趁夜色寻找卡比兽、圈圈熊等强大宝可梦交战。它把强烈精神能量注入汤匙，挨打者会头痛很久。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Under the cover of night, POKENAME seek out strong Pokémon such as Snorlax and Ursaring to fight. POKENAME imbue their spoon with intense psychic energy, leading to lingering headaches for whoever is struck by it.

entry: POKENAME趁夜色寻找卡比兽、圈圈熊等强大宝可梦交战。它把强烈精神能量注入汤匙，挨打者会头痛很久。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Under the cover of night, POKENAME seek out strong Pokémon such as Snorlax and Ursaring to fight. POKENAME imbue their spoon with intense psychic energy, leading to lingering headaches for whoever is struck by it.

entry: POKENAME藏在谷仓里，等农人离开农场，再飞出来用爪子割倒作物和谷物，随后又躲起来。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME hide inside barns, waiting for farmers to leave their farms. They then fly out, using their talons to slice down their crops and grain before going back into hiding.

entry: POKENAME在日落时开始活动，渐暗的光线触动体内时间感，开启它的一天。它夜视能力差，靠敏感羽毛感知气流，在黑暗中辨路。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME become active at sunset, the dimming light triggering an internal sense of time and encouraging them to begin their day. Their night vision is poor and they rely on their sensitive feathers to feel air currents to navigate in the dark.

entry: POKENAME身形轻巧，风阻极小，能无声而优雅地起飞、转向。无论捕猎还是躲避攻击，都十分高效。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's lithe body makes it highly aerodynamic, able to take off and maneuver through the air silently and gracefully. This makes it very efficient at both hunting and evading attacks.

entry: POKENAME的巢塞满了从所住森林里找来的草药。白天睡觉时轻轻咕咕叫，让家中更添宁静。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's nest is stuffed to the brim with herbs it finds throughout the forest it resides in. It lets out soft hoots while it sleeps through the day, adding to the tranquil atmosphere of its home.

entry: POKENAME年岁越长、智慧越深，精神力量就越强。长胡须在同类间是长寿与受敬重的象征。
author: ilazerheart
source: The older and wiser a POKENAME gets, the more powerful its psychic powers become. The long beard is a symbol of longevity and respect amongst POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME极聪明，经过许多夜的细心观察，精心安排蛛网捕猎。它根据猎物的日常习惯，判断最佳设网处。
author: sk372
source: Highly intelligent, POKENAME captures prey with carefully-planned web placement, borne from many nights of careful observation. It knows the perfect place to set its trap based on its prey's daily habits.

entry: POKENAME结群在夜里追踪猎物，用一连串低吟与嗡鸣交流。嗡鸣像手风琴，有些贵族因此欣赏其音乐才华，将它养作宠物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME form groups to stalk prey at night, using a series of groans and buzzes to communicate. Their buzzes remind people of the sound of an accordion, so some aristocrats keep them as pets for their musical talents.

entry: POKENAME只在夜间狩猎，四翼带来极快速度，很少被人看见。它视力极佳，再密的森林也能穿行，无论多黑，都能轻松发现敌人或食物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME hunts solely at night and is rarely seen due to the speeds it can achieve thanks to its four wings. Its eyesight is so sharp that it can navigate even the thickest of forests and easily spot any foes or food no matter how dark it may be.

entry: POKENAME偏爱在暴风雨之夜飞行，享受强风，考验自己的飞行本领。动荡的天空增强它的力量，使它成为空中劲敌。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers to fly through stormy nights, relishing in the high winds as it tests its flying prowess. The turbulent skies fuel its strength, making it a formidable force in the air.

entry: POKENAME整夜不睡，训练家常很难让它白天保持清醒。它意志坚定，常为了打盹而拒绝战斗。
author: .realthree
source: Because POKENAME stay awake all through the night, Trainers frequently have a hard time keeping them awake during the day. These strong-willed Pokémon often refuse to battle so they can nap instead.

entry: POKENAME看见未来景象时，脑后的羽毛会直立。它轻易就能预见最远20年后的未来，常早早预测事件结果。
author: .izik
source: The feathers behind POKENAME's head stick straight up when it has a vision. It can see up to 20 years in the future with ease, often predicting outcomes of events far ahead of time.

entry: 据说POKENAME定期看见未来，常独自安静沉思。许多人相信，它脑中不断思索着如何继续塑造完美的未来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to receive regular visions of the future, and is often seen in quiet contemplation. Many believe its mind is constantly racing with thoughts on how to continue shaping the perfect future.

entry: POKENAME夜里在高空巡视领地，视野完美无缺。飞行速度足以挑战喷气式飞机和私人飞机。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME soars through the night, patrolling its territory from above with perfect vision. It can reach flight speeds capable of challenging jets and private airplanes.

entry: POKENAME夜里聚群跳舞，观察发现舞姿与头顶星座相应。叶裙散发的芳香可制香水，闻了能保持清醒，深受夜店常客与学生喜欢。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME meet in groups at night to dance, which have been observed to correspond with the constellations overhead. The leaf skirt exudes an aroma used in perfume favored by clubbers and students for its ability to keep those smelling it awake.

entry: POKENAME从头上硬如岩石的羽毛散发墨莓果香，吸引附近的咕咕来筑巢。咕咕的陪伴似乎能安抚它，也让小鸟们有个宁静的家。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lets loose a Bluk Berry scent from the rock-hard feathers on its head to encourage Hoothoot in the area to nest on it. Their presence seems to calm it, creating a serene environment for the birds.

entry: POKENAME夜里贴近水面飞行，寻找猎物。曲折的航线让它能急转弯，动作难以预测，便于抓住目标。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME travels low near the water's surface during the nighttime hours, searching for prey. Its flight pattern is jagged, allowing it to make quick turns and unpredictable movements to catch its targets.

entry: POKENAME住在水下，却捕食陆生生物。小翅膀只能让它飞到离地几米高，难以悄悄接近猎物；不过，全身的凝胶能使附近生物的感官迟钝。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME lives beneath the water, but preys on land-dwelling creatures. Its small wings only allow it to fly a few metres above the ground and make it hard to sneak up on prey, but it is covered in a gel that dulls the senses of anything nearby.

entry: POKENAME夜里巡视领地，喙泛着暗淡黄光。双眼轻易看透浓雾，即使最黑暗的时刻也能敏锐警戒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME patrols its territory at night, its beak glowing a dull yellow as it travels. Its eyes can see through dense fog with ease, allowing it to keep a sharp lookout during the darkest hours.

entry: POKENAME不会说任何人类语言，咕咕声却诡异地像人声。它用这令人不安的声音扰乱旅人的方向，让对方无所适从，再逼入困境。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's hoots sound oddly human-like despite it not knowing how to speak any human language. It does this to disorient travelers and corner them, using the unsettling sounds to keep them off balance.

entry: POKENAME一顿一顿地移动，几乎恰好每秒跳一下或拍一次翅膀。想出其不意偷袭的敌人，会发现它的羽毛具有腐蚀性。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME moves in spurts: it can hop or flap its wings almost exactly once per second. Foes trying to catch it off guard will find that its feathers have corrosive properties.

entry: POKENAME的时间感能精确到秒。可这与背上时钟般的突起究竟有何联系，尚未得到充分研究。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME has a sense of timing to the second. The connection between this and the clock-like growth on its back has not yet been adequately studied.

entry: POKENAME用尖喙利爪在树干内掏巢，白天藏身其中。夜里以极响亮的尖叫互相呼应。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their sharp beak and claws to burrow out nests inside of tree trunks, sheltering within them during the day. At night they call out to one another with incredibly loud screeches.

entry: POKENAME夜里翻垃圾箱，用喙寻找残羹。每隔片刻，就把头完全转到背后，提防捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rummages through dumpsters at night, using its beak to dig for scraps. It turns its head fully around every few moments to watch for predators.

entry: POKENAME展开翅膀时释放精神波。飞累了便用念力平稳降下，双脚优雅着地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lets loose psychic waves when it spreads its wings. If it ever gets tired of flying, it will lower itself to the ground steadily with telekinesis, gracefully landing on its feet.

entry: POKENAME飞行中一受惊就立刻爆炸。因此会避开雷雨飞行，免得雷声令它惊慌，提前引爆。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME gets startled while flying, it will immediately explode. As such, it avoids flying during thunderstorms, as the thunder distresses it, triggering a premature detonation.

entry: POKENAME掘土时，把羽毛紧贴身体。若发现根菜就毫不犹豫地吃掉，品味地下收获的泥土风味。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME pulls its feathers close to its body while digging through the soil. Should it find root vegetables, it will eat them without hesitation, savoring the earthy flavors of its underground finds.

entry: 许多野生POKENAME已证明自己是最出色的夜间捕食者。迅捷、精准、无声、从不失手，都是人们最常用来形容它们的词。
author: k1n1t0.xo
source: Many wild POKENAME have proven to be the best nocturnal predators. Swift, precise, quiet, and unfailing are some of the most used adjectives to describe POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME用尖喙利爪在树干内掏巢，白天藏身其中。夜里以极响亮的尖叫互相呼应。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their sharp beak and claws to burrow out nests inside of tree trunks, sheltering within them during the day. At night they call out to one another with incredibly loud screeches.

entry: POKENAME用尖喙利爪在树干内掏巢，白天藏身其中。夜里以极响亮的尖叫互相呼应。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their sharp beak and claws to burrow out nests inside of tree trunks, sheltering within them during the day. At night they call out to one another with incredibly loud screeches.

entry: POKENAME用尖喙利爪在树干内掏巢，白天藏身其中。夜里以极响亮的尖叫互相呼应。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their sharp beak and claws to burrow out nests inside of tree trunks, sheltering within them during the day. At night they call out to one another with incredibly loud screeches.

entry: POKENAME群夜里穿梭森林，会合力包围独角虫等猎物，确保无路可逃，再俯冲捕获。
author: .izik
source: Flocks of POKENAME dart through forests at night. They will gang up on prey like Weedle, surrounding it to ensure there is no escape before diving in for the capture.

entry: POKENAME夜里用双爪抓住猎物，再以喙啄击。白天则爬上树，在枝头栖息。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME hunts prey at night, grabbing it with both claws and then pecking at it with its beak. It climbs up into trees to roost on branches during the day.

entry: POKENAME背上的壳能当钟表使用。不过往往走得不准，似乎按其他地区的时间运转。
author: bigoljax
source: The shell on POKENAME's back works as a functioning clock. However, these clocks are usually inaccurate, and seem to work on times based in other regions.

entry: POKENAME用长脖子追着受惊猎物探进地洞。它在暮光时更活跃，许多登山者都曾在昏暗中瞥见骷髅形的胸羽，吓了一跳。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME uses its long neck to pursue startled prey into their burrows. It is more active in twilight hours, so many hikers have been startled when glimpsing the skull-shaped chest plumage in the low light.

entry: POKENAME是夜间猎手，既可独猎，也可群猎。嚎叫时精神会集中起来，可能开始施展各种独特罕见的狩猎策略。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is a nighttime predator that may either hunt independently or in a group. When it howls, POKENAME's concertation blossoms, and it may begin using a variety of unique and uncommon hunting strategies.

entry: POKENAME智慧很高，制定的狩猎计划很少失败。咕咕声有明显的人工音色，据观察会干扰附近科技设备的计时功能。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's high intelligence helps it formulate hunting plans that rarely fail. Its hooting cry has a distinctly artificial tone to it, and has been noted to disrupt the time-keeping function of technology in its vicinity.

entry: POKENAME从高崖跃下，展开翅膀滑翔，用鹿角的超能力稳定动作。角中的精神能量让它在空中精准掌控方向。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME jumps from high cliffs and glides with its wings, using its antler's psychic abilities to stabilize its movements. The psychic energy from its antlers allows it to navigate through the air with precision.

entry: POKENAME每天至少需挤奶一次，否则会重得无法起飞。夜里若有人接近它所住的农场，就会毫不犹豫地将其赶走。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME must be milked at least once a day, or it becomes too heavy to take flight. If anyone approaches the farm where it lives during the night, it drives them off without hesitation.

entry: POKENAME把生病或受伤的咕咕放进身上柔软的袋中照料。危险靠近时，会向前蜷身，护住袋子。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME cares for sick or injured Hoothoot in the soft pouch on its body. If danger approaches, it curls its body forward to shield the pouch.

entry: POKENAME用附近的小树筑巢，夜里守望。它用两条尾巴向捕食者掷球果，凭敏捷身手保卫家园。
author: .izik
source: After building its nest with nearby saplings, POKENAME keeps watch during the night hours. It will pelt predators with Apricorns thrown from its two tails, using its agility to defend its home.

entry: POKENAME只在最黑暗的夜里狩猎，带着黑暗鸦与咕咕组成的帮伙。它指挥严酷，用精神力攻击管束每个手下。
author: ilazerheart
source: POKENAME hunts only on the darkest of nights with gangs of Murkrow and Hoothoot alike. It commands them ruthlessly, keeping each of its goons in line with a psychic attack.

entry: POKENAME把奇异力量注入头上硬如石头的羽毛，使敌人入睡。对方睡着后，它便迅速逃离，让敌人浑然不觉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME channels an odd power through the stone-hard feathers on its head that can make a foe fall asleep. Once they slumber, it flees quickly, leaving the opponent unaware of its departure.

entry: POKENAME虽然是出色的猎手，模仿训练家时却常摔倒。两条腿走路对它很困难。
author: smashbear
source: POKENAME may be an excellent hunter, but it often falls over while trying to impersonate its Trainer. Walking on two legs is difficult for it.

entry: POKENAME会捡起其他宝可梦的蛋，悉心孵育直到即将破壳。多数宝可梦都容许它留在巢边，照看后代。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME will pick up and incubate the eggs of other Pokémon and nurture them until they're ready to hatch. Most Pokémon will allow them to hang around their nesting sites to look after their young.

entry: 雷雨时，POKENAME把尾巴插进地里接地，展开双翼，仿佛挑战闪电来劈。体内储存的电荷会大大增强大脑活力。
author: ilazerheart
source: In thunderstorms, POKENAME ground their tail in the ground and spread their wings, daring lightning to hit them. The electrical charges stored in their body supercharge their brains.

entry: POKENAME在寒冷黑暗的夜晚最活跃。它们结群，借夜色掩护俯冲捕食。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are most active on cold, dark nights. They hunt in groups, swooping down to catch prey while hidden under the cover of darkness.

entry: POKENAME虽不会飞，却喜欢藏在树上。可惜身体太重，枝条常被压落。
author: themicelegion
source: Although POKENAME doesn't have the ability to fly, it loves to hide in trees. The problem is that it is too heavy for the branches, causing them to fall.

entry: POKENAME战斗时边舞边旋身转圈，用双翼维持平衡。优美动作既能迷惑敌人，也让战斗风格更显优雅。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs pirouettes and twirls while dancing during combat, using its wings to keep balance. The graceful movements not only confuse foes but also add an elegant flair to its battle style.

entry: POKENAME聪慧善良，夜里守护林中迷路者。它用精神力量悄悄击退想捕猎他们的生物，许多受护者甚至不知道自己为何平安通过。
author: sk372
source: Intelligent and kind, POKENAME watches over those lost in the forest at night. It silently repels those who would hunt them with psychic powers, and many are unaware their safe passage was due to POKENAME's protection.

entry: 人们普遍相信，这种POKENAME曾在很久以前遭到诅咒。没人知道它为何只有一条手臂，不过，少了这条手臂，似乎并没有妨碍它的生活。
author: cinnamoone_redfield
source: This variety of POKENAME is widely believed to have been cursed once upon a time. Nobody knows why it has only one arm, but it does not seem to be held back by its lack of said appendage.

entry: POKENAME不动翅膀，便能无声翱翔夜空。民间传说，它引渡善人前往来世时，角状光环会格外明亮。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME silently soars through the night sky without moving its wings. Folklore says that its horn halo glows particularly bright when ferrying a good person to the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME始终高度警惕，提防一切可能威胁巢穴的事物。消化系统十分强韧，有毒植物与树果也能吃。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is always on high alert, keeping a lookout for anything that could threaten its nest. It has a very resilient digestive system, allowing it to consume poisonous plants and berries.

entry: POKENAME飞行时能搬运最重100磅的原木，用来筑坝。它既展现高超建筑本领，也借此维护家园环境。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can carry logs of up to 100 lbs while flying. It uses these logs to build dams, contributing to its impressive construction skills and the maintenance of its home environment.

entry: POKENAME能附身附近所有钟表，强行校准并同步。依靠它计时的科学家会养上一批小拉达，确保它吃得饱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can possess and synchronize all clocks in a nearby area, forcing them to read the correct time. Scientists who rely on their timekeeping abilities keep a stash of Rattata so POKENAME can remain well-fed.

entry: POKENAME越老，背上的藤蔓就越长越粗。自古以来，人类便欣赏它睿智的外貌；有些文化相信，最初正是它教会了人类看时间。
author: milchik
source: The older POKENAME is, the longer and thicker the vine on its back gets. This Pokémon was admired by humans since ancient times for its wise look, and some cultures believe that it was POKENAME who originally taught people to tell time.

entry: POKENAME喙中积蓄强毒，守卫家园时便会释放。巢里装饰着从附近森林采来的花。
author: .izik
source: A strong venom accumulates in POKENAME's beak, which will be dispensed if it has to defend its home. Its nest is decorated with flowers it gathers from around the nearby forest.

entry: POKENAME的大黄羽能在黑暗中变色，夜猎时便不会惊动猎物。它优先盯上迷路而绝望的目标。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's large yellow feathers can alter their color in darkness so it does not alert prey while it hunts during the night. It first targets prey that are lost and in despair.

entry: 压力大时，POKENAME的羽毛会渗出浓稠的褐色毒液。虽然相对无害，气味却恶臭，用来驱赶领地里的威胁。
author: .izik
source: A thick brown poison comes off POKENAME's feathers when it is stressed. The poison smells awful, despite being relatively harmless, and is used to ward off threats in its territory.

entry: POKENAME头上的角与喙由相同材料构成。角中充满腐蚀性毒液，最远可喷到20英尺外，造成严重刺激与伤害。
author: .izik
source: The horn coming out of POKENAME's head is made of the same material that forms its beak. It is filled with a corrosive poison that POKENAME can spray out at distances of up to 20 feet, causing severe irritation and damage.

entry: POKENAME臂端长出的厚羽极其锋利，能刺穿钢铁。战斗时沿螺旋路线飞行，凭敏捷与锐羽压制敌人。
author: .izik
source: The thick feathers that grow from the end of POKENAME's arm are extremely sharp and able to pierce steel. It flies in spiral patterns when fighting, using its agility and sharp feathers to overwhelm its opponents.

entry: POKENAME视听敏锐，陆空行动都迅捷，是无与伦比的猎手。尾巴上的喙有舌状器官，只需轻碰，就能释放惊人的电量。
author: sk372
source: With powerful eyesight, hearing, and quick speed on the ground and in the air, POKENAME is an unparalleled hunter. The beak on its tail possesses a tongue-like organ that can discharge incredible amounts of electricity with just a tap.

entry: POKENAME守望林木茂密的山区，将栖息者视为自己的子民。它智慧很高，喜欢和平共处，领地内若有宝可梦过分好斗，就会毫不犹豫地驱逐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME watches over heavily forested mountain areas, treating the inhabitants as its subjects. It is highly intelligent and prefers peaceful coexistence, not hesitating to cast out Pokémon that pick too many fights in its domain.

entry: 钟表匠靠POKENAME帮忙校时。从落地钟到手表，它都能确保显示正确时间。
author: quackquackattack
source: Clockmakers rely on POKENAME to help adjust clocks to the correct time. From grandfather clocks to watches, POKENAME ensure that the correct time is displayed.

entry: 索罗亚克与猫头夜鹰的可怕融合体，以凶猛好斗的捕食者闻名，绝不可轻视。名声并非空穴来风，因为它们极力护幼。
author: elfail0
source: This intimidating fusion of Zoroark and Noctowl has a fierce reputation as a ferocious and aggressive predator which should not be taken lightly. There is some truth to this as they are very protective of their young.

entry: 神奥各地用POKENAME头上缎带般的羽毛制作围巾。虽不以保暖著称，却因美观时髦而备受珍视。
author: .izik
source: The ribbon-like feathers on POKENAME's head are used in scarves across Sinnoh. While they are not known to keep wearers warm, they are highly valued for their beauty and fashionable appeal.

entry: POKENAME尾巴有力，头角带毒，视力也极好。别看体型庞大，动作却敏捷得惊人。
author: essie
source: POKENAME have powerful tails, venomous horns, and superb vision. Despite their bulk, POKENAME are surprisingly agile.

entry: 这只融合体虽不是超能力属性，却颇有精神力量的天分。有人推测，它体内深处藏着某种诡异力量。
author: jaycielantern
source: Despite not being a Psychic type, this fusion shows an aptitude for psionic abilities. Some theorize some eldritch power lies deep within it.

entry: 战斗中，POKENAME用巨耳护身，综合各种因素，计算最佳行动。计划一成，便跳出遮护，用强力踢击反攻。
author: sk372
source: In battle, POKENAME shields its body with its massive ears, contemplating multiple battle factors to calculate the best course of action. Once it's formulated a plan, it leaps out of its shielding and fights back with powerful kicks.

entry: POKENAME夜里无声飞过森林与市区，以尖利歌声和同类交流。隐秘的身影、毫不眨动的红眼，加上歌声，让许多人认为它是不祥之兆。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME soars through forests and urban areas at night in complete silence. It unleashes a shrill song to communicate with others, which alongside its stealth and unblinking, red eyes has led to many believing it is a bad omen.

entry: POKENAME用响亮的布谷钟机关吓路人。接着钟面指针疯狂旋转，钟声敲响，让人更加摸不着头脑。
author: ilazerheart
source: POKENAME uses its loud cuckoo-clock mechanism to startle passersby. Then, the hands on its clock face begin spinning wildly and its chimes toll, adding on to the confusion.

entry: POKENAME夜里仰望天空，双眼特别适应黑暗。它记住星星的位置，借此导航，长途旅行。
author: santon5512
source: At night, POKENAME stare up at the sky, their eyes specially adapted to seeing in the dark. These Pokémon memorize the locations of the stars, using them to navigate and travel across long distances.

entry: 都市传说称，午夜钟响时，听全POKENAME的12声鸣叫就会丧命。它的心跳与体内钟摆的节奏同步。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is an urban legend that when the clock strikes midnight, anyone who hears all twelve chirps from POKENAME will perish. Its heartbeat syncs with the rhythm of the pendulum inside its body.

entry: 都市传说称，午夜钟响时，听全POKENAME的12声鸣叫就会丧命。它的心跳与体内钟摆的节奏同步。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is an urban legend that when the clock strikes midnight, anyone who hears all twelve chirps from POKENAME will perish. Its heartbeat syncs with the rhythm of the pendulum inside its body.

entry: POKENAME每天咳出6次火球，飘到头顶，炸成一片火花雨。这似乎只是娱乐，可没人知道为何次数从不改变。
author: sk372
source: Six times a day, POKENAME will cough up a fireball that floats above it and bursts into a shower of sparks. It appears to be merely recreation, though none are sure why it never deviates from that exact number.

entry: POKENAME休息时，有时会把内脏排到体外，摆成钟表指针的样子。指针位置总与当前时间完全吻合。
author: sk372
source: Sometimes while at rest, POKENAME will expel its innards out of its body in a way that mimics the hands of a clock. The positions the hands take is always a perfect match for the current time.

entry: 训练家睡觉时，POKENAME整夜清醒，吸走所有噩梦。存下的负面能量用来发动让敌人恐惧的攻击。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME will stay awake all night while its Trainer sleeps, absorbing any of their nightmares. This stored negative energy is used to create attacks that terrify its opponents.

entry: POKENAME在黑暗中静观目标，分析最佳出击时机。它把余烬撒在逃跑猎物前方，逼其掉头，往往正好冲进等候的利爪。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME quietly observes its target in the darkness, analyzing the best time to strike. It spreads embers in front of fleeing prey, sending them scurrying the opposite direction, often right into its waiting talons.

entry: 翅膀的构造让POKENAME穿行暗林时几乎无声。它用猛烈的火焰旋涡困住毫无戒心的猎物，再俯冲给予最后一击。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME makes little noise as it flies through dark forests thanks to the structure of its wings. It traps unaware prey in a vicious Fire Spin before diving in to finish them.

entry: 战斗中，POKENAME的羽毛电流噼啪作响。愤怒时，火花失控，阵阵电力足以电击敌人，使其暂时麻痹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feathers crackle with electricity during combat. When angry, they spark uncontrollably, releasing bursts of power that can shock foes and leave them temporarily stunned.

entry: POKENAME总知道当前时刻，靠体内时间感，每晚准时唱摇篮曲。没有它，野生宝可梦就很难入睡。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME always knows what time it is and relies on its internal sense of time to sing lullabies at the same time every night. Without POKENAME, wild Pokémon find it difficult to fall asleep.

entry: POKENAME虽小，却凶悍得惊人，体形大数倍的对手也不退让。潜行也极出色，能无声穿过最密的枝叶追踪猎物。
author: elfail0
source: Despite its small size, POKENAME are surprisingly ferocious and will not shy away from opponents many times their size. They are astonishingly stealthy as well, able to stalk prey through even the thickest foliage in silence.

entry: POKENAME羽毛身体周围形成的黄色胶质极黏。这种甜黏液常被咖啡馆加入燕麦粥或饼干，是当地甜点的抢手原料。
author: .izik
source: The yellow goo formed around POKENAME's feathery body is incredibly sticky. This sweet slime is frequently used in oatmeal or biscuits at cafes, making it a sought-after ingredient for local treats.

entry: POKENAME用强壮的喙钻开洞顶筑巢，凭毅力造出安全的家，避开下方洞穴中游荡的危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its strong beak to drill into a cave ceiling to make a den. Its persistence allows it to create a secure home, protected from the dangers that roam the caves below.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛摸着极烫，接触会造成三度烧伤。靠近它或与它近身战斗都很危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feathers are very hot to the touch. They can cause third-degree burns if touched, making it a dangerous creature to approach or engage in close combat.

entry: POKENAME只在夜里狩猎，太阳一升起便躲回洞中。大喙善于破开坚硬的坚果与树果，一口就能吞下。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hunts exclusively at night, hiding away in its cave once the sun rises. Its large beak is great at breaking through tough nuts and berries, allowing it to devour them in a single bite.

entry: POKENAME的红宝石眼睛泛起不祥光芒，敌人便陷入催眠术。成功制住后，它就凶狠地用爪子抓击。
author: mepp.
source: When POKENAME's ruby eyes glow ominously, enemies fall under its Hypnosis. Once successfully immobilized, POKENAME claws at them with vicious intent.

entry: POKENAME安静而精于计算，大多时间沉思。覆壳的身体攻击力不足，却能完美算出防御与闪避动作，极难击倒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a quiet and calculating Pokémon, spending much of its time deep in thought. It shell-covered body is lacking in offensive capability, but it perfectly calculates defensive and evasive maneuvers, making it very difficult to take down.

entry: POKENAME自首次融合以来，身体就让研究者费解。组成身体的木质状材料，带有毒性。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME's body has baffled researchers since they were first fused. The wood-like material that composes their body is toxic.

entry: POKENAME身体庞大，十分笨拙，常跌跌撞撞，飞着又会撞上窗户。
author: ohok3441
source: Thanks to their large bodies, POKENAME are clumsy. They have a tendency to stumble around and fly into windows.

entry: POKENAME轻摇叶片，散发浓烈的芭亚果香吸引猎物。好奇的生灵被天然香气引来，再被它迅疾飞捕。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's leaves wobble slightly to let loose a strong Iapapa Berry scent, using this to attract prey. This natural aroma lures in curious creatures which it captures with its swift flight.

entry: 傍晚能见到POKENAME缓慢摇摆起舞，之后才起飞狩猎。据说，它在与祖灵沟通，祖先会帮助随后寻找猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can be seen doing its slow and swaying dance in the evening, before it takes off in flight to hunt. It's believed it is communing with the spirit of its ancestors, who aid it in its subsequent search for prey.

entry: POKENAME附身的任何树桩，都会长出羽毛般的叶片。叶味极苦，脱落后，胆敢啃咬的生物都会久久难忘。
author: .izik
source: Feather-like leaves grow from any tree stump POKENAME possesses. The leaves have a very bitter taste, and when they fall, they leave behind a lasting impression on any creature that dares to nibble them.

entry: POKENAME身体立得僵直，眼睛却四处转动，清楚掌握周围。一有狩猎机会，便精准出动，猎物就这样无声消失在森林里。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME stands perfectly rigid, its eyes dart around, taking in its surroundings with perfect clarity. Once it sees the opportunity to hunt, it moves with calculated perfection, its prey disappearing from the forest in total silence.

entry: POKENAME精通夜猎，是森林中的顶级捕食者。起飞、飞行都毫无声响，猎物察觉它靠近时，已经太晚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a master of the nighttime hunt and an apex predator of the forest. It takes off and flies without making a sound, its prey completely unaware of its approach until it is too late.

entry: POKENAME是夜行宝可梦，无月之夜最活跃，靠夜视能力寻找任何猎物。它先用超声波制住目标，再俯冲而下。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are nocturnal Pokémon who are most active on moonless nights, where their night vision allows them to find any prey. They neutralize their targets with ultrasonic waves before descending upon them.

entry: POKENAME能一连数周完全不动，警惕地观察周围。一发现猎物，动作便快得让对方来不及反应。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be completely stationary for up to weeks at a time, keeping a watchful eye on its surroundings. If it does spot its prey, it moves so fast that its prey doesn't have time to react.

entry: POKENAME把头倒过来，查看蘑菇是否健康。白天躲在树顶附近的叶片下，吸收那里的枝条养分。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME flips its head upside-down in order to peer at its mushrooms and make sure that they're healthy. During the day, it hides under tree leaves near the top and absorbs the nutrients from the branches there.

entry: 古传说视POKENAME为月夜的不祥之兆，预示厄运与恶意。其实它对人类没什么兴趣，连训练家也常被冷淡以待。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Ancient legends speak of POKENAME as bad omens, harbingers of misfortune and malice on moonlit nights. In truth, POKENAME have little interest in people and are often aloof and disinterested, even toward their Trainers.

entry: 月亮升起，POKENAME展开双翼，示意狩猎开始。群体从黑暗中发出幽深的叫声回应。
author: .izik
source: As the moon rises, POKENAME signals the start of the hunt by spreading its wings wide. Its flock answers with haunting cries in the dark.

entry: POKENAME白天爬树休息，傍晚才醒。夜间散布的真菌孢子能催眠，也可泡成治疗失眠的茶。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME climbs up into trees to rest during the day, only waking up again in the evening. The fungal spores it scatters at night induce sleep and can be brewed into tea as a treatment for insomnia.

entry: POKENAME周身羽毛般的叶片常被用来染衣。浓郁色泽与质地适合制作鲜艳耐久的染料，在手工艺市场很受欢迎。
author: .izik
source: The feather-like leaves covering POKENAME's body are commonly used in dyeing clothing. Their rich color and texture are prized for making vibrant and durable dyes, popular in artisan markets.

entry: POKENAME夜行，追着亮光走，很容易迷路。尽管如此，黎明前总能回巢。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are nocturnal creatures that follow bright lights, easily getting lost. Despite this, they always manage to return to their nest by dawn.

entry: POKENAME时间感精准得不可思议，还能预见未来，判断攻击或闪避的最佳瞬间。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME has an uncanny sense of time and can see into the future. It can determine the exact right moment to attack or dodge.

entry: POKENAME羽毛的光能使人入睡，带来悲伤的梦。柔光先哄受害者安然睡去，随后便陷入忧郁的梦境。
author: .izik
source: The glow from POKENAME's feathers can put a person to sleep, bringing with it sad dreams. Its soft glow lulls its victims into a peaceful slumber before they're consumed by melancholy visions.

entry: POKENAME薄如纸的翅膀让飞行全然无声，能趁猎物不备捕获。古人在战时曾把它当作秘密信使。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's paper-thin wings allow for it to fly through the air in complete silence, allowing it to catch prey off-guard. Ancient people used to use POKENAME as a covert messenger during war times.

entry: POKENAME夜里栖在南瓜地，凭卓越视力提防偷作物的宝可梦。它用翅膀攻击驱赶入侵者，尽心尽力地守着瓜田。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME perches in pumpkin patches at night, using its superior eyesight to watch for Pokémon that try to steal the crop. Its Wing Attack is used to fend off intruders, defending its patch with fierce dedication.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛有浓郁巧克力风味，因此大受欢迎。许多训练家融合猫头夜鹰与胖甜妮，只为解一解巧克力馋。
author: hophoppip
source: The rich chocolate-like flavor of POKENAME's plumage makes it a popular fusion. Many Trainers have been known to fuse a Noctowl and Slurpuff just to satisfy a chocolate craving.

entry: POKENAME只在日落后掘地，白天睡觉。黎明时，先仔细梳掉羽毛里的泥土，再休息。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME only digs after sunset and sleeps during the day. At dawn, it carefully grooms dirt from its feathers before resting again.

entry: POKENAME能用念力分毫不差地同步钟表，却常忘了自己有这能力，看到劳动成果时还大吃一惊。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can use their telekinesis to synchronize clocks without any mistakes. They often forget that they have this ability and are quite shocked when they see the results of their labor.

entry: POKENAME冷静机敏，远远观察训练家。若对方满足了它随心订下的要求，便会现身，允许收服。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are calm and tactful creatures that observe Trainers from a distance. If the Trainer they observe meets their arbitrary requirements, they reveal themselves and allow capture.

entry: 与咕怪不同，POKENAME十分聪明，能轻松避敌。不过，它对猎物也可能极其残暴，绝不可小看。
author: ayutac
source: Unlike Hootkey, POKENAME is very intelligent and can easily avoid foes. However, it can also be very brutal with its prey. It should not be underestimated.

entry: POKENAME许多方面像摔角鹰人，却更聪明些，脾气也更喜怒无常。适应性强，容易学会格斗与飞行属性攻击。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME are similar to Hawlucha in many ways, but are a bit smarter and more temperamental. They are adaptable and can learn Fighting and Flying-type attacks easily.

entry: POKENAME先把头转180度，再从喙中喷火。这是交战者判断闪避时机的明显信号，因为它的火息极其危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME tilts its head 180 degrees before unleashing flames from its beak. This is a telltale sign for combatants to know when to evade, as its fiery breath can be extremely dangerous.

entry: POKENAME忠诚聪明，是备受追捧的伙伴。接近时仍需谨慎，它只允许选中的人类骑在背上飞行。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME is highly sought after as a companion due to its loyalty and intelligence. Approach with caution, as it will only allow select humans to fly on its back.

entry: POKENAME在黑暗中飞行觅食。受惊时会朝威胁的方向攻击，有时烧毁整片森林。它独自生活，很少结群。
author: fwexzsdvvfz
source: POKENAME flies around in the dark searching for prey. If startled, it will attack in the direction of the threat, sometimes burning down entire forests. It lives a solitary life and is rarely found in groups.

entry: POKENAME的智慧在河畔村落远近闻名。它观察咕蝌蚪失败的狩猎，确保自己不重蹈覆辙。
author: snookerron
source: POKENAME's wisdom is well known throughout riverside villages. It observes the failed hunts of Hootwag to ensure it does not repeat its mistakes.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在小池塘边筑巢，用腹部螺旋纹催眠猎物，吃到饱为止。新巢周围一旦供不上它暴食的需求，就迁往下一个池塘。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME have a tendency to make nests next to small ponds, using the spiral on their belly to hypnotize prey and feasting until they are full. Once their new nest can no longer satisfy their binge-eating habits, they move on to another pond.

entry: POKENAME展开翅膀时释放精神波，使敌人混乱，便于后续攻击，也能趁机迅速脱身。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME exerts psychic waves when it extends its wings. This can cause a foe to become confused, making them vulnerable to follow-up attacks or a quick escape.

entry: 养老院会请POKENAME引导老人深夜散步，同时为多人端送餐盘。有过不堪往事的人说，与它对视会心生恐惧。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are employed at retirement homes to help guide the elderly in late night walks and bring dishes to multiple people at once. Those with troubled pasts have reported a sense of dread when they make eye contact with POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的胃占身体大部分，能整只吞下小宝可梦。它夜里狩猎，猎物还未察觉它在，就已被发现并吞下。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's stomach makes up most of its body, allowing it to swallow small Pokémon whole. It hunts during the night, spotting and swallowing their prey before they even know it was there.

entry: POKENAME时间感敏锐，彼此行动能同步到毫秒。训练家若在它面前迟到，就会被毒刺扎中；迟到多久，便麻痹多久。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME have a keen sense of timing, allowing them to synchronize with each other down to the exact millisecond. If a Trainer is ever late in front of their POKENAME, it will jab them with a toxin that will stun them for as long as they were late.

entry: POKENAME把捡来的石头存进树干高处的家。锐眼发现下方跑过的猎物，便用强壮石臂掷石，把目标砸昏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gathers stones to keep within its home in the upper parts of tree trunks. Once its keen eyes spot prey running below, it uses its strong stone arms to hurl the rocks and knock out its target.

entry: 观察发现，POKENAME持棍的角度随时刻不同而变。不论何时、何种姿势，都能精密计算，精准挥动武器。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been observed holding its stick at different angles depending on the hour. No matter the time and position, it is always capable of wielding its weapon with calculated precision.

entry: POKENAME腰间斑驳的岩石开始转动时，敌人便头晕目眩，觉得脚下世界也在颤抖。它只对树果，或已足够虚弱、晕乱的敌人下手。
author: bobosmith01
source: When the speckled rocks on POKENAME's midsection begin to turn, foes begin to feel dizzy and as if the world beneath them was trembling. POKENAME only goes after Berries or foes that are properly weak and disoriented.

entry: POKENAME羽毛上的油能导致极度疲乏。它借此让猎物入睡，再吃掉梦境，使对方虚弱而迷乱。
author: .izik
source: An oil that coats POKENAME's feathers can cause extreme exhaustion and fatigue. It uses this to make its prey fall asleep before feeding on their dreams, leaving them weakened and disoriented.

entry: 它把阳光转成毒液，存进背上的种子。毒性很强，可POKENAME太胆小，不敢在战斗中用。
author: megashit100000
source: It converts sunlight into a poisonous fluid and stores it inside the seed on its back. The poison is very potent, but POKENAME is too timid to use it in battle.

entry: 太阳一露出地平线，POKENAME就醒了。起来后立刻吃树叶，直到肚子饱饱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME awakens the moment the sun hits the horizon. Once up, it immediately begins eating leaves until its belly is full.

entry: POKENAME眼睛不眨，始终警戒周围的潜在危险。爆炸后会在地面留下星形凹痕。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's unblinking eyes are always on the lookout for potential dangers around it. It leaves star-shaped indentations in the ground after it explodes.

entry: POKENAME蜂拥到花田，用骨棒敲打花朵。突然的动静让花粉扬散空中，完成授粉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swarm flower fields to smack flowers with their boney clubs. This sudden burst of movement forces pollen to spread throughout the air, pollinating the flowers.

entry: POKENAME靠能伸长的腿飞快跑走，避免争斗。被逼到绝境时，便紧闭双眼，六肢乱挥，盼这番看似武艺高强的架势能吓退捕食者。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: POKENAME avoids conflict by skittering away on its extensible legs. If cornered, it squeezes its eyes shut and flails with all six limbs, hoping to intimidate predators with the apparent display of martial prowess.

entry: POKENAME看见日出就吹起口哨。阳光似乎滋养着身体，让它开心地来回摇摆。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lets out a whistle when it spots a sunrise. The sunlight seems to nourish its body, causing it to sway back and forth with delight.

entry: POKENAME用藤蔓般的长臂抓花瓣吃，不必离开花田里扎根的地方。一天大多时间都在吸收土壤养分。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its long vine-like arms to grab and eat petals, avoiding movement from its ingrained spot in the flower field. It spends most of its day absorbing nutrients from the soil.

entry: POKENAME常被视为害兽，数量庞大，挤满河湖，把藻类与水草吃得精光，让其他宝可梦无食可吃。
author: mellowmuse
source: POKENAME are often seen as a pest. They flood rivers and lakes with their extensive numbers, feeding on the algae and plant life till there is nothing left for other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME从罂粟色的翅膀释放信息素，召来成群芭瓢虫，再带领大家采集花蜜或树果。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release pheromones from their poppy-colored wings to gather groups of Ledyba into one area. Once gathered, POKENAME lead the group to gather nectar or berries.

entry: POKENAME两把刀锋般的镰刀能吓退多数宝可梦。不过，它性情温和，只有遇险才会使用。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's two razor-sharp scythes scare off most Pokémon. However, it has a gentle nature and only uses them when in danger.

entry: POKENAME用手在海底奔跑，每迈一步便将身体向前撑出，移动迅速。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME moves quickly on the ocean floor by running on their hands, pushing themselves off every step.

entry: POKENAME用头上的角戳开树皮，吸食里面的树液。进食时轻轻哼鸣，吸引其他虫宝可梦一起用餐。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME uses the horn on its head to poke holes in tree bark and sip the sap inside. It hums softly while feeding, attracting other bug Pokémon to join the meal.

entry: POKENAME在网站间漫游，吃带有花朵的图片。吃完20张，便在桌面上安静待着，藏到文件后面。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME roams websites consuming images that feature flowers. After devouring 20, it settles quietly on a desktop, concealed behind files.

entry: POKENAME的拳头平时紧收茧边，需要时能短短伸出，阻吓捕食者。触角敏感，视力强，随时提防周围靠近的东西。
author: sk372
source: Normally kept tucked close to its cocoon, POKENAME can extend its fists short distances in order to deter predators. Its sensitive antennae and strong eyesight let it remain wary of anything approaching its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME总在半醒与刚入睡的状态间游移。受到惊吓，会从体内排出恶臭液体。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is constantly drifting between being partially conscious and being in the early stages of a typical sleep cycle. When frightened, it emits a foul-smelling fluid from its body.

entry: POKENAME经常蜕皮。研究者推测，留下的皮上那些黑点图案，是指引其他同类聚集的路标。
author: foolish_weasel
source: It will shed its skin often. Researchers hypothesize that the black-dotted patterns left behind on its skin are directions for other POKENAME to gather with each other.

entry: POKENAME大群同住，彼此相处融洽。不过，落单或受威胁时，就会变得暴躁固执。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME live together en masse, and among one another are quite agreeable. However, if alone or if threatened, POKENAME turn violent and stubborn.

entry: POKENAME十分害羞，喜欢和其他芭瓢虫待在一起。芭瓢虫也欢迎它，因为它的精神力量很有助于守巢。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME is very shy and prefers being in the company of other Ledyba. The other Ledyba appreciate its presence, as its psychic powers are really helpful in protecting their nest.

entry: 阿柏蛇靠近时，POKENAME用神秘守护保护巢穴，还会与兄弟姐妹配合飞行，分散袭击者的注意。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME protects its nest with Safeguard when Ekans draws near. It flies in coordination with its siblings to distract attackers.

entry: POKENAME在山丘顶上放哨。发现捕食者，就鸣叫通知伙伴，同时用反射壁阻挡敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME keeps watch from the tops of hills. If it spots a predator, it will cry out for its allies while using Reflect to keep the enemy at bay.

entry: POKENAME清晨栖在电话杆上，朝初升太阳咕咕叫。据说，有节奏的叫声能安抚附近宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME perches on telephone poles in the early morning to hoot at the rising sun. Its rhythmic cries are said to calm nearby Pokémon.

entry: 融合过程出现错误，让POKENAME的肢体远多于未融合的个体。多出的手臂使它爬得飞快，战斗时却很难妥善控制。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Errors during the fusion process that produces POKENAME result in them having significantly more limbs than their unfused counterparts. They use these extra arms to scuttle quickly, but they struggle to properly control them for combat.

entry: POKENAME织的网，形似星辰。每只POKENAME的网，还有独属于自己的气味。
author: gotfyr
source: POKENAME spin webs that take the appearance of stars. Each web has a unique scent tied to each individual POKENAME.

entry: 野外难得看见POKENAME。它们的网由许多星形图案组成，会在繁星满天的夜晚，微微发亮。
author: gotfyr
source: POKENAME are a rare site in the wild. Their webs consist of a multiple star shaped patterns that glow under a starry night sky.

entry: 这种长着蓝色角的POKENAME更加罕见。据传，在同类中，蓝角个体享有最高的地位。
author: gotfyr
source: These blue horned variants of POKENAME are an even rarer find. It is rumored that those with blue horns have the most authority over other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME电击捕食者，争取逃跑机会。长长的附肢日后还能再生，因此不介意为了脱身丢掉一两条。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shock predators to give themselves an opportunity to escape. Their long appendages also regrow over time, so they are not worried about losing a limb or two to ensure escape.

entry: POKENAME能产生危险电力，可外貌可爱、性情友善，其他宝可梦不会攻击。连讨厌虫的人也不把它当害虫，收服后常视为家人。
author: lutrax
source: POKENAME generates dangerous electricity. Due to its cute appearance and friendly nature, other Pokémon do not attack it, and even humans who dislike bugs do not consider this creature a pest. Once captured, it is often considered a family member.

entry: POKENAME不开心就不停嗡嗡叫。声音又惹得附近幼年宝可梦不安，最后嗡鸣与哭声响成一片。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lets out an incessant buzz whenever it gets upset. This buzz upsets other baby Pokémon in the area, creating a cacophony of buzzes and crying.

entry: POKENAME时刻与大群同类待在一起。寒冷季节，它们挤在一起取暖；温暖季节，则清早集合，随后一同飞行。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME stick together in large groups at all times. For example, they huddle together for warmth during the cold season, and they all get together in the early hours of the morning to eventually fly with one another during the warm season.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴上的手抓树果，手部小突起能增强抓握力。一抓牢，就带着新得的甜食嗡嗡飞走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME grab onto berries with the hand on their tail, which has tiny bumps to improve their grip. Once they latch onto a berry, they buzz away with a new sweet treat in hand.

entry: POKENAME吸走根系养分，还吃花，园丁视它为害虫。它行动快、繁殖迅速，泛滥后很难清除。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are considered pests by gardeners because they siphon nutrients away from root systems and eat flowers. Removing a POKENAME infestation is difficult because they are quite fast and reproduce rapidly.

entry: 大群POKENAME住在充满水的丘状建筑中。它们互相爬过身体传递信息，速度惊人，从深深地下传到地面只需几秒。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Hordes of POKENAME live in mound-like structures that are full of water. They crawl over each other to pass on information, which is surprisingly rapid, with messages being sent from deep underground to those at the surface in a few seconds.

entry: POKENAME清晨最活跃，白天大多时间晒太阳。不同群体的性情和等级结构，差异极大。
author: bobosmith01
source: Most physically active during the early morning hours, POKENAME spends most of its day basking in sunlight. Personalities and social hierarchy varies dramatically between each group of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME用多条手臂拳打花圃，使花瓣飞散，再用尖牙一口口接住吃掉，像在玩游戏。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME punches flowerbeds with its many arms to scatter petals. It then snaps at the petals with its fangs to eat them, as if playing a game.

entry: 夜里独处时，POKENAME会发出轻柔的哀鸣，仿佛葬礼上悲悼的人。清晨，它会先坐在阳光下暖身，再去休息。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: At night, when this Pokémon is alone, POKENAME will let out soft cries akin to the sound of a person in mourning at a funeral. During the early morning hours, POKENAME will sit in the rays of the sun to warm up before resting.

entry: POKENAME生活在温暖气候中，吃草与小型虫属性宝可梦。性情难以捉摸，可能突然攻击身边的生物。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME lives in warmer climates, feasting off grass and small Bug-type Pokémon. It has an unpredictable personality and can unexpectedly attack those nearby.

entry: POKENAME吃太多花瓣，身体就会不稳定。哪怕轻轻一碰，也可能突然爆炸。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME consumes too many flower petals, its body becomes unstable. Even a light tap can trigger an abrupt explosion.

entry: POKENAME一直藏在土里，直到太阳挂在地平线上的最后几分钟才现身，寒意更浓时又退回。每只身上的斑点与条纹都独一无二。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME lives burrowed under the dirt until the last few minutes of the sun being on the horizon, and then retreats as the cold settles in deeper. Each POKENAME has a unique pattern of spots and stripes.

entry: POKENAME的叫声喧闹刺耳，让农人心惊。它们成群扫过农场，把沿路的一切都吃掉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a cacophonous cry that instills fear in farmers. Groups of POKENAME sweep over farms, eating anything in their path.

entry: POKENAME爱蜂蜜，为了多吃不惜一切。它们会与同类合谋，蜂拥袭击蜂巢，偷走蜜脾。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love honey and will do anything to get more. They are known to collude with other POKENAME to swarm hives and steal honeycombs.

entry: POKENAME讨厌与同类分开，因此会分泌带气味的信息素，让伙伴闻着地面便能追踪。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME hates being apart from others of its own kind. Therefore, POKENAME will secrete scented pheromones that other POKENAME can track by sniffing the ground.

entry: POKENAME群能在水下快速同行。虽个头极小，海洋队仍看重它们靠数量压倒对手的本领。
author: comfortablybrum
source: Schools of POKENAME are able to travel together very quickly underwater. Despite their minuscule size, Team Aqua values POKENAME for their ability to overwhelm opponents with sheer numbers.

entry: 雄性POKENAME一边高速振翅，一边嚎叫，向伴侣展示自己。叫得越响，吸引伴侣的机会越大。
author: .izik
source: Male POKENAME beat their wings rapidly while howling to impress mates. The louder the howl, the greater their chance of attracting a partner.

entry: POKENAME聚在阳光明媚的草地，盘成紧紧的圆环一起晒太阳。鲜艳花纹很显眼，却少有捕食者敢接近整群。
author: vracken
source: Groups of POKENAME gather in sunny meadows, where they bask together in tightly coiled rings. Their colourful markings make them easy to spot, but few predators dare approach a swarm.

entry: POKENAME的鼻子对甜香特别敏锐。找来的树果和蘑菇都很美味，只是甜得几乎发腻。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's trunk possesses a sense of smell strongly attuned to sweet aromas. The berries and mushrooms it finds and forages are delectable, if almost sickeningly sweet in taste.

entry: 聚居地外缘有时能见到POKENAME，在田野农地觅食。它生性胆怯，一见训练家或敌意的宝可梦就容易逃跑。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can sometimes be seen on the outskirts of settlements, feeding in fields and farmland. It is skittish and prone to fleeing at the first sight of Trainers or hostile Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME多条手臂能更精细地控制画笔。它画的图案常以星星为主要主题。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's multiple arms allow it a controlled and more intricate touch to its brushstrokes when painting. Stars are often a major theme in the drawings it creates.

entry: POKENAME在丛林捕猎能整只吞下的小型虫属性宝可梦。遇到更大的威胁，就闪动颈部展开处的眼纹，鼓起身体，试图吓退对方。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hunt through jungles for smaller Bug-Type Pokémon that they can swallow whole. When confronted with a threat that's larger than them, they flash the eyes on their hood and puff up to try and scare the danger away.

entry: POKENAME性情平和，乐于独处，却给想猎捕或挤奶的来者准备了意外：看似乳房的地方，其实是6只可伸长的拳头，随时痛打不识趣的打扰者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is rather placid and happy to keep to itself, but holds a surprise for anybody approaching to hunt or milk it: what appear to be udders are six extendable fists ready to pummel anything making the mistake of bothering it.

entry: 冬天，POKENAME在海边洞穴深处冬眠，拍翅让暖气流通。可爱外表与温和性情令它在网上大红，每年春天都有数千人聚来看它出洞。
author: santon5512
source: During winter, POKENAME hibernate deep within seaside caves, beating their wings to circulate warm air. Due to their cute appearance and gentle demeanor, they have become very popular online, with thousands gathering each spring to watch them emerge.

entry: 只有天空刚亮、太阳尚未完全升出地平线时，才能在野外找到POKENAME。被发现后，它会发出凄厉尖叫，很快便胆怯起来。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is only found in the wild just as light starts to fill the sky, but before the sun is fully over the horizon. It lets out baneful, high-pitched screeches if discovered and quickly becomes timid.

entry: POKENAME五只一组，突袭乡间无人看管、没有防护的垃圾箱觅食。在神奥地区，它们很喜欢甜甜蜜树。
author: bobosmith01
source: As a group of five, POKENAME raid unprotected and unwatched wastebins in rural areas to gather food. In the Sinnoh region, they adore Honey Trees.

entry: POKENAME白天钻进沙里避暑。它痴迷人造光，夜里凡是发光的东西，周围常有好几只围着。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: During the day, POKENAME bury themselves in the sand to escape the heat. They are fascinated by artificial light, and anything that glows at night will often have several POKENAME surrounding it.

entry: POKENAME从短小白翼分泌热油，给羽毛防水。与它作伴的训练家常用软刷，将油抹到头羽上，偶尔会被轻微烫伤。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME secretes a heated oil from its stubby white wings that waterproofs its feathers. Trainers who partner with it often use soft brushes to spread the oil across the feathers on its head, occasionally suffering minor burns in the process.

entry: POKENAME合作开挖宽大隧道，彼此保持足够距离，免得玫瑰红的背刺勾在一起。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME create large tunnels by working in unison with other POKENAME. They space themselves with enough space so that their rose-red spines don't interlock.

entry: POKENAME背上多数刺都能轻易取下，深色刺却不行，随意碰弄会让它十分烦躁。有人认为，那些刺直接连着高度敏感的神经。
author: sk372
source: Though most of the spines on POKENAME's back are removable without issue, the dark spines are not, and POKENAME will become quite agitated if they are tampered with. Some believe they are directly attached to highly sensitive nerves.

entry: 头鳍虽能感知周围，POKENAME仍十分谨慎。只有信任的宝可梦陪着，才肯走到开阔地。
author: .jerden
source: Although the fin on its head enables it to sense its surroundings, POKENAME is very cautious. It will only head out into the open if accompanied by other Pokémon it trusts.

entry: POKENAME挖出复杂的地下隧道网，提供凉爽、潮湿又安全的休息处。冬天会邀请其他宝可梦进来，免得里面太冷。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME excavate an elaborate underground tunnel network to provide them with a cool, damp, and safe place to rest. It will invite in other Pokémon to prevent it from getting too cold in winter.

entry: POKENAME受快乐与喜悦吸引，会成群飞向心情积极的人。平时却害羞难寻，躲在灌木或洞里，避开人和其他宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swarm to people with a positive disposition, lured in by happiness and joy. They are otherwise elusive and shy, hiding from people and other Pokémon in bushes or caves.

entry: POKENAME落单时胆怯，喜欢小群行动。曾有群体晃进城镇，啃咬木制地基磨牙。
author: quackquackattack
source: They prefer to travel in small colonies, as they are timid when in isolation. They have been incidents where colonies of POKENAME saunter into towns and chew on wooden foundations to sharpen their teeth.

entry: POKENAME十分亲人，谁夸它斑点花纹独特，就会高兴地跳过去蹭蹭。可是体重惊人，常把倒霉的赞美者撞倒在地。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: It is very affectionate. If anyone compliments POKENAME's unique pattern of spots, it bounds over and nuzzles them happily. However, its immense weight often knocks the unfortunate admirer to the ground.

entry: 清晨，能见到POKENAME漫游林地，啃食沾着晨露的叶子。手臂短粗，不适合作战，因此它们靠挥尾扫击迎敌。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be seen roaming across the forest floor during the early morning, feeding on leaves that are coated in the morning dew. Their arms are stubby and ill-suited to battle, meaning they rely on swipes with their tail to fight.

entry: 古代文化曾尊POKENAME为花束之神，在野生个体面前献花，祈求丰收。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME was worshipped as a god of posies in ancient cultures. Floral offerings were placed before wild individuals in hopes of abundant harvests.

entry: 春天，数百万POKENAME向北迁徙，排成直线，缓缓蹒跚数百英里。一旦离群，就会极度焦虑，找最近的藏身处躲到来年春天。
author: santon5512
source: During the spring, millions of POKENAME migrate north, slowly hobbling forward in a straight line for hundreds of miles. If separated from the group, they become incredibly anxious, finding the nearest place to hide until next spring.

entry: POKENAME尾尖分泌令人安心的气味，用来与其他生物沟通。缎带般的附肢能部分控制香气流动的方向。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME secrete soothing scents from the tips of their tails. These Pokémon use these scents to communicate with others; by utilizing their ribbon-like appendages, they can partly influence how this scent flows.

entry: POKENAME把花粉吸进炮筒，转成能量。射出的光束几乎打中什么表面，都能让花朵长出来。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sucks pollen into its cannon to convert into energy. The beams it fires cause flowers to grow on almost any surface they hit.

entry: POKENAME天生胆怯，不结群求安全，就哪里也不肯去。通常夜里出行，借月亮导航。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Timid by nature, POKENAME refuse to travel anywhere unless they are in a group for safety. Typically, groups of POKENAME travel by night, using the moon to navigate.

entry: 大群POKENAME喜欢聚在洞顶。从下面经过要小心：它们极易受惊，会朝任何自认的威胁连射尖刺。
author: bee4082
source: Large colonies of POKENAME like to cluster together on cave roofs. Be careful when passing underneath, as these Pokémon are very skittish and will fire waves of spines at any perceived threat.

entry: POKENAME清晨在林中小群寻找落地树果，用火焰烹熟找到的食物。发现特别丰饶的一片，就会兴奋地尖叫。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found foraging for fallen berries in the early morning in forests, cooking any food they find with their flames. They search for their food in small groups, yipping excitedly when a particularly large patch is found.

entry: 它整天睡在森林里的高草中。有些传说称，叫醒它会让人倒霉9代！
author: skleegamer
source: This Pokémon spends its days sleeping in the tall grass inside forests. Some myths say if you wake it, it causes bad luck for nine generations!

entry: POKENAME平时气焰嚣张，一遭反抗就吓得尖叫逃走。它靠翻滚积蓄静电，再以阵阵亮光吸引同类。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME acts with immense bravado until it gets stood up to, upon which it timidly flees screeching in fear. It rolls around to build up static electricity so it can use bursts of light to attract others of its kind.

entry: 有风时能见到POKENAME飘在树梢上，用极长的手臂采树果。风一停，就在树里休息，等再次起风。
author: mistymagius
source: On windy days, POKENAME can be seen drifting just above the treetops, collecting berries with its extra-long arms. Once the wind dies down, it will stop to rest in the trees until the wind picks up again.

entry: POKENAME喜欢湿热环境，以释放气味和同类交流。不同气味各有含义。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME prefers hot and humid environments. It can communicate with other POKENAME by emitting a scent. Each kind of scent means something different.

entry: 吃花瓣时若受惊，POKENAME就会浑身起火。火焰很少伤到自己，却会烧焦附近植物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME bursts into flames if startled while eating petals off flowers. The fire rarely harms it but scorches nearby plants.

entry: POKENAME斗篷下另藏一对手臂，紧贴身体保暖。只有需要抵抗大型威胁时，才会把它们伸出来。
author: sk372
source: Underneath POKENAME's cloak lies an additional pair of arms, kept close to its body for additional warmth. It only lets its extra arms out when it needs to fight off larger threats.

entry: POKENAME在郁金香田下使出扎根，融入地下根系。休息时，身体因花朵能量而泛起微光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses Ingrain beneath tulip fields, merging with the underground root systems. Its body glows faintly with floral energy while resting.

entry: POKENAME悠然飞过向日葵田，落下从花苞里摘取种子，带回巢中，留到傍晚吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flutters carelessly over sunflower fields, descending to pluck seeds from the buds. It will bring them back to its nest for eating during the evening hours.

entry: 太阳刚开始暖地、晨露尚未蒸发时，POKENAME最活跃，特别爱吃水分充足的水果。它隐居害羞的性情，掩盖了强大的力量。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are most active just as the sun begins warming the area and before the morning dew begins to evaporate. They particularly love moist fruits. Their reclusive and shy nature belies their substantial power.

entry: POKENAME在绿草如茵、山丘起伏的地方漫无目的地翻滚。平时似乎无害，可一遇到穿山王等类似宝可梦，就莫名变得好斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rolls aimlessly around grassy, green zones with plenty of hills. It seems generally harmless, but strangely turns aggressive when in the presence of Sandslash and other similar Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME头上的花一直卷着，直到遇到另一只同类。嬉戏交流间，花朵舒展成美丽大花，把带催眠作用的香甜花粉洒向旁观者。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME keep the flower on their head curled up until they meet another POKENAME. They playfully communicate, which causes the flower to transform into a wide, beautiful bloom, showering onlookers with sweet-smelling pollen that causes drowsiness.

entry: POKENAME用强壮手臂按住想在它的花田里进食的宝可梦。一擒住，就使出强力虫鸣。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME holds down Pokémon that try to eat from its flower fields with its strong arms. Once grappled, it unleashes a powerful Bug Buzz.

entry: POKENAME主要吃草甸里的薰衣草，在花圃间跳着觅食。受扰时会放出一大团紫色孢子，使人神志迷乱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME mainly consumes lavender in meadow fields, hopping between flower beds to feed. If disturbed, it releases a large puff of purple spores that can cause delirium.

entry: POKENAME常独自旅行，谨慎又易受惊。不过，在难得一见的群体中，却会显露严酷凶暴的性情。
author: char_latte3412
source: POKENAME often travels alone, cautious and easily startled. However, amidst rarely-seen packs, it reveals a harsh, brutal demeanor.

entry: 冷时，POKENAME会找芭瓢虫群挤在一起取暖。背上蘑菇的孢子因此沾到它们的壳上，等暖和后飞走，便四处传播。
author: .jerden
source: In cold weather, POKENAME will seek out groups of Ledyba and huddle together with them for warmth. This transfers spores from the mushroom on its back onto their shells, which will be scattered after they fly away in warmer weather.

entry: POKENAME最大的威胁是汽车亮灯的诱惑，反倒不是捕食者。许多环保团体提议降低限速，减少人类与宝可梦受到的伤害。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's biggest threat isn't a predator, but the allure of bright lights from cars. Many environmental groups have proposed limiting speed limits to minimize harm to both people and Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME住在温暖森林，成群生活，围攻更大的对手。它们能靠舌上的唾液交流。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME stay in warm forests where they stay in groups and swarm bigger opponents. They can communicate with saliva from their tongues.

entry: POKENAME轻轻飘过草地，躯干阵阵发光，向潜在伴侣发出求偶信号。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats gently over meadows, releasing bursts of light from its torso. These glows serve as courtship signals to potential mates.

entry: POKENAME悠然浮在池面，吃睡莲花瓣。谁靠得太近，就使出超级吸取。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats peacefully on the surface of ponds while eating lily petals. It uses Mega Drain if anyone gets too close.

entry: 吃花根时若被打扰，POKENAME会破土而出，使出音速拳。力道强到能把铁壳蛹打飞。
author: .izik
source: If disturbed while feeding on flower roots, POKENAME bursts from the soil and strikes with Mach Punch. The force is strong enough to send a Kakuna flying.

entry: POKENAME身体的石质部分由黑曜石构成，黑底红斑。头上石块的斑点图案完美，深受宝石收藏家欣赏。
author: hophoppip
source: The stony parts of POKENAME's body are made of obsidian, both black and spotted red. Gemstone collectors appreciate the perfect spot pattern on the stone on POKENAME's head.

entry: POKENAME快速出拳，偷走食品摊贩的硬币，再用光墙隐去身形，逃得无影无踪。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME steals coins from food vendors with quick jabs. It uses Light Screen to vanish from sight and escape without a trace.

entry: POKENAME平时冷淡疏离，周围发生什么都不在意。一见训练家，却会兴奋振翅、开心长叫，冲来蹭脸。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are normally aloof Pokémon that are unfazed by events going on around them. When they see their trainer,  their wings buzz with excitement as they give a happy yowl, rushing over to rub their cheek against them.

entry: POKENAME冬天挤成紧紧的圆圈。天气越冷，头痛越重，有时甚至引发小型精神力风暴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME huddle in tight circles during winter. The colder it gets, the more intense their headaches become - sometimes creating small psychic storms.

entry: POKENAME常被小看，因此格外好斗。力量虽不足，四臂轮番出拳，仍能痛打对手，逐渐将其耗垮。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are highly aggressive due to frequently being underestimated. Despite their lack of strength, they can wallop foes by cycling their punches with their four arms, eventually wearing their opponents down.

entry: 训练家报告，春天见过池水一片红。这可能是POKENAME的繁殖期现象，数十只同时从水下的蛋孵化。
author: afilthycasual
source: Trainers report seeing ponds of red water during the spring. This phenomenon may be explained by POKENAME spawning periods, when dozens hatch at the same time from submerged eggs.

entry: POKENAME训练时的汗闻着像樱子果，吸引同类前来，一起锻炼。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME secretes sweat that smells like Cheri Berries during training. This scent draws in others of its kind to form group workouts.

entry: POKENAME藤蔓般的身体极苦，多数捕食者因此不愿下手。战斗时四肢到处扭动。每只颜色都稍有不同，乍看察觉不出。
author: bobosmith01
source: The vine-like body of POKENAME tastes extremely bitter, which causes most predators to avoid targeting it. It wriggles its limbs all around in combat. Each POKENAME has a slightly different color that is imperceptible on first glance.

entry: POKENAME吃池中水草，用壳兜住空气，便能水下呼吸。壳上黑斑的数量与位置，让宝可梦研究者辨明它来自哪里。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feed on pond weed, using their shells to capture air so that they can breathe underwater. Their shells are patterned with black spots, the number and position of the spots enabling Pokémon researchers to identify where they're from.

entry: 静看POKENAME已成了人们常推荐给压力大、焦虑者的活动。看它幸福的表情，闻带香味的体液，会使多数人的血清素反应增强。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME staring has become a commonly recommended practice for people with high stress and anxiety. Looking at their blissful expression and smelling their aromatic fluids invoke an increased serotonin response in most humans.

entry: POKENAME吃池中水草，用壳兜住空气，便能水下呼吸。壳上黑斑的数量与位置，让宝可梦研究者辨明它来自哪里。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feed on pond weed, using their shells to capture air so that they can breathe underwater. Their shells are patterned with black spots, the number and position of the spots enabling Pokémon researchers to identify where they're from.

entry: POKENAME飞行、游泳时用毛茸茸的耳朵保持平衡。攻击所用的芳香水常被拿来制香水。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME uses its furry ears to balance itself while flying and swimming. The aromatic water it uses in its attacks is often used in perfumes.

entry: POKENAME只有睡着时才会飞。在空中闲晃几分钟，一醒就落回地面。
author: illuminatedphantom
source: The only time POKENAME is found flying is when they're asleep. POKENAME loaf around in the air for a few minutes before returning to the ground once they wake up.

entry: POKENAME飞行、游泳时用毛茸茸的耳朵保持平衡。攻击所用的芳香水常被拿来制香水。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME uses its furry ears to balance itself while flying and swimming. The aromatic water it uses in its attacks is often used in perfumes.

entry: 它靠眼睛分泌的芳香液体交流。健康又快乐的POKENAME，甚至会被液体整个包裹。
author: apixelperfectionist
source: It communicates using the aromatic fluid it secretes from its eyes. A happy and healthy POKENAME will be fully encompassed by this fluid.

entry: POKENAME振翅交流，让森林各处响起嗡鸣。身体不够适合飞行，却能短距滑翔。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME whir their wings to communicate with one another, making loud buzzing noises within different parts of the forest. They are not aerodynamic enough to be able to fly, but can glide short distances.

entry: POKENAME轻巧友善，通过吹泡泡将自己向后推，在空中移动。据说，某处有支笛子，吹奏乐曲便能将它召来。
author: sk372
source: Lightweight and friendly, POKENAME propels itself through the air by blowing bubbles that move it backwards. It's said somewhere there exists a flute that can summon POKENAME forth with its song.

entry: 这种英雄般的宝可梦在星夜现身，以疾风骤雨般的拳脚痛打恶人，再潇洒消失。POKENAME的事迹已在一本热门漫画中连载。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: This heroic Pokémon appears on starlit nights, pummels evildoers with a rapid barrage of kicks and punches, then dramatically vanishes. POKENAME's exploits have been serialized in a popular comic book.

entry: POKENAME吃花越多，丝越粗。它栖在枝头，用丝抓来远处花朵，尽可能避免多余的动作。
author: .izik
source: The more flowers POKENAME eats, the thicker its silk becomes. It grabs at flowers from afar with this silk while perched on tree branches, avoiding unnecessary movement whenever possible.

entry: POKENAME罂粟红的翅膀远看像一群芭瓢虫，令捕食者避开。翅膀的甜香引来花朵宝可梦，它便从对方身上吸蜜。
author: quackquackattack
source: Predators avoid POKENAME due to their poppy red wings, which resemble a group of Ledyba at a distance. Their sweet-smelling wings draw in flower Pokémon that they drink nectar from.

entry: POKENAME用角牢牢夹住对手，不停打上勾拳，直到对方昏厥。终于能飞让它十分珍惜，最爱飞上高空，再自由落下，反复玩耍。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME's fighting style consists of strongly gripping its opponents with its horns, while throwing uppercuts until they faint. It cherishes finally being able to fly, and loves to reach high altitudes just to free fall and repeat.

entry: POKENAME背上嵌着数颗球体，能脱离身体独立行动。它们对战斗帮助很大，在网络空间对付恶意软件时，更是大显身手。
author: sk372
source: Several orbs embedded in POKENAME's back can separate and operate independently from it. These aid it greatly in fighting opponents, but even more so in helping it deal with malware when inhabiting cyberspace.

entry: 茧与其中的身体都很脆弱，POKENAME便用四只拳头奋力自卫。颈间围巾般的褶边随风飘动，就算无风可察也是如此。
author: sk372
source: Due to the cocoon and the body within being frail, POKENAME uses its four fists to vigorously defend itself. The scarf-like frill around its neck billows in the breeze, even when there is no discernible wind.

entry: POKENAME只在夜里狩猎，潜伏在空气最纯净的林间空地。强翼一扇，便掀起暴风；猎物若撑住，它就逼近，用强壮双颚给予决定性咬击。
author: fiordaliso
