source: POKENAME hunts only at night, lurking in forest glades where the air is at its purest. With a flap of its mighty wings, it whips up violent winds. Should its prey endure, it closes in and delivers a decisive bite with its powerful jaws.

entry: POKENAME一仰面倒下，就无法自己起身。露出软肚，只好乱挥六条短肢，吓退可能的攻击者。
author: sontyp
source: When it falls on its back, it's impossible for a POKENAME to get back up on its own. With its soft belly exposed, it flails its six short limbs around to avert potential aggressors.

entry: 据说POKENAME的生命力与星光相连，夜里自然更活跃，不过本就极少有人见到它。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Its life force is thought to be linked to starlight. Naturally, POKENAME becomes more active during the night, though it has been exceedingly rare to find one at all.

entry: POKENAME不停拳击敌人，随后注入黄色毒液。被击败的猎物会拖回蜂巢，作为战利品。
author: .izik
source: After punching a foe relentlessly, POKENAME stings them with yellow venom. It drags defeated prey back to its hive as a trophy.

entry: 春天偶有目击报告，见到POKENAME在花间打滚。虽然玩得开心，却弄得满身花粉，接连打喷嚏数小时。
author: .izik
source: During springtime, rare sightings of POKENAME rolling in flowers have been reported. This coats it in pollen, causing it to sneeze for hours despite the fun it is having.

entry: POKENAME收集玫瑰花瓣，揉进蓬松尾巴。据说，香气能安抚附近争夺领地的宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects rose petals and rubs them into its fluffy tail. The scent is said to calm nearby Pokémon during territorial disputes.

entry: POKENAME目光敏锐，晴天能看见数英里外。天气晴朗就高飞，成群涌向开满鲜花的草地。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have very keen eyesight, able to see for miles on clear days. They fly up high when the weather is clear and will swarm toward meadows with fresh flowers.

entry: POKENAME力量并未超过未融合的安瓢虫，出拳频率却高得多。它主动凭速度出击，赶走威胁群体的生物，防患于未然。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME do not develop any extra strength over unfused Ledian, but they are capable of landing punches at a much higher rate. They use their speed offensively, chasing away threats to the swarm before problems can develop.

entry: POKENAME力量并未超过未融合的安瓢虫，出拳频率却高得多。它主动凭速度出击，赶走威胁群体的生物，防患于未然。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME do not develop any extra strength over unfused Ledian, but they are capable of landing punches at a much higher rate. They use their speed offensively, chasing away threats to the swarm before problems can develop.

entry: POKENAME力量并未超过未融合的安瓢虫，出拳频率却高得多。它主动凭速度出击，赶走威胁群体的生物，防患于未然。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME do not develop any extra strength over unfused Ledian, but they are capable of landing punches at a much higher rate. They use their speed offensively, chasing away threats to the swarm before problems can develop.

entry: 进化后的POKENAME更爱独居。可一有危险，便会为了心中正义，保护自己与其他生命。
author: alliveir
source: After evolution, POKENAME prefer to live a more solitary life from eachother. If it senses danger it will protect both itself and others for justice.

entry: POKENAME正义感强烈，凡遇险的宝可梦，都愿守护。它们还能借弹力蛛网反弹，迅速赶路。
author: gotfyr
source: POKENAME have a strong sense of justice and will defend any Pokémon that are in danger. They bounce off their elastic webs to travel at high speeds.

entry: POKENAME自信地穿行雷雨，巡视花草地，驱逐任何威胁花朵的宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies confidently through thunderstorms. It patrols flower meadows and drives off any Pokémon that threaten the blooms.

entry: POKENAME有时被误认成水生宝可梦，孩子会把它扔回池塘或湖中。尽管是误会，它们似乎不介意被抛来抛去，有些还开心地晃触角。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are sometimes mistaken for an aquatic Pokémon, so children may toss one back into a pond or lake. Despite the confusion, they do not seem to mind being tossed around, and some wiggle their antennas with glee.

entry: POKENAME把手臂肌肉练得极强，已经用不着翅膀。如今能见到它拼命拳打空气，以此飞行。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME has trained its arm muscles to a level where its wings are no longer needed. Instead, POKENAME can be seen furiously punching the air to fly.

entry: POKENAME爱花香，在花圃附近筑巢。看见谁鲁莽地跑过草地，就会愤怒地滑翔过去，把对方赶走。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME adores the scent of flowers, creating nests near flowerbeds. If it spots someone recklessly running through the meadow, it will furiously glide towards them, driving them off.

entry: POKENAME释放的甜香与亮晶晶的闪粉可制香水。取自多只个体的柔和香气装成小瓶套装，是约会送礼的佳选。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a sweet aroma and shiny sparkles that are made into perfume. The soft fragrance is bottled into small sets that come from multiple POKENAME, which makes the perfume a great gift for dates.

entry: POKENAME飘在薰衣草田上，再轻轻落下进食。所到之处，都带着揉碎花朵的香味。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats above lavender fields before gently descending to feast. The scent of crushed blooms follows it wherever it goes.

entry: POKENAME在城市里游走，偷花店的花束放进巢中，掩盖刺鼻的城市气味。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME travels around cities, stealing bouquets from florists. It then places these flowers in its nest, masking the harsh city stench.

entry: 多数POKENAME住在大土丘里，统领一群芭波。若有子民也进化成POKENAME，两者便交战，败者必须离群，尝试另建族群。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Most POKENAME live as the leader of a colony of Ledyper in large mounds. Should one of their subjects evolve into another POKENAME, they both battle and the loser must leave the colony to try and start their own.

entry: POKENAME头上的芭瓢虫似乎是参谋。不管意见好不好，它都很关心这位伙伴，时不时鼓励地拍拍头。
author: hophoppip
source: The Ledyba on POKENAME's head seems to act as an advisor. Whether or not the advice is good, POKENAME cares greatly for its Ledyba companion, giving it encouraging pats on the head from time to time.

entry: POKENAME的大眼睛很适合在最活跃的清晨或傍晚收光视物。它与大型宝可梦保持距离，受威胁便亮出大牙，却更愿意逃跑。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME has huge eyes, perfect for taking in light in the early morning or late evening when they are most active. They keep their distance from larger Pokémon, baring their large fangs when threatened but preferring to run.

entry: 吸入太多花粉会让POKENAME发狂，附近什么都咬，无论敌人、朋友，甚至自己的训练家。
author: .izik
source: Inhaling too much pollen drives POKENAME into a wild frenzy. It bites anything nearby; foe, friend, or even its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME住在古代遗迹周围，寻找花瓣攥在拳中，不知如何便能吸取其中能量，作为养分。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its home around ancient ruins, searching for petals to grasp in its fists. It somehow drains energy from them this way as nourishment.

entry: POKENAME用精神力量轻轻托起花粉吃掉。它在花田飘游，比起新开的花，更喜欢较老的花草。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses psychic powers to gently lift pollen from flowers and eat it. It drifts through fields, preferring older flora over newly blossomed ones.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片状结构遇冷收拢，遇热张开。它最爱暖夜，甚至会松开挂着的树，开心地弹跳。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's scaly ligaments shut in the cold but open and flare out in the heat. Warm nights are POKENAME's favorite; they may even detach from the tree they hang from to bounce around happily.

entry: POKENAME坚定守护虫宝可梦。看见虫子受欺负，便如英雄般从天而降，以四只金属钳连续出拳，反击施暴者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a staunch defender of insect Pokémon. If it spots a bug being picked on, it descends with heroic flair and retaliates on the aggressor with a flurry of punches from its four metallic claws.

entry: POKENAME天生早起，太阳一升就醒，整天活跃。它又乐意搬运绑在壳上的装备，因此很受登山男欢迎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are naturally early risers, waking as soon as the sun rises and continuing to remain active throughout the day. This, combined with their willingness to haul equipment strapped to their shells, makes them a popular companion amongst Hikers.

entry: POKENAME用喙衔来野花装饰巢穴。面对入侵者十分好斗，会毫不犹豫地打出重拳。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME adorns its nest with wildflowers that it clutches in its beak. It reacts aggressively to intruders, landing strong punches without hesitation.

entry: POKENAME搭配米饭与海苔，是丰盛顶饱的一餐。肚子看似一颗意式面团子，里面存着大部分重要器官。
author: quackquackattack
source: When prepared with rice and seaweed, POKENAME make for a hearty and filling meal. Their stomachs look like a single piece of gnocchi and store most of their vital organs.

entry: POKENAME都懂得欣赏美景。若在文件中看见一只，便说明你的品味很好。它们以花朵的数据为食。
author: blaizegamer
source: All POKENAME are known to be appreciaters of great sceneries. If you were to see one in your files, it is a sign that you have great taste. They feast on datas of flowers.

entry: POKENAME在流星雨中出现，飞奔过陆海，仿佛追逐流星。陨石落处附近常有天然泉水，有人相信，那是它留下的祝福。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME appear during meteor showers, dashing across land and sea as if chasing the falling stars. Areas where the meteors fall often have a source of natural spring water nearby, leading some to believe it was left by POKENAME as a blessing.

entry: POKENAME在草地上空翱翔，向大嘴雀等威胁放出强力电击。火花常把附近花瓣照得发亮。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME soars above meadows and releases powerful electric shocks at threats like Fearow. Its sparks often set nearby petals aglow.

entry: POKENAME吃花粉时轻轻哔哔叫。偶尔却会急促鸣响，全身失控旋转，把附近花草毁掉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes quiet little beeps as it eats pollen from flowers. Occasionally, it beeps rapidly and spins its entire body uncontrollably, destroying any nearby flora in the process.

entry: POKENAME的复眼能迅速识别弱点，再用强力拳脚攻击。星星可见的晴夜，更容易见到它。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's compound eyes allow it to quickly identify weak points to strike with powerful punches and kicks. Sightings are more common on clear nights when the stars are visible.

entry: POKENAME虽有翅膀，在水里靠大尾推动反而更快。它寻找清澈平静的湖泊，在星夜游得最多。
author: .jerden
source: While it has wings to fly with, POKENAME is faster in the water, where it can use its large tail to propel itself forwards. It seeks out clear, still lakes, and swims the most on starry nights.

entry: POKENAME大多时间掘地，因为地下更能避开捕食者。白天大多睡在里面，只有星夜才到地面飞行。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of its time burrowing, as it is safer from predators underground. It sleeps there for most of the day and only comes above the surface to fly on starry nights.

entry: POKENAME虽有翅膀，却很少飞。它喜欢在地面筑巢，用挖出的土围成墙，再靠强壮手臂挥击防卫。
author: .jerden
source: Although it has wings, POKENAME rarely flies. It prefers to build its nest on the ground, surrounded by walls of earth it digs up, and defended by swings of POKENAME's powerful arms.

entry: POKENAME大量吃铃兰后，毒性会增强。花瓣在耳上留下苦涩残渣。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's poison strengthens after consuming large quantities of lily of the valley. The petals leave a bitter residue on its ears.

entry: POKENAME吃河岸花朵补充能量。吃饱便收集泥与原木，搭一间小屋遮蔽风雨。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME snacks on riverbank flowers for energy. When full, it gathers mud and logs to build a small lodge as shelter.

entry: 附近虫宝可梦遇险时，POKENAME便现身保护。幽灵般的身影灵活闪避攻击，再连续出拳反击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME manifests itself in defense of insect Pokémon near it that are in danger. Its spectral form nimbly dodges attacks while striking back with its multiple fist strikes.

entry: POKENAME是大型、不会飞的虫属性宝可梦，成群在林中进食，吃出大片空地。翅膀柔软灵活，扇动是为了展示，而非飞行。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are large, flightless Bug-Type Pokémon that will swarm together in forests to feed, creating large clearings as they do. Their wings are soft and flexible, fluttered as a means of display rather than being used as a means to fly.

entry: POKENAME振翅发出低沉嗡鸣，警告其他宝可梦远离觅食地。若仍吓不退竞争者，就改用疾风骤雨般的连拳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME whir their wings in a low-pitched drone to warn away other Pokémon from their feeding grounds. If their warnings fail to deter potential competitors, they will launch a flurry of rapid-fire punches instead.

entry: POKENAME双翼覆着巨颚般的甲壳，硬如岩石，能夹住攻击者。野外个体害羞避人，拿闪亮物品却可能引它靠近。
author: sontyp
source: Its wings are covered by a huge, jaw-like carapace that's hard as rock and can clamp down on attackers. In the wild, POKENAME are shy and hide from humans, but might be lured closer by presenting shiny or glittering objects.

entry: 暴怒时，POKENAME用巨臂抓住敌人，举在身前，让小手臂猛打。可小手臂力气太弱，感觉倒更像挠痒。
author: bandedbodypress
source: When enraged, POKENAME will grapple foes with its huge arms and hold them out so that its smaller arms pummel them. However, the small arms are so weak that it feels more like getting tickled.

entry: POKENAME振翅声极响，数英里外都能听见嗡鸣。它用声音驱赶同类，宣示领地。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's wings make an incredibly loud noise when they are whirred, the buzz audible from many miles away. They use this sound to warn away other POKENAME, staking their claim to their territory.

entry: POKENAME吃光整片芍药花，精炼毒液。之后，尖牙会滴出淡粉色毒素。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME consumes entire patches of peonies to refine its venom. Its fangs drip a faint pink toxin afterward.

entry: POKENAME挥刃、出拳，同时迎敌。月光下，刀刃闪闪发亮，挥动时还拖出一道光痕。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME fights with its blade and fist simultaneously. In the moonlight, its blade sparkles and makes glowing trails with its swings.

entry: 这种宝可梦行踪隐秘，只有流星雨时、夜空满是小陨星，才能见到。耀眼的尾巴令注视者入迷。
author: dodoowner_
source: This elusive Pokémon is only spotted during meteor showers when the night sky is filled with Minior. Its dazzling tail mesmerizes anyone who looks at it.

entry: POKENAME毕生梦想飞向星辰。非凡而富破坏力的力量，来自星之能量。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME holds a life-long dream of being able to fly to the stars. Its marvelous and destructive power derives from star energy.

entry: POKENAME清晨对训练家格外亲热。它悬在附近，黑色缎带在阳光中闪耀。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME displays great affection toward its Trainer during the early morning. Its black ribbons shimmer in the sunlight as it hovers nearby.

entry: POKENAME常彼此争夺领地。快拳与强翼让战场周围尘土飞扬，笼罩一片。
author: gileme__
source: POKENAME often engage in territorial fights with each other. Their fast-moving fists and powerful wings cause a cloud of dust to shroud the area around these fights.

entry: POKENAME拍翅，在体内积蓄能量与速度。力量足够时，便能打出速度、威力都惊人的连拳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's flaps its wings to help build up energy and speed within its body. Once it builds up enough power, it can strike with a flurry of punches with ridiculous speed and force.

entry: POKENAME炮中射出的激光足以劈钢。奇怪的是，它主要用这本领小心摘取树上的花来吃。
author: .izik
source: The laser POKENAME fires from its cannon is powerful enough to cleave steel. Oddly, it uses this ability primarily for delicately harvesting flower blossoms from trees to eat.

entry: POKENAME夜里受星月吸引，爱在高空翱翔。有人说，它飞得高到能亲自碰到月亮。
author: foolish_weasel
source: At night, POKENAME like to soar high in the sky, drawn to the stars and moon above. Some say they fly so high that they can touch the very moon itself.

entry: 神话说，星辰排成一线时，POKENAME将从群星降临。传说它落在哪里，哪里便会彻底净化。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Myths say that when the stars align, POKENAME will descend from the stars. According to legend, wherever it lands will be completely purified.

entry: POKENAME在雏菊田周围吐出透明蛛网，用来截住花粉，阻挡入侵的虫属性宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits clear webs around its daisy fields. It uses these webs to trap pollen and deter intruding Bug-types.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛对晨光格外敏感，清早能看见极远处。它们制造波长与晨光相同的缕缕火焰，便于在森林里找到彼此。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME eyes are extra sensitive to the morning light, enabling them to see across great distances during the early hours of the day. They create wisps of fire that match these wavelengths, allowing them to locate each other with ease in the forest.

entry: POKENAME在拳中制造火球，掷向敌人。热量会烧焦筑巢地周围的花。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME generates fireballs in its fists and hurls them at opponents. The heat scorches flowers around its nesting grounds.

entry: 白天，POKENAME收集花种，种在水坝附近。等花的数量让它满意，就迁往新家。
author: .izik
source: By day, POKENAME collects flower seeds to plant near its dams. Once the number of flowers there satisfies it, POKENAME moves on to a new home.

entry: POKENAME不会飞，便捶打树木和任何挡路的宝可梦泄愤。它主要夜行，会等入夜才四处找熟果，安抚情绪。
author: fiordaliso
source: It vents its frustration at being unable to fly by punching trees and any Pokémon that cross its path. As POKENAME is primarily nocturnal, it waits for nightfall to roam in search of ripe fruit to soothe its nerves.

entry: POKENAME模仿在花田散步的人类。成群的它们用幻象伪装成采花人，数十年来让旅人困惑不已。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME imitates humans wandering in flower fields. Swarms of them using illusions to disguise themselves as flower-pickers have confused travelers for decades.

entry: POKENAME是大型、不会飞的虫属性宝可梦，成群在林中进食，吃出大片空地。翅膀柔软灵活，扇动是为了展示，而非飞行。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are large, flightless Bug-Type Pokémon that will swarm together in forests to feed, creating large clearings as they do. Their wings are soft and flexible, fluttered as a means of display rather than being used as a means to fly.

entry: POKENAME从发光的花朵手臂散布强效催眠花粉。只吸一口，就足以令敌人昏迷。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME disperses potent sleep-inducing pollen from its glowing floral arms. A single breath can render a foe unconscious.

entry: 能见到POKENAME在树间跳跃，寻找树果吃。遭袭时，会用握紧的拳头还击，力道堪比冠军拳手。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be seen hopping from tree to tree in search of berries to eat. When it is attacked, it will strike its attacker with its curled-up fists with the same force as a champion-level boxer.

entry: POKENAME出拳时，拳头变得滚烫。打完便沿难以预料的S形路线飞走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fists grow scalding hot when it strikes. After punching, it escapes by flying in unpredictable S-shaped patterns.

entry: POKENAME与芭瓢虫群同住，芭瓢虫吃叶片，便替它修了叶。叶片若长得太大，它会摔倒，爬不起来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live alongside Ledyba colonies, as their leaves are trimmed when Ledyba eat them. If their leaves get too big, they fall over, unable to get up.

entry: POKENAME嘴里排出的液体带着异世般的气味，类似小陨星。它在黑暗中泛起微光，照亮新月之夜。
author: dodoowner_
source: The liquid excreting from POKENAME's mouth has an otherworldly smell, similar to the scent of Minior. The substance glows faintly in the dark, illuminating new-moon nights.

entry: POKENAME用四臂给敌人抹上大量黏液，使其动弹不得，占得先机。不过，它只有受挑衅才战斗，本性平和温柔。
author: milchik
source: Using its four arms, POKENAME coats its opponents in lots of sticky slime, immobilizing them to get the advantage. This Pokémon only fights when provoked, though, and is actually peaceful and gentle in nature.

entry: POKENAME与芭瓢虫群同住，因为共同的捕食者很难同时捕猎双方。它先用芳香雾气让捕食者入睡，群体再把威胁搬离家园。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME reside alongside Ledyba colonies, as their common predators have difficulty hunting both of them at the same time. POKENAME use an aromatic mist to put predators to sleep before the colony carries the threat away from their homes.

entry: 白天，POKENAME缩进众多尖刺附肢围成的壳中，夜里才出来沐浴星光。
author: deniablecredibility
source: During the day, POKENAME retreats into a shell created by its numerous spiky appendages. It emerges at night to bask in the starlight.

entry: POKENAME拳击敌人时，会从拳中喷出白色孢子。孢子黏在皮肤上，可能造成化学灼伤。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME punches a foe, a burst of white spores is released from its fists. These spores cling to the skin and can cause chemical burns.

entry: POKENAME悬在花圃上，朝任何擅自摘花的入侵者低吼。对方若想逃，它就飞快紧追在后，凶猛吠叫。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME hovers above flowerbeds, growling at any intruders picking the flowers. If the trespasser attempts to run away, it will closely zip behind it, barking violently.

entry: POKENAME在月下草地飞行时嚎叫。据说叫声能赶走潜伏在花圃附近的捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME howls while flying through meadows under moonlight. Its cry is said to ward off predators lurking near flower beds.

entry: POKENAME白天吃地下树根，晴夜便爬上同一棵树。等高到能看见星星，背上的蘑菇就向空中散布闪亮孢子。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME feeds on underground tree roots during the day, but climbs up the trunk of the same tree on clear nights. Once it gets high enough to see the stars, the mushroom on its back scatters glittering spores into the air.

entry: POKENAME不时向周围射出光束。古老传说猜测，每道光都由一颗垂死的恒星引发。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sporadically shoot beams of light around them. Ancient legends speculate that each beam of light is triggered by a dying star.

entry: 许多人和宝可梦沉醉于POKENAME优美的歌舞，它有时也愿意为别人表演。就连战斗，攻击动作也风格鲜明。
author: fireblade141
source: Many people and Pokémon find themselves entranced by POKENAME's beautiful song and dance, and it will sometimes choose to perform for others. Even in battle its attacks are highly stylized in form.

entry: 天空闪烁的星越多，POKENAME越善于隐匿。夜空中星星足够多时，它几乎完全看不见。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: As more stars twinkle in the sky, POKENAME becomes more capable of stealth. When there are enough stars in the night sky, POKENAME is practically invisible.

entry: POKENAME会带走住在空气污染城镇的人，再带到偏远森林深处，向他们展示浩瀚星空。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME is known to take people living in air-polluted towns. It then brings them to the middle of remote forests, showing them the cosmos.

entry: POKENAME在草地底下掘进时使出高速移动，迅速找到花根。吃饱就钻出地面，在阳光下安稳打盹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses Agility while tunneling through meadows to rapidly locate flower roots. Once it has eaten its fill, it surfaces and naps peacefully in the sunlight.

entry: POKENAME在大片花圃里打盹，享受周围花草的香气。若不巧叫醒它，便会陷入仿佛永无止境的狂暴。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME naps in vast flowerbeds, enjoying the scent of the surrounding flora. If you happen to wake it up, it will go on a seemingly never-ending rampage.

entry: POKENAME大肆暴走，用强拳痛打眼前的一切。唯有银河的景象，才能让它平静下来。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME goes on large rampages, punching everything in sight with its powerful fists. The only thing able to calm it down is the sight of the galaxy.

entry: 黄昏，POKENAME目不转睛地望着月亮，奔过大地。据说，它是在追逐月亮本身。
author: dodoowner_
source: During dusk, POKENAME runs across the lands, its gaze fixed on the moon. It's said that the Pokémon is attempting to chase the moon itself.

entry: POKENAME白天大多安全地待在水下，天黑后上岸锻炼四肢。星夜更活跃，始终提防夜行捕食者。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME spend much of the day underwater in safety but emerge after dark to strengthen their limbs on shore. More active on starry nights, they are constantly vigilant for nocturnal predators.

entry: 它身体始终覆着一层闪亮黏液，吸收星光越多，就越明亮。训练家坚称，凭气味就能知道POKENAME的心情。
author: afilthycasual
source: A shiny layer of mucous constantly covers its body that gets brighter the more starlight is absorbed. Trainers swear they can tell what mood their POKENAME is in based on this fluid's scent.

entry: POKENAME每拳的力道只相当于小孩。不过，六臂出拳快得眼睛跟不上，仍是能干的战士。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Each punch thrown by POKENAME is equivalent to one thrown by a child. However, its six arms punch faster than the eye can see, making it an effective fighter.

entry: POKENAME早晨成群聚到河岸，晒太阳让身体暖和起来。充分暖身后，它们便整天在河里潜入跃出，寻找水草充饥。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swarm together to river banks during the morning, sunning themselves to warm up their bodies. Once they are sufficiently warmed up, they spend the day diving in and out of rivers searching for weeds to feed on.

entry: POKENAME飞过罂粟田时散发蔓莓果香，引诱小拉达等猎物。等对方靠近，便用黏花粉困住。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lets loose a Razz Berry scent while flying over poppy fields to attract prey like Rattata. Once they approach, it traps them in sticky pollen.

entry: POKENAME的叶片释放柑橘香的花蜜，闻着像新鲜柠檬。虫属性宝可梦受香气吸引，就被藤蔓迅速抓住。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's leaves release a citrus-scented nectar that smells like fresh lemon. This aroma attracts Bug-type Pokémon, which it swiftly captures with its vines.

entry: POKENAME出没于偏僻村落，舔舐在外遇到的人。目击者说，感觉很奇怪，仿佛数千只绿毛虫在皮肤上爬。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME haunts isolated villages, licking individuals it finds outside. Witnesses report a strange sensation, like thousands of Caterpie are crawling on their skin.

entry: POKENAME的钳长得太大，飞不过1英尺高。战斗时借飞行把钳抬起，像锤子般砸向敌人。它喜欢能望星、听海浪的地方。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME's pincers grow so large that it is unable to fly more than a foot; it uses flight in combat to bring its pincer down on a foe like a hammer. POKENAME prefer to live in environments where they can view the stars and hear ocean waves.

entry: POKENAME精心打理自己的丝球，为此十分自豪，总想展示给其他宝可梦看。
author: missingmilkman
source: POKENAME meticulously maintains its ball of silk. It's very proud of it and always tries to show it to other Pokémon.

entry: 风起时，POKENAME借丝乘风，飘向更茂盛的树木。只有能控制方向的微风才这样做。若风已起，它却留在地面，可能预示暴风雨将至。
author: afilthycasual
source: When the wind picks up, POKENAME uses its silk to balloon to more lush trees. It only does this in mild breezes where it can maintain control. If the wind is up and a POKENAME is spotted on the ground, a storm may be approaching.

entry: POKENAME怕陌生人，平时融入高草丛，等电网捕猎。蛛丝可采来制作电缆与电线。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME is skittish around strangers and primarily blends into tall grasses while waiting to shock prey with their electric webs. This webbing can be harvested to produce electrical cables and cording.

entry: POKENAME藏在大灌木与高草中，等猎物走进蛛网。频率改变时，网会产生微弱电击，能被它的神经系统感知。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME hides in large bushes and tall grasses while waiting for prey to wander into their webbing. This webbing produces small electric shocks they can feel in their nervous system when there is a change in frequencies.

entry: POKENAME一窝中的每颗蛋，都会用丝包住自己，多添一层防护。若某个成员失去部分护甲，其他成员就会立刻合织补好。
author: sk372
source: Each egg in a POKENAME clutch covers itself with silk as an added layer of defense. If any member loses part of their armor, the rest of the group will work to weave a replacement posthaste.

entry: POKENAME给圆丝蛛提供住处，载着它们把巢安在需要的地方。受威胁时，会射出黏网与毒唾液，再退往安全处。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME offers itself as a home for Spinarak, carrying them wherever their nest needs to be. When threatened, it will launch sticky webs and poisonous spit at the threat before retreating to safety.

entry: POKENAME有些胆怯，却很容易先发制人。它用蛛丝把骨棒连在手上，像鞭子般挥舞，远远击打潜在威胁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a bit skittish and very quick to go on the offensive. It keeps its bone club connected to its hand via webbing, swinging it around like a whip to beat at potential threats from afar.

entry: POKENAME的腿与大颚使它不同于同类融合体，能走动、进食。不像其他同类，只能原地不动，靠储存的能量进化。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME's legs and mandible set it apart from other fusions of its kind. They allow it to move around and consume food, unlike its stationary brethren that rely on stored energy to evolve.

entry: POKENAME从每条藤蔓喷丝，捕捉小拉达等猎物。织丝又快又静，极少失手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME ejects silk from each of its vines to trap prey like Rattata. It weaves the threads fast and silently, rarely missing its target.

entry: POKENAME极易受伤，往往完全不动，只有必要时才移动。它用网缠住、拖慢想趁机下手的捕食者。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME are extremely vulnerable to attack and tend to remain completely still, only moving when necessary. They utilize their webs to trap and slow any predators who try to take advantage of their stillness.

entry: POKENAME用大颚分泌的黏丝给自己织翅膀。翅膀容易破损，需经常修补，它通常白天躲在树冠里修理。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME weave wings for themselves out of a sticky silk produced from their mandibles. These wings damage easily and regularly need repair, POKENAME typically sheltering with tree canopies to fix them during the day.

entry: POKENAME的角不停生长。为保持合适长度，它常在岩石和树上磨角，因此容易分叉、碎裂。捕虫训练家有时会收集碎角，当作幸运符。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME's horn never stops growing. It tends to fork and splinter as a result of it rubbing its horn against rocks and trees to keep it at a manageable length. Bug Catchers sometimes collect these as good luck charms.

entry: 许多POKENAME住在森林，有些已扩展到村落。它们能在天花板上爬，强壮双颚几乎什么都咬得碎。
author: chorb33
source: Many POKENAME live in forests, but some have spread into villages. They can climb on ceilings and crack almost anything with their strong jaws.

entry: POKENAME开朗，又爱训练家，常被视为初次尝试融合者的好选择。不过，它爱在不合适的地方结网捣乱，行为有时难以预测。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME is often considered a good choice for first time fusion Trainers due to its happy nature and love for its Trainer. However, this Pokémon tends to get into mischief by creating webs in unwanted places and can be unpredictable.

entry: 经历水生变异后，POKENAME能在沼泽水中隐身。它在水生树木的根间结网，捕捉游过的猎物，节省体力。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: After undergoing an aquatic mutation, POKENAME can become invisible in marsh waters. They weave webs into the roots of aquatic trees to ensnare swimming prey and conserve energy.

entry: POKENAME结网速度极快，令人难以应付。蛛网带电，能给电子设备供能；在野外，则常用来缠住行动迅速的对手。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME is considered a challenge due to the speed at which it produces webs. These webs hold an electric charge that can be used to power electronics; in the wild they are often used to ensnare fast-moving opponents.

entry: POKENAME用大颚挂在树上等待进化，有些却会累得掉下来。把它送回树上会得到感激，可许多好心登山者仍挨了狠狠一口。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME use their mandibles to attach to trees while they wait to evolve, though some tire and fall from their perch. Reintroducing them to a tree will make them grateful, but many altruistic hikers have received a nasty bite.

entry: POKENAME离开山洞里的栖处，下到附近森林狩猎。嘴里吐出炽热丝线，裹住猎物，几秒内就能烤熟。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME leaves its roost within mountain caverns to descend to nearby forests for hunting. It spits out super-heated thread from its mouth that wraps around prey and cooks it within seconds.

entry: POKENAME织出DNA形状的蛛网，给艺术创作带来灵感。它能让自己与网一起隐形，帮助捕虫。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME weaves webs in the shape of DNA, and its webs inspires art. POKENAME is able to make it and its webs invisible to help catch bugs.

entry: 这种会飞的虫宝可梦用绿羽融入树木，在树间用蛛丝筑小巢。据说，也会用这些丝做陷阱，捕捉毫无戒心的宝可梦。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: This flying Bug Pokémon uses its green feathers to blend in with trees, where they build small nests of web. This web is also said to be used to create traps for unsuspecting Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME经常给网涂上橙橙果汁，引诱猎物。蛛网极强韧，黏性可维持数月。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME regularly coats its webs with juice from Oran Berries to attract its prey. The webs are extremely strong and can stay sticky for months.

entry: 野生POKENAME在家中囤积半消化的树果与宝可梦。除了酸性唾液，它还能释放黏性物质，保存食物日后再吃。
author: bobosmith01
source: Wild POKENAME hoard halfway-digested Berries and Pokémon in the place they call home. In addition to its acidic spit, it can also emit a sticky substance that preserves food for later consumption.

entry: POKENAME喜欢不亲自近身的狩猎方式。它在夜色中用幻象与蛛网困住敌人，等对方疲惫，再将其抓走。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME prefers to hunt without getting physically involved. Instead, it ensnares foes in the darkness of night by using both illusions and webs until they tire out before POKENAME snatches them up.

entry: POKENAME很笨拙，还不习惯自己的翅膀。狩猎时常撞上东西，管它是不是猎物，都撞个正着。
author: gotfyr
source: POKENAME are very clumsy Pokémon. They aren't used to their wings yet, resulting in many hunts ending with them crashing into an object, prey or not.

entry: 进化之后，POKENAME狩猎更加大胆，会高速飞行，用头顶的尖角，刺穿猎物。
author: gotfyr
source: After evolving, POKENAME are more bold in their approach to hunting. They fly at high speeds using their sharp top horns to skewer their prey.

entry: POKENAME腹部模仿大型捕食者，骗过潜在袭击者。这招十分有效，连平时捕猎它的生物，大多也会被吓退。
author: jojojax164
source: POKENAME's abdomen mimics a larger predator to fool potential attackers. This method has proven very effective, since even regular hunters of POKENAME are mostly warded off by its intimidating appearance.

entry: POKENAME领地意识强，眼锐爪利。它用许多蛛网困住毫无戒心的宝可梦，再俯冲带走猎物，放着被困的大型对手不管。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME is highly territorial with sharp eyes and strong claws. It uses its many webs to trap unsuspecting Pokémon, before swooping down to carry away prey and ignore larger trapped opponents.

entry: POKENAME从嘴里分泌细丝，织成复杂蛛网，拖慢追赶者。只需轻碰，就能把电能注入网中，让效果更强。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME secretes a thin silk from its mouth, which it uses to weave intricate webs to slow down the Pokémon chasing it. With a single touch, it can channel electric energy into the web, making it even more effective.

entry: POKENAME织小网，夜里睡在其中。闪亮的网容易招来捕食者，它便用额角注入微弱毒素，使袭击者短暂无法动弹，再逃跑。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME create small webs to sleep in during the night. The webs are sparkly and tend to attract predators. They will inject their attacker with a weak poison from the horn on their forehead to immobilize them for a short time before running away.

entry: POKENAME吐出珍贵丝线，用来提运采集的树果。据说，这丝是极有用的药剂原料，能增强任何调制药液的效力。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME produces a valuable silk thread that it uses to carry berries it has collected. It is said this thread makes a very helpful potion ingredient used to increase the potency of any brew.

entry: POKENAME身上的羊毛极黏，很难好好剪下。取下后，主要用于制作格外结实的渔网。
author: sk372
source: The wool that POKENAME grows over its body is very sticky and tricky to shear off properly. Once removed, it is primarily used for the making of particularly strong fishing nets.

entry: POKENAME不用腹部吐丝，而从羊毛中抽取细缕织网。猎物靠得太近，静电就会从网跃出，将其击昏。
author: periperi_chicken
source: Rather than producing string from its abdomen, POKENAME takes strands of its wool to make its webs. When prey gets too close, static electricity jumps from the webbing and knocks them out.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴由极柔软的丝构成，每3个月脱落一次。世界各地的裁缝都争相寻求这些旧丝。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The tail of a POKENAME is made of incredibly soft silk. These Pokémon shed their tails every 3 months, and the discarded silk is sought after by tailors across the world.

entry: POKENAME用身体制造蛛网，兜住气流，在空中翱翔。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME creates webbing from its body that allows it to soar through the air by catching air currents.

entry: 偶尔能见到POKENAME结成小群，合作织篮状装置，搬运各类物品。从坚果、树果到训练家的失物，什么都收集。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME are occasionally seen in small packs that work together to weave basket-like mechanisms to carry a variety of items. They will collect anything from nuts and berries to lost items from Trainers.

entry: POKENAME用多条腿抓住树枝悬挂。它织丝成网，抛向其他宝可梦，拿对方开玩笑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hang from branches by grabbing onto them with their many legs. They prank other Pokémon by creating nets made out of silk and tossing them onto their victims.

entry: POKENAME在树枝间找到最佳采光处结网。夜里织好，白天就能尽情晒太阳。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME find the best spot to absorb sunlight between tree branches and make their web there. They spin their web at night so that they can spend most of the day sunbathing.

entry: POKENAME从尾尖制造毒网，十分耗能，因此只织小网。每只的图案都像人类指纹般独特，研究者便于监测群体。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: From the tip of POKENAME's tail it produces a toxic web. This requires a lot of energy, so POKENAME only ever build small webs, though each POKENAME has a unique web pattern, like a human fingerprint, so researchers can easily monitor groups of them.

entry: POKENAME敏感的毛能预测最细微的天气变化。据说，用蛛网连接敌人与伙伴，就能读取思想和意图。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME's sensitive fur allows it to predict the slightest changes in the weather. Through utilizing its webbing on opponents and allies alike, it is said to allow them to read minds and intentions.

entry: POKENAME在晨昏狩猎极为高效。亮黄色花纹微微发光，常被误认为初升或将落的太阳，蛛网则融入林间阴影。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: This Pokémon is a highly effective hunter at dawn and dusk. POKENAME's bright yellow patterning has a slight glow that is often confused for the rising or setting sun. Their webs blend in with the shadows found in forests.

entry: POKENAME吐出黏丝，从毫无戒心的旅人身上偷走闪亮饰物，再用宝物装饰凌乱的巢。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins sticky silk to snatch shiny trinkets from unsuspecting travelers. It decorates its tangled nests with stolen treasures.

entry: POKENAME叶上的囊中充满强毒，可提炼成冲洗胶片的药剂，使照片明暗对比准确呈现。
author: .izik
source: The sacs on POKENAME's leaves are filled with a potent poison that can be refined into a chemical for film development. This liquid ensures precise contrast in photographs.

entry: POKENAME用大颚仔细梳毛，有时一清就是数小时。可大颚又会吐丝，结果毛发变得粗糙黏腻，摸着不舒服。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fastidiously groom themselves with their mandibles, sometimes spending multiple hours cleaning through their fur. Their mandibles produce webbing, resulting in their fur having an unpleasant rough and sticky texture.

entry: POKENAME织出精密蛛网，夹着形似文字的怪异符文。这些图案迷惑、引诱猎物，随后它再降下身，将其带走。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME weave intricate webs laced with odd runes resembling letters. These patterns act as a trap to confuse and lure in prey before POKENAME descend and carry them away.

entry: POKENAME的大腹部像张假脸，骗过捕食者。重要器官位于腹部下侧，所以“脸”挨打也能轻松承受。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's large abdomen acts as a decoy face, fooling predators. Its vital organs are positioned towards the bottom of the abdomen, so it can easily shrug off attacks to its face.

entry: POKENAME用自己的丝网滑翔。网若破了，几秒便能修好，甚至飞在半空，也不耽搁！
author: gp423
source: POKENAME glides around on its own webbing. It can patch up any damage done to the web in a matter of seconds, even mid-glide!

entry: POKENAME爱拥抱，只要愿意被多条腿抱着，谁都欢迎。若被拒绝，就会垂头丧气，直到另一个人抱它。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love hugs and offer them to anyone willing to be hugged by their many legs. Whenever someone rejects their hug, they become dejected until another person gives them a hug.

entry: POKENAME遇到潜在威胁或猎物，会俯冲过去，吐网使目标动弹不得。虽然不危险，却十分扰人。
author: linhasxoc
source: POKENAME responds to potential threats or prey by dive-bombing them and spitting webs to incapacitate the target. While not dangerous, this makes it a severe nuisance.

entry: POKENAME动作慢，受威胁会鼓起身体、竖起尖刺。冬季寻找暖处时，常搬进人家。刺上滴着毒液，是危险的同住者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are slow moving Pokémon that will puff up and bristle their spikes when they feel threatened. They move inside people's houses over winter when searching out warm shelters. They're dangerous housemates as their spikes drip with poison.

entry: POKENAME的四只钳都能喷黏丝缠住敌人，再用快速子弹拳猛打。对方若想逃，就用丝拉回拳下。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's four pincers can each spew a sticky thread to entangle their opponents. They will pummel their enemies with rapid Bullet Punches, using their threads to pull them back into their strikes if they try to flee.

entry: POKENAME大多时间藏在壳里避敌。敏感的蛛网能让它察觉猎物落网，只有收取食物时才离壳。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME spends most of their days hidden in their shell to avoid predators. Using their sensitive webbing, they are able to detect when prey has been caught, and will only leave their shells to collect their meals.

entry: POKENAME在寒林树间拉丝，再覆冰加固。硬化的丝坚实到足以击落任何撞上的飞行宝可梦。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME stretches silk strands between trees in cold forests, then reinforces them with a layer of ice. These hardened threads become solid enough to take down any flying Pokémon that collide with them.

entry: POKENAME在森林低处结网，捕捉被蜂蜜香引来的昆虫。丝线人类也能放心吃，带着淡淡甜味。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spins its webs around the lower areas of forests, catching insects attracted to the honey-like scent its webbing emanates. The threads can be consumed by humans without issue, and have a faintly sweet taste.

entry: 构成POKENAME身体的毒液，其实毒性不强。真正厉害的是所织丝线，结实到能把巨石悬在半空。
author: imaginita
source: The poisonous liquid that makes up POKENAME's body isn't actually very toxic.  Its real strength comes from the thread it weaves, which is durable enough to hold a boulder suspended in the air.

entry: POKENAME从大嘴吐网，罩住目标，撞到什么表面，就把对方黏在上面。训练家有时会聚会，玩用网互相捆住的游戏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spits up nets of webbing from its wide mouth that stretch around a target and stick them to whatever surface it knocks them into. POKENAME Trainers sometimes gather to make a game of trying to web each other up.

entry: POKENAME用蛛丝织小网，抛向猎物将其困住。等对方挣扎累了，再把尖牙扎进去。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME make small nets out of silk webs to throw over their prey to ensnare them. Once they are stuck in the webbing, POKENAME wait until their prey tire themselves out, then sink their fangs in.

entry: 年幼圆丝蛛在POKENAME的大鹿角间结网。它跃过森林，虫子便落进网，供养整群圆丝蛛长大。
author: missingmilkman
source: Young Spinarak weave webs through POKENAME's large antlers. As it bounds through the forest, bugs become caught in the webs and feed the cluster to maturity.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴把蛛网织成精美艺术，能捕住波波大小的猎物。超能力者让顾客描述梦境，它在一旁织网，再凭图案解读运势。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME uses its tail to artistically spin its webbing into gorgeous art that entrap prey up to the size of Pidgey. Psychics have it weave while a customer describes their dreams, then interprets that person's fortune from POKENAME's design.

entry: POKENAME身手灵活，借蛛网荡跃，绕着对手移动，再用网捆住敌人，轻松取胜。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are incredibly acrobatic, using webs to swing and maneuver around their opponents. They use these webs to tie their foes up, restraining them for an easy victory.

entry: POKENAME用分泌的丝织心形网。戴着的蛛丝假发若被弄坏，就会生气。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME spins a heart-shaped web with the silk it produces. It will get angry if the silk wig it wears is damaged.

entry: POKENAME产奶丰富，经特殊工艺处理，能从奶中提取强韧丝线。
author: hophoppip
source: Strong silk threads can be extracted from the plentiful milk produced by POKENAME using a special process.

entry: 尽管流传着许多谣言，POKENAME其实只是友善地用丝织出其他宝可梦的模型，作为礼物送人。可惜，多数仍只能孤独度日。
author: infinex21
source: Despite the many rumors people spread about POKENAME, they are merely friendly Pokémon that weave replicas of other Pokémon out of silk to give to others as gifts. Alas, most POKENAME are left to wallow in solitude.

entry: POKENAME的腿撑不住体重，无法附着树干或爬树。它改从嘴里射出细黏丝，缠住水果和零食，拖到面前。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME cannot stick to or climb trees due to its legs not supporting its weight properly. Instead, it shoots thin sticky webbing from its mouth at fruits and other snacks to drag them down to it.

entry: POKENAME在地洞休息时，用自己的丝网裹成保护茧。它用多臂织网困敌，再以毒牙咬击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME roll themselves in their own silk webbing like a protective cocoon when they rest within their burrows. They weave their webbing using their multiple arms to entrap foes before biting with their venomous fangs.

entry: POKENAME不狩猎，靠蛛网充分利用光合作用。网是神经系统的一部分，能感知温暖，寻找阳光充足处。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME do not hunt for food, instead using their webbing to fully utilize photosynthesis. With their webbing as part of their nervous system, they can locate sunny areas by sensing warmth.

entry: POKENAME在凝固熔岩间筑巢，灰色蛛网融入浮石。蛛网足够耐热，能捕捉火属性宝可梦。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME makes its nest among dried lava flows. Its ash-colored webs blend in with the pumice, while being heat resistant enough to allow it to catch Fire-types.

entry: POKENAME在家周围布下灌注精神能量的细丝，警戒入侵者。受过训练的个体常留一根丝与训练家相连，时刻掌握对方位置。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spreads thin strands of psychic energy-infused webbing around its home to alert it to any intruders. Trained POKENAME often keep a thread connected to their Trainer so they always know where they are at any given time.

entry: POKENAME听觉出众，会找到其他虫属性宝可梦的家，在附近结网。可聪明的飞行属性宝可梦也懂得蛛网意味着什么，招来它不想要的竞争。
author: afilthycasual
source: With their exceptional hearing, POKENAME will find the homes of other Bug Types and set up their webs nearby. This invites unwanted competition from intelligent Flying Types that understand what the presence of these webs mean.

entry: POKENAME的网强到能困住冲锋的独角犀牛。多只聚集，会织出艺术般精密的网，显示群体间有心灵沟通。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME spins webs strong enough to trap a charging Rhyhorn. When many gather together, they weave artistically intricate webs that indicate psychic communication among the swarm.

entry: POKENAME一家在水面或水上合织蛛网，建成不漏水的坝。任何成员受威胁，整群就用网捆住袭击者，拖进小屋一起吃。
author: pjporwoll
source: A family of POKENAME will spin their webs together over or on water to create a leak-proof dam. If any member of the colony is threatened, the whole group will web up the attacker and drag it into their lodge to eat together.

entry: POKENAME一家在水面或水上合织蛛网，建成不漏水的坝。任何成员受威胁，整群就用网捆住袭击者，拖进小屋一起吃。
author: pjporwoll
source: A family of POKENAME will spin their webs together over or on water to create a leak-proof dam. If any member of the colony is threatened, the whole group will web up the attacker and drag it into their lodge to eat together.

entry: POKENAME从蛛形石头的多条肢体伸出几乎无法察觉的细丝。猎物一碰，幽灵形态便迅速沿丝赶来，将其裹住吞食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sends out faint, almost imperceptible threads of silk out from the many limbs of its arachnid-shaped stone. When potential prey touches a thread, its spectral form quickly travels along that thread to envelop and consume it.

entry: POKENAME把蛋背到孵化，以庞大身躯保护脆弱的乘客。背脊长出的多条腿末端有纺丝器，能在蛋周围织巢。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME carry their eggs on their back until they hatch, using their physical bulk to protect their delicate passengers from harm. The multiple legs sprouting from its spine are tipped with spinnerets, which they use to weave a nest around the eggs.

entry: POKENAME会让其他虫属性宝可梦在背上避难，也允许住客吃自己猎物的残余。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are known to let other Bug-type Pokémon take shelter on their backs. POKENAME also allow these inhabitants to eat leftovers of their own prey.

entry: POKENAME的网涂毒，慢慢削弱落网的小宝可梦。它被视为家中害虫，却也帮助清除其他虫属性宝可梦。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's webs are coated in a poison that slowly weakens small Pokémon caught in them. They are considered a household pest, but also help keep the home free of other Bug-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME住在冰洞，精细雕刻出蛛网形的冰。这是它的骄傲，谁胆敢破坏，它就从上方扑向毫无戒心的对方，使其麻痹。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME lives in icy caves, and delicately carves out the ice to look like a web. This is POKENAME's pride, and if anything dares to break it, they pounce on the unsuspecting creature from above, paralysing them.

entry: POKENAME在洞穴中布下丝网，感知猎物。它爬过昏暗洞顶，等猎物粘住、挣扎，再猛扑下去。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME creates web network systems in caves to sense prey. It wanders the dark ceilings and plunges into them while they struggle in the sticky web.

entry: POKENAME性情凶暴，连比自己大的敌人也敢攻击。角上分泌的毒，足以击昏过动猿。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's violent nature causes it to attack foes even larger than itself. The poison that secretes from its horn is enough to knock out a Vigoroth.

entry: POKENAME虽爪利颚毒，性情却相当温顺。它织网藏身，还拉起警戒线，感知任何靠近的东西。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are rather meek Pokémon despite their sharp claws and poisonous mandibles. They use their silk webbings to create webs to hide upon and to create tripwires to alert them to anything that approaches.

entry: POKENAME把幻象投在织好的网上，引来虫宝可梦。等对方黏上丝线，才知道上当。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME project illusions onto the webs they spin. The illusory images attract bug Pokémon, who only realize their mistakes once they're caught in the sticky strands.

entry: POKENAME深爱训练家，常把蛛网织成蝴蝶结相赠。据说，这些结散发积极能量，能安抚好斗的宝可梦。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME feel a deep love for their Trainer and often show it by weaving bows from their webbing and presenting them as gifts. It is said these bows radiate positive energy and can calm aggressive Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME体型巨大，尖牙却仍小而发育不全。它依靠庞大蛛网制住猎物，再用牙咬。
author: quackquackattack
source: Despite their gargantuan size, POKENAME's fangs remain small and underdeveloped. They rely on massive web networks to subdue their prey before they sink their fangs in.

entry: POKENAME从尾尖结网，多余蛛丝存进周围的球里。覆网的帽子极黏，误认成美味蘑菇的小宝可梦会被捕住。
author: milchik
source: This Pokémon spins its web from the tip of its tail and stores the excess in the balls around it. POKENAME's web-covered hat is very sticky and catches small unsuspecting Pokémon that mistake it for a delicious mushroom.

entry: POKENAME能快如闪电地移动，一边疾冲，一边吐黏丝，织出宽广复杂的网。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can move as fast as electrical bolts. They weave expansive, complex webs by darting about while spitting out their sticky threads.

entry: POKENAME能在包裹自身的液体中，任意位置瞬间形成毒角。它甩出套索状液丝，用念力操控，捕捉猎物。
author: silverscloudy
source: POKENAME can instantaneously form venomous horns anywhere within its self-enveloping fluid. It expels lasso-like strings of this liquid to capture its prey, controlling the liquid telekinetically.

entry: 满月之夜，POKENAME聚在一起，织出大网，绕网跳舞。蛛网由光滑的丝织成，月光下会发亮，是稀有而抢手的制衣材料。
author: actliux
source: During nights of a full moon, POKENAME will gather to spin a large web and dance around it. The web is made of a smooth silk that glows in moonlight, making it a rare and sought-after material for clothing.

entry: POKENAME深夜常藏在树木和灌丛中，用发光蛛网诱捕猎物。训练得当后，所吐丝线可制成发光网。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME is often found hiding among bushes and trees late at night. They utilize glowing webbing to lure prey into their traps. When properly trained, the thread produced from their webbing can be used to make glowing nets.

entry: POKENAME把收集的钥匙编进网，只因喜欢它们在光下闪耀。虽然极力护着钥匙，却任由闪光引来毫无戒心的猎物。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME collect keys to include in their webs simply due to enjoying the way they sparkle in the light. Despite their overprotectiveness for the keys they collect, they let this sparkling draw in unsuspecting prey.

entry: POKENAME织4种截然不同的网，分别适合特定猎物。即使在所住森林也很少被看见，不过观星者有时报告在流星雨中见到。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME create four distinct types of webs, each suited for a specific type of prey. They are rarely seen even within their forest habitat, but stargazers sometimes report seeing POKENAME during meteor showers.

entry: POKENAME能一动不动地躺上数年，等待猎物。好不容易等到靠近，有时还是懒得动。
author: missingmilkman
source: POKENAME can lie motionless for years at a time, waiting for prey. When prey finally comes near, sometimes it still doesn't feel like moving.

entry: 电工十分看重POKENAME带电的丝，用于供电不稳定区域的精细布线。
author: .izik
source: Electricians prize POKENAME for its electrically charged silk. The threads are used for delicate wiring in unstable power zones.

entry: POKENAME在洞里结网，常捕到超音蝠。若困住岩石属性宝可梦，就用角攻击，靠坚硬外壳减少自身受伤。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spins its webs inside caves, often capturing Zubat. If it manages to trap a Rock-type Pokémon in its web, it will attack with its horn, relying on its own hardened carapace to minimize the damage it takes.

entry: POKENAME在大嘴里搅弄大量丝线。合适的猎物靠近，就张大嘴吐出巨网，缠住目标。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME mixes up a large amount of thread within its large mouth. When suitable prey draws near, it opens wide and spits out a huge net of webbing to ensnare its target.

entry: 遭到攻击时，POKENAME会从头顶射出蛛网，希望能困住对手。它甚至会把网当作降落伞，让自己能从高树安全跃下。
author: mistymagius
source: When attacked, POKENAME will fire a net of webbing from the top of its head, hopefully immobilizing its opponent. It will even use its web like a parachute to allow it to safely jump down from tall trees.

entry: 包裹POKENAME的黄色液体是外置神经系统。它能自由操控液体形状，不过更喜欢变成腿。
author: silverscloudy
source: The yellow liquid that envelops POKENAME is its external nervous system. It can freely manipulate the shape of this liquid, though it prefers to form legs.

entry: POKENAME使用超能力时，核心上的角状器官会发光。另一核心专门清除包围身体的特殊液体中的异物。
author: silverscloudy
source: The horn-like organ on POKENAME's core glows when it uses its psychic abilities. Its secondary core is in charge of removing any external objects from the special liquid it is surrounded by.

entry: 翅膀上的网不会自然生长，POKENAME大多时间都用自己的丝重织翅膀。丝极黏，也让它能在翅膀上带小树果。
author: mistymagius
source: The webbing on its wings does not grow naturally, so it spends most of its time rebuilding its wings with its own silk. The silk is incredibly sticky, which allows POKENAME to carry small berries on its wings.

entry: POKENAME从头上毒针高速喷出极易燃的网，困住对手，再以微弱火星点燃。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME secretes highly flammable webs at high velocity from the stinger on its head. It uses this ability to entrap its opponents, then ignites the web with a weak ember.

entry: POKENAME的叶片极黏。过去，僧侣与抄写员会嚼叶制胶，用来装订书籍和手稿。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME's fronds are incredibly sticky. Monks and scribes used to chew POKENAME leaves to create glue for binding books and manuscripts.

entry: POKENAME把柔滑黏丝制成绒球，住在密林里。赫拉克罗斯、凯罗斯等大虫战斗时，它就站在场边加油。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME fashions itself pom-poms made of its silky, sticky web. It lives in dense forests and stands on the sidelines of battles between larger bugs like Heracross and Pinsir, cheering them on.

entry: POKENAME水下结网，横跨河流。多数时候只困住漂浮杂物，一旦黏住宝可梦，就立刻赶来猛咬，不让对方挣脱。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spins its webs underwater, stretching them across rivers. While it mostly traps floating debris, if the sticky web catches another Pokémon, POKENAME will rush in to attack with its powerful bite before it can break free.

entry: 刚出生的POKENAME抢在其他兄弟姐妹醒前采树果，因为同胞一批就可能超过100只。它最爱找亚开果，确保自己足够强韧，守得住藏粮。
author: quackquackattack
source: Newborn POKENAME rush to gather berries before the rest of their siblings can awaken, as their siblings can number upwards of 100 at a time. They seek out the Kee Berry over all others to ensure they are tough enough to defend their berry stashes.

entry: POKENAME夜里最活跃。无论睡没睡，它都睁着眼，身体静止不动，因此很难判断是否睡着。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is most active at night. It is difficult to tell if it is asleep, as its eyes remain open and its body remains very still regardless.

entry: POKENAME双翼裹着黏丝，飞行时便能捕到小虫。丝柔软灵活，是制作各种寝具的好材料。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's wings are wrapped in a sticky silk, allowing it to catch small insects as it flies. The silk is both soft and flexible, making it an excellent material for many different bedding items.

entry: POKENAME的毛由细丝组成，任何表面都能轻松爬上。它在废楼筑巢，织的网大到能捕住一辆巴士。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's fur is made of thin strands of silk, allowing it to climb any surface with ease. It nests in abandoned buildings, spinning webs large enough to catch a bus.

entry: POKENAME羽毛间的丝网让它展开双翼时能兜住空气。招牌招式是飞身重压，将敌人压住，再用大颚咬入、注毒。
author: infinex21
source: The silk webbing between each of POKENAME's feathers allows them to catch the air when they spread their wings. Their signature move is a Flying Press that pins their foes down as they bite them with their mandibles and inject their poison into them.

entry: 许多人和宝可梦争相寻找POKENAME迷人的蘑菇。它喜欢隐居，藏在枯叶下，用黏丝捕捉小型猎物。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME's mesmerizing mushrooms are sought after by many people and Pokémon alike. It likes to live in seclusion, hiding under dead leaves and trapping smaller prey with its sticky silk.

entry: POKENAME一结好网，就会格外好斗，连训练家靠近也咬。毒虽不致命，却会让受害者虚弱迟缓，直到接受治疗。
author: darkweavile428
source: Once POKENAME spins a web, it will become so aggressive that it will even bite its own Trainer should they come too near. These bites contain a venom that, while not fatal, will make the recipient feel weak and sluggish until it is treated.

entry: POKENAME把丝网织成竖琴，演奏甜美音乐，据说能引来毫无戒心的宝可梦。它极难寻，研究者说，唯有献上它喜欢的音乐，才会现身起舞。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME weave their webbing into harps to play sweet music that has been rumored to lure in unassuming Pokémon. They are highly elusive, researchers say that they will only appear to dance for those who offer it music it likes.

entry: POKENAME织的网大却脆，多数宝可梦碰上就能直接穿破。不过，断丝会黏住对方，携带真菌孢子，随它们传往各处。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME weaves a large but fragile web, and most Pokémon that make contact simply break through it. However, the strands of broken webbing that stick to them carry POKENAME's fungal spores, spreading them wherever they travel next.

entry: POKENAME的丝不太适合结网，因此更喜欢挖地洞。身上的毛发保暖，让它在冬季也能狩猎。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's silk is not very good at making webs, so it prefers to make a burrow instead. the hair on its body keeps it body warm and allows for it to hunt during the winter months.

entry: POKENAME睡着时在南瓜间结网。感到动静，就使出黑夜魔影，保护闹鬼的瓜田。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins webs between pumpkins while it sleeps. If it senses movement, it strikes with Night Shade to protect its haunted patch.

entry: POKENAME浮在水面下，用钢铁般强韧的网捕猎。叶状身体随季节变色，便于伪装。
author: .izik
source: Floating just beneath the water's surface, POKENAME uses webbing as strong as steel to snare prey. Its leafy body shifts colors with the seasons for camouflage.

entry: POKENAME在地下陷坑里铺黏网。落网猎物会仔细包裹，存着日后吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lines its underground pitfalls with sticky webs. Trapped prey are carefully wrapped and stored for later consumption.

entry: POKENAME把防水丝固定在珊瑚枝上，织出精巧图案。若误连到太阳珊瑚，丝常被它的移动扯断，整网崩塌，让自己暴露于捕食者前。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME creates its intricate web design by attaching its waterproof thread to coral branches. Threads accidentally attached to Corsola often break when the Corsola moves, resulting in the whole web collapsing and exposing POKENAME to predators.

entry: POKENAME的隧道塞满蛛网，帮助捕食。三个头各自监测振动，合作交叉定位来源，盼着找到食物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME tunnels are completely filled with webs to aid them in catching food. Each of the three heads monitors the webs for vibration, working together to triangulate the source in hopes of food.

entry: POKENAME常整天待在高处，等猎物被微泛金色的网困住。不过，多数忍不住扑向圆东西，尤其闪闪发亮的。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME will often spend most days perched, waiting for prey to become ensnared in its slightly golden webbing. However, most cannot resist pouncing after round items, especially if they sparkle.

entry: POKENAME从角上吐细丝。产丝腺一堵，角下就积起压力，导致头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produces tenuous strands of silk from its horn. Whenever its silk-producing gland gets clogged, pressure builds up beneath the horn, causing a headache.

entry: POKENAME鳍足间的丝网能黏住猎物。它封住对方的嘴或鳃，使其窒息，确保下一餐到手。
author: quackquackattack
source: The webbing between the flippers of POKENAME allow them to stick to prey. They seal the mouths or gills of their prey to suffocate them and secure their next meal.

entry: POKENAME腹部花纹像一张皱眉的脸。不过，它们常很快乐，爱给幼年宝可梦做蛛网蹦床。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a pattern on their stomachs that resemble a frowning face. Despite the appearance of this pattern, POKENAME are often jovial creatures that enjoy making web trampolines for baby Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME腹部有张友善的脸，引诱其他宝可梦的幼崽。猎物一够得着，就用两条强臂抓住，另一对手臂抵挡附近的其他宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME bellies are decorated with a friendly-looking face, luring in the young of other Pokémon. When their prey is within reach, POKENAME grab hold with two of their powerful arms, fending off other nearby Pokémon with their second pair of arms.

entry: POKENAME疑心很重，织网察觉闯入者，再瞬间移动逃走。觅食时，也靠瞬间移动来回附近的树果灌木。
author: frokachu
source: Due to its paranoid nature, POKENAME will construct webs to detect and teleport away from intruders. It will forage berries by teleporting to and from nearby bushes.

entry: POKENAME用心灵力量，让对手误以为被蛛网困住。特别弱小的宝可梦，甚至会因这精神投影完全动不了。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their telepathic powers to trick opposing Pokémon into believing they have been ensnared within a web. Particularly weak Pokémon become completely immobilised by POKENAME's psychic projection.

entry: POKENAME用角间的网捕获别人的思绪，摄取其中的精神能量。被吃过思绪者说，靠近它时，脑中会有种诡异的寂静。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use the webs stretched between their horns to capture the thoughts of others, feeding on the psychic energy caught this way. Those who have had their thoughts eaten describe experiencing an eerie stillness of the mind whilst near POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的丝极强韧，一根就能承受高达10磅的力。野外求生者常用来制作工具和衣物。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's silk is incredibly strong, a single thread being able to withstand up to 10 pounds of force. Survivalists will often use POKENAME silk to make tools and clothing.

entry: POKENAME在一部极热门的系列作品中化身正义英雄，荡跃楼宇，阻止罪犯。多部漫画、电影与电视剧都以它为主角。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME operates as a hero for justice in a highly popular series, swinging between buildings and stopping criminals. Multiple comics, movies, and TV shows have been made starring POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的藤蔓覆着黏毒，慢慢渗透皮肤，稍沾一点也可能引发严重皮疹。它常藏在常春藤中，伏击毫无防备者。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME's vines are covered in a sticky poison that slowly seeps in through the skin; even mild exposure could result in a bad rash. It frequently hides in ivy waiting to ambush the unwary.

entry: POKENAME夜里沿海滩爬行觅食，似乎很喜欢用触手末端的毒刺扎其他宝可梦。
author: hummusishome
source: POKENAME crawl along beaches at night in search of prey. They seem to enjoy stabbing other Pokémon with the poison barb at the end of their tentacles.

entry: POKENAME借网攀上山壁，牢牢附着。猎物会悬在崖外，留着以后吃。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their webs to scale and cling to the sides of mountains. They leave their prey dangling over cliffs, saving them for later.

entry: POKENAME在岩石与隐蔽角落间织网，强韧又极黏。水生猎物被困后慢下来，便足以让它追上攻击。
author: chibitales
source: Webs spun by POKENAME are sturdy and extremely sticky. They make these webs between rocks and other nooks to catch aquatic prey and slow them down enough for POKENAME to catch up and strike.

entry: 它平时慢吞吞，会织精密的网捕猎。唯一的问题是，猎物真落网了，它又懒得动。
author: bottomusmaximus3
source: Usually quite sluggish, this Pokémon will construct intricate web systems to catch its prey. The only problem is that when something gets caught in it, it's too lazy to move.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，头和肢体能完全缩进壳中，看着像死去已久的空壳，借此自保。醒来探出身体时，常吓坏碰巧在旁的怕蜘蛛者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can retract their limbs and head completely within their shell when they sleep, leaving the impression of a long-dead husk and keeping them safe. Their emergence when they wake often scares any arachnophobe that happens to be nearby.

entry: POKENAME不用催眠，直接让猎物吓得无法动弹。幼年圆丝蛛住在颈间蛛网的庇护中。
author: missingmilkman
source: POKENAME forgoes hypnotism, instead paralyzing its prey with fear. Young Spinarak live within the shelter of the webs around its neck.

entry: 有时能在阿利多斯巢中见到POKENAME。巢受威胁时，它充当防卫武器，向袭击者发射粗网和幼小的阿利多斯。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME are sometimes seen amongst a nest of Ariados. They act as a defensive weapon when the nest is threatened, launching thick webs and young Ariados at the attacker.

entry: POKENAME用死去阿利多斯的一部分作武器，把口腔腺体的毒涂在上面。只划出一道伤口，就能让对方严重衰弱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME wields a part of a deceased Ariados as a weapon in combat. It smears poison from glands in its mouth across the weapon, making just a single wound from it inflict a debilitating condition.

entry: POKENAME织丝面具，驱赶捕食者。手持长矛的矛尖分泌毒液，能击倒体型大得多的宝可梦。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME spin masks made of web to ward off predators. The spear they hold secretes a toxic poison from its tip, which is able to fell much larger Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME选定对手，便迅速织大网笼，当作拳台。除非战胜它，否则对手不许逃走。
author: sk372
source: Once POKENAME chooses an opponent, it quickly spins a large cage of webbing to act as a boxing ring for the match. Its opponent isn't allowed to escape unless it bests POKENAME in a fight.

entry: POKENAME用黏丝挂在枝头。丝网遇水会溶解，因此雨季可能掉到地上。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hangs from tree branches, attached to them with a sticky silk webbing. The webbing dissolves in water, which may cause it to fall onto the ground during a rainy season.

entry: POKENAME住在洞里，用细长腿探索黑暗，身体留在安全处。它们成群外出觅食，附近居民被提醒，别吸入遗落的麻痹鳞粉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in caves, using their long spindly legs to feel around in the darkness whilst keeping their body safe. They emerge in swarms to find food, nearby residents are advised to avoid breathing in the paralytic wing scales they leave behind.

entry: POKENAME的指尖触碰自己的丝，不会被黏住，因此能将丝织成各种形状。它们常喜欢完全用自己的丝，为别人编织肖像。
author: infinex21
source: The tips of POKENAME's fingers allow them to touch their own silk without it getting stuck to them, which allows them to weave their strands into many different shapes. They often love to create portraits of others made purely of their own silk.

entry: POKENAME不停在双钳间编织复杂图案。只要会动就吃，六腿猛爬，冲向猎物。
author: missingmilkman
source: POKENAME endlessly weaves complex silk patterns between its pincers. It feeds on anything that moves, scuttering violently towards its prey on all six legs.

entry: POKENAME在枝间织许多小网捕虫。发现猎物被困，就用角的分泌物下毒，再吃掉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spins a myriad of small webs across branches to catch insects in. Once it finds one stuck in its trap, it poisons them with the secretions from its horn before consuming them.

entry: POKENAME织成尾巴形的强韧网，帮助吸引大舌贝等猎物。水手有时训练它用网绑牢货物，便于远航。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME weave a strong web in the shape of a tail that aids them in attracting prey like Shellder. They are sometimes trained by sailors to use their webs to better secure cargo for long voyages.

entry: POKENAME的毛其实是自己织在身上、用来保护的细丝。天然暖意常引得弱小宝可梦想抱，结果被困住，日后成了它的一餐。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's fur is actually a fine silk that it has woven around its own body for protection. Due to its natural warmth, many weaker Pokémon are easily tempted to embrace this silk and will become trapped to later serve as a meal for an POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME脱落片状外壳，以便生长。碎片极黏，遇雨会溶解。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sheds flakes of its shell in order to grow. The flakes are extremely sticky and dissolve in the rain.

entry: POKENAME拖着网在空中翱翔，寻找猎物。它伺机捕食，4条腿抓得到的什么都吃。
author: universal9449
source: POKENAME soar through the sky with its web trailing behind it on the search for prey. POKENAME are opportunistic hunters that will capture anything they can grasp with their 4 legs.

entry: POKENAME行踪隐秘，很少离开所住的洞穴。洞里铺着许多蛛网，足以捕来丰富猎物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are elusive and rarely leave the caves they live in. These same caves are lined with many webs that ensnare plenty of prey.

entry: POKENAME用紫色晶体的光引诱猎物，落入强韧蛛网，再迅速使出带毒的咬住，将其解决。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use the glow of their purple crystals to lure prey into their strong webs. They will finish them quickly with their venomous Bite attacks.

entry: POKENAME巢中的蜜对同类完全无害，其他生物食用却有毒。长期吃会导致失明。
author: .izik
source: While completely harmless to its own kind, the honey in an POKENAME nest is poisonous if ingested. Prolonged consumption can cause blindness.

entry: POKENAME能同时吐多缕丝，迅速为圆丝蛛织网。网呈双螺旋形，圆丝蛛很容易在上面休息。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can generate multiple strands of webbing at once in order to create quick webs for Spinarak. Since POKENAME's webbing takes on the form of a double helix, Spinarak can easily rest on it.

entry: POKENAME嘴里产生浓稠的番石榴蜜汁，能含住1加仑，随后便会流出来。训练家会一边抚摸它的花瓣，一边将蜜汁稀释饮用，帮它解决这个问题。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produces a thick guava nectar from its mouth and can hold a gallon of the nectar until it drools out. To help with this issue, Trainers dilute and drink this sweet drink while petting its flower petals.

entry: 这个罕见POKENAME变体失去了翅膀与毒针，却长出牢固抓握能力，能持用针状武器。会借丝线疾冲、延伸针击。聪明善思，仍有强烈领地意识。
author: lutrax
source: This rare variant of POKENAME lost its wings and needles but developed a firm grasp to use needle-like weapons. Its silk is now used to dash and extend its needle. It is highly intelligent and capable of deep thoughts, but still territorial.

entry: POKENAME脚尖极黏，能爬上完全垂直的表面，也能黏在天花板上。
author: .izik
source: The tips of POKENAME's feet are extremely sticky. It has the ability to climb up completely vertical surfaces and cling to the ceiling.

entry: 别被模样骗了，POKENAME极容易受惊发怒。许多训练家想用手捧起野生POKENAME，最后都得就医。
author: gotfyr
source: Despite appearances, POKENAME are easily agitated. Many Trainers have needed medical attention after trying to hold wild POKENAME in their hands.

entry: 每只POKENAME都自认是最强的超级反派。那些邪恶计划，让宝可梦与训练家，都大伤脑筋。
author: gotfyr
source: Each POKENAME sees itself as the ultimate super villain. Their evil schemes make them quite the nuisance to both Pokémon and Trainers alike.

entry: POKENAME织密集毒网，使落网者麻痹。它在树间潜行，从背后出击，把嘴边伸出的强壮白钳扎进毫无戒心的猎物。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME weaves dense, venom-laced webs that paralyze those who get trapped. It moves stealthily among the trees and strikes from behind, sinking its powerful white pincers, protruding from its mouth, into its unsuspecting prey.

entry: POKENAME的尖刺与大颚不停渗出致命毒液。虽利于狩猎，却常意外使伙伴中毒，令它孤独。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME's spikes and mandibles constantly leak a deadly poison. Although this is useful for hunting, it leads to POKENAME being lonely, as it tends to accidentally poison its companions.

entry: POKENAME主要夜行，在树枝和织好的网上爬。弄脏时，用多条腿梳翅，清掉羽毛里的细枝、树叶和寄生虫。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are mostly active at night, crawling through tree branches and constructed webs. When they are dirty, they use their many legs to groom their wings, pulling out twigs, leaves, and parasites that get caught in their feathers.

entry: POKENAME极轻，最微小的风也能带走。它怕飘走，睡觉时总牢牢抓住物体表面。
author: .izik
source: Due to POKENAME's light weight, even the smallest breeze will carry it. It clings tightly to any surface when it sleeps in fear of floating away.

entry: POKENAME花数小时，把丝织成结实的网。狩猎时俯冲，用黏网裹住猎物，再迅速飞回巢。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME spends hours crafting its webs into sturdy nets. It hunts by swooping down and tangling its prey in the sticky netting before swiftly flying back to its nest.

entry: 雷雨时，POKENAME张嘴朝天，绕圈奔跑。喝够水，就在最近的池塘睡着。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME runs in circles during thunderstorms while holding its mouth open to the sky. Once it drinks enough water it will fall asleep in the closest pond.

entry: POKENAME出奇温顺，只有自己或朋友受其他宝可梦威胁，才变得好斗。它头脑简单，交起朋友却很费劲；一旦结交，便是强大伙伴。
author: roninthedev
source: POKENAME's are surprisingly docile, only becoming aggressive when they or their friends are threatened by another Pokémon. Their simple mindset makes them annoying to befriend, but they are a powerful companion once befriended.

entry: POKENAME用树皮与粗红丝混合筑巢。吃东西时受扰，会发出人类般的尖叫。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's nest is made of a mixture of tree bark and a thick red silk. Should it be disturbed while eating, it will scream like a human.

entry: POKENAME侵占老建筑，啃进墙里，织出密集的网巢。很难从屋里彻底清除，不停抓挠与吱叫，让人难以同住。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME infest old buildings, gnawing their way into the walls and building dense webbed nests within them. They are difficult to fully expunge from a house; their incessant scratching and squeaking make it unpleasant to live with their presence.

entry: POKENAME叶上的囊中充满好斗的毒蜘蛛。咬伤虽不致命，毒性却足以使成年人昏迷。
author: unchatzarb
source: The sacs on POKENAME's leaves are filled with poisonous spiders that are aggressive in nature. Though their bites are not fatal, they are capable of knocking out an adult human.

entry: POKENAME小群同住，潜伏树梢。它们合作用丝织文字，常在树冠中拼出未知语言的复杂句子。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME live together in small colonies, lurking in the treetops. Together, they spin letters out of web, often creating complex sentences of an unknown language in the canopy.

entry: 遭重拳击中，POKENAME会把黏丝吐到对方拳上，再将困住的敌人甩起，以惊人力量砸向地面。
author: .izik
source: If struck by a powerful punch, POKENAME spits adhesive silk onto its opponent's fist. It then swings the trapped foe around, slamming them into the ground with incredible force.

entry: POKENAME栖在两枝交角，精织垂在下方的网。它用上侧的腿在枝间奔跑切换，捞起下方猎物，拖回巢中。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME perch at the corners between two branches, weaving intricate nets that hang below them. They use their upper legs to run along and shift between different branches, scooping up any prey beneath them and dragging them into their nests.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴掘地，藏进洞里等猎物。巢边拉着毒丝警戒线，一有落网猎物，就提醒它拖进来。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME burrow holes into the ground with their tails, retreating inside to wait for prey. They set up strings of toxic threads around their den that act as tripwires, alerting them when it's time to pull their fallen prey inside.

entry: POKENAME族群在密林深处织出庞大的漏斗网。它们所住区域难以穿越，需要专用装备，才不至于困在林下灌丛中。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME colonies create a vast network of funnel webs deep within forests. The areas they call home are difficult for people to traverse and require specialist gear to avoid getting stuck in the undergrowth.

entry: 受过训练的POKENAME在建筑业备受重视。翅膀、蛛网和黏爪让它能到达难以接近的位置，修补建筑结构。
author: linhasxoc
source: Trained POKENAME are highly valued in construction. They use their wings, webs, and sticky claws to access hard-to-reach locations and perform structural repairs.

entry: POKENAME在林中漫游，倒刺不断放出黏丝。之后沿原路返回，吃掉被沿途蛛丝困住的小宝可梦。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME wanders throughout the forest, constantly releasing sticky silk from its barbs. It later retraces its steps, feasting on small Pokémon caught in its silken trail.

entry: POKENAME嘴里吐出的丝，一碰到东西就冻结。它借此将猎物裹成冰茧，还常把冻食挂起来，留着以后吃。
author: .jerden
source: The silk thread that POKENAME spits out from its mouth will freeze as soon as it makes contact with anything. POKENAME uses this to envelop prey in cocoons of ice, and often hangs up frozen food to eat later.

entry: POKENAME洞里满是大网，既保卫家园，也能白得食物。冬眠前会织一只装满猎物的茧，等春天再享用。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's den is filled with many large webs that both protect its home and catch free food. Before hibernation, it will create a cocoon filled with its prey to consume once spring comes.

entry: POKENAME壳中渗出鲜黄毒液。黄色正是警告，表明毒性强烈。
author: hophoppip
source: Bright yellow poison seeps from POKENAME's shell. The yellow color is a warning sign of the poison's potency.

entry: POKENAME在伸展的肢体间织网，结构紧密轻巧，足以充当翅膀。它飞得笨拙，却能长途往来不同森林。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME weaves webs to span between outstretched limbs, weaving them into a tight and light enough structure that they can function as wings. It is clumsy in flight, but can travel long distances between forests.

entry: 这种水生宝可梦从嘴里精准喷出黏网捕猎。网在水下黏性较弱，因此会避开与游泳敌人的战斗。
author: hophoppip
source: This aquatic Pokémon captures its prey with precise blasts of sticky webbing from its mouth. The webbing is less sticky underwater, so it shies away from fights against swimming enemies.

entry: POKENAME在伸展的肢体间织网，结构紧密轻巧，足以充当翅膀。它飞得笨拙，却能长途往来不同森林。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME weaves webs to span between outstretched limbs, weaving them into a tight and light enough structure that they can function as wings. It is clumsy in flight, but can travel long distances between forests.

entry: POKENAME战斗时贴近地面，先布网把对手困在场内，再出击。被逼到角落，会迅速从背后放丝，荡走绕回，再踢上一脚。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME stay low to the ground during battle, placing down webs to trap their opponents within the arena before they strike. If backed into a corner, POKENAME will rapidly extend webs from their backs to sling away and loop back around for a kick.

entry: POKENAME极其胆小，不停迁巢，从不在同一带留过一天。若被发现，就朝目击者吐网，热到足以熔石。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is extremely timid, constantly relocating its nest and never staying in one area for more than a day. Should it be spotted, it spits a web at the observer that is hot enough to melt stone.

entry: POKENAME的角不断产丝，在身上披成飘动鬃毛。到沼泽时会甩头，用网捕来大量虫子，留着以后吃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's horn constantly creates thread that becomes a flowing mane over its body. It swings its head around while visiting swampy areas, collecting large amounts of bugs in the web for it to consume later.

entry: POKENAME连垂直崖壁也爬得上。虽能吐丝，主要用来从猎物上方缓缓垂下，再用尖角与强牙攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's legs enable it to climb up even vertical cliff faces. While it can spin silk, it mostly uses this to slowly lower itself down on prey from above, then attack with its sharp horn and powerful fangs.

entry: POKENAME的牙能磨成粉，制成多种口红。密阿雷市的时尚达人会使用这种配方。
author: .izik
source: The fangs of an POKENAME can be ground up to create various forms of lipstick. This blend is used in Lumiosa City by fashion gurus.

entry: 魔法阵形的蛛网，明确表明POKENAME就在附近。织出的图形不同，便带有不同诅咒之力，确保没有东西能威胁它。
author: infinex21
source: Webs spun in the shape of magic circles are a clear sign that an POKENAME is near. Depending on the shapes spun with these webs, they will be imbued with the powers of different curses that ensure none can pose a threat to this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在洞穴或树冠筑巢，静观附近经过的一切。它太怕因外貌遭恶待，从不现身，却会留下蛛丝雕塑，作为礼物送人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME nest within caves or the canopies of trees, quietly observing all that cross nearby. They are too fearful of being treated poorly due to their looks to ever show themselves, but they will leave sculptures made of silk for others as gifts.

entry: POKENAME用唾液慢慢溶解食物，再吸进去。不过，若遇到猎物宝可梦，就改用体重先压扁再吃。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME use their drool to slowly dissolve their food to slurp it up. When encountering prey Pokémon, POKENAME instead opt to flatten their prey with their body weight before consumption.

entry: POKENAME看着庞大，却能轻松附在洞顶。它垂下许多藤蔓，引诱并缠住猎物，再拉进体内。
author: infinex21
source: Despite how large they appear, POKENAME can effortlessly cling to cave ceilings. They will let many of their vines drape to entice and ensnare prey before pulling them within.

entry: 久而久之，POKENAME会选定林中一棵树，专门围着结网。这样能清除害虫，让树在未来数月里茁壮生长。
author: sk372
source: Over time, POKENAME will choose a specific tree in a forest to spin its webs around in particular. Keeping the tree free of pests in this way allows the plant to flourish and grow more vibrantly in the coming months.

entry: POKENAME吃肉，用毒液软化猎物。山林之外虽罕见，出色的滑翔与攀爬本领，却让它可能出现在任何地方。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is carnivorous and uses venom to soften up prey. Although rare outside mountains or forests, POKENAME can be found anywhere due to its incredible gliding and climbing abilities.

entry: POKENAME的大颚与手臂都能吐丝。身体容易出故障，织的网也常凌乱无章。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can generate silken threads from both its mandibles and its arms. Due to its body's tendency to glitch out, the webs it creates are often messy and haphazard in form.

entry: POKENAME是攀爬高手，能轻松在树间跳跃。爪上覆毒，能迅速让猎物失去行动能力。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are expert climbers, jumping from tree-to-tree with little effort. Its claws are coated in poison, which it uses to quickly incapacitate its prey.

entry: POKENAME腹部的黑色花纹，像一只小圆丝蛛。它们想借此显得更小，但其他部位的颜色太鲜艳，这项技巧大多没有效果。
author: heal_fire
source: On the bellies of these Pokémon, there is a black pattern that resembles a tiny Spinarak. POKENAME try to use this to appear smaller, but due to the flashy colors on their other body parts, this technique has proven to be mostly ineffective.

entry: POKENAME虽能吐丝，却太重，无法附在网上。它改在地面织温暖小巢睡觉。全身硬如石，仍爱被揉肚子，脚掌也很敏感。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME can produce silk, but due to its weight, it cannot stick to webs. Instead, it creates a tiny nest on the ground to sleep warmly. Despite POKENAME's whole body being as hard as a rock, it loves belly rubs and has very sensitive paws.

entry: POKENAME用坚爪钻透洞壁，也用来将丝线织成网。它们潜伏在洞顶，发现猎物，便让锐刺朝下，朝对方坠落。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their tough claws to tunnel through cave walls and to weave their silk webbing into webs. They will lurk upon the ceilings of caves and drop, with their sharp quills aimed down, upon prey.

entry: POKENAME能从最远1英里外精准喷出水柱。视力极其发达，还能察觉热源。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can accurately spray jets of water from up to a mile away. Its eyesight is extremely advanced and able to pick up heat signatures.

entry: 它聪明得危险，会在领地里拉丝，沿丝轻跃，乍看仿佛踏空而行。靠精神力量，能同时迅速布放并操控无数丝线。
author: infinex21
source: Dangerously clever, it will string up its own silk threads around its territory and prance along them; at a glance, most think it to be walking on air. It uses its psychic power to swiftly cast about and control countless threads simultaneously.

entry: POKENAME常因外貌遭到恶评。据说善待它的人，会获赠最华美的丝衣，以及一位能用蛛网挡住所有敌人的忠诚伙伴。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are often horribly judged for their appearance. Its said that those who treat them with kindness will be blessed with the most luxurious silk outfits and a loyal companion whose webs will keep all foes at bay.

entry: POKENAME吃树根和多叶草本。若闻到地下有根，就用尖爪利牙飞快刨土。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's diet consists of tree roots and leafy herbs. Should it smell a root underground, it will use its sharp claws and fangs to rapidly dig into the soil.

entry: POKENAME从角上放出毒网，将敌人拖近，再用角补上一击。毒性虽相对弱，仍能引发严重偏头痛和迟缓，约1小时后才消退。
author: evilgammon
source: Able to secrete a toxic web from its horn, POKENAME shoots it at its foes to rope them in for a follow-up horn attack. While the toxin is relatively weak, it's enough to induce strong migraines and sluggishness for around an hour before wearing off.

entry: POKENAME的网由纤细坚固的金属构成，可拆解后用于制造飞机引擎。
author: .izik
source: The web deployed by an POKENAME is made up of a thin and sturdy metal. This web can be broken down and used in the construction of airplane engines.

entry: POKENAME用黏网绑住原木，建成结实小屋。蛛网耐水，即使完全浸没也保持完好。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME binds logs together with its sticky web to create sturdy lodges. The webbing resists water damage, staying intact even when fully submerged.

entry: POKENAME把楔石藏在网里，混在其他闪亮石头中。东西靠得太近，就使出毒击。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME's hide their keystone in their web among other shiny stones. When something gets too close, POKENAME lashes out with Poison Jab.

entry: POKENAME收养无家的幼年圆丝蛛，背着它们缓缓穿林。它用强丝配合有力藤蔓采食，直到幼蛛能自己狩猎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will adopt young Spinarak without a home, carrying them on its back as it lumbers through the forests. It uses a combination of strong silk and powerful vines to gather food for them until they can hunt on their own.

entry: POKENAME在背上织卵囊，始终背着，直到蛋即将孵化。幼崽远小于成体，却长得很快。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME weave an egg sack on their back that they carry with them at all times until the eggs are ready to hatch. Their young are far smaller than an adult POKENAME but they grow rapidly.

entry: POKENAME用头上诱饵伪装，潜进阿利多斯巢，抱满一怀蛋逃走。若被揭穿，就装无辜。
author: wigglypon
source: Using the decoy on its head as a disguise, POKENAME infiltrates Ariados nests and absconds with an armful of eggs. If exposed, it puts on an innocent act.

entry: POKENAME织出复杂的蛛网迷宫。困在网上的宝可梦会被吃掉。走到迷宫终点的，会遇到POKENAME——也会被吃掉。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME weaves a complex maze of webs. Pokémon caught in the webs are devoured. Those who reach the end of the maze will meet POKENAME. They, too, are devoured.

entry: POKENAME外貌像阿利多斯，能混进它们的族群。它不会织网、不会狩猎，只能小心偷拿无人看管网上的猎物，生怕惹怒阿利多斯。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's similar appearance to Ariados allows it to hide among their colonies. Lacking webbing or hunting skills, it carefully swipes prey from unattended webs, fearful of inciting Ariados's ire.
