entry: POKENAME常靠蛮力克服障碍和敌人。累了就爬树，睡上超过半天。
author: whiteupgrade
source: POKENAME often uses brute force to overcome obstacles and enemies. When it's tired, it climbs up a tree and sleeps for more than half a day.

entry: POKENAME身上放出的绿色蛛网微微发光。全黑时，眼睛会泛出诡异光芒。
author: .izik
source: The green web that comes from POKENAME's body is slightly luminous. When in complete darkness, its eye lets off an eerie glow.

entry: POKENAME借大树干和深影遮住鲜艳身体。小鸟或虫宝可梦靠近时，便从腹部的嘴使出吐丝，把猎物拖进树洞。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: To conceal its bright body, POKENAME relies on the trunks of large forest trees and their deep shadows. When small birds or Bug Pokémon draw near, it fires a String Shot from the mouth on its stomach, dragging its prey into the hollow.

entry: POKENAME偶尔离开黑暗海底的住处，上岸在森林边休息，让圆丝蛛爬上来。随后载着小蜘蛛去新家，再返回海中。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME occasionally comes up from its dark undersea dwelling to go on land and rest near forests and let Spinarak climb atop it. It then ferries the small spiders off to a new home before returning to the sea.

entry: POKENAME织出壮丽的蛛网，详述已知宇宙的历史。为免艺术品受损，会先用一层丝网遮住训练家眼睛，再引向别处。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME create glorious displays of webs that detail the history of the known universe. To ensure nothing damages their works of art, they blind Trainers with a layer of silk webs before luring them away.

entry: POKENAME角中储存加压的毒液，能高速喷射。最远1英里外的静止目标也打得中。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stores pressurized venom in its horn and can fire it at high speeds. It can hit a stationary target from up to 1 mile away.

entry: 战斗中，POKENAME在树间疾跃，吐黏丝设陷阱。见到机会，就跳下猛打敌人。
author: bobosmith01
source: In battle, POKENAME darts from tree to tree, spitting sticky threads and setting up traps for foes to get stuck in. When it sees an opportunity, it leaps down and pummels the foe.

entry: 战斗中，POKENAME在树间疾跃，吐黏丝设陷阱。见到机会，就跳下猛打敌人。
author: bobosmith01
source: In battle, POKENAME darts from tree to tree, spitting sticky threads and setting up traps for foes to get stuck in. When it sees an opportunity, it leaps down and pummels the foe.

entry: POKENAME从鼻孔射出粗网，捕住远处猎物，再拉近，用短短的石质肢体夹碎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME shoots nets of thick webbing out of its nostrils to capture distant prey. It reels them in closer to it so it can crush them between its short stone limbs.

entry: POKENAME的网涂着使人衰弱的毒，接触皮肤便会吸收。毒不由纺丝器产生，而是用体侧长出的肢体，从刺上收集后涂到丝上。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The webs POKENAME spin are coated in a debilitating toxin that is absorbed through skin contact. Their spinnerets do not produce this toxin; instead, they use limbs sprouting from their flanks to gather toxins from their spines to add to the silk.

entry: 野生POKENAME不猎食、不战斗时，就忙着用丝制造复杂蛛网与陷阱。头角硬如铁，其中毒素常用于制作强效药。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME spend their time creating intricate webs and traps using their silk webbing when they are not hunting or battling. The horn upon an POKENAME's head is iron-hard and contains a toxin oft used to make potent remedies.

entry: POKENAME最上方手臂的伸缩爪分泌强毒，只要伤口够深，就能妨碍敌人行动。吐丝织出的网堪比某些金属强韧，深受工匠珍视。
author: infinex21
source: The retractable claws of POKENAME's uppermost arms secrete a potent poison that can impair a foe from a deep-enough cut. The silk webbing they spit and weave is as tough as some metals, making it prized by many artisans.

entry: POKENAME用翅膀发出声波，震晕猎物或吓退捕食者。蛛丝对声音十分敏感，许多吉他手喜欢用来制琴弦。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's wings are used to emit sonic waves that stun prey or that scare away predators. Their silk webs are rather keenly attuned to sounds, and many guitarists prefer to use this silk webbing for their strings.

entry: 裁缝与科学家都研究POKENAME独特的纺丝方式。它转动身体，将网绕轴推送，同时挤出丝线，保持图案轻巧牢固。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have been studied by both tailors and scientists for their unique method of spinning thread. As their bodies turn and push the web around an axis, their webbing is extruded to keep their designs light and secure.

entry: POKENAME头、尾的毒刺都毒性极强，锋利到连厚甲也刺得穿。它先附在洞壁或峡谷壁上，再跃下增强攻击冲力。
author: .jerden
source: The stingers on POKENAME's head and tail are both highly venomous, and sharp enough to pierce even thick armor. It will cling to the walls of caves and canyons, then leap down to increase the impact of its attack.

entry: 传说POKENAME曾以坚不可摧的网拖动大陆。至今所产丝仍极强韧，研究者推测超过任何人造材料。
author: shyguy11011
source: Legends claim POKENAME once towed continents using its indestructible webs. Even now, it creates incredibly strong silk that researchers theorize surpasses any man-made material.

entry: POKENAME以自行惩恶闻名，多人钦佩，少数鄙弃。它从手上射网，荡跃穿行，捕住敌人。
author: violet_zero
source: POKENAME has a reputation as a vigilante, admired by many and scorned by few. It shoots webs from its hands to swing around and snare its foes.

entry: POKENAME振翅太快，哪怕碰上一粒灰尘，也容易撕裂。遇到这种事，许多个体会织柔滑的蛛网翅膀替换。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME flap their wings so quickly that they easily tear when met with a speck of dust. Many weave silky, webbed wings as replacements whenever this occurs.

entry: POKENAME把自身等离子体展开成大网，威吓其他生物，也捕捉、电焦小型猎物。它吐出的黏丝能承受强电流而不损坏。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME expand their own plasma like a large web to intimidate others and to catch, and subsequently fry, small prey. They produce and spit sticky threads that can conduct strong electrical currents without being damaged.

entry: POKENAME是较好斗的蛛形融合体之一，在家周围大片区域布下带电蛛网。穿过领地却不触电、不落网，几乎不可能。
author: sk372
source: One of the more aggressive arachnid fusions, POKENAME covers a large area surrounding its home with electrically-charged webbing. It's nearly impossible to traverse through its territory without being shocked or ensnared.

entry: POKENAME从海底射黏网，捉住上方船只。一缠牢，就把船拖进水下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires a sticky web from the seafloor to catch boats from below. Once it latches onto a vessel, it will drag it under the water.

entry: POKENAME聪明，会用网捕捉小虫，捆在身上。再积攒大量虫子，与其他宝可梦换更大的一餐。
author: mistymagius
source: This clever Pokémon collects smaller bugs in its webs and then keeps them tied up on its body. POKENAME then trades large amounts of them with other Pokémon for larger meals.

entry: 它们很难用细腿站稳，常得靠自己的网找个落脚处。尽管如此，多腿却是有效武器，能快速连刺，直到敌人屈服。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon struggle to stand on their thin legs, often having to use their own webs to give them a perch. Despite this, their multiple legs make for effective weapons that they will rapidly jab their foes with until they submit.

entry: POKENAME主要住在深洞，织精密蛛网。丝上覆着余烬，可随意点燃，让任何落网者陷入火海。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME primarily live in deep caves, spinning intricate webs. These Pokémon cover their silk in embers that they can ignite at will, engulfing anything caught inside in flames.

entry: POKENAME很少用下肢。两个真头常忙着争吵，尾尖便有第三个假头，防止被偷袭。
author: chromaerym
source: POKENAME rarely use their lower limbs. On their tail tip is a fake third head to prevent ambushes since the two true heads are often busy arguing.

entry: POKENAME很少用下肢。两个真头常忙着争吵，尾尖便有第三个假头，防止被偷袭。
author: chromaerym
source: POKENAME rarely uses its lower limbs. On its tail tip is a fake third head to prevent ambushes, since the two true heads are often busy arguing.

entry: 这种虫宝可梦往往只见于大洞穴，用翼状肢体抓住洞顶，细看下方经过的一切。三个头能喷网，将猎物缠住拖走。
author: infinex21
source: Often found only in large caves, these bug Pokémon use their wing-like limbs to grapple and cling to the ceilings and carefully watch all who pass below. They will spew webbing from their three heads to ensnare and drag away their prey.

entry: POKENAME胆怯善躲，通常潜伏在森林、丛林或洞穴深处。只有夜里才出来找树果、坚果，之后仿佛凭空消失。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are skittish and evasive bug Pokémon that typically lurk within the depths of forests, jungles, or caves. They only emerge at night to forage for berries and nuts, before seemingly disappearing into thin air.

entry: 这种虫宝可梦智力极高，能理解半径1英里内其他生物的想法，甚至感受情绪。它常在城镇，好奇地观察人和宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: These highly-intelligent bug Pokémon are able to understand the thoughts of others within a mile radius and can even feel their emotions as well. They are often found in cities and towns watching people and Pokémon alike with ample curiosity.

entry: POKENAME的肢体与卷须极灵巧，能像人手般精细操作。蛛网形似DNA，却与地球上任何已知序列都不相符。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME's limbs and tendrils are highly dextrous, capable of fine manipulation like a human's hands. The webs it weaves resemble DNA, but match with no known sequence on the planet.

entry: POKENAME喜欢嚼丛林藤蔓，胜过活的猎物。一天轻轻松松就能吃掉50磅藤蔓。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers to chew on jungle vines rather than any live prey. It can quickly consume 50 lbs of vines per day.

entry: 焦虑时，它会疯狂嚼木头。POKENAME若压力过大，能把一片小森林夷平。
author: .izik
source: It frantically chews wood whenever it is anxious. Should an POKENAME become over-stressed, it can level a small forest.

entry: 有些研究者认为，POKENAME的厚皮其实只是外壳，真正的身体藏在里面。它吃岩石与矿物，在所住洞穴布满陷阱，防备入侵者。
author: infinex21
source: Some researchers believe that the thick hide of POKENAME is actually just shells that contain their true forms. They eat rocks and minerals and will entrap their cavernous homes to protect themselves from intruders.

entry: POKENAME嘴里吐出的丝，质地如白银。藻玉镇的工匠会将其熔化，制作高脚杯。
author: .izik
source: The silk that comes from an POKENAME's mouth has the same consistency as silver. Artisans in Wisteria Town melt it down and craft goblets from it.

entry: 它们通常藏在沙漠深处，搅动猎物脚下的沙，将其拖进等候的大嘴。周围布着蛛丝警戒线，提醒有什么靠近。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon typically dwell within the sandy depths of deserts, waiting to churn the sand beneath their prey and drag them into their awaiting maws. They lay tripwires of silk webbing about to alert them when something is approaching them.

entry: POKENAME布下无数蛛网后躲起来。它不等猎物自己落网，而是振翅制造冲击波，将其撞进黏丝。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sets up countless webs before hiding itself away. Rather than waiting for prey to stumble into webs, it uses shockwaves generated by its beating wings to knock them into the sticky threads.

entry: POKENAME拍翅既能飞，也能发出声波，在沙漠领地中辨路。腿很强壮，能牢牢缠住敌人，直到毒液使其昏倒。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME flutter their wings both for flight and to loose sonic waves to help them navigate through their desert territories. Their legs are so strong they can latch onto their foes and constrict them until their venom knocks them out.

entry: 它在猎物面前垂下圆丝蛛状的诱饵。一分散注意，POKENAME便咬住颈部，注入致命毒液。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: It dangles a lure that resembles Spinarak in front of its prey. Once the victim is distracted, POKENAME injects a deadly venom through a bite to the neck.

entry: POKENAME夜里从树上垂下甜香丝线，引诱虫属性宝可梦。等待出击时，胶状身体随着心跳闪动黄光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dangles a sweet-scented silk thread from trees to lure Bug-types at night. Its gelatinous body pulses with yellow light in rhythm with its heartbeat as it waits to strike.

entry: POKENAME蜂蜜般的胶状身体散发腻人的甜香，引多数虫宝可梦进入强韧蛛网。身体与两颗心脏同步搏动，泛着蜜金色光。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's honey-like gelatinous body emits a sickly sweet scent that lures most Bug Pokémon into its durable webs. Its body throbs and glows with a honey-gold light in tandem with the beating of its two hearts.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着粉色黏网。溶进水后，可当维生素补充剂。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is covered in a sticky, pink web. If dissolved in water, this web can be used as a vitamin supplement.

entry: POKENAME住在枝条下侧，藏在阴影中。走林间小径的登山男被提醒留心，突然动作若吓到它，可能引来毒刺。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME live on the underside of tree branches, hidden in the shadows. Hikers that walk trails in the forest are recommended to keep an eye out for them, as any sudden movements that startle POKENAME can cause it to shoot poisoned barbs.

entry: POKENAME用网捕猎。网中集够食物，便带着飞回巢，喂给幼崽。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its webbing to ensnare its prey. Once it gathers enough food in its web, it flies it back to its nest to feed its young.

entry: POKENAME住在地下深处的洞穴，靠丝线找到回巢的路，因此，被视为洞穴探险者的理想伙伴。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME are found in deep underground caves, using their threads to navigate back to their nests. They're considered ideal partners for spelunkers.

entry: POKENAME织弹弓般的网，向敌人发射远程攻击。有时却把自己缠住，得找人帮忙。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME create a slingshot-like web that they use to fire off long-range attacks at opponents. They sometimes end up caught within their own web and require help.

entry: POKENAME每年会把一片森林据为己有。它用细丝甩动一团毒叶，把捕食者吓离家园。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME will claim a forest as its own once per year. It swings a clump of poisonous leaves with a thin string of silk to deter predators from its home.

entry: POKENAME身体制造过多毒液和丝，从各处溢出。加上强烈恶臭，它很难与其他生灵交往，因此十分孤单。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body over-produces its poisons and silk, to the point it overflows from various points of its body. This, combined with its potent stench, makes it very difficult for it to socialize with others, making it lonesome.

entry: POKENAME在峡谷筑巢，翼上的网让它能乘谷中气流。它吐丝织更多网，聚拢或分散强劲声波。
author: infinex21
source: The webbing of an POKENAME's wings helps them to ride upon wind currents that flow throughout the canyons they make their nests within. They spit and weave more silk webbing to focus or disperse their powerful sonic waves.

entry: POKENAME借身体花纹，伪装成普通霸王花。东西从上方飞过，就伸爪抓住，迅速裹网，留着以后吃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the markings of its body to disguise itself as a normal Vileplume. Once something flies overhead, it extends its claws to grab its prey and web them up quickly for later consumption.

entry: POKENAME体内充满白色黏稠毒液。看见想吃的东西，就会快速颤动，同时流口水。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is filled with a white viscous venom. When it sees something it wants to eat, it vibrates rapidly while drooling.

entry: POKENAME的洞穴里孢子云浓厚，难以辨路。闯入者通常还会遇到藏满地面的厚网。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's caves are filled with thick clouds of spores that make navigation difficult. Those who venture inside are usually met with thick webs hidden across the floor.

entry: POKENAME掌上的黏毛让它轻松爬上高墙。它主要夜行，在高楼中寻找猎物。
author: .izik
source: There are sticky hairs on POKENAME's palms that allow it to scale large walls with ease. It is active mainly at night, where it searches tall buildings for prey.

entry: POKENAME的丝常用来织捕梦网，防住多数噩梦。奇怪的是，丝网夜里发光，用久了最终会变黑。
author: infinex21
source: The silk webbing of POKENAME is often used to make dream catchers that prevent most nightmares. Strangely, their silk webbing glows at night and eventually turns black when it has been used for too long.

entry: POKENAME较少见的体色变体，却不算“异色”。孢子长出的蘑菇，会用坚韧丝线固定在地上。
author: frokachu
source: A less common color variant of POKENAME, but not classified as 'Shiny'. Its spores grow into mushrooms that stay anchored to the earth with sturdy silk strands.

entry: POKENAME在洞里制造庞大菌丝网，作用类似蛛网，储存食物与蛋。即使最锐利的刀，也极难切开。
author: .izik
source: The large mycelium networks POKENAME creates in caves function similarly to webs, storing its food and eggs. Cutting through this substance is extremely difficult even for the sharpest of blades.

entry: POKENAME结网极快，短短几秒就能裹住整个猎物。战斗时，先把敌人缠成丝茧，再用强力镰刀劈成两半。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME spins its webbing at a rapid pace, able to completely encase its prey within a couple of seconds. In combat, it will wrap its opponent in a cocoon of silk before slashing them in half with its powerful scythes.

entry: POKENAME花很多时间打理巢穴，织出窗帘般的网片，遮住外界视线。许多女裁缝研究其图案，从中寻找灵感。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spend lots of time maintaining their nests, weaving curtain-like sheets of webbing to block sight into their homes. Many seamstresses study the patterns POKENAME create to inspire their own work.

entry: 一些荒凉地方称它们为“死亡之铃”，实际却不伤大型生物，只捕食昆虫。
author: frokachu
source: Some desolate places call these Pokémon "bells of death," but they are harmless to larger creatures and prey only on insects.

entry: POKENAME毒性强到没有生物捕食，因此天生不怕捕食者。它反而格外友善好奇，照顾得当会是极佳宠物。
author: occulusmalus
source: POKENAME is so extremely poisonous that nothing will prey on it, meaning it has no natural fear of predators. As a result, it is unusually friendly and inquisitive, and with proper handling, makes an excellent pet.

entry: POKENAME在枝头挂数小时，等猎物靠近，再罩网击败。靠蛛网与策略，连体型两倍于己的对手也能战胜。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME hangs from branches for hours until prey comes nearby; then it covers it in a web and defeats it. POKENAME is able to defeat opponents twice its size with webs and strategy.

entry: POKENAME在灯具与路灯周围织网。可别站在巢下，它的粉末与丝线，都有毒。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME make their webs around lamps and streetlamps. Standing underneath these nests is unwise due to POKENAME's toxic dust and threads.

entry: POKENAME嘴里吐的丝有南瓜香，质地像糖浆。加热后更甜，用在许多派的配方里，是甜点的秘密原料。
author: .izik
source: The pumpkin-scented silk POKENAME dispenses from its mouth is similar in consistency to syrup. It is used in many pie recipes due to the sweetness it gains after being heated, making it a secret ingredient in desserts.

entry: POKENAME织出战甲，便能挑战远强于己的敌人。它把丝连在关心的对象身上，靠带刺的冠脊感知。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME spins combat armor so it can fight opponents much more powerful than itself. It attaches a silk thread to those it cares about, which it can sense with its spiked crest.

entry: POKENAME铺在陷坑里的黏丝极强韧。条件合适，连暴怒的火暴猴也能捆住。
author: .izik
source: The adhesive threads POKENAME spreads across its pitfalls are incredibly strong. Under the right conditions, they can restrain even a raging Primeape.

entry: POKENAME的毒让受害者晕乎乎。奇怪的是，中毒者常把它认成爱人，想亲吻它，结果为错误付出痛苦代价。
author: hophoppip
source: The venom from POKENAME leaves its victims in a woozy state. It's oddly common for envenomated victims to confuse POKENAME for their lover and try to kiss it, a mistake with painful consequences.

entry: POKENAME在地下隧道高速爬行，沿途留下丝。受威胁就沿网退回，把身后丝线拉拢封住，阻止追赶。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME scuttle through underground tunnels at high speed, leaving a trail of web behind themselves as they do. If they feel threatened, they retreat back through their webs, pulling the strands closed behind them to prevent pursuit.

entry: POKENAME常在网上挂硬币，诱骗毫无戒心的猎物。不过，它也能收买：献上闪亮东西的猎物，常能换得饶命。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME will often attach a coin to their webbing to lure in unsuspecting prey. However, they can be swayed as prey that deliver shiny objects to them are often spared in exchange for the item.

entry: POKENAME能吐出真正由黄金构成的贵重丝线，因此，多半只有十分富裕的训练家才养得起。
author: novellavaria
source: POKENAME produces highly valued silk that's made out of gold. Because of this, it's typically only owned by very wealthy Trainers.

entry: POKENAME脾气急、容易动粗，本就麻烦。紫色拳头还会产生强烈麻痹毒，使受害者无法反击，令它更危险。
author: sk372
source: Its quick temper and tendency to get violent is already enough of an issue, but POKENAME is even more dangerous due to the purple fists it possesses generating a highly paralytic poison that leaves victims unable to fight back.

entry: 它靠出色嗅觉追踪猎物。POKENAME若被水淋透，正在追踪的气味就全丢了。
author: .izik
source: It uses its superior sense of smell to track prey. Should an POKENAME be doused in water, it loses any scent it was tracking.

entry: POKENAME在肢体间拉丝飞行，凭灵活身手，在山与山之间结网。捕住飞行宝可梦后，再用尾巴点燃网。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME stretches silk between its limbs to fly, using the maneuverability this provides to create webs stretching between mountains. After catching a flying Pokémon in it, POKENAME will use its tail to set the web on fire.

entry: POKENAME臂端有小倒钩，任何垂直表面都能轻松攀上。战斗也很擅长，轻松承受攻击，同时每秒刺击10次。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has small barbs on the end of its arms, allowing it to scale any vertical surface with ease. It is quite adept in combat, effortlessly taking hits while jabbing its opponent 10 times a second.

entry: POKENAME藏在树木角落，一连睡上数天。只有吃网中捕到的食物，才会醒来。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME sleep for days on end and hide in the nooks of trees. They only awaken to dine on whatever has been caught in their web.

entry: 每只POKENAME的颜色都稍有不同，却不知为何想隐瞒。只要两只以上知道彼此在同一带，哪怕互为敌人，也会用超能力制造一模一样的幻象。
author: bobosmith01
source: Each POKENAME's coloration is slightly unique. For some reason, POKENAME try to hide this fact: if two or more are knowingly in the same area, they use their psychic abilities to create an illusion that they are identical, even if they are foes.

entry: 野生POKENAME常成对出现，独自生存很困难。有时被伙伴吓一跳，就困惑地互相指着。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME are often seen in pairs in the wild, and struggle to survive if on their own. Sometimes they will get surprised by their companion, causing them to point at each other in confusion.

entry: POKENAME用下半身装成一只受困的豪力，诱使毫无防备、想救助它的猎物上前。
author: fenragon
source: POKENAME mimics a trapped Machoke with its lower body to lure in unsuspecting prey trying to free it.

entry: POKENAME战中迅速织网，把远敌拉回擒抱范围。它还会挥舞密织蛛网制成的冠军腰带，送给令它满意的挑战者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME weaves webs quickly mid-battle to reel distant foes back into grappling distance. It waves champion belts made of tightly-woven webbing to give to those who give it a suitable challenge.

entry: POKENAME用长脖子摘取树上的树果，存进铃铛。随着果实分解，它会放出甜香，引来猎物，再用蛛网裹住。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its long neck to grab berries off trees and stores them in its bell. As the berries break down, it releases a sweet scent that attracts prey, which it then coils in a web.

entry: 它们在森林中窜行，寻找大型猎物。POKENAME会跃上强壮宝可梦的头，注入致命的神经毒素。
author: hummusishome
source: They scuttle through forests in search of large prey to devour. POKENAME jump on the heads of strong Pokémon and inject them with a lethal neurotoxin.

entry: POKENAME的紫火不会烧伤人，却有毒，接触会使它不信任的对象中毒。赛跑时，落后的个体会吐网，试图绊倒前面的。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's purple flames will not burn a person, but are toxic and will poison those it does not trust if touched. During POKENAME races, those trailing behind try to spit webs to trip up those ahead of them.

entry: POKENAME织乱网捕猎，可真等到落网，早忘了狩猎这回事。它通常陪被捕的生物玩几分钟，就放走。
author: sk372
source: It spins haphazardly-shaped webs to catch prey in, but by the time something is caught in the web, POKENAME has forgotten about the hunt. It usually plays with the caught creature for a few minutes before releasing it.

entry: POKENAME用丝织网，捕捉水下猎物。网中复杂的图案，给许多丝织工人带来灵感。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME create nets out of silk webbing to capture prey in the water. They inspire many silk weavers with the complex patterns that can be found in their nets.

entry: POKENAME的黏毒网由自身污泥构成，织得越大越复杂，身体就越小。猎物落网后，它连猎物带网一起吃，恢复失去的体积。
author: sk372
source: The sticky, toxic webbing POKENAME spins is made of its own sludge, so it shrinks as it spins larger, more intricate webs. Once it ensnares prey, it consumes the victim as well as its own web to regain its lost size.

entry: POKENAME织简单的网兜住气泡，带到水下呼吸。壳使行动笨重，在水里移动缓慢。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME weave simple webs that they use to capture air bubbles, taking these air bubbles with them underwater so that they can breathe. They are slow-moving in the water, their shell making their movements cumbersome.

entry: POKENAME多条尖腿力量很大，轻松附在洞壁和洞顶。它从高处落下，用网裹住岩石属性宝可梦，吸取养分。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's multiple pointed legs have great strength, letting it cling to cave walls and ceilings with ease. It drops down from these perches to web up Rock-type Pokémon to drain nutrients from them.

entry: POKENAME沿海底走动，挑取小鱼和蛤蜊吃。大钳上覆着黏丝网，一旦抓住什么，就绝无挣脱可能。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME treads along the sea floor, picking at small fish and clams to consume. Its large claw is coated with a sticky webbing that ensures once it grabs something, there will be no escaping its grip.

entry: POKENAME的鳞茎限制了起飞所需的背部肌肉，因此无法飞行。若从高处被抛下，能短暂滑翔。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are unable to fly because the bulb restrains the back muscles that are needed to launch into the air. They are capable of gliding for short periods of time if thrown off a ledge.

entry: 母亲的头骨已与它的头和翅膀融为一体，化作铠甲。双翼更结实了，也能当作利刃迎敌。
author: skymaster426
source: Its mother's skull has fused with its head and wings as armor. With its wings being given extra strength, it can use them as blades to attack.

entry: POKENAME在现身很久以前，就先放毒烟削弱敌人。等猎物发现自己吸入毒烟，早已倦怠得无法逃跑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME create noxious fumes to weaken their foes long before they are seen. By the time their prey realize they are inhaling these fumes, they are already too lethargic to escape.

entry: POKENAME的大头，总被其他头惹得心烦，时时惦念着从前，自己还是独立宝可梦的日子。
author: dodoowner_
source: The giant head of POKENAME is always annoyed and bothered by the other heads. It constantly dreams of when it was its own Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME有让任何穿刺伤无痛的奇妙本领，很受医院员工欢迎。它笨拙出了名，连自己的隐形屏障也应付不好，索性用来逗人笑。
author: mega_beedrill
source: POKENAME has become popular with hospital staff due to its strange ability to make any puncture wound painless. It is notoriously clumsy, even with its own invisible barriers. It uses this to its advantage to make people laugh.

entry: POKENAME的精神脉冲形成大团毒物，一靠近便爆开。毒物接触会造成强烈腐蚀，因此它为自保，也会远离自己攻击留下的东西。
author: thesilverowls
source: POKENAME's psychic pulses create large deposits of poison, which burst when approached. Contact with the poison can lead to heavy corrosion, so POKENAME prefer to stay away from the results of their attacks for self-preservation.

entry: 它用四翼高速追踪猎物，下翼帮助迅速调整路线。时机一到，便俯冲用钳抓住，再将猎物夹碎。
author: infinex21
source: It tracks prey while flying rapidly using its four wings, the lower wings helping it to rapidly adjust its path. When the time is right, it swoops down to grab its prey with its pincers and proceeds to crush them.

entry: POKENAME领地意识强，却不特别好斗。其他宝可梦闯入，就用翅膀撒粉哄睡，再搬出领地。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is territorial, but not particularly aggressive. If another Pokémon enters its territory, it puts them to sleep with powder spread from its wings before carrying them out of its domain.

entry: POKENAME吃电，比起电子设备，更爱吸收电属性宝可梦的能量。发电厂会用它驱赶饥饿的电击兽或小磁怪。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME feed on electricity. They prefer absorbing energy from Electric-type Pokémon rather than electronics. Power plants employ POKENAME to fend off hungry Electabuzz or Magnemite.

entry: 据说POKENAME以前飞行、游泳都很快。后来壳越长越大、越重，拖累身体，泳速大减，也飞不起来了。
author: pinkyoshi2350
source: POKENAME is thought to have once been able to both fly and swim very fast. Over time, its shell has grown much larger and heavier, weighing POKENAME down, making it much slower when swimming and unable to fly.

entry: POKENAME把偷洞中旅人物件当游戏，拿着赃物让对方怎么也够不着，自娱自乐。玩腻了总会归还。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes a game of stealing things from travelers passing through caves. It plays 'keep away' with the stolen item for its own amusement, always returning it once it grows bored.

entry: POKENAME背上的火映出脾气。火焰一咆哮，就要以毒牙出击。四翼一扇便能把火扫向任何目标，无处可逃。
author: fiordaliso
source: The fire on POKENAME's back mirrors its temper. When the flames roar, it's about to strike with venomous teeth. One beat of its four wings can sweep its flames onto any target, leaving no escape.

entry: 遇到野生POKENAME务必小心。增强的毒力与超音速，能在转眼间让你失去行动能力。
author: chaos_emblemx
source: When encountering a wild POKENAME, take great caution, as its amplified toxic power and supersonic speed could leave you incapacitated in mere moments.

entry: POKENAME四翼能迅速俯冲，用爪抓住小猎物。喙与利爪都带致命毒素，会毫不犹豫地用来削弱其他宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its four wings allow POKENAME to dive rapidly to snatch small prey with its claws. Both its beak and talons are infused with a deadly toxin, which it uses without hesitation to weaken other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME夜飞寻找罪犯，抓走带入黑暗。次日，罪犯出现在警局外，如醉般神志不清，拼命自首，让警方既困惑又感激。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME fly through the night in search of criminals to carry away into the dark. The next day, the criminals reappear outside of police stations and desperately turn themselves in as if in an inebriated stupor, leaving police baffled, but grateful.

entry: 有些地方因它优雅而凶猛，对其加以崇拜。凭着六只翅膀，它被称为“死亡炽天使”。
author: gellyfishsh
source: In some places, it is worshipped for its grace and ferocity. From its six wings, it is dubbed "The Seraph of Death".

entry: POKENAME在黑暗中乱飞，难免撞上石笋，磕裂蛋壳甲。这只会令它更加烦躁。
author: anonymous_16803
source: Flying erratically in the dark, POKENAME cannot avoid ramming into stalagmites and cracking its eggshell armor, which only agitates it more.

entry: POKENAME身上的暗羽见光闪耀，可它只夜飞，很少能见到。四只无羽翅膀拍得又快又静，推动身体飞行。
author: .jerden
source: The dark feathers on its body gleam in the light, but this is rarely seen since POKENAME only flies at night. Its four featherless wings beat rapidly but quietly as they move it through the air.

entry: POKENAME的腿进化成了翅膀，却大多时间待在水里。这些翼既能飞，也同样有助游泳。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Having its legs evolve to effectively become wings, POKENAME spends much of its time in the water. The wings help it swim just as much as they allow it to fly.

entry: POKENAME高声尖叫，召来其他蝙蝠宝可梦。它懂得同伴绕飞时的尖叫含义，随后会奔向只有从空中才能发现的猎物。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can let out a high-pitched screech to summon a swarm of other Bat Pokémon. It can understand the screeching sounds they make as they fly around it, since POKENAME will then head towards prey that could only have been spotted from the air.

entry: POKENAME保留了两种组成宝可梦的灵巧飞行本领，空中极为敏捷。它将下半身向上卷起，抓住空中猎物。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME retains the nimble flight abilities of both component Pokémon, making it highly agile in the air. It catches prey midair by curling its lower body upward to grasp it.

entry: 亲爱、眷恋与忠诚的力量，使POKENAME达到这形态。它整夜无声地狩猎、采集，把找到的一切带回洞里，与最亲近的对象分享。
author: bobosmith01
source: The power of affection, love, and loyalty has allowed POKENAME to reach this form. It stalks throughout the night to hunt and gather without making a single sound, then brings whatever it has found to its den to share with whomever it is closest to.

entry: 亲爱、眷恋与忠诚的力量，使POKENAME达到这形态。它整夜无声地狩猎、采集，把找到的一切带回洞里，与最亲近的对象分享。

source: The power of affection, love, and loyalty has allowed POKENAME to reach this form. It stalks throughout the night to hunt and gather without making a single sound, then brings whatever it has found to its den to share with whomever it is closest to.

entry: POKENAME吸收大量能量，就会变成这形态。能量可能来自与训练家的羁绊、月亮，或其他非自然来源。外貌让人想起遥远地区的一种现象。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME assumes this form whenever it has absorbed large amounts of energy. This energy can be from the bond between Trainer and Pokémon, the moon, or other unnatural sources. Its appearance brings to mind a phenomenon occurring in a distant region.

entry: 亲爱、眷恋与忠诚的力量，使POKENAME达到这形态。它整夜无声地狩猎、采集，把找到的一切带回洞里，与最亲近的对象分享。
author: bobosmith01
source: The power of affection, love, and loyalty has allowed POKENAME to reach this form. It stalks throughout the night to hunt and gather without making a single sound, then brings whatever it has found to its den to share with whomever it is closest to.

entry: 亲爱、眷恋与忠诚的力量，使POKENAME达到这形态。它整夜无声地狩猎、采集，把找到的一切带回洞里，与最亲近的对象分享。
author: bobosmith01
source: The power of affection, love, and loyalty has allowed POKENAME to reach this form. It stalks throughout the night to hunt and gather without making a single sound, then brings whatever it has found to its den to share with whomever it is closest to.

entry: POKENAME虽有四翼，背上沉重花苞却让它无法飞行。谁敢碰花瓣，就会挨毒牙。
author: fiordaliso
source: The heavy bud growing on POKENAME's back keeps it from flying, despite its four wings. POKENAME bites anyone daring to touch its petals with venomous fangs.

entry: POKENAME的强牙能轻松咬碎缟玛瑙。无可匹敌的咬合力，让它成为可怕的猎手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's powerful teeth can crush through onyx with ease. This unmatched biting force makes it a formidable hunter.

entry: POKENAME夸张地挥舞双翼，神秘吟唱、诡异尖叫，捉弄过路旅人。恶作剧时若有人靠近，它便一扇翅膀消失。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME extravagantly wave about their wings as they perform mysterious chants and eerie shrieks to prank wandering travelers. If anyone tries to approach a POKENAME during its mischief, it will disappear in a single flutter of its wings.

entry: POKENAME倒着飞，以无与伦比的精准度钻入地面，借此开凿隧道、逃避威胁。
author: .izik
source: Flying backwards, POKENAME drills into the ground with unmatched precision. This tactic allows it to carve tunnels and escape from threats.

entry: POKENAME用爪子在巢边雕出精巧石像，既作装饰，也标记领地。
author: .izik
source: Using its claws, POKENAME carves stone to create intricate statues near its den. These sculptures serve as both decoration and territory markers.

entry: POKENAME常在林中潜行，寻找妖精宝可梦吞食。金属钳牢牢夹住猎物，再使出剧毒牙，给予最后一击。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME often prowls the forests looking for fairy Pokémon to devour. It holds its prey with the tight grip of its metallic pincers before finishing them off with Poison Fang.

entry: POKENAME从壳中泼出酸汁，使敌人晕眩。酸汁既能防御，也有威慑作用。
author: .izik
source: Acidic juice from POKENAME's shell is splashed at enemies, leaving them stunned. This juice doubles as a defensive mechanism and deterrent.

entry: POKENAME能带着整棵树飞，最远10英里。惊人的力量，让它能在偏远高处筑巢。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can carry entire trees through the air for up to 10 miles. This incredible strength allows it to build nests in remote areas high above the ground.

entry: 科学家合成POKENAME牙中的毒素，制出强效晕船药。它还能发射加压水柱，力量、精度足以穿石。
author: fiordaliso
source: By synthesizing the toxins in POKENAME's teeth, scientists created a powerful remedy for seasickness. It can fire pressurized water jets so strong and precise they can pierce stone.

entry: POKENAME必须全力拍动四只翅膀，才能让沉重的身体留在空中。每次起飞前，它都会用锋利的脚爪，连续刮擦地面四次。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME requires all four of its wings to flap at full force in order to keep its heavy body aloft. It scrapes its sharp talons across the ground four times in a row before taking off into the air.

entry: POKENAME吃发光珊瑚，因此能在黑暗中发出美丽光芒。
author: mrbapcik
source: POKENAME's diet includes luminescent corals. Thanks to this diet, they glow beautifully in the dark.

entry: 它用翼状巨耳跃向惊人高处，再像轮子般落下，撞翻敌人。尖牙有强毒，既能削弱猎物，也能驱赶胆敢擅闯领地的生物。
author: fiordaliso
source: It uses its massive, wing-shaped ears to leap to incredible heights and then drops like a wheel to bowl over its foes. Its fangs are laced with a potent toxin, which it uses to weaken prey and drive out intruders that dare trespass on its territory.

entry: POKENAME能高速旋转着疾飞，想让它停下又不造成伤害，非常困难。转完常头晕，训练家便趁机收服。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can blitz through the air while spinning at a rapid pace, making it difficult to stop without risking injury. It frequently gets dizzy after spinning, which Trainers exploit to catch it.

entry: POKENAME拍翅制造强劲风压，扫倒障碍，连最难对付的敌人也能吹倒。
author: .izik
source: By flapping its wings, POKENAME generates powerful wind blasts that knock down obstacles. These gusts are strong enough to topple even the toughest opponents.

entry: POKENAME制造令人着迷的幻觉，持续数小时，还会引发妄想。它跟随受影响的训练家，引导他们走出洞穴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME induce spellbinding hallucinations that can last for hours and cause delusions. They stalk Trainers who are under the influence of their hallucinations to lead them out of their caves.

entry: POKENAME夜里飞得迅捷无声，带着一群超音蝠与黑暗鸦一系的融合体。手下一旦抗命，它就用尖牙咬住，吸走血液。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME flies swiftly and silently through the night, followed by its Zukrow minions. Should one of its cronies disobey an order, POKENAME will sink its fangs into them and drain them of blood.

entry: POKENAME在洞中家园起舞，四翼帮助平衡。摇摆动作会引来超音蝠群，像被催眠般专注观看。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's four wings assist with its balance as it dances about in its cavernous home. Its swaying movements have been known to attract Zubat swarms, who watch intently as if hypnotized.

entry: POKENAME用鳍调节磁场，极其精准地控制自己的位置与速度。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME uses its fins to modulate its magnetic field, giving it extremely precise control over its position and speed.

entry: POKENAME是捕猎其他飞行属性宝可梦的顶级猎手。它迅速掠过沿途障碍，将毒牙扎进猎物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are apex predators that hunt other Flying-type Pokémon. They zip past obstacles in their way to sink their venomous fangs into their prey.

entry: POKENAME后腿太短，只能拖着身体爬。想快点移动，就靠翅膀悬在地面上，前腿向前疾奔。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's hind legs are so short that it has to drag itself along the ground. If it wants to move faster, its wings will keep it hovering above the ground while its front legs charge forward.

entry: POKENAME能把身体转为数据，毒素研究者借它开发解毒药。它能从体内发出类似声呐的波，不知如何便识别、整理各种毒素。
author: .izik
source: Thanks to its ability to convert its body into data, toxin researchers utilize POKENAME to develop cures for poisons. It somehow identifies and organizes toxins using a sonar-like wave it produces from its body.

entry: POKENAME能把背刺当导弹，射向远处目标。锐刺密集，令对手难以躲避。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can fire the spines on its back like missiles, launching them at distant targets. This attack leaves opponents struggling to avoid the sharp barrage.

entry: POKENAME用头上安静的翅膀穿行所住洞穴，动作几乎无声。它擅长伏击，用毒爪划入、钉住猎物，直到对方不再动弹。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's movements are near silent as it utilizes the quiet wings on its head to maneuver through the caves it calls home. As an ambush predator, POKENAME uses its toxic talons to slash into and pin down its prey until the foe stops moving.

entry: POKENAME扇翼掀起强风，击退对手。臂上的炮能顺着炮口发射龙卷风。战斗时先跳起，再俯冲施以猛烈踢击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME uses its wings to stir up intense gusts of wind to blow back opponents. The cannon on its arm can launch tornados in the direction it is facing. During combat, POKENAME will jump up, then dive bomb foes with an intense kick.

entry: POKENAME的毒咬令人畏惧，哪怕擦出小伤，也会严重削弱敌人。它先用超能力感知弱点，再以快得看不清的速度出击。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is a feared predator due to its toxic bite, as even a small graze can leave debilitating effects. It uses its psychic abilities to sense vulnerability in its opponent before striking with blinding speed.

entry: POKENAME外貌虽吓人，却心地善良，总把其他宝可梦的安全放在自己之前。它也是很好的照料者，战斗之外，有时会收养年幼的宝可梦孤儿。
author: dyo_jonah
source: Despite its intimidating appearance, POKENAME has a heart of gold and always puts other Pokémon's safety above its own. They are also known to be great caretakers, sometimes seen adopting young orphaned Pokémon outside of combat.

entry: POKENAME所住洞穴地上散着原木。它从附近森林偷木头，试图在洞顶筑坝，似乎始终不懂这事有多荒唐。
author: sk372
source: Scattered logs can be seen on the cavern ground where POKENAME resides. It steals wood from nearby forests, attempting to create dams on the cave ceilings, seemingly never understanding the folly of this endeavor.

entry: POKENAME显现幽灵之身时，所住的铃便轻轻鸣响。它飞得快又无声，这往往是猎物能得到的唯一狩猎警告。
author: sk372
source: The bell POKENAME inhabits makes a faint chime whenever it manifests its spectral self. This is often the only warning prey may get that it is on the hunt, as POKENAME flies quickly and silently through the air.

entry: POKENAME不爱阳光直射，每早在铃内休息。神秘力量让铃始终光亮，就算沾泥，也转眼恢复光泽。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rests within its bell each morning, disliking direct sunlight. The bell stays glossy at all times, shining within moments even if muddied, due to a mysterious power.

entry: POKENAME优雅跃下高原，轻松滑翔。飞行操控精准，攻击能分毫不差地命中。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaps from tall plateaus with grace, gliding through the air effortlessly. Its precision in flight allows it to strike targets with pinpoint accuracy.

entry: POKENAME拍翼散布的花粉，对呼吸道刺激极强。夜里在林中游荡，释放朵朵花粉云标记领地。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME pollen is a particularly potent respiratory irritant that they spread by flapping their wings. At night, POKENAME roam around the forest releasing clouds of pollen to mark their territory.

entry: POKENAME的巨颚向四面张开，滴着黏稠毒唾液。其中的舌头甩出，力道足以击碎岩石，舌尖还会分泌麻痹毒。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's giant jaws open four ways and are dripping with a viscous, toxic saliva. The tongues of these jaws can lash out with enough force to break a rock and secrete a numbing venom from their tips.

entry: POKENAME臂力极强，一拍就能离地。它在不同地区间滑翔，把整片森林的水果与树果吃光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's arm strength is great enough that only a single flap is needed to take off from the ground. It glides from region to region, depriving entire forests of their fruits and berries.

entry: 有些传说把POKENAME描绘成渴求力量的神，掳走宝可梦和人类献祭，以求更强。不过，没有目击记录证实，仍众说纷纭。
author: actliux
source: In some legends, POKENAME is depicted as a power-hungry deity that kidnaps Pokémon and humans and sacrifices them to gain power. However, there have been no documented sightings of this, leaving much speculation.

entry: 据说，POKENAME尖利的叫声能扭曲心智，使人崇拜它。听力差者却不受影响。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's piercing screeches were said to warp minds into worship. Those with bad hearing were immune to this effect.

entry: 幽灵、毒与虫属性宝可梦聚向POKENAME背上的枯树，常组成小群落。它似乎不介意，不过难得独处时，也明显十分享受。
author: sk372
source: Ghost-, Poison- and Bug-type Pokémon flock to the withered trees on POKENAME's back, often making small communities together. POKENAME doesn't seem to mind, but does seem to immensely enjoy its rare moments of solitude.

entry: POKENAME夜里从岩缝爬出，飞天追猎。个头小，有时也会成为大型宝可梦想吃的一餐。
author: .realthree
source: At night, POKENAME crawls out of rocky crevices to take to the skies in pursuit of prey. Due to its small size, it is sometimes targeted as a meal by larger Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME全身入鞘时，飞得最快，四片翅膀都悄无声息。剑刃则靠吸血为食。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME flies fastest while in its scabbard, employing four silent wings in total. Its blade consumes blood.

entry: POKENAME牙尖滴着腐蚀性毒液，每滴都能传导足以驱动一辆小汽车的电能。它无声滑向猎物，亮眼不漏最微小的动静，是顶尖猎手。
author: middlec
source: POKENAME's fangs drip with a corrosive poison that conducts enough electricity in each drop to power a small car. Using its wings to silently glide upon prey and its gleaming eyes to spot even the slightest movement, it is an elite predator.

entry: POKENAME拍动多条缎带，模仿翅膀，达到近似飞行的效果。它在野外寻找超音蝠群，用缎带安抚，减少它们对旅人的敌意。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can flap its many ribbons in a mimicry of wings, attaining something close to flight. It seeks out Zubat colonies in the wild, using its ribbons to calm them down and lower their aggression towards travelers.

entry: POKENAME住在黑暗洞穴深处，拍翼生风，骗洞中宝可梦以为附近有出口，再发动攻击。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME lives in dark cave recesses and uses its wings to create wind. It fools cave-dwelling Pokémon into thinking that they are near an exit before it attacks.

entry: POKENAME泳姿敏捷，前后肢共同推动身体。传说称它为风暴使者，速度来自飓风翻搅的海洋。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are agile swimmers, their front and hind limbs both used to propel them through the water. Myths surround them as the heralds of storms, speaking of their speed coming from hurricane-whipped oceans.

entry: 四翼让POKENAME在空中操控自如。它藏在洞顶暗角，瞄准下方猎物，用头上的能量炮射击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's four wings give it great control of its aerial movement. It hides itself in dark upper corners of caverns, targeting prey below and taking shots at them with the energy cannon on its head.

entry: POKENAME会扑翅、跳跃，却从不飞，因为骨头太密实。它的面孔和举止常让人联想到小恶魔。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME flutters and hops, but never flies, since its bones are too dense. Its face and demeanor are often associated with imps.

entry: POKENAME是夜间猎手，靠皮膜翅膀滑翔。巨耳能捕捉下方最微弱的心跳。一锁定，便收翼，以毁灭性的后腿踢击猛撞猎物，再消失在黑暗中。
author: cerealjamalt
source: POKENAME is a night hunter that glides on leathery wings. Oversized ears detect the faintest heartbeat below. Once locked on, it folds its wings and slams prey with a devastating hind-leg kick before vanishing into the dark.

entry: POKENAME夜里无声滑翔，摇响菌盖，将孢子撒在猎物身上。制住猎物后，它们便伸出手臂，将其带进夜色深处。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME glide silently through the night, rattling their mushroom caps to scatter their spores over their prey. Once their prey is taken out, they extend their arms to carry them away into the darkness of the night.

entry: POKENAME是世界上速度最快的宝可梦之一，无声又迅疾地捕猎。多数受袭者等到察觉是谁出手，已经太迟。
author: soup1900
source: This Pokémon is known to be one of the fastest in the world. POKENAME is a silent but speedy predator, as most Pokémon it attacks will never realize who attacked them until it is too late.

entry: POKENAME是世界上速度最快的宝可梦之一，无声又迅疾地捕猎。多数受袭者等到察觉是谁出手，已经太迟。
author: soup1900
source: This Pokémon is known to be one of the fastest in the world. POKENAME is a silent but speedy predator, as most Pokémon it attacks will never realize who attacked them until it is too late.

entry: POKENAME在废弃宅邸中结群，倒挂在天花板上。它会追赶入侵者，吸走生命力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME form colonies inside abandoned manors and hang from the ceiling. They chase after intruders to siphon away the life force from them.

entry: POKENAME飞得颇慢，不过四翼同样大小，爬行速度比组成它的两种宝可梦都快。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is a fairly slow flier, but due to its four equally sized wings, it can crawl faster than either of its components.

entry: 有人说它是世上飞得最快的宝可梦。战斗时，羽毛如闪电般射出，羽轴浸毒又锋利，像淬毒苦无般刺来。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Some say this is the fastest flying Pokémon alive. In battle it will fling forth its feathers with lightning speed, the venom-drenched quills being so sharp that they stab like poisoned kunai.

entry: POKENAME只在漆黑夜里出行，而且只以超音速移动。有人推测，它根本没法走得更慢。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME only travels in the pitch black of night, and only at supersonic speeds. It has been theorized that it cannot travel any slower.

entry: POKENAME用带毒的胶状涂层黏住墙壁。虽然只有一只翅膀，却能靠精神力量浮离地面。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME sticks to walls using a gelatinous coating that is also quite toxic. Despite only having one wing, it uses its psychic abilities to levitate above the ground.

entry: POKENAME爆发强烈噪声，使敌人混乱、迷失方向。猛烈的声波攻击，让它很难应付。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME unleashes powerful bursts of noise that confuse and disorient its foes. The intensity of these sonic attacks makes it hard to counter.

entry: POKENAME吐酸像狙击般精准，极远的目标也能命中。腐蚀性攻击让它在战斗中成为危险对手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits acid with sniper-like precision, hitting targets from impressive distances. This corrosive attack makes it a dangerous foe in battle.

entry: POKENAME夜里出洞，捕猎夜行生物。双翼掀起紊乱的上升气流，把空中猎物打落。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME emerges from its cave at night to hunt for nocturnal prey. Its wings form updrafts of turbulent air to knock airborne prey out of the sky.

entry: POKENAME是水生猎手，能突然爆发速度，不到一秒窜出好几码。即使毫无光照，也能清楚视物。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is an aquatic predator able to attain sudden bursts of speed, able to dart forth and clear multiple yards in a fraction of a second. It can see clearly even in areas where no light shines.

entry: POKENAME恶作剧地偷走墓碑，随意散放各处。古怪举动让墓园守卫摸不着头脑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME steals gravestones as a mischievous prank, scattering them in random places. This strange behavior leaves graveyard keepers puzzled.

entry: POKENAME在峡谷深处筑巢，那里的声学效果增强了回声定位。偏僻位置既安全，也提供猎场。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME nests deep within gorges, where the acoustics amplify its echolocation. These isolated locations provide it with both safety and hunting grounds.

entry: POKENAME藏在雷雨云中，耐心等最佳出击时机。突如其来的伏击，让猎物来不及反应。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides within storm clouds, waiting patiently to strike at the perfect moment. Its sudden ambush leaves prey with no chance to react.

entry: 受威胁时，POKENAME趴下，展示后腰的大假脸，再猛扑向前，凶狠撞击敌人。
author: moopse
source: When threatened, POKENAME lies down and displays the large false face on it's lower back. It then lunges forward, brutally slamming into the enemy.

entry: POKENAME吃苔藓，让毛发保持光亮整齐。这种独特饮食也让它动作敏捷，随时能飞。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME feeds on moss to keep its fur glossy and well-maintained. This unique diet also keeps it nimble and ready for flight.

entry: POKENAME快速拍翼，精准打落树上的球果。这样既能取得食物，也能存着日后食用。
author: .izik
source: Using swift wingbeats, POKENAME knocks Apricorns off trees with remarkable accuracy. This behavior helps it access food and store it for later use.

entry: POKENAME每晚闲卧时，会唱迷人曲调。据说歌声既引来伴侣，也引来猎物。
author: hophoppip
source: Each night, POKENAME sings an enchanting melody as it lounges. It's believed that this melody is used to lure in both partners and prey.

entry: POKENAME用浓厚孢子云使猎物窒息。若对方开始逃跑，便用强翼掀风斩击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses thick clouds of spores to asphyxiate its prey. Should they begin to escape, it slices at them with wind generated by its powerful wings.

entry: POKENAME发出刺耳尖叫，震松洞壁的橄榄石。宝石一落，便俯冲吃掉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits piercing screeches to loosen peridot from cave walls. Once the gems fall, it swoops down to consume them immediately.

entry: 洞穴里能见到POKENAME用棍棒制造蝙蝠形火焰。火焰用途广，既照路，也烧伤打扰者。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be found in caves, using their stick to create fiery bat-like flames. These flames are multi-purpose, used by POKENAME to both light their way as well as to burn those that disturb them.

entry: POKENAME从高处跳下，扑向毫无防备的对手，也能投掷有毒手里剑。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME jumps from high places and leaps onto opponents who are unaware. POKENAME can throw poisonous shurikens at opponents.

entry: POKENAME独居，常为领地互斗。白天受扰，会迅速咬袭击者一口便飞走，留下对方承受毒咬。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are solitary Pokémon and will often fight with each other over territory. If it is disturbed during the day, it will quickly bite its attacker before swiftly flying away, leaving them to deal with its venomous bite.

entry: POKENAME夜里快速飞过田野，散播毒粉。看见猎物受影响，就立刻出击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies quickly through fields at night, scattering poisonous powder. Should it see that its prey was affected, it will strike immediately.

entry: POKENAME如模糊暗影般掠过，突袭猎物。距离一近，就喷火烤熟，再把毒牙扎进新鲜的一餐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME zip by in a shadowy blur to surprise prey. Once they close the distance, a burst of flames roasts their prey before venomous fangs sink into the fresh meal.

entry: POKENAME强力拍翼，掘进洞壁，轻松震落松动巨石，开出前路。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs into cave walls using powerful wing beats. Loose boulders are dislodged effortlessly as it clears a path forward.

entry: 训练家请POKENAME在葡萄园压树果酿酒，发泄怒气。客人看见它舔拳上的红汁，常吓得以为在喝受害者的血。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Trainers employ POKENAME at vineyards, encouraging them to work out their anger by squishing berries for wine. Many guests get intimidated when they see POKENAME licking red juice from their fists, afraid they're drinking blood from their victims.

entry: POKENAME用腹部共鸣，振动薄皮，发出低沉轰响的蛙鸣。它细听回声，每叫一次，就在脑中完善一分周围的地图。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their bellies as resonance chambers, vibrating the thin layer of skin to make deep, booming croaking noises. They listen carefully for the echoes of their croaks, building up a mental map of the area around them with each croak.

entry: POKENAME是2月庆典的象征，常被视为爱情的先兆。描绘却有分歧：有人说它用箭传播爱，也有人画它咬人。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are considered symbols of February celebrations, often regarded as a harbinger of love. There exist conflicting depictions of this, with some saying they spread love through an arrow, while others depict POKENAME biting humans.

entry: POKENAME是极危险的顶级捕食者。咬击注入的强毒，因潜藏的火焰而能熔化猎物内脏。
author: edeniteiron
source: POKENAME is an incredibly dangerous apex predator. Its bite can inject its prey with a potent toxin that will melt their insides due to the flames hidden within it.

entry: POKENAME用大翼划水，也用来升空。它把翼收进壳中便迅速坠下，着地的冲击也不当回事，笑着承受。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their large wings to both propel through the water and launch into the air. They tuck their wings into their shells to plummet quickly before shrugging off the impact from landing with a laugh.

entry: POKENAME用触手间的膜网包住猎物，再以臂上的刺吸干。膜网能短距滑翔，因此它在海崖高处筑巢，守望食物。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME envelops prey in the webbing of its tentacles, using the spikes along the arms to drain its quarry. The webbing allows it to glide short distances, so POKENAME climbs high along seaside cliffs to nest and watch for food.

entry: POKENAME用一对手臂抓住洞壁，另一对捡石头，再用酸溶开当零食。剩余物掉落，在下方形成石笋。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME cling onto cavern walls with one pair of arms while collecting rocks with the other. They melt down rocks with acid to snack on them and then let the remains fall away to form stalagmites below them.

entry: POKENAME用坚硬身体猛力俯冲敌人，让对方伤痕累累，失去平衡。
author: .izik
source: With its hard body, POKENAME dives into enemies with tremendous force. This aerial assault leaves its opponents battered and off-balance.

entry: POKENAME用翼状鳍划水，大而蓬松的尾巴当舵。它白天休息，直到水中变暗才狩猎，凭敏锐视听寻找猎物。
author: .jerden
source: While propelling itself through the water using its wing-like fins, POKENAME uses its large, fluffy tail like a rudder. It rests during the day and only hunts once the water becomes dark, relying on its keen eyesight and hearing to find prey.

entry: POKENAME只有靠超能力托起沉重身体，才能飞。奇特方式，却让它以惊人速度滑翔。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can only fly with the assistance of psychic powers, which lift its heavy body into the air. This strange method allows it to glide at surprising speeds.

entry: POKENAME靠磁力移动，而非拍翼，动作能全然无声，便于悄悄接近猎物。
author: .jerden
source: Because POKENAME moves itself around using magnetism rather than wingbeats, its movements can be completely silent. This enables it to stealthily approach its prey.

entry: POKENAME用磁力升空，小翼推动向前。身体虽重，仍能短时高速飞行。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses magnetism to lift itself into the air and its small wings to propel itself forward. Although its body is heavy, it can still fly at high speed in short bursts.

entry: POKENAME近战时挥舞削尖的大葱，刺向敌人。非同寻常的武器，让它既危险又难以预测。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME strikes with a sharpened leek, jabbing at enemies in close combat. This unconventional weapon makes it both unpredictable and dangerous.

entry: POKENAME饿了就吃洞壁上的虫子和小生物。其他宝可梦的巢比脖子能够到的地方高，它便用翅膀飞起来。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever it needs a snack, POKENAME eats bugs and other critters from cavern walls. It uses its wings to soar above the ground, as other Pokémon nest higher than where its neck reaches.

entry: POKENAME已适应在水中用超音波回声定位。它隐秘得连吸吼鲸王的血，也能不被察觉。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME has adapted to echolocate in the water using Supersonic. It is stealthy enough to drain the blood from a Wailord without being noticed.

entry: POKENAME把翅膀收进壳中，保护不受伤。它能不惊动敌人地飞到上方，再用身体撞下去。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME retracts its wings into its shell to protect them from any harm. It can fly over its foes without them noticing before slamming them with its body.

entry: POKENAME坚壳四翼，防御强、机动性高。攻击时合壳，从上方坠下，以坚硬身体猛砸目标。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's solid shell and four wings give it a strong defense and excellent maneuverability. To attack, it closes its shell and drops down from above to crack its sturdy body on top of its target.

entry: POKENAME忠诚又记仇，谁惹恼朋友伙伴，就会遭它凶狠纠缠。它会温和捉弄信任的对象，但若玩笑冒犯了对方，又会沮丧。
author: pjporwoll
source: Loyal and vengeful, POKENAME will viciously harass anyone who upsets its friends and allies. It plays mild pranks on those it trusts, but becomes despondent if the prank offends its target.

entry: POKENAME待在孩子窗外，不进房也能吃梦。这诡异本领，让熟睡者察觉不到它。
author: .izik
source: From outside a child's window, POKENAME feeds on dreams without needing to enter the room. This eerie ability leaves its presence unnoticed by those asleep.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀锋利，能利落切开大理石。如此精准的空中攻击，让它成为可怕对手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wings are so sharp they can slice cleanly through marble. This precision makes it a terrifying opponent in flight.

entry: POKENAME用翅膀划水，把壳充满气泡增加浮力。壳太庞大，不够流线，游得不快。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their wings to row through the water, filling their shell with bubbles to aid in their buoyancy. They are not very fast swimmers, their shell too bulky to be streamlined.

entry: POKENAME用翅膀划水，把壳充满气泡增加浮力。壳太庞大，不够流线，游得不快，却能用炮短暂爆发加速。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their wings to row through the water, filling their shell with bubbles to aid in their buoyancy. They are not very fast swimmers, their shell too bulky to be streamlined, but they can use their cannons to provide a brief burst of speed.

entry: 起飞前，POKENAME会扇动翅膀，帮助自己在地面蹦跳。它们捡来细枝，在背上的种子周围筑起保护巢，可巢一飞就散，常把它们气得不轻。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME flap their wings to aid in leaping around the ground before they take flight. They gather twigs to build protective nests around the bulbs on their backs, but grow frustrated when they fall apart during flight.

entry: POKENAME也躲不过比比鸟的捕猎。春夏草木茂盛时，独特羽色不幸暴露行踪，因此秋天最活跃。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are not safe from being hunted by Pidgeotto, and their distinct plumage unfortunately gives them away during the lush spring and summer seasons. As a result, they are most active in autumn.

entry: POKENAME找比比鸟巢，睡在蛋间，完美混入。醒后用精神力量推走未孵化的蛋，将巢据为己有。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME seeks out Pidgeotto nests and sleeps among the eggs, blending in perfectly. When it wakes, it uses psychic powers to push out any unhatched eggs and claim the nest as its own.

entry: POKENAME从喙中排出阵阵毒气，推动自己飞行。敌人靠得太近，就用利爪抓击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME propels itself through the sky by expelling puffs of poisonous gas from its beak. It uses its sharp talons to swipe at foes that get too close.

entry: POKENAME用藤蔓困敌，再凶猛连啄。藤蔓各自活动，几乎无从逃脱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its vines to ensnare foes before launching a flurry of aggressive pecks. The vines move independently, making escape nearly impossible.

entry: POKENAME展开强翼，发出震耳咆哮，保护弱小宝可梦。这番威吓常让捕食者害怕退却。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spreads its powerful wings and lets out a deafening roar to defend smaller Pokémon. This intimidating display often causes predators to back away in fear.

entry: POKENAME的领地包含陆海，用大鳍飞行、游泳。在海边树上栖息时，以灵活尾巴缠住枝条。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME claim a territory that includes both land and sea, flying and swimming around using their large fins. When roosting in trees on the seashore, they cling to branches with their flexible tail.

entry: POKENAME自任家乡森林的守护者，俯冲啄抓企图捕猎的生物，保护绿毛虫与独角虫一家。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appoints itself as a guardian of its home forest. It protects Caterpie and Weedle families by swooping down to peck and claw at would-be hunters.

entry: POKENAME高声鸣叫，同时用精神力量在空中筑隐形墙。屏障形成空中障碍，让捕食者和对手都晕头转向。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME chirps loudly while constructing invisible walls mid-air with its psychic powers. It uses these barriers to create aerial obstacles, confusing predators and opponents alike.

entry: POKENAME栖在歌剧院屋顶，有时能听见随演出啁啾。有些歌剧甚至把这点写进编排，让它不知不觉成了明星。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME roost in the roofs of opera houses and can sometimes be heard chirping along to the performances. Some operas have even been written taking this into account, with POKENAME becoming unwitting stars.

entry: POKENAME在所住草原全速奔跑，积够起飞的势头。性情极凶猛，用尖喙与岩石般坚硬的角迎战对手和敌人。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME runs at full speed across the prairies where it lives to gain the momentum needed to take flight. It is an incredibly fierce Pokémon that battles rivals and enemies using both its sharp beak and its rock-hard horns.

entry: POKENAME温顺，能以毒喙啄开坚硬水果。受威胁会扬尘，让捕食者短暂看不见，趁机逃走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are docile Pokémon that can break through tough fruit by pecking with their venomous beaks. When threatened, they kick up dust to momentarily blind predators while they escape.

entry: POKENAME黏软地爬上高树，在树冠狩猎。拍翼把胶状羽毛撒向目标，拖慢猎物，再追上捕获。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME oozes its way up tall trees to hunt for prey from the canopy. It flaps its wings to send goop-like feathers onto targeted prey, which slows them enough for POKENAME to hunt them down.

entry: 水色邮件的颜色虽然活泼，却是大学间专业通信的标准。POKENAME送信、送包裹又快又仔细，经常在机构间运货，足见本领。
author: quackquackattack
source: Despite the fun colors, Liteblue Mail is the standard for professional correspondence between universities. POKENAME are both fast and careful with letters and packages they deliver, as seen by how often they transport goods between facilities.

entry: POKENAME把吃掉的病毒数据存进尾羽，从中学习，让以后的进食更有效率。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stores data from consumed viruses within its tail feathers. It learns from this information, making future feedings more efficient.

entry: POKENAME还在茧中，很难用翅膀，索性靠吐丝从一棵树荡到另一棵，盼能吃够维生、进化所需的虫宝可梦。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME struggles to use its wings due to being in a cocoon state. Instead, it simply uses String Shot to swing from one tree to another, hoping to eat just enough bug Pokémon to get by and evolve.

entry: POKENAME已不能参加小小杯，有时因此迁怒发脾气。不过，一份应景的苦味咖喱能平复它的郁闷，让它在战斗中支援伙伴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is no longer able to partake in Little Cup tournaments and may occasionally lash out as a result. Even so, a Bitter Curry to match its angst helps it calm down so it can support others in battle.

entry: POKENAME头上的翅膀让它轻松翱翔。据说它会现身在梦想飞行的人类与宝可梦面前。
author: mistymagius
source: The wings on POKENAME's head allow it soar effortlessly across the sky. It is said that POKENAME will appear in front of people and Pokémon who dream of flight.

entry: POKENAME一扇翼就能掀起可怕的龙卷风。据说它心地善良，常飞越海面，救起船难后落海迷失的人。
author: fiordaliso
source: With a single beat of its wings, POKENAME can generate terrifying tornadoes. It is said to be a kind-hearted Pokémon that soars over the seas to rescue people lost overboard after shipwrecks.

entry: POKENAME在林中疾飞，双翼嗡嗡作响，快得眼睛跟不上。什么一动，就俯冲用尖刺扎一下再退走。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME zooms through forests with its loud buzzing wings, too fast for the eye to follow. It dives toward anything that moves, jabbing it with its sharp stingers before retreating.

entry: POKENAME是强大的鸟宝可梦，利爪锋锐无比。感到受威胁，便能轻松掀起龙卷风。
author: smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a very strong bird Pokémon, its claws are razor sharp. It will whip up a tornado without effort if it feels threatened.

entry: POKENAME身形小巧，能借风飘往任何想去的地方。蓝色羽毛里，似乎还藏着古老的超能力。
author: smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a tiny bird Pokémon that uses the wind to float anywhere it may want to go. Its blue feathers seem to hold an ancient psychic power.

entry: POKENAME凭强健的双翼飞上天空，巡视家族栖居的河流。虽然能以水攻击远处的敌人，它却更喜欢近身交战。
author: fiordaliso
source: It patrols the rivers where its family group lives from the sky, which it reaches thanks to its powerful wings. Although it is capable of striking from a distance with its water-based attacks, POKENAME prefers close-range combat.

entry: POKENAME本能地过量捕食，超出身体所能承受。不过，它也出于善意，把食物分给群中其他波波。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME instinctively catches and consumes more prey than its body can handle. However, in an act of kindness, it shares its meals with other Pidgey in the group.

entry: POKENAME不知疲倦地滑翔巡领地，提防危险。一见捕食者，就挥爪尖叫，警告伙伴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME tirelessly patrols its territory while gliding, keeping an eye out for danger. If it spots a predator, it waves its paws and lets out a sharp cry to warn others.

entry: 融合尚未普及时，POKENAME曾被误认成受伤的比比鸟。好些训练家不得不赶忙向宝可梦中心的护士解释，自己并没让宝可梦过度战斗。
author: afilthycasual
source: Before fusion became widespread, POKENAME were mistaken for injured Pidgeotto. Several Trainers had to hurriedly explain to Pokémon Center nurses that they didn't push their Pokémon too far in battle.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME的精神力量增强，不拍翼也能轻松滑翔。它无声狩猎，凭敏锐智慧追踪、捕获猎物。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME's psychic powers strengthen, allowing it to glide effortlessly through the air without flapping its wings. It hunts silently, using its keen intellect to track and capture prey.

entry: POKENAME主要早晨飞行，用手轻轻采集花粉。忙了一整天，就在缤纷花田休息，与花朵融为一体。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies mostly in the morning to harvest pollen, using its hands to gently gather from flowers. After a long day of work, it rests in colorful fields, blending in with the blossoms.

entry: POKENAME的巢用黏丝固定，常故意暴露在外，引来吃蛋的捕食者。粗心入侵者反被黏住，沦为猎物。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME nests are held together with sticky silk and are often left in the open to lure in egg-eating predators. Unwary invaders may find themselves stuck and preyed upon in turn.

entry: POKENAME的金色羽毛备受追捧，据说藏着尚未唤醒的力量。它比同伴更鲁莽，总把自己置于险境。
author: mistymagius
source: The golden plumage of POKENAME is highly sought after, as it is said to contain latent power. POKENAME is more reckless than its flock, constantly putting itself in danger.

entry: POKENAME兴奋或烦躁，就飞快拍动头上的翼。年纪太小，不善储能，一停到金属上，就把电全放光。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME rapidly flap their head wings when excited or agitated. They are very young, so they are inept at retaining energy. The moment they perch atop anything metal, they release all of their stored electricity.

entry: POKENAME难以挣脱阿利多斯的网，常被丝裹住好几天。好不容易脱身，没多久又陷进去了。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a difficult time extricating itself from Ariados webs and can often be found wrapped in silk for days. After finally freeing itself, it doesn't take long before it becomes trapped again.

entry: POKENAME若用超能力察觉巢边曾发生灾难，就立刻迁居。它更爱在能量安宁、安全的地方筑巢。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME detects a past disaster near its nesting site using its psychic abilities, it will immediately relocate. It prefers nesting in areas where the energy feels undisturbed and safe.

entry: POKENAME领地广大，有时涵盖整座城镇。同种融合使它更好斗，野生个体会专门追猎进入巢穴60英尺范围的训练家。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Territories established by POKENAME are large, sometimes encompassing entire towns. Self-fusion has made POKENAME aggressive, with wild POKENAME going out of their way to hunt any Trainer who goes within 60 feet of their nest.

entry: POKENAME只差一次进化，就能把波波一系的出色天赋尽数发挥到极致。可惜没有飘逸长头羽，威吓大比鸟对手时便吃亏。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME is one evolution away from perfection in every remarkable talent of the Pidgey line. Unfortunately, its lack of a long, flowing lock of hair gives it a disadvantage at looking intimidating to rivaling Pidgeots.

entry: POKENAME飞行时从翅膀放电，在空中留下微弱静电。脱落的羽毛也带电，触碰者会挨一下轻微电击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases electricity from its wings as it flies, leaving a faint static charge in the air. Even its loose feathers retain an electric charge when touched, giving a slight shock to those who handle them.

entry: POKENAME的花裙由叶片与大丽花瓣构成，帮助吸收阳光。飞完落下时，裙子也能减缓下降。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's flower dresses are made of leaves and dahlia petals, which help them absorb sunlight. Their dresses also offer them a slow descent when they are done flying through the skies.

entry: POKENAME难以自行梳羽，就在地上打滚，洗沙土浴。喙太小，难以可靠地啄中猎物，因此靠头花制造养分。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a difficult time grooming their own feathers, so they roll across the ground to give themselves a dust bath. Their beaks are too small to reliably peck at prey, so they rely on the flower on their head to generate nutrients.

entry: POKENAME低飞过西洋菜园，细看水面，寻找蚊香蝌蚪等猎物。一发现，就用利爪迅速抓起。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies low over watercress gardens, carefully watching the surface for prey like Poliwag. When it spots one, it swiftly snatches it up with its sharp talons.

entry: 它叫得实在太吵。养着POKENAME的人，不是放归野外，就是赶紧想办法，让它进化。
author: vaporvenator
source: Its cries are obnoxiously loud. Those who own POKENAME tend to either release them into the wild or evolve them as quickly as possible.

entry: POKENAME每天日出时醒来，寻找最适合吸收阳光的地方，借轻柔的风，迅速从一处移到另一处。阴天时，它们便待着不动，免得消耗体力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME awaken at sunrise each day to find the best places to absorb sunlight and ride on gentle gusts of wind to quickly move from one spot to another. They stay put during cloudy days to avoid getting tired.

entry: POKENAME猛烈拍动羽翼，疾掠池湖。它以惊人速度贴水而飞，在飞行中叼起昆虫。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feathery wings beat furiously as it zips across ponds and lakes. It skims the water's surface at incredible speeds, snatching up insects in mid-flight.

entry: 人们被劝告别给POKENAME劲爽汽水。它容易上瘾，若不能一罐接一罐地喝，就会发脾气。除了进化，尚无已知办法让它戒掉。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: It is encouraged not to give POKENAME Soda Pop as they can easily get addicted and get cranky if they don't constantly receive cans. There is no known way to get them to break the habit except by evolving them.

entry: POKENAME常栖在枝头看路人。据说，拔一根羽毛，便能瞥见某种可能的未来。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME are often perched atop tree branches watching passersby. Plucking one of POKENAME's feathers is said to grant a glimpse of a possible future.

entry: POKENAME常随水手出海，想找点吃的。有些因此被收养，因为能帮水手找到加快航行的气流。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often accompany sailors out at sea searching for a quick bite. Some are adopted as they help sailors find wind currents to speed up travel.

entry: POKENAME飞过森林田野，寻找合适的筑巢树。背上鳞茎对温湿变化敏感，因此会和同类争夺最佳树木。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME flies through forests and fields in search of the right tree to make its nest. The bulb on its back is sensitive to humidity and temperature changes, so it competes with other POKENAME to pick the best nesting tree.

entry: POKENAME看似笨重，强翼却让它飞得高明。飞行时，背上华丽花朵撒出一道道毒粉，削弱猎物或敌人。
author: fiordaliso
source: Although POKENAME appears quite bulky, it can soar through the air with remarkable skill thanks to its powerful wings. While flying, it releases trails of poisonous dust from the majestic flower on its back to weaken its prey or enemies.

entry: POKENAME飞得快，却很笨拙，常撞树惊扰树中住客，惹出麻烦。
author: vaporvenator
source: While fast in flight, POKENAME is very clumsy. It tends to start trouble by crashing into trees, disturbing its inhabitants.

entry: 浓密而鲜艳的头羽，是它求偶的资本。雌性POKENAME总会寻找头羽最浓密、颜色最鲜亮的雄性POKENAME。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: Its thick, colorful head plumage is used for courtship rituals. Female POKENAME search out the male POKENAME with the thickest, most vibrant plumage.

entry: POKENAME目光敏锐，观察周围时散出奇异气息。离奇传闻说，光凭神秘的存在，它就能影响别人的想法。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME uses its keen eyesight to observe its surroundings while exuding a strange aura. Wild tales suggest it can influence others' thoughts with its cryptic presence.

entry: POKENAME将精神力量导入两个喙，释放强大念力波。凭这独特本领，飞行中也能推开敌人、操纵小物件。
author: .izik
source: By channeling its psychic power through both of its beaks, POKENAME can emit powerful telekinetic waves. This unique ability allows it to push back foes and manipulate small objects mid-flight.

entry: POKENAME用利爪抓住入侵者，凶猛护巢。对方若反抗，就引发耀眼爆炸，让碎片四散飞射。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fiercely defends its nest by latching onto intruders with its talons. If the foe resists, it will detonate in a blinding explosion, sending debris flying in all directions.

entry: POKENAME用粗壮的喙挖泥，吃挖出的根。留下的小洞，常被其他宝可梦住进去。
author: .izik
source: With its thick, sturdy beak, POKENAME digs into mud to uncover roots, which it eats. It will often leave behind small burrows that other Pokémon later inhabit.

entry: POKENAME从枝头跃出，迅速拉近与猎物的距离。双爪猛砸，压倒性的力道连厚实甲壳也能打裂。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME launch themselves from tree branches to swiftly close the distance between themselves and their prey. By slamming their claws down onto their prey, the overwhelming force created can even crack dense shells.

entry: POKENAME头上的冠羽，让它在烈雀面前显得有威严。有时威势太强，整群甚至觉得它胜过领头的大嘴雀。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: The crest of hair on POKENAME's head gives it a sense of authority among other Spearow. Sometimes, it will exude so much authority that a flock of Spearow might consider POKENAME greater than their leading Fearow.

entry: POKENAME用强颚咬断果树枝，带回巢里存果，喂养幼崽。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its strong jaws to snap fruit tree branches, carrying them back to its nest. It stores fruit there to feed and raise its young.

entry: POKENAME在领地里威风地飞行，用带眼纹的钳吓退入侵者。谁一闯入，立刻就能察觉，赶来连连钳击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME flies menacingly around its territory, using its eye-patterned pincers to scare away any potential intruders. It can instantly spot any invader, to which it comes over to bash them repeatedly with its pincers.

entry: POKENAME的体型与羽色，让融合双方的同族都分不清。它站在哪边，取决于哪一半意识占上风，而且经常变化。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: The body shape and feather colors of POKENAME are enough to confuse both sides of its fused cousins. The side that POKENAME falls with depends on which half of its mind is greater, which changes frequently.

entry: POKENAME快速一啄，就能送入带毒唾液。它胆小，会飞快向后扑翅，等毒发作。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have venomous saliva that they can deliver with a quick peck. They are cowardly Pokémon and flutter backward rapidly whilst they wait for their venom to do its work.

entry: POKENAME狩猎时，用鼻子发出响亮的喇叭声，吓绿毛虫等猎物。目标一晕乱，便俯冲猛撞。
author: .izik
source: When hunting, POKENAME releases a loud trumpet-like noise from its trunk to startle prey like Caterpie. Once its target is disoriented, it swoops down for a powerful tackle.

entry: POKENAME强力拍翼，折断树果枝，再用超能力接住落果。它仔细挑拣，只吃最熟的。
author: .izik
source: With powerful wingbeats, POKENAME breaks berry tree limbs and catches the falling fruit with its psychic abilities. It carefully sorts through them, only eating the ripest berries.

entry: POKENAME飞行中翻身、后空翻，再施以重击。双翼增强机动性，让它战中闪避、调整位置。
author: .izik
source: While soaring through the air, POKENAME performs somersaults and backflips before delivering powerful strikes. Its wings enhance its mobility, allowing it to dodge and reposition mid-fight.

entry: 雷雨时，POKENAME举爪朝天吸电。静电充满身体，短暂增强攻击。
author: .izik
source: During thunderstorms, POKENAME raises its talons to the sky to absorb electricity. The static energy charges its body, making its attacks more powerful for a short time.

entry: POKENAME拍动大翼，制造强烈热风烧灼敌人。它偏爱干燥地区作战，能借风力攻击增强火势。
author: .izik
source: By flapping its large wings, POKENAME generates powerful gusts of hot wind to scorch its foes. It prefers battling in dry, arid areas where it can intensify the flames with its wind-based attacks.

entry: POKENAME翱翔密林上空，长长的身体拖在身后。当地文化的古老神话中，常有成群的它们出现。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME soar through the skies above dense jungles, their bodies trailing behind them as they fly. Flocks of POKENAME feature heavily in classical mythology for the cultures around their environment.

entry: POKENAME住在陆路难行的崎岖山区。它盘身跃起，展开颈部皮褶与翅膀，滑过险崖和沟壑。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in rough mountainous terrain that is difficult to traverse on the ground. They cross crags and ravines by coiling up then leaping, spreading their hood and wings wide to glide across the gaps.

entry: POKENAME飞到云中积蓄电力，引发猛烈雷暴。只有极少数训练家亲眼见过。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME flies high enough to be inside the clouds while charging up electricity, and creates a raging lightning storm as a result. Only a few Trainers have ever witnessed a POKENAME do this.

entry: POKENAME爱长途旅行，尽览周围声色。水手常发现它跟在航迹后，因为船会带它去新的探索之地。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy traveling long distances while taking in the sights and sounds of the world around them. Sailors often find POKENAME following in their wake, as the sailors lead them towards new places to discover.

entry: POKENAME飞累了，会落进住宅花园，一动不动。僵直的姿态与土色，让它像草坪装饰，连人和宝可梦都骗过。
author: .izik
source: When tired of flying, POKENAME will land in residential gardens and stand completely still. Its rigid posture and earthy coloring make it resemble a lawn ornament, fooling both people and Pokémon alike.

entry: POKENAME总留下树上最后一颗树果，种在附近。它用强风摇落果子，先吃饱，再确保未来的食物来源。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME always saves the last berry from a tree to replant it nearby. It uses powerful gusts to shake berries loose from branches, eating its fill before securing future food sources.

entry: 虽然已无参赛资格，它仍很自豪地教幼年宝可梦赢得小小杯。指导一轮后，吃盘涩味咖喱，再与附近愿意切磋的幼崽对练。
author: quackquackattack
source: It takes great pride in coaching baby Pokémon on how to win Little Cup battles, despite no longer being eligible. After a round of coaching, it eats a plate of Dry Curry before initiating spars between itself and consenting baby Pokémon nearby.

entry: POKENAME空中捕猎，地面筑巢。它不爱雨，偏好干燥沙地，即使沙暴中也看得清。
author: bobosmith01
source: While POKENAME hunt in the sky, they also nest in the ground. They dislike the rain and prefer dry, sandy areas; they have no trouble seeing even in a sandstorm.

entry: 这种宝可梦筑巢以后，会将从家中看得见的所有区域，都视为自己的领地。谁若侵入，POKENAME便会用脚爪、喙和火焰攻击，将对方赶走。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: When this Pokémon creates a nest, it considers any area it can see from its home to be its territory. POKENAME will use its talons, beak, and fire attacks to fend off opponents who encroach on its land.

entry: POKENAME在地下钻行时，会将强壮的翅膀紧紧收起，借势跃出，滑翔而去。背上长着许多尖锐坚硬的羽毛，可以脱落，射向敌人或猎物。
author: infinex21
source: Their wings are strong and fold up tightly as they burrow through the ground, using the momentum to leap and glide. POKENAME have many sharp and rigid feathers along their backs that they can shed and launch at foes or prey.

entry: POKENAME飞过自认属于自己的领地，寻找猎物。发现目标后，它便从高空俯冲，伸出利爪，以双脚飞踢敌人，再带着新猎获回巢。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME flies around land that it considers its territory to seek out prey. Once this Pokémon spots a target, it will dive from the sky before outstretching its taloned claws and dropkicking the foe. With its fresh catch, it returns to its nest.

entry: POKENAME还在学空中平衡，一觉得要掉下去，就常用瞬间移动。落地后用尘土裹身，防寄生虫。
author: ghostslythe
source: Still learning to stay balanced in the air, POKENAME will often teleport if it feels like it's falling. Once on the ground, this Pokémon covers itself in dust to protect against parasites.

entry: POKENAME读取情绪时，腰间细羽轻轻飘动。若察觉强烈负面情绪，就起飞，在对方上空盘旋，跳安抚之舞。
author: .izik
source: The delicate feathers around POKENAME's waist flutter softly when it is reading someone's emotions. If it senses strong negative feelings, it will take flight and circle above them in a calming dance.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，什么闯入都啄。身体虽小，羽下的毒刺却让它很有威胁。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME is incredibly territorial and will peck at anything that enters its turf. Although its body is small, the venomous barbs under its feathers make it a genuine threat.

entry: POKENAME沿溪边飞，用尖喙采芦苇，编进小屋结构，帮助抵御风雨寒暑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies along the edges of streams, collecting reeds with its sharp beak. These reeds are woven into the structure of its lodge to help insulate it from the elements.

entry: 古代文明把POKENAME视为至高神灵。直到今天，鸟宝可梦仍极其敬畏它，献上食物，祈求眷顾。
author: sk372
source: Ancient civilizations treated POKENAME as a divine being of the highest order. Even now, avian Pokémon treat it with extreme reverence, offering up offerings of food to it to gain its favor.

entry: POKENAME善战，用翅膀绕敌疾行，从意想不到的角度攻击。它配合啄击，以及爪上尖刺的反手挥击出招。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are adept combatants, using their wings to dart around their opponents and attack from unexpected angles. They strike through a combination of pecks and back swings with the spikes on their paws.

entry: POKENAME太重，飞不起来，便用翅膀守护背上的花。不找食物时，常能见到它晒太阳。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is too heavy to fly, so it uses its wings to defend the flower on its back. It can be seen basking in the sunlight whenever it is not finding food to eat.

entry: POKENAME不挖找鲜嫩多汁的小宝可梦时，就坐着看比力诺打斗，欣赏潜在伴侣。翅膀较小，得靠比力诺飞上树，为双方找更多食物。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: When a POKENAME isn't digging for some small, juicy Pokémon, it sits and watches Pidgerino brawls to admire a potential partner. It relies on Pidgerinos to fly up into the trees to get more food for them due to POKENAME's smaller wings.

entry: POKENAME只能借羽臂乘气流滑翔，算是“飞行”。奔跑足够快，头锤一击就能劈树，不过冲击通常也会把自己撞晕乎。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can only "fly" by gliding on wind currents with the help of their feathered arms. They can run fast enough that their Headbutt attacks can split a tree in one strike, though the impact of these attacks will typically leave them dazed.

entry: POKENAME前爪划击能送入使人衰弱的毒素。饲养它的训练家被建议戴防护手套，避免接触时不慎中毒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's talons are coated in a debilitating toxin that is delivered through slashes of their fore-talons. Trainers keeping POKENAME are advised to make use of protective gloves when handling them to avoid accidentally poisoning themselves.

entry: POKENAME高声尖利地互相呼唤，极远都能听见。巢常在远离捕食者的山崖上，谁想靠近就啄谁。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make loud, keening cries to one another that can be heard across large distances. Their nests are often found on mountain cliff faces away from predators; they will peck at anyone that tries to get close.

entry: POKENAME体大食少，却很机灵。它砍下整根树枝，再用唯一的翅膀扫走叶片，寻找藏着的虫宝可梦。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Large in size but meager in appetite, POKENAME is nonetheless crafty. It slashes whole branches off trees, then sweeps away the leaves with its singular wing to find the bug Pokémon hidden within.

entry: POKENAME每5至10只群斗，决定首领。角与爪激烈相撞，打得凶猛，任何听见战吼与碰撞声的比娜都会被吸引来。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME brawls happen in groups of 5 to 10 to decide the leader. The fights are so intense and violent that it attracts any Pidgerina that hears their battle cries and clashing of horns and talons.

entry: POKENAME头羽锋利如刃。头部一击就能利落切铁，轻松得令人害怕。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's head feathers are as sharp as blades. A single strike from its head can slice clean through iron with terrifying ease.

entry: 它在领地上空翱翔，保护所栖森林里，那些较弱的宝可梦。
author: melodydelune
source: Soaring around its territory, this Pokémon acts as a defender of weaker Pokémon in the forests it inhabits.

entry: POKENAME全身投入战斗，羽毛利爪狂舞。性情好斗，让穿过领地的登山者面临危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fight in a frenzy of feathers and claws, fully committing to their battles with their entire bodies. Their aggression makes them dangerous hazards for hikers travelling through their territories.

entry: 亏月时，POKENAME开始换羽。落羽在夜空下微微闪烁，有人因此相信它们带有神秘力量。
author: .izik
source: During a waning moon, POKENAME's feathers begin to molt. The fallen feathers shimmer faintly under the night sky, leading some to believe they carry mystical properties.

entry: POKENAME为争领地，与同类在空中激烈决斗。可面具一受损就立刻逃跑，因此很少能长期占住同一片地。
author: quantumradiation
