source: POKENAME will engage in fierce duels in the sky over territory against other POKENAME. However, as soon as the mask on its face is damaged, it will immediately flee, so it rarely remains in control of the same territory for long.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME跳螺旋舞。群体聚在空中，同步滑出诡异图案。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs spiral dances during full moons. Flocks gather in the sky, gliding in eerie synchronized patterns.

entry: POKENAME在寒冷山顶休息时，用暖尾裹住身体保温。白天在树间扑飞，留下轻柔的暖意。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME curls its warm tails around itself when resting, using them to stay warm on top of cold hilltops. It flutters between trees during the day, leaving behind a soft trail of heat.

entry: POKENAME纤细丝状翼上的珠饰带着颜色、重量相同的钥匙。有趣的是，曾有一只爱带花蓓蓓而非钥匙，被误认成了花疗环环。
author: haypile
source: The beads in its wiry wings have keys that are identical in color and weight. Interestingly, one POKENAME liked carrying Flabébé instead of keys and was then mistaken for a Comfey.

entry: POKENAME自命不凡，极细心地打理羽毛与尾巴。任何东西弄脏华美身体，都会让它暴怒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are pompous creatures that take fastidious care of their feathers and tails. They become incredibly irate when anything dirties their magnificent body.

entry: POKENAME清早飞到水边，用爪刮黏土，仔细涂在小屋上加固，确保结实。
author: .izik
source: In the early morning, POKENAME flies to the water's edge and scrapes up clay with its paws. It carefully applies the clay to reinforce its lodge, ensuring it remains sturdy.

entry: POKENAME能读取附近生物的波导，轻易察觉恶意。感到威胁时，尾羽先亮起金光，再起飞警告伙伴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can read the auras of those nearby, detecting malice with ease. If it senses a threatening presence, its tail feathers glow a brilliant gold before it takes flight to alert its allies.

entry: POKENAME独特而复杂的歌声在高山间远传，数英里外都能听见。它爱向观众表演，人靠近巢，歌就更响。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be heard across alpine mountains for many miles, their distinctive and complex songs carrying far through the air. The volume of their songs increases when people draw close to their nests as they love to perform for an audience.

entry: POKENAME伪装成人类采果人，诱骗毫无戒心的猎物。对方一松懈，就发动锐利而不停歇的连啄。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a human berry picker to lure unsuspecting prey. Once they lower their guard, it strikes with a barrage of sharp, relentless pecks.

entry: POKENAME化石常被错当成始祖小鸟。如今，它是陆地与天空中最凶猛的捕食者之一。
author: ozydamians
source: POKENAME fossils are often mistaken for Archen. In the modern day, POKENAME is one of the most ferocious predators on land and in the sky.

entry: POKENAME以羽冠长短分等级。因此，地位最高的个体无法分出、留下部分身体，记住觅食处，否则羽毛也会随之缩短。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME hierarchy is based on the length of its feather crest. Because of this status check, the most dominant POKENAME is unable to split or leave behind any of its body to remember feeding spots, as its feathers will shrink with it.

entry: POKENAME抓住树枝，高声对唱。群聚时会合成美丽的摇篮曲，常把听众唱睡。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME cling to tree branches and loudly sing to one another. When a flock of them groups together, they will harmonise with one another in a beautiful lullaby, often sending listeners to sleep.

entry: POKENAME能模仿听过的任何声音，神奇得不可思议，借此融入其他宝可梦的群体。这本领曾掀起短暂热潮，玩具公司争相尝试复制。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have an uncanny ability to mimic any sound they hear, using the ability to fit into communities of other Pokémon. Their ability to do this led to a brief craze where toy companies attempted to create replicas of them.

entry: POKENAME从高空狩猎，敏锐听觉在几百英尺高处也能定位猎物。它把腿收进羽毛，尽量加快飞行。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME hunts from high in the sky, using its acute hearing to locate prey from hundreds of feet in the air. It pulls its legs into its feathers to maximize its flying speed.

entry: POKENAME降落时，从爪子迸出火花，排掉积电。噼啪声有时会被误认成雷鸣。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME lands, it releases bursts of sparks from its talons to discharge built-up electricity. The resulting crackle can sometimes be mistaken for a thunderclap.

entry: 野生POKENAME每天巡领地，长牙让飞行更加迅捷。谁敢入侵，最好小心它致命的燕返。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME will patrol their territory daily, their tusks making it all the easier for them to fly swiftly through the air. Anything that dares invade their territories had best beware their deadly Aerial Ace attacks.

entry: POKENAME翱翔夜空，羽尖散出细小余烬。光迹令人着迷，在干燥地区却很危险。
author: .izik
source: When soaring through the night sky, POKENAME releases tiny embers from the tips of its feathers. This glowing trail creates a mesmerizing sight but can be dangerous in dry areas.

entry: POKENAME进食前从喙吐小火，烤熟食物。本能就知道最合适的烤制温度，从不过火。
author: .izik
source: Before eating, POKENAME spits small flames from its beak to cook its food. It has an instinctual sense for perfect roasting temperatures and will never overcook its meals.

entry: POKENAME无声抓走小虫宝可梦，用利爪死死抓牢。等回到巢，猎物早已挣扎得精疲力尽。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME silently abduct small bug Pokémon and clench onto their prey with sharp talons. By the time they return to their nest, their prey has exhausted themselves from struggling.

entry: POKENAME比看着灵活得多。身体轻、个头小，奋力一拍翼，就能飞到1英里外。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME is a lot more mobile than it appears. Its light body weight and small size mean a single huge flap of its wings can send it soaring a mile away.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，跺脚展翼，跳好斗的舞。可在信任的训练家身边，舞蹈就变得俏皮亲热。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME is very territorial, stamping its feet and spreading its wings in an aggressive dance. Around trusted Trainers, however, these dances become playful and affectionate.

entry: POKENAME看见最爱的食物，古怪、使人头脑麻木的口水就飞快流出。能忍受饲养它的训练家，往往只喂不算最爱、却仍吃得下的食物。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: When POKENAME sees its favorite food, its funky, mind-numbing drool comes out at a rapid pace. The only Trainers who manage to withstand owning a POKENAME tend to feed it a food it doesn't love but still tolerates.

entry: 翼上的棉花让飞行全然无声，猎物根本听不到POKENAME靠近。它用多余棉花垫软巢，每早醒来都休息得很足。
author: fiordaliso
source: The cotton covering its wings makes its flight completely silent, so its prey never hears it coming. POKENAME uses the excess cotton to make its nest softer, so it wakes up feeling well-rested every morning.

entry: 常忘了自己不会飞，竟从树上跳下尝试起飞。羽毛极锋利，会与其他POKENAME较量谁的羽毛更利。
author: mistymagius
source: It tends to forget that it cannot fly so it will sometimes throw itself out of trees in an attempt to take off. Its feathers are incredibly sharp, and it will fight with other POKENAME to see whose feathers are sharper.

entry: POKENAME行动反复无常，仿佛背上的蘑菇，正在时不时接管，身体的活动能力。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is very capricious in its actions. It almost seems as if the mushroom on its back is temporarily gaining control of its locomotor abilities.

entry: 它用爪爬树，也攀山壁。野生POKENAME常向进入领地的训练家投掷石头与沙。
author: schwaus
source: It uses its claws to climb trees and mountainsides alike. Wild POKENAME often throw rocks and sands at Trainers that enter their territory.

entry: POKENAME住在陡峭山坡，用大石和原木巧妙搭建复杂巢穴。
author: schwaus
source: POKENAME populate steep mountainsides, where they build elaborate nests. Its nests are cleverly constructed with large rocks and logs.

entry: POKENAME头上的大羽毛，标志着它在群体中的地位；首领的羽毛最大。它们常用利爪相互劈砍，为争夺主导地位而战。
author: santon5512
source: The large feathers across POKENAME's heads are indicative of their status in the pack, with the leader having the largest. These Pokémon often fight each other for dominance, using their talons to slice at each other.

entry: 睡在填满POKENAME羽毛的枕头上，醒来会休息充分、精力充沛。它很稀有，因此枕头往往售价极高。
author: chibitales
source: Sleeping on a pillow filled with POKENAME feathers leaves one well rested and energetic when they wake. Due to POKENAME's rarity, these pillows are often sold for extremely high prices.

entry: POKENAME漫无目的地爬过树枝，神情漠然，仿佛已无法掌控，自己的感官。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME crawls aimlessly through the branches of trees. It seems almost apathetic, as if it is not in control of its senses.

entry: POKENAME扇翼，把粉撒满森林树木与地面，再感知粉末受扰的位置，攻击、吃掉受其影响的小宝可梦。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME flaps its wings to blow its powder all over the forest trees and ground. It can then sense places where the powder is disturbed to attack and consume small Pokémon that are affected by it.

entry: POKENAME翅膀上的鳞片，更像细小的羽毛。它主要以虫宝可梦为食，可爪子太小，实在不便抓牢猎物。
author: robosoup
source: The scales on POKENAME's wings are more like tiny feathers. It mostly eats bug Pokémon, though its claws are too small for grasping prey.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME睡的池塘泛蓝光。科学家困惑不解，因为水的化学性质毫无变化。
author: .izik
source: On full moons, the pond where POKENAME sleeps glows blue. Scientists are baffled, as the water's chemistry remains unchanged.

entry: POKENAME潜伏池边，等毫无戒心的鲤鱼王跃出水面，再用利爪抓住，飞回巢。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME stalks the edges of ponds, waiting for an unsuspecting Magikarp to leap out of the water. It snatches its prey with its sharp talons, then flies off to its nest.

entry: POKENAME身上的黏土外壳格外耐用，风暴中能保护眼睛和羽毛，抵挡强风与飞散碎片。
author: .izik
source: The clay casing on POKENAME's body is remarkably durable. It shields its eyes and feathers from harsh winds and flying debris during storms.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME拍翼时身体泛橙光。它与群体沿8字形路线飞行，编成绚烂光景。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME's body glows orange as it flaps its wings. It flies in figure-eight patterns with its flock, creating brilliant light displays.

entry: 科学家争论POKENAME究竟是鸟、爬行动物、龙，还是恐龙。可致命的手爪、喙、牙齿与脚爪，比钢铁更锋利，毫无疑问。
author: ozydamians
source: Scientists debate if POKENAME is a bird, reptile, dragon, or dinosaur. There is no question, however, that its deadly claws, beak, teeth, and talons are all sharper than steel.

entry: POKENAME用强喙敲碎埋藏的巨石。喙若受损，就吃树根，慢慢修复。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its powerful beak to shatter buried boulders. If its beak damaged, it feeds on tree roots to slowly restore the beak.

entry: POKENAME会认领领地里的恋人，为保护他们巡视。任一方遇险，它就迅速来救，啄到威胁退却为止。
author: linhasxoc
source: POKENAME is known to adopt romantic couples within its territory and patrols for their safety. If one of the pair is in danger, it will swiftly come to their rescue, pecking the threat until it retreats.

entry: POKENAME谨慎选巢，靠敏感胡须察觉当地盛行气流。它挑避开强风的位置，常在高高的树梢筑巢。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are careful when choosing their nests, relying on their sensitive whiskers to detect the prevailing wind currents in the area. They choose spots that are sheltered from strong gusts, often nesting high in the treetops.

entry: POKENAME头脑还算清醒，能看见树里藏着的宝可梦。不过，它常判断失误，反被远大于己、远超应付能力的危险生物袭击。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME's somewhat clear head allows it to see Pokémon hiding inside trees. However, it usually ends up misjudging and gets attacked by something far bigger and more dangerous than it can handle.

entry: POKENAME训练波波群配合攻击，确保吃到东西。许多野餐篮遭洗劫，都拜它的指导所赐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME train Pidgey flocks on how to coordinate their attacks to secure meals. Many picnic baskets have been raided thanks to the guidance of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的空中战斗操控，在有翼宝可梦中格外出色。拳打脚踢，甚至倒立，都能保持浮空。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME's air control in combat is outstanding compared to other winged Pokémon. It is able to remain in the air while punching, kicking, and even being upside down.

entry: POKENAME飞行与格斗技巧堪比摔角鹰人，着重空中作战。即使没有地面支撑体重，也能打出使钢铁弯曲的重击。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME's flight and fight technique is comparable to Hawlucha, with a focus on air-based combat. It is able to deliver steel-bending blows even without a ground to support its weight.

entry: 专门的训练家常选POKENAME侦察稀有宝可梦与材料。增强的嗅觉让它找到任何指定目标，远传的鸣叫可向最远10英里外求援。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: Specialized Trainers often choose POKENAME to scout for rare Pokémon and materials. Its enhanced sense of smell and far-reaching cry allow it to find anything it's commanded to and call for help up to 10 miles away.

entry: 谁胆敢弄乱哪怕一根羽毛，POKENAME都会怒火中烧。每次从坚喙喷火，体温就升得极高，肚皮变得通红滚烫。
author: fiordaliso
source: If anyone dares to ruffle even a single feather, POKENAME flies into a burning rage. Every time it breathes fire from its sturdy beak, its body temperature rises so high that its belly becomes red-hot.

entry: POKENAME的聪明才智与庞大体形同样惊人。曾被观察到从高空投下尖石捕猎，再生火烤肉。
author: ozydamians
source: Its impressive size is matched only by its cleverness. POKENAME has been observed to drop sharpened stones on prey from above and roast the meat over a fire.

entry: 被危险宝可梦逼到角落，POKENAME会借双翼快速旋身，让胸前螺旋纹仿佛在转。多数宝可梦一看，虽未接触，也会觉得重心向一边偏。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: When cornered by a dangerous Pokémon, POKENAME will spin its body around rapidly with its wings, making the spiral on its chest appear to spin. Most Pokémon that see it will feel their weight shift to the side without any contact.

entry: POKENAME用大翼积蓄冲势，再撞向敌人。战斗太激烈，就瞬间移动到安全处恢复体力。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its large wings to build momentum before crashing into its enemies. If the battle grows too intense, it teleports to a safe location to recover its strength.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀与闪亮胡须赋予念力，让它在空中自动闪避攻击。观察发现，勇基拉看了它，会露出被研究者称为“胡须嫉妒”的情绪。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: The wings and glistening mustache of POKENAME give it telekinetic powers that allow it to avoid attacks automatically in the air. It has been observed that POKENAME has made Kadabras display an emotion researchers dub as mustache envy.

entry: POKENAME整天不知疲倦地训练，让肌肉更强。赢下决斗，习惯送对手一根羽毛，邀请对方进步后再战。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME trains tirelessly all day to make its muscles increasingly powerful. When it wins a duel, it has the habit of gifting one of its feathers to its opponent, inviting them to improve so they can meet again in future matches.

entry: POKENAME花数小时只顾吸土、在嘴里溶土，盼顺便吃到埋着的虫宝可梦。结果90%的食物都只是土。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME spends several hours doing nothing but sucking up and melting dirt in its mouth, hoping it will consume any buried bug Pokémon in the process. 90% of its diet ends up being just dirt.

entry: POKENAME滑过森林寻找橙橙果。壳带来的厚重体格让它挤开其他鸟宝可梦，摘到最熟的果子。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME glides through the forests in search of Oran Berries. Their shells give them the bulk to shove past other bird Pokémon, allowing them to pluck the ripest fruits.

entry: POKENAME用小翼飞过所住河流，确保自己与群体不受威胁。背腹的壳有时妨碍转向，因此常改用游泳。
author: fiordaliso
source: With its small wings, POKENAME flies over the rivers it inhabits to make sure no danger threatens itself or its group. The shell covering its back and abdomen sometimes hinders its maneuvers, so it often chooses to swim instead.

entry: 为显示支配地位，POKENAME试图扯掉彼此头顶羽毛般的叶片。失去叶片的个体，找到伴侣的机会会小得多。
author: mistymagius
source: To show their dominance over one another, POKENAME will try to rip out the feather-like leaves on top of each other's heads. POKENAME with their leaves ripped off are far less likely to find a mate.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀勉强够力，让它留在空中。因此能落到大石上将其砸开，吃里面的矿物与藏着的虫宝可梦。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME's wings are just about strong enough to keep it airborne. Because of this, it is able to drop down onto big rocks to break them open and eat any minerals and bug Pokémon it finds hiding inside.

entry: POKENAME起飞前尖声鸣叫，通知并协调同群伙伴。拍翼越有力，头上火簇烧得越旺，放出强烈红光。
author: fiordaliso
source: Before taking flight, POKENAME emits sharp cries to inform the rest of its flock and coordinate with them. The more vigorously it flaps its wings, the more the fiery tufts on its head blaze, radiating an intense red glow.

entry: POKENAME稍聪明些，能看出虫宝可梦会到哪里进入攻击范围，提前准备。不过通常算错，75%的时候都会落空。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: Somewhat smarter than normal, POKENAME can see where a bug Pokémon may end up in its reach and prepares to strike for that moment. It usually miscalculates and misses its mark 75% of the time.

entry: POKENAME低飞过河流，巡视周围，保护伙伴。壳让飞行困难时，就靠强大的游泳本领行动。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME flies low over rivers to survey its surroundings and protect its companions. When its shell makes flying difficult, it relies on its strong swimming abilities instead.

entry: POKENAME贴河面巡视，时刻守望伙伴。壳太重，飞不久时就入水，出色泳技足以弥补。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME patrols rivers from just above the surface, ever watchful over the companions it guards. When its shell proves too heavy for sustained flight, it takes to the water, where its swimming prowess more than compensates.

entry: POKENAME洗沙浴清洁，防止寄生虫附着。它转动甲壳扬沙，让翅膀也充分裹上。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME clean themselves by sand bathing to prevent parasites from sticking to them. They spin their shell to disperse sand into the air so that their wings are properly coated.

entry: POKENAME是圣特安努号佳肴“大葱油封禽肉”的主角。大葱经明火炙烤，肉先用释陀果酱腌渍，再烤至恰好的焦香。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is the star ingredient in 'Confit de volaille aux poireaux,' a delicacy served aboard the S.S. Anne. Its leek is flame-grilled, and its meat is marinated in a Custap Berry sauce before being perfectly charred.

entry: POKENAME羽毛与皮肤融合，变得毛茸茸、温暖又防水。因此能潜入冷水捞鱼宝可梦，甚至浮在水面休息。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME's feathers merge into its skin to make it furry, warm, and waterproof. This change in its body allows it to dive into cold water to scoop up fish Pokémon, and even rest on top of the water.

entry: POKENAME羽毛上的泥状糊毒性很强。污泥虽重，它仍能长途飞行，身后留下滴滴污染物。
author: .izik
source: The mud-like paste covering POKENAME's feathers is highly toxic. Despite the heaviness of the sludge, it still manages to fly long distances, leaving behind trails of polluted droplets.

entry: POKENAME身上厚厚的毒糊，能让20英尺内的人头晕。飞行时不经意撒出细滴，沿途留下刺鼻气味。
author: .izik
source: The thick, toxic paste covering POKENAME's body can cause dizziness to anyone within 20 feet. As it flies, it unintentionally scatters small droplets of ooze, leaving a pungent scent in its wake.

entry: POKENAME清洁身体的过程很长，既洗沙浴，也泡水。不洗澡时，就飞过倒木，喷出阵阵水流，追捕虫属性宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a lengthy bathing process that includes both sand bathing and immersing their body in water. When they are not cleaning themselves, they chase after Bug-type Pokémon by flying over fallen logs and shooting bursts of water.

entry: POKENAME身体沉重，只能低飞，每次仅数分钟，因此更爱游泳。它常与同类为领地主权争斗。
author: fiordaliso
source: Due to its heavy build, POKENAME can fly only at low altitude and for just a few minutes at a time, preferring to move by swimming instead. It frequently battles others of its species for territorial dominance.

entry: POKENAME在镇上飞，追踪居民，记住习惯。夜里落到屋顶，用超能力大吃他们的梦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies around town tracking citizens, memorizing their habits. At night, it lands on rooftops and uses its psychic powers to feast on their dreams.

entry: POKENAME把点亮触角所需的能量存进背上鳞茎。它住海底，主要吃死去的藻类。
author: fiordaliso
source: Inside the bulb on POKENAME's back, it stores the energy it needs to make its antennae shine brightly. It lives on the ocean floor, feeding mostly on dead algae.

entry: POKENAME发光的触角与扭动身体是完美鱼饵，因此常被渔民当诱饵。撑过几轮垂钓活下来的，有时便会进化。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often finds itself as a lure for fishermen, as its glowing antennae and wriggling body serve as the perfect bait for fishing. Those who survive a few rounds of fishing may end up evolving.

entry: POKENAME头上的许多触角同时释放光与精神能量，引来宝可梦和训练家。没有别的目的，只是喜欢有人陪。
author: foolish_weasel
source: The many antennae sprouting from POKENAME's head simultaneously emit light and psychic energy. This is meant to lure in Pokémon and Trainers alike for no other reason than it enjoys company.

entry: 无论水里水外，POKENAME都用亮光引导大家去安全处。水下靠头上的灯球，陆上则把会在黑暗中发光的分泌物涂在骨棒上。
author: sk372
source: Whether in the water or out, POKENAME guides others to safety with illuminating light. Underwater it uses the bulbs on its cranium, while on land it uses a secretion it covers its bone club with that glows in the dark.

entry: POKENAME让发光电球互相碰触来交流，一碰便迸出亮光。金色骨棒的导电性优于多数其他材料。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME communicate with each other by touching their glowing electrical bulbs together; when these bulbs touch, they produce bright flashes. Their golden clubs conduct electricity better than most other materials.

entry: POKENAME不爱打架，用两个黄色器官闪出强光，让敌人短暂看不见，再逃走。它用金色骨棒接闪电，补充能量。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME prefers to avoid fighting and emits bright flashes of light from its two yellow organs to momentarily blind foes while it flees. Using its golden club, it catches lightning bolts to replenish its energy.

entry: POKENAME好奇心极强。若遇到危险，便从口中喷出，带电的墨汁。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are known to be extremely curious. If it's in danger, it'll shoot electrified ink from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME绚烂的光让敌友都看得入迷。这场灯光秀既能防御，也能吸引猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's dazzling lights captivate both friends and foes, mesmerizing those who watch. This light show serves as both a defense and a way to attract prey.

entry: POKENAME的鳍在黑暗中闪耀，以美丽著称。有些水族馆会饲养、训练数只，编成活体灯光秀。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's fins shimmer and gleam in the dark. Renown for their beauty, aquariums sometimes house and train several POKENAME to act as members of a living lightshow.

entry: POKENAME雷雨时把触角伸出水面。若被雷击，就把电存进身体。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME extends its antennae out of the water during thunderstorms. Should it be struck by lightning, it will store the electricity within its body.

entry: 触角上的灯发出刺眼闪光，扰乱其他宝可梦，让POKENAME更容易取得花蜜。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The lights on its antennae emit blinding Flashes. This will disorient other Pokémon, giving POKENAME better access to nectar.

entry: POKENAME发梢的灯在黑暗中明亮发光，照亮并衬托舞姿。舞有些催眠，观众忍不住一直看到结束。
author: sk372
source: The lights at the end of POKENAME's hair glow brightly in the dark, illuminating and accentuating its dance moves. Its dance is vaguely hypnotic; viewers are compelled to keep watching until the performance finishes.

entry: POKENAME先跺蹄，让发光球闪耀，再冲向敌人。角中导入电流，帮助它最终击败对手。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME stomp their hooves to produce flashes of light from their luminous bulbs before charging at an enemy. Their horns channel electricity to help ensure they finish off their foes.

entry: 用水缸养POKENAME，得确保不装电动过滤器。靠得太近，它身上就会冒电火花。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME is to be kept in a tank, it is important to make sure an electric filter is not installed. Should it get too close to one, its body will spark.

entry: 深暗之中，有潜水者错把它认成潜艇。还没发觉认错，就已被POKENAME吞下。
author: dodoowner_
source: In the dark, some scuba divers mistake it for a submarine. Before they realize their mistake, they get eaten by POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME借灯光潜入深水捕猎。有些训练家骑着它，探索普通潜水员难以看清的暗处。
author: huh.7
source: POKENAME use their lanterns to dive deep below the water to catch their prey. Some trainers ride them to explore areas too dark for regular divers.

entry: POKENAME在网络空间是高效的防病毒程序。鼻子与尾巴发光，引来恶意程序，靠近后便予以清除。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME works effectively as an antivirus program in cyberspace. Its nose and tail emit a glow that draws in malicious programs, so it can purge them once they draw close.

entry: POKENAME浮在海底附近，用身体底部的强丝系住海床。触角闪出亮得刺痛双眼的光，赶走袭击者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats near the ocean bottom, tethered to the sea floor via a strong thread from its bottom. Attackers are repelled by painfully bright flashes of light from its antennae.

entry: POKENAME爱夜里一起游泳，在水中旋舞。它们会用头上的光，把落难海上的人引向岸边。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME love swimming together at night, dancing and twirling through the water. These Pokémon have been known to guide castaways to shore using the lights on their heads.

entry: POKENAME双尾的光让其他生物忍不住盯着看，陷入恍惚。趁对方入迷，便更容易探索其心灵和记忆。
author: sk372
source: The light emanating from POKENAME's twin tails compels others to stare into them, putting them in a stupor. This trance state lets POKENAME more easily explore the minds and memories of those it has charmed.

entry: POKENAME水下遇险，会将尾巴当临时拳头。可尾巴太软，打到敌人后通常又弹了回来。
author: teatedtiten
source: When threatened underwater, POKENAME will use their tails as makeshift fists. Their tails however are squishy, so it commonly bounces off of the opponent.

entry: POKENAME信任其他宝可梦与训练家，会亲昵蹭鼻问候。水下探险队常与它们交友，请它们照亮深海。
author: teatedtiten
source: POKENAME are very trusting with other Pokémon and Trainers, nuzzling with them as a greeting. Underwater exploration teams befriend these Pokémon to offer light in the deep ocean.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME眉毛末端的球每隔1分钟准时闪一次。若开始不同步，就表示它渐渐病了。
author: sk372
source: During the night, the orbs at the end of POKENAME's eyebrows pulse at exactly one-minute intervals. If the orbs begin glowing out of sync, it is a sign that POKENAME is growing ill.

entry: POKENAME头上明亮的触角能远距离传信。它极爱社交，雨夜能见到它们在整片天空互通消息。
author: comfortablybrum
source: The bright, glowing antennae on POKENAME's head allow them to send signals at long range. POKENAME are a very social Pokémon, and on rainy nights, they can be seen communicating all across the sky.

entry: POKENAME藏在深海，用亮触角把毫无戒心的猎物引到身边。靠得够近，就向前猛扑，用毒颚攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME hides in the ocean depths and uses its luminous antennae to lure unsuspecting prey toward its position. When the victim gets close enough, it lunges forward to strike with its venomous jaws.

entry: POKENAME众多耀眼的电光诱饵，会吸引任何在黑暗中看见它的深海宝可梦。它用亮卷须裹住猎物，再以强电流麻痹。
author: cartoonhostage
source: POKENAME's many dazzling, electric lures attract any deep sea Pokémon that sees it shining in the darkness. It wraps its prey in its gleaming tendrils, paralyzing them with powerful electric charges.

entry: 东部地区认为，在浅水面附近见到这种稀有POKENAME，是天灾将临的警告。西部却视为难得的吉兆，预示好运。
author: boggyboat
source: In eastern regions, spotting this rare POKENAME near the surface is believed to serve as a warning of an incoming natural disaster. In western regions, however, they are seen as a rare and lucky sight that brings promises of good fortune.

entry: POKENAME常发育不足，没法好好储电或放电。不过，尾上的球状器官能帮它存下一些电荷。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are often too underdeveloped to properly retain, or discharge, electricity. Their tails have a bulbous organ that helps them store some of their electrical charge, however.

entry: 新月之夜，POKENAME成群在浅海床上轻轻起落而舞，始终小心，不真正浮出水面。这场仪式中，似乎无视其他生物。
author: ocxin
source: On new moon nights, POKENAME can be seen in swarms, gently dancing up and down shallow ocean beds, taking care never to truly surface. They seem to ignore other creatures during this ritual.

entry: POKENAME友善，常为迷路的宝可梦与训练家照路。经常穿行暗处的人，往往带一只在身边。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are friendly Pokémon who often provide a guiding light for lost Pokémon and lost Trainers. Those who often traverse dark areas tend to have a POKENAME handy.

entry: POKENAME开心时常用鳍拍掌，身上黄色部位也泛微光。触角最长的就是最年长者，常受同类敬重。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME often clap their fins together when happy, the yellows of their bodies faintly glowing as well. The eldest POKENAME is the one with the longest antenna and is often well-respected among its own kind.

entry: POKENAME沿头侧产生电脉冲，不幸也会电到大脑。因此年纪越大，越不聪明，也越笨拙。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME generate electric pulses along the side of their head. This has the unfortunate side effect of zapping their brain, so POKENAME become less intelligent and clumsier as they age.

entry: POKENAME晃得海底相遇的宝可梦看不见，在战斗开始前就逃跑。月相似乎影响心情：满月极活跃，新月则几乎懒得动。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME blinds Pokémon it encounters on the seafloor and flees before a battle can break out. The lunar cycle appears to influence its mood, making it hyperactive during a full moon and nearly lethargic during a new moon.

entry: 受威胁时，POKENAME让背上花苞的花瓣发光，晃花附近敌人的眼。鳞茎太重，迫使它在水下游得很慢。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME feels threatened, it makes the petals of the bud on its back glow, blinding nearby enemies. Because of the weight of the bulb it carries, it is forced to swim very slowly underwater.

entry: POKENAME必须磨牙，才能产生点亮尾巴所需的能量。主要靠光引来河中宝可梦，尾巴一被轻咬，就将猎物拉近。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME must gnash its teeth together in order to generate the energy needed to make its tail light up. Its main way of hunting is luring river-dwelling Pokémon with its light, reeling them in when they take a nibble on its tail.

entry: 这种海生宝可梦很难看见，唯有迷惑目标时才点亮触角。它似乎不用吃固体，而从别的生物的痛苦中摄取能量。
author: infinex21
source: These sea-dwelling Pokémon are hard to see unless they emit light from their antennae, which they only do to entrance their targets. They seemingly have no need to feed on solid matter, instead gaining energy from the distress of others.

entry: POKENAME吃水下植物，尾巴放哨。一发现威胁，就让两个灯球强闪，既晃眼，也试图吓退。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME grazes on underwater plants. Its tail keeps watch as it eats, and if it spots a threat POKENAME will brightly flash its two bulbs, trying to both dazzle and frighten.

entry: POKENAME保护小虫，夜里闪光招来，让它们安全地聚在身边。谁想捕食，就会遭雷电击打。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is protective of small insects, flashing its light to attract them at night so they will flock to it and remain safe. Anything that tries to hunt the bugs will be zapped by lightning.

entry: POKENAME喷出发光泡沫，筑成耀眼屏障，赶走袭击者。泡沫碰什么黏什么，让逃跑很困难。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME expels glowing foam to ward off attackers, creating a dazzling barrier. The foam sticks to anything it touches, making escape difficult.

entry: 这种水生宝可梦常用尾端发光球捉弄其他生物。最常见的是用光误导方向，也会强闪，让对方短暂看不见。
author: infinex21
source: These aquatic Pokémon often use the luminous bulbs at the end of their tails to play tricks on others. Their most typical trick is to use their lights to misguide others, though they will also temporarily blind them with bright flashes.

entry: POKENAME的外壳会产生热量，使它在黑暗的深海，也能保持温暖。壳中的水因此沸腾，外壳微微发光，气泡从裂缝中逸出。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME generate heat from their shells to keep them warm even in the dark depths of the ocean. The process causes any water within their shells to boil, leading to the shells glowing slightly and leaking bubbles through the cracks.

entry: 近处电击猎物，远处喷射水柱。熟练的POKENAME甚至能让水弹也带电。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: It can electrocute prey at short range or shoot jets of water at them at long range. A skilled POKENAME can even electrify its own water projectile.

entry: POKENAME病时泛暗光，通知其他宝可梦自己需要帮助。微弱光芒确保困难时不会独自被留下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glows dimly when sick, signaling to other Pokémon that it needs help. This subtle glow ensures it is never left alone during difficult times.

entry: POKENAME羽毛连接尾部发光器官。飞行时把尾中能量转过去，让双翼明亮，照清前路。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's feathers are connected to the light-creating organ on its tail. It shifts the energy from its tail while flying, letting its wings glow bright and help illuminate its flight path.

entry: POKENAME的尾球摇得越多，就越亮。它通常住在小水域，用麻痹毒自卫。
author: infinex21
source: The bulb on a POKENAME's tail glows brighter the more it is shaken. They typically live within small bodies of water and defend themselves with a numbing poison.

entry: POKENAME射出电波，与同类交流。海上起雷暴，会误把闪电当同类，浮上水面。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME communicates with others of its kind by shooting electrical waves. When lightning storms occur at sea, it floats to the surface, mistaking the lightning for another POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME察觉危险时，鹿角会亮起来，随后便会飞快奔逃。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's antlers light up when it senses danger. When this happens, it gallops away with high speed.

entry: POKENAME特别紧张或害怕时，乳腺会迸电火花。野生个体与同类在海湾或海岸潟湖平静生活。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME is particularly stressed or frightened, sparks begin to shoot out of its mammary glands. In the wild, it leads a peaceful life with others of its kind in bays or marine lagoons.

entry: POKENAME常见于淡水水域，尾球至少带着微光。为避捕食者会逃上岸，甚至往水里放电。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are often found in bodies of freshwater, their tail bulbs emitting at least a faint glow. They will flee to land to avoid predators and may even discharge their electricity into the water.

entry: POKENAME战斗时飞快旋转尾巴，迅速产电，再发动攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins its tails incredibly fast during battle. This allows it to rapidly generate electricity before striking.

entry: 这种宝可梦的触角光，即使亮度低，也能催眠人和许多宝可梦。它喜暗，只在夜里靠近海面，使领地内的潮汐诡异地平静。
author: infinex21
source: The lights of this Pokémon's antennae have a hypnotic effect on people and many other Pokémon, even at low lumens. It only comes close to the ocean surface at night, as it prefers darkness, leading to eerily calm tides within its territory.

entry: POKENAME双尾分别向靠得太近的威胁放出负电与正电。尾尖相碰，便能产生明亮闪光。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's twin tails respectively discharge negative electricity and positive electricity at any threats that have drawn too near. They can tap the tips of their tails together to produce bright flashes of light.

entry: POKENAME安静，却友善得有时给自己惹麻烦。它可能真诚地向危险捕食者问好，尤其爱找铁炮鱼交好朋友。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is quiet but extremely friendly, to the point it sometimes gets itself in trouble. It may greet what is actually a dangerous predator in complete earnestness. They especially like to find Remoraid to become close friends with.

entry: POKENAME用发光尾球误导迷路的宝可梦，电击后方便捕食。遇到强敌，就用强光晃眼，再游得无影无踪。
author: infinex21
source: With their luminous tail-bulbs, POKENAME will misguide lost Pokémon and electrify them to better prey upon them. They will blind strong foes with bright flashes of light and swim away without a trace.

entry: POKENAME将幼崽护在体内充水的空腔里。亲子联手，能以最高15,000伏电力攻击猎物。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME keeps its babies safe inside the water-filled cavity in its body. Together, they attack prey with up to 15,000 volts of electricity.

entry: 它从海岸灯塔吸电，满足源源不断的能量需求。POKENAME虽在陆地安家，泳技却出色，速度连现代船只也能比。
author: fiordaliso
source: It draws electricity from the lighthouses along the seashore to satisfy its constant need for energy. Although it makes its den on land, POKENAME is an excellent swimmer, capable of competing in speed with even modern boats.

entry: 野生POKENAME多见于海滩附近，在沙里挖小洞休息。它能蜷成球，发光球恰好位于正中。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME are often found closer to beaches, where they often make little caves within the sand to rest within. They can curl up into a ball with their luminous bulb perfectly centered.

entry: 野生POKENAME住在河岸。电荷相反的两只成对同行，协调触角一起放电，电击敌人。
author: h0bojoe
source: Wild POKENAME live in riparian areas. They travel in pairs of opposite electrical charges and will coordinate discharging electricity from their antennas together to shock their foes.

entry: POKENAME在海面下滑行，借斗篷上深下浅的颜色伪装。听见猎物，就用爪尾钳住，持续电击，直到对方不再动弹。
author: kungfucutbug
source: POKENAME glides just below the surface of the ocean, camouflaged by its cloak's countershading. When it hears prey, it clamps onto them with its claws and tails, electrocuting them until they stop moving.

entry: POKENAME吃的数据越多，身上的囊越大越亮。装到最大量时，光在数英里外也看得见。
author: .izik
source: The more data POKENAME consumes, the larger and brighter the sacs on its body become. When they hold the maximum amount, the light can be seen for miles.

entry: POKENAME藏在泥里，只露冠脊。被碰到，就放电击退捕食者。
author: lighthouse.keeper.
source: POKENAME hides in mud with only its crest visible. If it is touched, it delivers a shock to ward off predators.

entry: 强烈情绪出现时，POKENAME的触角会亮起，似乎情绪能使其产电。受足够大的威胁时，也会射电，只是瞄不准。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's antennae light up in the presence of strong emotions; exposure to emotions seems to cause them to generate electricity. If a POKENAME feels threatened enough, it will discharge electrical bolts, although it lacks precision.

entry: POKENAME靠超能力在深水中迅速移动。运动或接触强烈情绪会产电，产生、储存越多，众多黄色灯球便越亮。
author: infinex21
source: By utilizing psychic powers, POKENAME can move swiftly deep underwater. They generate electricity by moving and in the presence of fervent emotions, with their many yellow bulbs glowing brighter the more electricity they generate and store.

entry: POKENAME用下方6个器官通电发出诱人光芒，引来猎物，再合拢下半身困住。潜在的精神力量推动身体，将俘虏带回巢。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their lower six organs to produce alluring light via electricity to lure in prey, which they will close their lower halves around. They propel themselves with latent psychic powers, allowing them to take captive prey back to their nests.

entry: POKENAME旋涡般的身体在深海发出脉动光芒。催眠效果引来宝可梦，使其脑中空白，轻易就被包住吞食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's swirling vortex of a body creates a pulsating illumination in the ocean depths. The hypnotic effects draw Pokémon near and empty their mind, making them easy to envelop and consume.

entry: POKENAME的触角含有少量电力，击中目标，能使其短暂麻痹。它们还能让触角明亮地闪烁，用于交流，或向同类发出求助信号。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's antennae contain small amounts of electricity, able to briefly stun those hit by them. It can cause these antennae to flash on and off with a bright light, which it uses for communication or to signal others of its species for help.

entry: POKENAME准备冲撞时，头上灯球明亮发光。摸着虽软，一撞上却会释放存下的强电。
author: sk372
source: The bulb on POKENAME's head glows brightly when it is preparing to charge at something. Though soft to the touch, upon impact the bulb releases a powerful electric burst of stored energy.

entry: POKENAME尾巴发出响亮电信号，充当信标。曾有个体向敌人射出高频信号光束。
author: alliveir
source: POKENAME's tail emits loud electric signals that act as a beacon. Some have been seen firing high frequency signal beams at their enemies.

entry: POKENAME的灯为迷路水手指路，带他们脱险。它不知疲倦地游，让远处始终看得见光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's lights serve as a beacon for lost sailors, guiding them to safety. It swims tirelessly, ensuring its glow is always visible from afar.

entry: POKENAME身上波动的附肢，亮到能照清海洋最深的海沟。若所有灯同时亮起，闪光很可能让每位目睹者永久失明。
author: sk372
source: The undulating appendages on POKENAME's body can shine with a light bright enough to light up the deepest trench of the ocean. If it were to use all of its bulbs at once, the flash would likely cause permanent blindness to all who saw it.

entry: 这种两栖宝可梦靠身体顶端的光源在夜里活动。背上空位很大，凯那市常用来搬运货物上下船。
author: smissmassentree_81799
source: A light source at the top of its body allows this amphibious Pokémon to be active at night. It has large amounts of empty space on its back, which is commonly used to haul cargo on and off ships in Slateport City.

entry: POKENAME用耳朵闪光交流。它通过独角产电、储电、放电，角中还有麻痹物质。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME communicate with each other using flashing lights emitted from their ears. They generate, store, and release electricity through their singular horn, which also contains a paralytic agent.

entry: 受惊时，耳朵会强闪，接着可能从角放电，也可能前冲角刺。尾部灯球充满电，就亮得格外明显。
author: infinex21
source: They emit bright flashes of light from their ears when startled and may either release an electrical bolt from their horn or attempt to charge forward and stab with their horn. When their tail bulbs are full of electricity, they glow rather brightly.

entry: POKENAME用发光卷须缠紧猎物，再施以致命电击。它生活在温暖海域。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME constricts prey with its luminous tendrils before delivering a deadly shock. It is found inhabiting warm seas.

entry: 野生POKENAME常受亮光吸引，误以为是同类的尾灯。准备从角放电时，黄色尖刺就会发光。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME have a tendency to be drawn toward bright lights, thinking they are the luminous tail bulbs of their own kind. Their yellow spines glow as they prepare to loose a bolt of electricity from their horn.

entry: POKENAME在海洋最深的海沟底休息。触角的光强到连这般深处，也能从水面上看见。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rests at the seafloor, within the deepest trenches of the ocean. The light from its antennae, even from those depths, is potent enough to be seen from above the water.

entry: POKENAME外貌像帕路奇亚的起源形态，引起古生物学家兴趣。有些人借此支持灯笼鱼自远古便已存在的理论。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's resemblance to Palkia's Origin form has sparked interest from paleontologists. Some have used it to support the theory that Chinchou have been around since ancient times.

entry: 吸收能量时，POKENAME从炮中伸出一根充满奇异黄液的触角。球状部分极不稳定，遭击便释放强大电磁脉冲。
author: .izik
source: When absorbing energy, POKENAME deploys an antenna from its cannon filled with a curious yellow liquid. This bulbous portion is extremely volatile and releases large electromagnetic pulses if struck.

entry: 新月之夜，POKENAME走出藏身处，照亮海洋，跳舞直到黎明。
author: dodoowner_
source: On new-moon nights, POKENAME emerges from hiding, illuminating the ocean. It dances until the break of dawn.

entry: 野生POKENAME仅在一处海边洞穴被发现过。全身的发光蘑菇在黑暗中美丽闪耀。
author: hophoppip
source: In the wild, POKENAME has only been found within a single seaside cave. The bioluminescent mushrooms that cover its body glow beautifully in the dark.

entry: POKENAME缎带末端只有一盏灯，里面全是负电。恨意越深，电力越强，直到连身体也承受不住，开始发麻。
author: soup1900
source: At the end of POKENAME's ribbon is a singular light filled with only negative electricity. As its feelings of hatred grow, its electrical powers build until even its own body becomes overwhelmed and starts to tingle.

entry: POKENAME悬在陵墓顶，等盗墓者从下方经过，再用发光卷须抓住。
author: hobiewankenobi
source: POKENAME hovers on the ceilings of mausoleums, waiting for grave robbers to venture beneath it and grabbing them with its glowing tendrils.

entry: POKENAME所住的洞里满是电网。它先用水属性攻击浸湿入侵者，逼进网中麻痹。腹部上方的灯球会发出明亮闪光。
author: chibitales
source: Caves where POKENAME reside are filled with electric webbing. POKENAME soak intruders with Water-type attacks, driving them into the webs and subsequently paralyzing them. The bulbs above its abdomen emit a bright Flash.

entry: POKENAME天性夜行，在黑暗中柔柔发光，带来微弱照明。林木茂密的地方最活跃。
author: .izik
source: Nocturnal by nature, POKENAME glows gently in the darkness, providing faint illumination. It is most active in heavily forested areas.

entry: POKENAME搜寻海底所有会亮的物件，挂在身上。它能用身体构成电路，让这些东西同时亮起。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME scours the ocean floor for any objects that light up, so it can hang them on its body. It can create an electrical circuit with its body, causing all the objects to light up at once.

entry: POKENAME视力极差，靠尾光在深海辨路。它与电灯九尾结群，用光的闪烁规律交流。
author: keiracm35_
source: POKENAME have very poor eyesight and navigate the deep ocean using light from their tails. POKENAME and Lantales live in pods and communicate through blinking patterns using these same lights.

entry: POKENAME漂游海中，两个诱饵亮如灯笼。钓客见到就兴奋，因为它似乎总能引来深海最稀有的宝可梦。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME floats through the ocean, its two lures glowing like lanterns. Anglers get excited if they see it in the water, as it seems to always lure in the rarest Pokémon from the ocean depths.

entry: POKENAME感应到附近其他生物的波导，感应器便亮起。它在海浪中拳打脚踢，锻炼肌肉。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its sensors light up when it detects someone else's aura nearby. POKENAME trains by kicking and punching in the ocean waves to build up its muscles.

entry: POKENAME开心地随波起伏，发光身体照亮周围水面。活泼好玩，让海滩游客很爱看。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME bobs happily on waves, its glowing body lighting up the water around it. Its playful nature makes it a popular sight among beachgoers.

entry: POKENAME高速振动四翼，制造强大电波，驱赶其他野生宝可梦。许多人深信，它一起飞，就预示风暴将至。
author: fiordaliso
source: By vibrating its four wings rapidly, POKENAME generates powerful electric waves to keep other wild Pokémon away. Many are convinced that when it takes flight, a storm is about to arrive.

entry: POKENAME用触角产生正负电能，为头部充电，也特别爱用头槌攻击。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME charges its head electrically by generating positive and negative energy via its antennae. It loves to give out headbutts.

entry: POKENAME游得不快，可硬壳加上，向周围放电的本领，让它几乎不怕天敌。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is not a fast swimmer. However, thanks to its hard shell and its ability to electrify its surroundings, it hardly fears predators.

entry: POKENAME尾上的灯球随情绪发光。暴怒时光越来越强，直到尾巴滚烫。它在南方海岸与庞大家族同住。
author: fiordaliso
source: The luminous bulb on POKENAME's tail glows in response to its emotions. When enraged, the light intensifies until the tail becomes scorching hot. It lives in large family groups along the coasts of southern seas.

entry: POKENAME住在黑暗深海，产生大量电力，整个身体照亮深处。它待在热液喷口附近，确保能量来源不断。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in the deep dark ocean, generating so much electricity that its entire body illuminates the dark depths. It stays around hydrothermal vents so it has a constant source of energy.

entry: POKENAME住在近海暗洞。视力差，就用自行发光的灯球照路。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME resides in dark caves near the ocean. Its vision is weak, so it uses its bioluminescent bulbs to light its way.

entry: POKENAME在海底搜食，长牙掘出什么就吃什么。身体能承受巨大压力。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME scours the ocean floor for food, eating whatever it can dig up with its tusks. Its body is capable of withstanding immense amounts of pressure.

entry: POKENAME兴奋时，两根触角间跃起电火花，体温升高。有什么闯进领地，触角便猛烈闪光。
author: foolish_weasel
source: When POKENAME gets excited, sparks jump between its two antennae, causing its temperature to rise. These antennae will flash aggressively when anything encroaches on POKENAME's turf.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀既适合飞行，也适合游泳，水下像鳍足。神情虽不起眼，领地意识却极强，空中鸟类、水中鱼类都驱赶。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME's wings are specially adapted to help it both fly and swim, acting like flippers underwater. Despite its unassuming expression, it is extremely territorial, fending off both birds from the air and fish from the sea.

entry: 天空灰暗、阳光少时，POKENAME帮患季节性抑郁的训练家保持快乐。亮起的灯球如情绪灯，照亮对方的一天。
author: quackquackattack
source: When skies are gray and there is less sunlight, POKENAME help Trainers with seasonal depression stay happy. By shining their luminous bulbs, POKENAME act like a mood light to brighten their Trainer's day.

entry: POKENAME住在海滩附近洞穴，倒挂洞顶。它点亮诱饵，让迷路孩子跟随，帮助走出洞。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live in caves found near beaches and can be seen hanging upside-down from ceilings. They help lost children escape the caves by shining their bright lures so that children follow them.

entry: 旧传说称，POKENAME用诱饵的苍白光芒，将粗心旅人引入海边雾洞。其实，它通常用光把人从这些洞中带出去。
author: karagar
source: Old stories claim POKENAME use the pale light of their lures to lead unwary travelers into foggy seaside caves. In truth, they usually use them to lead people out of those same caves.

entry: 常有报告见到POKENAME使用触角，以灯光照亮最黑暗的深海路径。不过，触角有毒，碰得太久会生病。
author: th3randomguy
source: POKENAME are regularly reported using their antennae. They have been seen using their lights to illuminate paths through the darkest depths of the ocean, while their antennae are poisonous and make anyone who touches them for too long ill.

entry: POKENAME住在黑暗海底，捕食领地内的一切。它靠闪烁尾球，与同类沟通。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Dwelling at the bottom of dark oceans, POKENAME prey on anything in their territory. POKENAME communicate with other members of their species by flickering the bulb on their tails.

entry: POKENAME眼里透出柔光，因此双亲外出时会闭眼，免得引来捕食者。等父母带食物回来，才安全睁眼。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a soft luminescence that shines through their eyes, so whenever their parents are away, they close their eyes to avoid attracting predators. Once their parents have returned with food, they can safely open their eyes.

entry: POKENAME咬下时，牙会发光，在猎物上留下亮痕。这奇特特征，让它出手后容易被追踪。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's teeth glow when it bites, leaving glowing marks on its prey. This unusual trait makes it easy to track once it has attacked.

entry: POKENAME住在珊瑚礁间，用附肢抓来漂浮海藻吃。常能见到角金鱼躲在它的冠中。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME lives among coral reefs, using its appendages to grasp drifting seaweed to eat. Goldeen are commonly seen hiding in POKENAME's crown.

entry: POKENAME的亮诱饵按奇怪规律闪烁，与同类交流。敌人靠得太近，就放电击退。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's glowing lures blink in an odd pattern to communicate with others of its kind. Should an enemy get too close, it will let loose an electric shock.

entry: POKENAME的毒液发出明亮黄光，警告其他生物远离。受威胁时，光更强。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's venom glows a bright yellow, warning others to stay away. The glow becomes more intense when it feels threatened.

entry: 很久以前，POKENAME的毒用于熬制治晕船的药。这古方如今已随时间失传。
author: .izik
source: Long ago, POKENAME's venom was used to brew a potion that cured seasickness. The recipe for this ancient remedy has since been lost to time.

entry: 它住在黑暗海沟，用发光蘑菇照明。吃下的发光藻类，让蘑菇也能明亮发光。
author: mistymagius
source: It lives in dark trenches, using its luminescent mushrooms to illuminate the darkness. It feeds on glowing algae, which allows its mushrooms to glow brightly.

entry: POKENAME能通过舞蹈操纵电力。研究者正探究它的叫声是否影响电流，以及如何利用。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: It can manipulate electricity by dancing. Researchers are studying whether POKENAME's vocalizations affect electrical currents, and how it could be utilized.

entry: POKENAME住在昏暗深水，用自身发光辨路。在这些暗水中，很容易融入周围。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dwells in the murky depths where it uses bioluminescence to find its way. In these shadowy waters, it blends in effortlessly with its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME住海床，吃上方沉下来的碎屑。它用发光蘑菇引来其他宝可梦，只为让对方沾满黏孢子游走。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME live on the seabed, feeding on debris that sinks down from above. They lure in other Pokémon with their bioluminescent mushrooms, but only so that these Pokémon swim away covered with the sticky spores they produce.

entry: POKENAME用头上葫芦形触角诱来宝可梦。触角黏，猎物很难脱开。咬住触角的宝可梦，就被它当作时尚配饰。
author: beetlething
source: POKENAME lures in Pokémon using the gourd-shaped antennae on its head. These antennae are sticky, making it hard for the prey to detach. It uses the Pokémon that bite onto its antennae as fashion accessories.

entry: POKENAME石质身体将它困在深海，因此颇为稀有。它用身上自行发光的宝石，晃得捕食者看不见。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's rocky bodies leave them trapped in the deep ocean, making them quite rare. They use the bioluminescent gems on their bodies to blind predators.

entry: POKENAME覆甲的身体在黑暗中明亮发光。外观启发了一处热门激光对战场的美术风格。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's armored body glows brightly in the dark. Its appearance has inspired the aesthetic of a popular laser tag arena.

entry: POKENAME夜里在海底掘进觅食，先放电脉冲震晕目标，再攻击。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME tunnels through the seafloor in search of prey. It releases electrical pulses to stun targets before attacking.

entry: POKENAME触角上的宝石各含相反电荷，放电时光彩夺目。宝石很抢手，可它害羞又住深海，因此稀有。
author: h0bojoe
source: Its antennae gems hold opposite electrical charges that shine brilliantly when discharged. These gems are highly coveted, but are rare due to POKENAME's shy nature and deep-sea habitat.

entry: 据说被同一只POKENAME触角电到的恋人，会永远相爱。有些海滨小镇举办节庆，让情侣寻光求好运。
author: .izik
source: It is said that a couple shocked by the same POKENAME's antennae will share an eternal love. Some coastal towns host festivals where lovers seek its light for good fortune.

entry: 野生POKENAME通常住在热带海底。遇上威胁，一颗头留下放哨，其余的，则躲进洞里。
author: dodoowner_
source: Wild POKENAME are usually found in tropical areas at the bottom of the ocean. If threatened, one head keeps watch and the others hide in their hole.

entry: POKENAME盯着头上的生物发光器官，缓解频繁的偏头痛。盯得太久，常忘了时间。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME abate their frequent migraines by staring at the bioluminescent light attached to their head. They often lose track of time because they spend so long staring at the light.

entry: POKENAME有孩子般的好奇心，游泳时也会分心。有时忘了触角是诱饵，盯着看好几个小时。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a childlike curiosity that distracts them from their swimming. Sometimes they forget that they have an antenna lure and stare at it for hours.

entry: POKENAME在海底漫游，用双灯照路，穿过深海平原。每天为觅食走数百英里，准备扑击前，先以强光晃花猎物的眼。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME roam across the sea floor, using their twin lanterns to guide their way across the abyssal plain. They travel hundreds of miles each day in search of food, dazzling their prey with bright lights when they're ready to pounce.

entry: POKENAME在阳光下看不清，飞行路线杂乱，常撞上船与岸。烦恼时便潜入深水，那里视野更好。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME erratically fly around, often bumping into boats and shorelines due to its poor vision in sunlight. When frustrated, they dive deep underwater where they can see better.

entry: 拍打POKENAME的尾巴，似乎能帮助积电，点亮肚皮。它常这样吓退威胁，因为肚子亮起来，许多内脏就透出来了。
author: infinex21
source: Slapping POKENAME's tails seems to help them build up electricity, which sets their bellies aglow. This is often how they often scare away threats, because when their bellies glow bright it reveals many of their internal organs.

entry: 瞬间移动前，POKENAME尾巴先亮起，释放刺眼闪光，帮助逃避捕食者。移走后，身上仍能见到微弱电流窜动。
author: sk372
source: Before it teleports, POKENAME's tail glows bright and releases a blinding flash to help aid it in escaping predators. Faint bits of electricity can be seen coursing over its body after it teleports.

entry: POKENAME嘴里有发电器官，放出大量光，将猎物直接引进嘴。深海潜水员常把它当水下手电筒。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has an electrical organ in its mouth that emits large amounts of light, luring its prey directly into its mouth. POKENAME are commonly used by deep-sea divers as underwater flashlights.

entry: POKENAME偷小艇的船桨，让水手困惑。赃桨常被发现藏在水下洞穴里。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME steals oars from rowboats, causing confusion among sailors. The stolen oars are often found stashed in underwater caves.

entry: 风暴中，POKENAME试图与闪电同步闪光。这习惯让研究者着迷，用途却仍不明。
author: .izik
source: During storms, POKENAME tries to flash its lights in sync with lightning strikes. This habit fascinates researchers, though its purpose remains unknown.

entry: POKENAME常待在岸边，懒得动。它把尾巴浸进水里，向周围放电捕猎。
author: mrpimbus
source: POKENAME often hangs out near the shore, not moving much. It hunts prey by dipping its tail underwater and discharging electricity into the surrounding area.

entry: 电灯问世前，POKENAME很受艺术家欢迎，尾光夜里足以照亮整间屋。有些至今仍选它作伴，把光滑的壳当画布。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME were popular Pokémon amongst artists prior to the advent of electrical lighting, the glow of their tails bright enough to illuminate an entire room at night. Some artists still take them as companions, using their smooth shells as a canvas.

entry: 三只宝可梦结伴分享电力，让整体更强。POKENAME向敌人喷带电水流，使其麻痹。
author: cartoonhostage
source: Three Pokémon have formed a bond to share electricity with one another, making the whole more powerful. POKENAME sprays streams of electrified water at enemies to paralyze them.

entry: POKENAME用两颗头，接触不同物体，搭起电路并发电，因此，常用于工业。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME connects its two heads to different objects for bridging and generates electricity. It is often used in industry.

entry: POKENAME用两颗头，接触不同物体，搭起电路并发电，因此，常用于工业。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME connects its two heads to different objects for bridging and generates electricity. It is often used in industry.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时按节奏闪灯。柔光引来小宝可梦，靠在身边休息。
author: .izik
source: While sleeping, POKENAME blinks its lights in a rhythmic pattern. This gentle glow attracts smaller Pokémon, which rest beside it.

entry: POKENAME从嘴里吐出亮珍珠，散落海床。收藏家争相寻求。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dispenses shining pearls from its mouth, leaving them scattered across the ocean floor. These pearls are highly sought after by collectors.

entry: POKENAME身体迸发刺眼闪光，扰乱敌人。它借此迷惑捕食者，迅速逃走。
author: .izik
source: Blinding flashes of light erupt from POKENAME's body, disorienting enemies. It uses these bursts to confuse predators and make a swift escape.

entry: POKENAME讨厌久晒太阳，白天退到阴暗水域。安全的黑暗中，灯会亮得更强。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hates prolonged exposure to sunlight and retreats to shady waters during the day. Its lights glow brighter in the safety of darkness.

entry: POKENAME能自行发光，偶尔可在港口城市附近海滩见到。钳若被切断或受损，健康就开始衰退。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a bioluminescent Pokémon that can rarely be found on beaches not far from port cities. If its pincers happen to be cut off or damaged, its health begins to decline.

entry: POKENAME在深海游，点亮背上的球，引猎物追光而来。球不断渗毒冒泡，削弱猎物，让它享用一餐。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME swim through the deep sea while illuminating the orbs on their backs, drawing in prey to the source of light. Their orbs constantly secrete and bubble with poison, wearing down prey and allowing POKENAME to enjoy their meal.

entry: POKENAME的球能亮得极强，带动体温升高。捕食者攻击时，就不停闪球，直到能逃脱。
author: seanothan_23
source: POKENAME's orb can glow extremely bright, making their body temperature warmer. When a predator attacks, they flash their orb repeatedly until they can escape.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴缠住珊瑚，闪动触角迷惑捕食者。扰乱方向的光，为它争取逃跑时间。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME curls its tail around coral and flashes its antenna to confuse predators. The disorienting light gives it time to escape.

entry: POKENAME先用烟幕笼罩周围，再向水里放出阵阵电击，赶走巨牙鲨等捕食者。
author: .izik
source: After cloaking the area in a Smokescreen, POKENAME sends jolts of electricity through the water. This tactic deters predators like Sharpedo.

entry: 人们把珠宝邮件交给POKENAME，送往潜艇或水下实验室。它会制造特殊气泡，防止信件沾水。海洋生物学家依靠这种邮件接收重要通信。
author: quackquackattack
source: Bead Mail is given to POKENAME to ferry to submarines or underwater laboratories because it produces a special bubble to prevent the mail from getting wet. Marine biologists rely on this type of mail to receive important correspondence.

entry: POKENAME逆瀑游上，触角亮起鲜黄光。夜里，整群能照亮一条河床。
author: .izik
source: As it swims up waterfalls, POKENAME's antenna glows a bright yellow. During the night, schools of POKENAME can light up an entire riverbed.

entry: POKENAME用明亮头灯照亮夜间的森林与田野，便能少受其他宝可梦竞争，取得花蜜。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME uses its bright head lamp to illuminate forests and fields during the night. By doing this, it can get nectar with little competition from other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用星形身体在海里旋转。若撞上船壳，就先放电火花警告，再退走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins through the sea with its star-shaped body. If it collides with a ship's hull, it discharges sparks as a warning before retreating.

entry: POKENAME潜伏海底，诱饵像个溺水或被拖入水下的女人，引出许多迷信。其实，它只爱待在幽暗深处，用诱饵和平地与其他生物交流。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: Lurking on the ocean floor, POKENAME's lure gives the illusion of a woman drowning or being pulled under. Despite many superstitions, it turns out POKENAME just prefers to stay in the deep dark, and uses their lure to interact peacefully with others.

entry: POKENAME的触角，发出诱人的光，吸引毫无防备的猎物。光景虽美，接下来发生的，可就骇人了。
author: mykoloth
source: POKENAME's antennae emit a captivating light that attracts unsuspecting prey. Though the light is a beautiful sight, what follows is truly horrific.

entry: POKENAME住在阳光到不了的最暗深海，找到什么都吃。亮触角把无辜宝可梦引进嘴，或用闪光晃花对方的眼。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME inhabits the darkest ocean depths, where no sunlight arrives, feeding on anything it finds. Its luminous antennae serve to draw innocent Pokémon into its jaws or dazzle them with Flash.

entry: POKENAME能承受海洋深渊区的水压，靠自身发光观察深海。
author: jona_hehe
source: POKENAME can withstand the pressure of the abyssal zone of the ocean. It uses its bioluminescence to see in the deep ocean.

entry: POKENAME开朗活泼，喜欢黑暗。暗到头上的球体开始闪亮时，它就会兴奋地跃动、翻滚，摆弄这些发光球。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME is a cheerful and energetic Pokémon that loves the dark. It is known to play excitedly with the glowing orbs on its head, leaping and tumbling around the moment they flicker to life when it's sufficiently dark.

entry: POKENAME背上排着亮闪闪的脊棱，带电时格外明亮，让它在最黑的水中，也能看清。
author: t.i.a.
source: A POKENAME has a row of shiny dorsal ridges down its back. They glow brightly with electricity, allowing it to see even in the darkest waters.

entry: POKENAME发光的毛，让它成为深海旅行的抢手伙伴。体内火囊连冰冷深处也能保暖。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's glowing fur makes it sought after for deep-sea excursions. The flame sac in its body is able to keep it warm even in the chilly depths.

entry: POKENAME游过网络论坛，释放阵阵电流，扭曲打开窗口里的文字。大量聚集，甚至能让整个网站过载瘫痪。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims through online forums, releasing bursts of electricity that distort text across open windows. When a large group gathers, it can overload and disable an entire site.

entry: 野生POKENAME曾因壳太亮，而走向灭绝。它们睡在海中，天敌却能从一英里外，看得清清楚楚。
author: dodoowner_
source: Wild POKENAME went extinct because of how bright their shells are. Predators could spot them sleeping in the ocean from a mile away.

entry: POKENAME群挂在枝头左右摇摆，闪灯模仿电萤虫。猎物靠近，一半释放刺眼闪光，另一半使出电击波。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Groups of POKENAME hang from tree branches and swing from side-to-side, flickering their lights to imitate Volbeat. Once prey approach, half the POKENAME release blinding Flashes while the others attack with Shock Waves.

entry: POKENAME以惊人速度潜入深海捕猎。身体的刺眼闪光让鱼晕得无法闪避，被咬合的双颚抓住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME dives into the deep sea to hunt. It cuts through the water at an incredible pace, creating blinding flashes of light with its body that leave fish too stunned to avoid the grip of its snapping jaws.

entry: POKENAME头上的灯，连最猛烈的暴风雪也能穿透。迷路登山者常循光而来，将命运交到灯的主人手上。
author: elibromax314
source: The lights on POKENAME's head are bright enough to pierce through even the strongest of snowstorms. Lost mountain climbers often follow these lights, putting themselves at the mercy of the POKENAME the lights belong to.

entry: POKENAME虽是捕食者，视力却不佳，靠嗅觉狩猎。夜里，它用身体发出的强光，假扮一簇星星，再一头扎进水里，捕食鱼类宝可梦。
author: krogens
source: Though it is a predatory Pokémon, POKENAME has poor eyesight and relies on its sense of smell to hunt. It utilizes the bright light it emits from its body to camouflage as a cluster of stars at night and dives into water to catch fish Pokémon.

entry: 船迷失海上时，POKENAME常来拿光贵重物品。打捞队会带食物到这些船，用来交换财物。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When ships become lost at sea, POKENAME often arrive to strip them of all their valuables. Salvage crews make expeditions to these ships with food to trade for valuables with POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME尾端的灯由精神力量供能，能随意变色。它爱用这本领表演灯光秀，给友好的水下住客看。
author: sk372
source: The lights at the end of POKENAME's tail are fueled by its psychic powers, and can change colors at will. It enjoys using this ability to make light shows for friendly underwater denizens.

entry: POKENAME靠头灯游入极深处。猎物靠近，便令周围水沸腾，几乎瞬间煮熟食物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims to great depths aided by the lamp on its head. Should prey draw near, it forces the surrounding water to boil, cooking its meal almost instantly.

entry: POKENAME在最黑暗的水中用诱饵吸引宝可梦。对方一分心，就以反应不及的速度猛然咬住。
author: elite01.
source: POKENAME uses its lure to attract unsuspecting Pokémon in the darkest waters. Once they are distracted, it latches on with its jaws faster than they can react.

entry: POKENAME放出发光液体，在空气中立刻蒸发成气态缎带。颜色随心情而变，有些地区会在节庆结束时放出它们。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME release luminescent fluids that instantly evaporate into gaseous ribbons in the air. The colors of the fluid change depending on the mood of the Pokémon. In some regions, people release POKENAME at the end of festivals.

entry: POKENAME的灯球与斑点夜里泛着独特红光。水手普遍相信，见到这光，便预示近期好运、航行顺利。
author: wiz0z
source: The bulb and spots of POKENAME glow a distinct shade of red at night. Common knowledge amongst sailors claims that seeing the glow of POKENAME is a sign of great fortune and smooth sailing in the near future.

entry: POKENAME拿水果形状的诱饵，引来猎物。对方一靠近，就会落入，腿间织好的网。
author: weirdtux
source: POKENAME will lure in prey with its fruit-shaped lure. Once its prey is close enough, it will ensnare it with a web woven between its legs.

entry: POKENAME极度痛苦时，灯闪得足以让附近生物永久失明。身体负担太大，因此很少使用。
author: .izik
source: In times of extreme distress, POKENAME's lights flash so brightly they can permanently blind nearby creatures. It rarely uses this ability due to the intense strain it causes on its body.

entry: 若在漆黑深海看见两点微光，就赶紧游回水面，免得成为POKENAME的下一餐！
author: phantom640
source: If you see two faint lights in the darkest depths of the ocean, swim as fast as you can back to the surface before you become POKENAME's next meal!

entry: POKENAME的发光诱饵形似猎物，能引来远比自己大的宝可梦。利牙连暴鲤龙的硬鳞也能刺穿。
author: cartoonhostage
source: Its glowing lures resemble prey, enticing Pokémon much larger than POKENAME. With its sharp teeth, it can even pierce the tough scales of Gyarados.

entry: POKENAME的四个灯球能够储电，存得越多，光就越亮。它主要通过脸颊的灯球释放电力，产电过多时，经常会这样做。
author: infinex21
source: Its four bulbs store electricity and glow the more they have stored. The bulbs on a POKENAME's cheeks are how it will primarily release electricity, which it will often do when it has generated too much.

entry: 建筑公司让POKENAME到难运设备的高楼顶焊接。海上工程也偏爱它，能完成对潜水员有危险的水下焊接。
author: oddwalls
source: Construction companies employ POKENAME as a welder atop tall buildings where equipment is difficult to transport. POKENAME is also a favorite in marine construction, where it performs underwater welding that could endanger divers.

entry: 建筑公司让POKENAME到难运设备的高楼顶焊接。海上工程也偏爱它，能完成对潜水员有危险的水下焊接。
author: oddwalls
source: Construction companies employ POKENAME as a welder atop tall buildings where equipment is difficult to transport. POKENAME is also a favorite in marine construction, where it performs underwater welding that could endanger divers.

entry: 深海舞动的明亮黄光，常是这种爱在夜里群舞的宝可梦。虽然罕见，有时也会浮上水面，在突出水中的岩石上共舞。
author: infinex21
source: Bright, yellow lights dancing within ocean depths are often these Pokémon who love to dance in groups at night. Although rare, they may come to the surface and dance together atop rocks jutting out amidst the water.

entry: POKENAME用头灯，在自己广阔蜿蜒的地洞中辨路。游泳与奔跑一样擅长。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME uses its head's lights to navigate its extensive, winding burrows. It can swim just as well as it can run.

entry: POKENAME热衷于在海滩挖洞，挖得特别深就用胡须照明。天然明亮，电影制片厂会用它补光。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME enthusiastically dig on beaches, using their whiskers to light up when they tunnel especially deep. Due to their natural brightness, movie studios use them for extra lighting.

entry: POKENAME用头光吸引其他生物靠近，再用多片鳍拥抱黏住。吼鲸王，有时连暴鲤龙身上，也能见到几只搭顺风车。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the light on its head to draw others closer so it can embrace and stick to them with its many fins. Wailord and occasionally Gyarados have been spotted with a few POKENAME clinging along for a ride.

entry: 现代船灯出现前，POKENAME为浓雾中的小船照路。锐眼能辨出几英尺外的障碍，不过有些故意不提醒驾驶者，让船受损。
author: chibitales
source: Before modern boat lamps, POKENAME were used to light the way for small boats in dense fog. Their perceptive eyesight can pick out obstacles from several feet away. This didn't stop some from intentionally damaging boats by not alerting the driver.

entry: 它的众多光球能瞬间亮起，轻易晃晕多数敌人。卷须里的球以特殊方式移动，光芒令多数生物入迷。它吃恐惧与痛苦，却似乎无意伤害肉体。
author: infinex21
source: Its many orbs can emit bright light in an instant, allowing it to easily daze most foes. The orbs within its tendrils move in ways that make their lights mesmeric to most. It feeds on fear and anguish but has no apparent desire to cause bodily harm.

entry: POKENAME是水生草食者，为避竞争，大多夜里借头灯觅食。夜行捕食者靠近，就用后半身强光晃花对方的眼。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is an aquatic herbivore, but to avoid competition it mostly eats at night, finding food in the dark using the light on its head. If any nocturnal predators approach, POKENAME will blind them with the bright glow of its hindquarters.

entry: POKENAME在最深海床游泳、掘进。激怒或狩猎时，身上的球会发出璀璨光芒。
author: moopse
source: POKENAME swims and burrows along the deepest parts of the ocean floor. The orbs on its body create a brilliant light when aggravated or hunting.

entry: POKENAME受惊就强闪头球，让潜在敌人眼花晕眩。它太容易受惊，常连无恶意的生物也一起晃到。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flashes the orbs on its head brightly when frightened, blinding and stunning potential foes. It has a very jumpy personality, so it often ends up flashing those who mean it no ill will.

entry: 曾在水下超过10000英尺处发现POKENAME。它闪光引来猎物，眨眼间便吞下。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME have been discovered dwelling over 10,000 feet underwater. It attracts prey by flickering its light before devouring them in the blink of an eye.

entry: POKENAME夜行，水陆都能呼吸。它收集数百颗树果，与幼崽分享。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME is a nocturnal Pokémon, and it can breathe in water and on land. It gathers hundreds of Berries and shares them with their young.

entry: POKENAME行走海床，背上的灯球促进藻类生长，不断补充食物。光照亮数英里周围，晃得捕食者看不见。
author: oddwalls
source: As POKENAME treads the sea floor, the bulb on its back stimulates the growth of algae, constantly replenishing its food supply. It illuminates its surroundings for miles, blinding potential predators.

entry: POKENAME比多数太阳珊瑚住得深，以体内电力照亮暗水。附近热液喷口众多，它已适应更强的酸性环境。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives much deeper than most other Corsola, using its internal electricity to light up the dark depths. Due to the many hydrothermal vents it lives near, it has adapted to withstand the more acidic conditions.

entry: POKENAME在隧道找猎物，先闪光晃眼，再攻击。长久以来，商人夜航会养一只，让它爬船首，点亮信标，通知别船并照出障碍。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME searches tunnels for prey, blinding them by flashing its light before striking. For a long time, merchants have kept one for sailing at night, when it climbs onto the prow and shines its beacon to signal other ships and highlight obstacles.

entry: POKENAME触角太亮，掠过海浪上空时，可能被误认成大船。它对水手十分友善，有时会伴随远航。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its antennae shine so brightly that it risks being mistaken for a large vessel when it glides above the ocean waves. POKENAME has a very friendly temperament toward sailors, whom it sometimes accompanies on their sea voyages.

entry: POKENAME触角太亮，掠过海浪上空时，可能被误认成大船。它对水手十分友善，有时会伴随远航。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its antennae shine so brightly that it risks being mistaken for a large vessel when it glides above the ocean waves. POKENAME has a very friendly temperament toward sailors, whom it sometimes accompanies on their sea voyages.

entry: 现代人造灯问世前，人们把POKENAME落羽当天然管灯。可是重如钢铁，安装太费力，难以普及到住宅和其他建筑。
author: soup1900
source: Before modern artificial lights were invented, people of the past used shed POKENAME feathers as natural tube lights. However, due to them being as heavy as steel, they required too much labor to be installed commonly among homes and other buildings.

entry: POKENAME虽像橡胶洗澡玩具，却是查找错误代码的知名编程助手。不过，一靠近运作中的电脑，诱饵状附肢就兴奋地急闪。
author: beatdoof
source: Despite its rubber bath-toy-like appearance, POKENAME is well known for its use as a coding assistant in rooting out faulty code. However, being near any active computer equipment causes its lure-like appendages to flash rapidly in excitement.

entry: 传说，人们曾看见水下成群的POKENAME发出灿烂光芒，便将它们与岸边的神异现象联系起来，开始加以崇敬。它们其实十分爱玩，也很容易亲近同伴或训练家。
author: markusknight
source: According to legends, people started revering underwater herds of POKENAME, seeing their bright lights and connecting them to supernatural incidents on shores. They are very playful and bond quickly to either their herd, or Trainer.

entry: POKENAME尾鳍动得越快，头球越亮。它摩擦脸颊，将体内电流导入颊囊，再放出去。
author: infinex21
source: The quicker its tail fin moves, the brighter the bulb on its head will glow. POKENAME will rub their cheeks to direct their internal electricity to their cheek pouches before discharging said electricity.

entry: 水流摩擦让它们体内积起静电，存进众多光球。它们用电放出明亮诱人的光，折磨敌人。
author: infinex21
source: Friction from water currents causes a static charge to build within these Pokémon, the power of which is stored within their many orbs. They harness their electricity to emit bright and alluring lights in order to torment their foes.

entry: POKENAME主要靠尾上灯球放电，常甩尾阻吓威胁。叫喊时，颊囊也常放出亮光。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME discharge electricity mainly through the bulbs upon their tails, often swinging them around to deter threats. When they cry out, their cheek pouches often emit bright lights.

entry: POKENAME住在雨林深处，藤梢的光在树冠阴暗处像星星。它半水生，在密灌丛与浑河里同样善于诱捕猎物。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME live deep in the rainforest, where the illuminated tips of their vines glow like stars in the canopied gloom. They are semiaquatic and can attract and trap prey equally well in the deep brush or the murky rivers.

entry: POKENAME住在充水的天然隔离服内，身体保持绝缘，避免误电伤其他生物。头上的水泡，让它不游泳时也能呼吸。
author: alestrius
source: POKENAME lives within a natural containment suit filled with water that keeps its body insulated to prevent accidentally electrocuting others. The water bubble over its head allows it to breathe when not swimming.

entry: POKENAME用光合作用取得的能量点亮触角。受威胁，就用强光晃花敌眼，跑掉。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME uses the energy it gains from photosynthesis to illuminate its antenna. When threatened, it will blind its opponent with an intense burst of light and run away.

entry: POKENAME有时把头顶光球垂得太低，放光反晃花自己的眼。化身数据时，所穿过的电缆、电线都会明亮发光。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME sometimes hangs the orb above its head too low on its face, causing it to blind itself when it releases light. Any cable or wire it travels through while inside cyberspace glows very brightly.

entry: POKENAME能控制空气中的水分，天气较干也保持健康。尾上长着会发各种彩光的种子，一年四季都显得喜气洋洋。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has the ability to control the water in the air, which allows it to stay healthy even during relatively dry days. Colorful seeds that can shine in different colors grow over its tail, making it a festive sight regardless of the time of year.

entry: POKENAME的灯球能产生大量光热。水下强闪驱敌，探出水面则向飞过的生物扔火球，纯粹取乐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's bulbs can generate high amounts of light and heat. Beneath the water, the bright flashes repel predators, and when it pokes above the water, it launches fireballs at creatures flying by, purely for sport.

entry: POKENAME无论蜷成球还是双足站着，都想飞快窜动，仿佛觉得非得再快点不可。可惜，它的速度在宝可梦中只算普通。
author: infranscia
source: Whether curled into a ball, or on two feet, POKENAME seems to try to zip around, as if it feels it's got to go fast.  Unfortunately, its speed is about average for a Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME只用触角，就能轻易制服被光引来的猎物，哪怕体型更大。尾鳍自行发光，一拍水便能掀起晃眼的巨浪。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is able to easily wrestle prey it has lured in with its light using only its antenna, even if they are larger than it. With its tail fin being bioluminescent, it can create giant, blinding waves with a splash.

entry: POKENAME的光能穿泥，很适合找污泥下遗落的东西。坐得够久，发光细菌就开始吸收泥，使泥也亮起来。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's light is able to penetrate mud, making it great at finding lost items left under the sludge. If it sits in mud for long enough, its light-creating bacteria will begin to absorb the mud and cause it to glow as well.

entry: 再深、再浑的水，POKENAME的光也能完全照亮。危险靠近，它先亮起来，提醒其他宝可梦避险，再用巨力亲自应付威胁。
author: soup1900
source: Even in the deepest and murkiest of waters, POKENAME's light is powerful enough to completely light the area. When danger approaches, it brightens up to alert other Pokémon to safety before using its immense strength to handle the threat itself.

entry: 风暴将至，POKENAME全身亮起，警告所有看得见光的宝可梦。可太近者会眼花晕眩，这时无论重量如何，它都会把对方送去安全处。
author: soup1900
source: When a storm approaches, POKENAME brightens up completely to alert all Pokémon able to see its light. However, anyone too close to it will become blinded and dazed. In these cases, POKENAME, no matter its weight, will carry them to safety.

entry: POKENAME游泳优雅如舞。触角散出的旋转光芒，引其他生物加入水下共舞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME swims through the water with a gracefulness akin to dancing. A swirling light that emanates from its antennae lures others so that they can join it in its undersea dance.

entry: POKENAME身上有数个发光器官。天性护人，常在自己与伙伴周围筑起纯光球，保护免受伤害。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has several light-producing organs on its body. Its protective nature means it will often construct a sphere of pure light around itself and its allies to shield them from harm.

entry: POKENAME在水下静止飘浮，亮光引来其他宝可梦。几乎碰不到它，稍有动静就漂开；任何试图碰触的生物，却会慢慢被吸走能量。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body floats motionlessly underwater, glowing with bright light to draw in other Pokémon. It is almost impossible to touch, floating away from the slightest movement, but it slowly drains the energy of anything that tries.

entry: POKENAME住在深海暗缝，诱饵是周围唯一的光源。猎物常误认成年幼灯笼鱼，它便趁对方不备出击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lurks deep in the ocean and makes its home in dark crevices where its lure produces the only light around. Prey Pokémon often mistake its lure for young Chinchou; POKENAME takes advantage of this and strikes at its unsuspecting target.

entry: POKENAME把自己固定在海床，用小灯把小猎物引进嘴。什么一进去，就被锐牙咬住。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME anchors itself on the seabed and uses its small light to lure small prey into its mouth. As soon as anything enters, it is bitten by POKENAME's sharp teeth.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME拖着重身躯到沿岸浅水，用光球引猎物靠近，再电晕。主要捕水生宝可梦，偶尔也引来好奇的陆生生物。
author: .jerden
source: At night, POKENAME drags its heavy body into shallow coastal waters and uses its glowing orbs to lure prey close before stunning it with an electric shock. It mostly hunts other aquatic Pokémon, but occasionally lures in curious land-dwellers.

entry: POKENAME在深海蹒跚，像在寻宝。水手说，它由贪婪潜水员的灵魂所生，生前为寻找满载财宝的沉船而死。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME trudges the ocean depths as if looking for treasure. Sailors claim this Pokémon is born from the souls of greedy divers who perished searching for lucrative shipwrecks.

entry: POKENAME住在黑暗深海，用头灯引来其他宝可梦，大快朵颐。
author: fairybell16
source: POKENAME live in the dark depths of the sea. The lights on POKENAME's head are used to attract other Pokémon, which POKENAME will feast on.

entry: POKENAME是聪明的水下宝可梦，会披上沉船残片，借此增强体魄，尤其能利用水压。沿身排列的灯球，可发刺眼强光。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are intelligent underwater Pokémon that drape themselves in the parts of wrecked ships. This has had the effect of strengthening their physiques, especially due to underwater pressure. The bulbs along their bodies can emit blinding lights.

entry: POKENAME向周围环形放光，寻找暗水中的猎物。在水面待得够久，长翅鸥便会飞来，在它身上筑巢。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME emits light in a circular pattern around it in search of prey hiding in dark waters. If it stays on the surface for long enough, Wingull will start flying in and build nests on top of it.

entry: 若无眼上特殊薄膜，POKENAME每次闪触角光，都会晃花自己。快速振翼给边缘薄膜充电，让飞行时发光。
author: sk372
source: If not for special membranes over POKENAME's eyes, the light from its antennae would blind it whenever it flashes. The rapid beat of its wings charges the membranes on the edges, causing it to glow while in flight.

entry: 华丽大赛中，训练家可能给POKENAME的水中表演配蓝色头巾，与鳞色相衬。电光与鳞片交织，形成美丽灯光秀。
author: quackquackattack
source: During Pokémon contests, a Trainer may include a Blue Scarf in POKENAME's aquatic routine, as it matches the color of their scales. The dazzling array of both electricity and their scales provides a beautiful display of light.

entry: 传闻POKENAME的身体花纹启发了一幅名画。它睡在阳光下，仿佛在给发光纹路充能。
author: kittyluv090
source: Rumor has it that the patterns on POKENAME's body inspired a famous painting. It sleeps under the sun, as if to recharge its glowing markings.

entry: POKENAME住在寒地浸水的洞穴中。整座洞穴群，都是它的领地，不过，也准许其他宝可梦住。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lives in flooded caves in icy regions. It claims entire cave complexes as its territory, but also allows other Pokémon to live in them.

entry: POKENAME住在寒地浸水的洞穴中。整座洞穴群，都是它的领地，不过，也准许其他宝可梦住。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lives in flooded caves in icy regions. It claims entire cave complexes as its territory, but also allows other Pokémon to live in them.

entry: POKENAME用触须放出强光，引来水生宝可梦。谁靠近，就给谁拥抱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lure aquatic Pokémon towards their feelers with the bright light they emit. They offer hugs to those that approach them.

entry: POKENAME的触角与身纹，亮到能照清最深海沟。它即将浮上海面时，先有巨大漩涡出现，放出刺眼强光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's antennae and body lines can glow bright enough to light up the deepest ocean trenches. Its arrival on the ocean's surface is heralded by the advent of huge whirlpools radiating brilliant blinding light.

entry: POKENAME在几乎无光的海底休息。若看见翼上多个光球亮起，便已来不及逃出掌握。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rests at the bottom of the ocean, where little to no light reaches. If one sees the illumination coming from the multiple orbs along its wings, it is too late to escape from POKENAME's grasp.

entry: POKENAME触角既照明，也扫描分析周围。研究者与它合作，绘制深海地图，寻找沉没或隐藏的事物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's antennae not only illuminate its surroundings but also work to scan and analyze the area. Researchers work with it to map out the ocean depths and search for sunken or hidden discoveries.

entry: POKENAME身上的球亮得格外强。它引水手回岸，顺便吸取一点生命能量，却绝不足以造成实际伤害。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: The orbs on POKENAME's body glow exceptionally bright. They guide sailors to shore, absorbing some of their life energy upon doing so, but never enough to cause any real harm.

entry: POKENAME住在深水，常藏小洞。满月时，大群开始浮出，头灯让从上方俯瞰的海面宛如星海。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME reside deep underwater, often hiding within small caverns and caves. During a full moon, large groups of POKENAME begin to surface, the lights on their heads making the surface look like an ocean of stars from above.

entry: POKENAME发光的突起帮助夜间辨路，也用来狩猎。
author: mrbapcik
source: POKENAME's glowing growth aids them in navigating during the nighttime. They utilize their luminescent appendage for hunting.

entry: POKENAME是强悍的捕食者，用头顶附肢把猎物引向海底。吼吼鲸一潜入深处，通常就再也见不到了。
author: dylonk25
source: A formidable predator, POKENAME uses the appendage atop its head to lure prey to the bottom of the ocean. When a Wailmer dives down to the depths, it is usually not seen again.

entry: POKENAME在海底休息，吃海带。触角微亮，刚好足够赶走食腐者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rests on ocean floors while feeding on kelp. Its antenna glows faintly, providing just enough light to ward off scavengers.

entry: POKENAME睡时浮在海面。触角柔柔发光，大群聚在一起，夜里像星座。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats on the sea's surface while sleeping. Its softly glowing antennae make large pods resemble constellations at night.

entry: POKENAME与灯笼六尾幼崽结群生活，用尾光晃敌，保护孩子。身体释放的强电，能让对方立刻麻痹。
author: keiracm35_
source: POKENAME live in pods along with their Chinpix cubs, using the lights on their tails to blind foes and shield the baby Chinpix. Their bodies emit powerful electric discharges that cause instant paralysis.

entry: POKENAME常把美丽鳞片误认成深海鳞片，所以真拿到深海鳞片，就紧紧留住。它们不满意自己的身体，渴望进化，常为鳞片争斗。
