author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME frequently mistake Prism Scales for Deep Sea Scales, so whenever they get their hands on a Deep Sea Scale, they hold onto it. They fight over scales, as they feel uncomfortable in their own bodies and want to evolve.

entry: POKENAME藏在珊瑚礁里避敌，却很容易分心，什么闪亮、发光，都跟着走。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME hides from predators in coral reefs. However, it is also easily distracted, following anything that sparkles or glows.

entry: POKENAME的膜靠精神能量放出强光。它们为安全成对同行，交替迸发电力与精神能量，保护彼此。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's membrane emits a bright glow, powered by the Pokémon's psychic energy. POKENAME travel in pairs for safety, pulsing with alternating electric and psychic bursts to defend each other from harm.

entry: POKENAME毕生游走海底，寻找沉下的吼鲸王尸体。找到一具便吃上数周，狂热地驱赶所有来者，保卫食物。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME spends its life wandering the ocean floor in search of fallen Wailord corpses. When it finds one, it will feed for weeks, zealously defending its meal from all comers.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME的光照范围可覆盖整片领地。两只的光哪怕稍一重叠，便会爆发刺眼而无情的战争。
author: soup1900
source: At night, the radius of POKENAME's light can encompass its entire territory. If two of their lights even mildly overlap, a blinding, merciless war will ensue between them.

entry: POKENAME住在密沼。日落后出水，用触角发光，与同类交流。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives in dense swamps. When the sun has set, it comes out of the water and emits light from its antennae to communicate with other POKENAME.

entry: 别被POKENAME滑稽的外貌骗了，背后是狡诈的海底猎手。诱饵强光亮得刺痛，让猎物晕眩，无力躲过刀锋般的牙。
author: sk372
source: Do not be fooled by POKENAME's comical appearance, for it belies a conniving undersea hunter. It stuns prey with painfully bright flashes from its lure, leaving them helpless to avoid its razor-sharp teeth.

entry: POKENAME欢快地游过海带林，球形器官放出强光。它是潜水者与泳客的好伙伴，尤其适合爱午夜入海的人。
author: vic1312
source: Merrily swimming through kelp forests, POKENAME provide bright light from their orb-shaped organs. They make great partners for divers and swimmers, especially those that enjoy a midnight dip in the ocean.

entry: POKENAME在其他植物附近，把下半身扎进海床，用黄色球状器官闪出规律光芒诱猎。靠近后便抓牢，以电击打。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME ingrain their lower halves along the seabed near other plants and lure prey with patterns of lights using their yellow, bulbous organs. When prey comes near, they will grab them with their claws and electrocute them.

entry: POKENAME十分贪玩，最爱摆弄自己的诱饵。可是打得太重，诱饵就会好几天无法发光。它们很少吸取教训，刚恢复，往往又将诱饵弄坏了。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME are very playful and love to play with their lure. Yet, when they hit it too hard, the lure becomes unable to produce light for a few days. POKENAME rarely learn from their errors and often damage their lure once they recover.

entry: POKENAME发光的触角储着亮毒液。察觉威胁，就把液体导向尖刺自卫。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's luminous antenna stores glowing venom. If it detects a threat, it redirects the fluid to its spikes for defense.

entry: POKENAME闪动触角，晃晕鲤鱼王等猎物。对方一迷乱，便以精准的精神冲击给予最后一击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flashes its antennae to stun prey like Magikarp. Once disoriented, it finishes them off with a precise Psyshock attack.

entry: POKENAME用自行发光的孢子照亮暗路，让训练家看清去向。森林里尤其有用，因为它得靠孢子施展这本领。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can illuminate dark paths with bioluminescent spores to ensure their Trainer can see where they are going. This is particularly helpful in forested areas, as POKENAME need spores to harness this ability.

entry: POKENAME虽勇猛善战，大多时间却在沉船或暗洞里冥想。冥想时点亮头球，警告别的宝可梦不要打扰专注。
author: pjporwoll
source: While POKENAME is a fierce combatant, it spends most of its time meditating inside sunken ships or dark caverns. It illuminates the orbs on its head during meditation, warning other Pokémon not to disturb its focus.

entry: POKENAME虽勇猛善战，大多时间却在沉船或暗洞里冥想。冥想时点亮头球，警告别的宝可梦不要打扰专注。
author: pjporwoll
source: While POKENAME is a fierce combatant, it spends most of its time meditating inside sunken ships or dark caverns. It illuminates the orbs on its head during meditation, warning other Pokémon not to disturb its focus.

entry: POKENAME的丝，可以织成渔网。渔民们喜欢把它留在身旁，免得哪天，网不够用了。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME silk can be used as net material. Fishermen love to have this Pokémon stick around, in case they run out of netting.

entry: POKENAME睡在海床下，只露亮触角。猎物靠近，就突然放出强电。
author: .izik
source: While sleeping beneath the seafloor, POKENAME leaves its glowing antennae exposed. If prey approaches, it discharges a sudden and powerful shock.

entry: 盯着POKENAME发光触角的人，会涌起初恋般的感情。一移开目光，这段记忆就消失。
author: .izik
source: Those who stare at POKENAME's glowing antenna are overcome with feelings of first love. The memory vanishes as soon as they look away.

entry: POKENAME掘地时，三盏灯全开照路。光合在一起亮到地面上也能看见地下移动的微光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses all three of its lanterns while digging to illuminate their path and increase visibility. In unison, their lights are bright enough to be seen from above ground as a faint glow moving underground.

entry: POKENAME被自己的诱饵迷住，盯着眼前光球看数小时。被打断，就射光束。
author: quackquackattack
source: Mesmerized by their own lure, POKENAME spend hours staring at the bulb of light in front of their faces. They shoot bolts of light when interrupted.

entry: POKENAME后脑的诱饵，引好奇宝可梦前来察看。它游泳时速可达60英里、近100千米，其他宝可梦很难跟上。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have lures on the back of their head that draw curious Pokémon to investigate. They are difficult for other Pokémon to keep up with, especially when they are capable of swimming up to 60 miles an hour, or nearly 100 kilometers an hour.

entry: POKENAME看着吓人，多数却受训当辅助宝可梦，为视障者引路，或替训练家传讯。头球的光，可用摩尔斯电码解读。
author: _pixelar_
source: Although they look intimidating, most POKENAME are trained as service Pokémon. They can act as a guide for the visually impaired or communicate for their Trainer. They can illuminate the bulbs on their head, which can be translated using Morse code.

entry: 港务人员雇POKENAME，夜里引导船安全进港。它们成群游在大船前方，在黑暗中照亮通往岸边的路。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are employed by harbour masters to help guide ships safely to docks at night. They paddle in the water ahead of large ships, working in packs to light the way to shore in the dark.

entry: POKENAME住深水，用精神力量使垃圾发光，诱来猎物。等靠近，便放出超过800伏的电，麻痹后吃掉。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives deep underwater, illuminating trash with its psychic powers to attract its prey. Once near, it paralyzes its prey with over 800 volts of electricity before consuming it.

entry: POKENAME常与当地救生员合作，风暴季节尤其如此，夜里帮助寻找海上失踪者。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: It's not uncommon to see a POKENAME work with local lifeguards, especially during the stormy seasons. They often help find people lost at sea during the night.

entry: POKENAME藏在暗处，从嘴伸出友善电灯怪模样的诱饵。猎物发现是假货时，早已来不及逃，成了它的一餐。
author: sk372
source: Hiding away in the darkness, POKENAME deploys a lure from its mouth that resembles a friendly Lanturn. By the time prey realizes the Lanturn is fake, it is too late to escape becoming POKENAME's meal.

entry: POKENAME扭动亮触手诱猎，再将诱饵硬化为注毒的尖刺。随后吐出腐蚀性酸液，消化碰到的食物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wiggle their glowing tentacle lures to draw in prey, before hardening the lures into barbs that inject poison. They then spit out a caustic acid, which digests food it touches.

entry: POKENAME沿海滩奔跑时，欢喜得如痴如醉。鬃毛发出鲜亮光芒，许多艺术家试着画出这光彩。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME experience rhapsodic glee whenever they run alongside beaches. Their mane produces a vibrant glow that many artists try to replicate in paintings.

entry: POKENAME夜里沿海滩奔跑，形成璀璨灯光。跑得越快，光就越亮。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME create resplendent arrays of light as they run along the beach at night. The faster they run, the brighter their glowing lights become.

entry: POKENAME在深海床盯着自己的亮诱饵，一看数小时。受扰便生气，朝打扰的来源射出小型冲击波。
author: quackquackattack
source: Spending hours on the deep seafloor, POKENAME will stare at their own glowing lure. If disturbed, they become angry and shoot small shockwaves to the source of interruption.

entry: POKENAME用天然光在最深水域狩猎。受威胁就缩壳，可里面透出的光常暴露位置。
author: delexious
source: POKENAME uses its natural light to hunt in the deepest waters. It hides in its shell when threatened, but the glow from within often gives it away.

entry: POKENAME受灯塔光吸引，可在有灯塔的海滩见到，因为球状诱饵会吸收其他明亮光源的光。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found at beaches with lighthouses, as they are drawn in by the light. This is because their bulbous lure absorbs light from other bright sources.

entry: 野生POKENAME闪动炮上的灯，警告其他宝可梦。若对方没注意，就以极高速水流轰击。
author: seanothan_23
source: Wild POKENAME flash the lights on their cannons as a warning to other Pokémon. If they don't notice this warning, then it will blast water at them at extremely high speeds.

entry: POKENAME吐出带电珍珠，黄光数小时不灭。有时潜水者会收来做灯笼。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits electrically charged pearls that glow yellow for hours. These pearls are sometimes collected by divers for use in lanterns.

entry: 许多宝可梦受POKENAME的光吸引。可惜它只顾挖水下隧道，塌下的岩石有时会砸到其他野生宝可梦。
author: bobosmith01
source: Many Pokémon are attracted to the light POKENAME gives off. Unfortunately, POKENAME is single-minded in creating underwater tunnels, so collapsing rocks sometimes strike other wild Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME背上鳞茎充电后，释放柔和、振奋精神的光。它产的小种子，只有雷雨时才发芽。
author: quackquackattack
source: The bulb on POKENAME's back releases a soft, energizing glow when charged with electricity. It produces small seeds that only sprout during thunderstorms.

entry: POKENAME跑动时会产生少量电。看见树上有果，就用电把它打落。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME runs, it will generate small amounts of electricity. If it sees a fruit in a tree, it will use the electricity to drop it to the ground.

entry: 据说它们手持的小骨，来自另一种电属性宝可梦，但尚未证实。没这骨头，POKENAME就难以控电，垂头丧气。
author: infinex21
source: The tiny bones these Pokémon wield are believed to have come from another Electric-type Pokémon, though this has yet to be verified. Without this bone, POKENAME struggle to control their own electricity and become despondent.

entry: POKENAME电力强，身体却无力容纳，因此已经碎裂。碎块松散地连着、包着电核心，吐出小团雷雨云。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's electrical capability is strong, but its body lacks the strength to properly contain it. As such, its body has shattered, loosely connected to and covering its electrical core while puffing out small storm clouds.

entry: POKENAME在角间形成电弧，与伙伴分享电。雷雨时，整群游到水面招引闪电。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME shares electricity with others by creating electrical arcs between its horns. Schools of POKENAME swim to the surface during thunderstorms to draw in lightning strikes.

entry: 它靠壳内细小的肌肉动作产生静电，既防捕食者，也与其他POKENAME沟通。
author: afilthycasual
source: It generates static electricity through small muscle movements inside its shell. This can be used to defend from predators as well as communicate with other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME栖居的森林，虽有许多其他宝可梦，它们采蜜时，却通常会刻意避开任何冲突，多半因为控制不好自身电力。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although many kinds of Pokémon dwell in the forests that POKENAME resides in, it generally goes out of its way to avoid any kind of confrontation while gathering nectar, likely due to its inability to properly control its electric powers.

entry: POKENAME默剧技巧熟练，偶尔仍会电力失控。本想使出屏障，双手却在面前放电，惹出麻烦。
author: sk372
source: While POKENAME's miming techniques are skilled, it still occasionally loses control of its electricity. Instead of placing up a Barrier, its hands may wind up discharging electricity in front of it instead, causing issues.

entry: POKENAME受惊就放光体内积电，电到自己和周围的泳者。幸好电囊尚未发育好，只是轻微电击。
author: chibitales
source: When POKENAME are surprised, they release all of the electricity built up in their body, electrocuting themselves and those swimming around them. Thankfully, the shock is nothing more than a mild zap due to their underdeveloped electric sacs.

entry: POKENAME并非纯粹好斗，却因体型和脾气而危险。它容易不高兴，一闹脾气便扭来甩去，大量放电。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is not strictly aggressive, but is dangerous due to its body and temperament. It is easily upset, and when it throws a tantrum its body will release large amounts of electricity while it thrashes around.

entry: POKENAME乐意载人过水，却有些风险。身体尚在发育，可能无意放电，误电到乘客。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is happy to ferry people across water, but doing so is somewhat risky. Since its body is still developing, it may inadvertently discharge some electricity and accidentally shock its passengers.

entry: POKENAME静止不动，在体内储电。久而久之能量增强，壳便泛起带电微光，可能有意或不慎放出。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME stays motionless, storing electrical energy within its body. Over time, the energy intensifies, causing its shell to glow with a faint electric charge, which can be released accidentally or intentionally.

entry: POKENAME进攻时倾尽全力。可这也常让它被过强电力伤到，或还没击中，毒液就漏得到处都是。
author: bobosmith01
source: When on the offensive, POKENAME puts everything it has into its attacks. Unfortunately, this means it often hurts itself with overwhelming electricity, or it may leak its poison everywhere before actually hitting the opponent.

entry: POKENAME虽力量惊人，却难以驾驭。颊囊常爆发强大能量冲击，待在身边极危险。
author: daimposter_60614
source: Although it is incredibly powerful, POKENAME has trouble handling its powers. POKENAME often releases large shocks of energy from its cheek sacs, making it extremely dangerous to be around.

entry: POKENAME吸电后必须很快释放。这些电击会让许多生物产生奇异情绪与分子变化。
author: notsaying.
source: When POKENAME absorbs electricity, it must release it quickly. These bolts of electricity are known to cause strange emotions and molecular changes in many living things.

entry: POKENAME爱玩友善，还有点顽皮。强大本领尚未完全受控，有时意外释放精神能量，常使附近物件不慎浮起。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is playful, friendly and even a bit mischievous. It lacks complete control over its vast capabilities, so at times it may accidentally discharge psychic energy, typically resulting in inadvertently levitating objects near it.

entry: POKENAME吃素，以蔬菜、水果与树果为食。误入营地时，特别爱偷袋装蕈菇，因为栖息地没有这种东西。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are herbivores and eat vegetables, fruits, and berries. When they stumble into campgrounds, they are particularly fond of stealing Mixed Mushrooms, as they are not endemic to where they live.

entry: POKENAME兴奋就跳舞，有节奏地咬合双颚。什么夹进牙间，就本能咬紧并放电。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME show their excitement by dancing around and rhythmically snapping their jaws together. If anything gets caught between their teeth, they will instinctively clamp down and release electricity.

entry: 刺刺耳POKENAME往往比普通个体更外向，也咬得更重，热情实在收不住。
author: sylviasnake
source: Spiky-eared POKENAME tend to be even more outgoing than the typical POKENAME. They also bite harder, unable to curb their enthusiasm.

entry: POKENAME电量过多就飞不动，得先在地面从羽毛放掉静电，才升空。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME struggles to fly when overcharged. It releases static from its feathers while it's on the ground before rising to the skies.

entry: POKENAME跳过高草丛观察，每次弹起，都有电击般的啪声。
author: fouguri
source: POKENAME jumps over tall grass to keep watch. Each bounce makes a zap sound.

entry: POKENAME睡时来回摇晃，羽毛冒出细小电火花。轻柔放电，用微弱闪光照亮周围。
author: .izik
source: As it sleeps, POKENAME rocks back and forth, causing its feathers to emit tiny sparks. These gentle discharges illuminate its surroundings with a faint, flickering glow.

entry: POKENAME看见宝可梦遇困，不知该帮忙，还是躲着看。它爱与同伴边飞边玩，互相击打、迸火花。害怕时，颊部就放电。
author: drack8786
source: POKENAME doesn't know whether to help the Pokémon it sees in trouble or hide and watch. It enjoys playing with its peers, releasing sparks and hitting each other while flying. When it gets scared, it releases an electric shock from its cheeks.

entry: POKENAME年纪小，还控制不好电力。大部分时候，待在能吸收零星电击的电网上，才安心。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME are still young and can't control their electricity. They spend most of their time on Electrowebs that absorb their stray Thunder Shocks.

entry: 城都久远的过去，少数冷僻记录描绘过类似POKENAME的生物。研究者正确认，这是它昔日的模样，还是已灭绝的亲缘种。
author: sk372
source: A few obscure records from Johto's distant past describe creatures similar to POKENAME. Research is being done to determine if POKENAME once looked like this in the past, or if the records are of a now-extinct relative.

entry: POKENAME喜欢依偎蹭脸，表达亲热。与其他电属性宝可梦摩擦，会积起大量静电，此时碰上，会挨一次难受却无害的电击。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME like to cuddle and rub their cheeks against others to show affection. If they nuzzle with other Electric-type Pokémon, a big amount of static electricity builds up; anyone who touches them in this state receives a nasty, but harmless, shock.

entry: POKENAME超能力弱，只能骑着尾巴行动一小会儿，就会疲倦。这通常让它转去阳光下休息，恢复能量。
author: daimposter_60614
source: A POKENAME can only ride on its tail for a small period of time before getting tired due to its weak psychic powers. This usually results in POKENAME resting in the sun in order to restore energy.

entry: 月光明亮的夜里，许多POKENAME在清湖边围成圈跳舞。牵手形成电路，原本不稳定的放电便平静下来。
author: infinex21
source: On nights where the moon shines bright, many POKENAME will dance around in a ring near clear lakes. Their erratic electrical discharges become calm during this time, as they will form a circuit by joining hands.

entry: POKENAME唱歌时在毛里积起静电。还不善储电，尤其专注表演时，很容易意外放出。
author: abiapollo
source: It builds up static electricity in its fur while it sings. Since it is not yet skilled at storing electricity, POKENAME is prone to accidental electrical discharge when especially focused on its musical performances.

entry: POKENAME敏感的耳朵能察觉水中最细微的动静。若因此受惊，可能放电，电到附近的一切。
author: getz22
source: POKENAME can sense the smallest movements in the water using its sensitive ears. When startled by something it detects, it may release a jolt of electricity, shocking anything nearby.

entry: POKENAME先用利牙咬住敌人，再释放强力电击。这出其不意的策略，让它能逃离大型捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME latches onto its foe with sharp fangs before unleashing a powerful Thunder Shock. This surprising tactic allows it to escape from larger predators.

entry: POKENAME站着吸收阳光时，常冒细小电火花。它爱在水里打滚，颊上的记号也随之发光。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME will often discharge small electrical sparks while they stand still to absorb sunlight. They love to roll around in water, the marks on their cheeks glowing as they do so.

entry: POKENAME脸上的鳃电流噼啪。入水前通常先浸鳃，排掉积电。太兴奋忘了，就啪地被炸得后退，晕头转向，却毫发无伤。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The gills on POKENAME's face crackle with electricity. Before entering water, it usually dips them in to discharge the buildup. When too excited, it forgets, resulting in a sharp crack as it's blasted backward, left dazed but completely unharmed.

entry: 警校里能见到POKENAME受训，成为初出茅庐的侦探。它与警员一起练习收集证据、帮助人们破案。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found at police academies training to become fledgling detectives. They practice collecting evidence and helping people solve crimes alongside officers.

entry: 据说野生POKENAME背上的鳞茎一开花，就能供一间房屋用电。可得存上数年才够，因此几乎从不开放。
author: daimposter_60614
source: A wild POKENAME has a bulb on its back that is said to produce enough electricity to power a house when it blooms. These bulbs almost never bloom, however, taking years to store enough electricity.

entry: POKENAME慢慢沿地爬，毫不躲藏。被什么碰到，就放出一阵电火花，随后若无其事地继续走。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME crawls along the ground slowly and makes no effort to hide. If anything touches it, it will discharge electricity in a shower of sparks, then continue moving as if nothing had happened.

entry: POKENAME娇纵任性，一不顺心就准闹脾气。它尖叫拍翼，电火花四射，直到平静才停。
author: sk372
source: Spoiled and petulant, POKENAME will inevitably throw tantrums if it doesn't get its way. It screeches and flaps its wings, sending out electric sparks all around it until it calms down.

entry: 危险稍露苗头，POKENAME就迅速缩进坚硬石壳。这时触碰，只会挨很轻微的电击。
author: fancyskunk
source: At the slightest sign of danger, POKENAME quickly retreats into its tough, rocky shell. Touching POKENAME while it is in this defensive posture will result in a very mild electric shock.

entry: 合众传说说，一名科学家把自己变成了POKENAME。其他地区的训练家常觉得，反复提这传说既老套又烦人。
author: fancyskunk
source: According to Unovan legend, a scientist transformed himself into a POKENAME. Trainers from other regions often find references to this legend tiresome and overdone.

entry: POKENAME控温能力差，常不慎从壳中喷火，吓自己一跳，又因受惊把附近生物电到。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have poor control over their internal temperature. They are prone to inadvertently releasing bursts of fire from their shells, startling them and causing them to also electrocute those nearby in surprise.

entry: POKENAME很难停止产能，便把尖牙扎进猎物，释放不断产生的电力。咬后麻木，让毒液毫无阻碍地迅速扩散。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sinks its fangs into prey to discharge the constant electricity it produces, as it has a difficult time stopping its own production of energy. The numbness left from the bite allows venom to spread quickly without resistance.

entry: POKENAME只要进入感染恶意软件的设备10英尺内，就会失控冒电。这些电击强到连自己也会受伤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sparks uncontrollably when within 10 feet of a device infected with malware. These shocks are strong enough to injure even itself.

entry: POKENAME是初出茅庐的小画家，用尾上的墨状物不停涂画。液体带着体内微电，墨未干就碰作品，通常会挨一下电。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a budding artist constantly doodling using the ink-like substance on its tail. The liquid carries faint amounts of electricity from its body, so touching its art while the ink is still wet usually results in a jolt.

entry: POKENAME电力弱，很难远距离电击，宁愿跑近对手，送上一个带电的亲吻。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's electrical powers are weak, so it has trouble delivering shocks from afar. It prefers to run up its opponent and give them an electrifying smooch.

entry: POKENAME能从头骨放电，强到足以击晕成年人。极费体力，每天只能用一次。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can discharge electricity from its skull powerful enough to stun a full-grown adult. This exhausting feat can only be performed once per day.

entry: POKENAME一开始放电，就停不下来。为重新积电，它会用强壮身体紧缠变压器或电缆。
author: infinex21
source: Once POKENAME begins to release electricity, it cannot stop. To reaccumulate electricity, it uses its strong body to tightly coil around transformers or power cables.

entry: POKENAME把电存进腹部的特殊带状结构，再从头顶放出。它容易被其他宝可梦吓到，需要不断安慰，告诉它做得很好。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME store electricity in a special band around their stomach and release these that energy through the top of their head. They are easily frightened by other Pokémon and need constant reassurance that they are doing well.

entry: POKENAME太兴奋，尾巴就放电，感到威胁也会如此。收服时最好谨慎接近。
author: daimposter_60614
source: When a POKENAME gets too excited, it releases shocks of electricity from its tail. It also does this when it feels threatened, so it is best to approach with caution while catching one.

entry: POKENAME比皮丘更会控电，却仍未完全掌握，偶尔也有意外电流。幸好，放电已不再伤害自己。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME has better control over its electricity than Pichu, it still has not fully mastered it. Accidental electrical bursts can still occur, but fortunately the discharges no longer harm POKENAME itself.

entry: POKENAME能储下足够一座城市用的电，却很难容纳。受惊会放出大股能量，足以击晕小孩。
author: daimposter_60614
source: A POKENAME is capable of storing enough electricity to power a city; however, it struggles to contain it. When startled, POKENAME can release large jolts of energy, enough to stun small children.

entry: POKENAME还在学产电，吃完热食常打嗝冒火花。若喂雾莲果，全身会起静电，碰上很痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are still learning to generate electricity and often burp out sparks after a warm meal. If they are fed a Rowap Berry, they produce a static charge around their body that is painful to touch.

entry: POKENAME难以留住电力，游泳时常突然放出一阵电，再被周围的水，传导出去。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME has difficulty retaining its electricity. While swimming, it will often release a burst of electricity that's then conducted by the water.

entry: 掘地时，POKENAME会间歇闪出微光，短暂照亮周围，免得自己迷了方向。
author: chorb33
source: When digging, POKENAME regularly emits weak flashes to briefly illuminate its surroundings so that it does not lose its bearings.

entry: POKENAME产生带大量电的小冰晶。可冰不太导电，存下的电便到处冒火花。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME produces small ice crystals that are charged with large amounts of electricity. However, the ice isn't very conductive, so the stored electricity ends up sparking everywhere.

entry: POKENAME寻找数据中心，吸收里面服务器的数据。吃信息时，身体会不时失控冒电，待在旁边很危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME seeks out data centers to absorb data from the servers inside. Periodically, while consuming the information, its body sparks uncontrollably, making it dangerous to be around.

entry: 它不停漏出静电，绒羽总是蓬松炸起。受惊还会喷出小火球。
author: lydiaprower8
source: This Pokémon's downy feathers are always fuzzy and sticking out from all the constant static electricity leaking out. It bursts out with little fireballs when startled.

entry: 掘地时，POKENAME会间歇闪出微光，短暂照亮周围，免得自己迷了方向。
author: chorb33
source: When digging, POKENAME regularly emits weak flashes to briefly illuminate its surroundings so that it does not lose its bearings.

entry: 掘地时，POKENAME会间歇闪出微光，短暂照亮周围，免得自己迷了方向。
author: chorb33
source: When digging, POKENAME regularly emits weak flashes to briefly illuminate its surroundings so that it does not lose its bearings.

entry: 掘地时，POKENAME会间歇闪出微光，短暂照亮周围，免得自己迷了方向。
author: chorb33
source: When digging, POKENAME regularly emits weak flashes to briefly illuminate its surroundings so that it does not lose its bearings.

entry: POKENAME能感知人的精神状态。若发现谁没劲，就可能电他一下，好让脚步轻快些。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME can sense people's energy levels. If it's low, it may give them a shock to put more pep in their step.

entry: POKENAME在体内储电，情绪一激动就突然暴涨。害怕训练家遇险时，会迸出狂暴电流，足以击倒树木。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME stores electricity within its body, but heightened emotions cause sudden surges. When in fear that its Trainer is in danger, it discharges violent bursts of electricity that are capable of felling trees.

entry: POKENAME天生害羞，避免战斗。通常弱小，听觉却惊人，毛下还藏着利刺。刺上漏出的毒若注入体内，会引发疼痛的皮疹。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are naturally shy and avoid combat. They are generally weak, but have incredible hearing and have sharp barbs hidden under their fur. Anyone injected by the poison leaking from their barbs will develop a painful rash.

entry: POKENAME用小电击促进当地植物生长，再以长成的灌木筑坝。大量聚居处，土壤带轻微负电，可能让人挨静电。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use small electric shocks to stimulate plant growth in their local environment, using the resulting shrubs as building material for dams. Where large populations are present the soil has a slight negative charge and can cause static shocks.

entry: POKENAME的石头不能完全容纳身形，偶尔会随电光不由自主地猛然冒出，无意间吓到附近生物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's stone cannot keep its form fully contained. It will occasionally rise up suddenly and involuntarily with an electric burst, often scaring nearby creatures without meaning to.

entry: POKENAME一心想显得凶猛，却仍控不好颚部肌肉。因此常结伴，互相帮助学习。
author: poppyisconfused
source: Despite its fiery devotion to looking fierce, POKENAME is still inept at controlling the muscles in its jaw, therefore they are often found in packs helping each other learn.

entry: 危急时，雄性POKENAME通常保护雌性。若躲不开捕食者，全洞的成员会试着放出所有电与毒，作最后的自保。
author: bobosmith01
source: Male POKENAME generally protect female POKENAME in times of crisis. If they cannot flee or hide from a predator, all POKENAME in the den will try to release all of their stored electricity and toxins in a last-ditch effort to keep themselves safe.

entry: POKENAME个头小，空中灵活，不过被剑尖戳到也没多大威胁，产生的电只像静电一下。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME is small and nimble in the air, but being poked by its blade is no major threat. The electricity it produces is like a static shock.

entry: POKENAME勇敢地试着用剑刺敌。可剑太钝，结果只是用力戳了一下。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME valiantly tries to stab opponents with its blade. However, because the blade is rather dull, it just does a strong poke instead.

entry: POKENAME反复跺地，威吓敌人，阻止靠近。它与同类住在宁静草原。
author: bobosmith01
source: To intimidate foes and dissuade them from coming closer, POKENAME stomps on the ground over and over. It is found in peaceful grasslands with others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME兴奋时，缎带末端轻轻噼啪放电，附近对象可能不慎挨到短暂轻微的电击。
author: mepp.
source: The ends of POKENAME's ribbons crackle softly when it is excited. Those nearby may accidentally receive a brief, mild shock.

entry: POKENAME很不善用脸颊储电、放电，因此常改用爪觅食。它性情凶猛，外貌尤其令人不安。
author: slothboy1028_94690
source: POKENAME are terrible at storing and releasing electricity from their cheeks, so they often use their claws to get their food instead. POKENAME are quite ferocious, especially with their quite unnerving appearance.

entry: POKENAME住在臭氧层附近的高空。风暴天降下，吸收雷云中的电，穿云时全身能量噼啪作响。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME resides high up in the sky, near the ozone layer. It descends during stormy weather to soak up the electricity within the storm clouds, its body crackling with energy as it weaves through them.

entry: POKENAME小又没经验，很难镇定。受惊会弹出内脏，碰到就会挨猛烈电击。
author: glacierwing
source: Due to its small size and inexperience, POKENAME struggles to maintain its composure. When startled, it ejects its inner organs, which delivers a nasty shock if touched.

entry: 谜拟丘附身皮丘，形成了POKENAME。皮丘似乎不太舒服，但附身实际上帮助它控制电力。
author: adoster
source: POKENAME is the result of a Mimikyu possessing a Pichu. While it seems unpleasant to Pichu, being possesed actually helps it control its electricity.

entry: POKENAME极胆小，住空心倒木，不惜一切避险。若被发现，就突然迸强火花，扰乱捕食者，再逃走。
author: .izik
source: Extremely timid, POKENAME makes its home in hollowed logs, avoiding danger at all costs. If discovered, it releases a sudden bright spark to disorient its predator before fleeing.

entry: POKENAME本能地把电导向尾巴，控不好，有时电到自己。它很快甩掉麻感，继续玩。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME instinctively channels electricity through its tail, but its lack of control sometimes results in shocking itself. It quickly shakes off the jolt and continues playing.

entry: 雷雨云形成，POKENAME便聚集。若闪电击中沙地，就全体兴奋地跳舞、吠叫。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME gather together when thunderstorms form. If lightning strikes the sand, POKENAME all dance and bark excitedly.

entry: POKENAME很孤独，吃仙人掌果，等友善的人路过。它不太聪明，常把风滚草当宝可梦一起玩。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are quite lonely, spending time eating cacti fruit as they wait for a friendly person to walk by. POKENAME are not the brightest, often playing with tumbleweed as if it were another Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME总想作伴交友，游泳时会蹭近其他鱼。可惜控电差，常无意电到对方，反而被避开。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is always seeking companionship and new friends, nuzzling up against other fish as it swims. It unfortunately cannot control its electricity well, so it often accidentally shocks others this way and cause them to avoid it.

entry: POKENAME藏在幻象后，模仿人或宝可梦自保。不过，太兴奋或受惊，控不好就会让幻象露馅，还意外放电。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME hides behind illusions, mimicking people or Pokémon to protect itself. However, its lack of control can cause its illusions to falter and lead to accidental discharges when it becomes too excited or startled.

entry: POKENAME难驾驭力量，冒火花或吐火星后很容易累。疲倦时尾火变暗，训练家常备零食，让它保持活力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a difficult time managing its powers and easily gets tired after shooting sparks or breathing out embers. The flame on its tail dims whenever it gets tired, so Trainers tend to keep snacks ready to help keep it active.

entry: POKENAME常被自己的小腿绊倒，摔时喷一团花粉。花粉带微电，碰皮肤会麻麻的。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME tends to trip over its tiny legs, releasing a puff of pollen as it falls. The pollen carries a slight electric charge and tingles upon skin contact.

entry: POKENAME靠静电聚成大团。一放电，整群散开，每只连最微小的风也抵抗不了。
author: pjporwoll
source: Using static electricity, POKENAME clusters together in large masses. When the energy discharges, the swarm is scattered, leaving each POKENAME at the mercy of even the slightest wind.

entry: POKENAME不停产生带静电的小孢子，一碰就啪地炸开。遇险时，会大量喷发。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME is constantly producing little static spores that pop on contact. Those spores can burst in greater quantity when POKENAME is in danger.

entry: POKENAME试图伏击猎物，再用带电双颚麻痹。可电力太不受控，常没出手，就暴露了位置。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME attempts to ambush its prey before paralyzing them with its electrified jaws. However, due to how wild its electricity is, it often gives away its location before it can strike.

entry: POKENAME耳朵太大，飞得吃力。快速拍翼产生微弱静电，刺激肌肉。
author: mudkip0433
source: Due to its large ears, POKENAME struggles to fly. The rapid flapping of its wings produces small amounts of static electricity that stimulate its muscles.

entry: POKENAME常见于市区，躲在掏空的水果和大树果里。它从手持设备与玩具偷电，常造成永久损坏。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Commonly found in urban areas, POKENAME take refuge in hollowed-out fruits and large berries. POKENAME leech electricity from handheld devices and toys, often causing permanent damage to them.

entry: POKENAME不慎被踩，就从倒刺放电。肌肉因电绷紧，人或宝可梦常被绊倒，又摔到其他POKENAME身上。
author: mellowmuse
source: If POKENAME is accidentally stepped on, it releases electric shocks through its barbs. These shocks lead muscles to tense, frequently causing Pokémon or people to trip and fall onto other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME在建筑墙腔里爬，啃电线，从小设备吸电。被发现时会发出可怜叫声，连最铁石心肠的对象也会放下戒备。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME can be found crawling within wall cavities of buildings, where it chews on electrical wiring and absorbs charges from small devices. When discovered, it will unleash a pitiable cry that lowers the defenses of even the hardest heart.

entry: POKENAME积蓄电力时，身上晶体明亮发光。疲倦时，晶体变得暗淡浑浊。
author: petratheangel
source: When POKENAME is charging electricity, the crystals on its body glow brightly. When it is tired, the crystals become dull and cloudy.

entry: 它们有时出现在邻近辽阔森林的村庄，林中很容易迷路。现身是福是祸，各地看法差异很大。
author: ocxin
source: These Pokémon sometimes emerge near villages which border vast forests that are easy to get lost in. Whether their appearance is considered a blessing or a bad omen varies greatly from community to community.

entry: POKENAME中央的皮丘似乎掌控身体行动。还没完全驾驭力量，攻击时有时放电远超本意。
author: sk372
source: The Pichu in POKENAME's center appears to control the body's movements. It hasn't fully mastered its strength, so sometimes it discharges far more electricity with an attack than it means to.

entry: POKENAME大部分电力存进背上蘑菇，受惊偶尔冒电花。移除真菌，几乎就会失去全部电力。
author: sk372
source: Most of POKENAME's electrical power is stored within the mushrooms on its back. They spark on occasion when it is startled, and removing the fungus will sap it almost completely of its electric capabilities.

entry: POKENAME摩擦带电鳞片产电。不过，能量太多，鳞片就会失控振动。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME rubs its charged scales together to generate electricity. However, if it generates too much energy, the scales will start to vibrate uncontrollably.

entry: POKENAME潜伏住宅附近，吃废电池。被发现，就试着对目击者使出十万伏特，过程却常电到自己。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME lurk near houses to consume discarded batteries. If spotted, POKENAME try to use Thunderbolt on whoever spotted them, often electrocuting themselves in the process.

entry: 这种胆小宝可梦很容易被大对手吓住。它用电击使敌人短暂晕眩，争取时间匆忙逃走。
author: fireblade141
source: This timid Pokémon is easily intimidated by large opponents. It uses electric shocks to stun said foes long enough for it to make a hasty escape.

entry: 三合一磁怪与朝北鼻常聚在POKENAME身边。它把电存进嵌在体内的雷之石。
author: cait_sith
source: Magneton and Nosepass tend to gather around POKENAME. It stores electricity in the Thunder Stones embedded in its body.

entry: POKENAME很难自行积静电，便蹭其他毛茸茸的宝可梦。电荷会让敏感的毛根根竖起。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME struggle to develop a static charge on their own, so they rub against other furry Pokémon to develop a static charge. This charge causes their sensitive fur to stand on end.

entry: POKENAME全身敏感细毛一积静电就竖起，放电后才恢复。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have sensitive hairs across their body that stand on end whenever they develop a static charge. Their fur returns to normal when they discharge electricity.

entry: POKENAME的糖丝状毛又软又甜，会随年岁增长脱落。吃了会挨微弱静电，舌头电得麻麻的。
author: .izik
source: The sugary, floss-like fur of POKENAME is both soft and sweet, shedding as it ages. If eaten, it delivers a small static shock, tingling the tongue with electricity.

entry: POKENAME看似蓬松，却不宜触碰，因为身体还控不好其中奔流的电。
author: chaotic_aspergers
source: Despite its fluffy appearance, POKENAME is not safe to touch, as its body cannot yet control the electricity coursing through it.

entry: POKENAME啃地下电缆吸电，常引发意外停电。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gnaws on underground power cables to absorb electricity. This habit frequently causes unexpected power outages.

entry: POKENAME三颗头的电都控制不好，总互相电到，也因此，吵个不停。
author: mistymagius
source: The three heads of POKENAME are always squabbling with one another since they constantly shock each other with their uncontrollable electricity.

entry: POKENAME喜欢嬉戏对打，却常兴奋过头，麻痹较弱的玩伴。若对手更强，反倒可能把自己麻痹。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME enjoy play fighting but often get too excited and paralyze weaker Pokémon. Against tougher playmates, POKENAME may end up paralyzing itself.

entry: POKENAME健忘，学习需要反复强化。每次用超能力时，训练家用苹野果奖励，可让愉快感受巩固对能力的掌握。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are forgetful creatures that need reinforcement to properly learn a lesson. Whenever they use their psychic powers, offering them a Leppa Berry can help Trainers reinforce the powers with positive emotions.

entry: POKENAME爱逗其他宝可梦，会游到朋友身边，轻轻电一下。每次只能产生几瓦电力，恶作剧通常一次电击就结束。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to tease other Pokémon and are known to swim up to their friends to deliver a small zap. Their mischief usually begins and ends at a single shock, as they can only produce a few watts of electricity at a time.

entry: POKENAME常跑去找某种树果或朋友，漫无章法，随后忘了自己在干什么。迷路时会向空中射火花，盼训练家找到。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often go on desultory quests to find a particular berry or a friend, only to forget what they were doing. Whenever they are lost, they shoot fiery sparks into the air in the hopes that their Trainer finds them.

entry: POKENAME是格斗新手，靠拳头取胜。每次输了就闹脾气，冒出火花。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are novice fighters that rely on their fists to win battles. Whenever they lose, they release sparks as they enter into a temper tantrum.

entry: POKENAME电力尚未发育好，尝试使用时常电到自己。幸好硬壳能保护它。
author: killerrene64
source: Due to its underdeveloped electric powers, POKENAME often shocks itself while trying to use them. However, its hard shell keeps it protected.

entry: POKENAME把雷雨时产生的能量存进壳。控电还在学习，承受不住就会放出。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME stores the energy generated during thunderstorms in its shell. It is still developing the ability to control electricity, causing it to discharge when overwhelmed.

entry: POKENAME用植物茎捣碎树果、敲开坚果，也能当武器。它常不慎放电，所以茎被烧焦。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME wields a plant stalk to help pulverize berries and crack open nuts, though it can also use it as a weapon. Its stalk is charred because it often releases electricity accidentally.

entry: POKENAME两个头常为食物、夜里谁醒着而争吵。两喙一碰，就会放电，把自己都电到。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's two heads habitually argue over food and over which will remain awake for the night. If the beaks of its two heads touch, electricity discharges and zaps them both.

entry: POKENAME快速碰钳，迸出火花，和同类玩。哪怕不再碰，有时钳子仍会不由自主地继续冒火花。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME plays with others of its kind by clicking its claws together rapidly to create sparks. Sometimes its claws may involuntarily continue producing sparks even after it stops clicking.

entry: POKENAME背上嵌着会亮的月亮碎片，光的强弱随月相盈亏。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a piece of the moon embedded in their back that glows. The intensity of the glow waxes and wanes with the phases of the moon.

entry: POKENAME虽能吃各种天然与加工食物，满月下却似乎最有精神。据说主要力量来自月光。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although they can eat a variety of natural and processed foods, POKENAME seems to be most energetic under the full moon. It is thought they get most of their power from the moon's rays.

entry: 几只POKENAME靠在一起，外圈有皮皮、巴大蝶及它们的融合体保护。夜里，保护者一同跳舞唱歌，似乎有助加快进化。
author: bobosmith01
source: Several POKENAME will stay close together as a circle of Clefairy, Butterfree and their fusions protect them. At night, their protectors will dance together and sing to POKENAME, which seems to help speed up the evolution process.

entry: POKENAME吃碎石助消化，在坚韧体内将其磨碎。这饮食也帮助石质外表硬化。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME consumes gravel to aid in digestion, grinding it down within its tough body. This diet also contributes to the hardening of its rocky exterior.

entry: POKENAME嗓音还没发育好，唱歌很刺耳。它反而利用这点，制造恼人噪声，驱赶捕食者。
author: dodoowner_
source: Since POKENAME's voices aren't fully developed yet, their songs are very irritating. They will use their voices to their advantage by creating an annoying noise to deter predators.

entry: POKENAME在满月下成群游动，跃出水面，试着让自己沐浴月光。原因尚不清楚，不过传说，若有POKENAME能跃上月亮，便会发生惊人的变化。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME school together under the full moon and will jump out of the water to try and bathe themselves in moonlight. Why they do this is unclear, but legends say that if a POKENAME can jump to the moon it will undergo an incredible transformation.

entry: 若一群POKENAME入侵系统，直射月光便能迫使它们离开。哪怕只照一会儿，也会从硬件里蹦出来。
author: .izik
source: If a group of POKENAME infests a system, exposing it to direct moonlight will force them out. Even brief illumination causes them to spring free from the hardware.

entry: POKENAME几乎总在休息，节省进化能量。它能预感流星雨将至，便醒来赶去，寻找陨星落下时可能带来的月之石。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME are almost always resting, conserving energy for evolution. They can sense imminent meteor showers, waking up and rushing to them in search of any Moon Stones that may have landed amid the falling meteoroids.

entry: POKENAME白天总疲倦，因为整夜用小翼向上飞，徒劳地想够到月亮。它大群生活，成员彼此照顾。
author: fiordaliso
source: During the day it is always tired, as it spends the night flying upward trying in vain to reach the moon with its small wings. POKENAME lives in large groups where each member cares for the others.

entry: POKENAME偷旅人的帽子垫巢。越精巧的帽子，在它日益增加的收藏中越珍贵。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME steals hats from passing travelers to line its nest. The more elaborate the hat, the greater its value in this Pokémon's growing collection.

entry: POKENAME很少独行，总与同类簇拥，像朵飘浮的花。据说见到这样的群体，会有好运。
author: vracken
source: POKENAME rarely travels alone, surrounding itself with others of its kind until they resemble a floating flower. The sight of such a swarm is believed to bring good fortune.

entry: POKENAME的网在黑暗中泛出各种绚丽色彩，略有催眠作用，引昆虫落网，成为下一餐。
author: sk372
source: The webs POKENAME spins glow a variety of radiant colors in the dark. The effect is slightly hypnotic, drawing in insects to become ensnared and become its next meal.

entry: POKENAME对大气电磁变化敏感。夜空有极光时，尤其容易意外放电。
author: linhasxoc
source: POKENAME is sensitive to electromagnetic changes in the atmosphere. If an aurora is visible in the night sky, POKENAME are especially prone to accidental electric shocks.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME格外害羞，躲在物体或其他宝可梦后面。那些夜里的歌声轻如耳语，却仍能催眠。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME becomes incredibly shy during a full moon, hiding behind objects or other Pokémon. Its songs on those nights are barely above a whisper, yet they still carry a sleep-inducing effect.

entry: POKENAME爱在夜里蹦跳，还会找伙伴一起。连滚数英里，也不累。
author: captainjefejefe
source: POKENAME loves to bounce around at night, and will find others to do it with. It can roll around for miles and not get tired.

entry: POKENAME极爱探索，乘晚风去未知的地方。群体旅行时，会牵手一起跳空中舞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a very exploratory nature, using the evening breeze to carry it to parts unknown to explore. When traveling in groups, POKENAME link hands and perform aerial dances together.

entry: 旅人睡着，POKENAME就偷偷咬断、偷走鞋带筑巢。这怪习惯，让许多人醒来摸不着头脑。
author: .izik
source: While travelers sleep, POKENAME sneaks in to gnaw off and steal their shoelaces to build its nest. This peculiar habit leaves many waking up in confusion.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在月光下玩，可几分钟就累。若找到月之石，就会向大家炫耀，抛来抛去。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME love playing in the moonlight, but tend to get tired after a few minutes. If one finds a Moon Stone, it will show it off to others and toss it around.

entry: POKENAME白天用水与富含养分的凝胶混合浇作物。夜里在刚浇过的田中休息，吸收月光，舒缓疲惫身体。
author: quackquackattack
source: During the day, POKENAME waters crops using a mixture of water and a nutrient-rich gel. At night, it rests in the freshly watered fields to absorb moonlight and ease its tired body.

entry: POKENAME若护理不当，毛会不停生长，常严重打结。野生靠家人打理，家养则得常去美容师那里。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's fur grows indefinitely without proper care, often leading to severe matting. In the wild it relies on its family to manage its coat, while domesticated POKENAME require frequent trips to the groomer.

entry: POKENAME项链似乎由月岩制成，价值很高。不过，偷猎者可得小心：项链也能把月光导成强大能量束，用来自卫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's necklace appears to be made of lunar stone, making it highly valuable. Would-be poachers should beware, however, as it also allows it to channel moonlight into powerful beams of energy to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME循螺旋掘进，挖出复杂地洞。曲折路径既是家，也能迷惑入侵者，起到防御作用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs in spiral patterns, creating intricate burrows beneath the earth. These twisting paths serve as both a home and a defense, confusing potential intruders.

entry: POKENAME撕碎树皮，铺成柔软舒服的巢，走到哪里都有舒适睡处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME shreds tree bark to build comfortable bedding, creating soft nests. This habit ensures it always has a cozy place to rest, no matter where it travels.

entry: 满月之夜，许多野生POKENAME带着文柚果聚集。吃到饱，再一直唱，直到黎明才休息。
author: cobalt0135
source: Many wild POKENAME gather together on the night of the full moon bringing Sitrus Berries to eat. They feast until they're full and then sing until they rest at daybreak.

entry: POKENAME在强月光下泛粉红光，速度也稍快。只在晴夜的火山附近活动，因此难得一见。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME glow pink in strong moonlight, and will move a bit faster than normal. Due to only being active near volcanoes on clear nights, this Pokémon is not often seen.

entry: POKENAME受不了浓气味，避开花朵和香浓食物。它喜欢气味平淡的地方，对环境很挑剔。
author: .izik
source: Strong scents bother POKENAME, causing it to avoid flowers or fragrant foods. It prefers areas with neutral smells, making it quite particular about its environment.

entry: POKENAME蜷在空心树干里睡觉，温暖安全。个头小，能挤进其他宝可梦不愿去的地方。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps curled up inside hollow tree trunks, seeking warmth and safety. Its small size allows it to squeeze into spaces other Pokémon avoid.

entry: POKENAME群满月时聚集脱角，角因美丽与传说中的药效而抢手。到下次满月，很快又长回。
author: mepp.
source: Herds of POKENAME gather on the night of the full moon to shed their horns, which are coveted for their beauty and supposed medicinal benefits. These horns quickly grow back by the next full moon.

entry: POKENAME收集化石，用小拳头从洞壁敲下，再骄傲地摆在巢中，作为力量的证明。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects fossils, breaking them free from cave walls with its small fists. These treasures are proudly displayed in its nest as a sign of strength.

entry: POKENAME颈部皮褶的图案，会准确反映月相。开心又安全时，上面的星星就闪烁。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The pattern on POKENAME's hood changes to accurately reflect the phases of the moon. Whenever POKENAME feels happy and safe, the stars seen on their hood twinkle.

entry: POKENAME吃落叶，给腹内火焰添燃料，保持温暖。找到越多叶子，火就越热。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME consumes fallen leaves to fuel the flame within its belly, keeping it warm. The more leaves it finds, the hotter its flame becomes.

entry: POKENAME望月时若遭攻击，会以惊人力道反击。传说，满月挨打，反击还会诅咒施暴者的家人。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME is struck while gazing at the moon, it retaliates with incredible force. Legends say that if it is attacked during a full moon, the counterattack will place a curse upon the aggressor's family.

entry: POKENAME模仿植物，静立避险。它怕雨，雷雨云一聚，就找地方躲。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME mimics the behavior of plants, standing still to avoid threats. Rain frightens it, and it seeks cover whenever storm clouds gather.

entry: POKENAME满月下看舞，只看一次便能完美模仿。学会后永远记得，随时能跳。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME watches a dance routine under a full moon, it can perfectly mimic it after a single viewing. Once learned, it will remember and be able to perform the dance forever.

entry: POKENAME白天吃各种树果，却会把香罗果单独堆放，不与其他树果混在一起。满月之夜，它们各取一颗香罗果吃下，让思维稍微敏锐一些。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME eat many sorts of berries throughout the day but keep Maranga Berries in a pile away from the other berries. On nights of the full moon, they each take a Maranga Berry and eat them to gain a slight boost to their mental acuity.

entry: POKENAME坐在飞碟的保护中，飞过星夜。若发现有趣的物件，就以牵引光束，将其提起。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME flies through starry nights protected by a flying saucer. If it spots an interesting object, it uses a tractor beam to pick it up.

entry: POKENAME极善良，什么人、什么事，只要能帮都愿意。可惜手指带电，碰到者常挨难受的电击。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME is incredibly kind, offering to help whatever and whoever it can. Unfortunately, the electrical charge carried in its fingers tends to unleash nasty shocks to those it touches.

entry: POKENAME恶作剧地偷工地工具，让工人乱成一团。施工队常被弄得困惑不解。
author: .izik
source: As a prank, POKENAME steals tools from construction sites, causing chaos among workers. These antics often leave construction crews baffled.

entry: POKENAME是宝可梦培育家喜爱的伙伴。这些幼年宝可梦很容易与其他幼崽交友，总笑容满面。月亮可见的夜里，会跳舞直到睡着。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are the beloved partners of Pokémon Breeders. These baby Pokémon easily make friends with other young Pokémon and always have smiles on their faces. During nights when the moon is visible, POKENAME will dance until they fall asleep.

entry: POKENAME吃毒植物，增强体内毒囊。久而久之，毒越来越强，也越来越危险。
author: .izik
source: By eating poisonous plants, POKENAME strengthens the poison sacs within its body. This diet makes it more dangerous over time, with its toxins becoming increasingly potent.

entry: POKENAME用魅力让敌人放松警惕，再出其不意攻击。它善于欺骗，很难靠智谋战胜。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's charm lulls enemies into a false sense of security before it strikes unexpectedly. This deceptive nature makes it a tricky opponent to outwit.

entry: POKENAME的脸给面具作气密封口。传闻若把脸推进身体，就会打开通往遥远星云的门。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's face serves as an airtight seal for its mask. Rumors say that if you push its face into its body, it opens a portal to a distant nebula.

entry: 新月夜，POKENAME能影响附近心灵，让它们视自己为神。黎明效果消失，先前痴迷者都困惑不解。
author: .izik
source: On nights of the new moon, POKENAME can influence nearby minds to treat it as a deity. This effect vanishes by dawn, leaving the previously enthralled in a state of confusion.

entry: POKENAME吃洞中苔藓，偏爱微甜的发光品种。独特饮食，让尖刺在暗处也微亮。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME feeds on cave moss, preferring the glowing variety for its subtle sweetness. This unique diet make its spikes glow faintly in dark environments.

entry: POKENAME吃金属矿，强化体内金属骨骼。持续摄取让身体耐用，久而久之泛起微光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME consumes metal ore to strengthen the metallic skeleton within its body. This steady intake ensures its durability and gives it a slight shimmer over time.

entry: 流星满天之夜，POKENAME成群聚集，缎带泛出神秘光芒。据说目睹这场面，会获繁盛富足的祝福。
author: mepp.
source: When groups of POKENAME gather on nights filled with shooting stars, their ribbons gleam with a mysterious light. Those who witness these gatherings are said to be blessed with great prosperity.

entry: POKENAME每晚把月光吸进炮中。奇怪的是，射出的光束会让目标短暂散发奶酪味。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME absorbs moonlight into its cannon each night. The beam it fires curiously causes the target to smell like cheese for a short period.

entry: POKENAME虽向月亮许愿，对敌人却满怀恶意。许多人相信，满月下与它相遇，会招来不幸。
author: .izik
source: Though it makes wishes to the moon, POKENAME's intentions toward enemies are filled with malice. Many believe that misfortune befalls those who cross its path under a full moon.

entry: 天空晴朗、星星可见时，POKENAME的花开放，彻夜起舞。早晨精疲力尽，通常睡一整天。
author: .jerden
source: If the sky is clear and the stars are visible, POKENAME's flowers will open, and it will dance all night. By morning, it is exhausted and usually sleeps all day.

entry: POKENAME身体娇弱，若挨上猛烈攻击，就会整个融化。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME's body is delicate. If hit by a strong attack, it'll melt.

entry: POKENAME爱玩又害羞，总隔着一段距离，跟在训练家与宝可梦身后。只须招招手，它就飘过来。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME is playful but shy, following behind Trainers and Pokémon at a distance. It'll float over when beckoned.

entry: POKENAME如流星穿空，身后闪光点点。它寻找皮皮群，背起来，让它们享受星月下的飞行。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME zips through the air like a shooting star, sparkles trailing behind it. It seeks out groups of Clefairy to carry on its back, letting them enjoy flying beneath the moon and stars.

entry: 代欧奇希斯的身体成了机甲，供皮宝宝用意念操纵。尽管年幼、经验不足，皮宝宝仍驾驶得优雅自如。
author: hophoppip
source: The Deoxys's body has become a mech suit for Cleffa to control with its mind. Despite its youth and inexperience, Cleffa pilots the machine with grace.

entry: POKENAME每夜都钻地睡觉，唯独满月不肯，反而睁大眼睛，眨也不眨地望天。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows underground to sleep every night, except on full moons. On those nights, it refuses to burrow and instead watches the sky with wide, unblinking eyes.

entry: POKENAME天生与群星相通，常看天空，琢磨这天能不能尽情玩。它也出奇敏捷，一跃能达到成年暴鲤龙的高度。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME is naturally attuned to the stars, often watching the skies to mull over if it's going to be a day full of play or not. It is also surprisingly agile, leaping up the height of a full-grown Gyarados.

entry: POKENAME爱玩，别人抛接游戏时，喜欢唱歌作伴。满月夜，会找同类在月下和声。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are playful creatures that love to sing for others while they play catch. On nights of the full moon, they find others of their kin to sing in harmony under the moonlight.

entry: POKENAME的大嘴能张得比身体还宽。据说里面能看见星星，不过尚未证实。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a large set of jaws that can open wider than its body. It is said that a person can see stars within its open mouth, but this has yet to be confirmed.

entry: POKENAME开心吃油，给体内火焰添燃料，保持明亮。若不经常补充，火就变暗，身体也冷得懒动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME consumes oil with delight, using it as fuel to keep its internal flame burning brightly. Without regular intake, its fire dims, making it sluggish and cold.

entry: POKENAME看见流星就释放甜香。据说吸入者日后会极其幸运。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a sweet aroma when it sees a shooting star. Those who breathe in its scent are believed to become extremely lucky later in life.

entry: POKENAME爱用耳朵的绒尖挠痒逗人。若一整天大多时间都兴奋竖耳，就表示夜里将有流星划过。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME delights in tickling others with the fluffy tips of its ears. When its ears excitedly perk straight up for most of the day, that means a shooting star will pass through the sky at night.

entry: POKENAME看见蘑菇就毫不犹豫地吃，尤其爱毒蘑菇。虽是妖精属性，却不受蘑菇毒性的伤害。
author: teatedtiten
source: POKENAME will eat any mushrooms they find without second thought, especially Poison Mushrooms. Though being a Fairy-type Pokémon, they are unaffected by the mushroom's venomous sting.

entry: POKENAME喜欢沙暴中旅行，借旋风掩护，悄然移动，避开潜在威胁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers traveling during sandstorms, using the swirling winds as cover. This behavior allows it to move unseen and avoid potential threats.

entry: POKENAME在湿地乱飞，以难预测的动作迷惑捕食者。行动敏捷，浓雾也难不住它辨路。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies erratically through marshlands, using its unpredictable movements to confuse predators. Navigating through dense fog is no challenge for this agile Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME偷粗心旅人的珠宝，藏进秘密洞穴。日积月累，藏品常堪比寻宝人的收获。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME steals jewelry from careless travelers, stashing it away in secret caves. Its hoard grows over time, often rivaling that of treasure hunters.

entry: POKENAME先冻食物再吃，喜欢冰冻后的爽脆口感。其他宝可梦常惊奇地看它享用冰食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME freezes its food before eating, preferring the crisp texture of frozen meals. Other Pokémon often watch in amazement as it enjoys frozen treats.

entry: POKENAME头里嵌着形似月之石的叶片。若有宝可梦扯叶，它就发出刺耳尖叫。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has leaves that resemble Moon Stones embedded in its head. Whenever a Pokémon tugs on these leaves, they let out an ear-piercing cry.

entry: 它无忧无虑地跑，尽力传播幸福快乐。可惜实在太臭，欢乐举动反而被视为扰人，让POKENAME很沮丧。
author: porterofgames
source: It runs around without a care in the world, spreading happiness and joy wherever it can. Unfortunately, it absolutely reeks, so its acts of joy are seen more as a nuisance, leaving POKENAME dejected.

entry: POKENAME游荡在陨石坠落处。每到新地点，就吸收陨石矿物，角逐渐充实，最终形成硬壳，围住头中涌出的宇宙能量。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are found wandering the sites of fallen meteorites. Each time these Pokémon visit a new one, they absorb the minerals inside, gradually filling out their horns until they form a hard shell around the cosmic energy flowing from their heads.

entry: POKENAME因力量太强，被囚禁冰中。人们怕它一逃，就凭压倒性的可爱，给世界带来混乱。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME is imprisoned in ice because its powers are too great.  It is feared that if it ever escaped, it would use its overwhelming cuteness to inflict chaos on the world.

entry: POKENAME月光下兴奋，像螃蟹般爬来爬去。奇怪的是，背上蘑菇经过长久岁月，有时会钙化成月之石。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME gets excitable in moonlight, and scuttles around like a crab. Curiously, its back mushrooms sometimes calcify and become Moon Stones after long periods of time.

entry: POKENAME鼻子极敏感，能在天气变化前察觉，是可靠的风暴预报伙伴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's nose is so sensitive it can detect changes in the weather before they happen. This ability makes it a reliable companion for predicting storms.

entry: 月夜，POKENAME常在山间寻找亮石，装饰毛发。
author: melodydelune
source: On moonlit nights, POKENAME can be found along mountains searching for shiny rocks to decorate their fur.

entry: POKENAME聚在山顶沐浴月光。据说满月时见到这景象，会获美梦的祝福。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME gathers at the peaks of mountains to bask in moonlight. Those who witness this sight when the moon is full are believed to be blessed with pleasant dreams.

entry: 新月时，POKENAME的蘑菇漏出奇特的切达奶酪香液，城都各地用来调鸡尾酒。前一天吃得越多，液体就产得越多。
author: .izik
source: During new moons, POKENAME's mushroom leaks a peculiar cheddar-scented fluid used in cocktails throughout the Johto region. The more it eats the day before, the more fluid it produces.

entry: 满月下，POKENAME身上的褐石泛纯白光。直晒月光越久，便越亮。
author: .izik
source: The brown stones on POKENAME's body glow a pure white under a full moon. The glow intensifies the longer it remains in direct moonlight.

entry: POKENAME胆小，不过信任人类后，可能允许对方尝尝自己产的美味奶油。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is a timid Pokémon, but once it gains the trust of a human, it may allow them to taste the delicious cream it produces.

entry: POKENAME很受婴儿欢迎，柔软闪烁的尾巴，摸着只有微温，恰能哄他们安稳入睡。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME is popular with infants, as its soft twinkling tail helps lull them to sleep, and is only warm to the touch.

entry: 据说POKENAME尾上星云散出的热，与核聚变有关。可惜，它稀有，又只住在最难抵达的山上，研究很少。
author: .realthree
source: It is thought that the heat that radiates from the nebula on POKENAME's tail is linked to nuclear fusion. Unfortunately, it's poorly-studied, as this rare Pokémon only lives on the most inaccessible of mountains.

entry: POKENAME寻找、挖出埋藏陨石，在周围掘出大坑。虽然方便研究者，却有时让人误以为陨石刚落下。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will seek out and unearth buried meteorites, digging out large craters around them. While this can be useful to researchers, it is sometimes mistakenly thought that the meteorite has recently fallen.

entry: POKENAME偷毫无戒心者的硬币，藏进隐秘洞穴。囤得多了，常足以引来寻宝者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME steals coins from unsuspecting victims, stashing them in hidden caves. This hoard often grows large enough to attract treasure hunters.

entry: POKENAME格外亲近太空岩石，轻易就能用超能力举起。满月夜，群体起舞，这些岩石便排列成星座般的图案浮起。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a particular affinity with rocks from outer space and can easily lift these rocks with their psychic powers. During nights of the full moon, these rocks float in constellation patterns as groups of POKENAME dance.

entry: POKENAME爱闹着打，谁靠近都轻轻挥拳，无意留下长久伤害。满月时自制力变弱，可能误伤想一起玩的伙伴。
author: sk372
source: Playfully combative, POKENAME throws weak punches at anyone who draws near, not intending to cause any lasting harm. During the full moon, it loses a bit of self-control and may accidentally hurt those it wants to play with.

entry: POKENAME在地下湖安家，轻松游过暗水。隐秘住处让它避开捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its home in underground lakes, swimming through the dark waters with ease. These hidden habitats provide it with safety from predators.

entry: 满月之夜，POKENAME从湖中出来，在岸上聚集，彼此牵手，跳起螺旋状的舞。每只轮流从外侧起舞，一直跳到螺旋中心。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME emerge from lakes on the night of the full moon, gathering on the shore and linking hands with one another. They dance in a spiral pattern, each POKENAME taking a turn to start from the outside and dance to the centre of the spiral.

entry: 满月夜，POKENAME整夜不睡，在空中摇摆，唱神秘旋律。可庆祝后容易累坏，第二天余下时间都睡过去。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: On nights of a full moon, POKENAME stay awake all night to sway in the air and sing mystical melodies. Unfortunately, they tend to get worn out easily after these celebrations, leading to them sleeping through the rest of the next day.

entry: POKENAME举止可爱，让人以为友善温顺，直到倒霉的训练家挨上四臂没完没了的连拳。
author: actliux
source: Given its cute demeanor, one would assume a POKENAME would be friendly and docile. Until that is, hapless Trainers finds themselves in a relentless barrage of punches from its four arms.

entry: 一只小皮宝宝操控主体，遇险或潜水时，周围会形成保护层。POKENAME没有敌意，大多时间在陆上用长触手当腿，四处跳舞。
author: sk372
source: A small Cleffa controls the main body, a protective layer forming over it when in danger or diving underwater. POKENAME is non-hostile, and spends much of its time dancing about on land, its long tentacles acting as legs.

entry: POKENAME大把嚼宝石，享受酥脆口感。珠宝商常哀叹它的胃口，因为店会被吃得一片狼藉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME munches on gems by the handful, savoring their crunch. Jewelers often lament its appetite, as it leaves their stores in disarray.

entry: POKENAME闪耀的鬃毛不停流转，宛如彗尾。据说看见它满月下驰过陡山，会获好运祝福。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's shimmering mane perpetually flows and swirls like the trail of a comet. Those who see it gallop across steep mountains under the light of the full moon are said to be blessed with good luck.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME不肯把尾巴浸水，反而朝天举数小时，像在等看不见的东西。
author: .izik
source: During a full moon, POKENAME refuses to dip its tail in water. Instead, it lifts its tail to the sky for hours, as if waiting for something unseen.

entry: POKENAME看似弱小，吸引力却很强，还能放出电磁场，阻止敌人靠近。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME seems weak, but it has strong powers of attraction and can generate electric magnetic fields to keep enemies away.

entry: POKENAME突然现身，吓店主一跳，再偷糖溜走。顽皮举动既麻烦，又有点惹人喜爱。
author: .izik
source: By scaring shopkeepers with sudden appearances, POKENAME sneaks away with candy. These mischievous antics make it both troublesome and oddly endearing.

entry: POKENAME饿了就烦躁难管，常退到地下深处。训练家很快便学会带零食，免得它闹脾气。
author: .izik
source: When hungry, POKENAME becomes cranky and difficult to manage, often retreating deep underground. Trainers quickly learn to carry snacks to avoid its tantrums.

entry: POKENAME爱玩又有耐心，很受孩子们欢迎。科学家认为，背上的奇特突起可能是成长关键。
author: kianjp2008
source: POKENAME is a popular companion among children due to its playful and patient nature. Scientists believe the peculiar protrusion on its back may be the key to its growth.

entry: POKENAME触角的独特气味，似乎每个人闻起来都不同。有人觉得甜香诱人，有人却难以忍受。
author: potatoforged
source: POKENAME releases a unique scent from its antennae that seems to smell different to everyone. Some say it's sweet and inviting, while others find it unbearable.

entry: POKENAME大小形状像极了精灵球，身体却柔软灵活，弹性十足。
author: smashbear
source: Though POKENAME's size and shape bear an uncanny resemblance to a Poké Ball, its soft and pliable body is very bouncy.

entry: POKENAME电力大增，却是在不懂友爱的情况下进化。它们容易兴奋，也容易爆炸。
author: smashbear
source: POKENAME have gained much electrical power, but they evolved without  knowing friendship. They are known to get excited and explode easily.

entry: POKENAME的骨面具与骨棒常让人害怕，其实身体脆弱，脾气也急。不开心就大闹，把骨棒猛砸地面。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are often seen as scary because of their boney mask and club, but they are fragile creatures that have a short temper. If they get upset, they throw a massive tantrum and slam their club against the ground.

entry: POKENAME壳硬如钢，里面却仍柔软轻巧。它无法主动移动，只能漫无目的地沿地翻滚，直到终于进化。
author: potatoforged
source: POKENAME's shell is as hard as steel, but inside it's still soft and light. Unable to move by itself, it tumbles aimlessly along the ground until it finally evolves.

entry: POKENAME温顺，喜欢珊瑚礁。它短短哼鸣来交流，遇捕食者就喷黑墨，趁机逃走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are docile creatures that enjoy living in coral reefs. To communicate, POKENAME hum for short periods of time. If confronted with a predator, they spray out black ink before making their escape.

entry: 它从花到花轻飘，每处花蜜都涂上皮肤。发现大片花丛，便唱歌通知其他POKENAME位置。
author: potatoforged
source: It floats gently from flower to flower, coating its skin with nectar from each one. When it finds a large patch of flowers, it sings to signal the location to other POKENAME.

entry: 许多歌手因POKENAME的投入与初露的才华而收养它。身体中央的宝石能扩音，远处也听得清。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many singers adopt POKENAME because of their dedication and budding talent. The gem at the center of their body allows them to amplify their voice so that it can be heard clearly from quite a distance.

entry: 唱歌受扰，POKENAME会朝打断者吐黏丝，再接着唱，一个音也不错过。
author: .izik
source: If interrupted while singing, POKENAME will spit a sticky silk thread at the offender. It then resumes its song without missing a note.

entry: POKENAME身体弹性惊人，碰到任何表面都能弹开，几乎不损失冲势。一旦弹起来，几乎停不住。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is incredibly elastic, allowing it to bounce off any surface. It barely loses any momentum while bouncing, making it almost impossible to stop once it gets going.

entry: POKENAME看着蓬松，整个身体都软软弹弹，像橡胶。它很爱被两人像抛接球般来回扔着玩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body appears fluffy, but is entirely soft and pliable, bouncy like rubber. It actively enjoys playing by being thrown from one person to another like a game of catch.

entry: POKENAME身体柔软有弹性，碰什么都能弹回。最爱电脑使用者用光标拖住、甩出，让它无伤地弹遍屏幕。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's soft and bouncy body lets it rebound off of anything it collides with. Its favorite way to play is to have a computer user drag it and fling it with a cursor, causing it to bounce harmlessly all about the screen.

entry: POKENAME的茧是身体数倍大，里面宽敞舒服。捕食者常打中空处，也为它争取额外逃跑时间。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cocoon is several times the size of its own body. This gives it ample room to get comfortable, while also providing extra time to escape, as predators often strike at empty sections of the cocoon.

entry: POKENAME身体极柔韧，住在崎岖地形里，钻进其他宝可梦进不去的窄缝。夜里彼此唱和，听着像大地在歌唱，十分诡异。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A Pokémon with a highly pliable body, POKENAME lives in very rugged terrain and makes its home amongst tight cracks that are inaccessible to other Pokémon. At night they sing to one another, creating an eerie illusion that the ground is singing.

entry: POKENAME鼓身飘过群山，边走边哼。许多人说，欢快哼声传数英里，被视为登山平安的征兆。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME inflates its body while floating through mountains, humming as it travels. Many claim its jovial humming can be heard for miles and is regarded as a sign of a safe climb.

entry: POKENAME醒着大多时间都练飞。风很容易吹走它，必须苦练才能掌握。不练飞时，多半就在练习歌唱般的啁啾。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME spends much of its waking hours practicing its flight. As the wind can easily blow it away, it must train very hard to achieve mastery. When it is not practicing flight, it is likely practicing its ability to chirp in a sing-song manner.

entry: POKENAME不飞时，会按特定间隔上下跳。若听见节拍稳定的歌，就跟着跳。
author: bobosmith01
source: When not flying, POKENAME hops up and down in distinct intervals. If it hears a song that has a steady beat, it will hop along with it.

entry: POKENAME爱为朋友办小音乐会，向愿听者唱欢快高音。压轴时，会在头顶放一小阵彩色火花雨。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME likes to put on small concerts for its friends, singing chipper high-pitched songs to all who would listen. It creates a small shower of colorful sparks above it for the finale.

entry: 月亮渐圆时，POKENAME开始唱，声音轻柔哀伤。据说，连最铁石心肠者也会听哭。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME begins to sing when it sees a waxing moon, its voice soft and sorrowful. The song is said to bring even those with the hardest hearts to tears.

entry: POKENAME比未融合的宝宝丁更有弹性与浮力，从任何高度落下都不受伤。它爱弹跳，能一跃高过楼房。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have far more rubbery and buoyant bodies than unfused Igglybuff. They can fall any distance without harm. They enjoy bouncing around and can be seen bounding high over buildings.

entry: POKENAME哼欢快旋律，让身边所有生灵振奋。阳光明媚的午后，常能听见。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hums a cheerful melody that lifts the spirits of everyone nearby. Its songs are often heard during sunny afternoons.

entry: POKENAME不停哔哔、啁啾，似乎毫无规律。它常从树上掉下，落地弹起，毫发无伤。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME constantly beeps and chirps, seemingly at random. It's often seen falling out of trees, bouncing unharmed when it lands.

entry: POKENAME身体轻，不需大翼也能飞。不过有些科学家认为，更该称作悬浮。
author: alexa09_music
source: Due to its light weight, POKENAME doesn't need large wings to fly, though some scientists argue it should be considered more like a hover.

entry: POKENAME随春风轻飘，独自轻哼。空灵歌声常被误认为风穿林的声音。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats gently on spring winds, humming softly to itself. Its airy voice is often mistaken for the sound of breeze through trees.

entry: POKENAME靠弹性身体跳进垃圾箱觅食。找到好吃的，就边啃边开心哼唱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its springy body to bounce into dumpsters in search of food. When it finds something tasty, it hums happily while nibbling away.

entry: POKENAME在苋草丛休息，唱轻快曲调。据说旋律能让附近植物长得更快。
author: .izik
source: While resting in amaranth patches, POKENAME sings a lively tune. Its melody is said to encourage nearby plants to grow faster.

entry: 许多父母按旧迷信，在第二个孩子两岁生日时送一只POKENAME。它毛软性温，是幼童的好伙伴，还很会教游泳。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Many parents gift their second child an POKENAME on their second birthday due to old superstition. With its soft fur and a gentle temperament, it is a perfect companion for young children, and it is also great at teaching them to swim.

entry: POKENAME知识很少，却极易受影响，学行为很快。人们建议，只有老练训练家才选它作伙伴。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME have very limited knowledge but are extremely impressionable and learn behaviors very quickly. It is recommended that only seasoned Trainers take on an POKENAME as a partner.

entry: POKENAME每早用欢快的歌迎接新一天。唱到一半受扰，就愤怒爆炸，四周烧得焦黑。
author: .izik
source: Each morning, POKENAME greets the day with a cheerful song. If interrupted mid-verse, it explodes in rage, leaving behind scorched surroundings.

entry: POKENAME学飞很吃力，会有热心的胖蝎王守着，直到学会。它用爪子整齐剪下树果。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME struggles learning to fly but is watched over by a helpful Wigglycor until it becomes successful. It uses its claws to clip berries neatly from the plant.

entry: 谁打断POKENAME的晨歌，就会挨愤怒尖叫。越不理它，声音越刺耳。
author: .izik
source: Anyone who interrupts POKENAME's morning song is met with angry squawks. Its voice grows shriller the longer it's ignored.

entry: POKENAME看似纤细，身体却柔软有弹性。学爬树时常摔下，训练家有时能见到幼崽在林地无助地弹来弹去。
author: cait_sith
source: Despite their slender appearance, POKENAME have a very bouncy and squishy body. POKENAME often fall when they learn to climb trees, so Trainers will sometimes spot young POKENAME bouncing helplessly across the forest floor.

entry: POKENAME毛软又可爱，很受年轻女子欢迎。野外能见到它练唱。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's soft fur and adorable appearance makes it popular among young women. In the wild, it is seen practicing its singing.

entry: POKENAME体温高得难受，烫得根本不能徒手碰。身体如熔融橡胶，摸着黏；研究者推测，这让接触更易造成烫伤。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME maintain an uncomfortably high body temperature and are far too hot to handle with bare hands. They have the consistency of molten rubber and are sticky to the touch; researchers speculate this increases the likelihood of burns when touched.

entry: POKENAME很早就学会用短角冲撞。柔韧身体让同伴能尽情疯玩，摔倒也只是从地上轻弹。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME learn early to ram their targets with their stubby horns. Their pliable bodies let them play very roughly with one another, gently bouncing off the ground when they tumble.

entry: POKENAME身体轻盈，在森林里蹦跳毫不费力。它能深深吸气，将身体鼓胀起来，以更大的体型，试着吓退可能捕食自己的家伙。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's lightweight body makes prancing through the forest a simple task. It can inhale deeply and inflate its body to increase its size in an attempt to scare off others that might prey on it.

entry: POKENAME藏在巷影中，静静研究人类，模仿行为。观察时哼着诡异摇篮曲，似乎只有自己听懂。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lurks in alley shadows, quietly studying humans to mimic their behavior. As it watches, it hums a haunting lullaby only it seems to understand.

entry: POKENAME常由父母送一颗水煮蛋，练习照料本领。等准备好照顾真正的蛋，就把水煮蛋吃掉，多添点力量。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is often given a Boiled Egg by its parents, as the egg helps it practice its skills as a caregiver. When it is ready to move on to a real egg, the Boiled Egg is eaten to give it an extra boost.

entry: POKENAME十分贪吃，不喜欢分享食物。吃了嘉珍果以后，它们会变得好斗，凡是靠近嘴边的东西都会咬。不过事后，又会懊悔得哭起来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are gluttonous creatures that do not enjoy sharing their food. When they are fed a Jaboca Berry, they become aggressive and bite anything that comes near their mouth. They feel so much remorse afterwards that they end up crying.

entry: POKENAME原生于平柑岛，贪玩又爱挖洞。会挖浅穴，在草地和沙滩互相追逐，皮肤触感出奇有弹性。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A playful burrowing Pokémon native to Pinkan Island, POKENAME digs shallow burrows and can be found chasing one another through the grass and along beaches. Its hide is surprisingly springy to the touch.

entry: POKENAME乱挥刀锋般的利爪，毫无协调或危险意识。白天大多睡觉，夜里在林中蹒跚，连捕食者也躲着哭嚎与乱打。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME wildly flails about with its razor-sharp claws, lacking any sense of coordination or danger. It sleeps most of the day and toddles around the forest at night, when even predators avoid its wailing and thrashing.

entry: POKENAME身体软，温暖舒服，喜欢轻唱。有些父母与它交好，请它坐在婴儿身边，柔歌与暖意让孩子几分钟内睡着。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's body is squishy and comfortably warm and it enjoys singing softly. Parents have been known to befriend POKENAME and have it sit near their infant. The gentle singing and warmth help the baby fall asleep within minutes.

entry: POKENAME对周围情绪敏感。唱歌时若感知负面情绪，就焦虑起来，匆匆把歌唱完。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are sensitive to the emotions of those around them. If they sense negative emotions while they are singing, they become anxious and rush through their song.

entry: POKENAME怕别人听见生涩歌喉，独处时才轻声练唱。只有最信任、最爱的训练家，能当它唯一的观众。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME practices singing in a quiet voice when alone, afraid of letting others hear its amateur vocals. It will only allow a truly trusted and beloved Trainer to be its one-person audience.

entry: 危险靠近巢穴，POKENAME就唱轻快的歌，召集伙伴。威胁若再近，皮肤就渗出毒液。
author: .izik
source: When danger nears its nest, POKENAME sings a lively song to rally its allies. If the threat draws closer, it leaks a toxic fluid from its skin.

entry: POKENAME长时间唱歌，鳞片会飞快变换颜色与图案。若与同类分开养，通常自己也不知道这回事。
author: bobosmith01
source: When POKENAME sing for extended periods of time, the color of their scales changes rapidly into varying patterns and hues. It seems POKENAME themselves are not typically aware of this fact if raised apart from their kind.

entry: POKENAME还没学会完全控制磁力悬浮。常能见到它痛苦地不由自主漂走，训练家便用绳系住伙伴，保它安全。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME have yet to learn how to fully control their magnetic levitation. Distressed POKENAME can be found drifting around against their will. Trainers have taken to tying string around their companions to keep them safe.

entry: POKENAME体型虽大，身体却极软、有弹性，去哪里都能跳。背上的树散发淡淡甜香。
author: santon5512
source: Despite their size, POKENAME's body is incredibly soft and bouncy, allowing them to hop wherever they go. The tree on their backs gives off a faintly sweet aroma.

entry: 科学记录称，POKENAME会与头顶的怪器官交谈，仿佛有两重意识。它长出了装甲外壳，保护这个器官。
author: arandomweon123
source: Scientific records state that POKENAME talks with the odd organ on top of its head as if there were two consciousnesses in one species. It has developed an armored shell to protect said organ.

entry: POKENAME除了锐角，全身都软如橡胶。角里有强毒，能麻痹更大的敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has a soft, rubbery body except for its sharp horn. The horn contains potent venom capable of paralyzing larger foes.

entry: POKENAME独自轻哼，在野外寻找需要安慰的宝可梦。若对方拒绝触须的拥抱，它就眼泪汪汪，快哭出来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME softly hums to itself and searches the wild for Pokémon to comfort. If a Pokémon rejects a hug from its feelers, its eyes will water on the verge of tears.

entry: POKENAME大而软的身体轻如气球。它无声飘到孩子背后，用巨大发光眼吓人，再邪气地咯咯笑着消失。
author: milchik
source: Its big squishy body is as light as a balloon. By floating silently in the air, POKENAME sneaks up on children from behind and scares them with its huge glowing eyes before disappearing in a fit of sinister giggles.

entry: POKENAME大而软的身体轻如气球。它无声飘到孩子背后，用巨大发光眼吓人，再邪气地咯咯笑着消失。
author: milchik
source: Its big squishy body is as light as a balloon. By floating silently in the air, POKENAME sneaks up on children from behind and scares them with its huge glowing eyes before disappearing in a fit of sinister giggles.

entry: POKENAME从不离开所坐的金属外骨骼，以保护软绒身体。装甲虽像机器人，却有自己的意识，会用金属爪攻击靠得太近的东西。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME protects its soft plush body by never leaving the metal exoskeleton it sits on top of. Although this armor seems robotic, it has a mind of its own and will use its metal claws to attack anything that gets too close to POKENAME.

entry: 据说POKENAME的玩偶里住着幼童灵魂。它整天陪玩，玩偶若被夺走，就会陷入绝望。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's dolls are said to be inhabited by the souls of young children. It plays with them all day and falls into despair if the dolls are taken away.

entry: POKENAME一入侵设备安家，就立刻启动所有能启动的东西，制造声音。给它足够时间，杂音就能变成一首还算像样的歌。
author: soup1900
source: As soon as an POKENAME infiltrates and inhabits a device, it immediately starts activating everything it can to create sounds. Given enough time, it can improve the random sounds into a somewhat decent musical song.

entry: POKENAME飞得快，也有些好斗，却不太危险。身体软如橡胶，冲撞什么，通常也只是无伤地弹回来。
author: sk372
source: Although POKENAME flies at high speeds and has some aggressive tendencies, it is not much of a danger to others. Its soft and rubbery body means that typically when it charges into something, it tends to rebound harmlessly on impact.

entry: POKENAME轻唱摇篮曲，哄敌人睡。一犯困，就突然来一记旋身踢。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sings a soft lullaby to lull opponents to sleep. Once they're drowsy, it strikes with a sudden spinning kick.

entry: POKENAME摇篮曲轻柔笨拙，常先把自己唱睡。野生群体在草地一同弹跳，月下唱到一半便入梦。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's lullabies are soft and clumsy, often putting itself to sleep before anyone else. Wild groups bounce together in meadows, drifting off mid-song under the moonlight.

entry: POKENAME身体柔软，歌声又未发育好，难以自行觅食。只能靠可爱向人讨点心，或接受老练长辈留下的食物。
author: elfail0
source: Its soft, rubbery body and underdeveloped singing voice make it very difficult for POKENAME to forage for food. As such, it must feed itself by charming humans with its cuteness for treats or by accepting scraps from its more skilled elders.

entry: POKENAME神情天真，让其他宝可梦不忍攻击。它们互唱简单摇篮曲度夜，让傍晚的空气里充满歌声。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a youthful innocence to their expression that keeps other Pokémon from wanting to attack them. They sing simple lullabies to one another to pass the night, filling the early evening air with their songs.

entry: 晴朗明媚的日子，POKENAME边晒暖阳边唱欢快曲调。开满花的草地边，常能听见。
author: .izik
source: On bright, sunny days, POKENAME sings a cheerful tune while basking in the warmth. Its melodies are often heard near flower-covered meadows.

entry: POKENAME爱埋进湿润茂林的软烂土里。它一路吃出地面，再高兴地唱歌，感谢这一餐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME likes to bury itself in the soft and mushy soil in moist, lush forests. It eats its way out of the ground, and then sings in delightful appreciation of its meal.

entry: POKENAME烦躁时，会散出甜甜的泡泡糖香。喜欢这味的训练家时不时戳一下，惹它产香，却不造成实际伤害。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME emits a sweet, bubblegum-like scent when agitated. Trainers who are fond of the scent may poke it intermittently, which irritates it enough to make it produce the fragrance without causing any real harm.

entry: 常能听见成群POKENAME唱歌，借回声定位猎物。声带脆弱，因此轮流唱，让其他同伴休息。
author: santon5512
source: Groups of POKENAME can often be heard singing as a form of echolocation, locating prey. Due to their fragile vocal cords, these Pokémon take turns singing, giving the others a break.

entry: POKENAME身体极软，碰撞时能缓冲。羽毛比丝更软，许多工匠与收藏家都珍视。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have incredibly soft bodies, which dampen the impact whenever they might crash. Their feathers are softer than silk, so many craftsmen and collectors treasure them.

entry: POKENAME极贪玩，会追着交到的朋友，想送出自己的红宝石。若送给你，你就会永远是它最好的朋友。
author: mistymagius
source: Extremely playful Pokémon, POKENAME will pursue anyone they befriend trying to give them one of its red gemstones. If it gives you one, you will become its best friend for the rest of time.

entry: POKENAME去哪都滚，却常把自己弄得晕头转向。滚下山坡太快时，就能听见求救。
author: quackquackattack
