source: POKENAME roll wherever they go, but this can be quite disorienting for them. Their cries for help can be heard whenever they roll down a hill too fast.

entry: POKENAME唯一的防御手段，是将空气吸入体内，鼓起身体，变成更深的红色，吓退对方。它无法长时间憋气，便藏在高草丛里，尽量少用这招。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's only method of defense is to inflate its body with air, turning a deeper red to scare off others. It cannot hold its breath for long, so it hides in taller grass to limit its need to use this technique.

entry: 捕食者靠近巢，POKENAME就跳芭蕾般的舞。旋转间唱出愤怒歌声，震晕入侵者。
author: .izik
source: When predators approach its nest, POKENAME performs a ballet-esque dance. As it twirls, it unleashes an angry song that stuns intruders.

entry: POKENAME随节奏舞动，橡胶般的双臂挥出流畅弧线。轻柔动作常用来安抚其他生物。
author: .izik
source: While dancing in rhythm, POKENAME swings its rubbery arms in smooth arcs. Its gentle movements are often used to lull others into calm.

entry: POKENAME蓬松的翅膀，闻着、吃着都像棉花糖。坐在人头顶时，唱歌会更有自信。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's fluffy wings have a sweet smell and taste of marshmallows. It gains more confidence to sing when sitting atop someone's head.

entry: POKENAME身体极柔韧，能惊人地压缩、伸展。它爱被抱，孩子很喜欢，常搂着一起上床睡。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have very pliable bodies, able to compress and stretch to an impressive degree. They are popular Pokémon for young children as they enjoy being held, making them popular to cuddle up with for bed.

entry: POKENAME用柔软灵活的身体扭进猎物的洞穴。
author: mx_wellman
source: POKENAME has a soft and pliable body, which it uses to contort its way into the dens and burrows of its prey.

entry: POKENAME靠弹性身体跳上树梢，吃新鲜细枝。钳太软，无法自卫，遇捕食者也靠弹跳逃跑。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME uses its springy body to bounce into the treetops and eat fresh twigs. Because it cannot defend itself with its soft pincers, it also bounces away from predators.

entry: 遇险时，POKENAME躲进背上蘑菇状结构的下方。它软韧得什么碰上都弹开，摸着、闻着都像一大块棉花糖。
author: imaginita
source: When in danger, POKENAME will hide under the mushroom-like structure on its back, which is so soft and pliable that everything bounces off of it. It feels and smells like a big marshmallow.

entry: POKENAME弹性身体吸收冲击，转成动能，出奇耐打。存下的能量又转成热，供它产生、喷吐火焰。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have an elastic body that absorbs impacts and turns them into kinetic energy, making them surprisingly durable. They convert the stored energy into heat, enabling them to breath and produce fire.

entry: POKENAME大群游泳，用啁啾与歌曲协调。潜水者发现，每群歌曲都独特，让它们分清自己与其他群体。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Swimming in large shoals, POKENAME coordinate their shoals with chirps and songs. Divers have found that the songs each shoal makes are unique, allowing them to differentiate between their own shoal and those of other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME一察觉危险，就把头鼓到身体的三倍大，飘飞逃走。熟悉了、安心了，它又会十分亲人。
author: chorb33
source: If POKENAME senses danger, it blows its head up to three times its body size to fly away. Once it has gained confidence, it is very affectionate.

entry: POKENAME住在森林高处的树冠，靠长臂在枝间荡行。若没抓稳，柔软弹性的身体也能保护它不受伤。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lives high in the canopy of forests, swinging between branches with its elongated arms. If it does miss a branch, its soft and rubbery body prevents it from injuring itself.

entry: POKENAME一唱歌，身体力量就翻倍。节奏到最高潮时，一记踢倒就能踢翻卡车。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME sings, its physical strength doubles. A single Low Kick can topple a truck when it reaches peak rhythm.

entry: POKENAME遇险，就会边大声哭，边往外游。可惜，哭声反而引来，更多的注意。
author: chorb33
source: If POKENAME is in danger, it swims away crying loudly, which unfortunately attracts even more attention.

entry: POKENAME在洞壁间弹跳，每撞一次便开心尖叫。却很少唱歌，因为一听自己的声音在洞里回荡，就害羞了。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME bounces around the walls of caves, letting out delighted squeaks each time it impacts a wall. It rarely sings because it becomes shy as soon as it hears its own voice begin echoing in its cavernous habitat.

entry: POKENAME遇到新朋友，会兴奋地抬起前蹄。身体软而有弹性，背上乘客如坐软垫。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME show their excitement when meeting a new friend by raising their front hooves off the ground. Their soft, elastic body offers a soft cushion to whoever rides on their back.

entry: POKENAME遇险，就会边大声哭，边往外游。可惜，哭声反而引来，更多的注意。
author: chorb33
source: If POKENAME is in danger, it swims away crying loudly, which unfortunately attracts even more attention.

entry: POKENAME背有硬壳，腹部柔软。若肯让你摸肚子，便是极信任的表现。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a hard shell that protects their back and a soft underbelly. If they allow you to pet their stomachs, it is a sign of great trust.

entry: POKENAME身体极软，几乎全是空气，能随风漂。所产气体有淡甜香，常用来制香水。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's bodies are incredibly soft and almost entirely filled with air, allowing them to drift in the wind. The gas they produce is often used in perfume due to its faintly sweet aroma.

entry: POKENAME能鼓大双手，显得更吓人。不过只是虚张声势，钳太软，哪怕放大也不适合打击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can inflate its hands in order to appear more intimidating to others. It's only a scare tactic, however; its claws are far too soft to be effective as striking weapons, even when oversized.

entry: POKENAME鳞茎里长出蛋黄般的种子，据说吃下就能纯粹快乐整整一个月。它几乎对谁都好，却只把种子交给深深信任的对象。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME grows a yolk-like seed inside of its bulb, and anyone who eats it is said to be granted pure happiness for a full month. Despite being kind to just about everyone, POKENAME will only give its seed to those it deeply trusts.

entry: 据说衣服只要织进一根POKENAME的丝，就能给训练家带来战斗好运。可它胆小，很难取得丝。
author: aster_oid1701
source: It is believed that wearing clothing weaved with just one strand of silk spun by POKENAME gives trainers good fortune in battles. Due to its rather timid nature, getting thread can prove difficult.

entry: POKENAME极爱社交，情感依赖强。连孵化中的蛋，都常滚到彼此身边寻求安慰。
author: metcassette
source: POKENAME are extremely sociable and emotionally dependent. Even during incubation, their eggs have a tendency to roll close to each other for comfort.

entry: POKENAME拖着死去波克基斯的遗骨，只有躺在旧骨旁才能安睡。有人认为灵魂仍在，睡时给它一点安慰。
author: sk372
source: It drags along the remaining bones of a fallen Togekiss with it and can only sleep soundly while laying near the old bones. Some think the Togekiss spirit still lingers and grants POKENAME small comforts during sleep.

entry: POKENAME骨骼柔软可弯，双腿格外灵活，善于吸收冲击。它很笨拙，常摔倒，长腿朝天乱踢，试着翻身。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME's bones are soft and malleable, making its legs extra flexible and better at absorbing impact. They are rather clumsy Pokémon that often fall over, leaving their long legs kicking in the air as they try to right themselves.

entry: POKENAME爱蛋味，凡是蛋料理都能吸下肚。吃得太多，连唾液的质地、气味都像蛋黄。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME adores the taste of eggs, slurping up any egg-based dishes it can. It consumes so much, even its saliva has taken a consistency and odor similar to that of egg yolk.

entry: POKENAME全身怪纹似能阻吓捕食者，让它安心在茧中成长。据说饲养它，会让照顾者感到舒适快乐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are covered in odd patterns that seem to deter predators, allowing them to peacefully develop inside their cocoon. It is said that raising one will spark feelings of comfort and joy in the caregiver.

entry: 虽然大小不相称，基因检测证实，POKENAME确实从所住的蛋孵出。它在蛋内奔跑，就能出奇灵巧地移动。
author: staghorn
source: Despite the size difference, genetic testing confirms that the POKENAME hatched from the egg it lives in. By running around the inside of the egg, it can move about with surprising deftness.

entry: POKENAME虽弱，体内却有危险毒素。毒让人放松愉快，可若不治疗，几小时内便能让孩子丧命。
author: musicsheep.
source: Despite being weak, POKENAME carries a dangerous toxin inside of it. The toxin causes relaxing, nice feelings, but it can be fatal to a child within hours if not treated.

entry: POKENAME害怕不确定，缩在壳里，因为深信只有壳永不改变。它也把最快乐的感情存进壳，因而容易进化出仙子伊布的形态。
author: yourfriendhare
source: The fear of uncertainty frightens POKENAME, to the point it stays in its shell as it knows it's the only thing that'd never change. POKENAME also stores its happiest feelings in its shell, making them prone to evolving into a form of Sylveon.

entry: 普遍被认为是古代化石宝可梦的现代后裔。保留许多原始特征，尤其缺乏完善鱼鳔，因此水中平衡很差。
author: katieplaysgames
source: This marine Pokémon is widely considered to be the modern descendant of an ancient fossil Pokémon. It retains many primordial traits, most notably it lacks a proper swim bladder which leaves it with a poor sense of balance in the water.

entry: 普遍被认为是古代化石宝可梦的现代后裔。保留许多原始特征，尤其缺乏完善鱼鳔，因此水中平衡很差。
author: katieplaysgames
source: This marine Pokémon is widely considered to be the modern descendant of an ancient fossil Pokémon. It retains many primordial traits, most notably it lacks a proper swim bladder which leaves it with a poor sense of balance in the water.

entry: POKENAME挂树时，别站下方。它可能掉下来误撞下面的人，连自己也会受伤。
author: musicsheep.
source: One should be careful not to stand beneath POKENAME while it hangs from a tree. It may fall and accidentally strike those below—an accident that also hurts POKENAME itself.

entry: POKENAME一孵化就活泼独立，身体却软而脆弱。为自保，会随身带着残余蛋壳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are active and independent as soon as they hatch, though they have very soft and vulnerable bodies. To help protect themselves, they carry the remains of their eggshell with them.

entry: POKENAME一孵化就活泼独立，身体却软而脆弱。为自保，会随身带着残余蛋壳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are active and independent as soon as they hatch, though they have very soft and vulnerable bodies. To help protect themselves, they carry the remains of their eggshell with them.

entry: POKENAME一孵化就活泼独立，身体却软而脆弱。为自保，会随身带着残余蛋壳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are active and independent as soon as they hatch, though they have very soft and vulnerable bodies. To help protect themselves, they carry the remains of their eggshell with them.

entry: POKENAME极弱小脆弱，平常的毒针一用便会碎，只好改用柔软的后方毒针攻击。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME is extremely weak and frail. It uses its soft hind stinger to attack, since using its normal stingers would cause them to break apart.

entry: POKENAME极罕见，有人说，连最纯洁温柔的心灵，也未必配见它。古时，能与它作伴者，被视为王室甚至神明的后裔。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is such a rare sight that some say even the purest and gentlest of soul may not be worthy of its appearance. In ancient times, those who managed to have one as a partner were considered descendants of royalty or even divinity.

entry: POKENAME身上迸出的蛋壳碎片，可像子弹般致命。它自己与急着玩耍的训练家都不懂，已酿成许多悲剧。
author: anonymous_16803
source: The eggshell fragments that burst forth from its body can be as deadly as bullets. Ignorance on this point on the part of both POKENAME and Pokémon Trainers eager to play with them has led to more than its fair share of tragedies.

entry: POKENAME心地纯洁、精力无穷，却不懂双颚有多强。跟训练家玩着轻咬，也可能造成重伤。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME has a pure heart and endless energy. That being said, it doesn't understand how powerful its jaws are and can cause serious injury when it playfully nips at its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME有些娇纵。野外会侵入巢穴，躺在蛋旁，坚持要双亲像宠亲生孩子般宠自己。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a bit of a spoiled brat in behavior. In the wild it invades nests and rests next to the eggs, insisting the parents pamper it as if it were their child.

entry: POKENAME飞得笨拙，短翼勉强维持浮空。它很依赖双亲保护养育，会用共感力量促使这样的照料。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are clumsy fliers, their stubby wings only barely able to keep them aloft. They are largely dependent on their parents to protect and nurture them, using empathic powers to encourage this behaviour.

entry: POKENAME角与大颚有强效神经毒，使情绪混乱起伏。奇妙的是，所织丝网恰与之相反，谁碰到都会平静。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's horns and mandibles contain a potent neurotoxin that causes chaotic mood swings. As a surprising counter to their own neurotoxin, the silk webbings they create bring calm to any who touch them.

entry: POKENAME一孵化，就常亲昵地蹭训练家。摩擦产电，因此常不慎把对方电到。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME will often nuzzle their Trainers with affection as soon as they hatch from their eggs. The friction from the nuzzling generates electricity, so they often shock their Trainers by mistake.

entry: 黎明微光中醒着的人，有时能见野生POKENAME在沾露花间欢快跳舞。发现人类看，就会逃走。
author: cobalt0135
source: Those who are awake during the twilight hours of dawn may see wild POKENAME gleefully dancing outside among the dew-covered flowers. They will flee if they spot a human looking at them.

entry: 据说POKENAME从流星雨后落到地球的蛋孵出，有与善良人类分享幸福的神秘本领。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME are said to hatch from Eggs that fall to the planet after meteor showers. They have the mysterious ability to share happiness with kind-hearted people.

entry: POKENAME一阵玩兴上来，就爱跳出蛋壳四处狂奔。累了总想回壳里睡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME likes to leap out of its shell and streak around during bursts of playful hyperactivity. It will always wish to return to its shell and sleep in it once it gets tired.

entry: POKENAME走哪都带着另一片蛋壳，便能缩进完整壳里。遇麻烦时，多一层防御。
author: sk372
source: It carries a second piece of eggshell with it wherever it goes. This lets POKENAME tuck itself into a complete shell, offering it more defense when things get troublesome.

entry: POKENAME看见快乐的人就欢欣鼓舞，在头顶绕完美圆圈飞，撒下闪耀气息，让喜悦更浓。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gets elated when it sees happy humans. It will fly in perfect circles above their heads, spreading a shimmering aura that enhances their joy.

entry: 给POKENAME的蛋涂彩，是一些人庆祝复活节的传统。它虽以蛋闻名，本身也是很好的宠物。
author: dodoowner_
source: Painting POKENAME eggs is a tradition for people who celebrate Easter. Although it's mostly known for its eggs, it also just makes for a good pet.

entry: 每只POKENAME的壳纹都独特，形成于蛋中时周围的情绪。有奢侈品市场专求花纹越少越好的个体，认为这样优雅。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The pattern on every POKENAME's shell is unique, formed from all the emotions around them while they are still in their egg. A luxury market exists for POKENAME with as few markings as possible as they are considered elegant.

entry: 每只POKENAME的壳纹都独特，形成于蛋中时周围的情绪。花纹越多，通常越和善友好。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The pattern on every POKENAME's shell is unique, formed from all the emotions around them while they are still in their egg. POKENAME with more markings are generally more amicable and friendly.

entry: POKENAME出生起就把蛋壳留在头上。虽然一直挡住视线，却总是好心情。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has kept the eggshell on its head since the day it was born. Despite the eggshell permanently blocking its vision, POKENAME always seems to be in a good mood.

entry: POKENAME每月脱一次彩色甲片，好长出新的。据说甲片带来好运，制成的饰品因此颇受欢迎。
author: sk372
source: Once a month, POKENAME sheds the colored plates on its body in order to grow new ones. These plates are said to bring good luck, so accessories made of them are in relatively high demand.

entry: 周围人和宝可梦开心，POKENAME便吸足积极能量，整个早晨啁啾歌唱。下半身的彩纹，每只都独一无二。
author: fiordaliso
source: When surrounded by happy people and Pokémon, POKENAME spends its mornings chirping, filled with the positive energy it has absorbed. The colorful patterns on its lower body are unique to every individual.

entry: POKENAME白色外骨骼满是红蓝花纹。每次蜕去外层，新生内层很快硬化，比以前更强韧。
author: richardcareylol
source: POKENAME's white exoskeleton is covered in red and blue patterns. Every time it sheds its exterior, the fresh undercoat soon hardens to become even stronger than before.

entry: POKENAME一得不到想要的，就大闹。更糟的是，拿到什么也不满意。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME throws absolute tantrums any time it doesn't get what it wants. To make things worse, POKENAME is also never satisfied with what it gets.

entry: POKENAME不会自卫，只坐着哭喊妈妈。虽然照顾麻烦，却给用心养育者带来幸福与安宁。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME does not know how to defend itself and will just sit there and cry for its mother. Despite being a hassle to take care of, it brings happiness and tranquility to those who raise it well.

entry: POKENAME薄薄的石壳受力易碎，表面常有损伤。微毒气体从裂缝逸出，吸入者会感到欣快。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME shells often bear superficial damage, the thin rocky crust prone to breaking apart under force. Mildly toxic gas escapes their shell through these cracks, inducing feelings of euphoria in those that breath it in.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉敏锐，单凭气味便能察觉情绪波动。它挨近悲伤者，亲昵蹭蹭，带来安慰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's sense of smell is so acute that it can detect fluctuations in emotions by scent alone. It sidles up to those that are feeling sad and nuzzles them to bring them some comfort.

entry: POKENAME一孵化就是敏捷的猎手，水柱最远可射出15米。身体柔软，又没有鳞片防护，它们便用旧蛋壳保护自己。
author: katieplaysgames
source: As soon as they hatch, POKENAME are swift predators capable of shooting jets of water up to fifteen meters away. Their bodies are soft and they have no scales for protection, as they use their old egg shells to help protect themselves.

entry: POKENAME身体周围有皮革般的壳，随时间慢慢硬化。长大后，壳变成细小整齐的鳞片。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a leathery shell around their bodies that slowly hardens over time. As they grow, this shell hardens into small, uniform scales.

entry: POKENAME热衷多种武术，年少气盛，常不自量力，试着挑战远超自己本领的敌人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are enthusiastic practitioners of many different kinds of martial arts. In their youthful exuberance, they often overreach and try to fight foes that are far beyond their skill levels.

entry: POKENAME感知到什么散发喜悦或兴奋，就忍不住追着走。父母和训练家都得费大力气，才能防止它老往外跑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME feels a compulsion to follow after anything it senses exuding joy or excitement. POKENAME parents and Trainers alike find themselves working hard to keep it from running off constantly.

entry: 训练家心情低落时，POKENAME会轻轻电一下对方，想让其振作。但它控制电力的本领不够好，常放出多于所需的能量。
author: mistymagius
source: When its Trainer is feeling down, POKENAME will shock them with a small jolt of electricity to get them energized. However, it can't control its electricity that well, often discharging more energy than is necessary.

entry: POKENAME感到附近有笑声或快乐，体内火焰就增强。小火苗在周围跳，仿佛呼应着情绪。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME senses laughter or nearby happiness, its internal flames surge in strength. Flickers of fire can be seen dancing around it as if echoing its emotion.

entry: POKENAME住在热门登山小径下方的浅地洞，靠附近探险者的愉悦宁静茁壮成长。可它极害羞，不肯向别人现身。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME live in small burrows just underground from popular hiking trails. It thrives off the feelings of pleasure and calmness that radiates off of nearby adventurers. Despite this, they are incredibly shy and refuse to show themselves to others.

entry: POKENAME壳拳的力道惊人，每下都能击退防御强的宝可梦。不过身体极脆弱，挨几记像样攻击就会昏厥。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's shell fists hit with surprising force, knocking even strong defensive Pokémon back with each pummelling strike. It is extremely frail however, with only a few decent strikes being enough to make it faint.

entry: 准父母常在迎婴派对上收到一只POKENAME，日后送给孩子。据说，它能给一同长大的孩子带来幸福与好运。
author: alestrius
source: Expecting parents will often receive a POKENAME at their baby shower to give to their child. The POKENAME is said to bring happiness and good fortune to the child it grows up with.

entry: POKENAME友善开朗，爱聚会分享食物。谁给它吃的，它就非得回赠才肯罢休。若有人拒收，会放声大哭。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are friendly and cheerful Pokémon who love to gather and share food with others. If given food, they will not rest until they can gift food in return. If one denies their offering of food, they will loudly cry.

entry: POKENAME罕见，史上经核实的记录也少，据说是喜悦与纯真的化身。见到它，所有攻击欲与负面情绪都会消散。
author: sk372
source: Rarely seen and with few verified records of it in history, POKENAME is said to be the embodiment of joy and innocence itself. Those who gaze upon its form will feel all aggression and negative emotions drain from their minds.

entry: POKENAME出生就蜷成球，防御或焦虑时也摆这姿势。周围的关爱与喜悦，让它茁壮成长。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are born curled up in a ball, a posture they assume to defend themselves and when they feel anxious. They thrive when exposed to the feelings of compassion and joy from others.

entry: POKENAME每月脱落苍白的叶状部分。昆虫与小生物收去筑巢，似乎让巢中养大的幼崽更健康。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sheds the pale leafy parts of its body monthly. Insects and other small creatures will gather the shed leaves to help make nests, which seem to foster better health in young reared within said nests.

entry: POKENAME主要吃儿童游戏网站的数据，不知如何能感受玩家的喜悦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME primarily consumes data from gaming websites meant for children. It somehow senses the joy of those playing on them.

entry: POKENAME是友善天真的森林住客，总想交新朋友。它收集漂亮叶子，分给想结交的对象。
author: sk372
source: A friendly forest denizen, POKENAME is innocent and always trying to make new friends. It gathers up pretty-looking leaves to collect, and shares them with those it hopes to befriend.

entry: POKENAME开朗得让人见了难不笑。与刚孵化的幼年宝可梦同住，能帮它们更平静、不胆怯。
author: hophoppip
source: A cheerful Pokémon that's hard not to smile at. If housed with newly hatched baby Pokémon, POKENAME will help them feel calmer and less timid.

entry: POKENAME很难独立，通常都与父母待在一起。一旦被独自留下，或找不到父母，就会大声哭喊，乱踢乱蹬地闹起脾气。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are usually seen with their parents, as this Pokémon has a hard time being independent. When left or alone or can't find its parents, POKENAME will cry out loudly and throw a kicking temper tantrum.

entry: 据说POKENAME给遇见的善良人一点好运，却把最好的祝福留给训练家：只要它在身旁，主人就永不倒霉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to bestow a minor blessing of luck to anyone it meets with a kind heart. It saves the best blessing for its Trainer, however; owners are said to never have bad luck as long as POKENAME is near.

entry: 乍看POKENAME背上的洞，只见空壳。亲近者却知道，壳里满是浓缩快乐。它慷慨分享，尤其给遭遇失去之痛者格外纯净的一份。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: At first glance, the hole in POKENAME's back reveals only an empty shell. However, those close to it know the shell is filled with concentrated joy. POKENAME shares its stock of joy freely, giving extra-pure portions to those suffering from loss.

entry: POKENAME在水坝隐秘内室里的蛋中孵化。长大过程中，仍把蛋壳留在身边，抵御危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hatch from eggs laid in dams, hatching in hidden chambers within the structures. They keep their eggshell around their bodies to help protect them against danger whilst they grow up.

entry: POKENAME的楔石像蛋壳。据说遇见它，会获好运祝福。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's keystone resembles an eggshell. Those who encounter POKENAME are said to be blessed with good luck.

entry: POKENAME背上的巨花散发香气，让闻者整体心境积极、待人友善。它们性情平和，通常喜欢有其他生灵作伴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME produce a scent from the giant flower on their back that induces feelings of generalised positivity and friendliness in those that smell it. They are peaceful Pokémon and tend to enjoy the company of others.

entry: POKENAME唯有完全安心才肯离蛋壳。它极挑食，往往不爱酸味。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME won't leave its eggshell unless it feels completely safe. It is an incredibly picky eater and tends to dislike sour foods.

entry: 它还不知道，自己已经破壳出生，便仍留在蛋壳里，保护自己。被喜欢的气味包围时，又会进化。
author: skymaster426
source: It doesn't know it has hatched from its egg yet, and keeps within its shell for protection. When it is surrounded by smells it enjoys, it evolves.

entry: POKENAME的剑是身体好几倍大，却舞得轻松灵活，令人惊讶。一部由它主演的热门儿童节目，眼下进入第4季。
author: sk372
source: Though the blade is many times larger than the body, POKENAME wields it with surprising ease and agility. A popular children's show starring POKENAME is currently entering its fourth season.

entry: POKENAME天真快乐，想祝福遇到的每位善人。缎带拂过，心中充满喜悦，据说还能带来接下来一周的好运。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is an innocent and joyful soul that seeks to bless any kind person it comes across. A brush from its ribbons not only fills one with joyous feelings, but is believed to grant good luck for the next week.

entry: 它会依恋第一眼看见的人。身体坚韧得很，哪怕冒雨踏雪，也要一点点挪着追去，直到重新相见。
author: skymaster426
source: It grows immensely attached to the first person it sees. It is immensely durable, and will scooch after them through rain and snow until they reunite.

entry: 据说POKENAME只为心灵纯洁的孩子实现愿望，是童谣的热门主角。孩子望进第三只眼，此后余生都只会感到幸福。
author: sk372
source: Said to only grant wishes to pure-hearted children, POKENAME is a popular figure in nursery rhymes. A child that gazes into its third eye will know nothing but happiness for the rest of their days.

entry: POKENAME宁愿远离其他宝可梦，只与家人交往。渐渐成熟，腰间的壳也更硬、更鲜艳。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME prefers to live away from other Pokémon and instead only associates with its family. As it matures, the shell around its midsection becomes harder and more colorful.

entry: POKENAME散发欢乐积极的气息，凭共感寻找心情相同的伙伴。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME emanates an aura of joy and positivity. POKENAME uses its empathetic nature to find others who feel similarly.

entry: POKENAME唱快节奏旋律，似乎从细胞层面改变心情。它聚在阴郁的城镇广场，连最消沉的人也被唱出笑容。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits high-speed melodies that seem to alter moods on a cellular level. It gathers in gloomy town squares where its songs stir smiles from even the most despondent.

entry: POKENAME外向爱社交，也很容易不高兴。唯有学会调节情绪，波克比的DNA才会进一步进化。
author: bobosmith01
source: While outgoing and social, POKENAME also gets upset very easily. It is only when POKENAME learns to regulate their own emotions can its Togepi DNA evolve further.

entry: POKENAME身体像蛋壳，却极坚实耐打。没有天敌，因此好奇心强，毫不在意地接近陌生者。
author: sk372
source: Despite looking similar to an eggshell, POKENAME's body is highly sturdy and resistant to blows. It has no natural predators, so it has a very curious personality and approaches strangers without a care.

entry: POKENAME的花苞唯有接触积极情绪才开。兴奋时，会喷出一小阵花粉。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's bud only opens when it is exposed to positive emotions. Its bud produces small bursts of pollen whenever POKENAME gets excited.

entry: POKENAME是嘉年华游戏胜者常收到的奖品。据说只要孩子握着它的线，孩子和它都不会不开心。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a popular gift presented to game winners at carnivals. It's said that no child is unhappy if they're holding a POKENAME's strings, and vice-versa.

entry: POKENAME是林中迷路者的希望之光，孢子能让头脑清明、舒缓。天性友善乐助，在家乡森林为人和同类引路。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: A beacon of hope for those lost in the forest, POKENAME produces spores that can help clear and ease the mind. It is very friendly and helpful by nature, guiding people and POKENAME through the woods it calls home.

entry: POKENAME夜里常飘在新生儿床边。与许多幽灵宝可梦不同，它受人欢迎，因为大家相信，它只陪在注定健康快乐长大的孩子身旁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME often appears floating around the cribs of newborns at night. Unlike many other ghostly Pokémon, its presence is welcomed; many believe it only haunts near children destined to grow up happy and healthy.

entry: POKENAME虽看不见，却能感知附近心灵善恶。只有被认定邪恶的对象，才会遭它咬着吸血。
author: sk372
source: Though blind, POKENAME can sense the hearts of others nearby, whether wicked or kind. It only bites and draws blood from those it deems as possessing a wicked heart.

entry: POKENAME依附心怀关爱与快乐的人。不过年幼无经验，有时也会揽下自己吃不消的事。
author: togetik
source: POKENAME attaches itself to people with hearts of compassion and joy. Being young and inexperienced, it sometimes bites off more than it can chew, though.

entry: POKENAME群一听悦耳歌声，就喜悦不已，整天帮做家务。观察过的活包括洗碗、晾衣，以及用尾羽掸灰。
author: lampent12
source: If a flock of POKENAME hears the sound of a melodious singing voice, they will be overwhelmed with joy and spend the day helping with daily chores. Observed tasks include dishwashing, hanging clothes to dry, and dusting with their tail feathers.

entry: POKENAME虽惹麻烦，却被视为好运象征。它爱无伤大雅地捉弄过路训练家。若觉得玩笑太过分，就留下小宝石赔礼。
author: sylviasnake
source: Despite the trouble they bring, a POKENAME is considered a sign of good fortune. Playing pranks on passing Trainers, they love innocent mischief. If a POKENAME feels its pranks were too mean, it will leave behind a gift of small gemstones.

entry: 新孵化的POKENAME带着蛋壳碎片，多一层防护。壳虽脆，受惊时却能带来慰藉与安全感。
author: rakunk
source: Newly hatched POKENAME carry pieces of their eggshell for added protection. Though fragile, these shells are a source of comfort and security when startled.

entry: POKENAME在野外很保护幼年宝可梦。发现危险，就把孩子藏进蛋状下颚，飞快跑走，安全后才放出来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite protective of young Pokémon in the wild. If it spots danger, it hides the young in its egg-like lower jaw and runs off with great haste, releasing them once they've made it to safety.

entry: 遇到负面情绪，POKENAME就裹紧斗篷，躲开世界。这时斗篷散发微弱安抚气息，缓解附近的压力与攻击欲。
author: sk372
source: When confronted with negative emotions, POKENAME tightens its cloak around it and hides itself from the world. The cloak emanates a faint calming aura during this time that alleviates stress and aggression in those nearby.

entry: POKENAME在盛开的花田蹦跳，啁啾唱快乐小调。它向自认善良的对象弹花粉，吸入后会平静快乐数小时。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can be found prancing through blooming flower fields, chirping happy little tunes. It flicks pollen from its leaves at those it deems good souls; inhaling it brings calm and joy for hours.

entry: POKENAME隐居害羞，却有时静静接近守灵仪式。据说缓慢谨慎的舞，能安抚悲恸者的心，也安慰新逝者的灵魂。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is reclusive and shy, but can be seen quietly approaching wakes for the deceased. Its slow and careful dance moves are said to soothe the minds of the grieving, as well as the soul of the recently-departed.

entry: 许多故事称POKENAME生于未孵化宝可梦的灵魂，它却格外快乐外向。哪有积极情绪就去哪，沐浴其中，便能摄取为食。
author: infinex21
source: Although many stories claim these Pokémon are born from the spirits of unhatched Pokémon, POKENAME are extraordinarily joyful and outgoing. They go wherever they feel positive emotions, basking in them and passively feeding on them.

entry: POKENAME有些太弱，孵化后还无法完全破壳，有些则保留部分蛋壳自卫。喜欢谁，就会名副其实地黏在谁身上。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are either too weak to fully break free of their eggs after having hatched or they keep part of their eggs to defend themselves with. They will, quite literally, attach themselves to those they grow fond of.

entry: POKENAME难以独自站立，在双腿足够强前，得靠父母或训练家帮忙。它与养育者有深厚情感。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME have trouble standing on their own and rely on their parents or Trainers for assistance until their legs are strong enough. They develop a strong emotional bond with those who raise them.

entry: 据说融化POKENAME身上的冰，能得到香草味的甜液。可下半身极冷的蛋壳，始终让身体暖不到能融化的程度。
author: .realthree
source: It is said that melting ice from POKENAME's body results in a sweet liquid with a flavor reminiscent of vanilla. However, the extremely cold eggshell on its lower half keeps POKENAME's body from becoming warm enough to melt.

entry: POKENAME心情很受周围影响。沾上负面情绪就闹脾气，疯狂挥臂破坏，直到被安抚。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's mood is easily influenced by those around it. If influenced by negative feelings, it will throw a tantrum and flail its arms wildly, causing destruction until calmed.

entry: POKENAME爱抱抱，却常太晚才想起身上尖刺。触手越长，保护的脆壳便渐渐碎开。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves hugs but often forgets about its sharp spines until it's too late. As its tentacles grow longer, the brittle shell that protects them will slowly begin to break apart.

entry: POKENAME身体多刺，便穿蛋壳，接触人时不致伤害。它几乎总开心，什么让它快乐就抱什么。
author: mistymagius
source: Because of its spiky body, POKENAME wears its eggshell so it can touch people without causing harm. It is almost always happy, hugging anything that gives it joy.

entry: POKENAME爱在海边陪小孩玩，用沙质身体一起塑形。不过，碰到头顶壳状部分，就会本能扬沙逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys playing with young children at the beach, forming shapes together with its sandy body. Touching the shell-like top of its head will cause it to instinctively fling sand and run away, however.

entry: 人们曾信吃POKENAME的蘑菇能有好运，因而猎捕它。如今认为，这说法源自食用真菌后的轻微欣快。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME was once hunted due to the belief that eating its mushrooms gave the consumer good luck. Now it is assumed this belief stemmed from the mild euphoria that comes from eating the fungi.

entry: POKENAME撒出的孢子飘在空中，发出细小兴奋叫声。一落定就安静下来，悄悄长成蘑菇。
author: .jerden
source: The spores POKENAME scatters let out small excited cries as they float through the air. When they settle, they become silent and begin to quietly grow into mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME感到快乐就兴奋，开始明亮急闪。这可能使凝视者抽搐或失明。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME senses happiness, it grows excited and begins flashing brightly and rapidly. This can induce seizures or blind those who stare at it.

entry: POKENAME撒出的孢子飘在空中，发出细小兴奋叫声。一落定就安静下来，悄悄长成蘑菇。
author: .jerden
source: The spores POKENAME scatters let out small excited cries as they float through the air. When they settle, they become silent and begin to quietly grow into mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME背上有蘑菇硬壳保护。真菌吸收积极情绪，产生孢子。蛋壳若裂开，就涌出巨大孢子云，让附近所有生灵充满喜悦。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's back is protected by the hard shell of a mushroom. This fungus is nourished by positive emotions, which is uses to produce spores. If the eggshell ever cracks, a massive cloud of spores will emerge, filling everyone nearby with joy.

entry: POKENAME蛋壳很甜，可给酸奶增甜。可这做法很受反对，因为会把它弄哭。
author: firstromaniandiscoerd
source: POKENAME's eggshell is very sweet, and is used as a yogurt sweetener. This is highly frowned upon, because it makes POKENAME cry.

entry: POKENAME崇拜野生滑滑小子群，用出生时仅有的那点东西，模仿钟爱的打扮。不过，它似乎不懂帽子与兜帽的区别。
author: wilmervr
source: Idolizing packs of wild Scraggy, POKENAME has taken to using the little they are born with to emulate the fashion that they so adore. POKENAME does not seem to understand the difference between a cap and a hood.

entry: POKENAME想法简单，觉得钱就是快乐。为分享快乐，它把找到的亮硬币统统收来，送给别人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a simple mind that equates money with joy. To spread that joy around, it collects any and all shiny coins it finds and gifts them to others.

entry: POKENAME温暖、温柔又友善，是幼童理想的宠物。它能帮害羞内向的孩子敞开心扉，多与别人交往。
author: sk372
source: Being incredibly warm, gentle, and friendly, POKENAME is ideal as a pet for extremely young children. It has been known to help shy and introverted kids come out of their shells and socialize more with others.

entry: POKENAME腹部有坚壳，保护肚子免受外伤。它常打得激进鲁莽，全靠壳挡住反击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a tough shell covering their belly, protecting their stomach from physical harm. They frequently fight in an aggressive, reckless style, relying on their shell to protect them from retaliation.

entry: POKENAME腹部有坚壳，保护肚子免受外伤。它常打得激进鲁莽，全靠壳挡住反击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a tough shell covering their belly, protecting their stomach from physical harm. They frequently fight in an aggressive, reckless style, relying on their shell to protect them from retaliation.

entry: POKENAME受不了负面情绪，哪怕一点怒意或悲伤，也会立刻瞬间移动逃走，觉得安全才回来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME cannot stand to be in the presence of negative emotions. The minute it senses an ounce of anger or sadness, it teleports away until it feels it is safe to return.

entry: POKENAME看不见，也几乎听不见，主要靠感知情绪。从出生那天起，就用这本领保护有需要的对象。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME can't see, and can barely hear. Its primary sense is its ability to detect emotions, which it uses to protect those in need even from the day it's born.

entry: POKENAME天生爱武术，却讨厌伤人。训练家应让更强的宝可梦陪它成长，好切磋而不怕误伤对方。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME has a natural love for martial arts, but hates to cause harm to others. A Trainer should raise it alongside a stronger Pokémon which POKENAME can spar with without risk of hurting it.

entry: POKENAME肌肉密实，几乎无法破坏，蛋却更坚韧。哪怕战中惨败、身受重伤，蛋恐怕也不会裂。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME's dense muscles are almost indestructible, but its egg is even more durable. Even if one is completely defeated in battle and badly hurt, the egg probably won't even crack.

entry: POKENAME能感受其他生灵的情绪。察觉别人受伤害，就满心愤怒，可它厌恶暴力，便靠冥想保持自制。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME can sense the emotions of other living things. Feeling harm being done to others fills it with rage, but it abhors violence, so it meditates to maintain self-control.

entry: 哪怕按宝可梦的标准，POKENAME也不聪明。不过，它极想给周围带来喜悦与安慰，肌肉也赋予它实现心愿的足够力量。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: Even by the standards of Pokémon, POKENAME isn't smart. However, it is highly motivated to spread joy and comfort to all nearby it, and its muscles give it more than enough power to.

entry: POKENAME在蛋壳里带着土，帮助自己在旅途中收集水分与养分。不过，双脚所在的壳缝会漏土，只好经常从各地取土补充。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME carries soil in its eggshell to help it collect water and nutrients as it journeys. However, the cracks in the shell for its feet leak soil, so it must refill often with dirt from all over the region.

entry: POKENAME从树顶垂下蛋形诱饵，骗爱吃蛋的生物上钩。一抓诱饵，就被拖进嘴，整个吞下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME drops an egg-shaped lure from the treetops to trick egg-hunting creatures into taking the bait. Once it's grabbed, it drags them up into its mouth and swallows them whole.

entry: POKENAME神情疲惫，却爱与周围宝可梦玩。它很谨慎，陪幼崽时总收力，免得把谁压在身下。
author: quackquackattack
source: Even though POKENAME have an exhausted expression, they love to play with Pokémon around them. They are cautious creatures that hold back whenever they play with baby Pokémon to avoid crushing anyone beneath them.

entry: POKENAME爱照顾洞窟里遭遗弃的蛋，在岩石巢穴中保暖。据说，送给它们闪亮的石头，会高兴得不久就进化。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy taking care of eggs that are abandoned in caves, keeping them warm in their rocky den. It is said that giving them shiny stones fills them with so much glee that they evolve shortly thereafter.

entry: POKENAME是刚孵化的幼年宝可梦，还没完全脱去蛋壳，会用余下的壳护身。后腿远比身体其他部分发育得好，专用来逃跑。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A baby Pokémon freshly hatched from its egg, POKENAME has not yet shed its egg fully and uses the remaining shell to protect its body. Its hind legs are far more well-developed than the rest of its body and are used for escape.

entry: POKENAME能微妙影响情绪与反应。想玩时，别人就有点想互动；想吃时，别人可能也饿。没有证据表明它有意使用。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has the ability to subtly influence the emotions and reactions of others. If it wants to play, others will feel a slight urge to interact; if it wants to eat, others may feel hungry. There is no evidence it uses this ability intentionally.

entry: POKENAME只接近散发善意与积极能量的对象。用棍轻碰，就能让对方满心温暖喜悦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME only approaches those it senses kind and positive energy from. Tapping those it comes near with its stick causes them to feel a warm and joyous sensation filling them.

entry: POKENAME有些体节易碎，剥落后露出下面的肉。部位极敏感，一碰就哭嚎乱扭。
author: sk372
source: Some segments of POKENAME's body are brittle and chip away to reveal the flesh underneath. These parts are very sensitive, and POKENAME will cry and thrash about if they are touched.

entry: 受POKENAME催眠入睡，被视为好运。吃完梦，它会掰一小片壳留下，作为来访名片。
author: quackquackattack
source: It is considered good luck to fall asleep under the influence of a POKENAME's hypnosis. After eating their target's dreams, POKENAME breaks a sliver of their shell to leave behind as a calling card.

entry: POKENAME在海岸漫游，天真地戳弄遇到的垃圾，尤其好奇偶尔废弃巢中的蛋壳碎片。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME innocently pokes and prods at any litter it comes across while roaming the beach shores. It seems particularly intrigued by egg shell shards from the occasional abandoned nest.

entry: POKENAME快乐，爱陪训练家，尤其喜欢林中徒步。开心时，背上鳞茎就放出甜花粉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are jovial creatures that love to spend quality time with their Trainer, especially hikes in the forest. They release a sweet pollen from the bulb on their back whenever they are happy.

entry: 渔民相信POKENAME作饵能带好运，鱼获更多。其实是身体极黏，水生宝可梦一咬，就被黏在钩上。
author: quackquackattack
source: Fishermen believe that using POKENAME as bait leads to better catches because they bring good luck. In reality, their gooey bodies are incredibly sticky and cause aquatic Pokémon that take the bait to stick to the hook.

entry: POKENAME头戴头骨做成的头盔，免得玩游戏时撞成脑震荡。玩够了，它们马上就把头盔摘下来，让脑袋透透气。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wear skull helmets atop their heads to ensure that they do not receive concussions while they play games. As soon as they're done with their fun, the skulls come off their heads to allow fresh air to pass by their heads.

entry: POKENAME双腿的力量来自孤儿的希望与梦想。因此，它会四处把孩子与父母分开。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME's legs are given power from the hopes and dreams of orphans. Because of this, POKENAME will go around separating children from their parents.

entry: POKENAME脚步轻盈，步法完美，拳斗时像跳舞般进退。两只对赛，战斗的喜悦四散，总让观众激动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are light on their feet, their footwork immaculate as they dance in and out of a fight with their boxing. Watching a match between two POKENAME invariably thrills those watching as the joy of the fight radiates off of them.

entry: 人类学家发现，各地对POKENAME彩烟的看法奇妙地分歧。温暖热带文化常把烟当笑气，北方文化却嫌俗艳、亮得过头。
author: anonymous_16803
source: Anthropologists note an odd division in opinion on the colorful plumes of smoke POKENAME exudes from its body. Warm, tropical cultures often use its vapors as laughing gas, while northern cultures judge them garish and overbright.

entry: 药剂师信POKENAME的茧赐好运，能防病。其实空茧富含抗氧化物，有助增强免疫系统。
author: quackquackattack
source: Apothecaries believe that the cocoons of POKENAME prevent illness because of the good luck they bestow. In reality, the empty cocoons of POKENAME are high in antioxidants, leading to a boosted immune system.

entry: POKENAME在善良的人附近，循柔和弧线游，吐出闪亮泡泡，静静表达亲热与信任。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims in gentle arcs near kindhearted people. It releases glimmering bubbles as a form of quiet affection and trust.

entry: 画家信POKENAME的鳞粉含好运，制成清漆涂画。其实鳞粉有密封物质，能防潮保护绘画，提升作品价值。
author: quackquackattack
source: Artists believe that POKENAME scales contain good luck and coat their paintings with a varnish made out of these scales. In reality, POKENAME scales contain a sealant that protects the painting from humidity, increasing the value of the artwork.

entry: POKENAME常飘在高草丛中，唱歌给受伤宝可梦，试着帮忙。据说与它同行，能给训练家带好运。
author: curvingapollo
source: POKENAME can usually be found floating around in tall grass, singing to injured Pokémon in an effort to help them. It is said that traveling with this Pokémon can bring the Trainer good luck.

entry: POKENAME总想暖身拥抱，传播温暖。可它不喜欢不善之人，会用烈焰驱赶讨厌的对象。
author: anarraveofcolour
source: POKENAME will always seek to spread their warmth by heating themselves and providing hugs. However, POKENAME dislike unkind people and will use their intense flames to ward off anyone they do not like.

entry: POKENAME蜇别人，让对方极快乐。它以为在传播幸福，却不知毒素接触过多会造成伤害。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME stings others to cause intense feelings of joy. It believes it is spreading happiness, unaware that its toxins can have harmful effects if overexposed.

entry: POKENAME野外罕见，据说只在善良纯洁的人面前出现。游泳时轻唱，柔歌安抚有幸听见者的心。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is rarely seen in the wild, supposedly only appearing before people with kind and pure hearts. It's noted for singing while it swims, a soft melody that soothes the hearts of those who manage to hear it.

entry: POKENAME总用变身帮助别人。训练家不开心，就感知什么能让对方快乐，再变成那样。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME always uses its transformations for the benefit of others.  If its Trainer is upset, it will use its ability to sense what will make them happy, then turn into it.

entry: POKENAME通过键盘释放轻柔气息，安抚附近打字的人。数据吃得越多，效果越强。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits a gentle aura through keyboards that calms those typing nearby. The soothing effect strengthens as it consumes more data.

entry: POKENAME掉下树时，能优雅滑向地面，对自己和周围的危险都小了许多。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME can gracefully glide downwards towards the ground when it falls out of trees, making it much less of a danger to itself and those around it.

entry: 据说POKENAME的火焰能治任何疾病与伤势。它为善人家宅降下祝福。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: It's believed that POKENAME's flames can heal any sickness or injury. It blesses the homes of kind people.

entry: POKENAME稀有，在远离人类的地方筑巢。它受强烈积极情绪吸引，最常被享受旅途的登山男遇见。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are rare Pokémon that make their nests far from human civilization. They are drawn to strong positive emotions and are most commonly seen by Hikers that are enjoying their travels.

entry: POKENAME稀有，在远离人类的地方筑巢。它受强烈积极情绪吸引，最常被享受旅途的登山男遇见。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are rare Pokémon that make their nests far from human civilization. They are drawn to strong positive emotions and are most commonly seen by Hikers that are enjoying their travels.

entry: POKENAME蜿蜒穿行山地，蛇形身体十分适合险峻环境。遇人就开心拍小翼，想替对方挡风雨寒暑。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wend their way around mountainous terrain, their serpentine bodies perfect for moving around the treacherous environment. When they encounter people they will flap their tiny wings in delight and try to protect the person from the elements.

entry: 红针含致命神经毒，蓝针含解药。坏心的人先挨红针，直到改过，才会得到蓝针。
author: musicsheep.
source: The red stinger contains a lethal neurotoxin. The blue stinger contains the antidote. Mean people get stung with the red stinger and don't get the blue stinger until they change their ways.

entry: POKENAME虽极罕见，据说见到者就能快乐一生。因此，有人花数年寻遍大地。
author: bostroms
source: While its appearances are extremely rare, it is said that anyone who sees a POKENAME will live a joyful life. For this reason, people will spend years searching the earth for it.

entry: POKENAME虽极罕见，据说见到者就能快乐一生。因此，有人花数年寻遍大地。
author: bostroms
source: While its appearances are extremely rare, it is said that anyone who sees a POKENAME will live a joyful life. For this reason, people will spend years searching the earth for it.

entry: POKENAME虽极罕见，据说见到者就能快乐一生。因此，有人花数年寻遍大地。
author: bostroms
source: While its appearances are extremely rare, it is said that anyone who sees a POKENAME will live a joyful life. For this reason, people will spend years searching the earth for it.

entry: POKENAME旋转头顶叶片，产生缓解焦虑紧张的香气。性情平和温柔，是出色的情感支持宝可梦，许多治疗师都会推荐。
author: fiordaliso
source: By spinning the leaf above its head, POKENAME can create an aroma capable of easing anxiety and tension. Its calm and gentle nature makes it an excellent emotional-support Pokémon, and many therapists recommend it.

entry: POKENAME巨颚总带微笑，露出48颗洁净牙齿。它想笑着带给人快乐，因为很不善应对负面情绪。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME massive jaw is always smiling with its 48 pristine teeth. It smiles to try to bring joy to people, because it cannot process negativity very well.

entry: POKENAME很注重身体接触，表达亲热与战斗时都是如此。它汇聚融合附近的幸福感，通常乐于帮忙。
author: bobosmith01
source: Most POKENAME are very physically oriented towards physical contact, both in affection and in fights. It synthesizes nearby feelings of happiness and usually attempts to help others.

entry: POKENAME的歌能带来美梦与安睡。它很喜欢好梦的感受，常在营地周围出现。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The songs of POKENAME have been shown to bring listeners pleasant dreams and restful sleep. They delight in the feelings of a good dream and can often be found around campsites.

entry: 善人进森林，常有POKENAME群跟随。若有人攻击被跟随者，就会挨树枝或附近任何它们拿得动的东西砸。
author: darkweavile428
source: Kind people who enter forests are often followed by a flock of POKENAME. If anyone tries to attack the person whom they follow, the offender will be pelted with twigs or anything else nearby that POKENAME can carry.

entry: POKENAME跟踪进入森林者，紧盯陌生人。据说数附近树上有几只，就能预知近期发生的事，而事情又受它赐的好运影响。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME stalk those who enter their forest, keeping a close eye on strangers. Counting the number of POKENAME in the nearby trees is said to predict events in the near future, which is influenced by the good luck POKENAME bestow.

entry: 繁星满天的夜里，POKENAME聚在一起飞翔，欣赏头顶群星的美。传说，有幸目睹它们成群飞行的人，会受到祝福，获得绝佳好运。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gather together on starry nights to fly together and bask in the beauty of the stars above. Seeing them flying en masse is said to be a blessing that bestows fantastic luck on one fortunate enough to witness it.

entry: POKENAME飞过人群，一心尽力传播喜悦。通常就是扑飞过去，黏着给人一个亲热拥抱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flies over groups of people, intent on spreading joy to others however it can. This usually takes the form of fluttering over to someone and clinging to them in a friendly hug.

entry: 记得自己也曾弱小，它自认是无力自保者的守护者。巡视天空，一见捕食就俯冲地面，最乐于给弱者带来幸福。
author: anonymous_16803
source: Driven by memories of when it was itself weak, this Pokémon fancies itself a protector of the defenseless. It patrols the sky and swoops down to ground level when it espies predation. It relishes bringing happiness to underdogs.

entry: POKENAME即使看不见伙伴，也能完美编队飞行。它感知同类情绪，根据是否仍能感应群体，调整航线。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to fly in perfect formation with other members of their flock even without being able to see them. They do this by sensing the emotions of other POKENAME, adjusting their flight patterns based on whether they still sense the flock.

entry: POKENAME只有认定训练家心灵纯洁，才肯在其身边进化。否则升级时，就借进化能量朝训练家扔大团黏胶，引起轻微皮疹。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME will only evolve with a Trainer if it believes they are pure of heart. If they don't, when they level up, they harness the power of evolution to throw a large ball of goo at their Trainer, which causes mild rashes.

entry: POKENAME爱社交，吃附近的负面情绪，让人卸下压力、精神焕发。不过有时，也会让对方失去解决生活问题的动力。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a social Pokémon that feeds off the negative emotions of those nearby, causing them to lose feelings of stress and feel refreshed. However, it sometimes means that they lose motivation to fix the problems in their life.

entry: POKENAME进化前多次蜕外骨骼，每次更硬，才有如今洁净的外表。它仍会多次蜕壳，以达到最终进化。
author: gloomymort
source: POKENAME's pristine exterior is the result of it shedding its exoskeleton many times before it evolved, hardening it further each time. It will continue to shed its outer shell multiple times in order to reach its final evolution.

entry: POKENAME用壳里储存的树果调汁，十分抢手，因为人们相信，喝了就有好运。
author: hophoppip
source: The juice POKENAME concocts from the Berries stored in its shell is highly sought after, as it is believed to bring good fortune to anyone who drinks it.

entry: POKENAME笑脸藏着顽皮。它送训练家硬币和亮物，趁对方忙着收礼，偷走财物。追来者会被冰冻之风冻在原地。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's smile belies its mischievous nature. It bears gifts of coins and shiny objects to Trainers, only to steal the Trainer's own valuables while they're occupied. It freezes pursuers in place with an Icy Wind.

entry: POKENAME既关爱又爱逗人，被说一半天使、一半魔鬼。尽管如此，人们相信它心灵极纯洁，必要时不惜冒生命危险。
author: deadshields
source: POKENAME are known for their simultaneously caring yet teasing personalities, earning them a reputation as equal parts heavenly and hellish. Despite this, they are believed to be incredibly purehearted, risking life and limb when needed.

entry: 传闻能孵开POKENAME的蛋状壳，就有好运。其实只是石壳，不过它很享受试图孵化者的百般呵护。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's egg-like shells are rumoured to bring good fortune to those who are able to make them hatch. In reality, they are simple rocky shells, though POKENAME enjoy the pampering they receive from those attempting to hatch them.

entry: POKENAME能闻出情绪，靠近悲伤或寂寞的人。它依偎、轻声安抚，在低谷时陪伴，带来安慰。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can sniff out people's emotions and will gravitate toward those feeling sad or lonely. They will snuggle up to these people and make soothing noises, staying with them to offer comfort in their low moments.

entry: POKENAME能闻出情绪，靠近悲伤或寂寞的人。它依偎、轻声安抚，在低谷时陪伴，带来安慰。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can sniff out people's emotions and will gravitate toward those feeling sad or lonely. They will snuggle up to these people and make soothing noises, staying with them to offer comfort in their low moments.

entry: POKENAME能闻出情绪，靠近悲伤或寂寞的人。它依偎、轻声安抚，在低谷时陪伴，带来安慰。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can sniff out people's emotions and will gravitate toward those feeling sad or lonely. They will snuggle up to these people and make soothing noises, staying with them to offer comfort in their low moments.

entry: POKENAME常在凉处翻找蘑菇、种子等食物。性情胆怯，稍有声响就把头缩进厚毛下，躲开别人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is typically seen rooting around cool areas for foods such as mushrooms and seeds. It is quite timid, retracting its head underneath its thick fur to hide from others at the slightest noise.

entry: POKENAME用翼状鳍快速划水，比想捕它的宝可梦还快。据说钓鱼时能成功钓上一只，才真考验本领。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their wing-like fins to propel themselves rapidly through the water, darting about faster than the Pokémon that would try to catch it. Successfully catching one while fishing is said to be a true test of skill.

entry: POKENAME收集海底物品，囤一小堆让自己开心的东西。来客若带礼物，就会获赠藏品；情感意义远比价值重要。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make collections of items on the sea floor, creating a small hoard of items that bring them joy. They give these items away to visitors if they bring a gift in turn, the value of the object mattering far less than the emotional significance.

entry: 有些POKENAME的翼和吻部比同类发育得更好，机动性更强，便远行寻找让自己快乐的收藏品。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Some POKENAME have better developed wings and snouts than others of their species. They use the better mobility granted to them by these differences to cover great distances in search of objects to collect that bring them joy.

entry: POKENAME活泼爱玩，会在善人劳累一天后现身逗乐。玩累了，就爱蜷在选中的人腿上。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: Playful and energetic, POKENAME appears before kindhearted people to cheer them up after a rough day. When POKENAME is tired from playing, it enjoys cuddling in its chosen person's lap.

entry: POKENAME遇善人，会狂喜地绕圈滚。有时速度太快撞上建筑，再不好意思地送一份好运祝福。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: When it meets a kindhearted person, POKENAME rolls around them in ecstatic circles. Sometimes it builds up too much speed and crashes into buildings, then sheepishly offers a blessing of good luck.

entry: POKENAME难过时，运行一行短代码，就立刻恢复好心情。这简单程序，对情绪健康大有帮助。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME feel sad, they run a short line of code that instantly restores their mood. This simple program does wonders for POKENAME's emotional wellbeing.

entry: POKENAME运行两行代码，就能迅速转变心情。聚会时需要振奋、撑过整夜，这尤其重要。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME run two lines of code that allow them to quickly change their mood. This is especially important when they need to cheer up at parties to make it through the night.

entry: POKENAME虽不能真飞，小翼却能提高战斗灵活性。它极享受交手，只要愿意应战，多强的对手也找上去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Even though they can't truly fly, POKENAME use their small wings to improve their agility while fighting. They take great joy from combat and will seek out any opponent willing to face them, regardless of how strong they are.

entry: POKENAME遇见悲伤独处者，就转圈，想逗对方开心。若转倒了，却会哭得停不下来，直到昏过去，通常得哭数小时。
author: laughing_dan
source: When POKENAME finds someone sad and alone, it will spin around to try to cheer them up. When it falls over, it will cry uncontrollably until it passes out, which usually takes several hours.

entry: POKENAME向低落者俏皮飞吻，可爱举动让看见的人振奋。一次不成，就拍小翼四处飞，摆姿势加倍卖萌。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME playfully blow kisses at anyone they notice feeling down, the adorable display helping to cheer up anyone who sees it. If the first attempt doesn't work, POKENAME will fly about on their tiny wings and strike poses to play up their cuteness.

entry: POKENAME美羽丝毛招来偷猎，直到不久前还被认为野外灭绝。传闻只会在心灵平和的训练家面前现身。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's beautiful feathers and silky fur make it a target for poachers to the point where POKENAME was thought to be extinct in the wild until recently. Rumors say that it will only show itself to Trainers with peaceful hearts.

entry: 一名巡视雾林的巡护员发现了行踪隐秘的POKENAME。它能借电场察觉其他生物，甚至读取情绪。
author: cobalt0135
source: The elusive POKENAME were discovered by a ranger surveying a misty forest. They can detect the presence of others and even read emotions through the electric field.

entry: 过去，人们相信吃POKENAME的尾巴能一生好运，因此猎捕。如今野外罕见，被列为极度濒危。
author: sk372
source: In the past, POKENAME was hunted for its tail, which was believed to grant a life of good fortune when consumed. The species is rarely seen in the wild and considered critically endangered as a result.

entry: POKENAME用双尾裹住喜欢的训练家，让对方满心喜悦安宁。它爱收集蛋，却不善育幼，最好给不会孵化的蛋。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME wraps its twin tails around Trainers it likes, filling them with joy and serenity. It loves to collect eggs, but it's best to give it a sterile one, as it is not the best parent.

entry: POKENAME饿了就吃丰富健康的水果，满足甜食口味。传统上，交换它时会喂杏子，象征新开始。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME gets hungry, it dines on a healthy array of fruits to satisfy its sweet tooth. Apricots are traditionally fed to it when traded, to indicate a fresh start.

entry: POKENAME乘气流飘过天空，不断寻找可安慰的悲伤者。白色外衣上的三角纹，每只都不同。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME drifts through the sky on wind currents, constantly searching for sad people to cheer up. The triangular patterns on its white coat are different for each individual.

entry: 它喷射熔融蛋黄，化学成分为本物种独有，比普通熔岩保热久得多。蛋黄高度压缩储存在体内，看似POKENAME有无穷供应。
author: anonymous_16803
source: It shoots a kind of molten yolk that is peculiar to its species in chemical composition, and stays hot for far longer than normal lava. The yolk is stored in a super-compressed form in its body, giving the impression POKENAME has an endless supply.

entry: POKENAME一生中很长一段时间，翅膀都弱得飞不久。它主要改在地下掘进，好锻炼身体。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's wings remain too weak to stay in the air for long for a good portion of its life. Instead, it mostly digs underground to better train its body.

entry: 据说POKENAME给别人带好运、分幸福，结果自己的好运所剩无几。程序错误让它的头一直与身体分离。
author: ruben2309295
source: It's said that POKENAME bring good fortune and share their happiness with others, this leaves them with little good fortune for themselves. Due to a glitch, POKENAME's head stays detached from its body.

entry: POKENAME只有不把旅人视为自己与森林家园的威胁，才肯现身。偶尔会送一片肢体上的彩叶，许多人相信，佩戴就能带好运。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will only appear before forest travelers if they are not deemed a threat to it or its home. Rarely, it will offer one of the colored leaves from its limbs, which many believe are charmed to bring good luck to the wearer.

entry: POKENAME喜欢快乐啁啾、蹦跳，试图分享喜悦。看见谁微笑，就开心得拍翼浮起，双脚踢动。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME seems to love chirping happily and hopping around in an attempt to spread its joy to others. When it witnesses an individual smile, overjoyed, POKENAME will flutter its wings, begin floating, and kick its feet.

entry: POKENAME接触负面情绪，尖刺便竖起；积极情绪则让刺伏平。它用强爪挖石，雕成礼物送朋友。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's sharp quills rise when it is exposed to negative emotions and lay flat when it is exposed to positive emotions. It uses its strong claws to dig up rocks and carve them into gifts for friends.

entry: POKENAME带着好运气息、性情喜悦，被用作健身计划的代言吉祥物。让它保持健康与动力，能给周围所有人带来快乐。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are used as mascots to sell fitness plans because of their aura of good luck and gleeful personality. Keeping POKENAME fit and motivated brings joy to everyone nearby.

entry: POKENAME协助紧急救援人员赈灾。心形胸角感知痛苦，甜美歌声安抚受惊幸存者，让灾区精神振奋。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME assist emergency workers during disaster relief. Sensing distress with their heart-shaped chest horns, they use their sweet singing to calm distressed survivors and lift spirits across affected areas.

entry: POKENAME身上的鳞片能折射光，让它隐形。它散布闪粉，接触者会感到幸福。
author: mepp.
source: The scales on POKENAME's body can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible. It emits a sparkling dust that promotes feelings of bliss to those that come in contact with it.

entry: POKENAME身体笨拙，自觉脆弱，因此容易受惊。拍动小翼也逃不开危险时，就唱轻柔舒缓的曲子，试着安抚好斗敌人。
author: ambrosia04
source: Because POKENAME's clumsy bodies leave them feeling vulnerable, they are easily startled. If fluttering their small wings fails to carry them away from danger, they sing gentle, soothing melodies in an effort to calm aggressive foes.

entry: 附近负面情绪过于强烈，就会引来POKENAME现身。它释放平静气息，安抚周围，带来几分安宁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's appearance is triggered when it senses an overwhelming amount of negative emotions near it. When it manifests, it emits a calming aura that soothes those around, giving them a measure of peace.

entry: POKENAME有独特本领，蓝红两种波导均衡共存。它会将两者按不同份量分享，据说帮助平衡对方的波导，更加平和。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a unique ability, possessing both blue and red aura in equal balance. It shares these with others in differing amounts, believed to be helping others balance their own aura and feel more at peace.

entry: POKENAME的花一生只开一次，十分罕见，因此据说，目睹花开能为观者带来好运。花开以后，无论昼夜，都保持盛放，让见者心生喜悦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Watching a POKENAME's flower blossom is said to bring good fortune to the observers due to the rarity of the event, their flowers opening just once in their lifetime. Their flowers remain in full bloom at all times of day, the sight inspiring joy.

entry: 有人相信，轻敲POKENAME头骨能暂时驱走厄运。头骨坚固，它感觉不到疼痛，也似乎不介意这仪式。
author: sk372
source: Some believe that lightly striking POKENAME's skull will ward off bad luck for a time. Thanks to the sturdiness of its skull, POKENAME feels no pain and doesn't seem to mind the ritual.

entry: 危急时，POKENAME可能突然现身，保护善人免受伤害，再消失无踪。
author: robosoup
source: In moments of peril, a POKENAME may suddenly appear to shield good-hearted people from harm. It then vanishes without a trace.

entry: 天灾时，POKENAME能量增强，向周围散出一波波喜悦。不合时宜的快乐，常让人低估身边危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's energy intensifies during natural disasters, radiating waves of joy to those nearby. This misplaced happiness often leads people to underestimate the danger around them.

entry: POKENAME强大的气息，强迫附近所有生灵感到快乐。记录称，最多能同时影响1000个个体。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits a powerful aura that enforces happiness on all nearby beings. Records claim this effect can influence up to 1,000 individuals at once.

entry: POKENAME飞近纯洁心灵，喙便泛粉光。它常停在对方肩上，开心地轻轻啁啾。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's beak glows pink as it flies near those with pure hearts. It often perches on their shoulders, chirping softly in happiness.

entry: 许多传说称POKENAME捕食别人的幸福，人许愿到一半时，吸走的喜悦最多。因此，虽然外表可爱，许多人仍不愿靠近。
author: .izik
source: Many legends claim POKENAME preys on the happiness of others, absorbing the most joy while people are mid-wish. Because of this, many shy away from being near it despite its adorable appearance.

entry: 据说它给心灵纯洁者带来好运。性情虽然善良，一生气却几乎哄不好。
author: roundabout_robin
source: They say that this Pokémon brings good fortune to those who are pure of heart. Despite its kind-hearted nature, it is nearly impossible to soothe it once angered.

entry: 迷雾密林深处，能听见野生POKENAME的歌。林中回声重重，几乎无法循声穿雾找到。
author: cobalt0135
source: Wild POKENAME can be heard singing deep within dense mist-shrouded forests. Following their voices through the mist is nearly impossible due to the reverberation of the dense forest.

entry: POKENAME常飘过盛开花田，所到之处传播喜悦。据说舞蹈能抚慰破碎的心。
author: dammaskk
source: POKENAME often floats over blooming fields, spreading joy wherever it goes. Its dance is said to heal broken hearts.

entry: POKENAME满心幸福，走到哪里都表达喜悦。训练家若回应这份快乐，它就分享一簇尾毛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is full of felicity and expresses that joy wherever it goes. It shares tufts of fur from its tail with Trainers who reciprocate its happiness.

entry: POKENAME罕见，多从民间故事为人所知。传说称它“喜悦使者”，会邀纯洁心灵者握住尾巴，祝福其幸福1000年。
author: mepp.
source: As POKENAME is rarely seen, it is mostly known through folklore. These legends call it the “Joybringer”, as it invites those pure of heart to hold its tails to bless them with happiness for 1,000 years.

entry: 它轻到不动翅膀也可能飘起。为安抚其他生物，会奏乐伴唱。据说听过POKENAME表演，第二天便精神饱满。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is so lightweight that it may float in the air even without using its wings. To soothe and relax others, it plays an instrument and sings along. Those who listen to POKENAME's performance are said to feel exuberant the day after.

entry: POKENAME洋溢喜悦，几乎不停蹦跳。据说能给周围带来好财运。
author: bobosmith01
source: It exudes joy and is almost constantly skipping and hopping around. POKENAME is said to bring good financial fortune to those around it.

entry: POKENAME自由飘空，身后拖纤维丝。有种特别习俗，会在重大节庆后把它系在桥上，帮助孩子回归日常生活。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME float freely through the air as fibrous string trails close behind them. There is a particular ritual of tying POKENAME to bridges after a major festival to help children transition back to normal life.

entry: 据说POKENAME天生会感知好运。若见它竖耳跑向某处，跟上似乎就必然碰到幸运的事。
author: sk372
source: It's said that POKENAME has an innate ability to sense good fortune. If one sees it perk its ears up before running off somewhere, following it seems to inevitably lead to something fortuitous.

entry: 一只POKENAME带领一群进化前的幼体，往来城镇。在它指挥下，大家捡垃圾、扫街区，再飞走。
author: lampent12
source: A single POKENAME will lead a flock of their pre-evolutions from town to town. Under POKENAME's orders, they pick up trash and clean the neighborhood before flying off.

entry: POKENAME飞过城镇，用火烧掉散落垃圾。若抓到你乱扔，就怒火中烧地啄来。
author: lampent12
source: POKENAME flies through towns and cities, using their fire to burn loose trash. If they catch you littering, they will peck at you in a burning fury.

entry: POKENAME用嘴衔着波克比，飞过洞穴护送。作为回报，波克比送好运与积极感受，它十分乐意接受。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME escorts Togepi through caves by carrying them in its mouth and flying through caverns. In exchange for this aid, Togepi bestow good luck and positive feelings to POKENAME, which it happily accepts.

entry: 蜕下脆弱蛋壳后，POKENAME比进化前更好奇外界。常与其他幼年宝可梦结伴，寻求安慰。
author: rakunk
source: After shedding its fragile eggshell, POKENAME is much more curious of the outside world compared to its pre-evolution. It often allies with other young Pokémon for comfort.

entry: POKENAME会一起高速跳起繁复的舞蹈。可翅膀十分脆弱，复杂的动作又容易让彼此相撞。若真撞伤，它们就会互相照料。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME partake in elaborate dances with one another at high speeds. However, their wings are very fragile and during these dances the complexity means they are at risk of hitting each other. If this does happen, they tend to each other's injuries.

entry: POKENAME的加油舞让受助者好运、能量都增强。跳舞时绒球撒彩色火花，一个红，一个蓝。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cheering dances provide a luck and energy boost to those it cheers for. Its pom-poms spread colorful sparks as it dances; red from one and blue from the other.

entry: POKENAME羽毛极软，一碰，负面情绪便神奇消失。它喜爱小孩，连飞行时也让他们骑背。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's feathers are so soft that if you touch them, all of your negative emotions will magically disappear. It adores young children and will even allow them to ride on its back while it flies.

entry: POKENAME爱带给别人幸福。据说抚摸它极其舒缓，身体触感像造型黏土。
author: rakanadyo
source: POKENAME enjoys bringing happiness to others. Petting one is said to be very soothing, with their body texture being compared to modeling clay.

entry: POKENAME通常担任群体里的保护者，回报同伴，无论是野生宝可梦还是训练家的队伍。据说黏液气味一吸入，就很能安抚。
author: gdottb
source: POKENAME typically take a protective role in their social network as a form of repayment to their community, whether it be other wild Pokémon or their Trainer's team. Their slime is said to have a great calming effect when the scent is inhaled.

entry: POKENAME给自认纯洁的人分享幸福，用双臂紧抱。可惜不知道自己多有力，常弄伤想逗开心的对象。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME shares its happiness with those it finds pure of heart, wrapping its arms around the person in a tight hug. Unfortunately, POKENAME does not know its own strength and often injures those it tries to make happy.

entry: POKENAME发现谁需要安慰，就用多条触手拥抱，“神奇地”让对方好受。触手极轻，还能当好几对额外翅膀。
author: mistymagius
source: If POKENAME finds someone in need of cheering up, it will hug them with its many tentacles to 'magically' make them feel better. These tentacles are very lightweight, allowing them to act as extra pairs of wings.

entry: POKENAME察觉善良猎物，铲子就抽动。它无声俯冲，把喜悦吸入白翼。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's shovel twitches when it detects kindhearted prey. With a silent swoop, it drops from above to drain joy into its white wings.

entry: POKENAME孢子像兴奋剂，让人快乐激动。过去人们靠它减轻抑郁影响，使用很久后才了解背后的化学机制。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spores act like a stimulant that makes people happy and excitable. People in the past relied on these spores to help mitigate the effects of depression, though knowledge of the chemical mechanisms came long after its use.

entry: POKENAME能给周围带来极大喜悦，被用于情绪治疗。野生个体四处飞，寻找需要关爱与同情的人。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME are used as emotional therapy Pokémon as they bring great joy to those around them. Wild POKENAME will fly around, seeking people who need love and compassion.

entry: POKENAME被善良关爱者围绕，背上蘑菇就长高。偶尔抖动蘑菇，便放出被称为喜悦粉的发光孢子。
author: .jerden
source: The mushroom on POKENAME's back grows taller if it is surrounded by kind and caring people. POKENAME will occasionally shake this mushroom, releasing glowing spores known as joy dust.

entry: POKENAME开心时，用尾巴敲背鳞。声音被形容为像小铁琴。
author: .realthree
source: When POKENAME is happy, it strikes the scales on its back with its tail. The resulting sound has been described as similar to that of a small metal xylophone.

entry: POKENAME善良温柔，在积极情绪中茁壮成长。友善举止与鲜艳颜色，让它常在马戏团、集市等游乐场所担任助手和向导。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a kind and gentle creature that thrives in the presence of positive emotions. Its friendly demeanor and vibrant coloring see it often employed as assistants and guides at circuses, fairs and other attractions.

entry: POKENAME的小翅膀，每次只能让它离地几分钟。飞行时，菌盖会散出孢子，让吸入者短暂地陶醉不已。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can lift itself off the ground for only a few minutes at a time with its small wings. When it flies, it spreads spores from its mushroom cap that provide a short-lived euphoric sensation in those who inhale them.

entry: POKENAME扑飞田间，用绒毛授粉，帮助农人。敏锐复眼紧盯庄稼，迅速赶走害虫。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME aid farmers by fluttering through fields to pollinate blossoms with their fuzzy coats. Using keen compound vision, they keep a close watch over crops, quickly driving away nuisance pests.

entry: POKENAME爱收集闪亮小饰物。若送一件给训练家，就预示大好运将至。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love collecting shiny trinkets. If they offer one of these baubles to their Trainer, it is a sign that great fortune will soon occur.

entry: POKENAME大多在水下吃水草。强烈积极情绪会引它浮上来，最常在孩子附近玩水坑时冒头，让孩子大喜。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend most of their time underwater feeding on pond weed. They are drawn to the surface by strong positive emotion and are most commonly seen popping up when children are splashing around in nearby puddles, much to the delight of the child.

entry: POKENAME极爱练肌肉，常鼓励别人加入。它成了私人健身教练的热门伙伴，却少有人跟得上那用不完的精力。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME take great joy in exercising their muscles, often trying to encourage others to join in. They have become popular companions of personal trainers, though few people are able to keep up with their indefatigable energy.

entry: POKENAME感知情绪时，胡须会抽动。极快乐的情绪尤其让它反应强烈，常寻找大型庆典，沐浴其中的积极感受。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's whiskers twitch when they sense the emotions of others. Particularly joyful emotions create a strong response from them, and they are known to seek out large celebratory gatherings to bask in the positivity there.

entry: POKENAME感知情绪时，胡须会抽动。它寻找低落者，用心灵感应传去积极乐观的感受，试着传播快乐。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's whiskers twitch when they sense the emotions of others. They seek out those suffering from low moods and telepathically project feelings of positivity and optimism in an attempt to spread cheer.

entry: 组成POKENAME的波克基古以带好运著称，它却更实在地送来福气。把礼物交给有需要者，用力量确保人人分得公平。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: While one of its components, Togetic, is known for bringing fortune, POKENAME brings it in a literal sense. It delivers gifts to those in need, using its strength to ensure all get their fair share.

entry: POKENAME亲手制作要送的礼物。灵巧双手虽也能破坏，却能同时做两件、甚至四件礼物。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME creates the gifts it delivers by hand. This dexterity, which it can also use for destructive power, allows it to work on two or even four gifts simultaneously.

entry: POKENAME巡视山顶，检查岩石，防止滑坡。传闻它会帮困境中的登山者，换取爱吃的亮石头。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME are seen patrolling the tops of mountains, inspecting rocks to prevent rockslides. Rumors say POKENAME will help struggling mountaineers in exchange for shiny rocks and stones, which they like to eat.

entry: POKENAME身上的红蓝花纹，都是同类一笔笔仔细画上的。据说帮它画这些图案，会有好运。
author: quackquackattack
source: The red and blue pattern on the bodies of POKENAME are painstakingly painted onto their bodies by other POKENAME. It is said that helping POKENAME paint their bodies with these patterns will bring good luck.

entry: 它奔跑时，火鬃撒出的粉尘能让接触者快乐。会在善人面前现身，一同赛跑。分享幸福越多，火焰越亮。
author: jojojax164
source: This Pokémon gallops with a fiery mane that scatters dust that induces joy in those it contacts. It appears before kindhearted people and races with them. Its flames glow brighter as it shares happiness.

entry: 安详的POKENAME身后有一道尾状闪光。站在其中会精神振奋，可它似乎不大乐意别人这样做。
author: bobosmith01
source: A tail-shaped trail of sparkles follows behind the serene POKENAME. Standing in these sparkles will make one feel exuberant, although POKENAME does not seem to enjoy another doing so very much.

entry: POKENAME因共同心愿彼此相连，用明亮电光祝福疲惫旅人。它们常被误认成民间传说的善良小精灵。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME have formed a link between one another through their mutual desire to bring blessings to weary travelers through the use of bright electrical charges. Frequently, they have been confused with kindhearted pixies from folklore.

entry: POKENAME两个头似乎总唱反调。不过，靠好运与妥协，能克服分歧，为训练家取胜。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have two heads that always seem to act contrary to each other. Through good fortune and compromise, POKENAME can overcome their differences to secure victory for their Trainer.

entry: POKENAME笑容有感染力、双眼可爱，很难不喜欢，全世界都爱它。野外稀有，数千人会专程到野生动物园看。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is loved all around the world, with its infectious smile and adorable eyes making it difficult to hate. Due to being rare in the wild, thousands of people will come to wildlife parks just to see it.

entry: POKENAME外貌与欢快性情，让它成了畅销早餐麦片的吉祥物。随后，孩子试着舔剧毒身体，诉讼便接踵而来。
author: robosoup
source: Because of POKENAME's appearance and its cheery personality, it became the mascot for a best-selling breakfast cereal. Lawsuits soon followed, when children tried licking its highly toxic body.

entry: POKENAME见到潜水者就慷慨送珍珠。珍珠格外闪亮，似乎给持有者带来好运。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME freely give out their pearls to any divers they see. These pearls are exceptionally shiny and seem to bring good luck to those who hold them.

entry: POKENAME在晒暖的海岸跟随善人，爬近保护。捕食者靠太近，就会遭它猛烈钳击。
author: .izik
source: At sun-warmed shores, POKENAME trails kind souls, scuttling close to guard them. Its claws snap fiercely at predators that wander too near.

entry: POKENAME虽友善，训练起来却危险。它常用强钳抓住喜欢的对象，表达亲热。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite is friendly nature, POKENAME is quite dangerous to train. It has a tendency to grab anyone it likes with its powerful pincers as a show of affection.

entry: POKENAME用细喙啄穿树果核，再把种子种回地里。吃剩余果肉时，会看见未来长成美丽大树的景象。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their thin beaks to pierce the pits of berries before replanting their seeds in the ground. They then eat the remaining berry while watching visions of the beautiful tree that will eventually grow where they planted it.

entry: POKENAME把精神能量导入骨头，清清楚楚预见5分钟后的未来。这时会轻声、有节奏地啁啾。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME channels psychic energy through its bone to glimpse five minutes into the future with perfect clarity. During these visions, it emits soft, rhythmic chirps.

entry: POKENAME藏在枝叶间，盯过路人。至今没被拍到过，因为一见相机就瞬间移动走。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME hides among foliage and stares at passing humans. Its never been photographed, as it teleports away the moment it sees a camera.

entry: POKENAME在林地找种子吃。喙分泌的弱毒，恰能把捕食者削弱到足够逃回树干下的家。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME goes around the forest floor looking for seeds to eat. Its beak secretes a mild poison that weakens predators just enough to allow it to flee back into its home beneath tree trunks.

entry: POKENAME熟知进化过程与好处，会选自己预见最有利的进化。家养个体甚至能预知，哪种最适合训练家或未来队伍。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are very knowledgeable on the process and advantages of evolution, seeking out the evolution that they predict will benefit them the most. Domestic POKENAME can even predict which evolution will suit their Trainers or future teams best.

entry: POKENAME一出现在电脑，就引发大量故障，十足的混乱制造者。唯有使用者谈成交易，才肯修复，可代价总是高昂。
author: sk372
source: A chaotic creature indeed, POKENAME causes glitches aplenty when it appears on a person's computer. It will only fix the problems it causes if the user makes a deal with it, but the price is always steep.

entry: 据说POKENAME睡着，隔着眼皮也能看。偏远森林里，常见它盯着附近任何吃的。
author: reese1017600
source: It is said that POKENAME can stare through their eyelids even when they are asleep. In remote forests, POKENAME are often found staring at any kind of food nearby.

entry: POKENAME蹦跳时，火羽拖在身后。它嘴衔树果，转身用尾上余烬烤熟。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME hop about with their fiery feathers trailing behind them. They hold berries in their beaks and turn to cook them with the embers from their tails.

entry: POKENAME不肯在危险处筑巢。预知未来的能力让它察觉洪水、滑坡，始终住在安全稳妥处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME refuses to make a nest in a dangerous place. It uses its ability to foresee the future to be aware of flooding or rock slides, ensuring that it always stays in a safe, secure location.

entry: POKENAME若预见可怕的未来，头便会飞快地转圈。若景象格外骇人，头转得还会比平时更快，显示出这次预见有多么强烈。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME has a vision of a terrible future, its head will spin in circles rapidly. If it is a particularly awful vision, the head will spin faster than normal, a sign of the intensity of its foreseeing.

entry: POKENAME靠预知狩猎。只有知道鲤鱼王即将跃瀑，才会去瀑布，免得白跑浪费体力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its ability to foretell events to hunt. It will only go to a waterfall if it knows a Magikarp will soon ascend, ensuring it doesn't waste energy on unnecessary trips.

entry: POKENAME害羞古怪，在爱好者间很有名。许多个体容易被莫名物件吓到，雷鸣等现象却完全无动于衷。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are known among enthusiasts for their shy and quirky personality. Many are easily frightened over random objects, while other phenomena, such as claps of thunder, leave them completely unfazed.

entry: 黄昏最容易遇见POKENAME，但它害羞，又容易不知所措，依旧很难寻找。满月时，它们能跳到平常三倍的高度。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are most often found at dusk, although they are still difficult to find due to their shyness and tendency to get overwhelmed. When the moon is full, they can jump thrice as high as normal.

entry: POKENAME啁啾唱曲时能预见未来。若看见坏事，就唱得更响、更急，警告麻烦将至。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has the power to see the future while it chirps in a melody. If it sees something awful, it will chirp louder than normal, its tune growing more frantic to signal impending trouble.

entry: POKENAME一感到厄运或不纯意图，就尽快跳走。可惜腿短，速度不快。
author: b_e_n_jamin_
source: Upon sensing bad luck or impure intentions, POKENAME will hop away as fast as it can. Unfortunately, it is not very speedy due to its short legs.

entry: 野生POKENAME用伸缩颈采天然雀平时够不到的树果。若预见训练家未来幸福，就喜悦起舞。
author: b_e_n_jamin_
source: Wild POKENAME use their extendable necks to harvest berries that Natu normally cannot reach. If it sees happiness in a Trainer's future, it will begin to dance with joy.

entry: POKENAME好斗，常找穿山王、超音蝠打架。可对勾魂眼很友善，会用啄帮它取得祖母绿。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are quite aggressive, often picking fights with Sandslash and Zubat. Despite this, POKENAME are very friendly with Sableye, using Peck to help them obtain emeralds.

entry: POKENAME像旧记录中，天然雀与天然鸟之间一种据说已灭绝的中间形态。聪明好奇，甚至会用工具画画、沟通。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME bears resemblance to old records of a supposedly now-extinct middle form between Natu and Xatu. It's quite intelligent and curious and can even use tools to draw and communicate with others.

entry: POKENAME跳进垃圾箱前，先用超能力判断有无可吃的。越饿，能力越不准，饿极有时便预见失误。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to determine if a dumpster has any edible food in it before it jumps in. Its powers are more flawed based on how hungry it is, sometimes leading to inaccurate predictions when starving.

entry: POKENAME爱用爪尾偷过路训练家的物件。预见能力惊人，几乎无法偷袭，多数人再拿不回东西。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves to steal items from passing Trainers using its clawed tail. Due to its amazing sense of foresight, it is almost impossible to ambush, and most people never get their stuff back.

entry: POKENAME脚部凝胶能让它沿任何表面行走。虽不会飞，却能从任何高度无伤潜水：入水时扭转身体，用冠脊破水。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME secretes a gel from its feet that it can use to walk up any surface. Although unable to fly, they can dive into water from any height without injury, by contorting their body as they enter and using their head crest to break the water.

entry: POKENAME夜里静立望月，据说借此占卜未来。得到预见时，双翼展开，圆环明亮发光。
author: sk372
source: At night, POKENAME stands motionless while gazing up at the moon. It's said to divine the future from this action, its wings spreading wide and its rings glowing bright when it receives a vision.

entry: POKENAME能感知旅途中的最佳路线，是受欢迎的信使。但最好别托它送太闪亮的东西，它可能分心，想据为己有。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME make popular messengers due to their ability to sense the best routes on their travels. It is advised not to ask them to deliver anything too shiny, as they may get distracted and try to keep the objects for themselves.

entry: POKENAME找到什么都能织复杂巢，从树枝、棉花到散落毛发。打扰巢穴者，会遭可怕诅咒。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME weave complex nests of whatever materials they can find, from sticks, cotton, and even loose hair and fur. Those who disturb their nest suffer a terrible curse.
