entry: POKENAME能看见朦胧的未来景象，借此避免重伤。被迫与其他宝可梦交战时，它们会观察对手，等到恰当时机，再发起反击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have hazy visions of the future that they rely on to avoid serious injury. When they are forced to fight another Pokémon, they observe their opponent to find the right moment and launch a counterattack.

entry: 未来一有分岔，POKENAME两个头就看见相反结果，用心灵感应争辩。民间故事里，探险者试着解读哪个头看见真相，好达成目标。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Whenever there is a branching path for the future, the two heads of a POKENAME will see opposite outcomes and telepathically debate with each other. Folk tales tell of adventurers trying to interpret which head is seeing the truth to find their goal.

entry: POKENAME钻入地下时，用喙迅速拨开泥土。若遇到阻碍，它们便借超能力向后退，改用尾巴掘土前行。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their beaks to rapidly push dirt aside while they burrow into the ground. If they face any opposition, they will propel themselves backwards with psychic powers and start tunneling through dirt with their tails instead.

entry: POKENAME用超能力，提前预见猎物会移到哪里。可它常看得太远，景象还没成真，就先俯冲了。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their psychic powers to predict where their prey will be before it can even move. Unfortunately, they tend to read too far into the future and dive before their visions can come true.

entry: POKENAME用心灵感应和群体沟通。只要一只发现危险，就协调航线，完美配合避开威胁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its telepathy to communicate with others from its flock. If one sees any type of danger, they will coordinate flight patterns, avoiding threats by working together in perfect harmony.

entry: POKENAME探知树的过去，看同类是否吃过。它偏爱自己选的树，但饿极也吃共用树上的食物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME peers into a tree's past to see if others of its kind have fed there. It prefers its own chosen tree but will eat from a shared tree if starving.

entry: POKENAME冷静精算，常花大把时间冥想。略能预知，可在冥想时预感捕食者来袭，作相应反击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a calm and calculating sort, spending a good chunk of its time meditating. It possesses mild precognition, able to anticipate predators trying to attack it while it meditates, and counter the attacks accordingly.

entry: POKENAME窥见未来时，身上冒泡的绿色黏液，会变得极热。它借此自保，确保高度专注时，谁也无法靠得太近。
author: .izik
source: The bubbling green goo on POKENAME's body becomes intensely hot while it is gazing into the future. It does this to protect itself during its visions, ensuring that no one can get too close during these moments of intense focus.

entry: POKENAME喜欢嗅寻美味的蘑菇来吃。久而久之，它常会栽种自己的菌菇园。有人试着解读，它种下的奇怪图案，究竟是否含有什么意义。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a penchant for sniffing out tasty mushrooms to eat. It will often begin cultivating its own garden of fungi over time, and some have attempted to decipher if there is meaning behind the odd patterns in which it tends to grow them.

entry: POKENAME作重大移动前，会左右晃头、尝尝空气，似乎毫无规律。宝可梦研究者认为，它在感知不同可能性，判断未来会怎样。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME sway their heads from side to side and taste the air, seemingly at random , before they make any significant movement. Pokémon Researchers believe they are sensing different probabilities and determining what the future may hold.

entry: 有人推测，丰缘古遗迹中约10%的壁画出自POKENAME。艺术是否藏有深意，还是单纯古代涂鸦，仍不清楚。
author: sk372
source: It's speculated that about 10 percent of murals found on ancient Hoenn ruins were painted by POKENAME. Whether the art has deeper meaning or is simply ancient graffiti has yet to be determined.

entry: POKENAME住在偏僻森林的树上，吃叶片与树果。弹跳力出奇强，轻易一跃就超过身体数倍长。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME lives in the trees in secluded forest areas and eat leaves and berries. It is a surprisingly powerful jumper and can clear distances several times its body size with ease.

entry: POKENAME以强烈凝视吸引路人，再表演、模仿逗大家开心。等玩腻了，便秀一招压轴戏，迅速溜走。
author: arcul
source: POKENAME's intense gaze draws the attention of passersby, when it will then begin to entertain and imitate them. When it grows bored, it performs a final grand trick before quickly fleeing.

entry: POKENAME野外几乎不见，传闻现身预示大事将至，命运向前迈一步。不过好坏皆有可能，见到最好做好准备。
author: b_e_n_jamin_
source: Although it is nearly nonexistent in the wild, there are rumors that POKENAME show up to signify a big event- a step towards destiny. However, this event can be good or bad, so if you see one it is best to brace yourself.

entry: POKENAME喙碰电脑设备，会瞥见与设备主人有关的未来。可它也吃设备，因此每吃一次，都极苦恼。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME catches glimpses of the future when its beak touches computer equipment, based on whoever owned the device. This unfortunately causes it great distress whenever it consumes said equipment.

entry: POKENAME天生好奇，许多人归因于发达大脑与强大精神能量。虽仍容易受惊，感到威胁却会喷火。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are naturally curious Pokémon, which many attribute to their well-developed brains and potent psychic energies. Though still quick to startle, they will resort to spewing flames if they feel threatened.

entry: POKENAME入战时静立，直到察觉敌意才出击。只要曾交手一次，就能轻松看穿对方的策略模式。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Standing perfectly still when it enters battle, POKENAME will not strike until it senses hostility. If it has fought an opponent once before, it will be able to read the patterns of their strategy effortlessly.

entry: POKENAME站得纹丝不动，试图融入周围。虽然浑身鲜艳，仍善于隐藏在眼前，仿佛凭空消失。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME stand perfectly still in order to try and become one with their surroundings. They are able to hide in plain sight well enough to seemingly disappear despite the vibrant colors along their bodies.

entry: POKENAME常预见即将到来的灾难，却难确定地点。它尽快赶去警告人们，却常得再等着看哪里最需要自己。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME frequently experience visions of approaching future distaters, but have trouble narrowing down the locations where they will take place. They rush to warn people as soon as possible, but often have to wait and see where they're needed most.

entry: POKENAME在夜间无声飘行，小身体披着阴影。眼周花纹发光，性格又顽皮，会用超能力制造诡异幻象，捉弄旅人。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME drifts silently through the night, its small body cloaked in shadows. With glowing markings around its eyes and a mischievous nature, it plays tricks on unsuspecting travelers while using its psychic powers to create eerie illusions.

entry: POKENAME一眼察敌意，赶忙自卫。不过，有时感应到的未来敌意，恰是自己先攻击引起，弄得战斗无故开始。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are able to sense hostility from a single glance, rushing to defend themselves from any incoming threats. However, they occasionally sense the future hostility in response to their own attacks, causing their battles to start for no reason.

entry: POKENAME拍翼释放杏子与薄荷混合般的安抚香。许多调香师试着仿制，却至今未能完全重现。
author: .izik
source: When flapping its wings, POKENAME releases a calming scent resembling a blend of apricots and mint. Many perfumers have attempted to replicate this aroma but have yet to do so perfectly.

entry: POKENAME一动不动时，据说在窥看不同于我们的世界。这时不回应互动，暗影双翼却会本能拂开打扰者。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME stands stock-still, it is believed to be peering into a world different from our own. It doesn't respond to interactions during this time, though its shadowy wings instinctively brush away anything trying to bother it.

entry: POKENAME通常不爬、不飞上树，而在地面用背炮射激光，切下头顶枝条。掉落后，再用喙吃叶和果子。
author: .jerden
source: Rather than climbing or flying up into trees, POKENAME usually remains on the ground, cutting through branches above it by firing laser beams from the cannon on its back. After they have fallen, POKENAME will use its beak to eat leaves and fruit.

entry: POKENAME预见钥匙何时丢，好找回来还给主人。可它不懂，往往正是自己挪动钥匙，才导致最初的失踪。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME predicts when keys go missing in order to find them and return them to their owners. What POKENAME doesn't realize is that its moving of the keys is often what leads them to go missing in the first place.

entry: POKENAME视力敏锐、超能力强，从不跟丢猎物。这些本领，也让它是搜救任务的出色伙伴。
author: cait_sith
source: Due to its sharp eyesight and psychic powers, POKENAME never loses track of its prey. These qualities also make it an excellent partner for search and rescue missions.

entry: POKENAME掘地时常看见过去。历史片段闪过，身体就突然停止，直到景象结束，暂时定在原地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME will frequently get visions of the past while it digs. During this time, its body will come to an abrupt stop until the vision ends, leaving it temporarily frozen in place as it experiences flashes of history.

entry: POKENAME不会飞，就靠圆身体弹跳，够最爱的树果。吃太多，一入水便直沉到底。
author: fiordaliso
source: Since POKENAME cannot fly, it bounces using its round body to reach the Berries it loves. If it overeats, it sinks straight to the bottom the moment it steps into the water.

entry: POKENAME身体浮力足，哪怕海浪很猛，也能轻松漂着。察觉危险，它不迎战，更爱瞬间移动到安全处。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its buoyant body allows it to stay afloat effortlessly, even when the sea is particularly rough. When POKENAME senses danger, instead of facing it, it prefers to get to safety by teleporting elsewhere.

entry: POKENAME若预见坏事，就用喙吸气，飘上天空，试着远离看到的不祥未来，退避直到危险过去。
author: .izik
source: Should POKENAME foresee a bad event, it will inhale air through its beak and drift into the sky, attempting to distance itself from the negative future it envisions and retreating until the danger passes.

entry: POKENAME壳的重量刚好平衡巨头。若翻倒，必须用脚挖坑，落进去才恢复重心。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's shell is just heavy enough to counterbalance its massive head. If it tips over, it must dig a hole with its feet and fall into it to recover its center of gravity.

entry: 研究发现，人和宝可梦都很少能盯住POKENAME超过几秒。参与者说主要因为外貌令人不安，研究者却推测可能有精神干扰。
author: wiz0z
source: Studies have found that few people and Pokémon manage to maintain focus on POKENAME for longer than a few seconds. Participants cited its disturbing appearance as the main cause, but researchers speculate on possible psychic interference.

entry: POKENAME每周收一次树枝，用火点燃，凝视烟雾。有人说，它在从烟形解读未来。
author: sk372
source: Once a week, POKENAME gathers sticks together to light up with its flames and gaze into the smoke it creates. Some say it's attempting to discern future events through the smoke's shapes.

entry: POKENAME坐在林中，透过斑驳树叶看太阳。看饿了，就用超能力打落上方树果，果子撞上橡胶般的皮，也只是无伤弹开。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME sit in forests watching the sun through the dappled leaves. If they get hungry during their viewing, they will use their psychic powers to drop berries from the trees above them, the berries bouncing harmlessly off of their rubbery skin.

entry: POKENAME体型看似庞大，其实大多是绒毛，因此十分轻。跃起后，它们能浮得足够久，让风接住，推动它们继续前行。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Despite the apparent bulk of their bodies, POKENAME are very light due to being mostly fluff. They can float long enough after a jump for the wind to catch them and propel them forwards on their travels.

entry: POKENAME完全失明，却能用超能力极精准地感知周围。双翼负责转向，飞行主要靠悬浮。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are completely blind, but they can use their psychic powers to sense the area aound them with impressive accuracy. While they use their wings to steer, they mainly fly through levitation.

entry: POKENAME会黏住预见适合同行的训练家或大宝可梦。初遇未必总理想，却从不找错真正的朋友。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME cling onto Trainers or larger Pokémon that they predict will be good travel companions. While the initial meetings may not always be ideal, POKENAME never fail to find true friends.

entry: POKENAME的帽子极易燃。准备进化时，群体把宝石堆在一起，在原生地烈日下跳仪式舞，直到帽子烧光。
author: jangodiot
source: The hats found on POKENAME are extremely flammable. When ready to evolve, groups of POKENAME gather their gemstones into a single pile and perform a ritual dance beneath the harsh sun of their natural habitat until their hats burn away.

entry: POKENAME靠体型与锐眼，迅速察觉任何危险靠近。颈褶散出的精神脉冲，帮助击退威胁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's size and sharp eyesight alert it quickly to the approach of anything that could be dangerous. Psychic pulses that radiate from its frill help fend off these approaching dangers.

entry: POKENAME在极地栖地奔跑，羽毛形成保温层。它能预见小好运，冰钓者会跟着找鱼获丰盛的位置。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's feathers form a protective thermal layer as it scampers around its arctic habitat. It can foresee minor good fortune, so ice fishers will follow one to find a good spot to catch a lot of food.

entry: POKENAME偶尔瞥见短暂未来，但大多平淡无奇。据说头上唯一的羽毛是来源，不过证据尚不足。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME experience transient glimpses into the future, though the events they see are typically lackluster. The singular feather on their head is said to be the source of their visions, though the evidence is inconclusive.

entry: POKENAME头上每片球形花瓣都有独特花纹，不懂的人看着却相似。除了好看，还能放大精神力量。
author: entomoxie
source: Each spherical petal on a POKENAME's head is uniquely patterned, though these patterns can seem similar to untrained eyes. In addition to looking nice, they can amplify psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME头上每片球形花瓣都有独特花纹，不懂的人看着却相似。除了好看，还能放大精神力量。
author: entomoxie
source: Each spherical petal on a POKENAME's head is uniquely patterned, though these patterns can seem similar to untrained eyes. In addition to looking nice, they can amplify psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME栖在枝头，凭锐眼远观战斗，记录不同宝可梦的招式。其他宝可梦常来请教，如何破解它看过的技巧。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME perches on tree limbs and observes fights from afar with its strong eyesight, cataloging the moves of different Pokémon. Pokémon often come to seek its advice on how to counter the techniques it has witnessed.

entry: POKENAME察觉谁未来有苦难，就不由自主地从背上图腾形蘑菇大量放出绿孢子。谁吸入都头晕，连自己也一样。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME senses that someone's future holds distress, it involuntarily releases large amounts of green spores from the totem-shaped mushroom on its back. This causes dizziness in anyone who inhales them, including itself.

entry: POKENAME能预见最远10分钟后的事。若预知有人进入觅食地，就避开那里数周。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can foresee events up to ten minutes ahead. If it predicts someone entering its feeding ground, it avoids the area for weeks.

entry: 自古POKENAME羽毛便是热门首饰配件，被视为未来繁荣的象征。它旅行时常故意撒羽，盼延续传统与希望。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Since ancient times, POKENAME feathers have been popular accessories for jewelry as they were believed to be symbols of a prosperous future. POKENAME often purposefully scatter feathers on their travels to try and keep the tradition and hopes going.

entry: 哪怕眼见敌人冲来，POKENAME也来不及作合理反应。科学家认为，它忙着缓解持续头痛，常顾不上处理现实世界。
author: bobosmith01
source: Even if POKENAME sees a foe charging at it, POKENAME will fail to react in any reasonable amount of time. Scientists believe that POKENAME is so preoccupied trying to ease its constant headaches that it often fails to process the physical world.

entry: POKENAME若预见有坏事将要发生，毛发便会变得极热，足以点燃干燥叶片。因此，它升高的热量，也成了危险的先兆。
author: .izik
source: Should POKENAME see in the future that something bad is going to happen, its fur will become incredibly hot. Its fur can get hot enough to cause fires in dry foliage, making it a harbinger of danger when its heat increases.

entry: POKENAME站着睡，有时甚至睁眼。做梦时，尾火可能变换多种颜色。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME sleeps while standing upright, sometimes even while keeping its eyes open. The flame on its tail may change into a variety of different colors as it dreams.

entry: POKENAME白天大多抱臂静思。偶尔盯汤匙中的倒影，可看出了什么，无人知晓。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends much of the day staying still with its arms crossed in contemplation. Occasionally it stares into its reflection in its spoon, but what it ascertains from this is unknown.

entry: POKENAME不断与人合作训练，提升身心。矿工喜欢它热情，又能预见灾难，及时发起疏散。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME constantly works to improve its mind and body, training by cooperating with humans. Miners enjoy working with it due to its enthusiasm, and because its foresight leads it to start an evacuation if it foresees disaster.

entry: POKENAME靠超能力迅速理解听到的任何语言，懂得各地区战斗者的指令，借此完善身体本领。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME uses its psychic abilities to speedily comprehend any language spoken to it. It uses this knowledge to understand commands of combatants from all regions as it perfects its physical abilities.

entry: POKENAME天生好奇，习惯摇摆走近人，默默盯双眼，既可爱又让人发毛。
author: banquoviaquo
source: POKENAME are very curious by nature, but their habit of waddling up close to people and staring them in the eyes silently puts them somewhere between cute and unnerving.

entry: POKENAME目光锐利，反应更快。采食时见东西靠近，便用强臂把全身弹离地面，猛撞来者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has sharp eyesight and even sharper reflexes. If it spots something approaching while out gathering food, it flings itself off the ground with its strong arms and hurtles its entire body towards the interloper.

entry: POKENAME预见未来时，头火变深蓝。此时完全不动，全部心神都在眼前景象。
author: .izik
source: The flame on POKENAME's head turns a deep blue while it is looking into the future. During this time, it is completely immobile, its focus solely on the visions it perceives.

entry: POKENAME善跳，许多训练家便搭迷你跳跃赛道，丰富日常活动。如今成了小众爱好，还有小团体办比赛。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME is a good hopper, so many trainers make them miniature jumping courses as enrichment. It has turned into a niche hobby, and small groups hold competitions.

entry: POKENAME平时收拢头羽，威吓时展开。这比它始终凶巴巴的目光，更能可靠地表明敌意。
author: banquoviaquo
source: The plume on POKENAME's head is usually kept folded down, but flares up in threat displays: a more reliable indicator of aggression than its perpetually-surly stare.

entry: POKENAME尝试不同磁力模式，看哪种电荷组合能让东西浮起。若找不到办法，就爆发精神力量，试着把附近全举起来。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME experiement with their magnetic patterns to determine which combination of charges will cause an object to levitate. Should they struggle to find a method, they will unleash a burst of psychic power to try and lift everything in the area.

entry: POKENAME在枝条啄孔，嵌入坚硬矿物，帮助集中精神力量。击中时，矿物彼此共鸣，增强精神振动，让简单打击也更有力。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME peck out holes in branches to insert sturdy minerals that can help them focus their psychic powers. When struck, the minerals resonate with each other, amplifying psychic vibrations for more power behind simple strikes.

entry: POKENAME每个头能专注完全不同的目标，再完美合作，各自达成。若三个头同时盯你，绝不是好兆头。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: Each of POKENAME's heads can focus on entirely different objectives, and then work together flawlessly to accomplish each. It is never a good sign if all three heads stare at you at once.

entry: 巨牙鲨追来，POKENAME就用超能力制造漩涡。它游得慢，这水中防御恰能帮助逃敌。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its psychic abilities to create whirlpools if it is being pursued by Sharpedo. This is useful as it is a slow swimmer, allowing it to escape from predators with its watery defense.

entry: POKENAME的喙比钻石硬，轻松凿石。吃宝石时，过去的景象会猛烈涌现，让它与世界历史联系更深。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's beak is harder than diamond, allowing it to dig through stone with little effort. When it eats gems, it experiences intense visions of the past, giving it a deeper connection to the history of the world.

entry: POKENAME是快如闪电、坚韧如钻石的战士。据说脚一接触对手，就能在心中看见其过去未来。
author: princessmilandria
source: POKENAME is a warrior quick as lightning and tough as diamonds. It is said to see an opponent's past and future in its mind's eye when its foot makes contact.

entry: 许多拳手喜欢与快拳郎切磋，唯有世界顶尖者才敢找POKENAME。超能力让它在对手还没想到出招前，就看见攻击，战斗占尽优势。
author: jangodiot
source: Though many boxers like to spar with Hitmonchan, only the best in the world try to do so with a POKENAME. Their psychic power allows them to see attacks before the opponent even thinks about performing them, giving POKENAME a massive edge in combat.

entry: POKENAME的卷须独立于身体活动。给笔纸，就自行写预言，哪怕本体正睡着。
author: cenizarey
source: POKENAME's tendrils move independently of its body. If given pen and paper, they scrawl prophecies of their own accord, even if the host is sleeping at the time.

entry: POKENAME久久站在一处，望向地平线，防水双翼护头，遮雨挡阳。孩子常想逗出反应，多数却连一颤也换不到。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME stares out into the horizon, remaining in one place for long periods of time as its waterproof wings shield its head from rain or sunlight. Children often try to get a reaction out of it, though most fail to get even a flinch.

entry: POKENAME群不断迁往世界最佳观星点。旅途中，它们自己常被误认成流星。
author: cenizarey
source: Flocks of POKENAME are in a constant state of migration to wherever in the world has the best stargazing spots. During these journeys, they are often mistaken for shooting stars themselves.

entry: POKENAME是城都邮政的重要一环，为亲友运输花案邮件。也能兼任分拣员，轻易认出与自身颜色相配的邮件。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are an essential part of the Johto postal service, as they transport Flower Mail between friends and family. They also double as sorters, as they easily identify mail that matches their coloration.

entry: POKENAME略能窥见未来，用眼睛一连串闪光传达景象，代表二进制代码，供人解码翻译。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses a modicum of insight into the future. It communicates its visions with a series of flashes from its eyes that represent binary code, to be decoded and translated.

entry: POKENAME四处迁居，按只有自己懂的日程换睡处。科学家花了大量时间解读移动规律。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is nomadic, moving to a new sleeping area based on a schedule only it understands. Scientists have devoted much time to deciphering its movement patterns.

entry: 过去人们信POKENAME的蜕皮留有神秘力量，拿来煮药，据说能让饮用者短暂预见未来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's shed skin was once believed to hold some of its mystical power. Potions were brewed using the discarded skin, said to grant the drinker the temporary ability to see into the future.

entry: POKENAME通常挖空树桩筑巢，唯有遇险才以念力悬浮。它俯冲，把巨大毒针像钉子般扎进敌人，消除威胁。
author: ghostslythe
source: Usually found hollowing out tree stumps for nests, POKENAME only start psychically hovering when in danger. To finish the threat, they nosedive while driving in their oversized stinger as a nail.

entry: POKENAME发达的精神头脑能窥见遥远未来。不知看见什么，它似乎觉得一切毫无意义，疏远其他宝可梦，也不给来访者好脸色。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's advanced psychic mind glimpses into the distant future. Whatever it has seen appears to have given it a nihilistic personality, distancing it from other Pokémon and reacting negatively to visitors.

entry: POKENAME能预见谁靠近，瞬间移动走。因此曾被以为只是本地早期定居者创造的传说。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can foresee anyone approaching it, and it has the ability to teleport away in an instant. As a result, it was thought to be a myth created by early settlers of the region.

entry: POKENAME能静立数小时，望未来等待。值得一战的敌人靠近，身体便燃起热焰，空气扭动。战中几乎无人能碰到它，许多对手化为灰烬。
author: jonclyd
source: POKENAME can stand motionless for hours, gazing into the future as it waits. When a worthy foe nears, its body ignites with heat, the air shimmers, and in battle it is nearly untouchable, reducing many who oppose it to ashes.

entry: 有人推测，许多古雕刻画的并非天然鸟或猫头夜鹰，而是POKENAME。研究表明，数个古村落曾崇拜它，视为赐人知识的存在。
author: bobosmith01
source: It has been speculated that many old carvings did not depict Xatu or Noctowl, but instead POKENAME. Studies suggest several ancient villages worshipped it as a being that anointed others in knowledge.

entry: POKENAME织网时，丝线看似随意。其实它预见了捕住未来猎物所需的位置。
author: cenizarey
source: When POKENAME spins webs, it places strands in a seemingly random pattern. In truth, it is predicting the strands that will be necessary to capture future prey.

entry: 白天，POKENAME一动不动地凝望太阳。夜幕一落，便飞上天空，出门寻猎。
author: darkweavile428
source: During the day, POKENAME stands perfectly still and stares at the sun, but as soon as night falls, it takes to the skies in search of prey.

entry: 传闻POKENAME一见流星，就能瞥到未来碎片。精神力量虽强，它仍太小，不会管理能量，需要大量休息。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to rumors, POKENAME can glimpse a fragment of the future when it sees a shooting star. Despite its great psychic powers, it requires plenty of rest, as it is still too young to manage its energy.

entry: 人们信天然鸟能预知，却不爱分享；POKENAME反而热情传达预测。可它似乎全凭盲目乐观，未必真有预见。
author: anonymous_16803
source: Unlike Xatu, who are trusted to see the future yet reticent to share it, POKENAME enthusiastically conveys its predictions. They appear to be guided by blind optimism alone rather than genuine foresight.

entry: 据说POKENAME祝福即将遇大逆境的人。传闻这份祝福，能让人连最黑暗的时代也坚忍度过。
author: b_e_n_jamin_
source: POKENAME is said to bless those who are about to face great adversity. It is rumored that these blessings can give someone the strength to persevere through even the darkest of eras.

entry: POKENAME用超能力感知遇险的人，再瞬间移动到对方身边，展开救援。救下人后，它会送出自己的一根羽毛，给所有触碰羽毛的人带来好运。
author: agostostino
source: POKENAME detects people who are in danger with its psychic powers, teleporting to where a person is to rescue them. When POKENAME saves someone, it will give them one of its feathers, which brings good luck to whoever touches it.

entry: POKENAME能瞥见未来，却常模糊不清，难以理解。它对景象反应过度，常让训练家与其他宝可梦也不安。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can see glimpses of the future, but the future is often so hazy and unclear that they have a difficult time making sense of what they see. They often overreact to the visions they have, which distresses their Trainer and other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME能看见过去与未来。有人甚至推测，它能改变某些事情，最终的结果。
author: manandesz
source: POKENAME has the power to peer into the future and past. Some theorize it even has the power to change the outcomes of certain events.

entry: POKENAME栖在高枝，时不时歪头，似乎全不在意周围。据说若突然起飞，便是预见未来灾难。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME perches on high branches, cocking its head at random while seemingly oblivious to anything else near it. It is believed that if it suddenly takes off in flight, it has seen a vision of future disaster.

entry: 曾有人在森林发现一个末日教团，身边有POKENAME，它因此成了“终末”的象征。诡异的是，现场所有个体移到各实验室后，几天内全消失了。
author: jangodiot
source: This Pokémon has become synonymous with signs of 'the end times' after a doomsday cult was found in a forest with these Pokémon. Mysteriously, despite being relocated to various labs, all POKENAME that were found at the scene disappeared days after.

entry: POKENAME能高高站立，数周不动，凝视远方。每只模样不同，腹纹随居住环境而变。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME stand tall and unmoving for weeks at a time, staring off into the distance. Each one differs in appearance, the patterns along their stomachs varying based on the environment they live in.

entry: 城都一带，人们会收集POKENAME微毒的羽毛，干燥后碾成粉，再拿来当烟吸食。这会让吸食者看见鲜活的梦境，有人声称，甚至能看见未来。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: In the Johto region, people are known to collect POKENAME's slightly toxic feathers and dry them so they can be crumbled into a powder. Smoking this causes the user to see vivid dreams, with some saying that they can see the future.

entry: 城都一带，人们会收集POKENAME零星蜕下的皮，干燥后碾成粉，再拿来当烟吸食。这会让吸食者看见鲜活的梦境，有人声称，甚至能看见未来。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: In the Johto region, people are known to collect POKENAME's slightly shed skin and dry it so it can be crumbled into a powder. Smoking this causes the user to see vivid dreams, with some saying that they can see the future.

entry: POKENAME沐浴阳光时，身上的球体便会发光。谁若碰到发光的球，就能看见自己的过去或未来，具体取决于触碰哪一颗。
author: darkweavile428
source: When POKENAME is bathed in sunlight, the orbs on its body begin to glow. If someone were to touch one of the glowing orbs, they could view either their past or future depending on which orb they touch.

entry: POKENAME整天看未来，平静无视挑衅。智慧虽高到能规划有利时间线，却宁愿寻找附近鲤鱼王这辈子跳得最高的一跃。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: It gazes into the future all day, calmly ignoring all provocations. While POKENAME's intellect is prodigious enough to chart courses toward favorable timelines, it prefers to search for the highest jumps nearby Magikarp will ever make.

entry: POKENAME有眼皮，却选择不用。夜里看地、白天望天，仿佛追随太阳移动。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME has an eyelid, but it chooses not to use it. It stares at the ground at night and up at the sky during the day, almost like it tracks the sun's movements.

entry: POKENAME受过去景象困扰，逃不开历史回响。它常把脸埋进泥，拼命想挡住没完没了的画面。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is plagued by visions of past events, unable to escape the echoes of history. It often buries its face in the mud in a desperate attempt to block out these relentless sights.

entry: POKENAME对未来的鲜明预见，让它感知危险何时降临。眨眼间，就能用角截住牙爪，把袭击者掀得四脚朝天。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have vivid visions of the future that allows them to sense when danger is about to strike. Within the blink of an eye, they can intercept fangs and talons with their horn to flip their assailant onto their backs.

entry: POKENAME移动时，诡异绿火在全身闪动，让空气生出古怪热影。热影照片中，可瞥见变化后的景观，研究者推测那是未来。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Eerie green flames flicker across POKENAME's body as they move, creating strange heat shimmers in the air. Photographs of the heat shimmers show glimpses of altered landscapes; researchers theorise these are glimpses of the future.

entry: POKENAME轻松游水，从喙射击，狙击较弱宝可梦。它预见未来，确保发发命中。
author: chartanon
source: POKENAME effortlessly swims through the water, sniping weaker Pokémon with shots from its beak. It foresees the future to ensures its shots will always hit.

entry: POKENAME拍长耳占卜未来，找到最佳滚动路线，避开危险宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME scry into the future by flapping their long ears. They find the best places to roll where they can remain safe from dangerous Pokémon.

entry: 据说POKENAME能占卜未来，却只能用旧打印机印出信息。打印机神秘地半途停下，让解读很困难。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are said to be able to scry into the future, but they can only print out this information onto old printers. These printers mysteriously stop printing halfway through, making deciphering information difficult.

entry: 据说POKENAME能画出过去未来，却常想同时画，结果作品极超现实。它常盯自己的画，仿佛也想解读。
author: drcew
source: POKENAME is said to have the ability to paint the past and future, though it often attempts to depict both simultaneously, resulting in very surreal paintings. POKENAME is often seen staring at its own works, seemingly trying to decipher them.

entry: POKENAME是细心的医生助手，病人还没进门，就认出症状疾病。若预见手术有问题，会喂病人一颗自己的蛋，帮助恢复。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME make for very attentive doctor assistants, recognizing symptoms and ailments before the patient even arrives in the room. If a POKENAME predicts an issue with a surgery, it will feed the patient one of its eggs to help them recover.

entry: POKENAME望将来的雷云，向预见落雷处甩尾。它停在没装避雷针的树或房顶，先吸走电，不让击中人和宝可梦。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gaze at incoming storm clouds and flick their tails where they predict that lightning will strike. They perch atop trees or homes without lightning rods to absorb the electricity before it can hit any people or Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用预知未来，识别今后可能受污染的水源。科学家追踪目击报告，提前防治污染。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME uses its Future Sight to identify water sources that may become contaminated in the future. Scientists keep track of reported sightings to take preventative action against pollution.

entry: POKENAME先闭眼收翼，再展翼，睁开发光双眼。最后，一道灾难般的闪电从天落下，击中敌人。
author: bobosmith01
source: First, POKENAME close their eyes and curl their wings inward. Next, they spread their wings back out and open their now glowing eyes. Finally, a calamitous bolt of lightning comes from the sky to strike their foe.

entry: POKENAME定期飞过天空，在猛烈风暴后造彩虹。神话称，凝望彩虹者会预见自己的未来。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are known to periodically soar across the skies, creating rainbows after volatile storms. In mythology those who peered into the rainbows created by POKENAME would see premonitions of their own futures.

entry: POKENAME用超能力预知小火马赛跑中的冷门胜者，结果一公布便消失。占卜者与赌徒都想找到，精进本领。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are known for using their psychic powers to predict the wins of underdogs in Ponyta races, disappearing shortly after the results are announced. Fortune tellers and gamblers alike search for POKENAME in the hopes of improving their craft.

entry: POKENAME的超能力让其他智慧生灵想献食。据说古文化会依赖它回赠的预报，预测将至灾难。
author: bobosmith01
source: Due to POKENAME's psychic powers, other beings of intelligence feel inclined to give offerings of food to POKENAME. Supposedly, older cultures would then rely on a reciprocal forecast from POKENAME to predict oncoming disasters.

entry: POKENAME先把尾巴的尖刺钩进地里，再抬起身体，沐浴阳光。它们预判猎物的飞行路线，张开爪子静立不动，再从空中一把抓住。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME hook the spikes on their tails into the ground before raising themselves into the air to bask beneath sunlight. They predict the flight patterns of their prey, standing perfectly still with their claws open and grabbing them out of the air.

entry: POKENAME吃邮件数据时，会随机看见相关人员的过去未来。一封群发邮件，常让它承受不住。
author: .izik
source: When consuming email data, POKENAME has random visions about the past and future of those associated with the message. This can be overwhelming when it consumes an email sent to multiple people.

entry: POKENAME大脑发达，能短暂窥未来。虽有强火自卫，却更爱预先避开冲突。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are capable of briefly seeing into the future due to their highly-developed brains. Though they can defend themselves with strong flames, POKENAME prefer to simply avoid conflict and use their foresight to do so.

entry: POKENAME头脑强，每次快速打击都精密计算。速度若失效，就用精神力量定住敌人，再发动连番近身攻击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are capable of rapid physical strikes that are each calculated with precision thanks to their powerful minds. If their speed somehow fails them, they can then hold their opponent with psychic power and unleash a barrage of physical strikes.

entry: POKENAME既精通武术，也拥有强大的超能力。它的超能力足以窥见未来，因此能预判对手的出招。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME is adept in martial arts and it has powerful psychic powers as well. Its psychic powers are strong enough that it can see into the future, which allows it to predict the moves of its opponents.

entry: 某个极古老文明里，POKENAME同时象征永恒与怯懦。尤其是过强的预见感，让它避免冒险。
author: bobosmith01
source: In one particularly ancient civilization, POKENAME's image was associated with both eternity and cowardice. In particular, POKENAME has an overpowering sense of foresight that causes it to avoid taking risks.

entry: POKENAME主动寻找小型聚落，想去守护。可谜一般的力量，与让人不安的模样，往往换来人类的疏远。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME seeks out small communities to protect. However, its enigmatic power and unsettling nature often leads to humans shunning it instead.

entry: POKENAME战中动作谨慎精算，许多人相信，它先看未来中对方怎么打，再照景象行动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's movements in battle are so careful and calculated that many believe it gazes into the future to see how its opponent will fight, and moves according to that vision.

entry: POKENAME的翼独立活动，感知威胁并挡住。它背后戴特性护具，确保双翼不受妨碍，随时抵挡攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's wings move independently of itself, as its wings detect threats and shift to block them. It wears an Ability Shield behind its back to ensure that its wings remain free to block attacks.

entry: POKENAME根据预见的未来主动变色。危险到前先融入环境，威胁尚未现身，就已避开。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME actively changes color in response to the future it foresees. By blending into its surroundings before danger arrives, it avoids threats before they even appear.

entry: 据说古文明呼唤灵魂指引时，POKENAME会从火焰现身。预言起初或许朦胧，却总会成真。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: It is said that when ancient civilizations called on spirits to guide them, POKENAME would appear from the flames. While its predictions may seem hazy at first, they always ring true.

entry: 有人说，盯POKENAME的头，会看见自己身处记不起的情境。研究者怀疑它能预示未来碎片，但证据不足。
author: jangodiot
source: People say that when they stare into its head, they see themselves in situations they cannot recall. Researchers wonder if POKENAME can foretell fragments of the future, but evidence is inconclusive.

entry: 研究者估计，POKENAME头中同时藏着无数景象，无法理解。每个看进去的人，都报告之后做了恐怖噩梦。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME's head contains what researchers estimate to be countless visions at once. The visions are incomprehensible, and all who look into them report horrific nightmares afterward.

entry: POKENAME虽能预见今后每场灾难，却无力改变命运。它默栖高崖，哀悼救不了的生命。
author: amiel997
source: Though POKENAME can foresee every disaster that will ever occur, it is powerless to alter fate. It perches silently on high cliffs, mourning the lives it is unable to save.

entry: POKENAME安静，通常住各气候区的山顶。常立崖边，观察下方世界，用超能力从空中捉鸟宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are quiet Pokémon that typically live atop mountains of any climate. They often stand near cliffs and observe the world below them, snatching bird Pokémon from the air with their psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME占卜未来，找最佳路线。平时躲训练家，因此偶然有幸遇见，被视为好运。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME scry into the future to find the best routes to travel through. A fortuitous meeting with a POKENAME is considered lucky since they typically avoid Trainers.

entry: 古记录称，有群人相信POKENAME是人与神之间的中介。颜色鲜艳，也常出现在儿童填色书里。
author: bobosmith01
source: According to ancient records, there was a group of people who believed POKENAME acted as a mediator between humans and the divine. Due to its bright coloration, it is often depicted in children's coloring books.

entry: 家养POKENAME能预知训练家战中的每道命令。若不同意下一步，就回头盯着，直到对方改主意。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: A domestic POKENAME is able to predict any command that its Trainer will give during battle. If it disagrees with the next instruction, it will turn back to stare at its Trainer until they change their mind.

entry: POKENAME的大脑与3个天然雀模样的小鼻子伙伴心灵相连。每个各盯一个方向，任何攻击都无法偷袭。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's brain is psychically linked with the brains of its three Natu-nose companions. Each Natu-nose keeps watch in a different direction so no attacks can ambush them.

entry: POKENAME翼上两头分别看过去未来，中头负责解读，并传给主体。它们静止，直到察觉灾难，就飞去帮有需要者。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The two heads atop a POKENAME's wings watch into the past and future respectively, leaving the middle head to interpret and communicate with the main body. They remain motionless until they sense disaster and then fly off to help those in need.

entry: POKENAME是完美守卫，若无挑衅，能高站数日。它能看未来，预知危险到来，作相应行动。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME make for the perfect guards, standing tall for days at a time unless provoked. These Pokémon have the ability to see the future, allowing them to predict when danger will arrive and act accordingly.

entry: 有些古描绘表明，POKENAME曾被视为警告人类的神。神话说，它若停在某镇最高处，便是警告数月内毁灭将临。
author: sk372
source: Some ancient depictions of POKENAME suggest it was seen as a deity that warned humanity. According to myths, if it perched upon the highest point of a given town, it was a warning that ruination would arrive in the coming months.

entry: POKENAME眺望水面，观察波浪与水流。救生员常训练它监测离岸流、风暴和海啸。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gaze across the water and watch the flow of waves and currents. Lifeguards often train POKENAME to watch for riptides, storms, and tsunamis.

entry: 许多人认为POKENAME是侍奉全能神的化身。外貌古怪，多数人怕靠近，它内心却温柔善良。
author: sk372
source: Many have thought of POKENAME as an avatar working for an almighty deity. Most are afraid to approach it because of its strange appearance, but it is gentle and kind at heart.

entry: 有些地区把POKENAME视为希望象征。据说触碰缎带，能看见幸福未来，鼓励人努力实现。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is seen as a symbol of hope in some regions. Coming into contact with its ribbons is said to instill visions of a happy future, inspiring people to work towards making it a reality.

entry: POKENAME常仗势威吓别人，却会在预见未来时突然停下。整个过程纹丝不动，一结束，又继续暴走。
author: sk372
source: While POKENAME is prone to throwing its weight around and intimidating others, it will suddenly stop the moment it receives a vision of the future. It stands stock-still for the vision's duration before going right back to its rampage.

entry: POKENAME力量巨大，全身每只眼各看一条时间线。据说它在巨型图腾柱上刻自己模样，散放守护的各地。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME possesses immense strength and sees a different timeline through each eye covering its body. It is said to carve its own likeness into massive totem poles, leaving them scattered across the lands it protects.

entry: POKENAME浮在高空，留意需要帮助的人。若谁需保护，就降下锁链，缠住对方而不伤害，再将来袭攻击引向别处。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME floats high in the sky to watch for people in need. If someone is in need of protection, it will send down chains to harmlessly wrap around them and instead redirect incoming attacks.

entry: POKENAME预知入侵者何时近巢，凭无双速度，提前数小时逃走。因此野外只能趁它睡觉时看见。
author: cenizarey
source: POKENAME uses its future-seeing abilities to predict when intruders will approach its nest, and uses its peerless speed to escape hours before they arrive. As such, it can only be seen in the wild when it is sleeping.

entry: POKENAME是活图腾，被当作窥未来的灵性器具。部族长老向古老巨蔓藤求指引，解读它身上的预见符号。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME are living totems used as spiritual devices to glimpse the future. To interpret these visions, tribal elders seek guidance from ancient Tangrowth, who help them translate the future-seeing symbols on their bodies.

entry: 旧部族留下的描绘常称，POKENAME的烟能让人看未来，甚至灵界。却无证据支持，烟似乎只造成不同幻觉。
author: infinex21
source: Depictions left over by tribes of the past often claim that the smoke of a POKENAME allows one to see into the future, or perhaps into the world of spirits. No proof supports this, as this smoke only seems to cause varying hallucinations.

entry: POKENAME常几个小时不眨眼，凝望远方，有人说，这是在窥探未来。它们的翅膀如同巨大的斧刃，能让它们高速滑过天空。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME often stare into the distance unblinkingly for hours, which some claim to be because they are peering into the future. Their wings are like large axe blades that allow them to glide through the sky at great speeds.

entry: POKENAME用超能力看最远10分钟后的事，决定是否离开海底惯常的休息处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its psychic abilities to peer up to 10 minutes into the future. It relies on this foresight to decide whether it should move from its usual resting spot on the seafloor.

entry: POKENAME能捕获熟睡者的噩梦，再将噩梦，化为梦雾。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME are used to capture the nightmares of sleeping people. When it captures a nightmare, it turns it into Dream Mist.

entry: POKENAME做成天然鸟模样的伪装，想与它同住。可伪装没翼可抬起沟通，只好用下方黑暗造临时假翼，常把天然鸟吓到。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fashions a disguise resembling Xatu in order to coexist alongside it. Its disguise lacks wings to raise to communicate, so it creates temporary false wings from the darkness underneath, often scaring Xatu in the process.

entry: POKENAME始终把两只翼叠在身前。传说，它守着一道预言的知识，详述末日般的灾难。
author: cenizarey
source: POKENAME keeps two of its wings folded over its body at all times. According to legend, it is guarding knowledge regarding a prophecy that details an apocalyptic disaster.

entry: 许多人说，POKENAME空白目光是因同时远观多条时间线。它不断看见小屋被毁的种种可能，永远静默沉思。
author: .izik
source: Many say POKENAME's blank gaze is due to its ability to remotely view multiple timelines at once. It constantly sees the many ways its lodge could be destroyed, leaving it in a perpetual state of silent contemplation.

entry: 据说POKENAME能预知未来。可唯一记录证据，只是猎物一出洞，它似乎总会冒出来。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: It is said that POKENAME can foretell the future. However, the only recorded evidence of this is that POKENAME always seems to pop up whenever its prey emerges from burrows.

entry: POKENAME静立，用精神能量把宝石托在空中。据说宝石灌注着与太阳相连的神秘能量。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME spend their time standing still, holding gems up in the air with psychic energy. It is said that the gems they hold are imbued with a mystical energy connected to the sun.

entry: POKENAME的未来景象帮助避险。有人称，点燃其叶制成的蜡烛，也能给人同样的占卜能力，但未证实。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have visions of the future that help them avoid danger. Some people claim that by burning candles made out of POKENAME leaves can give people the same future scrying abilities, though this has yet to be proven as fact.

entry: POKENAME产生浓树液，正受科学家仔细研究。预知能力的持续研究，让许多个体被人工圈养。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a thick sap that is under heavy scrutiny by scientists. The ongoing research of POKENAME for their ability to see into the future has led to many of them being raised in captivity.

entry: POKENAME超能力强、听觉敏锐，能听未来的声音。唯有最安静隐秘的宝可梦，才骗得过。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's psychic powers and keen hearing allow it to hear sounds from the future. Only the quietest and stealthiest Pokémon can fool it.

entry: 人们曾观察到POKENAME以超音速飞越沙漠，也知道它会帮助迷失在沙丘间的人。据说，它凭强大的听觉，还能听见来自未来的低语。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: POKENAME have been observed flying across deserts at supersonic speeds, and are known to help those who have lost their way amongst the dunes. It is also said that it can hear whispers of the future with it's powerful ears.

entry: POKENAME大触须能闻未来的气味，在自己弄懂原因前，就引它去今后有用的地方。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's large feelers detect scents from the future, guiding POKENAME to locations that will be helpful before it can understand why.

entry: POKENAME看未来时，全身瘫软，因此没法阻止小孩把它抱起，当玩具玩。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME goes completely limp while it is experiencing visions of the future. Because of this, it cannot prevent small children from picking it up and playing with it as if it were a toy.

entry: POKENAME略能预知，体格也适合战斗，是比看着难对付的对手。招牌飞身重压受预见引导，因此许多生物畏惧。
author: infinex21
source: Gifted with mild foresight and a fine physique fit for battle, POKENAME are deceptively tricky combatants to face. Their signature move is a Flying Press guided by their foresight, and thus is feared by many.

entry: 古老信仰认为，吃POKENAME能短暂预知未来。科学家仍争论，这是真赋予本领，还是只造成强烈幻觉。
author: _pixelar_
source: Historic beliefs hold that eating a POKENAME grants temporary future sight. Scientists debate whether the consumption really gives the ability or just induces strong hallucinations.

entry: 许多POKENAME一生大多住同一冰川或山上，太暖才迁移。民间传说，它创造的极光，会投出人的未来片段。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Many POKENAME spend most of their lives living on the same glaciers or mountains, only wandering if it gets too warm. In folklore, the auroras created by POKENAME project glimpses of one's future.

entry: 据说POKENAME能创作反映所遇之人真实内心的歌曲。谁打断，就睁眼发出震耳尖啸。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: It is said that POKENAME has the power to create songs that reflect the true heart of any person it has met. If anyone disturbs its song, it will open its eyes and release a deafening screech.

entry: 它们有看未来的神秘力量。预见晴朗日子时，轻快欢唱起舞；预见风暴时，则带着不祥的喜悦跳舞。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon have the mysterious power of being able to see into the future. They sing and dance with frivolous joy when they foresee bright and sunny days and they dance with ominous glee when they foresee stormy weather.

entry: POKENAME预知弱，只见未来片段。因此许多个体长期恐惧未来，也容易焦虑发作。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's clairvoyance abilities are weak, so it can only see parts of the future. Because of that, many POKENAME are afflicted by a persistent phobia of the future, and they're prone to anxiety attacks.

entry: POKENAME散放树枝，在特殊仪式中烧，解读火烟的飘动来预知。献一根树枝，就能给它专看你未来的媒介。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME scatter sticks to burn in special rituals, reading the way the smoke drifts from the fire to predict the future. Offering a stick to a POKENAME will give them an anchor to read your future specifically.

entry: POKENAME常静栖山巅。贤者与导师送煤给它吃，盼换来未来征兆。
author: badtothebow
source: POKENAME is often found perched motionless atop the peaks of mountains. Sages and gurus will bring gifts of coal for it to eat in hopes of receiving a portent of the future.

entry: POKENAME撒闪粉，强迫猎物重历过往狩猎的恐怖景象。吓得无法动弹，便很容易捕获。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME scatters a shimmering powder that forces prey to relive horrifying visions of its past hunts. Paralyzed by fear, its victims become easy targets for capture.

entry: POKENAME在池边静立，远观过去。恍惚时，头顶睡莲叶泛粉光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stands completely still near ponds while remotely viewing the past. The lilypad on its head glows pink during this trance.

entry: POKENAME靠未来景象与审慎判断，帮助情侣走到一起。它用心灵感应分享可能的未来，通常满是喜悦与浪漫。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on visions of the future and prudent judgement to help couples get together. They telepathically relay visions of the potential future that are usually filled with joy and romance.

entry: POKENAME白天静止冥想，入夜才停，去偷最亮的硬币。传说它曾被尊为灵性存在，能在硬币倒影里见未来。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: During the daytime, POKENAME will motionlessly meditate, only stopping once night falls to steal the shiniest coins. In legend, POKENAME were revered as spiritual beings who possessed the ability to see into the future in the reflection of coins.

entry: POKENAME陆上走得慢而有条理，步态古怪不平。入水则偏爱顺流，轻松避开沿途障碍。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME moves slowly and methodically on land, walking in an odd and uneven gait. When in water, it prefers to travel downstream, effortlessly avoiding any obstacles in its way.

entry: 据说POKENAME能准确预测野火的时间地点。曾有人见到，它在毁灭性野火爆发前，把野生宝可梦聚拢赶出森林，送往安全处。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: It is said that POKENAME can accurately predict the location and time of wildfires. POKENAME have been observed finding and herding wild Pokémon out of forests to safety just before these destructive wildfires occur.

entry: POKENAME总梦未来，常记不清每个预测何时实现。它看太阳计时，却往往等不到第一次成真，就又睡着，看见新预言。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Constantly dreaming of the future, POKENAME often lose track of when each specific prediction will come true. They watch the sun to keep track of time, but usually end up falling asleep again and seeing a new prediction before the first can arrive.

entry: 融合扩大脑容量，让它们能看见无数可能未来。据说POKENAME用尽全部精神力量，甚至能影响命运走向。
author: agtl05
source: Through the power of fusion, they can perceive countless possible futures due to increased brain capacity. It is said that when POKENAME uses its full psychic power, it can influence the course of fate.

entry: POKENAME戴腰带，限制身心能力，防止战中失控。每天爱看日出冥想，据说会带来预言景象。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME wears a belt that restrains its mental and physical abilities from becoming uncontrolled in combat. It likes to begin each day by meditating while watching the sun rise, which is believed to grant it a prophetic vision.

entry: POKENAME站在图腾柱或高枝守卫，不断窥未来。占卜师用它算命，也用来直接把不守规矩的顾客赶走。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Found perched on totem poles or tall branches, POKENAME stands guard, constantly peering into the future. Fortune Tellers use POKENAME for divination purposes, as well as to physically remove unruly customers.

entry: POKENAME刚交战时完全不动，先预见不同结果。一找到胜路，就以闪电般的拳头与拍翼猛攻。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME remains completely still when first engaged in combat, as it is foreseeing different outcomes of the battle. When it predicts a path to victory, it lashes out with lightning-fast punches and wing slaps.

entry: POKENAME飞上树枝，等从上方扑猎。它从不久等，因此人们信它用预知，在合适时机到达合适位置。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME flies up to tree branches and waits to drop down on prey from above. It never has to wait for long, so it is believed that it uses precognition to position itself in the right place at the right time.

entry: 它们连跑着也对周围敏锐得很，有人因此相信会预知。威吓敌人时，会抬前腿，展开弱翼。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon are so keenly aware of their surroundings, even while running, that some believe them to have foresight. They will rear up and open their weak wings to intimidate foes.

entry: POKENAME天生对周围极其敏锐，虽挑剔骑乘者，却仍在竞速中广受欢迎。感到威胁时，它们火焰升腾，扬起前腿，用蹄子将威胁踏退。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's innate, keen awareness of their surroundings makes them popular in races even though they are picky about who may ride them. Their flames flare up when they feel threatened and they will rear up to stomp away threats using their hooves.

entry: 古文明里，最睿智、最受敬重的先知骑POKENAME。据说它与骑者分享预见，让对方瞥到未来。
author: sk372
source: In ancient civilizations, the wisest and most regarded of seers rode POKENAME as their steed. It is believed the Pokémon shared its precognitive abilities with its rider, letting them glimpse the future.

entry: POKENAME看得见未来，动作慢却让反应迟了。只在预见已发生时才应对，看着反倒诡异地准备充分。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can see into the future, but its reaction is delayed due to its slow movements. This causes it to respond to events only when its vision is already unfolding, making it appear eerily well-prepared.

entry: POKENAME始终紧紧收翼裹身，用精准踢击，以及硬尾如节拍器般的挥动，抵挡近身交锋。
author: banquoviaquo
source: POKENAME keeps its wings tightly folded around its body at all times, using precise kicks and swings of its rigid, metronomic tail to fend off a physical clash.

entry: 据说POKENAME一头看过去，一头看未来。两头沟通，分享看见的知识。
author: hophoppip
source: One of POKENAME's heads is said to see into the past, while the other sees into the future. The two heads communicate to share the knowledge they've seen in their visions.

entry: POKENAME三头分别看过去、现在、未来。中头常得保护另外两头，防备当下的危险。
author: pinkyoshi2350
source: POKENAME's three heads respectively see the past, present, and future. The middle head often has to protect the other two from dangers happening in the moment.

entry: POKENAME腹炮发出的精神能量冲击，肉眼无法看见。可特殊成像发现，它们由古怪的紫外光符号构成。
author: banquoviaquo
source: The psychic blasts from POKENAME's belly cannon are invisible to the naked eye. However, specialized imaging has detected they are composed of bizarre ultraviolet symbols.

entry: POKENAME能让自己进入催眠、易受暗示的状态。在其中看见未来，把将来发生的事记住。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to put themselves into a hypnotic and suggestible state. Whilst in this mental state they receive visions of the future, committing the coming events to memory.

entry: POKENAME接近睡着的人和宝可梦吃梦，再用未来景象替换，常带来不适与噩梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME approach sleeping Pokémon and people to feed on their dreams. They replace the stolen dreams with visions of the future, often causing discomfort and nightmares to follow.

entry: POKENAME背上怪种子长出导电棉絮，靠水与阳光生长，可像羊毛般剪下。不过积起的静电很多，需小心。
author: infinex21
source: Upon POKENAME's back is a strange seed, from which an electrically conductive cotton has grown. This cotton grows with water and sunlight and can be sheared like wool, though caution is advised due to how much static electricity can accumulate.

entry: POKENAME手持的杆像电池，储存厚羊毛中多余的积电。
author: melodydelune
source: The pole POKENAME carries acts as a battery to store the excess electricity built up within its thick wool.

entry: POKENAME精力旺盛，能长时间不停奔跑。前角如探测棒，能感知哪里正发生雷暴。
author: gamblebreaker
source: POKENAME are generally very energetic and can run for long periods of time without stopping. They are able to sense where thunderstorms are happening using their front horns like divining rods.

entry: POKENAME有时把孩子抱出袋，在自己羊毛上蹭。双方都不受伤，却产生强静电，阻止其他宝可梦攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will sometimes take its infant out of its pouch and rub it against its own wool. This doesn't harm either of them, but generates a powerful static charge to discourage other Pokémon from attacking either of them.

entry: 训练家必须常刷POKENAME的羊毛头发，避免打结。得用专用刷，才不致被电焦。
author: hophoppip
source: Trainers of POKENAME must keep its woolly hair tangle-free by regularly brushing it. A special brush is required to prevent the Trainer from being fried by an electric shock.

entry: POKENAME变身时缩进羊毛外套，过程中迸出肉眼可见的电光。完成后，羊毛仍留在新形态的某处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME retreats itself into its wool coat when it transforms, generating visible crackles of lightning during the process. The wool remains somewhere on its new form after the transformation completes.

entry: POKENAME被剪毛后，只要吃片草，几乎立刻长回。传闻有一只的羊毛会变色。
author: hophoppip
source: If sheared, POKENAME can regrow their wool almost instantly by grazing on a patch of grass. There's a rumor about a POKENAME with wool that shifts colors.

entry: POKENAME吃草就再长羊毛。不知为何，每次剪下，总是完美的羊毛方块。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME regrows its wool when it grazes on grass. For some reason, shearing always results in perfect cubes of wool.

entry: POKENAME白天大多睡，常有咩利羊在肚子周围跳。睡着也听觉极佳，留意环境，必要时用电尾猛击。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME spend most of the day sleeping, often accompanied by Mareep jumping around their belly. Despite being asleep, they have exceptional hearing to stay aware of their environment and will lash out with their electrified tail if need be.

entry: POKENAME约每周蜕一次皮，连剩余羊毛一起。蜕后没有电力，直到新毛长够。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME regularly sheds its skin at a rate of about once a week, including whatever wool remains. After shedding, it will have no electrical abilities until enough new wool grows back.

entry: 这种稀有POKENAME只与大水域附近吃草的咩利羊群交往。有人亲述，蜕后留下的羊毛，能给牧羊人带来惊人好运与财富。
author: brendyn_ashton
source: This rare fusion can be found socializing exclusively with flocks of Mareep that graze near large bodies of water. Personal accounts state that POKENAME's discarded wool made after shedding can bring shepherds incredible luck and fortune.

entry: POKENAME摩擦毛掌，积起巨量静电，造强大雷球投敌。尾球还能放出震晕对手的强精神脉冲，进一步限制行动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rubs its woolly palms together to gather immense amounts of static electricity, creating powerful orbs of lightning to hurl at foes. The orb on its tail can emit powerful stunning psychic pulses to further incapacitate opponents.

entry: POKENAME隐居，谁打扰就毫不犹豫地掷电球。赢得信任者会发现，羊毛蓬松，也极耐撕扯。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are reclusive creatures and won't hesitate to launch Electro Balls at anyone who disturbs them. Those who manage to earn the trust of POKENAME will find their wool is fluffy and very resistant to tearing.

entry: 科学家报告，POKENAME产的电，性质不同于普通电。原因与用途，仍在实验研究。
author: imaginita
source: Scientists report that the electricity generated by a POKENAME has properties unlike normal electricity. Experiments to discover why and what it can be used for are ongoing.

entry: POKENAME背上喷火自卫。毛能长得很厚，训练家通常剪掉，免得起火。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME emits flames from its back as a defense mechanism. Its woolly fur can grow quite thick, but Trainers usually shear their POKENAME to keep the wool from catching fire.

entry: POKENAME视力不佳，嗅觉却十分出色。身体耐火，蓬松的毛若长得太厚，它们就从特定腺体放出火焰，直接烧掉。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME do not see very well, but they have an excellent sense of smell. Their body is resistant to fire, so if their fluffy wool grows too thick, they simply burn it off by releasing fire through specific glands.

entry: POKENAME摩擦肚子上的羊毛蓄电，再从爪子甩出电流，击向旁人。它的嘴虽然小，牙却很锋利，咬下仍能造成不轻的伤害。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rubs the wool on its tummy to gather electricity and fling it from its claws at others. Though it has a small mouth, its teeth are still quite sharp, so its bites cause quite a bit of damage.

entry: POKENAME拍翼产生大量静电，存进羊毛般的绒羽。群体停在电线上，常造成局部停电。
author: fancyskunk
source: Flapping its wings generates large amounts of static electricity, which it stores in its wooly down feathers. Flocks of POKENAME that roost on power lines often cause localized blackouts.

entry: 家养POKENAME最爱被揉肚子。不过主人得小心，揉太快会激起毛中电力，手可能挨一下刺痛的轻微电击。
author: sk372
source: A domesticated POKENAME's favorite thing is having its belly rubbed, but owners should be careful; rubbing too fast stirs up the electricity in its fur and could lead to a sharp little shock to their hand.

entry: POKENAME厚厚的羊毛般羽毛，能在夜里保暖。睡觉时，它们不断产生附着于身体的静电；黎明醒来，积蓄的电力，已足够为移动通信设备供电。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a thick layer of woolly feathers that keeps them warm at night. As they sleep they generate static electricity that clings to their body. When they awaken at dawn they have built enough electricity to power cellular devices.

entry: POKENAME的电网由自己的羊毛织成，因此尽量少织，免得用光。有些工厂用剪下的丝，提高电线导电性。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's electrified webbing is made from its own wool, so it uses minimal webs to hunt so it won't run out. Some factories use the sheared threads to help increase the conductivity of manufactured wiring.

entry: POKENAME成群生活在深海，光芒宛如夜空的星座。它们调节光的闪烁，在深渊家园的黑暗中，彼此交流。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Shoals of POKENAME live in the deep ocean, their lights reminiscent of constellations in the night sky. They can adjust the flashing of their lights to communicate with one another across the darkness of their abyssal home.

entry: POKENAME精力充沛，训练家着急时，能很快给设备充电。有时帮得太热情，反把电子设备烧坏。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can expediently charge its Trainer's devices in a hurry because it is brimming full of energy. Sometimes it is too enthusiastic about helping and ends up frying the electronic device it charges.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着厚厚的羊毛，厚到无法走路，只能靠翻滚移动。虽然外表可爱，它却十分强悍，能释放威力惊人的电击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body is covered in a massive coat of wool so thick it can't walk, forcing it to roll to move around. Despite its cute appearance, it is a tough Pokémon, capable of unleashing devastating electric attacks.

entry: 2月的爱情庆典上能见到POKENAME，总想待在彼此身边。许多城镇相信，只要它们尾巴相碰，庆典就算成功。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be spotted at love festivals in February, constantly seeking to be near each other. Many towns hold the belief that if POKENAME touch tails with each other, then the festival is considered a success.

entry: POKENAME比体型看着轻得多，身体大半其实是轻绒羽。微风也能托起，让它乘气流漂数英里。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are unusually light for their size, the majority of what appears to be their body actually being a light downy fluff. They can take off with even just a light breeze, drifting for miles on the air currents.

entry: POKENAME的毛远比其他茸茸羊长得快，不妥善打理就会妨碍行动。不过，电分布范围更大，羊毛带的电较弱。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's wool grows significantly faster than other Flaaffy, which if not managed properly can start to impair its movement. However, its wool has a weaker electric charge as its electricity is spread over a larger area.

entry: POKENAME靠强静电悬浮，随风旅行。曾有数名训练家碰到被阵风吹偏的个体，遭到电击。
author: alumed
source: POKENAME generate a powerful static charge that they use to hover above the land and travel using the winds. Several Trainers have been electrocuted after making contact with a POKENAME that was blown off-course by a sudden gust.

entry: POKENAME飘过草地，头花转动。累了落下，羊毛垫能缓冲，避免笨拙着陆受伤。
author: .izik
source: The flower on POKENAME's head spins as it floats through meadows. Should it get tired, its wool padding helps cushion its fall, preventing injury from a clumsy descent.

entry: POKENAME胆怯，行动极快，羊毛迅速积起强静电。一群产的电，够一栋大楼用约半周。
author: infinex21
source: These skittish Pokémon move with such speed that their wool quickly builds up potent static charges. A herd of POKENAME can produce enough electricity to power a large building for about half a week.

entry: POKENAME爱用尾灯电其他宝可梦，逗弄对方。虽顽皮，小而灵巧的身体却让它是电工的好帮手。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to tease other Pokémon by zapping them with the electrical bulb on their tails. Despite their mischievous nature, they make great helpers for electricians because of their small yet nimble bodies.

entry: POKENAME从尾巴发信号，吸引电属性宝可梦照顾自己。奇怪的是，信号夜里就不生效。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME emit signals from their tails that attract Electric-type Pokémon so that they can take care of POKENAME. These signals mysteriously fail to work at night.

entry: POKENAME入水时，羊毛紧贴身体，形成绝缘层。离水后，尾巴吸收电力，让羊毛根根竖起，看起来比原本两倍还大。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When POKENAME is in the water, its wool sticks close to its body and becomes an insulating layer. When it leaves the water, its tail absorbs electricity, and causes its wool to stand on end, making it appear more than twice its size.

entry: POKENAME啃地下电线吸电，存进羊毛。力量因此增强，必要时便能使电力攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gnaws on underground wiring and absorbs the electricity, storing it in its wool. This makes it more powerful and able to use electricity-based attacks when needed.

entry: POKENAME可爱友善，却有个恼人习惯：夜里总在奇怪时刻高声咩叫。
author: hophoppip
source: Though quite cute and friendly, POKENAME has an irritating habit of bleating loudly at odd hours of the night.

entry: POKENAME的厚羊毛冬天保暖，春天自然脱落。尾上副头施展超能力属性攻击时，会明亮发光。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's thick wool keeps it warm during winter and naturally sheds in the spring. The secondary head on its tail glows brightly when channeling Psychic-type attacks.

entry: POKENAME聚在云里收静电。绒毛一被碰，就迸出静电，随后跑掉。
author: equation8573
source: POKENAME congregates inside clouds to gather static electricity. When its fluffy fur is touched, POKENAME releases a burst of static electricity, then runs away.

entry: POKENAME低掠草地时从尾放电，突然电晕捕食者，再逃跑。
author: .izik
source: While gliding low over meadows, POKENAME releases electricity from its tail. The sudden shock is used to stun predators before it escapes.

entry: POKENAME亲人，爱送拥抱。身周若有静电，可能不慎电到被抱者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are affectionate creatures that love to give out hugs. When they have a static charge around them, they can accidentally shock those they hug.

entry: POKENAME落羽保留着与羊毛摩擦产生的微电，是热门的新奇羽毛笔。写出的墨迹会在黑暗中亮几天。
author: sk372
source: Feathers shed by POKENAME retain faint electricity gathered from rubbing against its wool. These feathers are a popular novelty quill, as ink written with them will glow in the dark for a few days.

entry: POKENAME半夜从农场偷走整群咩利羊。农人给它起了童谣里牧羊女的绰号——“小波比”。
author: musicsheep.
source: In the middle of the night, POKENAME will steal entire flocks of Mareep from farms. Farmers have nicknamed it "Little Bo Peep".

entry: 人们用POKENAME群清田，准备下一季作物。它们缓缓吃过旧田，吃上一季残余，沿途留下肥沃灰烬，促进新生长。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME herds are used to clear fields in preparation for the next season's crops. They slowly move across old fields, grazing on what is left over from the previous season while leaving a trail of fertile ash behind them to encourage new growth.

entry: 人们用POKENAME群清田，准备下一季作物。它们缓缓吃过旧田，吃上一季残余，沿途留下肥沃灰烬，促进新生长。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME herds are used to clear fields in preparation for the next season's crops. They slowly move across old fields, grazing on what is left over from the previous season while leaving a trail of fertile ash behind them to encourage new growth.

entry: POKENAME厚厚的正电羊毛抵御寒冷。鼻子能闻雪下食物，帮它在严酷环境觅食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's thick, positively charged wool keeps it safe from the cold. Its nose can smell food buried under the snow, helping it find nourishment in harsh conditions.

entry: POKENAME蜷进蓬松羊毛保暖。烦躁时猛摇尾，闪强光晃花打扰者的眼，争取时间蜿蜒逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME coils up in its own fluffy wool to stay warm. If agitated it will shake its tail furiously, flickering a bright light to blind the nuisance and give POKENAME time to slither away.

entry: POKENAME能轻松连接电子设备，有人因此让它管电脑。行为很听话，可电脑进睡眠模式，就能看见它生成咩利羊图像。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's ability to easily interface with electronics has led to some people leaving it in charge of their computers. It behaves obediently, but when the computer is placed in sleep mode, it can be seen generating images of Mareep.

entry: 野生POKENAME用电力展示，逼对手屈服。谁能在头顶制造更大的鹿角形电弧，谁便占上风。
author: sk372
source: In the wild, rival POKENAME will attempt to cow the other to submission via displays of electric power. The one who can create the larger arc of antler-shaped lightning above their head is considered superior.

entry: POKENAME的羊毛极毒，常散满战场。它用尾巴静电把毛黏在敌身，不让逃脱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wool is extremely poisonous and often left all over the battlefield. It uses static from its tail to make the wool cling to foes, preventing their escape.

entry: 人们在奶里发现羊毛后，POKENAME奶销量下滑。问题虽已解决，企业却始终没完全挽回销量损失。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME milk fell in sales after people began finding strands of wool in their milk. Even after the issue was resolved, companies never fully recovered from the sales losses.

entry: POKENAME的奶比普通哞哞鲜奶略稠，有人比作奶昔。山区居民更爱这种奶。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME's milk is slightly thicker than normal Moo Moo Milk. Some people compare it to a milkshake. This milk is preferred by people living in mountainous regions.

entry: POKENAME持续放静电，模拟带蛋行走的作用。许多培育屋开始用它自动孵蛋。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME produce a constant stream of static electricity that mimics the movements of walking with an egg. Many daycares have begun to use them as automatic egg hatchers.

entry: POKENAME头毛长得惊人，短短几天就厚到遮眼、失去平衡。
author: sk372
source: The wool on POKENAME's head grows at an alarming rate. In only a few days, its wool will grow thick enough to obscure its vision and put it off-balance.

entry: POKENAME定期让导电尾尖碰地，排掉毛中静电。毛虽软，制成的衣物却很快也会起静电。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME periodically discharges the static that builds up in its fur via its tail, tapping the conductive tip against the ground. Its wool is soft, but clothes made from it will quickly generate their own static charge.

entry: POKENAME长舌电流奔涌，受威胁时能电击。既是战斗工具，也是独特能量来源。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's long tongue courses with electricity, allowing it to deliver electric shocks when threatened. The tongue is both a tool for combat and a unique source of power.

entry: POKENAME的“羊毛”远看像毛，其实硬如岩石。它用尾巴当避雷针。
author: bluefire7_9
source: Although it looks like wool from afar, a POKENAME's "wool" is actually rock hard. It uses its tail as a lightning rod.

entry: POKENAME厚羊毛充满空气，能兜风滑翔，追赶猎物。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's thick coat of wool is full of air, and helps it catch the wind when gliding to pursue its prey.

entry: POKENAME很以角为傲，常与伙伴比较。虽然看着蓬松，想碰就会挨电。
author: st4rdustyugure
source: POKENAME is very proud of its horns, and often compares them with its fellows. Even though it looks very fluffy, attempting to touch it will shock you.

entry: POKENAME周身看似羊毛，其实是大量卷曲绒羽。做成的枕头，以无比柔软舒适闻名。
author: mepp.
source: What seems like wool around POKENAME's body is actually a mass of curly down feathers. Pillows made from POKENAME's down are renowned for their sublime softness and comfort.

entry: POKENAME一剪毛，便找最近的泥地打滚。新毛长回前，泥能替代羊毛调节体温。
author: sk372
source: Immediately after being sheared, POKENAME will attempt to find the nearest source of mud to roll around in. This works as a suitable substitute for regulating body temperature until its wool starts to grow back.

entry: POKENAME被周围情绪压得紧张，就揉蓬松大头，积电防危险。
author: skymaster426
source: When POKENAME gets stressed from the emotion it feels around it, it rubs its large fluffy head. This allows it to charge its electricity in case of danger.

entry: POKENAME把头毛中的电导进躯干宝石，再射出强雷电，守护训练家与伙伴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME channels electricity from the wool on its head into the gem on its torso. By channeling the energy, it can fire strong lightning bolts used in defense of its Trainer and companions.

entry: 战斗或狩猎前，POKENAME使劲揉羊毛，体内静电让伸缩舌带电，将敌人或猎物电到屈服。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rubs the wool on its body vigorously before a battle or hunt. The static charge this creates internally coats its extendable tongue in electricity, allowing it to shock foes or prey into submission.

entry: POKENAME有时与裁缝同住，供应绝缘衣料。喂得饱，能产108磅以上羊毛。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME sometimes live with tailors, providing wool for insulated clothing. Well-fed POKENAME can produce upwards of 108 pounds of wool.

entry: POKENAME的颚上覆着羊毛，咀嚼时，便常会把静电，释放到猎物身上。
author: mossybanana
source: Since POKENAME's jaws are covered with wool, it will often discharge static electricity on its prey whilst chewing.

entry: POKENAME奔跑时积静电与冲势，准备攻击。为弥补羊毛缓冲头撞，撞上时会直接电击被压制的对手。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME build up static energy as they run, steadily gaining momentum until they're ready to attack. To make up for their wool cushioning their headbutts, they release electricity on impact to shock their pinned opponents directly.

entry: POKENAME总想依偎，身体却硬如石。初养的训练家很失望：看似蓬毛，其实是紧密编织的钢纤维。
author: something_smith
source: Despite its insistently snuggly nature, the bodies of POKENAME are rock hard. Much to the disappointment of first-time POKENAME Trainers, what appears to be fluffy wool is actually tightly woven steel fibers.

entry: 头绒虽软，却能抵消多数攻击。POKENAME的毛常被采去制电池，导致它有时易受攻击，许多地区因此禁止这种做法。
author: bradlybro199
source: Although the fluff on its head is soft, it still nullifies most attacks. POKENAME's wool is often harvested and used as a component in batteries. This can sometimes leave POKENAME vulnerable to attacks, so many regions have made the practice illegal.

entry: POKENAME群合作守草场，防其他宝可梦。羊毛的弱静电与同伴电荷汇集，就能产生强大电击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Herds of POKENAME work together to protect their grazing fields from other Pokémon. Their wool produces a weak static charge that, when combined with their herd mates, can produce powerful shocks.

entry: POKENAME混进咩利羊群捕食。夜里一只只抓走，带回洞中。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME preys on Mareep, disguising itself amongst the flock. It will pick them off one by one, snatching them during the night and bringing them back to its den.

entry: POKENAME庞大身体上的厚羊毛缓冲岩石、船只的撞击，像软屏障。强放电前，尾尖先耀眼发光。
author: fiordaliso
source: The thick wool covering POKENAME's massive body cushions impacts against rocks or ships, acting like a soft barrier. Just before releasing a powerful electric discharge, the tip of its tail glows brilliantly.

entry: POKENAME羊毛能长得极大，许多孩子觉得像行走的云。毛中电流强烈时，甚至看着像雷云。
author: infinex21
source: The wool of a POKENAME can grow so large that many children think of them as walking clouds. The electricity that surges within their wool can grow so intense that their wool can look like it is a thundercloud.

entry: POKENAME用尾球光与群体沟通。常爬到高树，灯光也能替旅人指路。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME communicate with their fellow pack members using lights emitted from their tail orbs. Because these Pokémon climb high into trees, their lights tend to help guide travelers as well.

entry: POKENAME住极地，通常挤着，用体温与厚毛防寒。大量聚集，合成的电场会扰乱指南针，难以导航。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lives in arctic environments and is usually found huddled together to use its body heat and thick wool to ward off the cold. When large numbers of them gather, their combined electrical field disrupts compasses, making navigation difficult.

entry: POKENAME毛茸茸的尾巴互相摩擦，产生静电，再把能量传进刀刃。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's woolly tail generates static electricity by rubbing against itself. This energy is transferred to its blade.

entry: POKENAME凭高超静电操控，把丰厚羊毛编成辫。优雅天真的性情，启发了许多艺术心灵。
author: miecreates
source: POKENAME braids its voluminous wool with an incredible mastery of static electricity. Its graceful but innocent nature has inspired many an artistic spirit.

entry: POKENAME的齿轮每转满一圈，核心就会迸出一小阵光与电能。头上的绒毛若不定期梳理，就会妨碍它正常运作。
author: sk372
source: Every full rotation of POKENAME's gears causes a small burst of light and electric energy to generate from its cores. If the wool on its head is not groomed regularly, it will cause issues with its functionality.

entry: POKENAME必须定期剪毛，以免羊毛长得过盛。若任其生长，毛中便会涌出过量电力，形成缎带般的雷电长鞭，伤及附近的生灵。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME needs to be regularly sheared so that its wool does not grow excessively. If allowed to grow out, the wool will surge with excessive electricity and create ribbon-like whips of lightning that can injure those nearby.

entry: POKENAME有剃掉浓毛与羊毛的坏习惯。想留爆炸头或胡子，最好离远点。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME has a nasty habit of shaving anything with bushy hair or wool. It's advised to stay away from POKENAME if you plan on growing an afro or a beard.

entry: POKENAME的羊毛其实是大量保暖蛛丝。柔软材料让它耐寒，也能有效困住猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wool is actually massive amounts of webbing used for warmth. The soft material helps it survive in colder environments, while also serving as an effective trap for prey.

entry: POKENAME羊毛绝缘极好，是电工衣料的佳选。可它脾气不好，想剪毛十分危险。
author: fenragon
source: POKENAME wool is an excellent electric insulator and makes for a great material for electrician's clothing. However, trying to shear POKENAME is very dangerous due to it's temperament.

entry: POKENAME常拿头上羊毛蹭尾巴，既保暖，也存静电，电击接触的敌人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME regularly rubs the wool on its head against its tails. This keeps it warm, and also stores up static electricity to shock any foes it comes into contact with.

entry: POKENAME的钥匙白天吸电、夜里释放，整夜保持安全温暖。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME keys absorb electrical energy during the day, and unleash it during the night. This provides POKENAME safety and warmth throughout the night.

entry: 强雷雨时，能见POKENAME在山脊仰头，等待滋养它的雷电劈下。
author: chorb33
source: During heavy thunderstorms, POKENAME can be spotted on mountain ridges, stretching their heads upwards to be struck by nourishing lightning.

entry: POKENAME高速飞行，羊毛在身后留下一道静电轨迹。多只同行时，轨迹可能相交，引发一大片耀眼火花。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME zips through the air at high speeds, it leaves a trail of static electricity from its wool behind. If multiple POKENAME fly together, their trails may intersect and cause a dazzling array of sparks to erupt.

entry: POKENAME压力大，毛就一团团脱落，沿途留下。隧道里常满是绒毛，穿山王等捕食者借此追踪。
author: .izik
source: When stressed, POKENAME's wool comes off in clumps, leaving behind a trail of discarded fur. Its tunnels are often full of tufts, which predators like Sandslash use to track it down.

entry: 活动时，毛皮产生静电，存到皮肤下。研究如何储电的尝试都失败了，因为电强到产生干扰附近精密电子设备的场。
author: darkwolfe
source: During physical activity, its fur coat generates a static charge that is stored under the skin. Attempted research into how the charge is stored has failed as it can become so strong it generates a field that disrupts nearby sensitive electronics.

entry: POKENAME性情温和，谁都能交朋友。某些宗教派别长期用它象征冲突群体和平共处。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME has a gentle personality and will befriend anyone.  Certain religious sects have long used it to symbolize conflicting groups living together in peace.

entry: POKENAME的羊毛用于电线绝缘，让机器更高效运转，对工程师与懂技术的人很有价值。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wool is used as insulation in wiring that helps machines run more efficiently. This makes it a valuable resource for engineers and tech-savvy individuals.

entry: 齿轮每转12圈，POKENAME就迸出一小团带电毛粒。颗粒无害，只让人痒痒麻麻1小时。
author: sk372
source: After every twelve rotations of the gear a small burst of electrically-charged wool particles bursts out from POKENAME. The particles are harmless, only causing an hour of ticklish tingling sensations.

entry: POKENAME靠摆尾与闪尾球沟通。耐火羊毛会长满全身，必须每月修一次。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME communicate with others via tail movements and by flashing light from their tail orbs. Their flame-resistant wool grows enough to cover their entire bodies, so they must be trimmed on a monthly basis.

entry: POKENAME羽化时，羊毛便自然织成薄层。这织物容易积静电，导入光球储存。
author: lucioleuh
source: POKENAME's wool forms a thin layer that is naturally woven from eclosion. This fabric charges static energy easily and transfers it to the orb to be stored.

entry: 手周围的光球分别吸引电子与质子，产生强弱不一的放电。羊毛还能释放毒素，提炼后用于某些香水增香。
author: fiordaliso
source: The orbs surrounding its hands can attract electrons and protons respectively, allowing it to generate electric discharges of varying intensity. Its wool can release toxins that, once refined, are used to perfume certain varieties of fragrances.

entry: POKENAME喜欢漂在操场与学校附近，诱使孩子触碰黄色圆球，再狠狠电上一下。
author: sottiwotti
source: POKENAME likes to float around playgrounds and schools. They entice children into touching their yellow spheres, violently shocking them.

entry: POKENAME毛中存着奔跑产生的静电。可能量存太多，就会电到自己。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's fur stores static electricity that it generates while running. However, it will end up shocking itself if it stores too much energy.

entry: POKENAME强烈感受情绪时，身体涂层自行发光、带电。有时电让它浮起，因此常被误认成球状闪电或鬼火。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME's bioluminescent coating glows and becomes charged when it feels strong emotions. The resulting charge occasionally causes it to levitate; as a result, it is often mistaken for ball lightning or will-o-wisps.

entry: 有风的山丘上，能见整群POKENAME漂浮。有时撞电线，便引发停电。
author: musicsheep.
source: Entire herds of floating POKENAME can be seen on windy days in the hills. Sometimes, they end up colliding with a power line and cause a power outage.

entry: POKENAME身体由胸前电球供能，雷雨时现身充电。一只离群，其他成员就全跟上。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is powered by the electric orb on its chest and will appear during thunderstorms to recharge its orb. If one POKENAME wanders away from its herd, the rest of the group will follow.

entry: POKENAME还不会走、不会飞，就能驱赶捕食者。巢里厚毛蹭着兄弟姐妹，产生强大静电。
author: hophoppip
source: They can fend off predators before they can even walk or fly. In the nest, a POKENAME's thick wool rubs against that of its siblings to generate a formidable static charge.

entry: POKENAME的毛极厚，什么猎物踩上都能缠住。一困牢，就放强雷电，使对方无法行动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wool is extremely thick and can ensnare any prey that steps on it. Once trapped, it lets loose a powerful bolt of lightning to incapacitate its foe.

entry: POKENAME羊毛上的毒因有光泽，被用于多种墨水。采集得有熟手，因为毒很危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wool is coated with poison, which is used in a variety of inks for its luster. However, harvesting it requires a skilled hand, as the poison can be dangerous.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，浓密的羽毛相互摩擦，积蓄静电。电力会导入翼端的绒球，再一口气放出，电击敌人。
author: hophoppip
source: When POKENAME dances, its thick plumage rubs together and builds up a static charge. The electricity is channeled into the pom-poms on the ends of its wings, which can release the charge all at once to shock foes.

entry: POKENAME头上的羊毛产生大量静电，充入尾珠，使其明亮发光。会引好奇路人进林子，盼着交朋友。
author: arcul
source: The fleece on POKENAME's head generates abundant static electricity. It uses this energy to charge the orb on its tail so it can glow brightly, drawing curious passersby into the woods in hopes of making friends.

entry: POKENAME悠然浮在雷云中。蓬松羊毛绝缘，挡住云里猛烈电流，保持安全。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats within thunderclouds with little concern. Its fluffy wool insulates it from the harsh electrical surges that occur within the clouds, keeping it safe.

entry: 有些POKENAME爱和其他宝可梦交好。自己不适合战斗，朋友常替它抵御捕食者。
author: crafter_94443
source: Some POKENAME enjoy bonding with other Pokémon, since they are not fit for combat, the other Pokémon they befriend often protect them from predators.

entry: POKENAME长厚毛，加固周围屏障。接触它，可能遭麻痹或心脏骤停。
author: alliveir
