source: POKENAME grows its thick fur to fortify the barrier around it. Those who make contact with this Pokémon may suffer from paralysis or cardiac arrest.

entry: POKENAME战前摆姿势，挥动绒翼，细小电光更添气势。胜利姿势时，躯干光球最亮。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME swings its fluffy wings about during pre-fight poses, small electrical discharges burst out and add to the flair. The orb on its torso glows brightest during its victory pose.

entry: POKENAME在森林地面爬来爬去，舔尝小蘑菇。大多会当场吃掉，遇上味道特别喜欢的，就贴在背上，带回家留待以后细细享用。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME scuttles around the forest floors, licking at Tiny Mushrooms. Most are eaten right away, but those it particularly enjoys the taste of are attached to its back, carried to its home to be savored later.

entry: 古神话视POKENAME为死亡之灵。各地发现多套仿其形刻的面具，让历史学家相信，它在全球文化中都很重要。
author: mepp.
source: Ancient myths regard POKENAME as a spirit of death. Discoveries of multiple sets of carved masks in the Pokémon's likeness have historians believing these Pokémon held great cultural significance throughout the world.

entry: 传说，POKENAME守护着人类与宝可梦的梦，用尾巴发出的光驱散邪灵。据说，只要触碰它柔软的羊毛，便会沉入深沉而甜美的梦乡。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to legend, POKENAME watches over the dreams of humans and Pokémon alike, keeping evil spirits away with the light it can emit from its tail. It is said that anyone who touches its soft wool will fall into a deep, sweet sleep.

entry: 雷雨时，POKENAME出门把毛淋湿。随后几天大量真菌在毛中生长，让它变大，孢子效力也增强。
author: .izik
source: During thunderstorms, POKENAME ventures outside to soak its wool in the rain. Large amounts of fungi grow within the wool in the days that follow, increasing its size and the potency of its spores.

entry: POKENAME边走边积静电，耳中毛就蓬起，看着更大。这时触碰，可能严重电灼伤。
author: potatoforged
source: As it builds static charge by walking, the fur in POKENAME's ears puffs out, making it appear larger. Touching it in this state can cause severe electrical burns.

entry: POKENAME尾球是产电、储电器官，因此亮得像灯泡。它摇下半身，会撒出带静电的鳞片。
author: infinex21
source: Its tail bulb is an organ that generates and stores electricity, which causes it to light up similar to a lightbulb. When a POKENAME shakes its lower body, it scatters statically charged scales.

entry: POKENAME羊毛看似糖，却不是。毛细，沾着自己含糖的唾液，很黏，一碰就黏手。
author: musicsheep.
source: While POKENAME's wool may look like candy, it is not. Its wool is thin and sticky from its own sugary saliva, causing the wool to get stuck to hands when touched.

entry: POKENAME深夜点亮身体下的球，引迷路宝可梦脱险。累过头，每拍一次翼，就撒一次毒粉。
author: fiordaliso
source: In the dead of night, POKENAME makes the bulb beneath its body shine brightly to guide lost Pokémon to safety. When overexerted, it releases toxic powder each time it flaps its wings.

entry: POKENAME摩擦前臂毛块产电，直到尾球带电发亮才停。爪足够锋利，能在毛长太密前自己修剪。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME generates electricity by rubbing together the patches of wool on its forearms. It stops when its tail orb glows with electricity. Its claws are sharp enough to trim away its own wool before it grows too dense.

entry: POKENAME三头从同一具厚毛身体探出。睡觉时缩回毛里，既保暖，也融入环境。
author: hophoppip
source: The three heads of POKENAME emerge from a single body covered in dense wool. The heads retract into the wool when sleeping, which keeps them warm and helps them blend into the environment.

entry: 训练家常把POKENAME的毛剪短，便于活动与控温。野生个体毛浓密，重量能长到几乎与身体相当。
author: hophoppip
source: Its common for POKENAME Trainers to keep its fur trimmed short for mobility and temperature regulation. Wild POKENAME have thick, wooly fur that may grow to weigh almost as much as the Pokémon's body.

entry: POKENAME毛中静电太多，就严重偏头痛。定期受控放电、经常剪毛，能让它健康快乐。
author: sk372
source: If static electricity builds up too much within POKENAME's fur, it develops strong migraines. Periodic controlled discharges and regular shearing will ensure a healthy, happy POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME准备战斗，尾巴就跟着急促心跳脉动。柔软毛皮像垫子，吸收敌方攻击的冲击。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it is ready to fight, POKENAME's tail begins pulsing in sync with its frenzied heartbeat. The soft fleece covering its body acts as a cushion, absorbing the impact of opposing attacks.

entry: 成群的POKENAME一同漫游草甸，大部分成员进食，少数则巡查危险。守卫用尾灯闪光彼此联络，合力抵御威胁。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME herds roam across grassy meadows together, the bulk of the herd feeding whilst a handful of POKENAME patrol for danger. The guard POKENAME communicate with one another through flashes of their tail lights, banding together against threats.

entry: POKENAME群在草地漫游，多数吃草，少数巡危险。它们只需少量保护，大多能自行照顾，很受养毛牧场欢迎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME herds roam across grassy meadows together, the bulk of the herd feeding whilst a handful of POKENAME patrol for danger. They are popular Pokémon to farm for wool, as they need little protection and the herds mostly look after themselves.

entry: POKENAME靠飞行时的摩擦，在羊毛中产生电力，再储存到尾尖的光球里。电力存得越多，它们就越兴奋，会寻找战斗，释放过剩的电力。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use the friction of flight to generate electricity within their wool fleeces, which is then stored in the orbs on their tail tips. They grow more excitable the more power they have stored and seek battles to let loose their excess power.

entry: POKENAME借毛中的静电增强念力。群体积电发出的光，数英里外都能看见。
author: melodydelune
source: It builds up its psychokinetic abilities through the static electricity in its wool. A herd of POKENAME can be seen from miles away from the light they emit from their static buildup.

entry: POKENAME随身银匙充当电力攻击的准星。瞄得极准，100码外目标也能击中。
author: melodydelune
source: The silver spoon POKENAME carries with it acts as a crosshair aiming its electrical attacks. It can aim its attacks so precisely it can hit a target from 100 yards away.

entry: POKENAME为避冲突缩壳，用静电羊毛塞住孔。毛防水，因此最常在湿地吃草。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME withdraws into its shell to avoid conflict, blocking up the holes with its static wool. It is most often found grazing in marshlands since its wool repels water.

entry: POKENAME群居自保。哪怕一只遇险，整群也会从嘴放出强毒。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME live together in herds for protection. If even one is in danger, all of the herd will release a powerful poison from their mouth.

entry: POKENAME粗糙打结的毛，保护翻滚的身体。毛里沾够石头细枝，就脱掉最外层，继续照常滚。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have coarse, matted wool that protects their body whenever they roll around. After collecting rocks and twigs in their wool, they shed the outermost layer of wool so they can keep rolling as usual.

entry: POKENAME战中朝敌人扔静电毛。毛里大量电能，不知为何会招来落雷。
author: mistymagius
source: In combat, POKENAME will throw its static wool at its opponents. The wool contains large amounts of electrical energy that somehow attracts lightning strikes.

entry: POKENAME崇拜群里的咩利龟，训练自己，想一起抵御捕食者。它望向吃草伙伴的外围，用闪动尾灯警告危险。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME idolizes the Matoise in its herd, and trains to help them in defending the group from predators. It watches beyond the grazing members of the herd and will flash blinking signals with its tail to alert them to danger.

entry: POKENAME将魔杖在毛上摩擦，积蓄静电，再瞄准对手，射出一道电光。魔杖似乎能吃，带有辛辣的葱味，却没几人尝试过。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME rubs its wand on its fur to gather a static charge, then aims it at its opponent and fires an electric bolt. The wand is apparently edible, with a spicy onion-like taste, but few have tried it.

entry: POKENAME从喙射雷电，电击靠得太近的一切，战斗中危险又难预测。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lets loose bolts of lightning from its beaks, shocking anything that gets too close. This makes it an unpredictable and dangerous foe in combat.

entry: POKENAME从炮中射带电毛团，守群防危险。背毛很快硬成壳，把碎屑困住，必须常剪。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME protects its flock by firing electrically charged clumps of wool from its cannons at any perceived dangers. Its woolly back must be shorn often as it hardens quickly into a tough shell, trapping detritus within.

entry: POKENAME游不快，通常靠强壳保护。紧急时全身迸强光，试着晃花敌眼。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME does not swim very fast, so it typically relies on its strong shell for protection. In case of emergencies, its body will emit a brilliant flash in an attempt to blind foes.

entry: 据说用POKENAME羊毛做枕头，便不会再做噩梦。它对休息者的安抚舒缓作用，有充分记录。
author: .izik
source: Pillows made with POKENAME's wool are said to remove the ability to have nightmares. Its calming, soothing effect on those who rest with it is well-documented.

entry: POKENAME的华丽羽冠与宽大翅膀，能让种子免受地面上的威胁。它们大部分时间都在空中飞翔，展开双翅，让阳光照到种子上。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME's plume of feathers and large wings protect their bulbs from any threats on the ground. They spend most of their time flying through the air, spreading their wings to let sunlight shine down on their bulbs.

entry: POKENAME虽无翼，却飞得惊人。黏而带羽的身体，从树上数百英尺高处落地也不伤，享用地面花蜜，再随微风飘回。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: Despite its lack of wings, POKENAME is capable of amazing flight. Its sticky, yet feathery body allows it to fall hundreds of feet from off of trees unharmed to feast on nectar on the surface, and floats back up from the slightest breeze.

entry: POKENAME身体大而圆，却有接近时速100英里的飞行记录。它常停在城市和发电厂附近电线，啄破外皮，啃里面的铝。
author: chibitales
source: Despite their large, round body, POKENAME have been recorded flying at speeds close to one hundred miles per hour. They often roost on power lines in cities and near power plants, breaking through the outer coating to pick at the aluminum inside.

entry: POKENAME把骨头当回力镖，击落空中鸟宝可梦，再偷走剩余骨头羽毛，装饰自己。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its bone like a boomerang, striking other Bird Pokémon out of the sky. It will then steal any leftover bones and feathers to decorate itself with.

entry: POKENAME向外鼓出的体形，让它常飞得太高，感到不适。它便硬化身体，增加重量，降回低处，免得飘进太空。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: Because of its curved-out body shape, POKENAME will often fly a bit too high for its comfort. To counter this, it hardens its body, giving them enough weight to come back down  and not float off into space.

entry: POKENAME一跑就难停，常在所住山脉冲出崖边。幸好翅膀能滑向安全处，不致撞到下方地面。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME has trouble stopping after they begin running, often leading them to run off cliffs throughout the mountain ranges they inhabit. Thankfully, their wings allow them to glide to safety and avoid crashing into the ground below.

entry: POKENAME高速破水，是凶猛猎手。快速移动配合撒墨，使猎物看不见，几秒就能拿下远大于己的鱼。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME cuts through the water at blistering speeds, making it a fierce hunter. By blinding prey through quick movements and spreading ink around, it can take down fish much larger than it in mere seconds.

entry: POKENAME两对翅膀操控空中自如，常吓到其他鸟宝可梦。不过，这份威吓也让它能保护交好的绿毛虫与铁甲蛹。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: Other bird Pokémon are easily frightened by POKENAME due to its doubled pair of wings that give it lots of air control. However, its intimidation factor is what allows POKENAME to protect the Caterpie and Metapod it has bonded with.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，谁擅闯就不警告地攻击。过去，角是珍贵战利品，曾遭猎捕，如今因此多住野生原野区。
author: fiordaliso
source: This highly territorial Pokémon attacks without warning anyone who enters its territory without permission. POKENAME was once hunted because its horns were considered a valuable trophy; for this reason, it now lives mostly within Safari Zones.

entry: POKENAME目光极锐，高飞天空也能看见人和宝可梦。过去，角是珍贵战利品，曾遭猎捕，如今因此多住野生原野区。
author: fiordaliso
source: It has extremely sharp eyesight that allows it to spot Pokémon and people even while flying high in the sky. POKENAME was once hunted because its horns were considered a valuable trophy; for this reason, it now lives mostly within Safari Zones.

entry: POKENAME拍翼扬起晃眼尘旋，防捕食者。毒针未发育、喙又小，让它没别的自卫办法。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME flap their wings to create blinding swirls of dust to defend themselves from predators. Their undeveloped stinger and small beak prevent them from using other means of defense.

entry: POKENAME众多羽毛电流噼啪，战中常撒出去电敌。曾见野生个体穿过活跃雷云，充电提神。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's many feathers crackle with electricity, which they will often scatter during battle to shock their opponent. Wild POKENAME have been seen flying through active storm clouds to recharge and refresh themselves.

entry: 互联网早期，POKENAME常送电子邮件，因为穿行网络空间比通常发送还快。如今少见了，但怀旧或锻炼时，仍会请它送信。
author: sk372
source: In earlier days of the internet, POKENAME would deliver emails, as it tended to move through cyberspace faster than messages would typically send. This is less prevalent now, but letting POKENAME deliver mail is still done for sentiment and exercise.

entry: POKENAME刺进大舌贝的壳铰接处，撬开迫使露出柔软器官。先吃软部，再把壳也咬碎吃掉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME break open Shellder by jabbing into the hinge joint and forcing them to expose their soft organs. After eating the softer parts, they crush and consume the shell as well.

entry: POKENAME模仿大比鸟叫，吓退其他宝可梦，避免被吃。连大比鸟也会怕闯进对手领地，离开这带。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME avoid getting eaten by mimicking the cry of a Pidgeot to scare away other Pokémon. This mimicry also causes other Pidgeot to leave the area, fearing that they entered into rival territory.

entry: 许多宝可梦不爱酸味咖喱，POKENAME却选它，好让队伍伙伴吃得开心。它靠酸味料理滋养自己，让其他宝可梦吃最爱的口味，茁壮成长。
author: quackquackattack
source: Sour Curry is not a popular choice for many Pokémon, but it is one that POKENAME takes to ensure other Pokémon in the party can eat well. It nourishes itself on tart and sour dishes so that other Pokémon may thrive eating their favorites.

entry: 洁净的雪日，能见华美的POKENAME飞行，蓝羽泛着美丽蓝光。俯冲捕猎时，双翼会覆上细小冰晶。
author: mistymagius
source: These gorgeous POKENAME can be seen on pristine, snowy days, its blue feathers radiate a beautiful blue glow as it flies. As it swoops down to catch their prey, their wings become coated in small ice crystals.

entry: POKENAME用大针扎猎物，注满毒液。动不了后，就带回巢，那里有等着的雏鸟。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME jabs its prey with its large stinger to pump them full of venom. Once its prey is rendered immobile, it carries the prey to its nest where its chicks are waiting.

entry: POKENAME耐心飞在湖上，等渔民开始钓鱼。一有收获，就俯冲迅速抢走。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME patiently fly above lakes, waiting for fishermen to start fishing. Once a fisherman catches something, POKENAME swoop down and quickly grab whatever they caught.

entry: POKENAME力量强大，感到威胁时，就会掀起龙卷风。蓝色羽毛宛如瀑布，还藏着古老的力量。
author: smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a very strong Pokémon, and it will whip up a tornado if threatened. Its blue feathers look like waterfalls and contain an ancient power.

entry: POKENAME是强大的宝可梦，利爪锋锐无比，遇上威胁，更能轻松卷起龙卷风。
author: smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a very strong Pokémon. Its claws are razor sharp, and it will whip up a tornado without effort if it feels threatened.

entry: POKENAME每月换羽期间，必须等新羽长好才能飞。训练家喂种子、坚果与树果，帮它度过。
author: quackquackattack
source: During its monthly molting, POKENAME cannot fly until its feathers grow back. Trainers support POKENAME during this process by feeding it seeds, nuts, and berries.

entry: POKENAME如杂技般掠过树枝，突袭猎物。趁其不备，毒针啪地扎入，让毒迅速发作。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME performs acrobatic feats to swoop past tree branches and surprise its prey. This surprise allows it to jab its stingers into prey with a quick snap, ensuring that the venom swiftly activates.

entry: 波波难得因猎物分配起争执时，POKENAME会出面调解。它像老练的群体领袖，维持秩序。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: In an unlikely situation where Pidgey can't agree on their share of prey, POKENAME steps in to settle the dispute. Its leadership resembles that of a seasoned flock leader, ensuring order among its group.

entry: POKENAME用丝网与细枝筑黏巢。外出狩猎时，蛋也不会掉出。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME makes nests out of silk webbing and twigs. These sticky nests prevent eggs from falling out of the nest while it is out hunting.

entry: POKENAME的独特狩猎法，让它在群体中与众不同。美羽引来猎物，再用利爪撕碎。
author: cheroace
source: POKENAME sets itself apart from its flock with its unique hunting method. It lures prey in with its gorgeous feathers and tears them apart with its sharp talons.

entry: POKENAME以3马赫飞行，掀起毁灭性狂风，吹倒大片森林。头顶灿烂羽饰，令大小宝可梦都赞叹。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can fly at Mach-3 speeds, causing devastating windstorms that knock down large sections of forest. The plumage on its head is admired by Pokémon of all sizes for its brilliance.

entry: 它鲜艳多彩的羽毛，象征力量与活力。能连续飞数天，不停下休息。
author: soup1900
source: The bright, colorful feathers that this Pokémon has are a sign of strength and vitality. It can fly for days on end without stopping to rest.

entry: POKENAME最爱偷偷混进大比鸟群，试着伪装成其中一员。骗局若被识破，它们就会发出啾鸣般的笑声，飞去寻找新的群体加入。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME take great joy in sneaking in to join flocks of Pidgeot, trying to camouflage themselves amongst them. When their deception is uncovered, they will give a chirping laugh and fly away to find a new flock to join.

entry: POKENAME比未融合的同类更亲近训练家。常能见它引导年轻训练家，继续旅途。
author: amberaxolotl223
source: POKENAME are much friendlier towards trainers than their unfused counterparts. They are often seen guiding young Trainers further in their journeys.

entry: 它鲜艳多彩的羽毛，象征力量与活力。能连续飞数天，不停下休息。
author: soup1900
source: The bright, colorful feathers that this Pokémon has are a sign of strength and vitality. It can fly for days on end without stopping to rest.

entry: POKENAME尖叫吓得猎物慌乱。对方一逃，便抓走带回巢。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a shrill cry that startles their prey into panicking. Once their prey is fleeing, they snatch up their prey to bring back to their nest.

entry: POKENAME会分泌黏液，让羽毛保持光泽。比赛时，有些训练家甚至给它哞哞鲜奶，混入黏液，让羽毛更加闪亮，映着光几乎像珍贵宝石。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME produces a slime that it uses to make its feathers glossy. For competitions, some Trainers even give their POKENAME Moomoo Milk to mix with the slime, as it brings out the shine even more, catching the light almost like a precious gem.

entry: POKENAME渐渐长出更小的翼，好灵活避车。常在杂货店和咖啡馆附近，盼慷慨训练家送甜食。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have developed smaller wings over time to give them more maneuverability to avoid cars. They often spend time around bodegas and cafes hoping to solicit a sweet treat from a generous Trainer.

entry: POKENAME爱沿山坡滑翔取乐。边滑边撒孢子，在下方草上留下黏性残余。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be seen gliding down hills for entertainment. It releases spores as it glides, which leaves a sticky residue on grass below it.

entry: 把波拉达养到进化成POKENAME，就能得到十分忠诚的伙伴。羽毛也总打理得干干净净，摸着柔软。
author: vaporvenator
source: Those who keep Pidtata long enough to evolve into POKENAME are rewarded with a very loyal companion. Its feathers are well-cleaned and soft to touch.

entry: POKENAME狩猎前，总先分析周围。从猎物脚下流沙到附近岩石，一切都考虑好才开始。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME go hunting, they take an analytical glance at their surroundings. From the shifting sand beneath the prey to the rocks that surround the area, everything is taken into account before the hunt ever begins.

entry: 曾目击一只POKENAME独闯由30只烈雀和大嘴雀组成的群。仅5分钟后，已成群体首领。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: A POKENAME was sighted invading a flock of 30 Spearow and Fearow on its own. By the end of the encounter, just 5 minutes later, the POKENAME had become the flock leader.

entry: POKENAME的双翼能让它以2马赫飞行，却更多用来调节体温。爪子般的双钳，则由钢铁构成。
author: darkweavile428
source: While its wings allow it to fly at Mach 2, POKENAME mostly uses them to regulate its body temperature. Its talon-like pincers are made of steel.

entry: POKENAME在悬崖壁的高处安家，脚下便是陡峭的深渊。它们喜欢招惹邻近的宝可梦，闯进对方巢穴抢夺食物，再回到安全的家中。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their homes high up on the side of cliff faces, living above precipitous drops. They have a tendency to pester neighbouring Pokémon, raiding their nests for food before returning to the safety of their home.

entry: POKENAME不受挑衅就不攻击。可光凭外貌举止，所有波波与烈雀都会怕，主动让出食物，盼逃过锐爪尖喙。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME doesn't attack unless provoked. All Pidgey and Spearow fear POKENAME from appearance and demeanor alone and will give up their meals, hoping they will be spared from its razor-sharp talons and beak.

entry: POKENAME能连续翱翔数英里，不需落地。晴天，波波烈雀群会飞在下面，暂避烈日。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME soar through the air for miles without needing to land. On sunny days, flocks of Pidgey and Spearow will fly beneath them, taking shelter from the harsh sun for a bit.

entry: POKENAME努力把金属身体与羽毛打理光亮。谁弄脏哪一处，它就卷起强风，并把落羽掷向对方。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME work hard to keep their metal bodies and feathers polished and clean. They churn fierce winds and fling shed feathers at any who sully any part of their bodies.

entry: POKENAME是顶级猎手，疾飞天空，捕食其他飞行属性宝可梦。金属翼锋利精准，能切开猎物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are apex predators that swiftly dart through the sky to hunt other Flying-type Pokémon. Their metallic wings slice through their prey with sharp precision.

entry: POKENAME的喙带有强毒，领地意识又极强，在野外最好绕远些。它用尾端的羽毛，梳理头上光亮的羽鬃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's beak has a potent venomous bite and a large territorial streak, so it should be given a wide berth in the wild. It uses the feathers on the end of its tail to groom the glossy mane of feathers on its head.

entry: POKENAME很强壮，利爪能搬极重的东西。它搭建的巢也结实，足够承受自己与后代的重量。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME is a very strong Pokémon with the ability to carry very heavy objects with its talons. It builds hardy nests that are strong enough to bear both its weight and that of its offspring.

entry: 秋天，POKENAME互撞鹿角，争夺最佳的冬眠处。胜负一分，落败者就会飞走，另找一处地方继续争夺。
author: quackquackattack
source: During fall, POKENAME clash against each other by ramming their antlers into one another to fight over the best places to hibernate. Once the victor has been decided, the loser flies off to find a different place to fight over.

entry: POKENAME强爪能抓住墙，施展复杂战斗动作。它不懈训练，完善空中技巧，以灵活胜敌。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's powerful talons enable it to cling to walls while executing intricate combat maneuvers. It trains relentlessly to perfect aerial techniques that outmaneuver its foes.

entry: POKENAME讨厌受打扰，睡觉时尤其如此。其他宝可梦若靠得太近又太吵，蛇尾便会注入强毒。
author: teatedtiten
source: POKENAME do not like being disturbed, especially when they sleep. When other Pokémon get too close and too loud, the serpentine tail will inject potent venom into the disturbance.

entry: POKENAME靠吓人的体型管束弱小宝可梦。许多陪舰队司令航行，管其他水手：啄得疼，锐眼又很少漏过冒犯。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their intimidating size to keep weaker Pokémon in line. Many accompany ship admirals to keep other sailors in line, as their pecks are painful and their eyes rarely let any slight go unnoticed.

entry: POKENAME是空中顶级猎手，降雷把猎物吓出洞，方便抓走。猛烈雷雨前夕，光亮冠羽会竖成刺状。
author: sk372
source: An apex aerial hunter, POKENAME sends thunderbolts crashing down from the air to send prey scurrying out of their dens to be easily snatched up. Its glossy crest becomes spiky and stands up on the eve of intense thunderstorms.

entry: POKENAME每天若吃不到3棵树的树果量，就懊恼高叫。饲养者必须常备足量树果。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME does not consume three trees' worth of berries daily, it will chirp loudly in frustration. Trainers raising one must always have a plentiful berry supply on hand.

entry: POKENAME一见甜味咖喱，就想赢小小杯。如今太大，已不适合参赛，便一有机会就为训练家的幼年宝可梦加油。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME sees a plate of Sweet Curry, it is filled with thoughts of winning the Little Cup. Now that it is too big for those events, it cheers for the Trainer's baby Pokémon whenever it gets the chance.

entry: POKENAME群猎，在树上等猎物经过。配合几近完美，俯冲捕捉，常一举拿下整群宝可梦。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME hunt in flocks, waiting in the trees for their prey to pass by. With almost perfect coordination, they swoop down to snatch up their prey, often taking down entire groups of Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME每根羽都带强磁，落下也保留。因此数码影像总出现“光晕”效果。
author: staghorn
source: Each of POKENAME's feathers holds a potent magnetic charge, even after being shed. Digital recordings of it consistently have a "halo" effect, as a result.

entry: 有些古遗迹壁画尊POKENAME为某种守护神。它发射带磁羽毛，各自移动，打击多个目标。
author: sk372
source: Some ancient ruins depict murals of POKENAME, revering it as some type of guardian deity. It fires magnetically charged feathers that can move independently and strike multiple targets.

entry: POKENAME极和平，以树果为食，避免捕猎其他生物。谁碰羽毛，都会满心平和安宁。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an extremely peaceful being that follows a berry-based diet to avoid hunting other creatures. Anyone who touches its feathers is overcome with a sense of complete peace and serenity.

entry: POKENAME骄傲又焦虑，似乎不喜欢陌生者陪伴。有人看就试装威严冷静，年长后情绪才渐稳。
author: bobosmith01
source: Prideful yet anxious, POKENAME does not seem to enjoy the company of strangers. It will attempt to model an intimidating and stoic persona if there is anyone watching it. As POKENAME grows older, its mood tends to stabilize.

entry: POKENAME光亮的羽鬃，尽可能多吸阳光，进行光合作用。战中猛拍翼，脱落刀锋般的叶状羽，借强风射出。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's glossy mane lets it soak up a maximum amount of sunlight for photosynthesis. In battle, it vigorously flaps its wings to shed razor-sharp leaf-like feathers propelled by the gusts of wind it creates.

entry: POKENAME双眼打旋，想看远物或猎物就极头晕。羽毛暗淡凌乱，让一般大比鸟迷大失所望。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME becomes extremely dizzy when trying to spot faraway objects or prey due to its swirly eyes. Its feathers are rather dull and messy, making it a great disappointment to typical Pidgeot fans.

entry: POKENAME在树梢间滑翔找鲜果。谁来采最爱树果树上的果子，它都会毫不犹豫击倒。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME glide from treetop to treetop in search of fresh fruit. They have no qualms about striking down unwanted gatherers taking from their favorite berry trees.

entry: 强翼与利爪，让POKENAME能在野外狩猎。体侧的红刺，则保护它珍爱的翅膀，不让敌人伤害。
author: therider
source: Strong wings and sharp claws allow POKENAME to hunt in the wild. The red spikes along its side prevent attackers from harming its prized wings.

entry: 许多空手道王在擂台模仿POKENAME。它从不退缩，拳脚快如闪电，再跳上树顶，俯冲使出燕返。
author: ghostslythe
source: Many Black Belts mimic POKENAME's moves in the ring. They never back down from a challenge, their kicks and punches landing lightning-quick before they jump on top of trees to dive into an Aerial Ace.

entry: POKENAME羽臂肌肉发达，战中主要却用来维持浮空，改以强踢向下打敌。
author: .jerden
source: While POKENAME's feathered arms are muscular, in combat it mostly uses them to keep itself up in the air. It strikes down at its foes with powerful kicks instead.

entry: POKENAME强翼载它上树顶，为水坝采更多枝条。求偶仪式的一部分，是互相梳理光亮的羽鬃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its powerful wings to fly up to the tops of trees and gather more branches for its dams. Part of its mating ritual involves POKENAME grooming each others' glossy manes.

entry: POKENAME温柔宽厚，让其他鸟宝可梦在背上筑巢。自己与巢遇袭，就放出只针对威胁的毒孢子。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a gentle and magnanimous nature that encourages other bird Pokémon to use its back as a nest. Whenever it and the nest on its back are attacked, it releases toxic spores that only target the threat.

entry: 天刚亮，POKENAME便出巢，找虫子或露根。清晨这阵活动出其不意，常能带回大量食物。
author: quackquackattack
source: At the crack of dawn, POKENAME emerges from its nest to hunt for bugs or exposed roots. This burst of early morning activity catches most prey by surprise, so it brings plenty of food back.

entry: POKENAME领地意识很强，同类对手若闯入自己的家园，它便会应战。两者的战斗可持续数小时，彼此振翅，掀起强风，尖厉的叫声回荡群山。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are territorial and will battle any rival POKENAME that stray into the area they call home. Battles between the two can last for hours with loud squawks echoing through the mountains as they flap powerful blasts of air at one another.

entry: POKENAME驱赶猎物时轻松浮在水上，翅膀似已退化。可守护波波一系与吼吼鲸的融合群体时，巨大强翼一拍，连海床深处的构造板块也会移动。
author: therealcenk
source: POKENAME effortlessly floats over water while herding prey, seemingly having vestigial wings. When POKENAME is defending a school of Pidmer, the flap of those massive, powerful wings causes even tectonic plates deep under the seafloor to shift.

entry: POKENAME只需振一下翅膀，就能腾空而起，速度可达每小时七十英里。起飞的力量大得会激起冲击波，飞走后，总会留下一根发光的羽毛。
author: sk372
source: With a single flap of its wings, POKENAME can take to the skies at speeds reaching 70MPH. Its take-off is so powerful that it releases a shockwave, and it always leaves a single glowing feather behind after it flies off.

entry: POKENAME领地意识很强，同类对手若闯入自己的家园，它便会应战。两者的战斗可持续数小时，彼此振翅，掀起强风，尖厉的叫声回荡群山。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are territorial and will battle any rival POKENAME that stray into the area they call home. Battles between the two can last for hours with loud squawks echoing through the mountains as they flap powerful blasts of air at one another.

entry: POKENAME常从高空俯冲，以利爪踢出重击。猎物的同伴还没反应，目标便被抓走，只剩混乱与羽毛。
author: frink202
source: POKENAME usually swoop down from on high before delivering devastating kicks with their talons. They abduct their prey before their peers can even react, leaving nothing but confusion and feathers behind.

entry: POKENAME看似虚荣孤僻，其实细心观察附近宝可梦，担当保护者。一有麻烦，迅速赶走肇事者，再回巢守望。
author: chinigan
source: Though they may seem vain and antisocial, POKENAME are carefully keeping track of the Pokémon that live near them to act as a protector. Should trouble arise, they're quick to chase off the perpetrator, then resume watching from their nest.

entry: POKENAME凶恶变体的来历不明，似乎为取乐，什么都猎。行为虽吓人，有时也爱平静生活，而且颇聪明。沿岸散步似乎能安抚它。
author: chinigan
source: The origin of POKENAME's threatening variant is unknown. They will hunt anything, seemingly for fun. Despite their fearsome behavior, POKENAME sometimes enjoy peaceful lives and are quite intelligent. Walking along the shore seems to calm them.

entry: POKENAME精确控制磁力，几乎能无限漂浮。它可把石翼的一部分射出，石块稍后又靠磁力飞回。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's strong control over its own magnetism lets it float around almost indefinitely. It can fire off parts of its stone wings as projectiles, the stones returning shortly after via magnetic force.

entry: 很久以前，许多恶名昭彰的海盗船长首选POKENAME为武器，看中锐利头脑与更锋利的刃。
author: .fedoraman
source: In times long past, POKENAME were known as the weapon of choice for many infamous pirate captains. They valued this Pokémon for its keen mind and keener blade.

entry: POKENAME的剑分飞时达1马赫，合飞则达2马赫。狩猎效率太高，多数时候只是取乐。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's swords fly at Mach 1 separated and Mach 2 while flying together. They are such effective hunters that they most often hunt for sport.

entry: POKENAME弯曲的刀刃，让它深受海盗喜爱。夜里，它们会切下虫类宝可梦睡着的树枝，带着猎物回到山中的巢穴。
author: leandermalurt
source: Their curved blades have made POKENAME a popular Pokémon among pirates. During the night, they hunt down bug Pokémon by cutting off the branches that the bugs sleep on and carry them back to their nests in the mountains.

entry: POKENAME若认为群体遇险，就会毫不犹豫地扑向敌人，试图用额上的毒角刺穿对方。双翼强健，让它俯冲时能达到惊人速度。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it believes its group is in danger, POKENAME won't hesitate to hurl itself at its enemies, attempting to pierce them with the poisonous horn on its forehead. Its wings are so strong that they allow it to reach incredible speeds when diving.

entry: POKENAME用利爪与天降雷电守领地。赢得信任者，便得到忠诚伙伴。
author: garret95
source: POKENAME protects its domain with sharp claws and by unleashing electric bolts from the sky. Those who win its trust are rewarded with a loyal companion.

entry: POKENAME战中高速旋身，造大旋风。科学家正研究能否用于风力发电。
author: mistymagius
source: In combat, POKENAME will spin its body at high speeds to create large twisters. Scientists have been researching if POKENAME's abilities could be used as a source of wind power.

entry: POKENAME常停在信任的训练家肩头，遇到喜欢的训练家，也会轻轻咕鸣。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME will often perch on the shoulders of Trainers it trusts. It emits a soft, cooing sound around Trainers it likes.

entry: POKENAME双翼能掀烈风，把擅闯山中家园者吹得滚下悬崖。登山男被建议带食物供品，安抚暴躁的它。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to flap their wings strong enough to create gale-force winds, an ability they use to send trespassers on their mountain homes tumbling down cliffs. Hikers are advised to bring food offerings to appease the cantankerous Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME双翼能掀烈风，把擅闯山中家园者吹得滚下悬崖。有些还会在崖顶扫尾，让巨石追着惹怒者滚下。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to flap their wings to create gale-force winds, sending trespassers on their mountain homes tumbling down cliffs. Some POKENAME will then swipe their tail at the cliff top to send boulders after the target of their ire.

entry: POKENAME巨翼每拍一下，就迅速召来一波风暴。愤怒时，降下雷电与狂风，令敌人恐惧。
author: quackquackattack
source: Each beat of POKENAME's massive wings can swiftly call a surge of storms to gather around it. When angered, POKENAME rains down bolts of lightning and torrential winds to strike fear into its foes.

entry: POKENAME飞过的地方，会留下约1小时的淡玫瑰香。过去有人借它聪慧与惊人速度，长途送信。
author: quantumradiation
source: The areas POKENAME fly over have a faint rose scent that lasts for about an hour after their appearance. In the past, some have used POKENAME to deliver letters across large distances due to their intelligence and impressive flight speeds.

entry: POKENAME以长眉羽为傲。两只相遇，眉羽更长者便占主导。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's long brow feathers are a point of pride. When two POKENAME meet, the one with the longest brow feathers will assert dominance over the other.

entry: POKENAME用利爪尖喙凶猛守领地，空中疾飞，快速击打侵犯者。可身体脆弱，得在猛攻与安全距离间不断平衡。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME aggressively defends its territory with its sharp claws and beak, darting through the sky to land quick blows on its aggressors. It has a frail body, however, and needs to constantly balance its aggression with keeping a safe distance.

entry: POKENAME群每7年爬出地下巢，仿佛凭空出现。出土总是吵闹，响亮啁啾填满森林，持续数月。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Flocks of POKENAME emerge as if from nowhere once every seven years, clambering free of their underground nests. Their emergence is invariably a noisy affair, loud chirping filling the forests for months.

entry: POKENAME若不满意尾中困住的猎物，就直接吃掉，再找更能打的目标。不过，多数时候笼子仍空着。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: If POKENAME is not satisfied with the prey trapped in its tail, it will simply consume them and find another quarry that puts up a better fight. More often than not, however, its cage remains empty.

entry: 给几颗种子，POKENAME就能让酷暑家中凉爽。特别顽皮时，会吹乱没压好的书刊页。
author: quackquackattack
source: In exchange for a few seeds, POKENAME can keep a home cool during the hot summer.  Whenever they feel particularly mischievous, they blow air across unsecured pages of books and magazines.

entry: 满月夜，POKENAME高飞，群体同步跳舞，图案像夜空星座。
author: quackquackattack
source: During nights of the full moon, POKENAME fly at high altitudes and dance in synchronized patterns. These patterns resemble constellations in the night sky.

entry: POKENAME体大翼小，飞不好。可纯粹的力量与狡诈战术，仍让它成为可怕对手。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME cannot fly well due to its bulky size and small wings. Despite this disadvantage, its sheer strength and devious tactics make it a terrifying opponent.

entry: POKENAME用强翼掀起猛烈狂风，再以锋利如刀的长牙斩击。它们力气很大，能用利爪抓起大型敌人，带上空中，再往下抛。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME fight with forceful gales loosed by their strong wings and with slashing attacks that utilize their razor-sharp tusks. They are strong enough to pick up large foes with their talons and lift them into the air before throwing them downward.

entry: POKENAME展着雄伟双翼翱翔，通常守护古遗迹，以诡异强风吓退闯入者。
author: nightwingjay
source: POKENAME soars through the skies with its majestic wings. POKENAME typically guard ancient ruins where they will create eerie and powerful winds to scare off any intruders.

entry: POKENAME灵巧的爪能开锁。无性别，不能用迷人，就试着用偷来的收藏吸引其他宝可梦。
author: haypile
source: They can pick locks using their dexterous talons. Genderless POKENAME that can't use Attract instead try to impress other Pokémon with their stolen collection.

entry: POKENAME战得越久、越躁动，羽间就散越多热。它用强壮滚烫的爪钉住猎物，迅速给予最后一击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME vent more and more heat from between their feathers as a battle draws on and as their agitation builds. They use their strong, scalding talons to pin down prey and quickly finish them off.

entry: POKENAME驾驭天空，乘上升气流巡视领地，能向地上敌人洒下火弹。
author: elite01.
source: POKENAME has mastered the skies and soars on updrafts to view its territory. It can rain pellets of fire on its opponents on the ground.

entry: POKENAME性情凶暴，三个头不停啄，直到对方昏迷不动。似乎唯有面对年幼波波，才控得住冲动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's violent nature compels it to peck creatures with all three of its heads until they are unconscious and unmoving. It seems to be able to rein in its impulses only when confronted with young Pidgey.

entry: 春天，POKENAME啁啾唱欢歌，找能终生同唱的伴侣。壮丽双翼让它高飞到云层之上。
author: fiordaliso
source: In spring, POKENAME tweets cheerful songs in search of a partner to sing alongside for the rest of its life. Its majestic wings let it soar to great heights, above the banks of clouds.

entry: POKENAME羽毛亮如光滑黑曜石。枕下放一根，就能整夜温暖。
author: ozydamians
source: POKENAME's feathers shine like sleek obsidian. A single plume under your pillow can keep you warm throughout the night.

entry: POKENAME是无害的大鸟，羽发美丽柔滑。世界各地城市精英的鸟舍里，都很受欢迎。
author: ratractac
source: POKENAME is an inoffensive large bird with beautiful, silky hair. POKENAME is popular in the aviaries of urban elites around the world.

entry: POKENAME用超能力增强本已敏锐的视力，数百米外微小动静也看得见。吃樱子果，让羽冠鲜艳。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses psychic powers to enhance its already sharp vision, detecting even the slightest movement from hundreds of meters away. Its diet of Cheri Berries keeps its feathered crest vibrant.

entry: POKENAME发展出好记性，记住觅食地，省去留凝胶记号所需的能量。许多个体的长羽冠标志资历。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME develop a sharp memory to help them remember their feeding spots. This allows them to conserve energy normally used to leave gel markers. Many POKENAME have long feather crests that signal their seniority.

entry: POKENAME华美头羽让飞行无声。羽毛虽抢手，据说拔一根却会倒霉30年。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME gorgeous head feathers allow it to fly without making a sound. Though the feathers are highly coveted, it is said that to pluck one will bring three decades of bad luck.

entry: 它个头小，双翼掀起的疾风却能割伤树干。长牙不断脱落再生，落牙美丽，深受收藏家追捧。
author: infinex21
source: Despite its small size, this Pokémon's wings can create cutting gales that scar trees. Its tusks are always being shed and regrown; the shed tusks are widely sought by collectors due to how beautiful they are.

entry: POKENAME双翼强到能击碎岩石，长牙一斩便断树。性情相对温顺，因此很受新手训练家欢迎。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's wings are strong enough to physically shatter rocks and its tusks can cleave through a tree in a single slash. It is relatively docile and, thus, favored by starting Trainers.

entry: POKENAME虽小，却是凶猛战士。利爪踩敌时，美丽头羽也随之舞动。
author: asyoko
source: Despite it's small stature, POKENAME is a ferocious battler. It's gorgeous head feathers dance as it stomps on it's foes with it's sharp talons.

entry: 许多航空管制员视POKENAME为麻烦。管制塔挡住迁徙路线，它就撞上去，许多还停在塔顶，利爪弄坏屋顶。
author: quackquackattack
source: Regarded as a nuisance by many air traffic controllers, POKENAME slam into air traffic control towers because they interfere with their migratory patterns. Many end up perching atop the towers, causing damage to the roof with their sharp talons.

entry: POKENAME太重，无法飞翔，便靠强壮的双腿，在开阔的平原上奔跑追猎。它猛然加速，伏击体型较小的宝可梦，再将其拖回隐蔽的巢穴。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME is too heavy to fly, instead it uses its powerful legs to sprint across open plains in pursuit of prey. It ambushes smaller Pokémon with sudden bursts of speed and drags them back to its hidden nest.

entry: POKENAME咬合力强，钩喙让咬伤更疼。近期发现认为，它可能比当代科学复原的怪颚龙，更接近怪颚龙原貌，但仍有争论。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: POKENAME's bite force is strong and much more painful due to their hooked beak. Recent discoveries suggest POKENAME may be closer to what Tyrantrum originally looked like than what modern science has recreated, but many still debate about this.

entry: POKENAME无声而优雅地漂过冰冻山口。长彩冠兜高空气流，稳定轻盈飞行，连猛烈暴雪也能轻松穿过。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME drift gracefully through frozen mountain passes without making a sound. Their long, colorful crests catch high-altitude winds, stabilizing their weightless flight and making it so they can navigate fierce snowstorms with ease.

entry: 它头羽散出仿若名贵花草的香气，藏进灌丛，引猎物入陷阱。一扇翼便能掀毁灭性旋风，让敌人无路可逃。
author: fiordaliso
source: The feathers on its head emit a scent that mimics a fancy plant, allowing it to hide among bushes and lure unsuspecting prey into its trap. A single beat of its wings is enough to create devastating whirlwinds that leave no escape for its enemies.

entry: 有人偏离常走的路时，常能遇到POKENAME。许多个体冰中封着另一活物，可被困者是否仍有意识，还不清楚。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME are commonly found when someone strays from the beaten path. Many POKENAME contain another living creature encased within their ice, though it's unclear whether the trapped creature is still conscious.

entry: POKENAME靠宽大花瓣，借上升气流滑翔各处，在风中轻轻旋转。长途旅行时，它们用长羽的尾巴指引方向、稳定身体。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their broad petals to glide from place to place, catching updrafts and spinning gently in the wind. They use their feathered tail to guide and stabilise themselves when they want to travel large distances.

entry: POKENAME领地意识强得危险，群体把整片山坡据为族群所有。常与迁徙的独角犀牛冲突。
author: schwaus
source: POKENAME is dangerously territorial. Groups of them claim whole mountainsides for their kin. They frequently clash with migrating Rhyhorn.

entry: POKENAME羽毛已适应，覆满碎屑也能高效运作。随季节不同，在沙漠或海滩狩猎。
author: schwaus
source: POKENAME's feathers have adapted to work efficiently even when covered in debris. They are found hunting in deserts or beaches depending on the season.

entry: POKENAME住在树梢，吃叶子与枯木。背上的真菌，却夺去了它感受疼痛的能力。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lives in treetops, where it feeds on leaves and dead wood. The fungus on its back robs it of any sense of pain.

entry: POKENAME洗尘浴、互相梳羽，保持健康光亮。烦躁时猛烈抖羽，发出密集鼓点般的声响。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME maintain the health and shine of their feathers by bathing in dust and preening each other. When agitated, they shake their feathers vigorously, making a sound similar to a drumroll.

entry: POKENAME翼上鳞片像小羽，覆着孢子。它在森林四处落羽，标记领地。
author: quackquackattack
source: The scales of a POKENAME's wing resemble small feathers and are coated with POKENAME's spores. POKENAME shed feathers throughout the forest to mark their territory.

entry: POKENAME一家世代住同一棵树。歌声像极人声，许多人把它们的群体叫“合唱团”。
author: turron_turron
source: Families of POKENAME call the same trees home for generations. Many refer to groups of these Pokémon as 'choirs', as their song-like voices bear a striking similarity to those of people.

entry: POKENAME飞在河床上方，等最佳伏击时机。它迅速俯冲入水，用利爪刺抓目标，再跳胜利舞。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME soars above riverbeds, waiting for the perfect opportunity to ambush its prey. It divebombs swiftly into the water, catching its target with its piercing talons, then celebrates with a victory dance.

entry: POKENAME复杂高速的空中表演，让许多训练家赞叹。若有音乐，就随节奏协调动作。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME impresses many trainers with its elaborate, high-speed aerial performances. If music is playing, it will coordinate its movements to the rhythm.

entry: 奇怪的是，POKENAME群试图飞出太阳系。可翅膀一累，就落回来，常被误认成流星雨。
author: seanothan_23
source: Strangely, flocks of POKENAME attempt to fly past the solar system. However, when their wings tire out, they fall back down, often being mistaken for meteor showers.

entry: POKENAME头羽像火焰，恰好映出惊人体温。它喷出阵阵烟，加速并晃花追赶者的眼。
author: bobogagabobo
source: POKENAME's head feathers resemble a flame that perfectly represents its incredible internal temperature. It uses bursts of smoke to speed up and blind any Pokémon chasing it.

entry: 晴天，羽毛如彩虹闪耀。据说中世纪最负盛名的手稿，便用POKENAME的羽毛笔书写。
author: ozydamians
source: On sunny days, its feathers glow like a shimmering rainbow. In medieval times, the most illustrious manuscripts were said to be penned with POKENAME quills.

entry: POKENAME用落羽铺隧道，给幼崽睡时温暖舒适的床。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lines its tunnels with loose feathers for its young. The soft bedding provides warmth and comfort while they sleep.

entry: 曾有报告，POKENAME用头羽捆住吵架情侣。过去只见于关都，如今栖息地受扰，连邻近城都也出现这种行为。
author: linhasxoc
source: Incidents have been reported of POKENAME using its head feathers to restrain quarreling couples. Though historically limited to Kanto, habitat disruption has caused this behavior to spread to neighboring Johto.

entry: POKENAME在地下用强翼凿穿坚岩，每天花数小时挖隧道，巡视领地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses powerful wings underground to dig through solid stone. It spends hours daily tunneling to patrol its territory.

entry: POKENAME双翼让它飞得惊人快。据说来自异世界，性情友善，是好伙伴。训练家遇困，就抓起飞走。
author: ghost.moth.666
source: POKENAME uses its wings to fly at impressive speeds. It's said that this Pokémon came from another world. Its friendly disposition makes it a good partner. If its Trainer is in trouble, it will grab them and fly away.

entry: POKENAME极重视外貌，训练家呵护时最开心。它用爪轻梳胡须，保持完美状态，随时感知飞行中的风。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME take great pride in their appearance and are at their happiest when they're being pampered by their trainer. They keep their whiskers in pristine condition with gentle brushes of their paw, keeping them ready for sensing the wind in flight.

entry: POKENAME十分看重自己的外表，最开心的就是受到训练家的悉心呵护。它们常用喙梳理羽毛和毛发，时刻准备着一有需要便飞上天空。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME take great pride in their appearance and are at their happiest when they're being pampered by their trainer. They regularly preen at their feathers and fur with their beak, keeping themselves ready to take to the air at a moment's notice.

entry: POKENAME对自己的外貌十分自豪，得到训练家宠爱时，最为开心。梳理羽毛时，它会发出轻柔的咕噜声，享受这番照料，总还想再多梳一会儿。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME take great pride in their appearance and are at their happiest when they're being pampered by their trainer. They make a soft purring coo as their feathers are brushed, enjoying the act of grooming and always wanting more.

entry: POKENAME常被派去照看巢中幼崽。这责任让它常头痛，尤其得把兄弟姐妹从危险中救出时。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are often tasked with taking care of baby Pokémon at their nest. This duty gives them many headaches, especially when POKENAME have to rescue their siblings from danger.

entry: POKENAME教波波群偷野餐食物。有些公园只好在建筑设施上作驱鸟设计，阻止它逗留。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME teach Pidgey flocks on how to steal food from picnics. Some parks have resorted to installing hostile architecture to discourage the presence of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME狡猾，爱偷野餐篮。它训练波波群分散游客注意，再抓走篮子。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are cunning creatures that love to steal picnic baskets. They train flocks of Pidgey to distract parkgoers before snatching the basket.

entry: POKENAME以头上光亮长羽为傲。任何东西碰到，就会立刻疯狂拍翼尖叫。
author: sk372
source: It takes pride in the glossy length of feathers extending from its head. Anything touching these feathers will quickly send POKENAME into a flapping, screeching frenzy.

entry: POKENAME暴怒，身体羽毛变硬竖起，攻击附近一切。它剧烈拍翼，以刀锋般的风斩击。
author: .izik
source: The feathers on POKENAME's body become rigid and erect when it flies into a rage. In this state, it attacks anything nearby, flapping its wings violently to strike with razor-sharp gusts.

entry: POKENAME是许多文明民间传说中的古老生物。无数仿其形的雕像守着古庙。据说瞥见飞行身影，会得难以想象的好运。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an ancient creature woven into the folklore of many civilizations. Countless statues depicting it stand guard at old temples. It is said that glimpsing one in flight brings unimaginable good fortune.

entry: POKENAME是许多文明民间传说中的古老生物。无数仿其形的雕像守着古庙。据说瞥见飞行身影，会得难以想象的好运。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an ancient creature woven into the folklore of many civilizations. Countless statues depicting it stand guard at old temples. It is said that glimpsing one in flight brings unimaginable good fortune.

entry: POKENAME嘴尖能击碎巨石。遇险一扇翼，就掀猛烈火旋风。
author: bobosmith01
source: The tip of POKENAME's maw can shatter boulders. If in danger, it can whip up intense fiery whirlwinds with a flap of its wings.

entry: POKENAME天生总想训练肌肉，成为周围最强。体型虽丝毫不利飞行，最强个体仍能靠拍臂飞起。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have an innate urge to train constantly, working on their muscles so that they can be the strongest Pokémon around. Despite not being at all aerodynamic, the strongest POKENAME are still able to fly by flapping their arms.

entry: POKENAME嘴尖能击碎巨石。遇险一扇翼，就掀猛烈火旋风。
author: bobosmith01
source: The tip of POKENAME's maw can shatter boulders. If in danger, it can whip up intense fiery whirlwinds with a flap of its wings.

entry: POKENAME双翼强壮，能连续飞18小时不休息。唯有认定对手值得全力，才动用灼热火焰。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME possesses wings strong enough to fly for 18 consecutive hours without rest. It only resorts to its searing flame attacks if it deems its opponent worthy of its full power.

entry: POKENAME巨翼很难收进壳。小喙限制它只吃树果，从灌木摘下毫不费力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have massive wings that are hard to tuck into their shell. Their small beaks limit their diet to berries, which they pluck from bushes with ease.

entry: POKENAME无翼，手臂却强到能将身体弹出极远，甚至达2马赫。若以这速度挨坚实躯干猛撞，通常致命。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Though POKENAME has no wings, it possesses arms strong enough to launch itself through the air at great distances, even achieving Mach 2 speeds. To be pummeled by its sturdy torso at that speed is usually fatal.

entry: POKENAME用尖喙挖大理石矿，吃碎屑。矿物强化骨骼，让飞行本领更强。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its sharp beak to dig into marble deposits and consume the rubble. The minerals it ingests strengthen its bones, making it an even more formidable flier.

entry: POKENAME圆身由紧压的泥土组成。它洗干土浴修补损伤，再抖掉翼尘，羽毛比原先还干净。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's round body is made of tightly packed dirt. It bathes itself in dry earth to repair any damage, then shakes the dust out of its wings to leave the feathers cleaner than they were before.

entry: 许多威严飞天坐骑的故事，都受它启发。控火极精，绝不伤敌人以外的任何对象。
author: infinex21
source: Many tales about majestic, flying steeds were inspired by this Pokémon. It has such control over its flames that they will never hurt anyone other than its foes.

entry: POKENAME一拍翼就能迅速后跃，把小猎物拉出洞。它用水喷湿猎物毛发，让逃脱困难。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can quickly leap backwards with a flap of their wings that allows them to pull small prey out of their burrow. They spray their prey's fur with water to make escape difficult.

entry: 尽管有人误会，它与手持的走路草似乎彼此喜欢。有时能见它战后照料走路草的伤。
author: plkfsa32
source: Despite misconceptions, this Pokémon and the Oddish it holds appear to be fond of each other. Sometimes, it is seen tending to the Oddish's wounds after battles.

entry: POKENAME羽毛的特殊油，让它轻松在水中滑行。速度足够，便潜入水面下，像鱼雷般推进。
author: .izik
source: A special oil secreted from POKENAME's feathers allows it to glide effortlessly in water. With enough speed, it can dive beneath the surface and propel itself like a torpedo.

entry: POKENAME华美羽毛能耐受家乡的冰冷海洋。虽不再能融入白雪，仍可轻松以2马赫游走。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: Its gorgeous feathers are resilient to the frigid oceans that it calls home. Though it can no longer camouflage among the snow, POKENAME can easily swim away at Mach 2 speed.

entry: POKENAME掠过下水道，捉小拉达等猎物，沿途留下臭如垃圾的黏糊残余。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swoops through sewers, looking for Rattata or other prey to snatch. It leaves trails of gooey residue that reek of garbage.

entry: POKENAME背炮喷出的阵阵水流足以击倒树。狩猎先高飞选目标，再以暴烈水势震晕。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME fire bursts of water from their back cannons that can knock down trees. When hunting, they fly into the sky to identify a good target before releasing a torrential force that stuns their prey.

entry: 它能将炮口朝下，喷出道道水流，将自己推上天空。POKENAME十分为自己的羽冠骄傲，羽毛越长，就表示个体越健康。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is capable of taking flight by angling its cannons downward and blasting streams of water to launch itself into the air. POKENAME is very proud of its feathered crest, the longer the feathers, the healthier the Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME仔细梳理爪背羽毛。越大、打理越好，就越能吸引伴侣。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME takes great care in grooming the plumage located on the back of its claws. The bigger and better-kept the feathers, the more likely it will be able to attract a partner.

entry: 每个POKENAME都有一头华美软棉毛，与同窝伙伴织在一起。摸着虽极软，却带着六个成员天生的电。
author: t3isukone
source: Each individual POKENAME has its own head of luxuriously soft cotton wool that they weave together with the rest of the clutch. While it is incredibly soft to touch, it's also charged with all six's natural electricity.

entry: POKENAME带导电骨头，靠它电击敌人。电耗光，就拿骨蹭身体，再产更多。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME carry a bone that conducts electricity that they rely on to zap foes. Once the electricity is depleted, they rub the bone against their bodies to generate more electricity.

entry: POKENAME产生强静电，将自己黏在树上。若不定期放电，它们可能彼此黏成团，甚至被吸向路人的衣料，黏在上面。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME produce a strong static charge that they use to attach themselves to trees. If they do not discharge regularly they can end up attaching to one another in clumps, or even get drawn to and stick to clothing of people passing by.

entry: POKENAME腹袋衬软毛，给蛋保暖。冷天能把袋口拉高，让暖绒盖住蛋。
author: hophoppip
source: The pocket on POKENAME's belly is lined with soft wool to keep its egg warm. On cold days, POKENAME can pull the pocket up to cover the egg in warm fluff.

entry: POKENAME把孤儿咩利羊安全放袋中保护。尾球存电，随时可放出护孩子。
author: sk372
source: Orphaned Mareep are under POKENAME's protection, carried safely within its pouch. Electricity stored in the orb on its tail can be discharged at any time in protection of its child.

entry: POKENAME产生强静电，将自己黏在树上。若不定期放电，它们可能彼此黏成团，甚至被吸向路人的衣料，黏在上面。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME produce a strong static charge that they use to attach themselves to trees. If they do not discharge regularly they can end up attaching to one another in clumps, or even get drawn to and stick to clothing of people passing by.

entry: POKENAME游历关都城都，为愿听者演乡村音乐。现场听众说，演得太好，头发都竖了起来。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME travel throughout Kanto and Johto, performing Country music for all who listen. Those who listen to live performances claim that their hair stood on end from how well the performance was.

entry: POKENAME挥臂越多，羊毛中储存的电力也越多。战斗时，它有时会扯下一团带电的羊毛掷出，命中目标，毛团便会爆出雷电。
author: sk372
source: The more POKENAME swings its arms, the more electricity it stores within its wool. During battles it will sometimes tear off a chunk of electrified wool and toss it, the clump exploding into lightning when it hits a target.

entry: POKENAME羊毛不断产电，触碰危险。被接近时，就溶入附近水域，让水面带电。
author: krivaswell
source: POKENAME's fleece generates electricity constantly, making it dangerous to touch. When approached, it dissolves into nearby bodies of water, leaving the surface electrically charged.

entry: POKENAME长出厚厚的羊毛外壳，感到危险，便将柔软的身体藏进去。物理防护虽有限，羊毛却带电，谁试着咬上去，就会挨电。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME grow a thick woollen shell to hide their soft body within, sheltering themselves from harm when they feel endangered. Though it offers little physical protection, their wool is electrically charged and shocks those who try to bite into it.

entry: POKENAME长厚毛壳，遇险把柔软身体藏进去。宝石带电时闪耀亮蓝光，触碰就会被电光电得生疼。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME grow a thick woollen shell to hide their soft body within, sheltering themselves from harm when they feel endangered. Their gem sparkles a brilliant blue when it is charged with electricity, delivering painful Sparks to those who touch them.

entry: POKENAME临时竖琴的每根弦，都由坚韧毛织成。摇篮曲能安抚最凶暴的宝可梦，拨弦还能召雷。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Each string on POKENAME's makeshift harp is made with their sturdy fleece. Their lullabies can soothe the most savage Pokémon, and plucking their strings calls lightning strikes.

entry: POKENAME所产的电，似乎像神经系统电流。用它供能的除颤仪，让心脏恢复跳动的效果尤其好。
author: imaginita
source: It appears that the electricity generated by a POKENAME acts like the electricity of a nervous system. Defibrillators powered by a POKENAME are especially effective at restarting hearts.

entry: POKENAME受威胁，便来回挥头绒。毛的旋转积起电，再阵阵放出自卫。
author: sk372
source: If it feels threatened, POKENAME begins waving the fluff on its head around. The wool's rotation charges up electricity within it, letting it release it in bursts to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME喜爱雷暴造成的强上升气流，主动寻找。在带电天空翱翔的刺激，助长了冒险天性。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME loves the strong updrafts caused by lightning storms and seeks them out. The thrill of soaring through charged skies fuels its adventurous nature.

entry: POKENAME触角覆防水绒毛，能用电力制造十分柔散的光。水族馆深海展区很喜欢它，照亮水缸却不过分刺眼。
author: katieplaysgames
source: With antennae coated in waterproof fluff, POKENAME produce very diffuse lighting with their electrical powers. They are popular Pokémon for deep sea exhibits in aquariums as they light up the tanks without being overwhelmingly bright.

entry: POKENAME常被误认成异色咩利羊。可毛厚与所产电压，都更近于茸茸羊。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME is commonly mistaken for a Shiny Mareep. The thickness of its wool and the voltage of the electricity it generates, however, is much closer to that of a Flaaffy.

entry: POKENAME厚毛长得快，静电强到能托起小物件。剪下的纤维，可用在电线内部。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME's thick wool grows so quickly that its static is strong enough to make small objects float. When shorn, the fibres can be used inside power lines.

entry: POKENAME的大半电力，来自天然棉絮产生的静电，也因此，尽可能不让自己沾湿。
author: phantom640
source: Most of POKENAME's power is generated by static electricity from its natural cotton. Because of this, it tries to avoid getting wet whenever possible.

entry: POKENAME携带的光球，升高时亮起深蔚蓝，降下则变暗。无月之夜，这迷人光芒尤其美。
author: .izik
source: The orb POKENAME carries glows a deep cerulean as it ascends, dimming as it descends. This enchanting glow is especially beautiful on moonless nights.

entry: POKENAME漂浮所用的绒球充满静电。它把能量转成电磁波，麻痹袭击者。
author: .izik
source: The puffballs POKENAME floats with are filled with static electricity. It redirects this energy into a Thunder Wave to stun attackers.

entry: POKENAME裸露皮肤渗出滑膜，既防干，也免得电到自己。睡过特别舒爽的一觉，尾巴就明亮发光。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The exposed areas of POKENAME's skin ooze a slick film both to protect them from drying out and from zapping themselves. After a particularly refreshing nap, POKENAME's tail shines brightly.

entry: POKENAME游泳时，尾球遇凉水，泛柔蓝光，身体也因此充电。
author: .izik
source: While swimming, the orb on POKENAME's tail reacts to the cool water, glowing with a soft blue light. This process charges its body with electricity.

entry: POKENAME痴迷黄色物件，收来垫巢。它先电晕敌人，再偷财物。
author: .izik
source: Fascinated by yellow objects, POKENAME collects them to line its nest. It uses electric shocks to stun foes before stealing their valuables.

entry: POKENAME咬敌时迸出一阵火花。暴怒就用强力电击，将对手击昏。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME bites an enemy, it releases a burst of sparks. If enraged it will unleash a powerful Thunder Shock to knock out the foe.

entry: POKENAME常把人的头发电炸起来，借此捉弄。幽灵衣装保护免受电击，也帮助吸收恐惧情绪。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME often zaps people by frizzing their hair to mess with them. Its ghostly attire protects it from shocks and helps absorb fearful emotions.

entry: POKENAME住在电子设备的旧说明书与设计图里，守着机器，偷偷吸收无人看管设备的电。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its home inside old manuals and schematics for electronic devices. It stays near machinery, secretly absorbing electricity from unattended equipment.

entry: POKENAME身上光球储存羊毛收集的静电。一充满就脱落，让新的长出。
author: .izik
source: The orbs on POKENAME's body store static electricity collected from its wool. Once fully charged, the orbs drop off, allowing new ones to grow.

entry: POKENAME产电过多，得大量吃食物。可口味很挑，只吃最甜的红色点心。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Due to producing an excessive amount of electricity, POKENAME have to consume a large amount of food. POKENAME are quite picky, however, and will only eat the sweetest red treats.

entry: POKENAME先晃触角光球，再朝入侵者射雷电。这电力防御确保安全。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wiggles the orb on its antennae before releasing bolts of lightning at intruders. This shocking defense ensures its safety.

entry: POKENAME剪下小团羊毛，藏进钳子里。下次在战斗中张钳，高度带电的羊毛，便会突然放出雷电，打敌人一个措手不及。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME clips small clumps of its wool to store within its claws. This way, when it opens them next in battle, its foe will be caught off-guard by the sudden bolts of lightning released from the highly charged wool within.

entry: POKENAME嫉妒又狡诈，总有办法显得比实际更好。天性善骗，邪恶组织很喜欢，常用礼物宠它。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are envious and duplicitous creatures that always find a way to make themselves look better than they really are. Their natural deceitfulness makes them a popular choice for villainous organizations, who spoil POKENAME with gifts.

entry: POKENAME壳里储着强带电的棉，快速阵阵放出，驱赶群体的捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stores cotton within its shell that retains a powerful electrical charge. It distributes this electricity in quick bursts to deter predators from its herd.

entry: POKENAME轻松穿过雷雨，将闪电吸进尾球，供强力电攻使用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies effortlessly through thunderstorms, absorbing lightning into the orb on its tail. This energy fuels its powerful electric attacks.

entry: POKENAME狩猎时，把电导过尾球，使出强力放电，震晕猎物，轻松捕获。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME channels electricity through the orb on its tail, unleashing a powerful Discharge while hunting. This tactic stuns prey and ensures an easy catch.

entry: POKENAME奶与毛产太多而病，就喂素肉干恢复。它会反刍，多次消化，单吃一口也能吸到更多养分。
author: quackquackattack
source: When POKENAME gets sick from producing too much milk and wool, they are fed plant-based jerky to revitalize them. The jerky is digested several times, as their cud-chewing biology allows them to obtain more nutrients from a single bite.

entry: POKENAME兴奋时，尾尖与脸颊冒火花。它喜欢帮助乡村，过去常在夜里养在室内照明。
author: katieplaysgames
source: When excited, POKENAME generate sparks from the tip of their tail and their cheeks. They enjoy working alongside rural communities and were historically kept indoors at night to provide light.

entry: POKENAME羊毛中的电靠定期光合作用。尾球光一暗，就得很快到阳光下补能。
author: sk372
source: The electricity in POKENAME's wool is dependent on regular photosynthesis sessions. If the light radiating from the orb on its tail is dim, it needs to recharge itself beneath sunlight soon.

entry: POKENAME爱把下半身泡泥，却小心不沾上半身。因为泥黏毛会扰乱存电，造成极大不适。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys soaking its lower half in mud, but takes care to avoid getting it on its upper half. This is because mud clinging to its wool will disrupt the electricity stored within and cause extreme discomfort.

entry: POKENAME带着光球，追踪观察电流。羊毛会随接触电流的频率和电量变色，剪下后也一样。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME carry orbs with them that allow them to track and observe electrical currents. Their wool changes color based on the frequency and amount of electricity that it's exposed to even after it's shed.

entry: POKENAME用脱落软毛铺洞，让家温暖舒适。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lines the inside of its den with soft tufts of wool that it sheds. These tufts keep its home warm and cozy.

entry: 旋转的羊毛团产电，保护POKENAME。光球可脱离毛团直接攻击，据说里面住着幽灵。
author: sk372
source: A swirling mass of wool generates electricity to protect POKENAME from its opposition. The orbs can detach from the mass to directly attack others, and are believed to be inhabited by ghostly spirits.

entry: POKENAME以雷电拳著称，电力足以让工业发电机过载。周围波导中的情绪变化，晶体光色也跟着变。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME is known well for its Thunder Punch attacks, which channel enough electricity to overcharge an industrial generator. The color of its crystal's glow changes in reaction to the emotions felt within the auras around itself.

entry: POKENAME担心羊毛变少，发不出足够电力，便常特意放电，权当锻炼。
author: mossybanana
source: POKENAME will often discharge its electricity simply as an exercise, as it is concerned about having less wool with which to generate it.

entry: POKENAME头上紧实羊毛硬如石，静电噼啪。对手常互撞头，一打数小时。
author: reflecbeat
source: The tightly packed wool on its head is as hard as rock and crackles with static electricity. Rival POKENAME engage in head-clashing battles that can last for hours at a time.

entry: POKENAME头顶圆罩始终带电。口袋装零散硬币靠太近，可能挨小电击。
author: something_smith
source: The dome on POKENAME's head is always electrically charged. Getting too close with loose coins in your pocket might cause small shocks.

entry: POKENAME烦躁时，尾巴便会亮起。它用明亮的闪光作武器，试着晃花令自己不安者的眼睛，趁机使出强力电击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME tails light up when they are agitated. They use the bright flashes as an offensive weapon to try to blind whatever caused them to grow anxious, giving them a chance to land a powerful shock.

entry: 许多小宝可梦在POKENAME身上筑巢，夜里爬上睡。它被逼到角落，会放巨电，浑身毛竖起，把住客全电醒。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Many small Pokémon make their nests on POKENAME, climbing up onto it at night to sleep. If it is ever backed into a corner, POKENAME expels a massive electric charge, standing its fur on end, and jolting the Pokémon on it awake.

entry: POKENAME大群聚居会妨碍海航与极地导航，共同电场扰乱设备。尾光柔和，古时也像灯塔般使用。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Large colonies of POKENAME can cause problems with nautical and polar navigation; its combined electrical fields play havoc with navigation equipment. Its tail gives off soft light; in antiquity, it was used similarly to lighthouses.

entry: POKENAME毛防水耐寒，在极地水中游也不觉冷。尾灯造绚烂水下景象，吸引方圆数英里的游客。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The wool of POKENAME is waterproof and very cold-resistant, allowing it to swim in arctic waters without feeling the cold. The lights on its tail create dazzling underwater displays, drawing tourists from miles around.

entry: POKENAME的羊毛，能产生更多电力，身体也更耐电击。靠近导电材料，就会激起电弧。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's wool generates more electricity, and its body is more resistant to shocks. Electrical arcs form when it nears conductive materials.

entry: 强雷雨中，POKENAME尾巴微亮。许多人说，凝望这光，会感到十分平静。
author: .izik
source: During intense thunderstorms, POKENAME's tail glows faintly. Many report a strong sense of calm while gazing at the light.

entry: POKENAME一见满月，全身就迸火花。满月高悬时，远处璀璨灯光秀，可能就是一群正在欢舞的POKENAME。
author: bobosmith01
source: When POKENAME sees the full moon, sparks fly off their body. Distant dazzling light displays when the full moon is high in the sky may be a group of POKENAME dancing in glee.

entry: POKENAME浮在雷云间，自然吸电。受惊就掉落光球，爆发毁灭性放电。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME floats among storm clouds, passively absorbing a charge. If startled, it drops its orb, which explodes in an annihilative electrical discharge.

entry: POKENAME头球虽小，却存着大量电。它借此射雷电攻击。
author: .izik
source: The orb on POKENAME's head stores vast amounts of electricity, despite its size. If utilizes this energy to attack with bolts of lightning.

entry: POKENAME毛里存静电，月下常轻轻噼啪。它爱偷到训练家背后，玩笑地电一下，再开心跳走。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME stores static electricity in its wool, which is often heard crackling softly under the moonlight. It is known to sneak up behind Trainers and zap them playfully before skipping off in delight.

entry: 茸茸羊柔软的羊毛，与风妖精优质的棉絮结合，成了极好的织物。这种特殊纤维，广用于靴子、背心与帽子。
author: dodoowner_
source: Flaaffy's soft wool mixed with Whimsicott's great cotton makes the ultimate fabric. This special fiber is used in many boots, vests, and hats.

entry: POKENAME巢上的网可充电，成为强力陷阱。入侵者被震晕，动弹不得。
author: .izik
source: The webs covering POKENAME's nest can be charged with electricity, creating a powerful trap. Intruders are left stunned and immobilized.

entry: POKENAME白毛极软，人们试着织毛衣，却发现暖得难受，还很容易挨静电。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's white wool is luxuriously soft. People have tried making sweaters out of it, but found them to be uncomfortably warm and prone to giving static shocks.

entry: POKENAME导电羊毛迅速把电能送遍身体。它用头尾伸出部分招引雷电。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME's conductive wool quickly distributes electrical energy to its body. It tries to attract lightning with the extension on its head and tail.

entry: POKENAME脱落的软绒毛，是极热门的玩偶填料与面料。胸球被认为是超能力来源。
author: chibitales
source: Downy wool shed from POKENAME is exceedingly popular as material for plush toys, both as stuffing and fabric. The orb on its chest is thought to be the source of its psychic power.

entry: POKENAME尾毛柔如绒，极能保热，常用于保温毯。养来采毛的个体，常享王室般待遇，因而变得傲慢。
author: chibitales
source: The velvety soft fur on POKENAME's tails is often used in heated blankets due to its ability to hold heat very well. POKENAME raised for their fur are often treated like royalty and have developed haughty attitudes because of it.

entry: POKENAME仰躺池面懒漂，让光球露出空气。受惊就往水里放电，晕住附近一切。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts lazily through pond waters on its back, exposing its orb to the air. If startled, it releases electricity into the water, stunning everything nearby.

entry: POKENAME专注感知周围波导时，蓝晶体会亮。腕踝羊毛相擦产电，增强肉搏打击。它的羊毛以格外耐用闻名。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's blue crystal glows as it focuses on sensing the auras around itself. By rubbing together the wool on its wrists and ankles, it generates electricity to empower its physical strikes. POKENAME wool is known for being remarkably durable.

entry: POKENAME虽群居，最常竞争的对象却也是伙伴。食物或最佳睡处之类的小事，都能吵到激烈打斗。
author: bobosmith01
source: While POKENAME live in packs, their most common natural competition is also their packmates. They argue and get into violent fights amongst one another for things such as food or the best napping spot.

entry: POKENAME虽群居，最常竞争的对象却也是伙伴。食物或最佳睡处之类的小事，都能吵到激烈打斗。
author: bobosmith01
source: While POKENAME live in packs, their most common natural competition is also their packmates. They argue and get into violent fights amongst one another for things such as food or the best napping spot.

entry: 成群的POKENAME聚在田野里，彼此对唱。它们的群体究竟能有多大，很难估计，因为每次研究者试着清点，都会被歌声哄得睡着。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Herds of POKENAME gather together in fields to sing to one another. It is difficult to estimate how large these herds can get. Whenever researchers tried to count them, they found themselves lulled to sleep by their songs.

entry: POKENAME把羊毛电导入尾球，争领地时，用电尾互打金属甲，直到一方屈服。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME channels the electricity from its wool into the orb on its tail. This electrified orb is used for territorial combat, with POKENAME striking their tails against each other's metal armor until one finally submits.

entry: POKENAME把点亮尾巴的能量转到喉部器官。张嘴就能放光，成了活手电筒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can transfer the energy illuminating its tail to an organ located in its throat. Doing this projects light from its mouth when open, turning it into something of a living flashlight.

entry: POKENAME黏在风车底吸电，令当地人头痛。收来的能量，供电力本领使用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME clings to the bases of windmills to absorb electricity, which can be a nuisance for locals. The collected energy powers its electric abilities.

entry: POKENAME性情温顺，羊毛又暖和，是幼童常见的伙伴。毛层能长得非常厚，即使只取极少一点，产生的静电，也足够让灯泡亮上数小时。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are common companions for young children due to how docile they are and how warm their wool fleeces are. Their wool fleeces can become so thick that the smallest amount will generate enough static electricity to power a lightbulb for hours.

entry: POKENAME每周产体重两倍的毛。剪下清洗、纺成线，用来做羊绒衫、裙子与围巾。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce twice their body weight in wool on a weekly basis. Their wool is sheared, washed, and spun into yarn that goes into cashmere sweaters, dresses, and scarves.

entry: POKENAME尾球越亮，羽毛电越多。大雷雨将至，白羽会开始变深灰。
author: mistymagius
source: The brighter the orb on POKENAME's tail glows, the more electricity is stored in its feathers. When large thunderstorms roll in, its white feathers will start to turn dark grey.

entry: POKENAME攻击时，双颚咬敌，翼上迸火花。双重攻势压倒猎物。
author: .izik
source: When attacking, POKENAME clamps its jaws onto a foe and releases sparks from its wings. This dual assault overwhelms its prey.

entry: POKENAME以惊人速度冲过碎浪，用利牙咬牢猎物。接着反复放电，击昏再吃。
author: .izik
source: After darting through the surf at incredible speeds, POKENAME latches onto its prey with sharp fangs. Once attached, it delivers repeated jolts of electricity to knock them out before feeding.

entry: POKENAME身胖，难以久飞。飞不动就改拍翼产静电，在耳边显现。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Its chubby body makes it hard for POKENAME to fly for long periods. If it can't fly, it will instead flap its wings to generate static, which manifests around its ears.

entry: POKENAME身胖，难以久飞。飞不动就改拍翼产静电，在耳边显现。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME's chubby body makes it hard for it to fly for long periods. If it can't fly, it will instead flap its wings to generate static, which manifests around its ears.

entry: POKENAME揉胸前纽扣状光球，积静电。受威胁能从爪放出强力电球。
author: .izik
source: By rubbing the button-like orbs on its chest, POKENAME stores static electricity. It can release powerful Electro Balls from its paws when threatened.

entry: POKENAME开心见人，尾球便亮。牙硬如石、导电快，咬中就能麻痹对手。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME is happy to meet someone, the orb on its tail glows brightly. Its rock-hard teeth conduct electricity very quickly, allowing it to paralyze opponents it bites.

entry: POKENAME毛中静电极强，轻轻碰一下，也可能遭危及生命的电击。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's fur carries an extremely strong static charge. Even a gentle touch can result in a life-threatening shock.

entry: POKENAME用电从尾巴或壳的某些斑点射亮光。有些场馆给斑点上色，让光束变彩，请它表演缤纷灯光秀。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can use its electric powers to shine bright beams of light from its tail or certain spots of its shell. Some venues paint over these spots to color the beams and have POKENAME create vibrant light shows.

entry: 释放催眠粉前，POKENAME球状眼先泛明亮青光。迷人光芒，哄敌人陷入深睡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's orb-like eyes glow a bright cyan before releasing Sleep Powder. The mesmerizing glow lulls foes into a deep slumber.

entry: POKENAME下半身的毛状材料导电极强，存着强大电能。受挑衅，就用强力头撞放出。
author: .izik
source: The wool-like material covering POKENAME's lower body is highly conductive, storing powerful electrical energy. It discharges this electricity with a powerful headbutt when provoked.

entry: POKENAME频频往上提绒毛裤，产生电力，为微波炉供能。据说，只要储存一天静电，就足以煮熟一包即食面。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produces electricity to power a microwave with how often it pulls up its pants made of fleece. It is said that in one day of storing static, it has enough electricity to cook a pack of Instant Noodles.

entry: POKENAME常飞近客机吸能。撞机翼也无伤，不过有时会被弹出数英里。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME often flies near passenger jets to absorb power. Collisions with wings are harmless, though they sometimes launch it for miles.

entry: POKENAME光球夜里闪微弱信号。雷雨接近，脉冲便加快，以规律闪烁警告伙伴。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME's orb flashes faint light signals. These pulses quicken when a thunderstorm is near, warning others with rhythmic blinks.

entry: POKENAME把闪电引向尾巴，吸电增强身体，再用尾中能量点燃高草。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME draw lightning strikes to their tail and absorb the electricity to supercharge their bodies. They harness the power stored in their tail to set tall grass ablaze.

entry: POKENAME蹭喜欢的对象，用微弱麻电作记号。想摸回去得小心：它反复无常，不愿被碰时可能放出更强电击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rubs against those it likes, generating a faint tingle of electricity to mark them. One should be careful about attempting to pet it back; it has a capricious personality and may use a stronger shock if it doesn't feel like being touched.

entry: 训练家常给POKENAME剪毛，免得发痒。若有挠不到的痒，它就一直试，哪怕弄得头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are regularly sheared by their Trainers to prevent them from getting itchy. If they end up with an itch they cannot scratch, they will continue to try even if it gives them a headache.

entry: POKENAME游泳时有力踢腿，轻松超过其他宝可梦。头肩羊毛在水下也蓬松。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME kicks its legs powerfully when swimming, easily outpacing other Pokémon. The wool on its head and shoulders remains fluffy even underwater.

entry: POKENAME踝上的铁环调节电能。出拳释放电脉冲，造成毁灭性重击。
author: .izik
source: The iron bands on POKENAME's ankles regulate its electrical energy. When it punches, it releases pulses of electricity for devastating strikes.

entry: 抚摸POKENAME得小心。它虽享受关注，毛却迅速积静电，可能让粗心者挨强烈麻痹电击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Trainers are advised to exercise caution while petting POKENAME. Though they enjoy receiving the attention, their fur rapidly builds up static and can deliver powerful paralytic shocks to the unwary.

entry: 神奥遗迹描绘POKENAME为古代洗翠显贵守卫。如今仍因忠诚、能用尾灯无声传警而颇受欢迎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Ruins in Sinnoh depict POKENAME acting as guards for ancient Hisuian dignitaries. They retain some popularity in the present day for their loyalty to their Trainer and for their ability to silently communicate warnings with their flashing tail light.

entry: 它猛拍覆毛的翼，瞬间就充满静电。穿风暴飞时，尾上蓝球捕雷电，POKENAME再转成养分。
author: fiordaliso
source: By frantically flapping its wool-covered wings, it can charge them with static electricity in an instant. When flying through storms, the blue orb on its tail captures lightning energy, which POKENAME then converts into nourishment.

entry: POKENAME分泌的油导电极强，既让毛发闪亮，也能增强攻击，还被用于某些电池。
author: gamblebreaker
source: The oil that POKENAME secretes is incredibly conductive, making it not only useful for its shiny coat but also empowering its attacks. It has also been used as a component in some batteries.

entry: POKENAME头周羊毛的静电刺激大脑，增强超能力。
author: melodydelune
source: The static electricity POKENAME builds up in the fleece around its head stimulates its brain, amplifying its psychic abilities.

entry: POKENAME准备以羊毛使出紧束，嘴里光球就亮。吸取对方精华时越兴奋，光越强。
author: .izik
source: The orb in POKENAME's mouth shines brightly as it prepares to Wrap a foe in its wool. The glow intensifies with its excitement as it absorbs their essence.

entry: POKENAME羊毛防水，在河口追猎不致湿透。它产咸奶，带微弱提神电荷，可制成松散易碎的奶酪。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's wool is hydrophobic, allowing it to pursue prey in its estuary habitat without becoming waterlogged. It produces a briny milk, infused with a small, energy boosting electric charge, which is made into a crumbly cheese.

entry: 养老院、托儿所有时能见POKENAME为来访孩子织东西。壳不爱被关注，会躲开目光，哪怕把线弄乱。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are sometimes found at retirement homes and daycares, knitting for the visiting children. Their shells do not enjoy the attention, and will try to avoid being looked at, even at the cost of tangling the thread.

entry: POKENAME羊毛防水，在河口追猎不致湿透。它产咸奶，带微弱提神电荷，可制成松散易碎的奶酪。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's wool is hydrophobic, allowing it to pursue prey in its estuary habitat without becoming waterlogged. It produces a briny milk, infused with a small, energy boosting electric charge, which is made into a crumbly cheese.

entry: POKENAME背上的球靠光合作用维生。夜里，多余能量随发光消耗。
author: musicsheep.
source: The orb on POKENAME's back performs photosynthesis to stay alive. At night, any excess energy is burned away by the orb's glow.

entry: POKENAME替其他虫宝可梦放哨。闪动尾端强光，警告地面虫子危险靠近，让它们来得及逃向高处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME acts as a lookout for other bug Pokémon. By flashing the bright light at the end of its tail, it warns bugs on the ground of approaching danger so they have time to flee to higher ground.

entry: POKENAME站得高、光球又亮，许多水手长期叫它“灯塔宝可梦”。又能安然吸雷，许多船至少会用一只。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have long been called "Lighthouse Pokémon" by many sailors due to how tall they stand and the bright lights they release from their orbs. Because they can also absorb lightning without issue, many ships utilize at least one POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME把电像电池般存进骨。能量低了，就吸收存电恢复。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stores electricity within its bones like batteries. When its energy runs low, it absorbs the electricity to restore itself.

entry: POKENAME用骨盔与骨棒吸收电力攻击自保。许多还学会弹回，电敌人一下。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME protect themselves from electrical attacks by absorbing strikes with their boney helmet and club. Many learn how to bounce these attacks back at foes to give them a jolt.

entry: POKENAME风暴时高举骨状棒，捕捉吸收闪电。棒彼此敲击，就能放电。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME raise their bone-like clubs high during storms to catch and absorb lightning. When they strike these clubs together, they can release bolts of electricity.

entry: POKENAME的三个球体，各自负责全身电力流转的重要环节：尾上的球充电，头上的球储存、分配电力，棍棒上的球则负责放电。
author: infinex21
source: An POKENAME's three orbs each play an important role in the flow of electricity throughout its body. The orb on its tail charges electricity, the orb on its head stores and distributes electricity, and the orb upon its club discharges electricity.

entry: POKENAME每出拳，拳头都明亮发光。有些受训以一连串拳击打节拍，传递消息。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME's fists glow brightly whenever it throws a punch. Some have been trained to communicate in rhythmic beats via a series of punches.

entry: POKENAME亮毛似乎吸引咩利羊，整群会跟着走。虽从不误认自己的孩子，仍会保护所有成员。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's brightly glowing fur seems to attract Mareep, and a flock of them will follow it around. Although POKENAME never confuses them with its own child, it will act as a protector for them all.

entry: POKENAME借夜间发光采蜜，制作蜂蜜。光也强到能晃花捕食者的眼，将其赶走。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME uses the light it emits at night to gather nectar to produce honey. This light is also bright enough to ward off predators by blinding them.

entry: POKENAME尾灯向遥远太空闪出强烈彩光。直视闪烁尾巴，可能暂时失明。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME flashes its tail with bright colors into the outer reaches of space. Looking directly at the flashing tail can cause temporary blindness.

entry: POKENAME受威胁，头尾宝石就分泌恶臭液。宝石也亮，许多训练家带在身边，帮忙暗处辨路。
author: mepp.
