source: The gems on POKENAME's head and tail secretes a foul liquid when threatened. Many Trainers keep POKENAME close to help them navigate in the dark, as the gems also produce a bright glow.

entry: POKENAME在雷雨里，破坏欲格外强。一些地区越来越担忧这种行为，连天气预报，也常提起。
author: vaporvenator
source: POKENAME become very destructive during thunderstorms. This behavior is a rising concern in some regions, often being mentioned in weather broadcasts.

entry: 这种善良的宝可梦，外壳亮得像信标，在漆黑的夜晚为船只引路，帮助穿过海礁，停靠岸边。水下，小型宝可梦也会聚在POKENAME的光芒周围，寻求保护。
author: milchik
source: With its shell glowing brightly like a beacon, this kind Pokémon guides ships during dark nights, helping them maneuver between sea rocks and moor to the shore. Underwater, small Pokémon gather around POKENAME's light for protection.

entry: POKENAME的毛摸起来始终温暖，却也总在噼啪放静电。许多训练家仍愿忍受静电，只为亲手感受柔软的暖毛。
author: infinex21
source: The fur of an POKENAME is always warm to the touch, though it is also always crackling with static electricity. Still, many Trainers choose to endure this static for the sake of experiencing their soft, warm fur for themselves.

entry: POKENAME不慎吃病毒，身体变鲜黄，放猛烈电流。闪光强到晕住周围生物。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME consumes a virus by accident, its body turns bright yellow and discharges a violent surge of electricity. The flash is strong enough to stun those nearby.

entry: POKENAME在海底相遇，就互闪壳中光球沟通。大量聚集，连水面上也能见光。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME meet at the sea floor, they communicate by flashing the orbs in their shells at each other. Mass gatherings of POKENAME can cause glows of light visible even above the water's surface.

entry: POKENAME软如枕的身体覆羊毛。只要喂得饱，每天腹部就长0.5英寸毛。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its pillowy body is covered in a coat of fleece. As long as POKENAME remains fed, it will produce half an inch of fleece on its belly every day.

entry: POKENAME烦躁，华美白毛便雷电噼啪。有人见它在雷云周围、内部飞，云一散，很快也消失。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's luxurious white fur crackles with lightning when it is agitated. POKENAME have been spotted flying near and within storm clouds and they quickly disappear when the storm clouds have cleared.

entry: 与流行说法相反，POKENAME不用尾巴照亮暗处，而是配合反光双翼，夜里传信求助。
author: firstromaniandiscoerd
source: Contrary to popular belief, POKENAME do not use their tail to light up dark places. They use it alongside their reflective wings to signal for help at night.

entry: POKENAME一思考，头球就亮，毛发电流噼啪。虽主要用精神攻击与雷电，也能打毁灭性的雷电拳。
author: infinex21
source: The orb upon POKENAME's head glows and its hair crackles with electricity whenever this Pokémon thinks. Although it mostly fights with psychic attacks and lightning bolts, it is plenty capable of delivering devastating Thunder Punches as well.

entry: POKENAME让尾巴闪光，与其他宝可梦交流，还会根据交谈的物种，调整最合适的闪光规律。它虽然不能隐形，却能放出刺眼强光，争取足够时间飞快逃离。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME blinks light with its tail to communicate with other Pokémon, changing the patterns it uses to best suit the species it's talking to. While it can't turn invisible, it can release a blinding flash of light to give enough time to dash away.

entry: POKENAME温顺，白天晒太阳，借能量产电。雷雨时，光球像避雷针，吸足电力。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are docile creatures. During the day, they bask in the sun, using its energy to generate electricity. During thunderstorms, POKENAME's orbs act as lightning rods, supercharging them.

entry: POKENAME性情与力量都不稳定。颈火一旺，火花就狂飞，电到站太近者。一只便能供一座小城用电。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME is volatile both in personality and in power. When the fire on its neck flares, sparks fly around it wildly, shocking any standing too close. One POKENAME can produce enough electricity to power a small city.

entry: POKENAME抓住猎物后，猛烈翻滚，放出致命电量。吃下前，猎物已完全烧焦。
author: musicsheep.
source: When POKENAME gets hold of its prey, it violently rolls while generating lethal amounts of electricity. The prey is completely charred before being eaten.

entry: POKENAME触角的强光，甚至能照入海洋最深处，在海上搜救中十分宝贵。但光太亮，缺少适当防护，也能造成眼部损伤。
author: bobosmith01
source: The bright light that POKENAME can emit from their antennae can shine through even the deepest parts of the ocean, making it valuable in sea-based rescue missions. However, the light is so bright it can cause eye damage without proper protection.

entry: POKENAME全身宝石明亮，远处也看得见。全球定位系统问世前，常用来帮助飞机在低能见度或夜里降落。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The gems studded on the bodies of POKENAME glow brightly and are visible from a great distance. They were commonly put to work to help aircraft land in low visibility conditions and at night before the invention of GPS.

entry: POKENAME揉羊毛，把大量电能送入其中。毛便亮得刺眼，还能暂时生成周身电盾。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can rub its own wool to transfer its copious electrical energy into the fleece. This lets the wool glow blindingly bright and even generate a shield of electricity around itself for a time.

entry: POKENAME毛中电多到听得见雷声。尾灯一亮，直视可能造成永久眼损。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's wool carries so much electricity that thunder can be heard from it. The bulbs on its tail, when lit, are so bright that they can cause permanent eye damage when looked at directly.

entry: POKENAME毛中电多到听得见雷声。尾灯一亮，直视可能造成永久眼损。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's wool carries so much electricity that thunder can be heard from it. The bulbs on its tail, when lit, are so bright that they can cause permanent eye damage when looked at directly.

entry: POKENAME毛中电多到听得见雷声。尾灯一亮，直视可能造成永久眼损。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's wool carries so much electricity that thunder can be heard from it. The bulbs on its tail, when lit, are so bright that they can cause permanent eye damage when looked at directly.

entry: POKENAME全身宝石明亮，远处也看得见。全球定位系统问世前，常用来帮助飞机在低能见度或夜里降落。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The gems studded on the bodies of POKENAME glow brightly and are visible from a great distance. They were commonly put to work to help aircraft land in low visibility conditions and at night before the invention of GPS.

entry: POKENAME全身宝石明亮，远处也看得见。全球定位系统问世前，常用来帮助飞机在低能见度或夜里降落。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The gems studded on the bodies of POKENAME glow brightly and are visible from a great distance. They were commonly put to work to help aircraft land in low visibility conditions and at night before the invention of GPS.

entry: 清洁POKENAME头发，绝不能用水。得用钢丝绒刷，把里面的泥刮出。
author: musicsheep.
source: When cleaning POKENAME's hair, never use water. Instead, it must be brushed with steel wool to scrape out the mud inside.

entry: POKENAME的头发因泥变硬。一泡水就松软无力，无法正常产电。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME's hair is stiff with mud. When soaked in water, it becomes loose and weak, unable to generate electricity properly.

entry: POKENAME啃硬物，防尖牙过长。烦躁时胡须冒电花，出击前红晶体先闪光。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME gnaw on hard objects to keep their fangs from growing too much. Their whiskers spark with electricity when they are agitated. They release flashes of light from their red crystals before they strike.

entry: POKENAME天生带静电，毛总竖着。它爱啃电线，补充体内电场，成了市区的麻烦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's fur constantly stands on end due to their innate static charge. They have a habit of gnawing on electrical wires to replenish their internal electrical field, making them a nuisance for urban areas.

entry: POKENAME不爱被看见，尾巴却不停发光，因此躲在明亮处。
author: musicsheep.
source: It doesn't like being seen, but its tail is constantly giving off light. Because of this, POKENAME hides in bright areas.

entry: POKENAME不同体节能各自旋转，似乎借此产电，支持它越钻越深地掘地。
author: infinex21
source: The different segments of POKENAME's body can rotate individually. This seems to be how it generates the electricity that fuels it as it burrows deeper and deeper underground.

entry: POKENAME常支配其他犬类宝可梦，让它们做自己的仆人。谁不听话，脸上就得挨一记重击。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME often control other dog-like Pokémon and make them its servants. If they don't comply, they get a whack to the face.

entry: POKENAME摆足王室般高傲姿态，财富却全是不义之财。其实相当弱，一碰就容易认输。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME acts very high and mighty like royalty, despite its entire wealth being ill-gotten. It is actually quite weak and folds easily.

entry: POKENAME成群聚向火山喷口，以及岩浆翻涌的地方。吸热时，外壳上的斑点会明亮发光，因此工厂也会用它们，警示哪些地方可能太烫，不宜触碰。
author: notadoctor75
source: POKENAME flock towards volcanic vents and areas where magma bubbles up. The spots on its shell shine brightly when it is absorbing heat, making it also useful in factories to warn of areas that may be too hot to touch.

entry: POKENAME双翼带电，飞得越久越强。它把电能导入尾巴，飞行中便明亮发光。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wings carry an electrical charge that gradually grows stronger as they fly. They channel this electrical potential into their tail, causing it to light up brightly when in flight.

entry: POKENAME背上的角，能吸引、吸收天降的雷电。有些人开始在雷雨时请它帮忙，保护屋顶的卫星天线与其他金属物品。
author: fiordaliso
source: The horns on POKENAME's back allow it to attract and absorb lightning bolts falling from the sky. Some people have begun asking for its help during thunderstorms to protect satellite dishes and other metal objects on the roofs of their homes.

entry: POKENAME触手吸盘放出耀眼闪光，晃花猎物的眼，再从嘴里吐带电墨箭，给予最后一击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses radiant flashes of light from the suction cups on its tentacles to blind prey. It then finishes them off with bolts of electrically-charged ink spat from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME随和爱社交，想与许多宝可梦相伴。它精准控雷，保护水中朋友，抵御多数水与飞行属性捕食者。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has an easygoing nature and is very social, so it tries to stick by numerous other Pokémon. It can fire controlled bolts of lightning that keep its aquatic friends safe from most Water and Flying-type predator Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME身体双翼都是纯金。金身飞行时闪耀，阴天也一样。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME's body and wings are made of pure gold. Its gilded form shines brightly when flying, even on cloudy days.

entry: POKENAME喷的水里有数十亿细菌，通电便明亮发光。水炮既能刺眼，也能滚烫。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The water POKENAME expels is filled with billions of bacteria that glow brightly when electrified. Its Hydro Pump can be blinding and boiling hot.

entry: POKENAME身上红球充当太阳能板。自己没法防晒，每次光球需充能，就躺进泥里休息。
author: bigoljax
source: The red orbs on POKENAME's body are used as solar panels. Due to it having no protection from the sun, it rests in mud whenever the orbs need to charge.

entry: POKENAME夜里常被误认成车尾灯。其实它在向潜在捕食者闪灯威吓。
author: musicsheep.
source: It is often mistaken for a car's taillights at night. In reality, POKENAME is shining its lights at possible predators to intimidate them.

entry: POKENAME的奶明亮发光，喝下肚，仍能透过人体看见。奶无害，孩子常觉得很酷。
author: musicsheep.
source: The milk that POKENAME lactates glows brightly. Even after ingestion, it can be seen glowing through the human body. The milk is harmless and children often think it looks cool.

entry: POKENAME开始疾冲时，会先爆出小而明亮的闪光，几秒后才传来雷鸣般的巨响。光在数英里外也能看见。
author: frokachu
source: When POKENAME break into a sprint, a small but bright explosion occurs, followed by a thunderous boom seconds after. The light from this event can be seen from miles away.

entry: POKENAME硬壳限制行动，便找暗处躲。有什么靠太近，尾巴就短促放出刺眼强闪，赶走对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME finds itself in dark places to hide due to its hard shell limiting its mobility. To fend off anything that comes too close, its tail can emit blindingly bright flashes of light in short bursts.

entry: 废弃灯塔里能见到POKENAME，用电力把船误导向险地。
author: zazafable
source: POKENAME can be found in abandoned lighthouses, where it uses its electric powers to mislead ships to dangerous locations.

entry: POKENAME开心，尾球的光便照亮全身。通常饭后这样，能短暂看见胃里刚吃食物的轮廓。
author: sk372
source: When feeling happy, POKENAME's entire body illuminates with light generated from the orb on its tail. Since it usually does this after eating, one can temporarily see the silhouette of its recent meal within its stomach.

entry: POKENAME夜里尾巴按快速重复规律强闪，在暗处沟通。大群聚集会造成光污染，困扰人类聚落。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME produce powerful flashes of light at night, their tails blinking in rapid repeating patterns to communicate with one another in the dark. Large swarms of POKENAME can cause problems for human settlements due to light pollution.

entry: POKENAME爱帮其他草属性宝可梦，提供额外光照，进行光合作用。它会专程去昏暗地方补光。
author: thesilverowls
source: POKENAME love to be helpful to other Grass-type Pokémon, providing them with extra light for photosynthesis. They are known to travel into poorly lit areas to provide the required light.

entry: POKENAME身上众多的水晶珠，冷如坚冰，能传导尾毛储存的电力。有人用它脱落的珠子冷却食物。它还能将毛发冻结，使其竖起，更好地保护自己。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's many crystalline orbs are as cold as solid ice and serve as conduits for the electricity stored within its tail fur. Some use its shed orbs to cool foods. It can freeze its fur to make it stand on end to better defend itself.

entry: 野生POKENAME寻找猎物时，会藏身于雷暴云中。它们的钳子每一击，不仅有碎石之力，还带着足以让草属性宝可梦也麻痹的强大电力。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME will conceal themselves within storm clouds as they search for prey. Each strike from their pincers is not only strong enough to break rocks, but also charged with enough electricity to even stun Grass-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME能从宝石录制、播放影像。知名导演称赞清晰画质与临场感，影评人却指出，能放这些影片的影院太少。
author: wiz0z
source: From their gems, POKENAME can record and display videos. High-profile directors have praised the sharp resolution and immersion provided by filming with POKENAME. Critics have noted the limited number of theaters able to display these films.

entry: POKENAME将家安在最高的树上，用尾巴引来、接住雷电，储存在体内。准备从尾尖放出雷电时，沿背排列的每颗球都会亮起。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME make their homes within the tallest trees so they can use their tails to draw and capture lightning that they then store within their bodies. Each orb along its back will light up as it prepares to fire lightning from the tip of its tail.

entry: POKENAME体内储存的电力越多，肌肉就越膨胀、绷紧。发力时，白色的长毛会变得像雷暴云一样漆黑，这常发生在它准备保护巢穴的时候。
author: infinex21
source: Its muscles expand and tense the more electricity it has stored within itself. The long, white hair of an POKENAME turns as dark as a storm cloud when it exerts itself, which often occurs when it prepares to protect its nest.

entry: POKENAME用光球的神秘光，牧送迷路咩利羊回群。农人视它现身为福，能让羊群夜里平静安全。
author: ultrazombie929
source: POKENAME acts as a shepherd to lost Mareep, guiding them back to the flock with the mystical light of their orbs. Farmers consider it a blessing when one appears, as it keeps the flock calm and safe at night.

entry: POKENAME尾光极微弱。据说它引导幽灵船前往来世。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME's tail glow is very faint. It is said that it helps guide ghost ships to the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，常对进洞者用闪光警告。可偶尔也会离家，只为电登山者。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are incredibly territorial Pokémon. They are known to use Flash on those who enter their caves as warning signals. However there have been rare occurrences where POKENAME leave their homes simply to shock hikers.

entry: POKENAME战中蓬鬃电流噼啪。波导弹灌足电，能震晕体型3倍于己的敌人。
author: infinex21
source: The fluffy mane of an POKENAME will crackle with electricity during battle. They imbue their Aura Sphere attacks with enough electricity to stun foes thrice their size.

entry: POKENAME背球吸太阳能，额宝石再射出。触碰皮肤，可能长疣。
author: musicsheep.
source: The orb on its back absorbs solar energy, while the gem on its forehead blasts the energy back out. Touching POKENAME's skin can cause warts to grow.

entry: POKENAME的毛品质极佳，常被用来制作防静电衣物，因此备受珍视。
author: mossybanana
source: POKENAME are treasured for the quality of their fur, which is often used to make static-resistant clothes.

entry: POKENAME住在深海平原，照亮漆黑海域，把猎物引得，直接游进自己的嘴。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lives on the abyssal plains of the ocean. There it lights up the pitch-black ocean and attracts prey that swims straight into its mouth.

entry: POKENAME住在深海平原，照亮漆黑海域，把猎物引得，直接游进自己的嘴。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lives on the abyssal plains of the ocean. There it lights up the pitch-black ocean and attracts prey that swims straight into its mouth.

entry: POKENAME大胡须像翻滚雷云。绒中不停噼啪，似乎总在毛里酝酿雷暴。
author: something_smith
source: POKENAME's grand beard resembles rolling stormclouds. Crackling can constantly be heard from inside its fluff, suggesting it is always brewing a lightning storm within its fur.

entry: POKENAME金色的身体，明亮耀眼，每隔几秒，光就会闪灭一次。虽然适合为灯塔照明，它却常在深夜打盹，让光芒熄灭，直到醒来。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's golden body glows brightly, but the light flashes on and off every few seconds. While this can be useful for lighthouses, POKENAME tends to doze off late at night, causing the light to go out until it wakes.

entry: POKENAME产的电，能供整栋楼用数天。可领地本能让发电厂利用失败，总在发电机房打起来。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME generate electrical charges powerful enough to power entire buildings for multiple days. Attempts to use POKENAME in power plants fail due to their territorial instincts, resulting in fights breaking out in the generator rooms.

entry: POKENAME现于猛烈电暴，古代有些文化奉为风暴神。一看落雷，就高速移动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME appears amid violent electrical storms, leading some ancient cultures to worship it as a storm god. It moves at high speeds any time it sees lightning strike.

entry: POKENAME尾端光亮到太空也看得见。古文明曾信，夜空星星就是不同的它们照亮天空。
author: sk372
source: The light on the end of POKENAME's tail can light up to the point of being visible from space. Ancient civilizations once believed the stars in the night sky were various POKENAME illuminating the skies.

entry: POKENAME战中红宝石起火，白鬃电流噼啪。不战斗，就训练，维持身体巅峰状态。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's red jewels ignite with fire while its white mane crackles with electricity during battle. When it is not fighting, it is training to stay in peak physical condition.

entry: POKENAME能在鼻下造强雷云，电击近物。珠状眼强闪，足以晃得半径100码内每个人都看不见。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can create a powerful storm cloud beneath its nose, shocking anything too close with its bolts of lightning. Its pearl-like eyes can flash with a light bright enough to blind every person in a 100-yard radius.

entry: POKENAME灯塔般的光，会引来寻宝者与挑战者。它也正热切等着，和这些家伙一较高下。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's beacon-like light attracts treasure-hunters and challengers it is eager to face.

entry: POKENAME鬃毛有独特导电力。战中蹭对手，施以电击；尾巴一亮，电攻电压便升高。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: The wool on POKENAME's mane has the unique ability to conduct electricity. In battle, they nuzzle against their opponent, shocking them. When POKENAME's tail glows, the voltage of its electric attacks rises.

entry: POKENAME能给铁身大量充电，亮光警告其他生物别靠近、别碰。尾巴和主要的角能发出强烈闪光，数英里外可见。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can supercharge its iron body with electricity, making it glow prominently as a warning for others not to approach or touch it. Its tail and primary horn can create intense light bursts able to be spotted from miles away.

entry: POKENAME齿轮转动积能，存进羊毛护着的红核心。核心很抢手，可供灯塔等大型设备使用。
author: pjporwoll
source: The rotating of POKENAME's gears builds energy, which it stores in the red cores protected in its wool. The cores are highly sought after to power large devices like lighthouses.

entry: POKENAME光球散出明亮带电能量，能削弱附近龙属性宝可梦。露营者常用光代替营火与驱虫剂，更加安全。
author: npshi
source: The orbs POKENAME possess radiate a bright, electrifying energy, which is known to weaken nearby Dragon-type Pokémon. The light emitted from these orbs is often used by campers as a safer alternative to campfires and pest repellent.

entry: POKENAME一生住雷云，即使没下雨，周围云层也雷声噼啪。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME lives in storm clouds for its entire life. Even if there is no rain, the clouds surrounding POKENAME will crackle with thunder.

entry: POKENAME在毁灭性风暴中旅行。据说以风暴经过带来的悲伤绝望为食。
author: raydrago
source: POKENAME travels inside devastating storms. It is said to feed on the sadness and despair caused by their passing.

entry: POKENAME能用炮造强光束。全力发射时，连太空也看得见。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can utilize its cannon to create intense beams of light. The light beams it creates at max power are so bright that they can be seen from space.

entry: 据说POKENAME尾上巨球一亮，太空便能看见。许多故事讲它引水手穿过可怕风暴，抵达安全处。
author: fenri_fox
source: It is said that when the massive orb on POKENAME's tail glows, it can be seen from space. There are numerous stories of POKENAME guiding sailors through terrible storms to safety.

entry: POKENAME靠近月之石，身上绯红宝石便放柔和光。外貌虽无害，转眼也能放出够供整城的电。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME finds itself near a Moon Stone, the scarlet gems on its body radiate a pleasant glow. Despite its harmless appearance, this Pokémon can discharge in an instant enough electricity to power an entire city.

entry: 狂风暴雨里，POKENAME射出凶猛十万伏特。天气平静，就躲阁楼，啃屋内电线。
author: musicsheep.
source: During windy storms, POKENAME sends out nasty Thunderbolts. When the weather is calm, they hole themselves up in attics to chew on wires inside of homes.

entry: POKENAME被认为是最独特的流氓鳄融合体之一。黑暗中，尾巴发出亮光；它看得比人眼更远，却仍十分笨拙。
author: wh3reverimayr0am
source: POKENAME is known to be one of the most unique Krookodile fusions. Its tail shines bright when it's dark, and it can see farther than the human eye, though it is still quite the clumsy Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME守望坟墓、森林、洞穴等幽暗曲折处，伸出明亮电力肢体，为迷路旅人安全指出出口。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stands watch in dark and twisty locations such as tombs, forests and caves. It emits bright limbs made of electricity to guide and point lost travelers to exits safely.

entry: POKENAME三球都能发极强光。一起亮起，能驱散方圆数英里的黑暗，让最暗夜如最亮白昼。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's three orbs can all glow with extremely bright light. If active simultaneously, its light can dispel darkness for miles around, making the darkest night seem like the brightest day.

entry: 据说POKENAME中央的金核产生巨大能量，供防御，也赋予控雷本领。
author: the.the.the.the.the.the
source: The golden core at POKENAME's center is said to generate immense energy, powering its defenses and granting it the ability to control lightning.

entry: POKENAME三条尾巴末端的光球，既亮又热。据说热到一定程度，它便进化。
author: .jerden
source: The three orbs at the ends of its tails glow with bright light, but also produce a lot of heat. It is believed that if they become hot enough, POKENAME will evolve.

entry: POKENAME众多绒翼搅出电能，每拍一下都散大量热。火山周围若总有雷雨，很可能它就住里面。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's many fluffy wings churn up electrical energy, casting off strong amounts of heat with each flap. If thunderstorms happen constantly around a volcano, it's likely an POKENAME is living within.

entry: 别被POKENAME可爱的模样骗了。它的尾巴与尖刺，都能释放致命电击。
author: chorb33
source: Pokémon Trainers shouldn't be fooled by POKENAME's deceptive cuteness. It can deliver deadly electric shocks via its tail and spikes.

entry: 光芒连太空里，也能看见。天文学家会借助驯养的POKENAME，校准探测器与卫星，重新调整方位。
author: chorb33
source: Its light is visible even in space. Domesticated POKENAME are used by astronomers to calibrate or realign space probes and satellites.

entry: POKENAME能高飞平流层。一发怒，身边云团便转灰，掀起无情的狂风骤雨。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can soar into the stratosphere. When it gets angry, its clouds turn gray and it unleashes a merciless tempest.

entry: POKENAME能高飞平流层。一发怒，身边云团便转灰，掀起无情的狂风骤雨。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can soar into the stratosphere. When it gets angry, its clouds turn gray and it unleashes a merciless tempest.

entry: POKENAME能高飞平流层。一发怒，身边云团便转灰，掀起无情的狂风骤雨。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can soar into the stratosphere. When it gets angry, its clouds turn gray and it unleashes a merciless tempest.

entry: 它九尾末端的光球，最多发9种颜色。先以众光晃花敌眼，再用缠雷火焰解决。它从不主动寻战。
author: infinex21
source: The orbs at the ends of this Pokémon's nine tails can shine in up to nine different colors. It will bedazzle its foes with its many lights before finishing them off with lightning-clad flames. It never seeks out fights.

entry: POKENAME温和吃素，沿河筑大坝。野外从不主动好斗，有谁攻击，也只挨一道雷，它便继续过日子。
author: bobosmith01
source: A mild-mannered herbivorous Pokémon, POKENAME creates large dams by rivers. It is never naturally aggressive in the wild; those who attempt to attack it are merely struck by a jolt of lightning as POKENAME continues about its day.

entry: 野生POKENAME整夜清醒，明亮发光照周围。似乎很爱灯火城市，有时还在夜店跳舞，跟节拍闪光。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME stay up all night, glowing brightly to illuminate their surroundings. They seem to love brightly lit cities, and sometimes even dance inside nightclubs, flashing in time to the beat.

entry: 岩石密布、通行困难的海岸，常有POKENAME工作。它们挥动许多尾巴，向船只示警岸边的危险；尾尖的宝石明亮得数英里外都能看见。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are commonly put to work on the shorelines of particularly rocky and difficult coasts. They wave their many tails to signal the dangers of the shore to ships, the gems at the tip of their tails lighting up bright enough to be seen for miles.

entry: POKENAME最强的发光器官在喉后。受威胁就张巨颚，射出能灼伤视网膜的光束，有时会导致永久失明。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's strongest light-generating organ rests in the back of its throat. If it feels threatened, it opens its mighty jaws and lets loose a retina-searing beam of light that can cause permanent blindness in some cases.

entry: POKENAME振翼越快，尾越亮。响亮的电力嗡鸣，能干扰电器。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's tail glows brighter the faster it beats its wings. They create a loud, electrical, buzzing noise that can interfere with electronic appliances.

entry: POKENAME爱乘微风。风暴中被吹得乱转，就对周围一切使出电击。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME loves to ride the gentle breeze. During storms, POKENAME is thrown around wildly as it uses Thundershock on everything around it.

entry: POKENAME羽饰越大，电攻越强。羽少的常偷茸茸羊的毛，想显得更厉害。
author: mistymagius
source: The POKENAME with the largest plumage have the most powerful electric attacks. The ones with less plumage will often steal the wool from Flaaffy in an effort to look more powerful.

entry: POKENAME收集电气石，击碎、灌注能量，储电其中。再把发光宝石排在多岩海岸，鲜明警告驶近的船。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME assemble caches of tourmaline, breaking the gems down and imbuing them with energy to store electrical charges within them. They then arrange the glowing gems along rocky shorelines, forming a vibrant warning to ships heading in to coast.

entry: 雪地居民夜行会带POKENAME照路。若迷路，它也能引回家。
author: oddwalls
source: In snowy regions, residents who must travel at night bring POKENAME with them to light the way. It can also guide them home if they lose their way.

entry: POKENAME夜里出现在林中迷路者面前，像要用光引路。可只带孩子脱险，却把成年人引向林深处。
author: oddwalls
source: At night, POKENAME appears to people lost in the forest, acting like it will guide them with its light. However, it only guides children to safety, leading adults deeper into the woods.

entry: POKENAME给伙伴加油，手上光球火花四射。越兴奋，电荷越强。
author: hophoppip
source: Sparks fly from the orbs on POKENAME's hands as it cheers on its allies. The more excited POKENAME gets, the stronger its electrical charge.

entry: POKENAME的光能穿透所住的漆黑水域，诱来猎物，最远2英里外也看得见。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The light emitted from POKENAME is strong enough to pierce through the pitch-black waters it resides in. This light is used to lure in prey and can be seen for up to two miles.

entry: POKENAME十分热心，会救助海上迷途的水手。每颗红珠的光，都亮得足以穿透浓雾。
author: yoshimon
source: POKENAME are extremely helpful Pokémon that help lost sailors at sea. Each of their red orbs can shine brightly enough to cut through dense fog.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，翼云产电。积够后，双翼变暗，光球跃出电弧。充满电的群体常被误认成远处雷雨，让市民躲回室内。
author: chibitales
source: As POKENAME flies, the clouds on its wings generate electricity. Its wings darken and lightning begins to arc from its orbs when they build up enough charge. Fully-charged flocks are often mistaken for distant thunderstorms, driving citizens indoors.

entry: 据说POKENAME乘风舞，以水晶般歌喉唱，长期被称作天使。引迷路者、救溺水者、安抚恐惧，因而受尊为温柔守护者。
author: jonclyd
source: Said to dance upon the winds and sing with a crystal-like voice, POKENAME has long been called an angel. Guiding the lost, rescuing the drowning, and calming the frightened with its voice, it is revered as a gentle protector.

entry: POKENAME产电，让覆云双翼随意放雷。它飞过风暴海域，用明亮尾光引船去安全港。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's electrical generation lets its cloud-covered wings cast thunderbolts at will. It flies through stormy seas, guiding ships toward safe harbors via the bright light its tail can emanate.

entry: POKENAME尾巴能随时强烈照明。若塞进嘴，整个身体便明亮发光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tail is able to generate a powerfully illuminating light at will. If it stuffs it tail into its mouth, it can make its entire body glow brightly.

entry: POKENAME给羊毛涂上黏液，防止脱落。可这也让羊毛隔绝电流，因此它得小心，不能涂得太多。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME coats its wool with a sticky slime to prevent it from falling off its body. This, however, causes the wool to become an insulator for its electricity, so it has to be careful not to put on too much.

entry: POKENAME由带电岩石构成，始终强烈发光。虽避开群体，黑夜里数英里外仍能见它的光。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME is composed of electrically charged rocks, which constantly give off an intense glow. Though it avoids society, one can see the light of an POKENAME from miles away in the dark of the night.

entry: POKENAME身体静电导向尾尖。拥抱时把尾巴远离训练家，免得误电。
author: hophoppip
source: Static electricity from POKENAME's body is transported to the end of its tail. It keeps its tail away from its Trainer during cuddle time to prevent accidental shocks.

entry: POKENAME心地不坏，野生个体却脾气急躁。先放光晃花周围的眼睛，再凑近一抱，足以压碎肋骨。
author: meltan808
source: Although it's good-natured, wild POKENAME tend to have a short temper. It will blind anyone nearby with its ability to produce light, then close in for a rib-crushing hug.

entry: POKENAME背上带电蘑菇能强亮。吃腐木时，借光吓退偏爱暗处的竞争者。
author: .jerden
source: The electrically charged mushrooms on POKENAME's back can glow brightly. While feeding on rotting wood, it uses this light to frighten away competitors that prefer dark environments.

entry: 它待在岸边，发出灯光，替船只引路。人们却不知道，POKENAME其实想让船沉没，好拿来取乐。
author: kiddivinegon
source: This Pokémon hangs out on the shore and shines lights to guide ships. What people don't know is that POKENAME is trying to sink those vessels for fun.

entry: POKENAME活动时，沿身排列的光球如极光闪烁。受威胁，就从球放电。
author: infinex21
source: The orbs lining an POKENAME's body shimmer with the lights of an aurora when it is active. They discharge electricity from these orbs whenever they feel threatened.

entry: POKENAME身上晶体含本物种独有金属的微量成分，让电导向尖端。肌肉调整晶体瞄准，收缩也能积电。
author: thordemidgard
source: The crystals growing on POKENAME's body include traces of a metal unique to its species that lets it direct electricity towards the tips. Its muscles shift to aim them in the desired direction, also building up electricity through the contractions.

entry: POKENAME背上红球夜里明亮，吸引许多虫属性宝可梦。虫群沾蘑菇孢子，等灯熄，再带去远方。
author: .jerden
source: The red orbs on its back shine brightly at night, drawing in many Bug-type Pokémon. This swarm will pick up spores from POKENAME's mushroom, then carry them a long distance once POKENAME's light switches off.

entry: POKENAME蘑菇上的多个球，能组成耀眼闪光。有人请它在公共活动中表演精彩灯光秀。
author: sk372
source: The multiple orbs on POKENAME's mushroom allow it to create dazzling and blinding displays of flashing lights. Some have used it to create impressive light shows at public events.

entry: 有人说POKENAME光球比太阳还亮。可除非吃下蕴含巨大能量的东西，否则亮不了多久。
author: musicsheep.
source: Some say that the light that shines from POKENAME's orbs shines brighter than the sun. It can't shine for very long unless it eats something with immense energy.

entry: POKENAME给爪充强电时，全身光球亮起。在家乡海里受威胁，就大范围猛烈放电，电击周围一切。
author: fireblade141
source: The orbs on POKENAME's body glow whenever it charges its claws with intense electricity. In the ocean where it lives, this Pokémon sets off powerful discharges to electrocute everything around it in a wide radius when threatened.

entry: POKENAME周身白毛产刺激粉，除了自己，谁都觉得难受。它能从身上珍珠放高压电花。
author: fiordaliso
source: The white fur surrounding POKENAME's body produces an irritating powder that bothers everyone except itself. It can generate high-voltage electric sparks from the pearls on its body.

entry: POKENAME能见未来。察觉危险就明亮发光，用强信号试着警告伙伴。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME can see into the future. If it senses danger, it will glow brightly and try to warn others with bright signals.

entry: POKENAME能从魔杖放出巨量光，把整个夜空照得如白昼。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME can emanate so much light from its wand that it can brighten the entire night sky into appearing like its day.

entry: 过去，POKENAME有时被叫作“风暴先知”。许多文化向它询问风暴何时、何地发生，它也常在风暴中充当信标帮忙。
author: foolish_weasel
source: At times in the past it has been referred to as the “Storm Seer” Pokémon. Many cultures will consult POKENAME to determine when and where storms may occur. It will often assist by acting as a beacon during these storms.

entry: POKENAME把身上光球砸地，就能引发闪光爆响。趁对手看不见，便逃走。
author: musicsheep.
source: The orbs covering POKENAME's body can be slammed on the ground to set off a flashbang. While the opponent is blinded, POKENAME makes its escape.

entry: 沿岸悬崖常聚着POKENAME，夜里将崖顶照亮。汇聚的光足够明亮，水手能把它们当作灯塔，避免船只搁浅。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Swarms of POKENAME are found along coastal cliffs where they illuminate the clifftops at night. Their collective light is bright enough that sailors are able to use them in place of lighthouses to avoid beaching their ships.

entry: POKENAME尾球可摘，之后再生。它用球猛砸敌人，让光球剧烈炸碎。
author: musicsheep.
source: The orb on its tail can be plucked off and will regrow. POKENAME uses these orbs to slam them into opponents, causing the orb to shatter violently.

entry: POKENAME常用于限制空域，用强光警告飞机正进入禁飞区。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME is often utilized in restricted airspace. With its bright lights, it alerts aircraft that they are entering a no-fly zone.

entry: 这些宝可梦高兴时，会两脚轮流跳动，让红色结晶闪闪发光。尾巴上的球体十分烫，雨水一碰到，就会瞬间蒸发。
author: infinex21
source: When these Pokémon are happy, they hop from foot to foot while flashing lights from their red crystals. The orbs on their tails are hot to the touch, to the point that rain will instantly evaporate on contact.

entry: POKENAME烦躁时，尾球电花四射。爪坚到凿岩也不崩口，摸着滚烫。
author: infinex21
source: Electrical sparks fly from POKENAME's tail orbs when they are agitated. Their claws are tough enough to break through rock without chipping and are hot to the touch.

entry: POKENAME酷爱闪亮的东西，痴迷地寻找硬币和抛光的宝石。找到心仪之物时，尾巴便亮得像信标，招来其他POKENAME，一同看看发现了什么。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a love for shiny objects, obsessively hunting out coins and polished gemstones. When they find something to their liking their tail lights up like a beacon, drawing other POKENAME to come and see what they've found.

entry: POKENAME需要不断放电，因此在灯塔工作。明亮的喙，帮船导航到岸。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME work at lighthouses because they constantly need to release electrical energy. Their bright bill helps ships navigate to shore.

entry: POKENAME忠诚，很少离训练家身边。兴奋便摇尾，越开心，尾与鼻的光球越亮。
author: sk372
source: A loyal companion, POKENAME rarely leaves its Trainer's side. It wags its tail when excited, and the happier its mood, the more brightly the orbs on its tail and nose will glow.

entry: POKENAME尾灯极亮，暴雨夜也远远可见。机场让它们成对跑在飞机前，照亮跑道两侧，引导降落。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME tails light up brightly enough to be visible from great distances, even on stormy nights. Airports make use of them to guide airplanes to the ground, having POKENAME race ahead of the planes in pairs, lighting either side of the runway.

entry: POKENAME尾灯极亮，暴雨夜也远远可见。机场让它们成对跑在飞机前，照亮跑道两侧，引导降落。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME tails light up brightly enough to be visible from great distances, even on stormy nights. Airports make use of them to guide airplanes to the ground, having POKENAME race ahead of the planes in pairs, lighting either side of the runway.

entry: 野生POKENAME以极高速奔驰，身上的众多球体发亮，在多数生灵眼中，宛如一道红黄流光。吠叫时，嘴里洒出余烬，光球迸出雷电火花。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME dash across the lands at extreme speeds, the many orbs along its body aglow and casting it as a streak of red and yellow to the eyes of most. When it barks, embers spill from its mouth and sparks of lightning fly from its orbs.

entry: POKENAME将能量导进拳，浓缩电力使拳头明亮。它标志性的招牌，无疑是雷电拳。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it channels energy into its fists, they shine brightly from all the condensed electricity. The signature move that defines POKENAME is undoubtedly Thunder Punch.

entry: POKENAME常帮农人牧大群咩利羊、搬重农具。形体虽吓人、肌肉强，性情却温柔善良。
author: vlavoc
source: POKENAME is often seen working alongside farmers, herding large flocks of Mareep and moving heavy farm equipment. Despite its intimidating form and capable muscles, it's a very gentle and kind Pokémon.

entry: 这种宝可梦飞行四方，寻找更强的敌人，猛烈的雷雨也挡不住前路。放出全部电力时，尾上的球能亮到数英里外都看得见。
author: infinex21
source: This Pokémon flies in search of stronger foes. Not even a fierce thunderstorm will bar its path. When it releases all of its electricity, the orb on its tail can glow bright enough to be seen miles away.

entry: POKENAME控不好尾宝石的亮度，常不慎强闪，方圆数英里都看见。它很容易因失误害羞，缩壳躲起来。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME struggles to control the brightness of the gem on its tail, sometimes accidentally releasing bursts that can be seen for miles around. It is easily embarrassed by these mistakes and will withdraw into its shell to hide.

entry: POKENAME嘴里有颗强光球。教得好，便能作极强的手电筒。
author: musicsheep.
source: Inside of POKENAME's mouth is an orb that emits a strong light. If taught correctly, you could utilize POKENAME as an extremely powerful flashlight.

entry: POKENAME把电导入触手，点亮末端。它挥光远距沟通，数英里外也可见。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME channel electricity into their tentacles to make the tips of them glow brightly. They wave these lights around to communicate with one another over long distances; the light they produce is visible for miles.

entry: POKENAME鬃毛柔软与耐火程度，均数一数二。为防偷猎使其灭绝，不得不制定严法。
author: infinex21
source: The mane of an POKENAME is some of the softest and most flame-resistant wool ever known. Strict laws had to be established to prevent poachers from hunting them into extinction.

entry: 这些威严的宝可梦，能在周围召来雷电，用华美的角将落雷“接住”。POKENAME暴怒时，奔踏会烧焦脚下的土地，还会召下道道闪电，将大地劈裂。
author: infinex21
source: These majestic Pokémon can call forth lightning around themselves and will "catch" lightning with their marvelous horns. An enraged POKENAME's trampling will scorch the very ground they walk upon and call down bolts of lightning to split the earth.

entry: 被晃动得太厉害时，POKENAME的尾巴会本能地放出强闪光，自卫御敌。可它无聊时爱玩自己的尾巴，结果常被闪光晃花了自己的眼。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tail emits a bright flash of light as an instinctive self-defense maneuver whenever it is jostled too much. Due to POKENAME's tendency to play with its own tail when bored, it often ends up blinding itself with this light.

entry: 船上电力系统故障，船员就派POKENAME。头尾宝石亮到穿透最暗浓雾，还可训练给其他船传信。
author: ghostslythe
source: When electric systems on board a vessel go down, the crew deploy POKENAME. The gems on their tails and head are bright enough to pierce the darkest fog, and they can be trained to signal other ships.

entry: POKENAME不再产毛，专心用精准炮发电击，保护群体。老年个体聚海岸，以尾作天然灯塔。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME no longer produces wool, dedicating itself to protecting members of its flock by launching electric blasts from its accurate cannons. Elderly members of the species congregate along shorelines, acting as natural lighthouses with their tails.

entry: POKENAME尾光发送假求救信号，欺骗水手。成功就发出令人毛骨悚然的笑。
author: mistershaokahn
source: The light emitted by POKENAME's tail is used to deceive sailors by sending out false S.O.S. messages. When it succeeds, it lets out a blood-curdling laugh.

entry: POKENAME细控电力，操纵脑波，改变被催眠者的记忆。亮球先引目标，再悄悄重塑思想。
author: amiel997
source: Using its fine control of electricity, POKENAME's manipulates brainwaves to alter the memories of those it hypnotizes. Its glowing orbs lures in targets before subtly reshaping their thoughts.

entry: POKENAME巨钳只需咔嚓一合，就迸出电能，闪光亮到1英里外可见。
author: sk372
source: With just a snap of its massive claw, POKENAME generates a burst of electric energy. The resulting flash is bright enough to be visible from a mile away.

entry: 大量吃烛木果，POKENAME就长出浓厚电毛。人们请地面属性宝可梦帮剪，用来制公共设施工人的耐用衣物。
author: pjporwoll
source: With a robust diet of Wacan Berries, POKENAME will produce thick coats of electrically-charged wool. This wool is shorn with the help of Ground-type Pokémon so it can be used in producing heavy-duty clothing for utility workers.

entry: POKENAME光合作用时放花香，让周围所有野生宝可梦失去战意。通常住在未受破坏的森林空地。
author: fiordaliso
source: While photosynthesising, it releases a floral fragrance that causes all wild Pokémon in the area to lose any will to battle. POKENAME typically lives in clearings within unspoiled woods and forests.

entry: POKENAME吃下体重3倍的叶子，获取足够能量，供养头上的花朵。每朵花都耗费大量养分，因此头上同时开着的，很少超过两朵。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME eat thrice their body weight in leaves so that they have enough energy to maintain the flowers on their head. They rarely have more than two flowers on their head at a time because of how many nutrients that go into each flower.

entry: POKENAME春季最容易见到。爆炸会喷一阵花粉，尤其惹过敏者困扰。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are most likely to be spotted during the season of spring. They are particularly annoying for people with allergies, as they release a burst of pollen when they explode.

entry: POKENAME颜色图案多样。吸阳光越多，越鲜艳；完全无光，独特色彩也可能全消失。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME come in a variety of different colors and patterns. The more sunlight they absorb, the more vivid they are; without any sun, they can lose their unique coloration entirely.

entry: POKENAME六个单体由奇异力量相连，阳光下更强。存的阳光越少，颜色越暗。特殊色调的个体，收藏家很喜欢。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's six individual units are connected through a strange power that strengthens under the sun. The less sunlight POKENAME has stored, the more dull its color. POKENAME of peculiar shades and hues are desirable among collectors.

entry: POKENAME叶子产芳香油，压榨后制成肥皂。园丁想多种叶片，就摘下一头，种成新植株。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produces an aromatic oil from its leaves that is squeezed and pressed into soap. When gardeners need to produce more leaves, one of its heads is detached to grow a new plant.

entry: POKENAME独处也开心跳舞，尤其爱以舞蹈晨练开始一天。它与其他宝可梦切磋，把头花的粉末涂在骨棒上，削弱对手。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME cheerfully dances even when alone, especially loving to begin the day with dancing exercises. It spars with other Pokémon, coating its bone club in debilitating powders from the flowers on its head.

entry: 对POKENAME来说，战斗就是舞蹈，都需技巧优雅。它不断练动作，让战中、平日的每一步都熟练完美。
author: sk372
source: To POKENAME, combat and dancing are the same, and both must be tackled with skill and grace. It practices its movements constantly so that every movement in or out of battle is practiced and perfected.

entry: POKENAME的苦叶有益消化系统。常在草药师家，采叶制药。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produces bitter leaves that have a salutary effect on the digestive system. It is often found in the homes of herbalists, where its leaves are harvested to make medicine.

entry: 热带的POKENAME花朵有独特胡椒辣味，还能提神。有道高档料理，将吉利蛋的蛋温火煮，再以花点缀。
author: mepp.
source: Found in the tropics, POKENAME's flowers have a distinct peppery flavor that also boosts one's energy. One high-class recipe consists of coddled Chansey eggs garnished with these flowers.

entry: 海带园里若有POKENAME，海藻就随舞蹈有节奏摇摆，很好辨认。它吐鲜艳墨汁，以墨幕掩护逃敌。
author: sk372
source: One can tell if an undersea kelp garden contains POKENAME, as its dances cause the seaweed to sway in a notably rhythmic fashion. It spits a vibrantly-colored ink to create a smokescreen to escape predators.

entry: POKENAME群举行精巧斗舞，展示旋转与同步动作。舞后疲惫，容易被捕食，便聚在一起自保。
author: pjporwoll
source: Schools of POKENAME gather to conduct elaborate dance battles where their spins and synchronized maneuvers are shown off. Afterwards, the tired POKENAME become prime targets for predators, so they cluster to avoid being eaten.

entry: POKENAME对同栖地鱼宝可梦友好，很适合暖地池塘。欢快旋转，启发了关都的一种交谊舞。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is friendly towards other fish Pokémon in its habitat, making it a recommended choice for ponds in warm climates. Its joyful spinning movements have inspired a form of ballroom dancing in Kanto.

entry: POKENAME一振翅，就会撒出粉末，让植物长得更好，活得更长。
author: dodoowner_
source: With a flap of its wings, POKENAME spread a powder which promotes growth and longevity in plants.

entry: POKENAME躺阳光下，巧装花朵避敌。核心吸日光存能，失去肢体，几乎瞬间就能长回。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will lie in the sun, cleverly disguising themselves as flowers to avoid predators. They will absorb sunlight through their core, storing it in order to allow them to almost instantly regrow lost limbs.

entry: POKENAME主动猎捕想吃舞中美丽花的虫宝可梦。安静时，能见它在空中摇摆，跳人类无法做到的刀舞。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME actively hunts Bug-type Pokémon who attempt to devour dancing Bellossom. In quiet moments, it can be seen swaying through the air in a humanly impossible blade dance.

entry: POKENAME生活在规模庞大的群落，阳光下一同起舞，靠头上的花吸收日光，转为养分。它们很合群，常帮助训练家，或邀请训练家一起跳舞。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME live in very large communities,  dancing in the sun together. They use the flower on their head to absorb sunlight, converting it into nutrients. They are very social Pokémon, often helping out Trainers or inviting them to join their dances.

entry: 火山将喷发，POKENAME就跳舞，反传出舞蹈引起喷发的说法。舞时甩尾，也会误点燃周围野生生物。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME dances whenever a volcano is about to erupt, but this behavior has caused rumors that the dance itself causes the volcano to erupt. It swings its tail around while it dances, causing it to accidentally ignite the surrounding wildlife.

entry: 阳光足、空气清新，POKENAME就温顺。日落或天气差，却会烦躁喷气，懊恼地乱动。
author: sk372
source: When there's ample sun and fresh air, POKENAME behaves in a docile manner. Once the sun sets or the weather turns foul, however, it gets agitated, snorting and flaring about in frustration.

entry: POKENAME喜住晴朗花田，与同类有节奏扭动。性情开朗，又只吃落叶和植物碎屑，很受花农欢迎。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME prefers living in sunny fields where it joins with others of its kind to wiggle in rhythm. Florists welcome it in their gardens since it has a sunny disposition and only eats detached leaves and other plant detritus.

entry: POKENAME优雅跃过山丘草原一天，便靠带刺植物休息自保。自己也满身刺，很少受扰。它特别爱太阳雨。
author: bobosmith01
source: After a day of leaping gracefully over hills and through grassy plains, POKENAME rests by thorny flora for protection. As its own body is also covered in thorns, it is rarely disturbed during this time. POKENAME particularly loves sun showers.

entry: POKENAME藏进美丽花群伪装避敌。要认出来，就找唯一不跳舞的那朵“美丽花”。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides among groups of Bellossom as camouflage to protect itself from predators. It can be identified among the crowd as the only "Bellossom" not dancing.

entry: POKENAME白天与幼崽一起觅食。太阳落下，就庆祝起舞，享用收集的食物。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will forage for food with their young throughout the day. As the sun begins to set, they will hold a celebration, dancing and feasting on the food that they've collected.

entry: POKENAME可能比大针蜂温和，腹花花粉却与大针蜂毒刺一样强，春天更达双倍。
author: chazoplebas
source: POKENAME may have a milder temper than its Beedrill counterpart, but the pollen stored in its abdominal bloom is as potent as a Beedrill sting. It's doubly so during springtime.

entry: 热带密林深处的POKENAME，以舞步放出疗愈精神波。对植物尤其有效，滋养周围花朵，保持健康鲜艳。
author: sk372
source: Nestled deep in tropical forests, POKENAME's dance moves send out healing psychic waves around it. The pulses are most effective on flora, helping nourish the flowers around it and making sure they stay healthy and vibrant.

entry: POKENAME与芳香治疗师合作，帮助病人缓解压力。所散香气凝成油，让病人随身带，随时平心静气。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME works alongside aromatherapists to help patients treat their stress. The aromatic scents it releases are condensed into oil that patients carry throughout the day to calm themselves down.

entry: POKENAME采草地花装头，把茎夹羽间。彼此跳精巧舞，显眼地展示花朵。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME will pick flowers from meadows and adorn their heads with them, tucking the stems in between their feathers. They perform elaborate dances for one another, prominently displaying their flowers as they do so.

entry: 太阳升得最高、最暖和的时候，POKENAME舞得也最有活力。它用花尾撑高身体，让自己更加显眼，好让更多来者看见欢乐的舞姿。
author: sk372
source: When the sun is at its highest and casts the most warmth, POKENAME dances its most vibrantly. It uses its flowery tail to lift itself up and make it more visible, so that more outsiders can bare witness to its joyous moves.

entry: POKENAME头花放深红花粉，催眠其他宝可梦。等睡着，再轻轻咕咕叫，把梦变得恐怖。
author: .izik
source: The flowers on POKENAME's head release a crimson pollen that induces sleep in other Pokémon. Once they drift off, it emits quiet hoots that fill their dreams with terrifying nightmares.

entry: POKENAME小翼让它优雅飘于花间，吃花粉。家在大片雏菊田，与花融为一体。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tiny wings allow it to float gracefully from flower to flower, consuming pollen. It makes its home in vast daisy fields, blending in with the blossoms.

entry: POKENAME快乐飞过花田，优雅盘旋。偶尔落下摘花瓣，吃作养分。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME joyfully flies above flower fields, performing elegant spiraling motions. It lands occasionally to pluck flower petals, which it eats for nourishment.

entry: POKENAME以静电把落叶贴身。它爱音乐，会参加庆典，与人和宝可梦一起兴奋跳舞。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME attach fallen leaves to their body using static electricity. They have a great love of music and will join in celebrations and festivities, dancing with great excitement alongside people and Pokémon alike.

entry: POKENAME毛间的花产珍贵香油。采花得先建立信任，否则它放尽积电，毁掉花朵。
author: fancyskunk
source: The flowers that grow amidst POKENAME's wool produce oils prized by perfume makers. Harvesting these flowers requires building a trusting relationship with POKENAME. Otherwise, it will discharge its electrical build up and destroy the flowers.

entry: POKENAME雷雨中优雅起舞，风里散花瓣，聚电恢复受损森林的能量。大雨中尾巴微亮，引迷路者脱险。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME dance elegantly through thunderstorms, scattering flower petals in the wind that gather electricity and restore energy to damaged forests. Their tails glow faintly amidst the heavy rain, guiding any lost Trainers or Pokémon to safety.

entry: 它把阳光变成电力，再射出雷电。POKENAME的花越红、越深，便代表蓄电越多。
author: ecovermination
source: It turns sunlight into electricity, before firing off bolts of lightning. The darker the red POKENAME's flowers are, the more charged up it is.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴虽美，里面却可能藏着高达1000伏的电压。花朵有时，更亮得宛如太阳。
author: dodoowner_
source: A POKENAME tail, although pretty, can have up to 1000 volts of electricity hiding inside. This Pokémon's flowers sometimes shine as bright as the sun.

entry: 据说POKENAME休满一季的土地，就能繁花百年。研究证实，花粉中和空气毒素的效率极高。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is said that wherever POKENAME rested for a full season, the land would bloom for a hundred years. Studies confirm that its pollen neutralizes airborne toxins with remarkable efficiency.

entry: 晴天，上升暖气流托起POKENAME的轻身体。地上待太久会烦躁，不安起舞，直到太阳再照。
author: .jerden
source: On sunny days, POKENAME's lightweight body is lifted into the air by rising thermals. It becomes agitated if it remains on the ground for too long, and will dance restlessly until the sun shines again.

entry: POKENAME在热带田野嬉戏，阳光不断补能，夜来才一堆堆睡。人们采花粉制药，帮助安睡。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME frolics in tropical fields where sunlight continually energizes it until it falls asleep in piles when night arrives. Its pollen is collected for use in medicine that helps induce restful sleep.

entry: POKENAME早晨在丛林各处采种，树间荡跃时，朝旅人扔去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spends its morning gathering seeds from plants throughout the jungle. It throws these seeds at travelers while swinging from tree to tree.

entry: POKENAME第一次遇雨，就带泥球远行，直到找到晴处。遇见想永远交好的宝可梦或训练家，便赠泥球。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When POKENAME experiences its first rain, it immediately travels far away until it finds a sunny place, taking a ball of mud with it. When it meets a Pokémon or Trainer they wish to be friends with forever, POKENAME gifts them the mudball.

entry: POKENAME身体多处有益健康。花瓣助消化，鳞茎产孢子缓头痛，藤蔓则增加膳食纤维。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many parts of a POKENAME have various salutary effects on the body. The petals help the digestive system, the bulb produces spores to alleviate headaches, and the vines add fiber to a person's diet.

entry: POKENAME在野花田下筑复杂巢道，避多数捕食者。它找花装饰枝状尾，再跳仪式舞求偶。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME build complex nesting tunnels under wildflower fields where they can avoid most predators. They seek out flowers to decorate their tree branch tails before performing dance rituals to attract a partner.

entry: POKENAME有时会聚在林间小路，搭成一道花拱。最明亮的花在顶端，较弱的则从下方，吸取养分。
author: leshii
source: POKENAME sometimes gather and form an arch over forest footpaths. The brightest blooms form the top, while the weakest draw nutrients from below.

entry: POKENAME情绪受压，身花就停止生长。抑郁时，花会干枯变灰。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME experiences emotional stress the flowers on its body will stop growing. When depressed, the flowers will dry out and turn grey.

entry: 据说POKENAME头上的莲花，能给附近的人和宝可梦带来吉祥未来。玉虹游戏城的狂热常客尤其喜欢，用心养莲，盼多好运。
author: eni.starfall
source: The lotus on POKENAME's head is told to bring an auspicious future to humans and Pokémon in its proximity. They are especially popular amongst Celadon Game Corner fanatics, who tend to care for POKENAME's lotus well in hopes of garnering more luck.

entry: POKENAME花朵由钢瓣组成，风里诡异鸣响。农人信听见这声，就该弃地离去。
author: jaminmcready
source: The blossoms on a POKENAME are made of steel petals that chime eerily in the wind. Farmers believe hearing them is a sign to abandon the land.

entry: POKENAME收集各种花，把最爱戴头上。谁想偷，就以猛烈终极冲击报复。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME collects an array of flowers, displaying its favorites on its head. If someone attempts to steal them, it retaliates with a violent Giga Impact.

entry: POKENAME看见谁践踏植物，就会追个不停，直到咬中。模样虽吓人，它其实更愿整天照料头上的花，而非争斗。
author: fiordaliso
source: If it sees someone trampling on a plant, POKENAME will chase after them until it manages to bite them. Although it looks menacing, it would rather spend its days tending to the flowers growing on its head than fighting.

entry: 战中的POKENAME美丽动人。节奏振翼调整位置，编排每次优雅攻击，恰合舞拍命中。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: A fighting POKENAME is beautiful to behold. Adjusting its position with rhythmic wingbeats, POKENAME choreographs each graceful attack to land in time with its dance.

entry: POKENAME椰子状钳的空洞咔嗒声，就是独属各自的舞蹈伴奏。音乐与舞步，启发了媒体中多个知名歌舞作品。
author: sk372
source: The hollow clacking of POKENAME's coconut-like pincers serves as its own rhythmic backdrop for its dances, unique to each individual. Its music and moves have inspired several famous songs and dances in media.

entry: POKENAME身体与花色受许多因素影响，如附近土壤成分、最近火山的活跃程度。粉色个体尤其少见。
author: bobosmith01
source: The colors of POKENAME's body and flowers all vary on a variety of factors, such as nearby soil composition and how active the closest volcano is. POKENAME with pink hues are particularly rare.

entry: 它双翼是鲜艳花瓣，晴天在地上拍着跳舞。别的宝可梦常不当威胁，可什么进到尖喙范围，便突然扑去。
author: .jerden
source: Its wings are made of brightly colored petals, and in sunny weather it will flap them as it dances on the ground. Although other Pokémon often do not see it as a threat, it will suddenly lunge at anything that gets within reach of its sharp beak.

entry: POKENAME美丽草衣与温柔性情，吸引小宝可梦背上休息。睡着时，几乎分不清是它还是长满草的大石。
author: pizzarcato
source: POKENAME's beautiful grass coat and gentle demeanor attract small Pokémon to rest on its back. While sleeping, it is barely distinguishable from an overgrown boulder.

entry: POKENAME与别的花摩擦、交换花粉，就产花蜜。最后全身覆无花果蜜汁，一路滴落，直到没有花粉可再转。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME rubs against other flowers, its body produces nectar from the exchange of pollen. Its body eventually becomes covered in fig nectar, which forms a drippy trail behind it until it no longer has pollen to convert into nectar.

entry: POKENAME羽毛轻盈，温暖的晴天里，乘着柔风便能翱翔。它们讨厌受潮、受冻，每到秋天，便能见到它们往来某些地区迁徙。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have lightweight feathers that allow them to soar on a soft breeze on a warm sunny day. They can be seen migrating to and from certain regions when the season of fall comes, as they loathe getting wet or feeling cold.

entry: POKENAME把花种收存进鼻。积够就种入新土，培育花圃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME collects and stores flower seeds in its snout. Once it has enough seeds, it plants them into fresh soil to cultivate flowerbeds.

entry: POKENAME摇头花，制造恐怖幻象驱敌。凭这本领赢得其他宝可梦敬重与好感，常有同伴共居，享受保护。
author: fiordaliso
source: By shaking the flowers on its head, POKENAME creates frightening illusions to drive away predators. Thanks to this power, it earns the respect and goodwill of other Pokémon, which often live in its company and enjoy its protection.

entry: POKENAME长期被偷猎，学会用头花造恐怖幻象，阻挡猎人。每只都有独特细腻香气。
author: fiordaliso
source: Because it was long hunted by poachers, POKENAME learned to use the flowers on its head to create terrifying illusions and keep hunters at bay. Each specimen has a unique, delicate fragrance.

entry: POKENAME爱挑战强敌，虽总居下风。受伤就躺太阳下恢复。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME loves to battle against challenging foes, even though it's always the underdog. When injured, it lies out in the sun to recover.

entry: POKENAME阳光下跳热闹旋舞，据说能帮助召来阳光。群体聚集时，规律舞动便是庆典的核心。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME will perform a festive spinning dance underneath the sun, it's said that their movements are able to help summon sunlight. When herds POKENAME group up, their rhythmic motions are the heart of celebrations.

entry: POKENAME藏在花田，用胸前的假花引来传粉者，供自己捕食。遇到较大的威胁，它们就迅速摇动身上的叶片，发出响亮的沙沙声。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will hide out in flower fields, using the false flowers on their chests to attract pollinators in order to eat them. When faced with a larger threat, they will rapidly shake the leaves on their bodies, creating a loud rustling sound.

entry: POKENAME的花蜜甘甜醇厚，美味又似乎能安抚心绪。连暴怒的火暴猴喝一口，也会放松。
author: phantom640
source: The sweet and mellow flavor of POKENAME's nectar is not only incredibly tasty, but it also seems to have a calming effect on those who drink it. Even a furious Primeape will relax after a single sip.

entry: 几百年来，人们一直用它的花泡茶。据说喝下，谁都会心情平静。
author: barfy_here
source: People have been using this Pokémon's flowers to make tea for hundreds of years. It is said to have a calming effect on anyone who drinks it.

entry: 据说POKENAME一声强吼，就能让整片森林的树全开花。花鬃变深红，便是在蓄积毁灭性火属性攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is said that POKENAME can make every tree in an entire forest bloom with a single mighty roar. When its floral mane turns a deep crimson, it is charging up a devastating Fire-type attack.

entry: POKENAME一年只开一次花，而且年年都在同一个夜晚。花开时，它会将花献给最钟爱的对象。两只POKENAME若这样交换了花朵，便会相伴一生。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME only blossom once a year, and always on the same night each year. When their flowers blossom they will offer them to their favourite individual. When two flowers are exchanged between POKENAME this way they pair for life.

entry: POKENAME早晨采种，细心种遍丛林，再把尾上漏出的花蜜喷在新作物上。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers seeds in the mornings and takes great care to plant them around the jungle. The nectar that leaks from its tail is sprayed on these planted crops.

entry: POKENAME爱跳舞，把从前模仿的各种动作融进抽象舞步。几乎没有宝可梦和它处不好。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME loves to dance and will incorporate all kinds of previously mimicked movements into an abstract jig. Very few Pokémon fail to get along with it.

entry: POKENAME一年只开一次花，而且年年都在同一个夜晚。花开时，它会将花献给最钟爱的对象。两只POKENAME若这样交换了花朵，便会相伴一生。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME only blossom once a year, and always on the same night each year. When their flowers blossom they will offer them to their favourite individual. When two flowers are exchanged between POKENAME this way they pair for life.

entry: POKENAME一年只开一次花，而且年年都在同一个夜晚。花开时，它会将花献给最钟爱的对象。两只POKENAME若这样交换了花朵，便会相伴一生。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME only blossom once a year, and always on the same night each year. When their flowers blossom they will offer them to their favourite individual. When two flowers are exchanged between POKENAME this way they pair for life.

entry: POKENAME寒暖地区都游走，阳光下却最茂盛。常群同行，动作同步如仪式舞，据说能从云后召来阳光。
author: jonclyd
source: POKENAME roam cold and warm regions alike, though they flourish beneath the sun. Often seen traveling in packs, they move in rhythmic unison in a dance-like ritual said to summon sunlight from behind the clouds.

entry: POKENAME会把身上长出的花，送给伤心的人。跳舞时，身上也飘出怡人的香气。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME offers the flowers growing on its body to those who are sad. When it dances, a pleasing scent wafts from its body.

entry: 屋主度假时，POKENAME帮园丁照料植物，尤其善修灌木枯枝。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME helps gardeners take care of plants while homeowners are away on vacation. It is particularly good at pruning dead branches from shrubs and bushes.

entry: 有人认为POKENAME疯狂摇摆是高深舞蹈，其实完全不是，而是光合积能过多，不由自主的抽动。
author: soup1900
source: While some people believe that the frantic shakes and body movements POKENAME performs are advanced dances, they are nothing of the sort. Instead, they are involuntary twitches it does after photosynthesizing too much energy.

entry: POKENAME趴在花田，伪装并吸日光或月光。开心时，尾尖花如小螺旋桨转，撒柔和无害的花粉。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME lay flat on their bellies amidst fields of flowers to disguise themselves and absorb sunlight or moonlight. When happy, the flowers on the tips of their tails spin like small propellers and scatter a soft, harmless pollen.

entry: POKENAME舞时，阳光让羽色更鲜艳。优美舞步是迎春庆典的宠儿，可同一双腿，也能踢出毁灭性攻击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Sunlight intensifies the colors of POKENAME's feathers as it dances. Their graceful routines have made them beloved performers at festivals celebrating the arrival of spring. However, the same legs used for dancing can deliver devastating kicks.

entry: POKENAME淋雨、晒阳跳舞，两者提供不同却必要的养分。花瓣容易长得庞大沉重，得用超能力抵抗重力。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME bask in rain and dance in sunlight, both of which provide them with different, yet vital, nutrients. They use their psychic abilities to defy gravity due to how large and heavy their petals easily become.

entry: POKENAME把附近植物当自己孩子照料保护。野生个体探访森林、花园、花田等处，以超能力监测周围大片区域的麻烦。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME tend to and protect nearby plant life as if it were its own young; forests, gardens, flower fields, and even more have been visited by wild POKENAME. Using their psychic powers, they can monitor a wide area around themselves for any trouble.

entry: POKENAME寻找日之石，黏上吸能。一附着，就不再需要阳光与食物维生。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will seek out and latch onto Sun Stones, sapping the energy from them. Once they're attached to one, they will no longer need sunlight or food to survive.

entry: POKENAME周身长多朵美花，极爱向其他宝可梦展示。它喜欢选美比赛，自信满满地走台。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME grow multiple beautiful flowers across their body and take great pride in showing them off to other Pokémon. They love to take part in Pokémon beauty contests, strutting across the stage with complete confidence.

entry: POKENAME不同花朵随光照活跃，一天不同时刻，便产不同香气。香型多样，深受芳香治疗师欢迎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME produce different aromas depending on the time of day, their various flowers active depending on the light level. They are popular Pokémon for aromatherapists thanks to their variety of scents.

entry: POKENAME以花香引来虫属性宝可梦，再张颚整只吞下。消化猎物时，花色也会加深。
author: vibrationjaveline
source: POKENAME lures in Bug-type Pokémon with the scent of its flowers, then it opens its jaw to swallow them whole. The colors of its flowers deepen as it digests its prey.

entry: 热带海岸的POKENAME照料开花的鹤望兰。吵闹水属性宝可梦入侵，就召锐瓣风暴，再冲上将敌人撞回海。
author: ghostslythe
source: Native to tropical shores, POKENAME tends to flowering Birds of Paradise. When rowdy Water-types invade their home, these Pokémon call down a storm of razor sharp petals, rushing forward afterward to bowl the foes back to sea.

entry: 大量毁林之地，POKENAME便现身蹦跳，散花蜜让倒树再长。科学家发现，这物质危急时也能治疗草属性宝可梦。
author: ghostslythe
source: Where mass deforestation occurs, POKENAME appears and begins to prance. As it moves, it spreads nectar from its flowers that regrow downed trees. Scientists have found this substance can heal Grass-types in a pinch.

entry: POKENAME似乎住在鲜花果树繁盛的热带。舞步能瞬间让周围所有植物开花，身边始终绚丽多彩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears to live in tropical regions bursting with vibrant flowers and fruit-bearing trees. Its dance moves can instantly cause all the plants around it to bloom, ensuring its surroundings are always spectacular and colorful.

entry: POKENAME小巧爱玩，住在较凉的热带。它连吐带淡果香的泡泡，向其他生物打招呼。
author: sk372
source: A small and playful little creature that inhabits colder tropical regions. POKENAME greets others by blowing a series of bubbles that have a faint and fruity scent.

entry: 这根花束手杖借助鲜花与阳光的力量，能带来拨云见日、治愈轻伤等奇妙效果。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This bouquet staff uses the powers of flowers and sunshine to generate wondrous effects like parting clouds for sunlight and healing minor injuries.

entry: POKENAME常担任私家花园与温室的守卫。准备强电攻，空气就满是浓花香。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is commonly used as a guardian to protect private gardens and greenhouses. When it prepares to unleash its powerful electric attacks, the air fills with an intense floral scent.

entry: POKENAME初看吓人，内心却是温柔巨人。它在林间移动，附近小宝可梦都因其存在而安心。
author: sirg44
source: While POKENAME may appear intimidating at first glance, they are gentle giants at heart. As they move through the forest, smaller Pokémon in the area are calmed by their presence.

entry: POKENAME蓝核心吸收、代谢阳光，让众多叶片持续旋转。准备从核心射日光束时，叶片便明亮发光。
author: infinex21
source: The blue core of a POKENAME absorbs and metabolizes sunlight, which ensures its many leaves may continue to spin. These leaves will glow brightly when this Pokémon charges a Solar Beam to be fired from its core at its opponents.

entry: POKENAME红花有安抚疗愈作用，花瓣常入草本茶或镇静剂。彩缎带收阳光，转成养分。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its red flowers have calming and therapeutic properties, which is why its petals are often used in herbal teas or sedatives. POKENAME uses its colorful ribbons to gather sunlight and convert it into nourishment.

entry: POKENAME不断以炫目舞挑战同类，花瓣洒得到处都是。双脚与尾巴猛跺，震动强到能将地面劈成两半。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME constantly challenges others of its kind by performing dazzling dances that scatter flower petals everywhere. By powerfully stomping its feet and tail, it can create vibrations strong enough to split the ground in two.

entry: 风里若有沙锤声，很可能POKENAME正在表演。它爬到悬崖或火山边，慢慢摇摆，奏自己喜欢的歌。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: If the sound of maracas can be heard in the wind, it's likely that a POKENAME is performing. POKENAME climb to the edges of cliffs or volcanoes, slowly moving back and forth as they play a song they find enjoyable.

entry: POKENAME新月夜开花，产易随风飘的催眠花粉，让受影响者经历鲜明清醒梦。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's flowers bloom during nights with a new moon. These flowers produce soporific pollen that easily floats along the wind and causes those affected by it to experience vivid lucid dreams.

entry: POKENAME新月夜开花，产易随风飘的催眠花粉，让受影响者经历鲜明清醒梦。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's flowers bloom during nights with a new moon. These flowers produce soporific pollen that easily floats along the wind and causes those affected by it to experience vivid lucid dreams.

entry: POKENAME骄傲时跳华丽舞，满地花瓣挑衅对手。脚尾猛跺引震，据说能劈开地面。
author: fiordaliso
source: In displays of pride, POKENAME performs ornate dances, showering the field with petals to provoke rivals. With fierce stomps of its feet and tail, it unleashes tremors rumored to cleave the ground.

entry: POKENAME花朵一沐月光，就发亮。它住海滩，随风的低语摇摆。
author: dodoowner_
source: When exposed to moonlight, POKENAME's flowers become luminescent. It inhabits the beach, swaying to the whispers of the wind.

entry: POKENAME住在地球较暖的热带，身边植物鲜艳。跳求雨舞前，先伸展长臂，让舞更有效。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME inhabits tropical regions in the warmer parts of the planet, surrounding itself with vibrant plant life. It stretches out its extendable arms before it performs rain-summoning dances to make them more effective.

entry: POKENAME看似无害植物，全身却由耐风化的轻彩金属构成。“花朵”轻转吸日光，可没人懂为何模仿光合作用。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME may appear to be a harmless plant, but its entire body is crafted from lightweight, coloured metal that resists weathering. Its 'blossoms' rotate gently to absorb sunlight, though no one is sure why it mimics photosynthesis.

entry: POKENAME不停光合作用，每天至少要16小时日照，才最鲜艳。雨季很少见。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME constantly photosynthesizes and needs at least 16 hours of sunlight to reach peak vibrancy. During rainy seasons, it's rarely seen.

entry: POKENAME身上羽状部分，其实是叶片。泡成茶，可迅速治好多数呼吸系统疾病。
author: .izik
source: The feather-like portions of POKENAME's body are actually leaves. A tea made from these leaves can quickly cure most respiratory-based ailments.

entry: POKENAME亮日下休息数小时，展尾多吸太阳能。光不够就补吃树果，可花瓣会变淡，直到再吸到光。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME lounge in bright daylight for several hours, spreading their tails to absorb more of the sun's energy. When they cannot get enough light, they supplement their diet with berries, though their petals grow pale until light is absorbed again.

entry: POKENAME爱群居、爱太阳。游走时毛很快沾满大量花粉种子，一抖落，附近到来年春天必然繁花盛草。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are social pack Pokémon that love the sun. Their fur traps tons of pollen and seeds very quickly while they roam around; when they finally shake it all loose, the nearby area will no doubt bloom with flora by next spring.

entry: POKENAME歌舞让多数生物入睡，却给周围植物带来活力。听演出睡着者，常醒在盛开的花丛间。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's song and dance puts most creatures to sleep, while having a revitalizing effect on plants around it. Those that fall asleep to its performance often wake up surrounded by blooming flowers.

entry: POKENAME用花瓣装饰耳，偏爱自己歌舞催开的花。群聚时常换花瓣，让装饰环更缤纷。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME decorates its ears with petals from flowers, favoring those it has helped bloom with its song and dance. When gathered in groups, it often trades petals to make its decorative loops more colorful.

entry: POKENAME以把花种传遍世界著称，夏天最活跃。早晨吸阳光，再起飞飘过草地，种下绚丽花朵的种子。
author: quackquackattack
source: Known for spreading flower seeds throughout the world, POKENAME are most active in the summer. They soak up sunlight in the morning before taking off to float above fields of grass, planting seeds that blossom into vibrant flowers.

entry: POKENAME晒久了，就有刺鼻气味。香气黏在周身凝胶，让它变明亮黄绿色。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a pungent scent that comes from long exposure to the sunlight. The aroma they produce clings to the gel around their body, turning the gel into a bright chartreuse color.

entry: POKENAME休息就藏叶堆。受扰常惊慌，高声吱叫，再逃走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hide in piles of leaves whenever they rest. When disturbed, they often panic and release a high-pitched squeak before escaping.

entry: POKENAME经过花时蹭一蹭，帮农人传粉。它最爱的零食之一是哞哞乳酪，农人用来收买它留田里。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME helps farmers spread pollen by rubbing against flowers when it passes by. One of its favorites snacks is Moomoo Cheese, which farmers use to bribe it to stay in their fields.

entry: POKENAME用刺附树，吸收阳光。美丽红花可采来泡茶，很受欢迎。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME uses its thorns to attach itself to trees as it absorbs sunlight. Its beautiful red flowers can be collected and made into a popular tea.

entry: POKENAME由扭缠编织的根构成，能承受许多强攻。它却极胆小，宁愿缩进自己体内，等袭击者走，也不迎战。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's body is made out of twisting woven roots, making it able to withstand many strong attacks. It is extremely timid, preferring to retreat into itself and wait for the attacker to leave rather than face them in battle.

entry: POKENAME爱热带日光浴，下雨就翻腾，试着把太阳带回来。烦躁时会放电。
author: the_fireplace
source: POKENAME enjoys sunbathing in the tropics, and flops about if it is rainy in an effort to bring back the sun. It emits a shock when agitated.

entry: POKENAME以海滩上的欢快舞姿闻名。它一跳，周围的大家，也都神清气爽。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME is known for its cheerful dance that it performs on beaches. When it dances, everyone around feels refreshed.

entry: POKENAME在花田欢舞，裹满花粉花瓣，再回巢，与同伴分享富营养的收获。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME will dance merrily in flower fields, coating themselves in pollen and flower petals. They will then travel back to their nests, sharing the nutritious pollen and petals with their nestmates.

entry: POKENAME身花的蜜，闻着像花束与罗子果混合。片栗镇一家美容院，把这种香气用进洗发水。
author: .izik
source: The nectar that comes from the flowers on POKENAME's body smells like a mixture of posies and Rindo Berries. There is a salon in Arrowroot Town that uses this fragrance in their shampoo.

entry: POKENAME与花店合作，制美丽花束与插花。性格放松，容易相处，花大量时间微调花朵，求完美花束。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME works alongside florists to create beautiful bouquets and flower arrangements. Its relaxed personality makes it easy to work with, and it spends a lot of time making minor adjustments to flowers to create the perfect bouquet.

entry: POKENAME爱收玫瑰，把大部分精力用于养护。它会送给新情侣，象征爱情。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves to collect roses, spending most of its energy to keep them healthy. It will give these roses to new couples as a symbol of their love.

entry: POKENAME身体由有机废料与盆栽土组成。手臂放的烟初闻玫瑰香，很快转酸，呛得人难呼吸。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's body is made up from organic waste and pot soil. The fumes it expels from its arm smell rosy, but quickly sour into choking gas.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，叶片散出烤哈密果的淡香。偶尔找到来历不明的种子，就囤起来。
author: .izik
source: While POKENAME dances, its leaves give off the soft scent of baked Hondew Berries. It occasionally finds seeds from an unknown source and hoards them.

entry: POKENAME角顶彩花吸引虫属性宝可梦。靠近就先黏液困住，再浇高度腐蚀的黏液。
author: mepp.
source: The colorful flowers on top of POKENAME's horns attract Bug-type Pokémon. Once they draw near, POKENAME ensnares them in slime before dousing them in a highly corrosive mucus.

entry: POKENAME鲜花香气宜人，让周围精神振奋。据说古文明将它留在身边，方便磨面粉等工作。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's vibrant flowers produce a pleasant scent that uplifts the spirits of those around it. It is thought that ancient civilizations kept POKENAME close, as they were useful for tasks like milling flour.

entry: POKENAME与霸王花不同，白天最活跃。头花恶臭，快乐蹦跳旋转时，臭味反而更浓。
author: bobosmith01
source: Unlike Vileplume, POKENAME is most active during the day. The flower atop its head carries a foul smell that only becomes more potent as POKENAME happily skips and twirls around.

entry: POKENAME走动，12条腿互擦，发出规律沙沙声。这些腿能牢牢锚住抵抗潮水，不被卷出海。
author: pizzarcato
source: When POKENAME walks, its 12 legs brush against each other to create a rhythmic shuffling sound. These legs allow it to anchor itself securely against the tide, ensuring it won't get swept out to sea.

entry: POKENAME飞时，翼叶落地。厨师因淡薄荷香而采集。
author: .izik
source: The leaves on POKENAME's wings fall to the ground while it flies. Culinarians gather these for their mild minty scent.

entry: POKENAME花中产深红蜜，吸引传粉者。附近人家采来作糖浆。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produces a deep crimson nectar from flowers that draws in pollinators. People who live around POKENAME harvest this nectar to use as syrup.

entry: POKENAME住热带海滩，友善地在花旁挪步跳舞。可一碰头上铲子，就生出沙触手，抓人扔向远方。
author: sk372
source: An inhabitant of tropical beaches, POKENAME is a friendly creature that shuffles and dances near where flowers grow. Touching the shovel on its head, however, causes it to generate sandy tentacles that grab a person and throw them into the distance.

entry: POKENAME整天晒太阳，滋养背花。夜里挖吃能找到最肥的土。
author: .jerden
source: To nourish the flowers growing on its back, POKENAME spends all day lying in the sun. At night, it digs up and eats the richest soil it can find.

entry: POKENAME嚎叫，尾上大花便撒闪亮粉。粉有药效，可过量接触会引发剧烈抽搐。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME howls, the large flower on its tail releases a shimmering pink powder. This powder has medicinal properties, but excessive exposure can cause violent seizures.

entry: POKENAME在花田疯狂跳舞嚎叫，扬起花粉，滋养土壤，让附近植物繁盛。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME howls while dancing wildly in flower fields. These frenzied movements kick up pollen, enriching the soil and helping nearby flora thrive.

entry: POKENAME歌声能让周围草木与动物繁盛。据说会在严重污染的地方现身。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's songs encourage flora and fauna surrounding them to thrive. It is said to appear in highly polluted areas.

entry: POKENAME见于葱茏森林，飞时撒香瓣。甜花香让敌人安然陷入梦幻般的恍惚。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are found in verdant forests, scattering fragrant petals as they fly. The sweet aroma from their flowers lulls foes into a peaceful, dreamlike trance.

entry: POKENAME背花催它寻找温暖晴处。到了就绕圈跳，让所有叶片都晒足。
author: .jerden
source: The flower on POKENAME's back compels it to seek out warm and sunny places. Once it gets there, it dances in circles, giving all of its leaves plenty of light.

entry: POKENAME用花束魔杖复活枯死植物。工作时齐舞，立刻安抚其他生物。严冬还在舞中用火，暖和困在风雪中的生命。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME uses its bouquet wand to revive dead plants. As they work, these Pokémon dance in unison, having an immediate calming effect on creatures. In the harsh winters, they use flames in their dance, heating anything stuck in the elements.

entry: 夏季，POKENAME飘着哼曲，所到之处长红花、盛放。可这些花，一夜间又神秘消失。
author: shadeofblu
source: During the summer months POKENAME will float around humming a tune that will cause red flowers to grow and bloom wherever it goes. These flowers will mysteriously disappear overnight.

entry: POKENAME头上椰子存各种树果汁。发酵了，就聚起来分享，欢喜地旋转跳舞，虽然不太协调。
author: fancyskunk
source: POKENAME store assorted berry juices in the coconuts atop their heads. When the juice ferments, they gather together to share drinks with each other. These gatherings are filled with jubilant, if uncoordinated, twirling and dancing.

entry: POKENAME出土晒美花，一下雨就再躲地下。常见于别墅与住宅花园。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME emerges from the ground to let its beautiful flowers absorb sunlight, but if it starts raining, it hides underground again. This Pokémon can often be found in the gardens of villas and houses.

entry: POKENAME乐于挖土，腾出栽种花卉鳞茎的地方，很受园丁欢迎。过程里还有找到稀有古钱的神奇本领。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular Pokémon with gardeners as they will happily dig out soil to make space for flower bulbs to be planted. They have an uncanny knack for finding rare antique coins in the process.

entry: POKENAME不狩猎，懒躺田里晒太阳。湿度高的日子，身花能长到平时两倍大。
author: .izik
source: Instead of hunting, POKENAME will lazily lounge in fields soaking in the sun's light. During days with high humidity, the flowers on its body will grow up to twice their normal size.

entry: POKENAME不停从头产花粉，缓解头痛，却让花粉过敏者头痛。有幼童的父母常带它来玩，据说花粉增强免疫健康。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME constantly produce pollen from their heads to soothe their headaches, which make them a headache for people who are allergic to pollen. Parents of young children often bring POKENAME to play as their pollen is said to boost immune health.

entry: POKENAME操纵附近植物成波浪状，骑着移动。常见于奇异植物繁茂的热带。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME manipulates nearby flora to make a wave-like shape, riding it as a way of transportation. It's commonly found in tropical areas with lush and exotic plant life.

entry: POKENAME爱跳舞，观众笑它动作笨拙，就暴怒。花瓣入药或泡茶能安抚别人，对自己脾气却似乎无用。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME loves to dance but flies into a rage when onlookers laugh at its somewhat awkward movements. The petals of its flowers have a calming effect on others when used in medicines or teas but do not seem to help POKENAME's temper.

entry: POKENAME凭宽翼，在空中优美起舞，散出阵阵甜美花香。一天最热的时候，它格外活跃，因为阳光能增强它的招式。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can dance majestically in flight thanks to its broad wings, releasing a sweet floral fragrance all around as it moves. It is particularly active during the hottest hours of the day, as the presence of the sun strengthens its moves.

entry: POKENAME正午阳光下共舞，分花给附近宝可梦。花虽美，闻着却有股水味，令许多生物不喜欢。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME dance together under the midday sun, sharing their flowers with nearby Pokémon. Despite their beauty, the flowers POKENAME produce have a watery scent to them that are off-putting to many.

entry: POKENAME把精神能量导过花触角，以优雅舞蹈使敌人恍惚。花瓣泛能量光，知识越多，开得越明亮。
author: lilithxincarnate
source: POKENAME channels psychic energy through its floral antennae, using graceful dances to lull foes into a trance. Its petals shimmer with power, blooming brighter the more knowledge it gains.

entry: 野生POKENAME靠舒缓舞姿沟通，很易懂人和宝可梦的肢体语言。它寻找不能说话的人，用藤蔓比训练家教的手语，传达需求。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME communicate in the wild through calming dance moves, and easily pick up on Pokémon and human body language. They seek out humans who are unable to speak, and help communicate their needs with their vines signing Trainer-taught sign language.

entry: POKENAME嘴里散出可口花香，吸引猎物。口中叶片吃下，会极度困倦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a delicious floral scent from its mouth to attract prey. The leaves in its mouth can cause extreme drowsiness if consumed.

entry: POKENAME每早收叶上露水，存进捕虫瓶深处。露水富营养，加快生长，让色彩更鲜艳。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects dew from its leaves each morning, storing it deep within its pitcher. This nutrient-rich dew accelerates its growth and enhances its vibrant coloration.

entry: POKENAME的体色可能随栖息环境略微改变。比如，土壤和水的盐度较高，便会偏黄；低盐地区的个体，则会略带蓝色。
author: bobosmith01
