source: The hue of POKENAME's body may slightly alter depending on the conditions of its habitat. For instance, higher salinity soil and water lead to yellow tints, while POKENAME in areas with lower salt content are slightly more blue.

entry: POKENAME虽是水生，强壮灵活的肢体却让它陆上行动出奇优雅。不过，唯有明亮晴天才能这样。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's powerful and flexible limbs allow the otherwise aquatic Pokémon to traverse on land with surprising grace. However, it can only do so when the skies are bright and sunny.

entry: POKENAME虽在某些地方受崇敬，平日却几乎什么也不做，只偶尔滚两下，进行光合作用。
author: rawthorn
source: Although revered in some regions, POKENAME have been observed to do very little. They occasionally roll around to photosynthesize.

entry: POKENAME孵出还站不起来，靠双亲保护，直到叶片光合积够能量。头上红花随年岁更加鲜艳。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are unable to stand after hatching, relying on their parents for protection until they photosynthesize enough energy through their leaves. The red flowers on their head become more vivid as they age.

entry: POKENAME阳光下最活跃，奔过草地，身后留下花瓣。人工饲养需大量空间，才健康强健。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are most active when the sun is out, leaving behind petals as they gallop through fields of grass. Those held in captivity need lots of space to keep their bodies fit and healthy.

entry: POKENAME坚韧，哪怕精疲力尽，仍向目标奔去。多年间，坚定决心激励了许多人。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are hardy Pokémon that will continue galloping towards their goal even when exhausted. Their fierce determination has become an inspiration to many people over the years.

entry: POKENAME奔跑，蹄落处就长偏红花朵。太阳越热，越有精神。
author: fiordaliso
source: As it runs, POKENAME leaves behind a trail of reddish flowers that sprout where its hooves touch the ground. The hotter the sun, the more energized it feels.

entry: POKENAME奔跑，蹄落处就长偏红花朵。太阳越热，越有精神。
author: fiordaliso
source: As it runs, POKENAME leaves behind a trail of reddish flowers that sprout where its hooves touch the ground. The hotter the sun, the more energized it feels.

entry: POKENAME傍晚在岸边跳极慢、有条理的舞。跳完就睡在沙上。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs a very slow methodical dance on the shoreline during the evenings. When it finishes its dance, it will fall asleep in the sand.

entry: POKENAME编花项链，象征与关爱者的牵绊。据说收到花环，就代表是有爱心、负责任的训练家。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME weave flowers into decorative necklaces that represent their bonds and connections to those they care about. It is said that receiving a wreath from a POKENAME is a sign of being a caring and responsible Trainer.

entry: POKENAME炮中有硬如石的种子，以加压水发射。太久不发，种子便会发芽开花。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its cannons contain rock-hard seeds that it blasts out with pressurized water. If POKENAME goes too long without firing its seeds, they sprout into flowers.

entry: POKENAME训练家常说，总有被盯的寒意，连睡觉也一样。人们还在争论，更催眠的究竟是目光，还是摇摆花瓣。
author: robobunnybutt
source: Trainers of POKENAME often describe the chilling sensation of being watched at all times, even while they sleep. Many people still debate which is more hypnotizing - its gaze or its swaying petals.

entry: 人们相信POKENAME能控天气。其实它只是催眠，让人觉得、相信天气已变成自己想要的样子。
author: laughing_dan
source: People believe POKENAME can control the weather, when in reality it hypnotises people into feeling and believing the weather has changed to what they want it to be.

entry: POKENAME尾巴伸出骨刺，能像连枷般甩尾。玩得粗野，头骨常因此开裂。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have boney protrusions that stick out of their tail that allow them to fling their tail like a flail. Their skulls often end up cracked because of the rough play they engage in.

entry: POKENAME胃口大，容易过食。保持健康体重，就得鼓励爱玩的天性。抛接游戏或追着玩，都能快乐减掉多余体重。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are prone to overeating because of their voracious appetites. To maintain a healthy weight, it is important to encourage their playful selves. A simple game of catch or chasing your POKENAME is a fun way to help them lose excess weight.

entry: POKENAME爱用角戳破海中游客的浮具，恶作剧完就用扁尾高速逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME loves using its horn to pop floating tools from beachgoers in the ocean. It does this as a prank, using its flat tail to flee at high speed after the deed is done.

entry: POKENAME靠敏耳侦察领地。谁擅闯，就用钻角穷追不舍。
author: lampent12
source: Using their sensitive ears, POKENAME scouts their territory. If anyone is found trespassing, POKENAME will relentlessly pursue the offender with their drill horn.

entry: POKENAME约12只一群，大耳能听见远方其他群体的声音。相遇很欢乐，彼此分树果、玩耍。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME gather together in flocks of about a dozen individuals, their large ears allowing them to hear other flocks across great distances. Interactions between flocks are joyful, with individuals sharing berries and playing.

entry: POKENAME爱上台，是想成名的音乐家热门伙伴。它天生懂配合歌曲的舞蹈，乐于参加音乐会。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME love to perform on stage and are popular companions for aspiring celebrity musicians. They have an innate understanding of dance numbers for songs and will happily take part in concerts.

entry: 肚脐岩附近常见POKENAME群，靠水边游时，触角上的球在水面起伏。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's schools are often spotted near Navel Rock, where the sphere on their antennae bobs at the surface as they swim near the water's edge.

entry: POKENAME住水草间，吃藻与小寄生虫。要逃敌，就迅速鼓大尾部浮囊，升到安全水面。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live on underwater weeds, feeding on algae and small parasites. When they need to escape from a predator they rapidly inflate the float on their tails, rising to the surface to safety.

entry: POKENAME爱池溪嬉戏，玩彼此尾巴，在浅水追逐。遗传构成极不稳定，适应性很高，随环境变形态。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME love to frolic in ponds and streams, playing with one another's tails and chasing each other through the shallows. They have a very unstable genetic makeup and are highly adaptable, changing form depending on their environment.

entry: 海岸边，常能看见POKENAME比着彼此的壳。据说，那些住着的壳，原属于古代宝可梦。
author: captainzscourge
source: POKENAME often is found along shorelines comparing their shells to other POKENAME. The shell it inhabits is said to be that of an ancient Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME住水草间，吃藻与小寄生虫。要逃敌，就迅速鼓大尾部浮囊，升到安全水面。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live on underwater weeds, feeding on algae and small parasites. When they need to escape from a predator they rapidly inflate the float on their tails, rising to the surface to safety.

entry: 它靠尾球弹跳行进，一跳数百英尺。若感到被看，立刻瞬间移动走。
author: bostroms
source: It travels around by bouncing on the ball on its tail, covering hundreds of feet in a single bounce.  If it senses it is being watched, it will teleport away immediately.

entry: POKENAME颈部珠状树液腺，有甜甘草香。它把树液抹在球尾，便于抓牢，因为水上得抱尾巴浮着。
author: quackquackattack
source: The beads of sap glands around POKENAME's neck have a sweet licorice smell. POKENAME coat their bulbous tail in this sap to make it easier to hold onto, as POKENAME hold onto their tails to remain afloat on water.

entry: POKENAME采各种树果，特别爱藻根果。常误把尾巴当橙橙果，结果绕圈跑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME forage for all kinds of berries and have a particular fondness for Kelpsy Berries. They often mistake their tail for an Oran Berry and end up running in circles.

entry: POKENAME是夜行杂食者，多见小湖河边。时间感无可挑剔，所有个体本能地在同一日期、同一小时迁徙。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a nocturnal omnivore most often found by small lakes and rivers. It has an impeccable sense of time; all POKENAME migrate on the same date and hour instinctually.

entry: POKENAME水下生活，却需空气呼吸，便用细网兜气泡带着。紧急时给尾部浮囊充气，升上水面。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lives underwater but needs air to breathe, using a finely meshed web to capture air bubbles that it can take with it. In emergencies, it inflates its tail floats with gas and rises to the surface.

entry: POKENAME在河里和空中都能捕猎，身上的毛发具有防水作用。一离开水面，毛发就会变干，使它能立刻起飞，不被湿毛拖累。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME hunts both in rivers and in the air, aided by its water-repellent fur. It will be dry as soon as it leaves the water, enabling it to immediately take flight without being weighed down by wet fur.

entry: 月夜，POKENAME聚岸边，向天空吹心形泡泡，闪如星。传闻情侣若目睹，便注定永为灵魂伴侣。
author: porterofgames
source: On moonlit nights, POKENAME can be seen gathering by shorelines as they blow heart-shaped bubbles into the sky that twinkle like stars. Rumor has it that couples who witness this phenomenon are destined to be soulmates forevermore.

entry: POKENAME身黏蛋壳碎片，摇摆走。对训练家极忠，甚至鄙视其他训练家。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME waddle around with pieces of eggshell stuck to their bodies. They are fiercely loyal to their Trainer, to the point where they show disdain for other Trainers.

entry: 训练家若发现POKENAME漂河，能在不弄醒的情况下捞出，它就终生依恋这人。尾中油有安抚作用。
author: lampent12
source: If a Trainer finds a POKENAME drifting down a river and can lift them from the water without waking them up, POKENAME will imprint on them for life. The oil in their tail has calming effects.

entry: 湖边常能看见成群的这种宝可梦，吃草、吃树果，或浮在水中取乐。羊毛会渐渐失去防水性，必须定期修剪，否则毛层会发霉。
author: bobosmith01
source: Herds of this Pokémon can be spotted by lakes, feasting on grass and berries or floating in water for recreation. Its wool loses its waterproof properties over time, so it must be routinely trimmed, lest mold start to grow in its woolen coat.

entry: POKENAME很受城都年轻女子欢迎。野生各种气候天气都见，尾球的光泽、大小可反映健康。
author: bobosmith01
source: Popular among younger women in Johto, wild POKENAME can be spotted out and about in many different climates and weather conditions. The luster and size of the orb on their tail can be an indicator of their health.

entry: POKENAME比未融合的玛力露浮力大得多，还能将空气留在油润的毛发中。只要愿意，它们便能惬意地坐在河面上，看着四周景色缓缓流过。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are far more buoyant than unfused Marill, and are able to trap air within their oily fur. They are so buoyant that they can sit happily on the surface of rivers if they want to, watching the world drift by.

entry: 野生POKENAME友善保护玛力露。身体小软，却有惊人韧性与力量，常打以为好对付的敌人一个措手不及。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME acts as a friendly bodyguard for Marill in the wild. Its small and soft body packs a surprising amount of resilience and power, often taking aggressors expecting an easy fight by surprise.

entry: POKENAME在森林溪流边，彼此欢快起舞，用复杂的动作交流。它们想让聚会保持秘密，若碰巧被人看见，就会僵住不动，试图藏好自己。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME cheerfully dance amongst one another around forest streams, performing complex moves to communicate with one another. Their gatherings are meant to be secret and, in an effort to hide, they will freeze up if someone happens to see them.

entry: POKENAME大群平静浮在河湖。风暴吹来时，它们高举叶子，被风从水上卷起，成大片云般漂向新家。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME float peacefully atop the surface of rivers and lakes, clustering together in large groups. When a storm blows through they will lift their leaves high and are plucked from the water, being blown to new homes in large clouds.

entry: POKENAME尾巴密度较大，开始漂浮所需温度比身体更高。18至25摄氏度时，尾巴像锚，身体随微风摇摆。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's tail begins floating at a higher temperature than the rest of its body because it is denser. If the temperature is between 18 C and 25 C, its tail acts like an anchor while its body sways with the breeze.

entry: POKENAME常在田里浇植物。身体很弹，靠体重与油毛，也能浮水。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME are often used in fields to water the plants. They're also very bouncy and can float in water due to their weight and oily coat.

entry: POKENAME常在田里浇植物。身体很弹，靠体重与油毛，也能浮水。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME are often used in fields to water the plants. They're also very bouncy and can float in water due to their weight and oily coat.

entry: POKENAME偏爱水果烤饼，胜过其他甜食。软糯黏润的口感，咀嚼不伤敏感牙齿。吃完会打盹，帮助消化。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME prefer cobblers over other types of sweets, as the soft, gooey texture allows them to chew without hurting their sensitive teeth. When they finish eating, they take naps to help with digestion.

entry: POKENAME用尾舀泥，拍身防干。裹好后，就吃附近灌木，保持养分与水分。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its tail to scoop up mud, then slaps it on its body to avoid drying out. Once coated, it will snack on any nearby brush, staying nourished and hydrated.

entry: POKENAME覆防水毛，只为自己认为值得的训练家下水。
author: notsaying.
source: Covered in water-repellent fur, a POKENAME will only enter a body of water for a Trainer it considers worthy.

entry: POKENAME防水的毛与浮尾很适合河流生活。常在急流边嬉戏，顺流游下，再沿岸跑回高处，重新来过。
author: katieplaysgames
source: With its waterproof fur and buoyant tail, POKENAME is well suited to its river home. They can often be found playing with one another near rapids, swimming down the fast-flowing water and scampering back up the banks to swim down again.

entry: POKENAME沿水面滑行，轻盈又不易沾水，始终不会浸入水中。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME can be found sliding along the surface of bodies of water. It is hydrophobic and lightweight, so it never immerses.

entry: POKENAME讨厌毛发不够湿润，从不远离水域。一天中的大部分时间，它都靠浮力十足的尾巴，漂在水面上。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hates it when its fur isn't constantly moist and is never seen far from a body of water. It spends most of the day floating on top of the water with its buoyant tail.

entry: POKENAME高速潜入池塘，抓取小型鱼类宝可梦为食。猎物一抓稳，它们便迅速鼓起尾端的浮囊，火箭般冲回水面，脱离险境。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feed on small fish Pokémon by diving at high speed into ponds to grab at their prey. Once they have their prey secured, they rapidly inflate the float at the end of their tail, rocketing back to the surface and to safety.

entry: POKENAME可爱地表演，自以为无伤玩笑，却因不懂规矩，常成麻烦。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME puts on a cute display, and while it may believe itself to be acting in harmless fun, will often become a nuisance because it doesn't understand good behavior.

entry: POKENAME最爱两件事：吃蜂蜜和游泳。它大吃特吃，常弄得满身蜂蜜，再下水游个痛快，顺便洗净这一身狼藉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's two favorite things are honey and swimming. It gorges itself on the sweet substance to the point of covering its body, then it goes swimming to both play and clean up the mess it's made.

entry: POKENAME壳中存不同温度的水。历史上的干旱时，它曾给困境中的人饮水。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME's shell stores water at varying temperatures. During droughts throughout history, POKENAME have been known to provide struggling individuals with drinking water.

entry: POKENAME把空气兜进浓厚防水毛，供水下呼吸。它靠这气源在河床翻找小食物，一次能潜数十分钟。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME trap air within their thick, water-repellent fur to allow them to breathe underwater. They rely on their air supply whilst digging through riverbeds for morsels of food and can remain submerged for dozens of minutes at a time.

entry: POKENAME随海浪漂，只有往尾巴装更多零食时才出水。羽毛防水耐污，很适合它爱吃、容易弄脏身体的人类零食。
author: vic1312
source: They float about on ocean waves, only coming up from the water to gather more snacks into their tail. POKENAME are covered in water-repellent feathers that are also stain-resistant, helpful with their preference for messy human snacks.

entry: POKENAME每天在浮具上晒数小时太阳。哪怕海浪把它冲出海，也照样懒散。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME will laze in the sun on its floatie for hours in a day. Even if a wave washes POKENAME out to sea, it will continue to slack.

entry: POKENAME随海浪漂，只有往尾巴装更多零食时才出水。羽毛防水耐污，很适合它爱吃、容易弄脏身体的人类零食。
author: vic1312
source: They float about on ocean waves, only coming up from the water to gather more snacks into their tail. POKENAME are covered in water-repellent feathers that are also stain-resistant, helpful with their preference for messy human snacks.

entry: POKENAME跃出海浪时，尾球绕圈转。它与同群伙伴竞速，让大海充满欢乐比赛。
author: .izik
source: The ball on POKENAME's tail spins in a circle as it jumps out of waves. It races with others in its pod, creating a joyful competition in the open sea.

entry: POKENAME极力保护认定的伙伴，也爱和它们打闹。受训后，会在集装箱船上捉害兽、救落水船员。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME fiercely protects those it considers its pack, with whom it loves to roughhouse. It is trained to help on container ships by hunting vermin and rescuing crew that fall overboard.

entry: 常能看见POKENAME用象鼻拨弄尾上的球。有时它用力抛出，却忘了球还连着尾巴，结果将自己带得翻倒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can often be seen using its trunk to play with the ball on its tail. Sometimes it will fling the ball forcefully, forgetting that it is attached to its tail, and causing it to tumble over.

entry: POKENAME爱表演、爱当焦点，很受参加华丽大赛的训练家欢迎。动作虽生涩，潜力却大，用心训练就能发挥。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME love to perform and be the centre of attention, making them popular for Trainers taking part in Pokémon contests. They are unpractised in their movements but have great potential that can be brought out with dedicated training.

entry: POKENAME沿河岸筑巢，在芦苇间养育幼崽。游出去捕猎时，它们靠宽阔的颈褶和浮力十足的尾巴，保持在水面。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their nests along river banks, raising their young amongst the reeds. When they swim out to hunt, they rely on their broad hood and buoyant tail to keep themselves at the water's surface.

entry: POKENAME最早的目击记录，来自关都偏远地区。起初以为是皮卡丘未知的奇异进化，后来研究证实并非如此。
author: sk372
source: The first recorded sighting of POKENAME was reported in a remote part of Kanto. It was originally thought to be a strange unseen evolution of Pikachu before further research confirmed otherwise.

entry: 它总想用水中杂耍取悦人和宝可梦。经验不足，常出滑稽错误，结果大家都逗它。不表演时，多在河边整理发型。
author: fiordaliso
source: It always tries to entertain Pokémon and people with aquatic juggling acts, but its inexperience often leads to funny mistakes and everyone ends up teasing it. When it is not performing, it can usually be found fixing its hairstyle on riverbanks.

entry: POKENAME尾巴1秒内能伸出超过6英尺。尾尖很黏，用来抓住、制住虫属性猎物。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its tail can extend over 6 feet in a second. The tip of its tail is sticky, so POKENAME uses it to capture and restrain Bug-type prey.

entry: POKENAME从皮肤排泡泡。水下受威胁，就造遮视的泡泡云，分散袭击者注意，趁机逃走。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME expels bubbles through its skin. If threatened underwater, it creates an obscuring bubble cloud to distract attackers while it escapes.

entry: POKENAME见于充满幸福感的水域附近。油尾巴能让它浮着。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME is found near bodies of water where there's happiness in abundance. Its oily tail allows it to float.

entry: POKENAME尾巴容易干，常浸池里补水。潜水时，大耳专注听捕食者动静。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tail dries out easily, so it regularly dips it in ponds to stay hydrated. It listens intently with its large ears for predators while submerged.

entry: POKENAME身体大部分能伪装，唯独尾巴不行。蓝尾能蜷球或伸开，却无法变色配合其余身体。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of camouflaging most of their body except for their tails. Their blue tail can be curled into a ball or stretched out, but they cannot change its color to match the rest of their body.

entry: POKENAME灰圆石哪怕完全浸水也干燥。它住沉船，朝靠近者连吐泡泡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's round grey stone stays dry even when fully submerged. It makes its home in sunken boats, spitting bursts of bubbles at anyone who draws close.

entry: POKENAME浮在暖水，用充油尾作浮具。身体留水下，大嘴咬任何进入范围的鱼。
author: darklordarbitur
source: POKENAME can be found floating in warm waters, using its oil-filled tail as a flotation device. Its body sits below the surface, snapping at any fish that come in range with its large mouth.

entry: POKENAME在河床找食物，用背上植物控浮力。花能快速光合，充满氧气泡。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME root around for food along river beds, controlling their buoyancy through the plant growing on their back. The flower of the plant can rapidly photosynthesise, filling with bubbles of oxygen.

entry: POKENAME头上水泡看似脆弱，其实是无法穿透的坚实钻石。圆顶上几乎看不出的裂痕，是荣誉标志，说明这只恐龙是群中受敬的领袖。
author: beatdoof
source: Deceptively fragile in appearance, the water-like bubble atop POKENAME's head is actually solid, impenetrable diamond. A dome marred by barely discernible cracks is a badge of honor, marking the dinosaur as a revered leader of its pack.

entry: POKENAME将尾巴挥到威胁袭来的方向，靠宽大的金属板承受攻击。尾板还能兼作便携的遮阳伞，让它在烈日下乘凉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swing their tail into the path of any threats, relying on the broad metal plate to absorb the blows coming their way. Their tail plate can also double as portable shade, allowing POKENAME to cool off if the sun gets too hot.

entry: POKENAME懒极，连家周围淹水，也不肯出力。水下睡觉与陆上一样舒服。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is extremely lazy, refusing to exert its strength even as the area around its home floods. It naps just as comfortably underwater as it does on land.

entry: POKENAME察觉大飓风将至，就游向翻腾水流，出奇轻松地穿行巨浪。
author: .izik
source: When it senses a massive hurricane approaching, POKENAME swims toward the churning currents. It navigates the violent waves with surprising ease.

entry: POKENAME在溪底等待猎物靠近，再用锐利的门牙咬住。它力气很大，能牢牢抓住猎物，轻松拖到身边。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME waits at the bottom of creeks for prey to get close before biting at them with its sharp front tooth. It drags its catch in with ease, using its strength to hold onto the prey.

entry: POKENAME全身软羽防水，便于在冷水游。圆尾很重，可击退从水下身后来袭的敌人。
author: sk372
source: Soft and water-resistant feathers coat POKENAME's body, which aid it in swimming through chilly waters. Its round tail is quite heavy, used to knock away attackers coming up from behind while underwater.

entry: POKENAME尾端湿球帮助夏季控温。它常把球泡池，释放平静气息，让其他生物保持距离。
author: .izik
source: The soggy orb at the end of POKENAME's tail helps regulate its body temperature during summer. It regularly soaks the orb in ponds while releasing a calming aura to keep others at a distance.

entry: 许多家里，POKENAME既像宠物，也像摆设。火大多无害，只散出舒服光芒与温暖。
author: dylonk25
source: In many homes, POKENAME occupies a role somewhere between pet and decoration. Its flame is mostly harmless, producing only a pleasant glow and gentle warmth.

entry: POKENAME尾油给腹内火供燃料，产生高热。吐的水滚烫，足以烫伤靠太近的一切。
author: .izik
source: The oil in POKENAME's tails fuels the flames inside its belly, allowing it to generate intense heat. The water it spits is scalding hot, capable of burning anything that gets too close.

entry: POKENAME战斗时极敏捷，以弹尾为支点四处跳跃，扰乱敌人。主要只是体形太小，才没能威胁更多宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are remarkably agile in fights, using their springy tails as launching platforms to leap around and confound their opponents. Their small statures are the main thing preventing them from posing serious threats to more Pokémon.

entry: 抱得太紧，皮毛便会迸出一阵火星。多余静电虽无害，却能让人的头发根根竖起。
author: .izik
source: If hugged too tightly, this Pokémon's fur will let loose a flurry of sparks. While harmless, this excess static can cause a person's hair to stand on end.

entry: POKENAME住岩石河床间的土里，总在玩。头像气球，能张大，造比自己还大的泡泡。
author: alindrome
source: POKENAME lives in the dirt among rocky riverbeds, always playing. Its head is like a balloon that can open wide to create bubbles bigger than itself.

entry: POKENAME常住在生活废水管中，在排水形成的瀑布里玩耍。它们挤过管道，在U形弯管里产卵。幼崽孵出后先以碎屑为食，等强壮到能游泳，才与父母团聚。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Greywater drains are often home to POKENAME, who play in the discharge's waterfalls. They squeeze through pipes to lay eggs in u-bends. When the young hatch, they feed on debris until they're strong enough to swim and unite with their parents.

entry: POKENAME尾巴与身体充氦，在天空飘得出奇快。它收河面浮叶当食物，安然漂空。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tail and body are filled with helium, allowing it to float at surprising speeds across the skies. It collects leaves floating in rivers for food, drifting peacefully through the air.

entry: POKENAME靠水生活，吃些水生猎物。尾部的圆球，在水中能充当刹车，让它很快就能重新起飞。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME live near bodies of water, subsisting on aquatic prey. The baubles of its tails act as water brakes, allowing it to quickly take off again.

entry: POKENAME多刺的身体密度很高，因此很快就会沉到水底。它用沉重、多刺的尾巴，敲开大舌贝等硬壳水生生灵的壳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sinks to the bottom of water quickly thanks to the high density of its spiked body. It uses its spiky, heavy tail to crack open the shells of Shellder and other hard-shelled aquatic denizens.

entry: POKENAME羽毛防水，能漂能游。性情虽温顺，战斗却强悍，对敌人毫不留情地啄。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's feathers are water-repellent, allowing it to float and swim in water. While often docile in nature, they're mighty in battle, pecking mercilessly at the enemy.

entry: POKENAME俯冲向河流，用喙抓取猎物。它们在河岸生火，烹熟食物再吃；若火势蔓延得太开，就会泼水遏制。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME hunt for prey by swooping down onto rivers and grabbing it with their beak. POKENAME start fires on the riverbank to cook food before they eat it, but will splash water onto the flames if it starts to spread too much.

entry: POKENAME看不见，却很听得进鼓励。什么事都能被说动，有时因此交上不靠谱的伙伴。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME can't see, but it listens to encouragement very well. Because it can be convinced to do anything, POKENAME sometimes ends up among sketchy companions.

entry: POKENAME住在潮湿洞窟，潜入水池寻找猎物，找到什么就吸取其血。吸来的血混上翼内油脂，带来惊人的浮力。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME lives in damp caverns. It dives into pools of water in search of prey, and sucks the blood out of anything it finds. The blood it draws from its prey is infused with the oil in its wings making them surprisingly buoyant.

entry: POKENAME住河底，尾巴一被碰，就放强电。大洪水后，常有大群被冲上岸。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives at the bottom of the river and if anything touches its tail, it will deliver a powerful electric shock. After large floods, large groups of POKENAME can be seen washed up on shore.

entry: POKENAME边舞边喷不同图案的水，用水势表达喜悦。舞越有劲，水柱越强。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits water in various patterns while dancing, expressing its joy through the strength of the spray. The more energetic the dance, the more powerful the water jets become.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，捧着尾上光球摇摆。舞完，光球灌注精神能量，还能悬浮一阵。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME holds the orbs on its tails as it sways around during its dances. Once its dance finishes, the orbs will levitate for a time, charged up by POKENAME's psychic energy.

entry: 七之岛沿海常见POKENAME群，咬附近游轮。这好斗行为，让当地船只头痛。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME schools are often seen along the coast of the Sevii Islands, where they bite at nearby cruise ships. This aggressive behavior makes them a nuisance for vessels in the area.

entry: POKENAME身体触感类似加了黄原胶的水。有人推测尾里存着某种化学物质，造成这效果，但未证实。
author: mary_the_jane
source: POKENAME's body has a similar texture to water that has been mixed with xanthan gum. Its tail is theorized to hold some sort of chemical to achieve this, but it has yet to be proven.

entry: POKENAME一见猎物，尾球就渗强毒。既能防御，也能在出击前先制住目标。
author: .izik
source: The sphere on POKENAME's tail leaks a powerful toxin when it sees prey. This serves as both a defense mechanism and a means of subduing its prey before it strikes.

entry: POKENAME满怀冒险心，爱与训练家探索新地方。常先跑去找野生宝可梦，要战要交友，全看心情。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Filled with a sense of adventure, POKENAME loves to explore new lands with its Trainer. They will often run ahead in search of wild Pokémon to battle or befriend, based entirely on their mood.

entry: 它全身覆细小防水鳞片。逃跑速度极快，身后区域变得一尘不染。
author: ggorehoundd
source: This Pokémon is covered in tiny water-repellent scales. When fleeing, it moves at such a high rate of speed, the area left behind is spotless.

entry: POKENAME蓬松的毛能一小团一小团取下，当作甜食享用。若先让毛吸足淡水，它便会将存水化成甜汁，滋味更加甘甜。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's fluffy fur can be removed in small chunks and consumed as a sweet treat. If it is allowed to soak up fresh water beforehand, the sweetness increases as POKENAME's fur turns the stored water into a sugary juice.

entry: 有些嘉年华能见到POKENAME，小宝可梦坐睡莲叶上，通过尾巴改变行进方向。陪玩一场，只想换几颗美味树果。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found at certain carnivals where small Pokémon can ride atop its lily pad and change the direction it goes with its tail. In exchange for a fun time, all it desires is a few delicious berries.

entry: POKENAME喷出的绿水满是霉菌。若长留物体表面，霉菌会凭酸性强烈腐蚀，损坏材料。
author: .izik
source: The water POKENAME spits is green and filled with mold. This mold is highly corrosive if left on a surface too long, capable of damaging materials with its acidic properties.

entry: POKENAME身体防水，尾火却不防。不过不需一直烧，只为威吓才点着。
author: mary_the_jane
source: Though POKENAME's body is hydrophobic, the flame on the tail isn't. However, the tail does not need to stay aflame; it just keeps it lit up for a threat display.

entry: POKENAME球尾中的油，过去用于新婚夜料理，据说带来永恒爱情。其实吃下会引发剧烈腹绞痛。
author: .izik
source: The oil inside POKENAME's ball-like tail was once used for creating dishes on wedding nights, said to bring everlasting love. In reality, it causes severe abdominal cramping when consumed.

entry: POKENAME潜金矿附近河流，搜河床金块。尾巴作浮具，因此绝不会溺水。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME dives into rivers near gold mines, scouring the riverbed for gold nuggets. Its tail acts as a flotation device, so it never drowns.

entry: POKENAME蜷在岸边睡，用重尾球锚住，免得漂走。河畔小镇的孩子常有它作伴，因为尾巴能抵住小水流。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME sleeps by curling near the shore and using the heavy ball on its tail as an anchor, preventing it from drifting away. Children in riverside towns are often accompanied by this Pokémon, as its tail can ward off minor currents.

entry: POKENAME牙痛就常咬球尾，安抚自己，缓解不适，直到痛退。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME regularly gnaws at its ball-like tail if it has a toothache. This soothes it and helps ease the discomfort until the ache subsides.

entry: POKENAME长途旅行后，爱涉浅池放松。夏热时用扁尾扇自己。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love wading in shallow ponds to relax after traveling long distances. To overcome the summer heat, they fan themselves with their flat tails.

entry: POKENAME在险恶海滩陪救生员。浮具加上强臂，让它逆急流快游，迅速把挣扎者拖到安全处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME serve as companions to lifeguards on particularly dangerous beaches. The combination of their float and their powerful arms allows them to swim against strong currents, quickly swimming out to struggling people and pulling them to safety.

entry: POKENAME用坚手打树石训练。危及生命时，能把圆尾当第三条肢体，挥拳攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME train by punching against trees and rocks with their sturdy hands. When they are in life-threatening situations, they can employ the use of their round tail as a third limb to punch with.

entry: POKENAME先用泡泡包身，再沿水面滚。尾巴跟着弹，激起涟漪，或搅动岸沙。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME encase themselves in bubbles before rolling along the surface of water. Their tails bounce along behind them, creating ripples in the water or stirring up sand along the shore.

entry: POKENAME只有与人玩时才真活跃。即使这样，也更爱自己懒着，用超能力来玩。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME are only really active when playing with others. Even then, they prefer using their psychic powers to play while they loaf around.

entry: POKENAME隐形躺湖面，在水下晃玛力露状假器官，引其他宝可梦。猎物一捕住，养分迅速吸干，留下身体沉底。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME lay invisible on the surface of lakes, bobbing their false Marill organ below the water to attract other Pokémon. Once POKENAME has caught prey, their nutrients are absorbed swiftly and their body is left to sink at the bottom of the water.

entry: POKENAME尾端的球体有沙滩球大，能让它在水里浮起来。在海滩爬行时，它会用钳子提起浮具，免得拖在沙上。
author: .jerden
source: The beachball-sized orb on the end of POKENAME's tail keeps it afloat in the water. When scuttling across the beach, POKENAME picks the float up in its claw to stop it from dragging in the sand.

entry: POKENAME住湿地，巢在高芦苇间。听觉敏锐，几乎立刻就能察觉危险捕食者。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME live in wetlands, nesting amongst tall reeds. Its sensitive hearing allows POKENAME to detect dangerous predators almost instantly.

entry: POKENAME骨头刺出皮肤，看着像僵尸。它用刺尾猛砸敌人。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's bones have protruded its skin, causing its zombified-like appearance. POKENAME uses its spiked tail to bash its foes.

entry: POKENAME失去外皮，以尾上裸露骨头当棒，残暴击敌。许多人一见它冲来，就竭尽所能跑得又快又远。
author: soup1900
source: With its body skinned, POKENAME utilizes the now-exposed bones on its tail like a club to brutally bash enemies. Many people run as far and as fast as they can as soon as they see one charging towards them.

entry: POKENAME用棒痛打敌人。训练时会先吹出几个飘浮泡泡，再试着一挥全部击破。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME bludgeon foes with their club. When training, POKENAME produce several floating bubbles before attempting to strike them all down with a single swing.

entry: POKENAME挥棒的力道足以砸碎巨石。与其他宝可梦切磋时，会用软泡泡包住棒子，减轻打击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swing their club with enough force to smash through boulders. When they are sparring with another Pokémon, a soft bubble envelops the club to soften blows.

entry: POKENAME的双头棒几乎与自己一样重。棒飞出去时，它会喷泡泡分散敌人注意，让棒绕回再击一次。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wield a double-sided club that weighs nearly as much as they do. While their club flies through the air, POKENAME shoot bubbles at foes to distract them as the club makes its second pass.

entry: POKENAME通常住在淡水水库深处，也能陆行。潜力惊人，据说练到巅峰，什么材料都能踢穿。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although it typically lives deep in freshwater reservoirs, POKENAME can still tread on land. It has incredible latent power; POKENAME that have reached peak performance are said to be able to kick through any material.

entry: POKENAME有节奏地拳打池面训练，让涟漪传遍水域。温和举止下，是精准有力的格斗方式。
author: mgfox_66676
source: POKENAME trains by rhythmically punching the surface of ponds, creating ripples that echo across the water. Its gentle demeanor masks a precise and powerful fighting style.

entry: POKENAME来回摆耳储能。力量足够，便能猛力推进身体，冲上瀑布。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wiggles its ears back and forth to store energy. Once it has enough power, it will propel its body with enough force to scale a waterfall.

entry: POKENAME友好又好奇，常对路过训练家感兴趣。它乐于带人去森林中看似随意的角落，展示最爱的觅食与休息处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are friendly and very curious Pokémon, often taking an interest in passing Trainers. They delight in showing Trainers their favourite places to eat and rest, leading them to seemingly random areas in the forests they live in.

entry: POKENAME在马戏团扮演滑稽消防员，在场中弹跳，搞笑地彼此碍事。近年却渐失人气，许多人觉得吓人胜过好笑。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME perform at circuses as comedy firefighters, bouncing around the circus ring and getting in one another's way in humorous ways. Their popularity has been waning in recent years with many people finding them unnerving rather than funny.

entry: POKENAME在马戏团扮演滑稽消防员，在场中弹跳，搞笑地彼此碍事。近年却渐失人气，许多人觉得吓人胜过好笑。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME perform at circuses as comedy firefighters, bouncing around the circus ring and getting in one another's way in humorous ways. Their popularity has been waning in recent years with many people finding them unnerving rather than funny.

entry: POKENAME热爱表演，在戏剧界很常见。整部剧本与舞步只看一遍就记住，是完美的舞台演员。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are a common sight in the theatre industry thanks to their love of performing. They can memorise entire scripts and routines on their very first read through, making them the perfect stage performers.

entry: POKENAME结实的身体，能拉着数千磅重物穿田过河。人们把整群套在沉船上，将其拖回陆地。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its tough body can draw forward thousands of pounds through fields and rivers alike. Herds of POKENAME are hitched to sinking ships to bring them back to land.

entry: POKENAME能从周围水中摄氧，在水下呼吸，再从毒针以泡泡排出二氧化碳，形成稳定气泡流。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to breath underwater, drawing oxygen from the surrounding water. They excrete carbon dioxide in bubbles through their stinger, releasing a steady stream of bubbles.

entry: POKENAME协助救生员保护大家安全。壳容易抓牢，更方便救溺水泳客。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME help lifeguards ensure everyone is staying safe. Their shell is easy to hold onto, which makes it easier to save drowning swimmers.

entry: POKENAME毛蓬松又防水，入水时兜住气泡，一起带下去，帮助游泳时保持浮力。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have very fluffy and water repellent fur. When submerged in water, it captures air bubbles that are brought underwater with it. They use these bubbles to aid in buoyancy when swimming.

entry: POKENAME毛蓬松又防水，入水时兜住气泡，一起带下去，帮助游泳时保持浮力。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have very fluffy and water repellent fur. When submerged in water, it captures air bubbles that are brought underwater with it. They use these bubbles to aid in buoyancy when swimming.

entry: POKENAME在水中会用体内蓄火造出火焰气泡。栖息的河湖，水温能超过华氏1,400度。
author: beatdoof
source: Whenever POKENAME spends time in the water, it creates fire-filled bubbles from the flames stored in its body. The waters of the rivers and lakes where it lives can reach over 1,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

entry: POKENAME吃够数据，就开始朝四方喷水。液体有奇怪磁性，会干扰附近设备。
author: .izik
source: After consuming enough data, POKENAME begins spraying water in all directions. This liquid possesses a strange magnetic property that interferes with nearby devices.

entry: 沉重的外壳，让POKENAME难以在急流中游动。它索性沿着沙质河底，翻滚着前进。
author: captainzscourge
source: The shell on its body makes it hard for POKENAME to properly swim in strong currents. It has resorted to tumbling along the sandy bottoms instead.

entry: POKENAME头尾都有浮具，常来回挥动，转移对身体的注意。研究者推测，这是让捕食者分不清哪端才是头。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have floats at both their head and tail that they wave around to distract from their body. Researchers theorise that they do this to confuse predators about which end of their body is their head.

entry: POKENAME附在河湖附近的树上，每天从湿空气吸水。尾巴有细小毒针，毒会引起恶心。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME clings to trees near lakes and rivers, absorbing their daily moisture through the humid air. Their tail contains tiny stingers with venom that causes nausea.

entry: POKENAME大多待在河溪，打盹常堵住航道。似乎只有另一只POKENAME振奋有力的腹鼓，才能唤醒。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME spend most of their time in rivers and streams, often leading them to block navigable waterways while napping. Only a rousing Belly Drum from another POKENAME seems to be able to wake them.

entry: POKENAME几乎总在水中，仰浮着入睡。厚脂肪层让它保暖，也保持浮力。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends almost all of its time in the water, falling asleep while floating on its back. A thick layer of fat keeps it insulated and buoyant.

entry: POKENAME保护极地海洋，先在水面造泡，再急冷，筑成新冰川的基础。见冰川融化，就降暴雪，再次降温。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME protects arctic seas, creating bubbles along the water's surface then rapidly chilling them to create foundations for new glaciers. If it witneses melting glaciers, it will cast down blizzads across the area to chill them again.

entry: POKENAME喜欢流水声，常在溪河或瀑布边安家。游泳时，用有弹性的保护气泡包住自己与陆生朋友。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME adore the sound of running water, often making their homes near brooks, rivers, or waterfalls. When they swim, POKENAME surround themselves and their land-dwelling friends with a protective, bouncy air bubble.

entry: POKENAME住在瀑布边，攀爬瀑后岩壁，以急水声遮掩行动。强腿能让它弹向空中，轻松穿越崖面。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live beside waterfalls, climbing the rockfaces behind the falls and using the rushing water to mask their movements. They have powerful legs that can spring them through the air, letting them traverse cliff faces with ease.

entry: POKENAME看着快乐，容易让人误会，却始终用敏耳找猎物。四翼无声飞过湖河，灵巧俯冲，捕住水下目标。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Though it possesses a misleadingly joyful demeanor, POKENAME uses its sensitive ears to constantly seek out prey. It flies silently with its four wings over lakebeds and rivers, deftly diving down to catch prey from the water beneath.

entry: POKENAME整夜无声飞行觅食。常在湖边贴水飞，用蓝色皮肤伪装。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME flies silently throughout the night seeking prey. It often hunts around lakes, where it can fly close to the water and uses its blue skin to act as camouflage.

entry: 若POKENAME群在附近定居，湖畔房产就可能贬值，因为它会俯冲袭击自认领地里的任何人。人们得请专门训练家安抚，试着劝其迁走。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Lakeside properties can see their value fall if a flock of POKENAME decide to take up residence nearby, as they divebomb anyone they deem as in their territory. Special Trainers are called in who can calm them down and try to get them to move on.

entry: POKENAME在周围造一串泡泡，帮助瞄准水中电击。泡泡泛能量光，从暗处引来猎物，再接连炸成电火花。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME create a series of bubbles around them in order to better aim their electricity through the water. The bubbles glow with energy, luring in prey from the dark before bursting in a series of sparks.

entry: POKENAME潜水，只让尾巴浮着，在猎手看来像颗漂过的遗失蛋。捕食者靠近，它便用尾敲头，再潜下游走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME submerges itself in water and lets its tail bob on the surface, appearing to hunters as a lost egg floating by. When a predator draws near, it hits them on the head with its tail before diving back down and swimming away.

entry: POKENAME靠脚与弹性尾巴蹦跳，也用尾浮水。只有吃树果时，会短暂离水。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME uses its feet and its bouncy tail to hop around, and uses its tail to float on water. It momentarily leaves the water to eat berries.

entry: 多雨季节，常见POKENAME在河中欢舞。民间传说，它会跳到雨下不停，淹坏作物，招来饥荒。
author: beatdoof
source: In heavy rainfall seasons, POKENAME is often seen dancing happily in rivers. A folk legend claims it will dance so long that the rain never ends, over-watering crops and causing famine.

entry: POKENAME能蜷成球，沿水面弹跳。跳太久，却会严重晕动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has the ability to roll its body into a ball and bounce across the water's surface. If it bounces for too long, it will get severe motion sickness.

entry: POKENAME尾部连着浮具，能自行调节浮力，必要时几秒内就能回到水面。它们深受救生员喜爱，经过训练，能救助溺水的人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have floats attached to their tails that they can control the buoyancy of, enabling them to return to the surface of the water in seconds if they need to. They are a popular companion of lifeguards and are trained to rescue drowning people.

entry: POKENAME聚在山溪，模仿林中宝可梦取乐。人一经过就僵住装树，可鲜蓝身体让伪装一眼看穿。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME cluster in mountain streams and will entertain one another by imitating other forest Pokémon. They will freeze up and pretend to be trees should a person walk by, but their bright blue colour makes their disguise obvious.

entry: POKENAME有孩子般的好奇心，常悬在湖上，只为看水下游动的宝可梦。太分心时，被风带走一阵也没发现。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME is known for its childlike curiosity, looming over lakes just to gaze down at the Pokémon swimming beneath the water. If it gets too distracted, it won't notice the wind carrying it away for a short period of time.

entry: POKENAME浸入超过18℃的水，头上红花就开。晴天，上升气流托起身体，让它飘在家乡池塘上。
author: fiordaliso
source: The red flower on its head opens when POKENAME immerses itself in water with a temperature above 18°C. On sunny days, this Pokémon floats above the pond where it lives, carried by rising air currents.

entry: POKENAME爱看宝可梦战斗，常浮在训练家学校上空，尖声加油。特别精彩时，会快速挥绒手表达喜悦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME love to watch other Pokémon battle, floating above Trainer schools they make high-pitched cheering squeaks. When they see a particularly exciting battle they wave their fluffy hands quickly to signal their joy.

entry: POKENAME爱看宝可梦战斗，常浮在训练家学校上空，尖声加油。特别精彩时，会快速挥绒手表达喜悦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME love to watch other Pokémon battle, floating above Trainer schools they make high-pitched cheering squeaks. When they see a particularly exciting battle they wave their fluffy hands quickly to signal their joy.

entry: POKENAME温柔爱玩，外表亲切，很适合陪婴幼儿。它用尾巴弹跳，能上高树。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME is an ideal Pokémon to have around babies and small children due to its gentle and playful nature and approachable appearance. It uses its tail to bounce high into trees.

entry: POKENAME体表薄油膜帮助浮水。它会到田里，帮忙浇作物。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME has a thin, oily film on its body to help it float in water. It visits fields to help water crops.

entry: POKENAME周身黏液有薄荷香。玉虹市有款能量饮料，以它为主要原料。
author: .izik
source: The sticky slime that covers POKENAME's body smells like mint. There is an energy drink made in Celadon City that uses it as a main ingredient.

entry: POKENAME花大量时间洗身上的泥土。哪怕毛上只沾1盎司，也难睡着。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spends a great amount of time cleaning mud and dirt off of its body. It has trouble sleeping if even a single ounce is on its fur.

entry: 锐眼、灵耳和防水羽毛，让POKENAME连暴雨夜也能飞。一只乌鸦头头融合体手下，大约有15只。
author: bobosmith01
source: Their powerful eyes, sense of hearing, and waterproof feathers allow POKENAME to fly even in extreme downpours at night. Around 15 POKENAME serve under a Honchkrow fusion.

entry: POKENAME体侧尖刺能射出沉重蓝球，打击其他生物。不堪负荷时，它高速旋转，重击如旋风扫来。
author: sk372
source: The spines on the side of POKENAME's body can fire out heavy blue orbs to strike at others. When it is overwhelmed, it spins rapidly and becomes a whirling dervish of heavy blows.

entry: POKENAME住在深海，还会钻入深海平原下方。它却很友善，让弱小海洋宝可梦同住，用坚不可摧的颚收集碎屑喂它们。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME lives beneath the deep ocean, burrowing deep under the abyssal plain. Despite that, it is a truly friendly Pokémon that lets weaker ocean Pokémon live together with it, feeding them with detritus collected with its unbreakable jaw.

entry: POKENAME总跟着爱囤食的宝可梦，等它们离家，再偷储粮。被抓就从喙喷水，赶在受伤前慌忙飞走。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME constantly follows behind Pokémon who hoard their food, waiting until they leave their homes to steal from their piles. If caught, it'll spit out water from its beak, frantically flying off before it can get hurt.

entry: POKENAME壳与身体分离，里面能自由活动。有些游乐场让人猜头从哪个洞冒出，赢家可得一杯它产的甜汁。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's shell is detached from its body, allowing it to move about freely within it. They are sometimes kept at funfairs, where the game is to guess which hole their head will pop out of. Winners get a cup of the sweet juice they produce.

entry: POKENAME爱吹肥皂泡，再用利爪戳破。受威胁会把皂液泼敌眼，趁机逃走。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME loves to blow soap bubbles before popping them with its sharp claws. If threatened, POKENAME will splash soap into its opponent's eyes before escaping.

entry: POKENAME虽然重，想浮想沉都轻松。它靠从壳中排气泡控制，也用泡泡帮助溺水宝可梦。
author: imaginita
source: Despite its weight, POKENAME can easily float in water — or sink if it wants.  It does so by releasing bubbles of air from its shell, which it can also use to help drowning Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME身上的泡泡随攻击变色。喷烫水前变红，喷墨前变黑，最后休息时变白。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The bubbles along POKENAME's body change color depending on how they attack. The bubbles turn red before POKENAME spray scalding water, black before they spray ink, and white when they finally rest.

entry: 野生POKENAME沿河床翻滚，靠身体保护，水下积起冲势。一冲上陆地，滚动突击便撞破前方所有障碍。
author: moga6
source: A wild POKENAME builds momentum underwater, rolling along riverbeds while its body protects it. When it bursts onto land, its rolling charge smashes through all obstacles ahead.

entry: POKENAME伸缩尾巴，匹配信号频率，连接无线电塔。有些训练家已学会，跟它说话就能打电话。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME connect to radio towers by extending and contracting their tail to match the frequency emitted. Some Trainers have figured out how to make phone calls by talking to POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME直立着浮在水里，将头和颈褶探出水面，来回摇摆，好看清岸上的动静。受到威胁时，它们便甩动尾巴上的浮具，击向敌人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME bob upright in the water, popping their head and hood above the surface and swaying back and forth to get a good view of what's happening on the shore. When threatened, they attack by swinging the buoy on their tail at their foe.

entry: POKENAME造的泡泡，以清爽美味著称。味觉敏锐的美食家，单凭味道就能辨明它来自哪个地区。
author: mepp.
source: The bubbles POKENAME makes are famously refreshing and delicious. Gourmets with highly developed palates can even pinpoint which region an POKENAME is from the taste alone.

entry: POKENAME用袋轻抱小宝可梦，是热门摆渡者与保姆。它造一簇簇小泡泡，逗乐乘客。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Gently cradling smaller Pokémon in their pouches, POKENAME make for popular ferries or babysitters. They produce small clusters of bubbles to entertain the Pokémon they carry.

entry: POKENAME总是可爱傻气，可一拿到电气球，玩闹就变成恐怖，四处作乱。
author: musicsheep.
source: While POKENAME always behaves cute and silly, when in possession of a Light Ball, POKENAME causes havoc by turning its playfulness into terror.

entry: POKENAME靠黑暗鸦一系的融合打手统治湖泊，敏锐听觉还能预料反叛阴谋。它爱用泡泡戏法逗幼崽，却只在最信任的伙伴面前显露这面。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME controls its lake through its Makrow enforcers and its powerful hearing, which helps it anticipate plots against it. It loves entertaining baby Pokémon with bubble tricks, but will only show this side among its most trusted allies.

entry: POKENAME想快速浮上水面，就用尾部浮具的电，从周围水中分离氧气。大量气泡让它猛增浮力。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use the charge in their tail float to split oxygen from the water surrounding them whenever they want to surface quickly. The abundance of bubbles that result from the process provide them a burst of buoyancy.

entry: POKENAME掌上有皂油，攻击时能自由制造旋转锐泡。泡泡割得深可及骨。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME's palms are coated in soapy oils, which allow POKENAME to freely make spinning razor bubbles as it attacks. These bubbles can cut down to bone.

entry: POKENAME想快速浮上水面，就用尾部浮具的电，从周围水中分离氧气。大量气泡让它猛增浮力。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use the charge in their tail float to split oxygen from the water surrounding them whenever they want to surface quickly. The abundance of bubbles that result from the process provide them a burst of buoyancy.

entry: 电荷流过POKENAME的尾巴，让尾尖成为阳极，身体成为阴极。这种交替变化的电荷，能将周围的水化成气泡，帮助它迅速移动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: An electrical charge runs through the tail of POKENAME, which allows them to turn their tail tip into an anode and use their body as a cathode. This alternating charge allows them to turn water around them into gas bubbles, letting them move swiftly.

entry: 电荷流过POKENAME的尾巴，让尾尖成为阳极，身体成为阴极。这种交替变化的电荷，能将周围的水化成气泡，帮助它迅速移动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: An electrical charge runs through the tail of POKENAME, which allows them to turn their tail tip into an anode and use their body as a cathode. This alternating charge allows them to turn water around them into gas bubbles, letting them move swiftly.

entry: POKENAME翻土极快，对园丁很有价值。可训练家若不盯紧，也常见它偷啃自己劳作长出的作物。
author: deniablecredibility
source: POKENAME are valuable resources for any gardener given how quickly they can till the soil, though they can often be caught nibbling on the crops that result from their labor if their Trainer doesn't keep a close eye on them.

entry: POKENAME生活在睡莲之间，拿叶片当平台，彼此玩耍。它们身上也会开花，花瓣的颜色，取决于所吃的植物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in and amongst water lilies, using their leaves as platforms on which to play with one another on. Flowers bloom on their bodies, the colour of the petals depending on the plants they eat.

entry: POKENAME不如进化后精准，常造出一池泡沫，而非平稳水波。
author: thebreathlesshashira
source: Lacking the precision of their evolutions, POKENAME often create pools of froth instead of making steady waves.

entry: POKENAME大量吸气，让锻炼效果更好。它很爱玩，常朝训练家踢水。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: To optimize their workout, POKENAME intake large amounts of air. POKENAME are quite playful, and are known for kicking water at their trainers.

entry: POKENAME用强肺吹出又大又耐破的泥泡，散布领地各处。这样能伏击毫无戒心的猎物，又避开危险。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME uses its powerful lungs to create large, durable mud bubbles. These bubbles are scattered throughout its territory to ambush unsuspecting prey while avoiding danger.

entry: 它吹的泥泡大到装得下一只大王铜象。大洪水时，会把人和宝可梦封在泡里，挡住碎屑与水流。退水后，泡泡干了，从里面很容易打破。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It blows mud bubbles large enough to fit a Copperajah inside. During severe floods, it seals people and Pokémon inside these bubbles, protecting them from debris and currents. Once waters recede, the bubbles dry and can be easily broken from within.

entry: POKENAME轻飘湖上，低看水下生物。漂着受袭，会用下方水流构成力场。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME drifts lightly over lakes, looking down and watching the creatures swimming below. It creates a force field made of the water beneath it if attacked while it floats around.

entry: POKENAME被泡泡围着出水，夜里缓慢漂浮，寻找自己的目标。它造出实体泡泡，投下阴影，试着把人拉回水中。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Emerging from the water in a surrounded by bubbles, POKENAME slowly drifts at night in search of purpose. It creates solid bubbles that cast down shadows to try and pull people back into the water with it.

entry: POKENAME潜水时，让耳朵保持在水面上，听察危险。听到空中猎手俯冲的声音，它便跃出水面，用沉重的尾球将攻击者击昏。
author: sk372
source: When diving, POKENAME keeps its ears above the water to listen for danger. If it hears the sound of an aerial hunter swooping down, it leaps out of the water and knocks the attacker out with the heavy ball on its tail.

entry: POKENAME能随意改变楔石的重量，捉弄发现自己的人。拿起后一刻，楔石可能轻如羽毛，下一刻却又变得超过100磅重。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are able to change the weight of their keystone at will, using this ability to prank those who find them. A POKENAME's keystone may feel light as a feather a moment after being picked up, then weigh just over 100lbs in the next.

entry: 野生POKENAME极想精进自己，常两两对练。单独训练时，则花大量时间冥想、自省。
author: katieplaysgames
source: In the wild, POKENAME are highly motivated by self-improvement and can often be found in sparring pairs. When training alone, POKENAME will spend large stretches of time in meditation and self-reflection.

entry: 野生POKENAME极想精进自己，常两两对练。单独训练时，则花大量时间冥想、自省。
author: katieplaysgames
source: In the wild, POKENAME are highly motivated by self-improvement and can often be found in sparring pairs. When training alone, POKENAME will spend large stretches of time in meditation and self-reflection.

entry: 野生POKENAME极想精进自己，常两两对练。单独训练时，则花大量时间冥想、自省。
author: katieplaysgames
source: In the wild, POKENAME are highly motivated by self-improvement and can often be found in sparring pairs. When training alone, POKENAME will spend large stretches of time in meditation and self-reflection.

entry: POKENAME在花基部造泡泡筏，托起身体，随流漂游。小宝可梦有时搭顺风车，在背上放松。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swim by creating a raft of bubbles around the base of their flower, lifting themselves up and floating with the current. Smaller Pokémon will sometimes hitch a ride on a passing POKENAME, relaxing on their back.

entry: 野生POKENAME在湖里伪装、等候，听潜在猎物。什么一踏进它的湖，就遭巨颚猛力攻击。
author: bringmeadream_
source: Wild POKENAME wait in lakes, camouflaged in the water, listening for potential prey. Should anything step into POKENAME's lake, they'll be attacked by its giant jaws with huge strength.

entry: POKENAME钻石圆顶随年岁失去透明，硬化成不透光的骨白武器。它用坚不可破的头骨，反复把猎物打倒再吃。
author: beatdoof
source: As it ages, POKENAME's diamond dome loses its transparency, hardening into an opaque, bone-white weapon. It uses this impervious skull to hunt, relentlessly battering its prey to the ground before consuming it.

entry: POKENAME钻石头罩的灰化程度，标明猎群地位。它能以惊人速度奔过水面，冲撞的毁灭性力量，多数宝可梦都挡不住。
author: beatdoof
source: The graying of POKENAME's diamond dome denotes its rank within the hunting pack. Capable of sprinting across the water's surface with startling speed, its charge becomes a devastating force that most Pokémon can't withstand.

entry: POKENAME大多坐在河里，任流水冲身。可吃的东西一漂近，便迅速有力地抓牢。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of its time sitting in rivers, letting the current wash over it. If anything edible floats within reach, it will quickly seize it in a forceful grip.

entry: POKENAME几乎不离家乡河流，懒漂着，掉进水里的什么都吃。若它突然站直、伸到最高，与你对视，就祈祷不是你惹它终于起身。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME barely leaves the rivers it lives in, floating about lazily and eating whatever falls into the water. However, if it stands up and locks eyes with you as it stretches to its full height, pray you are not the reason it finally roused itself.

entry: POKENAME体内高压水辅助肌肉，带来毁灭性力量。物理攻击能夷平周围，甚至打出湖泊。
author: cobalt0135
source: The devastating power of POKENAME comes from internal pressurized water aiding its overall muscles. Its physical attacks can level their surroundings and form even lakes.

entry: POKENAME靠尾上耳朵听。尾巴当战锤挥时必须小心，冲击可能让它短暂失聪。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hears through the ears on its tail. It must be careful when swinging it as a war mace, as the impact can leave it deaf for a few moments.

entry: POKENAME爱在夜间沙滩徘徊，享受凉爽的夜游，可常因此，吓着游客。
author: supersonicloki
source: Known to roam beaches at night, POKENAME usually frightens tourists as it enjoys a cool night swim.

entry: 有人说，POKENAME引溺亡者灵魂去来世。长耳连湍急河流中最微弱的声音也能听见，轻易便找到逝者。
author: nyoomymph
source: Some say POKENAME guides the spirits of those who drowned into the afterlife. Its long ears can hear even the faintest of noises within strong rivers, enabling it to find those who've passed easily.

entry: POKENAME体内空气太多，很难留水下。睡着后，会慢慢升到海面。
author: .izik
source: Due to the high amount of air in its body, POKENAME has trouble staying underwater. When an POKENAME sleeps, it slowly rises to the ocean's surface.

entry: 有人相信，救生圈设计参考了POKENAME腰环。大海难时它现身，以力量让幸存者浮起，送往安全处。
author: sk372
source: Some believe life preservers were designed based on the ring around POKENAME's torso. It appears during great disasters at sea, using its powers to keep survivors afloat and carry them to safety.

entry: POKENAME战斗时摇摆挑衅，诱敌先出招，灵巧避开后，以尾巴猛烈反击。反击时，它通常还会点燃尾巴，增强伤害。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME takes a swaying, taunting stance in battle in order to trick its foes into taking the first move. It moves nimbly to avoid strikes before countering with heavy blows from its tail, typically while igniting the tail for extra damage.

entry: POKENAME是探险者的多功能宝可梦工具，既能当棍棒，又能探听声音，还能在水下提供气泡。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME functions as a Pokémon multi-tool for explorers. It can be used as a club, a auditory sensor, and an underwater air bubble dispenser.

entry: POKENAME精通气压，能一气潜过海沟，再迅速升到云上。可它不总懂训练家做不到，往往独自飞走，把人留后面。
author: alindrome
source: POKENAME has such a mastery over air pressure that it can dive through underwater trenches and ascend above the clouds in one swift, continuous motion. However, it does not always realise that Trainers can't do this, leaving them behind as it flies.

entry: 有些游泳学校请POKENAME教初学者。抱浮尾能保持水面，踩水时，缎带的轻触也能安抚紧张。
author: sk372
source: Some swimming schools use POKENAME to help beginners learn how to swim. Holding its buoyant tail helps keep the beginner afloat, while the gentle touch of its ribbons helps calm the swimmer's nerves while treading water.

entry: POKENAME住在水面镜映的异世界。任何倒霉者一被抓住，就被拖进去，再没人见到。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME lives in an alternate world mirrored across the surface of water. Any poor fool caught in its grasp is dragged into its world and never seen again.

entry: POKENAME开心跳过水坑，毛靴让它不湿。战中与尾巴配合，舞姿难以预测。
author: miecreates
source: POKENAME cheerfully prances through puddles, kept dry by its fur boots. In battle, it fights in tandem with its tail in a wildly unpredictable dance.

entry: POKENAME优雅而谨慎，能用长耳感知细微动静。它们温柔体贴、泳技高超，会赶去援救溺水的宝可梦。常出没于河边，执着地梳理耳朵，若被弄脏，就会凶猛还击。
author: jonclyd
source: POKENAME are graceful yet cautious, sensing faint movements with their long ears. Gentle and caring, they are skilled swimmers rushing to aid drowning Pokémon. Often found near rivers, they groom their ears obsessively and strike fiercely if dirtied.

entry: POKENAME沿湖泊与河流觅食，寻找水生真菌吃。它的尾巴能伸长，出击有力，能在进食时抵御想来攻击的生灵。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME forages around lakes and rivers to find water-based fungi to snack on. Its tail is extendable and packs a powerful punch, letting it deter things that would try to attack it while it feeds.

entry: POKENAME力量惊人，少有对手或弱点。可天性友善，对几乎所有对象都和气，只有万不得已才会战斗。
author: altius
source: POKENAME's incredible power makes it a Pokémon with few rivals or weaknesses. However, it is merely a friendly creature that is kind to almost everyone, only fighting when absolutely necessary.

entry: POKENAME靠灵巧与惊人听觉，以骇人速度察觉、回应任何潜在威胁，野外因此极难目睹。
author: mary_the_jane
source: POKENAME uses its agility and amazing hearing to quickly detect and react to any possible threat at alarming speeds. This makes it very difficult to spot in the wild.

entry: POKENAME泡泡虽脆，却立刻再生。放松时，便像泳圈般浮在水里。
author: typhloquil
source: While POKENAME's bubbles are frail, they will regenerate right away. When relaxing, it uses its bubbles like a pool float to drift in the water.

entry: 泡泡负担太重，POKENAME能让它们脱落。脱落泡泡曾困住小宝可梦，大个体的甚至能困人。
author: wyattwintersoul
source: When overburdened with bubbles, POKENAME can shed them from it's body. This has been known to trap small Pokémon, and larger specimens can even trap people.

entry: 北方海域的POKENAME常劈冰山试力。刀刃钝了，就放泡泡重新磨利。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME from northern oceans tend to test their strength by slicing through icebergs. Should their blades become dulled, they dispense bubbles that sharpen them once more.

entry: 湖里的POKENAME领地意识过强。谁以相近高度闯入，就挥刃连攻，直到对方倒下或退走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME from lakes are known for their overly territorial nature. Should anyone enter their territory at a similar height, they will attack with their blades until the intruder falls or retreats.

entry: 南方海域的POKENAME集成被称为“手斧群”的大群，从岛到岛旅行，登陆就互相切磋。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME from southern oceans travel in large groups known as 'hatchets'. They journey from island to island, sparring with one another upon making landfall.

entry: 河流等流动淡水里的POKENAME，往往只夜猎。大量泡泡拖慢猎物，再用刀刃平侧砸碎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME from rivers and other running freshwater sources tend to hunt only at night. They use large amounts of bubbles to slow prey before pulverizing them with the flat edges of their blades.

entry: POKENAME是托育中心与宝可梦孤儿院不可缺的帮手，不起眼又可爱，却能挡住威胁孩子的一切。水流喷射的速度，甚至超过先进军用喷气机。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME is an indispensable resource in childcare centers and Pokémon orphanages. An unassuming, cute bulwark against anything that threatens the children. Its Aqua Jet can fly at speeds beyond that of an advanced military jet.

entry: 融合后，POKENAME变得温和被动，令人惊讶。人们常借这融合，更安全地饲养单首龙。
author: blitzydragon
source: After being fused, POKENAME's personality becomes shockingly passive. This is usually fused as a safer way to raise Deino.

entry: POKENAME两颗头不太会分享食物，却从不动粗。最好仍给它们各备一个食盆。
author: blitzydragon
source: The two heads of POKENAME struggle when it comes to sharing food but they never get aggressive. It's still ideal to provide each head with its own food bowl.

entry: POKENAME常教新泳者如何浮起、完成水中练习。经验丰富，也在有些水上乐园担任救生员。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are often used to help teach inexperienced swimmers how to properly float and complete exercises in the water. Their expertise has also led them to undertake roles as lifeguards at some water parks.

entry: POKENAME迷彩花纹让它浮水不被发现。能连续睡数天，一醒，就找附近植物维生。
author: sakuraneko
source: POKENAME's camouflage pattern allows it to float unnoticed on bodies of water. It can sleep for days at a time, but once it awakens, it searches for nearby plants to sustain itself.

entry: POKENAME精力过剩，总在拍尾球或乱挥手臂。附近有宝可梦开始溺水，就迅速赶去帮忙。
author: markusknight
source: It is hyperactive and is always found either bouncing the ball on its tail, or flailing its arms. Whenever a Pokémon nearby starts drowning, POKENAME will rush quickly to help.

entry: POKENAME双颚特别适合呼气时造大量泡泡。扎根地面时，总望天空。
author: alindrome
source: The jaws of POKENAME are specially adapted to produce vast quantities of bubbles as it breathes out. While rooted in the earth, it always looks to the sky.

entry: POKENAME维持精细体内气压，造充氦泡泡翼，高速旋转产生升力。能飞，总让它看着开心极了。
author: alindrome
source: POKENAME maintains a delicate air pressure internally, constructing wings of helium-filled bubbles that can pivot at great speeds to create lift. POKENAME always appears overjoyed at being able to fly.

entry: POKENAME自己的火容易让身体过热，便靠大耳自然散热。太冷就把尾火拉近，温度一升，再伸远。
author: ambrosia04
source: Because it can easily overheat from its own fire, POKENAME uses its massive ears to passively radiate heat. If its body gets too cold, it pulls its tail flame close, stretching the tail away again as soon as its temperature rises.

entry: POKENAME潜在池湖泥边，每天吃足湿土。受扰就吐泥水，赶走对手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME submerges itself in the muddy edges of ponds and lakes so it can eat its fill of moist soil every day. If bothered, it spits a stream of muddy water to deter its opposition.

entry: POKENAME认真清理周身薄膜外侧，不让游泳时碰到的碎屑干扰。这份细致，来自多个大脑协作。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME dutifully clean the outside of the membrane around their body, ensuring that none of the detritus they encounter while swimming can disrupt it. This fastidiousness is a product of their multiple brains working in tandem.

entry: POKENAME耳朵能听远处心跳。找血滋养时，优先盯心跳强的生物。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME's ears can hear the heartbeats of living beings from far away. It will prioritize those with strong heartbeats when it searches for blood to nourish itself.

entry: POKENAME平静漂在北方冰水中。中空身体的许多孔，能射水流或大冰块。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats around placidly in icy waters in northern regions. It can shoot water bursts or large chunks of ice from the many holes in its hollow body.

entry: POKENAME夜里高跳吸月光。可跳得太高，很快就累。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME jump high at night to absorb moonlight. However, they jump so high that they tire out very fast.

entry: POKENAME造泡泡装身，跳舞向伴侣炫耀。战斗也用舞，盼迷住敌人，别来打扰。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME creates bubbles to adorn its body when dancing and showing off to mates. It also uses these dances in battle, hoping to mesmerize foes into leaving it alone.

entry: POKENAME通常在各种水域旁摇摆起舞。跳舞时，超能力会让细小的涟漪随动作节拍，在水面荡开。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is usually found doing its swaying dances near some type of body of water. As it dances, its psychic powers cause small waves to ripple across the water's surface in tune with its movements.

entry: POKENAME打小嗝吐泡，看着可爱，泡里却是冲击嗅觉的臭气。
author: musicsheep.
source: While POKENAME may look cute with its little bubble-blowing burping, these bubbles contain a smelly gas that will assault the senses.

entry: 别误认成肥皂泡，POKENAME的泡泡由毒气构成，破掉会引起恶心。
author: musicsheep.
source: While they may look like soap bubbles, make no mistake. The bubbles created by POKENAME are made of toxic gases that can induce nausea when they pop.

entry: POKENAME沿林湖浮泡弹跳。受惊就在连串破泡中消失，看着自己也像被戳没了。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME bounce along bubbles floating atop forest lakes. If they're startled, they will disappear in a flurry of popping bubbles, appearing to pop out of existence themselves.

entry: POKENAME把泡泡送空中，捕月光来喝。泡若破，便放腐臭味。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME sends bubbles into the air to capture moonlight for it to drink. If these bubbles pop, they release a putrid smell.

entry: POKENAME无忧无虑地游走北方，爱下水交朋友。可身体冰冷，一入水几乎立刻冻住，把其他生物困在里面。
author: sk372
source: A happy-go-lucky creature that roams northern areas, POKENAME loves to join others in bodies of water to make new friends. Unfortunately, its frigid body almost instantly freezes the water after it enters, trapping the other creatures within.

entry: POKENAME把重身体沉湖底，在最深处放松。离水太久，行为就慢吞吞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sinks its heavy body to the bottom of lakes, finding relaxation at the deepest depths. It behaves sluggishly if it spends too much time out of the water.

entry: POKENAME不停喷泡。泡泡甜而营养丰富，可一破就极臭。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME constantly spews out bubbles. These bubbles are very sweet and nutritious, but smell terrible if popped.

entry: 野生POKENAME白天大多在海滩或湖边玩。只要一拳打得好，就能轻松砸开大钳蟹的壳。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Wild POKENAME spend most of the day playing on beaches or lakesides. They can easily shatter the shell of Krabby with a proper punch.

entry: POKENAME的泳技出奇高，与外表给人的印象不同。它潜海底，以熊抱挤破刺甲贝的壳。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Despite its appearance, POKENAME is a surprisingly adept swimmer. It dives to the sea floor and breaks the shells of Cloyster with a bear hug.

entry: POKENAME大胆，野外毫不害怕。是极好的旅行伙伴，既驱危险宝可梦，也替训练家找食物和水。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are bold Pokémon that show a complete lack of fear in the wilderness. They make for excellent traveling companions, warding off dangerous Pokémon while also foraging for food and water for their Trainers.

entry: POKENAME战中造大泡，在敌人刚好够不到处弹跳起舞。泡破的巨响让对手迷乱，便能迅速踢击。
author: chibitales
source: During battle, POKENAME create large bubbles to bounce and dance on just out of reach of their opponents. These bubbles create a loud, disorienting sound when popped, allowing POKENAME to quickly strike with kicks.

entry: POKENAME蘑菇块存着大量水。岛屿城镇的许多厨师，用来炖菜。
author: .izik
source: Chunks of POKENAME's mushroom retain copious amounts of water. Many chefs use this as an ingredient in stew dishes in island towns.

entry: POKENAME整天游水，不断锻炼双臂。练出的肌肉，让拳击有毁灭性力道。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME swims around in the water all day, constantly exercising its arms. The muscle this builds enables its punches to hit with devastating force.

entry: POKENAME蓝色的身体，能藏在清澈的水中，在陆地却十分显眼，因此很少冒险上岸。遇到更大、更强的宝可梦，它会迅速逃走，却会趁弱者不备，发起攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's blue coloration enables it to hide in clear water but is highly visible on land, so it rarely ventures onto shore. POKENAME is quick to flee from larger and stronger Pokémon, but attacks weaker Pokémon if it can catch them by surprise.

entry: POKENAME长触角极敏感，能察觉、分辨不同深海生物低闷的声音。脸太小，视力更差，这本领正好弥补。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: POKENAME's long antennae are remarkably sensitive, allowing it to detect and identify muffled sounds made by different deep-sea creatures. This compensates for its poor vision, which is exacerbated by the small size of its face.

entry: POKENAME先用泡困猎物，再优雅跃前，一击解决。被逼绝境，就沿身造一串泡，滑走寻找更好的出击角度。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME trap their prey within bubbles before gracefully leaping forward and finishing them in one strike. When cornered, they create a series of bubbles along their body to slip away and get a better angle for their next attack.

entry: POKENAME厚脂肪层保护全身，抵御冷热，因此能舒服地进雪冻原或热沙漠找食物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a layer of thick fat that surrounds their body and protects them from hot and cold sensations. This allows them to comfortably wander into snowy tundras or hot deserts to search for food.

entry: POKENAME整天在流动的河溪上方振翅飞舞，偶尔停在水面上方，伸手抓取水生宝可梦。它们体质脆弱，靠长耳聆听危险，一受惊就飞走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend their days fluttering over running streams and rivers, occasionally pausing above the water's surface to grab at an aquatic Pokémon. They are physically frail and use their long ears to listen for danger, flying away if startled.

entry: POKENAME虽矮胖，只要敏锐的感官察觉不对，就能以出人意料的速度蹦跳。据说，吃下它带着的粉色蛋，就能得到永恒幸福。
author: beatdoof
source: Despite POKENAME's short and bulky stature, it can hop and skip around at unexpectedly fast speeds if it detects anything bad with its surprisingly sharp senses. The pink egg it carries is said to bring everlasting happiness to anyone who eats it.

entry: POKENAME游泳，睡莲叶的重量常把它翻得仰躺，毫无防备。它便拼命挪动，盼水波足够强，把自己翻回来。
author: bigoljax
source: While it swims, the weight of POKENAME's lily pad often causes it to flip over onto its back, leaving it defenseless. It then starts to frantically shuffle around, trying to make ripples in the water strong enough to flip it back over.

entry: POKENAME爱在睡莲叶上跳舞，俯身用帽子舀水。装满后，它便游上岸，边跳舞，边让鸟类宝可梦停在帽沿喝水。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME loves to dance atop lily pads, leaning down to scoop up water with its hat. Once filled to the brim, it'll swim onto land, letting bird Pokémon perch on the sides to take a drink while it dances.

entry: POKENAME整天在流动的河溪上方振翅飞舞，偶尔停在水面上方，伸手抓取水生宝可梦。它们体质脆弱，靠长耳聆听危险，一受惊就飞走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend their days fluttering over running streams and rivers, occasionally pausing above the water's surface to grab at an aquatic Pokémon. They are physically frail and use their long ears to listen for danger, flying away if startled.

entry: POKENAME乘浪造泡，藏在泡沫里。据说冲浪遇见它，就预示爱情将至。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME ride along the waves, creating bubbles and hiding among the foam. It is said that encountering an POKENAME while surfing is a sure sign that love is on the way.

entry: POKENAME所住的冰块中，探出三个头。天性爱玩，会从三张嘴各吹一股冷泡，浇向对方打招呼。
author: sk372
source: Three heads poke out of a frozen ice block POKENAME inhabits. Playful by nature, it greets others by showering them with three streams of chilly bubbles blown from each mouth.

entry: POKENAME球尾一亮，很容易看入迷。野生爱在热闹水上乐园逗留，一见溺水者，就不假思索地救。
author: doctorjazznumber6215
source: POKENAME easily get distracted by their ball tail when it glows. Wild POKENAME loiter in water parks, preferably thriving ones. They impulsively rescue anyone drowning on notice.

entry: POKENAME敏耳胡须能在敌人形成威胁前察觉。强后腿与无声脚掌，让它能不被发现地逃开。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's sensitive ears and whiskers can detect foes before they become a threat. Its powerful hind legs and quiet paws let it escape predators undiscovered.

entry: POKENAME会吠叫，警告别靠近危险急流，避免被冲走溺水。救起误落水宝可梦后，还用软暖毛帮它们取暖。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME barks to warn people away from spots where the current is dangerously strong, preventing them from being swept away and drowning. After rescuing Pokémon that have accidentally fallen into the water, it warms them with its soft, cosy fur.

entry: POKENAME双腿极强，能逆猛烈瀑布上游，不知疲倦。水与火属性招式交织出迷人蒸汽景象，常让岸边观众入迷。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME has such powerful legs that it can swim upstream against raging waterfalls without tiring. It's known to enchant onlookers on the riverbank by creating dazzling displays of steam, formed from the combination of its Water and Fire-type moves.

entry: POKENAME拍动翅膀，为尾部燃烧的火焰送入空气，产生的热量，足以煮沸周围的水。它们藏进蒸汽，让泡泡反射火光，扰乱猎物。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME flap their wings to add air to the fire burning along their tails, creating enough heat to boil any water around them. They hide within steam and reflect the light of their fires along bubbles to disorient prey.

entry: POKENAME想精确模仿腹纹，循螺旋游。每天练数小时，出水后又困又晕。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME swims in spiral patterns, wanting to mimic the exact design on its stomach. It spends hours every day trying to perfect its style, leaving it sleepy and dazed once it leaves the water.

entry: POKENAME浮具足够有力，再汹涌的水也不沉。它常在河流激流中来回游，借艰难水况锻炼。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's float is buoyant enough to keep them from sinking even in the stormiest waters. They regularly train by swimming up and down rapids in rivers, strengthening themselves in the challenging waters.

entry: POKENAME将泡泡储存在壳里，让自己在水中轻盈浮起。缩进壳时，它们能迅速排出空气，沉到水底，藏进石堆。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME store bubbles within their shell, using them to float and make themselves lighter in the water. They can expel the air rapidly when they retract inside their shell, sinking to the bottom to hide amongst the stones.

entry: 许多训练家因外表可抱而小看POKENAME，可超大钳中力量惊人。它靠敏锐听觉追猎。
author: .jerden
source: Many Trainers underestimate it because of its cuddly appearance, but POKENAME has a huge amount of power in its oversized claw. It hunts down prey using its keen sense of hearing.

entry: 神奥研究者复活当地已灭绝的洗翠顽皮雷弹化石，得到POKENAME。石化过程改变体质，比灭绝的原种更结实。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Sinnoh researchers managed to resurrect fossils of their native Hisuian Electrodes after the regional form went extinct, resulting in POKENAME. The petrification process has altered them to be physically hardier than their extinct counterparts.

entry: POKENAME身体像种子，却全由石组成。雨里石面变泥，因此尽量避水。
author: .izik
source: Though POKENAME's body resembles seeds, it is made entirely of stone. In the rain, its rocky surface turns muddy, so it avoids water whenever possible.

entry: POKENAME爱住繁茂热带。身上树果状石虽诱人，来摘的鸟宝可梦却只会失望，或弄伤喙。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME likes to reside in lush, tropical regions. While the berry-like rocks on it look enticing, bird Pokémon that try to pluck them only leave with disappointment or a hurt beak.

entry: POKENAME在密林深处打盹，小宝可梦会在枝叶间筑巢觅食。外皮坚韧，多数时候根本没发现多了住客。
author: sk372
source: When it snoozes deep in the forest, other smaller Pokémon nest or feed among POKENAME's foliage. Its resilient hide means it doesn't even notice the extra company most times.

entry: POKENAME让小盆才怪坐袋里，安心满足。自己虽常静立，谁凶狠接近孩子，就会突然挨一记重掌。
author: sk372
source: Young Bonsly are allowed to ride in POKENAME's pouch to feel safe and content. Though POKENAME tends to stay perfectly still, anyone approaching the child aggressively will find themselves slapped rather hard and suddenly.

entry: POKENAME虽爱静立，对盆才怪却有强烈亲情。谁惹孩子，就会从背后挨重击，可它看着从没动过……
author: sk372
source: Though it prefers to spend time standing as still, POKENAME possesses strong parental instincts towards Bonsly. Those agitating the children find themselves struck hard from behind, yet POKENAME appears to never have moved...

entry: POKENAME一生大多时间都想静止不动，可肢体上长出的球有甜香甜味，会招来昆虫。它常只好抖掉虫子，每周换几次地方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tries to remain stationary most of its life, but the orbs growing on its limbs have a sweet scent and taste that attracts insects. It often has to shake the bugs off and relocate several times a week.

entry: 没人看时，POKENAME会活力十足地跳舞，缓解漫长静站的苦。人一发现，就飞快逃走。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME dance with energy and vigor when nobody is looking, as it gives them relief from the endless hours of standing still they endure. When people notice POKENAME dancing, they scurry off like the wind.

entry: POKENAME用锯齿牙慢慢啃树皮。吃太慢，常骗得其他宝可梦以为只是一棵树。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its serrated fangs to slowly nibble away at tree bark. However, because it eats so slowly, other Pokémon are often fooled into thinking POKENAME is just another tree.

entry: POKENAME像未知树种，方叶、长干。有人试采木材，得到轻巧木块。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME resemble trees of an unknown species, with blocky leaves and a long trunk. People who have tried to harvest wood from POKENAME receive lightweight blocks of wood.

entry: 野生POKENAME常挡训练家路，许多只有被杰尼龟喷壶喷水才回应，外观随之出错，变得看不见。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME block the paths of many Trainers out in the wild. Many only respond when sprayed with a Squirt Bottle, which causes their texture to glitch out and turn invisible.

entry: POKENAME模仿电脑命令提示符，盼人来使用，功能也与电脑自带的命令提示符几乎一致。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME take on the appearance of command prompts found in PCs. They take on this form hoping that people will use them, as their function is nearly identical to the actual command prompt found natively in PCs.

entry: POKENAME起初被当成巨大的树才怪，后来被用作路障，阻止公众进入施工区。
author: camtft
source: Originally believed to be an oversized Sudowoodo, POKENAME have been employed as roadblocks used to block off construction zones from the public.

entry: POKENAME常装成水面漂木避敌。在湖里安静住着，避开冲突，耐心储存进化能量。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME often pretends to be a fallen log drifting on the water's surface to hide from predators. It dwells quietly in lakes, avoiding conflict while patiently storing the energy it needs to evolve.

entry: POKENAME用强精神力，让胆敢靠近者恐惧。也靠同样力量把雨移开，风暴中形成空洞，反暴露位置。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME use their powerful psychic abilities to invoke fear in those who dare to approach them. They use these same powers to divert rain away from themselves, creating holes in storms that give away their location.

entry: POKENAME周围始终绕着的球，会奇异地影响心智。人一被打中，就不再认它是宝可梦，只当普通树。
author: sk372
source: The ever-present orbs circling POKENAME have a strange effect on the mind. After getting hit, a person will no longer recognize POKENAME as a Pokémon, instead thinking of it as a normal tree.

entry: 为避免争斗，POKENAME试着站定不动，藏在高树之间。可一紧张，颈边的球体便会散出浓烈的草药香，往往暴露自己的位置。
author: sk372
source: Seeking to avoid conflict, POKENAME attempts to stand still and hide itself amongst tall trees. The orbs around its neck put forth a strong herbal scent when it is stressed, often resulting in it giving away its position.

entry: 它每到整点，分秒不差地探出身体，发出咕鸣，因此在乡间十分受欢迎。有时，也住在森林里。
author: chorb33
source: This fusion is popular in rural areas, as the body emerges every hour to the second and emits a cooing sound. Occasionally, it also lives in forests.

entry: POKENAME很受豪华家具收藏家青睐，与老派房间十分相配，又不用四处走动。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is a popular fusion for collectors of luxury furniture. It perfectly complements rather old-fashioned rooms and doesn't need to move.

entry: POKENAME触角察觉细小天气变化。绿叶泡茶虽极苦，却有舒服的泥土风味。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses it antennae to detect small changes in the weather. Its green leaves can be soaked in water to create a tea that is extremely bitter, but has a nice, earthy flavor.

entry: POKENAME常一脸烦忧，因为总怕惹训练家不高兴。得不断被告知自己是宝贵队员，才能克服恐惧。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often have a perturbed expression because they are in constant fear of upsetting their Trainer. To overcome this fear, they need constant reassurance from their Trainer that they are a valuable member of the team.

entry: POKENAME常在森林，附近有人或宝可梦就僵住。自认独处后，立刻漂空，找树上树果。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are often found in forested areas, freezing up when people or Pokémon are nearby. As soon as they believe they're alone, they float through the air to find Berries in trees.

entry: POKENAME装成地板缝里小杂草，悄悄找碎食。水是弱点，轻喷一下就逃跑。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME pretend to be small sprigs of weeds hiding between floor cracks so they can scrounge for scraps undisturbed. They are weak to water, so a quick spritz is enough to make them scarper.

entry: POKENAME全由岩石构成，却装花，想显得不吓人。为像得真，得常换头上叶子。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME are entirely made of rock but choose to mimic a flower to appear less intimidating. They have to replace the leaves on their head often to look convincing enough.

entry: POKENAME被割伤，会产稠树液状物盖伤口。对细菌毒性极强，有时用于医院。若它把头偏离你，便表示害怕。
author: whatagooddaytodie
