source: When cut, POKENAME produces a thick substance similar to sap to cover the wound. This sap is severely toxic to bacteria and is sometimes used in hospitals. If POKENAME tilts its head away from you, it is an indication of fear.

entry: POKENAME被割伤，会产稠树液状物盖伤口。对细菌毒性极强，有时用于医院。若头向你倾斜，便是信任。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When cut, POKENAME produces a thick substance similar to sap to cover the wound. This sap is severely toxic to bacteria and is sometimes used in hospitals. If its head is tilting towards you, it is a sign of trust.

entry: POKENAME想借扭枝外貌藏进灌丛。可灌木少时极脆弱，因为容易被误认成椒盐卷饼。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME attempts to hide in bushes, using its twisted branch appearance to blend in. Unfortunately, when bushes are scarce, it's especially vulnerable, as it's easy to mistake for a pretzel.

entry: POKENAME性情平和，想避冲突，也避开与其他物种的大多接触。它常试摆完美对称的姿势，却频频失败。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a placid personality, seeking to avoid conflict and indeed most interactions with others outside its species. It spends much time trying to pose in ways that make it look perfectly symmetrical, but fails often.

entry: POKENAME漂过疏林，高速旋转，把大绿种子射进周围土里。之后会长成强壮大树。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats through sparse forests and spins rapidly, launching large green seeds into the dirt around it. These seeds grow into mighty, sturdy trees later.

entry: POKENAME缩头进壳，就装小灌木。罕见时，也会双臂举树果，改装果树丛。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME pretends to be a small shrub whenever it withdraws its head into its shell. On rare occasions, it will sometimes hold some berries with its arms to mimic a berry bush instead.

entry: POKENAME一遇啮齿宝可梦，就举起卡通般夸张的大锤，使出木槌击垮对手，再独自咯咯笑着跑走。
author: musicsheep.
source: When POKENAME comes face-to-face with a rodent Pokémon, it readies its cartoonishly oversized mallet. Using Wood Hammer, POKENAME crushes its opponent and runs away while giggling to itself.

entry: 公园保护区请POKENAME作吉祥物与向导。它完全不动，可人问路、移开目光，再看回来，双臂已指向目的地。
author: sk372
source: Parks and reserves employ POKENAME as mascots and guides. They stand completely still, but if a person asks directions and then looks away, when they glance back POKENAME's arms will point them to their destination.

entry: 火山喷发后，能见成林POKENAME聚在被毁树木的残余上。有研究者认为，它们试图在毁灭后找回正常感。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Forests of POKENAME can be seen clustered together after volcanic eruptions. They sit above the remains of trees felled by the eruption, leading some researchers to suggest they're trying to regain a sense of normality after the destruction.

entry: 丰缘传说称POKENAME协助黑夜魔灵，帮助灵魂往生。现代则常引导拉普拉斯夜里渡客。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Hoennian legend describes POKENAME assisting Dusknoir in helping souls cross over. In modern times, they often help guide Lapras with nighttime ferry trips.

entry: 野生POKENAME绕住树枝，用枝状尾作鸟饵。宝可梦一停上，就猛扑整只吞下。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME will wrap themselves around tree branches and use their branch-reminiscent tails as bait for bird Pokémon. When a Pokémon lands upon their tail, they will lunge and swallow it whole.

entry: POKENAME背上的树才怪，常动弹不得。充当遮雨物时，有时还能听见，它在哭着求救。
author: dodoowner_
source: The Sudowoodo on top of POKENAME's back is often unable to move. It is sometimes heard crying for help as it serves as protection from the rain.

entry: POKENAME鹿角上的球感知风与天气，察觉降水将至，好找地方躲。与萌芽鹿一样，球会随季节变色。
author: sk372
source: The orbs on POKENAME's antlers are attuned to wind and weather, letting it know when precipitation is imminent so it can seek shelter. Like a Sawsbuck, these orbs change color with the season.

entry: POKENAME努力装树，被互动或遇险境也纹丝不动。最大弱点是暴雨，会让它哭得停不下来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tries hard to pretend to be a tree, remaining perfectly still when interacted with or in harsh conditions. Its main weakness is rainstorms, which cause it to cry uncontrollably.

entry: POKENAME石身比起巨石更像大灌木，能安静待在森林而不受打扰。冬天会藏进洞，因为永远绿的身体会暴露伪装。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's rocky bodies resemble a large bush more than a boulder, allowing them to sit peacefully in the forest without being disturbed. In winter, these Pokémon hide out in caves, their perpetually green bodies giving their disguise away.

entry: 山林罕见的POKENAME迅速漂过灌丛，让不敬者领受大自然的怒火。古代雕像也描绘这份职责，可有些所谓雕像，其实只是睡着的POKENAME。
author: ocxin
source: A rare sight in mountain forests, POKENAME floats through thickets at speed and unleashes the wrath of nature on all those who disrespect it. Ancient statues depict it in this role, though some were found to be just sleeping POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME在森林等图片里模仿树木。可形体容易视觉出错，很难长期维持幻象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME attempts to mimic an image of a tree within images of forests and the like. Its form is prone to glitching out visually, however, making it difficult to maintain the illusion for long.

entry: POKENAME总想装树，却不断抽动，只有有风才骗得过。它用臂圆端探电脑、分析数据，可冷却液一流，就逃走。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is always trying to pretend to be a tree, but because it constantly twitches, this facade only works when it's windy. It uses the round ends of its arms to probe computers, analyzing their data, but flees once the coolants start flowing.

entry: POKENAME一生都与家族成员一起，照料自己栖居的大树。它非常害羞，一发现人类，便会僵在原地，一动不动，假装自己也是木头。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME cares for the tree it lives on throughout its entire life, alongside the other members of its family. Because it is very shy, if it spots a human it freezes completely, pretending to be made of wood.

entry: POKENAME能变色，更易融入环境与四季变化，因此常招来野生树才怪的嫉妒与愤怒。
author: sk372
source: Due to its ability to change color, POKENAME can more easily blend in with its surroundings and the changing seasons. This causes it to gain the ire of jealous Sudowoodo in the wild.

entry: POKENAME用幽灵力量，更像周围树木。可灵力让夜里发光，反毁了伪装。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses some of its ghostly powers to better mimic the trees surrounding it. However, its spiritual energy causes it to emit a glow during the night, ruining the illusion.

entry: POKENAME硬如石的角尖漏出浓绿毒液。短暂接触，也可能引起持续数小时的抽搐。
author: .izik
source: A thick green toxin leaks from the tip of POKENAME's rock-solid horn. Even brief contact may cause seizures lasting for hours.

entry: POKENAME在林中静立装树。谁挑衅想揭穿，就先挨愤怒头撞，随后它便气闷地走去别处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stands stock-still in forests, pretending to be a tree. Attempts to provoke it and dispel this masquerade are met with an angry headbutt before POKENAME sulks off elsewhere.

entry: POKENAME藏在灌木里，等人经过，便跃出来吓唬。但找不到够大的灌木时，它就会滑稽地试着躲在小树、矮灌木后。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides in the bushes, waiting for someone to pass by so it can jump out and scare them. However, if it can't find a large enough bush, it will comically try to hide behind small trees and shrubs.

entry: POKENAME大多时间不动，因为不肯让人看见。确定不会被发现，才离地悬浮，去找最近磁源。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME remains motionless for most of the day because it refuses to be seen moving. Once it is convinced that it will not be spotted, it levitates off the ground and floats towards the nearest magnetic source.

entry: POKENAME不是木头，是岩石，核心还由石墨构成。它爱在墙上画树，一被看见，又把脸藏好。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is not made of wood, but rock; its core is made of graphite. It likes drawing trees on walls and hides its face when observed.

entry: POKENAME模仿木练习剑，避免被拿去真战。可成分更近石头，常酿成不幸的训练事故。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME mimics wooden training swords to avoid being used for real combat. However, its composition is closer to stone than wood, often resulting in unfortunate training accidents.

entry: 雨会削弱POKENAME的毒，让它惊慌。为保毒效，风暴时就藏干洞。
author: .izik
source: Rain weakens POKENAME's venom, sending it into a panic. To protect its potency, it hides in dry caves during storms.

entry: 这种融合体，性情差异极大。有些守护弱者，有些却装成树，吓路人一跳，再转身逃跑。
author: ohok3441
source: This fusion tends to vary wildly in personality. Some protect the weak while others pretend to be trees and try to scare passerby before running away.

entry: POKENAME藏身树木与灌丛，远远跟踪猎物。不过，毛发的绿色过于不自然，常常还没出击，就被其他宝可梦发现。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME stalks its prey from afar, camouflaging itself in the trees and bushes. However, due to its fur being an unnatural shade of green, other Pokémon often end up spotting it before it can strike.

entry: POKENAME喜欢受到关注，却常因与环境融为一体，而无法如愿。训练家只要注意到它，它便欢叫着伸出触须，紧紧拥抱对方。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME loves attention but often struggles to get any because it blends in with the world around it. Whenever POKENAME is noticed by a Trainer, it lets out gleeful cries as it embraces them with its feelers.

entry: 据说野生POKENAME只在曾遭火灾、风暴蹂躏的密林深处。行为神秘：只有见到另一个生物移动，自己才动。
author: bobosmith01
source: Supposedly, wild POKENAME are only found deep in forests that were once ravaged ravaged by fire and storms. They exhibit enigmatic behavior: They only move if they spot another being moving as well.

entry: POKENAME颜色融入家乡树木，方便突然高效捕猎。伪装加上高速狩猎，让很少有人见过野生移动的身影。
author: sk372
source: Its coloration allows it to hide well amongst the trees of its home, to better let it hunt prey suddenly and efficiently.  Between its camouflage and high-speed hunting, few have actually seen a wild POKENAME in motion.

entry: 传说POKENAME生于受尽关爱的木娃娃，因此有了生命。可要活下去，又需吸取附近植物的生命力。
author: mistymagius
source: Legends say that POKENAME are born from wooden dolls that have been treated with so much love they come to life. In order to keep going, they need to drain the life force of nearby plants.

entry: POKENAME不装树，改装灌木。它爱闹着伏击人，纯为取乐。
author: birchbot
source: Instead of pretending to be a tree, POKENAME pretends to be a bush. It likes to playfully ambush people just for fun.

entry: POKENAME虽想尽量不动，多尾却本能自行摇摆。遇袭时，尾端光球点燃，向敌人甩灼热火焰。
author: sk372
source: Although POKENAME likes to remain motionless as long as possible, its many tails move instinctively on their own. When under attack, the orbs at the ends will ignite and fling scalding fire at any aggressors.

entry: POKENAME能将胃吐出，充满空气，让自己浮在水上。某些地区，会举办把POKENAME扔进海里的比赛；待它们漂回岸边，再收集眼泪制盐。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME can eject their stomachs and fill them with air, allowing them to float in water. In certain regions, POKENAME are thrown into the ocean in a competition. After floating to shore, their tears are collected to be turned into salt.

entry: POKENAME锋利的绿羽，无论沾上哪里的水，都会膨胀。战斗时，它会脱下这些羽毛，再用一股股蒸汽射向敌人；睡觉时，新羽毛便会长回来。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's sharp, green feathers swell as it is exposed to water from any source. It will shed these feathers in battle and launch them at its foe with bursts of steam, but new feathers will regrow as it sleeps.

entry: POKENAME太害羞，不敢主动交往，便跟踪喜欢的宝可梦，融入环境不被发现。常成单方面关系，付出得不到回应。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME stalk Pokémon that they are fond of since they are too shy to initiate the relationship, and blend into their surroundings well enough to avoid detection. This leads to many one-sided relationships where they give unreciprocated affection.

entry: 几百年前，贵族花园里常有POKENAME。华丽尾巴，为城都传统枯山水庭园添上亮色。
author: opossiblymage
source: Hundreds of years ago, POKENAME was a common fixture in the gardens of nobility. Its extravagant tails were an excellent pop of color in traditional Johto dry gardening.

entry: POKENAME整整一周吃得饱足后，胸口的洞便会结出坚硬如石的绿色果实。它们用左侧卷须，将果实投向威胁，或用右手砸开，分给其他宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME produce green, rock-hard fruits from the hole in their chest after they've eaten their fill for an entire week. They use their left tendrils to throw these fruits at threats, or break them with their right hands for other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME想模仿树木，可精力积蓄太多，根本站不久。它试着静止时，眼里会流露明显的挣扎，最后还是放弃，四处狂奔。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME wishes to mimic trees, but contains far too much pent-up energy to remain still for long. When it tries to stand motionless, visible strain can be seen in its eyes before it gives up and runs around wildly.

entry: POKENAME虽通常住海，有时也游进河流，把自己插在较浅水里，只为四下看看、探索一番。与树才怪不同，它很爱被浇水。
author: bobosmith01
source: Despite typically being an ocean-dweller, POKENAME may occasionally swim into rivers and plant itself in moderately shallow water just to look around and explore. Unlike Sudowoodo, it loves being watered.

entry: POKENAME自信，努力鼓励别人做最好的自己，哪怕有点与众不同。常接近缺信心、需要支持的宝可梦，赞美鼓励。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are confident Pokémon that strive to inspire others to be their best selves, even if they stand out a bit. They often approach insecure Pokémon who need support and offer encouragement and praise.

entry: 野生POKENAME装气球，盼找到家。可身体沉重，只有小孩与容易受骗者信。
author: alestrius
source: Wild POKENAME imitates a balloon to try and find a home. Given their heavy weight, this mimicry is only effective on young children and the easily fooled.

entry: POKENAME栖在树枝上，借周围环境伪装自己。身上的球体由铁构成，脱落后，常被猎人收集起来，作为武器的弹药。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME sits on tree branches, camouflaging itself with its surroundings. The orbs on its body are made of iron and once they fall off, hunters will often collect them and use them as ammunition for their weapons.

entry: POKENAME群舞，同步开心摇枝。可谁靠太近，就吓得逃走。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME dance in groups, cheerfully shaking their branches in sync. However, they will flee in fear if anyone gets too close.

entry: POKENAME随风挥翼，模仿灌木枝摇。偶尔动作太热情，不慎毁掉伪装。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME waves its wings with the wind, mimicking a shrub's billowing branches. Sometimes, it gets too enthusiastic with its gestures, accidentally ruining its disguise.

entry: POKENAME轻易融入森林，常被当灌木。所带树果其实剧毒，吃后必须立即就医。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are easily able to blend in with forests, usually mistaken for bushes. The berries they carry are actually incredibly poisonous and require immediate medical attention after being eaten.

entry: POKENAME球状身体存甜树液，春天释放，引小虫宝可梦。受威胁便挺硬茎，以惊人力道抽击。
author: ilija09
source: POKENAME stores sweet sap inside its bulbous body, releasing it during spring to attract tiny Bug Pokémon. When threatened, it stiffens its stem and lashes out with surprising force.

entry: 太多水渗入、损伤岩石身体时，POKENAME身上就会积起黄斑。它总坐在有光照的地方，及时晒干水分，免得造成永久损害。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME accumulates yellow spots if too much water seeps through and damages its rock body. By sitting in front of light rays all the time, it can dry off any water on it before it causes permanent damage.

entry: POKENAME藏在树间装树，虽然比那些树矮得多。谁看得太仔细，就会遭它挥动刺球攻击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides among the trees, pretending to be one despite being much shorter than those it mimics. It swings its spine-covered orbs at anything that scrutinizes it too closely.

entry: POKENAME遇到威胁，就会蜷起四肢，假装成一丛五彩蘑菇。即使骗不过对方，背上石质的马勃菌，也足够坚硬，能抵御大多数袭击者。
author: .jerden
source: If POKENAME is threatened, it will curl up its limbs and pretend to be a patch of colorful mushrooms. Even if this isn't convincing, the rocky puffballs on its back are hard enough to resist most attackers.

entry: POKENAME学别的宝可梦唱歌，准确惊人。受威胁便静止，展开叶状冠毛，装小棕榈树。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME mimic the songs of other Pokémon with remarkable accuracy. If they feel threatened, they will stand completely still, spreading their leafy hair-crests to pass as small palm trees.

entry: POKENAME像大蘑菇，却由石组成。撒出的石孢子边长边缓慢侵蚀岩石，整群甚至能破坏建筑地基。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME's body resembles a large mushroom, it is made of stone. The stony spores it scatters slowly erode rock as they grow, and a colony of POKENAME can undermine the foundations of a building.

entry: POKENAME藏小灌木，手臂作枝。一下雨，就能见大群跑去躲。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME camouflages itself in small bushes, with its arms acting as branches. When its starts raining, swarms of them can be seen running for cover.

entry: POKENAME朝敌人扔像木棍的石头。装树太像，有时得好几天才被看穿。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME throws rocks that look like sticks at opponents. POKENAME can camouflage like a tree so well that sometimes it takes days for someone to realize it's not a tree.

entry: POKENAME天性好斗，随时愿切磋。招牌连招是连续两拳，再用头顶原木向下砸。
author: sk372
source: Scrappy by nature, POKENAME is always up for a good sparring session. Its signature combo is a one-two punch with its fists before a downward strike using the log on its cranium.

entry: POKENAME遇险反应矛盾：一颗头静止，一颗想近战，第三颗留后方，抛泥扔石。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has conflicting responses to being put in danger. One remains perfectly still, another attempts to engage in close combat, while the third stays back and lobs dirt and stone.

entry: POKENAME能数天不动，甚至站着睡。耐心等小宝可梦的动静，靠够近就扑去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can remain motionless for days on end, even remaining asleep whilst standing. They patiently wait until they sense the movement of a small Pokémon nearby, pouncing on it when it gets close enough.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，靠球团般的绿毛，融入灌木丛。受打扰，它就向惊醒自己的对象使出喷射火焰，再找新的藏身处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME rely on their bulbous green fur to disguise them amongst bushes and shrubs while they sleep. If they're disturbed, they lash out with a Flamethrower at whoever roused them before finding a new place to hide away.

entry: POKENAME喜欢藏在木材场，将自己埋进原木堆，只露出脖子以上，再跳出来，试着吓路人一跳。它们似乎没发觉，巨大的笑脸，早已让自己在木堆中格外显眼。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME enjoy hiding in lumberyards, burying themselves up to their neck in piles of logs. They leap out in an effort to surprise those who pass by, seemingly unaware that their giant grins make them easy to pick out amongst the piled-up wood.

entry: POKENAME爱藏木场，埋进原木堆，再跳出吓路人。每次成功，都咧出巨大的笑。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME enjoy hiding in lumberyards, burying themselves within piles of logs. They leap out in an effort to surprise those who pass by, invariably sporting a gigantic grin when they successfully startle someone.

entry: POKENAME把惊人精神能量导入手持树枝，施加幻象，让几乎所有看见的生物都信只是一棵树。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME channels its incredible mental energy into the tree limbs it carries around. This energy casts an illusion effect that makes almost any creature that sees POKENAME believe it is nothing more than a simple tree.

entry: POKENAME似乎真信自己是树，常举枝久久静立。虽整天不锻炼，肌肉仍坚实强壮。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME seem to believe that they are trees, often staying still for long periods of time while holding branches. Despite not working out throughout the day, their muscles remain firm and strong.

entry: POKENAME嘴形如铃，却不会响。仍常在钟楼，听见钟声就摇身体。
author: whiteupgrade
source: While POKENAME's mouth is shaped like a bell, it doesn't ring. Despite this, POKENAME is commonly found in bell towers and shakes its body when it can hear a bell ring.

entry: 有人见POKENAME在门外静站数小时，盼被迎进家。一进屋，找到什么都吃，次日便消失。
author: pokejirkaok
source: People have reported POKENAME standing perfectly still outside their doors for hours, hoping to be welcomed into their homes. Once inside, it eats whatever food it can find before disappearing the next day.

entry: POKENAME动作极慢，常坐着不动，无意间成了很好的灌木伪装。缓慢的移动，连背上的东西也几乎察觉不到。
author: glacierwing
source: A POKENAME is very slow and often sits still, which unintentionally makes a good bush disguise. Its movements are so sluggish that anything on its back barely notices.

entry: POKENAME主体视力差，便用手上每个绿色部分的眼睛观察。它摆各种怪姿势，尽量扩大监视范围。
author: sk372
source: The main body has poor eyesight, so POKENAME uses the functional eyes on each green segment of its hands to better survey its surroundings. It goes through a variety of odd poses in order to maximize surveillance.

entry: POKENAME将自己埋在土里，伪装成幼树。住在其他树旁，既能让模仿更加逼真，也能确保根系固定土壤，不被雨水冲走。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME buries itself in dirt to disguise itself as a young tree. It resides near other trees, both to further sell its mimicry and to ensure that the dirt is rooted and won't wash away in rain.

entry: POKENAME有些刺端的绿球像深水炸弹。它脱球游走，球随后猛烈爆开，向四方射锐片。
author: sk372
source: The green orbs on the end of some of POKENAME's spines act like depth charges. They detach from it before it swims away, before bursting explosively and launching sharp shards in every direction.

entry: POKENAME兴奋爱玩，喜欢抛接球体、互相滚着传递。信任的训练家若做噩梦，就会将恶梦收进球里，帮对方解脱。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are very excitable by nature. They enjoy juggling and rolling their orbs back and forth to each other. If a POKENAME trusts a Trainer who is experiencing nightmares, the POKENAME will contain the bad dream within its orb to aid them.

entry: POKENAME和善亲切，摆动球体，安抚躁动的人入睡。奇怪的是，对站着的人最有效，还能帮助维持平衡、提供保护。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are very pleasant and kind by nature. They swing their orbs to soothe restless people to sleep. However, this technique seems to be most effective when their targets are standing up, granting them balance and protection as well.

entry: POKENAME是两栖生物，无论水中还是陆地，都捕食虫属性宝可梦。吃饱常叠成一小摞，睡在彼此的睡莲叶上。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are amphibious creatures that eat Bug-type Pokémon on land and in water. When they are full, it is common for them to form to sleep atop each other's lily pads in a small stack.

entry: POKENAME边舞边以骨杖散泡，低声鸣叫回荡。若听来哀伤，别的宝可梦可能跟哭；若欢快，有些就同舞。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME dances as it scatters bubbles with its wand of bone, letting out low, echoing cries. When POKENAME sounds mournful, other Pokémon may start crying, but whenever it sounds joyful, some of them will dance alongside it.

entry: POKENAME头骨密实，比钻石硬。周围下雨，就用骨棒敲头，像在打鼓。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have incredibly dense skulls that are harder than diamond. When it is raining around them, they will use their bone clubs upon their own heads like they are beating on drums.

entry: POKENAME靠舌头抓取枝上的树果。训练家揉一揉它脸颊的腺体，就能使其张嘴；需要服苦药时，这很方便。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their tongue to grab berries from tree branches. By rubbing the glands on their cheeks, a Trainer can force them to open their mouth, which is perfect when they need to take bitter medicine.

entry: POKENAME可凭青柠色茧与腹上黄旋纹辨认。茧放薄凝胶，让它难抓牢。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be identified by the distinct lime color of their cocoon and the yellow swirl on their stomach. Their cocoon releases a thin gel that makes them harder to grab onto.

entry: POKENAME用河草裹身保湿，藏河床，混在芦苇里避敌。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME covers its body in river plants to keep its body moist. It hides in riverbeds, camouflaging itself amongst the reeds to avoid predators.

entry: POKENAME家乡湖泊无天敌，野外数量泛滥。一场广告宣传格外成功，当地人如今开始把它切方块作刺身生吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME suffer through overpopulation in the wild, as the lakes they are from have no natural predators. After a particularly successful advertising campaign, locals have now adopted eating them as raw cubes of sashimi.

entry: POKENAME是关都少数湖泊的特有种，没有天敌。它是当地佳肴，科学家也提倡食用，以减少泛滥的数量。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are endemic to a few lakes in the Kanto region and have no natural predators. They are a regional delicacy, and consumption is promoted by the scientists to reduce overpopulation.

entry: POKENAME把泡泡拉成屏障，出奇结实，挡许多强攻。它自居高贵国王，到哪都趾高气扬。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME stretches bubbles into barriers that are surprisingly solid and can withstand against many forceful attacks. It acts as if it is a noble king, strutting with a pompous arrogance wherever it is.

entry: POKENAME喜欢满身泥巴在雨里跳舞，任雨点冲刷，同时兴奋地转动强劲的钳子。
author: d_numeritos
source: POKENAME loves to dance in the rain while covered in mud. It likes to energetically spin its powerful pincers, as the raindrops wash over it.

entry: POKENAME不擅长游泳，常被栖居河流的水势卷得东倒西歪。头顶的卷曲鱼鳍，能确立群体中的等级；鳍最出众者，会受到王者般的礼遇。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME are not skilled swimmers, and are often tossed about by the currents of the rivers they reside in. The curled fins on top of their heads help establish a pecking order among schools, with the most impressive fins earning royal treatment.

entry: POKENAME叫声大到能造成永久听损与内脏伤害，让目标失去行动能力，因为身体70%都是共鸣腔。
author: radiance8990
source: POKENAME can incapacitate its targets with cries so loud that they cause permanent hearing loss and internal organ damage. This is because resonance chambers make up 70% of its body.

entry: POKENAME吼声像电流噼啪与雷鸣，会吓其他雷伊布，让毛本能竖起，放电回应。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME bellows noises that sound like crackling electricity and thunder. These croaks scare other Jolteon and instinctively cause their fur to stand on end and discharge their electricity in response.

entry: POKENAME找下雨或流水的网络视频，在屏幕角静看。若点它，就开心蛙鸣，跳走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME searches for online videos featuring rain or flowing water and quietly watches from the corner of the screen. If clicked, it croaks happily and hops away.

entry: 野生POKENAME会占据整片池塘，堆起岩石，做成能躺卧的“王座”，俯瞰新领地。头上的卷毛越长，它就越骄傲高慢。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME will lay claim to an entire pond and stack up rocks to form a "throne" that they can lay upon to survey their new domain. The longer the curled hair upon a POKENAME's head, the more prideful and haughty it is.

entry: POKENAME长舌沉重，能兜住、卷回一小片森林全部水果与树果的收成。得用双臂拍身体，才把舌头射出。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have a long, heavy tongue capable of holding and reeling in a small forest's entire haul of fruits and berries. They must use both of their arms to smack their own bodies to shoot out their own tongue.

entry: 据说POKENAME把筑巢地变成多雨湿地。翼膜让游泳与飞行同样迅捷。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is said POKENAME turns the areas where it nests into rainy, marshy lands. The membranes of its wings allow it to swim as swiftly as it flies.

entry: POKENAME几乎什么都吃，长舌会黏住任何稍像食物的东西。传闻某些岛屿上，各色个体组成与世隔绝的社会。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can eat almost anything, latching onto anything remotely edible-looking with its long tongue. Rumors persist of islands where POKENAME of all colors live in their own secluded society.

entry: POKENAME翼上植被随成长环境不同，湿地与沼泽个体差异尤其明显。只要被尊为国王，就照料供养较小的宝可梦。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's wings have different vegetation growth depending on its upbringing, with key differences between wetland and marsh POKENAME. In exchange for declaring it as their king, it cares for and provides for other smaller Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME大体格让多数宝可梦畏缩，多数人却觉得无害友善。它所到便有雨，因此海上称为“风暴使者”。
author: soup1900
source: To most Pokémon, POKENAME's large physique causes them to cower in fear of it, but to most people, it looks very harmless and friendly. On the seas, it is known as “the bringer of storms” since rain follows its presence.

entry: 研究表明POKENAME能改变当地湿度，迫使巢边形成沼泽。翼膜利用层流，在空中、水中都能高速推进。
author: fiordaliso
source: Research shows POKENAME alters local humidity, forcing marshes to form near its nest. Its wing membranes utilize laminar flow, enabling high-velocity propulsion in both aerial and aquatic environments.

entry: POKENAME先用精神能量形成的泡泡裹住全身，再沉到湖底睡觉。它的鼾声响亮，像隆隆的蛙鸣，无论潜得多深，从水面上也听得见。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME encases itself in a bubble of psychic energy before descending to the bottom of lakes to sleep. The loud, croaking rumble of its snoring can be heard from above the water no matter how deep it has dived.

entry: POKENAME常来花园池塘洗澡玩水。清晨互相啁啾蛙鸣，常响到吵醒附近居民。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are frequent visitors to garden ponds, washing themselves and playing in the water. They make croaking chirps to call to one another in the early morning light, often loud enough to wake nearby residents.

entry: POKENAME每天同一时刻，都会高声呱鸣。野外族群又常齐声合唱，借此驱走天敌。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME croak loudly at the same time each day. Wild populations often synchronize their croaks, which helps drive away potential predators.

entry: POKENAME无声低飞湖池，伏击岸边猎物。休息时仰浮水中，让四翼放松，也能把翼当桨，快速安静地掠过水面。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME silently flies low over lakes and ponds to ambush prey on the shore. POKENAME rests its four wings by floating on its back in the water, but can also use them like paddles to glide quickly but quietly across the surface.

entry: POKENAME既不善游，也不善储电。开心会拍前肢或肚皮，细小电击便四散飞出。
author: infinex21
source: It is inept at swimming and at storing electricity. When happy, a POKENAME will clap its forelimbs together or against its belly, which sends small jolts flying about.

entry: 呱呱鸣叫时，它们的喉咙会泛起电光。夜晚，POKENAME聚居的森林，既有悦目的光，也有动听的鸣声。
author: blitzydragon
source: Their throats glow with electricity when croaking. Forests with POKENAME flocks look and sound beautiful at night.

entry: POKENAME鼓起羊毛，让叫声更响。雄性毛越大、越卷，叫得越响，也越受雌性与年幼蚊香羊尊敬。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME puffs up its wool to make its cries louder. Male POKENAME with bigger, curlier coats have louder calls and garner more respect from females and young Poliffy.

entry: POKENAME边跳舞边呱呱叫，吸引同类加入表演。舞蹈与杂乱的叫声，能一同唤来大雨，浇灌家园的热带植物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME utters a croaking cry while it dances, meant to draw in others of its kind to join in the performance. The dance and cacophony of cries together can summon heavy rain to water the tropical plants of its home.

entry: 有记录显示，POKENAME会聚成大群，沿急河漂下。有人说，遇见能听到“快乐的蛙鸣”。
author: zeeroooo
source: POKENAME have a history of gathering into large pods and floating down fast rivers. Some say you can hear "croaks of joy" when you encounter them.

entry: 城都古记录偶有描述极像POKENAME的生物。据说，它在适应成现代模样前，远古可能正是这形态。
author: sk372
source: Historical records from Johto's past occasionally reference a creature looking very similar to POKENAME. It's believed that POKENAME may have looked this way in ancient history before adapting to its modern form.

entry: 一座池塘只许一只雄性POKENAME当王，取得最多食物与雌性伴侣。它得不断战斗保王位，否则很快被赶出家。
author: periperi_chicken
source: Only one male POKENAME can be the king of its pond and gets the most food and females. The king POKENAME will fight constantly to keep its crown; otherwise, it is quickly kicked out of its home.

entry: POKENAME最爱池塘，常与孩子玩数小时。最喜欢石头剪刀布，每只都有固定偏爱的一招，总是出它。
author: heal_fire
source: Ponds are among POKENAME's favorite places, and they are seen playing for hours with children. POKENAME's favorite game is rock-paper-scissors, and each individual has a favorite move that they always choose.

entry: POKENAME飞过湿地湖泊，用长黏舌捕虫。受更大宝可梦威胁，就潜水躲藏。
author: fancyskunk
source: POKENAME fly around marshes and lakes, catching insects with their long, sticky tongues. When threatened by a larger Pokémon, POKENAME dive into the water to hide.

entry: POKENAME脸上的卷毛能伸长，抓取最远两米处的物件。毛尖覆着黏胶，碰到的东西就逃不掉。孩子们相互争吵时，它便会用这项本领。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The curled hair on POKENAME's face can extend and grab things up to 2 metres away. The tips are coated in a sticky gel that ensures that anything they touch doesn't get away. POKENAME uses this on their children when they argue with each other.

entry: POKENAME躺在静水中或附近，很少动。下雨更活跃、更爱叫，成群时简直像齐声“唱歌”。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME lie in or near still waters, and they rarely move. When it rains, they become more active and more vocal as well; in fact, groups of POKENAME effectively "sing" in unison during rain.

entry: POKENAME用精神能量，始终在身下保持水洼，免得皮肤干。每个沼泽群落中，尾巴最卷的被认作首领。
author: ambrosia04
source: To prevent their skin from drying out, POKENAME use psychic energy to constantly keep pools of water beneath them. In each of their swamp colonies, the individual with the curliest tail is recognized as the leader.

entry: POKENAME踩莲叶童子的头，跳过水面。有时睡在它身上，另有宝可梦又来睡自己背上的睡莲叶。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hop across bodies of water by landing atop the heads of Lotad. Sometimes when they fall asleep on a Lotad, another Pokémon comes to sleep on the lily pad on their backs.

entry: POKENAME跳跃出色，一跃距离超过体长20倍。身体滑，捕食者难抓，腾空时尤其如此。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are superb jumpers and can leap over 20 times their own body length. Their slippery bodies make them difficult for predators to grab, especially while airborne.

entry: POKENAME散甜香、发各种蛙鸣，吸引虫属性宝可梦。背上鳞茎授粉后，有些会选择吃掉传粉者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME attract Bug-type Pokémon by releasing a sweet scent and producing various croaks. Once the bulb on their back is pollinated, some POKENAME opt to eat the pollinator.

entry: POKENAME透明壳像两栖宝可梦的蛋，却坚韧得多，多数攻击会直接弹开或滑走。
author: moopse
source: POKENAME's transparent shell resembles the egg of an amphibious Pokémon. However, it is much more durable, with most attacks bouncing or sliding right off.

entry: 它身周冷气足以让小虫宝可梦行动迟缓，轻松捕获。找不到，就退而吃草属性宝可梦。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: The cold air around this Pokémon's body is enough to make small Bug-type Pokémon sluggish enough to be easily caught. If it can't find any, it settles for Grass-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME鼓起弹性皮肤，让振动在硬壳间回响，用全身扩音。若嘴闭着、头发却震动，就是准备发出强大蛙鸣。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME can use its entire body to enhance its cry, inflating its flexible skin and making the vibrations echo off its hard shell.  If its mouth is closed but the hair on its head is vibrating, it's preparing a powerful croak.

entry: POKENAME黏舌能伸长超过20英尺，从空中捉小鸟宝可梦。羽毛接触不到水，就会干燥易碎，因此只在大雨时狩猎。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's sticky tongue can extend to over 20 feet long, allowing for it to snatch smaller Bird Pokémon out of the sky. Its feathers turn dry and brittle when not exposed to water, so POKENAME only hunts when there is heavy rainfall.

entry: POKENAME只在雨天现身，吸水润肤。开始干燥时，会产稠黏液，已证实是极好的皮肤保湿物。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME only appear on rainy days, soaking up the water to hydrate its skin. When its starts getting dry, it produces a thick mucus that has been proven to be a fantastic skin moisturizer.

entry: POKENAME在沼泽繁盛，沿底部漂着吃藻。蚊香蝌蚪群常黏在它鳍的下侧，借此避难。
author: santon5512
source: Thriving in marshy environments, POKENAME drift along the swamp floor, feeding on algae. Pods of Poliwag often cling to the undersides of these Pokémon's fins, finding shelter beneath them.

entry: POKENAME用火属性攻击必须小心。攻击含强毒，连被烧物的余烬灰也会污染家乡水域。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME must be careful when using its Fire-type attacks. As the attacks are laced with powerful toxins, even the embers or ashes of whatever the fire strikes can pollute the water it calls home.

entry: POKENAME用长黏舌捉水下迅速移动的食物。受惊就用强后腿跃空，再笨拙扑翼飞走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their long, sticky tongue to snatch up fast moving food from under the water. When they are startled, they use their powerful hind legs to leap into the air before flapping awkwardly away.

entry: POKENAME夜聚河岸歌唱，先大声蛙鸣，再拖成嘶嘶声。最想得关注，训练家得宠它，不然就不听令。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME gathers along riverbanks at night to sing, beginning with a loud croak that trails off into a hiss. It desires attention above all else, so Trainers must pamper it, lest it decide to ignore orders.

entry: POKENAME开始滚，长舌便绕身保护。停下时常黏满东西，弄得不舒服。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's long tongue wraps around itself to protect its body when it begins rolling. Many things are often stuck to the tongue once it finally stops, causing it discomfort.

entry: POKENAME爱用头触角随意引暴雨，打乱气象专家预报。软件更新让它迅速查专业网站，实时掌握最新预测。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME loves to upset weather experts' forecasts by triggering rainstorms at will using the antenna on its head. It stays up to date in real time by checking specialized websites, which it can access quickly thanks to its updates.

entry: POKENAME尾毛能产生极易溶解的颜料，它们用来在栖居池塘旁的岩石上画风景。作品转瞬即逝，每逢雨来，就会被冲洗干净。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME produce a highly soluble pigment from the fur on their tails. They use this pigment to paint landscapes on rocks and stones around the ponds they live in. Their artwork is ephemeral, washing away whenever the rains come.

entry: POKENAME战斗沿用战舞郎的旋转技，却藏一手：长舌如伸缩鞭，让高速旋转的它也能打中原本够不到的敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME utilizes Hitmontop's signature spinning fighting style in combat, but with an extra secret. Using its lengthy tongue, it can attack enemies out of range, acting as an extendable whip while it spins at rapid pace.

entry: POKENAME顽皮，会扯泳客的脚吓人。常见它闹着把其他宝可梦摔下湖中石头，自己夺冠。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has an impish personality and will tug on the feet of swimmers to startle them. It is often spotted playfully wrestling other Pokémon off rocks in the middle of lakes to be crowned champion.

entry: POKENAME穿越时间，招不同年代的蚊香蝌蚪、蚊香君入群，自己领导。高声一叫，就开多个时间通道，让子民来身边。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME travels across time, recruiting Poliwag and Poliwhirl from different eras to join its group with it as the leader. When it lets out a loud croak, multiple time portals will open to allow its subjects to gather around it.

entry: POKENAME爱雨中舞，也爱石头剪刀布。能预知对手下一手，因此两只一起玩，想得太多，最后谁也不出。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME love to dance in the rain and play their favorite game: rock paper scissors. They are able to predict their opponent's next move, so when two POKENAME play this game, they think too much and end up never choosing a move.

entry: POKENAME磁场集中在舌状附肢。市政工人常请它打捞废金属，清理城市水道。
author: mepp.
source: The magnetic field emitted by POKENAME is concentrated on its tongue-like appendage. Civic workers looking to keep city waterways clean often use POKENAME to dredge up discarded metal.

entry: POKENAME乐观开朗，体形又大，常在训练家学校陪孩子玩。察觉危险时，触角便会摇摆。
author: teatedtiten
source: Because of POKENAME's positive demeanor and bulk, they are commonly found in Trainer Schools playing with children. Their antennae sway when they sense danger.

entry: POKENAME在久已沉寂的破火山口形成的湖里，建立等级分明的群落。它以外貌为傲，打理最好者领导大家，唱震耳合唱。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME build hierarchical colonies in lakes made from long dormant calderas. POKENAME takes great pride in its appearance, with the most well-groomed member of a colony leading the others in a deafening choir.

entry: POKENAME靠跳与掘地移动。年纪越大，头上那根毛越卷。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME move by hopping and by burrowing through the ground. The older they grow, the more curled their singular hairs become.

entry: POKENAME舌头能变形，插入电脑接口。一插进去，就快速吸数据。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tongue can change shape to fit into computer ports. Once inserted, it absorbs data from the machine at a rapid pace.

entry: POKENAME巡视流经森林的溪流，清除天然或人为造成的阻塞，维护环境的健康。头顶弯曲的触角，让它能极为准确地预测降雨。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME patrols the streams that flow through the woods and clears them of natural or man-made obstructions, thereby preserving the health of the environment. The curved antenna on its head allows it to predict rain with extreme accuracy.

entry: POKENAME中，耳最长最尖者为王。它把蛋黏背，保护滋养，直到即将孵化。
author: potatoforged
source: The POKENAME with the longest and sharpest ears is considered king. It sticks eggs to its back to protect and nourish them until they're ready to hatch.

entry: POKENAME爱边泼水边啁啾歌唱。受惊或威胁，歌就变刺耳走调，驱赶敌人。捕食者若继续逼近，就吐火球。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME loves to chirp and sing while splashing in the water. When startled or threatened, POKENAME's song turns sour and pitchy to scare away foes. If a predator continues to advance on this Pokémon, POKENAME will spit fireballs at it.

entry: POKENAME住沼泽等泥多湿重之地。利爪能挖穿埋在泥中的任何岩石。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live in marshes and anywhere else that is rife with mud and humidity. With their claws, they can dig through any rocks buried in the mud.

entry: POKENAME快活友善，住湖泊沼泽。干旱时，会成群举行大型求雨，让大地恢复活力。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME are jolly, friendly Pokémon that live in lakes and swamps. In times of drought, groups of POKENAME will perform a mass Rain Dance to rejuvenate the land.

entry: POKENAME双腿是有记录中最强的一类，轻松将自己弹过广阔海岸巢区。用头上厚鳍争首领，胜者自豪展示胸旋纹。
author: mspaintbrush
source: POKENAME's legs are some of the strongest ever recorded, easily catapulting them across their vast nests on the coastline. They fight for leadership using the thick fins on their heads, with the winner proudly displaying the spiral on its chest.

entry: 多只POKENAME相聚，就合唱美丽交响。使用超能力时，头毛会卷成紧密螺旋。
author: bacondlx
source: If multiple POKENAME are gathered together, they will begin to sing a beautiful symphony. The curled hair on a POKENAME's head will form a tight spiral when it uses its psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME很友好，可背上毒刺让触碰危险，相处得小心。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME is very friendly. Unfortunately, the toxic barbs on its back makes them dangerous to the touch, so its important to handle them with care.

entry: POKENAME找木头筑坝，总先用头卷观察选中木块，再啃咬或搬走。这检查能看出什么，仍不清楚。
author: sk372
source: When finding wood for building dams, POKENAME always observes its chosen chunk with the curl on its head before gnawing or carrying it away. It's not yet known what it ascertains from this method of examination.

entry: POKENAME用宽大的嘴吹出大泡泡，与同类交流。野外的对手会咬住彼此的卷毛，粗暴拉扯，展示支配地位。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME blows large bubbles from its wide mouth to communicate with others of its kind. Rivals in the wild will bite down on the other's hair curl and tug it roughly as a show of dominance.

entry: POKENAME伪装惊人，轻易融入环境。头一潜水，就与普通睡莲叶无异。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have amazing camouflage abilities that allow them to blend into their environment. When their head is submerged underwater, they are indistinguishable from a normal lily pad.

entry: POKENAME体型巨大，喜欢水里打盹。背上睡莲叶够大，可让几只宝可梦同睡。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are massive creatures that enjoy taking naps in the water. The lily pad on their back is large enough for several Pokémon to nap on.

entry: POKENAME生活在大湖中，飘浮于水面附近，沐浴阳光。需要离水时，它们会带上巨大的睡莲叶遮阳，帮助身体保持湿润。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in large lakes, floating near the surface and soaking in the sunlight. When they need to leave the water they will do so by carrying gigantic lily pads with them to shade themselves from the sun and help keep them from drying out.

entry: POKENAME头上伸出的粉色附肢，能扫过表面，感知其他宝可梦的细微痕迹。太敏感也成弱点，沿附肢分布的尖刺保护它。
author: deadshields
source: The pink appendage coming out of POKENAME's head is a sensory organ, capable of detecting faint traces of other Pokémon by being raked across surfaces. The organ's sensitivity makes it a weak point, the spikes along its length defending it from harm.

entry: POKENAME住湖岸，嘹亮蛙鸣让距水1英里内的谁都知道位置。它们一互叫，谈话就困难，居民很困扰。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live along the banks of lakes, their bellowing croaks loudly announcing their location to anyone within a mile of the water. Their presence is a nuisance to local residents, conversation becoming difficult when they call out to each other.

entry: POKENAME低沉蛙鸣能指挥天气。一叫便下雨，声振还让地面像远雷般震动。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME's deep croaking commands weather patterns. When it does, rain begins to fall, and the vibrations from its voice can shake the ground like distant thunder.

entry: POKENAME只能靠舌头捧着的独眼看，抬眼在诡异静默中扫描周围。被盯住的人说，会看见令人不安的景象。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME can only see through the single eye held by its tongue, which it raises to scan its surroundings in eerie silence. Those caught in its gaze report unsettling visions.

entry: POKENAME用脱离身体的眼扫描大片区域，常早早发现猎物或入侵者。偏远地区守卫很喜欢，依靠它充当活安防系统。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME uses its detached eye to scan vast areas, often spotting prey or intruders long before they're aware. It's favoured by watchmen in remote regions, who rely on it as a living security system.

entry: POKENAME鬃毛不断产富矿雨，滋养途经之地的土壤与植物。它花很久种繁花，引最可口的虫来吃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's mane constantly generates mineral-rich rain that helps nourish the ground and plant-life of the areas it travels through. It spends long periods of time growing plentiful flowers that attract the most delicious insects for it to eat.

entry: POKENAME宽大的荷叶，是其他两栖伙伴的避难所。它走遍湿地，寻找疲惫的生命，收留它们。
author: thropp
source: POKENAME's large lily pad provides sanctuary for its fellow amphibians. It roams the wetlands, searching for weary creatures to take in.

entry: POKENAME不爱深水，总贴近浅处。头卷分泌苦液，阻止捕食者。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is known to dislike deep water and sticks close to shallow water. The curl on its head secretes a bitter-tasting fluid to deter predators.

entry: POKENAME通常住池塘，与同类争水域霸权。黄色金属突起覆盖身体，用于强力攻击，其中最显眼的在头顶形成王冠。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME usually inhabits ponds, where it battles other members of its species to dominate the waters it calls home. Its body is covered with yellow metal growths used for powerful attacks, the most distinctive forming a crown atop its head.

entry: POKENAME靠电磁，让小型鸟状机械单体围绕主体运转。攻击时将其发射，同时用巨鼻共鸣发出响亮声音。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME use electromagnetism to keep their smaller, bird-like drones in orbit around their main bodies. They attack by launching these units as projectiles while resonating loud sounds through their massive nose.

entry: POKENAME吸收池水与雨水。天一干，就呱鸣着引来蚊香君与蚊香蝌蚪，请它们替自己淋水。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME absorbs water from ponds or rain. When the weather is dry, it croaks to attract Poliwhirl and Poliwag to shower them.

entry: POKENAME嘴里不停涌云。云落下的雨，帮助抵御恶劣天气。
author: moopse
source: A constant stream of clouds spews from POKENAME's maw. The rain that falls from these clouds help to protect it against the elements.

entry: POKENAME高声蛙鸣，让附近花朵释放安抚香。强腿能让它跳得极高。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME release bellowing croaks from their mouths that make nearby flowers release soothing aromas. Using their powerful legs, they can leap incredibly high.

entry: POKENAME不用走，而靠无底、永不滞流的水洼滑行。它靠近时，训练家得留心脚下。
author: jacklemon
source: POKENAME uses its bottomless and never-stagnating puddle to glide around instead of walking. Trainers should watch their step when POKENAME moves near them.

entry: POKENAME夜里游荡古遗迹，举灯照暗。许多人觉得可爱，它却极危险，会用藏刃刺太靠近者。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME can be found at night roaming ancient ruins, lighting up the darkness with the lantern they carry. Although many find them cute, they are incredibly dangerous, stabbing at those who come too close with a hidden blade.

entry: 每逢满月之夜，POKENAME便与同类聚集，放声高歌。可爱的外表让它成为热门宠物，它也常挥动双臂，央求训练家抱起自己，显得格外爱被搂着。
author: periperi_chicken
source: Every night on a full moon, POKENAME gathers with others to belt out songs. Its cute appearance makes it a popular pet, and it often waves its arms to ask its Trainer to pick it up, showing its love of being held.

entry: POKENAME生活在池塘里，藏在水下，只露出像莲花的头顶。大群小虫飞过池面时，它们便浮出水，用长舌抓来吃。
author: keiracm35_
source: POKENAME live in ponds where they hide with only the tops of their heads sticking out, which look like lotus flowers. When many small bugs fly over a pond, POKENAME come out of the water to catch them with their long tongues and feed.

entry: POKENAME住在湖泊、池塘底部，织出导电的丝网，再用卷毛触碰，电击落网的猎物。唯有大雨时，它们才浮上水面，望向天空，留意闪电。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME live at the bottom of lakes and ponds, weaving a web of conductive strands, which they touch with their curls to shock prey that gets caught in it. They only rise to the surface during heavy rain and watch the sky for lightning.

entry: POKENAME控制环境湿度，能将水分聚成团，化作雨云，也能聚集能量，点燃自己。它的云一烧起，就会迸散成大片蒸汽。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are able to control the levels of moisture in an environment, either packing together bundles of moisture to form into rain clouds or gathering energy to ignite themselves. If one of their clouds burns, it will burst into a field of steam.

entry: 沼泽有时能见POKENAME随自然声摇摆。它似乎爱班卓琴，有些一拿到，就会弹。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are sometimes found in swamps, swaying back and forth to the sounds of nature. It seems that POKENAME enjoy banjo music, with some playing the instrument if they can get their hands on one.

entry: 若在神秘池塘遇POKENAME，送一件物品，它就看透你的心。心灵纯洁，物品便增强；否则会被烧毁，彻底失去。
author: teatedtiten
source: If you stumble upon a POKENAME in a mysterious pond and give it an item, it looks into your heart. If your heart is pure, the item is strengthened. If not, the item will be incinerated and lost.

entry: POKENAME精力躁动，常在栖居的池塘里互相交战，想击败对手，统领同伴。它们用紧握的拳头或迅捷的舌头，猛击敌人。
author: vic1312
source: Filled with restless energy, POKENAME regularly battle one another in the ponds they call home. They seek to triumph over their rivals and become the ruler of their peers. They will pummel their opponents with their clenched fists or quick tongue.

entry: POKENAME睡在瀑边，专注流水声，混在睡莲叶间，躲捕食者。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME sleeps near waterfalls, concentrating on the sound of the water. It blends in with nearby lily pads to conceal itself from predators.

entry: POKENAME伪装成睡莲叶，等待虫属性宝可梦靠近。对方一进入范围，它们便迅速弹出舌头，黏住吞食。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME pretend to be a lily pad and wait for Bug-type Pokémon to come their way. Once they are within range, they flick their tongue out to stick onto the Bug-type Pokémon and eat them.

entry: POKENAME生活在大湖中，飘浮于水面附近，沐浴阳光。需要离水时，它们会带上巨大的睡莲叶遮阳，帮助身体保持湿润。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in large lakes, floating near the surface and soaking in the sunlight. When they need to leave the water they will do so by carrying gigantic lily pads with them to shade themselves from the sun and help keep them from drying out.

entry: POKENAME在栖居森林里遇到干燥地区，就立刻振动头上的触角，唤来雨水。它很爱墨莓果，有时连走数天，只为找结这种果的灌木。
author: fiordaliso
source: If it comes across parched areas within the forests where it lives, it instantly makes it rain by vibrating the antenna on its head. POKENAME is fond of Bluk Berries; sometimes it even walks for days on end in search of bushes that bear that variety.

entry: POKENAME等不知情训练家把自己误认成手偶。据说一套到手上，就开始影响对方心智。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME wait for unassuming trainers to mistake them for a hand puppet. Once on the hand of trainers, it's been said that POKENAME begin to influence their minds.

entry: POKENAME若附在另一只宝可梦头上高声蛙鸣，其他同种宝可梦便开始认那只为首领。研究者仍不懂，它从中有何好处。
author: .jerden
source: If POKENAME attaches itself to the head of another Pokémon and croaks loudly, other Pokémon of the same species will begin to treat that Pokémon as their leader. Researchers are still unsure if POKENAME gets any benefit from this arrangement.

entry: POKENAME若附在另一只宝可梦头上高声蛙鸣，其他同种宝可梦便开始认那只为首领。研究者仍不懂，它从中有何好处。
author: .jerden
source: If POKENAME attaches itself to the head of another Pokémon and croaks loudly, other Pokémon of the same species will begin to treat that Pokémon as their leader. Researchers are still unsure if POKENAME gets any benefit from this arrangement.

entry: POKENAME甜甜啁啾，邀其他宝可梦雨里玩。它与大群住湿地沼泽，需潮湿环境才能茁壮成长。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME invites other Pokémon to play in the rain, calling to them with sweet chirping. It nests with its large flock in marshes and swampy areas, since it needs damp environments to thrive.

entry: POKENAME受惊，角放烟幕，急忙逃跑。可腹部沉重，只能走短短一段，逃脱往往不顺利。
author: teatedtiten
source: When frightened, POKENAME's horn releases a smokescreen and it scurries away. Its abdomen is heavy, so it only walks short distances, making its escape not very successful.

entry: 雨天很少能见POKENAME。它宁愿把甲壳当轮子，而非步行，因为尖刺更容易通过湿滑地形。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can rarely be seen during rainy weather. It prefers to use its carapace as a wheel instead of walking since its spines allow it to traverse slippery terrain more easily.

entry: POKENAME颈褶能感知雨将至。它统治沼泽，要求附近所有宝可梦敬畏自己。
author: hampterbychoice
source: The frills on POKENAME's neck can sense oncoming rain. It rules over the swamps, demanding respect and fear from all nearby Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME两栖，水下能游，陆上能走。常浮沼水，只露鼻孔。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are amphibious creatures that can both swim underwater and walk on land. They can be seen floating atop swampy water with their nostrils above the surface.

entry: POKENAME张嘴，让体内臭味引苍蝇等虫。集够就甩出垃圾构成的舌头，抓一餐虫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME opens its mouth to let the stinky aroma of its insides attract flies and other insects. Once enough gather, it lashes out its tongue, made of garbage, and snatches up a meal of bugs.

entry: POKENAME嘴里收食物碎屑等腐物，转堆肥，滋养所带土。人们发现许多濒危、甚至曾以为灭绝的植物，都被它妥善保存照料。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME collect food scraps and other decaying materials in their mouths, turning them into compost to enrich the soil they hold. Many endangered and even thought to be extinct plants have been found safely held and tended to by these Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME以头卷为傲，仔细梳成恰好的形状。若弄脏或乱，就哭数小时。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very proud of the curl on its head, meticulously preening it to just the right shape. It will cry for hours if something causes it to become dirty or disheveled.

entry: POKENAME目击极少。它在冰水里睡数年，直到察觉蚊香蝌蚪与蚊香君族群的大变动，再发出刺耳尖叫，安抚所有听见的两种宝可梦。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: There have been very few sightings of POKENAME. It slumbers in icy waters for years until it senses a major disturbance in Poliwag and Poliwhirl populations. It then unleashes an ear-splitting cry, which calms all Poliwag and Poliwhirl that hear it.

entry: POKENAME头卷被认为是天线，可接收全球任何无线电信号。金属般的洪亮蛙鸣，会干扰半径1英里内的通信设备。
author: sk372
source: The curl on POKENAME's head is thought to be an antenna that can pick up any radio signal across the world. Its bellowing, metallic croak causes disruption in communication technology within a mile radius.

entry: POKENAME快乐爱玩，是经历抑郁者很好的伙伴。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME have an very joyous, playful nature. They make great companions for those going through depression.

entry: POKENAME水状鬃毛让颈石保持湿润，生出藻类。双方共生，藻在水下提供氧气。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's watery mane keeps the rocks on its neck damp, so algae grows there. This relationship is symbiotic, as the algae provides oxygen underwater.

entry: POKENAME住林溪岸，进食时向流水放孢子，给下游栖地输送关键养分。有些研究者开始称它“食物网之王”。
author: vic1312
source: Residing along the banks of forest creeks, POKENAME release spores into the flowing water while they feed. Due to this essential transfer of nutrients to downriver habitats, some researchers have started calling them the King of the Food Web.

entry: 这种宝可梦躲在池塘里避开捕食者时，背上的花会像睡莲一样浮在水面。夜里，POKENAME成群聚集，一同唱歌，歌声宛如风吹过芦苇。
author: milchik
source: When this Pokémon hides from the predators in the ponds, the flower on its back floats on the water surface akin to a waterlily. At night, groups of POKENAME gather to sing together; their songs sound like a wind blowing over the reeds.

entry: 它们活泼爱玩，喜在雨水坑跳舞泼水，用植物露珠清洁。每只选一片大叶作伞，留用一生。
author: keiracm35_
source: These playful and lively Pokémon love dancing and splashing in rain puddles, and they clean themselves with dew from plants. They each pick large leaves to use as an umbrella and keep them for life.

entry: POKENAME专注冥想，凝神呼吸，让叶上收来的露珠保持平衡。传统说，在静水附近遇见它，会带来繁荣。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME devotes itself to meditation, focusing its breath while balancing dew gathered from its leaf. According to tradition, an encounter with this Pokémon near calm waters brings prosperity.

entry: POKENAME平静睿智，整天在睡莲叶上冥想。有人说，它的内心平衡深到能只凭专注，就让水按意愿荡起波纹。
author: fiordaliso
source: Calm and wise, POKENAME spends its days meditating atop lily pads. Some say its inner balance is so profound that the waters ripple at its command, moved only by its mental focus.

entry: POKENAME善跳，能迅速换位。有时一声叫，便能让其他蛙宝可梦听令。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME has an excellent leap that it uses to quickly change positions. POKENAME can sometimes make other frog Pokémon obey its commands with its cry.

entry: POKENAME爱用长舌舔棒棒糖。虽然可爱，领地意识却可能很强。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME enjoy licking lollipops with their long tongues. Despite their cute appearance, they can be highly territorial.

entry: POKENAME潜池，用睡莲叶藏水中。虫属性宝可梦经过，就射舌捕捉。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME lurks in ponds, using its lily pad as a way to hide in the water. When Bug-type Pokémon pass by, POKENAME launches its tongue forward to catch them.

entry: POKENAME隐秘，却是活力舞者，藏在香蒲、芦苇等高草后跳。一被看见，就朝旁观者喷水，再翻进水。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are elusive yet energetic dancers, as they hide their dancing behind tall reeds like bulrush or phragmites. When they are spotted, they squirt a burst of water onto the onlooker before flipping into the water.

entry: POKENAME一生大多埋在土沙下，只有寻偶才出来。若被挖出，就朝挖它的人愤怒尖叫，直到对方不再打扰。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME spends most of its life buried under dirt or sand, emerging only to find a mate. If it's unearthed, it will angrily squeak at whoever dug it up until it's left alone.

entry: 这形态的POKENAME颜色最易融入土沙，因此比其他形态，更常待在地面。
author: hophoppip
source: This form of POKENAME blends into dirt or sand most easily thanks to its coloration. Thanks to this, it spends more time unburied than other forms of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME通常埋土沙，只露头卷。野生族群里的雄性，会出土，靠卷毛寻伴侣。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME typically stays buried under dirt or sand, with only its curl sticking out. In wild POKENAME populations, the males will leave the dirt to locate a mate by its curl.

entry: POKENAME用超能力，头发就卷起、展直。它泳技高，闭眼也常在湖池仰泳。
author: infinex21
source: The hair atop a POKENAME's head curls and uncurls while it uses psychic powers. These adept swimmers are often seen performing backstrokes in ponds and lakes even with their eyes shut.

entry: POKENAME为威吓敌人，抖身把鬃油搅成泡。泡一碰就起火，因此蹦跳时尤其危险。
author: pokepower
source: To intimidate foes, POKENAME shakes its body to froth up the oils in its mane into bubbles. These bubbles burst into flames on contact, making it particularly dangerous when they hop around.

entry: POKENAME聪明有王者风范，自居池塘与沼泽之王。不向年轻的水属性宝可梦传授智慧时，大多在精心梳理胡须，保持王室仪态。
author: sk372
source: Intelligent and possessing a regal disposition, POKENAME places itself as the king of ponds and swamps. When not imparting wisdom to young Water types, it spends much of its time preening its mustache to perfection befitting royalty.

entry: POKENAME像隐居池塘的贤者，常有蚊香蝌蚪追随求学。它会指点旅人，甚至收养水属性孤儿。
author: sk372
source: A sage of a Pokémon that retires itself to ponds, POKENAME often amasses a following of Poliwag eager to learn from its wisdom. POKENAME is known to offer advice to travelers and even adopt orphaned Water-type Pokémon.

entry: 野生POKENAME为池塘里的最佳位置摔跤。互相抓推，直到一方重重仰倒，站着的便获胜，得以提升池中地位。
author: cobalt0135
source: Wild POKENAME will wrestle each other for prime positions in their ponds. They will grapple and push one another until one falls hard on its back, declaring the standing Pokémon the victor with the rights to move up the pond's hierarchy.

entry: POKENAME经常笨手笨脚的。有时会把训练家错认成敌对宝可梦，朝对方喷水。
author: spencerrdevv
source: POKENAME are often clumsy in nature. They will sometimes confuse Trainers for rival Pokémon and begin spraying water at them.

entry: POKENAME轻蛋聚成束，避免被强风吹走。头上长叶的那颗，就是实际首领。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's lightweight eggs bundle together to avoid being blown away by strong winds. The one that grows leaves upon its head is the de facto leader of the group.

entry: POKENAME头叶锋利可脱落，用作备用武器。它悬浮在对手上方，连续投出骨头回力镖。
author: dodoowner_
source: The leaves on POKENAME's head are sharp and detachable, being used as a backup weapon. It hovers above its opponent, launching numerous Bonemerangs.

entry: POKENAME头骨长出的叶片，让它能离地飘飞很远。若难以安全落地，就会放声大哭。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's skull sprouts leaves that allow it to flutter great distances above the ground. It cries loudly when it struggles to land safely.

entry: POKENAME排气降低体内压力，便能浮起。需落地时，改吸气压缩，提高压力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release gas from their bodies to decrease the pressure within their bodies so that they can float. When they need to reach the ground, they inhale and compress air to increase the pressure instead.

entry: POKENAME入冷水，叶状触角会变褐。温暖日光让绿色恢复，也增强能量。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME enters cold water, its leafy antennae turn brown. Exposure to warm sunlight revives its green hue and boosts its energy.

entry: POKENAME结巨大群自保，通常完全避战。尾巴却是千针鱼偏爱的零食。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME band together in giant schools for protection and generally avoid confrontation altogether. Their tails are a preferred snack to Qwilfish.

entry: POKENAME身体轻，一阵微风就能带起。它们在空中旋转，从叶片散出花粉，让沾到的花，香气略微更甜美一些。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's light body is easily carried by even light gusts of wind. It spins its body while airborne, dispensing pollen from its leaves that makes any flowers touched by it smell just a little bit sweeter.

entry: POKENAME用长叶兜风，在微风天轻盈跃起，飘浮着跳舞。风大时会躲进室内，以免被吹走。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's long leaves catch the wind, and on days with a gentle breeze, POKENAME will use them to float during graceful leaps as it dances. On windy days, POKENAME will shelter inside to prevent it from being blown away.

entry: 春季，许多POKENAME被清爽的风吹散。落在哪里就在哪里筑巢，以毒刺攻击任何胆敢接近者。
author: reflecbeat
source: In the months of spring, many POKENAME are scattered all around by the crisp winds. Wherever they land, they make their nests, delivering poisonous stings to anything that dares approach.

entry: POKENAME头上的叶片可安全摘下泡茶。茶以果香味著称，喝后还会觉得身体轻盈。
author: sk372
source: The leaf on POKENAME's head can be safely removed and steeped in order to brew tea. The drink is notable for its fruity taste and for making those who drink it feel lighter afterward.

entry: POKENAME自己产生的热，常把鲜绿叶片点燃。火焰使身体轻于空气，因此它们聚在一起，免得被风带走。
author: beandrawsthings
source: POKENAME's bright green leaves often burst into flame due to the heat they generate. The flames make their bodies lighter than air, so they cluster together to prevent themselves being carried off by the wind.

entry: POKENAME很聪明，乘风漂浮时会用大型叶状尾巴掌舵。有些人把它视作春日新生的象征。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME is intelligent enough to use its large, leaf-shaped tail to steer itself while floating in the wind. Some see it as a symbol of how new life appears during springtime.

entry: POKENAME常伴着毽子草群乘风漂。它拍动翅膀调整大家的航线，帮助同伴旅行。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is often found accompanying groups of Hoppip floating across the breeze. It helps the Hoppip's journey by flapping its wings to adjust their flight paths.

entry: POKENAME来回猛跳，挥舞叶片，试图吓退领地入侵者。然而，叶片随风摆动，反把轻盈的身体托离地面，吹了出去。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME aggressively hop back and forth while waving their leaves to try and scare intruders off of their territory. Unfortunately, the motion of their leaves in the wind causes their light bodies to lift off of the ground and blow away.

entry: POKENAME织出能兜气流的网囊，借此远距滑翔。许多幼崽靠这方法，散布到离家很远的地方。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME create pockets of webbing that catch on air currents and allow them to glide long distances. Many baby POKENAME rely on this method to disperse far from their home.

entry: POKENAME织精细金丝，带淡柠檬香。常用来衬巢，以刺鼻香气阻挡捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME weaves delicate, golden silk that carries a faint lemon fragrance. This silk is often used to line its nest, keeping predators at bay with its sharp scent.

entry: 风托着POKENAME的轻身体，同时刺激它积起更多电。着地时释放多余能量，碰地便迸强光、啪地大响。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME accumulates more electricity in its body via stimulation from the wind that carries its light body through the air. It vents the excess energy when it lands, causing bright bursts and loud pops when it touches the ground.

entry: POKENAME通常在花田间漂，传粉吸蜜。花田一成热门去处，却会因野餐遗留的愤怒馒头等加工零食生病。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME normally float between flower fields to spread pollen and drink nectar. When those flower fields get popular, they get sick from food left behind after picnics, such as a Rage Candy Bar or other processed treats.

entry: POKENAME夜里沿着月亮在天空的轨迹漂行。爱落在天空最清澈的高处，等下一轮满月。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME drift through the night, following the path the moon takes in the sky. They love to settle at high altitudes where the skies are clearest, watching for the next full moon.

entry: 微风也能吹走POKENAME。太阳最明亮时，它唱得最响。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is blown away by even gentle winds. When the sun is at its brightest, the songs POKENAME sings are are at their loudest.

entry: 微风也能吹走POKENAME。太阳最明亮时，它唱得最响。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is blown away by even gentle winds. When the sun is at its brightest, the songs POKENAME sings are at their loudest.

entry: POKENAME翅膀太小，不能自行飞起。不过弹跳有力，腾空后身体轻得能被风托走。总盯着地平线上的某物。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Though its wings are too small to fly on its own, POKENAME can hop powerfully and is light enough for the wind to carry it once airborne. It is always staring at something on the horizon.

entry: POKENAME羊毛柔软轻如羽，让叶片能充当旋翼。风起时，便轻轻升空。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wool is soft and light as a feather, letting its leaves act like rotors. When the wind picks up it gently lifts into the sky.

entry: POKENAME爱仰躺湖池，转叶推进，再旋转双臂转向。
author: fireflower20002
source: POKENAME like to float on their backs in lakes or ponds. To move around in the water, they rotate their leaves to propel themselves while spinning their arms to change direction.

entry: POKENAME与尾巴密度不同，穿树飞时常出问题。容易卡在枝间，不过晃一晃，就能轻松脱身。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME and its tail have different densities, which often causes issues when it tries to fly through trees. It often gets stuck in tree branches, but it can easily dislodge itself with a shake.

entry: 融合让POKENAME长出更长手臂与更多叶片。叶片增重却容易失衡，它常像辅助螺旋桨般摆尾，稳住平衡。
author: thordemidgard
source: Fusion changed POKENAME's body to develop in many new ways, gaining longer arms and more leaves. However, the added weight of their leaves makes them easily lose balance, so they often wiggle their tail like an auxiliary helix to balance themselves.

entry: 有风的夜里，有时能见POKENAME乘风漂，面孔叶片泛柔光。它太亲人，常俯冲扑向训练家。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are sometimes spotted on windy nights, their faces and leaves emitting a soft glow as they float in the wind. POKENAME often divebomb Trainers because of how affectionate they are.

entry: POKENAME头顶花朵轻转，滑过蒲公英田。漂动间，把花粉散到所经之处。
author: .izik
source: The flower atop POKENAME's head spins gently as it glides over fields of dandelions. Its drifting motion spreads pollen wherever it travels.

entry: POKENAME身体对微风极敏感，细小波动便提示捕食者可能在附近狩猎。因此少风或无风时，很少离洞。
author: sk372
source: Its body is very attuned to the breeze, small fluctuations letting it know when predators may be around on the hunt. Because of this, POKENAME rarely leaves its burrow on days with little to no wind.

entry: POKENAME将自己埋在土里，让大叶片吸收阳光，感知周围天气。有风的日子，它就钻出地面，乘着微风走上一程。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME keeps itself buried in the soil, letting its large leaves draw in sunlight and sense the weather around it. On windy days it pops up from the ground to take a ride along the breeze.

entry: POKENAME用背上翼状种子结构飞行，控制灵巧，全速飞时也轻松倒退转弯。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME fly around with the wing-like seed structures on their backs. They can deftly control these structures, reversing and turning with ease while flying at full speed.

entry: POKENAME用长长的叶状耳朵舀泥，涂满身体，在酷暑保持凉爽。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME scoops up mud with its long, leaf-like ears and smears it over its body. This keeps it cool during scorching summer days.

entry: POKENAME大量住在河里，个头小、来回疾游，很难看清。融雪时互缠叶片，免得被冲向下游。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are found living in great number in rivers, their small size making individuals difficult to spot as they dart about. During snowmelt they interlace leaves with each other to stop them being dragged downstream.

entry: POKENAME翅膀几乎没有，只能靠风带着飞一段。群体常聚喷泉边，被水与池中硬币吸引。
author: sk372
source: With almost nonexistent wings, POKENAME flies by being carried some distance by the wind. Groups of POKENAME often congregate near fountains, attracted by the water and the coins tossed within.

entry: POKENAME常在开阔原野的草间啄来啄去，寻找种子吃。飞行时，它会脱落羽毛般的叶片，有人用来给茶增添甜味。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is usually found pecking at the grass in open fields, searching for seeds to eat. As it flies, it sheds feather-like leaves that are used by some to sweeten the taste of their tea.

entry: POKENAME是调情高手，遇到每只同类都想示爱。现代大多数调情技巧，都受它们启发。
author: spagalapof
source: A great seducer, they try to flirt with every other POKENAME they come across. They have inspired most modern flirting techniques.

entry: POKENAME大多在果灌木间漂着，收集冬粮。喂一颗利木果，就能多扛两天霜冻，采足冬眠所需的食物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spend most of their time floating between berry bushes and gathering berries for winter. By giving them an Aspear Berry, they can tough out against the frost for a couple more days to gather essential food for hibernation.

entry: POKENAME不断脱落易被风卷上天的外壳，上面长着木兰、山茶等许多花。外壳飞走时，花也漂散各处。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME continuously shed an outer shell that is easily swept into the sky. Many flowers grow on the shell, such as magnolia and camellia flowers, which float and scatter when the shell is swept away.

entry: POKENAME脸上叶面具冰冷，可点缀冷冻甜点。据说冷意能衬得树果滋味更浓。
author: .izik
source: The leaf mask on POKENAME's face is ice-cold and used as a garnish in frozen desserts. Its chilling touch is said to enhance a berry-based flavor.

entry: POKENAME旅行时跃出珊瑚礁晒太阳。宽大的叶状鳍先在空中闪耀，再重新潜水。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaps from coral reefs to bask in sunlight as it travels. Its wide, leaf-shaped fins shimmer in the air before diving again.

entry: POKENAME每月脱一次尾叶，次日长新。叶片泡的茶，在关都北部颇受欢迎。
author: sk372
source: Once a month, POKENAME sheds the leaves on its tail and grows a new set the next day. These leaves are used to brew a tea that has become fairly popular in northern Kanto areas.

entry: POKENAME虽轻，力气却大。想被关注，就顽皮地蹦跳，用鼻子拉训练家。
author: sylviasnake
source: POKENAME are quite strong despite their light weight. They playfully hop around and tug at their trainers with their trunk when they want attention.

entry: 强风吹来，POKENAME旋转升空。为争好气流，它们转着互撞，直到一方掉下。
author: wiz0z
source: When a strong breeze blows, POKENAME spin up into the air. POKENAME compete with one another for good air currents by spinning into each other, bashing their bodies together until one of them falls.

entry: POKENAME行动笨拙，常常摔倒，可身体非常轻，从不会因此受伤。有风时，它们会牵住交好宝可梦的手，以免被吹走。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are clumsy and often fall over, but their bodies are so light that this never causes them any damage. In windy weather, they hold hands with Pokémon they have befriended to prevent themselves from being blown away.

entry: 虽有翅膀，POKENAME却不靠振翅飞行，而是控制周围空气推进、滑翔。常引领成群毽子草。
author: teatedtiten
source: Though having wings, it does not fly by flapping. Instead, POKENAME controls the air around them as propulsion, allowing it to glide to its destination.  POKENAME are often found leading flocks of Hoppip.

entry: POKENAME穿行空气与时间同样轻松。动荡时代如强风般裹挟它，因此多在平静年代休息。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME drifts through the air and through time with equivalent ease. Turbulent time periods carry it like strong winds, so it most often rests in calmer times.

entry: POKENAME尾巴的重量，避免身体被大风完全带走。微风仍会把它甩来甩去，尾巴却不让漂到全然不同的地方。
author: sk372
source: The weight of POKENAME's tail keeps its body from being completely blown away by strong winds. It can still be flung about by the breeze, but its tail will prevent it from being carried to an entirely different location.

entry: POKENAME用长长的叶状手臂模仿人类动作。孩子常误认成随风漂的木偶。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME mimics human gestures with its long, leaf-like arms. Children often mistake it for a puppet drifting on the breeze.

entry: POKENAME最爱蜷在最坚韧的杂草下、土中睡觉。虽能短暂飞，却无法长时间停留空中。夜视虽好，天性仍是昼行。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's favorite spot to curl up and sleep is in the dirt, just under the hardiest weeds. Although it can fly for short periods of time, it cannot stay aloft for very long. Despite having decent night vision, it is diurnal in nature.

entry: POKENAME在田野竞速，彼此挑战最快。晴天会赛着跑上能到的最高山丘，争先沐浴正午阳光。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME race through fields, challenging one another to go as fast as possible. On sunny days they will race to the highest hills they can reach to be the first to catch the midday sun.

entry: POKENAME平静时，叶片散樱子果香。它喜欢安静池塘，能不受扰地漂。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gives off a Cheri Berry scent from its leaves when calm. It prefers tranquil ponds where it can float undisturbed.

entry: POKENAME很爱温柔暖夏风，用超能力托起轻身体，任风载行。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME adores the sensation of a warm and gentle summer breeze. Using its psychic powers, it levitates itself and lets the wind carry its lightweight body about.

entry: POKENAME从石中现身得小心，气体身体轻又不稳。最微小的风，也可能吹散大半，令它极度虚弱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME must be careful when emerging from its stone as its gaseous body is quite light and unstable. Even the slightest breeze could cause much of it to dissipate and weaken it greatly.

entry: POKENAME常涉热带岛屿浅水，吸收光能维生。鲜艳颜色警告捕食者，因为多数水生宝可梦一尝，就会生病。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is often found wading in the shallows of tropical islands, absorbing light for sustenance. Its bright coloration is a warning to predators, as tasting it will make most aquatic Pokémon ill.

entry: POKENAME容易被大风吹走，用大耳检查风速。毒刺能把自己固定在物件上，免得飞走。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME is easily blown away by strong winds, so it uses its large ears to check the wind's speed. It uses its toxic barbs to attach itself to objects to prevent itself from being blown away.

entry: POKENAME的安抚气息易随风远传，最远1英里外也隐约感得到。吃叶也有同样感受，因此常拿来作菜肴香草。
author: santon5512
source: The soothing aura POKENAME emit gets easily carried by the wind, able to be faintly felt up to a mile away. This property carries into their leaves upon consumption, which are commonly used as herbs in dishes for this very reason.

entry: POKENAME花蜜可制一小瓶愉悦香水，因而珍贵。唯有春天为吸引传粉者产出过量花蜜时，才做得到。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's nectar is valuable because it is an ingredient used to produce a vial of Joy Scent. This is only possible during the spring when its body produces an excess of nectar to attract pollinators.

entry: POKENAME月下无声漂过草甸。一见猎物，就突然使出诡异的影子偷袭。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts silently over meadows beneath moonlit skies. When it spots prey, it strikes with a sudden and eerie Shadow Sneak.

entry: POKENAME劳累过度，就从蓬松护层中钻出，睡在上面。可这让它暴露，常在睡梦中遭捕食者攻击。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME will exit its fluffy, protective covering and sleep on it when overworked to exhaustion. Unfortunately, this leaves it vulnerable to predators, frequently getting attacked throughout its slumber.

entry: 它始终散发着新鲜葛拉西蒂亚花的香气，因此十分受欢迎。人们却常把它与危险、没有气味的反向融合体混淆。
author: kai____________
source: A highly sought-after Pokémon, as it eternally gives off the smell of a fresh Gracidea. It's often confused with its dangerous, odorless reversed counterpart.

entry: POKENAME能独立活动每条叶片般的尾巴，调整位置，尽量多接收光照。强风一来，它们便将尾巴大大展开，兴奋地尖叫着，随风漂游。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can move their multiple leaf-like tails independently of each other, adjusting them to be able to catch as much light as possible. When strong winds pick up, they spread them out wide and float on the breeze, making excited yips as they do.

entry: POKENAME用叶状舌抓海床海带，贴近沙底漂浮，边进食边随潮流移动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its leafy tongue to snatch kelp from the ocean floor. It floats just above the sand, drifting with the tide as it feeds.

entry: POKENAME转身迎着微风，十分享受风拂叶片的感觉。它们最爱玩电风扇，能在前面一坐就是好几个小时。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME turn to face into the breeze and greatly enjoy the feel of the wind on their leaves. They love to play with electric fans and will sit in front of them for hours on end.

entry: POKENAME转身迎着微风，十分享受风拂叶片的感觉。它们最爱玩电风扇，能在前面一坐就是好几个小时。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME turn to face into the breeze and greatly enjoy the feel of the wind on their leaves. They love to play with electric fans and will sit in front of them for hours on end.

entry: POKENAME任风载行，只短暂落地，又随风走。身后留下入侵性极强的异世界植物种子，若不铲除，会让生态中其他所有植物死光。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: POKENAME will let the wind carry them until they land for a brief moment, then follow the breeze once more. They leave behind seeds of a highly invasive plant not of this world that kills off any other plants in its ecosystem if not weeded out.

entry: POKENAME背叶锐到能劈小石。它用来挖洞，吃挖出的树根。
author: .izik
source: The leaves on POKENAME's back are sharp enough to split small stones. It uses them while digging dens and feeds on tree roots it uncovers.

entry: POKENAME靠尾巴悬浮，半睡半醒地漂过天空。长时间在阳光下飞行，难免晒伤；给它一颗莓莓果，它就能治好这些伤。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be seen floating through the sky half-asleep while their tail keeps them suspended. By giving them a Rawst Berry, they can heal themselves of the sunburns they inevitably get while flying for long periods in the sun.

entry: POKENAME身体虽大，却极轻，能随风远行，常落在距出发处数英里外。
author: turcai_87271
source: Despite POKENAME's large bodies, they are extremely lightweight. This adaptation allows them to travel vast distances in the wind, often ending up miles away from where they began.

entry: POKENAME对天气变化敏感，有些乡村便借助它们，提前准备风暴。它们聚到田间，就预示雷雨将至。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are sensitive to changes in the weather and are used by some rural communities as a way of preparing for storms. When POKENAME gather out in a field it's a warning that a thunderstorm is imminent.

entry: POKENAME对天气变化敏感，有些乡村便借助它们，提前准备风暴。它们聚到田间，就预示雷雨将至。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are sensitive to changes in the weather and are used by some rural communities as a way of preparing for storms. When POKENAME gather out in a field it's a warning that a thunderstorm is imminent.

entry: POKENAME爱风暴天共玩，享受雨与强风。叶片积静电，天够暗便能见彼此间跃起火花。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME prefer to play with one another during stormy weather, greatly enjoying the rain and high winds. Their leaves collect static charge and, when it's dark enough, sparks can be seen leaping between them.

entry: 强风时，POKENAME鼓起身体，让小宝可梦也能跟着乘气流同行。叶片晒够阳光，就唱欢快小调。
author: fiordaliso
source: When strong winds blow, it inflates its body to let smaller Pokémon travel alongside it, riding the air currents. Once its leaves absorb enough sunlight, POKENAME starts singing cheerful little tunes.

entry: POKENAME如珠宝般受保护，因为树液是制心动香水的主要原料。可只有受伤才产，环保人士因此呼吁禁止这类采集。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are protected like jewelry because its sap is the main ingredient in a vial of Vivid Scent. However, because it only produces sap when injured, environmentalists push to ban the practice.

entry: POKENAME产出细腻甜香的花粉，只有传粉者才能采到。它是制一小瓶兴奋香水的原料之一，因此宝可梦与花粉都很昂贵。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produces a delicately sweet pollen that can only be harvested by pollinators. It is one of the reagents to produce a vial of Excite Scent, making the Pokémon and pollen expensive.

entry: POKENAME随清爽夏风，悠悠漂荡。夏日里的孩子们，最爱陪POKENAME玩耍。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are known to drift along fresh summer breezes. Children love to play with POKENAME during the summer months.

entry: POKENAME的毛有春草甜香，帮助它保持好心情。强腿让它能跃至12英尺高。
author: mistymagius
source: Its fur smells like sweet, spring grass, which helps keep it in a positive mood. POKENAME's strong legs allow it to leap up to 12 feet in the air.

entry: POKENAME能造微风，乘着漂行，可大风通常抵挡不了。它夜里更活跃，白天休息。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME can create gentle breezes and drift around in them. However, strong winds typically overpower them. They are more active during the night, resting during the day.

entry: POKENAME泡状涂层易破，一破却洒出黏胶。它立刻再生涂层，趁戳泡者被胶拖慢，漂走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's bubble-like coating is easily popped, but splatters a sticky coating of goo when it does. It regenerates this coating instantly and floats away while the bubble-popper is slowed by the goop.

entry: POKENAME喜住湿洞，很少晒强光。它吃素，主要以苔藓为食。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME prefer to live in damp caves where they are hardly exposed to bright sunlight. They are herbivores who primarily feed on mosses.

entry: POKENAME夜游丛林，带着仿佛蒲公英做的黄面具。是勾起悲伤记忆，还是怀旧香气所致，面具总让人落泪。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wanders the jungle at night, carrying its yellow mask which looks like it is made out of a dandelion. Whether it is because it reminds people of sad memories or it has a nostalgic aroma, the mask makes people cry.

entry: POKENAME平躺草甸，像藏好的陷阱。猎物靠近，就突然使出超级吸取。
author: .izik
source: Lying flat among meadow grasses, POKENAME waits like a hidden trap. When prey approaches, it lashes out with a sudden Mega Drain.

entry: POKENAME头上双叶覆细小感知毛。对空气中的化学物质与信息素敏感，让它看不见也能察觉其他宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a pair of leaves growing from their heads that are covered in tiny sensory hairs. These hairs are sensitive to chemicals and pheromones in the air, letting them sense other Pokémon even without seeing them.

entry: POKENAME的爪子一生都在生长，若长得太长，就会妨碍奔跑。它的身形有利于减少空气阻力，使它能在森林中高速疾驰。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's claws constantly grow throughout its lifetime and if they grow too long, it will be unable to run properly. Its body is very aerodynamic, allowing it to run through the forest at high speeds.

entry: POKENAME半埋地里，看着与普通杂草一样。一被拔，就生气蹦跳，四处撒有害孢子。
author: bobosmith01
source: It looks like any other weed when buried partway beneath the surface. If plucked, POKENAME begins to hop around in anger, spreading harmful spores everywhere.

entry: POKENAME一跳舞就陷入恍惚，直到舞完才结束。哪怕强风托身上天，也照样按拍子动，一个节奏不漏。
author: sk372
source: Once POKENAME begins to dance, it enters a trance-like state that only ends when the dance does. Even if strong winds carry its light body through the air, it continues its rhythmic movements without missing a beat.

entry: POKENAME吃腐烂有机物，维持堆肥般的身体。蒲公英种在它的堆肥里，长得很快。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME feeds on decaying organic matter to maintain its compost-like body. Dandelion seeds grow quickly when planted in its compost.

entry: POKENAME漂过湿地，叶片发幽灵般的声音。连睡着也随风摇，仿佛闹鬼。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME floats through marshes, its leaves produce a ghostly sound. Even in sleep, its leaves sway with the wind, as if haunted.

entry: POKENAME身体像树，却轻得会被大风带走。为留地面，它把根深扎土中。
author: .izik
source: Though POKENAME has a tree-like body, it is light enough to be carried off by strong winds. To stay grounded, it drives its roots deep into the soil.

entry: POKENAME叶翼让它几乎不费力就悬空。累了便轻落郁金香丛，吃花瓣。
author: .izik
