source: POKENAME's leafy wings allow it to stay aloft with minimal effort. When it grows tired, it gently lands among tulips and eats their petals.

entry: POKENAME把叶片围成堡垒状，抵御强风。一抬叶，便兜风，推它升空。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME positions its leaves like a fort to protect itself from strong winds. When it lifts its leaves, they catch the wind and propel it into the sky.

entry: POKENAME乘暖气流升上高空。叶片满是利刺，却不知为何让身体更适合顺风飞行。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME rides on warm air currents, lifting it high into the sky. Its leaves are covered in sharp thorns that somehow make its body more aerodynamic.

entry: POKENAME飞时从翼撒闪亮花粉，甜香又能滋养土地。因此农人视飞行身影为春季丰收吉兆。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME releases a sparkling pollen from its wings as it flies. This sweet-smelling pollen helps nourish the ground, so farmers consider seeing it in flight as an omen of a bountiful spring harvest.

entry: POKENAME快速旋转叶状尾鳍，在水中推进，动作让捕食者难以抓住。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins its leaf-like tailfins rapidly to propel itself through water. The motion makes it difficult for predators to catch.

entry: POKENAME只选最坚韧的林叶做面具，旧的留着肥林。为争支配地位，会用头锤互撞，直到一方面具碎裂。
author: ghostslythe
source: Choosing only the strongest forest leaves, POKENAME make their own masks, leaving old ones to fertilize forests. To show dominance, they Headbutt rivals until one of their masks breaks.

entry: POKENAME夜漂草地，闪柔黄光。据说同时见到几只、且图样相同，能带来绝佳财运。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts above meadows at night, blinking a soft yellow light. Seeing multiple with the same pattern is said to bring great financial luck.

entry: POKENAME几乎没有自行飞行的能力，而是伸展翅膀，借风滑翔。叶片产生的微毒花粉，很容易随风飘散，接触后，会产生刺激与瘙痒。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME have little to no flight power on their own, instead outstretching their wings to glide with the wind. The mildly toxic pollen their leaves produce easily gets carried off by the wind, causing irritation and itching upon contact.

entry: POKENAME浮在麦田上，摇摆沉重的下半身，沿途放出促进作物生长的花粉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats over wheat fields, swaying its heavy lower body. As it drifts, it releases pollen that boosts crop growth wherever it passes.

entry: 春天，池边常见POKENAME漂浮。它让虫属性宝可梦坐在开花的叶片上，帮助过池。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME are commonly seen floating around ponds during spring. They help Bug-type Pokémon cross ponds by letting them onto their flowered pad.

entry: POKENAME在训练家常走的沼泽上，连成空中船队。一只发现分心者，就潜水溅湿对方，逗得伙伴大笑。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME float above swamps where Trainers tend to travel, linking together in flying flotillas. When one spots a distracted person, they dive into the water. Their sudden splash soaks the target, sending their fellow POKENAME into fits of laughter.

entry: POKENAME住静水，游泳肌肉弱，身体又轻，很容易随流卷走。一跃出水，强风甚至也能带走它。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives in placid waters, as its weak swimming muscles and light body makes it easily swept up by any current. If it leaps out of the water, it may even be carried away by a strong breeze.

entry: POKENAME转动螺旋桨加快游泳，住在大海带林，似乎对当地生命有积极影响。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME spins its propeller to swim faster. It makes its home in large kelp forests and appears to have a positive effect on the life in its habitat.

entry: POKENAME叶片对天气极敏感，细小气压下降也察觉。雨前便躲藏，蜷着等好天晒太阳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME leaves are highly sensitive to changes in weather, able to pick up even small drops in pressure. They take shelter just before rain, curling up while they wait for better weather to sunbathe in.

entry: POKENAME摘吃自己的叶，缓解头痛。可只对自己有效，别人吃，反而剧烈头痛。
author: sk372
source: It pulls off and consumes its own leaves to help soothe its aching head. It's only a curative for POKENAME, however; others consuming its leaves will develop a strong headache instead.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间都在软土里挖掘，寻找种子和根来啃。尾巴上脱落的叶片能磨成药粉，味道却极苦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends most of its time digging in soft dirt for seeds and roots to chew on. The leaves shed from its tail can be ground up for medicinal powder, but the powder is extremely bitter to taste.

entry: POKENAME将头顶的叶片转得像螺旋桨一样，借此游泳，浮入水流，在河溪表面欢快地旋转。顺流而下时，它们还会互相喷出泡沫，嬉戏玩耍。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swim by twirling their leaves above their head like a propeller, floating up into the current and spinning happily across the surface of rivers and streams. They playfully spray Bubbles at one another as they are swept downriver.

entry: POKENAME清晨与黄昏摇摆走出池，沐浴微弱却温暖的日光。皮肤需一直湿润，正午太阳下很快干，因此白天大多在水里玩。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME waddle out of ponds at dawn and dusk, soaking in the dim sunlight and basking in the warm light. Their skin requires constant moisture, drying out rapidly in the midday sun, so they spend the majority of the day splashing about in the water.

entry: POKENAME极胆小，尽量藏树灌里。它能用念力控植物，靠叶与藤蔓自卫。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is extremely timid, trying its best to hide itself in bushes and trees. It has telekinetic control over plants and will defend itself using leaves and vines.

entry: POKENAME把叶状触手挥在水面上，以甜香引宝可梦。饥饿者一上钩，就迅速被抓住拖入水下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME waves its leaf-like tentacles above the water's surface, drawing in Pokémon with their sweet scent. Hungry Pokémon that take the bait are quickly snatched and dragged underwater.

entry: POKENAME身轻随风乱飞，众多叶触手也乱舞。毫无防护地碰叶，皮肤会起轻微疹子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's many leafy tentacles flail about wildly as its light body is blown around by the wind. Touching the leaves without protection will lead to mild rashes developing on the touched skin.

entry: POKENAME太轻，被风带走都没察觉。据说尾巴烹熟后，吃着像萝卜。
author: mistymagius
source: Because of its light body, POKENAME gets carried along the wind without it even noticing. When properly cooked, its tail apparently tastes like radishes.

entry: POKENAME背上螺旋桨，出奇有力，足够托它离地。可太懒，往往懒得用。
author: evilgammon
source: Surprisingly, the propeller on POKENAME's back is strong enough to lift them off the ground. However, due to their laziness, they often don't bother.

entry: POKENAME身体轻，能拿大片叶子或浮木冲浪。耳朵和尾巴像帆，帮助保持平衡，可在刮风的陆地上，也常使它踉跄。
author: lukanbeetle
source: It uses big leaves or drifting wood to surf, a feat possible thanks to its light weight. POKENAME's ears and tails are like sails, helping them keep their balance when surfing, but often making them stumble on the ground when it's windy.

entry: POKENAME挂枝，藏在卷叶里伏击。能量消耗少，不需吃太多。它常忘了自己在干什么，连挂着也会睡。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME hang from tree branches, hidden within their coiling leaves to better catch prey unawares. They don't use much energy; thus, they do not need to eat much. POKENAME often forget what they are doing and fall asleep, even while hanging.

entry: POKENAME跑遍田野，用长喙拔出萝卜与生菜，偷偷带走。农民们，自然很不欢迎。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME runs across fields and steals turnips and lettuce by pulling them out of the ground with its long beak. They are not popular with farmers.

entry: 野生POKENAME，能毁掉整季的收成。可有些农民，倒成功将它们驯服，训练成快速犁田的帮手。
author: chorb33
source: Wild POKENAME devastate entire harvests. However, some farmers manage to tame them and train them to rapidly plow their fields instead.

entry: POKENAME蛋奶酱般的身体极轻，能被风载走。形体虽黏软，空中却滑得优雅。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's custard-like body is so light it can be carried by the wind. Despite its gooey form, it glides gracefully through the air.

entry: POKENAME夜里认真照料小花园，把植物排到最易吸晨光的位置。轻轻拂开挡路者，却常因突如其来的幽灵触感，不慎吓到对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME dutifully tends to small gardens at night, arranging plants to help them best gather sunlight in the morning. It gently brushes aside those that get in its way, often accidentally spooking them with its sudden ethereal touch.

entry: POKENAME爱晒太阳休息，靠光合作用补养分。许多虫属性宝可梦，也来给头花授粉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy resting in the sun to nourish themselves with photosynthesis. Many Bug-type Pokémon also come to pollinate the flower atop their heads.

entry: POKENAME在草原上组成图案漂行。另一组图案若靠得太近，就突然使出终极吸取。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts in patterns across grasslands. If another pattern gets too close, it strikes with a sudden Giga Drain.

entry: 气温一凉，POKENAME便休眠。回暖就醒来找花，舔花粉，准备下次休眠所需的养分。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME slumbers in dormancy whenever the temperature cools down. Once it warms up, it awakens to seek out flowers, licking the pollen off of them to last it through its next hibernation.

entry: POKENAME放毒气，让附近漂着的宝可梦头晕。它在空中朝其他飞行者射种子，挑起战斗。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release toxic gases from their body and cause Pokémon floating nearby to become dizzy. They shoot seeds at other flying Pokémon to incite fights while airborne.

entry: POKENAME每口放出的气都满是花粉，令过敏者困扰。高浓度花粉可作强效致幻剂，有人用来看未来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are a menace to people who are allergic to pollen, as every puff of air they release is saturated with pollen. In high concentrations, POKENAME pollen can be harnessed as a powerful hallucinogen that some people use to see the future.

entry: POKENAME似乎不怕冷热，只要晴天就外出歌舞。配上花香，表演仿佛让其他宝可梦忍不住靠近观看。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME does not seem to mind how warm or cold it is and will go outside to sing and dance whenever it is sunny. When combined with the fragrance of POKENAME's flowers, these performances appear to compel other Pokémon to approach and watch.

entry: POKENAME黏软身体会溶掉除草以外的几乎所有东西。多只同行，身后就留平坦草原。
author: jaminmcready
source: As POKENAME moves across the land, its gooey body dissolves nearly everything but grass. When many travel together, they leave behind a flattened grassy steppe.

entry: 据说POKENAME头花只在特定温度开。可它不断产热，因此始终未获确证。
author: beandrawsthings
source: It is thought that the flower on POKENAME's head blooms only at certain temperatures. However, as it generates heat constantly, this has never been conclusively proven.

entry: POKENAME黄瓣泡热水能止嗝。头花吸足光，超能力就大大增强，更有效。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's yellow petals, when steeped in hot water, stop hiccups. If the flower on its head absorbs a lot of light, POKENAME's psychic powers benefit greatly, becoming more effective.

entry: POKENAME游荡花田，毛上沾粉，散花瓣助授粉。落瓣用于香水与古龙水，甜香中带一点柑橘气息，让人想起夏日。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME meanders around flowering fields, scattering its petals and helping pollinate since pollen sticks to its fur. Its fallen petals are used to infuse perfumes and colognes with a sweet, slightly citrusy scent reminiscent of the idea of summer.

entry: POKENAME左右换脚华丽跳跃，花瓣飞散，努力炫耀。飞行时头花旋转，滴答声很有节奏。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME leap from one foot to the other in dramatic flourishes and a flurry of flower petals to try and show off. The flowers on their heads rotate with a rhythmic ticking when they fly.

entry: POKENAME十分讲究条理，头上的大花若被风吹乱，或歪向一边，就会感到烦躁。它会拍动花朵般的翅膀，调整姿态，直到三朵花的动作一致。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are very methodical, so they grow frustrated if the large flowers on their heads are caught in the wind or left askew. They flap their flower-like wings to re-adjust themselves until all three flowers are synchronized.

entry: 林间能见POKENAME撑蛛网降落伞滑翔。旧丝伞残余，散在许多树枝间。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be seen with a webbed parachute gliding through the forest. The remains of silk parachutes can be seen dispersed in many branches of trees.

entry: POKENAME用许多亮花装网，引美味虫宝可梦去巢。大多友好，但若谁破坏它的网，常会被一路追赶。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME covers its web with lots of bright flowers, luring tasty Bug Pokémon toward its nests. It is a mostly friendly Pokémon; however, it will often pursue anyone who damages its web.

entry: 它们更常在夜里现身。发光的触角，能让随气流漂浮的它，吸引其他POKENAME靠近。
author: kitarchen
source: They are often seen at night, rather than during the day. Their glowing antennae allow them to attract other POKENAME as they float on air currents.

entry: POKENAME花朵伪装出色，藏花丛诱猎。飞行属性宝可梦靠近，轻易就遭电击。
author: kasai_kitsune
source: Having excellent floral camouflage, POKENAME hides among flower patches to attract prey. It easily electrocutes Flying-type Pokémon that draw near.

entry: POKENAME难寻，白天藏身。月夜能见整群无声漂过天空。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are elusive, hiding away during the daytime. Groups of the Pokémon can be seen silently drifting across the sky on moonlit nights.

entry: POKENAME从不分开，塔中每只各有职责：底层供力量，中层负责飞行移动，顶层可爱健谈，赢得其他宝可梦喜爱。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME never separates, as each one has its purpose in the tower. The bottom provides strength. The middle provides mobility through flight. Lastly, the top has a cute, chatty disposition that endears it to other Pokémon.

entry: 工匠很喜欢POKENAME，爱用花装盆罐。花长在羊毛里，采摘完全不会伤到它。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are popular amongst artisans as they love to decorate their pots with their flowers. The flowers grow in their wool, so picking them does not hurt POKENAME at all.

entry: POKENAME羊毛带甜花香，很受地毯、家具制作欢迎。电力来自阳光，能量充满，尾灯便亮。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's wool carries a sweet scent of flowers, which makes it quite popular for making rugs and furniture. It generates its electricity through sunlight; its tail glows brightly when it's fully powered up.

entry: 天气太冷或太阴，POKENAME就不活动。头花在日光下绽放，少数情况下也会开出不同颜色。
author: bobosmith01
source: It enters an inactive state if the weather is too cold or cloudy. The flowers on POKENAME's head bloom in the sunlight; rarely, the flowers may bloom in different colors.

entry: 长期以来，科学家以为POKENAME用尾吓幼崽。最近才发现，它摇尾是想邀请幼年宝可梦一起玩。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: For the longest time, scientists believed that POKENAME would use their tail to scare away baby Pokémon. Recently, it has been found that POKENAME shake their tail to entice baby Pokémon to play with them.

entry: POKENAME爱待在周围花草繁茂的池边。玩时把尾球抛起，再试用头花接住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys hanging around ponds with lots of floral growth surrounding them. For fun, it tosses the ball on its tail into the air and attempts to catch it with the flower on its head.

entry: POKENAME爱漂过花田。有时摘一朵带远，数英里后才放下，原因不明。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME loves drifting over flower fields. Sometimes it plucks a blossom and carries it far away, dropping it miles later for unknown reasons.

entry: POKENAME花蜜格外香甜，因此常被采来出售，作为糖的替代品。
author: kittyluv090
source: The nectar in POKENAME's flowers is exceptionally sweet and flavorful, so it is often harvested and sold as a sugar substitute.

entry: POKENAME漂过森林，把找到的种子在空中撒出，帮助传播。剩下的就一边顽皮旋转，一边吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spreads seeds it finds by floating through forests and releasing them midair. It eats leftover seeds while spinning playfully.

entry: POKENAME腹部的花纹，会随所处水域的酸碱度变色：酸性水中呈红色，碱性水中呈蓝色，中性水中则是绿色。相关基因已被提取，用于研究。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The patterns on POKENAME's stomach change colour depending on the pH of the water it is in, going from red in acidic water to blue in alkaline water, and green in neutral. The gene relating to this has been extracted and is used in research.

entry: 春天，成群的POKENAME十分常见，会摘下小花，带回巢里。头上的花靠光合作用供能，因此它们无需进食。
author: mistymagius
source: Flocks of POKENAME are common during the springtime, as they can be seen picking small flowers to take back to their nest. They have no need to eat as the flower on their head provides energy through photosynthesis.

entry: POKENAME背上大花把小种子吹入风中。种子飞向远方，落在异地生长。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have large flowers atop their backs that blow small seeds into the wind. These seeds soar through the sky and land far from their home to grow in distant lands.

entry: POKENAME低低旋过巷道，寻找无人看管的垃圾箱。进食受惊，就用愤怒门牙吓退威胁。
author: .izik
source: Spinning low through alleyways, POKENAME searches for unattended dumpsters. If startled while feeding, it uses Super Fang to scare off threats.

entry: POKENAME旋转尾花，漂过漆黑洞穴，撒出会引起轻微发痒的怪花粉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats through pitch-black caves by spinning its tail flower. As it drifts, it scatters a strange pollen that causes mild itching.

entry: POKENAME有点好斗，驯服需技巧，却也长得快，很受稍有经验的训练家欢迎。一赢得信任，便极忠诚。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Popular amongst Trainers who have gained a little bit of experience, POKENAME has a mildly confrontational nature that takes some skill to tame but is also a fast-growing Pokémon. When their trust is earned, they become fiercely loyal.

entry: POKENAME悬在作物上，喷天然杀虫剂，驱赶虫宝可梦。休息会黏粮仓或筒仓侧面，免被风带走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hovers over crops to spray a natural insecticide that keeps bug Pokémon away. To prevent itself from being carried off by the wind, it sticks to the side of barns or silos when it is resting.

entry: 晴天，POKENAME沸热的身体散出浓绿茶香。头部远离主要热源，刚好凉到能安全触碰。
author: .realthree
source: On sunny days, POKENAME's boiling body gives off a strong scent of green tea. The head, which is extended away from the main source of the heat, is just cool enough to touch safely.

entry: POKENAME爱摘别的花瓣装饰翅膀。飞到哪里，都带刚割青草的甜香。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME likes to pluck the petals off of other flowers to decorate its wings with. It brings the sweet scent of freshly cut grass wherever it flies.

entry: POKENAME在小石之间安巢，用鲜艳花瓣吸日光。病了花会枯，身体变病态绿。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME nests itself between small rocks, absorbing sunlight through its vibrant petals. If POKENAME ever becomes ill, its flowers will wilt, and its body will turn a sickly green.

entry: POKENAME收林地落瓣，常送喜欢的训练家。冬天存尾里，养活到春天。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME collects fallen flower petals from the forest floor and will often give these petals to Trainers it likes. It stores its petals in its tail during the winter, keeping them alive until spring arrives.

entry: POKENAME钻地，只露花。人们采瓣配药，解大多数蛇毒。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME burrows so just its flower can be seen above ground. The petals are plucked to be used in a mixture for an antitoxin for most snake venom.

entry: POKENAME爱暖，常躺着把鼻子伸向太阳。
author: sylviasnake
source: POKENAME love warm temperatures and can often be found lying down with their trunk reaching towards the sun.

entry: POKENAME吃的图片越多，自然产的种子越多。住进哪栋办公楼，就撒遍那里。
author: .izik
source: The more images POKENAME consumes, the more seeds it naturally produces. It scatters these seeds throughout any office building it makes its home in.

entry: POKENAME头上的花本来是白色，它却喜欢涂色，通常用尾上的黄色颜料。人们常见它给其他花涂色，因为它似乎只爱黄色。
author: mistymagius
source: The flower on POKENAME's head is naturally white, but it prefers to paint it—usually with the yellow paint from its tail. It can often be seen painting other flowers, as it only seems to like the color yellow.

entry: POKENAME颈褶内侧的花纹，特别善于吸日光。太冷就钻地，等回暖。
author: pjporwoll
source: The flower pattern on the inside of the hood of POKENAME is especially good at absorbing sunlight. Whenever the temperature gets too cold, POKENAME burrows to wait until warmer temperatures.

entry: 看POKENAME叶状翅膀上的褐斑数量，就能判断年龄。双翼全褐后会碎裂剥落，直到再也不能飞。
author: teatedtiten
source: You can tell how old a POKENAME is by the amount of brown spots on its leaf-like wings. When POKENAME's wings get fully brown, they crumble and flake off until it can no longer fly.

entry: POKENAME饿了，便乘微风漂向最近的花丛。大吃花朵后，身体重得无法浮起，只能待在地上，直到消化后，再次升空。
author: sk372
source: When hungry, POKENAME floats over to the nearest flower patch by riding the breeze. After gorging itself on the flowers, it is grounded until it digests, as the binge-eating makes it too heavy to float.

entry: POKENAME磁悬浮在树冠上，转动头花如陀螺稳定器。只有远离碰撞风险，才展开易损太阳能板，进行光合作用。
author: anonymous_moose
source: POKENAME magnetically levitates above the treeline, spinning the flower atop its head as a gyroscopic stabilizer. Only when it is far away from any risk of collision does POKENAME unfold its delicate solar panels to photosynthesize.

entry: POKENAME转花短距滑翔，漂过雏菊田时，用长舌舔食花朵。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can glide short distances by rotating its flower. It uses its long tongue to lap up flowers while drifting over daisy fields.

entry: POKENAME洞里衬着根系，散出细香葱般的淡香，既标领地，也驱走不速之客。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's burrows are lined with roots that release a faint chive-like aroma. This scent marks its territory and deters unwelcome visitors.

entry: POKENAME爱在水坑泼水玩。若一跳差点距离，就转花滑完剩下路程。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME splashes in puddles for fun. If its jump comes up short, it spins its flower to glide the rest of the way.

entry: POKENAME边旋空边变色，融入黎明天空。一被看见，就释放麻痹粉，再漂走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME changes color to blend with the dawn sky while spinning through the air. If spotted, it unleashes Stun Spore before floating away.

entry: POKENAME从开花植物的波导汲能攻击。身体极轻，能弹到远高于对手处，借身后刺眼日光占先机。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME draws from the aura of flowering plants to power its attacks. Its body is so light that it can spring into the air far above its opponent, using the blinding sunlight behind it to its advantage.

entry: POKENAME仔细照顾背上花苞，清掉碎屑，确保直晒阳光。许多传粉者来，盼喝新鲜花蜜。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME take fastidious care of the flower bulbs on their backs, clearing debris from their backs to ensure direct sunlight reaches their bulb. Many pollinators come to POKENAME hoping to drink some fresh nectar.

entry: POKENAME背上的小花，需要大量资源才能长大。在直射的阳光下休息，能加快糖的产生与代谢，促进发育。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have small flowers on their backs that require lots of resources to develop. They can accelerate the process of growth by resting in direct sunlight, increasing the rate at which sugar is produced and metabolized.

entry: POKENAME焦虑预感灾难，尤其天气变化，因此很少久居。人们用花瓣泡草本茶，借解读茶叶占卜、预警危险。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME rarely lives in one location long because it anxiously anticipates oncoming disaster, especially weather changes. Herbal tea brewed with its petals is used in divination which requires reading of tea leaves to warn of danger.

entry: 寒冷时，POKENAME花闭，原本安抚的气息变苦涩。身体虽轻却不能自飞，只好缎带缠毽子棉，搭便车。
author: soup1900
source: In cold weather, the soothing auras POKENAME radiates turn bitter since its flower closes up. Its body is light, but it can't fly on its own, so it hitches a ride on Jumpluff by wrapping its ribbons around them.

entry: POKENAME巨大有力，却是最温柔的巨人之一。野外细心照料花园，感到微风拂身，就喜悦轻哼。
author: sk372
source: Despite its immense size and strength, POKENAME is one of the gentlest of giants. It meticulously and carefully tends to gardens of flowers in the wild, and faintly hums in joy when it feels the breeze against its body.

entry: POKENAME身体轻，跳到半空，也可能被强风吹走。它们便伸长手臂，抓住最近的表面，免得彻底被带走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is fairly light, and it may be blown away mid-hop by a strong enough gust of wind. It uses its extendable arms to grab onto the nearest surface in order to keep from being carried away completely.

entry: POKENAME轻得在强风中难飞。头瓣专为尽量多吸阳光，以光合作用供能。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME struggles to fly in strong winds due to being incredibly light. The petals on its head are specialised to absorb as much sunlight as possible, giving it energy through photosynthesis.

entry: POKENAME转花，滑过衬丝隧道。巢道广阔黏稠，连老练探险者也会迷路。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins its flower to glide through silk-lined tunnels. Its nests are vast and sticky, confusing even experienced explorers.

entry: POKENAME住干净池塘，把长口器伸出水面晒太阳。身体分泌甜香黏液，帮助植物生长。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in clean ponds, extending its proboscis above the surface to absorb sunlight. It secretes a sweet-scented slime from its body that helps promote plant growth.

entry: POKENAME漂过草地，轻轻叮当。旋花发出柔和规律的铃音。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME floats through meadows, it jingles faintly. Its spinning flower creates soft, rhythmic chimes as it drifts.

entry: POKENAME装成自己头花的茎。确定没人看，就移到阳光下，保持健康。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME pretends to be the stem of the flower on its head. When it's sure no one is looking, it moves into the sunlight to ensure it remains healthy.

entry: POKENAME尾上金花瓣，只在温暖晴天开。花香常被比作焚香，有些寺庙把它作太阳象征。
author: .jerden
source: The golden flower petals on POKENAME's tail only open on warm, sunny days. The scent of POKENAME's flowers is often compared to fragrant incense, and some temples use POKENAME as a symbol of the sun.

entry: POKENAME转花乘风。落地后，在西洋菜附近挖洞休息，吸收养分。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats on wind currents by spinning its flower. When it lands, it digs near watercress to rest and absorb nutrients.

entry: POKENAME以藤蔓固定水坝，上面开满黄花。啃倒树后，又会试着让树再长，恢复环境平衡。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's dam is covered in yellow flowers as it uses its vines to hold its dam together. After it chews down a tree, it will try to regrow the tree to restore balance to the environment.

entry: POKENAME花香浓，近似柑橘，令周围振奋。毛能吸大量阳光，因此无需睡眠。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's flower gives a strong, almost citrusy scent that invigorates everyone around it. It absorbs large amounts of sunlight through its fur, so it has no need for sleep.

entry: POKENAME爱夜游海，白天浮上来滋养头花。日光足够，有些还能短距飞。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy swimming through the sea at night and surface during the day to nourish the flower on their head. With enough sunlight, some POKENAME are able to fly short distances.

entry: POKENAME不断追太阳，跋涉数英里寻光。日落后自己亮起，找路回家。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME constantly seek the sun, trekking miles to chase the light. After the sun has gone down, POKENAME glow vibrantly to find their way back home.

entry: POKENAME疾跑大片花田，黄毛在日光下明亮。见旅人低落，就开心地领去最爱花丛。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME sprints across large flower fields, its yellow fur glowing brightly in the sunlight. If it sees a traveler who looks sad, it will cheerfully lead them to its favorite flower patch.

entry: POKENAME身体充够气，就能浮到高空，靠近太阳，让头花吸更多能量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's inflatable body lets it float up high into the air once inflated enough. It does this to place itself closer to sunlight, absorbing more energy into the flower on its head.

entry: POKENAME只夜行，得吸别的花的能量，才不让自己枯萎。训练家经过花田，它都会开心招呼。
author: mistymagius
source: Since POKENAME is only active at night, it has to drain the energy from other flowers to keep its own flower from wilting. It will happily greet any Trainer that passes by its flower patch.

entry: POKENAME察觉附近悲伤，花便开始转，散出安抚花香，让心平静。
author: .izik
source: When it senses sadness nearby, POKENAME's flower begins to spin. It releases a soothing floral scent that calms the heart.

entry: POKENAME一生相当多时间在洞里吃湿润富营养的苔藓。吃足后，靠高声尖叫回声定位，走出洞穴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spend a fair chunk of their lives inside caves to nourish themselves off of moist, nutrient-rich moss. Once they have eaten their fill of moss, they rely on high pitched squeals to escape the cave via echolocation.

entry: POKENAME多半不动，爱在晴草地休息。头花随气温升降开合，特别冷时，身上倒刺状种子便掉落。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is a primarily sedentary creature that enjoys resting in a sunny patch of grass. As temperatures rise and fall, the flower on its head opens and closes. Its barb-like seeds fall from its body when it is particularly cold.

entry: POKENAME生长需大量日光，许多住洞口，晒头花。晒够后，再进洞吃营养苔藓。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME require lots of sunlight to grow, so many spend life near cave entrances to nourish the flower on their head. Once they have received enough sunlight, they venture into caverns to eat nutritious moss.

entry: POKENAME的保护色融入家乡花田。谁踩到，就被猛然炸开的衰弱性花粉攻击。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's cryptic coloration helps it blend in with the flower-filled fields it calls its home. Those who step on it will be attacked by an explosion of debilitating pollen.

entry: POKENAME用头花香引猎物。冬天花死，觅食就更难。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME uses the delightful scent from its flower to lure in prey. During the winter, the flower dies, making it harder for POKENAME to feed.

entry: POKENAME的花散发甜香，能随风飘出很远。它们的嗅觉对这种花香尤其敏锐，凭此便能在密林中找到彼此。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME exude a sweet scent from their flowers that can carry for long distances on the wind. Their sense of smell is particularly sensitive to the smell of these flowers and they use it to seek one another out in dense forests.

entry: POKENAME虽像凶猛的蜈蚣王近亲，天性却温柔善良。乐于载孩子玩，走过的地方留下花朵。
author: rakunk
source: Despite a close resemblance to its more aggressive cousin, Scolipede, POKENAME is known for its gentle and kindhearted nature. It delights in allowing children to ride on its back, leaving a trail of flowers in its wake.

entry: POKENAME颈花甜香让心情积极。常在花田嬉戏，不知不觉把身后花踩坏。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME releases a sweet scent from the flower on its neck that keeps it in a positive mood. It can be seen frolicking around flower fields, unintentionally trampling the flowers in its wake.

entry: POKENAME有些昼行，有些夜行，取决于组成它的宝可梦何时孵化。大个体可能清晨更旺盛，夜里最活跃者毒性更强。
author: bobosmith01
source: Some POKENAME are active during the daytime, while others are active during the night; it all depends on what time POKENAME's components hatched. Larger POKENAME likely thrive in the morning, while the ones most active at night have stronger toxins.

entry: POKENAME爱与头花同速缓慢旋转，释放舒缓精神波，让其他生物也跟着转。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME loves to slowly spin at the same speed as the flower on its head. It releases soothing waves of psychic energy that compels others to follow suit.

entry: POKENAME舞时，身花放大量花粉。不引过敏，常被收来做抗过敏药。
author: jaminmcready
source: When POKENAME dances, the flowers on its body release large amounts of pollen. This pollen doesn't trigger allergies and is often collected for use in allergy medications.

entry: 传闻若在孩子墓上放大量鲜花，孩子就会转生成宝可梦。能见它们成群在天灾后，让树木与花朵重新生长。
author: mistymagius
source: It is rumored that if large amounts of flowers are placed on a child's grave, they will be reborn as a Pokémon. Groups of them can be seen regrowing trees and flowers after natural disasters.

entry: POKENAME没有恶意，蹒跚穿林时，却常吓走其他宝可梦。它大吃花朵，最爱黄色的。
author: mistymagius
source: While POKENAME doesn't mean harm, it often scares away other Pokémon as it shambles around the forests. It munches on large amounts of flowers, yellow ones being its personal favorite.

entry: POKENAME整日寻找阳光。鲜艳花瓣则警告大家，它身带毒素。
author: elite01.
source: POKENAME spend their days in search of patches of sunlight. Its bright petals are a warning of the toxins POKENAME contains.

entry: POKENAME糖浆状的涂层散清爽柑橘香。有些高档咖啡馆开始用它给茶添甜。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's syrupy coating emits a refreshing, citrusy smell. Certain upscale cafes have started using this substance to sweeten their teas.

entry: 夏天，POKENAME顺风大步跃起、腾空，沿途散出有毒又恶臭的孢子。
author: bobosmith01
source: In the summer, POKENAME travel in the direction of the wind, leaping and soaring in great bounds; all the while they spread toxic and foul-smelling spores.

entry: 春天，POKENAME全身开满鲜花。多数黄色，有时也粉、白，甚至蓝色。
author: mistymagius
source: During the springtime, POKENAME's body becomes covered in brightly colored flowers. Most of these flowers are yellow, but they can sometimes be pink, white, or even blue.

entry: POKENAME是住在开花堆肥中的幽灵。常在花园留下富矿堆肥，让植物健康大大改善。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is a spirit inhabiting a flowering compost heap. It is frequently found in gardens, where it leaves behind mineral-rich compost that exponentially aids the health of the plants.

entry: POKENAME孢子让困倦者振作，哪怕累，也焦虑清醒。别的宝可梦嫌它整夜不让睡，它只好漂去不同森林。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME releases spores that vivify sleepy Pokémon, causing them to stay anxiously awake even when they are tired. It floats between different forests because other Pokémon get upset that it keeps them awake at night.

entry: 科学家在含化石的岩石中发现POKENAME花粉，认为其谱系可追溯到史前。如今也用花粉判岩石年代。
author: quackquackattack
source: After discovering POKENAME pollen in rocks containing fossils, scientists believe that POKENAME can trace back their lineages to prehistoric Pokémon. POKENAME pollen is now used as a method of determining the age of rocks.

entry: POKENAME让头上的扇叶，迎向强风，就能乘风而去，一路滑过几公里，抵达新的草地。
author: chorb33
source: When POKENAME points the fans on its head against strong winds, it is swept along. In this way, it glides several kilometers to new meadows.

entry: POKENAME爱晴天在草地追逐，鲜瓣随风拖在身后。开心时，花散美妙香气。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME love to chase one another through meadows on sunny days, their brightly coloured petals trailing behind them in the wind. When they're happy, their flowers release a wonderful fragrance.

entry: 只要周围够暖，POKENAME花朵便散宜人香。温度太低，味道就变臭。
author: sk372
source: A pleasant aroma is emitted from POKENAME's flower, so long as the temperature of its surroundings remains warm enough. If the temperature around it drops too low, the smell turns foul.

entry: POKENAME转花，悬在南瓜田上，提防入侵者。受扰就用寄生种子攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins its flower to hover above pumpkin fields. It watches for intruders, attacking with Leech Seed if disturbed.

entry: POKENAME双翼富叶绿素，靠阳光维生。晴天大群飞草地，脱落富能鳞粉，促进花朵生长。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wings are filled with chlorophyll, enabling them to subsist off of sunlight. Swarms of them flutter over meadows during sunny days, shedding energy rich wing scales that encourage the growth of flowers as they do.

entry: POKENAME夜里旋在瓜田巡视。哪个入侵者傻到靠近，就使出吸取。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME spins above pumpkin patches to patrol. It uses Absorb on any intruder foolish enough to approach.

entry: POKENAME与同伴在开满花的草地群猎，拔起大花掩身，悄悄靠近猎物。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME hunt in groups with their peers through flower meadows. They pull up large flowers to hide themselves as they approach their prey.

entry: POKENAME拉扯宽松外层，空气就满花香，因此有时被画在衣物柔顺剂包装上。
author: .realthree
source: When POKENAME tugs on its loose covering, a pleasant floral aroma fills the air. Because of that, POKENAME is sometimes depicted on packaging for fabric softeners.

entry: POKENAME柔软蓬松的花，是许多宝可梦喜爱的蹦床。让伙伴在头上跳，还能帮助授粉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a soft, plush flower that makes for a pleasant trampoline for many Pokémon. Allowing other Pokémon to bounce on its head has the added benefit of helping with pollination.

entry: POKENAME水陆都见，几乎总与伙伴玩。跳上它头顶的轻巧宝可梦，可被弹性花朵送上4英尺高空。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found on water or on land but is almost always be found playing with other Pokémon. Those light enough to jump onto its head can be launched four feet into the air with its bouncy flower.

entry: POKENAME身上的花，只要足够温暖就会绽放，散出甜香。它们寻找阳光明媚的地方躺卧，靠敏感的胡须，察知即将到来的雨。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flowers blossom when they are sufficiently warm, releasing a sweet fragrance into the air when it does. POKENAME seek out sunny locations to lounge in, relying on their sensitive whiskers to warn them of impending rain.

entry: POKENAME花暖够便开，甜香入空气。有些个体的花特别大，极为自豪，绽放时会开心咕噜。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flowers blossom when they are sufficiently warm, releasing a sweet fragrance into the air when it does. Some POKENAME have particularly large blooms that they show great pride in, purring happily as their flowers blossom.

entry: 偏头痛一来，POKENAME的花就快转。疼得厉害，甚至不慎升空漂走。
author: .izik
source: When migraines strike, POKENAME's flower spins rapidly. If the pain is intense, it may accidentally lift off and float away.

entry: POKENAME转花绕湖。一发现鲤鱼王等猎物，就迅速俯冲捕捉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME twirls over lakes by spinning its flower. When it spots prey like Magikarp, it dives swiftly to catch them.

entry: POKENAME脾气急，胳膊也短，可拳头打出的力道，却足以把钢铁，生生折弯。
author: t.i.a.
source: POKENAME have a short temper and short range with their fists. However, they can deliver enough force to bend steel.

entry: POKENAME曾是王室宠物，陪国王王后在城堡花园待客。它会送客人一朵尾上鲜花，表示善意。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME were once kept as royal pets, accompanying kings and queens when they entertain guests in the castle garden. As a sign of goodwill, it gives guests a blooming flower from its tail.

entry: 温暖月份，POKENAME常沿水面仰浮，任水流缓缓转动，花朵吸日光。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are commonly found floating along the water's surface during warmer months. They lie on their back, idly allowing the current to twirl them around as their flower soaks in sunlight.

entry: 温暖的月份，POKENAME常漂在水面。它们一起逆流游动，努力停在原位，让栖居的河流，看上去仿佛一片花田。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are commonly found floating along the water's surface during warmer months. They swim together against the current in an effort to remain in place, creating the illusion of a field of flowers in the rivers they call home.

entry: 温暖月份，POKENAME常沿水面漂。大部分能量来自阳光，在湖池聚成小小的浮草甸。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are commonly found floating along the water's surface during warmer months. They gain most of their energy from sunlight, clustering together in small floating meadows in ponds and lakes.

entry: POKENAME以精心布置的花园为傲，在水清亮的河岸培育花丛与装饰灌木。
author: ozydamians
source: POKENAME takes great pride in its carefully landscaped gardens. It cultivates flower patches and decorative bushes along river banks with sparkling clean water.

entry: POKENAME常在草甸晒太阳打盹。被接近就乘强风逃，没风则瞬间移动。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME are often seen napping in meadows, bathing in the sunlight. When approached, POKENAME will flee by riding strong winds. If there are no winds, they'll teleport instead.

entry: POKENAME爱河湖游泳，却把头花留水上，方便虫宝可梦授粉。许多行动轻巧的伙伴，也踩它头迅速过河。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy swimming in lakes and rivers but leave the flower atop their heads above water to allow Bug-type Pokémon to pollinate them. Many light-footed Pokémon also hop atop their heads to swiftly cross rivers.

entry: POKENAME嘴中甜香，引虫宝可梦来给花授粉。爱好者通常更喜欢花最大的个体。
author: mistymagius
source: A sweet scent wafts from POKENAME's mouth, encouraging Bug Pokémon to come and pollinate its flower. Enthusiasts tend to prefer POKENAME with the largest flowers.

entry: POKENAME滚过花田，传播身花花粉。睡时，三蜜蜂等虫宝可梦常蜂拥聚来。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME roll through fields of flowers, spreading pollen from the flowers on their bodies. As they sleep, Combee and other Bug-type Pokémon will often swarm them.

entry: POKENAME背上涌出浓稠花蜜。愤怒便点燃，造出甜香火焰。
author: hophoppip
source: Thick nectar gushes from along POKENAME's back. When angry, it sets the nectar ablaze, creating sweet-smelling flames.

entry: POKENAME漂花田，把黏尾探入花。之后将采来的花瓣，一片片吃掉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts above flower fields, dipping its sticky tail into blooms. Later, it eats the gathered petals one by one.

entry: 炎夏，POKENAME爱游湖降温。累了就浮水露花，安静放松。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy swimming in lakes on a hot summer day to cool off their bodies. Whenever they feel tired, they float atop the water with their flower exposed to relax.

entry: POKENAME吃落叶与濒死植物，黏液是好肥料。有些调查声称，用它种的花，香味好上10倍。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's slime is a great fertilizer as it feeds on fallen leaves and dying plants. Flowers grown using its slime supposedly smell 10 times better, according to some surveys.

entry: POKENAME壳重，限制了随风漂浮的本领，却也更能防御捕食者。它喜欢猛烈风暴来临，因为风势可能够强，将自己吹起来带走。
author: sk372
source: The weight of POKENAME's shell limits its ability to float along with the wind but gives it better defense against predators. It enjoys when heavy storms arrive as they have a chance of possessing winds strong enough to blow it away.

entry: 许多失眠者养POKENAME，借花的催眠香入睡。它却只爱吃噩梦，因为对花养分最多。
author: mepp.
source: Many people who struggle with insomnia keep POKENAME around for the soporific scent of its flower. POKENAME prefers to consume only nightmares, as they provide the most nourishment for the flower.

entry: POKENAME住热带，头花大量吸日光。讨厌被踩，就爬上大树顶，进行光合作用。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in tropical areas, absorbing large amounts of sunlight with the flower on its head. As it hates being stepped on, it will climb up large trees and sit atop them while it photosynthesizes.

entry: POKENAME背上的种子覆着柔软的白绒，触碰者都会感到刺激。为免这层绒毛被强风吹散，风特别大时，它便躲进地洞。
author: fiordaliso
source: The seed on its back is covered in a soft white fuzz that causes irritation to anyone who touches it. To prevent strong winds from blowing this coating away, POKENAME hides in its burrow during particularly windy days.

entry: POKENAME在自己的棉球上滚动，以加快移动。个头小，极端天气里常能见它抱棉球浮在空中。
author: plkfsa32
source: POKENAME rolls around on its cotton puff to move faster. Due to its small size, it can usually be seen floating in the air whilst holding onto its cotton puff during extreme weather events.

entry: POKENAME用附近绒毛编成浮筏，乘暖南风越过海洋，飞向异国。
author: gentlesage
source: POKENAME craft hovering rafts from nearby fluff to ride warm, southern winds across the sea, flying to foreign lands.

entry: POKENAME总是喜笑颜开，仿佛不停点头答应。可软绵绵的拳头，对多数宝可梦，都没什么威力。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME always has a happy expression, like it's nodding 'yes' all the time. Its soft punches aren't very effective against most Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME总迷迷糊糊地漂，对自己的花粉也没有免疫力。几个头受过敏困扰，始终沉重憋闷。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is always seen floating around in something of a daze. It's not immune to its own pollen flow, so its allergies leave its heads constantly feeling heavy and stuffy.

entry: POKENAME跃出栖居的河流时，会将尾上的一颗花粉球抛向岸边。花粉有助植物生长，因此这些河畔，常遍布繁盛鲜艳的花。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME leaps out of the rivers it calls home, it flings out one of the pollen orbs on its tail towards the river-line. The pollen aids in plant growth, so rivers with POKENAME in it tend to be bordered by plenty of robust, colorful flowers.

entry: POKENAME用尾兜风漂，节省能量。只有发现下方可口花朵，才用翼改变航线。
author: sk372
source: To save energy, POKENAME floats through the air by catching the wind with its tail. It only uses its wings to alter its flight path when it spots tasty-looking flowers beneath it.

entry: POKENAME蓬松的花朵发髻与叶裙，秋季自然脱落。时髦训练家会送漂亮冬装，让它温暖自信地等春天。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's fluffy hair bun flowers and leafy dress are naturally shed in the autumn season. Fashion-forward Trainers gift their POKENAME with stylish cold-weather outfits to keep them warm and confident until the spring.

entry: POKENAME是乘柔风迁徙的宝可梦。需吃或避难，就射黏丝抓附近树，把自己拉下天空。树叶既遮风雨，也供食物。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME are migratory Pokémon carried by gentle winds. When they need to eat or take shelter, they shoot a sticky silk at a nearby tree and pull themselves out of the sky. The leaves provide cover from the elements and a source of food.

entry: POKENAME任天气摆布，转眼就可能被卷走。有时，它们会变成鸟类宝可梦，控制自己的飞行，却无法长久保持这种形态。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are subject to the caprice of the weather and can be whisked away at a moment's notice. Sometimes they transform into bird Pokémon to control their flight, but they cannot maintain that form for long.

entry: POKENAME十分轻盈，每次弹跳，都能乘强风滑翔。它们出了名地善于适应环境，无论多恶劣都不怕，因此即使被风吹走，也能茁壮生存。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are light enough to glide on strong winds with every leap and bounce they make. They are known for adapting to any environment, no matter how harsh, so even if they are carried away by the wind, they will be able to thrive.

entry: POKENAME在风暴中活跃，能化水、沿水穿行，攀雨滴升高，再乘强风远行。干旱时则焦躁不安。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME thrives in storms. Using its ability to become and travel through water, it climbs raindrops high into the sky and rides the violent winds over great distances. POKENAME will become restless during dry periods.

entry: POKENAME棉絮极热，又是最耐火的材料之一。能起火，却不会烧尽。战中撒棉孢子，再点燃。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME cotton is incredibly hot, yet also one of the most fire-resistant materials known. Their cotton can catch on fire but will not burn away. They fight by scattering cotton spores and setting them aflame.

entry: POKENAME把棉孢子举头顶兜风，盼能飞。可圆胖身体往往太重，风带不动。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME carries its cotton spores above its head to catch the wind, hoping to fly. Sadly, its rotund body often makes it far too heavy for the wind to carry.

entry: POKENAME速度与技巧出色，翱翔天空。筑巢时会用棉絮般的绒羽。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME soars through the sky with excellent speed and skill. It uses its cotton-like down when making its nests.

entry: POKENAME用棉孢子包针，免得误蜇别人。它们成群旅行，可风常把群体吹散很远。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME covers its stingers with cotton spores to prevent accidentally stinging someone. They travel in swarms; however, wind often breaks them up and spreads them far apart.

entry: POKENAME花粉遗传构成极独特，全球无数科学家仍在研究。偶尔可见它乘热带气流，飞过丛林高空。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its pollen has such a unique genetic makeup that it continues to be the subject of study by countless scientists around the world. POKENAME can rarely be glimpsed soaring through the skies above the jungles, carried by tropical wind currents.

entry: POKENAME花粉遗传构成极独特，全球无数科学家仍在研究。偶尔可见它乘热带气流，飞过丛林高空。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its pollen has such a unique genetic makeup that it continues to be the subject of study by countless scientists around the world. POKENAME can rarely be glimpsed soaring through the skies above the jungles, carried by tropical wind currents.

entry: POKENAME把身上长出的棉花揉成球，挥打向敌人。“百代杂技”网球队的灵感，正来自它。
author: shocktopus1717
source: POKENAME makes balls out of the cotton that grows from its body, and whacks them at its enemies. It inspired The Eterna Acrobats tennis team.

entry: POKENAME爱在薰衣草田打滚，让绒身覆香粉，再悠然漂草甸，找更多花吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME enjoys rolling in lavender fields, coating its fluffy body in fragrant pollen. It floats leisurely over meadows in search of more flowers to graze on.

entry: POKENAME轻轻悬浮在玫瑰丛上，边吃边传粉。农人欣赏它的努力，因为有助作物茂盛。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hovers gently over rose bushes, transferring pollen between flowers as it feeds. Farmers appreciate its efforts, as it helps their crops flourish.

entry: POKENAME在腹部裹上一层薄薄的蓬松丝线，将蛛网收存其中，留作降落伞。一旦腾空，便会将网一下子全部放开，随风滑翔。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wrap a thin layer of puffy silk across their abdomen to store webbing until it is ready to be used as a parachute. Once airborne, they release their webbing all at once to glide through the wind.

entry: POKENAME藏花田伏击虫宝可梦，先织网，再乘气流向前跃起捕猎。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hides in fields of flowers to ambush bug Pokémon. It spins webs that it uses as netting, before leaping forward on a wind current to capture prey.

entry: POKENAME软棉翼能让它连续飞数小时不休，乘晚风优雅轻松。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's soft, cotton-like wings let it soar for hours without rest. It rides the evening wind with graceful ease.

entry: POKENAME夜行，微风也能托走，人们过去常把发光种球误认成不明飞行物。矿工用来安全照明，种子撒开还能照亮大洞。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is nocturnal and light enough to be carried by even a light wind, so people used to mistake its glowing seed puffs for UFOs. Miners use it as a safe light underground, and its seeds can be scattered to light up a large cavern.

entry: POKENAME蓬松身体的棉絮，常挠得鼻子发痒，使它频频打喷嚏。喷嚏还伴着超能力爆发，因此训练家最好把绒毛修短，免出意外。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's puffy body causes it to sneeze very often due to the cotton tickling its nose. These sneezes are accompanied by a burst of psychic power, so Trainers are advised to keep POKENAME's fluff trimmed to prevent accidents.

entry: POKENAME棉毛下的身体极纤细，轻到一阵强风就能带离巢很远。
author: .izik
source: Beneath its cottony fur, POKENAME's body is incredibly thin. It's so light that a strong breeze can carry it far from its nest.

entry: POKENAME双翼由轻软棉絮形成，不适合强拍，改借它们乘气流滑翔。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME grow wings formed of a light and fluffy cotton. Their wing composition makes them unsuitable for powerful flapping; instead, they use them to glide on air currents.

entry: POKENAME各绒球带着相反电荷。释放储存能量时，能从头部引发强大雷击。
author: .izik
source: Each of POKENAME's fluffy puffs holds an opposing electrical charge. When it releases the stored energy, it can generate powerful lightning strikes from its head.

entry: 它起舞产生的棉孢子带静电，彼此极性不一，便容易散开。这种宝可梦厌雨，常聚在洞里或浓树下躲。
author: infinex21
source: The Cotton Spores produced by this Pokémon's dancing are statically-charged, which helps them to scatter due to their incoherent polarities. They loathe rain and will often huddle in caves or under thick trees to avoid it.

entry: 有风时，常能见POKENAME浮空，成群一同旋转，把种子留在地面。
author: barfy_here
source: POKENAME are often seen floating in the air when conditions are windy. They spin around in groups together, leaving behind seeds on the ground.

entry: POKENAME风天跳舞，把棉球像绒球般挥，散孢子随风走。直到全散光，也不肯停。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME dances on windy days, waving its cotton puffs like pom-poms. This scatters spores to be carried off by the wind, and POKENAME doesn't stop dancing until all of them are gone.

entry: POKENAME活力跳舞传播种子，却常被看作负面的象征。
author: fixthewifi
source: POKENAME spreads its seeds by dancing energetically. Despite this, it is often viewed as a symbol of negativity.

entry: POKENAME跃过郁金香田，释放蓬松绒球，帮助花朵授粉，也让风景更明媚。
author: .izik
source: While leaping through tulip fields, POKENAME releases fluffy puffs. These help pollinate flowers and brighten the landscape.

entry: POKENAME靠头尾棉簇乘暖夏风，野外很美，进城却麻烦：会从窗漂进来，让房间满是难清的孢子。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME drift on warm summer breezes using the cottony tufts on their heads and tails. Beautiful in the wild, they become a nuisance in urban areas, floating in through windows and covering rooms in spores that are hard to remove.

entry: POKENAME因惊人弹跳得名，小而强的腿一跃近1千米。寒冷神秘地增强弹性肌肉，有时能跳更远。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Named for its astonishing leaps, POKENAME launches itself skyward with its small but powerful legs. Each bound can carry it nearly a kilometre, sometimes farther in cold weather, which mysteriously boosts the strength of its springy muscles.

entry: POKENAME靠背上大绒球，自由随夜风漂。天性胆怯，很少让人接近。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lets the wind carry it through the night, floating freely thanks to the large puff on its back. Naturally timid, it rarely allows humans to get close.

entry: POKENAME看着吓人，却只吃树皮，十分易惊。唯一防御是从头、手、尾喷花粉，晃眼、刺激捕食者，再逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a frightening appearance, but only eats bark and is incredibly skittish. Its only means of defense is spraying pollen from its head, hands and tail to blind and agitate predators while it runs away.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴习惯咬东西，却被厚厚的绒毛包住，攻击也就没了伤害。它一抖毛，数千棉絮状孢子便飘散出去，让自己暂时光秃秃的。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME's tail has a habit of biting, but it's coated in so much fluff that its attacks are rendered harmless. When POKENAME shakes its coat, thousands of cotton spores float away, leaving it bald for a while.

entry: POKENAME睡时附着在枫树枝上，随微风轻摇。打盹也会散孢子，帮助附近树木生长。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps while attached maple branches, gently swaying in the breeze. As it snoozes, it scatters spores to help nearby trees grow.

entry: POKENAME乘风漂游时，缩在蓬松的家中，只有落地才伸出肢体。研究仍在进行，人们想弄清它们到底有多长，又如何装进这团绒毛。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME withdraw themselves inside of their puffy homes as they drift on the wind, only extending their limbs out when they land. Studies are still being conducted to try and determine just how long they are and how they fit in their fluff.

entry: POKENAME的孢子让人极痒。敌人因此失去行动能力后，它就将对方远远抛走。
author: mepp.
source: The spores produced by POKENAME cause a great amount of itchiness. Once foes are incapacitated by this, POKENAME hurls them far away.

entry: POKENAME加热棉絮般外壳内的空气，便能随风远行。它们寻找荒地，将旅途收来的种子，连同黏液散出，帮助植物生长。
author: secondegg
source: By heating the air within its cotton-like shell, POKENAME can float in the wind to travel great distances. It seeks out barren areas, spreading seeds that it has picked up in its travels along with its slime, which helps promote plant growth.

entry: 空中交战，POKENAME疯狂摇头，撒蓬松纤维。纤维妨碍对手动作，给它时间脱身。
author: .izik
source: When midair battles occur, POKENAME shakes its head frantically, scattering fluffy fibers into the air. These fibers disrupt an opponent's movement, giving it time to escape.

entry: 随风的POKENAME，有时被误认成断线风筝或风向袋。棉球种子可防敌，一周内球就再长回。
author: pjporwoll
source: When borne upon the wind, POKENAME is sometimes mistaken for a loose kite or windsock. The seeds of its cotton puff are used to ward off foes, and the puff regrows within a week.

entry: POKENAME常追暖风，以鼻上棉絮判断去向。
author: sylviasnake
source: POKENAME are often found following warm gusts of wind. They use the cotton that grows on their trunk to decide where to go.

entry: POKENAME收电脑内尘埃碎屑，长大身上3颗绒球，也清洁设备。球可安全摘下丢弃，是保持电子设备洁净运作的宝贵帮手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME grows the three fluffy orbs on its body by gathering dust and detritus from within computers, cleaning them out. The orbs are easy to safely remove and dispose of, making POKENAME invaluable for keeping electronics clean and functional.

entry: POKENAME奔过绿田，用头尾绒让花粉随风散。人们发现，长出的花从空中俯瞰，是巨大艺术作品。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME runs about in verdant fields, using the fluff on its head and tail to let pollen scatter in the winds. It has been discovered that the blooming flowers from its actions create vast works of art when viewed from above.

entry: 多数人和宝可梦对POKENAME棉球过敏。它战中每拳裹敌一层棉，让对方眼泪直流、频打喷嚏。
author: wiz0z
source: Most people and Pokémon are allergic to POKENAME's cotton puffs. They use this to their advantage in combat, covering their opponent in cotton with each punch, resulting in watering eyes and frequent sneezing.

entry: POKENAME体型虽大，却十分胆小，稍有风吹草动就逃。被逼得无路可退时，它便用尾上的绒毛拍击敌人，撒出花粉干扰视线，争取脱身的机会。
author: sk372
source: Despite its large size, POKENAME is a very timid Pokémon that runs at the first sign of trouble. If cornered, it smacks an opponent with the fluff on its tail, spreading pollen to agitate the attacker's vision so POKENAME can escape.

entry: 吸入POKENAME的孢子，会让人感到极大的快乐，却也会使人病得很重。每到这时，它虽然会试着照顾病人，可待在附近，只会让情况更加恶化。
author: soup1900
source: While breathing in the spores of POKENAME gives great joy, they also cause the person breathing them in to become gravely unwell. POKENAME does try to nurse the sick person when this happens, but it being in the proximity only worsens the situation.

entry: 吸入POKENAME棉孢子虽幸福快乐，也会重病。这时它就乘风，用袋带来幼年宝可梦，想让病人好受些。
author: soup1900
source: While breathing in the cotton spores of POKENAME gives happiness and joy, they also cause you to become gravely unwell. When this occurs, POKENAME rides winds to collect baby Pokémon in its pouch so they can help make the sick person feel better.

entry: 受到威胁时，POKENAME向周围抖落几团花粉般的绒毛，再放出强力电流。电光在绒团间跳跃，形成连锁闪电般的效果。
author: sk372
source: When threatened, POKENAME shakes off several bits of pollen-like fluff into the air around it. It then releases powerful electric jolts from its body that jump from clump to clump, creating a chain-lightning effect.

entry: POKENAME每次振翅都会洒种子，帮助新的草属性宝可梦生长，也治愈受伤个体。预言称，种子能将荒地变成繁茂森林。
author: teatedtiten
source: POKENAME scatters seeds with every flap of its wings. These seeds help grow new Grass-Types and heal those that have been wounded. These seeds are prophesied to turn wastelands into lush forests.

entry: POKENAME随季风周游世界，把食物存棉孢子里，准备长旅。不断吃零食增重，也决定当天被风带多远。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME stores food within its cotton spores for long voyages as it travels throughout the world on seasonal winds. Its weight gain from constant snacking determines how far the winds can carry it on any given day.

entry: POKENAME抖出手上花粉，促进花蜜丰富的花朵生长。用完后，会从圆肚里吐出体内产生的粉团，重新补满。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME promotes the growth of nectar-rich flowers with the pollen it shakes from its hands. When they run out, it restocks them by regurgitating lumps of pollen produced from within its rotund belly.

entry: POKENAME射爆炸棉球自保。身体出奇轻，够强的风便能托离地。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME shoots explosive cotton balls to protect itself. Its body is surprisingly light and can be lifted from the ground by a strong enough gust.

entry: POKENAME可爱友善，带新鲜草香，许多人想养。可它生来漫游、厌室内，只有四处旅行的训练家适合饲养。
author: periperi_chicken
source: Many wish to keep POKENAME as pets, due to their cute appearance, friendly demeanour and the scent of fresh outdoor grass that follows them. POKENAME were born to roam, and hate being kept indoors. Only Trainers living on the move should own one.

entry: 运动队爱请POKENAME当啦啦队员。欢乐活泼的性格，连最可爱的妖精属性宝可梦也能媲美。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Sports teams love using POKENAME as cheerleaders. Their joyful and energetic personality rivals even the cutest Fairy-types.

entry: POKENAME脚上覆着柔软的棉絮状孢子，能缓冲强力踢击，方便面对弱敌时控制力道。遇到强敌，它便射出种子，露出脚爪冲锋。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's feet are covered with soft cotton spores, cushioning its powerful kicks and allowing it to balance its power against a weaker opponent. When facing a powerful foe, it blasts the seeds at them and charges with its foot talons exposed.

entry: 野外，相互竞争的POKENAME会用头碰撞，让头上的花粉成团散开。因此，它们栖居的地方，植物往往更加繁茂。
author: sk372
source: Rival POKENAME bonk heads against each other in the wild, causing the pollen on their head to disperse in great batches. Areas where POKENAME live tend to be filled with a greater amount of plant-life due to this.

entry: POKENAME挥着毽子棉绒毛做的绒球，一心想当一位，热情洋溢的啦啦队员。
author: thisisnotaplaceholder
source: POKENAME wields pom-poms made of Jumpluff's fluff. It aspires to be a passionate cheerleader.

entry: POKENAME受惊便会伪装、逃走，沿途留下棉种。若这发生在荒地，新出现的植物，可能让一套新生态由此兴起。
author: dodoowner_
source: When startled, POKENAME will camouflage itself and run away, leaving a trail of cotton seeds in the process. If this activity happens in a barren field, it may jumpstart a new ecosystem due to the new presence of plants.

entry: POKENAME漂枝间，精准折掉濒死枝条，收来送到河边小屋，供建筑用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts between tree branches, snapping off dying limbs with surprising precision. It collects these broken branches and delivers them to riverside lodges for use in construction.

entry: POKENAME以紧密花粉团现身，绕所住的毽子棉状石头漂。友善爱社交，可形体天性常让其他生物喷嚏不停。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME manifests itself as a tightly packed mass of pollen that can float around the Jumpluff-like stone it is housed in. It is very friendly and social, but the nature of its form often causes other creatures to sneeze constantly.

entry: 近年农人爱用POKENAME形稻草人，因为领地习性会赶走同类。可若有一只识破，整块田便会被吃得精光。
author: boggyboat
source: In recent years, scarecrows of POKENAME have become quite popular amongst farmers, due to the fact that their territorial behavior wards off others of their own species. If one grows wise to this, though, the entire field will be completely devoured.

entry: POKENAME冲撞别人，是为了玩耍，并非出于敌意。撞击的力道虽轻，却会散出大量花粉，往往使玩伴的过敏加重。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME charges down others not as a mark of aggression but as a way of playing. The impact is gentle, though it spreads out a large amount of pollen that typically aggravates the playmate's allergies.

entry: POKENAME很受大姐姐欢迎，训练家努力模仿外貌与优雅。它享受宠爱，也常参加华丽大赛。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular Pokémon with Beauties, the Trainers striving to emulate their appearance and grace. POKENAME enjoy the attention lavished upon them and are common entrants in Pokémon contests.

entry: POKENAME常在平原蹦跳。刮风时，用强健双腿稳住自己。
author: schwaus
source: POKENAME can be found bouncing on plains. It uses its strong legs to stay sturdy during windy days.

entry: POKENAME随季节乘风环游世界，洒下孢子。接触会造成细小割伤，呼吸时须当心。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME scatters spores as it rides the wind across the world seasonally. Contact with these can give tiny cuts, so take caution when breathing.

entry: 过敏季节，POKENAME将缎带末端生长的花粉，吹向旁人。这并非恶意，已证实吸入后，抗过敏的效果最长可持续一周。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME blows the bits of pollen that grow at the end of its ribbons at others during allergy seasons. This is not a malevolent act, as inhaling this special pollen has proven to combat allergies for up to a week after inhalation.

entry: POKENAME乘柔风往来花田，身体蹭花再飞，帮助授粉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME ride on soft zephyrs to travel between fields of flowers. They help pollinate flowers by rubbing their bodies against flowers before flying away.

entry: POKENAME轻漂农田，从绒球散孢子，让下方宝可梦困倦，便于躲捕食者。
author: .izik
source: Floating gently over farmlands, POKENAME scatters spores from its puffy poms. The spores induce drowsiness in any Pokémon below, making it easy for POKENAME to evade predators.

entry: POKENAME高速飞，身后留棉状碎屑，能轻轻漂数小时。
author: .izik
source: While flying at high speeds, POKENAME leaves behind a trail of cotton-like debris. The puffs it leaves in its wake float gently for hours.

entry: POKENAME用太阳能电离周围空气，造出招牌光球，并借此产生升力。
author: inquis1
source: POKENAME uses solar power to ionize the air around it. This creates its signature balls of light; this, in turn, generates lift.

entry: POKENAME身轻，不费力就能在暗洞滑翔，向毫无戒心的猎物释放带电蛛网。
author: .izik
source: In dimly lit caves, POKENAME glides effortlessly, releasing electrified webbing onto unsuspecting prey. Its lightweight body allows it to stay airborne with minimal effort.

entry: POKENAME绒球尾转眼再生，用它乘风，再烧掉落地。
author: danarchosyndacalist
source: A POKENAME can regrow its puffball tails in moments. It uses them to ride the wind and burns them off to land.

entry: POKENAME不靠游泳或沿海床爬行，而任洋流载着，沿途吸收透入水中的日光补养分。
author: t3isukone
source: Rather than swimming or crawling across the seabed, POKENAME allow themselves to be carried by the ocean's currents, absorbing the sunlight that filters in for nutrients as they go.

entry: POKENAME奇爱面粉，用硬化绒毛仿钥匙形状。夜里潜进人家，闯入食品储藏室，偷最爱的面粉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has an unusual craving for flour and will mimic the shape of keys using hardened fluff. It sneaks into homes at night, breaking into pantries to steal its favorite treat.

entry: POKENAME本体小，附肢像乒乓球，轻得宛如塑料袋般随风飞舞。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The lightweight POKENAME flies around in the wind like a plastic bag with its tiny body and ping pong ball appendages.

entry: POKENAME摇绒球，在洞边撒毒棉。纤维黏皮，一碰就刺痛。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME shakes its fluffy poms to scatter poisonous cotton near its burrow. The fibers cling to skin and sting on contact.

entry: 它们用绒毛与棉絮筑屋。屋子一被吹走，POKENAME便坐在里面，前往新的土地。
author: staghorn
source: They construct lodges out of fluff and cotton. When these lodges blow away, the POKENAME ride inside them to travel to new lands.

entry: POKENAME腹部覆一层层蓬松防水花粉。晴朗风天，它倒浮水面，让风把粉带去远地。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's underside is covered with layers of fluffy waterproof pollen. On sunny, windy days, it floats upside-down on the water's surface to let the breeze carry the pollen off to distant lands.

entry: 雷雨时，POKENAME任强风卷起，带电空气积进绒球，必要时可放静电。
author: .izik
source: During thunderstorms, POKENAME allows itself to be swept up by strong winds. The charged air builds up within its poms, allowing it to unleash static shocks if needed.

entry: POKENAME尾上9个棉球极轻，让身体几乎不沾地。暖日里，种子随风散再多，也似乎不见缩小。
author: .jerden
source: The nine cotton puffs on POKENAME's tail are so light that it barely touches the ground. No matter how many seeds scatter to the wind on warm days, they never seem to get any smaller.

entry: POKENAME棉球外表下，是沉重金属部件，比看着重得多。开心从齿轮跳去抱训练家时，常惹麻烦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is deceptively heavy, as its cotton-puff exterior covers heavy metal body parts. This sometimes causes issues when a happy POKENAME launches from the gear to hug its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME遇大生物很快逃，身后放大量绒粉。追者一吸毒粉，迅速剧痛咳嗽、接连打喷嚏。
author: sk372
source: Quick to flee from larger beings, POKENAME lets loose lots of fluffy pollen behind as it runs away. Pursuers who inhale the poisonous pollen find themselves quickly beset with painful coughing and sneezing fits.

entry: POKENAME大风时举触角兜风，让自己滚过大地。绒毛帮助它轻松通过最崎岖的地形。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME raise their antennae up when there's a strong wind, using it to catch the breeze and send themselves rolling across the landscape. Their fluff helps them travel across even the roughest terrain without difficulty.

entry: POKENAME身上的蒲公英状突起，分泌强毒。接触会造成疼痛灼伤与起泡。
author: .izik
source: The dandelion-like growths on POKENAME's body secrete a potent toxin. Contact can cause painful burns and blistering.

entry: POKENAME虽大却极轻。棉絮孢子可以安全骑乘，但哪怕只吸入一点，也可能剧咳或发痒。
author: h0bojoe
source: Despite its large size, POKENAME is extremely light. Although its cotton-puff spores are safe to ride on, inhaling any may cause violent coughing or itchiness.

entry: POKENAME冻结多余绒毛，作柔软身体的甲。它借暴雪掩护，密集散射结晶绒毛攻击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME freeze the spare fluff that they produce to act as armor for their soft bodies. They scatter barrages of crystallized fluff to attack under the cover of blizzards.

entry: POKENAME播种季漂游，沿途收树果种。继续飞时，风抖落种子，让各处野生树果地得到滋养。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME float around during planting seasons, collecting many berry seeds along their journey. As they continue to float, the wind knocks the seeds out, causing them to fertilize random patches of wild berries.

entry: POKENAME漂过墓园，将棉簇放在被遗忘的坟上。据说这举动，是向不得安息的亡灵致意。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts through graveyards, placing tufts of cotton atop forgotten graves. The gesture is said to honor restless spirits.

entry: POKENAME头棉能黏所有布料与许多材料，却没人用，因为对活组织腐蚀性极强。
author: fireflower20002
source: The cotton on POKENAME's head can stick to all types of cloth and many other materials. However, nobody uses POKENAME's cotton since it is highly corrosive to living tissue.

entry: POKENAME没绒翼就飞不好，秋天棉羽脱落时，会去偏远处避难。巢址严守秘密，一被发现就搬走。
author: bobosmith01
source: They cannot fly well without their fluffy wings, so they flee to a remote location when their cottonlike feathers fall out in autumn. This hidden nest's location is a closely guarded secret; if it is discovered, POKENAME move elsewhere.

entry: POKENAME头绒极易脱落，微风也能吹走。绒覆花粉，是花粉症患者很强的过敏原。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME head fluff detaches easily, blowing free from their bodies with even a mild breeze. Their fluff is coated in pollen and can be a major allergenic for those who suffer from hayfever.

entry: POKENAME身体由细蓝沙组成。雨后，背上常长蒲公英与小野花。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is formed from fine blue sand. Dandelions and small wildflowers often sprout from its back after it rains.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇覆着一层厚厚的棉絮状孢子。孢子能迸散出去，既用于自卫，也能促进附近真菌生长。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's mushrooms are coated with a thick layer of cotton-like spores. The spores can burst and spread outward both as a defense mechanism and as a way to stimulate fungal growth in the area.

entry: POKENAME漂草甸上，放大片发光黄孢子，击昏猎物，再用超级吸取摄取生命力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases large clouds of glowing yellow spores to knock out prey while floating above meadows. Once they are unconscious, it uses Mega Drain to sap their vitality.

entry: POKENAME手上棉孢子的纤维能硬化，形成刀锋般锐面。棉让它乘风，从树梢漂到林地伏击。
author: ilazerheart
source: The fibers of the cotton-puff spores on POKENAME's hands can harden, forming a razor-sharp surface. The cotton allows it to glide on the wind, drifting from the treetops to the forest floor to ambush prey.

entry: POKENAME巨大的孢子，很容易聚成一团，摸起来柔软，分量却不减。有些商人尝试用这些孢子制成枕头，却发现，一旦吸入，就会使人陷入沉睡。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME's massive spores like to clump together. They're soft to the touch while still retaining their mass. Some entrepreneurs tried to use POKENAME's spores to make pillows, only to discover they invoke a deep sleep if inhaled.

entry: POKENAME能远射种子，安抚目标入梦。几起旅人突然在异地醒来的事件，都被归咎于它的顽皮。
author: chorb33
source: It can shoot its seeds over long distances, which have a soothing effect that sends its targets off to the realm of dreams. Several incidents in which travelers suddenly wake up in different places have been attributed to mischievous POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME清早巡瓜田。察觉作物生病，就挥头绒，通知附近农人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME roams pumpkin patches at early morning. If it senses a sick crop, it waves the fluff on its head to alert nearby farmers.

entry: 风大的日子里，POKENAME成群振翅升空，各自寻找最强的阵风。它们飞行时伸开蓬松的双臂，团团种子便随微风飘离群体。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flutter into the sky in large swarms on windy days, each of them searching for the strongest gusts of wind. They hold their fluffy arms out as they fly, clouds of seeds drifting away from the swarm in the breeze.

entry: POKENAME夜漂时释放亮种球，像心跳般脉动。传说用头接住一颗，就能实现一个愿望。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME drifts through the night sky, it releases glowing seed puffs that pulse like heartbeats. Legend says catching one on your head grants a single wish.

entry: POKENAME白天晒着太阳，散播棉絮孢子。夜里则钻进地下深处，躲开天敌。
author: gentlesage
source: POKENAME spends its day basking in the sunlight and scattering cotton spores. At night, it burrows deep into the ground to escape predators.

entry: 有风的清晨，只有运气极好才能瞥见POKENAME。它安然漂游，绒脸上始终挂着一丝微笑。
author: shreks_stepfather
source: If one gets supremely lucky on a windy morning, one may catch a glimpse of POKENAME. It serenely floats from place to place, a tiny smile everpresent on its fluffy face.

entry: POKENAME三个绒球极黏，用来捕捉浮游生物吃。
author: dylonk25
source: The three puffballs attached to POKENAME are highly adhesive. They are used to trap plankton for consumption.

entry: POKENAME一旦选好定居的地方，就再也挪不走。它会吸引来大群毽子鼠，在这里寻找安全的住处。
author: gentlesage
source: Once a POKENAME decides on a place to settle, it is impossible to remove. It attracts hordes of Jumplett that are seeking a safe place.

entry: POKENAME操控尾棉，变成表达情绪的符号。若成骷髅形，就是准备扑击。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME has the ability to manipulate the cotton on its tail, forming symbols that convey its emotions. When the cotton takes the shape of a skull, it is preparing to pounce.

entry: 捕食者靠近宁静潟湖，POKENAME就急摇绒球，分散注意，再逃跑，将威胁引离家。
author: .izik
source: If a predator nears its peaceful lagoon, POKENAME rapidly shakes its poms to create a distraction. It then flees, leading the threat away from its home.

entry: POKENAME飞行本领出众，能驾驭遇到的气流，借暖风飞得更远。旅途中，它们从尾上的棉絮放出花粉，传播到各处，让新的花朵绽放。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an exceptionally skilled flier, mastering the air currents it encounters and using warm winds to cover greater distances. From the cotton on its tail, it releases pollen during its journeys, spreading it to make new flowers bloom.

entry: POKENAME在湖面附近游，白天晒太阳。头叶造氧气泡，游过便留一道泡沫。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swim near the surface of lakes, basking in the sunlight during daytime. The leaves on their head create bubbles of oxygen, leaving a trail of foam behind them as they swim.

entry: POKENAME公开锻炼，想炫体格、收赞美。可举的哑铃其实是蒲公英绒做的，轻得不可思议。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME exercise openly, eager to show off their physique and receive compliments. Being made of dandelion fluff, the dumbbell they lift is actually incredibly light.

entry: POKENAME一叹气，就离地漂走，把花粉散遍田野。
author: clawshdi
source: When POKENAME sighs, it lifts off the ground and starts to float away, spreading pollen across the fields.

entry: POKENAME早年生活在海中，会用贝壳做球拍，与同类竞技。年长后，任轻盈身体乘风，去远方找其他宝可梦对赛。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Early in its life at sea, POKENAME will fashion a racket out seashells to play sports against other POKENAME. Later on in life, it allows its light body to be swept up by the winds to play against other Pokémon farther abroad.

entry: POKENAME容易发怒，常袭击训练家。可拳头全是棉花，打起来，根本不痛。
author: sand_coffin
source: POKENAME is easily irritated and is known to attack Trainers frequently. However, due to having cotton for fists, its punches don't hurt at all.

entry: POKENAME小跑草甸，身后花粉让蒲公英遍地盛开。若遇比自己快的宝可梦，就苦练，直到精疲力尽倒下。
author: fiordaliso
source: As POKENAME trots across meadows, it leaves behind a trail of pollen that causes dandelions to bloom across the grass in abundance. If it encounters a faster Pokémon, it trains relentlessly until it collapses from exhaustion.

entry: POKENAME通常不会飞，就收蒲公英茎兜风远行。落地撒种，培育花田，补充茎秆。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are normally flightless, so they gather dandelion stalks to help them catch the breeze and travel great distances. They scatter dandelion seeds as they land to cultivate fields and replenish the supply of stalks.

entry: POKENAME奔跑的时速，可达60英里，能把身上的种子，撒遍草地，长出各式花朵。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can run up to 60 miles per hour, spreading the seeds on its body over all the meadows. Flowers of all kinds grow from it.

entry: POKENAME奔跑的时速，可达60英里，能把身上的种子，撒遍草地，长出各式花朵。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can run up to 60 miles per hour, spreading the seeds on its body over all the meadows. Flowers of all kinds grow from it.

entry: POKENAME奔跑的时速，可达60英里，能把身上的种子，撒遍草地，长出各式花朵。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can run up to 60 miles per hour, spreading the seeds on its body over all the meadows. Flowers of all kinds grow from it.

entry: POKENAME被攻击时，就旋转头顶的突起，扬起大量种子，挡住敌人的视线，再趁机逃走。
author: chorb33
source: When POKENAME is attacked, it whirls the outgrowths on its head around to block its opponent's view with lots of seeds and then runs away.

entry: POKENAME沿路采有害杂草吃，人们开始用它照顾大花园。
author: camtft
source: Wherever POKENAME moves, they pick up harmful weeds to consume. Humans have begun utilizing them to care for large gardens.

entry: POKENAME沿海岸懒漂，摘岸边海藻当零食。只爱最软的，硬或苦的都丢掉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts lazily along the coastline, plucking seaweed from the shore to snack on. It prefers the softest strands and will discard any tough or bitter ones.

entry: POKENAME偶尔在球果树干留小牙印，告知领地，又不致严重伤树。
author: .izik
source: Occasionally, POKENAME makes small teeth marks on an apricorn tree trunk. This tells others of its territory without damaging the tree extensively.

entry: POKENAME用电烧穿木门，或令金属门的电锁短路。主要奔着奶酪轮去，因为滚着带回洞里，方便又好玩。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their electricity to burn holes in wooden doors or short-circuit electrical locks on metal doors. They mainly go after cheese wheels, especially because they find it convenient and entertaining to roll with them back to their dens.

entry: POKENAME群住发电厂，啃电线吸电。能量吃太多就爆炸，造成停电。
author: santon5512
source: Packs of POKENAME will reside in power plants, chewing on wires to absorb electricity. If they consume too much energy, they will explode, causing blackouts.

entry: POKENAME尾巴绑在一起，不停争主导。为食物、走哪边互斗，彼此啃咬拉扯。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's tails are bound together, leaving them in a constant fight for dominance. They will fight among themselves over food and which way to go, gnawing at and yanking each other.

entry: POKENAME找骨头作武器，欺负小拉达，抢食物。小拉达常偷骨盔报复，让攻击陷入恶性循环。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME wields a bone it procures to bully Rattata and steal their food from them. Rattata often retaliate by stealing its skull helmet, furthering the vicious cycle of aggression.

entry: 火箭队常养POKENAME，派去潜入戒备地点。可它容易分心，反而跑去洗劫食物。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are often kept by Team Rocket, sending them to stealthily infiltrate secure locations. However, they often get distracted, instead opting to raid the place for food.

entry: POKENAME战斗时更爱用腿，也不怕用咬作为卑鄙手段。锻炼后，汗很像陈年奶酪的味道。
author: mistymagius
source: While preferring to use its legs in combat, POKENAME is not afraid to bite its opponents instead as a cheap tactic. After exercising, its sweat smells a lot like old cheese.

entry: POKENAME把不屈斗志用在不断找食物上。它凶狠护粮，快拳配惊人咬力，赶走想捡食的生物。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME possesses an indomitable fighting spirit, which it channels into its constant pursuit of food. It fiercely protects its hoard, pairing rapid punches with its incredible bite force to ward off would-be scavengers.

entry: 体内不断产生的毒气，让POKENAME浮了起来。它也能通过牙齿，将毒素传给对方。
author: chorb33
source: It continuously produces poisonous gases in its body that cause POKENAME to float. It can transmit these poisons via its teeth.

entry: POKENAME群无法移动，靠拉达搬来搬去。唯一的牙齿能啃开树木结的坚果，也能咬破企图吃它的宝可梦，挣脱出来。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: A swarm of POKENAME can't move, and rely on Raticate to carry them from one place to another. Its singular tooth allows it to nibble on and break tree nuts, and break out from another Pokémon that tries to eat them.

entry: POKENAME漂下水道与垃圾场，不停吃垃圾维生，给毒气添燃料。年纪越大，排出的气越毒。
author: santon5512
source: Floating through sewers and trash dumps, POKENAME are constantly consuming garbage to survive. The trash that they eat fuels the poisonous gas they spew from their bodies, which becomes more toxic as they grow older.

entry: POKENAME吃时领地意识极强，城市一见它觅食，街道常会疏散。最好任它吃够，打扰可能引发毁灭性暴走。
author: santon5512
source: Extremely territorial while eating, city streets are often evacuated if these Pokémon are spotted looking for food. It is best to simply let POKENAME eat to its heart's content as disturbing them could lead to a devastating rampage.

entry: POKENAME把食物存袋，给幼崽吃。也张臂欢迎小拉达，常让它们把袋当家。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will stash food in their pouches for their young to eat. Rattata will often make these pouches their homes as well, as POKENAME welcome them with open arms.

entry: POKENAME用锐齿啃穿珊瑚，吃藏在坚硬礁体里的动物。它们还会啃出礁洞，方便遇险时快速逃离，也从不离洞太远。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their sharp teeth to gnaw through coral, feeding on the animals hiding within the rocky growths of the reef. They gnaw burrows into the reef to have a quick escape route when threatened, never straying far from their holes.

entry: 走到哪里，祸就闯到哪里。问题严重得让科学家正研究空中捕鼠器等对策。
author: sottiwotti
source: This Pokémon wreaks havoc everywhere they go. It's such a big problem, scientists are trying to develop countermeasures like airborne mouse traps.

entry: 快餐店常请POKENAME表演，它也开心吃应得的一份。可若不满足，打烊后有时还闯进来偷。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is often employed as an entertainer at fast-food restaurants, happily eating its share of the food. However, it will sometimes break in after hours to steal more if not satisfied.

entry: 许多海滨居民见POKENAME游向偏远岛屿。抵达后，因天敌少，往往迅速繁衍。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many locals who live along beaches describe POKENAME swimming through the water towards remote islands. They often proliferate quickly when they arrive at these islands, as there are few predators to stop them.

entry: POKENAME常在家中为害，会咬开垃圾桶，找里面的剩食。头上毒刺若扎到人，会引起轻微皮疹。
author: sk372
source: A common household pest, POKENAME chews its way into garbage cans to get to the discarded foodstuffs within. It's poison stinger on its head will cause a minor rash if stung by it.

entry: POKENAME胡须带来极强嗅觉，能找洞里食物。毒刺帮助攻击、击败洞中住客。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's whiskers provide an extreme sense of smell, allowing them to locate food in burrows. Their venomous stinger allows them to attack and defeat the burrow's residents.

entry: POKENAME背上住小拉达群，游海时替它放哨。它救下从正在下沉的船上逃出的小拉达；背上太挤，就送到最近港口。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's back is home to a group of Rattata, who keep watch for threats as POKENAME swims across the ocean. POKENAME will rescue Rattata they find fleeing from sinking ships, and if its back becomes crowded, it will take them to the nearest port.

entry: POKENAME背上住小拉达群，游海时替它放哨。它救下从正在下沉的船上逃出的小拉达；背上太挤，就送到最近港口。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's back is home to a group of Rattata, who keep watch for threats as POKENAME swims across the ocean. POKENAME will rescue Rattata they find fleeing from sinking ships, and if its back becomes crowded, it will take them to the nearest port.

entry: POKENAME咬什么就能变什么。咬越深，变身越准确。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can transform into anything it bites. The deeper the bite, the more accurate the transformation becomes.

entry: POKENAME靠近进化石，尖牙就振动。它立刻钻地，挖出取回。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fang vibrates when near evolution stones. It immediately digs underground to uncover and retrieve them.

entry: POKENAME多见污染海岸，吃水里能找的任何垃圾。人们也因此常养它，帮助清洁。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are most often found on polluted shores, eating whatever trash they can find in the water. They are often kept around for this reason, helping to clean up garbage.

entry: POKENAME遇险竖毛，准备射电针自卫。它爱啃电线，市区视它为小害兽。
author: sk372
source: When in danger, POKENAME's fur bristles out as it prepares to fire needles of electricity in defense. It enjoys chewing on electrical wiring, so urban areas consider it a bit of a pest.

entry: POKENAME需至少一小群同类，才能好好生活。它们挤堆睡，毛中暖意合起，让空气出现肉眼可见的热影。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a social creature, needing at least a small group of its own kind to properly function. They sleep in clumped piles, the warmth from their fur combining to cause visible heat distortion in the air.

entry: 不知为何，POKENAME爱吃奶酪相关网站中的代码。研究者还解释不了这数字食谱。
author: .izik
source: For unknown reasons, POKENAME prefers to feed on code embedded in cheese-related websites. Researchers have yet to explain this digital diet.

entry: POKENAME虽需休息才能充分进化，却爱尖叫嘶吼数小时，汇聚进化怒气。叫声最远传5英里，近处的捕食者会头晕。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: Despite needing rest to fully evolve, POKENAME prefers to squeal and hiss for several hours, channeling the rage required for it to evolve. Its cries can be heard from up to 5 miles away, making potential predators dizzy in close proximity.

entry: POKENAME以拾食为生，一觉附近有生物，就迅速埋土。它比化石盔更能耐低温。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a scavenger Pokémon that quickly buries itself in dirt if it senses others nearby. It can withstand cooler temperatures than Kabuto.

entry: POKENAME以堵住繁忙道路闻名，却也最适合守护重要物件，挡住窥探的目光。
author: inksans201x
source: While it's notorious for blocking busy pathways, POKENAME is ideal for protecting important things from wandering eyes.

entry: POKENAME夜逛城市，填无底胃口。早上，垃圾箱常被它吃空。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will roam cities at night, searching for food to fuel their insatiable appetite. By morning, dumpsters are often found completely empty, having been cleared out by these Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME主动捕猎，用长身体钻别的宝可梦洞。耳与胡须对声音动作极敏，在漆黑地下也能追猎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are active predators, using their long bodies to worm into the burrows of other Pokémon when hunting. Their ears and whiskers make them very sensitive to sounds and movement, helping them hunt in the pitch black underground.

entry: POKENAME主动捕猎，用长身体钻别的宝可梦洞。耳与胡须对声音动作极敏，在漆黑地下也能追猎。
author: katieplaysgames
