source: POKENAME are active predators, using their long bodies to worm into the burrows of other Pokémon when hunting. Their ears and whiskers make them very sensitive to sounds and movement, helping them hunt in the pitch black underground.

entry: POKENAME几乎什么都吃。消化系统碰到难处理的东西，就转进身上宝石，使其膨大。若爆开，能量足以炸出小坑。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME eat almost anything, and if their digestive system encounters anything problematic, it gets diverted to the gem on its body. The gem swells in size, and if it ever pops, it releases enough energy to form a small crater.

entry: POKENAME一发现钻头状双手磨损，就会抛掉，重新长出。不知情的宝可梦想吃旧钻头，却发现仍满是多余毒液，能在胃里停留最长一个月。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME will always eject its drill hands to grow new ones when they get worn out. Unsuspecting Pokémon will try eating these discarded drills, only to find they are still packed with excess poison that can sit in their stomachs for up to a month.

entry: POKENAME的威势，方圆数英里都能感到。许多训练家笑它矮小，却被超能力像排球般抛来抛去，最后送进平流层。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME's intimidating presence can be felt for miles around. Many Trainers laugh due to its small stature, and are tossed around like volleyballs before being sent to the stratosphere by its psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME泛滥大多无害，却几乎清不走。许多除害工人有恐怖经历：被它玩弄后，它自己传走，甚至把追者送去未知地方。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: POKENAME infestations are mostly harmless, but can prove nearly impossible to get rid of. Many pest control workers have horror stories about POKENAME toying with them, and either warping away or even teleporting their chasers to parts unknown.

entry: POKENAME靠叶香与其他小拉达融合体沟通。独特动作与细微香气变化，让它向同族传多种消息。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the scent its leaf emits to communicate with other Rattata fusions. It has numerous unique motions and minute scent fluctuations in order to send a variety of messages to its kin.

entry: POKENAME伸长颈，把头探进窗，抢露在外的食物。颈圈味极像奶酪，病中的宝可梦吃下便能得到治愈。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their long necks to reach their heads through windows, snatching any food left out in the open. The collar around their necks tastes remarkably like cheese, healing any sick Pokémon who eat from it.

entry: POKENAME极胆小，对视就退，野外因此少见。想接近的训练家，初遇便看地、递树果，避免吓走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are extremely skittish and rarely seen in the wild, as eye contact causes them to retreat. To avoid this, eager Trainers look down at the ground while offering berries during initial encounters.

entry: POKENAME靠体内器官掌握捕食者的睡眠规律，找准时机再去觅食。
author: demonic_garbage
source: With the help of its internal organ, POKENAME can track its predators' sleeping patterns. When the time is right, POKENAME scrounges for food.

entry: POKENAME虽在城镇扮重要角色，对付却是噩梦。它藏最小地板缝，常在天花板筑巢，用细织网从上偷食。
author: thordemidgard
source: Despite playing an important role in towns and cities, POKENAME are a nightmare to deal with. They will hide in the smallest spots between floors, often building their nests on ceilings and stealing food from above with carefully spun webs.

entry: POKENAME强力的咬击，还带着轻微毒性，能制服猎物。它们也能拾食树果，甚至垃圾。几乎哪里都能活下去，让这种融合体格外繁盛。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME's powerful bite is augmented by a weak poison. While this can be used to subdue prey, it is also capable of scavenging food such as Berries or even garbage. Its ability to survive almost anywhere has made it a particularly prolific fusion.

entry: 许多人觉得家有POKENAME，没别的虫患鼠患糟。墙内抓挠虽烦，它却猎尽昆虫，几乎让家里无虫，足以弥补。
author: sk372
source: Many treat having a POKENAME living in one's house as less of a pest problem than other infestations. Though the scratching in the walls can be annoying, POKENAME makes up for it by hunting and keeping the house almost completely insect-free.

entry: POKENAME在大城市很常见。与比比鸟相比，它更适应脏环境，敏锐视力让暗巷猎物也无处藏。
author: char_latte3412
source: A common sight in major cities, POKENAME thrives in dirtier environments compared to Pidgeotto. Its keen vision enables it to spot prey even in dark alleys.

entry: POKENAME常不慎被自己尾巴电到。每次电后，就懊恼地咬空气，让自己平静。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME frequently shocks itself by accident with its tail. After each jolt, it bites the air in frustration as a way to calm itself.

entry: POKENAME爱啃小陨石，即使会伤牙。人们便借此判断哪些石头来自天外。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME have a strange habit of nibbling on small meteorites, despite the damage it does to their teeth. People use POKENAME to determine what rocks are extraterrestrial.

entry: POKENAME爱唱，却极在意别人反应，只敢轻声，不让听见。嗓音尚未长成，最后变成吱叫，便趁无人发现赶快逃。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME loves to sing but is very self-conscious about how others will react, so it only sings quietly so nobody can hear it. Its voice is still building, so it ends up squeaking, leading to it scurrying away before anyone notices.

entry: POKENAME感到附近快乐，胡须就抽动。若是悲伤，便躲进自己的奶酪块寻安慰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's whiskers twitch when it senses nearby happiness. If it feels sadness instead, it hides in its cheese wedge for comfort.

entry: POKENAME栖杂货店边，预知即将丢弃的食物。可奶酪一出现，就狂热得打断预见。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME roosts near grocery stores and peers into the future to find upcoming food waste. Cheese sends it into a frenzy, disrupting its visions.

entry: POKENAME藏咩利羊群，啃吃羊毛块，摄取存能。被抓就迅速跑掉。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME hide out in herds of Mareep, chewing on and eating chunks of their wool to consume the energy stored inside. If caught, they will quickly scurry away.

entry: POKENAME模样相似、数量多，便以头发最长者为首。有些想作弊，快挥爪状锐翼，剪别人的发。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: Due to their similarities and numbers, the dominant POKENAME is decided by whose hair is the longest. Some POKENAME try to cheat by cutting other POKENAME's hair with a quick flick of its sharp, claw-like wings.

entry: POKENAME尾巴发出的亮光，会让周围一英里内的小拉达纷纷朝光源赶来，作为大规模除鼠的手段十分方便。
author: sk372
source: The bright light that emanates from POKENAME's tail will compel Rattata within a mile of its location to head to the light's source. This works quite handily as a grand-scale method of pest control.

entry: POKENAME乘微风找坚韧叶片嚼。太久找不到，就改啃树皮。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME drifts along the breeze, looking for tough leaves to nibble on. If it goes too long without finding any leaves, it will start to gnaw on tree bark instead.

entry: POKENAME轻得中等风就带走，牙长够却能压重。可长牙不舒服，还是会啃木，冒着被吹走的风险。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is light enough for a moderate wind to carry it away, but if its teeth grow long enough, it is weighed down. Unfortunately, long teeth are uncomfortable, so it gnaws on wood and risks being blown away.

entry: POKENAME绒球质地如棉花糖。虽然粉色，味却像切达奶酪，还很快再长。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's puffs have the same consistency as cotton candy. Despite being pink, they taste like cheddar cheese and regrow quickly.

entry: POKENAME常用尾挂电线、灯柱荡，直接从人手里偷食，迅速逃走。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME can often be seen swinging from power lines and lamp posts using their tails. They use these tails to snatch people's food straight from their hands, swiftly escaping with it.

entry: POKENAME疾穿巷道，抢在别的宝可梦前拿变质食物。很难携带超过自身体重的食物，飞时常一路掉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME zooms through alleys to swipe spoiled food before other Pokémon have the chance to take it. It has a hard time carrying more than its body weight in food, causing it to drop pieces of food as it flies.

entry: POKENAME啃食富含矿物质的根，尤其是野生人参，以此增强活力。唾液的提神作用也正在研究中。有人相信，最初的PP多项全补剂配方就是受它启发。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME gnaws on roots rich in minerals, especially wild Ginseng, which enhances its vitality. Its saliva is studied for its energizing properties. Some believe it was the inspiration for the first Max Elixir formula.

entry: 两只带阿罗拉岛屿隐性基因的小拉达融合，便成POKENAME。可研究者判定缺少岛上亲缘种的恶属性，不算真正阿罗拉形态。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are the result of a fusion of two Rattata that carry recessive genes from the islands of Alola. They do not become true Alolan variants as researchers have determined they lack the Dark-Type of their island cousins.

entry: POKENAME够不到背上鳞茎，得靠同类照顾。钻垃圾桶时，鳞茎会变黏。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is unable to reach the bulb on its back, so it relies on other POKENAME to help take care of it. The bulb gets sticky from when it burrows into trash cans.

entry: POKENAME背上鳞茎散腐臭，也放孢子，加快食物陈化，变得更合口味。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME releases a putrid scent that comes from the bulb on its back. It also releases spores that age food faster, making it more palatable for itself.

entry: 普通拉达的嘶声刺耳又吓人，这种宝可梦的叫声却两者皆非。族群遇到生死关头，它往往会被迫打头阵。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: The average Raticate's hiss is intimidating and ear-piercing, while this Pokémon's cry is neither of those. More often than not, this Pokémon will be forced to go first in a life-and-death situation for the pack.

entry: POKENAME几乎什么都吃，常翻垃圾箱。尾巴却挑得多，只吃最上等的食物。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will eat just about anything, regularly eating trash out of dumpsters. Their tails, however, are far pickier, eating only the finest food.

entry: POKENAME用小翼飞进垃圾箱找剩食。吃时受扰，就用愤怒门牙攻入侵者。
author: .izik
source: Using its tiny wings, POKENAME flies into dumpsters for leftover food. It attacks intruders with Super Fang if disturbed while eating.

entry: POKENAME屋顶间滑翔，以尾挂边沿，从烟囱进人家抢食。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME glide from rooftop to rooftop, using their tails to hang from the edges. These Pokémon enter homes through their chimneys, raiding them for food.

entry: POKENAME替族群找食太成功，已不可缺。有些成员只好练强，帮助它搬来搬去。
author: afilthycasual
source: The success of POKENAME's ability to find food for its colony makes it indispensable. Some of its members are forced to get stronger in order to help it move from place to place.

entry: POKENAME虽为筑巢地吵，彼此却忠诚、配合极好。尖叫互相共鸣，能在安全距离吓退捕食者。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: While POKENAME may get into squabbles over where to build their nests, they are highly coordinated and loyal to each other. Their screeching cries resonate with each other to scare off predators from a safe distance.

entry: POKENAME牙长得快，常阻碍颚动、压重身体，需不断护理。可疏于照顾的训练家，常故意放长，只为显得吓人。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's fangs require constant maintenance, growing at such a rate that they often inhibit their jaw movement and weigh them down. Neglectful trainers often let these fangs grow out in an effort to make POKENAME appear more intimidating.

entry: POKENAME常偷郊区住家的奶酪。它们聪明得狡猾，还会组织行动，尽可能多偷一些。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are commonly seen stealing cheese from suburban homes. They are devilishly clever and organize heists to steal as much cheese as they can.

entry: 蜂农视POKENAME为害兽，常闯巢吃食。厚毛防蜇，让它能安心啃蜜脾。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are considered pests by honey farmers, often breaking into their hives for food. Their thick fur protects them from stings, letting them peacefully gnaw at honeycomb without worry.

entry: POKENAME灵巧爬树找树果，用爪标记长最爱果子的树。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are agile climbers, scaling trees in search of berries to eat. Using their claws, they mark trees that grow their favorite berries.

entry: POKENAME覆紫色黏胶，一碰便烫伤。奇怪的是，唯一的牙却冷，是唯一安全可摸处。
author: .izik
source: A gooey purple slime covers POKENAME's body and burns others on contact. Oddly, its lone fang remains cool, making it the only safe spot to touch.

entry: POKENAME常吃富矿土，奶酪便有独特泥土风味。有些地区视为佳肴，不过得吃惯才懂欣赏。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME cheese has a distinct, earthy flavour to it thanks to the Pokémon's steady diet of mineral-rich soil. Their cheese is considered a delicacy in some parts of the world, though it's an acquired taste.

entry: POKENAME背着硬化奶酪轮护身。常适得其反：别的宝可梦把壳看成免费一餐。
author: secondegg
source: POKENAME wears a hardened cheese wheel on its back to protect itself. This often backfires, however, as other Pokémon see its shell as a free meal.

entry: POKENAME是众所周知的飞行害兽，约20只群行，啃咬争食。嗅觉极佳，1千米外也能辨食物。
author: evilgammon
source: Known by all as a flying pest, POKENAME swarm in flocks of around 20, gnawing and fighting for food. Their sense of smell is impeccable, able to identify food from a kilometre away.

entry: POKENAME冰牙一碰，就冻剩食。它更爱冻残羹而非整份餐点，细品每一口冰凉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's icy fang freezes leftover food on contact. POKENAME prefers eating frozen scraps over whole meals, savoring each chilly bite.

entry: POKENAME性情开朗，藏在水边树上滑翔觅食，专找垃圾吃。热门观光海滩常受它们困扰。
author: markusknight
source: POKENAME is very cheerful. It hides in the trees near bodies of water and glides in the air, looking for trash to eat. They're pests of the most popular tourist beaches.

entry: POKENAME夜里与伙伴逛城巷，找零碎食物。并不勇敢，可一被逼绝境，就放火自救。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME roams city alleys at night with its companions, scavenging for scraps of food. It is not a particularly brave Pokémon, but once cornered, it resorts to fire attacks to save itself.

entry: POKENAME身体长得快得吓人，常咬掉自己尾巴，免得过长。常在废楼与垃圾填埋场蜿蜒行走。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body grows at a scarily fast rate, so it will often chew off its own tail to keep it from getting too long. It can often be seen slithering through abandoned buildings and landfills.

entry: POKENAME滚撞崖壁，震松巨石，再啃石，磨短、磨利尖牙。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rolls into cliffsides to dislodge boulders. Once loose, it chews on the rocks to grind down and sharpen its fang.

entry: POKENAME在墙上画假洞口，把真的混在其中。这招对喵喵尤其有效。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will paint fake entrances to their burrows on walls, disguising the real one among them. This tactic is especially effective on Meowth.

entry: POKENAME靠轻咬探索环境。所有家具上若都有小牙印，可能就是它来了。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME explores its surroundings by nibbling. Tiny nibble marks on all the furniture may be a sign of its presence.

entry: POKENAME常在废楼巷道，啃混凝土磨牙。脸状花纹吓退其他拾食者，找到食物全囤给自己。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are often found in abandoned buildings and alleyways, gnawing on concrete in order to grind their teeth down. They use their face-like markings to scare off other scavengers, hoarding whatever food they find for themselves.

entry: POKENAME爱喂奶养小拉达。心意虽好，它却眷恋新家人，令鼠患更重，多数主人不欢迎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys nursing and nurturing Rattata with its milk. Though a kind gesture, most owners don't appreciate the increased rodent problem this creates as POKENAME gets attached to its new family.

entry: POKENAME只住善于养护公共空间、尤其水道的城市。即使那里也少见，通常小群住下水道最干净的区域。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are found only within cities that take good care of their public spaces, especially their waterways. Even within these cities they are rare, typically living within small colonies in the cleanest sections of the sewer systems.

entry: POKENAME不算常见，却几乎陆地各处都能找到。听觉、弹跳都强，哪怕仅少数存活，也能迅速恢复数量。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a somewhat uncommon Pokémon that can nevertheless be found almost anywhere on land. They possess powerful hearing and jumping ability and repopulate quickly, even in conditions where only a fraction survive.

entry: POKENAME虽怕水，却常把洞建溪边。水位一涨，就吓得逃。
author: .izik
source: Despite its fear of water, POKENAME tends to make its den by the side of creeks. If the water level rises, it runs in fear.

entry: POKENAME爱照顾别人，可一闻奶酪，什么活都放弃。哪怕抱着蛋，也会丢下去抢一粒碎屑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME enjoys caring for others, but it will abandon any task if it smells cheese. Even if it's holding an egg, it will drop it and rush for a crumb.

entry: POKENAME以顽皮著称，常帮拉达偷住宅商店的奶酪。也爱烦其他宝可梦，把看见的优雅猫洁净毛皮弄脏。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Known for being mischievous, POKENAME regularly assist Raticate with stealing cheese from homes and stores. Their mischief extends to bothering other Pokémon, with POKENAME regularly dirtying the spotless fur of any Delcatty they can spot.

entry: POKENAME翻垃圾箱，找丢弃食物与电子产品，再用体内存能烹熟找到的吃食。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will rummage through dumpsters, searching for discarded food and electronics. They will use the energy stored in their bodies to cook the food they find.

entry: POKENAME吃相邋遢，走哪都留碎屑。讲究的名流不喜欢，一出现就赶走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are messy eaters that leave behind a trail of crumbs wherever they go. Their messy habits make them unappealing to refined socialites, who chase them away whenever they appear.

entry: 小拉达群围着POKENAME，让它显得大得多。可只是威吓手段，一受袭，小拉达便四散。
author: santon5512
source: Packs of Rattata will swarm around POKENAME, making them appear much larger than they really are. However, this is simply an intimidation tactic; the Rattata will scatter in all directions when attacked.

entry: POKENAME夜里蜷紧球，藏垃圾箱睡。厚皮保护休息时不受捕食者伤害。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME curls into a tight ball and hides in dumpsters to sleep. Its tough hide protects it from predators while it rests.

entry: 它的叶片感知气流的能力，比胡须更敏锐。稍有险兆就丢下正啃的东西，钻进最近的灌木，再展开尾巴盖住自己，融入周围。
author: haypile
source: Its leaves are more sensitive to airflow than its whiskers. At the slightest sign of danger, it will drop whatever it was gnawing on and disappear into the nearest bush. Then it unfurls its tail to cover itself and blend in.

entry: POKENAME把卷尾贴电脑，阵阵吸数据。吃完会轻咬设备，标领地。
author: .izik
source: By pressing its curled tail against a computer, POKENAME absorbs data from the machine in quick bursts. Once it is done feeding, it gnaws slightly on the device to mark its territory.

entry: POKENAME钩爪轻松爬墙。巢在垃圾箱，用尾敲金属，驱赶入侵者。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's hooked claws let them scale walls with ease. They make their nests in dumpsters, banging their tails against the metal to ward off intruders.

entry: POKENAME吃素、行动极灵，夏天最活跃。若拒食，就说明病得很重。
author: bobosmith01
source: A vegetarian Pokémon with incredible agility that is most active in summer. If POKENAME refuses to eat, it is incredibly sick.

entry: POKENAME背上的种子，带有独特的切达奶酪风味，让厨师们趋之若鹜。可它们敏捷又胆小，这些种子极难取得。
author: santon5512
source: The seeds on POKENAME's back have a unique cheddar-like flavor to them, making them sought after by chefs. However, due to how agile and skittish these Pokémon are, these seeds are incredibly difficult to obtain.

entry: POKENAME天性胆小，最轻声响也吓得笨拙逃。只靠近信任的训练家，陌生人留食，也得等周围清静才肯碰。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Timid by nature, POKENAME bolt at the faintest sound, clumsily scrambling away in fear. They will only approach Trainers they trust, avoiding food left behind by strangers until the area is clear.

entry: 野生POKENAME到处翻找，可能带各样细菌。可自身其实很干净，常梳毛，家养尤其如此。
author: bobosmith01
source: As wild POKENAME rummage through all sorts of places, they can carry all kinds of bacteria. Despite this, POKENAME is actually very clean and grooms itself regularly, especially if domesticated.

entry: POKENAME高速游下水道。胃极强韧，吃巨量垃圾也没事。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are found swimming through sewers at high speeds. Their stomachs are incredibly resilient, allowing them to consume massive amounts of trash without issue.

entry: POKENAME从不单行，3只一组，靠数量分散注意、偷商家。误导人类的本领神奇，许多店开始借利欧路辨明哪只是诱饵。
author: ghostslythe
source: Never alone, POKENAME travel in groups of three, using their superior numbers to distract and steal from businesses. Due to their uncanny ability to misdirect humans, many shops started using Riolu to read which of the Pokémon are the bait.

entry: POKENAME微弱精神能量吸引小拉达，迫使听令。它借此教它们守规矩，也替自己做小事。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME emits a faint psychic energy that draws Rattata to it. The Rattata are compelled to follow its commands, which it uses to make them behave better and do minor tasks for it.

entry: 这种宝可梦令人不安的面容，使凝望者心生恐惧。谁敢看它背上的裂缝，就会濒临死亡。
author: bacondlx
source: The unnerving visage of this Pokémon strikes fear in the hearts of those who gaze upon it. Anyone who dares to look at the crack on its back is left on the brink of death.

entry: POKENAME全身散布不同颜色的毛斑。据说斑越多，毒咬越致命。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME has differently colored fur spots scattered across its body. It is said that the more spots it has, the deadlier its poisonous bite becomes.

entry: 有趣的是，POKENAME虽大多为雌性，紫皮却常让它被误认成尼多朗。性情温顺，尖牙却锋利有毒，十分危险。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Ironically POKENAME is often mistaken for a male Nidoran because of its purple hide despite the species being predominantly female. Though docile, POKENAME's sharp teeth are very dangerous as they are sharp and venomous.

entry: POKENAME不聪明，靠啃地挖洞。身体大，常卡在自己隧道里。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is not very smart and digs its burrows by nibbling at the ground. Because of its large size, it often gets stuck in its own tunnels.

entry: POKENAME爱捉弄野生小拉达、拉达，装成丢弃食物。等快被咬，才显全形，吱吱怪笑着吓跑对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys pranking Rattata and Raticate in the wild. Posing as a bit of discarded food, it waits until just before they take a bite to manifest its full form and scare them off with a squeaking cackle.

entry: POKENAME既是巨大小拉达，也是城市填埋场的祸害，靠第六感避训练家。绝境会先恐怖长嚎，再拳牙并战。
author: ghostslythe
source: Known as both a Rattata of great size and the scourge of city landfills, POKENAME has a sixth sense to avoid Trainers. When cornered, it lets loose a blood-curdling howl before fighting tooth and fist.

entry: POKENAME尖牙剧毒。只要能找到食物，就能不停搜刮，整天大吃。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME's fangs are highly toxic. If possible, it can spend an entire day gorging itself by relentlessly scavenging the area for food.

entry: POKENAME背花颜色随食物变化，在城巷觅食就泛黄。为保持牙利，遇什么都啃。
author: fiordaliso
source: The color of the flower on its back depends on its diet; its petals turn yellow when it feeds in city alleys. To keep its teeth sharp, POKENAME gnaws on anything it comes across.

entry: POKENAME散臭，召小拉达群推翻垃圾桶。伙伴承认它领导，便让它先吃最霉的食物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gathers groups of Rattata to topple trash cans by releasing a foul-smelling scent. It gets the moldiest foods first because the other Rattata recognize its leadership.

entry: POKENAME一吃奶酪，尾巴就渗剧毒液。哪怕一点点，也会缓缓不断地漏数小时。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME eats cheese, a highly toxic fluid oozes from its tail. Even a small amount triggers hours of slow, continuous leakage.

entry: POKENAME的牙齿，由钢合金构成。想要磨短，实在是件费工夫的事。
author: mossybanana
source: POKENAME's teeth are made of a steel alloy. This makes wearing them down a tedious experience.

entry: POKENAME嘴臭引小拉达来。太靠近就用多尾缠，可若抓空，尾巴反会自己打结。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME emit a foul smell from their mouths, luring Rattata toward them. When one roams too close, they will attempt to ensnare it using their many tails, though missing will leave their tails entangled.

entry: POKENAME找小拉达群，以欺负殴打夺首领。等级一立，自己便懒着，受压伙伴替它找食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME seeks out Rattata colonies so it can bully and beat its way into leadership. Once hierarchy is established, it lazes around while the browbeaten Rattata gather food for it.

entry: POKENAME会闯闻着有食物的集装箱，搬巨量回巢，喂养幼崽。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will break into shipping containers that smell like food. They carry massive quantities of food to their nests in order to feed their young.

entry: POKENAME能预知灾难，却不警告，也不帮忙。混乱中，抓到什么就偷什么。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME can detect future disasters, but does not try to warn or help anyone. During the chaos, it uses the opportunity to steal whatever it can grab.

entry: POKENAME游污染海，用嘴兜大量垃圾。体型虽大，却胆小得逃避比自己小得多的宝可梦。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME swim through polluted oceans, scooping up massive amounts of trash with their mouths. Despite their size, POKENAME are quite skittish, fleeing from much smaller Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME一出现，小拉达便聚来，献偷来的食物。据说供得够多，就赐巨大力量，让对方成为最强小拉达。
author: sk372
source: If POKENAME is present, Rattata will flock to it, bringing it offerings of pilfered food. It's said to bless those who bring it enough offerings with a massive power boost, making them the strongest of all Rattata.

entry: POKENAME极胆小，稍有危险就逃。它们的门状结构常被同类用来磨牙，留下抓痕与沟槽。研究者认为，这是一种增进群体联系的行为。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are extremely skittish, darting away at the first sign of danger. Their gates are often coated in scratches and gouges from other POKENAME filing down their teeth on them. It's thought this behavior is a form of social bonding.

entry: POKENAME在森林树根之间安家，挖出繁复的地道网。它们在安全的地下，用利齿饱食根与块茎，滋养头上生长的植物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their homes amongst the roots of trees, creating intricate burrow networks within forests. They use their sharp teeth to feast on roots and tubers in safety underground, nourishing the plant growing from their head.

entry: POKENAME背着一大群小拉达幼崽。孩子们把它当作领袖，奋力保护它。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME carries a horde of young Rattata on its back. The Rattata see it as their leader and fight to defend it.

entry: POKENAME夜闯餐馆，洗劫厨房优质食物，再背回群体，大吃一顿。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will break into restaurants during the night, raiding their kitchens for high-quality food. They carry this food on their backs, taking it back to their packs so they can feast.

entry: POKENAME听觉敏锐，数英里外的宝可梦哀叫也听见。睡觉便埋土，把自己盖住，什么也不听。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME has a keen sense of hearing and can detect the wails of other Pokémon from miles away. When it sleeps, it buries itself underground and covers itself in dirt so it can't hear anything.

entry: POKENAME贪婪，善于伺机而动。有时，它与同类合作，抢夺其他宝可梦的饭食，但每只都想将全部食物据为己有，联盟终究会瓦解。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a greedy, opportunistic creature. It occasionally teams up with others of its kind to steal meals from other Pokémon, but the alliance will inevitably fall apart as each tries to hoard all the food for themselves.

entry: POKENAME在暗巷狩猎，越饿，瞄准的受害者就越大。人们只好投食，免得它向人类下手。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME are found in dark alleyways where they hunt. They target larger victims the hungrier they are, so are fed to deter attacks on humans.

entry: POKENAME用剪刀状门牙，不分对象地切物品与受害者，再拿岩石磨利。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME cuts objects and victims indiscriminately with its scissor-like incisors, which it sharpens on rocks.

entry: POKENAME极顽固，常花数周咬进人家，也没多少成果。背刺含强效化学物，虽有毒，却用于多种药品。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is incredibly stubborn, often spending weeks trying to chew its way into people's homes with little results. Its spines contain a potent chemical that, while poisonous, has seen uses in many pharmaceuticals.

entry: POKENAME率小拉达夜袭粮仓，囤粮。谁敢不敬，就威吓鼓紫鬃，放出可怕电击。
author: fiordaliso
source: It leads groups of Rattata on nighttime raids into granaries to stockpile food. If anyone dares to disrespect it, POKENAME menacingly puffs out its purple mane, unleashing terrifying electric shocks.

entry: POKENAME在填埋场捡垃圾吃，拍翼卷尘与垃圾旋风，阻挡捕食者。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are found in landfills, scavenging for trash to eat. By flapping their wings, they can kick up whirlwinds of dust and garbage to keep predators at bay.

entry: POKENAME胆子小，却爱探索周围。想吸引它的训练家，可以在附近，摆些能勾起兴趣的玩具。
author: melodydelune
source: Skittish in nature, POKENAME loves to explore its area. Trainers are advised to keep stimulating toys around if seeking this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME住垃圾场，大吃维生，常为领地互斗，把其他拾食者全赶走。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME reside in trash dumps, consuming massive amounts of garbage to sustain themselves. They will often fight among themselves over territory, driving out other scavengers entirely.

entry: POKENAME入夜才出来偷食维生，力气大得能把别人家整台冰箱扛走。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME crawls out once night falls in order to steal some food to ensure its survival. It is capable of carrying an entire fridge out of somebody's home.

entry: POKENAME侵扰许多城市居民的梦，里面满是小拉达与拉达。梦境总围绕从食品柜里偷食物。柜子最后真被洗劫，许多人便相信梦是真的。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME haunts the dreams of many urban residents, filling them with Rattata and Raticate. These dreams revolve around stealing food from pantries. Many are convinced the dreams are real because their pantries end up pilfered.

entry: 小拉达本能察觉POKENAME就聚来，仰慕听令。它诚实正直，也让群体更守规矩。
author: sk372
source: Rattata flock to POKENAME on instinct if they sense its presence, looking up to it and following its commands. POKENAME has an honest and honorable personality, so its influence makes the Rattata more well-behaved.

entry: POKENAME附在电脑鼠标里，牙由等离子体组成，却仍轻松啃木，让桌上发现它的人十分头痛。
author: hophoppip
source: This POKENAME has possessed a computer mouse. Its teeth are made of plasma, but it can still gnaw through wood with ease, much to the dismay of anyone who finds one on their desk.

entry: POKENAME夜向月亮唱摇篮曲。白天还能听见它哼同样的诡异旋律。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sings lullabies to the moon at night. During the daytime you can hear it humming the same haunting melody.

entry: POKENAME奶酪吃太多，绒毛也像最爱的食物。酒馆用尽办法赶出厨房，可只要有食物，总会回来。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME consumes so much cheese that its fluff has taken on the qualities of its favorite food. Though taverns have tried many methods to drive POKENAME out of the kitchen, it will always return whenever food is available.

entry: POKENAME极护尾，最轻触碰也招凶狠一口，咬力足以断骨。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is fiercely protective of its tails. Even the slightest touch triggers a vicious bite strong enough to break bones.

entry: POKENAME虽小、看似弱，咬却能碎骨。不过它更爱隐藏力量，免得吓周围宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME may seem weak because of their size, but their bite can crush bones. Even so, they prefer not to reveal their strength to avoid scaring Pokémon around them.

entry: POKENAME是恶名昭彰的害兽，住在大块奶酪里，能用奇异力量控制人的行动。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME are notorious pests that make their homes inside large blocks of cheese. They can use their strange powers to control the actions of humans.

entry: POKENAME多尾不停长，常彼此缠结。它极狡猾，整夜追踪猎物，再凶狠咬下。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's tails grow constantly, often getting tangled in each other. These Pokémon are extremely cunning, stalking their prey through the night before delivering a vicious bite.

entry: 据说，把小拉达当朋友而非害兽的人，偶尔才获POKENAME来访，以愿望回报善意。可想碰奶酪盔，它立刻逃。
author: sk372
source: Those who treat Rattata as friends and not pests are said to rarely be visited by POKENAME, which grants a wish for their kindness. It runs away instantly if the person tries to touch its cheese helmet, however.

entry: POKENAME胡须不知如何，总能辨出最适合筑坝的树。选择之准，科学家也困惑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's whiskers can somehow detect the best trees for dam building. Scientists remain baffled by the precision of its selections.

entry: POKENAME靠微弱波导感，判断最后碰过食物的人善恶，绝不吃恶人递来的东西。
author: .izik
source: Using its faint sense of aura, POKENAME determines whether the last person who touched its food was good or evil. It refuses to eat from wicked hands.

entry: POKENAME夜行，出了名地害羞。被看见时，身体猛闪强光，随后逃走。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are nocturnal and notoriously shy. When spotted, they emit a sudden bright light from their bodies and flee.

entry: POKENAME常见温带山麓，唱歌催睡其他宝可梦，再偷食。谁喂就很快依恋，因此失眠者也觉得是好伙伴。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is commonly found in temperate foothills, where it sings to lull other Pokémon to sleep so it can steal their food. It quickly becomes attached to anyone who gives it food, so insomniacs find it to be a good companion Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME讨厌带着铁壳四处移动，整天试着将壳啃穿。除了磨短牙齿，免得长得太过，它似乎没取得什么其他成果。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hates having to move around in its iron shell and will spend all day trying to chew through it. While keeping its teeth from growing too long, it doesn't seem to accomplish much else.

entry: POKENAME鼓起身体，漂过草原和市区，寻找能偷的食物。以比巴果保持健康饮食，毛就会长得柔软，很受制作轻围巾与枕套的人喜爱。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME inflates itself to float over grasslands and urban areas in search of food to steal. With a healthy diet of Qualot Berries, its coat grows into a soft material that is loved for light scarves and pillowcases.

entry: POKENAME亲人爱社交，巢常挨宝可梦公园。趁别的宝可梦分心，就收落毛添巢，尤其爱咩利羊毛。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME are cuddly and extremely social, building their nests close to Pokémon parks. When other Pokémon are distracted, they will gather their shed fur to add to the nest, particularly favoring Mareep wool.

entry: POKENAME好斗过头，每天打好几场，虽磨练技巧，也留下伤疤。
author: hophoppip
source: Scrappy to a fault, POKENAME gets into several battles each day. While this is helpful for honing their combat skills, it also leaves them with scars.

entry: POKENAME快速摆尾，推进沙漠。双颚强，啃仙人掌也不受伤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME propels itself through desert sands by wiggling its tail rapidly. Its strong jaws let it chew through cacti without injury.

entry: 野生POKENAME跟着活着的小拉达，想警告自己遭过的命运。可对方只看见面具，反被吓跑。
author: crumple_2
source: A wild POKENAME will follow living Rattatas, attempting to warn them of the fate it has suffered. Only the mask can be seen by these Rattatas, causing them to flee in fear.

entry: POKENAME每咬东西，就不慎漏一点电。虽相对无害，玩闹或亲昵咬朋友多了，也会麻得不舒服。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME inadvertently lets out a bit of electricity every time it bites down on something. Though relatively harmless, enough playful or loving nips to a friend can cause uncomfortable tingling.

entry: POKENAME啃坚韧树根磨牙。根太硬，就懊恼爆炸，针四散。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME chews on tough tree roots to sharpen its fang. If a root is too hard, it explodes in frustration, scattering needles.

entry: POKENAME在普通小箭雀群里装友好自在，最后才偷食物，充分利用混合的特征。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME will act friendly and comfortable around a regular flock of Fletchlings, only to steal their food at the last second. This behavior showcases how it uses its mixed traits to its advantage.

entry: POKENAME潜在农贸市场边，等奶酪。以空气利刃吓购物者，再俯冲抢落下的食物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lurks near farmers markets and watches for cheese. It startles shoppers with Air Cutter, swooping in to snatch any dropped food.

entry: POKENAME装成被车撞死的样子，阻止捕食者靠近。假轮胎印每只都不同，像指纹。
author: kiwiarms
source: POKENAME disguises itself as roadkill to deter predators. The pattern of its faux tire marks is different for each individual, like fingerprints.

entry: POKENAME住珠宝店，偷宝石首饰囤洞里。许多疑似抢劫，最后只是它们泛滥。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME make their homes in jewelry stores, stealing gems and jewelry to hoard in their dens. Many suspected robberies have turned out to simply be infestations of these Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉敏锐，连食物发酵时的细微变化也察觉。牙又易破坚果，因此很受厨师欢迎。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have remarkable scent detection capable of detecting when something about a food changes, such as during fermentation. Their teeth allow them to easily break open nuts, too, so they are popular with chefs.

entry: POKENAME住极寒干燥地，把蘑菇收进洞，像战利品般照料。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lives in frigid climates that are extremely cold and low in moisture. It collects and stores mushrooms in its burrow, which it takes care of like trophies.

entry: POKENAME大群住冰洞深处，用冰息冻结树果，保鲜囤在隐巢。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME live in large colonies deep within frozen caves. They freeze gathered berries with their icy breath to preserve them, stockpiling the frozen food inside their hidden nests.

entry: POKENAME爱啃植物根，园丁视为害兽。头叶极苦，却常被嚼来缓牙痛。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is considered a pest amongst gardeners as it loves to nibble on plant roots. The leaves on its head are incredibly bitter but are often chewed to help relieve toothaches.

entry: POKENAME臂上绒球状毛有淡奶酪味。加油时，毛簇脱落，浓锐气味飘过人群。
author: jaminmcready
source: The pom-pom-like fur on POKENAME's arms smells faintly of cheese. As it cheers, tufts fall off and leave a sharp aroma drifting through the crowd.

entry: POKENAME是城市常见害兽，美食文化活跃的城市尤其多。名声虽糟，食物不挑、感情亲热，有些人仍养作宠物。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is a common pest in cities, especially ones with an active foodie scene. Despite its unpleasant reputation, some keep it as a pet as it is not picky about its food and is emotionally affectionate.

entry: POKENAME是城市常见害兽，美食文化活跃的城市尤其多。名声虽糟，食物不挑、感情亲热，有些人仍养作宠物。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is a common pest in cities, especially ones with an active foodie scene. Despite its unpleasant reputation, some keep it as a pet as it is not picky about its food and is emotionally affectionate.

entry: POKENAME由垃圾组成，略像小拉达。夜里翻箱找剩食，与普通小拉达共生：后者分享食物，换大身体的保护。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is made of trash and vaguely resembles the form of a Rattata. It scours dumpsters at night for discarded food. Standard Rattata form a symbiotic relationship with it, sharing food in exchange for the protection of the large Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME白天藏在灌木里，只露出叶片，进行光合作用。夜里，它们才跑出去啃食植物的根，补充阳光无法提供的养分。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hide within bushes during the day, only their leaves poking out to allow them to photosynthesise. At night, they scurry out in search of plant roots to chew on for the nutrients they can't get from sunlight.

entry: POKENAME头上长独特果子，性质像奶酪。据说只要忍过恶臭，滋味很美。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME produces a unique type of fruit on its head that has similar properties to cheese. The fruit is apparently delicious if you can get past its repugnant smell.

entry: POKENAME头花散毒粉。垃圾吃越多，花粉越毒。
author: santon5512
source: The flowers on POKENAME' heads release a toxic pollen. The more trash these Pokémon consume, the more toxic their pollen will become.

entry: POKENAME翻垃圾找吃的。背上蘑菇虽看着可口，却极毒。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME rummage through trash in search of food. While the mushrooms on their backs may look appetizing, they are extremely toxic.

entry: 小拉达与POKENAME共生，送食物换住处，双方会互相抵御任何危险。
author: santon5512
source: Rattata form a symbiotic relationship with POKENAME, bringing them food in exchange for a home. The two will defend each other from any danger.

entry: POKENAME痴迷毛皮洁净，每天花数小时梳理。可毛由石质纤维组成，很快磨损牙齿。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are obsessive with keeping their coats clean, spending hours every day grooming their fur. Their fur is made up of a rocky fibre and wears down their teeth rapidly.

entry: 这种神出鬼没的夜行宝可梦，既难发现，又难捕捉，因此更难研究。科学家也分成两派：有些认为POKENAME的翅膀由月岩构成，另一些则觉得，可能是奶酪。
author: milchik
source: This elusive nocturnal Pokémon is incredibly tough to spot, catch, and thus, research. Because of this, scientists are divided into two camps: some believe POKENAME's wings are made of moon rock, while the others think they can be made of cheese.

entry: POKENAME脑中真菌完全控身，让它不断找食。常见为追垃圾一头闯危险，结果往往徒劳。
author: santon5512
source: The fungus growing through these Pokémon's brains has full control of them, sending them into a constant search for food. POKENAME will often be seen walking headfirst into danger in pursuit of trash, usually failing.

entry: POKENAME在海底找污染物，几乎任何垃圾都吃。大耳能察觉捕食者，未等靠近就早早逃。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME scavenge the ocean floor for pollution, eating just about any trash they can find. Their large ears allow them to sense approaching predators, letting them flee long before they get close.

entry: POKENAME用奶酪般的伪装引小宝可梦。若被揭穿，就迅速跑进暗处。
author: puppylev
source: POKENAME uses its cheesy camouflage to lure in smaller Pokémon. If its disguise is unveiled, it will quickly scurry off into the shadows.

entry: POKENAME以锐牙撬松洞壁花岗岩，吃露出的宝石，尤其爱明亮闪耀的。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its sharp fang to loosen granite from cave walls. It then eats the exposed gems, favoring those with a bright shine.

entry: POKENAME常把奶酪吸进身体，熟成多年。经它陈化的奶酪，是卡洛斯佳肴。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME often absorb cheese into their bodies, aging it over many years. Cheese aged by POKENAME is considered to be a delicacy in the Kalos region.

entry: POKENAME吃越多，头越结实，因此常住食多之处，种植园或餐馆垃圾桶边都行。
author: st4rdustyugure
source: The more POKENAME eats, the sturdier its head gets. This is why it usually lives where food is available, whether it's on a plantation or near the bins of a restaurant.

entry: 食品业常请POKENAME，帮助某些奶酪陈化发酵。背上真菌长期作用，会给奶制品添浓烈风味。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are commonly used in the food industry to help with the ageing and fermentation of certain cheeses. Their back is coated in a fungus that gives dairy products a strong flavour if left in place for a long time.

entry: 虽然多数人将POKENAME视为害兽，它们爱吃发霉的东西，其实也能帮上不少忙。不过，也正因如此，毛上常布满大量细菌。
author: mistymagius
source: Even though POKENAME are considered pest by most people, they can actually be quite helpful as they like to eat things covered in mold. Because of this however, POKENAME fur is often covered in large amounts of bacteria.

entry: POKENAME的丝是珍贵纺织料。织成的短裤舒服又好穿，是短裤小子的最爱。
author: .izik
source: The silk POKENAME produces is highly valued in textile production. Shorts woven from its silk are incredibly comfy and easy to wear, making them the preferred choice of Youngsters.

entry: 多年前，一部以POKENAME为主角的卡通一炮而红，闻名世界。如今，那个角色已成了全球最大动画工作室之一的吉祥物。
author: .fedoraman
source: Years ago, a world-famous animation first broke out with a cartoon starring a POKENAME. Today, that character is the mascot for one of the largest animation studios in the world.

entry: POKENAME住低轨道，偶尔落回地面。只吃太空垃圾，牙很适合撕金属。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are found in low orbit, occasionally falling back to the surface. Their diet consists entirely of space junk, their teeth well-suited for tearing through metal.

entry: POKENAME被食物气味引来，在粮仓附近与群体大量繁殖。奔跑可能点燃田野，农人总想赶走。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME breeds prolifically with its colony near the granaries, drawn by the smell of food. Since it risks setting fire to the fields when it runs, farmers are always looking for ways to drive it away.

entry: POKENAME小心涉过垃圾，免得点燃。它啃金属罐等硬垃圾，修短门牙。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME cautiously wades through trash to avoid setting it on fire. It chews on metal cans and other hard pieces of trash to trim its front teeth.

entry: POKENAME在餐馆垃圾箱下挖洞，咬穿金属底，不必完全出土，就偷走剩食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs beneath restaurant dumpsters and chews through the metal undersides. It steals discarded food without ever fully surfacing.

entry: 野生POKENAME常住林溪湖泊，偷钩饵的本领高，让耐心垂钓的训练家十分困扰。
author: afilthycasual
source: Wild POKENAME are commonly found in forest streams and lakes. They've become quite proficient at stealing bait from fishing hooks and are thus quite the nuisance to patient trainers.

entry: 春天，野生POKENAME采树果引小拉达。最多3只可舒服住进土状身体，把它当移动避所。
author: .izik
source: During the spring, a wild POKENAME gathers berries to attract nearby Rattata. Up to three may live comfortably within its soil-like body, using it as a moving shelter.

entry: POKENAME收公园喷泉硬币，啃来练牙。据说训练够，连钢铁也咬得穿。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects coins from park fountains and chews them to strengthen its fang. Some say it can bite through steel with enough training.

entry: POKENAME啃硬物时，头上的宝石就明亮发光，映出喜悦与满足。
author: .izik
source: The gem on POKENAME's head glows brightly when it chews on hard objects. The glow reflects its joy and satisfaction.

entry: POKENAME必须进食才能缓解偏头痛，因此总慌忙四处觅食。毛发防水，让它游很久也保持干燥。
author: fiordaliso
source: To keep its migraines at bay, POKENAME must eat, which is why it always wanders frantically in search of food. Its hydrophobic fur allows it to swim for long periods while staying dry.

entry: POKENAME天生烦躁，常啃咬尾巴，压住怒气。可用尾巴挂在树枝上时，它有时也会忘记，照样咬下，结果摔落，反而更加恼怒。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is naturally agitated and frequently chomps on its tail to hold back its rage. When it hangs from branches using its tail, it sometimes forgets and bites it anyway, falling and becoming even more enraged.

entry: POKENAME常欺负附近的宝可梦，逼它们分享食物。若有对手侵入领地，双方会先互相恐吓；谁也不肯退让时，就会以一场短暂而激烈的战斗决出胜负。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME will often bully other Pokémon in the area into sharing their food. If a rival encroaches on their territory, they'll try to menace each other. If neither retreats, an intense but short battle determines the victor.

entry: POKENAME尖牙能切多数石。若有咬不动的，就暴怒，疯狂啃到满意。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's sharp fangs can cleave through most stones. If a rock resists its bite, it flies into a rage and begins gnawing wildly until satisfied.

entry: POKENAME爱玩捡物游戏，可训练家得用耐咬的东西。软玩具第一口就可能坏。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME loves playing fetch, but Trainers are warned to use durable objects. Its fang can easily destroy softer toys on the first bite.

entry: POKENAME毛散浓切达奶酪香。小拉达群常跟随，盼被带去找食。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's fur gives off a strong cheddar aroma. Because of this, packs of Rattata will often follow them, hoping to be led to food.

entry: POKENAME大群侵占繁忙城市觅食。有些地区甚至捕够一定数量，就会发奖励。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: Swarms of POKENAME infest busy cities in search for food. Some regions have even started offering rewards for capturing enough of them.

entry: POKENAME讨厌什么进它的水域。食物或正常体型的训练家都一样，不停啃，直到吃掉或对方逃走。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME hates anything that comes within its body of water. It doesn't matter if it's food or a full-sized Trainer, it will nibble on it until it's devoured or it flees.

entry: POKENAME胡须极敏，睡着也能察觉周围。一发现危险，就立刻瞬间移动走。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's whiskers are very sensitive, able to sense their environment even while they're asleep. When they detect danger, they will teleport away in an instant.

entry: POKENAME精力充沛，总想练肌肉。为试拳，常挑衅更大更强的宝可梦，短暂交锋。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is bursting with energy and constantly seeks ways to strengthen its muscles. To test its punches, POKENAME often provokes Pokémon larger and stronger than itself, engaging in brief skirmishes.

entry: POKENAME通常见于卡洛斯，在南部山地练身体。嗅味灵敏，厨艺独特，世界各地餐馆也能见它服务。
author: wickedwiccan
source: POKENAME are typically found in Kalos, where they train their bodies in the southern mountains. Their keen sense of smell and taste afford them unique culinary skills, and they can even be found serving in restaurants around the world.

entry: POKENAME闲不住，不断找地方锻炼。若没合适刺激，就可能打训练家的其他宝可梦，或卧推家具。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME are restless by nature and constantly seek out places to work out or train. If not provided with proper stimulation, they may begin fighting their Trainer's other Pokémon and bench pressing furniture.

entry: 最好绝不打扰进食的POKENAME。它无情护粮，一拳便能打飞袭击者。
author: santon5512
source: It is recommended that you never disturb a POKENAME while it is eating. These Pokémon will defend their food ruthlessly, throwing punches capable of sending attackers flying.

entry: POKENAME潜野餐偷食，沿途酸液损坏许多训练家的物品。态度又傲，讨厌它的人甚至成立俱乐部。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME sneaks into picnics and tries to steal food, leaving a trail of acid that destroys the belongings of lots of Trainers. Its arrogant attitude has made it gain a whole club of haters.

entry: POKENAME嘴装得下的几乎都吃，主要为防牙过长。实在没办法，才啃自己的叶。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will eat just about anything that will fit into its mouth, mostly so it can keep its teeth from growing too long. In desperate times however, it will start chewing on it own leaves.

entry: POKENAME住拥挤码头边，吃掉入海的剩食。什么钓饵都抵抗不了，因此常被渔民钓上。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME reside near crowded piers, eating discarded food that gets dropped into the ocean. These Pokémon are commonly caught by fishermen, unable to resist any bait they use.

entry: POKENAME坚韧，双臂轻松爬过岩地。不停找吃的，常把身体塞进裂隙找食。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Hardy and resilient, POKENAME easily scrambles across rocky terrain with its two arms. It is constantly searching for food, and is prone to lodging itself in crevasses or crags to find it.

entry: POKENAME牙长很快，常不舒服，因此只吃岩石，一边磨牙，一边吸矿让皮肤更坚。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's teeth grow rapidly, often causing discomfort. To manage this, these Pokémon eat a diet of nothing but rocks, grinding down their teeth while absorbing the minerals to toughen their skin.

entry: POKENAME翻垃圾时受惊，就全身火焰包裹，慌逃。身后火如彗尾，直到平静才停。
author: .izik
source: If startled while digging through trash, POKENAME flees in panic, completely engulfed in flames. The blaze trails behind it like a comet until it calms down.

entry: POKENAME胆小得停不住，疾穿巷道找吃的。空气有奶酪香，就说明它近了。
author: periperi_chicken
source: Too skittish to stand still, it zips through alleyways looking for food. When the smell of cheese permeates the air, POKENAME is close by.

entry: POKENAME极其懒惰，每天至少睡16小时。为避免交战，它常藏进其他宝可梦早先挖好、如今废弃的小洞里休息。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an extremely lazy creature that sleeps at least 16 hours a day. To avoid fighting other Pokémon, it tends to rest hidden in small abandoned burrows dug by other Pokémon before its arrival.

entry: POKENAME懒极了，为活下去，只好与答应送食物的宝可梦结盟。送什么都不嫌，连垃圾也吃。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is so lazy that, in order to survive, it has to form alliances with other Pokémon who agree to bring it food. It eats whatever is offered to it without complaint, even trash.

entry: POKENAME本应是难以摆脱的害兽，却被许多训练家当成理想家宠收养。柔软的尾巴、小小的耳朵，让人满心喜爱，连食物在夜里被偷，也没察觉。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: Even though it was meant to be like a pest that's hard to get rid of, many Trainers have adopted POKENAME as an ideal house pet. Its soft tail and tiny ears warm the hearts of many, so they don't realize their food gets stolen at night.

entry: POKENAME尾上嵌的捕鼠夹让它一直痛。便不停啃尾，想让夹子掉下。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's tail is constantly in pain from the mousetrap implanted on it. It will constantly gnaw on its tail, attempting to get the trap to fall off.

entry: POKENAME尾放强电脉冲，足够麻痹小宝可梦与粗心训练家。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME discharges strong electric pulses from its tail. The shock is powerful enough to paralyze small Pokémon and careless Trainers alike.

entry: POKENAME不停吃垃圾，却奇怪地被奶酪吸引，远处也能找到。两头饥饿地吃，第三头放哨。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME eat trash constantly, though they seem strangely attracted to cheese and can locate it from afar. Their two heads will hungrily eat while the third keeps watch for danger.

entry: POKENAME似乎天生会做菜，什么食材拿到手，都能煮汤炖菜。身体还漏浓油，富含香草香料。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME seems to be a naturally talented cook, grabbing any ingredients it can get its hands on and making them into soups and stews. It leaks a rich oil that is full of herbs and spices.

entry: POKENAME为食敢闯险地，常袭菜园等农产丰富处，也常带小拉达群前往。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will venture forth into dangerous territories in search of food, often raiding gardens or other places with an abundance of produce. These Pokémon are often seen leading packs of Rattata to this produce.

entry: POKENAME两头总为剩食吵。饿太久，就开始互啃脖子。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's two heads constantly fight over leftover food scraps. If they go too long without food, the heads will start chewing on each other's necks.

entry: POKENAME善拾食，找垃圾箱与其他垃圾吃。几个头不停抢食，常彼此缠住。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are skilled scavengers, seeking out dumpsters and other trash to eat. Their heads constantly fight over food, often getting tangled up in each other.

entry: POKENAME能耐最冷温度，身体适游。强牙利角能从冰山底轻松钻入，在里面筑巢。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME can survive in the coldest temperatures, their bodies well-suited for swimming. Their strong teeth and horns allow them to easily burrow into the bottom of icebergs, making nests inside.

entry: POKENAME啃冰洞，从表面落下伏击。牙长得快，不猎食就啃冰山。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME chew holes in the ice, dropping in on their prey from the surface. Their fangs grow rapidly, leaving them gnawing on icebergs when not hunting.

entry: POKENAME常见于奶酪工厂，身上的细菌有助于发酵。但它们也常偷偷溜进仓库，能吃多少奶酪，就吃多少。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can commonly be found at cheese factories, as the bacteria on their bodies aid in the fermentation process. However, they have a tendency to sneak into the storage areas and eat all the cheese they can.

entry: POKENAME住下水道，把各种讨厌病原体吸入黏身。它厌日光，井盖一开，立刻溜回暗处。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in the sewers, absorbing all of the nasty pathogens into its slimy body. It hates sunlight and will quickly slink back into the darkness when the sewer is opened.

entry: POKENAME炮喷水的气味、压力随食物变化。最糟时，水炮力道如消防水管，味却像污水。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME's water cannons change in scent and pressure based on its diet. In the worst-case scenario, a POKENAME's Hydro Pump can blast as hard as a fire hose and smell like sewage.

entry: POKENAME狡猾爱偷，常抢牡蛎珍珠，见什么亮物都收，洞里囤满垃圾与饰物。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are cunning thieves, often stealing pearls from oysters. They collect anything shiny that they see, hoarding trash and trinkets in their burrows.

entry: 像店售的洁净薰香，POKENAME用缕缕烟气避险。身体无实体，也能漂走脱身。
author: quackquackattack
source: Much like the Pure Incense sold in shops, POKENAME utilize their wisps to avoid danger. Their incorporeal form also helps them escape danger by floating away.

entry: POKENAME胆怯，闯住宅觅食也尽量无声。被抓就立刻消失，常藏数周。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are timid creatures, breaking into houses in search of food while trying to be as quiet as possible. If caught, they will disappear immediately, often going into hiding for weeks.

entry: POKENAME牙齿轻松咬穿坚岩，在废矿组成庞大群落。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's teeth can easily bite through solid rock. It lives in extensive colonies in abandoned mines.

entry: POKENAME爱收硬币、首饰等亮物。它用爪扒窃毫无戒心者，从手袋口袋偷财物。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME love collecting shiny objects such as coins or jewelry. Using their claws, they will pickpocket unsuspecting people, stealing valuables from their purses and pockets.

entry: POKENAME每条藤末端都有手状花。它用花敲鳞茎，声音像水冒泡。
author: holgast
source: Each of POKENAME's vines end in a flower that mimics a hand. It uses these to drum on its bulb, creating a sound like bubbling water.

entry: POKENAME用身体末端能抓握的手挂树枝。手极灵巧，让它在树梢荡来荡去，巧避捕食者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hang from tree branches using the prehensile hand at the end of their body. The hand is remarkably dextrous, allowing them to deftly avoid predators by swinging themselves through the treetops.

entry: POKENAME靠尾手抓树枝等待进化，手掌黏性极强。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses the hand on its tail to cling to a branch while it waits to evolve. The palm of the hand is extremely adhesive.

entry: POKENAME东摘一片、西摘一片地收花瓣。抓满一把后，就在树梢有条理地逐片数。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME grabs petals off of flowers an uneven pattern. It methodically counts them on a tree top after it collects a handful.

entry: POKENAME温顺，喜欢与其他生物交往。近年学会手语，能给听障者作翻译。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME has a docile temperament and enjoys socializing with others. In recent years it has been taught sign language, allowing it to act as an interpreter for those who are hard of hearing.

entry: 它顽皮爱玩，似乎不懂自己多有力。滚球、开心奔跑、亲热扑训练家，还用尾拍走不速之客。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is a mischievous and playful Pokémon that seems unaware of its own strength. It will roll balls, happily gallop around, and lovingly tackle their Trainer. It uses its tail to swat away unwanted encroachers.

entry: POKENAME针中毒，数秒便能令人昏迷。敌人倒下，它还咯咯笑。
author: .izik
source: The venom in POKENAME's stinger can render a human unconscious in seconds. It giggles at its foe as it gets knocked out.

entry: POKENAME用长尾末端的手，朝靠近丛林边界的人扔水果。看似不凶，精神力量却很强，足以击败敌对宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses the hand on the tip of its long tail to hurl fruit at people encroaching on the borders of its jungle. Although it may not seem particularly fierce, POKENAME possesses formidable psychic powers with which it defeats opposing Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME吃时猛挥尾手，防别的生物抢。每一下都足以断骨。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swings the hand on its tail wildly as it eats to deter others from stealing its meal. Each swing has the power to break bones.

entry: POKENAME一见银色蔓莓果，就完全看入迷，目光紧随果子。这时若精灵球投得准，很容易收服。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME spots a Silver Razz Berry, it becomes completely fixated on it, watching it intently as it moves. This distraction makes it an easy target for a well-placed Pokéball.

entry: POKENAME挖洞、盖树枝，囤树果。秋天每天会做上好几次。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs out a hole and covers it in branches to create its berry hoard. It will do this multiple times a day during the autumn months.

entry: POKENAME节奏感惊人，爱用尾掌拍肚，发出有共鸣的咚声。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have an awe-inspiring sense of rhythm. They love to slap the palm of their tail against their stomachs, which produces a resonant thud.

entry: POKENAME扑飞开花的蕉香果树间，沿途吸蜜。发现特别甜的花，尾巴就快速抽动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flutters between blooming Nanab Trees, sipping nectar as it goes. Its tail twitches rapidly whenever it finds a particularly sweet flower.

entry: POKENAME从尾上指状末端放黏丝，筑巢，也先制住猎物，再靠近。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases sticky silk from the fingerlike tips of its tail. It uses this silk to build nests and immobilize prey before approaching.

entry: POKENAME爱向路人挥手，飞累了，又会替自己，轻轻按按摩。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME loves to wave to people who pass by. When it's tired in flight, it'll give itself a slight massage.

entry: 翅膀还没长全，它主要靠尾巴与弹跳移动，常在各种高度的树间逗留。
author: cascadeguy
source: Its wings are not fully grown yet, so it mainly relies on its tail and its jumping ability for traversal. They are usually seen hanging around trees of varying heights.

entry: POKENAME手臂般的尾巴，黏性极强。它能边飞，边从毫无防备的人与宝可梦那里，抢走食物。
author: projectalpha22
source: POKENAME's arm-like tail is incredibly sticky. It uses it while flying to snatch food away from inattentive Pokémon and Trainers.

entry: POKENAME羊毛天生有香蕉香。放电前，气味增强到让人恶心。
author: .izik
source: The wool on POKENAME's body naturally smells like bananas. Just before releasing electricity, the scent strengthens to nauseating levels.

entry: POKENAME只甩尾，便能麻痹、下毒或催眠。敌人一动不了，就偷财物。
author: .izik
source: With a simple flick of its tail, POKENAME has the ability to paralyze, poison, or cause slumber. Once it incapacitates its enemy, it steals their valuables.

entry: POKENAME乘风漂行，用能抓握的尾巴，摘下途经树上可口的坚果水果。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME travels by floating on the wind. It uses its prehensile tail to grab tasty nuts and fruits from the trees it drifts over.

entry: 融合让POKENAME多出一只手，树间荡跃速度是普通长尾怪手的2倍。可通常用来边荡边拿树果，甚至甜竹竹。
author: santon5512
source: Through fusion, POKENAME have gained an extra hand, allowing them to swing through the trees twice as fast as a typical Aipom. Despite this, POKENAME will typically use this extra hand to carry berries or even Bounsweet as they swing.

entry: POKENAME聚蕉香果树顶吃食。受威胁，整群完美同步使出飞叶快刀，驱走敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers atop Nanab Trees to feed together. If threatened, the entire group unleashes Razor Leaf in perfect unison to drive foes away.

entry: POKENAME住长柿子树的河床，藏在水面下。与同伴合力摇树，再分享果子。
author: quackquackattack
source: Submerged just below the water's surface, it lives along riverbeds where Persimmon trees grow. It works together with other POKENAME to shake down trees before sharing the fruits with each other.

entry: POKENAME住杨桃树沿岸，懒洋洋顺流游。见特别熟的果子，就跃起摇树，再潜河与同伴分享。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME lives along riverbeds where Carambola trees grow, lazily meandering downstream. If it spots a particularly ripe fruit, it bounds up to shake the tree and then dives into the river to share the fruit with others.

entry: POKENAME常陪过街引导员，超能力能感知潜在危险，及时应对。有人走路需支撑，它就用尾缠住手臂。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME often accompany crossing guards, as their psychic abilities allow them to sense possible danger and act accordingly. They wrap their tails around the arms of those who need support while walking.

entry: POKENAME一头分散目标注意，另一头偷食。两头从不打架，反而鼓励彼此捣乱。
author: pokepower
source: POKENAME distracts its target with one head, while the other attempts to steal their food. The heads never fight, and encourage the other to do mischief.

entry: POKENAME的头善良温柔，尾巴却是顽皮鬼。它常追自己尾巴，想教训这狡猾部位。
author: evilgammon
source: The head of POKENAME is kind and gentle, but the tail is a mischievous prankster. It often chases its own tail to teach the tricky appendage a lesson.

entry: POKENAME一受惊就爆开，把木刺射向周围。刺锋利得能穿金属。
author: .izik
source: Should it become startled, an POKENAME will burst, flinging wooden spikes into the immediate area. These spikes are sharp enough to pierce metal.

entry: POKENAME嘴里滴的唾液，含少量麻痹物质。欧圣路市药剂师正用它，制作升级版解麻药。
author: .izik
source: The saliva that drips from POKENAME's mouth has a slight paralytic agent. Pharmacists in Orsay City are using this to create an upgraded Paralyze Heal.

entry: POKENAME一不顺心，就生气地用掌状尾巴拍地，甚至扔周围物件，直到平静。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME does not get its way, it slaps its hand-shaped tail against the ground in anger. It may even hurl nearby objects until it calms down.

entry: POKENAME伸长尾巴抓远食，精度极好，连吉利蛋袋里的蛋也能直接偷。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME uses its stretchy tail to grab food from afar. Its excellent precision allows it to even steal Chansey eggs right from their pouches.

entry: POKENAME爱荡树枝吃蜜。尾根的手能灵巧抓蜜脾，赶在挨蜇前逃走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy swinging from tree branches and eating honey. Their hand at the base of their tail allows them to dexterously grab pieces of honeycomb and flee before they are stung.

entry: POKENAME飞时用身体手状部位摘球果。若发现熟得完美，就迅速吃掉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses the hand-like portion of its body to grab Apricorns off trees while in flight. Should it find a perfectly ripe one, it will eat it rapidly.

entry: POKENAME与群体凶猛守蕉香果。先尖吠，再朝敌人使出高速星星。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fiercely guards gathered Nanab Berries with its pack. Before attacking, it barks sharply, then unleashes a Swift at foes.

entry: POKENAME出击前，先规律挥手状鹿角，导引精神力量，造短暂幻象。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME waves its hand-shaped antlers rhythmically before striking. The motion allows it to channel psychic power and craft brief illusions.

entry: POKENAME是自学成才、满怀抱负的画家，在热带栖息地的石头和树上作画。颜料用完就进城，偷美术店的颜料管，却只拿红、绿、蓝。
author: jackster
source: Aspiring, self-taught artists, POKENAME paint on rocks and trees in their tropical habitats. When they run out of paint, they travel to local towns and steal paint tubes from art supply stores, but only in reds, greens, and blues.

entry: POKENAME产蕉香果味的甜奶，烘焙师爱做蛋糕和派。奇怪的是，没吃过蕉香果，也能产这味。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME produces Nanab-scented milk that is remarkably sweet. Bakers prize it for cakes and pies. Curiously, it creates this flavor even when it has not eaten Nanab Berries.

entry: POKENAME的手看似轻巧，却极重。每只手，甚至重过一辆普通皮卡车。
author: .izik
source: Despite their hands' lightweight appearance, POKENAME are very heavy. Each hand weighs more than an average-sized pickup truck.

entry: POKENAME拍尾引注意。对方一看，就跑跳过去，用掌状身体拍打。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME slaps its tail against the ground to get others' attention. Once they look over in its direction it runs and leaps at them, slapping them with its palm-shaped body.

entry: POKENAME尾巴像握着一件闪电状物品，电力巨大。它当长矛刺敌，也从尖端射电。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tail appears to hold a lightning bolt–shaped object of great electrical power. It wields it akin to a spear, jabbing at opponents and firing electric bolts from the tip.

entry: POKENAME每条触手末端，都有原始却出奇灵巧的手，能在树间荡得快得与体型不相称。
author: holgast
source: Each of POKENAME's many tentacles ends in a primitive yet surprisingly dextrous hand. Its uses them to swing through trees with blinding speed for its size.

entry: POKENAME在家乡泥池边装天真爱玩，欺骗旅人。所谓新朋友一转头，就被尾巴抛来的大泥团砸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tricks travelers by acting innocent and playful, while staying near to the muddy pond it calls home. When its supposed new friend looks away, it pelts them with large clumps of mud flung via its tail.

entry: POKENAME高举尾巴，用掌心的花朵进行光合作用，聚集能量。谁攻击，就以惊人速度把这只手拍下，将对方压进地面。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME raise their tails high into the air, using photosynthesis through the flower on their palm to gather energy. Should anyone attack, they will slam this hand into them with incredible speed, stamping them into the ground.

entry: POKENAME用可对向抓握的触手，逮住游过的一切，直到想吃才松。触手若被咬掉，约14天再生。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will grab anything that swims by with its opposable tentacles and will hold onto them until it is ready to eat them. If one of the tentacles is bitten off, they will grow back in about 14 days.

entry: 古文献称，POKENAME可同时把手状肢体复制最多1000次。学者仍有争论，因为没有在世目击者证实。
author: .izik
source: Ancient texts claim POKENAME can duplicate its hand-like limbs up to 1,000 times at once. Scholars debate these accounts, as no living witness has confirmed such displays.

entry: POKENAME见领地入侵者，就从树梢毫不犹豫落下击打。手尾指端有细尖，躲不开拍掌，就会中毒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME won't hesitate to drop from its perch among treetops to strike down at any intruders in its territory. The fingers of its hand-like tail have tiny points that can deliver poison to those unable to avoid its smack.

entry: POKENAME挥舞藤蔓的手和利刃，能在森林中迅速夺走生命。幸好，它更喜欢用它们抓取、切开水果和坚果。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's vine-swinging hand and blade can make for a swift death in the forest. Thankfully it prefers grabbing and cutting fruits and nuts instead.

entry: POKENAME常在林边田野共玩，察险便逃。森林起火，却会冒生命危险，用尾抓幼崽送往安全处。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Generally found playing together in fields near woods, POKENAME scarper when they sense danger. During forest fires, they use their tail to grab young Pokémon, carrying them to safety, risking their own life to save others.

entry: POKENAME尾端射利针，全身薄合金层保护它免受攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires sharp needles from the end of its tail. A thin metallic alloy coats its entire body, protecting it from assault.

entry: 融合让POKENAME触须极灵，移动与抓力都增强。有人见它用附肢抚摸其他生物，安抚情绪。
author: robobunnybutt
source: POKENAME's feelers become highly agile as a result of the fusion process, increasing both mobility and grip strength. It has been observed petting other living beings with its appendages as a means of calming their emotions.

entry: POKENAME看似手指的部分，其实是缩起藏好的刺鞭。轻敌者会发现，它能极其精准地挥出致命的带刺藤蔓。
author: sk372
source: What appear to be POKENAME's fingers are actually retracted thorny whips it hides from view. Those that underestimate it will find it able to lash out with spiked vines with deadly precision.

entry: POKENAME靠多只手，在树枝与藤蔓间飞快荡行，偷走毫无防备宝可梦的树果，或其他东西。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME use their multiple hands to quickly swing across branches and vines. They steal berries and other items from unsuspecting Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME尾巴平衡飞行。尾端哪怕轻伤，也得等痊愈，才不飞得笨拙。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its tail to balance its flight. Should the end of the tail be injured even slightly, it will fly clumsily until it heals.

entry: POKENAME用黏手爬住宅墙，夜里窥窗找猎物。
author: .izik
source: Using the adhesive properties of its hands, POKENAME climbs the walls of homes. It peeks through windows at night, searching for prey.

entry: POKENAME性情悠闲，常被误认懒。尾巴做大部分工作，因此自己从不急着动。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a laid-back personality that is mistaken for indolence. It is never in a hurry to move because its tail does most of the work.

entry: POKENAME尾手急闪，分散敌人注意。光在超过1英里外也看得见。
author: .izik
source: The hand on POKENAME's tail flashes rapidly to distract its foe. The light from its tail can be seen from over a mile away.

entry: POKENAME睡时用尾手抓洞壁。群体工作，尾巴相连，采运矿物当食物。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use the hands on their tails to secure themselves to walls of caves while they sleep. They work in packs, linking their tails together to gather and transport minerals for food.

entry: POKENAME攻击前，尾火变手状。它在球果树附近烧掌印，标记领地。
author: .izik
source: Before attacking, the flame on POKENAME's tail takes on a hand-like shape. It burns palm-shaped prints near Apricorn Trees to mark its territory.

entry: POKENAME雷雨时用手抓树等牢固物。风暴过后，会睡数天，恢复体力。
author: .izik
source: During thunderstorms, POKENAME uses its hands to grab onto trees or other sturdy objects. Once the storm passes, it sleeps for days to refill its stamina.

entry: POKENAME啃商家附近电缆，吃电流。受威胁，就布强力电网，以爪状尾导电，击退捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gnaws into electrical cables near businesses to feed on the current. If threatened, it casts a powerful Electroweb and channels electricity through its paw-like tail to shock predators.

entry: POKENAME用舌尖的手卷猎物，再以大牙巧妙吸取敌人生命力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses the hand on the end of its tongue to reel in prey. Using its large fangs, it skillfully drains the life force of its enemy.

entry: POKENAME晨昏最活跃。叶片苦而有毒，想拿来饱餐一顿的生物，准会大吃苦头。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is most active at dusk and dawn. Their leaves are bitter and poisonous; those who try to feast on them are in for a nasty surprise.

entry: POKENAME漂浮时，能听到多支笛子的声音。动得越快，声越强。
author: .izik
source: The sound of multiple flutes can be heard while an POKENAME floats. The faster it moves, the more intense of a noise can be heard.

entry: POKENAME靠尾手在树枝间荡，沿途放出一片片花粉云。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses the hand on its tail to swing from branch to branch. As it swings, it lets loose clouds of pollen into the air.

entry: POKENAME晨昏高声喊同伴。掌状尾里另有一只肺，让喧闹叫声能持续极久。
author: pokepower
source: At dawn and dusk, POKENAME hoots and hollers to find its kin. It has an extra lung inside its hand-tail, letting its raucous cry go on for ages.

entry: POKENAME先飞身重压敌人，再用尾手固定，拳脚猛击。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME attacks its opponents with a flying press, then holds them in place with its tail-hand as it pummels them with punches and kicks.

entry: POKENAME假装四肢僵硬，走得歪斜。可突然爆发杂技动作，绊敌偷食，很难预测。
author: pokepower
source: POKENAME fakes having stiff limbs, moving in an off-kilter fashion. Sudden bursts of acrobatics make it unpredictable, tripping up foes and stealing food.

entry: POKENAME不断产出来历不明的沙。华蓝市的玻璃吹制工匠，会利用这些材料制作珠宝。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body continuously produces sand from an unknown source. Glassblowers in Cerulean City utilize this glass in jewelry crafting.

entry: POKENAME身上蘑菇像手。受惊就放紫粉，吸入有毒。
author: .izik
source: The mushrooms on POKENAME's body resemble hands. When startled, it will release a purple powder that is toxic if inhaled.

entry: POKENAME只用那一只手，慢慢堆起自己的身体，十分自豪。可一慌乱挥动着自卫，身体又往往散了。
author: pokepower
source: POKENAME take great pride in building up their body using their singular hand. Their body usually falls apart as they flail to protect themselves.

entry: POKENAME蘑菇块可配制万能粉，本身闻着像香蕉与洗手液。
author: .izik
source: Clumps of POKENAME's mushroom can be used in recipes for Heal Powder. The mushroom itself smells like bananas and hand sanitizer.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上手掌般的部分，滋味极其鲜美，用于各种煎炸菜肴。但它避着人，逃跑又快，因此被视为稀有佳肴。
author: .izik
source: The hand-like portion of POKENAME's tail is extremely savory and used in a variety of fried dishes. It is considered a rare delicacy due to POKENAME's avoidance of humans and the speed at which they run away.

entry: POKENAME睡时用尾拍中空瓜状身体，邦戈鼓般的诡声回荡瓜田，令旅人不安。
author: .izik
source: When sleeping, POKENAME swats the hollow pumpkin-like part of its body with its tail. The eerie, bongo-like sounds echoing through pumpkin patches unsettle travelers.

entry: POKENAME看似温顺，几句挑衅就能惹怒这只灵长类。突如其来的好斗，让家长不愿选它。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME may seem docile, but it only takes a few incendiary words to spark anger in the primate. These sudden bursts of aggressiveness make them an unpopular choice among parents.

entry: POKENAME勇敢善战，卑鄙手段也敢用。第三只手让它迅速换位，突袭敌人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are intrepid fighters who are not afraid of getting their hands dirty with underhanded tactics. Their third hand allows them to quickly shift positions and surprise their foes.

entry: POKENAME用腹纹晃晕别的宝可梦，再偷桃子、油桃等软果。吃完便跑，赶在对方回神前消失。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dazes other Pokémon with the pattern on its stomach, before stealing soft fruits from them like peaches or nectarines. After finishing its stolen fruit, it scurries away before the dazed Pokémon snaps out of it.

entry: POKENAME轻松计算复杂数学。阿罗拉科学家借它研究虫洞等现象。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's mind has the ability to do complex math without much effort. Scientists in Alola utilize it to research wormholes and other phenomena.

entry: 王国时代，人们请POKENAME取悦王室。它杂技与力量表演都出色。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME were employed during the time of kingdoms to entertain royals. They were proficient in both acrobatics and feats of strength.

entry: POKENAME会不由自主远观半径10英里内任何讲笑话的人。若听到好笑的，就会笑数小时。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME unwillingly has the ability to remotely view anyone making a joke within a 10-mile radius. Should it hear a funny joke it will laugh for hours.

entry: POKENAME用手抓带电线，大吃电力，能让整座变电站停摆。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its hand to grab onto live wires. It consumes large amounts of power in this way, taking out entire substations.

entry: POKENAME的棍离主人一天，就会硬化。米丽法城有家店，把这些棍当痒痒挠出售。
author: .izik
source: An POKENAME's stick will harden after one day should it be separated from its owner. A shop in Milyfa Town sells these sticks as back scratchers.

entry: POKENAME用两只前爪行走，锻炼上半身的力量，将第三只爪留作攻击。为使对手措手不及，它会俯身趴下，飞快旋转，抓紧一切靠近的东西。
author: foulz4k
source: POKENAME walks on its two front paws to train its upper body strength, leaving its third paw free to attack with. To catch opposing Pokémon off guard, it falls back onto its stomach and rapidly spins, clenching anything that may come close.

entry: POKENAME夜里会用巨大的尾状附肢，抓住毫无防备的人。它并不想伤害，只是想吓一跳。
author: projectalpha22
source: POKENAME uses its large, tail-like appendage to latch onto unsuspecting people at night. It does not wish to do harm however, merely to frighten.

entry: POKENAME背上鳞茎需大量阳光生长。它找最佳晒处，再在那里休息。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME needs lots of sunlight for the bulb on its back to grow. It searches for the best place to soak up sunlight before resting there.

entry: POKENAME只靠高草晨露维生，整早都吃。吃饱便挤在同一片已干的草里休息。
author: bagumbothimble
source: Subsisting entirely on the morning dew that clings to tall grass, POKENAME will spend their entire morning eating. Once full, they will huddle together and rest in the same, now dry, grass.

entry: POKENAME每颗头总处在不同生命阶段，一群几乎永生。可任何时刻只一颗完全长成，战斗作用不大。
author: mistymagius
source: Due to each head always being at different stages in their life cycles, a single group of POKENAME is virtually immortal. However, since only one of them is ever fully grown at a time, they are not much use in battle.

entry: 特别晴朗的地方，POKENAME头能长得巨大。太大便脱落，最终长成新个体。
author: mistymagius
source: In particularly sunny areas, POKENAME's heads can grow to gargantuan sized. However, if they grow too big, they will end up falling off and eventually growing into a new POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME以泥石做工具武器自卫，可头盔上芽茎才是身体本身。怕水积太多，就把多余的哭出来。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME mold tools and weapons out of mud and rock to better defend themselves; the stems sprouting from their helmets are part of their actual bodies, however. To keep themselves from being overfilled with water, they weep the excess.

entry: 它与手持大芽存在偏利共生：芽把阳光转养分，供它吸收。可它也保护芽，因此有人争论，双方是否其实互利共生。
author: infinex21
source: It has a commensal relationship with the large sprout it wields; the sprout turns sunlight into nutrients that are absorbed by it. There is some debate if the relationship is symbiotic, since this Pokémon makes sure to protect the sprout from harm.

entry: POKENAME光合作用时，力量速度渐增。久无日光，能量流失，身体便开始萎蔫。
author: evilgammon
source: As POKENAME photosynthesizes, it becomes gradually stronger and faster. If without sunlight for a prolonged period of time, it will begin to lose energy, leading to its body starting to wilt.

entry: POKENAME粉烟有标志气味：花香、泥土与腻甜。可惜它极易燃，常因自己造成的爆炸昏厥。
author: haypile
source: Pink plumes from a POKENAME have a signature smell -- floral, earthy, and sickly sweet. Unfortunately for POKENAME, it's highly flammable and often faints from explosions of its own making.

entry: POKENAME绿烟闻着像青菜混烟霾，新奇浓烈。可惜它极易燃，常因自己造成的爆炸昏厥。
author: haypile
source: Green plumes from a POKENAME smell like a novel, heady mix of garden greens and smog. Unfortunately for POKENAME, it's highly flammable and often faints from explosions of its own making.

entry: 特别干的季节，POKENAME把尾露外一夜。早上舔自己的叶，吃积起的露水。
author: bagumbothimble
source: During particularly dry seasons, a POKENAME will leave its own tail exposed to the elements overnight. In the morning, it will lick its own leaves to consume any dew that may have gathered there.

entry: POKENAME茧上特殊花纹融入环境。它尽量静止，免被捕食者发现。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have special markings on their cocoon that help them blend into their surroundings. They try to remain as still as possible to avoid being detected by predators.

entry: POKENAME晴野里开心冲跑蹦跳。一到无日光处，却立刻趴地，闷闷不乐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can be seen happily charging and prancing about open fields in the sunlight. The moment it reaches a point where there is no sunlight however, it flops onto the ground and becomes sullen.

entry: POKENAME精力过剩，一跑便难停，常边跑边从背撒种子炸弹。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are so hyper that they struggle to stop running once they begin. They tend to scatter Seed Bombs from their back as they run around.

entry: POKENAME角冠保护头上嫩芽。若悉心养的芽在战中折断，它便失去所有智慧迹象，狂怒起来。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME's horn and crests protect the sprout emerging from its head. When this carefully-tended sprout breaks off in battle, it loses all signs of intelligence and flies into a rage.

entry: POKENAME性情善良，常把长势不佳的幼苗放袋里，照料到健康强壮。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is known for its kind nature. It is often seen placing struggling sprouts into its pouch, tending to them until they become strong and healthy.

entry: POKENAME藤蔓虽防直接攻击，却也让它成目标。藤蔓营养足，飞行宝可梦可能抢一条。冷天它会变弱。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although POKENAME's vines protect its main body from direct attacks, they still make it a target. These vines are filled with nutrition, so flying Pokémon may try to snag one. POKENAME grows weak in cold weather.

entry: POKENAME袋中幼苗般的宝宝，被根与细丝连住。最后一位试分离幼崽和宿主的研究者，去向不明，从未公开结果。
author: haypile
source: The seedling joey inside the pouch is tethered in place by roots and filaments. The last researcher who tried to separate it from the host POKENAME disappeared somewhere without ever sharing the results.

entry: POKENAME常待在近水面，很少潜得更深，好让身体吸收到，足够维生的日光。
author: kitarchen
source: POKENAME often stay close to the surface of water and rarely dive deeper. This is to ensure they are collecting enough sunlight to sustain themselves.

entry: POKENAME以管状嘴吐种，用寄生种子等招式。若训练家改要水属性招式，通常会用扇状鳍叶泼对方，表示抗议。
author: haypile
source: For moves like Leech Seed, it spits seeds out of its tube-like mouth. If a Trainer asks POKENAME to use a Water-type move instead, POKENAME will usually splash them with its fan-like fin leaves in protest.

entry: POKENAME借旋转的花瓣，优雅地逆着急流游动。额头上的角是唯一的防御手段，因此进化之前，它多半选择避战逃离。
author: pizzarcato
source: Its petals spin in a rotating motion to help it swim gracefully up strong streams. The horn on POKENAME's forehead is its only method of defense, so it chooses to flee most battles until it evolves.

entry: 水面忽冒嫩芽，很可能是POKENAME群。它们吃水草根、光合供全天能量，遇险便逃向安全水域。
author: chibitales
source: Sprouts suddenly appearing from the water's surface are likely from a school of POKENAME. They feed on aquatic plant roots and photosynthesize sunlight to maintain their energy throughout the day. When danger approaches, they flee to safer waters.

entry: POKENAME挂在日照充足的树枝上。缺少阳光，生长就会受阻；为到达向阳的草地，有些个体可能选择从枝头落下。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hang from branches where plenty of sunlight shines. Their growth can get stunted if they do not receive enough sunlight, so some may opt to fall from the branches if it means reaching a sunny patch of grass.

entry: POKENAME产特殊种子，一碰地就啪地裂开。遇捕食者，能借种子一闪换到附近躲攻击。用光后，很可能被吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce special seeds that quickly snap when they make contact with the ground. When faced with a predator, they can dodge attacks by snapping a short distance away with their seeds. If they run out of seeds, they are likely to be eaten.

entry: 融合日渐普遍，许多自然保护者赞赏POKENAME天生给各类植物授粉，沿途传花粉与种子。
author: bobosmith01
source: Since Pokémon Fusion has become more commonplace, many natural conservationists have praised POKENAME's natural-born tendency to pollinate all kinds of flora, spreading pollen and seeds wherever it goes.

entry: POKENAME平躺装光合。看似叶片的其实是灵活手臂，靠太近就被合拢抓住。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME lays flat and pretends to photosynthesize. What looks like leaves are actually highly mobile arms that fold closed around anything that gets too close.

entry: POKENAME任两条棕肢都能站，有时看着倒立或侧立。更爱漂而非走，叶面积足，能安稳浮在水面。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME can stand upright on any two of its brown limbs, sometimes making it appear upside-down or sideways. It prefers drifting over walking -- its leaves provide enough surface area that it can float peacefully on the surface.

entry: POKENAME晒太阳、被捉弄，甚至镰刀切东西时，表情都不变。有爱好者觉可靠安心，也有人觉是诡异害兽。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME's expression never changes, whether it's sunbathing, getting pranked, or slicing something to shreds with its scythes. Some fans find the reliability soothing, while others find POKENAME to be an unsettling pest.

entry: POKENAME摇摆时，裙边的幼芽便会开合子叶。它能用超能力独立操纵每棵幼芽，让它们挥动打招呼，或缠住敌人；裙下还藏着更多，蓄势待发。
author: haypile
source: When POKENAME sways, the sprouts around its skirt open and close their cotyledons. It can move each sprout independently with psychic power to make them wave hello or ensnare a foe. There are a lot more sprouts hidden in wait under the skirt.

entry: 学生在学校从精灵球里放出POKENAME，邻班就抱怨爆米花香让人分心。它控好火息温度梳身体，让壳脆且硬。
author: haypile
source: Students who let POKENAME out of its Poké Ball in school get complaints from neighboring classrooms that it smells distractingly like popcorn. POKENAME keeps its shell crispy and tough by grooming itself with flame breath at a controlled temperature.

entry: POKENAME奔踏草原，蹄子翻土。有种子被压深，有的被踢向阳光，让不同植物有机会生长，丰富生物多样性。
author: haypile
