source: When POKENAME rampage across the plains, their hooves till the soil. Some seeds get pressed deeper in, and others get kicked up toward the sunlight, giving various plant species a chance to grow and enrich the plains' biodiversity.

entry: 据说POKENAME温顺待在乡间森林地下，吸养分准备进化。可什么靠近栖地，都遭藤根攻击。
author: aquaxena
source: This Pokémon is said to remain docile underneath a rural forest, absorbing its nutrients for further evolution. POKENAME attacks anything that comes near its habitat with vines and roots.

entry: POKENAME住繁绿地方附近的大水域，坏脾气与可爱表情相反。体型虽大，却相当弱，想暴走也往往不成气候。
author: sk372
source: Residing in large bodies of water near verdant locales, POKENAME has an ill temperament that contrasts with its cute expression. However, despite its size, it is rather weak, so its attempts at rampaging fall a bit flat.

entry: POKENAME爱在肥沃的泥土里玩耍，也能从中吸收许多养分。接触进化石会让叶片发生变化，接触越久，变化越明显。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME love to play in rich mud and dirt, which provides them with many nutrients to absorb as well. Exposure to evolutionary stones causes their leaves to change, with the changes being more noticeable the longer their exposure.

entry: POKENAME水下游，花瓣向后压合肩部，盖住颈凹，使身体更呈纺锤形，也更流线减阻。
author: haypile
source: When POKENAME swims underwater, its petals are pushed backward, sealing around its shoulders. This covers the dip of its neck, functionally making POKENAME more fusiform and aerodynamic.

entry: POKENAME肩上藤状茎有离子通道，向外导电。头顶特化芽与之互补，吸收外电，再供自己利用。
author: haypile
source: The vine-like stems extending from POKENAME's shoulders host ionic channels that conduct electricity outward. These complement the specialized sprout on its head that absorbs external electricity, recapturing that energy for its own use.

entry: POKENAME似乎不怕枝叶里的大火。体内热太足，每次火被灭，又会重新起。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME doesn't seem bothered by the fires raging in its foliage. Its abundant internal heat causes a new fire whenever an ongoing blaze is extinguished.

entry: POKENAME在城市垃圾场收废芯片，埋到田里。芯片帮助导航，也协助授粉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects discarded microchips from city dumps and buries them in fields. These chips aid in navigation and assist it with pollination.

entry: POKENAME壳里全是土和植物，而非空气，游泳不如菊石兽。植物多到撑裂壳时，就接近进化了。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME are less adept at swimming than Omanyte because the inside of its shell is full of soil and greenery instead of air. When the greenery becomes so abundant that it splits the shell open, POKENAME will be close to evolving.

entry: POKENAME从树上掉下，总脸朝地，因独特密度分布，让背上芽最终朝太阳。
author: haypile
source: When POKENAME falls from a tree, it always lands face-down. This is due to a unique density distribution, ensuring the sprout on its back ends up facing the sun.

entry: POKENAME头后嫩芽在水中上浮，帮助感知水下自身姿态。游近可口猎物后，臂镰扎入，透过植物组织吸内养分。
author: haypile
source: The sprout on the back of the head of a POKENAME floats up in water, helping with its proprioception while submerged. When it swims to delicious-looking prey, it sinks its arm scythes in and absorbs their inner nutrients through its plant tissues.

entry: POKENAME懒得出奇，明明身体极轻，行动却像沉重不堪。它宁愿等翅膀积起露水，也不肯飞到溪边喝一口。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME is a remarkably lazy Pokémon; it acts like its body is heavy even though it's incredibly light. It would rather wait for its wings to collect dew than fly to a stream for a drink.

entry: POKENAME代谢日光产电，存进翼中种子。它爱风暴，开心穿过雷云。
author: infinex21
source: The seeds within POKENAME's wings are filled with electricity that is generated when their bodies metabolize sunlight. They love stormy weather and will happily fly through thundering clouds.

entry: POKENAME爱太阳，在热草原筑巢。掉下的种子营养丰富，吃着像爆米花。
author: mcnchsschl
source: POKENAME likes to be in the sun, so it seeks out hot, grassy plains to nest in. Seeds that fall from this Pokémon are very nutritious, and their taste is reminiscent of popcorn.

entry: POKENAME用腹内孢子给毒植物授粉。撒粉一边肥土，一边毒附近宝可梦。住地繁绿、阻入侵者，可久沾花粉，会让作物形态扭曲。
author: jaddies
source: POKENAME pollinates toxic plants using spores stored in its abdomen. The powder it scatters fertilizes soil while poisoning nearby Pokémon. Areas it inhabits grow lush and repel intruders, but prolonged exposure to its pollen can warp crops.

entry: POKENAME进行光合作用时也会产生精神力量，但大半力量都困在身体坚硬的外壳下。它烦躁地甩着尾巴，盼望进化后能发挥全部潜能。
author: haypile
source: When POKENAME photosynthesizes, it also generates psychic power, but that power is largely trapped under the hard-shelled parts of its body. It whips its tail in frustration while waiting to evolve to unlock its full capacity.

entry: POKENAME的精神力量依赖阳光，因此早晨的它最强大，也最开心。夜里，它会用剩余的力量在身边撑起护罩，在里面睡到天亮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's psychic power is dependent on sunlight, so it is at its strongest and happiest in the mornings. At night, it uses what power remains to form a shield around itself to sleep in until morning arises again.

entry: POKENAME通常散发着甜香。若香气略带坚果味，就说明它晒太阳太久，产生了过多氨基酸，成了饥饿宝可梦眼中的美食。
author: haypile
source: Usually, a POKENAME lets off an aromatic sweetness. If that scent turns mildly nutty, that's a sign that POKENAME has been out in the sun for too long and is overproducing amino acids, which makes it an appealing target for hungry Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME喜欢晒太阳，尤其喜欢炎热的夏日。它最爱的活动之一是陪训练家徒步，借运动消耗光合作用积攒的多余能量。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy being out in the sun, especially on a hot summer day. One of their favorite activities is hiking with their Trainer, as the exercise allows them to burn the excess energy they get from photosynthesis.

entry: POKENAME会把头上娇嫩的芽别在耳后，免得战斗前冒出的旺盛火焰将它烧伤。身体其余部分像种皮一样坚韧耐火。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME tucks its delicate head sprout behind its ear so it isn't burned in the energetic flames that emerge when it's ready to battle. The rest of its body is tough like a seed coat and resists fire.

entry: POKENAME喷发出的孢子会像爆米花一样响亮地炸开。它使出的大晴天光芒耀眼，足以照亮一座小城。
author: haypile
source: The spores released in POKENAME's eruptions burst loudly like popcorn. Its dazzling Sunny Day move glitters brightly enough to illuminate a small city.

entry: 为了节省能量、早日进化，POKENAME很少飞行。它们三五成群地挤在一起，吃树上掉下的坚果、树果和松果。
author: sk372
source: To save energy in order to hasten evolution, POKENAME rarely takes to the air and flies. It huddles together in small groups, eating nuts, berries and pine cones that fall from trees.

entry: POKENAME在荒地上忽左忽右地蹦跳，每跳一下就从头顶开口撒出一把当地植物的种子。短短几天，茂密的丛林就开始萌生。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME erratically bounces across barren land. With each bounce, it releases a handful of native seeds from an opening in its head. In just a few days, a lush jungle starts to sprout.

entry: POKENAME在肥沃的土地里挖掘庞大复杂的地洞，常给农民添麻烦。它要积攒进化所需的能量，因此很少出洞。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME constructs large, intricate burrows in fertile ground, often interfering with farmers. It is rarely seen outside its den, as it conserves energy needed to evolve.

entry: POKENAME白天经常打盹，每次只睡10分钟就醒来。确认自己仍晒得到充足阳光后，又会睡上10分钟。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME take lots of naps throughout the day, as they only sleep for 10 minutes at a time before waking up. Once they awaken, they make sure they are still getting enough sunlight before falling back to sleep for another 10 minutes.

entry: POKENAME一拳，就能打出适合播种的洞。效率出色，也让POKENAME很受农民喜欢。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME use their punches to make perfect holes for seeds. This efficiency has made POKENAME favored by farmers.

entry: POKENAME很会分辨杂草与真菌，飞遍农场，除掉可能危害作物的植物。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME are great at identifying weeds and fungi. They fly around farmsteads eliminating any plants that may threaten the farm.

entry: POKENAME在向阳处结丝网，好让自己待在上面晒太阳。别的宝可梦撞上网时，它就用毒牙咬对方，叫对方以后别再弄坏它的网。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME make silk webs over sunny patches to give themselves a place to soak up sunlight. When another Pokémon runs into their web, they bite down with venomous fangs to discourage the Pokémon from breaking their web in the future.

entry: POKENAME耐心地伏在斑驳的日光下，偶尔把肢体挪向旁边的阳光。虫属性宝可梦凑过来啃食那些叶片般的肢体时，就会冷不防挨上它的毒牙。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME lies patiently in dappled sunlight, occasionally shifting its limbs closer to nearby sunbeams. When a Bug-type Pokémon wanders over to munch on those leaf-like limbs, POKENAME surprises them with a venomous bite.

entry: POKENAME是水生宝可梦，靠发光的球茎状触角在黑暗水域中辨路。随着它逐渐长大，触角末端会开始舒展开来。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are aquatic Pokémon who use their glowing, bulb-like antennae to guide themselves through dark waters. As they mature, the tips of their antennae begin to unravel.

entry: POKENAME把身体埋进土里，只将双臂露在地面，以便吸收土中的养分和水分。若有东西抓住它的茎，它就会释放全部能量，随后昏过去。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME bury their bodies, with their arms aboveground, to better feed on nutrients and water in the ground. If anything grabs their stems, they discharge all of their energy and black out.

entry: 流星划过满天时，许多POKENAME会现身，舒展开卷曲的叶片，仿佛在吸收星光。此后它们很少活动，只靠雨露维生，直到准备好进化。
author: chibitales
source: When shooting stars fill the sky, many POKENAME appear and unfurl their leafy curls as if absorbing the light. They will not move much after the event is over, subsisting only on rain and dew until they are ready to evolve.

entry: 人们常把POKENAME当成树果，所以有人靠近时，它就躲进灌木。人离开后，它会收集巧可果、通通果等各种能帮助自己抵御天敌的树果。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hide in the bushes when people come nearby since they are often mistaken for berries. After people leave, they harvest different types of berries that help protect them from predators, such as the Occa Berry or Kebia Berry.

entry: POKENAME借风飘行，扩大族群的分布范围，却也因此很容易被飞行属性宝可梦捕获；对方尤其喜爱它营养丰富的身体。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although POKENAME float on the wind to spread the reach of their population, it also means they become easy pickings for Flying-type Pokémon, who adore their nutrient-filled body.

entry: POKENAME的羊毛染上了叶绿素，却呈现出黄色。它喜欢晒太阳休息，在草地上吃草。它的羊毛会被做成黄色夏裙。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have wool dyed with chlorophyll that gives off a yellow hue. They love to rest in the sunlight and graze in fields of grass. Their wool is made into yellow summer dresses.

entry: 世界各地都有POKENAME，而且人们总看到它朝西飞。研究者发现，它早晨先晒太阳，等太阳渐渐西沉，就起飞追逐落日。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are found globally and are always observed to be flying westward. Researchers have observed that they spend the morning sunning themselves and, as the sun begins to set, they will take off and fly toward it.

entry: POKENAME的羊毛覆盖着身体自然分泌的油脂。剪下羊毛后，人们会提取其中的油，积攒起来煎炸食物。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME's wool is covered in oils that its body naturally secretes. Its wool can be shorn and stripped of oils, which are saved up and used for frying food.

entry: 战斗间隙，POKENAME会坐在阳光下进行光合作用，给自己充充电。尾尖的球亮起来，就说明它已精力充沛。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME recharge their metaphorical batteries between battles by sitting in the sun and photosynthesizing. A person can tell if a POKENAME is full of energy once the orb on the tip of their tail glows bright.

entry: 头上的花其实是复叶，许多小叶片会展开，尽量收集阳光。攒够跳舞的能量后，它便翩翩起舞，裙子上蜡质的叶片相互摩擦，发出细小的吱吱声。
author: haypile
source: The flowers on its head are actually compound leaves. The leaflets spread out to gather as much sunlight as possible until it has the energy to dance; then the waxy leaves of its skirt make little squeaking sounds when they rub against each other.

entry: POKENAME性情开朗，尾巴的花纹也很应景，因此常被选作网球活动的吉祥物。它还会用尾巴接露珠，帮助自己漂浮。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME is often used as a tennis mascot for its cheerful nature and the pattern on its tail. Its tail is also used to catch dewdrops and help it float.

entry: POKENAME生活在田野附近的河岸，主要从阳光和露珠中获取养分。它会合起耳朵防水，张开耳朵接收阳光。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME lives on the riverbank near fields, mostly getting its nutrients from sunlight and dewdrops. It closes its ears to keep them from getting wet, and opens them to catch sunlight.

entry: POKENAME裹在身上的叶片状材料能够防水，只要离水面够近、晒得到阳光，它就能在河里生活。不过它更喜欢上岸，呱呱唱歌，希望交到朋友。
author: haypile
source: The leafy material wrapped around POKENAME's body is waterproof, letting it live in rivers as long as it's close enough to the surface to photosynthesize. It still prefers to come to land where it can croak out its songs, hoping to make friends.

entry: POKENAME总是闲不住，常常跳来跳去，寻找阳光最充足的地方。许多同类还会充当别的宝可梦玩耍的球，展示自己在空中飘浮的本领。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are restless Pokémon and are often hopping from one location to another to maximize their exposure to sunlight. Many POKENAME serve as a ball for other Pokémon to show off their ability to float through the air.

entry: POKENAME从地面跃起时，会撒出一团肥料，加快附近植物的生长。
author: camtft
source: When POKENAME launches off the ground, it disperses a cloud of fertilizer that speeds up the growth of nearby plants.

entry: POKENAME体型小巧，在草原和花田里四处奔跑。虽然能利用叶片状尾巴吸收的阳光获取能量，它仍喜欢啃叶子和花瓣。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are small Pokémon that scurry across grassy plains and fields of flowers. They enjoy nibbling on leaves and petals, even though they metabolize sunlight absorbed through their leafy tails.

entry: POKENAME用藤蔓般的尾巴在树枝间荡来荡去。荡累了，就找自己够得到的最高枝头晒太阳。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swing from branch to branch with their vine-like tail. Whenever they are tired from swinging around, they find the tallest branch they can reach and soak in the sunlight.

entry: POKENAME身上长出了几片坚韧的长叶，行动更加方便灵活。代价是每天需要平常四倍的阳光，才能维持活动。
author: sk372
source: Several long and sturdy leaves have grown from POKENAME's body, granting it more mobility and agility. This comes at the tradeoff of requiring four times the daily amount of sunlight to function, however.

entry: POKENAME用翅膀吸收阳光，常在向日葵花丛里寻找最佳位置。越接近进化，头上的芽就长得越大。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME absorbs sunlight through its wings, often searching for sunflower patches to find the best spot. The sprout on its head grows bigger the closer it is to evolution.

entry: POKENAME会把蛋产在约一米深的地下，再用土盖住。幼崽要等大雨把地面泡软，才能从泥土中钻出来，并在途中吸收重要养分。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME Eggs are laid about a metre underground, then covered with earth. Newborn POKENAME emerge only after heavy rain softens the ground, allowing them to burrow up from the mud, absorbing important nutrients as they do.

entry: POKENAME头上的坚硬种子扎了根，刺激着它的大脑和精神力量。它并不在意种子的侵入，依然乐天开朗。
author: haypile
source: The hard seed over its head is rooted in place, stimulating POKENAME's brain and its psychic powers. POKENAME isn't bothered by the invasion, maintaining a sunny disposition.

entry: POKENAME的叶绿素被背上的幼苗吸收，所以身体呈深褐色。它会拼命保护幼苗，因为幼苗一旦受损，它就无法利用养分。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are dark brown because the chlorophyll is absorbed by the seedling on their back. They fiercely protect the seedling on their back because they are unable to process nutrients if it becomes damaged.

entry: POKENAME背上有一株小幼苗，彼此分享养分。幼苗吸收它体内产生的叶绿素，过程中留下了深褐色的色素。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a small seedling on their back that they share nutrients with. The seedling absorbs chlorophyll they produce from their body and leaves behind a dark brown pigment in the process.

entry: POKENAME为了进化在体内储存养分，常因此显得圆鼓鼓的。它用伸缩自如的藤蔓状尾巴够取坚果，靠咀嚼硬壳保持门牙锋利。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are often bloated due to the nutrients they have stored within their bodies for the sake of their evolution. Their tails are like stretchy vines that they use to reach hard nuts to chew on, which help to keep their fangs sharp.

entry: POKENAME把身体藏在长叶里。叶片上有一层奇怪的涂层，几乎能反弹任何攻击。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME hides its body inside its long leaves. The leaves have a strange coating that lets them reflect almost any attack.

entry: POKENAME身体两半的交界处长出长芽，作用尚不明确。不过训练家试过把芽当成缰绳，牵着它走，免得靠近尾巴上笑容诡异的种子。
author: haypile
source: Where the two halves of POKENAME's body meet, long sprouts emerge. The purpose of the sprouts is unknown, but Trainers have tried using them as reins to lead POKENAME without getting close to the eerily smiling seed on its tail.

entry: POKENAME聚集在树上朝阳的枝头，整天追着阳光在树间挪动，争抢最高的位置，好晒到最多的太阳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME cluster in trees on the branches facing toward the sun. They will move around the tree throughout the day, jostling for the highest position to catch the most sunlight.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀覆盖着一层叶绿素，飞行时也能吸收阳光。夜里，它会用翅膀裹住身体，减少能量消耗。
author: quackquackattack
source: The wings of POKENAME are covered with a coating of chlorophyll that allows them to absorb sunlight while flying. At night, they wrap themselves in their wings to conserve energy.

entry: POKENAME钻进地下深处，再把钢铁般坚韧的根伸到地表吸收阳光。这些根很难清除，还会破坏人类建筑的地基，令人头疼。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME tunnels deep underground, then it extends its steel-tough roots to the surface to absorb sunlight. Its roots are troublesome as they are difficult to remove and undermine human constructions.

entry: POKENAME睡得很浅，一感觉不到阳光就醒来，赶紧挪到有太阳的地方。因此它夜里一直醒着，是优秀的夜间守卫。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are light sleepers that awaken whenever they do not feel sunlight and will quickly move to get back in the sunlight. This causes them to remain awake at night, which makes them great nighttime guards.

entry: POKENAME在高草里收集种子，储存在头上。随后飞到空旷田野的高处，把种子撒下。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME collects seeds in tall grass and stores them on its head. It then flies high above empty fields and distributes the seeds.

entry: POKENAME胸前的围兜由压实的土壤构成。它喜欢把种子浅浅地埋在里面。
author: haypile
source: The bib on POKENAME's chest is made of compacted soil. It likes to plant seeds shallowly in the soil.

entry: POKENAME胸前的围兜由压实的土壤构成。它很护着上面长出的植物，有谁靠近，就低吼着威吓对方。
author: haypile
source: The bib on POKENAME's chest is made of compacted soil. POKENAME is protective of the plants that grow there, and it growls to intimidate anyone who gets close.

entry: POKENAME头上的茎其实相当坚韧，几乎任何刀刃都切不动。它喜欢待在高树上，用黄色的毛吸收阳光。
author: mistymagius
source: The stem on POKENAME's head is actually quite tough, being resistant to virtually any blade. It likes to sit in tall trees, absorbing sunlight through its yellow fur.

entry: POKENAME借太阳的能量获得敏捷的反应，靠这本领从其他宝可梦身边冲过，偷走蜂巢。雨季里，它吃不到蜂蜜，只能向训练家讨食。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME harness the energy of the sun to gain quick reflexes, which they rely on to run past other Pokémon and steal honeycombs. During rainy seasons, they are unable to eat honey and beg for food from Trainers.

entry: POKENAME天生喜爱幼苗，深受大型园艺中心欢迎。它会受雇在苗圃播种，再定期走过苗床，为幼苗留下肥沃的土壤。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are a popular Pokémon for large garden centres thanks to their affinity for young plants. They are employed to plant seeds in nurseries, then periodically travel across the nursery beds to deposit fertile soil for the sprouting plants.

entry: POKENAME把土壤堆在背上，用黏液固定，再种上小植物。研究者推测，这能帮助它伪装，躲开天敌。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME gather soil atop their back, binding it to themselves with sticky mucus. They use the soil to grow small plants. Researchers speculate that this behaviour helps them camouflage themselves and avoid predators.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在肥沃的土地上栖息，双脚踏进富含养分的壤土，张开翅膀吸收阳光。一旦下雨，就起飞寻找避雨处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME love to roost in fertile soil, resting their feet within the nutritious loam whilst fanning their wings out to absorb sunlight. They take to the sky and search for shelter if it ever starts to rain.

entry: 成群的POKENAME常在冬季挖出小坑，把自己种进松软的土里，直到春天才出来。它会利用冰融成的水滴和雨水收集养分，为即将到来的进化做准备。
author: npshi
source: Flocks of POKENAME often dig small holes and plant themselves into soft dirt throughout the winter, before coming back out as spring arrives. POKENAME will use the droplets of water from ice and rain to collect nutrients for their upcoming evolution.

entry: POKENAME背上的种皮像极了花盆，用来保护过大的子叶。子叶一旦折断，它就得等到重新长出后，才能继续为进化积攒力量。
author: haypile
source: The seed coat around POKENAME's back bears an uncanny resemblance to a flower pot. Its purpose is to protect POKENAME's oversized cotyledons, since if those break off, POKENAME can't get closer to evolving until they grow back.

entry: 不知何时，POKENAME的尾袋上多了一张贴纸，和市售肥料的标签一模一样。袋里果然装着营养丰富的堆肥，它到处撒，连室内也不放过。
author: haypile
source: The sticker that somehow wound up on POKENAME's tail-bag looks just like the label on commercial Mulch. It should come as no surprise that the content of POKENAME's tail-bag is nutrient-rich compost, which it scatters everywhere, even indoors.

entry: POKENAME翅膀上的叶片薄而锋利，碰一下就会留下纸割般的伤口。利爪末端的根能扎进林地，直接吸取土中的养分。
author: haypile
source: The leaves in POKENAME's wings have razor-fine edges; touching them results in wounds that resemble paper cuts. Their root-tipped talons help them ingrain into the forest floor and drink up nutrients straight from the soil.

entry: 晴天时，太阳的力量会提高POKENAME火焰的温度，让它喷出猛烈的火焰。雨天恰好相反，潮湿的环境会削弱它的火焰。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of releasing powerful flames on a sunny day, as the power of the sun increases the temperature of their flames. The inverse occurs on rainy days, as their flames grow weak in the wet conditions.

entry: POKENAME用鼻子喝水、储水，常喷在自己或同类身上，滋养头顶的茎。它的鼻子力气很大，能举起和自己一样大的岩石。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME drink and store water with their trunks, often spraying themselves or others of their kind to keep the stems on their heads nourished. Their trunks are strong enough to lift rocks as big as they are.

entry: 白天，POKENAME会站在向阳的草地上打盹。到了夜里，它就变得好斗，用叶片状的角彼此冲撞。
author: quackquackattack
source: During the day, POKENAME can be found napping while upright in sunny patches of grass. At night, they get aggressive and tackle each other with their leafy antlers.

entry: POKENAME在烈日下锻炼，增强力量。若没有充分训练，一到雨天，它的拳头就会变得软弱无力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME trains under intense sunlight to build power. In the rain, its punches become weak unless it has trained thoroughly.

entry: POKENAME不知道自己体型庞大，还带着毒。哪怕面对小小的天敌，它也会害怕地乱甩叶片来吓退对方，发出令人不安却极有辨识度的沙沙声。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME doesn't know it is big and poisonous. It fearfully thrashes its leaves about to scare off even small predators, which creates a haunting but iconic rattling sound.

entry: POKENAME头上肥厚的叶片储满了草属性和火属性招式所需的燃料。储备不足时，它就得停下来，吃点热乎的东西。
author: haypile
source: The plump leaves on POKENAME's head are full of fuel for its Grass-type and Fire-type moves. When those reserves thin out, it needs to stop and eat something warm.

entry: POKENAME能像挤奶一样挤出甜美的树汁，只是每天产量很少。充分吸收阳光和养分后，树汁最甜，因此清晨最适合采集。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can be milked for a sweet sap, though only for a small amount every day. The fluid is sweetest after absorbing plenty of sunlight and nutrients, so the early morning is the best time to milk it.

entry: POKENAME的袋子里住着一只更小的宝可梦，身上的坚硬种皮能为对方遮护。它不愿把能量花在争斗上。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME keeps a smaller Pokémon in its pouch, where the hard seed coating over its body keeps them shielded. It's hesitant to spend energy on conflict.

entry: 传说POKENAME落下的每一片叶子都会引起火灾。其实，这则传说源于有人目睹一只受惊的POKENAME飞上天空，躲避野火。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME appears in a legend wherein, purportedly, any leaf it sheds starts a fire when it lands. The myth started when a startled POKENAME was seen fleeing into the sky to escape a wildfire.

entry: POKENAME在田间四处寻找最肥沃的土壤，找到合适的地方就停下来，把脚扎进土里。一群POKENAME迁入后，农民的庄稼可能就遭了殃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wander from field to field in search of the most fertile soil they can find, settling down and planting their feet in the ground when they find a suitable location. Farmers can find their crops ruined by an arriving group of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME虽顽皮，有些不走寻常路的园丁却极信赖它的独特本领，拿来帮忙务农。它播下的种子，似乎发芽快得多。
author: rakunk
source: Despite its mischievous personality, some unconventional gardeners swear by using POKENAME as a farmhand due to its unique talents. Seeds sown by this Pokémon appear to sprout much faster than normal.

entry: POKENAME既与太阳能相连，也与大气中的电能相连，反倒两头吃亏。它放出雷电时常烧焦自己的叶子，进行光合作用时又会产生干扰，削弱自身的能力。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME's connection to both solar power and atmospheric electricity don't serve it well. It will often fry its own leaves when emitting thunder, and it creates self-dampening interference when trying to photosynthesize.

entry: POKENAME胃口极大，却只爱吃爆米花。电影院便利用这一点，在晚上散场后，让它吃光剩下的爆米花。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Despite having voracious appetites, POKENAME prefer to eat only popcorn. Movie theaters take advantage of this, letting POKENAME eat all the leftover popcorn when the theater closes for the evening.

entry: 暴风雨过后，POKENAME会用爪子斩断树枝，喝上面落下的雨水。它身体轻得出奇，行动时可以随风滑行。
author: santon5512
source: After storms, POKENAME will use their claws to slash branches off trees, letting rainwater fall for them to drink. Their bodies are incredibly light, letting them glide with the wind as they move.

entry: POKENAME性情亲切友善，却整天一动不动地埋在沙里，只露出头顶的芽，白白浪费了这份好脾气。寒夜里，它才钻出来，用坚韧的皮肤收集露水。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME's sweet and friendly disposition is wasted by its habit of burying itself motionless in sand all day, only leaving its head sprout above ground. On cold nights, POKENAME surfaces to collect dew on its tough skin.

entry: POKENAME通过光合作用获取能量，用叶片状的尾巴吸水，常从地面吸收湿气。它喜欢在温暖阳光下的岩石上休息，向四周散出清新芳香的空气。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME acquire energy through photosynthesis, using their leafy tails to absorb water; often enough, they absorb moisture from the ground. They often rest atop rocks bathed in warm sunlight, exuding fresh, aromatic air all around them.

entry: POKENAME外表像一根美味的带骨肉串，其实长着柔软的褐色羽毛，还很容易惹麻烦。看似骨头的部分，其实是会释放灼热花粉的雄蕊。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: While POKENAME's outside appearance may look like a tasty meat stick, this Pokémon has soft brown feathers and gets into trouble easily. What appears to be a bone is actually the stamen that releases heated pollen.

entry: POKENAME白天总在躲避天敌。因为一晒到太阳，它就会散发出烹熟禽肉般的香气。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are constantly on the run from predators during the day. This is a result of POKENAME's smell that activates when they are in the sun and is reminiscent of cooked poultry.

entry: 野生POKENAME会蜷起或趴平，伪装成草丛。它的爪子强劲，挖出的洞足以容身睡觉；草叶般的尖刺还能短暂硬化，用于自卫。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME curl up or lay flat to disguise themselves as grass shrubs. Their claws are strong enough to dig holes big enough for them to sleep in and their grassy quills can harden for a short time to defend themselves.

entry: POKENAME背上长出的种子，可由专业园丁摘取。种下后，会长出味道奇特、带有苦味的树果。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME grows seeds on its back which can be plucked out by professional gardeners. When planted, they grow into berries with a strange, bitter taste.

entry: POKENAME很胆小，只在清晨钻出地面晒太阳。若早晨起风，它还会伸出叶片般的舌头，接住随风飘来的花粉。
author: sk372
source: A timid sort, POKENAME only comes up from underground during the early mornings to take in sunlight.  On windy mornings, it extends its leaf-like tongue out as well in order to catch pollen carried by the breeze.

entry: 清晨的阳光下，POKENAME的幽灵形体从种子里浮现，散出轻柔的暖意，滋养附近花朵。日落后，它就缩回种子，等到第二天再出来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's spectral form emerges from the seed during the morning sun, radiating a light warmth that nourishes nearby flowers. Once the sun sets, it retreats back into its seed until the next day.

entry: POKENAME喜欢待在阳光下，常一晒就是几个小时。它的大嘴能储存数升水，用来滋养头顶的芽。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoys spending time in the sun and is known to sunbathe for hours at a time. Its large mouth can store several liters of water, which it uses to nourish the sprout atop its head.

entry: POKENAME会在花田里吸收数小时的阳光。一下雨，就把背上的叶片拢成杯状，保证自己喝够水。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spend hours in flower fields absorbing sunlight. Whenever it rains, they form a cup with the leaves on their back to ensure they remain properly hydrated.

entry: POKENAME的毛孔里长着种子，遍布全身。这些种子吸收叶绿素，留下天然的深褐色，使它的体色变暗。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have darkened pigmentation because of the seeds in their pores that grow across their entire body. These seeds absorb chlorophyll and leave behind a naturally dark brown hue.

entry: POKENAME的皮肤会分泌油状毒素，接触紫外线后，能让人起严重的疹子。它乐得悠闲晒太阳，靠这天然的防御手段挡住打扰。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME secrete an oily toxin through their skin that causes a nasty rash when exposed to ultraviolet frequencies. They happily laze in the sun, content to rely on their natural defences to keep themselves from being disturbed.

entry: POKENAME见到什么花都着迷，几乎每天都要换掉头上种的花。它悉心照料土壤，让花健康生长，常顶着新找到的花，在田野里开心地跑来跑去。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is so fascinated by every flower it finds that it replaces the one growing on its head almost every day. It takes great care of the soil to keep its flowers healthy and can often be seen happily running through fields with its newest find.

entry: POKENAME常在池塘边休息，尽量多晒太阳，因为阳光对进化至关重要。日落后，它便藏进水下，免得与别的宝可梦争斗，浪费能量。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME tends to rest on the shores of ponds to absorb as much sunlight as possible, as it is essential for its evolution. After the sun sets, it hides underwater to avoid fighting other Pokémon and wasting energy.

entry: POKENAME的身体主要是一粒磨尖的种子。它用尖锐的边缘刺进其他宝可梦的血肉，扎下根，吸取对方的生命能量，直到能够进化。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME's body consists largely of a sharpened seed. They use this edge to plant themself into the flesh of a Pokémon and take root, feeding off of its life energy until they can evolve.

entry: 野生POKENAME会吸入、过滤并排出自己栖居游动的水。一旦养分不足，叶片状身体上鲜艳的颜色就开始暗淡。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME absorb, filter, and disperse the very water they live and swim in. If they ever run low on nutrients, the vivid colors of their leafy bodies begin to dull.

entry: POKENAME虽能用幻象吓退天敌，却不愿这样做。它靠信任他人和乐天的性格生存，相信训练家与宝可梦都会为自己着想。
author: riley_muir_qu33n_in_yellow
source: While they have the ability to use illusions to ward off predators, POKENAME choose not to. This Pokémon relies on their belief in others and sunny personality to survive, trusting that Trainers and Pokémon alike have their best interests in mind.

entry: POKENAME特别开心时，会释放数百粒种子，日后长成向日种子。在异地，这种行为可能让向日种子成为入侵物种。
author: dodoowner_
source: When POKENAME feels especially happy, it releases hundreds of seeds, which will eventually grow into Sunkern. In foreign regions, this behavior may introduce Sunkern as an invasive species.

entry: POKENAME的头才是真正的本体。下半身主要是泥土和石块，靠大量粗壮坚韧的根维系、操控。
author: infinex21
source: The head of a POKENAME is actually its main body. Its lower body is mostly dirt and rock held together, and controlled, by their many vast and tough roots.

entry: POKENAME大多时候站着不动，试图融入成片的黄花。它用头顶的叶片吸收阳光，为炮积蓄能量，再向威胁自己的事物射出明亮光束。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME stands motionless most of the time and tries to blend in among fields of yellow flowers. It absorbs sunlight with the leaves on its head to charge its cannon with energy, which it fires as bright beams at anything that threatens it.

entry: POKENAME只在清晨出来，靠初升的阳光获取养分。进行光合作用时，它向周围散出强烈热量，蒸干晨露。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME only comes out in the early morning, to bask in the first rays of the sunrise for nourishment. As it photosynthesizes, it radiates a strong warmth around it that evaporates the morning dew.

entry: POKENAME爱吃其他植物，尤其爱吃胡萝卜，也十分注意保持自己叶片状身体的清洁。遇袭时，它会撒出大团柔软叶片，遮住身影逃走。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME love to eat other plants, especially carrots, and take great care to keep their own leafy bodies clean. They will scatter thick plumes of their soft leaves to conceal themselves and flee when attacked.

entry: POKENAME吸收阳光，加快成长。积攒足够的太阳能后，它能将体温升到足以烧毁周围一切的程度。
author: sly.crook
source: POKENAME soaks up sun rays to expedite its growth. After absorbing enough solar energy, it can raise its temperature high enough to burn everything around it.

entry: POKENAME叶片状的鬃毛吸收阳光，使多条尾巴泛起光芒。它能利用阳光的能量与热度，产生温暖的火焰。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's many tails glow with the sunlight absorbed through their leafy manes. They can harness the power and heat of this sunlight to produce warm flames.

entry: POKENAME用卷须在土里挖洞播种。人们认为，它的触碰能改变土壤性质，使其完全适合所种的种子，尽量发挥生长潜力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its tendrils to dig out holes in the soil to plant seeds in. It's believed that its touch manipulates the properties of the soil to perfectly adapt to the seed it plants to maximize its potential growth.

entry: POKENAME坐在开阔的田野里吸收阳光。晒得越多，毛发发出的光就越亮。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME sits in open fields, absorbing sunlight. The more sunlight it takes in, the brighter its fur glows.

entry: POKENAME在土里挖坑，再盖上叶子捕捉猎物。可惜头顶的小芽会露出来，这招并没有它以为的那么好用。
author: pizzarcato
source: It creates a hole in the soil and covers it with leaves to trap prey. Unfortunately, the small sprout on top of its head pokes out, leaving this tactic less effective than POKENAME realizes.

entry: POKENAME不停地想要转身，却总被自己的藤蔓绊住。只有太阳升到最高处时，它才能转动身体；即使如此辛苦，也始终笑容不减。
author: misfit0521
source: POKENAME constantly tries to keep turning, but its vines continuously get in the way. Only when the sun is at its highest point does POKENAME turn - yet it never stops smiling through the struggle.

entry: POKENAME钻进土里，只为隐藏自己。若有人不慎踩到叶子，它便喷出火焰，烧得对方疼痛。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME digs itself into the ground to hide. If someone accidentally steps on its leaf, it emits a painful flame.

entry: POKENAME眼睛表面总覆着一层淡水泪膜，随时能哭出眼泪，给缺水的植物喝。它浑身毛发柔软，深色泪痕却永远留在了上面。
author: haypile
source: The surfaces of POKENAME's eyes are always covered with a thin layer of freshwater tears, and it can cry on command to share this water with needy plants. It is covered in soft fur which is permanently marked by its dark tear trails.

entry: 除了光合作用，POKENAME还会咀嚼小植物，补充养分。吃完后，花苞便张开，散播花粉，帮助附近的植物生长。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME chews on small plants to gain additional nutrients separate from its photosynthesis. Once it finishes eating, its bud opens up and spreads pollen that will aid plant growth in the area.

entry: 周围的人心怀怨恨或嫉妒时，POKENAME头上的芽就会变长。长到一定程度，它就会试图把那些人拖进向日葵田。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's sprout grows longer if the people around it hold grudges or envy. If this sprout grows long enough, it will attempt to drag those people into sunflower fields.

entry: POKENAME能判断天气、播种日期等农事信息，已经取代了农事历。它将根伸进土里，与植物类宝可梦交流，获取这些信息。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can determine weather forecasts, planting dates, and other farming data, which has allowed them to replace the almanac. They determine this information by sinking their roots into the soil to communicate with plant-based Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME把身上的藤蔓伸进地下，吸取养分。遇到威胁时，它会闭上眼睛，毫无预兆地爆炸。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME extends its body's vines underground to gather nutrients. If threatened, it shuts its eyes and explodes without warning.

entry: POKENAME用叶片状的翅膀翱翔，吸收阳光，让自己不觉疲倦。黎明时欢快的叫声，早已成了许多森林居民的天然闹钟。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME soar through the skies with their leafy wings, absorbing sunlight to keep themselves from tiring. Their cheerful cries at the break of dawn have long served as nature's alarm clocks for many living near forests.

entry: POKENAME夏季最活跃，整群一起在温暖的阳光下跳舞。它缓缓摇摆，耗能极少，还能让每片叶子都晒到太阳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are most active during the summer, with entire flocks of the Pokémon dancing together in the warm sunlight. Their slow, swaying dance expends very little energy and ensures that all of their leaves have time in the sun.

entry: POKENAME轻柔的双翼在田野间飞行时收集空气水分。旱月便化作细雨洒下，帮助其他草属性宝可梦的种子长大。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The wispy wings of POKENAME gather moisture from the air as they fly from field to field. In drier months, the water collected in their wings is showered out as soft rain, helping the seeds of other Grass-types grow to adulthood.

entry: POKENAME背上的黏液里生着微小的种子。这些种子极苦，常被磨成粉末，制成万能粉。
author: .izik
source: Tiny seeds grow within the slime on POKENAME's back. These seeds are extremely bitter and are often ground into dust to make Heal Powder.

entry: POKENAME背上裹着黏液的种子，偶尔会长出芳香的叶片。叶片晒干后，可用来制作便宜的饱腹薰香。
author: .izik
source: The ooze-covered seed on POKENAME's back occasionally sprouts fragrant leaves. When dried, the leaves are used to craft inexpensive Full Incense.

entry: POKENAME黏滑的尾巴末端有一粒种子，睡觉时也会吸收阳光。发怒时，它会将储存的能量化为破坏力惊人的龙息。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's slimy tail ends in a seed that absorbs sunlight as it sleeps. When angered, it channels this stored energy into a devastating Dragonbreath.

entry: 很少有什么比提醒POKENAME没有手更让它恼火。为了弥补这一点，它学会了用叶片抓东西。
author: haypile
source: Few things annoy a POKENAME more than being reminded it doesn't have hands. It learned to grasp with its leaves to compensate.

entry: POKENAME一动不动地吸收、储存阳光，却很难融入自己栖居的开阔田野。有谁靠近，它就猛攻对方，免得再受打扰。
author: wavypavy_1
source: By remaining in a motionless state, POKENAME absorbs and stores sunlight. It has trouble blending in with the open fields it occupies and lashes out when approached to deter further interruptions.

entry: 背上的种子已将主根深深扎入POKENAME本体。移除种子的尝试表明，它们各司其职：右侧种子负责辨路，左侧种子负责交流。
author: haypile
source: The seeds on its back have sunk their taproots deep into POKENAME's main body. Attempts at removal found that each seed maintains its own separate role: the right seed is responsible for navigation, while the left is responsible for communication.

entry: POKENAME忠诚听话，是很好的宠物。它早晨最活跃，主人得做好早起的准备，让它吸收朝阳，获取养分和能量。
author: sk372
source: Loyal and obedient, POKENAME makes for a good pet. Its most active in the mornings, so owners should be prepared to wake up early so it can soak in the sunrise for sustenance and energy.

entry: 难以安睡的宝可梦自然会被POKENAME吸引，而它也乐于接纳。睡在它背上的草床里，就能做个美梦。
author: haypile
source: Restless Pokémon are naturally drawn to POKENAME, who happily accommodates them. A Pokémon who sleeps in the bed of grass on POKENAME's back will have wonderful dreams.

entry: POKENAME背上的草床柔软清凉得不可思议。睡眠研究试验表明，在它背上打盹，或许能减轻炎症，进而延长寿命。
author: haypile
source: The bed of grass on POKENAME's back is surreally soft and cool. Sleep study trials suggested that succumbing to a snooze on POKENAME's back may be good for reducing inflammation and, by extension, increasing longevity.

entry: POKENAME头上的芽会释放成团的橙色孢子，散发着向日葵香气。大量吸入可能引发严重的肺部问题。
author: .izik
source: The sprout growing from POKENAME's head releases clouds of orange sunflower-scented spores. These can cause severe lung problems if inhaled in large quantities.

entry: POKENAME在安静的森林里吃野草。一被发现，就高速逃走，藏进空心树干。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME grazes on wild herbs in quiet forests. If spotted, it flees at high speeds and hides inside hollow logs.

entry: POKENAME尽量把时间都花在晒太阳上。吸收的太阳能越多，就越能用每天收集的树枝施展更多烟火技艺。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends as much time in the sunlight as it can. The more solar energy it absorbs, the more pyrotechnic feats it can perform with the twigs it gathers up each day.

entry: POKENAME在翅膀上收集露水，与叶片产生的毒粉混合。受到挑衅时，它就迅速抖动翅膀，把有毒的露水泼向敌人。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME collect dew on their wings, which mixes with the toxic powder that their leaves produce. When provoked, they rapidly shake their wings to splash this toxic dew on foes.

entry: POKENAME叶盘里的玉米晒热后会爆开，变成温热可口的点心。因此，它常被养在露天剧场。
author: lydiaprower8
source: The corn in POKENAME's pad warms up in the sun and pops to make a warm, tasty treat. POKENAME is usually kept at outdoor theatres because of this.

entry: POKENAME把种子装在头顶叶盘里，运到田间播种。夏初的庆典上，常能看见它跳舞。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME carry seeds in the pad on their heads to fields so they can be planted. They're often seen dancing at festivals held at the beginning of summer.

entry: 每只POKENAME都围绕着一粒种子成形，终生与之相伴。它为种子提供养分，种子则分享一部分光合作用产生的能量。这些种子非常结实、生命力强，农民很爱收集。
author: _pixelar_
source: Every POKENAME forms around a seed that it will host for its entire life. It provides the seed nutrients and the seed shares some energy created by photosynthesis. Farmers like to collect these seeds as they are very sturdy and resilient.

entry: 它最有效的防身本领，只有喷火。可这会耗掉POKENAME大量能量，因此，通常避免作战。
author: chorb33
source: Its only effective defense is fire, which it can emit. However, this drains POKENAME of a lot of energy, so it usually avoids combat.

entry: POKENAME在地下朝向阳处挖掘，需要大量阳光，才能让三个头保持精神。草属性宝可梦知道，有它洞口的地方就是进行光合作用的好位置。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME digs its way towards various sunny spots, needing large amounts of sunlight to keep its three heads energized. Grass Pokémon know that a POKENAME hole is a sign of a prime location for photosynthesis.

entry: POKENAME虽然长得像猫，举止却完全和向日种子一样。它喜欢一动不动地站着节省能量，又认不出露水以外的食物，常常饿肚子。
author: haypile
source: Despite POKENAME's feline appearance, its behavior is completely Sunkern-like. It likes to stand completely still to conserve energy, and it often goes hungry because it does not recognize anything other than dew as sustenance.

entry: POKENAME很好照料，喜欢懒洋洋地晒太阳，除了尾巴轻轻摆动，几乎一动不动。它很少需要喂食，大部分能量都来自照在身上的阳光。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are low-maintenance Pokémon that enjoy lounging in the sun, remaining motionless save for the gentle swish of their tail. They rarely need feeding and are able to get most of their energy from the sunlight on their body.

entry: POKENAME头痛时会到外面，彻底放空脑袋，让自己好受些。因此，常能看到它站着发呆，两眼空空。
author: haypile
source: When it gets a headache, POKENAME goes outside and clears its head completely to feel better. You'll often see POKENAME standing around with a perfectly vacant stare.

entry: 不论对方实际是什么性别，两只POKENAME面对面时，总会把彼此当成雄性。雌性会试着亲近对方，雄性则会发起游泳比赛。
author: haypile
source: Regardless of actual gender, two POKENAME facing each other will always assume the other POKENAME is male. Female POKENAME will try to cozy up to one another, while males will try to engage in swimming competitions.

entry: 建议饲养者让POKENAME多晒早晨的太阳，这能让它一整天都脾气平和。若光照不足，它就会整个傍晚闹脾气。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME owners are recommended to let it absorb as much morning sunlight as possible, as the solar rays keep its temper even for the day; too little light and it will throw tantrums all throughout the evening.

entry: POKENAME虽然体型不小，却十分虚弱。它用爪子钻进松软肥沃的田地，举起尾巴，为进化收集能量。
author: chorb33
source: Despite its size, POKENAME is very weak. It digs into soft, nutritious fields with its claws and raises its tail to gather energy for evolution.

entry: POKENAME的鳍肢由叶片变化而来。漂浮着让叶面正对阳光时，它最开心。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME's flipper is a modified leaf. It's happiest when it can float with that leaf perpendicular to the sun.

entry: POKENAME的四肢由缠绕的茎松松相连。若出拳过猛，甩掉了一条肢体，再长一条就是了。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME's limbs are loosely attached by twined stems. If it punches too hard and loses a limb, it will simply grow that limb back.

entry: 身上的螺旋纹引导POKENAME吸收阳光的热量。肌肉一暖和起来，它就迫不及待地挥动种皮保护着的拳头，向对手连连出拳。
author: haypile
source: The swirls on its body direct the absorption of heat from sunlight. When this heat warms its muscles, POKENAME starts eagerly dishing out punches with its seed-coat-protected fists.

entry: 没有什么比在向阳花园里睡一整天更让POKENAME开心。对于它所居花园生机盎然的原因，主流假说认为，它用精神力量将植物连成网络，像奇异的菌根网络一样促进交流。
author: haypile
source: Nothing pleases a POKENAME more than an all-day nap in a sunny garden. The leading hypothesis for its home gardens' vitality is that a POKENAME makes a psychic web connecting the plants, facilitating communication like a strange mycorrhizal network.

entry: POKENAME精心挑选最佳地点，挖坑种花或其他植物。栽好后，它用精神力量刺激花朵，悉心培育，帮助日后长得更好。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carefully picks out prime spots to dig holes for it to place flowers and other plants into. Once planted, it stimulates the flower with its psychic powers to nurture it and help improve its future growth.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，精神能量会在四周显现，映出梦中景象。它梦见的往往和白天所做的一样：为年幼的宝可梦营造花园。
author: haypile
source: When POKENAME sleeps, psychic energy manifests around it and displays the contents of its dreams. It usually dreams of the same thing it does all day -- creating gardens for younger Pokémon to enjoy.

entry: 它会在同一地区生活多年。第一年从播种开始营造花园，以堪比超级计算机的大脑，每天24小时掌握土壤状况和每株幼苗的需求，再慢慢教会花园自行茁壮生长。
author: haypile
source: It lives in the same region for years. In the first year, it starts a garden from seed, using its supercomputer brain to track the soil and the needs of every individual sprout 24 hours a day. Then it slowly teaches the garden to thrive on its own.

entry: POKENAME的一条肢体是一枚正在生长的花苞。它长大时，花苞也跟着长大；进化时，花苞也会一同变化。
author: bobosmith01
source: One of POKENAME's limbs is a growing bud. As POKENAME grows, so too does the bud. When it evolves, the bud transforms alongside it.

entry: POKENAME虚弱又怕火，看到自己尾尖的火焰也会吓一跳。不过，它还是会装出勇敢的模样。
author: haypile
source: Because POKENAME is weak and afraid of fire, seeing the flame at the end of its own tail startles it. It puts on a brave face, though.

entry: POKENAME早晨吸收的阳光越多，产生的水就越清澈爽口。下午，它喜欢照料需要滋养的植物。
author: sk372
source: The more sunlight POKENAME absorbs in the morning, the more clear and refreshing the water it produces is. It enjoys spending the afternoon tending to any plants that need nourishment.

entry: POKENAME用大嘴困住虫子，慢慢将它们溶解成养分，让头上的芽健康翠绿。它觉得自己和虫子是朋友，可要问虫子的意见，恐怕未必赞同。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME uses its gaping mouth to trap bugs, which slowly dissolve into nutrients that keep its sprout happy and verdant. It thinks it's friends with the bugs, but if you asked the bugs, they probably wouldn't agree.

entry: POKENAME张大的嘴里存着雨水，偶尔还有倒霉掉进去的虫子。嘴边呈褐色的个体生活在较阴凉的地区，性情更悠闲。
author: haypile
source: Its gaping mouth holds rainwater and occasionally an unfortunate bug that fell in. Brown-lipped POKENAME are found in shadier regions and have a more relaxed nature.

entry: POKENAME张大的嘴里存着雨水，偶尔还有倒霉掉进去的虫子。嘴边呈红色的个体往往会引来更多猎物，将它们溶解在深深的积水中。
author: haypile
source: Its gaping mouth holds rainwater and occasionally an unfortunate bug that fell in. Red-lipped POKENAME tend to attract more prey to dissolve in their watery depths.

entry: POKENAME自己也拿不定主意，究竟是坐在花箱里好，还是像海藻一样随水漂流好。仔细透过它头上深色的吸光部位看，或许会发现里面是空的。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME themselves aren't sure whether they'd prefer to sit in a flower box or drift like seaweed. If you peer closely through the dark sunlight absorbers on their heads, you might see they're hollow inside.

entry: POKENAME潜水时无法利用水中的二氧化碳，因此会自带气泡。浮出水面时，它将空气导入头上罐状的生态舱，同时呼出纯氧，浓得能让其他宝可梦头晕。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME can't use the CO2 in the water when it submerges, so it brings its own bubbles. When it breaches, it funnels surface air into its canister-like cranial terrariums while exhaling pure oxygen that can make other Pokémon dizzy.

entry: 小拳石双臂为这次融合开启了绝佳组合。POKENAME能移到最方便饮露的位置，也更易藏进地下。烈雀若来袭，就会被拳头“说服”改主意。
author: lutrax
source: This fusion marks the start of a great combination in the wild. With Geodude arms, POKENAME can move to the best spot for its dew-based diet, and better hide into the ground. If attacked by a Spearow, POKENAME will punch a change of mind into it.

entry: 向日拳石以水和阳光为生，POKENAME却开始吃石头和泥土，强化外壳。它常从山丘上啃出凹洞，夜里便和同伴钻进去休息。
author: bobosmith01
source: While Sundude consumes water and light, POKENAME has begun eating rocks and dirt as well in order to harden its outer shell. Most frequently, it eats spots out of hills, which is where it and its brethren will burrow for the night.

entry: POKENAME常爬上山顶，尽量靠近太阳。也喜欢雨水渗进皮肤裂缝。体内植物长大后，便必须蜕去岩石外皮。
author: lutrax
source: POKENAME regularly climbs to mountaintops in order to be as close as possible to the sun. This Pokémon also loves rainy days as the water drips through the cracks in its skin. As the plant system within it grows, POKENAME must shed its rocky skin.

entry: POKENAME在阳光明媚的草甸和平原上嬉戏。它性情温顺，很适合骑术初学者和孩子。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME frolic in sun-kissed meadows and plains. Their gentle temperaments make them a great Pokémon for novice equestrians and children alike.

entry: POKENAME从不活动，因此不觉疲倦；又只有小小的植物脑袋，感觉不到痛苦，所以总是很开心。它喜欢住在河边，下雨时会咕咕轻鸣。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME is always happy because it never feels exhaustion due to never moving, and never feels suffering thanks to only having a tiny plant brain. It coos during the rain and loves living near rivers.

entry: POKENAME走到哪里，都在背上的小提袋里装着幼苗。它用长藤绕住壳，固定提袋，慢慢穿过森林或在湖中游泳。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME carry seedlings wherever they go in a little tote on their back. They wrap long vines around their shell to keep the tote in place as they shuffle through forests and swim in lakes.

entry: POKENAME为了吸收更多水，把尾巴变成根，伸入地下深处。需要搬动它时，可以放心摘下尾巴，它会再长一条。摘下的尾巴可能受精神力量影响，变成独立的植物。
author: haypile
source: In order to take up more water, POKENAME transformed its tail into roots to reach deeper into the ground. If you need to move it, you can safely detach its tail; it can grow a new one. The detached tail may psychically mutate into its own plant.

entry: POKENAME的三个身体顶部毛茸茸，其余部分都像种皮一样坚硬。富含铁的绒毛能帮助储存电荷，用来发动电击。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME's three bodies are fuzzy on top, but as hard as seed coats otherwise. The iron-rich fuzz helps it hold a charge which it utilizes to dish out electric attacks.

entry: POKENAME拿着的树枝能增强它的力量。谁想抢树枝，它就啄谁，只是圆钝的喙啄起来，并不比橡胶鞋打一下疼多少。
author: haypile
source: The branch a POKENAME holds amplifies its power. It will try to peck anyone who wants to steal its branch, but its rounded bill doesn't hurt much worse than a rubber clog.

entry: POKENAME拿着的树枝能增强它的力量。傻乎乎的笑容说明它心情平和，但若想抢走它最爱的树枝，据说它皱眉的模样会令人不安。
author: haypile
source: The branch a POKENAME holds amplifies its power. Its goofy grin is a good indicator of its peaceful mood, until you try to steal its favorite branch, in which case its frown is reportedly unsettling.

entry: POKENAME一个头开始犯傻时，另一个就会轻啄它的叶子以示提醒。可惜两个头都不太聪明，看起来就像整天都在梳理羽毛。
author: haypile
source: When one of POKENAME's heads starts doing something stupid, the other will peck its leaves in gentle warning. Since POKENAME overall isn't very bright, this makes it seem like it's constantly preening.

entry: POKENAME总有一个头在睡觉，似乎光合作用产生的能量不足以让三个头同时清醒。身体本能存下大量能量，可它一攒到就拿去跑步了。
author: haypile
source: One of POKENAME's heads is always sleeping. It seems it doesn't get enough energy from photosynthesis to keep all three heads online at once. Its body could store lots of energy, but it uses that energy up for running as soon as it collects any.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在水泥上腐蚀出洞，接触下面的土壤。它的酸液和酶似乎专为此用，对有机物几乎不起作用。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME loves to melt holes in cement to reach the soil underneath. Its acids and enzymes seem to be specialized for this purpose, and they hardly work at all on organic material.

entry: POKENAME嘴里护着一株幼苗，会尽一切努力保护它。它向食草宝可梦投掷黄色的毒污泥球，免得对方咬上一口。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME carry a seedling within their mouths and will do everything within their power to protect it. They toss yellow balls of toxic sludge towards herbivorous Pokémon to discourage them from taking a bite.

entry: POKENAME故意往携带的土壤里灌大量水，让栽种的花茁壮成长。多余的水会由花朵猛烈喷出。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME purposefully deluge the soil they carry with water to ensure that the flowers they carry can grow big and strong. The flowers spray out any excess water in powerful bursts.

entry: POKENAME以为自己能隐身，常抖动叶子制造沙沙声，假装是捣蛋的幽灵。可惜这只是它的幻想，鲜亮的黄色身体总是一眼就能看见。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME thinks it can become invisible, and often shakes its leaves to make rustling noises, pretending it's a poltergeist. Unfortunately, it's delusional -- its bright yellow coloration is always easy to see.

entry: POKENAME喜欢阳光与阴影各占一半的地方。虽然常待在原地节省能量，它对靠近者却很友善。
author: honestly_vitali
source: POKENAME prefer places that get equal sun and shade. While they often stay in one place to conserve energy, they are friendly to those who come near.

entry: 沉睡的POKENAME在地下稍一翻动，整片山坡就可能毫无预兆地移动。它待过的土地会一年比一年肥沃，因此农民常标记它的休息地点。
author: jaminmcready
source: Entire hillsides have shifted without warning when a sleeping POKENAME stirs beneath the soil. Farmers often mark its resting places, as the land left behind grows richer and more fertile each season.

entry: 少许POKENAME的孢子就能催人入睡，但依赖这种助眠方式的人，可能无法克制地想晒太阳，以致晒伤。有人正游说将这些孢子列为管制物质。
author: haypile
source: A sprinkle of POKENAME's spores can put you to sleep, but people who become dependent on this sleep aid may develop uncontrollable urges to bask in sunbeams, causing sunburns. Lobbyists want to make POKENAME spores a controlled substance.

entry: POKENAME不催眠别人时，就自己打盹。找不到向阳处，它便用精神力量移走云朵或屋顶等障碍。
author: haypile
source: When POKENAME isn't putting others to sleep, it's taking naps of its own. If POKENAME can't find a sunny spot, it uses its psychic powers to remove obstacles like clouds or roofs.

entry: POKENAME身上的条纹分散对手的注意，让对方察觉不到自己正在被催眠。陷入恍惚的人和宝可梦，随后会被温和地引导着离开，不再打扰它。
author: haypile
source: The stripes on POKENAME's body distract its opponents from noticing that they're being put into a trance. Entranced people and Pokémon are then gently directed to leave POKENAME alone.

entry: POKENAME像钟摆般晃动的花扭得太厉害，没法让人一直盯着看。不过，它本来也不是靠这招催眠。真正该提防的是孢子。
author: haypile
source: The flower it swings like a pendulum twists too much to entrain the eye, but that's not how POKENAME hypnotizes you anyway. It's the spores you have to watch out for.

entry: POKENAME靠光合作用获取能量，再静止不动地节省能量。只有天敌靠近时，它才会行动，用钳子保护自己。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME performs photosynthesis to get energy and stays still to preserve it. POKENAME do not move unless a predator comes close, in which case POKENAME uses their pincers to defend themselves.

entry: 没吃过POKENAME的肉，可能想不到它的味道更像根茎蔬菜，而非甲壳类。钳子虽能再生，它在被采肉时可不会乖乖配合，小心那强大的咬合力。
author: haypile
source: If you've never had POKENAME meat, you may be surprised that it tastes more like a root vegetable than a crustacean. The claws grow back, but POKENAME isn't docile during harvesting -- beware its bite force.

entry: POKENAME背上的球茎里，花朵已经发育完整，却还不够成熟，无法绽放。它会晒太阳、尽量多吃，加快成长。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a fully developed flower in the bulb on their back but are not yet mature enough to bloom. They bask in the sunlight and eat as much as they can to speed up their growth.

entry: POKENAME主要靠树叶和阳光维生。可阳光最充足的地方往往没多少叶子，让它很难兼顾两种食物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have two main sources of food: leaves and sunlight. They often struggle to balance their diet because the places with the brightest sunlight do not have many leaves.

entry: POKENAME的各个花头分享吸收的阳光，因此个个都同样鲜艳欢快。在一些海岛地区，送人一只POKENAME被视为浪漫的示爱。
author: sk372
source: Sharing sunlight as they absorb it means every flower head on POKENAME is always as vibrant and jubilant as the rest. Gifting someone a POKENAME is considered a romantic gesture in some island regions.

entry: 随着年龄增长，无论晒多少太阳，POKENAME曾经鲜艳的花瓣都会渐渐暗淡。它是老年人之间颇受欢迎的礼物。
author: mistymagius
source: As POKENAME gets older, its once vibrant petals will start to grow dull no matter how much sun they get. POKENAME tend to be popular gifts amongst elderly communities.

entry: 看看骨棒上的芽，就能大致判断POKENAME是否健康。健康个体的芽挺拔而结实。
author: mepp.
source: One can judge the general health of POKENAME by looking at the sprout growing on its bone club. A healthy POKENAME has its sprout standing firm and tall.

entry: POKENAME头上过分茂盛的花吸收阳光，为代谢提供能量，却也挡住视线，让它不停地跑，直到撞上东西才停下。
author: infinex21
source: The overgrown flower upon POKENAME's head absorbs sunlight to fuel their metabolisms. This flower also obscures their sight, causing them to run about without stopping until they collide with something.

entry: 野生POKENAME开心地跺步行走时，常会引起轻微震动。它能将种子般的角大力射向对手。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME often cause small tremors as they happily stomp about. They can fire their seed-like horns at opponents with powerful force.

entry: POKENAME在向阳处生长旺盛。它能量近乎无穷，身体又温暖，人们怀疑许多微生物住在它的藤蔓下，甚至会攻击病毒，帮助它保持健康。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME thrives in sunny areas. Due to its near-boundless supply of energy and warm body, it is suspected that many microorganisms make nests under its vines and may even help POKENAME by attacking viruses.

entry: POKENAME探出水面，向附近地面喷水，希望帮助植物生长。家园四周鲜花盛开时，它最开心。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME pokes above the water's surface and spits streams of water at the ground nearby, hoping to help plant life grow. POKENAME is at its happiest when its home is surrounded by blooming flowers.

entry: POKENAME扇动花瓣般的翅膀，在空中寻找最适合休息的枝头。它一天大半时间都待在高枝上晒太阳。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME flutter through the air with their petal-like wings to find the best branches to rest in. They spend much of their day basking in the sunlight from branches high above the ground.

entry: POKENAME多肉的身体像一枚果实，却散发着浓浓的葵花籽油味。它不断分泌这种油，靠强效防晒作用，连正午灼热的阳光也能尽情享受。这种油很受游客追捧。
author: ocxin
source: Its meaty body looks like a fruit, but it smells heavily of sunflower oil. POKENAME secretes it constantly as a powerful sun protective, allowing it to soak in even boiling midday sunlight, making the oil a sought-after item for tourists.

entry: 有时会看到POKENAME从背后伸出茎，将自己固定在地上。它静静吸收阳光和养分，增强精神力量与飘浮能力。
author: ocxin
source: POKENAME can sometimes be seen with extended stems from their back that anchor them to the ground. They quietly take in sunlight and nutrients to empower their psychic powers and levitation.

entry: POKENAME体内充满太阳能，能长时间工作，帮助人们栽培植物。从修剪造型树到照料花园，需要园艺帮手时，它都很受欢迎。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are brimming with solar energy and can work long hours to help people cultivate plants. From topiary cuttings to gardens, POKENAME are a popular choice for people needing help with horticulture.

entry: POKENAME晒足阳光便会变色。有些甚至燃烧起来，它们却乐在其中。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME change color when exposed to lots of sunlight. Some may even burst into flames, but they enjoy this.

entry: POKENAME将一颗仿造的太阳高举过头。它能收集光线，恰好集中照在POKENAME的头顶。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME holds a faux sun high above their head. It collects light and concentrates it perfectly down upon their head.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在开阔向阳的田野奔跑，对人类通常脾气很好。只有与同类争夺晒太阳的好位置、互相顶撞时，才会变得好斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys wide open, sunlit fields to run around in, and maintains a relatively easy disposition among humans. The only time it gets aggressive is when butting heads over a prime spot for absorbing sunlight with a rival POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME靠近水面游动，尽量多吸收阳光。可惜这也让众多天敌更容易捕到它。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME swims close to the surface so it can absorb more sunlight. Unfortunately, this also makes them easier prey for their many predators.

entry: 它们生活在茂密的森林或丛林里，身体盘成一团，周围开满草花。太阳一被云遮住，就会暴怒，疯狂扭动身体。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon live within lush forests or jungles, coiled around themselves with grass flowers growing all around them. When the sun is covered by clouds, they fly into a thrashing rage.

entry: 接触特定的进化石后，POKENAME尾巴上的叶片会变化。野生个体常见于空旷田野、花园和农田，哪里养分丰富、阳光充足，它就往哪里去。
author: infinex21
source: Their tail leaves change when they are exposed to specific evolutionary stones. Wild POKENAME are a common sight in open fields, gardens, and farmlands. They will go wherever they can find rich nutrients and bathe in bright sunlight.

entry: POKENAME用尾尖的大叶片吸收、储存水分，再像出汗般分泌出来，让绿色皮肤泛起水光。阳光明媚时，它喜欢漂在水上。
author: infinex21
source: Water is absorbed and stored with the large leaves at the tips of their tails. Their green hides glisten with the stored water that they secrete like sweat. POKENAME love to float in water when the sun is shining bright.

entry: POKENAME利用阳光获取养分、产生电力，储存在鲜黄色的花瓣里。花瓣被用于许多缓解麻痹的药物，以及一些药用兴奋剂。
author: infinex21
source: They metabolize sunlight to acquire nutrients and to generate electricity, which is stored in their vibrantly yellow petals. POKENAME petals are used in many anti-paralytic remedies and in some medicinal stimulants.

entry: POKENAME叶片状的身体柔软温暖，长着无数种子。尾巴般的花苞张开时，会撒出种子，露出里面柔和的火焰。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have leafy bodies that are soft, warm, and lined with myriad seeds. When their tail-like buds open, they scatter seeds and reveal a gentle flame within.

entry: 住进电脑后，POKENAME只靠阳光就能为电脑持续供电。这时，它还会散发淡淡的花香。
author: .izik
source: While inhabiting a computer, POKENAME can keep it powered by sunlight alone. During this time, it emits a gentle floral aroma.

entry: POKENAME成群聚在向阳的海滩休息。背上的大壳能吸收阳光，遇到威胁时便化为强力的日光束射出。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME gather in large groups on sunny beaches to rest. The large shell on its back can take in sunlight and release it in a powerful Solar Beam if it feels threatened.

entry: POKENAME只吃削过皮的西葫芦，像吸面条一样慢慢吸进嘴里。若给它没削皮的，它就夸张地叹口气，扔到一边。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME will only eat a peeled courgette, slurping it slowly into its mouth like a noodle. If given an unpeeled one, it tosses it aside with a dramatic sigh.

entry: 据说冬去春来、百花初绽时，POKENAME会飞过，带走积雪。它生活在寒冷却阳光充足的地方。
author: bobosmith01
source: As winter turns to spring, POKENAME is said to fly by, taking the snow with it as the first flowers bloom. It lives in cold areas that nevertheless have plenty of sunlight.

entry: POKENAME靠光合作用获取能量，庞大的身体所需甚多。因此，它们成群追逐太阳，大多数野生个体从未置身黑暗。
author: mcnchsschl
source: POKENAME photosynthesizes its energy from the sun, and its large body requires a lot. This leads them to flock together and follow the sun, and most wild POKENAME have never been in darkness.

entry: 阴天时，POKENAME用神秘的气息围住自己，驱散云层，让阳光照进来。农民自古就把它的出现视为丰收的预兆。
author: mepp.
source: On cloudy days, POKENAME surrounds itself with a mystical aura to clear the skies and let in the sun. Farmers have long regarded the presence of this Pokémon as a sign of a plentiful harvest.

entry: POKENAME性情开朗，最爱晒夏日太阳。营养丰富的鳞片掉落后，还能帮助植物生长。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are cheery Pokémon who love to bask in the summer sun. Its nutrient-rich scales can help plants grow when they fall off.

entry: POKENAME在世界各地飘游，寻找阳光最充足的地方。吸收阳光时，它散出精神波动，让波动所及之处的人与宝可梦心生喜悦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats around the world, seeking out the sunniest spots it can. As its body takes in sunlight, it radiates a psychic pulse that causes a feeling of joy in those the wave washes over.

entry: 这种罕见的融合体只在晴朗的夏日出现。POKENAME飘上高空，吸收大量太阳能，在下方的人看来，仿佛第二颗太阳。
author: pizzarcato
source: This rare fusion is only seen on bright summer days. When POKENAME floats high in the sky, it absorbs enough solar energy to appear as a second sun to observers below.

entry: POKENAME将光合作用多得的太阳能存进头顶花中。性情乐观，晴日尤其开心。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME stores excess solar energy from photosynthesis in the flower on its head. It is a very positive Pokémon and seems to be especially cheery on sunny days.

entry: 春夏时，POKENAME会散发舒缓的香气，让疲倦者振奋，让焦虑者平静。它脱落的花瓣被一些昂贵的香水品牌采用。
author: greaterjagras
source: During the spring and summer months, POKENAME release a calming aroma that energize the weary and calm the anxious. Shedded petals from POKENAME have been used in expensive perfume brands.

entry: POKENAME伪装成睡莲叶，在沼泽中漂流，也让其他宝可梦歇在背上。谁威胁它的家园，它就破水而出，死死咬住对方，拖入水下施展死亡翻滚。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME drifts through swamps camouflaged as lily pads and allows other Pokémon to rest on its back. When someone threatens its home, it bursts from the water, clamps its jaws on the threat, and "death rolls" them under the water.

entry: POKENAME一动不动地站在向日葵田中，完美融入花草，躲避天敌。一旦被发现，就高速蹦跳着逃走。
author: dodoowner_
source: It stands motionless in sunflower fields, camouflaging seamlessly with the flora to avoid predators. Should POKENAME be spotted, it bounces away at high speeds.

entry: 需要深入思考时，POKENAME会正对太阳，尽量增强思考能力。可若一直想过了日落，思路就会全断掉，只能第二天从头再来。
author: soup1900
source: When needing to go deep into thought, POKENAME will position itself directly at the sun to maximize its thinking power. However, if this mental focus continues on past sunset, it will lose all train of thought and must start over the next day.

entry: POKENAME用叶片状的翅膀无声起飞。它只在有阳光时活动，借阳光的能量让动作更灵敏。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME takes flight with its leafy wings, it moves without making a sound. It only moves when the sun is shining, using its light as a source of power to move more nimbly.

entry: POKENAME双臂如炮，能射出种子。它飞过农场上方，对任何可能危害庄稼的东西，都会开火。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME have the ability to fire seeds from their arms like cannons. They fly above farmsteads, firing at anything that may be a threat to the crops.

entry: POKENAME一天大半时间都在高空飞行，用四只翅膀吸收阳光。攒够后，翅膀上的花瓣便能放出明亮光芒，与花朵分享阳光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flies up high for most of the day, absorbing sunlight into its four wings.  Once it has absorbed enough, it can shine the petals on its wings brightly and share the sunlight with flowers.

entry: POKENAME鲜亮的黄绿色翅膀，让它飞行时能尽量多收集太阳能。受伤后，它会爬到树冠下洒着阳光的地方，迅速恢复。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have bright chartreuse wings that maximize the solar energy they collect while flying. When injured, they crawl to sunny spots under a leafy canopy to quickly recover.

entry: POKENAME沿海底行走，即使到了深水，花朵状的触角也明亮发光。那光乍看像阳光，其实来自体内流动的强大电流。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME walk along the seabed, their flower-like antennae shining brightly even in deep waters. Although their light looks to be sunlight at first, they are actually produced by the strong electricity flowing within their bodies.

entry: POKENAME在海底游动，照亮其他水生植物，帮助它们进行光合作用，维系海中的植物群落。
author: fxncy_poland
source: POKENAME swims around the ocean floor and shines light on other aquatic plants. This helps them photosynthesise and aids in maintaining the ocean flora.

entry: POKENAME生活在旷野花丛里，脸和花瓣始终朝向太阳。它被认为很孤傲，受到惊吓时会释放自身的能量。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live in open fields amidst flowers, with their own faces and petals always aimed toward the sun. They are considered very aloof and discharge their own energy when startled.

entry: POKENAME的羊毛在阳光下储存太阳能，夜里睡觉时，这些能量会发出光芒。
author: firstromaniandiscoerd
source: The wool of a POKENAME stores solar energy in the sunlight. This solar energy glows while it sleeps at night.

entry: POKENAME草叶般的羽毛富含养分，以疗愈功效闻名。不过，若未等自然脱落就摘下，羽毛几乎立刻就会枯萎。
author: infinex21
source: The many grass-like feathers of a POKENAME are renowned for their curative properties due to the rich nutrients they contain. However, if one is picked before it is shed, it will nearly instantly wilt.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴散发温暖光芒，性质与阳光相近。美黑沙龙、温室等商家开始用它提供人造阳光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tail radiates a warm glow with properties not unlike those of the sun's rays. Tanning salons and greenhouses, among other businesses, have begun using them to provide artificial sunlight.

entry: 明亮的阳光照在POKENAME身上，热能会让花朵旋转，带着它直直升空。据说这时，它感受到的只有纯粹的喜悦。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: When bright sunlight shines down on POKENAME, the heat energy makes its flower spin, lifting it straight into the air. It is said that the feeling it experiences at these times is pure joy.

entry: 从黎明到黄昏，POKENAME乘风穿行整个地区，尽量多吸收阳光，再把能量分享给沿途遇见的花，帮助它们茁壮生长。
author: oejoeboy33
source: From dawn to dusk, POKENAME rides the winds across the region, absorbing as much sunlight as it can. It spreads this energy into all flowers it comes across, helping them thrive.

entry: 野生POKENAME虽然很容易融入花丛，却胆小得有东西靠近就会迅速逃走。白天，头周围的花瓣会微微发光。
author: infinex21
source: Although wild POKENAME can easily blend in with flowers, they are so skittish that they will quickly flee if anything gets close to them. The petals around their heads glow faintly during the day.

entry: POKENAME吸收大量太阳能，可以分享给附近任何生物。农民把它视为福气，总是热情欢迎它来到田里。
author: jangodiot
source: Energy from the sun is absorbed in enormous quantities from POKENAME, allowing it to transfer that energy to any nearby organism. Farmers welcome this Pokémon into their fields with open arms, as they view it as a blessing.

entry: 吸收太阳能后，POKENAME的头迅速长大，身体却跟不上。因此，它常拖着蜷成一团的身体挪动，吃力地支撑过大的脑袋。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's head grows rapidly as it absorbs solar energy, but its body lags behind. As a result, it is often seen shuffling along in a heap, struggling to support the weight of its oversized head.

entry: 吸收太阳能后，POKENAME的头迅速长大，身体却跟不上。因此，它常拖着蜷成一团的身体挪动，吃力地支撑过大的脑袋。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's head grows rapidly as it absorbs solar energy, but its body lags behind. As a result, it is often seen shuffling along in a heap, struggling to support the weight of its oversized head.

entry: POKENAME的花瓣吸收日光，身体上的圆环吸收月光，因此能量充沛，每天只需睡一个多小时。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's petals absorb sunlight while the rings on its body absorb moonlight. This gives it an abundance of energy; it's known to only sleep a little over an hour a day.

entry: 本体努力保持严肃，背上的向日花怪却总边晒太阳边开心地笑。向日花怪常会戳戳本体，想逗它笑，可本体很少买账。
author: sk372
source: The main body tries to be serious, while the Sunflora on its back is always smiling and chipper as it absorbs sunlight. Often the Sunflora will prod and poke the body in order to get it to crack a smile, which it rarely does.

entry: POKENAME偏爱坚果和树皮。它将尾巴钻进地里，吸取水和养分，同时用花瓣吸收阳光。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME favor hard nuts and tree bark as food. They burrow their tails into the ground to absorb water and nutrients while also absorbing sunlight through their petals.

entry: POKENAME戴着一串神奇的蔓莓果项链。果实熟透时，捏破就能带来好运；可若尚未成熟或熟过了头，它就会诅咒捏果子的人，带来一点小小的厄运。
author: firstromaniandiscoerd
source: POKENAME wears a magical Razz berry necklace around its neck, which gives luck when popped when it is fully ripe. However, when unripe or overripe, POKENAME will hex the popper with very minor bad luck.

entry: POKENAME花朵状的尾巴看似无辜，却总向头低语，出着残忍的主意。头一边痛苦地哭，一边攻击，无论如何都会照着尾巴的心意做。轻信它的人正是下手的好目标。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME's flower tail acts innocent, but whispers cruel advice to the head. The head cries in distress as it attacks, but it carries out the whims of its tail no matter what. Those who trust it too easily are perfect targets for POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME醒着时，总开心地在阳光下奔跑。兴奋时它会摇尾巴，越兴奋，尾巴的笑容就越大。尾巴上的眼睛从不眨动。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME spends its waking hours happily running in the sunlight. When excited, POKENAME wags its tail, which grins wider as its excitement increases. The tail's eyes never blink.

entry: POKENAME夜里合上壳，白天打开，尽情吸收阳光。攒够光能后，它会爆炸，撒出种子，瞬间长成大片花田。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME keeps its shell closed at night but opens it during the day to soak up sunlight. Once it absorbs enough light, it explodes and scatters seeds that propagate into enormous flower patches in an instant.

entry: POKENAME在向阳的树林里蹦跳，把树汁从一棵树涂到另一棵，与同伴分享。它讨厌用角自卫，因为会弄乱角周围叶片的排列。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME bounds about in sunny groves, smearing sap from one tree to the next to share it with others. It detests using its horn in self-defense, as it messes up the arrangement of leaves surrounding it.

entry: POKENAME脸上会产生甜蜜的花蜜，它会舔食滴到爪子上的蜜。它总追着阳光走，到了夜里便不再产蜜。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a sweet nectar from their face and lick the liquid that drips onto their paws. It is known to chase after sunlight and stops producing nectar at night.

entry: POKENAME非常友善，虽然不易消化蜂蜜，却很爱吃。它喜欢晒太阳，靠光合作用帮助消化食物。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME are very friendly Pokémon who love eating honey, despite having a hard time digesting it. They enjoy sunbathing, which enable POKENAME to photosynthesise and digest its food.

entry: POKENAME一天大半时间都懒洋洋地晒太阳，只偶尔挪动，保持花朵朝向阳光。夜里反倒更活跃，会寻找富含矿物质的石头吃，滋养自己的土壤。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are content to spend most of the day lazing in the sunlight, only moving periodically to ensure their flower is still facing toward the light. They grow more active at night, seeking out mineral rich rocks to feed on to nurture their soil.

entry: POKENAME住在休眠火山的山坡，吃凝灰岩矿层，强化外壳。壳里矿物质丰富，十分适合新植物发芽，成群的它们就像移动的草甸。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live on the flanks of dormant volcanoes, feeding on tuff deposits to strengthen their shells. The high mineral content of their shells makes them ideal for new plant life to sprout, with clusters of POKENAME looking like moving meadows.

entry: POKENAME在花田上空翱翔，用沿翅膀生长的花朵吸收阳光。向日种子一看到它，就蜂拥而来，攀住翅膀下方，吃上面沾着的花粉。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME soar high above flower fields, the flowers along their wings taking in sunlight. Swarms of Sunkern flock to these Pokémon when they spot them, clinging to the undersides of their wings to feed on the pollen stuck to them.

entry: 有趣的是，POKENAME反靠月光获取能量，每夜都找一片新空地晒月亮。到了日出时，便已攒够能量，用大字爆炎吓退威胁。
author: ghostslythe
source: Ironically, POKENAME gain energy from lunar radiation and each night find a new clearing to bask in the moonlight. By sunrise, they have stored enough energy to scare off threats with Fire Blast.

entry: POKENAME藏在靠近海面的海带丛里，多吸收些阳光。它出奇地好斗，会向闯进海带丛的家伙吐出滚烫的墨汁泡泡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides among kelp gardens that float near the ocean's surface where it can gather more sunlight. It is surprisingly aggressive and will spit extremely hot ink bubbles at those that invade its kelp.

entry: POKENAME总带着灿烂表情，欢快地迎接电脑用户。不少人觉得笑容背后藏着邪恶、空洞的东西，但多数人认为，这只是疑神疑鬼的传言。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME greets computer users with a bright expression and a cheery disposition. Many believe something sinister and soulless lies behind the smile, though most have determined the belief to be simply paranoid rumors.

entry: POKENAME吸收电脑里的数字信息与代码获取能量，这个过程称为“码合作用”。必须有人看管这个过程，因为已有广为人知的例子，POKENAME的性情因此变得厌恶人类。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME gathers energy by absorbing digitally-written information and lines of code in computers, a process called codexynthesis. This process must be watched over, as there are well-known cases of POKENAME's personality turning misanthropic.

entry: 白天，POKENAME在草甸上奔驰，始终面朝太阳。盯着它的脸太久，会失明数小时，随后视力才渐渐恢复。
author: andromeda102037
source: POKENAME can be found galloping across grassy meadows in the daylight, always facing towards the sun. Those who stare into POKENAME's face for too long go blind for a few hours before their vision gradually returns.

entry: POKENAME常陪孤独、悲伤的人走过最黑暗的时光。据说，它的画能让生活重新有了色彩。
author: inksans201x
source: POKENAME often accompany the lonely and sad through their darkest times. Their paintings are said to bring color back into one's life.

entry: POKENAME躁动又难以预测的举止，让许多人不安。它会损伤自己的花朵，取得作画用的汁液。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME's restless and erratic behavior disturbs many. It damages its own flowers to create the sap it paints with.

entry: POKENAME常成群一起旋转，将阳光化为能量。它们结队寻找更多阳光，彼此分享能量；夜幕降临，就合上花瓣，扎根地面。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME are often seen in groups, spinning together, converting sunlight into energy. They move in herds in search of more sunlight, sharing energy with one another. When night falls, they close their petals and root themselves in the ground.

entry: POKENAME是一种非常欢快的蛇宝可梦，总在寻找热源，尤其喜欢阳光。晒不到太阳时，就紧紧缠住附近的人或宝可梦，分享对方的温暖。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a very jubilant serpent Pokémon always searching for heat sources, particularly sunlight. When sunlight is not easily available, it will coil around nearby people or Pokémon, embracing them tightly to share in their warmth.

entry: POKENAME用叶片状的藤蔓吸水，能滤去一切污染物。水分和养分充足，草叶般的鬃毛常泛着亮光。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME drink water through their leafy vines, capable of filtering out any pollutants. Their grassy manes are often shimmering from how well-nourished and watered they are.

entry: POKENAME挑向阳处晒太阳，既强化外壳，又加快进化。天气越明媚温暖，它脸上开心的笑容就越大。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME picks out sunny spots to bask in, the sunlight helping to strengthen its shell as well as expedite its evolution. The brighter and warmer the day, the bigger the joyous smile on POKENAME's face.

entry: POKENAME常待在山中住处外，大量吸收阳光。许多个体会在山壁凿洞，让洞穴里也有能晒太阳的地方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are most often seen outside their mountain dwellings, absorbing massive amounts of sunlight. Many carve holes in the walls of the mountains so that even within the caverns, there are still spots to bask in the sun's rays.

entry: 早晨，有些山地宝可梦一听到急促沉重的脚步就躲起来。这些跺步声通常来自兴奋的POKENAME，正急匆匆跑出来晒太阳。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: In the morning, some mountainous Pokémon hide when they hear rapid, heavy footsteps. These stomps are usually the sound of excited POKENAME, who eagerly rush out to bask in sunlight.

entry: POKENAME性格开朗，外形可爱，在宠物饲养者中口碑很好。有些地区甚至举行只有它参加的选美比赛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's happy disposition and adorable features have garnered it quite a positive reputation among pet owners. Some regions even hold beauty competitions solely featuring POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME下半身像盆才怪一样由岩石构成，仿佛一个储水的花盆，让草叶构成的上半身不至于干枯。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have rocky lower halves reminiscent of a Bonsly. Their lower halves are like pots that store water to keep their grassy upper halves from drying out.

entry: POKENAME鲜亮的黄色花瓣储存电力，电量过多时就会脱落。等待花瓣重新长出时，它会更有攻击性，不过这些花瓣对许多人都很有价值。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's bright, yellow petals contain its electricity and are shed when it stores too much. Although it becomes more aggressive while waiting for its petals to regrow, these petals are valuable for many people.

entry: POKENAME常坐在大花园里，边唱歌边吃周围的植物。虽然它几乎总是乐呵呵的，可一吃光附近的花，就开始哭。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is usually seen sitting among large flower gardens, singing and snacking on the plants around it. Though almost always keeping a sunny disposition, it starts crying once it's eaten all the flowers nearby.

entry: POKENAME借体内微生态加速培育茴香籽，再用臂炮发射。它吸收阳光产出一批种子，然后向对手密集射去。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shoots fennel seeds from its arm cannon by accelerating growth in its microbiome. It absorbs sunlight to produce a batch of seeds before releasing a flurry of them toward its opponent.

entry: 民间传说，在天空中看到POKENAME，就能迎来一整年的好运。有阳光时，它能连续飞行数小时而不疲倦。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to folklore, spotting this Pokémon in the sky brings a year of good fortune. When the sun shines, POKENAME can fly for hours without tiring.

entry: 一晒到太阳，POKENAME就欣喜地跳起舞，扭动圆滚滚的身体，唱出由电子音组成的曲子。听到歌声的人总会忍不住加入，分享它的快乐。
author: sk372
source: When exposed to sunlight, POKENAME becomes overjoyed and dances, wiggling its rotund body around and singing a tune made of digital tones. Those who hear the song can't help but join in and share POKENAME's joy.

entry: POKENAME习惯跳上够得到的最高处，看见太阳便啾啾鸣叫，因此很受农民欢迎。它摇晃花瓣，撒出余烬，吸收光能帮助成长。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME make for popular companions for farmers due to their habits of hopping up to the highest point they can reach and chirping when they see the sun. They shake their petals about to scatter embers, absorbing light for energy to grow.

entry: POKENAME守卫玉米田，用强劲的踢击赶走入侵者。阳光赋予它巨大的力量，它得跑上一整天，才能消耗多余能量。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME stands guard over cornfields, chasing off intruders with powerful kicks. The sunlight gives it tremendous strength, and it must run all day to burn off its excess energy.

entry: POKENAME会改变地形，帮助植物和草属性宝可梦茁壮成长。它用双臂挖土，把肥沃的土壤搬到合适的位置。
author: firstromaniandiscoerd
source: POKENAME is known for helping plants and grass Pokémon flourish by shaping the landscape. It does so with its arms, digging and placing fertile soil.

entry: POKENAME随时乐意起舞，阳光越直，舞姿越有活力。附近的同类也会忍不住加入，组成整支满面笑容、陶醉其中的舞队。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is always up for a dance, moving more vibrantly the more direct sunlight is upon it. Other POKENAME are compelled to join in if nearby, forming entire troupes of smiling, blissful dancers.

entry: 这种形态的POKENAME虽然表现得开朗阳光，却常常情绪低落。为它读诗，或许能抚慰心中的忧伤。
author: hophoppip
source: Though it acts cheerful and sunny, this form of POKENAME often struggles with low mood. Reading poetry to it may help to soothe its sorrows.

entry: 野生POKENAME照料着广大的花园，种有花卉和其他植物。宽大的花裙一展开，就能撒出富含养分的花粉；它还会将储存的太阳能凝成强力攻击，守护花园。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME tend to vast gardens of flowers and other plants, their expansive flower-like skirts capable of scattering nutrient-rich pollen whenever they unfurl. They can condense stored solar energy into powerful attacks to protect their gardens.

entry: 晴天，POKENAME会聚在一起，两两切磋，讲究礼节、尊重对手。自古以来，人们就很推崇这份武德，中世纪手稿中也画有它的形象。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME gather on sunny days to pair off and spar with each other, making sure to respect their opponent with honorable practices. This valor has been highly prized historically, with artwork of POKENAME appearing in medieval manuscripts.

entry: POKENAME藏在向日花怪群中，悄悄吸走它们的能量。即使如此，对谁仍都十分友善。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hide amongst other Sunflora, slowly draining their energy while they're unaware. Despite this, they are still very friendly to everyone.

entry: POKENAME金黄色的花瓣在阳光下闪耀。它坐在山顶，大量吸收并储存太阳能，黄昏时再化为一道光束，射向天空。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shimmer in sunlight with their goldenrod petals and sit atop hills to gain and store lots of solar energy. At dusk, they release the stored solar power with a beam of light that is shot into the sky.

entry: POKENAME一家会在日出前聚在一起，朝东等待第一缕阳光。上午一同晒太阳，利用光能合成尖刺里的毒素。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Families of POKENAME cluster together in the early morning before sunrise, facing toward the East to wait for the first rays. They spend the first half of the day basking together, using the energy from the light to synthesise toxins in their spines.

entry: POKENAME用后脑上的假花引诱毫无戒心的虫类宝可梦。花会喷出使其麻痹的毒，让猎物无力反抗，只能任它捕食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the false flower on the back of its head to lure in unsuspecting insect Pokémon near. The flower expels a stunning poison on the victim, leaving them helpless to resist becoming POKENAME's prey.

entry: POKENAME常在阳光明媚的海滩漫步，温柔又亲近人。它会在附近沙土里挖坑，让植物类宝可梦休息、吸收阳光。
author: sk372
source: Often seen wandering around sunlit beaches, POKENAME is highly approachable and gentle. It digs holes in the nearby sand and dirt for plant Pokémon to rest in and absorb sunlight.

entry: 人们只在白天见过POKENAME。据说和它一起看日出，能带来三代人的好运。
author: riley_muir_qu33n_in_yellow
source: POKENAME has only ever been spotted during the day. It is said that watching the sunrise with this Pokémon will bring three generations of good luck.

entry: POKENAME用头骨保护重要器官。只有毁掉下方的头骨，才能打败本体。
author: themicelegion
source: POKENAME uses its skull as protection for its vital organs. The main body can only be defeated once the skull underneath is destroyed.

entry: POKENAME总朝着太阳，即使夜里，也能靠天生的磁力追踪太阳方位。它追逐阳光时会带着植物同行，是优秀的园艺伙伴。
