author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME always faces toward the sun, using its innate magnetic powers to track the direction of the sun even at night. It makes for an excellent garden companion as it will carry plants with it as it follows the sunlight.

entry: 为了结出孕育下一代的种子，POKENAME必须偷来一株植物，接管其生长过程，让它长出幼小的POKENAME。这个过程会耗尽植物与亲代的全部生命能量。
author: .fedoraman
source: In order to make seeds that will grow into the next generation of POKENAME, they must steal a plant and hijack its biology to grow a baby POKENAME instead. All of the life energy of the plant and the parent is spent in this process.

entry: POKENAME曾忠于同样热爱太阳的古人。直到今天，它仍守护着那些人的神殿遗迹。
author: _testrun_
source: POKENAME were loyal to ancient people who shared a love for the sun. POKENAME continue to guard what remains of their temples.

entry: 天气格外晴朗时，POKENAME喜欢在开阔田野上空滑翔，撒播尾上花朵产生的花粉。花瓣吸收的阳光越多，它就越精神、越活泼。
author: fiordaliso
source: During particularly sunny days, POKENAME enjoys gliding over open fields, scattering the pollen produced by the flower on its tail. The more sunlight its petals absorb, the more energized and lively this Pokémon becomes.

entry: 花瓣吸收的阳光越多，POKENAME就越精神、越活泼。可到了阴天，它会变得极其烦躁，可能猛甩尾巴，赶走靠得太近的家伙。
author: fiordaliso
source: The more sunlight its petals absorb, the more energized and lively this Pokémon becomes. On cloudy days, however, POKENAME tends to grow extremely irritable and may drive away anyone who approaches too closely with powerful swings of its tail.

entry: POKENAME常在白天睡觉，头浮在栖居的湖面上吸收阳光。年龄越大，花束般的尾巴就开出越多新花，人们常将花剪下，作为恋人间的礼物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME often sleep during the day, their heads bobbing on the surface of their lake homes as they absorb sunlight. Their bouquet-like tails sprout new flowers the older they become and are often trimmed and used as presents between human lovers.

entry: 白天，POKENAME不停旋转，让至少一个头始终朝着太阳。夜里，它进入休眠，将旋转产生的能量转成养分，维持生命。
author: skittytales
source: During the day, POKENAME is constantly rotating so at least one of its heads is always facing the sun. At night it goes dormant, converting the energy generated from rotating into nutrients to sustain itself.

entry: POKENAME进行光合作用时，会散出蜂蜜般的香气。许多训练家反映，带着它旅行时遭到了圈圈熊的攻击。
author: dodoowner_
source: When POKENAME photosynthesizes, it releases an aroma similar to honey. Many Trainers report being attacked by Ursaring when traveling with this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME身侧看似锋利的长叶，藏着岩石般坚硬的爪子。花瓣吸收的阳光会化为能量，常储存在双角里，再从角尖发出威力较弱却精准的日光束。
author: infinex21
source: The long, sharp-looking leaves at POKENAME's side conceal rock-hard claws. Its petals absorb sunlight that its body turns into energy, which is often stored within its two horns. It can release precise, albeit weaker, Solar Beams from its horns.

entry: POKENAME虽然讨喜，却常爱捣蛋。即使身受重伤，脸上的笑容也从不消失。
author: inksans201x
source: While quite charming, POKENAME is often prone to mischief. Even when gravely injured, the smile on its face never falters.

entry: POKENAME的头不断放出灿烂光芒，盯久了就会让人着迷。看上几分钟，人就会站着沉沉睡去。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's head constantly emits radiant light. Staring into it for too long mesmerizes anyone. After minutes of looking at it, people fall into a deep sleep while standing.

entry: POKENAME日出时起飞，每天从东到西追随太阳。日落后降回地面，休息一整夜，第二天再重复同样的旅程。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME takes to the sky at sunrise, following the sun from east to west on its daily journey. It comes back to the ground at sunset, resting throughout the night until it repeats the cycle on the next day.

entry: 晴天，POKENAME会跃上高空，尽量直接吸收阳光。它用大叶片助跳、控制下落方向，优雅地沿着迷宫般曲折的轨迹落下。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: On sunny days, POKENAME leap high into the sky to directly absorb as much sunlight as possible. They use their large leaves to boost their jumps and steer their descents, gracefully falling in winding patterns that resemble mazes.

entry: POKENAME连战斗时都朝着太阳，不必转身，也能对付任何方向的敌人。
author: staghorn
source: Even in combat, a POKENAME will always orient itself towards the sun. It can fight opponents in any direction without turning its body.

entry: POKENAME从头顶的向日葵获取能量，定期脱落尾巴上营养丰富的种子。种子可以烘烤，制成咸味零食。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME gains its energy from the sunflower on its head. It regularly sheds the nutrient-dense seeds on its tail, which can be roasted into a salty snack.

entry: POKENAME伪装向日葵，融入田野与花园。若被捕食者发现，就展开藏起的双翼，高速飞走。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a sunflower to blend seamlessly into fields and gardens. If spotted by a predator, it reveals its hidden wings and takes off at incredible speeds.

entry: 白天，POKENAME用叶片收集阳光，转为能量存在腹部。太阳下山后，它就借这股能量以快得令人眼花的速度远行，沿途四处播撒种子。
author: milchik
source: During the day, POKENAME gathers sunlight with its leaves and converts it into energy, storing it in the abdomen. When the sun goes down, POKENAME uses this energy to cover large distances with blinding speed and spread its seeds everywhere it flies.

entry: 融合使它白天变得欢快、宽容。夜里，深埋的怨恨又会浮现，让它重新踏上复仇之路。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Due to fusion, it becomes gleeful and forgiving during the day. At night, its buried grudges resurface, resuming its search for vengeance.

entry: POKENAME体表的凝胶极擅长光合作用，一小时产生的能量就够它用两天。科学家认为，这种凝胶或许能用于制造高科技太阳能板。
author: mistymagius
source: The gel that coats POKENAME's body is amazing at photosynthesis, producing enough energy in an hour to last it two days. Scientists think the gel could be useful in creating high-tech solar panels.

entry: POKENAME十分友善，爱晒太阳，让头周围的花瓣尽情吸收阳光。它能造出明黄色的小火球，威力不强，常拿来玩。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are very friendly Pokémon that love to bathe in sunlight as the petals around their heads drink it in. They can create weak balls of bright, yellow flames and play with them often.

entry: POKENAME做出伪装，想混进野生向日花怪中，一起晒太阳。可惜伪装很快就会干燥变脆，被热量弄得散架，必须不断修补。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fashions a disguise in an attempt to join Sunflora in the wild and bask in the sunlight. Unfortunately, its disguise becomes dry and brittle quickly, falling apart from the heat and requiring constant repairs.

entry: POKENAME白天吸收的阳光越多，翅膀就越明亮，笑容也越欢快。积攒足够的太阳能后，它就像一颗小太阳，能照亮整片花田。
author: milchik
source: The more sunlight POKENAME absorbs during the day, the brighter its wings glow and the more cheerful its smile gets. With enough sun energy accumulated, this Pokémon can illuminate an entire flower field akin to a small sun.

entry: POKENAME靠精神力量理解人类语言。人们总看到它不停地朝太阳所在的方向飞。
author: mepp.
source: With POKENAME's psychic powers, it is capable of understanding human speech. It is seen endlessly flying towards the direction of the sun.

entry: POKENAME常在草木繁茂的田野里晒太阳。虽然性情温顺，谁若打扰了它的清静，也会遭到猛烈攻击。
author: thropp
source: POKENAME is often found in lush fields, basking in the sun. Although docile, POKENAME will viciously attack those who disturb its peace.

entry: POKENAME白天吸收大量阳光，夜里也能极其活跃。若看见它睡觉，就说明它缺乏阳光，已经到了危险的程度。
author: sk372
source: The high amounts of sunlight it absorbs during the day allows it to continue to be extremely active during the night as well. A sleeping POKENAME is one that has been dangerously deprived of sunlight.

entry: POKENAME通常面朝上待在水里，获取太阳能。但一饿起来，就会向下猛冲，破坏水下环境，捕捉宝可梦吃。
author: firstromaniandiscoerd
source: POKENAME is usually seen in the water face-up to gain solar energy. When it is hungry, however, it charges down and destroys the aquatic landscape to catch Pokémon to eat.

entry: POKENAME每天从东往西追逐太阳，增强身体的力量。太阳下山时，它就朝自己正对的方向使出鬼火。它附近的植物似乎长得格外快。
author: ghostslythe
source: Always following the sun, POKENAME marches from east to west every day, powering up its body. When the sun sets, it uses Will-o'-Wisp in whatever direction it happens to be facing. Plants in its vicinity seem to grow especially fast.

entry: POKENAME靠光合作用获取能量，同时释放氧气和一种神秘气体，吸入后会让人感到满足、快乐。不过，一阵强风就能把它们吹散。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME photosynthesizes sunlight for energy and releases oxygen and a mysterious gaseous substance as byproduct that brings contentedness and happiness to those that inhale it. Strong gusts of winds blow them away, however.

entry: POKENAME粗犷的钢铁骨架看似坚实，其实由柔软的植物纤维构成，能高效吸收阳光。它以大晴天让满田花苞化为缤纷花海的本领闻名。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Though POKENAME's rugged steel frame appears solid, it is actually composed of soft plant fibers that efficiently absorb sunlight. It is renowned for using Sunny Day to transform fields of flower buds into vibrant seas of blooming color.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME下方的头四处寻找湿泥，通过根吸取养分。太阳升起后，上方的花头则寻找向阳的地面，吸收阳光。
author: quackquackattack
source: At night, POKENAME's bottom head roams to find damp mud to absorb nutrients through their roots. When the sun rises, POKENAME's flower head finds sunny patches of land to absorb sunlight from.

entry: POKENAME精力充沛，喜欢边吸收阳光边跑来跑去，却会在阴雨天难过。科学家正研究季节性情感障碍对它这类野生宝可梦的影响。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are energetic creatures that love to run around as they absorb sunlight, but are sad on days that are cloudy or rainy. Scientists are currently studying the effects of seasonal affective disorder on wild Pokémon like POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME全身的毛孔都储着种子。它晒太阳获取能量时，种子产生的叶绿素会把皮肤染成黄绿色。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have pores across their entire body that store seeds. These seeds produce chlorophyll that tints their skin a chartreuse color while POKENAME bask in the sunlight to gain energy.

entry: POKENAME尾端始终燃着小火，身体却十分易燃。每逢攻击，都得小心，别把自己点着。
author: chorb33
source: Although POKENAME always emits a small flame from its tail, its body is flammable. It is always careful not to ignite itself when attacking.

entry: 吃了POKENAME掉落的种子，会变得怨怼、满怀恨意。不过，种子烤过后就失去了这种作用。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The seeds that POKENAME drop cause those who eat them to become bitter and hateful. If you roast these seeds, they lose this attribute.

entry: POKENAME固定在一处休息，吸收养分和阳光。坚韧的倒刺，让园丁很难把它从花园里清走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rests in a static location to absorb nutrients and sunlight. Gardeners have a difficult time removing it from their gardens because of its tough barbs.

entry: 这种宝可梦不断进行光合作用，产生电能。一旦被踩，就会释放大量强力的带电孢子，甚至能使对方麻痹。
author: chaos_emblemx
source: This Pokémon photosynthesizes constantly to produce electrical energy. Stepping on one will release a flood of potent electric spores that can even cause paralysis.

entry: POKENAME无忧无虑地在森林里快乐漫步，用花朵吸收阳光。不过，若想在它睡觉时叫醒它，它就会大发狂性。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME cheerfully strolls around the forest without a care in the world, absorbing sunlight with its flower. However, if you try to wake it while it's sleeping, it will fly into a rampage.

entry: POKENAME伏在大花田中，伸长尾巴，等其他宝可梦经过。授粉的生物一落上花，就成了它的盘中餐。
author: mundane_frog
source: POKENAME lies in large flower fields, its tail outstretched in wait for a Pokémon to come by. Once a pollinator lands on a flower, it secures a meal.

entry: 强烈暴风雪来袭时，POKENAME会用头上的花放出强光，防止植物枯死。农民不在时，它也能帮忙照料作物，因此深受喜爱。
author: agostostino
source: When a strong blizzard appears, POKENAME will emit a light source strong enough to prevent plants from dying using the flower on its head. POKENAME is beloved by farmers, as it helps them take care of their produce when they are away.

entry: 向日花怪与走路草组成的这对搭档乐于彼此陪伴，POKENAME的两张脸上总挂着笑容。它们一起在阳光下行进，唱着快乐的二重唱。
author: sk372
source: This duo of Sunflora and Oddish delight in each other's company; POKENAME is never seen without a smile on both faces. They march together beneath the sunlight, singing a happy duet together.

entry: POKENAME起舞时，地下休眠的种子会苏醒、开花，仿佛在为它喝彩。一场表演就曾让整片山坡绽放色彩，留下道道野花。
author: jaminmcready
source: When POKENAME dances, dormant seeds beneath the soil begin to stir and bloom as if cheering it on. Entire hillsides have burst into color from a single performance, leaving behind trails of wildflowers.

entry: POKENAME在堆肥和粪堆里开花，生长时还会改善脚下的肥料，因此有“园丁之友”的称呼。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME blooms in piles of compost and manure heaps. Because its growth enhances the fertilizer it blooms from, it's called a "Gardener's Friend".

entry: POKENAME常守护，整片向日花怪的田野。谁敢闯入，很快就会遭到，致命而无解的诅咒。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME often take up the role of protector to entire fields of Sunflora. Any intruders will soon fall under a deadly and incurable curse.

entry: POKENAME常守护，整片向日花怪的田野。谁敢闯入，很快就会遭到，致命而无解的诅咒。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME often take up the role of protector to entire fields of Sunflora. Any intruders will soon fall under a deadly and incurable curse.

entry: 随着光合作用，POKENAME的翅膀会越长越大，达到最大翼展时就会进化。奇怪的是，它的羽毛带有一股浓烈而特别的植物油香。
author: bobosmith01
source: Their wings get larger and larger as they photosynthesize. POKENAME evolve when they reach their maximum wingspan. Oddly, their feathers have a strong and particular fragrance reminiscent of vegetable oil.

entry: 野生POKENAME极其罕见。它释放特殊能量，让植物生长、让其他生命满心欢喜。可持续而强烈的能量输出，也让大多数野生个体短短几天就会死去。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME tend to be extremely rare in the wild. They radiate a special energy that causes plants to grow and others to feel overjoyed. However, such constant and intense energy output results in most wild POKENAME passing away in mere days.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀十分壮观。蓬松的翅尖其实长着特殊种荚，飘落地面后会自行扎进土里，过了冬天便萌生成幼鸟。
author: chiari_queen
source: POKENAME's wings are truly spectacular. Its fluffy wings are actually tipped with special pods that, after floating to the ground, seed themselves into the soil and bud into newborn chicks following the winter season.

entry: POKENAME在山脚阳光下盛开的花田里生长旺盛。身体哪里破损，就用周围的石块补上，再用沿身体生长的藤蔓固定。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME thrives at the base of mountains where flower fields bloom in the sunlight. POKENAME replaces broken pieces of its body with surrounding stones and secures them with vines that grow along its frame.

entry: 植物占据一副空钢壳，形成了这种宝可梦。阳光强烈时，它体内会传出机械声。
author: frokachu
source: Vegetation took over an empty steel shell, resulting in this Pokémon. Mechanical sounds can be heard from it during strong sunlight.

entry: 天气越晴朗，POKENAME就越活跃。虽然气味宜人，它跑动时撒出的黄色花粉一接触皮肤，就会引起疼痛的疹子。
author: .jerden
source: The sunnier the weather, the more active POKENAME becomes. Although it smells pleasant, the yellow pollen it scatters as it scurries about causes a painful rash upon contact with skin.

entry: POKENAME讨厌有人进入领地，见到谁就朝谁射小刺。它特别喜欢蓝色的花，因此野生个体手里拿着蓝花是常有的事。
author: agostostino
source: POKENAME hates when someone enters its territory, so it will shoot little spikes at anyone it sees. POKENAME really likes blue flowers, so it is normal to see POKENAME in the wild with a blue flower in its hand.

entry: POKENAME长着形似向日葵的蘑菇。孢子会黏住平时替花传粉的宝可梦，迅速扩散到整片林地。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have mushrooms that mimic the appearance of sunflowers. Their spores cling to Pokémon who typically pollinate flowers, allowing POKENAME to rapidly proliferate these spores throughout a forested area.

entry: POKENAME生活在阳光充足的南方热带地区，是友善温柔的巨型宝可梦。颈部褶边完全张开时，会放出阳光般温暖的光，让其他生命尽情沐浴。
author: sk372
source: Inhabiting southern tropical areas heavy with sunlight, POKENAME is a friendly and gentle giant of a Pokémon. When it opens its frill fully, it generates a warm light akin to the sun's rays for others to bask in.

entry: 只要晒得到太阳，POKENAME就总是和善友好。可夜色一来，它便暴躁易怒，用飞叶快刀攻击物品，发泄不满。
author: soup1900
source: As long as it receives sunlight, POKENAME is always very nice and friendly. However, as soon as night turns, its demeanor turns violent and angry, lashing out its frustration by using Razor Leaf against objects.

entry: 阳光直射时，POKENAME体内产生孢子的速度迅速加快。可惜它在强光下看不清，这段时间几乎等于失明。
author: .izik
source: When in direct sunlight, POKENAME's internal spore production accelerates rapidly. Unfortunately, it has trouble seeing well in bright light, leaving it nearly blind during this period.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇常在宴会上被当作碗，因为能借太阳能提升食物风味。蘑菇还会增添辛香，很适合搭配玉米脆片。
author: firstromaniandiscoerd
source: POKENAME's mushroom is commonly used as a bowl at feasts, since it enhances the flavour through solar power. The mushroom also adds spice, which pairs well with nachos.

entry: 古老神话称POKENAME为“噬日者”。它遮住太阳时，会用身体反射阳光，使附近所有生物长出变异的花朵和异常结构。
author: beatdoof
source: Known as 'Devourer of the Sun' in ancient myths, POKENAME reflects sunlight off its body as it blots the sun, causing floral mutations and anomalies to sprout from all living beings near it.

entry: 它们一生大多躺在开阔的广袤田野上晒太阳。起身跳舞、消耗多余能量时，还会撒出无数种子，长成美丽的花田。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon lay in great, open fields for most of their lives as they bask in the sunlight cast upon them. When they get up to dance away their excess energy, they also scatter around countless seeds that become fields of beautiful flowers.

entry: POKENAME把双臂伸向太阳，大量吸收太阳能。它主要靠光合作用维生，但训练家递来树果，它也会高兴地享用。
author: beetlething
source: POKENAME will stick its arms up towards the sun in order to absorb large amounts of solar energy. This photosynthesis is its main diet, but it has been known to enjoy a berry if it is offered one by a Trainer.

entry: POKENAME常被称为“温柔巨人”。弱小宝可梦跟随它，寻求友谊和保护。所到之处会长出花田，孕育完整的生态。
author: rakunk
source: Often nicknamed 'Gentle Giant', smaller Pokémon tend to follow POKENAME around for their friendship and protection. Wherever it travels, entire ecosystems and flower fields sprout in its place.

entry: POKENAME伞状的叶片能储存大量光能，再以火焰的形式释放。天气不好时，它也用叶片遮挡风雨。
author: tioghi
source: POKENAME's umbrella-shaped leaf is capable of storing a massive amount of luminous energy, which is subsequently released in the form of flames. It also uses it to cover itself from bad weather.

entry: POKENAME园艺本领多样，深受香氛姐姐喜爱。它会利用向日葵预测当天的云况，调整花园布置，尽量满足植物的需求。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are beloved by Aroma Ladies for their various gardening skills. POKENAME use sunflowers to predict the day's clouds and will adjust gardens to best suit the plants' needs.

entry: POKENAME园艺本领多样，深受香氛姐姐喜爱。它用手杖为受寒的植物送去太阳般温和的热量。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are beloved by Aroma Ladies for their various gardening skills. Using their staff, POKENAME can generate the gentle heat of the sun for plants suffering from the cold.

entry: POKENAME从壳里一股股喷出蒸汽，既调节体温，也净化周围空气。背上的向日葵白天追随太阳转动，入夜便合上。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME releases puffs of steam from its shell that both regulate its body temperature and purify the air around it. The sunflowers blooming on its back track the sun's movement across the sky throughout the day, closing when night falls.

entry: 叶片状的翅膀太脆弱，POKENAME只在晴天起飞。平时多半在地上行走，用脚从下方土壤吸取水和养分。
author: mistymagius
source: Because of how fragile its leaf-like wings are, POKENAME only takes flight when the weather is clear. It prefers to walk on the ground most of the time, its feet drawing water and nutrients from the soil beneath.

entry: 没人看着时，POKENAME每天会追着太阳跑两次，日出、日落各一次。训练家常得循着它快乐的歌声，才能把它找回来。
author: danarchosyndacalist
source: An unattended POKENAME will run after the sun twice daily, at sunrise and sunset. Trainers often have to track them back down by following the sound of their joyous song.

entry: POKENAME喜欢分享自己种的树果，让人开心，也会送礼物给训练家。
author: firstromaniandiscoerd
source: POKENAME love making people happy by sharing berries they grow. POKENAME also gives gifts to its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME常坐进别人家的花园，开心地晒太阳。有人嫌它添乱，也有人热情欢迎它乐观的性格。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will often sit in other people's gardens, cheerfully absorbing sunlight. While some people see POKENAME as a nuisance, others welcome their positive attitude with open arms.

entry: POKENAME僵直地站在森林或田野，吸收阳光。敌人一走近，就喷出火焰，有时，甚至引发森林大火。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME stands rigidly in forests or fields and absorbs sunlight. If an enemy approaches, it launches fire that has been known to light forest fires.

entry: POKENAME的叶片能中和胃酸、缓解胃酸反流，因此会被采集。它需要大量阳光和充足的清水，才能长出大叶子。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produces leaves that are harvested for its ability to neutralize stomach acid, which helps with acid reflux. It requires lots of sunlight and plenty of clean water to sprout big leaves.

entry: POKENAME开心地在原地跳舞，对谁都像最好的朋友。有人说，笑脸之下还潜藏着阴暗得多的性格。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME dances in place happily, and behaves as if it considers everyone its best friend. Some say it houses a much darker personality lurking just beneath its smiling face.

entry: POKENAME常跑进城市花园，在松软的土里安家。它友善又可爱，许多居民最后干脆收养它，让它长住下来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME often finds its way into urban gardens, making its home within the soft soil. Because of its friendly personality and cute appearance, many residents wind up adopting it and letting it live there permanently.

entry: POKENAME一家成群在花田里游走，追逐彼此的尾巴取乐，借玩耍建立紧密的家庭关系。之后便开心地坐在一起，面朝太阳吸收能量。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Prides of POKENAME prowl through flower fields, amusing themselves by chasing after one another's tails. They form tight-knit families through this play, happily sitting together afterward and facing toward the sun to absorb its energy.

entry: POKENAME尽量长时间待在阳光下，因为皮肤一晒不到太阳，就开始剧烈头痛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tries to remain in sunlight for as long as possible. This is because it begins suffering intense headaches the moment it no longer feels sunlight on its skin.

entry: POKENAME需要适量阳光，才能正常思考。光太少，会因能量不足而睡着；光太多，又会因光合作用制造了过多糖分而头痛。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME require specific levels of sunlight for their mental function. Too little light causes them to fall asleep from lack of energy, too much causes them headaches as they photosynthesise too much sugar.

entry: POKENAME在草地上飞奔时，也能大量吸收阳光。它速度极快，常让人只看见一道黄绿相间的残影。草叶般的毛摸起来十分温暖。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME absorbs large amounts of sunlight even as it dashes quickly through grassy fields, often seen as a mere blur of yellow and green due to the speeds it can reach. Its grassy fur is extremely warm to the touch.

entry: POKENAME不停吸收太阳能。蓄够了，就能卷起整场火焰风暴，可也得小心，自己易燃的身体。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME constantly absorbs solar energy. Once it has collected enough, it can ignite entire firestorms. But it has to be wary of its flammable body.

entry: POKENAME腹部的花朵吸收阳光，转为养分维持身体。晴天时，可以看到它仰躺在睡莲叶上晒太阳。
author: santon5512
source: The flowers on POKENAME's stomachs absorb sunlight, converting it into nutrients to fuel themselves. On sunny days, these Pokémon can be found lying on their backs on top of lilypads, basking in the light.

entry: POKENAME很有领导才能，带领一群草属性宝可梦也毫无问题。童话里说，没有什么比它的梦想更强大。
author: agostostino
source: POKENAME are so good at being leaders that they can guide a group of Grass-type Pokémon without problems. Children's stories say that nothing is stronger than a POKENAME dream.

entry: POKENAME喜欢晒太阳，却常被想轻松饱餐一顿的天敌打扰。好在它的壳不但能缓冲攻击，还能让它继续进行有限的光合作用。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy basking in the sunlight but are often interrupted by predators looking for an easy meal. Thankfully, not only does their shell cushion attacks from predators, but it also allows them to continue to photosynthesize to a limited degree.

entry: POKENAME靠阳光茁壮成长，晒得越多，纤细的身体就长得越长。夏季时，嘴里还会开始滴出葵花籽油。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME thrive on sunlight, their slender bodies growing longer the more sun exposure they get. During the summer month, sunflower oil will start dripping out of their mouths.

entry: POKENAME把残羹剩饭和腐烂的果蔬吃进肚里，转成肥料。在明亮的阳光下休息，能加快肥料的产生。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME takes food scraps and rotten produce and converts them into mulch inside its stomach. By resting in bright sunlight, it accelerates the rate at which the mulch is produced.

entry: POKENAME白天攀上山顶，吸收阳光；夜里则挖出浅浅的洞穴，躺下休息。睡在洞中时，旁人若不仔细看，只会把它当成一块普通的石头。
author: lutrax
source: During the day, POKENAME climbs to the tops of mountains to absorb sunlight. At night, this Pokémon digs shallow burrows to rest, and while sleeping in said burrows, it appears to casual bystanders as just a simple rock.

entry: 晴朗午后，山顶可能聚着无数晒太阳的POKENAME。可傍晚登山要当心，成群的它们会毫无顾忌地一路滚下。
author: lutrax
source: If you happen to be on the peak of a mountain during a sunny afternoon, you could see a myriad of POKENAME enjoying the sunlight; however, be careful when climbing in the evening, as during that time herds of POKENAME may be rolling down carefree.

entry: POKENAME大口吃营养丰富的土壤，维持健康，多余能量则用来修补、更换身上的岩石。有人见过野生个体制作堆肥。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME devours nutritious soil in order to stay healthy. Excess energy is used to repair and replace rocks on its body. Some POKENAME have been seen creating compost piles in the wild.

entry: POKENAME曾是受欢迎的竞速品种。可速度竟依赖太阳，实在太不可靠，最终不再被看好。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME used to be a popular Pokémon racing breed. However since its speed depended on the sun, it was deemed too unreliable.

entry: 这种宝可梦懒洋洋地待在向阳的河边，开心地用尾巴搅着水，享受阳光。有人形容，它把“无知是福”发挥到了极致。
author: sk372
source: This Pokémon lazes by sunny riverbeds, happily swirling its tail in the water and taking in the sunlight. Some have described it as being the pinnacle of blissful ignorance.

entry: 需要光合作用无法产生的特殊养分时，POKENAME就会寻找树果加餐。它常挑落入水中的，因为游过去就容易吃到。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME need special nutrients that cannot be made with photosynthesis, they search for berries to add to their meals. They often go after berries that have fallen into the water as they are easy to swim to.

entry: POKENAME将阳光转成电能，让自己飘浮，也为攻击供能。唯一的缺点是，一到夜里便完全无力自保。
author: firstromaniandiscoerd
source: POKENAME levitate by converting sun rays into electric power that also fuels POKENAME's attacks. The only downside is that they are completely helpless at night.

entry: POKENAME整天通过向日葵的茎吸收光。遇到威胁，就将储存的能量转成锐利光束，惊退或驱逐天敌。
author: ilija09
source: POKENAME absorbs light through its sunflower stalk throughout the day. When threatened, it redirects the stored energy into sharp beams that can startle or repel predators.

entry: POKENAME白天高速奔跑，尽量让各个头长时间晒到太阳。只有太阳被遮住，它才停下来休息，直到感知到下一缕阳光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME runs across the land at high speeds during the day, keeping its heads in the sunlight for as long as possible. Only when the sun is hidden does it finally stop moving and rest, until it detects the next ray of sunshine.

entry: POKENAME晒太阳后身体很暖，因此爱躺在冰凉的表面。它将叶片拍在一起，或用尾巴拍地时，会从身上撒下小叶片和花瓣。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME love to laze on cold surfaces due to how warm their bodies get as they absorb sunlight. When they clap their leaves together or their tail against the ground, they scatter small leaves and petals from their bodies.

entry: POKENAME身上污泥般的物质，其实是浓缩的树汁和花粉。过敏专科医生用它制药，缓解人们春季的花粉过敏。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME's sludge-like substance is actually a concentration of sap and pollen. Allergists make medicine out of the substance to help with people's springtime hay fever.

entry: POKENAME在壳上伸出的管子里装土，借身体的保护种植藤蔓。两只相遇时，会交换种子，分享植物种类，尝试种些新植物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME gather soil in the pipes extending from their shell, growing vines in the safety of their body. When two POKENAME meet, they exchange seeds to share plant species and try growing new plants.

entry: POKENAME虽然长着翅膀，却不会飞。它用翅膀在密林里与同类交流，夏季的树丛中满是响亮的嗡鸣。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Despite their wings, POKENAME are flightless Pokémon. They use their wings to communicate with one another through dense forests, the trees filled with loud buzzing through the summer months.

entry: 据说POKENAME能长时间保持超音速时，就会进化。因此，人们给它用了本不需要的速度强化。
author: quackquackattack
source: It is said that POKENAME evolves when it is able to sustain supersonic speeds for long periods of time, which is why it is given unnecessary X Speed boosters.

entry: POKENAME身体的每一部分都按固定轨迹飞行。每晚睡前，它会协调好彼此的飞行路线。
author: .izik
source: Each portion of POKENAME's body flies in a fixed pattern. It coordinates flight patterns each night before it falls asleep.

entry: POKENAME会振动手中的骨头，模仿蜻蜻蜓振翅的声音。蜻蜻蜓常把这当成求救信号，飞来保护它。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can vibrate the bone it carries to mimic the sounds of a Yanma's beating wings. Yanma often respond to the sound like an emergency call, flying in to keep POKENAME safe from harm.

entry: POKENAME靠翅膀行动极快，战斗中几乎碰不到它。出拳速度几乎赶得上振翅，短短几秒就能向对手打出数十拳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wings give it exceedingly quick movements, making it nearly untouchable in battle. It can punch nearly at the same speed it flaps its wings, pummeling foes with dozens of punches in a matter of seconds.

entry: POKENAME靠翅膀轻易逃离危险，眼睛连最快的动作也能察觉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wings allow it to to escape from danger with ease. Its eyes can detect even the swiftest of movements.

entry: POKENAME很擅长捕捉比自己大得多的猎物。它装作浑然不觉，引来想捕食自己的家伙，再用翅膀振动制造无形的墙，将对方困住。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME are skilled at capturing prey much larger than themselves. By pretending to be unaware, they lure in would-be predators before capturing them with invisible walls created by their vibrating wings.

entry: POKENAME把巢建在离实际猎场很远的地方。它高速俯冲，用头上的钳子抓住猎物，随后迅速离开，免得别的天敌来抢食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes its den a good distance away from its actual hunting grounds. It swoops with great speed to snatch prey with the pincers on its head, speeding away afterward to avoid other predators attempting to steal its meal.

entry: POKENAME贴近水面飞行，小翅膀托起身体十分吃力。哪怕一丝涟漪，也可能让它失去平衡，扑通掉进水里。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME fly just above the surface of the water, struggling to lift their body with their small wings. Even a small ripple in the water can send them off-balance and send them splashing down.

entry: POKENAME以惊人的速度在林地上爬行，寻找最美味的叶子。因为总能快速逃走，它很少动用头上的毒刺。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME crawl across the forest floor with amazing speed in search of the tastiest leaves. They rarely use the venomous stinger on their head because they can always make a speedy escape.

entry: POKENAME独特的翅膀能使周围光线折射，形成模糊光影，掩藏身形。它常捉弄其他野生宝可梦，吊着树果，让对方总是差一点够到。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have unique wings that refract light around them, creating a blur of light that helps them obscure their presence. They often pull pranks on other wild Pokémon, often harassing them by dangling berries just out of reach.

entry: POKENAME颈部的草芽散发甜香，引来小得能一口吞下的猎物。它的外形远不适合飞行，却能疯狂振翅，短暂悬停。
author: t3isukone
source: The grassy buds around POKENAME's neck emit a sweet scent that lures in prey small enough for it to swallow. While far from aerodynamic, it can briefly hover through the frenzied beating of its wings.

entry: 太阳下山时，POKENAME会发出尖锐的叫声，响得足以让池水泛起涟漪。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lets out a high-pitched shriek when the sun goes down. The sound is loud enough to cause the water on a pond to ripple.

entry: POKENAME一兴奋就迅速窜来窜去。它非常黏人，开心时会用翅膀发出尖细的嗡鸣。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME darts around rapidly whenever it's excited. It is incredibly affectionate and will make a high-pitched buzz with its wings when happy.

entry: 日落后，POKENAME聚成大群，齐齐振翅嗡鸣。所有翅膀一同振动，能让整栋房子摇晃。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME gather in large swarms once the sun sets, buzzing their wings in harmony with each other. The vibrations from all their wings can cause an entire house to shake.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛由薄薄的几丁质构成，飞行时发出噼啪声。它的虫鸣足以震碎巨石，需要时能发挥强大威力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feathers are made of a thin chitin, creating a crackling sound as it flies. Its Bug Buzz is strong enough to break apart boulders, making it a powerful force when needed.

entry: POKENAME在湖面上曲折飞行，振翅产生大量静电，用于战斗。
author: schwaus
source: POKENAME can be seen flying in a zigzag pattern all across lakes. The beats of its wings generate a plethora of static electricity, which it uses in battle.

entry: POKENAME在沼泽四处翻找种子和小虫吃。感到受威胁时，它就迅速振翅，发出响亮吓人的嗡鸣，赶走威胁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME pokes around marshes for seeds and small insects to eat. If it feels threatened, it flaps its wings rapidly to make a loud and intimidating buzzing noise to ward off the threats.

entry: POKENAME太重，飞不起来，便改用翅膀积起静电，射出电击波，作为主要攻击手段。
author: t.i.a.
source: Too heavy to fly, POKENAME use their wings to charge up static electricity and shoot shock waves as its main form of attack.

entry: POKENAME飞得极快，多数人只能看见尾球划出的光带。它先越来越快地振翅，在体内产生电力，再起飞觅食。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME fly so quickly that most only see streaks of the light produced by the orb on their tail. They flutter their wings at increasing speeds to generate electricity within themselves before they take off in search of food.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀每次只能让它飞行几分钟。平时它多半随风飘行，只用翅膀稍稍调整路线。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wings only allow it to maintain flight for a few minutes at a time. It typically lets the wind carry it instead, using its wings to adjust its flight path slightly.

entry: 四只翅膀不停拍动，让POKENAME速度惊人。尾巴能抓握果实或其他东西，稳稳地带回巢里。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can move at incredible speeds thanks to the constant flapping of its four wings. Its tail has prehensile properties and can grasp fruit or other objects, which it then carries safely back to its nest.

entry: POKENAME头顶的翅膀像旋翼一样转动。白天，它在向阳空地休息；夜里，则把脸埋进泥里吸收养分。
author: .izik
source: The wings atop POKENAME's head spin like a rotor. By day, it rests in sunlit clearings; at night, it buries its face in mud to absorb nutrients.

entry: POKENAME的视野无可比拟，很难悄悄接近。过去，乡村会用它侦察、协助守卫，因为一有异常，它就会迅速提醒训练家。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME have an unparalleled field of vision, making it very hard to sneak up on them. Historically, rural communities would use them as scouts and alongside guards, as POKENAME are quick to alert their Trainers if anything is amiss.

entry: POKENAME能极其精准地控制翅膀，穿过只有身体宽的缝隙时，会及时收拢翅膀。关都的冬季会举办它的表演，各地区的训练家都会前来观看。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME makes extremely precise movements with its wings and can fly through gaps no wider than its body by folding its wings down as it passes through. POKENAME shows are held during Kanto winters with Trainers from all regions travelling to them.

entry: POKENAME身体太粗壮，翅膀托不起来，只能用来发出强烈的嗡鸣。它会在泥里打滚，遮挡阳光，保持皮肤凉爽湿润。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its body is too stocky for its wings to lift it, so POKENAME uses them only to produce powerful buzzing sounds. To shield itself from the sun, it rolls in mud, keeping its skin cool and moist.

entry: POKENAME视力敏锐、速度惊人，能轻易捕获猎物。常在日落后出来狩猎。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's keen vision and amazing speed allows it to effortlessly take down prey. It's commonly seen hunting after the sun sets.

entry: POKENAME绕着当地的地标计时飞行，锻炼速度，每天至少飞50趟。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME does laps around local landmarks to time itself and improve its speed. It will make a minimum of 50 flights per day.

entry: POKENAME振动翅膀，向球茎内泵入空气，同时封住开口，积蓄压力。准备播种时，就靠储存的压力，将种子射出许多米远。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME whir their wings to pump air inside of their bulbs, keeping the opening closed as they build up the internal pressure. When they are ready to release seeds they launch them using the stored pressure, able to fling their seeds many metres.

entry: POKENAME护目镜般的眼睛，能看清水面下的景象。它从空中精准俯冲，捕捉猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's goggle-like eyes allow it to see clearly beneath the water's surface. It dives from the sky with precision to catch its prey.

entry: POKENAME密密成群地移动，合力捕捉大型猎物。它们用底部的钳子夹住目标，齐齐振翅，抬起比自己大得多的东西。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME travel in thick swarms, working together to take down larger prey. They latch on with their pinchers at their base and buzz their wings in unison, lifting things much larger than themselves.

entry: POKENAME高速掠过水面。有谁靠近巢穴，它就撞上去自爆。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME skims the water's surface at high speed. If anyone approaches its nest, it crashes into them and self-destructs.

entry: POKENAME能瞬间调整路线，不但很少撞上东西，也很少跟丢追踪的敌人。成群时，它们用叫声互相警告危险，协调迅速的攻击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can adjust their trajectory in an instant, so they not only rarely crash but they also rarely lose a foe they are tracking. A flock of POKENAME will use their cries to warn one another of danger and to coordinate their quick attacks.

entry: POKENAME靠高速和利爪袭击大针蜂的巢，抢夺蜂蜜。不过，若另一只同类也来抢同一个巢，它们反而会打起来。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its high speed and sharp claws to effectively raid Beedrill nests for their honey. However, if another POKENAME tries to raid the same nest, they will end up fighting with each other instead.

entry: POKENAME小小的身躯勇敢又爱冒险，喜欢挑战飞行能力的极限。它最爱的练习之一，是从高山跃下自由落体，看看能挨到离地面多近才飞走。
author: sk372
source: Courageous little thrill-seekers, POKENAME enjoy pushing the limits of what their aerial capabilities can do. A favored exercise is leaping from tall mountains and free-falling to see how close they can come to impact before flying off.

entry: POKENAME用身体紧缠猎物，力道足以勒断骨头。若发现附近有敌人，就连着仍被缠住的猎物一起飞走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME constricts its body around prey hard enough to break bones. Should it notice an enemy nearby, it will fly away with the prey still imprisoned.

entry: POKENAME原本出色的视野被庞大身躯挡住，因此特别讨厌突如其来的惊吓。它把獠牙撞向附近树木发泄，常常打扰住在树梢的宝可梦。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME's impressive field of vision is restricted by their bulk, and they get incredibly frustrated by things surprising them. They deal with their frustration by ramming their tusks into nearby trees, disrupting treetop Pokémon constantly.

entry: POKENAME以无与伦比的灵活身手迅速穿过沼泽。发现猎物后，便在半空挥出威力惊人的一拳。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME speeds across marshes with unmatched agility. When it spots prey, it delivers a midair punch with astonishing force.

entry: 飞行时，POKENAME体内的火焰越来越旺。发光的身体在空中留下一道淡淡的热痕。
author: .izik
source: The flames within POKENAME's body intensify as it flies. Its glowing body leaves behind a faint trail of heat in the air.

entry: 它一扇翅膀，便能电死身旁飞过的虫宝可梦。黄昏时，大群POKENAME会一同演出绚丽的灯光秀。
author: schwaus
source: The flap of its wings can electrocute other bug Pokémon it flies by. Large groupings of POKENAME create elaborate lightshows at dusk.

entry: POKENAME飞得太快，周围时间都慢了下来。因此，寿命比其他宝可梦长约50%。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME flies so fast that time slows down around it. Because of this, POKENAME's lifespan is about 50 percent longer than other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴和拍动的翅膀会冒出难以预测的火花。它视力惊人，能轻易用电力精准击中远处的目标。
author: bobosmith01
source: From POKENAME's tail and fluttering wings, unpredictable sparks are formed. POKENAME has incredible vision and can easily snipe faraway targets with electricity.

entry: POKENAME闯进小拉达的越冬粮仓，大吃树果。可惜吃得太撑，小翅膀再也托不起圆滚滚的身体。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME break into the winter stores of Rattata and gorge themselves on berries. Unfortunately, they stuff themselves so full that their small wings cannot get their rotund little bodies off the ground.

entry: 感到受威胁时，POKENAME会迅速振翅，发出嗡鸣警告对方。随后飞上天空，蜷成一团，砸向对手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME warns others when it feels threatened with the hum coming from the rapid beat of its wings. It takes to the skies before curling into a ball and crashing down on its opponents.

entry: POKENAME虽然体型庞大，却只爱捕捉较小的猎物。巡飞领地时若发现更大的宝可梦，它宁可避开，也不愿正面冲突。
author: .jerden
source: While large in size, POKENAME prefers to target only smaller prey. If it spots a larger Pokémon as it flies around its territory, POKENAME will prefer to avoid it rather than confront it.

entry: POKENAME在树冠间飞掠，吃树木的新芽，补充光合作用以外的养分。它速度无可匹敌，爱追逐同样住在树冠里的宝可梦。
author: vic1312
source: Flitting among the treetops, POKENAME feed on the new growth of trees to supplement their photosynthesis. Their speed is unmatched, and they delight in chasing other canopy-dwelling Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在网络空间高速飞行时，翅膀释放的波动会使视频文件失真。因此，许多人把在网上追踪它当成了爱好。
author: .izik
source: While flying at high speed through cyberspace, POKENAME releases waves from its wings that cause distortions in video files. Because of this, many have made a hobby of tracking these Pokémon online.

entry: POKENAME在栖居的森林里跃过树枝时，会用前臂长出的翅膀滑翔。它拥有360度视野，轻易就能发现任何威胁。
author: fiordaliso
source: It uses the wings sprouting from its forearms to glide as it jumps from branch to branch within the forests where it lives. POKENAME has 360° vision, allowing it to effortlessly spot any type of threat.

entry: POKENAME一心想帮助别人，潜力也巨大，却还不懂，怎样把力量发挥出来。
author: jackythewannabe
source: POKENAME is driven by a strong desire to help others. Though it has great potential, it doesn't know how to tap into this power.

entry: POKENAME为尼多兰族群侦察，从高处树枝上巡视四周。发现危险，就振翅产生独特频率的嗡鸣，提醒下方的族群。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME acts as a scout for Nidoran colonies, scanning the area from high up tree branches. It alerts the crowd beneath to danger with a unique buzzing frequency generated by the beat of its wings.

entry: POKENAME高速掠过栖居的沼泽，吓出藏在草里的小宝可梦。等猎物逃到开阔处，它就凶猛地俯冲而下。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME blast through the air at high speed, flying over the marshes they call home. They frighten smaller Pokémon from within the marsh grass, flushing them out into the open and descending in a vicious fervor.

entry: POKENAME大半时间都在寻找树果，尤其喜欢沙鳞果。它在空心树里筑巢，尽可能找来树果，把巢塞得满满的。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME spend most of their time hunting for berries, having a particular interest in Salac Berries. They make their nests in hollow trees, filling them to the brim with as many berries as they can find.

entry: POKENAME会猛烈振翅，提醒人类有危险。可惜它太小，训练家根本听不见。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME aggressively flap their wings to warn humans of danger. Unfortunately, they're too tiny for Trainers to hear them.

entry: POKENAME生活在湖畔，嗡嗡地飞到结果的植物旁，寻找食物。双眼能察觉周围360度，逼近的威胁。
author: melodydelune
source: Living along lakes, POKENAME will buzz around fruiting plants to eat. Their eyes allow them to see approaching threats 360° around them.

entry: POKENAME背上长着巢，迁徙的蜻蜻蜓途中会本能地进去歇脚。它腹部发光，为夜行的虫属性宝可梦指明安全的庇护处。
author: pjporwoll
source: A hive grows on POKENAME's back, which migratory Yanma instinctively use to rest within while journeying. Its underbelly glows to signal a safe haven to nocturnal Bug-type Pokémon.

entry: 这种英勇的宝可梦总用敏锐的昆虫眼睛警戒危险。一察觉敌人，就摆好进攻架势。
author: havic0970
source: This heroic Pokémon is always on the lookout for danger with its keen, insectoid eyes. When it senses an enemy, it poises to strike.

entry: POKENAME不会走路，却是飞行和游泳的高手。它大多待在浅水，捕捉小虫和甲壳类，靠迅速进出水面躲避天敌。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is unable to walk, but is a masterful flyer and swimmer. It spends most of its time in the shallows, hunting small insects and crustaceans, and avoids predators by darting in and out of the water.

entry: POKENAME虽然能向任何方向飞行，却始终面朝北。它喜欢尽速飞行，将路上的鸟宝可梦统统撞晕。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite being able to fly in any direction, POKENAME will always be facing north. It likes to fly as fast as it can, knocking out any bird Pokémon in its path.

entry: POKENAME疯狂振翅时，能让周围宝可梦晕头转向，再用刀刃精准攻击。它通常栖居在密林和丛林深处，那里阳光难以穿透。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it frantically beats its wings, it can disorient the Pokémon around it, leaving them vulnerable to precise strikes from its blade. POKENAME typically inhabits the heart of dense forests and thick jungles, where sunlight struggles to penetrate.

entry: POKENAME爱互相赛跑，宁可留在地上，也不用强劲的翅膀飞行。它会改用翅膀制造破坏性冲击波，威力足以击碎防弹玻璃。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME love to race against each other, preferring to stay grounded than to use their powerful wings. Instead, they use them to create damaging shockwaves that are strong enough to smash bulletproof glass.

entry: POKENAME飞过沼泽时，振翅声能让附近的生命平静下来。它飞得越快，效果就越强。
author: .izik
source: While flying through marshlands, the sound from POKENAME's wings induces calm in those nearby. The effect intensifies the faster it flies.

entry: POKENAME常以超音速飞行，竞速般掠过飞机，似乎只为享受飞快的感觉。特殊管道连着胸部储氧的空腔，让它在这种高速下仍能呼吸。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME regularly fly at supersonic speeds, racing past aircraft seemingly just for the thrill of flying fast. They have a special tube connecting to a cavity in their chest that contains oxygen, allowing them to breathe despite their speed.

entry: 日落时，POKENAME借栖居沼泽产生的温暖上升气流升空。它用腹部的大复眼寻找新落脚处，留待白天休息。
author: vic1312
source: As the sun sets, POKENAME rise into the air on the warm updrafts produced by the swamps they call home. They utilize the large, compound eye on their underbelly to spot a new place for them to land and rest at during the day.

entry: POKENAME振翅时会产生宜人的暖意。它与同类边飞边吐小火球，玩打仗游戏，看能否把对方击落地面。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wings generate a pleasant warmth when they flap. It play-fights with others of its kind by spitting out small fireballs while flying and seeing if they can snip each other down to the ground.

entry: POKENAME胆小极了，察觉一点动静就拼命往地下钻。翅膀虽小，却能拍得极快，让它稍稍悬离地面。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are incredibly skittish, as they will frantically burrow themselves into the ground when they sense the slightest movement. Despite their small wings, POKENAME can beat them so fast that they can hover above the ground slightly.

entry: POKENAME眼睛敏锐，视野宽阔清晰。虽然还在发育，也能隐约看见他人的波导，甚至看穿实体障碍。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's eyes are very sharp, giving it a wide range of clear vision. Though still developing, they also allow it to faintly see the auras of others, even through solid obstacles.

entry: POKENAME落在路灯上吸收电能。吸取电流时，翅膀会发出响亮的嗡鸣。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lands atop streetlights to absorb electrical energy. Its wings buzz loudly as it drains the current.

entry: POKENAME的红色花纹和坚硬外骨骼，能吓退想轻松吃点东西的天敌，弥补尚未发育完全的翅膀无法支撑长途飞行的不足。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's red markings and tough exoskeleton deter predators who want a quick snack. This makes up for its developing wings, which cannot support its weight for long flights.

entry: POKENAME的颚看起来小而无害，可一有虫属性宝可梦靠近它在沙中的藏身处，颚就能瞬间伸出，抓住猎物。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's jaws appear small and unthreatening, but when a Bug-type Pokémon draws near the fusion's hiding place in the sand, they can extend in an instant to snatch the prey.

entry: POKENAME头骨坚硬，飞行又没准头，能严重破坏城市。它若铁了心，连强化玻璃也挡不住。
author: currentlymuffin
source: With their hard skulls and erratic flying, POKENAME can cause severe damage to cities. Even reinforced glass can't withstand a determined POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME迅速振翅，推动身体高速前进，也为尾焰送入氧气。修长柔韧的身体让它转弯流畅，尾巴也会随之调整。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME rapidly flap their wings to propel themselves at incredible speeds and feed oxygen into the flames on their tails. Their long, flexible bodies allow them to take turns smoothly while adjusting their tails as needed.

entry: POKENAME身上覆着绿色液体，过去曾被用于提升速度的药物。后来发现会使宝可梦行为失常，便不再采用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is coated in a green fluid once used in speed-enhancing medicine. The practice was discontinued due to causing erratic behavior in Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME高速嗡鸣着飞过高草，撒播花粉，帮助附近植物生长。即使强风中也能轻松飞行。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME buzzes at high speeds over tall grass, scattering pollen that helps the surrounding plants grow. It can fly easily in even high winds.

entry: POKENAME从空中猛冲，用带刺的金属身体撞击大比鸟等天敌。冲撞的力量连钢板也能撞凹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME charges through the air and slams its spiked metallic body into predators like Pidgeot. The impact leaves dents even in steel plating.

entry: POKENAME能借翅膀短促而快速地滑翔，避开争斗，还能边用獠牙划开树干，直接吸食树汁。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have wings that allow them to glide for short, but quick, bursts. These quick moves also allow them to avoid fights while cutting into trees with their tusks so they can suck at the sap directly.

entry: POKENAME每秒振翅60次，托起身体。短喙喝不到花蜜，因此只能嗡嗡飞着寻找树果啄食。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME flap their wings at 60 times per second to lift their bodies. They are unable to drink nectar because of their short beaks, so they buzz around to find berries to peck at.

entry: POKENAME空中身手灵活，不用转身就能改变方向。从上方发现猎物后，就以超音速俯冲向地面。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has great aerial mobility, able to change directions without turning its body. It will spot its prey from above and then dive towards the ground at supersonic speeds.

entry: POKENAME飞过沼泽时，会喷火开路。火焰的热量能烘干整片沼泽草地。
author: .izik
source: While flying over marshes, POKENAME spits fire to clear its path. The heat from its flames can dry entire patches of swamp grass.

entry: POKENAME振动叶片，以尖锐声音扰乱敌人。最外层的叶片可以充当翅膀，让它短距离飞行。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME vibrates its leaves to disorient foes with high-pitched sounds. Its outermost leaves can act as wings, allowing POKENAME to fly for short distances.

entry: POKENAME深夜在沼泽里飞窜。见到旅人，就模仿孩子的哭声，故意吓人取乐。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME darts around swamps late at night. If it spots travelers, it mimics the cries of children just to unsettle them-for its own amusement.

entry: POKENAME力量并不算强，却能靠速度每秒挥拳多达200次。它会尽力保护弱小的宝可梦，只是并不总能成功。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are not that physically strong, but it uses its speed to punch up to 200 times a second. It will try its best to protect weaker Pokémon, but it is not always successful.

entry: POKENAME嚎叫时，翅膀会狂猛拍动。声音在崖壁间回响，能惊吓附近的宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME howls, its wings flap with wild energy. The sound echoes through cliffs and can startle nearby Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME穿行在潮湿沼泽积水的草丛间。芦苇里一有沙沙声，附近所有同类就会毫无预兆地升空，闹哄哄地飞走。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME scurries through the waterlogged undergrowth of humid marshes. If something rustles the reeds, all the nearby POKENAME will launch into the air without warning, flying noisily away.

entry: POKENAME特化的复眼能防止灰尘进入。这一点格外重要，因为它飞掠其他宝可梦身旁时，常会迎面碰上扬尘。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have specialized compound eyes that prevent dust from getting into their eyes. This is especially important since dust tends to brush past them as they zip past other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME性情平和，遇险时会从排气口释放浓烟。它温顺，又善于控制热量与火焰，被视为新手训练家的好伙伴。
author: ahenci
source: POKENAME is a peaceful Pokémon. When in danger, it releases thick smoke from its exhaust vents. Known for its docile nature and control over heat and fire, it's considered a good companion for beginner Trainers.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀虽只能短暂飞行，夜里却能让躯干微微发光，吸引毛球等猎物。
author: .izik
source: Though its wings allow only brief flight, POKENAME glows faintly from its torso at night to lure in prey like Venonat.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀由含糖的薄脆层组成，很容易碎落。面包店很珍视它们，会拿来做纸杯蛋糕上的可食用装饰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wings are made of sugary, brittle layers that break off easily. Bakeries prize them for use as edible cupcake decorations.

entry: POKENAME高速穿过沼泽，找到深水就潜进去睡觉，靠睡莲叶保持漂浮。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME darts across marshes at high speed. Upon finding deep water, it dives in and falls asleep, its lily pad keeping it afloat.

entry: POKENAME调动精神能量时，翅膀迅速拍动。空气的振动让它在进攻前更加专注。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wings beat rapidly as it channels psychic energy. The vibrations in the air sharpen its focus before it strikes.

entry: POKENAME太重，无法真正飞行，但大翅膀能让它多跳高几英寸。这份本领主要用来跳起后以肘部下砸。
author: dylonk25
source: While POKENAME's body weight prohibits true flight, its large wings add a few extra inches to its jump height. This gift is mainly used for elbow drops.

entry: POKENAME先在地上高速奔跑，再缩进壳里，全力撞向对手。这样撞倒敌人后，它总要摆个帅气姿势，潇洒地扶一扶“眼镜”。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can run across the ground at high speeds before retreating into its shell and crashing full-force into opponents. After knocking a foe down this way, it always makes sure to pose and adjust its "glasses" in a cool manner.

entry: POKENAME虽然不会飞，背上坚挺的膜却能用来滑翔。它会从高空用护目镜般的部位锁定敌方宝可梦。
author: hushpuppy
source: While POKENAME cannot fly, the stiff membrane on its back can be used to glide. It uses its visor to lock onto enemy Pokémon from far above.

entry: POKENAME既能用壳抵挡敌人，也能借翅膀迅速逃走。它掠过海面时，会激起细小波浪。
author: bobosmith01
source: While POKENAME has a shell to defend itself from enemies, it can also flee quickly using its wings, making small waves as it darts across the sea.

entry: POKENAME极其沉重，翅膀也因此是宝可梦中最强健的一类。即便如此，它仍只能短距离飞行，常用许多小脚抓住岩石或崖壁休息。
author: bee4082
source: Due to its massive weight, POKENAME's wings are some of the strongest of all Pokémon. However, it still only flies short distances, frequently grabbing onto rocks or cliffsides with its many small legs to rest.

entry: POKENAME振翅发出催眠般的音调，令人昏昏欲睡。它只吃美梦，对噩梦全然不感兴趣。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME vibrates its wings in a hypnotic tone that causes drowsiness. It feeds only on pleasant dreams, ignoring nightmares entirely.

entry: POKENAME拿着的钟摆只是幌子，用来吸引目标的注意。真正的催眠作用，来自迅速振翅产生的奇异嗡鸣。
author: sk372
source: The pendulum POKENAME carries is actually a mere distraction, meant to keep a target's focus occupied. The actual hypnotic effect it wields comes from the strange hum it emanates with its rapid wingbeat.

entry: POKENAME背上的球茎会分泌黏滑的毒液，覆在皮肤上防晒。毒液虽有毒，却能加糖煮成黏黏的酸味糖果。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME have a bulb on their back that secretes a slimy, toxic film which covers their skin, protecting them from sunlight. Though the film is poisonous in its liquid form, it can be mixed with sugar and boiled to make a sticky, sour candy.

entry: POKENAME用头顶触角分泌的液体涂满全身，靠难闻的气味驱赶天敌。可惜大多数天敌根本不介意，导致它遭到过度捕食。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The antennae on top of a POKENAME's head secrete a liquid that they cover themselves in. This liquid is foul-smelling and designed to repel predators. Unfortunately, most predators don't mind the smell and have led to overhunting.

entry: POKENAME的两根鳃一旦碰在一起，即使碰到的是同类的鳃，也会引发爆炸。它常涂上泥防止接触，却因此像极了潜水球，被粗心的训练家捡错。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: If two gills of POKENAME ever make contact, even with another of its kind, it triggers an explosion. To prevent this, they often coat them in mud, which makes POKENAME resemble a Dive Ball, leading to careless Trainers picking them up by mistake.

entry: 这种宝可梦直到海底电缆启用后才有记录。它们在电缆周围聚居，玩累了就挨着电缆蹭一蹭，给自己充电。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: These Pokémon have only been documented since the adoption of subsea electrical cables. They form colonies around them, and play games until they tire, whereby they nuzzle into the cables and charge up.

entry: 这种宝可梦直到海底电缆启用后才有记录。它们在电缆周围聚居，玩累了就挨着电缆蹭一蹭，给自己充电。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: These Pokémon have only been documented since the adoption of subsea electrical cables. They form colonies around them, and play games until they tire, whereby they nuzzle into the cables and charge up.

entry: POKENAME开心地成群浮在浅沼泽的水面。随水起伏的模样像漂流的种子，很容易被忽略。
author: .izik
source: Clusters of POKENAME float happily on the surface of shallow marshes. Their bobbing movement resembles drifting seeds, making them easy to overlook.

entry: POKENAME失去头部似乎并不疼，只要还剩一个头，其他头就能重新长出。轻轻加热掉下的头，孔洞里会渗出液体，可作为低热量的糖替代品。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Losing heads seems to be painless for POKENAME and as long as one head remains, it can regrow the others. If the heads are gently heated, a liquid will ooze from the orifices and can be used as a low-calorie alternative to sugar.

entry: POKENAME眼里藏着深深的悲伤，与它对视的人大多都会落泪。它会安静地蹭蹭对方，随后继续永无止境的旅程，仍小心地期盼未来会更明亮。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's eyes hold a great sadness so deep that most that meet its gaze are moved to tears. POKENAME will comfort them with a quiet nuzzle, then continue its never-ending journey to a future it still dares to hope will be brighter.

entry: POKENAME满怀期待地靠近人类，轻轻把骨头推过去，只想玩一场简单的抛接游戏。若被无视或拒绝，它就瘫成一团，哭着睡去。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME approaches humans with a hopeful gaze, gently nudging its bone towards them. It longs for a simple game of fetch. If ignored or refused, it collapses in a heap and cries itself to sleep.

entry: 远看POKENAME像是腹肌结实，近看才发现只是皮肤的天然花纹。因此，人们用它的名字形容乍看很有魅力、内里却令人不快的人。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME appears to have impressive abs from a distance, but up close, is just a natural pattern on its skin. This gave rise to people calling others a POKENAME, used to describe someone who seems appealing at first, but hides an unpleasant nature.

entry: 失去了曾经最珍重的东西，POKENAME也失去了生活的目标。
author: fuade
source: Having lost what it once valued most, POKENAME finds itself without purpose.

entry: POKENAME生活在冷水中，爱舔冰块。虽然不疼，舌头却可能被冻住，得等上几分钟，冰融化后才能脱身。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME live in cold water and are prone to licking ice. Although this doesn't cause them pain it can render them immobile for a few minutes while they wait for it to melt.

entry: 工业化鼎盛时期，每周四都会有人带POKENAME游街，吸收住宅周围的污染。等身体完全鼓起，再带到下风处，让它用清除之烟排出毒素。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: During the height of industrialisation, POKENAME were paraded through the streets every Thursday to absorb pollution from around people's homes. Once fully inflated, they were taken downwind, where they expelled the toxins with Clear Smog.

entry: POKENAME常挂在水域上方蜕变。遇到威胁就掉进水里，外皮立即变硬。虽然这样很安全，却无法生长，因此还得冒险重新离水。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME often hang above bodies of water, undergoing metamorphosis. When threatened they drop into the water, where their outer skin instantly hardens. Whilst they are safe in this state, they cannot grow, so must venture out of the water again.

entry: POKENAME爱吃腐烂的西兰花和臭掉的欧洲防风。再配上兰紫色花蜜，它就会高兴得分泌黏胶。这种分泌物效力极强，仅一份就能提炼出多达10000瓶特攻强化。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME loves rotting broccoli and putrid parsnips. When paired with Purple Nectar, it becomes so happy it releases a sticky goo. This secretion is highly potent, just one sample can be refined into as many as 10,000 bottles of X Sp. Atk.

entry: 同样密实沉重的宝可梦常在湿地寸步难行，POKENAME却适应得很好。宽脚让它不易下陷，始终有4处着地，其中尾巴甚至能撑住全身重量。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Similarly dense Pokémon often struggle to get around in wetlands, but POKENAME is well adapted to them. Its wide feet ensure it doesn't sink, and it always has 4 points of contact with the ground, including its tail, which can hold its entire weight.

entry: POKENAME在水里格外灵活，上岸后却难以挪动肥大的身体。它把角抵在物体上，帮助自己站稳，却常把支撑物戳穿。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Although especially lithe in water, when POKENAME is on land it struggles to move its great girth. It rests its horn against objects to help it remain upright, which often causes them to become punctured.

entry: POKENAME从袋里分泌具有疗愈作用的黏液，深受宝可梦中心重视。它常陪在伤病宝可梦身边，轻声唱歌，为对方涂上黏液。据说光是待在附近，就能加快康复、减轻疼痛。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME secretes a healing mucus from its pouch that is prized by Pokémon Centers. It's often found near sick or injured Pokémon, singing softly while coating them in the goo. Its presence alone is said to speed up recovery and ease pain.

entry: POKENAME常被卡住或缠住，便懊恼地细声叫着，等待宝可梦或训练家来救。获救后会蹭蹭恩人，留下一层气味宜人的薄膜。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME frequently gets stuck or tangled up. It meeps remorsefully, waiting for a Pokémon or Trainer to rescue it. Once freed, they nuzzle their rescuer, leaving a pleasant-smelling film on them.

entry: 与多数宝可梦不同，POKENAME的袋子能像睡袋一样完全封住，靠特殊器官产生的黏液粘紧。这对保护幼崽至关重要，因为它们完全成熟前都不能在水下呼吸。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Unlike most Pokémon, POKENAME's pouch can seal completely like a Sleeping Bag. A special organ produces a sticky secretion that keeps it shut. This is vital for protecting its young, who can't breathe underwater until they reach full maturity.

entry: POKENAME喷墨汁自卫，墨汁会与鱼鳞反应，腐蚀鱼鳞并引起灼痛。不过对人类无害，古人曾用它文身，相信能防止感染。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME defends itself by squirting ink that reacts with fish scales, causing a burning sensation as they begin to erode. It is harmless to humans and ancient cultures used the ink in tattoos, believing its properties helped prevent infection.

entry: POKENAME喷墨汁自卫，墨汁会与鱼鳞反应，腐蚀鱼鳞并引起灼痛。不过对人类无害，古人曾用它文身，相信能防止感染。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME defends itself by squirting ink that reacts with fish scales, causing a burning sensation as they begin to erode. It is harmless to humans and ancient cultures used the ink in tattoos, believing its properties helped prevent infection.

entry: POKENAME在湖底成批产蛋，再喷上凝胶保护。幼崽孵出后，会吃穿凝胶，获得足以独立生存的能量。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME lay clutches of eggs at the bottom of lakes and squirts a gel over them to protect them. When they hatch, the young Pokémon eat through the gel, giving them enough energy to survive on their own.

entry: POKENAME从一个池塘无助地扑腾到另一个，水花四溅。途中，它用角吓退想趁虚而入的天敌。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flops helplessly from pond to pond, splashing about as it moves. During this time, it uses its horn to deter predators from taking advantage of its struggle.

entry: POKENAME冬天待在海里，夏天则逆流游到冰川湖，无法忍受明显高于冰点的温度。圈养尝试总告失败，因为它会埋进角落，拒绝进食。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME spends winters in the ocean, but in summer, it swims upriver to glacial lakes, unable to tolerate temperatures much above freezing. Attempts to keep it in captivity fail as it buries itself in a corner and refuses to eat.

entry: POKENAME常挂在水域上方蜕变。遇到威胁就掉进水里，外皮立即变硬。虽然这样很安全，却无法生长，因此还得冒险重新离水。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME often hang above bodies of water, undergoing metamorphosis. When threatened they drop into the water, where their outer skin instantly hardens. Whilst they are safe in this state, they cannot grow, so must venture out of the water again.

entry: 每只POKENAME的翅膀都独一无二，颜色取决于曾造访的花。翅膀必须一直湿润，否则就会皱缩，无法托起身体。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Every POKENAME's wings are unique as they get their colouration from the types of flowers they visit. Their wings need to be kept constantly wet otherwise they will shrivel up and be unable to hold the POKENAME's weight.

entry: POKENAME每条臂上的鳃随年龄不断变长，最终覆满全身。它通过鳃汲取精神能量，读取心声，在对方采取行动前就感知意图。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The gills along each arm grow longer with age, eventually covering the body entirely. Through these gills, POKENAME taps into Psychic energy, allowing it to read minds and sense intentions before a single move is made.

entry: 进化后，POKENAME依然渴求水之石。有些年长个体会在巢里藏多达3块，严防其他宝可梦拿走，连乌星星也不例外。这种行为衍生出许多神话。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: After evolving, POKENAME still desires Water Stones. Older members of the species have been known to keep up to 3 in their nest, guarding them from other Pokémon, even Wooyu. Much mythology surrounds this behaviour.

entry: 一有人看它，POKENAME就开心地跳舞，嘴咧成大大的笑容。观众也会忍不住加入，舞步越跳越不规律。若有人跳完全程，它就会赠送一件物品。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME dances happily whenever someone looks at it, its mouth becoming a big grin. Onlookers cannot help but join it in its dance, which grows increasingly erratic. Should one complete the dance, POKENAME will gift them an item.

entry: 一有人看它，POKENAME就开心地跳舞。观众也会忍不住加入，舞步越跳越不规律。有些人没跳完就累晕了，让它十分难过。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME dances happily whenever someone looks at it. Onlookers cannot help but join it in its dance, which grows increasingly erratic. Some who begin the dance pass out from exhaustion before finishing, greatly saddening POKENAME.

entry: 一有人看它，POKENAME就开心地跳舞。观众也会忍不住加入，舞步越跳越不规律。有些人没跳完就累晕了，让它十分难过。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME dances happily whenever someone looks at it. Onlookers cannot help but join it in its dance, which grows increasingly erratic. Some who begin the dance pass out from exhaustion before finishing, greatly saddening POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME善于捕捉水中猎物，大眼睛擅长判断折射、充分利用光线。可到了陆地，这反而让它刺激过度，笨拙地跌跌撞撞。有些训练家便为它制作墨镜。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is adept at catching prey in water, with its large eyes well-suited to judging refraction and maximising light. When on land, this leads to over-stimulation and it stumbles around clumsily. Some Trainers have taken to making it sunglasses.

entry: POKENAME有时会造访世界最寒冷地区的聚落，跳起奇怪的舞。观众会装扮成它的模样，若能受邀一起跳舞，被视为莫大的荣耀。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME would sometimes visit settlements in the coldest regions of the world, performing strange dances. Onlookers would dress up like them, and it was considered a great honour to be invited to dance amongst POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME群体有时会造访世界最寒冷地区的聚落，跳起奇怪的舞。只有一位训练家获准同行，多年后归来，讲述种种奇幻故事。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME colonies sometimes visit settlements in the coldest regions of the world, performing strange dances. A single Trainer is permitted to accompany them, returning after many years to tell fantastical stories.

entry: POKENAME走到哪就乱到哪，拨歪电视天线、堵住排水槽，还随机放电使家电短路。可一被责骂，它就紧紧蜷成球，以为这样就没人看得见。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Causing chaos wherever it goes, POKENAME turns TV aerials the wrong way, clogs gutters, and shorts out appliances by discharging electricity at random. However, the moment it's scolded, it curls up into a tight ball, believing that it can't be seen.

entry: POKENAME不断散出热雾，让密闭空间变成闷热的蒸汽房。使出火焰拳时，骤增的热量瞬间汽化附近水分，以滚烫的雾笼罩敌人，造成严重烫伤。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME constantly emits a hot mist from its body, turning enclosed spaces into sweltering steam rooms. When it uses Fire Punch, the sudden heat flash-vaporizes nearby moisture, engulfing foes in a scalding haze that leaves severe burns.

entry: 年幼的POKENAME会经历凶猛的出牙期，本能地见什么咬什么。每窝幼崽中，谁能咬穿筑巢的岩石，谁就是首领。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When young, POKENAME go through a fierce teething stage, driven by an instinctual urge to bite anything they can. Within each litter, the alpha is determined by whichever manages to bite through the rocks that make up their nest.

entry: 年幼的POKENAME会经历凶猛的出牙期，本能地见什么咬什么。每窝幼崽中，谁能咬穿筑巢的岩石，谁就是首领。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When young, POKENAME go through a fierce teething stage, driven by an instinctual urge to bite anything they can. Within each litter, the alpha is determined by whichever manages to bite through the rocks that make up their nest.

entry: POKENAME以暴烈发作闻名，发狂时旁观者最好远远避开。它住在海崖上，不停踩踏，加快岩石风化，常留下堆积的粉笔石。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Known for its violent outbursts, it would behoove any onlookers to stand clear when POKENAME runs amok. They make their homes atop seaside cliffs, where their constant trampling accelerates weathering, often leaving behind deposits of Chalky Stone.

entry: POKENAME生活在浅沼泽，埋进泥里降温。若玩耍时搁浅，就会无助地扑腾，直到再次没入水中。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lives in shallow marshes, where it buries itself in mud to stay cool. If it beaches itself while playing, it will flop around helplessly until it manages to submerge again.

entry: 新生POKENAME的鳃太小，无法在水下呼吸，只能到陆地觅食，因此格外脆弱。长大后，它一次就能在水下待数小时。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The gills on a newborn POKENAME are so small they can't breathe underwater, so must forage on land. They are vulnerable at this stage, but when they have grown, they can stay underwater for hours at a time.

entry: POKENAME的鳃极其灵敏，隔着许多英里，也能发现最爱的藻类。它虽体型庞大，却非常温柔，常将小宝可梦托在盘曲的身体上，送到安全处。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its highly sensitive gills can detect the presence of its favorite algae even from many miles away. Despite its large size, POKENAME is extremely gentle and often carries smaller Pokémon on its coils to bring them to safety.

entry: POKENAME通常一动不动，悠然看着世事变迁。洋流将小石块带入身体的缝隙，渐渐磨得光滑。多年后，碎片被冲出来，常被误认为海边的玻璃。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are usually motionless, content to let the world pass by. Ocean currents carry small stones into crevices on their body, where over time they're polished smooth. After many years, these fragments wash free, often mistaken for Beach Glass.

entry: POKENAME通常一动不动，悠然看着世事变迁。洋流将小石块带入身体的缝隙，渐渐磨得光滑。多年后，碎片被冲出来，常被误认为海边的玻璃。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are usually motionless, content to let the world pass by. Ocean currents carry small stones into crevices on their body, where over time they're polished smooth. After many years, these fragments wash free, often mistaken for Beach Glass.

entry: POKENAME常咕噜着说话，像人类婴儿的牙牙学语。奇怪的语言激起其他宝可梦的想象，它们会献上宝可尾草、南国贝壳之类的小玩意，换取故事。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is usually found gurgling in a language reminiscent of human baby gobbledygook. This strange speech captures the imagination of other Pokémon, who offer it trinkets like Poké Toys or Tropical Shells in exchange for stories.

entry: POKENAME常咕噜着说话，像人类婴儿的牙牙学语。奇怪的语言激起其他宝可梦的想象，它们会献上宝可尾草、南国贝壳之类的小玩意，换取故事。

entry: POKENAME不稳定的DNA难以固定形态，偶尔会突然恶心。有些训练家说，让它拿着特防强化能缓解症状；也有人坚称，一棵沾泥的卷心菜同样管用。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME occasionally suffers from sudden bouts of nausea as its unstable DNA struggles to settle into a fixed form. Some Trainers claim that giving it an X Sp. Def to hold eases the symptoms, while others insist a muddy cabbage works just as well.

entry: POKENAME不稳定的DNA难以固定形态，偶尔会突然恶心。有些训练家说，让它拿着特防强化能缓解症状；也有人坚称，一棵沾泥的卷心菜同样管用。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME occasionally suffers from sudden bouts of nausea as its unstable DNA struggles to settle into a fixed form. Some Trainers claim that giving it an X Sp. Def to hold eases the symptoms, while others insist a muddy cabbage works just as well.

entry: POKENAME覆着黏稠的毒膜，既能保护身体，也能让它融入水中。毒膜使身体周围的光线偏折，令它几乎隐形。在水下使出溶化后，更是几乎碰不到它。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is coated in a sticky, poisonous film that offers protection and helps it blend seamlessly into water. The substance bends light around its body, rendering it nearly invisible. When it uses Acid Armor underwater, it's almost untouchable.

entry: POKENAME覆着黏稠的毒膜，既能保护身体，也能让它融入水中。毒膜使身体周围的光线偏折，令它几乎隐形。在水下使出溶化后，更是几乎碰不到它。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is coated in a sticky, poisonous film that offers protection and helps it blend seamlessly into water. The substance bends light around its body, rendering it nearly invisible. When it uses Acid Armor underwater, it's almost untouchable.

entry: 据说很久以前，一只POKENAME带着金色叶子来到雷电不息的草原深处。强大的雷击让它的身体永远改变，直到今天，碰一下它的毛，就能击晕一只成年的宝可梦。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Long ago, it is said that a POKENAME carried a Gold Leaf to the heart of the steppe, where lightning never ceased. Struck by a mighty bolt, its body was changed forever. Even today, its fur can knock out a full-grown Pokémon with a single touch.

entry: POKENAME会对幼崽轻轻使出火焰牙，通过游戏教它们自卫，并非要伤害它们。危险逼近时，它们本能地钻进泥里，只露出微微抽动、感知振动的鳃。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME uses a gentle form of Fire Fang on its young, not to harm them, but to teach them self-defence through play. When danger approaches, they instinctively burrow into the mud, hiding everything but their gills, which twitch to sense vibrations.

entry: POKENAME将黏液涂上海底电缆，形成导电通路，让自己进入数字系统、穿行网络空间。它非常害怕含蛇的游戏，若和它们处于同一数据层，可能使系统崩溃。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME enters cyberspace by secreting a slime onto subsea cables, creating a conductive path that lets it phase into digital systems. It has a deep fear of games that contain snakes and may crash a system if it finds itself on the same data layer.

entry: 遇到威胁，POKENAME就缩进壳里。鳃太大，收不进去，于是它会分泌毒膜覆住鳃，损伤攻击者的神经。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When threatened, POKENAME withdraws into its shell. Its gills are too large to fit in with the rest of it, so they have developed a poisonous film that they excrete onto their gills, causing nerve damage to anything that tries to attack it.

entry: POKENAME可爱的外表掩盖了凶猛性情和旺盛食欲。它装得温顺爱玩，引来小宝可梦，再使出尖刺加农炮。它在寒冷湖泊里生活得很好。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's cute looks belie their vicious nature and appetite. They lure in smaller Pokémon by acting docile and playful, then launch Spike Cannon attacks. They thrive in cold lakes.

entry: POKENAME在小水域底部休眠，鳃能吸收水中悬浮的微量养分。此时耗能极少，其他宝可梦都以为它已经死了。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME lay dormant at the bottom of small bodies of water. Their gills can absorb the tiniest sustenance suspended in the water. They use so little energy in this state, that other Pokémon assume they are dead.

entry: POKENAME视力差，嗅觉也弱，住在地下含水层深处。它整天制作浑圆的光滑泥球，雌性会以此挑选伴侣。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: With weak eyesight and a poor sense of smell, POKENAME dwells deep within underground aquifers. It spends its days crafting a perfectly round Polished Mud Ball, which females use to judge potential mates.

entry: POKENAME在深达5千米的水下无声猎食，坚硬的壳能轻松抵住巨大水压。双臂动作精细，甚至曾在人类医生短缺时，帮忙进行手术。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME hunts silently at depths reaching 5 km, its tough shell easily withstanding the crushing pressure. Its arms are precise enough for delicate tasks, and it has even been known to assist in surgery when human doctors are scarce.

entry: POKENAME在深达5千米的水下无声猎食，坚硬的壳能轻松抵住巨大水压。双臂动作精细，甚至曾在人类医生短缺时，帮忙进行手术。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME hunts silently at depths reaching 5 km, its tough shell easily withstanding the crushing pressure. Its arms are precise enough for delicate tasks, and it has even been known to assist in surgery when human doctors are scarce.

entry: POKENAME在海上翱翔，很少降落。发现猎物就俯冲，向后收起鳃，让猎物难以从蓝天中辨出这只蓝色捕食者。近来数量激增，让人担心捕食过度。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME soars over oceans, rarely landing. It dives down when it spots prey, pulling back its gills so the prey struggles to make out the blue predator from the sky above. Its population has recently exploded, sparking fears of overhunting.

entry: POKENAME体温寒冷，鳃常冻住，略感不适。训练家若帮它掰动鳃，破开冰、恢复知觉，它会十分感激。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's gills freeze in place from the coldness of its body, which causes it mild discomfort. It greatly appreciates any Trainer who cracks its gills, breaking the ice and bringing back feeling.

entry: POKENAME向上放出雷电，击中毫无防备的鸟宝可梦。它最爱的游戏，是赶在猎物落地前接住。即使不饿也照玩，因此被它击中，未必就会送命。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME sends jolts of lightning upwards, hitting unsuspecting bird Pokémon. Its favourite game is trying to catch its prey before they hit the ground. It does this even when it isn't hungry, so being hit by POKENAME isn't necessarily fatal.

entry: POKENAME排出体内的水，水被内部高热瞬间蒸发，产生升力，让它短暂飞行。不过，它得常回水里滋润皮肤，否则可能过热、干枯。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME expels water from its body, which instantly evaporates due to its intense internal heat, creating lift for short bursts of flight. However, it must frequently return to water to rehydrate its skin, or it risks overheating and drying out.

entry: POKENAME似乎最爱龙之怒，用来让自己开心，却会让皮肤干燥。训练家得小心维持它的好心情，否则它会毁坏周围一带。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's favourite move seems to be Dragon Rage, which it uses to cheer itself up, but causes its skin to dry out. Trainers have to be careful to keep it happy, otherwise it will devastate the local area.

entry: 融合技术出现前，人们以为POKENAME已被猎杀殆尽。战利品猎人珍视它颈上的水晶，磨亮后当作稀有弹珠陈列。已知最大的收藏共有21颗。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Before the advent of fusion technology, POKENAME were believed to be hunted to extinction. Trophy hunters prized the crystal on their necks, polishing and displaying them as a rare Marble. The largest known collection ever assembled contained 21.

entry: 融合技术出现前，人们以为POKENAME已被猎杀殆尽。战利品猎人珍视它颈上的水晶，磨亮后当作稀有弹珠陈列。如今，它已是受保护物种。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Before the advent of fusion technology, POKENAME were believed to have been hunted to extinction. Trophy hunters prized the crystals on their necks, polishing and displaying them as a rare Marble. They are now a protected species.

entry: POKENAME平时动作笨拙，使出龙之俯冲时却壮观得令人叹服。目标有时被那气势震住，甚至忘了躲开。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Although quite clumsy in its everyday movements, watching POKENAME perform Dragon Rush is truly a spectacle to behold. Targets are sometimes stunned by its majesty and don't even try to get out of the way.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，什么东西靠得太近，就俯冲过去用刺攻击。它在水边的泥里产蛋，却似乎一产完就忘了。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are very territorial and will dive at anything that gets too near, striking with their stingers. They lay their eggs in the mud near water but seem to forget about them as soon as they are laid.

entry: POKENAME爱用念力举起泥巴，再像淋浴一样撒在自己身上，享受这简单的快乐。其他宝可梦会献上食物，若送来它最爱的西葫芦，有时能得到进化的回报。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME delights in the simple pleasure of telekinetically lifting mud and letting it rain over itself like a shower. Other Pokémon bring it offerings of food, and those who present its favourite, courgette, are sometimes rewarded with evolution.

entry: 据说POKENAME诞生于纯粹的机缘巧合，在广阔湿地中飘游，身后拖着丝带般的精神能量。它极少现身，目击者却说，它会赠予一片银色叶子，作为心灵纯洁的证明。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Said to be born of pure serendipity, POKENAME drifts through sprawling wetlands, trailing ribbons of Psychic energy in its wake. It's rarely seen, but those who do spot one say it gifts them a single Silver Leaf, as proof of being pure of heart.

entry: 据说POKENAME诞生于纯粹的机缘巧合，在广阔湿地中飘游，身后拖着丝带般的精神能量。它极少现身，目击者却说，它会赠予一片银色叶子，作为心灵纯洁的证明。

entry: POKENAME懒洋洋地沿河漂流，吸收阳光。有危险的东西从头顶飞过，它就潜水藏起来。温湿度恰好合适时，它会异常活跃，力量也出奇强大；每只偏好的温湿度都不同。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME drifts lazily along rivers, soaking up sunlight. When something threatening flies overhead, it dives out of sight. At just the right temperature and humidity, which varies for each member, it becomes hyperactive, and surprisingly powerful.

entry: 夏季，POKENAME头顶的叶片吸收阳光，长得十分茂盛。它喜欢训练家定期修剪、温柔照料。叶片配上烤茄子，能添一份清香，成为夏日美食。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: In summer, the leaf atop POKENAME's head flourishes as it absorbs sunlight. It enjoys the gentle care of Trainers who prune it regularly. When paired with roasted eggplant, the leaf adds a fragrant touch, making for a summer treat.

entry: POKENAME能嗅出病树，蹭着树干分泌物质，杀死大多数寄生虫，是尽责护林人的好搭档。研究者正探索这种疗愈分泌物治疗人类疾病的潜力。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME can sniff out sick trees and rub its body against them, secreting a substance that kills most parasites. The counterpart of any dedicated forester, its healing secretions are now being studied for potential use in treating human disease.

entry: 只有极度危险时，POKENAME才从背上喷出滚烫的水。热量会损伤自身皮肤，让它明显感到疼痛。好在伤口愈合很快，研究者认为，这项特征正是为支撑这种冒险的防御而演化。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME sprays scalding water from its back, but only in extreme danger. The attack causes it visible pain, as the heat damages its own skin. Fortunately, its body heals quickly, a trait researchers believe evolved to support this risky defence.

entry: 睡前，POKENAME会涂满泥巴，吸出毒素，滋养皮肤。不过，它做美梦时会从背部和头上喷水，因此很容易被发现。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Before going to sleep, POKENAME covers itself in mud to draw out toxins and invigorate its skin. It is easy to spot, however, as when it is having a good dream, it spurts water from its back and head.

entry: POKENAME堆出足以容身睡觉的泥丘，再用火焰轮烤硬。夜里常邀结识的小宝可梦一起住，天亮就离开，每晚另建新居。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME gathers mud and shapes it into a mound large enough to sleep in, then uses Flame Wheel to bake it solid. It spends the night inside, often with smaller Pokémon it befriends. At dawn, it moves on, building a new shelter each evening.

entry: POKENAME在河岸筑巢，用类似波波的独特叫声吸引伴侣。不过，它鸣叫时还会喷出大量水，因此声音咕噜咕噜，最后还带一声响亮的水花。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME build their nests on riverbanks. They attract mates with a distinctive call similar to that of a Pidgey's, except POKENAME simultaneously expel great volumes of water. This causes it to sound more gurgled, followed by a big splash.

entry: POKENAME甩尾搅动河床，扬起细小泥沙，再用浓泥裹住身体，锁住水分、保护敏感皮肤。这样就能在陆地待得更久，不易干燥。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME thrashes its tail to churn riverbeds, kicking up fine sediment. It then coats its body in the thick mud, which helps trap moisture and protect its sensitive skin. This allows it to spend longer periods on land without drying out.

entry: POKENAME住在河边，察觉一丝危险就用尾巴拍水。清脆的响声能惊吓天敌，也能提醒族群中的同伴。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME lives along riversides and reacts to the slightest hint of danger by slapping its tail against the water's surface. The sharp crack it creates can startle predators and serves as a warning signal to alert others in its group.

entry: POKENAME覆着滑溜的薄膜，能轻松爬上天敌身体，抢走对方的猎物再滑走。虽然冒险，却很少被抓住。它偶尔也偷人类的东西，把闪亮物品误当成食物。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is coated in a slippery film, allowing it to climb predators with ease and snatch their catch before slipping away. Though risky, it's rarely caught. It occasionally steals from humans too, mistaking shiny objects for food.

entry: POKENAME总在尖叫，有人说它能感知天气变化，正试图提醒其他生命。泥巢虽然会被大雨冲走，它却总在第一滴雨落下前离开。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is always screeching. Some say it can sense weather patterns and is trying to warn others. Its mud-nests wash away in heavy rain, though POKENAME always depart before the first drop falls.

entry: POKENAME总在尖叫，有人说它能感知天气变化，正试图提醒其他生命。泥巢虽然会被大雨冲走，它却总在第一滴雨落下前离开。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is always screeching. Some say it can sense weather patterns and is trying to warn others. Its mud-nests wash away in heavy rain, though POKENAME always depart before the first drop falls.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀更适合水中而非空中，能以最高每小时90千米的速度破水前进。上岸后却平静合群，常与同伴挤在一起，在水下从不这样。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's wings are better adapted for water than air, allowing it to slice through currents at speeds up to 90 km/h. On land, however, it becomes calm and sociable, often seen huddling with others, behaviour it never displays while underwater.
