author: whatagooddaytodie
source: An ancient text exists that seems to be a transcription of a panegyric praising a group of POKENAME for fighting off a group of sea monsters and saving the city. They continue to do what they can to protect people and their Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME喜欢极端环境，酷热或严寒、极湿或极干都合心意，因此遍布世界许多地方。它能控制体内的火囊，为自己降温或保暖。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME prefers extremes: extreme heat or extreme cold, extreme humidity or extreme dryness. As a result, POKENAME can be found in many places around the globe. It can cool itself down or warm itself up by controlling the flame sac inside its body.

entry: POKENAME生活在珊瑚礁附近，钻进海底沉积物。黏滑的身体完美融入浑浊环境，天敌几乎看不见。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lives near reefs, where it burrows into the sediment on the ocean floor. Its slimy body blends in perfectly with the murky surroundings, making it nearly invisible to predators.

entry: 对POKENAME来说，越闪亮就越有魅力。它用亮泽的唾液涂身，增添光彩，还爱收集闪亮物品，骄傲地展示；甚至有人见过它带着闪亮邮件。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: For POKENAME, attractiveness is measured by how shiny it appears. It produces a glossy saliva that it rubs into its body to enhance its sheen. Known to collect and proudly display sparkling objects, some have even been found carrying Glitter Mail.

entry: 运动时，POKENAME体内的火焰被推离内脏，腹部花纹因而亮得白热。若过热，就会从嘴里冒出一点火。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When exercising, the patterns on POKENAME's stomach glow white-hot, as the fire within it is pushed away from its internal organs. If it overheats, it releases a spark of fire from its mouth.

entry: 运动时，POKENAME体内的火焰被推离内脏，腹部花纹因而亮得白热。它能用黏液覆身，即使内部高温，摸起来依然凉爽。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When exercising, the patterns on POKENAME's stomach glow white-hot, as the fire within it is pushed away from its internal organs. It is able to cover itself in a goo to make it cool to the touch, despite its high internal temperature.

entry: POKENAME藏在泥泞的斗篷下，模仿溺亡乌波的样子，避开阳光，常潜伏在泥沼。试图偷看伪装下方的人，会感到无尽悲伤，此后再也不谈此事。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME hides beneath a muddy cloak, mimicking the appearance of a drowned Wooper. It avoids sunlight and is often found lurking in bogs. Those who try to peek under its disguise report overwhelming sorrow, and never speak of it again.

entry: POKENAME使用的布料在阳光下很快褪色，使它显得十分苍白。试图偷看伪装下方的人，会感到无尽悲伤，此后再也不谈此事。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The fabric POKENAME uses bleaches quickly in the sunlight, making it appear very pale. Those who try to peek under its disguise report overwhelming sorrow and never speak of it again.

entry: POKENAME跌跌撞撞地乱走，从不看路。攻击者咬到难吃的布料，很快就会退缩。试图偷看伪装下方的人，会感到无尽悲伤，此后再也不谈此事。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME bumbles around, never looking where it is going. Anything that attacks it is quickly put off when getting a mouthful of its foul-tasting fabric. Those who try to peek under its disguise report overwhelming sorrow and never speak of it again.

entry: POKENAME消化泥土，合成坚韧的丝，织成陷阱，冬季会散出柔和暖意。猎物被温暖吸引，自愿走入，随后陷进无痛、无尽的睡眠，再也不醒。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME synthesizes strong webbing by digesting mud, spinning it into traps that radiate gentle heat during winter. Drawn in by the warmth, prey willingly enter and are lulled into an endless, painless sleep from which they never awaken.

entry: POKENAME生活在地下湖，大多待在浑浊湖底。什么掉下来都吃，连石头等不能食用的东西也不例外。胃里的特殊黏液能让这些东西顺利通过身体。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Found living in underground lakes, POKENAME spends most of its time in the murky bottom. Anything that falls will be consumed, even inedible things like rocks. It produces a special mucus in its stomach that allows these things to pass through it.

entry: POKENAME每个头都有自己的想法，常为食物和方向争执。不过，它们对水上微光、落叶、泡泡等短暂事物十分着迷，会暂时忘掉无休止的吵闹。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Each head of POKENAME has a mind of its own, fighting over food or direction. Despite their aggression, they are fascinated by ephemera, brief glimmers on water, falling leaves, or bubbles, which briefly distract them from their constant squabbling.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴与嗜热微生物有着奇妙的共生关系。微生物借它的体热分解水分子，持续释放氧气，让它能在水下轻松呼吸。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The tails of POKENAME harbour heat‑loving microbes in a remarkable symbiosis. Fuelled by the Pokémon's body heat, these microbes split water molecules and release a steady stream of oxygen, letting POKENAME breathe effortlessly underwater.

entry: POKENAME的力量与中央的宝石直接相连。宝石严重受损时，会分泌保护液，避免进一步受伤。每次修复、恢复原有光彩后，它都会更强。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's power is directly tied to the gem in its centre. If the gem is critically harmed, it secretes a protective liquid to prevent further injury. Each time the gem is restored to its former resplendence after damage, POKENAME grows stronger.

entry: 人类一生对POKENAME似乎转瞬即逝。它会与一位训练家相伴，度过对方的一生。训练家离世后，它选择沉睡千年，没人知道这是否是哀悼。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Human lifetimes seem to pass by very quickly for POKENAME. It bonds with a single Trainer for the Trainer's entire life. It is not known if POKENAME mourns their passing, instead choosing to fall asleep for a millennium.

entry: POKENAME钻进泥里时，会释放浓稠黏液，覆满全身。身体因此滑得难以抓住，轻易就能摆脱天敌。
author: .izik
source: While digging into the mud, POKENAME releases a thick slime that coats its entire body. This makes it incredibly slippery, allowing it to escape from predators with ease.

entry: POKENAME在流水旁容易烦躁，却懒得像同类那样筑坝。它宁可住在泥里，将鳃插进淤泥吸水，再舔掉鳃上的水，补充水分。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME gets irritable around flowing water, but it's too lazy to build dams like others. Instead, it prefers to live in mud, where it hydrates by sinking its gills into the muck, which draws out moisture, then licking the water off afterwards.

entry: POKENAME释放微弱波导，与同类交流。信号在冷空气中传播最好，因此聚居极地。进化前，全身会开始柔和发光，显示内在力量正在增长。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME emits a faint aura it uses to communicate with others of its kind. The signals travel best in cold air, so they gather in polar regions. Just before evolution, its entire body begins to glow softly, a sign of its growing inner strength.

entry: POKENAME释放微弱波导，与同类交流。信号在冷空气中传播最好，因此聚居极地。它会循着同伴留下的痕迹走，残留黏液使痕迹微微发光。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME emit a faint aura that it uses to communicate with others of its kind. The signals travel best in cold air, so they gather in polar regions. They follow tracks others have left behind that glow slightly, due to the goo that is left behind.

entry: 野生POKENAME大多在泥地附近徘徊，捧泥涂身，保持凉爽，再懒洋洋地捡过路的小虫和蠕虫吃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends most of its time in the wild lingering around muddy areas. It scoops up mud to smear on itself to keep cool, and feeds by lazily picking at bugs and worms that scurry by.

entry: POKENAME情感奔放，总把心情显露在外。难过时，全身毛孔都会渗出液体，被认为是它哭泣的方式。碰到这些眼泪，会突然变得精力充沛。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is known for being rhapsodic, always displaying its emotions. When sad, it secretes a liquid from all pores on its body, with researchers believing these are its way of crying. The tears cause those that touch them to get suddenly energetic.

entry: 有些群体流传着预言，说会出现一只陆栖的POKENAME。它通常很快干枯，本不可能这样生活。据说这只个体将从巨大的鼻孔喷出祝福之水，润泽世界，治愈一切苦难。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Some circles speak of a vaticination foretelling a land-dwelling POKENAME, normally impossible, as they dry out quickly. It is said this one will heal all the world's ills, drenching it in blessed water expelled from its great nostrils.

entry: POKENAME最爱依偎在疼爱自己的训练家身边。被抚摸时，它会产生微弱电流，发出悦耳的噼啪声，表示开心。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME loves nothing more than snuggling up to a loving Trainer. When stroked, it shows its pleasure by generating slight electric currents that produce a pleasant crackling sound.

entry: POKENAME虽然可爱，在海上却令人畏惧。美丽歌声能传一英里，莫名引得听众跳海。落水后，音乐将人笼罩，催入梦乡，让人无法自救，最终溺亡。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Despite its cute looks, POKENAME is feared at sea. Its beautiful song carries for a mile; inexplicably luring listeners to jump overboard. Once in the water, the music envelops them, and they fall asleep, unable to stop themselves drowning.

entry: POKENAME从海水中吸收微量金属，为进化做准备。但污染加剧后，吸收速度超过生长速度，常过早进化，阻碍发育、限制长远潜力。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME absorbs trace metals from seawater to prepare for evolution. However, due to rising pollution, it now takes in metals faster than it can grow, often evolving prematurely. This stunts its development and limits its long-term potential.

entry: POKENAME吃下的石头不同，保护黏液的味道和性质也会变化。吃蓝宝石后产生的薄膜，提炼后能让人欣喜若狂，在某些地区是珍贵稀有的材料。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Depending on the rocks it consumes, POKENAME's protective slime changes flavour and properties. When it feeds on sapphires, the resulting film, if refined, can induce feelings of exultancy, making it a prized but rare material in certain regions.

entry: POKENAME翅膀拍得极快，必须喷雾防止干燥，却常常忘记。训练家一听到它发出细细的沙沙声，就会察觉并提醒。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's wings move so quickly that they have to spray mist on them to keep them from drying out, though they are not very good at remembering to do so. Trainers notice this if they hear a susurrus from their Pokémon and remind them.

entry: POKENAME曾被视为弱小，如今却因黏液能提炼成好中药而备受追捧。遇险时，它突然发出强烈闪光，学者形容，就像深处骤现的一道闪电。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Once dismissed as weak, POKENAME is now sought after for the mucus it secretes, able to be refined into a Fine Remedy. When threatened, it emits a flash of light so sudden and intense, scholars liken it to fulguration in the deep.

entry: POKENAME借潮汐能量彼此旋转着前进，横渡海洋。旅途漫长，可能超过100年。抵达新大陆后，它们产下蛋，再重复旅程。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME travel across oceans, using the energy from the tide to rotate around each other to move. This is a long process, and their peregrination can take over 100 years. Once they arrive at a new continent, they lay eggs and repeat the journey.

entry: POKENAME常成群生活，没有等级之分，一只起身走，其他就跟上。它似乎能把尾巴埋进地里，从土中吸取养分。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are often found together as a pack. There is no hierarchy and when one decides to get up and move, the others follow. They seem to be able to draw in nutrients from the soil by burying their tails in the ground.

entry: POKENAME头顶和尾巴上的毛柔软得不可思议，王室过去曾用来填枕头。可悲的是，如今有非法养殖场只为取毛而繁育它，采完便将它丢弃。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The tuft of fur on POKENAME's head and tail is so incredibly soft that royalty once used it to stuff pillows. Sadly, illegal farms have begun breeding POKENAME solely for their fur, harvesting it and discarding the Pokémon.

entry: 夏季，POKENAME的鳃展开，分泌甜蜜花蜜，吸引传粉者。昆虫进食时留下花粉，等身上积够花粉，它就会进化，完成独特的共生循环。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: During summer, POKENAME's gills unfurl and secrete a sweet nectar that attracts pollinators. As the insects feed, they leave behind pollen. Once enough has built up on its body, POKENAME will evolve, completing a unique symbiotic cycle.

entry: 园艺师都知道，一只POKENAME就能让好花园更上一层楼。它用沾着油的花朵轻蹭其他植物，就能让对方茁壮生长，结出足以获奖的果实。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: It is known among horticulturists that a single POKENAME can turn a good garden into a great garden. This is because POKENAME can brush their oil-dappled flowers against any other plant, causing it to flourish and produce prize-winning produce.

entry: POKENAME释放细密的含硫雾气，帮助自己飞行。雾气被收集用于制作一刮就能闻到气味的书，重现工业化鼎盛时期污染河流的气味。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME emits a fine, sulphurous mist that helps it fly. It is collected for scratch-and-sniff books, offering a whiff of what polluted rivers once smelled like during the height of industrialisation.

entry: POKENAME一生待在海上，却用耳朵乱扑腾着游泳，看起来像在溺水。海军会用它的名字戏称少尉，指对方经验不足。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME spend their lives at sea, though their swimming technique involves their ears thrashing about and makes it look like they are drowning. POKENAME is used as a nickname for an Ensign in the Navy, referring to their lack of experience.

entry: 不戴手套碰POKENAME会剧痛，却不留永久损伤。几百年前，人们流行把处理过的蘑菇别在西装上，视为衣着优雅的象征。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Touching POKENAME without gloves causes intense pain, though leaves no lasting damage. There was a fashion a few hundred years ago to wear the treated mushroom from POKENAME pinned onto a suit and was considered sartorial elegance.

entry: POKENAME爱朝人泼水，想吓对方一跳。可人家究竟是吓到了，还是被逗笑了，它往往又分不清。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME loves to spook people by splashing water on them, though most times it's confused whether that person is spooked or laughing.

entry: 世界有些地方，会在窗边挂上POKENAME模样的纸偶，用来求雨。
author: staghorn
source: In some parts of the world, paper dolls resembling POKENAME are hung in windows in order to invite rain.

entry: POKENAME体表的胶状膜黏性极强，能先黏住树干或岩石，再打盹。一睡就是数小时，纹丝不动，任风吹来的树叶和泥土盖满身体。
author: jaminmcready
source: The gooey membrane around its body is extremely adhesive, allowing POKENAME to attach itself to tree trunks or rocks before dozing off. Once asleep, it remains motionless for hours as wind blows leaves and dirt that covers POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME聚在冰山底部，用胶状身体过滤海水，吸收养分和微生物。体色随水质变化，近来污染加剧，许多个体已明显变暗。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME gather on the undersides of icebergs, filtering water through their gelatinous bodies to absorb nutrients and microorganisms. Their colour changes based on water quality. Recently, rising pollution has caused many to darken noticeably.

entry: POKENAME聚在冰山底部，用胶状身体过滤海水，吸收养分和微生物。体色随水质变化，吃树果也会暂时让它变暗。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME gather on the undersides of icebergs, filtering water through their gelatinous bodies to absorb nutrients and microorganisms. Their colour changes based on water quality. Consuming berries also temporarily makes them darker.

entry: POKENAME随海风漂流，任凭风雨摆布。为求生存，它覆上疏水薄膜、蜷成球，让风暴随意抛来抛去而不受伤，是适应漂泊生活的奇特妙招。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Carried by ocean winds, POKENAME is at the mercy of the elements. To survive, it coats itself in a hydrophobic film and curls into a ball, allowing storms to toss it about without harm, an odd but effective adaptation to its drifting lifestyle.

entry: 研究者用POKENAME监测沙漠化。它只喝沙漠附近的水，借其中沙土合成特殊凝胶，防止身体干枯。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Researchers use POKENAME to monitor desertification. They only drink water near deserts, where sand and silt help them synthesize a special gel that keeps their bodies from drying out.

entry: POKENAME在水里能感知热源，上岸后感受器却因缺水而皱缩，几乎失明。即便如此，它每天仍必须离水至少一次，吸收阳光。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME can detect thermal signatures while in the water. As soon as it makes its way onto land, the lack of moisture causes its receptors to shrivel up, making it effectively blind. It must leave the water at least once a day to absorb sunlight.

entry: POKENAME有时带着一张珠宝邮件，上面刻着自己前世的面容。它从不微笑，只在独处时默默哭泣。有人相信，泪水落在古代遗迹上，能把记忆刻进石头。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME sometimes carries a piece of Bead Mail etched with the face it had in a previous life. An agelast by nature, it never smiles, only weeps quietly when alone. Some believe its tears can etch memories into stone if they fall on ancient ruins.

entry: POKENAME住在水力发电厂附近，在水中休息，吸收残余电力。它会定期出来释放静电，再回到深处。
author: .izik
source: It makes its home near hydropower plants, resting in the water to absorb residual electricity. POKENAME will emerge periodically to discharge static energy before returning to the depths.

entry: POKENAME的鳃坚硬如石，受到威胁时能当弹丸射出。接下来几天，鳃逐渐再生，它便埋进泥里藏好，免遭天敌袭击。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's gills are as hard as stone and can be launched like projectiles when it feels threatened. While they regenerate over the next few days, it buries itself in mud to remain hidden and safe from predators.

entry: POKENAME用獠牙钻掘河岸，寻找富含矿物质的泥吃。挖时，鳃过滤河水；吃得越多，獠牙越尖。它天性友善，筑巢时却会凶猛地捍卫领地。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME burrow through riverbanks with their tusks, searching for mineral-rich mud to eat. Their gills filter the water as they dig, and their tusks grow sharper the more they eat. They are friendly by nature, but fiercely territorial when nesting.

entry: 它们虽由先进科学创造，却让人想起人类与宝可梦相互依靠、共同求生的古老时代。据说被它触碰，就能体验人类所有情绪。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Despite the advanced science used in their creation, they are redolent of an ancient time where people and Pokémon depended on each other for survival. Some say that being touched by one causes you to experience all human emotions.

entry: 它们虽由先进科学创造，却让人想起人类与宝可梦相互依靠、共同求生的古老时代。据说被它触碰，就能体验人类所有情绪。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Despite the advanced science used in their creation, they are redolent of an ancient time where people and Pokémon depended on each other for survival. Some say that being touched by one causes you to experience all human emotions.

entry: POKENAME住在两极附近，白天活动，只在黑暗时睡觉，因此盛夏每天能醒着长达22小时。眼缘因而容易结痂，它会产生液体，保持湿润。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME live close to the poles. They are diurnal and only sleep when it is dark, which means they stay awake for up to 22 hours a day in mid-summer. The edges of their eyes go crusty due to this, so they produce a liquid to keep them hydrated.

entry: POKENAME采用奇特的方法飞行：将下方空气加热到极高温，获得离地所需的升力。它只能短暂飞一会儿，就得休息。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: To fly, POKENAME employs the unusual technique of superheating the air below it to give it enough lift to get off the ground. It can only manage short flights before it must rest.

entry: POKENAME在沼泽孵化，吃根、植物，甚至泥土成长。研究者认为，泥土有助于为进化做准备。原栖地土壤不同，体色也略有差别。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME hatches in swamps and grows by feeding on roots, plants, and even the mud itself. Researchers believe the mud plays a role in preparing it for evolution. Its colouration varies slightly depending on the soil type of its native habitat.

entry: POKENAME头顶的触角其实是鳃。条件允许时，它会倒挂在低矮的顶部睡觉，让鳃浸进浅水池。
author: char_latte3412
source: The antennae atop POKENAME's head are actually gills.  When possible, it will sleep dangling from a low ceiling, its gills submerged in a shallow pool.

entry: POKENAME看起来垂头耷脑，是因为脊柱向后弯曲，好让它趴平、完全藏进泥里。蚊香蛙皇爱找它，在背上使出腹鼓取乐，让它苦不堪言。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Its drooped appearance is due to its spine having evolved to curve backwards, allowing it to lie flat and hide completely in mud. Politoed are known to seek them out, performing Belly Drum on their backs for fun, much to POKENAME's distress.

entry: POKENAME看起来垂头耷脑，是因为脊柱向后弯曲，好让它趴平、完全藏进泥里。蚊香蛙皇爱找它，在背上使出腹鼓取乐，让它苦不堪言。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Its drooped appearance is due to its spine having evolved to curve backwards, allowing it to lie flat and hide completely in mud. Politoed are known to seek them out, performing Belly Drum on their backs for fun, much to POKENAME's distress.

entry: POKENAME看起来垂头耷脑，是因为脊柱向后弯曲，好让它趴平、完全藏进泥里。蚊香蛙皇爱找它，在背上使出腹鼓取乐，让它苦不堪言。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Its drooped appearance is due to its spine having evolved to curve backwards, allowing it to lie flat and hide completely in mud. Politoed are known to seek them out, performing Belly Drum on their backs for fun, much to POKENAME's distress.

entry: POKENAME在河口泥滩寻找牡蛎和大舌贝，把鳃贴在壳上，就能感知里面是否有珍珠。若有，就轻轻开壳取珠，把对方送回安全处，再贪婪地吞掉珍珠。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME wanders estuary mudflats in search of oysters and Shellder. By pressing its gills to the shells, it can sense if a pearl is inside. If so, it gently opens it, removes the pearl, returns them to safety, then greedily devours the gem.

entry: POKENAME分泌一种稀有液体，人们曾误以为是PP单项全补剂，能恢复宝可梦的能量。它翻滚时会猛然产生推进力，激动或守卫泥地领地时，就能以出奇的速度向前扑击。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME secretes a rare fluid once mistaken for Max Ether, believed to restore energy to Pokémon. Its rolling motion generates sudden impetus, letting it lunge forward with surprising speed when agitated or defending its muddy territory.

entry: 许多训练家会教POKENAME毒击。它众多的鳃本就分泌微量毒液，驱赶天敌；经过训练，还能将这能力化为武器，接连刺击对手数十次，注入毒液。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Many Trainers teach their POKENAME Poison Jab, as its numerous gills naturally secrete trace amounts of venom to deter would-be predators. With training it can weaponise this ability to pierce opponents dozens of times and inject them with poison.

entry: POKENAME虽然没牙，强颚仍能咬穿汽车。不过它怕引擎声，从不咬点着火的车。其实，城市生活许多方面都让它害怕，因此总远离城市。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: With its strong jaws, POKENAME can bite through cars, even though it has no teeth. It never bites cars that have their ignition on, as it is scared of the noise they make. In fact, it is scared of much of urban life, keeping well clear of cities.

entry: 证据表明POKENAME曾是顶级捕食者，没有手臂却让学界困惑。甚至有理论认为，它原本有手臂，只是现存化石中的手臂都随岁月散失了。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Despite evidence proving POKENAME was an apex predator, its lack of arms has puzzled the scientific community. Some theories even suggest that POKENAME did have arms, but they have all been lost to time in the fossils remaining.

entry: 传统说法认为，POKENAME会拜访下雪的住家，人们习惯在门外留冻好的果汁牛奶。近来目击减少，科学家认为，它正艰难适应气候变化。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Traditions claim that POKENAME will visit houses that receive snowfall; it is custom to leave frozen Lemonade outside for them. There have been fewer reports in recent times, as scientists believe they are struggling to adapt to climate change.

entry: POKENAME在冰水中漂流，脸上的笑容仿佛永远冻住。它降低体温，将自己封进坚冰，再从水下伏击猎物。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME drifts through icy waters with a permanent grin frozen across its face. It lowers its body temperature to encase itself in solid ice, and ambushes prey from beneath the surface.

entry: POKENAME浮在湖上，用头顶叶片吸收阳光。发现比自己小的东西，就疯狂吞食，常弄伤叶子，所得大半能量最后都用来修复损伤。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME bob along on lakes, absorbing sunlight through their head leaves. When they spot anything smaller than themself, they devour it in a frenzy, often damaging their leaves. Most of the energy they gain ends up going into healing the damage.

entry: 劲爽汽水看中POKENAME仿佛无穷的精力，选它作品牌吉祥物。它有独特的散热方法：在绒球里产生冰凉凝胶，再伴着电击释放。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: A brand of soda called Psycho Soda uses POKENAME as their mascot, due to its seemingly limitless energy. It has developed a unique way of removing excess heat from its body, by producing a cold gel in its pom-poms and releasing it with a shock.

entry: 劲爽汽水看中POKENAME仿佛无穷的精力，选它作品牌吉祥物。它有独特的散热方法：在绒球里产生冰凉凝胶，再伴着电击释放。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: A brand of soda called Psycho Soda uses POKENAME as their mascot, due to its seemingly limitless energy. It has developed a unique way of removing excess heat from its body, by producing a cold gel in its pom-poms and releasing it with a shock.

entry: POKENAME适应了污染水域，外形变得像塑料袋。试图解开它的人常被注入毒性较弱、却让人难受的毒液，这是它的防御机制。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME has adapted to life in polluted waters, taking on the appearance of a plastic bag. Those who attempt to untie it often report being injected with a mild but unpleasant toxin as a defence mechanism.

entry: POKENAME靠在海水中上浮或下潜调节体温。冬季会靠近水面，与敢于面对冰水的游泳者玩耍。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME regulate their body temperature by moving deeper or shallower in seawater. In winter, they come close to the surface and are known to play with swimmers brave enough to face the frigid water.

entry: POKENAME飘过沼泽，模仿四周听到的声音。它以为很好玩，许多人却觉得诡异走调的模仿令人不安。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats through marshy areas, mimicking sounds it hears in its surroundings. Though it believes this to be playful, many find its imitations unsettling, as they are eerily off-key.

entry: POKENAME心思单纯，住在森林湖泊和池塘旁，大半时间都在清除水中碎屑。它还从附近树上摘果子，分给水里的宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: Simpleminded creatures that live around forest lakes and ponds, POKENAME spends much of its time keeping the waters clean of detritus. It takes fruit from nearby trees to share with the Pokémon that live in the water.

entry: POKENAME浸在沼泽里，不断吸水、吸取养分，再从头顶排出。净化后的水常是附近最干净的，吸引许多宝可梦来喝。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME submerges itself in swamps. They continuously draw in water, absorb its nutrients, then expel it from the top of their heads. This purified water is often the cleanest around, attracting many Pokémon to drink from it.

entry: POKENAME完全失明，住在黑暗寒冷的洞穴。看似眼睛的部位，其实是感知熟果释放化学物质的特殊器官，极其敏感，隔着五英里多也能察觉。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is completely blind and lives in dark, cold caves. What appear to be eyes are actually specialized organs that detect chemicals released by ripe fruit. Incredibly sensitive, they can pick up these signals from over five miles away.

entry: POKENAME完全失明，住在黑暗寒冷的洞穴。看似眼睛的部位，其实是感知熟果释放化学物质的特殊器官，极其敏感，隔着五英里多也能察觉。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is completely blind and lives in dark, cold caves. What appear to be eyes are actually specialized organs that detect chemicals released by ripe fruit. Incredibly sensitive, they can pick up these signals from over five miles away.

entry: POKENAME讨厌脏环境，会用鳃掸灰。清扫时务必别打扰，已有报告说，它连训练家也会用燕返攻击！
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME hates dirty environments and will use their gills to dust. Care must be taken not to disturb them when they are doing this as there have been reports of POKENAME using Aerial Ace on even their own Trainers!

entry: POKENAME模仿同类的声音，与幼崽齐声歌唱，美妙得令人落泪。它会收集这些眼泪，防止皮肤干枯。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME copy the sounds of other POKENAME. POKENAME and their offspring can be found singing in such beautiful unison that it is known to make observers cry. POKENAME collect these tears to keep their skin from drying out.

entry: POKENAME模仿同类的声音，与幼崽齐声歌唱，美妙得令人落泪。它吸取这份能量，即使翅膀脆弱，也能飞行。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME copy the sounds of other POKENAME. POKENAME and their offspring can be found singing in such beautiful unison that it is known to make observers cry. They harvest this energy to allow them to fly, despite the frailty of their wings.

entry: POKENAME不断渗出黏液，形成温暖湿润、充满细菌的涂层。曾短暂流行饲养它来“增强免疫力”，却因感染和过敏就医人数骤增，很快告终。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME constantly oozes a sticky slime that creates a warm, moist layer teeming with bacteria. A brief trend saw people keeping them to "boost immunity," but it quickly ended after a surge in hospital visits from infections and allergic reactions.

entry: POKENAME不断渗出黏液，形成温暖湿润、充满细菌的涂层。曾短暂流行饲养它来“增强免疫力”，却因感染和过敏就医人数骤增，很快告终。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME constantly oozes a sticky slime that creates a warm, moist layer teeming with bacteria. A brief trend saw people keeping them to "boost immunity," but it quickly ended after a surge in hospital visits from infections and allergic reactions.

entry: POKENAME向目标喷出强酸黏液，将对方化成一摊紫色果汁。现代化学品普及前，人们曾用少量黏液处理兽皮。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME squirts a highly acidic goo onto its targets, reducing them to nothing more than a Purple Juice. Small quantities of this goo were once used to treat animal hides, before modern chemicals were brought into use.

entry: 野外的POKENAME常待在进化前的同类身边。它看似想教对方东西，对方却常比它熟练，因为进化似乎让它在大多数方面反而退步了。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: In the wild, POKENAME is often found amongst its pre-evolutions. Although it seems as though it is trying to teach them things, they are often much better than it, as evolving has seemed to cause it to lose proficiency in most areas.

entry: 它虽由岩石构成，掉下的部分却很快分解成黏黏的蓝色果汁。据信，这是最后被发现、加入图鉴的乌波融合体。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Although made of rocks, if parts of it fall off, they quickly degrade into Blue Juice that is sticky to the touch. This is believed to have been the final Wooper fusion to be discovered and added to the Pokédex.

entry: 远看POKENAME像冰做的，光泽却来自全身分泌的凝胶。凝胶永不腐坏，让研究者能准确追溯它数千年来的迁徙。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: From afar, POKENAME looks like it is made of ice, but the shine is actually caused by a gel it secretes all across its body. This gel never decays so researchers have been able to accurately figure out how POKENAME migrated over millennia.

entry: 一面绘有POKENAME图案的古代卡洛斯战旗，几乎不曾受岁月侵蚀。历史学家认为，它曾象征王权：忠诚得愿意效力，也强大得能抹除君王路上的一切阻碍。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: An ancient Kalos oriflamme bearing a motif of POKENAME remains nearly untouched by time. Historians believe POKENAME used to symbolise royal power, loyal enough to serve, yet strong enough to obliterate anything that stood in the monarch's path.

entry: 一面绘有POKENAME图案的古代卡洛斯战旗，几乎不曾受岁月侵蚀。历史学家认为，它曾象征王权：忠诚得愿意效力，也强大得能抹除君王路上的一切阻碍。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: An ancient Kalos oriflamme bearing a motif of POKENAME remains nearly untouched by time. Historians believe POKENAME used to symbolise royal power, loyal enough to serve, yet strong enough to obliterate anything that stood in the monarch's path.

entry: POKENAME的花瓣覆着黏稠树汁，在寒冷气候下会结晶，保存DNA片段。这让科学家能极其准确地追溯它数百万年的演化史。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The petals of POKENAME are coated in a sticky sap that can crystallize in cold climates, preserving fragments of its DNA. This has allowed scientists to trace the evolutionary history of POKENAME with remarkable accuracy over millions of years.

entry: POKENAME一睡就是一个世纪，身体化为湿地的肥沃土地。它吸收经水折射的光成长，终于醒来时，突然的变动会扰动周围形成的脆弱生态。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME sleeps for a century, its body forming fertile ground for wetlands. It grows by absorbing refracted light through water. When it finally stirs, the sudden shift sends ripples through the delicate ecosystem that formed around it.

entry: POKENAME太爱泡水，主人得留神：只要察觉有人淋浴或泡澡，它就会突然闯进去，想一起洗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys soaking in water, so much that its owners should take precautions; if POKENAME senses someone taking a shower or bath, it will barge in unexpectedly in order to join them.

entry: POKENAME体表黏液剧毒，连最执着的天敌也能赶走。它埋在湿泥里，等候毫无戒心的猎物。
author: .izik
source: The mucus coating POKENAME's body is highly toxic, capable of deterring even the most determined predators. It buries itself in wet, muddy areas, lying in wait for unsuspecting prey.

entry: POKENAME埋在沼泽里，吸收泥中养分。消化不了的废物会转成毒液，注入天敌或入侵者体内。各地毒素不同，无法制成通用的解毒血清。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME buries itself in swampy terrain, absorbing nutrients from the mud. Any waste it can't digest is transformed into venom, which it injects into predators or intruders. The toxin varies by region, making a universal antivenom impossible.

entry: POKENAME的鳃对环境十分敏感。受到威胁，就吞下大量水，把身体胀大，希望吓住对手。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's gills are very sensitive to its environment. If it is threatened it will swallow large amounts of water, inflating its body to hopefully intimidate its opponent.

entry: POKENAME将空气导入尖刺根部的气囊，胀起后以接近音速射出尖刺，再释放凝胶封住孔洞。凝胶疗愈能力强，让新刺很快长出。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is able to direct air into sacs at the base of its spines that, when inflated, expel the spines at close to the speed of sound. A gel is then released to cover the hole that has great healing properties, allowing a new spine to grow quickly.

entry: POKENAME远看像由沙子构成，身体却是果冻质地，天生不沾沙。这项特性被用于制作海滩游玩后的清洁液，涂上就能去掉最后一粒沙。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Though it appears sandy from afar, POKENAME's body has a jelly-like texture that naturally repels grains of sand. This unique trait is harnessed to produce a liquid used after beach trips that, when applied, will shed every last speck of sand.

entry: POKENAME依偎在珊瑚礁的岩缝里，一动不动就是几天。为躲天敌，它分泌掩盖气味的物质，却也引来寄生虫，许多就此永久住在身上。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME nestles in rocky crevices of coral reefs, remaining motionless for days at a time. To avoid predators, it secretes a scent-masking substance, but this also attracts parasites, many of which end up living on its body permanently.

entry: 这种宝可梦从冰山吸收寒气，储在鳃中，防止过热。这却加速冰融，威胁附近物种；气候危机使海冰减少，更令问题严重。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: To survive, this Pokémon absorbs cold from icebergs, storing it in its gills to prevent overheating. Unfortunately, this accelerates melting, posing a threat to nearby species, especially as the climate crisis reduces sea ice.

entry: POKENAME虽然会游泳，却像陆上的四足动物一样沿海底行走。颈部褶边将四周光线反射进眼睛，让它在浑浊深水也能看清。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME roams the ocean floor, moving as a quadruped would on land, despite its ability to swim. The frills on its neck reflect light all around it into its eyes, allowing it to see even in the murky depths.

entry: 证据显示，古代海洋部族曾与POKENAME共处。它比人类潜得深，曾被用来把鱼赶向水面，供人捕捉。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Evidence suggests ancient ocean tribes once lived alongside POKENAME. It can dive deeper than humans and was used to scare fish toward the surface to be caught.

entry: POKENAME生活在河口三角洲，与流水和声歌唱。有些会观察溶食兽，模仿嘴部动作，让声音更有力、共鸣更纯净。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME live along river deltas, singing in harmony with the flowing water. Some POKENAME study Gulpin and mimic its mouth movements. This allows them to project their voice more powerfully and with a purer resonance.

entry: POKENAME优雅的旋转启发了一种舞蹈：舞者越转越快，再跃起，在空中劈叉。它亲自跳时更惊艳，在湿滑泥地上也能转得完美，控制自如。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's elegant spinning inspired a dance where performers pirouette faster and faster before leaping into a mid-air split. It's even more stunning when POKENAME does it, spinning flawlessly on slippery mud with perfect control.

entry: 冷得能看见呼气的夜晚，有时能在水边看到POKENAME玩耍，美丽鳞片映着月光闪耀。这动人的景象曾令人落泪。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: On nights when it is cold enough to see your breath, POKENAME can sometimes be found playing at the water's edge, its beautiful scales glinting off the light of the moon. This stunning sight has been known to move people to tears.

entry: POKENAME虽然没有牙齿，咬合力却足以碎骨。它在浅沼泽伏击猎物，狠狠咬住毫无戒心的对方。
author: .izik
source: Despite having no teeth, POKENAME's jaw strength is powerful enough to break bones. It thrives in shallow marshes, ambushing unsuspecting prey with crushing bites.

entry: POKENAME的鳃仿佛有自己的意志，能引它找到视线外的食物。科学家曾以为它嗅觉敏锐，大量测试却表明，它其实完全闻不到气味。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The gills on a POKENAME seem to have a mind of their own and can steer POKENAME to a food source out of their sight. Scientists once thought they had a strong sense of smell, but extensive tests suggest that, in fact, POKENAME cannot smell at all.

entry: POKENAME形态不稳定，仿佛夹在两种形态之间。观察者说，余光里会看到乌波和究极奈克洛兹玛分开闪现，正眼看却仍完整一体，更添神秘。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME appears unstable, as if caught between two forms. Observers report seeing both Wooper and Ultra Necrozma flicker separately in their peripheral vision, but when viewed directly, it remains whole, adding to its mystery.

entry: POKENAME半浸在高海拔山湖里悠闲休息，那里许多大型宝可梦连呼吸都困难。因为没有天敌，它十分友善，训练家来到栖居地时，鳞片还会开心地发光。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME lounge half-submerged in tarns at high altitudes where many larger Pokémon struggle to breathe. Due to a lack of natural predators, they are very friendly and their scales glow with joy when Trainers approach them in their natural habitat.

entry: POKENAME头上的鳞片能显示健康状况，越亮越有光泽，就越健康。它会压低身体，把鳞光射进潜在威胁的眼睛，常能将对方吓退。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The scales on POKENAME's head are used to indicate its health, the brighter and shinier they are, the healthier it is. Potential threats are often scared away when POKENAME crouches low, directing light from its scales into their eyes.

entry: POKENAME头上的鳞片能显示健康状况，越亮越有光泽，就越健康。它会压低身体，把鳞光射进潜在威胁的眼睛，常能将对方吓退。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The scales on POKENAME's head are used to indicate its health, the brighter and shinier they are, the healthier it is. Potential threats are often scared away when POKENAME crouches low, directing light from its scales into their eyes.

entry: POKENAME住水管、偷食物又吵闹，被当成害兽，却很少遭驱赶。它分泌天然抑菌凝胶，走到哪就清洁到哪，因此每晚出动后，许多人醒来发现家里更整洁了。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Though seen as a pest for living in pipes, stealing food, and making noise, POKENAME is rarely removed. It secretes a naturally antibacterial gel that cleans surfaces as it moves, so after its nightly sorties, many wake up to a tidier home.

entry: POKENAME常待在瀑布后，平静时会哼鸣，一哼就是几天。有人将录音当成白噪声，帮助集中精神或入睡。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Often found behind waterfalls, POKENAME hums when it is in a calm state, which can last days. Some people listen to recordings of this as a form of white noise to help them concentrate or sleep.

entry: POKENAME开心时散发香茅般的清新气味，难过时则变成烂鱼味。训练家会深深依恋它，像照顾孩子般细心，因此有人推测，气味能影响大脑中的化学反应。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Happy POKENAME emit a refreshing scent, reminiscent of lemongrass, but when distressed, it shifts to that of rotting fish. Some theorise it affects brain chemistry as Trainers grow deeply attached and tend to them with care one might give a child.

entry: POKENAME在冰水游泳时，双臂绕身盘旋保暖，看起来像在跳舞。上岸后，它会等训练家按摩，帮助肌肉恢复。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: As POKENAME swims in frigid water, its arms spiral around it to keep it warm, creating the illusion that it is dancing. When it gets onto land, it expects its Trainers to massage it, to help its muscles recover.

entry: 若耐心擦亮POKENAME，洗去覆身的泥，就能发现美丽的模样。可这美景只能欣赏几小时，因为它很快又会涂满泥巴。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: If someone has the patience to polish a POKENAME and scrub away the mud that coats them, they will find a beautiful sight. They are only able to enjoy this for a few hours, as POKENAME will soon cover itself in mud again.

entry: 据说，英语中表示高声欢呼的词源自POKENAME的叫声。开心时，它的声音混合着欢呼与笑声。有些儿童词典甚至在这个词旁边画上它。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The word "whooping" is believed to have been derived from POKENAME's call. When happy, they make a noise that resembles a mix of cheering and laughter. Some children's dictionaries even include an image of it next to the word.

entry: POKENAME的鳃仿佛有自己的意志，能引它找到视线外的食物。科学家曾以为它嗅觉敏锐，大量测试却表明，它其实完全闻不到气味。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The gills on a POKENAME seem to have a mind of their own and can steer POKENAME to a food source out of their sight. Scientists once thought they had a strong sense of smell, but extensive tests suggest that, in fact, POKENAME cannot smell at all.

entry: POKENAME每天花数小时，用自己分泌的凝胶做发型。爱美的训练家会养它，既能用凝胶，也能借鉴它的发型。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME spends hours a day styling their hair with a gel that they secrete. Vain Trainers keep these Pokémon to use their gel, and to get inspiration for their own hair.

entry: POKENAME性情温柔，见到什么都亲昵地蹭一蹭。鳃能产生墨汁般的凝胶，用来写树叶信。语言虽常很稚拙，心意却真切无疑。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Known for its gentle nature, POKENAME rubs affectionately against anything it meets. It can produce an ink-like gel from its gills, which it uses to craft a Leaf Letter, often primitive in its language, but unmistakably heartfelt in its intent.

entry: POKENAME性情温柔，见到什么都亲昵地蹭一蹭。鳃能产生墨汁般的凝胶，用来写树叶信。语言虽常很稚拙，心意却真切无疑。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Known for its gentle nature, POKENAME rubs affectionately against anything it meets. It can produce an ink-like gel from its gills, which it uses to craft a Leaf Letter, often primitive in its language, but unmistakably heartfelt in its intent.

entry: POKENAME拿着的树枝能引导能量，寻找间歇泉。同类会聚来社交，在蒸汽中跳舞，却很少久留，因为它们吃富含矿物质的黏土，还会守住自己的那份。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The stick POKENAME carries helps it channel energy to locate geysers. Here, members of its kin gather to socialise, performing dances in the steam. They rarely stay together for long, as they feed on mineral-rich clay and guard their personal supply.

entry: POKENAME进化时，长辈会赐予手中的树枝。将树枝朝上、集中精神，就能看见未来。许多个体却宁可朝下，因为这样能想象出最完美的泥浴。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The stick POKENAME carries is bestowed upon it by its elders when it evolves. When it points it upwards and concentrates, it is able to see the future. Many point it downwards instead, as doing so lets them picture the perfect mudbath.

entry: POKENAME跳起时，尾巴也会伸长，增强力量。记录中，跳起的高度超过自身身高的50倍，既用来逃避天敌，也用来玩。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When POKENAME jumps, its tail also extends to give it more power. It has been recorded jumping over 50 times its own height. It does this both to escape predators and to play.

entry: POKENAME跳起时，尾巴也会伸长，增强力量。记录中，跳起的高度超过自身身高的50倍，既用来逃避天敌，也用来玩。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When POKENAME jumps, its tail also extends to give it more power. It has been recorded jumping over 50 times its own height. It does this both to escape predators and to play.

entry: 喷气背包的早期原型用煤作燃料，灵感正来自POKENAME将煤转为能量的方式。可它偏偏很怕飞，更爱待在水下地热喷口旁，那里最安全自在。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Early prototypes of the Jetpack used coal as fuel, inspired by how POKENAME converts it into energy. Ironically, POKENAME are terrified of flying and prefer to stay underwater close to geothermal vents, where they feel safest and most at home.

entry: 若夜里独自在田野听到轻微踩泥声，附近或许有POKENAME，无害却诡异。一部人气恐怖喜剧讲述它只想交朋友，却不知不觉吓坏一群青少年的故事。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: If you hear the faint squelch of mud while alone in a field at night, a POKENAME may be nearby, harmless, but eerie. A popular comedy-horror film follows one such POKENAME, unknowingly terrifying a group of teens despite just trying to make friends.

entry: POKENAME吃植物，再用唾液转成麦芽糊精，这是一种容易消化的糖，储在体内。科学家如今已能人工合成，用于食品，或喂给生病的POKENAME。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME consumes plants and, using its saliva, converts them into maltodextrin, a highly digestible sugar it stores in its body. Scientists now produce this compound synthetically, which is used in food or to feed sick POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME歌声颤抖，仿佛强忍泪水，悲伤的旋律有时像在哀叹遗失的“一边的耳环”。一些殡葬公司甚至让它为哀悼者提供凄婉的背景音乐。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME sings with a voice that trembles like it's holding back tears. Its mournful melodies sometimes sound like they're lamenting a lost Lone Earring. Some funeral companies even offer them to provide haunting background music for the grieving.

entry: POKENAME雌雄外观相同，却很容易分辨：雄性的毛甜得多，还会产生糖浆般的物质，有些地区用来浇在冰淇淋上。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Male and female POKENAME are identical, though there is an easy way to distinguish them. The fur on males is much sweeter, and they also produce a syrup-like substance that is used in some areas as an ice cream topping.

entry: POKENAME的皮肤不断生长，堆成层层褶皱，不处理就会拖慢动作。野外会蹭粗树皮或石头，去掉多余皮层；被训练家养着时，则喜欢泡矿物浴、刷洗干净。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's skin grows constantly, forming wrinkled layers that slow it down if not managed. In the wild, it scrapes against rough bark or rocks to shed the excess. When raised by Trainers, it enjoys soaking in mineral baths and being brushed clean.

entry: POKENAME生活在乌波族群中，十分护着幼小的乌波。它陪幼崽玩，让它们在头顶叶片的积水里嬉闹，培养重要的生存本领。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME live amongst Wooper colonies and are fiercely protective of young Wooper. They play with them, letting them splash about in the water in the leaf on its head, which builds essential skills for the young Wooper.

entry: POKENAME演化出无摩擦的皮肤，在水中游得快，上岸却很快干枯。为此又长出储水叶盘，保持湿润，却拖慢了泳速，让研究者不解这种取舍。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME evolved frictionless skin for speed in water but dried out quickly on land. To adapt, they developed a water-storing pad to keep their skin moist. This adaptation slowed them down as they swam, leaving researchers puzzled by the trade-off.

entry: POKENAME沿海底滚动，水越冷，滚得越快。成熟后会聚到热液喷口，突如其来的热量触发反应，将它们从海里射入大气。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME rolls along the seabed, moving faster in colder waters. When mature, they gather at hydrothermal vents, where the sudden heat triggers a response that launches them out of the sea and into the atmosphere.

entry: POKENAME成熟时，鳃从硬刺间隙冒出，硬刺则逐渐脱落。每根刺都会长成与亲代一模一样的新个体，却不知道自己的亲代是谁。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: As POKENAME matures, gills erupt through gaps in its hardened spikes, which fall away over time. Each of these spikes will grow into an identical copy of itself, with no idea who its parent is.

entry: POKENAME能吸取空气中的水分，再从尾巴喷水。已有多次报告说，它用尾巴浇灭火焰，阻止了住宅火灾。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are able to draw in moisture from the air and can spray water from their tail. There have been multiple reports of a POKENAME preventing a house fire by using its tail to douse the flames.

entry: POKENAME在浅水的岩石中挖掘，建造蜿蜒的隧道居住，长度可达数百米。虽然早已远超所需，它还是不停扩建。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME dig through rocks in the shallows to build winding tunnel systems to live in that can be hundreds of metres long. Although this is much longer than necessary, POKENAME never stops expanding their system.

entry: 过去，统治海洋的君主被期待取得POKENAME的宝石。它极其罕见，因此旅程艰难，君主沿途经历的试炼会证明其统治的正当性。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Historically, monarchs that have domain over the ocean have been expected to harness a gem from POKENAME. This was an arduous journey, as POKENAME are extremely rare. The trials the monarch would face during this would prove their rule as legitimate.

entry: POKENAME在小池塘游泳，一察觉附近有幸福情侣，就跃出水面。有人说它想分享喜悦，也有人觉得，它只是喜欢受关注。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims around small ponds, leaping into the air whenever it senses a happy couple nearby. Some say it does this to share in the joy, while others believe it simply enjoys the attention.

entry: POKENAME在浅水的岩石中挖掘，建造蜿蜒的隧道居住，长度可达数百米。虽然早已远超所需，它还是不停扩建。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME dig through rocks in the shallows to build winding tunnel systems to live in that can be hundreds of metres long. Although this is much longer than necessary, POKENAME never stops expanding their system.

entry: POKENAME大多待在海床下，很少现身。隧道里有一处堆满破旧钓竿和好钓竿的废弃钓线，引发争论：它是在扯断钓鱼人的线，还是清理海洋污染？
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are rarely seen, spending their time mostly under the seabed. Their tunnels contain an area that is filled with discarded Old Rod and Good Rod lines, which has led to debate on whether they snap anglers' lines or clean up ocean pollution.

entry: 冲浪者曾流行把冲浪板漆成金色，借阳光闪耀，引来旁人赞叹。可潮流很快结束，因为没人看守时，野生POKENAME就会偷走板子。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: There was once a trend among surfers to paint their Surfboard gold coloured, so it would catch the sun and impress onlookers. This didn't last long though, as wild POKENAME would steal them when not being guarded.

entry: 冲浪者曾流行把冲浪板漆成金色，借阳光闪耀，引来旁人赞叹。可潮流很快结束，因为没人看守时，野生POKENAME就会偷走板子。

author: whatagooddaytodie
source: There was once a trend among surfers to paint their Surfboard gold coloured, so it would catch the sun and impress onlookers. This didn't last long though, as wild POKENAME would steal them when not being guarded.

entry: POKENAME的胡须对气流变化极敏感，甚至曾躲过扔来的速度球。不过，快未必灵活，它还是常撞上附近障碍。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's whiskers are so sensitive to changes in air currents that they have even been seen to outmanoeuvre a Fast Ball being thrown at them. Their speed doesn't necessarily equate with agility though, as they often crash into nearby obstacles.

entry: POKENAME常在咸淡水交汇处生活，少动弹，以水草为食。面对危险反应虽慢，一旦受了威胁，潜藏的超能力便会觉醒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are typically found around brackish water, where they live sedentary lives feeding on aquatic plants. They are often slow to react to danger but have latent psychic powers that activate when threatened.

entry: POKENAME皮肤覆着黏滑涂层，碰到会引发严重偏头痛。休息整整一天，症状才会消退。
author: .izik
source: A slimy coating covers POKENAME's skin, capable of inducing severe migraines if touched. The symptoms fade after a full day's rest.

entry: POKENAME很爱玩，喜欢把正鼓足勇气下冷水的游泳者泼湿。人们说，这能帮助更快适应水温；若遇险，它也会把人送上岸。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is very playful and enjoys soaking swimmers that are bracing themselves to get into cold water. They say it helps them acclimatise to the water quicker, and if they are ever in danger, POKENAME carries them to shore.

entry: 一个人气攀岩装备品牌与POKENAME同名，因为它能攀上看似无法攀登的崖壁。双臂累了，甚至能用鳃和尾巴固定身体。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: A popular brand of Climbing Gear shares its name with POKENAME due to their ability to climb seemingly unscalable cliff faces. They can even use their gills and tail to hold them in place if their arms get tired.

entry: 一个人气攀岩装备品牌与POKENAME同名，因为它能攀上看似无法攀登的崖壁。双臂累了，甚至能用爪子固定身体。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: A popular brand of Climbing Gear shares its name with POKENAME due to their ability to climb seemingly unscalable cliff faces. They can even use their claws to hold them in place if their arms get tired.

entry: 这种宝可梦生气时，智力下降得几乎看不出来，因为本来就很笨。它会一字不差地执行训练家的任何命令，因此下令时必须格外小心。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The drop in intelligence when this Pokémon gets angry is barely noticeable as it is already very dim. It follows any instruction from its Trainer to the letter, so great care must be taken when issuing commands.

entry: 曾有传言说，要让乌波与卡蒂狗融合，就必须用等级球分别捕获，再喂某个热门品牌的香草冰淇淋。后来才发现，这只是冰淇淋公司的宣传噱头。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: There was once a rumour that to get a Wooper and Growlithe to fuse, you had to capture them both using a Level Ball, then feed them a popular brand of vanilla ice cream. It has since come out that it was a publicity stunt by the ice cream company.

entry: POKENAME奔过辽阔平原的景象令人屏息，尾巴如丝带拖在身后，在风中绵延数百米。古人将它视为土地的守护者，虔诚敬奉。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Watching a POKENAME race across expansive plains is a breathtaking sight, its tail trails behind like a ribbon, rippling for hundreds of meters in the wind. In ancient times, people revered it as a steward of the land and worshipped it accordingly.

entry: POKENAME通常很温柔，喜欢待在其他水属性宝可梦身旁。可一旦暴怒，尾巴就会失控喷水，掀起倾盆大雨。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Generally, POKENAME are gentle creatures, preferring to stick close to other Water Types. But if they become furious, POKENAME can cause torrential rain from spraying water uncontrollably from their tail.

entry: POKENAME开心时，鳃尖会迅速抽动。它分泌的有毒黏液会随饮食改变气味，据说吃过PP极限提升剂后，会奇妙地带上奶油硬糖味。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The tips of POKENAME's gills twitch rapidly when it's happy. It secretes a poisonous slime with a scent that changes based on its diet, after consuming a PP Max, it is said to smell oddly like butterscotch.

entry: POKENAME覆着黏液般的薄膜，摸起来不舒服，却能作服装染色套装的基料。将染色颜料浸在里面，色彩会更鲜明，也更均匀地渗入布料。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is coated in a mucous-like film that, while unpleasant to touch, can be used as a base for a Clothing Dye Kit. By steeping dye pigments in the film, it enhances their colour and helps them soak more evenly into fabric.

entry: 迷信说，若用厉害钓竿钓上POKENAME，就必须用诱饵球捕获，否则它会在你家上空召来下青蛙的雨云。或许因此，多数训练家索性用别的钓竿。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: According to superstition, if a POKENAME is hooked with a Super Rod, it must be caught in a Lure Ball, or else it will summon a raincloud of frogs over your house. This may explain why most Trainers prefer using other rods entirely.

entry: 研发传送仪时，POKENAME是受到广泛研究的宝可梦之一。它对研究者平静友善，发生罕见事故、失去肢体时，也能平静地再生。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME were one of the Pokémon extensively studied during the development of the Teleporter. They were calm and friendly with researchers and, when rare accidents occurred, were able to regenerate lost limbs without distress.

entry: 研发传送仪时，POKENAME是受到广泛研究的宝可梦之一。它对研究者平静友善，发生罕见事故、失去肢体时，也能平静地再生。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME were one of the Pokémon extensively studied during the development of the Teleporter. They were calm and friendly with researchers and, when rare accidents occurred, were able to regenerate lost limbs without distress.

entry: POKENAME长期未被编入图鉴，因为它会催眠目击者，忘掉自己的存在。即使亲手养大乌基拉、看着它进化的训练家，也会在它再次变化后，忘记这个阶段。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME remained unindexed for a long time, as it would hypnotize anyone who saw it into forgetting it existed. Even Trainers who raised a Woobra and watched it evolve would forget this stage once it changed again.

entry: POKENAME表情从不变，很难判断是得意，还是单纯发呆。它并非通常那样游泳，而是操控身边的水分子，不动一块肌肉，也能轻松滑行。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: It's difficult to tell if POKENAME is smug or simply vacant, as its expression never changes. Rather than swimming in the traditional sense, it manipulates water molecules around its body, allowing it to glide effortlessly without moving a muscle.

entry: 千万别给POKENAME砖块，它会以为在帮忙，立刻用头将砖撞成两半。这种误会代价高昂，有些建筑公司甚至不许它进工地。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Never hand a POKENAME Bricks as they'll immediately try to headbutt them in half, thinking they're being helpful. Some construction companies have even banned them from worksites due to the costly misunderstandings they cause.

entry: 千万别给POKENAME砖块，它会以为在帮忙，立刻用拳头将砖打成两半。这种误会代价高昂，有些建筑公司甚至不许它进工地。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Never hand a POKENAME Bricks as they'll immediately try to punch them in half, thinking they're being helpful. Some construction companies have even banned them from worksites due to the costly misunderstandings they cause.

entry: 桨帆船的船长曾十分珍视POKENAME的划桨力气。它能跟上人类节奏，力量却超过100倍。可晴天皮肤会干，只好放下船桨，改在船边游泳。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Galley captains once prized POKENAME for their incredible rowing strength, able to match human rhythm but deliver over 100 times the power. On sunny days, however, their skin would dry out, forcing them to abandon the oars and swim alongside instead.

entry: 桨帆船的船长曾十分珍视POKENAME的划桨力气。它能跟上人类节奏，力量却超过100倍。可晴天皮肤会干，只好放下船桨，改在船边游泳。

entry: 曾有一座POKENAME可食用雕塑，创下同类最大世界纪录，用上它最爱的点心：意式甜馅卷做鳃，蓝莓派做左胸肌，司康饼做腰带中央。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: A world record was set for the biggest edible sculpture of a Pokémon. The likeness was of POKENAME and featured some of its favourite treats. Cannoli for gills, a blueberry pie as the left pec, and a scone forming the centre of its belt.

entry: 桨帆船的船长曾十分珍视POKENAME的划桨力气。它能跟上人类节奏，力量却超过100倍。可晴天皮肤会干，只好放下船桨，改在船边游泳。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Galley captains once prized POKENAME for their incredible rowing strength, able to match human rhythm but deliver over 100 times the power. On sunny days, however, their skin would dry out, forcing them to abandon the oars and swim alongside instead.

entry: POKENAME颈部肌肉无力，看起来总弯着身子。这姿势启发了一种以它命名的深蹲变化式：每次动作前，先从髋部弯曲，让躯干与地面成90度。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's weak neck muscles give it an appearance of a permanent stoop. This posture inspired a squat variation named after it, where athletes bend at the hips until their torso is at a 90-degree angle to the floor before performing each rep.

entry: POKENAME不断流出粥状液体，既恶臭，效力又极强。放入零余果浸泡，就会吸引钢属性宝可梦，它们似乎喜欢混合物在皮肤上起泡、微微刺痒的感觉。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME constantly dribbles gruel-like liquid from its mouth, both foul-smelling and incredibly potent. When a Chesto Berry steeps in it, the mixture attracts Steel-types, who seem to enjoy the tingling, foaming sensation it produces on their skin.

entry: POKENAME爱玩，通常成大群生活。最爱的游戏之一，是尽量高地跃出水面，再缩进壳里，砸出最大的水花。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are very playful and are usually found in large groups. One of their favourite games involves jumping as high as they can out of the water, then tucking into their shell to create the biggest splash.

entry: 白天，POKENAME藏在地下，嚼泥吸取养分。夜里出来，把泥吐成球，看起来很像褐色的“奇怪的果实”。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: During the day, POKENAME hides under the earth and extracts nutrients from mud by chewing it. At night it emerges and expels the mud as a spitball, looking almost like a brown Strange Fruit.

entry: POKENAME住在湿地，一生大多半埋泥里，纹丝不动地等猎物靠近。它产生心动香水，附在身上，引来远近的宝可梦。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Found in wetlands, POKENAME spend most of their lives half-submerged in mud, remaining totally still as they wait for prey to wander close. To lure targets, they produce a Vivid Scent that clings to their body, drawing in Pokémon from far and wide.

entry: 在POKENAME附近使用便携电脑要小心。触手若碰到，它不知怎的能让里面储存的宝可梦中毒。研究者正探索它惊人的再生能力，希望在抗衰老治疗上取得突破。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Be cautious when using a Box Link near POKENAME. If their tentacles make contact, they can somehow poison the Pokémon stored inside. Their incredible regenerative abilities are now being studied for potential breakthroughs in treating aging.

entry: POKENAME在泥泞的红树林里滤食，生活简单。触手无害，只用来拉着身体穿过浓密草丛。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME lives a simple life, filter feeding in muddy mangrove forests. Its tentacles are harmless, used only to pull itself through dense undergrowth.

entry: 野生POKENAME温顺，乐得看世事流过，也乐意让矿工把灯笼挂在鳃上照明。坚韧皮肤和黏液涂层利于藻类生长，让它显得长满苔藓。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Docile and content to watch the world pass by, wild POKENAME happily let miners hang Lanterns over their gills for extra light. Their tough skin and mucous coating encourage algae to grow, giving them a mossy appearance.

entry: POKENAME最大的乐趣，是蜷成球滚下瀑布，因此在它领地的瀑布游泳很危险。都城瀑布顶有家公司，正利用它把热带邮件送到下方。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's greatest joy in life is curling up into a ball and rolling down waterfalls, making waterfall swimming in their territory quite dangerous. There is a company at the top of Tohjo Falls that uses POKENAME to deliver Tropic Mail to the bottom.

entry: POKENAME一生大多在水下，只在一年最冷的一天浮上来蜕皮、继续生长。难得的蜕皮，是工匠大师制作沉重球的珍贵材料。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME spends most of its life underwater, surfacing only on the coldest day of the year to shed its skin so it can grow. This rare, discarded skin is a prized ingredient in the crafting of a Heavy Ball by master artisans.

entry: POKENAME皮肤覆着含铜的黏稠凝胶，让火焰烧成蓝色。它一打喷嚏，便会暂时被烈焰包住，网络上的人却觉得可爱极了，看得十分开心。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The surface of POKENAME's skin is covered in a sticky gel containing copper. This causes the flames it produces to burn blue. When it sneezes, it is engulfed in a temporary inferno, much to the delight of the internet, which finds it adorable.

entry: 与进化前不同，POKENAME在当代文化里很不受欢迎，因为它会袭击新生宝可梦，吸走能量，维持背上的火焰。火一熄灭，它就会死。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Unlike its previous form, POKENAME is highly disliked in contemporary culture. This is because it is known for attacking newborn Pokémon. It does this to absorb their energy, which fuels the flames along its back. If they go out, POKENAME dies.

entry: POKENAME温顺单纯到极点，所谓“狩猎”，就是半浸水中，张着嘴随河漂流，盼有什么东西自己漂进嘴里。
author: sk372
source: Docile and simplistic to an extreme degree, POKENAME "hunts" by floating along the rivers with its mouth open and half-submerged, hoping something will float into its waiting maw.

entry: POKENAME完全失去了乌尼龟时期的玩心，如今独自捕猎、梳理身体。不过，离群太久，它还是会寂寞。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME have lost all the playfulness they exhibited as a Wootle. They now spend their time hunting alone and preening but still get lonely if they are away from others for too long.

entry: 一位残忍的训练家曾用十字镐，试图撬下POKENAME尾巴上的大舌贝。从此，它便害怕这种工具，一见到就本能地从鳃里释放黏稠污泥。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: A cruel Trainer once tried to pry the Shellder from a POKENAME's tail with a Pickaxe. Ever since, POKENAME have shown a fear of the tool, releasing a sticky sludge from their gills whenever they see one, an involuntary response to fear.

entry: 向POKENAME扔狩猎球，很少能如愿。它天生的磁力会干扰球的轨迹，让球偏离方向。这种现象尚未在其他种类的精灵球上发现。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Throwing a Safari Ball at a POKENAME rarely works as expected, as its natural magnetism disrupts the ball's trajectory and causes it to veer off course. This effect has not been observed with any other type of Poké Ball.

entry: POKENAME由三个相连的身体组成，释放低频磁波，靠脉冲稍稍悬离地面。风暴中，它会轻轻哼鸣，产生的黏液导电性极强，泛着静电的光。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is made up of three linked bodies that emit low-frequency magnetic waves. These pulses keep it suspended just above the ground. During storms, it hums softly, and the mucus it generates becomes highly conductive, glowing with static charge.

entry: POKENAME任何身体部位都能再生，因此远比多数宝可梦莽撞。据说，只有失去过翅膀、长得比以前更强壮后，它才能使出空气斩。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Able to regrow any part of its body, POKENAME are far less cautious than most Pokémon. It is said that they are only able to perform Air Slash after they have lost their wings, as once regrown, they return even stronger than before.

entry: 据说极偶尔会有只长一个头、智慧超人的POKENAME出生。可没有证据，或许只是安慰人的传说，毕竟大多数个体笨得常忘记吃饭。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: It is said that, on rare occasions, a POKENAME is born with only one head and possesses superhuman intelligence. There's no evidence to support this, and may simply be a comforting myth, as most POKENAME are incredibly dull and often forget to eat.

entry: 最早的记录中，一只未融合的乌波和嘟嘟利，被流星群砸得撞在一起，形成了这种宝可梦。它们不但没被打倒，反而似乎更强了，只是没变聪明。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The first recorded incidence of this Pokémon was after an unfused Wooper and Dodrio were smashed into each other by a Draco Meteor. Rather than knocking them out, it only seemed to make them stronger – though not smarter.

entry: POKENAME爱玩又亲人，看似完美宠物，直到离开水面。为保护皮肤，它分泌无害却散发腐臭的黏液，很快就能赶跑大多数人。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is playful and affectionate, making it seem like the perfect pet, until it leaves the water. To protect its skin, it secretes a harmless but putrified-smelling slime that quickly drives most people away.

entry: POKENAME吐息极冷，身边始终有雾，帮助娇嫩皮肤保持湿润。它常躺在漂流的冰山上，给水手带来危险，得靠清除浓雾才能安全绕过。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's breath is so cold it creates a constant mist around its body, helping to keep its delicate skin moist. Often found lounging on drifting icebergs, they can pose a hazard to sailors, who must rely on Defog to safely navigate around them.

entry: POKENAME浓稠如墨的涂层，带着强烈靛莓果味，掩盖它在泥沼中的踪迹。这黏稠物质会黏住任何擦过的东西。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's thick, ink-like coating smells strongly of Belue Berries, masking its presence in quagmires. This sticky substance clings to anything that brushes against it.

entry: POKENAME蠕过下水道，吸收污染物，留下有毒渗滤液。它能消化部分污染物，因此迁入后水质稍有改善，可气味难闻得连臭泥也会避开。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME oozes through sewers absorbing pollutants and leaving behind a trail of toxic leachate. Water quality is slightly improved if POKENAME moves in, as it can digest some pollutants, but its stench is so reprehensible that even Grimer avoid it.

entry: POKENAME常用背上的水炮互相打着玩。它会坚决保护乌尼龟和乌咪龟，随时愿为族群牺牲性命。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME often fight each other for fun using the water cannons on their backs. They are fierce protectors of Wootle and Wootortle, ready to lay their life down to protect the group.

entry: POKENAME曾是丰缘的珍馐，罕见得一份肉就值三个月工资。多亏融合技术，如今一家人气快餐连锁店每周都推出“POKENAME星期三”特惠。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Once considered a delicacy in Hoenn, POKENAME were so rare that a single serving of their meat cost the equivalent of three months' wages. Thanks to fusion tech, a popular fast-food chain now offers them in a weekly promotion: "POKENAME Wednesday".

entry: POKENAME曾是丰缘的珍馐，罕见得一份肉就值三个月工资。多亏融合技术，如今一家人气快餐连锁店每周都推出“POKENAME星期三”特惠。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Once considered a delicacy in Hoenn, POKENAME were so rare that a single serving of their meat cost the equivalent of three months' wages. Thanks to fusion tech, a popular fast-food chain now offers them in a weekly promotion: "POKENAME Wednesday".

entry: POKENAME躲在壳里，在其他宝可梦面前很害羞。关心它的训练家能鼓励它出壳玩耍。它会送来消化一半的食物作礼物，若训练家也回送食物，就开心极了。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME hides inside its shell and is very shy around other Pokémon. A caring Trainer can encourage them to come out of their shell to play. POKENAME gives gifts of half-digested food, and is delighted when Trainers give it some food in return.

entry: POKENAME如幽灵般漂游，出现时常伴着湿冷薄雾。它身边常有看似失去灵魂的沼王。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME drift as ghostly beings, their presence often marked by a cold, damp haze. They are often found alongside seemingly soulless Quagsire.

entry: 年幼POKENAME很顽皮，不停恶作剧，被抓住前就消失在雾里。成熟后，能用恶之波动让体重超过100千克的宝可梦失去行动能力。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Young POKENAME are mischievous, constantly playing pranks and vanishing into mist before they're caught. Mature POKENAME can use Dark Pulse to incapacitate Pokémon over 100kg.

entry: POKENAME藏在海面涟漪中，只有余光偶尔瞥见。游泳者漂进突然冰冷的水域，可能发现它攀住双腿，往下拖。已知唯一的脱身方法，是用连续拳攻击它。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME hides within the ripples of the sea, only glimpsed from the corner of your eye. Swimmers who drift into sudden cold patches may find one clinging to their legs, dragging them downward. The only known escape is to strike it with Comet Punch.

entry: 它大半时间在海床下钻洞，偶尔得浮到水面，让皮肤变硬。冲出海面的速度快得像在飞，常被误认成幼小的暴鲤龙。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Spending most of its time tunnelling under the seabed, it needs to come to the surface occasionally to harden its skin. It bursts out of the sea at such velocity it almost looks like it is flying, and is commonly misidentified as a young Gyarados.

entry: POKENAME一靠近，四周的生命就会莫名迷失方向、头昏眼花。据说，英语中表示晕乎乎的词便源于这种现象。接触太久，常会突然陷入无梦的睡眠。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: As POKENAME draws near, a strange sense of disorientation and light-headedness washes over those nearby, resulting in the word "woozy" originating from this effect. Prolonged exposure often leads to sudden, dreamless sleep.

entry: POKENAME领地里哪怕出现一点食物，也能引发争食。它们十分合群，大群生活，可一到饭点就总要吵。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Even small morsels of food can cause a feeding frenzy in POKENAME's territory. They are very social and live in large colonies but always squabble when it comes to mealtimes.

entry: POKENAME想环游世界，却懒得游远，便攀在路过船只的后部船底。它很爱社交，会学到沿途海滩的口音，因此没有两只说话的声音完全相同。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME dream of exploring the world but are too lazy to swim far, so they cling abaft the undersides of passing ships. Highly social, they pick up accents from the beaches they visit and no two POKENAME sound exactly the same when they speak.

entry: POKENAME很爱社交，身边没同类时，就用钳子敲着聊天。它会学到沿途海滩的口音，因此没有两只说话的声音完全相同。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are very social, and if there are no others of their kind around, they chatter with their claws. They pick up accents from the beaches they visit and no two POKENAME sound exactly the same when they speak.

entry: POKENAME喜欢泡在沼泽水里休息，用皮肤吸收养分。它小心让花苞露出水面，吸收阳光。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to rest in swampy water where they absorb nutrients through their skin. They are careful to keep their flower bud above the water to absorb sunlight.

entry: POKENAME爬过浑浊沼泽，寻找茂密叶片吃。饱餐后就藏进泥里，等饿了再出来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME crawl through murky swamps to find bushy leaves to consume. After a dense meal, they hide in the mud until they are hungry again.

entry: POKENAME虽然能摇摇摆摆地走，却似乎更喜欢滚动和跳跃。滚动能让它产生更多电力，既可能只是附带效果，也可能正是它爱滚的原因。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME may be able to waddle around, but they seem to prefer rolling and jumping most of all. Either a mere byproduct of their rolling or the reason they prefer to roll, rolling helps them generate more electricity than they otherwise would have.

entry: POKENAME久静不动。究竟是身体太湿，还是太懒，才迟迟不爆炸，科学家也无从确定。
author: duskrd
source: Scientists have been unable to determine if POKENAME is either too damp or too lazy to explode. It stays completely still for long periods of time.

entry: POKENAME身上带着几根骨头，却似乎不用来战斗。它敲骨棒，只因喜欢声音；戴头盔，也只因喜欢自己戴着的样子。
author: sk372
source: Although POKENAME carries several bones on its body, it doesn't appear to use them for battle purposes. It smacks its clubs together because it likes the noise, and wears the helmet because it likes how it looks wearing it.

entry: 它总吐着舌头，不知是在逗人，还是不得不如此。平日便在沼地与湿泽间，游来游去。
author: dodoowner_
source: It constantly sticks its tongue out, either to be funny or because it has to. It swims around in marshes and swamps.

entry: POKENAME在空中漂浮，释放浓稠、污染环境的烟雾。它并无恶意，只是不知道自己的气体有毒。
author: fancyskunk
source: POKENAME floats through the air, releasing a thick, polluting smog. It lacks any malicious intent in this; it is simply oblivious to the toxic nature of its own gasses.

entry: 沼毛虫进化成POKENAME时，会钻进泥堆裹上壳，身体则化成黏液。坚硬外壳保护液体，等身体重构，完成进化。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: When a Quagpie evolves into POKENAME, it burrows into a pile of mud and coats itself in a shell while its body decomposes into a gooey liquid. Its hard outer shell keeps this liquid safe as it reconstructs its body to evolve.

entry: POKENAME为人父母也单纯轻信，曾把孩子交给刚认识的人或宝可梦，自己便摇摇摆摆地走开，享受独处。
author: sk372
source: As a parent, POKENAME is simple-minded and trusting. It has been known to hand its child over to people and Pokémon it has only just met before waddling off to enjoy some alone time.

entry: 过去，有些以浮夸绚丽演出闻名的表演者，因POKENAME优美的鳍和动作，用它的名字自称。称呼流传下来，许多人至今仍穿着受它鲜艳外貌、飘逸风格启发的华服。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Performers known for theatrical, flashy shows once called themselves "POKENAME" after its elegant fins and graceful movements. The name stuck, and many still wear ornate costumes inspired by its vibrant appearance and flowing style.

entry: POKENAME飞行间隙会定期泡水，因为翅膀缺乏水分就难以运作。它最爱吃池塘和湖边泥地生长的植物、蘑菇。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME regularly takes a dip in water between flights, as its wings don't function well without sufficient moisture. Its favorite meals are plants and mushrooms that grow in the muddy edges of ponds and lakes.

entry: POKENAME挥刃劈砍时，会从刃尖喷出臭水。气味分散对手的注意，恰好够它接上下一击。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME slashes with its blades, it sprays smelly water from the tips. The odor distracts opponents just long enough for a follow-up.

entry: POKENAME有些迟钝，反倒消磨了攻击性。许多个体住在牧场，让孩子骑着玩。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a certain obtuseness that mellows out their aggression. Many live on ranches where they give rides to children.

entry: POKENAME在泥沼爬行，躲避天敌视线。若被发现，就甩泥巴、挥动毒刺，直到对方失去兴趣。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME crawl through muddy swamps to avoid being seen by predators. If they are spotted, they fling mud and brandish their venomous stinger until the predator loses interest.

entry: POKENAME身体虽长，上岸仍想用脚走，而非蜿蜒爬行，结果总不顺利。不过，它费力挪动的样子，让它成了港口城镇的人气观光亮点。
author: thesilverowls
source: Despite their bodies' length, POKENAME still attempt to use their feet for movement on land instead of slithering. This rarely goes well, but the sight of their struggles has made them something of a popular tourist attraction for port towns.

entry: POKENAME乐于在水上载客，却相当迷糊。常得一遍遍提醒目的地，免得它游着游着跑偏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is happy to ferry passengers along the water, but it is rather scatterbrained. It will often need to be reminded repeatedly of where it is supposed to go so that it doesn't wander off.

entry: POKENAME在沼泽里懒散度日，偶尔变成眼前看见的东西。不管变成什么，精力和懒散程度都不会改变。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME laze around in swamps and marshes, occasionally transforming into whatever it sees. Regardless of what it transforms into, its energy and laziness do not change.

entry: POKENAME不只忠于训练家，谁关心它，它就忠于谁。无论什么物种的宝可梦聚居，都能看见它想办法融入。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: POKENAME are very loyal not only to Trainers but to anything that shows care for them. Wherever a group of Pokémon lives, regardless of species, POKENAME can be found attempting to fit in.

entry: POKENAME不只忠于训练家，谁关心它，它就忠于谁。无论什么物种的宝可梦聚居，都能看见它想办法融入。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: POKENAME are very loyal not only to Trainers but to anything that shows care for them. Wherever a group of Pokémon lives, regardless of species, POKENAME can be found attempting to fit in.

entry: POKENAME喜欢融进一片水里，等猎物游过，再及时恢复实体，发动袭击。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: POKENAME's preferred method of hunting involves melting into a patch of water, waiting for prey to swim through, and then rematerializing just in time to strike.

entry: 野生POKENAME蹭树产生静电，标记领地，再用积攒的电荷把树烧成焦炭。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: Wild POKENAME mark their territories by rubbing against a tree to generate static electricity. They will then burn the tree to a crisp with their built-up static charge.

entry: POKENAME常住温泉，生活平静悠闲。冬季，颈部的毛会冒蒸汽，许多小宝可梦便来寻求庇护。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: Usually found in hot springs, POKENAME live very calm, relaxed lives. The fur around POKENAME's neck generates steam during winter months. Many small Pokémon seek POKENAME for refuge during these months.

entry: POKENAME虽庞大强壮，性情却温和极了。它心思极简单，仰躺在湖里，让乌波、大牙狸等宝可梦歇在肚子上。
author: sk372
source: Despite its massive size and strength, POKENAME is as gentle as can be. Extremely simpleminded, it floats belly-up in lakes and lets Pokémon such as Wooper and Bidoof rest on its stomach.

entry: POKENAME化蛹时，大半身体包在壳里，头却探在外面警戒天敌。一发现就叫起来，提醒巢里的其他成员。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: While most of their bodies are encased, POKENAME poke their head out while pupating to watch out for predators. Should a POKENAME spot one, it will cry out to alert the rest of the hive.

entry: POKENAME生活在大河附近，从水面捞鱼吃。它总心情很好，常在浅水里安静打盹。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives near large rivers, scooping up fish from the water's surface. It is always in a good mood and can be seen peacefully taking naps in the shallow water.

entry: POKENAME每年会离巢一次，飞过极寒地区。若发现迷路、快冻僵的登山者，就会将对方带到安全处。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: Once every year, POKENAME will leave its nest to fly through arctic regions. If it spots a lost hiker at risk of freezing, POKENAME will pick them up and carry them to safety.

entry: POKENAME高速翱翔时，能产生超过200万伏的电压。仅凭与空气粒子碰撞产生的摩擦，就足以达到如此高压。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: POKENAME create over two million volts of electricity by soaring through the air at high speeds. Collision with air particles is all they need to produce enough friction to generate such high voltage.

entry: POKENAME其实不会生火，而是到火山吸收岩浆，留待日后使用。体内一次最多能储存30加仑岩浆。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: POKENAME can't actually produce fire; rather, it absorbs magma in a volcano for later use. POKENAME can store up to thirty gallons of magma at any given time.

entry: 谁靠近巢穴，POKENAME就极具攻击性；巢不受威胁时，却又悠闲自在。野生个体的蜂蜜尝起来像泥巴。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: While POKENAME are very aggressive to anything that gets too close to their hive, they are very lax and carefree when their hive isn't being threatened. Wild POKENAME honey tastes similar to mud.

entry: POKENAME外形和能力都令人畏惧，平时却脾气很好，爱与其他宝可梦相处。只要力所能及，它都会挺身保护受欺负的弱小宝可梦。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: Despite its intimidating appearance and abilities, POKENAME is usually very well-tempered and loves to interact with other Pokémon. It will stand up for any weak, mistreated Pokémon it can.

entry: POKENAME精神力量强大，却因太重而无法飘浮。它在沼泽边摇摆着走，一被人看见，就瞬间传送离开。
author: bigoljax
source: Despite their strong psychic abilities, POKENAME are unable to float due to their weight. They waddle around the edge of marshes, instantly teleporting away when someone sees them.

entry: POKENAME单纯友善，瞬间传送到世界各地，与沼泽等泥地的宝可梦玩。有时只是它想玩，训练家就莫名被传送进泥坑。
author: sk372
source: Simpleminded and friendly, POKENAME teleports across the world to play with Pokémon that live in swamps and other muddy areas. Occasionally, Trainers have been randomly teleported to mud-holes because of a POKENAME wishing to play.

entry: POKENAME宜人的香气被形容为花香中带一丝咸咸海风，吸引许多生命。可多数随后就被口气熏跑，因为它偏吃味道特别冲的真菌。
author: sk372
source: Many are drawn to POKENAME for its pleasing scent, described as floral with a hint of salty sea air. Most are then repelled by its breath, which is very odoriferous due to its diet of particularly pungent fungi.

entry: POKENAME性情温和被动，爱呆呆望着远方。花粉能治好周围生病的植物，保证自己总有美景可看。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are passive creatures that love to stare blankly into the distance. The pollen they produce heals sick plants around them, which ensures that POKENAME always have something beautiful to stare at.

entry: POKENAME住在深泥岸里，也睡在里面。藏在泥下时，往往只能靠冒出的气泡，才知道它在。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME lives and sleeps in deep mud banks. While under the mud, the only evidence of a POKENAME's presence is often the bubbles it creates rising to the surface.

entry: POKENAME后颈的发热部位若过热，就会让水产生大量蒸汽，扰乱对手，遮蔽视线。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: If the heat-generating areas on the back of POKENAME's neck get too hot, it will cause the water to generate large amounts of steam, confusing and obscuring the view of its opponents.

entry: POKENAME能吐泥团、喷出水流，阻止敌人靠近。它更爱享用静湖和小河边花朵的蜜。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can spit clumps of mud and gushes of water to deter foes from approaching. It prefers to feast on the nectar from flowers growing by still lakes and small rivers.

entry: POKENAME开心地飞在浑浊湿地上，总带着无忧无虑的笑容。性情温和，会用宽大、浮力强的尾巴，帮助成群乌波渡过深而湍急的河流。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME flutter happily above murky wetlands with a perpetual, carefree smile. These gentle Pokémon use their broad, buoyant tails to help ferry groups of Wooper across deep, fast-moving river currents.

entry: POKENAME在水外放电，皮肤会迅速干燥，必须赶紧潜回水里，免得疼痛开裂。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME discharges electricity, its skin dries rapidly if out of water. It must re-submerge quickly to prevent painful cracking.

entry: POKENAME把空气存在尾巴的特殊气囊里，能边打盹边悠闲地顺流漂下。厚皮保护它不受尖石和天敌伤害。孩子有时把起伏的尾巴当成玩具，试着钓过来。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME stores air in a special sac in its tail, allowing it to float lazily downstream while napping. Its thick skin protects it from sharp rocks and predators. Children sometimes mistake its bobbing tail for a toy and try to reel it in.

entry: POKENAME最爱坐在河床上，让皮肤吸水。它态度悠闲乐观，许多其他宝可梦也会来陪着懒散度日，享受平和气氛。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves to just sit in the riverbed, absorbing the water into its skin. It has an incredibly relaxed and positive attitude, and plenty of other Pokémon will laze with it to enjoy the peaceful vibes.

entry: POKENAME胖乎乎的翅膀只能让它短暂飞起。它在空中跌撞乱飞，碰到东西后，又扑通落回栖居的沼泽。它爱吃泡过水的树果。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME can only fly in short bursts with their pudgy wings. They blunder about in the air, bumping into things before splashing back down into the marshlands they call home. They like eating berries that have been soaking in water.

entry: POKENAME在泥里打滚，靠体表的黏膜黏住泥巴。有时昆虫和小宝可梦也被一起黏上，它就开心地从身上摘下来，当零食吃。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME rolls around in mud, which sticks to it due to a sticky film that coats it. Sometimes insects and small Pokémon get caught up along with the mud, which POKENAME happily plucks off itself and snacks on.

entry: POKENAME在泥里打滚，靠体表的黏膜黏住泥巴。有时昆虫和小宝可梦也被一起黏上，它就开心地从身上摘下来，当零食吃。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME rolls around in mud, which sticks to it due to a sticky film that coats it. Sometimes insects and small Pokémon get caught up along with the mud, which POKENAME happily plucks off itself and snacks on.

entry: 据说，这种融合体是所有沼王的王。王冠越大、装饰越华美，就越受尊重。
author: valtsuri
source: This fusion is said to be the king of all Quagsire. The larger and more decorated the crown, the more respect it has.

entry: POKENAME与泥地栖居环境融为一体，身体甚至有一部分也变成了泥。形态虽有些不稳，仿佛快融化，它却依然开心、无忧无虑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is so in-tune with its muddy habitat that its body has in part become mud as well. Despite its slightly unstable, almost melting form, POKENAME remains happy and carefree in behavior.

entry: POKENAME定期比赛，看谁的精神力量最强。奇怪的是，脑袋越空，反而越善于运用精神力量。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: POKENAME regularly hold competitions to see whose psychic powers are the strongest. The POKENAME with the emptiest heads are strangely the most adept at utilizing psychic abilities.

entry: POKENAME身上的深色花纹容易被雨冲掉。虽然不影响战斗力，它却总会放下手头的事，重新涂好花纹，因此很少赢得战斗。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: The dark markings on POKENAME are prone to washing off in the rain. This does nothing to POKENAME's fighting abilities, but it will usually stop whatever it is doing at the moment to re-apply the markings. Because of this, it rarely wins fights.

entry: POKENAME用皮肤吸收泥中养分，滋养尾巴上的叶片。太阳照到眼睛时，它就举叶遮阳。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME absorb nutrients from mud through their skin to nourish the leaves on their tail. Whenever the sun shines in their eyes, they shade themselves with their leaves.

entry: POKENAME迟缓又没干劲，常张着嘴躺在地上，等东西自己走进去。若看得够久，甚至能亲眼看见门牙一点点长长。
author: foolish_weasel
source: It is very sluggish and unmotivated. It will often just lie down on the ground with its mouth open, waiting for something to wander in. If someone watches POKENAME do this for long enough, they can even see its fangs grow in real-time.

entry: POKENAME身体围着毒膜，仿佛完全不理外界。每天似乎随机挑个时间，与同类聚在一起跳舞，科学家至今仍在研究这个谜。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a toxic membrane surrounding its body and is seemingly oblivious to the outside world. It gathers with other POKENAME at seemingly random points in the day and dances, which is an enigma that scientists are still studying.

entry: POKENAME漫无目的地小跑过沼泽，享受湿润空气。尾巴像乌波，甚至能模仿叫声，因此总吸引乌波跟随。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME trots mindlessly around swampy regions, enjoying the humidity in the air. Wooper are drawn to follow it due to its tail, which resembles that of Wooper and can even mimic its cry.

entry: POKENAME张着嘴，等猎物进入范围，就迅速吞下。随后紧紧合起，慢慢消化，一顿就够满足数月。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME leaves its mouth open until prey wanders into range, at which point it moves at great speed and devours it. It then tightly closes and slowly digests its food; a single meal can keep it satisfied for several months.

entry: POKENAME身体黏滑，四处滑动，反复撞上洞壁。钢铁般坚硬的身体留下凹痕，能用来追踪它的行迹。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's slimy body causes it to slide around and repeatedly bump into cave walls. The indents left behind by its steel-hard body can be used to track down its movements.

entry: POKENAME没有真正的牙齿，只有坚韧、带棱的牙龈。猎物常只受些淤伤就逃掉，让它只能靠坚韧植物和慢行昆虫维生。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME has no true teeth, only tough, ridged gums. When it bites at prey, they often escape with little more than bruises, leaving it to rely on a diet of hardy plants and slow-moving insects to survive.

entry: POKENAME爱在大池塘和水洼里扑腾，拍翅把自己淋湿。它飞得笨拙，起飞时常撞上那些不留神坐在水边的人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME love to splash in large ponds and puddles, flapping their wings to coat them in water. They are clumsy in flight and will frequently fly into any person unwary enough to be sat at the water's edge when they take off.

entry: POKENAME在水底取食，吸取沙里藏着的养分。它大半时间都懒洋洋地游逛海底。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are bottom feeders, sucking up any nutrients hidden in the sand. They spend most of their days lazily roaming the ocean floor.

entry: POKENAME大半时间在河面游泳，偶尔潜水，用宽大翅膀推进。虽然能飞，在空中却十分笨拙，毫不优雅。
author: katieplaysgames
