source: POKENAME spend most of their time swimming at the surface of rivers, occasionally diving under the water using their broad wings to propel themselves. Whilst they can fly, they are very clumsy and inelegant in the air.

entry: POKENAME懒懒地歇在珊瑚礁里，饿了就啃珊瑚。受伤后，用自我再生就能轻易修复损坏的部位。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rests lazily among coral reefs, gnawing on coral when hungry. If injured, it uses Recover to heal any damaged parts with ease.

entry: POKENAME向路过者吐墨汁和泥巴的混合物，泥团一命中就大叫。起初被认为是在守领地，后来才知道，这其实是它友好打招呼的方式。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spits an ink-and-mud mixture at any passersby, emitting a loud cry once the blob impacts its target. At first it was thought to be territorial behavior, but apparently this is actually considered a friendly greeting for POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME高兴时会蹦蹦跳跳，开心地乱挥翅膀，撒下脏兮兮的羽毛。羽毛逐渐融入地面，滋养泥土。
author: sk372
source: When elated, POKENAME prances around and happily flails its wings around, scattering its grimy feathers around. These dissolve into the ground over time and help nurture the mud and soil.

entry: POKENAME潜居沼泽，行动隐蔽，爱吃小型两栖动物。它如何在野外活下来，仍是谜，因为圈养个体连面对眼前的猎物，也常不知所措。
author: hophoppip
source: A stealthy swamp-dwelling Pokémon that likes to eat smaller amphibians. It's unknown how it survives in the wild, as captive-kept POKENAME are often confused by prey even when they're right in front of them.

entry: POKENAME看似胖乎乎，其实全是肌肉，因此能在河床上有力地大步前行。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It appears to be very chubby, but is pure muscle. This allows POKENAME to stride powerfully along river beds.

entry: POKENAME住在大湖附近，用各种水生植物装饰角。强壮的蹄能踏过泥地，不被陷住。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives near large lakes, decorating its antlers with all sorts of aquatic plants. Its strong hooves allow for it to walk through the muddy terrain without getting stuck.

entry: 据说POKENAME一个哈欠就能引发海啸。它平静地住在海底，身体无论被怎么碰，都毫不在意。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is said a single yawn from POKENAME could cause a tsunami. POKENAME lives placidly at the bottom of the sea, completely undisturbed by any physical contact it receives.

entry: POKENAME是合力施法，守护森林的小妖精。虽然呆呆的、无忧无虑，却从不忘记，林间发生的事。
author: theeggoverlord
source: POKENAME are little fairies who protect the forest with their combined magics. While dopey and carefree, they never forget what happens in the forest.

entry: POKENAME吃太多时，常游着游着就睡了，自己还没察觉。水下呼吸毫无问题，它能在河床打盹数小时，把泥巴和藻类当成舒适床铺。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME overeats, it often falls asleep while swimming without even realizing it. Since it has no trouble breathing underwater, it can spend hours napping on the riverbed, using mud and algae as a comfortable bedding.

entry: POKENAME突然行动时，过大的舌头会失控乱甩，把浓口水溅到四周。有些训练家只好轻轻固定舌头，免得战斗或旅行时被淋一身。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Whenever POKENAME moves suddenly, its oversized tongue flails uncontrollably, splattering anything nearby with thick drool. Some Trainers resort to gently securing its tongue to prevent getting soaked during battles or travel.

entry: POKENAME天性被动，受打扰却会挥藤反击。一困住威胁，就毫不在意地继续打盹。
author: .izik
source: Though passive by nature, POKENAME lashes out with vines when disturbed. Once it traps a threat, it resumes napping without concern.

entry: POKENAME飘到哪里，就带来指路的祝福。循着它的水痕前行，就能到达附近最好的沼泽。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: It brings blessings of guidance wherever it floats. Those who follow the wake of a POKENAME are led to the choicest swamps in the area.

entry: POKENAME虽被归为植物，却没有叶绿体，无法进行光合作用。因此，它住在水质浑浊的湿地，从水中吸收养分。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: POKENAME, despite technically being classified as plant life, do not contain any chloroplasts and thus cannot photosynthesize. To fight this, they inhabit wetlands with dirty water, drawing nutrients from said source.

entry: POKENAME虽然带着冰的特性，却受不了寒冷地方，更喜欢温暖潮湿的环境。只有万不得已，才用冰属性攻击。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: Despite their icy nature, POKENAME cannot stand cold places. They prefer to live in warm, humid biomes, using ice-based attacks only in last-resort situations.

entry: POKENAME睡在沼泽时，头上的角会释放大量无线电信号。收到的内容通常是乱码般的胡言乱语，来自它一生吸收的数据。
author: .izik
source: While sleeping in marshlands, POKENAME releases high amounts of radio signals from the horn on its head. If received, these signals are usually garbled nonsense derived from the data it has absorbed throughout its lifetime.

entry: POKENAME背上的尖刺滴着恶臭的蓝色液体，毒性虽弱，一接触却会痒得厉害。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's back quills drip with a blue fluid that smells awful. Though only mildly toxic, it causes intense itching on contact.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME用腿将沸水踢向敌人，同时还做出复杂的翻腾动作。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME kicks boiling water from its legs at foes during combat. It does this while simultaneously pulling off complex flipping motions.

entry: POKENAME在浅泥水里涉行，吸收养分和矿物质。吃饱后就扑倒泥洼里，仰面睡觉，好看着云朵飘过。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wade in shallow muddy water to absorb nutrients and minerals. When they are full, they flop down into a mud puddle and fall asleep facing the sky so they can see clouds roll by.

entry: POKENAME心思单纯、心地善良，只想给其他生命带来快乐。它能释放精神波动，扫去负面念头，让对方暂时平静安宁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses a simple mind and a kind heart, wishing only to bring joy to others. It can emit a psychic pulse that empties the minds of others of any negative thoughts, bringing them placid peacefulness for a time.

entry: POKENAME非常单纯、温顺友好。它在浅湖里涉行，用尾巴拍水，招呼其他生命一起来玩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is extremely simple-minded, docile and friendly. It wades around in shallow lakes, slapping its tail against the water as a call to others to come play with it.

entry: POKENAME藏在沼泽水中，等猎物游过自己潜伏的闹鬼岩石，再试着让对方大脑停止运转。可它常失败，只让猎物短暂地变笨一点。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME hides in swamp water, waiting for prey to swim over the haunted rock it lurks in. It then attempts to shut down their brains, but often fails and leaves its prey slightly unintelligent for a brief moment of time.

entry: 史前时代，POKENAME吃水生植物为生。它太心不在焉，往往等发现天敌，早已为时太晚。
author: .izik
source: In prehistoric times, POKENAME grazed on aquatic plants. It is so absentminded that it rarely notices predators until it's far too late.

entry: POKENAME野外很少见，因为它懒得认真找食物，只随河漂流，等鱼自己游到够得着的地方。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is quite rare in the wild, as it does not put a lot of effort into looking for food. Instead, it just lazily floats along the river, waiting for any fish to swim within reach.

entry: POKENAME惯用头槌进攻，可脑袋又软又空，实在打不出多少威力。
author: sandguything
source: POKENAME's default offensive strategy consists of headbutting its opponents, though its head is too squishy and empty to do any significant damage.

entry: POKENAME本能地保护弱小宝可梦，单纯的心思却也不怨恨攻击者。对方撞上坚硬头骨、被拦住后，反会得到它友善的一舔。
author: sk372
source: It defends smaller Pokémon on instinct, but its simple mind holds no ill will towards aggressors either. Those that are halted by ramming into its solid skull wind up getting a friendly lick from POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME性情温和，爱躺在沼泽泥里晒太阳。偶尔需要保卫巢穴时，据说角只需一刺，就能让冲来的顿甲失去行动能力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are mellow creatures that enjoy spending time laying down in swampy mud and sunbathing. On the rare occasion they need to defend their nest, a single jab from their horn is said to incapacitate a charging Donphan.

entry: 刚发现POKENAME时，人们以为它用尾巴拍地是在玩。后来才知道，它是在试着交流，提醒即将来临的灾难。
author: sk372
source: In the early days of first discovering POKENAME, it was thought that the slapping of its tail against the ground was play behavior. It's since been discovered it's actually an attempt to communicate and warn of impending disasters.

entry: POKENAME突然冒出沼泽、发出惊人叫声，常不小心吓走想结识的玩伴。它完全无害，没跑掉的人会得到一位快乐友善、热切想同行的伙伴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME often inadvertently scares away potential playmates by popping up from marshes with a startling cry. It is entirely harmless, so those that don't run away will find a blissful friendly companion eager to travel with them.

entry: POKENAME出没于河港码头，夜里从凿沉驳船的泥泞残骸中现身。与空洞目光相对的人，会心神恍惚，即使被带向浑浊河底也不察觉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME haunt river docks, emerging from the muddy ruins of scuttled barges at night. Those who meet their vacant gaze feel their own mind wandering, even as they're led into the murky river depths.

entry: 过去，人们猎取POKENAME营养丰富的脂肪，一只就够十个人吃一整冬。禁猎后，它们又生活了数十年，如今许多个体已有数百岁。
author: quackquackattack
source: In the past, they were hunted for their nutritious blubber, as one POKENAME could sustain a group of ten people for an entire winter. After this practice was banned, they continued to live for decades, and many alive now are hundreds of years old.

entry: 古代占卜者将POKENAME奉为沼泽之神。人们用烧过的香蒲摆出形似它面孔的护佑图案，夜里守护家园。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME was believed to be a god of marshes by ancient oracles. Burned cattails were shaped into protective symbols resembling its face to guard homes at night.

entry: POKENAME生活节奏缓慢，大多数日子都在打盹。庞大的身体哪怕只挪几英尺，也要耗费大量能量，因此节省能量至关重要。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live a slow-paced life where most of their days are spent napping. Conserving energy is vital for these large creatures, as it takes a lot of energy to move a few feet.

entry: POKENAME在沼泽里艰难跋涉，寻找淡水。一发现有趣的东西，就会难得地灵活起来，摇摆着赶过去。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME trudge through swamplands to find fresh water. Whenever they find something of interest, they get a rare burst of agility that allows them to waddle towards whatever piques their interest.

entry: POKENAME能与其他宝可梦交流，却很少知道该说什么。它常张开嘴，像要说话，最终却一声不出。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is capable of communicating with other Pokémon, but it rarely knows what to say. It often opens its mouth as if to speak, but lets no sound come out.

entry: POKENAME爱逗乐其他生命，尤其喜欢年幼宝可梦。拿手好戏是从头顶喷水，把“帽子”冲飞，再任它落回头上，装作被砸晕。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME loves to entertain others, particularly young Pokémon. Its signature act has it spurting water from its head and causing its "hat" to fly off and fall back on it, pretending to be knocked out by the impact.

entry: POKENAME爱仰躺在水里漂流，用翅膀松松地引导方向。尾巴粗壮有力，一次有力的摔打就能掀起颇大的浪。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME love to lay on their backs in water and drift about, their wings loosely guiding them. Their tails are thick and strong, with a single good Slam being able to create a decently-sized wave.

entry: POKENAME失去一只或两只翅膀，都能再生。通常需要约一周，等待期间却十分脆弱。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: If POKENAME were to lose one or both of its wings, it could regenerate the lost limb. This process usually lasts for about a week, but POKENAME are quite vulnerable during the wait.

entry: POKENAME在沼泽用幻象藏住自己和家。等倒霉旅人掉进泥里，才解除幻象，痛快嘲笑对方的不幸。
author: sk372
source: While residing in marshes, POKENAME casts illusions to hide itself and its home. It waits for hapless travelers to fall into the mud before dispelling the illusion to have a good laugh at their misfortune.

entry: POKENAME撞到船，就好奇地探出水面，看看撞了什么。许多个体会想抱抱表示歉意，可多数人不太愿意拥抱满身泥的它。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME bump into boats, they curiously poke their head above the water to see what they bumped into. Many offer hugs as an apology, though most people are reluctant to hug a muddy POKENAME.

entry: 野生POKENAME按丝带状肢体上的泥纹延伸多远来选首领。不过，泥纹若一直延伸到本体，反而被视为不适合领导。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: Wild POKENAME determine their leaders by how far the mud markings on their ribbon-like appendages reach; however, POKENAME with markings that reach their main body are deemed unfit to lead.

entry: 对POKENAME炮的分析显示，它能发射宝可梦中最强力的一类泡沫光线。不过，它只用这门炮吹出少量泡泡，陪幼崽和朋友玩。
author: sk372
source: Analysis of POKENAME's cannon suggests it can fire out some of the most powerful Bubble Beam attacks among Pokémon. However, it only uses it to blow light amounts of bubbles to play with its young and their friends.

entry: 冬季，POKENAME会找一位朋友，一起游进水下洞穴，寻找冬眠处。据说每到冬眠季，它总选同一位朋友，彼此陪伴才安心。
author: quackquackattack
source: During the winter season, POKENAME find a friend and swim into underwater caves in search of a place to hibernate. It is said that they always choose the same friend every time during hibernation season, as they help each other feel safe.

entry: POKENAME出现在刚离世的宝可梦身旁，其他生命就会本能地让开。人们相信，它们感知到了超自然的存在，让它完成被许多人视为神圣的葬仪。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When POKENAME appears beside a recently deceased Pokémon, all others instinctively step aside. It's believed they sense its supernatural presence, allowing it to carry out what many consider sacred funerary rites.

entry: POKENAME大多不活动，只需水就能维生。它似乎总心情很好，挨了大多数攻击也若无其事，甚至毫无察觉。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is mostly inactive, requiring only water in order to survive. It always seems to be in a good mood, shrugging off most attacks without even noticing.

entry: POKENAME十分保护年幼乌波，常在乌波众多的沼泽上空盘旋。察觉危险，就会把幼崽带到安全处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are very protective of young Wooper and will often hover around marshes with large populations of Wooper. They will lift the young Pokémon to safety if they sense danger.

entry: 野生POKENAME偏爱住在火山的岩浆房。在别处见到它，是很稀罕的事。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: A wild POKENAME prefers to reside in the magma chamber of a volcano. Seeing one living anywhere else is a rare occurrence.

entry: POKENAME每条尾巴都很重，举着却似乎毫不费力。皮肤分泌的黏液，在阳光下灿烂闪亮。
author: empty_set
source: Each of POKENAME's tails is very heavy, but it never seems to struggle to hold them up.  The mucus its skin excretes glistens brilliantly in the sun.

entry: POKENAME登场时气势惊人，高耸的身影从浅得不可思议的泥水洼里冒出。随后却笨拙地乱逛，仿佛没有任何目的。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME has been known to make an imposing entrance, its towering form emerging from impossibly shallow puddles of swamp muck. After this, it bumbles around with no apparent goal.

entry: POKENAME两条水状肢体伸得很远，能好奇地触摸、探索四周。肢体还能瞬间净化小片水域，让水清新透亮。
author: sk372
source: The twin water-like limbs of POKENAME give it a long reach to touch and curiously explore its surroundings. These limbs can purify small bodies of water, turning them fresh and crystal-clear in an instant.

entry: POKENAME横身拦住小溪，形成堤坝，吃聚来的养分。若水没流过身体，它就会严重晒伤，接连几天都脾气不好。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME dams small streams by stretching its body across them, feeding on the nutrients that gather. If the water doesn't flow over its body, it gets a terrible sunburn and becomes grumpy for several days.

entry: POKENAME太懒，能在泥里坐到，身边的泥土全干硬了。之后便动不了，只好等着下一场雨。
author: blitzydragon
source: POKENAME is quite lazy. It can sit in the mud for so long that the earth will dry around it, leaving it immobilized until it rains again.

entry: 一下雨，POKENAME就激动地泼泥、扔泥。因此，POKENAME的领地，多半到处是干泥。
author: blitzydragon
source: Whenever it rains, POKENAME will start splashing and throwing mud violently. Territories of POKENAME are usually covered in dried mud because of this.

entry: POKENAME友善的笑容，足以让路过的游泳者安心。它爱漂在波浪上，背着疲倦的人与宝可梦，帮助他们上岸。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The friendly smile of a POKENAME is enough to soothe any swimmer that happens to pass by. POKENAME enjoy drifting above the waves, carrying tired people and Pokémon on their backs to help them to shore.

entry: POKENAME很笨拙，陆上走路摇摇晃晃。虽然看似无害，却能瞬间让鳍带电，自我防卫。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its clumsy nature makes POKENAME wobble when it walks on land. Despite seeming harmless, it can coat its fins in electricity in an instant to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME记性太差，有时会忘记自己在追猎物，索性放弃。在水里，它快如闪电，尾巴一摆就能前进数米。
author: fiordaliso
source: Because of its terrible memory, it sometimes forgets that it is chasing prey and abandons the hunt altogether. In the water, POKENAME moves as fast as lightning, and a single swing of its tail is enough to propel it several meters forward.

entry: 满月之夜，POKENAME漫无目的地四处蹦跳。即使遭到攻击，也因太过无忧无虑，完全不把威胁当回事。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME are found bouncing around aimlessly during nights of a full moon. Even when attacked, their immensely carefree nature disregards any threats.

entry: POKENAME躺在泥池，张嘴等猎物，自己走进来。可几乎，从来没有成功过。
author: duskrd
source: POKENAME lies in a pool of mud and waits for prey to wander into its open mouth. It is almost never successful.

entry: POKENAME通常住在较小的海域。犯困时，便用双翼裹住身体，钻进海床睡去。
author: niseria
source: POKENAME usually live in smaller seas. If POKENAME get sleepy, they cover themselves with their wings and burrow into the seabed.

entry: POKENAME智力不高，想去哪就去哪，毫不多想。或许正因此，种群数量很少。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME have low intelligence and go wherever they please without a second thought. It is likely for this reason that they have a low population.

entry: POKENAME智力不高，想去哪就去哪，毫不多想。或许正因此，种群数量很少。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME have low intelligence and go wherever they please without a second thought. It is likely for this reason that they have a low population.

entry: POKENAME歇在急流里，让水流转动齿轮状身体，积蓄能量，再猛然释放，用尾巴推动身体高速前进。它一生都在慢慢逆流而上，前往产蛋。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME rests in fast-moving streams, letting the current turn its gear-like body to store energy. It releases this power in bursts, propelling itself with its tail at great speed. Its life is spent slowly journeying upriver to lay its eggs.

entry: POKENAME拿到什么热食都吃，却常把火也当成食物，因此舌头往往烫得厉害。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: POKENAME will eat any hot food it can get its hands on. Because it often mistakes fire for food, most POKENAME can be found with scalding tongues.

entry: 只要身体浸在自身凝胶里，POKENAME几小时内就能再生任何部位。科学家推测，断肢若留在凝胶里，也会长成新的POKENAME。
author: mistymagius
source: As long as POKENAME's body is submerged in its gel, it can regenerate any body part within a few hours. Scientists theorize that if a cut-off limb is kept in the gel, it will grow into a new POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME爱捉弄游泳者，把人拖进水下几秒钟。它并不聪明，甚至不去捕猎，只靠其他宝可梦剩下的食物过活。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME enjoys playing pranks on swimmers by dragging them underwater for a few seconds. It isn't particularly clever; in fact, instead of hunting, it makes do with the leftovers left by other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME虽然没有尖牙，偶尔仍试着咬人或宝可梦取血。受害者身上会覆满令人不适的黏滑薄膜。
author: char_latte3412
source: Though lacking fangs, POKENAME occasionally attempts to bite people or Pokémon to draw blood. Victims are left covered in an uncomfortable, slimy film.

entry: POKENAME尽可能摊平身体，等待有东西经过，踩到自己。一旦被踩中，它便欢快地叫起来，仿佛这样就赢了一场游戏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flattens itself out as much as possible and waits until something comes along and treads upon it. Once something does, it lets out a joyful cry, as it treats being stepped on like winning a game.

entry: POKENAME长时间躺着，以柔软胡子作垫，等猎物不慎走进张大的嘴。它平静极了，却喜欢被当成王公贵族般宠着。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME lays down for long periods, using the soft beard as a cushion while waiting for prey to accidentally walk into its open maw. It is incredibly calm but loves to be pampered like royalty.

entry: 这种沉重的捕食者埋在泥里，用巨颚突然咬住毫无戒心的猎物。虽有原始的凶猛性情，眼神却奇异地呆笨，在湿地横冲直撞时，常连疼痛也不理。
author: shivaequinox
source: This heavy predator lies submerged in mud, using its massive jaws to snap shut on unsuspecting prey. Despite its primitive ferocity, it possesses a strangely dim-witted gaze and will often ignore pain while rampaging through wetlands.

entry: POKENAME是冷血宝可梦，不自行产热，血液在零下却不会结冰。血液如防冻液，让它在严寒中仍能维持循环。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are cold-blooded Pokémon that do not generate their own heat, yet their blood does not freeze when exposed to sub-zero conditions. Their blood acts similar to anti-freeze, which keeps the blood pumping in frigid conditions.

entry: POKENAME温顺迟缓，平静地浮过冰冻泥沼。训练家常看见它用宽大中空的袖子，轻轻捧住幼小乌波，挡住湍急河水。
author: ambrosia04
source: Docile and slow-moving, POKENAME float peacefully through frozen bogs. Trainers often observe them using their wide, hollow sleeves to gently scoop up and shield young Wooper from fast river currents.

entry: POKENAME亲切又爱玩，可惜身上满是过敏原，让多数宝可梦不太敢亲近。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: POKENAME are very kind and playful. Unfortunately, they're chock-full of allergens, which make most other Pokémon hesitant to interact with them.

entry: POKENAME爱吃水中的污垢，常被用来清洁公共泳池。它很爱社交，气味却不好闻，因此常被躲开。
author: fiordaliso
source: Because it loves feeding on the grime it finds in water, POKENAME is often used to keep public pools clean. It is a very sociable creature, but since it doesn't smell pleasant, it is often avoided.

entry: POKENAME将泥与唾液混合，制成天然毒素，融入体表黏液，让上半身染上紫色。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME can create a natural poison by mixing mud with their saliva. The poison mixes with their slimy coating, causing the purple tint on their upper half.

entry: POKENAME迅速游过咸淡交汇的水域，身后跟着一串乌波。它常放慢速度，确认没有谁掉队。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims quickly through brackish waters with a trail of Wooper in tow. It frequently slows to ensure none of them are left behind.

entry: POKENAME头顶长着香蒲般的肢体，常让登山者措手不及。因此，安全课程常用它举例，讲解野生宝可梦的伪装。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: The cattail-like appendages growing out of POKENAME's head catch many hikers off-guard. Because of this, they are frequently used as examples of wild Pokémon camouflaging in safety courses.

entry: POKENAME将黏液和土混成肥沃的浓泥，掺进绒毛，沼泽植物在里面扎根，形成有效伪装。配对的个体晚上会一同哀鸣，叫声刺耳地回荡。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME mix the mucus they secrete with soil to create a rich, fertile mud. This mud mixes into their fluff and becomes effective camouflage as marsh plants take root within. Mated pairs of POKENAME keen in the evenings, their cries echoing harshly.

entry: POKENAME始终覆着极滑的薄膜，即使皮肤再粗糙，也几乎不可能把它抱起来。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: Picking up a POKENAME is nothing short of impossible, even for those with the roughest skin. This is because POKENAME have extremely slick films covering them at all times.

entry: POKENAME开心地坐在河底，用触手捕捉游过的小鱼。皮肤分泌的毒能让猎物无法行动，却穿不透人类皮肤。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME happily sits at the bottom of the river, catching small fish that swim by with its tentacles. While its skin secretes a toxin that it uses to incapacitate its prey, the poison can't get through human skin.

entry: POKENAME游得小心，免得背上的蘑菇碰到东西。若有攻击指向蘑菇，它会迅速转身，宁可用脸承受。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME takes careful swims to make sure the mushrooms on its back don't accidentally bump into anything. If an attack were to ever be aimed at the fungi, POKENAME quickly spins around to let its face take the assault instead.

entry: POKENAME游过泥水，释放魔法粒子，改善水质，让水显得充满魔力。骗子把水装瓶，吹成包治百病的神水，其实它并无神奇疗效。
author: vic1312
source: Swimming through muddy water, POKENAME release magical particles which improve the quality of the water and give it an enchanted appearance. Swindlers have bottled this water and peddled it as a miracle cure-all, despite it being truthfully mundane.

entry: 除非鱼群受到威胁，POKENAME总平静得出奇。一察觉危险，就释放强大的精神冲击，赶走天敌。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME remains unnaturally calm unless its school is threatened. When it senses danger, it releases a powerful Psyshock to drive predators away.

entry: POKENAME爱晒太阳，让人怀疑它的头能进行光合作用。可每当有人想检查，它就低下头躲开。
author: bukie
source: POKENAME's affinity for sunbathing has lead some to speculate that its head can photosynthesize, but it ducks its head down whenever someone tries to check.

entry: POKENAME大半时间蜷在狭窄岩缝里，靠坚韧铠甲保护。终于展开身体站起时，又常忘了自己多大，撞到头，引起地面阵阵轻震。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME spends most of its time curled up in narrow crevices, protected by its tough armour. When it finally uncurls and stands, it often forgets its size and bumps its head, causing small tremors that ripple through the ground.

entry: POKENAME视力不佳，靠触角勾勒周围景象。毛上覆着油，让它游得快，也能刺激碰到它的天敌。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has poor eyesight but uses its antennae to develop a picture of its surroundings. Its fur is covered in an oil that lets it speedily swim and irritates predators that come in contact with it.

entry: POKENAME用草和泥裹住自己，迅速硬化成几乎攻不破的铠甲，只有最执着的攻击者可能突破。代价是行动能力大幅下降。
author: deniablecredibility
source: POKENAME packs itself with grass and mud that quickly hardens, giving it nigh-impregnable armor against all but the most dedicated attackers, even if it does significantly reduce its mobility.

entry: POKENAME住在沼泽，互相扔泥巴竞赛玩。泥稍微晾干，就能成为制陶常用的优质黏土。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in marshy areas, playfully throwing mud at each other as a form of competition. When dried a little, its mud can be turned into a rich clay that is often used in pottery.

entry: POKENAME一停就是几天，因翅膀漏出的鳞粉麻痹作用很强，对四周一切都浑然不觉。鳞粉被收集，用于多种止痛药和麻醉剂。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME perches for days, blissfully unaware of anything that happens around it since its wings leak powdery scales with a strong numbing effect. This powder is collected to be used in a variety of pain relief medications and anesthesia.

entry: POKENAME平静地泡在河流浅水，用睡莲叶吸收阳光。只有与其他宝可梦跳舞时才活跃起来，尤其爱逗乌波等幼小宝可梦开心。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME calmly basks in river shallows, absorbing sunlight with its lily pad. It only becomes active to dance with other Pokémon, especially enjoying entertaining young Pokémon like Wooper.

entry: POKENAME覆着薄薄黏液，离水后也能保持皮肤湿润。黏液极易燃，它想给自己做饭时，就拿来引火。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are coated in a thin mucus layer that keeps their skin moist even when they leave the water. The mucus is highly flammable and POKENAME will use it as kindling when they want to cook food for themselves.

entry: POKENAME产生的水静置后会变硬，几分钟内长出晶体。它用晶体装饰洞穴住处。
author: .izik
source: The water POKENAME produces hardens when stagnant, growing crystals within minutes. It uses these to decorate its cavern home.

entry: 许多水属性宝可梦自然地追随POKENAME，把它当成首领。它心不在焉，很少察觉，人和宝可梦却都欣赏它悠闲的生活方式。
author: t3isukone
source: Many Water-type Pokémon gravitate towards POKENAME as a leader. The absent-minded POKENAME rarely picks up on this, but both Pokémon and humans admire its laid-back lifestyle.

entry: POKENAME用咔嗒声、泡泡和身体动作组成复杂语言。多年研究后，学者认为最常用的一句大意是：“我饿了，吃饭吧。”
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME communicate through a complex language of clicks, bubbles, and body movements. After years of study, researchers believe their most commonly used phrase roughly translates to, "I'm hungry, let's eat".

entry: POKENAME用咔嗒声、泡泡和身体动作组成复杂语言。多年研究后，学者认为最常用的一句大意是：“我饿了，吃饭吧。”
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME communicate through a complex language of clicks, bubbles, and body movements. After years of study, researchers believe their most commonly used phrase roughly translates to, "I'm hungry, let's eat".

entry: POKENAME用高超的挖掘本领，在泥里给自己挖小池塘。大半时间都泡在里面，等食物自己送上门。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their superb digging skills to dig out small ponds for themselves in the mud. They spend most of their time basking in them, waiting for food to come to them.

entry: POKENAME懒得出奇，伸个懒腰就算完整锻炼。可灵活肌肉仍让它轻松闪开攻击，对手招式还没结束，它就又趴下了。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Incredibly lazy, POKENAME considers a stretch to be a full workout. Despite this, its lithe muscles allow it to effortlessly dodge attacks and flop back down before its opponent even finishes their move.

entry: POKENAME懒得出奇，伸个懒腰就算完整锻炼。可灵活肌肉仍让它轻松闪开攻击，对手招式还没结束，它就又趴下了。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Incredibly lazy, POKENAME considers a stretch to be a full workout. Despite this, its lithe muscles allow it to effortlessly dodge attacks and flop back down before its opponent even finishes their move.

entry: POKENAME覆着厚厚黏液，吞入会引发偏头痛。离水太久，黏液就会干。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is covered in a thick layer of mucus that can cause migraines if ingested. The mucus will dry if it stays out of the water for too long.

entry: 总被拿来与大嘴王比较，让它心生自卑。它盼着身材更结实，却把嫉妒，藏在笑容后面。
author: megaban
source: It has developed an inferiority complex of sorts, being compared to Golsire. It wishes for a more well-built body, hiding its envy behind a smile.

entry: POKENAME脸上虽开心，却很容易为小事生气。它会找一群乌波，坐在旁边深呼吸，看它们玩泥巴，让自己平静下来。
author: bigoljax
source: Though it has a happy expression, POKENAME can easily get angry at even the simplest things. To calm itself down, it'll look for groups of Wooper and sit near them, taking deep breaths as it watches these groups play in the mud.

entry: POKENAME憨憨的，却很可爱，身躯有多庞大，童心就有多旺盛。柔云般的双翼载着它懒懒飘过天空，可哪怕一缕微风，或一件闪亮物品，都能让它分心。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME has a lovable but dim-witted personality. Its massive size is matched only by its childlike enthusiasm. With wings made of soft clouds, it soars lazily through the skies, often getting distracted by the slightest breeze or shiny objects.

entry: POKENAME仰躺着顺缓流漂下，用发达双臂轻易推开杂物。
author: lampent12
source: POKENAME drift down lazy rivers on their backs. They effortlessly push debris aside with their well-developed arms.

entry: POKENAME夜间活动，白天大多仍在睡觉。它用念力把体型小、虚弱或受伤的宝可梦送进嘴里，吃完又打盹。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a nocturnal being that still sleeps through most of the day. It feeds by using psychokinesis to force small, weak, or injured Pokémon into its mouth before dozing off again.

entry: 研究者不知道，POKENAME将庞大智慧用在何处。传说它正酝酿诡计，下一刻却立刻忘记自己在盘算什么。
author: daniel360n
source: Researchers are unaware of what POKENAME is using its vast intellect for. Rumors say that it's hatching a Nasty Plot only to instantly forget what it was plotting the very next moment.

entry: POKENAME爱展示肌肉，谁愿意看，就骄傲地在谁面前摆姿势。若观众也展示肌肉回应，它就开心极了。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME loves to show off its musculature to others, flexing proudly in front of anyone who will watch. It is overjoyed if the ones watching it flex their own muscles in response.

entry: POKENAME生活在沼泽，遇到威胁就缩进壳里，快速旋转，埋入泥中。可惜年幼个体力量不够，没法独自从浓泥里出来。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: POKENAME live in swampy areas. When threatened, POKENAME retreats into its shell and spins rapidly to bury itself in mud. Unfortunately, young POKENAME are not strong enough to get out of the thick mud by themselves.

entry: POKENAME必须一直接触水，否则身体就会干燥。它只需极少食物便能维生，因此常让其他同类躲在嘴里。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME needs to be constantly exposed to water, otherwise its body will start to dry out. As it requires very little food to survive, it will often let other POKENAME hide in its mouth.

entry: POKENAME长期被当成体色异常的玛瑙水母，直到一位海滩度假的研究者发现死去个体，才将它另立物种。它的墨汁带特殊深蓝色，备受追捧。
author: leandermalurt
source: POKENAME was long thought to be a discoloured version of Tentacool until a researcher on beach vacation discovered a dead one and classified it as a separate species. They are sought for their ink, which has a special dark blue tint.

entry: POKENAME友善，却似乎不知道触手布满会刺痛人的倒钩。它拥抱遇见的人，对方却因此起灼痛的疹子。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is friendly but doesn't seem to realize its tentacles are covered in stinging barbs. It will hug those it meets, who are left with a burning rash.

entry: POKENAME背上鬃毛般的胶状鳍热得危险，跑得越快，温度越高，因此很难骑乘。
author: .izik
source: The gooey, mane-like fin on POKENAME's back is dangerously hot. Its temperature increases the faster it runs, making it difficult to ride.

entry: POKENAME在水中的速度和灵活几乎无可匹敌。可一上岸，步态就迟缓笨拙，不停绊到自己，扑倒地上。
author: sk372
source: In the water, POKENAME is an almost peerless swimmer in speed and agility. On land, however, its gait is slow and clumsy, constantly tripping over itself and flopping onto the ground.

entry: 即使睡着，POKENAME的尾巴也稳定地摇着，拍打泥巴或水，向附近池塘、沼泽里的朋友传递有节奏的信号。
author: .izik
source: Even while asleep, POKENAME's tail wags steadily. It slaps the mud or water with its tail, sending rhythmic signals to friends nearby in ponds or swamps.

entry: POKENAME在池塘吃藻，总有一个头警戒。远远发现天敌，就像炮台一样喷水，等对方靠得太近才逃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME eats algae from ponds while one head always keeps watch. Should it spot a predator from a great distance, it spits water like a turret, only fleeing once they draw too close.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛几乎总是湿透的。它就喜欢这样，一听到风暴开始，便冲进雨里淋湿自己。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feathers are almost always extremely damp. It prefers them this way, running out into the rain to soak itself whenever it hears a storm begin.

entry: POKENAME笨拙得游泳时常撞上冰山或船。它用冰冷吐息减慢前方猎物的速度，让捕捉更容易。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is so clumsy it often collides with icebergs or ships while swimming. It uses its icy breath to slow down prey swimming ahead, making them easier to catch.

entry: 野生POKENAME的群体组织严密，无论照顾幼崽、捕猎还是抵御天敌，每一只都各尽其职。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: Wild POKENAME live in very organized groups. Whether it be taking care of their young, hunting, or fending off predators, every POKENAME does their job.

entry: POKENAME能精妙控制喷水口的水压，不过性情温顺，通常只用来打下果实，再张大嘴整颗吞下。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have remarkable control over the pressure of the water they release from their waterspouts. They are docile, however, and only tend to use their waterspouts to shoot down fruits, with their mouths agape to swallow the fruit whole.

entry: 它们主要用尾巴拍打地面，借力前进，即使在深水中也一样。捕猎时也先等猎物靠近，再突然弹出，紧紧攀住。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon mostly move by swinging their tails against the terrain to propel themselves, even if deep underwater. This is also how they acquire prey, waiting for prey to draw near, launching themselves, and then latching on tight.

entry: POKENAME外表不起眼，正好引来猎物。它在洞里筑巢，把坚固的壳藏在阴影中，猎物一近就猛然合拢，迅速终结挣扎。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME has an unassuming appearance, which serves to lure prey. It nests within a cave and keeps its strong shell obscured by the shadows, clamping shut upon prey that comes near and swiftly ends their struggle.

entry: POKENAME附近常有人犯困、昏沉，因为皮肤周围的黏膜释放信息素，附在鼻中的感受器上。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME are nearby, people report feeling sleepy or groggy. This is because the mucous membrane around their skin releases pheromones that cling to receptors in people's noses.

entry: POKENAME附近常有人昏昏欲睡，因为黏膜释放的信息素会让人头昏、眩晕。人睡着后，它还会吃梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: People report becoming drowsy whenever POKENAME are nearby. This is because its mucus membrane releases pheromones that cause lightheadedness and dizziness. It is also known to eat dreams when people fall asleep.

entry: POKENAME晃动装着神秘水滴的小瓶催眠。有人会梦见自己被鱼吞下，其实是它使出食梦的结果。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swing their vial of Mystic Water to hypnotize. People report having dreams of being swallowed by fish, which comes as a result of POKENAME using Dream Eater.

entry: POKENAME强劲的双臂一抓住敌人，就几乎无法挣脱。它自己却覆着滑溜黏液，任谁都抓不牢。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's powerful arms seize foes in an almost inescapable hold. Because its body is covered with slippery slime, nothing can get a firm grip on its own body.

entry: POKENAME把精神能量储存在背上的种子中。两条尾巴其实是敏锐的藤蔓，能感知其他宝可梦的情绪。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME stores its psychic energy in the bulb on its back. Its twin-tails are actually sensitive vines that it uses to sense the emotions of other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME靠读取周围生命的心思在野外求生。察觉天敌的念头，就能赶在被发现前藏好。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME survive in the wild by reading the minds of those around them. By tapping into the thoughts of predators, they can avoid detection by hiding before getting noticed.

entry: 任何靠近POKENAME的人，都会被难以控制的悲伤淹没。受到惊吓时，它会以庞大的精神力量反击。
author: mistymagius
source: Anyone who approaches POKENAME will be overcome by uncontrollable sadness. When frightened, POKENAME will lash out with its immense psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME战斗开始时总亲自挥动骨棒，随着战斗才显出真正实力：用念力操纵骨棒分散注意，再从别处以强力幻象光线击中对手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME always begins a fight physically wielding the bone it carries, but shows its true strength as the fight goes on, manipulating the bone psychically to distract opponents while it hits them from elsewhere with powerful Psybeams.

entry: POKENAME用心灵感应对天敌说话，将它们吓离附近。天敌以为念头来自危险得多的宝可梦，常给它留下礼物，恳求放过自己。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME scares predators away from an area by speaking to them with telepathy. Predators mistake these thoughts for the thoughts of much more dangerous Pokémon, so they often leave gifts for POKENAME as a plea to leave them alone.

entry: POKENAME精神力量极强，能将能量完全覆在翅膀上，看起来足有原来的两倍大。据说每枚鳞片都能增强心智能力，因此很受欢迎，被当作护符。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME possess such great psychic power that they can fully veil their wings with energy and make them appear twice as large as they truly are. Their every scale is believed to amplify one's mental abilities, making them popular as charms.

entry: POKENAME鞭子般的尾巴嵌满冰晶。它战斗动作迅速，风格却不顾后果。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's whip-like tail is studded with icy crystals. It is fast and reckless in its fighting style.

entry: POKENAME坚挺的耳朵是精神力量的通道。若双耳被遮住、长时间晒不到太阳，就会失去念力。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME's rigid ears serve as a conduit for its psychic power. If its ears are covered and kept away from sunlight for too long, it will lose its telekinetic abilities.

entry: POKENAME常成群出没，人们称其为“集合体”。遇险时，整个集合体会协力，打出庞大的精神冲击。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME are usually found in herds known as collectives. When in a pinch, the collective will attack with a giant psychic blast.

entry: POKENAME吃苦味草药，培养精神力量。它能同时举起、束缚许多宝可梦，免得被天敌吃掉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a diet of bitter herbs that foster their psychic abilities. They are capable of lifting and restraining many Pokémon at once, which helps them avoid getting eaten by predators.

entry: 人们只在平静水面见过POKENAME，因为它能提前预测风暴，总会找到安全港湾躲避。水手看它朝岸边去，就知道跟着最安全。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are only ever seen swimming on calm water because they can predict storms in advance and will always find a safe harbor to shelter in. If sailors see one heading for shore, they know that the safest course is to follow it.

entry: 额头的红宝石能读出对手精确的身体比例，再用这些数据，完美模仿对方的形态。
author: .izik
source: The red gem on its forehead reads the exact proportions of an opponent. It uses this data to perfectly mimic their form.

entry: POKENAME需要增强力量时，训练家会给它特攻强化，帮助打好艰难战斗。据说白天效果更强，不过也可能是夸大。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME needs a boost, Trainers give it an X Sp. Atk to help it shine through a tough battle. The booster is said to produce a stronger effect during the day, though this could be an exaggeration.

entry: POKENAME的精神能力特别擅长预测、应对水灾，风暴和洪水中都很能干，因此常陪伴水手和救援人员。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's psychic abilities are especially attuned to predicting and navigating aquatic disasters. It is often a companion to sailors and rescue workers as it is adept during storms and floods.

entry: POKENAME的大脑充满高压电，反应快得能在事情发生前就作出回应。
author: .jerden
source: Its brain is charged with high-voltage electricity. POKENAME's reflexes are so fast that it can react to events before they occur.

entry: POKENAME读到对手正准备强力且效果绝佳的攻击，就会竖起毛。还没等对方完成招式，双尾便释放麻痹电流，将其拦住。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME spikes out its fur when it reads the opponent readying a powerful, super-effective attack. Before the foe can finish their move, it launches a paralytic charge from its twin tails to stop them in their tracks.

entry: POKENAME身体轻盈，这也帮助它靠精神力量飘浮。向两边斜看的眼神常惹人发笑，让它能趁对手不备出手。
author: chibitales
source: Thanks in part to its lightweight body, POKENAME is able to levitate using psychic power. Its walleyed stare is often found humorous, allowing it to catch opponents off guard.

entry: POKENAME身体轻盈，这也帮助它靠精神力量飘浮。广告公司倚重它，预测顾客上网时可能在寻找什么。
author: chibitales
source: Thanks in part to their lightweight bodies, POKENAME are able to levitate using psychic power. POKENAME are relied upon by advertising agencies to predict what their customers might be looking for while surfing the web.

entry: POKENAME把大部分能量留在茧内生长。若有格外执着的天敌来烦，它便释放精神波动，让对方头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME reserve most of their energy for growing within their cocoon. If a particularly persistent predator bothers them, they release psychic waves that cause the predator to experience headaches.

entry: 晨光中，POKENAME额头的宝石闪耀，精神力量增强。它借此将果树连根拔起，让满树果实触手可及。
author: lampent12
source: In the morning light, the gem on their forehead flashes and their psychic power grows. POKENAME uses this power to uproot fruit trees, bringing their bounty within easy reach.

entry: POKENAME十分亲人，爱突然给训练家一个温暖拥抱。它飞到最适合晒太阳的地方，用阳光为额头宝石充能，增强精神力量。
author: ambrosia04
source: Highly affectionate, POKENAME love to surprise Trainers with warm hugs. They fly to ideal sunbathing spots and use the sunlight to recharge the gems on their foreheads and power their psychic abilities.

entry: 被POKENAME蜇过的人，会觉得自己片刻间忽然开悟，还声称能用念力举物。这些幻觉只是暂时的，毒液在体内分解后就会消退。
author: quackquackattack
source: People who are stung by POKENAME report feeling momentarily enlightened and claim to lift objects with their mind. These hallucinations are temporary and fade as the venom in their system is broken down.

entry: 据说POKENAME能用精神力量扭曲现实，让自己隐形。虽然尚未证实，已知它对愿在谁面前现身十分挑剔。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can supposedly bend reality with their psychic powers to make themselves invisible. While this has yet to be proven, what is known is that they are very selective about who they will appear before.

entry: POKENAME虽然爱玩，却不许任何人碰毛。它始终用无形、玻璃般的念力外壳围住身体，让娇嫩毛发保持洁净。
author: ambrosia04
source: Despite being rather playful, POKENAME won't let anyone touch its fur. It constantly surrounds its body with an invisible, glass-like psychic shell to keep its delicate fur pristine.

entry: POKENAME受惊时，背上会冒出精神力量形成的火焰，让其他生命虚弱、头痛。它喜欢亲近安静沉稳的人。
author: sk372
source: When startled, POKENAME emits psychic flames from its back that cause weakness and headaches in others. It is drawn to people with calm and quiet personalities.

entry: 一到黄昏，POKENAME就完全分不清方向，常困在离家很远的地方。因此太阳刚开始下山，成群的它们就急急冲回巢。
author: dodoowner_
source: Once dusk hits, POKENAME loses all sense of direction, often becoming stranded far from home. As a result, flocks of these Pokémon are seen violently rushing back towards their nests when the sun begins to set.

entry: 人们认为，只有与训练家的羁绊如太阳般明亮，POKENAME才会自然进化。它性情含蓄又难以捉摸，却偏偏能预见未来。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is only thought to evolve naturally when its bond with its Trainer is as bright as the sun. It has a coy, unpredictable personality that belies its ability to predict the future.

entry: 人们认为，只有与训练家的羁绊如太阳般明亮，POKENAME才会自然进化。它性情含蓄又难以捉摸，却偏偏能预见未来。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is only thought to evolve naturally when its bond with its Trainer is as bright as the sun. It has a coy, unpredictable personality that belies its ability to predict the future.

entry: POKENAME飞行时会用念力把自己倒过来，只为专心思考。一想到主意，头上的球就像太阳般明亮发光。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME will psychically flip itself upside down while in flight just to focus on its thoughts. Once it has come up with an idea, the orb on its head starts shining brightly like the sun.

entry: 哪怕最微弱的光碰到POKENAME额头的球，也会使其发亮，照亮整片地方。它自己能夜视，却靠光保护正在训练的年幼咕咕，免遭危险。
author: soup1900
source: Once even the faintest light touches the orb on POKENAME's forehead, it glows and illuminates the whole area. Though POKENAME can see in the dark, the light helps protect the young Hoothoot it's training from getting into danger.

entry: POKENAME用精神能量，将对手困在毒丝网中。毒会侵蚀心智，削弱对手。未经训练的眼睛看不见这张网。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME uses psychic energy to ensnare its opponents in poisonous webbing. This poison degrades their rivals' minds and leaves them compromised. The webbing appears invisible to untrained eyes.

entry: POKENAME咬一口，就能注入强效神经毒素，让受害者意识麻木。它还能神秘地将精神能量织成实体网，把受害者拖回巢里。
author: infinex21
source: A bite from an POKENAME is capable of injecting a potent, mind-numbing neurotoxin into its victim. It is mysteriously able to weave psychic energies into physical webs, which it uses to drag its victims back to its lair.

entry: POKENAME触角末端的球储着大部分精神能量。为了避险，球能释放舒缓的精神波动，让附近的生命平静下来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's antennae possess globes at the end that house much of its psychic energy. To avoid danger, the orbs can send out pulses of soothing mental waves that pacify those in the nearby radius.

entry: POKENAME先用头部器官的光晃得其他生命睁不开眼、无法动弹，再读取心思。若无敌意，就游走；若心怀恶意，则继续以精神力量攻击其心智。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the light from the organ on its head to blind and immobilize other creatures before reading their minds. If it senses no hostility, it swims away, but those with ill motives have their mind further assaulted by psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME能感知、吸收附近的情绪。积极情绪让身体胀大、充满能量，消极情绪则让它缩小、疲惫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can sense and absorb the emotions of those near it. Positive emotions make its body swell and fill it with energy, while negative emotions cause it to shrink and grow weary.

entry: 据说POKENAME凝视太阳时，能得到惊人启示，洞悉过去与现在的一切。夜幕一落，它便藏起来，直到日出。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is said to have incredible revelations of all things past and present as it stares into the sun. Once night falls, it hides away until sunrise.

entry: POKENAME敏感的羊毛能察觉空气最微小的变化，甚至感知情绪。感觉训练家压力大时，它会温柔地让对方靠在毛茸茸的胸前休息。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME's sensitive wool detects the slightest shifts in the air and can even sense emotions. When it feels its Trainer is stressed, it gently lets them rest against its woolly chest.

entry: POKENAME宝石发光时，叫声能影响其他宝可梦的心智，让它们忍不住服从。但尾巴一被抓住，它就使不出任何精神力量。
author: infinex21
source: When POKENAME's gem glows, its cries affect the minds of other Pokémon and make them feel compelled to obey it. If its tail is grabbed, it cannot muster any of its psychic power.

entry: POKENAME全力释放精神力量时，棉团状的孢子会炸开，将棉孢子撒向四周。等它借阳光补充力量，棉团状孢子几乎立即就能长回来。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME unleashes its full psychic power, its cotton-puff spores explode, releasing cotton spores everywhere around it. When it recharges its power from the sunshine, the cotton-puff spores grow back almost instantly.

entry: POKENAME整天用头顶叶片吸收太阳能，再借这股能量，预测什么时候会下雨。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME absorb solar energy throughout the day with the leaves on their head. They harness that energy to predict when rain will come.

entry: POKENAME在黑暗中生长最好，常赋予悉心照料它的训练家超能力。受到威胁时，它用鲜亮的花瓣催眠对手。
author: fxncy_poland
source: POKENAME flourishes best in darkness, typically seen to grant psychic powers to Pokémon Trainers who care for it. When threatened, it uses its bright petals to hypnotise its opponent.

entry: 危险靠近时，POKENAME的大耳朵会张开到两倍大，还渗出毒性物质，用来攻击对手。因此，对常遇上麻烦的训练家来说，它是很好的伙伴。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's large ears flare and expand to twice their size when danger is nearby. They also begin to sweat a toxic substance that they can attack opponents with. This makes them great partners to Trainers that regularly find themselves in trouble.

entry: 融合后，POKENAME感知、影响情绪的能力提升了数个数量级。摇尾时，尾内的球会释放精神脉冲，平复半径10米内所有生命的情绪。
author: sk372
source: After fusion, POKENAME's ability to sense and affect the emotions of others has increased by orders of magnitude. By shaking its tail, the orb within emits a psychic pulse that pacifies the mood of all creatures in a 10-meter radius.

entry: POKENAME白天活动，却常不被发现。它似乎能预测人和宝可梦会看哪里，原地不动地等对方离开，或悄悄绕到身后。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME often remains undetected, even though it moves around during daylight. It seems to be able to predict where people and Pokémon will look, enabling it to remain still until they leave or quietly move around behind them.

entry: 它长期被视为平衡的象征。性情平和，很受已有一定经验、想发展独特战斗风格的训练家欢迎。
author: ocxin
source: Long since valued as a symbol of balance, their even-natured demeanor makes them popular for intermediate trainers seeking to further their battle style into something unique.

entry: POKENAME同时吸收月亮与太阳的能量，增强能力。有些个体日夜都懒洋洋地躺着，节省能量。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME absorb energy from both the moon and sun to enhance their abilities. Some POKENAME lounge around all day and night to conserve energy.

entry: 黄昏时，POKENAME能力大增，连对手神态最细微的变化也能察觉。它会预测攻击来向再反击，慢慢耗倒敌人。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: At dusk, POKENAME's abilities are greatly enhanced. Allowing them to sense even the slightest changes in an opponent's demeanor. POKENAME are known to battle by slowly wearing down their foe, predicting where they will attack and countering.

entry: POKENAME宝石闪烁时，正在评估附近某人的心思，看看有没有值得偷的东西。有人被分析后遭它无视，反而觉得受了冒犯。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME's gem sparkles, it's evaluating the mind of someone nearby, to see if they have anything worth stealing. Some people take offense to being ignored by POKENAME after it analyzes them.

entry: POKENAME的毛极其敏感，能察觉空气的细微变化，远在天敌扑出前就逃走。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME's fur is so sensitive that it can detect minor changes in the air. It uses this ability to run from predators long before they jump out.

entry: POKENAME的花，只在晴天绽放，释放全部的超能力。蓝色叶片散发的香气，也能抚平心绪。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's flower only blooms on sunny days, unleashing its full psychic power. Its blue leaves give off a calming scent that soothes minds.

entry: POKENAME用精神力量互相梳理，感知同伴毛里的污垢，再将其提走。虽然外表乱蓬蓬，清洁习惯却十分讲究，是很干净的宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their psychic powers to groom one another, sensing dirt and grime in their companion's fur and lifting it free. Despite their scruffy appearance, they are fastidious in their grooming habits and are very clean Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME虽在白天最活跃，太阳出来时却尽量待在暗处。据说它满身的毛能感知、吸收敌人的情绪。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although POKENAME is most active during the day, it tries to stay in dark places while the sun is out. It is said the fur that covers its body can detect and absorb the emotions of its foes.

entry: POKENAME对训练家十分忠诚，会读懂对方的心思，再设法让训练家开心。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME is very loyal to its Trainer. Reading its Trainer's mind, it always tries to make them happy.

entry: POKENAME预测对手每一步动作，尾巴则开心地咧嘴笑。不战斗时，尾巴白天都在睡。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME predicts its opponents' every move, its tails grinning with delight. When not in battle, the tails sleep through the day.

entry: POKENAME用精神力量互相梳理，感知同伴毛里的污垢，再将其提走。虽然外表乱蓬蓬，清洁习惯却十分讲究，是很干净的宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their psychic powers to groom one another, sensing dirt and grime in their companion's fur and lifting it free. Despite their scruffy appearance, they are fastidious in their grooming habits and are very clean Pokémon.

entry: 阴天，POKENAME会情绪极其低落，除非信任的人温柔劝哄，否则不肯吃。只有它完全相信的训练家，才能让它打起精神。
author: .izik
source: On cloudy days, POKENAME becomes deeply depressed, refusing to eat unless gently coaxed by someone it trusts. Only Trainers it fully believes in can lift its spirits.

entry: POKENAME主要由岩浆构成，极不稳定，只能尽力靠头部中央的念力宝石维持身体。长期使用精神能量，让身体变成了罕见的淡紫色。
author: ludacriswell
source: POKENAME is a highly unstable Pokémon composed mostly of magma. It uses the psychic gem in the center of its head to hold its body together as best as it can. Prolonged use of psychic energy has turned POKENAME's body an unusual shade of lilac.

entry: 进化后，POKENAME学会维持熔融的身体，多余精神能量如今只用于战斗。更令人不安的是，它的壳由岩浆结晶而成，还会增强念力。
author: ludacriswell
source: POKENAME has learned to maintain its molten body composition through evolution and now uses its excess psychic energy strictly for combat. Even more unsettling, its shell is composed of igneous crystals that further amplify its telekinetic powers.

entry: POKENAME天性小气，却很忠于生活中懂得明智取舍的训练家。晴天，常能见它跟在强大的水属性宝可梦后面。
author: sondededoo
source: While stingy by nature, POKENAME are very loyal to trainers who make smart life choices. POKENAME can often be found on sunny days following powerful Water-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME以催眠般的动作，让猎物误以为安全，再用超能力将其压垮。凝视腹部的眼睛，就会被它彻底控制。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME moves in a hypnotic pattern that lures its prey into a false sense of security before it crushes them with their psychic powers. Staring into the eyes on its belly puts you under its full control.

entry: POKENAME战斗时总寻找最佳办法。大多数会先用精神力量抓住对手、拖到近前，再使出打雷。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME always seek the optimal path in battle. Most POKENAME use their psychic abilities to grab and drag their opponents closer before striking them with Thunder.

entry: POKENAME敏感的毛能预测重大天气变化，甚至环境灾害，常赶来帮助受灾者。漏油后，它往往最先到场，净化水质。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME's sensitive fur allows them to predict major changes in weather; they can predict environmental disasters and will often arrive to assist with aiding those impacted. They are often the first to arrive after oil spills to purify the water.

entry: POKENAME爱吃石头和晶体，越闪亮，吃得越开心。它只向自己认为可信的训练家现身，出了名地挑剔。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME love to eat rocks and crystals, though the shinier they are, the happier they are to eat them. They only appear to Trainers they believe they can trust; they are notoriously picky.

entry: POKENAME很少亲自活动身体，而是用念力挪动自己，节省体力。运用精神力量时，红色晶体会发光，据说比钻石还硬。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME rarely moves, at least physically; it will move itself by using its telekinetic powers to conserve its strength. Its red crystal glows as it harnesses its psychic abilities and is known to be harder than diamond itself.

entry: POKENAME释放精神能量时，宝石会发光。即使发狂，也能向四周释放精神波动。最广为人知的安抚方法，是由它信任的人触摸或出声。
author: infinex21
source: Its gems glow as it unleashes its psychic energies. Even as it rampages, it can still release psychic waves all around it. The best-known way to calm a rampaging POKENAME is with the touch and/or voice of someone it trusts.

entry: POKENAME目光敏锐，性情又友善，是受欢迎的伙伴。据说，它还会赐予为正义而战的人，神奇的力量。
author: neonriser
source: POKENAME's insightful nature and friendly demeanor makes it a popular companion. They are said to grant magical powers to those fighting for justice.

entry: 过去，POKENAME的形象被用作智慧的象征。太阳升至最高处时，羽毛最闪亮，精神力量也会增强。
author: chibitales
source: Images of POKENAME were used as symbols for wisdom in the past. Its feathers shine the brightest and its psychic power is heightened when the sun reaches its apex in the sky.

entry: 成群POKENAME用精神波动交流、协调，距离最远约半英里。它能短距离瞬间传送，骚扰、攻击闯入领地的家伙。
author: infinex21
source: Packs of POKENAME communicate and coordinate with one another using psychic waves across distances up to around half a mile. They have exhibited the ability to teleport short distances as they harass and attack any trespassers of their territories.

entry: POKENAME精神力量强，又能操纵磁力，是难缠的对手。近年来，科学家建造新太空船时，会让它安全地搬运沉重机械零件。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's psychic prowess and ability to manipulate magnetism make it a formidable foe. In recent years, scientists have used POKENAME to safely move heavy mechanical parts when constructing new spaceships.

entry: POKENAME用精神力量分别操纵双舌的肌肉。经验越丰富，对动作的控制就越精细。
author: alestrius
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to independently maneuver the muscles in its twin tongues. The more experienced an POKENAME becomes, the finer control they can exert over the movements.

entry: POKENAME感知空气的动静，预测对手动作，再用精神能量抽走空气中水分的热量，瞬间冻结，制成冰柱攻击。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME can sense motion in the air to predict their opponent's movements. They then use psychic energy to drain heat from the moisture in the air, instantly freezing it and attacking with the newly created icicles.

entry: POKENAME爱吃任何试图预测未来的数据，常住在存有体育博彩、气象资料等信息的系统。附近的预测数据一应验，头上的球就更明亮。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME enjoy eating any data that attempts to predict the future. One can find them residing within systems that host things like sports betting and meteorological data. The orb on their head glows brighter when predictive data nearby comes true.

entry: POKENAME常从栖居的丛林吸收能量，转成精神力量。力量全满时，背上的珍珠会发光。
author: red.89
source: An POKENAME is often seen absorbing energy from its jungle home to generate psychic power. The pearls on its back glow when at full power.

entry: 小小的POKENAME跟着训练家到处走，有时会调皮地追扑行走的双脚。它能用精神力量控火，却还不熟练，过程中可能不小心烧伤自己。
author: milchik
source: This little Pokémon follows its Trainer wherever they go, sometimes playfully hunting for their feet as they walk. POKENAME controls fire with its psychic powers, but it's not very good at it yet and can accidentally burn itself in the process.

entry: POKENAME的爪由锋利坚固的宝石构成，含有强大精神能量。力量直接来自阳光，因此上午和下午最精神，奔跑、踢击快得肉眼难辨。
author: milchik
source: Its claws are made of sharp, sturdy gems that contain powerful psychic energy. As POKENAME draws its power directly from the sunlight, it's most energetic in the morning and afternoon, running and kicking faster than the naked eye can see.

entry: POKENAME的脚掌摸起来柔软有弹性，靠近喜欢的人时，总记得收好利爪。听觉和夜视能力出色，让强劲踢击即使在黑暗中也从不落空。
author: milchik
source: Its paws are soft and squishy to the touch, and POKENAME makes sure to retract its sharp claws whenever it's around those it likes. Its powerful kicks never miss the target even in the dark thanks to its excellent hearing and night vision.

entry: 每个晴朗清晨，POKENAME都会在训练家旁跳舞，早早唤醒对方。头顶宝石闪耀，传出精神能量，让人醒来神清气爽，而非昏沉。
author: sk372
source: Every sunny morning, POKENAME dances near its Trainer to wake them up bright and early. The jewel on its head shines and transfers a psychic energy to ensure they wake up feeling rested rather than groggy.

entry: POKENAME大半时间都在最爱的安静角落看书。训练家若带来新书，它很快就愿意亲近。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME spend most of their time reading in their favorite quiet spots. They easily warm up to Trainers who bring them new books.

entry: 只要训练家在身边，POKENAME就不断读取心思和身体语言，分辨最细微的情绪变化。它时刻疼爱、关心对方是否开心，几乎到了执着的地步。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME reads its Trainer's mind and body language at all times in their presence to discern even minute changes in their mood. It dotes on them constantly, concerned for their happiness to an almost obsessive degree.

entry: POKENAME会与尊重它的训练家结下深厚羁绊。强大的精神能力让它感知未来，引导训练家避开一切危险。
author: jadey.1557
source: POKENAME forms strong bonds with Trainers that show it respect. Its potent psychic abilities let it sense the future, allowing it to guide its Trainer away from any and all dangers.

entry: 古时，许多文化敬奉POKENAME，感激它仁慈地预见灾难、引人避险。直到如今，一些地区仍保留雕像，像前时常摆着供品。
author: sk372
source: In ancient times, many cultures revered POKENAME for its kindness and foresight guiding them away from disasters. Even in modern times, some regions retain statues of POKENAME that regularly have offerings placed before them.

entry: 古人相信，成群POKENAME用精神力量推动太阳穿过天空。它生性仁慈，许多个体会收留野外失去亲人的宝可梦。
author: chibitales
source: In ancient times, POKENAME were believed to move the sun across the sky using their psychic powers as a group. Their benevolent nature leads many to take wild, orphaned Pokémon under their care.

entry: POKENAME极难遇见，据说只在人最需要帮助时现身，用精神能力引导对方走向更好的未来。
author: cerealjamalt
source: It is exceptionally rare to encounter an POKENAME. It's said to appear only to those in their hour of need; it uses its psychic abilities to guide them to a better future.

entry: POKENAME不喜欢训练家，就会捉弄对方。有人只记得在梦里见过它，有人连捕捉过它都忘了。不过，对喜欢的训练家，它会格外努力。
author: ludacriswell
source: If POKENAME dislikes their Trainer, they will play tricks on them. Some Trainers recall it in a dream, but that is all they can remember. Others don't remember catching it at all. That said, POKENAME works remarkably hard for Trainers it is fond of.

entry: POKENAME改变鳞片颜色，完全融入环境，只露出发光的红宝石。独立转动的眼睛配合敏感耳朵，能预测任何方向的威胁。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME alter their scale coloration to blend seamlessly into their surroundings, leaving only their glowing red gems visible. Their independently rotating eyes work alongside sensitive ears to predict incoming threats from any angle.

entry: POKENAME修习忍术，完美融入墙壁，悄悄观察四周。它结合精神专注与隐蔽伪装，从阴影中射出念力操控、手里剑般的刀刃。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME practice ninja techniques, blending seamlessly into walls to observe their surroundings unseen. Combining psychic focus with stealthy camouflage, they strike from the shadows with telekinetic, shuriken-like blades.

entry: POKENAME的精神直觉敏锐得有人说它能看透灵魂。它还有独特能力，能把一个人的情绪转移给另一个人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's psychic intuition is so sharp that some say it can read a person's very soul. It has the unique ability to transfer the emotions of one person into another.

entry: POKENAME能用神秘力量读心，预知下一步行动。它聪慧过人，把缔结羁绊的训练家视作平等伙伴，也能从双手射出紫色能量。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME uses supernatural powers to read minds and predict future actions. Highly intelligent, it views the Trainer it's bonded with as an equal. It can fire blasts of purple-colored energy from its hands.

entry: POKENAME头上的突起扩大精神波动的范围，方便彼此交流。它会舍命保护自己认可、值得效忠的训练家。
author: infinex21
source: The protuberances on POKENAME's heads expand the range they can emit their psychic waves to communicate with one another. They will lay down their lives to defend their Trainers that they have deemed to be worthy.

entry: POKENAME用精神力量，让一朵花悬在背上。花虽不与身体相连，却能持续供给养分。
author: pinkyoshi2350
source: POKENAME uses its psychic power to levitate a flower above its back. The flower is not attached to the body yet provides continuous nourishment to POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME用脸上的许多球制造念力屏障，几乎能挡下一切攻击。连续阴天时最脆弱，球缺少阳光供能，屏障也更易被击碎。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses the many orbs in its face to create a near-impenetrable psychic barrier from all attacks. It is most vulnerable during streaks of cloudy days, where its barrier can be more easily shattered due to the lack of sunshine to power its orbs.

entry: POKENAME用细毛感知气流，预测对手每个动作。战斗时尽量少动，一预见空当，就施以强击或精神能量冲击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can sense air currents with its fine fur, predicting its opponent's every move. It will move as little as possible in combat, but will deliver powerful strikes or psychic blasts as soon as it foresees an opening.

entry: POKENAME靠精神力量预见灾难，再将景象分享给附近的生命，传播消息、寻求帮助，尽量减轻预见中的严重后果。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's psychic powers give it premonitions of disasters. It shares these visions with those nearby to spread the message and gain help in alleviating the worst consequences of its visions.

entry: 白天，POKENAME常在水边，用阳光为额头的球充能。细毛能极精准地感知电磁波，帮助捕猎，或与同类社交。
author: milchik
source: It can be seen near the water's edge, charging its forehead orb with sunlight during the day. Its fine fur can feel electromagnetic waves with astonishing precision, which POKENAME uses for hunting or socializing with other members of its species.

entry: POKENAME借日出的光恢复能量，全身晶体也随之闪耀。传说，它能同时读取1000个人的心思。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the light of the sunrise to rejuvenate its energy, the crystals of its body shining bright as it does so. It can read the minds of 1000 people at once, according to legends.

entry: 凭强大的超能力，POKENAME能随心操纵火焰，也能让火势迅速蔓延。
author: chorb33
source: Thanks to its strong psychic powers, POKENAME can control fires and spread them at will.

entry: POKENAME极其自负，什么可能伤及自尊，它就找什么较量。据说尾巴上的铃铛，连最受煎熬的心灵也能安抚。
author: bottomusmaximus3
source: POKENAME are extremely boastful and will confront anything that might threaten their pride. It is said that the bell on their tails can soothe even the most tormented mind.

entry: POKENAME预判对手的下一招，及时格挡，保护握着自己的人。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME anticipates the future moves of its opponent and parries them to protect its wielder.

entry: POKENAME预判对手的下一招，及时格挡，保护握着自己的人。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME anticipates the future moves of its opponent and parries them to protect its wielder.

entry: POKENAME预判对手的下一招，及时格挡，保护握着自己的人。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME anticipates the future moves of its opponent and parries them to protect its wielder.

entry: POKENAME将自己锁在神殿深处冥想，外有成群受其精神控制的太阳伊布和劈斩司令守卫。敢闯过神殿、来到内殿的人，会由它亲自考验胆识。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME locks itself away to meditate deep within temples, guarded by throngs of Espeon and Bisharp it has enthralled with its mind. Those that manage to brave the temple and reach its sanctum will have their mettle personally tested.

entry: POKENAME保护训练家从不犹豫，总将坚固的石身挡在威胁前。精神能力发动时，铠甲上的珍珠便放出刺目的绯红光辉。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME never hesitates to protect its Trainer, interposing its rugged stone body between them and any threat. When its psychic abilities ignite, the pearls on its armor shimmer with a piercing scarlet radiance.

entry: 许多古代衣物上都有POKENAME的图案。人们认为，穿戴者是希望自己也能像它一样智慧优雅。
author: chibitales
source: Images of POKENAME appear on many types of clothing from the ancient past. It's thought people would wear these clothes in hopes of becoming as wise and elegant as POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME用幻象能力，让肉眼几乎看不见自己，只留下发光双眼。尾刺含有毒性较弱的毒液，能让中毒者产生幻觉。
author: chibitales
source: By using their illusory abilities, POKENAME become nearly invisible to the naked eye, save for their glowing eyes. Their tail spikes contain a mild venom that causes hallucinations in those afflicted.

entry: POKENAME用丝带触碰他人，就能读取心思和情绪，再调整丝带的性质，更轻易地安抚对方、改善心情。
author: sk372
source: Touching another with its ribbons allows POKENAME to read their mind and emotional state. Using this information, it can adjust the properties of its ribbons to more easily soothe them and improve their mood.

entry: POKENAME用丝带缠住训练家时，能以心灵感应交流。只有彼此羁绊深厚的训练家，才有幸分享这份能力。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: POKENAME can communicate with its Trainer through telepathy when it wraps its ribbons around them. It only shares this gift with Trainers with a deep, mutual bond.

entry: 传说POKENAME精神力量惊人，连地壳板块也能移动。它极少出现在地表，据说只向心灵纯洁的训练家现身。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to legend, POKENAME is capable of moving even tectonic plates with its astonishing psychic powers. It is said to reveal itself only to Trainers pure of heart, rarely appearing on the surface.

entry: POKENAME用念力控制两门悬浮的小炮作战。能量弹虽比主炮弱，却很适合持续压制敌人，让它准备决定胜负的一击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's telekinesis lets it control two floating miniature cannons in battle. These have less powerful energy shots than its main cannon, but are excellent at keeping pressure on a foe while it prepares a more decisive blast.

entry: POKENAME似乎能从日月获得平时所需的全部能量。若没有日月食、云层等阻碍，它就完全不必吃喝。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME appears to be able to synthesize all of the energy it typically needs from both the sun and the moon; if it were not for things such as eclipses or clouds, POKENAME would never need to eat or drink.

entry: POKENAME用精神力量了解对手，再仔细挑选两种毒素中的一种。不过，若训练家另有命令，它会放下自己的判断，照做。
author: quantumradiation
source: POKENAME are able to use their psychic powers to better understand their opponent and then carefully select which of their two toxins to use against them. Despite that, they will ignore their own judgement if their trainer commands them differently.

entry: POKENAME尾巴能感知最细微的风向变化，在空中待一天，就能预测未来一周的天气，比大多数专业气象学家还可靠。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's tails sense the slightest change in the wind, and after one day in the air it can predict the weather for the next week. Its forecasts are more reliable than most professional meteorologists.

entry: POKENAME胆小，会用精神力量定住陌生人，检查心思与来意。觉得安全就放开，否则先将对方远远推开，再害怕地跳走。
author: sk372
source: Due to its timid nature, POKENAME holds strangers in place with psychic powers to scan their minds and motives. If it feels safe, it releases them; if not, it pushes them far back before hopping away in terror.

entry: POKENAME以速度配合精神幻象，压倒敌人，使其晕头转向。对手越烦躁、越困惑，它的力量就越呈指数增长。
author: ludacriswell
source: POKENAME are known to overwhelm and disorientate their enemies with a mixture of speed and psychic illusions. They gain power exponentially the more frustrated or confused their opponent becomes.

entry: 据说POKENAME通过与月亮的奇异共鸣，获得强大精神能力。它在月光下确实会增强，满月时，额头宝石也最明亮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to get its powerful psychic abilities through a strange resonance with the moon. Its powers do increase in the moonlight, and the jewel on its forehead glows brightest during the full moon.

entry: POKENAME用暂时不需要的精神能量，在头顶长出棉花。需要更多力量时，就扯下一团，放在额头宝石上，吸收储存的能量。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME converts extra psychic energy it doesn't need at the current moment into growing cotton on its head. Once it needs more power, it tears off a puff and places it over its forehead gem to absorb the stored energy.

entry: POKENAME布下的每根丝都带着精神力量，能感知靠近的东西。额头的球充满能量后，整张网就能化成念力屏障，困住猎物。
author: soup1900
source: Each string POKENAME lays out is imbued with psychic powers that it can tap into to sense when anything is near them. When the orb on its forehead is fully charged, it can turn its webs into full psychic barriers to trap prey.

entry: POKENAME长久磨炼超能力，长出的水晶也更大、更有力量，能保护自己，对抗敌人。
author: ladan
source: POKENAME spent a long time honing its psychic abilities. It grows larger and more powerful crystals to protect itself against foes.

entry: POKENAME靠阳光为身体充能，充满时，头上的红点就会发光。白天不断发出有节奏的哔哔声，像复古游戏的曲子。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on sunlight to charge their bodies. The red dot on their head glows when fully charged. Throughout the day, POKENAME release rhythmic beeps that resemble songs from retro games.

entry: POKENAME集中精神力量，连微风最细小的变化也能察觉。它借此准确预测猎物飞过的时机，眨眼间出击。
author: chibitales
source: By focusing its psychic power, POKENAME can sense even the slightest variation in the breeze. It uses this ability to predict exactly when prey will fly by, striking in the blink of an eye.

entry: POKENAME敏感的毛能察觉细小温度变化。训练家若觉得太冷，它就依偎过去，用温暖翅膀裹住对方保暖。
author: vlavoc
source: POKENAME has sensitive fur that detects tiny temperature changes. If its Trainer feels too cold, it will huddle close and wrap its warm wings around them to provide warmth.

entry: POKENAME读取气流，知道有东西接近，总能在被发现前隐形。携带心之水滴后，它能储存更多太阳能，使用精神力量更久才会疲倦。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can always turn invisible before being spotted by reading air currents to know when something comes near. When holding a Soul Dew, it can store more energy from sunlight and use psychic powers for longer before it becomes exhausted.

entry: POKENAME九条末端分叉的尾巴，因传说蕴藏的力量而广受敬重赞叹。它也会以同样的尊重和坚定忠诚，回报值得效忠的训练家。
author: infinex21
source: Its nine, split-tipped tails are viewed with great respect and admiration for the powers oft claimed to be within them. An POKENAME will treat worthy Trainers with equal respect and unyielding loyalty.

entry: POKENAME吃铁矿和地下晶体，为红宝石供能。大耳、分叉尾巴和敏感宝石，能透过岩层感知地震振动与磁场变化。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME feed on iron ore and subterranean crystals to power their red gems. Using their large ears, split tails, and sensitive gems, they sense seismic vibrations and magnetic currents through stone.

entry: POKENAME在阳光下给尾巴充能，用热量引出精神力量。它很容易累，夜里若没有足够能量还想动用能力，就会头晕。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME charge their tails in sunlight, using the heat to draw out their psychic powers. They tire out easily and get dizzy if they try to access their powers at night without a proper supply of energy.

entry: POKENAME每只花朵般的手里，都捧着一颗精神潜能巨大的球。清晨，球的力量最强，能离开本体独自飘浮行动，协助战斗。
author: sk372
source: Each of POKENAME's flower-hands holds an orb of great psychic potential. In the early morning hours, these orbs are at their strongest, and can float and operate independently of POKENAME to aid it in combat.

entry: POKENAME感到威胁或兴奋时，会释放引起鲜明幻觉的孢子。文学学者怀疑，许多童话都是作者受孢子影响时写下的。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: When feeling threatened or excited, POKENAME will release spores that cause vivid hallucinations. Literary scholars suspect that many fairytales were written by authors under the influence of these spores.

entry: 据说POKENAME能与逝者交流，因此是许多超能力者喜爱的伙伴。
author: nyoomymph
source: It's said that POKENAME possesses the power to communicate with those who have passed on. It's a popular partner choice for many psychics.

entry: POKENAME没有四肢，便学会操纵自己长出的锋利水晶，抵御来犯的敌人。
author: ladan
source: Since the POKENAME lacks any limbs, it learned to manipulate the sharp crystals it grows to fend off attackers.

entry: POKENAME捕猎时会催眠受害者，削弱痛觉，再吸取血液，直到满足。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME hypnotises victims it hunts and dulls their sense of pain. Then, it drains the prey of its blood until it is satisfied.

entry: POKENAME身上的宝石储着大量毒液。若开始渗漏，最好远远避开。
author: .izik
source: The gems on POKENAME's body store a vast amount of poison. If they begin to leak, keeping your distance is strongly advised.

entry: POKENAME是严肃独居的巨兽，读取经过领地者的心思与情绪。来者若无恶意，就允许平安通过；察觉捣乱者，则会猛烈追赶。
author: sk372
source: A solemn and solitary giant, POKENAME reads the minds and emotions of those that pass by its territory. Those without ill intent are allowed to pass through unharmed, but it will aggressively chase away any troublemakers it senses.

entry: POKENAME优雅漂浮，不碰冰冻的地面。它通过头顶红宝石引导精神力量，用飘逸的绯红长带操纵冰冷气流。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME drift gracefully without touching the frozen ground. Channeling psychic power through the red gem on their head, they manipulate frosty air currents with their long, flowing crimson ribbons.

entry: POKENAME将精神能量聚在翅尖，形成发光绒球。它能感知训练家的情绪，对方害怕或紧张时，就跳舞鼓劲。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME gathers psychic energy around its wing tips to create glowing pom-poms. It can sense its Trainer's emotions, and will inspire them with a dance if they're feeling scared or nervous.

entry: POKENAME结合预知与回声定位，从不被打个措手不及。有些冒险者会带它同行，在危险来袭前得到警告。
author: .fedoraman
source: With their combination of precognition and echolocation, POKENAME are never caught off-guard. Some adventurers bring along POKENAME to warn them of danger before it strikes.

entry: 你看见POKENAME时，它肯定早已看见你。它天生善于投机，谁喂得最好就帮谁，不问对方的目的。
author: .fedoraman
source: If you spot an POKENAME, it is sure to have already spotted you. It is a naturally opportunistic Pokémon, aiding whomever keeps it the best-fed, regardless of their cause.

entry: 邪恶组织曾招揽POKENAME参与活动。它尤其适合监视，能靠精神力量悬停数小时，不断观察，身影几乎融入夜空。
author: .fedoraman
source: Villainous organizations have been known to enlist POKENAME in their dealings. They are uniquely useful for stakeouts, as they can use their psychic powers to hang in midair for hours on end, watching, nearly invisible against the night sky.

entry: 训练家受伤，POKENAME就立即用棉花般的翅膀轻蹭，舒缓伤痛。战斗中，全力释放精神力量之前，额头的球会放出强光。
author: fiordaliso
source: If its Trainer is injured, POKENAME immediately rubs its cottony wings against them to soothe their wounds. When battling, the orb on its forehead emits a powerful glow right before it unleashes the full extent of its psychic powers.

entry: 训练家受伤，POKENAME就立即用棉花般的翅膀轻蹭，舒缓伤痛。战斗中，全力释放精神力量之前，额头的球会放出强光。
author: fiordaliso
source: If its Trainer is injured, POKENAME immediately rubs its cottony wings against them to soothe their wounds. When battling, the orb on its forehead emits a powerful glow right before it unleashes the full extent of its psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME黎明飞到云上，沐浴朝阳，补充精神力量，云朵般的羽毛也随之变暗。精神力量消耗后，羽毛又褪回白色。
author: wiz0z
source: In order to charge their psychic powers, POKENAME fly above the clouds at dawn to bask in the rising sun. Their cloudy feathers darken in response. When POKENAME expends their psychic powers, their feathers fade to white.

entry: POKENAME日落时穿云飞行，用精神力量操纵周围云朵，遮住身影。若有幸看见，被认为是吉兆。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME fly through clouds at sunset, using their psychic powers to manipulate the surrounding clouds and hide themselves from view. Managing to spot one is considered to be an auspicious omen.

entry: POKENAME必须留在阴影里保持湿润，却对太阳奇异地着迷。什么东西像太阳，它都会敬畏地盯着看。
author: hophoppip
source: Though it must remain in the shade to keep its body moist, POKENAME has an odd fascination with the sun and will stare at anything sun-shaped in awe.

entry: POKENAME身体由纯冰构成，始终微微发光。每逢使用精神力量，除了眼睛，全身都会闪耀鲜艳色彩。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is made of pure ice, but it glows faintly at all times. Whenever it uses its psychic powers, its entire body flashes with bright colors, except for its eyes.

entry: 阳光照进POKENAME领地，精神力量便涌入中空的身体，让它活跃起来。战斗无需听令，它早已举起肢体，准备施以灾难般的重击。
author: bobosmith01
source: When sunlight breaches into POKENAME's domain, psychic power pours into POKENAME's hollow body, causing it to become active. It need not hear a command in order to battle; by then, it has already risen its limbs to strike with cataclysmic power.

entry: POKENAME直接飞到恒星近旁，将尽可能多的阳光吸进晶体部位。充满能量后，就能瞬间感知其他生命的动作，召来喷泉般的精神能量轰向敌人。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME flies directly near suns and absorbs as much sunshine as it can into the crystalline parts of its body. Having these body parts fully charged allows it to instantly sense others' actions and summon geysers of psychic energy on foes.

entry: POKENAME随水手旅行，附近一有沉船，就必定提醒同行者。有人认为，它的精神能力能与随船罹难者的灵魂交流。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME traveling with sailors unfailingly alert their companions when sunken ships are nearby. It's thought by some that POKENAME's psychic powers let it communicate with the spirits of those who went down with said ships.

entry: POKENAME勇敢作战，守护同伴，在高处据点间轻松跳跃。灵活身手和坚定意志，让它成为可靠队友。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fights valiantly to protect its allies, leaping effortlessly between high vantage points. Its agility and determination make it a reliable teammate.

entry: POKENAME融合了昼行与夜行的宝可梦，因此很少睡觉。超能力，也让光合作用，更有效率。
author: vaporvenator
source: As a fusion of a nocturnal and diurnal Pokémon, POKENAME rarely sleeps. Psychic power aids in the efficiency of its photosynthesis.

entry: POKENAME很少捕猎，可一出手就从不失误，因为能预知未来，判断什么猎物抓得到。
author: vaporvenator
source: While POKENAME doesn't hunt often, its attempts to do so are always flawless, as it can predict the future to determine what is a feasible prey item.

entry: POKENAME结合孢子与精神波动，让宝可梦入睡。科学家采集孢子，制成帮助人和宝可梦入睡的助眠品。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME put Pokémon to sleep by releasing a combination of spores and psychic waves. Their spores are harvested by scientists to create sleep aids that help people and Pokémon fall asleep.

entry: POKENAME背上长着形状独特的蘑菇，每周释放一次闪亮孢子。蘑菇和孢子似乎都能暂时提升智力，却也有引起幻觉的副作用。
author: sk372
source: Uniquely-shaped mushrooms grow on POKENAME's back and emit sparkling spores once a week. The fungi and the spores both seem to temporarily enhance intellect, but come with a hallucinogenic side-effect.

entry: 岩石般的身体让POKENAME格外勇敢。捕猎时，它还能靠气流预测附近生命的动作，更加得心应手。
author: duskangel
source: POKENAME is exceptionally brave due to its stone-like build, making it more adept at hunting by using air currents to predict the movement of nearby lifeforms.

entry: POKENAME是芯片音乐家，曲子空灵，仿佛来自异界。精神能量从额头宝石散出，让它预知事件，再通过音乐传达。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME are chiptune musicians whose songs feel ethereal and otherworldly. Psychic energy radiates from the gem in their forehead, allowing them to predict events they communicate through music.

entry: POKENAME用许多传唱不衰的晨歌，唱出黎明分别的爱情。带着骑士气息的旋律，让听众既紧张，又感到苦甜交织。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sing of love that separates at dawn through many timeless aubades. The chivalrous melody inspires a mixture of tension and bittersweet feelings in those who listen to it.

entry: POKENAME体内释放的日之石微粒富含维生素D。沐浴这些明亮闪耀的微粒，效果几乎等同于晒太阳。
author: soup1900
source: The Sun Stone particles that are released from POKENAME's body are incredibly rich in vitamin D. Bathing in these bright and shiny particles has almost equivalent effects to basking in sunshine.

entry: POKENAME以收集、悉心保护日之石闻名。只有认可另一只宝可梦潜力巨大，它才愿意送出一块。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME is known to collect and protect Sun Stones with utmost care. It will only part with a stone if it recognizes great potential in another Pokémon.

entry: 日出时，POKENAME起伏背上的翅膀，接住阳光，为上面许多球充能。持有它羽毛的人，感知会变得更敏锐细腻。
author: soup1900
source: During sunrises, POKENAME undulates the wing on its back to catch sun rays and charge the many orbs there. Holders of its feathers are granted heightened senses of awareness and sensitivity.

entry: 吸入POKENAME的孢子会产生幻觉，通常看见并不存在的成群伊布。追着幻影伊布跑，最后就会迷路。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spores cause hallucinations when inhaled. Those under the effect of spores typically see groups of Eevee that do not exist and end up getting lost when they chase the illusory Eevee.

entry: 据说直视POKENAME的火焰攻击，就会被迷住。它似乎随机挑选人类作训练家，蜷在对方身边，用耳朵提供舒适的暖意。
author: ghostslythe
source: It is said any who stare into POKENAME's fire attacks will be entranced. It appears to randomly pick humans to be its Trainer, and will curl up with them while providing comfortable heat from its ears.

entry: POKENAME头顶分泌特殊的酸奶涂层，餐馆用来裹树果。它能按周围的庆典调整风味，因此某些节日尤其受欢迎。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME secretes a special yogurt coating atop their heads, which restaurants use to coat berries. They are especially popular during certain holidays, as they can adjust their flavor to match the events around them.

entry: 受到威胁时，POKENAME将潜藏的精神能量化为近乎不破的绯红薄幕，笼住自己，能弹回任何攻击。这形象使它成为反主流文化艺术运动的重要象征。
author: beatdoof
source: When threatened, POKENAME cloaks itself in a near-unbreakable crimson veil formed from latent psychic energy, able to bounce back any attack. Its imagery has made it a prominent symbol in counterculture art movements.

entry: 受到威胁时，POKENAME将潜藏的精神能量化为近乎不破的绯红薄幕，笼住自己，能弹回任何攻击。这形象使它成为反主流文化艺术运动的重要象征。
author: beatdoof
source: When threatened, POKENAME cloaks itself in a near-unbreakable crimson veil formed from latent psychic energy, able to bounce back any attack. Its imagery has made it a prominent symbol in counterculture art movements.

entry: 人们认为POKENAME来自群星之外。它通过宝石释放微弱精神脉冲，感知心思，与训练家同步。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME are thought to have arrived from beyond the stars. They emit faint psychic pulses through their gem, allowing them to detect thoughts and synchronise with their Trainers.

entry: POKENAME头上的尖晶石能帮助集中精神力量。照料得好的个体，尖晶石光泽极佳。
author: hophoppip
source: The spinel crystals on POKENAME's head help to focus its psychic powers. A well-kept POKENAME's spinels are highly lustrous.

entry: POKENAME总在头痛，身边一有人，却神秘地好了。它用心灵感应窥见他人的心思，就不再反复纠结自己的念头。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have constant headaches that mysteriously vanish whenever they are in the presence of another person. By using their telepathic powers to see into other people's thoughts, they stop ruminating on their own thoughts.

entry: POKENAME总想帮助遇到困难的野生宝可梦，因此巡护员常让它加入队伍。可它十分胆小，一遇到自己觉得可怕的宝可梦，就想逃跑。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME always try to help wild Pokémon with problems, prompting Pokémon Rangers to have them on their teams. POKENAME are quite skittish, however, and will try to flee when encountering a Pokémon they consider scary.

entry: POKENAME能读取其他宝可梦的心思，轻易就被逗乐。它常花数小时听心声，身体则悠闲地浮在湖面。
author: quackquackattack
