source: POKENAME can read the thoughts of other Pokémon and are easily entertained by what they hear. They often spend hours listening to thoughts while their body idly floats on the surface of lakes.

entry: 宝可梦文明的遗迹中，到处出土POKENAME的雕像。人们相信，当地古人看中它威严的外貌和强大精神能力，将它当作珍贵宠物。
author: inquis1
source: Statues of POKENAME are unearthed everywhere among the ancient ruins of Pokémopolis. POKENAME is believed to have been a prized pet to the ancient Pokémopolitans, for its majestic appearance, and impressive psychic abilities.

entry: POKENAME躯干上鲜艳的旋纹，几乎瞬间就能让其他生命陷入催眠恍惚。趁对方发愣，它判断是敌是友；若是敌人，就从爪中射出精神能量光束。
author: sk372
source: The vibrant swirling pattern on POKENAME's torso can near-instantly put another being into a hypnotic stupor. While they're stunned, POKENAME judges if they are friend or foe; foes are treated to psychic energy beams launched from its claws.

entry: POKENAME白天吸收太阳能，很少需要睡觉。大耳读取细微气流，一察觉危险靠近，额头宝石就立即发光，带它瞬间传送离开。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME absorb solar energy by day, leaving them with little need to sleep. By reading subtle air currents through their large ears, their forehead gems glow instantly and teleport them away the moment they sense approaching danger.

entry: POKENAME拿着的勺子，将阳光直接导入体内，增强精神能力。这股光能让它白天的力量更强。
author: .izik
source: The spoon POKENAME carries channels sunlight directly into its body, amplifying its psychic abilities. This radiant energy makes its powers more potent in daylight.

entry: POKENAME浮在水面，让头上的球闪烁，引诱猎物。靠近后，就用众多触手缠住，拖入水下。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME entices prey by twinkling the orbs on its head as it floats on the surface of the water. Once close, it ensnares its meal with its many tentacles and drags them underwater.

entry: POKENAME耐心守望山路，读取附近来者的意图。赢得它尊重的训练家，就能得到终生忠诚的守护者。
author: haxill_1
source: POKENAME patiently watches over mountain trails, reading the intentions of those nearby. Trainers who earn its respect gain a loyal protector for life.

entry: POKENAME潜藏的精神力量已经觉醒，还与火焰力量融合。凝视火焰的人，往往觉得自己正被牵入催眠状态。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's latent psychic powers have awakened and melded together with the powers of their flames as well. Those who stare at their flames tend to feel like they are being drawn into a hypnotic state.

entry: POKENAME敏感的毛能感知气流，发现任何方向的攻击者。可反应极慢，常还没来得及自卫，就已挨打。
author: cait_sith
source: By feeling air currents with its sensitive fur, POKENAME can detect attackers from any direction. However, POKENAME has an incredibly slow reaction time, so it's often struck before it can defend itself.

entry: 察觉训练家遇险，POKENAME额头的宝石便开始燃烧，化为凶猛的斗士。恢复原态后，壳上会永远留着一道焦痕。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When POKENAME sense their Trainer is in danger, the gem on their forehead begins to burn as they transform into a violent fighter. When returning from this state, their shell has a permanent scorch mark.

entry: POKENAME尾巴覆着晶壳，帮助它更好地控制精神能力。它用能力安抚悲伤的人，代价却是让对方暂时变得和自己一样单纯。
author: sk372
source: A crystal shell covering POKENAME's tail helps grant it better control over its psychic abilities. It uses them to soothe and comfort those feeling sad, at the cost of making the person temporarily behave as simple-minded as POKENAME is.

entry: POKENAME住在空心松树里，研究自己的球，试图看见一切可能的未来。一看到某位特定训练家，就立即动身，飞向命定的归宿。
author: ghostslythe
source: Found inside hollowed-out pine trees, POKENAME studies its orb, attempting to see all possible futures. When it sees a specific Trainer, it immediately flies to its destiny.

entry: POKENAME的心灵感应格外出众，不只自己的几颗头，连其他生物也能与之交谈。可每颗头个性不同，一吵起来，往往就是好几个小时。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME possesses an extraordinary ability to communicate through telepathy, not only with its own heads but with other creatures as well. Each head has a distinct personality, and will often argue with one another for hours at a time.

entry: POKENAME碰过的东西都会留下有毒残留。食物若被沾上，吃下后会轻微头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME leave a residue on whatever they touch. This poisonous residue causes a light headache in those who consume food tainted by their touch.

entry: 察觉训练家遇险，POKENAME额头的宝石便开始燃烧，化为凶猛的斗士。恢复原态后，毛色会永久变暗。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When POKENAME sense their Trainer is in danger, the gem on their forehead begins to burn as they transform into a violent fighter. When returning from this state, their fur permanently darkens.

entry: POKENAME壳内覆着闪亮的珍珠层，反光表面帮助集中精神，以精神能量将尖刺射向敌人。
author: .jerden
source: The inside of its shell is coated with shimmering mother-of-pearl. This reflective surface focuses POKENAME's mind as it uses psychic energy to propel sharp spines toward foes.

entry: POKENAME催眠其他宝可梦，让它们梦见超能力。许多宝可梦一生中第一次在梦里用上念力，体验片刻奇妙。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hypnotize other Pokémon to give them dreams of psychic powers. These dreams allow a moment of wonder as many are able to harness telekinesis for the first time in their lives while dreaming.

entry: POKENAME用精神力量催眠其他宝可梦，给予现实中只能想象的能力，让它们一直睡着。许多个体选择学超能力，爱用念力举物，哪怕只在梦里。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hypnotize other Pokémon with their psychic powers and keep them asleep by giving them powers they can only imagine of in reality. Many opt to learn psychic powers and love to lift objects with their mind, even if it is only in a dream.

entry: POKENAME十分保护训练家，会守在熟睡的对方身旁，赶走噩梦，让梦境安稳。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME is very protective of its Trainer. It will watch over its Trainer while they sleep and fend off nightmares so that the Trainer's dreams are safe.

entry: POKENAME从月光中获取能量，满月时，背上的种子开得最盛。受到威胁时，种子会渗出毒汁，误食后会引起严重恶心。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME gets its energy from moonlight, with its bulb blooming most fully during the full moon. When threatened, the bulb seeps toxic sap that causes severe nausea if consumed.

entry: POKENAME还很弱，会离开庇护处吸收月光，希望早日进化。它能织出极细、极受珍视的银丝，像月光本身一样闪亮。
author: fiordaliso
source: Since POKENAME is still very weak, it leaves its shelter to absorb moonlight in hopes of reaching its evolutionary stage soon. It can weave extremely fine, highly prized silver silk that shines like moonlight itself.

entry: POKENAME黄昏时聚在古老墓园附近，在墓碑间安静玩耍，日出前便消失。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME gather near old graveyards at dusk. They play quietly among the stones, vanishing before sunrise.

entry: POKENAME无声而敏捷，藏在暗处，以强力踢击迎敌。准备出手时，环纹会亮得更盛，先扰乱对手，再迅速、精准地击中。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME moves with silent agility, striking with powerful kicks in the cover of darkness. Its glowing rings intensify when it's ready to attack, disorienting foes before delivering swift, precise blows.

entry: POKENAME先让拳套明亮发光，晃花对手的眼，再使出可怕的上勾拳。它整夜击打巨树的树皮训练，黎明才睡。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME makes its gloves shine brightly to dazzle its opponents before striking them with terrifying uppercuts. It spends entire nights training, punching the bark of enormous trees, then goes to sleep when dawn breaks.

entry: POKENAME察觉危险，就喷出毒雾，让敌人暂时失明。这种气体可提炼，用来制作烟雾弹。
author: kittyluv090
source: If POKENAME senses danger, it will expel a toxic smog that temporarily blinds enemies. This gas can be refined and used to make smoke bombs.

entry: 它让身上的黄环发光，晃花靠近的天敌，趁对方混乱逃走。需要月光才能变强，因此白天藏好，只在合适时机才出巢。
author: fiordaliso
source: It makes the yellow rings on its body glow to dazzle approaching predators, then takes advantage of their confusion to escape. As it needs moonlight to grow stronger, it remains hidden during the day and only emerges from its den at the right moment.

entry: POKENAME全身的黄环，让它显得比实际更凶险。圆环在黑暗里发光，更强化了这份危险印象。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have yellow rings across their body that make them appear more menacing than they actually are. The rings glow in the dark, which only reinforces their perceived dangerousness.

entry: POKENAME夜里在城市吃烟雾为生。它的气体半衰期长达两个世纪，散发着强烈的硫醇臭味。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME feeds off of smog during city nights. POKENAME's gas has a half-life of two centuries and reeks of mercaptan.

entry: 鼻上的角转得越快，POKENAME金色圆环散出的光晕就越亮。它完美融入洞穴的黑暗，还会筑起足够全家同住的大巢。
author: fiordaliso
source: The faster the horn on its snout rotates, the brighter the aura that POKENAME radiates from its golden circles. It blends perfectly with the darkness of the caves where it builds impressive dens that can accommodate its entire family.

entry: POKENAME会把无人看管的蛋据为己有，放进袋里孵化，根本不在乎原主人。蛋孵出后，常又与幼崽组成偷蛋团伙。
author: blake
source: POKENAME is known for claiming unattended eggs and placing them in their pouch until they hatch. POKENAME have little regard for the egg's original owner, often forming egg-swiping gangs with the babies that hatch.

entry: POKENAME性情平静，暗色藤蔓上带着黄环，满月下会发光。它跟随巨蔓藤导师，学习如何编织藤蔓，捕捉、储存柔和月光。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME are calm Pokémon whose dark, yellow-ringed vines glow under the full moon. With the guidance of Tangrowth mentors, they learn how to weave their vines to capture and store this gentle lunar light.

entry: POKENAME与同伴成大群生活，逢满月下的涨潮，尤为活跃。它让发光环圈在海中闪耀，与远处的同类交流。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lives in large schools with its companions and becomes particularly active when the tide rises under the light of the full moon. It makes its luminous rings shine in the sea to communicate over great distances with others of its kind.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME身上的金色花纹明亮发光。日出后，它会向水中释放闪光，散去多余的月亮能量。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has golden markings on its body that glow brightly when there is a full moon. When the sun rises, it releases sparkles into the water to release excess lunar energy.

entry: POKENAME全身有鲜黄色圆环，在黑暗中发光。许多宝可梦都靠黄环的光，在暗处看清东西。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have bright yellow rings across their body that glow in the dark. Many Pokémon rely on the light produced by these yellow rings to see in the dark.

entry: 准备战斗时，POKENAME会从体内嵌着的月之石射出光束，几乎晃得人睁不开眼。它夜里活跃得多，白天却昏昏欲睡。
author: fiordaliso
source: When preparing to battle, POKENAME emits almost blinding beams of light from the Moon Stone embedded in its body. It is much more active at night, while appearing drowsy during the day.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME在海边模仿潮汐起落。孩子们若配合它推拉大海的表演一起玩，圆环就会开心地发光。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: When there's a full moon, POKENAME imitates the movement of the tides by the seashore. Its rings light up in happiness when children play along with its performance of pushing and pulling the sea.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME在海边模仿潮汐起落。孩子们若配合它推拉大海的表演一起玩，圆环就会开心地发光。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: When there's a full moon, POKENAME imitates the movement of the tides by the seashore. Its rings light up in happiness when children play along with its performance of pushing and pulling the sea.

entry: POKENAME夜间在黑暗中游走，寻找蘑菇，尤其爱发光的，宁可选它们，也不要不发光的。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are nocturnal creatures that wander through the darkness searching for mushrooms. They are particularly fond of glowing mushrooms and will pick those over those that do not glow.

entry: POKENAME身上的花纹夜里明亮闪耀，因此许多水手都认识它。海上能遇见，被许多人视为福气。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon are well-known among many sailors due to the markings upon their bodies that shine bright at night. To many, POKENAME are seen as a blessing to encounter at sea.

entry: POKENAME胶状的身体在月光下更加柔韧。夜里，形体闪烁流动，流畅得有些诡异。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's gelatinous body becomes even more pliable under moonlight. At night, its form shimmers and flows with eerie fluidity.

entry: POKENAME需要增强力量时，训练家会给它特防强化，抵挡强攻。据说能帮它扛住整巢宝可梦的攻势，不过多半是夸大。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME needs a boost, Trainers give it an X Sp. Def to help shield itself from tough attacks. The booster is said to help it tough out entire nests of Pokémon, though this is likely hyperbole.

entry: POKENAME夜间活动，月相越接近满月，就越活跃。临近进化时，身上的圆环还会变色。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is nocturnal and grows more active the more full the moon's phase is. The rings on its body have been known to shift color as its evolution draws nearer.

entry: POKENAME白天大多住在水下，入夜才上岸。颈部褶边吸收月光维生，身上圆环也随之闪耀。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends most of the day residing underwater, only coming onto land after nightfall. The frill around its neck absorbs moonlight for sustenance, its rings glowing brightly as it does so.

entry: POKENAME常在夜空下奔跑，为体内电力充能，再用发光圆环储存的月光，让光芒更亮。
author: ambrosia04
source: Often spotted running beneath the night sky, POKENAME dash to recharge their internal electricity. They use the moonlight stored within their glowing rings to shine even brighter.

entry: POKENAME越爱训练家，攻击就越强、火焰越旺。金色鬃毛沐浴月光时，会散出舒缓的光。
author: fiordaliso
source: The greater POKENAME's affection for its Trainer, the more powerful and fiery its attacks become. When its golden mane is bathed in moonlight, it glows with a soothing light.

entry: POKENAME出奇脆弱，常碎成许多块，还会穿模越过地形。有理论认为，这只是在玩。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME is surprisingly frail. It will often shatter into many pieces and clip through the terrain. Theories suggest this is playful behavior.

entry: POKENAME产生鲜黄色毒液，储在环绕身体的带状部位。黄环夜里发光，让它能在黑暗中看清。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a bright yellow venom that is stored in bands around their body. These yellow rings glow at night to allow them to see in the darkness.

entry: POKENAME挂在树上，圆环在黑暗中发光。森林里的许多宝可梦都不打扰它，因为它能照亮黑夜。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hang from trees and have rings that glow in the dark. Many Pokémon that live in the forest leave them alone because of the illumination they provide in the dark.

entry: 这头史前猛兽，只肯夜间狩猎。偏偏饭点定得太死，能选的食物，便实在不多。
author: patch_bros
source: This prehistoric powerhouse would exclusively hunt at night. Due to this scheduled mealtime, it unfortunately didn't have too many options for food.

entry: 月光下，身上的光环开始发亮、迸出火花。有记录的POKENAME目击，都发生在暴风雨的夜里。
author: deflador
source: Under the moon's light, the rings on its body start to glow and spark. The only recorded sightings of POKENAME have been during stormy nights.

entry: POKENAME制造暗黑火焰，满月下明亮发光。不速之客闯入领地时，它会增强火焰，试图驱逐对方。
author: krivaswell
source: POKENAME creates dark flames that glow brightly in the light of a full moon. When an unwanted guest enters its domain, the flames intensify as POKENAME tries to repel the trespasser with its flames.

entry: 夜里迷路的旅人，有时会被POKENAME花纹的柔光引到安全处。
author: fredfeyh
source: Travelers who become lost at night are sometimes led to safety by the gentle glow of POKENAME's markings.

entry: 据说月夜里，POKENAME会出现在安静湖边。耐心的旅人若见到它，被认为会有好运。
author: fredfeyh
source: POKENAME is said to appear near quiet lakes on moonlit nights. Seeing one is believed to bring good fortune to patient travelers.

entry: POKENAME挂在枝头，用鲜亮黄环照亮幽暗森林。许多人专程来到它聚居的森林，借光看书。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hang from branches and illuminate dark forests with their bright yellow rings. Many people come to forests full of POKENAME to read books under their light.

entry: POKENAME亲近皮皮一系。夜里，它出现在对方面前，制造满月的幻影，让它们在下面跳舞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has an affinity towards members of the Clefairy line. At night, it appears before them and creates an illusory projection of the full moon for them to dance beneath.

entry: POKENAME通常在月夜出巢，身上符号也会发光。光点在天空舞动的景象很受欢迎，尤其吸引游客。可它太胆小，没法靠近。
author: infinex21
source: The symbols on their bodies glow on moonlit nights, which is when they typically come out from their dens. The sight of POKENAME lights dancing in the sky is very popular, especially with tourists. They are too skittish to get near to, though.

entry: 夜幕降临，POKENAME体内能量涌动，火焰变得强烈鲜明得多。训练家遇险，它先用金环晃花敌人的眼，再猛烈反击。
author: fiordaliso
source: As night falls and its body surges with energy, its flames grow significantly more powerful and vivid. When its Trainer is in danger, POKENAME blinds the enemy with its golden rings before launching a fierce counterattack.

entry: POKENAME咬住东西时，圆环会更亮。起初被认为在吸取受害者生命，近来却已证实，只是享受咬东西的刺激，开心而已。
author: sk372
source: The rings on POKENAME's body glow brighter when it chomps down on something. At first it was thought to be a sign of it draining the life from a victim, but recently it's been determined to simply be a joy response to the thrill of biting something.

entry: POKENAME羽毛在黑暗中泛着淡黄微光。这种夜行鸟宝可梦轻易就能暗中辨路，发光羽毛也常替其他生命指路。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME feathers glow faintly in the dark with a pale, yellow light. These nocturnal bird Pokémon can navigate through darkness with ease, and their glowing feathers often guide others as well.

entry: POKENAME有许多眼睛，能看清远近，找出隐藏之物。它原生于幽暗森林，也时常守护着，那片树林。
author: anlcorpagent
source: POKENAME possesses many eyes that can see far and wide, able to detect hidden objects. It is native to dark forests, regularly protecting them.

entry: 使出接棒时，POKENAME翅上的黄羽会泛出柔和金光。这一闪，标志着隐藏的力量传给同伴。
author: .izik
source: When using Baton Pass, POKENAME's yellow wing feathers glow with a soft golden light. This flash marks the transfer of its hidden strength to its allies.

entry: POKENAME是高效的夜间捕食者，用微泛金光的丝网引诱猎物。据说它自身的微光，只会为最勇敢的疲倦旅人指路。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME are highly effective night predators. They utilize webbing that has a slight golden glow to lure in prey. They have a slight glow that is said to guide only the bravest of weary travelers.

entry: POKENAME身上的花纹只在月亮露出时发光，即使没直接晒到月光也一样。因此它在白天捕猎，用丝网扑住猎物，再以毒牙制服。
author: infinex21
source: The markings along an POKENAME's body glow only when the moon is exposed, even if it is not within the moonlight itself. As such, it is a diurnal hunter that pounces upon prey with nets of silk and subdues them with its venomous bites.

entry: POKENAME住在漆黑洞穴，除了身上圆环，再无别的光。一看到其他光源，就会立刻逃走。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME resides in pitch-black caves, void of all light except for the glow of the rings along its body. It will immediately flee upon seeing any other light source.

entry: POKENAME在洞里筑巢，夜里出来，月亮出现时，身上黄色部位柔和发光。它像出汗般分泌不致命的毒，拍一下翅膀，就能撒得很远。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME nests within caves and emerges at night, the yellow parts of its body glowing softly when the moon is out. It secretes a non-lethal poison like sweat, which it can scatter quite far with a flap of its wings.

entry: POKENAME能放出，宛如克雷色利亚般美丽的月光。满月之夜，光芒也最强。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME can emit moonlight as beautiful as a Cresselia's. Its bioluminescence is strongest on a full moon night.

entry: POKENAME站在月光下收集能量，转为电力，却还不能有效运用。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME stands underneath the light of the moon to gather energy. This energy is converted into electricity, though POKENAME cannot wield it effectively yet.

entry: POKENAME靠近来自群星之外的陨石时，圆环会放出奇美的金色光晕。临近进化，它们便聚到陨石坑中心，原因尚不明确。
author: fiordaliso
source: Whenever POKENAME comes close to a meteoric rock from beyond the stars, the rings on its body blaze with a marvelous golden halo. For reasons yet unknown, these creatures gather at the heart of craters when it is time to evolve.

entry: 它虽体型不小，仍能从黑暗中跟踪猎物，迅速扑出，利爪足以破开某些虫属性宝可梦的硬壳。月下泛光的羽毛广受喜爱，让它很有人气。
author: infinex21
source: Despite its size, this Pokémon stalks its prey from the dark and pounces swiftly. Its talons can break open the hard shells of certain Bug-type Pokémon. The glow of its feathers in moonlight is beloved by many, making it quite popular.

entry: POKENAME身上的黄纹随储存的电力发光、嗡鸣。夜里，母亲会带幼崽跳过栅栏，教它们高速移动。
author: periperi_chicken
source: The yellow markings on POKENAME's body glow and hum with its stored electricity. At night, mother POKENAME teach their young Agility by guiding them as they hop over fences.

entry: 成群POKENAME聚在月下跳舞，吸收月光。吸够后，身上的圆环便开始发亮。
author: santon5512
source: Groups of POKENAME will gather and dance under the moon, absorbing the moonlight. Once they are full, the rings on their bodies will begin to glow.

entry: 夜里，它们从湖泊或池塘旁的巢中出来，在月下跳舞。体表覆着一层薄薄毒油，被用于一些解毒药。
author: infinex21
source: At night, these Pokémon emerge from their dens near lakes or ponds and dance in the moonlight. Their bodies are covered in a thin veil of poisonous oil. This oil is used in some antidotes.

entry: 每只POKENAME的花纹都独一无二，与进化时的月亮状况有关。数千年前的个体曾被发现完好保存在泥中，让科学家得以观察月亮过去如何影响地球。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Each POKENAME's markings are unique and relate to the condition of the moon when it evolved. POKENAME from thousands of years ago have been found perfectly preserved in mud, allowing scientists to observe how the moon impacted the earth in the past.

entry: 每只POKENAME的花纹都独一无二，与进化时月亮的力量强度有关。数千年前的个体曾被发现完好保存在泥中，让科学家得以观察月亮过去如何影响地球。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Each POKENAME's markings are unique and relate to the strength of the moon when it evolved. POKENAME from thousands of years ago have been found perfectly preserved in mud, allowing scientists to observe how the moon impacted the earth in the past.

entry: 每只POKENAME的花纹都独一无二，与进化时的月之力有关。数千年前的个体曾被发现完好保存在泥中，让科学家得以观察月球引力过去如何影响地球。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Each POKENAME's markings are unique and relate to the moon's power when it evolved. POKENAME from thousands of years ago have been found perfectly preserved in mud, allowing scientists to observe how the moon's gravity impacted the earth in the past.

entry: POKENAME捕猎高效，能预测猎物动作。每天只睡2小时，黎明、黄昏各一小时。
author: lampent12
source: POKENAME is an efficient hunter that can predict their prey's movement. POKENAME only needs 2 hours of sleep a day, one at dawn and one at dusk.

entry: 满月之夜，POKENAME充满能量，精神能力随之增强。深色毛发让它融入黑暗环境。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: On the nights of full moons, POKENAME are filled with an energy that increases their psychic abilities. Their dark fur allows them to blend in with their dark surroundings.

entry: POKENAME身上的圆环在月光下明亮发光。望向藏在黑暗中的一大群，仿佛有数百只闪亮眼睛正盯回来。
author: periperi_chicken
source: The rings on POKENAME's body glow brightly under moonlight. Looking at a whole horde hidden in the dark, it can appear as if hundreds of gleaming eyes are staring back.

entry: POKENAME吸收的月光越多，背上的花便开得越大。它会用小角撞击对手，注入致命的毒液。
author: mistymagius
source: The more moonlight POKENAME absorbs, the bigger the blossom on its back grows. It will tackle its opponents with its small horns, injecting them with a deadly poison.

entry: 无月之夜，POKENAME躁动不安，甚至会用门牙朝同伴乱咬。察觉危险将至，就让身上金环尽可能地闪耀。
author: fiordaliso
source: On moonless nights, POKENAME grows restless, to the point of snapping its incisors even at its own companions. When it senses imminent danger, it makes the golden rings on its body blaze as brightly as possible.

entry: 这些奇特的宝可梦会将下方尖刺扎进常有月光的地面，尽情晒月亮。吸收越多月光，便越能展露潜藏的力量。
author: infinex21
source: These odd Pokémon will embed their lower spikes into the terrain of a location often exposed to moonlight so they may bask in it aplenty. The more moonlight they absorb, the more of a hidden potential they begin to display.

entry: POKENAME整夜吃草，发光圆环照亮黑暗。尾巴能赶在危险来袭前察觉。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME grazes through the night, its glowing rings illuminating the darkness. Its tail can sense danger before it strikes.

entry: 猜POKENAME壳上有几个黄环，是青少年比胆量的危险游戏。猜错的人按规则必须摸它，冒着引发爆炸的风险。
author: banzai.exe
source: Guessing the number of yellow rings on a POKENAME's shell is a dangerous game played by teenagers as a dare. If one guesses wrong, the rules of the game state they must touch the POKENAME and risk it exploding.

entry: POKENAME以耐心闻名，会在暗处等上数天，等毫无戒心的猎物经过。若被发现，便躲进钢壳保命，等夜里借月之力积蓄力量，再以爆炸反击敌人。
author: banzai.exe
source: POKENAME is a famously patient Pokémon, waiting for days in dark places for unsuspecting prey to pass. If discovered, it can safely hide in its steel shell until nighttime, where the moon's power charges its ability to explode on attackers.

entry: POKENAME白天极害羞，容易受惊。夜里月亮却给它信心，谁想攻击，它就咬回去。
author: soup1900
source: In the daytime, POKENAME is extremely shy and easily frightened. In the night, however, the moon gives it confidence, and it will bite back at anything that tries to attack it.

entry: POKENAME只在深夜最黑的时候出巢觅食。哪怕最微弱的月光，也会让身上花纹在暗中发亮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME only comes out of its den to forage during the darkest part of the night. In even the faintest of moonlight, the markings on its body will glow in the darkness.

entry: POKENAME的壳释放与月之石相近的能量，火焰在夜里闪着诡异黄光。它寻找陨石坑，吃落下的陨石碎块。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME shells emit a similar energy to that given off by Moon Stones, their flames glowing an eerie yellow as they flicker in the night. They seek out meteor craters, feeding on fallen chunks of meteorite.

entry: POKENAME是夜间猎手，善于在暗中无声移动。它让翅上花纹不祥地发光，分散猎物注意，再用尖喙精准施以致命一击。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is a nocturnal hunter that is adept at moving silently in the dark. The patterns on its wings ominously glow to distract prey before it uses its sharp beak to strike with deadly precision.

entry: 月亮最明亮时，常能看到POKENAME凝望。它在尾巴里收集月之石。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME can often be found gazing at the moon when it's at its brightest. It collects Moon Stones in its tail.

entry: POKENAME靠黑色身体掩护，优雅地游过水中，悄悄掠过海底。只有准备战斗时，才让黄环发光，迷惑潜在对手。
author: fiordaliso
source: Thanks to its black body, POKENAME can swim gracefully through the water, skimming the seabed without being seen. It only makes its yellow rings glow to confuse potential rivals when it is ready to fight.

entry: POKENAME从波浪中现身时，金环闪耀，在水上形成壮丽光影。黑色身体让它完美藏进深海，避开不愿遇见的家伙。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME emerges from the waves, its golden rings sparkle, creating magnificent light effects on the water. Its black color allows it to hide perfectly in the depths of the sea, thus avoiding unwanted encounters.

entry: POKENAME身上的圆环会按不同方式发光。人们认为，族群狩猎时借此交流。满月下，圆环会亮得多。
author: chibitales
source: The rings on this Pokémon's body glow in various patterns. It is thought that POKENAME packs communicate with each other using this ability during hunts. Under the full moon, the rings glow much brighter.

entry: POKENAME仪态威严，被视为夜晚的先兆，见到便知夜幕将近。体内高热难以压住，尾部蓝焰宛如夜空。圆环一叮当响，大多数生命就逃了。
author: lesbian_garlicbread
source: This regal Pokémon is seen as a harbinger of night; spotting POKENAME means nightfall is near. Its body burns hotter than it can contain, the blue flame of its tail mirroring the night sky. The jingling of its rings sends most fleeing.

entry: POKENAME蛇形的身体滑过高草，完美融入黑暗，设下猛烈伏击。它用毒牙咬伤、削弱猎物，让对方无力反抗。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME slithers its serpentine body through tall grass, blending perfectly into the dark to set devastating ambushes. It weakens its prey with bites from its venomous fangs, leaving them powerless to resist.

entry: POKENAME是夜行生物，人们只在傍晚见过它于网络空间活动。分析数据时，身上的圆环会依次点亮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a nocturnal creature, having only been seen active in cyberspace during the evenings. The rings on its body light up in sequence while it analyzes data.

entry: POKENAME的角晒过月光后，会在黑暗中发亮，因此曾被偷猎者追捕。满月之夜，原本微弱的精神力量也会增强。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME were once hunted by poachers due to their antlers glowing in the dark after exposure to moonlight. Their mild psychic powers grow stronger during nights when the moon is full.

entry: POKENAME的角在月光下发亮，成为无良之徒争抢的商品。它会振动角，产生令人头痛的精神脉冲自卫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's antlers glow when exposed to moonlight, making them a commodity sought by unscrupulous sorts. It vibrates its antlers to produce a headache-inducing psychic pulse to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME在月光下更有精神，因此整夜训练，改进格斗技巧。被对手逼入绝境，身上金环就会开始发光。
author: fiordaliso
source: Since POKENAME feels more energetic in the moonlight, it spends entire nights training to improve its fighting techniques. When an opponent corners it, the gold rings on its body begin to glow.

entry: POKENAME主要吃苹野果，帮助增长肌肉。晒过月光后，格斗招式会更敏捷、反应更快。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's diet consists mainly of Leppa Berries, as they help build its muscle mass. After being exposed to moonlight, its fighting techniques become more agile and responsive.

entry: POKENAME是自信的独居猎手，夜间捕食。满月下，大群同类会本能地聚集，齐声嘶鸣数小时。
author: bass.
source: POKENAME are confident hunters, living solitary lives and preying at night. Large groups of POKENAME instinctively gather beneath a full moon and hiss in unison for hours.

entry: POKENAME的奶被称为“银河牛奶”。它的外观奇特，宛如夜空，又有超凡的特性，因此很快就受到欢迎。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME milk, known as Milky-Way Milk, quickly became popular thanks to both its odd resemblance to the night sky and its otherworldly properties.

entry: POKENAME的奶被称为“银河牛奶”。它的外观奇特，宛如夜空，又有超凡的特性，因此很快就受到欢迎。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME milk, known as Milky-Way Milk, quickly became popular thanks to both its odd resemblance to the night sky and its otherworldly properties.

entry: 谁闯进这种夜行宝可梦的领地，很快就会迎来落雷。POKENAME露牙低吼的样子恶名远扬，有人便戴上形似它的面具，吓唬别人。
author: infinex21
source: Those who trespass upon the domains of these nocturnal Pokémon will swiftly be met with lightning bolts crashing down. The sight of an POKENAME bearing its fangs as it growls is infamous; thus, some people don masks resembling them to terrify others.

entry: POKENAME借月光增强火焰。月光充满后，圆环明亮闪耀，喷出的火也呈现亮银色。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses moonlight to enhance the power of its flames. Its rings glow bright when fully charged with moonlight, and the fire it breathes out takes on a bright silvery hue.

entry: 过去，POKENAME被视为黑暗的化身，无月之夜常被归咎于它。
author: xenellia
source: Moonless nights were often attributed to POKENAME, known in the past as the incarnation of darkness.

entry: POKENAME身上最亮的斑点急速闪光，催眠、麻痹猎物。满月让它更强、更饿，捕猎也更凶猛。
author: sk372
source: The brightest spots on POKENAME's body hypnotize and paralyze prey with rapid-fire bright flashes. It hunts more aggressively when the moon is full, enhancing its strength as well as its hunger.

entry: POKENAME不但毒牙咬合有力，毛孔还分泌毒液，喷向猎物或威胁。
author: t3isukone
source: Not only does POKENAME have a powerful venomous bite, but its pores secrete poisonous liquid it sprays at prey or threats.

entry: POKENAME潜行黑暗，身上花纹发着诡光。它用背上的发光符号分散猎物注意，绕住对方，紧缠压碎。
author: infinex21
source: The patterns along POKENAME's body glow with an eerie light as it skulks in the darkness. It encircles its prey, using the glowing symbols on its back to distract its target as it wraps around them and crushes them.

entry: POKENAME结群在夜里移动。早上发现果子不见，多半就是它偷的。
author: lesbian_garlicbread
source: POKENAME gather in packs as they move through the night. Those who find their fruit missing in the morning can likely attribute the theft to POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME夜视能力极佳，即使近乎全黑，也能辨别颜色，帮助它在漫长极夜寻找树果。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME possesses impeccable night vision. They are capable of discerning colors even in near-complete darkness. This helps them forage for berries during the long polar night.

entry: POKENAME出腿快得惊人，爱趁对手倒地再踢，享受刺激。它喜欢看对手受苦，却更喜欢亲自施加痛苦。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME delivers wicked-fast kicks to attack and delight in the thrill of kicking others while they're down. They enjoy seeing their opponents suffer, but prefer to inflict the suffering instead.

entry: POKENAME掌心孔洞周围围着圆环，准备发射弹丸时，会不祥地发光。满月之夜，尾上的月形球会放出奇异辐光。
author: sk372
source: Rings surround the holes in POKENAME's palms, glowing ominously when it prepares to fire projectiles. The moon-shaped orb on its tail illuminates with a strange radiation during evenings with full moons.

entry: POKENAME只在夜里离开地洞，满月的光下最为活跃。身上的金色环泛起微光，让它们在一片漆黑中也能看清。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME emerge only at night from their burrows and are most active under the light of the full moon. The golden rings on their body give a faint glow, allowing them to see even in the pitch black.

entry: POKENAME的毛和叶片尝起来又苦又辣，对某些未成熟的宝可梦甚至有毒。满月之夜，悠闲漫步高草间，似乎最让它开心。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's fur and leaves are both bitter and spicy to taste and are outright poisonous to certain immature species of Pokémon. It appears POKENAME is most happy when it can take a relaxingly amble through tall grass on the night of a full moon.

entry: POKENAME像许多植物一样，白天靠光合作用收集能量，夜里再转成有机物。因此，身体几乎只在日落后长大、进一步成熟。
author: bobosmith01
source: Just like many plants, POKENAME gathers energy throughout the day with photosynthesis before turning this energy into organic compounds at night. Therefore, POKENAME grows larger in size and matures further almost exclusively when the sun is down.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME靠黑色身体和圆环黄光融入星空背景，悄悄跟踪猎物。受伤又走投无路时，它会喝下自己的毒汗疗伤。
author: soup1900
source: At nighttime, POKENAME's black body and the yellow glow from its rings provide camouflage against the starry night sky as it silently stalks its prey. If it gets desperate enough when injured, it will drink its own poisonous sweat to heal itself.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME的黄环明亮发光，让它精神振奋。这时进入电脑，会让图标短暂失真，快得肉眼察觉不到。
author: .izik
source: At night, the yellow rings on POKENAME's body glow brightly, invigorating it. Computers it enters during this time has its icons distorted for a moment, imperceptible to the human eye.

entry: POKENAME的圆环在暗中发光，让捕猎时很难隐蔽。它便从附近沼泽取泥和污垢涂满全身，盖住天生的光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's rings glow in the dark, causing it difficulty in remaining hidden while hunting. It coats its body with mud and grime from nearby swamps to cover up the innate illumination.

entry: 月夜，POKENAME抛出精神能量形成的光环，跳着穿过，完成复杂舞步。这时，身上的圆环也会亮到极致。
author: sk372
source: On moonlit nights, POKENAME casts up rings made of psychic energy, leaping through them as part of an intricate dance routine. The rings on its own body glow their brightest during this time.

entry: 没有什么比与训练家月下散步更让POKENAME开心。月光也会大幅激发精神潜能，让它遇险时更有能力妥善保护对方。
author: sk372
source: Nothing delights POKENAME more than a stroll with its Trainer beneath the moonlight. The moonbeams also supercharge its psychic potential, making it vastly more able to properly protect them should danger arrive.

entry: 古人相信，POKENAME会聚在一起，推动月亮穿过天空。它常住在能无遮无挡仰望夜空的地方，毛发和尾巴闪烁，仿佛盛满星光。
author: chibitales
source: In ancient times, POKENAME were believed to gather together and move the moon across the sky. They are often found in areas where the night sky is unobstructed. Their hair and tail glimmer as if filled with stars.

entry: POKENAME被用来保护富裕人家的孩子，孩子躁动时，就唱歌哄睡。月夜，手中的球会发光，亮度取决于它有多开心。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME are used to protect the children of wealthy families, singing them to sleep when they become restless. On moonlit nights, the orb they carry glows, the intensity of it depending on POKENAME's happiness.

entry: POKENAME只在夜里现身，临近满月时更常见。平日性情温和，会点亮法杖、环纹与角，引导迷途旅人平安回家；战斗时，则筑起光墙自保。
author: cinnamoone_redfield
source: POKENAME appear only at night, and are more common near full moons. Generally passive, these Pokémon light up their staves, rings, and horns to guide wayward travelers home safely, and create defensive walls of light in combat.

entry: POKENAME部分身体像月亮，或许因为它吸收月光，为每个动作提供力量。身上黄色部位微微亮起，就说明月光已充足，准备好战斗。
author: infinex21
source: Parts of POKENAME's body resemble the moon itself, perhaps due to how it absorbs moonlight to empower its every action. When the yellow parts of its body are dimly lit, it is full of moonlight and ready to fight.

entry: POKENAME正义感强，会在月光下追捕想借黑夜掩护的恶徒。
author: t3isukone
source: It has a strong sense of justice. Under the light of the moon, POKENAME hunt down evildoers who think to use night as cover.

entry: 据说无月之夜，POKENAME会出现在迷路的人面前。舒缓的光在黑暗中飘动，无声引向安全处。
author: imeavie
source: POKENAME is said to appear on moonless nights to those who have lost their way. Its soothing light drifts through the darkness, silently guiding them to safety.

entry: POKENAME感到受威胁，便从身体渗出毒液，驱赶天敌。它通常夜里出来，吸收成长变强所需的月亮能量。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME feels threatened, its body begins to sweat a poisonous fluid that repels predators. It usually emerges at night to absorb the lunar energy it needs to grow stronger.

entry: POKENAME的身心似乎都受月相影响。满月时，它聪明得惊人，还能从身上花纹释放强烈的月光束。
author: sk372
source: Both POKENAME's mind and body seem to be affected by the phases of the moon. When the moon is full, it exhibits incredible intelligence and can utilize intense beams of moonlight from the marks on its body.

entry: POKENAME中央周围的金环，以催眠般的方式旋转。据说盯得够久，就会被命令服从它的意愿。
author: camtft
source: The golden rings around the center of POKENAME swirl in a hypnotizing fashion. It is said that those who glance into the rings for long enough will be commanded to do POKENAME's bidding.

entry: POKENAME白天练习读取波导，午夜才训练战斗，极少有人见过。目击者说，它的格斗动作让人想起不同的月相。
author: patch01774
source: POKENAME spends the daylight hours practicing its aura reading abilities. Its battle training takes place at midnight, which very few people have seen. Witnesses have stated that its fighting movements are reminiscent of the different moon phases.

entry: 哪怕最微弱的月光，也会让POKENAME身上黄色部位发光，因此它在新月之夜捕猎最多。其他夜晚，敏捷身手也让猎物只见刀刃微光，就已倒下。
author: sk372
source: Because the yellow parts of its body glow with even the faintest of moonlight, POKENAME hunts the most during new moon nights. Even during other nights, its agility means prey only sees the faint glimmer of its blades before they're taken down.

entry: POKENAME背上的花，需要月光才能绽放、存活。因此，只有夜里才能看见它，花朵也在月色中泛着微光。
author: patch
source: The flower on POKENAME's back requires moonlight to blossom and stay alive. Because of this, POKENAME can only be seen at night, where this flower glimmers in the moonlight.

entry: POKENAME守护熟睡的尼多兰和尼多朗幼崽，整夜警戒，让天敌无法靠近。实验室会合成黑色尖刺里的毒素，制成强力除草剂。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME watches over sleeping Nidoran pups, keeping every predator at bay through a vigil that lasts all night long. The toxins within its black spines are synthesized in laboratories to create powerful herbicides.

entry: POKENAME的颚强得能咬穿钢梁。必要时，还能用精神力量把对手举进嘴里。
author: fluttershy0471
source: POKENAME's jaw are strong enough to bite through steel beams. POKENAME is able to lift its opponents into said jaws with psychic powers if necessary.

entry: POKENAME的圆环和卷须在黑暗中灿烂发光。尾部条纹的配色，让它很受非二元性别训练家欢迎。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's rings and tendrils glow brilliantly in the dark. The colors of its tail stripes has made it popular with nonbinary Trainers.

entry: 许多洞窟壁画上都画着这种宝可梦。它很久以前曾受人敬奉，或许因为形似月亮。
author: notsaying.
source: This Pokémon is seen in many cave paintings. It was worshipped long ago, likely due to its resemblance to the moon.

entry: 野生POKENAME整天睡在黑暗洞里，夜幕一落便出门，在林中纹丝不动、悄无声息，等猎物进入范围，再突然抓住。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME sleep in dark caves all day. They wake up and head out as night falls, then stand completely still and silent in forests, waiting for prey to come within reach to suddenly seize it.

entry: POKENAME靠深色鳞片完美藏进阴影，悄悄跟随特定生物，以强力摔击彻底消除威胁，再于被发现前藏好。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME melt into the shadows, perfectly hidden by their dark scales. They have taken to stalking specific creatures, completely destroying threats to them with powerful slams, then hiding before being noticed.

entry: POKENAME仁慈乐善，将森林里迷路的孩子引到安全处。若察觉孩子怕黑，便用圆环照亮前路。
author: dodoowner_
source: Benevolent and charitable, POKENAME guides children lost in the forest to safety. If it senses a child is afraid of the dark, it will illuminate up the path ahead with the rings on its body.

entry: 围绕POKENAME有许多神话传说，真假与迷信却很难分清。它常出现在灾难现场，吸收负面情绪的能量，用途尚不明确。
author: thordemidgard
source: Many myths and legends surround POKENAME, but separating those that are true from the mere superstitions is a difficult task. They frequent catastrophic events and consume the energy from negative emotions, although what they use it for is unclear.

entry: 民间传说，月食下见到POKENAME是毁灭的凶兆。可它只在人类遇险时靠近，用金色花纹的光驱退潜伏威胁。
author: fiordaliso
source: Folklore holds that seeing POKENAME beneath a lunar eclipse is an omen of ruin. Despite this, it approaches humans only in times of danger, using the light of its golden markings to repel lurking threats.

entry: POKENAME夜里最活跃，迅速破海前进，捕食小鱼。冲出水面时，圆环吸收月光，明亮闪耀。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is most active at night, cutting through the sea rapidly and hunting small fish. When it breaches the water's surface, its rings glow brightly as they absorb the moonlight.

entry: POKENAME的力量似乎与月相相连，满月高悬时最强。圆环能制造发光的圈，将其他生命强行传送到远方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's powers appear tied to the phase of the moon, showing its strongest capabilities when the full moon hangs high in the sky. The rings on its body can generate glowing circles that can forcibly teleport others far distances.

entry: POKENAME在撞击区附近睡到夜幕。流星落下时惊醒，替大地挡住毁灭性撞击。坠落的小陨星常到它巨大、月亮般的壳上避难。
author: bluenido.
source: POKENAME sleep near impact zones until nightfall. Awakened by falling meteors, they shield the land from devastating strikes. Fallen Minior often seek refuge on their massive, moonlike shells.

entry: POKENAME四处寻找卷心菜和花椰菜吃。在它附近睡着的人，说会梦见可怕的大混战。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME travel around seeking to eat heads of cabbage and cauliflower. Those that fall asleep near POKENAME report having dreams of a frightening battle royale.

entry: 建筑工人常被警告，别借POKENAME的磁力吊重物。稍一分心，就可能发现它已带着财物，逃进夜色。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: Construction crews are often warned against using POKENAME's magnetism to lift heavy objects. If their attention is turned elsewhere, they may soon discover that POKENAME fled into the night with their belongings.

entry: 与伊剑鞘的其他进化形态不同，POKENAME不喜欢被握在手里，而是躲在暗处，默默保护训练家。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Unlike its fellow Eevedge evolutions, POKENAME doesn't like being held. It instead protects its Trainer from the shadows.

entry: 与伊剑鞘的其他进化形态不同，POKENAME不喜欢被握在手里，而是躲在暗处，默默保护训练家。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Unlike its fellow Eevedge evolutions, POKENAME doesn't like being held. It instead protects its Trainer from the shadows.

entry: POKENAME从盾上的三个圆环放出黄光，涌遍灵体屏障。谁想近身攻击，它就从盾里喷出毒汗反击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME radiates yellow light from the three rings on its shield that surges throughout its spectral barrier. It ejects a poisonous sweat from its shield to counterattack anyone who tries to physically attack it.

entry: POKENAME藏在夜色掩护中，暗用力量操控人和宝可梦替它办事。阴谋论者相信，如今真正控制各国政府的，就是它们。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME use their powers to secretly manipulate people and Pokémon to do their deeds while hiding under the covers of darkness. Conspiracy theorists believe that these Pokémon are the ones who actually control our governments today.

entry: POKENAME是沉默的战士，据说已掌握古代城都的格斗术。它们对训练家忠心耿耿，潜伏暗处，趁敌人最不设防时，打出决定性的一击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are silent warriors that are said to have mastered fighting techniques from ancient Johto. They are fiercely loyal to their Trainers, operating in the shadows to deliver decisive blows to their opponents when they least expect it.

entry: POKENAME跃过夜空，头顶刀刃宛如弯月。它们投出金色光环惊扰目标，再从光环映出的阴影里，无声挥刃袭击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME leap through the night sky, the blades on their heads resembling the crescent moon. They project rings of golden light to surprise their targets, silently striking with their blades from the shadows they cast.

entry: POKENAME启发了好几位漫画反派。尽管如此，它性情温和，只有受到威胁才攻击。
author: ferdirenz
source: POKENAME has been the inspiration for several comic book villains. Despite that, it is a mild-mannered Pokémon and only attacks when threatened.

entry: 吸足月光后，POKENAME的圆环比黄金更闪耀。它能完美融入黑暗，用带电咬击捕捉猎物。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it absorbs enough moonlight, the rings on its body shine brighter than gold. POKENAME can blend perfectly into the darkness and catch its prey with electrified bites.

entry: 月光影响POKENAME的心情，月相越圆，就越想打。吼声响如雷鸣，隔着许多英里也能听见。
author: fiordaliso
source: Moonlight can influence POKENAME's mood, making it increasingly eager to fight the fuller the moon is. Its roars are as loud as thunder and can be heard from many miles away.

entry: 月光影响POKENAME的心情，月相越圆，就越想打。吼声响如雷鸣，隔着许多英里也能听见。
author: fiordaliso
source: Moonlight can influence POKENAME's mood, making it increasingly eager to fight the fuller the moon is. Its roars are as loud as thunder and can be heard from many miles away.

entry: POKENAME能将月光转成能量，增强电击。满月时，甚至能产生磁场，让自己飘浮。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can convert moonlight into energy to strengthen its electrical attacks. During a full moon, this Pokémon can even generate a magnetic field that allows it to levitate.

entry: POKENAME能将月光转成能量，增强电击。满月时，甚至能产生磁场，让自己飘浮。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can convert moonlight into energy to strengthen its electrical attacks. During a full moon, this Pokémon can even generate a magnetic field that allows it to levitate.

entry: 它的铠甲由璀璨的月岩琢出棱面。战斗中，甲胄若泛起光芒，便是POKENAME正在引导神秘的月之力。
author: nellnast42
source: Its armor is faceted from a brilliant moon rock. When the armor glows in battle, POKENAME is channeling a mysterious lunar power.

entry: POKENAME用角吸收月光，直到金纹亮得像熔融金属。谁威胁训练家，它便以强壮身躯的全部力量，向前猛扑。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME absorbs moonlight with its horns until its golden markings gleam like molten metal. If someone threatens its Trainer, it lunges forward with all the strength in its formidable frame.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME通过角收集月亮能量，身上的金带稳定发光。训练家遇险，它就迎头冲去，释放强壮身体的全部力量。
author: fiordaliso
source: At night, POKENAME gathers lunar energy through its horns, causing the golden bands on its body to shine steadily. If its Trainer is endangered, it charges headlong, unleashing the full force of its powerful body.

entry: POKENAME住在最深的湖底，难得现身。据说白天见到的人，会为美丽而倾倒；夜里见到的人，却会吓得动弹不得。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME lives at the bottom of the deepest lakes. Those who see the elusive Pokémon during the daytime are said to be overwhelmed with its beauty; those who see it at night are said to freeze in horror.

entry: POKENAME夜间活动，靠月光获取能量。它快速闪动金纹、转动齿轮，向同类警告危险。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is nocturnal, gathering energy from moonlight.  When it rapidly flickers the golden markings and spins its gears rapidly, it alerts others of its kind of danger.

entry: POKENAME圆环散出的光，连最烦乱的心灵也能安抚。它与训练家羁绊极深，保护对方甚至成为生命中唯一重要的事。
author: fiordaliso
source: The light radiating from the rings on POKENAME's body has the power to calm even the most troubled soul. This Pokémon bonds deeply with its Trainer, to the point that protecting them becomes the only priority that matters in its life.

entry: 传说POKENAME是暮色森林里蒙羞的守护者。故事说，它力量太强，吓跑了所有想保护的宝可梦，最终家园也衰败了。
author: mepp.
source: Spoken in legends, POKENAME are disgraced guardians of dusky forests. The story goes that due to their immense power, they scared off every Pokémon they sought to protect, leading their home to ruin.

entry: POKENAME通过遍身的环状面板吸收月光，为炮供能。满月下战斗，只要月光一直照着，就能无限地以最大威力开炮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cannon is powered by moonlight absorbed through the ring panels across its body. Fighting during the full moon allows it to fire its weapon at maximum level indefinitely as long as the moonbeams are on it.

entry: POKENAME满月之夜最活跃，会与其他皮皮争夺最好的赏月位置，最后难免打起来。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are most active on nights of the full moon. They will quarrel with other Clefairy over the best viewing spots on these nights, and a clash will inevitably ensue.

entry: POKENAME想藏进夜色，花朵的微光却常暴露位置。不过它仍是称职的猎手，靠强毒轻易就能放倒猎物。
author: quantumradiation
source: POKENAME attempts to hide in the darkness of the night, but the faint glow of its flowers often gives it away. Despite that, POKENAME is still a competent hunter and has no issue taking down its prey with its powerful poisons.

entry: POKENAME尽量朝月亮飘近，升入极高的大气层，直到气压不足，让身体瘪下去，再掉回地面。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME float up as close as they can to the moon. They rise incredibly far into the atmosphere until the lack of air pressure causes them to deflate and fall back down to earth.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在全黑中战斗，唯一可见的光来自身上圆环。许多对手只见一闪亮光，就已挨上数记强劲踢击。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME prefers to battle in complete darkness, where the only visible light shines from the rings on its body. Many opponents only see a brief flashing light before POKENAME lands several powerful kicks on them.

entry: POKENAME先释放催眠孢子，再从阴影中攻击。它始终隐蔽，一边消耗对手，一边在黑暗中恢复。
author: hermsmegerms
source: POKENAME releases sleep-inducing spores before striking from the shadows. It remains hidden as it wears down opponents and recovers in the dark.

entry: 夜里静坐赏月，对POKENAME及同族是很重要的仪式。新月时，小皮皮和皮宝宝会围着它发光的花纹、尾巴，感受类似赏月的效果。
author: opossiblymage
source: Sitting and observing the moon at night is a very important ritual to POKENAME and its kin. When the new moon is out, small Clefairy and Cleffa will gather around the radiant light of this Pokémon's markings and tail to get a similar effect.

entry: POKENAME随风漂泊，到家里留下棉花恶作剧，边做边咯咯笑。它多在夜里活动，早晨晒太阳休息，让棉花再生；若被打湿，却会变弱。
author: jonclyd
source: POKENAME lives a nomadic life, drifting on the wind and causing mischief by leaving cotton in homes, giggling as it does so. Mostly active at night, it rests in the morning sun to regrow its cotton, though it weakens if it gets wet.

entry: 有些古代文化，将POKENAME视为神圣。至今，它仍徘徊于他们的墓地，诅咒擅闯之人。
author: cadyrocks
source: POKENAME was seen as sacred by certain ancient cultures. To this day, it haunts their tombs, placing its curse on trespassers.

entry: POKENAME用头上稀有的月亮徽记引来盗贼，再困进身体，用毒汗淹死，随后丢弃尸体。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME lures thieves with the rare moon emblem on its head before trapping them in its body. Once they are trapped, it drowns them in poisonous sweat before discarding their bodies.

entry: POKENAME藏在阴暗角落，用黄环作套索，套住路过的无防备猎物。棺门一开，身体便会喷出毒汗。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME hides inside of dark corners and uses its yellow rings to lasso unsuspecting prey that pass by. Poisonous sweat will burst from its body if it opens its coffin door.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME的网因电能而明亮发光。它只在夜里捕猎，用强烈毒液麻痹猎物。
author: mistymagius
source: During a full moon, POKENAME's web glows brightly with electrical energy. It hunts exclusively at nighttime, using its powerful venom to paralyze its prey.

entry: 无月之夜，POKENAME会找高处发光，吸引最爱的猎物——蛾类宝可梦。
author: wigglypon
source: On moonless nights, POKENAME will find a high vantage point and shine its lights. This attracts moth Pokémon, POKENAME's most-preferred prey.

entry: POKENAME只在繁星满天、夜空澄澈的时候现身。传说，若看见它在满月下起舞，往后数年都会好运相随。
author: cpnquacken
source: POKENAME only appear during nights when the stars are plenty and the sky is unobstructed. Steeped in legend, it is said that seeing one dancing under the full moon would bring you good fortune for years to come.

entry: POKENAME只在夜里月亮最高时上岸，把内脏排出体外，晒月光获取能量，新月形花纹也随之明亮闪耀。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME only breaches onto land at night when the moon is highest in the sky. It expels its innards to expose them to moonlight it absorbs for energy, its crescent markings glowing bright as it does so.

entry: POKENAME吸收月光维生，能量全满后，黄环就会发亮。夜里，它唱歌、奏起舒缓音乐，帮训练家入睡。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME absorb moonlight to fuel themselves, the yellow rings on their bodies glowing once fully charged. At night, they will sing and play soothing music to help their Trainers fall asleep.

entry: 狩猎时，POKENAME借月下的阴影掩护伏击。能力只在夜里发挥作用，它便从天明一直睡到日落。
author: nellnast42
source: When hunting, POKENAME utilizes the moon's shadow to disguise its ambushes. Since its abilities are strictly nocturnal, it sleeps from dawn till dusk.

entry: POKENAME是无声的猎手，统领晨昏天空。暗羽吸收光，使它满月下也几乎隐形，被认为是最致命的猎手之一。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME is a silent hunter that rules the skies at dusk and dawn. Its dark plumage absorbs light, making it appear almost invisible during a full moon. POKENAME is considered one of the deadliest hunters.

entry: POKENAME平时十分害羞，不是躲着其他生命，就是想吓退对方。靠近朋友时，黄环会在暗中微微发光，含蓄地表达喜爱。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME is usually a really shy Pokémon that hides from others or tries to scare them. When it is close to a friend, its yellow rings glow a little bit in the dark as a subtle way to show its affection.

entry: POKENAME腿和尾巴上的金带，用来抑制力量。它年幼又没经验，没有金带可能控制不住能力，无意伤到自己和其他生命。
author: distinguishedmanlygentleman
source: The golden bands on POKENAME's legs and tail act as inhibitors for its power. Due to its youth and inexperience, POKENAME may not be able to control its abilities without the bands, unintentionally injuring itself and others.

entry: 夜幕降临，POKENAME九条尾巴上的圆环，会按当前月相发光。体内的火让毛始终全干，雨天也不例外。
author: fiordaliso
source: When night falls, the rings on POKENAME's nine tails glow according to the current moon phase. The fire within its body keeps its fur completely dry, even during rainy days.

entry: 随着月相渐满，POKENAME的花纹越来越亮。满月时，隔着数英里也能看见。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: On each progressing stage of the moon, POKENAME's markings shine brighter. On full moons, they shine so brightly that they can be seen from miles away.

entry: POKENAME调皮地在篮球场蹦来蹦去，鼓动球员抓它，打乱比赛。有些休闲玩家喜欢这份混乱，乐意让它加入。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME mischievously disrupts basketball games by bouncing all over the court and encouraging players to catch it. Some casual players enjoy this chaotic element and will happily include POKENAME in their games.

entry: 据说POKENAME的壳，是月亮气息的结晶。它与许多洞穴宝可梦为友，让圆环发光，再借壳反射，即使最黑的洞里也能提供月光。
author: sara886a
source: It is said that POKENAME's shell is a crystallized manifestation of the moon's aura. A friend to many cave Pokémon, POKENAME is able to make the rings on its body glow, bouncing light off its shell to provide moonlight even in the darkest caverns.

entry: POKENAME每晚月下冥想，储存能量、增强力量。嘴里吐出小火苗时，这番用力会让全身金环明亮发光。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME meditates every night under the moonlight to store its energy and become stronger. When it exhales small flames from its mouth, the effort makes the golden rings across its body glow brightly.

entry: 被睡着的人抱着时，POKENAME圆环会柔和发光。父母说是为了安慰怕黑的孩子，其实它想显得凶险，吓退天敌。
author: soup1900
source: The rings of POKENAME glow softly when held by someone asleep. Though parents say they do it to comfort children afraid of the dark, they truly glow so they can make themselves look ominous and scare predators away.

entry: POKENAME白天留在地面，只有夜里飞起。远远看去，身上的光环让它像一颗星。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME remains on the ground during the day, and only flies up at night. From a distance, the glowing rings on its body make it look like a star.

entry: POKENAME每逢满月脱毛，几天内重新长好。黄色的毛因此成了夜光服装的可持续原料。
author: turcai_87271
source: POKENAME's fur is shed every full moon and regrows in a matter of days. The yellow fur is utilized for the production of sustainable glow-in-the-dark clothing.

entry: POKENAME吸收月之石释放的能量，闪烁如夜空。这给了它天然的夜间伪装，成为危险的伏击猎手。
author: deniablecredibility
source: POKENAME absorbs the energy given off by Moon Stones, causing it to shimmer like the night sky. This gives it natural camouflage at night, making it a dangerous ambush hunter.

entry: POKENAME夜里在沙地游走捕猎。感到威胁，就闪动金环，晃花敌人的眼，再将其吓退。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME prowls the sandy lands during the night hours to hunt its prey. When it feels threatened, it flashes the golden rings on its body to blind its enemies and scare them away.

entry: POKENAME体型小、尚未成熟，却仍努力表现得独立高傲。明月下，獠牙闪耀着令人敬畏的力量。
author: bobosmith01
source: A small and immature Pokémon, POKENAME still tries to act independent and prideful. Under the glittering moon, POKENAME's tusks glow with awesome power.

entry: POKENAME夜视能力强，月亮亮起的部分超过一半时，才会出现在洞穴外。因此，每月只有某些时段较容易见到野生个体。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME possesses powerful night vision. When the moon is over halfway full, it can be spotted outside its cavern home. This means seeing wild POKENAME is most common only in certain parts of the month.

entry: POKENAME感到威胁，会从毛里射出有毒、带火的火花，造成远比普通烧伤更可怕的剧痛。
author: kittyluv090
source: If POKENAME feels threatened, it shoots toxic, fiery sparks from its fur that cause horrendous pain, much more than that experienced from a normal burn.

entry: POKENAME的身体由坚硬的黑色外壳保护，能完美融入黑暗。向敌人冲锋前，它会先让甲壳上的圆环亮起光芒，为自己占得优势。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body is protected by a hard black shell that allows it to camouflage perfectly in the darkness. Just before charging at an enemy, it makes the rings on its armored carapace glow, to have an advantage against them.

entry: 坚硬黑壳保护POKENAME，让它完美融入黑暗。向敌人冲锋前，它会让甲壳圆环发光，取得战斗优势。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its body is protected by a hard black shell that allows it to blend perfectly into the darkness. Just before charging at an enemy, POKENAME causes the rings on its armored carapace to glow, giving it an advantage in battle.

entry: POKENAME以惊人速度穿过夜色追猎，抓到后便用尖刺里的毒结果对方。满月时，身体的圆圈闪亮，更显威严可怕。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME darts through the night at incredible speeds to pursue its prey. Once caught, it finishes them off with the poison in its quills. When the moon is full, the circles on its body shine, giving it an even more majestic and fearsome appearance.

entry: POKENAME虽然蒙着眼，却是舞蹈高手，以优雅动作闻名。许多宝可梦都找它请教舞步。
author: chaotic_aspergers
source: Despite its blindfold, POKENAME is an excellent dancer known for its graceful moves. Many Pokémon look to POKENAME for tips on how to dance.

entry: 古老神话将POKENAME描述为审判之灵，称它曾有锐利金眼，亮得如同羽毛。它极难寻见，只生活在暗林深处。
author: mepp.
source: Ancient myths describe POKENAME as a spirit of judgement, claiming they once had piercing golden eyes that shone just as bright as their feathers. They are highly elusive Pokémon, only living deep within dark forests.

entry: 月光下，POKENAME身上的环纹会发亮，反而暴露了行踪。不过它快得惊人，猎物察觉时，往往已逃不掉了。
author: glacierwing
source: POKENAME's rings glow under moonlight, unfortunately alerting prey to its presence. However, this Pokémon is so fast, it's often too late for them to escape.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME翱翔天空，让下方地面陷入黑暗。它将月亮能量存在圆环里，用来发射强力能量光束。
author: mistymagius
source: During the full moon, POKENAME soars across the sky, shrouding the ground below it in darkness. It stores the moon's energy in its rings, which it uses to fire powerful energy beams.

entry: POKENAME走到哪，就留下一道黑黏液。黏液白天漆黑，月光下却微微发亮。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME leaves a trail of black slime wherever it goes. The slime is pitch black during the day but glows faintly under moonlight.

entry: POKENAME身体吸收月光，维持生命，甚至修复损伤。额头圆环能将浓缩月光化为高能射线发出。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body absorbs moonlight, using it to sustain itself and even repair damage taken. The ring on its forehead can fire high-powered energy rays composed of concentrated moonbeams.

entry: POKENAME能在头顶一小片区域投映夜空。靠这份本领，它很受初为父母的人欢迎，用来哄孩子睡觉。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME are capable of projecting a recreation of the night sky in a small area overhead. Using this projection, they have become popular with new parents for putting their children to sleep.

entry: POKENAME只在夜间活动，满月时似乎更活跃。投入战斗，身上的圆环便明亮发光。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is exclusively nocturnal, but it seems to be more active on full moons. The rings on its body glow brightly when it's locked in combat.

entry: 水池里的暗斑，可能是POKENAME静伏水下。倒霉猎物一游过，就会遭到偷袭，被紧紧勒住、拖入深处。
author: soup1900
source: Dark spots inside pools of water could actually be an POKENAME lying silently under the surface. The unfortunate prey who swim in these waters are sneak attacked and strangled as they get dragged down below.

entry: POKENAME用光环引诱沙漠旅人偏离道路，带着绕圈，直到累得不能动。可若日出先于旅人倒下，它就会逃走。
author: deelee2020
source: POKENAME use their glowing rings to lure desert travelers off the path. The travelers are led in circles until they become too exhausted to move - but if sunrise comes before they collapse, POKENAME will flee.

entry: POKENAME的孢子与身上黄带由同一种物质构成。夜里，成团孢子发光，照亮它在暗中漫游的路。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce spores which are made of the same substance that comprise the yellow bands across their body. At night, clouds of spores light the way for POKENAME to wander in the dark.

entry: 粉丝单方面建立的亲密关系，严重困扰着POKENAME。如今它只在深夜独自歌唱，听过的人说，那是慢节奏音乐。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME has been greatly impacted by the parasocial relationships of its fans in negative ways; it now only sings late at night in isolation. Those who have heard it claim it sings downtempo music.

entry: POKENAME唱着著名夜曲，唤起夜晚的意象。阴影般的动作平静，略带忧郁，观众却始终被那份热情吸引。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sing the melodies of famous nocturnes that inspire imagery of the night. Their shadowy movements can be tranquil and somewhat gloomy, but audiences are captivated by their passion regardless.

entry: POKENAME在月夜迅速飞行，身后拖着点点碎光，映着月色闪耀。若歇在你家上方，睡梦就会充满繁星点点的美丽天空。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME zips rapidly through the air on moonlight nights, trailing sparkles that catch the moonbeams behind it. If it rests above one's home, your sleep will be filled with beautiful dreams featuring star-filled skies.

entry: POKENAME虽然无毒，身体却模仿其他有毒海洋生物的花纹。不过，它的咬击仍可能致命。
author: frokachu
source: Despite not being poisonous, POKENAME's body mimics the toxic patterns of other poisonous sea life. Its bite can still be lethal, however.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇会在黑暗中发光，释放的小团孢子也一样。微风一吹散，便形成美丽光景。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have mushrooms on their back that glow in the dark. The spores that they release in small clouds also glow in the dark and produce a beautiful display of light when a breeze scatters the spores.

entry: POKENAME白天在海底洞穴冥想，夜里出来。满月之夜则会上岸晒月亮，似乎能增强力量。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME spends its time meditating in undersea caves during the day, but will emerge at night. During nights with a full moon, however, it will come ashore to bask in the moonlight, which seems to increase its power.

entry: 这种宝可梦夜间活动，深色皮肤吸收月光，再将能量导入双臂，用于攻击。若被打败，就退进阴影，迅速消失在周围密叶中。
author: fireblade141
source: This Pokémon is nocturnal. Its dark skin allows it to absorb moonlight, and it channels this energy into its arms for offensive purposes. If defeated, it will retreat into the shadows, quickly disappearing into the dense foliage around it.

entry: POKENAME触角和环状的毛在暗中发亮，足以引来巴大蝶。因为长着复眼，训练家无论站在哪，都觉得它正直盯着自己。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME's antennae and fur ring glow so well in the dark they attract Butterfree. Due to its compound eyes, regardless of where a Trainer stands it appears to be staring right at them.

entry: POKENAME身体坚实，连职业球员的冲撞也能承受。无月的黑夜里，它会指导球队，场上只有自身圆环的光。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME's sturdy body allows it to withstand tackles from professional football players. It coaches teams on dark, moonless nights where the only lights come from its own rings.

entry: 诅咒让POKENAME能感知周围生命的意图。它惩罚恶意，通过手杖集中精神力量，击溃目标心智；纯洁的意图则得到守护咒的回报。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME are cursed to be able to sense the intentions of surrounding creatures. They punish malice, focusing their psychic might through staves and breaking the target's psyche. Pure intent is rewarded with protective spells.

entry: POKENAME用手杖吸收月光能量，增强精神火焰。它行事审慎负责，只为保护暴力受害者而战。
author: fiordaliso
source: With its staff, POKENAME can absorb energy from moonlight to empower its psychic flames. It is a highly measured and conscientious Pokémon that fights only to protect those who fall victim to violent aggression.

entry: POKENAME能将黑暗化成月牙，用作弹丸。它藏在暗处，伏击附近经过的猎物。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME can create crescents out of darkness that it uses as projectiles. POKENAME hides in dark places and ambushes prey that pass nearby.

entry: POKENAME在壳里燃烧月之石供能。不知为何，夜里石头烧得效率更高，让它的力量、耐力都远胜平时。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME burns Moon Stones inside its shell for energy. During the night, these stones, for some strange reason, burn more efficiently, giving POKENAME way more strength and stamina than usual.

entry: 夜幕降临，POKENAME展开美丽翅膀优雅翱翔，身后留下一道闪亮金粉。感到威胁，就从嘴里呼出毒孢子，阻止敌人靠近。
author: fiordaliso
source: When night falls, POKENAME soars gracefully on its beautiful wings, leaving behind a trail of golden, glittering dust. If it feels threatened, it exhales poisonous spores from its mouth to keep enemies at bay.

entry: POKENAME产生酸甜的粉末，糖果师会掺进配方。酸度随饮食改变，因此糖果师会控制它吃什么，保持风味一致。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produces a sweet yet tart powder that candy confectioners mix into their recipes. Its diet influences the level of tartness in the powder, so candy confectioners control its diet to ensure consistency.

entry: POKENAME生活在暗巷和废仓库，能听见它们沙哑地合唱。松垮毛发最白、最闪亮的那只，就是团伙首领。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME live in dark alleys and abandoned warehouses, where they can be heard singing together, raspy and all. The POKENAME with the whitest, most glistening saggy fur among them is their gang leader.

entry: POKENAME能操纵宽松皮肤隐形，主要用来在城市捣乱。近来，朋克和金属乐队会收留它，既是随团粉丝，也当现场乐手。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME can manipulate its baggy skin to turn invisible, which is mostly used to cause a ruckus around urban areas. Lately, punk and metal bands have been adopting it as both a groupie and live band member.

entry: 夜幕降临，POKENAME展开美丽翅膀优雅翱翔，身后留下一道闪亮金粉。感到威胁，就从嘴里呼出毒孢子，阻止敌人靠近。
author: fiordaliso
source: When night falls, POKENAME soars gracefully on its beautiful wings, leaving behind a trail of golden, glittering dust. If it feels threatened, it exhales poisonous spores from its mouth to keep enemies at bay.

entry: 这些夜行宝可梦用爪与火焰，在洞壁和山侧开巢。满月时精力充沛，攻击性会大幅增强。
author: infinex21
source: These nocturnal Pokémon use their claws and their flames to create nests within cave walls and the sides of mountains. When the moon is full, they brim with energy and become much more aggressive.

entry: POKENAME的金色晶体在月下美丽放光。迷信说法认为，这些晶体能驱赶恶灵。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's golden crystals radiate beautifully when under the light of the moon. Superstition claims that these crystals have the power to ward away evil spirits.

entry: POKENAME只在深夜将三个头探出地面，吸收月亮能量。新月时，三个头就不再和睦，什么事都能吵起来。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME pokes its three heads out of the ground only to absorb the moon's energy in the dead of night. During the new moon, the three heads stop getting along and start arguing over absolutely everything.

entry: 某些古文明将POKENAME奉为神圣生物，只有王族后裔才能养作宠物。许多平民献上贡品，盼得祝福。
author: sk372
source: In certain ancient civilizations, POKENAME was worshiped as a divine creature. Only those of royal descent were allowed to keep one as a pet, and many commoners gave tribute in hopes of being granted a blessing.

entry: 沐浴月光，POKENAME的头痛就会消失，变得格外专注、警觉。可白天的偏头痛让它连简单事也做不了，只好尽量睡觉。
author: fiordaliso
source: When bathed in moonlight, its headaches vanish, allowing POKENAME to become remarkably focused and alert. During the day, however, its migraines render it unable to perform even simple tasks, so it sleeps as much as possible.

entry: POKENAME以战斗时夸张华丽的登场闻名。可惜同样出名的，还有被自己披风绊倒、脸朝地摔晕的场面。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are famous for their dramatic entrances to battles. Unfortunately, they are also famous for tripping on their capes and knocking themselves out when they faceplant onto the ground.

entry: POKENAME圆环夜里发光，新月之夜尤其明亮，常引来其他宝可梦，探查这奇怪的光。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have rings on their body that glow at night and shine particularly bright on nights of the new moon. They often draw the attention of other Pokémon who come to investigate the strange light.

entry: POKENAME先让圆环明亮发光，晃花对手的眼，再挥出强拳。新月时会失控，完全被怒气吞没，连训练家也毫不犹豫地攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: It makes the rings on its body shine brightly to blind its opponents before striking them with powerful punches. During the new moon, POKENAME loses control and is consumed by rage, becoming willing to attack even its own Trainer without hesitation.

entry: POKENAME忠诚极了，为保护训练家什么都愿做。口吐火焰时，威严的金鬃会亮得如同夜空的月亮。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an intensely loyal creature, willing to do anything to protect its Trainer. When it breathes flames from its jaws, its majestic golden mane shines as bright as the moon in the night sky.

entry: 月亮可见的夜晚，它们的尾焰、符号和翅膀会明亮发光。月光似乎也赋予强大力量，让火焰几乎能熔穿一切材料。
author: infinex21
source: The tail flames, symbols, and wings of these Pokémon shine bright on nights where the moon is visible. Moonlight seems to fill it with great power as well, as its flames can melt through nearly any material on moonlit nights.

entry: POKENAME腹部发光的螺旋，连强大的超能力者也会立即被迷住。许多诗人将它比作满月。
author: t3isukone
source: The luminous spiral on POKENAME's stomach immediately entrances even powerful Psychics. Many poets have compared it to the full moon.

entry: 不管睡了多久，月亮一升起，POKENAME就睁眼。有人说，它的毛比夜还黑，只能在攻击前，靠圆纹诡异发光才看见。
author: ghostslythe
source: Regardless of how long POKENAME sleeps, its eyes open when the moon rises. Some say its fur is darker than night, and it can only be seen when its circle patterns glow eerily before an attack.

entry: POKENAME用精神力量制造幻象，仿佛融入周围阴影。据说满月之夜，精神能力会变成三倍。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is able to cast illusions with its mental powers, making it seem to blend in with the shadows around it. It's said that its psychic capacity triples during nights of the full moon.

entry: 过去，城都人在后来成为缘朱市的地方举行仪式，曾用到POKENAME。道馆里不自然的黑暗，被认为与它有关。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME were used in old Johtonian rituals in what would become Ecruteak City. The nature of the gym's unnatural darkness is attributed to POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME展示肌肉时，毛上的圆纹就会发光。它花太多时间摆姿势，因此在暗处很容易看见。
author: mellowmuse
source: When POKENAME flexes, the circular patterns on its fur begin to glow. Since they spend so much time flexing, they're easily spotted in dark locations.

entry: 毒汗让它的火焰呈蓝色，连水也浇不灭。它总想打架，却从不攻击弱者或伤者。夜里咆哮，金色符号便明亮闪耀。
author: infinex21
source: Its flames burn blue due to its poisonous sweat. Its flames cannot be extinguished with water as a result. It is always seeking fights, though it will never attack a weaker foe or the injured. When it roars at night, its golden symbols shine bright.

entry: POKENAME夜里沿河巡游，确认岸边无人遇险。吸足月光后，它让壳发光，晃花对手的眼。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME roams along the rivers at night to make sure no one is in danger along the banks. It blinds its opponents by making its shell glow after absorbing plenty of moonlight.

entry: POKENAME漂在海面，夜里用明黄色的生物闪光，与远方同类交流。闪烁频率和亮度各有含义，研究者正试图解读。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME drifts on the ocean surface, communicating with one another over long distances at night with bright yellow bioluminescent flashes. The frequency and brightness of the flashes hold specific meanings that researchers are trying to determine.

entry: POKENAME夜里浮在海面，黄环和球吸收月光，明亮发光。它制造纯粹阴影构成的触手，把猎物拖向底部实体触手遮住的真正嘴巴。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME floats on the ocean surface at night, with its yellow rings and orbs glowing brightly as it absorbs moonlight. It conjures tentacles of pure shadow which it uses to drag prey to its true mouth, hidden by the physical tentacles at its base.

entry: POKENAME用金环照路，为山中隧道里迷路的探险者指引。它能感知岩中藏着的月之石，是矿工的宝贵伙伴。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME guides explorers lost in mountain tunnels by lighting their way with its golden rings. It can sense Moon Stones hidden in the rock, making it a valuable ally for miners.

entry: POKENAME的身体由月球上也能找到的同种岩石构成。即便如此，它仍无法让其他宝可梦进化。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME's body is composed of the same rocks that can be found on the moon. Despite this, it is unable to cause other Pokémon to evolve.

entry: POKENAME爱吃年糕。有些地区认为，是年糕与月亮的文化联系所致；也有人觉得，它只是觉得好吃。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME loves mochi. Certain regions believe the cause is due to the cultural ties mochi has to the moon, while others believe it's just a tasty snack.

entry: POKENAME的火焰颜色很暗，月亮可见的夜晚才会明亮起来。身上花纹夜里也发光，让它小跑过空地时，稍稍露出身影。
author: infinex21
source: An POKENAME's flames are rather dark but will light up at night when the moon is visible. Their body markings glow at night as well, making them slightly visible when they trot through open fields at night.

entry: POKENAME站在月下，天幕般的鬃毛旋转，闪着点点星光。摩鲁蛾常来打扰它。
author: periperi_chicken
source: When POKENAME stands beneath the moon, its celestial mane swirls and glistens with twinkling stars. It is frequently bothered by Venomoth.

entry: POKENAME夜里沿河巡游，确认岸边无人遇险。吸足月光后，它让壳发光，晃花对手的眼。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME roams along the rivers at night to make sure no one is in danger along the banks. It blinds its opponents by making its shell glow after absorbing plenty of moonlight.

entry: POKENAME夜里沿河巡游，确认岸边无人遇险。吸足月光后，它让壳发光，晃花对手的眼。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME roams along the rivers at night to make sure no one is in danger along the banks. It blinds its opponents by making its shell glow after absorbing plenty of moonlight.

entry: POKENAME有根特殊短棒，夜里能吸收月亮能量。新月之夜，短棒便会明亮发光，照亮黑夜。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a special baton that draws in lunar energy at night. During nights of the new moon, the baton shines brightly to give illumination in the dark night.

entry: POKENAME歇在浮冰上吸收月光，再潜回栖居的水域。它吃一种入侵藻类，对保持海底洁净至关重要。
author: fiordaliso
source: It rests on floating ice platforms to absorb the moonlight before diving back into the waters where it dwells. POKENAME feeds on a type of invasive algae, making its presence vital for keeping the seabed clean.

entry: POKENAME留下的残留物有毒，沾污食物后吃下，会视线模糊。残留物消化后，这种短暂障碍便会消退。
author: quackquackattack
source: The residue left behind by POKENAME is poisonous. The effects of consuming food contaminated by POKENAME residue include blurred vision. This momentary impairment passes as the residue is digested.

entry: POKENAME白天用阴影裹住自己。夜里悄悄靠近人，突然吐舌、出声，再消失在夜色。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME shrouds itself in shadows during the daytime. At night, it sneaks up on people to stick its tongue out, make a noise, and vanish into the night.

entry: POKENAME夜里无声无形地游走，遇见人，就突然让花纹发亮，吓唬对方取乐。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME roams around at night, silent and unseen. If it encounters anyone, it will suddenly make its patterns glow, frightening them for its own amusement.

entry: POKENAME让被催眠者陷进黑暗的梦。许多怕黑的宝可梦醒来时，会焦虑惊慌。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME envelop those they hypnotize in dreams of darkness. Many Pokémon who are scared of the dark awaken in an anxious panic.

entry: POKENAME拿着的金环脉动着精神能量，轻轻一动，就能让其他生命沉睡。
author: .izik
source: The golden ring POKENAME carries pulses with psychic energy. With a single motion, it can lull others into a deep sleep.

entry: POKENAME在深海狩猎，圆环在暗中微微发光。遇险时，会从钳子向四周海水喷出毒液，逼退对手。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hunts in the deep sea, the rings on its body faintly glowing in the dark. When in danger, it will spray a poisonous fluid from its claws into the surrounding water to deter its opponent.

entry: POKENAME贪恋贵重物品，藏在森林巢穴里。仔细追踪，或许能找到塞满财宝的空心树。
author: busilisk
source: POKENAME are known to covet valuable items and cache them within their forest lairs. Carefully tracking them could reveal a hollow tree filled with riches.

entry: POKENAME自己攒不了多少电，会从其他宝可梦或设备偷吸。若偷得太多，就会爆炸，常常是无意的。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME cannot build up much of a charge itself, so it siphons electricity from other Pokémon or devices. If it steals too much power it will explode, often accidentally.

entry: POKENAME常想加入黑暗鸦群。两者关系复杂，它一半时间保护同伴，另一半时间则讨回被同伴偷走的骨头。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME often tries to join up with flocks of Murkrow. The two species have a complicated relationship; POKENAME spends half its time protecting its brethren and the other half trying to get its bone back from them after it was stolen.

entry: POKENAME身体释放红雾，所到之处都会引起幻觉。附近沼泽许多女巫目击报告，其实只是它路过。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dispenses a red fog from its body that causes illusions wherever it travels. Many reports of seeing a witch in nearby swamps are simply sightings of a POKENAME passing through.

entry: POKENAME身边迷信众多，许多故事说，靠近落单个体会招来一生厄运。其实它爱玩，只是习惯偷走闪亮东西，带回巢里。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Superstitions abound around POKENAME, with many stories claiming that approaching a lone POKENAME invites a lifetime of misfortune. In truth, they are playful Pokémon that are prone to stealing anything shiny, spiriting the items away to their nest.

entry: POKENAME潜在湖底，等旅人泛舟经过或靠近岸边，就猛然挺身尖叫，吓得对方离去，盼掉下些能偷的物品。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lies in wait beneath lakes until travelers float along the lake or come near the shore. It rears up with a frightening shriek to scare them off, hoping they drop some goods it can pilfer for itself.

entry: POKENAME小巧狡黠，灵活穿过人群，顺走闪亮饰物。久而久之，更适应周围环境，偷窃、逃避追捕也越发熟练。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a crafty little creature, nimbly moving through crowds to swipe shiny baubles. Over time, it adapts to its surroundings to be more and more effective at thievery and evading capture.

entry: POKENAME飞上高空，把翅膀收进壳里，朝地面俯冲。途中精准抓走闪亮东西，再在撞地前完全缩进壳。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME fly up high, then tuck their wings into their shell and dive towards the ground. They precisely snatch shiny things as they pass, then fully tuck into their shell before hitting the ground.

entry: 人和宝可梦都避开POKENAME攀住的树，把它当成凶兆。幸好这份迷信让它能在壳里不受打扰地成长。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Both Pokémon and Trainers alike avoid the trees that POKENAME cling to as they see POKENAME as an ill omen. Thankfully this superstition allows POKENAME to grow within its shell without being disturbed.

entry: 训练家一发现POKENAME，它就记住对方的脸，往后远远避开。有人看见时，它还能在猛然炸开的羽毛中消失。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: Whenever a trainer finds POKENAME it remembers the trainers face and stays away from them. POKENAME is able to vanish in an explosion of feathers when someone sees it.

entry: POKENAME视力极有限，夜里靠红外线看东西。它撒出火花探知风向，再聚向最大的热源。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME have very limited eyesight, relying on Infrared to see at night. They scatter sparks to track the movements of winds before converging on the greatest source of heat.

entry: POKENAME等入夜才离巢，黑羽让它在暗中几乎隐形。身躯虽小，啄起对手却凶狠、毫不迟疑。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME waits for nightfall to leave its nest, its black feathers making it nearly invisible within the darkness. Though small, it fiercely pecks at its opponents without hesitation.

entry: POKENAME用细喙和窄身钻进小开口，收集食物、闪亮饰物。小贵重物品一失踪，常被怪到它头上。
author: ambidexhex
source: POKENAME can reach into small openings to collect food and shiny trinkets with its thin beak and narrow body. It's often blamed for small valuables going missing.

entry: 有人说，夜里看到POKENAME前后摇晃，会遭逢可怕厄运。传说把它一根羽毛插进头发，就能避开诅咒、保佑平安。
author: .izik
source: Some say if you see POKENAME rocking back and forth at night, you will experience terrible misfortune. The tale says that placing one of its feathers in one's hair will avoid the curse and protect against ill fate.

entry: 筑巢后，POKENAME先用翅膀跳一段怪舞，再将头转一整圈，确认无人窥视。这道仪式，让它在隐蔽住处安心。
author: .izik
source: After making its nest, POKENAME does an odd dance with its wings and then rotates its head in a complete circle to ensure nobody was watching. This ritual helps it feel secure in its hidden refuge.

entry: 经过POKENAME领地，旅人最好看紧财物。这种嗜偷的宝可梦很会远远射丝，拽走小饰物。
author: sk372
source: Travelers are encouraged to keep a close eye on their valuables in POKENAME territory. The kleptomaniac Pokémon is very adept at shooting webs from a distance in order to yank away small trinkets.

entry: POKENAME用闪亮饰物装点丝网，吸引合意的猎物，自己则去找更多宝贝。看中什么闪亮物，就用网包住，拖回巢里。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME decorates its web with shiny trinkets to attract preferable prey while it hunts for more treasures. When it finds shiny objects it likes, it webs them up in a net to drag back to its nest.

entry: POKENAME光洁顺滑的黑羽因美丽而珍贵，绒羽则用于多种高级时装。它好饲养，响亮鸦叫却让培育家很头疼。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have sleek black feathers that are prized for their beauty, with their down used in a variety of high fashion products. They are easy Pokémon to keep, but their loud crows make them a headache for the Pokémon Breeders keeping them.

entry: POKENAME爱帮忙，可以训练它捡起公园遗落的硬币和好东西。作为回报，它只要一顿好饭和关爱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to be helpful and can be trained to pick up coins and other goodies left behind at parks. All they ask for in exchange is a good meal and affection.

entry: POKENAME沿椭圆路线飞行，巡查巢穴周围。遇见危险宝可梦，就撤退呼救，其他同类也会跟着做。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME flies in ovals to patrol around their nest. If they meet a dangerous Pokémon, they retreat and cry for help, causing others to follow suit.

entry: POKENAME大方好心，却不太懂私人物品的归属。它常偷陌生人的东西，送给珍爱的人，因而惹出麻烦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is magnanimous and well-meaning, but has little understanding of personal property. It often causes issue by stealing things from strangers to give to those it cherishes.

entry: 据说见到POKENAME，运气就会变化。神话还说，它能偷走情绪，再送给别人。不过，大多数科学家最能达成共识的，是它性情有些多变。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is said seeing POKENAME will result in a change in one's fortune. Myths also say it can steal the emotions of others and give them to someone else. Ultimately, the main thing most scientists agree on is its somewhat moody nature.

entry: POKENAME能预见未来，在不会淹水的地方筑巢。预知让住处不论季节如何更替，都安全干爽。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can see the future and builds its nest in areas that will not flood. Its foresight ensures its home remains safe and dry, regardless of seasonal changes.

entry: POKENAME颈部绒毛会被用来制作婚纱头纱。薄而细腻，质感柔软，轻盈通透，因此十分珍贵。
author: .izik
source: The fluff growing around POKENAME's neck is used to create wedding veils. It is thin and delicate, prized for its soft texture and light, airy feel.

entry: POKENAME收集茄科花朵，装点裙子和帽子。新月之夜，它们一起跳舞，结下相伴终生的羁绊。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME collects nightshade flowers to decorate their skirt and hat. These Pokémon dance together on nights with a new moon to forge bonds that will last for their lifetime.

entry: POKENAME用附近田野的花装点巢穴。娇嫩花朵增添色彩和魅力，让家成为生机盎然的休息处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME decorates its nest with flowers from nearby fields. These delicate blooms add color and charm to its home, creating a vibrant resting place.

entry: POKENAME飘在草甸上，寻找大片花丛。它偏爱用雏菊装点巢穴，让家多一分欢快。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats above meadows looking for large patches of flowers. It prefers to decorate its nest with daisies, adding a cheerful touch to its home.

entry: POKENAME融入黑夜，成大群搜刮喙能叼走的一切。它们只听命于率领鸦群的乌鸦达。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
