source: Blending in with the darkness of night, POKENAME swarm in massive flocks to try and pilfer anything they can gather in their beaks. They only answer to the Honchicate that leads their flock.

entry: POKENAME眼睛极敏锐，远远就能找到闪亮东西，先用起风吹上半空，再一把抓住，是空中偷窃高手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's eyes are incredibly sharp, able to spot shiny objects from afar. It will use Gust to blow them into the air before snatching them up, making it a master of aerial theft.

entry: POKENAME锐利的眼睛，能看见远处最微弱的一丝闪光。飞行几乎全然无声，只有翅膀轻得不能再轻的嗡鸣，提醒人它正尾随。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's sharp eyesight lets it spot even the faintest hint of something shiny glimmering in the distance. It flies in almost complete silence, only the faintest hum from its wings warning people of its presence stalking them.

entry: POKENAME找到喵喵的巢，就喷水吓跑主人，再尽量用喙叼走贵重物品，带着战利品飞走，向附近其他喵喵宣示优势。
author: .izik
source: Should POKENAME locate a Meowth's nest, it will spit water at it to scare it away, then steal as many valuables as it can in its beak before flying off with its prize. It does this to assert dominance over other Meowth nearby.

entry: POKENAME深夜奔走觅食，用蓬松尾巴盖住脚印。它格外警惕梦歌仙人掌，一见到就融入阴影，迅速逃走。
author: fiordaliso
source: As POKENAME scurries around in the dead of night in search of food, it uses its bushy tail to cover its tracks. It is particularly wary of Cacturne, so as soon as it spots one, it blends into the shadows and quickly makes its escape.

entry: POKENAME在垃圾箱之间飞行，吃丢弃食物、收集闪亮东西。捡食习惯让它成了夜行猎手，随时寻找下一件宝贝。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies between dumpsters, eating discarded food and collecting shiny objects. Its scavenging habit makes it a nocturnal hunter, always on the lookout for the next treasure.

entry: POKENAME曾出现在一个流行故事里，告诫孩子别走进森林太深。人类般的叫声和调皮性情，让故事很容易被相信。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME were once featured in a popular story that warns children not to wander too far into forests. Their human-like cry and mischievous nature make these stories easy to believe.

entry: POKENAME夜里无声滑过城市，偷来闪亮饰物，在昏暗处引诱猎物。被逼入绝境，就用尾巴反击再飞走，只留一阵黑羽。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME glide silently through cities at night, stealing shiny trinkets to lure in prey in the dim lighting. If they're cornered, they will strike with their tails before flying away, leaving only a flurry of black feathers behind.

entry: POKENAME常躲在阴影里，突然蹿出来惊吓人类与宝可梦。被吓得丢下的贵重物品、小饰件，都会落入它手中，再也找不回来。
author: gamblebreaker
source: POKENAME often hide in shadows and wait to jump out at people and Pokémon. Any valuables or trinkets that are left behind are taken by them, never to be seen again.

entry: POKENAME观察敏锐，伺机偷食物。它还会尾随其他宝可梦，引它们前往食物所在。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME relies on its astute observation skills to opportunistically steal food. It is also known to stalk other Pokémon to lead them to food sources.

entry: POKENAME突然从坚硬壳里冒出，吓其他生命一跳。趁对方惊愕的一瞬，抢走带着的食物，再缩回壳里躲好。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME surprises others by suddenly popping out of its sturdy shell. In the split second while they are shocked, it snaps up whatever food they might have been carrying and retreats back into the shell to be safe from harm.

entry: POKENAME用强喙从洞壁啄煤吃。进食时，头上的羽毛变热，冒出余烬。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its strong beak to peck coal from cavern walls to eat. This causes the feathers on its head to grow hot and emit embers as it feeds.

entry: POKENAME主要夜间狩猎，借黑羽悄悄飞行。它常在城市公园筑巢，据为己有的树，谁也不许靠近。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME hunts mainly at night, taking advantage of its black plumage to fly unnoticed. It tends to nest in city parks and allows no other Pokémon to approach the tree it has claimed as its own.

entry: POKENAME拿着一把冰雕小武器，威吓人和宝可梦交出食物、财物。不过，这武器其实完全无害。
author: pankiwi
source: POKENAME uses a small ice-carved weapon to intimidate Pokémon and Trainers into giving up their food and valuables. This weapon is entirely harmless.

entry: POKENAME有着光滑的黑羽，身边环绕着小小的火焰。它爱在夜里恶作剧，用尖喙与火星吓唬毫无防备的旅人。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME is a mischievous Pokémon with sleek black feathers and a small aura of flames. It loves to play tricks at night, using its sharp beak and small embers to frighten unsuspecting travelers.

entry: POKENAME头羽剧毒。它先抖尾，再啄猎物，用毒削弱目标，随后进一步出击。
author: .izik
source: The feathers on POKENAME's head are very poisonous. It rattles its tail before pecking at prey, using its poison to weaken its target before making its move.

entry: POKENAME将尾巴碰到喙，尾端墨汁就会变色。靠这本领，它走到哪，都能创作独特鲜艳的图案。
author: .izik
source: Touching its tail to its beak changes the color of the ink at the end of its tail. This ability allows POKENAME to create unique and vibrant patterns wherever it goes.

entry: POKENAME腹部花纹像张不祥的脸，据说能直视灵魂。吓人的外表衍生出许多传闻迷信。它轻易就能吓得敌人动不了，再缠住对方。
author: foolish_weasel
source: The pattern on POKENAME's belly appears to be an ominous face said to stare into one's soul. Many rumours and superstitions develop around it as a result of its frightful appearance. It easily paralyzes its foes with fear before constricting them.

entry: POKENAME外貌阴森，引来传言，说是可怕毁灭的凶兆。它似乎知道这些传闻，大半时间待在远离人烟的深水里。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME's sinister look has caused rumors to circulate that it is an omen of terrible ruin. Apparently aware of these rumors, POKENAME spends most of its time deep underwater and far away from civilization.

entry: POKENAME是强大的黑暗鸦监工，收取一半赃物作为保护费。翅膀一挥，就能造出色调幽暗的彩虹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a powerful overseer of Murkrow, making sure they offer half of their stolen goods to it for protection. With a wave of its wings, it creates rainbows of dark colors.

entry: POKENAME筑巢时，会发出令人不安、像人念咒般的吟唱。词句毫无意义，诡声却充满四周，给巢穴更添神秘气息。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes an unsettling, human-like chanting while building its nest. The words make no sense, but the eerie sound fills the air, adding to the mysterious aura of its lair.

entry: POKENAME拍翅召集附近黑暗鸦。鸦群毫不迟疑地服从，跟着它协调合作。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flaps its wings to gather Murkrow in the immediate area. Its flock obeys it without hesitation, following its lead as they work together in coordinated efforts.

entry: POKENAME融入夜色，无声滑翔追猎。出击前先叫起来，嘈杂怪笑扰乱四周，越来越响，随后骤然消失。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Blending into the darkness of the night, POKENAME glide silently to pursue their prey. They cry out before they strike, disorienting all in their surroundings with their cacophanous laughter that only grows louder before suddenly disappearing.

entry: POKENAME的头飘到人面前，嘎嘎啾啾地叫，惹人烦。趁对方分心，身体就偷走所有够得着的随身物品。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's head floats around in front of a person's face, squawking and chirping to annoy them. While the person is distracted by this, the body swipes away any personal items it can.

entry: 这种不会飞的食腐宝可梦待在公园灌木里，看人来往。POKENAME看中闪亮东西，就跳到包旁偷走，再蹦跳着离开。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: These flightless scavengers hang around parks, hiding in the brush, watching people pass by. When POKENAME see something shiny they want, they will hop near bags and steal the shiny object before hopping away.

entry: 晨昏时，POKENAME常在玉米田，把稻草人当训练靶。猛烈踢斩让稻草人破烂不堪，令农民十分苦恼。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Often found in corn fields during twilight, POKENAME will use the scarecrows posted in the fields as training dummies. Their fierce kicks and slashes leave the scarecrows in disrepair, much to the farmer's dismay.

entry: POKENAME靠强腿爬上高树，将偷来的宝贝藏在隐蔽树洞。它担任团伙首领的副手，能指挥其他喽啰。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME use their powerful legs to scale tall trees and keep the treasures they've stolen in hidden holes. POKENAME act like second-in-command to the boss of their group and can command other cronies.

entry: POKENAME在湖边树根处筑巢，用芦苇装点。天然材料帮助融入环境，让家安全隐蔽。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its nest at the base of trees near lakes, decorating it with reeds. The natural materials help it blend into its surroundings, providing a safe and hidden home.

entry: POKENAME爱收集树枝和所有看中的东西。找到最爱的树枝，就用自己的羽毛装饰，甚至借精神力量骑在上面。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME love to collect sticks and anything else that catches their attention. When a POKENAME finds its favorite stick, it decorates the stick with some of its own feathers and will even ride atop it using its psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME以神秘力量捣乱而恶名远扬，尤其爱用念力抢东西、恶作剧。有些节目还用它的夸张形象，塑造常见的捣蛋角色。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are infamous for causing mischief with their mystical powers, namely for psychically snatching goods from others and playing pranks. Some shows have even utilized caricatures of these Pokémon as common troublemakers.

entry: 据说POKENAME只在病痛深重时现身，深夜用奇怪药剂和精神能量治疗疾病。
author: koishikomeiji.
source: Said to appear only in times of great sickness, POKENAME appears in the dead of night, treating disease with strange tonics and psychic emanations.

entry: POKENAME假扮小黑暗鸦，让其他生命误以为安全，再露出真容。巨大的影子操纵黑暗与幽灵力量，大肆捣蛋。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME masquerades as a small Murkrow to lull others into a false sense of security before revealing itself. The massive shadow manipulates dark and ghostly powers to cause mischief aplenty.

entry: POKENAME飘过墓园时，头羽会发出阴森嚎声，常在深夜响起，更添鬼魅气氛。
author: .izik
source: The feathers on POKENAME's head make a creepy howling noise as it floats through cemeteries. This eerie sound is often heard in the dead of night, adding to the ghostly atmosphere.

entry: POKENAME常陪在绅士身旁，模仿扶帽致意等举止。被幼小宝可梦或幼儿园小朋友围住，就用手杖轻轻推开。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME is commonly spotted alongside Gentlemen, mimicking their mannerisms such as tipping hats. When POKENAME is swarmed by baby Pokémon or Preschoolers, POKENAME gently pushes them away with its cane.

entry: POKENAME仍听命于劈斩司令或乌鸦头头，大多似乎对安排很满意。战场上突然斜向飞窜，旋身使出暗袭要害，宛如舞步。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME still defer to Bisharp or Honchkrow and most seem satisfied with that arrangement. When POKENAME dart across the battlefield, they do so in sudden diagonal movements, using Night Slash while twirling around, resembling steps in a dance.

entry: POKENAME在沙尘地拦住旅人，迅速拍翅扬起大片尘屑。趁颗粒蒙住对方视线，带着偷来的财物溜走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME accosts travelers in dusty or sandy areas, flapping its wings rapidly to kick up clouds of detritus. While its targets are blinded by the particles, POKENAME makes off with some of their belongings.

entry: 许多记录提到，它们收集贵重物品和宝藏，装饰自身。不过从不偷任何人的东西，也总愿将失物归还原主。
author: infinex21
source: Many records exist of these Pokémon collecting valuables and treasures and adorning themselves with their collections. However, they have never stolen from anyone and have always been willing to return lost valuables to their rightful owners.

entry: POKENAME无辜的表情只是伪装。一没目击者，它就抢光目标的一切财物。
author: bitterchemicalhaze
source: POKENAME's innocent expression is a front. Once no witnesses are present, it robs its target of anything of value.

entry: POKENAME能让每根羽毛各自飘浮，无论离身体多远。它把羽毛聚在树枝末端，托着自己升空，就不用亲自飞了。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME have the power to float their feathers individually regardless of how far they are from their body. They gather their feathers together at the ends of branches to lift themselves into the air without having to manually fly.

entry: 科技工作者普遍畏惧POKENAME，把它当成厄运预兆。所到之处，电子设备都会出故障，可它太会藏在暗角，很难赶走。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are widely feared by people working with technology as omens of ill fortune. Wherever they go, electronic devices malfunction, but POKENAME are so skilled at hiding in dark corners that they are difficult to get rid of.

entry: POKENAME将树枝削成刀刃，战斗时点燃。虽然能吓住对手，它却也常被自己的火光吸引，分了心。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME whittle branches into blades then ignite them as they enter battle. While this strategy assists them in intimidating opponents, they also tend to get distracted by the light shining from their flames.

entry: POKENAME遍身覆着防水小羽毛。有人见过，它在海滨城镇向游客讨食。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's body is covered in small waterproof feathers. Some people have witnessed it beg for food from tourists in seaside towns.

entry: POKENAME先啄城里的人，再偷走家门钥匙，用来装点巢，以收集饰物与宝藏为傲。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME steals house keys from people in towns after pecking at them with its beak. It decorates its nest with these keys, proud to be a collector of trinkets and treasures.

entry: POKENAME不断扇动翅膀，想警告人们厄运将至，却从来没人当回事。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME flaps its wings around trying to warn people of ill fortune, but nobody takes it seriously.

entry: POKENAME会欺骗其他宝可梦，也会偷走它们的树果。如果帽子被偷，它就会大闹一场，直到找回帽子为止。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME is known to con other Pokémon or steal their Berries. If its hat is stolen, it goes on a rampage until it is found.

entry: POKENAME钻进山坡，在洞里筑巢，用闪亮物品装饰隧道，让地下住处光彩熠熠。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows into the side of hills and makes its nest in the hole. It uses shiny objects to decorate its tunnel, creating a gleaming display within its underground lair.

entry: POKENAME尾羽有时脱落，它就取来铺巢。柔软的羽毛成为舒适床垫，让家更宜居。
author: .izik
source: The feathers on POKENAME's tail fall off sometimes, and it uses them in its lodge due to their softness. These feathers serve as a comfortable bedding material, making its home more inviting.

entry: POKENAME夜视能力强，任何时候都能自由游走。与黑暗鸦不同，它有强烈道德准则，不偷东西；却仍爱闪亮物，会收集失物和松落的闪光矿石自用。
author: bobosmith01
source: Powerful night vision allows POKENAME to roam freely at any hour. Unlike Murkrow, it has a strong moral code and will not participate in thievery. However, it still adores shiny objects and will collect lost items or loose glistening ore for itself.

entry: POKENAME总伸手够附近的闪亮东西，动作却太慢，根本偷不到。有些旅人觉得可爱，可怜它，便让它拿走些无关紧要的小东西。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME reaches towards anything shiny in its vicinity, but moves far too sluggishly to actually steal anything. Some travelers find it endearing, and allow it to take something inconsequential out of pity.

entry: POKENAME在电线杆顶筑巢。高处视野让它能警戒威胁、寻找机会，守稳空中领地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its nest at the top of electric poles. The high vantage point allows it to keep a lookout for any threats or opportunities, securing its domain in the sky.

entry: POKENAME夜视完美，被用于船上值夜。船若将撞上障碍，它就唱起甲板上也能听见的响亮海员号子，提醒船员。
author: ghostslythe
source: Used on ships for night watch, POKENAME has perfect night vision. If the ship is on a collision course, it alerts the crew with a sea shanty loud enough to be heard on deck.

entry: POKENAME用纯金的喙，为族群凿出巢穴。它们爱一起谋划计策，齐心完成下定决心要做的事。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their solid-gold beaks to carve out dens for their flocks. They enjoy plotting schemes with each other, working together to accomplish whatever task they put their minds to.

entry: 成群POKENAME在落叶下共同筑巢，等游荡的训练家经过。一听脚步，就齐齐冲出，扬起羽毛和树叶分散注意，偷走财物。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Flocks of POKENAME build nests together beneath fallen leaves, waiting for a wandering Trainer to pass by. Once they hear footsteps, they all burst out at once, scattering feathers and leaves to distract their target while they take any valuables.

entry: POKENAME想吓人，却常挑中根本不怕的目标。见对方不跑，反而自己慌了逃走，还用燃烧的尾巴拍打目标，免得追上来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tries to be intimidating, but often picks targets unfazed by its displays. When its victim doesn't run away scared, it panics and turns tail itself, smacking its flaming tail against its target to discourage pursuit.

entry: POKENAME为黑暗鸦群放哨。它深吸气鼓起身体，发出足够响亮的鸦叫，提醒整群危险将至。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME acts as a lookout for Murkrow flocks. It puffs up its body by inhaling deeply so it can unleash a caw loud enough to alert the whole group to incoming danger.

entry: 有人说，被POKENAME盯上是凶兆，预示歉收。如今多数人不再务农，只当旧话听，它却仍背着坏名声。
author: lucioleuh
source: Some say having a POKENAME stare at you is a bad omen, predicting a bad harvest. However, this is now regarded as an old saying, as most people aren't farmers. The species still carries a bad reputation regardless.

entry: 成群POKENAME飞过晴空，仿佛暗云。传闻说，谁拽它的线，谁就会在一阵羽毛爆散中消失。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Flocks of POKENAME fly through the skies, appearing to be dark clouds in otherwise clear skies. Rumors claim that anyone that tugs on a POKENAME's strings will disappear in a burst of feathers.

entry: POKENAME趁训练家被可爱模样吸引，悄悄顺走小饰物。被抓到偷窃，就调皮地笑着归还宝贝，让谁也没法继续生气。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME secretly pockets trinkets from Trainers while they're distracted by its cutesy demeanor. If POKENAME is caught stealing, it will playfully giggle while returning the treasure, making sure that nobody can stay mad at it.

entry: 使出强力暗影球前，POKENAME的喙会泛紫光。布料般的身体由细小羽毛构成，让幽灵模样更显空灵。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's beak glows violet before it uses a powerful Shadow Ball attack. Its cloth-like body is made up of tiny feathers, adding an ethereal quality to its ghostly appearance.

entry: POKENAME在住家附近听话，学会模仿人声。黄昏，它把受害者引出门，再用精神力量拖进森林。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME mimics human speech after listening near homes. At dusk, it lures victims outside, then drags them into the woods with psychic force.

entry: POKENAME性情很像恶棍，拦住旅人，威吓交出供品，作为经过领地的路费。很少有人愿意试试，拒绝会付出什么代价。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a very thuggish personality, accosting any travelers and intimidating them into giving it an offering as a toll for passing through its territory. Few are willing to see what the cost of refusal would be.

entry: POKENAME收集各种小饰物，放到逝者安息之地。人们认为，它想用自己喜欢的东西，安慰已进入来世的亡者。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME collects a variety of small trinkets and places them in the resting grounds of the deceased. It is thought that it is attempting to comfort those who have gone into the afterlife with things POKENAME itself enjoys.

entry: POKENAME睡着时若倒下，就会爆炸，羽毛四散。突然释放的能量，是搅乱周围的防御手段。
author: .izik
source: Should POKENAME fall over while sleeping, it will explode, scattering its feathers everywhere. This sudden burst of energy is a defense mechanism that causes chaos in its surroundings.

entry: 随着进化，POKENAME会对训练家因美貌而非实力和努力偏爱的队友变得刻薄。它不惜一切让队伍重回正轨，觉得跟不上时，甚至主动让位。
author: epping_forest
source: As it evolves, POKENAME becomes very mean towards teammates favored by its Trainer for their beauty, rather than strength and effort. It will do anything to steer the team back on course, even stepping down when feeling unable to keep up.

entry: POKENAME出击时，用强喙紧扣猎物。若被逃掉，就用奇异之光拖慢，确保能再次抓住。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME latches onto prey with its strong beak when striking. If they get away, it will use Confuse Ray to slow them down, making sure they can't escape recapture.

entry: POKENAME拍动唯一的翅膀，放出短促雪雾。冰冷阵风更添寒意，让它在冷地显得像个幽灵。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME flaps its single wing, it lets loose brief puffs of snow. These icy gusts add to its chilling presence, making it a haunting figure in cold environments.

entry: 很久以前，人们以为POKENAME是女巫伪装，因恐惧而将它猎到濒临灭绝。幸好，近年来数量已开始恢复。
author: mepp.
source: Long ago, POKENAME were thought to be witches in disguise. That fear resulted in them being hunted to near extinction, though luckily their numbers have started to recover in recent years.

entry: POKENAME算是农田的小害兽，爱挖出种好的种子，随意埋到别处，搅乱农场精心规划的作物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a bit of a farmland pest: it likes to dig up planted seeds and bury them in other random spots, which causes chaos among the carefully-plotted crops most farms tend to keep.

entry: POKENAME默默守卫据为住处的树，快速弹动翅膀，就能像掷飞刀一样，向入侵者甩出羽毛。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME silently defend the trees they claim as their homes. By flicking their wings quickly, they can fling their feathers at intruders in a way similar to throwing knives.

entry: POKENAME吃路边垃圾，有人靠近就飞走。捡食习惯常将它带到垃圾箱和荒废处，寻找下一餐。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME eats trash from the side of roads and flies away when someone gets too close. Its scavenging behavior often leads it to dumpsters and abandoned areas, where it hunts for its next meal.

entry: POKENAME借翅膀辅助，能跃出很远。驱赶沼泽入侵者时，就靠这本领，以出奇的速度和灵活追逐。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can vault large distances with the aid of its wings. It uses this ability while chasing intruders from its marsh, pursuing them with surprising speed and agility.

entry: 无人时，POKENAME会把滑溜黏液涂满地面。倒霉路人一滑倒，它就迅速蠕过去，试着扒走能找到的闪亮饰物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spreads a slippery slime from its body across the ground when nobody is around. Once a hapless passerby trips on the slime, POKENAME quickly oozes over and attempts to pickpocket any shiny baubles it can find.

entry: POKENAME爱偷其他宝可梦的东西，却只在对方没看时下手。华贵黑毛被做成帽子、外套，似乎很受邪恶组织欢迎。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves to steal things from other Pokémon, but only if they aren't looking. Its luxurious, black fur is used to make hats and coats which seem to be popular amongst evil teams.

entry: POKENAME在公园树间跳跃，寻找随身物品没放牢的人。抓走东西便猛冲逃离，靠速度和灵活甩开失主。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME jumps from tree to tree in public parks, looking for humans with loose belongings. It grabs them before dashing away, using its speed and agility to outpace its targets.

entry: POKENAME听话忠诚，却保留了黑暗鸦爱偷东西的倾向。不过这是它表达喜爱的方式：从别人那里偷饰物，送给深爱的训练家。
author: sk372
source: Though well-behaved and loyal, POKENAME retains Murkrow's kleptomaniac tendencies. In its case, however, it's meant as a sign of affection, stealing trinkets from others to gift to its beloved Trainer.

entry: POKENAME用响亮尖叫和不和谐的歌远距离交流。叫声实在刺耳，林中居民有时只为让它闭嘴，就会发动攻击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME communicate long distances with grand shrill cries and discordant songs. Its shrieking voice is so cacophonous that other woodland denizens may attack it just to shut it up.

entry: POKENAME吃海带或藤壶时，若被灯塔光束照到就会惊慌。它躲到漂浮物下，瑟瑟发抖，直到自以为的危险过去。
author: .izik
source: While snacking on kelp or barnacles, POKENAME panics when hit by lighthouse beams. It hides beneath flotsam, trembling until the perceived danger passes.

entry: POKENAME叶片般的羽毛含有效力强的草药，用于天然药物。过去，医者用来治疗中毒和麻痹症状。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's leafy feathers contain potent herbs used in natural medicine. Healers once used them to treat poisoning and paralysis symptoms.

entry: POKENAME全身羽毛含有粉末，会撒向靠近闪亮收藏的家伙，使其麻痹。守护宝藏时，靠这防御手段挡住入侵者。
author: .izik
source: The feathers covering POKENAME's body contain a powder that it scatters to paralyze anyone who gets close to its collection of shiny objects. This defense mechanism keeps intruders at bay while it guards its treasures.

entry: POKENAME常在重大疾病暴发前出现，过去曾被视为疾病先兆。虽然广泛研究已否定这种说法，许多人依旧警惕。
author: mepp.
source: Long ago, POKENAME were once thought to be the harbingers of disease as they often appeared right before major outbreaks of illnesses. Though extensive research has dismissed these claims, many people still are wary of the Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME翅膀上的粉极其闪亮，被用于生产眼影。这份闪光特性，让它在化妆品行业备受追捧。
author: .izik
source: The powder from POKENAME's wings is extremely shiny and is used in eyeshadow production. Its glittering properties make it highly sought after in the cosmetic industry.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛带着金南果味，酸中透着咸鲜。这香气让某些宝可梦无法抗拒，忍不住靠近接触。
author: .izik
source: The feathers on POKENAME's body smell like Pumkin Berries, releasing a sour and savory scent. This aroma makes it irresistible to certain Pokémon, drawing them closer for interaction.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME从树梢监视领地。受到打扰，整群便一齐扑下，用围攻收拾入侵者。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME watches from treetops to guard its territory. If disturbed, its flock descends together to Beat Up any intruder.

entry: POKENAME会舔没有威胁的人，深受许多训练家喜爱。遇险时，它会发出像小喇叭般的声音。
author: agostostino
source: POKENAME is beloved by many Trainers, as it licks them if they aren't a threat. When in danger, POKENAME will make a sound that is similar to a little horn.

entry: POKENAME满脑子只想偷闪亮东西，很少睡觉。它栖在门上，等屋主离开，再入室行窃。
author: rihse
source: POKENAME rarely sleeps, consumed by a need to steal shiny objects. It perches above doorways and waits for homeowners to leave before burgling residences.

entry: POKENAME偷硬币和珠宝，装点柳树上的巢。闪亮饰物添一分奢华，尽显它对贵重物品的喜爱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME steals coins and jewelry to decorate its nest in willow trees. The shiny trinkets add a touch of luxury to its home, showcasing its affinity for precious items.

entry: 一部热门儿童动画让POKENAME扮演反派头号手下。它忠实听令，计划却总因头痛导致魔力失控，而弄巧成拙。
author: sk372
source: A popular children's cartoon casts POKENAME as the villain's main henchman. In it, it dutifully follows orders, but the plans always backfire when its headaches cause its magic powers to go haywire.

entry: POKENAME傍晚开心地啾啾叫，迎接夜晚。若被打断，就勃然大怒，向胆敢打扰安宁时刻的家伙发泄。
author: .izik
source: In the evening hours, POKENAME chirps happily to welcome the night. If interrupted, it will fly into a rage, unleashing its fury on anyone who dares to disturb its peaceful moment.

entry: POKENAME唯一胜过对闪亮物渴望的，是对训练家的忠诚。它虽会替送来亮物的宝可梦帮忙，却没有什么能让它违抗训练家。
author: quackquackattack
source: The only thing that is greater than a POKENAME's desire for shiny objects is their loyalty to their Trainer. While they may perform favors for Pokémon who give them sparkling objects, nothing will make them disobey their Trainer.

entry: 它虽骄傲又爱自夸，却被人们尊为守护者。保护训练家的强烈意愿使它颇受欢迎。
author: xephyr
source: Although proud and boastful, these Pokémon are revered as guardians. Their burning desire to defend their Trainer makes them popular.

entry: POKENAME从喙射出极高压水流，足以摧毁混凝土。水柱威力强，需要时能造成巨大破坏。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME shoots water from its beak at extremely high pressures, capable of destroying concrete. This powerful water jet makes it a formidable force, able to cause massive damage when needed.

entry: POKENAME夜间活动，住在城市外围。靠瞬间传送，它只用几秒就能偷走财物、逃之夭夭。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a nocturnal Pokémon found just outside of urban areas. Thanks to its ability to teleport, it can steal someone's valuables and flee in mere seconds.

entry: POKENAME用强拳在崖侧打洞，再取附近树枝筑巢，在岩壁中建成结实、适合安居的家。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME punches holes in the sides of cliffs, making its nest with nearby twigs. Its powerful punches create a sturdy home in the rocky environment, perfect for nesting.

entry: POKENAME常在儿童节目扮演坏人手下，举起东西，砸向主角。虽然演着邪恶反派，其实心地宽厚，希望谁都开心。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often play the role of evil henchmen in children's show, lifting objects and throwing them at whoever the protagonist may be. Even though they act like evil villains, they have a big heart and want everyone to be happy.

entry: POKENAME跺蹄、乱挥翅膀，威吓训练家，也警告野火。混乱中，它用喙抓走散落的闪亮物，藏进头顶熊熊火焰。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME stomp their hooves and flail their wings to intimidate Trainers and warn of wildfires. In the middle of the chaos, they snatch any stray shiny objects with their beaks and hide them within the raging fire on their heads.

entry: POKENAME用无意吸来的金属物件装点巢。身体的磁性让巢里各式金属闪耀，形成独特又杂乱的家。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME decorates its nest with metal objects that it accidentally attracts. The magnetic properties of its body make its nest shine with various pieces of metal, forming a unique and cluttered home.

entry: 人们常见POKENAME在偷窃、入室等案发现场“调查”，往往只是想掩饰自己才是真凶。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME are commonly seen "investigating" the scenes of thefts, break-ins and similar crimes. This is often an attempt to hide the fact that they are the real culprits.

entry: POKENAME像掷匕首一样甩出羽毛，让敌人入睡。等对方失去意识，就饥渴地吃梦，以潜意识中的念头为食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flings its feathers at foes like daggers to induce sleep. Once they're unconscious, it eats their dreams with deep hunger, feeding off their subconscious thoughts.

entry: 被POKENAME钟摆催眠的人，常会突然很想偷东西。野外，它借此让其他生命梦游，替自己的巢收集物品。
author: aster_oid1701
source: Those who are hypnotised by POKENAME's pendulum tend to have sudden bouts of kleptomania. In the wild, POKENAME uses this ability to its advantage by making others collect things for its nest whilst they are under its sleepwalking spell.

entry: POKENAME背上鼓起的壳，赋予它惊人洞察，可一觉得承受不住，就会睡着。睡眠中释放成团花粉，让其他生命也困倦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a bulbous shell on their back that gives them incredible insights, but they fall asleep whenever they feel overwhelmed. As they sleep, they release clouds of pollen that cause drowsiness.

entry: POKENAME一边哼鸣，一边捏住舌头不同部位，改变音调，奏出令人着迷的旋律。听众被引来后，它就出击。
author: kiwiarms
source: By pinching specific parts of its tongue while humming to produce different tones, a POKENAME can play a haunting melody which draws in those who hear it. Then, it strikes.

entry: POKENAME喜欢独处，思考世界的奥秘，尤其是头顶王冠夹紧脑袋时。唯一例外是秋季求偶期，它会离开独居生活，寻找合适伴侣。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoys time in isolation to consider the mysteries of the world, especially when the crown atop its head clamps down onto its head. The only exception to this is the fall courtship season, when it leaves isolation to find a suitable partner.

entry: POKENAME拍翅制造戳不破的泡泡，原因在于有毒尘粉。尘粉融入泡泡，会诱发神经元生成。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME flaps its wings to form unpoppable bubbles due to its toxic dust. This dust is imbued into the bubbles and induces neurogenesis.

entry: POKENAME是无可匹敌的表演者，把庞大智慧的每个脑细胞，都投入研究各种形式、风格的演出。眨眼间，就能策划整场马戏。
author: foolish_weasel
source: An unrivaled entertainer, POKENAME dedicates every brain cell of its vast intellect towards studying performances in all forms and styles. It can plan an entire circus routine in the blink of an eye.

entry: POKENAME能表演世上曾创出的每种舞蹈、节目和马戏技巧，一生只为用演出传播欢乐，却不肯说话。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Capable of performing every dance, routine, or circus trick ever devised, POKENAME lives to spread cheer through its performances. It refuses to speak, however.

entry: 高智力让POKENAME清楚知道身体有多弱、多脆。它忧郁地独处，静候进化之日，好换上配得起智慧的形态。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's high intelligence makes it acutely aware of how weak and fragile its body is. It somberly keeps to itself and bides its time until the day it evolves and changes into a form worthy of its intellect.

entry: POKENAME头上的壳注入毒素，让它一天比一天笨，常连基本的求生本能也会忘。
author: mistymagius
source: The shell on its head injects a toxin that makes POKENAME dumber by the day. Because of this, POKENAME will often forget basic survival instincts.

entry: POKENAME精神力量强，能与背着过水的人心灵交流。途中，它会说些体恤温柔的话，安抚烦乱心绪。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's mind is strong enough to communicate telepathically with the humans it carries across water. During these ferries, it offers words of compassion and kindness to soothe troubled minds.

entry: POKENAME极聪明，几乎什么程序摆在面前，都能看出改进之处，再加以完善。研究者将现代许多科技突破，归功于有它协助研发。
author: sk372
source: Highly intelligent, POKENAME is capable of finding and improving nearly any program shown to it. Researchers attribute many modern technological breakthroughs to having POKENAME assist in development.

entry: POKENAME主要吃杏仔果，在危急时得到极大智慧。可这份智慧转瞬即逝，一睡着就忘了。
author: quackquackattack
source: A POKENAME's diet mainly consists of Apicot Berries that give them great wisdom in dire circumstances. These moments of wisdom are transient, as the wisdom is forgotten when they fall asleep.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀由一种接触后会让人混乱、恶心的化合物构成。只有翅膀被戳破才生效，形成有趣的防御手段。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The wings of POKENAME are made up of a compound that induces confusion and nausea upon contact. This is only applicable if the wings are popped, making their wings into an interesting defense mechanism.

entry: POKENAME头骨上的壳，吸收了大量精神力量。极偶尔，它会与其他生命分享壳，赋予暂时的念力。
author: sk372
source: The shell on POKENAME's cranium has absorbed a large amount of its vast psychic powers. On rare occasions, it will share the shell with others, granting them temporary telekinesis.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间站在水里，只露出花瓣、脖子和头。其他宝可梦聚在周围，尚不清楚是来听叫声，还是单被花香吸引。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of its time standing in water, with only its petals, neck, and head above the surface. Other Pokémon gather around it, but it is unknown if they are listening to its cries or are simply drawn in by its flower's fragrance.

entry: POKENAME充满智慧，帮助年长训练家保持规律生活。精准的计时本领，让训练家总能准时赴约。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are wise creatures that help elderly Trainers maintain a sense of routine. Their precise timekeeping abilities ensure their Trainers always make it to appointments on time.

entry: POKENAME精神影响力极强，聚来的虔诚追随者声称，在它身旁会见到异象。它极少出声，整座群落却曾毫不质疑地服从其无声指令。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME exerts overwhelming psychic influence, gathering devoted followers who claim to receive visions in its presence. It rarely makes noise, yet entire communities have been known to obey its silent commands without question.

entry: POKENAME以惊人速度飞遍世界，探寻世间奥秘的答案。历史学家常在它巢里找到古文明遗物。
author: distinguishedmanlygentleman
source: POKENAME flies at incredible speeds around the globe in search of answers about the mysteries of the world. Historians often find artefacts from ancient civilisations in a POKENAME's nest.

entry: POKENAME常与吼吼鲸一系和乌波的融合体同行，描绘大陆形状、洋流，分享给其他水属性宝可梦。两者都难耐温暖气候，因此知识仅限较冷地区。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME and Wailper often journey together, mapping out the shape of continents and ocean currents which they share with other Water Pokémon. They both struggle in warm climates, so their knowledge is limited to cooler regions.

entry: POKENAME几乎不做事，常坐在一片泥里望向远方。动得太快或太突然，甚至会昏倒。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME do very little and are primarily seen sitting in patches of mud, staring into the distance. If POKENAME move too fast or suddenly, it can cause them to pass out.

entry: POKENAME对他人的心思和情绪洞察极深，善于照顾受压抑记忆或情感创伤困扰的人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses a powerful insight into the minds and emotional states of others. It serves well in caring for those with repressed memories or emotional trauma.

entry: 融合大幅提升POKENAME的智力，也让它开始敌视人类。有人认为，智慧和自负一起增长，使它如今将人类视为低等生命。
author: sk372
source: Fusion has increased POKENAME's intellect greatly, but has also caused it to become aggressive towards humans. Some believe its mind and ego has grown enough that it now considers them inferior beings.

entry: 许多人声称，只要看进POKENAME的一颗水晶球，就能借它神秘的力量，望见自己的命运。
author: mepp.
source: With its enigmatic powers, many claim that one can see their destiny by simply peering into one of POKENAME's crystal balls.

entry: POKENAME藏在阴影里，有条不紊地击倒偷猎者，保护成群呆呆兽。因为没有毒刺，它会用王冠打晕对方。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME protect groups of Slowpoke by hiding in the shadows and systematically taking down poachers. Due to lacking a stinger, POKENAME will smack their crown on poachers to knock them out.

entry: POKENAME的王冠和钳子硬如钢铁，每条臂里还有一个较小的大脑，能各自独立行动。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's crown and claws have the hardness of steel. It has a smaller brain in each of its arms, enabling them to operate independently.

entry: 大舌贝咬住POKENAME的头后，它获得了神秘力量与近似人类的智慧。可大脑尚未适应，反应依旧慢得出奇。
author: sontyp
source: When a Shellder bit POKENAME's head, it developed mystical powers and a human-like intelligence. Its brain can't adapt to this yet, so it is incredibly slow to react.

entry: 野外研究者最好留意好奇的POKENAME。它虽无恶意，却常想凑近看研究什么，不小心烧伤研究者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Field researchers are advised to be wary of curious POKENAME. Though their intentions are innocent, POKENAME are prone to accidentally burning researchers in their efforts to get close and see what's being studied.

entry: POKENAME智力高，掌握的战术理论多得无可比拟。它宁可用智慧指挥同伴，也不愿亲自上战场。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses a high intellect and an unparalleled number of tactical doctrines. It prefers using its intelligence to direct allies in battle, rather than taking to the battlefield itself.

entry: POKENAME深思时，会蜷成球，转圈滚动。一想到天才主意，就展开身体，兴奋地撞向最近的东西；撞伤了头，转眼又忘。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME curls into a ball and rolls around in circles when it is in deep thought. Once it has come up with a genius idea, it uncurls and tackles the nearest object it can find in excitement. The head injury from the impact then causes it to forget.

entry: POKENAME常向人投映幻象，承诺只要一点小礼，就能赐予王室头衔。它虽能造出幻影王冠，却给不了真正头衔，只是爱收集钱。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME frequently projects illusions to humans, promising them a royal title for only a small gift. POKENAME is not able to grant any real titles, though it can project an illusory crown, and merely enjoys collecting currency.

entry: POKENAME穿越时间时，会想出周密计划，恢复自然往日荣光，让世界成为和平乐土。可一抵达，就全忘了，离开那个时代。
author: soup1900
source: While a POKENAME travels through time, it comes up with an elaborate plan to restore the world to a peaceful utopia by regrowing nature to its former glory. As soon as it reaches its destination, though, it forgets and leaves the time period.

entry: POKENAME看似心不在焉，其实正在盘算下一场恶作剧。毛很短，却防水，触感如天鹅绒。
author: shreks_stepfather
source: POKENAME may appear absent-minded, but it is actually scheming its next act of mischief. It has very short but waterproof fur with the texture of velvet.

entry: POKENAME一想模仿什么，就会跟着目标走，尽可能学尽各方面。正因如此，许多人收它作学生或学徒，简直是完美弟子。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Once a POKENAME tries to mimic something, it will follow its subject around, learning every possible aspect about it that it can. Many take on POKENAME as students or apprentices for this very reason, as they make the perfect pupils.

entry: POKENAME爱到拥挤市场观察、模仿人。脑里记下太多细节，可能的做法多得反而不知所措，只能坐着，没精打采地望着人来人往。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME likes to find crowded marketplaces so that it can watch people and try to mimic them. It captures so many details in its head that it often becomes paralyzed with possibilities and simply sits there staring listlessly at all the activity.

entry: POKENAME友善聪明，很受幼儿父母青睐。它细心看护孩子，教导知识，帮助情感和智力发展。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a friendly and intelligent creature often sought after by parents of small children. It watches over the children carefully, tutoring them and helping with their emotional and intellectual development.

entry: POKENAME游过溪流，会无意放出电脉冲，击晕附近宝可梦。若发现自己造成伤害，便短暂惊慌，再游走。
author: .izik
source: While swimming through creeks, POKENAME unintentionally releases electric pulses that stun nearby Pokémon. Should it notice it has caused harm, it panics briefly before swimming away.

entry: 头顶的壳咬住颅骨时，POKENAME会突然饥饿，尤其想吃龙火果。这种树果能让它在压力下忽然顿悟。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME experience surges of hunger whenever the shell atop their head bites onto their skulls. When this happens, a particular craving for Petaya Berries occurs that give them epiphanies whenever they are stressed.

entry: POKENAME智慧惊人，记得最佳捕鱼处，再飞过去。流线型翅膀适合飞行，行动无声，让捕鱼不易被察觉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has incredible intellect that allows it to remember the best locations to catch fish and soar through the sky to reach those places. Its sleek and aerodynamic wings allow it to travel silently, so it can fish without being noticed.

entry: POKENAME头上的壳储着海量数据，再以数据为食，为强大的超能力属性招式供能。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stores vast amounts of data within the shell on its head. It feeds off this data to fuel its powerful Psychic-Type moves.

entry: POKENAME智慧广大，头上的壳又增强精神力量。它住在海滩，守望人类，保护他们免受海洋危险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses vast intellect as well as psychic powers enhanced by the shell on its head. It resides in beach areas, watching over humans and protecting them from the ocean's dangers.

entry: POKENAME被称为沙堡英雄，奋力保护海滩玩耍的孩子。潮水毁掉沙堡，它就算出最合适的干沙位置，让孩子重建。
author: karmaofevil
source: Said to be the hero of sandcastles, POKENAME fiercely protects children enjoying a day on the beach. When the tides destroy a child sandcastles, it calculates the best dry sand spot to build on.

entry: POKENAME以类似王者之证的物体为核心，显现成井状。常露出的呆呆兽是否才是真身，至今争论热烈。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: With an object similar to a King's Rock as its keystone, POKENAME manifests with a well-like shape. Active debates are held over whether the Slowpoke often spotted is POKENAME's true form.

entry: POKENAME用头撞敌人时，很小心不弄坏王冠。受到威胁，就在头周围撑起念力屏障。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It is very careful to not damage its crown when head butting enemies. POKENAME surrounds its head in a psychic barrier when threatened.

entry: POKENAME心智强大，外壳更强，能充分抵御对手。它极不喜欢暴力，总先尝试和平解决，最后才考虑战斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's strong mind and even stronger shell covering gives it ample defense against opponents. It is very disinclined towards violence, so it always tries to solve problems peaceably before it resorts to battling.

entry: POKENAME看似懒散，思绪却始终活跃，深深思考。智慧让它能完成了不起的事，例如学习手语、用手语交流。
author: mepp.
source: While POKENAME may appear lazy as it loafs about, its mind is constantly active and in deep contemplation. Its intellect allows it to accomplish great feats such as learning and communicating through sign language.

entry: POKENAME睡着时，鬼魅能力受到压制，真正醒来才完全发动。平时总能听见轻轻鼾声，一旦停止，就说明它快醒了。
author: aurange
source: POKENAME's ghastly abilities are held in check while it slumbers, but its powers fully activate when it finally wakes up. Normally, POKENAME can always be heard snoring softly. If this Pokémon ever stops snoring, it's a sign that it will soon awaken.

entry: POKENAME头上的球藏着大部分力量。情绪不安或觉得危险时，可能控制不住。传说甚至有整片城区因此毁灭。
author: sottiwotti
source: The orb on POKENAME's head contains most of its power. When it becomes distressed or feels endangered, POKENAME might lose control over this contained power. There are stories about whole city districts being destroyed because of this.

entry: 乍看像POKENAME抛弃了大舌贝，其实只是坐在里面。它不如呆呆王聪明，却因大舌贝变得结实，获得更好保护。
author: jangodiot
source: Although at first glance it seems that POKENAME has abandoned its Shellder, it's actually sitting inside of it. It isn't as smart as Slowking, but it is more protected since the Shellder has become sturdier.

entry: POKENAME精通剑术，乐于教其他生命战斗。现代武器出现后，这些教诲便只受爱好者重视。
author: .fedoraman
source: Wise in the art of swordsmanship, POKENAME readily teaches others how to fight. The advent of modern weaponry has made POKENAME's teachings only valued among hobbyists.

entry: POKENAME优雅，虽大多住在海里，节庆时却常上岸与人共舞。据说被选作舞伴，是健康幸福的吉兆。
author: ludacriswell
source: Although this graceful, aquatic Pokémon mostly spends its time in the ocean, POKENAME often come ashore during festivals to dance with humans. When POKENAME choose someone as a dance partner, it is said to be an omen of good health and happiness.

entry: POKENAME住在岛屿洞穴，偏好独处。头上的壳散出气息，让靠得太近的来者平静下来。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its home in island caves, preferring solitude. The aura emanating from the shell on its head calms anyone who draws too close.

entry: POKENAME会死死盯着它认为有威胁的人。在野外遇见它时，应避开目光，慢慢走远。
author: duskrd
source: POKENAME will intensely stare at anyone that it considers a threat. If you encounter one in the wild, slowly walk away without making eye contact.

entry: POKENAME一个齿轮极聪明，另一个明显不是。笨的那个常自行走掉，逼它用精神力量拉回，提醒必须待在一起才能活。
author: sk372
source: One of the gears is highly intelligent, the other is decidedly not. The dimmer of the two often wanders off, forcing POKENAME to use psychic power to pull it back and remind it that the two need to stay together to survive.

entry: POKENAME因头上的壳而洞察惊人，却也很情绪化。火爆脾气，让保持理性变得困难。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gain powerful insights because of the shell on their head but are also quite emotional creatures. Their hot temper makes any attempt at rationality difficult.

entry: 鱼咬住POKENAME尾巴，它就甩向附近岩石，通常足以击晕，让猎物无法行动。若还不能稳稳吃到，就用大王冠头撞目标。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME takes fish that bite onto its tail and flings them onto nearby rocks to stun them, rendering most prey incapacitated. If this is not enough to secure its meal, it headbutts its target using its large crown.

entry: POKENAME极其聪明，据说壳帽上的宝石蕴藏无尽知识。壳似乎怎么也摘不下，谁哪怕只是想试，它便发出强大精神冲击波，将对方吹走。
author: sk372
source: Highly intelligent, it's said the gem on POKENAME's shell-cap contains an infinite well of knowledge. The shell appears impossible to remove, and POKENAME emits powerful psychic shockwaves to blow away those who even think of trying.

entry: POKENAME天生好奇，什么一引起注意，就会停整整一天。一日过去，便记住目标的一切，再继续漫游。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME are very curious by nature. When something catches their attention, they stop moving for the whole day. When a day passes, POKENAME will have memorized everything about the object of interest and will resume wandering.

entry: POKENAME歌声轻快，听者都会振奋。水手常停下工作，聆听那短暂旋律。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sing with a lighthearted lilt that lifts the spirits of anyone who listens to their song. Sailors often stop working to listen to the transient melody of the POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME往做梦者额头滴水，解除噩梦。头上的大舌贝吸收噩梦，让它闲时慢慢探索，试着理解他人。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME drips its water onto dreamers' foreheads to relieve them of nightmares. The Shellder on its head absorbs the nightmares, allowing POKENAME to explore them at its leisure as it seeks to understand others.

entry: POKENAME身上奇怪的冠状蘑菇，似乎大幅提升了智力，代价却是削弱身体力量和行动能力。
author: sk372
source: The strange crown-like mushroom covering POKENAME's body appears to have greatly enhanced its intelligence. However, it seems to have come at the cost of weakening its body in both strength and mobility.

entry: 即使智慧广大，POKENAME仍认定，最喜欢的莫过于整天坐桑拿。它喷出的水非常温暖。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Even with its vast wisdom, POKENAME has decided it enjoys nothing more than sitting around in saunas all day. The water it spouts is very warm.

entry: 比起各种音乐，POKENAME似乎更爱跟教学音频跳舞。精力和学习热情，尤其能感染年幼、好奇的宝可梦。城市附近水边能找到它。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME seems to enjoy dancing to the audio of instructional media rather than any type of music. Its energy and passion for learning is particularly infectious to young and curious Pokémon. It can be found by bodies of water near urban areas.

entry: POKENAME智慧强盛得难以理解，甚至让脑袋自行起火。眼神虽显得冷静精明，脾气其实很火爆。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME's vast intelligence is so incomprehensible that its own head spontaneously combusts from the sheer potency of it. Though its calculating eyes suggest it has a calm demeanor, it actually is quite hotheaded.

entry: POKENAME智力惊人，能造出别具一格的璀璨宝石。含有少许大舌贝毒素的宝石，在全球市场上价值数百万以上。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's incredible intellect allows it to create dazzling and unique gems unlike any other. Gemstones that have bits of Shellder poison within them are worth over millions on global markets.

entry: POKENAME被称为海中媒人，似乎总知道哪两只宝可梦将相爱。不过，这份牵线本领是否也适用于人类，尚不清楚。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has been described as the matchmaker of the sea, as it always seems to know when two Pokémon are going to fall in love. It is not known if its matchmaking knowledge is effective on humans, however.

entry: POKENAME洞悉自己所处世界冷峻的现实。头上的壳一咬紧，就会陷入对自身存在的深深恐惧，常引发剧烈偏头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gain great insights on the sober reality they live in. They experience existential dread whenever the shell on their head bites against their skull, which often leads to a powerful migraine.

entry: POKENAME用心灵感应与同类交流复杂想法。需求难以说明时，就把念头传进人脑，让对方明白为何提出古怪要求。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME communicates complex ideas with others of its kind through telepathy. Whenever it has a hard time explaining its needs, it beams thoughts into a person's mind to elucidate why it asks for outlandish things.

entry: POKENAME极其自负，常强行领导不情愿的宝可梦群或训练家。权威一受质疑，就勃然大怒，用头上的壳撞击眼前一切。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME have incredibly high egos, often imposing their leadership onto unwilling groups of Pokémon or Trainers. If their authority is ever questioned, they will become enraged, using the shell on their heads to headbutt anything in sight.

entry: POKENAME看似王者般高傲疏离，其实只是迟钝，不愿过快反应。真动起来速度很快，却非得有性命之危，才能让它行动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: What appears to be a regal bearing and aloofness in the attitude of POKENAME is actually a slow wittedness and reluctance to react too quickly. When roused to act, POKENAME can move quickly but nothing short of life-threatening danger can move them.

entry: POKENAME在向阳处休息，靠光合作用保持思维敏锐活跃。阳光不够，身体就迟缓，心智也开始衰退。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rests itself in sunny areas, its photosynthesis helping to keep its mind sharp and active. Without enough sunlight, its body becomes sluggish and its mind starts to deteriorate.

entry: 沉重石质躯干限制速度，POKENAME行动缓慢，却有条不紊。想独自思考时，就把头和四肢缩进石里，躲开其他生命。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's movements are slow and methodical as its heavy stone torso limits its speed. It can tuck its limbs and head into the stone to hide away from others when it wants to be alone with its thoughts.

entry: 偶尔，大舌贝毒素效力不足，无法完全进化成呆呆王，便形成POKENAME。虽然仍比呆呆兽聪明许多，它却主要用智慧想办法更高效地偷懒。
author: sk372
source: On occasion, Shellder's toxins aren't effective enough to create a full evolution to Slowking, resulting in POKENAME. Though still quite a bit more intelligent than Slowpoke, POKENAME mostly uses its intellect for more efficient ways to be lazy.

entry: POKENAME通过手杖引导广大智慧。一与手杖分开，就失去精神能力和学到的一切，重聚后才恢复。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME channel grand wisdom through the staff that they carry. If they are separated from their staff, they lose their psychic abilities and all the knowledge they have attained until they are reunited with their staff.

entry: 许多沿海社区里，谁给POKENAME讲故事，它就送一根壳上的刺。每逢晴朗周末，许多家庭来分享趣闻，这项消遣已代代相传。
author: quackquackattack
source: In many coastline communities, POKENAME offer spikes from their shell to people who tell them a story. Many families come on a sunny weekend to share entertaining stories, a pastime that has been passed down with each new generation.

entry: POKENAME全身受铠甲保护，常沉迷思绪，相信自己的智慧绝对正确。幸好，壳被撞击的浑厚响声，足以赶在真正受伤前，让它回到现实。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Fully protected by armor, POKENAME often get lost in their own minds and believe their wisdom to be absolute. Luckily, the profound ringing of an impact against their shells is enough to snap them back to reality before they sustain any real damage.

entry: 大钳蟹和巨钳蟹似乎认可POKENAME的壳冠象征权威，它挥钳就能指挥。让对方替自己找食物，它就能尽量少动。
author: .jerden
source: It can wave its claw around to direct Krabby and Kingler, which seem to recognise its shell crown as a symbol of authority. By instructing them to gather food for it, POKENAME can move as little as possible.

entry: POKENAME皮肤里有深青绿色素，能吸收阳光。背上的花苞吸引传粉者，可尚未成熟，里面找不到花粉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a dark teal pigment in their skin that allows them to absorb sunlight. The flower bud on their back attracts pollinators, but no pollen can be found as it is not yet mature.

entry: POKENAME轻轻托着尾尖球茎，等待开花。它用藤蔓在树梢间迅速穿行，躲避天敌。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gently cradle the bulbs at the end of their tails, waiting for them to bloom. They use their vines to quickly dart between treetops in order to avoid predators.

entry: 谁靠得太近，POKENAME头顶的叶状结构就会电击对方。雷雨时，叶片吸收电力，保护森林免遭雷击。
author: oreee0230
source: The leafy structure on POKENAME's head zaps others when they are too close. During thunderstorms, these leaves absorb electricity to protect the forest from lightning strikes.

entry: POKENAME由六颗蛋组成，只有五颗有脸。第六颗上面开着鲜艳花朵，受到另外五颗的拼命保护。
author: cait_sith
source: A POKENAME consists of six eggs, only five of which have faces. The sixth egg, which bears a vibrant flower, is fiercely guarded by the other five eggs.

entry: POKENAME常挥动那根有生命的手杖，像个小巫师。人们以为它有神秘的法力，但也许只是装装样子。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME often waves its living staff around like a tiny wizard. People assume it has mystical powers, but it may just be an act.

entry: POKENAME高强度练腿、开始疲倦时，会散出浓郁花香。刚完成光合作用，踢击便格外迅速，威力惊人。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME begins to tire during intense leg-training sessions, it starts releasing a rich floral fragrance. Immediately after photosynthesising, its kicks become extraordinarily fast and devastatingly powerful.

entry: POKENAME高强度练腿、开始疲倦时，会散出浓郁花香。刚完成光合作用，踢击便格外迅速，威力惊人。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME begins to tire during intense leg-training sessions, it starts releasing a rich floral fragrance. Immediately after photosynthesising, its kicks become extraordinarily fast and devastatingly powerful.

entry: POKENAME爱吃树果，用背上球茎的甜香吸引虫属性宝可梦，替最爱的树果灌木传粉。果实一熟，就开心地大吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love berries. They attract Bug-type Pokémon to pollinate their favorite berry bushes by releasing a sweet scent from the bulb on their back. Once the berries are ripe, they happily dig in.

entry: POKENAME不断散出头顶花苞的芳香，常被养在家里作天然空气清新剂。不过，花粉可能引起人和宝可梦过敏。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME constantly emits a fragrant aroma that smells like the bud on its head, which is why it is often used as a natural air freshener in homes. However, the pollen from its flower can cause allergies in both Pokémon and humans.

entry: 为了让头顶花苞绽放，POKENAME只吃同样晒着太阳的叶片，同时从两处获取能量。临近开花时，却会散发难闻的气味。
author: soup1900
source: To help the bud on its head bloom, POKENAME will only eat leaves that are also in the bright sunlight to gain energy from two sources at once. When its bud is about to bloom, it releases a repulsive smell.

entry: POKENAME十分保护球茎，硬化身体，挡住来袭威胁。有东西从背后接近，就射出一阵锋利叶片，试图驱退。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are very protective of their bulbs, hardening their bodies so that they can protect it from incoming threats. If something approaches them from behind, they will launch a flurry of sharp leaves to try and repel it.

entry: POKENAME产生烂水果味的有毒气体，沾遍每处角落缝隙。训练家想除味，会用柑橘擦皮肤，靠酸分解化学成分。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produces a noxious gas that smells like rotten fruit, which clings to every nook and crevice. Trainers who want to rid themselves of the scent rub citrus fruits on their skin, as the acid breaks down the chemical.

entry: POKENAME吸收其他宝可梦释放的毒物，增强自身毒性。它吸得很开心，毒性越强，花苞也越鲜艳。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME strengthens its own toxicity by absorbing poisonous substances released by other Pokémon. It happily absorbs these toxins, making its buds become more vibrant as its toxicity increases.

entry: POKENAME不断用角蹭岩石和树干，把孢子揉进去，缓解藤蔓够不到的角根瘙痒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME constantly scratch their horn against rocks and tree trunks to rub in spores. The spores help prevent itchiness around the horn where their vines cannot reach.

entry: POKENAME带着的花苞养分充足，已准备绽放。它很警觉，稍有动静就迅速逃走。
author: oreee0230
source: The buds carried by POKENAME are full of nutrients ready to bloom. It is quite alert and will quickly flee at the slightest disturbance.

entry: POKENAME袋中的幼崽很像妙蛙草。两者相互合作，帮助彼此生存。
author: oreee0230
source: The baby Pokémon in POKENAME's pouch resembles an Ivysaur. The two mutually work together to help each other survive.

entry: POKENAME用花苞引来猎物，再喷水击晕。若不小心引来大宝可梦，就放出墨云，遮住自己逃跑。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME uses its flower bud to attract prey, then shoots water to stun them. If it accidentally attracts a large Pokémon, it will use a cloud of ink to cover itself and escape.

entry: POKENAME生活在丛林河流，叶片状的鳍帮助伪装。头上花朵的甜香，会被收集加入香水。
author: mepp.
source: Living in jungle rivers, POKENAME's leaf-like fins help it camouflage. The sweet aroma produced from the flower on its head is collected and added to perfumes.

entry: POKENAME常住红树林沼泽，在淹水的树根间生活。大半时间待在水面，进行光合作用，也让虫属性宝可梦为花传粉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are often found in mangrove swamps, living amongst the submerged roots of the trees. They spend most of the time at the surface of the water, photosynthesizing and allowing their flowers to be pollinated by Bug-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用来作尾巴的花繁复美丽，很受观赏池饲养者欢迎。它通常倒悬在水面附近，让花露在空气中。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular Pokémon to keep in ornamental ponds thanks to the elaborate flowers that they use as a tail. They typically linger near the surface of the water, hanging upside down with their flower exposed to the air.

entry: POKENAME迅速旋转时，会向敌人甩出锋利叶片。它住在暖海，温和气候让星形身体健康、充满活力。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME spins rapidly, it hurls razor-sharp leaves at its foes. It inhabits warm seas, where the gentle climate keeps its star-shaped body healthy and vibrant.

entry: 退潮时，许多POKENAME困在沙滩，涨潮前几乎没办法回水里。幸好还能甩动滑溜藤蔓，抵御天敌。
author: quackquackattack
source: At low tide, many POKENAME are stranded on beaches with few ways to get back into the water until high tide returns. Fortunately, they can defend themselves against predators by whipping them with slippery vines.

entry: POKENAME爱表演围绕花朵的古怪小把戏，常见的一招，是将藤蔓变成一把花瓣。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy performing quirky little tricks that revolve around flowers. A common trick they like to perform revolves around transforming a vine into a bunch of petals.

entry: POKENAME翅膀太小，托不起身体长时间飞行。它改用镰刀挂在树上，再跳下，伏击无防备的猎物。
author: amityblamity
source: POKENAME's wings are too small to support its body for long periods of flight. Instead, it hangs from trees with its scythes and leaps down onto unsuspecting prey.

entry: POKENAME毫不谦逊，希望所有目光都看着自己。它甩响藤鞭、扬起飞叶，吸引注意。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are far from modest creatures and want all the attention to be on them. They crack vine whips and create fluttering leaves to draw focus towards themselves.

entry: POKENAME头上的叶子虽不硬，却很锋利。白天用嘴里的藤蔓吃果子、嫩叶，夜里则钻进地下避寒。
author: oreee0230
source: Although the leaf on POKENAME's head is not hard, it is very sharp. During the day, POKENAME uses the vine in its mouth to eat fruits and tender leaves, and at night, it digs underground to avoid the cold.

entry: POKENAME发起决斗，争夺族群首领。每打一场，鬃毛就更鲜艳，因此首领往往有亮红鬃毛。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME initiates duels to compete for leadership of its herd. Its mane becomes more vivid with each battle it goes through, so leaders of its herd often have bright red manes.

entry: 为了让身上两个花苞都晒够太阳，POKENAME必须部分露出水面，或侧着游，或轮流正游、仰游。
author: bobosmith01
source: To make sure both flowering buds on its body get enough sunlight, POKENAME has to partially reveal itself above the water's surface, either swimming sideways, or by alternating swimming right side-up and upside down.

entry: POKENAME借花苞掩护，藏在开花的灌木丛中，啃食里面的叶子。饱餐之后，它们会沿灌木基部种下嫩芽，帮助灌木更快长回来。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their bulbs to hide among flower bushes, eating away at the leaves within. Once they have finished their meal, they will plant sprouts along the base of the bush to help it grow back sooner.

entry: POKENAME水中动作出奇优雅，边游边用藤蔓抓猎物。等对方不动，就吞下，因此很少需要光合作用。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME moves through the water with surprising grace. While it swims, it uses the vines on its body to snatch up prey. Once the prey stops moving, it devours them. As a result, POKENAME rarely needs to photosynthesize.

entry: POKENAME不合群，却不算特别凶猛，喜欢游在少受打扰的深水。只有让球形花苞晒太阳时，才到水面。
author: sk372
source: Antisocial but not overly aggressive, POKENAME prefers to swim in watery depths where few others will bother it. It only goes to the water's surface to let its flower bulb take in sunlight.

entry: POKENAME伪装成附近植物的一部分。小宝可梦若靠近，它可能试着啃咬对方。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a part of nearby plants. If small Pokémon come close, it may try to nibble on them.

entry: POKENAME的鬃毛和球茎状尾巴，在阳光下吸收养分后会变大。它常住茂密雨林，暴风雨时能随雨水完全消失。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME's mane and bulb tail grow larger in size when in sunlight as they absorb nutrients. They tend to stay in dense rainforests as they are able to completely vanish with the rain from storms.

entry: POKENAME从雷暴收集能量，叶片因多余电力噼啪作响。它也吸收阳光，确保随时精力充沛。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME gathers energy from lightning storms; its leaves crackle with excess electricity. It can also absorb sunlight to ensure it is always full of energy.

entry: POKENAME叶片含有耐火成分。吃太多、产生过多热量时，就到凉爽通风处，展开叶片散热。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's leaves contain fire-resistant chemicals. When it eats too much and creates too much heat, it goes to a cool, ventilated place to spread its leaves and dissipate heat.

entry: POKENAME在数码工具中担任助手，帮助用户辨认出游时遇见的花草种类。发现从未见过的品种，就会尖声叫。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is used within digital tools as an assistant to help users identify specific types of flowers or plants encountered during their excursions. If it discovers a variety never seen before, it emits a high-pitched cry.

entry: POKENAME花苞坚硬，叶片坚韧，用叶裹住身体，就能保护自己免遭危险。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's buds are hard, and its leaves are tough. By wrapping its body with leaves, POKENAME can protect itself from danger.

entry: POKENAME捕猎时收拢花苞，向前猛扑，用利齿咬。花苞由轻盈花瓣构成，让它比甲壳厚重的多刺菊石兽更快。
author: oreee0230
source: When hunting, POKENAME tightens its bud and lunges forward to bite with its sharp teeth. Its flower bud is made out of lightweight petals, making it faster than a heavily armored Omastar.

entry: POKENAME高栖花树，混在盛开的花间伪装，等待进化。天敌若靠近住处，就从球茎射出一阵毒针。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME perch high in flowering trees, disguising themselves among the blooming flowers while they wait to evolve. If a predator approaches the tree they call home, they will spray a volley of poisonous needles from their bulbs.

entry: POKENAME住在海中洞穴深处，能安心让背上粉红花苞完全绽放。细小的腿让它轻松攀上任何表面。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lives deep within marine caves, where it can peacefully let the pink bud on its back bloom fully. Its small legs allow it to climb any surface with ease.

entry: 背和尾巴上的粉红花苞散出甜香，引来其他宝可梦。POKENAME优雅飞过森林，用强翼迅速穿行栖居的树枝间。
author: fiordaliso
source: The pink buds on its back and tail release a sweet aroma that lures other Pokémon toward it. POKENAME flies gracefully through the forest, using its strong wings to dart between the branches of the trees it calls home.

entry: POKENAME爱在花园打盹，一睡着就搬不动。建议在附近留些掰断的黄瓜，它讨厌那气味，便会慢慢挪走。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME loves to nap in gardens and becomes impossible to move once asleep. It is recommended to leave broken cucumbers nearby, as it finds their smell disgusting and will slowly shuffle away.

entry: POKENAME一拍动茂密的翅膀，周围就满是温暖花香。即使已经飞上天空很久，诱人的香气仍久久不散。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME flaps their bushy wings, the area around them is flooded with the warm aroma of flowers. This alluring scent lingers long after POKENAME take off into the sky.

entry: POKENAME的鳞皮蜕下时，带着一片能净化毒素的花瓣。花瓣虽贵，若从蜕皮摘下，就失去力量，迅速枯萎。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's scaly skin sheds with a petal attached that can purify poison. These petals are valuable, but lose their power if removed from the shed skin, quickly withering away.

entry: POKENAME用藤蔓固定在树上，全身都能毒蜇，尤其叶片和藤蔓毒性最强。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME uses vines to secure itself to a tree. Each part of POKENAME's body has a venomous sting and is especially potent in its leaves and vines.

entry: POKENAME靠球茎周围的大叶飞行。先藏在树冠，再卷着叶片风暴飞出，猎物看见毒刺时，早已太晚。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME fly using the large fronds around their bulbs. They hide among the treetops before flying out in a storm of leaves, its prey only seeing their poisonous stingers once it's too late.

entry: POKENAME一次精神脉冲，就能加速附近植物生长。可再有这本领，也没法让尾花更快绽放。
author: quackquackattack
source: With a single psychic pulse, POKENAME can accelerate the growth of plants around them. Despite this power, they cannot force the flower on their tail to bloom faster.

entry: POKENAME背上的花香气浓烈，能减轻偏头痛造成的疼痛。它极其罕见，独居丛林深处。
author: fiordaliso
source: The flower on POKENAME's back gives off an intense fragrance that can relieve the pain caused by migraines. It is an extremely rare Pokémon that lives a solitary life in the heart of the jungle.

entry: POKENAME用背叶吸收空气杂质，净化四周。必须持续有阳光，才能完成过程，否则毒素过多，叶片就会枯萎。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME absorb impurities in the air through the leaves on their back to cleanse the air around them. They need a steady supply of sunlight to complete the process, otherwise their leaves will wilt from excess toxins.

entry: POKENAME颈花晒到太阳，会产生宜人香气。因为能让植物恢复生机，古文将它描绘为带来春日祝福的精灵。
author: mepp.
source: The flower on POKENAME's neck produces a pleasant scent when exposed to sunlight. Because POKENAME has the ability to revitalize plants, ancient texts described it as a spirit that brings blessings of spring.

entry: POKENAME光合作用吸收大量阳光，体温大幅上升。干季晒太阳时，曾不小心点燃灌木。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME absorb so much sunlight through photosynthesis that their body temperatures rise dramatically. During dry seasons, these Pokémon have been known to accidentally set brush ablaze while basking.

entry: POKENAME背上火焰周围的叶片耐热，白天用阳光滋养火焰。晴天会冒出甜香烟雾，仿佛正在燃香。
author: .jerden
source: The leaves around the fire on its back are heatproof and feed the flame with sunlight during the day. On sunny days, POKENAME will produce sweet-smelling smoke, as if it is burning incense.

entry: POKENAME暴怒时，背上炽红烈焰会点燃附近植物。可裹身的叶片始终耐火，无论多热也从不枯萎。
author: .jerden
source: When POKENAME is enraged, the red-hot fire on its back will ignite nearby plant life. Despite this, the leaf wrapped around its body always remains fireproof and never wilts, regardless of how hot it gets.

entry: POKENAME住在热带雨林河流，只露球茎和眼睛。它爱玩，却不明白自己有多危险，没防备的来者可能挨上狠咬。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found in the rivers of tropical rainforests, only their bulb and eyes poking above the water line. They are playful Pokémon, but have a poor sense of the threat they can pose and can give a nasty bite to the unwary.

entry: POKENAME住在热带雨林河流，只露球茎和眼睛。它用背藤抓来岸边看着有趣的东西，拉近咬一咬。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found in the rivers of tropical rainforests, only their bulb and eyes poking above the water line. They use the vines on their back to grab interesting looking things on the shoreline and bring them close to bite on.

entry: POKENAME悠闲躺在河岸晒太阳，让花朝着阳光。若被叫醒，脾气就不好，谁打扰晒太阳，就朝谁咬。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lounge on river banks sunning themselves and keeping their flower pointing toward the sun. They are grumpy if woken up, snapping at whoever disturbs their sunbathing time.

entry: POKENAME头顶触角能准确分清植物与猎物。毒刺来不及出击时，腹部花苞就会喷出毒气。
author: oreee0230
source: The antennae on POKENAME's head can accurately separate plants from prey. The flower bud on its abdomen sprays a toxic gas when it cannot attack fast enough with its stinger.

entry: POKENAME收集散叶筑巢。满意后，再用剩叶，在背上球茎周围搭一个小号的巢。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gather scattered leaves to form their nests. Once they are happy with their nests, they use any leftover leaves to create a smaller version around the bulbs on their backs.

entry: POKENAME一连几天都纹丝不动地待在水里，只露球茎。真要行动，就是捕食，能突然爆发惊人速度。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME will hang motionless in the water for days on end, only their bulb visible above the water. When they do move, it's to hunt for food, and they are capable of a surprising burst of speed.

entry: POKENAME成群背对太阳、用尾巴支身，晒起日光浴。晒时，各自轮流站岗。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME gather together into groups with their backs to the sun to sunbathe, using their tails to support themselves. As they sunbathe, they each take turns keeping guard.

entry: POKENAME花苞虽未成熟，却能排出催眠力很强的花粉。它在日光下打盹，偶尔也因自己的花粉而沉沉睡去。
author: silverscloudy
source: Though POKENAME's floral buds are immature, they can expel potent pollen that can cause drowsiness. POKENAME nap in the sunlight, occasionally falling into a deep sleep due to their own pollen.

entry: POKENAME花瓣冠很锋利，因此偶尔会头朝前冲进战场。眼周的粉红色夜里微微发亮，分散猎物注意，也能威吓。
author: silverscloudy
source: Due to the sharpness of POKENAME's petal crown, they occasionally rush into battle headfirst. The pink coloration around their eyes faintly glow at night, distracting and intimidating their prey.

entry: 背上的球茎让POKENAME更易受冻，冬季尤其难以生存。它常借其他宝可梦的洞睡觉，保持温暖。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have an especially difficult time surviving during winter because the flower bulb on their back exposes them to freezing temperatures. They often sleep in another Pokémon's burrow to keep warm.

entry: POKENAME大花苞很显眼，因此会从附近树上伏击。若网住的猎物耐毒，它可能放走，另找更容易捕捉的。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's prominent flower bud is quite conspicuous, so it ambushes prey from a nearby tree. If the prey caught in its web resists its poison, they may be released so it can find prey that is easier to capture.

entry: POKENAME用丝、枝、叶筑巢。捕猎时，从腹部吐丝攀住树枝，等时机伏击。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME builds nests using silk threads, branches, and leaves. When it goes hunting, it spins silk from its abdomen to cling to tree branches, waiting for the right moment to ambush prey.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME无声接近虫属性宝可梦，从林地抓起猎物。沿途留下盛开的花朵。
author: quackquackattack
source: At night, POKENAME silently sneak up on Bug-type Pokémon before plucking prey from the forest floor. They leave blooming flowers in their wake as they hunt.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，谁靠得太近就释放毒孢子。它用大翅膀扇风，把孢子散在巢边，让自己睡着时也能护住盛开的球茎。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are fiercely territorial, releasing poisonous spores if anyone gets too close. They use their large wings to create gusts, spreading the spores around their nests to protect their blooming bulbs while they sleep.

entry: POKENAME很狡黠，潜在泥水下，只露三朵花。传粉者一靠近，就突然电击，有时连小鸟也这样抓到。
author: ludacriswell
source: The trickster, POKENAME, will wait for prey below muddy water and pose with three of its flowers exposed. When a pollinator comes near, it shocks them with an unexpected jolt of electricity. Sometimes, it even catches small birds this way.

entry: POKENAME球茎开花时，会散出甜香，浓得弱小宝可梦可能受不了。它每到春天就开花，秋天再合上。
author: daimposter_60614
source: When an POKENAME's bulb blooms, it lets off a sweet smell that can be too strong for weak Pokémon. This bulb blooms every spring and closes in the fall.

entry: 看不了星星，POKENAME就会闷闷不乐。若训练家带它去看繁星夜空，就会得到好运祝福。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME can be found sulking when it cannot stargaze. If taken for a trip to see the starry night sky by its Trainer, it bestows good luck onto them.

entry: POKENAME开心地一起在星空下跳舞。流星一过，便会结伴追赶。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME will happily dance together under the starry sky. If a shooting star passes, they will try to chase it together.

entry: POKENAME很能干，却紧张易受惊。吓到时就甩出大批藤蔓，不断鞭打惊吓它的东西，直到平静。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are anxious yet capable creatures that are easy to frighten. If startled, they unleash a flurry of vines to whip whatever surprised them until they calm down.

entry: POKENAME用花瓣裹住娇嫩身体。训练家每次帮忙清洁，都会得到一个月的好运祝福。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are wrapped in petals to protect their delicate bodies. Whenever a Trainer helps them clean their bodies, they are blessed with good luck for a month.

entry: POKENAME滑翔时，用背上的叶片帮助掌舵。振翅散落的叶子，则会被它用阵风收拢，引回巢中。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use the leaves on their back to help them steer as they glide along the air. They scatter leaves as they flap their wings, collecting them with gusts of wind and directing them back to their nests.

entry: POKENAME尾上的球茎靠电力进行光合作用。幸好球吸收的阳光会立即转成电力，不必到发电厂偷电。
author: creaturecore
source: The bulb on POKENAME's tail uses electric power to photosynthesize. Luckily POKENAME doesn't have to leech off of power plants because sunlight that is absorbed by the orb is instantly converted into electric power.

entry: 成群POKENAME聚在河岸唱歌。藤鞭一拍肚子，就发出悦耳的咚声，正好作打击乐器，伴着呱呱合唱。
author: quackquackattack
source: Groups of POKENAME gather along the riverbanks to sing songs. Their stomachs release a satisfying thud when slapped with a vine whip, giving them the perfect percussion instrument to go along with their croaking.

entry: POKENAME不断从背上花苞喷出花粉，让自己留在空中。春季最活跃，对花粉过敏的人来说简直是噩梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME constantly pumps pollen from the flower bud on their back to keep themselves airborne. They are most active during spring and are a nightmare for people who are allergic to pollen.

entry: POKENAME弯曲背上的叶片，控制滑翔方向。长时间滑翔后，会在草地晒太阳，滋养背上的花。
author: quackquackattack
source: By bending the leaves on their back, POKENAME control the direction they glide in. After gliding for long periods of time, they sunbathe in a patch of grass to nourish the flower on their back.

entry: POKENAME整天找食物，滋养背上盛开的花，让它更美。开心时自然散出浓香，吸入者都会心情振奋。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME spends its entire day searching for food to nourish the flower blooming on its back, making it grow even more beautiful. When it is happy, it naturally releases a strong fragrance that can lift the spirits of anyone who breathes it in.

entry: 偏远地区的人敬奉POKENAME，它则照料田地作为回报。作物虽没有它也能长，但在没有训练家的村庄，这关系对双方都有益。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME is worshiped in remote areas and is repaid by taking care of the fields. Although crops can still grow without POKENAME, this relationship is beneficial to both sides in villages without Trainers.

entry: 晴天，POKENAME与许多同伴聚在林中空地跳舞。夏季，围着脸的粉红花瓣香气更浓，引来森林各处的野生宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: On sunny days, POKENAME gathers with many of its companions to dance together in forest clearings. In summer, the pink petals framing its face grow more fragrant than ever, drawing wild Pokémon from every corner of the woods.

entry: POKENAME经常捕猎，侧着停在树上进食。背和尾尖的花苞随年龄越来越重，强腿也变得更粗壮，以便支撑。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME hunt regularly, landing sideways on trees to consume their prey. The buds that emerge from their back and tail tip grow heavy as they get older, and their strong legs become thick and strong to support them.

entry: POKENAME生活在草木繁茂的沼泽，用宽大的叶片托着自己漂浮，悄然藏于水面。受惊时，头顶的花便会释放毒孢子。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live in marshy areas covered with flora, using its large leaves to float on the water without being seen. The flower on its head releases poisonous spores when agitated.

entry: POKENAME常张嘴趴平，等睡莲叶自己漂进嘴里。背上的球形花苞，让它在野外很显眼。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often lie flat with their mouth open to wait for lily pads to float into their mouth. The flower bulb on their back makes them easy to spot in the wild.

entry: POKENAME生活在密林和花田，是天生园丁。尾巴像磁针般伸直，指向附近缺乏养分的植物，再用精神强念搬来清水、新土。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Found among dense forests and flower fields, POKENAME are natural gardeners. Their tails straighten and point to nearby malnourished vegetation like a magnet. Using Psychic, POKENAME then ferry fresh water and soil to these needy plants.

entry: POKENAME能借阳光，同时恢复健康、积攒精神能量。必要时，也能将花苞储存的能量转成精神能量，代价却是长时间虚弱。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME can simultaneously restore health and accumulate psychic energy with sunlight. If necessary, POKENAME can convert energy stored in its buds into psychic energy, but this will lead to prolonged weakness.

entry: 野生POKENAME满月时更活跃，斑点映着月光，泛起诡异光芒。
author: 22ndsolstice
source: Wild POKENAME are more active during the full moon. Their spots reflect the moonlight with an eerie glow.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME花中长出黑种子。种子能提炼成油，是“零一号”全地形车等车辆燃料的重要成分。
author: .izik
source: Black seeds grow from POKENAME's blossom at night. These seeds can be refined into oil, which serves as a key component in the fuel for vehicles like the ZERO-ONE.

entry: POKENAME从远方收集种子，在秘密花园种花。夜里摘它的花，被认为会招来厄运。
author: ozydamians
source: It collects seeds from far-off places to plant flowers in a secret garden. It is considered bad luck to pick one of POKENAME's flowers at night.

entry: POKENAME对周围世界洞察极深，总热切地分享知识。它以学识渊博为傲，很少肯闭嘴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gain great insights into the world around them and are always eager to share their knowledge. They pride themselves on their vast knowledge and rarely hold their tongue.

entry: POKENAME白天在田里觅食，滋养背花。开心时散出甜香，据说连最疲惫的心也能安抚。
author: fiordaliso
source: To enrich the flower growing upon its back, POKENAME spends its day foraging through fields. When pleased, it releases a sweet scent believed to soothe even the weariest heart.

entry: POKENAME背上的花苞产生果香与麝香交织的气味。为了给巨大花苞供能，它通过皮肤吸收阳光。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME develop a fruity, musky scent from the flower bud on their back. To fuel this massive bud on their back, they absorb sunlight through their skin.

entry: POKENAME翻找公园和步道旁的垃圾桶，捡好吃的。可背上球茎太大，有时会卡在桶里。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME digs through garbage cans near parks and trails to scavenge tasty treats for itself. Due to the large bulb on its back, sometimes it gets stuck in garbage cans.

entry: POKENAME头顶开着花，能引导神秘能量，迅速催长、操纵花瓣。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: A flower blooms on POKENAME's head. POKENAME can use channel mystical energy to rapidly grow and manipulate the petals of the flower.

entry: POKENAME一生大多不是晒太阳，就是保护花苞。其余身体会承受来袭的攻击。有时，只是看球茎的眼神不对，也能把它吓跑。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME spends most of its life either basking in the sun or protecting its flower bud. The rest of its body soaks up any attacks made against it. Sometimes, simply staring at its bulb the wrong way can scare it away.

entry: POKENAME是害羞的林中生物，皮肤油润。口气像浓烈草药，通常太冲，一般人难以欣赏。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a shy woodland creature with oily skin. Its breath smells like pungent herbs, typically too strong for the average person to enjoy.

entry: 成群POKENAME霸占花田数周，吸蜜，为去下一片花田的旅程供能。它用猛烈的飞叶快刀守住选中的地方，赶走一切靠太近的生命。
author: chibitales
source: Flocks of POKENAME take over fields of flowers for weeks, sipping nectar to fuel their journey to the next field. They will guard their chosen site with flurries of intense Razor Leaf attacks, driving away anything that comes too close.

entry: POKENAME在壳里收集大量花，再用藤蔓绑住树，伪装自己。壳中发酵的花茶很香，多数虫类宝可梦却不喜欢。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME collects a large number of flowers in its shell and then uses vines to tie itself to a tree to camouflage itself. The flower tea fermented inside its shell is very fragrant, but most bug Pokémon dislike it.

entry: POKENAME刚吃完蜂蜜，花就散出香甜气味。冬季几乎从不出巢，因为受不了冷。
author: fiordaliso
source: Right after eating honey, the flower on POKENAME releases a sweet, fragrant aroma. During winter, it is almost never seen outside its den, as it cannot tolerate the cold.

entry: POKENAME藏在花草间躲天敌，可球茎高温下会融化，让炎热天气里的伪装失效。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME hides amongst flowers and other foliage to hide from predators. However, its bulb melts under high temperatures, rendering its disguise useless under hot weather.

entry: POKENAME用腐蚀液溶解岩石，补充养分。活动越多，花苞便逐渐热起来。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME uses corrosive liquids to dissolve rocks to supplement nutrients. Its buds gradually warm up as activity increases.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛带有宜人的草药香，因此很受富商欢迎，常被留在家中。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's feathers have a pleasant herbal scent. As a result, keeping these feathers in one's home is popular among rich business owners.

entry: POKENAME背上花苞准备绽放时，会散出甜香。它用鼻子觅食，有时反而被自己的香味弄糊涂。
author: mistycloud
source: The bud on POKENAME's back gives off a sweet scent when it's ready to bloom. As POKENAME uses its nose to look for food, this sweet smell will sometimes confuse it.

entry: POKENAME头上的枝条很受许多宝可梦喜爱，也是上好的香料。只要清水充足，枝条就再生得极快，因此许多训练家养它牟利。
author: oreee0230
source: The branches on POKENAME's head are loved by many Pokémon and are also an excellent spice. When there is a supply of pure water, the branches of POKENAME regenerate very quickly, which is why many Trainers raise POKENAME for profit.

entry: POKENAME生活在潟湖浅水，通常只让花露在水面。它用满布吸盘的触手固定水底，抵住潮流。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in the shallows of lagoons and are usually seen with just their flowers above the surface. They use their sucker-covered tentacles to anchor themselves to the floor, letting them resist tidal flow.

entry: POKENAME袋状的尾巴装满土。晒太阳时，土中养分增加，再用来给等待开花的植物施肥。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME has a bag-like tail filled with soil. When it basks in the sun, this soil gains more nutrients, which it uses to fertilize plants waiting to bloom.

entry: POKENAME虽成小群生活，却很难好好合作。每只都想当首领，因此常为地位争斗。
author: sk372
source: Despite grouping in small packs, POKENAME have a difficult time cooperating properly with one another. Each one attempts to be seen as the leader, so fights over hierarchy are extremely common.

entry: POKENAME成群生活，对外来者充满敌意。口中火焰能夺去敌人生命，却将养分留在灰烬里。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME lives in packs that are hostile to outsiders. The flames in its mouth have a unique ability to strip the life from its enemies while preserving nutrients in the ashes.

entry: 谁靠得太近，POKENAME就抖尾、释放刺痛人的花粉。警告若被无视，便咬住闯入者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rattle their tails and release a stinging pollen when someone gets too close to them. If the warning is ignored, they bite onto whatever invades their space.

entry: POKENAME渴了，就用鼻子吸水，喷向背上的花。强壮的鼻子只要一扯，就能拔起树果灌木。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME are thirsty, they suck in water from their trunk and spray it onto the flower on their back. This muscular trunk can uproot berry bushes with a single tug.

entry: POKENAME用长鼻浇背上的花，还能卷住树枝，拿来挠背再合适不过。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME water the flower on their back by using their long trunk. This trunk can also grab onto sticks that make for the perfect back scratcher.

entry: POKENAME背藤的抗拉强度极高，因此常被用来驮运重物。
author: dylonk25
source: Due to the immense tensile strength of the vines on its back, POKENAME is commonly used as a beast of burden.

entry: 孩子在网上解谜，每答对一次，POKENAME就得到一阵可吸收的光来补充能量。作为回报，它帮计数器加一，表示一袋米捐给了慈善组织。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gain energy from children solving puzzles on the internet, as each correct answer gives them a burst of light to absorb. In exchange, POKENAME help increment a counter to indicate a bag of rice is donated to a charitable organization.

entry: POKENAME十分疼爱训练家。对方受伤，就用藤蔓包住伤口，再亲亲头。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are doting creatures that love their Trainers. If their Trainer gets hurt, they wrap the wound with vines and give their Trainer kisses on the head.

entry: POKENAME尾巴分泌的液体，对多数生物有毒，会甩出来自卫。有时也用来在自己的花叶上留标记。
author: infinex21
source: The fluid secreted from POKENAME's tails is poisonous to most things and is flung to defend themselves. They sometimes use it to leave markings on their own flowers and leaves.

entry: POKENAME不断长大的球茎，让走路越来越难。外貌可爱、气味香甜，让它成为许多名人的时尚象征，装在手袋或宠物提篮里同行。
author: wiz0z
