source: POKENAME's growing bulb makes it difficult to walk. Alongside their cute appearance and sweet scent, they have become a fashion statement of many high-profile celebrities, riding along in purses and carriers.

entry: POKENAME很温柔，喜欢各种来为花传粉的虫属性宝可梦陪伴。用它的花做成的花束，一年四季都很受欢迎。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is quite gentle, enjoying the company of various Bug-type Pokémon that come to pollinate its flowers. Bouquets made from POKENAME's flowers are very popular all year-round.

entry: POKENAME产奶时，背花散出甜香，能传到许多英里之外。谁敢破坏它住的农场，就用角撞击惩罚。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME produces its milk, the flower on its back releases a sweet aroma that can spread for many miles. If anyone dares to damage the farm it lives on, it punishes them by striking with its horns.

entry: POKENAME带着的花苞能麻痹痛觉，光在附近就能舒缓炎症。花盆几乎没重量，花朵太大却挡住了视线。
author: oreee0230
source: The buds carried by POKENAME have the power to numb pain, as simply being nearby can soothe inflammation. The weight of the flowerpot is negligible, but the size of the flower obscures its vision.

entry: POKENAME背上的盆装满液体，一流出便化为薰香。虽有招财传说，却很难靠近，因为四周植物会产生电火花。
author: oreee0230
source: The pot that POKENAME carries on its back is filled with a liquid that turns into incense as soon as it flows out. While there is a legend that POKENAME can bring wealth, approaching it is difficult as the plants around it produce sparks.

entry: POKENAME叶片吸收阳光，头顶花苞便不断长大。它常躺在花草地里，有时融入得太好，被其他生命不小心踩到。
author: infinex21
source: The flower bud atop POKENAME's head continuously grows as its leaves absorb sunlight. It will often lie in fields of grass and flowers, sometimes blending in so well that others accidentally step on it.

entry: POKENAME喷出一股气，推动自己飞向阳光充足处。气体虽带花香，里面的沙粒却可能引发肺病。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME flies to areas with lots of sunlight by propelling itself forward with a burst of air. Although the gas released carries a floral fragrance, the sand particles in it may cause lung disease.

entry: POKENAME不断成长，背上长出许多不同植物。小宝可梦被天敌追赶，常躲到它身后，因为它往往会出面吓退天敌。
author: quackquackattack
source: As POKENAME continues to grow, many different species of plants grow on their back. Many small Pokémon retreat behind POKENAME when running from predators, as they often intervene to scare the predator away.

entry: POKENAME球茎不断抽走身体能量，所需甚多。训练家会喂它电池，是安全快捷的补能方法。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME requires lots of energy for its bulb, which constantly zaps energy from its body. Trainers are known to give it batteries to eat, as they are a safe and quick method of energizing their POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME头顶球茎不断掉花瓣，跑过森林时留下一路花瓣。受到威胁，就借头上藤蔓跃向高空，再飞踢敌人。
author: ghostslythe
source: The bulb on POKENAME's head constantly sheds petals, leaving a trail behind it as it runs through the woods. If threatened, it will use the vines on its head to launch skyward and dropkick its foes.

entry: POKENAME的头像花苞，其实由石壳构成。真正的花苞藏在头上缝隙里，流出黏稠苦涩的盐水，仿佛蜂蜜。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's head looks like a flower bud, but it is made out of a stony shell. The real flower bud lies within the gap on its head and releases a viscous, bitter brine that flows like honey.

entry: POKENAME吸收过多阳光时，会从尾端的花苞释放多余能量，使周围植物骤然生长。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME absorbs too much sunlight, it dispels this energy through the bud on its tail. This causes plants nearby to suddenly grow.

entry: 它相当圆胖，却有强壮肌肉，支撑头顶生长的植物。会摇树抖下坚果和果实，有时却把树也弄坏。
author: infinex21
source: It is a rather rotund Pokémon, yet it does have strong muscles to support the growing plant atop its head. It will shake trees to loose the nuts and fruits within them, but sometimes damages the tree in the process.

entry: POKENAME四至七只结群，随洋流游向养分丰富的水域。需要特定饮食，为身体与花苞的进化做准备。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME travel in schools of four to seven, following the ocean currents to nutrient-rich waters. They require a specialized diet to prepare their body and their flower bud for evolution.

entry: POKENAME领地意识强，会清除范围内生长的植物。纤细花苞能感知萌发的植物。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME is a territorial creature and will clear plants growing within its domain. Its slender flower buds can sense plants that sprout.

entry: 春天，POKENAME全身开出小花。虽然只有泥土味，营养却丰富，被珍视为应急食物。
author: .izik
source: During spring, tiny flowers bloom across POKENAME's body. Though they taste like plain soil, the flowers are highly nutritious and valued as emergency food.

entry: POKENAME在高树上展开叶片般的翅膀休息，扇翅释放冲击波，震落果实或打开坚果。飞行时，常在身后留下浓密花粉。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME rest atop tall trees with their leafy wings spread apart. To knock free fruits, or to open nuts, they loose shockwaves with beats of their wings. They tend to leave trails of rich pollen behind them as they fly.

entry: POKENAME身上的花苞，不论长得多大、多健康，都毫无香气。只有蓝光直接照射才会开花，其他任何光都不影响生长。
author: soup1900
source: The bud on POKENAME's body has no scent whatsoever, no matter how big and healthy it gets. The bud only ever blooms when directly exposed to blue light; no other types of light affect the growth of the bud.

entry: POKENAME树栖，组成关系紧密的群落，生病或受伤时互相照料。它用尾花交流，靠独特香气辨认彼此。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are arboreal Pokémon that form tight-knit communities, looking after one another when sick or injured. They use the flowers on their tails to communicate, using the unique scents of their tails to identify one another.

entry: POKENAME住在密林，混在蕨叶间伏击小猎物。背上花苞释放舒缓香气，减轻压力、缓解头痛。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME dwells in dense forests, blending among ferns and leaves to ambush small prey. The bud on its back releases a soothing aroma that eases stress and relieves headaches.

entry: POKENAME穿行林地，预感天敌将近，就藏进密草。等危险过去时，会伸长脖子，从灌木里张望。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME traverse the forest floor and use the dense undergrowth to hide in when they anticipate predators. They peer out of the bushes with their long neck while they wait for danger to pass.

entry: 它常向敌人撒叶片和种子，再用火焰全数点燃。强腿让它跳跃灵活，藤蔓也帮助穿行栖居的森林。
author: infinex21
source: It will often scatter leaves and seeds at foes and then use its flames to set it all ablaze. Its strong legs let it jump around, and its vines help it better navigate forest homes.

entry: POKENAME在地表下挖掘，很少将头和四肢露出。背花又苦又臭，因此从不必担心被捕食。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME rarely exposes its head and limbs above ground, tunneling just below the surface. The flower on its back has a bitter taste and a foul scent, ensuring it never needs to worry about predation.

entry: 干季，POKENAME皮肤上长出大量小花。它用利爪替同伴梳掉，因为留得太久，会造成腐蚀性灼伤。
author: .izik
source: In dry seasons, masses of small flowers grow from POKENAME's skin. It uses sharp claws to groom them from its kin, as leaving them too long can cause caustic burns.

entry: 战斗受伤时，POKENAME能从头顶球茎抽取养分，获得一股能量继续打。战后会找向阳处躺下休息，补回球茎消耗。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: When injured in combat, POKENAME can draw nutrients from the bulb on its head and receive a burst of energy to keep fighting. After combat, POKENAME will find a sunny place to lie down and rest, replenishing the bulb's lost energy.

entry: POKENAME在丛林河流嬉水，用响亮叫声穿过密草，与同伴交流。一天最热时才上岸，挤在一起晒太阳、打盹。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME splash around and play in jungle rivers, communicating with loud cries to one another through the dense undergrowth. They leave the water during the hottest parts of the day, cuddling together to snooze in the sun.

entry: POKENAME大半时间半埋沼泽泥里，静静吸收周围养分与阳光。受打扰能突然快得惊人，却宁愿逃，不愿打。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend most of their time partially submerged in the mud of swamps, passively absorbing nutrients from around them and from sunlight. They are capable of a surprising turn of speed when disturbed, but prefer to flee rather than fight.

entry: POKENAME能感知其他生命的情绪。发现有人低落，就散出甜香，希望让训练家心情好些。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME can sense the feelings of others. If it notices someone is feeling down, it will emanate a sweet scent in hopes of brightening the Trainer's mood.

entry: 训练家相信它能成功时，POKENAME最强，这份积极能量让它振奋。只要得到信任，就能用强力藤鞭克服逆境。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are strongest when their Trainer believes in their success, as this positive energy invigorates them. They can overcome adversity with powerful Vine Whips if their Trainer believes in them.

entry: POKENAME精神能力强，必须在阳光下深深专注，集中力量。它能预测花何时开，便带训练家来，一起赏花。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME has strong psychic abilities and needs deep concentration while in the sun to focus its powers. It can predict when flowers will bloom, and will bring its Trainer over to enjoy the flowers together.

entry: POKENAME高悬树冠间，贴近冠层的花。它奇异地不受天气影响，四周树木随风摇晃，自己却纹丝不动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hover high up amongst the crown of trees, staying close to the flowers in the canopy. They are strangely unaffected by the weather, remaining entirely stationary even as the trees around them sway in the breeze.

entry: POKENAME用皮肤和背上仙人掌吸水。仙人掌成熟后落到身后地面，给沙漠里的捡食者提供营养。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME absorb water through their skin and the cacti on their back. When mature, the cacti fall onto the ground behind them, creating a source of nutrition for desert scavengers.

entry: POKENAME满身的毒刺，保护背上生长的花苞。闭合花瓣的香气，能安抚吸入者，因此常被用于配制某些镇静剂。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body is covered in poisonous thorns that protect the bud growing on its back. The fragrance of its still-closed petals can soothe anyone who breathes it in, which is why it is often used in the preparation of certain tranquilizers.

entry: POKENAME集中或分散皮肤中的叶绿素，改变体色，藏在枝叶间，用黏长舌伏击虫属性宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to change their colouration by concentrating or dispersing the chlorophyll in their skin. They use this ability to hide amongst foliage and ambush Bug-Type Pokémon with their long, sticky tongue.

entry: POKENAME光合作用能力强，能长时间不进食。人们相信，两只将藤蔓交缠时，就会发生进化。
author: bobosmith01
source: It doesn't need to eat for long periods of time thanks to its powerful photosynthesizing abilities. It is believed that when two POKENAME interlace their vines, an evolution will occur.

entry: POKENAME像花盆里的一枚花苞。释放孢子时，会夺去范围内植物的生命。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME resembles a flower bud in a planter. When it releases spores, it steals the life of plants within its range.

entry: POKENAME是骄傲的斗士，会俯冲向毫无戒心的格斗属性宝可梦，发起决斗。融合赋予它威严的面容，像人类空手道大师。
author: lupa
source: POKENAME is a proud fighter. It swoops down on unsuspecting Fighting-type Pokémon for duels. Pokémon fusion has given it a majestic visage reminiscent of human Karate masters.

entry: 它背上的花苞还没到绽放的时候。为了让花苞长大，它耗去了大部分能量，因此行动格外迟缓。
author: soup1900
source: The bulb on its back is not fully ready to bloom yet. It is quite sluggish since it uses most of its energy to grow its bulb.

entry: POKENAME常聚在向阳处吸收阳光。性情温和，同类聚集也极少打架。
author: _._starry_._
source: POKENAME often gather in sunny spots to absorb sunlight. Because of its gentle nature, it is extremely rare for fighting to occur when they come together.

entry: POKENAME后脑其实是伪装成花苞的大嘴，流出的却是真花蜜。花苞状嘴张不太大，因此更喜欢捕捉小猎物。
author: oreee0230
source: Although the back of POKENAME's head is actually a big mouth disguised as a flower bud, the liquid that flows out is real nectar. Because the bud-shaped mouth cannot open very wide, POKENAME tends to prefer capturing smaller prey.

entry: POKENAME的许多小花苞开合，抓住小虫，喂给中央真正的头。食物很久才到胃里，让它常吃过量，饭后变得迟缓。
author: sk372
source: The many smaller buds snap and grab small insects to feed to POKENAME's true head in the center. Due to meals taking a long time to reach its stomach, it often overeats and winds up sluggish after feeding.

entry: 藤蔓上的嘴先咀嚼、消化食物，再交给主嘴吸收养分。本体爬得慢，藤蔓却能脱离、快速移动，活跃数周。
author: oreee0230
source: The mouths on its vines chew and digest food before giving it to the main mouth to absorb nutrients. Although the main body crawls slowly, the vines can detach, move quickly, and remain active for several weeks.

entry: POKENAME是比陆生植物还古老的宝可梦。复活的化石显示，它曾在水面进行光合作用，让古生物学家推测，它是早期大气充氧的关键。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are ancient Pokémon that predate land plants. Revived fossils show that they lived at the water's surface photosynthesising, leading Palaeontologists to theorise they were key to filling the early atmosphere with oxygen.

entry: POKENAME生活在热带浅水，浮在水面附近，藏进水草。大部分能量来自阳光，有机会也会猎食小宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in shallow waters in tropical regions, floating near the surface of the water whilst hiding amongst water plants. They get most of their energy from sunlight but will hunt smaller Pokémon if the opportunity presents itself.

entry: POKENAME用尾花作诱饵，以亮丽花瓣把注意引离身体。既能迷惑大宝可梦、将其引开，也能方便自己设伏捕猎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use the flower on their tail as a lure, drawing attention away from their body with its bright petals. They use this distraction both to ward away larger Pokémon and to help them lay ambushes on their own prey.

entry: POKENAME用覆甲的头保护背上娇嫩花朵，总正面迎敌，绝不露出脆弱的背。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their armoured head to help protect the delicate flower growing upon their backs. They always face their foes head on, refusing to expose their vulnerable backs.

entry: POKENAME用覆甲的头保护背上娇嫩花朵，总正面迎敌，绝不露出脆弱的背。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their armoured head to help protect the delicate flower growing upon their backs. They always face their foes head on, refusing to expose their vulnerable backs.

entry: POKENAME花粉对多数人和宝可梦都有强烈刺激。一大家子同时开花，光靠花粉就能把其他宝可梦赶出领地。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME pollen is a major irritant for a majority of Pokémon and people. Large families of POKENAME that flower at the same time are able to drive other Pokémon from their territory purely through the pollen they release.

entry: POKENAME球茎要更多养分才能开花，因此四处寻找能晒太阳的地方。它会赶走捕食弱小草属性宝可梦的虫属性宝可梦。
author: porpoisemerchant
source: POKENAME's bulb needs more nutrients to bloom, so it roams in search of spots to soak up sunshine. It chases off bug types that prey on weaker grass type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的双腿十分强健，能在树冠间跳跃。那些巨大的森林生长在它赖以栖身的古老洞穴中。
author: veteranadventurer
source: POKENAME's legs have grown strong to allow it to leap through the canopy of the massive forests that grow in the ancient caves it calls home.

entry: 这种宝可梦浮在热带海洋，常待在雨林和丛林附近。它能像风扇般转动背叶，推动自己游动，或制造漩涡。
author: ecstaticwoop64556455
source: This Pokémon can be found floating through the tropical oceans, hanging around near rainforests and jungles. It can spin the leaves on its back like a fan, propelling itself through the water or creating whirlpools.

entry: POKENAME背上花苞渗出色素，改变壳的颜色。这种色素也是广泛使用的农用肥料。
author: oreee0230
source: The bud on POKENAME's back oozes a pigment that changes the color of its shell. This pigment is also a widely used agricultural fertilizer.

entry: POKENAME壳上覆草，靠透过叶片的阳光生存。草无论颜色还是气味，都提供完美伪装。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's shell is covered with grass, which relies on the sunlight that passes through POKENAME's leaves to survive. The grass provides perfect camouflage, both in color and in smell.

entry: POKENAME背上的树长着桃子般的花苞，却不能食用。它们永不开花，将迷人香气锁在里面，常被摘来作香料。
author: oreee0230
source: Although the buds on the tree on POKENAME's back look like peaches, they are not suitable for consumption. These buds, which never bloom, lock in a charming scent and are often picked to be used as fragrance.

entry: POKENAME住在热带丛林，始终待在高树冠，从不下地。它远远荡过树林找果子，沿途撒下花粉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in tropical jungles, staying high in the canopy and never coming down to the ground. They swing across vast distances in search of fruit, scattering pollen from their flowers in their wake.

entry: POKENAME靠小而突然的跳跃前进。进化前，会找隐蔽温暖处，停下不动。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME traverse through small but sudden hops. Before evolving, they find a secluded warm spot and stop moving.

entry: POKENAME组成多代同堂、关系紧密的家族。成体轮流照顾幼崽和老者，其余成员找果子，再靠花香独特的组合辨路回家。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form tight knit family groups that contain multiple generations. The adults take turns watching over the young and elderly whilst their peers search for fruit, navigating home by the unique combination of scents from their flowers.

entry: POKENAME打法灵活，全身各处都能接连出击，深受空手道王欢迎。看似尾巴的其实是柔韧藤蔓，能伸能缩，带来惊人机动性。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fight with a nimble combat style that makes them popular with Black Belts, using every part of their body to rain down blows. What appears to be a tail is actually a flexible vine that can extend or retract, granting incredible mobility.

entry: 即使野生，POKENAME也很勤于清洁自己和叶片，因此常在溪河边或水里看见。叶片越长，它就越骄傲自大。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME, even if wild, are very diligent about keeping themselves and their leaves clean, so they are often seen near, or in, streams and rivers. The longer their leaves are, the more prideful and uppity POKENAME will be.

entry: POKENAME趴在营养丰富的泥地，球茎朝向太阳。让球茎吸收、利用阳光时，这样似乎既降温，也补充养分。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME will lie on their bellies in patches of nutrient-rich mud, their plant bulbs facing toward the sun. This seems to keep them cool and further nourished as they let their bulbs absorb and process sunlight.

entry: POKENAME鼻子上阴凉，是鸟宝可梦舒适的落脚处。战斗时，猛打一个喷嚏，就能将毒孢子撒满战场。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME's well shaded nose makes a comfortable perch for bird Pokémon. In battle, a hefty sneeze allows POKENAME to spread its poisonous spores across the battlefield.

entry: POKENAME虽然仍能当作棍棒使用，却更喜欢让花苞散发香气，把对手哄睡。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Though still a functional club, POKENAME prefers to put its opponents to sleep with the aroma emanating from its bulb.

entry: POKENAME身上繁茂的植物开始开花。重量增加，挥动攻击也更有力，瞄准得好，一击就能斩断石柱。
author: ocxin
source: POKENAME's overgrowth has started to bloom. As it grows heavier, it can put more force behind its swinging attacks. A well-aimed strike could slice through stone pillars.

entry: 据说见到POKENAME是吉兆，却最好别太靠近，因为它的触须能给敌人疼痛的鞭击。
author: flickeredflame
source: Seeing an POKENAME is said to be a good omen; however, it's advised not to get too close, as its feelers can deliver painful, whipping blows to its enemies.

entry: POKENAME开心时，花瓣会散发怡人的花香。经常能看到POKENAME在阳光下打盹。
author: melodydelune
source: The petals of POKENAME emit a pleasant floral scent when it is happy. POKENAME can often be found napping in the sun.

entry: POKENAME与相近物种共同生活。它好胜，急着继续进化，除了光合作用，还常加餐。不过，总先保证尼多兰和尼多朗幼崽吃饱。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME live together with those of similar species. Competitive and desperate to evolve further, they tend to eat additional food rather than just photosynthesizing. However, they always make sure young Nidoran have plenty to eat first.

entry: POKENAME全身蔓生着复杂的植物群。力量一释放，大片区域的植物便失控生长，让绿意骤然破土而出。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's body has a complex array of plants sprawling across its body. When it releases its power, plants grow uncontrollably over a wide area, causing a burst of greenery to emerge from the soil.

entry: POKENAME住在臭氧层，让球形花苞大量吸收阳光。落回地面也留着能量，交战第一击就能使出强力日光束。
author: sk372
source: Living in the ozone layer allows POKENAME's flower bulbs to absorb large amounts of sunlight. It holds this charge when it descends to the ground, letting it unleash a powerful Solar Beam as its first strike in combat.

entry: POKENAME能扭曲空间，让藤蔓延伸到近乎无限长。背上球茎越大，附近的重力也越强。
author: h0bojoe
source: It can distort space such that its vines can extend to near-infinite lengths. As the bulb on its back grows, so too does the gravity in POKENAME's vicinity.

entry: 它从叶片释放孢子，哄对手入睡。受孢子影响者，都会经历痛苦的噩梦。
author: h0bojoe
source: It releases spores from its leaves to lull opponents to sleep. Anyone affected by these spores experiences wretched nightmares.

entry: POKENAME吸收月光，和吸收阳光一样容易。白天歇在旷野，夜里醒来玩耍。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME can absorb moonlight as readily as it can absorb sunlight. It rests in open fields during the day and awakens at night to play.

entry: POKENAME臂上的叶片香气独特，头顶花苞反而毫无气味。靠叶片上剧毒的细毛，它能有效捕食小拉达等猎物。
author: oreee0230
source: The leaves on the arms of POKENAME have a unique fragrance, while the flower bud on its head is actually odorless. Relying on the highly toxic trichomes on its leaves, POKENAME can effectively hunt prey like Rattata.

entry: POKENAME繁复的头花遮住眼睛，只能靠其他感官辨路。花也决定社会等级，越大、越繁复，地位越高。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have an elaborate head flower that covers their eyes, leaving them to rely on their other senses to navigate the world. These flowers enable them to establish societal hierarchies, larger and more elaborate flowers denoting higher status.

entry: POKENAME的等离子体模仿花苞形状，帮助稳定电荷。它常被训练用等离子体藤蔓，在停电时暂时维持供电。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's plasma mimics the shape of a flower bud and allows it to stabilize electric charges. POKENAME is often trained to use its plasma vines to temporarily maintain power supply during blackouts.

entry: 月光下，POKENAME背上花苞散出浓香。野生个体一听附近有训练家，就停止赏月，藏起来。
author: oreee0230
source: The bud on POKENAME's back emits a strong fragrance under the moonlight. Once it hears Trainers nearby, wild POKENAME will stop moon-gazing and hide.

entry: POKENAME球茎虽香，巡护员仍提醒训练家别太靠近，因为花蜜极易燃。球茎生长，需要阳光，也需要附近生物的生命力。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Though its bulb gives off a pleasant aroma, Pokémon Rangers caution Trainers against getting too close, as POKENAME's nectar is incredibly flammable. The bulb requires both sunlight and the life force of nearby creatures in order to grow.

entry: POKENAME飞过丛林，寻找花粉点起火焰。它是丛林的保护者，会攻击造成破坏的人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME flutter across the jungle, searching for pollen to ignite their flame. POKENAME are protectors of the jungle, attacking people who cause damage to the jungle forest.

entry: POKENAME燃烧花中的花粉，产生浓烟遮住火焰。它让破坏丛林的人失去行动能力，再搬到林外。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME burn pollen from within their flowers to produce thick hazes of smoke that conceal their flames. They incapacitate people who cause destruction to the jungle and carry them out.

entry: POKENAME主动寻找空置的丛林遗迹定居。身上蔓生的植物，填补多年累积的裂缝和伤痕，靠核心能量持续生长。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME actively hunt for empty jungle ruins to settle in. The plants sprawling across their body fill in cracks and wounds that may have accumulated over the years. These plants rely on the core's energy to continue growing.

entry: 记录显示，POKENAME曾守卫常青森林等地。如今常见于园艺店和玉虹市一带，照料各种小型盆栽树果植物。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Records show that POKENAME were once used to guard locations such as Viridian Forest. Nowadays, they can be spotted in garden shops and around Celadon City, taking care of various small potted berry plants.

entry: POKENAME草叶般的毛里满是小花苞，香气极浓，用来吸引同类。晒太阳休息数小时后，能控制的火焰便更强。
author: fiordaliso
source: The grassy fur of POKENAME is filled with tiny, highly fragrant buds that it uses to attract other members of its species. After resting for many hours under the sun, the flames it can control become more intense.

entry: POKENAME头冠垂下的花瓣遮住双眼，挡了视线。它因而过分凶猛，先发制人地攻击一切自认为的威胁。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have their eyes covered by the petals growing down from the crown of their heads, obscuring their vision. They overcompensate for their poor vision by being particularly aggressive, pre-emptively attacking anything they think is a threat.

entry: POKENAME很少挪窝，被形容为懒惰、难合作。它放出藤蔓网络，搬运枝条筑坝。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are described as lazy and uncooperative because they rarely move from one spot. They release a network of vines to move sticks and branches to create dams.

entry: POKENAME用结实藤蔓，在栖居丛林两端之间迅速荡行。过于活跃，始终动个不停，必须大吃果子维持体力。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its robust vines to swing swiftly from one end of its jungle home to the other. Its hyperactivity keeps it in constant motion, so it needs hearty meals of fruit to keep up its strength.

entry: POKENAME住在枝叶茂密的丛林。捕猎时，用藤蔓般的尾巴缠住猎物，再施以强烈电击。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives in jungles with dense foliage. When hunting, POKENAME ensnares prey with its vine-like tail before electrocuting them with a powerful shock.

entry: POKENAME吃富含矿物质的岩石和泥，为背上盛开的花供给养分。花带有独特浓郁的泥土气味。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feed on mineral rich rocks and mud to provide nutrients for the flower blooming on their back. Their flowers have a uniquely rich, earthy smell to them.

entry: POKENAME沿脊柱的花叶，很容易让它藏进密草。它白天藏着懒散度日，自信即使被发现，厚重铠甲也能保护自己。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to blend into dense undergrowth easily, the flowers and leaves lining their spine easily camouflaging them. They spend their days lazing out of sight, confident that should they be found their thick body armour will protect them.

entry: POKENAME叶片不断产出小而沉的种子，起飞前必须快速振翅抖落。饥饿的宝可梦很快捡光，没剩几粒能发芽。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME constantly produce small yet heavy seeds on their leaves, so whenever they are about to fly, they rapidly vibrate their wings to shake the seeds off. These seeds are swiftly picked up by hungry Pokémon, leaving few seeds behind to sprout.

entry: POKENAME吸收阳光后，会到湖底找闪亮东西，尤其对其他宝可梦的鲜亮鳞片兴奋。
author: smashbear
source: After absorbing sunlight, POKENAME search the lakebeds for anything shiny. They seem particularly excited by the bright scales of other Pokémon.

entry: 头顶球茎日渐沉重，因此身体总是肌肉密实。它们盼着开花的那天，也会为保护球茎而逃跑。
author: infinex21
source: The bulbs on their heads grow heavier with every day, so their bodies are always dense with muscle. They long for the day that their bulbs will bloom into flowers and will flee to keep to their bulbs safe.

entry: 壳板的成分与根相同，帮助将花苞里的水和养分送往本体。腿虽小，肌肉却密实。
author: infinex21
source: The plates of their shells have the composition of roots and help carry nutrients and water from their flower buds to their actual bodies. Though their legs are small, they are dense with muscle.

entry: POKENAME转动齿轮状身体，慢慢展开花苞。花苞准备好绽放时，就会进化。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME slowly opens up its flower bud by rotating its gear-shaped body. When the flower bud is ready to bloom, it evolves.

entry: POKENAME爱恶作剧，先用亲切可爱的模样引来其他生命，再从球茎喷出花粉。花粉让对方更容易中了随后施展的幻术。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a prankster that lures others close with a friendly and cute appearance before blasting them with a cloud of pollen from its bulb. The pollen makes them far more susceptible to the illusory tricks it plays on them afterward.

entry: POKENAME背上花苞有特殊形状的空腔，能放大歌声。叶片也能呼吸，因此唱歌可以一直不换气。
author: oreee0230
source: The bud on POKENAME's back contains a specially shaped cavity that can amplify its singing. Since its leaves can also be used for breathing, POKENAME's singing can continue without needing to take a breath.

entry: 它的花同时处于绽放与未绽放的奇妙状态，因此散发着其他花朵都没有的独特香气。
author: soup1900
source: Its flower is in a special state of blooming and not blooming at the same time. This gives it a unique aroma no other flower has.

entry: 尾端的花苞越鲜艳，POKENAME就越有精神。花苞若散发出带烟熏味的香气，就表示快开花了。
author: soup1900
source: The more vibrant the bud on its tail is, the more energetic POKENAME becomes. A smoke-like aroma from the bud indicates that it's about to bloom.

entry: 它十分珍爱尾巴上的花苞。如果这株植物枯萎，POKENAME也会随之死去。
author: dodoowner_
source: It is very proud of the bulb on its tail. If the plant ever withers away, POKENAME will die with it.

entry: POKENAME翱翔天空，向下释放成团花粉。休息时用藤蔓绕住树枝，免得被风吹走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME soar through the sky releasing clouds of pollen beneath them. When resting, they wrap their vines around tree branches to prevent themselves from being blown away.

entry: POKENAME越觉得被爱，耳上粉红花苞就越鲜亮。吸足能量后，强健双腿让它能优雅跃起。
author: fiordaliso
source: The more loved POKENAME feels, the brighter the pink buds on its ears become. After absorbing enough energy, it can leap gracefully into the air thanks to its powerful, athletic legs.

entry: POKENAME几乎不停争夺树果，身体却慢，常错过一餐。孢子能让比自己重许多倍的宝可梦也睡着。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are in near constant competition for berries and often miss out on a meal because of their slow bodies. They release spores that can cause Pokémon many times their body weight to fall asleep.

entry: POKENAME头顶长着甜香小花，花蜜很适合制香水，因此备受芳香疗法师追捧。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have tiny flowers sprouting from the top of their heads, a sweet scent emanating from them. The nectar from these flowers makes a wonderful perfume and POKENAME are very sought after by aromatherapists.

entry: POKENAME常挂在树枝上，叶片状身体随风摇摆。据说以负面情绪为食，或许因此才爱向路人扔坚果、树果。
author: infinex21
source: These forest Pokémon are often seen hanging from branches, their leafy bodies swaying in the wind. POKENAME are said to feed on negative emotions, which might explain why they drop nuts and berries on passersby.

entry: POKENAME释放精神波动，让附近花草迅速成熟。等完全开花，就吸入树汁泡，迅速分解为基本成分吃掉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release psychic waves that cause plants in the nearby flowers to rapidly mature. Once in full bloom, POKENAME eat these flowers by absorbing them into their sap bubble that rapidly dissolves the flower into its base components.

entry: POKENAME夜里飞出，用背上的花轻蹭野花传粉。黎明时，将发育不足、视力微弱的眼睛背向太阳，让背上球茎吸收阳光。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME fly out at night to pollinate flowers by rubbing the flower on their back against wildflowers. Their weak, underdeveloped eyes face away from the sun when dawn arrives to absorb sunlight with the bulb on their backs.

entry: POKENAME有顶叶片帽，方便光合作用。背上的花苞，却限制了地下行动。
author: amphi64
source: POKENAME has a leafy cap to facilitate photosynthesis. The bud on its back restricts its underground movement.

entry: POKENAME是寄生宝可梦，用锋利门牙咬穿树皮，吸食枝内树汁。大量寄生时，树看似满树开花，其实很不健康。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are parasitic Pokémon, using their sharp incisors to bite through tree bark and feed on the sap within their branches. Large infestations can leave an afflicted tree looking as though it's in full bloom despite being very unhealthy.

entry: POKENAME将根接上附近植物，偷取作物与野生生物的重要养分。它满身尖刺，没有专门手段，很难拔除。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME connect their roots to other plants in the nearby area and steal vital nutrients from crops and wildlife. Their thorny exterior makes it difficult to uproot them without specialized techniques.

entry: POKENAME如今能量足够，不靠藤蔓也能维生。取而代之，头上有朵小花，替它进行光合作用。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME now have enough energy to self-sustain without vines. They instead have a small flower on their head that photosynthesizes for them.

entry: POKENAME用尾上花瓣的香气，引来无防备的猎物。再用喙与利爪迅捷、精准地出击，打倒对手。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses the scent released by the petals on its tail to lure unsuspecting prey toward it. It takes down opponents with swift, precise strikes of its beak and talons.

entry: POKENAME身体大多由花构成，脸周围着细软叶片，花瓣从身后拖出。睡觉时倒挂枝头，很容易被当成树花。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The bodies of POKENAME are mostly made up of their flower, fine downy leaves surrounding their face as petals trail out from behind their bodies. They hang upside down from tree branches when they sleep and can be easily mistaken for tree flowers.

entry: 它用大嘴抓住大果子和坚果，再以利牙吸尽汁液。吸干的果子也会吃，坚果却随便吐掉，根本不在乎落哪。
author: infinex21
source: It uses its gaping maw to snatch large fruits and nuts, which it will then drain dry of all their juices using its sharp fangs. Though it will also eat the drained fruit, it will spit out the nuts without a care for where they land.

entry: POKENAME慢慢转身，让每片叶子均匀受光。若照料得好，也许会允许训练家摘叶做沙拉。
author: busilisk
source: POKENAME slowly rotates its body to allow equal light to strike its leaves. A well-cared-for POKENAME may allow Trainers to pick its leaves for use in salads.

entry: POKENAME进食时压低身子，藏在草丛，用满身花叶伪装。觉得危险，就挺起身体，摇得叶片沙沙响，威吓对方。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME keep low in the undergrowth when they're feeding, using the leaves and flowers covering their bodies to camouflage themselves. When they're feeling endangered, they rear up and rustle their leaves in a threat display.

entry: POKENAME漫游栖居的热带雨林，背上的花似乎缓和了倔强性格。不过，惹恼它的宝可梦，仍会遭藤蔓攻击。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME roams the tropical rainforests it calls home. The flower on its back seems to have mellowed its stubborn nature, though it will attack Pokémon who irritate it using its vines.

entry: POKENAME害怕或冷时，会用斗篷般的叶子紧裹身体。只有开心、完全安心时，花才会绽放。
author: ambrosia04
source: When frightened or cold, POKENAME wraps its cloak-like leaves tightly around its body. Its flower will only bloom when POKENAME is happy and feels completely safe.

entry: POKENAME无声飘行，在阳光下旋转，享受关注。它爱嫉妒，谁被当成争宠对手，就向谁喷催眠粉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME drift silently through the air, twirling in the sunlight and revelling in attention. They are jealous Pokémon and will puff out a Sleep Powder at anyone they view as a rival for attention.

entry: POKENAME兴奋就释放孢子，可孢子对其他宝可梦有毒。因此对方不肯玩，它还很困惑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME releases spores whenever it is excited. These spores are toxic to other Pokémon, so it becomes confused whenever they refuse to play with it.

entry: POKENAME受惊会喷出极强毒孢子，形成拱顶状云团。多数宝可梦因此避开，不过毒属性宝可梦不受影响，常歇在身旁。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: When startled, POKENAME will spray highly potent noxious spores in a dome-shaped cloud. Most Pokémon avoid POKENAME due to this reaction; however, Poison-type Pokémon are often seen resting beside it, unaffected by its spores.

entry: POKENAME藤蔓比进化前更粗长，因此更重、不再那么像丝带。背上球茎准备开花时，会散出辛香。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME's vines are thicker and longer than its pre-evolution's, causing them to be heavier and less ribbon-like. The bulb on its back gives off a spicy scent when it's ready to bloom.

entry: POKENAME遍身长着各种植物，让它们吃自己的污泥成长。不过，植物随后就会对人和宝可梦有毒。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME has a body that is covered with various plants. Its body can support the growth of these plants by allowing them to feed off its sludge, but then they become toxic to Trainers and Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME前后摇动开着花的尾巴，推动自己游过海洋。留下的花瓣，会被小型水生水属性宝可梦吃掉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swim through the ocean by rocking their flowery tail back and forth to push them through the water. The petals left behind get eaten by small aquatic Water-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME没有鳍，背上球茎便充当推进器，喷出维生素与矿物质，极能滋养海底植物。
author: bradlybro199
source: The bulbs on the back of POKENAME act as a propeller in the absence of a fin. The bulbs spew vitamins and minerals that are extremely nourishing to the plants on the sea floor.

entry: POKENAME似乎从不休息，阳光下却动作变慢，月光反而让它充满能量。临近进化、球茎状的头即将展开时，会散出刺鼻香气。
author: infinex21
source: This Pokémon never seems to rest, though it does appear to move slower when exposed to sunlight; moonlight, however, fills it with energy. An POKENAME's bulb-like head will release a pungent aroma as it grows nearer to opening when it evolves.

entry: POKENAME守护森林家园，几乎热心过头。一察觉入侵者，就甩出多条藤蔓，抓住扔走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is protective of its forest home to an almost overzealous degree. The instant it senses an intruder, it sends out multiple vines to grab and toss them away.

entry: POKENAME猛烈拍翅，升上高空，更好地散播花粉，吸引虫属性朋友。洁白棉絮，正是它爱干净、晨昏活动的证据。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME flaps aggressively to get high in the sky, where it can better disperse its pollen and attract Bug-type friends. Its white cotton is evidence of its tidy crepuscular lifestyle.

entry: POKENAME猛烈拍翅，升上高空，更好地散播花粉，吸引虫属性朋友。能光合作用的绿色棉絮，明确显示养分和阳光充足。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME flaps aggressively to get high in the sky, where it can better disperse its pollen and attract Bug-type friends. Its green photosynthetic cotton is a sure sign it's getting lots of nutrition and sunlight.

entry: POKENAME覆着薄薄黏液，保持花苞新鲜。等待进化时，胃口极其旺盛。
author: .realthree
source: An POKENAME is covered with a thin layer of slime that keeps its bud fresh. It has a ravenous appetite as it awaits evolution.

entry: POKENAME头顶流出香甜却剧毒的花蜜，引诱猎物。可动作平平又笨拙，许多猎物即使发现它在旁，也不害怕。
author: oreee0230
source: A sweet-smelling yet highly poisonous nectar flows from the top of POKENAME's head, which it uses to lure prey. Because of its underwhelming and clumsy movement, many of its prey are not afraid even when they realize POKENAME is nearby.

entry: POKENAME偏爱阳光明亮的沙漠，吸收耀眼光线。为保护头上仙人掌，它放弃捕猎，尽量减少受伤风险。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME prefers to live in bright deserts surrounded by the sun, absorbing the glowing rays. To protect the cactus on its head, it abstains from hunting to minimize its risk of injury.

entry: POKENAME将藤蔓接上根系，吸取其他植物的养分。它剪去坏叶、大量喝水，细心养护背上的球茎。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME connect their vines to root systems to siphon nutrients from other plants. They carefully maintain the bulbs on their back by clipping damaged leaves and drinking lots of water.

entry: POKENAME花少量养分，造出一只像妙蛙种子的小诱饵。花苞能长达四米高，捕猎时，将敌人困进沙墓。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME expends a small amount of nutrients to produce a small decoy that looks like a Bulbasaur. Its bud can reach four meters high and envelops foes in a sandy tomb when it hunts.

entry: 训练家一坐下，POKENAME就凑来，把头搁在膝上。叶片展开成毯盖住对方，自己打盹时，也静静吸收阳光能量。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME will come up and rest their head on their Trainer's lap whenever their Trainer sits down. Their leaves fan out and form a blanket across their Trainer, passively absorbing energy from sunlight while POKENAME snoozes.

entry: 争领地时，POKENAME会蓬起花瓣鬃毛。鬃毛最健康鲜艳的那只，通常能让对方退让。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fluff out their petal mane when they engage in territorial disputes. The POKENAME with the healthiest and most vibrant mane is usually the one to make the other back down.

entry: 争领地时，POKENAME会蓬起叶片鬃毛。鬃毛最健康、绿得最鲜亮的那只，通常能让对方退让。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fluff out their leaf mane when they engage in territorial disputes. The POKENAME with the healthiest and most vibrantly green mane is usually the one to make the other back down.

entry: 许多古聚落认为，见到POKENAME却不表谢意，是对整个聚落的挑衅。许多人只为听它唱歌，就愿付出一切。
author: oreee0230
source: In many ancient settlements, failing to show gratitude upon seeing POKENAME was regarded as a provocation to the settlement. Many people were willing to give everything just to hear POKENAME's singing.

entry: POKENAME走到哪就撒下花粉，在云团间旋舞，姿态绚丽。许多网红爱给它拍照，花粉云更衬美丽。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME scatter pollen wherever they go, dancing and twirling through clouds to give themselves a beautiful flourish. Many influencers enjoy taking photos of POKENAME, as these clouds of pollen accentuate their beauty.

entry: POKENAME花瓣散出极甜香气，安抚附近所有生命的梦。人们相信它守望森林，会现身对抗巨大的邪恶力量。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its petals release an incredibly sweet fragrance that soothes the dreams of anyone nearby. It is believed that POKENAME watches over forests and appears to oppose great evils.

entry: 背上寄生的花以养分为交换，增强POKENAME的免疫力。它喝甜树脂，保持花瓣芳香、色彩鲜亮。
author: fiordaliso
source: The parasitic flower on its back boosts its immune system in exchange for nutrients. POKENAME drinks sweet tree resin to keep its petals fragrant and brightly colored.

entry: POKENAME吃大量遇见的碎屑，补充营养，再将废物集中在最外层花瓣，定期脱落。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME consumes large amounts of debris it encounters to supplement its nutrition. POKENAME concentrates the waste from the debris on its outermost petals and periodically sheds them.

entry: POKENAME爱用藤蔓、花朵等装饰身体，让自己更漂亮。其他宝可梦身上的植物若足够好看，它甚至会用藤蔓摘下来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME likes to decorate its body with vines, flowers and the like to make itself feel prettier. It will even use its own vines to pluck flora off of other Pokémon if it finds them appealing enough.

entry: POKENAME在花苞中积存种子，等待出击时机。一阵弹丸般的小种子射出，会缠住目标，防止逃跑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME accumulate seeds inside their flower bud, waiting for the right opportunity to strike. A burst of these small pellet seeds wrap around their targets to prevent escape.

entry: POKENAME花苞的香气常引来天敌。不过，叶片锋利如刃，能保护生长中的花苞，免受重伤。
author: st4rdustyugure
source: The scent of POKENAME's bud often attracts predators. However, its leaves are as sharp as blades, protecting the growing bud from serious harm.

entry: POKENAME很害羞，会藏进花瓣，避免与其他宝可梦对视。特别紧张时，就释放毒孢子，吓退不愿接触的来者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be quite shy and hide in flower petals to avoid making eye contact with other Pokémon. When they are particularly anxious, they release toxic spores to scare away those they do not want to interact with.

entry: POKENAME木壳坚硬，修复很快。头顶花苞看似弱点，纤维素含量却极高，结实得很。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's wooden shell is hard and restores itself quickly. The bud on POKENAME's head may look like a vulnerable weak point, but it is extremely tough because of its high cellulose content.

entry: 湿热时节，POKENAME浓密的毛更加鲜艳。环境潮湿，它便从耳内叶片散去多余热量。
author: mistymagius
source: Its lush fur will become more vibrant during the tropical season. Due to its humid environment, POKENAME radiates excess heat from the leaves in its ears.

entry: POKENAME用手杖温暖的末端碰植物，就能加快开花。天气格外晴朗，粉红花瓣的香气浓郁得几千米外也能闻见。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME touches a plant with the warm tip of its staff, it can speed up its blooming. On particularly sunny days, its pinkish petals give off an aroma so intense and fragrant that it can be detected from several kilometers away.

entry: 蕨形翅膀覆着刺激性极强的物质，以免被其他宝可梦误食。它喝森林深处最甜树果的汁，帮助腹部粉红花苞绽放。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its fern-shaped wings are coated in an incredibly irritating substance, preventing other Pokémon from accidentally trying to eat them. It drinks the juice of the sweetest berries deep in the forest to help the pink bud on its abdomen bloom.

entry: POKENAME牢牢埋在地里，除非受扰，否则不动。释放的宇宙能量，让附近植物长得扭曲奇异。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME remains firmly buried in the ground unless disturbed. The cosmic energy it emits causes nearby plants to grow warped and strange.

entry: 尾端的花苞绽开时，会露出一小簇火焰。它有时会在战斗中故意开花，让前来攻击的对手措手不及。
author: soup1900
source: When the bud on its tail blooms, a tiny flame is revealed. It will sometimes intentionally do this in battle to surprise foes who attack it.

entry: POKENAME圆圆的红鼻子散出苹果般的甜香，虽然宜人，却会无意引来附近天敌。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's round red nose releases a sweet apple-like scent. While pleasant, the aroma unintentionally attracts nearby predators.

entry: POKENAME常在沼泽大群游泳，最爱吃睡莲绽放的粉红花朵。
author: victor9106
source: POKENAME are often found swimming in marshlands in great schools. Their favorite food is the pink flowers formed when lily pads bloom.

entry: 为给花苞积攒养分，POKENAME胃口无穷，会吃光附近植物。在原生森林，人们曾见植物被拖进地下，给它吃掉。
author: oreee0230
source: In order to accumulate nutrients for its buds, POKENAME's endless appetite causes it to eat all nearby plants. In the forests that POKENAME are native to, people report seeing plants being dragged underground to be eaten by an POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME将藤蔓在地下延伸最远100米，寻找水。一找到，便精准地朝水源直挖。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spreads its vines up to 100 meters beneath the soil to locate water. Once found, it digs directly toward the source with precision.

entry: 植物性食物营养不足以供给三个花苞，因此POKENAME常捕食其他草属性宝可梦。花苞香气让猎物温顺，一放松，就被拖进地下。
author: oreee0230
source: Plant-based food is not nutritious enough for the three buds, so POKENAME often prey on other Grass-type Pokémon. The scent of the buds makes prey docile, allowing POKENAME to drag them into the ground the moment they relax.

entry: POKENAME用常春藤般的尾巴荡过枝头，沿途捡拾林中遗落的物品和钱。它把妙蛙喵从出生的低枝，带到长大所需的树冠。
author: alextheperson
source: POKENAME use their ivy-like tails to swing from branch to branch, often picking up items and money dropped in forests while they travel. They carry Bulbath from the lower branches where they are born to the canopies where they mature.

entry: POKENAME动作优雅、几乎无声，完美融入密草。胡须感知阳光暖意，准确找到能吸收太阳能的空地，滋养背上的花。
author: fiordaliso
source: Moving gracefully and almost without sound, POKENAME blends perfectly into the undergrowth. Its whiskers detect warmth from sunlight, allowing it to pinpoint clearings where it can absorb solar energy to nourish the flower on its back.

entry: POKENAME靠头顶球茎与植物说话。交流太久会剧烈头痛，可能数小时才恢复。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME relies on the bulb on its head to speak with plants. Prolonged communication with plants causes strong headaches that may take hours to recover from.

entry: POKENAME靠背上球茎与植物说话。交流太久会严重偏头痛，可能数小时才恢复。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME relies on the bulb on its back to speak with plants. Prolonged communication with plants causes powerful migraines that may take hours to recover from.

entry: POKENAME游得快，几秒就能横渡湖泊。独特泳法让背上球茎始终露出水面。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are swift swimmers that can cross lakes in a few seconds. They have a unique swimming method that ensures the bulb on their back remains above water.

entry: POKENAME总容易发怒，或许因为茂生花叶藤蔓占满大半身体。鼻里一开始喷孢子，就说明快暴怒了。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon are always quick to anger, most likely due to the overgrowth of leaves and vines that have overtaken most of their bodies. When an POKENAME starts exhaling spores out from its nose, it is about to fly into a rage.

entry: 勃然大怒时，它的花苞会打开一半，全身的叶片也根根竖起。这样的怒火，似乎能促进体内循环，使叶片长得更加茁壮。
author: infinex21
source: Its flower bud opens halfway and the leaves along its body stand on end when it flies into a fit of rage. These fits of rage seem to boost its circulation, which results in the leaves growing even more robust.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉会忽略自己的花香，方便辨认领地里的陌生气味。嘴或花都能喷出火柱，阳光下打盹还能增强火力。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's sense of smell ignores the scent of its own flower, letting it identify unknown scents in its territory. It can blast jets of fire from either its mouth or the flower and it increases the potency of the fire by napping in sunlight.

entry: POKENAME不断奔跑，为球茎追逐阳光，甚至穿过危险栖地，赶上白昼的脚步。走过许多地区，让背花得到多种植物的充分授粉。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME runs to always seek sunlight for its bulb, even crossing dangerous habitats to keep up with the passage of the day. Since it travels through many regions, the flower on its back becomes healthily pollinated by a variety of other plants.

entry: 尾端的花苞能喷出猛烈火焰，却不会伤及身上的植物。它会烧掉枯树与灌木，为新植物腾出生长空间。
author: soup1900
source: The bud on its tail spouts an intense flame that doesn't harm its flora. It will burn down dead trees and shrubs to allow room for new ones to grow.

entry: POKENAME身后长着大花苞，走路笨重，便常在安静池塘无目的地漂流，让花苞有足够时间从阳光吸取养分。
author: char_latte3412
source: The large bud growing on its backside makes walking cumbersome. Many POKENAME will instead drift aimlessly in quiet ponds, allowing their buds ample time to absorb nutrients from the sun.

entry: 尾上的花苞总是湿的，却从不显得浇水过多。甜香会对它游过的水域产生积极影响。
author: ichosuzu
source: The bud on its tail is always damp, yet it never seems to be overwatered. It gives off a sweet aroma that positively affects whatever it swims in.

entry: POKENAME把花蜜抹在肚子上，引来虫类宝可梦。聚得够近，就用催眠螺旋让对方沉睡。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME rubs nectar onto its belly to lure bug Pokémon close. Once they have gathered close enough, they are lulled into a slumber with its hypnotic spiral.

entry: 运用精神力量前，头上的花会散出浓烈郁金香味。它一生大多安静地睡在林间树下。
author: fiordaliso
source: Before using its psychic powers, the flower on its head releases an intense tulip-like scent. It spends most of its life peacefully sleeping beneath forest trees.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时间虽是清醒的两倍，晒太阳打盹时，似乎恢复得更快。野生个体只在晴天出现，天一阴就瞬间传送到远处。
author: oreee0230
source: Although POKENAME spends twice as many sleeping hours compared to the time it spends awake, it seems to recover faster while napping in sunlight. Wild POKENAME only appear on sunny days, teleporting away to distant places as soon as it is cloudy.

entry: POKENAME花苞释放强大精神能量，托起体重，悬在空中。勺子似乎能使土壤肥沃，但这强大工具只许信任的训练家使用。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's buds release powerful psychic energy to supports its weight and levitate in the air. Its spoon seems to be able to fertilize the soil, but only Trainers it trusts are allowed to use this powerful tool.

entry: POKENAME每天训练数小时，保持强健肌肉，打出破坏力十足的格斗属性重击。它绝不愿伤到背上的花，因此从不背对敌人。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME trains for hours every day to keep its muscular body in shape and deliver devastating Fighting-type blows. Since it never wants to damage the flower blooming on its back, it never turns its back on its opponents.

entry: POKENAME用自己的藤蔓练力量，双臂与藤蔓相互拉扯，同时锻炼两者。力量大得单手能举起超过500千克。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their own vines to weight train, straining their arms against their vines in order to strengthen them both. They are powerful enough to hoist over 500 kilograms in a single hand.

entry: POKENAME头上的叶片虽能吸收阳光，仍需进食，维持大量身体活动。锻炼时，花苞会更鲜艳。
author: oreee0230
source: Although the leaves on POKENAME's head can also absorb sunlight, it still needs to eat to support its high level of physical activity. As it exercises, its flower buds become more vibrant.

entry: POKENAME用根缠住树，从宿主吸取养分。它护着身上花苞，会长出藤蔓自卫。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wrap their roots around trees to siphon nutrients from their host. They are protective of the flower bud on their body and will sprout vines to defend it.

entry: POKENAME挂在树上时，用花苞配重。一次吃太多，身体和花苞重得强壮触手也撑不住，可能只好在地上过夜。
author: oreee0230
source: When POKENAME hangs on a tree, it uses flower buds as a counterweight. If it eats too much at once, it may be forced to spend the night on the ground because the weight of its body and flower buds becomes too great for its muscular tentacles.

entry: 野生POKENAME极危险，用甜香把无防备的宝可梦引到巢区捕食。报告说林深处曾有庞大群落，可没人知道真正巢址。
author: npshi
source: Wild POKENAME are extremely dangerous, preying on unsuspecting Pokémon by drawing them into POKENAME nesting grounds with sweet smells. Large colonies of POKENAME have reportedly been seen deep in forests, but no one knows where they truly nest.

entry: POKENAME通过头顶晶体吸收阳光，集中能量发出激光。搁浅时，会用藤蔓抓石头，把自己拉回海里；若是平坦沙滩，就只能等涨潮。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME absorbs sunlight through the crystals on its head to focus its energy into laser beams. A stranded POKENAME will try to use vines to grab rocks to pull itself back into the sea, but on a flat beach, it can only wait for the tide to rise.

entry: POKENAME头顶花苞能释放强大超声波能量。它随时能长新藤蔓，再吸水，将长度增加数十倍。
author: oreee0230
source: The bud on POKENAME's head can release powerful ultrasonic energy. POKENAME can grow new vines at will and absorb water through them to multiply their length dozens of times.

entry: 它们住在云上的山顶，靠光合作用长大背上球茎。寒冷让生长缓慢，往往好几年才能开花。
author: joeofthealps
source: They are found above the clouds on mountaintops, photosynthesizing to grow the bulbs on their backs. The cold conditions in these areas slow their growth, and it often takes years for the bulb to bloom.

entry: POKENAME常攀在崖边，让叶片尽量多晒太阳。它十分护着球茎，曾把对手从最爱的晒太阳处撞下，落到无防备的登山者头上。
author: joeofthealps
source: POKENAME can often be seen clinging to cliff sides to expose their leaves to the most sunlight possible. Fiercely protective of its bulbs, it has been known to knock rivals out of its favored basking spots and onto the heads of unsuspecting hikers.

entry: POKENAME通常温顺，爱晒太阳滋养背上的花。可一察觉树被砍，就变得极凶，引发泥石流吓退伐木工。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are typically docile creatures that enjoy soaking up the sun's rays for the flower on their back. However, they become incredibly aggressive whenever they sense that a tree is chopped down, and cause mudslides to scare away lumberjacks.

entry: POKENAME球茎外壳不断受热，奔跑时又冷却，保护里面待开的花，仿佛钻石铸成。叶片吸收阳光后产热，能维持到下次日出。
author: oreee0230
source: The casing around an POKENAME's bulb is constantly heated and cools as it runs, protecting the budding flower inside as if it were made of diamond. Its leaves generate heat after absorbing sunlight, which can last until the next sunrise.

entry: POKENAME尾端的花苞、叶片都耐火。快跑时，背上的火焰会留下一道火痕。
author: oreee0230
source: The buds and leaves at the end of POKENAME's tail are resistant to flames. When it runs quickly, the flame on its back leaves a trail.

entry: POKENAME从尾尖的花朵放出独特香气，引来野生宝可梦。它十分懒惰，便用超能力摘取树上的水果，省得攀爬。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lures other wild Pokémon toward it by releasing a distinctive aroma from the flower at the tip of its tail. Because it's very lazy, it uses its psychic powers to pick fruit from trees so it doesn't have to climb.

entry: 花苞长得太大时，它就无法再用后腿站立。人们看见这一幕，常会把POKENAME误认成树林龟。
author: dodoowner_
source: If its bulb grows too large, it'll lose the ability to stand on its hind legs. When people see this, they often mistake POKENAME for a Grotle.

entry: POKENAME尾部植物像共生伙伴，持续供应能量滋养它；它则不断补回植物用去的水和矿物质。
author: oreee0230
source: The plant at POKENAME's tail acts like a symbiote. The plant nourishes POKENAME with a continuous supply of energy while POKENAME constantly replenishes the water and minerals used.

entry: 它的电力如今全部储存在头顶的花苞里，再通过磁铁形状的藤蔓释放出去。
author: mariod246
source: All of its electricity is now stored in the bulb at the top of its head. It uses its magnet-shaped vines to expel said electricity.

entry: 花苞中的电荷吸引来了另外两只妙蛙磁怪。三只聚在一起，电力也增至原来的三倍。
author: mariod246
source: The charge from its bulb has attracted two other Ivytons. Together, they triple their electric power.

entry: POKENAME爱炫耀羽毛，便长出花来，练习华丽动作。战斗中若没能迷住对手，花就会长成强劲刺藤。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy flaunting their feathers, so they grow flowers that they can practice their grand gestures with. If they fail to charm their opponent in battle, their flowers will grow into powerful thorny vines.

entry: POKENAME有两个头，花头没眼没嘴，只有另一个能交流。花头常因对方打扰传粉而生气，却没有有效办法阻止。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have two heads, but only one can communicate, as the flowery head has no eyes and no mouth. It often grows angry at the other head for disrupting pollination but has no effective means to stop it.

entry: 三个头帮助平衡沉重球茎，免得摔倒，长腿也因此格外强壮，能长跑许久不休息。
author: infinex21
source: Its three heads help it to maintain balance with its heavy bulb and not fall over. Its long legs are extremely strong as a further result, so it can run for long periods without rest.

entry: POKENAME长时间漂在海里，将尾巴高高举起，靠光合作用收集进化能量。
author: corra_universe
source: POKENAME spends long periods of time drifting in the sea. It holds its tail high above itself to photosynthesize energy for evolution.

entry: POKENAME吃污泥，从背上开花的球茎产生绿色肥料。吸收肥料的植物常变异、长出怪异结构，让科学家困惑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME take sludge and consume it to produce a green fertilizer from the flowery bulb on their back. Plants that absorb this fertilizer often mutate and develop strange growths, baffling scientists.

entry: POKENAME构成身体的黏液，能作除草毒剂，深受园丁喜爱。它不许靠近携带的花苞，有谁想碰，就释放毒瓦斯。
author: fiordaliso
source: The slime it is made of can be used as a poison for weeds and is highly appreciated by gardeners. It doesn't allow anyone to approach the bud it carries, and if someone tries to touch it, POKENAME releases Poison Gas.

entry: 坚硬壳内是它生长植物的地方，植物从底部探出，形成尾巴。遇险时，再把这条植物尾巴收回壳里。
author: soup1900
source: The inside of its hard shell is where this Pokémon grows its flora, which then pokes out at the bottom to produce a tail shape. When in danger, it will retract this floral tail back into its shell.

entry: 它吸收阳光为炮管积蓄能量。蓄满后便会射出两道强劲的日光束，足以贯穿混凝土。
author: soup1900
source: It absorbs sunlight to charge its cannons. Once it is fully charged, it'll fire two powerful Solar Beams that can tear through concrete.

entry: POKENAME身边笼着朦胧雾气，滋养附近植物。气态身体让它穿过破损墙壁，从另一边现身。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a hazy fog around their bodies that nourishes nearby plants. Their gaseous bodies allow them to slip through damaged walls and reappear on the other side.

entry: POKENAME有毒的身体散出浓烈花香，住处长满能抵抗它毒素的植物。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's poisonous body has a strong floral fragrance. The areas it inhabits are filled with plants that resist its toxins.

entry: POKENAME靠遍布全身的坚挺藤蔓相连。藤蔓网络释放矿物质，被构成身体的岩石吸收，让它比附近岩石更坚硬。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are connected with a set of rigid vines that span their entire body. The network of vines releases minerals that get absorbed into the rocks that comprise their body, making them tougher than the rocks around them.

entry: POKENAME靠人的梦维生，一边释放孢子，一边造出催眠的花瓣阵，让人入睡。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME feeds off people's dreams to sustain itself. It lulls people asleep by releasing spores while also creating a hypnotic array of petals.

entry: POKENAME用嘴过滤土壤，吸取养分，只吐出干粉尘和碎石。只要能量、阳光充足，受损的钳子短短半小时就能再生。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME can absorb nutrients from the soil by filtering it through its mouth, only spitting out dry dust and gravel. If its claws are damaged, it can swiftly regenerate them in just half an hour, as long as it has enough energy and sunlight.

entry: POKENAME住在岩岸，背上的花需要海水，才能继续绽放。它通常平和，用嘴吹泡泡，与同类交流。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lives along rocky coastlines, as the flower on its back needs seawater to keep blooming. A generally peaceful creature, it produces bubbles from its mouth to communicate with others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME会啃咬地窖、食品储藏室的门框和门板。人们以为它们惦记着里面的奶酪，其实它们是在分解木质纤维，为背上的种子获取养分。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gnaw away at the frames and doors to cellars or pantries. While it is common belief that they are after the cheese stored within, they actually break down the wood grain of the structures to gather nutrients for their bulbs.

entry: 成群POKENAME住在废弃发电厂，吃剩余电力。有时为宣示统治地位，会试着咬穿彼此金属壳，夺取更多电。
author: mistymagius
source: Hordes of POKENAME live in abandoned power plants, feasting on the leftover electricity. To show dominance over the rest of the hordes, they will sometimes try to bite through each other's metal shell for more electricity.

entry: POKENAME住在食物稀少的洞窟与地道网中，靠啃骨获取骨髓。它们甚至会随身带着骨头，饿了就吃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in caves and tunnel networks that have very few sources of food. They will gnaw on bones to extract marrow from them, going so far as to carry bones with them to feed off when they get hungry.

entry: POKENAME战斗时将长尾当鞭，高速抽打其他宝可梦。尾内有密实骨头加固，帮助承受冲击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wield their long tails as whips during battles with other Pokémon, lashing out with them at high speed. Their tails are reinforced internally with dense bones to help them survive the impacts.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴当鞭，常统治一群小拉达，把它们使唤到精疲力竭。
author: atlas3339098
source: POKENAME uses its tail like a whip. It often lords over a pack of Rattata that it works to the bone.

entry: 传说一只POKENAME曾带着一群杰尼龟逃进下水道。杰尼龟随后成了金黄市的夜间义警，它则担任睿智导师。
author: violet_zero
source: Rumor has it that a POKENAME once fled to the sewers with a group of Squirtle in tow. The Squirtle would soon become the nightly vigilantes of Saffron City, with POKENAME as their wisened mentor.

entry: POKENAME在下水道吃垃圾、丢弃食物，活得很好。它格斗极熟练，尾巴帮助平衡，向敌人踢出一阵连击。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME thrive in sewers, eating trash and thrown-out food to survive. They are incredibly skilled fighters, their tails helping them balance as they unleash flurries of kicks at foes.

entry: POKENAME成群住在肮脏的下水道里。无论它吐出的气体还是咬伤，都可能传播多种疾病。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME live together in groups in dirty sewers. Both the gas it emits and its bite transmit numerous diseases.

entry: 极少数情况下，拉弹的尾巴会缠在一起，再也无法分开，最终形成POKENAME。
author: chorb33
source: In rare cases, the tails of Ratfings become so entangled that they can no longer detach and form POKENAME.

entry: 没人确切知道POKENAME究竟有几条尾巴。发现过少至4条的个体，也有多达50条的。
author: mistymagius
source: It is not quite known how many tails POKENAME actually has. Some specimens have been found to have as few as 4, but others have had as many as 50.

entry: POKENAME是入侵性很强的融合体，囤积草地上的花，几分钟就能全摘光。它用花蜜，让触角产生奶酪气味的露液，喂给幼崽。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME is a very invasive fusion that hoards flowers from grassy fields, picking every flower there in minutes. They use the nectar from the flowers to create a cheesy-smelling dew from their antennas to feed their young.

entry: 一喂奶酪，POKENAME身上就冒出额外尾巴，还尖叫着要更多。若察觉附近还有，就用屏障困住人，嘴里滴着浓口水。
author: .izik
source: If fed cheese, extra tails erupt from POKENAME's body as it screeches for more. It will trap people behind a Barrier if it senses more cheese nearby, thick saliva dripping from its maw.

entry: POKENAME牙齿排列凌乱，却能撕碎大多数食物。带膻味的肉、骨头都轻易咬碎，反而很难啃食猎物的肥肉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a chaotic arrangement of teeth that shred through most food. They can easily shred gamy meat and break apart bones but have a difficult time eating fatty parts of prey.

entry: POKENAME总找东西啃，通常咬冰山，有时也在木船上钻洞。不过，它通常会留在附近，营救沉船乘客。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is always looking for things to gnaw on, and while it usually chews on icebergs, it may also bore holes in wooden ships. POKENAME usually remains in the area to rescue passengers from the sinking ship.

entry: POKENAME从垃圾箱吃到新食物，就会本能地变成它。这段时间，即使遇到威胁，也变不回原样。
author: .izik
source: After eating new food from a dumpster, POKENAME instinctively transforms into it. During this time, it cannot revert, even if threatened.

entry: POKENAME在海滩附近游泳找垃圾，用利牙撕开。尾巴像舵一样，帮助游动时转向。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME swim near beaches in search of trash, using their sharp fangs to tear through garbage. They use their tails like rudders to steer as they swim.

entry: POKENAME偏爱吃过时文件格式，因此常住进老电脑。桌面电脑尤其古旧时，部分身体可能加载得更慢。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often ends up in older computers because it prefers consuming obsolete file formats. Parts of its body may take longer to load on especially antiquated desktop computer systems.

entry: POKENAME凭庞大体型，为自己率领的族群定下所有规矩。它还主演过一部知名、广受影评人赞誉的三维动画电影。
author: grilled7up
source: POKENAME makes all of the rules for the packs it leads due to its sheer size. It also starred in a famous and critically acclaimed 3D animated movie.

entry: 多种特征让这只融合宝可梦格外适合树栖生活。它会从树上俯冲而下，抢走路人手中的食物。
author: vaporvenator
source: A combination of traits make this fusion suitable for a uniquely arboreal lifestyle. It swoops down from trees to snatch food from passersby.

entry: POKENAME胡须隔着数英里也能感知奶酪。它不停大吃，还把多余的存进毛里，留待以后。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's whiskers are able to sense cheese from miles away. They will constantly gorge themselves on cheese, storing extra in their fur for later.

entry: POKENAME十分活跃，身体柔韧弯曲，很难抓牢。毛长得快、脱得也容易，哪怕抓得再紧，也能挣脱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are very active Pokémon that are difficult to pin down thanks to their sinuous bodies. Their fur grows quickly and comes away from their body easily, letting them pull free from even the tightest grip.

entry: POKENAME粗硬的毛发，能帮助它抵御异常状态最严重的影响。尾巴上没有一点毛，却能迅速挥动，当作鞭子攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have rough, coarse fur that helps to protect them from the worst impacts of status effects. Their tails have no fur at all and can be moved rapidly, letting POKENAME use it as a whip to attack with.

entry: POKENAME毛虽常乱蓬蓬，却会细心梳理，避免打结。它什么会动的都吃，还啃猎物骨头，磨短不断生长的门牙。
author: empty_set
source: While its fur may often look disheveled, POKENAME carefully preens itself to avoid matting.  Eating anything that moves, it gnaws on the bones of its prey to wear down its ever-growing front teeth.

entry: POKENAME的女王产两种蜜，一种供巢内同伴安全食用，另一种对野生宝可梦有毒。巢里总满是毒蜜，足以让圈圈熊最幸运的一天瞬间变糟。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: A POKENAME queen produces two kinds of honey. One that is safe and consumable to its hive, and one that is toxic to wild Pokémon. POKENAME hives are always filled with this toxic honey, which can make an Ursaring's luckiest day turn instantly sour.

entry: POKENAME是难应付的家中害兽，闯进屋啃家具、偷垃圾。一被发现就瞬间传送逃走，等能回来，再来一遍。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite the household pest to deal with. It will invade homes to gnaw on furniture and steal trash, but always teleports away when found, waiting until it can return later and repeat the process.

entry: POKENAME全年采野生树果，储粮过冬。主要吃木子果，治愈身上的各种病痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME forage for wild berries throughout the year to store up supplies for winter. Their diet mainly consists of Lum Berries, which cure them of any ailments they may have.

entry: POKENAME缠住垃圾桶，不让其他生命靠近自己的发现。等吃完，就头也不回地丢下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wraps its body around trash cans to keep others away from its find. Once it's done eating, it abandons the can without a second glance.

entry: 感知有人梦里吃奶酪，POKENAME就栖在窗外，用食梦享用这场幻想。
author: .izik
source: If it senses cheese being eaten in someone's dream, POKENAME perches outside their window. It then uses Dream Eater to consume the fantasy.

entry: POKENAME用丝把猎物裹成茧，连网一起吃。丝网回收的额外养分，帮助大牙保持强健、洁净。
author: sk372
source: After cocooning prey in its silk, POKENAME will consume the webbing along with its meal. The recovered extra nutrients from the web help maintain its large teeth, keeping them strong and clean.

entry: POKENAME独自捕猎，靠剧毒咬击，常放倒两倍体型的宝可梦。它在肮脏巷子筑巢，也常为最佳位置互相打斗。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are solitary hunters, often taking down Pokémon twice their size with their incredibly toxic bite. They make nests in filth-filled alleys and often fight each other over the best spots.

entry: POKENAME玩耍时常绊倒，偶尔掉下几片壳，就慌忙捡回来。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME frequently trips while playing. Occasionally, parts of the shell will fall off of its body and it will scramble to pick them up.

entry: 喂了奶酪，POKENAME的未来景象就变得混乱，反复看见拉外套拉链、草被踩过等平凡画面。
author: .izik
source: If fed cheese, POKENAME's visions of the future become erratic. It repeatedly sees mundane images, like a coat being zipped or grass being stepped on.

entry: POKENAME翅缘排着牙本质构成的齿状结构，似乎胡乱相撞作响。研究者发现，它预见未来前几分钟，就会出现这种声音。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have rows of dentine lining the edges of their wings; these tooth-like structures rattle against one another seemingly randomly. Researchers have determined that this happens a few minutes before POKENAME receive visions of the future.

entry: POKENAME生气时，尖牙噼啪冒火花，可能不知不觉就电到附近的朋友或敌人。
author: .izik
source: Sparks crackle from POKENAME's fangs when it's angry. During this period, it may shock nearby friends or foes without realizing it.

entry: POKENAME让幼小的小拉达住进蓬松的肢体部位，保护它们。对方增加的重量，也让它不易被风吹走。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME protects young Rattata by housing them in its fluffy extremities. In turn, the weight they add helps stop POKENAME from being blown away in the wind.

entry: 除非递来最爱的食物，训练家最好别摸POKENAME。这只灵活滑溜的小拉达，却有进化后的咬合力，能留下疼痛、愈合缓慢的伤口。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: Trainers should avoid petting POKENAME unless offering its favorite food. This agile and slippery Rattata has the bite force of its evolution and can leave painful wounds that take a long time to heal.

entry: 打结的尾巴如同第三只手，专门顺走看中的东西。遇上危险，POKENAME还能咬断尾巴，引开敌人的注意。
author: mistymagius
source: Its knotted tails act like a third arm, mainly being used to swipe things that catch its eye. When in danger, POKENAME can chew off its tail to use as a distraction.

entry: POKENAME啃修大牙狸筑的坝，确保水道畅通，再用有蹼的脚在水中游泳觅食。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME will nibble at dams built by Bidoof to ensure proper flow of waterways, where it swims with its webbed feet in search of food.

entry: POKENAME爱在河里懒游，却常迷路、撞上船。碰上这种事，就顺势啃穿船壳，寻找零食。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME likes to swim lazily in the river, often losing its way and bumping into boats. When it does this, it seizes an opportunity to gnaw through the hull in search of snacks.

entry: POKENAME故意把昂贵手袋、衣服咬出大洞，毁掉物品。甚至只是为使坏，也会咬穿金首饰。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME goes around intentionally ruining expensive items like handbags and clothing by chewing large holes in them. It will even chew through gold jewelry just out of spite.

entry: POKENAME从背上球茎射出藤蔓，掀倒垃圾桶，再在散落垃圾中翻找腐烂食物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME topples over trash cans by shooting vines from the bulb on its back. It rummages through the resulting pile of trash in search of rotten food.

entry: 有报告称，POKENAME在暗中统领着数支拉达小队。这些小队彼此配合，企图控制道路。
author: the_smirker
source: Reports state POKENAME commands small legions of Raticate in secret. These legions work together to assert control over routes.

entry: 头发和门牙长得一样快。它常得自己啃掉一些丰厚秀发，才不至于太长。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: The hairs on its head grow as fast as its fangs. It often has to pare down its luscious locks by chewing on them.

entry: POKENAME眼睛对光极敏感，因此常钻进地下室。身上长出的奶酪，泥土风味浓郁，很受鉴赏家欢迎。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will often tunnel into basements, as their eyes are very sensitive to light. The cheese that grows on their body has a strong earthy flavor, which makes it quite popular among connoisseurs.

entry: POKENAME吃奶酪十分认真，若被打扰，就闹脾气，直到能继续吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME takes cheese eating very seriously. If interrupted, it flies into a tantrum until it can begin eating again.

entry: 有时，拉达群中几只成员神秘融合，就会出现它。它常要求全群服从，宣示统治；多数成员宁可离群，也不肯屈服新首领。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: This Pokémon sometimes emerges among Raticate packs when several members mysteriously fuse. It often asserts dominance over the pack, demanding obedience. Most others in its pack abandon the group rather than submit to their new leader.

entry: POKENAME用四个头寻找满是奶酪的商店。可每个头性格不同，常为先偷哪块奶酪打起来。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME use their four heads to find stores full of cheese. However, each head has its own personality, often leading them to fight over which cheese to steal first.

entry: 有时，拉达群中几只成员神秘融合，就会出现它。它常要求全群服从，宣示统治；多数成员宁可离群，也不肯屈服新首领。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: This Pokémon sometimes emerges among Raticate packs when several members mysteriously fuse. It often asserts dominance over the pack, demanding obedience. Most others in its pack abandon the group rather than submit to their new leader.

entry: 融合后的POKENAME很像阿罗拉形态的拉达。研究者对原因看法不一，有人认为源于基因，也有人指出生活方式相似。
author: katieplaysgames
source: When fused, POKENAME bear a strong resemblance to Alolan Raticate. Researchers are divided on why this similarity exists, some arguing for a genetic basis whilst others point to lifestyle similarities.

entry: POKENAME靠两个鼻子，轻松找到盒里藏的奶酪。常一个头吃，另一个放哨。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Using their two noses, POKENAME are able to easily find cheese hidden in boxes. Often, one head eats while the other acts as a lookout.

entry: 两只拉达神秘融合，有时就出现它。它很快凭威慑感要求服从，统治族群；多数拉达宁可逃跑，也不接受管辖。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: This Pokémon sometimes emerges when a couple of Raticate mysteriously fuse. It quickly asserts dominance over the pack, using its imposing presence to demand obedience. Most Raticate flee rather than accept its rule.

entry: 最好远离POKENAME的巢。一发现有人靠近，就会凶猛抓咬，直到对方离开领地。颚强得能咬穿小骨头。
author: mistymagius
source: It is best to stay away from a POKENAME's nest, as if it spots you near it, it will violently claw and bite until you leave its territory. Its jaws are strong enough to chomp through small bones.

entry: POKENAME用巨大的门牙彼此较量。族群首领的门牙往往最大也最锋利。
author: kitarchen
source: POKENAME use their giant fangs to compete. The leader of a pack of POKENAME often have the largest and sharpest fangs.

entry: POKENAME厚毛足以抵御栖居苔原的严寒。它与同伴攻击一切入境者，挥动锋利爪子，接连猛攻。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's fur is thick enough to protect it from the freezing temperatures of the tundras where it lives. Together with its companions, it attacks anyone who enters its territory, bombarding them with its razor-sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME不断啃树磨牙，走到哪都留齿痕。它能迅速爬树，用尾巴打下树果和蜂巢。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are constantly gnawing on trees to shave down their teeth, leaving bite marks wherever they go. They are able to swiftly climb trees, using their tails to swat down berries and hives.

entry: POKENAME用牙放倒巨树，吃掉落树果。它囤积大批树果，以狂暴攻击捍卫存粮。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their teeth to fell massive trees, consuming the fallen berries. They hoard massive stockpiles of these berries, defending their food with rabid aggression.

entry: 进攻前，POKENAME尾巴会炽红发光。这段延迟给敌人机会逃走，可真打中，威力极强。
author: .izik
source: Before attacking, POKENAME's tail glows red-hot. This delay gives foes a chance to escape, though the attack itself is devastating if it lands.

entry: POKENAME啃穿奶场的墙，寻找鲜奶。它们用高体温让奶凝成奶酪，再偷走，令奶农苦恼不已。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME gnaw their way through the walls of dairies in search of fresh milk. They use their high body heat to curdle the milk into cheese to steal away, much to the dismay of the dairy farmers.

entry: POKENAME顽强难缠，吃起东西破坏力惊人，有时被称为“害兽之王”。关都屋顶漏雨，头号祸首就是它啃坏了瓦片。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME are sometimes called "apex vermin" due to their tenacity and destructive eating habits. POKENAME chewing through roofing tiles is the leading cause of roof leaks in Kanto.

entry: POKENAME常一边飞，一边啃石头磨牙。石块也常从嘴里掉下，砸中路人脑袋的事，已经发生过许多次。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME can often be seen gnawing on rocks mid-flight to whittle down its fangs. It is not uncommon for it to drop these rocks, and there have been many occasions where the falling rocks have hit people in the head.

entry: POKENAME住在沿海城市下水道。突起物极脆，打斗时常断，必须尽量吃东西，促进再生。
author: mochauspocus
source: POKENAME live in the sewers of coastal cities. Their protrusions are very brittle and break off frequently in scuffles, so they must eat whatever they can to promote regrowth.

entry: POKENAME尾随毫无防备的海滩游客，等时机偷食物。有些也会趁深夜人少，闯进食品储藏室。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME stalk unsuspecting beachgoers waiting for the right moment to steal food. Some are known to break into pantries in the middle of the night when there are few people.

entry: POKENAME不但咬合力强，牙还带弱毒，最好别惹。不过它天性不凶，宁愿咬一口就跑，也不留下争斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's teeth not only have a strong bite force but a mild venom to them as well, making it ill-advised to agitate. Its not aggressive by nature though, preferring to bite and run rather than stay and fight.

entry: 吃过奶酪的第二天，POKENAME会因戒断反应，滚得摇摇晃晃。一小块奶酪，就能立刻让动作恢复正常。
author: .izik
source: The day after eating cheese, POKENAME wobbles while rolling due to withdrawal. A small piece immediately returns its motion to normal.

entry: POKENAME像有显示器、鼠标的电脑，却不带键盘。它常显示小拉达和拉达出演的节目，训练家一不在，就会播放。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME resemble a PC that has a display and a mouse, though they do not come equipped with a keyboard. They often display shows where Rattata and Raticate are featured and play these shows whenever their Trainer is not around.

entry: POKENAME用体内复杂软件，为小宝可梦表演。隐藏的蹼脚配合小量放电产生的静电，让它能在任何表面保持平衡。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME use the intricate software installed inside their bodies to put on shows for small Pokémon. POKENAME can balance on any surface, using their hidden webbed feet in conjunction with static created from small electrical discharges.

entry: POKENAME懂数十种战斗招式，还用硬化尖牙作小盾，运用这些知识，以惊人准确度挡住来袭攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME knows dozens of fighting moves. It wields this knowledge with hardened fangs that act like tiny shields, blocking incoming attacks with surprising accuracy.

entry: POKENAME咬击虽无毒，强颚却能碎骨，极其危险。暖地里，它会脱掉大半毛，露出底下苍白的鳞皮。
author: mistymagius
source: While not venomous, POKENAME's bite is incredibly dangerous as its strong jaws are powerful enough to break bone. In warmer climates, it sheds most of its fur, showing the pale, scaly skin underneath.

entry: POKENAME清洁习惯极讲究，会找纯净水源洗自己。工业化越普遍，就越少能见到它。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are fastidious in their cleaning habits, seeking out pure water sources to clean themselves. They have become a rare sight since industrialisation has become more common.

entry: POKENAME尾巴灵活，能钻过小缝取物。尾巴没有痛觉感受器，因此受伤可能也察觉不到。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's tails are quite flexible, allowing them to maneuver through small cracks to retrieve items. As the tails have no pain receptors, POKENAME may not notice if one is injured.

entry: POKENAME脾气暴躁，饿时尤其如此，只有最耐心的训练家养得来。攻击凶猛，先电击，再咬敌人。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME has a short temper, especially when hungry, so only the most patient Trainers can raise it. It strikes ferociously, biting its foes after jolting them with electricity.

entry: POKENAME只吃奶酪，一天最多吃自重5倍。因此有人见过，成群的它们袭击超市，抢光全部奶酪。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's diet consists entirely of cheese, eating up to 5 times their body weight in cheese a day. Due to their limited diet, hordes of POKENAME have been seen raiding supermarkets of their entire cheese supply.

entry: 神奥寒冷地区的训练家，每年举行诱捕POKENAME的比赛。它会冻住锁，轻易偷空整间食品储藏室，却也狡猾得能识破、避开陷阱。
author: ghostslythe
source: In the colder regions of Sinnoh, Trainers hold an annual POKENAME trap contest. These Pokémon are known to freeze locks, easily stealing entire pantries of food, yet are cunning enough to notice and avoid traps.

entry: POKENAME挖隧道遇到挡路石头，宁可用利牙啃穿，也不绕路挖。
author: .izik
source: While tunneling, POKENAME uses its sharp fang to gnaw through stones blocking its path. It prefers to chew rather than dig around.

entry: 门牙长得太难使唤，POKENAME就找树皮最坚韧的树干啃，磨短牙。毛上的白麝香味极受追捧，被用于卡洛斯名贵香水。
author: fiordaliso
source: When its incisors grow too unwieldy, POKENAME files them down by gnawing on the toughest-barked tree trunks it can find. The white musk scent of its fur is highly sought after for crafting renowned perfumes in the Kalos region.

entry: POKENAME尾上长着粗硬厚毛，当刷子清理洞穴。争食时，会短促有力地扫动，扫得最响的通常获胜。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have thick, bristly hairs on their tail that they use like a brush to keep their burrows clean. When challenging one another for food, they will make short, sharp sweeps, with the loudest sweeper usually being the winner.

entry: POKENAME挖秘密隧道通往杂货店，只为偷奶酪。没找到嗅到的东西，就绝不停止。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs secret tunnels into grocery stores just to steal cheese. It will not stop until it finds what it's smelling out.

entry: 往POKENAME壳上的洞看，会极其在意自己的牙齿，直到不舒服。它自己的牙，则终生不停生长。
author: chibitales
source: Peering into the hole on POKENAME's shell makes the looker incredibly aware of their teeth to the point that they become uncomfortable. POKENAME's own teeth continue to grow throughout its lifespan.

entry: 成群POKENAME住在下水道，吃流入的垃圾。毛里虽带许多细菌，仍有人用它清除家中废物。
author: mistymagius
source: Hordes of POKENAME live in sewers, feeding on the garbage that flows down there. Despite the many types of bacteria it carries in its fur, some people use POKENAME to help get rid of household rubbish.

entry: POKENAME喜欢修牙、寻找并戴上水玉色之带等简单小事，改善外貌。一点小礼就能满足，因此很少不开心。
author: quackquackattack
source: They enjoy small, simple tasks to improve their appearance, from trimming their teeth to finding and wearing a Polkadot Bow. An unhappy POKENAME is rare given that they are easily pleased by the smallest of gifts.

entry: POKENAME是各地食品仓库的祸害，用利牙、爪子挖穿几乎任何东西找吃的。大吃时噪声极大，因此族群很难长期不被察觉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The scourge of food warehouses everywhere, POKENAME use their sharp teeth and claws to dig through nearly anything in search of food. A population of POKENAME rarely goes undetected for long due to the loud noise they make while feasting.

entry: POKENAME释放毒孢子，加快食物腐败。它尤其喜欢人们丢掉的发霉奶酪、过期饮料。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME releases toxic spores that hasten the decomposition of food. It especially loves moldy cheeses and expired drinks that people throw away.

entry: POKENAME适应力极强，几乎有食物就能捕猎、繁盛。不过对人类有攻击性，家中一发现，就得叫专业捕手。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are incredibly adaptable, able to hunt and thrive just about anywhere food is available. As they are aggressive toward humans, specialized catchers must be called if one is spotted in your house.

entry: 人们普遍认为POKENAME十分危险，却也有一小群爱好者很喜欢照顾它们。
author: mossybanana
source: POKENAME is generally considered a very dangerous Pokémon. There is, however, a niche community that greatly enjoys caring for them.

entry: POKENAME身侧的柔韧突起推动游泳，外形虽笨重，水中却很快。它冲向猎物，用锋利门牙咬住捕食。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have flexible growths along their flanks that propel them through the water, letting them swim quickly despite their ungainly appearance. They hunt by racing toward their prey and biting at them with their sharp incisors.

entry: POKENAME不爱与外界接触，远离人群聚居，野外很少见。直到近来还被以为已经灭绝，只发现过化石。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are insular and rarely seen in the wild, forming colonies far from people. Until recently, they were thought to be an extinct Pokémon species, with only fossils of them being found.

entry: POKENAME用利牙撕开仓库门，贪婪偷食。双腿与尾巴大力砸地，能使地面剧烈摇晃。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its sharp fangs to tear down the doors of warehouses from which it voraciously steals food. It can violently shake the ground by powerfully slamming its legs and tail against it.

entry: POKENAME在垃圾箱顶尖叫，操纵远方来者的感知。受影响者会不断献供，直到它离去，幻象才消退。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits a shrill cry from atop dumpsters that manipulates perception across great distances. Those affected bring offerings until it departs, at which point the illusion fades.

entry: POKENAME极其珍爱背上的奶酪拼盘。就算只是看它的眼神不对，手上也可能狠狠挨一口。
author: patch
source: POKENAME heavily values the cheese platter on its back. Even just looking at it the wrong way can result in a nasty bite to the hand.

entry: 最强的POKENAME，牙也最大最尖。它想咬岩石等硬物炫耀力气，结果却把牙弄断。
author: mistymagius
source: The strongest of POKENAME have the largest and sharpest teeth. They will try to bite strong objects such as rocks to show off their strength, only to have their teeth broken in the process.

entry: POKENAME夜里在巷中闻到餐馆的饭香后，曾持剑胁迫店员，把食物抢走。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME has held restaurant employees at sword-point to steal the food it smells from the alleyways at night.

entry: 一喂奶酪，POKENAME就陷入狂乱，角里毒液失控渗出，铺满下方地面。
author: .izik
source: When fed cheese, POKENAME flies into a frenzy. Venom leaks uncontrollably from its horn, coating the ground beneath it.

entry: POKENAME牙釉质刀刃很锋利，敞开的胸口嘴也排着利牙。可刀刃极脆、易断，迫使它退避再生。
author: evilgammon
