source: POKENAME's enamel blades are very sharp, as are the teeth lining its gaping chest-mouth. These blades are extremely brittle and easily broken, however, forcing it to retreat to regenerate them.

entry: 这只机灵的啮齿类宝可梦以高智商闻名。会用爪子和手状缎带解开遇到的各种谜题，需要格外用心照顾。
author: melodydelune
source: Known for its high IQ, this crafty rodent Pokémon uses its paws and hand-ribbons to solve various puzzles it finds. It requires extra attention.

entry: 谁想靠近POKENAME据为家的地方，它就迅速叩牙警告。若不理会，便扑向惹怒它的家伙，狠狠咬下。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME rapidly chatter their fangs as a warning to anyone who tries to come close to a place they have claimed as home. If their warning is ignored, they lunge at the subject of their ire to land vicious bites.

entry: POKENAME会收集死去的啮齿动物的灵魂。据说向它供奉奶酪，就能让家中免受鼠患。
author: jaycielantern
source: POKENAME collects the soul of every rodent that meets its end. It is said that offering it tributes of cheese keeps one's home free from pests.

entry: POKENAME吃植物，结实尖牙对它却没太多用。遇到威胁，有的逃跑，有的用强踢反击。
author: mystora
source: POKENAME are herbivorous, so their sturdy fangs are not very useful to them. When threatened, some POKENAME run away, whilst others retaliate with a powerful kick.

entry: 头上的针和裹绷带的尾巴，让POKENAME像受伤、无力战斗。可一靠近，它便猛扑狠咬，刺痛如同一千根针同时扎来。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: The needles in its head and its bandaged tail make POKENAME appear hurt and unable to fight. When approached, however, it lunges forward with a bite that stings like being pierced by a thousand needles at once.

entry: POKENAME任背毛长得极其茂密，当作储藏处。它把偷来的小食藏进去，往后只消抖一抖，随时都有零嘴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lets the fur on its back grow out to copious levels so it can act as a place of storage. It stows away stolen morsels in the fur, so it always has a snack it can shake loose later.

entry: POKENAME族群喜欢住在电流不断的地方。城里的个体常待快餐店旁，似乎特别爱偷披萨。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME colonies are drawn to live in places with a constant electric current. Urban POKENAME can often be found around fast food shops and appear to have a preference for stealing pizza.

entry: 矿井一荒废，POKENAME就迁入，不知为何开始挖掘。它极护着头顶的蜡烛。
author: rakanadyo
source: If a mine is left abandoned, POKENAME will move in and begin digging for unknown purposes. They are extremely protective of the candles on their heads.

entry: POKENAME多条尾巴放出强热，扭曲周围空气。还没看见，就能感到它在。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's many tails radiate intense heat, distorting the air around them. Its presence can be felt before it's even seen.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴收集各种杂物，甚至小生物。不过千万别硬抢，它会毫不迟疑地用巨大门牙，留下狠痛的一口。
author: sk372
source: It uses its tail to collect all manners of junk and even smaller creatures, but one should never try to take something from it by force; POKENAME will not hesitate to leave a nasty bite with its massive incisors.

entry: POKENAME没人看管就很调皮。训练家不在时，爱闯进食品储藏室，想吃什么就吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be quite naughty when left to their own devices. They enjoy breaking into food pantries to eat whatever they want while their Trainer is away.

entry: POKENAME用短臂攀住高台边缘，探头张望，显得像小得多的宝可梦。待猎物经过，再用异形长须捉住，从晶体核心闪出激光，将其击晕。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME will peer over ledges and hold on with its short arms, looking like a much smaller Pokémon, only to snare passing prey with its long alien tendrils. Then it flashes laser light from its crystalline core to stun them.

entry: POKENAME得啃木头磨短牙。栖地木材不够，就去偷伐木工的柴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME needs to chew on wood to trim its teeth. When there is not enough wood in its natural habitat, it steals firewood from lumberjacks.

entry: 吃奶酪后，POKENAME感知波导的能力倍增，数英里外也能察觉心情和能量水平。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's aura-sensing ability multiplies when it eats cheese. It can detect moods and energy levels from miles away.

entry: 它在热带丛林摇树，为家人做成袋装果实。若送一袋给训练家，就代表把对方也当成家人。
author: quackquackattack
source: It shakes down trees in tropical jungles so that it can make a Fruit Bunch for its family. If it ends up giving a Trainer one of its fruit bunches, then it considers that Trainer a part of its family.

entry: POKENAME强颚能压碎金属，嘴中央的门牙尖利得足以切开岩石。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME can crush metal with its powerful jaws. The incisors in the center of its mouth are sharp enough to cut through rock.

entry: POKENAME总找东西啃。有时连经验丰富的训练家命令也不听，只顾跑去咬树枝。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is constantly trying to find something to gnaw on. It will even ignore the commands of a seasoned Trainer on occasion to run off and nibble on a stick.

entry: POKENAME低声哼鸣，引猎物靠近。一放松，就以破坏力惊人的必杀门牙咬下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hums in a low tone to lure prey closer. Once they relax, it attacks with a devastating Hyper Fang bite.

entry: POKENAME快速叩牙，发出高频尖叫，能扰乱最远100英尺处的猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME snaps its fangs together rapidly to emit high-frequency screeches. These sounds confuse prey from up to 100 feet away.

entry: 面具带着怒容，让POKENAME始终陷在无法抑制的暴怒中，对任何东西都会攻击。
author: crumple_2
source: Because its mask is angry, POKENAME is stuck in a state of unbridled rage, and will lash out at anything and everything.

entry: POKENAME爱躲墙内啃电缆，被视为大害兽。它用断线织网，再用自身电力给网充能。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are considered major pests as they love to hide in the walls and chew on electrical cables. They will use the broken wiring to build their webs, charging them with their own electricity.

entry: 碰上硬得咬不动的东西，POKENAME就发怒爆炸，将尖刺射向四面八方。
author: .izik
source: When it encounters something too tough to bite, POKENAME becomes enraged and explodes. This sends sharp spikes flying in all directions.

entry: POKENAME尖牙不停生长，会啃钟乳石，免得太长。它不爱自己捕猎，通常吃更强宝可梦的剩饭。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's fangs constantly grow, so it can be seen munching on stalactites to keep them from growing too long. It doesn't like hunting for itself, so it usually eats the leftovers from other, stronger Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME装成路上被车撞死的样子，吓退天敌，因为许多天敌不吃露在外面的猎物。恶臭更让对方不想下口。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME mimic the appearance of roadkill to deter predators, as many of their predators refuse to eat prey left out in the open. Their foul scent further discourages predation.

entry: POKENAME十分可怕，见到鼠形动物或宝可梦就追猎。据说它想当住处的首领，谁来阻止就咬谁，同类也不例外。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME are terrifying creatures that hunt down any rodent-like animals or Pokémon they see. It's said that POKENAME try to be the leader of the place they live in and that they would bite anyone trying to stop them, even their own kind.

entry: POKENAME守护族群，用不断生长的结实尖牙，凶猛保卫冰洞。作为回报，同伴带回冻僵旅人时，它总先分一份。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME serves as the protector of its colony, fiercely defending its icy cave with sturdy fangs that never stop growing. In exchange for defending the colony, it always claims the first share of any frozen travelers the others bring home.

entry: POKENAME腹部有个小垃圾袋般的囊，储存捡来的食物。带回族群，再与同类交换最爱的餐食。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has a pouch that resembles a small trash bag on its belly where it stores scavenged food. It brings the food back to its colony to trade for its favorite meals with others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME身体由所吃食物构成，通常是丢弃披萨和其他奶酪制品。只要食物充足，就能长得极大，臭味漫过好几个街区。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's body is composed of the food it eats, generally discarded pizza and other cheese products. It can grow to immense sizes if its food source remains readily available, leading to a stench that can pervade multiple city blocks.

entry: POKENAME无法直接清理自己，每晚便细心互相梳理，确保家人胡须洁净。研究者推测，这有助于维系深厚家庭关系。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fastidiously groom one another each night, working to make sure their families' whiskers are pristine, as they cannot groom themselves directly. Pokémon Researchers theorise this helps to ensure strong family bonds between them.

entry: POKENAME偶尔吃点翅上绒毛，白天又逐渐长好。绒毛似乎没味道，却有一丝新鲜奶酪香。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will occasionally eat some of the fluff on its wings, which grows back over the course of the day. Though the fluff seems flavorless, it carries a faint aroma of fresh cheese.

entry: POKENAME花朵的刺鼻气味像腐烂奶酪。它夜间活动，到人类聚居地大吃丢弃的垃圾。
author: mepp.
source: The pungent odor produced by POKENAME's flower smells similar to rotten cheese. It is nocturnal, visiting urban settlements to feast upon discarded garbage.

entry: POKENAME毛上覆着的东西看似美味奶酪，其实是折磨它的病变物质。撕下会散出恶臭，引来小拉达；物质被消化后，便让它们中毒。
author: soup1900
source: While the material that covers POKENAME's fur may look like delicious cheese, it is actually a diseased substance that plagues POKENAME. Ripping this material off releases a stinky smell that attracts Rattata and poisons them once digested.

entry: POKENAME爱社交、成大群，数量若不加控制，会危及住宅和建筑工程。任其自行活动，连混凝土、钢铁也会被啃穿。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Large populations of POKENAME can be a danger to housing and building projects if left unchecked. They are social and form large packs, and will gnaw through both concrete and steel if left to their own devices.

entry: POKENAME成小群游逛城镇，偏爱荒废地区，少受人类打扰。训练家若驯服一只，就会发现是出奇忠诚的伙伴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form small packs that roam around towns and cities, they prefer to stick to abandoned areas where they don't get disturbed by too many humans. Trainers that manage to tame one find them to be surprisingly loyal companions.

entry: POKENAME分泌富含脂肪的乳状物，硬化成奶酪，吃下会困倦。没别的东西磨门牙时，它就啃自己的翅膀，也会用来喂幼崽。
author: milchik
source: Its body secretes a fatty milk-like substance that hardens into cheese, which has a soporific effect when consumed. POKENAME either gnaws its wings when nothing else is available to grind its incisors, or uses them to feed its young.

entry: POKENAME利牙连最硬树皮也能刺穿，吃里面的软芯。身上真菌控制心智，驱使它攻击一切靠近者。
author: fiordaliso
source: With its sharp teeth, POKENAME can pierce even the bark of the toughest trees to reach their soft core and feed on it. The fungus growing on its body controls its mind and drives it to attack anyone who comes too close.

entry: POKENAME啃自己钢铁般硬的鳞片，免得牙长过头。鳞片看着、闻着都像奶酪，小拉达便不断聚来，想从身上啃下。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME gnaws on its own steel-hard scales to keep its teeth from growing too long. Because its scales look and smell like cheese, Rattata constantly gather around it and attempt to eat them off its body.

entry: POKENAME爱啃木器，毛上满是木屑。受袭时，便抖掉木屑，方便脱身。
author: mistymagius
source: Due to POKENAME's habit of gnawing on wooden objects, its fur is covered in sawdust. When it is attacked, it will shake off the sawdust to allow for an easy getaway.

entry: POKENAME在整块奶酪里筑巢，保证食物不断，是奶酪商的一大害兽。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME create nests inside blocks of cheese, guaranteeing a constant food supply. They're a major pest for cheesemongers.

entry: POKENAME的翅粉刺激性极强，能引起持续数周的剧痒。夜间让屋灯亮着，就会引来它们，试图啃穿墙壁。
author: mistymagius
source: The dust from POKENAME's wings is extremely irritating, causing intense itching that can last for weeks. If you leave a house's lights on during the night, they will be attracted to the light and try to chew through the walls.

entry: POKENAME隔着一英里，也能分清两种不同奶酪的气味。厨房里很有用，但得看紧，免得它不知不觉把奶酪吃掉。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME can distinguish the smell of two different types of cheese from a mile away. They're useful in the kitchen for that ability, though it's important to watch them so that they don't end up mindlessly eating the cheese.

entry: POKENAME身上松弛的皮肤，能在彼此争斗时，帮助它们避免严重的伤害。争抢食物时，它们往往会相互抓挠，再用锋利的牙齿撕咬。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The loose skin around the bodies of POKENAME help protect them from serious injury when they scrap with one another. They have a tendency to scratch at one another and bite with their sharp teeth when fighting for food.

entry: 有人见过POKENAME翻找音乐节结束后留下的垃圾。还有报告说，它会用剩余物品办自己的派对。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME have been sighted rummaging around the trash left behind in the aftermath of music festivals. There have been reports of POKENAME holding their own parties with whatever remained.

entry: POKENAME一边点脚、扭胯，在任何舞池都大显身手，一边稳稳顶着一轮奶酪。跳舞时常吃一口，奶酪却仿佛永远吃不完。
author: regulavish
source: With tapping feet and swinging hips, POKENAME expertly tears up any dance floor, all while balancing a cheese wheel on its head. Despite frequent mid-dance snacking, the cheese never appears to run out.

entry: POKENAME身旁常围着小拉达，啃它坚硬的岩质外壳。孩子常相信它由奶酪构成，传言或许就来自奶酪般的气味。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are often surrounded by Rattata that chew on their tough, rocky exterior. Children often believe that POKENAME are made out of cheese, which is a rumor that likely developed because POKENAME smell like cheese.

entry: POKENAME啃剩骨头或金属罐磨利牙。磨牙被打扰，就向源头射出火星。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sharpen their teeth by chewing on leftover bones or metal cans. When they are interrupted from their teeth maintenance, they shoot embers at the source of the disturbance.

entry: POKENAME从下方钻进粮仓，直到仓空，才有人发现窃贼。
author: ayutac
source: POKENAME burrow into granaries from below, so that no one notices the thieves until the granaries are empty.

entry: 成群POKENAME对木屋十分危险，钻到地基下，转眼就能啃穿木头。
author: ayutac
source: A horde of POKENAME can be very dangerous for a wooden house. They dig under the foundation and gnaw through the wood in no time.

entry: 看见有人吃奶酪，POKENAME就扔神秘硬币过去。对方分心，食物通常掉地，让它趁机偷走。
author: .izik
source: When it spots someone eating cheese, POKENAME hurls mysterious coins at them. The distraction usually causes a meal to be dropped, giving it a chance to pilfer the meal.

entry: 一闻奶酪，POKENAME就不停喵喵叫，蹭着吃的人，可怜巴巴又执着地讨碎屑。
author: .izik
source: When it smells cheese, POKENAME meows relentlessly. It rubs against the eater, pleading for crumbs with pitiful determination.

entry: POKENAME本能地追逐逃跑的小宝可梦，也会被突然动作吸引。训练家陪玩最好用结实或便宜玩具，因为抓到什么都会啃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME instinctively chase any smaller Pokémon that run from them and are attracted to sudden movements. Trainers that play with them are advised to use sturdy toys, or cheap toys, as they will gnaw on anything that they manage to catch.

entry: POKENAME吃垃圾桶食物可能生病，使喙内堵塞。生病时，揉一揉喙，能减轻随之而来的紧张性头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can become ill after eating from garbage cans, which causes congestion to build up in their bills. When POKENAME are sick, rubbing their bill can ease the tension headache that they develop.

entry: POKENAME情绪极不稳，很危险。受惊或发怒，就扑到最近的东西上疯狂啃咬。一抓牢，除非被打晕，否则绝不停止。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very volatile and dangerous, as being startled or angered will cause it to leap onto the nearest thing and gnash wildly at it. Once it has a grip, it will not stop biting unless knocked out.

entry: POKENAME极凶，用利牙撕裂对手。经常同类斗殴，让牙缝里总卡着碎毛。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is incredibly vicious, ripping its opponent apart with its sharp teeth. Since they frequently get into brawls with one another, they often get bits of fur stuck in their teeth.

entry: POKENAME尖牙热得足以熔石。它深夜仍啃岩石，保持牙齿锋利强健。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fangs heat up enough to melt stone. It chews on rocks late into the night to maintain their sharpness and strength.

entry: POKENAME凭体型与力量，统率大群小拉达一系与卡蒂狗的融合体。两只争首领时，会摆出许多威吓姿势，比拼各自火焰的强度。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lead large colonies of Ratlithe, using their bulk and power to take charge. Leadership competitions between two POKENAME involve a lot of posturing and comparing the strength of their own flames.

entry: POKENAME啃死去宝可梦的骨头磨牙，再用强焰烘烤、熔化骨髓，将骨头变成软烂的一餐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gnaws on the bones of dead Pokémon to sharpen its teeth. Afterwards it melts the bone marrow by roasting it with its powerful flames, leaving behind a soft meal made out of bones.

entry: POKENAME读取附近心思，寻找奶酪。发现来源，就瞬间传送偷来，留待以后吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME reads nearby minds to locate cheese. Once it identifies a source, it teleports to steal it for later consumption.

entry: POKENAME随身带叉，随时有奶酪可啃，因为吃了才能思维敏锐。太久吃不到这零食，精神力量就开始不稳定。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries a fork around to always have cheese on-hand to nibble, as consuming cheese keeps its mind sharp. A POKENAME denied this snack for too long begins to exhibit psychic instability.

entry: 不知为何，这种融合体总有四只草苗龟相伴，每只都戴着颜色不同的头巾。见到它们围在一起吃披萨，也不是什么稀罕事。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: For some reason, this fusion is accompanied by four Turtwigs, each with a different color of headband. It's not uncommon to see them eating pizza.

entry: 奶酪香会让POKENAME发狂。它曾为找到源头，将超市门连铰链都打掉。
author: .izik
source: The scent of cheese drives POKENAME into a frenzy. It has been known to punch supermarket doors off their hinges to reach the source.

entry: POKENAME强壮又热心帮助处境艰难的人，医院越来越常用它。常见它护送轮椅病人上车，一受夸就随时准备秀肌肉。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Hospitals have seen an increase in the use of POKENAME thanks to their strength and eagerness to help those less fortunate. It's common to see POKENAME escorting wheelchair patients to vehicles, always ready to flex in response to praise given.

entry: POKENAME解决问题的主要办法，是伸展双臂快速旋转。最爱的点心，是遥远国度的一种珍奇水果。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's main method of dealing with problems is spinning rapidly with its arms outstretched. Its favorite treat is a very exotic fruit from a faraway land.

entry: 吃奶酪被打扰，POKENAME反应极凶。拳力大得能把冒犯者打飞数百英尺。
author: .izik
source: If disturbed while eating cheese, POKENAME reacts violently. It punches with such force that the offender can be launched hundreds of feet.

entry: POKENAME进食时不断叩牙，将吸进嘴里的东西分成许多小口，发出一连串急促咔嗒声。
author: sk372
source: When eating, POKENAME gnashes its teeth together to take many small bites of whatever it sucked into its maw. This causes it to make rapid-fire clacking noises as it eats.

entry: POKENAME住废弃建筑，用强颚慢慢啃穿墙。对同类极有攻击性，常能看到叶子被咬缺。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME inhabit abandoned buildings, slowly gnawing through the walls with their powerful jaws. They are incredibly aggressive with each other and can often be seen with bites taken out of their leaves.

entry: POKENAME靠光合作用长牙，夏天得更常啃树皮、岩石。它借伪装诱来毫无戒心的猎物。
author: rhipuyo
source: A POKENAME's teeth grow through photosynthesis, requiring it to gnaw on bark and rocks more frequently in summer. It attracts unwitting prey through aggressive mimicry.

entry: 看到有人吃东西，POKENAME就气恼地扔石头，盼对方突然受惊，掉下食物。
author: .izik
source: If it sees someone eating, POKENAME throws rocks at them in frustration. It hopes the sudden shock will cause the person to drop their food.

entry: 喂了奶酪，POKENAME火焰会热上十倍。虽然有助战斗，却常意外引起野火。
author: .izik
source: If fed cheese, the flames on POKENAME's body burn ten times hotter. Though helpful in battle, this often leads to accidental wildfires.

entry: POKENAME是溜走高手，缩进壳就像普通一轮奶酪。长长的双尾能抽打对手，发出响亮的啪声，让对方晕头转向，帮助逃脱。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME is a master of sneaking away. It is able to hide in its shell to resemble a normal wheel of cheese, and its long, doubled tail allows it to whip opponents, creating a loud and disorienting crack to aid in its escape.

entry: 进化后，POKENAME会发现一块神秘奶酪。想追查来源的研究者，接触后却报告失忆，可能与它的精神力量有关。
author: .izik
source: Upon evolving, POKENAME discovers a mysterious piece of cheese. Researchers trying to find the source report memory loss after encountering it, possibly due to its psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME尖牙像电池，带着相反电荷。咬住敌人，就猛然放出大量电力，一碰就灼伤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fangs hold opposing charges like batteries. When snapped onto a foe, they release huge bursts of electric power that singe on contact.

entry: POKENAME每个头都想当家，不断互啃互咬，碰上食物尤其厉害。牙很锋利，争执中常让彼此重伤。
author: evilgammon
source: All of POKENAME's heads fight for dominance, gnawing and biting at each other constantly - especially when food is involved. Their teeth are very sharp and they often seriously injure each other in their arguments.

entry: POKENAME住在人多的海滩附近，用强颚咬开大钳蟹和龙虾小兵的壳。舌头没有痛觉感受器，吃东西时有时连自己的舌头都咬穿。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives near populated beaches, using its strong jaws to crack through the shells of Krabby and Corphish. Its tongue has no pain receptors so it will sometimes bite through its own tongue while eating.

entry: 它住在脏巷，能抓到什么残羹就吃什么。黏滑身体不带毒时，会产生恶臭，让大多数人远远避开。
author: mistymagius
source: It lives in dirty alleyways, feeding on any scraps it can get its hands on. When its slimy body isn't toxic, it produces a foul odor that keeps most people far away from it.

entry: POKENAME藏在脏巷，用强颚嚼吃整箱垃圾。身体散出腐烂奶酪般的恶臭。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides in dirty alleyways, using its strong jaws to chew and eat entire dumpsters full of garbage. Its body produces a putrid smell similar to that of rotting cheese.

entry: POKENAME壳里住一窝小拉达，只要喂得够好，就替它充当炮台、发动攻击。平均每窝同时住10至15只小拉达。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME has a nest of Rattata inside its shell. These Rattata are responsible for acting as POKENAME's cannons, and attacks for them, just as long as they are fed well enough. On average, a POKENAME nest houses 10-15 Rattata at once.

entry: POKENAME出没于老旧废屋，疯狂磨牙，制造阴森声音。向饿嘴里扔食物作供品，通常能安抚，让闹鬼暂歇。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME haunts old abandoned homes, gnashing its teeth furiously to create eerie sounds. Throwing an offering of food into its hungry maw tends to calm it and cease the haunting for a while.

entry: POKENAME住在废弃建筑，谁踏入领地就想赶走。它爱家里尽量乱，啃穿墙壁家具，布置成理想模样。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME takes residence in abandoned buildings and will try to chase anyone that sets foot in its territory. It likes its home to be as messy as possible, chewing through walls and furniture to get its desired look.

entry: POKENAME爱藏在人家墙里，大声咀嚼，惹屋主烦。对方来查看，就突然跳出吓一跳，再逃走。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves to hide within people's walls, making loud chewing noises to annoy the homeowners. When they go to investigate, POKENAME will quickly jump out and scare them before fleeing.

entry: POKENAME夜里常闯民宅，啃穿床架。没人知道为什么，有人推测，它靠人睡不好觉来维生。
author: mistymagius
source: During the night, POKENAME will often break into people's houses and chew through their bedframes. No one knows why it does this, but some theorize it thrives off people getting a bad night's rest.

entry: POKENAME收集树果、草药和其他宝可梦的粪便，投入背上的大锅，调成致命的毒药。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME collects berries, herbs, and droppings from other Pokémon to add to the cauldron on its back. The toxic mix makes a deadly poison.

entry: POKENAME在墓地尖叫、哭泣，声音可怕得只有最胆大者不跑。只要得到一点点关爱，就会依赖那个人或宝可梦。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is found in gravesites, screaming and sobbing in such horrific ways that it frightens away all but those with the strongest nerves. If shown the smallest amount of love and care, it becomes dependent on that person or Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME释放致幻烟雾，引起可怕幻景，再通过身上圆球，吸收恐惧为食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits hallucinogenic smoke that induces terrifying visions. It feeds on the fear through the orbs on its body.

entry: POKENAME全为吓人才冲向对方，真撞上前便停。宝石般的角能吸收其他生命的恐惧和痛苦，转成能量。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME will charge at others purely to instill fright within their targets and will stop just before colliding. Through their gem-like horns, they can absorb the fear and misery of others and convert it into energy.

entry: POKENAME假装好意，送给人难吃的蛋。一看对方被味道吓到，就飞快逃走，免得遭报复。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME fakes a kind gesture by gifting eggs with a foul taste to people. Once it sees their startled reaction to the egg's taste, it runs away extremely quickly before the person can enact their revenge.

entry: POKENAME催眠般的触手，盯久会让人疑神疑鬼、心生恐惧。触手受损就脱落，化回灰烬。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has hypnotic tentacles that evoke feelings of paranoia and fear when stared at for too long. When a tentacle is damaged, it falls off and returns to ash.

entry: POKENAME用花朵般的身体作为天然伪装，既能躲避天敌，也能蒙骗猎物。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME uses its flower-like body as natural camouflage, both to hide itself from predators and to deceive its prey.

entry: POKENAME挥手造出无形墙，不让观众逃离演出。人们当然会不安，它却似乎以这份恐惧为养分。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will wave its hands to conjure invisible walls, preventing its audience from escaping its performance. While people obviously find this upsetting, POKENAME seems to be nourished by their fear.

entry: POKENAME夜里潜入民宅，布下无形迷宫。早晨便开心旁观，以人们试图逃出自家时的痛苦叫声为食。
author: soup1900
source: During the night, POKENAME will sneak into people's houses to set invisible mazes throughout the homes. Once morning arrives, they watch gleefully, feeding on the cries of agony as the people try to escape their own houses.

entry: POKENAME常莫名喃喃着听不懂的胡话，有人据此认为它是灵媒。不管是否真与死者交流，多数训练家仍会被低语吓到。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a reputation for murmuring indecipherable gibberish at random, which some people interpret as evidence that they are spirit mediums. Regardless of whether they actually speak to the dead, most Trainers find the murmuring startling.

entry: 它全力冲向对方，通常又在眼前停住。红球吸收冲锋引起的恐惧，不知怎的转成养分。
author: infinex21
source: It charges at others with all its might, though typically stops just in front of them. It absorbs the fear caused by its charging within its red orbs, which somehow convert that fear into nutrition.

entry: 情绪是它们主要的能量和营养来源，不过每种情绪，似乎各自影响举止。飘逸长毛受许多人追捧，尤其上层人士。
author: infinex21
source: Emotions serve as their main source of energy and nutrition, though each different emotion seems to have a specific influence on their mannerisms. Their long, flowing fur is sought after by many, but especially those of the upper class.

entry: 小群POKENAME比拼一夜能吓到几个熟睡孩子，再大吃恐惧，直到撑得动不了。
author: lampent12
source: Small groups of POKENAME will compete with each other to see who can scare the most sleeping kids in one night. They will glut themselves on the produced fear until they can't move.

entry: POKENAME能用颈间圆珠唤来浓雾，让月亮染红，借不祥的气氛吓退可能的威胁。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME can use the orb around its neck to summon fog and turn the moon red. It uses this foreboding atmosphere to unnerve potential threats.

entry: POKENAME用灵力恶作剧，吃惹出的负面情绪。事后却总懊悔，尽力修复那些只为吃饱而造成的问题。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME causes mischief with its spiritual powers to feed off the negative emotions its pranks create. It always feels bad afterwards, doing its best to fix whatever problems it caused just to feed.

entry: POKENAME疏离，通常住在远离人烟的废屋。背上幽灵火焰猛然增强，吓退入侵者，让对方以为看见鬼火。
author: keiracm35_
source: POKENAME is very aloof and mostly lives in abandoned houses, far from civilization. A spectral fire flares from its back and intensifies to scare off intruders, making them believe they see will-o'-the-wisps.

entry: 它们以恐惧为食，人不觉得可怕就会失望。夜里低飞，悄悄从背后接近，突然发出孩子尖叫般的高声。
author: .jerden
source: They feed on fear, and so are disappointed whenever people do not find them frightening. They fly low at night to quietly approach people from behind, then suddenly produce a high-pitched cry that sounds like a child screaming.

entry: 背部暗羽比腹羽更轻、更硬，因此它能用翅膀发出破坏力强的攻击。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: The dark plumage on its back is lighter and stiffer than the plumage on its belly. Because of this, it can use its wings for devastating attacks.

entry: POKENAME能瞥见一小段未来，预先知道恶作剧的结果。若发现准备捉弄的人反应不妙，它就会换个目标。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gain small glimpses into the future that allow them to see the results of their pranks. If they find that the person they are about to prank has a bad reaction, then they find a different target for their pranks.

entry: POKENAME面无表情，用幽灵力量让怪异不幸降临。有人相信，这些恶行是避免预见中更大灾难的必要手段。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses ghostly powers to cause strange misfortunes to befall others, all while retaining a blank expression. Some believe it is doing these things as a necessary evil to avoid greater disasters it has seen in future visions.

entry: POKENAME以电为食，靠吓人发电，毛随制造的恐惧积攒电荷。两天后能量消散，为求生只能再吓，是最焦虑不安的宝可梦之一。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME feeds on electricity, generating power by frightening others. Its fur builds charge from the fear it creates. The energy fades after two days, forcing it to scare again to survive, making it one of the most anxious Pokémon in existence.

entry: POKENAME以电为食，靠吓人发电，尾巴随制造的恐惧积攒电荷。两天后能量消散，为求生只能再吓，是最焦虑不安的宝可梦之一。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME feeds on electricity, generating power by frightening others. Its tail builds charge from the fear it creates. The energy fades after two days, forcing it to scare again to survive, making it one of the most anxious Pokémon in existence.

entry: POKENAME以电为食，靠吓人发电，毛随制造的恐惧充能。两天后能量消散，为求生只能再吓；它为此产生的恐惧，也能提供少许能量。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME feeds on electricity, generating power by frightening others. Its fur charges from the fear it creates. The energy fades after two days, forcing it to scare again to survive,h the fear this causes it provides a small amount of energy.

entry: POKENAME向尾巴引导神秘灵力，施加诅咒。幽灵属性宝可梦尤其厌恶它的尾巴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME casts hexes by channeling a mysterious ethereal energy into its tail. Ghost-type Pokémon in particular have an aversion to its tail.

entry: POKENAME吃其他生命的恐惧，越吃，尾部越笼上不祥紫雾。通常住在暗林里的池塘旁。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME feeds off the fears of others; the more it eats, the more its tail develops an ominous purple fog. They usually live near ponds in dark forests.

entry: POKENAME严密护着尾端圆球。人们相信，这是因为大部分诅咒力量，都来自球内能量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very protective of the orb at the end of its tail, guarding it closely. It's believed this is because most of its power to hex others comes from energy within the orb.

entry: 它随风漂流，深夜降在人类聚居地附近，用奇特力量惹事，再吸收人们受惊的反应。
author: hophoppip
source: It drifts on the wind, landing near a human settlement in the dark of night. Where it lands, it causes trouble with its strange powers and absorbs the fright of reacting humans.

entry: POKENAME跳到哪，就长出受诅咒、形似雏菊的花。谁摘下，谁就倒霉三天。
author: hophoppip
source: Wherever POKENAME hops, cursed daisy-like flowers sprout. Anyone who plucks such a flower will suffer from three days of bad luck.

entry: POKENAME很调皮，以恐惧为食。它制造小拉达从墙缝窜出的幻象吓人，自己却极少露面。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are quite mischievous, feeding on fear. They create illusions of Rattata scurrying out of walls and crevices to startle people, rarely ever being seen themselves.

entry: 据说POKENAME走到哪里，就将不幸带到哪里。浅色皮毛根根竖起时，便是在与彼岸沟通。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are known to carry misfortune wherever they go. If this Pokémon's light fur stands on end, it is said to be communicating with the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME狡猾，为得所欲不择手段。它常故意只照命令字面办事，折腾训练家，搅黄许多计划。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME tend to be sly creatures that stop at nothing to get what they want. They often torment their Trainers with malicious compliance that derails many of their Trainer's plans.

entry: POKENAME用强牙啃墙，吓唬人。吸收恐惧后，尖牙会更长、更坚固。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME uses its powerful teeth to chew through walls and scare people. Its fangs grow in length and durability when it absorbs fear.

entry: POKENAME露出巨大尖牙吓人，再通过颈部发光圆球，把恐惧吸进去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME frightens people by baring its oversized fangs. It then draws the fear in and absorbs it through the glowing orbs on its neck.

entry: 它们形似名为振翼发的幽灵生物，那生物是否存在，至今仍有争论。它们多出现在难吓的人附近，发出原始尖啸，试图引起集体恐慌。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: They resemble a ghostly creature called Flutter Mane, whose existence is debated to this day. They seem to mostly appear in areas with people that are hard to scare, making primal screeches in an attempt to cause mass panic.

entry: 过去，POKENAME的阴森叫声被当成附近有女巫的迹象。头部为旅人引路穿林，尾上珍珠却想引向歧途。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: In the past, POKENAME's haunting cries were assumed to be signs of a witch lurking nearby. While its main head guides travelers through the forest, the pearl on its tail tries to lead them astray instead.

entry: POKENAME飘过天空，发出金属般的尖叫，散出的恐惧被吸入身上圆球。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lets out metallic screeches as it floats across the sky. The fear it spreads is drawn into its body's orbs.

entry: 满月，POKENAME现身吓唬附近人类，收集恐惧，滋养胸前水晶球。
author: .izik
source: During full moons, POKENAME emerges to frighten nearby humans. The fear it collects feeds the crystal orbs on its chest.

entry: POKENAME藏在玄武岩矿层，宝石与火山岩的暗灰形成鲜明对比，引人靠近。谁上当，它就笑着跳出吓人，乐在其中。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hide themselves within basalt deposits. Their gems stand out against the dark grey of the volcanic deposits, drawing people in close. They delight in surprising those who fall for their ruse, cackling as they leap out to shock the person.

entry: POKENAME能无限期留在空中，翅膀累了，就借飘浮能力维持飞行。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME can keep itself in the air for an indefinite period of time, supplementing its flight with levitation when its wings grow tired.

entry: POKENAME认脸极准，能准确记恨、烦扰得罪过它的家伙。最爱的添堵小招之一，是用喙撬锁，让冷风灌进来。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has a strong sense for facial recognition, allowing it to accurately hold grudges and annoy those who have wronged it. One of its favorite small inconveniences is to pick locks with its beak and let in drafts.

entry: POKENAME贴在闹鬼地方的暗角藏身。有生命靠近，就吐暗墨泼向受害者，让对方长时间打寒颤，满心可怕的恐惧。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME clings to dark corners of haunted locales, hiding away from sight. When others draw near, it spits out a dark ink that splatters across the victim and leaves them with chills and a feeling of ghastly dread for quite some time after.

entry: POKENAME双臂的蛇，只因一连串幻象才看似活着。其实藏着有毒卷须，一碰就麻痹。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: The snakes that make up POKENAME's arms only appear to be alive due to a series of illusions. In reality, they hide tendrils of poison that paralyze on contact.

entry: POKENAME潜进电脑，读取用户资料，了解对方，再挑选最合适的诅咒施在电脑上，造成最大困扰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sneaks into computers and reads the data of a user to find out information about them. Using this, it knows exactly the kind of hexes to afflict a computer with and cause the most duress for them.

entry: POKENAME用角制造幻象，最远可达50米。敌人被吓坏后，再将恐惧吸进圆球。
author: .izik
source: Using its antlers, POKENAME can cast illusions from up to 50 meters away. Once its foe has been terrified, POKENAME absorbs the fear into its orbs.

entry: POKENAME挥臂产生幽灵能量，泛起苍白光晕，再把光转到耳上，显得更大、更有威慑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME generates ghostly energy by swinging its arms around, causing them to emit a pale, glowing aura. It transfers the glow to its ears in order to make itself look larger and more imposing.

entry: 许多古部族在护符上仿制POKENAME颈部的图案，用来诅咒目标遭厄运。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: The pattern on POKENAME's hood was replicated by many ancient tribes in talismans meant to curse a target with misfortune.

entry: 周围有强烈恐惧时，POKENAME的奶会更营养、味道更好。只能安全地喂给幼小幽灵属性宝可梦，而且必须用特制玻璃容器盛放。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's milk improves in nutrition and flavor if it is in the presence of intense fear. The milk can only be safely used to feed baby Ghost-type Pokémon and must be contained in specialized glass.

entry: POKENAME吸收水中腐物和污垢，做成宝石链。链子一断或被偷，就哭上几天。
author: blitzydragon
source: POKENAME absorbs rot and filth from bodies of water, forming it into a chain of gems. It weeps for days if the chain is broken or stolen.

entry: POKENAME梦想长得巨大，靠大规模混乱破坏制造恐惧。目前只能借阴影显得更大、回声放大尖叫，增强吓人本领。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME dreams of growing enormous to cause fear through chaos and destruction on a large scale. For the time being, it uses shadows to appear larger and echoes for its screeches to be amplified to enhance its ability to frighten.

entry: POKENAME呼出浓雾，熄灭周围的光，笼入黑暗。它借这掩护，捕猎、恐吓闯入领地的家伙。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can exhale a thick mist that snuffs out the light of the surrounding area, plunging it into darkness. It uses this shadowy cover to hunt and terrorize those who wander into its territory.

entry: POKENAME在宝石与颊囊中储存魔力。多只聚在一起时，就能在辽阔的区域内制造强大的幻象。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME stores magical power in its gems and cheek pouches. When multiple gather together, they can create powerful illusions over vast areas.

entry: POKENAME飘过夜空，喃喃着听不懂的话。许多人相信，它正在念古老诅咒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats through the night sky, muttering unrecognizable words. Many believe it's reciting an ancient curse.

entry: POKENAME夜袭食品储藏室，能找到多少甜点就吃多少。不合口味，就满厨房扔餐具，将椅子全堆在一起，弄得十分碍事。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME raids pantries in the night, devouring as many sweet treats as it can find. If the food is not up to its liking, it throws the cooking utensils around the kitchen and stacks all of the chairs in an inconvenient pile.

entry: POKENAME天性自大，爱让人和宝可梦围着大肆夸赞。谁侮辱它，就瞪着对方，不断念咒诅咒，直到道歉。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Incredibly pompous by nature, POKENAME enjoy surrounding themselves with people and Pokémon who will shower them with compliments. If someone insults a POKENAME, it will glare at them and mutter incantations and curses until they apologize.

entry: POKENAME藏在老屋墙里窜动、挖掘，持续噪声折磨得许多人神志恍惚。等它被发现，那些人的说法才得到证实。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hide inside the walls of old homes, skittering and tunneling within those walls. They have driven many people delirious from the persistent noise they cause, only to be vindicated once they are revealed.

entry: POKENAME会突然降低某人周围温度，吓一跳，恶作剧取乐。它的确喜欢这么玩，受害者随后的负面念头，也能维持身体所需。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME may prank others by suddenly dropping the ambient temperature around someone to shock them. While it does genuinely enjoy the prank, the victim's negative thoughts afterwards also physically sustains POKENAME too.

entry: POKENAME会突然降低某人周围温度，吓一跳，恶作剧取乐。它的确喜欢这么玩，受害者随后的负面念头，也能维持身体所需。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME may prank others by suddenly dropping the ambient temperature around someone to shock them. While it does genuinely enjoy the prank, the victim's negative thoughts afterwards also physically sustains POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME似乎在寻找某个特定存在，随机冒出网络空间，光是在场就会引发故障。有人相信，一旦找到，就会将对方拖回数字世界深处的家。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears to be searching for a specific being, popping up randomly in cyberspace, its mere presence causing glitches. Some believe once it finds who it searches for, it will drag them to its home deep within the digital realm.

entry: 看不到照料者，POKENAME就紧张尖叫，起初轻如耳语，随后越来越响，直到被抱。它讨厌黑暗，会吐鬼火照亮四周。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME becomes nervous when it cannot see its caretaker and will begin to screech, quiet as a whisper at first but growing in strength until it is cuddled. It spits out will-o-wisps to light up areas because it hates being in the dark.

entry: POKENAME的爪能削去受害者战意。受到威胁，就造出幻象帮助逃走。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: A POKENAME's claws can sap a victim's will to fight. When threatened, POKENAME will create illusions to help them run away.

entry: 据说POKENAME由死后世界最恶毒的亡灵聚合而成。它用广大幽灵力量，大半时间不停闹鬼、恶作剧，尽可能烦扰更多人。
author: sk372
source: It's said POKENAME is formed from a conglomeration of the most malicious spirits of the afterlife. With its vast ghostly powers, it spends most of its time unceasingly haunting and pranking as many people as possible.

entry: 古代POKENAME曾威吓原始森林，以弱小生物的恐惧为食。吸收恐惧就更强，每阵惊惧，都让阴森的角长大。
author: eiskitsune
source: Ancient POKENAME once terrorised primordial forests, feeding on the terror of lesser creatures. It grows stronger by absorbing fear, its ghastly horns growing larger with every pulse of dread.

entry: 成群POKENAME夜里游过田野，只有宝石的诡光照亮。据说行进图案能指引迷失的灵魂，宝石在队中的方位，组成失落语言的符文。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Herds of POKENAME wander through fields at night, illuminated only by the eerie glow of their gems. It is said that the patterns they travel in help to guide lost spirits, the position of their gems along the pack forming runes from lost languages.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME头上红球泛出明亮绯红光。它常待墓园附近，似乎在保护游魂，免受超自然危险。
author: jaminmcready
source: When the moon is full, the red orbs on POKENAME's head glow a bright crimson. POKENAME is often found near cemeteries, appearing to shield wandering souls from paranormal danger.

entry: POKENAME以稳定速度，无声飘过夜空。许多灵媒过去相信，它是亡者之神。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts silently through night skies at a steady pace. Many spiritual mediums once believed it to be a god of the dead.

entry: POKENAME的晶体由负面情绪形成，刺入目标时，吸取更多负面情绪，将其带走。只猎恶徒的个体，以及由针灸诊所饲养的个体，最为健康。
author: deadshields
source: A POKENAME's crystals are formed from negative emotions, gathering more as they are stabbed into a target and draining away their negativity. The healthiest POKENAME are those that exclusively hunt evildoers and those owned by acupuncture clinics.

entry: POKENAME很危险，能看见、控制你未来的行动。惹怒它，就会被诅咒倒霉七年。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are dangerous creatures, which are able to see and control your future actions. Making it mad causes it to place a bad luck curse on you for seven years.

entry: POKENAME用丝带轻蹭其他生命，吸走一点喜悦，转成施咒能量。它乐于制造不幸和困扰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its ribbons to brush against others to drain bits of joy from them. The absorbed emotions serve as energy for it to use to cast hexes on others, as it delights in causing misfortune and distress.

entry: POKENAME的炮击，几乎能贯穿任何防御。民间传说把它描绘为恶魔般的收割者，收走目标灵魂。
author: mepp.
source: The cannon that POKENAME wields fires bolts that can pierce through nearly any defenses. They are described in folklore as devilish reapers who collect the souls of their targets.

entry: POKENAME爱找其他格斗属性宝可梦打架，假装拳头打得很痛。随后轻易穿过所有拳击，惊住对手，再给最后一击。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME has fun picking fights against other Fighting-type Pokémon, acting as if their punches hurt them. Then, they surprise their foes by effortlessly going through all of their punches before delivering the final blow.

entry: 胆小的POKENAME会用幽灵之力吓退入侵者。可对方若不怕幻象，它反倒马上害怕起来。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: The timid POKENAME uses its spectral powers to scare off intruders, though it quickly becomes terrified of those who resist its illusions.

entry: POKENAME用浓密头发抓住、缠紧受害者，慢慢吸走生命力。受到威胁，就发出震耳哀号，让攻击者陷入难以抵挡的恐惧。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its thick hair to grab and ensnare its victims while it slowly drains away their life force. If it is threatened, it will let out a deafening wail which inflicts its attacker with an overwhelming sense of fear.

entry: POKENAME只唱一个幽幽音符，就能召来鬼火。白天睡在废建筑，夜里出来，吸取被亮焰引来者的生命力。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME summons ghostly fire by singing a single, haunting note. In the daytime it sleeps within abandoned structures, coming out at night to siphon the life force of those attracted to these bright flames.

entry: POKENAME胆小易受惊，用幻象藏身，不让人看见。据说抱一抱，就能得到六年好运。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: Skittish and easily frightened, POKENAME use illusions to hide themselves from people. It's said that hugging one will bring you six years of good fortune.

entry: POKENAME哀号像啜泣，常吓到人。有人靠近安慰，就不再哭，也许转为轻轻唱歌。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's wailing often frightens people, as it sounds like sobbing. It will stop crying if a human approaches POKENAME to comfort it, and may begin to sing softly instead.

entry: POKENAME优雅又顽皮，只向自己认可的人现身。据说惹它不快，就会招来千年诅咒。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: Elegant and impish, POKENAME only reveal themselves to those they believe are worthy. Making one displeased is said to bring a thousand-year curse.

entry: POKENAME调皮，却没力气恶作剧。哪怕只召一丝阴风，事后也得睡七小时。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses a mischievous personality, but lacks the energy to pull off pranks. Even just conjuring a slight ghostly breeze requires a seven-hour nap afterward.

entry: POKENAME深夜来到卧室窗外，低吼、高嚎，热情唱出不和谐旋律。每逢午夜小夜曲导致心脏病发作，它似乎又会后悔。
author: regulavish
source: With rumbling snarls and raucous howls, POKENAME will appear outside people's bedroom windows in the dead of night to enthusiastically bellow discordant melodies. It seems remorseful whenever its midnight serenade causes a heart attack.

entry: POKENAME小小的，却极爱捣蛋，最喜欢随机放电，逼其他生命跳着躲电。人们散出的恐惧、惊讶，让它十分开心。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a highly mischievous little creature. Its favorite pastime is to startle others by discharging lightning at random and making them jump to avoid getting shocked; it delights in the fear and surprise people emanate.

entry: 能与亡者交流的传闻，让POKENAME很受信奉通灵的人欢迎。神婆把它当占卜指示器握住，带着在通灵板上移动。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is popular among spiritual people because of rumors that it can communicate with the dead. Mediums hold onto it like a planchette and guide it across spirit boards.

entry: POKENAME出没于与死者相关的地方，希望帮家属走出悲痛。它拖动指示器划过通灵板，传递据称来自亡者的消息。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is found in places associated with the dead, hoping to help families move on from grief. It drags its planchette across its spirit board to deliver supposed messages from the dead.

entry: POKENAME以幽怨的叫声和阴森火焰惊吓踏入领地的人。得逞后，火焰便烧得更亮。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME uses its haunting cries and ghastly flame to scare those who wander through its territory. Its flame brightens when it succeeds.

entry: POKENAME装得友善可爱，请人闻玫瑰。谁上当，就被喷一大团花粉，遭到整整一周厄运的诅咒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses a false air of kindness and cuteness, offering them to smell from its roses. Those that fall for the ruse get blasted with a large cloud of pollen that inflicts a week-long curse of bad luck.

entry: POKENAME从树后冒出吓人，再吸收恐惧为养分。它靠其他生命的情绪茁壮成长，用恐惧维生。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME pops out from behind trees to startle people, then absorbs their fear for nourishment. It thrives on the emotions of others, using the fear to sustain itself.

entry: POKENAME吃墓碑上凋谢中的花。这诡异习惯常见于偏僻坟墓附近，它默默享用将枯的花朵。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME eats flowers as they wither on gravestones. This eerie habit is often witnessed near secluded graves, where it silently feasts on the dying blooms.

entry: POKENAME在林中撒棉团，庇护迷失灵魂。灵魂一住进去，便燃起幽灵火焰，烧去棉絮，让灵魂得以前往来世。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME scatter bundles of cotton through forests to shelter lost spirits. Once a spirit has settled within a bundle, it will ignite with a spectral flame, burning away the cotton to let the spirit pass on.

entry: POKENAME装无辜，引来天真好奇的旅人，让对方凝视圆球。球里浮现恐怖景象，吓住受害者，好让它吸食恐惧。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME draws naive and curious travelers close with displays of false innocence in order to get them to gaze into its orb. A vision of terror appears within, spooking the victim so POKENAME can feed on their fear.

entry: POKENAME住墓园，在墓碑间躲藏。雷雨之夜坐上陵墓，吸收雷击能量，增强自身。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lives in cemeteries, seeking shelter among the tombstones. During nights with thunderstorms, it sits on mausoleums to absorb lightning strikes, using the energy to strengthen itself.

entry: POKENAME收集宝石，加进项链。收藏太大，走路可能被自己的项链绊倒。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME collect precious stones to add to their necklace. If their collection grows large enough, they might trip over their necklaces while trying to walk.

entry: POKENAME尖牙能吸收恐惧产生的化学物质，因此先尾随、尖叫吓猎物，最后才咬。太阳出来，就躲洞穴或废建筑。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's fangs absorb chemicals produced by fear, so it scares its prey by stalking them and screaming before finally biting. It hides in caves and abandoned buildings when the sun is out.

entry: POKENAME残酷又爱捣蛋，偷走训练家的珍贵饰物，再四处丢撒，逼对方穿过恶劣环境寻找。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are cruel creatures that love to cause mischief. They steal valuable trinkets from Trainers and scatter them to force Trainers to wander through unpleasant conditions.

entry: POKENAME在原始森林里加速绕过障碍，尖声叫着。多只聚集会赛跑，尖啸混成噪声，仿佛幽灵合唱。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME emits a screeching cry as it accelerates around obstacles in its old-growth forest habitat. When multiple congregate, they will race each other, joining their shrieks in a cacophony sounding like a choir of ghosts.

entry: POKENAME是栖息在古老森林深处的幽灵宝可梦，喜欢残忍的玩笑。它们模仿人声，诱导训练家走错方向，让人迷失深林，几乎无望归家。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A Ghost-type Pokémon found deep in ancient forests, POKENAME has a cruel sense of humor. They delight in misleading Trainers with the sounds of other people, leaving them lost and confused with little hope of getting home.

entry: POKENAME夜间活动，常大声尖叫，吓跑其他宝可梦。它用咒语让人家花园长杂草，爱捉弄人，因此被归为害兽。
author: distinguishedmanlygentleman
source: POKENAME is a nocturnal Pokémon, and is often heard letting out loud shrieks which are used to scare off other Pokémon. POKENAME is classified as a pest, as it is a trickster which uses its incantations to cause weeds to sprout in people's gardens.

entry: POKENAME夜里成群出现吓水手，还常揪下对方头发。碰到不容易被吓住的家伙，自己却会胆怯。
author: h0bojoe
source: It appears in swarms at night to frighten sailors, often pulling out their hair. POKENAME becomes timid when confronted by those who are not easily frightened.

entry: POKENAME在守护的森林里模仿枯树，尾随入侵者。通常只用阴森尖叫吓旅人，吃恐惧；若有人伤害森林，就诅咒对方永远迷失。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME mimics a dead tree as it stalks intruders in the forest it protects. It usually only scares travelers with creepy shrieks, feeding on their fear, but if anyone harms the forest, POKENAME will curse them so they are lost forever.

entry: POKENAME在守护的森林里模仿枯树，尾随入侵者。通常只用阴森尖叫吓旅人，吃恐惧；若有人伤害森林，就诅咒对方永远迷失。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME mimics a dead tree as it stalks intruders in the forest it protects. It usually only scares travelers with creepy shrieks, feeding on their fear, but if anyone harms the forest, POKENAME will curse them so they are lost forever.

entry: POKENAME发出令人毛骨悚然的尖叫，把人吓坏，再将恐惧吸进圆球，摄取其中能量为养分。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes a blood-curdling scream to scare people. It absorbs their fear into its orbs for nourishment, feeding off the energy that fear provides.

entry: 乌云低垂却迟迟不下雨的日子，高空会传来POKENAME的啜泣。据说，它携带的宝石里，藏着早逝者被遗忘的梦。
author: ozydamians
source: On days when dark clouds hang heavy in the sky but no rain falls, the sobbing cry of POKENAME can be heard high above. The jewels it carries are said to contain the forgotten dreams of those who passed too young.

entry: POKENAME生气，黏滑身体就产生泡泡，脱落后飘在四周。泡里满是幽灵能量，若在人旁破掉，就会给对方厄运诅咒。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME is angered, its slimy body creates bubbles that detach and float around it. These bubbles are filled with ghostly energy and will curse a person with bad luck if they pop within the person's vicinity.

entry: POKENAME柔软身体覆着滑溜黏膜，最好别碰。许多人相信，黏液里藏着一碰就永不离身的诅咒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's soft body is coated with a slick and slimy mucus membrane. Touching it is advised against, as many believe the slime contains a curse that will never leave a person once touched.

entry: POKENAME爱附身毛绒玩具，享受吓小孩的快乐。待在娃娃里，力量会强得与体型不相称。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves to possess stuffed toys, as it gets joy out of scaring young children. While POKENAME is inside the doll, it is abnormally strong for its size.

entry: POKENAME背上的毒蘑菇毒性极强，人误食可能致命。因为它住墓园，许多人把这些蘑菇叫作“入土之邀”。
author: .izik
source: The toadstools growing from POKENAME's back are extremely toxic, capable of killing a human if ingested. Due to POKENAME's cemetery habitat, many have taken to calling these growths the 'Burial's Beckoning'.

entry: 它能随意移动身体的沙，造出新结构。小宝可梦一进门，就变成可怕房间，吓对方取乐。
author: hophoppip
source: It can move the sands of its body at will to form new structures. When a small Pokémon walks through its door, it takes delight in scaring the Pokémon by transforming into a terrifying room.

entry: POKENAME住在泥泞荒原和森林，唱着阴森回荡的歌谣；一被打扰，就爆发令人麻痹的尖啸。过去，人们误以为是刚去世者的灵魂在唱，还会留礼物给幽灵。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME lives in boggy moors and forests where it sings eerie, echoing ballads, but erupts with paralyzing screeches if interrupted. Historically, its singing was mistaken for a recently deceased spirit and people left gifts out for the ghost.

entry: POKENAME大眼睛让人不安。周围的人一紧张，头上的宝石珠就会发光。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's large eyes give it an unsettling quality. The gemstone beads on its head glow when people feel nervous around it.

entry: POKENAME夜里潜行，用力量哄人入睡，看似温柔安稳。梦起初平和，却会变成可怕噩梦，让它吃梦中压力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stalks the night and uses its powers to lull people into a seemingly gentle slumber. Though the dreams start out peacefully, they turn into terrible nightmares so that POKENAME can feed off the stress the bad dreams cause.

entry: POKENAME勤于擦亮随身大宝石，始终保持完好洁净。据说盯进去会看到最大的恐惧，让它很开心。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME diligently polishes the large gem they possess, ensuring that it is in pristine condition at all times. Those who stare into this gem are said to see their greatest fears, much to POKENAME's amusement.

entry: 这团毛球没有超自然力量就动不了。触角上的球茎彼此共鸣，放大力量。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: This ball of fur is incapable of moving without the aid of its otherworldly powers. The bulbs on its antennae resonate with each other to amplify this power.

entry: POKENAME很挑剔，饲养者若不立刻满足，就被任性尖叫、嚎声淹没。睡觉时，大半身体透明，只有喉边的珠子仍看得见。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is very particular, so owners who do not meet its desires immediately will be inundated with sassy shrieks and howls. When sleeping, it becomes mostly transparent except for the beads around its throat.

entry: POKENAME转动顶端带宝石的手杖，造出可怕幻象，吓人和宝可梦。等受害者恐惧，再一转杖，将恐惧吸入。
author: hophoppip
source: With a swirl of its gem-tipped staff, POKENAME conjures frightening illusions to scare people and Pokémon. Once the victims are terrified, it swirls the staff again to absorb their fear.

entry: POKENAME调皮，爱分散训练家注意，让人迷路。它只想制造刺激，却常被当成恶意，训练家因此改道躲开。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is a mischievous Pokémon that enjoys distracting Trainers and causing them to get lost. Its desire to create excitement is often mistaken for malevolence, so Trainers take different routes to avoid it.

entry: POKENAME鲜艳鳞片反光，引来潜在猎物。碰到哪怕一根毛或一片鳞，也可能严重麻痹，动弹不得。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME's brightly colored scales reflect light to lure in potential prey. A single hair or scale from this Pokémon can cause debilitating paralysis on contact.

entry: POKENAME在南瓜地制造怪声，不让人靠近。不安的身影、阴森声音构成闹鬼气氛，赶走入侵者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes creepy noises in pumpkin patches to keep people away. Its unsettling presence and eerie sounds create a haunting atmosphere, driving off any intruders.

entry: POKENAME退化的腿可用于攻击，却只靠飘浮移动。兴奋时，火焰会随移动拖在身后。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME's vestigial legs can be used for attacks, but it only moves by levitating. When excited, flames trail behind it as it moves.

entry: POKENAME爱在神社与墓园附近游荡。据说若有POKENAME偷走供品，便是不祥之兆。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME love to hang around shrines and graveyards. It's believed that a POKENAME stealing an offering left there is a bad omen.

entry: POKENAME不断飘动、翻涌，仿佛被幽灵之风推动。许多人相信，被它偷走的东西，永远带着诅咒。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME are constantly flowing and billowing as if propelled forward by spectral winds. Many people believe that items stolen by POKENAME are forever cursed.

entry: POKENAME自信专注，严守自己的道德准则。它会让心怀邪恶的家伙头痛。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: Very assertive and focused, POKENAME follow a strong moral code. They are known to cause headaches for those with evil within their hearts.

entry: POKENAME轻盈、敏捷、顽皮，整天破坏东西。能跳穿墙壁，因此很难阻止。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: Light, agile, and impish, POKENAME spends its time vandalizing things. Its ability to leap through walls makes it difficult to stop.

entry: 据说POKENAME将身心训练到极限，获得难以想象的力量和专注。各种山顶，常能看见成群的它们在冥想。
author: naivetotoro
source: It is said that POKENAME trains both body and mind to their absolute limits, achieving strength and focus beyond imagination. Groups of these Pokémon can often be found meditating atop mountains of all kinds.

entry: POKENAME用恐怖尖叫吓得猎物僵住，再吃掉。火焰靠抽取受害者的能量燃烧。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME uses its terrifying screech to freeze its prey in fear before consuming them. Its flames burn from the drained energy of its victims.

entry: POKENAME夜里爬到营地，尖叫哀号，有人查看就装成岩石。露营者越怕，它吃得越足，全身泛起明亮粉红能量。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME crawls up to campsites in the night making spooky screams and wails, but pretends to be a rock if anyone investigates. As the campers become more fearful, it glows bright with pink energy as it feeds on their fear.

entry: POKENAME选定受害者，就在黑暗中不停追。跟随数月，到哪都尾随，守在阴暗角落，等最佳时机跳出来。
author: periperi_chicken
source: When POKENAME chooses its victim, it will chase them through the dark without stopping. It follows for months, stalking them everywhere and watching in shadowed corners, waiting for the perfect opportunity to jump out.

entry: POKENAME两侧磁铁藏着强大幽灵能量。三个圆球若绕其中一块转，就表示准备从那里放出格外强的诅咒。
author: sk372
source: The magnets on either side of POKENAME contain powerful ghostly energies. If the three orbs circle around one of them, it is preparing to cast a particularly powerful hex from that magnet.

entry: POKENAME夜里现身，游在船旁，盼将水手引进水里。咒语造成幻觉、头痛，只有远离施咒的那只，才能解除。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME appear at night and swim next to ships, hoping to lure sailors into the water. They cast spells that cause hallucinations and headaches, which can only be purged by traveling far from the POKENAME that cast them.

entry: POKENAME穿过人体，让人见幻景、闻恶臭、打寒颤，再对这份难受咯咯笑。身体极轻，强风时便用头发缠住屋檐或树枝。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME floats through people to cause them to see visions, smell horrible scents, and feel strong chills, giggling at their discomfort. It is incredibly light, so it clings to eaves or tree branches with its hair during strong winds.

entry: POKENAME躲角落哭，假装迷路孩子，等有人帮忙，就冲脸尖叫。它也爱用滑稽举动分散注意，再把手绕后，拍人的背，觉得好笑极了。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME cries in corners, pretending to be a lost child, until someone helps it and POKENAME can screech in their face. It also finds it hilarious to distract people with antics while moving a hand behind to tap them on the back.

entry: POKENAME在鬼屋工作，爱从游客影子里跳出吓人，也会做鬼脸，哄被吓坏的孩子开心。太久被无视，就难过尖叫。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is employed in haunted houses as it enjoys terrifying patrons by leaping from their shadows and pulling faces to cheer up children who got too scared. It becomes upset and begins screaming if ignored for long.

entry: 据说POKENAME每节身体都藏着大量黑暗魔法。远古，痴迷神秘学的人曾偷猎圆球，却少有成功，反招来灾难般的报复。
author: sk372
source: Every segment of POKENAME's body is said to hold a large amount of dark magic within. Those obsessed with the occult attempted to poach the orbs in the distant past, but rarely succeeded and instead incited disastrous retaliation.

entry: POKENAME和谐的呻吟，让听众睡得不安稳，满梦噩梦，再吃恐惧。想避开的人，会在枕头周围撒胡椒粉，因为它鼻子敏感。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's harmonic moaning lulls those who hear it into a fitful sleep. It then feeds on their fear as their dreams are filled with nightmares. Those wishing to avoid it sprinkle pepper around their pillows as POKENAME's nose is sensitive.

entry: POKENAME背上长出奇怪符文。研究含义时发现，它像某种未知图腾形态，科学家却还不清楚两者联系。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: An odd rune grows from the back of an POKENAME. Attempts to determine the meaning has led to the discovery that it resembles a form of Unown, but for now, scientists are unsure of the connection.

entry: 受威胁时，它不放臭气，而会让神秘文字的闪烁影像直接浮现在对手脑海。它似乎不进食。
author: bombboyxd
source: Rather than releasing foul odors when threatened, it sends flashing images of mysterious characters into its opponent's head. It doesn't seem to eat.

entry: POKENAME自认为是古代遗迹的守护者。可惜它们总爱对入侵者自爆，往往反而造成更严重的破坏。
author: griddle
source: POKENAME consider themselves protectors of ancient ruins. Tragically, their tendency to explode on intruders means they often cause greater harm.

entry: 眼睛才是本体。受威胁时会从保护壳中弹射出去，若逃不掉，就会爆炸。
author: griddle
source: The eye is its true body. When threatened, it will eject itself from its protective shell. If it can't get away, it explodes.

entry: 一种守护意识古怪的古老生物。察觉有人进入栖身之处，便会用眼睛锁定对方并发动攻击。
author: theheroict
source: An ancient being that has a strange sense of protection. When it senses someone in its home, it locks onto them with its eyes and attacks.

entry: 未知图腾愿让卡拉卡拉拿自己作武器，身体意外地很适合作棒。夜里，它让卡拉卡拉在土里画神秘符号，含义尚不明确。
author: sk372
source: Unown allows itself to be wielded as a weapon by a Cubone, its body making a surprisingly efficient club. At night, the Unown has Cubone draw mysterious symbols in the dirt, the meaning of which is not yet known.

entry: 所有记录中，直视POKENAME眼睛，都会感到极不舒服。它却似乎乐在其中，见谁就盯谁的眼。
author: hiimhdere
source: In all recorded cases, looking directly into the eye of POKENAME causes a profound sense of discomfort. It seems to relish in this, however, staring into the eyes of anybody it can see.

entry: 视力不好，让人类和宝可梦都误以为POKENAME很弱。可POKENAME的眼球蕴含庞大的超能力，连汽车都能轻易压碎，想捕捉它的人，往往下场凄惨。
author: sottiwotti
source: People and Pokémon think POKENAME is weak because of its poor eyesight, but POKENAME's eyeball contains a lot of psychic energy. It can easily crush a car with its powers, and people who try to catch it often meet a terrible fate.

entry: POKENAME吐出的烟雾里能看到数千只眼睛。没人知道它们属于谁，也没人知道它们在寻找什么。
author: griddle
source: Thousands of eyes can be seen in the smoke emitted by POKENAME. No one knows who the eyes belong to, or what they're looking for.

entry: POKENAME放出的云有独立的眼睛，各自张望、眨动。人们相信，云完全消散前，它也能通过这些额外眼睛观察。
author: sk372
source: The clouds POKENAME emits have their own eyes that look around and blink on their own. It's believed that until they dissipate completely, POKENAME can see through these additional eyes as well.

entry: POKENAME用巨眼吸收阳光，像光合作用般转为养分，帮助进化。其余眼睛则望着树梢，提防危险。
author: santon5512
source: In a process similar to photosynthesis, POKENAME will take in sunlight through its massive eye, converting it into nutrients to aid in its evolution. Its other eyes watch the treetops for potential danger.

entry: 吸入POKENAME气体的人会看见惊人幻象。受害者总会描述一片广阔的灰色天空，其中布满多如繁星的眼睛。
author: griddle
source: Those who inhale POKENAME's gas witness startling visions. Victims of it always describe a vast grey sky, filled with as many eyes as there are stars.

entry: POKENAME身体构造虽古怪，冲锋力却出奇强。它常守卫古代遗迹，赶走遇到的入侵者。
author: santon5512
source: Despite their strange body structures, POKENAME can charge with a surprising amount of force. These Pokémon are often found guarding ancient ruins, chasing away any intruders they encounter.

entry: POKENAME的头是只巨大、不眨的眼，瞳孔能移到任何部位。孩子哪怕走出一般视野，它也始终看得见孩子在哪。
author: sk372
source: The pupil can shift around to any part of the giant unblinking eye that is its head. Even should the child wander off beyond normal sight, POKENAME will always see where its child is.

entry: 翅上落下蜂蜜般甜的粉，形似多种古文字。占卜者把粉撒进早餐谷物，读取颗粒拼出的词，预测未来。
author: ozydamians
source: Honey-sweet powder shaped like symbols in myriad ancient languages falls from its wings. Soothsayers divine the future from the words spelled in the specks they sprinkle across their morning cereal.

entry: POKENAME能与训练家心灵交流，提供各种树果、草药的有用知识。常见它待在巨翅飞鱼旁，但关系尚不清楚。
author: sondededoo
source: POKENAME can telepathically communicate with their trainers, offering useful knowledge about various berries and herbs. They can often be seen hanging around Mantine, though their relationship is unclear.

entry: POKENAME的四肢柔韧得像橡胶软管。它会用这些肢体逗乐大人和孩子。
author: griddle
source: POKENAME's limbs have all the flexibility of a rubber hose. It uses these limbs to entertain children and adults alike.

entry: POKENAME神秘，通常守着遗迹和古庙，用坚角驱赶入侵者。尾上的眼始终警觉，能发现任何想从背后袭来的家伙。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a mysterious creature that typically guards ruins and ancient temples, driving away intruders with its sturdy horns. The eyes on its tails are perpetually watchful, allowing it to spot anyone attempting to strike it from behind.

entry: 独角虫的鼻子变成了一只眼睛，能异常敏锐地追踪威胁。它们常聚在一起，排出神秘的信息。
author: bombboyxd
source: Weedle's nose has been replaced with an eye that seems to track threats exceptionally well. Its often found in groups making mysterious messages.

entry: POKENAME沿复杂轨迹飞过天空，人们认为这些图案是失落已久语言的符号。传说它暴怒时毁灭城市，人们以为这是阿尔宙斯的神罚。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME fly through the skies in intricate patterns, it is believed that these patterns are the symbols of a long forgotten language. In tales POKENAME destroyed cities in fits of rage, it was believed that this was divine punishment from Arceus.

entry: POKENAME住进电脑，不盯用户时，就盯着光标动作。它有时打开文本文档，试图交流，留下的信息却总不知所云。
author: sk372
source: When inside a computer, POKENAME's eye will follow the movements of the cursor, when not staring at the user directly. It sometimes opens text documents and attempts to communicate, but the messages always appear to be gibberish.

entry: 一些博物馆已防范POKENAME捣乱，因为多数个体只要有机会，就会毁掉、吃掉化石。
author: bagumbothimble
source: Several museums have taken measures against the antics of POKENAME, since most POKENAME would destroy and consume fossils if given the opportunity.

entry: 无法移动的POKENAME常待在高高的树上，紧盯一切可能的危险，等待终将来临的进化。
author: bombboyxd
source: Immobile POKENAME will often sit high in trees, staring at any potential danger as it waits for its inevitable evolution.

entry: 它绝对无声地漂流，眼睛从不眨，也从不对齐。记录动作时，影像常损坏，或无尽循环观察者坚称根本没发生的片段。
author: jaminmcready
source: It drifts in absolute silence, its eyes never blinking and never aligned. Attempts to document its movements often result in corrupted footage or endless loops of moments observers swear never happened.

entry: POKENAME的眼柄不停扭动挥舞，永无止境地寻找值得捕捉的猎物，只有猎食成功后才会安静下来。
author: griddle
source: POKENAME's eyestalks constantly writhe and thrash in its endless search for worthy prey; they're only at rest after a successful hunt.

entry: POKENAME虽只有一只眼，视力却极佳。发现远下方地面的猎物，就俯冲，用尖尾攻击。
author: .jerden
source: Although it only has a single eye, POKENAME's vision is excellent. If it spots prey on the ground far below, it will dive down to attack with its pointed tail.

entry: POKENAME夜里一动不动地望天空，偶尔未知图腾会聚在上方，组成神秘图案。表达什么、对它有何含义，仍是谜。
author: lampent12
source: At night, POKENAME will stare into the sky, not moving a muscle, and on occasion, Unown will gather in the air above them, making mysterious patterns. What they say and what it means to POKENAME is still a mystery.

entry: POKENAME是船主的麻烦。一在船上安顿，就会愤怒攻击所有想赶走它的家伙。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are considered nuisances for boat owners. Once they've settled aboard a boat, they will angrily fight any and all who try to remove them.

entry: POKENAME是船主的麻烦。一在船上安顿，就会愤怒攻击所有想赶走它的家伙。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are considered nuisances for boat owners. Once they've settled aboard a boat, they will angrily fight any and all who try to remove them.

entry: POKENAME高栖山巅，俯视、巡视领地。与它对上眼的旅人，说会感到与四周低温全然不同的异常寒意。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rests high up on mountain peaks, gazing down and surveying its territory. Travelers that catch its gaze report feeling an unnatural chill completely separate from their cold surroundings.

entry: 它的领地意识不如大针蜂强，却常会守护废弃神庙，驱赶入侵者。为什么这么做，至今无人知晓。
author: bombboyxd
source: While less territorial than Beedrill, it will often spend its time defending ruined temples from intruders. It's not known why it does this.

entry: 未知图腾聚在POKENAME周围，协调攻击，保护它。有理论认为，它们以心灵感应交流。
author: santon5512
source: Unown gather around POKENAME, defending them with well-coordinated attacks. Theories suggest that POKENAME communicate with them using telepathy.

entry: 集中精神力量，眼状花纹便微微发光，但那只是图案，并非眼睛。虽然没有可见的眼，它仍能用精神能力感知四周一切。
author: infinex21
source: Its eyelike patterns glow faintly as it focuses its psychic powers; these are merely patterns, not eyes. Despite having no visible eyes, this Pokémon can use its psychic powers to perceive everything around it.

entry: POKENAME全身似乎满是符号，像世上最早宝可梦的基因。考古学家也发现，符号还像人类历史最早的文字。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME's body seems to be covered with countless symbols resembling the genes of the very first Pokémon in existence. Archaeologists also note that these symbols resemble the first written words in human history.

entry: POKENAME会出现在古迹探险者面前。亵渎遗迹者，迅速被瞬间传走、清除记忆。有些人却记得，遇见后曾被带到梦一般的世界，那里还有其他POKENAME。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are known to appear in front of people exploring ancient ruins. Those who desecrate these ruins are swiftly teleported away with their memories wiped. Some recall being taken to a dream-like world with other POKENAME after encountering one.

entry: POKENAME用治愈波动和魔法反射，能复活死去植物，甚至改变生理构造，使其更像古代亲缘植物。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: With the use of the moves Heal Pulse and Magic Coat, POKENAME can revive dead plants, even changing their physiology to be similar to their ancient relatives.

entry: 古刻画中，POKENAME被描绘为复活死去植物。古人会在金字塔养强大个体，确保送来的花不枯萎。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: In old carvings and paintings, POKENAME were depicted reviving dead plants. Ancient people kept strong POKENAME in pyramids to make sure gifted flowers didn't wilt.

entry: POKENAME特别好奇时，背上长出怪触须，轻轻起伏。盯得太久，会短暂混乱。
author: sk372
source: Strange tendrils sprout up from POKENAME's back whenever it is feeling great curiosity. The tendrils undulate slightly and will cause momentary confusion in those who stare too long at them.

entry: 它像融合前的宝可梦一样温顺。受到威胁时，就会让对手看见奇怪的幻象，或扬起沙子，趁机退走。
author: bombboyxd
source: It is docile like its unfused counterparts. If threatened, it will send strange visions or throw sand at its opponent before retreating.

entry: POKENAME身体弯成古文字般的怪形。据说一组成完整词，附近宝可梦便躁动，仿佛听见远方声音。
author: trenbologne
source: POKENAME's body bends into strange shapes that resemble ancient writing. It's said that when it forms a complete word, nearby Pokémon grow restless as if hearing distant voices.

entry: POKENAME能精准辨时，分秒不差。头羽随着身边漂浮的刻度旋转，推算种种事件，随后又回到当下的时间。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME have an uncanny ability to tell the time down to the second. The feathers on their head spin around along the ticks that float around them to calculate various events before returning to the present time.

entry: POKENAME主眼连最细微的机械故障也能发现。零一号全地形车早期试飞时，许多个体被用于监测。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's main eye can detect even the slightest mechanical malfunctions. Many were used to monitor test flights for the ZERO-ONE during its early stages.

entry: POKENAME住在茂密丛林遗迹里的洞穴。对光极敏感，因此不惜一切避开阳光。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME can be found in caverns within lush jungle ruins. Due to their high photosensitivity, these Pokémon will avoid sunlight at all costs.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，用多只手护住胸口。被迫战斗，才露出躯干，显出里面藏着奇异力量的眼睛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flies with its multiple hands protectively covering its chest. When it is forced into combat it uncovers its torso to reveal the eye within, which contains strange powers.

entry: POKENAME腹部背面的大眼，并非许多人曾以为的花纹。这个发现，让一些研究者怀疑，这部分其实是头，而不是腹部。
author: infinex21
source: The large, open eye upon the back of an POKENAME's abdomen is not a mere marking as many once believed. This discovery has led some researchers to wonder if this part of its body is the actual head, rather than the abdomen.

entry: 没人知道这种融合体如何进食。科学家只见过它残忍地伏击猎物，再将其拖往视线之外。巢穴周围，还常留着奇怪的符号。
author: bombboyxd
source: It's unknown how this fusion eats, but scientists have noted its cruelty when it ambushes its prey before taking them out of sight. It often leaves strange symbols around its nest.

entry: 触角末端的眼是假眼，一眨不眨地瞪着，吓唬其他生命。真正的眼也从没被见过眨动，强光闪过仍然如此。
author: infinex21
source: The eyes at the ends of their antennae are decoys to intimidate others by staring at them without blinking. Their actual eye has yet to be witnessed blinking, even when exposed to a bright flash of light.

entry: POKENAME能有意干扰某些鱼宝可梦的电通讯信号，让目标无力防备。因此与捕食者互利共生：它获得保护，对方轻松饱餐。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can consciously interfere with the electrocommunicative signals that some fish Pokémon use. As this makes its targets vulnerable, it forms mutualistic bonds with predators: POKENAME gets protection, while the predator gets an easy meal.

entry: POKENAME英名透着“不强壮”的意思，身体也确实很弱，甚至不如组成它的两种宝可梦。连小小棉花糖，有时也举得费劲。
author: hophoppip
source: Fittingly for a fusion named POKENAME, it is quite physically weak, even compared to its components. It sometimes struggles to lift objects as small and light as a marshmallow.

entry: POKENAME总盯太阳，似乎只有来者挡住视线，才会察觉。夜里太阳看不见，就哭。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME always stares at the sun and only seems to notice others if they block its view. At night, it cries when the sun is gone from sight.

entry: 它盯太阳直到落山，夜里转看地面，仿佛正透过星球感知太阳。
author: busilisk
source: It stares at the sun until it sets. At night, it looks at the ground, as if detecting the sun through the planet.

entry: 祭司们注意到，它的外貌仿佛带着神性。它不进食，却常以2马赫的速度逼近其他宝可梦，再骤然停下，直勾勾地盯着对方。
author: bombboyxd
source: Priests have noted its divine-looking form. While it doesn't eat, it often approaches Pokémon at Mach 2 before stopping to stare at them.

entry: POKENAME休息时，尾上的眼仍警觉。有生命靠近，就发射觉醒力量，黑羊毛也随储电噼啪作响。
author: .izik
source: When resting, the eye on POKENAME's tail remains alert. If approached, it fires a Hidden Power, while its black wool crackles with stored electricity.

entry: 长期以来，人们以为它能读人类文字。正式研究却显示，很可能不识字，只想吃书，又因没嘴而不知所措。
author: hophoppip
source: It was believed for a long time to possess the ability to read human writing. However, formal studies have shown that it likely cannot read and is instead trying to eat the books, confused by its lack of a mouth.

entry: POKENAME似乎从不睡觉，总用眼睛搜寻附近的材料，既拿来筑巢，也留下奇怪的标记。
author: bombboyxd
source: It doesn't seem to sleep. Instead, POKENAME uses its eyes to find sufficient materials to make both strange markings and its nests in its vicinity.

entry: POKENAME飞得极快，一边扫视高草找食物，一边在空中划出各种字母。有理论认为，它在拼词，可行为难料，不易研究。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME fly at incredibly fast speeds, darting through the air in the shape of various letters as it scans the tall grass for food. It's theorized that these movements spell out words, though its unpredictable nature makes them hard to study.

entry: 年幼的POKENAME会把未知王那些眼睛般的蛋，顶在头部的柄状突起上。科学家推测，这种行为能提高它的存活机会。
author: filteredtea
source: A young POKENAME carries the eye-like eggs of Unsire on its head stalks. Scientists theorize this behavior increases its odds of survival.

entry: POKENAME主要由略带毒的黏胶构成，几乎能变成任何形状。器官也随新形适应，研究者正探索，能否借此提升人体器官移植成功率。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are mostly made of slightly toxic goo, allowing them to morph into almost any shape. Their organs adapt to their new shape, and researchers are looking into how this may increase the success of human organ transplants.

entry: POKENAME主要由略带毒的黏胶构成，几乎能变成任何形状。有时成群个体会变成词语，甚至短句。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are mostly made of slightly toxic goo, allowing them to morph into almost any shape. Groups of POKENAME sometimes morph into words or even short sentences.

entry: 有人见过POKENAME用超能力改造湖泊池塘来筑巢。为了保护幼崽，它们会表现得极为凶狠。
author: filteredtea
source: POKENAME have been seen terraforming lakes and ponds with their psychic powers to make their nests. They defend their young with fierce hostility.

entry: 初次发现POKENAME时，人们以为它是月亮伊布的罕见变异。可研究没多久，眼睛就从它的纹饰中伸了出来。
author: jokerswild
source: POKENAME was thought to be a rare mutation of Umbreon upon initial discovery. After a short time studying it, eyes protruded from its markings.

entry: POKENAME表面上的身体，常像普通宝可梦一样行走。有时却松垮地挂在头饰下，仿佛悬浮王冠的傀儡。
author: banquoviaquo
source: An POKENAME's apparent body can often be seen ambulating as normal Pokémon do, but there are times when it hangs slack from the headpiece, as if a puppet of the floating crown.

entry: 这种POKENAME比其他同族更像人。它时不时会默默演出无人知晓的剧目，原因众说纷纭。
author: bombboyxd
source: This variation of POKENAME seems more human-like than others of its species. Periodically, it silently acts out unknown plays; the reason is debated.

entry: POKENAME最常见于老旧废图书馆。馆里书页缺字，让许多人相信，它直接把字母偷走了。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME are most commonly found in old, abandoned libraries.  Books within these libraries have been found to be missing letters, leading many to believe POKENAME steal them right off the pages.

entry: 它常沐浴在阳光下。有人认为，黑叶飘动是在尝试交流，可它想说什么，仍不清楚。
author: bombboyxd
source: It often spends its time in the sunlight. Some interpret the fluttering of its black leaf as an attempt to communicate, but its meaning is unknown.

entry: POKENAME硕大的眼睛让许多人望而生畏。它明明没有牙齿，却仍本能地啃咬东西，常把自己的眼睛弄伤。
author: bombboyxd
source: Many are put off by POKENAME's large eye. While it has no teeth, its natural instinct to gnaw often leaves it with ocular injuries.

entry: POKENAME以古老低语吟唱，吓退古墓来者。若入侵者仍不退，就用耀眼光束攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME chant in an ancient susurration to scare people away from ancient tombs. If intruders persist, then POKENAME assault them with blinding beams of light.

entry: 一群未知图腾似乎特地聚在一起，想与人类交流。可惜，它们想表达什么，依然无人知晓。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: A collection of Unown appear to have gathered together in an attempt to communicate with humans. Unfortunately, what they are trying to say remains unknown.

entry: 这种未知图腾的自融合体，似乎想排成十字交叉的词。不过，真能组成有意义的词，好像全凭运气。
author: infranscia
source: This self fusion of Unown seems to try to arrange itself to form words in cross-like patterns.  However, it only only seems to form actual words out of sheer luck.

entry: 这种未知图腾的自融合体，变成了另一种文字的样子。研究者推测，这是与另一个地方或时代的精神能量同步的结果。
author: infranscia
source: This self fusion of Unown has morphed to resemble a different form of writing.  Researchers speculate that it did so because has synced with the mental energies of another place and/or time.

entry: 这种未知图腾的自融合体由许多部分组成，能量彼此同步，因此能合力组成繁复字形。
author: infranscia
source: This self fusion of Unown is made of many parts.  These parts are synchronized with each-other's energies, allowing them to work together to create intricate glyphs.

entry: POKENAME唯一真正能用的双眼，在头上的眼柄。毛和尾巴的色纹制造其他眼睛的假象，曾被观察到能吓退部分天敌。
author: _pixelar_
source: An POKENAME's only working pair of eyes is on the stalks on its head. The illusion of the other eyes is created by color markings on its fur and tail. This illusion has been observed to intimidate and frighten away some of its predators.

entry: POKENAME巢穴四周，散落着被它猎杀的生物遗骸，每一具旁边都环绕着神秘符号。奇怪的是，遗骸似乎全都未被吃过。
author: bombboyxd
source: Around the nests of POKENAME are the remains of the prey it has hunted and defeated, each surrounded by mysterious symbols. Strangely, none appear to be eaten.

entry: POKENAME在古代洞穴里游泳，保护昔日宝藏。中央眼向入侵者射出精神能量波，使其头痛、焦虑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swim in ancient caverns, protecting treasures of the past. Using their central eye, POKENAME shoot waves of psychic energy towards intruders, causing headaches and anxiety.

entry: POKENAME被视为未知图腾最强的形态之一。外貌让人想起名为“未知图腾之王”的古老传说。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: POKENAME is considered to be one of the strongest forms of Unown. Its appearance is reminiscent of an old legend known as "The Unown King".

entry: POKENAME用念力改变头顶悬浮灰团的形状，与族群交流。若视线受阻，这种交流就不太有效。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME communicates to the rest of its pack by telekinetically manipulating the shape of the gray blobs floating on top of its head. This form of communication tends to be less effective if POKENAME's vision is blocked.

entry: POKENAME常在古人遗迹，爬向墙上刻字。它吃掉带字的岩石，吸收古文能量，因此被考古学家视为祸害。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are often found amongst the ruins of ancient peoples, crawling their way toward writings etched into walls. They consume rocks that have been written on, absorbing energy from the ancient words, and are considered a pest by archaeologists.

entry: POKENAME安静飞过古迹附近的森林，几乎不降落。受袭时，将众多身体部件分开，再重组反击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME soars quietly across forests located near old ruins, almost never landing. If attacked, it separates the myriad parts of its body before reassembling itself to counterattack.

entry: POKENAME鼻子虽像眼睛，却完全看不见。层层积雪下埋着的树果，也能嗅出来。
author: .izik
source: Though it resembles an eye, POKENAME's nose has no vision at all. It can sniff out buried berries even beneath layers of snow.

entry: POKENAME枝条末端的眼，不祥地盯住每个路过者。有些枝条长成像字母的形状。
author: hophoppip
source: The eyes on the ends of its branches stare ominously at anyone that passes by. Some POKENAME branches grow into shapes resembling letters of the alphabet.

entry: 谁在世上何处入睡，它的眼睛都看得见；谁醒着，超能力也能感知。POKENAME凭这两项本领，判断人们的善恶。
author: griddle
source: Its eye can see when anyone in the world is sleeping. Its psychic power lets it know when someone is awake. POKENAME uses both to judge people's morality.

entry: POKENAME部分刃羽可脱离身体，带着真正能看的眼，四处飘行，让它观察远方。它总好奇观察四周，难得把所有羽毛都连回身上。
author: sk372
source: Some of its bladed feathers are detachable and possess working eyes, floating around and letting POKENAME view across wide distances. Its rarely seen with all its feathers attached, as it's always curiously observing its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME的大眼睛便于在栖息的草原上搜寻食物，可它却常显得营养不良。
author: bombboyxd
source: POKENAME's large eye allows it to effectively search the grasslands of its habitat for food. However, it is often seen to be physically malnourished.

entry: POKENAME最早被发现于阿露福遗迹附近的研究中心。周围电脑开始显示文字字符，讯息却不属任何已知语言。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME was first spotted in the vicinity of a research center near the Ruins of Alph. Computers in its vicinity begin to display text characters, but the messages do not belong to any known language.

entry: 它放弃鲜艳的颜料，改用醒目的黑墨。书法间会跃出未知图腾，借力量让POKENAME写下的字句化为现实。
author: griddle
source: It has traded its vibrant colour palette for striking black ink. Unown spring from its calligraphy, bringing POKENAME's words to life with their power.

entry: POKENAME会在遗迹墙上画下抽象涂鸦。人们从画中发现了一些规律，有人坚称其中藏有奇怪的密码。
author: leshii
source: POKENAME will mark ruin walls with abstract graffiti. Patterns have been discovered in its paintings, which some insist include strange codes.

entry: 与POKENAME对上眼，会感到透骨寒意，被形容为如同冻原风暴般深寒。
author: .izik
source: Anyone who locks eyes with POKENAME is struck by a chilling sensation. The cold is described as being as deep as a tundra storm.

entry: 放电留下的痕迹与焦印，会形成酷似文字的图案。
author: staghorn
