source: The tracks and burns created by its electrical discharges form patterns that resemble text characters.

entry: 这种融合宝可梦极为凶暴。奇怪的是，颈部皮膜上的眼睛真的看得见；POKENAME受到威胁，它们便一齐怒视敌人。
author: bombboyxd
source: This fusion is brutally vicious. Strangely, the eyes of its neck flap are functional, and if POKENAME is threatened, they will glare at the foe.

entry: POKENAME睡时，光滑身体放出强热。受打扰就醒来，以觉醒力量自卫。
author: .izik
source: While asleep, POKENAME's smooth body radiates intense heat. If disturbed, it awakens and releases a Hidden Power in defense.

entry: 曾有研究者误把这只融合宝可梦当作水君的壁画。没人真正见过POKENAME移动，因为它只在你眨眼时奔跑和攻击。
author: griddle
source: A researcher once mistook this fusion for a wall mural of Suicune. Nobody has actually seen POKENAME move; it runs and attacks only when you blink.

entry: 它栖身在常有雷暴的遗迹中。从它传出的心灵讯息判断，它对闪电近乎狂热地崇拜。
author: bombboyxd
source: It spends its time in ruins that are regularly near thunderstorms. The psychic messages it sends shows that it holds lightning in a fanatical regard.

entry: 它外表诡异残破，仿佛部分被烧去。夜里漂过森林，唱阴森歌曲；据说听者会看见自己未来的可怕片段。
author: sk372
source: It has a strange decrepit appearance, as if it were partially burnt away. As it floats through the forest night, it sings a haunting song; those that hear it are said to see grim visions of their future.

entry: 它用目光，将思想直接传进其他生命脑中。做过恶事者，听见的只有一句：“为什么？”
author: reflecbeat
source: Its gaze transmits its thoughts directly into the minds of others. Those who have committed evil deeds hear nothing but the question, "Why?".

entry: POKENAME大眼不断扫描四周，根本无法逃开注视。它调皮地跳过遗迹，看过它眼睛的来者，随后数小时都会控制不住地笑。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME constantly scans its surroundings with its large eyes, making it impossible to escape its gaze. It playfully skips through ruins, leaving those who have seen its eyes smiling uncontrollably for hours afterwards.

entry: POKENAME大群生活，合力压倒敌人。它聪明又爱捣蛋，常在古迹刻难解涂鸦，故意折腾考古研究者。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME live in large colonies where they will all work together to overpower foes. They are incredibly intelligent but mischievous, commonly carving unintelligible scribbles into ancient ruins to mess with archaeology researchers.

entry: 地面上刻出的仪式圆阵，是辨认POKENAME巢穴的线索。至于这些圆阵有何用途，至今无人知晓。
author: griddle
source: One can identify an POKENAME's den by the ritual circles it carves into the ground. The purpose of these circles is a mystery to all.

entry: 据说它拥有广大古老知识。若感到受辱，可能施咒，让冒犯者暂时失明。
author: busilisk
source: This Pokémon is said to possess vast, ancient knowledge. If it feels insulted, it may temporarily blind the offending person with a spell.

entry: 它爱好谜团，常与小说家相伴。许多作家把POKENAME看作最忠实的书迷，也是最苛刻的评论家。
author: griddle
source: It loves a mystery, and can frequently be found in the company of novelists. Many writers regard POKENAME as their biggest fan and harshest critic.

entry: POKENAME休息时呼出的烟，过滤后用于制作驱赶球。烟中微弱的精神能量，会使接触者短暂晕头转向。
author: .izik
source: The smoke POKENAME exhales while resting is filtered and used in creating Pester Balls. The faint psychic energy in the smoke causes brief disorientation in anyone it hits.

entry: POKENAME三根眼柄全能转动，提供360度视野。谁同时看进四只眼，就控制不住地哭，只有它转开目光才停止。
author: sk372
source: All three of POKENAME's eye stalks can rotate around and give it a full 360 degree range of vision. Those who stare into all four of its eyes at once begin crying uncontrollably, stopping only when POKENAME looks away.

entry: POKENAME常与其他幼年宝可梦待在一起。欢笑与喜悦能增强它的超能力。
author: griddle
source: POKENAME is frequently found in the company of other baby Pokémon. Its psychic powers are strengthened by laughter and joy.

entry: POKENAME帮孩子学字母，十分受欢迎。孩子若待它不好，就挨十万伏特，连刚才一课都难记住。
author: agostostino
source: POKENAME is very popular popular among kids, as it helps them learn the alphabet. If a kid treats it poorly, POKENAME will hit them with a Thunderbolt that can make the lesson difficult to remember.

entry: 未知丘遭极其猛烈的雷击，便会变成POKENAME。电力充足时，瞳孔会泛起刺眼的黄光。
author: bombboyxd
source: POKENAME is created when an Unchu is struck by incredibly strong lightning. If fully charged, the pupils on its eyes glow a harsh yellow.

entry: POKENAME用爪在木头刻符号和词，目的不明。它极难寻见，常趁深夜在屋侧留下标记。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their claws to carve symbols and words into wood, though their purpose is unknown. They are incredibly elusive, often leaving these markings on the sides of houses in the dead of night.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛能在黑夜里看得一清二楚，却也格外容易患雪盲症，因此十分畏惧阳光。
author: griddle
source: POKENAME's eye gives it flawless night vision, but makes it uniquely vulnerable to snow blindness. It lives in fear of the sun as a result.

entry: POKENAME眼中藏着非凡力量，有人说其中还有第六感。它能将眼睛留下，相隔数英里仍能找回。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME holds an extraordinary amount of power within its eye, and some say it has a sixth sense within it. POKENAME can leave their eye behind and still track it down from miles away.

entry: POKENAME藤尖剧毒，触碰者最长麻痹30分钟。它很害羞，常装成灌木，躲开冲突。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: The tips of POKENAME's vines are incredibly toxic, leaving those who touch them paralyzed for up to 30 minutes. They are known to be incredibly shy, often pretending to be bushes to avoid confrontation.

entry: POKENAME躲在洞穴和金字塔暗角，不愿被看见。许多恶作剧者便利用它，吓洞穴潜水者。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are known to hide in the corners of caves and pyramids, out of the public eye. Many pranksters have taken it upon themselves to use POKENAME to scare cave divers.

entry: 尾上的眼能远远向敌人放电。所有眼集中同一目标，就能施出极强电击。
author: elekboy88
source: The eyes on its tail are capable of firing electricity at foes from a large distance. It can focus all of its eyes on a single target for a massive electric attack.

entry: 它从炮管射出未知图腾，把攻击拼成文字。强大的POKENAME能打出整句，最强的甚至能打出押韵的诗句。
author: griddle
source: It shoots Unown from its cannons, spelling its attacks. Strong POKENAME have been known to fire sentences; the strongest will actually fire rhymes.

entry: POKENAME似乎被温柔心灵吸引，飞在上方静静观察。可选中的来者一注意它，就赶紧飞走藏好。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears attracted to those with gentle hearts, flying over them and observing them quietly. However, when the chosen being notices it, it quickly flies off and hides.

entry: POKENAME挖的洞和穿山鼠一样深。不过，洞壁上还刻着奇怪的标记，谁也读不懂。
author: bombboyxd
source: POKENAME's burrows are as deep as Sandshrew's are, but it was discovered that the walls of these burrows contain strange, unreadable markings.

entry: POKENAME大半身体布满眼睛，几乎不可能避开视线。快速振翅产生怪异失真声，让人剧烈头痛、迷失方向。
author: sk372
source: With eyes covering most of POKENAME's body, escaping its sight is nearly impossible. The rapid beat of its wings creates a strange distorted noise that causes extreme headaches and disorientation.

entry: POKENAME用獠牙在冰里刻象形文字，标记领地。聚在一起，就会充满神秘力量。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are known to carve hieroglyphs in ice with their tusks, marking their territory. When POKENAME gather, they are filled with a mysterious power.

entry: POKENAME唯一的眼会在分离的身体部件间瞬移，从不久留一处。野生未知图腾会聚来，把中空身体当临时庇护所。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's singular eye can teleport from one part of its disjointed body to the other, never staying in one spot for long. Unown in the wild will flock to POKENAME and use its hollow body as a temporary shelter.

entry: POKENAME靠强眼远远追踪其他生命，将阳光与体内能量凝在尾边，像薄刃，能深深划开粗壮树干。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can track other beings at far distances thanks to its powerful eye. It can harness sunlight and its internal energy around its tail like thin blades that can deeply gouge thick trees.

entry: 前臂刀刃略像某些古文字。它常用独眼盯住猎物或天敌，试图威吓。
author: infinex21
source: The blades on its forearms resemble certain ancient text characters a bit. It will often stare down prey and predators with its singular eye to try and intimidate them.

entry: POKENAME多眼能吸收阳光，面对众多敌人时，也能集中能量射出光束。潜藏力量还会沿双臂，化为纯粹凝聚能量构成的鲜亮刀刃。
author: infinex21
source: An POKENAME's many eyes can absorb sunlight or release energy as concentrated beams when faced with many enemies. It can release its hidden power as vibrant blades of pure, condensed energy along its arms.

entry: POKENAME背上的尖刺并非皮肤组织，似乎与洞中的标记有所关联，看起来简直像一则信息。
author: bombboyxd
source: The spikes on POKENAME's back aren't hide, though they appear to be connected to the markings in their burrows. They almost seem to be a message.

entry: 古建筑描绘POKENAME淹没、摧毁城市。考古学家认为，缘由是事件刚发生后，它便出现寻找住处。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Ancient structures depict POKENAME flooding and destroying cities. Archaeologists believe that this is because POKENAME appeared shortly after these events in search of homes.

entry: POKENAME着迷于书，爱阅读。发现想告诉训练家的趣事，就试着拼一个词，描述有趣的东西。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are fascinated by books and enjoy reading. Whenever they find something interesting to tell their Trainer, they will try to spell out a word that describes the object of interest.

entry: 有人说，全体POKENAME都是同一存在的化身，从现实之外投映而来。身后一团变动的肢体，会轻轻抓握、注视近处来者，仿佛在找重要的东西。
author: sk372
source: Some say all POKENAME are avatars of the same being projected into our reality from somewhere beyond. The shifting mound of limbs behind the body grasps and gazes gently at those near, seemingly searching for something important.

entry: POKENAME将脱离的双臂远远送去斩敌，再把敌人推得更远。开阔场地最适合它，能自由绕敌移动，始终保持够不着的距离。
author: thesilverowls
source: POKENAME fights by sending its detached arms to foes from afar and cutting into them, then pushing the foe even further away from it. POKENAME excels in more open fighting grounds, where it can freely move around enemies and stay out of reach.

entry: 这种POKENAME比同族更具金属质感。背后的黑色附肢能伸出去，把倒霉的家伙刺穿，钉在坚硬的背上。
author: bombboyxd
source: This POKENAME is more metallic than others of its species. The black limbs on its rear can reach to impale unlucky others onto its hard back.

entry: POKENAME的角被眼睛取代，失去了原本御敌的主要武器。作为补偿，感知能力似乎敏锐得惊人。
author: bombboyxd
source: POKENAME's horn has been displaced by its eye, depriving it of its main defence against aggressors. In return, it seems to have incredible senses.

entry: 野生POKENAME常在遗迹，直立如漆黑方尖碑，用顶端独眼观察其他生命。体内能量能从眼中化成光束射出。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME are often found around ruins, standing upright like pitch-black obelisks as they watch others with their singular, large eyes resting at the tops of their bodies. They can direct their internal energy into beams loosed from their eyes.

entry: 据说，一部作品发表时若恰有108处拼写错误，就会诞生POKENAME。人们常用这故事吓唬粗心的学生。
author: griddle
source: It's said POKENAME are created when a written work with exactly 108 spelling errors is published. It's commonly used to scare inattentive students.

entry: POKENAME很少挪离住处，常终生留在同一带。据说看进转动的眼，就会遭诅咒108天。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME rarely move from the places they reside in, commonly staying in the same area their entire lives. It is said that those who look into POKENAME's gyrating eyes are cursed for 108 days.

entry: 据说盯这诡异变化的身体越久，感知越扭曲。与它对视者声称，会看见广阔黑暗，连灯笼的光也穿不透。
author: jaminmcready
source: Its eerie, shifting body is said to distort perception the longer it is watched. Those who meet its gaze claim to see a vast darkness that not even the glow of a Lantern can pierce.

entry: 科学家发现，POKENAME在日光下休息时，黑色字符便会传递一则信息。究竟是什么意思，依然是谜。
author: bombboyxd
source: Scientists have noted that POKENAME's black characters convey a message when it relaxes in the sun. What it means remains a mystery.

entry: POKENAME头形奇特，却意外地不妨碍日常生活。整个身体仿佛组成了一个古怪的符号。
author: bombboyxd
source: Surprisingly, the unique shape of POKENAME's head does not appear to affect its daily life. Its body seems to resemble an odd symbol.

entry: 身体是个空心外壳。人们将物品交给POKENAME保管，取回时只需轻轻摇晃它。它似乎并不介意。
author: griddle
source: Its body is a hollow shell. People will give POKENAME items for safekeeping and then gently shake it to retrieve them. It doesn't seem to mind this.

entry: POKENAME住在古迹残垣，脸朝地扑下，用触须写象形文字。许多个体对现代科技好奇。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are known to live at the remains of ancient ruins. They draw hieroglyphs by faceplanting into the ground and using their tentacles to write. Many instances of POKENAME are curious about modern technology.

entry: 它在海底散落的摇篮百合石化残骸中安家。虽然常被误解，其实它毫无恶意，只是害羞。
author: griddle
source: This fusion makes its home in the petrified remains of Cradily littering the seafloor. Contrary to popular belief, it's not malevolent; it's just shy.

entry: POKENAME看着有三只眼，其实只有中央那只是真的。它有神秘力量，超过一百只聚集，仿佛就能改变现实。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: Despite it looking like having three eyes, POKENAME has only one real eye, that being the one in the center. They have a mysterious power that allows them to seemingly transform reality when more than a hundred of them gather.

entry: 它们用砸碎的未知图腾残片装饰身体，研究者把这些战利品称为“断字”。佩有最大“断字”的POKENAME便是首领。
author: griddle
source: They adorn themselves with smashed Unown parts; scientists refer to these trophies as 'text breaks'. The POKENAME with the biggest text break leads.

entry: 除了总忍不住靠向完美的圆，人们几乎不了解它的行为。平时动作看似慢，却不规律，近乎随机。
author: banquoviaquo
source: Little is known about this Pokémon's behavior except that it is compulsively drawn toward perfect circles. Otherwise, its movements seem slow, but erratic—almost random.

entry: POKENAME常在遗迹，用圆头堵住通道。只有证明能读懂当地遗迹语言，才肯让路。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME are commonly found in ruins, blocking passageways with their circular heads. They will only move for those who prove themselves able to read the language of their native ruins.

entry: 它无声躺在废遗迹，独眼从不眨。虽似懒散，存在本身却干扰指南针、钟表，仿佛周围时间也慢下来。
author: jaminmcready
source: It lounges silently in abandoned ruins, its single eye never blinking. Though it appears lazy, its presence disrupts compasses and clocks, as if time itself grows sluggish around it.

entry: POKENAME闲躺遗迹，通常在沙里随意刻些象形文字。若被激怒，就爆发毁灭性的精神力量。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME lounge around ruins, they typically carve lazy hieroglyphs into the sand. When provoked, POKENAME unleash a burst of devastating psychic power.

entry: POKENAME的角和翅膀随精神力量脉动，显示模糊未来景象。为末日作准备的人，认作世界终结的讯息，常养一只。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME's horns and wings pulse with psychic power, showing vague visions of the future. Doomsday preppers believe this to be a message about the end of the world and often keep one around.

entry: POKENAME突然从浪下现身观察船只，能吓得船员偏航。被无视一阵，就平静潜回，但离开视野后，研究者便无法追踪。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME suddenly appears from beneath the waves to watch ships, which can startle crews to sail off-course. If it is ignored for a while, it will peacefully submerge, but researchers have not been able to track it once it leaves their field of view.

entry: POKENAME突然从浪下现身观察船只，能吓得船员偏航。被无视一阵，就平静潜回，但离开视野后，研究者便无法追踪。

source: POKENAME suddenly appears from beneath the waves to watch ships, which can startle crews to sail off-course. If it is ignored for a while, it will peacefully submerge, but researchers have not been able to track it once it leaves their field of view.

author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME suddenly appears from beneath the waves to watch ships, which can startle crews to sail off-course. If it is ignored for a while, it will peacefully submerge, but researchers have not been able to track it once it leaves their field of view.

entry: 据说POKENAME多眼看尽一切，人最好远离，盯久会不安、恶心。目击者形容：“既非奇数，也非偶数，它无穷无尽的眼总在变。”
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME is said to see everything with its many eyes. Humans should steer clear of this Pokémon, as looking at it for too long causes distress and nausea. "Never odd or even, its endless eyes are always changing," witnesses have described.

entry: 它是一种形似简陋长剑的古老宝可梦，却被认为早在青铜时代之前就已存在。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This ancient Pokémon is shaped like a rudimentary sword, but is thought to predate the bronze age.

entry: 它是一种形似过分繁复的长剑的古老宝可梦，却被认为早在青铜时代之前就已存在。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This ancient Pokémon is shaped like an over-complicated sword, but is thought to predate the bronze age.

entry: 它们借飞行的方向与动作交流。发现不喜欢的东西，两副身体便交叉成X形，用超能力将其驱退。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The direction and motion of how their bodies fly aid in their communication. If they see something they don't like, the two bodies will cross into an X-shaped formation and repel it with their psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME角里注入的毒黑得像墨，是攻击大脑语言中枢的神经毒素，使受害者胡言乱语，或无法说话。
author: hophoppip
source: The venom injected by POKENAME's horn is black and inky. It's a neurotoxin that targets the language center of the brain, causing victims to spout gibberish or become unable to speak.

entry: 古传说将POKENAME视为所有未知图腾的统治者，沉睡数千年。一醒来，就试图吞掉路上遇到的一切活物。
author: oxygen_the_chinchilla_angel
source: According to old folklore, POKENAME are considered the rulers of all Unown, lying dormant for thousands of years. When they awaken from their slumber, they will attempt to devour any and every living being that crosses their paths.

entry: POKENAME常在古迹和墓园，无声注视近处生命。它能心灵交流，讯息却是不明语言，研究者仍试图破译。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME often appear at ancient ruins and cemeteries, silently watching nearby creatures. They have the ability to communicate telepathically; however, these messages are spoken in an unknown language. Researchers are still attempting to decrypt it.

entry: POKENAME身形轮廓，像遗迹中发现的某个文字。含义有争议，有学者说仅是睡眠，也有人坚持只指噩梦。
author: .jerden
source: The outline of POKENAME's body resembles a character found in ancient ruins. There is debate about exactly what this symbol meant, and while some scholars say it simply meant sleep, others insist it only referred to nightmares.

entry: POKENAME能把自己压到锡箔般薄，贴墙站着，像一道淡影，等猎物靠近。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME can flatten itself to the thickness of tin foil. It stands against a wall, appearing as nothing more than a faint shadow, and waits for prey to approach.

entry: POKENAME用背炮，将象形文字轰进洞壁和古迹。这种语言，研究者仍未真正破译。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Using the cannons on their backs, POKENAME blast hieroglyphs into the walls of caves and ancient ruins. This language is yet to be properly deciphered by researchers.

entry: 古传说将POKENAME视为所有未知图腾的统治者，沉睡数千年。一醒来，就试图吞掉路上遇到的一切活物。
author: oxygen_the_chinchilla_angel
source: According to old folklore, POKENAME are considered the rulers of all Unown, lying dormant for thousands of years. When they awaken from their slumber, they will attempt to devour any and every living being that crosses their paths.

entry: 古传说将POKENAME视为所有未知图腾的统治者，沉睡数千年。一醒来，就试图吞掉路上遇到的一切活物。
author: oxygen_the_chinchilla_angel
source: According to old folklore, POKENAME are considered the rulers of all Unown, lying dormant for thousands of years. When they awaken from their slumber, they will attempt to devour any and every living being that crosses their paths.

entry: 月亮渐圆时，POKENAME独眼偶尔闪蓝光。原因至今完全不明。
author: .izik
source: During waxing moons, POKENAME's lone eye occasionally flashes blue. The reason for this glow remains completely unknown.

entry: 传说POKENAME飞遍世界天空，多眼观察人们行动，加以审判。人们也相信，它会降下猛烈雷击，惩罚不公。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to legend, POKENAME flies through the skies of the world, observing people's actions with its many eyes in order to judge them. It is also believed to punish injustice by raining down violent lightning bolts.

entry: POKENAME臂上触须偶尔卷成字母般的形状，拼出的却总无意义。承受不住时，便用触须遮脸，迅速扭成各种形状。
author: quantumradiation
source: The tendrils on its arms occasionally curl into what seem to be letter-like shapes, but always spell out nonsense. Whenever POKENAME is overwhelmed, it will cover its face with these tendrils and contort them rapidly into many different shapes.

entry: POKENAME飘行时，不眨的眼持续巡视领地，根本无法悄悄接近。小群偶尔聚在无线电塔旁，严重干扰电波。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's unblinking eyes survey its territory constantly as it floats, making it impossible to sneak up on. Small groups occasionally gather around radio towers, their presence causing heavy disruption in the radio waves.

entry: POKENAME白天慢慢飘行，入夜才捕猎。有故事说，它曾成群掳人，受害者称被带到描绘着传说的宝可梦的古迹。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: During the day, POKENAME slowly drift through the air. However, when night falls, POKENAME hunts for prey. There are stories of POKENAME taking people away in groups, and victims say they were taken to ancient ruins depicting Legendary Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME不断翻阅文本，找语言演变资料。它分不清虚构与真话，引来同类讨论研究是否可信。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME constantly scours through texts looking for data about linguistic evolution. It doesn't know the difference between fiction and true statements, leading to deliberation with peers over the validity of its research.

entry: 满月之夜，POKENAME静静站在平静池面，独眼一眨不眨地望月，直到黎明。
author: .izik
source: On nights of a full moon, POKENAME stands silently atop still pond waters. Its single eye gazes unblinking at the moon until dawn.

entry: POKENAME眼中放出远传的精神脉冲，能麻痹数十米外的受害者。一制住目标，它便奔去，怪颚一路凶猛开合。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's eye emits a far-reaching psychic pulse that can paralyze a victim from several dozen meters away. Once it stuns a target, it races towards them, its strange jaws snapping viciously all the while.

entry: 它们假扮坛罐，等愚蠢盗墓者误入巢。战斗时，便扑向敌人，发出刺耳尖叫。
author: sondededoo
source: Disguising themselves as jars, they lie in wait for foolish tomb raiders to stumble into their dens. During combat, they will lunge at their foes whilst letting loose an ear piercing scream.

entry: 蜡融化时，POKENAME鬼火投出被遗忘符文的淡影。在它火光下读书，也许能看到别的版本没有的词句。
author: ozydamians
source: As the wax melts, POKENAME's ghostly fire casts faint shadows of forgotten runes. A book read by the light of POKENAME may have words not found in other editions.

entry: 它不眨眼地盯潜在威胁，吓退，或至少让对方不安。战斗时，精神能量围住头侧，形成能切开坚石的利刃。
author: infinex21
source: It stares unblinking at any potential threats to deter them or to at least unnerve them. In battle, it wreathes the sides of its head with psychic energy to form sharp blades that can cut through solid stone.

entry: POKENAME乍看令人畏惧，一旦信任你，却会变得十分亲切。它的每只眼睛都曾属于一只未知图腾。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME is an intimidating Pokémon at first, but once it trusts you, it becomes very kind. Each eye it has once belonged to an Unown.

entry: POKENAME一度被视为神话中的君王，实际担任着墓地的守护者，对闯入者很不友善。
author: inksans201x
source: Once thought to be a mythical ruler, POKENAME acts as a guardian of cemeteries. It is not very fond of trespassers.

entry: POKENAME腿太小，撑不了身体太久，便靠飘浮。它守古建筑守得太好，甚至传闻有灵魂将它束缚在那里。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME's legs are too small to hold up its body for long periods of time, so they levitate. They are known to guard ancient structures so well that there are rumors about POKENAME being bound there by a spirit.

entry: POKENAME会绕各种火打转，俯冲进去吸收火焰，维持健康。民间故事却将它描绘为死亡象征。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are known to circle fires of all kinds. They dive in to absorb the flames and keep themselves healthy. In folktales, POKENAME have been painted as symbols of death.

entry: 多眼始终各盯不同的东西。一旦全部集中单一目标，对方就会立即起火。
author: infinex21
source: Its multiple eyes are always focused on different things. When all of them focus on a single target, that target will instantly combust.

entry: POKENAME在训练家对战里恶名远扬。人们相信，训练家落入劣势，只需派它上场，就能把劣势转给对手训练家。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME is infamous for its usage in Trainer battles. It is believed that if its Trainer is at a disadvantage, simply sending it into battle will shift the disadvantage onto the opposing Trainer.

entry: 星夜，曾记录到成群POKENAME绕古文明遗迹，不祥地盘旋，天亮便消失。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: On starry nights groups of POKENAME have been recorded ominously circling the ruins of ancient civilization, vanishing by daylight.

entry: POKENAME用精神场地，能呈现古迹数千年前的模样。受威胁，先让对手看惊人幻景，再反击。聚在一起，又充满神秘能量。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: With their use of Psychic Terrain, POKENAME can unveil what ancient ruins looked like thousands of years ago. When threatened, POKENAME give opponents startling visions before retaliating. When together POKENAME are filled with a mysterious energy.

entry: POKENAME极警觉，用遍身眼睛发现最小动静。平时有敌意，来到古建筑旁却会放松，原因不明。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are hyper-aware of their surroundings, using the eyes spread across their bodies to detect the slightest movements. Whilst typically hostile, POKENAME enter a state of relaxation around ancient structures for an unknown reason.

entry: POKENAME靠全身的眼，还是只靠头上的眼看东西，研究者意见不一。盯久会总觉得被注视，即使离远了也一样。
author: chibitales
source: Researchers are split on whether POKENAME are able to see out of all the eyes on their body or through just the ones on their head. Gazing too long into their eyes provokes feelings of being watched at all times, even after moving away from them.

entry: 据说POKENAME核心藏着可能连它自己都不知道的力量。肢体偶尔扭成遗迹中发现的古文字。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's core is said to contain a hidden power that may not even be known to it. Its limbs sometime writhe into the shapes of ancient text characters found within ruins.

entry: POKENAME用神秘火焰烧灼地面，刻出复杂象形文字，原因不明。据说心怀恶意者踏入领地，会受诅咒一千年。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME sear the ground with their mystical flames, making intricate hieroglyphs. While this behavior is done for an unknown reason, it is said that any ill-intended person who sets foot in POKENAME's territory is cursed for a thousand years.

entry: 它爱傍晚唱歌，可扭曲音调常让听者晕头转向。有报告说，身体音符状的部位会随歌曲改变。
author: sk372
source: It enjoys singing in the evening, though the warped notes it lets out tend to disorient those who listen to it. Some have reported that the note-shaped part of its body changes depending on the song.

entry: 据说古时一只POKENAME曾撞洞壁，试写宇宙起源的故事。研究者寻找那座洞，认为是互连洞，却已无证据留下。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: It is said that an ancient POKENAME once rammed into the walls of a cave in attempts to write down the story of the beginning of the universe. Researchers have searched for the right cave, and believe it to be Union Cave, though no evidence remains.

entry: POKENAME头上的眼全是假眼，真眼在嘴里。它躺在沙坑底，盯天空，等猎物。
author: santon5512
source: The eyes on POKENAME head are merely decoys, with its real eye residing in its mouth. It lies at the bottom of sand pits, staring into the sky as it waits for its prey.

entry: 这种宝可梦游得缓慢，最常见于浅礁。大眼让它十分善于发现来袭威胁，身体其他部分却太小，躲避本领就糟得很。
author: fireblade141
source: This Pokémon is a slow swimmer that is most often found in shallow reefs. Due to its large eyes, it is very good at noticing incoming threats. However, due to the rest of its body being so small, it's terrible at avoiding those threats.

entry: POKENAME无数眼睛从壳缝窥看。感知、耐久都出色，因此有些研究者带它探索陌生地下迷宫。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME's countless eyes peer through cracks in their shell. Some researchers take them on expeditions to unfamiliar dungeons due to their exceptional awareness and durability.

entry: POKENAME曾侵入实验室，替换机器齿轮，多半是打印或呈现信息的设备。装有它的机器，会不停产出难解的数字、字母组合。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME have been recorded invading research labs and replacing the gears in machinery, typically those that print or visualize information. Machines with POKENAME in them constantly produce indecipherable combinations of numbers and letters.

entry: 它唱出阴森、近乎有节奏的音调，独眼在暗中微微发光。听众常见怪异幻景，仿佛现实本身随旋律扭曲。
author: jaminmcready
source: It sings in eerie, almost rhythmic tones, with its single eye glowing faintly in the dark. Those who hear its song often experience strange visions, as if the very fabric of reality bends to its melody.

entry: 研究者声称，POKENAME在植物学课本旁筑巢，神秘地吸食读者能量。有人说，它让植物插图枯萎或微移，但尚无证据。
author: .izik
source: Researchers claim POKENAME nests near botanical textbooks, mysteriously feeding on the energy of readers. Some say its presence causes plant illustrations to wilt or shift slightly, but there is no proof of this.

entry: POKENAME在极高的大气层漂流，常需望远镜才看得清。地面的人有时误认成流星。
author: xzydra
source: POKENAME drift through the atmosphere at incredibly high altitudes, often requiring a telescope to see clearly. Sometimes, POKENAME are mistaken for shooting stars by people on the ground.

entry: 它的视力始终完美无缺。研究者一直研究POKENAME，希望从它身上找到治愈失明的秘密。
author: griddle
source: Its vision is always perfect. Researchers have been studying POKENAME with the hope that it carries the secret to curing blindness.

entry: POKENAME用弯曲身体，轻易钻过沙漠的沙。独眼在全黑中也看得清。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows effortlessly through desert sands using its curved body. Its singular eye sees clearly in total darkness.

entry: POKENAME虽有巨眼，却避开直接对视，爱从天花板或洞穴观察。翅膀产生轻度精神干扰，搅乱附近思绪。
author: jaminmcready
source: Despite its massive eye, POKENAME avoids direct gaze and prefers to observe from ceilings or caverns. Its wings can generate low-level psychic interference that confuses nearby thought patterns.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛在黑暗中泛起微光，屋主发现时，常会吓一跳。凝视太久，观看者的皮肤便有静电般的麻刺感。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's eye glows faintly in the dark, often leading to homeowners being spooked by its discovery. Staring into its eye too long causes one to feel a tingling sensation along their skin akin to static electricity.

entry: POKENAME的刺只引发幻痛，并不造成真正伤害。虽然疼痛，却没有可见伤口。
author: terrabits
source: POKENAME's spikes only inflict phantom pain instead of any real injury as there is no visible wound, despite the pain they give.

entry: POKENAME通常结群，最多二十六只。受惊便沿令人着迷的曲折路线移动，扰乱敌人，再飞走。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME typically live in groups with up to twenty-six members. When frightened they move in mesmerizing zigzag patterns to disorient their foe before flying away.

entry: POKENAME栖在树和古迹上，偶尔朝地面射火球，烧焦一片。留下的象形符号，让人推测它有自己的语言，却未证实。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: When perched on trees and ancient ruins, POKENAME occasionally shoot fireballs into the ground, charring the area. It is theorized that POKENAME have their own language due to the hieroglyphic symbols they leave in the dirt; this is yet to be proven.

entry: POKENAME通过振动吸取能量，将回声转成阵阵精神力量。翅膀共鸣嗡响，让飞行中的猎物晕头转向。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME siphons energy through vibrations, converting echoes into bursts of psychic force. Its wings emit a resonant hum that disorients prey mid-flight.

entry: POKENAME稍稍悬在地上，中央眼永不眨。盯久的人坚称，看见茧里某个形状在旋转，却无法好好描述。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hovers just above the ground, its central eye forever unblinking. Those who stare too long will swear they've seen the shape of something rotating inside the cocoon, but find themselves incapable of describing it adequately.

entry: POKENAME眼睛善于夜视，轻易追踪猎物。它创造象形文字，原因未知；符号最早追溯数亿年前，含义也不明。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME's eyes help them see in the dark, allowing them to easily track prey. They create hieroglyphs for an unidentified reason. Symbols created by POKENAME date back to as far as hundreds of millions of years ago, their meanings are unknown.

entry: POKENAME漂过废弃城市找旅人，多眼始终注意人和宝可梦的生命力。跟随谁，便慢慢吸走能量，哄其睡着。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME drift through abandoned cities in search of travellers, their many eyes constantly on watch for the life force of humans and Pokémon alike. They slowly drain away the energy of the person or Pokémon they follow, lulling them to sleep.

entry: POKENAME白天钻地下，只露叶冠吸收太阳辐射。夜里独眼保持警觉，与月相同步，慢慢转动。
author: jaminmcready
source: During the day, POKENAME burrows underground, exposing only its leafy crest to absorb solar radiation. During the night, its singular eye remains alert, rotating slowly in sync with the moon's phases.

entry: POKENAME总知道有人观看，身上眼睛挪动，始终锁定观众。据说与眼对视，会产生奇异、不舒服的暖意。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is always aware when it has an audience, the eyes on its body shifting to remain locked on its watcher. Meeting the eyes' gaze is said to induce a strange and uncomfortable warmth in a person.

entry: POKENAME悬在地上，优雅摇摆起舞。目击者移不开眼，开始用不明语言轻声歌唱。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME hovers above the ground as it dances and sways in a graceful manner. Those who witness this dance find themselves unable to look away, beginning to quietly sing in an unknown language.

entry: POKENAME身体由细碎纸片构成。有人相信，掉出的纸条传递着信息。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's body is made of fine shredded paper. Some believe that the strips of paper that fall out of POKENAME's body convey messages.

entry: POKENAME枝上吹落的黑叶，沿奇异轨迹飘行，落地后组成怪符印。
author: hophoppip
source: The black leaves that blow from POKENAME's boughs move through the air in unusual patterns before landing in the shape of strange sigils.

entry: POKENAME花瓣有时滴下浓稠分泌物，混着扰乱神经通路的孢子。它释放气味信号，同时一眨不眨地紧盯目标。
author: jaminmcready
source: A viscous secretion will sometimes drip from POKENAME's petals. It's laced with spores that confuse neural pathways. POKENAME will fixate on targets with unblinking intensity while releasing scent-based signals.

entry: POKENAME翅膀不能带起身体，便用念力飘浮。耳朵不断发出令人不安的声响。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's wings cannot catch the air, so it uses psychokinesis to levitate. Its ears constantly emit an unnerving sound.

entry: POKENAME爱唱歌，用云朵般的羽毛摆出实体音符。沉思时，羽毛会变成省略号形状。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME love singing, using their cloud-like plumage to physically display musical notes. Whenever they are pensive, these Pokémon will shift their plumage into the shape of an ellipsis.

entry: POKENAME形体不定，令人不安，引发疑问：未知图腾究竟由什么生物物质构成，长期接触它们或POKENAME是否伤人？至今，没有确凿证据表明它含毒。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's unsettling amorphous appearance has raised concerns over what Unown is biologically composed of and if they or POKENAME could be harmful to humans over long-term exposure. So far, there is no solid evidence that it contains any toxins.

entry: POKENAME是奇怪的金属宝可梦，通常安静、不动。脸上的圆其实是眼，能脱离飘行，更好地观察四周。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a strange metallic Pokémon that typically remains silent and sedentary. The circles on its face are actually eyes that can detach and float around to better observe its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME花中有复杂的色素细胞，能将思想折射成致幻景象。激动时，整朵花低频振动嗡响，瞳孔慢慢变色。
author: jaminmcready
source: The blossom on an POKENAME contains a complex array of pigment cells that can refract its thoughts into hallucinogenic visuals. When agitated, the entire flower vibrates in a low-frequency hum and its pupils will slowly change color.

entry: POKENAME由许多符号、字母奇异融合而成。光束直接照来，分隔各个符号的界线，便清楚显现。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's body is made up of many different symbols and letters that have strangely fused together to shape its body. When a beam of light is directly cast on POKENAME, lines that clearly distinguish the individual symbols become clear.

entry: POKENAME用爪在树皮刻符号，每道标记都呼应周围能量场。背上盘卷的真菌组织响应脑波，深思时微微脉动。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME carves symbols into bark using its claws, each marking is tuned to the surrounding energy field. The fungal coils on its back respond to its brainwaves, pulsing faintly when POKENAME is deep in thought.

entry: 人们相信，POKENAME模仿了数千年前曾居住遗迹的形状。传说它吸走生命力，让身上的草保持绿色；研究者正调查这种“能力”。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are believed to take the shape of the ruins they once inhabited thousands of years ago. In legend, POKENAME possess the ability to siphon life force to keep the grass on their bodies green. This 'ability' is being looked into by researchers.

entry: POKENAME能用精神力量造极光。古代洞穴壁画中，曾发现它的粗略描绘。
author: cait_sith
source: It can create auroras using its psychic powers. Crude depictions of POKENAME have been discovered in ancient cave art.

entry: POKENAME身体自主行动，完全由附近蘑菇产生的电波指挥。眼睛读取环境数据，能察觉真菌生长。
author: jaminmcready
source: The body of an POKENAME moves autonomously, directed entirely by electrical waves produced by nearby mushrooms. Its eye reads environmental data and can detect the growth of fungus.

entry: POKENAME叶片的香气能中和、掩盖附近气味，帮它在灌木丛里隐藏，躲开天敌。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME's leaves emit a neutralising aroma that covers nearby smells. It uses this scent to hide its presence from predators in bushes and shrubbery.

entry: 古庙里，POKENAME仔细观察所有进出者。遇到恶意入侵者，便以强效催眠粉末让对方睡去。
author: ozydamians
source: In ancient temples, POKENAME carefully observed all who entered and left. Intruders with bad intentions were put to sleep with a powerful soporific powder.

entry: 浓毛捕捉周围静电，让它感知思想、动作的扰动。受到威胁，就从触角爆出一阵生物电光。
author: jaminmcready
source: Its dense fur traps ambient static, allowing it to sense disruptions in thought and motion. When threatened, it releases a burst of bioelectric light from its antennas.

entry: POKENAME与另一只在一起，就更善于隐藏。它们四至五只成群，日常常一起生活。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME has the ability to hide better when with another POKENAME. POKENAME stays in groups of four to five, often living daily life together.

entry: POKENAME夜里在树梢等无防备的训练家。发现目标，就从树上跳下，试图吓一跳。可惜它实在不怎么吓人。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME wait at night in the treetops for unsuspecting Trainers to wander by. Once their prey has been spotted, they will leap from the tree and try to give them a fright. Unfortunately for POKENAME, they're not very scary.

entry: POKENAME夜里在树梢等无防备的训练家。发现目标，就从树上跳下，试图吓一跳。可惜它实在不怎么吓人。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME wait at night in the treetops for unsuspecting Trainers to wander by. Once their prey has been spotted, they will leap from the tree and try to give them a fright. Unfortunately for POKENAME, they're not very scary.

entry: POKENAME翅膀能将光与声折射成催眠脉冲，迷惑天敌和猎物。眼睛则在黑暗中持续搜索精神特征。
author: jaminmcready
source: The wings of an POKENAME can refract light and sound into hypnotic pulses, confusing both predators and prey. Its eyes continuously scan for mental signatures in the dark.

entry: POKENAME满身撞击伤痕，在天空难料地翻滚。观察者说，风暴聚起时，螺旋眼脉动更快，随远雷节奏闪烁。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME tumbles unpredictably across the sky, its body riddled with impact scars. Observers say its spiral eye pulses faster when storms gather, flashing in time with distant thunderclaps.

entry: POKENAME悬停太空边缘，只在地磁暴时下降，释放积攒电荷。受威胁便急转，每根闪亮尖刺都引导一股重力。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME hovers motionless near the edge of space, only coming down to release built-up charge during geomagnetic storms. When threatened, it spins rapidly, and each of its glinting spikes channels a surge of gravitational force.

entry: 书法家模仿POKENAME翅形，练习毛笔。它似乎也对艺术有兴趣，多眼注视着自己的模样被写成简单符号。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Calligraphers attempt to capture the shape of POKENAME wings as a way to improve their skills with using an ink brush. POKENAME appear to take an interest in this art, watching with their many eyes as their likeness is inscribed in simple symbols.

entry: 虽然它以攻击性强而闻名，研究却发现，它平时会花时间在崖壁上书写奇怪的字符。
author: bombboyxd
source: Though it's known for its aggressive behavior, research has revealed that it spends its time writing strange characters into the side of cliffs.

entry: POKENAME挖出的地洞窄得根本容不下它的头，可它偏偏能在其中穿行，令所有人都百思不解。
author: griddle
source: Nobody knows how POKENAME moves underground, as the holes it makes are too narrow for its head. To the bafflement of all, it traverses them anyways.

entry: 眼睛诡异而精准地扫描周围泥土，察觉数英里外振动。它无声迅速穿过隧道，往往发现时，早已太晚。
author: jaminmcready
source: Its eye scans the surrounding earth with eerie precision, detecting vibrations from miles away. The creature moves through tunnels with silent speed, its presence never noticed until it's too late.

entry: 没人知道POKENAME的根扎得有多深。最新研究发现，它的根竟能拼成整整几段文字。
author: griddle
source: No one knows how deep POKENAME's roots go. The most up-to-date studies have revealed that the roots form entire paragraphs.

entry: POKENAME凭超能力，只需对视就能看出一个人拥有多少财富。得到它的青睐，预示着好运降临。
author: griddle
source: Using its psychic powers, POKENAME is able to discern the wealth of anyone it makes eye contact with. Its favor is a portent of good fortune.

entry: 它忽左忽右地飞窜，独眼不断寻找什么。相遇者常发现东西不见或重排，唯一线索是一个难解符号。
author: jaminmcready
source: It darts erratically from place to place, its singular eye constantly searching for something. Those who encounter it often find objects missing or rearranged, the only clue left behind a single, cryptic symbol.

entry: 它常静立，望着空无一物，仿佛深思，眼睛却越来越亮。有人声称，只有它最困惑时，眼里才会闪现未来片段。
author: jaminmcready
source: It often stands still, staring at nothing, as if in deep thought, its eye glowing brighter with each passing moment. Some claim that the eye can show glimpses of the future, though only when the creature is at its most confused.

entry: 眼睛不停乱移，弄糊涂研究者。它能随意控水，发出阵阵能量，涟漪般扩散，影响有形与无形的世界。
author: jaminmcready
source: Its eye shifts erratically, confusing anyone who tries to study it. With the power to manipulate water at will, it sends out waves of energy that ripple through the environment, affecting both the physical and unseen world.

entry: 只要盯住眼睛，POKENAME就会僵在原地。但它极其讨厌对视，你一眨眼或移开目光，它便立刻攻击。
author: griddle
source: It will freeze on the spot if you stare into its eye. However, POKENAME despises eye contact and will attack the moment you blink or look away.

entry: 有旅人说，戳眼睛就能摆脱凶猛的POKENAME。可千万别试，这只会让它更加愤怒。
author: griddle
source: Some travellers say that you can escape an aggressive POKENAME by poking it in the eye. Do not do this; it will only get angrier.

entry: 它如一团狂乱旋风，眼里亮着未释放的攻击性。对峙者会被卷进令人眩晕、不可预测的动作中，无从躲开怒气。
author: jaminmcready
source: This creature is a whirlwind of frantic energy, its eye glowing with untapped aggression. Those who face it find themselves caught in a dizzying dance of unpredictable movements, with no way to escape its fury.

entry: 野外，它安静敏捷地穿过林地、草原，眼睛随时查动静。它守卫神圣林地，默看靠近者，只在恰当时机现身。
author: jaminmcready
source: In nature, it moves through forests and grasslands with quiet agility, its eye constantly scanning for any movement. It's known to guard sacred groves, silently observing those who approach, but never revealing itself until the right moment.

entry: POKENAME毛上饰着神秘符号，月下似会变化，仿佛描出隐秘语言。符号似藏古老力量，却没人破解真正含义。
author: jaminmcready
source: The fur of POKENAME is adorned with mysterious symbols that appear to shift in the moonlight, as if tracing a hidden language. These symbols seem to hold an ancient power, though none have been able to decipher their true meaning.

entry: 它身上的眼睛，能看见一切踏入领地的生物。为了保护未知恐龙刻下的图案，它会近乎狂热地喷出黑色火焰。
author: bombboyxd
source: The eyes on its body see all that enters its territory. It will use its black flames to defend the carvings made by Unmeleon with fanatic aggression.

entry: POKENAME的巨眼占体重的85%，让它拥有极佳的浮力。可它的视力却出奇地差，常常摔倒。
author: filteredtea
source: POKENAME's giant eye makes up 85% of its body weight, making it very buoyant. It often falls over due to its surprisingly poor eyesight.

entry: 从未知蝌蚪到POKENAME，体型如何转变仍不清楚。它能看清周围完整360度。
author: filteredtea
source: The transition in body type from an Unwag to an POKENAME is currently unknown. It can see in a complete 360 degrees around itself.

entry: POKENAME拳头由强大古代能量推动。据说曾有个体一击夷平整座摩天楼。
author: filteredtea
source: POKENAME's punches are powered by powerful ancient energies. It is said an POKENAME once leveled an entire skyscraper in one strike.

entry: POKENAME有时在巨石和岩壁旁，凿刻未知图腾语言。信息到底想表达什么，尚不清楚。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can sometimes be found near boulders and rock walls, chiseling in the language of Unown. It is unclear what these messages are intended to mean.

entry: POKENAME眼在躯干，平时四臂中的两条遮住保护。将向敌人放出奇异精神力量前，才会露眼。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's eyes are located on its torso, typically covered by two of its four arms for protection. It uncovers its eyes just before it releases a strange psychic power at its foes.

entry: 这种融合体虽连颜色也变了，最引人注目的却是壳上的字符，仿佛暗示着尚未揭开的奥秘。
author: bombboyxd
source: Despite the colour change of this fusion, the most striking change is the characters on its shell that seem to hint at mysteries untold.

entry: POKENAME情绪丰富，常交叉触手表示失望。有训练家说，做出惊人壮举后，它看见便自愿加入。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME is a notoriously emotive Pokémon, known for crossing its tentacles to demonstrate its disappointment. Some Trainers have reported POKENAME willfully joining them after it witnessed them perform an impressive feat.

entry: POKENAME英名带着“不残酷”的意味，也确实远不如普通毒刺水母凶残。它仍用触手抓人和宝可梦，却似乎只满足于检查一番。
author: hophoppip
source: Fitting its name, POKENAME is far less cruel than a standard Tentacruel. It will still grab people and Pokémon with its tentacles, but it seems to be content with inspecting them.

entry: POKENAME滚动时能看见未来。可它滚得太快，预言往往过于简略，派不上什么用场。
author: griddle
source: POKENAME has visions of the future when it rolls. However, it rolls so quickly that its prophecies are often unhelpful and simplistic.

entry: 为免感官负荷过重，POKENAME每次只会启用一只眼睛。因此，根本无法判断它正看向哪里。
author: griddle
source: In order to avoid sensory overload, only one of POKENAME's eyes is working at any given time. As a result, it's impossible to tell where it's looking.

entry: 它在田野嬉戏，背上的焦烟随之弥漫。消防员常误以为起火，赶来却只见无害的POKENAME，因此对它颇为头疼。
author: teatedtiten
source: The charred smoke on its back permeates the air as it frolics in fields. Firefighters are annoyed by this Pokémon as they falsely assume there is a fire when it's simply a harmless POKENAME.

entry: 野生POKENAME鲜有记录，更从没人见过它们伸出头来。未知图腾在旁嬉戏飞舞，仿佛是POKENAME梦中浮现的景象。
author: bombboyxd
source: Few POKENAME have been observed in the wild, and none with their head out. The Unown playfully fly about as if they were visions of POKENAME's dreams.

entry: 尾巴依然是长寿的象征，可上面的眼睛让它少了几分美感。胸前的符号，也变得越来越多。
author: bombboyxd
source: Its tail is still seen as a sign of longevity, though the eyes have removed much of its appeal. The symbols on its chest have become more numerous.

entry: POKENAME尾上两根眼柄各自转动，本体不动也能扫描动静。激动时，壳变漆黑，淡淡符文开始发光。
author: jaminmcready
source: The twin eye-stalks on POKENAME's tail rotate independently, scanning for motion even when the main body is still. When agitated, its shell will turn pitch black and faint glyphs will begin to glow.

entry: POKENAME很有成为网络梗的潜力，深受网民喜爱。不同于其他未知图腾融合体，它偶尔打破阴森难懂的沉默，清晰、毫无起伏地说一句“兄弟”。
author: banquoviaquo
source: Online fans adore this Pokémon for its memetic potential: unlike other Unown-derived Pokémon, POKENAME will occasionally break its ominous, inscrutable silence to say "bro" in perfect, clear monotone.

entry: POKENAME不会说话，以电脉冲交流。科学家仍在研发解读装置。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is a mute creature that communicates by producing pulses of electricity. Scientists are still developing a device to decipher what it is saying.

entry: POKENAME慢慢漂在空中，常浮在手机信号塔旁。它能截获电波，让另一端听来全成难懂胡话。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME drift through the air slowly, often hovering around cell towers. These Pokémon can intercept radio waves, turning them into unintelligible babbling for anyone on the other end.

entry: POKENAME的许多眼睛滑腻腻地在体表游移，窥看四周。视觉信息太多，让它迟迟决定不了下一步。
author: busilisk
source: Its many eyes slide greasily across its body, and peer in all directions. Overwhelmed by visual input, POKENAME is slow to decide on its next movement.

entry: POKENAME炮里塞着眼球，谁打扰休息，就向谁发射。眼球射出后会瞬间传回身体，科学家能用的研究手段因此很少。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have eyeballs crammed into their cannons that they fire at anyone who disturbs their rest. These eyeballs teleport back into POKENAME's body after being fired, leaving scientists few methods to study them.

entry: 许多POKENAME在驱赶球工厂值夜，确保无人闯入。大眼能在全黑中看清，身体则无声飘行。
author: .izik
source: Many POKENAME are employed in Pester Ball factories for nighttime monitoring, ensuring no trespassers. Each one has a large eye that can see in complete darkness while they float silently through the air.

entry: POKENAME能控制小群未知图腾作仆从，跟随身旁，谁看它们一眼就会睡着。吃受害者梦时，它眼里亮着刺目红光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's abilities allow it to ensnare small groups of Unown as its thralls, which follow it around and cause those who view them to fall asleep with a single glance. Its eyes glow a piercing red as it feasts on the victim's dreams.

entry: POKENAME有罕见的无眼变种，更加凶猛，派未知图腾仆从尽量催眠更多受害者，好无尽吞食美梦，只留下噩梦。
author: sk372
source: Rare eyeless variants of POKENAME exist that behave even more aggressively, sending out their thralls of Unown to send as many victims as possible to sleep so it may gorge endlessly on their sweet dreams, leaving only nightmares behind.

entry: POKENAME成群生活，却很少被看见。科学家发现，它在海滩聚集、摆姿势组成信息，像数百年无人再说的古老语言。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME live in groups but are rarely seen by people. Scientists have observed that they gather on the beach and pose to form some kind of message that looks like very old languages that have not been spoken for centuries.

entry: POKENAME一侧极敏感，因此战斗全力护着深色部位。格斗不强，便用极响的长嚎攻击。
author: lootererswillbeboated
source: One side of POKENAME is very sensitive, so it puts all its power in battle into protecting the darker part. It lacks strong fighting skills, so it ululates extremely loudly to attack.

entry: POKENAME比外表显得更轻、更不结实，一点碰撞也会弹来弹去。虽看得晕，袋里孩子却似乎很享受颠簸。
author: sk372
source: Lighter and less sturdy than it would appear, POKENAME's form bounces around from even light impacts. Though it looks disorienting, the child seems to enjoy being jostled around in the pouch during these moments.

entry: POKENAME通常温顺，在栖居河流独自度日。大船或人类施工若扰乱河流，就发狂，凶暴持续数周，许多个体阻碍了河岸开发。
author: vic1312
source: Usually a docile Pokémon, POKENAME keep to themselves in the rivers they call home. However, if the river is disturbed by large boats or human construction, they will go berserk and remain violent for weeks. Many have impeded riverside development.

entry: POKENAME旅行时胀起身体，不让谁碰壳。壳一被碰，就用强力冰冻光束反击。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME inflate their bodies when traveling, making sure no one can touch their shells. Should their shells be touched, POKENAME will retaliate with a powerful Ice Beam.

entry: POKENAME耐心等对手出招，再变身，将一模一样的招式回敬。不论变成什么生命或物体，漆黑尾巴都始终在。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME waits patiently for the opponent to make a move before transforming and performing that exact move back. Its pitch-black tail will always remain present no matter what being or object it transforms into.

entry: 信息技术人员将POKENAME设为“蜜罐”诱饵，先吸收针对电脑的恶意攻击，再由防火墙拦截、删除威胁。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are set up by information technology professionals to honeypot malicious attacks on PCs. They serve as a decoy that absorbs such attacks before the firewall intercepts and deletes the threat.

entry: 新生POKENAME身体极柔软、有弹性。不过，挨打越多，就越强健、耐打。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: A new POKENAME's body is remarkably soft and squishy. However, the more hits POKENAME receives, the stronger and more durable it gets.

entry: POKENAME每天最多吃900磅食物。圆滚体型加橡胶般皮肤，让它极善于反弹攻击。
author: lycanw_8d
source: POKENAME eat up to 900 pounds of food every day. The resulting rotund figure combined with a rubber-like skin make it excellent at reflecting attacks.

entry: POKENAME十分温顺，宁可逃跑藏好，也不攻击。训练家得耐心赢取信任，它才让摸。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME is very docile, and would rather flee and hide than attack. A Trainer must be patient and earn its trust before it will let them pet it.

entry: POKENAME藏在暗海，用果然翁模样的诱饵引猎物。一咬诱饵，就施以惊人电击，再享用受害者。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME hides in dark ocean waters, using the Wobbuffet lures to entice prey. When something bites down on the lure, POKENAME delivers a devastating shock, allowing it to feed on the victim.

entry: POKENAME胀大头上一个球茎，分散注意。海底天敌追上明亮大目标，刚碰到便被强电击退。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME inflates one of the bulbs on its head as a distraction tactic. Undersea predators go after the large bright target, only to be repelled by a powerful electric shock the moment they make contact.

entry: 对战时，POKENAME能瞥见未来，闪开部分来袭攻击。多这份知识，便能从几乎必败中，勉强争得胜利。
author: quackquackattack
source: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME get glimpses of the future and can dodge some attacks that come their way. This added knowledge gives them an edge that allows them to scrape out a victory from almost certain defeat.

entry: 与天然鸟融合后，果然翁尾巴成为新身体的主人，优雅操纵躯体。POKENAME的影子，总比身体更早出击。
author: hortensia_xxiii
source: In fusing with a Xatu, the tail of Wobbuffet asserts itself as the new master of its body, puppeteering it around with grace. POKENAME's shadow always strikes before its host does.

entry: POKENAME伸缩自如的身体，能挨许多攻击。不知不觉飞入危险宝可梦的领地时，靠这特征保平安。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can take many hits from other Pokémon because of its stretchy body. This feature keeps them safe when they obliviously fly into a dangerous Pokémon's territory.

entry: 野生POKENAME住寒冷、黑暗的水下洞，很难找到。它对外界条件极挑，少离家，常因此把自己饿着。
author: soup1900
source: Wild POKENAME are difficult to find since they make their homes in cold, dark, underwater caves. Due to their extreme pickiness of outside conditions, they rarely leave their homes and often end up starving themselves because of this.

entry: POKENAME尽量躲着人，因为人们常把它认成真正的汉堡，想拿来吃。许多人就因咬了一嘴毒膜，最后进了医院。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME tries to keep itself hidden from people since they often mistake it for a real burger and try to eat it. Many people have ended up in the hospital due to getting a mouthful of its poisonous film.

entry: POKENAME行动有限，蓝色身体只会发出叫声。因此它用精神能力，将弱小宝可梦引向毒花苞。
author: big_clanker
source: POKENAME has limited movement capabilities, as its blue body can only produce its cry. Because of this, it uses psychic abilities to lure weak Pokémon toward its poisonous bud.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴挑衅，还通过尾巴说话，惹恼敌人。对手一上当、决定攻击，它回击起来就几乎毫不留情。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME uses its tail as a tool to provoke and speaks through it to annoy foes. Once an opponent has made the error of falling for the bait and has decided to strike, POKENAME shows little to no mercy with the blows it deals.

entry: POKENAME尾上副头很大，看着仿佛倒走。对战需要承受大量伤害时，会转过身，用后半身接下攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME appear as though they are walking backwards because of the large auxiliary head on their tail. When they need to absorb lots of damage during a Pokémon battle, they flip to their rear end to soak up the attacks.

entry: POKENAME贴在暗洞天花板，融入阴影。光一照，就掉下来引爆自身，将身体当成最后防御。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sticks to dark cave ceilings, camouflaging itself in the shadows. If a light is shined on it, it will drop and self-destruct, using its body as a last-ditch defense.

entry: POKENAME在住处洞壁挖掘，寻找黑暗庇护。它躲光，偏爱阴影巢穴的独处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows through the walls of its cave home, seeking shelter in the darkness. It hides from light sources, preferring the solitude of its shadowy lair.

entry: POKENAME准备挨打时若真被打中，就先散蜂蜜香，再使出强力双倍奉还。这使它在战斗中既可怕，又出奇芳香。
author: .izik
source: Should POKENAME be hit while prepared to be struck, it will let loose a honey-like scent before unleashing a powerful Counter. This ability makes it a fearsome and surprisingly fragrant opponent in combat.

entry: POKENAME黑色橡胶壳异常柔软，受力压缩，很快又弹回原形。战斗时将壳朝攻击者，用强力双倍奉还反击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's rubbery black shell is unusually soft, compressing under force before rapidly rebounding back into shape. They turn their shells toward aggressors during battle, using their shells to attack with powerful Counters.

entry: POKENAME大型重甲护身，弱点却是柔软的漆黑羽毛。因此只在地面攻击，先让敌人被锋利金属割伤、渐渐疲惫，最后再用爪解决。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is a large, heavily armored Pokémon whose weakness is its soft, pitch-black feathers. Due to this, it only attacks on the ground, letting enemies get worn down and cut against its sharp metal before finishing them off with its talons.

entry: 电脑上看到POKENAME，只点蓝色部位，互动便相对无害。点黑色部位，会让它乱挥身体，使周围出错报复。
author: sk372
source: If spotted on a computer, POKENAME is relatively harmless if interacted with, as long as one only clicks on the blue parts of its body. Clicking on the black parts will cause it to flail about and glitch its surroundings in retaliation.

entry: POKENAME有爱心，总愿友善拍拍、抱抱情绪低落者。可谁想碰携带的黑蛋，它都会立即粗暴拍打。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is compassionate and always willing to lend a friendly pat or hug to those feeling down. It will, however, immediately and roughly smack anyone that attempts to touch the black egg it carries with it.

entry: POKENAME通常不争斗，最初挨几下甚至不回应。可尾巴一砸地，就说明已被惹怒，该准备逃开复仇怒火。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is typically non-confrontational and won't even respond to the first few blows struck against it. If it bashes its tail against the ground, however, one has succeeded in angering it and should be ready to flee from its burning vengeance.

entry: POKENAME对战中能承受许多打击。一有机会，就用闪电般快的尾巴反攻。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can absorb a lot of hits over the course of a Pokémon battle. When they are given the opportunity, they launch a counterattack with their lightning-fast tail.

entry: POKENAME身体橡胶般有弹性。被打后，会在周围随机乱弹，有时反而撞回攻击自己的家伙。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The body of POKENAME is exceptionally rubbery. When struck they bounce randomly and chaotically around their environment, sometimes even striking back into whatever hit them.

entry: POKENAME尽量不久战，主要用尾上黑突起攻击。可击中其他生命，似乎自己也会疼。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tries not to stay in combat for very long. Its main method of attacking is using the black protrusions on its tail, but striking against another seems to cause POKENAME pain as well.

entry: POKENAME身体柔软如橡胶，能弹开大多数物理攻击。可它仍怕受伤，战前会用石头做铠甲。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: A POKENAME's body is soft and rubbery enough to repel most forms of physical attacks. Despite this, POKENAME still worry about getting hurt, so they construct armor made of rocks before battles.

entry: POKENAME坚定守卫领地，站在大灌木旁，把敏感尾巴安全藏进去。更耐打的身体承受攻击，再适时反击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME defends its territory staunchly, standing firm near large bushes. This preferred position allows it to hide its sensitive tail in the bush for safety, letting its more resilient body take any blows and retaliate accordingly.

entry: POKENAME尾部叶片上的许多眼睛，望向四面八方，时刻警惕威胁。对手若威胁本体，所有叶片便会竖起，身体立即反击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The many eyes along the leaves of a POKENAME's tail watch in all directions, constantly on guard for threats. If an opponent threatens the main body, the leaves all bristle as the body counterattacks on a moment's notice.

entry: POKENAME的帽子对周围情绪极敏感。负面情绪太多，就本能释放精神脉冲，将带来感觉的生命推远。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cap is extremely sensitive to the emotions of others nearby. If too many negative emotions are sensed, it instinctively reacts with a psychic pulse to push those providing the sensations away.

entry: 石中形成的灵体庞大吵闹，引来注意。石头才是POKENAME本体，召出的灵体用来分散注意，避免本体直接受伤。
author: sk372
source: The spirit forming from the stone is large and loud, drawing the attention of others. This is because the stone is POKENAME's true body, and the spirit is a conjuration meant to distract and keep it from being harmed directly.

entry: POKENAME用第二张嘴挡攻击，再施出镜面反射，将能量原路送回。打法难测，是强劲对手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its second mouth to block attacks before unleashing a Mirror Coat to send the energy right back. This tactic makes it an unpredictable and formidable opponent in battle.

entry: POKENAME成群游海，靠同伴保护敏感黑尾。受到威胁，能用空气或水胀起身体，再突然猛烈排出。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME swim through the ocean as part of a group, relying on their allies to protect their sensitive black tail from attack. If threatened, POKENAME can inflate their body with air or water, then suddenly release it with great force.

entry: 洞居教团曾点蜡烛敬奉POKENAME。可它极讨厌光，会逃走，仪式最终也停止了。
author: .izik
source: Cave-dwelling cults lit candles in worship of POKENAME. This practice eventually ceased, as the species strongly dislikes light and would flee.

entry: POKENAME喜欢玩击剑游戏，但黑色尾巴若受伤，就会停下来。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME enjoys playful swordplay, but if its black tail gets injured, it will stop playing.

entry: POKENAME像根球棒，十分耐打；但若手臂受伤，就会狠狠还击。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is a bat that can take a beating, and if its arm is hurt, give a beating.

entry: POKENAME身体极有弹性，挨打便把攻击弹回。受撞后的短暂一刻，还会释放舒缓气息，让附近生命平静。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is extremely elastic, capable of bouncing attacks back at the aggressor when struck. During the brief moment after impact, it releases a soothing aura that calms those nearby.

entry: POKENAME身体能承受巨大动能。两只对战能打数日，彼此弹回的力越来越大，每一击也越来越强。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME bodies can withstand a tremendous amount of kinetic energy. A battle between two POKENAME can last days, with each blow getting progressively more powerful as they rebound off of one another with greater and greater force.

entry: POKENAME爱随音乐节拍跳跃。训练家或宝可梦大型聚会时，地面摇晃常是它造成。
author: spagalapof
source: POKENAME love to jump in time to music. They are often the cause of the ground shaking during large gatherings of Trainers or Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME将挨敌人攻击吸收的动能，存进腿里。受伤越多，就能跳得越远，逃到安全处。
author: sk372
source: Kinetic energy absorbed from receiving enemy attacks gets stored in POKENAME's legs. The more damage it takes, the farther it can leap away to safety.

entry: 除了黑色尾巴，POKENAME的整个身体都是投影。凡是被它截获的电磁信号，都会受到严重干扰。
author: staghorn
source: A POKENAME's body is entirely a projection save for its black tail. It causes any electromagnetic signals it intercepts to become heavily corrupted.

entry: POKENAME几乎全由水构成，因此能轻易将攻击转回对手。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME is comprised almost entirely of water. This allows them to relocate attacks back towards the opponent with ease.

entry: POKENAME通过尾巴唱出带精神力量的歌声，用来移动。受袭，体内空气从尾巴排出，歌便更响。响亮歌声能使听者混乱数小时。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It travels by emitting a psychic song through its tail. When attacked, the air in its body travels out from its tail, making its song louder. A loud POKENAME song causes confusion for hours.

entry: POKENAME通常满足于山里自唱，随节奏前后摇摆。若被宝可梦攻击打断，就凶猛使出双倍奉还。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are typically content to sing to themselves in the mountains, swaying back and forth in time to the rhythm of their songs. They strike back with a ferocious Counter if they find themselves interrupted by a Pokémon's attack.

entry: POKENAME受威胁，会抬翅展示下方眼纹。若吓不退攻击者，便吹出带精神能量的风，将对手推到100英尺之外。
author: mistymagius
source: When threatened, POKENAME will raise its wings, showing the eye pattern beneath them. If this does not frighten its attacker, it will blow a gust of wind charged with psychic energy, pushing its opponent over 100 feet away.

entry: POKENAME睡时被太阳照到，就飞进洞深处。阳光刺激皮肤，不舒服得只好退回阴影。
author: .izik
source: Should sunlight hit POKENAME while it sleeps, it will fly deep into its cave. The sunlight irritates its skin, making it uncomfortable and forcing it to retreat into the shadows.

entry: POKENAME躲在巨大蓝宝石后，等能量攻击打来。一中，就以数倍威力冲击波回敬，因此很危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides behind its large blue gem, waiting to be struck by an energy-based attack. Once hit, it sends a shockwave back with multiplied power, making it a dangerous foe.

entry: POKENAME极讨厌头上的叶被碰。伸来触碰的东西，会被长臂拍开，或被臭花粉喷中；随后它便跑走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME absolutely detests having the leaves on its head touched. Anything that reaches to touch them will be batted away with its long arms, or hit with a cloud of stinky pollen before it runs off.

entry: 黑色团块似乎才是POKENAME本体，中空蓝头只是退化残迹。不过，用任何方式点破，不论行动、语言或手势，黑身体就缩小，藏回头内。
author: bobosmith01
source: The black mass appears to be POKENAME's true body, and the hollow blue head merely vestigial. However, if this is pointed out somehow - physically, verbally, or gesturally - the black body will shrink and hide inside its head.

entry: POKENAME装树，尾随沼泽猎物。追敌时尖叫，还用踩影特性防逃，确保对方挣不脱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stalks prey in marshes by pretending to be a tree. It chases after foes screeching and using its Shadow Tag ability to prevent escape, ensuring they cannot flee from its grasp.

entry: POKENAME藏在洞最深处。有谁靠近，就放黑粉，麻痹敌人，留出足够逃跑时间。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides in the deepest portions of caves. When approached, it releases a puff of black powder that paralyzes foes long enough for it to escape.

entry: POKENAME抬翅尖叫，模仿音波龙，吓得目标僵住、无法逃脱。任何反抗攻击，都会被弹回攻击者。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME raise their wings and screech to mimic Noivern, stunning their targets in fear and leaving them unable to escape. Any attempts to fight back will be reflected back at the attacker.

entry: POKENAME橡胶般的花瓣能储动能。它爱刻意让花挨打，积够能量后，强力花粉便如火箭般喷出。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's petals are rubbery and store kinetic energy. They love to put themselves into situations where they are likely to take blows to their flower, sending powerful puffs of pollen rocketing outward after storing enough energy.

entry: POKENAME攻击远比外表强，通常只挨打后才还手。其力量已被证实，足以一击夷平摩天楼。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's strikes are deceptively powerful, but it will typically only attack if it is hit first. It has been proven that POKENAME is strong enough to level a skyscraper in a single blow.

entry: POKENAME常刻意让自己挨打，甚至找危险宝可梦。蘑菇挨打就放孢子，让研究者推测，或许是蘑菇促它趋向危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME regularly put themselves in positions where they are likely to be physically struck, often seeking out dangerous Pokémon. Their mushrooms release spores when struck, leading researchers to theorise that the mushrooms push them toward danger.

entry: POKENAME胶状的上半身，常被与牛奶混合，做成浓滑蓝酸奶。居民食用后，声称自觉耐力、勇气更足。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: Due to its gelatinous consistency, it is common practice to mix the top half of POKENAME with milk, resulting in a creamy blue yogurt. On consumption, residents claim newfound feelings of endurance and bravery.

entry: POKENAME臂鳞上的眼只是眼斑，用来骗敌人。尾上的眼却是真的，还能透过薄岩壁看其他宝可梦。
author: reflecbeat
source: The eyes marking the scales on a POKENAME's arms are just eyespots, used as an illusion to trick its foes. The eyes on its tail, however, are real, and they can see other Pokémon through thin rock walls.

entry: POKENAME藏在浓蒸汽里，一眨不眨，勉强咧嘴笑着承受重击。动能存在火山般的壳，再以滚烫热浪反击。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME endures heavy blows with a forced, unblinking grin while hidden inside dense steam clouds. It stores the kinetic energy inside its volcanic shell before returning a scalding wave of thermal retaliation.

entry: POKENAME爱藏暗洞，避开视线。要找它，可循空气里萦绕不散、幽影般的南瓜味。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers to stay hidden in dark caves, where it can avoid being seen. One can find it by the pumpkin scent it gives off, which lingers in the air like a haunting presence.

entry: POKENAME白天不得不出洞，就用兜帽状皮肤遮阳。照久虽未出现烧伤，心情却在日光下不断变差。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides from sunlight by using its hood-like skin when it has to leave its cave during the day. While no physical burns appear from prolonged exposure, its mood steadily decreases in the sunlight.

entry: POKENAME住远离阳光的地下湖，吃苔藓维生，始终潜水藏好，不让窥视。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its home in underground lakes, far from the sunlight. It survives by eating moss, staying submerged and hidden away from prying eyes.

entry: POKENAME尾巴藏地下，蓝身体在外巡视天敌。鼻子极敏感，一受攻击就让它很恼火。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's tail remains hidden underground while its blue body scans its surroundings for predators. Its nose is highly sensitive, quickly aggravating the Pokémon if attacked.

entry: 两只POKENAME碰面会打架，可攻击弱、踩影又困住彼此，对战永不结束。最终它们相爱成家，永恒决斗却仍继续。
author: epping_forest
source: If two POKENAME meet, they'll try to fight, but because of their weak attacks and their Shadow Tag ability trapping each other, the battle will never end. Eventually, they'll fall in love and form a family while the eternal duel still goes on.

entry: POKENAME战中很会盯住对手，让对方几乎逃不掉。可它只站到对手面前等出招，训练家用起来也很棘手。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are adept at keeping track of their opponents during battle, making escape nearly impossible. Their habit of simply getting in front of an opponent and waiting for their move makes them challenging to use, however.

entry: POKENAME战中很会盯住对手，让对方几乎逃不掉。可它只站到对手面前等出招，训练家用起来也很棘手。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are adept at keeping track of their opponents during battle, making escape nearly impossible. Their habit of simply getting in front of an opponent and waiting for their move makes them challenging to use, however.

entry: POKENAME战中很会盯住对手，让对方几乎逃不掉。可它只站到对手面前等出招，训练家用起来也很棘手。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are adept at keeping track of their opponents during battle, making escape nearly impossible. Their habit of simply getting in front of an opponent and waiting for their move makes them challenging to use, however.

entry: POKENAME战中很会盯住对手，让对方几乎逃不掉。可它只站到对手面前等出招，训练家用起来也很棘手。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are adept at keeping track of their opponents during battle, making escape nearly impossible. Their habit of simply getting in front of an opponent and waiting for their move makes them challenging to use, however.

entry: POKENAME身体结实、肌肉密实，平时温顺。可一挨打，宝石便亮起鲜红光，预示反击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME bodies are tough and densely packed with muscles. They are normally docile, but when struck, their gem flashes a bright red right, pre-empting their retaliatory strikes.

entry: POKENAME积压多年怒气，比多数宝可梦更愤怒。一受挑衅，就凶狠反击，将怒气全数爆发。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME bottle up years upon years worth of anger, leaving them angrier than most Pokémon. If provoked, this Pokémon will retaliate viciously, letting out all of its rage in one burst.

entry: POKENAME鼻子敏锐，能嗅出周围情绪变化。一闻攻击性，就绷紧身体，准备回敬将至的打击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's nose is sensitive enough to pick up emotional changes in those around it. When they smell aggression, they tense their body, preparing to launch a counter-attack against the incoming strike.

entry: POKENAME挨打时，螺旋发光，承受越多，就越明亮。它能突然释放能量，化成强力镜面反射，将攻击者轰走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's spiral glows whenever they're struck, growing brighter and brighter as they absorb more blows. They can unleash the energy abruptly as a powerful Mirror Coat, blasting away their aggressor.

entry: POKENAME用岩石身体撞穿石块，寻找洞内深处藏身。它怕光，一受打扰，就退向黑暗。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slams its rocky body through stones to find a deep portion of a cave to hide in. It is afraid of the light, and will always retreat to the darkness when disturbed.

entry: POKENAME躺在地下水道岸边不动，只有尾巴始终活动，眼睛四处查威胁。被攻击后，约一分钟才发出可怕反击。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME lies unmoving along the shores of underground waterways, except its tail remains in constant motion, its eyes darting around for threats. If attacked, POKENAME will unleash a devastating counterattack around a minute later.

entry: POKENAME两个头少有共识，一个极好斗，一个很被动。合作时，却能强力出击，以猛烈反击应对威胁。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a pair of heads that rarely agree with each other. One head is hyper-aggressive while the other is quite passive. When they work together, they can launch powerful attacks and manage threats with powerful counters.

entry: POKENAME各头不停吵。争得太凶，弹簧般的脖子就缠住，只好停下，先解开彼此。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The heads of POKENAME are constantly fighting with each other. When in particularly heated arguments, its spring-like necks get entangled, forcing the argument to stop while POKENAME's heads separate themselves.

entry: POKENAME尾巴被打，三个头就猛弹而出，一击能打倒重量级拳手。拳馆常雇它作陪练，直到强得不再安全。
author: staghorn
source: When a POKENAME's tail is struck, its three heads shoot out with enough force to KO a heavyweight boxer in a single blow. POKENAME are often employed by boxing gyms until they become too strong to serve as safe training partners.

entry: POKENAME不断滴下无味污泥，形成怪雾，让靠近宝可梦逃走，仿佛被无形力推开。科学家收集黏液，用于除虫喷雾。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The odorless sludge constantly dripping from POKENAME creates an odd mist that causes approaching Pokémon to flee as if pushed away by an invisible force. Scientists have collected this slime for use in Repels.

entry: POKENAME始终温柔友善，遇险也一样。它能让飞射物穿过身体自卫，却更愿保持实体，保护朋友。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are always gentle and amicable, even in the face of danger. They can phase through projectiles to protect themselves but prefer to remain corporeal to protect their friends.

entry: POKENAME藏阴影，遮住黑尾，只在夜里外出。它很少先动手，可若被打，便慢慢吸取生命力反击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME hides in the shadows to conceal its black tail, only going outside at night. It rarely strikes first, but if it is attacked, it will retaliate by slowly draining life force.

entry: POKENAME背上球茎低声索要阳光和水，指挥身体，保双方健康。身体睡时，球茎警戒，向靠太近的威胁喷毒。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The bulb on a POKENAME's back whispers demands of sunlight and water to the body, giving it instructions to ensure both of their health. While the body sleeps, the bulb keeps watch, spraying poison at any threats that come too close.

entry: 它食草，住在离大水域不远不近处：够远，能避开捕鱼的飞行属性宝可梦；又够近，周围植物强健丰盛。危急时，尾巴能咬敌人。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its a herbivorous Pokémon that lives within moderate distance from larger bodies of water: far enough to keep away from fishing Flying-type Pokémon, but close enough that the nearby flora are strong and bountiful. In a pinch, its tail can bite foes.

entry: POKENAME其中一颗蛋腐坏、开裂，其他蛋却依旧爱护、支持它。
author: kiwiarms
source: One of the eggs that makes up POKENAME is rotten and cracked. The others love and support it regardless.

entry: POKENAME用骨头细心引导精神能量，造出敌人最深愿望的幻象，给自己时间逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its bone to carefully channel psychic energy. It can create illusions of a foe's deepest desire, allowing it time to escape.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉强，能发现附近的宝可梦，甚至察知最近有没有宝可梦来过。可惜它移动缓慢，没法充分用好这项本领。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has a powerful sense of smell, which allows it to detect other Pokémon nearby, or even if any were in the area recently. Unfortunately, it cannot make great use of this ability as it doesn't move very quickly.

entry: 小头里有个产生有害烟气的器官，POKENAME借此驱敌。大头此时得屏住呼吸，因为它和敌人一样，也受不了那气味。
author: kiwiarms
source: The smaller head contains an organ which produces noxious fumes which POKENAME uses to fend off foes. The larger head has to hold its breath while doing so, as it can't stand the smell any more than its foes can.

entry: POKENAME的藤蔓不断生长，最终遮住眼睛。它便改靠尾巴观察周围。
author: jackskipper
source: POKENAME's vines grow constantly, eventually covering its eyes. It relies on its tail to see.

entry: POKENAME拍翅释放精神能量，唤起鲜明记忆，用昔日恐惧压倒敌人。
author: .izik
source: While flapping its wings, POKENAME releases psychic energy capable of inducing vivid memories. It uses this to overwhelm enemies with past fears.

entry: POKENAME镰上尖刺锋利得可怕，却主要用来把草切成小条吃。不过最好远离镰刀，因为会突然自行移动、攻击。
author: soup1900
source: Despite POKENAME having scarily sharp spikes on its scythes, it mainly uses them to cut grass into small strands to eat. However, it's still recommended to stay away from the scythes since they can suddenly move and strike on their own.

entry: 雷雨时，POKENAME举角朝天，热切等着雷击。吸来的电力，会增强精神能力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME raises its antlers skyward during thunderstorms, eagerly awaiting a lightning strike. The electricity absorbed amplifies its psychic abilities.

entry: POKENAME吞食枝条与植物前，会先用火焰吐息点燃，增添风味。即使POKENAME睡着，尾上的头也能喷火自卫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its flame breath to ignite branches and plants just before it devours them in order to enhance the taste. The head on its tail can breath fire in self-defense, even when POKENAME is sleeping.

entry: POKENAME的各个头共享意识。战斗时轮流上阵，而且每个头都随时做好了准备。
author: dodoowner_
source: A POKENAME's consciousness is shared between each head. They all take turns fighting in a battle, and they're all equally ready to fight.

entry: 牧场主在大草场饲养POKENAME。多汁嫩肉被切成牛肉般的各种部位，烤好后供餐馆售卖。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is raised by ranchers in large fields of grass. Its juicy, tender meat is made into various cuts that resemble beef, where it is grilled and served at restaurants.

entry: 它用尾巴捕小型水生宝可梦、捞水草，尾巴只要察觉动静，就会扑咬。细胞结构与水分子极相似，能有效融入水中，隐去身影。
author: infinex21
source: It fishes for small aquatic Pokémon and underwater plants using its tails, which will react to movement by lunging and biting. Its cell structure is so similar to water molecules that it can effectively meld into water and become invisible within it.

entry: POKENAME吃网上散布的恐怖故事，能将故事投进天敌脑里，让对方短暂失神。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME feeds on frightening stories scattered across the internet. It can project these tales into a predator's mind, trapping them in a brief trance.

entry: POKENAME壳与下方身体各有心智，合力行动。浅海奔行时，壳用精神力量阻止来者踩上去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's shell and the body beneath it both have their own separate minds, working in tandem. The shell uses psychic powers to keep anything from stepping on it as it scuttles around the ocean shallows.

entry: POKENAME尾巴极凶，嘴里装得下的都想攻击。两对翅膀同时使用，便能原地悬停。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME's tail is highly aggressive, attempting to attack anything they can fit in their jaws. By using both sets of their wings at the same time, they have the ability to hover in place.

entry: POKENAME不断寻找美味，喂给尾巴。比起咸食，极偏爱甜点，总挑能找到的最甜食物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is constantly searching for delicious food to feed its tail. It strongly prefers confections over savory dishes, always seeking out the sweetest options available.

entry: POKENAME吃草，植物吃不够，鲜绿色便会褪去。尾巴有自己的意识，偶尔连自己的花瓣也啃。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is a herbivore, and its vivid green coloration will fade if it doesn't eat enough plants. Its tail has a mind of its own and will occasionally nibble at POKENAME's own flower petals.

entry: POKENAME动作凶恶，仿佛正被极度痛苦、怒火折磨。嘴、尾和背刺都能发出强烈、破坏力极强的精神光束。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME acts in a vicious way that suggests it is wracked with extreme levels of pain and rage. It can fire intense and devastating beams of psychic energy from its mouth, tail or the spines on its back.

entry: POKENAME休息时，将尾巴留在洞外警戒。即使本体睡着，第二个头仍醒着，巡视天敌。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rests with its tail outside its den, always alert. Its second head remains awake, scanning for potential predators even while it sleeps.

entry: POKENAME高傲，会用精神力量制住正吃它最爱果子的家伙，抢来自己吃。上树睡时，尾巴仍警戒，见威胁就放精神能量，或直接咬。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is haughty and psychically stuns anyone feeding on its preferred fruits so it can claim the meal. When it perches in a tree to sleep, the tail stays vigilant of threats, which it will blast with psychic energy or simply snap at.

entry: POKENAME叫声发出精神波，影响目标感知，让对方看见重影。它借混乱，更轻易俯冲捕猎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cry emits psychic waves that affect the target's perception, causing them to see double. POKENAME uses the confusion this creates to more easily swoop in and catch its prey.

entry: 使出羽毛舞时，POKENAME释放精神能量，提升优雅姿态。迷人表演让观众误见流畅、却不可能做到的动作。
author: .izik
source: During its Feather Dance, POKENAME releases psychic energy to enhance its grace. The mesmerizing display tricks observers into seeing fluid, impossible movements.

entry: 它游得慢，触角上的嘴却大幅延伸触及范围。虽然能电击，一边为正、一边为负，必须同时咬同一目标，才能形成回路。
author: .jerden
source: Although it is a slow swimmer, the mouths on its antennae significantly increase its reach. While they can deliver an electric shock, one is positive, and the other is negative, so both must bite the same target to complete the circuit.

entry: 金色身体水下明亮闪耀，吸引猎物，再让触角末端的嘴出击，送出强大电击。
author: .jerden
source: Its golden body shines brightly while it swims underwater. It uses this to lure in prey so that the mouth at the end of its antenna can strike, delivering a powerful electric shock.

entry: POKENAME前头视力强，后头略能预知。两者配合，几乎无法悄悄接近，稍有危险迹象就飞走。
author: sk372
source: The front head has powerful eyesight, and the rear has mild precognitive capabilities. Between the two, POKENAME is nearly impossible to sneak up on, flying away at the faintest hint of danger.

entry: POKENAME尾上的头引导电能，使敌人无法行动。突如其来的电击，让对方僵住、无力防备。
author: .izik
source: The head on POKENAME's tail channels electrical energy which is used to incapacitate foes. Its shocking surprise attack leaves enemies stunned and vulnerable.

entry: POKENAME想照亮周围，或安静地与同类交流，就遵循特殊步骤：先眨眼，六秒后，尾巴才发出明亮光芒。
author: bobosmith01
source: To brighten its surroundings or quietly communicate with its kind, POKENAME follows a distinct process. First, POKENAME blinks. Six seconds later, brilliant light emits from its tail.

entry: POKENAME引导精神力量，头上的花就迅速旋转，常在溶解液攻击前，先让敌人着迷。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME channels its psychic powers, the flowers on its head spin rapidly. This display often mesmerizes foes before an Acid attack.

entry: POKENAME爱恶作剧，先不动，等什么经过，就用手上的嘴咬，再赶紧恢复静止，假装没对愤怒受害者做什么。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a mischievous streak, staying motionless until something passes by and then biting them with the mouths on either hand. It then quickly goes back to being still, pretending it did nothing to the irate bite victim.

entry: POKENAME身上两个头不断争该往哪走，各自想用潜在念力拖另一个。中间身体却很开心，什么冒险都乐意跟。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The two heads atop a POKENAME's body constantly debate which way they should go, each head trying to tug the other along with latent psychic powers. Meanwhile, the central body is just happy to go along on any adventure.

entry: POKENAME操纵尾上的头，精确得惊人，却很少动用双臂。因此，有研究者猜测，尾巴上的才是真正的主头。
author: slaphappygrandpappy
source: POKENAME controls the head on its tail with surprising precision, but uses its arms sparingly. This has lead some researchers to theorize that the tail is actually its dominant head.

entry: 这种融合体开朗好奇，爱跟旅人到处走，热切找新朋友。有谁停下陪玩，就高兴极了。
author: curazy
source: This cheerful, curious fusion loves following travelers around. It eagerly seeks new friends and becomes delighted whenever someone stops to play with it.

entry: 这种融合体开朗，爱晒太阳、大群聚集。喜欢人群，常贴着友好来者，开心享受温暖与关注。
author: curazy
source: This fusion is a cheerful Pokémon that loves basking in sunlight and gathering in large groups. It enjoys being around people and often stays close to friendly crowds, happily soaking up warmth and attention.

entry: POKENAME爱玩泥，因为泥滋养体表黏膜。副头流着这种黏液，似乎被它弄得无力行动。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME loves playing in the mud, as the mud nourishes the mucus membrane that coats its body. Its secondary head drools with this membrane, seemingly incapacitated by the mucus.

entry: POKENAME前面的头正常吃饭，后面的头却得供应泥巴。嚼着混入唾液，制成保护糊，再涂遍身体。
author: whatagooddaytodie
