source: POKENAME's front head consumes food as normal, but its back head needs to be supplied with mud. It chews this, mixing with its saliva to turn into a protective paste it then smears across its body.

entry: 尾上的“脸”被认为只是吓退天敌的花纹。可这解释不了，为什么有时还会眨眼。
author: kiwiarms
source: The 'face' on its tail is thought to be a pattern to ward off predators. This does not explain why it sometimes blinks.

entry: 大舌贝咬上后，尾巴比头聪明得多，两者换了角色。对新安排，却谁也不太适应。
author: kiwiarms
source: Upon being bitten by a Shellder, the tail became significantly smarter than the head, and they swapped roles. Neither is quite comfortable with the new arrangement.

entry: POKENAME尾巴有弹性，让后头够到很远，能从意料之外的角度咬敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tail is elastic, giving its rear head impressive reach. It uses this flexibility to bite at enemies from unexpected angles.

entry: 对战时，POKENAME转过结实后半身，吸收攻击。准备好反击，再朝正面转回，释放密集精神能量。
author: quackquackattack
source: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME turn their sturdy backside towards their opponent to absorb attacks. Once they are ready to counter attack, they flip to their front and unleash a barrage of psychic energy.

entry: POKENAME触角发出念力，将自己固定树枝，高处打盹也不会掉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's antennae emit a telekinetic force that secures it to branches. This prevents it from falling while it naps in high places.

entry: POKENAME的身体，总会或多或少地盘成螺旋。前面的头相当温顺，尾部的头却容易受惊，谁靠得太近，它就会试着用角刺过去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME always keeps its body coiled up in a spiral to some extent. It's front head is fairly docile, but the tail's head is skittish and will attempt to jab its horn into those who get too close.

entry: POKENAME受威胁时，会用尾上的头作诱饵。这颗头可以脱落，落下后还会猛烈扭动，几天内便会再生出新头。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The head on the tail of POKENAME is used as a decoy when threatened. This head can be dropped, upon which it will thrash around. A new head will be regrown in a matter of days.

entry: POKENAME借天生可爱的模样，装得小巧又无助，等猎物靠近才出击。体内的毒液，足以让一个小孩麻痹。
author: rakunk
source: Using its naturally adorable appearance, POKENAME pretends to be small and defenseless - luring prey closer before striking. It has enough poison to paralyze a small child.

entry: POKENAME飞在空中，用念力把绿毛虫等猎物压在地上，再反复砸向附近树木，全程无需降落。
author: .izik
source: While airborne, POKENAME uses telekinesis to pin prey like Caterpie to the ground. It then slams them repeatedly into nearby trees without landing by use of its powers.

entry: POKENAME钳状双手似乎各有意识，战斗外也常朝旁边来者夹咬。
author: atlas3339098
source: POKENAME's clawed hands seem to have minds of their own. They'll often snap at anyone nearby, even outside of battle.

entry: POKENAME尾巴代表调皮，其余身体则代表好奇。尾巴常趁本体没注意，偷走它好奇的东西。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME's tail represents its mischievous side, while the rest embodies curiosity. The tail will often steal whatever POKENAME is curious about without it even noticing.

entry: POKENAME用念力举起树上的粉球果，再用控火能力烤焦，放进头状壳的嘴吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses telekinesis to lift Pink Apricorns from trees, burning them with pyrokinesis. Once charred, it deposits them into the mouth of its head-like shell to eat.

entry: 古时，POKENAME羽毛被织进仪式头饰，被认为能帮佩戴者释放积压的悲痛。
author: .izik
source: In ancient times, POKENAME's feathers were woven into ceremonial headdresses. These were believed to help wearers release deep-seated grief.

entry: POKENAME分开的身体各有用途：暗色的擅长远距射击，黄色的则发射更快。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's separate bodies are modified for different purposes. The dark one specializes in long distance, while the yellow can fire at a much faster rate.

entry: POKENAME本是杂食，通常却由后头作主，决定吃什么。少数个体两颗头势均力敌，才会荤素兼食。
author: krune
source: Although technically an omnivore, POKENAME's rear head is usually dominant and decides the diet. On rare occasions, the heads are equally dominant, leading to a mixed diet of meat and plants.

entry: POKENAME温柔，喜欢用鼻子帮忙，搬小物、清理较轻的杂物，开心跟着群体走，尽量派上用场。
author: curazy
source: POKENAME is a gentle Pokémon that enjoys using its trunk to help others. It carries small objects, clears light debris, and happily follows groups while trying to be useful wherever possible.

entry: POKENAME住电脑时若感到威胁，就用微弱精神力量，让用户看见怪异幻景。趁对方分心，沿网络逃往另一台电脑。
author: chibitales
source: If POKENAME feels threatened while residing within a computer, it uses its minor psychic power to cause odd visions in those using the device. While the user is distracted, it escapes to a different computer via the internet.

entry: 特殊神经系统让头不论转多快，都不头晕，尾巴却没这本领。
author: kiwiarms
source: Its specialized nervous system prevents the head from getting dizzy, no matter how quickly it spins. The same does not apply to the tail, however.

entry: 据说它跑得像闪电，双脑轻松管理高速动作，碰上障碍也能立即反应。
author: kiwiarms
source: It is said to run at the speed of lightning, using its two brains to effortlessly manage high speed movement and react to obstacles in an instant.

entry: 发怒，头尾就一起战。尾端倒刺只需一扎，就能从内熔化敌人。
author: kiwiarms
source: When angered, both the head and tail fight in unison. A single prick from its tail's barbed tip can melt a foe from the inside.

entry: POKENAME尾巴随水质反应，知道什么水能喝。左尾爱冷水，右尾爱温水。
author: kiwiarms
source: POKENAME's tails react to water quality, allowing it to know what's safe to drink. The left prefers cold water, and the right prefers warm.

entry: POKENAME体表积攒静电，制住靠近的天敌。对方一僵，就接连发出念力冲击，赶走威胁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME builds static along its body to immobilize approaching predators. Once they are stunned, it unleashes a rapid series of telekinetic blasts to drive them off.

entry: POKENAME乐呵呵，爱装小丑逗笑。谁难过，就表演傻把戏、滑稽姿势，全群都笑时，自己最开心。
author: curazy
source: POKENAME is a jolly fusion that loves making others laugh by acting like a clown. It performs silly tricks and funny poses whenever someone seems sad, becoming happiest when the whole group is laughing.

entry: 进化后，POKENAME更加依赖多出的头，几乎不再用上半身做任何事。
author: slaphappygrandpappy
source: After evolving, POKENAME relies even more on its additional heads. It hardly uses its upper body for anything.

entry: POKENAME本体较温顺，尾上的头却记仇。即使本体想逃、不想打，它也会自行从嘴里扔黑魔法，挑起战斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME itself is rather docile, but the head on its tail is rather vindictive. Even if POKENAME would rather flee than fight, the head will hurl dark magic from its mouth and instigate battles on its own.

entry: POKENAME身上棕头研究栖地野生宝可梦，睡时将学到的编码进本体大脑，帮助模仿技巧，也提高生存机会。
author: bobosmith01
source: The brown head atop POKENAME's body will study the wild Pokémon in its habitat and encode what it has learned into POKENAME's brain while they sleep. This is done to help flourish both POKENAME's mimicry skills and its chances of survival.

entry: POKENAME大多高级脑功能，都在尾巴上的头进行。主头脑壳较小，便能长更厚甲片，增强冲锋。
author: wiz0z
source: Most of POKENAME's higher brain functions take place inside the head on their tail. The smaller braincase in their primary head allows for thicker plates that enhance the strength of their charging attacks.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛已完全消失，改用手中的球观察四周。将球在双手间抛来抛去，就能看清全貌。
author: jackskipper
source: POKENAME's eyes have completely disappeared. It instead uses its ball to look around, tossing it from hand to hand to get a full visual.

entry: POKENAME栖居于邪恶、纯洁平衡的文明，极善决断。天性中立，不受偏见影响。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME inhabit civilizations where evil and purity are equally balanced. They are superb at making decisions, as their natural neutrality causes them not to be affected by bias.

entry: POKENAME常与自己尾巴打着玩，取乐也锻炼。蜷球保护身体时，尾巴有时自行展开，咬向逼它躲藏的家伙。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME often play fights with its own tail to entertain and exercise itself. When it curls up into a ball for protection, sometimes the tail will uncurl of its own will and attempt to bite whatever caused POKENAME to hide.

entry: 许多地方都流传着POKENAME潜入孩子卧房、吸干鲜血的故事。但实际观察中，它们只用毒液制服比自己小得多的猎物。
author: rakunk
source: Various cultures have spun tales of POKENAME sneaking into children's bedrooms to drain their blood. However, despite these myths, POKENAME have only been observed using venom to subdue much smaller prey.

entry: POKENAME的两部分看似是性格迥异的两只宝可梦，却永远无法分开。
author: lyrebird.rainwing
source: Despite seemingly being two separate Pokémon and having different personalities, the two parts of a POKENAME can never be separated.

entry: POKENAME通过尾巴引导心灵感应，读取附近所有生命的心思。受威胁就先喷火再逃，靠火焰逼退危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME channels its telepathy through its tail, reading the minds of all nearby. Should it feel threatened, it will spit flames before fleeing, using its fire to ward off potential dangers.

entry: POKENAME挖掘时靠精神力量，避开自来水主管与电线。这份精准，让隧道安全高效。
author: .izik
source: Using psychic powers, POKENAME avoids water mains and power lines while digging. This precision keeps its tunnels safe and efficient.

entry: POKENAME出招中途点起火焰，本能经无数战斗磨炼，引导动作。每攻一次，体热更高，为最后一击添力。
author: curazy
source: POKENAME's flames ignite mid-strike, guided by instinct sharpened in countless fights. The heat of its body rises with each attack, fueling its final blow.

entry: POKENAME两个头都有保护欲，可尾上的头脑小、简单，更冲动。谁靠训练家太近，它习惯从嘴射出精神能量。
author: sk372
source: Both of POKENAME's heads have protective inclinations, but the tail's head is more impulsive, owing to its smaller and simpler brain. It has a habit of shooting psychic energy from its mouth at anything that gets too close to its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME以喜悦为食，常黏着开心的人作伴。尤其爱跟孩子，笑声能让它高兴地黏上数小时。
author: curazy
source: This POKENAME feeds on the joy of others, often latching onto cheerful people for company. It especially enjoys following children, whose laughter can keep it happily attached for hours.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的头用毒牙麻痹敌人。锯齿般的咬击，战斗中总能留下深刻印记。
author: .izik
source: The head on POKENAME's tail wields venomous fangs to paralyze enemies. Its serrated bite leaves a lasting impression in battle.

entry: POKENAME舌头上的头，有自己的意识，也是两颗头中唯一有味觉的。主头的嘴，除交流外，没多少其他用途。
author: foolish_weasel
source: The head on POKENAME's tongue has its own mind and is actually the only one between the two that is capable of experiencing the sensation of taste. The mouth on POKENAME's main head is used only for communication and little else.

entry: POKENAME四个大脑分布在两头。前头理性、善算，尾巴上的头则冲动、爱享乐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's four brains are divided between its two heads. The frontal head is more logical and calculating, while the head on the tail is more impulsive and hedonistic.

entry: POKENAME筑巢时用念力控制水流，让家大雨中也能稳固。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses telekinesis to control water flow while constructing its den. This ensures its home remains stable even during heavy rains.

entry: POKENAME行为在善意、恶意间摇摆。据说体内有108个灵魂，善恶恰好各半。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears to fluctuate between acting with good intentions or acting with malice. It is said to contain 108 spirits within itself, with a perfect split between kind and evil souls.

entry: POKENAME两半都想完全控制身体，不断冲突。人碰到身体，就会分裂出两种人格，持续24小时。
author: agostostino
source: The two halves of POKENAME are constantly in conflict because both want to take full control over the body. If a person touches a POKENAME's body, they will split into two personalities for 24 hours.

entry: POKENAME的大脑比后头的脑大；后头不太会思考，常乱咬东西，甚至整口吞下。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's brain is bigger than the one in its rear head. This leads it to biting things and even swallowing things whole, since it's incapable of much thought.

entry: POKENAME的大脑比后头的脑大；后头不太会思考，常乱咬东西，甚至整口吞下。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's brain is bigger than the one in its rear head. This leads it to biting things and even swallowing things whole, since it's incapable of much thought.

entry: POKENAME喉中藏第二头，专门解决掉进巨大嘴里的猎物。
author: kiwiarms
source: There is a second head hidden in POKENAME's throat, which finishes off any prey that fall into its enormous maw.

entry: POKENAME后头偶尔预感到与主头不同的灾难，便陷入两难，不知该帮哪边。常僵住，结果哪边也帮不上。
author: sk372
source: The rear head will occasionally sense a separate disaster from the main head, influencing POKENAME and leaving it torn on which to assist with, often freezing up and helping neither.

entry: POKENAME曾被奉为守护林间空地、难寻的神。后来才明白，它只是用精神力量操纵心思，确保能独处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME was once revered as an elusive god guarding forest glades. It later became clear it simply manipulated minds with its psychic powers to ensure solitude.

entry: POKENAME前面的头徒劳地想吃后头长出的叶，因此常转着圈走。
author: kiwiarms
source: POKENAME are often seen walking in circles, as the front head tries in vain to eat the leaves sprouting from the rear head.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的头，不断用毒唾液梳毛，让毛顺滑，也添一层防御。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tail head constantly grooms its fur using poisonous saliva. This habit keeps its coat sleek and adds a layer of defense.

entry: POKENAME背上小黑鼻，产生与前鼻相反的磁力，吸引其他同类。聚得多，就能连成长链，谁也过不去。
author: imaginita
source: The small, black nose on its back produces a magnetic force opposite to its front-facing nose.  This inverted force attracts other POKENAME, and when many gather, they can form an impassable chain.

entry: POKENAME的剑刃与尾巴天生敌视大多数靠近者。不过，向剑柄那一侧献上素食，就能让它平静下来。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's blade and tail are naturally hostile to most who approach it. However, vegetarian offerings to the hilt's side will calm it down.

entry: 活盾警戒时刀刃睡，反过来也一样。可惜打起架，总有一方很疲倦。
author: kiwiarms
source: The living shield keeps watch while the blade sleeps, and vice versa. Unfortunately, this means that one of them is always tired when they engage in battle.

entry: POKENAME先用念力定住敌人，再以利爪攻击。它常在石上磨爪，保持锋利。
author: .izik
source: It uses telekinesis to immobilize foes before striking with its razor-sharp claws. POKENAME regularly scrapes its claws on stones to keep them sharp.

entry: POKENAME鬃毛始终噼啪冒静电。它在风暴中捕猎，借雷声掩盖接近，趁猎物未觉危险就出击。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's mane crackles constantly with static electricity. It hunts during storms, using thunder to mask its approach, striking before prey senses danger.

entry: 蝴蝶结状器官上的眼，总看着与主眼不同的东西。触须边缘锋利，能把果子、草磨碎，再吃。
author: infinex21
source: The eyes upon its bow-like organs are always watching different things than its main eyes. The sharp edges of its feelers help it to grind up fruits and grass before eating them.

entry: 六足的POKENAME虽模样凶怖，实际温柔食草。为喂尾上的头，胃口极大，平和地笨重游走，只偶尔重重一脚，在现实里踩出个洞。
author: beatdoof
source: Despite its menacing, six-legged stature, POKENAME is actually a gentle herbivore. Driven by a voracious appetite to feed the head on its tail, it lumbers around peacefully, only occasionally stomping a hole in reality with its heavy footfalls.

entry: POKENAME中央头上覆着大嘴，有自己的能力，散出催眠能量。头被大嘴盖着的不适，会化为附近睡者的噩梦。
author: soup1900
source: The large mouth covering POKENAME's central head has its own powers that radiate sleepy energy. The discomfort of having the large mouth over its head is released as nightmares upon all who slumber around it.

entry: POKENAME副头的鼻子是门大炮。过敏高发季节，最好远远避开。
author: kiwiarms
source: POKENAME's secondary head has a powerful cannon for a nose. It is advised to stay far away from POKENAME during allergy season.

entry: POKENAME体型虽小，一夜也能吃光整片植物。白天本体睡，尾巴便醒着保护，直到它再次醒来。
author: npshi
source: Despite their small stature, POKENAME are capable of devouring fields of vegetation in a single night. While POKENAME sleep during the day, their tail awakes, protecting POKENAME until they wake up once more.

entry: POKENAME灵魂强大，身周形成护身气场，形似强大野兽。睡时气场缩小，却从不完全消散。
author: kiwiarms
source: This Pokémon's soul is so strong that it forms a protective aura around the body, resembling a mighty beast. When POKENAME sleeps, its aura shrinks, but never completely fades away.

entry: 两头各有所长，按情况换谁掌控。黄头当家时直立走，棕头当家则四脚跑。
author: kiwiarms
source: The two heads specialize in different things, so they swap which is in charge based on the situation. The yellow head walks upright, while the brown one runs on all fours.

entry: POKENAME用爪挖田、偷作物，逃走前以精神能量制住农民。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its claws to dig up and steal crops from fields. It stuns farmers with psychic energy before making its escape.

entry: POKENAME假装对周围毫无察觉，尾巴其实是伪装的头和颚，警戒偷袭天敌。对方一动手，大嘴便合拢吞下猎物，吓退其同伴。
author: pjporwoll
source: While POKENAME pretends to be unaware of its surroundings, its tails, actually a disguised head and jaws, watch for predators sneaking up on it. When they strike, the maw snaps closed and devours its prey, frightening off the victim's allies.

entry: POKENAME两张脸共享一个脑，却常想往相反方向走，最后只在转圈。
author: kiwiarms
source: The two faces of POKENAME share a single brain. Despite this, they often try to move in opposite directions, leading to them going in circles.

entry: POKENAME两头用心灵感应交流，合力解题。小头没有消化系统，吃的东西到底去了哪，没人知道。
author: kiwiarms
source: POKENAME's two heads work together to solve problems, communicating telepathically with one another. Nobody knows what happens to food the smaller head eats, as it lacks a digestive system.

entry: POKENAME浮过田地，从叶片撒花粉。吸入会看见多个可能未来的鲜明幻景，偶尔竟准确，让研究者困惑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats over crop fields, scattering pollen from its leaves. Inhalation causes vivid visions of multiple possible futures that baffle researchers due to their occasional accuracy.

entry: POKENAME完全看不见，住暗洞与森林。两尾不断咔嗒作响，用回声定位，寻找食物。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are entirely blind, residing in dark caves and forests. Their two tails emit constant clicking noises that they use to echolocate, helping them locate food.

entry: POKENAME的角集中心灵感应，远远定位猎物，因此是密林里熟练的猎手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's antlers help focus its telepathic powers in order to locate prey from great distances. This ability makes it a skilled hunter in dense forests.

entry: 宝石自以为当家，用心灵感应指挥伙伴背着走。伙伴却把它当钝器打敌人，让它十分沮丧。
author: kiwiarms
source: The gem thinks it's in charge, telepathically commanding its partner to carry it around. The partner uses the gem as a blunt weapon against foes, to its dismay.

entry: POKENAME假头太像真，没人知道哪端才是正面。它挪动时像被往2个方向拉扯，让敌人误以为安全。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME's false head is so convincing that nobody knows which end of the Pokémon is the real front. It shuffles as if pulling in 2 directions, an act which lulls foes into a false sense of security.

entry: POKENAME小却凶，以精神力量和重踏保护朋友。强颚咬下，就能牢牢不放。
author: curazy
source: Small but fierce, POKENAME uses psychic force and mighty stomps to protect its friends. It can hold on with a powerful bite, thanks to its strong jaws.

entry: 吸入POKENAME孢子，会产生灵魂出窍般的感受、视觉扭曲，或不由自主地发声。它本身害羞，通常无害。
author: bobosmith01
source: The spores POKENAME produces can cause unusual effects when inhaled, such as causing the sensation of an out-of-body experience, visual distortions, and uncontrollable vocalizations. POKENAME itself is shy and usually harmless.

entry: 与POKENAME相处要小心，本体虽温顺，额外的头却好斗。又因常吃垃圾，被咬很可能严重感染。
author: sk372
source: One should be careful interacting with POKENAME. Although it is docile, its additional heads are feisty, and the garbage-laden diet means that suffering a bite is likely to lead to a bad infection.

entry: POKENAME对附近情绪极敏感。一察觉苦恼，就跑过去吸食压力，直到压力消散。情绪调节障碍者喜欢把它养作情感支持宝可梦。
author: kungfucutbug
source: POKENAME is very sensitive to the emotions of those around it. If someone nearby is in distress, it will run over to feed off their stress until it's gone. Those with emotional dysregulation disorders like to keep it as an emotional support Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME上方多出的头，既能警戒天敌，咬下时还会分泌黏稠毒液。它们也会咬住藤蔓，把身体拉上树，躲到安全处。
author: holgast
source: The extra heads atop POKENAME alert them to predators and secrete a sticky, toxic goo upon biting. The heads also grab onto vines and pull the body up into trees for safety.

entry: POKENAME耳朵发出怪频率，扰乱敌人心智，也惹得尾巴躁动。尾巴于是攻击本体，没多少悔意。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME emits an odd frequency from its ears that messes with its opponent's mind. This frequency also agitates its tail, and it will attack POKENAME with little remorse.

entry: POKENAME虽高大强壮，却是温柔又好抱的巨兽，尾巴倒有些闹腾。它得当心，别把对方抱得太久，免得尾巴在拥抱中咬到对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a cuddly and gentle giant despite its strength and size, but its tail is a bit rambunctious. It must be careful not to hold those it hugs too long, or the tail may try to bite them while in its embrace.

entry: POKENAME展开披风，释放令人恐惧的气息，再以威力惊人的踢击，使敌人失去行动能力。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME spreads its cape wide, it releases a fear-inducing aura. It follows up with a devastating kick to incapacitate its foe.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇晒干磨粉，用于偏头痛治疗。过去，过度动用力量的超能力者曾使用。
author: .izik
source: The mushrooms growing on POKENAME's back are dried and powdered for use in migraine treatments. They were once used by Psychics who had overexerted their abilities.

entry: POKENAME漫游海滩，吃游客遗下的玩具，靠这些度日，等待更多猎物来。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME roams beaches, consuming toys left behind by visitors. These objects sustain it as it waits for more prey to arrive.

entry: POKENAME保护欲强，族群始终有成员放哨。看到天敌，不只提醒同族，也警告附近其他宝可梦。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME are very protective Pokémon, always having one member of their herd on lookout duty. If they see a predator coming, they will not only warn the rest of their herd, but also any other Pokémon nearby.

entry: POKENAME用精神能力察觉入侵者，就双头齐声长嚎，警告其他生命远离领地。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME psychically detects an intruder, it howls loudly from both heads. This display warns others to stay away from its territory.

entry: POKENAME靠超能力感知，游往刚受地震、喷发或破坏性拖网捕捞扰动的地区。它在破坏处进食，搅起沉积物，帮助海中植物扎根，开始复苏。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Guided by its Psychic senses, POKENAME swims to recently disturbed areas, from earthquakes and eruptions to destructive trawling. It feeds amid the devastation, stirring sediment that helps marine plants take root and begin the area's recovery.

entry: 蘑菇吸走POKENAME脑中的养分，智慧反超宿主，再放强烈精神脉冲，赶走靠近到足以威胁它的家伙。
author: sk372
source: The mushroom has siphoned nutrients from POKENAME's brain, granting it more intellect than the host. It radiates strong psychic pulses in order to repel anything that gets close enough to threaten it.

entry: POKENAME常与尾巴聊天，尤其挑衣服时。本体爱斑点，尾巴爱条纹，总为此争执，直到折中。
author: beetlething
source: POKENAME frequently chats with its tail, especially when POKENAME is shopping for clothing. POKENAME prefers spots on its clothing, while its tail prefers stripes, and they will constantly bicker about this until a compromise is reached.

entry: POKENAME翅上的脸只是花纹，却似乎活着。凝视双眼，会感觉有强大存在在脑中低语。
author: robosoup
source: The face on POKENAME's wings is just a pattern, but it seems to be alive. Stare into the eyes, and a strong presence whispers into your mind.

entry: POKENAME爱玩，喜欢甜点和傻游戏。常用蓬松尾巴缠身边东西，几乎任何圆球状物，都能拿来当玩具。
author: curazy
source: POKENAME is a playful Pokémon that loves sweet treats and silly games. It often wraps its fluffy tail around nearby objects, turning almost any sphere-shaped object into a toy to play with.

entry: POKENAME常待面包店、糖果工厂附近，被新出炉甜点的持续香味引来。它开心逗留，盼一两块漏下的点心。
author: curazy
source: POKENAME is often found around bakeries and confectionery factories, drawn by the constant scent of freshly baked sweets. It happily lingers nearby, hoping for a stray treat or two.

entry: POKENAME分心或睡觉，尾巴仍警戒。因此休息时有人靠近，或偷闪亮东西时被碰见，都能迅速逃开。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's tail remains on alert whenever they're distracted or asleep. This allows them to get away quickly if someone tries to approach them while they're resting, or if someone chances on them as they're stealing away shiny objects.

entry: POKENAME在密林用念力偷旅人珠宝。无声游走，受害者连失物也没发现。
author: .izik
source: In dense forests, POKENAME telekinetically steals jewelry from travelers. It prowls silently, leaving its victims unaware of their loss.

entry: POKENAME出奇有礼，平常的攻击性似乎都转进尾巴。因此本体睡时，尾巴仍向一切靠近者磨牙、挥打。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a surprisingly well-mannered Pokémon, as all the usual aggression appears to have been funneled into the tail. As a result, the tail gnashes and swings at anything approaching it, even when POKENAME sleeps.

entry: 有植物处都能找到POKENAME，虽数量稀少。它不停锻炼，控制怒气，通常确实远比火暴猴温和。
author: bobosmith01
source: They can be found anywhere there is vegetation, even if they are rare in number. They exercise constantly in order to control their anger; indeed, POKENAME are usually far less aggressive than Primeape.

entry: POKENAME副头读取训练家情绪，感知主人骄傲就开心吠叫，热切想加深羁绊。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's second head reads its Trainer's emotions. It barks joyfully when it senses its owner's pride, eager to deepen their bond.

entry: POKENAME尾巴藏着大量精神能量，不断咬住自己的头，试着传给本体。成功传能、同步脑波，就会进化。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's tail holds immense psychic energy, which they constantly try to transfer to their main body by biting down on their head. Those who succeed in this and sync their brainwaves will evolve.

entry: POKENAME尾巴用毛骨悚然的尖叫释放精神能量，曾引起头痛、电子设备短路。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's tails release psychic energy in the form of bloodcurdling screams. These screams have been known to cause headaches and short-circuit electronics.

entry: POKENAME尾巴咬住头，同步脑波。这种强化状态下，智力超过任何人类，精神能量输出不断增加。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's tails latch onto their heads, syncing their brainwaves together. In this heightened state, these Pokémon's intellect surpasses that of any person, their output of psychic energy ever increasing.

entry: 头管双臂，肚子管双腿。虽有分歧，合作仍足以应付最难缠的对手。
author: kiwiarms
source: The head controls the arms, while the gut controls the legs. Despite their differences, they work together well enough to handle even the toughest opponents.

entry: POKENAME后半身不需吃睡，能全天训练，甚至本体睡着也不停。因此强得惊人，巨石也能扔得远远越过地平线。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's back has no need to eat or sleep, allowing them to train at all hours of the day, even while asleep. Because of this, POKENAME are incredibly strong, able to hurl boulders well past the horizon.

entry: 肾上腺素高涨，POKENAME力量就发动。激动时刻，在场者会出现古怪、冲动的行为。
author: bobosmith01
source: When adrenaline runs high, POKENAME's powers activate: in the heat of the moment, those in POKENAME's presence end up engaging in unusual or impulsive behavior.

entry: POKENAME两个脑，让它总在帮忙、伤害间变换。混乱的善恶取向反而适合垃圾场，既有清醒头脑分类，也有力量砸碎废料。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME have two brains, constantly causing them to flip between helpful and harmful. Their chaotic morality makes them well-suited for work in junkyards, as they have the mental clarity to sort junk and the strength to break down scrap.

entry: POKENAME移动笨拙，咬下却快得可怕。大脸装傻，似乎才是幕后主脑。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME moves quite awkwardly, but can chomp down with frightening speed. The larger face plays dumb, but seems to be the mastermind here.

entry: POKENAME后头连着长藤，睡时绕住树梢，保持稳固。
author: .izik
source: The rear head of POKENAME is attached to a long vine. It wraps the vine around treetops while it sleeps to ensure stability.

entry: POKENAME左右两侧性情有别，右侧更凶，左侧更冷静。右侧有些许精神能力，经石拳引导。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's two sides display a dichotomy, with its right side being more aggressive and the left being more levelheaded. The right side displays modest psychic abilities that it channels through its stone fist.

entry: POKENAME奔跑时，尾上的头喷出美丽火焰图案。飞奔穿过草原，华丽展示灵活、自信。
author: .izik
source: The head on POKENAME's tail breathes fire in beautiful patterns while it runs. This flashy display shows off its agility and confidence as it races through prairies.

entry: 头食草，尾食肉。头啃岸边灌木时，尾巴就在水里，咬住游过的倒霉鱼。
author: kiwiarms
source: The head is a herbivore, while the tail is a carnivore. While the head munches shoreside shrubbery, the tail is in the water, snapping up unlucky fish that swim by.

entry: POKENAME以精神能量强化水之波动，让攻击拐弯，从意想不到的角度击敌。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME enhances its Water Pulse with psychic energy. This ability allows it to curve the attack and strike foes from unexpected angles.

entry: POKENAME始终将自己的尾巴带在身边，里面有第二头和独立小脑。尾巴能吃主头不能吃的植物、真菌，多一条获取养分的途径。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries its own tail, which contains a secondary head with its own tiny brain, close at all times. The tail can consume plants and fungi the main head cannot, giving it an alternative way to gain sustenance.

entry: POKENAME俯在睡者身上吃梦，仿佛也陷入恍惚。后头站岗，若看见、听见有谁靠近，就叫醒其余身体。
author: .jerden
source: When POKENAME feeds on dreams, it seems to enter a trance as it leans over the sleeper. The head behind it will keep watch, and will wake up the rest of POKENAME if it sees or hears anyone approaching.

entry: POKENAME催眠全靠自己，不需要带着的小头帮忙。它却让小头以为不可或缺，好觉得自己有用。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's hypnotic powers are all its own, not requiring the help of the small head it carries. It lets the head think it's crucial to the hypnosis effect so that it can feel helpful.

entry: POKENAME每只钳子都有独立意识，与本体共生，却常为食物有小分歧。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME's claws each have a mind of their own, operating independently from the main body. Though symbiotic, they often get into minor disagreements over food.

entry: POKENAME每只钳子都有独立意识，与本体共生，却常为食物有小分歧。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME's claws each have a mind of their own, operating independently from the main body. Though symbiotic, they often get into minor disagreements over food.

entry: POKENAME晒太阳打盹，松果球茎散出淡淡榴石果香。被打扰，就伴着惊人巨响醒来。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME naps beneath the sun, it releases a gentle Pomeg Berry scent from its pinecone bulb. If disturbed, it awakens with a surprising bang.

entry: POKENAME全身披着凌乱厚树皮，很难看出脸在哪。一位护林人声称，见过一只从头到脚全是脸。
author: hophoppip
source: The shaggy coat of chunky bark all over POKENAME's body makes it tricky to tell where its faces are. One forester claims to have seen a POKENAME entirely covered in faces from tip to toe.

entry: 它拿着自身脱落的一部分，摇时咯咯响。即使脱落，里面仍积能，终有一天会爆炸，因此必须定期丢弃。
author: infinex21
source: This Pokémon wields a shed part of itself, which emits a rattling sound when shaken. Even after being shed, this part still accumulates energy within; it must be regularly discarded at some point, as the energy will cause it to one day explode.

entry: POKENAME为保持腿灵活，会蜕掉平时覆盖的树皮。虽然因此脆弱，强踢仍能迅速赶走天敌。
author: soup1900
source: To keep its legs flexible, POKENAME sheds the bark that normally covers them. Though this leaves them vulnerable, its powerful kicks quickly drive away would-be predators.

entry: POKENAME的幼崽比亲代更凶、更好斗，亲代常得压住它，免得跳出袋子朝什么东西爆炸。
author: sk372
source: The child is more aggressive and combative than the parent. POKENAME is often forced to restrain the young, to keep it from leaping out of the pouch and exploding at something.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀质地独特，每次拍动，都会发出轻轻的噼啪声。尾立很爱啃食这些脱落到林地上的脆鳞片。
author: sk372
source: Due to the unique texture, POKENAME makes a soft crackling noise with every flap of its wings. Sentret are known to enjoy gnawing on these crunchy scales when they shed and fall to the forest floors.

entry: POKENAME吃烂木头，帮助森林保持洁净。强角也能抵挡附近敌对宝可梦的攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME feeds on rotten wood, helping to keep the forests clean. Its sturdy horns help it defend itself against attacks from hostile Pokémon in the vicinity.

entry: 它有坚甲，会从下方冲撞渔船发动攻击。据说外皮几乎无法刺穿。
author: thatblandman
source: Using its tough armor, this Pokémon is known to attack fishing vessels by crashing into them from below. Its hide is said to be nearly impenetrable.

entry: POKENAME很受捕虫训练家欢迎，粗硬的皮毛能在野外保护它。
author: melodydelune
source: Popular among bug catchers, POKENAME has rough fur that helps to protect it in the wild.

entry: POKENAME一闻到成熟树果的香气，就忍不住跑去吃。它能用坚硬的尾巴，向那些蠢到小看它的家伙，放出强力电击。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME senses the scent of a ripe berry, it can't help but run off to eat it. From its rigid tail, it can fire powerful electric shocks at anyone foolish enough to underestimate it.

entry: POKENAME的茧由多片硬板层叠，始终长新片替旧片，直到进化完成，都保持强防御。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cocoon is made of several rigid plates layered over each other. It constantly grows new plates to replace the old, so that its defenses remain strong until it completes its evolution.

entry: POKENAME采花粉，存在松果状蜂巢。黎明时蜂拥落入花田，再以爆发般的速度消失。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers pollen from flowers and stores it in its pinecone-shaped hive. At dawn, swarms descend on flower fields before vanishing with explosive speed.

entry: POKENAME受威胁能瞬间传送，因此不必加固壳，转而试验黏液。熟练个体能完美复制宝可梦产生的任何其他液体。
author: imaginita
source: Since POKENAME can teleport when threatened, it doesn't need to reinforce its shell. Instead, it experiments with its sticky fluid. A skilled POKENAME can make a perfect replica of any other fluid that Pokémon can create.

entry: POKENAME独特的针叶树香，被用于许多蜡烛和清洁用品。战斗时投出颈边松果，当成爆炸弹丸。
author: mepp.
source: The distinct coniferous aroma that POKENAME produces is used in many candles and cleaning products. In battle it hurls the pinecones around its neck, using them as explosive projectiles.

entry: POKENAME的壳结实，闻起来像烤坚果。它们挂在树上，啃食枝头的叶子，并靠摆尾交流，帮助彼此抵御捕食者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a sturdy shell that smells like roasted nuts. They hang from trees where they eat leaves off of branches. They communicate with each other by swinging their tails to help one another defend themselves against predators.

entry: POKENAME在松树筑巢，跃向威胁，快速使出乱抓。若看似必败，就无畏地引爆，作最后抗争。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME nests in pine trees and leaps at threats with rapid Fury Swipes. If defeat seems certain, it detonates in a fearless last stand.

entry: POKENAME时间感极准，少有差错。发怒时，从嘶叫到爆炸，恰好5秒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a keen sense of time that rarely goes awry. Whenever it gets angry, it takes exactly 5 seconds from the moment it hisses to the moment it explodes.

entry: POKENAME在松树筑巢，守住枝头，从眼发出催眠波，让入侵者睡去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME nests in pine trees and guards its perch. It emits hypnotic waves from its eyes to lull intruders to sleep.

entry: POKENAME花吃太多，就惊慌乱飞。不稳定的状态，让它不久后便引爆。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME consumes too many flowers, it panics and flies erratically. The instability causes it to detonate shortly afterward.

entry: 它收集落到网上的碎屑，拼成巨大的自己。鸟宝可梦一靠近，就摇网，让仿制品像活的。
author: hophoppip
source: It gathers the debris that fall onto its web and arranges them into a giant version of itself. When a bird Pokémon gets too close, it shakes the web to make its replica move like it's alive.

entry: 爆炸物专家训练POKENAME清除战场地雷。长腿小心挖土，若炸药被引爆，坚韧鳞壳还能保护身体。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are trained by explosive experts to remove mines from battlefields. Their long legs allow them to carefully dig at the ground while their tough, scaly shell protects them in case any explosives go off.

entry: POKENAME用爪攀住松枝，倒挂睡觉。夜里纹丝不动，融入上方树冠。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME clings to pine branches using its talons and sleeps upside down. It remains completely still during the night, blending in with the canopy above.

entry: POKENAME收树皮，盖住两根触角末端。夜里想与同伴交流，就以化学方式分解树皮，放出绿光。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME gathers bits of tree bark to cover the ends of its two antennae. When it wants to communicate with its brethren in the night, it chemically breaks down the bark to emit a green glow.

entry: POKENAME常在流星刚坠落处，将陨石碎片加进壳。它容易受惊，动辄爆炸，这时最好别打扰群体。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are often found where shooting stars have fallen recently, adding shards from the fallen meteors to their shell. They are easily surprised and quick to explode, so it is not recommended to disturb POKENAME groups during this time.

entry: POKENAME会摘下自身的小甲片，送给喜欢的生灵。甲片很快长回，由它自己摘取时也完全不痛，因此收下礼物无妨。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME removes and offers tiny plates from its own body as gifts to those it is fond of. They grow back quickly, and the self-removal is painless, so there's no harm in accepting the present.

entry: 风暴之夜，POKENAME会看见强烈幻景。若景象吓到自己，就恐慌引爆。
author: .izik
source: During stormy nights, POKENAME receives intense visions. If a vision frightens it, it will detonate in a panic.

entry: 风暴中，POKENAME站旷野引雷，储存电荷。黑鲁加等天敌威胁族群时，就用来爆炸反击。
author: .izik
source: During storms, POKENAME stands in open fields to attract lightning. It stores the charge and uses it to explode when predators like Houndoom threaten the herd.

entry: POKENAME连着树枝便完全不动，若被打落，却容易爆炸。罕见个体与同类完全不同，颜色、外貌各异。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME stay perfectly still when connected to a tree branch, but if they are knocked off, they're prone to explode. Rarely, there are POKENAME that look completely different from other POKENAME, with a different color and outer appearance.

entry: POKENAME飘过松林，留意天敌。带着令人放下戒心的笑，轻轻降落，一接触便爆炸。
author: .izik
source: While drifting over pine forests, POKENAME watches for predators. It floats down gently with a disarming smile, then detonates on contact.

entry: POKENAME用手状尾巴挂树。受威胁，就落向天敌，爆出遮蔽视线的烟和木屑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hangs from tree branches using its hand-like tail. When threatened, it drops down onto predators and explodes in a blinding burst of smoke and splinters.

entry: POKENAME浅浅埋在地里，避免被阵风吹走。其他宝可梦前来将它从原处拔起时，它们就会爆炸，向附近喷出一阵种子。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME bury themselves just below the surface to avoid getting blown away by a gust of wind. If another Pokémon comes to uproot them from their spot, they explode and release a burst of seeds into the nearby area.

entry: 它挑选栖息的树时，占有欲很强。铁壳蛹等宝可梦若在这棵树上挂起丝，它便振翅，将它们统统吹落林地，只让自己留下。
author: sk372
source: It has a possessive streak when it seeks a tree to perch on. If Kakuna and similar Pokémon hang threads on its tree, it will use the beating of its wings to blow them all to the forest floor so it alone can remain.

entry: POKENAME的头形，能防御本会捕食它的飞行宝可梦，却也限制视野。它在陆地走得笨拙，更愿待在泥水里，仰望天空。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The shape of POKENAME's head protects it from flying Pokémon that would otherwise predate on it but restricts their field of view. They are very clumsy when walking on land and prefer to spend their time in muddy water, looking up at the sky.

entry: POKENAME坚硬如木的胡须抽动，寻找残羹。它在城巷生活得很好，嗅找丢弃食物，准得惊人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's stiff, woodlike whiskers twitch as it scans for scraps. It thrives in city alleys, sniffing out discarded food with surprising accuracy.

entry: POKENAME挂树，用红尾吸引猎物，再落到食物上。受攻击，就爆出能量，将许多树皮甲片甩向攻击者。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME hangs from trees, attracting the attention of prey with its red tail, before dropping on its food. When it is attacked, it retaliates with an explosive burst of energy that flings much of its bark armor at the aggressor.

entry: POKENAME用精神感应读意图。一察觉恶意，就直冲冒犯者，毫不迟疑地爆炸。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its psychic sense to read others' intentions. If it detects malice, it bolts straight at the offender and explodes without hesitation.

entry: 两只榛果球融合，POKENAME便长出更密的鬃刺涂层，更加耐打。也比未融合的兄弟姐妹更易引爆，使城都野外更危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Fusing a pair of Pineco together results in POKENAME developing an extra-dense coating of bristles, making them even more durable. They are also more prone to detonate than their unfused siblings, creating dangerous situations in the Johto wilds.

entry: 两只榛果球融合，POKENAME便长出更密的鬃刺涂层，更加耐打。也比未融合的兄弟姐妹更易引爆，使城都野外更危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Fusing a pair of Pineco together results in POKENAME developing an extra-dense coating of bristles, making them even more durable. They are also more prone to detonate than their unfused siblings, creating dangerous situations in the Johto wilds.

entry: POKENAME覆着钢铁甲片，能挡开尖喙与利爪。甲片结实，它们很难被击落；可若真被打下，触地前就会猛烈爆炸。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are covered with steel plates that deflect beaks and talons. They are difficult to knock down because of their sturdy plates, but on the rare occasion they do get knocked down, they violently explode before reaching the ground.

entry: POKENAME怕极乌鸦头头，一见就混进树间伪装。独特飞法让它能在密草枝叶间穿梭，从不撞上。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is terrified of Honchkrow and will camouflage itself among the trees at the mere sight of one. It has developed a unique flying style that allows it to weave between branches in dense undergrowth without ever crashing.

entry: POKENAME坚韧鳞壳能承受许多虫属性宝可梦的蜇刺，从蜂巢偷蜜脾时，很有用。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a tough scaly shell that allows them to endure many stings from Bug-type Pokémon. This is helpful when they steal honeycombs from hives.

entry: POKENAME住针叶林，保护树木。许多砍林行动，都因它袭击而中止。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME dwells in coniferous forests and acts as a protector of the trees.  Many deforestation efforts have been brought to a halt due to its attacks.

entry: POKENAME在松林地上游走，吃落松果、松针。有宝可梦靠近，就僵住，装作普通松果。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME roam around the ground in pine forests, eating fallen cones and needles. If another Pokémon approaches, they will freeze in place and pretend to be nothing more than a pine cone.

entry: POKENAME背鳞硬如树皮。冲锋即使扑空，甲片硬边仍可能割伤跳到旁边的敌人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's back is protected by scales as hard as tree bark. Even if one of its charges misses, the hard edges of these armor plates may still slash foes that leap to the side.

entry: 它模仿手榴弹，试图吓退天敌。可惜多数天敌根本不知道手榴弹是什么，自然吓不住。
author: kiwiarms
source: It resembles a grenade as an adaptation to deter predators. Sadly, most of its predators don't know what a grenade is and thus are not intimidated.

entry: POKENAME对人和宝可梦都慷慨友善。它们喜欢送给人类坚果、树果和水果，分享自然的喜悦。
author: lemmymaster
source: POKENAME are very generous and kind to humans and Pokémon alike. They like to give nuts, Berries, and fruit to humans to spread the joys of nature.

entry: POKENAME吃松针、松果，给体内火焰供能。遇威胁，先在身边使出撒菱，再逃跑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME feeds on pine needles and cones to fuel the flames within its body. If threatened, it scatters Spikes around itself before fleeing.

entry: POKENAME滚得比其他宝可梦慢得多。可一旦碾过猎物，伤害也大得多。
author: mary_the_jane
source: POKENAME rolls much slower than other Pokémon. However, it is much more devastating if it manages to roll over its prey.

entry: POKENAME在树皮上摩擦身体，刮掉、折落长得过头的甲片。碎片会迅速生物降解，为土壤与植物补充养分。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rubs its body against tree bark in order to help scrape and snap off plates of its body that have grown excessively. The fallen pieces biodegrade quickly and provide more nutrients for soil and plant life.

entry: POKENAME接上通电招牌、电缆充电。吸太多，就过载爆炸，噼啪闪着电光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME connects to electrified signs and cables to charge. If it absorbs too much power, it overloads and erupts in a crackling electric explosion.

entry: POKENAME兴奋时，从松果状的头喷火。这些火焰能烧焦附近枝叶，或标记领地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME blasts fire from its pinecone-shaped head when excited. These fiery bursts can scorch nearby foliage or mark territory.

entry: POKENAME鳞层保护身体免遭咬伤。它的奶略带坚果味，非常适合做冰淇淋。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a layer of scales that protect them from bites. They produce milk that is tinged with a nutty flavor that is perfect for turning into ice cream.

entry: POKENAME藏树间，用鬃刺甲片伪装。受威胁，会像手榴弹破片般射出甲片，上面还带大量电荷。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides amongst the trees, using its bristled plating to camouflage against the trees. When threatened, it will fire off these plates like grenade fragments, charged with large amounts of electricity.

entry: POKENAME飞过森林，收有趣东西，装点帽子。天真好奇，有时也会顺走别人的物品。
author: gaogao028
source: POKENAME flies around forests collecting anything it deems interesting, gathering its finds as hat decoration. Through its innocent curiosity, POKENAME may occasionally snatch someone else's belongings.

entry: POKENAME在林里漫步，撕树皮、捡枝条吃。偶尔掰下自己的甲片也吃，似乎毫无害处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME strolls around forests, tearing off bark and picking up twigs to munch on. On occasion it will snap off pieces of its own plates and eat them, which seems to cause it no harm.

entry: POKENAME从不独飞，常成群聚在大树桩边，吃苔藓和霉菌。
author: elevn.
source: POKENAME never flies alone. It is often found in groups around large tree stumps that feed on moss and mold.

entry: POKENAME獠牙像松树，许多榛果球会住上面。受威胁，就摇身，让它们落下爆炸。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's tusks so convincingly resemble pine trees that multiple Pineco will take up residence. If POKENAME is threatened, it will shake its body so that these Pokémon drop off and explode.

entry: POKENAME找松果、枝条加固壳。一听振翅，就僵住、隐形，直到威胁过去，有时一等数小时。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME wanders in search of pine cones and twigs to reinforce its protective shell. If it hears wings fluttering, it freezes and turns invisible until the threat passes, sometimes for hours.

entry: POKENAME啃树啃烦，就引爆，想将树放倒。强爆炸让碎裂树桩散落森林。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME grows frustrated while gnawing at a tree, it detonates in an effort to topple it. Its powerful blasts leave splintered stumps scattered across the forest.

entry: POKENAME生气会缩进楔石，让石头因储能振动。这时一碰，就以爆炸释放积攒能量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME retreats into its keystone when angered, causing it to vibrate with stored energy. Touching it in this state will cause it to release this stored energy in the form of an explosion.

entry: POKENAME睡时双臂抱住松枝。全身布满有毒微刺，碰触很危险。
author: .izik
source: While sleeping, POKENAME wraps its arms around pine branches. Its body is lined with venomous microscopic spikes, making it dangerous to touch.

entry: POKENAME头对气温极敏感。暖天，柄状结构摊平、分开；冷天就并拢，变得密实如玉米棒。
author: banquoviaquo
source: The head of a POKENAME is very reactive to local temperatures. In warm weather, the stalks flatten and separate, but in cold weather, the stalks clump together into a denser corncob-like form.

entry: POKENAME足迹留清新木香，因此出了名好追踪。有些饲养者在眉上抹花生酱，引来鸟宝可梦。
author: banquoviaquo
source: POKENAME is infamously easy to track, as its footprints leave a fresh, woody scent. Some owners spread peanut butter on its brow to attract avian Pokémon.

entry: 它会用飘带把刀刃般的树皮，粘到中央的黏性部分，迎击来犯者。走投无路时，还会炸散身体，再一点点修复。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Its ribbon adds blade-like bark to its sticky center to hit attackers with. As a last resort, it explosively breaks apart and slowly repairs itself.

entry: POKENAME战斗用角冲锋。若看似要败，就爆炸，作最后一搏，试图打倒敌人。
author: .izik
source: In battle, POKENAME charges with its horn. If defeat seems likely, it explodes in a last-ditch effort to bring down its foe.

entry: POKENAME用利触须划开松干，大喝树汁。饱后睡树根旁，若被天敌叫醒，就爆炸。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drinks pine sap in great quantities by slashing open trunks with its sharp feelers. Once full, it sleeps at the base of the tree and will explode if awakened by a predator.

entry: POKENAME爆炸后的短暂一刻，时间仿佛停住。爆炸强度，直接影响这段感觉持续的时间。
author: .izik
source: For a brief moment after POKENAME explodes, time appears to stand still. The intensity of the explosion directly affects how long this moment seems to last.

entry: POKENAME甲片几乎永远冰冷，脱落后也一样。有人直接当盘，凉食能保冷更久。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's plates remain almost eternally cold even after they have fallen off of its body. Some use them as actual plates to keep chilled food cold for longer.

entry: POKENAME撒绿孢子，麻痹威胁。同类遇险，就无私冲前、爆炸防卫。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME paralyzes threats by scattering green spores from its body. If its kin are endangered, it will charge forward and explode in a selfless act of defense.

entry: POKENAME对夜里身在林中的旅人很有帮助。一醒，头顶灯芯点亮，可持续燃烧12小时。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME is naturally a great boon for travelers who find themselves in the woods at night. When it awakens, the wick on its head lights up and can stay burning for the next 12 hours.

entry: POKENAME夜里悬在旅人头上，刚好躲出视线。它点着几片甲，落下炸出幽幽火星，把旅人吓坏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hovers above travelers at night, keeping itself just out of sight. It uses its flames to set some of its plates alight, which fall down and burst into ghostly sparks, giving the travelers quite a fright.

entry: 成群POKENAME深钻地下。受打扰就猛烈爆炸，在泥土留下宽阔裂沟。
author: .izik
source: Swarms of POKENAME burrow deep underground. If disturbed, they explode violently, leaving wide crevasses in the dirt.

entry: POKENAME战斗使出迅捷武术打击。远战则把松果状帽子当旋转铁饼扔。
author: .izik
source: In battle, POKENAME performs swift martial arts strikes. For ranged combat, it throws its pinecone-like cap like a spinning discus.

entry: POKENAME住云杉，用幻象弄迷糊旅人，常假扮林里独自工作的伐木工。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lives in spruce trees and uses illusions to confuse travelers. It often disguises itself as a lone lumberjack working in the forest.

entry: POKENAME群落栖在高高的树枝间，彼此唱歌，消磨时光。身体下方的一圈褶边，能在跌落时挂住树枝，保护它们，留出爬回去的机会。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME colonies sit amongst high tree branches and sing to one another to pass the day. They have a ruff around their lower body that keeps them safe if they fall, catching on the branches of the tree to give them a chance to climb back up.

entry: POKENAME拔出地面树苗，摆在巢里。它完全不肯理会长成的树，只喜欢幼树。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME uproots tree saplings from the ground, displaying them in their den. They outright refuse to acknowledge fully grown trees, only taking a liking to saplings.

entry: POKENAME甲片像连衣裙，模样可爱。可要提防黏糊糊的泡沫耳朵，它用来把猎物粘在原地，轻松饱餐。
author: foulz4k
source: The plates on POKENAME's body act as a dress, giving it a cute appearance. People should beware its sticky foam ears, as they are used to glue prey down, allowing it to obtain an easy feast.

entry: POKENAME聚在阴树下休息。受打扰，就喷深绿孢子，麻痹靠近熟睡同胞的一切来者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rests in clusters beneath shady trees. When disturbed, it puffs out dark green spores that paralyze anything nearing its sleeping kin.

entry: POKENAME不稳定的外壳，偶尔剥落碎片。它用幽灵能量举起，甩向自认为的威胁。
author: .izik
source: Occasionally, parts of POKENAME's volatile shell flake off. It uses a ghostly energy to lift these fragments and fling them at those it deems a threat.

entry: 隆隆石进洞，POKENAME便从上方蜂拥攻击，按协调顺序接连引爆，将它驱逐。
author: .izik
source: If a Graveler enters POKENAME's caves, they swarm it from above. They detonate one after another in a synchronized sequence to drive it out.

entry: POKENAME吃松果、睡树干。燃料吃不够，不知为何反会体内过热，从里面烧起来。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME eats pinecones and sleeps in tree trunks. If it doesn't consume enough fuel, its body somehow overheats and combusts from within.

entry: POKENAME住深林，白天装松果睡觉。它用中空利牙刺入粗树，吸食树汁。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in the deep woods, disguising itself as a pinecone while it sleeps during the day. It bites into thick trees, drinking the tree sap inside with its hollow fangs.

entry: POKENAME藏在枝叶间埋伏，准备落到太靠近树木、毫无防备的路人头上。落下后，它会让电流覆盖全身，阻止任何人触碰。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lies in wait, hidden among the branches, ready to drop onto the heads of unsuspecting passersby who get too close to its tree. Once it falls, it coats its body in electricity to prevent anyone from touching it.

entry: POKENAME极好胜，在栖居针叶林与其他宝可梦赛跑。为赢，会爆出能量，把自己弹向前，随后昏倒。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is extremely competitive and races other Pokémon around its coniferous forest habitat. To win a race, it will unleash an explosive burst of energy to catapult itself forward, after which it faints.

entry: POKENAME用常青树枝装点身体、遮掩自己。偏爱针叶更尖的枝条，防天敌最好。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME decorates its body with evergreen branches to conceal itself. It prefers branches with sharper needles, as they make the best defenses against predators.

entry: POKENAME轻摆起舞时，流苏般的树皮状羽毛摩擦，沙沙作响。若这时被打扰，就完全失去冷静，爆炸。
author: pjporwoll
source: As POKENAME gently sways in its dance, the fringe makes a scratchy rattling sound as its bark-like feathers rub together. If something bothers it during the dance, POKENAME loses all semblance of calm and explodes.

entry: POKENAME累了就附身旧松桩休息。一被叫醒，整个树桩就在幽灵力量爆发中炸开。
author: .izik
source: When tired, POKENAME possesses old pine stumps to rest. If roused, the entire stump explodes in a burst of ghostly force.

entry: POKENAME在寒林的朽木妖枝上筑巢。危险将近，朽木妖就像投手榴弹一样扔出，让它们撞上便爆炸。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME nest in Trevenant's branches in colder forests. If danger nears, Trevenant hurls them like grenades, allowing them to explode on impact.

entry: POKENAME口滴樱子果香的黏树汁，引来猎物。目标靠近便引爆震晕，供同类吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drips a sticky Cheri Berry-scented sap from its mouth to lure prey. Once the target draws near, it detonates to stun them for its kin to feed.

entry: POKENAME倒挂枝头，用爪够取下方枝条的树果。夜里冒险离开树枝庇护，采蘑菇，睡前大吃一顿。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME hang upside-down from branches, grabbing berries from lower branches with their claws. At night, they risk leaving the safety of their branches to gather mushrooms for bigger meals before they sleep.

entry: 古老的冰川虫POKENAME将自己封进冰晶树皮，抵御天敌。受威胁，先从壳放出耀眼极光，迷乱敌人，再伴着冰冷爆风引爆自身。
author: jitteryjared
source: This ancient, glacial bug seals itself in icy crystal bark to ward off predators. When threatened, POKENAME releases a dazzling aurora from its shell that disorients foes before detonating itself with a chilling blast.

entry: POKENAME大半埋软土，睡觉或吃根。天敌若扰动地上部分，背上片状蘑菇便弹出，爆成遮蔽视线、刺激性强的孢子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME burrows most of its body down into soft soil to sleep or feast on roots. If a predator should agitate the part that remains above ground, its plate-like mushrooms on its back will eject and burst into blinding, irritating spores.

entry: POKENAME浮在田野上，身上亮着探照灯般的红光。发现入侵者，先使出撒菱，再用高速旋转制服。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats above crop fields with glowing red spotlights on its body. When it detects an intruder, it scatters Spikes and subdues them with a Rapid Spin.

entry: POKENAME看到南瓜地旁的入侵者，就冲去爆炸。它几乎没有自保本能。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME sees an intruder near its pumpkin patch, it dashes at them and explodes. It has very little instinct for self-preservation.

entry: 有谁靠池塘，POKENAME便夸张跃出水面，爆炸保护宁静领地。因此许多旅人，干脆完全绕开有它的池塘。
author: .izik
source: If someone approaches its pond, POKENAME leaps out of the water dramatically and explodes to protect its tranquil territory. Many travelers avoid ponds containing POKENAME entirely for this reason.

entry: POKENAME烦躁就爆炸，向四周撒出不明来源的硬币。研究虽多，仍没人知道钱哪来。
author: .izik
source: When irritated, POKENAME explodes, scattering coins from an unknown source in all directions. Despite ample research, nobody knows where the money comes from.

entry: POKENAME顶上硬壳挡住天敌，下方却没覆盖。天敌便将它掀翻，攻击底下脆弱身体。
author: fireflower20002
source: The tough shell that covers the top of POKENAME protects it from predators. The shell doesn't cover its bottom, so predators will knock POKENAME over to attack its weak body underneath.

entry: POKENAME的壳虽让它游泳不够灵便，却能有效抵挡海浪的严重伤害。浪势增强时，住在海滩的较小宝可梦，就会躲到壳后。
author: fireflower20002
source: Although the shell of POKENAME makes it hard for it to swim efficiently, its shell is effective at stopping waves from doing major damage. Smaller Pokémon that reside on the beach hide behind POKENAME's shell when the waves start to get intense.

entry: POKENAME把大葱当决斗剑，招式华丽，却不稳定。一绊倒，就尴尬得当场炸开。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wields its leek like a duelist's blade. It fights with flair but is volatile; should it stumble, it explodes with the force of its own embarrassment.

entry: 它拿着的炮，是身体的延伸，能引导、发射自身能量。不留神就会过热；据说用太多又不冷却，还可能爆炸。
author: infinex21
source: The cannon it wields is an extension of its own body, which allows it to channel and release its own energy at its targets. This cannon can overheat if it is not careful; supposedly, it may explode if overused without cooling off.

entry: POKENAME能向想吃它的天敌射出壳片。厚茧加上这关键本领，帮助它存活到能够进化。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can shoot pieces of its shell against predators that try to eat it. This essential skill, along with its thick cocoon, help it survive until it can evolve.

entry: 脸上的角能射尖刺，在猎物巢旁布下撒菱，封住退路。尖刺在体内，用吃下的金属矿石制成。
author: .izik
source: The horn on its face launches Spikes around a prey's nest to prevent escape. These spikes are crafted within its body by consuming metal ore.

entry: 它收集铁矿块，藏进袋里保管。人们相信，矿石能增强防御。
author: .izik
source: It collects chunks of iron ore and stores them in its pouch for safekeeping. This ore is believed to enhance its defensive capabilities.

entry: 身上金属团块像鳞片生长，构成保护铠甲，让人想起中世纪骑士。
author: .izik
source: The metallic clusters on its body grow like scales, forming a layer of protective armor. This natural defense is reminiscent of medieval knights.

entry: 大眼让它浓雾里也看得清，是能见度差时的出色侦察者。
author: .izik
source: Its large eye allows it to see clearly, even in thick fog. This keen vision makes it an effective scout in murky environments.

entry: 锐眼分析敌人动作，再完美模仿。这番嘲弄，常让敌人乱了节奏。
author: .izik
source: Its sharp eye analyzes enemy movements, allowing it to mimic them perfectly. This mocking behavior often throws foes off their game during battles.

entry: 它将利臂当刺刀，迅速劈斩敌人，再向对手周围布下毒菱，封住退路。
author: .izik
source: It wields its sharp arms like bayonets, delivering swift slashes to foes. It then scatters Toxic Spikes around its opponents to ensure they can't retreat.

entry: 它从头上角状炮口发射毒菱，锋利弹体形成致命陷阱，威胁附近一切。
author: .izik
source: It releases Toxic Spikes from the horn-like cannons on its head. These sharp projectiles create a deadly trap for anything nearby.

entry: 怒气越大，头骨上的铁甲越硬。它不断冲撞，即使对手早被制服，仍不停。
author: .izik
source: As its anger grows, the iron plating on its skull hardens. It repeatedly charges at foes, even long after they are subdued.

entry: 达到强化形态，鳞片比战列舰装甲还厚。如旋转鱼雷，猛烈钻穿任何胆敢闯入猎场的船。
author: thatblandman
source: Having reached this enhanced form, its scales are thicker than a battleship's armor. Like a spiraling torpedo, it violently bores through any vessel foolish enough to enter its hunting grounds.

entry: POKENAME两半外壳大多紧护脆弱核心。威胁接近，上半便悬起，让核心射出尖利弹丸，再迅速合紧。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's two shell halves rest tightly against its vulnerable core most of the time. If something threatening approaches, the top half levitates upward so it can fire sharp projectiles from its core before quickly shutting closed again.

entry: 最好远离POKENAME的巢，它领地意识极强，会从前肢远远高速发射尖刺。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME nests should be given a wide berth for safety's sake. Extremely territorial, it fires sharp spines from its front limbs, launching at high speeds from long distances.

entry: POKENAME封在壳里，藏进大石堆。被探险者捡起，就立即惊慌，因恐惧爆炸。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME encase themselves in their shells, hiding amongst large piles of rocks. When they're picked up by explorers, they instantly panic and explode in fear.

entry: POKENAME通常温顺，却易受惊，害怕就射出硬壳碎片。蜕壳后，许多农民会磨碎壳，因为是很好的肥料。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Despite being typically docile, POKENAME are easy to frighten. This leads to them shooting out hardened shell fragments in bouts of fear. When POKENAME shed their shells, many farmers grind the husks because they make excellent fertilizers.

entry: 它站田里吸收数小时阳光。充满能量，便散甜香，促进附近植物生长。
author: .izik
source: It stands in fields soaking up sunlight for hours. Once fully charged, it emits a sweet aroma that encourages nearby plants to grow.

entry: POKENAME头部两侧各有一张嘴，开合速度快得能让附近的水微微升温。不过，它们瞄得不太准，常常咬不中猎物。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME has two mouths, one on either side of its head. They open and close at such speeds that the nearby water heats up slightly, though they are not very precise and often miss their prey.

entry: POKENAME合拢上下两半，就造出几乎能反弹任何攻击的念力盾。中央尖端再射精神能量刺，进一步防御。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME closes its upper and lower halves it creates a psionic shield that reflects almost any attack. The pointed part in its center fires off spikes of psychic energy to further defend itself from attackers.

entry: POKENAME最多能给炮蓄能16小时，光束半径、射程都取决于蓄能多久。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME are capable of charging up their blasters for up to sixteen hours. The radius and length the beam travels depend upon the charge duration.

entry: 它滚过峡谷后，用鼻子收集被推开的泥土，留待之后当防御屏障，抵挡天敌。
author: .izik
source: After rolling through canyons, it uses its snout to collect displaced dirt. Later, it deploys this dirt as a defensive barrier against predators.

entry: POKENAME尾巴存坚果、树果，留着以后吃。受威胁，就把存粮飞快射出去。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME stores nuts and berries in its tail to eat later. When it is threatened, it will shoot its food out incredibly quickly.

entry: POKENAME静歇湖边石上，像普通岩石。黏壳自然吸来附近垃圾、藻类，睡在哪，就净化哪的水。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME rests motionless on lakeside rocks, appearing to be just another stone. Its sticky shell naturally pulls in any nearby trash or algae, cleaning the water wherever it naps.

entry: POKENAME不断蜕甲，每次新长的都更强。遍身各式炮口，如移动军团，朝敌人密集轰出水流。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME constantly shed their armor, regrowing it stronger each time. The assortment of cannons on their bodies make them walking armies, unleashing barrages of water blasts at foes.

entry: 它的藤状触须极结实，能紧缠敌人，再卷进纠结的身体，让其无法动弹。
author: .izik
source: Its vine-like tendrils are incredibly sturdy and can wrap tightly around foes. Once captured, it reels its prey into its tangled body for immobilization.

entry: POKENAME交配前，会挑选最好的结实原木，挖空内部，留待日后养育幼崽。
author: dodoowner_
source: Before mating with others, POKENAME will find the finest and strongest log and hallow it out. It will then raise its young there.

entry: POKENAME进电脑吸数据，机器外就长出怪壳。电脑开太久，壳硬如钢铁，几乎无法安全拆除。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME enters a computer to absorb data, an odd shell begins to grow around the machine. If left on too long, this shell becomes as hard as steel and is nearly impossible to remove safely.

entry: 臂上的刀刃变成了炮管，攻击方式也更难预测。铠甲哪怕受一点损伤，它都会伤心。
author: pokopish
source: The blades on its arms have turned into cannons and its attack patterns have become more unpredictable. Any damage to its armor causes it grief.

entry: POKENAME在厚甲身体内积蓄压力，借此从背上的炮射出种子。最远能射到100米外，准头却不怎么样。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME build up pressure within their thickly plated body and use this pressure to shoot out seeds from cannons from their back. These projectiles can be fired up to a hundred meters away, though they are not especially accurate.

entry: 它不断咬东西，试颚的力量。岩石、金属碎片，找到什么都不放过。
author: .izik
source: It tests the strength of its jaws by constantly biting down on objects. Anything it finds is fair game, from rocks to metal scraps.

entry: 融合后，POKENAME攻击性、猜疑猛增。一受挑衅，触手上的藤壶状突起就抽打，时速超过50千米。
author: hortensia_xxiii
source: POKENAME's aggression and paranoia have risen sharply since fusing. When provoked, it lashes the barnacle-like protrusions on its tentacles at speeds of over 50 kilometers per hour.

entry: POKENAME坚壳提供充分防御，主要用头撞进攻。撞击刺激又让头上突起，射出高速尖刺。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's sturdy shell plating gives it ample defenses against attacks. Its primary offense is its headbutt, the stimulation of which causes protrusions on its head to fire high-velocity spikes.

entry: 它大概在叫自己的名字，壳却闷得太厉害，根本听不清。平时多用中空尾巴，吹排箫般的哨音交流。
author: banquoviaquo
source: Presumably this Pokémon says its own name, but it's far too muffled by the shell to make it out. Instead, it mostly communicates using its hollow tail as a panpipe-like whistle.

entry: 它没有嗓音，缓慢脚步却撼地，脸上空管吹出葫芦丝般音调，因此以神秘威仪闻名。
author: banquoviaquo
source: Between its slow, groundshaking walking pace and the hulusi-flute tones that blow through its hollow facial pipes, this voiceless Pokémon has earned a reputation for mystic dignity.

entry: POKENAME厚甲能承受数吨冲击。研究者见过它们互射速度达2马赫的弹丸，撞击脆响，数英里外也听得见。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a thick carapace that can withstand impacts of several tonnes. Pokémon researchers have observed them firing projectiles at one another at Mach 2, the loud crack of the impacts audible for many miles.

entry: 它一感知飓风将至，金属壳便变硬。有研究者认为，这是想挡住强风卷来的碎屑。
author: .izik
source: Its metallic shell hardens if it senses an impending hurricane. Some researchers believe this reaction is an attempt to shield itself from debris carried by strong winds.

entry: 它在墓园附近徘徊，给哀悼者看似安慰的拥抱，实际上吸走悲伤，靠哀痛维生。
author: .izik
source: It lingers near graveyards, offering seemingly comforting hugs to mourners. However, it absorbs their sadness to sustain itself, feeding off their grief.

entry: 它行动迟缓得很，炮管发射弹丸却快得惊人。只有从下方攻击才能伤到它。
author: chorb33
source: It is incredibly sluggish and slow, but it can fire projectiles surprisingly quickly from its cannons. You can only damage it from the underside.

entry: POKENAME不太灵活，防御却无可挑剔，用结实的身体保护野生波加曼免遭危险。嘴和鳍肢的孔，能高速射出钢铁般坚实的冰柱。
author: sk372
source: With low mobility but impeccable defenses, POKENAME uses its sturdy body to protect wild Piplup from danger. Its mouth and the holes on its flippers can fire icicles as solid as still at high speeds.

entry: POKENAME甲片带强电，碰到时，电击能瞬间烧焦皮肤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's plates carry a strong electric charge. If touched, they can instantly char skin with a powerful shock.

entry: POKENAME睡时从头部炮口放出凉雾。接触这雾，会有强烈安抚作用。
author: .izik
source: While asleep, POKENAME releases a cool mist from the cannons on its head. When touched, this mist carries a powerful calming effect.

entry: POKENAME从炮里密集发射金属刺，包围敌人，封住退路，再靠近用强臂打击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires metallic spikes from its cannon in large bursts to surround foes. This prevents the foe's escape while it moves in to strike with its strong arms.

entry: 头盔硬如钛，提供强大防御。每晚它悉心擦亮，保持诡异光泽。
author: .izik
source: Its helmet is as hard as titanium, giving it formidable defense. Every night, it diligently polishes it to maintain its eerie shine.

entry: 发怒时，它从臂上锥形部位喷出烈焰。高热让沿途留下烧焦的路。
author: .izik
source: When enraged, it unleashes fiery blasts from the cones on its arms. The intense heat leaves scorched paths in its wake.

entry: POKENAME吃住处的石、土和其他矿物。消化时，部分材料压实，存入侧身小孔，留作高速射出来自卫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's meals consist of stone, dirt and other minerals in its home. As it digests, parts of the materials get compacted and stored in the pores on its sides, to be fired out at high speeds in self-defense.

entry: 虽看似胶状，表层物质却硬如玻璃，帮助抵御重撞。
author: .izik
source: Although it appears gelatinous, the material covering its body is as hard as glass. This toughness helps it withstand heavy impacts.

entry: 绒毛坚韧如钢，却能像棉花一样随意塑形。人们利用它柔软耐用的特点，制作铠甲和其他金属衣物。
author: soup1900
source: Its fluff is as hard as steel but malleable like cotton. It's used to make armor and other metal clothing since it's both soft and durable.

entry: 绒毛坚韧如钢，却能像棉花一样随意塑形。人们利用它柔软耐用的特点，制作铠甲和其他金属衣物。
author: soup1900
source: Its fluff is as hard as steel but malleable like cotton. It's used to make armor and other metal clothing since it's both soft and durable.

entry: POKENAME金属壳几乎没有开口，身体易过热，因此定期从颈周红孔，排放蒸汽。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are clad in a metal shell with little to no openings. Because of this, their bodies are often at risk of overheating, so they regularly vent steam from the red ports around their necks.

entry: 它将冰冻的外壳塑形染色，以此吓退天敌。研究者发现，每个外壳的色调与形状都有细微差别。
author: pokopish
source: It shapes and dyes its frozen shell to deter predators. Researchers note the subtle differences in each shell's hue and form.

entry: POKENAME始终警戒着自己照管的森林。一有入侵者，便从指尖射出脱落的金属甲片。
author: sandguything
source: Ever vigilant of the forests they tend, POKENAME will fire off discarded fragments of their metallic armor from their fingertips at intruders.

entry: POKENAME滴着带浓烈龙睛果味的酸唾液，还能从三个炮状肢体中的一个射出。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drools an acidic saliva with a strong Ganlon Berry scent. It can launch this fluid from one of its three cannon-like appendages.

entry: 它休息时藏在钢壳下，受威胁，便从壳上孔口释放各种有害花粉。
author: infinex21
source: It hides under its own steel shell when it rests. The ports along this shell can loose a variety of noxious pollens if this Pokémon feels threatened.

entry: 它从拳上的锥体精准射出尖刺，100英尺之外的目标，也能稳定命中。
author: .izik
source: It fires spikes from the cones on its fists with incredible precision. These spikes can reliably hit targets from over 100 feet away.

entry: 虽然菌菇藏在壳里，POKENAME的孢子仍能感染其他生物。它也能像其他佛烈托斯一样，缩入巨大的钢壳。
author: dodoowner_
source: Although its fungus is hidden by its shell, POKENAME spores can still infect others. It can retract into its large steel shell, like other Forretress.

entry: POKENAME对月长嚎时，全身所有管道会同时出声，各有不同。这时，壳会硬得如同钻石，直到长嚎结束才恢复。
author: .izik
source: While howling at the moon, POKENAME does so through all of the tubes on its body simultaneously, each producing a different noise. During this time, its shell becomes as hard as diamond, reverting once the howling is done.

entry: 它从钳上的炮射出毒粉，削弱敌人，产生的毒云极难躲开。
author: .izik
source: It fires Poison Powder from the cannons on its claws to debilitate foes. The toxic cloud it generates is difficult to avoid.

entry: 受到威胁时，POKENAME常将上身蜷成四面攻不透的球，哪怕被掀倒，也不影响防护。它会一直这样，直到攻击者放弃、离开。
author: fireblade141
source: When threatened, POKENAME will often use its ability to curl its upper body up into a ball that is impervious to attack from all sides, even if knocked off its feet. It will remain like this until whatever was attacking it gives up and leaves.

entry: POKENAME蘑菇状壳的磨痕，印证防御本领和年岁。它慢慢穿过林地，撒毒孢子，阻挡敌人。
author: mepp.
source: The wear sustained on POKENAME's mushroom-like shell is proof of its defensive capabilities and the age of the Pokémon. It slowly lumbers across the forest floor while scattering poisonous spores to deter foes.

entry: POKENAME从炮中发射尖刺时，强大的后坐力，足以震碎自己的钢铁外壳。只要身在臭氧层中，它就能吸收一些纳米粒子，修补外壳。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME fires off a spike from one of its cannons, the recoil from the blast is enough to crumble its steel shell. As long as it's in the ozone layer, it can absorb some nanoparticles to mend the shell.

entry: 骑士曾用POKENAME守城堡，以喷射火焰阻挡入侵者。战斗中，它用钢头盔弹开攻击。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME were once used by knights to defend castles, keeping invaders at bay with its Flamethrower. During battle, it deflects attacks with its steel helmet.

entry: POKENAME的身体相当敏感，很少将头探出地面太高。头颅由坚固的外壳保护，颈部的突起，还能发射锋利的石弹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is rather sensitive, so it rarely pokes its heads up very far above ground. Their craniums are protected by a sturdy shell, and they can fire sharp stone projectiles from the growths on their necks.

entry: 看见贵重物，额上宝石便温热。若是金属，它就吃下，加固头骨外壳。
author: .izik
source: The gem on its forehead grows warm when it spots something valuable. If the object is metallic, it consumes it to reinforce the shell on its skull.

entry: POKENAME大半时间发呆，忽略大多数外来刺激。真有东西惊醒它，就本能地造精神能量刺，射出自卫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends much of its time staring blankly into space, ignoring most outside stimuli. Should something manage to startle it out of its stupor, it instinctively creates and fires spikes made of psychic energy as a defense mechanism.

entry: POKENAME细心养护毛茸茸的外壳，保护里面密实肌肉。谁哪怕威胁到一根毛，它也狂怒，朝四面疯狂挥拳。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME take careful care of the fuzzy shells that protect their densely-packed muscles. If anyone threatens a single hair on their shells, POKENAME fly into a wild rage and punch furiously in all directions.

entry: 当地军方施压，要求捕捉POKENAME用于防卫，因此野外很少见。仍在野外的个体，也彼此相隔很远。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME are rarely found in the wild due to local military pressure to capture and utilize them for defense. Those that remain in the wild stay far away from one another.

entry: 硬壳渗出果香毒素，甜美却致命，引来小宝可梦，让对方很快在毒陷阱里倒下。
author: .izik
source: The hard shell on its body leaks a fruit-scented toxin. This sweet yet deadly aroma lures in small Pokémon, which quickly succumb to its venomous trap.

entry: POKENAME从侧孔发射磨尖的石弹。收拢四肢、合上壳，能让石片发射更频繁，距离也更远。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fires sharpened stone projectiles from the holes in its side. By tucking in its limbs and closing its shell, it can increase the rate and distance at which it can fire the stone shards.

entry: POKENAME尾巴太重，行动困难。可它本就爱待在一处，根本不算问题。
author: atlas3339098
source: POKENAME's tail is so heavy that it makes it difficult to move. This is hardly an issue given that the Pokémon prefers to stay in one place.

entry: 受惊，它嘴喷尖刺、乱跑，两头疯狂挥摆，所过一片混乱。
author: .izik
source: When startled, it spits spikes from its mouths and runs erratically. Both heads flail wildly, causing chaos in its wake.

entry: 两个头能把小金属片射到最远60英尺，第三头却只会撞。不过它是首领，因为另外两头的炮，太近反而打不到它。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Two of its heads can fire small scraps of metal up to 60 feet away. The third is only capable of bashing things with its head. This head is the leader, as the others' cannons cannot hit it at such a close range.

entry: POKENAME坚固的壳，既能让它浮在水中，也能抵挡危险水生猎手的袭击。货船会小心避开漂浮海面的POKENAME群。
author: caldonb
source: POKENAME's impressive shell is capable of keeping it buoyant, as well as withstanding attacks from dangerous aquatic predators. Cargo ships take care to avoid groups of POKENAME floating on the ocean's surface.

entry: POKENAME壳看似金属，实为冰，亮色来自自身产生的有机色素。
author: .jerden
source: Although it appears metallic, its shell is actually made of solid ice. The bright coloration comes from organic pigments produced by POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME钢般的外层，是吃岩石、矿物的副产物，用些力便可使其脱落。金属开始渗入、融合脊柱，被认为是接近进化。
author: bobosmith01
source: The steel-like outer layer that protects POKENAME is produced as a byproduct of its diet of rocks and minerals, and it can fall off with some force. When the metal begins to seep in and fuse with POKENAME's spine, it's thought that evolution is near.

entry: POKENAME会在一天中较暖和的时候出来。气温转凉，它就用种子伸出的藤蔓挖洞，在里面睡到第二天，再享受新的暖意。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME comes out during the warmer parts of the day. As the temperature cools, it uses the vines from its bulb to dig out holes for it to sleep in until the next day brings about more warmth for it to soak in.

entry: POKENAME尾端像钻，转眼就能钻地下。小小身体的巢却很复杂，森林地下常见这样的巢。
author: infinex21
source: With their drill-tipped tails, POKENAME are able to burrow underground at a moment's notice. The nests of these tiny Pokémon are rather complex and many can be found in the ground beneath forests.

entry: POKENAME虽长翅膀，却靠精神能力稍稍悬离地面。研究者称，是翅膀无力托起体重。
author: sleepyman0731
source: Despite having wings, POKENAME use their psychic abilities to float slightly above the ground. Researchers claim this is because POKENAME's wings are not strong enough to hold their own weight.

entry: POKENAME天生知道埋物在哪，用尾钻取骨吃。考古学家借它找古代葬地，却得小心，别让墓地受扰。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME has an innate sense for where things are buried. It drills into the ground with its tail to retrieve bones, which it feeds on. Archaeologists use POKENAME to find ancient burial sites but have to be careful they don't disturb them.

entry: POKENAME用钻尾固定岩石或树，纹丝不动地等进化。身体比铁硬，因此很少被打扰。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their drill-like tails to secure themselves into rocks and trees, where they remain without moving as they await evolution. Their bodies are harder than iron so they are rarely ever disturbed.

entry: 野生POKENAME极害羞，只与DNA相近者合得来。它用分泌物标领地，想必极臭；人闻不到，其他宝可梦却似乎很反感。
author: bobosmith01
source: Wild POKENAME are incredibly shy and only get along with those whose DNA is similar to their own. They use what must be foul-smelling secretions to mark their territory; although humans cannot detect the smell, other Pokémon seem to be repulsed.

entry: 小翅让它悬在最高枝附近，用藤蔓摘白球果。它更爱先弄落，再逐颗收集。
author: .izik
source: Its tiny wings allow it to hover near the highest branches, where it plucks White Apricorns with its vines. It prefers knocking them loose before collecting them one by one.

entry: POKENAME袋里养幼崽，住极深地下隧道，保护后代。虽没手，仍能靠钻尾守护全家。
author: equation8573
source: POKENAME raises its offspring in a pouch, living in extremely deep tunnels underground to keep its offspring safe. Even though it does not have hands, POKENAME can still defend its family using its drill tail.

entry: POKENAME被迫防卫，就把尾巴埋地，稳住自己，让墨汁射击更准确。
author: sk372
source: When put on the defensive, POKENAME buries its tail into the ground to stabilize itself. Doing this allows it to become much more accurate in its ink shots.

entry: POKENAME寿命长，运气好能活200年。可年纪越大，越慢慢失去自行捕猎的意愿。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME have very long lifespans, living up to 200 years if they are lucky. However, as POKENAME ages, it will slowly lose the will to hunt for itself.

entry: 或许是当土龙蛹时的习惯，POKENAME常把钻尾插树或岩石，倒挂睡觉。它也用尾钻取树汁，让许多生命受益。
author: infinex21
source: Perhaps due to their lives as Dunpods, POKENAME have a tendency to sleep hanging upside down, their drill-like tails burrowed into trees or rocks to hang from. They also use their tails to tap into sap within trees, to the benefit of many.

entry: POKENAME水下用钻状肢体迅速前进。老练潜水者相信，看幼崽学用全部五肢游泳，会带来好运。
author: sleepyman0731
source: When underwater, POKENAME use their drill appendages to travel swiftly. Seasoned divers believe it is good luck to witness baby POKENAME learning how to use all five limbs to swim.

entry: 按POKENAME躯干红圈，会发出各种好笑声音，深受幼儿喜爱。可脸上的红圈，按了会痛。
author: sk372
source: Pressing the red circle on POKENAME's torso makes it emit a variety of funny noises, making it popular with young children. Pressing the red circle on its face hurts it, however.

entry: POKENAME能用钻头攻击钳住的宝可梦。钳子妨碍用角掘地，因此一般留在地面。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can use its drill to attack any Pokémon it seizes with its pincers. The pincers prevent it from using the horn to burrow, so POKENAME generally remains above the ground.

entry: POKENAME在森林的林下钻穴而行，很少出现在地面。它们靠两只钻头，既能向前挖，也能向后挖；挖出的隧道，对混合土中的养分十分重要。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME burrow through the undergrowth in forests and are rarely seen above ground. They can dig both forward and backward thanks to their twin drills and they play an important role in mixing nutrients in the soil with their tunnels.

entry: POKENAME用尾钻挖地下，直到找到水。反复多次，建出隧道网当家。
author: sleepyman0731
source: POKENAME will use its drill tail to burrow into the ground until it has located water. POKENAME will do this various times in order to build a network of tunnels for its home.

entry: 游戏开发者曾用POKENAME在游戏里挖逼真洞穴、隧道。后来它太害羞，还挖错地方，便被取代。
author: equation8573
source: POKENAME was once used by game developers to dig realistic caves and tunnels in video games. It was replaced due to being too shy and digging in the wrong spots.

entry: POKENAME常用爪攀住钟乳石，倒挂睡觉。极少飞，遇天敌也只是匆匆爬走。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are often found sleeping upside down, using their claws to cling to stalactites. They rarely fly, only scurrying away when faced with a predator.

entry: 天气转凉，POKENAME便开始大吃。吃下足够维持整季的食物后，它就用钻头状尾巴挖个大洞，将自己埋进土里冬眠，直到春天。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gorges on food as the weather turns cooler. Once it has consumed enough to last the season, it digs a large hole with its drill-shaped tail and buries itself in the dirt to hibernate until spring.

entry: POKENAME住在历经数百年挖成的巨大地下洞，极少被人看见。危急时却会现身，救下快要丧命的洞穴探险者。
author: lasercraft32
source: POKENAME lives in massive underground caverns dug out over hundreds of years. It's rarely seen by humans, but will appear in moments of need to rescue cavers from their untimely demise.

entry: 它朝天在空中飘浮，却仍拍翅，仿佛正在飞。睡前将尾钻地，免得自己漂走。
author: oddwalls
source: Though it floats through the air facing the sky, it flaps its wings as though it were flying. It drills its tail into the ground before falling asleep to prevent itself from floating away.

entry: POKENAME性情平静温柔，生活缓慢。打哈欠，嘴里散出甜香，让附近生命困倦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a very calm and gentle personality, taking life at a slow pace. When it yawns, it generates a sweet scent from its mouth that invokes drowsiness in others near it.

entry: 翅膀太弱，撑不起持续飞行，它却一试就是几小时，想扑翅稍稍离地。这份坚持，展现坚定意志。
author: .izik
source: Its wings are too weak for sustained flight, but it spends hours attempting to flutter just above the ground. This persistent effort showcases its determination.

entry: POKENAME一察觉地下土居忍士等猎物，就从枝头俯冲，直钻泥土。精准得很少失手。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME detects prey like Nincada beneath the ground, it will dive from a branch and drill straight into the dirt. Its accuracy is so precise that it rarely misses its target.

entry: POKENAME很会讲故事。训练家常到它的洞穴拜访，向它请教丰富的智慧。
author: fenragon
source: POKENAME is a great storyteller. Trainers often visit this Pokémon's burrow to learn from its vast wisdom.

entry: POKENAME用头角掘地，沿途在身后洞壁铺上厚黄丝，加固隧道。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses the horn on its head to burrow through the earth. As it tunnels, it lines the walls behind it with thick yellow silk to reinforce them.

entry: POKENAME为何能在洞中穿行得又快又准，研究者仍在探究。它们还会替家族钻出结构精巧的地道。
author: schwaus
source: Researchers are still trying to determine how POKENAME navigate caves with such speed and precision. They have been known to drill elaborate burrows for their families.

entry: 大风暴中，POKENAME飞上崖边，将尾钻岩石固定，免遭强风吹走。
author: .izik
source: During heavy storms, POKENAME flies up to a cliffside and anchors itself by drilling its tail into the rock. This keeps it from being blown away by fierce winds.

entry: POKENAME能用耳挖地，虽很快疲倦，身体小却只需挖个小睡洞。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can use its ears to dig through the ground. It will quickly grow tired, but because its body is small, it only needs to dig a small burrow to sleep in.

entry: 它吃洞底宝石，用强尾打碎。这饮食让身体在暗光里微微闪亮。
author: .izik
source: It feeds on gems found on cave floors, breaking them apart with its powerful tail. This diet helps its body sparkle faintly in dim light.

entry: POKENAME难见，一察觉有人便瞬间传走，科学家甚至不确定是否自然存在于野外。强大训练家养的，也只会无力扑翅，难托起体重。
author: bobosmith01
source: Scientists are unsure if POKENAME exist naturally in the wild due to their obscurity and tendency to teleport away the moment they detect someone. Even a strong Trainer's POKENAME will weakly flutter around, unable to properly carry its own weight.

entry: 城都当地传说，POKENAME真正睁眼，就释放毁灭性力量。可这现象，从未被确切观察到。
author: bobosmith01
source: According to local Johtonian legends, when a POKENAME properly opens its eyes, devastating power is unleashed. However, this has never been properly observed.

entry: 城都民间故事说，野生POKENAME跳舞赞美太阳。人们也见它在晴朗林地空隙，用翅表演精巧空中舞。
author: sleepyman0731
