source: POKENAME live extremely deep underground. Researchers have found that their cave systems are covered in strange crystals that appear to produce an aurora-like effect during crescent moons, despite moonlight being unable to illuminate them.

entry: POKENAME孢子让多数表面长出岩石般的真菌。对人无害，却很伤岩石属性宝可梦，一碰就能造成疼痛的麻痹。
author: sk372
source: The spores POKENAME produces cause rock-like fungi to grow on most surfaces. Though harmless to humans, these strange mushrooms can be very harmful to Rock-type Pokémon, causing painful paralysis with a single touch.

entry: POKENAME头上的未知金属，能发锣般巨响，铛声传数英里。声音似让它发狂，战中攻击性、力量都增加。
author: evilgammon
source: The unknown metal on POKENAME's head acts as a loud gong, with its booming clangs being heard for miles. This sound seems to whip POKENAME into a frenzy, increasing its aggression and strength in battle.

entry: POKENAME身体的宝石被称为“银钻”。晶体结构近乎完美，被视为世界最坚固的材料之一。
author: turron_turron
source: The gems making up the body of POKENAME are known as "Silver Diamonds." These crystals are considered to be one of the strongest materials in the world due to their near-perfect crystalline structure.

entry: POKENAME上排牙是燧石般的岩，下排全由钢铁构成。一合牙，火星四溅，溅到的东西会稍稍烧焦。
author: evilgammon
source: The top row of POKENAME's teeth is flint-like rock, and the bottom row is solid steel. By chomping down, it creates a shower of sparks, lightly singeing anything caught in it.

entry: 它们感知大地振动，找到地底洞窟。间歇泉储水处干涸，便群集到那里，吃留下的岩石。
author: quackquackattack
source: Their sense of earthly vibrations allows them to detect caverns below the surface. When the water reservoir of a geyser dries out, they are known to flock to that location to consume the rocks left behind.

entry: POKENAME浑身贴金，不停向洞里住客炫耀。却分不清黄金和黄铁矿，亮晶晶的装饰，大多只是愚人金。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME covers itself in gold, constantly flaunting it to the other cave denizens. However, it can't distinguish between gold and pyrite, so most of its bling is actually just fool's gold.

entry: POKENAME身上刮痕，似来自野外竞争战，因为已知人造材料，都未成功划伤它。两只互撞，铿锵巨响震耳欲聋。
author: sk372
source: Scratches on POKENAME's body appear to be made from rival fights in the wild, as no known manmade material has managed to scratch it. The clangs made by two POKENAME tackling each other are ear-splitting.

entry: POKENAME的铠甲由经过淬炼的钢构成，能承受极高温度。巨锤击中的一切，都会被点燃。
author: kduffradio
source: The tempered steel that makes up POKENAME's armor can withstand extremely high temperatures. It sets ablaze anything it strikes with its large hammer.

entry: POKENAME掘地时蹭锐石，保持铂金身体光洁。它钻得极深，承受四周地层的巨大压力与高热。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME maintain a polished platinum body by scraping their body against sharp rocks while burrowing. They dig so far beneath the surface that they experience immense pressure and heat from the surrounding earth.

entry: POKENAME住大铁矿床旁，吃铁加固金属外皮。铁耗尽，就猛撞穿地，直到找下一个矿床。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives near large iron deposits, feeding on the iron to strengthen its metal hide. If it runs out of iron, it will smash itself through the earth until it finds a new deposit.

entry: POKENAME身体产生明亮的水蓝色火焰，热得惊人。金属身体的特殊蹄，让它能爬近乎垂直的崖，因此难以追踪或捕捉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce bright aqua flames from their bodies that grow incredibly hot. Their metallic bodies also have special hooves that help them climb near vertical cliffs. This ability to climb cliffs makes them difficult to track or capture.

entry: 住在富含钾矿的洞穴，让它的火焰变成美丽紫色。它却很少用火，更爱用钢铁身躯踩踏对手。
author: mistymagius
source: Due to living in caves with high amounts of potassium deposits, its flames have turned a gorgeous shade of purple. It rarely uses its flames, however, as it prefers to trample its opponents with its steel body.

entry: POKENAME虽然身体沉重，却能高速奔腾，身后一路拖着漆黑的火焰。它会奔上力所能及的最高峰，守望整座山，身姿格外醒目。
author: sk372
source: Despite its heavy body, POKENAME can gallop at high speeds, trailing dark flames behind it all the while. It races to the highest peaks it can and stands watch over the mountain, cutting a striking visage.

entry: POKENAME壳上炮管的火力和弹药都与火药大炮相似。它用高压水流射出钢球，射程可达数英里，足以击毁军舰。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME's shell cannons have the firepower and ammunition akin to a gunpowder cannon. It uses pressurized water to shoot the steel balls, which travel for miles and are capable of destroying warships.

entry: POKENAME身上的金属外壳形似另一种宝可梦的头骨，能借此吓退海里的其他宝可梦。它游弋在冰冷的深水中，捕食躲在岩石间的宝可梦；那些岩石轻易就会被它击碎。
author: fiordaliso
source: The metal shell covering POKENAME's body resembles the skull of another Pokémon, which helps it intimidate other sea Pokémon. It swims in the depths of icy waters, feeding on Pokémon that hide among rocks, which it can easily destroy.

entry: POKENAME会用钢铁外壳困住贸然靠近的猎物。为了保持金属牙齿锋利，它每天都会撕碎栖息水域上方形成的永久冻土。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its steel shell to trap prey that unwisely approaches its position. To keep its metal teeth sharp, it shreds the permafrost that forms above the waters where it lives every day.

entry: POKENAME会在漆黑的洞穴里将迷路的登山者逼入绝境，袭击他们并夺走灵魂。灵魂会储存在它身上长出的晶体中，用来增强幽灵属性攻击。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME corners lost hikers in dark caves, attacking and stealing their souls. These souls are stored in the crystals growing from its body and used to amplify its ghost attacks.

entry: POKENAME生性凶猛，却常蛰伏不动，往往藏身于金属矿山中。它睡在成簇的贵重矿物下，一旦被惊扰就会凶狠地袭击对方。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME is an aggressive yet dormant Pokémon, often found camouflaging in metal mines. It sleeps beneath clusters of valuable minerals and attacks viciously if disturbed.

entry: 巨钳过于庞大，POKENAME只能拖着身体在海底爬行。它会把富含矿物质的矿石夹碎，再将碎屑铲入口中吃掉。任何落入钳中的生物都会被碾得粉碎。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME drag themselves across the ocean floor due to their gigantic claw. They eat mineral-dense ores by crushing them and shoveling the remains into their mouths. Any creature caught in POKENAME's pincer is pulverized.

entry: POKENAME背上长着一株小树苗，会结出粉红色的树果。这些树果看似美味，对人却有很强的毒性，只能喂给宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a small sapling sprouting from their back that produces pink berries. While they may seem delicious, they are quite poisonous to people and should only be fed to Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME会拼命保护自己的蛋，冲向一切靠近的东西并发出嘶声。就连训练家也只能看，不能碰它的蛋。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME defends its eggs with its life, charging and hissing at anything that gets close. Not even its Trainer is allowed to touch its eggs, though they are permitted to look.

entry: POKENAME有一根格外珍惜的骨棒，会叼在嘴里或用爪子拿着，细心照料。它不肯让大多数人触碰，所以愿意托付这根骨头，就代表着极高的信任与敬重。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a special boney club that they take care of, carrying it in their mouths or their paws. They refuse to let most people touch it, so being entrusted with this special bone is a sign of high trust and respect.

entry: POKENAME很为自己又大又蓝的舌头骄傲，逢人便展示。要是没人夸赞舌头的大小和颜色，它就容易闹别扭。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very proud of its big blue tongue, presenting it to any who would bear witness. It is prone to pouting if people do not compliment its size and hue.

entry: POKENAME很少顺着训练家的心意，尤其不肯在蛋的事情上让步。如果得到尊重和善待，它终究会变得亲近，只是这需要很长时间。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rarely acquiesces to the whims of its Trainer, especially if the situation involves its egg. It eventually warms up when treated with respect and kindness, but that is a long process.

entry: POKENAME很容易受惊。每当孩子敲打鱼缸，它就会摆出可怕的表情，用角撞向惹事的家伙。它不用经常进食，又喜欢安静，因此更愿意与老人相伴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are easily startled, so whenever a child taps on the glass of their tank, they make a scary face and ram their horn at the culprit. POKENAME tend to prefer being pets of the elderly, as they do not need to eat often and enjoy silence.

entry: POKENAME友善又爱玩，见到其他犬类宝可梦甚至会有些害羞，因此常会进化成与仙子伊布或叶伊布融合的形态。不过它很听训练家的话，稍加引导就能朝任何方向进化。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME is very friendly, playful, and even gets a little shy around other dog Pokémon. Due to this, they often evolve into Snubveon or Snubfeon, but they like to listen to their Trainers and can be guided into any evolution with a little coaching.

entry: 有人说，POKENAME五彩的毛色预示着它将来会进化成什么样。它活泼外向又贪玩，是很受欢迎的宠物。
author: t3isukone
source: Some say the colorful fur of a POKENAME is a prediction of what they will evolve into. They are extremely playful and outgoing, and make very popular pets.

entry: 哪怕只是片刻不如意，POKENAME也会大发脾气，突然朝周围的一切使出电击。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME is denied even briefly, it erupts into a tantrum. During these outbursts, it releases a sudden Thunder Shock at anything nearby.

entry: POKENAME一心想避免争斗，却为此付出了代价。身体长得比外壳更快，被挤压得十分危险。这虽然让其他宝可梦不敢攻击，它却不得不忍受痛苦的一生。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME has a desire to avoid conflict, but this has come at its own expense. Its body grows faster than its shell and causes it to be dangerously compressed. This deters other Pokémon from attacking it but causes POKENAME to live a painful life.

entry: POKENAME虽然面目可怕、体形庞大，其实很温和，喜欢人们陪它玩，也乐意让人爬到身上玩耍。它食量很大，却很容易被气势汹汹的宝可梦吓得放弃食物。
author: soup1900
source: Despite its scary face and large size, POKENAME is actually very kind and likes to have people play with or on it. It loves to eat a lot, but it can easily be scared into giving up food by any intimidating Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME很黏人，喜欢被宠爱。第一个给它零食的人会被它认定，从此无论走到哪里，它都会紧紧跟随。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is clingy and likes to be spoiled. It imprints on the first person to give it a treat, following them closely and endlessly from that moment on.

entry: POKENAME难伺候是出了名的，性格往往自鸣得意又自以为是，因此很受同样心态的社会名流喜爱。尽管表面如此，它其实是忠诚的伙伴。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: POKENAME are infamously high-maintenance, often having smug and self-righteous personalities. As such, they are favourites among social elites who share that mindset. Despite this outward appearance, they genuinely are loyal companions.

entry: POKENAME会用喙轻柔细致地为训练家和幼崽梳理。它虽然总皱着脸，天性却平和而体贴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME grooms its Trainer and young with careful beak strokes. Despite its scowl, it is calm and nurturing by nature.

entry: POKENAME亲人又合群，喜欢与大家待在一起。一群兴奋的POKENAME会每隔一秒齐声吠叫。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are affectionate and social creatures that love spending time with others. A group of excited POKENAME will bark every second at the same time in unison.

entry: POKENAME一旦被惹恼，就会朝惹它生气的对象吐出黏丝。裸露的皮肤长时间接触这些丝，会起瘙痒的皮疹。
author: .izik
source: When irritated, POKENAME spits sticky silk at the source of its frustration. Prolonged contact with the silk can cause itchy rashes on exposed skin.

entry: POKENAME好争执，常为琐事和训练家吵闹，也可能突然变得挑食。这种反抗是在试探界限，因为它还在学习如何与他人相处。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a pugnacious tendency to argue with its Trainer over trivial matters and can suddenly become picky over its food. This defiance is a way of testing boundaries, as it is still learning how to interact with others.

entry: POKENAME很亲人，喜欢蹭训练家。这样会在周围积起静电，也让自己的羊毛变得蓬松。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are affectionate creatures that love to rub against their Trainer. This causes static to build around them and fluffs up their wool.

entry: POKENAME引以为傲的羊毛每年都会参加专门的评比，只有最出色的个体才能入选。要是有人弄乱它的发型，它就会大发雷霆，到处迸出电火花。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its prized wool is judged yearly in special contests open only to the finest specimens. If someone messes up its hairstyle, POKENAME becomes furious and starts releasing sparks everywhere.

entry: POKENAME虽然看起来总在生气，其实感情深厚。它会朝不喜欢的对象喷水，待在训练家身边时尤其如此。
author: .izik
source: Though its face appears grumpy, POKENAME is deeply affectionate. It spits water at those it dislikes, especially when near its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME虽然可爱，爱啃东西的习惯却破坏力十足。它只是想磨短不断生长的牙齿，却会啃坏桌腿、咬爆车胎，甚至咬伤脚踝。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME are cute, but their need to chew is highly destructive. They are only trying to keep their constantly growing teeth down, but their gnawing can ruin table legs, burst car tires, and injure ankles.

entry: 对战时，POKENAME能精准地操纵带爪的尾巴，将对手割伤，准头令人胆寒。不战斗时，尾爪能帮助它抓稳树枝，在枝间荡来荡去。
author: quackquackattack
source: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME can maneuver their clawed tail with terrifying precision to slice up their opponents. When they are not fighting, the claws on their tail give them extra grip when they swing between branches.

entry: 春天时，POKENAME头上蝴蝶结般的嫩芽会转得更快。研究者尚不清楚原因，有人认为这是它为夏天将至而兴奋的表现。
author: .izik
source: The bowlike sprout on POKENAME's head spins faster during spring. Researchers are unsure why, though some believe it signals excitement for summer.

entry: POKENAME会展开耳朵表达亲近，但这会把脸扯成难看的怪相，常让人望而却步。要是觉得自己不受欢迎，它就会悄悄走开，在身边围起一道泥墙。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: To show affection, POKENAME flays its ears. This forces its face into an unpleasant grimace, and many are put off by this. If it feels unwanted, it slinks off and makes a wall of mud around it.

entry: POKENAME背上长着一棵小树，结出的粉红色树果对人有毒。它会把树果分给饥饿、需要补充体力的POKENAME。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a small tree growing from their backs that produces pink berries poisonous for people to consume. They give out these berries to hungry POKENAME who need an extra boost of energy.

entry: POKENAME虽然不识字，却总能莫名地察觉附近的文字拼错了。它会绕着自身的轴线飞快旋转，闹上好几个小时才平静下来。
author: .izik
source: While unable to read, POKENAME somehow always senses when nearby text is misspelled. It will rotate on its axis rapidly while throwing a tantrum for hours until it calms down.

entry: POKENAME天性爱玩，喜欢和训练家拔河。尾巴很容易兴奋过头，还爱咬人。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME has a playful nature and enjoys games of tug-of-war with its Trainer. The tail gets easily overexcited and tends to bite.

entry: 被发现时，POKENAME会摆出吓人的表情，试图吓跑发现自己的对象。如果没用，它就会用尾巴钻入地下逃走。
author: darkweavile428
source: When spotted, POKENAME will make a scary face to try and scare away the one who saw it. If that doesn't work, it burrows into the ground with its tail to escape.

entry: POKENAME亲人又爱拥抱。每当训练家回家，它都会守在门边，飞扑上来送一个意外的拥抱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are affectionate creatures that love to give out hugs. Whenever their Trainer comes home, they are always waiting by the door to give out a surprise hug, flying into their Trainer.

entry: POKENAME极其挑食，只吃品质最好的食物，为此偶尔会走出平时的领地。鲜艳的体色让捕食它的宝可梦很容易发现它。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is incredibly picky and only eats the highest quality food, which causes it to occasionally wander out of its typical territory. Its bright coloration means it is easy for predator Pokémon to spot it.

entry: POKENAME十分固执，却又极不愿争斗。哪怕其他宝可梦攻击它、试图赶走它，它仍会若无其事地沿着认定的路前进。华美的皮毛让它成了偷猎者的目标。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is incredibly stubborn but also incredibly non-confrontational. Even if other Pokémon try to shoo it away with attacks, it will simply tread along its desired path in a blasé manner. Its luxurious fur makes it a target of poachers.

entry: POKENAME会周游世界，给乖巧的宠物宝可梦送礼物。对不听话的宠物，它则会挥动装满零食的沉重袋子，狠狠敲上一记以示训斥。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME travel around the world, giving out gifts to well-behaved pet Pokémon. Badly-behaved pets instead get a scolding wallop from the heavy sack of treats it carries.

entry: POKENAME咬紧对手后，会喷出灼热的气息。火焰的温度足以熔化铜线。
author: .izik
source: After locking its jaws on a foe, POKENAME unleashes a fiery breath. The flames it produces are hot enough to melt copper wiring.

entry: POKENAME会用可爱的模样让猎物放松警惕，再突然咬下，注入毒液。不过，这也让大多数宝可梦在对战时不把它当回事。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its cutesy appearance to catch its prey off guard before striking them with its venomous bite. However, this leads to most Pokémon not really taking it seriously in combat.

entry: POKENAME一闹别扭，柔软的角就会飞快地抖动，随后便试图用封印困住附近的敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's soft antlers wiggle rapidly when it begins to pout. Soon after, it attempts to trap nearby foes using Imprison.

entry: POKENAME虽然有力气将身体盘住的树木绞碎，性格却很胆怯。如果凶相和低吼都吓不退威胁，它就会惊恐万分地游走。
author: sk372
source: Despite possessing the power to crush trees with its coils, POKENAME is rather meek. If its intimidating appearance and growling doesn't ward off a threat, it slithers off in utter terror.

entry: POKENAME是少见却很讨人喜爱的家养宠物，能很快与人亲近，可惜也因此容易产生分离焦虑。饲养者必须留心，因为它一闹脾气就会冒出刺鼻的浓烟。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is a rare but beloved housepet, renowned for bonding quickly, but unfortunately to the point of separation anxiety. Owners must take care, as its tantrums result in thick, acrid smoke billowing from it.

entry: POKENAME很爱受关注。如果训练家太久不理它，它常会电对方一下。奇妙的是，它喜欢被打扮，给它穿上各式服装已成了颇受欢迎的风尚。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME adores attention and will often shock its Trainer if they ignore it for too long. Oddly enough, it loves to be dressed up, and it is quite the popular trend to dress up POKENAME in all sorts of outfits.

entry: POKENAME平时很乖，一见到同类却容易好斗。两只相遇时，几乎总会先飞快地互踢好几脚。
author: sk372
source: Though usually well-behaved, POKENAME gets feisty in the presence of others of its kind. A meeting between two POKENAME almost always starts with an exchange of numerous rapid kicks.

entry: POKENAME天性疏离，总摆出高人一等的样子，因此很受名流喜爱。不过它能感受他人的情绪，私下里对在乎的对象会格外温暖亲昵。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: Standoffish by nature, POKENAME act superior to others, making them favourites with socialites. Despite this, their empathic abilities allow them to become highly warm and affectionate towards those they care about in private.

entry: 最乖戾的时候，POKENAME会用尚在成长的精神力量捉弄、骚扰周围的人。不过它心底深爱着在乎的对象，总会尽力用逐渐增强的力量保护他们。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: At their most churlish, POKENAME uses its developing psychic powers to prank and harass those around it. However, it secretly holds deep affection for those it cares for, using these growing powers to protect them whenever possible.

entry: POKENAME会拼命保护训练家。受到威胁时，它会发出由精神力量增强的吠声，将敌人吓得四散逃窜。虽然举止凶悍，它最喜欢的却是陪孩子玩换装和茶会游戏。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: POKENAME are fiercely protective of their Trainers. If threatened, they unleash a psychically enhanced bark that sends foes scurrying. Despite their aggressive demeanor, they love nothing more than playing dress-up or tea parties with children.

entry: POKENAME通常很乖，但表情几乎不变，心情很难捉摸。唯独光环被碰到时，它会露出牙齿，发出沙哑而空灵的低吼。
author: sk372
source: Though generally well-behaved, POKENAME's lack of changing expression can make it difficult to judge its mood. The only exception is if something touches its halo, whereupon it bears its teeth and utters a scratchy, ethereal growl.

entry: POKENAME猛咬一口就能咬碎混凝土，随后注入的毒液会使对方头晕并产生幻觉。
author: .izik
source: With one crushing bite, POKENAME can shatter concrete. It follows up with venom that induces dizziness and hallucinations.

entry: POKENAME背上长着一棵会结粉红色树果的树。有宝可梦想吃点东西，它就会慷慨地赠送树果，也很喜欢其他宝可梦在枝叶下休息。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a tree sprouting from their back that produces pink berries. They offer these berries freely to Pokémon that want to have a quick bite and love when other Pokémon rest beneath their branches.

entry: POKENAME通常遇到争斗就逃，但保护弱小的本能会压过退意。为了守护体形较小的宝可梦，它会展现出惊人的顽强。
author: sk372
source: While POKENAME will typically flee from most fights, its protective instincts will outweigh this tendency. In defense of smaller Pokémon, it will fight with a surprising amount of tenacity.

entry: POKENAME很反感别人崇拜自己，很快就会发火。它会试图咬那些冒犯者，力道足以压扁钢铁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME reacts poorly to those who attempt worship and quickly loses its temper. It will attempt to bite offenders with enough force to flatten steel.

entry: POKENAME的大耳朵能听见一英里以外训练家的声音，随后便会笨拙又欢快地蹦跳着奔向对方。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's large ears can detect its Trainer's voice from over a mile away. It bounds toward them in joyful, clumsy hops.

entry: 野生的POKENAME一不高兴，就会飞快地前后乱扑，想引人注意，刀刃也随之肆意挥舞。想让它平静下来，唯一能保证安全的办法是轻轻拍它的后脑勺。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: When a wild POKENAME gets upset, it will rapidly flail back and forth for attention, swinging its blades with reckless abandon. The only guaranteed safe way of calming it down is gently patting it on the back of the head.

entry: POKENAME一不如意，就会放声大哭，朝四面八方甩打触须。它无意造成重伤，但被抽中仍会淤青。
author: .izik
source: When it does not get its way, POKENAME cries loudly and lashes its feelers in all directions. While it does not seek to cause serious harm, contact with these slaps can cause bruising.

entry: POKENAME虽然长得吓人，其实极其胆小，只要觉得附近有人就会逃走。被困住时，它会大声咆哮，试图吓退周围的对象；如果仍无法脱身，才会动用奇异的力量。
author: bobosmith01
source: Despite its appearance, POKENAME is incredibly timid and will flee if it thinks anyone is near. If trapped, it will let out a mighty roar in an attempt to intimidate those nearby. They begin using odd powers if they are still cornered afterwards.

entry: 与布鲁不同，POKENAME会模仿怒犬四处跑，专门吓唬小型宝可梦与孩子。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Unlike a Snubbull, POKENAME runs around mimicking an angry dog, scaring small Pokémon and children.

entry: POKENAME讨厌被说可爱，谁这么说，它就想找谁打架。它对他人的情绪十分敏感，会奋力保护心情低落的对象。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hates being called cute and will try to fight anyone who does. It is very sensitive to others' emotions and will fiercely defend those who are feeling down.

entry: POKENAME一旦咬住敌人，就会释放强烈的电流。随着它越咬越紧，附近的收音机也会受干扰，传出杂音。
author: .izik
source: Once it clamps onto a foe, POKENAME discharges powerful electric bursts. Radios in the area flicker into static as it bites down.

entry: POKENAME虽然外表强悍，其实很胆小。察觉危险时，它会低吼着掩饰恐惧，毛皮间同时放出耀眼的电光。
author: skittytales
source: In spite of its tough appearance, POKENAME is quite timid. If it senses danger, it growls to hide its fear and discharges blindingly bright electricity from its fur.

entry: POKENAME自以为比实际模样吓人得多，见到陌生事物就会跑上前低吼。不过，只要抓住它头顶的毛簇，它立刻就会服服帖帖。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME thinks of itself as far more intimidating than it actually appears. It runs up and growls at anything unfamiliar, but grabbing it by the tuft on its head will instantly subdue it.

entry: POKENAME受到威胁时会竖起毛发、迸出火花，朝潜在的危险大声低吼。可惜它实力不强，若这番威吓不起作用，也就没什么别的办法了。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spikes out its fur and sheds sparks when threatened, growling strongly at potential danger. Unfortunately its strength is rather meager, so if the threatening display fails, there's little else it can do.

entry: POKENAME平时性情温和，但一旦选定地方安顿下来晒太阳，就会变得好斗。无论什么靠近，它都会低吼着用大叶子抽打。
author: sk372
source: Normally POKENAME has a placid personality, but when it chooses a spot to call its own to settle down and gather sunlight, it becomes more aggressive. It growls at and smacks anything that comes near with its large leaves.

entry: POKENAME是拥挤城市中常见的麻烦。哪怕一丝音乐声都会引它们从高处下来，随后便不合拍地乱叫，搅乱街头演出。
author: jaminmcready
source: In crowded cities, POKENAME are a common nuisance. Even the faintest music will call them down from above where they then start to bark offbeat and disrupt any street performance.

entry: POKENAME看似野蛮叛逆，但训练家只要替它梳理鬃毛，那副强硬的模样就会化作亲昵。它有多不愿当众撒娇，就有多渴望被关爱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME may seem like wild, rebellious creatures but this tough exterior melts into affection when Trainers brush through their mane. Their reluctance for public affection is only matched by their desire to feel loved.

entry: POKENAME很需要陪伴，想引人注意时会用头顶训练家。抚摸它头上敏感的鳞片，是建立信任的好办法。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are needy creatures that headbutt their Trainer when they want attention. Petting the sensitive scale on their head is a good way to develop trust with a POKENAME.

entry: 喜爱POKENAME的人称赞它是理想的宠物，既有布鲁可爱的脸，又有煤炭龟温暖的身体。不过训练家也得留心它惊人的食量：吃下的食物很快就会在体内的熔炉中烧尽。
author: .jerden
source: Fans of POKENAME claim that it makes a great pet, as it has Snubble's cute face and Torkoal's warm body. Trainers should be aware that it also has a ravenous appetite, as any food it eats is quickly burned up by the furnace inside it.

entry: POKENAME极其自私，看见甜食，就毫不犹豫地偷走。若没拿到自己认为应得的那份，还会大发脾气。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is an extremely selfish Pokémon who will steal any sweet treat it can find without hesitation. It will throw a tantrum if it doesn't get the sweets it thinks it deserves.

entry: 给POKENAME喂零食时，一定要分成三份。若拿不到等量的三份，它就会像小孩子一样闹别扭，引发局部地震。
author: .izik
source: When feeding POKENAME a snack, it is important to always offer treats in amounts of three. Should it not receive three equal portions, it will begin pouting like a toddler and cause localized tremors.

entry: 它会摆出凶相，低吼着吓跑体形较小的宝可梦，抢走它们的东西。不过只要遭到反抗，它立刻就会变得胆怯，惊慌逃走。
author: sk372
source: It makes a frightening face and growls to scare smaller Pokémon away and steal their things. Should it face opposition, however, it immediately turns timid and runs away in fear.

entry: POKENAME是十分乖巧的家养宠物。建议买一根宝可尾草，满足它爱玩的天性。
author: bacondlx
source: POKENAME makes for an incredibly well-behaved house pet. It is recommended to purchase a Poké Toy to indulge its playful nature.

entry: POKENAME经常参加宝可梦华丽大赛，培育家争相选送口鼻最短、垂腮最明显的个体。额头钱币越亮，也往往越受青睐。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are a common entrant in Pokémon contests, with breeders competing to enter individuals with the shortest snouts and the most pronounced jowls. POKENAME with shinier forehead coins are often considered more desirable.

entry: POKENAME喜欢拥抱其他宝可梦，却常抱得太久，让对方不舒服。等到难免被推开时，它又会十分焦虑，甚至因压力而头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to give out hugs to other Pokémon but often cling on for an uncomfortable amount of time. When they are inevitably pushed away, they get so anxious that they may develop a headache from the stress.

entry: 名流们开始把POKENAME视作值得炫耀的名贵宠物，精心宠爱打扮。富裕地区也常举办比赛，比谁的POKENAME梳理得最整洁、装扮得最漂亮。
author: sk372
source: Socialites have begun seeing POKENAME as a fine trophy pet to pamper and preen. Competitions to see who has the most well-groomed and dressed-up POKENAME have become common in affluent locales.

entry: POKENAME鲜艳的粉红色和友好的性情很受宝可梦培育家喜爱。它很容易学会上台表演各种把戏，因此常被送去参加宝可梦华丽大赛。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular amongst Pokémon Breeders for their vivid pink colouration and friendly demeanour. They are commonly entered into Pokémon Contests thanks to the ease with which they can be trained to perform tricks on stage.

entry: POKENAME喜欢踩水坑、游泳，却讨厌雷雨，最常出没在城郊的乡野。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME love splashing in puddles and going swimming, but despise thunderstorms. They are most often found in the suburban countryside.

entry: POKENAME虽常大喊大叫、龇牙咧嘴，却既不危险也不好斗，很受新手训练家欢迎。
author: chorb33
source: Although POKENAME often shouts and grimaces, it is neither dangerous nor aggressive. It is a popular Pokémon for rookie Trainers.

entry: POKENAME深受世界各地小女孩的喜爱。它爱玩，颜色柔和又可爱，许多人过生日时都想要一只。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME are adored by little girls worldwide, their playful nature and cute pastel colours making them a popular birthday request.

entry: POKENAME总在生气，凡有东西经过，它都会低吼、嘶叫。不过它实在太懒，不会为这股怒气采取行动。
author: evilgammon
source: Being in a constant state of anger, POKENAME growls and hisses at anything that passes it. However, its too lazy to act on this rage.

entry: 不知为何，每只POKENAME的性格都十分极端。无论是过分黏人、极其固执，还是凶猛好斗，都常让训练家觉得难以招架。
author: bobosmith01
source: For reasons still not entirely clear, each individual POKENAME has an extreme personality. Whether utterly over-affectionate, intensely stubborn, or vicious and aggressive, POKENAME is often regarded by Trainers as a handful.

entry: POKENAME争强好斗，常蓬起羽毛、张开翅膀，想显得更吓人。它们争抢树梢向阳的位置，败者只好待在下层枝头。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are rather argumentative, puffing up their feathers and spreading their wings to try and appear more intimidating. They fight over sunny spots in the treetops, leaving those that lose the fights to stay on the lower branches.

entry: 圆滚滚的身体让POKENAME飞行很吃力，几乎总在烦躁。一旦气过了头，它就会炸成一团羽毛，还可能在鸟群中引发连锁爆炸。
author: pjporwoll
source: Due to its round body, POKENAME struggles with flying, leading to a near-constant state of annoyance. If it becomes too angry, POKENAME explodes into a puff of feathers, which can set off a chain reaction in a flock.

entry: POKENAME会把骨头藏在翅膀中，悄悄接近猎物。一进入射程，它便会突然投出一连串骨头回力镖，发动伏击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME conceal bones within their wings to sneak closer to their prey. Once they are in range, they ambush prey with a flurry of bony boomerangs.

entry: POKENAME会猛踢树干，震落藏在枝间的猎物。它也会凭武术奋力保卫猎场，击退企图抢占地盘的对手。
author: fiordaliso
source: It delivers devastating kicks to tree trunks to knock down prey hiding among the branches. With its martial arts techniques, POKENAME defends its hunting grounds fiercely from rivals who try to steal them.

entry: POKENAME的蛹由坚硬的角蛋白构成，很难穿透。遇到捕食者时，它会扇动小小的翅膀扬起尘土，趁机逃跑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME chrysalises are made of a hard keratin that makes them difficult to penetrate. They kick up dust by flapping their tiny wings to escape predators.

entry: 清晨，大群POKENAME会落在最喜欢的谷物种植地，一边喧闹地叫着，一边大口吞食小麦。多余的种子常卡在翅膀里，被带到远达20英里的地方。
author: mistymagius
source: In the early morning, large flocks of POKENAME descend onto their favorite grain plantations, gobbling up the wheat while squawking up a riot. Excess seeds often get caught in their wings, spreading them up to 20 miles away.

entry: POKENAME常欺负成群的烈雀，却也会保护它们，击退前来挑衅的大型宝可梦。它似乎觉得，这些小鸟只能由自己欺负。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tends to bully flocks of Spearow, yet at the same time defends them from larger Pokémon picking fights. It seems to believe that only it is allowed to pick on the little birds.

entry: POKENAME会把毒针上的毒液滴在栖息树木的根部，标记领地。若有同类闯入，双方就会扭打，直到一方疲倦、离开那棵树为止。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME marks its territory by dripping venom from its stinger onto the base of its tree. If another POKENAME enters its territory, they will wrestle until one becomes tired and leaves the tree.

entry: POKENAME的上半身很像普通烈雀。训练家有时会误以为它是溺水的烈雀，等水下的身体完全升起，才被吓得魂飞魄散。
author: hophoppip
source: The top part of POKENAME's body resembles an ordinary Spearow. Trainers sometimes mistake it for a drowning Spearow, only to be terrified when the rest of its body rises out of the water.

entry: POKENAME的毛皮会随环境和季节改变颜色与厚度，性情也往往随之变化。毛皮较薄或颜色较浅的个体，看起来更温顺。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's fur coat shifts color and thickness in accordance with its surroundings and the seasons. The changes usually come with a shift in attitude as well; POKENAME with thinner or lighter-hued coats appear more docile.

entry: 秋天，大树根部常能找到刚进化的POKENAME，它们藏在落叶下伪装。孩子在落叶堆里玩耍时，可能会无意中翻出埋在下面的它们。
author: afilthycasual
source: Newly evolved POKENAME are commonly found in autumn at the bases of large trees, camouflaged under fallen leaves. Children may accidentally uncover buried POKENAME when playing in piles of leaves.

entry: POKENAME好斗又善于乘虚而入，是危险的宝可梦。遇到它时切勿背对它，因为人只要一移开视线，它就可能立刻扑上来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are dangerous creatures, as they are aggressive and opportunistic. When encountering a POKENAME, it is advised to never turn one's back toward them, as they are known to pounce the moment a person looks away.

entry: 传说POKENAME狂躁地鸣叫时，就预示着可怕的风暴将至。它以水生软体动物为食，会用尖喙啄开它们的外壳。
author: fiordaliso
source: Rumor has it that when POKENAME squawks furiously, a terrible storm is about to arrive. It uses its sharp beak to crack open the shells of the aquatic mollusks it feeds on.

entry: POKENAME标记领地时很容易被激怒。一有入侵者，它就会发出一英里外都能听见的尖叫，向其他同类示警。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME are easily aggravated when marking territory. When their territory is invaded, they produce a high-pitched cry that can be heard from over a mile away to alert other POKENAME of an intruder.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀太短小，无法飞行，只能用精神力量浮空。升到空中后，翅膀便能帮助它加速、调整方向。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME's wings are too stubby to fly, so it instead uses its psychic power to levitate. Once in the air, its wings are useful for speeding up and controlling its direction.

entry: POKENAME是一只贪玩的小小鸟宝可梦，谁一靠近，就想拉对方玩捉迷藏。
author: smallcutekitty
source: POKENAME is a very playful tiny bird Pokémon. It will attempt to play hide and seek with anyone coming near.

entry: 大多数烈雀都把POKENAME当作异类。它没那么好斗，想融入哪个鸟群，常会被哪个鸟群赶走。多数个体一生都找不到归属。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME is considered an outcast to most Spearow. Its less aggressive behavior will often have it kicked out of any flock it tries to fit in with. Most POKENAME will never find where they belong.

entry: POKENAME的领地意识很强，会守护巢穴附近的树木。对入侵者使出催眠术时，它的眼睛会泛起粉红色的光。
author: .izik
source: Fiercely territorial, POKENAME guards the trees near its nest. Its eyes glow pink as it unleashes Hypnosis on intruders.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，脾气也暴躁。谁打扰它白天睡觉，它就会用识破追踪对方，穷追不舍地啄击。
author: .izik
source: Extremely territorial and quick-tempered, POKENAME uses Foresight to track and relentlessly peck at anyone disturbing its daytime sleep.

entry: POKENAME会从高处的树枝上扑向猎物，在上方扇动翅膀，用细长的腿将目标裹进黏网。绑好以后，它便把猎物拖回安全的树上。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME pounce on their prey from high branches, flapping above it and using their spindly legs to bundle their target up with sticky webs. Once they have it bound, they haul their prey back into the safety of the trees.

entry: POKENAME的体形和羽色，连融合前双方的同族都容易认错。不过，与外形相近的比雀不同，它随时都只挑身上食物最多的对象攻击。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: The body shape and feather colors of POKENAME are enough to confuse both sides of its fused 'cousins'. Though unlike a similarly shaped fusion, Pidgerow, it instead attacks whoever has the most food on them at any point.

entry: POKENAME的电囊尚未发育完全，却保留了烈雀的鲁莽，常成群围攻更大的宝可梦抢食。农夫常饲养它们，用电击驱赶有害的宝可梦，不过体形较大的害兽就应付不来了。
author: chibitales
source: Despite their electric sacs being underdeveloped, POKENAME retain the recklessness of Spearow, causing them to swarm larger Pokémon to steal food. Farmers often raise them to zap pest Pokémon, though larger pests are too much for them to handle.

entry: POKENAME会盯着月亮，只要月亮还在视野里，就一直把喙朝向它。这种行为已让研究者困惑了几十年。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fixates on the moon, keeping its beak pointed at it for as long as it remains in view. This behavior has puzzled researchers for decades.

entry: POKENAME的鸣声悠扬，带着安抚人心的音调。即使凶猛的敌人，听久了也会睡着。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's melodic chirps carry a soothing tone. Prolonged exposure to its song can cause even aggressive foes to fall asleep.

entry: POKENAME会啄地，寻找种子和露出的根来吃。躯干外包着的蛋壳让它跑步时常常绊倒自己。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME peck at the ground to find seeds and exposed roots to eat. They often trip over themselves whenever they are running because of the eggshell that surrounds their torso.

entry: POKENAME虽然领地意识很强，却会先用精神力量窥视闯入者的过去。只有不怀恶意的对象才获准通行。
author: .izik
source: Though fiercely territorial, POKENAME uses psychic power to gaze into a trespasser's past. Only those without ill intent are allowed through.

entry: 轻盈的羊毛覆在POKENAME身上，丝毫不妨碍它轻松翱翔。它飘过草甸，宛如一朵活的云。
author: .izik
source: The light wool that covers POKENAME's body does not obstruct its ability to effortlessly soar through the skies. It drifts through meadows like a living cloud.

entry: POKENAME和普通烈雀几乎没有区别，同样吵闹无礼，领地意识强。只是它需要更多食物，脾气也加倍暴躁，还没继承大比鸟那一半飘逸迷人的长羽。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME is barely different than a normal Spearow. POKENAME is just as territorial, loud and rude, only having twice the temper due to needing much more food than normal, and lacks the flowing, alluring hair of the Pidgeot half.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛不沾水，既能游泳也能飞行。潜水觅食时，一旦发现水草，它们便会大声鸣叫，互相通报。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME's water repellent feathers allow it to both swim and fly. When diving for food, they use their loud cries to alert each other to any aquatic plants they find.

entry: POKENAME会停在河流上方的树梢，紧盯顺流而下的鱼。羽毛不沾水，让它能潜入水中捕猎，再飞回巢穴。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME sit in the treetops above rivers, watching intently for fish swimming downstream. These Pokémon's plumage is hydrophobic, allowing them to dive underwater and catch prey before flying back to their nests.

entry: POKENAME飘过草甸时，羽毛会散发胡椒般的气味。香气能安抚附近的宝可梦，缓和领地争端。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME drifts over meadows, its feathers release a peppery scent. This aroma calms nearby Pokémon and eases territorial tensions.

entry: POKENAME会按需蓬起羽毛保暖，或扇动翅膀为蛋送凉风，将巢内温度稳定在18摄氏度。它十分护巢，谁靠得太近就啄谁。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME keep their nests at a steady temperature of 18 degrees C, fluffing their feathers or flapping cool air over their eggs as needed to maintain the temperature. They are very protective of their nests and peck at anyone who gets too close.

entry: 卡在POKENAME羽毛里的种子很容易生长，每天清晨都会冒出小树苗。同一群中的每一只，身上长的草本植物都可能不同。
author: .izik
source: Seeds caught in POKENAME's feathers grow easily, sprouting tiny saplings each morning. Each POKENAME in a flock might have different herbs growing out of it.

entry: POKENAME吃下复原种子虽然会昏倒，却似乎仍会在野外主动寻找。研究者推测，种子会与它的大脑产生某种反应，让它体验灵魂出窍般的感觉。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Even though consuming a Reviser Seed causes POKENAME to faint, they seem to seek them out in the wild. Researchers theorize that it reacts with their brain in such a way that it gives them an out-of-body experience.

entry: POKENAME会发出沙哑的叫声，张开翅膀让自己显得更大，避免被捕食者吃掉。人们认为夜里遇到它不吉利，常把它赶出城镇村庄，赶回森林。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME avoid being eaten by predators by releasing a hoarse caw and spreading their wings to appear larger. Meeting a POKENAME at night is regarded as bad luck, so they are chased out of towns and villages back into the forest.

entry: POKENAME会啄击其他宝可梦，或用藤蔓抽打它们，保卫领地。遇到同类时，双方可能会对峙，不断挺起胸膛，直到一方认输。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME defends its territory by pecking other Pokémon or using its vines to whip them. Whenever it meets another POKENAME, a stand-off can occur where both Pokémon continue to puff up their chests until one of them surrenders.

entry: POKENAME虽然身体粗壮，仍能靠翅膀优雅地滑过平原，寻找食物。科学家从它背上的花苞中合成了一种抗组胺药，能帮助治疗花粉引起的过敏。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite its stout body, its wings allow POKENAME to glide gracefully over the plains while searching for food. From the bud sprouting on its back, scientists have synthesized an antihistamine that helps treat pollen-induced allergies.

entry: POKENAME常常心情不佳，会凶狠地追逐任何被它视为领地入侵者的对象。占卜师会观察两颗头是在合作还是争吵，借此判断一个想法是好是坏。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is regularly in a bad mood, aggressively chasing any it deems an intruder to its territory. Fortune tellers watch its behavior for if the two heads are cooperating or arguing, interpreting that as signaling whether an idea is good or bad.

entry: POKENAME常待在高高的树枝间，用急促尖细的鸣叫彼此交谈。它们会凶猛地保卫树木，从高枝落下，啄击所有从下方经过的对象。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hang around high in tree branches chattering to one another in rapid high pitched chirps. They aggressively defend their trees, dropping from high branches and pecking at anybody passing underneath.

entry: POKENAME在大树内部筑巢，白天多半都在打盹。不过它领地意识很强，任何东西一靠近巢穴，就会遭到猛烈啄击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME makes its nest inside large trees, spending most of its time napping the day away. However, it is very territorial and will viciously peck at anything that comes near its nest.

entry: POKENAME会先尖叫一声，再挺着带倒刺的尾巴扑向敌人。往往只需一击，就能把目标打得晕头转向。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME chirps sharply before lunging at foes with its barbed tail. A single strike is often enough to stun its target.

entry: POKENAME自以为高同伴一等，总爱欺负同群成员，甚至威逼它们交出食物，任其挨饿。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will constantly bully other members of its flock, thinking itself superior. It will even threaten its flock members into giving up their food, leaving them to starve.

entry: POKENAME彼此决斗时，会用强壮的角突刺、横扫，试图撞倒对方。它体力好、平衡感也强，因此交锋常持续几十分钟，仍分不出胜负。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME duel each other by thrusting and swinging their mighty horns to knock each other over. Due to POKENAME's high stamina and good balance, these duels often go on for tens of minutes with no clear winner.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛带着淡淡的蜂蜜香，会用这股甜香讨好旅人，让对方分些食物给自己。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feathers give off a faint honey scent. It uses its sweetness to charm travelers into sharing their food.

entry: POKENAME会从喙中吐出灼热火焰，足以把坚实的巨石熔成一滩熔岩。它主要栖息在火山一带。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits searing flames from its beak, hot enough to melt solid boulders into pools of lava. It lives primarily near volcanic areas.

entry: POKENAME平时虽然莽撞，彼此玩耍时却十分可爱。很少见到宝可梦像它们这样互相背着玩，鸟类宝可梦中尤其罕见。
author: chinigan
source: Despite their usual brash nature, POKENAME engage in play with one another in an adorable manner. Few Pokémon have been observed giving piggyback rides to one another as POKENAME do, especially in bird-like species.

entry: 它会混进烈雀群中，趁对方不注意，偷走食物。POKENAME一生中，只长得出少数几根钢羽。
author: mistymagius
source: It will disguise itself amongst flocks of Spearow, planning on taking their food while their unaware. POKENAME only produce a couple of steel feathers in their lifetime.

entry: POKENAME如同蛇形风筝，在空中蜿蜒前进。尖喙覆着微毒，能使猎物虚弱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slithers through the air like a serpent-like kite. Its sharp beak is coated in a mild toxin that can weaken prey.

entry: 爱玩的POKENAME会扇动翅膀般的耳朵，飞过短短一段路。它能轻松灵巧地从树上摘下白球果。
author: .izik
source: The playful POKENAME uses its wing-like ears to flutter short distances. It deftly plucks White Apricorns from trees with effortless skill.

entry: POKENAME体形太大，无法长时间离地飞行。它领地意识极强，会蜷成一团，从树上扑向入侵者。
author: santon5512
source: Due to their size, POKENAME are unable to keep themselves off the ground for long. These Pokémon are incredibly territorial, curling up into a ball before throwing themselves from trees at intruders.

entry: POKENAME会用尾巴上的颜料，在岩石和倒木上画出同伴的模样。飞行时，它会像旋翼一样转动尾巴，延长滞空时间。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME paints its flockmates onto rocks and logs using pigment from its tail. When flying, it twirls its tail like a rotor to stay airborne longer.

entry: POKENAME的奶是制作上等奶酪的珍贵原料。不过，为了守住奶水，它会凶狠地啄击不信任的对象。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's milk is a prized ingredient in fine cheeses. However, it viciously pecks at anyone it does not trust to defend its supply.

entry: POKENAME争强好胜，有时很难与同伴合作。只要认定谁是对手，它就会挺起胸膛、拍打翅膀，显示自己的优势。
author: regulavish
source: Its highly competitive spirit can at times make it difficult for POKENAME to work alongside its allies. It will puff out its chest and beat its wings in a display of dominance at anyone it perceives as a rival.

entry: POKENAME的喙上电光噼啪作响。战斗时，它会释放强力电击，能击晕体形两倍于自己的敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's beak crackles with electricity. In battle, it fires powerful shocks capable of stunning foes twice its size.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛致密坚挺，比玄武岩更硬。扇动翅膀时，羽毛碰撞作响，宛如石头相互刮擦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feathers are dense and rigid, harder than basalt. They rattle when it flaps its wings, producing a sound like stone scraping stone.

entry: POKENAME在城市街道上空盘旋，观察人们的动作。到了夜里，它们便聚在一起，整齐地模仿白天所学，场面令人毛骨悚然。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME circles city streets from the air, studying people's movements. At night, it gathers with others to mimic what it learned in eerie unison.

entry: POKENAME能用头上的钻头钻穿山岩，凿出防盗的巢穴。它的身体太庞大，一对翅膀只能支撑极短时间的飞行。
author: fiordaliso
source: The drills on its head allow POKENAME to pierce the mountain rock so it can carve out a theft-proof nest. Its body is so massive that its pair of wings can only keep it airborne for very limited periods of time.

entry: POKENAME重得无法飞行，却是敏捷的短跑高手。即便被天敌抓住，对方也很难突破它的甲片。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME is too heavy to fly, but it is an agile sprinter. Even predators that catch it will have trouble getting through its plating.

entry: POKENAME每到秋天都会换羽，沿途落下的羽毛像金黄的落叶。到了春天，新的羽毛才开始长出。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME molts every autumn, leaving trails of feathers that resemble fallen golden leaves. New feathers begin forming during the spring.

entry: POKENAME在高高的枯草中筑巢，便于藏身。它是凶猛的猎手，会潜伏在草间跟踪虫属性宝可梦，趁猎物不注意时冲上去袭击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME make their nest in tall dry grass where they can hide themselves. These Pokémon are aggressive hunters, stalking bug Pokémon in the grass before rushing forward and attacking when their prey isn't looking.

entry: POKENAME刺耳的叫声在半英里外都能听见，可用来震慑敌人。若潜在的威胁仍不断侵入领地，它便会冲上前，用手脚上的利爪攻击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's ear-piercing cry can be heard over half a mile away and is used to keep foes at bay. If a potential threat continues to encroach on its territory, POKENAME will rush forward and attack with the sharp talons on its hands and feet.

entry: POKENAME在池塘上方疾飞，沿途叼食虫属性宝可梦。头顶蓬乱的羽毛十分敏感，能让它瞬间发现附近的猎物。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME dart over ponds, snapping up bug Pokémon as they go. The scruff of feathers on their heads are highly sensitive, helping them detect nearby prey in an instant.

entry: 它的翅膀还不够大，无法飞行。为了迎接进化，它会一边玩耍奔跑，一边像风车般挥动双臂。
author: busilisk
source: Its wings are not quite big enough to enable flight. In preparation for evolution, it darts around playfully, windmilling its arms.

entry: POKENAME的喙尖含有剧毒。打赢战斗后，它会欢快地飞舞，庆祝胜利。
author: .izik
source: The tip of POKENAME's beak contains potent venom. After a victorious fight, it joyfully flits through the skies in celebration.

entry: POKENAME受惊时，羽毛会变成与周围相同的颜色，几乎完全隐没在林间树叶中。
author: .izik
source: When startled, POKENAME's feathers shift colors to match its surroundings. It becomes nearly invisible among forest leaves.

entry: POKENAME会从杏仔果树上采果，带回河边的住处。储粮堆满后，它就会蜷在上面睡觉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers fruit from Apicot Berry trees and brings them to its riverside lodge. Once its hoard is full, it curls up atop it and sleeps.

entry: 脱离身体的翅膀环绕着POKENAME的主体。翅膀高速旋转时能掀起强风，吹走其他小型鸟类宝可梦，让它抢走对方的食物。
author: sk372
source: Disembodied wings circle around POKENAME's main form. By rotating them at high speeds, it can create strong gusts of wind that blow other small avian Pokémon away and allowing it to swipe their meals.

entry: POKENAME释放的黏性孢子会在背上留下残留物。它们会彼此梳理，用喙拉扯、啄除已经硬化的残渣。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME releases sticky spores that leave behind residue on its back. It helps groom other POKENAME by pulling and pecking away at the hardened residue with its beak.

entry: POKENAME的喙会滴下有毒墨汁，曾是配合雅致羽毛笔使用的名贵墨料。贵族和外国显要都以用它的羽毛书写为荣。
author: .izik
source: Toxic ink drips from POKENAME's beak, once prized for use alongside elegant quills. Nobles and foreign dignitaries proudly used its feathers for writing.

entry: 地震将至时，POKENAME的喙会变得异常温热。它随即大声鸣叫，向大家警告危险。
author: .izik
source: When an earthquake approaches, POKENAME's beak becomes unnaturally warm. It begins to chirp loudly, warning others of the danger.

entry: POKENAME的大耳朵能听见最细微的声响。若休息时受惊，它就会慌乱地冲上天空，毫无规律地四处乱飞。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's large ears pick up the slightest sounds. If startled during rest, it bolts into the sky in frantic, erratic patterns.

entry: POKENAME虽然小，傲气和好斗程度却远超体形。它的战斗力不算强，但只要觉得受了侮辱，就会愤怒地发出刺耳尖叫，哪怕对方是体形四倍于自己的捕食者。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME's pride and belligerence are disproportionate to its small size. While not particularly powerful in battle, they deliver furious, ear-piercing shrieks to anyone who they feel insults them, even predators four times their size.

entry: POKENAME本身速度不快，但熟练的投矛手能利用它天生的悬浮能力，把它当作精准的远程投射武器。它的舌根绕着头骨，能保护它免受脑震荡。
author: .fedoraman
source: While not very fast on their own, trained spear-throwers can make use of POKENAME's natural ability to hover to make an accurate long-ranged projectile. The base of POKENAME's tongue wraps around its skull, protecting it from concussions.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛覆着一层薄薄的毒液。害怕时毒性会增强，连短暂接触都很危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feathers are coated in a thin layer of poison. When frightened, the toxicity intensifies, making even brief contact dangerous.

entry: POKENAME手臂上刀刃般的羽毛很脆弱，但即使在战斗中折断，一夜之间也能重新长得锋利如刀。
author: .izik
source: The blade-like feathers on POKENAME's arms are fragile but regrow razor-sharp overnight if broken during fights.

entry: 它很容易发怒，谁若闯入领地，就会被它啄个不停。
author: melodydelune
source: Quick to aggravate, this Pokémon will incessantly peck at anyone who wanders into its territory.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀尚未发育完全，只能短暂飞行。它还在学习控制火焰力量，喙常常热得发烫。
author: zyrum_
source: The wings of POKENAME are underdeveloped, so it can only fly for a short amount of time. POKENAME often have a hot beak as they learn to control their fire powers.

entry: POKENAME会用喙偷走旅人的小物件。在群体中，钥匙串最大的个体最有威望。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its beak to steal small objects from travelers. In its flock, birds with the largest keyrings are seen as the most prestigious.

entry: POKENAME在倒木上打盹，发出轻柔而有节奏的鸣声。睡得毫无戒心，让它很容易遭到捕食者偷袭。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dozes atop fallen logs, letting out soft, rhythmic chirps. Its careless sleep leaves it vulnerable to sneaky predators.

entry: POKENAME会三五成群地齐声鸣叫，炫耀宽广的音域。可这片杂乱的喧嚣让附近的宝可梦十分烦躁。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gather in small groups to caw in unison, showing off their wide vocal range. The resulting cacophony frustrates nearby Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME坚韧的羽毛能抵御猛烈沙暴。它会藏在沙尘中，用强有力的颚袭击猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tough feathers shield it from fierce sandstorms. Hidden in the dust, it strikes at prey with powerful jaws.

entry: POKENAME常聚成庞大而喧闹的群体。它领地意识很强，会仗着数量优势，奋力追赶一切闯入领地的宝可梦。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME are commonly seen forming large, noisy schools. They are highly territorial and will fiercely chase away any Pokémon that enters their domain, finding their strength in numbers.

entry: POKENAME能精确控制喙中喷出火焰的温度。百代市的面包店会请它烘烤洛玫果挞。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME controls the temperature of the flame emerging from its beak with great precision. Bakeries in Eterna City use it to bake Roseli Berry tarts.

entry: POKENAME身顶蛋形的花苞会分泌带有龙火果香的汁液，滋养附近的植物。人们常看见它在果园里清除杂草。
author: .izik
source: The egg-like bud atop POKENAME's body releases a Petaya Berry-scented sap that nourishes nearby plants. It is often seen clearing weeds from orchard soil.

entry: POKENAME会把花茎顺着风向摆好，借风滑翔。沿着气流飞行时，它会向下方散播花粉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME glide through the wind by positioning their flower stalks in the direction of the breeze. As they fly along wind currents, they release pollen below them.

entry: POKENAME会将青铜色的翅膀紧贴身体，融入木头的颜色，藏在枝间。它会突然袭击虫属性宝可梦，用利爪将其抓住。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hide in branches by folding their bronze wings close to their body, which blends in with wood. They surprise bug Pokémon and snatch them up with their talons.

entry: POKENAME身上凸出许多喙状尖刺，能向过分靠近栖枝的对象发射利针。
author: .izik
source: Beak-like spikes jut from POKENAME's body, launching sharp needles at anything that gets too close to its roost.

entry: 许多人觉得它们的鸣声悦耳，但音量也很大。它们能大幅调整音调，在近处听，甚至会让人晕头转向。
author: infinex21
source: Although their cries are considered melodic to many, they are also very loud. They can adjust the pitch of their cries to a degree that, up close, the noise can be disorienting.

entry: 它越烦躁或兴奋，腹中的火焰囊就越热，直到开始喷火。多余的热气终究会从喙中排出，让原本响亮的叫声更加震耳。
author: infinex21
source: The flame sac in its belly grows hotter as it grows more agitated or more excited, to the point that it will start to breathe fire. Its already-loud cry is amplified by the excess heat it will inevitably vent from its beak.

entry: POKENAME扇翅很轻，但只要有一点光，砖红色的翅膀就很显眼。因此，比起森林，它更容易在洞穴里捕猎。
author: quackquackattack
source: While POKENAME have a slight wingbeat, their brick-colored wings make them stand out with any amount of light. They have an easier time hunting in caves than in forests for this reason.

entry: POKENAME会被亮晶晶的东西吸引，常把它们囤在巢里。经过训练，它也能帮忙从高处或其他难以到达的地方取回特定物品。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are allured by shiny objects and often hoard them in their nest. They can also be trained to help retrieve certain items from high or otherwise hard-to-reach places.

entry: POKENAME会凭体形和尖叫震慑烈雀群，迫使它们奉自己为首领。比起真正指挥大家做事，它似乎更在意鸟群是否敬畏、崇拜自己。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its size and shrill cry to cow flocks of Spearow into making it their leader. It seems far more interested in being feared and admired by the flock than actually commanding them to do anything.

entry: 满月之夜，POKENAME的叫声在一英里外都能听见。它会借此吓退可能的袭击者。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: On a full moon, a POKENAME's cry can be heard from a mile away. It uses this technique to scare potential attackers.

entry: POKENAME聚在一起时会优雅地起舞。据说这种舞蹈能让它们平静下来，增强精神力量。不过，只要有一只受到威胁，整个群体就会迅速反击。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME are known to dance elegantly when together. This dance is said to keep them calm and elevate their psychic powers. However, when any of them is threatened, the entire flock is quick to retaliate.

entry: POKENAME聚在一起时会优雅地起舞。据说这种舞蹈能让它们平静下来，增强精神力量。不过，只要有一只受到威胁，整个群体就会迅速反击。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME are known to dance elegantly when together. This dance is said to keep them calm and elevate their psychic powers. However, when any of them is threatened, the entire flock is quick to retaliate.

entry: POKENAME会用翅膀产出的多余棉花，把巢铺得更暖和舒适。它的鸣唱主要用来威吓猎物，或召唤同伴。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses the excess cotton produced by its wings to make its nest more comfortable and warm. Its chirping song is mainly used to intimidate prey or to summon its companions.

entry: POKENAME靠头上长出的长触手在水中推进。触手覆着细密而防水的羽毛，能减小游动时的水阻。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME propel themselves through the water using the long tentacles that sprout from their head. These tentacles are covered in fine water-proof feathers, helping to make them more hydrodynamic.

entry: POKENAME会扇动翅膀保持平衡，做出复杂的摔跤扑击。面对空中的对手，它尤其喜欢从空中擒抱。
author: .izik
source: While flapping its wings for balance, POKENAME performs complex wrestling lunges. It favors aerial grapples against airborne opponents.

entry: POKENAME以坚果、种子和谷物为食。它生性好斗，常能看见它追赶登山者。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's diet consist of nuts, seeds, and grain. They're often seen chasing after hikers due to their aggressive nature.

entry: 等着玩捡回东西的游戏时，POKENAME会急切地摇动尾羽。谁愿意拿石头或玩具陪它玩，它很快就会与谁亲近。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wags its tail feathers eagerly while waiting to play fetch. It bonds quickly with those offering stones or toys.

entry: 它的翅膀太短小，带不动沉重的身体，因此会在树根附近筑巢。那里的菌丝能从树木中吸取养分，它也能啄食从身旁窜过的小虫。
author: imaginita
source: Its wings are too stubby to lift its heavy body off the ground. Instead, it nests near the roots of trees, where its mycelium can absorb nutrients from the tree and it can pluck insects skittering by.

entry: POKENAME与身上被称为“小菇灵”的活菌体共生。它敲喙的咔嗒声，配上小菇灵蹦跳的咚咚声，会交织成颇为有趣的打击乐节奏。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME has a symbiotic relationship with the living fungi on its body, which are known as Shroomites. The clicks of its beak and the thumps of jumping Shroomites combine to make an intriguing percussive beat.

entry: POKENAME是夜间捕食的鸟类宝可梦，会在城市边缘游荡，被路灯或无人看管的垃圾吸引。只需扇一下翅膀，它就能释放浓密的毒粉，削弱或驱走敌人。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a nocturnal predatory bird that prowls city outskirts, drawn to streetlights or unattended trash. With a single flap of its wings, it releases dense clouds of Poison Powder to weaken or drive away its foes.

entry: 暴雨中，POKENAME的翅膀会像碗一样蓄水。接下来的几天，它会慢慢吸收储存的水分。
author: .izik
source: During rainstorms, POKENAME's wings collect water like bowls. It slowly absorbs the stored water over the following days.

entry: 身体变得太重时，POKENAME会从臭氧层滑翔而下。它常先发出尖锐响亮的叫声，再撞向人们，试图挑衅，却没能激怒对方。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME glides down from the ozone layer when its body gets too heavy. It's known for emitting loud, shrill cries before knocking into people in an unsuccessful attempt to provoke them.

entry: 饥饿时，POKENAME尾巴上的火焰会减弱。它在黎明出猎，用强壮的翅膀飞上天空，搜寻食物或小型猎物。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it is hungry, the flame on its tail burns weaker. POKENAME goes out hunting at dawn, using its strong wings to scout for food or small prey from above.

entry: 下雨时，POKENAME会用翅膀遮住尾巴。它会点燃灌木，将猎物引出地洞，再用尖喙啄击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their wings to shield their tail whenever it rains. They set fire to bushes to lure prey out of burrows before pecking with their sharp beaks.

entry: POKENAME成群生活，彼此保护，共同抵御捕食者。只要群体足够大，凭尖喙和迅疾的攻击，连饥饿的巨牙鲨也能击退。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME live in schools to help protect each other from predators. When schooling in large numbers, their sharp beaks and swift strikes can even fend off hungry Sharpedo.

entry: POKENAME主要栖息在崎岖多石的峡谷。白天很少能见到它，因为它会钻入地下，只偶尔短暂露面，寻找蚯蚓和幼虫。
author: alice_alice
source: Its primary habitat is rough and rocky canyons. POKENAME is rarely seen in the daytime, as it burrows underground and only emerges for short periods to forage for worms and grubs.

entry: POKENAME会从地下飞快地啄碎巨石，继续挖掘，找到草本植物后不露头就将其吃掉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rapidly pecks at boulders from beneath the ground to shatter them. It tunnels onward to reach herbs, which it devours without surfacing.

entry: POKENAME会用尖喙从公园喷泉里叼出硬币，骄傲地用这些闪亮的战利品装饰巢穴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its sharp beak to pluck coins from park fountains. It proudly decorates its nest with the shimmering prizes.

entry: 光滑流畅的羽毛让POKENAME行动格外敏捷。它常从城市公园的游客手中抢走提包，随即消失无踪。
author: .izik
source: Thanks to its sleek feathers, POKENAME moves with unmatched agility. It often snatches purses from city park visitors before vanishing.

entry: POKENAME性情暴躁而野蛮。凡有东西招惹它，它就会尖叫一声，接连飞踢过去。
author: .izik
source: Short-tempered and wild, POKENAME lets out a sharp squawk before launching a flurry of kicks at anything that provokes it.

entry: POKENAME暴怒时会挥动强壮的利爪攻击敌人。一旦被激怒，它便只顾盲目厮打。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME attacks foes mid-rage by lashing out with its strong talons. It fights blindly once angered.

entry: 带POKENAME散步时，最好确保一叫它就会回来，或准备好长牵绳。它一兴奋就会追逐眼前移动的一切，甚至飞出很远，只为追上目标。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Trainers taking POKENAME for walks are advised to either ensure their POKENAME comes when called or to make use of long leads. When excited, POKENAME chase after anything they see move and will fly long distances to try and catch their target.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀与庞大的身体相比，小得有些滑稽。别的宝可梦只要投掷石头，就很容易把它打下来，因此它很少飞行。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have comically small wings compared to their large bodies. They are easily taken out of the air whenever a Pokémon throws rocks at them, so they are rarely seen flying.

entry: POKENAME群会大声鸣叫、拍打翅膀，凶狠地驱赶其他宝可梦，独占喜欢的饮水处。如果威吓没用，它们就会朝对方喷水。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flocks aggressively chase other Pokémon away from their preferred watering holes, loudly squawking and flapping their wings to drive others away. If their display fails, they spray the target of their harassment with water.

entry: POKENAME主要吃鱼类宝可梦，其中的脂肪酸有助于维持它强大的大脑。发现遗留在水中的钓线和鱼钩时，它会用念力取出，拿来当作武器。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME feeds mainly on fish Pokémon, which contain fatty acids that support its powerful brain. When it finds fishing line and hooks left in the water, it telekinetically pulls them out and utilizes them as weapons.

entry: POKENAME会用精神力量制作钓线，钓鱼觅食。它钓鱼时太过专注，很容易遭到背后的袭击。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Using their psychic abilities, POKENAME craft fishing lines to fish for food. POKENAME concentrate so hard on fishing that they leave themselves vulnerable to being attacked from behind.

entry: POKENAME肌肉发达的双臂覆着浓密羽毛，只需一拳就能轻易击穿实心钢板。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's muscled arms are covered in dense feathers. With one punch, it can easily smash through sheets of solid steel.

entry: 翅上的羽毛入水后会拢在一起，让POKENAME当作鳍使用。短腿划水也能帮它加速。
author: chorb33
source: The feathers of its wings clump together in the water so that POKENAME can use them as fins. It can also pedal with its stubby legs to accelerate.

entry: POKENAME住在洞穴里，会敲碎岩石来吃。响亮的叫声在洞穴与矿井间久久回荡。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lives inside caves where it breaks rocks down for consumption. Its loud cries can be heard echoing throughout caves and mineshafts.

entry: POKENAME奔跑或飞行时，鬃毛般的羽毛会升温。不小心碰到，就可能被烫得十分疼痛。
author: .izik
source: The feathers in POKENAME's mane heat up when it runs or flies. Careless touch can cause painful burns.

entry: POKENAME鬃毛般的羽毛随风舞动，宛如鲜艳的火焰。远远望去，常被误认成野火。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's mane feathers dance in the wind, resembling vivid flames. Many mistake it for a wildfire when seen from afar.

entry: POKENAME会待在河边，将长着羽毛的尾巴垂入水中当作诱饵钓鱼。尾巴十分敏感，若被别的宝可梦咬住，痛叫声在一英里外都能听见。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME fishes on riverbanks by dangling its feathered tail in the water like bait. This tail is very sensitive, so if another Pokémon bites it, POKENAME's cry of pain will be audible for over a mile away.

entry: POKENAME身上覆着金属羽毛，会发出轻微的嗡鸣。周围的磁场能干扰手机信号。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is covered in metallic feathers that hum softly. The magnetic field around it can disrupt cellphone signals.

entry: POKENAME平时很平和，但若丢了大葱般的指挥棒，就可能变得暴躁。发现别的宝可梦拿着它的棒子时，它便会紧追小偷，直到对方归还。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are typically quite calm creatures but can act aggressively if they lose their leek-like baton. If they spot another Pokémon with their baton, they chase the thief relentlessly until they give it back.

entry: POKENAME弄丢指挥棒时会极其恼怒，尤其不能忍受被偷走。等到终于找回棒子，满心的释然便会化作轻快欢喜的鸣叫。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME become incredibly irate when they lose their baton, especially if it was stolen from them. When they inevitably find their baton, the immense relief they feel is released in happy little squawks.

entry: POKENAME靠双腿四处行走；若腿受伤，就只能依赖他人的接济。受伤时，几颗头常因怪罪彼此害自己倒霉而互相生气。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their legs to roam around the world and rely on the charity of others if their legs are injured. Their heads often get angry at each other when they are injured as they blame one another for the misfortune.

entry: POKENAME会从河里高高跃上红树林树冠，寻找食物。要是运气不好，落进特别纠缠的枝丛，它可能就下不来了。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME leaps high into mangrove treetops from the river in search of food. If it lands in a particularly unlucky cluster of branches, it may find itself unable to get back down.

entry: POKENAME会用背上的炮管射出水流。翅膀还不够大，无法支撑飞行，所以它更喜欢待在地面。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shoot jets of water with the cannons on their back. They prefer to remain grounded because their wings are not yet big enough to sustain flight.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛坚硬如岩，却不知为何仍能在空中飞上数小时。养鸟人已经研究它的迁徙数十年。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's rock-hard feathers somehow allow it to stay airborne for hours. Bird Keepers have studied its migrations for decades.

entry: POKENAME会通过喙释放精神波动，哄敌人入睡，再趁对方毫无察觉时吃掉它的梦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME channels psychic waves through its beak to lull foes into sleep. It then feeds on their dreams while they remain unaware.

entry: POKENAME十分忠诚，喜欢被训练家拥抱。有时太兴奋，会放出一团有毒孢子，因此训练家要留心，别让它过于激动。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are loyal creatures and love to get hugs from their Trainer. Sometimes they get so excited that they release a cloud of toxic spores, so Trainers need to be wary of overstimulating POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME会低吼着磨牙，擦出火花，试图吓退对方。若不起作用，它就会张大嘴猛地咬下，力道足以引发猛烈爆炸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME growls and gnashes its teeth to create sparks as a way to ward off others. If this doesn't work, it opens its jaw wide before biting down hard, the force of which causes a powerful explosion.

entry: POKENAME绝不容忍训练家的贬低，哪怕为此挨饿。获准触碰它的蛋是最高的信任，只会给予温柔待它、尊重它的训练家。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME will not accept any denigration from its Trainer, even if it means going without food. Being trusted to touch its egg is the highest privilege, awarded only to Trainers who treat it with kindness and respect.

entry: POKENAME会坐在池塘或湖边，谁踏入领地一步，它就朝谁吠叫。不过它很容易被吓到，一旦害怕就会畏缩着躲起来。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME sits at the edge of ponds and lakes, barking at anyone who steps one foot into its territory. However, it is quite easy to scare, and if you do so it will cower and hide.

entry: 遇到其他宝可梦时，POKENAME会挺起胸膛，威风凛凛地把大钳敲得咔咔响，想逼对方退让。其实它很容易被吓跑，哪怕对方稍显敌意，也会立刻退缩。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME puff up their chest and clack their pincers together menacingly when they come across other Pokémon, trying to intimidate them into backing down. In reality, they are easily scared off, even a slight show of aggression making them retreat.

entry: 它会变成敌人的模样，让对方放松警惕。等敌人凑近查看，就突然咬上一口。
author: .izik
source: It transforms into a copy of its foe to catch them off guard. Once the enemy investigates, it delivers a surprise bite.

entry: 受到细心照料的POKENAME，对训练家忠诚无比。它常凭顽强意志，撑着战斗到最后一刻。
author: inksans201x
source: When raised with care, POKENAME is fiercely loyal to it's Trainer, oftentimes willing itself to keep fighting until the very end.

entry: POKENAME凭庞大的体形和利牙，轻易就能震慑其他宝可梦，吃饭睡觉时很少被打扰。若真有宝可梦反抗，它通常会换个地方，免得白费力气。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's large size and sharp fangs enable it to easily intimidate other Pokémon, ensuring it is rarely bothered while it eats and sleeps. If another Pokémon stands up to it, POKENAME usually just goes somewhere else to avoid unnecessary exertion.

entry: POKENAME只要看中了玩具，就会直接拿走，根本不管孩子还在玩。直到孩子哭了，它才开始难过，随后把孩子瞬间传送到远处，好让自己安心玩耍。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME spots a toy it wants, it takes it without regard for the child currently playing with it. Its concern only awakens if the child cries, at which point it grows sad and teleports the child far away so it can play in peace.

entry: POKENAME会露出獠牙、大声吠叫，保护咩利羊群免遭捕食。要是捕食者靠得够近，它便会狠狠咬上一口，让对方留下难忘的教训。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME brandish their fangs and bark loudly to protect flocks of Mareep from predators. If a predator is close enough, POKENAME gives them a potent bite that is sure to leave a lasting impression.

entry: 同等体形的宝可梦中，POKENAME最为凶猛，好胜的天性常在战斗中展露无遗。不过，它只挑有把握获胜的仗打。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It's the most ferocious Pokémon of its size, and its competitive nature often displays this in battle. However, POKENAME chooses only to fight battles it knows it can win.

entry: 捕食者一旦靠近巢穴，它便会咬上去，力道足以咬坏银行金库的门。它会拼命保护自己的领地。
author: .izik
source: If a predator approaches its nest, it bites with a force strong enough to destroy a bank vault door. It is fiercely protective of its territory.

entry: POKENAME身体小，很难分清下颚在哪里结束、身体又从哪里开始。它常收起耳朵、闭上眼睛，把自己装成一颗蛋。
author: soup1900
source: Due to POKENAME's small body, it is hard to discern where its lower jaw ends and its body begins. It often pretends to be an egg by tucking in its ears and closing its eyes.

entry: 烘焙的甜香会把POKENAME引出栖息地，在面包店和住家厨房附近飞来飞去。它尤其喜欢柑橘类点心。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME are attracted to the sweet smells produced by baking and are often drawn out of their habitats to flit near bakeries and home kitchens. They are particularly fond of citrus-based treats.

entry: POKENAME沉重的双颚看似凶狠，其实它胆小易惊。害怕时，它会从脸颊分泌滑溜的薄膜，迈着摇晃的双腿逃跑。赢得它信任的人会发现，它极其忠诚，也出奇地亲人。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's heavy jaws look fearsome, but it is timid and startles easily. When frightened, it releases a slippery film from its cheeks and sprints away on unsteady legs. Those who earn its trust find it fiercely loyal and surprisingly affectionate.

entry: 它几乎见什么都咬，但若感到对方友好，就只会玩耍般地轻轻啃咬。超常的感知能力能帮助它分辨敌友。
author: .izik
source: It bites nearly everything, offering weak playful nibbles to those it senses are friendly. Its clairvoyance helps it distinguish friend from foe.

entry: POKENAME喜欢时髦的打扮，乐意在美容院里待上数小时，维持精致的外表。背上的蝴蝶结裹住花苞，限制孢子散出，让自己保持干净。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love looking stylish and enjoy sitting for hours at a salon making sure they maintain their exquisite appearance. The bow on their back wraps around their flower bulb to restrict the flow of spores and keep themselves clean.

entry: POKENAME很忠诚，会不惜一切保护训练家。如果训练家没让它晒够太阳，它就可能生病，因此陪它一起晒太阳很重要。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are loyal creatures and will use any means necessary to defend their Trainer. They can become sick if their Trainer does not allow them to get enough sunlight, so it is important for Trainers to go with them to sunbathe.

entry: 它硕大的牙齿能啃穿木头和石头，也会通过咬树标记领地，留下清晰的沟痕作为警告。
author: .izik
source: Its oversized teeth are strong enough to gnaw through wood and stone. It marks its territory by biting trees, leaving distinct grooves as a warning.

entry: POKENAME会在洞穴里挖掘，追捕领地内的地鼠。不过它实在不擅长挖洞，只好吃泥土和石头。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME burrows through caves, hunting any Diglett in its territory. However, it is a very poor digger, so it is forced to eat dirt and stone.

entry: 它会一路滚过广阔的地带，并给自己的旅程计时。发现仙人掌时，它会很兴奋，最喜欢停下来大口咬着吃。
author: .izik
source: It rolls across long landscapes and times itself during the journey. Spotting a cactus excites it, as it loves to stop and eat them with eager bites.

entry: POKENAME的嘴虽然巨大，含东西时却柔软又轻柔，连蛋放进去也不会破。它们常这样叼着自己的蛋，护着运走。
author: sontyp
source: Its huge mouth is actually so soft and gentle that a POKENAME can keep an egg in it without it being damaged. This goes so far that POKENAME often transport their eggs this way to guard them.

entry: 进入POKENAME的领地很危险。它会冲向一切入侵者，直到对方离开或被它痛打一顿才罢休。不过，戳破气球，或制造类似的响声，就能把它吓跑。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Entering its territory is very dangerous. POKENAME charges any intruders, only stopping when they leave or it brutalizes them. However, you can scare it away by popping a balloon or making some similar loud noise.

entry: POKENAME面目凶恶，小鸟们怕惹它发怒，纷纷聚来充当手下。鲜少有谁发现，它其实心肠极软，只要稍遭反抗就会屈服。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's fearsome face makes small birds flock to be its underlings to avoid incurring its potential wrath. Few figure out that it is incredibly softhearted and will buckle beneath the slightest bit of opposition.

entry: POKENAME食量大却懒散，会用巨颚威吓其他宝可梦，逼它们丢下食物逃跑。它其实很胆小，只要有宝可梦站出来反抗，自己就会逃走。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has a big appetite but a slothful nature and will use its large jaws to intimidate other Pokémon into dropping food and fleeing. POKENAME is rather cowardly and will run away if any other Pokémon stand up to it.

entry: POKENAME十分亲人，是深受欢迎的宠物，也能守护孩子。不过它很容易受惊，吓到以后需要一些时间，才能鼓起勇气。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are very affectionate, making them a desired pet and protector for children. However, they are very skittish and require time to steel themselves should they become spooked.

entry: POKENAME战意不强，常靠敲响钳爪、磨动巨颚来吓退对方。不过真到了必须交手的时候，也不能小看它的咬合力和毒刺。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME doesn't have a strong will for fighting, so it relies on clicking its claws and gnashing its large jaws to scare off others. When push comes to shove, however, one shouldn't underestimate its bite or venomous sting.

entry: POKENAME的下颚有部分像獠牙一样突出面部。温暖的季节里，这些硕大的牙齿会产生冷气，为身体降温，防止过热。
author: sk372
source: Parts of POKENAME's lower jaw jut out from its face like tusks. During warmer seasons, these oversized teeth generate cold air to keep it cool and prevent overheating.

entry: POKENAME的尖牙极重，任其长得太长，连头都会歪向一边。因此，它会拿树干磨牙。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME has very heavy fangs that cause its head to tilt to one side if left to grow too much. Therefore, it will file its fangs down on trees.

entry: POKENAME能通过头罩上凸出的金属铆钉，感知人类和宝可梦的情绪。它看似好斗，其实十分害羞，听到特别大的响声就会逃跑。
author: fiordaliso
source: It senses the emotions of humans and Pokémon thanks to the metal studs protruding from its hood. Although POKENAME looks aggressive, it's actually very shy and runs away when it hears very loud noises.

entry: 为了更好地保护训练家，POKENAME会摆出吓人的模样，想借此赶走威胁。若不管用，它就会发出三声可怕的吠叫，回声远远传向大海。
author: cinnamoncreampuff
source: In order to better protect its Trainer, POKENAME donned an intimidating appearance to scare off threats. If that fails, it lets out three terrifying barks that echo far out to sea.

entry: POKENAME天生擅长烘焙。不过，要是做的是宝可梦零食，它总忍不住尝几口自己的作品。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is naturally skilled at baking. If it bakes Pokémon treats, however, it can't help but sample some of its creations.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在美容院里一待就是数小时，享受梳理和照料，直到变得漂漂亮亮。背上花朵的根部缠着丝带，让它看起来更时髦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to spend hours at salons where they are groomed and pampered until they look beautiful. The flower on their back has a ribbon wrapped around the base to make themselves look stylish.

entry: POKENAME常参加选美，炫耀时髦的造型。背上的丝带裹住花朵，既防止孢子弄脏身体，也让它保持漂亮。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often enter into beauty pageants to flaunt their stylish look. The ribbon on their back wraps around their flower to prevent spores from getting messy while also keeping them looking fashionable.

entry: POKENAME身体密度大、重量惊人，尤其是头部，因此行动不快。它讨厌争斗，常靠坚实的身体和吓人的瞪视保护自己。
author: bobosmith01
source: The density and sheet weight found in POKENAME's body, especially the head, prevent it from moving very quickly. It loathes getting into fights, so it relies on its tough body and frightening glare for protection.

entry: POKENAME常被用来看守废品场等地方。但它们性情懒散，大多只是叫得凶，却不怎么咬人。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME are commonly used as guards for junkyards and similar establishments. However, their lax personalities mean most are more bark than bite.

entry: POKENAME外表可怕、体形庞大，常被当作凶恶的怪物，其实却十分温和，甚至有些胆怯。哪怕挨打，它也很少还击，往往选择逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's fearsome appearance and huge size cause many to treat it as a vicious monster, but it is in actuality incredibly gentle and even timid. Even when attacked it rarely retaliates, instead choosing to flee.

entry: 它喜欢咬金属，测试自己的颚力。磁性鼻子能探出附近还没被它咬过的物品，供它继续啃咬。
author: .izik
source: It loves biting metal to test its jaw strength. Using its magnetic nose, it detects nearby unbitten items for further chewing.

entry: POKENAME见到什么、遇到谁都爱咬，先咬上一口，再来回磨牙。虽然被它咬会疼，但它磨牙时散出的气味却格外安神。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have a penchant for biting anything or anyone they meet; they bite once and then begin to teethe. Although their bites can be painful, the scent they exude as they teethe is remarkably calming.

entry: 它咬住猎物时会散发安抚的香气，减轻对方的反抗。幼崽闹腾时，它也会用类似的办法安抚，不过只是轻啃，而非猛咬。
author: infinex21
source: As it bites down onto prey, it exudes a calming scent to minimize their resistance. It has been seen using a similar tactic to quell its young when they become rowdy, though in such instances it nibbles rather than bites.

entry: 这是颚部最发达的宝可梦之一。咬合的力量，几乎能一口咬碎任何东西。
author: prof.whitebeam
source: This is one of the Pokémon with the most-developed jaws. It has a strength that allows it to break almost anything with an single bite.

entry: POKENAME的低吼深沉响亮，连周围地面都会震动。这是它唯一的威吓手段，若吓不走对方，自己便会逃跑躲藏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's growl is deep and loud enough to cause the very ground around it to tremble and shake. This is its only intimidation technique, and if it fails to frighten something off, POKENAME itself will flee and hide.

entry: POKENAME比外貌看起来更亲人，也很容易受惊。一旦吓着，就会在恐惧中横冲直撞。
author: genesisparallax
source: POKENAME is much cuddlier than its looks might suggest. They are easily startled and, when spooked, it will take off on a fear-fueled rampage.

entry: 被招惹时，它会咬人自卫，同时分泌黏液，让袭击者打滑退开。强壮的双颚能咬碎海滩上的小贝壳。
author: .izik
source: It bites defensively when provoked, releasing a sticky slime that makes attackers slip away. Its strong jaws can crush small shells found on the beach.

entry: 它领地意识极强，半英里外的电电虫也能看见，因此很受欢迎，常被选作守卫宝可梦。
author: cait_sith
source: It is incredibly territorial and can spot a Joltik from half a mile away. These traits make it a popular choice for a guard Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME体形小，有些训练家因此低估了它的咬合力。训练时最好戴上防护手套。
author: thescreamingidiot
source: Due to its small size, some Trainers have underestimated the bite strength of POKENAME. Wearing protective gloves is recommended during training.

entry: 它会用柔软而有弹性的毛皮让对手放松戒心，再出其不意地咬下去。生气时，毛会蓬起来，让体形看起来大上一倍，吓退捕食者。
author: .izik
source: It uses its soft, stretchy fur to disarm opponents before biting unexpectedly. The fur puffs up when it's angry, making it look twice its size to scare off predators.

entry: 它会高速滚动，用利牙咬穿前方的障碍。受到威胁时，就会蜷成球，使出强力的旋转攻击。
author: .izik
source: It rolls at high speeds, using its sharp fangs to bite through obstacles in its way. When threatened, it curls into a ball and strikes with powerful spinning attacks.

entry: POKENAME是出了名的不合群的叛逆家伙，惹是生非只因自己做得到。连训练家也管不住它的任性与不听话。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a notorious antisocial rebel, stirring up trouble for no other reason than because it can. Even its own Trainer is not exempt from its unruly and disobedient behavior.

entry: POKENAME硕大的颚会滴下汁液，散发零余果般的气味，吸引附近的虫属性宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: Sap drips from POKENAME's massive jaw, releasing a scent reminiscent of Chesto Berries. This aroma attracts Bug-type Pokémon in the area.

entry: POKENAME会转动耳朵寻找同类，找不到就嚎叫。短腿让它在陆地上行动缓慢，但在冰上滑得飞快，远看宛如逼近的雪崩。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME moves its ears to try and locate others of its kind, howling if it cannot. Its small legs make it slow on land, though it can slide across ice at great speeds, looking like an approaching avalanche from a distance.

entry: 它会从远处用金属锁链捆住敌人，再狠狠咬下，力道足以咬碎混凝土。
author: .izik
source: It uses metal chains to bind foes from a distance before delivering an extremely hard bite. Its bite is powerful enough to destroy concrete.

entry: 它喜欢啃咬沙漠中滚烫的物体。啃东西时若有人靠得太近，它便会射出利针，赶走对方。
author: .izik
source: It enjoys biting down on hot objects in the desert. If someone gets too close while it gnaws, it will fire out sharp pins to ward them off.

entry: 阳光下，它身上会开出骷髅形的花。若有人靠得太近，就会用强壮的双颚咬下去自卫。
author: .izik
source: Skull-shaped flowers bloom on its body in sunlight. If someone gets too close, it will bite with its strong jaws to protect itself.

entry: 这种融合体会改变沙子构成的身体，装成岩石，引诱猎物靠近。目标一到跟前，它便猛咬下去，将对方拖进沙中。
author: .izik
source: This fusion lures prey close by shifting its sandy body to mimic a rock. When the target approaches, it bites down hard and drags them into the sand.

entry: 它能磨动可怕的牙齿，产生精神波动。强悍的外表只是吓退对手的手段；真打起来，只要攻击不奏效，它立刻就会游走。
author: hophoppip
source: It can generate psychic waves by gnashing its fearsome teeth. Its tough appearance is a tactic to scare off opponents; when it does get into a fight, it swims away the moment its attacks fail.

entry: POKENAME嘴里长着硬化的真菌。它一口就能咬断木头，并在残余的木头上留下蘑菇孢子。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Hardened fungus grows out of POKENAME's mouth. Its bite can snap wood and leaves behind mushroom spores on whatever is left.

entry: POKENAME凶恶的外表很适合看守住宅和商铺，尖端泛红的鳞片也能用来制作珠宝。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's menacing appearance makes it useful for guarding homes and businesses. Its red-tipped scales have also been used to make jewelry.

entry: POKENAME会用强壮的双颚把倒木咬成碎块，当作简单的工具翻土，再种下种子。它常在被野火破坏的地方重新造林。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its powerful jaws to break logs into pieces to use as basic tools, then plants seeds in the soil it churns. It is often seen reforesting areas damaged by wildfires.

entry: POKENAME喜欢藏在领地里，等宝可梦胆敢闯入，就用锁链勾住对方，发动攻击。它十分好斗，多数宝可梦都知道要远离它的地盘。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME enjoys hiding in its territory, so when Pokémon dare to enter its domain, it latches its chain onto them and attacks. POKENAME is very aggressive, so most Pokémon know to stay away from its territory.

entry: POKENAME的身体如同糕点，很容易中毒。面对严重的情况，厨师们研制出特别的酥饼帮助治疗。一块娑罗沙布蕾就能帮助它代谢毒素，也能应付其他不适。
author: quackquackattack
source: They are prone to being poisoned due to their pastry-like bodies, and in extreme cases chefs have developed a special shortbread to help cure them. A single Shalour Sable helps a POKENAME metabolize poison and deal with other ailments.

entry: POKENAME强壮的双颚能轻易咬碎铁块。它想占据哪条小巷，就会用令人不安的瞪眼吓走其他对象。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's powerful jaws can crush iron with ease. It uses a disturbing Leer to scare others away from alleyways it wants to claim as its own.

entry: POKENAME会低吼着猛烈咬合双颚，威吓入侵者、保护领地。一见到同伴或训练家，它又会跑上前，立刻亲热个不停。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME growl and fiercely snap their jaws to intimidate intruders and protect their territory. When a POKENAME spots a member of its pack or its Trainer, it will run up to them and immediately shower them with affection.

entry: 小巧的体形丝毫没能减轻POKENAME暴躁好斗的天性。迷信称，被它咬过就会失去爱的能力，心中只剩愤怒，因此大家都绕着它走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's small stature does nothing to curb its violent and aggressive tendencies. It's given a wide berth due to superstition that those bitten by POKENAME will lose the ability to feel love, replaced with rage.

entry: POKENAME会从小巷里跳出来，大声尖叫，想凭凶相吓得路人掉下钱财。虽然有这种习惯，它其实很胆小，只要遭到反抗就会逃跑。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their fearsome appearance to try and scare passers-by into dropping their money, leaping out of alleyways and giving a loud yowl when they do. Despite this habit, they are cowardly and will run if they face confrontation.

entry: POKENAME会从小巷里跳出来，大声尖叫，想凭凶相吓得路人掉下钱财。虽然有这种习惯，它其实很胆小，只要遭到反抗就会逃跑。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their fearsome appearance to try and scare passers-by into dropping their money, leaping out of alleyways and giving a loud yowl when they do. Despite this habit, they are cowardly and will run if they face confrontation.

entry: POKENAME喜欢拥抱其他宝可梦，却常抱得太紧。要是对方也用同样的力道回抱，挤压就可能让它短暂头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to give out hugs to other Pokémon but often squeeze too tightly. Whenever the same tightness of a hug is reciprocated, the pressure can cause them to develop a brief headache.

entry: 它虽然面目可怕，其实胆怯，尽量避免冲突。被逼入绝境时才会挥爪攻击，那也是走投无路的最后手段。
author: .izik
source: Despite its fearsome appearance, it is timid and avoids conflict. When cornered, it lashes out with swipes, but only as a last resort.

entry: 隔着玻璃或围栏时，POKENAME会冲着每个路过者摆出凶相、大声吠叫，想把对方吓跑。若没有屏障可躲，靠近它就会发现它很友好，还喜欢被人宠爱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME bark and posture aggressively at anyone who walks past while they're behind glass or a fence, loudly trying to scare them away. If approached without a barrier for them to hide behind, they are friendly and enjoy receiving fuss.

entry: 保安巡逻时常带着POKENAME。凶相和响亮的吠声通常足以震慑犯罪，幸好如此，因为真正对峙时，它往往相当胆怯。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are commonly used by security guards when on patrol. Their fearsome appearance and loud barks are usually enough to prevent crime, which is fortunate, as they tend to be rather timid in actual confrontations.

entry: 保安巡逻时常带着POKENAME。它喜欢高速追赶逃跑的擅闯者，追上后便咬住对方，拖回保安身边。
author: katieplaysgames
