source: POKENAME are commonly used by security guards when on patrol. They love to give chase to fleeing trespassers, racing after them at high speed before biting onto the person and pulling them back to the guard.

entry: POKENAME虽然长着大獠牙，往往仍胆怯得不敢靠近袭击者，除非受到威胁。一旦暴怒，尾焰就会猛烈爆发，变成鲜艳的粉红色，彰显内在的力量。
author: npshi
source: Despite POKENAME having large fangs, they will often be too timid to approach their attacker unless they are threatened. Once enraged, the flame on their tail erupts violently into a vibrant pink as a show of inner strength.

entry: 闲下来时，它会开心地啃勺子。战斗中却能释放强得可怕的念力冲击，常打得敌人措手不及。
author: .izik
source: It happily gnaws on its spoon when idle. In battle, it unleashes terrifyingly strong telekinetic blasts, often catching foes off-guard.

entry: 工作日里，POKENAME会帮建筑工人在工地搬运钢梁。周末，工人们就带它去参加宝可梦华丽大赛，展示辛勤劳作练就的健美体魄，让评委眼前一亮。
author: quackquackattack
source: Throughout the week, POKENAME help construction workers carry steel beams across work sites. On the weekends, the workers show off their POKENAME at Pokémon Contests, dazzling judges with the peak physical form that comes from hard work.

entry: 常能在锐舞派对上见到POKENAME和训练家，其中的训练家大多刚接触另类文化。它虽然喜欢一起狂欢，但玩得太累时，也会想念家中安静的时光。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be found at raves with their Trainers, who more often than not have just entered the alt scene. Despite enjoying raves with their trainers, overexertion can lead to them wishing for a calmer scene at home.

entry: POKENAME的叶片会散发柿仔果般的香气，引诱毫无戒心的猎物。等对方靠近，它便狠狠咬下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits a Persim Berry-like scent from its leaves to lure unsuspecting prey. When they draw near, it bites down with crushing force.

entry: POKENAME的小屋由极其坚固的黑曜石和火山岩筑成。发达的下颚能轻松咬碎各种岩石。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME's hut is made of incredibly robust obsidian and volcanic rock. With its well-developed lower jaw, it effortlessly crushes any rock.

entry: 它的双颚强壮，能轻易咬开硬坚果，再用火焰烤熟。它喜欢与其他宝可梦赛跑，只用一年就能练出发达的腿部肌肉。
author: infinex21
source: Its jaws are so strong that it can easily crack open hard nuts and roast them using its flames. It tends to race with other Pokémon, its legs' muscles becoming well-developed in a year's time.

entry: 唯有对伽勒尔样子烈焰马的嫉妒，能与它惊人的速度相提并论。传说那身带尖钉的装束只是为了比对手更时髦，对战斗并没有实际用处。
author: h0bojoe
source: Its blazing speed is rivaled only by its jealousy of Galarian Rapidash. Rumor has it that its spiked apparel is just an attempt to outstyle its rival and serves no real purpose in battle.

entry: 唯有对伽勒尔样子烈焰马的嫉妒，能与它惊人的速度相提并论。传说那身带尖钉的装束只是为了比对手更时髦，对战斗并没有实际用处。
author: h0bojoe
source: Its blazing speed is rivaled only by its jealousy of Galarian Rapidash. Rumor has it that its spiked apparel is just an attempt to outstyle its rival and serves no real purpose in battle.

entry: 它视力不佳，会用两颗头轻轻啃咬物体，辨认是什么。探索周围时，它咬得虽轻，却会一直啃个不停。
author: .izik
source: With poor eyesight, it nibbles on objects using both heads to identify them. Its bites are gentle but persistent as it explores its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME偶尔会浮出水面采集树果，串在刺上吸取养分。果汁混合进毒液，形成气味甜美的毒素，在深海中吓退捕食者。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME occasionally emerge from the water to gather Berries and stick them along their spines to drain them of nutrients. The juice from the Berries mixes into a sweet-smelling poison that deters predators in the deep sea.

entry: POKENAME对触碰十分敏感。它聚居的水域不宜行船，因为只要轻轻碰到倒刺，就会在船身上炸出一个洞。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It is sensitive to the touch. POKENAME-infested water is not navigable by boats. A gentle press against its barbs will blow a hole in any vessel.

entry: POKENAME会用锁链把自己固定在地面，再向上浮起，等待对手触碰。一旦碰到，它便使出大爆炸，射出有毒的金属倒刺。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Using their chains, POKENAME embed themselves in the ground and float up, hoping for contact. If an opponent touches them, they use Explosion, firing poisonous metal barbs.

entry: POKENAME会用一根特殊的骨头当链枷，砸向对手的头顶。上面的尖刺带毒，被打中就会身中剧毒，备受折磨。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses a special bone as a flail to smash over the heads of its opponents. The spines on the flail are tinged with toxins, so getting hit causes one to be wracked with a potent poison.

entry: 靠近POKENAME时务必小心。亲代能控制毒素，不毒伤信任的对象，但幼崽尚无法控制，碰到它的刺就会中毒，疼痛难忍。
author: sk372
source: One should take extreme caution when approaching POKENAME. The parent can control itself and not poison those it trusts, but the child lacks control of its toxins; any touch of its spines will be painfully poisonous.

entry: 这种不同体色的POKENAME常见于热带地区。颜色差异可能来自食谱中更多的水果，而这种变体刺上的毒性也没那么强烈危险。
author: sk372
source: An alternate coloration of POKENAME often found in more tropical regions. Its different colors are likely due to a higher intake of fruit in its diet, and this variant is known to have less dangerously potent toxins in its spines.

entry: 它生活在沼泽和湿地中，总贴近地面，以免被雷劈。若没有烛木果帮助，它会不时痉挛，直到病症治愈。
author: quackquackattack
source: It lives inside swamps and marshes but stays low to the ground so as to not get hit by lightning. Without a Wacan Berry, it will spasm every so often until its affliction is cured.

entry: POKENAME高速撞上物体时会鼓起身体，缓冲冲击。不过膨胀很费力，所以坐在训练家的车里时，它不喜欢对方开得太快。
author: hophoppip
source: When it rapidly collides with a surface, POKENAME inflates its body to cushion the impact. Puffing up is straining for it, so it dislikes Trainers who drive too fast while it's in their vehicle.

entry: 对大脑的研究发现，POKENAME确实无法感受愤怒以外的任何情绪。它会头朝前冲向敌人，试图将对方刺穿。
author: kiwiarms
source: Research into this Pokémon's brain has revealed that POKENAME is literally incapable of feeling any emotion besides anger. It will swim at foes headfirst to try and skewer them.

entry: POKENAME会把原始数据转化为易挥发的毒素。长时间接触这种物质，可能引发剧烈抽搐。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME converts raw data into a volatile toxin. Prolonged exposure to this substance can trigger violent seizures.

entry: POKENAME会尽量少动，储存进化所需的能量。它能憋气鼓起身体，用毒刺扎向过分靠近的对象。
author: fiordaliso
source: It tends to move as little as possible to store the energy it needs to evolve. POKENAME can inflate its body by holding its breath, using its venomous spines to sting anyone who comes too close.

entry: 它会脸朝下浮在水面睡觉，肚子里胀满水和空气。排出空气、水，或同时排出两者，都能推动自己；也能喷出精准的水柱自卫。
author: infinex21
source: It sleeps facedown atop water, its belly swollen with air and water both. It releases air and, or, water to propel itself and can shoot precise jets of water to defend itself.

entry: 它身上的刺毒性极强，刺中象牙猪后，只需几秒就能将其毒倒。火焰因体内产生的有毒化学物质而呈紫色，能轻易腐蚀大多数金属。
author: infinex21
source: The quills along its body contain a poison so potent they can knock out a Mamoswine within seconds upon striking them. The flames along its body are purple due to the toxic chemicals its body produces and can corrode most metals with ease.

entry: POKENAME会从毒刺中射出毒针，大幅削弱猎物后再进攻。它在深水筑巢，巢穴常彼此靠近，形成聚落。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME fires poisoned needles out of its stingers to heavily weaken prey before it attacks. Their nests are found in deep water and are often close together to form a colony.

entry: POKENAME会先鼓起身体，再朝四面八方射出带毒的尖刺。尖刺射出后仍能受它控制，确保每一根都命中目标。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME inflates its body before releasing a burst of toxin-laced spines all around it. It can control these spikes after firing to make sure all the pointed projectiles hit their targets.

entry: POKENAME受惊时会加热体内储存的水，让身体迅速膨胀。等觉得威胁过去，它就会从尖刺排出气泡，恢复原本的大小。
author: bacondlx
source: POKENAME retains water in its body that it heats up to rapidly expand when frightened. When it believes the threat has passed, it releases bubbles through its spikes to return to its normal size.

entry: POKENAME会鼓起上半身，增加毒素的产量，让尖刺更加致命。每当这时，背上就会冒出有毒的泡沫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME inflates its upper body to increase the amount of toxins its body generates, making its spines deadlier. Poisonous bubbles froth up from its back whenever it does this.

entry: POKENAME全身长满锋利的毒羽。训练家常见它将羽毛射向靠得太近的宝可梦。
author: schwaus
source: POKENAME grows sharp toxic feathers all across its body. Trainers often see POKENAME launching its feathers at Pokémon that get too close.

entry: POKENAME点亮触角照明时，触角末端会鼓起来。瘪下去时，又会向周围的水中释放有毒物质。
author: sk372
source: The ends of POKENAME's antenna inflate when it lights them up to illuminate its surroundings. When they deflate, they release a toxic material into the water surrounding them.

entry: POKENAME会仔细观察其他飞行属性宝可梦，学习如何俯冲捕捉海里的宝可梦。或许是奇异精神力量的缘故，连最大的敌人也会被它一眼震慑。
author: bobosmith01
source: It closely observes fellow Flying-type Pokémon to learn how to properly divebomb and catch sea-dwelling Pokémon. Perhaps in thanks to their unnatural psychic powers, a stare from POKENAME can intimidate even the largest of foes.

entry: 猎物还没游近，POKENAME便已知道它何时会来。它在海面上飞行，掌握着俯冲捕食的最佳时机。
author: dodoowner_
source: It knows when prey will come before they even swim near POKENAME. It flies above the sea, knowing the perfect time to swoop down and catch its food.

entry: POKENAME会吸入水和空气，鼓起胸膛，让肌肉绷紧、头上的刺变硬。因为经常潜水，它的羽毛总是十分干净有光泽。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's chest swells with water and air that it inhales, causing the muscles to tense and the quills on its head to harden. Its feathers are always rather clean and glossy because it so frequently dives through water.

entry: POKENAME全身长满带毒的短刺。饲养POKENAME的训练家必须小心接触，以免被刺伤。
author: kitarchen
source: POKENAME are covered in short toxic quills. Trainers that own a POKENAME must handle them with care to avoid getting pricked.

entry: 无论陆地还是水中，POKENAME都行动缓慢，很容易成为其他宝可梦的猎物。危险靠近时，它想把自己埋进泥里，却总只能埋进一半。不过身体已适应得极难消化，多数捕食者懒得下口。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Slow both on land and in water, POKENAME is easy prey for many other Pokémon. When danger is nearby, it tries to bury itself in mud but only ends up half-submerged. Its body has adapted to be extremely tough to digest, so most predators don't bother.

entry: 靠近野生POKENAME，身上就会突然传来尖锐的刺痛。因此，有人把它们视为不祥之兆。
author: jackskipper
source: A sharp sting will hit your body when you are near a wild POKENAME. Because of these harmful interactions, they are considered bad omens by some.

entry: POKENAME在半咸水域以小家庭生活，在红树林根部下方挖洞。群体中最大的成员常会吸水鼓起身体，用自己堵住洞口。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME live in small family groups in brackish waters, digging out dens underneath mangrove roots. The largest member of the pack often physically blocks the entrance of their den. This blockage is accomplished by inflating their body with water.

entry: 这种宝可梦曾在一部海底题材的儿童电影里，作为反派的宠物登场，因此大受欢迎。可很少有训练家预料到，它常常脾气多变、要求又多。
author: ocxin
source: This Pokémon rose to popularity after appearing as the antagonist's pet in an underwater-themed kids movie. Few trainers were prepared for their often temperamental and demanding nature.

entry: POKENAME的壳硬如钢铁，感觉却极其敏锐。虽然多数宝可梦都知道别招惹它，它还是很紧张，轻轻一碰就会射出毒刺。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME has a shell as hard as steel, but it is incredibly sensitive. Even though most Pokémon know not to pick a fight with a POKENAME, it is very high strung, and the slightest tap will cause it to shoot out its poisonous spikes.

entry: 这种融合体曾被误认为千针鱼尚未发现的电属性进化形态。其实是两只千针鱼的毒素结合后过于强烈，能让全身麻痹，才造成了误会。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: This fusion was once believed to be an undiscovered Electric-type evolution of Qwilfish. The confusion came from the potency of the combined Qwilfish toxins being so strong that they can inflict full-body paralysis.

entry: 它会吞下并储存大量的水，让身体鼓起来，毒刺也随之竖立。双臂能相当轻松地击碎坚硬岩石。
author: infinex21
source: It swallows and stores large amounts of water to help it bulk out its own body and make its poisonous quills stand on end. Its arms can shatter solid rock with relative ease.

entry: POKENAME会带采珠人找到大舌贝群，请对方帮忙撬开贝壳。随后它吃掉大舌贝，把珍珠留给采珠人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME leads pearl divers to Shellder colonies, where the pearl divers help pry the Shellder open. It then eats the Shellder, giving the pearls to the divers.

entry: POKENAME脾气差，不喜欢与其他对象相处。生气时，它会用热气鼓起背上的浮囊，试图威吓对方，却常因此被水流带走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are foul-tempered Pokémon that dislike the company of others. They puff up the buoy on their back with hot gas when angry in an effort to intimidate others, often floating away in the water currents when they do so.

entry: POKENAME会吸收受污染珊瑚礁水域中的毒素。从珊瑚枝排出的水已完全净化，可以安全饮用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME absorbs toxins from polluted reef waters. The water it expels through its coral branches is completely purified and safe to drink.

entry: POKENAME能拔下毒刺，叼在嘴里，再借水柱将其射向猎物。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME can detach its poisonous quills, hold one in its mouth, and launch it at prey with a jet of water.

entry: POKENAME会从嘴里吐出覆着毒液的尖针，锋利无比。哪怕短暂接触毒液，也会头痛得眼前发黑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits incredibly sharp pins from its mouth coated in venom. Even brief contact with this venom can cause blinding headaches.

entry: POKENAME会从细长的嘴里射出毒针，速度和准头足以媲美精心调校的弩。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires poisonous needles from its elongated mouth. The speed and accuracy of its shots rival that of a finely tuned crossbow.

entry: POKENAME随洋流漂动时会猛烈放电。如果烦躁起来，放电的强度就会大幅提高。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases large bursts of electricity while drifting through ocean currents. Should it become agitated, the intensity of these bursts increases significantly.

entry: POKENAME会陪叛逆的少年艺术家在建筑外墙或火车车厢上涂鸦。颜料由它自己的毒液制成，清除涂鸦的人必须戴口罩，以免吸入有毒化学物质。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME paints alongside rebellious teenage artists on the side of buildings or train cars. The paint is made of its own venom, so people who want to clean its graffiti off surfaces need face masks to avoid inhaling toxic chemicals.

entry: POKENAME会把特殊的尾巴当作纹身机，用毒液在各种表面绘制图案，最常见的是它标志性的骷髅纹。
author: gordogamr
source: POKENAME uses its specialized tail like a tattoo gun to apply patterns of poison on various surfaces. Most frequently seen is POKENAME's iconic skull-like pattern.

entry: POKENAME会吸水储存在颈部，既能威吓对手，也能与强效毒液混合。战斗时，它会接连射出油污般的脏液和粗刺，让对手中毒虚弱，痛苦难当。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: POKENAME inhales water and stores it in their neck, both to intimidate and mix it with their potent venom. In battle, they launch a painful combo of oil-like grime and thick spikes at their opponent to guarantee they'll be poisoned and weak.

entry: POKENAME的乳房里既存着奶，也存着毒液。农夫前来挤奶时，往往会被喷一脸毒。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME keep both toxins and milk in their udders. If a farmer comes up to milk it, they get splatted in the face with poison.

entry: 它能把身体胀得近乎球形，抵御重击，也便于用毒刺刺中敌人。小嘴还能喷出精准而强劲的水柱。
author: infinex21
source: It can bloat its own body to a near-spherical shape to deflect heavy impacts and to better stab foes with its poisonous quills. It can spew precise and powerful jets of water from its small mouth.

entry: POKENAME能安然坐在尾端的刺球上，甚至弹来弹去解闷，毫不难受。别的对象若碰到刺球，却会被扎伤，中了毒而疼痛不已。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is able to rest on its spiky tail-orb without any sort of discomfort, even bouncing on it to alleviate boredom. Anything else that tries to touch the orb will be pricked and given a painful dose of venom.

entry: 古老传说称，POKENAME身上每根刺都藏着不同的诅咒或毒素。只需扎一下，目标就会遭遇种种古怪而难以预料的变化。
author: ocxin
source: An old myth says every quill on POKENAME's body holds a different curse or poison. One prick is enough for a target to become affected in various strange and unpredictable ways.

entry: POKENAME恶意十足，会故意让自己讨厌的家伙，承受难忍的剧烈刺痛。
author: jackskipper
source: POKENAME are nothing short of malicious. They will purposefully affect those they dislike with a horrible stinging feeling.

entry: POKENAME的刺能喷出毒液，引起静电电击般的刺麻感。饲养它的训练家最好小心接触。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: A POKENAME's quills have the ability to spray poison that causes a tingling sensation, similar to a static shock. It is advised that Trainers who own POKENAME should handle them carefully.

entry: 为了自卫，它会吸入大量水，像气球一样膨胀，并让电流环绕全身。胀大后仍相当轻，因此它会把尾巴插进地面，甩动身体攻击敌人。
author: infinex21
source: To defend itself, it inhales enough water to expand like a balloon and veils itself in electricity. It remains rather light when expanded, so it plants its tail into the ground and swings itself around at its foe.

entry: POKENAME常把整个头浸入水中，不断吸水，直到肚子微微鼓起。储存的水能化作精准水柱，用来自卫，也能击落猎物或高挂的水果、树果。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME often dunk their entire heads into water and suck it up until their bellies slightly expand. They can shoot this water as precise jets to defend themselves or to shoot down prey and hanging fruits or berries.

entry: POKENAME能干扰渔船的声呐系统。想钓到它，钓客就得放弃先进设备，改用简单的鱼竿和渔网。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME can disrupt the sonar systems used by fishing boats. Anglers seeking to catch POKENAME must avoid advanced technology and use simple rods and nets.

entry: POKENAME脾气不好，也不合群，会待在深海避免接触其他对象。它还能把缥缈身体的一部分硬化成尖锐毒刺，进一步阻止别人靠近。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite grumpy and antisocial, placing itself in deep parts of the ocean to avoid contact. It can harden some of its wispy body into pointed, poisonous spines to further deter anyone from interacting with it.

entry: POKENAME生活在海底，会用爪子向小型猎物注入毒液。受到攻击时，背上能猛地伸出尖刺，力道足以刺穿钢铁，再通过尖刺注入同样的毒液。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME live on the seafloor, using their claws to inject poison into small prey. If attacked, they can jut spikes from their backs with enough force to pierce through steel, injecting that same poison through them.

entry: POKENAME浑身毒刺，能震慑其他对象。它会冲向敌人，用尖刺当武器，并往头顶的圆罩中注水使其鼓起，提高刺中目标的机会。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are covered in venomous barbs as a deterrent to others. They charge at their foes with the intent to use their barbs as a weapon, puffing up the dome on their skull with water to increase the odds of making contact.

entry: POKENAME受到威胁时，会往中空的头盾里注水，鼓大外形，吓退捕食者。若对方仍试图咬它，盾边的利刺还能提供第二重防护。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME fills its hollow head shield with water when threatened, using its larger appearance when inflated to ward off predators. The sharp spines around its shield offer a secondary defense if a predator attempts to take a bite.

entry: POKENAME天性体贴、爱护弱小，常抱起小型宝可梦，搂在怀里保护。此时身上的刺会伸长，防止怀里的宝可梦受到外来的伤害。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a protective and nurturing nature, often scooping up smaller Pokémon in order to cuddle and keep them safe. Its spines extend while doing so, intent on protecting its charges from any external harm.

entry: POKENAME通常只有6英寸长，但富有弹性的身体灌满水后能胀到47英尺。一般只有受到威胁时，才会达到这样的大小。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is normally just six inches long, but its elastic body can expand to 47 feet when filled with water. It usually only hits this size when threatened.

entry: POKENAME能大幅鼓起身体，生成毒刺，一呼气便将它们射向空中。记录中，它一次最多能射出1000根针。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can inflate its body massively to generate poison spines that fire off into the air once it exhales. It's been recorded firing up to a thousand needles in a single burst.

entry: POKENAME生活在珊瑚礁间，用捡来的珊瑚碎片伪装自己。它能用壳上的尖刺，将毒液注入捕食者体内。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live amongst coral reefs and use pieces of coral it finds as camouflage. It uses the quills on its shell to inject poison into predators.

entry: POKENAME背上长出的扇状珊瑚，能用毒刺注入强效毒素。它的壳富有弹性，受到威胁时身体便能鼓起来。
author: hophoppip
source: The coral fans that grow from POKENAME's back can inject powerful toxins with their stingers. POKENAME's shell is flexible, allowing it to inflate when threatened.

entry: POKENAME耳内有一层膜，即使潜入水下也能保持干燥。若有谁靠得太近，它就会亮出覆有剧毒的尖刺。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its ears contain a membrane that keeps them dry even when it dives underwater. If anyone gets too close, POKENAME displays its spines, which are coated with a very potent poison.

entry: 据说POKENAME是被千针鱼毒死、痛苦身亡的渔夫之魂。它会钩住大批水生宝可梦，并使其毒发。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Said to be the spirit of a fisherman painfully killed by a Qwilfish's poison, POKENAME hooks and poisons mass amounts of aquatic Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME身体带刺的部分相当轻，挥舞这种链枷般的融合体，比挥舞真正的链枷容易。不过，过去惯用链枷的战士反而用不顺手，因为他们早已习惯更重的分量。
author: hophoppip
source: Wielding this flail-like fusion is easier than wielding a real flail, as the spiky part of POKENAME's body is quite lightweight. However, flail-using warriors of the past struggled to use POKENAME, accustomed to far more heft.

entry: POKENAME满身的尖刺比岩石更硬，即使被船撞上也不会断。它喜欢吃藻根果，能帮助毒素在体内顺畅流动。
author: fiordaliso
source: The spines covering its entire body are harder than rock and won't break even if it's struck by a boat. POKENAME has a taste for Kelpsy Berries, which help keep the poison flowing smoothly through its body.

entry: POKENAME浑身长着毒刺，丝带上尤其密集。毒液能造成强烈麻痹，但其中混有麻醉和致欣快的成分，中毒者反而不会疼痛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body possesses many poison spines across it, particularly on its ribbons. The toxin is a potent paralytic agent, though victims are not in pain due to the numbing and euphoric agents mingled within the venom.

entry: 水手十分看重POKENAME威武凶猛的外表，会请它看守停在港口的船只。集中精神后，它能朝周围一圈射出岩石般坚硬的刺，贯穿任何障碍。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its powerful and fierce appearance is highly valued by sailors, who use this Pokémon to guard boats moored in the harbor. By concentrating, POKENAME can shoot its rock-hard spikes in a circle around itself, piercing through any obstacle.

entry: POKENAME背上看似第二颗头的结构，其实是能自行识别目标的炮。它用高压水流射出锋利的金属刺，刺上可能覆毒，也可能由不同卡带赋予能量。
author: .jerden
source: What appears to be a second head on POKENAME's back is actually a cannon capable of identifying its own targets. It uses pressurized water to expel sharp metal spikes, which may be coated with poison or charged with energy by various Drives.

entry: 这只POKENAME的某些特征，让人想起令人畏惧的洗翠样子千针鱼。它面目凶恶，深受海盗喜爱，常被选来守船。
author: hophoppip
source: This POKENAME bears traits reminiscent of the dreaded Hisuian Qwilfish. It's a preferred ship guard for pirates due to its fearsome appearance.

entry: POKENAME几乎感觉不到疼痛，常把尖锐物体扎进身体，让它们穿过时沾满毒液。察觉危险时，它会猛地鼓起身体，把收集来的倒刺和针射向四面八方。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME barely feels any pain and often sticks sharp objects into its body, covering them in its venom as they go through. When this Pokémon senses danger, it puffs up sharply, shooting barbs and needles it collected in all directions.

entry: POKENAME想让伪装足以骗过其他宝可梦，便在上面堆了过多的刺。然而尽管费尽心思，大多数刺一泡水就会散掉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a superfluous number of spines on their disguise because they want to ensure that their disguise is convincing enough to fool other Pokémon. Despite their best efforts, most of their spines fall apart when soaked in water.

entry: POKENAME会吸满水，在海面上滚动。完全鼓起时，身上的刺会变得锋利得足以刺穿船壳。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fills itself with water and rolls across the sea's surface. When fully inflated, its spines grow sharp enough to pierce ship hulls.

entry: 沉船遗迹周围常能找到POKENAME的育幼地。幼崽借破船掩护成长，受到威胁时就会吸水膨胀，填满整间沉在水下的船舱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME nurseries can be found around the ruins of shipwrecks. They use the destroyed vessels as shelter to hide in as they grow, puffing up with water and filling an entire sunken room when threatened.

entry: POKENAME出没于大河附近，尤其常见于河口。只需1秒，身体和倒刺就能胀到平时的4倍大。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is found by large rivers and especially estuaries. It can inflate its body and barbs up to four times their normal size in merely one second.

entry: POKENAME的倒刺覆着细针，会折断并迅速向受害者注入毒液。大多数毒液都留给了倒刺，因此獠牙里只含微量毒素。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have barbs that are covered with tiny needles, which snap and rapidly inject venom into victims. Most of their venom is reserved for their barbs, so their fangs hold only trace amounts of venom.

entry: POKENAME手臂上沉重的花球充满毒素和电力。战斗时，它会一边跳舞一边猛烈敲击，让敌人中毒或麻痹。
author: sk372
source: The heavy pom-poms on POKENAME's arms are filled with both toxins and electricity. It combines its dances in combat with powerful bludgeoning strikes that leave foes poisoned or paralyzed.

entry: 当地人开始向热门湖泊投放POKENAME，以遏制乱扔垃圾。它若在水里发现垃圾，就会把垃圾吐回乱扔的人身上。
author: oddwalls
source: Locals have begun stocking popular lakes with POKENAME to curb littering. If POKENAME finds garbage in the water, it will spit the garbage back at the litterer.

entry: POKENAME会结群围攻更大的宝可梦，疯狂争食。不过要是吃得太快，身体就会突然不受控制地鼓起来，几乎无法移动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gather in schools to take down larger Pokémon in a feeding frenzy. If they gorge too quickly, however, their bodies will suddenly and involuntarily inflate, leaving them almost immobile.

entry: POKENAME会装成花朵，引诱虫属性宝可梦，再用毒刺扎入，让对方中毒昏倒。
author: whiteupgrade
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a flower to lure Bug-type Pokémon. It will then pierce them with its stinger to poison them, knocking the Pokémon out.

entry: 受到威胁时，POKENAME的触手会胀起来，向四面八方射出毒针。接触毒液会导致严重的水疱。
author: .izik
source: When threatened, POKENAME's tentacles swell, firing toxic needles in every direction. The venom causes severe blistering on contact.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇覆着数十根尖刺。察觉危险时，它会鼓起身体，将尖刺射出，刺中目标后再把内部的有毒孢子注入。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's mushroom is covered with dozens of pointed spines. It inflates itself when danger is sensed, causing the spines to fire off and inject the toxic spores within on impact.

entry: POKENAME会游到海滩上的宝可梦附近，再突然跃起，用刺扎住对方。它可能把受害者拖进深海，让谁都没察觉对方已经不见了。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME swims near Pokémon on the beach, then leaps on them and latches onto them with its spikes. POKENAME may drag them deep into the ocean so nobody realizes they are gone.

entry: POKENAME能在战斗中向敌人射出尖刺和鳞片，射出的部分很快就会重新长好。尖刺攻守兼备，近身交战时也能替它挡下攻击。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME have the ability to launch their quills and scales at foes in battle, these projectiles growing back quickly. POKENAME's quills work both offensively and defensively, being able to shield POKENAME from attacks during close combat.

entry: POKENAME战斗时极为注重防守，任由物理攻击者撞上毒刺。承受一击后，它再用锋利如刀的爪子猛烈反击。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME is extremely defensive in battle, letting physical attackers slam into its poisoned spikes. Then, once it has absorbed the blow, it hits back with a powerful counterattack using its razor sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME生活在热带珊瑚礁间，以珊瑚丛为家。它满身是刺，叶片更带有厉害的毒素，能让人疼上好几天。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in tropical reefs, making their home in and amongst corals. They are covered in spines; their leaves in particular carry a nasty toxin that can cause pain for several days.

entry: POKENAME镰刀般的叶片末端垂着花瓣，颜色虽然鲜艳，却没有毒。过去人们曾用它染衣，但因为饲养困难，这股风尚渐渐消退。
author: chibitales
source: Despite the bright colors, the petals dangling from the end of POKENAME's scythe-like leaves are not poisonous. In the past, these petals were once used to dye clothing, but the difficulty of raising POKENAME caused the trend to fade.

entry: 海水的压力使它背上的刺比铁更硬，没有敌人敢从背后偷袭。强壮的双臂能打出重击，也能搬开堵住海底洞口的岩石。
author: fiordaliso
source: The pressure of seawater has made the spines on its back harder than iron, so no enemy dares to attack it from behind. Its muscular arms allow it to deliver powerful blows and move rocks that block the entrance to underwater caves.

entry: POKENAME生活在深海，以矿物为食。它格外喜爱来自宇宙的矿物，因为身体能将这些矿物代谢成毒素。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME live deep in the sea and oceans where they eat minerals. POKENAME are very fond of minerals that come from space due to their body being able to metabolize them to make poison.

entry: POKENAME浑身倒刺，碰到什么就会向其中注毒。人们曾见它们聚在一起，试图模仿地鼠进化，结果却被彼此的倒刺卡在了一起。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have barbs across their body, injecting poison into anything that touches them. They have been seen gathering together in attempts to replicate a Diglett's evolution, but they end up getting stuck together by their barbs.

entry: POKENAME常跳起来，试图扎伤在它面前亲热的情侣，因此在情侣间名声很差。人们认为，这种行为无非出于小心眼的嫉妒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has become infamous among couples, as it has a tendency to leap and attempt to sting those it sees behaving romantically. It's thought that this behavior is born out of little more than petty jealousy.

entry: POKENAME擅长游泳，水下的反应尤其敏捷。如果有宝可梦游泳时不慎撞上它，身上的倒刺就会折断，扎在那个冒失家伙身上。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are adept swimmers that have heightened reflexes while underwater. When another Pokémon bumps into them while swimming, the barbs on their body break and stick to the clumsy Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME受到威胁时会鼓起拳头，用指节上的刺愤怒还击。可惜它多疑又易怒，几乎总处在这种狂暴的状态。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME inflates its fists when it feels threatened, and uses the quills on its knuckles to fight back with fury. Unfortunately, since POKENAME is paranoid and very easily aggravated, it almost always is in this violent state of mind.

entry: POKENAME会让大半个身体鼓起来，显得更大，威吓其他对象。此时若击中肚子，就会射出部分毒刺。
author: sk372
source: To intimidate others, POKENAME will inflate much of its body to increase its size. Striking its belly while inflated causes it to fire off some of its poisonous spines.

entry: POKENAME会绷紧肌肉，让身体微微胀大，显得更强壮、更有威慑力。刺上带有微毒，被扎中后会暂时肌肉萎缩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flexes the muscles in its body to inflate itself slightly, looking to appear stronger and more imposing. Its spines carry a mild toxin that causes temporary muscle atrophy in those stung by them.

entry: POKENAME的腰带藏在长满刺的肚子下面，这让它觉得难为情。如果有人或宝可梦嘲笑，它就会追上去，用肚子狠狠撞对方。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The belt of POKENAME hides under its spiky gut, which it's embarrassed by. If a Pokémon or human makes fun of it, POKENAME will chase them down to slam its belly against them.

entry: POKENAME能把污泥身体的小块硬化成尖刺，里面充满构成身体的有毒化学物质。只需刺中一根，几乎任何宝可梦都会支撑不住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can harden small chunks of its sludgy body into solid spines. These spikes are full of the toxic chemicals comprising its body; being pierced by a single one is enough to bring almost any Pokémon to their knees.

entry: POKENAME能把躯干鼓到惊人的大小，壳上的大型毒刺也会伸长。肩部的炮管可以射出毒液。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can inflate its torso to incredible sizes, as well as extending large poison-tipped spines on its shell. Toxic liquid can be shot from cannons located on its shoulders.

entry: POKENAME的催眠能力只对约30%的人有效。催眠摆锤不起作用时，它就直接用摆锤敲打目标，注入毒素，迅速将对方毒昏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's hypnosis abilities are only effective on about 30 percent of people. When its pendulum fails, it simply hits the victim with it, injecting them with a toxin that quickly knocks them out.

entry: POKENAME的双腿能伸长，再以惊人的力量弹回，从出乎对手意料的距离踢击。它会用大钳牵制敌人，寻找最佳的出手机会。
author: reaverlamont
source: POKENAME's legs can stretch and snap back with tremendous force, delivering kicks from a distance few opponents expect. It uses its pincers to keep foes at bay while searching for the perfect opening to strike.

entry: 沉重的金属身体限制了POKENAME的行动，让它不得不讲究战术。它会承受攻击，等待最合适的反击时机，再用强力一拳将敌人打倒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's heavy metallic form restricts its movement, forcing it to take a tactical approach to combat. It endures attacks while waiting for the perfect opportunity to retaliate with a punch so strong it knocks out a foe with a single strike.

entry: POKENAME虽然外表凶猛，其实很温顺，喜欢红色铠甲被人抚摸揉搓。不过一察觉威胁，它就会全速冲刺，试图用尖角刺穿对方。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite its fierce appearance, POKENAME is actually quite docile, and enjoys having its red armor stroked and rubbed. When it senses a threat, it charges at full speed, trying to skewer the threat with its pointed horn.

entry: POKENAME攻守俱佳，也因此有些爱炫耀。它会用钳爪敲头，或当着敌人的面夹碎厚实的石块，挑衅对方。
author: sk372
source: Due to its offensive and defensive strength, POKENAME is a bit of a braggart. It taunts foes by rapping its claws against its head or using them to crush thick stones to rubble before their eyes.

entry: POKENAME正在为进化做准备，因此很少移动。虽然长着翅膀，身体却太重，飞不起来。
author: elite01.
source: POKENAME does not move very much because it is preparing for evolution. It possesses wings but is too heavy to fly.

entry: POKENAME会捕猎大岩蛇，保持刀刃锋利。有人说，虽然如今身体覆着铁一般坚硬的甲壳，它仍能如闪电般从树上切下树果。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME keeps its blades sharp by hunting Onix. Some say they can cut berries from trees as fast as lightning, in spite of the iron-hard chitin now covering its body.

entry: POKENAME通常情绪平淡，多数时候看不出喜怒。测试却发现，它似乎很喜欢开车。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME is a neutral Pokémon, showing neither positive nor negative emotions in most situations. Testing has proven that they seem to enjoy driving.

entry: POKENAME尾钳的钳口锋利如刀，几乎不费力就能切开大多数东西，包括猎物。丰缘的修理工有时会请它帮忙切断厚塑料管和金属管。
author: pkbonusducks
source: The pincer on POKENAME's tail has a razor-sharp clamp. Even with minimal effort, it can slice through most objects, including prey. Handymen in Hoenn sometimes employ POKENAME to help them cut through thick plastic and metal pipes.

entry: POKENAME背上的大钳内部宽敞柔软，完全不适合攻击。不过出海时，里面可以安全地容纳几位乘客，为他们保暖、提供保护。
author: sk372
source: The pincer on POKENAME's back is spacious and soft inside and ill-equipped for any sort of offense. Instead, it can safely store a number of passengers within to keep them warm and safe during its sea travels.

entry: POKENAME的身体由红色液态金属构成，习惯变成自己觉得有趣的对象。奇妙的是，一紧张，钳爪就不容易变形。
author: .izik
source: The red liquid metal making up POKENAME's body habitually transforms into anyone it finds interesting. Curiously, its claws have difficulty transforming when it is nervous.

entry: 面对强敌时，POKENAME会不时发生突变，以便更好地应对。它能精细控制尾钳，抓住易碎物品而不将其夹坏。
author: amityblamity
source: When faced with strong foes, POKENAME sporadically mutates to better handle them. It exerts fine control over its pincer tail, allowing it to grasp fragile objects without breaking them.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME大钳的颜色和眼状花纹经过演变，变得像死去宝可梦的头骨。战斗时，它会借此威吓敌人。
author: foolish_weasel
source: It is thought that the coloring and eye-patterns of POKENAME's pincers have evolved to look like the skulls of fallen Pokémon. In battle, POKENAME uses this to intimidate its foes.

entry: POKENAME不对称的肢体中，清楚体现着融合前双方宝可梦的基因。捕猎时，它会用大钳夹住猎物，再用镰刀将其剖开。
author: foolish_weasel
source: The genes of POKENAME's parent Pokémon are evident in its asymmetrical limbs. When hunting, POKENAME will hold its prey with its pincer, while using its scythe to cut it open.

entry: POKENAME的双颚坚强如钢，被咬住后几乎不可能挣脱。古时候，它会吞下石块，帮助磨碎食物。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME's jaws are as strong as steel, making it nearly impossible to escape their grip. In ancient times, POKENAME swallowed rocks to help grind up foods.

entry: POKENAME的金属外壳通常非常冷，温度接近冰点。长时间战斗会让身体由内而外发热，蒸汽随之从翅膀间流出。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's metal shell is typically very cold, staying at temperatures close to freezing. Prolonged combat causes its body to heat up from the inside, steam beginning to flow from its wings as it does so.

entry: POKENAME深红色的鳞片硬如钢铁，极难刮伤。它会飞快振动白色金属翅膀，无声悬浮，并用金色珠子储存巨大的能量，供长时间飞行使用。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME possess steel-hard crimson scales that are extremely difficult to scratch. They hover silently by rapidly fluttering their white metallic wings, using their golden beads to store enormous amounts of energy for long-term flight.

entry: POKENAME的双眼能穿过茂密丛林，看见远处的猎物。这种凶蛮的宝可梦会张开大钳，迅疾而精准地俯冲下去袭击。
author: cobalt0135
source: The eyes of POKENAME can perceive their prey from very long distances through the dense jungle. These barbaric Pokémon will swoop down on their prey with swift precision as they ready their pincers to attack.

entry: POKENAME背上的翅膀力量不足，无法独自托起覆着金属的身体。它会用精神力量弥补翅膀的弱点。
author: sk372
source: The wings on POKENAME's back are not strong enough to fully lift its metal-covered body off the ground. It uses psychic powers to help compensate for the weakness of its wings.

entry: POKENAME多半藏在花朵和色彩鲜艳的植物下，利用头顶叶片散发的气味掩饰自己。
author: toniaglitched
source: POKENAME is mostly found hiding beneath flowers and colorful plants. It disguises itself using the scent that is spread by the leaf on its head.

entry: POKENAME会在城都的岛屿及其他需要频繁飞行才能到达的地方之间递送邮件。锐利的眼力让它很容易认出蓝天邮件，迅速抓起要送的信便出发。
author: quackquackattack
source: They carry mail between islands and other locations in the Johto region that require heavy use of flying. Bluesky Mail is easily identified by POKENAME due to their sharp eyes, which allow them to snatch the mail they need before rushing off.

entry: POKENAME会摇摇摆摆地走在沙滩上寻找汽车。找到后，它就用钳爪撕开引擎盖，夹住电池，把电吸得一干二净。
author: lampent12
source: POKENAME waddles sandy beaches looking for cars. Once they find one, they rip the hood off with their claws and clamp on to the battery, draining it dry.

entry: POKENAME花朵上的纹样形似眼睛。跳舞时，花纹不断移动，能让潜在的捕食者晕头转向。
author: mepp.
source: The patterns on POKENAME's flowers have an eye-like shape. When they dance, the shifting movement of these patterns disorient potential predators.

entry: POKENAME的钳中藏着舌头般的附肢，能弹出去捉虫，储存起来以后再吃。这些长舌又长又快，战斗时也能有效充当鞭子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's claws contain tongue-like appendages it can fire out to grab and store insects for later consumption. The length and speed of the tongues also make them effective as whips in combat.

entry: POKENAME会吃肉贩丢弃的肉和骨头，用大钳把骨头夹成便于吞食的小块。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME eats discarded meat and bones that butchers throw away. It crushes bones with its claws to break them into edible chunks.

entry: POKENAME一旦用尾端的红钳抓住东西，就绝不松开。它在树枝间穿行极快，肉眼常难以跟上动作。
author: fiordaliso
source: Once POKENAME grabs something with the red pincer on its tail, it never lets go. It moves so swiftly among tree branches that its movements are often hard to follow with the naked eye.

entry: POKENAME坚韧的外壳保护着脆弱的内部。铠甲一旦被刺穿，就会流出黏液，持续数小时，难以再战。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's toughened exterior protects its weak insides. Should the armour be pierced, it leaks goo for hours and struggles to fight.

entry: POKENAME只在攻击或进食时打开外壳。外壳与甲片的颜色并不固定。
author: krune
source: POKENAME only open their shell when they are attacking or eating. The color of the shell and carapace can vary.

entry: POKENAME的大钳边缘参差，抓住什么都会撕得粉碎。大钳还十分沉重，挥拳时能给予敌人猛烈重击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's jagged pincers cause it to rip things it grips into shreds. These pincers are also super heavy, causing massive blows when used to punch foes.

entry: 长时间战斗时，POKENAME会因身体导热性高而变得十分灼热。若持续太久，身体就会开始熔化。
author: soup1900
source: When battling for long periods of time, POKENAME's body will become very hot due to its high thermal conductivity. If left like this for too long, POKENAME's body will start to melt away.

entry: POKENAME的大钳边缘参差，抓住什么都会撕得粉碎。大钳还十分沉重，挥拳时能给予敌人猛烈重击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's jagged pincers cause it to rip things it grips into shreds. These pincers are also super heavy, causing massive blows when used to punch foes.

entry: POKENAME本领多样，既能用钳子击倒树木，也能用角撞碎巨石。
author: incognito1234
source: A highly versatile Pokémon, POKENAME is able to use its pincers to knock down trees and its horns to destroy boulders.

entry: POKENAME的金属利爪能切开原木般粗厚的金属。不过只要遇到同类，无论大小，它都会为了食物与之争斗。
author: vwicixinsanity
source: Using its sharp, metallic claws, POKENAME can slice metal as thick as a log. However, if POKENAME spots another of its species, it will fight for their food, no matter their size.

entry: 探索丰缘等热带地区时，训练家会带POKENAME清理灌木。在它原生的寒冷地区，村民则请它收集引火物，供冬天生火。
author: ghostslythe
source: When exploring tropical lands, such as Hoenn, Trainers bring a POKENAME to clear the underbrush. In their native cold lands, villages use them to gather tinder for winter fires.

entry: POKENAME感官十分敏锐，一察觉捕食者就能闪避。自卫时，它也能咬得对方十分疼痛。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME has highly adept senses, allowing it to evade predators at a moment's notice. It can deliver a painful bite when defending itself.

entry: POKENAME如同活兵器，一旦动起来便几乎势不可挡。可碰上崎岖地形，又特别容易卡住。
author: jaycielantern
source: POKENAME is a living weapon, nigh unstoppable once it starts moving. However, it's very susceptible to getting stuck on uneven terrain.

entry: POKENAME用四条披甲的腿潜行捕猎，钢铁外甲会热得十分危险。被激怒时，它会展开刀刃般的翅膀冲锋，身后留下一路焦土。
author: labreezy187
source: POKENAME prowls on four armored legs, its steel plating growing dangerously hot during a hunt. When angered, it spreads its bladed wings and charges, leaving scorched earth in its wake.

entry: POKENAME贴着水面下方掠行，用刀刃般的鳍转向，姿态优雅得不可思议。凝聚的水构成钳爪，打出刺骨的一击后便散作雾气，只留下水面涟漪。
author: mgfox_66676
source: POKENAME skims just beneath the surface, using its bladed fins to steer with uncanny grace. Its claws, formed of condensed water, strike with chilling force before dissolving into mist, leaving nothing but ripples behind.

entry: POKENAME见到移动的对象就要挑战，无论对方多大。它不知疲倦地锻炼大钳和四肢，希望有一天能打败实力相称的对手。
author: reaverlamont
source: POKENAME challenges anything that moves to a fight, regardless of its size. It practices tirelessly to strengthen its pincers and limbs, hoping to one day defeat an opponent worthy of its skills.

entry: POKENAME必须不停扇动翅膀，调节体温。停得太久，身体就会喷出成股的熔岩和浓烟。它喜欢在田野上奔跑，每一步都会灼焦地面。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME need to constantly flap their wings in order regulate their body temperatures. If they go for too long without doing so, plumes of lava and smoke spew out of their bodies. POKENAME enjoy racing across fields, each step scorching the land.

entry: POKENAME的防御几乎无懈可击，金属甲壳能挡下大多数攻击。它会全力反击，用强壮的钳爪砸碎、碾压挡在面前的一切。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's defense is near impenetrable, its metal carapace shrugging off most attacks. It counter-attacks with absolute force, slamming and crushing anything in its way with blows from its powerful claws.

entry: POKENAME的大钳能释放狂风，或喷出汹涌水柱。它会借这些力量，将入侵者赶离作为家园的孤岛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's claws hold the power to emit gale-force winds or torrential geysers of water. It uses these abilities to force back intruders to the solitary islands it claims as its home.

entry: POKENAME每年迁往另一片海域，用巨钳在崖壁间撕出新巢。捕猎时，金属壳的重量能帮它以惊人的速度潜入深海。
author: sk372
source: Once per year, POKENAME migrates to another section of the ocean, using its massive claws to tear itself a new den within cliff faces. The weight of its metallic shell helps it dive to the ocean depths at ridiculous speeds when it goes hunting.

entry: POKENAME会给钳爪充电，让攻击更具破坏力。它精力充沛、行动迅捷，在战场上飞奔，背上的翅膀也不停猛振。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME charges its claws with electricity to make its strikes even more devastating. Energetic and fast, it dashes across the battlefield while frantically beating the wings on its back.

entry: POKENAME两条尾巴的末端都长着大钳，抓握力惊人。人们会请它在废品场等地方干活，帮助拆解大块材料。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's two tails end in pincers with incredible gripping power. Some have put it to work in junkyards and other jobs where it can assist by tearing apart large materials.

entry: POKENAME上半身的铠甲虽然不含铁，仍然十分坚硬。腹部却毫无保护。
author: faelocke
source: The armor covering POKENAME's upper body contains no iron, but is still remarkably hard. Its stomach is unprotected, however.

entry: POKENAME会用尾钳捉住敌人，再向对方释放强烈电流。如果仍没能将其击败，它就会用头顶坚硬的角猛撞。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME will capture foes with the pincer at the end of its tail before releasing a powerful discharge of electricity into them. If this is not enough to defeat them, it will headbutt them with the tough horn atop its head.

entry: POKENAME是令人畏惧的猎手，会藏在树上，倒挂枝头，趁猎物松懈时捕捉。皮肤硬如钢铁，能抵御大多数攻击，因此它也不怕睡在其他宝可梦附近。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME is a feared predator who hides in trees, hanging inverted from branches to catch its prey when they lower their guard. It does not fear sleeping near other Pokémon due to its steel-hard skin that protects it from most attacks.

entry: POKENAME无法完全控制瞄准的方向，只能无奈地乱挥大钳，试图打中敌人。它甚至会被自己的钳子吓到，赶忙冲向电脑，躲进网络空间。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME helplessly flails its pincers to try to land a punch on foes since it can't fully control where it's looking to aim a hit. It can scare itself from looking at its own pincers, causing it to dart to a computer to hide inside cyberspace.

entry: POKENAME以超过每小时80英里的速度在树梢间奔跑，旁人眼中只剩一道红影。发现下方的威胁时，它就会以钢铁尾尖朝下坠落，冲击力如同货运列车。
author: ghostslythe
source: Registering only as a red blur of motion to onlookers, POKENAME runs treetop to treetop at over eighty miles per hour. If it spots a threat below, it drops steel-tipped tail first, hitting with the force of a freight train.

entry: POKENAME蜷起来时，钢铁身体几乎能抵御一切伤害。背上掉落的刺曾被用来制作鱼叉的尖头。
author: sk372
source: When curled up, POKENAME's steel body makes it almost impervious to harm. Spines that fall off its back have been used to make the points of fishing spears.

entry: POKENAME像被丢弃的人偶，身体里嵌着钩子。它们会结群捕猎，向看着自己的猎物逼近，距离足够近时便用钩子攻击。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME resemble abandoned dolls with hooks lodged in their bodies. POKENAME hunt in packs, advancing towards prey that look at them. When close enough, POKENAME rely on their hooks to attack.

entry: POKENAME身体虽是沉重的钢铁，仍能在战场上优雅地旋转起舞。谁想打断舞蹈，就会遭到金属钳爪沉重的碾压打击。
author: sk372
source: Despite a heavy steel body, POKENAME dances and twirls across the battlefield with grace. Those that try to interrupt its dancing will become victims of heavy crushing blows from its metallic claws.

entry: 它的身体像一只被丢弃的钳子，多数时候无声地浮在空中。若有人或宝可梦靠近，就会凶狠地咬合钳口，发出警告。
author: .jerden
source: Its body resembles a discarded pincer. Most of the time it floats silently in the air, but it will snap aggressively as a warning if a person or Pokémon approaches.

entry: POKENAME能从钳中弹出舌头般的附肢，上面覆着与身体相同的坚固金属，战斗时能充当威力十足的鞭子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME launches tongue-like extensions from within its claws. These are covered with the same sturdy metal its body is, making them extremely effective as whips to be used as weapons in combat.

entry: POKENAME一次最多能附身并控制500磅金属。战时，神奥的铁匠曾寻找它，帮助在锻炉和铸造厂间快速搬运固态金属与熔融金属。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME are capable of possessing and controlling up to 500 pounds of metal at once. During wartime, blacksmiths from Sinnoh sought POKENAME to quickly transport solid and molten metals around forges and foundries.

entry: POKENAME靠背上的翅膀极速突进，用钢钳毫不留情地打击敌人。它能感知其他生物的波导，不断四处游走，寻找强大的宝可梦切磋，让自己更强。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses the wings on its back to dash at incredible speed, striking foes with its steel claws without mercy. It senses the aura of other creatures and roams endlessly, seeking powerful Pokémon to test its skills and grow stronger.

entry: POKENAME有着锋利如刀的大钳和迅捷的翅膀，会穿空疾飞，挑战强敌。它循着感知到的波导前进，找到旗鼓相当的对手前绝不停歇。
author: fiordaliso
source: With razor-edged claws and fast wings, POKENAME darts through the air to challenge powerful foes. Guided by its ability to sense aura, it never rests until it finds a worthy opponent.

entry: POKENAME会借翅膀高速移动，快得肉眼难以跟上。它会锁定强盛的生命力量，穷追不舍，通过战斗同时磨砺钳爪与心志。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its wings to move faster than the eye can follow. It tracks strong life forces and relentlessly pursues them, sharpening both its claws and its spirit through battle.

entry: 据说POKENAME能感知力量本身的存在。它循着无形的波导流，在山谷间飞奔，寻找值得一战的对手。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is said that POKENAME can feel the presence of strength itself. Following invisible currents of aura, it races through mountain valleys, searching for worthy opponents.

entry: POKENAME镰刀般的肢体通常只用来威吓，但若真遭到挑衅，也能轻易斩倒敌人。飞得太快时，身体会过热，因此得扇动翅膀为自己降温。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME's scythe-like limbs are typically used for intimidation. If confronted, however, they can cleave down their foes with ease. If POKENAME flies too fast, they overheat, causing them to fan their wings to cool themselves.

entry: POKENAME背上的三只钳爪会打向敌人、夹住猎物，再注入强毒将其削弱。它能飞快扇翅，贴地悬浮，从任何方向发动破城槌般的冲撞。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The three claws on the back of POKENAME strike at foes and clamp down around prey before delivering a strong poison to wear them down. POKENAME rapidly flap their wings to hover along the ground and act as a battering ram from any angle.

entry: 坚硬的钢甲加上虚化的能力，让POKENAME在战斗中的防御达到极致。张开大钳后，会伸出幽灵般的触须，抓住敌人，拖入足以碾碎对方的铁钳中。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's hard steel armor coupled with the capability to turn intangible gives it maximum defenses in battle. Opening its pincers allows it to exude ghostly tendrils that grab foes and drag them into its crushing iron grip.

entry: POKENAME身体沉重，在陆地上只能缓慢挪步。不过到了水下，它却异常迅捷，能轻松捕猎巨牙鲨、毒刺水母等危险的宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's heavy body causes it to plod around slowly when on land. However, despite its weight, it is masterfully quick underwater, hunting dangerous Pokémon like Sharpedo and Tentacruel with ease.

entry: POKENAME的大钳抓握力强，还能释放寒气。被夹住的对象会冻成冰块，再被扔到一旁，以此警告对方别再招惹它。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's pincers possess a powerful grip and freezing ability. Those seized in its claws get frozen solid and tossed aside, as a warning not to mess with POKENAME further.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃由昆虫几丁质天然形成，不仅极其轻盈，而且像钢铁一样坚硬。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's blade is naturally formed out of ultralight insect chitin that is also as hard as steel.

entry: POKENAME的身体坚如钢铁，却十分轻巧，动作快得出人意料。头上的刀刃会随年龄增长；若满是缺口和划痕，它很可能经历过许多战斗。
author: infinex21
source: It has a body akin to steel, yet is incredibly light and moves with unexpected swiftness. The blade upon its head grows with age. If a POKENAME's head-blade is marred with nicks and scratches, it has likely endured many battles.

entry: POKENAME覆着双层金属，材质不同，却同样坚固。防御几乎无懈可击，但披甲身体的重量也极大限制了行动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is coated with a dual layer of two separate yet equally durable metals. Its defenses are all but impregnable, but its mobility is extremely reduced due to the weight of its armored body.

entry: 它的外骨骼硬如钢铁，能承受战斗中的重击。它行动迅速，会从利爪中释放猛烈的妖精之风，压倒目标。
author: infinex21
source: Its exoskeleton is as hard as steel, allowing this Pokémon to endure heavy blows during battle. It moves swiftly and releases fierce Fairy Wind attacks from within its sharp claws to overwhelm its target.

entry: POKENAME擅长伏击，会从灌木中跃出，用强壮的大钳捉住猎物。将对方制住后，它便把炮口贴近猎物开火，确保狩猎成功。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are ambush predators, leaping from bushes and grabbing onto their prey with their powerful claws. Once they have their prey immobilised, they fire their cannon point-blank into it to ensure a successful hunt.

entry: POKENAME的甲壳比其他虫属性宝可梦脆弱，但两只耳朵各有独立的意识。主体寻找食物时，耳朵分别放哨，对威胁的反应快过眨眼。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME's chitin is weaker compared to other Bug types, but its ears each have their own mind. While the main body scavenges for food, each ear stands watch, reacting faster than a blink of an eye to threats.

entry: 这些动作迅捷的宝可梦以电为食，会用大钳夹住设备和机器吸电。张开钳子时能释放汹涌的电流，不过能量也会很快耗尽。
author: infinex21
source: These quick Pokémon feed on electricity by clamping their pincers onto devices and machines. They can release torrents of electricity when they open their pincers, though this quickly uses up their energy.

entry: POKENAME由蜂群和棺材形的蜂巢组成，共享同一意识，而蜂巢本身其实就是蜂后。蜂群会追捕偷走巢中物品的家伙，拖回来供整个群体进食。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is a hive mind composed of a swarm of drones and a coffin-like hive which is actually the queen. The drones hunt those that stole from the hive, dragging the prey back so the hive mind can feed.

entry: 大钳上的斑点对光敏感，让POKENAME不用看也能抓住物体。它会用钳子夹碎、撕小食物，让中间的头吃得更快。
author: .jerden
source: The spots on its pincers are sensitive to light, enabling POKENAME to grab objects without looking at them. It uses these pincers to crush and tear its food into small pieces so that its central head can eat faster.

entry: 迅速振翅让POKENAME能沿直线高速飞行，却很难停下或转弯。它会用手臂抓住附近的物体，借此快速改变方向。
author: .jerden
source: The rapid movement of its wings enables it to fly fast in straight lines, but POKENAME has difficulty stopping and turning. It will grab nearby objects with its arms in order to quickly change direction.

entry: 尾巴上的钳子攻守兼备。POKENAME控火十分娴熟，能用钳子充当火焰喷射器。
author: codewolfie
source: The pincers on its tails act as both defense and offense. POKENAME is very skilled with their fire, using its pincers as flamethrowers.

entry: POKENAME会用反光的身体抵御宇宙辐射。战斗时，它会挥动变异的镰刀与大钳，鞭打敌人。
author: havic0970
source: POKENAME uses its reflective body to shield itself from the radiation of space. It battles by lashing with its mutated scythes and pincers.

entry: POKENAME用大钳捉住猎物后，会紧夹不放。虽然其他宝可梦不难挣脱单只钳子，但它通常会尽可能用更多的钳子一起夹住。
author: .jerden
source: When POKENAME seizes prey with its pincers, it will hold on tight and refuse to let go. While it is not too difficult for other Pokémon to pull free from one of them, POKENAME usually clamps on as many of its pincers as possible.

entry: 为了保持甲壳色泽鲜艳，POKENAME必须不停进食，大多数时间都在捕猎。双颚力道极大，连钢铁也能咬碎。
author: fiordaliso
source: To keep its carapace's color vivid, POKENAME must constantly feed, spending most of its time hunting. Its jaws are so strong they can crush even steel.

entry: POKENAME被城市灯光吸引，常在街头大闹。它会突然消失，用脱离身体的钳爪捉弄无辜路人，最后把一整片街区当作恶作剧地盘，拿汽车测试钳子的力道。
author: ghostslythe
source: Attracted to city lights, POKENAME wreaks havoc in the streets. It often vanishes, using disembodied claws to prank innocent bystanders. It ends up claiming a city block as its pranking ground, testing its claw strength against cars.

entry: POKENAME会用巨钳修剪树木，除去病枝。据说有它居住的森林更加茂盛，因为经过修剪的树木能长得更健壮。
author: pokefanart
source: POKENAME uses its massive pincers to prune trees and remove diseased branches. It is said that forests inhabited by this Pokémon grow more lush, as its cuts allow trees to regrow stronger.

entry: POKENAME虽然不会飞，刀翼却锋利如刃，一划就能切开大多数金属。即使金属甲壳和刀翼十分沉重，它的敏捷也无可匹敌。
author: evilgammon
source: While unable to fly, POKENAME's blade wings are razor sharp, able to cut through most metal in a single slice. Its agility is unmatched, despite its metal carapace and blade wings weighing it down.

entry: POKENAME能从耳部发出金属般的尖啸，强得足以产生冲击波。它会借翅膀快速接近敌人，再用大钳打击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME emits metallic screeches from its ears so powerful that they generate shockwaves. Using its wings, it can swiftly reach its enemies before striking them with its pincers.

entry: POKENAME的花瓣能像壳一样合拢，保护自己，同时向附近敌人释放有毒孢子。它总会高估孢子持续生效的时间，战斗结束后仍可能躲上数小时。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME's petals serve as a shell to close up while releasing toxic spores to enemies nearby. They always overestimate how long these spores remain active, so they can stay inside for hours after the battle is over.

entry: POKENAME会用巨钳挖开树根下的泥土，采集养分，并挖出睡觉用的洞。吸取树干的养分时，它会飞快扇翅，扫清残留的泥土。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their large claws to dig up soil from beneath tree roots, collecting nutrients and making burrows to sleep within. They rapidly flap their wings to clear out any dirt left behind as they drain nutrients from the trunk of trees.

entry: 它会用尾巴夹住猎物，甩来甩去，直到对方晕倒。战斗时，它会凭惊人的速度和假头迷惑对手。
author: silverscloudy
source: It will clamp onto its prey with its tail, flailing them around until they are stunned. It uses its blinding speed and false heads to confuse its opponents in combat.

entry: POKENAME的金属壳下，身体里交织着菌丝。蘑菇伞盖上的眼状斑纹能吓跑潜在的捕食者。
author: hophoppip
source: Under its metal shell, POKENAME's body is interwoven with mycelium. The eyespots on its mushroom cap scare away potential predators.

entry: POKENAME会向敌人投掷手里剑，再用舌头收回。手里剑能砍倒树木，因此它也常被请去帮助伐木工。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME throws its shuriken at opponents, then uses its tongue to retrieve it. POKENAME is able to chop down trees with its shuriken and is often employed to help lumberjacks because of this.

entry: 它披着一身坚韧的金属皮肤，形似古代战士的铠甲。它会一动不动地引诱对手进入攻击范围，再用沉重的钢钳打出快得看不清的一击。
author: willowwhisker_98658
source: It wears a suit of durable, metallic skin that mimics the armor of ancient warriors. This Pokémon remains perfectly still to bait an opponent into range before delivering a blindingly fast strike with its heavy steel pincers.

entry: POKENAME虽然有翅膀，却因身体太重飞不起来。不过，寒冷的地下隧道里，它仍会快速振翅，产生热量取暖。
author: hophoppip
source: Though it has wings, it's unable to fly due to the weight of its body. POKENAME still makes use of its wings, vibrating them rapidly to generate warmth in chilly underground tunnels.

entry: POKENAME的身体已适应得近乎一颗假头，能吓退潜伏深海的生物，也能抓住或咬住靠得太近的对象。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's body has adapted to almost look like a fake head to scare away any creatures lurking in the deep sea. It can also be used to grab or bite anything that gets too close.

entry: POKENAME的每只大钳都能发射近距离的集中烈焰溅射。它很少用来攻击，反而喜欢朝脚下喷射，借瞬间爆发的冲力，朝任意方向跃出最远20英尺。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Each of POKENAME's pincers can expel short-ranged concentrated Flame Bursts. Seldom using this technique to attack, they instead favor aiming it at the ground below them. The sudden explosive force can propel POKENAME up to 20 feet in any direction.

entry: POKENAME有着钢铁肌肉、镰刀和大钳，破坏力无与伦比。承包商常请它在施工前帮忙清除树林。
author: sk372
source: With its steel muscles, scythes and pincers, POKENAME is a destructive powerhouse like no other. Contractors have used it regularly to help in deforestation prior to construction efforts.

entry: POKENAME坚硬的金属身体十分强壮，多数危险都不足为惧，因此很少缩进壳里。它会与同类玩捉人游戏，用大钳喷水追逐彼此。
author: sk372
source: It is rare to see a POKENAME retreat into its shell, as its hard metal body gives it enough strength to be unafraid of most dangers. It plays tag with other POKENAME by squirting water from its large claws.

entry: POKENAME能缩进岩石外壳，防御十分周全。它的战术是带着壳飞上天空，再像流星一样猛砸下来。
author: evilgammon
source: Being able to retreat into its rocky shell, POKENAME is well defended. Its tactic in battle is to take to the air in its shell and come crashing down like a meteor.

entry: POKENAME的身体硬如钢铁，也很耐热，却常常温热甚至发烫。不过，对它信任的对象，火焰绝不会造成伤害，钢铁般的身体摸起来也很凉爽。
author: infinex21
source: The body of a POKENAME is as hard as steel and resistant to heat, yet is often hot or warm. Its flames will never harm those it trusts, and its steel-hard body will feel cool to the touch for them as well.

entry: POKENAME所持棍棒的末端有钳子，很适合夹取平时够不到的高处树果。棍棒沉重又覆着金属，也是高效的防身武器。
author: sk372
source: The pincer at the end of POKENAME's stick makes it perfect for grabbing berries too high for it to reach normally. Its weight and metal coating also make it an efficient club to use for self-defense.

entry: 巨钳螳螂原本的大钳如今有了大脑，能独立于主体行动。奇怪的是，用基因之楔融合后，无论钳子还是身体上的脸，举止似乎都不像巨钳螳螂，也不像嘟嘟的任何一颗头。
author: bobosmith01
source: The claws that Scizor possessed now have brains and can act independently of the main body. Mysteriously, if fused via DNA splicers, neither the claws nor the body's face seem to behave like the Scizor or either head of Doduo.

entry: POKENAME有一个分成三大部分的大脑，类似于人脑的两个半球，相关生物学研究仍在继续。为了避免过热，它长途奔跑时必须定期休息。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME possesses one brain that is divided into three main parts, much like the two hemispheres of the human brain; further studies into its biology are ongoing. In order to not overheat, POKENAME must periodically rest when running long distances.

entry: POKENAME有一个分成三大部分的大脑，类似于人脑的两个半球，相关生物学研究仍在继续。为了避免过热，它长途奔跑时必须定期休息。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME possesses one brain that is divided into three main parts, much like the two hemispheres of the human brain; further studies into its biology are ongoing. In order to not overheat, POKENAME must periodically rest when running long distances.

entry: POKENAME的钢壳连最寒冷海洋深处的低温也能抵御。它会潜伏在寒冷寂静的深海，突然从黑暗中扑出，抓住毫无察觉、游经上方的猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's steel shell resists even the frigid temperatures of the bottom of the coldest of oceans. It lies in wait in the cold and quiet depths, springing out from the darkness to snatch up prey that unknowingly swims above it.

entry: POKENAME有着巨大的金属钳和钢铁身体，是难缠的敌人。鲜有攻击能刮伤厚重的甲壳，而巨钳一夹，连最坚固的钢材也能轻易粉碎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's giant metal pincer and steel body make it a formidable foe. Few attacks can even scratch its heavy carapace, and its giant claw has enough crushing power in its grip to shatter the sturdiest of steels with ease.

entry: POKENAME会躲在壳里吃储存的树果。外壳红白相间，常被误认为陈旧或损坏的精灵球。
author: beandrawsthings
source: POKENAME hide inside their shells, consuming stored berries. Due to the red and white colouration of their shells, they are often mistaken for old or damaged Poké Balls.

entry: POKENAME像一只用遗落已久的头骨代替外壳的壶壶。酿出树果汁时，多余的汁液会从空眼窝流下，仿佛头骨正在哭泣。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME resembles a Shuckle using an old forgotten skull as a replacement shell. As it generates berry juice, excess liquid pours from the hollow eye sockets, making it look as if the skull is crying.

entry: POKENAME常无忧无虑地四处飘荡。有人说，那是毒素侵入了它的脑子。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME is often seen floating about without a care in the world. Some say the toxins got to its brain.

entry: POKENAME在繁茂的丛林中，用蘑菇伪装自己。平日几乎一动不动，偶尔才吃点树果。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME camouflages itself with mushrooms in lush jungles. It usually stays motionless, occasionally eating berries.

entry: 进化后，POKENAME体内流动的毒素严重伤害了身体。它最终可能病重得无法作战，渐渐衰亡。
author: dodoowner_
source: After evolving, toxins flowing through POKENAME's body seriously damaged it. This Pokémon may eventually get too sick to fight and wilt away.

entry: POKENAME住在树果树附近，借独角犀牛的力量撞落树果，存进坚如岩石的壳里，制成美味果糊。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lives near berry trees, using Rhyhorn's strength to knock berries loose. It stores them inside its rock-solid shell and creates a delicious paste.

entry: POKENAME的育儿袋里自然长着多种树果，会在体内将它们酿成混合果汁。这些果汁能有效应对各种疾病，它也乐意免费分享。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME grows a variety of berries naturally in its pouch, which it uses to create mixed juices inside its body. These concoctions are effective at combating various illnesses, and POKENAME shares them freely.

entry: POKENAME大多数时间都在采集树果，装入育儿袋。在小壶壶的壳完全长好前，它会在袋中教幼崽把树果发酵成优质、营养丰富的果糊。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: POKENAME spends most of their time foraging for berries and putting them in their pouch. Until the baby Shuckle's shell fully grows, POKENAME's pouch provides an environment to teach the baby how to ferment berries into a fine, nutritious pulp.

entry: 它会把四肢扭成翅膀的形状，居然真能短暂飞行。吃树果前，它喜欢先裹上一层花粉。
author: sk372
source: It contorts its limbs into the shapes of wings that miraculously allow it to fly for short periods. It enjoys coating berries in flower pollen before consuming them.

entry: POKENAME没有实体外壳保护柔软的身体，只能依靠半透明屏障。为了时刻维持防护，它腾不出任何肢体表演其他模仿动作。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME doesn't have a physical shell to protect its soft body, relying instead on a translucent barrier. Maintaining this shield at all times doesn't leave any appendages free to mime anything else.

entry: POKENAME喜欢独处，好专心寻找钟爱的树果，除非同伴格外安静。受到威胁时，它会挥动钉头锤般的尾巴，趁对手晕头转向时逃走。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME prefers solitude to focus on searching for its favored variety of berries, unless its companions are extremely calm. When threatened, it will swing its mace-like tail and run away while the opponent is disoriented.

entry: POKENAME常被误当成椒盐卷饼，引来灰尘山、小拉达等宝可梦捕食。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are often preyed upon by Pokémon such as Garbodor and Rattata, as it is commonly mistaken for a pretzel.

entry: POKENAME会漂洋过海，寻找没吃过的树果，尽可能收集不同种类。生态学家曾在它壳里发现被认为早已灭绝的树果种子，并用来培育出新植株。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME travel the ocean in search of new berries to feed on, trying to gather as many unique species as they can. Ecologists have found the seeds of berries previously thought to be extinct within POKENAME's shell, using them to grow new plants.

entry: POKENAME会漂洋过海，寻找没吃过的树果，尽可能收集不同种类。它用壳里伸出的长须，从水面捞起漂浮的果实，再稳妥地收进壳里。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME travel the ocean in search of new berries to feed on, trying to gather as many unique species as they can. They use long tendrils sprouting from their shell to pluck floating fruit from the water, tucking it safely into their shell.

entry: POKENAME壳里酿出的树果汁，只有多边兽及其相关种类真正懂得欣赏。其他宝可梦都觉得味道古怪，喝完以后，肚子里还会麻上一阵。
author: sk372
source: Juice produced by berries held within POKENAME's shell is only really appreciated by Porygon-related species. Any others find the flavor to be strange, leaving an odd tingling in the stomach for some time after drinking.

entry: POKENAME能复制出草药和树果的数字版本，在壳里混合。医院常请它制作、测试新的实验性药物。
author: rymyll_the_wanderer
source: POKENAME is capable of creating digital copies of herbs and berries it can mix inside its shell. It is commonly used at hospitals to create and test new experimental medicines.

entry: POKENAME平时温顺，大多把身体缩在壳里，尽量显得毫无威胁。但若被逼得必须交战，就会展现完整的体形与力量，迅速收拾敌人。
author: sk372
source: Usually passive in nature, POKENAME keeps most of its body retracted in its shell and looks as unimposing as possible. If pushed to confrontation, however, it reveals its full size and strength, making quick work of its foe.

entry: POKENAME的头长在细长尾巴的最末端。吃下的树果经过过滤，送入蜷起的身体，最终化成果汁，从身体闭合的“眼睛”里渗出。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's head is located at the very end of its long and small tail. Berries it consumed are filtered to the curled-up body, eventually becoming juice that will leak from the body's closed "eyes".

entry: POKENAME常缩在壳里，沿河流小溪漂行。外壳散发甜甜的树果香，引来小虫，它便伸出长舌吸食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends much of its time tucked into its shell, floating down rivers and streams. It uses a long tongue to slurp up insects drawn to the sweet berry-like scent its shell gives out.

entry: POKENAME会用爪子挤碎树果，将多汁的果浆送给其他对象，表达亲近。因此对多数训练家来说，养它总免不了弄得黏糊糊、乱糟糟。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME squishes berries between its paws and offers the juicy slurry to others as a sign of affection. This makes owning one as a pet a sticky, messy affair for most Trainers.

entry: POKENAME飞行时会采集异奇果，存进壳里。酿出的果汁口味偏涩，却营养丰富。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects Wiki Berries while flying and keeps them in its shell. The juice it brews is dry in flavor but packed with nutrients.

entry: POKENAME的羊毛摸起来柔软，防护力却出人意料。战斗中，连强烈的冲击也能吸收，看不出任何损伤。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's wooly coat is soft to the touch, but it's also surprisingly protective, absorbing forceful strikes in battle with no visible damage.

entry: POKENAME会把电缆或金属导体收进壳里，帮助持续发电、增强电力。紧张时，它会释放大量电流，让身体发亮，再将光从壳里照出去。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gather cables or metal conductors into their shells to help generate and amplify their electricity at all times. When under stress, they unleash enough electricity for their bodies to glow, projecting the resulting light from their shells.

entry: POKENAME会漂过遥远的路程，寻找木子果。它将树果存进壳里，为同伴酿制疗伤果汁。
author: .izik
source: Floating across great distances, POKENAME searches for Lum Berries. It stores them in its shell, creating healing juice for its allies.

entry: POKENAME繁殖很快，会聚成大群生活，进化后才离群。想进化时，它会囤积树果汁，想加快这个过程，但研究者尚不清楚是否有效。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME live in large clusters due to how quickly they reproduce, and only leave after evolution. When wanting to evolve, they save a stockpile of Berry Juices to quicken this process; researchers do not yet understand if this has any effect.

entry: 它会用极有弹性的尾巴采摘高处的树果，甚至偷拿其他宝可梦巢里的果子。尾巴上有保护壳，因此打出的拳力道出奇地强。
author: mistymagius
source: It uses its super stretchy tail to grab berries from high up trees, even stealing them other Pokémon's nests. Due to the protective shell on its tail, its punches are surprising strong.

entry: POKENAME擅长检出食物中的毒，还能分泌延长饭菜保鲜时间的液体，因此很受王室厨房青睐。它也乐在其中，因为能吃到品质最好的树果。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is an expert at detecting poison in food and can produce a liquid that keeps meals fresher for longer, making it highly sought after in royal kitchens. POKENAME enjoyed this arrangement, as it was fed the highest quality berries.

entry: POKENAME擅长检出食物中的毒，还能分泌延长饭菜保鲜时间的液体，因此很受王室厨房青睐。它也很满意，因为自己得到了从未有过的尊重。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is an expert at detecting poison in food and can produce a liquid that keeps meals fresher for longer, making it highly sought after in royal kitchens. POKENAME was happy with this arrangement, as it was treated with newfound respect.

entry: 翅膀带不动外壳的重量，POKENAME因此无法飞行。部分外壳长到了头顶，形成带有坚硬角的头盔，用于自卫。
author: oddwalls
source: Its wings cannot carry the weight of its shell, rendering POKENAME flightless. Part of its shell has grown over its head, forming a helmet with strong horns, which it uses for self-defense.

entry: POKENAME身体柔软，飞行时会不由自主地翻滚旋转。常能看见它与图图犬结伴。
author: oddwalls
source: Due to its flexible body, POKENAME tumbles and spins involuntarily as it flies. It can often be seen in the company of Smeargle.

entry: POKENAME装得很聪明，但没有大舌贝给它注毒，其实几乎和呆呆兽一样傻。它的滑稽举动让卡在头上的壶壶很烦恼。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME acts like it's intelligent, but since there was no Shellder to envenomate it, it's almost as stupid as a Slowpoke. Its antics annoy the Shuckle stuck on its head.

entry: POKENAME会采集莓榴果，酿出辛辣却舒缓的果汁。美食厨师常为独家食谱而寻找它。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME harvests Haban Berries to create a spicy yet soothing juice. Gourmet chefs often seek it out for exclusive recipes.

entry: POKENAME与古代文字相似得不可思议，人们认为它的含义是“保护”或“防御”。
author: atlas3339098
source: POKENAME shares an uncanny resemblance to ancient writing. Its meaning is thought to be "protection" or "defense".

entry: 它们会偶然找到健美爱好者留下的训练器材，其中就有力量负重。它们会利用这些负重增加冲撞的动量，撞向其他物体。
author: quackquackattack
source: They stumble upon training equipment left by bodybuilders, and one such piece of equipment is the Power Weight. They utilize these weights to gain more momentum to slam into other objects.

entry: 它的主体虽然脆弱，保护壳却几乎无法摧毁，连拆楼铁球的撞击也能承受。它会一路撞穿森林，收集沿途发现的树果。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its main body being quite vulnerable, its protective shell is almost indestructible, strong enough to withstand impacts from a wrecking ball. It smashes through the forests, collecting the berries it finds along the way.

entry: POKENAME用威风凛凛的外形吓跑天敌，好安心酿造果汁。据说酿出的汁液尝起来像葡萄酒。
author: phantom640
source: POKENAME takes advantage of its imposing shape to scare away predators so it can brew its juice in peace. This juice supposedly tastes akin to wine.

entry: 高雅的派对或活动上，常能见到POKENAME提供树果汁。这种果汁经过充分发酵，带着柑橘的味道。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: It's not uncommon to spot POKENAME at fancy parties or events providing Berry Juice. This Berry Juice is especially fermented and has a citrus taste to it.

entry: POKENAME会破开棱瓜果树的树皮，吸食树液，再将掉落的树果存进甲壳，留待以后食用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drinks sap from Coba Berry trees after breaking their bark. Fallen berries are stored in its chitin for later consumption.

entry: POKENAME靠坚韧的外壳保护自己，受到威胁时就会缩进去。壳外伸出的触须不断探测空气中的气味，试图在危险来临前察觉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME rely on their toughened shells to keep themselves safe from harm, withdrawing into them when they feel threatened. The tendrils extending from their shell constantly taste the air, attempting to sense danger before it arrives.

entry: POKENAME靠坚韧的外壳保护自己，大部分身体都藏在里面。它会排出由树果汁和黏液混成的浓稠糊状物，借此移动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME rely on their toughened shells to keep themselves safe from harm, keeping most of their bodies hidden within them. They extrude a thick paste made from the juice of berries mixed with mucus, using the paste as a means of locomotion.

entry: POKENAME靠坚韧的外壳保护自己，将身体藏在壳里。它会排出由树果汁和黏液混成的浓稠糊状物，借此移动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME rely on their toughened shells to keep themselves safe from harm, keeping their body hidden away within them. They extrude a thick paste made from the juice of berries mixed with mucus, using the paste as a means of locomotion.

entry: 它不停分泌黏液，使身体不怕进水。对孩子十分友善，无论如何都会把保护他们放在首位。
author: skymaster426
source: It secretes mucus constantly, which allows it to stay waterproof. It is very friendly around children and will protect them above all else.

entry: POKENAME吃下的图像会决定酿出果汁的味道。水果图像让味道更甜，蔬菜图像则让味道更鲜。
author: .izik
source: The images POKENAME consumes determine the flavor of the juice it produces. Fruits create a sweeter taste while vegetables yield a more savory one.

entry: POKENAME把树果与体液混合，在角上形成黑色圆球。这些球营养丰富，能做成又甜又酸的糖果。
author: bobogagabobo
source: POKENAME mixes berries with its body fluids to produce the black orbs on its horns. These orbs are very nutritious and can be used to make very sweet and acidic candy.

entry: POKENAME不停寻找树果，将它们压碎混合，制成颜料。颜料品质极佳，颜色丰富，很受著名画家追捧。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are constantly foraging for berries, crushing and mixing them to create paint. The paint they create is incredibly high quality with a wide range of colors, making it highly sought after by famous painters.

entry: POKENAME最爱大嚼树果。产出的奶带着怡人的果甜味，风味会随食谱变化。农夫很珍爱它营养丰富的奶和温顺的性情。
author: korro0490
source: POKENAME adores munching on berries. The milk it produces has a delightful fruity sweetness that changes with its diet. It is cherished by farmers for its nourishing milk and gentle nature.

entry: 它经常馋粘糕，尤其喜欢体力粘糕。不过从中几乎得不到营养，因此训练家常先把它与队伍的其他成员分开，再喂给它吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: It frequently has cravings for Mochi and is drawn to Health Mochi in particular. Since it gains little to no nutritional value from it, Trainers often separate it from the rest of the party before feeding it.

entry: POKENAME会在尾巴外的壳里储存树果，留待以后吃，免得外出遇见其他宝可梦。储存的树果常会发酵，酿成极为珍贵美味的果汁。
author: infinex21
source: Within the shell around its tail, POKENAME stores berries for later meals in order to avoid encountering other Pokémon. Often enough, its stored berries ferment and become some of the most precious and delicious juices known.

entry: POKENAME会用细长的尾巴挂在树枝上。四肢分泌的黏液能帮助抓稳，一旦直接接触空气又会迅速变硬，兼顾行动与防御。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hangs from tree branches using its long, spindly tails. Its limbs produce a sticky secretion that helps it to maintain its grip while also rapidly hardening when exposed directly to air, providing it both mobility and defense.

entry: 它尚未发育出将树果转化成果汁所需的消化液，却仍会把树果和其他东西收进育儿袋，装作酿果汁的大师。
author: hophoppip
source: It hasn't yet developed the digestive juices needed to turn Berries into juice. Still, it gathers and stores Berries and other things inside its pouch, pretending to be a master juice maker.

entry: POKENAME十分依赖厚壳保护。战斗时，它会调整姿势，确保总由身体中段先承受打击，再积蓄攻击的动能，将其转化为电力。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME rely heavily on their thick shell for protection, angling their bodies so that their midsection is always the first to take a blow in a fight. They can charge up the kinetic energy of attacks and convert it into electricity.

entry: POKENAME主要吃水果，也会在体内混合苦根与茶叶，酿出类似康普茶的液体。据说这种发酵茶有助于肠道健康，会喂给消化不良的宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: While primarily frugivorous creatures, POKENAME mixes bitter roots and tea leaves in its body to produce a liquid that resembles kombucha. The fermented tea is said to help improve gut health and is given to Pokémon with digestive issues.

entry: POKENAME是行动缓慢、性情温和的巨兽，坚硬外壳能抵挡大多数危险。它会吃下大量树果，最终将其变成多汁的冰冻点心。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a slow-moving, gentle giant; its hard shell protects it from most dangers. It consumes vast quantities of berries, eventually turning them into juicy frozen treats.

entry: POKENAME在网络空间移动时，中央身体外的壳能抵御恶意程序。活得越久，现实中的壳也越坚固。
author: .izik
source: The shell encasing POKENAME's central body defends it against malware as it moves through cyberspace. The longer it lives, the sturdier its shell becomes in the real world.

entry: POKENAME受到攻击时会缩进钛一般坚硬的壳里，也能从壳上的孔洞发射尖刺，赶走敌人。
author: .izik
source: When attacked, POKENAME retreats into a titanium-hard shell. It can launch spikes from shell openings to drive foes off.

entry: POKENAME会用强壮的双臂高效榨取树果汁。近来，果汁店开始雇它制作饮料。
author: hophoppip
source: With its powerful arms, POKENAME squeezes the juice from Berries with great efficiency. Juice bars have recently started employing POKENAME to make drinks.

entry: 进入POKENAME体内的树果，最后会变成一种极为古怪、在许多地区遭禁的果汁。酿制期间，它会用沾满果汁的钳爪，猛烈攻击周围的一切。
author: sk372
source: Berries taken into POKENAME's body are eventually turned into a very strange type of juice outlawed in many regions. It violently attacks anything near it during the process, swiping at them with juice-stained claws.

entry: POKENAME主要住在洞穴，白天也常进森林采集树果。它很自私，若有谁想拿一颗给自己，就会变得十分凶狠。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME primarily lives in caves, though it can often be seen venturing into forests to gather berries during the day. A selfish Pokémon, it gets very aggressive should someone try to take one for themselves.

entry: 它会在第二副颚里收集各种树果。果子的风味，与被引诱进这副颚里的不幸猎物相当搭配。
author: hophoppip
source: It collects a variety of Berries in its second set of jaws. The flavors of the Berries pair well with the unfortunate prey lured into the jaws.

entry: POKENAME生活在荒凉多石的海底，是真正的先驱，为更复杂的生命找到立足之地创造条件。迁移时，它们会碾碎岩石，为其他宝可梦开辟栖息地。
author: ocxin
source: Living among barren, rocky underwater landscapes, POKENAME are true pioneers and pave the way for more complex life to find its niche. They crush up rocks as they migrate, creating habitats for other Pokémon.

entry: 越来越多果汁店雇用POKENAME提供树果汁。它会先笨拙地跳一段舞，再恭敬鞠躬，从头部倒出果汁。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Juice bars have seen a rise in hiring POKENAME to serve Berry Juice. After giving an awkward dance, POKENAME give a respectful bow, dispensing Berry Juice from their heads.

entry: POKENAME会在中空的体内发酵树果，酿出果浆般的树果汁，哺育后代。探索冒险一整天后，幼年的尼多兰和尼多朗最爱喝这种果汁。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME nurture their offspring by fermenting berries in their hollow body, creating a slurry-like Berry Juice. After a day of exploration and adventure, young Nidoran love to drink this juice.

entry: 饥荒时，POKENAME会现身，将收集的树果全送给挨饿的宝可梦。不知为何，它的角有种力量，能让周围的食物不再腐坏。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will appear during famines, giving away all the berries it has collected to starving Pokémon. Somehow, its horn has the power to prevent any food around it from spoiling.

entry: 早期的野外目击报告称，曾看到POKENAME双眼流血的可怕景象。进一步研究才发现，只是体内多余的树果汁从空眼窝流出来。
author: sk372
source: Early sightings of POKENAME in the wild reported the macabre sight of it bleeding from its eyes. Further research revealed this was simply excess berry juice from within its body leaking out through the hollow sockets.

entry: POKENAME很像海底的岩石构造，缓慢爬行却常暴露身份。即使如此，它仍能借众多触须跃起，用壳罩住猎物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME almost seem like rock formations on the ocean floor, but their slow crawl usually exposes them. Even so, they can use their many tendrils to jump up and cover their prey with their shells.

entry: POKENAME出现在森林时，会吃光周围树上的树果，再消失不见。体内各种树果混合酿出的汁液极其罕见，据说是能治愈一切疾病的神奇灵药。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME appears in a forest, it consumes all the berries from the trees around it before vanishing. The berry juice created from this mixture within its body is extremely rare, and said to be a miracle elixir capable of curing any disease.

entry: POKENAME壳上的孔洞会不断长出树果树，结出的树果随季节变化。它虽然因诱人的香气而受欢迎，却十分胆小，有谁靠近就会缩进壳里。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME continuously grow berry trees from the holes in their shell, with the berries changing based on the season. Despite being popular for their alluring scent, POKENAME are quite skittish and will hide in their shells if anyone approaches.

entry: POKENAME坚硬的岩石壳总会指向最近的磁力来源。若将它放在两块磁铁之间，它就会不停转圈，直到拿走其中一块。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a tough rocky shell that always points to the closest magnetic source. When placed between two magnets, it spins in circles until a magnet is pulled away.

entry: POKENAME是杂食性宝可梦，会先用带刺的壳捶打食物，再吞下碎屑，与体液混合成咸甜的汁液。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is omnivorous and beats its food with its spiky shell. It eats what's left, mixing with its bodily fluids to create a sweet and savory juice.

entry: POKENAME进化时，锋利的壳会裂成两片刀刃，由灵活的触手熟练挥舞。战斗中，壳刃里储存的树果汁会从小孔渗出，赋予刀刃特殊的性质。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's sharp shell split upon evolution, forming two blades that it skillfully wields with its flexible tentacles. The berry juice stored inside the shell-blades seeps out through small openings during battle, giving them special properties.

entry: POKENAME会缩进几乎无法穿透的壳里，抵御攻击。受到威胁时，它能以惊人的力量还击，但这样也会暴露柔软的身体。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME withdraws inside its almost impenetrable shell to protect itself from attack. If threatened, it can strike back with incredible force, but doing so leaves its soft body vulnerable.

entry: POKENAME会用众多丝带摘下树果，压成果泥，再邀请其他对象舔食丝带上甜甜的果浆。若好意遭拒，它会十分难过。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its many ribbons to grab at berries growing from trees, before smashing them together into a pulp. It then offers to let others lick the sweet, juicy mush off the ribbons; it gets very sad if this generosity is refused.

entry: POKENAME常去农场偷树果，在背部磨碎。加工完毕后，它就能用手炮射出树果汁来攻击。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME frequently rob farms of their berries, grinding them in their back. Once finished, POKENAME can fire the Berry Juice out of their hand cannon as an attack.

entry: POKENAME会在巢里储存树果，用尾巴的孢子帮助发酵。酿出的果糊美味可口，它会与同族分享。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stores berries in its den, where spores from its tail help ferment them. The resulting paste is delicious and shared with its kin.

entry: 它在庞大中空的体内储存树果，能搅成果糊，放出汁液与其他对象分享，也能借此分散敌人注意，趁机逃跑。
author: infinex21
source: It stores berries in its large, hollow body. It can churn these berries into a fine pulp and release the juices for others, or to distract foes while it flees.

entry: POKENAME实现愿望时，头部会漏出树果汁，可能已经发酵了好几年。它喜欢轻柔舒缓的旋律。
author: bobosmith01
source: When POKENAME grants a wish, Berry Juice that has likely fermented for years leaks from its head. It enjoys gentle and calming melodies.

entry: POKENAME会采集杏仔果，埋在地道里。发酵后，果汁会变得极富营养。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers Apicot Berries and buries them in its tunnel. After fermenting, the juice becomes an incredibly nutritious substance.

entry: POKENAME会在树果田里奔跑玩耍，扑向找到的树果，拿来嬉戏。认定果子符合自己的标准后，它就会将其抛入尾巴里榨汁。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME play through berry fields, pouncing and playing with the berries they find. When they declare a berry is up to their standards, POKENAME tosses the berry into their tail to juice.

entry: POKENAME十分害羞，多数时间都藏在壳里。它歌声出众，但需要大量训练，才有足够自信让训练家听到。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: Being very shy, POKENAME spends most of its time hidden within its shell. POKENAME is an amazing singer, but it takes a lot of training to build its confidence enough to let its Trainer hear its song.

entry: POKENAME会用壳啃碎仙人掌果，直到能轻松喝下。用这种果实制成的树果汁带着淡淡酸味。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME use their shell to gnaw on cactus fruit until they can easily drink it. Berry Juice made by POKENAME carry a slight tartness from these fruits.

entry: POKENAME在夜里觅食，用中空的獠牙吸尽树果的汁液。厚壳虽然防护出色，却也常让它难以飞行。
