author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME feeds during the night, using its hollow fangs to drain berries of all of their juices. While its thick shell is great for protection, POKENAME often has difficulty flying because of it.

entry: POKENAME会在洞穴深处采集宝石和树果。压碎的树果化成甜果汁，风味随着一同存放的宝石而改变。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers gems and berries deep in caves. The crushed berries become a sweet juice that changes based on the gems they are stored alongside.

entry: POKENAME吃下的树果会与体内毒素混合，酿成毒汁。为了自卫，它会从甲壳孔洞射出一团团毒液。
author: sk372
source: Berries POKENAME consumes mix with its internal toxins to make a poisonous juice. It launches globs of the toxic concoction from the holes in its carapace as a way of self-defense.

entry: POKENAME会等在最高的山顶，再高速滚下。外壳极其坚固，哪怕猛撞上滚动路线中的对象，也能承受最强烈的冲击。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME wait up on the highest of mountains before rolling down them at high speeds. Their shells are able to withstand the hardest of crashes with whoever finds themselves upon the receiving end of their roll.

entry: POKENAME会把桃桃果存进毒液晃荡的壳里。毒素能将果子转化为美味、具有解毒作用的果汁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stores Pecha Berries in its sloshing, poison-filled shell. The toxins turn the fruit into a delicious, detoxifying juice.

entry: POKENAME合颚时，触手会从壳上的小孔伸出蠕动。张开颚后，它们便一齐从口中探出，卷住所有能抓到的树果，拖入口中吃掉。
author: sk372
source: When its jaws are closed, POKENAME's tentacles wriggle out of the pores of its shell. When its jaws open, they all undulate out from its mouth to grab and reel in any berries it can take in to consume.

entry: POKENAME把树果存放在中空的木质身体里。传说偷走一颗，就会遭到永无止境的疲惫诅咒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME keeps berries in its hollow wooden body. Legends say that stealing one results in a curse of endless exhaustion.

entry: POKENAME喜欢帮助其他宝可梦，会在头上堆满树果，任大家吃。如果有谁需要保护，它甚至愿意让对方躲进壳上的孔洞里。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves to help other Pokémon, keeping tons of berries atop its head so they can snack on them. It will even let them hide in the holes in its shell if they are in need of protection.

entry: POKENAME会用声波震落树上的雾莲果，存进壳里，并把酿出的果汁分给亲近的朋友。
author: .izik
source: Using sound waves, POKENAME knocks Rowap Berries from trees. It stores them in its shell and shares the juice with its close friends.

entry: POKENAME是宝可梦互利共生的例子。其他宝可梦保护它免遭捕食，作为回报，能得到营养丰富的发酵果汁，其中的细菌还能帮助抵御疾病。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME is an example of Pokémon participating in symbiosis. By providing POKENAME with protection from predators, other Pokémon receive highly nutritious fermented juice filled with bacteria that protect against diseases.

entry: POKENAME无法控制黏液的酸性，却很喜欢被抚摸，因此训练家总会小心地只摸外壳。
author: mary_the_jane
source: POKENAME cannot control its mucus's acidity. However, it is known to love pets, so Trainers cautiously pet its shell.

entry: 许多神秘生物的传闻似乎都源自它奇特的体形。四肢能伸长到30英尺以上，甚至能看到它跨在树梢上方行走。
author: mistymagius
source: Many cryptids seem to have been born from this Pokémon due to its peculiar body shape. Its limbs can stretch over 30 feet long and can even be seen walking above the treetops.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇常渗出类似树果汁的物质。可惜味道极苦，很可能是为了吓退捕食者。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The mushrooms on POKENAME's back often leak a substance similar to Berry Juice. Unfortunately it is extremely bitter, most likely a way to deter predators.

entry: POKENAME会借壳内的真菌消化采来的树果。多数人觉得过程中的副产物很恶心，但也有人欣赏那股酵母风味，喜欢抹在烤面包上吃。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME digests berries it gathers with the help of a fungus inside its shell. Although most people consider the by-product of this process to be disgusting, some people praise its yeasty flavor and love spreading it on toast.

entry: POKENAME会用粗厚的手指压碎树果榨汁。这种方法配上更大的身体，能让树果汁产量达到未融合壶壶的三倍。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME use their thick fingers to crush berries into juice. Combining this method with their larger bodies allow them to triple the Berry Juice output of an unfused Shuckle.

entry: POKENAME会攀在洞穴和隧道壁上，用黏滑的附肢收集霉菌和其他真菌来吃。它能吃净石头上的杂物，再吐出光洁的宝石，因此很受宝石收藏者喜爱。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME clings to cave and tunnel walls, feeding on molds and fungi by collecting them with its slimy appendages. It is popular with gem collectors since it eats a stone clean of debris, then spits the polished gem onto the ground.

entry: POKENAME背上的厚壳主要由硬化的蘑菇伞盖构成，会定期从表面的大孔中喷出一团团甜香的孢子。
author: .jerden
source: The thick shell on POKENAME's back mostly consists of the hardened mushroom cap of a fungus. It will regularly expel puffs of sweet-smelling spores from the large holes in its surface.

entry: 多数人以为POKENAME的壳只是精巧却不能动的拟态，让捕食者误以为看到了甲贺忍蛙。其实它会先投出发酵果汁构成的雾弹，迷惑敌人，再如忍者般灵巧地逃走。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: Most assume POKENAME's shell is an elaborate, yet immobile mimicry to fool predators into thinking they're looking at a Greninja. Instead, POKENAME disorient foes with a misty bomb of fermented juice before fleeing with ninja-like grace.

entry: POKENAME壳内有特殊腺体，能让树果汁充满碳酸气。小型宝可梦会成群围过来，看果汁从壳里壮观地喷涌而出。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has a special gland inside its shell that allows it to carbonate its berry juice. Groups of small Pokémon gather around POKENAME to watch the geyser of juice spectacularly erupt from its shell.

entry: 金南果在POKENAME壳里被压碎，酿出的果汁甜得惊人，能让人的味觉迟钝好几天。
author: .izik
source: Pumkin Berries are crushed inside POKENAME's shell. The juice is so sweet it can dull a person's sense of taste for days.

entry: POKENAME酿果汁时，壳上最大的孔洞会亮起橙光。景象令人不安，许多人因此认为它的树果汁受了诅咒。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME's body is in the process of creating juice, an orange light glows from the largest holes in its shell. This unsettling view has lead many to believe that POKENAME's berry juice is cursed.

entry: POKENAME爱吃甜树果，会存进茧状外壳，留待缺粮时食用。分泌出的果汁被赞为甘甜可口的饮品。
author: metcassette
source: POKENAME have a penchant for sweet berries, which they store in their cocoon-like shell to eat when food is otherwise scarce. The resulting juice they secrete is praised as a delicious and sugary beverage.

entry: POKENAME在体内收集少量树果后，会浮到高处，再重重砸向地面。冲击会瞬间把存下的树果压成美味的果浆汁。
author: sk372
source: After gathering up a small amount of berries in its body, POKENAME floats up high and crashes back down to the ground harshly. The impact instantly turns the stored berries into a slurry of tasty berry juice.

entry: POKENAME既能翻耕土地，又能用吃下的树果分解后的残渣施肥，对农夫而言是难得的帮手。
author: larkus
source: POKENAME is incredibly valuable to farmers due to its ability to till land and fertilize it with the decomposed remnants of the Berries it eats.

entry: POKENAME准备战斗时会挺起身体，从坚硬的壳里伸出多条触须。它力气不够，打不出重击，只能热情有余、技巧不足地乱挥，防御则十分依赖外壳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME rear up when they're preparing to fight, extruding multiple tendrils from their tough shell. They lack the strength to land heavy attacks, instead flailing with more enthusiasm than skill and relying heavily on their shell for defence.

entry: POKENAME一旦抓到谁偷拿领地里的树果，就会暴怒。等它闹完，周围的树木和叶片往往都已碎成细小的纸屑模样。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: If POKENAME catches anyone trying to steal berries from its territory it flies into a violent rage. When its rampage is finished, every leaf and tree in its environment often resembles tiny pieces of confetti.

entry: 察觉危险时，POKENAME会先把四肢缩进壳里，再瞬间移动到安全处。偶尔，壳里储存的树果没能一起移动，会在空中悬停几秒才落地。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME senses danger, it tucks its limbs into its shell before teleporting away to safety. On rare occasions, berries it stored within do not travel with it, hovering in midair for a few seconds before dropping to the ground.

entry: POKENAME天生力气不大，耐力却出众，会刻苦锻炼，让自己更壮。长时间训练后，它会喝加盐的树果汁，补充体力。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME do not naturally have the great strength, they have remarkable endurance, and train strenuously to bulk up. At the end of a long workout, they drink Berry Juice with added salt to replenish their energy.

entry: POKENAME的身体几乎全是肌肉，没有骨头，能吸收冲击，减轻伤害。但只要不再绷紧肌肉，整个身体就会完全瘫软。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is almost entirely muscle. The lack of bones helps it to absorb impacts with minimal damage, but it will completely collapse if POKENAME ever stops flexing.

entry: POKENAME的手指无法对握，力气又大，想抓水果却常捏得汁液溅满全身。试图收拾时，又只会把果汁抹得到处都是。
author: soup1900
source: With no opposable fingers and having immense strength, POKENAME often splatters fruit it attempts to grab all over itself. Attempts to clean up its own mess only further spread the juices around.

entry: POKENAME会大量饮用自己树果汁制成的能量饮料，维持强壮发达的肌肉。它用手臂砸敌人的技巧，与捣烂水果十分相似。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME keeps itself extremely strong and muscular by drinking plenty of energy drinks made with its own Berry Juice. Its technique in smashing foes with its arms is similar to that of pulping fruit.

entry: POKENAME身体细长，酿果汁的时间比多数同类更久。它会甩动长脖子，用中间坚硬的壳块打击袭击者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's juice-making process takes longer than most due to its gangling, spindly body. It swings its lengthy neck around to hit attackers with the solid piece of shell in the center.

entry: POKENAME挂在树果树上，将采到的树果存进壳里。果子慢慢化成甜果汁，它会与其他宝可梦分享。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hangs from berry trees, collecting the berries and storing them in its shell. The berries are slowly turned into a sweet juice that POKENAME shares with other Pokémon.

entry: 为了加快酿果汁，POKENAME会缩起身体，沿山坡滚下，搅动体内的树果。方法虽然有效，却会洒出不少果汁，染上滚过的道路。
author: sk372
source: To accelerate the juice-making process, POKENAME tucks inside itself and rolls down mountainsides to churn the berries inside it. Though effective, much of its juice spills out and stains the paths it rolls down.

entry: POKENAME会在岩石般坚硬的壳里储存墨莓果，靠滚动将其压碎。果汁味美但营养较少，很适合制作冰沙。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers Bluk Berries in its rock-hard shell and rolls to crush them. The juice is tasty but low in nutrients, perfect for smoothies.

entry: POKENAME会用棍棒敲落树上的岳竹果，收进壳里，酿成甘甜又营养的果汁。
author: .izik
source: Using its stick, POKENAME knocks Magost Berries from trees. It stores them in its shell, producing a sweet and nutritious juice.

entry: POKENAME会捡树果和垃圾吃，在壳保护着的胃里消化。它沿途留下的黏液，可由经验丰富的厨师去毒后制成沙拉酱，带着浓郁酸味。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME scavenges berries and litter, digesting them in its shell-protected stomach. It trails ooze, which, when prepared by experienced chefs who neutralize the toxins, is used on salads as a tangy dressing.

entry: POKENAME非常热衷于飘着穿过物体，似乎对自己的能力着了迷。有些研究者指出，它们对进化抱有异乎寻常的乐观态度。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are ecstatic about floating through objects as though they are fascinated by their powers. Some researchers note that POKENAME are unusually optimistic about evolution.

entry: POKENAME虽然开朗温和，许多人却对它怀着难以抑制的恐惧。众多触手上覆着小吸盘，能轻松爬上任何表面。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its cheerful and gentle personality, a lot of people have an uncontrollable fear of POKENAME. Its many tentacles are covered in small suckers, allowing it to climb any surface with ease.

entry: POKENAME会吸取植物维持生命的树液，存进背上的球茎，确保冬天也有稳定的养分来源。它力气巨大，加上岩石般坚硬的角，能抬起并掀翻巨石。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME drains vital sap from plants and stores it inside the bulb on its back, ensuring a steady supply of nourishment even during winter. Its immense strength, combined with its rock-hard horn, allows it to lift and overturn massive boulders.

entry: 一窝中的第六颗蛋特别善于寻找甜美的花蜜和树液，供其他蛋享用。它这样做，主要是免得其他蛋惦记起自己的树液。
author: sk372
source: The sixth egg in the clutch has a particular affinity for finding sweet nectar and sap for the rest to consume. It does this primarily to make sure that the rest don't ever wish to feed of its own sap.

entry: 有人说POKENAME的头盔是空的，其实只是复眼漆黑一片。它会用角绊住袭击者，将其掀得仰面倒地，再用骨棒补上最后一击。
author: ghostslythe
source: It is said POKENAME's helmet is hollow, but in truth its compound eyes are the darkest shade of black. Using its horns, it tangles attackers, flipping them onto their backs before delivering a final bone club blow.

entry: POKENAME的角几乎和双腿一样有力。它会挑起大型对手，抛向空中，等对方落下时，再以毫不留情的回旋踢结束战斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's horn is nearly as powerful as its legs. Scooping large opponents and tossing them into the air, it finishes them off with a merciless roundhouse kick as they fall back towards the ground.

entry: POKENAME的外骨骼比岩石更硬。它会吸食树液增强体力，不断挑战同类，用巨角交锋，证明自己的优势。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body is covered by an exoskeleton harder than rock. It feeds on the sap of trees to make itself stronger, and it constantly challenges other members of its species, clashing with its titanic horn to prove dominance.

entry: POKENAME会用长藤缠住敌人，拖到近处，再用角打出迅猛的重击，结束战斗。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME entangles foes with its long vines, dragging them in close. It finishes the fight with a swift, crushing blow from its horn.

entry: POKENAME会用角撬开层层树皮，或在土里挖洞。一找到藏着的小虫，众多藤蔓就会伸出去抓住，送来吃掉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its horn to pry off layers of bark from trees or dig holes in dirt. Once it finds small insects beneath, its many vines reach out and grab the bugs so it can begin eating.

entry: POKENAME平时性情温和，一涉及食物却会变得贪婪又凶狠。进食时，若有谁想把它从树上弄下来，就会遭到猛烈反抗。
author: sk372
source: Normally a Pokémon with a very mild temperament, POKENAME becomes very greedy and aggressive where food is concerned. If anything tries to pry it from a tree while it feeds, it responds with extreme violence.

entry: POKENAME会刻划树皮标记领地，白天多半在空中巡视边界。若有同类闯入，它便如闪电般俯冲，扭住对手，再用刀刃般的肘部刺击。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME marks its territory by carving tree bark, spending most of the day patrolling the boundary from the air. If another of its species enters, it dives fast as lightning, grappling the foe before driving in a bladed elbow.

entry: POKENAME用巨角一击，连大树也能撞倒。它会迅速吞饮流出的树液，将树干吸干。
author: .izik
source: With its colossal horns, POKENAME topples even massive trees in a single blow. It quickly devours the sap that spills out, draining the wood dry.

entry: POKENAME会用坚硬的角撞树，震落果实。尾端的毒针则是武器，能用来抵御其他宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME crashes into trees, hitting them with its hard horn to knock fruit to the ground. It uses the poisonous stinger at the tip of its tail as a weapon to defend itself against other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME引以为傲的角既能导电，也能掀飞敌人。它通常很烦躁，但甜蜂蜜能让它平静。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME uses its prized horn to both conduct electricity and fling foes. It is usually agitated, but can be calmed with sweet honey.

entry: POKENAME是深海猎手，有着钢铁般坚硬的骨架，即使被击中要害也能承受。它会沿海底行进，用长角捕猎。
author: riel.vndxgrxvnd
source: POKENAME is a deep-sea hunter. With a steel-hard skeletal frame, it can withstand critical hits. It uses its long horns to hunt prey while traveling along the sea floor.

entry: POKENAME会用腹部的角切开、挖入树干，吸食里面的树液。它很贪吃，享用时无论什么靠近，哪怕是同类，它也会凶狠地挥角驱赶。
author: sk372
source: It uses the horn on its abdomen to cut and dig into trees in order to get to the sap within. Being greedy, it will aggressively flail its horn at anything approaching while it feasts, even other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME会剥下树皮，获取下面的树液。整个过程不用碰到植物，角尖亮起精神力量的光，就能撕下外层树皮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME peels bark off of trees in order to get the sap beneath. It does this without physically touching the plants, the tip of its horn glowing with psychic energy as it tears off the outer layers.

entry: 它虽然不是昆虫，却浑身覆着甲壳质的外骨骼。甲壳上的天然气孔能以爆发性的力道喷出火焰。
author: t3isukone
source: Though not an insect, this Pokémon is totally covered in a chitinous exoskeleton. Natural vents on its exoskeleton let it expel fire with explosive force.

entry: 这种林地宝可梦极其好斗，酷爱蜂蜜。它会袭击蜂巢，哪怕惹怒数十只宝可梦也毫不畏惧。一天结束后，它会睡进自己用角挖出的地洞。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is a highly aggressive woodland Pokémon that adores honey; it will attack hives and draw the anger of dozens of Pokémon without fear. At the end of the day, it sleeps in a burrow it dug out using its horn.

entry: 这种林地宝可梦极其好斗，酷爱蜂蜜。它会袭击蜂巢，哪怕惹怒数十只宝可梦也毫不畏惧。一天结束后，它会睡进自己用角挖出的地洞。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is a highly aggressive woodland Pokémon that adores honey; it will attack hives and draw the anger of dozens of Pokémon without fear. At the end of the day, it sleeps in a burrow it dug out using its horn.

entry: 它背上的硬壳能像翅膀一样张开，帮助控制猛烈的火焰，并推动身体飞行。战斗时，它会用强壮的角攻击，还常让自己的火焰裹住角。
author: infinex21
source: The hard shell on its back can split apart like wings to help control its explosive flames and propel itself through the air. It fights with its powerful horn that it will often veil in its own flames.

entry: POKENAME太久没吃蜂蜜，就会格外暴躁，用角攻击任何靠得太近的对象。它也不喜欢其他飞行属性宝可梦，总想把它们赶出领地。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME goes too long without honey, it becomes particularly short-tempered and attacks anyone who gets too close with its horn. It doesn't take kindly to other Flying-type Pokémon and constantly tries to chase them out of its territory.

entry: POKENAME是颇为寻常的小型虫属性宝可梦，却有个奇怪的习惯：会用角把不想要的猎物掀出蛛网。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME is a pretty typical little bug Pokémon. It has the curious habit of using its horn to flip undesired prey out of its web.

entry: POKENAME会用坚硬的角打击敌人，连树干都能轻松破开。它在夜空滑翔，以强力俯冲伏击猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME strikes at foes with its sturdy horn, capable of breaking open tree trunks with ease. It glides through the night sky, ambushing prey with powerful aerial dives.

entry: POKENAME以惊人的飞行能力闻名，会高速长途飞行，寻找甘甜花蜜。进食时若被打扰，它就会用角将入侵者狠狠掀飞，赶走对方。
author: jonclyd
source: POKENAME are notorious for their incredible flying ability, soaring long distances at high speed to seek sweet nectar. If disturbed while feeding, they chase off intruders, using their horns to hurl them with force.

entry: POKENAME能短暂窥见未来，借此预测对手动作。突然一挥角，就能将对手挑离地面，打出决定性的一击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME harnesses the brief glimpses into the future to predict movements from their opponents. With a sudden swing, they can lift their opponent off their feet to land a decisive blow.

entry: POKENAME能清楚预见未来，提前规划整场战斗。它会把坚硬的角当棍棒在身前挥动，挡下预见的攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can see into the future with such clarity that they can plan out an entire fight in advance. Their sturdy horn is wielded like a club, which swings in front of them to protect them from foreseen attacks.

entry: POKENAME会用角钻开坚韧树皮，获取下面的甜树液。若有谁打扰进食，它就让角和尾巴上的圆球迸出强光，使对方目眩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME digs into tough tree bark with its horn in order to get at the sweet sap lying just underneath. If others intrude on its feeding process, it blinds them with bright flashes from the orbs on its horn and tail.

entry: POKENAME的长舌像它常大口吸食的树液一样黏。强壮的四肢和翅膀能帮助它跃出很远。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's long tongue is as sticky as the tree sap their species so often gorge upon. Their muscular limbs and wings help them to leap large distances.

entry: POKENAME会用大角将自己固定在树枝上，免得被风吹走。它会吸食一种特殊柳树的树液，那种树仅生长在某些森林中。
author: fiordaliso
source: It uses its large horn to anchor itself to tree branches and prevent itself from being blown away by the wind. POKENAME feeds by sucking the sap from a very special kind of willow tree that grows only in certain forests.

entry: 除了世界上严寒的南北地区，几乎各地都能见到POKENAME浮在高空。它虽然也吃花蜜，最喜欢的却是蜂蜜。
author: bobosmith01
source: Excluding the frigid north and icy south parts of the world, POKENAME can be found floating high in the sky all across the globe. Although they also consume nectar, honey is their favorite food.

entry: POKENAME会用牙齿啃开树洞，吸食树液。若有小型宝可梦想来抢食，它就用角驱赶；可一旦遇上更大的对手，立刻就会逃跑。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their teeth to chew holes into trees, sucking out the sap. They use their horns to drive away smaller Pokémon looking to steal this sap, though they will flee in an instant when faced with a larger opponent.

entry: POKENAME住在树上，以甜蜂蜜和水果为食。尾巴和角格外有力，连最坚韧的果肉也能撕开。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME live in trees, feeding off of sweet honey and fruits. They have a particularly powerful tail and horn, which can rip through the flesh of even the toughest fruits.

entry: POKENAME会用坚硬的角掘土，将自己埋在水源附近，借此休息、恢复体力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its sturdy horn to dig into soil and bury itself near water sources. It does this to rest and replenish its strength.

entry: POKENAME闭眼时会靠触角感知热量和光。白天总会转向太阳，吸收能量。
author: .izik
source: When its eyes are closed, POKENAME uses its antennae to sense heat and light. It always turns toward the sun during daylight hours to absorb energy.

entry: POKENAME在沼泽间振翅飞行，寻找树液丰富的柳树，再用大口啃开树皮，吸尽里面的甜汁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME buzzes through swampy regions, searching for willow trees rich with sap. It chews into the bark with its maw to drain the sweet liquid inside.

entry: POKENAME会用角在河岸侧面挖巢。暴雨时，洞穴能存下多余的水，减轻洪灾，因此有人呼吁将它引入容易泛滥的河道，作为天然的防洪办法。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME use their horn to dig out nests in the side of riverbanks. Their burrows hold excess water when it rains heavily, leading to less flooding, and calls have been made to introduce them to flood-prone waterways as a nature-based solution.

entry: 训练家有危险时，POKENAME会立刻赶去救援，用强壮的角击倒每一个威胁。尝到格外甜美的蜂蜜时，身上的环纹会放出灿烂金光，表达满心欢喜。
author: fiordaliso
source: If its Trainer is in danger, POKENAME rushes to the rescue at once, striking down every threat with its powerful horn. When it tastes especially sweet honey, the rings on its body release a splendid golden glow to show how much it enjoyed it.

entry: 训练家有危险时，POKENAME会立刻赶去救援，用强壮的角击倒每一个威胁。尝到格外甜美的蜂蜜时，身上的环纹会放出灿烂金光，表达满心欢喜。
author: fiordaliso
source: If its Trainer is in danger, POKENAME rushes to the rescue at once, striking down every threat with its powerful horn. When it tastes especially sweet honey, the rings on its body release a splendid golden glow to show how much it enjoyed it.

entry: 身体健康时，POKENAME背上的黄花会散发蜂蜜般的甜香。遇见同类，它就会用大角摩擦树皮，发起挑战。
author: fiordaliso
source: When in good health, the yellow flower on its back releases a sweet, honey-like scent. If POKENAME encounters others of its kind, it challenges them by rubbing its large horn against tree bark.

entry: POKENAME会用长长的鼻角互相争斗，想把对方掀得仰面朝天。腿太短，翻倒后很难自己站起来。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fight one another using their long nose horn, attempting to flip one another onto their backs. With their stubby legs, it is difficult for POKENAME to right themselves when knocked over.

entry: POKENAME聚在深林里，吸食树汁与花蜜，用角集中超能力。大群一同施力，便能让林地扭转成离奇梦境，再用怪异现象与幻术，守住这片天地。
author: alkazamis
source: POKENAME gather deep in forests to sip sweet sap and nectar. They focus their psychic powers using their horns. Swarms of them warp their woodland realms into surreal dreamscapes, which they protect with freaky phenomena and bizarre illusions.

entry: 野生POKENAME会聚在印记树林，吸食树干内部的汁液。它能用耳朵察觉危险。
author: dodoowner_
source: Wild POKENAME gather together in the Tagtree Thicket and drink the sap inside of trees. It can sense danger with its ears.

entry: POKENAME会用角破开铜矿床，吞下矿石，强化金属外壳。受到攻击时，它会稳住身体，再以惊人的力量反击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME breaks apart copper ore deposits with its horn and consumes them to reinforce its metallic shell. When under attack, it braces itself and counters with devastating force.

entry: POKENAME正义感很强，常迅速救出陷入危险的人与宝可梦。每当看见谁作恶，它就会使出超级角击，将对方打倒。
author: cobalt0135
source: With a strong sense of justice, POKENAME often rescues people and Pokémon from danger with great speed. Whenever it sees someone commit an act of evil, it takes them down with its Megahorn.

entry: 它能从壳上的任意孔洞伸缩四肢。想偷袭它的捕食者会大吃一惊：角会突然缩回，再从身体完全不同的位置飞快伸出。
author: sk372
source: It can retract and extend its limbs from any of the holes in its shell. Predators thinking they can sneak up on it will be surprised when its horn disappears and then flies out of a completely different section of its body.

entry: POKENAME的巨角极其有力，能同时贯穿多个物体。它常吃下大量花蜜，维持充足的体力。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's gigantic horn is extremely powerful, able to pierce through multiple objects at once. This Pokémon will frequently eat lots of nectar to keep its energy high.

entry: POKENAME能把钳爪缩进外骨骼，排出多余体热。此时，它也能把双臂当机关枪，朝敌人接连发射飞弹针和岩石爆击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can retract its claws into its exoskeletal shell, allowing it to vent excess body heat. While in this state, it can use these arms like a machine gun, pelting foes with Pin Missile and Rock Blast.

entry: POKENAME力气巨大，连整架战斗机都能相当轻松地举起。它会用巨角刺破蜂巢，让蜂蜜与花蜜流下来享用。
author: soup1900
source: Due to their immense strength, POKENAME could lift an entire fighter plane with relative ease. It uses its gigantic horn to pierce beehives, letting the honey and nectar drip out for it to eat.

entry: POKENAME的角和钳爪能轻松撕下树皮，获取里面的树液。它贪吃又好胜，常能看到几只为了同一处树液争斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's horn and claws make it easy for it to tear off tree bark in order to get the sap underneath. It is quite greedy and competitive, so one often sees several POKENAME fighting over a single sappy spot.

entry: 除非饿极了，它只肯吃蜂蜜。进食时若被打扰，就会彻底发狂，连暴走的圈圈熊与它相比都显得温和。
author: bobosmith01
source: It will only eat honey unless it is completely starved. If interrupted while eating, it will throw itself into a complete frenzy that would make even a rampaging Ursaring feel mellow in comparison.

entry: 它在蜂蜜产量最多的暮春最为活跃，先尽情大吃一番，再专心抚育幼崽，之后才重新进入冬眠。
author: bobosmith01
source: It becomes most active late in the spring, when the most honey is produced. After it finishes gorging itself on whatever it can eat, it will focus on raising its young before going back into hibernation.

entry: POKENAME会寻找琥珀，熔化这种树液化石，吃下产生的副产物。无法消化的宝石部分会融入外壳。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME seek out amber, melting the fossilized tree sap down and feeding on the byproducts produced. The portions of the gems that they cannot digest are integrated into their shells.

entry: POKENAME柔软的绒羽不只保暖，还会分泌油脂，让主要食物树液不至于黏在身上。
author: honestly_vitali
source: The soft, downy feathers of POKENAME don't just provide warmth. They also produce an oil that prevents tree sap, POKENAME's main food source, from sticking to it.

entry: POKENAME不停训练，将体能推向极限。厚实甲壳能强力抵御重击。野外的个体会聚在一起混战，决出最强的一只。
author: bluenido.
source: POKENAME train constantly, pushing themselves to their physical limits. Their thick carapace provides formidable defense against heavy blows. Groups gather in the wild to brawl and establish the strongest individual.

entry: 它会先喷毒让对手晕眩，再用尾巴缠住，力道足以绞碎岩石。紧缠钩爪能增强抓握力，连石头里的水也能挤出来。
author: quackquackattack
source: It spits out venom to daze its opponents before it wraps its tail around opponents with enough force to break rocks. A Grip Claw enhances its grip strength to squeeze water from rocks.

entry: POKENAME战斗中一边滚动一边用角猛撞地面，能把自己弹上最远60英尺的高空，再以角朝下落地，刺中目标。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slams its horn into the ground while rolling during combat, launching itself up to sixty feet skyward. It then drops down horn-first to strike its target.

entry: POKENAME会在作为家园的森林里巡行，冲向一切挡路的对象。它的尖叫声十分刺耳，听见就会头痛。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME prowl the forests they call home, charging towards any that cross their paths. POKENAME possess a shrill scream that induces headaches in those who hear it.

entry: POKENAME常互相争斗至筋疲力尽，借此锻炼角的坚韧程度。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME can often be seen fighting one another to exhaustion in order to increase the durability of their horns.

entry: 如果张开颈部皮褶还吓不退敌人，POKENAME就会发出嗡鸣般的嘶声警告。若对方仍不理会，它便用强壮的毒角将敌人掀飞。
author: chibitales
source: If flaring POKENAME's hood does not intimidate foes, it lets out a buzzing hiss as a warning. If not heeded, it moves to fling the enemy with its strong, venomous horn.

entry: POKENAME会用强壮的角破开页岩，吞食碎片获取养分。它会与其他吃岩石的宝可梦争夺最富饶的矿藏。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its powerful horn to break apart shale and consumes the fragments for nourishment. It competes with other rock-eating Pokémon for the richest mineral deposits.

entry: 野生宝可梦进化成POKENAME后，会放弃过去用一次角突刺穿敌人、或凭钳握碾压的战法，转而练习二连击、种子机关枪等招式。
author: bobosmith01
source: When a wild Pokémon evolves into POKENAME, it ditches its old strategy of tearing through enemies in a single horned thrust or crushing grip, and instead begins to practice using moves such as Double Hit and Bullet Seed.

entry: POKENAME在森林里成大群生活，常跟着圈圈熊寻找蜂蜜。人们认为，融合略微增强了它们的力量和精度，让最强的攻击能完美同步。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME live in large colonies in forests, often following Ursaring in search of honey. It is believed that fusion has amplified POKENAME's strength and precision marginally, allowing them to perfectly sync their strongest attacks.

entry: POKENAME会掏空各种材料，用来盛装树液，收进育儿袋随身携带。虽然主要留着自己享用，但只要开口讨，它几乎总愿意分享。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hollows out materials to collect sap it can carry around in its pouch. Though the sap is primarily for its own indulgence, POKENAME will almost always be willing to share if asked.

entry: POKENAME额头的角像避雷针，能在猛烈风暴中吸收能量。它会凶狠地攻击提斧头经过森林的人，误以为对方要威胁自己筑巢的树。
author: fiordaliso
source: The horn on POKENAME's forehead functions as a lightning rod, absorbing energy during violent storms. It fiercely attacks anyone carrying an axe through its forest, mistaking them for a threat to the tree where it nests.

entry: 只有吃得饱饱的POKENAME，身上缠绕的金藤才会隐约带着蜜味。想来啃甜藤的害虫，都得先过它强壮身体这一关。
author: bobosmith01
source: The golden vines laced around its body taste vaguely of honey, but only when POKENAME is well-fed. It uses its powerful body to defend itself against pests wanting to nibble on its sweet vines.

entry: POKENAME虽然有翅膀，主要却用来吸引配偶。身体太重，根本飞不离地面。
author: dodoowner_
source: Although POKENAME have wings, they mostly use them to attract mates. They are too heavy to get off the ground.

entry: POKENAME会浮到松树中段，钻入树干，直到树液流出。它贪婪地吸食，等树液不再流，就转向另一棵树。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME levitates to the center of pine trees and digs into the trunk until sap begins to leak. It hungrily devours the sap until the flow stops, then moves on to another tree.

entry: POKENAME先用强力角击撞飞敌人，再接连发射能量球。咄咄逼人的战法让人难以靠近。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME knocks enemies away with a powerful horn strike before firing a flurry of Energy Balls. Its aggressive tactics make it difficult to approach.

entry: POKENAME平时是坚定又聪明的守护者，保护森林里的小型宝可梦。但偶尔也会因渴求甜美多汁的树液而发狂，将附近树木撕碎、连根拔起，只为解馋。
author: sk372
source: Normally, POKENAME acts as a stalwart, intelligent guardian of small forest Pokémon. However, it occasionally goes wild with a craving for sweet succulent sap, and will tear apart and uproot any tree near it to get its fix.

entry: POKENAME会用钳爪攀住树木，再用角撕开树皮，吸食下面的树液。它能拍动背部甲壳，震落背刺，射向进食时可能来袭的对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its claws to sling onto trees while tearing bark off with its horn to get to the sap beneath. It can flap the back part of its carapace to dislodge the spines on its back to fire at those who might attack it while it eats.

entry: POKENAME旋转的舞姿既赏心悦目，也很适合战斗。每条手臂上各有两根角状附肢，让它能轻盈跃起、回旋，优雅又轻松地击倒对手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's twirling dance is as lovely to watch as it is effective in battle. With two horn-like appendages on each arm, it can leap and whirl around to take out opponents with grace and ease.

entry: POKENAME披着甲壳质装甲，奋力保护训练家。它精通各种擒抱和投掷，能掀倒敌人，制服所有威胁，确保训练家安全。
author: quackquackattack
source: Armored with chitinous plates, POKENAME fiercely defend their Trainer. They have mastered the art of flipping foes with various grapples and throws to ensure any threats are subdued and that their Trainer remains safe.

entry: POKENAME英勇无畏，总会一头冲入战斗，刀刃还没碰到对手，角就已经撞了上去。力气极大，体重超过自身10倍的敌人也能轻松举起。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are gallant creatures that charge headfirst into combat, slamming their horn into their opponents before their blades even make contact. Their sheer strength allows them to lift opponents more than ten times their body weight with ease.

entry: POKENAME会先用角剥下外层树皮，再背对着贴在树上。过一阵子，它便浮空离开，而树液已被吸得一干二净。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its horn to tear outer layers of bark from trees, before sticking itself backwards onto the tree. Some time later it floats off, with all the tree's sap being completely drained from it.

entry: 它会轻轻剥开树皮，啃咬木头，寻找树液吸食。平时不爱动武，角通常只用来拨开或掀走烦人的对象。
author: sk372
source: It lightly peels away bark from trees to gnaw on the wood and seek out sap to suck. Normally nonviolent, its horn is typically only used to swat or fling nuisances away.

entry: 它的外骨骼颜色取决于这一周吃过的树液。举东西前，它会用强壮的前肢固定身体，再借大角发力，因此能抬起自身重量3倍的物体。
author: infinex21
source: The hue of its exoskeleton changes depending on the tree sap it has consumed throughout the week. It secures itself with its strong forelimbs before lifting anything with its impressive horn; it can lift three times its own body weight as a result.

entry: POKENAME会用幽灵般的身体直接钻进树木，不必剥开外层树皮，就能吸取里面的树液。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its ghostly body to dive right into trees. It does this to get to the sap within without needing to peel away the outer layers or bark.

entry: POKENAME会像挥链枷一样甩动第二张嘴，砸开树干，急切地喝下流出的树液。捕食者靠得太近时，这副颚就会以足以碾碎对方的力道合拢。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swings its second mouth like a flail to break apart tree trunks, then eagerly drinks the sap that flows out. If a predator gets too close, the jaws snap shut with crushing force.

entry: 它的角极强，曾掀翻过护城龙，不过也得使出全力。它常像独角犀牛一样盲目往前冲，用角抛开挡路的障碍，直到最终撞上什么才停下。
author: infinex21
source: Its horn is so strong that it has been capable of tipping over Bastiodon, albeit by fully exerting itself. It has a tendency to blindly charge forward like a Ryhorn, using its horn to toss obstacles out of its way until it inevitably crashes.

entry: POKENAME力气大得能用角把自卸卡车抛到空中。尾尖也能用力夹合，劈开较小的岩块。许多采石场会请它负责重体力工作。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are strong enough to toss a dump truck in the air with their horns. The tips of their tails are able to pinch together with enough force to split apart small boulders. Many quarries utilize these Pokémon for heavy-duty work.

entry: POKENAME只要有足够的距离助跑，强壮的角就能刺穿坚实岩石。它会用头角挑起又大又硬的水果，压向背上的角，将其剖开。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's horns are strong enough to pierce solid rock so long as it has a decent running start. It scoops up large, tough fruits with the horn on its head and then presses them against its back's horn to split them open.

entry: POKENAME爱吃蜂蜜、树果和树液，却通常懒得亲自获取。它会抓住路过的小型宝可梦，扔向最近的树，威胁对方不带回好吃的，就还要挨打。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME adores honey, berries and sap from trees, but is usually too lazy to get it itself. It grabs smaller Pokémon that pass by and throws them at the nearest tree, threatening further violence if they don't bring it back something tasty.

entry: POKENAME能提前察觉飓风，却会因此惊慌，用角猛撞附近物体。这会赶走其他对象，无意间救了它们。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME senses hurricanes before they strike and panics, slamming its horn into nearby objects. This act drives others away, unintentionally saving them.

entry: POKENAME会用强劲的尖足打击敌人，也用来刺穿树木，吸食树液。后腿能把它弹到比翅膀所能飞及之处更高的地方。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their powerful, pointed feet to strike at foes and to puncture trees so they may drink of their sap. Their hind legs can launch them further off the ground than their wings can carry them.

entry: POKENAME的背又宽又平，成了绝佳擂台。常在那里开打的，便是怒气冲冲的赫拉克罗斯与凯罗斯。
author: incognito1234
source: Possessing a large, flat back, POKENAME have become perfect places for fights. Usually, this is between angry Heracross and Pinsir.

entry: 成群的POKENAME越来越受房屋模型爱好者欢迎。每只壳上都建着不同的小屋，随着群体移动，村庄不断变换，让模型爱好者欣赏不尽。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME herds have risen to popularity amongst the model house community. Each POKENAME has a different house constructed upon its shell, and the movement of the herd creates an ever-changing village for the model enthusiasts to enjoy.

entry: POKENAME的大角很适合撕树皮，但主要还是用来对付同类。为了食物、领地和配偶争斗时，它们既会撞头，也会用角交锋。
author: sk372
source: Its large horn is good for tearing bark off of trees, but is predominantly used against rival POKENAME. They butt heads and horns equally in disputes over food, territory and mates.

entry: POKENAME用巨力放倒树木，吸取甘甜的树液。若进食时被打扰，它也会退而求其次，吸走来袭者的生命力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME fells trees with tremendous force to absorb their sweet sap. It will settle for an attacker's life force if disturbed while eating.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀振动极快，能产生锐利的声波，轻易切开空气。
author: camtft
source: The wings of POKENAME vibrate so quickly that they generate sharp soundwaves that slice through the air with ease.

entry: POKENAME出手精准有力，以敢于对抗更大的敌人而闻名。只要看见机会，哪怕对手占着优势，它也会反击。
author: korro0490
source: With its precise and powerful strikes, POKENAME is known to face opponents bigger than itself. When it sees an opportunity, POKENAME will counterattack even if the opponent has the advantage.

entry: 它快速振翅时，会迅速积聚强烈静电。透视般的视力能让它轻松找到新鲜树液，再用角刺穿树干，也用角掀走障碍。
author: infinex21
source: By rapidly fluttering its wings, it quickly accumulates a strong static charge. It possesses a form of x-ray vision, which allows it to easily find fresh tree sap. It uses its horn to puncture trees for their sap and to toss away obstacles.

entry: POKENAME喜欢举起巨石，抛过山岭，测试自己的力量。为了最喜欢的蜂蜜，它会推倒树木。据说铠甲比钢铁更坚韧，而角能连根拔起一片树林。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME enjoy testing their strength by lifting boulders and hurling them across mountain ranges. They topple trees in search of their favorite food: Honey. POKENAME's armor is said to be tougher than steel, while its horns can uproot a grove.

entry: 它们的大角在进化中逐渐变成暴飞龙头部的形状，用来威吓其他对象。粗壮而肌肉发达的尾巴，也能挥出破坏力惊人的重击。
author: infinex21
source: Their large horns took the shape of a Salamence head during the course of their evolution so as to intimidate others. They swing their bulky and muscular tails to deliver devastating blows.

entry: POKENAME会用角剥下树皮，将树液抹在丝带上，再去分给其他饥饿的昆虫。丝带天然的分泌物似乎能让树液更美味，更吸引小虫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its horn to peel bark from trees so it can smear the sap onto its ribbons. It then goes off to share the sap with other hungry insects. The ribbons' natural secretions seem to make the sap more flavorful and appealing to the bugs.

entry: POKENAME住在巨大的红杉树干里，静静等候暴雨。雨后，它们会离开家，滚出巨大的泥球，再把每一个都塑成自己的模样。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME live inside the trunks of giant sequoia trees, quietly waiting for rainstorms. After rainfall, they leave their homes and begin rolling up massive balls of mud, sculpting each ball to look like themselves.

entry: POKENAME会用分成两侧的角把敌人挑起，再从头部中央的红色发射器喷出能量，将对方轰飞。
author: imaginita
source: With its two-sided horn, POKENAME lifts its foes aloft and then sends them flying with a blast of energy from the red emitter at the center of its head.

entry: POKENAME有森林英雄之称，会灵巧地在树间跳跃，巡视有无危险。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are known as heroes of the forest. They nimbly leap from tree to tree scouting for danger.

entry: POKENAME会挺角跃入战斗，准备决斗。它灵巧地低身闪避，角如刀剑般挥斩，并谨慎调整全身姿势，平衡角的重量，轻松保持战斗的节奏。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME spring into battle with their horns prepared for a duel. They duck and dodge nimbly, horns slashing like swords. They carefully move their entire bodies to balance the weight of their horns, keeping the momentum of battle effortlessly.

entry: POKENAME不爱久战，更愿意用角抛飞敌人后逃走。它平时独居，满月时却会聚在一起，在月光下徘徊。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a disinclination for prolonged combat, preferring to toss an opponent with its horn and then flee. Usually solitary creatures, during the full moon groups will gather together and mill beneath the moonlight.

entry: POKENAME会先用粗丝网捉住猎物，再用角攻击。它在树间迅速穿行，留下带电的蛛丝，阻挡入侵者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME captures prey with thick strands of webbing before striking with its horn. It moves swiftly through trees, leaving electrified silk behind to ward off intruders.

entry: POKENAME用引以为傲的角，掀翻披着重甲的宝可梦，再以强颚咬破柔软的腹部。
author: gentlesage
source: POKENAME uses its prized horn to flip over heavily-armored Pokémon. It then uses its powerful jaws to break though the softer underbelly.

entry: 饲养者喜欢在冬季节日里装饰POKENAME。它自己也乐于被打扮，为亲友提供节日灯光。信使鸟似乎也会被装饰好的它吸引。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME owners like to decorate it for the winter holidays. POKENAME itself delights in being dressed up and providing festive lighting for friends and family. Delibird also seem drawn to decorated POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME能把额头的角加热得通红，赶走前来挑衅的宝可梦。它在捕虫大赛中十分抢手，因为总能拿到很高的分数。
author: fiordaliso
source: It can heat the horn on its forehead until it glows red-hot to drive away Pokémon that try to pick a fight with it. POKENAME is extremely sought after in Bug Catcher contests, as it consistently earns a high number of points.

entry: POKENAME喜欢长时间静伏不动。毫无戒心的猎物一靠近，它便弹出角状的肢体。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME prefers to lie dormant for long periods of time. When unsuspecting prey approaches, it shoots out its horn-like appendage.

entry: POKENAME饿了会先选一棵树，在周围撒下易燃鳞粉，开始吸食树液后再点燃。火焰能挡住入侵者，免得进食时被打扰。
author: sk372
source: When hungry, POKENAME scatters flammable scales around the tree it chooses. It ignites these scales once it starts feeding, so that the fire will keep intruders from bothering it as it sucks sap from the trees.

entry: 野生POKENAME天生失明，会把角当作探测棒，在周围辨路。哪怕角只受一点伤，它也会彻底失去方向感，直到完全痊愈。
author: .izik
source: A wild POKENAME is naturally blind, so it uses its horn as a dowsing rod to navigate its surroundings. If its horn is even slightly damaged, it loses all sense of direction until it fully heals.

entry: POKENAME的两颗头会合力破树吸取树液，连对战时也配合默契，但除此之外却常互相争吵、攻击。它的颈部肌肉格外强壮，甚至能飞过短短一段路。
author: bobosmith01
source: While they break through trees to get sap together and even fight in Pokémon battles in sync, the two heads of POKENAME argue and lash out at one another otherwise. POKENAME has particularly powerful neck muscles and can even fly small distances.

entry: POKENAME会三五成群，聚在最高树木隐蔽的树冠间，吸食甜树液。只要有一只用敏感触角察觉危险，就会以精神力量通知全群散开。
author: anonymous_moose
source: Small herds of POKENAME gather around the secluded canopies of the tallest trees, feeding on the sweet sap. If any member of the herd detects danger with its sensitive antennae, it psychically notifies the herd to scatter.

entry: POKENAME深色毛皮下藏着一对翅膀，能助它优雅跳跃。高雅的仪态很受宝可梦华丽大赛选手青睐，而控火本领和坚不可摧的角，也让它在战斗中强大而灵活。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME conceals a set of wings in its dark pelt, allowing it to launch graceful jumps. Its refined bearing makes it coveted for Pokémon Contests, yet its flame-handling skills and unyielding horn also grant it strength and versatility in battle.

entry: POKENAME会用角从枫树侧面钻入，藏着吸食树液。被打扰时，它会钻得更深，躲开对方的探查。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows into the sides of maple trees using its horn, remaining hidden while it drinks the sap. If disturbed, it tunnels deeper into the bark to escape detection.

entry: POKENAME会用翅膀保持平衡，施展杂技般的武术。踢击精准有力，能踢碎大理石板。
author: .izik
source: Using its wings for balance, POKENAME performs acrobatic martial arts techniques. Its kicks are so precise and powerful they can shatter marble slabs.

entry: POKENAME会为树上最好的位置相互争斗。它们行动缓慢，一场架可能要打上好几周。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME fight each other for the best spots in trees. Their slow nature means that fights may take weeks to complete.

entry: POKENAME静止太久，积累的压力就会让大角变红。为了补充庞大的能量消耗，它会吃下大量蜂蜜和熟水果。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME stays still for too long, the stress that builds up turns its large horn red. To fuel its massive energy expenditure, it feeds on generous amounts of honey and ripe fruit.

entry: 野生POKENAME很少见，只生活在红树林水下纠缠的根系里。它完全独居，会与其他水生宝可梦争夺领地。
author: mochauspocus
source: A wild POKENAME is a rare sight to see, living only in the tangled underwater roots of mangroves. POKENAME are completely solitary and will fight other aquatic Pokémon for territory.

entry: POKENAME受到威胁时，覆盖全身的极硬外壳会烧得通红。它会用红角在树上刻痕，标记领地。
author: fiordaliso
source: The extremely hard shell covering its body can become red-hot if POKENAME feels threatened. It carves marks into trees with its red horn to mark its territory.

entry: 春天，POKENAME会成大群聚集，比谁能把对手抛得最远。不过个头小，其实都扔不了多远。
author: elite01.
source: POKENAME will gather in large groups in the spring. They will compete to see who can throw their opponent the farthest. They can't throw very far due to their small size.

entry: POKENAME借包裹身体的液体，吸收找到的蜂蜜充饥。吃得太多，身体也会鼓胀起来。
author: incognito1234
source: Using the liquid surrounding its body, POKENAME absorbs any honey it finds as food. This can cause it to swell when it obtains too much.

entry: POKENAME轻松地浮行于树木之间，用角破开树皮，吸食里面的树液。一路走来，身后尽是被剥去树皮的树干。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats effortlessly between trees, cracking bark with its horn. It feeds on the sap within, leaving trails of stripped trunks behind.

entry: POKENAME以某些仙人掌为食，它们产出的乳白色甜汁令它难以抗拒。尾巴上角状的突起是武器，用来抵御其他沙漠宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME feeds on certain species of cactus that produce a sweet, milky sap it finds irresistible. The horn-shaped protrusion on its tail is used as a weapon to fend off other desert Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME找到大量蜂蜜，就紧紧附在上面，用满身尖刺驱赶天敌。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME locates large honey sources and then sticks to them, warding off predators with its many spikes.

entry: POKENAME一旦把牙咬进树里，没吃饱绝不松口。若不强行拉开，它可能吸尽整棵树的养分，只留下一副枯萎的躯壳。
author: sk372
source: Once it sinks its fangs into a tree, it refuses to let go until it's had its fill. If POKENAME is not forcibly removed, it may drain a tree completely of its nutrients and leave it a wilting husk.

entry: POKENAME的水晶眼睛与阿罗拉地区的Z纯晶材质相近，能随意增强自己和同伴的虫属性攻击。它的角力道极大，破开基岩就像击碎玻璃一样。
author: deadshields
source: Its crystal eyes are made of a similar material to the Alola Region's Z-Crystals, allowing POKENAME to enhance the strength of its own Bug-Type attacks and those of its allies at will. Its horn is strong enough to break through bedrock like glass.

entry: 颈旁的众多钳爪能让它附在树上，更方便吃树皮中的甜汁。它生性好奇，似乎不知道自己的体形和气势可能会吓坏小生物。
author: sk372
source: The many claws near its neck let it attach to trees to better eat the sweet sap from their bark. It is a curious sort, and seems unaware of its size and stature potentially being frightful to smaller creatures.

entry: POKENAME会用角撕开树皮，吸食下面的树液。树一旦不再流汁，它就会大发脾气，想用双颚把树撕碎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its horn to tear bark off of trees to get to the sap underneath. Once the tree no longer provides its sap, POKENAME throws a tantrum and tries to tear the tree apart with its jaws.

entry: POKENAME只有一根角，全靠它阻吓捕食者。它常做被飞行属性宝可梦吃掉的噩梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a singular horn that they rely on to deter predators. Their dreams are often filled with nightmares of getting eaten by Flying-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME会跳舞来集中精神，更好地运用精神力量。它用念力把其他生物从树上撬开，独自剥开树皮，享用下面的甜树液。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME dances to better focus and utilize its psychic powers. Using telekinesis, it pries other creatures off of trees so it alone can peel off the tree's bark and get to the sweet sap beneath.

entry: POKENAME十分顽皮，爱用角戳人，随后迅速消失无踪。
author: incognito1234
source: A mischievous creature, POKENAME like to poke humans with its horn before quickly disappearing.

entry: POKENAME会从角尖分泌酸液，在树上钻洞，吸食里面的树液。身体散发淡淡甜香，能吸引其他虫属性宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME secretes acid from the tip of its horn to bore holes into trees, allowing it to drink the sap inside. Its body emits a faint, sweet scent that attracts other Bug-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME很固执，常试图举起比自身重好几倍的东西，结果往往失败。
author: incognito1234
source: A very stubborn Pokémon, POKENAME is usually seen trying to lift objects many times its own weight, oftentimes failing.

entry: POKENAME能从尾巴产出浓稠、带泥土气息的蜂蜜。这种蜂蜜是许多地区深受欢迎的珍馐。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME has the ability to produce a thick, earthy honey from its tail. This honey is a popular delicacy in many regions.

entry: POKENAME常帮助伐木公司，用大角搬运粗大的树干。大风暴过后，也能见到它努力清理残骸。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has been seen frequently aiding logging companies, using its large horn to help carry large tree trunks. After large storms, POKENAME can be seen trying to clear away debris.

entry: 它们会寻找其他虫属性宝可梦避开的苦植物汁液，在肚子里与沙粒混合，制成十分适合做牙膏基料的物质。
author: vic1312
source: They seek out the bitter sap from plants that are avoided by other bug-type Pokémon. They combine this sap in their gut with a sandy grit, creating a substance that makes a great base for toothpaste.

entry: POKENAME会挖开部分洞壁，传播孢子，培育蘑菇，供同巢的其他成员食用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs out sections of cave walls to spread its spores and cultivate mushrooms. These serve as sustenance for other members of its nest.

entry: POKENAME会低吼、吠叫，警告其他对象不要靠近洞穴。若警告被无视，它便会挺着岩石般坚硬的角冲锋。不过用它极爱的蜂蜜，很容易就能引它出来。
author: fiordaliso
source: It growls and barks to warn others not to come too close to its den, but if its warnings are ignored it charges with its rock-hard horn. POKENAME can be easily lured out with honey, which it is extremely fond of.

entry: POKENAME会从附近的松树收集树液，带回庞大的蘑菇群落。背上的真菌吸取丰富养分，长得更加茁壮庞大。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects sap from nearby pine trees and carries it back to its massive mushroom colonies. The fungi on its back thrive on the rich nutrients, allowing them to grow even larger.

entry: POKENAME热爱战斗，只要觉得对方值得一战，哪怕实力不如，也会一头冲上去。科学家曾观察到它们自行举办临时比武，却没发现胜者能得到什么奖品。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME love to battle, jumping headfirst against anyone they deem worthy even when outmatched. Scientists have observed POKENAME holding makeshift tournaments between one another, but there are no records of awards for winning these fights.

entry: POKENAME对比自己弱的宝可梦不感兴趣，常摩擦翅膀，发出鳞片碰撞般的铿锵声，吓走小型宝可梦。野外也曾见它袭击椰蛋树，啃食叶片。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME has no interest in Pokémon weaker than itself; it usually scares away smaller Pokémon by rubbing its wings together, which sounds like clanging scales. POKENAME are known to attack Exeggutor in the wild, chewing on their leaves.

entry: POKENAME会把角抵在地上，感受附近活动引起的震动。察觉危险就会毫不犹豫地逃跑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rests its horn on the ground to sense vibrations of nearby movement. If it detects danger, it flees without hesitation.

entry: 它崇拜赫拉克罗斯和强大的斗士。即使笨拙地模仿它们的招式，凭着扬起的毒粉，攻击仍然有效。
author: pokepower
source: It idolizes Heracross and great fighters. Even its clumsy imitations of their moves are effective, thanks to the toxic powder it kicks up.

entry: POKENAME会寻找致命的树液，涂在手里剑上。若藏身时被发现，它就会愤怒地冲向对手。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME searches for deadly tree saps to coat its shurikens with. When a POKENAME is found while hiding, it charges at the opponents with rage.

entry: 喝下足够的桦树汁后，POKENAME的躯干会发出强光，随着呼吸一明一暗。
author: .izik
source: After consuming enough birch sap, POKENAME emits a bright light from its torso. The glow pulses in time with its breathing.

entry: POKENAME会被路灯下的树木吸引，吸食灯光照亮的树液。若进食时被打扰，它便喷出一阵麻痹粉还击。
author: .izik
source: Drawn to trees under streetlamps, POKENAME feeds on their illuminated sap. If disturbed while eating, it retaliates with a burst of Stun Spore.

entry: POKENAME刚吃下成熟树果，尾焰就会更加明亮。它不断用角撞击古老的橡树树干，测试角的强度。
author: fiordaliso
source: Immediately after eating a ripe berry, the flame on its tail glows more brightly. POKENAME constantly tests the strength of its horn by slamming it against the trunks of ancient oak trees.

entry: POKENAME强壮的角连最坚韧的树根也能撕开，成群出没时可能危及森林。不过，它通常会小心避免连根拔树，因为很喜欢树栖宝可梦产出的甜甜蜜。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's powerful horn can rip right through even the toughest of tree roots, making groups of them a danger in forested areas. However, POKENAME is usually careful to not uproot trees, as they love the Honey that tree-dwelling Pokémon can produce.

entry: POKENAME会互相撞头，表示亲近。水下没有甜美蜂蜜，因此它改以拾食残羹为生，安静地吃着被丢弃猎物的肥美残肉。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME headbutt one another as a sign of affection. As sweet honey is not found underwater, POKENAME instead acts as a scavenger and peacefully dines on the fatty remains of discarded prey.

entry: 它会用角撞树，挖开、撬入树干，吸食里面的甜汁。树液的滋味能缓解用角过度引起的头痛。
author: sk372
source: It bashes its horn against trees to dig and pry its way within to get to the sweet sap within. The taste of the sap helps soothe the pain of the headache it gets from using its horn.

entry: POKENAME面上不露情绪，常被误认为冷酷。其实它会无私地用角凿树，放出甜树液，再叫同伴来享用。它从不喝自己凿开的树里的汁液，这是同类间荣耀的象征。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's lack of visual emotion is often mistaken for callousness. But it selflessly uses its horn to gouge trees, releasing sweet sap, then calls its packmates to feast. It never drinks sap from a tree it tapped, a mark of honour among its kind.

entry: POKENAME会用长角掀翻对手来战斗。不过耐力差，拖成持久战就很难获胜。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME fights its opponents by flipping them over with its long horn. It has a difficult time winning drawn-out, protracted fights because of its low stamina.

entry: POKENAME战斗时很少用角，因为用四条强壮手臂抓起敌人、抛出去要轻松得多。角主要用来在树上钻洞，训练后喝些甜树液补充体力。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME rarely uses its horn in combat, as it is far easier for it to pick up and throw its enemies using four powerful arms. It mainly uses the horn to punch holes in trees, drinking the sweet sap to refuel after workouts.

entry: 它缩进壳里时，角会从前方伸出。小触须能感知附近是否有捕食者，必要时也能用角击地，借力弹离危险。
author: sk372
source: When tucked into its shell, the horn sticks out from the front. Small feelers let it sense if predators are near, and it can strike the ground with its horn to propel itself away from danger if needed.

entry: POKENAME的嘴会滴出带甜香的酸液，引诱猎物。对方一靠近，它便挺角冲锋，给予猛烈一击。
author: .izik
source: A sweet-smelling acid drips from POKENAME's mouth to lure in prey. Once close, it charges with its horn to deliver a brutal strike.

entry: POKENAME的肌肉过于致密，硬得像石头，翅膀已经无法发挥作用。不过它能转动身体，把角当铲子，快速挖掘。
author: cwynwyn
source: POKENAME's wings no longer function as its muscles are too dense and stony. it can dig quickly by spinning and using its horn as a shovel.

entry: POKENAME住在地下深处，只有寻找蜂蜜时才挖出洞穴。战斗时，它会先全力滚撞目标，再试图将对方掀翻。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME live deep underground, only digging out from their burrows in search of honey. They battle by rolling into their target at full force before attempting to flip them over.

entry: POKENAME出生的第一年很弱，会把时间花在锻炼双腿和角上。它会用火焰让自己显得比实际更吓人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are rather weak for the first year they are born and spend their time strengthening their legs and their horns. They use their flames to make themselves look more intimidating than they really are.

entry: 野生POKENAME奔跑时，会用强壮的角将巨石和一些宝可梦抛开。它还会用前爪挖开树干，引出里面的树液，舔来享用。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME use their strong horns to throw boulders and some Pokémon out of their way as they run. They use their foreclaws to dig into trees to draw forth the sap within and lap it up.

entry: POKENAME在河里高速游泳时，会用额头的角移开挡路巨石。它习惯在藏身处尽量囤积水果，等熟透再吃。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses the horn on its forehead to move large boulders that block its path as it swims at high speed in rivers. It has a habit of stockpiling as much fruit as possible in its hiding place and then eating it once it is ripe.

entry: POKENAME会把随身的大葱与其他香草一起当作诱饵，设伏等待爱吃叶子的昆虫。等对方靠近，它就从上方用角袭击，将其击倒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the leek it carries in combination with other flavorful grasses as a lure. It sets a trap for leaf-loving insects and waits until they get close, then attacks from above with its horn to knock them out.

entry: 较大的头擅长发现适合进食的地方，也能察觉附近的捕食者；较小的头则负责用强壮的角自卫。
author: sk372
source: The larger head is adept at sensing opportune places to feed as well as nearby predators, while the smaller head takes care of defending itself with its mighty horn.

entry: POKENAME常见于寒冷的北极水域，会用角撞碎挡路浮冰。运气好时，还能看见它晒太阳，炫耀大角来吸引配偶。
author: universal9449
source: POKENAME are often found in the cold arctic waters, where they use their horns to smash through ice chunks that may be blocking their path. If you're lucky, you can catch them basking in the sun, trying to attract partners by showing off their horns.

entry: 它在海底疾行，很少露出水面。没人知道壳里究竟藏着什么。
author: krune
source: It scurries along the bottom of the sea, rarely seen above water. Nobody knows what is inside its shell.

entry: POKENAME用触角感知水流，辨认环境与其他宝可梦。看触角的大小，还能判断POKENAME的年龄与性别。
author: krune
source: POKENAME use their antennae to feel the current in the water, in order to discern their surroundings and sense other Pokémon. The size of the antennae determine the age and gender of a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME能发出多种类似笑声的叫声。头部带角的甲片，形状与大小各不相同。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME have a variety of vocalizations they can make that sound like laughter. The horned plating on its head comes in different shapes and sizes.

entry: POKENAME会藏在阴影里，让巨角化为灵质，穿过敌人的实体护甲，直接打击灵魂。它以目标突如其来的恐惧为食，只留下刺骨寒意和久久不散的古怪嗡鸣。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME hides inside shadows, turning its massive horn ectoplasmic to bypass a foe's physical armor and strike their spirit directly. It feeds on the sudden fear of its targets, leaving behind a cold chill and a strange, lingering buzzing sound.

entry: 角的形状让POKENAME挖土不如大岩蛇快，却凭攻击范围和力道为战斗带来优势。正面对上它，敌人轻易就会被掀飞！
author: bobosmith01
source: Due to the shape of its horn, POKENAME cannot tunnel through earth as fast as Onix. However, the horn does give it an edge in battle, due to its reach and power. Foes are flicked away effortlessly if they face POKENAME!

entry: POKENAME背上几乎总附着头骨，尤其偏爱大型捕食性宝可梦的头骨。无法用锋利如刀的钳爪攻击时，它就会通过头骨的嘴射出高压水流。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are very rarely found without a skull attached to their back, favoring skulls of larger predatory Pokémon. When unable to strike with their razor-sharp claws, they fire a pressurized stream of water through the skull's mouth.

entry: POKENAME有许多带钩小爪，爬树攀岩都很轻松。它会伺机偷蛋吃，尤其喜欢鸟类宝可梦的蛋。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have many small, hooked claws that make it easy for them to climb trees or scale rocks. They wait for opportunities to steal eggs to eat, favoring the eggs of bird POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME会用亲手雕制的武器震慑狃拉部落，将它们统合到自己麾下，通常是为了约束它们过分鬼祟狡诈的行径。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the weapons it carves to establish dominance over Sneasel tribes. It unites them under its banner, typically to reign in their more sneaky and devious mannerisms.

entry: 进化前，POKENAME会收集羽毛，塞进自己的茧里。虽然一动不动，里面的宝可梦仍然聪明又狡猾。
author: t3isukone
source: Before evolving, a POKENAME will collect feathers that it can tuck into its cocoon. While unmoving, the Pokémon within is still intelligent and cunning.

entry: 野生POKENAME会先使出烟幕，再伏击猎物，因为它能轻易看穿烟雾。有些个体还会偷取其他海底宝可梦的宝藏和贵重物品。
author: bobosmith01
source: Wild POKENAME use Smokescreen before ambushing prey, as they can easily see through the smog. Some POKENAME have been known to steal the treasures and precious items of other undersea Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME爱吃树果，会从其他宝可梦那里偷来充饥。幸好它走到哪里都留下闪亮粉尘，机灵的宝可梦能沿着痕迹追踪。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love the taste of berries and are known to steal them from other Pokémon to satisfy their hunger. Fortunately, they leave behind a sparkling dust wherever they go, creating a trail for astute Pokémon to follow.

entry: POKENAME借翅膀助推，速度比赛车更快，转向也十分灵活。通常成双出现，彼此轮流攻击，让敌人应接不暇。
author: ghostslythe
source: Using its wings for an extra boost, POKENAME moves faster than a race car and maneuvers sharply. Generally seen in pairs, each takes turns attacking while confounding their foes.

entry: POKENAME爱慕虚荣，十分在意外表，尤其精心照料用来威吓的羽毛。它会装伤，袭击停下来帮忙的对象，至少也要抢走财物，再逃进冰封的群山。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME vainly maintains its appearance, taking special care of its feathers, which are used for intimidation. It pretends to be injured, then attacks any who stop to help it, at least stealing their valuables before fleeing into frozen mountains.

entry: POKENAME是聪明而凶残的山地猎手。它大多静伏雪下，探查猎物弱点，等待最佳时机，再以接连的效果绝佳招式，压倒对方。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME are intelligent, brutal mountain predators. They remain mostly still under a blanket of snow, detecting their prey's weaknesses, waiting for the perfect moment to strike with multiple overwhelming super-effective moves.

entry: POKENAME的叶片散发舒缓的薄荷香，会借此分散对方注意，偷走零食。受到的关注不够时，它很容易嫉妒，因此不建议新手训练家饲养。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's leaf emits a soothing, minty aroma, which it uses as a distraction to steal snacks from the affected creature. It easily becomes jealous if not enough attention is paid to it, making this Pokémon not recommended to new Trainers.

entry: POKENAME勤于在树木和岩石上磨利爪子，成群在夜间狩猎，常为争夺猎物与其他夜行鸟类融合体打斗。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME diligently sharpens its talons against trees and rocks. Flocks hunt at night, often getting into fights with other nocturnal bird fusions over prey.

entry: POKENAME会用利爪爬上树皮，从上方扑向猎物。腹部伸出富有弹性的丝线，毒针一刺中目标，就立刻把自己拉回高处。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses its sharp claws to climb tree bark, then drops down on prey from above. It extends a string of stretchy silk from its abdomen, pulling it back upwards as soon as it has struck its target with its poisonous stinger.

entry: POKENAME夜间狩猎时，会在接近地面的树干之间拉起丝线，再爬上枝头等猎物绊到线。随后便从上方落下，用带毒的爪与角攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME hunts for prey at night by stretching silk strands between tree trunks close to the ground. It climbs up into the branches to wait for prey to trip over the thread, then drops down from above to attack with its venomous claws and horn.

entry: POKENAME会攀在北极崖壁上，倾听路过者的动静，伺机吸血。它天性多疑，一次只真正信任一个对象，哪怕受到一点背叛，也会失去信任。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME clings to arctic cliff faces, listening for passerby from whom it can drain blood. It has a suspicious disposition, only really trusting one other being at a time and losing faith in them at the slightest betrayal.

entry: POKENAME生活在较冷的水域，用附肢催眠般的光引诱生物靠近。对方一接近，它就用手中藏着的小爪割伤，注入冰冷而能使其无法动弹的毒素。
author: sk372
source: Inhabiting colder waters, POKENAME lures creatures closer with the hypnotic glow of its appendage. Once something draws near, it cuts them with tiny claws hidden in its hands that carry a chilling, immobilizing poison.

entry: POKENAME总在沮丧地哭，因为它想吃掉自己，却办不到。千万别把两只单独留在同一个房间，否则最后就只剩一只了。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME is constantly crying in frustration because it wants to eat itself, but can't. Never leave two POKENAME alone in a room together, or you'll end up with just one POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME会让有偷窃癖的人更加冲动，怂恿他们偷走一切看中的东西。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME spreads feelings of impulsiveness among kleptomaniacs, urging them to steal whatever they see fit.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛锋利得能切开大钢蛇坚韧的铠甲。锐利的视力让它在暴风雪中也能锁定猎物。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME's feathers are sharp enough to slice through Steelix' tough armor. Its keen eyesight allows it to home in on prey during snowstorms.

entry: POKENAME诡计多端，不停构思邪恶的计划。不过，它只用这些计划捕捉虫属性宝可梦，因此人类认为它无害而温顺。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME is a devious plotter who constantly invents evil plans. However, it only uses these plans to catch Bug-type Pokémon, so humans consider it harmless and docile.

entry: POKENAME会帮扒手偷窃毫无戒心的游客。它会划开提包，让里面的东西落地，再带着赃物逃走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME helps pickpockets steal from unsuspecting tourists. It slashes purses so the contents fall onto the ground before running off with the stolen goods.

entry: POKENAME敏捷又善于切割，四肢柔韧得令人惊讶。它喜欢用尾巴挂在树枝上，因此不少树枝突然折断，也被认为是它造成的。
author: th3randomguy
source: POKENAME are very agile and sharp-cutting creatures with shockingly bendable limbs. They have also been reported to be the reason many tree branches have suddenly snapped off, due to the fact that they like to use their tails to hang from them.

entry: POKENAME一次能下数百颗蛋，大多数很小，永远无法发育成宝可梦。父亲会吃掉这些蛋，吸收能量，并引发激素反应，逐渐变得更有父性。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME lay hundreds of eggs at a time. Most of them are tiny and will never develop into Pokémon. The fathers eat them, absorbing energy and triggering a hormonal response that makes them begin to change their behaviour to become more paternal.

entry: POKENAME一次能下数百颗蛋，大多数很小，永远无法发育成宝可梦。父亲会吃掉这些蛋，吸收能量，并引发激素反应，平静下来，变得更有父性。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME lay hundreds of eggs at a time. Most of them are tiny and will never develop into Pokémon. The fathers eat them, absorbing energy and triggering a hormonal response that calms them down and causes their behaviour to become more paternal.

entry: POKENAME会用全身细毛感知气流，预测附近飞行属性宝可梦的进食规律。趁夜潜入巢穴后，它就会戳破蛋壳，吸食营养丰富的内容物。
author: vic1312
source: By reading air currents using the fine fur that covers their bodies, POKENAME predict the feeding patterns of nearby Flying-type Pokémon. Sneaking into nests under cover of night, they will poke holes in eggs and slurp up the nutritious innards.

entry: POKENAME会用极锋利的门牙威胁比自己弱的宝可梦，抢走食物。它受不了阳光，白天便睡在树根下自己挖的洞里。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME steals food from Pokémon weaker than itself, threatening them with its extremely sharp incisors. During the day, it sleeps in the burrows it digs beneath tree roots, as it cannot stand sunlight.

entry: POKENAME会聚在面包店周围，希望离店的顾客分它们几口。因此，面包店都会立起告示，劝大家别喂野生宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME flock around bakeries in the hopes of getting a few pieces from customers that leave. In response, bakeries have a sign to discourage feeding wild Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME会在下雪的夜晚捕猎，借冰地和低能见度占据优势。不过它也很爱找虫巢，把冻住的蜂蜜当冰棒舔。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hunts its prey during snowy nights, using the icy terrain and low visibility to its advantage. However, it loves to go for insect hives, licking the frozen honey like a popsicle.

entry: 世界各地的公园都能见到POKENAME，它会吃野餐留下的食物。性情刻薄，谁想一起吃残羹，它就把谁吓跑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found at parks around the world where they eat leftovers from picnics. Their cynical nature causes them to scare away other Pokémon that try to eat the scraps alongside them.

entry: 树果埋在深雪下时，POKENAME的羽毛会剧烈颤动。它会用利爪不停挖掘，直到找到果子。
author: .izik
source: When berries are buried beneath deep snow, POKENAME's feather twitches wildly. It digs with sharp claws until it finds the fruit.

entry: POKENAME速度快得惊人，会先攻击猎物的腿，让对方无路可逃。小眼睛对光十分敏感，因此更喜欢夜间狩猎。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are surprisingly fast, going for their prey's legs first so they have no means of escape. They prefer to hunt at night as their tiny eyes are very sensitive to light.

entry: 传说POKENAME会开小飞机，偷走训练家的小饰品后迅速逃离。它爱亮晶晶的东西，总背着装满这些物件的袋子，方便炫耀收藏。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are rumored to aviate small planes to make quick getaways after stealing trinkets from Trainers. They enjoy shiny objects and carry a sack full of such items so they can show off their collection.

entry: POKENAME会寻找无人守护的宝可梦巢，偷走蛋，存进袋子般的尾巴。它也曾顺走毫无戒心的登山者的贵重物品。
author: kokoria_
source: POKENAME seeks out unprotected Pokémon nests and steals their eggs, storing them in its sack-like tail. It has also been known to swipe valuables from unsuspecting hikers.

entry: POKENAME在高山筑巢，铁甲能抵御严寒。它会从上方俯冲，用尖锐的金属爪刺穿猎物。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME nests high in the mountains, its iron armor protecting it from the extreme cold. It divebombs its prey from above, spearing them with its sharp metal talons.

entry: POKENAME聪明而独立，需要训练家用心投入、体谅它，才能教会指令。它很不信任陌生对象，主人不在时可能直接袭击，主人在场则会警惕地紧靠身旁。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is highly intelligent and independent, so it requires a dedicated and empathetic Trainer to teach it commands. It is very distrustful of new presences, leading it to attack if its owner is not present or to remain warily close to its owner.

entry: POKENAME很精明，靠欺骗捕捉猎物。它会以古怪的路线游动，假装受伤，再出其不意地咬下致命一口。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are shrewd creatures that rely on deception to secure their prey. They pretend to be injured by slithering in an odd pattern before surprising their prey with a lethal bite.

entry: POKENAME会在峡谷中高速滚动，转过的地方留下一道滑溜的冰路，几乎无法追赶。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rolls at high speeds through canyons. As it spins, it leaves a slick path of ice in its wake, making pursuit nearly impossible.

entry: POKENAME运用巨爪十分灵巧，能细致地整理文件，再迅速撕碎不需要的部分。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is rather dexterous with the large claws it wields. Using them, it can meticulously sort through files and quickly shred apart those that are no longer needed.

entry: POKENAME会高举鹿角般的法杖，精准施展冰属性攻击。猎物常连步子都没迈完，就被冻得停在原地。
author: .izik
source: Holding its antler-like wand aloft, POKENAME casts precise Ice-type attacks. Frozen prey are often left standing mid-step.

entry: POKENAME会用涂鸦标记领地，每只都有独特的风格和签名。争夺领地时，它们会在对方的涂鸦上覆盖作画。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME marks its territory with painted graffiti. Each POKENAME has a unique style and signature. During territorial disputes, POKENAME will paint over each other's graffiti.

entry: POKENAME领地意识很强。若有敌对同类在不该出现的时候闯来，立刻就会被收拾，用来警告其他对手。尾巴的颜色代表所属帮派。
author: musicsheep.
source: A territorial Pokémon. If any rival POKENAME shows up in the wrong place at the wrong time, it is made a quick example of. Its tail color represents its gang affiliation.

entry: 它们天生甘愿当手下，会聚到附近最强的个体身边。只要能捣乱，就会勤勤恳恳地执行命令。
author: jackythewannabe
source: Natural-born underlings, they flock to the strongest individual nearby. They follow orders diligently as long as it causes mischief.

entry: 它们寻找其他宝可梦的巢，合力打败亲代，再把双亲连同蛋，一并吃下。
author: darkweavile428
source: They seek out the nests of Pokémon and work together to defeat the parents. Once their prey is defeated, they eat both the parents and their eggs.

entry: POKENAME有锋利的爪子，能在坚冰上疾奔。它本可以是出色的雪橇宝可梦，却坚决不肯套上挽具。
author: danarchist
source: POKENAME have sharp claws that allow them to sprint on solid ice. They would make excellent sled Pokémon, but they will not tolerate being harnessed.

entry: 它藏在北方森林覆雪的针叶树间，攀爬时，利爪会在树皮上留下深痕。
author: cait_sith
source: It hides among the snow-covered coniferous trees of boreal forests. Its sharp claws leave gouges in tree bark as it climbs.

entry: 它们聪明又狡诈，觉得什么有用就偷什么：石头拿来砸人，宝可梦的蛋拿来吃或作为要挟，连其他宝可梦的巢都不放过。
author: bobosmith01
source: Intelligent and devious, they steal anything they think might be useful: stones to pelt others with, Pokémon Eggs to eat or otherwise keep hostage, and even the nests of other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME独处时胆怯，结成大群却能轻松伏击体形六倍于自己的宝可梦。它们极其聪明，常把猎物引上冰地，取得优势。
author: mistymagius
source: While timid on their own, large packs of POKENAME can ambush Pokémon six times their size with ease. They are incredibly clever, often leading their prey into icy areas where they have the advantage.

entry: POKENAME能在结冰湖面高速滑行，平衡感出色。飞快滑动时，它会用羽冠调整方向。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides across frozen lakes with speed and balance. It uses its feathered crest to steer while skating at high velocity.

entry: POKENAME守在阴影里，用灵活伸缩的刀刃撬开无人看守的蛋，或撕开无力防备的猎物。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: After waiting in the shadows, POKENAME uses its dexterous, retractable blades to crack open unguarded eggs or rip into vulnerable victims.

entry: POKENAME的金属爪散发刺骨寒气，轻轻一划，连血肉和铠甲都能冻住。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's metal claws radiate bitter cold. A single scratch from them can freeze flesh and armor alike.

entry: POKENAME常被称为“梦魇”，以专挑村庄恐吓而恶名远扬。它只在夜里袭击，还会吓跑守卫宝可梦。据训练家说，它囤积的财物里满是零钱。
author: ghostslythe
source: Often called The Nightmare, POKENAME is infamous for choosing villages to terrorize. It only attacks at night and will scare off guard Pokémon. Trainers report their hordes are filled with loose change.

entry: POKENAME会在冰洞里游荡觅食，爪间释放能使对方平静的毒素。被划伤的对象反应会变慢，让它在战斗中占上风。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prowls ice caves in search of prey, releasing a soothing venom from its claws. This weakens the reaction time of anything it slashes, allowing it to gain the upper hand in combat.

entry: POKENAME会伸长手臂，将爪子扎进树皮攀爬，也会骄傲地展示羽毛帽。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME climbs trees by stretching its arms out and digging its claws into the bark. It shows off its feathered cap with pride.

entry: POKENAME打盹时，头上的羽毛会缓缓摇摆。它只偶尔短暂醒来吃点东西，很快又继续睡。
author: .izik
source: While it naps, POKENAME's head feather sways slowly. It only wakes for short bursts to eat before dozing off again.

entry: POKENAME摇尾时，尾羽会迸出噼啪电光。火花照亮周围雪地，宛如一场静电风暴。
author: .izik
source: The tail feathers of POKENAME crackle with electricity when it wags. Sparks light up the snow around it like a static storm.

entry: POKENAME可爱的外表下藏着狡猾的性情。它会用甜美嗓音哄宝可梦入睡，再潜入巢穴，偷蛋来吃。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME's cute appearance hides a cunning demeanor. POKENAME uses its sweet voice to lure Pokémon to sleep, then sneaks into their nests to steal eggs to eat.

entry: POKENAME极其狡猾，常骗得更强的宝可梦放松警惕，再迅速打击弱点。它在黑夜狩猎，专挑独自在森林游荡的弱小宝可梦。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are incredibly cunning, often tricking stronger Pokémon into letting their guard down before swiftly striking their weak spot. It hunts in the darkness of night, targeting weak Pokémon wandering the forest alone.

entry: POKENAME会结成小队捕猎，用幻象伪装自己，突然袭击倒霉的目标，再以快速游击将其压倒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gather in small packs for hunting operations. Using illusions to disguise themselves, they take hapless targets by surprise and overwhelm them with quick hit-and-run strikes.

entry: POKENAME自大，总挑战比自己大得多的敌人。可爪子弱、火苗小，多半只能落败。它又极其输不起，常勉强自己，逞强到损害健康的地步。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are cocky creatures that take on foes much larger than themselves. Their weak claws and small embers lead most of them to defeat. They are also incredibly sore losers and are known to push themselves to unhealthy limits.

entry: POKENAME天性顽皮，常借雪白毛皮掩护，跟在登山者身后，一有机会就顺手偷东西。
author: lucioleuh
source: POKENAME have a mischievous nature. They often are spotted following mountain hikers, camouflaged by their snow-like fur, occasionally stealing items when given the chance.

entry: POKENAME会用爪子钩住较大的猎物，再用耳朵猛砸，直到对方倒下。它虽然欺负其他宝可梦，却害怕路卡利欧，一见到就会逃离那片领地。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME hooks its claws into larger prey and pummels them with its ear until they collapse. Though it bullies other Pokémon, it fears Lucario and will flee its territory if it spots one.

entry: 白天，成大群的POKENAME会在冰洞里打盹。夜幕一落，它们便分成小队，捕猎在黑暗苔原游荡的宝可梦。
author: mistymagius
source: Large hordes of POKENAME can be seen napping during the day in their frozen caves. Once night falls, they will hunt in small groups to take out any Pokémon wandering the dark tundra.

entry: POKENAME会携带形似锐利之爪的物品，确保攻击有足够威力，一击解决猎物。传说这些刀刃来自已经死去的狃拉。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME carry items resembling Razor Claws to ensure that their strikes will carry enough power to finish off their prey in one blow. Rumors claim that these blades come from Sneasel that have passed on.

entry: POKENAME会在冰冻洞窟里，用覆霜石块筑巢。它能释放电流，既赶走入侵者，也照亮洞穴。
author: .izik
source: In frozen caverns, POKENAME builds nests out of frost-covered stones. It fires electric bursts to ward off intruders and light its den.

entry: POKENAME会结成小队，合作偷窃旅人。几只在不同方向爆炸，分散注意，另几只挑选出的成员则悄悄潜入，能偷什么就偷什么。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME coordinate in small groups to steal from travelers. A few members will explode from different sides to work as distractions while a select few other members sneak in and swipe anything they can.

entry: POKENAME偷取洞穴中的龙属性宝可梦蛋，动作灵巧，极少被抓住。爪子即使折断，几秒就能再生，比原先更锋利。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME steals Dragon-type eggs from their caves with such agility that it is rarely caught. If its claws break, they regrow within seconds, even sharper than before.

entry: POKENAME会跟踪猎物，无论宝可梦还是人，再无声吸血，吸到仍能飞得动的极限为止。若吃得格外有营养，粉红羽毛就会更加鲜艳，这也是它引以为傲的标志。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME stalks its prey, Pokémon or human, before silently draining as much blood as will allow it to fly. The pink feather becomes more vibrant after an especially nutritious meal, which is a mark of pride for POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME会接受邪恶组织传授的秘密技巧训练，偷取文件或稀有物品。它会得到宝石作为奖励，但也享受偷窃本身。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are trained to steal documents or rare items through surreptitious techniques passed down by evil organizations. They are given gems as a reward but enjoy stealing for its own sake.

entry: POKENAME有虐待的癖好，会用爪子割伤对手，希望留下永久伤疤。它总在战斗中戏弄敌人、拖长交锋，没玩够之前绝不打出决定性一击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a sadistic streak, cutting at opponents with its claws in the hope of leaving permanent scars. It toys with its foes during fights to prolong them, never going for a decisive blow until it's had its fun.

entry: POKENAME会裹着外套般的覆盖物，在路旁哭喊发抖，等路人停下来帮忙。趁热心人不备偷走东西后，它便尖声咯咯笑着跑开。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME waits along trails wailing and shaking in its coat-like covering, waiting for passerby to stop and help. It looks for an opportunity to steal from the generous helper and scampers away with a high-pitched giggle.

entry: POKENAME会用寒冷吐息冻住亲代宝可梦，再偷走蛋。冰还没开始融化，它就已消失无踪。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME freezes parent Pokémon with a chilling breath, then steals their eggs. It vanishes before the ice even starts to thaw.

entry: POKENAME滑行时会扬起积雪，制造小型暴风雪，隐藏行踪。直到出手前一刻才抬爪，再借仍在无声飘落的雪，不知不觉地消失。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME brushes snow up into the air as it glides, creating miniature blizzards to hide its presence. It only lifts its claws right before it strikes, using the remaining silent snowfall to disappear unnoticed.

entry: POKENAME被认为是最聪明的宝可梦之一，足以与呆呆王相比。它会用空灵舞姿迷住猎物，再给予致命一击。研究发现，它的毒液能暂时麻痹长毛猪。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are thought to be some of the smartest Pokémon, comparable to Slowking. They hunt by using ethereal dances to mesmerize their prey before striking them with a fatal blow. Studies show their venom can temporarily paralyze a Piloswine.

entry: 这种形态的POKENAME带有洗翠样子狃拉的特征。虽然不是毒属性，树液却有毒，接触后会引起严重刺痛的皮疹。
author: hophoppip
source: This form of POKENAME has taken on traits from Sneasel's Hisuian form. Though not a Poison-type, its sap is toxic, causing severe stinging rashes on contact.

entry: POKENAME看起来比实际更凶，却容不得欺凌。它会朝欺凌者吐出一团黏液，困住对方，再靠近用爪子惩罚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME looks more intimidating than it actually is, but doesn't stand for bullying. It spits a glob of sticky slime at bullies, immobilizing them so it can get close and punish them with its claws.

entry: POKENAME战斗力不算出众，却很擅长在雪地甩掉对手。它独居，只在夜里狩猎，方便藏入阴影。
author: mistymagius
source: While not all that impressive in battle, POKENAME has mastered the art of losing its opponents in the snow. It lives in solitude, only hunting at night so it can conceal itself in the shadows.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME会用长指甲刮山村的窗户，引起住户注意。若窗被打开，它就会喷出一团令人麻木的孢子，再把受害者拖走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drags its long nails across windows in mountain villages at night to get the residents' attention. If the window is opened, it releases a puff of numbing spores before dragging the victim away.

entry: POKENAME会爬上树，将榛果球从枝头割下来，再撕开外壳，往里面塞满孢子。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME climbs trees and severs Pineco from the branches. It then tears into Pineco's shell and fills Pineco with spores.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在积雪森林里，始终躲在视线刚好够不着的地方窥望。见到过它的人，很少还能活着讲述经历。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME lurks in snowy forests, watching from just out of sight. Few have spotted it and lived to tell the tale.

entry: POKENAME攀上许多树的树顶，都用不了四秒。它喜欢登上高处，攻击所有从下方经过的对象。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME can scale to the top of many trees in less than four seconds. POKENAME enjoys reaching high places and attacking anything that walks under it.

entry: POKENAME身体轻巧，格外灵活。蓬松的毛皮尝起来有浓浓的八角味。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's lightweight body makes it especially nimble. Its fluffy fur tastes strongly of star anise.

entry: POKENAME披着漆黑斗篷，能完美融入黑暗。它性情其实相当温和，但阴暗的外表让它背上小偷、骗子的名声，行为也常遭到误解。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME wears a jet-black cloak that allows it to hide perfectly in the dark. Although it has a rather gentle disposition, its shady appearance has earned it a reputation as a thief and liar, and so its actions are often misinterpreted.

entry: POKENAME会用鲜艳色彩晃花对手的眼，再用天体般身体上凸出的利冰柱刺入对方。每种颜色都有不同的水果风味。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME dazzles its opponents with flashy colors before embedding them with sharp icicles protruding from its celestial body. Each color has a different fruit flavor.

entry: POKENAME爱打架，却讨厌输。因此常用卑鄙不公的手段，例如伏击，或往对手眼里扬尘。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME love to fight, but hate to lose. Because of this, they often use underhanded and unfair tactics, such as ambushing and throwing dust into the eyes of their opponents.

entry: POKENAME会用锋利如刀的爪子挖开冰层与永久冻土，在地下造出庞大的隧道网。它擅长伏击，会从下方冒出，抓住猎物，拖进自己挖出的冰窟。
author: fancyskunk
source: POKENAME uses its razor-sharp claws to carve through ice and permafrost, creating massive tunnel networks under the ground. An ambush predator, POKENAME emerges from below, grabs its prey, and drags it into the frozen caverns it creates.

entry: POKENAME极其自私，天生爱囤积东西。必须培养它的同理心，才能让它不再为食物争斗。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are incredibly selfish creatures that have a natural hoarding instinct. Developing their sense of empathy is necessary to stop them from fighting over food.

entry: POKENAME自诩为绅士怪盗。如果发现有人行为不端，对方第二天就会莫名其妙地道歉。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME styles itself as a gentlemanly thief. If POKENAME notices someone misbehaving, the person will mysteriously apologize the following day.

entry: 持续不断的偏头痛让POKENAME变得记仇又任性，稍有不顺，就会用精神力量发泄。柿仔果能缓解头痛，也能让它少些怒气。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's incessant migraines have led to its vindictive and petulant personality. Even the smallest annoyance leads it to lash out with its psychic powers. Persim Berries can help it find some relief from the headaches, lessening its anger as well.

entry: POKENAME在冰冻湖泊里狩猎，用强壮的爪子破冰直潜。不过水中比外头的空气暖和，因此它大多数时间都待在水下。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hunts in frozen lakes, using its powerful claws to dive straight through the ice. However, it stays underwater most of the time since the water is warmer than the outside air.

entry: POKENAME肠胃强健，能吃腐败的树果汁和陈放的肉。它会挖出坚固的地下隧道，在里面制作原始的工具、建筑和玩具。
author: turron_turron
source: POKENAME have resilient stomachs that can handle diets of rotten berry juice and aging meats. They carve out sturdy underground tunnels where they build primitive tools, structures, and toys.

entry: POKENAME热爱犯罪，梦想着帮训练家逃脱法网。要把这种融合宝可梦教得正直善良，非得有最坚定的意志、最纯净的心。
author: epping_forest
