source: POKENAME adores crime, as it cherishes the dream of helping its Trainer get away from the forces of law. It will take the strongest of wills and purest of hearts to raise this fusion in the ways of justice and goodhearted actions.

entry: POKENAME在夜里迅速穿行，除了闪动的粉红火焰，几乎看不见身影。若牛一夜之间从田间消失，往往是它所为，因为原地会留下烧焦的蹄印。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME use their speed to move quickly through the night, almost invisible except for their flickering pink flames. When cattle disappear from fields overnight, POKENAME are often to blame, as it leaves behind scorched hoof prints.

entry: POKENAME总在闲躺，只有耐心地用尾巴钓鱼觅食时才动一动。虽然脸上常挂着顽皮神情，脑子里也满是狡计，它却懒得付诸行动。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME loafs about, only moving to patiently fish for food with its tail. While it usually has a mischievous expression on its face, POKENAME is far too lazy to act on any schemes formed with its cunning intellect.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛带着强烈磁性，潜行经过工厂废墟时，会吸来螺栓、电线和废料。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feather holds a powerful magnetic charge. In factory ruins, it attracts bolts, wires, and scraps as it sneaks through.

entry: POKENAME喜欢互相吓着玩，先躲在岩石后，再笑得傻乎乎地跳出来。虽然动作可能很笨拙，躲避捕食者的本领却出奇地好。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves to surprise one another, playfully hiding behind rocks before jumping out with a goofy smile on their face. Despite how clumsy they can be, they are surprisingly good at evading predators.

entry: 攻击时，POKENAME的尾羽会冻成坚硬刀刃，以迅疾的劈划切开冰层。
author: .izik
source: When attacking, the feathers on POKENAME's tail freeze into rigid blades. It uses them to carve through ice with swift, slicing motions.

entry: POKENAME受惊时会吐出冰冷的珍珠。若直接命中，敌人就可能被完全封在冰里。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits out freezing pearls when startled. A direct hit can leave foes completely encased in ice.

entry: POKENAME施展幽灵属性攻击时，羽毛会亮起冰蓝色的光。它无声地飘过夜空，在空气里留下一股寒意。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feather glows icy blue when channeling Ghost-type attacks. It leaves a cold aura in the air as it floats silently through the night.

entry: POKENAME虽然嘴和犬牙可怕，咬合力却不值一提，连爪子也钝而无力。它靠的是吓唬人的手段，而非力量。
author: musicsheep.
source: Despite its terrifying mouth and canine teeth, its bite is nothing worth mentioning. Even its claws are dulled down and weak. POKENAME relies on scare tactics rather than power.

entry: POKENAME爱潜入其他生物的巢，吃无人看管的蛋。彩色羽毛让飞行属性捕食者很容易发现它，但它会用锋利如刀的大钳凶狠反击。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME loves to sneak into nests of other creatures to feed on unprotected eggs. It is easily spotted by Flying-type predators due to its colorful feathers, but will fight back viciously with its razor-sharp pincers.

entry: POKENAME背上罐子产出的蜜对人有毒，却是极有效的杀虫剂。园丁会养它在园地里游走，让害虫被蜜吸引，吃下后中毒。
author: pjporwoll
source: The honey produced by the jar on POKENAME's back is toxic to humans, but is an exceedingly effective pesticide. Gardeners raise POKENAME to wander their land so pests will be attracted to the honey and be poisoned when they eat it.

entry: POKENAME闻到蜂蜜后，会连着裹茧的身体跳过去，蹭上蜂蜜，裹满全身。这样进化以后，就能把沾蜜的破茧残片当零食吃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hops its cocooned body over to sources of honey it smells. It rubs itself against the honey in order to be coated by it, so that when it evolves, it can snack on the honey-coated remains of its broken cocoon.

entry: 它舌头敏感，喜欢用清淡健康的食物开启一天。一碗粥加点盐就很满足，是饲养花费不高的宠物。
author: quackquackattack
source: Due to its sensitive tongue, it enjoys a bland, healthy diet to help get started with its day. It is happy with porridge and a bit of salt, which make them a cheap pet to have around.

entry: POKENAME爱闯进三蜜蜂的巢夺蜜，其实是拿蜜把丝线与细枝粘在一起，搭自己的巢。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME love to raid Combee nests for their honey. They actually use the honey to stick silk and twigs together to make their nests.

entry: POKENAME主要靠蜂蜜为生，身体的质地和气味也很像蜂蜜。大针蜂常误以为是遗落的蜜，直接把它带回蜂巢，结果让它大吃储存的蜂蜜。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME subsists mainly on honey, giving their bodies a consistency and smell similar to it. Beedrill often mistake POKENAME for lost honey, bringing them directly to the hive where they feast on the reserves.

entry: POKENAME是杂食宝可梦，每天吃的食物多种多样。它能通过进化迅速适应某类食物以求生存，但多数更愿意维持多样而均衡的食谱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are omnivorous creatures that eat a variety of food on a daily basis. They can evolve to quickly adapt their bodies to certain kinds of food to survive, but most prefer to keep their varied yet balanced diet.

entry: POKENAME极爱甜食，最喜欢的尤其是蜂蜜。它会先用火焰吐息加热黏稠的蜜，再急切地舔食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is extremely fond of sweet treats, with honey in particular being its favorite. It warms up the sticky liquid with its fire breath before eagerly lapping it up.

entry: POKENAME常误入网络蜜罐，真以为里面装着蜂蜜。因此，各种防火墙都会把它赶出电脑系统，不少个体为此十分难过。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often accidentally fall for honeypot traps as they believe that the traps involve actual honey. This leads many types of firewalls to force POKENAME out of PC systems, causing many to feel sad.

entry: POKENAME会摇树，甚至折断树木，取得果实，再混合大针蜂花粉，制作自己的蜂蜜。它虽然自己吃得很多，也喜欢分给其他对象。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME will shake or even break trees to get a hold of their fruits to mix with Beedrill pollen to make their own honey. Though they will consume their own honey aplenty, they also love to share some of it with others.

entry: 情况危急时，POKENAME会向对手吐出蜂蜜般的物质。这种物质干得极快，会像树脂一样变硬，让敌人几乎无法动弹。
author: dodoowner_
source: In extreme situations, POKENAME spits a honey-like substance at opponents. This substance dries extremely quickly and hardens like resin, leaving enemies virtually immobilized.

entry: POKENAME是熟练的制蜜高手，能调出多种蜂蜜，记得每一种尝试过的配方。它把尾巴当搅拌勺，因此尾巴总带着最近所用原料的气味。
author: imaginita
source: A skilled honey artisan, POKENAME can whip up a wide variety of honey and remembers every recipe it has tried. It uses its tail like a mixing spoon, so it always smells of whatever ingredients POKENAME used most recently.

entry: POKENAME像一只活着的大毛绒玩具，背上能排出类似填充物的东西。不过材料滚烫，碰到就会被烫得生疼，最好别摸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has an appearance like a large living stuffed animal. It can expel something resembling stuffing from its back, though the material is blisteringly hot, and one should avoid touching it to prevent painful burns.

entry: POKENAME爱吃甜树果，常在空心树里藏下数百颗。果子会慢慢发酵，变成甜果泥，很受欢迎，常被抹在烤面包上吃。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves sweet berries and will often store hundreds of them inside of hollow trees. However, the berries will slowly start to ferment, creating a sweet puree that is quite popular on toast.

entry: POKENAME会捉弄其他宝可梦，惹了麻烦却会坦然承认。虽然顽皮，它并不愿意看到人或宝可梦因自己的恶作剧受伤。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME pulls pranks on other Pokémon but reacts with candor whenever it is in trouble. Despite its mischievous nature, it does not enjoy seeing people or Pokémon hurt by its antics.

entry: POKENAME会研究产蜜的巢穴，算出最佳偷袭时机。自己行动受限，因此常请其他宝可梦帮忙。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME study hives that produce honey to calculate the best time to raid the nest. They often enlist the help of other Pokémon because of their limited movement.

entry: POKENAME会召集大群虫属性宝可梦一起觅食，常带队找到蜂巢，合力偷蜂蜜，最后供自己享用。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gather swarms of Bug-type Pokémon to hunt for food as a group. POKENAME often leads the group to hives where they collectively steal honey for POKENAME to eat.

entry: POKENAME的毛皮带着淡淡甜香，容易被某些捕食者盯上，因此通常与同类一起生活，互相保护。它极难寻踪，性格却出奇友善亲昵，幼年时尤其如此。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME generally lives alongside its own kind for protection, as their vaguely sweet-smelling fur makes them targets for certain predators. It is incredibly elusive, yet surprisingly friendly and affectionate, especially in its younger years.

entry: POKENAME十分善良，常与其他对象交朋友，只为让对方开心。不过，只要送它蜂蜜之类的甜食，它就再也不肯离开你。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is a very kind Pokémon, often befriending others for no reason but to make them happy. However, if you offer it something sweet like honey, it will never leave your side.

entry: POKENAME心思单纯，精神力量的潜力却很大。额头的月牙发光时，它便能短暂看见即将发生的未来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a simple mind, but possesses great psychic potential. When the crescent moon on its head glows, it receives a short vision of the immediate future.

entry: POKENAME能在恰当时机转动棉花般的风帆借风，控制漂浮的方向。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME can control the direction it drifts by turning its cotton sails to catch the wind at just the right moment.

entry: POKENAME的汗和唾液，带着上次吃下食物的些许气味。不过几乎从来不甜，因为身体会吸收食物中几乎所有糖分。它最常见于林地。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's sweat and saliva smells a bit like what it last ate. However, it almost never smells sweet; this is due to POKENAME's body absorbing almost all sugary content in whatever it has eaten. They are most often found in the woodlands.

entry: POKENAME会用尾巴上的手从蜂巢里顺走蜜脾，跑到安全距离后，再用爪子撕成小块。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME steal honey from hives by swiping honeycombs with the hand on their tail. Once they run a safe distance away, they tear the honeycombs into pieces with their claws.

entry: POKENAME爱吃蜂蜜，愿意冒险获取蜜脾。晴天最活跃，阳光能让它跑得更快，逃开守护蜂巢的宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to eat honey and are willing to put themselves in danger to obtain honeycombs. They are most active during sunny days, where the sunlight gives them a boost of speed to escape Pokémon that defend hives.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的凝胶毒性极强，几乎什么碰到都会被毒倒。它会把尾巴伸进蜂巢取蜜，对蜜蜂造成的伤害，比蜜蜂对它造成的还大。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's tail is coated in a gel that is poisonous enough to knock out almost anything that touches it. They poke it into beehives to collect honey, causing more damage to the bees than they cause to it.

entry: POKENAME思考复杂方程或哲学问题时会一动不动，唯独头顶罐子滴下蜂蜜时，才会动一动去舔。甜蜜的糖浆能为大脑补充能量。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME stand perfectly still while pondering the answers to complicated equations or philosophical questions. They only move during this process to lick up the honey dripping from the pots on their head, the sweet syrup helping fuel their brains.

entry: POKENAME常偷取大针蜂和三蜜蜂巢里的蜂蜜，装进罐子放在头上。吃蜂蜜既能维持敏锐头脑，也能随时享用甜零食。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME often steal honey from hives of Beedrill and Combee, putting pots of it on their head. By consuming the honey, POKENAME maintains a keen intellect, as well as having access to a sweet snack.

entry: 最大的POKENAME通常在冬眠前攒下了最多的糖和脂肪，因此受到同伴敬重。夏季最爱玩，也只有这时候才喜欢朋友亲昵地碰触。
author: bobosmith01
source: The biggest POKENAME generally has secured the largest amount of sugar and fat during the season before hibernation, so it has the respect of its peers. They are most playful in the summer months and only then enjoy physical affection from friends.

entry: POKENAME受惊时会释放蜂蜜般的气味，警告同伴。如果威胁继续靠近，它就会慌张地引爆自己，造成小型爆炸。
author: .izik
source: When frightened, POKENAME releases a honeylike scent to warn others. If the threat comes closer, it panics and detonates in a small explosion.

entry: POKENAME尾巴里住着一群小型虫属性宝可梦。它们采集花蜜酿蜜，它再将蜂蜜存进尾巴，留作冬粮。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's tail is home to a hive of small Bug-type Pokémon. They gather nectar from flowers to produce honey, which POKENAME stores inside its tail as food for winter.

entry: POKENAME会占据自己的树果树筑巢，同类靠得太近就常打架。不过它允许虫宝可梦同住，只为让大型宝可梦先去捕捉小虫。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME claim their own berry trees to nest in and will often fight other POKENAME if they get too close. However, they let Bug Pokémon stay with them, only so that bigger Pokémon will go after the bugs first.

entry: POKENAME受到袭击就会躲进硬壳，因为天生没有反击手段。为了储备冬粮，它会把采来的树果在壳里酿成蜂蜜般的物质。
author: _pixelar_
source: When a POKENAME is attacked, it hides inside its hard shell, as the Pokémon has no natural means to attack back. To store food for the winter, it creates a honey-like substance inside its shell using Berries it forages.

entry: POKENAME在满月时最活跃，会忧伤地望着天空，仿佛等待月相变化。神奥研究者认为，这种不同于未融合熊宝宝的表现，暗示潜藏的月月熊基因正在显现。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are most active during the full moon. They watch the sky mournfully as though waiting for a change in the phase of the moon. Sinnoh researchers think this difference to unfused Teddiursa hints at latent Ursaluna gene expression emerging.

entry: POKENAME在满月时最活跃，会忧伤地望着天空，仿佛等待月相变化。神奥研究者认为，这种不同于未融合熊宝宝的表现，暗示潜藏的月月熊基因正在显现。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are most active during the full moon. They watch the sky mournfully as though waiting for a change in the phase of the moon. Sinnoh researchers think this difference to unfused Teddiursa hints at latent Ursaluna gene expression emerging.

entry: POKENAME体形大却亲切，很受欢迎，常想抱住比自己小的对象。它心肠太软，无论对手多弱，开战前都会发抖。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite popular due to its large size but amiable disposition, often seeking to cuddle anything smaller than it. It's so softhearted it will tremble before any battle, even against weaker foes.

entry: POKENAME散发怡人的甜香，肥厚的身体又让捕食性宝可梦更难抗拒，因此相关种类常不得不保护它。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has a pleasant and sweet aroma. Its fatty body also adds temptation to predator Pokémon, so related species often end up having to protect it.

entry: 几乎所有POKENAME都喜欢甜味和涩味树果。清洁时会用毛茸茸的身体蹭石面；平时住在山边，也让这件事更方便。
author: bobosmith01
source: Almost all POKENAME adore sweet and dry Berries. To clean themselves, they rub their furry body against stony surfaces; the fact their typical habitats are near mountains assists with that act.

entry: POKENAME作为宠物，既难养又好养。水温、洁净度等条件不合适，就很容易生病；可喂点蜂蜜似乎又能解决所有问题，至少暂时如此。
author: sk372
source: As a pet, POKENAME is simultaneously difficult yet simple to care for. Without proper water temperature, purity and other such criteria it will grow ill easily, yet feeding it honey seems to cure all its issues, at least for a time.

entry: POKENAME鼻子格外灵敏，能闻到远处的大针蜂巢。有些美食家已开始训练它，嗅出埋在地下的珍贵松露。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME have especially keen noses and can sniff out Beedrill hives across great distances. Some gourmands have started training POKENAME to sniff out valuable truffles buried underground.

entry: POKENAME住在高山的森林中，靠敏锐嗅觉寻找满是蜜的蜂巢。找到后，便一再撞树，直到蜂巢掉到林地上。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lives high in the mountains amongst alpine forests. Using its keen sense of smell it tracks down hives filled with Honey and will ram into the trees until the hive drops to the forest floor.

entry: POKENAME会滚撞树木，震落大针蜂巢，砸开吃蜜，再赶在蜂群袭来之前滚走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rolls into trees to knock down Beedrill hives. It smashes them open for honey, then rolls away before the swarm can attack.

entry: 酿蜜的虫宝可梦夜里睡熟，POKENAME便趁机远行，寻找最爱的食物。遇上筑着蜂巢的树，它会凭巨力将其推倒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Preferring to navigate at night when the Bug types that produce Honey are asleep, POKENAME will travel great distances in search of its favourite food. When it finds a tree housing a nest, it uses its immense strength to topple it.

entry: POKENAME哪怕只吃一盎司蜂蜜，滚动速度也会变成三倍。借这股新添的冲劲，连垂直崖壁也能径直滚上去。
author: .izik
source: After eating even an ounce of honey, POKENAME's rolling speed triples. It can even roll straight up vertical cliffs with its newfound momentum.

entry: POKENAME吃很多蜂蜜，产出的奶也格外甜。它常不好意思分享奶水，但只要拿甜食交换，就很容易说服。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's high consumption of honey means that the milk it produces is particularly sweet in flavor. It's often shy about sharing its milk, but is easily convinced when offered sweets in exchange.

entry: POKENAME饿了会十分暴躁，为找食物，能把整棵树撕开。冬天开始冬眠前，它会用大石头堵住洞口。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is incredibly irritable when hungry, and rips through entire trees looking for food. During the winter, it blocks the entrance of its den with large rocks before beginning hibernation.

entry: POKENAME头上的孔会散发甜香，吸引传粉的虫宝可梦。其实它并不需要授粉，只是喜欢它们所带花蜜的甜味。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME releases a sweet scent from the holes on its head, attracting pollinating Bug Pokémon. However, it doesn't actually need to be pollinated, it just likes the sweet taste of their nectar.

entry: POKENAME总是昏昏欲睡。它睡的枕头，连暴怒的火暴猴都能哄入梦乡。
author: toxicrown
source: POKENAME is always very sleepy. The pillow it sleeps on could send even a raging Primeape into slumber.

entry: POKENAME常劫掠大针蜂巢取蜜，身体强健，也因此有大量对抗蜂毒的抗体。毛皮带甜香，常因吃了太多蜂蜜而黏糊糊的。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have robust bodies with plenty of antibodies for Beedrill venom, due to how often they pillage their hives for honey. Their furs carry a sweet scent and are typically very sticky from all the honey they consume.

entry: POKENAME在林间从一棵树滑翔到另一棵树时最开心。它天性幼稚单纯，却极其善良。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is at its most gleeful when it is gliding from tree to tree in the woods. It has an immature, naive, but extremely kind nature.

entry: POKENAME擅长攀爬，会用爪子登上高树，寻找三蜜蜂巢，再用爪子刺入，吃掉里面的蜂蜜。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are skilled climbers, using their claws to scale tall trees in search of Combee hives. They stab into these hives with their claws, consuming the honey inside.

entry: POKENAME常偷农夫和大针蜂巢里的蜂蜜。食欲旺盛，饿极了，一天能劫掠20多个蜂巢。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME regularly steal honey from farmers and Beedrill hives. POKENAME have voracious appetites and can raid over 20 hives in a day if hungry enough.

entry: 幼年的POKENAME不会离出生的洞穴太远，会耐心等待亲代回来。觉得有危险时，它会先哀叫一声，再蜷起身体，靠甲片般的皮肤保护。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME don't stray far from their childhood den when they're young, waiting patiently for their parent to return. If they feel they're in danger, they make a plaintive cry before curling up, relying on their plated skin to protect them.

entry: POKENAME身上的叶片会随季节变色，冬季逐渐发白，春天则变成金棕色，散发怡人的蜂蜜香。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's leafy bits change color with the seasons, growing pale in the winter months. During the spring they become golden-brown, and emit a pleasing honey-like aroma.

entry: POKENAME住在温带森林，临近进化时会向苔原气候的地带迁移。它几乎不停地大吃蜂蜜，靠高大的体形吓退可能的袭击者。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME lives in temperate forests and travels closer to tundra climates when it is close to evolving. It gorges itself on honey nearly nonstop and relies on its impressive stature to intimidate any would-be attackers.

entry: POKENAME对甜食嗅觉灵敏，即使身处网络空间，也能闻到现实中的味道。如果电脑旁的零食莫名消失，很可能就是它干的。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a strong sense of smell regarding sweets, able to sniff them out in the real world even while in cyberspace. If snacks set near one's computer seem to disappear, it is likely POKENAME's doing.

entry: 极浓密的毛皮和生火器官，能让野生POKENAME冬眠时保持温暖。它不学习社交，总会竭力避开可能的捕食者。
author: bobosmith01
source: Incredibly dense fur and a flame-producing organ keep wild POKENAME warm during winter hibernation. They do not learn to be social, and they avoid potential predators at all costs.

entry: POKENAME最喜欢泥坑多、树上有蜂蜜的住处。几乎每次见到它，毛皮上都糊满了泥和蜂蜜。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's preferred home is one lush with mud puddles and trees bearing honey. It's almost constantly seen caked with both mud and honey all over its fur.

entry: 它在人面前十分害羞。想与它交朋友，最简单的办法就是送上蜂蜜。
author: toxicrown
source: This Pokémon is extremely shy around people. The easiest way to befriend one is to present it with honey.

entry: POKENAME的刺会释放模仿大针蜂的信息素，让它悄悄潜入蜂巢。它会把大块蜜脾带回洞里，享用好几天。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's spines emit pheromones that mimic those of Beedrill, allowing it to sneak into their hives unnoticed. It takes large chunks of honeycomb back to its den and feasts on them for days.

entry: POKENAME不太聪明，通常靠出色的嗅觉找食物。它爱吃树果和蜂蜜等甜食，因此可能不知不觉走进市场和面包店。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is not that smart, usually following its incredible sense of smell to find food. It loves sweet things like berries and honey, which can lead to it wandering into markets and bakeries.

entry: 据说POKENAME会让附近的对象失眠，害训练家一连数小时无法入睡。有些训练家说，曾见它在黑暗里变成骇人的模样，不过这些报告多被归为光线造成的错觉。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME is said to induce insomnia in those nearby, leaving its Trainer sleepless for hours on end. Some Trainers report witnessing POKENAME assume disturbing forms in the darkness, though such accounts are mostly attributed to tricks of the light.

entry: POKENAME的头骨和爪子外都有金属护层。爪上的金属让它更容易攀爬、挖开树木，取得蜂蜜。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a metallic shielding around its skull as well as its claws. The metal around the claws is used to more easily climb and dig into trees to obtain honey.

entry: 风暴来临前一小时，POKENAME就会开始来回踱步、低吼，是长途徒步的好伙伴。
author: curazy
source: POKENAME starts pacing and growling an hour before storms arrive, making it a perfect partner on long hikes.

entry: POKENAME在人和其他宝可梦面前温和，与同类却有强烈竞争心。常能见它们互相冲撞、顶头，尤其是争食的时候。
author: sk372
source: Though placid in the presence of humans and other Pokémon, POKENAME maintains a strong rivalry with others of its kind. Its quite common to see them charging at and headbutting into each other, particularly over food.

entry: POKENAME能抓下额头的月牙刀刃，掷向树枝，打落装满心爱蜂蜜的蜂巢。它十分害羞，只要察觉附近有人，就会藏进灌木。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can grasp the crescent-shaped blade on its forehead and hurl it at tree branches to knock down beehives full of the honey it loves. It is a very shy creature and hides in the bushes as soon as it notices a human nearby.

entry: POKENAME会用丝带多收集些蜂蜜，留待以后舔食。收集和吃下的量太多，哪怕清理干净，丝带仍带着蜜香。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its ribbons to gather up extra honey and lick it off of them later. It gathers and consumes so much that even when cleaned off, the ribbons still carry the scent of honey.

entry: POKENAME的冬眠遵循月亮周期，只在满月之夜活动。每月活动期以外，几乎不可能叫醒它。
author: quackquackattack
source: The hibernation of a POKENAME follows the lunar cycle, so they are only active during nights of the full moon. Outside of their monthly cycle, they are otherwise nearly impossible to awaken.

entry: POKENAME似乎在模仿抓娃娃机，借小毛绒玩偶充当眼睛观察。它乐意拿玩偶换蜂蜜点心，因此很受孩子欢迎。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME appear to mimic claw machines, using a small plushie as their eyes to see. POKENAME are popular with children, as they will gladly exchange plushies for honeyed snacks.

entry: 随着年龄增长，POKENAME头顶的毛簇会越来越长，也越来越弯。最年长的个体，毛簇上会开始长出小黑斑，宛如月面的坑洞。
author: bobosmith01
source: As POKENAME ages, the tuft of fur on their heads grows longer and curves more and more. The oldest of POKENAME begin developing small dark spots on this tuft, reminiscent of craters on the Moon.

entry: POKENAME头上的月牙火焰和融蜡，散发着近似新鲜蜂蜜的气味。可惜这常引来熊宝宝纠缠，偶尔连圈圈熊也会来。
author: sk372
source: The crescent flame and melting wax on POKENAME's head emit a scent very close to fresh honey. This unfortunately causes it to be accosted by Teddiursa and even the occasional Ursaring.

entry: POKENAME会选用让自己更可爱的纽扣，尽力显得无害。它避免与其他宝可梦起冲突，不高兴时就会逃走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME does its best to appear innocuous by choosing buttons that help it appear cuter. It avoids confrontation with other Pokémon and will run away when upset.

entry: POKENAME的几颗头只在爱吃蜂蜜这一点上意见一致。它们常为零食争抢，弄得满身黏蜜；想舔掉彼此的污渍，又常咬到对方。
author: sk372
source: The only thing that POKENAME's heads agree on is a love for honey. This leaves them often fighting over the snack and winding up coated and sticky, and often biting each other as they try to lick the stains off the other.

entry: POKENAME在森林里游荡，从树间跳来跳去，寻找树果。受到威胁时，它会鼓起身体，吓退可能的袭击者。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME wanders around the forests, hopping from tree to tree in search of berries. When threatened, it will inflate its body to intimidate would-be attackers.

entry: POKENAME会吃各种营养丰富的食物：牛油果补脂肪，蜂蜜补糖，作为杂食宝可梦，也会吸血补铁。唾液能麻痹猎物的神经，让它进食时不被察觉。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME consumes a variety of foods rich in nutrients: avocados for fat, honey for sugars, and, as an omnivore, blood for iron. Its saliva numbs the nerves of its prey while it feeds unnoticed.

entry: POKENAME常出现在蜂女王巢穴附近的田野中。它们一心寻找蜂蜜，除此之外什么都不吃。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are often found in fields near Vespiquen hives. They are always on the hunt for honey, and will not eat anything other than it.

entry: POKENAME嘴里总滴着蜂蜜般的口水。甜香吸引小虫，它便能轻松吸食被黏住的虫子，饱餐一顿。
author: sk372
source: A honey-like drool drips from POKENAME's mouth at all times. The sweet scent attracts small insects to it, making it easy for it to slurp up the stuck bugs for a meal.

entry: POKENAME毛茸茸的头顶长着植物，会结出能中和毒素的小坚果。草药师常跟着它，希望采到坚果，制作强效解毒药。
author: .izik
source: The plant atop POKENAME's fuzzy head sprouts small nuts known to neutralize toxins. Herbalists often follow it in hopes of gathering the nuts for potent Antidotes.

entry: POKENAME对人友善，是果园与蜂场的好帮手。帮忙采收后，它只求分到一些蜂蜜，作为报酬。
author: arcul
source: POKENAME are very friendly to humans and are great helpers in orchards and apiaries. In exchange for help with harvesting, POKENAME asks for portions of honey as payment.

entry: POKENAME无声飘过月光下的天空，收集一切闪亮的东西。被打扰时，它会轻轻哼鸣，连最凶猛的敌人也能安抚。
author: curazy
source: POKENAME floats silently through moonlit skies. POKENAME collects anything that sparkles, and if disturbed, it lets out a hum that calms even the most aggressive foes.

entry: POKENAME吃太多蜂蜜，黏液的质地和味道都很像蜜，有时会招来爱吃甜食的捕食者。
author: hophoppip
source: Because it consumes so much honey, POKENAME's slime is honey-like in texture and flavor, which sometimes attracts predators who are fond of sweet foods.

entry: POKENAME柔软而令人安心，孩子压力大时可以抱住它，因此深受小朋友喜爱。有人认为它体内住着幽灵，但至今没有证据。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is beloved by small children for being a soft, comforting presence they can embrace in times of stress. Some believe POKENAME has a ghostly spirit inhabiting it, but this is so far unsubstantiated.

entry: 许多人误以为POKENAME的蘑菇有蜂蜜香，就可以放心吃。它虽然不致命，却不适合人食用，吃下后会严重肠胃不适好几天。
author: sk372
source: Many have falsely assumed that the honey-like scent of POKENAME's mushrooms makes them safe to eat. While not deadly, they should not be eaten by humans and will cause severe stomach upset for days afterward.

entry: POKENAME极易驯服，很受新手训练家欢迎。部分原因是它爱蜂蜜，拿来当零食款待，很快就能赢得信任。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME is popular among novice Trainers for being exceptionally easy to tame. This is partly due to its love of honey, which quickly earns its trust when offered as a treat.

entry: POKENAME极易驯服，很受新手训练家欢迎。部分原因是它爱蜂蜜，拿来当零食款待，很快就能赢得信任。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME is popular among novice Trainers for being exceptionally easy to tame. This is partly due to its love of honey, which quickly earns its trust when offered as a treat.

entry: POKENAME常藏在树果丛里，既有稳定食物来源，也得到庇护。身上的瓜收获后味道格外甜，很适合做馅饼。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME often hides in berry bushes, providing it a reliable source of food and protection. Once harvested, its gourd has an incredibly sweet flavor, which makes it perfect for making pies.

entry: POKENAME会给遇见的每个对象分发烘焙点心。不过，就算拒绝收下，它仍会经常登门，直到你终于让步。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be seen handing out baked goods to anyone it meets. However, even if you refuse to take its treats, POKENAME will regularly show up to your door until you eventually give in.

entry: 食物被偷，常是因为人们对POKENAME无辜的眼神放松了戒心。不过真正深受其害的，是在地下蜂巢储蜜的大针蜂。
author: xiapher
source: Stolen food items are often the result of the disarming eyes of a POKENAME. The true victims of a POKENAME's antics, however, are Beedrill, which store their honey in underground hives.

entry: 想钓到POKENAME，最好的办法是在饵上抹一团蜂蜜。它太爱这种甜食，甚至有整群围向同一块饵的目击记录。
author: sk372
source: The best way to catch a POKENAME is to put a dollop of honey on one's bait when fishing. Entire schools have been seen flocking to a single piece of bait, so great is POKENAME's love for the sweet treat.

entry: POKENAME会捡零钱，逐渐积攒。攒够后，它就去人类聚居地，试着用硬币换蜂蜜之类的美味点心。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME collects spare coins it finds and builds a collection. Once it gathers enough, it goes into human civilizations and attempts to barter its coins for tasty treats such as honey.

entry: POKENAME爱甜食，会在训练家的公寓里四处觅食。它行动敏捷，能爬到高架子上，把容器推到地面摔开，吃里面的东西。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a fondness for sweet foods, prowling through their trainer's apartment in search of food to eat. They are agile Pokémon, able to reach high shelves to knock containers to the floor, breaking them open to get to the food inside.

entry: POKENAME极爱蜂蜜，会想尽办法取得。无论正在吃，还是正要取蜜，只要被打扰，就会暴怒。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME really loves to eat honey and will go to great lengths to acquire it. If it is ever interrupted while eating or trying to get honey, it will fly into a violent rage.

entry: POKENAME嗜甜如命，会在森林里寻找蜂蜜。发现树上挂着蜜脾，就会不断拳击树干，直到将其震落。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have an insatiable sweet tooth, hunting through forests in search of honey. When they find a tree with honeycomb hanging from it, they punch at the trunk until they shake the honeycomb free.

entry: 辛苦训练一整天后，POKENAME喜欢靠着温暖的壁炉休息，吃一块蜜脾犒劳自己。它会从嘴里吐出火星，让炉火不熄。
author: quackquackattack
source: After a long day of training, POKENAME love to rest by a cozy fireplace with a piece of honeycomb as a treat. They keep the fireplace lit by releasing embers from their mouth.

entry: POKENAME会采集蘑菇来吃，为漫长冬眠做好身体准备。受到威胁时，它会嚎叫，召来圈圈熊保护自己。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME has to prepare its body for long hibernations by gathering mushrooms to eat. If threatened, it lets out a howl, drawing Ursaring to its defense.

entry: 北上乡常能见到POKENAME帮忙制作粘糕。它捣粘糕时热情十足，却很容易弄得到处都是。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be found in the Kitakami region, assisting with the production of mochi. POKENAME exhibit lots of enthusiasm when mochi pounding, and is prone to create messes.

entry: POKENAME很为肌肉得意，爱带着玩笑炫耀，想让其他对象刮目相看。展示力量后，它常期待得到蜂蜜点心作为奖励。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a playful sense of pride in its musculature, always looking for a way to show off and impress others. It often expects to be rewarded with sweet honey treats for these displays of strength.

entry: POKENAME会从嘴里吐出甜蜂蜜，将自己黏在树枝上。蜂蜜虽然极其美味，却常把强大的虫宝可梦引到身边。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME spews out sweet honey from its mouth which it uses to stick itself to tree branches. While the honey is incredibly tasty, it often attracts strong Bug Pokémon to POKENAME's location.

entry: 别被颜色迷惑，POKENAME产出的物质有毒，不能食用。它会在各处表面涂满残留物，散出甜香，吸引虫宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: Despite its color, the substance POKENAME produce is toxic and should not be consumed. The residue that POKENAME suffuse over every surface has a sweet aroma that attracts bug Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME幼时头上就会长出石质月牙，满月时微微发光。虽然光芒诡异，它的行为却奇怪地毫无变化。
author: .izik
source: A stony crescent grows from POKENAME's head early in its life, glowing faintly during full moons. Despite this eerie glow, its behavior remains curiously unchanged.

entry: POKENAME双臂强壮，在战斗中能高效挥动骨棒，但最喜欢的用途却更平常：把蜂蜜或甜汁抹在骨头上，留待以后舔食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's strong arms let it wield the bone club with great effectiveness in battle, but its preferred use is more mundane: POKENAME enjoys smearing the bone with honey or sweet juices, saving them to lick up later.

entry: POKENAME很容易发怒，会在森林里横冲直撞，撞倒树木和沿途一切。唯有蜂蜜的香气能让它停下，立刻变得十分温顺。
author: sk372
source: Easy to anger, POKENAME goes on charging rampages through the forests, bowling over trees and anything in its path. The only thing that can stop its charge is the scent of honey, whereupon it becomes very docile.

entry: POKENAME是热带海域令人畏惧的猎手，常不分对象地攻击一切靠得太近的生物。有人说某些形状或图案能将它赶走，但这些说法尚未证实。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are highly feared predators of tropical seas, often indiscriminately attacking anything that comes too close. Some suggest certain shapes or patterns can ward off POKENAME, though these claims have yet to be verified.

entry: POKENAME最痴迷的依次是蜂蜜、花蜜和花粉。灵敏的鼻子哪怕只闻到一缕气息，它都会醒来，直接飞向来源，与挡路的对象交战。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is most obsessed with honey, nectar, and pollen, in that order. If its powerful nose detects even a single waft of these, it will awaken and fly right to the source, combating those who get in its way.

entry: POKENAME有些阴郁不合群，往往只顾自己的事，但答应用蜂蜜款待，很容易就能引它靠近。喂够甜食后，它终究会敞开心扉，变得开朗。
author: sk372
source: A bit sullen and antisocial, POKENAME tends to stick to its own devices, though it is easily lured closer with the promise of honey. If fed enough sweet treats, it will eventually open up and behave in a more upbeat fashion.

entry: POKENAME爱跳舞，特别擅长一种蹲着轮流踢出双脚的舞步。这种舞因与网络梗相连，在网上大受欢迎。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME loves to dance and performs a special dance where the dancer squats and thrusts one foot out in turns. This dance has grown popular on the internet because of its association with memes.

entry: POKENAME的外貌加上慢吞吞的动作，常让它被误认成巨大的儿童玩偶。
author: stabbycat
source: Because of POKENAME's appearance and slow-moving nature, it is often mistaken for a large children's toy.

entry: POKENAME住在缺乏树果的岛上，会袭击路过船只、抢走货物充饥。它太过凶猛，船只规划航线时甚至完全避开它栖息的岛屿。
author: soup1900
source: Inhabiting islands lacking berries, POKENAME gets its food by attacking passing ships and robbing their cargo. Its ferociousness has caused ships to plot courses that avoid islands where it lives entirely.

entry: POKENAME住在缺乏树果的岛上，会袭击路过船只、抢走货物充饥。它太过凶猛，水手规划航线时甚至完全避开它栖息的岛屿。
author: soup1900
source: Inhabiting islands lacking berries, POKENAME attacks passing ships and robs their cargo to gain its food. Its ferociousness has caused sailors to plot courses that avoid islands where it lives entirely.

entry: POKENAME极易被蜂蜜吸引，闻到一丝香气就会迅速飘过去。它有些贪心，若觉得其他宝可梦想抢蜜，甚至会用精神力量搬走整棵树。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is greatly attracted to honey sources, floating quickly to them the moment it catches a whiff. It is a bit greedy and may carry off an entire tree using psychic powers if it thinks another Pokémon may try to steal the honey it's after.

entry: POKENAME藏在大原木里，吃掉前来打扰的小虫。若原木被毁，它就会在森林里横冲直撞，直到找到另一根合适的。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hide inside large logs, feeding on any small insects that try to disturb it. If its log is ever destroyed, it will rampage through the forest until it finds another suitable log.

entry: POKENAME有自己的无声语言，能彼此交流。毛皮上的环纹夜里会发光，一连串闪光各有含义，组合起来就能传达复杂信息。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME have the ability to communicate silently amongst one another through a language of their own. The ring around their fur can radiate light during the night; a series of flashes can have its own meaning, creating complex messages when strung.

entry: POKENAME有自己的无声语言，能彼此交流。毛皮上的环纹夜里会发光，一连串闪光各有含义，组合起来就能传达复杂信息。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME have the ability to communicate silently amongst one another through a language of their own. The ring around their fur can radiate light during the night; a series of flashes can have its own meaning, creating complex messages when strung.

entry: 它们的羽毛和毛皮都柔软亮泽。会从树顶采集树果，再把食物囤在高处，免得被其他宝可梦找到。
author: .jerden
source: Both their feathers and fur are soft and glossy. They gather berries from the tops of trees, then hoard food in high places to prevent other Pokémon from finding it.

entry: POKENAME的爪子能脱落，投向对手作武器，之后慢慢再生。有人认为，古时的手里剑可能就是由此得到启发。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's claws can be detached and used as throwing projectiles against opponents, as they regenerate over time. It's thought that this might have inspired the creation of shuriken in the past.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉惊人。雪崩发生后，人们会请它寻找被困在雪下的人。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME have an incredible sense of smell. When avalanches hit, they are used to locate people trapped under snow.

entry: POKENAME只凭气味指引，就能飘过茂密森林。鼻子能闻到一英里以外结着果实的树。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats through dense forests guided by scent alone. Its nose can detect fruit-bearing trees from over a mile away.

entry: POKENAME极其护着自己的蜂蜜，谁靠得太近，它就凶狠地攻击谁。不过要是打不赢，它便抛些蜂蜜黏慢对方，再逃走。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is very protective of its honey and will fiercely attack anyone who gets too close. However, if it can't win the fight, it will lob some of its honey at the attackers to slow them down before fleeing.

entry: POKENAME会在核心中产生黏稠如蜜的物质，射向敌人。单是冲击就很强，而糖浆般的黏稠质地又常妨碍对手移动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME produces a sticky, honey-like substance in its core, which it can fire as projectiles. The impact is powerful enough on its own, and the syrupy thickness often impedes an opponent's movement.

entry: POKENAME会朝洞穴附近的入侵者发出深沉低吼，不过多半只是虚张声势。若对方继续靠近，它就会慌张地钻地躲起来。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME growls deeply at intruders near its cave, though it's mostly for show. If approached further, it panics and burrows out of sight.

entry: POKENAME采食的树果会影响毒刺分泌蜂蜜的风味。它会闯进营地偷食，但陌生食物会扰乱敏感肠胃，妨碍产蜜。
author: pjporwoll
source: The kind of berries POKENAME forages impacts the flavor of the honey it excretes from its stinger. It will break into campsites to steal food, but the unfamiliar food disrupts its sensitive stomach, thus hampering its honey production.

entry: POKENAME睡在富矿山脉的地下深处，鼾声隆隆，响彻洞窟。偶尔浮上地面，推倒树木，寻找蜂蜜和树果补充食谱，随后又回去冬眠。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME slumbers deep beneath mineral-rich mountains, its rumbling snores echoing throughout the caverns. It occasionally surfaces, knocking over trees in search of honey and berries to supplement its diet, before returning to hibernation.

entry: POKENAME住在山里，会用爪子偷登山男的食物，把背包和野餐篮拖回洞穴，翻找吃的。
author: .izik
source: Living in the mountains, POKENAME uses its claws to steal food from Hikers. It hauls backpacks and picnic baskets to its cave to raid for meals.

entry: POKENAME比普通熊宝宝更好斗，多半独居，自力更生。不过它很保护熊宝宝，只要有东西威胁它们，就会毫不犹豫地凶狠挥爪。
author: sk372
source: More aggressive than the average Teddiursa, POKENAME tend to live more solitary lives fending for themselves. They are protective of Teddiursa however, and won't hesitate to claw viciously at anything that threatens them.

entry: 有POKENAME居住的林区，冬季会封闭。它虽然很难从冬眠中被吵醒，但若提前醒来，脾气就会凶得可怕。
author: chibitales
source: Forest areas where POKENAME are known to reside are closed off during the winter months. While these Pokémon are hard to wake from hibernation, they are ferociously cranky when woken up early.

entry: POKENAME的身体完全由壳分泌的蜂蜜构成。它会借黏性身体爬上墙壁和树木，躲避想吃掉自己的熊宝宝。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's body is made entirely out of honey, which their shells secrete. Using their sticky bodies, they climb up walls and trees to get away from Teddiursa trying to eat them.

entry: POKENAME生活在高山地区，常在森林上空翱翔，寻找蜂巢取蜜。它会用利爪抢走蜂巢，赶在蜂群攻击前飞离，再到安全距离摔开享用。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in alpine regions, soaring over forests in search of hives to gather honey from. They use their talons to snatch hives before they can be attacked, flying off with them and then dropping them at a safe distance to smash them open.

entry: POKENAME虽然不用冬眠，却喜欢白天大多都睡着。白昼里醒着的几个小时，它会撞树，震落树果。
author: quackquackattack
source: Even though POKENAME do not need to hibernate, they enjoy sleeping throughout most of the day. During the few hours of daylight that they are awake, they slam their bodies against trees to knock down berries.

entry: POKENAME的毛皮极厚，能抵御严寒，因此不必冬眠。人们常见它用头撞树，震落树果来吃。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME does not need to hibernate, as its incredibly thick fur protects it from the extreme cold. It can be seen headbutting trees to knock down berries for it to eat.

entry: POKENAME外表粗犷，却喜欢从袋子里拿礼物，分给听话的小朋友。人们发现，它送出的东西都与蜂蜜多少有些关系。
author: sk372
source: Though it has a gruff appearance, POKENAME enjoys sharing gifts from its bag with young children that behave well. It's been noted that all the gifts it hands out are related to honey in some way.

entry: POKENAME身体沉重，难以长途飞行，因此只占据小块领地。被激怒时，它可能从翅膀拔下一根利羽，当投掷武器。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's heavy body makes flying for long distances difficult, so it claims only small patches of territory. If angered, it may pluck one of its sharp feathers from its wings and use it as a throwing weapon.

entry: POKENAME善于攀爬，常沿弯曲树干滚下，加快速度，再借这股冲劲突然追上猎物。
author: .izik
source: An agile climber, POKENAME often rolls down curved trunks to build speed. It uses this momentum to chase down prey in bursts.

entry: POKENAME会躲在洞里，等月光照亮夜晚才外出狩猎。胸前的环纹反射月光，让看见的目标陷入催眠，呆滞得无法防备它的缠绕。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides away in caves until the moonlit night falls and it can hunt. The ring on its chest reflects moonlight and casts hypnosis on victims who see it, stunning them and leaving them open to be constricted.

entry: POKENAME极其护蛋，谁靠得太近就朝谁低吼。训练家若悉心照顾，它会回报忠诚与亲昵，不过蛋始终排在第一位。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Extremely protective of their eggs, POKENAME growl at anyone who gets too close. If a Trainer takes proper care of an POKENAME, they will be rewarded with loyal affection, but the eggs will remain the POKENAME's priority.

entry: POKENAME爱蜂蜜，却很难爬上树够到蜂巢，因此会不断用头撞树，直到蜂巢落地摔开，再舔流出的蜜。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves honey but struggles to climb up trees to get to the hives. So instead, it will constantly headbutt the tree until the hive falls and cracks open, spilling out honey for it to lick up.

entry: POKENAME通常在枫树附近筑巢，吸食甜树液。它会将一棵树据为领地，努力赶走想偷食的小型宝可梦。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME usually nests near maple trees, feeding on the sweet sap they produce. It will claim a single tree as its territory and try to fight off smaller Pokémon who attempt to steal its food.

entry: POKENAME会在密林中高速奔驰，灵巧地穿过树梢与树下。若觉得某棵树太挡路，就会用翅膀将其推倒。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It rushes through dense forest at high speed, deftly navigating through tree tops and tree bases. If it deems a tree obstructs its path too much, POKENAME uses its wings to topple it.

entry: 满月时，野生POKENAME会格外凶猛，翅膀爆发的火焰足以把敌人烧成灰。若由经验丰富的训练家照料，这时的火力便会缓和，脾气也会平静下来。
author: .izik
source: Wild POKENAME become incredibly ferocious during full moons, unleashing bursts of flame from their wings that can reduce foes to ash. When cared for by an adept Trainer, these abilities soften and their temper calms during these periods.

entry: POKENAME会往蜜罐里混入神秘草药和花朵，酿出拥有各种魔法效果的蜂蜜。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME mixes mystical herbs and flowers into its honey pot, creating honey with various magical effects.

entry: POKENAME几乎一生都在睡觉，靠本能打出强力攻击，驱退危险。它与树枕尾熊十分相像，也引发了关于共同祖先的科学讨论。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends almost the entirety of its life asleep, fending off danger with instinctive strikes that pack a powerful punch. Its resemblance to Komala has sparked some scientific discussion over shared ancestry.

entry: POKENAME厚实的毛皮能抗寒，其他宝可梦不敢出门的恶劣暴风雪中，它也能狩猎。它是凶猛的猎手，能击倒体形两倍于自己的宝可梦。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's thick coat is resistant to the cold, allowing it to hunt during harsh snowstorms when other Pokémon wouldn't dare. It is a vicious predator, taking out Pokémon double its size.

entry: 野生POKENAME主要捕食其他宝可梦，生活在严寒的冬日环境。暴风雪太猛烈时，它会靠出色的嗅觉，找到提前挖好的地下洞穴。
author: bobosmith01
source: A wild POKENAME preys on other Pokémon as a primary food source. It lives in harsh winter conditions; if a blizzard grows too strong, it uses its incredible sense of smell to find the underground den it dug out prior.

entry: 野生POKENAME主要捕食其他宝可梦，生活在严寒的冬日环境。暴风雪太猛烈时，它会靠出色的嗅觉，找到提前挖好的地下洞穴。
author: bobosmith01
source: A wild POKENAME preys on other Pokémon as a primary food source. It lives in harsh winter conditions; if a blizzard grows too strong, it uses its incredible sense of smell to find the underground den it dug out prior.

entry: 看见POKENAME蜷成球，别以为它只在防守。它会高速滚撞对手，用庞大身体和利刺切割、碾压对方。
author: sk372
source: If you see an POKENAME curl into a ball, do not assume it has gone on the defensive; it rolls into opponents at high speeds to cut and crush them with its bulk and sharp spines.

entry: 一般不建议靠近野生POKENAME。虽然看起来害羞胆怯，但一旦觉得被挑衅，就会用超自然力量攻击。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is generally recommended to not approach wild POKENAME. While they appear shy and timid, if they feel provoked, they will attack by using supernatural powers.

entry: 它们很自豪于自己丰厚柔美的皮毛。但为了保护幼崽，哪怕弄得满身脏污也毫不犹豫。
author: quote.lass
source: They take great pride in their plush, luxurious coats, but will not hesitate to get dirty to protect their young.

entry: POKENAME会藏在森林里，用蜂蜜般的香气引宝可梦靠近。对方一走得太近，它就会站起来，朝头上猛拍。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME hide in forests, luring Pokémon closer with their honey-like scent. When Pokémon get too close, POKENAME rises up to smack them upside the head.

entry: POKENAME会藏在森林里，用草莓般的香气引宝可梦靠近。对方一走得太近，它就会站起来，朝头上猛拍。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME hide in forests, luring Pokémon closer with their strawberry-like scent. When Pokémon get too close, POKENAME rises up to smack them upside the head.

entry: 满月下，POKENAME的波导力量会大幅增强，感知猎物的范围比平时远出好几英里。发现蜂巢后，它会用波导将其蒸发，只留蜂蜜来舔食。
author: soup1900
source: When exposed to a full moon, POKENAME's aura powers become much stronger, allowing it to sense prey miles farther than it normally can. When it finds a beehive, it uses aura to vaporize it, leaving only the honey behind to be licked up.

entry: POKENAME会用翅膀砍树，轻松取到树果。若有小偷偷走领地里的果子，它就会以音速飞行，毫不留情地追赶。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME cut down trees with its wings to easily access the berries in them. It will fly at sonic speeds to mercilessly chase down thieves who steal berries from its territory.

entry: 都市传说警告，夜里别深入森林，否则可能撞上POKENAME。故事里说，看见它娇小的身影时，就已经来不及躲开那张从黑暗中扑出的可怕大嘴。
author: sk372
source: Urban legends warn not to go deep into forests at night or you may run afoul of POKENAME. The tales say that if you see its diminutive frame, it's already too late to escape its fearsome maw that lunges from the darkness.

entry: POKENAME不爱被打扰，谁中断它打盹就赶走谁。它在满月时狩猎，藏在树木投下的阴影里。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME do not like being disturbed, chasing away anyone that interrupts its nap. It hunts on full moons, hiding in the shadows cast by the trees.

entry: 关于夜里目击POKENAME，有许多可怕传闻。故事里，受害者看到黑暗中的发光环纹，迷得出了神，全然没察觉幽灵利爪已准备落下……
author: sk372
source: Many a terrifying tale is told about sightings of POKENAME in the night. As the stories go, a victim sees a glowing ring in the dark, becoming so hypnotized by the sight they never see spectral claws ready to descend upon them...

entry: 古籍记载，POKENAME暴怒时会长出1000只爪。不过，现代记录从未证实这些可怕的描述。
author: .izik
source: Ancient tomes describe POKENAME as growing 1,000 paws when enraged. No modern record has confirmed these terrifying accounts.

entry: POKENAME背上的景观映照着故乡的风貌。血月期间，它会发生诡异变化，背上的景观也变得阴森，宛如闹鬼。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The landscape carried on the backs of POKENAME reflects that of their home. During blood moons they undergo an eerie transformation, their landscapes taking on a haunted appearance.

entry: POKENAME背上的景观映照着故乡的风貌。血月期间，它会发生诡异变化，背上的景观也变得阴森，宛如闹鬼。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The landscape carried on the backs of POKENAME reflects that of their home. During blood moons they undergo an eerie transformation, their landscapes taking on a haunted appearance.

entry: POKENAME住在森林深处，每天锻炼身心。一拳就能把树打成两截。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME lives deep in forests, training its mind and body daily. It can snap a tree in half with a single punch.

entry: 据说POKENAME的蜂蜜美味无比，还格外滋补。许多冒险者只为尝上一口，就丢了性命。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME's honey is said to be delicious and incredibly fortifying. Many adventurous souls have died trying to get a taste.

entry: POKENAME是顶级猎手，连体形两倍于自己的宝可梦也能追踪击倒。视力极佳，只要盯上猎物，直到将其打倒都不会跟丢。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is an apex hunter, able to track and take down Pokémon even twice its size. Due to its excellent vision, once its prey is spotted, POKENAME will not lose sight of it until it is taken down.

entry: 这种凶残的宝可梦会猎捕一切无力反抗的对象，尤其是人类儿童。不过，它绝不离开自己划定的领地。
author: fireblade141
source: This vicious Pokémon will hunt down anything that is too weak to fight it off, most notably human children. However, it will never venture outside of whatever domain it has claimed for itself.

entry: POKENAME会用丝带分泌的蜂蜜状物质标记领地。在树干上用这种闪亮的特殊蜜画圆，就代表树归它所有。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses a honey-like secretion from its ribbons to mark territory. Circles drawn on tree trunks using this special sparkling honey indicate the trees have been claimed as POKENAME's.

entry: POKENAME在新月之夜不活动，满月时却强大无比。出色的听觉和嗅觉，让它轻松避开或追踪其他宝可梦。
author: bobosmith01
source: While inactive on nights of a new moon, POKENAME are extremely powerful when the moon is full. Their impressive ability to hear and smell allows them to easily avoid or pursue other Pokémon.

entry: 一队熊宝宝会拉着POKENAME的绳子，免得它被风吹走。它们协调动作，还能让它挥爪劈斩。
author: hophoppip
source: A team of Teddiursa carry POKENAME's strings to keep it from blowing away. The Teddiursa coordinate their movements to make POKENAME slash with its claws.

entry: 据说POKENAME寄宿着对历任主人的全部恶意与怨恨。哪怕只是试图触碰，也会引爆积恨，展现残酷的力量。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is said to host all of the malice and grudges it has had for its past owners. Even trying to touch it will unleash its built-up hatred in a brutal show of power.

entry: 服装店会请POKENAME在上架前洗大量衣服，洗后格外柔软。可惜它只有春夏能工作，秋冬都用来充电。
author: wiz0z
source: Clothing stores use POKENAME to wash massive loads of clothing before putting them on display. These washes make the clothes ultra-soft. Unfortunately, POKENAME are only functional in the spring and summer, spending fall and winter recharging.

entry: POKENAME用厚厚的蜂蜜包裹身体，既能防护，身处其中还会逆转衰老。不过，除它以外的任何对象吃下这种蜜，都会陷入昏迷。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME protects its body in a thick coat of honey. This honey not only protects it from harm, but being encased in this honey reverses aging. However, if anything other than POKENAME eats this honey, they fall into a coma.

entry: POKENAME会在夜里吸收巨量能量，总是在双脚间交替蹦跳嬉戏，连战斗中也不例外。赤道附近等白昼较长的地区，会让它变得迟缓虚弱。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME absorbs extreme amounts of energy during the night. It is always bouncing and frolicking from foot to foot, even in combat. In regions with long daylight hours, such as near the equator, it becomes sluggish and weak.

entry: POKENAME会采集蜂蜜，存进体内食用。若有人或宝可梦威胁它的储蜜，它就会用幽灵般的利爪凶狠攻击。
author: mega_beedrill
source: POKENAME forage and store honey inside their bodies for consumption. When another person or Pokémon threatens their honey stash, they use their ghostly claws to brutally attack.

entry: POKENAME会采集蜂蜜，存进体内食用。两只相遇时，会摇响各自的罐子，想吓走对方。若不奏效，就会毫不留情地攻击。
author: mega_beedrill
source: POKENAME forage and store honey inside their bodies for consumption. When two POKENAME meet, they rattle their jars to scare off the other. If that fails, they attack relentlessly.

entry: 它会用可怕的獠牙劈开树木，让装满蜂蜜的巢摔落，再大快朵颐。领地意识极强，连同类也不容忍，会为争夺地盘与对手恶战。
author: fiordaliso
source: It cleaves through trees with its fearsome tusks, sending honey-filled hives crashing to the ground so it can feast on their contents. Fiercely territorial even toward its own kind, it engages in brutal battles with rivals over control of its domain.

entry: 它很少离开洞穴。只有要用黏稠蜂蜜把身体重新黏合时，才会走出巢穴，随后立刻继续冬眠。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It is rarely seen outside caves. When it emerges from its den, it is only to mend its body together with sticky honey. It resumes its hibernation immediately afterwards.

entry: POKENAME会爬上高树，在树皮上抓下深深的爪痕。月光照耀的夜晚，它对闯入者会更加凶狠。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME climbs high trees to slash claw marks deep into bark. On moonlit nights, it becomes more aggressive toward trespassers.

entry: POKENAME会囤积一切甜食，尤其喜欢蜂蜜。它常偷露营者的补给，也会洗劫偏远住宅的食品储藏室。
author: lucioleuh
source: POKENAME hoards everything sweet, with a preference for honey. It will often steal campers' supplies or plunder the pantries of homes in remote areas.

entry: POKENAME会释放信息素吸引三蜜蜂。等它们在枝上筑巢，就把它们吓走，吃留下的蜂蜜。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME releases pheromones to attract Combee. After they build hives on its branches, it scares them away and consumes the honey they left behind.

entry: POKENAME的力量来自翅膀吸收的阳光。连续晒上一整周太阳后，力气就大得足以击碎山岳。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The power of POKENAME comes from absorbing sunlight into its wings. After a full week of sunbathing, POKENAME is strong enough to break apart mountains.

entry: POKENAME相当胆小，会躲在洞穴和密林中。皮肤会分泌香气浓郁的蜂蜜，吸引三蜜蜂相伴。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are quite timid Pokémon, hiding out in caves and dense forests. They secrete a strong-smelling honey from their skin to attract the company of Combee.

entry: POKENAME虽然力大无穷，性情却温和，对人也很友好。它爱吃甜食，甚至会袭击村庄，抢走点心。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its immense strength, POKENAME is quite a docile Pokémon and is quite friendly towards humans. It loves sugary foods and will even raid villages for their sweet treats.

entry: POKENAME是最适合拥抱的宝可梦，也是可靠的朋友，深受孩子和一些大人喜爱。
author: krune
source: The cuddliest Pokémon that exists, POKENAME is a true friend and is very popular with children and some adults.

entry: POKENAME会用音乐和怡人香气，把小型宝可梦引进体内，再让它们经历可怕幻觉。靠恐惧饱餐近五小时后，才会把它们吐出来。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use music and a pleasant aroma to lure small Pokémon inside them. Once inside, POKENAME subject them to frightening hallucinations, feeding off their fear for nearly five hours before spitting them out.

entry: POKENAME会用歌声安抚蜜蜂，让它们愿意把巢戴到自己头上，再用带魔力的动作控制蜂群，酿出自己想要的所有蜂蜜。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its singing to calm bees and allow their hive to be worn on its head. Then, using its enchanted movements, it controls the bees to create all the honey it wants for its liking.

entry: 秋天，POKENAME会急切地吞食花朵。冬季则在空心倒木里冬眠，用树叶封住两端。
author: .izik
source: In autumn, POKENAME devours flowers with urgency. It hibernates in hollow logs through winter, sealing the ends with leaves.

entry: POKENAME的身体是一大块蜜脾，外面覆着厚毛。产出的蜂蜜被形容为美味绝伦，常用于专业餐厅。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is made of a large block of honeycomb protected by a thick layer of fur. The honey it produces is described to be absolutely delectable and is often used in professional restaurants.

entry: POKENAME会在树皮上啃出深槽，宣示领地，尤其喜欢核桃树。任何入侵者一靠近它的树林，就会遭到头锤攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME chews deep grooves into bark to claim its territory. It favors walnut trees and uses Headbutt on any intruder that nears its grove.

entry: POKENAME头上的假凰梨果散发蜜香，吸引其他宝可梦靠近。一旦果子被碰到，带刺的头冠就会像捕熊夹一样猛地合拢。
author: santon5512
source: The fake Pinap Berry on POKENAME's head gives off a honey scent, attracting other Pokémon toward them. If this berry is touched, their spiked headcrests will snap shut like bear traps.

entry: POKENAME会用火焰攻击威吓守巢的大针蜂，抢夺心爱的蜂蜜。饿了以后尤其好斗易怒，靠近时必须小心。
author: fiordaliso
source: It uses fiery strikes to intimidate Beedrill guarding hives filled with the honey it craves. When hungry, POKENAME becomes especially aggressive and irritable, so it should be approached with caution.

entry: POKENAME的浓密毛皮能在挖掘时挡住泥土，不让它沾身。嗅觉灵敏，能闻到好几英里外埋着的食物。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's dense fur helps keep dirt off them as they dig. Their keen sense of smell lets them smell buried food from miles away.

entry: POKENAME独居，在山间占据大片领地。咆哮声能传出数英里，警告竞争者离开。若有谁无视警告，它便会搜寻对方，宝石闪着愤怒的红光。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are solitary Pokémon that maintain large mountain territories. Their roars are audible for miles, warning away competition. They seek out any transgressor that ignores their warning, their gem gleaming an angry red while they search.

entry: 宝可梦巡护员会追踪POKENAME的种群，向当地登山男通报位置。它会冲向任何闯入山中家园的对象，对疏于防备的旅人十分危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Pokémon Rangers track POKENAME populations and provide updates on their location to Hikers in the area. POKENAME can prove dangerous to unwary travellers as they will charge at anyone encroaching within their mountainous homes.

entry: POKENAME会在森林深处巡逻，保护林中居民。它天性沉稳，绝不先动手，但谁对它或它保护的对象施暴，就会遭到毫不留情的还击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME patrols around deep forests, guarding the denizens within from harm. Stoic by nature, it never makes the first strike, but responds mercilessly to those who would choose violence against it or those it protects.

entry: POKENAME独居在葱郁森林，喜爱蜂蜜，总在洞中大量储藏。厚毛已经适应得让大针蜂和蜂女王很难把它从蜂巢赶走。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a solitary creature that lives in verdant forests. It has a fondness for honey and always keeps a large supply stored in its den. Its thick fur has developed to make it harder for Beedrill or Vespiquen to drive it away from their hives.

entry: POKENAME会在森林深处巡逻，保护林中居民。某些变体格外爱好和平，会替小型宝可梦挡下攻击，一起退到安全处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME patrols around deep forests, guarding the denizens within from harm. Some variations of the species are notably more pacifistic, shielding smaller Pokémon from attacks as they retreat to safety together.

entry: POKENAME带刺的拳头力道极大，一拳就能让疾驶的半挂卡车停下。对手之间会互击胸前圆纹的中心，较量力量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's spiked fists are strong enough to stop a speeding semi-truck in its track with one punch. Rivals will test their strength by punching each other directly in the center of their circular chest patterns.

entry: POKENAME很要求自己显得强壮、沉稳。不过一拿出蜂蜜，这副样子就很容易破功，它实在忍不住开心地大吃甜食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME holds itself to a high standard in appearing strong and stoic. This front is rather easily broken when offered honey, as it can't resist ecstatically gorging on the sweet treat.

entry: 它会沐浴月光，在体内积蓄力量，再通过黄色纹样释放攻击。如果能量用尽，就会进入漫长冬眠，直到下一次满月。
author: deadshields
source: It gathers power within its body by basking under moonlight, then channels it for attacks through its yellow markings. If all its energy is expelled, it enters a long hibernation until the next full moon.

entry: POKENAME会蜷在洞里冬眠，多数人只当它是块巨石。凡是把它弄醒的东西，都会遭到强力爪击的报复，被打得生疼。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hibernates in caves, curling up and appearing as a large boulder to most. Anything that causes it to wake up will suffer powerful and painful claw swipes in retaliation.

entry: POKENAME会保护森林幼崽，抵御偷猎者。凭惊人的力量与速度，它能抱起无助的幼崽，用猛抓或踢击赶走袭击者，再以多数对象都追不上的速度撤离。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME protects young forest Pokémon from poachers. With its tremendous strength and speed, it can scoop up helpless young and fend off attackers with powerful swipes or kicks before retreating faster than most can keep pace.

entry: POKENAME是顽皮的捣蛋鬼，会拿棍子戳蜂巢，想弄到蜂蜜。不过结果往往是被吓得落荒而逃。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are very mischievous troublemakers, using sticks to poke at hives in hopes of getting honey. This often leaves them fleeing in terror, however.

entry: 它会在长着格外美味果实的树上抓下爪痕。有时，三颗头还会争论，这棵树的果实是否好得值得标记。
author: sk372
source: It scratches claw marks into trees that grow particularly flavorful fruit. The three heads will sometimes argue over whether a tree's fruit is worthy enough to be marked.

entry: POKENAME白天大多在洞里睡觉，只有觅食时才醒来。若被什么吵醒，就会暴怒，用岩石身体砸烂面前的一切。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME spends most of the day sleeping in its cave, only waking up to hunt for food. If anything ends up waking it, it will fly into a rage, smashing anything in its path with its rocky body.

entry: POKENAME会用催眠摆锤让整巢大针蜂入睡，再轻松抢走储蜜，不会被蜇。
author: mega_beedrill
source: POKENAME use their hypnotic pendulum to lull hives of Beedrill to sleep. They then can easily raid their stores of honey without being stung.

entry: 当熔岩浇上火山周围绽放的花苞，POKENAME便会诞生。
author: theheroict
source: POKENAME is born when lava pours onto the flower buds that bloom around volcanos.

entry: POKENAME会寻找巨石，熔化后吞食，甚至钻穿山体，只为找到矿物格外丰富的矿石。吃够之后就停止活动，开始硬化成蛹。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME searches for immense rocks to melt and consume, even boring through mountains to find particularly mineral-rich ore. Once it has fed enough, it stops moving to begin hardening into its pupa state.

entry: POKENAME会成群比赛，用棒子把熔融矿石锻造成最令人赞叹的珠宝。它的身体能让金属保持熔融，因此铁匠和金匠常会寻找它。
author: ghostslythe
source: Packs of POKENAME gather in competitions, taking molten ores to forge into the most impressive jewelry with their clubs. Due to their bodies' ability to keep metal molten, blacksmiths and goldsmiths seek them out.

entry: POKENAME走到哪里，都会滴下一团团灼热熔岩。有时熔岩里困着有毒气泡，一被戳破就会爆炸。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME drip blobs of hot lava wherever they go. Sometimes bubbles of toxic gas are trapped in the lava that explode whenever they are popped.

entry: POKENAME是这一进化系中短暂的阶段，此时无法移动、暴露在外，也最脆弱。岩浆身体虽能保护它，但水属性捕食者只要不断喷水，就能让身体结晶成岩石。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is a brief stage in the life cycle of this evolutionary line with it at its most vulnerable as it is immobile and exposed. Its magma body offers protection, but Water-type predators can spray it enough to crystallize its body to rock.

entry: POKENAME会附在灼热的火山表面，吞食熔岩，慢慢爬行。受到攻击时，它会挥出熔融的藤蔓，灼伤敌人。
author: bluenido.
source: POKENAME cling to hot, volcanic surfaces. They feast on lava and move at a sluggish pace. When attacked, they lash out with molten vines to scorch their foes.

entry: POKENAME会结成小群，在岩浆河里游泳。火山喷发时，能看见好几只试图逆流而上，爬过火山口边缘，进入内部。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME swim magma rivers, grouping together in small schools. During eruptions, one can witness several of them attempting to swim up the streams to climb the volcano's rim and enter its insides.

entry: POKENAME散出的热量，让它从山崖跃下时能够缓缓降落。壳里有尚在成形的岩浆翅膀，因此它会不惜一切保护外壳。
author: pjporwoll
source: The heat emanating from POKENAME allows it to gently descend when leaping from mountainous crags. The shell contains magma wings that are still forming, so it protects the shell at all costs.

entry: POKENAME住在火山洞里，借熔融的身体贴住洞壁。眼睛能发射高热光束，威力足以熔穿铅。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in volcanic caves, using its molten body to cling to the cave walls. It can fire a beam of intense heat from its eye powerful enough to melt through lead.

entry: POKENAME的身体由灼热熔岩构成，擦过一下也会严重烧伤。双翼能让它迅速逼近敌人，再用炽热的岩浆镰刀斩击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body is made of searing lava, and even brushing against it can cause severe burns. Its pair of wings allows it to dart close to its foes, which it then slashes with blazing magma scythes.

entry: 它的身体由岩浆构成，很少远离能恢复体力的火山地带。两把镰刀又热又锋利，能将任何障碍劈成两半。
author: fiordaliso
source: Since its body is composed of magma, it rarely strays far from volcanic areas where it can recover its strength. Its two scythes are so scorching and sharp that it can slice any obstacle in half.

entry: 有时能听见POKENAME在超高温岩浆下咆哮。这预示着它即将现身，最好保持距离。
author: mellowmuse
source: Sometimes POKENAME can be heard roaring underneath the surface of superheated magma. It's a sign it will soon emerge, so it's best to keep your distance.

entry: POKENAME住在熔岩附近，用灼热的火山气流梳理身体。它能黏在许多表面，因此有时能见到它倒挂在洞顶打盹。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME lives near lava, grooming its body with hot volcanic air. Its body can stick to many surfaces, so it is sometimes found napping upside-down on the ceilings of caves.

entry: POKENAME的高热局限在自身范围内，周围温度仍然正常。许多人发现，它能安全地熔掉垃圾，不留下残渣或灰烬。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are incredibly hot within a self-contained area, but the surrounding area remains normal. Many people have figured out that POKENAME can safely melt trash without leaving behind residue or ash.

entry: POKENAME靠吞噬各种岩石为生，似乎尤其偏爱硫磺。经常吃硫磺，让它在体内产生一种有毒化学物质，也能使身体保持半固态。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live by subsuming various rocks, though they seem to prefer sulfur. Their frequent consumption of sulfur has led them to produce a poisonous chemical within themselves that also keeps their bodies partly-solid.

entry: POKENAME平时动作缓慢，战斗中却能突然迅疾移动。无定形的身体由极热物质构成，连甩出的小液滴打中，也会严重烧伤。
author: bobosmith01
source: While typically slow-moving, POKENAME can make sudden and swift movements in battle. As its amorphous body is composed of extremely hot material, even getting hit with small flung droplets can cause severe burns.

entry: POKENAME必须经常休息，因此会睡在流动的岩浆或熔岩里，防止身体冷却变硬。醒来后，它会大吃易燃物，饮下岩浆或熔岩。
author: infinex21
source: Due to how often they must rest, POKENAME sleep in flowing magma or lava to keep their bodies from cooling and hardening. When awake, they gorge upon flammable material and drink magma or lava.

entry: POKENAME只在火山正在喷发时出现。即使结束冬眠、出来活动的时间很短，冒出的烟也足以让5平方英里的天空黑上一周。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME only appear for the duration of active volcanic eruptions. Even in the short time they are out of hibernation they create enough smoke to blacken 5 square miles of sky for a week.

entry: 它们的翅膀和臂部毒针由凝实的岩浆构成，靠体内产生的化学物质，才没有完全石化。这种物质对多数其他生物有毒，连某些毒属性宝可梦也不例外。
author: infinex21
source: Their wings and arm-stingers are made of solid magma that has yet to fully turn to stone thanks to the chemical produced within themselves. This chemical is poisonous to most others, even some Poison-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在火山内部休息，吸收熔岩进入体内，使火山休眠。它一醒来，便会紧接着发生突然而猛烈的喷发。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME rests inside of volcanoes, absorbing the lava into its body and rendering the volcanoes dormant. When POKENAME awakens, a sudden and powerful eruption will follow.

entry: POKENAME缓缓浮行，从不远离遍布岩浆的家园。否则身体会冷却凝固，无法动弹，从空中直坠地面。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats around slowly and never ventures far from its magma-laden home. If it did, its body would cool and solidify, immobilizing it and sending it plummeting to the ground.

entry: POKENAME常在火山附近摇摆着行走，必须不断移动，维持体温。若行动被限制，身体就会迅速冷却，长出令人疼痛的黑曜石碎片，必须清除。
author: quackquackattack
source: Often seen waddling around volcanoes, POKENAME need to keep moving to keep their bodies warm. If restrained, their bodies rapidly cool and produce painful obsidian shards on their body that need to be removed.

entry: POKENAME生活在火山地带，会从毒针的小孔分泌熔岩。发现猎物后，它会用钻头刺穿皮肤，注入大量毒液和熔岩。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME lives in volcanic areas and secretes lava through small pores on its stinger. When it finds prey, POKENAME pierces their skin with its drill to flood them with venom and lava.

entry: POKENAME的身体由岩浆构成，飞行时常向下滴落。它会潜入岩浆或熔岩“捕鱼”，也借此防止身体冷却变硬。
author: infinex21
source: Their bodies are made of magma that often drips from them as they fly about. POKENAME dive into magma and lava to "fish" for prey but also to help keep their own bodies from cooling and hardening.

entry: POKENAME成群生活，这样的群体被称为“余烬”。它很少露面，只有火山即将喷发时，才会出现在岩浆房之外。
author: foulz4k
source: POKENAME live in groups called embers. They are rarely seen and are only spotted outside of a volcano's magma chamber when it is about to erupt.

entry: POKENAME体内的热量让身体持续膨胀，因此不停蜕壳。脱下的壳慢慢变红，熔入身下的熔岩，又让温度更高、身体继续膨胀。
author: weirdmageddonprepper_93813
source: The heat from within POKENAME causes its body to constantly expand, resulting in constant molting. The molted shells turn red over time and melt into the lava underneath POKENAME's body, allowing hotter and hotter temperatures and more expansion.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀已足以轻松掀起强风，将滴下的岩浆吹向敌人。爪子热得能熔化某些金属，因此它也常捕食一些钢属性宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: Their wings have developed enough to easily create strong gales that scatter their magmatic drippings at foes. Their talons are hot enough to melt some metals, as shown by how often POKENAME prey upon some Steel-type Pokémon.

entry: 在冰寒地区，POKENAME是友好的公交伙伴，会协助司机把人们送到目的地。它能给车厢保暖，发动机没电时也能帮忙启动。
author: quackquackattack
source: In icy cold regions of the world, POKENAME are friendly bus companions who work alongside drivers to deliver people to their destination. They keep the bus warm and jumpstart the engine when it runs out of electricity.

entry: 只有幼崽热得足以熔穿蛋壳，POKENAME的蛋才会孵化。它爱依偎着其他火宝可梦，将温暖分给伙伴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A POKENAME egg only hatches once the baby within has reached a sufficient temperature to melt through its shell. It loves to cuddle up to other Fire-types, sharing its warmth with its fellow Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME从不睡觉，会不断看见眼前生物与物体可能的未来。据说盯着它的烟、闻着烟气，就能见到它眼中属于自己的未来。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME never sleeps, instead constantly witnessing possible futures of the creatures and objects it looks at. Allegedly, staring into its smoke and smelling its fumes will cause one to witness what it sees in their future.

entry: POKENAME在火山坑或熔岩池里筑巢，身体始终灼热，滴着熔岩。大多时候温顺，被惹恼后却会用岩石般坚硬的爪子和喷出的岩浆球凶猛还击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME nest within volcanic pits or pools of lava, so their bodies are always hot and dripping with lava. They are mostly docile, though when agitated will fight fiercely using their rock-hard talons and by spitting balls of magma at foes.

entry: POKENAME很难休息，因为必须时刻保持足够体温，防止凝固。它会啃煤，既磨利牙齿，也为体内火焰添燃料。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME have a hard time resting because they need to constantly keep their bodies warm enough to avoid solidifying. They gnaw on coal to both sharpen their teeth and fuel the fire in their bodies.

entry: POKENAME会从熔岩附近的森林中长出来。体内温度可达岩浆般灼热，让新手园丁很难照料。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sprout from forests that grow near lava. They reach internal temperatures that are as hot as magma, which make them difficult for new gardeners to handle.

entry: POKENAME适应了极热环境，会分泌凝胶，像出汗一样借蒸发降温。凝胶的比热容远高于水，一滴就能吸收相当于1升水的热量。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Adapted to live in extremely hot conditions, POKENAME produces a gel that evaporates to cool it, similar to sweating. The gel has a much higher specific heat capacity than water, allowing a single drop to absorb as much heat as a litre of water.

entry: POKENAME适应了灼热环境，会分泌凝胶，像出汗一样借蒸发降温。有些运动员会收集这种凝胶，在锻炼时用来调节体温。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Adapted to live in searing conditions, POKENAME produces a gel that evaporates to cool it, similar to sweating. The gel is collected and used by some athletes to regulate body temperature whilst exercising.

entry: POKENAME住在火山内外，定期从熔岩补充熔融的身体。它能借体内积聚的火山气体飞行，多余气体会化作滚滚黑烟排出。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in and around volcanoes, regularly replenishing their molten bodies from the lava. They're able to fly by using volcanic gas buildup within their bodies, the excess belching out of them in black billowing clouds.

entry: POKENAME的獠牙导热极强，面对体内高温仍能保持形状。因此，它的咬击能附带炽烈能量，强得足以撕开金属。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's fangs are extremely heat-conductive, able to retain their structure despite its internal heat. This allows its bites to be amplified with blazing energy, strong enough to rip through metal.

entry: POKENAME温度极高，几乎什么都能熔穿，因此会被用来在金属块上刻字。它们常聚在一起组成信息，有的令人忧惧，有的惹人发笑。
author: jeeveseatsfish_20788
source: POKENAME are incredibly hot Pokémon which can melt through almost anything. Because of this, they are used to engrave letters on metal blocks. They frequently group to form messages which can range from dire to funny.

entry: 森林火灾过后，常能发现POKENAME挂在树上。专家意见不一：究竟是它不怕火，不必逃离，还是原本就是它引发了火灾？
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can often be found hanging from trees in the aftermath of a forest fire. Experts are divided on whether they are present because they can survive the blaze without needing to flee, or if they are the cause of the fire in the first place.

entry: 人们推测，POKENAME核心的温度能与地球上某些已知最炽热的物质相媲美。热力过强，随着年龄增长，它会从内而外慢慢熔解自己。
author: camtft
source: The core of POKENAME is presumed to rival some of the hottest known substances on the planet. It is so potent that POKENAME is slowly dissolving itself from the inside out as it ages.

entry: POKENAME会用尾巴挖沟，改变火山岩浆的流向。它努力将岩浆汇成一大片隔绝的池子，供众多同类安宁地聚集。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its tail to dig troughs to alter the direction that volcanic magma will flow. It works to eventually form a large isolated magma pool at which many of its kind can congregate together in peace.

entry: POKENAME会把废弃采矿设备熔成金属浆，再吸食液体，将金属融入身体。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME devour abandoned mining equipment by melting the metal into a slurry. They then slurp the metallic liquid, which gets incorporated into their body.

entry: POKENAME会在火山洞口附近聚成喧闹的鸟群，啄咬新鲜木头和树苗，等烧起来后再吃掉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers in noisy flocks near volcanic cave mouths. It pecks at fresh wood and saplings, consuming them after they catch fire.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀不用于飞行，而是产生热量，调节体温。离开火山家园后，它必须不停加热自己，否则身体冷却后就会硬化变脆。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wings are not used for flying, but generating warmth to regulate its body temperature. Outside of its volcanic home, it must heat itself constantly, or its body would harden and become brittle as it cools.

entry: POKENAME的毛皮始终暖烘烘的。不过抱得太紧，可能滴下一点熔岩，灼伤皮肤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fur stays toasty at all times. If hugged too tightly, it may drip a single bit of lava that can scorch the skin.

entry: POKENAME体温太高，很难维持完整稳定的体形。身体的二氧化硅含量极低，能在地面快速流动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have trouble maintaining a cohesive body shape due to the intense heat of their bodies. Their bodies have a very low silica content, enabling them to flow rapidly across the ground.

entry: POKENAME身体热得厉害，外壳根本来不及冷却成岩石。虽然因此更易受攻击，却也能穿过原本钻不过的小缝隙。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body burns so hot that its shell has no time to cool into rock. While this does mean it is more vulnerable to attacks, it also allows POKENAME to move through small gaps it otherwise couldn't have.

entry: 换羽季，POKENAME外出捕猎会成为山火隐患，因为岩浆羽毛落地就会燃烧。每年，宝可梦巡护员和杰尼龟都会在巢区周围做好准备。
author: pjporwoll
source: When out hunting, POKENAME is a wildfire threat during molting season as its magmatic feathers fall to the ground and catch fire immediately. Teams of Pokémon Rangers and Squirtle prepare around its nesting grounds each year.

entry: POKENAME不停寻找食物，让体温在冷热间变换。只要停下，身体就会立即冷却变硬，鲜嫩的肉也得以保存，正适合作为上等食材。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME never stops in its pursuit for food to oscillate its temperatures between hot and cold. If it stops at any moment, its body would immediately harden and cool, its succulent and preserved meat ripe for fine dining.

entry: POKENAME厚实、羊毛般的毛皮能抵御极端温度的侵害。它对声音敏感，在猛烈暴风雪或酷热中，耳朵都有破裂的危险。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME's thick, woolly, furry body gives it great protection against the ravages of extreme temperatures. It is sensitive to sound, and its ears are at risk of rupturing during an intense snowstorm or sweltering heat.

entry: POKENAME竟能在天空飞行，降落时也不至于每次都摔落坠毁。翅膀不断脱落的部分，会化作一团团灼热熔岩落向地面。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME miraculously fly through the sky without crash-landing each time they descend. They constantly shed parts of their wings, which fall down to the ground as blobs of hot lava.

entry: POKENAME不停钻行于火山岩中，免得半液态身体冷却成岩石。尾尖已经部分硬化，它们会摇出响声，彼此交流。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are always on the move, burrowing through volcanic rock so that their semiliquid bodies don't cool and turn to rock. The tips of their tails have partly hardened and are now used to communicate with each other by the rattle noises they make.

entry: POKENAME会趴下来，沿火山和山坡流下，收集泥石碎屑，直接吸收进体内。随后慢慢爬回高处，一遍遍重复。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME flops down and oozes down volcanoes and mountainsides to collect earthy debris, which it directly absorbs into its body. It will then slowly travel back up, and repeat this process over and over again.

entry: POKENAME会趴下来，沿火山和山坡流下，收集泥石碎屑，直接吸收进体内。随后慢慢爬回高处，一遍遍重复。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME flops down and oozes down volcanoes and mountainsides to collect earthy debris, which it directly absorbs into its body. It will then slowly travel back up, and repeat this process over and over again.

entry: POKENAME会蜷着不动，静静形成石质外层保护。使出滚动时，岩块和熔岩便会四处飞溅。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME rests curled-up and unmoving to allow itself to create a stony outer layer of protection. When it uses Rollout, chunks of rock and lava fly everywhere.

entry: POKENAME会伪装成广告，想出售自己黏糊糊身体的一部分。买家对买的东西所知不多，收到邮寄来的身体碎块时，常十分不满。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME disguise themselves as advertisements in an attempt to sell part of their gooey bodies. Buyers have few details about what they are buying, leading many to become upset when they receive a part of POKENAME in the mail.

entry: 它会用自己身体的岩浆作画。虽然能画得很美，每幅却都是橙色，而且冷却后常凝成粗糙的一团。
author: h0bojoe
source: It paints with magma from its own body. Though capable of beautiful art, every piece is orange and often hardens into a rough mess once cooled.

entry: POKENAME平衡感差，移动时常跌倒，失去形状，几乎只剩一滩岩浆。得花上几分钟，才能重新站稳，恢复正常模样。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's lack of balance causes it to often fall over as it moves and lose its shape, becoming little more than a pool of magma. It takes several minutes for it to right itself and regain its normal form.

entry: 即使睡觉，它们的身体也不停移动，免得冷却变硬。躯干上脸状花纹的眼部能局部燃起紫火，威吓对手和猎物。
author: infinex21
source: Even when these Pokémon sleep, their bodies are constantly moving so that they do not cool and harden. They eyes of the face-like pattern on their torsos can partly ignite in purple fire to intimidate their opponents and their prey.

entry: POKENAME头上的发光圆球持续放热。它会竭力躲雨，因为滋滋声可能惊动捕食者。
author: .izik
source: The glowing spheres on POKENAME's head emit constant heat. It avoids rain at all costs, as the sizzle can alert predators.

entry: 它们岩浆般的身体极热，却远远不及真正岩浆的温度。许多训练家会借它烹饪，条件是做好后要分它一份。
author: infinex21
source: Their magma-like bodies are incredibly hot, though nowhere near as hot as magma. Many Trainers use their bodies to help cook foods, on the condition that they share the food with them.

entry: POKENAME藏在熔岩池深处，很少露面。不断生长的熔融藤蔓会定期脱落，硬化成岩石般的化石，被爱冒险的收藏者视为珍贵战利品。
author: bluenido.
source: Hiding deep inside lava pools, POKENAME are seldom seen. Their ever-growing molten vines shed periodically, hardening into rock-like fossils that adventurous collectors prize as valuable trophies.

entry: 穿过POKENAME的领地可能很危险。为免身体冷却干涸，它会从一个熔岩池滚向另一个，完全不顾沿途有什么挡着。
author: sk372
source: Traveling through POKENAME territory can be a risky endeavor: it rolls from one lava pool to another in order to avoid its body cooling down and drying up, paying no heed to anything that might be in its path as it does so.

entry: POKENAME的液态身体能轻松钻进电脑通风口，慢慢吸取数据。此时身体会变得格外凉爽并硬化，确保电脑不因它而过热。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's liquid body can easily work its way into computer vents, slowly absorbing data from the machine. During this time, its body stays incredibly cool and hardens, ensuring the system does not overheat from its presence.

entry: POKENAME很喜欢玉米，会开心地一口口吞下。若喂爆米花玉米粒，一次只能给几颗，因为还没来得及咽下，就可能在嘴里爆开。
author: regulavish
source: POKENAME has a fondness for corn and will gleefully gobble it down by the mouthful. If you feed it popcorn kernels, do so with only a few at a time, as they might pop in its mouth before it's had a chance to swallow.

entry: 一小群POKENAME会聚在一起玩，轮流看对方蜷成球、跳入熔岩池。谁能溅起最大的一片熔岩，谁就获胜。
author: sk372
source: For fun, small groups of POKENAME will gather together and watch each other curl into balls and leap into lava pools. The one who makes the biggest splash when diving is the victor.

entry: POKENAME能缩进壳里，在战场上胡乱滚动，喷出熔岩，让敌人晕头转向。一察觉破绽，它就会跃向对手，猛烈劈斩。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME can curl up into its shell and roll wildly around the battlefield, letting loose jets of lava to disorient its enemies.  Then, when it senses an opening, it will leap at an opponent with intense slashes.

entry: POKENAME十分黏人，喜欢紧靠训练家为其取暖。不知为何，它的身体在寒冷中也不会变硬。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very clingy and love to keep close to their Trainer to keep them warm. Somehow their bodies never harden in the cold.

entry: POKENAME会先把有毒植物烧成灰，再吃下去。受到威胁时，吃下的灰烬会为身体冒出的毒刺提供力量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME consumes poisonous plants, reducing them to ash before feeding. When threatened, venomous spines erupt from its body, fueled by the ash it consumes.

entry: POKENAME虽然没有多少工厂经验，却很想取悦其他对象，因此能迅速掌握高效工作所需的技能。它既能焊接金属，也能将金属弯成曲面。
author: quackquackattack
source: While POKENAME may be inexperienced with factory work, their deep desire to please others allows them to quickly develop the skills needed to work effectively. They are capable of welding metal and bending metal to create curved surfaces.

entry: POKENAME会在工厂工作，耐热身体让它能将金属弯折、焊成所需形状。它勤恳得常一连干很久都不休息，人们必须介入，帮它放松。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME work in factories where their heat-resistant bodies allow them to bend or weld metal into whatever shape is necessary. Their firm industriousness pushes them to work long hours without breaks, so people have to step in to help them relax.

entry: POKENAME会吐熔岩打落树枝，再一边咀嚼一边烧成灰。它们会合作收集灰烬，筑坝拦河。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits lava to knock branches from trees, then chews and burns them into ash. It teams up with others to gather the ash and dam rivers.

entry: POKENAME靠吸收活火山地区的熔岩和烟灰维生。吸得越多，核心能释放出的烟雾与岩浆漩涡就越庞大、越强劲。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sustains itself by absorbing lava and soot from active volcano areas. The more it soaks up, the larger and stronger the swirling mass of smoke and magma it can project from its core.

entry: POKENAME坚韧的头骨由被体热软化的金属构成。内脏间流动的熔岩，让它看起来像熔化了一样。它似乎并不在意，还常喜欢到炎热的地方晒太阳。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME's tough skull is made of metal softened by the heat of its body. POKENAME's innards have lava flowing in them, causing it to have a melted appearance. It doesn't seem to mind and often enjoys sunbathing in hot places.

entry: POKENAME能察觉即将发生的山火。讽刺的是，火往往就是它引起的，无意中烧掉了自己想警告的森林。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME can detect upcoming wildfires. Ironically, it is often the cause of these wildfires, accidentally burning the forests it tries to warn.

entry: POKENAME住在深层岩浆房里，以产生的火山气体为食。它只在喷发前现身，因此某些人把它视为死亡与苦难的象征。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in deep magma chambers, feeding on the volcanic gases they produce. It is seen as a symbol of death and suffering amongst certain people, as it only appears to them before a volcanic eruption.

entry: 若看见POKENAME从熔岩池里升起，最好找地方躲避。它浮上来是为了从喷口排出多余熔岩，飞溅四周，会烧伤周围一切。
author: sk372
source: One should take cover should it spot a POKENAME rising up from a lava pool. It surfaces to vent excess lava from its spout, which sprays all about and will burn anything in the surrounding area.

entry: POKENAME走过后会留下一滩滩熔融岩浆，靠近时必须格外小心。愤怒时，它会从壳上凸出的岩石喷出阵阵浓黑烟。
author: fiordaliso
source: As it walks, POKENAME leaves behind pools of molten magma, so it must be approached with extreme caution. When angered, it releases bursts of thick black smoke from the rock protruding from its shell.

entry: POKENAME角上喷出的火焰足以熔化板岩。除非被逼入绝境，否则很少动用这股力量。
author: .izik
source: Flames shoot from POKENAME's horn with enough force to melt slate. It rarely uses this power unless cornered.

entry: POKENAME的身体几乎全是高热岩浆，因此一拳就可能致命。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME's body is comprised almost entirely of hot magma. Due to this, one punch from it could be lethal.

entry: POKENAME的身体由不会凝固的铁水构成。它静伏熔岩之中，只让缎带露出表面，等待挑战者。
