author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's body is made of molten iron that doesn't solidify. It lies dormant in lava with only its ribbon above the surface, waiting for a challenge.

entry: POKENAME爱啃树当食物，过程中常会把树点着。有些地方会饲养它，在森林过密时进行受控烧除。
author: victor9106
source: POKENAME loves gnawing on trees for food, often setting them on fire in the process. They are kept in certain areas to start controlled burns when forests grow too thick.

entry: POKENAME伪装成其他宝可梦时，熔融身体散发的高热往往会露馅。幻象也藏不住热量，因此它通常假扮其他火属性宝可梦。
author: .jerden
source: When POKENAME disguises itself as another Pokémon, the usual giveaway is the intense heat that radiates from its molten body. POKENAME is unable to hide this with illusion, and so usually pretends to be other Fire-type Pokémon.

entry: 山火中，POKENAME会从耳朵释放安抚的气场，让周围对象平静。可惜，这种松懈常招来致命后果。
author: .izik
source: During wildfires, POKENAME releases a calming aura from its ears that soothes anyone nearby. Unfortunately this complacency frequently leads to fatal results.

entry: 与其他对象对峙时，POKENAME会从岩浆坑里缓缓升起，靠凶相吓退大多数对手。它虽力大，行动却慢，限制了真正动武威胁对方的能力。
author: sk372
source: When confronting others, POKENAME rises slowly from magma pits, relying on its intimidating appearance to scare off most opposition. Though it possesses great strength, its movements are slow, hindering its ability to physically threaten others.

entry: POKENAME发怒时能造成严重干旱，最长持续一周。传说它体温极高，只需碰一下，就能熔化巨大的冰山。
author: agostostino
source: When POKENAME gets angry, it can create powerful droughts that last up to a week. Legends say that POKENAME's body temperature is so high that it can melt gigantic icebergs with a touch.

entry: 为了避免岩浆身体在夜里冷却变硬，野生POKENAME会在其他对象的梦中休息，直到日出。若在梦里被招惹，就会把梦变成噩梦。
author: h0bojoe
source: To avoid having its magma body cool and harden overnight, wild POKENAME rests in others' dreams until sunrise. If it is ever provoked in the dream, it will turn it into a nightmare.

entry: POKENAME的身体由未知物质构成，碰到的一切都会被熔化，连梦也不例外。侵入梦境时若被招惹，它便会将其变成噩梦。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME's body is comprised of an unknown substance that melts anything it touches, including dreams. If it is ever provoked while invading a dream, it will turn it into a nightmare.

entry: 据说POKENAME体内热量太高，连身体也开始液化，才有了熔融的模样。它住在火山洞穴深处，只在心怀真正烈火般热忱的对象面前现身。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's molten body is said to be the result of its internal heat burning so hot that its body has begun to liquefy. It resides deep within volcanic caverns and only appears before those with truly fiery souls.

entry: POKENAME会聚在破火山口里，靠岩浆的热量保持熔融。察觉月亮来到头顶时，它们便一起跳舞，即使看不见，也能追随月亮划过天空的轨迹。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME gather within the calderas of volcanoes, relying on the heat from the magma to keep themselves molten. They dance together when they sense the moon overhead, tracking its progress through the sky without ever seeing it.

entry: POKENAME大多时候都喜欢泡在岩浆里。岩浆浴不只能够治愈一切伤口，也方便顽皮的它突然跳出来，吓路人一跳。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME prefers to spend most of its time submerged in magma. Not only can a magma bath restore any wounds, but it also allows the mischievous POKENAME to leap up and surprise passers-by.

entry: POKENAME会聚在破火山口里，靠岩浆的热量保持熔融。察觉月亮来到头顶时，它们便一起跳舞，即使看不见，也能追随月亮划过天空的轨迹。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME gather within the calderas of volcanoes, relying on the heat from the magma to keep themselves molten. They dance together when they sense the moon overhead, tracking its progress through the sky without ever seeing it.

entry: 熔岩外层能防止盗墓者偷走它体内的宝藏。不过许多人怀疑，它守着的东西恐怕早已被高热熔化。
author: h0bojoe
source: Its lava coating prevents graverobbers from stealing the treasures inside its body. However, many doubt whether whatever it's guarding hasn't already melted from the intense heat.

entry: POKENAME会用尾巴形成熔岩球，战斗时自由操纵。尾巴随年龄增长越来越热，等到准备进化，就会硬化。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME form balls of lava out of their tails, freely controlling them in battle. Their tails grow hotter and hotter as they age, eventually hardening over once they are ready to evolve.

entry: POKENAME飘过火山隧道时，会叮当作响。熔滴从身体落下，留下一路发亮的焦痕。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME jingles as it floats through volcanic tunnels. Molten drops fall from its body, leaving behind glowing scorch trails.

entry: POKENAME羽毛上覆盖着岩浆般的黏液，让它能随意点燃全身。这种适应既有利战斗，也能让它飞行时不被自身火焰灼伤。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME's feathers are covered in a magma-like slime that allows it to ignite itself at will. This unique adaptation not only aids in battling but also protects it from burns during flight.

entry: POKENAME眼上常糊着熔岩团，视线不清。它走到哪里都滴熔岩，训练家会赶快用水浇灭，以防山火。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often has blobs of lava over its eyes, which makes seeing difficult. It drips lava wherever it goes, which Trainers quickly douse with water to prevent forest fires.

entry: POKENAME多年不为人知，直到地震学家在活火山岩浆房中探测到异常活动。研究人员送入专用探测器，才发现成群的它们正以家庭为单位，在岩浆里划行。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME remained undiscovered for many years until seismologists detected unusual movement within the magma chambers of active volcanos. Specialist probes were sent inside and discovered families of POKENAME paddling through the magma.

entry: POKENAME虚弱倦怠，常懒散地待在岩浆池附近。白天只勉强动到足以维持身体的程度，免得干涸后完全动弹不得。
author: sk372
source: A weak and lethargic creature often seen lazing about near magma pools. POKENAME only moves enough during the day to keep its body from drying out and becoming completely immobile.

entry: 它住在火山地区，以煤与火山岩为食。急需补充能量时，还会吞下木头作为燃料。
author: melodydelune
source: Living in volcanic areas, its diet is composed of coal and volcanic rocks. If it desperately needs a recharge, it will consume wood to fuel itself.

entry: 它几乎找到什么就吃什么，连煤、岩石和木头也不例外。吃下的杂物越多，身体就越热。
author: larky_
source: It eats nearly anything it can find, including coal, rocks, and wood. The more debris it consumes, the hotter its body becomes.

entry: POKENAME只栖息在火山地区，多见于熔岩池旁。熔岩队曾研究它，试图开发新的地热能源。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are only found in volcanic regions, mostly being observed close to lava pools. Team Magma has been known to study POKENAME in an attempt to develop a new geothermal energy source.

entry: POKENAME站着不动时，会将翅膀贴着身体快速振动，产生热量，保持温暖，免得冷却后开始变硬。
author: sk372
source: When standing still, POKENAME vibrates its wings rapidly against its body. The wings generate heat and keep its body warm, so it doesn't cool down and begin to harden.

entry: POKENAME是乡村常见的宠物，温暖身体能给炉灶加热，很受欢迎。遇见陌生人时却很害羞，会熔化身体，钻进附近缝隙躲藏。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are common pets in rural areas, popular for their ability to heat stoves with their warm bodies. They are quite shy around strangers, so they melt to fit any nearby crevice to hide themselves.

entry: POKENAME常被自己产生的熔岩吓到。在它平静下来之前，周围的一切都会遭到焚烧。
author: mistershaokahn
source: POKENAME is often frightened by the lava it itself produces. When this happens, all its surroundings are burned until it has calmed down.

entry: POKENAME会吸满空气，再用装有岩浆的特殊器官加热，让身体浮起。吸气能上升，排气则下降，借此控制高度。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME fills its body with air, then heats that air with a specialized magma-filled organ. This allows POKENAME to float, and it controls its altitude by either taking in air to rise or expelling air to descend.

entry: POKENAME被高热吸引，会成大群住在火山内部。若看见整群同时飞出火山，就代表喷发即将来临。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are known to reside in large groups within volcanoes, attracted to the intense heat. If one sees a flock of POKENAME flying out of a volcano all at once, it's a sign an eruption is about to occur.

entry: POKENAME紧握面具，视若珍宝。人们认为，一旦失去面具，熔岩般的身体就会失去凝聚力，化作一滩没有生命的岩浆。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME holds tight to its mask, treating it as a precious treasure. It's believed that if it lost its mask, its lava-like body would lose cohesion and melt into a puddle of lifeless magma.

entry: POKENAME常骚扰前往釜炎镇的登山男。被咬后会起疼痛的水疱，还会痛苦地发炎。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are known to plague Hikers who travel to Lavaridge Town. Their bites create painful blisters and cause painful inflammation.

entry: 有些学者认为，POKENAME是很久以前在火山灾难中遗失的古代造物残骸。熔融核心吸收热量，让残破的外壳仍能存活、移动。
author: white_cinnamon50
source: Some scholars believe POKENAME are what remains of ancient constructs lost to volcanic disasters long ago. Its molten core draws in heat, keeping the ruined shell alive and able to move.

entry: POKENAME会俯冲向落叶，在飞行中将其点燃，练习捕猎。火焰虽小，每成功扑击一次，就亮上几分，渐露未来空中猎手的潜力。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME practices hunting by diving at fallen leaves, igniting them mid-flight. Though its flames are small, they grow brighter with every successful strike, showcasing its potential as a future aerial predator.

entry: POKENAME会在活火山里筑巢，借高温孵蛋、养育幼崽。科学家把这样一群火热的宝可梦，称为“一阵热潮”。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME is known for nesting inside active volcanoes, using the intense heat to incubate its eggs and raise young. Scientists refer to a group of these fiery Pokémon as a 'Hot Flash'.

entry: 熔岩在POKENAME体内流动，一接触外界便汩汩冒泡。离开栖息地后，POKENAME会凝成密实的外壳，模样近似另一地区的泥巴鱼。
author: teatedtiten
source: POKENAME's lava courses through its system, bubbling up when exposed to the elements. When out of its habitat, POKENAME hardens into a dense shell similar to a Stunfisk of another region.

entry: POKENAME以快得看不清的速度掠过大地，身后留下一路火焰与熔岩。一旦停下，身体就会冷却，硬化成岩石。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME zooms across the land at blinding speeds, leaving a trail of fire and melted rock in its wake. If it stops moving, it will cool down and harden into rock.

entry: 绚烂的晶体云环绕全身。碰上一颗，就会冷得仿佛被灼烧。
author: melodydelune
source: Dazzling clouds of crystals surround its body. Touching one of these crystals leaves one with a chill so cold it burns.

entry: POKENAME常出没于仍然活跃的火山附近，科学家尚不清楚原因。它在空中优雅起舞时，构成身体的熔岩滴会溅向四面八方。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME tends to haunt areas near still-active volcanoes, though scientists have yet to understand why. When it dances gracefully in midair, droplets of the molten lava that forms its body can splash in every direction.

entry: POKENAME会附身于焦黑森林里的树桩。待得太久，树桩可能起火，闷烧好几天。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME possesses tree stumps in scorched forests. If it stays inside too long, the stump may catch fire and smolder for days.

entry: POKENAME能控制岩浆流向，会试着将其引开，保护火山地区附近的森林。但若扎根太久，自身的岩浆也会硬化成石头。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME can exert control over the flow of magma, which it uses to try to protect forests near volcanic regions by diverting it. Its magma will harden into solid stone if it takes root for too long.

entry: POKENAME覆着结实而柔韧的膜，无论环境怎样，都能维持完整的形态。因此，熔岩般的身体物质也不容易流失。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's body is covered in a tough yet flexible membrane that allows it to persist and keep its form together regardless of its environment. It can't easily lose any of its lava-esque mass as a result.

entry: POKENAME覆着结实而柔韧的膜，无论环境怎样，都能维持完整的形态。因此，熔岩般的身体物质也不容易流失。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's body is covered in a tough yet flexible membrane that allows it to persist and keep its form together regardless of its environment. It can't easily lose any of its lava-esque mass as a result.

entry: POKENAME住在海底热泉口，能瞬间抓住过分靠近的海底宝可梦。筑巢后，几乎从不离开原地。
author: bobosmith01
source: It can snatch up undersea Pokémon that come too close to the thermal vents where they live in an instant. POKENAME almost never move from where they make their nest.

entry: POKENAME在火山地区的森林里缓慢爬行，吞食枯叶和树枝，为熔融身体提供燃料，也靠高温抵御其他宝可梦。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME slowly crawls through forests in volcanic regions. It will devour dry leaves and sticks as fuel for its molten body, relying on its high temperature to protect it from other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在熔岩池里嬉戏飞溅，让身体保持熔融。灵敏的鼻子能察觉微量有毒气体，很擅长发现小规模的气体泄漏。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME love to splash around in lava pools, keeping their bodies nice and molten. Their powerful noses are able to detect feint amounts of toxic gases, making them great at finding small gas leaks.

entry: POKENAME在活跃的熔岩流里嬉戏，开心地游过熔岩，再跃出来抖抖身体，甩干自己。地震学家能探测到岩浆流的异常，认为那可能是地下深处的它们。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME frolic within active lava flows, happily swimming through molten rock before bounding out and shaking their bodies to dry off. Seismologists are able to detect abnormalities in magma flows that are thought to be POKENAME deep underground.

entry: POKENAME多见于火山坡上的森林，造成的破坏可能比山火更甚。吸食一棵树时，它会从内部将树烧空，只留焦黑、毫无生气的躯壳。
author: .jerden
source: Most often found in forests growing on the side of volcanoes, POKENAME can cause more damage than wildfires. When they feed on a tree, they burn it up from the inside, leaving only a charred and lifeless husk.

entry: POKENAME不停漏出岩浆，必须经常泡熔岩浴。它会用舌头在领地内的树上留下标记。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME needs constant lava baths because it is constantly leaking magma. POKENAME uses its tongue to mark trees in its territory.

entry: POKENAME常懒散地泡在熔岩池里，从壳上的气孔排出极热气体。战斗时，它会从壳内喷出汹涌的灼热岩浆。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is usually seen lazing around in lava pools, expelling extremely hot gases from the vent on its shell. When in combat, it spews torrents of hot magma from inside its shell.

entry: POKENAME走到哪里都带着葫芦，不知为何，葫芦不会被熔融的身体毁坏。不过，有些宝可梦会误以为里面是温热的好汤，想喝上一口。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME carries its gourd wherever it goes, somehow not being damaged by its molten body. However, some Pokémon mistake it for a nice warm soup and try to drink from it.

entry: POKENAME追随活火山的光，吃新涌出的熔岩。飞行时，滚烫的岩浆沿途滴落，身体便逐渐缩小，直到它再次进食。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are drawn to the light of active volcanoes to feed on the fresh lava they produce. Droplets of hot lava drip off this Pokémon as it flies, slowly reducing their body size until they can feed again.

entry: 火山地区常能见到POKENAME聚在新鲜岩浆里。登山男常会寻找它，相信能得到永恒爱情的祝福。
author: sakuraneko
source: It is a common sight in volcanic areas where POKENAME will congregate in fresh magma. Hikers will often seek them out, believing that it will bless them with an eternal love.

entry: POKENAME体内高热，让额头的黄金护符不断得到精炼。因此，这种精炼黄金是收藏者争相购买的珍品。
author: camtft
source: POKENAMEs high internal heat leads to the gold amulet on their forehead constantly being refined. Due to this, their refined gold is a top commodity for collectors.

entry: POKENAME需要炎热干燥的环境，才能避免偏头痛。为了让它免于头痛，也让它有事可做，人们会请它在蒸汽机旁铲煤。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME require a hot, dry environment to avoid developing migraines. To help them avoid those migraines, and to keep them busy, they help shovel coal on steam engines.

entry: POKENAME沿海底游泳，始终靠近地热喷口。若离得太远，缺少热量，身体就会凝固。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swim along the ocean floor where they remain close to geothermal vents. If they ever stray too far from the vent, their body solidifies from the lack of heat.

entry: POKENAME越愤怒，皮肤温度就越高。暴怒时，岩浆般的身体会沸腾飞溅，甩出的物质会破坏周围环境。
author: houseoffallingflowers
source: As POKENAME's fury builds, so too does the temperature of its skin. At high levels of rage, its magma-like form will bubble and spit, damaging its surroundings with the cast-off material.

entry: POKENAME白天会在破火山口里开心划游，泡着冒泡的熔岩放松。家园开始喷发时，它们便结群离开熔岩，沿火山坡奔逃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend their days happily paddling around within the calderas of volcanoes, relaxing within the bubbling lava. When their volcanic home begins to erupt, packs of POKENAME leave the lava and race down the slopes of their volcano to escape.

entry: POKENAME熔融的身体不断滴下熔岩，留下一路焦痕。翅膀散出高热，让它能在火山上空翱翔，而不至于熔化。
author: segmoph
source: POKENAME's molten body constantly drips lava, leaving scorched paths in its wake. Its wings radiate intense heat, allowing it to soar through volcanic skies without melting.

entry: POKENAME会在火山地形举起熔融巨石锻炼，轻松就能抬起超过一吨。每举一次，身体就更亮一些。
author: .izik
source: In volcanic terrain, POKENAME trains by lifting molten boulders. It can easily lift over a ton, its body glowing brighter with each rep.

entry: POKENAME攻击时，覆满熔岩的身体会形成发光肢体。一拳就能在岩石或钢铁上留下灼痕。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's lava-coated body forms glowing limbs as it strikes. A single punch from it can leave burns on stone or steel.

entry: POKENAME体温超过2000度，却会避免过热，免得石壳熔化。受到威胁时，它会向袭击者投掷熔岩球。
author: mistymagius
source: While its body burns at over 2000 degrees, POKENAME avoids overheating to prevent its rocky shell from melting. When threatened, it hurls balls of molten rock at attackers.

entry: POKENAME会用四肢从洞壁扯下岩石，在核心中熔化，维持体内热量。
author: .izik
source: Using four limbs, POKENAME pulls rocks from cave walls. It melts them down within its core to sustain its internal heat.

entry: POKENAME沿火山山脊奔腾时，鼻子会滴下熔融黏液。经过的地面冒起蒸汽，将周围空气也加热。
author: .izik
source: As it gallops across volcanic ridges, POKENAME drips molten mucus from its nose. The ground steams as it passes, heating the air around it.

entry: POKENAME能用强磁力控制熔融金属。它在熔岩流中漂动时，只有顶上的螺栓露出表面。
author: gnom3
source: POKENAME controls the flow of molten metal using its strong magnetic abilities. It drifts through lava streams with only its top bolt visible above the surface.

entry: POKENAME体热强烈，能让周围保持温暖。它总拿着串有棉花糖的棍子，糖似乎从来不熔化。有人猜那其实是石头，但无人能证实。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have an intense body heat that keeps the area around them warm. POKENAME always carry a stick with a marshmallow that never seems to melt. Some people speculate that the marshmallow is a rock, but no one has been able to confirm this.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛覆着熔融熔岩，飞奔过干燥原野时，会留下一滩滩滚烫的液体。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feathers are coated in molten lava. It leaves behind scorching puddles when dashing across dry fields.

entry: 秋冬，POKENAME会吃柴火、守在壁炉边，为乡村住家取暖。经过训练，它会把烟排进烟囱，让人们免于吸入毒烟。
author: quackquackattack
source: During fall and winter, POKENAME heats up rural homes by eating firewood and resting at the fireplace. It is trained to vent its smoke into chimneys so that people avoid inhaling toxic fumes.

entry: POKENAME会用满含烟雾的吐息毒伤对手，将其削弱。它必须不停吃煤，保持高温，否则就有干涸的危险。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME weakens rival Pokémon by poisoning them with its smog-laden breath. It must constantly feed on coal to keep its body temperature high, or else risk drying out.

entry: POKENAME的身体温度极高，靠与铠甲融为一体的熔融外壳保护。它会用炮管发射灼热岩浆，守卫领地，也能熔穿障碍。
author: segmoph
source: POKENAME's body burns at extreme temperatures, protected by a molten shell fused with armor. It launches searing blasts of magma from its cannons to defend territory and melt through obstacles.

entry: POKENAME住在熔岩池边，吞食熔融岩石。受到威胁时，它会制造熔岩泡，送向捕食者。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME reside near the edge of lava pools, consuming molten rock. When threatened, they will produce bubbles of lava that they will send towards predators.

entry: POKENAME会在背上球茎里储存岩浆，吸取产生的热能滋养自己。即使气候最冷，也能持续供暖，因此常是北极考察的伙伴。
author: secondegg
source: POKENAME stores magma in the bulb on its back, nourishing itself with the thermal energy it produces. This allows it to continually produce warmth even in the coldest climates, making it a common companion during arctic expeditions.

entry: POKENAME的背部已开始硬化，形成保护蛹期的外壳，但在无法动弹之前，仍不停吞食矿石。面对争抢岩石的竞争者，它会大胆凶猛地驱赶。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's back has begun to harden into the shell protecting its pupal stage, but it continues to devour ore in pursuit of more food before it is immobile. It is aggressively bold at chasing off competitors for the rocks it eats.

entry: POKENAME头骨里装着格外不稳定的熔融岩浆。紧张时，岩浆会猛烈爆炸，将滚烫熔岩洒满周围。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cranium is filled with a particularly volatile batch of molten magma. Should it become stressed, the magma reacts with an explosive burst that spreads searing lava all over the immediate vicinity.

entry: POKENAME体内有个巨大的气囊。包裹气囊的熔岩表层十分脆弱，容易破裂并猛烈爆炸。
author: jaycielantern
source: POKENAME has a large air pocket inside it. The surface tension of the lava that surrounds it is fragile, and is prone to burst with explosive results.

entry: 它会吸收太阳的热量。晴朗明亮的日子里，几颗头会胀大，火力和精神力量一并增强；雨天火焰减弱，头也会缩成平时的一小部分。
author: imaginita
source: It absorbs heat from the sun. On bright, sunny days, the heads grow in size, increasing their firepower and psychic strength. On rainy days, the flames will die down, and the heads shrink to a fraction of their normal size.

entry: POKENAME哭泣时，脸上灼热的头骨状部分会硬化。它常在开战时这样做，强化防护。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME cries, the hot skull-like portion of its face hardens. It often does this at the start of battle to fortify itself.

entry: POKENAME踢出能熔化金属的火焰踢时，熔融的身体会不断滴落，发出嘶嘶声。它热爱训练，总想踢得更快，因此训练过的地方常留下焦痕。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME's molten body drips and sizzles as it delivers flaming kicks that can melt metal. It loves to train, trying to increase the speed of its kicks, often leaving scorch marks wherever it trains.

entry: POKENAME会用熔融的双腿灵活闪避，陷入绝境时，肩上火焰便会猛涨。出拳时它会迅速冷却拳头，形成额外石层，增强威力。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their molten legs to duck and weave around attacks and flare up the fire on their shoulders when cornered. They rapidly cool their fists when they punch, creating additional layers of stone to increase their power.

entry: POKENAME产生的可燃气体不断被点燃，冒出仿佛无穷无尽的烈焰和毒烟。烦躁时，它会一次释放全部气体，爆炸产生的烟足以暂时遮住太阳。
author: secondegg
source: The flammable gases POKENAME produces are constantly being lit, producing seemingly endless plumes of flame and toxic smoke. If agitated, it releases all of its gas at once; the ensuing explosion creates enough smoke to temporarily block out the sun.

entry: POKENAME体外覆着保护性的火山岩，让身体能安全完成蜕变。快准备好进化时，表面会裂开，漏出熔岩和火焰。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is covered in a protective outer coating of volcanic rock, allowing its body to safely undergo the metamorphosis process. Once it is nearly ready to evolve, cracks appear and it leaks lava and flames.

entry: POKENAME身上升起的烟热得危险。长时间接触，会使皮肤起水疱，也会熔化金属。
author: .izik
source: The smoke rising from POKENAME's body is dangerously hot. Prolonged exposure can blister skin and melt metal.

entry: 它们的壳密度太大，常难以移动，只能不停搅动体内岩浆，防止完全硬化。自卫时，会从壳上的众多裂缝使出喷烟。
author: infinex21
source: Their shells are so dense that they often struggle to move, instead churning their bodies of magma inside to keep it from fully hardening. They defend themselves by releasing Lava Plumes from the many cracks along their shells.

entry: POKENAME在深层火山洞穴中漫游，吸食熔岩流。常为领地归属与鸭嘴火兽争斗。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME roam in deep volcanic caves, feeding from lava flows. They often fight with Magmar due to territorial claims.

entry: POKENAME外表虽是硬化火山岩，性情却极其温和。多雪地区常请它给工人充当活暖炉。
author: ambrosia04
source: Despite its exterior being made of hardened volcanic rock, POKENAME is incredibly gentle. It is often employed in snowy regions to act as a living heater for workers.

entry: POKENAME身体大部分是熔岩冷却硬化成的藤蔓。每周都会脱落许多藤蔓，免得身体重得动不了。
author: sk372
source: Much of POKENAME's body is comprised of vines made from cooled lava that hardened. It sheds many of these vines weekly to prevent its body from becoming too heavy to move.

entry: POKENAME石质的育儿袋里装满高营养熔岩，供幼崽进食。使用冷却岩浆刨下的碎屑，已成了一股流行而昂贵的养生风尚。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME's stony pouch is full of high-nutrient lava meant to feed their young. Using shavings from their cooled magma has become a popular and expensive health trend.

entry: POKENAME住在小熔岩池里，用火焰吐息烤熟飞得太近的小虫。发现捕食者时，它改为喷烟掩护，争取足够时间潜回池中。
author: secondegg
source: POKENAME makes its home in small lava pools, using its flame breath to roast small insects that fly too close. If it spots a predator, it spews smoke instead, concealing it for long enough to dive back into its pool.

entry: 壳里有一种水样液体，始终沸腾却永不蒸发，能帮助产生蒸汽，为身体其他部分保温。它能极精准地向对方喷射岩浆团和强力火球。
author: infinex21
source: Within its shell is a special water-like liquid that is always boiling but can never evaporate, which helps produce steam to keep the rest of its body hot. It can shoot globs of magma and strong fireballs at others with extreme precision.

entry: POKENAME像某些水生宝可梦，会在岩浆或熔岩河里游动，再跃出来用角刺穿鸟类宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME resemble some aquatic Pokémon. They swim within rivers of magma or lava and leap out to skewer bird Pokémon with their horns.

entry: POKENAME与帕底亚的一只传说的宝可梦十分相似。虽然外貌纯属巧合，生态位却很接近：它也会熔化石头和沙，游在造出的熔岩池里。
author: hophoppip
source: It closely resembles a Paldean Legendary Pokémon. Though this resemblance is purely coincidental, POKENAME's niche is quite similar to said Legendary, as it also swims through pools of lava made from the stone and sand it melts.

entry: POKENAME体外覆着保护性的火山岩，让身体能安全完成蜕变。快准备好进化时，表面会裂开，漏出熔岩和火焰。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is covered in a protective outer coating of volcanic rock, allowing its body to safely undergo the metamorphosis process. Once it is nearly ready to evolve, cracks appear and it leaks lava and flames.

entry: 破蛹而出后，POKENAME的翅膀只需片刻就能暖到足以飞行。它住在火山上，更喜欢去近期没造访过的熔岩池进食，过程中也会交换部分岩浆。
author: pjporwoll
source: After breaking free from its chrysalis, POKENAME's wings take mere moments to warm enough for flight. It lives on volcanic mountains and prefers to feed from lava pools it has not visited recently, exchanging some of its magma in the process.

entry: POKENAME会黏在活火山内部，只有那里的热量，才足以防止身体完全硬化。火山一开始休眠，它便会喷出蒸汽推动身体，寻找新家。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are found stuck to the insides of active volcanoes, for that is the only heat enough to keep their bodies from completely hardening. If a volcano begins to go dormant, they will propel themselves with bursts of steam to find a new home.

entry: POKENAME能灵巧操纵构成双手的熔岩，硬化成复杂形状，借明亮的身体作背光，表演精巧的手影戏。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME can deftly manipulate the lava composing their hands. By hardening the lava into complex shapes, POKENAME perform intricate shadow puppetry, using their bright bodies as a backlight.

entry: POKENAME的熔岩身体已凝成保护铠甲，能抵御风雨侵袭。它靠翅膀在猎场迅速穿行，伏击猎物，再用熔融镰刀给予决定性一击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's lava-body has solidified into a protective armor that shields it from the elements. With its wings, it maneuvers swiftly through its hunting grounds, ambushing prey and finishing them with decisive strikes from its molten scythes.

entry: POKENAME会收养被遗弃的蛋，代替母亲孵化，并养育幼崽。从这些蛋里孵出的宝可梦，日后会带礼物回来看它，表达谢意。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME act as surrogate mothers to abandoned eggs, incubating them and raising them. The Pokémon that hatch from these eggs return to visit these POKENAME with gifts of appreciation.

entry: POKENAME能精细控制体温，把一只手臂的全部热量转到另一只，产生强烈的温差电流，再接连打出又热又带电的攻击。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME exhibit very fine control over their temperature. By transferring all the heat from one arm to the other, they create a powerful thermoelectric current and unleash a flurry of blows, both hot and electric.

entry: POKENAME住在火山深处的隧道里。熔融的身体让狭窄洞穴始终泛着光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its home in deep volcanic tunnels. Its molten body keeps the narrow caves perpetually glowing.

entry: POKENAME会耐心等生物靠近，再用石钳捉住。钳尖小孔流出的熔岩，会把被困的猎物烤熟。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME patiently waits for creatures to draw near before grabbing them with its stone pincers. Once ensnared, the prey is cooked by lava that comes out from small holes in the pincers' tips.

entry: POKENAME性情易怒好斗，行动却慢，很难追上目标。因此长出三条纯粹由火焰构成的长尾，更便于鞭打惹怒自己的对象。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME has a volatile and aggressive temperament, its slow movement speed makes chasing down targets difficult. It adapted three long tails of pure flame in order to better lash out at those who have gained its ire.

entry: POKENAME由流纹质熔岩构成的身体充满气泡，在水中略有浮力。它偶尔会跃出海面，排放体内易爆的气体。
author: ilazerheart
source: The rhyolitic lava POKENAME's body is full of bubbles, making it slightly buoyant in the water. It occasionally jumps from the sea to vent out the explosive gases inside its body.

entry: POKENAME会用岩浆身体塑造火山岩，再披在身上当壳。它靠灵敏嗅觉，在自己挖出的火山隧道间辨路，寻找食物、避开捕食者。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME shells are pieces of volcanic rock they've used their magmatic bodies to shape and then wear. They use their acute sense of smell to navigate the tunnels they form in volcanic areas in search of food and to avoid predators.

entry: 野生POKENAME常在栖身的熔岩池里猛烈翻腾，把一团团高热熔岩甩向四周。越生气，火山岩外壳上喷出的火焰就越多。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME often thrash about within the pools of lava they swim within, casting globs of the superhot material all around. The angrier they are, the more flames that erupt across their shells of volcanic rock.

entry: POKENAME能很好地控制体温，甚至冷却到让人舒适骑乘的程度。古老民间故事里，一群它们曾载着整座镇子的居民渡过熔岩流，救大家逃离火山喷发。
author: secondegg
source: It has great control over its body temperature and can even cool itself enough to be comfortably ridden by humans. An old folktale tells of a group of POKENAME saving an entire town from a volcanic eruption by ferrying them across the flowing lava.

entry: POKENAME橙色的黏液部分能轻松变形，模仿对手，但石头部分需要专注得多。只要笑起来，石质部分便会变回原样，暴露伪装。
author: .izik
source: While the orange portion of POKENAME's goo can easily transform to mimic opponents, the stone portions require far more concentration. Should it laugh, these stone portions revert, giving away its disguise.

entry: POKENAME的黑色石尾只要进入任意进化石3英尺以内，火焰便会熄灭。可惜它走得极慢，带它寻石，总让同行者等得心烦意乱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's black stone tail will cease flaming when it comes within 3 feet of any Evolution stone. Unfortunately it walks incredibly slowly, making searches involving one extremely exasperating for anyone involved.

entry: 野生POKENAME住在火山地区的海岸。尾端鳍状部分其实是不断流动的火焰，睡觉时也只稍微减弱。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME live near the oceanic coastlines of volcanic areas. The fin-like ends of their tails are actually an ever-flowing stream of fire that only dulls a little when they sleep.

entry: POKENAME的鬃毛由多根冷却硬化的熔岩刺构成。它能用电力分批射出，化作使对方麻痹的利弹，不过之后至少要一天才能长出新鬃毛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's mane is made up of several spines of cooled and hardened lava. Using electricity, it can fire these off in bursts as paralyzing pointed projectiles, though it requires at least a day to reform a new mane afterward.

entry: POKENAME只住在熔岩床附近，只要不够酷热，就会虚弱疲倦。栖息环境危险，研究不易，但学者已发现，硬化的皮肤其实很脆。
author: darxer_
source: POKENAME exclusively lives near lava beds, as anything below extreme heat will make it weak and fatigued. Because of its unsafe habitat, studying it is difficult, but researchers have found its hardened skin is very brittle.

entry: POKENAME躲在壳里时，看起来不过是一块焦黑石方块。它突然钻出时，不少毫无戒心、靠得太近的生物都会被烫伤。
author: sk372
source: When hiding in its shell, POKENAME appears as little more than a charred cube of stone. Many unsuspecting creatures have gotten burned by being too close when POKENAME decides to emerge from within.

entry: POKENAME踏过熔岩池，从中汲取温暖。若待在寒冷之地，很快就会死去。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME stride through lava pools, which provide them with warmth. If they're in cold environments, they will soon perish.

entry: POKENAME稍有不顺就缩进背壳。它喜欢泡在热门温泉的深处，可人类若不小心踩到，就会惹来愤怒反击，造成麻烦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tucks into the shell on its back at the slightest inconvenience. It likes to soak deep in popular hot springs, which can cause problems when humans accidentally step on it and incite angry retaliation.

entry: POKENAME壳内的蒸汽定期从壳上的尖刺逸出。它也能提高内部压力，将尖刺高速射出自卫。
author: sk372
source: Steam from within POKENAME's shell regularly emanates from the spines on said shell. It can increase the pressure within to cause those spikes to fire off at high speeds as a defense mechanism.

entry: POKENAME会冷却部分身体，形成岩石壳，保护自己完成蜕变。受到威胁时，就从壳缝放出火焰。
author: secondegg
source: POKENAME cools part of its body into a rocky shell to protect itself while it undergoes metamorphosis. If it is threatened, it releases flames from the cracks in its shell.

entry: POKENAME的岩浆身体，能完全缩回石壳，保护自己；也借此避免伤及周围。
author: divinelunaria
source: POKENAME's magma body can fully retreat into its stony shell for protection. It also does so to avoid harming its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME会缩进硬壳，显得无害，等待目标靠近。对方一到跟前，它便突然钻出，用液态岩浆构成的镰刀手臂袭击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME retreats into its hardened shell to appear innocuous, waiting for something to draw near. Once it does, it springs out from hiding and strikes with its liquid magma arm-scythes.

entry: 野生POKENAME多住在地下岩浆湖，以矿物或较弱的宝可梦为食。将双刃交叉，就能把两刃一同点燃，更有力地击退敌人。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME mostly live in underground lakes of magma, feeding on either minerals or on weaker Pokémon. By crossing their blades together, they can ignite them both to better fight off foes.

entry: POKENAME住在数百年未喷发的死火山顶。有时会吓坏地质学家，因为数量一多，发光的身体就让山顶看起来像正在喷发。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME live on the peaks of extinct volcanoes that have not erupted for centuries. Their presence can sometimes give geologists a fright, as their glowing bodies in sufficient numbers give the summit the appearance of an eruption.

entry: POKENAME的壳庞大中空，需要时能把身体完全缩进去。自卫时，它会喷出强烈火流，或抛掷熔岩团。
author: infinex21
source: Their shells are hollow and large, so they can fully withdraw into them if they need to. POKENAME can defend themselves with intense streams of fire and by flinging globs of molten rock.

entry: POKENAME会从火山汲取岩浆，冷却周围空气，造出岩浆岩。它常雕刻自己和其他宝可梦，作品含义晦涩，艺术家有时会专程前往巢区寻找灵感。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME draw magma from volcanoes and cool the surrounding air to create magma rock. They tend to craft esoteric sculptures depicting themselves and other Pokémon. Artists will sometimes make pilgrimages to their nesting grounds for inspiration.

entry: 雷雨时，偶尔能看见POKENAME橙色的身体滑翔于云间。每扇一次翅膀，就会落下熔岩滴，烫伤下方被击中的对象。
author: .izik
source: During thunderstorms, POKENAME's orange body can sometimes be spotted gliding between the clouds. Small drops of lava fall from its body each time it flaps its wings, causing burns to anyone they strike below.

entry: 据说POKENAME诞生于世界的地壳，数百万年前从第一座火山里现身。振翅时火与灰四散，能在春回之际融尽顽固的霜冻。
author: notadoctor75
source: POKENAME was said to be born of the world's crust, emerging from the first volcano that formed millions of years ago. The flapping of its wings scatters fire and ash, thawing out any stubborn frost at the turn of spring.

entry: POKENAME住在火山内部，能以惊人的速度游过岩浆。传说它有引发火山喷发的力量，也有人在喷发时见过它飞上天空。
author: secondegg
source: POKENAME lives within volcanoes, swimming through magma at surprising speeds. It is said to have the power to cause volcanic eruptions, and some have been seen flying into the sky during these events.

entry: POKENAME的壳成分类似硫磺和火山岩，摸起来异常坚硬。需要时也能放出部分体内热量，加强防护。
author: infinex21
source: The shell of a POKENAME has a composition similar to sulfur and volcanic rock. Their shells are remarkably hard to the touch and they can release some of their internal heat to further protect themselves as needed.

entry: POKENAME翅膀燃烧的速度常与再生相当，因此一旦受损便无法弥补。它飞不走，毒刺中充满灼热毒液，就变得格外重要。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wings often burn at the same rate they regenerate, making any damage to their wings permanent. This makes it all the more important that their stingers are full of hot venom, as they cannot fly away from danger.

entry: POKENAME想远离人和宝可梦，会用精神力量与火山身体，在罕有人迹、路途危险的极北之地造岛。岛屿一被发现，它就会离弃。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME seeks isolation from people and Pokémon. Using its psychic powers and volcanic body, POKENAME creates islands to the far north where travel is infrequent and dangerous. It abandons these islands whenever they are discovered.

entry: POKENAME住在活火山深处，用精神力量操纵岩浆，形成气泡，在里面休息。出门时，它喜欢从尾尖吹熔岩泡，和其他对象玩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives deep within active volcanoes, resting within a bubble formed of psychically-manipulated magma. When it does venture out, it likes to play with others by blowing lava bubbles from the tip of its tail.

entry: POKENAME会挥舞头上冒出的火焰自卫。它寻找芳香植物，割下茎秆晾干后食用；得益于这样的食谱，健康个体会冒出甜美芳香的烟。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME whip the flame that issues from their head to defend themselves. POKENAME seek out fragrant vegetation to consume, cutting down the stalks and drying them out. Healthy POKENAME emit a sweet, aromatic smoke thanks to this diet.

entry: 枯树开始腐烂时，人们会请POKENAME等宝可梦帮忙。它最爱吃的燃料就是烂树桩，会从土里撬出，立刻吞下。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When dead trees begin to rot, POKENAME are among the Pokémon brought in to help. Their favorite food and fuel source involves rotting stumps, which they pry out of the soil and promptly eat.

entry: POKENAME醒着时，背上尖锐的石刺会燃起火焰。睡得越久，火就越暗，只有熟睡时才能清楚看见石刺。
author: .izik
source: The sharp stone quills on POKENAME's back burst into flames while it is awake and gradually dim the longer it sleeps. Only during deep slumber can one see them clearly on its back.

entry: POKENAME会以爆炸般的力道，快速排出自身热量。许多野生宝可梦常被它惹恼，哪怕只为让噪声停下，也要找它打一架。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME rapidly expel their own heat with explosive force.  Many other wild Pokémon are often agitated by these Pokémon and will attempt to battle them if only to cease their noise.

entry: POKENAME会把双颚加热到极高温，轻松咬穿岩石和钢铁。它玩耍时会毁坏车辆，因此经过栖息地的道路常被封闭。
author: secondegg
source: It superheats its jaws, allowing it to easily bite through rock and steel alike. Roads passing through POKENAME habitats are often closed due to it destroying vehicles while playing.

entry: 它坐在岩浆池中，寻找可袭击的猎物。如果猎物逃进水里，它仍会追赶，哪怕身体迅速冷却硬化也不停下。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It sits in magma pools, looking for prey to attack. If its prey escapes into water, it will continue to chase, even if its body rapidly cools and hardens.

entry: POKENAME是火山地带的熔岩鸟，吃岩石、宝石与矿物。它在高空飞行时，身体可能滴落岩浆，登山者可得留神。
author: alexandre_vulgo_xande
source: POKENAME is a lava-like bird native to volcanic areas; its diet includes rocks, gems, and minerals. Hikers should be careful since it can drop lava from its body when flying high in the sky.

entry: 野生POKENAME会藏在岩浆或熔岩河边，借背上的岩石融入环境。猎物靠得够近时，它便扑上去，用滚烫的大嘴咬住。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME conceal themselves alongside rivers of magma and lava, their dorsal rocks helping them to blend in. When prey draws near enough, they will pounce upon them and bite into them with their scalding maws.

entry: POKENAME没有腿，靠尾巴移动。每跳一下都会溅出熔岩，烧坏周围的东西。
author: bigoljax
source: Due to not having legs, POKENAME use their tails as a way to get around. Lava splashes out with each bounce, causing nearby objects to get burnt.

entry: POKENAME会缩进圆壳滚动前进。它总是群居，其他同伴睡觉时，至少会有一只保持清醒。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME moves by withdrawing into its round shell and rolling around. These Pokémon always live in groups, where at least one remains awake while the others sleep.

entry: POKENAME太沉迷思考，常被栖息火山的熔岩流困住。虽然不会受伤，却得等岩浆冷成石头，才能挣脱。
author: ilazerheart
source: POKENAME gets so lost in thought that it gets caught in lava flows from the volcanoes it lives in. This does not harm it, but it must wait for the magma to cool into rock before breaking free.

entry: POKENAME性情极其温暖，会帮助需要振作的对象。它很适合暂时给心事重重的孩子做心理疏导。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME have an incredibly warm personality, helping those who need to cheer up. They're very useful as temporary therapists for troubled kids.

entry: POKENAME会在不起眼的地方布下滚烫蛛网，困住、烤熟猎物。蛛丝能纺成一直保持温暖的衣服，对登山者和北极探险者很实用。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME leave scalding-hot webs at inconspicuous places to trap and bake prey. The silk from these webs can be spun into clothing that never lose warmth, which is very useful for mountaineers and artic explorers.

entry: POKENAME栖息在活火山旁的洞里，方便吸食岩浆。它飞行几乎无声，只有炽热翅膀的滋滋声，能提前警告它正在靠近。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME roost in caves near active volcanoes, where they can easily feed on magma. They fly almost silently, the sizzle of their blazing wings serving as the only warning of their approach.

entry: POKENAME常在熔岩池旁筑巢，也常潜进去觅食，因此身体总是温热。体温高得一碰就能熔化岩石，训练家摸它时最好小心。
author: alexandre_vulgo_xande
source: POKENAME is known to make nests close to lava pools and often dives into them in search of food. As a result, it is always warm. Its body temperature can melt rocks with one touch, so Trainers are advised to be careful while petting it.

entry: POKENAME生活在深海的海底火山中。它先引诱猎物靠近，再用诱饵状附肢电击对方，完成狩猎。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are found deep in the ocean, inside underwater volcanoes. They hunt by luring prey in and shocking them with their lure.

entry: 它熔岩般的身体里含着导电的熔融金属。兴奋时可能意外喷发，把自己吓哭。
author: hophoppip
source: Its lava-like body contains molten metals that conduct electricity. When excited, it may accidentally erupt, startling it into crying.

entry: 与火的联系让POKENAME对天体的感知变迟钝，常把火山喷出的岩石误认为流星。岩块直落而来时，它却还在跳舞。
author: vic1312
source: As their sense of celestial objects has been dulled due to their connection to fire, many POKENAME confuse rocks exploding from volcanoes for falling meteors. POKENAME will dance as the falling rocks hurtle towards them.

entry: POKENAME会结伴潜入地下深层岩浆房，拿来取乐。积聚的压力会喷出熔岩泉，把轻盈的它们抛到空中，再欢快地落回地面。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME gather together to dive deep into magma chambers within the earth. They do this for fun, as the building pressure leads to erupting lava fountains. This launches the lightweight Pokémon into the air, where they merrily fall to the earth.

entry: 这些小宝可梦的下半身是坚实岩石，会像蛋一样滚动，也能从下半身喷火，滚得更快。
author: infinex21
source: These small Pokémon roll about like eggs with their lower halves made of solid rock. They can vent flames from their lower half to help them roll even faster.

entry: POKENAME翅膀太小，飞不远，却能跃上高空，从上方放出灼热火焰。额头的火焰羽饰减弱时，它就返回岩浆，恢复体力。
author: fiordaliso
source: Because its wings are too small, POKENAME cannot fly long distances. Instead, it can leap high into the air to unleash scorching flames from above. When the fiery plume on its forehead weakens, it returns to the magma to restore its strength.

entry: 它的羊毛摸起来极热，剪下后却会冷却。即使凉下来，保温效果仍十分出色，许多人会用来制作冬衣。
author: secondegg
source: Although its wool is incredibly hot to the touch, it will cool down if it is sheared. Even when cool, this wool is a very effective insulator, and many use it to make winter clothing.

entry: 它们岩浆构成的身体移动时总在冒泡，会戴火山岩帽，保护原本裸露的大脑。
author: infinex21
source: Their magmatic bodies are always bubbling as they move. They wear caps made of volcanic rock to protect their otherwise-exposed brains.

entry: 它们体内烈焰轰鸣，热得足以熔化某些金属。部分身体已凝固用于防护，也曾见它们剥下冷却部分的碎片，掷向其他对象。
author: infinex21
source: Within their bodies are ever-roaring flames and heat intense enough to melt some metals. Parts of their own bodies have solidified to protect themselves, though they have shown to be able to shed pieces of these cooled parts and fling them at others.

entry: POKENAME体内的岩浆在颈边翻腾，汇在脚下。卷起的尾巴里藏着一颗耐热宝石，偶尔迸出噼啪电光。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have internal magma that bubbles around their necks and pools at their feet. They carry a heat-resistant gem within their rolled-up tail that occasionally crackles with electricity.

entry: POKENAME的鬃毛是流动的岩浆，能扯下掷向对手。头顶圆球极耐高温，也能导电。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have flowing manes of magma that can tear free and be hurled at opponents. The orb atop their heads is highly heat-resistant and electrically conductive.

entry: POKENAME出没于火山地区，会在火山口边缘跳舞。研究发现，它的叶片质地与火山灰相同。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be found in regions with volcanoes, dancing around the crater rims. Studies have found that their leaves have the same consistency as volcanic ash.

entry: POKENAME吹出的泡泡摸起来暖暖的，却不如身体那么热。有些家长会在寒冷月份请它当泡泡机，一边逗孩子开心，一边保暖。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The bubbles POKENAME make are warm to the touch, but not as hot as its body is. Some parents use POKENAME as bubble machines in the cold months, entertaining their children while keeping them warm.

entry: POKENAME会用大耳朵听地下深处的声响，寻找水源。有时却误跟着岩石熔成岩浆的声音，导致许多个体在火山喷发前聚集过来。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME use their large ears to listen to noises deep underground, guiding them towards water. POKENAME sometimes mistakenly follow the sound of rock melting into magma, causing many POKENAME to gather at a volcano just before it erupts.

entry: 它努力装成危险的熔岩喷口，其实身体更像橡胶，多半无害。它很讨厌壳沾水，因为存在里面的火焰可能被浇灭。
author: notadoctor75
source: It tries to maintain the appearance of a dangerous spout of lava, but in reality, its body has a more rubber-like consistency, and it is mostly harmless. It despises getting its shell wet, as it risks getting the flames it stores there extinguished.

entry: POKENAME能把冷却的岩浆当作临时睡莲叶，借此过河。留下的火成岩还能为水中补充养分。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME can use their cooled down magma as temporary lilypads to get across rivers. These ingneous rocks give nutrients to the water they're left in.

entry: POKENAME会漫无目的地随风滑翔，沿途撒下裹着火山岩的种子。若被下沉气流卷落，着地就会点燃附近植物，常在干旱地区引发山火。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME aimlessly glides with the wind, scattering seeds encased in volcanic rock across the region. If caught in a downdraft, its landing ignites nearby flora, often sparking wildfires in drought-stricken areas.

entry: POKENAME越热，便越朝太阳升高。与此同时，石质花瓣中冒泡的熔岩柱也会扩大，形成循环，让它更热、飘得更高。
author: foolish_weasel
source: As it gets hotter, POKENAME floats higher towards the sun. Coincidentally as this happens the bubbling lava plume from its stony petals expands as well, creating a cycle causing it to get even warmer and float even higher.

entry: 它往岩石手臂里灌入热气，让身体升空。若一只手臂坏了，便吐上热熔岩，耐心等它冷却成石，修补如初。
author: mistymagius
source: It fills its rocky arms with hot air, allowing it to lift off the ground. If one of its arms is damaged, it will spit hot lava on it, then patiently wait for it to cool back into rock.

entry: POKENAME白天在火山地区奔走觅食，夜里躲进小缝隙。它会啃岩石磨短牙齿，偶尔在过程中直接把石头熔穿。
author: secondegg
source: POKENAME scurries around volcanic regions, searching for food during the day, while hiding in small cracks at night. It gnaws on rocks to whittle down its teeth, occasionally melting right through them in the process.

entry: POKENAME躺在浅熔岩池里，吸取热能。过程中完全不动，因此常被误认为岩石。
author: secondegg
source: POKENAME lies in shallow lava pools, absorbing energy from the heat. It stays perfectly still in the process, leading many to mistake it for a rock.

entry: POKENAME会吸收阳光，将能量存进背壳，再化作暖意释放。据说即使最冷的夜晚，站在它身旁也像置身温暖晴日。
author: secondegg
source: It absorbs energy from sunlight, storing it in the shell on its back and releasing it as warmth. It is said that on even the coldest nights, standing near a POKENAME feels like a warm, sunny day.

entry: POKENAME浑身会分泌滚烫黏液，冷却后变成抗菌凝胶，人们自古就会收集。如今已能合成便宜得多的纯素替代品，不过许多瓶身仍印着它的形象。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME produces a burning hot slime over its body. Historically, people have collected this as when it cools it becomes an antibacterial gel. A much cheaper, vegan version is now produced synthetically, though many bottles use POKENAME imagery.

entry: POKENAME极其笨拙，会被自己的脚绊倒，弄得熔岩四溅。不过熔岩冷却得比平时快，因此不会伤害周围对象。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are incredibly clumsy, tripping over their own feet and causing their lava to fling everywhere. Though due to their lava cooling down more quickly than normal, they don't cause harm to those around it.

entry: POKENAME在熔岩池边休息，觉得身体变冷时，就用精神力量举起熔岩团，浇在自己身上。奇妙的是，若它敬重触碰自己的训练家，身体的熔岩摸起来却很凉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rests near lava pools, using psychic energy to lift globs of lava and drop them onto itself when it feels it is cooling down. Oddly, the lava forming its body is cool to the touch if it respects the Trainer making contact.

entry: POKENAME对月亮痴迷得古怪，会静止到次日清晨，让熔岩身体冷却变硬。随后迅速排出内部热量，打破自己的壳，下一晚再重复一遍。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are oddly enthralled with the moon, causing them to stay so still that their lava-like bodies cool and harden by the next morning. They rapidly expel their internal heat to break their own shells until they repeat the process the next night.

entry: POKENAME迷恋别人的小饰品，石质部分太重，却限制了偷窃。它为此恼怒，索性朝饰品吐熔岩，全部熔掉，让谁也得不到。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME obsesses over the trinkets of others, but the heavy weight of its stone parts limits its ability to pilfer. Incensed by this limitation, it settles for spitting globs of lava at the trinkets and melting them so nobody can have them.

entry: POKENAME每学到一个新事实，熔岩就会膨胀，再硬化成壳。不同壳块储存不同信息，信息可能受损、丢失，甚至能在同类间交换。
author: staghorn
source: A POKENAME's lava expands with every new fact it learns, which then hardens and becomes its shell. Specific pieces of shell contain specific bits of information, which can be damaged, lost, or even traded between POKENAME.

entry: 这些小宝可梦常见于火山地区、覆灰平原，甚至某些矿山。寻找煤和其他易燃食物时，会从后部喷火，加速前进。
author: infinex21
source: These small Pokémon are common near volcanic areas, ash-clad plains, and even some mines. They expel flames from their rear to propel themselves at greater speeds as they search for coal and other flammable materials to feed on.

entry: POKENAME壳下伸出的灰叶总覆着薄灰。它很护着这些叶子，常用熔岩藤蔓抽打靠得太近的对象。
author: sk372
source: The gray leaves that poke out from beneath POKENAME's shell are always covered with a fine layer of ash. It is quite protective of them, often lashing out at those too close with vines made of lava.

entry: POKENAME上方那对石牙更靠近滴落的岩浆，长得比下方一对快得多。因此，它只用上牙笨拙地啃东西，免得比下牙长得太多。
author: soup1900
source: The upper pair of POKENAME's stone teeth grows much quicker than its bottom pair since they are closer to its dripping magma. Due to this, it awkwardly chews on objects using only its top pair to keep them in size with its bottom pair.

entry: POKENAME喜欢模仿婴儿哭声，吓唬洞穴探险者。随后突然现身，朝对方喷火，吓得人拔腿就跑。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME like to spook people who explore caves by mimicking a babies cry. They then come out of nowhere, blowing fire at the explorers and causing them to run off.

entry: POKENAME会与同类在熔岩池上方盘旋浮游，偶尔像是巧合般拼出单词。有些神婆认为，它们是很久以前葬身火海者的通灵媒介。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME levitate above lava pools in circles with others of their kind, occasionally spelling words seemingly by coincidence. Some Mediums believe they serve as spiritual conduits for those who perished in the flames long ago.

entry: POKENAME的身体几乎全是熔岩，自认为无人能碰。不过，它从来没把水当成威胁考虑进去。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME consider themselves untouchable, due to their bodies almost being made entirely of lava. However, they never take water into consideration as a threat.

entry: 它前半身的温度最高可达华氏3000度，后半却出奇凉爽，甚至不用防护装备也能触摸。为了让两半都舒服，它会把头浸入熔岩，尾巴则避开。
author: secondegg
source: Although its front half reaches temperatures of up to 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit, its back half is surprisingly cool, even able to be touched without protective gear. To keep both halves happy, it dips its head into lava, while the tail stays clear.

entry: POKENAME常倒浮在熔岩池里，留意是否有猎物经过。一发现猎物，就从头顶喷火推进，再以爆炸般的力道砸向对方。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME often float upside-down within pools of lava, watching for any prey to walk by. When they spot prey, they launch themselves with flames from the top of their heads and crash down on them with explosive power.

entry: POKENAME藏在坚实火山岩构成的大壳里，两侧伸着冷却熔融矿石形成的喷口。它会从这些口向对手喷火流或岩浆团。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME hide within large shells made of solid, volcanic rock with ports of cooled, molten ores extending along their sides. They let loose streams of flames or globs of magma from these ports at opponents.

entry: POKENAME常捕食佛烈托斯，并将身体填入它们的下半片外壳中。它必须从侧面喷口和上壳排出余热，避免熔掉下方的金属壳。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME fill in the lower shells of Forretresses that they often prey upon. They must release excess heat from their side ports and from their upper shells to avoid melting their lower, metal shells.

entry: POKENAME尾端的石钻旋转时会热得发白。它会借此破开煤矿床，取煤来吃。
author: .izik
source: The stone drill at the end of POKENAME's tail grows white hot when spinning. It uses this to break apart coal deposits for consumption.

entry: POKENAME的钳爪由厚实石头构成，抓住敌人后便开始加热。夹紧后，温度足以造成严重烧伤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's claws are made of thick stone that begins to heat up when it grabs a foe. Once latched on, the claws grow hot enough to cause intense burns.

entry: POKENAME只吃火山岩。强力双颚每咬一口，都能压碎岩石，并加热到熔点以上，化成岩浆。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME feeds exclusively on volcanic rock. Its powerful jaws crush stone into magma with every bite, heating the stone beyond its melting point.

entry: 野外，POKENAME不断翻涌的裙摆是警告，提醒其他对象别靠近。但当作宠物时，许多人却看得入迷。训练有素的个体会低吼，提醒宠爱它的训练家别徒手碰。
author: imaginita
source: In nature, POKENAME's constantly billowing skirt serves as a warning not to come near.  As a pet, however, many find the movement mesmerizing.  A well-trained POKENAME will growl to remind the doting trainer not to touch it with bare hands.

entry: POKENAME发现泡着的熔岩池开始冷却，就会像孩子般闹脾气，朝四面八方乱溅，让周围变得极其危险。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME determines the lava pool it is bathing in is cooling down, it throws a tantrum like a child. During this time it splashes in all directions, making its surroundings incredibly hazardous.

entry: POKENAME会从后部喷出极热火焰，推动身体前进。它会鼓起岩浆身体，用硬刺压倒更大的对手。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME propel themselves forward by releasing extremely hot flames from their rears. They puff out their magmatic bodies and use hard quills to overpower larger opponents.

entry: POKENAME吃下富矿岩石，身体由其中的熔融金属构成，不断滴落。它能从大钳释放强烈热流，击退攻击者。
author: infinex21
source: The ever-dripping bodies of POKENAME are formed from molten metal derived from ore-rich rocks they consume. They release streams of intense heat from their pincers to fend off aggressors.

entry: POKENAME把树果存进壳里，边吃边煮沸，产生甜香的果酱状物质，覆在手臂上。它会小心地分给其他宝可梦，换取对方帮忙在干旱环境里找树果。
author: notadoctor75
source: POKENAME stores berries in its shell and boils them as it consumes them, producing a sweet-smelling, jam-like substance that coats its arms. It cautiously gives the jam out to other Pokémon in exchange for helping it find berries in arid climates.

entry: 岩石外骨骼让POKENAME能藏进岩浆，伪装自己。时机一到，便猛跃而出，用角攻击猎物。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME's rocky exoskeleton enables it to camouflage itself in magma. At the right time, it jumps out and attacks prey with its horn.

entry: POKENAME除了体热，几乎没有其他防身手段，因此会偷熔岩蜗牛的壳。它知道壳很脆，便拿来砸在对手头上，趁尘烟四起逃走。
author: secondegg
source: POKENAME has little way to defend itself aside from its body heat, so it steals the shells of Magcargo. It knows these shells are quite brittle, so it breaks them over its opponent's head and escapes in a cloud of dust and smoke.

entry: POKENAME行动通常缓慢，住在高山森林中。领地里明显没有冰雪，因为高体温会熔化靠近的冰。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are generally slow-moving Pokémon that can be found high up in alpine forests. Their territories are notably clear of snow and ice, their high body temperatures melting any ice that comes near them.

entry: POKENAME行动通常缓慢，住在高山森林中。领地里明显没有冰雪，因为高体温会熔化靠近的冰。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are generally slow-moving Pokémon that can be found high up in alpine forests. Their territories are notably clear of snow and ice, their high body temperatures melting any ice that comes near them.

entry: POKENAME行动通常缓慢，住在高山森林中。领地里明显没有冰雪，因为高体温会熔化靠近的冰。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are generally slow-moving Pokémon that can be found high up in alpine forests. Their territories are notably clear of snow and ice, their high body temperatures melting any ice that comes near them.

entry: POKENAME天生迟缓，很少移动。身体滚烫，穿过火山地区的人应当小心，别踩到它。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME are naturally quite sluggish and don't move very often. Their bodies are scorching hot, so anyone traveling through volcanic areas should avoid stepping on them.

entry: POKENAME身体的黏度，完全取决于食物中的二氧化硅含量。含量高时，壳致密，动作极慢；含量低时，动作更快，壳却较软。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The viscosity of POKENAME's body depends entirely upon how rich in silica its diet is. POKENAME with a diet rich in silica have dense shells but move extremely slowly, whilst those with a silica-poor diet are faster but have softer shells.

entry: POKENAME的壳是一座微型火山，会随年龄增长。最终会重得让它无法移动，只能在原地度过余生。
author: kiwiarms
source: POKENAME's shell is a miniature volcano, and it grows as the Pokémon ages. Eventually, it will become too heavy for the POKENAME to move, forcing it to stay in one spot for the rest of its life.

entry: 这种熔岩蜗牛的自身融合形态热得惊人，经过的地面立刻就会熔成熔岩。冷却后的熔岩营养极丰富。有些传说称，它故意摧毁古老贫瘠的土地，好让更美好的生命生长。
author: infranscia
source: This self fusion of Magcargo is so hot that the ground it travels instantly melts into lava.  The the cooled lava is extremely nutrient-rich.  Some legends say it intentionally destroys old, barren lands so that better things can grow.

entry: POKENAME会从喙滴熔岩进地洞，逼猎物从其他洞口逃出，再将其叼住。硬化的石壳限制了空中灵活性，却也减少了意外引发山火的机会。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME drips lava from its beak into burrows to scare prey to exit the other entrances, where it can snap them up. The hardened rock shell limits its aerial mobility, but does limit the chance of it causing inadvertent wildfires.

entry: POKENAME会用大鼻子找到藏在土里的树果，再把鼻子放在食物上，慢慢烹熟。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's large nose helps them find berries hidden in the dirt. They then rest their noses onto their food, slowly cooking them.

entry: POKENAME的壳和獠牙很脆，裂缝可能喷出体内2000摄氏度的熔岩，也可能吹出困在里面、出人意料的冷风。登山男常带着它，把它当作王牌之一。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME's shell and tusks are very brittle; cracks in them can either spew 2,000°C molten lava from its body or blow unexpectedly cold gusts from trapped winds within. Hikers are often seen accompanied by it, as one of their ace Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME住在深海沟，以火山活动的地热能为食。许多深海生物依赖它提供的能量和温暖，整个生态系统常以它为中心形成。
author: secondegg
source: POKENAME lives in deep ocean trenches, feeding on geothermal energy produced by volcanic activity. Entire ecosystems are often centered around POKENAME, as many deep-sea creatures rely on the energy and warmth it produces.

entry: POKENAME在火山岛上生长旺盛，会从石质底座伸出岩浆身体，更好地吸收热量和火山灰。察觉危险时，它会缩回石头，翻转身体，藏好自保。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME thrives on volcanic islands, extending its magma body from the stone base to better absorb heat and volcanic ash. It retracts into the stone and flips itself over to hide and protect itself when it senses danger.

entry: POKENAME借壳内的强大压力喷射熔岩，射程和精度都十分出色。同时从壳背裂缝排出些岩浆，免得后坐力把自己掀飞。
author: imaginita
source: A POKENAME uses the intense pressure inside its shell to shoot lava with impressive accuracy and range.  It simultaneously expels some magma from cracks in the back of its shell, so that the recoil doesn't send the POKENAME flying.

entry: POKENAME住在海底火山中，躲避捕食者，并在壳里储存岩浆。它能从虹吸管喷出岩浆，制服猎物，逃开敌人。
author: oddwalls
source: To avoid predators, POKENAME lives in undersea volcanoes, storing magma in its shell. By expelling the magma from its siphon, it can subdue prey and escape foes.

entry: 岩石身体太重，POKENAME只能贴着海面低飞。翅膀滴落入水的熔岩，会变成无瑕的黑色玻璃。
author: oddwalls
source: Because their rocky bodies weigh them down, POKENAME fly low over the ocean, barely skimming the surface. Drops of lava that fall from their wings into water become flawless black glass.

entry: POKENAME一生都在学习如何用熔融身体好好飞行。终于学会时，会高兴得发亮，耀眼得让城都居民偶尔误认成凤王。
author: ilazerheart
source: POKENAME spends its whole life learning to fly properly with its molten body. Once it does, it glows with happiness; so bright that the people of Johto occasionally mistake it for Ho-oh.

entry: POKENAME会结成大群，用不同叫声协调狩猎，合力将远比自己大的猎物赶下悬崖，靠坠落冲击使其失去反抗能力。若没摔死，它们再围上去烤熟。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME coordinate in large packs with varied cries when hunting. They work together to drive prey much larger than themselves off cliffs, relying on the impact to disable their meal. If the fall is not fatal, POKENAME close in to roast the Pokémon.

entry: 地质学家常把POKENAME的洞穴误认为熔岩管，因为它习惯用体热熨平睡觉的石面。真正受到威胁时，能把岩浆身体完全缩进壳里。
author: vic1312
source: The dens of POKENAME are often mistaken for lava tubes by geologists. This is due to their habit of smoothing the stone they sleep upon with their heat. When truly threatened, they can fully retract their magma bodies into their shells.

entry: POKENAME形似蛇，会钻行于火山岩中，靠经常接近的岩浆保持熔融高热。身体冒泡的液体具有腐蚀性，能轻易熔穿黑曜石。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are serpentine Pokémon that burrow through volcanic rock, their bodies kept molten hot by the magma they so often come near. The bubbling liquid of their bodies is a corrosive substance that easily melts through obsidian.

entry: POKENAME常潜伏深海，尤其喜欢海底火山。附近可捕食的宝可梦不多，因此它靠吃火山气体获取养分。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME often lurk in the depths of the sea, favoring underwater volcanoes. Few prey Pokémon live around these volcanoes, so POKENAME get their nutrients from eating volcanic gas.

entry: POKENAME能用鼻子将极热熔岩喷向远处。如果仍吓不退敌人，就会滚着逃走，留下一路燃烧的痕迹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can spit incredibly hot lava from its trunk at great distances. Should this fail to deter a foe, it rolls away leaving burning trails behind it.

entry: POKENAME体热强烈，獠牙能熔穿金属。曾有目击记录称，它会熔开餐车，吃掉里面装的食物。
author: bigoljax
source: Due to POKENAME's intense heat, their tusks have the ability to melt through metal. They've been seen melting through food trucks, eating whatever they carry.

entry: 它原是一套广受欢迎、防护出色的防火墙。科学家将其变成宝可梦，POKENAME便诞生了。
author: dodoowner_
source: It used to be a very popular and protective firewall. Scientists turned it into a Pokémon, and POKENAME was born.

entry: POKENAME的身体熔融，角也适应得覆上一层火成岩。森林火灾中，它会用角为幼小宝可梦抬开倒树。
author: bigoljax
source: Due to their molten bodies, POKENAME's horns have adapted to have a igneous rock layering. They use these horns to lift fallen trees out the way for young Pokémon during forest fires.

entry: POKENAME性情古怪，几乎什么上面都爱涂画。作品完成后，它会点火，火焰变化出缤纷色彩，十分耀眼。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a quirky being who will doodle on just about anything. After finishing a piece of art, it sets it on fire, with the flames becoming a variety of different colors in a dazzling display.

entry: POKENAME会头朝下，以每小时10英里的速度旋转，将岩浆甩向四周，构成防护圈。坚硬的火成岩身体承受攻击后，再用华丽的踢技反攻。
author: ilazerheart
source: POKENAME spins on its head at ten miles per hour, casting bits of magma around to form a defensive perimeter. It takes hits with its hard, igneous body, then counters with fancy kicks.

entry: POKENAME会通过亲吻分析陌生物体和人。虽然不算格外危险，吻后留下的烫伤却会让人疼痛又困扰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME analyzes new objects and people by kissing them. Though not especially dangerous, this can be painful and problematic due to the burns a POKENAME's kiss will leave behind.

entry: POKENAME常像举火把一样举着双臂，让火焰从末端开口涌出。转动手臂时，两根角就会发电。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME typically hold their arms up like torches as flames pour out from the openings at the ends. When they spin their arms, they generate electricity from their two horns.

entry: POKENAME能出色地控制火焰温度，因此能受训担任多种工作，从烹饪、金属加工，到充当随身暖炉。
author: secondegg
source: POKENAME demonstrate great control over the temperature of their flames. Because of this, they can be trained for many different jobs, ranging from cooking, to metalwork, to even a personal heater.

entry: POKENAME的身体主要是岩浆，却仍能用耐热装置挤奶。产出的温热奶水永远是热的，现有任何手段都无法将其冷却。
author: sk372
source: Despite having a body comprised mostly of magma, POKENAME is able to be milked using heat-resistant mechanisms. The warm milk produced by POKENAME is perpetually hot, unable to be cooled by any modern means.

entry: POKENAME肚前袋子里的石头很受理疗师珍视。只要放在酸痛的肌肉或关节上，所有痛楚就会消失，人也会感到深深的平静。
author: notadoctor75
source: The stones that POKENAME keeps in the pouch on its stomach are highly valued by physical therapists. Just by laying the stones on an aching muscle or joint, all pain will go away, and the person will be filled with a deep sense of calm.

entry: 这些兽形宝可梦小跑过火山原野，背上的火山岩喷口冒出滚滚浓黑烟。烟中噼啪迸出红色火山闪电，常让大多数潜在敌人望而却步。
author: infinex21
source: These bestial Pokémon trot through volcanic fields with plumes of thick, black smoke bellowing from the ports of volcanic rock atop their backs. Their black smoke crackles with red, "dirty" lightning that often scares away most would-be foes.

entry: POKENAME极易受惊，见到大多数人都会逃跑。移动时，它会吐出漆黑烟云，掩藏行踪。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is incredibly skittish, fleeing at the sight of most humans. It bellows out clouds of pitch black smoke to conceal its presence while traveling.

entry: POKENAME游走于火山山脉时，休眠的岩浆房便会开始活动。古籍传说，每逢大地在灰与火中重塑，山坡上就能见到它炽燃的轮廓，听见震撼大地的咆哮。
author: silentscript89
source: When POKENAME prowls volcanic ranges, dormant magma chambers will begin to stir. Ancient records spin tales of witnessing its blazing silhouette and earth-shattering roar on the mountainsides whenever the land reshaped itself in ash and fire.

entry: POKENAME有独特的力量，能将任何水源变成沸腾的熔岩池。虽然破坏力惊人，它却是温柔的守护者，会为其他火属性宝可梦创造新栖息地。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME wields the unique power to turn any water source into a boiling pool of lava. Despite its destructive power, POKENAME is a gentle guardian, creating new habitats for other Fire Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME会用黑烟遮住自己和同伴，烟中竟几乎不含污染物。火山岩构成的角，能帮助引导体内的热量和火焰。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME veil themselves and others with a black smoke that is surprisingly pure of pollutants. Their horns of volcanic rock help them to channel their internal heat and flames.

entry: POKENAME会用壳上刻出的眼洞威吓对方。若不管用，就向捕食者吐熔岩。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME use the eye holes carved into their shells as a way of intimidation. But in case it doesn't work, they spit out lava at their predators.

entry: POKENAME自认实力足以证明资格，会将整座火山据为领地。不过动作太慢，常被鸭嘴炎兽打败。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME claim entire volcanos as their territory, due to thinking their strength can fully prove these claims. However, they're often defeated by Magmortar due to their lack of speed.

entry: 野生POKENAME住在火山里，免得大部分岩浆身体冷却硬化。体热有时强得让嘴里喷出烈焰，足以媲美原始岩浆的温度。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME live within volcanoes to keep most of their magmatic bodies from ever cooling and hardening. Their internal heat can grow so intense that their mouths will erupt with flames that rival the heat of raw magma.

entry: 它从海底喷口收集体内的岩浆，获得几乎无穷无尽的热能。扇一次翅膀，就能掀起持续数月的热浪与干旱。
author: ilazerheart
source: The magma in its body, gathered from undersea vents, is a near limitless source of heat energy. With one flap of its wings, it can unleash heat waves and droughts that last for months.

entry: 它们身体硬化部分的脸状花纹会突然燃起火焰，无论猎物还是捕食者都会吓一跳。脸上的嘴能喷出构成身体的冒泡腐蚀液，迅速熔化猎物，再饮下去。
author: infinex21
source: The face-like patterns on the hardened part of their bodies will burst into flames to startle prey and predator alike. The mouths of these faces can spew the bubbling, corrosive material of their bodies to quickly melt their prey and drink them up.

entry: POKENAME常见于火山脚下的城镇，夜里会在街头玩类似曲棍球的运动。它们似乎也想借机撞倒路灯，好大吃其中的电力。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are common in towns near the base of volcanoes, often playing a sport resembling hockey in the streets at night. It seems they do this in part to knock over streetlamps so they can feast on the electricity.

entry: POKENAME会吞下岩石，在喉部类似胃的嗉囊中熔化，吸收维持火焰所需的矿物。产生的岩浆则化作战斗中灼热难缠的投射物。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME ingest and melt rocks within their crop, a stomach-like organ located within their throat, allowing them to absorb the minerals necessary for sustaining their flames. POKENAME use the magma byproduct as a nasty, burning projectile in battle.

entry: 据说POKENAME不属于这个时代，因为身体似乎适应的是被岩浆覆盖的史前星球。没人知道，它为何至今仍在现代存在。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is said to not be from this time, as its body seems to be adapted to a prehistoric planet bathed in magma. No one knows how it is still around in the modern day.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的壳看着沉重，其实很轻又中空。幼崽会把尾巴当船，安全地顺着熔岩流和河流漂行。
author: wiz0z
source: Despite its heavy appearance, the shell on POKENAME's tail is actually very light and hollow. Young POKENAME use their tails as boats to safely float down lava flows and rivers.

entry: POKENAME爱找甜水果，用身体烤熟。这常引来其他同类，各自带上水果，最后变成一场盛宴。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME love to look for sweet fruits, cooking them with their bodies. This often attracts other POKENAME who bring their own fruits, causing a feast to happen.

entry: POKENAME会把熔融附肢浸入水中冷却，造出硬化岩浆构成的拳头。既能拿食物、击退威胁，也能给碰到的表面加热。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME create fists made of hardened magma by cooling their molten appendages in water. POKENAME can use these fists to handle food, fight off threats, and even warm surfaces they touch.

entry: POKENAME十分罕见，住在破火山口，通常最多三只结成称作“巫团”的小群。民间传说最好别打扰，因为惹怒它们可能招来烈火诅咒。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME are rare, typically found in groups of up to three called covens, and inhabit volcanic calderas. Folklore says that it is best to leave them alone as angering them may lead to a fiery curse being laid upon you.

entry: POKENAME十分罕见，住在破火山口，通常最多三只结成称作“巫团”的小群。民间传说最好别打扰，因为惹怒它们可能招来烈火诅咒。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME are rare, typically found in groups of up to three called covens, and inhabit volcanic calderas. Folklore says that it is best to leave them alone as angering them may lead to a fiery curse being laid upon you.

entry: POKENAME和手下在温泉及破火山口附近生活、狩猎。岩浆双翼下的风可达华氏1800度，落到树上就可能引发山火。
author: ilazerheart
source: POKENAME and its grunts hunt and live around hot springs and volcanic calderas. The wind beneath their magma wings reaches 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. Landing in trees can result in forest fires.

entry: POKENAME会哭出灼热的岩浆泪，冷却缓慢，因此被请到水疗场所。人们会将它安置在蒸汽房，产出桑拿石，也让它与按摩师配合，帮助热石按摩。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME sob hot, magma tears that cool slowly and are employed in spa retreats as a result. They are placed in steam rooms to produce sauna stones or paired with a massage therapist to assist with hot stone massages.

entry: POKENAME的下半身沉重，行动不快。它内心敏感，常常哭泣，落下火泪，可能烧坏周围的一些东西。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's heavy lower body prevents it from moving too quickly. Sensitive at heart, it cries often, shedding tears of fire that may end up burning some of its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME喷火技巧出众，常见于嘉年华。帽尖也会被用来点燃大炮的引线。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME have exceptional skills at fire breathing, making them common in carnivals. The tips of their hats are also used to burn the wicks of cannons.

entry: POKENAME的腹袋里带着蛋形石头，用高体温加热。将这种石头放进水池，立刻就能变成有疗养功效的温泉。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME carries an egg-shaped rock in its belly pouch, warming the stone with its high body heat. Place a POKENAME stone into a pool to create an instant restorative hot spring.

entry: POKENAME能用尾巴吸收熔岩的热能和大气中的电能。它会把尾巴插入地面，排掉多余能量，因此巢穴周围很快就会变得贫瘠。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME can use its tail to absorb thermal energy from lava and electric energy from the atmosphere.  It will discharge excess energy by planting its tail into the ground, so the ground around a POKENAME's nest quickly becomes barren.

entry: POKENAME体温高，代谢极快，必须不断进食，甚至夜里也要醒来吃，才能摄取足够热量生长。
author: oddwalls
source: Due to its high body heat, POKENAME's metabolism runs extremely fast. It must eat constantly, even waking during the night, to ensure that it consumes enough calories to grow.

entry: POKENAME会无忧无虑地在岩浆池里游泳，常仰躺漂浮、晒太阳，让石质腹面保持干燥脆硬。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME swims about in magma pools without a care. It often floats on its back, sunning itself and keeping its rocky underside dry and brittle.

entry: 岩浆为POKENAME提供天然防护，因此它胆子极大。研究者偶尔甚至发现它挑战烈咬陆鲨。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are incredibly bold creatures, due to the natural protection their magma gives them. Researchers have occasionally found them challenging Garchomp.

entry: POKENAME身体的融合部分，能提供大量熔融的磁性岩石。它会制造火球，用小手臂掷向对手。
author: infinex21
source: The fused parts of POKENAME's bodies provide a rich supply of molten, magnetic rock. They generate balls of fire that they launch from their small arms at opponents.

entry: POKENAME爱演奏随身乐器。人们会付钱，隔着安全距离欣赏，以免被喷出的岩浆烫伤。据说乐声像萨克斯管与迪吉里杜管的混合。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME loves to play the instrument it carries around. People pay to see it perform at a safe distance, so as not to be burned by magma it spits out. Its music is said to sound like a saxophone mixed with a didgeridoo.

entry: POKENAME会从掌孔发射沉重的硬化熔岩块，击退袭击者。弹药来自自身岩浆，短时间连发就会让体重明显减轻。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fires heavy chunks of hardened lava from the holes in its palms to deter attackers. It uses its own magma to do this, so repeated firing in a short time causes its body mass to visibly decrease.

entry: POKENAME是一大团移动岩浆，外沿覆着火山岩。它住在熔岩坑里，用能伸长的手臂困住靠得太近的猎物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are giant blobs of moving magma lined with volcanic rock. They live in lava pits and use their stretchable arms to ensnare any prey that wanders too close.

entry: POKENAME脾气暴躁，被惹怒就可能造成大规模破坏。它会把岩浆与电力混合，制造碰到任何表面都会爆炸的岩浆球。
author: bigoljax
source: Because of their high temper, POKENAME can cause mass destruction when aggravated. They mix their magma with their electricity, creating magma balls that explode when they make contact with any surface.

entry: POKENAME背壳中储存大量液态岩浆，与双手直接相通，能从手臂喷出，抵御面前的危险。
author: sk372
source: A large amount of liquid magma is stored within the shell on POKENAME's back. These stores connect directly to its hands, allowing it to spray magma from its arms to fend off any dangers that it faces.

entry: POKENAME走到哪里，翅膀就把火带到哪里。如果转得足够快，甚至能形成小型火旋风。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's wings constantly spread fire wherever it goes. They can even create a smaller version of a fire whirl if they spin fast enough.

entry: POKENAME最坚硬的部分是壳，其他皮肤没那么结实，却能从裂缝喷火。柔软腹面则能吸收火山的地热能。
author: imaginita
source: Its shell is the toughest part of its body.  The rest of its hide isn't as tough, but in exchange, POKENAME can shoot fire through the cracks.  Its soft underbelly allows it to absorb geothermal energy from volcanoes.

entry: 石质身体太重，POKENAME白天大多在休息。捕猎时会暂时迸出火焰翅膀，飞起来，用沉重石尾打倒猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's stone body chunks weigh it down heavily, so it spends much of the day at rest. When it goes to hunt, wings of flame temporarily erupt and let it take flight and knock out prey with its heavy stone tail.

entry: 有时能在北极环境看见POKENAME，望着冰层，享受冷空气。为免身体在寒冷中硬化，尾巴会保持燃烧，维持体温。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can sometimes be found in arctic environments, staring out at ice structures while enjoying the cold air. To prevent their bodies from hardening in the cold, their tail is kept aflame to keep their body hot.

entry: POKENAME能从石制钳爪发射沸腾熔岩，几乎什么都能熔化。翅膀让它飞得悄无声息，打猎物一个措手不及。
author: fiordaliso
source: From its stone-forged claws, POKENAME can fire boiling lava projectiles capable of melting nearly anything. Its wings allow it to fly in complete silence, catching prey off guard.

entry: POKENAME脸和獠牙上的铠甲，是熔岩反复遭暴风雪冷却形成的。它极其罕见而强大，只在火山喷发时被目击，踩着烈焰横冲大地。
author: beatdoof
source: The armor in POKENAME's face and tusks is made of molten lava cooled by repeated exposure to blizzards. An extremely rare and powerful Pokémon that has only been spotted during volcanic eruptions, stampeding across the landscape with fiery stomps.

entry: 微弱磁力让POKENAME浮在空中。它会在火山原野胡乱起舞，将熔融身体的液滴甩向四周。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are kept afloat by a weak magnetic force. They dance erratically through volcanic fields, flicking droplets of their molten bodies about.

entry: POKENAME性情害羞，通常独处。不过受到威胁，就会用硬化的尾巴猛击攻击者。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are shy creatures, usually keeping to themselves. If threatened however, they bash their aggressors with their hardened tails.

entry: POKENAME在阿罗拉等热带地区极少被目击。它睡在火山隧道里，到丛林狩猎。平时虽慢，必要时却能突然迅疾出击。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are very rarely spotted in tropical regions such as Alola. They sleep in volcanic tunnels and hunt in the jungle. While typically slow-moving, they may strike with sudden swiftness when necessary.

entry: POKENAME会用岩浆自制靶子，练习踢击。有些能练到一脚将靶子踢成两半。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME practice their kicks by making their own targets out of magma. Some can get strong enough to break these targets in half.

entry: POKENAME会尽身体所能勤奋训练，绕着作为家园的火山奔跑。它也踢打倒木，每秒连出数脚。木头会变成上等木炭，采集者便来收走残片。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME train as often as they physically can, running around the volcanoes they call home. They also train against fallen logs, loosing multiple kicks per second into the wood. Foragers gather the remains, as the logs become premium charcoal.

entry: POKENAME战斗时会耐心等待最佳时机，再以快得看不清的速度反击。不战斗时，它喜欢在熔融岩浆池里冥想。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME slowly waits for the perfect moment in combat before retaliating with blindingly fast counterattacks. When not in battle, it enjoys meditating within pools of molten magma.

entry: POKENAME常呆呆地嚼着母亲定期给的熔岩。母亲寻找真正的食物时，便能借此打发时间。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME love to mindlessly chew on molten rock regularly given to them by their mothers. This gives them something to pass the time while their mothers look for actual food.

entry: POKENAME会滴下熔岩，把水变成冒着蒸汽的圆石，借此过水。石头很脆，容易碎，可能害它跌落，但步伐稳健，旅程仍相对安全。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME crosses over bodies of water by using its dripping lava to turn the liquids into steaming cobblestone. While this stone is very brittle and shatters easily, which may cause POKENAME to fall, its sure footing makes this trek relatively safe.

entry: POKENAME最爱几乎整个泡进熔岩池，放松的同时，也让身体裹上新鲜岩浆。掉落的石质身体部分会再吃掉，回收养分。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME submerges itself almost completely in lava pools, its favorite spot to relax and keep its body coated with fresh magma. Rocky parts of its body that fall off are consumed to regain nutrients.

entry: POKENAME能从正面情绪获得能量。格外温暖的感情，会让身体泛起层层岩浆波纹。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME gains energy from positive emotions.  Especially warm feelings will cause its body to billow with ripples of magma.

entry: POKENAME常在火山口边缘跳舞。它会用念力增强热造成的幻景，造出宁静美好风光的幻象。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME can often be seen dancing around the edges of volcanic craters.  They use their psychokinetic powers to amplify heat mirages and create illusions of idyllic scenery.

entry: POKENAME瞬间移动前会张开双臂。每次移动后，似乎总会留下几滴熔岩。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stretches its arms wide before teleporting. It always seems to leave behind a few drops of lava when it does.

entry: 它身体通常覆着一层凉而脆的硬化岩浆。但训练家遇险时，就会烈焰迸发，震碎甲壳，据说威力胜过上百座火山。
author: imaginita
source: Its body is usually covered in a cool, brittle outer layer of hardened magma.  If its Trainer is in danger, however, it will erupt into flame, shattering its carapace with power said to be greater than a hundred volcanoes.

entry: POKENAME驮着小山般的壳，里面藏着庞大的岩浆身体。通常很少久留壳外，除非训练家或朋友在身旁。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have expansive bodies made of magma within the mound-like shell they lug around. They rarely emerge from their shells for long, unless around their Trainer or their friends.

entry: POKENAME是英勇的守护者，总警戒在训练家身边。随身的剑热得足以熔穿岩石。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are valiant protectors, always on guard near their trainers side. The swords they carry are hot enough to melt through stone.

entry: POKENAME会立刻保护需要帮助的对象，用岩浆强化身体。即使激战中，也能灵巧引导岩浆，迅速填补、修复铠甲裂缝。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME leaps to the defense of those in need, reinforcing its body with magma.  It can skillfully direct this magma to quickly fill and repair any cracks in its armor, even in the heat of battle.

entry: 它们的岩浆身体住在火山岩壳里，形似某些虫属性宝可梦丢下的壳。悬浮的原理尚不完全清楚，多数人认为是强烈热量将它托在空中。
author: infinex21
source: Their magmatic bodies inhabit shells of volcanic rock that resemble the discarded shell of certain Bug-type Pokémon. It is not entirely known how they float, but most assume they exude such raw heat that it keeps them in the air.

entry: POKENAME会用灼热发光的耳朵向同类闪光示意。自卫时，会朝威胁吐出一团团灼热的腐蚀物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME flash signals to others of their kind with their glowing-hot ears. They will defend themselves by spitting globs of a hot, corrosive material at threats.

entry: POKENAME血液极冷，离开火山家园时会裹上灼热熔岩，免得在凉冷气候中冻住。它通过冷却、再加热岩浆，形成岩石图案，与同类交流。
author: deadshields
source: POKENAME have extremely cold blood, so they coat themselves in hot lava whenever they leave their volcanic homes to avoid freezing in cooler climates. They communicate with each other by cooling and reheating their magma into rocky patterns.

entry: POKENAME常在工业场所工作，不断而来的任务让它忙个不停。它爱加工金属，既觉得自己有用，也能练习火焰能力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found in industrial settings where the constant flow of work keeps them busy. They love handling metal because it gives them a sense of purpose while also giving them practice with their fiery powers.

entry: POKENAME会把体内岩浆当燃料，推动自己冲向同类，结合后进化。人们曾见它飞越夜空。
author: ilazerheart
source: POKENAME uses the magma in its body like fuel, propelling itself towards others of its kind to combine and evolve. They have been seen soaring across the night sky.

entry: POKENAME性情沉稳，很难吓一跳。这份认真让它十分适合工厂工作，能将金属加工成零件。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are difficult to surprise because of their calm disposition. This seriousness makes them a great fit for factory settings where they shape metal into parts.

entry: POKENAME需要更多岩浆时，会用磁力挪动地壳板块，强行引发小型火山喷发。体温达到钢液沸腾温度的两倍。
author: ilazerheart
source: If POKENAME ever needs more magma, it uses its magnetic powers to shift tectonic plates and forcibly erupt small volcanoes. Their bodies are twice the temperature of boiled steel.

entry: POKENAME体热能传得很远，它在场时，工厂工人几乎不会冷。它认真对待金属切割工作，有些甚至会忘记休息。
author: quackquackattack
source: Factory workers are almost never cold when POKENAME are around, as their body heat radiates far from their bodies. They take the task of cutting shapes out of metal seriously, so much so that some POKENAME forget to take breaks.

entry: POKENAME体内有四个熔岩储池，各装着独立的大脑。形成新个体的过程热得厉害，连气象卫星的读数都可能受干扰。
author: ilazerheart
source: A POKENAME has four reservoirs of lava inside its body, each containing a separate brain. The process of forming a new POKENAME is so hot that it can disrupt weather satellite readings.

entry: POKENAME会定期啃火山岩磨牙。训练家必须持续供给岩石，否则它无聊了，就会啃家里的家具。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME regularly gnaw on volcanic rocks to wear down their teeth. Trainers that raise them need to supply them with a steady source of rocks. Otherwise, they grow bored and begin gnawing on furniture around the Trainers' home.

entry: POKENAME散发惊人热量，一碰就能熔化岩石。虽然外表烈焰腾腾，却仍保有路卡利欧的敏捷与战斗本领。
author: sheogorath
source: POKENAME emit immense heat, capable of melting rocks with a touch. Despite its fiery exterior, it maintains Lucario's agility and combat prowess.

entry: POKENAME只要待在火山里，凭力量终究能成为顶级猎手。不过，若附近有鸭嘴炎兽、风速狗之类的宝可梦，它就会抢在冲突前迅速离开。
author: bigoljax
