source: Whenever POKENAME find themselves in a volcano, they eventually become the apex predator due to their strength. However, if Pokémon like Magmortar and Arcanine are in the area, POKENAME will quickly leave before a confrontation.

entry: POKENAME双臂经过热处理的砍刀能轻易劈开钢铁。靠近时必须格外小心，不可小看它火爆的脾气。
author: ilazerheart
source: The heat-treated cleavers on POKENAME's arms can rip through steel with ease. Exercise extreme caution when approaching; their hot-tempered disposition is not to be underestimated.

entry: POKENAME睡在熔岩池里，背上的石壳露出表面。有时壳上会长出小花，代表身体健康。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps within lava pools, the stone shell on its back protruding above the surface. Tiny flowers will sometimes grow from the shell, indicating it is in good health.

entry: POKENAME背上喷口放出的火焰带着令人作呕的气味，让捕食者不太想下口。爪尖有毒，会引起强烈灼痛。
author: infinex21
source: The flames that POKENAME release from the ports along their backs emit a sickening scent that makes them less desirable to predators. The tips of their claws carry a poison that causes intense burning sensations.

entry: POKENAME大半身体藏在形似大嘴娃的石壳中，让自己显得无害。随后，熔岩构成的大嘴会从里面猛扑出来，吞下毫无戒心的目标。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides much of its body mass within a stone shell that resembles Mawile. It makes itself seem unimposing before a massive mouth made of lava lunges out from within to swallow up its unwary target.

entry: POKENAME是海底的伏击猎手，会让上层外表硬化成岩石。察觉猎物在附近时，它就弹出熔岩触手，引发蒸汽爆炸，震晕猎物。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME are ambush predators. Living at the bottom of the sea, they allow their upper exterior to harden into stone. When it senses prey nearby, it launches out tentacles of lava, creating steam explosions that stun its prey.

entry: POKENAME身体虽然是岩浆，却喜欢潜在水中，常住在深海热泉口附近。早期训练家会在家旁架起大水槽饲养，做成原始的热水器。
author: vic1312
source: Despite their magma bodies, POKENAME enjoy being submerged and are often found residing near hydrothermal vents in the deep sea. Early Trainers would house POKENAME in large, elevated vats near their homes, creating primitive hot water heaters.

entry: POKENAME拥有极坚固的硬化岩浆铠甲，配上巨爪，攻守都十分强大。专精虫属性的训练家很看重它的实力。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME possess hardened magma armor of incredible strength. That, paired with their enormous claws, makes them a powerhouse of defense and offense. They are highly prized by Bug-Type specialists for their strength.

entry: POKENAME岩浆身体太热，始终裹着火焰。它住在陆地，却会潜入岩浆或熔岩寻找猎物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are always clad in flames due to how hot their magmatic bodies are. They live on land, but dive into magma and lava in search of prey.

entry: POKENAME撞击敌人时，头上的石壳会燃起火焰。有时冲力太强，壳块会崩落，得花好几天才能重新长好。
author: .izik
source: The stone shell on POKENAME's head bursts into flames when it rams into a foe. Sometimes it rams with such force that chunks of the shell break off, taking days to regrow.

entry: POKENAME会用头撞岩壁，故意磕裂石质头罩，排掉过去战斗中积蓄的火焰。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME bash their heads into the sides of rocks, cracking their stone domes open on purpose. This helps them get rid of any built up fire from past battles.

entry: POKENAME的头盔坚韧，却容易开裂。它会把熔岩吐进水里，再凿出适合头部的孔，制成头盔戴上。
author: bigoljax
source: The helmets POKENAME wear are tough, but can be prone to cracking. They make their helmets by spitting out lava into water, then carving out a hole to fit onto their heads.

entry: 前方硬化岩浆构成的盾能承受正面攻击，液态岩浆层则把力道分散到全身。施加的冲力还能为熔岩增压，供它喷射反击。
author: vic1312
source: The shield of hardened magma on their front absorbs the strength of frontal attacks as a layer of liquid magma distributes the force through their whole body. The forces acting on their bodies pressurize the lava they blast in retaliation.

entry: POKENAME的铠甲由硬化岩浆构成，能烧伤用物理攻击来袭的对象。它会吃燃烧的树果，提高体温。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME's armor is made from hardened magma, allowing them to burn any assailant using physical attacks. They are known to eat flaming berries to increase their temperature.

entry: 这些大型宝可梦住在火山地区的地下，持续的高热让身体不至于完全硬化。不过体内产热太多，它们必须经常休息。
author: infinex21
source: These large Pokémon dwell under volcanic areas, where the constant heat is enough to keep their bodies from completely hardening. They have to rest often due to how much heat they produce internally.

entry: POKENAME是火山地区许多宝可梦常见的守护者。它会用石质外壳挡下攻击，再以火焰拳还击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are the common protectors of many Pokémon that live within volcanic areas. They use the rocky shells of their bodies to guard against attacks and counterattack with Fire Punches.

entry: POKENAME喜欢借喷发的岩浆飞上天空，一生都在追逐刺激。大岩蛇已经学会，一见到它就赶快离开，因为岩浆有时会被引进自己的隧道。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME love to fly up on magma erupting from volcanoes and spend their life travelling from thrill to thrill. Onix have learned that seeing a POKENAME is a sign to quickly vacate the area, as magma is sometimes diverted into their tunnels.

entry: POKENAME身体极热，覆着熔岩，但头骨状面具表面始终不超过80度。面具一掉，它就会慌张地放下一切，尽快重新戴好。
author: .izik
source: Despite POKENAME's body being incredibly hot and covered in lava, the surface of its skull-like mask never exceeds 80 degrees. Should the mask fall off, it will panic and drop everything to get it back on as quickly as possible.

entry: 民间传说称，POKENAME原本是受诅咒的熔岩，生出邪恶意识后，寄宿在石头身体里。它会催眠凝视眼睛的对象，试图引诱对方走入岩浆池。
author: sk372
source: Folklore states that POKENAME is cursed, lava that gained malevolent sentience and inhabited a stone body. It hypnotizes those that gaze into its eye, trying to lure them to walk into pools of magma.

entry: POKENAME喷出高达10000度的火焰，将吞下的东西烧尽。待在它身旁虽危险，处理垃圾时，它却是个好帮手。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME spews flames up to 10,000 degrees, incinerating anything it consumes. Despite how dangerous they are to be around, POKENAME are quite helpful in garbage disposal.

entry: 每只POKENAME独特的矿物组成，都与陨石撞击点回收的物质完全吻合。身上的火焰永不熄灭，即使在海底也不例外。
author: _pixelar_
source: Each POKENAME's unique mineral composition perfectly matches matter recovered from meteor impact sites. The flames on its body can never be extinguished, even at the bottom of the sea.

entry: 暮秋常能看见POKENAME大嚼落叶。若叶片咬起来响亮脆爽，它就会让火焰涨大，高兴地蹦跳。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: During the late autumn season, POKENAME can be found munching on leaves that have fallen from trees. If a leaf crunches loudly, they increase their flame size and bounce in joy.

entry: POKENAME背壳由肥沃的火山土构成。体热虽让植物无法直接长在上面，但训练家若想为自家花园刮些土，它很乐意。
author: imaginita
source: The shell on its back is made of nutrient-rich volcanic soil. Although the heat of POKENAME's body prevents anything from growing directly on it, it will gladly allow its Trainer to scrape off some soil for their own garden.

entry: POKENAME生活在火山活跃地区，跟着熔岩流给身体补充燃料。高热会烧掉周围大部分植被，但岩浆营养丰富，留下的土壤也格外肥沃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in volcanically active areas, following lava flows to fuel their bodies. The sheer heat from their body burns away most of the vegetation around them, but the high nutrient content of the magma makes the soil they leave very fertile.

entry: POKENAME生活在火山活跃地区，跟着熔岩流给身体补充燃料。高热会烧掉周围大部分植被，但岩浆营养丰富，留下的土壤也格外肥沃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in volcanically active areas, following lava flows to fuel their bodies. The sheer heat from their body burns away most of the vegetation around them, but the high nutrient content of the magma makes the soil they leave very fertile.

entry: POKENAME生活在火山活跃地区，跟着熔岩流给身体补充燃料。高热会烧掉周围大部分植被，但岩浆营养丰富，留下的土壤也格外肥沃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in volcanically active areas, following lava flows to fuel their bodies. The sheer heat from their body burns away most of the vegetation around them, but the high nutrient content of the magma makes the soil they leave very fertile.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时会冷却身体，形似雕像。日出醒来时，伴随着闪光和响亮的碎裂声，有些山镇便用来报时。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME will cool its body down while it is sleeping, causing it to resemble a statue. Its awakening with the sunrise is accompanied by a flash of light and loud cracking. Some mountain towns use this as a means of keeping time.

entry: 它们耳内是全身最热的部分，常发出明亮光芒。背上硬壳很难打破，即使破损，也能在一天内重新成形。
author: infinex21
source: The insides of the ears of these Pokémon are the hottest parts of their bodies, often glowing bright. The hardened casing along their backs is difficult to break but will reform within a day's time if somehow broken.

entry: POKENAME喜欢偷漂亮的椅子，坐在上面模仿统治者。一旦主人想拿回椅子，它就会赶忙逃跑。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME like to steal fancy looking chairs, mimicking rulers as they sit upon them. They quickly run off as soon as the owners try to get the chair back.

entry: POKENAME不懈锻炼敏捷性，让岩浆身体更灵活。这份勤奋让它成为资深训练家的得力伙伴，滚烫肢体也能配合高超武术。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME train their agility relentlessly, working to limber up their magma bodies. Their training makes them dedicated partners for experienced trainers, and their burning hot limbs complement their advanced martial techniques.

entry: POKENAME很容易绊倒，让头上的裂口喷出熔岩。随后常会放声大哭，直到母亲前来安慰。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are prone to tripping a lot, causing the slits on their heads to burst out lava. This often makes them burst out in tears until their mothers come to soothe them.

entry: POKENAME和幼崽住在熔岩湖旁。湖一旦凝固，它们就会跋涉数英里寻找新家，对栖息熔岩的成分十分挑剔。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME and their hatchlings live beside lava lakes. Whenever these lakes solidify, POKENAME will march for miles in search of a new home. They are very particular about the makeup of the lava they live in.

entry: POKENAME鼻子会流出熔岩般的黏液，接触冷空气后，硬化成光亮的黑石。
author: .izik
source: A stream of lava-like mucus drips from POKENAME's nose. When exposed to cold air, it hardens into glossy black rock.

entry: POKENAME鼻子不断滴下的熔岩，会补充身体坚硬的外壳。它一感冒，就没有谁是安全的。
author: kiwiarms
source: The lava constantly dripping from its nose replenishes the hard outer shell of POKENAME's body. If it catches a cold, nobody is safe.

entry: POKENAME偶尔深入地下，将体温升至华氏18,000度，再有意冷却背部，形成坚硬的鞘。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME occasionally delves deeper underground to raise its temperature to 18,000 degrees F and strategically cools its back into a hard sheath.

entry: POKENAME的双剑会用心灵感应配合战斗。防守时硬化岩石外壳，进攻时则脱去外壳，用熔岩刃劈斩、灼伤敌人。
author: oddwalls
source: The twin swords of POKENAME coordinate their combat telepathically. When defending, they harden their rocky outer shells, but when attacking, they shed the shells to slash and burn foes with blades of lava.

entry: 阿罗拉地区认为POKENAME十分神圣。它从熔岩流家园降下时，会烧掉旧植被，留下肥土供新生命生长。每逢这种不定期事件，人们都会举办节庆。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME are considered sacred in the Alola region. When they descend from their homes in the lava flows, they burn away the old foliage and leave behind fertile soil for new growth. This irregular event is celebrated with a festival.

entry: POKENAME的身体同时存在于硬壳和锤子里。意识虽然一分为二，行动却配合得天衣无缝。
author: flagbearer
source: A POKENAME's body is within both the hardened shell and the hammer. Though the mind is split between the two, they work in perfect unison.

entry: POKENAME体温极高，身体不停硬化又熔化。它会从背上尖端开口的刺排出余热，也可能借此推动身体向前，用角刺击对手。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have remarkably hot bodies that are always in a cycle of hardening and melting. They vent excess heat through open-tipped spikes along their backs, which may also propel them forward to jab opponents with their horns.

entry: POKENAME每次狩猎后，都会用岩浆身体的热量重新锻造刀刃。保养时有时会遭对手伏击，能用钝刃击退袭击的个体，被认为是野外最出众的。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME reforge their blades using the heat of their magma bodies after each hunt. They are sometimes ambushed by rivals when maintaining their blades. POKENAME who can fend off attacks with dull blades are considered apex specimens in the wild.

entry: POKENAME的群体等级森严，重视力量与战术。需要战斗时，它会制定复杂精妙的策略，带领同伴获胜。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME live in a strict hierarchy, where strength and the art of war matter. If POKENAME need fight, they will develop complex yet clever strategies to lead their friends to victory.

entry: POKENAME体表通常覆着冷却的岩浆，有人因此误以为它能量不足。其实它极善控制能量输出，眨眼间就能化作轻捷的烈焰形态。
author: imaginita
source: Because its body is usually covered with cooled magma, some are tricked into believing it is low on energy.  In truth, POKENAME are very adept at controlling their energy output, and can burst into a lithe, flaming form in the blink of an eye.

entry: POKENAME除了头部的耐热装甲，整个身体都由熔融钢铁构成。它只捕猎其他钢属性宝可梦，将对方的金属部分熔进自己身体。
author: secondegg
source: POKENAME's entire body is made of molten steel, save for the heat-resistant plating on its head. It exclusively hunts other Steel-type Pokémon, melting their metal parts into its own body.

entry: POKENAME的镜片能保护双眼，抵御栖息岩浆坑中的极热。它会扩大背上火焰，威吓敌人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's lenses protect their eyes from the extreme heat of magma pits they inhabit. They expand the flames on their backs to intimidate enemies.

entry: POKENAME住在火山口深处，极难寻踪。据说有幸瞥见它的对象，都会精神振奋。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME live deep inside volcanic craters. Those who are lucky enough to catch a glimpse of the elusive Pokémon are said to have their spirits invigorated.

entry: POKENAME常停在火山边缘等待猎物，再俯冲下去，用嘴叼住，扔进火山里。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are usually seen perched on the edges of volcanos, waiting for prey. They swoop down, snatching their prey in their jaws and dropping them into the volcano.

entry: POKENAME壳外的环不停旋转，提供可供利用的再生能源。只一只储存的能量，就足以给大型铸造厂供热供电。
author: oddwalls
source: The ring around its shell constantly rotates, providing a renewable source of accessible energy. A single POKENAME stores enough energy to heat and power large foundries.

entry: POKENAME会用石层裹住丰厚的毛发，防止被自身火焰和岩浆点燃、熔毁。不过用幻象变换外貌时，部分石头太难遮掩，必须先剥下来。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME encases its large fur in stone to prevent it from catching on fire or being melted away by its fire and magma. However, it must break some of this stone off when using illusions to change its appearance since they're too difficult to hide.

entry: POKENAME的黑色身体是硬化岩浆，鬃毛却是发光熔岩。它会用幻象掩护，靠近猎物，再喷出灼热火焰、浓黑烟，或用石壳猛烈冲撞。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's black body is made of hardened magma, with a glowing mane of molten rock. POKENAME cloaks itself in illusion to get close to prey, then attacks with blasts of scorching fire or thick black smoke, or heavy bashes with its rocky shell.

entry: POKENAME的触须覆着薄薄一层不断流动的熔岩，让身体始终保持高热。它似乎能在一瞬间改变熔岩流向。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feelers are coated in a thin layer of constantly shifting lava. It uses this to keep its body perpetually hot, somehow altering the flow at a moment's notice.

entry: POKENAME体形相当大，住在海底火山和深海其他热区附近。身体烫得无法触碰，能阻吓其他水下宝可梦的物理攻击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are rather large Pokémon that live near underwater volcanoes and other hotspots within the ocean depths. Their bodies are too hot to be touched, which helps to ward off physical attacks of other underwater Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME很少待在地表，因为岩浆身体待得越久，越会冷却硬化。因此多数时间都睡在赤热的地下洞穴里，灼热熔岩淹着家园的大部分。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME spends little time on land above the surface since its magma body cools and hardens the longer it's up there. Therefore, it spends most of its time slumbering in red-hot caves underground, where hot lava floods the majority of its home.

entry: POKENAME在火山地区高空飞行，喷发时才降下，吸食火山气体。过去每次目击后都紧接灾变，因此一度被视为毁灭的预兆。
author: secondegg
source: POKENAME flies high in the sky above volcanic regions, descending during eruptions to feed on volcanic gases. It was once believed to be a harbinger of destruction, as its only sightings were followed by cataclysmic events.

entry: 神奥传说称，POKENAME曾合力冷却岩浆，创造各个地区。它们还操纵时间，加快冷却，结果自身身体也硬化、暗淡下来。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Sinnoh tales describe POKENAME working together to cool magma to create the various regions. These stories claim that POKENAME manipulated time to accelerate the cooling process, leading to their own bodies to harden and dim.

entry: POKENAME能操纵熔岩与岩石，压成球体，随意瞬间传送。它住在活火山内，入侵者会被这些球砸中，力道如陨石坠落。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can manipulate lava and stone, compressing it into spheres it can teleport at will. Living within active volcanoes, trespassers find themselves pelted by these orbs hurtling with the force of falling meteors.

entry: POKENAME虽满是熔岩，却从不烧坏地面，因为滴下的熔岩立刻就会被瞬间传送走。有人认为直接送进了地下，让许多稳定山岳变成喷发的火山。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: Though it's overflowing with lava, POKENAME never burns the ground because any that drips off of it is immediately teleported away. Some believe it is teleported directly into the ground, transforming many stable mountains into explosive volcanoes.

entry: 熔岩通常是滚烫液体，POKENAME的却反其道而行，是温暖的固体。主要也是最猛烈的攻击，是射出大块岩石，碰到敌人后便熔成岩浆。
author: soup1900
source: Despite lava typically being a burning hot liquid, POKENAME's lava flips that logic on its head, being a warm, solid material instead. Its most violent and main attack involves blasting large rock fragments at foes that melt into magma upon contact.

entry: 传说这种宝可梦只要一动，就能让火山开始活跃。六只眼睛能同时盯着不同的东西。
author: infinex21
source: There are legends that speak of this Pokémon, claiming that its movements cause volcanoes to become active. Its six eyes can each watch different things at the same time.

entry: 它住在偏远火山口。察觉有入侵者进领地，就会悄悄哄其入睡，再用岩浆身体将其整个裹住，景象骇人。
author: h0bojoe
source: It lives in remote volcanic craters. If it senses intruders in its territory, it will sneakily lull them to sleep before horrifically enveloping them with its magma body.

entry: POKENAME容易施暴，总觉得自己正受到威胁。熔岩队试图拿它做实验，已在基地引发许多事故。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are prone to violence, always assuming they're under threat. Many incidents have been caused in Team Magma bases due to them trying to experiment on POKENAME.

entry: 某些地区的古老传说似乎以POKENAME为主角，讲述王国因过分贪婪与傲慢，遭熔融巨龙的力量彻底熔毁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears to be the subject of ancient legends in some regions, that speak of kingdoms becoming too greedy and being melted away for their hubris by the powers of a molten dragon.

entry: 据说POKENAME会在月夜从火山池里现身起舞。它们收集月之石，附在石壳上。
author: vic1312
source: It is said that POKENAME emerge from volcanic pools to dance on moonlit nights. They collect moon stones and attach them to their rocky shells.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴由导电的熔融岩石构成，快速旋转便能在其中发电。战斗时常向对手抛掷岩浆团和火球。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's tail is made of molten, conductive rock that can generate electricity within it by spinning rapidly. It often fights by hurling globs of magma and fireballs at its opponents.

entry: 充满电时，POKENAME的岩浆身体和火焰都会变蓝。此时掷出的火球、岩浆团也变得很容易爆炸。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's magmatic body and flames turn blue when it is fully charged with electricity. In this state, the balls of flame and magma that it tosses become rather explosive.

entry: POKENAME只有喷出烈焰的部位能冷却成石。其他部分都是灼热冒泡的岩浆，每次发动攻击，都有溢出身体的危险。
author: soup1900
source: The only parts of POKENAME's body that can cool and solidify into stone are the sections where it blasts out hot flames. The rest is made of hot, bubbling magma that is under constant threat of spilling from its body if it unleashes an attack.

entry: POKENAME会先喷出熔岩，再用极寒的冰冻光束冻住，将目标封进坚硬黑曜石。不过攻击后，岩浆身体会不稳定，因此也得冷成黑曜石，维持完整。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME attacks, it lets out a blast of lava before freezing it over with an ultracold Ice Beam to encase the target in hard obsidian. However, after the attack, its magma body destabilizes, so it also cools it into obsidian to keep it intact.

entry: POKENAME会让部分岩浆身体积成层，冷却为石头，更好地集中火焰。它让热量在四肢循环，即使石头压得沉重，也能自由移动。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME allow portions of their magma-like bodies to collect in layers and cool into stone to better concentrate their flames. They cycle heat through their limbs to ensure they can move freely despite the stone weighing them down.

entry: POKENAME懒洋洋地飘过活火山，漂游在烟灰之间，常被误认为溅出的一团熔岩。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats lazily over active volcanoes, drifting through smoke and ash. It's often mistaken for a wayward splash of lava.

entry: POKENAME察觉危险时，会将岩浆身体硬化成壳。若被逼迫，就会破壳而出，踢出热得足以让铁沸腾的一脚。
author: ilazerheart
source: When POKENAME senses danger, it hardens its magma body into a shell. If pressured, it bursts from its shell and delivers a fiery kick hot enough to boil iron.

entry: POKENAME会从帽子撒出火星，引发小火。夏至或冬至庆典上，人们常把它们聚在一起，点燃仪式篝火。它们也会互相交战，敲出稳定的鼓点。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME scatter sparks from their caps that can start small fires. Groups of them are often brought together to ignite ritual bonfires at solstice celebrations. They engage in combat with one another at these events, providing a steady drumbeat.

entry: POKENAME动作快得肉眼几乎看不见。不过壳里冒出的火，有时会意外点燃自己的翅膀。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are quick enough to be barely seen by the human eye. The fire coming out of their shells can accidentally light their wings ablaze.

entry: 北方某些群落很崇敬POKENAME，视为守护者，因为领地有入侵者时，它会从熔岩池里冲出。不过研究者如今已知道，它其实爱玩，跳出来吓人只是恶作剧。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME are revered as defenders by certain northern communities, as they burst from lava pools when someone intrudes into their volcanic territory. However, researchers now know that POKENAME are playful and pop out to scare people as a joke.

entry: POKENAME壳里的岩浆转得极快，像发电机一样产电，形成电磁场，仿佛一层膜，包住液态身体。
author: imaginita
source: Inside the shell is magma spinning so fast that it acts as an electric generator, producing an electromagnetic field that encloses POKENAME's liquid body like a membrane.

entry: POKENAME外层的性质类似硅砂，能帮助专业玻璃吹制工取得制作钠钙玻璃的原料。
author: bigoljax
source: The outer layer of POKENAME has a similar property to silica sand. This helps professional glassblowers get the materials to make soda-lime glass.

entry: POKENAME会在火山深处积蓄能量，再将自己弹上天空，试图飞向月亮。人们会定期记录它的栖息地与迁徙，免得误当成火山正在喷发的迹象。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME build up energy from deep within volcanoes before launching themselves into the air in an attempt to fly to the moon. POKENAME habitats and migrations are regularly recorded to avoid them being confused for the signs of an active eruption.

entry: POKENAME壳缝偶尔漏出熔岩，却会迅速冷却，慢慢堆厚外壳，让它一天比一天大。
author: bigoljax
source: Lava occasionally leaks out of the cracks of POKENAME's shell, though it quickly cools. This slowly builds up their shells, growing larger and larger each day.

entry: POKENAME常在熔岩河里游泳，不断寻找猎物，平时主要吃鸭嘴火兽和小火马。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME often swim through lava rivers, constantly on the hunt. Their usual diet consists of Magmar and Ponyta.

entry: POKENAME外表吓人，常惊吓偶然遇见它的探险者。其实它很友好，会用双臂抓住两岸，让石质身体搭成桥，供大家跨过流动熔岩。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME possess an intimidating appearance and often scare explorers who stumble upon them. Truthfully, they are quite friendly and offer their rocky bodies as a bridge across active lava flows, using their arms to grip each bank.

entry: 护士有时会请POKENAME缓解关节酸痛。它将加热的丝网裹在患处，缓慢而轻柔地传递暖意。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are sometimes used by nurses to ease aching joints. POKENAME will wrap heated webbing around afflicted areas, spreading a slow, gentle heat throughout.

entry: 液态双腿让POKENAME走路不便。长途旅行时，它会用脚把自己焊在路过的车上，也会附在钢属性或岩石属性宝可梦身上。
author: oddwalls
source: Their fluid legs make locomotion awkward. To travel long distances, POKENAME use their feet to weld themselves to passing vehicles. They will also attach themselves to Steel-type and Rock-type Pokémon.

entry: 某些角度下，熔岩会遮住POKENAME的脸，常让它被误当成真正蜡烛。不知情的顾客伸手去拿，就会烫伤。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are often mistaken for actual candles due to their lava hiding their faces at certain angles. This causes unknowing customers to burn their hands trying to grab them.

entry: POKENAME玻璃般的头里装着发光液体，比熔岩凉，却仍会烫伤触碰的对象。它会用来抵御捕食者。
author: .izik
source: The glowing liquid inside POKENAME's glassy head is cooler than lava but still burns to the touch. It uses it to defend itself from predators.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在寒冷黑暗的地方，散出诱人的暖意与光。然而传说，待在身旁太久，就会被迫越靠越近，直到被火烧得只剩灰烬。
author: secondegg
source: POKENAME lurks in cold, dark areas, providing an alluring source of warmth and light. However, it is said that those who stay near it for too long will be compelled closer and closer to its flame, until ashes are all that remains.

entry: POKENAME的石獠牙强大而危险，却太脆，难以在战斗中有效运用。因此更喜欢谨慎出手，只用边沿流动熔岩勾出的灼热刃口攻击。
author: soup1900
source: While POKENAME has overwhelmingly powerful and dangerous stone tusks, they are too brittle to be used effectively in combat. Therefore, it prefers to delicately attack using only the searing edges of the tusks where flowing lava outlines them.

entry: POKENAME靠核心岩浆驱动，主要出没于寒冷地区的古代遗迹。研究者因此推测，古文明可能曾依靠它取暖。
author: secondegg
source: Powered by the magma within its core, POKENAME is mainly found within ancient ruins in cold regions. For this reason, researchers theorize that ancient civilizations once relied on them for warmth.

entry: POKENAME最初只有一条装满熔岩的石尾。每当尾巴裂开，熔岩流出、冷却，就会形成一条全新的尾巴。
author: secondegg
source: At first, POKENAME has a single rocky tail, filled with lava. When this tail cracks, the lava leaks out and cools, forming an entirely new tail each time.

entry: POKENAME必须先吐出体内大部分岩浆，才能观察周围，或与外界互动。它喜欢把大半时间花在沸腾的岩浆池里浸泡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME must spew up much of its magma innards in order to view or interact with its surroundings in any capacity. It enjoys spending much of its time soaking in boiling magma pools.

entry: POKENAME俯冲快得惊人，借炽热的利爪烧灼猎物。动作精准又迅猛，猎物几乎来不及感到疼痛，是令人畏惧的高效空中猎手。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME dives at incredible speeds, searing its prey at intense temperatures through its claws. Its precision and velocity ensure the process is almost painless for its victim, making it a feared but efficient hunter in the skies.

entry: POKENAME会混在熔岩蜗牛群里，尝试模仿它们。偶尔会专心试着达到高得离谱的温度，可惜总是失败，只把自己累得不轻。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be spotted in groups of Magcargo, attempting to imitate their behaviors. Occasionally, they will concentrate on trying to reach an absurdly hot temperature. Unfortunately, this always fails, leaving POKENAME very tired.

entry: POKENAME能随意移动身上的火山岩鳞片，在穿过喷发时，保护黏稠身体免受冲击。据说鳞片的排列方式，对同类可能有某种含义。
author: vic1312
source: The volcanic rock scales on the body of POKENAME can move at their will. They use this to defend their viscous bodies from impacts when flying through eruptions. It is said that the arrangement of scales may mean something to other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME若没能一直保持火山般的温度，岩浆身体就会开始冷却，常挡住视线。它便漫无目的地游荡、撞墙，直到石壳脱落。
author: santon5512
source: If POKENAME don't stay in constant volcanic temperatures, then their magma bodies will begin to cool, often inhibiting their vision. This leaves these Pokémon wandering aimlessly, bumping into walls until the rocky shell breaks off.

entry: POKENAME从火山口升起时，咆哮声在数英里外都能听见。人们常召来许多强大训练家，平息它的暴走。
author: bigoljax
source: As they rise from volcanic craters, POKENAME's roars can be heard from miles away. Many strong trainers are called to calm a POKENAME's rampage.

entry: POKENAME用滚烫的翅膀轻松翱翔。两颗较小的“头”没有大脑，似乎只是用来引导、喷吐火焰和岩浆。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their burning-hot wings to soar through the air with ease. The two smaller "heads" of a POKENAME lack brains and seem to only serve to help channel and spew fire and magma.

entry: POKENAME身体庞大，很难自行起飞，便会选在火山即将喷发的位置，借力冲上天空。升空后，它会飞向强烈情感的来源，往往是热情的训练家。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME struggle to take flight on their own due to their bulky bodies. They position themselves within future eruptions to launch themselves in the air. They will fly towards strong sources of emotion once airborne, often passionate Trainers.

entry: POKENAME的身体由熔岩构成，内部温度足以熔化大多数材料。接触空气后冷却的岩石形成皮肤，而尾巴往往比身体凉一些。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have bodies composed of molten lava, their internal temperature high enough to cause most materials to melt. Their skin is rock that has cooled on contact with the air, their tails often being comparatively cooler than their bodies.

entry: 太空望远镜曾观测到POKENAME漂在高层大气之上，绕行星一段时间后，再一头冲回地面。它常被误认为陨石。
author: wiz0z
source: Space telescopes have observed POKENAME drifting above the upper atmosphere, where it orbits the planet for a while before launching itself back down to the planet. It is often mistaken for a meteorite.

entry: 过去人们认为，把心爱之物投入火中，POKENAME就会实现愿望。一个痴迷火山的教团曾崇拜它，定期举行献祭仪式。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME were once thought to grant wishes to those who cast something beloved into flames. A volcano-obsessed cult used to venerate them, conducting regular ritual sacrifices in their honor.

entry: POKENAME常睡在火山内部的岩浆里。被喷发抛出来、划过天空时，常会被误认为流星。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME often slumber within magma inside volcanoes. When expelled by eruptions, they are mistaken for shooting stars as they streak across the sky.

entry: POKENAME本能地想拦坝截流，因此减灾队伍常在火山喷发时请它帮忙。它会用逐渐冷却的岩浆和岩石，改变熔岩流向，避开附近城镇。
author: vic1312
source: Due to their instinct to dam up flowing streams, POKENAME are often deployed by disaster mitigation teams at active volcanic eruptions. Using a combination of cooling magma and rocks, they redirect lava flows away from nearby towns.

entry: POKENAME会长途跋涉训练，逐渐增加背壳的大小与重量。两只相遇时，会放下各自的壳，友好地切磋。
author: wiz0z
source: To train itself, POKENAME travels long distances while slowly increases the size and weight of the shell on its back. When two POKENAME meet, they will drop their shells and engage in a friendly sparring match.

entry: POKENAME靠自身体热维生，能一连数周完全不动。移动时从不用四肢，更喜欢像熔岩流一样滑过地面。
author: oddwalls
source: Sustained by its own body heat, POKENAME can go weeks at a time without moving at all. It never uses its limbs to travel, preferring to slide across the ground like a lava flow.

entry: POKENAME精力仿佛无穷，比多数熔岩蜗牛融合体行动更快、也更不知疲倦。移动时四肢乱挥，岩浆到处飞溅，最好远远绕开。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's sheer boundless energy lets it move at a quicker, more relentless pace than most Magcargo fusions. Bits of lava fling about as it swings its limbs wildly while moving, so giving it a wide berth is recommended.

entry: POKENAME的身体浮力极强，避免与栖身的火山湖完全混在一起。冷却岩浆构成的下半身既能防护，也能用强力泰山压顶还击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have extremely buoyant bodies that allow them to avoid completely melding with the volcanic lakes they live in. Their lower halves made of cooled magma help to defend them, but also allow them to fight back with strong Body Slams.

entry: POKENAME兴奋或遇险时，身体会热得发亮。它能将更多能量导向尾巴，控制亮度，向远处同伴传信。
author: imaginita
source: When excited or in danger, POKENAME's body glows with heat. By directing more energy to its tail, it can control how brightly it glows and send signals to its allies from a distance.

entry: 平静时，POKENAME身体会慢慢冷却成脆壳。即使一动不动，经验丰富的训练家也能看出它被什么吸引了注意，因为壳里会开始噼啪迸出火星。
author: imaginita
source: When calm, POKENAME's body slowly cools into a brittle carapace. Adept Trainers will know when something has caught this Pokémon's attention, even if it remains still, because sparks will start crackling through the shell.

entry: POKENAME的身体由熔岩构成，内部温度足以熔化大多数材料。接触空气后冷却的岩石形成皮肤，移动时会裂出纵横交错的缝。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have bodies composed of molten lava, their internal temperature high enough to cause most materials to melt. Their skin is rock that has cooled on contact with the air, webs of cracks crossing across them whenever they move.

entry: POKENAME不唱胖丁通常那种甜美催眠的歌，而是唱得像死亡金属乐，吓得对手惊慌逃跑。
author: bigoljax
source: Instead of the sweet, sleep-inducing music Jigglypuff usually sings, POKENAME sings in a manner similar to death metal. This causes opponents to run away in shock and fear.

entry: POKENAME成群住在火山洞窟深处，吃滴落岩浆中富含铁的玄武岩。洞穴塌了，就直接啃穿碎石出去。
author: ilazerheart
source: Groups of POKENAME live deep in volcanic caverns, eating the iron-rich basalt from dripping magma. If the cavern collapses, they simply gnaw their way through the rubble.

entry: POKENAME会浸泡、饮用熔岩流，把石质身体淬炼得如钢铁般耐用。身上的裂石，是过去领地争斗的痕迹。
author: ilazerheart
source: POKENAME tempers its stone body to a durability comparable to steel by bathing in and drinking from lava flows. Cracked stones on its body are evidence of past territorial disputes.

entry: 野生POKENAME藏在火山岩下，等猎物从上方经过。大嘴一合，就在里面将猎物活活烤熟。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME hide beneath volcanic rock and wait for prey to pass overhead. They snap their maws shut and cook prey alive within.

entry: POKENAME的火焰翅膀必须极快振动，才有足够力量托起厚重外壳。飞行时，振翅会发出低沉的滋滋声。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's fiery wings have to flap at a very rapid speed in order to exert enough strength to lift its hefty shell. When in flight, its wing-beat makes a deep sound akin to sizzling.

entry: POKENAME常住在死火山留下的零星浅岩浆池里。虽然没多少岩浆能游，它通常也不在乎，毕竟本来就几乎不动。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are often found living in the sparse, shallow magma pockets left in an extinct volcano. While they don't have much magma to swim in, they typically don't mind or care since they barely move to begin with.

entry: POKENAME驮着冷却岩浆形成的大壳，防止柔软的上部受到空中宝可梦袭击。对方有时会被壳弹开，随后它爬过其身体，常将其活活烤熟。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME lug large shells made of cooled magma around to protect their softer tops from aerial Pokémon. Sometimes, Pokémon that try to attack them from above will bounce off and they will crawl over them, often cooking them alive.

entry: POKENAME能让壳内岩浆像涡轮一样旋转发电，借电力浮在空中。岩浆冷却后，就只能在地上爬，直到吃进更多岩浆。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME can spin the magma stored in its shell like a turbine, which creates electricity that it uses to float above the ground. When the magma cools, POKENAME must crawl on the ground until it can consume more.

entry: POKENAME若无法飘走逃离威胁，最后便会向追兵射出熔岩球。但壳里储存的熔岩损失太多，就会坠落地面。
author: oddwalls
source: If POKENAME cannot escape a threat by floating away, it will eject balls of lava at its pursuer as a last resort. Losing too much of the lava reserves in its shell will bring it crashing to the ground.

entry: POKENAME会在火山附近变成小孩的模样，引诱旅人前来，设法骗进灌满熔岩的裂缝，再将其吃掉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a human child near volcanic environments to lure travelers to its location. It attempts to trick them into lava-filled crevices before feeding on them.

entry: POKENAME偶尔会滴落熔岩、脱落腹部鳞片。饲养它的训练家常把这些小而脆的鳞片磨亮，制成首饰。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME shed drips of lava and the scales along their bellies occasionally. Trainers who raise POKENAME often have the small, fragile scales polished and turned into jewelry.

entry: POKENAME能鼓起身体，装作熔岩泡。它的熔岩偏温暖，不算滚烫，很适合当暖炉。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME can mimic lava bubbles by inflating themselves. Their lava is more warm than hot, making them great heaters.

entry: 为了震慑敌人，POKENAME会吸气，再高温加热，让身体胀得极其庞大。安全后，就完全放气，平躺着晒太阳，为下次战斗补充能量。
author: notadoctor75
source: To deter their foes, POKENAME will intake air and superheat it to expand their bodies to a gargantuan size. Once they are safe, they will deflate their bodies completely and lie flat in the sun, recharging their energy stores for the next battle.

entry: POKENAME的身体是硬化的火山灰，会封住花苞，保护里面引火用的小火苗。核心岩浆含有毒物质，让身上飘落的灰也不宜吸入。
author: vic1312
source: With a body consisting of hardened volcanic ash, POKENAME seal their bud to protect the pilot flame within. The magma at their core carries toxic materials within, making the ash that blows off them hazardous to breath.

entry: POKENAME能从手上的石花伸出长度有限的熔岩藤蔓。有趣的是，花里流出的岩浆仍带着淡淡花香，在丰缘颇受欢迎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME extends short-range vines of lava from the stone flowers on its hands. Interestingly, the magma from these flowers retains a faint floral scent, one that is fairly popular in Hoenn.

entry: 人们曾见POKENAME用触须抓起野生熔岩虫，带到附近火山里倒进去。为什么这样做，尚不清楚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been observed using its tendrils to grab hold of wild Slugma and lift them away. It dumps the other Pokémon into nearby volcanoes, though why it does so is not known.

entry: POKENAME受到威胁时，能展开卷曲的石耳，打出如燃烧炮弹般有力的一击。特别冷的夜晚，它们会聚在一起。
author: ilazerheart
source: By uncoiling its rocky ears, a threatened POKENAME can strike with the force comparable to that of a flaming cannonball. They group together on especially cold nights.

entry: POKENAME住在火山口，会把自己塞进找到的喷口。火山气体不断积在堵住的口内，最后像迫击炮一样把它高高抛上天空。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME live in craters, plugging themselves into any vents that they can find. Volcanic gasses build up within the blocked vents, eventually launching them high into the air like a mortar.

entry: POKENAME沿刚喷发过的火山坡滑行，吞食含重金属的岩石，留下适合植物新生的土壤。岛民很珍视它恢复喷发后环境的能力。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME glide along the slopes of recently erupted volcanoes, consuming rocks that contain heavy metals and leaving behind soil primed for new plant growth. Island communities prize them for their restorative capability post-eruption.

entry: POKENAME会吐舌头发出噗噗声，还会灼烧对手的身体下侧，强迫对方产生愤怒等负面情绪。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME can force negative emotions like anger within their opponents. They do this by spitting raspberries and burning the undersides of their opponent.

entry: 熔岩层内的石头才是POKENAME真正的身体。它会在岩浆里滚动，让外层越来越厚。
author: bigoljax
source: The rock inside the lava layering is POKENAME's true body. They build their layering up more by rolling in magma.

entry: POKENAME会在火山脚下结成最多五只的小群，橙色身体黏糊糊地挤在一起，微微颤动。即使冬天，也能让周围最远100英尺内热得难耐。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rest in quivering, slimy orange clusters of up to five at the base of volcanoes. Even during winter, this can raise the surrounding temperature to sweltering levels up to 100 feet away.

entry: POKENAME顶部看似岩浆的部分，其实是鲜橙色的棉花，质地和保暖性都备受珍视。织成的衣服，在最寒冷的环境中也能保持温暖。
author: oddwalls
source: What looks like magma on POKENAME's top is actually bright orange cotton, prized not only for its quality but also for its warmth. Clothing made from POKENAME cotton remains warm in even the coldest temperatures.

entry: 它们会钻过灼热沙漠，免得熔融身体冷却。钻过的地方，都会留下一条条玻璃隧道。
author: secondegg
source: They burrow through hot desert sands to prevent their molten bodies from cooling down. Wherever they have burrowed, they leave tunnels of glass.

entry: POKENAME必须不停扇翅，免得冷却硬化，影响飞行。它会扑落到猎物身上，借熔融身体的热量烤熟对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME must flap its wings constantly to keep them from cooling and hardening enough to limit its flight. It hunts by falling upon prey and letting the heat of its molten body cook them.

entry: POKENAME的身体不断产生细尘般的火星，通常被风吹走。火星却可能意外点燃灌木，险些引发山火。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's bodies constantly produce dust-like embers, usually blowing away in the wind. These embers can accidentally light bushes aflame, almost causing forest fires.

entry: POKENAME会紧抱一块特殊火山岩，拼命保护。据说若被强行分开，身体就会失去凝聚力，化作一滩毫无生气的岩浆。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME clutches a special chunk of volcanic rock tightly to itself, guarding it fiercely. It is said that if one were to forcibly part it from the stone, its body would lose cohesion and turn into a lifeless puddle of magma.

entry: POKENAME靠吸取其他火属性宝可梦的能量生存。半熔融身体既耐极热，也能紧黏选中的宿主。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME find their niche in absorbing energy from other Fire-type Pokémon. Their semi-molten bodies allow them to withstand extreme temperatures and help them stick fast to their chosen host.

entry: POKENAME身体明亮，放出的热却很少。石刺能让它攀住洞壁，因此矿工常请它在洞穴里当灯笼照路。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME's body glows brightly but gives off little heat. Because POKENAME can cling to stone walls with their rocky spines, miners use them as lanterns when navigating caves.

entry: POKENAME有一根火山岩角。随年龄和生长脱落的碎片极其锋利，古人会收集来当菜刀。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME possess a horn of volcanic stone. The shards they shed as they age and grow are incredibly sharp. People in ancient times would collect these shards to use as cooking knives.

entry: POKENAME獠牙的边沿是熔融岩浆，切开障碍就像热刀切黄油。若獠牙折断，它会仔细浸入熔岩，将其修复。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME's tusks are made of molten magma at the edges.  This allows them to slice through obstacles like a hot knife through butter.  If one is broken, the POKENAME can restore it by dipping it meticulously into lava.

entry: POKENAME会一连数小时站在古墓台座上，纹丝不动地守护。发现入侵者，就会接连吐出熔岩。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stands motionless on pedestals in ancient tombs for hours to watch over them. When it spots an intruder, it spits lava at them in rapid bursts.

entry: POKENAME大多时候都攀在活火山内缘。躯干周围的石头保护最敏感的部分，也对日后的进化十分关键。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends much of its time clinging to the inner rims of active volcanoes. The stones around its torso shield its most sensitive parts, and play a crucial part in helping it evolve later in its life.

entry: POKENAME在空中翱翔，嘴里喷出熔融熔岩。发亮的轨迹如流星般照亮夜空。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME soars through the sky spewing molten lava from its mouth. Its glowing trail lights up the night like falling stars.

entry: POKENAME不被打扰就藏在壳里。如果感觉有东西碰壳，石头就会裂开，熔岩身体涌出，烧伤招惹它的对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides within its shell unless disturbed. If it feels something touch the shell, the stone cracks open and POKENAME's lava body spills out to burn the whatever bothered it.

entry: 它带着一大块火山岩当盾牌。盾牌变得不够坚固时，就用高温的爪子制作新的。
author: melodydelune
source: It carries around a large volcanic rock it uses as a shield. When weakened, it will make a new shield with its high-temperature claws.

entry: 它的石盾原本由硫磺、煤、铁，以及钻石、祖母绿等不同宝石层层组成。如今已全融成不透明、形状不规则的熔渣。
author: epping_forest
source: Its rock shield was once composed by different layers of brimstone, coal, iron and different gems like diamonds and emeralds.  Nowadays, they all have merged into an opaque irregular slag.

entry: POKENAME会钻穿坚实岩石，挖出延伸数英里的复杂隧道网。它在洞顶刻槽，标记所处位置，再用触角摸索，在黑暗中辨路。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME bore their way through solid rock, creating complex tunnel networks that can stretch for miles. They leave grooves in the ceiling of their tunnels to mark where in the network they are, feeling their way through the dark with their antennae.

entry: POKENAME几乎全身都覆着冷却硬化的熔岩，保护进化中的身体。快进化时，它会滚上最近的火山，再钻进去完成蜕变。
author: sk372
source: Almost all of POKENAME's body is covered by a layer of cooled, hardened lava, protecting the body while it evolves. When evolution draws near, it will roll up the side of the nearest volcano, diving in to complete its transformation.

entry: POKENAME神情悲伤，是因为失去了曾经迅捷的行动。如今只能漫无目的地滑行，寻找小小的慰藉，安抚受伤的心。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's saddened expressions are caused by the loss of their once quick movements. They aimlessly glide around instead, finding small comforts to soothe their wounded hearts.

entry: POKENAME几乎忍不住总想用滚烫双颚啃咬、磨嚼东西。有时甚至会从自己身上扯下冷却硬化的岩浆块，只为满足这股冲动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has an almost irresistible urge to bite and gnash things with its heated jaws. At times, it may tear chunks of cooled and hardened magma from its own body just to sate this compulsion.

entry: POKENAME咆哮时，参差的石牙会热得通红。一口就能在坚实岩石上留下熔融的裂痕。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME roars, its jagged stone fangs glow red-hot. One bite can leave molten cracks in solid rock.

entry: 最初发现时，研究者以为POKENAME是被熔岩之灵附身的骨骼化石。其实看似骨头的部分，只是岩浆身体硬化成的坚实石头。
author: sk372
source: Upon first discovery, researchers thought POKENAME was a fossilized skeleton possessed by lava spirits. What appear to be its bones are just parts of its magma body that have hardened into solid, sturdy stone.

entry: POKENAME住在多雪地区，许多宝可梦依靠它取暖。猛烈暴风雪里，雪还没落地就熔化，让它周围看起来像被气泡包住。
author: secondegg
source: POKENAME live in snowy regions, and many Pokémon rely on them for warmth. During strong blizzards, there appears to be a bubble around them due to the snow melting before it can touch the ground.

entry: POKENAME很难找到家：对北极太热，对火山又太冷。因此许多训练家乐意收留，给它一直渴望的温暖家园。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME struggle to find a home for themselves, as they're too hot for the arctic but also too cold for volcanoes. Because of this, many trainers like to take them in, giving them a warm home that many longed for so long.

entry: POKENAME像活火球，却能迅速冷却、冻结周围水分。也正因这种奇异力量，体表始终冷却硬化，形成耐用石壳。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are like living fireballs that have a paradoxical ability to rapidly cool and freeze moisture around them. Their own ability causes the outer layer of their bodies to always be cooled and hardened into a durable shell of rock.

entry: POKENAME坐在活火山的岩浆池里，招手叫旅人跟自己进入深处。它不够聪明，始终想不通为什么没人照做。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME sits in pools of magma in active volcanoes, beckoning travelers to follow it into the depths. It is not intelligent enough to figure out why this does not work.

entry: 日落时，POKENAME会把自己埋进土里，灰叶随之脱落，一夜间重新长好。园丁会收集落叶当肥料。
author: oddwalls
source: When POKENAME bury themselves in the dirt at sundown, their ashen leaves drop off and regrow overnight. Gardeners collect fallen POKENAME leaves for use as fertilizer.

entry: POKENAME会扇翅卷起酷热强风，打向对手。背壳坚固却脆，因此总想正面迎敌。
author: darxer_
source: It uses its wings to whip sweltering gusts into its opponents. The shell on its back is strong but brittle, so POKENAME tries to always attack facing forward.

entry: POKENAME想用啦啦舞把火热带电的精神传给大家。多数喜欢火焰花球，也有人见过它挥舞纯粹由雷电构成的花球。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME seeks to use its cheering dance routines as a way to imbue others with its fiery and electrifying spirit. Though most prefer pom-poms made of fire, some POKENAME have been seen wielding ones made of pure lightning.

entry: POKENAME常被叫作“烫手垃圾”。虽然说得没错，听了却还是会伤心。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are often known as "Flaming Hot Garbage." Although true, it still hurts the Pokémon's feelings.

entry: 这些宝可梦的岩浆身体披着致密火山岩，内部却相当空。虽然什么易燃物都能吃，似乎更偏爱垃圾，废物在体内烧尽时，就会排出毒烟。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon have magmatic bodies clad in dense, volcanic rock that are otherwise very hollow. Although they can eat anything flammable, they seem to prefer to consume waste, which causes them to expel toxic fumes as the waste burns away within.

entry: POKENAME会成大群穿行于行星地幔，寻找猛烈火山喷发。有些科学家推测，数量够多时，迁徙本身就能引发喷发。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME travel through the planet's mantle, seeking explosive volcanic eruptions. They travel in vast schools, with some scientists postulating that in sufficient numbers, they can trigger eruptions due to their migration.

entry: POKENAME移动极快，连地下也能飞快穿行，沿途留下熔岩沟渠。它会用鼻尖熔穿猎物。
author: bigoljax
source: Fast enough to even speed through ground, POKENAME make lava canals as they move. They use the tips of their noses to melt through prey.

entry: 火山喷发后，POKENAME会从烧焦树桩里形成。树桩虽然覆着一层耐热灰，仍会被它的熔融身体慢慢烧尽。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME appear after volcanic eruptions, forming out of the burnt tree stumps. Despite the stump being coated in a layer of heat-resistant ash, POKENAME's molten body will slowly burn it away.

entry: 据说POKENAME想住在哪里，就会在那里引起山火，创造自己的栖息地。直到周围其他树都烧光，才觉得像家。
author: spookypookie.
source: It is said that POKENAME will create its own natural habitat by starting a forest fire wherever it wishes to reside. It will only feel at home once every other tree around it has burned down.

entry: 它头上花朵般的突起，能喷出气味强烈的灰。有些人喜欢这味道，但灰一沾皮肤，就会引起痛苦的灼烧感。
author: imaginita
source: The flower-like protrusion on its head can release an eruption of strong-smelling ash.  Some like the smell, but if the ash makes contact with skin, it will cause a painful burning sensation.

entry: 它会把最喜欢的水果收进壳里，用体热煮熟再吃。若有什么窥探，就会从入口朝对方轰出声波。
author: ilazerheart
source: It takes its favorite fruit into its shell, cooks it with its body heat, and eats it. If something peeks in, it unleashes sonic blasts out the entrance towards them.

entry: POKENAME的耳朵足以听见深层洞穴里的猎物。它会缩起身体旋转，用石翼尖端挖进那些洞穴。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's ears are strong enough to listen for prey deep down in caves. They tuck their bodies in before spinning, using the tips of their stone wings to dig down to these caves.

entry: POKENAME借火山烟雾构成的翅膀漂浮，前往寒冷地区，停在人们头顶帮忙取暖。极少数情况下，大群甚至能遮住太阳。
author: secondegg
source: Floating on wings of volcanic smoke, POKENAME travel to cold areas, perching on people's heads to keep them warm. Rarely, large flocks of these Pokémon have even been known to block out the sun.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛像一大团黑烟，低空飞行时，冒泡的岩浆尾巴常垂拖在下方。
author: infinex21
source: The feathers of a POKENAME are like a big cloud of black smoke. Their tails of bubbling magma often drag below them as they fly at low altitudes.

entry: POKENAME走到哪里，都留下一路黏稠滚烫的黏液。黏液极难清除，还曾引发山火，因此许多人觉得它是大麻烦。
author: secondegg
source: Wherever POKENAME travels, it leaves a trail of sticky, burning slime. It is considered a major nuisance by many, as its slime is incredibly difficult to remove, and has been known to cause wildfires.

entry: POKENAME身体的岩浆很黏，行动缓慢。为了不被捕食者捉住，它会引爆外壳，朝四面八方射出锋利的黑曜石碎片。
author: wiz0z
source: The magma of POKENAME's body is very viscous, making them quite slow. To avoid capture from predators, POKENAME detonate their shells, letting loose sharp obsidian shrapnel in all directions.

entry: POKENAME身上沸腾的橙色黏液，带着焦水果和汽油味。虽然形似熔岩，质地却更像胶水，冷却后曾被用来装订书籍。
author: .izik
source: The orange boiling slime covering POKENAME's body smells of burnt fruit and gasoline. Despite resembling lava, it is closer in consistency to glue and when cooled has been used in book bindings.

entry: 有些古老壁画描绘过与POKENAME相似的宝可梦。它温顺地住在岩浆池里，热量在壳内流动，让火山岩外壳甚至比身体更热。
author: infinex21
source: Some old murals depict Pokémon reminiscent of POKENAME. POKENAME are docile dwellers of magma pools, and their volcanic rock shells are even hotter than their bodies due to the heat flowing within them.

entry: 遇到强敌时，POKENAME石头般的耳朵会涌出火焰。若觉得打不过，它便缩进壳里，放出所有储存的热量，直到对手不再纠缠。
author: infinex21
source: Flames pour from the rock-like ears of POKENAME when they face a powerful opponent. If they believe themselves to be outmatched, they will withdraw inside of their shells and vent all of their stored heat until their opponent leaves them alone.

entry: POKENAME石质身体的裂缝会漏出蒸汽与极热岩浆。人们认为，它曾被奉为神圣守护者，栖息地附近的火山也被视为圣地。
author: sk372
source: Steam and incredibly hot magma leak out from the cracks of POKENAME's stone body. It is believed that it was considered a sacred guardian, and the volcanoes it lived near were considered holy spots.

entry: 身体原本全是熔融状态，经急速冷却后，大部分变成黑曜石。内部却仍蓄着大量热量。
author: jaycielantern
source: Its body was once all molten, but being quickly cooled turned most of it into obsidian. Its insides still retain a large amount of heat.

entry: POKENAME由岩浆构成，冷却后会变成混合的火山岩。它住在冷洞里，总想继续降温，因此有人送来冰凉的东西或旧石头，就会很开心。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME is made of magma that cools down into an amalgam of volcanic stone. It lives in cold caves and is constantly trying to cool down, so POKENAME is very happy when a human brings it something cold or an old stone.

entry: POKENAME胸前的小圆点才是真正的眼睛。攻击前，它会用假眼分散对方注意。
author: bigoljax
source: The small circles on POKENAME's chest are actually their true eyes. They use their false set of eyes as a way to distract before going on the offensive.

entry: 野生POKENAME常浸在岩浆或熔岩里，像漂浮的坚实岩块，供其他对象踩着走。受到威胁时，能从壳内释放浓密的麻痹气体。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME are often submerged in magma or lava, acting as floes of solid rock for others to walk upon. If they feel threatened, they can release a thick, paralytic gas from their shells.

entry: 它喜欢拥抱遇到的训练家，可体热惊人，难免无意间造成危险。不过与穿着熊不同，它能控制力道，只要备好耐热装备，也能安全地抱它。
author: secondegg
source: It loves to hug trainers it comes across, which makes it unintentionally dangerous due to its immense body heat. Unlike Bewear, it can control its strength and can even be safely hugged if one is properly equipped to withstand its heat.

entry: 锚上黏糊糊的藻类，才是POKENAME真正的身体。它分泌的油脂能让自己在水下燃烧。明亮的火焰在水面也能看见，引来了水下闹鬼的传说。
author: wiz0z
source: The oozing algae covering the anchor is the true body of POKENAME. It secretes an oil that allows it to light itself aflame underwater. These bright flames can be seen from the surface, giving rise to tales of ghosts beneath the water.

entry: POKENAME常栖息在海底火山附近，触手由凝固的岩浆构成。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: POKENAME often live near underwater volcanoes. Their tentacles are made of hardened magma.

entry: POKENAME的触手覆着岩石，硬得足以媲美钢铁。试图攻击触手的对象会被严重灼伤，痛楚持续数周。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's tentacles are covered with rock hard enough to be as strong as steel. Those who try to attack these tentacles will suffer harsh burning that lasts for weeks.

entry: POKENAME会故意削弱外壳、降低体温，放弃身体优势，只凭技巧战斗。职业摔跤手会用它炽热的羽毛装饰面具，祈求好运。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME intentionally weakens its shell and cools its body heat to eliminate its combat advantages, preferring to rely on skill alone. Pro wrestlers adorn their masks with POKENAME's fiery feathers for good luck.

entry: 因为身上有火，POKENAME常被说成“火爆脾气”，其实恰恰相反。它会为旅人照亮洞穴与森林。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME is usually called hot-headed due to its fire, but it's actually quite the contrary. It lights up caves and forests for travelers.

entry: POKENAME的帽子由极其坚固的黑曜石制成，能替训练家挡下致命攻击。
author: dodoowner_
source: A POKENAME's hat is made out of a very tough obsidian. It uses it to protect its Trainer from lethal attacks.

entry: POKENAME身上的刺，是体内熔岩接触空气后冷却硬化而成。它能成片发射，震慑入侵者，几秒内就会长出新刺。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's spines are bits of lava from its body that have cooled and hardened after exposure to the air. It can fire them off in large volleys to deter intruders, new spines forming in their place within seconds.

entry: 它们背上蘑菇形的壳，其实用来排出多余体热。它们学会以恰当速度移动，既不慢到完全冷却硬化，也不快到彻底熔化。
author: infinex21
source: The mushroom-shaped shells upon their backs are actually how they vent excess internal heat. They have learned how to move just quick enough to not fully cool and harden but slow enough to not be fully melting.

entry: 火山地区常能见到POKENAME零星分布，住在活跃熔岩河旁。它会让幼年熔岩虫藏进自己的石堡，保护它们，察觉危险逼近就封好城堡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can usually be seen dotting volcanic areas, residing near active rivers of flowing lava. It protects young Slugma by letting them hide within its stone castle, which it seals up when approaching danger is sensed.

entry: POKENAME的模样酷似曾令它灭绝的火山，如今栖居在山地环境中。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME looks like the volcanoes that once drove it to extinction. It makes its home in mountainous environments.

entry: POKENAME几乎能瞬间急冷岩浆，只要保持稳定步伐，就能径直走过岩浆池。留下的火山玻璃碎片，过去很受当地原住民群体珍视。
author: vic1312
source: Capable of super-cooling magma near instantly, POKENAME can walk straight across magma pools, provided they are moving at a steady pace. The shards of volcanic glass they leave behind were historically prized by local indigenous groups.

entry: POKENAME是很好的宠物，因为熔岩没看起来那么热。不过，饲养者和训练家仍得留心尾巴冒出的火。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME make great pets, as their lava isn't as hot as it seems. However, owners and trainers still need to keep careful of the fire coming out of POKENAME's tail.

entry: POKENAME常结群捕猎烈焰马等宝可梦。不过群体很快就可能减员，因为烈焰马一脚就能将它们踢倒。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are often seen in packs, usually hunting down Pokémon like Rapidash. However, packs can dwindle quickly, as one kick from Rapidash can knock them out.

entry: POKENAME通常独自狩猎，专挑较弱的猎物。不过饿得厉害时，也会挖化石充饥。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME usually hunt alone, focusing on weaker prey. However, if hungry enough, POKENAME will sometimes dig for fossils to satisfy their hunger.

entry: POKENAME会把脱落的冷却熔岩碎块搭成简易麦克风架，用于表演。不可思议的是，这种自制工具真能让声音更响亮、回声更足。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses shed bits of cooled lava to form a makeshift mic stand to use during its performances. Against all odds, this homemade tool does somehow make POKENAME's voice louder and have more reverberation.

entry: 古代岛屿聚落的一些仪式曾祭拜POKENAME，相信它的火焰舞蹈能阻止火山喷发，保护土地。熔岩般的头发，温度远超华氏1000度。
author: chibitales
source: Some rituals documented from ancient island settlements paid homage to POKENAME, believing that their fiery dancing kept volcanoes from erupting and destroying the land. Their lava-like hair reaches temperatures well over 1,000°F.

entry: 传说POKENAME诞生于一次朝向月球的巨大太阳耀斑，现身时曾平息一场火山喷发，拯救许多生命。
author: frokachu
source: Born from a great solar flare that faced the moon, It is said a POKENAME's presence once stopped the eruption of a volcano, saving many lives.

entry: POKENAME会用大石牙吓唬敌人，却很少真用，因为太容易崩裂。它会用精神力量，把喷出的火焰塑成时髦夺目的鳍。
author: soup1900
source: While POKENAME uses its big stone teeth to intimidate foes, it uses them sparingly since they break and crumble very easily. It uses psychic powers to shape its spouting flames to look like snazzy, eye-catching fins.

entry: 巨大的圆锥壳既保护柔软身体，也能储存、排放余热。大钳是全身最热的部分，切开材料时，热量足以软化其中大多数。
author: infinex21
source: Their large, cone-shaped shells serve as shields for their softer bodies and as a means to store and vent excess heat. Their pincers are the hottest parts of their bodies, capable of softening most materials with their heat as they slice through.

entry: 这种形态的POKENAME蕴藏无数活火山的能量。它很友好，兴奋时却难控制热量，走到哪里就破坏到哪里。
author: hero.drawing
source: In this form, POKENAME contains the energy of innumerable active volcanoes. They're very friendly, but they struggle to control their heat when excited, causing destruction wherever they go.

entry: POKENAME会迅速冷却部分熔融身体，锻成板甲。铠甲既能护身，也能制造震耳欲聋的地震，让威胁它的对象误以为火山将要喷发。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME rapidly cool off sections of their molten body to forge into plated armor. They use this armor to protect their bodies in battle and to create deafening earthquakes that intimidate threats into thinking that a volcano is about to erupt.

entry: POKENAME一生大半时间都在火山里垂落的熔岩下冥想，强化外壳。只要看见威胁，它就会主动挑衅，展示自己的优势。
author: nexusshenanigans
source: POKENAME spend most of their lives meditating under falling lava inside of volcanoes to strengthen their shells. They will provoke any threat that they see as a display of superiority.

entry: POKENAME头上覆着厚火山岩壳，虽然较脆，却能有效分散力道，抵御大多数头部打击。壳破了，它就会撤退，等待自行修复。
author: vic1312
source: A thick shell of volcanic rock covers their head, it is relatively brittle but distributes force effectively. This defense protects POKENAME from most blows to their head. They will retreat to allow the shell to repair itself when broken.

entry: 融合似乎改变了蘑菇的性质，POKENAME常因此发狂。喷出的橙色黏液像熔岩一样烧穿接触的一切，而坚韧甲壳也让它的冲撞足以致命。
author: fireblade141
source: The mushroom's nature seems to have been altered by fusion, and POKENAME is often driven mad as a result. The orange goop it spews burns through anything it touches like lava, and the fusion's tough carapace makes its slamming attacks deadly.

entry: POKENAME会从身上撒出高热的暗红粉末，围在巢边。接触会造成化学灼伤，若不立刻洗掉，就会留疤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spreads a heated dark crimson powder from its body around its nest. Contact with this powder can cause chemical burns that scar if not washed off immediately.

entry: POKENAME喜欢彼此比赛，看谁的火焰喷得最远。有些甚至挑战鸭嘴炎兽等宝可梦，不过通常都会输。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME like to compete with each other by seeing how far their flames can shoot out. Some even try to challenge other Pokémon like Magmortar, though they usually lose.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，耳内熔岩会冷却硬化，暂时限制听力，直到重新暖起来。
author: .izik
source: While POKENAME sleeps, the lava in its ears cools and hardens. This temporarily limits its hearing until it warms up again.

entry: POKENAME休息的洞穴里，充满身体排出的气体和烟。吸入后会暂时获得精神力量，包括模糊的未来景象。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME rest in caves filled with gases and smoke from their bodies. Those that inhale these fumes will gain temporary psychic abilities, including muddled visions of the future.

entry: POKENAME喜欢温泉等较暖的水源，常把植物泡在水里很久，等于先煮熟，再拿来吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers to live near warmer water sources such as hot springs. It frequently soaks plant life in the water for extended periods before eating it, effectively cooking it first.

entry: POKENAME通常三只一群，会在火山家园的石头上冥想，全程单脚站立。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME are usually spotted in groups of three. They meditate on stones in their volcanic habitat, balancing on one leg the entire time.

entry: POKENAME只要吃饱，身体就能保持熔融。暴怒时，它会从背上排出大股滚烫浓烟。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body stays molten as long as it has eaten enough. When enraged, it vents scalding smoke from its back in great plumes.

entry: POKENAME移动时，身上沸腾的橙色黏液会滴落。黏液冷却后，落下处的土壤便散出养分，帮助附近植物快速生长。
author: .izik
source: The orange boiling slime covering POKENAME's body drips off as it moves. The spots in the soil where it lands spread nutrients that help nearby plant life grow rapidly once the slime cools.

entry: POKENAME的绒毛吃起来有甜橙味，很受追捧。只有信任的对象才能分到一些；其他对象若想靠近，它就能把绒毛加热到三位数的温度，赶走敌人。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The fluff of POKENAME is highly desired, as it tastes like sweet oranges when consumed. POKENAME will only allow those it trusts to have some; for others, the fluff can be heated to triple-digit degrees to ward off foes.

entry: POKENAME看着烈焰灼人，仿佛能把手烧掉，体温最高却只有华氏110度。而且只有被惹恼时，才会达到这个温度。
author: loikthescreamo
source: Despite POKENAME looking like it could burn your hand off with singeing flames, its temperature can go up to a maximum of 110°F. Despite that, they are known to reach their maximum temperature only if aggravated.

entry: POKENAME身体不断冷却，因此会蜕下一层层薄火山岩，免得全身硬化。它能藏在石质皮肤里自保，但待得太久，就再也挣脱不出来。
author: secondegg
source: POKENAME's body is constantly cooling, so it sheds thin layers of volcanic rock to keep its entire body from hardening. It can hide in its rocky skin to protect itself, but if it stays in this state for too long, it will be unable to break free.

entry: POKENAME浮在熔岩流表面，偏爱火山正在喷发时的高温。偶尔能见到小型宝可梦把它当踏脚石，借道通过。
author: secondegg
source: POKENAME floats on the surface of lava flows, preferring the hotter temperatures of an active volcanic eruption. Small Pokémon have occasionally been seen using them as stepping stones to get across.

entry: POKENAME的帽子能挡雨，因为水会让身体失去形状。帽子也能用来烹饪树果和肉。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's hat keeps their bodies safe from rainfall due to water causing their bodies to lose shape. Their hats can also be used to cook berries and meat.

entry: POKENAME虽然不停滴岩浆，幸好跳舞时不会甩到其他对象身上，因此常在火祭中被优先选用。
author: bigoljax
source: Despite constantly dripping magma, POKENAME's dances thankfully don't fling their magma at others. They're often the Pokémon of choice during fire festivals.

entry: 火山喷发时抛出的许多火球，其实是POKENAME。虽然被爆发力轰上天空，它落地时却常完好无损。
author: infinex21
source: Many of the fireballs launched during volcanic eruptions are actually POKENAME. Despite the explosive force that sends them flying, they often land fully intact.

entry: POKENAME常出现在火山上方高空，几乎到了大气层之外。下降时，有人会误认为流星。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are often seen in the skies above volcanos, nearly above the atmosphere. Some mistake them for shooting stars during their descents.

entry: POKENAME会用锋利却脆弱的爪子撕开敌人。古人曾收集它偶尔脱落的火山岩鳞片，镶在武器上，也用来装饰仪式配件。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME have sharp but fragile claws that they use to tear their foes apart. The volcanic rock scales they occasionally shed were once collected by ancient peoples. They used the scales to line their weapons and decorate ritual accessories.

entry: POKENAME在地下钻行时，会留下一路熔岩，烧伤上方植物的根。沿着焦草形成的路线，就能追踪它。
author: oddwalls
source: As POKENAME tunnels underground, it leaves behind a trail of lava, scorching the plant roots above it. POKENAME can be tracked by following the paths of burnt grass.

entry: POKENAME会用覆着熔岩的附肢抽打煤和植物，将其吸收、浓缩成碳。体内储存一个月后，身上会长出奇异的绿色钻石状宝石。许多人声称，睡着时只要与这些宝石接触，就能实现一个愿望。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME whips lava-covered appendages at coal and plant life to absorb and condense them into carbon. After a month of storing this within its body, odd green diamond-like gems appear on it that many claim can grant a wish if touched while sleeping.

entry: POKENAME身上的晶体是结晶岩浆，既不熔化，也似乎永不冷却，因此许多人会用它在寒冷环境中取暖。
author: infinex21
source: The crystals along a POKENAME's body are crystallized magma. These crystals do not melt and never seem to cool off, leading many to use them to help them stay warm in colder environments.

entry: POKENAME的壳形似爱心，常见于热带地区的浪漫餐厅。它似乎很满意，因为服务员和厨师会定时喂食。
author: bigoljax
source: Due to POKENAME's shells being shaped like hearts, they're commonly seen in romantic restaurants in tropical regions. They seem to be fine with this, as they're regularly fed by the waiters and chefs.

entry: POKENAME能钻进地下最深60英里处，浸泡新鲜岩浆。过去有人以为它能创造新火山，但隧道太窄，岩浆无法沿着抵达地表。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME bore up to 60 miles deep into the planet to bathe in fresh magma. It was once thought that POKENAME could create new volcanoes, but the tunnels they dig are too narrow for magma to reach the surface.

entry: POKENAME常在锻炉旁游荡，想顺走尚未凝固的金属，捏成硬币和亮晶晶的小物件。铁匠常在铺里备些热废金属，分散它的注意。
author: notadoctor75
source: POKENAME are commonly found loitering around forges, hoping to pocket any still-molten metal to shape into coins and other shiny baubles. Blacksmiths will often keep spare scrap metal heated in their shops to distract this Pokémon.

entry: 它能借壳内巨大的热量与压力，产出各种宝石。它非常骄傲，会用宝石装饰自己，虚荣地想变得更美。
author: secondegg
source: Using the immense heat and pressure within its shell, it produces a variety of gemstones. It is very prideful, decorating itself with these gems in a vain attempt to appear more beautiful.

entry: POKENAME的喙是全身唯一硬化熔岩构成的部分，里面会积聚大量蒸汽。它必须定期排放，否则就会开始头痛难忍。
author: sk372
source: A large amount of steam builds up within POKENAME's beak, the only part of its body made of hardened lava. It needs to vent this steam out regularly, lest it start developing painful headaches.

entry: POKENAME在水温极高的地热喷口旁游泳，吸收喷口释放的矿物，帮助维持坚硬的外壳。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swim around geothermal vents where the water is incredibly hot. The minerals that come from the geothermal vents are absorbed into their bodies and help maintain their tough shell.

entry: POKENAME被外壳重量拖慢，打不到远处的对象，让原本火爆的脾气更加恶劣。一旦终于打中、得以发泄怒气，它就会完全不肯罢休。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is held back by the weight of its shell, causing its already fiery disposition to get worse as it fails to strike those far away. Once it manages to attack someone and vent its rage, it is utterly relentless.

entry: POKENAME被外壳限制行动，本来就暴躁的脾气更狂野。怒到一定程度，便能爆发惊人力量，短暂快得离谱，追上最近的目标。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's shell limiting its movements makes its already raging temperament even wilder. Once it gets angry enough, it can exhibit enough strength to gain a burst of ludicrous speed and chase down the nearest target it can find.

entry: POKENAME是忠诚的宠物，不过体温太高，常得住在家门外。因此，出现在建筑外的它，逐渐成了守护与保护的象征。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME are very loyal pets. However, their high body temperature often leads to them living outside of their family homes. As such, POKENAME have become symbols of guardianship and protection when seen outside of a building.

entry: 虽然岩浆流动往往缓慢，POKENAME脚步却很快。它用轻巧浮石做壳，代替更结实的熔岩石。壳上喷出的火柱，在高速时会猛然涨大。
author: vic1312
source: Despite the often laborious movement of magma, POKENAME are incredibly fleet-footed Pokémon. They form their shells from lightweight pumice instead of sturdier cooled magma rock. The jet of fire that arises from their shell flares at high speeds.

entry: POKENAME岩浆般的身体不够灵活，便靠壳滚动。滚坏时，脆壳会散落碎片，它常把碎片当作带火的投射武器。
author: zekkenbytheden
source: POKENAME use their shell to roll due to the lack of mobility of their magma-like body. When their shells are damaged by this rolling, their brittle shells scatter debris that they often use as fiery projectiles.

entry: POKENAME常静坐休息，身体轻轻闷燃，节省能量。察觉附近有人遇险，就会用积蓄的力量极速赶去救援。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sits at rest often, its body quietly smoldering as it conserves its energy. When it senses humans in danger nearby, it uses that stored energy to dash off at breakneck speeds to rescue them.

entry: POKENAME沿岩浆脉游历世界，用压倒性的体热试探挑战对象的决心。若对方承受住最初的高热攻击，它就会正式交战，放出更强火焰。
author: notadoctor75
source: POKENAME travels the world through magma veins, testing the resolve of those it challenges with an overpowering heat from its body. If its foe is able to withstand this initial assault, it will engage them in battle, using even stronger flames still.

entry: 曾见更强大的宝可梦请POKENAME保护筑巢地。它以沉重坚韧的石质躯干稳守，用岩浆拳头击退入侵者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been seen being employed by stronger Pokémon to protect their nesting areas. It stands firm with a resilient heavy stone torso, fighting off intruders with its magma fists.

entry: 受到威胁时，POKENAME会尽力敲响硬化的肚子。若警告被无视，就会用岩石般坚硬的拳头猛砸对手头骨。
author: bigoljax
source: Whenever threatened, POKENAME bash their hardened bellies as loud as they can. If their warnings are ignored, POKENAME will slam their rock hard fists hard into their opponent's skulls.

entry: POKENAME背上的壳由皮肤冷却硬化而成。它努力让自己始终处于活动用力的状态，不让身体其余部分有机会硬化。
author: badtothebow
source: The shell on the back of POKENAME is formed from the parts of its skin that have cooled into hardened magma. It works to keep itself in a perpetual state of exertion so that the rest of its body never has the chance to harden.

entry: 它整天睡在火山口，只在一天最热时醒来吃东西。哪怕察觉身体一小部分开始冷却，也会立刻瞬间移动到更热的地方。
author: notadoctor75
source: It spends all day napping in the craters of volcanoes, only waking in the hottest part of the day to eat. If it senses that even the smallest part of its body is beginning to cool, it instantly teleports to a hotter area.

entry: POKENAME会把金属吸入体内，迅速冷却，锻成勺子。勺子能汇集、引导流动的身体，确保火焰只烧它想烧的东西。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME absorb metal into their bodies and rapidly cool themselves down in order to forge the metal into spoons. The spoons collect and direct their oozing bodies, ensuring that a POKENAME's flames only burn what it wants them to.

entry: POKENAME训练后身体酸痛，就会泡进熔岩放松。休息充足后，举起一辆皮卡也不费什么力气。
author: .izik
source: When its body aches from training, POKENAME submerges in lava to relax. Once fully rested, it can lift a pickup truck without much effort.

entry: POKENAME会到火山喷口，给自己裹上新鲜岩浆，再去水池冷却，为本就强壮的身体添一层外壳。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME visit volcanic vents to slather themselves in fresh magma. Afterwards, they cool themselves in pools of water, adding a new layer to their already powerful bodies.

entry: 凭惊人力气和高热，POKENAME一拳就能在其他宝可梦身上打出洞。不过它很少这样做，因为不想造成多余的暴力。
author: bigoljax
source: With their incredible strength and high heat, POKENAME are able to punch holes through other Pokémon. However, they rarely do this, as they don't wish for unnecessary violence.

entry: POKENAME能借升高的体温驱动蒸汽机车。长途旅行时，一次要吃四把煤，才能燃烧足够长的时间。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME use their increased body temperature to power steam locomotives. For long journeys, POKENAME eat four handfuls of coal at a time to burn long enough.

entry: POKENAME细瘦、灰烬般的身体会短促抽动着前进。受到威胁时，会从嘴里向攻击者喷岩浆球。身体的灰中含有极高浓度的重金属。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME move their thin, ashy bodies in short, jerky movements. When threatened, they blast balls of magma at their attackers from their mouths. The ash from their bodies contains extremely high concentrations of heavy metals.

entry: 它的壳已硬化成纯黑曜石，极耐高温。它会从嘴里喷熔岩，灼伤袭击者。
author: secondegg
source: Its shell has hardened into pure obsidian, making it incredibly heat-resistant. It burns its attackers by spraying lava from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME的身体由灼热熔岩构成，会用胃里的岩浆熔化食物。
author: bluefire7_9
source: A POKENAME's body is made out of hot lava. It uses the magma inside of its stomach to melt its food.

entry: 它们叶状的覆盖物，能防止体内冒泡的灼热毒液漏得自己满身都是。可惜这也让多余热量几乎不停从两侧排出。
author: infinex21
source: Their leaf-like covers prevent them from leaking the bubbling-hot, poisonous liquid inside of them all over themselves. Unfortunately, this practice causes the excess heat inside to vent out from their sides almost constantly.

entry: POKENAME会一动不动地待在海洋最底部，伪装成深海喷口，抓住靠得足够近的猎物。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME live at the very bottom of the ocean, staying completely still. They do this to disguise themselves as deep sea vents, snatching prey that get close enough.

entry: POKENAME睡在熔岩池附近的巨石里。察觉火山即将喷发时，它会本能地在石内引爆，把碎石炸向四面八方。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps within boulders near lava pools. If it senses a volcanic eruption is imminent, it reflexively detonates within the boulder, scattering stones in all directions.

entry: POKENAME会肚子朝下睡在熔岩池中，靠石壳漂浮。热量渗入核心，让它保持充沛能量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps belly-down in lava pools, using its rocky shell to float. The heat seeps into its core and keeps it energized.

entry: POKENAME会与同类攀在火山壁上，轮流落入熔岩，比较溅起熔岩的高度，决定首领。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME clings to the walls of volcanoes with others of its kind. They drop into the lava one at a time, comparing splash height to determine their leader.

entry: POKENAME奔腾时，每次蹄子落地，都会留下一滩熔岩。跑过很久后，沿途仍然泛着光。
author: .izik
source: As it gallops, POKENAME leaves puddles of lava where its hooves strike the ground. The trail glows long after it passes.

entry: POKENAME背上的石鞍足够凉，人可以轻松骑乘。虽然比许多熔岩蜗牛融合体快，最高速度却只算普通。
author: sk372
source: The stone saddle on POKENAME's back is cool enough to make it easy for a human to ride it. Though faster than many Magcargo fusions, POKENAME's top speed is rather average.

entry: POKENAME的壳会随时间出现裂缝，定期喷出下面的火。年长个体因此更危险，因为有更多火焰能用来自卫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's shell forms cracks over time that spout out the fire from beneath periodically. This makes older POKENAME more dangerous as it gives them greater amounts of flame to defend themselves with.

entry: POKENAME像浮在空中的岩浆球，大部分覆着熔融岩石保护层。壳内磁性物质让它带少量电荷，也被认为是悬浮的原因。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are like floating balls of magma mostly encased in a protective layer of molten rock. Their molten rock shells are composed of a magnetic material that gives them a slight electric charge and is thought to be what allows them to float.

entry: POKENAME三个组成部分的石磁铁能高效配合。不过磁铁很脆，晃动后可能脱落，妨碍协调，直到重新长出。
author: sk372
source: The stone magnets on all three components of POKENAME work in tandem to great effect. However, the magnets are brittle and may fall off if jostled, inhibiting their coordination until new ones can form.

entry: 它们的熔融岩石身体含着磁性物质，将三颗头连在一起。因为始终黏在一处，热量已让石壳开始熔进身体。
author: infinex21
source: The molten rock of their bodies are lined with magnetic materials that keep their three heads connected together. Due to them always being stuck together, their rock shells have begun to melt into their bodies due to the heat.

entry: 它无法自行调节体温，几颗头冷得太过，就有硬化成石的危险。因此会轮流把自己浸入熔岩流，重新暖起来。
author: secondegg
source: Unable to regulate its own body temperature, its heads are at risk of hardening into stone if they cool off too much. To counteract this, they take turns dipping themselves into lava flows to heat up.

entry: POKENAME会一边大声鸣叫，一边奔过火山地形。每次落脚，都留下一道淡淡的焦土痕迹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME squawks loudly as it dashes across volcanic terrain. Each footstep leaves behind a faint trail of scorched dirt.

entry: POKENAME在熔岩里游上数小时后，会挖出火山内的通风孔，呼吸干净空气。它很讨厌水，因为水会让岩浆身体硬化成石，妨碍玩耍。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME digs holes that act like air vents inside of volcanoes so it can breathe clean air after swimming inside lava for hours. It despises water since it would harden its magma body to rock and restrict its movements for play.

entry: POKENAME住在极地火山附近的水域，在大块浮石岛上养育幼崽。自身的壳也是浮石，潜水时能帮助控制浮力。
author: vic1312
source: Residing in the waters around polar volcanoes, POKENAME raise their young on large pumice islands. Their shells are also composed of pumice, which helps POKENAME control their buoyancy while diving.

entry: POKENAME身上发光的橙色污泥，摸起来滚烫。休息时会缩进壳里，藏在暗处，散发腐败垃圾般的臭气。
author: .izik
source: The glowing orange sludge covering POKENAME's body is hot to the touch. When resting, it retreats into its shell and hides in a dark environment while giving off a putrid trash-like scent.

entry: POKENAME会用体热驱动大型机车，通过排气管排出有害烟雾，保障工人安全。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME power large locomotives with their body heat. They vent noxious smoke through an exhaust pipe to keep workers safe.

entry: POKENAME主要吃晶洞石和岩石，在灼热熔岩构成的体内将其熔化。暴怒时，它会从壳里吐出阵阵黑烟，充满有毒有害物质。
author: fiordaliso
source: It feeds mainly on geoids and rocks, which it melts inside its body, composed of scorching lava. When POKENAME flies into a rage, it emits puffs of black smoke from its shell, filled with toxic and harmful substances.

entry: POKENAME壳内熔岩可达华氏12000度，将外壳硬化成黑曜石般的岩石。它会往炮管吸水，高温加热后，朝对手喷出滚烫蒸汽。
author: ilazerheart
source: The lava in POKENAME's shell reaches 12,000 degrees Fahrenheit, hardening its shell to an obsidian-like rock. It takes water into the barrels of its cannons, superheats it, and then blasts opponents with scolding jets of steam.

entry: POKENAME的舌头比身体其他部分热得多，因此总伸在外面。它会埋进沙里睡觉，潜水者便能看见一群橙色舌头竖在海床上。
author: oddwalls
source: Because their tongue burns much hotter than the rest of their body, POKENAME will always leave it sticking out. Since POKENAME bury themselves in sand to sleep, divers will see groups of orange tongues sticking out of the seabed.

entry: POKENAME的壳裂开后，柔软核心暴露，防御减弱。它会把温度升到难以忍受的程度，并向敌人射出利刺，弥补弱点。
author: oddwalls
source: The fractures in POKENAME's shell expose its soft core and weaken its defenses. It compensates by increasing its temperature to unbearable levels and firing sharp spikes at foes.

entry: POKENAME会收集岩石，巩固胶状身体，再慢慢吃下维生。据说它脱落的石头硬如钻石。
author: darxer_
source: POKENAME collects rocks to consolidate its gelatinous body, slowly eating them to stay alive. The rocks shed by a POKENAME are said to be as hard as diamonds.

entry: POKENAME的身体完全由熔融岩石构成，常见于火山地区深处。它嘴里冒毒气，因此人们常用它的吐息形容某人的口气。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME are often seen in the depths of volcanic areas, as their bodies are composed entirely of molten rock. It has become common to compare someone's breath to that of POKENAME, due to the poisonous gas that escapes their mouths.

entry: POKENAME熔岩上升起的烟带木炭味，却毒性极强。长时间接触，会引发强烈多疑，以及古怪的恐水症状。
author: .izik
source: The charcoal-scented fumes rising from POKENAME's lava are extremely toxic. Prolonged exposure can cause intense paranoia and an odd onset of hydrophobia.

entry: POKENAME深埋在世界的地幔里，野外极少见到。难得有个体出现在地面，附近城镇就会疏散，因为它只会为回应剧烈火山活动而浮上来。
author: secondegg
source: POKENAME are seldom seen in the wild, as they bury deep within the world's mantle. On the rare occasion one is spotted above ground, nearby towns are evacuated, as they only ever surface in response to intense volcanic activity.

entry: 这些主要由岩浆构成的宝可梦，在火山地区钻得极深，已开始形成黑曜石外壳。偶尔会直接浮入熔岩池，防止其他身体部分冷得太过。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon made mostly of magma dig so deep under volcanic regions that they have begun to form shells made of obsidian. They occasionally surface directly within pools of lava to keep the rest of their bodies from cooling off too much.

entry: POKENAME吃下美好愉快的梦，就会舒服地闲躺，身体冷却硬化。若吃到噩梦，身体便会沸腾，烈焰喷发，将之前冷却的石头熔回岩浆。
author: soup1900
source: If POKENAME eats a nice, pleasant dream, its body cools down and hardens as it comfortably lounges around. However, if it eats a nightmare, its body boils as flames erupt and previously cooled rocks melt back to magma.

entry: POKENAME的岩浆摆锤能让任何其他生物入睡。不过散出的热量太强，很难悄悄接近目标。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's magmatic pendulums have the ability to cause any other being to fall asleep. However, due to the heat they radiate, its hard for them to sneak up on their victims.

entry: POKENAME熔岩般的皮肤一碰水，就会迅速冷却成灰色甲壳。不过壳很脆，只要情绪激动或遭到攻击，就会裂开，露出下面新一层火热皮肤。
author: imaginita
source: When POKENAME's lava-like skin touches water, it quickly cools and hardens into a grey carapace.  However, this shell is brittle and will crack if the POKENAME gets fired up or is hit by an attack, revealing a new layer of fiery skin beneath.

entry: 它们的下半身是火山岩，里面留着一些沸水，免得热得过头。大钳上的岩石裂开时，就会从中涌出蒸汽。
author: infinex21
source: The lower halves of their bodies are made of volcanic rock with some amounts of boiling water to keep them from getting too hot. When the rock of their large pincer cracks, steam pours out from within.

entry: POKENAME壳内熔岩又热又密，让壳变成了微型火山群。它会往背上喷水，冷却硬化岩浆，让壳逐渐加厚。
author: ilazerheart
source: The lava in POKENAME's shell is so hot and dense that the shell has become a miniature volcanic cluster. POKENAME sprays water onto its back to cool and harden the magma, gradually thickening its shell.

entry: POKENAME用长喙摘取树梢的树果，也常以喙相击，彼此决斗。不过打得再激烈，它们也始终恪守同一条规矩：绝不攻击对方的种子。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their long beaks to grab berries out of treetops. They often get into duels with each other, clashing their beaks into each other. No matter how intense the fights get, POKENAME always stick to a code of honor to not attack their bulbs.

entry: POKENAME会用喙啄食藏在树缝里的草属性宝可梦。猎物若想逃，就会被它射出的丝线固定住。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their beaks to peck at Grass-type Pokémon that hide inside tree crevices. If their prey tries to escape, they launch stringy silk to pin them down.

entry: POKENAME会掠过发电厂和广播塔，借磁场加速飞行。它们比赛速度，显示优势，因为最快的能先吸电池里的电。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME zooms past power plants and radio towers, leveraging magnetic fields to fly faster. They race each other as a display of dominance, as the fastest POKENAME gets to drain batteries first.

entry: POKENAME会把铁甲蛹从树上敲落，带回巢里，再用喙刺穿进食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME knocks Metapod from trees to hunt for food. It carries them back to its nest, piercing them with its beak before feeding.

entry: 它们的翅膀几乎能当手，至少足以抓住食物和猎物残骸。即使拿着东西也能飞，还能投掷物品，或用长喙啄击。
author: infinex21
source: Their wings can be used almost like hands, at least enough to grab hold of foods and the remains of their prey. Even while holding something, they can still fly and attack by throwing objects or by pecking with their long beaks.

entry: 这种好斗的鸟类宝可梦会从上方精准俯冲踢击，敌人还没反应过来，就已被震晕。
author: sanserof
source: This aggressive bird Pokémon dive‑kicks its prey from above with pinpoint precision, stunning them before they can react.

entry: POKENAME羽毛下藏着极坚韧的壳，抵御攻击。长喙能吸食树液，让它每天进食、变得更强。
author: fiordaliso
source: Beneath its feathers, POKENAME hides an incredibly tough shell that shields its body from attacks. Its long beak allows it to suck sap from trees, feeding and growing stronger every day.

entry: POKENAME是疼爱孩子又严格的亲代，会鼓励幼崽独自捕猎。训练飞行时，它会扇出强风，让幼崽逆风飞行。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a doting yet strict parent, encouraging its young to hunt for food on its own. It trains the child's flight by flapping its wings, providing strong gusts of wind the young must fly against.

entry: POKENAME在海边崖上筑巢，捕捉陆地与水中猎物。身体能潜得比大嘴雀更深，但体形笨重，又缺少长颈，空中不够灵活。
author: mimisha_m.lkpowder
