source: POKENAME nests on seaside cliffs and hunts land and aquatic prey. While its adapted body allows it to dive deeper underwater than a Fearow, its bulky body and lack of a long neck reduce aerial agility.

entry: POKENAME用长喙吸食花蜜时，会快速扇翅，悬停原处。为了维持位置，每秒大约要振翅60次。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME drink nectar from flowers with their long beaks. They flap their wings rapidly to keep their body in a fixed position while they drink. They flap their wings about 60 times a second to maintain their airborne position.

entry: POKENAME能完美模仿其他任何宝可梦的声音，借此逗刚孵出的幼崽开心，也会挥舞羽翼，为表演添彩。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have the ability to perfectly mimic the sounds that any other Pokémon makes. They do this whilst entertaining freshly hatched Pokémon, flourishes of their feathered wings adding to their performance.

entry: POKENAME主要吃小池塘里的小鱼。它会将毒针浸水放毒，再用喙刺中因中毒浮上水面的鱼。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME primarily feeds on tiny fish in small ponds. It dips its stinger into the water to leak poison into it, then uses its beak to spear the sickened fish that float to the surface.

entry: 这些巨大的海鸟很少飞上天空，更多时候在开阔海洋中游过数千公里。它会把脖子前伸，像船艏一样破浪，速度惊人。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: These immense seabirds rarely take to the skies, instead swimming thousands of kilometres across the open ocean. It stretches its neck forward and cuts through the waves like a ship's bow, reaching astonishing speeds.

entry: POKENAME暴怒时，耳朵和头冠会燃起烈焰，直到平静才熄灭。它主要吃小虫，凭长喙能精准捕捉。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it becomes enraged, blazing flames flare along its ears and crest, extinguishing only once POKENAME has calmed down. It feeds primarily on small insects, which it captures with precision thanks to its long beak.

entry: POKENAME常停在高树顶端，观察当地生态和潜在猎物，好在进化后立刻开始狩猎。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME are usually found perching on the top of tall trees. They do this to observe their local ecosystem and the potential prey within it, so that they can prepare to start hunting as soon as they evolve.

entry: POKENAME出了名不会筑巢，便仗着庞大体格，把别的宝可梦赶出家门。做法虽不客气，倒总能有个舒服的地方睡。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME is notoriously bad at building its own nests. Instead, it uses its impressive size to push out other Pokémon from their homes. Though not the most polite approach, this tactic ensures it always has a comfortable place to sleep.

entry: POKENAME的大头冠和翅膀能让自己在捕食者眼中显得更大。舞蹈般的动作让它灵巧穿过战场，用烈焰裹住对手。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's large crest and wings serve to make them seem larger to potential predators. Their dance-like movements allow them to deftly cross the battlefield and wreathe opponents in intense flames.

entry: POKENAME会用臂上喙状毒针刺穿鱼和大虫，拿来吃。它会飞到高树冠进食，尽量远离可能抢走辛苦猎获之物的家伙。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the beak-like stingers on its arms to spear through fish and larger insects for consumption. It flies up to high canopies to eat, hoping to remain far away from any that would potentially steal its hard-earned meals.

entry: POKENAME的绒羽极软，据说睡在做成的床垫上，仿佛躺在云端。不过它太稀有，近年报告中采到的羽毛也只有寥寥几根。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's down is so soft that sleeping on mattresses made with it is said to feel like sleeping on a cloud. Due to their rarity, only a handful of these feathers have ever been reportedly collected in recent years.

entry: POKENAME虽然好斗，个头小，却算不上威胁。多数时间都在纠缠其他宝可梦，讨些残羹。
author: mepp.
source: Despite POKENAME's belligerent nature, its small size hardly makes it a threat. It spends most of its time bugging other Pokémon for scraps of food.

entry: 它会用喙敲树，向同伴传信，协调群体狩猎。有节奏的信号，能确保彼此有效合作。
author: .izik
source: It drums its beak on trees to communicate with its allies, coordinating group hunts. These rhythmic signals ensure effective teamwork.

entry: 不留心的训练家初见POKENAME，可能把它误认成咕咕。不过与咕咕不同，它会凶猛地用催眠力量和尖喙，守卫巢穴与周围领地。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Unwary Trainers may mistake POKENAME for Hoothoot when encountering them for the first time. Unlike Hoothoot, POKENAME will aggressively defend their nest and the surrounding territory with a combination of hypnotic powers and their sharp beaks.

entry: POKENAME头上长着惊人的大片鲜红羽饰，警告其他宝可梦保持距离。警告被无视时，就会灵活转颈，用长喙袭击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME grow impressively large head plumage in a vivid red, using the feathers as a warning to other Pokémon to keep their distance. Should their warning be ignored, they will strike with their long beak and agile neck.

entry: 它会在空中胡乱翻滚着挥拳，想打乱敌人的平衡。这套空中技巧，让它在战斗中难以预测。
author: .izik
source: It tumbles through the air in a chaotic movement while punching, aiming to knock foes off balance. This aerial technique makes it unpredictable in combat.

entry: 它守在树梢高处等待猎物。猎物一靠近，POKENAME便飞扑而下，刺入毒液。
author: dodoowner_
source: It stays high in the trees, waiting to launch onto its prey. When it approaches, POKENAME will fly onto its food and sting it with venom.

entry: POKENAME很骄傲，长着绯红色的喙。捕猎虫属性宝可梦时，会先将活猎物串在喙上，再带回巢里。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are prideful creatures that have a cardinal-red beak. They hunt Bug-type Pokémon by creating a skewer of living prey on their beak before bringing them back to their nest.

entry: POKENAME翼展虽然巨大，个头却小，几乎构不成威胁。多数时间都在用翅膀拍打其他宝可梦，纠缠着讨些残羹。
author: mepp.
source: Despite POKENAME's massive wingspan, its small size hardly makes it a threat. It spends most of its time bugging other Pokémon for scraps of food, swatting at them with its wings.

entry: 有报告称，POKENAME怒到极点时，羽毛会硬得像铁。借此强化后，翅膀攻击足以推倒建筑。
author: .izik
source: There are reports of POKENAME becoming so enraged that its feathers harden to the strength of iron. With this enhancement, its Wing Attack can topple buildings.

entry: 猴怪一旦闯入领地，POKENAME就会从树上扑出袭击。如果扑空，便会张开嘴迎风，借气流掉头。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: If Mankey invade their territory, POKENAME will fling themselves out of their trees to attack. Should POKENAME miss, they open their beaks to catch a breeze, reversing their direction.

entry: POKENAME拥有波波与烈雀一系最优秀、最实用的特征。速度、体形、力量和闪亮羽毛常让研究者误以为，它是关都三只传说鸟宝可梦之间缺失的一环。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME possesses all the best and most helpful traits of the Pidgey and Spearow line. Its speed, size, strength and shining feathers have often confused researchers, thinking that POKENAME is the missing link of the three legendary birds of Kanto.

entry: 只要借到强风，它就能不扇翅滑翔数英里。弯动头冠，还能帮助在空中转向。
author: cait_sith
source: If it catches a strong wind, it can glide for miles without flapping its wings. It flexes its head crest to help it turn in the air.

entry: POKENAME很受关都养鸟人欢迎，聪明易训，体格又适合高速长途飞行。战斗时会俯冲，用长喙啄击敌人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular with Kanto Bird Keepers, their intelligence making them easy to train whilst their build allows them to fly at high speeds and over great distances. During battle they use their long beak to peck at their foes during a dive.

entry: 把邪惑种子和其他树果一起打成缤纷冰沙，喂给POKENAME，它就会不受控制地跳上几分钟。许多配上音乐的视频，曾在网上疯传。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Blending up a Via Seed with other berries into a Colorful Shake and giving it to POKENAME will make them start to dance uncontrollably for a few minutes. There have been many viral videos of this put to music.

entry: POKENAME会用爪、喙和藤蔓与同类交锋。虽然打得凶猛，却会让球茎毫发无伤，表示彼此尊重。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME clash with other POKENAME with claws, beaks, and vines. Despite the ferociousness of the exchange, they leave the bulb undamaged as a sign of mutual respect to each other.

entry: POKENAME能迅速从任何表面弹射出去，速度惊人。全速时，喙能贯穿数英尺厚的钢铁。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME can rapidly repel itself away from any surface to launch at incredible speed. At top speed, POKENAME can punch its beak through several feet of steel.

entry: POKENAME会用长喙修剪墓地里枯萎的花。有人说它在悼念死者，但没有事实能够证明。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its long beak to prune wilting flowers at grave sites. Some say it mourns the dead, but there are no actual facts that can back this up.

entry: 它能同时运用两个大脑，巧妙影响人的想法。经过妥善训练，甚至可以帮助人戒掉坏习惯。
author: .izik
source: Utilizing both of its brains, it can subtly manipulate a person's thoughts. With proper training, it even helps people break bad habits.

entry: POKENAME能迅速鼓起身体，胀到平时的两三倍。此时会产生足够浮力，在天空中游来游去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can rapidly puff up their bodies, expanding to two or three times their normal body size. When they do this, they become buoyant in air, able to swim around through the sky.

entry: 它能灵巧扇翅，掀起冰冷强风，让对手变慢。看见感兴趣的物品，就用长喙叼走，赶在被抓住前迅速起飞。
author: fiordaliso
source: By skillfully flapping its wings, it creates gusts of icy wind that slow its opponents. When it spots an object of interest, it snatches it with its long beak and swiftly takes flight before it can be caught.

entry: POKENAME多了一对翅膀，羽色也更深棕；这些基因改善，常让它在求偶竞争中压过未融合的大嘴雀。这可能使求偶遭拒的大嘴雀，捕猎时不再那么凶狠。
author: pixlhoopa
source: Sporting an extra pair of wings and feathers of a deeper brown, DNA improvements of POKENAME lead to them often dominating unfused Fearow in competitions to find a partner. This can lead to rejected Fearow become less predatorial while hunting.

entry: POKENAME会从远处高速射水，击晕目标。对方停住后，它就迅速游近，试图用尖喙刺穿。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses long-range spouts of water shot at quick speed to stun targets from a distance. Once stopped in their tracks, it swims forward quickly in an attempt to spear them with its pointed beak.

entry: POKENAME常在山顶筑巢，独自生活，连同类也不愿相伴。长喙硬如金属，能轻易钻穿坚实石墙。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME tends to nest on mountain peaks, leading a solitary life and shunning even the company of its own kind. Its long, metal-hard beak can easily drill through solid stone walls.

entry: POKENAME是骄傲的斗士，会俯冲向毫无戒心的格斗属性宝可梦，发起决斗。融合赋予它威严的面容，像人类空手道大师。
author: lupa
source: POKENAME is a proud fighter. It swoops down on unsuspecting Fighting-type Pokémon for duels. Pokémon fusion has given it a majestic visage reminiscent of human Karate masters.

entry: POKENAME没有四肢，却快得出奇。肌肉，尤其尾部，能盘紧成弹簧，紧要时将它弹向高空，再一头钻入地面，捕捉猎物。
author: faeflame
source: POKENAME are incredibly fast despite having no limbs. Their muscles, especially near the tail, can coil up and act like a spring in a pinch letting POKENAME soar to great heights before tunneling down into the ground to capture their prey.

entry: 它的耳朵有中空骨骼，能进行有限的飞行，羽毛也能有效捕捉气流。这种独特适应，让它出奇地灵活。
author: .izik
source: Its ears have hollow bones that enable limited flight, while its feathers efficiently capture air currents. This unique adaptation makes it surprisingly agile.

entry: 奶水耗尽时，它会使出强力的啄钻破开树木，吸食树液。食物短缺时，便靠此维生。
author: .izik
source: When its milk supply is drained, it uses a powerful Drill Peck to crack open trees and consume their sap. This sustains it in times of scarcity.

entry: POKENAME会给长喙通电，击晕对手，抢占战斗优势。它习惯啄高压电线充电，无意间让附近城市电力不足，甚至停电。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME electrifies its long beak to stun opponents and gain the upper hand in battle. It has a habit of pecking at high-voltage power lines to recharge its energy, unintentionally causing power drops or blackouts in nearby cities.

entry: POKENAME格外记仇，飞行属性宝可梦若不肯分食，它就会毁掉对方的巢。深夜，它会带领黑暗鸦群去田间，囤积树果或谷物。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME destroys the nests of Flying-type Pokémon that refuse to share their food with it, showing itself to be particularly vengeful. In the dead of night, it leads flocks of Murkrow to fields to stockpile Berries or grain.

entry: POKENAME喜欢藏在树上等猎物经过，再跃下，用喙将其钉在地面，持续电击，直到昏迷。
author: seanothan_23
source: POKENAME like to hide in trees and wait for their prey to pass by. When it does, POKENAME jumps down and pins it to the ground with their beak, then zaps it until it is unconscious.

entry: 它们以绒羽保暖，在雪地里结小群生活，用长喙和利爪刺穿藏在雪下的小型宝可梦。
author: haypile
source: They live in snowy regions, insulated by downy feathers, in small packs. They use their long beaks and sharp claws to spear smaller Pokémon that live under the snow.

entry: POKENAME极其护幼，为了让幼崽免遭危险，什么都愿意做。羽毛虽然锋利，却像叶片一样脆弱。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME is fiercely protective of its young, willing to do anything to keep them safe from danger. Though its feathers are sharp, they are as delicate as leaves.

entry: POKENAME会挥翅猛击，也会用长喙啄击，抵御一切侵袭家园丛林的对象。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME lashes out with its wings to deliver a powerful blow as well as using its long beak to peck at anyone who attacks its home jungle.

entry: POKENAME的长喙灼热，每击中一处都会留下焦痕。战斗时，它会像挥军刀一样甩动长喙，每次斩击都灼伤敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's long beak burns with intense heat, leaving singed marks wherever it strikes. In battle, it swings its beak like a saber, scorching foes with each slash.

entry: POKENAME在地面筑巢，方便捕猎。发现潜在食物时，它会压低身子，等猎物靠近，再用灼热长喙攻击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME make their nest on the ground where they can better hunt for food. When these Pokémon spot a potential meal, they will lower their stance and wait for the prey to get close before attacking with their long and heated beaks.

entry: POKENAME力量强大，宽阔翅膀只需扇几下就能维持飞行。它尽量避免争斗，但若无法避免，也会用武术自卫。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME have large wings that keep these powerful Pokémon airborne with only a few flaps. POKENAME avoid fighting when they can, but will protect themselves using martial arts if a fight is unavoidable.

entry: POKENAME会在崖边筑巢，把大块泥团压实，造出自己和幼崽住的杯形巢。有些也会住在公路立交桥下，或建筑侧面。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME make their nests on cliffsides. They pack together large clods of mud to make cup-shaped homes for themselves and their young. Some POKENAME build their homes beneath highway overpasses or on the sides of buildings.

entry: POKENAME一发现猎物，就会高速扑去，在空中旋转、螺旋突进。每只都有自己的动作编排。
author: lampent12
source: When POKENAME spots prey, they'll launch themselves at high speeds, twirling and corkscrewing through the air. Each POKENAME has its own choreography.

entry: POKENAME是敏捷的战士，能借翅膀灵活绕过敌人，再用臂刃斩击。敏捷和精巧的身手很受空手道王欢迎，他们常想学会它的战法。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are highly agile combatants, using their wings to outmanoeuvre their foes before landing a slash with their arm blades. Their agility and finesse make them popular Pokémon with Black Belt Trainers, who often aim to learn their style.

entry: 它的喙尖储着微毒，愤怒时便会渗出，在地面留下一道道淡淡毒痕。
author: .izik
source: A weak toxin is stored at the tip of its beak, which leaks out when it becomes angry. The dripping venom leaves faint trails on the ground.

entry: POKENAME平时会用能伸长的舌头捉小虫充饥。不过喙也能突然略微伸长，很适合刺中游近水面的鱼。
author: sk372
source: Normally POKENAME uses its extendable tongue to catch small bugs to satiate its hunger. However, its beak can also elongate slightly in a quick burst, making it effective at spearing fish swimming close to the surface.

entry: 它会用头撞树，让树液流出，却常把自己撞昏。这种莽撞的办法，既笨拙又惹人怜爱。
author: .izik
source: It rams its head into trees to make sap leak out, often knocking itself unconscious in the process. This reckless method is both endearing and clumsy.

entry: 古代王墓里曾发现POKENAME的图像。它能读取波导，因此曾被留在身边，防止暗杀。如今会用长杖翻挖林地，控制有害生物数量。
author: ghostslythe
source: Depictions of POKENAME were found in ancient tombs of kings. Due to their ability to read auras, they were kept close to prevent assassinations. In modern times, they dig through forest soil with their staves in order to control pest populations.

entry: 许多小型鸟类宝可梦会在POKENAME翅膀间筑巢，以它为家。背上的花会释放安抚孢子，让愤怒的捕食者平静。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are home to many small bird Pokémon that nest in their wings. The flower on their back release calming spores that calm angry predators.

entry: 它用大翅膀优雅地飞过草原，能从喙里精准射出带倒刺的小针，击退袭击者。
author: .izik
source: It soars gracefully over prairies using its large wings. From its beak, it can fire tiny barbed needles with surprising accuracy to fend off attackers.

entry: 传说POKENAME用喙一击，就能打碎整座山。令人震惊的是，史籍竟记载了三起这样的事件。
author: .izik
source: Legends state POKENAME's beak could shatter an entire mountain in one strike. Shockingly, three such incidents are recorded in historical documents.

entry: 它喙里分泌的强毒会在黑暗中微微发光，诡异光芒既是警告，也能震慑捕食者。
author: .izik
source: The potent toxin secreted from its beak glows faintly in the dark. This eerie luminescence serves as both a warning and a threat to predators.

entry: 它像陀螺一样旋转，往喙中积蓄磁能。全部释放时，磁力足以让一艘游轮沉没。
author: .izik
source: It spins like a top, charging magnetic energy through its beak. When fully unleashed, its magnetic force is powerful enough to sink a cruise ship.

entry: 许多中世纪社会喜欢把POKENAME做成雕像，排在城堡道路两旁。人类学家推测，是为了让贵族将真身藏在其中充当守卫，突袭入侵者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME were a popular subject of statues amongst many medieval societies, their likeness lining many castle pathways. Anthropologists theorise that this was to allow nobles to station POKENAME as concealed guards to surprise invaders.

entry: POKENAME针般的刀刃能缩回体内，受惊时又会迅速弹出，让许多对象措手不及。
author: .fedoraman
source: The needle-like blade of POKENAME is retractable into its body and extends quickly when startled. This sudden movement catches many by surprise.

entry: 闯进POKENAME领地的对象，会被幻象折磨，迷失在林中。它从高高树冠窥视，等受害者累倒的一刻，立刻袭击。
author: snomisgod.
source: Intruders in POKENAME's domain will be tormented by illusions that cause them to lose themselves in the woods. It watches its victims high up in the forest canopy, striking the moment they collapse from fatigue.

entry: POKENAME宽大有力的翅膀，能让它在空中长时间飞行，无需降落。
author: melodydelune
source: Its large, powerful wings allow POKENAME to remain airborne for long periods of time without needing to land.

entry: POKENAME身体上的炮会在飞行中收集云雾，将水分凝聚在体内，再强力发射，轻易就能击穿岩石。
author: .izik
source: The cannon on POKENAME's body collects clouds as it flies. It condenses the moisture within its body and fires it with enough force to pierce stone with ease.

entry: POKENAME飞行时若被追赶，就会无规律地摇动爪子，触发古怪混乱的能力。因此许多训练家不愿与它冲突，根本猜不到会发生什么。
author: .izik
source: If pursued while flying, POKENAME wiggles its talons unpredictably, triggering strange and chaotic abilities. This has led to many Trainers avoiding conflict with it, unsure of what might happen.

entry: POKENAME飞过林地时，会撒下毒性极强的棕色粉末。接触的对象可能发烧，一连持续好几天。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME scatters an incredibly toxic brown powder as it flies through forested areas. Anything that touches the powder can develop a fever that lasts for days.

entry: POKENAME会飞过其他宝可梦的巢，用喙发出柔和催眠的旋律。等住户睡着，再俯冲下去，偷一颗蛋当作下一餐。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies above the nests of other Pokémon, emitting a soft, hypnotic melody from its beak. Once the inhabitants fall asleep, it swoops down to snatch an Egg for its next meal.

entry: POKENAME会用腹部分泌的粗丝铺巢。丝线带有静电，能吸住散落的羽毛，为产蛋造出柔软舒适的环境。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME line their nests with a thick silk that they produce from their abdomen. The silk has a static charge that attracts loose feathers, making for a plush and comfortable environment for them to lay their eggs in.

entry: POKENAME会操纵火星，把小型宝可梦逼出栖息地，进行捕猎。它极少无故袭击，不过相关事件已有详细记录。
author: bobosmith01
source: It hunts for small Pokémon by forcing them out of their habitat with controlled embers. Although unprovoked attacks from POKENAME are extremely rare, they are well-documented.

entry: POKENAME住在高塔或摩天楼顶，会迅速飞过城市，捕猎较小的飞行宝可梦，用喙与利爪拿下下一餐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lives atop towers or skyscrapers. It swiftly flies between cities to hunt smaller flying Pokémon, and uses its beak and talons to secure its next meal.

entry: POKENAME飞行效率极高，一生都能不落地。它还能隐身，因此多数人遇上它，也只觉得河边掠过一阵凉风。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME flies so efficiently that it can go its whole life without landing. Because it can make itself invisible, most people only witness it as the sensation of a cool breeze by riversides.

entry: POKENAME尾巴放出的热能让蛋更快孵化。它会用长喙凶猛打击，把其他飞行属性宝可梦赶出领地。
author: fiordaliso
source: The heat radiated by its tails helps its eggs hatch more quickly. POKENAME drives other Flying-type Pokémon out of its territory with fierce strikes from its long beak.

entry: 它习惯先在池塘里洗净墨莓果，再吃下去。这份讲究，让它进食时出奇地整洁。
author: .izik
source: It habitually washes Bluk Berries in ponds before eating them. This fastidious habit makes it a surprisingly neat feeder.

entry: POKENAME头冠被碰到就会暴怒，喙上充满电力。它不必鸣叫，也能点亮尾尖黄星，向同类传信。
author: fiordaliso
source: If anyone dares to touch its crest, POKENAME flies into a rage, and its beak becomes charged with electricity. It communicates with its fellow POKENAME without needing to squawk by making the yellow star at the tip of its tail glow.

entry: POKENAME个体若格外强大又睿智，尾色就会褪去，直到变白。它领地意识极强，会飞起来，赶走所有闯入者。
author: fiordaliso
source: When a specimen becomes especially powerful and wise, its tails fade until they turn white. POKENAME is extremely territorial and takes flight to drive away anyone entering its domain.

entry: 傍晚，POKENAME会欢快地鸣叫，宛如唱歌。听见的对象称，几乎瞬间就睡着，被悠扬叫声引入安宁梦乡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes happy chirps that sound like singing during the evening hours. Those who hear it report falling asleep almost instantly, lulled into a peaceful slumber by its melodic calls.

entry: 外嘴里的喙能伸出，精准咬住猎物。受到威胁时，凭锐利程度和力道，连大理石也能刺穿。
author: .izik
source: The beak within its outer mouth extends to snap at prey with precision. Its sharpness and force are enough to pierce through marble when threatened.

entry: POKENAME会生起小篝火，为巢穴保暖，严冬也能抵御寒冷。战斗时，则靠长喙给予强力打击。
author: fiordaliso
source: It builds small bonfires to keep its nest warm and withstand the cold even in harsh winters. In battle, POKENAME relies on its long beak to deliver powerful strikes.

entry: 身体充满氦气，让它不扇翅也能轻松漂浮，在空中显得安宁而优雅。
author: .izik
source: Its helium-filled body allows it to float effortlessly when not flapping its wings. This buoyancy gives it a serene and graceful appearance in the sky.

entry: POKENAME喜欢独自狩猎。若有另一只POKENAME闯进领地，双方便会用尖喙互相戳刺，想把对方戳破。身体虽轻，却能搬起摩托车般沉重的物件。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME prefer to hunt alone and will try to pop each other with their sharp beaks if another POKENAME enter their territory. Despite being lightweight, it is able to carry items as heavy as a motorcycle.

entry: POKENAME受伤时，头冠会变成鲜亮的酒红色。因为看不见，又得抵御更大的捕食者，它经常受伤。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a head crest that turns a bright burgundy whenever they are hurt. This happens often because they have to defend themselves from larger predators without the ability to see.

entry: POKENAME会在周围产生静电场，感知附近宝可梦的活动。它会慢慢爬向强电场，也曾被见到疯狂扇翅，袭击电线。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME generate a static field around themselves that they use to sense the movement of other Pokémon close by. They creep slowly toward strong electric fields and have been observed attacking power lines in a flapping frenzy.

entry: POKENAME会在周围产生静电场，感知附近宝可梦的活动。它会慢慢爬向强电场，也曾被见到疯狂扇翅，袭击电线。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME generate a static field around themselves that they use to sense the movement of other Pokémon close by. They creep slowly toward strong electric fields and have been observed attacking power lines in a flapping frenzy.

entry: POKENAME绕着巢区盘旋巡视，留意入侵者。若捕食者靠近，就会全速俯冲，撞上后爆发猛烈冲击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME patrols its nesting grounds in a circular pattern, watching for intruders. If a predator approaches, it dive-bombs at full speed, causing an explosive impact upon collision.

entry: 它会吸食枫树汁，为体内燃烧的能量补充燃料。受惊时，胸口会迸出鲜亮粉红闪光自卫。
author: .izik
source: It drinks sap from maple trees to fuel the energy burning within its body. When startled, it emits bright pink flashes from its chest as a defense.

entry: 它用尖喙钻开树干吸汁，尤其喜欢气味浓烈的松树汁，靠这种行为在森林中维生。
author: .izik
source: Using its sharp beak, it drills into trees to drink sap, favoring pine sap for its strong scent. This behavior sustains it in forested areas.

entry: POKENAME善于飞行，能在洞窟间高速穿梭。看见洞壁宝石，就会一头俯冲过去，用喙强力一击，将其敲落。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are skilled flyers, soaring through caverns at high speeds. When they spot a gemstone in the wall, they dive headfirst towards it, striking with their beaks with enough force to dislodge it.

entry: POKENAME双腿强健、眼力出众，是可怕的猎手。数英里外的猎物也能看见，再迅速奔跑追上，远跃扑击，用强壮双颚咬住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's powerful legs and eyes make it a fearsome hunter. It can spot prey miles in the distance, run rapidly to catch up, and leap long distances to pounce and clasp its powerful jaws down upon them.

entry: POKENAME会拍动头尾羽毛，让小身体升空，再从上方落向猎物，用尖喙刺击。若这样还没击倒，注入的毒液也可能让对方倒下。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lifts its small body into the air by flapping the feathers on its head and tail, then drops down on prey from above to stab with its sharp beak. If this doesn't knock them out, they may succumb to the poison it injects.

entry: 长脖子让它能优雅地跳出复杂桑巴舞步。它常在儿童派对附近表演，寻求欣赏与掌声。
author: .izik
source: Its long neck allows it to perform intricate sambas with grace. It often showcases its dances near children's parties, seeking admiration and applause.

entry: 护林员对POKENAME又敬又怕，认为它领地意识强，也称得上高尚。它守护的林地里散落着大团树脂，有些封着不受欢迎的访客残骸。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME are respected and feared by forest rangers, citing the Pokémon as territorial and arguably noble. Woodlands guarded by POKENAME are littered with large globs of resin, with some containing the remains of unwelcome guests.

entry: 夜幕降下，POKENAME会离巢起飞，寻找猎物。长喙发出的叫声强烈而震耳，听见的对象都会晕眩。
author: fiordaliso
source: When night falls, POKENAME leaves its nest and takes flight in search of prey. From its long beak it lets out cries so powerful and deafening that they stun anyone who hears them.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀比自己的喙还短，却仍能离地，避开危险。它会模仿其他同类的声音，再用低沉如号角的鸣声重放。
author: tamszen.ore
source: With wings smaller than its own beak length, POKENAME can still lift itself off the ground to avoid hazards. It is known to mock the sounds of other POKENAME, replaying them in a deep, trumpet-like squawk.

entry: POKENAME的模样曾让古人心怀恐惧。早期文献称它会审判邪恶，把不配之人带上天空，再用可怕的目光惩罚。
author: wiz0z
source: The appearance of POKENAME drove fear into the hearts of ancient people. Text from early eras refer to POKENAME as judges of evil who carried away the unworthy into the sky and punished them with their fearsome gaze.

entry: 它头上的羽毛形似花瓣，会散出强烈气味，吸引其他宝可梦，再用头部中央的喙啄食。
author: .jerden
source: The feathers on its head mimic the petals of a flower. It produces a strong scent to lure in other Pokémon, then pecks them with the beaks in the center of its head to feed.

entry: 它会用爪子采集黄球果，存进空心树。伐木工常发现这些古怪的储藏，对这种特殊的囤积习惯摸不着头脑。
author: .izik
source: It collects Yellow Apricorns with its paws and stores them in hollow trees. Lumberjacks often find these bizarre stockpiles, leaving them puzzled by the peculiar hoarding behavior.

entry: 它浑身羽毛细如针，又锋利得危险，能在沙漠中保护自己免遭捕食。
author: .izik
source: The feathers covering its body are as thin as needles and dangerously sharp. This adaptation protects it from predators while in the desert.

entry: 它会大张翅膀，吸收沙漠阳光，获得飞越荒凉大地所需的能量。
author: .izik
source: It spreads its wings wide to absorb rays from the desert sun. This energy sustains it during long flights over barren landscapes.

entry: POKENAME从小就学习如何堵住逃跑宝可梦的去路。眼力锐利，能找出死路，将野生宝可梦困住。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is taught from a young age on how to corner escaping Pokémon. Its sharp eyes allow it to spot dead ends to pin down wild Pokémon.

entry: 民间认为，拿它柔软的羽毛填枕头，便能睡得安稳舒适。它虽然极其罕见，一年中某些时节，却能清楚看见它飞过夜空。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to popular belief, filling pillows with some of its soft feathers is said to ensure peaceful and restful sleep. Although it is a very rare Pokémon, at certain times of the year you can clearly see it flying across the night sky.

entry: POKENAME会振翅飞上树。发现下方猎物，就撒下羽毛般的孢子，使其晕眩、变慢，再落下用尖喙攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME flies up into trees using its wings. If it sees prey below, it will shower it with feather-like spores to stun and slow it, then drop down to attack with its sharp beak.

entry: POKENAME翅膀般的耳朵，让它能在深谷上方优雅翱翔。头顶鳞片格外锋利，飞行中也能切开坚韧的岩层。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wing-like ears allow it to soar gracefully above deep canyons. The scale on its head is exceptionally sharp, capable of slicing through tough rock formations mid-flight.

entry: POKENAME在空中很灵活，四翼能让它朝任何方向飞，甚至原地悬停。航空航天工程师正研究它的飞行方式，希望用于飞机设计。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are agile in the air, their four wings enabling them to fly in any direction and even hover in place. Aerospace engineers are studying POKENAME flight patterns in the hopes of applying it to aircraft designs.

entry: POKENAME划过晨空，落下星尘般的羽毛。发现独角虫等猎物，就会以惊人速度俯冲。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME streaks across the morning sky, shedding feathers like stardust. Upon spotting prey like Weedle, it dives at incredible speed.

entry: POKENAME圆滚滚的身体沉重，很难长时间悬空，因此常贴近地面。若其他猎手来争食，它会从眼睛射出近距离光束，赶走对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME keeps low to the ground, as its heavy round body is difficult to keep aloft for long. If another hunter tries to compete with it for a meal, POKENAME fires short range beams of light from its eyes to deter them.

entry: 暴雨时，POKENAME会用宽阔翅膀遮住尾焰，免得减弱。捕猎时，细长尖喙能伸进树干窄洞，够到藏着的猎物。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its wide wings to shield the flame burning on its tail when heavy rain falls, preventing it from weakening. When hunting, it uses its long, pointed beak to reach prey hiding inside narrow holes in tree trunks.

entry: 它会从地下伸出利爪抓击，出其不意地从下方袭击敌人。靠这种战术，狩猎时也能藏好自己。
author: .izik
source: It extends its talons from underground to scratch at foes, surprising them with an attack from below. This tactic keeps it hidden while hunting.

entry: POKENAME野外独居，人工饲养时却常被养在同一鱼缸里。有人靠近，它就凑到玻璃前噘起喙，许多人认为是在亲吻。不过吃东西时，却会疯狂撕扯食物。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME live alone in the wild but are often kept together in fish tanks in captivity. They approach the glass when people are close and purse their beak in what many believe is a kiss. When feeding, they tear apart their meal in a frenzy.

entry: 它会用长喙偷走毫无戒心路人的首饰。偏爱高处，常在金融机构的屋顶筑巢。
author: .izik
source: It uses its long beak to steal jewelry from unsuspecting passersby. Preferring high ground, it often nests on the roofs of financial institutions.

entry: 它会在银行和金融机构屋顶筑巢，用偷来的名贵衣物与钱财搭建住处，偷窃习惯恶名昭彰。
author: .izik
source: It nests on the roofs of banks and financial institutions, using stolen high-value clothing and currency to construct its home. Its thieving habits are notorious.

entry: 它会用翅膀拍打池塘，卖力展示力量，向潜在配偶求爱。仪式既壮观，又充满戏剧感。
author: .izik
source: It performs elaborate displays of strength, splashing ponds with its wings to court potential mates. These rituals are both impressive and theatrical.

entry: 它像专业拳击手一样精准啄击敌人，再凭空中灵活性躲开攻击。速度与力量让它成为难缠的对手。
author: .izik
source: With the precision of a professional boxer, it pecks its foes while using aerial agility to dodge attacks. Its speed and power make it a formidable opponent.

entry: 它能让长喙裹上烈焰，打出破坏力惊人的突刺。性情可靠，双翼威武，是骑乘着跨越整个地区的出色伙伴。
author: fiordaliso
source: By coating its long beak in flames, it can deliver devastating thrusts. Its reliable nature and majestic wings have made it an exceptional companion for crossing entire Regions while riding on its back.

entry: 它能让长喙裹上烈焰，打出破坏力惊人的突刺。性情可靠，双翼威武，是骑乘着跨越整个地区的出色伙伴。
author: fiordaliso
source: By coating its long beak in flames, it can deliver devastating thrusts. Its reliable nature and majestic wings have made it an exceptional companion for crossing entire Regions while riding on its back.

entry: POKENAME会用利爪抓住体形庞大的宝可梦，迅速带回巢穴，再用强烈火焰烤成食物，供幼鸟享用。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME latches onto bulky Pokémon with its talons to whisk them away back to its nest. Once it returns home, it roasts the Pokémon into a meal with its powerful flames. The resulting meal is then eaten by its chicks.

entry: POKENAME会飞上高空巡视广阔领地，再俯冲袭敌，打个措手不及。拳力极强，石墙和钢板都能轻易打裂。
author: fiordaliso
source: It uses its wings to watch over its vast territory from above and dive down on enemies, catching them off guard. POKENAME can deliver extremely powerful punches, capable of cracking stone walls or steel plates as if they were nothing.

entry: POKENAME通常守着沙漠神殿，会用精神力量从上方降下，拿长杖敲打入侵者。捕到它的考古学家会发现，自己的袜子全被编进巢里，它还穿着其中一件连帽衫。
author: ghostslythe
source: Normally found guarding desert temples, POKENAME descends psychically from above and hits intruders with its staff. Archaeologists who catch it find all their socks woven into a nest while it wears one of their hoodies.

entry: POKENAME尖声长鸣时，是在为冲上天空鼓劲。随后俯坠，用自上而下的劈击打向对手。它更喜欢用拳，因为比喙结实。
author: haypile
source: When POKENAME lets out a keening caw, it's amping itself up to launch into the sky. It plummets back down to land a diving overhead chop on its opponents. It prefers to fight with its fists since they're sturdier than its beak.

entry: POKENAME会先飞上天空，再自由落向猎物。它不想抓住目标，而是直接撞上去，用钝击将其击倒。
author: bobogagabobo
source: POKENAME hunts by flying up in the sky and dropping towards its prey in a free fall. Instead of trying to catch the target, it tries to collide with it and knock it out with blunt force.

entry: 赤道附近某些文化曾把POKENAME当作半神崇拜。据说它吹响战号时，数英里外听到的人都会因恐惧单膝跪地。
author: wickedwiccan
source: POKENAME were once worshipped as demigods by certain cultures near the equator. It's said that when they blew into their warhorn, men who heard its cry miles away would take a knee, overcome by fear.

entry: 长脖子便于POKENAME潜水时伸头换气。双翼发育不良，只能扑腾着飞一小段。
author: chorb33
source: Its long neck helps POKENAME to gasp for air when diving. Its wings are so stunted that it can only flap over short distances.

entry: 进食时，嘴上的尖刺会转向内侧，防止猎物逃走。只有肚子完全空着时，它才能飞行。
author: staghorn
source: When it eats, the spikes on its mouth turn inward to keep its prey from escaping. It can only fly if its stomach is completely empty.

entry: POKENAME会装成在水面遇险的大嘴雀，疯狂拍翅鸣叫，引起注意。宝可梦一来查看，它便亮出藏着的腹面，用毒触手困住倒霉的受害者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME mimic a Fearow in distress at the water's surface, flapping their wings and crowing frantically to get attention. When a Pokémon comes to investigate, they reveal their hidden underbelly and trap the unfortunate victim in venomous tentacles.

entry: POKENAME会用大喙敲碎岩石。若敲不动，就飞上高空，再一头撞下来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME breaks apart rocks with its large beak. When it has trouble breaking rocks, it will fly high into the sky before crashing down onto the rock.

entry: 它会用石头般坚硬的手臂拍断树枝，取得树液。汁液一流出，就把喙伸进去贪婪地喝。
author: .izik
source: Using its hard, stone-like arms, it smacks tree limbs to break them off and access sap. Once the sap flows, it sticks its beak in to drink greedily.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀有力，能将身体推上高空，却撑不了真正飞行所需的时间。它会借高跃落下，用沉重身体砸向猎物或对手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wings have the strength to propel it high into the air, but cannot keep it aloft long enough for true flight. It uses these large leaps to drop its heavy body down on prey or opponents.

entry: 它飞过夜空时，火焰鬃毛会变成耀眼的灯光表演。它常停在火山旁，借绒羽吸收暖意。
author: .izik
source: Its flaming mane creates stunning light shows as it flies through the night sky. It often perches near volcanoes, absorbing warmth through its down.

entry: POKENAME喜欢漂在各种水域中，靠四肢悠闲划行。一旦受惊，就会起飞逃走。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME likes to drift through all kinds of water and moves leisurely with the help of its limbs. If it gets spooked, it takes off and runs away.

entry: 它能通过喙发射电光，每一发都足以造成灼伤。这种电击又让它多了一项强力手段。
author: .izik
source: It fires bolts of electricity through its beak, each powerful enough to cause burns. This shocking attack adds an extra edge to its arsenal.

entry: POKENAME若弄丢大葱，就会不断盘旋，靠锐利视力从高处找回来。细长尖喙也能赶走想偷心爱棍棒的对象。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME happens to lose its leek, it flies in circles until it can spot it from above with its sharp vision. Its long, pointed beak helps ward off anyone trying to steal its cherished stick.

entry: 它会往羽毛上喷树果汁引诱猎物，却把全身弄黏，暂时飞不起来。点子虽然多，总免不了乱糟糟。
author: .izik
source: It squirts berry juice on its feathers to attract prey, but this leaves its body sticky and grounds it temporarily. Its resourcefulness is offset by its messiness.

entry: POKENAME的3颗头都有极锋利的喙，俯冲时能刺穿任何猎物。它常栖在高山山脉，低处的居民难以看见。
author: cobalt0135
source: The 3 heads of POKENAME have very sharp beaks that can pierce through any prey when they swoop down from the skies. They often roost on high mountain ranges beyond the sight of those that live below.

entry: POKENAME无论地面还是空中，都能飞快移动。受到威胁时，众多头会瞪住危险对手，直到对方逃走。谁靠得太近，它就用长尖喙凶狠啄击。
author: jadey.1557
source: POKENAME can move exceedingly quickly, both on land and in the sky. When threatened, its numerous heads will stare down dangerous opponents until they run. It uses its long, sharp beaks to viciously peck anyone that gets too close.

entry: POKENAME虽体重不轻，却能轻松飞行。背上的炮管能射出强劲水柱，用来加速或闪避。
author: chorb33
source: Despite its weight, POKENAME can fly with ease. The cannons on its back can shoot powerful jets of water, which it can use to accelerate or dodge.

entry: 它飞行时会把利爪敲得响亮，吓退敌人。爪子力道很强，能毫不费力地剪断树枝。
author: .izik
source: It snaps its sharp claws loudly while flying, intimidating enemies into retreating. The claws are strong enough to cut through tree limbs effortlessly.

entry: POKENAME凭爪子和喙，能撬开任何贝类。它偷走其他宝可梦的猎物后，便笨拙地横行逃开，藏起来享用。
author: pokepower
source: Between its claws and beak, POKENAME can open up any shellfish. It steals prey from other Pokémon, then clumsily scuttles away to hide and eat it.

entry: POKENAME背上扎根着一种罕见植物的种子，在寒冷气候中极其顽强。鼻子几乎总贴着地，寻找并拱出埋在雪下或土里的树果和蘑菇。
author: infinex21
source: A rare plant seed has taken root upon POKENAME's back; the seed is remarkably resilient within cold climes and environs. Its nose is almost always to the ground as it searches and roots for berries and mushrooms buried in the snow or dirt.

entry: POKENAME主要以毒蘑菇为食，借此释放恶臭，驱赶天敌。
author: midnightsoup
source: POKENAME's diet primarily consists of poisonous mushrooms. These mushrooms allow it to secrete a foul odor it uses to ward off predators.

entry: POKENAME爱大吃闻到后挖出的蘑菇，却必须小心。如果短时间吃太多，可能因过量而爆炸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME loves to feast upon lots of mushrooms it sniffs out and digs up, but it must be careful. If it gorges too much in a short amount of time, it may explode due to excessive consumption.

entry: POKENAME的唾液摸起来冰冷，几乎不停滴落。舔一下，几乎任何接触物的表面都会结冰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's saliva is frigid to the touch and drips almost constantly. One lick can freeze the surface of nearly any object it contacts.

entry: POKENAME可能排出冰冷气体，引发严重肺部炎症。它以腐烂物质为食。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME may emit a freezing gas that causes terrible lung inflammation. It eats decomposing material.

entry: POKENAME将自己裹在厚厚的冰壳里，保护身体。等准备好进化时，冰壳才会融化。
author: midnightsoup
source: POKENAME encases itself in a thick shell of ice to protect itself until it's ready to evolve, at which point the shell will melt away.

entry: POKENAME鳍尖极冷，始终覆着厚霜。它会游在较冷水域的深处，主要吃嗅到的海藻。
author: sk372
source: The tips of POKENAME's fins are freezing cold, always covered by a thick layer of frost. It swims around the lower depths of cooler waters, primarily feasting on seaweed it sniffs out.

entry: 一年里大多数时候，POKENAME都藏在洞中，保持低体温。冬天到来，才会出洞寻找配偶。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hide in burrows for most of the year to keep their body temperature low. When winter comes, they emerge from these burrows to look for a mate.

entry: 有些造型学校会养POKENAME作助教。厚毛适合练剪发和编辫子，它也会温和地引导学生改进手法。
author: jaminmcready
source: Some styling schools keep a POKENAME as a teaching assistant. Its thick coat is ideal for practicing cuts and braids, and it gently guides students towards better techniques.

entry: POKENAME的大钳摸起来极冷。它会闻出树上多汁的树果，用钳子摘下，冷藏保鲜，等想吃时再享用。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's pincers are very cold to the touch. It sniffs out succulent berries growing on trees, using its pincers to grab them, keeping them chilled and fresh until it's ready to eat.

entry: POKENAME毛发浓密，走到哪里掉到哪里。毛上覆着有毒油脂，会让捕食者生病。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a hirsute exterior that sheds hair wherever they go. This hair is coated with a poisonous oil that causes predators to get sick.

entry: POKENAME虽然嗅觉灵敏，食物却常卡在毛里，害它不停转圈找气味来源。它是寒冷地区很受欢迎的宠物。
author: frokachu
source: Though it has a strong nose, POKENAME often gets food stuck in its fur, causing it to run in circles trying to find the scent. It is a popular pet in colder climates.

entry: POKENAME覆着实心冰壳，会住在冰洞里，进一步减慢融化。它不断呼出冷气，保持外壳低温，直到快进化时才停。
author: infinex21
source: It is covered in a shell of solid ice, so it resides in a frozen cave to further slow the melting of its shell. POKENAME breathes out cold air to keep its shell cold and only stops doing this as it nears its evolution.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃锋利得吓人，却只用来采摘闻到的蘑菇。它会切成一口大小，串在刀尖上，再一份份吃掉。
author: sk372
source: Despite the imposing sharpness of POKENAME's blades, they are only used for harvesting mushrooms that they sniff out. They chop the mushrooms up into bite-sized pieces, spearing them on the tips before eating the portions.

entry: POKENAME连最严酷的冬季与风暴中也能找到食物。它睡得太久，常醒来才发现已被雪埋住。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can find any food, even during the harshest winters and storms. They sleep for such long periods of time that they often become buried under snow until they wake up.

entry: POKENAME能向敌人注入源自冰河时代的古老毒液。它会钻过土壤，寻找长在草下的蘑菇。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME injects an ancient venom from the ice age in foes. POKENAME drills through soil to find mushrooms that grow under grass.

entry: POKENAME的鼻子能轻松闻出优质蘑菇，偏爱会让人类产生幻觉的种类。对它而言，这些蘑菇似乎能暂时增强精神能力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's nose is able to easily sniff out high-quality mushrooms. It has a preference for mushrooms that are hallucinogenic to humans; for POKENAME, they seem to temporarily enhance its mental abilities.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛能形成一层暖空气，锁住体热。它在户外巢中睡觉，冬天也能保持温暖。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a layer of feathers that lock in their body heat by creating a layer of hot air. Since they sleep outside in their nest, this allows them to remain warm during winter.

entry: POKENAME只出现在寒冷、地质活动活跃的山区附近。它不喜欢独处，常成群睡觉。
author: curazy
source: POKENAME appears only near cold, active mountain regions. It dislikes being alone and is often found sleeping in groups.

entry: 它单凭气味就能分辨一个人心地是否纯洁。不过，常把善良的气味误认成食物香。
author: larky_
source: It can sense whether a person is pure of heart by smell alone. However, it often mistakes the smell of kindness for the smell of food.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉出色，很远也能闻到美味蘑菇。只要嗅到好东西，尾巴上的圆球就会明亮发光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's potent sense of smell allows it to sniff out tasty mushrooms even from long distances. If it's caught the scent of something good, the orb on its tail glows brightly.

entry: POKENAME会用尾尖摩擦羊毛，更快产生攻击所需的电力。它生活在较大的群体中，减少被捕食者盯上的机会。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME rubs the tip of its tail against its wool to generate the electricity needed for its attacks more quickly. It lives in fairly large groups to reduce the chances of predators targeting it.

entry: POKENAME厚厚的羊毛让它在最寒冷的环境也能安然生活。尾光能穿透暴风雪，因此常被请去带领冰雪地区的考察队。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its thick wool allows POKENAME to thrive even in the coldest environments without suffering from the low temperatures. The light from its tail can shine through blizzards, so this Pokémon is often used to guide expeditions in icy habitats.

entry: POKENAME厚实的身体和毛皮能在雪地保暖，冰尾却会让触碰的对象冻伤。它能找到雪下埋藏的东西，甚至有发现温泉的报告。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's thick body and fur help it to keep warm in its snowy climate, and its icy tail causes frostbite on contact. It can find things buried in the snow, and there have been reports of POKENAME finding hot springs.

entry: POKENAME觅食时若受惊，就会试着借风逃跑。它常待在阵风频繁的地方。
author: notsaying.
source: If POKENAME is startled while searching for food, it will attempt to flee using the wind. It stays in places with frequent wind gusts.

entry: POKENAME太喜欢雪球，无论到哪儿都带着三个。传闻它之所以长这样，就是因为曾吃下一颗雪球。
author: yorui3913
source: POKENAME loves snowballs so much that it carries three wherever it goes. It's rumored that its shape is the way it is because it ate a snowball once.

entry: POKENAME咬下前，门牙会放出强烈寒气。它喜欢冻食，常先把树果冻住再吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's front tooth radiates an intense chill just before biting. POKENAME prefers its food frozen and often ices berries before eating them.

entry: POKENAME能一睡数周，醒来就饿得厉害。它会攻击体形大上许多倍的猎物，还常出人意料地获胜。不过展现这股蛮力后，就变得温顺，实力也弱得多。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME will sleep for weeks at a time, then wake up with a ravenous hunger. They will attack prey many times larger than itself, and against all odds, often come out on top. After this display of force, they become very docile and much weaker.

entry: POKENAME傍晚外出觅食，闻出蘑菇再挖出来。嗅觉似乎直接受月光影响，满月之夜，它会四处飞跑，挖出品质最好的真菌。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME goes out to forage during the evening, sniffing out mushrooms to dig up. Its sense of smell seems directly tied to moonlight exposure, so nights with full moons see it racing around and digging up the best quality fungi.

entry: POKENAME通常顺走其他对象的食物，尤其爱蘑菇。常能见它在餐馆和商店附近的垃圾里翻找。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME typically swipes food from others, with a particular penchant for mushrooms. It's fairly common to see it rifling through garbage located near restaurants and stores.

entry: 磨碎POKENAME的叶子制成药膏，能有效退烧，无论烧得多高。它会寻找蘑菇，最喜欢毒蘑菇的味道。
author: infinex21
source: The salves made by grinding up POKENAME leaves are effective at reducing fevers, no matter how high. They forage for mushrooms and favor the taste of poisonous mushrooms the most.

entry: POKENAME的厚毛像保温外套，能锁住热量。它们会成群共用地洞网络，熬过严寒的夜晚。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's thick fur acts as an insulating coat that traps heat. Groups of this Pokémon share burrow systems to survive frigid nights.

entry: POKENAME扁平而无声，像古文字一样贴在冰洞墙上。察觉有旅人迷路，就会变成箭头，带对方走向安全处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME, flat and silent, clings to icy cavern walls in the shape of ancient letters. If it senses a lost traveler, it reshapes into an arrow and leads them to safety.

entry: POKENAME的钻头覆着厚毛，能挖穿积雪和永久冻土。它在地下洞里储藏树果，暴风雪来时也有稳定食源。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's drill is covered in thick hair, allowing it to dig through the thick snow and permafrost. It stores berries in its underground den, so it has a reliable food source when large blizzards arrive.

entry: POKENAME会寻找找到蘑菇的小山猪，扑过去抢走。它也可能偷训练家的保暖衣物。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME searches for Swinub that have found mushrooms and swoop in to take them. POKENAME may also steal warm clothing from Trainers.

entry: POKENAME会等其他宝可梦离巢，再偷走巢穴当打盹处。只要有食物和舒适睡处，它就愿意接受驯养。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME waits for other Pokémon to leave their nests, and then steals the nest for a napping spot. It is willing to become domesticated as long as it is provided with food and a cozy place to sleep.

entry: POKENAME的厚冰壳能保护脆弱身体，持续冒出薄雾。冰壳在太阳下逐渐融化，必须定期使出冰冻之风，重新补好。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME shells are formed of thick ice, protecting their vulnerable bodies from harm. Their icy shell lets off a constant stream of mist, gradually melting under the sun and needing to be refreshed periodically by an Icy Wind.

entry: POKENAME的胃口是普通小山猪的两倍，产热也有两倍。因此大吃一顿后，便会暖暖和和、心满意足地打起盹。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have twice the appetite as a normal Swinub, but also produce twice as much heat. This results in POKENAME binge eating before resting warm and happy in an after-meal dip.

entry: POKENAME比普通小山猪大得多，需要更多食物才能健康。它饱餐后总睡得昏沉，常让人头疼，所以不少训练家只在长时间训练后喂食。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME becomes much larger than a normal Swinub and often needs more food to remain healthy. Its food comas can be particularly annoying to deal with, so many Trainers only feed POKENAME after a long training session.

entry: 它的嗅觉进一步增强，能闻到深埋土里的食物和其他物品。体形大，急着查探气味时，可能不小心撞倒较小的生物。
author: sk372
source: Its sense of smell has been enhanced even further, able to sniff out food and other items buried deep within the dirt. Its large size means it can accidentally bowl over smaller creatures in its eagerness to investigate a smell.

entry: 栖息地破坏加剧，野外数量稀少，让它们已达到濒危标准。过去住的洞穴如今太暖，只好迁移寻找新家。
author: quackquackattack
source: Due to the increase of habitat destruction and low wild population, they meet the criteria to obtain endangered status. The caves they used to reside within are now too warm for them, so they are forced to migrate to find a new home.

entry: POKENAME视力差，给孩子送礼物时常弄错。不过凭坚持和善意，仍深受世界各地孩子喜爱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME make many mistakes when giving gifts to children because of their poor eyesight. Despite their flaws, they are beloved by children around the world because of their perseverance and good will.

entry: POKENAME年纪越大，身体越长。敏锐的鼻子能找到蘑菇、树果，甚至冰层下的温泉。
author: the_fireplace
source: The older POKENAME gets, the longer it grows. It has a very sensitive nose that can locate mushrooms, Berries, and even hot springs buried under ice.

entry: POKENAME莫名讨厌鸟类宝可梦，尤其是暴躁的那些。对方一靠近，它就会大声喷鼻，提醒同类使出纹理，融入周围环境。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has a strange aversion to bird Pokémon, particularly irate ones, letting out a loud snort when they are near. This alerts others of its kind to use Conversion and blend into their surroundings.

entry: POKENAME的冰角无论什么季节都极冷。盛夏时，也能将露水冻成小雪花。
author: .izik
source: The icy antlers of POKENAME remain frigid no matter the season. In the height of summer, they can still freeze dew into tiny snowflakes.

entry: POKENAME会闭眼专注，施展优雅的武术动作。每次击中，落点都会留下一层薄霜。
author: .izik
source: With its eyes closed in focus, POKENAME strikes with elegant martial arts moves. Each hit leaves behind a thin layer of frost across the impact zone.

entry: POKENAME梳理头上的毛时，鼻子会飞快颤动。它坚持用冰冷泉水，让毛皮保持洁净。
author: .izik
source: As it grooms the fur on its head, POKENAME's nose twitches rapidly. It insists on using icy spring water to keep its coat pristine.

entry: 受过训练的POKENAME能轻松闻出土下优质蘑菇。嗅到后，它会跑过去，一头跃向地面，用两根尖突标出该挖的位置。
author: sk372
source: Trained POKENAME can sniff out high-quality mushrooms beneath the soil easily. When it catches a whiff, it runs to the spot and leaps head-first onto the soil, its twin prongs marking the spot that needs to be dug into.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时会挂在树枝上。它会挖到地下温泉，整天待在那里，再回到树上睡觉。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME hangs off of tree branches when it falls asleep. POKENAME dig down to underground hot springs and spends the whole day there until it goes back up to sleep.

entry: POKENAME头顶的毛热得足以煎蛋。鼻子能喷火，如果当天吃过辣食，火就更热。
author: .izik
source: The fur atop POKENAME's head grows hot enough to fry an egg. It releases fire from its nose which burns hotter if it's eaten spicy food that day.

entry: 寒冬，成群的POKENAME会吃光农田的肥土，造成严重破坏。一年里其他时候，则改吃作物。
author: bandedbodypress
source: During cold winters, herds of POKENAME devastate farmland by eating all of their fertile soil. The rest of the year, they eat crops.

entry: POKENAME会给温泉水通电，独占整池温泉。若有宝可梦反抗，它就钻进墙里逃走。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME electrocutes hot spring water so that it can have the hot spring all to itself. If any Pokémon try to fight back, POKENAME digs into a wall to get away.

entry: POKENAME会用尾巴弹跳，触发一种独特的生理特性。尾巴受压时，嗅觉会暂时增强，更容易闻出美味蘑菇。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME bounces on its tail in order to trigger a unique physiological trait it possesses. Its tail being squished temporarily enhances its sense of smell, making it easier to sniff out tasty mushrooms to eat.

entry: POKENAME圆圆的身体覆着厚毛，能在寒雪中保暖。尾巴也能帮它浮在冰水中，不至于下沉。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME has a thick layer of fur and a round body to keep it warm in the cold snow. Its tail can help it stop sinking in the icy water.

entry: 冬天常能看见POKENAME彼此依偎，分享体热。毛皮极软，让它成了寒冷地区训练家喜爱的伙伴。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be seen cuddling one another to share their body heat during the winter. Their fur is incredibly soft, so they are popular companions for Trainers that live in colder climates.

entry: POKENAME能投掷雪球抵御天敌，也很喜欢打雪仗。
author: yorui3913
source: POKENAME is able to throw snowballs, which it uses to defend itself from predators. It loves snowball fights.

entry: POKENAME被酷寒冻得不停发抖，很难伪装自己。行动能力有限，因此代谢极慢，以便储存更多能量。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME struggles to camouflage itself as it is constantly shivering from the extreme cold. Because of how little it can move, it has a very slow metabolism so it can store more energy.

entry: POKENAME会把积雪攒成巨大的冰雪球，在上面滚动、跳舞。若摔下来，就会夸张地在周围掀起小型暴风雪，仿佛那也是表演的一部分。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME collect piles of snow into giant icy snowballs to roll and dance around on top of. If a POKENAME ever tumbles off of its snowball, it creates a miniature blizzard around itself as a grand gesture, as if it were a part of its performance.

entry: POKENAME会保持低体温，帮助毛皮导电。它能挥动镰刀般的尾巴，接触目标时释放电力，给予厉害的电击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME keep their body temperature low to aid in keeping their fur conductive to electricity. They deliver nasty jolts by lashing out with their scythe-like tail, discharging electricity when it makes contact.

entry: 它们的厚毛足以抵御酷寒，能闻到远处的食物，一路追踪，直到疲倦，或被新气味吸引。
author: infinex21
source: Their furs are thick enough to withstand intense cold. They can smell foods from far away and will track them down until they either grow tired or until a new scent catches their attention.

entry: POKENAME很擅长挖蘑菇，常找到远超所需的数量。它会把多余的埋好，留待饥荒时食用。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME is a master at digging for mushrooms and often finds way more than it needs. POKENAME buries its extra mushrooms so that they have some when there is a famine.

entry: POKENAME有时会俯冲到农夫市集偷新鲜树果，惹来麻烦。有些农夫开始摆出蘑菇，让它改拿这些。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME sometimes antagonize farmers' markets by swooping down to steal fresh berries. Some farmers have begun leaving out mushrooms for POKENAME to take instead.

entry: POKENAME要睡觉时，会在贴岸冰上找积雪处。有些因冰层脱离陆地，在海上失踪。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: When POKENAME needs to sleep it finds a snowy spot on fast ice. Some POKENAME have been lost at sea due to the ice breaking off from the land.

entry: POKENAME爱蘑菇，会大量收集。有时采得太多，累得精疲力竭，甚至吃到一半就睡着。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME adores mushrooms and collects them en masse. Sometimes, it gathers so many mushrooms it tires itself out to the point of exhaustion, and will fall asleep in the midst of eating one.

entry: POKENAME十分胆小，附近一出现人就逃跑。拿香气特别浓的蘑菇款待，是引它出来、赢得信任的最佳办法。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very timid, fleeing at the first sight of humans in its vicinity. The best way to lure it out and earn its trust is to offer it extremely fragrant mushrooms to eat.

entry: POKENAME大多不爱活动，会在真菌茂盛处安家。白天多半打盹，饿了才伸长舌头，捞蘑菇吃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives a mostly sedentary lifestyle, making homes where fungi grow abundantly. It spends much of the day napping, using its long tongue to reach out and nab mushrooms when it's hungry.

entry: POKENAME石中寄宿的灵魂性情温顺，极少自行出来。不过抵抗不了真菌香，拿一朵蘑菇，就能很快引出来交流。
author: sk372
source: The spirits inhabiting POKENAME's stone are meek and rarely come out on their own. However, they find the smell of fungi irresistible, so offering one is a quick way to draw them out and interact with them.

entry: POKENAME会尽量少耗能，熬过家园的酷寒。为了适应环境，一旦不得不费力，它就会不高兴。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME survives the bitter cold of its home by expending as little energy as possible. As an adaptive mechanism, having to exert itself causes it to become unhappy.

entry: POKENAME靠嗅觉辨路，因此双眼部分发育不全。它已学会分辨许多气味，最先认得的就是身上大花的甜香。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME rely on their sense of smell to navigate, so their eyes are partly underdeveloped. They have learned to distinguish many scents, starting with the sweet scents of their large flowers.

entry: POKENAME总把鼻子贴地找吃的，受体形影响，常撞上周围东西。幸有硬化头骨，受到的伤害很小。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME keeps its nose to the ground to sniff for food, often bumping into things in its environment as it does due to its stature. Any damage POKENAME takes from this is minimal thanks to its hardened skull.

entry: POKENAME只住在严寒环境，毛皮格外致密。硬头骨能击碎实心冰层，因此很受巡护员青睐。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME fur is notably dense because they live strictly within frigid environments. Rangers favor these Pokémon for their ability to shatter solid ice with their hard skulls.

entry: POKENAME体温极低，皮肤冷得能让身上凝出冰刺和冰甲。它靠这些冰层在战斗中自保，一旦碎落就得撤退。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME maintain a very low body temperature, their skin cold enough to cause ice to freeze into spikes and plates on their body. They rely on these icy growths to help protect them in combat, though they have to retreat whenever they break off.

entry: POKENAME会前往寒冷地区的村落，预警即将到来的严重雹灾。毛皮能锁住热量，让它安全留在户外，护送村民到安全疏散点。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME travel to villages in icy climates to warn people of cataclysmic hailstorms. Their fur locks in heat so they can safely remain outside while they escort villagers to a safe evacuation point.

entry: POKENAME会落在积雪海滩睡觉。想回到水中时，就翻扑着身体，慢慢挪回海里。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: To sleep, POKENAME lands onto a snowy beach. To get back in the water POKENAME flops around, which slowly lets it reach the ocean.

entry: POKENAME毛皮上形成的冰柱，曾在神奥宗教仪式中备受珍视。这些冰能保持坚固好几周，不会融化。
author: .izik
source: Icicles forming on POKENAME's fur were once prized in Sinnoh religious rituals. These frozen growths remain solid for weeks without melting.

entry: POKENAME的壳内护着一颗小种子，抵御冰寒。脚上覆有特殊液体，免得冻黏在地上。
author: mspaintbrush
source: The inside of POKENAME's shell protects a small seed from the icy cold. Its feet are coated with a special liquid so they don't freeze to the ground.

entry: POKENAME会群居，互相保护取暖。多数日子都完全不动，节省能量。偶尔才两只结伴外出拾食、采集，把找到的食物都吃掉。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME live together in groups for protection and warmth. For most days, they stand perfectly still to conserve energy. Every once in a while, they scavenge and forage in pairs and eat all the food they can muster.

entry: 训练家常想把POKENAME当冰镐，却没意识到它有多脆。只要敲错一下，刀刃就会裂开，连它也昏倒。
author: jaminmcready
source: Trainers often try to use POKENAME as an Ice Pick but fail to realize how fragile it is. One wrong strike can cause its blade to crack and the Pokémon to faint.

entry: POKENAME能神奇地感知生物所在，因此曾被制成某种罗盘，用来寻找迷失的人和宝可梦。
author: .fedoraman
source: It has an uncanny ability to sense where living things are. POKENAME have been fashioned into a sort of compass used to find lost people and Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME必须保暖，否则钢刃会在寒冷中变钝变脆。它会不停捕猎小山猪和长毛猪，拿它们的毛皮做暖衣。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME needs to keep itself warm since its steel blades will become dull and brittle in the cold. It relentlessly hunts Swinub and Piloswine, using their fur as warm clothing.

entry: POKENAME会飞到雪山，在积雪里睡觉。它一生大多在睡，因此会多次往返这些山。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME flies onto snowy mountains and sleeps within the snow. POKENAME sleeps for most of its life so it takes many trips to these mountains.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉很强，能轻松找到土里的蘑菇，再用丝带收集。尤其擅长寻找吃下后有舒缓药效的种类。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's strong sense of smell lets it easily locate mushrooms beneath the soil, which it then gathers up with its ribbons. It is especially adept at finding mushrooms that have soothing medicinal properties when eaten.

entry: 这种变体POKENAME住在更冷的北方，格外擅长寻找雪下的稀有真菌。这些蘑菇煮熟吃下后，尤其以安抚情绪的效果闻名。
author: sk372
source: This variant of POKENAME is found in more frigid northern regions, and is especially good at finding rare fungi beneath the snow. These mushrooms are particularly noted for their calming effects when cooked and eaten.

entry: POKENAME睡在冰神殿里，会寻找其中的积雪堆。它还会从神殿挖洞出去，寻找地下温泉。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME sleeps in ice temples and searches for piles of snow within them. POKENAME digs out of these temples so that it can find underground hot springs.

entry: POKENAME没有眼睛，却能结合嗅觉和听觉，精准锁定其他宝可梦，再用背炮发射冰冷冲击。虽然能装卡带，赋予其他形式的能量，它却不喜欢火。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lacks eyes, but can pinpoint other Pokémon through a combination of smell and hearing, and then fire icy blasts from the cannon on their back. While they can be fitted with Drives to charge them with other forms of energy, they dislike fire.

entry: POKENAME爱收集冰之石，喜欢它们在冬夜星光下闪烁的样子。它们也爱成群聚到山顶，望着极光掠过天空。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves to collect Ice Stones, as it likes the way they twinkle under the winter stars. Groups of them like to gather at the mountain's peak to watch auroras streak across the sky.

entry: POKENAME会飞过洞穴网络，不停寻找能一起玩的同类。聚成一群后，就会彼此唱歌。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME fly through cave systems, always on the search for more POKENAME to play with. When a group of POKENAME have gathered, they sing to each other.

entry: POKENAME会飞过洞穴网络，不停寻找能一起玩的同类。聚成一群后，就会彼此唱歌。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME fly through cave systems, always on the search for more POKENAME to play with. When a group of POKENAME have gathered, they sing to each other.

entry: 它一边挪步，一边不停嗅地，撞碎看不见的障碍。鼻子能精准闻出埋着的根和洞穴猎物，准得令人不安。
author: jaminmcready
source: It constantly sniffs the ground as it shuffles forward, smashing through obstacles it cannot see. Its snout picks up the scent of buried roots and cave-dwelling prey with unnerving precision.

entry: POKENAME能靠两个鼻子精准找到温泉。找到后，两颗头就会争谁先泡进去。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME locates hot springs with pinpoint accuracy using both of its noses. When it finds a hot spring, its heads fight over which one gets to be dunked in the hot spring first.

entry: POKENAME覆着厚冰甲，天气越冷，甲就越厚。但若重得过头，走路也会困难。
author: mistymagius
source: Its body is protected by a thick layer of icy armor, which continues to thicken in the cold weather. However, if the armor gets too heavy, POKENAME will struggle to walk properly.

entry: 它常藏在雪下或薄冰下伏击猎物。厚毛让它能张着大嘴，一连几天纹丝不动，忍受寒冷也毫不难受。
author: fiordaliso
source: It tends to hide beneath snow or thin layers of ice to ambush its prey. Thanks to its thick fur, it can remain perfectly still with jaws wide open for days, enduring the cold without discomfort.

entry: POKENAME住在寒冷的高山湖泊中。POKENAME冰制的鳍会发光，为跌破冰面落水的生物指引方向。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME live in cold mountain lakes. The icy fins on POKENAME glow, acting as a guiding light to anything that may have fallen through the ice.

entry: POKENAME不会正常出汗，而是分泌可燃油脂，因此尾焰虽然顶多暖和，却烧成蓝色。它很容易被喜欢的浓香引来，连气味微弱的树果也能闻到。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME secrete a flammable oil in place of normal sweat, which is why their tail flames burn blue despite being warm at best. POKENAME are easily drawn to strong scents they find pleasant; they can even smell berries with weak scents.

entry: 冬天，POKENAME会成群挤在一起，因为太冷就长不大。毛发长得极快，走过的地方会留下一路落毛。
author: mistymagius
source: Groups of POKENAME bundle up during the winter as they can't keep growing while they are too cold. Its fur grows extremely quickly, leaving trails of shed fur wherever it goes.

entry: POKENAME冬季会埋在雪和土下保暖，也能吸取土里的养分。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME bury themselves under snow and dirt in the winter to stay warm. They can absorb nutrients from the ground.

entry: POKENAME住在雪山，厚毛抵御寒冷。天冷得特别厉害时，它们会成群挤进小温泉取暖。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live in the snowy mountains, their thick fur protecting them from the cold. When the weather gets really cold, groups of POKENAME will gather in small hot springs to keep warm.

entry: POKENAME完全靠嗅觉和听觉，在家园冰洞里辨路。它会吃小型枯死植物。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME relies entirely on its sense of smell and hearing to navigate around the icy caves it calls home. It feeds on small dead plants.

entry: POKENAME主要住在寒冷气候中，会把鼻子埋进雪里找食物。总这样做，连獠牙也结满了冰。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME primarily lives in cold climates, where it buries its nose in the snow to sniff for food. Its tusks are frozen over from doing this constantly.

entry: POKENAME的身体，是毛皮与黏土的奇妙混合。它先用灵敏的鼻子嗅出食物，再挥动永远覆着冰的双臂，向地下挖去。
author: glacierwing
source: POKENAME's body is a curious mix of fur and clay. It uses its sensitive nose to sniff out food before digging into the ground with arms permanently covered in ice.

entry: POKENAME厚实的羽毛和核心体温能帮助保暖。它会蹦跳着四处活动，啄食埋在地下的东西。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME’s thick feathers and core temperature help keep it warm. It hops around and pecks at things buried in the ground.

entry: 这种宝可梦的毛极其蓬松，能抵御许多恶劣环境。它天生好奇贪玩，常因此迷路，或陷入各种倒霉的困境。
author: fireblade141
source: This Pokémon's immensely fluffy hair serves as good protection against many a harsh environment. Being naturally curious and playful, they often get themselves lost or trapped in various unfortunate situations.

entry: POKENAME毛皮保温性好，能防止翅膀冻住，在寒冷气候里十分适应。不过全球升温已让它的数量减少。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's fur is a great heat insulator, preventing its wings from freezing over. It thrives in colder climates, however a global rise in temperature has reduced POKENAME's numbers.

entry: POKENAME独居在雪山坡上，会用利爪花很久雕刻一块冰，直到完全合乎心意。
author: mepp.
source: It lives a solitary life along snowy mountain slopes. Using its sharp claws, POKENAME takes great time in carving a block of ice perfectly to its taste.

entry: POKENAME厚而覆霜的毛里，藏着毒刺。只需蹭过敌人，不必真正攻击，就能悄悄让对方生病。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's thick, frosty fur is laced with hidden venomous barbs. By brushing against a foe, it can silently deliver an illness without ever attacking.

entry: POKENAME会跟小山猪群旅行，用毒击退想伤害群体的威胁，证明自己。它无力保护大家时，许多感恩的小山猪也会围上来保护它。
author: redknight2030
source: POKENAME will travel with a herd of Swinub and prove itself by poisoning any incoming threats that wish to harm the herd. When it cannot defend the herd, many of the grateful Swinub will surround and protect it.

entry: 毛皮让它比舒适的温度稍热一些，因此会披上冰冷斗篷降温。强风刮起时，大量细雪会从斗篷上飘下。
author: sk372
source: Its fur coat keeps it a little warmer than is comfortable, so it wears an icy cloak to keep itself cool. When strong winds pick up, powdered snow drifts off of the cloak in large amounts.

entry: POKENAME会钻进新雪调节体温。一开始觉得热，鼻子就会颤动，提醒自己该降温了。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows into fresh snow to regulate its body temperature. When it starts to feel warm, its nose quivers, warning it to cool off.

entry: 自然环境中，POKENAME大多数时间都在找睡觉处。浓密毛皮能抵御酷寒，让它一连几天静卧雪堆，动也不动。
author: curazy
source: In its natural habitat, POKENAME spends most of its time searching for places to sleep. Its dense fur insulates it from extreme cold, allowing it to rest motionless in snowdrifts for days without stirring.

entry: POKENAME出没于苔原，会把身体埋进永久冻土，只露叶子。生长时吸收大量土中毒素，因而对其他宝可梦有毒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found in the tundra, burying themselves within the permafrost with just their leaves above the ground. They absorb a lot of toxins from the ground as they grow, making them poisonous to other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME厚毛让它在最冷的暴风雪中也能轻松行走。它不容许任何东西妨碍找蘑菇，挥臂一下，就能把障碍打到地平线外。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's thick coat of fur lets it walk around in the most frigid of snowstorms with little issue. It does not tolerate anything getting in the way of its mushroom searching, knocking obstacles over the horizon with a single swing of its arm.

entry: POKENAME常在松树上聚集保暖。头顶花苞没有暖毛覆盖，因此容易冻住。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can usually be found in pine trees, huddling together to keep themselves warm. Since the bud on their head isn't covered in warm fur, it tends to freeze over.

entry: POKENAME很容易被真菌密集处吸引。如果它不停嗅空气，背上蘑菇也开始鼓动、震颤，就表示附近发现了真菌。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is easily drawn to areas with extensive amounts of fungi present. One can tell when it senses fungus nearby, as it will sniff the air constantly while the mushrooms on its back begin pulsing and vibrating.

entry: 它的硬毛常被拿来制作给其他宝可梦梳毛的刷子。鼻子灵敏，能闻出埋在厚雪下的树果和其他食物。
author: fiordaliso
source: The bristles from its fur are often used to make grooming brushes for other Pokémon. Its keen nose allows it to detect berries and hidden food buried beneath thick layers of snow.

entry: POKENAME覆着厚毛，能在严寒中保暖生存。它会贴地循着气味前进，从食物到忙碌一天后回家的路，都能找到。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sport a thick layer of fur that keep their bodies warm to survive in frigid environments. They keep their noses close to the ground to follow scent trails, finding anything from food to their way back home after a long day.

entry: POKENAME喜欢寒冷气候，常结群游走于苔原或山上雪线以上。方向感出众，暴风雪中也不例外，是很好的伙伴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME prefer to live in cold climates and are usually found roaming in packs in tundras or above the snow line on mountains. They make excellent companions as they have a keen sense of direction, even during blizzards.

entry: POKENAME喜欢寒冷气候，常结群游走于苔原或山上雪线以上。方向感出众，暴风雪中也不例外，是很好的伙伴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME prefer to live in cold climates and are usually found roaming in packs in tundras or above the snow line on mountains. They make excellent companions as they have a keen sense of direction, even during blizzards.

entry: 帕底亚寒冷地区很流行用POKENAME做塔可。由于它主要吃莲蒲果，这些塔可有甜甜的回味，据说能让全身暖和起来。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: POKENAME tacos are a popular meal in the colder regions of Paldea. Due to POKENAME diets primarily consisting of Chople Berries, these tacos have a sweet aftertaste said to fill one's body with warmth.

entry: POKENAME的鼻子敏感得能闻到埋在坚实岩石里的宝石。在所有石头中，它格外偏爱变石。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's nose is so sensitive it can smell gems buried in solid rock. It has a strong preference for alexandrite above all other stones.

entry: 每年初雪时，POKENAME会走过街区，在经过的每家前院堆雪人。若作品被毁，它就会暴走，用锋利冰柱轰击四周。
author: dodoowner_
source: On the first snowfall of the year, POKENAME strolls through neighborhoods, creating snowmen on every front lawn it passes. Destroying its creations sends POKENAME into a rampage, bombarding the surrounding area with razor-sharp icicles.

entry: 每年初雪时，一群群POKENAME似乎会神秘地出现在各地。悉心打理外表的训练家会获赠异常大的雪花作为谢礼，常被用来制作手工艺品。
author: dodoowner_
source: On the first snowfall of the year, groups of POKENAME seem to mysteriously pop up throughout the region. Trainers who take care of their appearance are gifted with unnaturally large snowflakes as a token of gratitude, often used for arts and crafts.

entry: POKENAME会把枕头放进松雪下，让自己更舒服。如果睡觉被吵醒，可能极其暴躁凶狠。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME places its pillows under soft snow so that it is extra comfortable. POKENAME can get extremely violent if it gets waken up from its sleep.

entry: POKENAME会用叶子载小型宝可梦，帮助穿过深雪。气候较暖时，也能拿叶子替自己遮阳。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME carries small Pokémon on its leaf to help them navigate deep snow. When in a warmer climate, it can use its leaf to shade itself from the sun.

entry: POKENAME会有节奏地跺地，靠震动寻找埋着的根来吃。人类很早就从它的“舞蹈”中得到作曲灵感。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: It taps its feet on the ground rhythmically, using the vibrations to search for buried roots to eat. Humans have long used POKENAME's 'dance' to inspire songs.

entry: POKENAME会用爪子挖掘闻到的食物和水。越费力，分泌的可燃油就越多，火焰也因此呈蓝色；牙齿或爪子摩擦，就能点燃油脂。
author: infinex21
source: Using their claws, POKENAME dig for food and water they catch the scent of. The more they exert themselves, the more they sweat a flammable oil that causes their flames to burn blue; the friction of their teeth or claws can ignite this oil.

entry: POKENAME出没于世界大多数多雪地区。因为总埋在雪里，它常打喷嚏，也大多带着其他感冒症状。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME are found in most snowy regions of the world. Due to being constantly burrowed in the snow, they sneeze often and have other symptoms of the common cold most of the time.

entry: POKENAME会合作挖穿积雪，靠出色的嗅觉找食物。夜里则挤在洞中保暖。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME work together to burrow through the snow, using their excellent sense of smell to find food. At night, they will huddle in their burrows for warmth.

entry: POKENAME头上带着的雪球能增强能力。强大个体的雪球，即使暖天也不会融化。
author: hophoppip
source: The snowball POKENAME carries on its head amplifies its abilities. A powerful POKENAME's ball stays frozen even in warm weather.

entry: 若不定期梳理，POKENAME的毛会遮住眼睛，引起剧烈头痛。任其不管，痛苦还会通过心灵感应，传给附近的其他对象。
author: .izik
source: Without regular grooming, POKENAME's fur covers its eyes and causes intense headaches. When left unmanaged, its pain can spread telepathically to others nearby.

entry: POKENAME很少离水，因为湿透的毛皮在北极低温中几乎立刻就会冻住。食物短缺时，它会睡在海底，节省能量。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME rarely leaves the water, as its soaked fur would freeze almost instantly in arctic temperatures. When food is scarce, it sleeps on the seafloor to conserve energy.

entry: POKENAME厚厚的毛能抵御严寒。弄湿后，它会从喷嚏里打出火星，想让自己暖起来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a thick layer of fur that protects it from frigid environments. When it gets wet, it sneezes out embers to try to warm itself up.

entry: POKENAME会在对手头顶翱翔，放出阵阵冰冷强风，压倒对方。翅膀覆着毛，能让它毫发无伤地穿过极地暴风雪。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME overwhelms opponents with blasts of freezing wind while soaring over their heads. The fur covering its wings allows it to fly through polar blizzards unscathed.

entry: 独处时，POKENAME会在周围召起冰风暴，蜷在中央冥想。既能锻炼耐力，也能让潜在捕食者远远避开。
author: reflecbeat
source: If left alone, a POKENAME will summon an icy storm around itself and curl up and meditate in the middle of it. This helps the POKENAME train its endurance and keep potential predators far away.

entry: POKENAME看似不起眼，却能单手举起象牙猪。训练家累了，它会让对方坐上背，再慢慢向前走。
author: quackquackattack
source: While POKENAME may seem like an unassuming Pokémon, it can lift up a Mamoswine with a single hand. When its Trainer is tired, it allows them to sit on its back before trudging forward.

entry: POKENAME是温和的巨兽，会尽心帮助坐轮椅的人出行。训练家疲倦时，它就用强壮肌肉推起轮椅，带对方回家。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are gentle giants that diligently help people in wheelchairs navigate the world. Whenever their Trainer is tired, POKENAME push wheelchairs with their burly muscles to help lead them home.

entry: 许多POKENAME会让长根穿过冰层，在酷寒中寻找养分。根最长可达30米，常把自己牢牢固定在冰川上。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many POKENAME create long root networks through ice to find nutrients in harsh, frigid environments. They often find themselves locked atop glaciers with roots that can grow up to 30 meters in length.

entry: POKENAME会挖穿冻土，找到地下温泉。为在冷环境中保暖，它会往部分壳内装温泉水；水凉后，又得不断重新补充。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME digs through frozen ground to reach underground hot springs. To maintain its warmth in cold environments, POKENAME fills some of its shell with hot spring water and has to constantly refill it when the water gets cold.

entry: POKENAME在水下朝你伸触手时，不必担心。触手与嗅觉相连，必须先碰到东西，才能闻出气味，知道是什么。
author: sk372
source: One should not be troubled if POKENAME reaches for them underwater. Its tentacles are connected to its sense of smell, so it needs to touch something in order to gain its scent and understand what it is.

entry: POKENAME的触手覆着味觉感受器，连周围水质成分的微小变化也能察觉。它会在海底漂游，寻找可吃的小块食物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's tentacles are covered in taste receptors, allowing them to detect even faint changes in the water composition around them. They drift across the ocean floor in search of morsels of food they can feed on.

entry: 它用火焰寻找埋在雪下的树果。雪乡的训练家常与POKENAME结伴出行，借它取暖。
author: schwaus
source: It uses its flames to look for berries under the snow. Trainers from snowy towns will often travel with POKENAME to keep warm.

entry: POKENAME能把周围热量储进体内，背上的冰晶便是这种能力的副产物。身体与周围空气因此产生温差，造成极强的冷却效果。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The ice crystals that form along the backs of POKENAME are a by-product of their ability to store ambient heat within their bodies. The temperature difference this creates between their bodies and the surrounding air has an extreme chilling effect.

entry: POKENAME懒散又单纯，很少有什么能叫醒不断打盹的它。用它最爱的蘑菇香引诱，是让它醒来活动的最佳办法。
author: sk372
source: With a lazy and simpleminded disposition, not much will rouse POKENAME from its constant slumbering. The best way to get it to wake up and move around is using the scent of mushrooms, its favorite snack.

entry: POKENAME闲时会用雪在身上塑出造型，并细心维护。如果被宝可梦弄坏，就会对其使出水枪。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME sculpts designs on itself using snow during its free time. POKENAME maintains the design and, if a Pokémon damages it, then it will use Water Gun on them.

entry: POKENAME会贴地闻根和蘑菇，找点零食。它极易受惊，几颗头一找到食物，就立刻跑去藏好，安心享用。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sniffs low to the ground searching for roots and mushrooms to snack on. Its highly skittish nature means that as soon as its heads have found food, they immediately run and hide to eat their meal in solace.

entry: 为了守洞，POKENAME会先朝入侵者泼冰水，再吹出刺骨寒风，将对方冻在原地。
author: .izik
source: To defend its den, POKENAME splashes intruders with freezing water before following up with a breath of ice-cold wind that locks them in place.

entry: POKENAME的壳由冰构成，炮管会发射雪球。它必须避开温暖的地方，免得外壳融化。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME's shell is made out of ice, and its cannons fire snowballs. POKENAME must avoid warm places so that its shell does not melt.

entry: POKENAME紧抱家人时，会用冰凉鼻子轻轻蹭蹭。对信任的人类，也会表达同样的亲昵。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME clamps onto its family in a warm embrace, it gently nuzzles them with its chilled nose. It offers the same affection to humans it trusts.

entry: POKENAME飞过严寒地区时，会发出轻轻吸鼻子的声音，身后留下一路幽灵般的落雪。即使气候温暖，雪片碰到人，也会让人短暂发冷。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes little sniffling noises as it flies around frigid areas and leaves a trail of ghostly snowfall behind it. These flakes will give a person momentary chills on contact, even in warmer climates.

entry: POKENAME体形虽大，却很胆小，稍见敌意就可能钻地逃跑。新鲜蘑菇的气味，通常足以让它走出家门。
author: sk372
source: Despite its size, POKENAME is a timid sort, likely to flee underground at the first sign of aggression. The scent of fresh mushrooms is usually enough to get it to venture out of its home.

entry: POKENAME的大钳虽然覆着毛，却冷如冰。夹得太紧会出现裂缝，得花好几天才能愈合。
author: .izik
source: Though covered in fur, POKENAME's pincers are ice-cold. A tight clamp can cause cracks in the pincers that take days to heal.

entry: 爪子与外壳都由冰构成，壳下却覆着一层脂肪与毛皮。
author: shadowpanther
source: Its claws and shell are made of ice. It has a layer of fat and fur underneath its shell.

entry: 它背上的种子很小，因此会用雪包起来，小心保护。训练家帮忙装饰这个雪球，也能与POKENAME增进感情。
author: admiralvermin
source: The bulb on its back is small, so it covers it with snow to keep it safe. Trainers will bond with their POKENAME by helping to decorate its snowball.

entry: POKENAME会埋在雪丘下睡觉，只露出骨头。借此感知细微风向变化，判断何时能安全出来。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps buried beneath snowy dunes with its bone exposed. It uses this to sense subtle wind shifts and know when it is safe to emerge.

entry: POKENAME常见于酷寒北方，嗅觉能排除烟和自身不断排出的臭气等干扰，精准锁定想找的气味，因此有时会被请去追踪。
author: bobosmith01
source: Typically found in the frigid north, POKENAME's incredible sense of smell is able to hone in on exactly what it wants to find over other scents, including smoke or its own constantly-emitted smelly gas. As a result, it is sometimes used for tracking.

entry: POKENAME每天从日出到黄昏，都会在冰洞里无声跳舞。漏掉一次，就会紧张得成团掉毛。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dances silently in icy caves from sunrise to dusk. If it misses a session, its fur begins to fall out in clumps due to its stress.

entry: POKENAME的模样和哼哼喷鼻的声音，常吓得小型宝可梦四散逃走。其实它是无害的素食者，只会用大钳夹开采来的硬坚果。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's appearance and grunting and snorting noises often send smaller Pokémon scurrying in fear. It is a harmless vegetarian, however, using its pincers to crack tough nuts it harvests.

entry: POKENAME会在冰冷水里游泳，靠毛皮保暖。发育不全的眼睛上覆着毛簇，能挡住强光。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swim in icy cold waters with a layer of fur to keep themselves warm. They have tufts of fur over their underdeveloped eyes, which protect them from bright lights.

entry: POKENAME厚毛能保护自己，即使在平时栖息的冰寒环境中也不怕。它会用火焰吐息，熔穿挡路冰墙。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its thick fur keeps POKENAME sheltered even in the freezing habitats it typically calls home. With its fiery breath, it can melt through walls of ice that block its path.

entry: POKENAME住进系统后，能给原本会过热的硬件降温。不过，它的存在也会大幅拖慢性能。
author: .izik
source: While inhabiting a system, POKENAME cools hardware that would otherwise overheat. However, its presence significantly slows performance.

entry: POKENAME个头大，又对声音敏感，能留意孩子的动静，因此很受家庭宠物饲养者青睐。不过家长也得留心，它夏季会掉很多毛。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are often sought after as family pets due to their large size and sound sensitivity that allows them to keep track of children. Parents are warned, though, that POKENAME shed quite a lot during the summer months.

entry: POKENAME会漂过苔原，毛皮让它暖暖和和。它爱捣乱科研设备，科学家还没来得及拦，就把相机掀倒了。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME float through the tundra, their fur keeping them nice and warm. They love to mess with scientific equipment, toppling cameras over before scientists can stop them.

entry: 苔原和严冬里，POKENAME会努力对冻住的植物打喷嚏，想让它们复苏。可惜厚毛遮眼、看不准目标，只能乱打喷嚏，盼着碰巧救活植物。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: In tundras and during harsh winters, POKENAME try their best to revive frozen plants by sneezing on them. Unfortunately, their thick fur obscures their vision and targets, so they sneeze at random with the hope of reviving plants.

entry: POKENAME毛皮和羽毛都极厚，能在酷寒生存。据说安宁而平稳的落雪时，它的力量会达到巅峰。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME have incredibly thick fur and feathers that allow them to survive in frigid environments. When peaceful, steady snow falls, their power is said to peak.

entry: POKENAME的羊毛隔寒效果极佳，却也会迅速积聚危险的静电，限制了应用范围。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME's wool is extremely good at insulating against cold weather. However, it also rapidly builds up dangerous amounts of static electricity, limiting its potential applications.

entry: 每年春天，POKENAME出洞时都裹满黏花粉，因为冬眠中仍不断放粉，把自己和洞壁都弄得黏糊糊。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME emerge from their burrows every spring covered in sticky pollen. This is because they continue to release pollen during hibernation, covering themselves and the walls of their burrow with the sticky substance.

entry: POKENAME每天睡约十八小时，为悄悄偷食积蓄体力。有时会用爪子在冰湖开洞，方便人们钓鱼，可一有机会，也会带着部分渔获溜走。
author: pjporwoll
