source: POKENAME sleeps for around eighteen hours each day, conserving energy for stealthily stealing food. It sometimes uses its claws to cut holes in icy lakes for people to fish, but will abscond with some of the catch when it sees an opportunity.

entry: POKENAME只需顶头撞上几下，就能独自推倒较小的树。它什么都吃，灵敏鼻子能找到确切想要的食物，用来追踪人也并非稀奇事。
author: bobosmith01
source: It can knock down smaller trees all by itself with a few headbutts. It is an omnivore and eats all kinds of things; it can use its powerful nose to find exactly what it wants, too. Tracking someone by using POKENAME is not unheard of.

entry: POKENAME很少见，出没于温带森林和苔原，笨重地寻找食物喂幼崽。它常暗中观察露营者，若发现对方不尊重野外环境，就会怒冲营地。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is a rare sight, found in temperate forests and tundras, where it lumbers about searching for food to provide for its young. It often stealthily watches campers and rushes into their camp in a rage if it witnesses poor wilderness respect.

entry: POKENAME毛皮隔热性极佳，体内虽热，表面摸起来却相对凉爽。用它的毛织成的冬衣，很受温带地区欢迎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur is a fantastic insulator, keeping their bodies relatively cool to the touch despite their high internal body temperature. Winter coats woven from POKENAME fur are very popular in temperate regions.

entry: POKENAME会用冰凉鼻子贴住同伴，打招呼。短促的喷鼻声能传达情绪，也能维系亲密关系。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME presses its chilly snout against others in its herd to greet them. These brief snorts help maintain close bonds and signal emotions.

entry: 这种长毛猪自身融合形态，带着永不融化的冰块，里面封存着遥远时代的遗留物。它是否真是融合重现的古代长毛猪，连化石也一并还原，相关研究仍在继续。
author: infranscia
source: This self fusion of Piloswine carries never-melting blocks of ice, which contain remnants of times long gone.  Research is ongoing as to whether this is actually an ancient form of Piloswine, somehow recreated through fusion, fossils and all.

entry: 科学家将POKENAME视为极危物种，因为能安全筑巢的洞穴已越来越暖，难以舒适生活。正在进行的驯养工作，也被宣传为帮助保育这个种类的办法。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are regarded by scientists as critically endangered because the caves they can safely nest in have been getting too warm for them to live comfortably. Ongoing efforts to domesticate POKENAME have been advertised to help preserve the species.

entry: POKENAME会收集松果当礼物。脸毛太厚，常认错对象，不小心送给陌生人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects pinecones to give as gifts. Its thick facial fur causes it to make frequent mix-ups, gifting to strangers by mistake.

entry: 过去有科学家声称POKENAME从不掉毛，近来已证实不对。人们发现，它会用长喙吃掉自己的毛，帮助在冰寒地区留住养分。
author: .izik
source: Old scientists once claimed POKENAME's fur never sheds. This lore has been recently proven false, as it was discovered to eat its own fur with its long beak to help retain nutrients in frozen regions.

entry: POKENAME会在北极深洞里，用尾爪在石头上刻画。许多历史学家误以为那些图画是史前人类的作品。
author: santon5512
source: Deep in arctic caves, POKENAME use the claw on their tails to etch drawings into the stone. Many historians have mistaken these drawings for the work of prehistoric humans.

entry: POKENAME群会一头撞向洞壁，震落石头吃，常因此弄塌洞穴，引发雪崩。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME herds charge head-first into cave walls to dislodge stones they eat. They often collapse caves and trigger avalanches.

entry: 它会先从鼻子喷出冰冷气体，削弱树根，再等解冻后大吃一顿。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It eats by shooting freezing gas from its snout at tree roots to weaken them. Once the roots defrost, it gorges itself.

entry: POKENAME会把山城据为领地。一旦占据，人们就会疏散城市，因为它从小石子到整座建筑，什么都吃。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME claim mountain cities as their territory. When they do, the cities are evacuated because they eat everything from pebbles to entire buildings.

entry: POKENAME覆着厚毛和层层脂肪，能在恶劣北极环境生存。它能给尾巴充电，迸出强光，帮助在暴风雪中看清。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The thick fur and layers of fat coating the bodies of POKENAME allow them to survive in harsh arctic environments. They can charge their tails with electricity to create a bright burst of light, helping them to see in the middle of blizzards.

entry: POKENAME把身上不断长出的植物纤维，编成粗绳，缠遍全身。若人类不定期收取一些，绳子越长越多，连它自己也会被困住。
author: sontyp
source: POKENAME are covered in thick ropes they braid from plant fibers that grow from their bodies. This growth never stops, so if humans don't harvest parts of these ropes intermittently, a POKENAME can become entangled in them itself.

entry: POKENAME的硬毛十分耐用，会被制成给其他宝可梦梳毛的刷子。它用爪与獠牙挖穿冻土，尽量把洞穴布置舒适。
author: fiordaliso
source: The bristles of its fur are very resistant; in fact, they are used to make brushes for grooming the fur of other Pokémon. With its claws and fangs, POKENAME digs through the frozen ground to make its den as comfortable as possible.

entry: POKENAME吃完后会在雪堆间跳上数小时。它讨厌吃撑的感觉，总要活动着消耗食物。
author: .izik
source: After eating, POKENAME leaps through snowdrifts for hours. It despises feeling full and stays active to burn off meals.

entry: POKENAME有数层厚毛，保护自己和幼年小山猪免遭寒冷。它会用精神力量托起身体，不让毛皮拖慢行动。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME have several layers of thick fur to protect themselves and young Swinub from the cold. POKENAME use their psychic powers to lift their bodies and keep their fur from slowing them down.

entry: POKENAME住在寒冷地区，会用獠牙拱开雪地找食物。如果看见有生物受冻，就会凑近，用毛皮给对方取暖。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME resides in frigid regions, using its tusks to root around the snowy ground for food. If it spots another creature chilled by the cold, it nuzzles close to warm them with its fur.

entry: POKENAME厚毛能抵御栖息地的恶劣严寒。为了击破挡路冰层，头骨已进化得相当坚硬。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have thick coats of fur to safeguard them against the harsh and frigid climates of their habitats. To break through ice formations that may bar their paths, their skulls evolved to become quite hard.

entry: 獠牙虽然小，却能帮助它破开厚冰觅食。它会用能撞断树的头击保护幼小宝可梦，也用暖毛替它们保温。
author: infinex21
source: Although small, its tusks aid it in breaking through thick ice whilst searching for food. It will protect younger Pokémon from threats using tree-shattering headbutt attacks and use its warm coat of fur to keep them warm.

entry: POKENAME常见于雪山，厚毛抵御刺骨寒冷。它能预测哪里将堆起积雪，再靠出色听觉和嗅觉，找到并疏散受影响地区的宝可梦。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME are often found in snowy mountains, their thick fur insulating them from the bitter cold. They can predict where snow drifts will occur and will find and evacuate Pokémon in the affected area using their great hearing and sense of smell.

entry: POKENAME在冰湖滑行时，会用一根冰柱保持平衡。即使摔倒，厚毛也能缓冲，不论速度多快都安全。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses an icicle to balance while sliding on frozen lakes. If it falls, its thick fur cushions the impact, keeping it safe regardless of speed.

entry: POKENAME用斧头砍倒腐树，寻找其中富含养分的蘑菇。挥斧时，厚皮毛还能帮它稳住身体。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME uses its axe to cut down rotten trees containing nutritious mushrooms. Its thick coat can be used to brace itself when it delivers a swing.

entry: POKENAME通常守在积雪地区的城堡门口，绝不肯让大门无人看守。纯冰利刃一旦击中，就会将对方冻住。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME usually stands guard at the gates of castles in snow-covered regions, which it refuses to leave unguarded. Its sharp blades of pure ice freeze anyone they strike on contact.

entry: POKENAME毛皮粗糙，摸起来刺激，裸露皮肤常会起疹。研究者发现，毛上覆着微小倒刺，还沾有腐蚀性毒素。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur is coarse and irritating to the touch, often causing rashes to unprotected skin. Pokémon researchers have found that their hair is covered in microscopic barbs coated in a caustic toxin.

entry: POKENAME的厚毛能让它在最大风雪中也暖和舒适。丝带轻轻一蹭，就能将暖意分给其他对象，是穿过寒冷地区时极珍贵的旅伴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's thick fur lets it remain nice and warm even in the heaviest of snowy conditions. With just a light brush of its ribbons, it can share its warmth with others, making it invaluable as a traveling companion through frigid areas.

entry: POKENAME的长毛几乎遮得看不见，却有强大嗅觉弥补。它能轻松闻出敌人，再用伸长的双臂精准重击。
author: sk372
source: Though its overgrown fur leaves it mostly blind, POKENAME compensates with a powerful sense of smell. It can pick out a foe's scent with ease and use its extendable arms with potent precision.

entry: POKENAME偏爱独居，人类在野外极少目击。身上冰晶能在周围掀起局部暴风雪，进一步藏好行踪。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME prefers to live a solitary life, so sightings of it in the wild by humans are exceedingly rare. The ice crystals on its body can generate a localized blizzard around it to help obscure its presence.

entry: POKENAME会用坚韧爪子刮开层层积雪，吃下面的苔原地衣。它虽然慢，蓬乱长毛却能在最猛烈暴风雪中保暖。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME feeds on lichen that grows in the tundra, scraping them up from beneath layers of snow with its tough claws. Though it's a slow Pokémon, its shaggy fur keeps it warm even in the most brutal snowstorms.

entry: POKENAME身体机能过于旺盛，毛发长得惊人，甚至遮住双眼，让它跑动时只能盲目乱扑腾。即使全剪掉，不到一小时就会长回来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's fur grows at an alarming rate due to its overactive body functions, even covering its eyes and causing it to flail around blindly as it runs around. Even if its fur is trimmed completely, it will grow back in less than an hour.

entry: POKENAME天生就想寻找、种植、照料番荔果。雪季一到，毛皮就会变长，再靠储藏的番荔果生活。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has natural-born instincts that compel it to find, plant, and take care of Yache Berries. Once the snowy, wintry season hits, its fur coat grows longer and it lives off its Yache Berry horde.

entry: POKENAME看不见，靠灵敏嗅觉辨物。它会偷其他宝可梦气味浓烈的草蚕果，保护自己免遭岩石属性宝可梦伤害。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on a keen sense of smell to identify different objects because they are blind. They steal pungent Charti Berries from other Pokémon to protect themselves from Rock-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME发抖时，毛里会迸出小片飞雪。在较冷月份，这种现象常预示着更大的降雪。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME shivers, tiny flurries of snow burst from its fur. This phenomenon often heralds heavier snowfall in colder months.

entry: POKENAME能从双獠牙发射冰冻光束。烦躁时，吐息会冻住周围空气，形成冰雾。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires Ice Beams from its twin tusks. When agitated, its breath frosts the air around it to cause an icy fog.

entry: POKENAME冰冷的毛一接触就能冻住对方。它会把冻僵的受害者拖回洞里，在寂静寒冷中寻求陪伴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's icy fur can freeze others on contact. It drags frozen victims into its cave, seeking company in the silent cold.

entry: POKENAME摸起来冰冷，待在身旁也令人不适。传说它会冻结人的灵魂，让对方变得无情。虽然英文名让人联想到沙，它似乎与地面属性无关。
author: the_lizard43
source: Cold to the touch and sickening to be around, POKENAME is said to cause people's soul to freeze, turning them into a heartless being. This Pokémon seems to have no relation to the Ground type despite its namesake.

entry: POKENAME常被误当成普通沙堆，让人踩上去，因此已演化出坚硬的沙质外壳。
author: thefrenchchefyt
source: POKENAME is often stepped on by people mistaking it for an ordinary pile of sand. This caused POKENAME to develop a hard outer shell of sand.

entry: POKENAME看似蓬松，毛却冰冷。它会埋在雪里睡觉，吸收寒气。
author: .izik
source: Despite its fluffy look, POKENAME's fur is freezing to the touch. It sleeps buried in snow, absorbing the cold.

entry: POKENAME的毛极软又保温。许多攀登天冠山的旅人，都曾在漫长行途中被野生个体蜷身包住，救回一命。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The fur of POKENAME is incredibly soft and insulating. Many a climber have found themselves saved by wild POKENAME curling around them on long journeys up Mt. Coronet.

entry: POKENAME的英文名源自栖身之处——“岩石堆”。厚毛既能保温，也能抵御轻微攻击，许多服装设计师都曾从它的模样获得外套设计灵感。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME is named after the places they abided - "pile of rocks". Their thick fur works as a great insulator and protection from light attacks, and many clothing designers have used their looks as inspiration for coats.

entry: 寒冷地区很需要有暖身效果的莲蒲果。农夫常请POKENAME寻找，因为敏锐嗅觉能轻松定位。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: In colder regions, there is a high demand for Chople Berries due to their heating properties. Consequently, farmers often employ POKENAME to find them, as POKENAME's keen sense of smell can easily locate their whereabouts.

entry: 这种宝可梦看似凶猛，其实是和平又懒散的草食者，大多时候都在冬眠，或保护进化前的同类。
author: t3isukone
source: While this Pokémon appears fierce, it is a peaceful and lazy herbivore, spending most of its time hibernating or protecting its pre-evolutions.

entry: 坚实冰层为POKENAME的身体增添防护。它能让冰层伸出尖柱，再成批射出，击退袭击者。
author: sk372
source: A solid coat of ice gives POKENAME's body added protection from attacks. It can make sharp icicles protrude from this coat, launching them en masse to ward off any attackers.

entry: POKENAME在白银山周围的雪崖和裂隙间筑巢。夜里最活跃，能见它振翅穿过冷空气，翅上的鳞片在月光下如雪闪亮。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their nests in the snowy crags and crevasses surrounding Mt. Silver. They are most active at night and can be seen fluttering through the freezing air, wing scales glittering in the moonlight like snow.

entry: POKENAME能把头痛的力量导进长杖，产生雪。越疼，出雪越多。有些格外残忍的训练家，会过度刺激它的头脑，故意引起头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME channel the power of their headaches to produce snow from their staff. The more pain they are in, the more snow comes out of the staff. Some particularly cruel Trainers overstimulate their minds to create headaches.

entry: POKENAME住在冰湖旁。厚毛入水后贴伏下来，能让它优雅地游过冰冷水流。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dwells by frozen lakes. Its thick fur mats down in water, allowing it to swim gracefully in icy currents.

entry: POKENAME双眼被遮住时很温顺，喜欢在雪地里玩。若有什么想把眼睛暴露在强光下，它就会暴怒，不断推开对方，直到重新理好毛发。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: While their eyes are covered, POKENAME are docile creatures that enjoy playing in fields of snow. If something tries to expose their eyes to bright lights, they will fly into a rage and push away until they can smooth out their fur.

entry: POKENAME平时缓慢稳步前进，节省能量，却也能突然高速奔跑，几乎从不显得疲倦。它偏爱富含蛋白质和脂肪的食物。
author: bobosmith01
source: While usually moving slowly and steadily to conserve energy, POKENAME has the ability to run suddenly at high speeds. Rarely does it ever seem to tire. It prefers a diet high in protein and fat.

entry: POKENAME平时缓慢稳步前进，节省能量，却也能突然高速奔跑，几乎从不显得疲倦。它偏爱富含蛋白质和脂肪的食物。
author: bobosmith01
source: While usually moving slowly and steadily to conserve energy, POKENAME has the ability to run suddenly at high speeds. Rarely does it ever seem to tire. It prefers a diet high in protein and fat.

entry: POKENAME生活在极地水域，较暖月份会用獠牙刮食冰上生长的藻类。即使周围水冷得刺骨，厚毛也能保暖。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are found in polar waters, using their tusks to scrape for algae growing on the ice during the warmer months. They rely on their thick fur to keep themselves warm despite the freezing water around them.

entry: POKENAME看不太清，常朝碰到自己或挡路的东西挥拳。好在听觉出色，能迅速认出训练家，免得日后不小心伤到对方。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Not being able to see well, POKENAME often resort to punching anything that bumps into them or gets in their way. Using their exceptional hearing they quickly identify their Trainer, preventing POKENAME from accidentally hurting them in the future.

entry: 它没有眼睑，头顶那片毛既能御寒，也能替双眼遮光。训练家若去掉这片毛，它就会因刺激过度而无精打采。
author: quackquackattack
source: It does not have eyelids, so the patch of fur atop its head serves as both protection from cold weather and a way to shade its eyes. If its Trainer removes this patch of fur, it becomes lethargic from overstimulation.

entry: POKENAME的浓密毛皮能让它在寒冷家园生存，保温性十分珍贵。有些宝可梦培育家会为此饲养大群。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have dense fur coats that help them survive the cold environments that they call home. Their fur is highly prized for its insulating properties and some Pokémon Breeders will maintain large herds of them for this.

entry: POKENAME住在冰冷水边，像呆呆兽一样用尾巴钓鱼。受袭时，会慢吞吞却坚定地用庞大身体撞击敌人。只有吃蘑菇和海鲜时，才明显兴奋起来。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME lives by ice-cold waters and fishes using its tail, just like Slowpoke. If attacked, it will slowly but surely use its large body and slam into foes. It only becomes outwardly excited over a meal of mushrooms and seafood.

entry: POKENAME尾巴覆着厚冰，能倒着冲向敌人，用尾巴打击。寒冷似乎不令它难受，暖天还帮助它降温。
author: .jerden
source: Its tail is covered with thick ice, which POKENAME can strike foes with by charging at them backwards. The cold doesn't seem to bother it and helps to keep it cool during warm weather.

entry: POKENAME群居，会挥动獠牙和角彼此较量。穿过冰海的水手会饲养它，让它用角撞开冰山，清理航路。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME live in herds where they compete by swiping tusks and horns at each other. Sailors traveling through icy waters keep them to clear icebergs, which the POKENAME crash into with their horns.

entry: POKENAME的舌头极冷，会先冻住海带再吃，让质地更脆，方便咀嚼。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tongue is extremely cold. It uses it to freeze kelp before eating, making the texture more brittle and easier to chew.

entry: POKENAME住在暖海，维持背上珊瑚群落的生命。作为交换，珊瑚会通过光合作用给它能量。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME resides in warm oceans to keep the coral colony on its back alive. In exchange, the coral gives POKENAME energy through photosynthesis.

entry: POKENAME很少移动，通常伏在海底，静候小型鱼宝可梦游近，再将其吃掉。
author: sottiwotti
source: POKENAME don't move very often. They usually lay on the ocean floor, silently waiting for small fish Pokémon to come closer so they can eat them.

entry: POKENAME会收集死珊瑚当武器。遇到准妈妈时，会送出珊瑚，祝愿孩子健康。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME collects dead coral to use as a weapon. If it encounters an expecting mother, it will offer the coral as an omen of a healthy child.

entry: 太阳珊瑚会聚在POKENAME周围寻求保护。谁不小心毁坏它的家园，就会遭到猛烈踢击。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: Corsola gather around POKENAME for protection. It delivers devastating kicks to anyone who carelessly destroys its home.

entry: 这种水生宝可梦出拳比子弹还快。POKENAME还会把海葵拿在手里，让每拳都附带痛苦的刺蜇，雪上加霜。
author: hophoppip
source: This aquatic Pokémon can fire a punch faster than a bullet. To further worsen the blow, POKENAME carries anemones in its hands, adding a painful sting to every punch.

entry: POKENAME分泌的黏液极黏，能困住微生物，供它吸食，也能兼作保护层。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The viscous slime POKENAME releases is very sticky. It traps microscopic organisms for POKENAME to slurp up. It also doubles as a protective coating.

entry: 它只会在藏身处静等进化，好摆脱外壳。深海巨压强化了珊瑚铠甲，比石头更硬，将身体包在里面。
author: fiordaliso
source: All it does is wait in its hiding place for the evolution that will free it from its shell. Its body is encased in a coral armor harder than stone, strengthened by the immense pressure of the ocean depths.

entry: 它附着在海里的有毒废物上，吸收毒素维生，同时也将废物净化。
author: staghorn
source: It attaches itself to oceanic toxic waste. It sustains itself by absorbing the toxins, purifying the waste in the process.

entry: 一道道洁净温暖的海水从体内流出。POKENAME栖居的地方，海洋生物往往十分繁盛。
author: pizzarcato
source: Ribbons of clean, warm ocean water stream out of its body. Ocean life prospers in areas POKENAME call home.

entry: POKENAME住在岩岸上，常与鸟宝可梦争斗得筋疲力尽，随后到潮池里晒太阳恢复精力。
author: pizzarcato
source: POKENAME wears itself out trying to fight bird Pokémon on the rocky shores it calls home. To recharge, it will bask in tide pools.

entry: POKENAME在浅水中寻找好坏星，试图将其击败。一旦获胜，背上的气泡便会喷得更加猛烈。
author: pizzarcato
source: POKENAME wades in shallow waters, attempting to find and defeat Mareanie. If it succeeds, the bubbles spouting from its back intensify.

entry: 水属性宝可梦要穿越陆地时，会找上POKENAME。POKENAME便用水袋装着它，将它送到目的地。
author: staghorn
source: If a Water-type Pokémon needs to travel across land, it will seek out a POKENAME. The POKENAME then carries it in its water pouch to its destination.

entry: POKENAME腹前的鳞片坚如石头。它动作慢，对水中微小变化又敏感，因此常待在原地。不过偶尔也会在傍晚浮上来，看看满月。
author: bobosmith01
source: The scales in front of POKENAME's stomach are as tough as stone. It is slow-moving and sensitive to minute changes in the water, so it often stays in one place. Rarely, however, it may surface during the evening to look at the full moon.

entry: POKENAME生活在珊瑚礁及周边，似乎会吸收来自宇宙的未知能量，再借此让海洋生命恢复活力。
author: fenragon
source: POKENAME live on and around coral reefs. They seem to soak up a strange, unknown energy from space to and use it to help revitalize ocean life.

entry: POKENAME会蜕下部分珊瑚身体，修补珊瑚礁的受损之处。再生能力惊人，只需几分钟，脱落部分就能长回来。
author: fiordaliso
source: To heal damaged sections of coral reef, POKENAME sheds pieces of its own coral body to repair them. Its remarkably fast regenerative abilities let it regrow the shed parts within just a few minutes.

entry: POKENAME会在海边表演有趣魔术，把泡泡吹成出奇坚固的物件。结束时，总会吹出小动物和玩具剑，送给台下的孩子。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME puts on fun beach side magic shows, blowing bubbles into surprisingly sturdy objects. At the end of its shows, it always blows small creatures and play swords and gives them to the children in the audience.

entry: 水中污染太多时，POKENAME身上生长的珊瑚会变白。珠宝匠有时会采来，制成订婚戒指。
author: .izik
source: The coral growing from POKENAME's body turns white when there is too much pollution in the water. Jewelers sometimes harvest this coral and craft it into engagement rings.

entry: 热带海滩上常能看见POKENAME摇摆起舞。当地人会模仿，相信能让珊瑚礁恢复生机，保证渔获丰收。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME can be found on tropical beaches, performing a swaying dance. Locals copy this Pokémon's dances, believing them to bring life to the coral reefs and ensure a good harvest of fish.

entry: POKENAME会守护其他水生宝可梦，既用强大电力迎击捕食者，也会分享雷电，为其他电属性宝可梦大幅充能，帮助它们。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME acts as a defender of its fellow aquatic species. Not only will it fight predators with its own formidable electric capacity, it also shares its lightning to supercharge other Electric types and aid them.

entry: 它们藏在缤纷的水生植物间，平时避免争斗。因此，野外很少有POKENAME能够进化。
author: bobosmith01
source: They hide among colorful underwater plant life and generally avoid combat. As a result, very few POKENAME evolve in the wild.

entry: POKENAME不知疲倦地巡游珊瑚礁，守护自然家园的完整。它极不信任人类，会凶猛地攻击船和潜水者，不惜一切把对方赶走。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME wanders tirelessly among coral reefs to watch over the integrity of its natural habitat. It becomes extremely aggressive toward boats and divers, driving them away at all costs due to its deep distrust of humans.

entry: POKENAME住在寒冷北海，捕食者很少。不过气候变化令海水升温，正威胁它们的数量。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME dwell in cold northern seas and have few predators. However, climate change is threatening their numbers as the temperature of the ocean rises.

entry: POKENAME会附在太阳珊瑚群上，让它们够到更远的地方。作为回报，对方会分些剩饭给它。它还会把泄漏的油引离住处，保护太阳珊瑚。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME latches onto groups of Corsola and extends their reach. In return they feed it leftovers from their meals. It also protects Corsola from oil spills by guiding the oil away from where they live.

entry: POKENAME的形态适应性强，对周围水质变化更有抵抗力。自然保护区正将它引入太阳珊瑚群，盼这种适应力随时间扩散，帮助整个种类延续。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's adaptive form makes it more resilient to changes in water conditions around it. Nature preserves are introducing it to Corsola colonies in the hopes it may spread this resilience over time and help the species's longevity.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在暖海的珊瑚礁间游泳。粉红身体在水上看很显眼，入水后却能融进珊瑚，常让想观察的研究者找得头疼。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME love swimming among coral reefs in warm ocean environments. While their pink bodies can be easily spotted by those above water, they blend in well with the corals around them, often frustrating researchers hoping to see them.

entry: POKENAME的身体已演化得能融入最纯净水域的珊瑚间。为了抵御捕食者，它会让尖刺带电，释放强力电击，连大得多的宝可梦也能震晕。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body has evolved to blend seamlessly among the corals found only in the purest waters. To fend off predators, it charges its spikes with electricity, releasing jolts strong enough to stun even much larger Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME能加热流过蓬松蓝毛的水，即使冷海也能适应。若水域变浑浊或受污染，鲜艳的粉红体色就会褪去。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can thrive even in cold oceans, as they warm up the water that flows through their fluffy blue fur. Their vivid pink color will fade if the water they live in becomes murky or polluted.

entry: POKENAME在设备里待太久，接口就会开始长出珊瑚状结构，可能造成无法修复的损坏。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME lingers within a device too long, coral-like growths begin forming from its ports. These formations can cause irreparable damage to equipment.

entry: POKENAME会藏进珊瑚，完美融入礁群，躲避捕食者。刺上带着刺激性极强的毒素，接触时便会释放。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME hides among the corals to avoid being spotted by predators, blending seamlessly into the reef. Its spines are laced with a highly irritating toxin that it releases upon contact.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME的模样，可能就是数百万年前镰刀盔的样子。粉红体色让对手小看它，转眼就被锋利的肢体击败。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME's appearance is believed to be what Kabutops could have possibly looked like millions of years ago. The pink coloration of its body causes opponents to underestimate POKENAME, who are quickly defeated with its sharp limbs.

entry: POKENAME与肚里的水属性宝可梦共生，为它们提供安全与食物。作为回报，它白天大多在睡觉时，对方便会提醒潜在威胁。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME shares a symbiotic bond with the Water-type Pokémon in its belly, providing them safety and food. In return, they alert POKENAME to potential threats while it sleeps through most of the day.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片呈珊瑚色，表面粗糙磨人。海洋生物学家会观察鳞片变色，监测珊瑚礁健康；它因污染生病时，鳞片就会变蓝。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have scales with a coral tint and an abrasive exterior. Marine biologists monitor the health of coral reefs by watching for discoloration of POKENAME scales, which become blue if they are ill from pollution.

entry: 传说POKENAME能用精神力量修复被毁的珊瑚礁。它一生住在暖海海底，睡在嘴里吹出的大泡泡上。
author: fiordaliso
source: Rumor has it that POKENAME, thanks to its psychic powers, is able to restore destroyed coral reefs. It spends its life on the ocean floor in warm seas, sleeping on large bubbles it blows out of its mouth.

entry: 传说POKENAME能用精神力量修复被毁的珊瑚礁。它一生住在暖海海底，睡在嘴里吹出的大泡泡上。
author: fiordaliso
source: Rumor has it that POKENAME, thanks to its psychic powers, is able to restore destroyed coral reefs. It spends its life on the ocean floor in warm seas, sleeping on large bubbles it blows out of its mouth.

entry: POKENAME能完美融入珊瑚，极难目击。谁扰乱海洋生物，它就会用强大的超能力与水属性攻击，将其赶走。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is an extremely rare Pokémon to spot, due to its ability to blend in perfectly with the coral. POKENAME drives away anyone who disturbs marine life using a combination of powerful Psychic and Water-type attacks.

entry: POKENAME群会沿海底长途跋涉，寻找珊瑚礁进食、争夺配偶。不过珊瑚礁白化，正让它们的数量迅速减少。
author: _._starry_._
source: Herds of POKENAME travel great distances along the seafloor to find coral reefs, where they feed and compete for mates. Due to the bleaching of reefs, their numbers are quickly declining.

entry: POKENAME住在南方暖海。受到威胁时，背上的珊瑚枝能热得煮沸周围海水。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME resides in warm southern seas. When threatened, the coral branches on this Pokémon's back can become hot enough to boil the water around them.

entry: 幼年POKENAME常啃珊瑚块磨牙，帮助双颚和獠牙发育。也常因同类身上长珊瑚，就咬起对方。
author: infinex21
source: Young POKENAME often teethe on chunks of coral to help their jaws and fangs develop. They often will bite their own kind due to the coral that grows on their bodies.

entry: POKENAME常叼着一块珊瑚啃，几乎像在用牙签。它爱在珊瑚群旁休息，谁靠近就咬谁。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are often seen gnawing on a piece of coral, almost like a toothpick. They tend to rest near formations of coral and will bite at those who draw near.

entry: 野生POKENAME在珊瑚丛里筑巢，周围会长满美丽的海藻与其他藻类。它会过滤、吸收污染物，维持巢穴清洁健康，再把它们制成浓毒，存进巨大的刺里。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME make hives within formations of coral, which become rife with beautiful seaweed and algae. Their large stingers contain a thick toxin from the pollutants their bodies filter and absorb to keep their coral hives clean and healthy.

entry: POKENAME会用喙折下珊瑚枝筑巢。水温下降后，就会成群迁往更暖的海洋。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their beaks to break off branches of coral, building their nests out of them. When the water temperature drops, they migrate to warmer oceans in flocks.

entry: 野生POKENAME会藏在珊瑚丛里伪装，猎物靠近就凶狠咬住。每年都得在背上珊瑚长得太大前蜕掉，营养丰富的珊瑚很快又会再生。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME disguise themselves in clusters of coral and fiercely bite down upon any prey that may draw near. Every year, a POKENAME must shed the coral upon its back before it grows too much. This coral is nutrient-rich and grows back quick.

entry: 它们会用丝网和珊瑚织巢，轻易困住小型水生宝可梦，也能放出含毒气泡，震慑更大的宝可梦与人。
author: infinex21
source: They weave nests of webbing and coral that easily entrap small, aquatic Pokémon. They can loose bubbles that contain poison to deter larger Pokémon and humans.

entry: POKENAME会用尖喙修剪翅上的珊瑚和海藻，再把剩余材料编进巢里。经阳光照晒，材料会逐渐褪成白色。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME trim coral and cut seaweed from their wings with sharp beaks. The remaining material is incorporated into their nest, turning into a bleached white after being exposed to sunlight.

entry: POKENAME的诱饵其实是小气囊，能帮它收集海底小物件。不过垃圾常卡在管里，害它呼吸困难。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's lures are actually small air pockets, allowing it to collect small items from the seafloor. However, it will often get pieces of trash stuck in its tubes, causing it difficulty breathing.

entry: POKENAME会定期浸水，给翅膀补充水分，免得海带般的生长物干枯。污染水域里很少见，数量不断减少，正让宝可梦生态学家越来越担忧。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME periodically dip into water to hydrate their wings, keeping the kelp-like growths from drying out. They are rare in polluted waters and Pokémon ecologists are growing concerned  about their declining populations.

entry: POKENAME会在潮池里一动不动，伪装珊瑚。受到触碰就反应激烈，操纵锋利水刃轰退捕食者。臂端的水富含矿物，可能从中析出晶体。
author: vic1312
source: Mimicking coral within tide pools, POKENAME remain still. They react dramatically when touched, controlling sharp blades of water to blast back predators. The water that tips their arms is very rich in minerals and may precipitate crystals within.

entry: POKENAME随海风漂在热带水域。悬在珊瑚礁上方时会跳舞，有人说能让礁体和其中的生物更健康。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats around tropical waters, carried by the ocean breeze. It dances in midair when hovering over coral reefs, and some say these dances improve the health of the reef and its inhabitants.

entry: POKENAME会啃掉珊瑚生病的部分磨牙，维护整片礁群的完整。它只在寻找海床沙中藏着的食物时，才会离巢。
author: fiordaliso
source: It sharpens its teeth by gnawing on diseased parts of the coral, thereby preserving the integrity of the rest of the reef. POKENAME leaves its den only to venture out in search of food hidden in the sand on the seabed.

entry: POKENAME繁殖周期很长，在暖海里也很少见。它总找阴影待着，因为直射阳光会让身上珊瑚白化。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are a rare sight in warm oceans as they have very slow reproductive cycles. They always seek the shade, as direct sunlight can bleach the corals that grow on it.

entry: POKENAME安睡在珊瑚礁里，几乎不理会打扰。如果游泳者擦过，它只会换个姿势，继续打盹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps peacefully within coral reefs, barely reacting to disturbances. If a Swimmer brushes against it, it simply shifts its position and continues its nap.

entry: 传说POKENAME的珊瑚能在月光下再生。它天性害羞，却从不犹豫用强大的水流攻击抵御侵犯。
author: fiordaliso
source: Rumor has it that POKENAME's coral can regenerate when bathed in moonlight. Although it is shy by nature, it never hesitates to fend off aggressors with powerful water-based attacks.

entry: 它大多数时间都在水下休息，让珊瑚进行光合作用。敌人若从上方靠近，珊瑚的毒刺便会防御。
author: hophoppip
source: It spends most of its time resting underwater while its coral photosynthesizes. If a foe approaches from above, the coral's toxic stingers act as a defense.

entry: POKENAME守护珊瑚礁，谁敢靠得太近，就会被它露牙威吓。它只能在暖海生存，水温太低，珊瑚生长物就开始褪色。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME guards coral reefs, baring its fangs at anyone who dares come too close. It can thrive only in warm seas; if the water temperature drops too low, its coral growths begin to lose their color.

entry: POKENAME海绵般的头发里有迷你珊瑚礁，住着躲避捕食者的小型宝可梦。它的哀号能赶走天敌，尖叫也成了热带海域古老沉船灵异故事的来源。
author: pjporwoll
source: Small Pokémon live in the miniature reef in POKENAME's spongy hair for protection from predators, which are warded off by its wailing. Its screams were the source of old ghost stories of shipwrecks in tropical waters.

entry: 这种善良的宝可梦会挺身而出，保护弱小海洋生物，甘愿为高尚目标冒险。可惜实力很弱，常被打得很惨。
author: evilgammon
source: This kindhearted Pokémon protects weak sea life from danger, putting itself on the line for it's noble cause. It is quite weak however and often gets beaten quite badly.

entry: POKENAME已变得十分强大，能保护无辜海洋生物，抵御遭遇的一切危险。这位英雄因此赢得“珊瑚礁守护者”的称号。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME has gotten very strong and can protect innocent sea life from any danger it may encounter. This heroic Pokémon has earned itself the title of Protector Of The Reef.

entry: POKENAME是外来入侵种，爱把净水药剂当零食，因此大量侵入公共泳池。人类想入池，它就会粗暴地赶走对方。
author: ghostslythe
source: An invasive species, POKENAME seek out water purification chemicals as treats. This has led it to infesting public swimming pools, violently kicking out humans who attempt to enter.

entry: POKENAME会驮着健康的幼珊瑚，前往遭白化侵袭的珊瑚礁。大群个体轻柔地移植新珊瑚，努力修复海洋失去的生机。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME travel to places where coral reefs have fallen prey to bleaching, bringing young, healthy corals along on their shell. Droves of POKENAME will gently transplant the new corals, working to restore what the ocean has lost.

entry: 这种宝可梦游泳最高时速可达100英里，灵巧无比，在水中飞快穿梭。动作迅疾，很难捕捉。
author: .izik
source: This Pokémon can swim at speeds of up to 100 mph, darting through the water with unmatched agility. Its swift movements make it difficult to catch.

entry: 这种快乐的宝可梦会在岛间递送热带邮件，也捎带彩色贝壳和干珊瑚作纪念品。当地人相信，在阳光下读一封，就能带来海上好运。
author: jaminmcready
source: This joyful Pokémon delivers Tropic Mail between islands, ferrying colorful shells and dried coral as souvenirs. Locals believe reading one under the sun brings luck at sea.

entry: POKENAME在暖海的珊瑚礁间巡游，赶走靠近家园的船只，防止水域受污染。射出的水柱力道极强，连钢铁船壳也能打坏。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME roams the coral reefs in the warm sea, driving away any ships that approach its habitat to protect its waters from pollution. It can shoot jets of water powerful enough to damage even the steel hulls of boats.

entry: POKENAME会用小鼻子清洁停泊在暖水港的船底。发现捕食者时，就藏进海底沙中，借身上珊瑚融入环境。
author: fiordaliso
source: With its small proboscis, it keeps the hulls of boats moored in warm-water ports clean. If it spots a predator, POKENAME hides beneath the sand on the seafloor, using the corals on its body to blend into its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME常在海滨度假广告牌周围悬浮。虽然能当鱼缸的天然过滤器，却也能神奇地闪入网络空间，逃离囚禁。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME are found hovering around billboards advertising oceanic vacations. Used as natural filters for fish tanks, they have the uncanny ability to escape confinement by flickering through cyberspace.

entry: 它身上长的珊瑚会产生更多虫黄藻，颜色格外鲜艳。部分虫黄藻能从尾巴排出，为白化珊瑚和太阳珊瑚恢复颜色与生机。
author: hophoppip
source: The coral that grows on its body produces extra zooxanthellae, making it remarkably vivid. It's able to exude some of its zooxanthellae through its tail, and uses it to restore color and life to bleached coral and Corsola.

entry: 它会独占所有肌力粘糕，不爱分给其他宝可梦。家园受污染、食物短缺后，才养成了这副刻薄性子。
author: quackquackattack
source: It hogs all the Muscle Mochi to itself and does not enjoy sharing with other Pokémon. It developed this snarky attitude when its home became polluted, and food was scarce.

entry: POKENAME坚硬的枝条能为麻麻小鱼提供掩护。双方会合力放电，狠狠电击袭击者。
author: mepp.
source: The rigid branches of POKENAME provide useful cover for Tynamo. Together they combine their electricity to deliver nasty shocks to attackers.

entry: POKENAME始终很善良，愿意把珊瑚枝送给任何对象，连想捕食它的好坏星也不例外。许多人会保留枝条，作为祈愿未来幸福喜悦的幸运符。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is always very kind and will give coral branches to anyone, even to Mareanie trying to hunt it. Many people keep the branches it gives as good-luck charms for future happiness and joy.

entry: POKENAME住在深海，守护海中所有水生生物，维持珊瑚礁的美丽纯净。咆哮能掀起潮浪。
author: keiracm35_
source: POKENAME lives in the depths of the sea and watches over all the aquatic creatures of the ocean. It is responsible for maintaining the beauty and purity of the coral reefs. Its roars can create tidal waves.

entry: 多种水生宝可梦会藏在POKENAME泡沫般的毛皮与水构成的鬃毛里。冷水中，它会煮沸周围海水保暖；不过身旁有其他宝可梦时，宁愿忍寒，也不愿烫伤它们。
author: santon5512
source: A diverse array of aquatic Pokémon hide in these Pokémon's bubbly fur and watery manes. In frigid waters, POKENAME boil the water around themselves to keep warm, though they will brave the cold if other Pokémon are around so as not to boil them.

entry: 传说POKENAME会在暖海现身，保护濒危珊瑚礁，赶走污染海水的船。它虽然罕见，许多水手仍畏惧它，避开那些水域。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to legend, POKENAME appears in warm seas to protect endangered coral reefs and drive away ships that polluted them. Though rarely seen, many sailors fear it and avoid those waters.

entry: POKENAME模样鲜艳可爱，电光也五彩缤纷，十分抢手，但饲养比多数人想的难。饮水必须十分新鲜洁净，哪怕一点杂质也很容易让它生病。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is highly sought for its vibrant, cute appearance and colorful electricity, but raising it is more difficult than most realize. It requires the freshest water to drink and easily gets ill if even a few impurities are present.

entry: POKENAME尾上的珊瑚突起能刮伤被击中的对象，是有效的防身手段。不过它自己坐在尾巴上弹跳，却毫无不适，也不会受伤。
author: sk372
source: The coral outcroppings on POKENAME's tail scrape and scratch those it strikes, making it an effective method of self-defense. It can sit upon its own tail and bounce about without any discomfort or injury.

entry: POKENAME在暖海生活得很好，会好奇地靠近过往船只。水手说，它曾引导船只安全穿过汹涌海面，因此现身是好兆头。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME thrive in warm seas and curiously approach passing boats. According to sailors, their presence is a good omen as they have been known to guide ships safely through rough waters.

entry: 它从独特的臂炮射出压实的珊瑚巨石。打得兴起时，偶尔连太阳珊瑚也会不小心射出去。
author: pizzarcato
source: Compacted boulders of coral are blasted from its distinctive arm cannon. In its fervor, Corsola are occasionally launched by accident.

entry: POKENAME住在离珊瑚礁和太阳珊瑚群不远的海岸，用双臂喷出过热水流，守护这些珍贵家园。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives in coastal areas not far from where coral reefs and Corsola colonies reside. It defends these precious habitats by firing superheated torrents of water from its arms.

entry: POKENAME会在珊瑚礁里凿出复杂地洞网络，便于逃生。它不擅游泳，而是沿海底步行，靠天然伪装自保。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make burrows within coral reefs, carving through the reef structure to form an intricate network of escape tunnels. They are poor swimmers and instead walk along the sea floor, relying on their natural camouflage to protect them.

entry: POKENAME会用强壮双腿在海中突进，凶猛地守护珊瑚礁。因保护珊瑚礁的努力，阿罗拉如今反而出现了个体过多的问题。
author: miss_lunala
source: A fierce defender of the coral reefs, POKENAME use their powerful legs to launch themselves through the ocean. There are now an overabundance of POKENAME in Alola due to the effort to conserve the coral reefs.

entry: POKENAME会让脆弱的小型宝可梦，躲进头顶生长的珊瑚。若有愚蠢潜水者想从家园偷珊瑚，它就会踢过去。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME allows small, vulnerable Pokémon to shelter within the coral that grows from its head. It kicks foolish divers who try to steal coral from its home.

entry: POKENAME通常生活在温暖的半咸水中。鲜艳体色可惜会引来巨沼怪等捕食者，但它对多数宝可梦仍很友好。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME typically live in warm, brackish waters. Unfortunately, their bright coloration makes them a target for Pokémon such as Swampert. Despite that, they remain friendly towards most Pokémon.

entry: 野生POKENAME努力摆出强硬模样，防范潜在捕食者。幸好身体强壮，无论战斗还是游泳都很出色。
author: bobosmith01
source: Wild POKENAME try to maintain a tough image in order to keep themselves safe from potential predators. Thankfully, they have a powerful body that is excellent at both battling and swimming.

entry: 热带地区的餐馆和店铺常雇POKENAME接待顾客。鲜艳外表与无可挑剔的专业服务，让顾客十分着迷。
author: sk372
source: Restaurants and other shops in tropical regions often employ POKENAME to help serve clients. Customers are enamored by their vibrant appearance and impeccably professional service.

entry: POKENAME披着宽大的海藻斗篷，用臂刃保护珊瑚礁和太阳珊瑚。长期与好坏星、超坏星对抗，体内已有抵御它们毒素的抗体。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME don capes of vast seaweed and use their arm blades to protect coral reefs and Corsola. Their bodies contain antibodies for the poisons of Mareanie and Toxapex after so long of being at arms with them.

entry: POKENAME能变色，融入任何一片珊瑚。随着海温上升，越来越多个体的颜色变淡了。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME can shift its color to blend in with any patch of coral. As ocean temperatures rise, more and more POKENAME bear paler colors.

entry: POKENAME十分聪明，能凭磁化珊瑚的能力，融入礁群隐藏。它会袭击毫无防备的超坏星，将其按住，咬成碎块。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME use their incredible intelligence to hide among their surroundings, using their ability to magnetize coral to blend in with reefs. They attack unsuspecting Toxapex, pinning them down and chewing them to bits.

entry: POKENAME由死去的太阳珊瑚与其身上所有珊瑚虫的灵魂转生而来。如今能自由移动，它很开心，常挥舞身体乱动。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is a reincarnation of the spirits of a deceased Corsola and all the coral polyps on its body. It's delighted by its new freedom of movement, and often flails about.

entry: POKENAME对领地里的外来物好奇，会游近水面船只。虽然目光好奇，却不能随便伸手抓，因为身上藏着毒刺。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are curious about foreign objects in their territory and will swim up to boats on the water. Despite their curious gaze, they should not be grabbed on account of POKENAME's hidden poison spikes.

entry: POKENAME沿海底缓步前进，不停吃海带和海藻。背上的海葵为许多小型宝可梦提供住处，它们都对毒液免疫。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME trudge along the seafloor, constantly eating kelp and seaweed. The anemone on their backs gives homes to many smaller Pokémon that are immune to their venom.

entry: POKENAME十分捍卫领地，尤其重视保护太阳珊瑚。看见好坏星追捕太阳珊瑚，就会游过去，使出大地之力还击。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are quite defensive of their territory, with an emphasis on protecting Corsola. When they spot Mareanie chasing Corsola, POKENAME swim over to retaliate with Earth Power.

entry: 野生POKENAME是害羞的深海生物，头上黏触手形似海葵，能掩护自己，也能捉住猎物进食。
author: keiracm35_
source: Wild POKENAME are shy creatures of the deep sea, hidden by the anemone-like appearance of the sticky tentacles on their head, which they use to catch prey and obtain food.

entry: POKENAME背上有一片珊瑚礁。它大体爱好和平，好坏星出现后，野外数量便急剧减少。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: POKENAME have a coral reef on their backs. Their population in the wild has dwindled drastically since the appearance of Mareanie, as POKENAME are a largely peaceful species.

entry: 有证据显示，怪颚龙最初漫游这颗星球时，这种融合体就已存在。POKENAME虽完全水生，头上的水罩却让它能短暂离水，迁往新水源。
author: _pixelar_
source: There's evidence that this fusion has existed since Tyrantrum first roamed the planet. Although POKENAME is a fully aquatic species, it is able to leave the water for a short time to move to a new water source, thanks to the water dome on its head.

entry: POKENAME不像盾甲龙，不喜欢头上的硬骨板被擦亮，尤其讨厌粗暴擦拭。因此植物和寄生物可能聚在上面，共生鱼类宝可梦便会吃掉这些生长物，帮忙清洁。
author: bobosmith01
source: Unlike Shieldon, POKENAME dislikes having its hard cranium plate polished, especially when done so in a rough manner. As a result, plant growths and parasites may gather on it; mutualistic fish Pokémon help clean it by eating these growths.

entry: 鲜艳的身体能让它完美融入珊瑚礁。它会一直不动，等小型宝可梦游近嘴边，再扑上去整口吞下。
author: adam_dnh
source: Its colorful body allows it to blend seamlessly into coral reefs. It remains motionless until small Pokémon swim near its mouth, then lunges forward to swallow them whole.

entry: 水手常误以为它是溺水的人，伸手救援，反而自己被拖进海里。爪上的麻痹毒液能阻止潜在猎物挣脱。
author: chibitales
source: Often mistaken for a drowning person, sailors will try to rescue this Pokémon only to be pulled into the ocean themselves. Its claws contain a paralytic venom to stop potential prey from escaping its grasp.

entry: POKENAME会寻找溺亡水手的灵魂，带往另一个世界。破破舵轮帮助定位、引来灵魂，再从每个灵魂吸取少量生命力，作为报酬。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME seeks out the spirits of drowned sailors, guiding them to another realm. A Dhelmise aids it in locating and drawing in the spirits, sapping a small amount of life-force from each one as its payment.

entry: POKENAME背上生长的珊瑚礁，孕育着生机勃勃的生态。多种水生宝可梦以这座移动礁为家，有时跟着走到原生栖息地很远之外。
author: anonymous_moose
source: POKENAME hosts a vibrant ecosystem within the coral reef growing from its back. Many varieties of aquatic Pokémon call this roving reef home, sometimes following it far outside their native habitats.

entry: POKENAME庞大的身体能给许多需要庇护的鱼类宝可梦安家。聚来的越多，游得越慢，直到把压得太重的那些赶走。
author: chibitales
source: Its large body serves as a home for many fish Pokémon needing shelter. As more Pokémon flock to POKENAME, its swimming becomes slowed until it shoos away the ones weighing it down.

entry: POKENAME庞大的身体能给许多需要庇护的鱼类宝可梦安家。聚来的越多，游得越慢，直到把压得太重的那些赶走。
author: chibitales
source: Its large body serves as a home for many fish Pokémon needing shelter. As more Pokémon flock to POKENAME, its swimming becomes slowed until it shoos away the ones weighing it down.

entry: POKENAME能在水下长时间憋气，吸引无数珊瑚种类生长，再引来多种水生宝可梦。
author: hophoppip
source: Able to hold their breath underwater for prolonged periods of time, POKENAME attract countless coral species, which in turn attract a variety of aquatic Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME锋利的珊瑚刺含有少量毒素。它无意伤人，但碰到后，伤口仍会刺痛数小时。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's sharp coral spikes contain a small amount of poison. While it doesn't intend to hurt others, contact with the spikes leaves the wound stinging for hours.

entry: POKENAME会用鼻尖指北，帮助迷路的潜水者。为了防止身上珊瑚败坏，它不能住在污染水域。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME assists lost divers by pointing north with the tip of its nose. To prevent its coral from deteriorating, it cannot live in polluted waters.

entry: 头部由致密的珊瑚构成。POKENAME在水下的太阳珊瑚群旁巡逻，保护它们免受天敌侵害。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Its head is formed out of dense coral. POKENAME patrols around underwater groups of Corsola to protect them from predators.

entry: POKENAME在珊瑚礁间成双巡逻，守护珊瑚，刺穿试图破坏的大型捕食者。珊瑚虫长在尖叉上，在两者之间迁移，让坚硬珊瑚均匀分布。
author: hophoppip
source: The duo of POKENAME patrols ocean reefs, safeguarding the coral and skewering large predators that attempt to harm it. Coral polyps grow on their prongs, migrating between them to evenly distribute the hard coral.

entry: POKENAME被激怒时，会沿海底冲锋，想用角给予强力一击。角上毒液能暂时麻痹，让刺击极其危险。
author: fancyskunk
source: When angered, a POKENAME will charge along the seabed, attempting to land a powerful blow with its horn. The poison carried in its horn can cause temporary paralysis, making piercing blows extremely dangerous.

entry: POKENAME在海中探索，似乎从不需要进食。其实头顶珊瑚枝会通过光合作用提供食物。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME explores the ocean, seemingly never needing to eat anything. In reality, the coral branches atop its head provide its food through photosynthesis.

entry: 最近，人们发现POKENAME的金属外部，并非身体，而是包容珊瑚本体的壳。气候变化后，它们开始住进废弃潜水服，躲避有害的海洋环境。
author: rakunk
source: Recent discoveries reveal that POKENAME's metal exterior is not part of its body but a shell housing its coral form. Due to climate change, it began living in abandoned diving suits to shield itself from harmful ocean conditions.

entry: POKENAME在海底步行，强大视力让它轻松看穿深海黑暗。它会被属性相同的其他宝可梦吸引，聚在附近保护它们。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME walks at the bottom of the sea, its powerful eyesight letting it see easily through the darkness of those depths. It's drawn to gather near and protect other Pokémon that share its typing.

entry: POKENAME爱好和平，静卧海底，让其他对象在坚固的金属与珊瑚身体上建立群落。唯有保护这些居民时才会起身，展现惊人的力量与防御。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a pacifistic creature that rests at the bottom of the sea, letting others form communities along its sturdy metal-and-coral form. It only moves to defend its charges, rising up to showcase incredible strength and defense.

entry: 它身上的丝带其实是带刺触须，能麻醉、捕捉猎物。对不想吃掉的海洋生物，它相处得倒很融洽。
author: hophoppip
source: The ribbons on its body are actually tendrils containing stingers, used to sedate and capture prey. It gets along quite well with the sea creatures it isn't trying to consume.

entry: POKENAME会在暖海底跺脚，把沙里的小生物震进水中，再捕食游来吃它们的鱼。
author: fancyskunk
source: POKENAME stomp around at the bottom of warm seas, forcing small sand-dwelling creatures into the water. POKENAME preys on the fish that swim over to feed on these smaller creatures.

entry: POKENAME身上的珊瑚，与某种早已灭绝的珊瑚有许多相同特征。各种海洋生物会来寄居，化石复活的宝可梦尤其感兴趣。
author: hophoppip
source: The coral covering POKENAME's body shares many distinct traits with a long-extinct coral species. Various sea creatures take shelter on its body, with Pokémon revived from fossils taking a particular interest in it.

entry: POKENAME在水下守护太阳珊瑚礁。捕食者一靠近就会受它影响睡着，而被它保护的太阳珊瑚却不受影响。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME acts as a protector of Corsola reefs underwater. Its presence causes predators to fall asleep as they draw near, while the Corsola POKENAME protects are immune to its effects.

entry: POKENAME沿海底慢慢走向受污染的珊瑚礁，用炮制造净水，清洗受影响的宝可梦。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME trudge along the ocean floor, traveling to coral reefs that are affected by pollution. Using their cannon, they are able to create purified water that they use to clean affected Pokémon.

entry: 幼年POKENAME皮肤洁净，没有随年龄堆积的藻类。有些训练家很重视这种干净的美感，会竭力保持它年轻的外貌。
author: fancyskunk
source: Young POKENAME have pristine skin, free from algae buildup that occurs with age. Some Trainers heavily value this clean aesthetic, and go to great lengths to preserve their POKENAME's youthful appearance.

entry: POKENAME的枝条与未融合的同类不同，会在月光下闪耀奇幻光芒。满月夜它们上岸跳舞时，南海的城市会举办庆典。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's branches, unlike their unfused counterparts, glitter fantastically under the moonlight. Cities in the southern seas hold festivals on nights of the full moon when these Pokémon come out to dance on the beach.

entry: 预测显示，POKENAME全盛时会长出醒目的黑白珊瑚，但实际珊瑚却黯灰脆弱，只有自身极寒才让它不至于散掉。海中的冰属性宝可梦常在枝间筑巢。
author: t3isukone
source: Predictions showed a POKENAME at its full power growing striking black and white coral, but its corals are a dull grey and so fragile that only the intense cold of POKENAME keeps them from falling apart. Oceanic Ice-types often nest in its branches.

entry: POKENAME一生大多固定在生机繁盛的珊瑚礁上。礁中生命逝去时，它会将灵魂收进气球身体里，确保它们安全。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME will anchor itself to a coral reef teeming with life for most of its existence. As the souls of the reef pass on, it collects them within the confines of its balloon body in order to keep their spirits safe.

entry: 它上半身充满空气，浮在海面，通过光合作用产能，再分享给深海中一大团珊瑚构成的下半身。
author: hophoppip
source: The upper part of its body is filled with air and floats on the ocean's surface, producing energy through photosynthesis. This energy is shared with the lower part of its body, a large mass of coral deep in the ocean.

entry: POKENAME会钻进船上导航设备，让船改变方向，远离附近珊瑚礁，保持家园水域不受船只往来干扰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME infests navigational equipment on ships to redirect them away from nearby reefs. It does this to keep the waters around its home clear of traffic.

entry: POKENAME住在偏僻海滩附近，保护当地野生生物。满月夜会走出藏身处，在月光下起舞。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lives near secluded beaches where it protects the local wildlife. During nights of the full moon, it comes out of hiding to dance in the moonlight.

entry: POKENAME是珊瑚礁的园丁与守卫，专门保护家园。脚上孔洞能种下幼珊瑚虫，长成完整珊瑚，也能向栖地喷送富含养分的水。
author: deadshields
source: Gardeners and wardens of coral reefs, POKENAME are specialised for safeguarding their home habitats. From the holes in their feet, they can plant young polyps to sprout into full coral and blow nutrient-rich water over their home patches.

entry: 记录显示，POKENAME住在暖海和珊瑚礁，单只领地范围最多可达8公里。若有同类闯入，就会爆发凶狠的战斗。
author: arveral
source: POKENAME has been documented to live in warm oceans and coral reefs. A single POKENAME can cover up to eight kilometers of territory. If another member of its species intrudes upon its territory, a vicious battle will ensue.

entry: POKENAME原生于纯净浅海，尾巴像飘动的海草，成熟时分成六缕，十分好认。水一受污染，它就会立刻弃领地而去。
author: beatdoof
source: Native to pristine ocean shallows, POKENAME is recognizable by its flowing seagrass tail, divided into six distinct strands as it matures. It will immediately abandon its territory if the water becomes polluted.

entry: POKENAME吸入的水越多，身体就越胀。此时珊瑚会变得格外锋利，吓退捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body expands the more water it inhales. During this time its coral grows incredibly sharp to dissuade predators.

entry: POKENAME静卧珊瑚礁，头和翅膀随水流轻摆。猎物游近时，两颗头会以惊人速度一同咬下。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lie still in coral reefs, gently swaying their heads and wings with the current. When prey swims close, both heads snap with incredible speed.

entry: POKENAME会待在珊瑚礁旁，装成礁体的一部分，引鱼类宝可梦来吃。它能数周不进食，静等良机；虽然看着笨重，水下却相当快。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME sits near coral reefs, pretending to be part of it in order to lure in fish Pokémon to eat. It can go several weeks between meals, waiting for the perfect opportunity to strike. Despite its clunky appearance, it is quite fast underwater.

entry: POKENAME希望与从小相伴的深海宝可梦分享星空。它会用强大精神力量，维持朋友们的栖息环境。
author: honestly_vitali
source: POKENAME desires to share the starry sky with the deep-sea Pokémon it grows up with. It uses its immense psychic powers to maintain its friends' habitat.

entry: POKENAME在珊瑚礁里低声唱着柔和旋律，温柔地促进受损家园再生。礁里有它，被视为生态健康的好迹象。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME sing crooning melodies within coral reefs, gently encouraging the regrowth of damaged habitats. Their presence within a reef is viewed as a good sign that the ecosystem is healthy.

entry: 这种宝可梦看似虚弱，珊瑚壳显得很脆，实际却比钢铁更硬，沉重无比。
author: t3isukone
source: This Pokémon may appear weak, but its fragile-looking coral shell is harder than steel and intensely heavy.

entry: POKENAME上下两半的旋转，会对珊瑚群落产生有趣影响。只要在附近转动，珊瑚礁似乎就更茂盛，生长速度也会增加。
author: sk372
source: The rotation of POKENAME's two halves has an interesting effect on coral populations. As long as POKENAME is rotating near, coral reefs seem to flourish more and show an increase in their growth rate.

entry: 捕食者威胁靠近时，POKENAME会放出一团泡沫，遮住身体。藏身其中时，身上珊瑚虫迅速重排，变成更吓人的宝可梦模样。
author: hophoppip
source: When threatened by a predator, POKENAME releases a cloud of foam to obscure its body. While it's hidden, the coral polyps on its body rapidly rearrange into the shape of a scarier Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在珊瑚礁里低声唱着柔和旋律，温柔地促进受损家园再生。礁里有它，被视为生态健康的好迹象。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME sing crooning melodies within coral reefs, gently encouraging the regrowth of damaged habitats. Their presence within a reef is viewed as a good sign that the ecosystem is healthy.

entry: 野生POKENAME沿海底游走，背上珊瑚过滤水中养分，滋养自己与宿主。它能从身体多处射出强劲水流，击退敌人。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME wander along the seabed, the coral atop their backs filtering nutrients from the water to keep them and their host nourished. They can release powerful streams of water from various parts of their bodies to repel enemies.

entry: 雨天过后，POKENAME头顶的枝条会舒展开，向空中释放泡泡。它住在潮池旁，喜欢晒明亮的太阳。
author: pizzarcato
source: After a rainy day, the branches atop POKENAME's head unravel, releasing bubbles into the air. This Pokémon lives by tide pools and loves to bask in the bright sun.

entry: POKENAME常在暖水珊瑚礁里结小群生活。身上和角上的珊瑚花，能吸收水中毒物，再将净水送回海洋。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME often cluster in warm water coral reefs in small groups. The coral flowers on their bodies and horns are able to absorb toxic poisons from the water and release clean water back into oceans.

entry: POKENAME会寻找最优质的土壤，把自己埋进去休息。睡觉时，周围土里可能长出小小的鲜艳真菌，形似珊瑚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME seeks out the highest quality soil it can to bury itself within and rest. While it sleeps, small and vibrantly-colored fungi that resemble coral may grow in the dirt around it.

entry: POKENAME身上的胶状膜有强大修复能力。受伤后会分泌特殊液体，借自我再生瞬间疗伤。
author: .izik
source: The jelly-like membrane on POKENAME's body possesses powerful restorative properties. If injured, it secretes a special fluid that allows it to heal itself instantly with Recover.

entry: POKENAME出没于海岸洞穴，晴天十分活跃。它捕猎太阳珊瑚群附近的小鱼，从水中抓起来吸血。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can be found in coastal cave areas, being highly active on sunny days. It hunts for small fish that typically mill near Corsola herds, snatching them from the water to drink their blood.

entry: POKENAME是珊瑚礁里狡猾的猎手。小型宝可梦想躲进背枝寻求庇护，却会被喙迅速叼住，吃下肚。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is a tricksy predator that inhabits coral reefs. Smaller Pokémon seeking shelter in the branches on its backside are quickly snapped up by its beak and consumed.

entry: POKENAME滚过海底时，角会在沙里划出深沟，有些宝可梦会拿来作洞。它会放出含毒气的泡泡，推动身体前进。
author: chibitales
source: As POKENAME rolls across the seafloor, its horns leave deep protrusions in the sand, which are used by some Pokémon as burrows. It releases bubbles filled with a poisonous gas to propel itself forward.

entry: POKENAME会伪装成大片珊瑚，吸引较弱的水下宝可梦。它似乎尤其爱好坏星，常常大吃特吃，连自身都开始产生有毒成分。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME disguise themselves as large masses of coral to lure lesser underwater Pokémon. They seem particularly fond of Mareanie and feast upon them so often that their own bodies have begun to develop toxic elements.

entry: 据说POKENAME是死于海边意外的孩子所化。有人在海边听到过声音，引诱自己跳入水中。
author: dodoowner_
source: It's said POKENAME are children who have died in mishaps around the ocean. People near oceans have reported a voice luring them to jump in the water.

entry: POKENAME只会在漆黑夜晚出现在偏僻海岸。有趣的是，大多时候只顾自己在海滩玩得开心。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are only found on secluded shores in the pitch-black of night. Interestingly, they mostly spend time playing on the beach for their own enjoyment.

entry: POKENAME的泡泡翅膀里装着无味气体，让它轻松漂在空中。受惊时，会突然放出一股气，快速转向。
author: regulavish
source: The bubbles that make up POKENAME's wings are filled with an odorless gas that allows it to drift effortlessly through the air. When startled, it releases a burst of this gas to change direction quickly.

entry: POKENAME每天照料背上的微型生态，那里住着多种珊瑚、水生植物和宝可梦。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME spends its days tending to the miniature ecosystem on its back. Its back houses various corals, aquatic plants, and Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME仗着坚固身体，在海底收集死珊瑚和船只遗弃的金属，再附到身上，逐渐建立起活的珊瑚生态。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Using its sturdy form, POKENAME scavenges the ocean floors for dead coral and abandoned metal from ships. By attaching these things to its body, POKENAME has created a living ecosystem of coral on its body.

entry: POKENAME住在每日阳光最充足的海域，能从巨手末端的孔洞发射鲜艳虹彩光束。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME resides in ocean areas that see the largest amounts of sunlight over a single day. Vibrant rainbow-colored beams of light can be fired from the holes at the end of its huge hands.

entry: POKENAME会一屁股坐在阳光明媚的海滩中央，吸收暖意。若有人想搬走它，就会拼命挣扎，力气大得与小个头不相称。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME plops down in the middle of sunny beaches to soak up the warmth of the sun's rays. It thrashes about if someone tries to move it, with great strength that belies its small stature.

entry: 许多POKENAME聚在一起，伪装成珊瑚礁。想躲进礁区的宝可梦，最终都会被它们吃掉。
author: darkweavile428
source: Many POKENAME come together in order to mimic coral reefs. Any Pokémon that seek to hide in their reefs are consumed.

entry: POKENAME触手上柔韧的珊瑚，再生比坚硬枝条更快。珊瑚枝长得够长，它就会折下，津津有味地吃掉。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: The flexible coral of POKENAME's tentacles regenerates even faster than its rigid branches do. When a coral branch grows long enough, POKENAME snaps it off and devours it with apparent delight.

entry: POKENAME藏在珊瑚礁中，与斑斓色彩融为一体。天敌出现时，也会让海洋生物躲进自己的掩体。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME hides in reefs, blending in among the different colors. It also allows sea life to hide within its bunker if predators are around.

entry: 野生POKENAME有时出没于衰亡珊瑚礁，周围珊瑚全白化后，自己反而更加鲜艳。游进拱门藏身的宝可梦也似乎会虚弱，仿佛生命力被吸走了。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME are sometimes found in dying reefs and become brighter and more colorful when all the coral around them is bleached white. Pokémon that swim into their arch to hide also seem to become weaker, as if being drained of vitality.

entry: POKENAME会让泡泡充气、放气，帮助穿过海洋。陆上交战时，泡泡能胀大后无害地破开，放出一团肥皂般的孢子。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME inflate and deflate their bubbles to allow them to traverse the sea. When fighting on land, they can inflate and harmlessly pop their bubbles to release a cloud of soapy spores.

entry: 野生POKENAME住在珊瑚礁，让其他宝可梦躲进体内。捕食者一靠近，哪怕只稍碰到它的身体，生命力也会开始被吸走。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME are found in coral reefs and allow other Pokémon to shelter within their body. If any predator approaches, the slightest contact with POKENAME's body will begin to drain its life force.

entry: POKENAME罕见，住在暖海，歌声优美。海洋生物学家靠近时，它会引导对方前往饱受污染的地方。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is a rarely seen Pokémon that dwells in warm oceans and sings in a beautiful voice. When marine biologists approach it, it guides them to areas plagued by pollution.

entry: POKENAME会在背上形成水泡，离水时也能让珊瑚保持湿润。许多小型宝可梦住进泡泡，以珊瑚为食。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME form bubbles of water on their backs, keeping the coral on their bodies hydrated while they are out of water. Many smaller Pokémon make their homes in these bubbles, feeding on the coral.

entry: POKENAME累了会平躺海底，形似珊瑚。它用一只爪扎进沙里固定自己，抵御强流。
author: .izik
source: When tired, POKENAME lies flat on the seafloor, resembling coral. It anchors itself by digging a claw into the sand to resist strong currents.

entry: 它像海绵一样吸收液体，连本不该消化的油污等有害物也不例外。最常见的治疗办法，是喂它混入果汁的解毒药。
author: quackquackattack
source: It soaks up liquids into its body like a sponge, including oils and other biohazards it is not meant to digest. The most common way to cure these ailments is to give them an Antidote mixed with juice.

entry: POKENAME会朝过分靠近珊瑚礁的对象吹热蒸汽泡。它很容易紧张，适合特别有耐心的训练家。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME blows hot steam bubbles at anyone who gets too close to its coral reef. It gets nervous very easily, so it is recommended for particularly patient Trainers.

entry: POKENAME尾巴拿着的珊瑚，采自自己长大的礁。它吹出的泡泡能像水晶球一样，用来占卜。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The coral POKENAME holds in its tail is plucked from the reef where it grew up. The bubbles it emits can be used like a crystal ball for POKENAME to scry through.

entry: POKENAME会用强大精神力量，把入侵者困进长杖的泡泡，再送往远处，守护家园。仍不断闯来的对象，就会被猛烈的泡沫光线连射，直到离开。
author: chibitales
source: Using its powerful psychic abilities, POKENAME defends its home by trapping intruders inside the bubbles from its staff and moving them far away. Those who continue to intrude are met with a mighty Bubble Beam barrage until they leave.

entry: POKENAME极其谨慎，会在潮池间跳跃，寻找最干净安全的水。淡水里极少见到，因为它会游向海洋，避开人类干扰或污染。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are extremely cautious, hopping between tidepools in search of the cleanest and safest waters. Seeing them in fresh water is extremely rare because they swim out to sea to try and avoid human interference or pollution.

entry: 它身上的珊瑚能变色，融入任何背景。珊瑚提供的能量，让它能一动不动待上数小时，甚至好几天。
author: hophoppip
source: The coral on its body can shift in color to match any background. It can remain motionless for hours or even days, kept alive by the energy its coral supplies.

entry: POKENAME游累后，会停在浮标上，用海藻裹住身体，挡住烈日。过热时就落入水中，沉到海底降温。
author: .izik
source: When exhausted from swimming, POKENAME perches atop buoys, wrapping itself in seaweed to block the harsh sunlight. If it overheats, it will drop into the water and sink to the seafloor to cool down.

entry: POKENAME能操纵海水中的碳酸钙，创造美丽珊瑚礁。许多宝可梦会搬来生活，尊它为女王。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME can manipulate the calcium carbonate found in seawater to create beautiful coral reefs. Many Pokémon will come to live in these reefs and will revere POKENAME as their queen.

entry: POKENAME会在珊瑚礁最高处安家，身上的石质生长物结合了活珊瑚与闪亮珍珠。据说有健康个体居住的礁，是世上最美丽的自然奇观之一。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their home at the highest point of a coral reef, their rocky growths a combination of living coral and shimmering pearl. Reefs with a healthy POKENAME are said to be among the most beautiful natural wonders in the world.

entry: POKENAME身上精巧的珊瑚会定期断落再生。据说制成项链，能让佩戴者产生浪漫情愫。
author: .izik
source: The delicate coral on POKENAME's body regularly breaks off and regrows. Necklaces made from its coral are said to bring romantic feelings to the wearer.

entry: POKENAME住的珊瑚礁在光下闪着彩虹般光芒，很受水肺潜水者欢迎。有些倡议者希望禁止公众进入，保护这些礁群。
author: bobosmith01
source: The coral reefs where POKENAME reside glitter like rainbows under the light, making them a popular scuba-diving spot. Some activists want to make these reefs inaccessible to the public in order to preserve them.

entry: POKENAME若吸收污染中的有毒化学物质，头上珊瑚就会变白，还会严重头痛，直到身体处理掉毒素。若没有保育者帮助，许多个体都会因此丧命。
author: quackquackattack
source: If POKENAME absorb toxic chemicals from pollution, the coral on their head turns white and they get a nasty headache until their body processes the toxin. Without the support of conservationists, many would lose their lives to the toxic chemicals.

entry: POKENAME会绕着珊瑚礁巡游，攻击向水里排放毒物的船。虽然只有岩石和水柱，这些简单的威慑仍能有效制止非法倾倒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swim around coral reefs to protect coral reefs, attacking ships that release toxic chemicals into the water. Even when equipped with just rocks and jets of water, these rudimentary deterrents are effective at stopping illegal dumping.

entry: POKENAME美丽的海带鬃毛，是小型宝可梦的避风港。它会守护太阳珊瑚群，用强力吠声吓跑捕食者。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's beautiful kelp mane is a safe haven for small Pokémon. It guards colonies of Corsola, scaring off predators with its powerful bark.

entry: POKENAME在关都各处沙滩安静生活。受惊就会潜入水下躲藏，最长能憋气30分钟。
author: shreks_stepfather
source: POKENAME lives a peaceful life on sandy beaches across Kanto. When startled, POKENAME dives underwater to hide. It can hold its breath for up to 30 minutes.

entry: POKENAME常守护暖海珊瑚礁，奋力击退一切威胁。威武双翼让它能翱翔海上，连气旋的力量也能抗衡。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME often guards coral reefs in warm seas, fighting fiercely to keep every threat at bay. Its majestic wings let it soar over the sea, defying even the power of cyclones.

entry: POKENAME能随意脱下枝条般的角，之后再长回来。被捕食者追赶时，常会脱角，分散对方注意。
author: smissmassentree_81799
source: POKENAME are able to shed their branch-like antlers at will and then regrow them later. They often shed their antlers as a distraction when predators are chasing them.

entry: POKENAME清理栖居的珊瑚时，会把吸起的碎屑存进体内，让珊瑚健康茁壮。它极难寻踪又警惕，一看见人就立刻逃走。
author: fiordaliso
source: It stores the debris it sucks up while cleaning the corals it inhabits inside its body, keeping them healthy and thriving. Whenever POKENAME spots a human, it immediately flees, as it is an exceptionally elusive and wary creature.

entry: POKENAME身体会分泌诱人香气，吸引小鱼。鱼会在嘴里安家，吃碎屑和藻类。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME secrete an alluring scent from their bodies, attracting smaller fish. These fish will make their homes within their mouths, feeding on debris and algae.

entry: 它只凭双臂的力气，拖着身体穿过珊瑚礁。遇到污染海水的人，就会从下方挥拳，打穿对方船底。
author: skyward_25
source: It drags itself through coral reefs using only the power of its arms. It attacks people who pollute its waters by punching holes into their boats from below.

entry: POKENAME几乎总沿着海底滚动，撞上珊瑚群或水下岩石也不停。凡被滚过或撞到的东西，常会黏在身体上。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are often always rolling along the seabed, even if they crash into formations of coral or underwater rocks. Anything they roll over, or into, often ends up stuck to their bodies.

entry: POKENAME会随群体在海底奔腾，最快的个体成为首领。它用滚烫吐息加热周围海水，滋养家园的珊瑚礁。
author: fiordaliso
source: It gallops across the seafloor alongside its herd, with the fastest among them rising to lead the group. POKENAME nurtures the coral reefs it calls home by warming the surrounding water with its scorching breath.

entry: POKENAME会用珊瑚碎片和其他宝可梦丢弃的壳，装饰覆壳的尾巴。尾上发现过一些近乎灭绝的珊瑚种类，让保育者开始考虑保护它的群落。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME decorate their shell-covered tails with coral bits and discarded shells from other Pokémon. Some near-extinct species of coral have been found on POKENAME tails, causing conservationists to consider protecting POKENAME colonies.

entry: 这只POKENAME从小待在水下珊瑚礁中。被捕获时，珊瑚也跟着留下，如今住在它身上，依靠它维生。
author: jojojax164
source: This POKENAME grew up underwater, nestled within coral reefs. When it was caught, the coral stayed with the POKENAME and now lives on it, relying on it for sustenance.

entry: POKENAME会用透明毒液形成泡泡，包住自己，便能浮出水外，跟训练家一起旅行。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME surrounds itself with a bubble made of a clear, poisonous liquid. This allows it to float out of water and travel alongside its Trainer.

entry: 它想邀请所有人到巨口里的海洋中玩耍，却不知道进去的人几分钟内就会溺亡。
author: skymaster426
source: It wishes to bring everyone into the ocean within its maw to play. It doesn't realize that anyone who enters will drown within minutes.

entry: POKENAME很少钻地，以免损坏珊瑚。移动时通常沿海底滑行。
author: phantom640
source: POKENAME rarely burrows below ground so as to avoid damaging its corals, and often slides along the seabed when moving around.

entry: POKENAME沿海底爬行，寻找美味海带。遇险时会接连射丝，缠住敌人，再爬走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME crawls along the ocean floor searching for delicious kelp to consume. Whenever it is in danger, it shoots out bursts of silk to entangle foes before crawling away.

entry: 许多捕食性宝可梦起初把POKENAME当作明显的目标，却不知它快得惊人，能保住性命。即使被抓住，也可能引爆储存的全部能量，免得沦为食物。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although many predator Pokémon initially see POKENAME as an obvious target, POKENAME has incredible speed that allows it to ensure survival. Even if caught, it may simply explode all of its contained energy to prevent itself from becoming prey.

entry: POKENAME拿着特别雕制的骨枪，能将高压水射向远处。科学界至今没弄懂，这把简陋武器究竟如何运作。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME wields a specially carved gun made of bones to shoot high-pressure water long distances. Science still has not figured out how exactly the makeshift weapon functions.

entry: POKENAME出没于硫酸池附近，悠闲地飘在上方，以烟气为食。虽然住处危险，吹出的泡泡却不含任何有害化学物质。
author: lithuanian_shortstack
source: POKENAME is found near pools of sulfuric acid, idly floating above them while feeding off the fumes. Despite its habitat, the bubbles it produces don't contain any harmful chemicals.

entry: POKENAME裹茧的身体太重，游得较慢。它会躲在海底，从嘴里射出压缩水流自卫。
author: sk372
source: Because of the weight of its cocooned body, POKENAME's swimming speed is rather low. It hides on the sea floor and defends itself with shots of compressed water fired from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME的几颗头各自独立行动。受到威胁时，会用有毒黑气填满周围，掩护逃跑。
author: lithuanian_shortstack
source: The heads on POKENAME act independently of each other; when it feels threatened, they fill the surrounding area with a toxic black gas to cover its escape.

entry: POKENAME会优雅跃出水面，用精准水柱击中空中猎物。目标落河后，再用尖角补上最后一击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaps elegantly from the water before blasting airborne prey with a precise jet of water. Once the target falls into the river, it finishes them off with its sharp horn.

entry: POKENAME常附在其他宝可梦身上，出没于热带浅水。它靠气孔呼吸，吃剩饭、皮屑等生物碎屑。遇到捕食者，就从嘴里喷水，借力冲走。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are often found in shallow tropical waters attached to another Pokémon. They breathe through their pores and eat biological scraps, such as leftover food and flakes of skin. They expel water through their mouth to jet away from predators.

entry: POKENAME会保护巨翅飞鱼等海洋宝可梦，抵御凶猛失控的融合体。神秘力量能通过嘴汇聚，再精准射出。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME protects other marine Pokémon such as Mantine from aggressive and out-of-control fusions. Mysterious power is channeled through its mouth and shot out with expert precision.

entry: POKENAME会装作在岸上无助扑腾，引诱没有戒心的小型宝可梦。对方一近，就用水柱击晕，打进河里。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME pretends to flop helplessly on land to lure in unsuspecting small Pokémon. The moment they get close, it stuns them with a jet of water and knocks them into the river.

entry: POKENAME会像火箭一样从嘴里喷水，推动身体，往返不同水域。身后留下的水雾，常形成彩虹。
author: wiz0z
source: In order to move between bodies of water, POKENAME will propel itself with jets of water from its mouth in a fashion reminiscent of rockets. The resulting mist often creates rainbows in its wake.

entry: POKENAME能在水下隐身，借此出其不意地射出强力水柱，击晕猎物。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME have the ability to turn themselves invisible when underwater. They take advantage of this by stunning prey with a powerful shot of water when it's least expected.

entry: POKENAME爱啃船，在船壳留下淡淡咬痕。尾巴常被海藻或珊瑚缠住，只好飞快转圈，设法挣脱。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME love to gnaw on boats and ships, leaving faint bite marks on their hulls. Their tails often get stuck on seaweed and coral, forcing them to rapidly spin around to get unstuck.

entry: POKENAME想与飞行属性宝可梦互利共生，分享食物、彼此清洁。若对方拒绝，就会被它喷水；若对方还手，它的家人便会介入。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME tries to form a mutualistic bond with Flying-type Pokémon where they share their food and clean one another. If the Flying-type refuses, POKENAME blasts them with water. If the Flying-type attacks, POKENAME's family intervenes.

entry: POKENAME起初对陌生对象叛逆又敌视，却很快会亲近起来，变得十分热情。比起陆地奔跑，它更喜欢在水中游。
author: bobosmith01
source: While it acts rebellious and hostile with strangers at first, POKENAME quickly warms up to them and becomes very affectionate. It prefers swimming in water over running on land.

entry: POKENAME自己凶恶疏离、不好相处，却鼓励幼崽与其他宝可梦交好。它吃肉，还要吸尽所有体液和汁水，尽量多获取热量。
author: bobosmith01
source: While POKENAME itself is fearsome, standoffish, and overall difficult to get along with, it encourages its young to get along with other Pokémon. It eats a carnivorous meal and makes sure to slurp up all the fluids and juices for maximum calories.

entry: POKENAME能把细长身体灌满水，再高压喷出作武器。不过吸得太多，身体就会胀得钻不过自己的隧道。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can fill its long, thin body with water, then spray it out at high pressure as a weapon. If it takes up too much water, it will become too bloated to fit through its own tunnels.

entry: POKENAME群居，常为谁能吃到最美味的鲤鱼王而争斗。它们暗藏可怕的利牙，连最坚硬的壳也能咬入。
author: skleegamer
source: POKENAME live in herds and tend to get aggressive over which Pokémon gets the tastiest Magikarp. These fearsome creatures hide a terrifying set of teeth, which can dig into even the hardest of shells.

entry: POKENAME极其谨慎，连睡觉也在听危险。稍有动静，就会从嘴里高速喷水，吓退可能的捕食者。
author: darkweavile428
source: Cautious in the extreme, POKENAME listens for danger even while it is asleep. If it hears even the slightest disturbance, POKENAME will blast water from its mouth at high velocity to scare off potential predators.

entry: POKENAME既继承铁炮鱼必须靠水呼吸的需要，也继承向日种子对强烈阳光的需求。不论水上还是水下，几乎都在痛苦中生活。
author: omelhorthiagofranze
source: POKENAME kept the need for water to breathe from Remoraid, but also the need for extreme sunlight from Sunkern. It lives in near constant pain whether above or below water.

entry: POKENAME能跃出水面，滑翔得与巨翅飞鱼一样远，再落回水里。它会从嘴里放出高频声音，吓唬捕食者。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can leap out of the water and glide just as far as Mantine before it lands back in. To scare predators, it unleashes high frequencies from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME在大河里很多，是稀有捕食者的重要食物来源。它爱泥，能让沉积物流动，却对重金属极敏感，上游有矿山就常生病。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are abundant in large rivers, where they are an important food source for rare predators. Their affinity to mud keeps sediment flowing, though they are very sensitive to heavy metals and frequently get sick if there are mines upstream.

entry: POKENAME住在深海，懒懒摆动长尾，缓慢前进，节省能量。凡是嘴里装得下的东西都先吞下，盼着是食物；太大吞不下，就改啃咬。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in the deep ocean, moving slowly with languid sweeps of their long tail to conserve energy. They gulp down anything that will fit in their mouth in the hopes that it's food, gnawing at it if it's too big to swallow.

entry: POKENAME远离陆地，在大洋中央狩猎。渔民会跟着鸟群，等它们潜水，便知道该在哪里下网。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live far from land, hunting for food in the middle of the ocean. Fishermen will follow flocks of POKENAME, waiting for them to dive into the water to know where to cast their nets.

entry: POKENAME会向闻到后挖出的真菌喷水。这股冲动太强，没先泡过水的蘑菇，它绝不肯吃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spits water on any fungus it manages to sniff out and dig up. This compulsion is so strong that it will not eat any mushroom it hasn't soaked with water beforehand.

entry: 这种形态的POKENAME明显更好斗，会主动找对象练靶。嘴或炮射出的水柱，连钢铁也能贯穿。
author: sk372
source: In this form, POKENAME becomes markedly more aggressive, seeking out others to use as target practice. The jets of water it shoots from its mouth or cannon can pierce through steel.

entry: POKENAME会以惊人准头，向空中的宝可梦接连射墨，专瞄眼睛，确保对方跌进水里，再发起袭击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires rapid bursts of ink at flying Pokémon with uncanny precision. It aims directly for their eyes, ensuring they drop into the water where it can strike.

entry: POKENAME夜间旅行，寻找不法之徒，用两只铁炮鱼狙击。被铁炮鱼水弹击中的对象，还会遭到奇异诅咒。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME travels in the night, searching for outlaws to snipe with its dual Remoraid. Those who get shot by the Remoraid's water bullets are also afflicted with strange curses.

entry: POKENAME会蜷成球，靠硬化鳞片抵御其他小型水生生物。滚成球时，也能从嘴里喷水，推动身体。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME curls into a sphere, letting its hardened scales protect it from other small aquatic creatures. It uses water spit from its mouth to propel it around while rolled into a ball.

entry: POKENAME主要靠射出压实的泥球进攻。偶尔会成群来到海滩，搜集、吃下湿沙，在岸边留下一道长沟。
author: glacierwing
source: A POKENAME's main form of offense is shooting compacted mud balls. Sometimes, hordes of them will gather on beaches to collect and eat wet sand, leaving a long trench on the shoreline.

entry: 它不擅长游泳，便把充气的尾巴绕在身上，浮在海面。
author: hophoppip
source: It's a poor swimmer, so it wraps its gas-filled tail around its body to float on the surface of the ocean.

entry: 两群POKENAME每次相遇，都会展开长达一周的争斗，直到一方全军覆没才肯罢休。
author: falsedoll
source: Whenever two groups of POKENAME run into each other, they will engage in a week-long conflict that only ends one side is completely annihilated.

entry: POKENAME会吞水，再用腹肌挤出自卫。它会用长舌黏住或挂住岩石，免得被强流冲走。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME swallow water and use their abdominal muscles to expel said water to defend themselves. They will use their long tongues to stick to, or hang onto, rocks to avoid being swept away by strong currents.

entry: POKENAME痴迷捉弄大牙狸，被它们当作害兽。它会潜伏等群落刚筑好坝，再从嘴里喷出水柱，冲垮整座结构。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is considered a pest by Bidoof due to its obsession with pranking them. It lies in wait until a colony has completed a dam before blasting a jet of water from its mouth and causing the structure to crumble.

entry: POKENAME偏爱崎岖海岸，用海藻和光滑石头筑巢。陌生对象一靠近，就会朝入侵者反吐泥球。
author: bagumbothimble
source: POKENAME prefer to live on craggy coastlines, making nests out of seaweed and smooth stones. When a stranger approaches its nest a POKENAME will regurgitate balls of mud at the intruder.

entry: POKENAME会吃掉海藻固定在海底的部分，让其余藻体浮上海面，连成大片。身体笨重，又常在海床步行，一度让人以为它不会游泳。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are known to eat the holdfast of seaweed, causing the rest to float to the ocean's surface and create mats. It was once thought that POKENAME were incapable of swimming, due to their bulk and because of how often they walk on seabeds.

entry: POKENAME藏在水下隧道，只有驱逐领地入侵者时才突然现身。喷出的高压水束，速度超过每小时100英里。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides itself in underwater tunnels, appearing only when it pops out to dispel intruders in its territory. It spits out beams of high-pressure water that travel over 100 mph.

entry: POKENAME沿森林河床游泳，偏爱纯净清水。胃里能存大量水，再极精准地喷向敌人。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME swims along forest riverbeds, preferring clean, pure water. It can store a lot of water in its stomach, which it sprays at enemies with extreme precision.

entry: 它敏感的鳍能察觉水中和空中的震动。水流攻击从远处也能精准命中，因此总与危险保持距离。
author: hophoppip
source: Its sensitive fins can detect vibrations in both water and air. It keeps its distance from danger, as its water blast attacks can strike accurately from afar.

entry: POKENAME猎捕飞行猎物时，会先从口中射出水柱将其击落，再让猎物坠上刀刃般的角。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME has a strategy for hunting flying prey: Striking it down with a water jet from its mouth and letting it fall onto its bladed horn.

entry: POKENAME会从刀刃周围喷高压水柱，切开一切障碍。可惜它爱一边攻击一边挥刃，常把水甩偏，徒劳地溅开。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME produce high-pressure jets of water from around their blades in order to cut through any obstacle. Unfortunately for them, their strategy of trying to swing their blades while attacking often causes the water to harmlessly splash off course.

entry: POKENAME水下狩猎时，凶猛得出人意料。它会游近猎物，用触须抓牢，再从嘴里高压喷水，将其击倒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME displays a surprising amount of aggression when hunting underwater. It swims towards prey and snatches them with its feelers, holding them still before knocking them out with jets of high-pressure water shot from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME会巡视海岸，寻找污染海洋和珊瑚礁的人。遇上这种人，就从双臂喷出强大高压水流。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME prowl coastlines, seeking to find those that pollute oceans and reefs. SHould they encounter such a person, they will fire a highly pressurized blast of water from their arms.

entry: POKENAME能吞下大量水，在体内加压储存。喷出的力道足以切开钢铁，因此很受建筑业追捧。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME gulp in vast amounts of water, storing pressurised water within their body. They can spray the liquid out with enough force to cut through steel, making them highly sought after by the construction industry.

entry: POKENAME会攀在吼鲸王身上，靠剩饭维生。捕食者一靠近，就会使出猛烈的冲天拳。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME clings onto Wailord, surviving on leftover food. If a predator approaches, it strikes with a devastating Sky Uppercut.

entry: POKENAME会从水坑吸水，存进胃里。察觉危险，就会强力喷出，击倒试图追赶自己的对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME slurps up water from puddles to store within its stomach. If it senses danger, it spits the water at high force to knock out whatever is trying to pursue it.

entry: POKENAME精力充沛，白天得不停活动，才能在入夜前把能量耗掉。它还会主动迎敌，从口中喷出强劲水柱，轻易压倒对手，再多耗些精力。
author: arcul
source: POKENAME has copious amounts of energy, needing to be constantly moving throughout the day to burn it off before nightfall. It takes on foes to further burn off energy, often easily outmatching them with powerful jets of water shot from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME漂在热带水域，能主动适度增减密度，让自己在海中或空中下沉、上升。
author: bobosmith01
