source: Found floating around tropical waters, POKENAME has the ability to voluntarily increase or decrease its density by moderate amounts, allowing it to sink or ascend through both the sea and the skies.

entry: POKENAME性情温顺，是理想的宠物。可肉质鲜甜，也令它经常遭到捕猎。
author: sand_coffin
source: Due to POKENAME's gentle and docile nature, it makes an ideal pet. However, it is also hunted often for its fresh, sweet taste.

entry: 一只铁炮鱼漂在POKENAME中央，整个身体的行为也类似这位住客的本能反应。手臂上的炮能射出极快、精准的水柱。
author: sk372
source: A Remoraid floats within the center of POKENAME, the body behaving similarly to its resident's instincts. The cannon on its arm can fire extremely rapid, accurate jets of water.

entry: POKENAME慢慢漂过海藻丛。发现猎物，就会从远处射出强力水柱，将其击倒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts slowly through seaweed beds. When it spots prey, it fires powerful jets of water to knock them out from a distance.

entry: POKENAME在溪流里疾游，用迅快的穿刺咬击伏击鲤鱼王等猎物。看见波波等空中猎物，则把握时机喷水，将其从空中打落。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME darts through streams to ambush prey like Magikarp with swift, piercing bites. If it spots flying prey like Pidgey, it will knock them out of the sky with a perfectly timed jet of water.

entry: POKENAME身上面包般的蘑菇竟十分健康美味。多年来，许多人会用它制作营养丰富的面包布丁。
author: .izik
source: Despite appearances, the bread-like mushroom covering POKENAME's body is incredibly healthy and delicious. Many over the years have used it to make nutritious bread pudding dishes.

entry: POKENAME偏爱近身战，也能从钳爪射出高压水流，狙击50英尺以外的猎物。它在海底狩猎，主要吃小型鱼类宝可梦。
author: mistymagius
source: While preferring close-ranged combat, POKENAME can fire pressurized jets of water from its claws to snipe prey from over 50 feet away. It hunts on the seafloor, mainly preying on small fish Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME受到威胁时，会发射头上的鱼糕，既能攻击，也能用美食分散捕食者注意。
author: hophoppip
source: When threatened, POKENAME launches the fish cake on its head, which serves as both a projectile and a tasty distraction for predators.

entry: POKENAME能从嘴里高压喷水，精准击落猎物。即使有一颗头失手，其他头的攻击也多半能命中。为免较大的宝可梦反击，它会钻进地下。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME accurately shoot down prey by expelling pressurized water from their mouths. Even if one of the heads happens to miss, attacks from the others will likely hit the target. They burrow into the ground to avoid retaliation from larger Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME会成群在城市池塘玩耍，彼此追逐着跃出水面，天热时也向路人喷水。热闹的游戏很讨游客喜欢，夏天会吸引访客到城市公园。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Packs of POKENAME frolic together in city ponds, chasing one another out of the water and spraying water at passers-by when they're too hot. Their boisterous play makes them popular with tourists, drawing visitors to the city parks on summer days.

entry: 野生POKENAME尽量避免争斗。察觉被捕食者跟踪，就会从嘴里射出强力、精准的水柱。只有水柱没用，才会近身交战。
author: bobosmith01
source: Wild POKENAME tend to avoid fighting. If it knows it is being stalked by a predator, it will fire a powerful and accurate blast of water from its mouth. Only if that fails will POKENAME battle in close quarters.

entry: 这种两栖生物很聪明，能用碎屑制作工具。它能从远处投矛，准头致命。
author: bobosmith01
source: An amphibious lifeform with the intelligence to craft tools made out of debris. It can hurl a spear from long distances with deadly accuracy.

entry: POKENAME的两张嘴能射出强水流，将毽子草等空中宝可梦打落海中。猎物入水后，再用触手麻痹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's twin mouths shoot powerful torrents of water at airborne Pokémon like Hoppip, sending them plummeting into the sea. Once submerged, it uses its tentacles to paralyze its prey.

entry: POKENAME战斗时会极速喷出酸性墨汁。准头虽还不够完美，液体的腐蚀性却极强，连岩石和金属也能熔穿。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME fires jets of acidic ink at an extreme velocity in battle. While its accuracy hasn't been perfected, the liquid is extremely corrosive, able to melt through even rocks and metals.

entry: POKENAME常在家园附近的镇上使出冰冻光束捣乱。有人只当是无害恶作剧，也有人认为这些行径实在可恶。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME regularly uses Ice Beams to cause mischief around the towns that neighbor its home. While some write off POKENAME's actions as harmless pranks, others claim that these acts are truly despicable.

entry: 人们发现许多POKENAME远离原有栖息地。原来它们附着在巨翅飞鱼身上时，忘了本来要去哪里。
author: gp423
source: Many POKENAME have been found far from their natural habitat. This is because they have forgotten where they were going while attached to a Mantine.

entry: 它的脸，恰好把胆小易惊的性格写了出来。除同类外，几乎什么都避开；谁靠近惊扰，就会惹得它慌张喷墨。
author: sk372
source: Its face is a rather perfect encapsulation of its skittish and timid personality. It steers clear of most anything other than its own kind, panicking and spitting ink at those that approach and startle it.

entry: POKENAME手上的嘴能射出剧毒水。这只手似乎有一定意识，有时表现得仿佛想脱离身体。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fires extremely poisonous water from the mouth present on its hand. The hand exhibits some measure of sentience and at times acts as if it wishes to separate from POKENAME's body.

entry: POKENAME会钻进泥沙，躲避捕食者。右钳喷水打落空中猎物，左钳则把猎物拖回洞里，慢慢享用。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME burrows into mud and sand to hide from predators. It uses its right claw to blast down aerial prey with jets of water, and then drags them into its den with its left claw so it can feed.

entry: POKENAME会收缩巨钳里的肌肉，射出足以打碎刺甲贝外壳的水柱。它与小型鱼类宝可梦共生，对方会帮忙清钳，除去寄生物。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME contracts muscles in its oversized claw to launch jets of water with enough force to shatter Cloyster shells. It creates a symbiotic relationship with small fish Pokémon who will keep the claw clean and free of parasites.

entry: POKENAME像一种球形烤点心，以小麦粉面糊和海鲜碎料制成。头上还配着蛋黄酱和特制酱汁。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME resemble a grilled ball-shaped snack made out of a wheat-flour based batter and seafood scraps. The toppings on their heads include mayonnaise and a special sauce.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，会用尾巴上的吸盘贴住礁内珊瑚侧面。打鼾时，鼻子偶尔冒出泡泡，营造安宁的水下氛围。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's suction cups on its tail allow it to stick to the sides of coral inside of reefs when sleeping. It lets loose intermittent bubbles from its snout as it snores, creating a peaceful underwater ambiance.

entry: POKENAME狩猎时，会把触手般的长尾绕住沉没货船，喷出强力泡沫光线，制服鲤鱼王等猎物。善用环境，让它能够成功捕猎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wraps its long tentacle-like tail around sunken freighters when it hunts, spitting out a forceful Bubble Beam to incapacitate prey like Magikarp. Its strategic use of the environment ensures a successful hunt.

entry: POKENAME先吐墨团，让敌人晕头转向，再用尖角袭击。平静水域里，墨云最长能停留一小时。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits globs of ink to disorient foes before striking with its sharp horn. The ink cloud can linger for up to an hour in calm waters.

entry: POKENAME游得悠闲，却不好惹。嘴旁的众多触手能轻松碾碎小型猎物；遇到更大的对象，则会制造、抛出墨团，打得对方疼痛。
author: sk372
source: Though it swims at a leisurely pace, POKENAME is not to be trifled with; its many mouth tentacles can crush smaller prey with ease, and create and lob painful globs of ink at anything larger.

entry: 晴朗夜晚，POKENAME会自己上岸，仰望星空数小时。被打扰后，就使出高速旋转回到海里，寻求水下家园的安慰。
author: .izik
source: On clear nights, POKENAME will beach itself to stare up at the stars for hours. If disturbed, it will do a Rapid Spin to return to the sea, seeking the comfort of its aquatic home.

entry: POKENAME伪装本领惊人，静卧时能改变体色与质地，几乎与环境毫无区别。敌人毫无察觉地经过，就会遭到从鼻部释放的强力招式伏击。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has impressive camouflaging abilities: when it lays still, it can alter its outer color and texture to look nearly indistinguishable from its environment. If a foe passes by unaware, POKENAME ambushes with powerful moves through its snout.

entry: 水坝常请POKENAME工作。湖水压力下降时，它会持续朝涡轮喷水，作为补充。多余能量则喂给它作报酬，鼓励继续工作。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are commonly employed in hydroelectric dams, spraying a constant stream of water onto the turbines should the pressure from the lake drop. Surplus energy is fed to POKENAME in exchange for their services, motivating them to keep working.

entry: POKENAME的吸盘能传导大量热量，烫伤被攻击者的皮肤。愤怒时，尾焰炽烈发亮，身体不断冒出蒸汽。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's suckers can conduct an immense amount of heat, leaving burns on the skin of those it attacks. When angered, its tail fire glows with a burning intensity and steam pours off of its body.

entry: POKENAME会用尾巴缠住海上浮标，被打扰时就扑腾起来。虽然无害，突然的动作仍会吓跑小型宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wraps its tail around ocean buoys and flops about when disturbed. Though harmless, its sudden movement can scare off smaller Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME能用不稳定的基因，给射出的物体赋予不同元素力量。可惜控制不住，常常走火。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME can use its unstable DNA to charge the projectiles it shoots with varying elemental power. Unfortunately, misfires often happen due to its lack of control over these elements.

entry: POKENAME会用带吸盘的尾巴捉住猎物，再不断电击。它的墨汁有强烈金属后味，极难入口。
author: dodoowner_
source: It uses its suction-cupped tails to catch prey before repeatedly shocking them with electricity. The ink POKENAME produces has a strong, metallic aftertaste, making it extremely unappetizing.

entry: POKENAME会收集材料，压成方块叠好，搭出自己的障碍赛道，跳跃通过。有时还会结小群，比赛谁用时最短。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gathers up materials and squeezes them into cubes to stack together. It sets up its own personal obstacle course to hop across, and small groups may form to compete to see who has the best time.

entry: POKENAME生活在海里，一生大多却在海上空飞行。它会用满含墨汁的泡弹击落敌人，再用触手捉住猎物，拖入水中解决。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live within ocean waters, but they will spend most of their lives flying in the ocean sky. They will shoot down foes with ink-filled bubble bullets and use their tentacles to snatch prey, which they will drag into water to finish them off.

entry: POKENAME蛇般的身体几乎全是肌肉，能轻松缠绞、压碎猎物。它常栖息在沉船残骸中。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's serpentine body is mostly made up of muscle, allowing it to constrict and crush its prey with ease. It can be found inhabiting the remnants of shipwrecks.

entry: 最初目击POKENAME的人，以为它是某种不受岁月影响的怪物的后代。其实它温和又对人好奇，常帮忙把搁浅船只拖回海里，再消失于墨云。
author: pjporwoll
source: The first person to witness POKENAME thought it was the scion of a timeless monster, but it is actually very gentle and curious about humans. It often helps tow grounded ships back to sea before disappearing in a cloud of ink.

entry: POKENAME会玩耍般地从触手喷水，把自己射向任意方向，撞到东西还会咯咯笑。受惊时，就会完美伪装成环境的一部分，避开探查。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME playfully sprays water from its tentacles to send itself flying in random directions, giggling if it bumps into something. When startled, it perfectly camouflages to match its surroundings and escape detection.

entry: POKENAME结合发光触角和灵巧触手，巡视海面。它会收集垃圾，让领地保持干净。
author: .izik
source: Combining its glowing antennae with agile tentacles, POKENAME surveys the ocean's surface. It collects garbage to help keep its territory clean.

entry: POKENAME使出章鱼桶炮前，触手吸盘会闪起一阵阵黄光。光能引猎物靠得够近，轻松命中。
author: .izik
source: The suction cups on POKENAME's tentacles pulse with a yellow light before it unleashes an Ocatazooka. The light helps lure prey close enough for the attack to land with ease.

entry: POKENAME会用带吸盘的耳朵，攀在近海的下水道格栅上，再用长触手翻找垃圾里的可食碎屑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its suction-cupped ears to cling to sewer grates near the ocean. It picks through discarded trash with its long tentacles, searching for edible scraps.

entry: POKENAME胆大又鲁莽，性格十分鲜明，还有个怪习惯：喜欢爬进垃圾堆。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's personality is distinctly bold and brash. It has an odd habit of crawling into piles of trash.

entry: POKENAME前方的红色身体负责守护，后方开花的身体进行光合作用，双方分享能量。据说过去曾被安置在屋外，充当原始安保。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The red body in the front works to defend the flowering body in the back while it photosynthesizes, sharing the energy between the two of them. It is said that POKENAME used to be stationed outside houses as primitive security systems.

entry: 有些地区流行POKENAME汤，肉质甜嫩，常配欧防风根和姜，甚至进入快餐菜单。它在被养殖时，会因害怕而尖叫、喷墨。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME soup is a popular dish in some areas, its sweet, tender meat often served with parsnips and ginger. It has even made its way onto fast-food menus. POKENAME is known to scream and squirt ink in fright as it is farmed.

entry: POKENAME背上球茎状的生长物装满盐水。离水觅食时，便靠这份储水维持湿润。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The bulbous growth on the backs of POKENAME are filled with salt water. When POKENAME leave the water to feed, they use this supply to keep themselves hydrated.

entry: POKENAME触手蠕动的声音，会让受害者不安。受威胁时，它会喷出暗墨云，在袭击者皮肤上染色，一周多也不退。
author: mistymagius
source: The sound made by POKENAME's squirming tentacles is known to make its victims feel uneasy. When threatened, it will spray a dark cloud of ink that stains the attacker's skin for over a week.

entry: POKENAME一发现捕食者，就会喷墨游走。喷出的物质看起来像文字，不过可能只是巧合。
author: dodoowner_
source: When POKENAME spots a predator, it shoots out ink and swims away. The substance that comes out appears to resemble words, but this may be a coincidence.

entry: 经验丰富的厨师供应的细嫩带毒肉越来越受欢迎，POKENAME数量随之减少。遇险时，它会先喷墨，再在浑浊掩护里鼓起身体。
author: pjporwoll
source: The POKENAME population has decreased due to an increased popularity in serving their delicate toxin-laced meat by experienced chefs. When it encounters danger, it sprays a cloud of ink, then puffs up inside the murky hiding spot.

entry: POKENAME在壳内储存高压水，强力喷射，捕捉猎物。不过压力太大，壳稍有裂缝，就会猛烈漏水。
author: secondegg
source: POKENAME stores pressurized water in its shell, which it shoots at prey in powerful bursts. However, due to the immense pressure, even the slightest crack in its shell will spring a powerful leak.

entry: POKENAME若发现礁上有泡沫塑料等垃圾，就会用触手捡好，带到岸上，盼有人妥善处理。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME finds styrofoam or other waste on its reef, it gathers the pieces with its tentacles. It then brings it ashore in hopes that someone will dispose of it properly.

entry: 它先在沙中撑稳身体，或用吸盘抓紧岩石，再射出威力如大炮的水柱。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: It braces itself in the sand or holds onto rocks with its suction cups before firing a jet of water with the power of a cannon.

entry: 融合后，POKENAME多了装甲，能更坚韧地守住阵地，向敌人射出强力墨弹。有些记录显示，这可能曾是它天然的形态。
author: sk372
source: After fusing, POKENAME now sports armor plating to help its resilience in standing its ground and firing powerful ink shots at foes. There exist some records that indicate this may have once been POKENAME's natural form.

entry: POKENAME会埋在沙里，只露尾巴，用摇响的声音引来猎物与敌人，再用带吸盘的尾巴捉住。
author: princessmilandria
source: POKENAME buries itself in the sand, leaving only its tail exposed. It lures prey and enemies in with its rattle and catches them with its suction-cupped tail.

entry: POKENAME会用大嘴制造强力漩涡，将海中猎物吸向自己。睡够、攒足能量后，喷出的墨流连空中的快龙也能击落。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its large mouth to create a powerful whirlpool that suctions prey in the ocean towards it. Once it has built enough energy by sleeping, it can spit streams of ink with enough force to knock even a Dragonite from the sky.

entry: POKENAME会用特大嘴制造强力漩涡，将海中猎物卷向自己。长嘴虽然收窄了漩涡，却也增强了吸力。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its extra-large mouth to create a powerful whirlpool that funnels prey in the ocean towards it. While the long mouth narrows the vortex, it also increases the strength of the suction.

entry: POKENAME很聪明，能用墨汁画画、写字，与人和宝可梦交流。记录显示，有的个体敌视图图水母和毒刺犬，也有的与它们友善相处。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME is an intelligent Pokémon, capable of communicating to people and Pokémon by drawing or writing with its ink. Individuals have been recorded to either be hostile or friendly towards Smearcruel and Tentagle.

entry: POKENAME产出的不是奶而是墨汁，因此常被人工饲养。墨汁既能书写，也能用于一些料理。
author: jaycielantern
source: POKENAME is often farmed for its capability to produce ink instead of milk. The ink can be used for writing, but is also used in some recipes.

entry: POKENAME莫名痴迷拉面，会用长触手同时煮好几碗，还会自产流心蛋，加进每一碗面。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have an odd fascination with ramen and use their long tentacles to cook several bowls at once. They also make their own runny eggs that get added to every bowl of ramen they make.

entry: POKENAME常先用尾巴抓住猎物，再释放吸盘里储存的强烈电击。
author: daniel360n
source: POKENAME tends to use its tail to grasp hold of its prey before delivering a devastating shock that is stored within its suction cups.

entry: POKENAME会给触手吸盘充电，捉住猎物后将其麻痹。海绵般的毛皮常被用来制作潜水服衬垫。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME charges the suction cups on its tentacles with electricity to paralyze prey once captured. Its spongy fur is commonly used to make padding for diving suits.

entry: 据说POKENAME肉质细嫩美味，自带的叶片还能调味。不过它友善温柔，人们更愿意宠爱饲养，因此主人常鄙视吃它的人。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME is said to be delicious, with tender flesh seasoned by its very own leaf. Yet, people prefer to cherish POKENAME as pets since they are friendly and gentle-hearted, and so people who eat POKENAME are often despised by these owners.

entry: 许多人称POKENAME为“海中恶魔”，它是冷酷而精于算计的水中杀手。宝可梦一遇见它，几乎一瞬间就会被抓住吞食。
author: jangodiot
source: Referred to by many as 'Sea Demons', POKENAME are cold, calculated killers of the water. If a Pokémon encounters one, it is immediately grabbed and devoured in what seems like an instant.

entry: POKENAME会用尾背吸盘攀在海边洞顶，也能变色，进一步藏身。它先用触手困住目标，再发射泡弹，直到对方屈服。
author: infinex21
source: It uses the suction cups along its tail and back to cling to beach cave ceilings and can change its colors to further hide itself. POKENAME uses its tentacles to ensnare its target before shooting bubble bullets at it until it submits.

entry: POKENAME能从满身触手间吐出奇异的发光墨团。墨汁虽然碰着无害，却可能让人睡觉时做噩梦，最长持续一周。
author: sk372
source: From amidst the mass of tentacles forming from POKENAME's body, it can spit globs of strange, glowing ink. Although technically harmless to touch, exposure to the ink can cause a person to experience nightmares during sleep for up to a week.

entry: POKENAME背上生长的植物，能感知周围世界。受到威胁，就会向攻击者连射高速种子。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The plants growing on the backs of POKENAME are able to sense the world around them. When threatened, they spit volleys of high-velocity seeds at their aggressors.

entry: 它用灵活的脖子精准瞄准，连高飞的宝可梦也能击落。铁炮鱼纷纷聚来，既为食物，也想向它学习。
author: staghorn
source: It uses its flexible neck to take perfect aim, shooting down even high-flying Pokémon. Remoraid flock to it, eager for both food and lessons.

entry: POKENAME的墨汁营养丰富，会被混进面条和意式烩饭。人们认为，之所以美味，是因为能激活大脑中渴望盐和蛋白质的原始区域。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a highly nutritious ink that is mixed into noodles and risottos. It is believed that the reason the ink is so delicious is because it activates a primitive part of the brain that craves salt and protein.

entry: POKENAME身上不断漏墨，是传统书法的理想墨源。这种古老墨汁尤其善于附在纸上，不会过度洇散。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME constantly leak ink from their bodies, making them the perfect source of ink for traditional calligraphy. This is especially true because the ancient ink is particularly good at clinging to paper without excessively bleeding.

entry: 许多虚构作品会用类似POKENAME的形象描绘邪神。有史料记载，一些岛屿文明过去曾向它献礼，祈求渡海平安。
author: sk372
source: Many works of fiction use imagery similar to POKENAME to depict evil deities. There is some historical records that some island civilizations made offerings to it in the past to ensure safe travels across the oceans.

entry: POKENAME会沉睡在海底做梦。被打扰时，它先用吸盘和环固定在周围表面，再从鼻部喷出猛烈冲击，连坦克装甲也能撕开。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME dreams in a deep slumber on the seafloor. When disturbed, it secures itself to surrounding surfaces with its suction cups and ring, following this up with a devastating blast from its snout that can tear through tank armor.

entry: POKENAME会用吸盘固定在下方地面，稳住身体，向敌人接连喷射汹涌的墨流或水流。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME will anchor itself with its suction cups on the ground underneath. It does this so that it will be steady when it fires torrential barrages of ink or water at its enemies.

entry: 难得遇到宝可梦大规模领地争端时，POKENAME会让其他宝可梦帮忙瞄准大炮般的嘴，效果惊人。正因如此，许多聪明宝可梦都想与它结盟。
author: foolish_weasel
source: On the rare occasion of large scale territorial disputes between Pokémon, POKENAME will allow others to aim its powerful cannon-like mouth to great effect. Many intelligent Pokémon seek to ally themselves with POKENAME for this very reason.

entry: POKENAME能射出一柄水刃。遇到危险时，群体会聚在一起，把刀刃合成一把巨型武器，阻挡任何敌人。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME can shoot out a single blade made of water. When there is danger, groups of POKENAME will gather together and merge their blades into one massive weapon to stop any foe.

entry: POKENAME会用布满吸盘的触手困住敌人和猎物，确保嘴里的攻击命中。它也会喷墨扰乱对方；有些还会用墨汁与触手，画些粗糙图画。
author: infinex21
source: Using their suction cup-clad tentacles, POKENAME ensnare foes and prey to ensure their attacks loosed from their mouths land. To disorient their foes, they may spew ink; some POKENAME have used their ink and tentacles to make crude drawings.

entry: POKENAME捕猎时，通常先用利爪抓牢，再用钢铁头部猛砸。本能让它想藏进孔洞、巨石之间，僵硬金属身体却常妨碍钻入。
author: imaginita
source: When hunting, POKENAME usually holds onto prey with its sharp claws and then smashes them with its steely head. It instinctively tries to hide in holes and among boulders, but its stiff, metal body hinders its attempts to slip inside.

entry: 满月夜，POKENAME的墨格外明亮，纹样映出宇宙。民间传说，大量喝下墨汁，就能得到超凡脱俗的美貌。
author: dodoowner_
source: The ink POKENAME produces shines especially bright on full-moon nights, reflecting the cosmos in its pattern. According to folklore, those who drink large amounts of POKENAME's ink acquire otherworldly beauty.

entry: POKENAME能从臂上吸盘喷射强力墨流，足以贯穿粗木。每只都有独特墨色，用来辨认彼此领地。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME sprays powerful jets of ink from the suckers on its arms powerful enough to pierce through thick logs. Each POKENAME has their own unique ink pigment that they use to distinguish each other's territory.

entry: POKENAME爱烹饪一种面糊混海鲜碎做成的球形烤小吃。精神力量加上众多触手，能同时烤好几盘，效率很高。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to cook a certain grilled ball-shaped snack made out of batter and seafood scraps. Their psychic powers and many tentacles allow them to cook several trays of this snack at a time, making them highly efficient for the task.

entry: POKENAME胆小敏感，常住在远离阳光的深海。人们认为，它喜欢黑暗，是因为那里像浩瀚宇宙，让它安心。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME is a timid and sensitive creature, often residing deep in the ocean far from sunlight. It is believed they feel comfort in darkness due to its similarities to the vastness of space.

entry: 野生POKENAME在海边洞穴筑巢。触手让它能轻松攀住洞壁和洞顶，向猎物发射带电泡弹。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME make their nests within beachside caves. Their tentacles allow them to easily cling to walls and ceilings as they fire electrified bubble-bullets at their prey.

entry: 野生POKENAME会用顶部触手挂在洞顶，观察猎物。对方靠近，就射出滚烫泡弹，再用其他触手，把身体拉向猎物。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME use their top tentacle to cling to cave ceilings as they watch for prey. When prey draws near, they will shoot at them with burning-hot bubble bullets and then pull their bodies up to them using their other tentacles.

entry: POKENAME会从岸边垃圾中收集漂浮物与弃物，把感兴趣的套在触手上，直到找到更有趣的。若海滩游客拿着它看中的物件，有时还会抓起铁炮鱼朝对方开火。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME gathers flotsam and jetsam from shoreline trash, looping items that interest it on its tentacles until it finds something more interesting. It occasionally snatches up Remoraid to blast beachgoers holding items it covets.

entry: POKENAME藏在橡胶般的伪装下，找不够材料做全套触手，就用自己的暗影附肢补上。它对新物件极好奇，会试着拿给其他对象看，想交朋友。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME hides under a rubbery disguise, but cannot find enough material for a full set of tentacles, so its own shadowy appendages complete the ruse. It is intensely curious about new objects and will try to show them to others to become friends.

entry: POKENAME用海中废弃物做伪装，像一辆带手臂的小坦克。它会消灭潮池或海滩上过分凶猛的宝可梦，想借此博得同情与关注。
author: pjporwoll
source: Utilizing discarded items in the ocean, POKENAME creates a disguise resembling a tiny tank with arms. It tries to garner sympathetic attention by exterminating overly aggressive Pokémon in tidal pools or on beaches.

entry: POKENAME会用尾上众多触手抓住敌人，直接往眼里喷浓黑墨汁，蒙住视线。最后再从体内喷出滚烫水流，灼伤对方。
author: keiracm35_
source: To defeat its enemies, POKENAME seizes them with the many tentacles on its tail and blinds them by blasting dense black ink straight into their eyes. To finish them off, it scorches them with scalding water that it expels from inside its body.

entry: POKENAME在岸上弹跳时，会用触手大吸盘拖着人和宝可梦，再跳进水里，将它们拉到水下，借水帮助自己移动。
author: .izik
source: When bouncing on land, POKENAME uses the large suction cups on its tentacles to drag people and Pokémon along. It will then bounce into the water to drag them below the surface, using the water to assist in its movement.

entry: 它用美妙歌声引来对手，再以触手牢牢缠住猎物。一旦缠上，绝不松开。
author: mrpeach774
source: After luring in a foe with a beautiful song, it uses its tentacles to latch onto its prey. Once attached, it never lets go.

entry: POKENAME自卫时会从嘴里喷墨，令攻击者晕眩，同时把自己推走。曾有孩子抓住它的绳子，结果被喷了一身墨。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: To protect itself, POKENAME will eject ink from its mouth to stun the attacker and launch itself away. Children have been known to get inked after grabbing POKENAME's strings.

entry: POKENAME感到威胁时，会卷起头上的一根触手。若仍不被放过，就会从触手爆发喷水，让攻击者晕眩。
author: reflecbeat
source: When POKENAME feels threatened, it curls up one of the tentacles on its head. If not left alone, it then unleashes an explosive burst of water from the tentacle, which leaves the aggressor stunned.

entry: POKENAME生活在深海，沉船附近尤其多。被袭击时，会朝捕食者喷出发光墨汁，引来更大的捕食者，自己趁机逃走。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME are found in the ocean depths, and in high numbers around sunken ships. When attacked, it sprays the predator with a bioluminescent ink that attracts even larger predators while POKENAME escapes.

entry: POKENAME全身围着不透明墨汁。害怕时，就躲进墨中，不让别人看见自己的表情。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are surrounded by an opaque ink that covers their entire body. Whenever POKENAME are scared, they retreat into the ink to obscure their expression.

entry: POKENAME翅上的触手妨碍飞行，很难追赶猎物。它便从嘴里吐出使对方虚弱的毒墨，减慢目标，直到能追上、缠住。
author: sk372
source: The tentacles on POKENAME's wings adversely affect its flight capabilities, making it difficult to pursue prey. To compensate, it spits a debilitating poison ink from its mouth to slow down targets enough for it to catch up and ensnare them.

entry: POKENAME会从手指喷墨，蒙住敌人视线。因为吃垃圾，墨汁气味十分难闻。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME blasts ink from its fingers to blind its foes. Due to its diet of trash, the ink has a horrible odor.

entry: POKENAME扭紧再松开触手，借反作用力前进，不太费力就能在水中悠闲滑行。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME twists and releases its tentacles, giving it propulsion and allowing it to glide leisurely through the water with little energy expenditure.

entry: POKENAME能将触手拧在一起蓄力。松开时，便能借这股力量迅速游过很远的距离。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can twist its tentacles into together to build up tension. When it releases them, it can cover long distances quickly thanks to the force.

entry: POKENAME能把触手相互绞紧，积蓄弹力。猛然松开时，反冲的力量，便能让它迅速跃过很远的距离。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can twist its tentacles into each other and build up tension. When it releases them, it can cover long distances quickly thanks to the resulting force.

entry: POKENAME在浅滩和强流、漩涡附近筑巢，防范强大捕食者。它会先向猎物喷黏墨，遮住视线，再拖进危险地带，免得逃跑。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME nests along shoals and near strong currents or whirlpools as defense mechanisms against powerful predators. It blasts gooey ink at prey to blind them before dragging them into these dangerous areas to prevent escape.

entry: POKENAME藏在满是毒刺的触手鬃毛里，探出头，从鼻部朝目标喷水。想玩时，连训练家也会被喷。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME hides within its mane of tentacles, which are covered in venomous spikes. It peeks out from this cover to blast targets with water from its snout, including its Trainer if it feels playful.

entry: POKENAME触手覆着毒黏液，吃下的捕食者会生病，以后不再招惹。小小的核心身体能再生失去的肢体，也引来爱冒险的厨师，尝试用触手做菜。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's tentacles are covered in a toxic mucus, sickening predators that eat them so that they leave it alone in the future. The tiny core body can regenerate its lost limbs, leading to adventurous chefs experimenting with its tentacles in dishes.

entry: POKENAME与背上两只海葵共生。它把海葵带到食物充足处，供其捕捉；海葵则用蜇人触手抵御捕食者，保护它。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has a symbiotic relationship with the two sea anemones on its back. It transports them to locations with plenty of food for them to catch, and they protect it from predators with their stinging tentacles.

entry: POKENAME会啃漂流木和漂浮碎屑，希望找出废物里藏着的食物。双颚强壮，能咬碎垃圾。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME bites at driftwood and floating debris, hoping to uncover food hidden among the waste. It has a strong jaw for breaking apart trash.

entry: POKENAME的墨含大量孢子，能帮助礁区家园附近的植物生长，却也会让古怪的黑色真菌过度扩散。
author: .izik
source: The ink POKENAME produces is filled with large amounts of spores. These spores help plant life near its reef home grow but also cause odd black fungi to spread in excess.

entry: POKENAME的模样像旧恐怖小说里的一头怪兽，有人猜它不知如何影响了作者的头脑。它能从鼻部发出耀眼光芒，影响其他对象的精神稳定。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's physical description resembles a beast that appeared in an old fictional horror tale; some have suggested POKENAME somehow influenced the author's mind. It can fire dazzling lights from its snout that impacts others' mental stability.

entry: POKENAME为赢会不择手段，既会给爪子涂墨，遮住敌人视线，也会用触手和钳爪擒住，直到碾碎。它会用墨搅浑海水，抢先偷袭对手。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME fights using any tactics to win, including coating its claws in ink to blind foes and grappling them in its tentacles and claws until they are crushed. It clouds the water with ink to get the jump on an opponent.

entry: POKENAME背上的海葵大到妨碍行动。它会用吸盘将海葵固定好，等海葵捕食后，分得对方吃剩的食物。
author: .jerden
source: The anemone on POKENAME's back is large enough to restrict its movements. POKENAME uses its suction cups to anchor the anemone in place while it catches its own food and is then fed with any leftovers it can spare.

entry: POKENAME悠闲又爱玩泡泡，被逼入绝境时却很危险。它能喷墨遮眼，也能射出如弹药般强劲的泡流。
author: t3isukone
source: While the laid-back POKENAME loves to play around with its bubbles, it becomes dangerous when cornered. It can spurt blinding ink or fire streams of bubbles with ballistic force.

entry: POKENAME痴迷制作面糊与海鲜混成的球形烤小吃。难得原料用尽时，也会开心地切下自己的身体，继续给顾客供应美味。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are obsessed with making a grilled ball-shaped snack made out of batter and seafood. On the rare occasion that they run out of ingredients, they happily chop into their own body to serve customers this delicious treat.

entry: 传说用POKENAME墨汁画的情侣像，能让感情永远牢固。游客纷纷涌向沿海城镇，高价买小瓶墨汁，相信是长久爱情的象征。
author: .izik
source: Tales state that a couple's portrait painted with POKENAME's ink will cement their relationship forever. Tourists clamor to coastal towns to buy vials of this ink for high costs, believing it to be a symbol of lasting love.

entry: POKENAME潜伏水下洞穴，用触手捉住路过猎物，拖进地下吃。水手有许多夸张传闻，有的甚至说它能长到拖沉整艘船。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lurk within underwater caves, grabbing at passing prey with their tentacles to drag them underground to feed on. Sailors have many tall tales surrounding POKENAME, with some stories claiming they grow large enough to drag entire ships down.

entry: 关都某些地方把POKENAME当珍馐。富含矿物的食谱让肉带着土香，丰富了海鲜菜肴。渔民却很难捉到，得用专门工具，才能从洞里弄出来。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are a delicacy in some parts of Kanto, their mineral-rich diet adding an earthy flavour to them and enriching seafood dishes. They are difficult for fishermen to catch, requiring specialised tools to get them out of their burrows.

entry: 为了安全，最好与POKENAME保持距离。它随时可能偏头痛，身体机能失控，朝四面八方乱喷墨。
author: sk372
source: It's advisable to give POKENAME a wide berth for safety; at any moment, it may experience a migraine that causes it to lose control of its bodily functions and spew ink all around it.

entry: POKENAME住在海里，却控制不了行动，只能随流漂。捕食者或猎物靠得太近时，它能用精神力量推远或拉近，触手随之鼓动。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME lives in the ocean but has no control over how it moves, getting taken with the current. Whenever a predator or prey gets too close, it can manipulate psychic energy to push them away or bring them closer, causing its tentacles to throb.

entry: POKENAME力量与灵巧兼备，能快速切鱼、剔骨，做出完美刺身，因此很受忙碌厨房重视。它也爱创造新奇异国寿司卷，给训练家品尝。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are highly valued in fast-paced kitchens, as their strength and dexterity allow them to quickly chop and debone fish into perfect cuts of sashimi. They also love creating new, exotic rolls of sushi for their Trainer to try.

entry: POKENAME常只因与水生宝可梦对视，就无意间迷倒对方。传闻称，受伤后反而会变得更英俊。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME have a penchant for accidentally wooing most aquatic Pokémon just by making eye contact. Some rumors claim that if POKENAME gets injured, it becomes more handsome.

entry: POKENAME脾气乖戾，不屑与其他对象相伴，更喜欢独自锻炼、创作艺术。不过许多人觉得它俊得古怪，因此仍很受欢迎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a rather surly personality, preferring to work out and do artistic endeavors away from others, disdaining company. Despite this attitude, it remains popular due to many finding it oddly handsome.

entry: POKENAME的众多触手力道凶狠，遍布强力吸盘，一被抓住就极难挣脱。逃跑的敌人，还会成为强力远程攻击的目标。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's many tentacles are brutally powerful. With strong suckers scattered across them, escaping POKENAME's grip is extremely difficult. Foes who run are targeted with powerful ranged attacks.

entry: POKENAME会在水下守护墨海马。遇到敌人，先用触手制住，再用拳头打得粉碎。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be found underwater, making sure Horsea are protected from threats. If they encounter a foe, POKENAME will restrain them with their tentacles before pulverizing them with their fists.

entry: POKENAME住在森林，以强大的种子机关枪闻名。一察觉威胁逼近，就会不停射种子，直到对方倒下。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives in the forest and is famous for its powerful Bullet Seed attack. When it senses a threat approaching, it won't stop firing seeds until the threat is knocked out.

entry: 家园变得不安全时，POKENAME会用触手在陆地旅行。平时大多挤在小型废弃物中，例如伤药瓶或大舌贝壳。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME will use its tentacles to travel over land when its habitat becomes unsafe. It spends most of its time squeezed into small discarded items like potion bottles or Shellder shells.

entry: POKENAME会用触手捉住猎物，再喷墨掩护自己离去。吃饱后，就挤进狭窄处，盖上伞状身体睡觉。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME uses its tentacles to ensnare prey before spraying ink to obscure its escape. Once it has fed, POKENAME squeezes into a tight location covered by its bell to sleep.

entry: POKENAME会从脸上的孔口施展奇怪招式，攻击猎物。它懒散少动，以此节能，野外每天大约只出招5次。若全落空，就会睡去，改天再试。
author: bobosmith01
source: It attacks prey by using odd moves from its facial orifice. POKENAME is sluggish and conserves energy by staying still; in the wild, it only about fires 5 moves a day. If it misses all of them, it goes into slumber to try again another day.

entry: 大舌贝通常附在呆壳兽尾上；POKENAME却似乎让章鱼桶接管了大舌贝的意识。它融合在呆壳兽手臂，鼻部像大炮，用来自卫。
author: bobosmith01
source: A Shellder is typically attached to a Slowbro's tail; POKENAME seemingly has Octillery override that Shellder's consciousness instead. Fused into Slowbro's arm, its snout acts as a cannon for defense.

entry: POKENAME休息时，会用触手般鳍上的吸盘贴住冰山侧面。寒冷环境能帮助维持能量，等候下一餐。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sticks to the sides of icebergs with the suction cups on its tentacle-like fins when resting. The cold environment helps it maintain its energy as it awaits its next meal.

entry: POKENAME住进大型宝可梦丢弃的壳，自我保护。它会与铁炮鱼共生，用高压水将小小的伙伴射向敌人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME inhabit the discarded shells of larger Pokémon and use them for protection. They form a symbiotic relationship with Remoraid and will use high-pressure water to launch the smaller Pokémon at their foes.

entry: 捕食者若想撬开POKENAME的壳，就会迎上一股墨与水的洪流，而POKENAME则借力远远弹开。
author: .fedoraman
source: If a predator attempts to pry open an POKENAME shell, it will be met with a torrent of ink and water, launching POKENAME far into the distance.

entry: POKENAME钳爪上的吸盘，方便攀过陡峭海崖和水下陡坡。它会从鼻部喷大量泡沫，遮掩洞口。
author: pjporwoll
source: The suction cups on POKENAME's claws aid in traversing the steep coastal cliffs and aquatic drop-offs it encounters in the wild. It will expel copious amounts of foam from its snout to disguise the entrance to its den.

entry: POKENAME头上坚硬的冠状凸脊，让它无法完全挤过窄缝逃避捕食者。它改将甲壳类宝可梦蜕下的壳，组合成攻守兼备的铠甲。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's tough, crown-shaped ridge on its head keeps it from being able to squeeze fully through tight spots to escape predators. Instead, it incorporates the shed shells of crustacean Pokémon into armor for offense and defense.

entry: POKENAME将用来充饥的种子存进背上包袱。这些种子也能在它栖居的雪林中生长。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses the bundle on its back to store seeds it uses for nutrients. These seeds are able to grow in the snowy forests where it lives.

entry: POKENAME会睡在许多人家门口，享受门下漏出的暖意。若获准进屋，就会高兴极了，尤其还能吃装饰树落下的松针。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sleep at the doorsteps of many homes to feel the heat from under the door. They are overjoyed whenever they are let inside, especially if they can eat pine needles that decorative trees shed.

entry: 冬日节庆里，人们总误认POKENAME是挂饰，拿来拿去，害它常很烦躁。每次碰到还会爆炸，炸飞随身食物，让它更不高兴。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are often annoyed due to being constantly picked up by humans mistaking them for ornaments during winter holidays. Each time they're touched, they also explode, launching away any food they were carrying, adding on to their grumpiness.

entry: 冬日节庆里，拿星纹挂饰得留心，因为也许是POKENAME。被拿起时，它得格外小心，避免爆炸，否则可能毁掉随身食物。
author: soup1900
source: People have to be wary of grabbing star-patterned ornaments during winter holidays due to them potentially being a POKENAME instead. It has to be really careful to not explode if this happens; otherwise, it may destroy the food it was carrying.

entry: POKENAME滚动时一颠簸，就会爆炸，把随身食物撒得到处都是。它常像挂饰一样吊在树上，可个头大，容易滑落，着地又会爆炸。
author: soup1900
source: If POKENAME hits a bump while rolling, it explodes and scatters the food it was carrying everywhere. It typically hangs off of trees like tree ornaments, but its large size often causes it to slip off and explode upon landing.

entry: 野生POKENAME成年、不再受庇护后，会主动远离其他对象，独居深山洞窟。不过一收到礼物，就会高兴极了，总竭尽所能加倍回礼。
author: bobosmith01
source: When wild POKENAME come of age and are no longer protected by others, they live a self-imposed lonely life away from others deep in mountain caverns. Despite this, they become overjoyed when given a gift and always go above and beyond to reciprocate.

entry: POKENAME拿随身骨头敲击物体，就会让表面覆满闪亮霜雪。如果在信使卡拉时期受过关爱，就常会收养迷路或被遗弃的宝可梦。
author: bobosmith01
source: When POKENAME whacks an object with the bone it always carries around, the object's surface becomes covered in twinkling frost and snow. If it was given love and care as a Delibone, it tends to take in any lost or abandoned Pokémon to raise them.

entry: POKENAME拿随身骨头敲击物体，就会让表面覆满闪亮霜雪。如果在信使卡拉时期受过关爱，就常会收养迷路或被遗弃的宝可梦。
author: bobosmith01
source: When POKENAME whacks an object with the bone it always carries around, the object's surface becomes covered in twinkling frost and snow. If it was given love and care as a Delibone, it tends to take in any lost or abandoned Pokémon to raise them.

entry: POKENAME擅长藏进长袜，不到进化或被赶出，就不会动。许多人认为养它能带来好运，因此不少个体在住家里进化。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are good at hiding in stockings and will not move until they evolve or are forced out. Many people believe that keeping a POKENAME is good luck, so many of them evolve in people's homes.

entry: POKENAME的藤蔓无论气候怎样，摸起来都凉。心情满足时，会发出多种鲜艳光芒，许多人喜欢这份节庆气氛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's vines always remain cool to the touch, no matter the climate it's in. The vines glow a variety of bright colors when it is content, and many enjoy the festive atmosphere the light brings.

entry: POKENAME会用背带兜着幼崽，天冷就裹得更严。找到的食物也会放进兜里留待以后，不过孩子通常立刻全吃光。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME carries its baby in a sling and will bundle it up more in cold weather. It will place any food it finds inside the sling for later, but the child usually eats it all immediately.

entry: POKENAME爱给孩子送礼。礼物常沾着翅上的闪亮粉尘，许多家长却仍欢迎它进屋，就算孩子之后得洗澡也不介意。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to give out presents to children. These presents are often covered with a glittery dust that comes from their wings, but many parents still welcome them into their home, even if it means their children need a bath afterwards.

entry: POKENAME双拳能放雷电与霜，阻止危险宝可梦找茬。某些节日里，每个对象都能收到礼物，连刻薄待它的训练家或宝可梦也不例外。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can shoot lightning and frost from its fists, which discourages dangerous Pokémon from picking fights with it. During certain holidays, it always has a present for everyone, even Trainers or Pokémon that are mean to it.

entry: POKENAME住在偏僻山坡，会好奇地跟着探险访客。它迷恋闪亮的石头，会收集到尾巴里。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME live on secluded mountain slopes, curiously following visiting explorers. They are fascinated by shiny rocks, collecting them in their tails.

entry: POKENAME飞翔于冰雪群山间，看见迷路的人，就载其飞往安全处，再分些食物。它的羽毛，柔软又温暖得出奇。
author: crazynaturekitty
source: POKENAME flies around icy mountains. If it sees someone lost, it will fly them to safety and give them some food. Its feathers are surprisingly soft and warm.

entry: 猛烈暴风雪中，POKENAME会现身，吞下风雪，储进嗉囊。随后再带回巢里，让家园终年冰封。
author: rockageddon
source: POKENAME appears during terrible snowstorms to eat and store the violent weather in their crop. Later it will deliver the weather to its nest to keep its home covered in permafrost.

entry: POKENAME爱送信，从笔友到公司首席执行官，每封邮件都满怀关爱、尽心送达。它很少在途中迷路，弄丢袋里邮件的情况更少。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love delivering mail. From pen pals to company CEOs, POKENAME reliably transport every piece of mail with love and dedication. Few ever get lost on their way to deliver mail, and even fewer make the mistake of losing mail from their bag.

entry: POKENAME充满节庆气息，以操纵糖果、增强甜味的本领闻名。战斗时会发射硬化点心，威力出人意料。
author: ilija09
source: POKENAME is a festive Pokémon known for controlling candy and amplifying its sweetness. In battle, it launches hardened treats that strike with unexpected power.

entry: 冬季夜里，POKENAME会绕住家飞行，尾巴留下一道道红绿光轨，数日不散。家被它装饰过，被认为是很大的福气。
author: sk372
source: During the winter seasons, POKENAME will circle people's homes at night, its tail creating trails of red and green lights that linger for days. It is considered quite the blessing to have one's house decorated by POKENAME's presence.

entry: POKENAME是干劲十足的送货鸟，常替人把小包裹送往严寒地区。若不拦着，凡是举得动的，它们都想送。
author: rockageddon
source: POKENAME are ambitious delivery birds used to send small packets to the coldest of regions. POKENAME will try to deliver anything they can lift if they are not stopped.

entry: POKENAME会把送礼任务交给其他信使鸟，但有空仍会帮忙。有些礼物已被咬过，不过孩子似乎不介意。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME delegates the task of giving gifts to other Delibird, but still helps out whenever they can. Some of the presents they offer have bites taken out of them, but children do not seem to mind.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME坐在高树上等待猎物。狩猎一整夜后，早晨便会把收获分给其他宝可梦。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME will sit in a tall tree at night, watching for prey. After a long night of hunting, it spends the morning sharing its spoils with other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME会用丝包好猎物，留待以后保鲜。它很无私，常把包好的小食送给其他饥饿宝可梦。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME wraps its prey in silk to keep it fresh for the future. It's an altruistic Pokémon, often gifting some of its wrapped-up morsels to other hungry Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME总背着重袋四处飞，飞行本领甚至胜过未融合叉字蝠。无声飞行让它能迅速送食物给最凶猛的宝可梦，再赶忙飞走。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are even better at flying than unfused Crobat since they always carry a heavy sack everywhere they go. Their silent flying allows them to quickly share food with even the most violent Pokémon before darting away.

entry: POKENAME会给格外友善的宝可梦送礼，似乎总很开心。很少久留一处，而是飞过城镇，传播快乐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gives presents to particularly nice Pokémon and seems to always be in a jovial mood. It rarely stays in one place for long and flies between towns and cities to spread happiness.

entry: POKENAME常送游戏卡带，让孩子用掌机玩。它也会把设备贴着脸颊摩擦充电，方便立刻开始新游戏。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often hand out game cartridges as presents so that children can play on handheld devices. They also charge the devices by rubbing it against their cheeks so that children can jump into their new game right away.

entry: POKENAME送来的食物礼被认为有好运。它只送给慷慨的人，而这些人通常又会分享，不把点心全留给自己。
author: .jerden
source: The gifts of food that POKENAME bring are considered to be good luck. They will only deliver them to generous people, but these people usually share them with others rather than keeping treats for themselves.

entry: 训练家得留意管住POKENAME。它急着打破送货纪录，常一冲就冲过了头，反而白白浪费时间。
author: rockageddon
source: Trainers must take care to rein in their POKENAME. Eager to break its delivery record, they will overshoot their delivery, losing time instead of saving it.

entry: 冬季，POKENAME会离开水下巢穴分享礼物，从尾端袋子般的圆球里拿出小饰品。
author: sk372
source: During the winter season, POKENAME emerges from its aquatic den to share gifts. It dispenses small trinkets from the pouch-like sphere at the end of its tail.

entry: POKENAME会向淡水附近和水中的宝可梦传播节日喜悦，常带来树果零食，存放在尾巴有弹性的袋子里。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spread festive holiday cheer to Pokémon living near and in bodies of freshwater. It often brings berries and snacks that it stores in the stretchy bag on its tail.

entry: POKENAME身体天生往上飘，会在尾里塞小石头，帮自己贴近地面。随着长大，也会逐渐换掉这些石头。
author: jaminmcready
source: Because its body naturally drifts upward, POKENAME keeps small stones tucked into its tail to help stay near the ground. As it grows, these stones are gradually replaced.

entry: POKENAME白天会从垃圾箱偷食物和小饰品，塞进随身袋子。夜里再拖回洞里，囤下大量食物。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME spend their days stealing food and trinkets from dumpsters, stuffing them into the bags that they carry. At night, they will drag these bags back to their dens, stockpiling massive amounts of food.

entry: POKENAME在树枝间荡来荡去，给高处的宝可梦送礼。礼袋能在三只手之间轻松换来换去，几乎不可能被偷走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swing from branch to branch delivering gifts to Pokémon high above the ground. They can easily swap the gift bag between their three hands, making it nearly impossible to steal from them.

entry: 冬天常能见到POKENAME成群挂在树上。白天吸收阳光，高兴得闪闪发亮；夜里则放出柔光，照亮下方森林。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found hanging from trees in groups during winter. During the day, they absorb sunlight and sparkle with delight. At night, they illuminate the forest below with a soft glow.

entry: 每逢满月，POKENAME习惯在训练家房里留一份礼物。身体即使零下也能生存。
author: fiordaliso
source: When the moon is full, POKENAME makes a habit of leaving a gift in its Trainer's room. Its body can survive even in sub-zero temperatures.

entry: 每逢满月，POKENAME习惯在训练家房里留一份礼物。身体即使零下也能生存。
author: fiordaliso
source: When the moon is full, POKENAME makes a habit of leaving a gift in its Trainer's room. Its body can survive even in sub-zero temperatures.

entry: POKENAME爱收集闪亮物品，把袋子塞满。每年会飞遍地区，将它们分给年幼训练家和宝可梦。
author: ghiragar
source: POKENAME love to collect shiny objects and fill their bags with them. Once a year they fly around the region to distribute them to both young Trainers and Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME袋里装了大量珠宝邮件、奇迹邮件和港口邮件，多得几乎背不动。它却一封也不肯送出，连训练家和最亲近的伙伴也不给。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME's bag is filled with such large quantities of Bead Mail, Fab Mail, and Harbor Mail that it struggles to carry them all. It refuses to give any of the mail away, even to its Trainer or closest companions.

entry: POKENAME嗜甜，会悄悄潜入住家，尽量偷走烘焙点心。它自私却又高尚，会偷别人的礼物，送给曾被自己伤害的对象，结果陷入恶性循环。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: POKENAME are foragers with a sweet tooth, sneaking into homes undetected to steal as many baked goods as they can. They have a selfish yet noble spirit, stealing gifts from others for those they have wronged and starting a vicious cycle.

entry: POKENAME的头善良体贴，会送食物给需要帮助的对象，尾巴却脾气差，讨厌别人开心。头一转开，尾巴就悄悄把食物偷回来，头却全不知情。
author: periperi_chicken
source: While POKENAME's head is kind and caring, gifting food to those in need, the tail is grouchy and hates seeing others' joy. When the head turns away, the tail steals the gifted food back without the head knowing.

entry: POKENAME吊在树上，突然落到路人面前送礼物。若对方拒收，POKENAME可能会懊恼得当场爆炸。
author: lemmymaster
source: POKENAME hangs in trees, dropping in front of passersby to give gifts to them. If the recipient refuses the gift, POKENAME may explode in frustration.

entry: POKENAME以欢乐的性情和甜香闻名，冬天常吸引其他对象靠近。虽然看着无害，受惊后的头撞却出奇有力。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME is known for its jolly demeanour and the sweet scent it gives off, which lures others in during winter months. Despite its harmless look, it can deliver a surprisingly strong headbutt when startled.

entry: POKENAME身体短，尾巴里食物装太多就飞不起来。虽然住在寒冷地区，下雪却会让它飞得笨拙，甚至摔落地面。
author: soup1900
source: Due to POKENAME's short body, it will be unable to fly if it carries too much food in its tail. Although it lives in cold places, snow will cause it to fly clumsily and even crash into the ground.

entry: POKENAME体内装满小玩具，会拿来分给孩子。有时礼物沾着树果汁，但孩子收礼太开心，似乎也不介意。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are full of small toys that they hand out to children. Sometimes their gifts are covered in Berry Juice, but children are often so excited to get a gift that they do not seem to mind.

entry: POKENAME很适合救援队，会参加山地与雪地搜救。袋里装着烤树果，分给受冻的宝可梦。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are specialized for rescue teams and used for mountain and snow rescues. Inside their sack are roasted berries that are to be given to freezing Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME爬动时，壳里的雪不断旋转，让冰属性力量随时待命。球罩虽然看着脆弱，其实由岩石和冰的硬化晶体构成。
author: thordemidgard
source: As it crawls about, the snow inside POKENAME's shell swirls around, which keeps its Ice-type power ready to use. Despite its fragile looks, the globe is made from hardened crystals of rock and ice.

entry: 送达包裹，对POKENAME是神圣之事。谁敢偷货，就会遭到数周的猛烈攻击。它永远记得那张脸，包裹贼别想安心。
author: rockageddon
source: Deliveries are sacred to POKENAME. Anyone that tries to steal deliveries will be mercilessly attacked for weeks. Package thieves are never safe, as POKENAME never forgets a face.

entry: POKENAME雪白胡子与红毛，曾多次让孩子报告有信使鸟受伤，想找人帮忙。如今人们会告诉孩子，信使鸟只是在睡觉，好让他们尊重POKENAME的休息，不去打扰。
author: quackquackattack
source: The snowy-white beard of POKENAME and their red fur have caused multiple incidents where children report an injured Delibird and try to get help. Nowadays children are told that the Delibird are sleeping so they respectfully leave POKENAME alone.

entry: POKENAME常与人类社区关系密切，很乐意参加节庆，尤其喜欢年终庆祝。小朋友来到水边，它就会送礼。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are often closely entwined in human communities and show great pleasure in joining in festivities. End-of-year celebrations are a special favourite, and they will give gifts to young children that approach the water's edge.

entry: 普通信使鸟天性慷慨，可两只信使鸟融合后却脾气暴躁又刻薄。礼物不送，只送煤炭。
author: valtsuri
source: Despite an unfused Delibird's generous nature, a Delibird double fusion is grumpy and mean. It only delivers coal, not gifts.

entry: 冬天，POKENAME会悄悄从通风口游进住家，偷走小饰品，再送给自己的幼崽。
author: dodoowner_
source: In the wintertime, POKENAME sneakily slithers into houses through vents, stealing trinkets. It will then give these gifts to its young.

entry: POKENAME会奔过森林和山岭，确保偏远地区的人也能收到礼物。回报只要几口零食，再拍拍它的角。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gallop through forests and mountains to ensure that people living in remote places of the world get presents. All they ask for in return is a few snacks and a pat on their antlers.

entry: POKENAME还在学习控制电力，手掌会射出乱跳的火花。它喜欢送礼给其他宝可梦，哪怕礼物很小。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shoots erratic sparks from its palms, still learning how to control its electrical powers. It enjoys giving gifts to other Pokémon, even if the gifts are small.

entry: POKENAME严厉却有爱心。懂感恩、乐分享的对象靠近时，胸前星星会发光；粗鲁狡诈的对象靠近，却会让它暴走。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is stern but affectionate. Being in the presence of the grateful and the giving causes the star on its chest to glow. The rude and deceitful being near, however, causes POKENAME to rampage.

entry: 冬天，POKENAME会飞过小村，故意把羽毛留在居民门口。据说能带来极大好运。
author: dodoowner_
source: During the wintertime, POKENAME flies over small villages, deliberately leaving their feathers on civilians' doorsteps. These feathers are said to bring great fortune.

entry: POKENAME带着两个袋子，让路人选择从哪个袋里收礼。一袋是有趣小物，另一袋却全是无用垃圾，因此每次选择都像赌博。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME offers the two bags it carries to passersby, letting them choose which to accept a gift from. In one it carries entertaining trinkets, and in the other only useless junk, so every offering is a gamble.

entry: 传说对别人过于残忍，就可能被POKENAME纠缠。它会在深夜到来，冰冷耳语般的叫声据说能招来可怕噩梦，报复对方造成的痛苦。
author: sk372
source: Those who have been overly cruel to others are said to risk being haunted by POKENAME. It comes in the dead of night, its cold whispering cry said to gift those it haunts with horrendous nightmares, as retribution for the anguish they've caused.

entry: POKENAME乐意从袋里分礼物，却只准自己碰袋子。谁想摸，就会遭闪电形尾巴一记厉害的电击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME happily hands out gifts from its bag, but it only allows itself to be the one to handle said bag. Anything that tries to touch it will be in for a nasty zap from its bolt-shaped tail.

entry: POKENAME能放出雷暴与暴风雪，保护朋友。每到冬季节庆，它都尽量送礼给每个对象，希望鼓励人们成为更好的自己。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can unleash lightning storms and blizzards to protect its friends. Every holiday winter season, it gives gifts to everyone it can because it wants to inspire people to be their best selves.

entry: POKENAME只在节日期间现身，传播欢乐。一个人越善良，收到的礼物就越多。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME is only seen during the holidays, spreading joy. The kinder a person is, the more presents they get from a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME穿过雪村，会朝人喷冰水，害对方掉下手里东西，再收进袋状尾巴。它是狡猾又机灵的小偷。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME travels through snowy villages, shooting icy water at people so they drop anything they carry. It stores its prizes in its sack-like tail, making it a tricky and resourceful thief.

entry: POKENAME会在较冷季节四处旅行，送礼给表现乖巧的对象。礼袋总拖过栖息的沼泽，几乎一直沾着泥。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME travels around during the colder seasons, handing out gifts to those that it sees behaving well. Its gift bag is almost constantly stained with mud due to dragging it through the swamps it lives in.

entry: POKENAME有约九到十个月看似冻在冰里。到了秋天，才会开始解冻、唱歌。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME spends around nine or ten months seemingly frozen in ice. When autumn rolls around, POKENAME will begin thawing out and singing.

entry: 某些地区会鼓励孩子站到POKENAME的石头前，接受品性评判。如果表现好，它就会现身，变出礼物奖励。
author: sk372
source: In some regions children are encouraged to stand before POKENAME's stone and have their character judged. If they've been good, POKENAME will manifest itself and materialize a gift as a reward for their behavior.

entry: POKENAME被束缚在节庆挂饰里，据说由孩子们许下的108个不同愿望聚成。它会努力行善，试着实现这些心愿。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Bound to a festive ornament, POKENAME is thought to be a collection of 108 different wishes made by children. It strives to grant these wishes by performing good deeds.

entry: 关于节日送礼者的故事里，POKENAME是他的助手。据说能感知孩子的波导，判断谁淘气、谁乖巧。
author: sk372
source: Tales of the one who delivers gifts at the holidays describe POKENAME as his assistants. As the stories go, this Pokémon can sense the auras of children to determine who is naughty or nice.

entry: POKENAME把礼物藏在冰冻崖壁里，分给迷路旅人。擅自拿走的礼物会爆炸，引发雪崩。
author: lampent12
source: POKENAME stores their gifts in frozen cliff sides, handing them out to lost travelers. Gifts taken without permission will explode, causing an avalanche.

entry: POKENAME享受给予和分享，却容不下贪婪者与小偷。谁想在附近擅拿别人的东西，就会被装满礼物的袋子一挥，打飞出去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys the act of giving and sharing, but has no tolerance for greedy individuals and thieves. Anyone trying to take from another in its vicinity will be sent flying with a swing of its full bag of gifts.

entry: 自然灾害刚发生过的地方，会有POKENAME前来赠送暖衣。衣服虽然常有印刷错误，和救命的保暖用途相比，那点问题却不算什么。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME arrive at places that have recently experienced natural disasters to give out gifts of warm clothes. The warm clothes often have a misprint on them, but that is a minor inconvenience compared to the lifesaving utility of the clothes.

entry: 恶劣冬夜，POKENAME可能在奇迹发生前一刻现身。人们当它是救世主，送来大量礼物，它却全分给阿勃梭鲁等不幸、受不公对待的宝可梦。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: On dire winter nights, a POKENAME may appear right before a miracle happens. Believing POKENAME to be a savior, people will shower them with gifts, but POKENAME gives all their gifts to less fortunate and unfairly treated Pokémon like Absol instead.

entry: 都市传说称，POKENAME夜里会追赶淘气的孩子和宝可梦，塞进袋里，送入灵界。夜晚结束时，又把整袋倒进肚上的大嘴，吃掉受害者。
author: pjporwoll
source: Urban legend says POKENAME chases down naughty children and Pokémon at night to stuff into its bag, which transports them into the spirit realm. At the end of the night, it empties the entire bag into the maw on its stomach to devour the victims.

entry: POKENAME有在暴风雪中出现、绑走人的可怕名声。其实它是在救迷路旅人，照料对方，直到能安全继续旅途。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has a feared reputation of appearing in blizzards and kidnapping people. In truth, it rescues lost travelers in snow storms and provides for them until it is safe to continue their journey.

entry: POKENAME会去世界各地的偏远村镇庆祝冬季节日，传播喜悦与善意。从不久留一处，几乎无法研究。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME celebrates winter holiday festivals in remote towns and villages across the world, spreading joy and goodwill. It never remains in one place for long, making it nearly impossible to study.

entry: 战斗过后，POKENAME照例会送礼给对手。打得越精彩、越激烈，礼物就越好，无论对方是否获胜。
author: sk372
source: It is customary after a battle for POKENAME to present a gift to its opponent. The quality and intensity of the battle increases the quality of the gift offered, no matter whether the foe won the fight or not.

entry: POKENAME住在气温常低于冰点的地方。发现旅人艰难前行，就会分享温暖美味的点心，但这些甜食究竟如何产出，尚不清楚。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME live in areas that frequently drop below freezing. When they spot a struggling traveler, they share warm and delicious treats with them. However, how POKENAME produces such desserts is not known.

entry: 风雪浓雾都拦不住POKENAME，只要知道有人需要帮助，无论天气怎样都会跋涉前往。帮完忙，就随一阵冰雾消失在夜里。
author: bobosmith01
source: Snow, wind and fog mean nothing to this Pokémon: it will trek through any condition in order to help someone it knows is in need. POKENAME vanishes into the night with an icy fog after giving assistance.

entry: 它踏过冰地，在冷得连钢铁也能冻住的温度里递送机械邮件。金属身体能为包裹隔温，让它们长途运输后仍完好。
author: jaminmcready
source: This Pokémon marches across icy terrain delivering Mech Mail in temperatures that would freeze steel. Its metallic body keeps each parcel insulated and intact during long-distance routes.

entry: POKENAME会往袋里塞许多重物，例如岩石、金属和木块。它略浮在对手上方，猛烈挥袋，希望把目标击倒。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME fills its bag with numerous heavy objects, such as rocks, metals, and pieces of wood. Against opponents, it violently swings this bag while hovering slightly above the target in hopes of knocking them out.

entry: POKENAME的触须极强，能伸得很远。它会用来从树上摘果，送给同伴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feelers are extremely strong and can extend great distances. They use these feelers to pick fruit from trees and deliver it to their allies.

entry: 家长会讲POKENAME夜里偷走淘气孩子，困进无情冰寒世界的故事。其实它颇友好，却会配合演戏，帮忙吓得孩子守规矩。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: Parents tell stories of POKENAME stealing away naughty children at night, trapping them in a world of merciless cold. In reality, POKENAME is rather amicable, but will play along to help scare misbehaving children straight.

entry: POKENAME会高效地巡视冰谷，把压缩冰弹存进机械尾包。发光面罩锁定目标后，就会从远处射出爆炸式寒能，将敌人冻住。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME patrols frozen valleys with high-tech efficiency, storing compressed ice bombs within its mechanical tail bundle. It locks onto targets with a glowing visor, firing explosive payloads of freezing energy from long range to turn enemies solid.

entry: 天热时，POKENAME会给周围所有对象分发美味刨冰。体内储雪似乎从不减少。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: On hot days, POKENAME hands out tasty snow cones to everyone around. The snow stored in its body never seems to diminish.

entry: 它把礼物包在蓬松棉尾里，乘着寒冷北风送达。
author: .jerden
source: It carries presents bundled up inside its fluffy cotton tail. It delivers them by riding on the cold north wind.

entry: POKENAME会穿过雪地，送去温暖。礼物多是暖衣，例如围巾、外套和毛衣。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME scamper through the snow to deliver the gift of warmth. Most of the presents they bring involve warm clothes, such as scarves, jackets, or sweaters.

entry: POKENAME找回钥匙后，会先判断主人是否友善，再决定归还。若不友善，就立刻扔进最近的洞。
author: mary_the_jane
source: POKENAME will return lost keys to their owners, only after it decides if they are nice or not. If not it will promptly throw them into the nearest hole.

entry: POKENAME会飞奔过雪地，给孩子送暖和舒适的衣服。据说摸它一条尾巴，就能得到好几年的好运。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dash through the snow to deliver warm and cozy clothes to children. It is said that if a child pets one of their tails, they are blessed with years of good luck.

entry: POKENAME木工本领出众，节日期间会制作应景木雕。许多年轻工匠想与它合作，精进技艺，做出一番成绩。
author: oejoeboy33
source: Known for its remarkable woodworking talent, POKENAME creates festive wooden statues around the holidays. Many young craftsmen seek its partnership to refine their skills and prosper.

entry: 它会把礼物含在嘴里，分给遇到的每个对象。若有人想伸手偷拿，就会毫不犹豫地咬下。
author: cait_sith
source: It carries gifts in its mouth to give out to anyone it meets. If someone tries to reach inside to steal a gift, it will bite down without hesitation.

entry: 这种宝可梦常给挨饿的孩子送食物，火焰中也带着对饥饿者的同情。
author: notsaying.
source: This Pokémon is often found giving food to starving children. Its flame burns with sympathy for the hungry.

entry: 训练家若没看紧POKENAME，就会发现附近的玩具纷纷不见。专家也不确定，它是想偷来惹孩子哭，还是有偷窃癖。
author: rockageddon
source: Trainers that don't pay attention to POKENAME will discover that toys tend to disappear around this Pokémon. Experts are not sure if the Pokémon likes to steal to make children cry or if it is a case of kleptomania.

entry: POKENAME的泡泡里不断产生雪状物，让身体摸起来冰凉。它喜欢被想降温的对象抱着，一边分享凉意，一边轻柔地咕咕叫。
author: sk372
source: It constantly produces snow-like material inside its bubble that leaves it cold to the touch. POKENAME enjoys being held by others in need of cooling down, cooing softly as it shares its temperature.

entry: POKENAME会从洞里收集宝石，送给信任的人。过去有人曾将这些石头卖出天价，因此从那以后，它赠出的宝石便远低于原本价值。
author: jangodiot
source: It collects gemstones from caves and gives them out to humans that it trusts. People used to sell these stones for astronomically high prices, so ever since, gemstones given out by POKENAME are worth much less than their original value.

entry: POKENAME每年会从雪地下来一次，给在它面前表现好的对象送礼。惩戒淘气的方式并非动武，而是发出失望又吓人的低吼。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME descends from snowy regions once a year to give out gifts to those who behave well in its presence. Naughty behavior is punished not with aggression, but with a disappointed and menacing growl.

entry: POKENAME会用冰冷吐息冻住洞边物品，再送给附近宝可梦。礼物常很奇怪，却总是冰凉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME freezes objects near its den with icy breath, then offers them to nearby Pokémon. The gifts are often strange, but always cold.

entry: 它摇动角，松脂的宜人香气便弥漫开来。闻到这香味，同伴与敌人都能平静下来。
author: .izik
source: When it shakes its horns, a pleasant scent of pine sap fills the air. This fragrant aroma calms both allies and opponents alike.

entry: 它的身体由多年被丢弃的数百件玩具、礼物和其他物质构成。它会试着擦净身上某件东西的污垢，送给需要振作的对象。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its body is composed of the hundreds of toys and gifts that have been thrown away over the years, along with other substances. It will try to clean off the grime of one of the objects in its body and present it to someone who needs cheering up.

entry: 人称“生日鸟”的它，爱送出彩纸礼物，给人类和宝可梦带来惊喜。见到派对，还总想偷偷拿一块蛋糕。
author: rockageddon
source: Commonly known as the Birthday Bird, this Pokémon loves to surprise people and Pokémon with confetti presents. If it spots a party, it will always try to sneak away with a piece of cake.

entry: 传闻，POKENAME会掰下身上的黑石，送给调皮的孩子。究竟想借此告诉他们什么，却没人明白。
author: iaobug
source: Urban legend says POKENAME will break off the black stones on its body and gift them to naughty children. The message this conveys to them is unclear.

entry: POKENAME有时会陪信使鸟参加送礼等节日活动。可惜似乎总没完全弄懂，有时反而不小心把礼物拿走。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME sometimes accompany Delibird in holiday activities such as gift-giving. Unfortunately POKENAME never seem to fully understand how it works, and sometimes accidentally takes gifts away instead.

entry: POKENAME冬天很常见，似乎格外亲近冬至。它喜欢成为焦点，会把礼物囤在身边，直到天亮才肯让它们离开视线。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are commonly found in the wintertime and appear to have a special affinity for the winter solstice. They enjoy being the centre of attention and will hoard gifts, only letting them out of their sight once the morning breaks.

entry: POKENAME十分珍爱自己的礼物，若被损坏或偷走，就会陷入绝望。不过给悲伤的它一件新礼物，又会像从前一样亲昵地对待你。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves its present dearly and will fall into despair if it is damaged or stolen. If you give a grieving POKENAME a new present, however, it will treat you with the same affection as before.

entry: POKENAME把礼物包戴在头顶，像一圈鬃毛。虽然模样粗犷，某些节庆里，孩子仍爱跟它玩。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wear their bundle of presents like a mane atop their head. Even with their rugged appearance, children love to play with POKENAME during certain holiday festivals.

entry: POKENAME送礼时爱唱节庆颂歌，洋溢着对往昔的怀念与喜悦。它一来，许多人和宝可梦都会跟唱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to sing festival carols while they deliver gifts. Many people and Pokémon sing along whenever they are around, as these carols are full of nostalgic joy from the past.

entry: POKENAME的颂歌唱出往日的怀旧喜悦，提醒人们节庆时友善相待。连士兵也曾跟着唱，它还促成过许多停火。
author: quackquackattack
source: The nostalgic joy of the past comes through the hymns that POKENAME sing, reminding people to be kind to one another during the holidays. Even soldiers have been known to sing along, as POKENAME have facilitated many ceasefires.

entry: POKENAME冬季很少露面，会唱各种充满节庆喜悦的曲子，偶尔也会唱忧伤思念的歌。若有人试图捕捉，它可能变换外貌，逃之夭夭。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME rarely appears during winter season, singing all sorts of tunes that bring to mind holiday cheer and festivity. Rarely, it may sing more melancholic and longing tunes. If one tries to catch it, it may shift in appearance and flee.

entry: POKENAME偶尔会在年末出现在世界各地偏僻处，带来树果和小礼物。它似乎能从别人的快乐中获得能量。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME rarely appears in secluded places around the world during the late parts of the year, bringing Berries and other small gifts. It seems to draw energy from the happiness of others.

entry: 雪季最常见它与其他宝可梦一起跳舞，用动作表演古老民间戏剧。领导力与魅力惊人，连敌对宝可梦也能轻松说服，合力为大家带来欢乐。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is most often spotted during snowy seasons, performing dances and miming ancient folk plays with other Pokémon. Endowed with incredible leadership and charisma, it can easily convince even rival Pokémon to work together to spread cheer to others.

entry: POKENAME脚步轻盈，能一边跳舞一边送礼。流畅动作让许多孩子受到启发，把舞蹈当作爱好。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are light on their feet and can dance while giving out presents. Their fluid movements inspire many children to pick up dancing as a hobby.

entry: 野外只有寥寥数人见过POKENAME，因此多数人只当它是神话。不过，节日装饰里仍常出现它的形象。
author: ludacriswell
source: As POKENAME has only ever been seen in the wild by a handful of people, it is largely dismissed as a myth. Nonetheless, it is often featured in holiday decorations.

entry: POKENAME背上的雪景球里装着数千有毒孢子。球一破，放出的孢子就可能引起冻伤和呼吸急促。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: The snow globe on POKENAME's back contains thousands of poisonous spores. If it breaks, the released spores can cause frostbite and shortness of breath.

entry: POKENAME会开心地摇摆行走，分享收集来的好东西。刺有时会扎破袋子，因此经常得修补或更换。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME happily waddles across the land, sharing goodies it has gathered with others. Its quills sometimes perforate its bag, so it regularly has to repair or replace it.

entry: 卡洛斯最寒冷地区的小村很崇敬POKENAME。它用拐杖糖法杖维持取暖火焰不熄，也从袋里取出必需食物。其他地区如今也会请它搜救。
author: ghostslythe
source: In the coldest reaches of Kalos, POKENAME is revered by small villages. Using a candy cane wand, it ensures heating fires stay lit, while pulling necessary food from its bag. Other regions have taken to using this Pokémon for Search and Rescue.

entry: 水泼到POKENAME壳上，就会产生热蒸汽。寒冷地区会把它用于传统桑拿。
author: mepp.
source: When water is splashed on POKENAME's shell, hot steam is produced. In cold regions, it is used in traditional saunas.

entry: POKENAME圆圆的冰冷身体里装着棉花状物质，移动时像雪景球一样旋转。摇晃身体，还会向空气散出淡淡南瓜香。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's round, icy body is filled with a cotton-like material that swirls inside like a snow globe when it moves. When it shakes itself, it releases a subtle pumpkin scent into the air.

entry: POKENAME身上到处闪着灯光，远远就能认出，夜里尤其明显。冬季大群聚集时，翅膀落下的白粉会像下雪一样。
author: santon5512
source: The blinking lights across POKENAME's bodies make them easy to spot from afar, especially at night. When large groups gather in the winter, the white powder shed from their wings can give the appearance of snowfall.

entry: POKENAME会在节日期间穿过住家，寻找点心。据说事先为它摆好零食，就会留下一份礼物。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME goes through houses during the holidays searching for treats. It's said that if you leave treats out for POKENAME, it leaves a present.

entry: 寒潮中，常能见到POKENAME贴着住家的门窗。哪里能感觉到室内漏出的暖意，它就拼命攀住哪里。
author: jaminmcready
source: During cold snaps, POKENAME are often found pressed against doors and windows of homes. They desperately cling to any surface where they can feel warmth escaping from inside.

entry: POKENAME爱做花环，乐意分给人和宝可梦。头上的花环能看出手艺高低，因为图案最复杂的总留给自己。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME loves making wreaths and happily shares whatever it makes with other people and Pokémon. The wreath on its head can reveal how skilled a particular POKENAME is, as it always keeps the most intricate patterns for itself.

entry: POKENAME给世界各地孩子送很多礼物，却常被需要记住的庞大数量压得不知所措。每次出错，压力增大，就会头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME give out many presents to children around the world, but they are often overwhelmed by the sheer number of presents they need to keep track of. Whenever they make a mistake, the added stress leads them to get a headache.

entry: POKENAME会为喜欢的人收集礼物，装进随身带的袋子。冬至时，就奔过大地，放在自己在乎的对象家门前。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME gather gifts for people they like into a sack that they carry with them everywhere. On the winter solstice, they race across the land to drop off their gifts at the front doors of those they care about.

entry: POKENAME会飞上天空，寻找需要暖毛衣、围巾和连指手套的孩子。个头大，可能吓着人，便会请小火龙帮忙送暖衣。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME soar through the sky searching for children who need warm sweaters, scarves, and mittens. Their large size can be frightening to some children, so they employ the help of Charmander to help them give out the warm clothing.

entry: POKENAME在冷河里游泳，沿岸觅食。多余食物收进袋中，与其他同类分享。
author: oejoeboy33
source: POKENAME swims in cold rivers in search of food along the shore. It stores extra in its bag to share with other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME腹部灯状斑纹会在情绪高涨时发亮。羽毛和皮肤分泌的油液摸起来冷，却能帮助离水后保持湿润。
author: chibitales
source: The light-like markings on POKENAME's stomach light up when they experience heightened emotions. The oily fluid secreted by their feathers and skin makes them cold to the touch, but helps to keep them moisturized outside of the water.

entry: POKENAME虽然爱送礼，却不懂送礼文化的细节。它不会好好递给喜欢的对象，而是用尽全力，把礼物砸向收礼者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Though POKENAME enjoy giving gifts to others, they have a poor grasp of the nuances of gift-giving culture. Rather than hand presents to those they like, they hurl their gifts with all their strength at the recipient.

entry: POKENAME会往返各地区送礼，让节日充满欢乐。四条手臂和更发达的肌肉，让它能背起足够装下半个地区礼物的袋子。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME help make the holidays a time of joy by delivering presents from region to region. Thanks to their four arms and increased muscle mass, POKENAME can carry bags filled with half a region's worth of gifts.

entry: POKENAME住在冷气候中，用胡椒薄荷香引诱猎物。只要能在战斗中打败它，叶子便可泡成清爽的节庆茶。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME lives in colder climates, luring prey Pokémon in with the scent of peppermint. Its leaves make for a refreshing holiday tea if one can manage to defeat it in battle.

entry: POKENAME体内塞着各种礼物与好东西。它不断寻找新礼物，因为太过慷慨，就会送到失去形状。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's body is stuffed with a variety of gifts and goodies. It constantly searches for new gifts, as too much generosity will make it lose its shape.

entry: 它速度飞快，很适合在遥远山镇之间递送橙色邮件。不过鬃毛散出的热，有时会把信烤焦。
author: jaminmcready
source: Its blazing speed makes it a favorite for carrying Orange Mail between distant mountain towns. The heat radiating from its mane sometimes singes the letters it delivers.

entry: 据说暴风雪里，POKENAME快得能隐形。驯养个体会奔过冰冻荒原，运送各种货物；野生个体则被视为即将丰收的兆头。
author: bobosmith01
source: During a blizzard, POKENAME moves so fast it is said to become invisible. Domesticated ones will gallop across frozen wastelands to deliver all sorts of goods, and wild ones are said to be a sign of a bountiful upcoming harvest.

entry: POKENAME会在海滩寻找贝壳、珍珠和有趣小物，送给孩子。它还会游到偏远岛屿，确保最遥远的地方也有节日欢乐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME search for seashells, pearls, and other fun trinkets on the beach to give out to children. They can be found swimming to remote islands to ensure festive cheer reaches even the most remote places.

entry: POKENAME能分成三块，沿街滚动寻找掉落零钱，再收集起来，留在自己认为需要帮助的对象门前。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME can separate itself into three pieces that roll through the streets searching for lost change. It then gathers the coins and leaves them on the doorsteps of those it believes are in need.

entry: POKENAME会找一根足够结实的茎秆，挑起大包食物，再四处旅行，与训练家和宝可梦分享、交换。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME seeks out a stalk sturdy enough to hold its large bundle of food. It travels across the land sharing or trading its food with Trainers and Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME有时会换轻棍，走得更快。食物虽然装得少，慷慨却不打折，仍愿意无偿分给训练家和宝可梦。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Sometimes POKENAME opts to carry a light stick for quicker travel. Even though it packs a light bundle of food, it is still no less generous with what it has and offers food freely to Trainers and Pokémon alike.

entry: 人们最常在节庆遇见POKENAME，它嘴里叼着礼物，送给参加者。一颗头爱送食物和钱，另一颗却偏爱送煤与其他石头。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are most commonly encountered by people during festive celebrations, showing up with gifts in their beaks to give to celebrants. One head loves to give food and money, the other has a tendency to give coal and other stones.

entry: POKENAME的礼物坚固得出奇，连大锤重击也能相当轻松地承受。它讨厌别人想拆礼物，因此节日期间总试着躲起来。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's present is surprisingly durable, able to withstand blows from a sledgehammer with relative ease. It dislikes people trying to unwrap its present, so it tries to hide away during the holidays.

entry: POKENAME袋里装满找到的闪亮小物，想拿来分享。深海潜水者盼着遇见它，因为可能收到价值不菲的礼物。
author: sk372
source: Its bag is filled with shiny trinkets it finds and wishes to share. Deep-sea divers hope to run across POKENAME during their dives, as it could potentially gift something very profitable.

entry: 冬天，POKENAME会四处旅行，悄悄接近人，让对方进入恍惚状态。它其实怀着好意，因为受影响者在剩下的季节里，会越来越无私。
author: sk372
source: During winter, POKENAME travels the lands, sneaking up on people to put them into a trance. It has good intentions behind the act, as those under its sway act increasingly altruistic throughout the remainder of the season.

entry: POKENAME性情合群，踏着海床悠闲漫步，还让小型水属性宝可梦躲进头上的突起中。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is a sociable Pokémon that stomps leisurely across the seabed, sheltering small Water Pokémon in its head outgrowths.

entry: POKENAME性情合群，踏着海床悠闲漫步，还让小型水属性宝可梦躲进头上的突起中。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is a sociable Pokémon that stomps leisurely across the seabed, sheltering small Water Pokémon in its head outgrowths.

entry: POKENAME带着鱼类宝可梦的骨架，挥动起来像摇铃。许多宝可梦误以为是有毒捕食者的声响，纷纷躲避，因此它常孤独生活。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME carry fish Pokémon skeletons to flail around like a rattle. Many Pokémon mistake this sound for a venomous predator, so POKENAME often live lonely lives because Pokémon avoid them.

entry: POKENAME的冲浪风格特别酷，能精准控制腿部肌肉操纵冲浪板，最颠簸的浪也能灵巧穿过。
author: foolish_weasel
source: This Pokémon's surfing style looks awfully groovy. POKENAME has precise control in its leg muscles to direct its board, deftly navigating even the choppiest of waves.

entry: POKENAME跃出水面时会吐泡，尽量延长滞空。若落在硬地上，泡泡也能缓冲。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits bubbles while jumping out of water, using them to stay airborne as long as possible. The bubbles also help cushion its landings should it land on a hard surface.

entry: POKENAME极其保护后代，让幼崽攀住鳍搭便车。它甚至会高高跃出水面，用角攻击，守护巢与家人，连空中捕食者也能抵御。
author: knilk
source: POKENAME is extremely protective of its spawn, allowing them to cling to its fins for a ride. It's been known to leap high out of the water to attack with its horn, defending its nest and family even from flying predators.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME会用尾巴紧攀珊瑚睡觉。海洋研究者常将它放在礁旁，因为能天然过滤水中毒素和沉积物。
author: jaminmcready
source: At night, POKENAME sleeps by clinging tightly to coral using its tail. Marine researchers often deploy POKENAME near reefs as POKENAME can naturally filter toxins and sediments from the water.

entry: POKENAME多见于热带珊瑚礁附近，对太阳珊瑚有强烈保护本能，会抵御游来的任何威胁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is most often found in tropical waters near coral reefs. It feels a strong protective instinct towards Corsola species, defending them from any threats that swim by.

entry: 过去，北方人曾骑着POKENAME穿过冰海，前往远方。如今更多成了一种复古游览方式，载游客穿过秀丽水道。
author: wiz0z
source: Once used by northern people to travel the frigid seas, POKENAME carried people on their backs to distant lands. Nowadays, they are used as a quaint form of travel, carrying tourists through scenic waterways.

entry: 偶尔会有小生物住到POKENAME背上。它很快就会亲近、保护对方，守护时展现出多数乘龙融合体少见的凶猛。
author: sk372
source: Occasionally, small creatures will make POKENAME's back their home. POKENAME quickly grows protective and attached to them, and defends them with a ferocity not often seen in most Lapras fusions.

entry: POKENAME不爱与其他宝可梦共享猎场。它把鳍和爪状腿插进沙里，掀起波纹，暴露或震出藏着的捕食者，再用岩崩击退。
author: kungfucutbug
source: POKENAME does not like sharing its hunting grounds with other Pokémon. It digs its fins and its claw-like legs into the sand, causing ripples to reveal or eject any hidden predators, then fends them off with Rock Slide.

entry: POKENAME平时在天际翱翔，累了偶尔落在海滩或船上。捕猎时，会快速绕圈游泳、拍翅，制造大得足以卷入猎物的漩涡。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME typically soar across the skies, occasionally landing on beach shores or boats when they are tired. While hunting, POKENAME will rapidly swim in circles, flapping their wings. This creates whirlpools large enough to drag in prey.

entry: POKENAME能快速游水，也能用大翼飞上高空。小型宝可梦常附在身上或搭背便车，它也毫不在意。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can swim quick through water or soar high in the sky with their large wings. They are unfazed by smaller Pokémon that attach to them or that simply ride atop them, which is a common occurrence and sight.

entry: POKENAME借翅膀轻松游过水下，留意附近威胁。人们会采集毒液，制成强效解毒剂，每年挽救无数生命。
author: fiordaliso
source: With its wings, POKENAME can swim effortlessly underwater, keeping watch for nearby threats. Its venom is harvested to create potent antidotes that protect countless lives annually.

entry: POKENAME在浅海游动，静静观察沿海城市和人造建筑。每年一两次，会前往城市近看，有时还带其他水属性宝可梦一起考察。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME swim in shallow ocean waters, quietly observing coastal cities and human constructs. Once or twice a year, POKENAME will travel to these coastal cities to get a closer look, sometimes taking other Water-Pokémon with them on this expedition.

entry: POKENAME很温顺，用浅水底散落的石头筑巢。若别的宝可梦威胁领地，它就另找地方安家。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are docile creatures that make nests made of scattered stones at the bottom of shallow waters. If another Pokémon threatens their territory, they simply find another place to make their home.

entry: POKENAME的触角分泌浓稠甜黏液，吸引铁炮鱼。它们会守在巢旁，保护它免遭捕食，让它安睡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's antennae release a thick, sweet mucus that attracts Remoraid. These Remoraid stay near its nest, protecting it from predators while it slumbers peacefully.

entry: POKENAME虽然游泳很好，却已学会不在水里动用电气能力。
author: huh.7
source: While POKENAME is a very good swimmer, it's learned to not use its electric abilities while in the water.

entry: POKENAME天生有领导力，乐意照顾其他宝可梦。傍晚用发光尾巴引导附近同伴，白天则常在水边出现。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has natural leadership qualities and has no problem taking other Pokémon under its wing. During the evening, it guides those nearby with a glowing tail; during the day, it is often found by the water.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在多彩珊瑚礁安家，给附近宝可梦跳舞，似乎并非为了自己获益。连急流中也优雅自如，让人想起神话中的水中仙女。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME prefer to make their home in colorful coral reefs and dance for other Pokémon in the area, seemingly for no benefit of their own self. Their grace even during turbulent waters has caused humans to compare them to mythical water nymphs.

entry: POKENAME不愿战斗，宁可坐着挨打，也不大愿意出手。它们十分喜欢宝物。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME are reluctant to engage in battle and much more likely to sit and endure hits rather than dish them out. They have a fondness for treasure.

entry: POKENAME性情温雅，对宝可梦对战嗤之以鼻，倒更愿意在待客、娱乐等方面施展才华。
author: rooboid
