source: POKENAME possess a very genteel nature. They scoff at Pokémon battles and showcase their talents elsewhere, such as in hospitality and entertainment.

entry: POKENAME会结成上百只的大群游动，头顶藻类高速旋转，还能让它们掠过海面，滑翔前进。
author: ayner
source: POKENAME swim as schools of hundreds. They use the algae growing on their head to glide over the sea by rotating them at high speed.

entry: POKENAME会在水中折起鳃，让身体呈流线形，轻松破水。它会边游边和其他水属性宝可梦玩，比赛速度和吹泡泡。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's gills fold in the water, making them more streamlined and able to cut through it efficiently. They play with other Water Pokémon as they swim, having races and bubble-blowing competitions.

entry: POKENAME会用背上的水容器，带水生宝可梦朋友上岸。它极护乘客，会挥出水构成的藤蔓，保护它们。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the water container on its back to take its aquatic Pokémon friends onto land. It is fiercely protective of its passengers, whipping vines made of water in their defense.

entry: POKENAME背上储着水，里面长着多种水生植物。渔民常随身带着它，让渔获在背上活着。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME hold water in their backs, growing various aquatic plant life inside. Fisherman often keep these Pokémon with them, letting them keep their catches alive in their backs.

entry: POKENAME温和友好，尾巴上的头却更紧张警惕。它常刚亲昵地蹭上新朋友，尾巴就凶巴巴地朝对方喷水。
author: sk372
source: While POKENAME is quite gentle and amiable, the head on its tail is a bit more twitchy and wary. It's not uncommon for POKENAME to nuzzle against a new friend, only for its tail to aggressively spit water at them.

entry: POKENAME看似粗野逞强，其实很不愿动手。但若答应事后替它揉揉肚子，它就会全力以赴。
author: rooboid
source: Despite their brutish bravado, POKENAME are rather loath to do battle. However, they will try their best if belly rubs are promised afterwards.

entry: POKENAME看似粗野逞强，其实很不愿动手。但若答应事后替它揉揉肚子，它就会全力以赴。
author: rooboid
source: Despite their brutish bravado, POKENAME are rather loath to do battle. However, they will try their best if belly rubs are promised afterwards.

entry: POKENAME看见巨牙鲨等威胁时，会在水面弹跳，吸气让自己显得更大，借此吓退可能的袭击者。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME sees a threat, like Sharpedo, it bounces on the water's surface, inhaling air to make itself appear bigger. This defense mechanism helps intimidate potential attackers.

entry: POKENAME能转动三条尾巴，在水中快速推进。肢体上的爪子既能轻易抓稳多数猎物，也能帮助在冰面行走。
author: infinex21
source: By spinning their three tails, POKENAME can quickly propel themselves through water. The claws of their limbs can easily hold onto most prey and allow them to walk along sheets of ice.

entry: POKENAME睡在珊瑚礁里，待腻了就滑过水面，去下一片礁。注意力难以持久，很难长留一处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps in coral reefs until it gets bored, gliding across the surface of the water to the next one. Its low attention span makes it difficult for it to stay in one place for long.

entry: POKENAME跃出海面的高度，最高能达巨翅飞鱼的两倍，还能借风延长滞空。宽翼也让较大的宝可梦能游在身旁，寻求庇护。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME can jump up to twice as high above the ocean as Mantine, riding the winds to stay aloft for longer. Its wings allow larger Pokémon to swim alongside it for protection.

entry: POKENAME巨大的耳朵能帮助起飞、滑翔，不过只能先从高处跃下才行。
author: camtft
source: The giant ears of POKENAME allow them to take flight and glide through the air. Though they can only do so after leaping off from a high point.

entry: POKENAME的长耳充当鳍，让它轻松随洋流前进。它会用獠牙掘开海底，寻找食物和宝物，带回洞中。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its long ears function as fins, allowing it to ride ocean currents with ease. Using its tusks, POKENAME digs into the seafloor in search of food or treasures to carry back to its den.

entry: 小小的POKENAME好奇心旺盛，一半时间在水中，一半在陆地。它吃水草，吃饱后有时会吹泡泡。
author: rooboid
source: The small, curious POKENAME lives half of its life in water and half on land. It feeds on aquatic vegetation and may blow bubbles when it's well-fed.

entry: POKENAME体内住着各种小型水生宝可梦。长大后，它便会学着借体内住客的力量维生。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME's body is home to an assortment of small, aquatic Pokémon. When it grows in size, it will learn to feed off the power of its inhabitants.

entry: POKENAME靠体内水生生态提供动力，以骇人速度破浪前行。双翼如刀，攻击凶狠毫不留情。
author: rooboid
source: Powered by an aquatic ecosystem within its body, POKENAME tears through the waves at a wicked pace. Its wings cut like blades; remorseless and fierce.

entry: 许多船只报告，POKENAME到来前，天空会横跨一道彩虹。它领地意识极强，曾有报告称，会召来直径最大300英尺的漩涡，击沉闯入的船。
author: .izik
source: Many seafaring vessels report a rainbow spanning the sky before POKENAME's arrival. It is extremely territorial, and whirlpools of up to 300 feet in diameter have been reported to be summoned by it to sink ships that enter its domain.

entry: 它是海边的宝可梦，尾巴随风飘舞。有些历史学家认为，尾巴乘风高扬的模样，启发了最初的风筝设计。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is a seaside Pokémon whose tail flutters in the breeze. Some historians suggest that the image of its tail gliding high in the sky with the wind inspired the designs of the first kites.

entry: 传说POKENAME诞生于海上遇难水手的怨恨。模样虽然优雅，尖叫声却大得足以震聋听者。
author: mepp.
source: According to legend, POKENAME were created from the grudges of sailors who perished at sea. Despite their elegant appearance, their piercing cries are loud enough to deafen those who hear them.

entry: POKENAME经常想抢掠船只与游轮，却总不成功。因为没手，实在偷不了多少。乘客常觉得这些举动有趣，被偷过后还会喂它。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME regularly try and fail to plunder boats and cruise ships, struggling to steal much due to their lack of hands. Passengers on these ships often find the antics amusing, feeding POKENAME after it attempts a theft.

entry: POKENAME把蝠鲼形尾巴当冲浪板，娴熟地驾驭汹涌海浪。它能吸收闪电力量，做出更大胆的特技，许多海洋生物聚来围观，十分钦佩。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its manta-shaped tail like a surfboard, riding turbulent waves with expert skill. It can absorb the power of lightning and channel it into even bolder stunts, earning the admiration of many sea creatures that gather to watch.

entry: POKENAME有小卡比兽的胃口，不会像巨翅飞鱼那样留残羹给铁炮鱼。想吃它剩饭的铁炮鱼，通常反而也成了那一餐。
author: hophoppip
source: Possessing Munchlax's appetite, POKENAME does not leave food scraps for Remoraid to eat like Mantine does. Remoraid who try to consume POKENAME's scraps usually become part of the meal instead.

entry: POKENAME喜欢伴着游艇跃出水面，享受浪花和关注。常能见到它在有船的近岸水域玩耍。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME happily jumps out of the water alongside yachts, enjoying the spray and the attention it garners. It is often seen playing near the coastline in the presence of boats.

entry: POKENAME扇动翼状鳍游泳，双臂形似铁炮鱼头，能射出高压沸水击落猎物，也能向后喷，增加推力。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME flaps its wing-like fins to swim through the water. Its arms resemble the heads of Remoraid, and can fire out high-pressure jets of boiling water to shoot down prey, or fire these behind it for extra propulsion.

entry: POKENAME把蝠鲼形尾巴当冲浪板，娴熟地驾驭汹涌海浪。它能吸收闪电力量，做出更大胆的特技，许多海洋生物聚来围观，十分钦佩。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its manta-shaped tail like a surfboard, riding turbulent waves with expert skill. It can absorb the power of lightning and channel it into even bolder stunts, earning the admiration of many sea creatures that gather to watch.

entry: POKENAME会潜够时间，抓取水生宝可梦，尤其偏爱铁炮鱼。有时会用它们帮忙战斗，随后又抛到一旁。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME dive long enough to snatch up aquatic Pokémon, though they favor Remoraid the most. Sometimes these Remoraid will be used to aid them in battle and then be cast aside.

entry: POKENAME的长耳能提供有限的滑翔能力，只有浅海才能获得足够速度。最远飞行记录超过100英尺。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its long ears give it limited gliding ability. The only place where it can gain enough speed to adequately glide is shallow ocean waters. The longest POKENAME flight was over 100 feet.

entry: POKENAME看似冲浪板的部分，其实也是身体。免疫系统出色，即使栖息环境骤变，也能熬过其他宝可梦难以承受的疾病。
author: bobosmith01
source: What appears to be a surfboard is actually part of a POKENAME's body. They have excellent immune systems and can survive through other kinds of illnesses other Pokémon can not, even if their habitat were to suddenly change.

entry: 阿罗拉近海常能见到POKENAME，和同类、巨翅飞鱼一起冲浪游玩。水上花样最多的那只，便是小队的头领。
author: teatedtiten
source: Commonly found off the Alolan coast, POKENAME surf with other POKENAME and Mantine for sport. The one who performs the most tricks on the waters is deemed the leader of their squadron.

entry: POKENAME改变尾上叶片的姿态，就能调节游速。它们对过路训练家很友善，常主动帮忙，载人渡海。
author: teatedtiten
source: By changing the leaves on their tails, POKENAME adjust their speed when swimming. POKENAME are very friendly to passing Trainers, frequently offering them help across the seas.

entry: POKENAME缓缓漂过海洋，偶尔停下挖沙里的蛋。个头大，铁炮鼠常攀在它背上寻求保护，吃些剩下的食物。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME slowly drift through oceans, only sometimes stopping to dig up eggs in the sand. Due to their size, Remoshrew tend to cling onto their backs for protection; eating any leftovers from their meals.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在雨后跳水洼。每只背鳍上的花纹都独一无二。
author: weirdtux
source: POKENAME love to jump in puddles after a rainy day. Each one sports a unique dorsal fin pattern.

entry: POKENAME部分身体像水般流动，甚至能供小型水生生物生活。有些保护区会请它照顾铁炮鱼等宝可梦，直到能重新放归野外。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: Part of POKENAME's body flows like water and can even sustain small aquatic life. Some wildlife reserves have POKENAME take care of Pokémon like Remoraid before they're ready for rehabilitation back into the wild.

entry: POKENAME被视为海中堡垒，庞大身体能庇护小型宝可梦。它随洋流滑行，保护迁徙者免遭捕食，也清除碎屑。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Considered bastions of the ocean, POKENAME use their large bodies to shelter smaller Pokémon. They glide along currents to travel, protecting migrating Pokémon from predators and clearing debris.

entry: POKENAME会滑过珊瑚礁，用精神力量清理垃圾与碎屑。睡觉时，体色会模仿周围珊瑚。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides across coral reefs, clearing trash and debris from the area with its psychic powers. While sleeping its body mimics the colors of the surrounding coral.

entry: 有人说，巨翅飞鱼与搭便车的铁炮鱼同时死去，就会诞生POKENAME。这个幽灵会引游泳者远离险水，曾救许多潜水者脱离厄运。
author: sk372
source: Some say a POKENAME is created when a Mantine and its Remoraid passenger pass away simultaneously. The ghostly spirit steers swimmers away from dangerous waters, and has saved many divers from ill fates.

entry: POKENAME虽能在陆地走，一生大多仍待在水中。它会钻进沙质海底躲避捕食者，也让铁炮鱼等小型宝可梦藏在身下。
author: bobosmith01
source: Despite having the ability to walk on land, POKENAME usually stay in the water for most of their lives. They burrow under the sandy seafloor to hide from potential predators, and even allow smaller Pokémon such as Remoraid to hide underneath them.

entry: POKENAME背鳍露出水面时，远看常被误认成巨牙鲨。不过它很友好，会好奇地游近船只。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is not uncommon for POKENAME's dorsal fin to be confused with Sharpedo's from a distance when it breaks over the water's surface. Despite that, POKENAME is friendly and will curiously swim up to nearby ships.

entry: POKENAME水陆都能生存，最爱在浅水休息。小鱼常躲进背上，以那里生长的植物为食。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME can survive both on land and in the water, preferring to relax in shallow waters. Smaller fish will often take refuge in their backs, feeding off of the plants that grow there.

entry: POKENAME的身体大多由软骨与软组织构成，硬骨很少。漫长的历史中，它的化石一直被错认成拉普拉斯。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME's body consists mostly of cartilage and soft tissue, with few bones. For most of history, its fossils were mistakenly attributed to Lapras.

entry: POKENAME不爱游泳，更喜欢脸朝下浮在水面，把背上披风当帆兜风。发现下方有食物，就会迅速伸下去抓取。
author: .jerden
source: Rather than swimming, POKENAME prefer to float face down in the water and use the cape on their back to catch the wind like a sail. If POKENAME spot food in the water below, they will quickly reach down to grab it.

entry: 深夜，POKENAME无声漂过港镇，寻找独处的人。它会用巨力抓住，拖到附近水下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts silently through port towns late at night in search of people who are alone. It seizes them with great force before dragging them beneath the surface of the nearby water.

entry: 岛屿国家曾尊POKENAME为海神。它会飞驰过海面，古籍声称，经过之处都会形成季风。
author: .izik
source: Island nations once revered POKENAME as a sea deity. It races across the ocean's surface, and ancient records claim monsoons form wherever it passes.

entry: POKENAME背上的水无论翻腾得多厉害，除非它主动引导，否则绝不溢出。许多海滩会雇成群个体，用背上水盆帮助拦截来袭海啸。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: No matter how furiously the water on a POKENAME's back rages, it will never spill out unless the POKENAME directs it to do so. Many beaches employ groups of POKENAME to help catch incoming tsunamis with their water basins.

entry: POKENAME不想在战斗中受伤，会用磁力派出三个“鱼鼻子”，代替自己迎战。
author: hophoppip
source: Preferring not to injure itself in battle, POKENAME sends its three Fishy-Noses to battle for it using magnetic forces.

entry: POKENAME在深海寻找猎物。找到后，会装得无害，慢慢接近，再亮出鳍下藏着的利刃，猛扑过去。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME swims deep in the ocean in search of prey. When it finds its targets, it innocently approaches them before unveiling the razor-sharp blade hidden underneath its fins and lunging at them.

entry: POKENAME能借电脉冲和电感受器，与多种电属性和海底宝可梦无声交流。满月时，大群会聚在平静浅水中。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME communicate silently with various electrical and undersea Pokémon through the use of electrical impulses and electroreceptors. Sweeping groups of them gather together in still and shallow waters under the full moon.

entry: POKENAME爱作恶，不过多数行为顶多只是惹人麻烦的恶作剧。不知为何，它莫名讨厌海绵和海星。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME delights in doing evil acts, though most of its actions are inconvenient pranks at worst. It possesses a strange aversion to sea sponges and starfish, for unknown reasons.

entry: 与巨翅飞鱼一系和班基拉斯的融合体一样，POKENAME的胃里栖居着大量水生宝可梦。这套生态能自给自足，也会分解它吃下的食物。
author: rooboid
source: Like Manitar, POKENAME's stomach is host to a plethora of aquatic Pokémon. This ecosystem sustains itself and breaks down the food that POKENAME eats.

entry: 与巨翅飞鱼一系和班基拉斯的融合体一样，POKENAME的胃里栖居着大量水生宝可梦。这套生态能自给自足，也会分解它吃下的食物。
author: rooboid
source: Like Manitar, POKENAME's stomach is host to a plethora of aquatic Pokémon. This ecosystem sustains itself and breaks down the food that POKENAME eats.

entry: POKENAME常从浪里跃上渔船，偷东西布置水下巢穴。水手若追来，它就从后鳍放出安抚气场，阻止对方。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME frequently leaps onto fishing vessels from the waves to steal items for its underwater nest. If pursued by sailors, it releases a calming aura from its rear fin to deter them.

entry: POKENAME每次跃出水面，都会掀起巨浪。游泳时，多种水生生物成群聚在庞大身体下，围着它形成微型生态。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME cause titanic waves each time they leap out of the water. Swarms of various aquatic life gather beneath these Pokémon's large bodies as they swim, forming mini ecosystems around them.

entry: POKENAME天空海洋都适应，更喜欢深海。它性情温柔，即使最强大凶猛的海底居民，靠近也会平静放松。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is at home both in the sky and the sea, but prefers the depths of the ocean. It is a gentle soul, and even the most powerful and vicious of underwater denizens act calm and complacent while near it.

entry: POKENAME小队会在浪上或浪下行进，后面跟着铁炮鱼群。铁炮鱼形的炮似乎骗过了其他铁炮鱼，让它们以为是同类，也加入火力压制。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: Squadrons of POKENAME will either travel above or below the waves with schools of Remoraid in tow. Their Remoraid-shaped blasters seem to fool other Remoraid into thinking the weapon is one of their own, so they'll join in with suppressive fire.

entry: 晴天尤其常能看见POKENAME群漫无目的地飘在空中。目击被视为好兆头，许多游客赶在飘远前拍照，却没人知道它们去哪里。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Schools of POKENAME can be seen floating aimlessly in the skies, especially on sunny days. It is considered a good omen to see a POKENAME, so many tourists take pictures of them before they float away, and no one knows where they go.

entry: POKENAME将黏液涂满身体，便能在海面滑行。即使搁浅，也能把自己弹回海里。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME covers itself in slime to be able to glide across the ocean surface. It is able to bounce itself back into the ocean if beached.

entry: POKENAME让成群铁炮鱼攀住自己的链条，载它们横渡海洋。可这样一来，也更容易成为大型猎手的目标。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME allows schools of Remoraid to cling to its chain as they transport them across the ocean. However, this makes them favored targets for larger predators.

entry: POKENAME柔韧的翅膀既能游泳，也能飞行，适应性很强。不过面对没赢得尊重的对象，性情反复又固执，因此很少被用来骑乘。
author: nyoomymph
source: Its flexible wings are used for both swimming and flying, making it a highly adaptable Pokémon. Despite this, POKENAME isn't often used as a ride Pokémon due to its fickle and stubborn behaviour when met with anyone who hasn't earned its respect.

entry: 据说把愿望写在POKENAME的一张纸条上，再放进海里，就能实现。故事称，纸条会像活物一样游走。
author: hophoppip
source: It is said that your wish will come true if you write it upon one of POKENAME's notes, then place that note in the ocean. Stories claim that the note will swim away as if alive.

entry: POKENAME在水面滚动，有时会奇怪地弹跳，与同伴玩耍。橘子群岛常能见到这种爱玩的模样。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rolls on the surface of the water, sometimes doing an odd bouncing motion to play with others in its pod. This playful behavior is a common sight among the Orange Islands.

entry: POKENAME漂过海洋，为愿意聆听的对象唱活泼的歌。旅人说听着很奇怪，水下听却十分悦耳。
author: sylviasnake
source: POKENAME float across the sea, singing bubbly songs to anyone who cares to listen. While reported to sound quite odd by travelers, the songs sound pleasant when heard from beneath the water.

entry: 可可多拉披着厚厚钢甲，POKENAME却由岩石构成。因此POKENAME潜入水下时，也不会生锈。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME's body is made of rock, unlike Aron, who boasts a thick coat of steel armor. Because of this, POKENAME doesn't rust when it dives underwater.

entry: 小型水生宝可梦住在POKENAME外壳的缝隙中。长久共生之后，它会利用这种关系，获得更强的力量。
author: rooboid
source: Small, aquatic Pokémon live within the cracks of POKENAME's shell. Eventually, it will capitalise on this symbiotic relationship to gain power.

entry: POKENAME像浮标一样漂在人气海滩附近，阻止游客靠近深水区，以婉转歌声和光滑皮肤闻名。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME float by popular beaches like buoys, warding tourists away from deep water. They're famous for their warbling singing voices and smooth skin.

entry: POKENAME像浮标一样漂在人气海滩附近，阻止游客靠近深水区，以婉转歌声和光滑皮肤闻名。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME float by popular beaches like buoys, warding tourists away from deep water. They're famous for their warbling singing voices and smooth skin.

entry: POKENAME流畅的身体能滑过海面，每隔数米才需扇翅一次。它会寻找跃出水面的海洋宝可梦，用大嘴在空中叼住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's sleek body glides over the ocean without needing to flap more than once per several meters. It seeks out ocean Pokémon breaching the water, snatching them out of the air with its large mouth.

entry: POKENAME被踩到就会喷高压水自卫，力道连最强大的来犯者也能击退。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits high-pressure water if stepped on, using it as a defense mechanism. The force of the water can knock back even the strongest foes that dare approach it.

entry: 这种宝可梦是凶猛猎手，常追逐荧光鱼群，填饱贪婪的胃口。必要时，能一跃离水，高得出人意料。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: This Pokémon is a vicious predator that often goes after schools of Finneon, hoping to secure prey to feed its ravenous appetite. If needed, it can leap clean out of the water with surprising height.

entry: 这种走路草融合宝可梦生活在海里。铁炮鱼喜欢躲进它的叶丛，避开天敌。
author: uncookie
source: This Oddish fusion can be found in the ocean. Species of Remoraid like to seek shelter from predators in its leaves.

entry: POKENAME模样吓人，其实善良温顺，会巡逻巨牙鲨出没的水域，保护人类。有时还会收养幼年利牙鱼，把它们养得同样平和。
author: sk372
source: Despite cutting a fearsome visage, POKENAME is very kind and docile, patrolling Sharpedo-infested waters to keep humans safe. It sometimes adopts young Carvanha and raises them to be equally even-tempered.

entry: POKENAME软骨柔韧，性格也很随和。常有两只铁炮鱼跟着，攀在鳍上，吃留下的残羹。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are flexible creatures, both in their cartilage and their temperament. They are often followed by a couple of Remoraid, who cling onto their fins and eat scraps that are left behind.

entry: POKENAME发现小个子的朋友遇险时，会将对方装进气泡，保护起来。
author: uncookie
source: When POKENAME sees a smaller friend in danger, it will shield them from harm by putting them in its bubble.

entry: POKENAME走过海里时，身上的黏液会沾住海带和食物碎屑，引来许多水生宝可梦围着吃。幸好它并不介意，还趁机交新朋友。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME walks through the sea, kelp and other food bits stick to the slime that covers its body. This leads to it being swarmed by many aquatic Pokémon feeding off it; luckily, it doesn't mind this, taking the opportunity to make new friends.

entry: POKENAME走过海里时，身上的黏液会沾住海带和食物碎屑，引来许多水生宝可梦围着吃。它却毫不介意，还趁机交新朋友。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME walks through the sea, kelp and other food scraps stick to the slime that covers its body. This leads to it being swarmed by many aquatic Pokémon feeding off it, but it doesn't mind at all, taking this opportunity to make new friends.

entry: POKENAME通常温和体贴，用气泡保护朋友。但必要时，也会用气泡困住或震晕敌人。
author: uncookie
source: POKENAME are usually passive and caring, using their bubbles to shield friends. However, if necessary, it will use its bubbles to trap or stun foes.

entry: 白天，POKENAME常在船旁游泳。傍晚会附在船底，吸走附近宝可梦的生命力，例如容易撞到船壳的沼王。
author: foolish_weasel
source: During the day, POKENAME can be seen swimming near boats. In the evening, POKENAME will attach itself to the underside of a vessel and drain the life force of any nearby Pokémon, such as Quagsire, who are prone to bumping into boat hulls.

entry: POKENAME用头上触角吸引猎物，再放出毒墨困住。墨汁迅速制服对方，方便捕捉吃掉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's antennae on its head attract prey, which it then ensnares with poisonous ink. The ink quickly subdues the prey, making it easy for POKENAME to catch and consume.

entry: POKENAME鳍里有强毒，不到五分钟就能让人昏迷。毒效迅速，让它成为领地里危险的猎手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fins contain potent venom that can cause someone to fall unconscious in under five minutes. This venom acts quickly, making POKENAME a dangerous predator in its domain.

entry: POKENAME会沿海中强流游泳，尽量加速。达到最快时，就跃上天空，做出惊人俯冲，制服敌人。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME attempts to build up as much speed as possible by swimming along a strong current in the ocean. When it has reached peak velocity it will spring out of the water into the air, performing an impressive dive bomb to subdue its foes.

entry: POKENAME脸上的孔会漏出多余水分。不少训练家误以为它在哭，结果被愤怒的它袭击。
author: hophoppip
source: Excess water leaks from the holes in POKENAME's face. A number of Trainers have been attacked by angry POKENAME after confusing this process for crying.

entry: POKENAME会停在海沟边缘，潜入深处，打猎物一个措手不及。捉到食物后，便展开鳍，浮回水面。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Perching at the edges of trenches, POKENAME dive into the depths to catch their prey off-guard. Once their meal is secured, POKENAME extend their fins and float back up towards the surface.

entry: POKENAME会在海洞家园周围制造漩涡，阻挡巨牙鲨等捕食者。夜里则在洞中铺开菌丝，庇护幼崽。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME creates whirlpools around its sea cave home to impede predators like Sharpedo. At night, it spreads mycelium throughout the cave to shelter its young.

entry: 暖天，POKENAME会站进深水，让头刚好露在浪上。此时，成群鱼类宝可梦会帮它清理褶边。
author: bandedbodypress
source: On warm days, POKENAME will stand in waters deep enough that its head barely remains above the waves. Schools of fish Pokémon clean its frills when it does this.

entry: POKENAME从浪间起跳时，会用精神力量推进得更远，因而跳得更高更远，游泳既灵活又难以捉到。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses psychic powers to propel itself further than normal when jumping from waves. This allows it to leap higher and longer, making it an agile and elusive swimmer.

entry: 它模样奇特，像顶着平坦菌盖的蘑菇，常见于沿岸沼泽，以腐烂植物为食。眼神空洞无神。
author: rooboid
source: Often spotted within coastline swamps, this unusual Pokémon resembles a flat-capped mushroom and feeds on rotten plants. Its gaze is soulless.

entry: POKENAME想当捕鱼好手，会沿岸仔细搜寻铁炮鱼。成功后，便骄傲地展示收获，连陌生人也要给看。
author: fishsticks_
source: POKENAME are aspiring fishers and will scour the shore for Remoraid to catch. After a successful hunt, POKENAME will proudly show off whatever they've caught, even to strangers.

entry: 捕鱼是POKENAME的本能，手边有什么材料都能做鱼竿。有人认为，远古人类是跟它学会捕鱼的，不过这种说法争议很大。
author: hophoppip
source: Fishing is an instinct for POKENAME, who can craft a fishing rod from any available materials. Some believe that POKENAME taught humans to fish in ancient times, though this theory is hotly debated.

entry: POKENAME白天会在码头钓铁炮鱼。如果水里没有巨牙鲨，就会把钓到的放回去。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME spend their days at docks and piers fishing for Remoraid. If the waters are clear of Sharpedo, POKENAME will release the Remoraid they catch.

entry: POKENAME成群住在珊瑚礁，白天藏好，躲避捕食者。夜里被星光吸引到海面，跃出水，贴浪滑行。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Swarms of POKENAME live together in coral reefs, hiding from predators during the day to keep themselves safe. At night, they are drawn to the surface by the light of the stars, breaching the water and skimming across the waves.

entry: POKENAME会紧贴海面上方长途滑翔。累了就落在岩石上，把睡莲叶朝向太阳，补充能量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides just above the ocean surface for long distances. When tired, it lands on rocks and aims its lily pad toward the sun to recharge.

entry: POKENAME无声滑过月夜天空，身后闪亮的尘迹让旁观者着迷。旅人沉迷光芒，常忘了时间，也远远偏离原定路线。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME glides silently through moonlit skies, leaving a trail of sparkling dust that mesmerises onlookers. Travellers entranced by this glow often lose track of time and wander far off their intended path.

entry: 传说POKENAME翅膀带着从夜空高处收集的真正星尘。飞过头顶时，留下的光迹据说能引人梦见遥远星系。
author: eiskitsune
source: Legends say POKENAME's wings carry real stardust, gathered from the upper reaches of the night sky. When it flies overhead, the trails it leaves behind are said to inspire dreams of distant galaxies.

entry: POKENAME成群住在珊瑚礁，白天藏好，躲避捕食者。夜里被星光吸引到海面，跃出水，贴浪滑行。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Swarms of POKENAME live together in coral reefs, hiding from predators during the day to keep themselves safe. At night, they are drawn to the surface by the light of the stars, breaching the water and skimming across the waves.

entry: POKENAME尽量待在地下、避开太阳，因为皮肤很容易干枯虚弱。雨天会成群聚集，仿佛一起在泥里冲浪取乐。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME tries to keep itself underground and away from the sun, as its skin dries out easily, causing it to weaken. Schools of POKENAME will congregate on rainy days and seemingly surf through the mud together for sport.

entry: 据说喝下POKENAME喷出的水能治愈心碎，实际却会引起轻微抽搐。它会用这种水阻挡捕食者，趁机游走。
author: .izik
source: It is said that the water POKENAME spits out can be drunk to cure heartbreak, but in reality, it causes mild seizures. It uses this water to deter predators while it swims away.

entry: 它“头部触角”上的嘴不断喷水，让钻行的地面尽量泥泞，方便相伴的铁炮鱼在泥水中游泳。
author: foolish_weasel
source: The mouths on its "head-antennae" constantly spout out water to make the ground it burrows through as muddy as possible. Doing this helps the Remoraid that accompany it to swim through the muddy water.

entry: POKENAME受长期头痛困扰，会游泳放松。剧烈偏头痛可能让它游得恍惚，有些甚至能用精神力量驱散风暴，好畅游无阻。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Plagued by chronic headaches, POKENAME will resort to swimming to help relax itself. Intense migraines can compel POKENAME to swim in a trance-like manner, with some POKENAME being able to psychically dissipate storms so that it can swim unimpeded.

entry: POKENAME会双脚交替跳动，平静摇摆，分散对手注意，再突然出击。沉着外表下藏着暴怒，只有挥拳时才会释放。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME hop back and forth from foot to foot, swaying serenely to distract their opponents and strike when least expected. Their calm demeanor hides a furious anger that they only unleash when they deliver a punch.

entry: 世界各地常能见到POKENAME协助救生员。陆上快，水中更快，能以最快速度找到遇险的人，带回安全处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is commonly seen aiding lifeguards around the world. Quick on land and even quicker in the water, it can locate and retrieve a person in danger with the greatest haste.

entry: POKENAME水陆都能极速移动。信任它的训练家可以骑上背，享受刺激体验。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME moves with incredible speed on land and in water. A trusting Trainer can ride on its back for an exhilarating experience.

entry: POKENAME会在急流里结群，强劲胸鳍能让它跃到海啸般的高度。尾尖是巨量能量的源头，热得足以让周围水冒泡、沸腾。
author: tamszen.ore
source: POKENAME form groups in fast-moving currents, packing enough strength in their pectoral fins to leap the height of a tsunami. The tip of its tail is the source of its extreme energy, generating enough heat to make the water around it bubble and boil.

entry: POKENAME内脏强韧灵活、耗能少，平时大多盘成螺旋。它能通过特殊孔口，暂时高速喷出肠道，清理肠道，或吓敌人一跳。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has powerful, flexible, and energy-efficient innards that generally rest in the shape of a spiral. It can temporarily eject its intestines from its body at high speeds through a specialized orifice to cleanse the organ or surprise foes.

entry: POKENAME陆地旅行时，会用念力在两角间悬着水泡。快干燥时，就能从泡里放出水流。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their telekinetic powers to suspend bubbles of water between their horns when travelling across land. They can use their bubble to produce streams of water whenever they're at risk of drying out.

entry: 它藏在海底岩石间，猎物可能误以为嘴里是安全藏身处。不过有时猎物太大，钻不进，反而卡住。
author: oddwalls
source: It hides among rocks on the sea floor, where prey might mistake its mouth for a safe hiding place. However, sometimes the potential prey is too large to fit and becomes stuck.

entry: 它藏在海底岩石间，猎物可能误以为嘴里是安全藏身处。不过有时猎物太大，钻不进，反而卡住。
author: oddwalls
source: It hides among rocks on the sea floor, where prey might mistake its mouth for a safe hiding place. However, sometimes the potential prey is too large to fit and becomes stuck.

entry: 整群铁炮鱼都能附在POKENAME的80条触手上生活。凡威胁共生朋友的宝可梦，都会被它缠住、碾压。
author: foolish_weasel
source: An entire school of Remoraid can live attached to POKENAME's 80 tentacles. POKENAME will crush and ensnare any Pokémon who pose a threat to its symbiotic friends.

entry: POKENAME聪明好学，常为了研究独自待着。得留心鼓励它出门社交，享受友谊的魔力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very intelligent and studious, often isolating itself in its studies. Care must be taken to encourage it to get out and socialize and enjoy the magic that is friendship.

entry: POKENAME游水时宛如奔腾，无论水流怎样都平稳迅捷。自卫时，会从嘴里喷出蒸汽滚滚的热水。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears to gallop through the water, swimming at a smooth and speedy rate no matter the current. It breathes steaming-hot water from its mouth when it needs to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME温和平静，游在暖海波间。铁炮鱼群会吃缠在它随水飘动的白色长尾上的海藻。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a gentle, peaceful creature that swims through the waves of warm seas. Groups of Remoraid feed on the seaweed that gets tangled in its long, flowing white tail.

entry: POKENAME主要由生活废水构成，不适合游进去。冲浪者虽然想乘它的浪，掉进去却常会病上好几天。
author: jaminmcready
source: Made mostly of greywater, POKENAME is not safe to swim in. Though surfers are tempted to ride its waves, those who fall in often end up sick for days.

entry: POKENAME主要由生活废水构成，不适合游进去。冲浪者虽然想乘它的浪，掉进去却常会病上好几天。
author: jaminmcready
source: Made mostly of greywater, POKENAME is not safe to swim in. Though surfers are tempted to ride its waves, those who fall in often end up sick for days.

entry: POKENAME能精妙指挥一队铁炮鱼和其他水属性宝可梦，仿佛是自己身体的延伸。双方互利，它会把食物均分给相伴的这些宝可梦。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME tactically commands a set of Remoraid and other Water-type Pokémon in battle with such expertise that it is as if they were extensions of its own body. It is a mutual arrangement: POKENAME shares its food equally among its welcome company.

entry: POKENAME会用壳困住想附上来的铁炮鱼。只有把它们像活鱼雷一样射向敌人时，才会放出来。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its shell to trap Remoraid that try to cling on to it. These Remoraid are only released once POKENAME fires them toward enemies like living torpedoes.

entry: 淡水水流将POKENAME的身体打磨得圆润光滑。夏日阳光下，它的身体闪闪发亮，吸引小型水生宝可梦前来安家。
author: rooboid
source: Rounded by the flow of freshwater currents, the body of POKENAME shines in the summer sun, attracting small aquatic Pokémon to make their homes there.

entry: POKENAME住在沉船里，仔细观察附近铁炮鱼，判断有没有捕食者。敏锐的观察力，让它能避开危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its home in shipwrecks, carefully watching nearby Remoraid to determine if the area is safe from predators. Its keen observation skills ensure it stays out of harm's way.

entry: POKENAME吃树根，会强化翅膀里的金属合金。金属羽毛曾被采集，用于制造零一号全地形车的原型。
author: .izik
source: The metal alloy in POKENAME's wings is strengthened as it consumes tree roots. Its metal feathers were harvested and used in constructing the prototype of the ZERO-ONE.

entry: POKENAME会捡盔甲鸟头骨防身，再找些脱落金属羽毛作武器。它会用羽刃刮头骨，发出尖啸，让捕食者晕头转向。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME scavenges up a Skarmory skull for defense and some shed metal feathers for offense. It scrapes its feather blade against the skull to make a screeching noise that disorients predators.

entry: 它靠拆毁废弃建筑锻炼拳头。两只POKENAME相互挑战时，金属碰撞声会一直持续，直到一方倒下。
author: mistershaokahn
source: It trains its fists by destroying abandoned buildings. When one POKENAME challenges another, their metallic strikes won't stop until one is down.

entry: 虽然蛋几乎无法打碎，它还是会拼命保护。虽长着翅膀，却不会飞。
author: krune
source: It protects its egg with its life, despite the fact that the egg is nearly unbreakable. Despite having wings, it cannot fly.

entry: 其他宝可梦遇险，POKENAME就会一头冲进去。看似鲁莽，其实似乎在教孩子无私关爱其他对象。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME launches headfirst into danger whenever other Pokémon are in trouble. Despite seeming reckless, it appears to be teaching its child to selflessly care for others.

entry: POKENAME游得出奇优雅，不论面朝哪边，都能朝任意方向前进。外壳也坚韧，因此很少被捕食者盯上。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can swim with surprising grace and travel in any direction regardless of which way it is facing. Since it also has a tough outer shell, it is not often targeted by predators.

entry: POKENAME钢铁背鳍像刀刃般划破水面，在河里疾游。快得在浪下看起来只剩一道模糊身影。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME cuts through rivers with a steel dorsal fin that breaches the surface like a blade. It swims fast enough to appear blurred beneath the waves.

entry: POKENAME像螺旋桨一样快速转动身体前进。此时靠近很危险，因为刀刃般的边缘，几乎能把沿途一切撕碎。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME moves by quickly rotating its body like a propeller. It's very dangerous to approach in this state, as its bladed edges are capable of shredding nearly anything in its path.

entry: POKENAME金属身体的许多部分都磨得极锋利，靠近十分危险。因此很难被亲昵地抚摸，显得有些孤单。
author: sk372
source: Much of POKENAME's metal body is sharpened to a fine edge, making it extremely hazardous to get near. This leaves it somewhat lonesome, as it makes it difficult for it to receive physical affection.

entry: POKENAME每天砍倒越来越大的树，磨利镰刀。虽然全身钢铁，地面和空中的动作却都十分敏捷。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME hones its sharp scythes by felling ever larger trees each day. Despite being made entirely of steel, it moves with remarkable agility both on the ground and in flight.

entry: POKENAME暴怒时，钢角会热得通红，飞过稀树草原时，尾巴疯狂甩动，靠高速飞行消磨怒气。
author: .izik
source: When enraged, POKENAME's steel horns glow red hot. Its tails thrash wildly as it soars over savannahs, burning off fury in high-speed flight.

entry: POKENAME游得太靠近停泊船只，金属鳍就会无意划坏船壳。沿海城市常组织捕捉比赛，减少它的数量。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME swims too close to anchored ships, it accidentally damages their hulls with its metal fins. Coastal cities often organize contests to catch and reduce their population.

entry: POKENAME翅膀太重，飞不起来，主要用来威吓。不过每根羽尖也带微毒，以防警告被无视。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wings are too heavy to let it fly, instead used primarily as threat displays. The tips of each feather also contain a mild amount of toxins, should its warning go unheeded.

entry: POKENAME暴走时会直线冲刺，用锋利钢翼切开沿途一切。有些城镇已在屋顶装上钢制利刺，试图阻止它袭击。
author: soup1900
source: When on a rampage, POKENAME rushes in straight lines to slice everything it comes by with its sharp steel wings. Some towns have implemented sharp spikes made of steel on roofs to dissuade POKENAME from attacking them.

entry: POKENAME的液态金属身体，能在转瞬间从柔软易塑变得坚硬锋利。
author: hophoppip
source: The liquid metal body of POKENAME's can shift from soft and malleable to hard and sharp in a fraction of a second.

entry: POKENAME会用金属装甲吸引闪电，控制电力。双翼用来提升奔跑和跳跃时的空气动力效率，并不用来飞行。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its metal plating to attract lightning and control its power. It uses its pair of wings to maximize aerodynamics while running or jumping, not for flight.

entry: POKENAME生气时，金属身体几秒就会热得通红。吃食物前，会从嘴里喷出火舌烤熟。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME gets angry, its metal body becomes red hot within seconds. This Pokémon roasts its food before eating it, blowing tongues of flame from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME会用金属喙啃穿垃圾邮件文件夹。清空后，就会离开，寻找下一个收件箱吞食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its metallic beak to gnaw through junk email folders. Once cleared, it departs in search of another inbox to consume.

entry: POKENAME身体纤细灵巧，能更快地游水、捉猎物。镰刀钩入猎物身体后，就拖上岸享用。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's slim, nimble body help them swim through waters and catch prey more quickly. They hook their scythes into their prey's bodies, dragging them onto land to feast upon them.

entry: POKENAME沉重的金属身体不利久飞，滑翔却出奇灵活。它会俯冲猛撞猎物，再用锋利翼缘切割。
author: sk372
source: Despite a heavy metal body making prolonged flight difficult, POKENAME is a surprisingly agile glider. It dives after prey and crashes into them forcefully,  before cutting at them with the sharp edges of its wings.

entry: POKENAME金属身体很重，降落时会猛烈砸向地面。刀刃尾巴能挥击，很适合切开想逃跑的猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's metal body gives it a heavy weight, crashing powerfully onto the ground when it descends. Its bladed tail lashes out and makes for a very effective tool at slicing prey that tries to evade it.

entry: POKENAME每次蜕皮，鳞片都会更硬更强，能抵御许多攻击。它会用钢盔猛撞威胁，自我保护。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's scales harden and grow stronger with each molt, making its hide resistant to many attacks. It defends itself by bashing threats with its steel helmet.

entry: POKENAME用改变天气的圆珠，将高空急流加速到惊人程度。它像导弹般冲过猛烈风暴，凭锋利钢翼轻松撕开强劲气流。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME triggers hyper-accelerated jet streams using its weather-altering orbs. It rockets through heavy storms like a missile, utilizing its razor-sharp steel wings to effortlessly shred harsh air currents.

entry: POKENAME生活在各地区的积雪森林。剑术足以压倒艾路雷朵，毒性也相当猛烈。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME can be found in forests in snowy areas of any region. Their swordsmanship is enough to overwhelm a Gallade and their poison is quite potent.

entry: POKENAME用强大念力操纵、重塑废金属，造出高大的金属守卫。入侵者靠得太近，这些构造便会发射集中的精神能量光束，保卫领地。
author: ambrosia04
source: Using its immense psychokinetic power, POKENAME commands and reshapes scrap metal to erect towering sentries. These metallic structures defend its territory by firing concentrated beams of psychic energy at any intruder who ventures too close.

entry: 镜子般的皮肤会显出人的本性。心地纯洁的人，会看到明亮的自己；心肠冷硬的人，映像却暗沉扭曲。
author: oddwalls
source: It reveals a person's nature with its mirror-like skin. A pure-hearted person will see a bright reflection of themselves, but the reflection of a stone-hearted person will be dark and distorted.

entry: POKENAME愤怒时，会从背上放火，表达情绪。温度太高，钢铁身体就会亮得通红。
author: fiordaliso
source: When enraged, POKENAME releases flames from its back as an expression of its emotions. If the temperature rises too high, its steel body begins to glow bright red.

entry: POKENAME愤怒时，会从背上放火，表达情绪。温度太高，钢铁身体就会亮得通红。
author: fiordaliso
source: When enraged, POKENAME releases flames from its back as an expression of its emotions. If the temperature rises too high, its steel body begins to glow bright red.

entry: POKENAME在大城市里结小群生活，从废品场和弃楼找铁吃。金属羽毛能打出强力翼击，连更大的宝可梦也会头疼。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lives in small flocks within large cities, feeding on iron scavenged from junkyards and abandoned buildings. Its metallic feathers allow it to strike with powerful wing blows that can trouble even larger Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME受伤就会尖叫，引起父母注意。金属翅膀能保护它，抵御天然栖地里弥漫的毒孢子。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME let out a piercing shriek whenever they are hurt, drawing the attention of their parents. Their metallic wings protect them from poisonous spores that fill their natural habitat.

entry: POKENAME白天睡在荆棘丛里，选无月光的夜晚出猎，免得金属羽毛反光暴露。不过振翅时轻轻的叮当声，仍常泄露行踪。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME sleeps in bramble bushes during the day, hunting on moonless nights so that the glint of its metallic feathers will not give it away. The soft clink of their wingbeats often gives away their approach.

entry: 它极其好斗，谁敢进领地就攻击谁，用钢羽毫不留情地打击。它吃建筑上的铁，常见它啃屋檐排水槽或电视天线。
author: fiordaliso
source: A truly aggressive Pokémon, it attacks anyone who dares enter its territory on sight, striking mercilessly with its steel feathers. It feeds on iron found on buildings, and is often seen chewing on gutters or TV antennas.

entry: POKENAME找到食物就会尖叫，与同类合作击倒大型目标。它也照顾兄弟姐妹，替它们挡下火焰攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release a shrill cry whenever they find food and cooperate with others of their kind to take down large targets. They also care for their siblings, shielding them from fiery attacks.

entry: POKENAME会扇翅发电，让周围充满静电。一碰到导电物，就把全部能量灌向接触点，迸出一片火花。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME generate electricity by flapping their wings to create a static charge around themselves. Once they touch something that conducts electricity, they discharge all the energy into that point and create a burst of sparks.

entry: POKENAME站在阳光充足的平顶山上，用磨亮身体把阳光反射进下方小型宝可梦的眼里。等目标被晃得看不见，就俯冲，用利翼解决猎物。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME stands at the top of sunny mesas and uses its polished body to reflect sunlight into the eyes of small Pokémon below. Once the target has been blinded, POKENAME swoops down to finish off its prey with its sharp wings.

entry: POKENAME羊毛的电荷会沿翅膀流动，用力扇翅就能放出闪电。它性格坚决，只允许极少数对象剪毛。
author: sk372
source: Electric charges from POKENAME's wool travel up its wings, letting it discharge bolts of lightning with strong flaps. It has a strong-willed personality, so few are allowed to shear its wool.

entry: 据说雄伟钢翼只需一振，就能推倒一座小建筑。为了保持强壮，它需要大量铁，因此常被请去处理金属废物，帮助城市保持干净。
author: fiordaliso
source: It's said that a single beat of its majestic steel wings can bring down a small building. Since it requires a large amount of iron to stay strong, it's often employed to dispose of metal waste and help keep cities clean.

entry: POKENAME会挥动利翼，凶猛保护后代。它用锯齿利爪捕杀虫宝可梦，再将食物分给鸟群成员。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME fiercely protect their offspring by brandishing their sharp wings. They slaughter bug Pokémon with their jagged talons and share their meal with members of their flock.

entry: POKENAME放出令人安宁的香气，将猎物引入洞穴，喂给自己的幼崽。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME tries to lure in its prey by letting out a serene smell. It then lures it to a cave to feed it to its young.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀如直升机般旋转，飞过时切开枝叶。刀刃每月脱落再生一次，飞行中会高速甩出去。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's wings spin much like a helicopter, cutting through leaves and branches as they fly. Once a month, these blades shed and regrow, flinging off at high speeds as these Pokémon fly.

entry: POKENAME会砍光干燥沙漠栖地里的新生植物，让猎物无处藏身。受到威胁时，锋利又能抓握的尾巴就会猛划，留下深伤。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME clear-cut new growth in their dry desert habitats, leaving no places for their prey to hide. When threatened, their sharp, prehensile tail slashes out, leaving their attackers with deep cuts.

entry: 野生POKENAME已失去飞行能力，住在地面，在河边筑大巢。展开的利翼能挖出围巢小沟，任何闯入者都会遭到攻击。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Wild POKENAME have lost the ability to fly and live on the ground, making large nests on the riverside. When unfurled, their razor-sharp wings are used to dig small trenches around their nest, and they attack anything that enters.

entry: 野生POKENAME已失去飞行能力，住在地面，但用心的训练家能重新教会。展开的利翼能挖出围巢小沟，任何闯入者都会遭到攻击。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Wild POKENAME have lost the ability to fly and live on the ground, but dedicated Trainers can teach them this skill. When unfurled, their razor-sharp wings are used to dig small trenches around their nest, and they attack anything that enters.

entry: 入侵者靠近领地时，POKENAME会抬起双臂，鸣叫威吓。不过不管对方逃不逃，表演完就不会再做什么。
author: sk372
source: Should an intruder approach POKENAME's territory, it will raise its arms and emit a cry of intimidation. Whether or not the intruder flees, POKENAME won't do anything else after its display.

entry: POKENAME能飞快潜游，追到猎物才停。眼睛像护目镜，能让它在水中看清猎物和捕食者。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME dive through the water at swift speeds, swimming rapidly until they catch their prey. Their eyes have properties similar to goggles, allowing them to clearly spot prey and predators alike while in the water.

entry: POKENAME必须吸收月光，才能启动金属翅膀起飞。它极爱独处，即使与训练家建立感情，也总要留些独处时间。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME must absorb moonlight to activate its metal wings and take flight. It has a deeply solitary temperament and, even after bonding with its Trainer, will always seek time alone.

entry: POKENAME身体是纯金属，却轻如羽毛，能在高速俯冲抓取树果、坚果时保护自己。它常被亮晶晶的东西吸引，包括同类脱落的羽毛。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have bodies of pure metal that are as light as feathers, keeping them safe as they dive for berries and nuts at rapid speeds. They are often drawn to shiny objects, including the shed feathers of their own kind.

entry: POKENAME常在高空暖上升气流中滑翔。发现猎物，就双脚朝下坠向地面，夹进爪间。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME is often seen gliding on warm updrafts high in the sky. When it spots prey, it plummets to the ground feet-first, trapping it between its talons.

entry: POKENAME睡在崖壁上，捕猎时，尾巴会漏出一种可生物降解、略像水银的物质。两只交战时，叫声会响彻周围。
author: bobosmith01
source: It sleeps on the sides of cliffs. A biodegradable substance somewhat similar to mercury leaks from its tail when it hunts. When two POKENAME fight, their cries reverberate throughout the area.

entry: POKENAME一生只蜕钢壳一两次。其他生物常把遗下的壳改作铠甲。
author: hampterbychoice
source: POKENAME sheds its steel shell once or twice in its lifetime. Other creatures will often repurpose its leftover molts as armor.

entry: POKENAME的金属外层摸起来极冷。冰雹中动作更快，凭熟练准头切穿风暴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's metal coating is frigid to the touch. It moves faster in hailstorms, slicing through the storm with practiced precision.

entry: POKENAME双臂有更厚的钢层，能挡下重击。配合翅膀，大多数攻击都能轻松弹开。
author: .izik
source: Thicker steel shields POKENAME's arms, allowing it to block heavy blows. Because of that combined with its wings, it deflects most attacks with ease.

entry: POKENAME会朝靠近巢穴的入侵者吐熔融金属，造成深度烧伤，吓退捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits molten metal at intruders nearing its nest. This can cause deep burns that deter predators.

entry: POKENAME住在山体深处富含矿物的含水层中。它把水中的金属与矿物融进身体，在皮肤表面长出金属甲片。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are found deep within mountains, living within mineral-rich aquifers. They incorporate the metals and minerals in the water into their body, growing metal plates across the surface of their skin.

entry: POKENAME会用金属长喙打出强击，连坚实岩石也能贯穿。翅上掉落的铁羽，常被用来建造大城市的新房。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its long metallic beak to unleash powerful strikes capable of piercing through solid rock. The iron feathers that fall from its wings are often used as building materials for new homes in large cities.

entry: POKENAME是危险的顶级猎手，捕食其他鸟类宝可梦。它会用锋利锯齿羽毛猛撞猎物，将其打落天空。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is a dangerous apex predator that hunts other bird Pokémon. It rams into its prey with its sharp, serrated feathers to knock them out of the air.

entry: 厚毛由数千锋利金属碎片组成，触碰极其危险。碎片经常脱落，也成了金属工匠的好铁源。
author: mistymagius
source: Its thick fur is made of thousands of sharp metal shards, making it incredibly hazardous to touch. It sheds these shards frequently, making them a good source of iron for metalsmiths.

entry: 它不停渴求铁，会啃停港船只的锚。身体极顽强，暖水冷水都能生存。
author: fiordaliso
source: Since it constantly craves iron, it chews on the anchors of ships docked at harbors. It's a remarkably resilient creature, able to survive in both warm and cold waters.

entry: POKENAME用流畅尖锐的金属身体破水，在海中疾游。它是神枪手，远距离也能精准射出水弹，击晕对手。
author: fiordaliso
source: It swiftly swims through the sea, cutting the water with its sleek, pointed metallic body. POKENAME is a skilled sharpshooter and can fire water projectiles with pinpoint accuracy even from great distances, stunning its opponents.

entry: POKENAME能用钢触手固定在任何表面，稳稳地从长圆喙射出强力投射物。披甲身体与敌对性情，让多数海洋宝可梦远离它的领地。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME anchors itself to any surface with its steel tentacles, keeping stable while firing powerful projectiles from its oblong beak. Its armored body and hostile temperament drive most marine Pokémon away from the territory it claims as its own.

entry: POKENAME被视为空中恐怖，一起飞，翅膀的金属轰鸣就会吓跑其他飞行属性宝可梦。它生性凶猛，钢喙能打出猛烈重击，击倒猎物。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is considered the terror of the skies: when it takes flight, its wings produce a metallic roar that sends other Flying-type Pokémon fleeing. It is a ferocious creature that brings down its prey with devastating blows from its steel beak.

entry: POKENAME被视为空中恐怖，一起飞，翅膀的金属轰鸣就会吓跑其他飞行属性宝可梦。它生性凶猛，钢喙能打出猛烈重击，击倒猎物。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is considered the terror of the skies: when it takes flight, its wings produce a metallic roar that sends other Flying-type Pokémon fleeing. It is a ferocious creature that brings down its prey with devastating blows from its steel beak.

entry: POKENAME的金属身体大多中空，装着能从嘴里喷出的火。背上钢翼虽不能带它离地，锋利边缘却能作武器。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's metal body is mostly hollow and filled with fire that it can shoot out from its mouth. While the steel wings on its back do not lift it off the ground, their sharp edges can be used as weapons.

entry: POKENAME会摩擦盘曲身体上的钢羽，吓得敌人血都凉了。猎物一松懈，它就瞬间扑出，用毒咬将其削弱。
author: fiordaliso
source: It scrapes together the steel feathers adorning its coils to freeze its enemies' blood with fear. When a prey lowers its guard, POKENAME lunges forward in an instant to weaken it with its venomous bite.

entry: 身体由轻盈而坚韧的金属构成。高速滚动时，便用翅膀状耳朵，控制行进方向。
author: staghorn
source: Its body is made of a lightweight yet durable metal. When rolling at high speeds, it uses its winglike ears to control its trajectory.

entry: POKENAME身体的金属外层，会随它从电脑出来的地区变化。北方呈铁的质感，南方则像钢。
author: .izik
source: The metal coating POKENAME's body shifts based on the region it emerges from a computer in. Northern regions produce an iron texture while southern regions mimic that of steel.

entry: POKENAME覆着防锈金属甲片，会渗出致命毒液。愤怒时，背上红刺竖起，盘曲身体相互摩擦，发出刺耳尖啸，让附近对象不安。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body is made of rustproof metal plates that exude deadly venom. In anger, it raises the crimson spikes on its back and grinds its coils, releasing piercing shrieks that unsettle anyone nearby.

entry: 这种变体POKENAME的翅膀硬如钢铁，却能飞行。扇出的狂风，据说足以媲美飓风。随着年长，鳞片会变暗，颜色像铁锈。
author: chibitales
source: This variant of POKENAME has wings that are as hard as steel, yet allow flight. When flapped, these wings allow POKENAME to create extreme gusts of wind that are thought to rival hurricanes. As they age, their scales darken to a color akin to rust.

entry: POKENAME会快速扇翅发电。过去曾受训，用电击瘫痪电子设备，如今却在许多汽车店帮忙，给汽车电池充电。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rapidly flap their wings to create electricity. They were once trained to shock and disable electronic devices but now help people charge car batteries at many car shops.

entry: 这些宝可梦的金属羽毛迎光闪出虹彩，钢铁身体十分温暖。
author: infinex21
source: The metal feathers of these Pokémon shimmer iridescently as light strikes them. Their steel bodies are incredibly warm.

entry: POKENAME会把刀尾甩向树木钩住，荡动积蓄冲劲，再弹上天空。翅膀很难托起金属身体，因此主要在树梢之间滑翔。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME fling their knife-like tails into trees to hook themselves in place while they swing, building up momentum before launching into the air. Their wings struggle to lift their metallic bodies, so they get around by gliding between treetops.

entry: 传说某些仪式过后，POKENAME就会出现，不过从未得到证实。它飞过夜空时，斗篷上的金属甲片哗啦作响，声音诡异。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is said that POKENAME appears after certain rituals are performed, though such rumors have never been confirmed. The metal plates on its cloak rattle, creating eerie sounds as it flies through the night.

entry: POKENAME凭钢羽的坚韧压倒附近乌鸦头头，既夺领地，也抢手下。宽翼能支撑长时间飞行，翼缘锋利，连坚实石头也能切开。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses the toughness of its steel feathers to overpower nearby Honchkrow, seizing not only their territory but also their underlings. Its broad wings let it fly for long periods, and their edges are sharp enough to slice through solid stone.

entry: POKENAME的凶暴程度与体型不相称，满怀杀意。在野外遇见它，务必要小心。
author: krune
source: Despite its size, POKENAME have murderous intent and can be quite violent. Be very careful if you meet it in the wild.

entry: POKENAME还很年幼，不懂得像长辈那样慈爱体贴。谁惹它生气，它就把石头扔向谁。
author: krune
source: As it is very young, POKENAME does not know how to be paternal and throws its stone at others who annoy it.

entry: 军方过去曾用POKENAME过度充电，炸毁电子设备。如今它会扇翅给汽车店发电，那里有许多电池等它充。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME were once utilized by the military to overcharge and explode electronic devices. Nowadays they flap their wings to generate electricity for car shops, where there are many batteries for them to charge.

entry: POKENAME十分合群，在冰山各处形成许多部落。闲时会彼此梳理，确保每根爪、每条尾和每片褶边都锋利得足以切开岩石。
author: turron_turron
source: POKENAME are highly social Pokémon that form numerous tribes throughout the Ice Mountains. They spend their free time grooming each other's coats, ensuring that every claw, tail, and frill is sharp enough to cut through solid rock.

entry: POKENAME受威胁时会蜷成防御球，靠坚韧装甲挡开多数攻击。若在崖边，甚至会滚下逃走，金属甲壳依然不会受损。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME rolls into a defensive ball when threatened, deflecting most attacks with its resilient armor plating. If near a cliff, it may even curl up and roll away from danger, as its metal carapace will remain undamaged.

entry: POKENAME钢翼振得够快，就能发出高频尖啸，让猎物晕眩、失去方向。全速掠过时，音爆甚至能震碎玻璃。
author: sk372
source: By flapping its steel wings fast enough, POKENAME creates a high-pitched screech that stuns and disorients prey. At top speed, POKENAME creates sonic booms that can shatter glass as it flies past.

entry: POKENAME会静攀山崖观察猎物，再极速扑下，用爪和尾刃制服。帮派会请它融入滴水兽雕像与建筑，充当领地守卫。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME clings motionlessly to mountain crags, watching for prey, which it descends upon with incredible speed and incapacitate with its claws and tail blade. It is employed by gangs to blend in with gargoyles and buildings as territory guardians.

entry: POKENAME最早的记录可追溯至卡洛斯战争。身上的金属甲片，是为了让人能骑着它上战场而打造的。
author: patch_bros
source: The earliest recorded cases of POKENAME date back to the Kalos War. The metal plating along its body was made so it could be ridden into battle.

entry: POKENAME飞过峡谷时，脱离身体的肢体会绕圈乱舞。落地后，肢体仍缓缓环绕，即使睡着也不停。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's disembodied limbs flail in circles as it flies over canyons. When it lands, the limbs continue to spin slowly around its body even while it sleeps.

entry: 翼刃锋利无比，飞过便能削倒树木。因此，POKENAME栖息的丛林，树永远长不过某个高度。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Its wing blades are so sharp that it fells trees as it flies. The jungles POKENAME live in never grow beyond a certain height as a result.

entry: 锋利红羽其实是特殊叶片，富含养分，还比刀更利。它常在树间跳跃，将叶子甩向对手。
author: infinex21
source: Its sharp, red feathers are actually special leaves packed with nutrients and sharper than knives. It will often leap from tree to tree, flinging these leaves at their opponents.

entry: POKENAME爱寻世界深处，会钻到地幔，让铠甲部分熔化、治好伤口，再结晶得更强。古老个体已知比钢铁还坚韧。
author: mindrivet
source: POKENAME is known to seek the deep places of the world. It will tunnel to the mantle, where its armor partially melts to heal its wounds only to crystallize stronger than ever. Ancient members of this species are known to be stronger than steel.

entry: POKENAME战斗时的优雅从容，宛如舞者，十分值得一看。它既优雅又务实，会瞄准要穴，迅速结束冲突。
author: xillo
source: POKENAME are a marvel to watch in battle, as the species strikes with the grace and poise of a dancer. Elegant but pragmatic, they aim for pressure points to end conflict swiftly.

entry: POKENAME臂上锋利的刀翼，是强大的战斗武器。它不介意身上大多数地方沾泥，却讨厌用于战斗的内侧羽毛沾泥。
author: sk372
source: The sharp, bladed wings on POKENAME's arms serve as a potent weapon in combat. Though mud on most of its body does not bother it, it disdains having it on the inner feathers it uses to fight with.

entry: 盔甲鸟群因领地争斗时，POKENAME就会从高空降下，挡在双方之间，用权杖宣布裁决，再以锋利刀翼确保服从。
author: ghostslythe
source: When flocks of Skarmory get in territorial tussles, POKENAME descends from the heavens. Getting in between the feuding parties, it declares judgments with its scepter and ensures obedience with razor sharp bladed wings.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着纯钢甲片，保护头部等要害。背上红色金属刺带着强毒，谁被刺中就会中毒。
author: fiordaliso
source: The body of POKENAME is covered with plates of pure steel that protect its vital areas, including the head. The red metal spikes on its back are infused with a potent toxin that poisons anyone pierced by them.

entry: POKENAME的楔石由一种独特金属构成，轻巧却极坚韧。许多人想仿造材料用于商业，可至今都没做出合适成果。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's keystone is made out of a unique metal that is lightweight but extremely resilient. Many have tried to recreate the material for commercial use, but all attempts thus far have failed to produce suitable results.

entry: POKENAME飞得如喷气推进般迅猛，速度足够高时，利翼几乎什么都能切开。不过铠甲会因此迅速升温，必须冷却才能再次起飞。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME soar through the air at speeds rivaling jet engines, their razor-sharp wings cutting through almost anything when flying fast enough. Their armor tends to heat up quickly from this, requiring POKENAME to cool down before their next flight.

entry: POKENAME金属爪浸着致命毒液。展宽钢翼俯冲敌人时，总想先令对方中毒，抢占战斗优势。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's metal claws are soaked in a deadly venom. When it dives at its foes with its wide steel wings, it always aims to poison them to gain the upper hand during the fight.

entry: POKENAME战斗中能猛咬，颚力足以碾碎石头。翅膀也极有力，飞行拍翅时掀起狂风，把较弱的宝可梦吹落地。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME delivers crushing bites in battle, with its jaw strong enough to crush stone. Its wings are also incredibly powerful, creating gusts of wind as it flies and flaps, knocking weaker Pokémon to the floor.

entry: POKENAME的不锈钢外骨骼，能抵御各种天气与威胁。它会吃躲在岩石里的小型带壳水生动物，用利爪敲开外壳。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its stainless steel exoskeleton protects it from all kinds of weather and threats. POKENAME feeds on small shellfish that hide in the rocks, which it cracks open with its sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME披甲身体能保护睡梦中的自己。醒来会敲打钢铁胸膛，打出鼓点般的节奏，赶走领地里的其他宝可梦。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's armored bodies protect them from danger while they sleep. When awake, they bang on their steel chests, creating drum-like beats to drive other Pokémon away from their territories.

entry: POKENAME金属身体太重，无法飞行，便用铁翼推着自己冲锋。巨大的铁质尾巴只一击，就能推倒参天树木。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its metallic body is far too heavy for flight, so POKENAME uses its iron wings to hurl itself forward when charging. A single strike of its massive iron tail can topple towering trees.

entry: POKENAME使用幽灵属性攻击时，银色铠甲会亮起深红光，同时发出阴森鸣声，在空中诡异回荡。
author: .izik
source: When using Ghost-type attacks, POKENAME's silver armor glows deep red. During this time, it lets out a haunting chirp that echoes unnaturally through the air.

entry: POKENAME身体中空如鱼雷，能吸入大量空气，再强力喷出。转过身后，最高能以3马赫前进，靠尾羽连空气本身都能劈开。
author: partypooperrex
source: With its hollow, torpedo-like body, POKENAME can suck in enormous amounts of air and blast it out with extreme force. By turning around, it can travel at speeds up to Mach 3 to slice even the air itself in half with its tail feather.

entry: 强大的POKENAME级航母，代表海军运用宝可梦的顶尖成果。舰载飞行编队覆盖范围无与伦比，让这些巨兽成为丰缘海岸警卫队的骄傲。
author: takopus
source: The mighty POKENAME-class carriers represent the pinnacle of naval Pokémon deployment. The unparalleled reach of their airwings makes these behemoths the pride of the Hoenn Coast Guard.

entry: POKENAME的身体由稀有金属构成，在这个世界自然界中从未发现过这种材料。红色翼羽能脱离身体独立行动，更好地抵御来犯者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is made of a rare metal not seen naturally on this world. The red feathers of its wings can detach and act independently of itself in order to better defend itself from those who would try to harm it.

entry: POKENAME的金属身体虽坚固，却十分中空，每次跳跃都能浮上空中。小翅膀主要用来发出刺耳声，让猎物动弹不得。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's metal body is incredibly hollow despite how sturdy it is, allowing this Pokémon to float through the air with every leap. Their small wings are mostly used by them to emit Screeches that immobilize prey.

entry: POKENAME金属羽毛还没发育到能托起飞行，因此会当作利刃自卫。它的铁质身体不会生锈，却会分泌对人和宝可梦都有害的毒素。
author: fiordaliso
source: Since its metal feathers are too underdeveloped to carry it into flight, POKENAME wields them as razor-sharp blades to defend itself. Rather than rusting, its iron body secretes toxins that are harmful to both Pokémon and humans.

entry: POKENAME会用喙磨亮金属羽毛，让自己逆流游得更快。它独居、领地意识极强，同类只要闯入，也会被攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: It polishes its metal plumage with its beak to make itself ever faster when swimming against the current. POKENAME is solitary and territorial, to the point of attacking even other members of its own species if it finds them in its territory.

entry: 钢铁身体让POKENAME能在水中以超音速前进，劈开沿途障碍。它战斗凶猛，既能用铁翼猛烈打击，也能从喙里射出强力水柱。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its steel body propels it through water at supersonic speed, cleaving through any obstacle in its path. POKENAME is a fearsome fighter that combines the brutal force of its iron wings with powerful jets of water fired from its beak.

entry: POKENAME在海中飞快穿行，几乎看不清身影。金属翅膀既切水也切石，喙里接连发射水流，摧毁前方几乎一切障碍。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME cuts through the ocean with blinding speed, its metal wings slicing water and rock alike. It launches bursts of water from its beak to obliterate almost any obstacle ahead.

entry: POKENAME扇状的钢羽刀刃能像鸟般飞翔。脱落的羽毛，很容易制成刀具。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's fan of steel feather blades can fly like a bird. Its fallen feathers are easily made into knives.

entry: POKENAME的双刃由特殊钢材构成，无论打多少场都锋利。它会相互刮擦，发出震耳欲聋的尖啸，吓得敌人退缩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's two blades are made of a steel material that stays sharp no matter how many battles it fights. It scrapes its blades together to create an intimidating and ear-splitting screech to make its foes cower before it.

entry: POKENAME铠甲光亮、极耐磨。融合让刀刃更像盔甲鸟的翅膀，锋利如刀，能当武器，也能有限度地滑翔。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's armor is shiny and extremely durable. Fusion made the blades more like Skarmory's wings, which are razor-sharp for use as weapons but also allow for some limited gliding utility.

entry: POKENAME无畏地飞过风暴，钢翼吸收闪电能量。迎敌时，会发出可怕的金属咆哮，数英里外也能听见。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's steel wings absorb energy from lightning bolts as it flies fearlessly through storms. When it faces an opponent, it lets out a terrifying metallic roar that can be heard even from miles away.

entry: POKENAME只住在最洁净纯粹的水里，尽量让金属身体干净。它会定期掀起猛烈水流，强力打磨，否则很容易生锈。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live only in the cleanest, purest waters so as to keep their metallic bodies as clean as possible. They regularly churn fierce torrents to forcefully polish their metal bodies, otherwise they can easily rust.

entry: POKENAME把金属身体磨得如镜子般明亮。不过映像里，常会出现并不在场的宝可梦。
author: epolybius
source: POKENAME keeps its metallic body so well-polished that it appears like a mirror. This reflection often shows Pokémon that aren't really there.

entry: 它的丝带由轻巧又极锋利的合金构成，能轻松切开对手。不过接触水太久，就会开始锈蚀。
author: mistymagius
source: Its ribbons are made of a metal alloy that is both lightweight and incredibly sharp, allowing it to slice through its opponents with ease. However, the ribbons will start to rust away if exposed to water for too long.

entry: POKENAME铠甲由未知合金组成，轻如羽毛，却比钛更强。科学家仍不清楚具体由哪些元素构成。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME's armor is composed of an unknown alloy that is simultaneously feather-light and stronger than titanium. Scientists are still unsure of exactly which elements make up this alloy.

entry: POKENAME体内烈焰燃烧，浓烟从全身开口和嘴里排出。它会巧用烟雾迷惑敌人，也遮掩部分攻击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME releases thick smoke from the flames raging inside itself from openings across its body and from its mouth. Using this smoke, it cleverly confuses its enemies and conceals some of its attacks.

entry: POKENAME战得越久，红焰就越强。有故事说，火焰会对热切追求真实的对象产生强烈反应。奇妙的是，即使火势如此，金属身体却几乎不暖。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's red flames grow stronger as they fight, and some stories say these flames react strongly to those who fervently pursue the truth. Oddly, its metal body is barely even warm despite these strong flames.

entry: POKENAME会追捕小偷与罪犯，朝逃避正义的对象撒出阵阵锋利、红宝石般的花瓣，割出痛苦裂伤。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hunt after thieves and criminals. They unleash flurries of sharp, ruby petals to cause painful lacerations against those who flee from justice.

entry: POKENAME已成了金属回收厂最大的害兽。长大时会层层加厚铠甲，让本已致密的钢更硬。遭到对峙时，它会飞快奔跑，跃过所有障碍。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME have become the biggest pests at metal recycling plants. As they grow they add layers to their armor, hardening the already dense steel. When confronted, they run incredibly fast, bounding over any obstacles.

entry: 据说POKENAME的镰刀锋利得几乎能切开任何金属。恶人常雇它作刺客，追猎人或宝可梦，哪怕为此丧命也要完成任务。
author: actliux
source: The scythe of POKENAME is said to be sharp enough to cut through almost any metal. Villains will often hire POKENAME as assassins to hunt people or Pokémon, carrying out their task even if it means their own death.

entry: POKENAME金属壳能传导部分体内电力。它会迅速织出带电丝网，再像撒网一样抛出，困住、电击猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's metal shell helps it conduct some of the electricity within itself. It can quickly weave up electrified webbing before casting it out like a net to ensnare and shock its prey.

entry: POKENAME是顶级猎手，会用利爪和翅膀割伤敌人。伤口极深，鲜有对象能挨过几次斩击还活下来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are an apex predator that slashes foes with their sharp talons and wings. These lacerations cut deep; few survive more than a couple of slashes.

entry: POKENAME能在极短时间加速到极快，有人声称起飞时会产生音爆。战斗拖长后，体温高得足以让周围空气扭曲。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can achieve such great speeds in such a short time that some claim they create a sonic boom when they take off. Their bodies grow hot enough to distort the air around them as battles involving them draw on.

entry: POKENAME完全看不见，会在洞里鸣叫，靠回声定位。一察觉活动，就用刀翼猛划。
author: .izik
source: Completely blind, POKENAME squawks to echo-locate through caves. Once it senses movement, it lashes out with blade-like wings.

entry: POKENAME会吃沿途机器和建筑里的金属，让羽毛保持光洁。臂上的头虽不需要养分，也会一起撕咬、吞下金属。
author: sk372
source: In order to keep its metallic feathers pristine, POKENAME consumes metal from machines and buildings it comes across. Though the heads on its arms do not require sustenance, they too chew and swallow the metal as it tears it apart.

entry: POKENAME是迅捷猎手，感知其他生物情绪的能力令人畏惧。更可怕的是，红羽还能像导弹一样发射，循目标的情绪追踪。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are swift hunters with the frightening ability to sense the emotions of other beings. Even more frightening is the fact that these Pokémon can unleash their red feathers like missiles that seek targets based on their emotions.

entry: 传说揉它的金属翅膀七次，就能实现一个愿望。它极其罕见，只会短暂出现在最高的山巅。
author: fiordaliso
source: Legend says that rubbing its metal wings seven times will grant a wish in return. It is an extremely rare Pokémon that appears briefly atop the highest mountain peaks.

entry: POKENAME会用木头和金属建造华丽建筑，利羽能轻松切成想要的形状。作品曾启发许多专业建筑师的项目。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME builds extravagant structures out of wood and metal, using its sharp feathers to effortlessly cut them to its liking. Its work has inspired many projects by professional architects.

entry: POKENAME能用锋利如刀的翅膀，迅速绕着敌人机动，同时精准斩击。不过，长时间飞行还没掌握。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME uses its razor-sharp wings to swiftly maneuver around its foes, dealing precise slashes in the process. It has yet to master long-term flight, however.

entry: 为了在进化前保命，POKENAME可能会伪装成其他鸟类宝可梦。不过有时却被不知情的鸟巢居民收养了。
author: epolybius
source: To keep safe before they evolve, POKENAME may disguise themselves as other bird-like Pokémon. However, they sometimes find themselves adopted into unaware nests.

entry: POKENAME全身由坚固金属甲片构成，能抵御更强大的宝可梦。寒冷月份必须睡在燃煤上，免得冻僵，无法动弹。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its body is made entirely of sturdy metal plates that shield it from stronger Pokémon. During the cold months, POKENAME must rest on a bed of burning coals to keep itself from freezing up and becoming unable to move.

entry: POKENAME翅上绽开金属花苞，个个散出甜美芭亚果香，引来无戒心的猎物。
author: .izik
source: Metallic bulbs bloom on POKENAME's wings, each releasing a sweet Iapapa Berry scent. It uses the fragrance to lure unsuspecting prey.

entry: 成簇的金属细藤像棉花一样，包住POKENAME下半身，仿佛铠甲。它飞得极灵活，藤层能抵御狂风与风暴。
author: .izik
source: Clusters of thin metallic, cotton-like vines wrap POKENAME's lower body like armor. They insulate it from harsh winds and storms as it flies with incredible agility.

entry: POKENAME是被哭哭面具附身的死去盔甲鸟，早已不能飞。金属身体刮擦地面的声响，老远就能听见它来了。
author: sottiwotti
source: POKENAME is a dead Skarmory possessed by a Yamask. It can't fly, which is why you can hear POKENAME coming from a distance by the metal scraping against the floor.

entry: POKENAME铁獠牙能撕开火车车厢，击中之处都会留下一道长长的熔融伤痕。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's iron tusks are capable of tearing through train cars. Its strikes leave long, molten scars across whatever they hit.

entry: 它大半身体披着钢甲，空气动力性能远胜普通鸟类宝可梦。不过越费力，身体和铠甲也越热。
author: infinex21
source: Most of its body is clad in steel armor that makes it vastly more aerodynamic than the average bird Pokémon. However, the more it strains itself, the hotter its body and armor become.

entry: 这些宝可梦越激动，身体和钢甲就越热。长途飞行后休息时，会定期喷火，排出余热。
author: infinex21
source: The more riled up these Pokémon become, the hotter their bodies and steel armors become. They periodically expel flames to vent their excess heat while resting after a long flight.

entry: POKENAME在洞里睡觉时，会用银色合金翅膀包住自己。反光护盾能保护它，免遭捕食者或对手伏击。
author: .izik
source: While sleeping in caves, POKENAME wraps itself in its silver alloy wings. This reflective shield protects it from ambush by predators or rivals.

entry: POKENAME身体包着钢铁，能极速滚动。冲劲最大时，还能像打水漂的石头一样掠过水面。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rolls at extreme speeds, its body encased in steel. At peak momentum, it can skip across water like a stone.

entry: POKENAME的骨头虽是金属，却能浮水，因为史前骨架结构里有中空肢体。研究者因此正深入研究它，希望改进造船技术。
author: quackquackattack
source: Despite having bones made out of metal, POKENAME can float on water. This is because their prehistoric bone structure includes hollow limbs that keep it above water. They are as a result under intense scrutiny to improve ship building practices.

entry: POKENAME会在山间狩猎，始终留意食物。金属利牙十分强劲，能轻易咬碎巨石。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME hunts for prey along mountainous areas, keeping its eyes out for food at all times. Its sharp, metallic fangs are strong enough to easily break boulders.

entry: POKENAME常被误认成传说的宝可梦，是强大的破坏机器，几乎无敌。与它交过手的宝可梦，鲜有能活着讲述。
author: sondededoo
source: Often mistaken for a legendary Pokémon, POKENAME is a powerful engine of destruction. Virtually invincible, very few Pokémon have fought this Pokémon and lived to tell the tale.

entry: POKENAME常在近水面游泳，把金属头冠露出来，迷惑攻击者。本想吓退威胁，多数宝可梦却只纳闷：盔甲鸟怎么在海里悠闲游泳？
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME usually swims near the surface, keeping its metal crown above the water to trick attackers. While it's meant to scare off threats, most Pokémon are just left wondering why a Skarmory is casually swimming in the ocean.

entry: POKENAME金属胸鳍和牙齿受损也继续打，因为都能再生。它会啃穿沉船，吃下的金属能加快恢复。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME fights even when its metallic pectoral fins and teeth become damaged since both grow back. It will chew through sunken ships because the ingested metals speed up this regeneration.

entry: POKENAME双翼强大，利爪如刀，猎物和敌人都能迅速解决。愤怒时，会放出足以震碎岩石、堪比喷气引擎的咆哮。
author: turron_turron
source: With its powerful wings and razor-sharp claws, POKENAME makes short work of prey and foe alike. When angry, POKENAME lets loose a rock-shattering roar rivaling that of a jet engine.

entry: POKENAME云般的羽毛由钢丝绒构成，十分耐打。它会把废金属存进绒层，刀刃受损时就能修补。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's cloud-like feathers are made of steel wool, which is highly resistant to attacks. It will store scrap metal in its wool so it can repair its blades when they get damaged.

entry: 水银不断从POKENAME铠甲滴下。它潜行峡谷时留下的毒迹，可能让地面受损多年。
author: .izik
source: A coating of mercury drips constantly from POKENAME's armor. As it slinks through canyons, the toxic trail it leaves behind can scar the ground for years.

entry: POKENAME金属触手会分泌稀薄透明的毒液，引起强烈偏头痛。即使短暂接触，也可能晕上数小时。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's metal tentacles secrete a thin, clear poison that induces intense migraines. Even brief contact can leave victims dizzy for hours.

entry: POKENAME是可靠的伙伴，会一直陪在朋友身边，直到对方生命终结。那时才会展翅，飞到云层之上。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME are trustworthy partners who stay by the side of their friends until the day of their death. Only then will they spread their wings and take flight above the clouds.

entry: POKENAME跃出水面，金属与鳞片一同闪亮。水分让身体光辉夺目，晃花猎物与对手的眼睛。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME bursts from the water with a flash of metal and scales. Moisture makes its body shine brilliantly, dazzling prey and rivals alike.

entry: POKENAME的爪子锋利无比，能轻易切开岩石和沉船。它们不停彼此决斗，因为铠甲缺口的数量，代表受尊敬的程度。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's claws are incredibly sharp, slicing through rocks and shipwrecks with ease. These Pokémon are constantly dueling each other because the number of chips in their armor equates to how respected they are.

entry: POKENAME个头小，很难发现，却会危及普通徒步者。它飞快跑过时，会用耳中刀刃在徒步者腿上划出长伤口。
author: .realthree
source: Though POKENAME is hard to notice, being so small, it poses a danger to casual hikers. When it runs by in a flash, it uses the blades in its ears to score a long slash in one's legs.

entry: POKENAME白天多半在家园沙漠的砂岩上磨羽。受袭后，会用游击战术，精准投出羽毛苦无，逐渐消耗敌人体力。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME spends most of its days sharpening its feathers on the sandstone of its native desert. If attacked, it employs hit-and-run tactics, needling the foe's health with well-placed feather kunai.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，会从翅上脱落旧铁鳞，释放有毒锈尘，吸入就会中毒。它只在夜里游走森林，寻找猎物。
author: fiordaliso
source: As it flies, POKENAME sheds old iron scales from its wings, releasing a toxic rusty dust that poisons all who breathe it. It roams the forests only at night in search of prey.

entry: POKENAME一动不动地漂浮，外壳硬化，覆着银层。日落时，会无声飘向猎物，不眨眼，也不移开视线。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats without motion, its shell hardened and silver-coated. As the sun sets, it drifts silently toward prey, never blinking or breaking its gaze.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME带着柔和粉光划过天空。人们相信，同一晚见到好几只，能带来兴旺与好运。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME streaks across the sky glowing a soft pink. Spotting several in one evening is believed to bring prosperity and good fortune.

entry: 它会用锋利如刀的金属羽毛，凶猛迎击对手。尾焰涨起时，钢皮就会热得通红，碰到什么都能烧伤。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its razor-sharp metal feathers are used to fiercely take on opponents. When the flame on its tail flares up, its steel skin grows red-hot and can burn anything it touches.

entry: POKENAME身体由磨亮的银构成，过去曾被采来制作高级首饰。有些订婚戒指上，仍闪着据说来自它身体的鳞片。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is made of polished silver that was once harvested for high-end jewelry. Some engagement rings still shimmer with scales said to come from its body.

entry: POKENAME是偷猎者恶名昭彰的宠物，因为很容易受训干这种事。偷猎者会教它咬濒危宝可梦的后颈，使其无法反抗，又保留许多值钱部位。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are infamous pets of poachers because they are easy to train for the task. Poachers train them to disable endangered Pokémon by biting on the nape of the neck, leaving many valuable parts intact.

entry: POKENAME因与偷猎者的关系而深陷争议。它爱吃濒危宝可梦的肉，也让许多训练家不愿饲养。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are at the center of controversy because of their affiliation with poachers. They are known to enjoy eating cuts of meat from endangered Pokémon, which makes them less desirable to many Trainers.

entry: POKENAME对金属身体困惑不已，想拥抱其他宝可梦，却常用锋利边缘不小心伤到对方。若对方不肯原谅，它就没完没了地赔罪，让对方难以招架。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are baffled by their metallic body and often accidentally hurt Pokémon that they want to hug with their sharp edges. If another Pokémon refuses their apology, their intense groveling can be a headache to deal with.

entry: POKENAME的铁甲似乎永不生锈，名声赫赫，被铁匠视为圣物。铠甲也极轻，让它能高速奔跑、滑翔。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's legendary iron armor is considered to be sacred by blacksmiths because it never seems to rust. The armor is also very lightweight, allowing POKENAME to dash and glide at very high speeds.

entry: POKENAME的钢铁甲片不只防护，刀刃般的空气动力设计，也让它飞得极快，打出更强的飞行属性攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: The steel plates covering its body like an armor aren't just for protection; thanks to their aerodynamic, bladed design, POKENAME can fly at incredible speeds and strike with even more powerful Flying-type attacks.

entry: POKENAME拿着小型骑枪，却还不熟练。它每天练习武器，增强战斗本领。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wield a small lance that they have little experience with. They practice with this weapon daily to improve their battle prowess.

entry: 融合让POKENAME以蛮力换来出神入化的剑术。虽然技艺高强，它却似乎不喜欢这种变化。
author: patch_bros
source: Fusion has caused POKENAME to trade its brawn for incredibly impressive fencing skills. Despite its prowess, it does not seem to enjoy this change.

entry: POKENAME过去曾被认为是剑术大师的弟子。虽然有骑士模样，骄傲却常引来不必要的冲突。
author: inksans201x
source: POKENAME were once thought to be students of a master swordsman. Despite their knightly visage, their pride often leads to unwanted conflict.

entry: 对战时，POKENAME会迅速连挥利爪，压倒对手。不过耐力不足，无法长时间猛攻，会给敌人留下反击空当。
author: quackquackattack
source: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME unleash a swift flurry of talons to overwhelm their opponent. They lack the stamina to keep up a long assault, which gives their opponent an opening to launch a counterattack.

entry: POKENAME会以快得看不清的连环刀击压倒敌人。如果这一轮剑技没能取胜，之后常因疲倦而落败。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME overwhelm opponents with a blinding flurry of blades. If they fail to defeat an opponent with this burst of swordsmanship, they often lose because they get tired afterwards.

entry: POKENAME白天大多在打磨金属身体，用河床找到的多孔石头擦掉杂质。谁敢打扰，就会被高压水柱喷击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME spends much of the day polishing its metal body, scrubbing away impurities with porous rocks found on riverbeds. It spits pressurized jets of water at anyone who dares disturb it.

entry: POKENAME会轻轻晃响金属翅膀，引来好奇的宝可梦。猎物一到跟前，就被整口吞下，几秒内被腐蚀性极强的酸液溶解。
author: fancyskunk
source: POKENAME lures curious Pokémon toward it by gently jangling its metallic wings. Once within reach, the prey is swallowed whole and dissolved within seconds by a powerfully caustic acid.

entry: POKENAME长触手末端的钢刃会划坏船壳。烦躁时，还会分泌铁锈色墨汁，对海洋环境有极强毒性。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME damages ship hulls with the steel blades at the tips of its long tentacles. When agitated, it secretes a rusty-colored ink that is highly toxic to the marine environment.

entry: POKENAME身上覆着沉重石块，每块都镀着钢。虽然重得惊人，仍能以最高每小时20英里的速度稳定飞行。
author: .izik
source: Heavy stones coat POKENAME's body, each plated in steel. Despite its immense weight, it can fly steadily at speeds of up to 20 miles per hour.

entry: 身体太过锋利，骑上去必被割伤。中世纪时，人们常用它的形象作为纹章图案。
author: staghorn
source: Its sharp body makes it impossible to ride without being cut. It was commonly used as a heraldic symbol during the Middle Ages.

entry: POKENAME身体的钢坚实流畅，受火焰影响，始终灼热。即使全身钢铁，速度仍惊人，还能借翅膀跃过一些峡谷。
author: infinex21
source: The sleek, sturdy steel of a POKENAME's body is always hot due to its flames. Even though its body is made of steel, it can achieve remarkable speeds and even use its wings to leap across some canyons.

entry: POKENAME会用可靠的长矛，从枝头串下果实。它在不同森林间飞行，品尝新水果。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME skewers fruits off of tree branches using its trusty spear. It flies between different forests to taste new types of fruit.

entry: 许多伽勒尔故事都会提到POKENAME，说它铠甲坚如钻石，手持茎秆连一些最坚硬的岩石也能刺穿。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME is mentioned in many Galarian tales, having armor tough as diamond. Its stalk can stab through some of the hardest rock.

entry: POKENAME一颗头会发出金属尖叫，震晕对手，另一颗再用极硬的喙袭击。强壮双腿让它能高速奔跑，一跃可达10米。
author: fiordaliso
source: One of its heads emits metallic screams to stun opponents so the other can strike with its incredibly hard beak. POKENAME's strong legs allow it not only to run at high speeds but also to make jumps up to ten meters.

entry: POKENAME三颗头虽共用一个胃，有时仍会为食物争吵。不过喙刺不穿自身金属皮，因此从来不会弄伤自己。
author: .jerden
source: Even though they share a stomach, POKENAME's three heads sometimes fight among themselves for food. Since their beaks cannot pierce their own metal skin, this never does POKENAME any harm.

entry: POKENAME尾端的钢尖，能轻松将整座冰山劈成两半。受到威胁时，它会从坚固金属喙精准射出冰冻光束。
author: fiordaliso
source: The steel tip on its tail can slice entire icebergs in half with ease. If POKENAME feels threatened, it precisely fires Ice Beam from its sturdy metallic beak.

entry: POKENAME潜伏淡水湖深处，用壳内强力鱼叉炮捕猎。钢铁皮肤极耐打，几乎不必害怕捕食者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lurks in the depths of freshwater lakes, hunting for prey using the powerful harpoon cannons within its shell. It has little to fear from predators, its steely hide making it highly resistant to attacks.

entry: POKENAME喜欢用坚实金属爪剪断锚链，让船随潮漂走。它主要吃沿海捕来的软体动物。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME delights in severing anchor chains with its sturdy metal claws, setting boats adrift on the tide. Its diet consists mainly of mollusks hunted along the coastline.

entry: POKENAME会烧灌木成灰，用来标记附近树木。符号表示领地已被占据，让它能独居。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burns bushes into ash and uses it to mark nearby trees. These symbols signal occupied territory, allowing it to live in solitude.

entry: POKENAME会用长腿踢下挂满白球果的树枝，再用火烤熟，拿来吃。
author: .izik
