source: With its long legs, POKENAME kicks down tree limbs heavy with White Apricorns. It then roasts them with its flames before eating.

entry: POKENAME会通过严苛切磋，决定群中等级。偶有个体对同伴使阴招，无论胜败，都会被逐出去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME decides hierarchy in the pack through rigorous sparring matches. The rare POKENAME that attempts dirty tactics on another will be cast out, no matter if it was victorious or not.

entry: 作物需要收割时，人们常请可靠的POKENAME帮忙。月亮升起后，它会巡逻农场围栏，从黑暗中跳出，击退害兽。
author: ghostslythe
source: When crops need to be harvested, the dependable POKENAME is often used. When the moon rises, these Pokémon patrol the farm's fence line, jumping out of the darkness to fight off pests.

entry: POKENAME举止可爱，咬下时却带着极强毒性，当地人都十分畏惧。受威胁时，它会先吠叫，警告人类赶快逃。
author: krune
source: Despite its cute demeanor, POKENAME has a very potently venomous bite, which is feared in the areas in which POKENAME lives. It barks when threatened, giving humans a warning to run before it bites.

entry: 旧科研记录显示，POKENAME曾被认为是伊布的地区形态，后来才被推翻。头上的骷髅斑会随元素倾向变色，暗示可能的进化方向。
author: sk372
source: Old science records show that POKENAME was once thought to be a regional variant of Eevee until it was disproved. The skull-like marking on its head shifts color based on elemental affinity, hinting the evolution it may undertake.

entry: POKENAME会住进找到的头骨，尤其偏爱镰刀盔头骨。谁走得太近就喷火；若攻击无效，还会深沉低吼。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME make their homes in skulls they find, favoring those of Kabutops. These Pokémon spit fire at anyone who steps too close, letting out a deep growl if their attacks are ineffective.

entry: POKENAME会变成其他宝可梦，混进鸟群或兽群玩。偶尔打喷嚏喷出火，暴露伪装，才赶忙瞬间移动逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME transforms into other Pokémon to play with their flocks or herds. It occasionally sneezes flames, blowing its cover before it teleports away.

entry: POKENAME通过叶片气味的细微变化与群体交流。叶片散出的花粉，也会作为某些城都辣味菜肴的原料。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME communicates with its pack via subtle changes in the scent created by its leaf. Pollen spread by the leaf is used as an ingredient in some spicy Johto dishes.

entry: 它们会收集已故人类与宝可梦的骨骼。藏品品质越好，在同族中就越受尊重。
author: sottiwotti
source: They collect the bones of deceased Pokémon and people. The quality of their collection influences the respect they get in their flock.

entry: POKENAME乌黑的条纹让它夜里极善伪装，常溜进烟囱，从住家储藏室偷食物。
author: quackquackattack
source: The ebony stripes of a POKENAME give them superb camouflage at night. They are known to slip into chimneys to steal food from home pantries.

entry: POKENAME一察觉活动，就会从喙发出尖锐吠声，再用识破判断入侵者是否危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits a sharp bark from its beak when it senses movement. It then uses Foresight to determine whether the intruder poses a threat.

entry: POKENAME停在最高树顶，清楚俯瞰领地。任何闯进巢区的对象，都会遭到极愤怒的攻击。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME perches atop the highest trees to maintain a clear view of its territory. It will attack any intruder that enters its nesting grounds with great fury.

entry: POKENAME振翅时会放出强热，足以让花枯萎。吃的花越多，温度也越高。
author: .izik
source: As its wings flap, POKENAME releases intense heat capable of withering flowers. The more blossoms it consumes, the more the temperature rises.

entry: POKENAME是城市里吵闹的小捣蛋鬼，会顺走饭后丢弃的骨头，当重棒敲打、骚扰大个生物，再带着笑声般的吠叫跑开。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are rambunctious little troublemakers inhabiting urban areas. They swipe discarded bones from meals, and use them as heavy clubs to hit and annoy bigger creatures before running off with a barking cackle.

entry: POKENAME每夜捣乱前都会对月嚎叫。它会开栅门、挖穿围栏下方，恐吓农场宝可梦，惹农夫烦恼。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME howl at the moon every night before they begin their mischief. They are known to pester farmers by opening gates and digging underneath fences to menace farm Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME群居，用叫声交流。同伴若受伤或难过，其他成员会送一块自己的壳，帮它振作。
author: grannyjojophone
source: POKENAME stay in packs, using cries to communicate. If a pack member is injured or sad, other POKENAME will give them a piece of their shell to cheer them up.

entry: POKENAME会成群飘过天空，寻找猎物和善人。发现善良的人，就会从上方撒粉，让附近所有对象都开心。
author: grannyjojophone
source: Packs of POKENAME will float through the sky, searching for prey and for kind people. If they spot a kind person, the pack will sprinkle dust from above, making everybody nearby happy.

entry: POKENAME游到哪里，周围水就开始沸腾。即使完全浸水，身体仍散出强烈热量。
author: .izik
source: Wherever POKENAME swims, the surrounding water begins to boil. Its body radiates intense heat even when completely submerged.

entry: POKENAME尾上的骷髅纹常被误认成夜巡灵。它爱吓其他宝可梦取乐，却很难把握适可而止的分寸。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a skull pattern on their tail that is often mistaken for a Duskull. They love to tease other Pokémon by scaring them and have a hard time knowing when to stop.

entry: POKENAME埋在水边，似乎夜里长得最快。察觉危险，就会发出只有同类听懂的嚎叫，彼此通报。
author: gnom3
source: POKENAME buries itself near water, and seems to grow the most at night. If it senses danger, it will communicate with howls only other POKENAME can understand.

entry: POKENAME能合力捉住猎物，却会争谁来给出致命一击。多数时候，猎物反而趁机悄悄逃走，让它们吵得更凶。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME work well together to catch prey but then squabble amongst themselves on who gets to make the killing blow. More often than not, this allows their prey to slip away unnoticed, causing the POKENAME to argue amongst themselves even more.

entry: POKENAME偶尔生来红毛，一副高高在上的样子。不为狩猎出力，却期待每次都能分一份。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are occasionally born with red fur, giving them an air of superiority. They expect a share of any hunt without contributing.

entry: 幼年POKENAME会一起玩，学习捕猎，却常演变成争吵。父母非但帮不上忙，还经常一起吵。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Young POKENAME play together to learn to catch prey but commonly end up squabbling amongst themselves. Their parents are no help and often join in on the quarrel.

entry: POKENAME会在毫无戒心的人附近放火，制造恐慌，再趁混乱俯冲偷走贵重物品。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sets fires near unsuspecting people to cause panic. In the chaos, it swoops down and steals their valuables.

entry: POKENAME虽然能聚在一起，通过符号或心灵感应交流，却更爱嚎叫。每群都有独特叫法，彼此不同，一群约有300只。
author: bobosmith01
source: While POKENAME can communicate by grouping together and communicating either with symbols or telepathically, they prefer to communicate with howls. Each pack of POKENAME has a unique set of howls over the next. There is about 300 POKENAME in a pack.

entry: POKENAME虽然能聚在一起，通过符号或心灵感应交流，却更爱嚎叫。每群都有独特叫法，彼此不同，一群约有300只。
author: bobosmith01
source: While POKENAME can communicate by grouping together and communicating either with symbols or telepathically, they prefer to communicate with howls. Each pack of POKENAME has a unique set of howls over the next. There is about 300 POKENAME in a pack.

entry: POKENAME漫游草原，寻找同族结伴。臀部的头常因饥饿而死；若那颗头还活着，它便明显快乐些，也更不爱独处。
author: krune
source: POKENAME roam the savannas, searching for others of their kind to ally with. The head on their rump is usually deceased from starvation, but when alive, they are noticeably happier and less solitary.

entry: 捕食者靠近时，POKENAME会大声吠叫警告。若威胁不退，它就会慌张爆炸，烈焰迸发。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME barks loudly as a warning when predators approach. If the threat persists, it erupts into flames in a panicked explosion.

entry: POKENAME不开心就闹脾气，想求安慰，却又装作不想被亲近。生气时，毛皮会变热。
author: .izik
source: When upset, POKENAME throws tantrums and seeks affection while pretending it doesn't want it. Its fur grows hot when it gets angry.

entry: 暴风雪后，POKENAME会用灼热的爪子帮其他对象挖巢。每划一下都能熔冰，造出供它们生存的洞。
author: .izik
source: After blizzards, POKENAME digs out nests for others using its heated claws. It melts ice with each slash, creating a den for others to survive in.

entry: POKENAME头骨般的冠会放出甜蜜香，引诱猎物。若不小心引来捕食者，就会慌张大哭，拔腿逃跑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's skull-like crest gives off a sweet honey scent to lure prey. If it accidentally attracts a predator instead, it panics, bursts into tears, and flees.

entry: POKENAME会成群合作，用出色嗅觉找到地下大片蘑菇。挖出之后，首领总先吃第一口。
author: sk372
source: Working together as a group, POKENAME use their impeccable sense of smell to locate large batches of mushrooms buried under the ground. The leader of the pack always gets the first bite of the fungi they uncover.

entry: POKENAME骨架般的翅膀，其实由轻巧金属构成。幼崽会在空中彼此切磋，磨练狩猎本领。
author: mepp.
source: The bony wings on POKENAME's body are actually made of a lightweight metal. Young pups hone their hunting skills while sparring with each other mid-flight.

entry: 每次只能由一个头使出火焰攻击，火焰却比黑鲁加能喷出的还要炽热得多。
author: itsbrewsky
source: Only one head is able to use fire attacks at a time, but this fire is vastly hotter than anything even a Houndoom is capable of producing.

entry: POKENAME产出的奶辛辣温热，富含钙质。许多地区看重浓郁风味和营养，会加进丰盛炖菜。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME produces spicy, heat-infused milk rich in calcium. Many regions use it in hearty stews for its strong flavor and nutritional value.

entry: POKENAME嚎叫时，翅膀会迸出阵阵火焰。被烧到的植物虽会燃尽，几天后却在原地长回，比从前更有生机。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME howls, bursts of flame erupt from its wings. Any plantlife caught in these flames will burn but grow back from the same spot a few days later, more vibrant than before.

entry: POKENAME以小群活动，只有一个首领。狩猎若失败，首领就倒转时间，让全群重来，无论多少次，直到成功。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME operate in small groups with a single pack leader. If the pack fails in a hunt, the leader will rewind time and let the group try again, as many times as it takes until the hunt is successful.

entry: POKENAME模仿路人，精准得诡异。头上帽子般的毛，摸起来烫得危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME mimics any passersby with eerie precision. The hat-like fur on its head is dangerously hot to the touch.

entry: POKENAME在干旱沙漠以小群狩猎，先伏好等猎物靠近，再从不同方向轮流用蜷起的身体冲撞，直到目标倒下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hunts in small packs in arid desert areas. The pack lies in wait until prey draws near, then takes turns crashing into it from different sides with their curled-up bodies until their target is knocked out.

entry: POKENAME背上的叶片又辣又苦，制成药后却有助消化。不过取得叶片也许得不偿失，因为它对一切靠近的对象都敌意强烈。
author: evilgammon
source: The leaf on POKENAME's back is extremely spicy and bitter, however has a positive effect on digestion if processed into a medicine. Getting it may be more trouble than it's worth, with the Pokémon's aggression towards anything that approaches it.

entry: POKENAME总一起训练、一起迎敌，哪怕数量远多于对手。最常见的制胜法，就是合伙从四面八方接连踢打。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME train together and always take on opponents together, even if they greatly outnumber a foe. Their most common way to finish a fight is to gang together and pummel their foe with a litany of kicks from all sides.

entry: POKENAME爱埋进泥里，却常迅速加热，让泥干掉，把自己困住。此时会发出可爱的叫声求助，同类总会来救。
author: orionsayshi
source: POKENAME love to bury themselves in mud, but they heat it up quickly enough that they often become trapped as it dries. When this happens they will emit an adorable cry to plead for assistance. Other POKENAME always come to their aid.

entry: POKENAME出了名爱唱反调，偏要让人怎么不方便，怎么来。它的毒液造成的灼痛，还能持续数周。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME are notoriously contrarian and enjoy being as inconvenient as possible. Their toxin causes a burning sensation that can last for weeks.

entry: 若坏运气接连不断，或许就是受了POKENAME的诅咒。它正义感强烈，会把不幸带给自己认定的恶人。
author: sajochi
source: If you are having a string of bad luck, a POKENAME may have cursed you. This Pokémon has a strong sense of justice and will bring misfortune to those it deems evil.

entry: POKENAME结成小群，合力照料植物、帮助树木生长。种出的树果，往往偏苦或偏辣。
author: sk372
source: Gathered together in small packs, POKENAME work together to tend to plants and help trees grow. Berry-bearing trees grown by POKENAME tend to have bitter or spicy-tasting berries.

entry: 感到危险时，POKENAME会尖叫，同时让尾巴上的火焰猛涨，提醒全群。大家会朝敌人扔小火球，直到危险过去。
author: sk372
source: Should POKENAME feel endangered, it will shriek and flare up the fire on its tail, alerting the rest of the pack. The whole group will fling small fireballs at the foe until the danger has passed.

entry: POKENAME从角放出一轮猛烈火焰后，会凶狠嚎叫。声音传过崎岖地形，数英里外仍有回声。
author: .izik
source: After launching a barrage of flames from its horn, POKENAME lets out a fierce howl. The sound echoes for miles across rugged terrain.

entry: 描绘中世纪的作品常出现POKENAME。据说背弃誓言、堕落的骑士，尤其爱选它作伙伴。
author: sk372
source: Images of POKENAME appear often in depictions of medieval times. It's said that it was the partner of choice to knights who became corrupt, breaking or forsaking their oaths.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，刀刃手臂会热得通红。每击都能留下灼热伤口，灼痛久久不散。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's bladed arms glow red-hot during battle. Each strike delivers searing cuts that leave a lingering burn.

entry: POKENAME会结小群，共同指挥劈斩司令和戴鲁比等宝可梦。若同类间对指挥体系意见不一，就以光明正大的决斗解决。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gather in small groups to act as co-commanders over Pokémon such as Bisharp and Houndour. Disagreements in command structure between POKENAME are settled by honorable duels.

entry: 它仍会捉弄其他对象，却比从前更加混乱。不分敌友，据说走到哪里都能闹得天翻地覆。
author: salt
source: It still plays tricks on others, but it is now more chaotic than ever. It does not differentiate between friend and foe and is said to cause mayhem everywhere it goes.

entry: POKENAME会玩耍般地朝情绪低落的同伴嚎叫，往往立刻让它平静，使全群重新振作。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME playfully howls near members of its pack that show signs of being downtrodden. This tends to calm them instantly, allowing the pack to rally.

entry: POKENAME很合群，能迅速与训练家亲近，喜欢一起跳舞玩耍。它夜间活动，还常弄醒训练家，硬要整夜陪玩。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are highly social Pokémon and quickly bond with their Trainers, enjoying dancing and playing with them. They are nocturnal and have a habit of waking their Trainer and insisting on play throughout the entire night.

entry: POKENAME会在没有月光的夜里聚集，围圈跳舞，用听着不祥的吟唱交流。它们似乎格外容易被一身黑的青少年训练家吸引。
author: .jerden
source: Groups of POKENAME gather on moonless nights to dance in circles, communicating with each other through ominous-sounding chanting. They seem to be drawn towards teenage Trainers who dress all in black.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时会蜷起，众多尾巴紧裹身体。若被惊醒，就会不停吠叫，最长十分钟才平静。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps curled up with its many tails wrapped tightly around its body. If startled awake, it will bark continuously for up to ten minutes before settling down.

entry: POKENAME会靠近孩子，装成小狗，盼有人收养自己。独自待着，就会心情低落。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME approaches children and acts like a puppy to try to get adopted. When alone, it gets depressed.

entry: POKENAME头上的骨质罩让它看不见，会朝遇到的陌生气味来源又剪又咬。它会轻咬年长同伴的耳朵，表示敬意与顺从。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME snip and bite at foreign scents they stumble upon, as they cannot see due to the bony cap on their heads. They nibble on the ears of older members of the pack to signal respect and subservience.

entry: POKENAME用各种叫声互通消息，将猎物逼入绝境。年长的POKENAME，皮毛会泛起黑曜石般的光泽。
author: krune
source: POKENAME communicate with each other using a variety of cries in order to corner their prey. A long-lived POKENAME will have fur that shines like obsidian.

entry: POKENAME是无情猎手，先用水晶核心震晕猎物，再跃上背，刺穿皮肤吸取生命力。骨刺的力道，足以突破任何物理防御。
author: partypooperrex
source: POKENAME are known to be ruthless hunters, stunning prey with their crystal core before leaping onto their backs and piercing the prey's hide to drain their life force. These bone spurs can deliver enough force to break any physical defense.

entry: POKENAME能在身上生出小小的蓝色波导火焰，也能吐出波导小火球。群体会一起锻炼波导，朝彼此放火，较量强弱，决定等级。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can create small blue aura flames on their body and even breathe out small aura fireballs. The pack trains together to hone auras, flaring at each other to determine which is stronger and decide the hierarchy.

entry: POKENAME一天能睡上20小时。打哈欠时有时会不小心喷火，靠近时务必小心。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME sleeps up to 20 hours a day. When it yawns, it sometimes accidentally emits hot flames, so caution is advised when approaching it.

entry: POKENAME在变电站附近筑巢，凶猛保卫领地。擅闯者会遭到强烈火焰喷击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME nests near power substations and fiercely defends its territory. Trespassers are met with a blast of intense fire.

entry: 这种POKENAME逐渐适应了与人类共处，喜欢放牧咩利羊等家畜宝可梦。不过，它也常只是作为宠物饲养。
author: krune
source: This POKENAME has evolved to be more integrated with humans. It likes herding Mareep and other creatures common in husbandry. It is often kept as just a pet.

entry: 它会破坏宝可梦群体的行动，看到混乱展开，就忍不住大笑。十分顽皮，爱捉弄其他对象。
author: salt
source: It can be seen sabotaging bands of Pokémon. It seems that seeing the chaos unfold makes it laugh uncontrollably. It is very mischievous and loves to play tricks on others.

entry: POKENAME在黄昏和明亮月夜最活跃。头上火焰虽会排出有害物质，但会烧掉死者灵魂的传闻，并没有依据。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are most active at dusk and during bright moonlit nights. Although the fire coming from their heads does emit harmful substances, the rumors that POKENAME burn away the souls of the deceased are unsubstantiated.

entry: POKENAME群能用心灵感应交流，因为成员彼此共享部分大脑。配合十分致命，连小群也能击倒大得多的猎物。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Packs of POKENAME communicate telepathically, as they each share a piece of their brain with each other. This allows for deadly coordination, with a small pack able to take down much larger prey.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时会用翅膀盖住脸，只露耳朵。睡梦中偶尔轻轻吠叫，回应只有自己听见的声音。
author: .izik
source: When sleeping, POKENAME folds its wings over its face, leaving only its ears exposed. It occasionally lets out soft barks in its sleep, reacting to sounds only it can hear.

entry: POKENAME躲在浅洞里，通过地面震动，感受附近同类的低吼，彼此交流。大型宝可梦走过洞顶，它们便用角刺毒，再全群一起吃。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME hide in shallow burrows, communicating with nearby POKENAME through growls they can feel through vibrations in the ground. They use their horns to stab larger Pokémon that walk over their burrow, poisoning them, then feed on them as a pack.

entry: POKENAME会结小群滚动，偏爱障碍少的开阔地。咆哮有时会被误认成小型发动机的声音。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME roll around in small groups, preferring open spaces with few obstacles. Their roars are sometimes confused with the sounds of small motor engines.

entry: POKENAME小群挤得很紧，分享体热。只有合作围猎时才分开，结束后又重新依偎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME live in tightly packed small herds, keeping close so as to share their body heat with each other. They only separate to coordinate attacks on prey, huddling together once again after the hunt is over.

entry: POKENAME外表像小恶魔，其实友善温顺。媒体作品常让它扮演反派手下，笨拙得逗人发笑。
author: sk372
source: Though it has an impish appearance, POKENAME is rather friendly and docile. It often shows up in media as a comically-inept henchman to villainous characters.

entry: POKENAME会先跳一段节奏鲜明的舞，再从翅膀放出火柱。动作既耀眼，也能震慑对方。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs a rhythmic dance before releasing pillars of fire from its wings. Its movements dazzle and intimidate all at once.

entry: 冷天，POKENAME旋转的舞蹈会散出强热。每踏一步优雅舞步，周围空气就更暖一些。
author: .izik
source: On cold days, POKENAME's swirling dance radiates an intense heat. The air around it warms further with each elegant step.

entry: POKENAME一旦离群，就完全不想狩猎或吃东西。鳞片格外粗糙，伴船游时，只轻蹭船身就能刮掉漆。
author: fiordaliso
source: If isolated from the rest of its group, POKENAME loses all motivation to hunt or eat. Its particularly abrasive scales can strip paint from boats if it merely brushes against them while swimming alongside.

entry: POKENAME虽住在城市外，却臭得像都市烟霾。幸好性情较和平，连夜里最活跃时也不例外。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although it actually lives outside of urban areas, POKENAME smells terribly of city smog. Thankfully, they are relatively peaceful, even during the night: their most active hours.

entry: POKENAME的刺像骨头一样致密，能提供强大防护。它会在沙漠阳光下静晒数小时，一动不动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's spines are as dense as bone and offer powerful protection. It basks silently in the desert sun for hours without moving.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇带着骷髅纹，能阻止捕食者下口。其实味道颇好，也用于某些关都菜肴。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The skull design on POKENAME's mushrooms deter predators from consuming them. Despite this, they are actually quite flavorful and are used in some Kantonian cuisine.

entry: POKENAME是杂食者，会吃树果和鼠类宝可梦。靠近妖精属性宝可梦时会刺痛，因此尽量避开，不过吃洛玫果能减轻这种感觉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are omnivorous creatures that eat a mixture of berries and rodent-like Pokémon. POKENAME avoid Fairy-type Pokémon because they experience a stinging sensation around them; however, they can eat Roseli Berries to reduce that sensation.

entry: POKENAME会烧灌木，吃掉灰烬。这个怪习惯能让身上的叶片保持鲜活健康。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burns bushes with its flames and consumes the ashes. This strange habit keeps the leafy parts of its body vibrant and healthy.

entry: POKENAME结成小群后，会把棍上的火聚在一起，合成大火。全群凝视火焰，就会充满活力，下次协同狩猎也更有效。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME gather in small packs, they hold the flames on their sticks together to create a greater fire. Gazing as a group into the great flame fills them with vigor, making their next coordinated hunt that much more effective.

entry: POKENAME开心就会掉短毛，质地像糖。许多厨师会拿来作配料，甜辣风味能为奶油菜肴增色。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's short fur sheds when it is happy, and it is similar in consistency to sugar. Many chefs use it as a topping, with its spicy-sweet flavor enhancing cream-based dishes.

entry: POKENAME群会在广阔地区狩猎，夜间奔过开阔平原。找到潜在食物后，就嚎叫，把其余同伴引向目标。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME packs hunt over vast areas, racing across open plains at night in search of prey. When they locate a potential meal, they let out a howl that draws the rest of their pack in to their target.

entry: POKENAME会从嘴里喷出滚烫水流，力道出人意料。准备攻击时，骷髅纹会微微发光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sprays scalding water from its mouth with surprising force. Its skull emblem glows faintly when it prepares to attack.

entry: POKENAME天性好斗、领地意识强，会向认定擅闯家园的对象投沙。合起双拳时，打击的力道足以迸出火花。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Aggressive and territorial by nature, POKENAME flings clumps of sand at anyone it considers to be intruding on its habitat. If POKENAME grips its fists together, it can strike hard enough to produce sparks.

entry: POKENAME的身体由煤块构成，会点燃自己的一部分，再以爆发性的力道掷向敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is formed from chunks of coal. It ignites pieces of itself and hurls them at enemies with explosive force.

entry: POKENAME群里跑得最快的，就是实际首领。它会指挥大家利用速度与数量，尽快封住猎物退路，逼入死角。
author: sk372
source: The fastest runner in a POKENAME herd is the de facto leader of the group. It directs them in using their speed and numbers to cut off prey's escape and corner them as quickly as possible.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME会结小群聚在亮着的路灯旁。相互摩擦磁铁，放出一小阵电流，就能交流。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME congregates in small groups around lit lampposts at night. It communicates by rubbing its magnets against each other, producing small bursts of electricity.

entry: POKENAME成群旅行，登上海岸时会齐声嚎叫，数英里外都听得见。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME travels in packs that howl in unison as they breach shorelines. The sound can be heard from miles away.

entry: 它黏糊糊的身体十分灼热，散发腐臭。人们扔饭后剩骨，想安抚它、赶它走，它却当作友谊的表示，反而留得更久。
author: sk372
source: Its goop-like body burns hot and emits a rancid aroma. People throw it bones leftover from meals to appease it and make it leave, but it takes this as a sign of friendship and lingers longer because of it.

entry: POKENAME外表可怕，吓坏多数人，其实很享受陪伴。它不愿离训练家太远，常会潜在对方影子里。
author: wiz0z
source: Though their fearsome appearance frightens most people, POKENAME greatly enjoy companionship. Trainers are likely to find POKENAME lurking in their shadow most of the time, never wanting to be far from them.

entry: POKENAME难过时，会落下极热的泪。越孤独，泪水就越接近沸腾。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sheds extremely hot tears when distressed. The lonelier it feels, the closer these tears come to boiling.

entry: POKENAME凶猛顽强，每次挥拳都会点起黑焰。被火燎伤会十分疼痛，甚至多年后仍然疼。
author: sk372
source: A vicious and tenacious fighter, POKENAME fights by igniting its fists with black flames with every punch it throws. Getting singed by these flames leaves a painful burn that will still hurt even years later.

entry: POKENAME细而能抓握的舌头，力气大得出奇，能轻松缠住、抬起大型生物。唾液会让舔到的对象留下难受而持久的灼伤。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's thin, prehensile tongue is surprisingly strong, able to constrict and lift large creatures with ease. Its saliva leaves a nasty lingering burn on anything it licks.

entry: 吸入POKENAME毒气，会永久灼伤并损害呼吸系统。它会故意拿大角戳其他瓦斯弹，引发爆炸，借此成为首领。
author: soup1900
source: Breathing in POKENAME's toxic gases will permanently burn and damage one's respiratory system. It gains leadership over other Koffing by purposely poking them with its large horns to cause an explosion.

entry: 等待进化的POKENAME几乎不动。一旦受了打扰，POKENAME便发出吠叫，声音足以让人做噩梦。
author: krune
source: POKENAME barely move while waiting to evolve. If POKENAME is disturbed, it will bark with a sound that can give humans nightmares.

entry: POKENAME裹着浓黑烟，走到哪都迸出鲜艳粉红色的火花。它总追着最近的宝可梦，直到对方被两个头骨不断排出的毒气熏昏。
author: tamszen.ore
source: Shrouded in thick black smoke and spraying hot-pink sparks wherever it goes, POKENAME is in a constant chase, following the nearest Pokémon around till they eventually pass out from the toxic gas being produced from within its two skulls.

entry: 终于破茧而出后，POKENAME会找到同类，结伴觅食。小虫、其他虫宝可梦，甚至蜂蜜，都是它们搜寻的目标。
author: krune
source: Having finally emerged from its cocoon, POKENAME find packs of other POKENAME and hunt prey together. They hunt and scavenge everything ranging from small insects, other bug-Pokémon, and even honey.

entry: 曾见POKENAME群通过歌舞竞争，决定等级。这份本领，也让宝可梦华丽大赛选手对它十分向往。
author: wiz0z
source: Groups of POKENAME have been seen competing with one another through dancing and singing to determine hierarchy. These skills have made POKENAME highly coveted by Pokémon Contestants.

entry: POKENAME双颚合不上，嘴里总冒烟，伴着响亮嗡鸣。它战斗时灵巧腾挪，用爪和角劈斩、踢击，也会喷烟遮住敌人视线。
author: oddwalls
source: It cannot close its jaws, so smoke constantly emerges from its mouth, along with a loud buzz. POKENAME fights acrobatically, slashing and kicking foes with its claws and horns while blinding them with smoke.

entry: 日落后，POKENAME会巡游寒冷海岸，哀鸣传过海面，数英里外仍能听见。冰冷黑雾落下之处，会留下烧灼的霜痕，标记过去的猎场。
author: labreezy187
source: POKENAME prowls cold coastal waters after sunset, its mournful cry carrying for miles across the sea. It exhales a freezing black mist that leaves burned frost wherever it settles, marking the sites of its past hunts.

entry: 深夜听见诡异嚎叫，或许是POKENAME正在觅食。受惊时，它会边逃边喷出热焰与浓烟，随后变成另一只宝可梦。
author: sajochi
source: If you hear an eerie howl in the dead of night, it may be a POKENAME looking for food. When frightened, it will attempt to flee while belching hot flames and thick smog before transforming into another Pokémon.

entry: 这些宝可梦曾被认为是冥界仆从，沿河巡逻，吃掉毫无防备的灵魂。它们用铲形尾巴在水中推进。
author: chibitales
source: These Pokémon were once thought to be servants of the underworld, patrolling rivers for unsuspecting souls to devour. They use their spade-shaped tail to propel themselves in water.

entry: POKENAME很聪明，能给自己制作镰刀，既作武器，也能威吓。过去人们认为，夜里见到它，预示自己不久后将死去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is intelligent enough to fashion itself a scythe to use as a weapon and intimidation tool. It was once thought that seeing it at night was an omen that one's death would soon arrive.

entry: POKENAME独居寒山，只在夜里外出捕猎。寒冷吐息哪怕擦过，都可能导致严重冻伤，使对方难以行动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives an isolated existence in frigid mountains, only coming out at night to hunt. Simply being grazed by its chilling breath could lead to severe, debilitating cases of frostbite.

entry: POKENAME的火焰深红，不管淋多湿都不熄灭。喷出的火能连烧数周，任何普通方法都扑不灭。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's flames burn crimson red, never extinguishing no matter how wet they get. The flames they spew can burn for weeks on end, unable to be extinguished by any normal means.

entry: POKENAME无声飞过雷云，长身体藏在烟雾中。诡异嚎叫常被误认成远雷，身后空气里却留着清楚可辨的灰烬气味。
author: labreezy187
source: POKENAME soars silently through storm clouds, its long body hidden by smoke and mist. Its eerie howl is often mistaken for distant thunder, while the air left in its wake carries the unmistakable scent of ash.

entry: POKENAME会在夜空开心地边跳舞边嚎叫。偶尔能在有篝火的庆典附近见到，却只是一闪而过的空中舞姿。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME howls happily while dancing in the night sky. It can rarely be spotted near festivals with bonfires, seen only in glimpses as it dances above.

entry: POKENAME会拿头角摩擦同伴的角，磨得锋利。嘴里喷出的灼热火焰，碰到什么都能烧成灰。
author: fiordaliso
source: It sharpens the horns on its head by rubbing them against those of other members of its pack. POKENAME can breathe scorching flames from its mouth, capable of turning anything it touches to ashes.

entry: POKENAME嘴里始终灼热，咬上一口痛苦难忍：咬力大、牙尖，还不肯松口，咬伤周围又会被高热烫伤。
author: sk372
source: The inside of POKENAME's mouth is perpetually burning hot. Bites from it are excruciating: besides its bite force, sharp teeth and refusal to let go, the heat of its mouth leaves scalding burns around the bite wound.

entry: POKENAME夜间捕猎，会用收集的骨头装饰身体。饰物最大、最气派的个体，会被公认为群体首领。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME hunt their prey at night. They decorate their bodies with the bones they collect, and the individual with the largest and most impressive ornaments is recognized as the leader of their parliament.

entry: POKENAME披着高贵斗篷般的羽毛，是优雅的学者。它用四只发光眼睛研究宇宙，借精神力量预测星辰运行。
author: ambrosia04
source: Dressed in regal, cloak-like feathers, POKENAME are elegant scholars. They use their four glowing eyes to study the cosmos, predicting the movements of the stars with their psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME会从尾尖射丝，一接触就灼烧目标。据说被它袭击，会招来厄运。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME fires silk threads that burn on contact from the tip of its tail. Getting attacked by a POKENAME is said to bring misfortune.

entry: POKENAME虽然极常见，一群却很少超过十二只，因为不断争夺首领，常让大群分裂成小群。
author: alestrius
source: Though extremely common, swarms of POKENAME rarely number more than a dozen because constant fighting for leadership results in splits and fragmentation of the larger group.

entry: POKENAME跳得极高，常从活火山脚跃到山顶筑巢。群体中，角越长、越卷，地位也越高。
author: shreks_stepfather
source: POKENAME can jump very high and often leaps from the base to the top of active volcanoes, where it prefers to make its nest. In a POKENAME pack, longer and curlier horns indicate higher ranking.

entry: POKENAME进化后会离群，寻找其他进化个体结伴。新群体凶猛得多，因为每个成员都清楚地位。它们会朝猎物吐有毒黏胶，减慢行动。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Upon evolving, POKENAME leave their pack to seek other evolved POKENAME. These packs are far more ferocious, as each member knows its place. They spit a toxic, adhesive gel at prey to slow movement.

entry: 红色POKENAME不同于其他个体，会留在未进化的同伴身边。它从不自力更生，因此始终没能成熟，同伴却仍尊重它，献上猎物最好的部分。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Unlike other POKENAME, a red POKENAME stays with its unevolved packmates. Since it never fends for itself, it fails to mature, yet its packmates still treat it with respect and offer the finest portions of prey.

entry: POKENAME的超能力攻击造成的痛苦，只有另一只POKENAME才能治好。但它们只愿治疗自己信任的训练家。
author: darkweavile428
source: The pain from POKENAME's psychic attacks can only be cured by another POKENAME. However, they will only cure a Trainer that they trust.

entry: POKENAME只准训练家摸角，而且必须先赢得信任。嘴里喷出大股火焰时，身上的环纹就会亮起。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME allows only its Trainer to touch its horns, and only once that trust has been earned. When it breathes gouts of fire from its mouth, the rings on its body begin to glow.

entry: POKENAME只准训练家摸角，而且必须先赢得信任。嘴里喷出大股火焰时，身上的环纹就会亮起。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME allows only its Trainer to touch its horns, and only once that trust has been earned. When it breathes gouts of fire from its mouth, the rings on its body begin to glow.

entry: POKENAME把外来的火吸入背上头骨，助长自身火焰。这样做时，骨中会传出尖叫般的声音。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME absorbs flames into the skull on its back to fuel its own fire. Scream-like sounds emanate from it when it does this.

entry: POKENAME会指挥一群年幼同类，协调袭击卖食物的商店，尽量多偷再逃走。它总分到最多，同伴却只能吃残羹。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME commands a pack of its younger brethren. It will coordinate attacks on stores selling food to steal as much as the pack can before fleeing. POKENAME gets the biggest piece of the pie while its brethren are stuck eating scraps.

entry: POKENAME渴望战斗，会裹着黑焰猛烈痛打对手。可常为了耍帅勉强身体，最后把自己的铠甲熔掉。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME yearns for battle, cloaking itself in dark flames while violently pummeling its opponents. However, it often pushes its body too far in an attempt to look cool and ends up melting its own armor.

entry: 成群的POKENAME通常不自己觅食，而是找只小宝可梦，用角欺负它，非逼它带路找吃的不可。
author: incognito1234
source: POKENAME packs typically do not search for food on their own. Instead, they find a smaller Pokémon and bully it with their horns until it leads them to food.

entry: POKENAME的岩浆身体被深色毒素浸染。如果被它烧伤，疼痛将永不消退。
author: asyoko
source: It's body is made of magma stained by dark toxins. If a POKENAME's molten body burns you, the pain will never go away.

entry: POKENAME壳里漏的液体看似熔岩，其实是极热唾液。吠叫时，唾液一阵阵向外飞溅，让附近对象轻微烫伤。
author: .izik
source: The liquid leaking from POKENAME's shell resembles lava but is actually an incredibly hot saliva. When barking, this saliva splatters outward in bursts, causing minor burns on those nearby.

entry: POKENAME会展翅飞过夜空，成群捕猎。白天在旧建筑顶筑巢，尤其偏爱有石雕滴水兽的建筑。
author: .jerden
source: Their wings enable POKENAME to fly through the night sky, hunting in packs for prey. During the day, they nest on top of old buildings, with a particular preference for structures with stone gargoyles on them.

entry: 融合后，POKENAME更疏离，也更爱独处。战斗时喷出漆黑火焰，哪怕稍擦到皮肤，也会留下疼痛的深色灼伤。
author: sk372
source: After fusion, POKENAME's personality becomes more aloof and solitary. In battle, it breathes out pitch-black flames that will leave painful dark burns on skin with just a slight grazing.

entry: 裹住身体的烈焰燃得极猛，已呈蓝白色。它骇人的模样，启发历代无数诗人与画家，创作出举世赞赏、富有张力的作品。
author: fiordaliso
source: The blazing flames coating its body burn so intensely that they have taken on blue and white hues. Its terrifying appearance has inspired countless poets and painters throughout history to create dramatic works celebrated across the world.

entry: POKENAME会高高俯视小型宝可梦，显示优势。不高兴时，就会烦躁地喷出一股火。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME towers over smaller Pokémon to assert dominance over them. Whenever it gets upset, it breathes out a plume of fire in frustration.

entry: 古老传说称，POKENAME会怒冲出湖水，严惩胆敢污染湖泊的家伙。华美鬃毛间点缀着火星，直到怒气平息才会熄灭。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to an ancient legend, POKENAME would emerge furiously from the lake waters to fiercely punish anyone who dared to pollute them. Its magnificent mane is studded with fiery embers that burn until its rage is appeased.

entry: POKENAME天生爱打架，总挑战比自己大得多的路人。尾巴强得能碾碎骨头，每场战斗后，却又得修补尾巴。
author: redmagecole
source: A scrappy fighter by nature, POKENAME constantly challenges passersby that are far bigger than it to fisticuffs. Its tails are strong enough to crush bone— requiring POKENAME to have to mend its tails after every fight.

entry: 即使进化成POKENAME，它在黑鲁加一系的群体里，仍是未成熟的跟随者，只会模仿命令，指使年轻成员。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are still immature followers of a Houndoom-related pack, even when evolved to a POKENAME, so they merely mimic orders and directions to boss young members of the pack around.

entry: POKENAME会飞着寻找冲突。看见有人避免争端、尊重别人，就从上方撒下让大家开心的粉；若遇到争斗，就会从天上喷出让人痛苦万分的火焰。
author: grannyjojophone
source: POKENAME fly around, searching for conflict. If a person is seen avoiding conflict and respecting others, it will sprinkle dust that makes anybody happy from above. If it finds somebody in conflict, it will spew extremely painful flames from above.

entry: POKENAME会把尖尾插进电脑接口，吸取数据。进食时，头角会热得通红，碰到就烫伤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME inserts its pointed tail into computer ports to absorb the data inside. While it feeds, the horns on its head grow red hot and can burn on contact.

entry: POKENAME擅长挖掘，会把受害者埋起来，直到只剩下白骨。随后，它会挖出骨骸，拿来玩耍。
author: d_numeritos
source: POKENAME excels at digging, burying victims until only bones remain. It then unearths them to play with their skeletal remains.

entry: POKENAME喜欢扮出恶魔模样，吓得其他对象胆寒，不过全是在演。它其实很怕真打，看似喝下的血，也只是树果汁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME delights in casting a devilish appearance that strikes fear in the hearts of others, though it is all simply an act. It is actually quite afraid of actual combat, and the blood it appears to drink is simply berry juice.

entry: POKENAME能随意生成黑焰，据说燎到的对象会一直被烧。它不特别好斗，却常以火威吓，阻止别的对象太靠近训练家。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can generate black flames at will that are said to never stop burning those singed by them. It is not particularly aggressive, but will often summon the fire as a threat display to those getting too close to its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME吵闹又蛮横，爱炫耀火焰吓唬人。即使训练家下令，也只能稍稍压下攻击性。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a boisterous and thuggish personality, showing off displays of its flames as a form of intimidation. This aggression can only be cowed marginally at the behest of its Trainer's commands.

entry: POKENAME像故事里的巫师，能独特地操纵玻璃，靠自身高热塑形。没人知道，左臂为何显得枯瘦病弱。
author: mercsthorn
source: This Pokémon resembles a sorcerer from a story. POKENAME has a unique ability to control glass, sculpting the material through the intense heat it produces. No one knows what causes this Pokémon's left arm to appear withered and sickly.

entry: POKENAME很受军旅老兵喜爱，常在战争前线凭凶猛刀刃压过其他宝可梦。离开不断战斗的生活后，它很难适应。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are a favourite Pokémon of army veterans and are often on the frontlines of war, their vicious blades giving them the edge over other Pokémon. They have trouble adapting to life away from constant battling.

entry: POKENAME漂来漂去，身体纹丝不动，也不露情绪，只有火焰大小或许透露心情。据说看进背洞，灵魂就会被拖进冥界。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats around motionless and emotionless, with only the size of its burning flame possibly indicating its mood. It's said gazing into the hole in its back will drag a person's soul into the underworld.

entry: POKENAME能发出响亮尖叫，配上用于威吓的巨大头部，让不少靠近者远远躲开。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME are capable of creating loud shrieks. Combined with the giant head used for intimidation, many stray far away from them.

entry: POKENAME每吸收一团火，背上的燃烧头骨就会咆哮。吸够后，便释放毒烟，把周围罩进漆黑毒云。
author: quackquackattack
source: The fiery skull atop POKENAME's back roars with each flame absorbed. Noxious fumes are released when POKENAME have absorbed enough flames, shrouding the area around them in a dark, toxic cloud.

entry: 传说，这些宝可梦守着通往灵界的大门。风吹过牙齿间隙，便传出仿佛有人痛苦呜咽的声音。
author: wormspawn
source: Legends say these Pokémon guard the gates to the spirit world. When the wind passes through their teeth, they make sounds like someone whimpering in pain.

entry: POKENAME虽原始，却拥有惊人的力量。可大多时间都在懒散度日，或毫无缘由地用骨头敲打岩石。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is primitive, but it has incredible powers. However, it spends most of its time lazing around or hitting rocks with its bones for no reason.

entry: POKENAME常结成最多十五只的大群。曾见它们跟在大型拖网渔船后面，却并不是冲着鱼来的。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are usually seen in large pods, up to fifteen. They have been seen following behind large fishing trawlers, though not for the fish.

entry: 与土台龟不同，POKENAME不照顾身上生长的生命。它在废弃城市里翻找，搜罗更称心的装饰。
author: vaporvenator
source: Unlike Torterra, POKENAME does not take care of the life that grows on it. It scavenges abandoned cities in search of more preferable ornamentation.

entry: 别看POKENAME的模样，它们其实顽皮爱捣蛋，喜欢点燃物件，四处吓人。东西倒不会烧坏，却要留下好几天的硫黄味。
author: sajochi
source: Despite its looks, POKENAME are mischievous tricksters who enjoy setting objects aflame to scare anyone it can. The items it ignites are unharmed but will have a lingering smell of sulfur on them for a few days.

entry: POKENAME能完美融入黑暗，因此夜里最活跃。头角和尾尖都带着强效毒液。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can blend perfectly into the darkness, which is why it is most active at night. Both its horn and the tip of its tail are infused with a powerful venom.

entry: 领地行为与地狱般的外貌，让人相信POKENAME曾守着冥界大门。刀刃上有奇怪文字，语言学家至今没解开。
author: .fedoraman
source: Its territorial behavior and infernal appearance lead to beliefs that POKENAME guarded the gate to the underworld. They have strange letters on their blade that linguists have not yet deciphered.

entry: 这一对刀刃优雅而致命地配合，镰刀挥动勾住敌人，匕首随之刺入。偶尔也让人挥舞，却传说所有使用者很快都会遭厄运。
author: .jerden
source: This pair of blades works together in elegant but deadly harmony, with the swings of the sickle catching foes so that the dagger can sink in. Occasionally, they allow a person to wield them, but it is said that all who do will soon meet their doom.

entry: 这一对刀刃优雅而致命地配合，镰刀挥动勾住敌人，匕首随之刺入。偶尔也让人挥舞，却传说所有使用者很快都会遭厄运。
author: .jerden
source: This pair of blades works together in elegant but deadly harmony, with the swings of the sickle catching foes so that the dagger can sink in. Occasionally, they allow a person to wield them, but it is said that all who do will soon meet their doom.

entry: POKENAME个头庞大、模样吓人，统治着诞生的火山。群体会用两根巨角彼此冲撞，想把对手撞进岩浆，争当火山之王。
author: redmagecole
source: POKENAME's large, menacing stature makes it rule over the volcanoes in which they were born. Packs of POKENAME will compete to become king of the volcano by ramming their two great horns into each other to knock each other into the magma.

entry: POKENAME战斗中会召出大片火山灰，隐藏自己。格外愤怒时，身体骨质的部分会亮得通红。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME summons large clouds of volcanic ash to conceal itself in battle. When it gets especially angry, the bony parts of its body will glow red hot.

entry: 据说POKENAME到来就预示混乱，火焰能烧毁整片森林。人们通常将它与邪恶和毁灭联系起来。
author: salt
source: It is said that the arrival of POKENAME is a sign of chaos. Its fire is said to be capable of burning entire forests. This Pokémon is usually associated with evil and destruction.

entry: POKENAME长触须的末端极热，抽打距离最远可达30英尺。它会在敌人或物体上留下烧得通红的鞭痕，标记领地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's long feelers are tipped with intensely hot ends. It whips them from up to 30 feet away to leave red-hot lash marks on foes and objects to mark its territory.

entry: POKENAME只需挥手，就能让黑焰裂地喷出。古文明的预言家曾认为，它会焚尽世界，审判人类。
author: sk372
source: With a wave of its hand, POKENAME can cause dark flames to crack the earth and erupt from the ground. Prophets from ancient civilizations once believed POKENAME would pass judgement on humanity by setting the world aflame.

entry: 传说POKENAME从天降下，以永不熄灭的火焰烧灼大地，就会迎来末日。相信的人很少，却都准备得狂热。
author: sk372
source: Legends say that the end of days will come from POKENAME descending from the sky and scorching the earth with flames that will never stop burning. Few believe the stories, but those that do are manic in their preparations.

entry: POKENAME有时会给上流阶层的孩子当保镖。它极护训练家，毫不犹豫就会烧伤对方的敌人。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are sometimes seen as bodyguards for elite children. They are very protective of their Trainers and will not hesitate to burn their Trainer's enemies.

entry: POKENAME会发出超声波，赶走领地里的其他宝可梦。人类听不见，因此常无意间闯入。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME release an ultrasonic noise that wards off other Pokémon from their territory. Humans are unable to hear this noise, leading to them wandering into POKENAME territory by accident.

entry: POKENAME每月聚集一次，升起熊熊大火，在月下围着跳舞。没能参加的个体，会苦闷阴沉得怎么安慰也没用，直到下次机会。
author: sk372
source: Once a month, groups of POKENAME will gather together and create a roaring fire, dancing around it beneath the moonlight. A POKENAME unable to attend the gathering becomes inconsolably bitter and sullen until the next opportunity arises.

entry: 暴怒的POKENAME造成的身体疼痛，只有等它平静才会减轻。有记载说，攻击引起的剧痛，会让人完全失去清醒思考与判断。
author: bobosmith01
source: Any physical pain inflicted by an enraged POKENAME only subsides when the POKENAME calms down. It has been written that the pure agony caused by its attacks completely overrides one's sense of clarity and judgement.

entry: POKENAME会扇翅，贴近地面飞。野生个体避开人类，阴森怪笑若吓不走，就会喷出诡异银光，造成痛苦灼伤。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME flaps its wings to fly around just above the ground. Wild POKENAME avoid humans, and if their sinister cackling does not frighten people away, they will attack with blasts of eerie silver light that cause painful burns.

entry: 某些偏远地方把POKENAME奉为骑拉帝纳的使者。它会借速度，用镰刀打出猛烈一击，毛皮却极其柔软。
author: nyoomymph
source: In some remote places, POKENAME is worshipped as a messenger of Giratina. POKENAME uses its speed to deliver devastating blows with its scythe. Its fur is incredibly soft.

entry: 看见POKENAME，被视为死亡的预兆，因为它似乎只在人将逝去前现身。人们相信，它会吃掉亡者灵魂，再将邪恶的魂送往冥界。
author: sajochi
source: The sight of a POKENAME is considered an omen of death, as it only seems to appear shortly before a person passes on. People believe this Pokémon consumes the souls of the departed, and sends wicked souls to the underworld.

entry: POKENAME战斗时会从嘴排出黑烟，人们认为是在释放过剩的龙属性能量。爪子留下的伤口，会灼痛好几天。
author: chibitales
source: When in battle, POKENAME emit a dark smoke from their mouth that is thought to be excess Dragon-type energy being released. Wounds left by POKENAME's claws leave a burning sensation for several days.

entry: 这种记仇的融合体若不小心被踩，就会用恶意能量之爪撕伤冒犯者，留下灼痛疤痕。
author: hophoppip
source: When this vengeful fusion is accidentally trampled, it rends the offender with a claw of malicious energy, leaving a burning scar.

entry: 传说，POKENAME是冥界守门者，为亡魂开路，等它们走过，再锁上身后的门。它们全身滚烫，仿佛刚从烤炉中出来。
author: knilk
source: Folklore speaks of POKENAME as the gatekeeper of the underworld, opening the way for the souls of the departed and locking the gates behind them. Their bodies are always burning hot, as if they had been left in an oven.

entry: POKENAME威武又吓人，能用多尾操纵火与影。鲜红眼睛锐利，动作优雅，在野外既迷人，又危险。
author: segmoph
source: This majestic yet menacing Pokémon commands both fire and shadow with its multiple tails. Its piercing red eyes and elegant movements make POKENAME a captivating yet dangerous presence in the wild.

entry: 传说心不纯的人真诚许愿时，POKENAME就会现身。它愿意实现愿望，换取自己认为等值的生命力。
author: fancyskunk
source: According to legend, when someone with an impure heart makes an earnest wish, a POKENAME will appear before them. The POKENAME will agree to grant the wish in exchange for what it deems to be an equivalent amount of life force.

entry: POKENAME转动齿轮，便传出不安、近乎超自然的声响。小齿轮能离开身体自由行动，却必须在破晓前回来，否则可能丧命。
author: sajochi
source: An unsettling, almost supernatural sound is emitted when a POKENAME spins its gears. The minigear can move freely from the body, but must return before daybreak or else it may perish.

entry: 它无目的地飘过墓地与古战场，颈间项链咔嗒作响，让人听得寒毛直竖。
author: krune
source: It floats aimlessly around graveyards and places where wars have been fought. Its necklace rattles with a chilling sound that sends shivers down one's spine.

entry: POKENAME无声飞过夜空，翅膀拖着硫磺气味。飞行中会发出诡异嚎叫，吓猎物一跳，再俯冲攻击。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME flies silently through the night, trailing the scent of brimstone on its wings. It emits eerie howls mid-flight, startling prey before diving in to attack.

entry: POKENAME会成群巡视大片林地，拾食并摸清周围地形。极敏感的触须能捕捉各种叫声，让它与远方同类交流。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME roam in swarms, sweeping large tracts of woodland to scavenge for food and map out the nearby environment. POKENAME can communicate with other faraway POKENAME by using various cries that they detect with their very sensitive feelers.

entry: POKENAME爱用咬东西、咬人的方式玩耍，咬伤却会刺痛好几天。最好备个皮皮玩偶，让POKENAME咬着玩。
author: sajochi
source: POKENAME loves to play by biting anything and anyone. It is recommended to keep a Poké Doll around for POKENAME to play with, as this Pokémon's bite will cause a stinging pain for a few days.

entry: POKENAME常住在沥青坑，受困宝可梦的骨头会卡进身体。古生物学家请它取回化石，它却很难整理好体内的骨头。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is often found living in tar pits, where bones of trapped Pokémon become stuck within its body. It is utilized by paleontologists to recover fossils, but it struggles to keep the bones organized within its mass.

entry: POKENAME随群游海，谁敢闯入领地就与谁恶斗。颚力极强，若小看它，连船的钢铁外壳也会被咬坏。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME swims through the seas with its pack, brawling with anyone who dares invade its territory. Its incredibly strong jaws can damage even the steel hulls of ships that underestimate it.

entry: POKENAME能闻到数海里外的猎物。一旦找到气味痕迹，就能连追数天不停。利牙崩缺后，立刻长出一整套锋利新牙，旧牙随之脱落。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can pick up the scent of prey from many nautical miles away. Once it detects a trail, it can pursue its target for days without stopping. When its sharp fangs chip, it immediately grows a new, razor-sharp set, shedding the old ones.

entry: POKENAME是记仇的森林小灵，会悄悄靠近领地入侵者，用尾巴戳刺。尾尖扎中后会刺痛灼伤，皮肤上必会留下铲形印记。
author: sk372
source: A vindictive little forest spirit, POKENAME sneaks up on trespassers in its territory before poking them with its tail. Being jabbed by the tip of its tail leaves one with a stinging burn that inevitably leaves a spade-shaped mark on the skin.

entry: POKENAME悲痛的叫声启发过许多葬礼进行曲，因此常被当作死亡象征。战斗时会用火焰翅膀打击，造成痛苦烧伤。
author: mepp.
source: The sound of POKENAME's dolorous cries have inspired many funeral marches, leading them to be commonly viewed as a symbol of death. In battle, POKENAME strike opponents with their flaming wings to inflict painful burns.

entry: POKENAME好斗残酷，多数人都躲着它，却也能成为某些人的忠诚伙伴。它常与有烦恼的孩子或欺负同学的孩子建立感情。
author: dylonk25
source: Though avoided by most for its combative and cruel nature, POKENAME can be a loyal companion to some. It tends to form bonds with troubled children or school bullies.

entry: POKENAME很护着自己美味的蘑菇，会用火焰咬击和锋利的尾状刺针，赶走所有靠近者。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are quite protective of their delicious mushrooms. With a fiery bite and a sharp tail-like stinger, they ward off all who approach.

entry: POKENAME会磨牙，在头上附肢点起黑焰，再低吼警告其他对象离开。不理会的，就会遭火球喷击，留下疼痛持久的灼伤。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME grinds its teeth together to create black flames upon the appendage on its head, growling deeply to warn others away. Those who do not heed the warning get blasted with fireballs that will leave painful and long-lasting burns.

entry: POKENAME会点燃背上火焰，照亮蘑菇的脸，吓跑捕食者。安全后，就自己笑起来，散播孢子，长出更多笑脸蘑菇，标记领地。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME ignite flames along their backs to illuminate the faces on their mushrooms and scare off predators. They laugh to themselves once they're safe, spreading spores to grow more smiling mushrooms and mark their territory.

entry: POKENAME会吃其他宝可梦的骨头，吸收足够钙质，让全身象牙般的鳞片保持强韧。喷火前，会摇响这些骨板，威吓敌人。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME feeds on the bones of other Pokémon to absorb enough calcium to keep the ivory scales covering its body strong and resilient. Before breathing fire, it rattles those bony plates to intimidate its foes.

entry: POKENAME会吹动舌头上的火焰，将火喷出。舌头上火焰最大的，通常也是群里最强势的个体。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME blows on its tongue's flame to shoot fire. The POKENAME with the largest flame on its tongue is typically the most dominant in the pack.

entry: POKENAME背上涌出的烟滚烫。一与猎物对上眼，就会立刻发出令人发寒的嚎叫。
author: .izik
source: The smoke that billows from POKENAME's back is scalding hot. It lets out a chilling howl the moment it locks eyes with its prey.

entry: 吸入POKENAME四处散布的孢子，喉咙就会产生难以忍受的灼痛，而且永远无法完全消退。
author: fenragon
source: The spores POKENAME scatters everywhere cause unbearably painful burns in the throat when inhaled. This pain will never completely fade.

entry: POKENAME会从地里现出三颗火焰头，每颗都能喷出灼热烈焰。据说嚎叫预示栖息地火山喷发。
author: segmoph
source: POKENAME emerges from the ground with three fiery heads, each capable of unleashing scorching flames. Its howls are said to predict volcanic eruptions in its habitat.

entry: POKENAME顽皮，近乎以折磨对方为乐，因此名声很差。成群作乱，活像邪恶小鬼。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME have garnered a negative reputation due to their mischievous, borderline sadistic nature. The chaos POKENAME gangs wreak on others is akin to an evil imp.

entry: POKENAME生性凶猛，一声嚎叫就能吓跑其他宝可梦。狩猎虽狠，却很善变，扔来点心就容易分心。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are ferocious creatures that scare away other Pokémon with a single howl. Despite their aggressive hunting style, they are fickle enough to be distracted by treats thrown their way.

entry: 有些传说里，它们潜伏冥界，焚烧恶魂。四处游荡时，硫黄味也如影随形。
author: skymaster426
source: In some legends, it is said that these Pokémon lurk in the underworld, burning evil souls. When they wander, the smell of sulphur follows.

entry: 往昔，POKENAME一声夜嚎，便足以引发恐慌。被它袭击的村庄，等到日出，就已不复存在。
author: skymaster426
source: In the past, a POKENAME's howl in the night would be enough to cause a panic. A village it attacked would no longer exist by the time the sun rose.

entry: POKENAME历来被视为灾祸使者，凶相加上偏爱强大的大字爆炎，显得威胁十足。深入了解它的训练家，却会发现凶恶外表下藏着体贴的性情。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are traditionally seen as heralds of doom, their fierce appearance and preference for battling using powerful Fire Blasts lending them an air of menace. Trainers who look beyond their fearsome exterior find them to be very caring Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME历来被视为灾祸使者，凶相加上偏爱强大的大字爆炎，显得威胁十足。封建时代，它曾因角而被捕猎，骨质的角被当作战利品保存。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are traditionally seen as heralds of doom, their fierce appearance and preference for battling using powerful Fire Blasts lending them an air of menace. POKENAME were hunted for their horns in feudal times, the bones being kept as trophies.

entry: POKENAME最爱用超能力折磨人。变出的汤匙一旦弯曲，毫无防备的受害者，心智也会随之扭曲。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME aims above all else to torment humans with its psychic prowess. As one of its conjured spoons bends, so too bends the mind of an unwitting victim.

entry: POKENAME用80条毒触手困住猎物。角最大的，就是群体首领。
author: jodue
source: POKENAME traps its prey with its eighty venomous tentacles. POKENAME with the biggest horns is the leader of the pack.

entry: POKENAME夜间狩猎时，煤块身体会点燃，明亮燃烧。掉下的煤块也能继续烧上好几天。
author: hophoppip
source: When POKENAME hunts in the night, its coal body sets alight and burns brightly. Chunks of coal that fall from POKENAME will keep burning for days.

entry: 野生POKENAME领地意识强，十分好斗，会用火裹身威吓敌人。即使被训练家捕获驯养，仍常凶猛地护着对方。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME are aggressively territorial and clad their bodies in flame to intimidate foes.  Even after being caught and tamed by a Trainer, these Pokémon will oft be aggressively protective of them.

entry: 古老预言中，四只POKENAME会在世界末日疾驰而过。因此，它们走到哪里，便把恐惧带到哪里。
author: nellnast42
source: Ancient prophecies describe four POKENAME riding at the end of the world. As such, these Pokémon bring fear wherever they go.

entry: POKENAME喜欢用角钩住树枝，旋转着跳进附近池塘或湖。难免有跳偏的时候，有些就会点燃枝叶茂密的灌木泄愤。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy looping their horns onto tree branches to spin and jump into nearby ponds or lakes. When they inevitably miss the water, some POKENAME vent their fiery wrath by setting leafy bushes on fire.

entry: POKENAME污泥身体毒性和酸性极强，因此呈深红色。裸露皮肤哪怕只沾一滴，都会剧痛灼伤，留下永久痕迹，疼痛也永不消退。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is a deep red due to how toxic and acidic the sludge of its body has become. Merely a drop on bare skin will cause excruciating burns that will leave permanent marks and never stop hurting.

entry: 吓坏的训练家会警告别人，有些洞里会有“怪异的蛇狗”钻墙进来，大声吠叫。其实只是POKENAME凶巴巴地索要抚摸。
author: redmagecole
source: Terrified Trainers warn others of caves where they claim "freakish snake-dogs" will tunnel in through the walls to bark loudly at them. In reality, these are just POKENAME ferociously demanding to be petted.

entry: POKENAME会用摆锤哄受害者入睡，大吃噩梦。受害者心越不纯，梦就越可怕，它也越满意。
author: acid_pen
source: POKENAME feasts on the nightmares of its victims that it lulls to sleep with its pendulum. The more impure the victim's heart is, the worse the nightmares the victim experiences, and the more satisfying the meal is for POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME钳内会亮得通红，煮沸周围海水。大群能显著提高栖水温度，离开后效果仍会持续。
author: santon5512
source: The insides of POKENAME's claws glow red-hot, boiling the water around them. Large groups of these Pokémon are capable of dramatically raising the temperature of the water they live in, with this effect persisting even after these Pokémon leave.

entry: POKENAME在森林里跳跃时，会把尾巴盘在背上。受惊或接近猎物时，又迅速伸尾，把自己弹向前方。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME coil their tails on their back while they hop across the forest. If they're startled or approaching prey, they will rapidly extend their tails to propel themselves forward.

entry: POKENAME有锋利毒牙，能抵御飞行属性宝可梦。受到威胁时，尾端响环会摇动，警告捕食者保持距离，否则就咬。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have sharp, venomous fangs that protect them from Flying-type Pokémon. The rattle at the end of their tail shakes when they feel threatened, warning predators to keep their space or get bitten.

entry: POKENAME分泌的特殊紫丝，在高级时装业很受追捧。想捉它的捕食者，会被它咬伤中毒，以此自卫。
author: fiordaliso
source: It secretes a special purple silk that is particularly sought after in the high fashion industry. POKENAME defends itself from predators that try to catch it by poisoning them with its bites.

entry: POKENAME的多个头从篮状身体里蜿蜒伸出，模样古怪。许多吹长笛或其他木管乐器的人，会奏曲压制它的暴力冲动。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are a bizarre sight to behold, their multiple heads slithering out from their basket-like body. Many who play flutes or other woodwind instruments play songs to control their violent urges.

entry: 格外顽皮的瓦斯弹和阿柏蛇常彼此吸引，结伴惹出双倍麻烦。许多反派团体用它们捣乱，身边也常有狡猾喵喵。
author: sk372
source: Particularly mischievous Koffing and Ekans are often drawn to each other to cause double the trouble. Many villainous teams have used them to cause hijinks, often accompanied by crafty Meowth as well.

entry: POKENAME会把尾巴缠在树枝上，耐心等进化。舌头极敏感，能察觉逼近的捕食者。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will wrap their tails around tree branches, patiently waiting to evolve. Their tongues are incredibly sensitive, allowing them to sense approaching predators.

entry: 若有东西靠近、可能威胁蛋，POKENAME就会吞下蛋逃走。重新安全后，再吐出来，继续细心照料。
author: sk372
source: If something approaches that could threaten the egg, POKENAME swallows it and flees. Once it feels safe again, it regurgitates it back out and resumes its nurturing ways.

entry: POKENAME能轻松挤进窄缝，静静节省体力，等猎物路过。使出强力大蛇瞪眼后，数百条附肢就会缠住猎物，再咬出更多伤口，注入毒液。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Able to easily squeeze into tight spaces, POKENAME quietly conserve their energy as they wait for food to wander by. After a powerful Glare, hundreds of appendages grapple onto prey to inflict further bite wounds and inject venom.

entry: POKENAME身体大多中空，能迅速整口吞下小型水生宝可梦。头角是震慑捕食者的好武器，对鸟类尤其有效。
author: infinex21
source: Most of an POKENAME's body is hollow, allowing it to quickly swallow smaller aquatic Pokémon whole. Their horns are effective weapons for deterring predators, especially bird Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME常见于草原，吃小型虫属性宝可梦。翅上鲜明的眼状花纹，能威吓敌人。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is commonly found in grasslands and eats small Bug-type Pokémon. The distinct eye-like pattern on its wings intimidates foes.

entry: POKENAME会折起身体，等猎物经过。捉住后，就会试着把猎物扯开。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME folds itself up as it waits for prey to walk by. When they are caught by POKENAME, it will try to stretch them apart.

entry: POKENAME会用浸毒的丝减慢其他虫属性宝可梦。等缠得够牢，再用头上的刺针或小獠牙注毒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME slow down other Bug-type Pokémon with their venom-soaked silk. Once properly encumbered, they inject venom through the stinger on their head or their small fangs.

entry: POKENAME鳞片磨成粉，能作天然解毒剂，但它天性好斗，找鳞片很危险。趁蜕皮季收集，才是最安全的办法。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME scales can be ground into a natural antidote for venom, but finding POKENAME scales is dangerous due to its natural aggression. Harvesting these scales during shedding season is the safest way to acquire scales.

entry: 它无定形的身体能挤进小缝。毒液并不致命，不过被咬过的受害者说，好像骨头都变成了果冻。
author: mistymagius
source: Its amorphous body allows it to squeeze into small gaps. Its venom isn't deadly, but bite victims have described feeling like their bones had turned to jelly.

entry: POKENAME在坚韧茧里发育，抵御恶劣天气。它会摇响尾端响环，吓跑捕食者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME develop inside a tough cocoon that protects them from harsh weather conditions. They scare away predators by shaking the rattle at the end of their tails.

entry: POKENAME埋在河床，只将眼睛露出沉积物。毫无戒心的宝可梦从上方经过，就会遭到突然迅疾的扑击。
author: vracken
source: POKENAME buries itself in riverbeds with only its eyes exposed above the sediment. When an unsuspecting Pokémon passes overhead, POKENAME emerges in a single speedy lunge.

entry: POKENAME身体肥重，行动笨拙，脑子却狡猾。它会设陷阱困住猎物，再整口吞下。
author: partypooperrex
source: POKENAME's fat body and immense weight makes movement cumbersome, but it has a cunning intellect. POKENAME are known to make traps to ensnare its prey before swallowing them whole.

entry: POKENAME以灵活身体闻名，方便逃避捕食者。遇险时，野生群体常四散逃跑，结果聚成的群也常变少。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME are known for their agile bodies, which are helpful when escaping from predators. Packs of wild POKENAME tend to scatter during dangerous situations, often leading to fewer groups of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME虽有惊人精神力量，却总被尾巴分心。尾巴仿佛有自己的想法，不受控制地乱甩。
author: bostroms
source: Despite possessing incredible psychic power, POKENAME is constantly distracted by its tail, which flails about uncontrollably as though it has a mind of its own.

entry: 有故事说，POKENAME的毒液能制成治愈百病的解毒剂。可惜它太罕见，相关酊剂配方又已失传，数十年没再见过这种药。
author: .izik
source: There are stories of POKENAME's venom being used to create antidotes capable of curing any disease. Unfortunately, due to their rarity and the recipes for these tinctures being lost, no such antidotes have been seen for decades.

entry: POKENAME很保护栖居的花园。它会摇尾警告不喜欢的来者，再朝不理会的对象，射出锋利如刀、沾着毒液的叶子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite protective of the flower gardens it inhabits. It warns those it dislikes with a shaking of its tail before letting loose razor-sharp leaves laced with some of its venom at those that don't heed its warning.

entry: 大颚上覆着的毒黏液，连卡比兽也能放倒。POKENAME密集的沼泽，常会禁止新手训练家进入。
author: schwaus
source: It covers its jaws with a venomous mucus that can knock out a Snorlax. Swamps with high populations of POKENAME are often closed off from novice Trainers.

entry: POKENAME能一动不动地潜在水下，盯着猎物好几个小时。一旦落入巨颚，便很难逃脱。
author: schwaus
source: POKENAME can lie still and stalk its prey from under the water for hours. Once prey gets caught in its jaws, they rarely escape.

entry: POKENAME会模仿阿柏蛇，威吓想捕食它的家伙。咬伤虽有毒，毒性却不足以造成明显反应。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME mimics an Ekans to intimidate would-be predators. While its bite is venomous, its venom is not strong enough to have noticeable side effects.

entry: 它飞着觅食时，会发出嘶声，吓唬小型生物。敏感舌头能察觉附近目标。
author: .izik
source: While flying in search of prey, it emits a hissing sound that intimidates smaller creatures. Its sensitive tongue can detect the presence of nearby targets.

entry: POKENAME会摇响触角末端，警告袭击者离开。振动也会刺激内部发电器官，对方若不退，就会挨一记疼痛电击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rattles the ends of its antennae as a warning for attackers to stay away. The vibrations stimulate electrical organs within, so if predators persist, POKENAME gives them a painful zap.

entry: POKENAME会先电麻猎物，再张大嘴整口吞下。消化后，会进入格外兴奋的状态，追逐其他宝可梦取乐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME paralyze their prey with a jolt of electricity before stretching their mouths wide to swallow their prey whole. After digesting their prey, they enter into a hyper state where they chase after other Pokémon for entertainment.

entry: 它能让颚关节脱开，吞下几乎与自身同大的东西。因此，一顿能吃的食物，远比想象中大。
author: .izik
source: Its jaw can unhinge, allowing it to swallow objects nearly as large as its own body. This adaptation helps it consume meals far larger than expected.

entry: 科学家尚不清楚，这种宝可梦为何觉得待在蛋里最好。有人推测，可能是想让作为猎物的鸟类或虫类宝可梦觉得没那么可怕，也可能是为了更好地抵御捕食者。
author: opossiblymage
source: Scientists aren't certain why, but this Pokémon decided it was best to stay within its egg. It is theorized that it is to appear less threatening to bird or bug Pokémon prey, or perhaps for added protection from predators.

entry: 它的巢铺着黄羊毛，既能伪装，也能保温，让蛋安全又暖和。
author: .izik
source: Its nest is lined with yellow wool, providing both camouflage and insulation. This cozy hideout keeps its eggs safe and warm.

entry: 登山男从山上跌落时，救援队会派POKENAME去救。它虽然爱救人，谁抓得太紧，仍会猛咬过去。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When Hikers fall off mountains, POKENAME are sent by rescue teams to save them. While POKENAME loves saving people, POKENAME will snap at those that grip too hard.

entry: 它的身体轻，能轻松漂过草甸。浮动的方式，常让追踪的捕食者摸不着头脑。
author: .izik
source: Its light body allows it to drift effortlessly through meadows. This floating motion often confuses predators trying to track it.

entry: 它穿过荨麻时，会蜕下粗糙皮肤，保持敏捷。沿途便留下脱落的鳞片。
author: .izik
source: As it walks through nettles, it sheds its rough skin to maintain its agility. This process leaves a trail of discarded scales.

entry: POKENAME长大时会生出一颗种子，遇险就缩进去封好，像个包裹。身体大得装不下时，又会像蜕皮一样，重新长一颗。
author: thordemidgard
source: As they age, POKENAME grow a seed; when danger is near, they recoil inside and seal it like a bundle. When an POKENAME grows too big to fit inside its seed, a new one will grow, in the same way they shed their skin.

entry: 它会低飞过沼泽，寻找小型猎物伏击。速度快得眨眼就消失，是很有本领的猎手。
author: .izik
source: It flies low over swampy areas, scanning for small prey to ambush. It flies fast enough to disappear in the blink of an eye, making it a highly skilled predator.

entry: 把少量POKENAME毒液加入绿色果汁，以求健康益处，正越来越流行。据说其中含有自然界最高浓度的抗氧化物。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: An increasingly popular trend is to use the venom from POKENAME in a Green Juice for its health benefits in small quantities. It is believed to contain the highest concentration of antioxidants in nature.

entry: POKENAME会趁其他宝可梦外出觅食，潜进洞穴，把大张的嘴抵在入口。办法虽简单，却很能捉到较小的宝可梦。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will infiltrate the burrows of other Pokémon while they are out foraging, pressing their wide-open mouths against the entrance. Despite the simplicity of this strategy, it has proven to be quite effective at catching smaller Pokémon.

entry: 它无声飞过夜空，从嘴里射毒针狙击猎物。精准一击，让猎物无处可逃。
author: .izik
source: Flying silently through the night sky, it shoots venomous needles from its mouth to snipe prey. This precision attack leaves no chance for escape.

entry: POKENAME主要吃腐烂树果，让身体保持酸性，也滋养背上的毒花。因此常被请去处理坏水果和腐败食物。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its diet consists mostly of rotten berries, which it uses to keep its body acidic and to nourish the poisonous flower growing on its back. Due to its eating habits, POKENAME is often employed to dispose of spoiled fruit and rancid food.

entry: POKENAME坐在草原，等待猎物经过。一餐可能要好几天才消化完，这期间会吸收太阳能量。
author: mcnchsschl_69424
source: POKENAME sits in grasslands, waiting for prey to pass by. It can take several days before a meal is fully digested, during which POKENAME absorbs energy from the sun.

entry: 它会在门上啃洞，偷偷进屋，洗劫食品储藏室。利牙连最坚韧的障碍也能迅速啃开。
author: .izik
source: It gnaws holes in doors to sneak into homes and raid pantries for food. Its sharp teeth make short work of even the toughest barriers.

entry: POKENAME虽会嘶叫、跺脚，想吓唬附近来者，其实害羞温顺，其他野生宝可梦一靠近就可能逃走。两颗头都能吃东西，口味却不同。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although it may try to hiss and stomp to intimidate those nearby, POKENAME is actually shy and meek and is likely to flee if approached by other wild Pokémon. Both of its heads can eat food, but have different preferences.

entry: POKENAME虽会嘶叫、跺脚，想吓唬附近来者，其实害羞温顺，其他野生宝可梦一靠近就可能逃走。它会在草原拾食。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although it may try to hiss and stomp to intimidate those nearby, POKENAME is actually shy and meek and is likely to flee if approached by other wild Pokémon. It scavenges for food in the grasslands.

entry: POKENAME挂在树枝上时，会摇尾警告靠近的捕食者。每块甲片也覆着薄毒，进一步赶走不理警告的家伙。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rattles its tail as a warning to predators that come close to it while it dangles from tree limbs. Each plate of its body is secreted in a fine layer of poison, further repelling predators that don't heed its warning.

entry: POKENAME常懒懒晒太阳，积蓄暖意。被打扰就会抬尾，准备用钻头般的刺针攻击。研究者发现，毒液只会造成轻微肚痛。
author: sleepyman0731
source: POKENAME commonly laze about in sunlight, gathering warmth. If disturbed, POKENAME raise their tail, poised to attack with their drill-like stinger. Researchers discovered that POKENAME's poison only causes a mild stomach ache.

entry: 它会蓬起耳朵、抬高身体，显得更大，先威吓敌人，再用獠牙袭击。第一口若不够，就会咬住不放，直到毒液完全注入。
author: .izik
source: It fluffs up its ears and raises itself onto the back of its to appear larger, intimidating foes before striking with its sharp fangs. If the first bite isn't enough, it will latch on and refuse to let go until its poison is fully injected.

entry: POKENAME身体太长，既难飞行，也难保持直立。不过仍有剧毒，不宜靠近。
author: vaporvenator
source: POKENAME struggles to fly or keep an upright posture due to its excessively long body. It is still highly venomous and should not be approached.

entry: POKENAME必须定期吃树液，否则獠牙毒性就会减弱，几乎无法再用于捕猎或自保。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's biology requires it to ingest tree sap on a regular basis. If it doesn't, the venom in its fangs loses potency and becomes nearly useless for hunting and self-preservation.

entry: POKENAME身体由熔融毒液构成。它会包住小型宝可梦，让毒液侵入，再吃掉虚弱的猎物。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's body consists of a molten, toxic liquid. It smothers small Pokémon to envenomate them before consuming the weakened prey.

entry: 它背上看似壳的部分，其实是紧盘的尾巴，能迅速弹出毒刺一击。想躲藏时，尾巴展开，黏稠的上半身便挤入地下。
author: imaginita
source: What appears to be a shell on its back is actually a tightly coiled tail. This position allows the tail to quickly strike with a venomous jab. When it needs to hide, the tail uncoils, and the viscous upper body smushes into the ground.

entry: 宽大的翅膀与强健肌肉，让这副奇特身体也能飞行。它常袭击鸟宝可梦的巢，将蛋整个吞下。
author: vaporvenator
source: Large wings and strong muscles allow its peculiar body shape to fly. It will often raid the nests of bird Pokémon to swallow their eggs whole.

entry: POKENAME的牙浅，毒液特殊，很受偷猎者欢迎。毒液能把猎物变成干尸，让偷猎者从猎杀中获取最大价值。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are a popular choice among poachers because of their shallow fangs and special venom. Their venom mummifies their prey, which helps poachers gain the most value from the kill.

entry: 准备进化的细胞失去平衡时，阿柏蛇可能长出第二颗头。已准备好进化的新头，会渐渐主导身体的思考，让第一颗头只能吃剩饭。
author: pixlhoopa
source: When an imbalance of cells that are ready for evolution occurs, an Ekans may find itself with a second head. The second head, primed for evolution, slowly becomes the dominant thinker of the body, leading to the first head consuming scraps of a meal.

entry: POKENAME能从鼻子喷酸团，吓退捕食者，或软化食物。不过最好别吃软化过的东西，因为它不善于按不同用途调整酸液毒性。
author: .izik
source: It can shoot globs of acid from its nose to deter predators or soften food. It is advised not to eat food soften by an POKENAME, as they have trouble altering the toxicity of their acid for different tasks.

entry: POKENAME会用响尾吸取电子设备的电力，融入咬住攻击。储能时，尾巴会鲜亮发光。
author: chibitales
source: Using its rattling tail, POKENAME siphons electricity from electronics to use in its Bite attacks. Its tail glows vibrantly as it stores this energy.

entry: POKENAME会用尾巴挂在电线上。缺能时，便吸取线中电力，也会旋转手臂，加快吸收。
author: m1918_94884
source: POKENAME use their tails to hang from electrical wires. When drained of energy, they sap electricity from the wires and spin their arms to absorb the energy faster.

entry: POKENAME没有毒液，也没有獠牙，便靠颈褶上的可怕脸孔吓退捕食者。它会藏在高草中，等小型猎物路过。
author: santon5512
source: To make up for their lack of venom and fangs, POKENAME ward off predators with the frightening face on their frills. They will hide out in the tall grass, waiting for smaller prey to wander by.

entry: POKENAME靠近雷之石，尾端响环就会本能摇动。只有觉得受威胁，又无路可逃，才会用毒牙咬击。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME finds itself near a Thunder Stone, the rattles on its tail instinctively begin to shake. It bites with its venomous fangs only when it feels threatened and sees no way to escape.

entry: POKENAME像藤蔓与蛇缠成的一团活结，作为单一生物行动。它会完全缠住猎物，再配合着接连毒咬数十次。
author: oejoeboy33
source: POKENAME resembles a living knot of vines and snakes that moves as a single organism. It entangles prey completely, then delivers dozens of coordinated poisonous bites.

entry: 利爪虽带剧毒，平日却主要用来挖土。战斗时，POKENAME更爱盘起身体，抖响尾巴，让来犯者知难而退。
author: frokachu
source: Though its claws carry potent poisons, they are mostly used for digging. In battle POKENAME prefer to coil up and rattle their tail to discourage attackers.

entry: 它上方的爪子会渗微量毒液，从地下伏击猎物。尾巴缠住对方后，便不断刺划，直到屈服。
author: infinex21
source: Trace amounts of venom secrete from its upper claws. It ambushes prey from underground, constricting them with its tail as it jabs and slashes until they submit.

entry: POKENAME的鳃会分泌微毒，一碰就头痛。它对人和宝可梦很友善，开心地亲蹭时，常不小心把毒液涂在对方身上。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's gills secrete a weak toxin that induces an immediate headache on contact. It is friendly to humans and other Pokémon, so it often accidentally slathers them in the toxin while nuzzling joyfully against them.

entry: POKENAME鲜艳体色和摇响的尾巴，能警告捕食者离开。若不奏效，身体便覆上使敌人晕眩的毒膜。鳍能感知附近活动，因此很少受惊。
author: pjporwoll
source: The vibrant coloration and rattling tail of POKENAME act as warnings for predators to leave it alone, but a poisonous, disorienting film covers its body if the foe is undeterred. Its fin helps it detect nearby movement, so it is rarely surprised.

entry: 陌生训练家靠近时，POKENAME会游出来，看是不是善良的人。若感到敌意，就会藏进高草，向内蜷起，尽量显得小。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When unfamiliar Trainers walk nearby, POKENAME slithers out to see if they are kind souls. If POKENAME senses aggression, it will hide in tall grass, curling inward to make itself seem smaller.

entry: POKENAME用头上舌状的附肢感知气流变化，寻找猎物。尾尖发出的声响，则用来御敌，连最强悍的生物，也会吓退。
author: krune
source: POKENAME use their tongue-like appendages on their heads to sense changes in the air currents, helping them locate prey. Their tail-tips are used to ward off attackers, producing a sound that scares even the toughest creatures.

entry: 过去传说看进POKENAME的眼睛就会石化，其实没那么神奇。头上的许多阿柏蛇，会本能地用精神力量使对方晕眩，以此防御。
author: sk372
source: It was once said that gazing into POKENAME's eyes would turn one to stone, but the truth is more mundane. The many Ekans on its head use psychic powers to stun others as an instinctive defense mechanism.

entry: 野生POKENAME敌意很强，却很懒。多数洞穴里，通常都能找到偷懒的个体。
author: k1n1t0.xo
source: Wild POKENAME are known to be hostile, but lazy. A wild POKENAME can usually be found slacking off in most caves.

entry: POKENAME靠吃烂树果和坏水果，维持身体酸性。背上的毒花也吸取同样毒素，因此是果园和城镇清理废物的珍贵帮手。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's acidic body is sustained by consuming rotted berries and spoiled fruit. The poisonous bloom on its back feeds on the same toxins, making it an invaluable Pokémon for cleaning waste in orchards and towns.

entry: POKENAME相当胆小，会在灌木底层伪装成普通植物。潜在威胁靠得太近，就摇响尾巴，想将其吓走。
author: mcnchsschl_69424
source: POKENAME is quite cowardly, disguising itself as a regular plant in the undergrowth. If a potential threat comes too close, it rattles its tail to scare it away.

entry: 它会从别的巢偷蛋，放进自己巢里，当作亲生幼崽养。这种怪习惯，让它总有幼崽可保护。
author: .izik
source: It steals eggs from other nests, placing them in its own to raise as its own offspring. This unusual behavior ensures it always has young to protect.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片由钢构成。古时，人们会把它蜕下的皮做成护臂。
author: mossybanana
source: POKENAME's scales are made of steel. In ancient times, the shed skin was used as an armor sleeve.

entry: 传说POKENAME只消一眼，就能将活物化为石头。头上的每条阿柏蛇，都拥有自己的意识。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: Legends say a mere glance from POKENAME can turn living things into stone. All of the Ekans on its head are sentient.

entry: 家人受威胁，POKENAME就会迅速吐出强毒，赶走袭击者。进食时会整吞猎物，可能花好几天才能消化完。
author: fiordaliso
source: If its family is threatened, POKENAME swiftly drives attackers away by spitting potent venom. When feeding, it swallows prey whole and may take days to fully digest it.

entry: POKENAME察觉灾难，会跑过附近村落，大声摇尾警告。若警告被无视，就会烦躁，常朝幸存者发作。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: When it senses disaster, POKENAME will run through nearby villages, rattling its tail loudly in warning. When its warnings are ignored, it becomes agitated, often lashing out at any survivors.

entry: 墓地传来嘶声，很可能是POKENAME躲在碑后无声漂动。虽有毒牙，性情却害羞，很少攻击人或宝可梦，更喜欢远远观察。
author: fiordaliso
source: If hissing is heard in graveyards, POKENAME is likely drifting unseen behind a tombstone. Despite its venomous fangs, this shy creature rarely attacks Pokémon or humans, preferring to observe them from afar.

entry: 耳上的刺带剧毒，能注入造成长时间麻痹的毒素，是强大的自卫手段，让它很难对付。
author: .izik
source: The spines on its ears are highly venomous, injecting a toxin that causes prolonged paralysis. This defense makes it a formidable foe.

entry: POKENAME的身体能伸得远比普通剑长。它会绕过刀刃，利用铠甲弱点，用毒牙咬入，赢得胜利。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can extend the length of their body much longer than a typical sword. They maneuver around blades to exploit weaknesses in armor and sink their venomous fangs to secure victory.

entry: 它进食时会大声摇响尾巴，饿了也会如此。声音是在警告其他对象，别碰它的食物。
author: .izik
source: It rattles its tail loudly while eating, a behavior it also exhibits when hungry. This noise warns others to stay away from its meal.

entry: POKENAME会用透视力找到洞里的猎物，柔韧身体连最小入口也能钻入。它以小群狩猎。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME uses its X-ray vision to find prey hiding in burrows, then slithers its flexible body into even the smallest entrance. POKENAME hunts in small packs.

entry: 多出的头没有大脑，只是一张张额外的嘴。POKENAME能将它们弹出，够到身体碰不到的食物。
author: melodydelune
source: Its extra heads contain no brain, but they work as extra mouths that POKENAME can launch to reach food its body can't.

entry: 入侵者进入领地，POKENAME会摇响尾端铃铛警告；若不肯离开，就用强壮身体冲撞。嘴里能分泌酸性极强的毒液，很受化工企业珍视。
author: fiordaliso
source: When intruders enter its territory, POKENAME rattles the bells on its tail as a warning; if they refuse to leave, it charges them with its powerful body. It can secrete a highly acidic venom from its mouth, prized by chemical companies.

entry: 头上的火焰缓缓熔化混有毒物的蜡质身体，产生几乎难以察觉的有毒蒸气。
author: chorb33
source: The flame on its head slowly melts the wax of its body, which is mixed with noxious substances. This produces toxic, barely noticeable vapors.

entry: 虽然右臂也有意识，科学家仍一致认为，POKENAME的整个身体由头部控制。
author: chorb33
source: Although its right arm is also conscious, scientists agree that POKENAME's head is controlling the whole body.

entry: 它积蓄热量、准备喷火时，尾端响环会迅速摇动。摇动的尾巴越多、摇得越快，火焰就越猛烈，变化也越繁复。
author: .izik
source: The rattles on its tails shake rapidly as it gathers heat to shoot out flames. As more of its tails vibrate faster, the flames grow more intense and elaborate.

entry: POKENAME喜欢收集小饰品，挂在身上。只要不再咬住尾巴，财物就会掉落丢失。
author: henry9000
source: POKENAME likes to collect trinkets and attach them to its body. If it ever stops biting its tail, its valuables will fall off and get lost.

entry: POKENAME靠一只长袜伪装。被摇晃时，会发出咔啦声，表示不满。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a long sock that they rely on for a disguise. When shaken, they produce a rattling sound to show their frustration.

entry: POKENAME有力的尾巴能突然伸出惊人距离。捉住猎物后，就会缩回地下洞穴。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's powerful tails can suddenly stretch surprising distances. Once they have snatched up prey, POKENAME retreats back to its underground den.

entry: POKENAME喜欢潮湿草地。目光令人不安，动作又快又突然，因此不太受小朋友欢迎。自卫时，会从獠牙分泌强毒。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME prefer damp grassy places to live. As they have an unsettling stare and move around swiftly and unexpectedly, they tend to not be very popular among young children. For self-defense, they secrete a powerful venom from their fangs.

entry: POKENAME虽然会筑坝，却觉得无聊又累，常干脆只用庞大身体堵河。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: Though they can make dams, POKENAME find this a boring and tiring task. Often, they block rivers with nothing but their own oversized bodies.

entry: POKENAME除拳脚外，也会把尾巴当鞭，击打、绊倒敌人，抢占优势。尾尖是感知其他生物波导的器官，因此很难被偷袭。
author: sk372
source: In addition to punches and kicks, POKENAME uses its tail as a whip to strike and trip up foes to give it an edge in combat. The tip of its tail is an organ for sensing the aura of other creatures, making it difficult to sneak up on.

entry: 多数POKENAME会把战斗交给年长同伴。若被困住，就突然从尾巴放出强光，晃花它认定的捕食者的眼睛。
author: bobosmith01
source: Most POKENAME leave fighting to older members of its pack. If cornered, it will suddenly emit a bright light from its tail to blind the perceived predator.

entry: POKENAME的利牙不只有毒，还能放出强电。毛皮带静电，粗糙得摸着不舒服。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME's sharp fangs pack not only venom, but also strong bolts of electricity. Their fur is staticky and rough, unpleasant to the touch.

entry: POKENAME极柔韧，能挤进很窄的地方。爪上既带电又有毒，十分危险。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME are immensely flexible, allowing them to fit into very tight spaces. POKENAME's claws have both electricity and venom, making them quite dangerous.

entry: 真身藏在中空却坚固的假身里，能随意控制它。近敌时，会从眼孔或口孔猛扑出来，毒伤对方，再缩回防护壳。
author: sk372
source: The true body hides within a hollow, yet sturdy false body that it controls at will. It lashes out at close opponents, striking out from the eye or mouth holes to poison a foe before retreating back within its defensive shell.

entry: 人们发现POKENAME脑部活动低得惊人，情绪却强烈。有些宝可梦张大嘴是为了捕猎，它似乎只是觉得活着很开心。
author: chinigan
source: It's been discovered that POKENAME's brain activity is shockingly low, but their emotions are strong. Some other Pokémon keep their mouths agape to catch prey, but POKENAME seem simply joyous to be alive.

entry: POKENAME会伪装成蛋，等猎物靠近。对方一试着攻击蛋形伪装，它就突然伏击，整口吞下。在沙漠里，这种伪装更难识破。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME disguises itself as an egg and waits for prey to come close. Once their prey tries to attack its egg-like disguise, it ambushes and swallows them whole. This disguise is harder to spot in the desert sand.

entry: 它会蜿蜒穿过转动的中空齿轮，似乎从中获取能量。一旦分开，蛇形身体就会无精打采，几乎无法动弹。
author: sk372
source: It snakes its way through the hollowed gears as they turn, seemingly deriving energy from them. Should the serpent be separated from them, it becomes listless and almost immobile.

entry: 索罗亚与阿柏蛇的融合，原本被寄望成为更好的除虫帮手。可喵喵依旧远更受欢迎，喜欢这种融合体的人，也就少得多。
author: elfail0
