source: This fusion, which combines Zorua with Ekans, was originally proposed as a possible means of better pest control. Unfortunately Meowth continued to be widely more popular, relegating this fusion to a much smaller following.

entry: POKENAME尾焰释放毒气，让附近植物的叶子枯萎。它至少五只结群生活、狩猎，因此很少遇见完全独处的个体。
author: fiordaliso
source: The flame on its tail releases poisonous gases that cause nearby plant leaves to wither. POKENAME lives and hunts in small groups of at least five members, making it rare to encounter one completely alone.

entry: POKENAME遇到同类，会在空中跳起轻盈的舞，伸缩身体，表示同类间的亲近。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME perform a light, airy dance in the sky when they meet another POKENAME. They expand and contract their bodies to signal kinship with each other.

entry: POKENAME把毒液以橙色凝胶形式存于体表，也能挡开打击。它会硬化凝胶攻击，刺穿厚韧外皮，注入储存的毒液。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME stores its venom around its body in the form of an orange gel that also serves to deflect blows. It hardens this gel to strike at prey, piercing through leathery hide to inject the venom around its body.

entry: POKENAME会用毒牙咬住猎物和敌人，一听到突来的大声响却会逃跑。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME sink their venomous fangs into prey and enemies alike, but flee when they hear sudden loud noises.

entry: POKENAME长得很快，经常蜕鳞。据说身体每条环带代表一个月，很多高龄个体有60至72道，甚至更多。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shed their scales often because they grow quite fast. Each band on their body is said to represent one month, with many having upwards of 60 to 72 bands at their oldest.

entry: POKENAME会蜕下淡紫色的鳞片，磨粉可作强化骨骼的补充剂。邪恶组织曾想驯养、生产鳞片，却被毒牙里的毒液击退。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shed orchid scales that can be ground into a supplement that makes one's bones stronger. Villainous organizations have attempted to domesticate POKENAME for scale production but have been repelled by the venom from their fangs.

entry: 它能让颚关节脱位，试着整吞大食物，不过有时仍会卡住。战斗时格外凶猛，越打身体越热。
author: infinex21
source: It can dislocate its own jaw to try to swallow larger foods whole, though sometimes the food will still get stuck. It shows a much more ferocious side during battle, its body growing hotter as it fights.

entry: POKENAME长尾的缠绞力，足以碾碎肚子般大的石头。吐向敌人的火带有毒素，很难扑灭。
author: infinex21
source: Their long tails have enough constricting power to crush rocks as large as their bellies. POKENAME spit flames at their enemies; these flames are laced with toxins that make them difficult to snuff out.

entry: 它会紧咬敌人，最多注入1升毒液，让猎物无法动弹，毫无防备。
author: .izik
source: It clamps onto its enemy tightly, injecting up to a liter of venom. This attack leaves its prey immobilized and vulnerable.

entry: POKENAME会咆哮、露牙威吓其他宝可梦。更大的宝可梦来救场时，常会放弃猎物，因为只有能整口吞下，才能吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME intimidate other Pokémon by releasing loud roars and brandishing their fangs. They often give up their prey if a larger Pokémon comes to the rescue, as they can only eat if they can swallow their prey whole.

entry: 有人说，POKENAME的模样就足以让一切僵在原地。不过许多真正面对过它的，都说自己只是被满头蠕动、形似阿柏蛇的发丝吓僵了。
author: infinex21
source: Some claim that the look of an POKENAME is enough to make anything become frozen in place. Though many who have actually faced one have said they frozen in fear of the many moving strands of Ekans-like hair upon their heads.

entry: POKENAME喜欢躲在灌木丛中。若被发现，就会迈着小短腿试图逃走。
author: kitarchen
source: POKENAME tend to hide themselves in scrub brush. If they are discovered, they will use their tiny legs to attempt an escape.

entry: POKENAME是狡猾的伏击猎手，埋在沙漠里，再突然扑向毫无防备的猎物。它能迅速展开盘尾，猛烈地把自己弹上去。
author: joeofthealps
source: Cunning ambush predators, POKENAME lies buried under desert sands before launching itself at unsuspecting prey. It does this using its tail, which it can rapidly uncoil to propel itself violently upward.

entry: POKENAME能吐甜香毒液，最强烈的反应要过一阵才出现，因此许多人误当作无害。它其实视力差，靠地面震动察觉其他生物。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is able to spit a sweet-smelling toxin. As the venom has a delayed release of its most potent side effects, many discount the fluid as harmless. POKENAME actually has poor eyesight and relies on vibrations from the ground to sense others.

entry: POKENAME滴落的酸液腐蚀性极强，一接触，就能溶穿皮肤和骨头。虽然狩猎十分方便，它却常为无法拥抱所爱而难过。
author: creaturecore
source: POKENAME drips such a corrosive acid that contact with it can melt through skin and bone. While this is extremely helpful for hunting prey, POKENAME often laments that it can't give hugs to those it loves.

entry: POKENAME蜿蜒前进时，身上覆盖着一堆活沙，随身体移动。沙地中的小宝可梦，往往在它出击前，都没发现它靠近。
author: hophoppip
source: A living pile of sand covers POKENAME as it slithers, moving with its body. Small Pokémon in sandy environments rarely see it coming before it strikes.

entry: POKENAME没有能抓捕猎物、撕碎植物的钳子，因此采取伏击。背上的蘑菇，就是引诱受害者的饵。
author: oddwalls
source: Because it lacks pincers for catching prey or tearing up plant matter, POKENAME is an ambush predator. The mushrooms on its back serve as bait for its victims.

entry: POKENAME生活在沙地，张开大嘴滑过沙中猎食。身体会变形，让无法消化的东西穿过去；沿途抓到的猎物，则被许多向内的牙齿困住。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME live in sandy areas, hunting prey by gliding through the sand with their mouths wide open. Their bodies shift, letting anything they cannot digest pass through. Any prey captured in their glide is trapped by their many inward-pointing teeth.

entry: 毒液储存在头顶帆状器官中，需用时流入舌头。它冷得能冻伤皮肤，也常被用来制作解毒药与灼伤药。
author: krune
source: Its poison is stored in sails on its head, and it flows into its tongue when needed. The poison gives a chilling effect that can freeze skin, so its poison is often used for making both Antidotes and Burn Heals.

entry: POKENAME全身的许多眼睛，帮助它时刻提防天敌。碰到身上的帆，则会中毒。
author: krune
source: POKENAME have many eyes on its body to help it stay alerted to predators.  Its sail is poisonous to the touch.

entry: 身上的宝石由毒液结晶而成。虽然受到收藏家追捧，却仍具有剧毒。
author: krune
source: The gems on its body are made of crystallized venom.  These jewels are sought after by collectors, but remain highly toxic.

entry: POKENAME深居简出，野外偶遇谁，就会直视对方眼睛。目光使对方陷入无梦的沉睡，让它轻松脱身。
author: sk372
source: A reclusive creature, POKENAME will gaze into the eyes of any who happen upon it in the wild. This stare causes the other party to fall into a deep and dreamless sleep, allowing POKENAME to make an easy getaway.

entry: POKENAME的长脖子不便穿过高草，因此采取伏击。背上的蘑菇，就是引诱受害者的饵。
author: oddwalls
source: Because its long neck makes movement through tall grass awkward, POKENAME is an ambush predator. The mushrooms on its back serve as the bait for its victims.

entry: POKENAME成窝的蛋，会产在树木和其他大型生物上。蛋慢慢吸取宿主生命，只有宿主完全衰亡后，才会孵化。
author: afilthycasual
source: Clutches of POKENAME eggs are laid in trees and other large fauna. These eggs slowly leech the life from their host and only hatch after it has completely withered away.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上看似响尾的部分，其实是第三朵蘑菇，滋味与另两朵不同。每隔几个月，它都会蜕下尾菇，再重新长出。
author: oddwalls
source: What appears to be a rattle on POKENAME's tail is actually a third mushroom, which tastes different from the other two. POKENAME sheds and regrows the tail mushroom every few months.

entry: POKENAME住在高草中，挖出植物，吞吃根部。背上蘑菇色彩明亮，很容易被看见，可多数捕食者都知道，它毒性太强，不值得冒险攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lives in tall grass, digging up plants to devour their roots. The bright colors of the mushroom on POKENAME's back make it highly visible, but most predators recognize that its poison is too potent to be worth attacking.

entry: POKENAME十分难觅。谁靠得太近，它就低吼，鳞片全都如铃铛般震响。咬击有毒，因此多数人不愿触碰。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a very elusive creature; if someone gets too close, it growls and rattles all its scales like a set of bells. Its bite is venomous, which is why most people avoid touching it.

entry: POKENAME十分胆怯，一有风吹草动，就迅速逃开，寻找藏身处。沿途会留下淡淡的毒黏液痕迹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a skittish sort, darting away at the first sign of trouble and finding somewhere to hide. It leaves a faint trail of poisonous ooze in its wake.

entry: 害怕时，它会紧紧蜷起。有些人以为，里面藏着珍贵宝石；可被POKENAME咬住、注入毒液后，通常就会后悔这个念头。
author: hophoppip
source: It curls up tightly when it's frightened. Some people believe it's hiding precious gemstones inside its curled form, but those people usually regret their beliefs when POKENAME bites them and injects its venom.

entry: 每隔一个月左右，头皮便会蜕下，露出底下柔软的刺。再花一个月变硬，之后又会蜕一次。
author: st4rdustyugure
source: Every month or so, the skin on its head sheds, revealing the soft quills underneath. It then takes a month to harden before shedding again.

entry: POKENAME的触角，总指向视野里最亮的光源。想抢先同类占住新发现的光时，它会大声摇响尾巴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's antennae always point toward the brightest visible light source. It will rattle its tail loudly when trying to obtain the newly found light before others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME迅速吐舌，品尝空气，辨认附近宝可梦的气味。察觉更大的宝可梦靠近，就会跳水，尽可能潜到深处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME rapidly stick their tongue out to taste the air, picking up the scent of other Pokémon in the area. They leap into the water and swim as deep as they can if they taste the approach of a larger Pokémon.

entry: 尾焰释放的毒气，会让附近植物的叶片枯萎。POKENAME以至少五只为一群生活、狩猎，很少落单。
author: fiordaliso
source: The flame on its tail releases poisonous gases that cause nearby plant leaves to wither. POKENAME lives and hunts in small groups of at least five members, making it rare to find a solitary individual.

entry: POKENAME失去耐心时，尾端的响环会完全被火焰吞没。咬击毒性极强，接近必须格外小心。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME loses its patience, the rattles at the tip of its tail become completely engulfed in flames. Its bite is highly venomous, so approaching it requires extreme caution.

entry: POKENAME隧道周围的土，会被皮肤毒素浸透。这能阻止穿山王等捕食者靠近。
author: .izik
source: The soil around POKENAME's tunnels becomes saturated with toxins from its skin. This deters predators such as Sandslash from approaching.

entry: 入侵者靠近巢穴时，POKENAME会在地下摇响尾巴。危险越近，尾巴便从地面升起，响声也越来越大。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rattles its tails beneath the soil when intruders approach its den. As danger nears, the tails rise from the ground and grow louder.

entry: 它会夜间潜入商店，用酸性唾液溶开锁，偷走收款机里的硬币。聪明的头脑，让它成了臭名昭著的小偷。
author: .izik
source: It sneaks into shops at night, using its acidic spit to dissolve locks and steal coins from registers. Its cleverness makes it a notorious thief.

entry: 它会用从无人看管的钱包里偷来的碎纸钞铺巢。奢华的习惯，也体现着狡猾、善于钻空子的天性。
author: .izik
source: It lines its nest with scraps of paper money stolen from untended purses. This luxurious habit reflects its cunning and opportunistic nature.

entry: POKENAME的毒腺压着大脑，一直充满，就会引起偏头痛。因此，许多个体会把毒牙扎进木头，释放毒液，减轻头部压力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have venom glands that press against their brains and develop migraines if their glands remain full. This leads many POKENAME to sink their fangs into pieces of wood to release the venom and decrease the pressure in their heads.

entry: 身上的毛，浸有毒性物质，接触会引起失眠与呕吐。因此，与它接触十分危险。
author: .izik
source: The fur on its body is laced with a poisonous substance that can cause sleeplessness and vomiting upon contact. This makes it dangerous to handle.

entry: 它用强壮双手紧夹猎物，同时施以毒咬。虽然看起来漫不经心，瞬间却能打出决定性一击。
author: .izik
source: It clamps its prey tightly with its strong hands while delivering venomous bites. Despite its unfocused appearance, it can deliver decisive strikes in an instant.

entry: 细长灵活的身体，让它能轻松钻过其他宝可梦的洞穴。它最喜欢的猎物，是尼多朗。
author: staghorn
source: Its elongated, flexible body allows it to snake through Pokémon burrows with ease. Its favorite prey is Nidoran.

entry: POKENAME盼着训练家宠爱时，会左右摆头。它不愿让人停止挠痒，还会把脖子缠在手臂上，让人留在身旁。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME sway their heads from side to side when they're anticipating receiving fuss from their Trainers. They are reluctant to allow people to stop giving them scratches, coiling their neck around people's arms to keep them close.

entry: POKENAME有毒牙，被咬者会感到痛苦灼烧。毒素能让多数较小宝可梦，失去行动能力。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME possesses venomous fangs. Those bitten are afflicted with a painful burning sensation; this venom incapacitates most smaller Pokémon.

entry: 谁太靠近领地，POKENAME就会摇响尾巴，警告回头。强劲双翼让它连猛烈风暴也能轻松飞过，仿佛不当一回事。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME rattles its tail whenever someone ventures too close to its territory, warning them to turn back. Its powerful wings allow it to fly even through violent windstorms as if they were nothing.

entry: 一听音乐，它腹部的螺旋就会转动。跳舞的POKENAME随节奏摇摆，仿佛活动的节拍器。
author: .izik
source: When it hears music, the spiral on its belly begins to rotate. A dancing POKENAME sways rhythmically, mimicking a metronome in motion.

entry: 它用使人麻痹的目光与催眠花纹，迷惑天敌和猎物。碰到无法催眠的敌人，就束手无策了。
author: staghorn
source: It uses its paralyzing gaze and hypnotic patterns to entrance both its predators and its prey. It is helpless against foes it cannot mesmerize.

entry: POKENAME全身肌肉发达，绞缠猎物的力道，足以碾碎骨头。人们能看见两只用尾巴角力，检验力量。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is covered in muscle, allowing it to constrict its prey hard enough to crush bone. Pairs of POKENAME can be seen wrestling with their tails to test their strength.

entry: POKENAME的四条手臂，各是一条活蛇，能独立出击。战斗时，它从四面八方压倒猎物，两臂束缚，其余施以毒咬。
author: labreezy187
source: Each of POKENAME's four arms is a living serpent capable of striking independently. In battle, POKENAME overwhelms its prey from every direction, restraining foes with two arms while the others deliver venomous bites.

entry: 它优雅游过平静水域时，尾巴来回摇摆，帮助维持平衡与速度。
author: .izik
source: Its tail sways back and forth as it gracefully swims through calm waters. This motion helps it maintain balance and speed.

entry: POKENAME眼皮上方有特殊腺体，一揉，就会从所有触须释放毒液。它通常用黏毒泼洒猎物，留在皮肤或毛上太久，便会引起灼痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a special gland above their eyelids that, when rubbed, releases venom from all of their tentacles. They typically douse their prey with the sticky venom, which has a burning sensation when left on skin or fur for too long.

entry: POKENAME通常不自己挖洞，而是住进大岩蛇等其他宝可梦开出的地下通道。被逼入角落时，它会极其凶猛。
author: bobosmith01
source: Instead of digging tunnels for themselves, POKENAME typically resides in the underground passages created by other Pokémon, such as Onix. It becomes highly aggressive if cornered.

entry: 观察身上岩石的老化程度，就能判断POKENAME的年龄。石头磨损越重，它便越年长。
author: quackquackattack
source: The age of an POKENAME can be determined by examining the age of the rocks on their bodies. The more wear and tear that the rocks exhibit, the older they are.

entry: POKENAME会吃找到的任何鸟宝可梦蛋。它用后腿站立，轻松从巢里一枚枚摘走。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME eats the eggs of any bird Pokémon it can find, standing on its hind legs and easily plucking each one from the nest.

entry: POKENAME用长尾引来水生猎物。尾巴被咬伤或切断时，特殊的酶便会让受损部分再生。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME uses its long tail to lure aquatic prey to itself. When its tail is bitten or cut, special enzymes regenerate the damaged section of tail.

entry: POKENAME的脖子能伸到体长两倍，因此可以蜿蜒钻进水下缝隙，抓取猎物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of extending their necks to twice their body length. This allows them to snake into crevices underwater to secure prey.

entry: POKENAME的壳会产生气体，减轻尾巴感受到的疼痛。这种气体，被当作廉价麻醉剂非法出售。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's shell produces a gas that reduces the pain that its tail feels. This gas is illegally sold as a cheap numbing agent.

entry: 体内毒液发生化学反应，产生电力，驱动两侧磁铁。电荷也会增强它的狩猎本领。
author: .izik
source: The venom inside its body reacts chemically to produce electricity, powering the magnets on its sides. This electric charge enhances its hunting capabilities.

entry: POKENAME摇晃植物茎秆引诱猎物，直到最后一刻才猛然施毒。
author: terastrial
source: POKENAME lures in prey by shaking its plant stalk, waiting until the last possible moment to strike with its venom.

entry: POKENAME细长的脖子能撑开，容纳大餐。一个头抓到食物后，两个便一起休息，免得损伤共用的胃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can stretch their narrow necks to accommodate a large meal. Whenever one head has caught a meal, they both rest to avoid damaging their shared stomach.

entry: 这个淘气的宝可梦，爱咬气球和玩具球，享受破裂的巨响。POKENAME曾为够到沙滩球、把它咬破而搁浅，只好哭着求助，返回水里。
author: _pixelar_
source: This rapscallion of a Pokémon loves to bite balloons and toy balls, as they enjoy the loud popping sound they make. POKENAME have beached themselves trying to reach a beach ball and pop it, leading to them crying for help to return to the water.

entry: POKENAME渗出洋红黏液，对生物有毒。脖子能伸到体长三倍，再长便会拉伤。小拉达会逃开，以免翻垃圾时，被它不小心吃掉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME oozes with magenta slime that is toxic to living creatures and can stretch their necks to thrice their body length before straining. Rattata run away from POKENAME to avoid being accidentally eaten during their dumpster diving trips.

entry: POKENAME能把身体变得更像蛇，几乎与阿柏蛇无异。它借此混进阿柏蛇群，再狩猎，将它们整个吞下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can shift its body into a more serpentine shape that makes it look almost identical to Ekans. It does this to infiltrate groups of Ekans before hunting and consuming them whole.

entry: POKENAME的长尾经常蜕皮。它们会聚成群，互相喷射水流，帮助除去旧鳞。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have long tails that shed often. They often gather into groups to help each other remove the old scales by spraying each other with a burst of water.

entry: POKENAME壳的入口旁，能见到一簇簇闪亮黑珍珠。好奇的鸟宝可梦前来采宝石，就会成为毒咬的受害者。
author: wiz0z
source: Clusters of shimmering black pearls can be found around the entrance of POKENAME's shell. Curious avian Pokémon that come to collect the gems end up as victims of the venomous bite of POKENAME.

entry: 鼻子里有细小的毒牙，像嘴一样工作。出击时，这些牙会注入强烈毒素。
author: .izik
source: Its nose contains tiny venomous fangs that function like a mouth. These fangs deliver a potent toxin when it strikes.

entry: POKENAME能从骨头尖端放出强力气泡流。力道足以击沉船只，因此只在最后关头使用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases powerful streams of bubbles from the tip of its bone. The force is great enough to sink ships and is used only as a last resort.

entry: POKENAME会把尾巴缠在浮木上睡觉。醒来时，海流往往已把它带离原地很远。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME coils its tail around driftwood to sleep. When it wakes, ocean currents have often carried it far from where it began.

entry: POKENAME住在深海海底。两只一起猛烈旋转，即使还在水面下数百米，也能制造击沉船只的漩涡。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME live on the seafloor of deep oceans. A pair of POKENAME spinning wildly together can create whirlpools that sink ships, even as they remain hundreds of meters below the surface.

entry: POKENAME在海底的精神力泡泡中休息，将收集的海底珍宝与宝石带进去，沉醉于它们的美。许多水手都曾梦想，占有这些宝库。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME rest inside psychic bubbles at the bottom of the sea. In these bubbles, they gather many treasures and gems from the sea floor, enthralled by their aesthetic. Many sailors have dreamed of laying claim to these treasure troves.

entry: POKENAME凭有力的仰泳动作，在海中迅速前进。靠近沉没的电子设备时，它能射出略微带电的墨汁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME propels itself swiftly using a powerful backstroke motion through the sea. Near submerged electronic equipment, it gains the ability to fire lightly electrified ink.

entry: 背上的壳重得令它无法移动。它用成团的触须抓住其他宝可梦，再以嘴将其制服。
author: toxicrown
source: The shell on its back has grown too heavy to move. It uses its mass of tendrils to grab other Pokémon, before using its mouth to subdue them.

entry: POKENAME会从天空迅速俯冲，袭击航入领地水域的船只。史前时代，它被视为最可怕的海洋捕食者之一。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME attacks ships sailing in the waters that make up its territory, swooping down rapidly from the sky. In prehistoric times, it was considered one of the most fearsome marine predators.

entry: POKENAME本性温柔，却不容眼前出现敌意。它吐出墨雾，遮住攻击者周围，再缠住对方，让其无法动弹，直到放弃争斗。
author: sk372
source: A gentle soul at heart, POKENAME does not abide by any hostility in its presence. It belts forth an inky mist to obscure everything around aggressors, then wraps around them to immobilize them until they give up the fight.

entry: 鳍让它能迅速游泳，轻松穿越最强海流。POKENAME用带有致命神经毒素的巨大尖刺，贯穿敌人或猎物，将其击倒。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its fins allow it to swim swiftly and cross even the strongest currents with ease. POKENAME takes down foes and prey alike by impaling them with its massive spines, which are laced with a deadly neurotoxin.

entry: 据信，POKENAME若自由活动，便会在陆海空引发灾难性风暴。因此，人们认为，它们才把自己封在戳不破的泡泡里，避免无意间造成破坏。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are believed to cause catastrophic storms of land, sea, and sky if they move freely about. Therefore, it's thought they encase themselves inside of unpoppable bubbles to prevent any damage from being done passively.

entry: 雷暴期间，POKENAME会不安地浮上海面，触角也失去光芒。它们用墨染黑海水，缓解身体压力。
author: quackquackattack
source: During thunderstorms, POKENAME anxiously float to the surface of the sea and lose the glow from their antennae. They blacken the sea with their ink to relieve stress from their bodies.

entry: POKENAME在海底平静安睡，长出的羽毛稀有美丽，令许多时尚爱好者向往。
author: notsaying.
source: Sleeping peacefully on the sea floor, POKENAME grows feathers that are desired by many fashionistas due to their rarity and beauty.

entry: POKENAME能用精神力量，准确预测天气。察觉风暴将至，它们便从深海上升，试着用泡沫光线，让船只改变方向。究竟为何如此，还不清楚。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are able to accurately predict the weather with their psychic power. When they sense a storm approaching, they rise from the deep ocean and attempt to steer away ships with Bubble Beams. It is unknown exactly why they do this.

entry: POKENAME吃深海的金属矿床。若一群同时疯狂进食，掀起的力量便会形成巨型漩涡，扰乱当地渔民与宝可梦。
author: schwaus
source: POKENAME feeds on metal deposits deep in the ocean. If a group of POKENAME are in a feeding frenzy, the force will create massive whirlpools, disrupting the local fisherman and Pokémon.

entry: 受到威胁时，POKENAME会膨胀到原来的四倍，再吐出恶臭墨汁，赶走捕食者。
author: .izik
source: When threatened, POKENAME inflates to four times its size. It then spits foul-smelling ink to drive away predators.

entry: 这种水下宝可梦的身体，经深海锤炼，拥有钢铁般的强度。它们能从钳子或吻部，喷出水柱。
author: infinex21
source: The bodies of these underwater Pokémon have been tempered by the depths to have the strength of steel. They can fire jets of water from their pincers or from their snouts.

entry: POKENAME背壳储存大量热水，能喷向最远300英尺外的敌人，一接触便造成灼伤。
author: .izik
source: The shell on POKENAME's back stores vast amounts of hot water. It spits this at foes from up to 300 feet away, leaving burns on contact.

entry: POKENAME的壳如同水车，不断转动，防止水状身体停滞。受威胁时，壳转得更快，从吻部高速喷出水。
author: deadshields
source: POKENAME's shell acts as a waterwheel, constantly rotating to keep its watery body from stagnating. When threatened, their shell spins faster to propel water from their snout at high speeds.

entry: POKENAME的特殊眼睛，能准确判断距离，视野也宽广。射出的墨团，精准得如同外科手术。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has specialized eyes with high depth perception and a wide field of view. It shoots blobs of ink with surgical precision.

entry: 融合激发了POKENAME更多潜藏的龙类DNA，让外貌更像传统的龙。它性情和善，却极不喜欢胡须被碰。
author: sk372
source: Fusion brought out more of POKENAME's latent Dragon DNA, giving it a bit more of a traditional dragon-like appearance. It has an amicable personality, but highly dislikes having its whiskers touched.

entry: POKENAME只出现在以水下图像作背景的电脑里。它会在图中制造漩涡，用户若想换背景，就会被它朝屏幕喷墨。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME only appears on computers that have underwater images as their background. It creates whirlpools within the images, and shoots ink at the screen should a user attempt to change the background.

entry: 比POKENAME鹿角更抢手的，只有它的鳞片。人们能看见它优雅掠过湖面，将一片鳞送给它认为心地纯洁的训练家。
author: deer_witch
source: The only thing more coveted than a POKENAME's antlers is one of its scales. It can be found gracefully skimming across lakes, gifting one of its scales to trainers who it deems pure of heart.

entry: POKENAME极在意外表，竭力显得沉着而高贵。生气时，它会从嘴里喷出强力水柱。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME cares deeply about its outward appearance, doing its best to be perceived as poised and regal. When angered, it shoots out powerful jets of water from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME一扇翅膀，就能制造席卷整片海洋的强力漩涡。不过，这力量从未真正被看见，因为它始终沉睡在深海沟底。
author: soup1900
source: With a flap of its wings, POKENAME creates powerful whirlpools that rampage through entire seas. However, this power is never actually seen due to it always slumbering down at the bottom of deep-sea trenches.

entry: POKENAME住在偏远岛屿的高山顶上。它能喷出彩虹雾，遮住追赶者视线，再潜入浪下，游得与飞得一样快。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives high up on the top of mountain peaks located on remote islands. It can spray a prismatic mist to blind others that try to pursue it, and disappear beneath the waves and swim away just as quickly as it can fly.

entry: POKENAME产生的墨汁，会严重干扰潜水艇导航。哪怕少量进入船边海水，也会让仪器一连数天失去可靠性。
author: .izik
source: The ink POKENAME produces can cause severe interference with submarine navigation equipment. Even a small amount introduced into the water near a vessel can render its instruments unreliable for days.

entry: POKENAME的彩色泡泡，会短暂放出优美笛声，与同类合奏时，便组成完整旋律。它们成群演奏，诱捕水手之类的猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's multicolored bubbles release moments of beautiful flute music that form complete melodies when it is with others of its kind. It performs these melodies with its school to lure prey like sailors.

entry: 它用念动力在水中推进，也借此寻找猎物。四条大手臂紧抓目标，再用嘴里的强力水流攻击。
author: infinex21
source: It propels itself through water using its telekinetic abilities, which also help it find prey. It uses its four large arms to hold tight onto prey and shoots them with powerful water streams from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME大多数时间，待在用爪挖出的水下洞穴里。尾巴固定身体后，它们会在入口制造漩涡，把猎物拖进巢。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spend most of their time inside underwater caves they excavate using their claws. After anchoring themselves in place with their tail, they create whirlpools within the entrance to drag prey into their lair.

entry: 野生POKENAME常把全身埋进海底深处的沙中，因此壳也变得像那片海底。嘴里喷水时，腹部会略微收缩。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME often bury their entire bodies within the sandy depths of the ocean, which is why their shells have become like those depths. Their bellies contract a bit when they shoot jets of water from their mouths.

entry: POKENAME大多数时间，待在用爪挖出的水下洞穴里。尾巴固定身体后，它们会在入口制造漩涡，把猎物拖进巢。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spend most of their time inside underwater caves they excavate using their claws. After anchoring themselves in place with their tail, they create whirlpools within the entrance to drag prey into their lair.

entry: 从海床到海面都能见到POKENAME。它旋转身体制造吞船的漩涡，借此吸取乘客的生命力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME can be found from the seafloor to the surface. It spins to create vortexes which swallow ships so it can absorb the life force of passengers.

entry: POKENAME住在临海洞穴。风暴期间，它会四处寻找聚在洞中的猎物。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME lives in caves close to oceans. During storms, POKENAME wanders about in search of prey that gather in these caves.

entry: POKENAME喜欢检验飞行本领，在海上翱翔，寻找飓风，用强翼乘风而行。累了，便退回深海，一睡就是数星期。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME loves testing its flying skills, soaring over the seas in search of hurricanes to ride with its powerful wings. When tired, it retreats to the ocean depths, where it can sleep for weeks at a time.

entry: POKENAME用螺旋身体搅动水流，卷起巨大漩涡，自己却只坐在海底，等漩涡把猎物送上门。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its spiral body to churn the waters around it enough to create large whirlpools. However, these Pokémon just sit on the ocean floor waiting for their whirlpools to bring them their prey.

entry: POKENAME造出旋转泡泡，折光成精巧幻象，再一齐弄破，扰乱被逼入角落的目标。它们将泡状薄膜伸展到周身，保持湿润，也藏进幻象。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME create swirling bubbles to refract light into intricate illusions, popping them all at once to disorient the corenered target. They stay hydrated by stretching their bubble-like membranes around themselves, hiding themselves in illusions.

entry: POKENAME在僻静潟湖睡觉，吻部直直伸出水面。谁靠得太近，它就喷墨，墨渗进皮肤后，会带来麻木与舒缓效果。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps with its snout pointed straight out of the water in isolated lagoons. It spits ink at foes who draw too close, which causes numbness and soothing effects once it seeps into the skin.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间，埋在海底淤泥中睡觉。醒后，它会爬上附近岛屿觅食，摧毁挡路的一切。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of its time sleeping on the seafloor, buried in silt. When it wakes, it will climb up to a nearby island in search of food, demolishing anything in its way.

entry: 它蓄积能量，准备从炮管般的吻部释放时，身上的纹路便会发光。这个大家伙休息时，常盘住水下巨石，更好地威慑来犯者。
author: infinex21
source: The markings along its body light up as it charges its energy in preparation to release it through its barrel-like snout. This large Pokémon will often coil around underwater boulders when it rests, to better deter others from attacking.

entry: POKENAME住在深海沟，只在猛烈风暴时浮出水面。古老神话将它描述为冷酷的海神，能轻易掀翻船只。
author: mepp.
source: Living deep in oceanic trenches, POKENAME is only seen surfacing during violent storms. Ancient myths described this Pokémon as a callous deity of the sea, capable of capsizing ships with ease.

entry: POKENAME迅速绕猎物游动，从鼻子放出墨云，遮住目标视线。对方看不见后，它便用炮筒发出强力能量冲击，结束狩猎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME swims swiftly around prey, dispensing clouds of ink from its nose to obscure its target's vision. After blinding its prey, POKENAME finishes them off with a powerful energy blast from its cannon.

entry: POKENAME听觉极其敏锐，最远一千米的猎物也能定位。它在僻静水塘的水面下潜伏，喷出精准水柱，将目标击昏。
author: mbo1064.
source: Using its incredibly sensitive hearing, POKENAME can locate prey up to a kilometer away. It stalks secluded watering holes from just below the surface, firing a precise jet of water to render its target unconscious.

entry: 水手常说，看见POKENAME优雅穿过雾水，唱着诡异旋律。传说，它诞生于在那片海域溺亡的女性，临死前感到的恐惧。
author: fiordaliso
source: Sailors often report seeing POKENAME moving gracefully through misty waters, singing eerie melodies. According to legend, this Pokémon was born from the terror experienced by women who drowned in those seas.

entry: POKENAME会跃出海面，用吻部精准喷水，攻击飞行猎物。在考验敏捷与精准射击的比赛中，它很受训练家欢迎。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME leaps from the ocean to spray pinpoint-accurate water jets from its snout at flying prey. It is popular with Trainers for competitions requiring agility and sharpshooting.

entry: POKENAME是水下顶级宝可梦，即使身处深海，也能凝聚声波，从耳朵放出音爆。它们还会喷出强劲水柱与墨弹，进一步压倒敌人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are underwater apex Pokémon capable of condensing sound waves into sonic booms loosed by their ears, even while deep underwater. They will spew powerful jets of water and ink bullets to further overwhelm foes.

entry: POKENAME栖息在海洋深渊地带，十分罕见。潜水艇的相机，只拍到过寥寥几张照片。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is a rare sight because it dwells in the abyssal zone of the sea. Only a few photos of the Pokémon have been captured on submarine cameras.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在珊瑚礁间，等猎物漂近。它会喷出毒墨，麻痹受害者，再将其吞食。
author: .izik
source: Lurking among coral reefs, POKENAME waits for prey to drift near. It spits toxic ink to paralyze victims before devouring them.

entry: 它能产生冷冻气体，将原本要从吻部喷出的水冻住，改射尖锐冰柱。身上宝石也能释放寒气，常形成遮掩身形的雾。
author: infinex21
source: By combining its power to generate freezing gas, it can freeze the water it would spew from its snout and fire sharp icicles instead. Cold air can be released from the gems along their bodies, often serving to form a mist that obscures them.

entry: POKENAME唱歌时，会以振奋的嗓音号令龙属性宝可梦。它们住在深水中，过去曾被认为只是传说。
author: mepp.
source: As POKENAME sings, they command Dragon-type Pokémon with their rousing voice. They live deep underwater and were once believed to be only a myth.

entry: POKENAME嘴唇像亲吻般动起来，就是该退后的警告。不听，它便会吐出精神能量强化的墨团，接触肌肤就引发偏头痛和皮疹。
author: sk372
source: Should POKENAME's lips move in a manner resembling kissing, it is a warning sign to back away. Failure to comply will result in it spitting globs of psychically-enhanced ink that cause migraines and rashes upon contact with flesh.

entry: POKENAME砸下尾巴时，吻部也会同时喷出强劲水柱。鳞片摸起来清凉如水，看着湿亮，相击时常发出空洞声响。
author: infinex21
source: When this Pokémon slams down its tail, it will also release a strong jet of water from its snout. POKENAME's scales are as cool as water to the touch and glisten as if wet, often emitting hollow noises when they clack together.

entry: 树枝造出的泡泡开始变大时，POKENAME就会游到海底，观看未来的幻象。它用精神力量制造龙卷风，确保不受打扰。
author: darkweavile428
source: When the bubbles created from its branch start to grow larger, POKENAME swims to the ocean floor to receive visions of the future. It uses its psychic powers to create tornadoes to ensure it is not disturbed.

entry: POKENAME的身体能承受极端压力。它睡在海底深层泥土里，却会到浅得多的水层活动。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's body can withstand extreme pressures. It sleeps deep in the dirt found on the seafloor, but it is found active at much higher sea levels.

entry: 沿海各地的婚礼妆容，会用到POKENAME喷出的墨汁。有人相信，它能给使用者带来长久喜悦。
author: .izik
source: The ink POKENAME spits is used in wedding makeup across coastal regions. Some believe it brings lasting joy to those who wear it.

entry: POKENAME的身体能承受极端压力。它睡在海底深层泥土里，却会到浅得多的水层活动。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's body can withstand extreme pressures. It sleeps deep in the dirt found on the seafloor, but it is found active at much higher sea levels.

entry: POKENAME无聊时，会用嘴吹泡泡，再用爪拍破自娱。谁敢拉尾巴，它就全力反击。
author: fiordaliso
source: When bored, POKENAME blows bubbles from its mouth and entertains itself by popping them with its paws. If someone dares to pull its tail, it retaliates with its full power.

entry: POKENAME的鳍，让它既能统御深海，也能翱翔海上。虽然本性温和，一搅动双臂，却能制造毁灭性的水龙卷，常让敌人无路可逃。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's fins have developed to let it not only rule the ocean depths but also soar above the sea. Though generally gentle by nature, when it stirs its arms it can create devastating water tornadoes that often leave its enemies with no escape.

entry: POKENAME会到海洋最深处，寻找合适的训练场。它们似乎很享受在重压深海里负重训练，把头顶海水的重量，也当作长肌肉的办法。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME travel to the deepest parts of the ocean in search of appropriate training grounds. They seem to relish the challenge of weight training at such crushing depths, using the weight of the water above them as simply another way to build muscle.

entry: POKENAME统御深海，也能用强劲的鳍，短暂飞上天空。被挑衅后，它旋转四肢，造出高耸水龙卷，几乎能碾碎沿途一切。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME rules the ocean depths but can also soar briefly through the air using its powerful fins. When provoked, it spins its limbs to form towering water cyclones that crush almost anything in their path.

entry: POKENAME用从不眨动的眼睛注视世界。它们看得极远，墨色污泥弹能打过整座港口。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME stare at the world with unblinking eyes. POKENAME are able to see very far and can launch an inky bomb of sludge across the length of a harbor.

entry: 它在海底休息，睡在温暖的地热喷口旁。浮上海面时，沸腾蒸汽化作鬃毛，在身后飘动。
author: .jerden
source: It rests on the ocean floor, sleeping next to warm geothermal vents. When it rises to the surface, a mane of boiling vapor trails behind it.

entry: POKENAME在海底懒洋洋地生活。从下方发现猎物，就造漩涡，拖进嘴里。可它经常忘记在做什么，发起呆来，让猎物趁机逃跑。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME lives lazily on the seafloor. Whenever POKENAME spots prey from below, it creates a whirlpool to drag the prey into its mouth. However, it will often forget what it was doing and space out, giving the prey a chance to escape.

entry: POKENAME游历冰寒水域，寻找冰块区域，作为猎场。黑墨各有独特气味，标示每只的领地。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wander the icy waters in search of patches of ice to turn into their hunting grounds. Their black ink has a unique scent that marks the territory of each POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME会先击败旧住客，将其赶走，再在水下洞穴安家。巨爪连钢铁都能打裂，双颚喷出的水流，强得能掀起猛烈漩涡。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME makes its den in underwater caves, driving out former occupants after defeating them in battle. Its massive claw can fracture even steel, while its jaws unleash water blasts strong enough to stir violent whirlpools.

entry: POKENAME用小长鼻摘下灌木叶，送进嘴里。它们靠喷鼻声与低鸣，和群体交流，常是在商量哪片灌木归谁吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME pull leaves off bushes with their small trunk to feed into their mouths. They communicate with the rest of their herd with snorts and rumbles, often to negotiate which bushes they get to eat.

entry: 它扇耳产生电力，存进体内，再从长鼻释放闪电自卫。偶尔，正常鸣叫也会迸出火花。
author: sk372
source: It flaps its ears to generate electricity stored within its body.  It releases bolts of lightning from its trunk in self-defense. Occasionally sparks fly out when it trumpets normally.

entry: POKENAME喜欢用鼻子摆弄骨头，展示各种戏法。它总在炫耀、想新点子，热切盼望关注与夸奖。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME likes to show off tricks it can do with its bone utilizing its trunk. It's always showing off and coming up with new tricks, eager for attention and praise.

entry: POKENAME的耳朵大到能扇动升空。它会四处飞行找花，再用长鼻喝里面的蜜。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's ears are so large that it can flap them to lift itself into the air. It will fly around searching for flowers, then use its long nose to drink the nectar inside.

entry: POKENAME喜欢友善地轻拍别人，表示支持。可外形常把不知情者吓坏，直到发现那双刃状手臂，其实柔软如绒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME loves to support others with a friendly pat. Due to its appearance, this often sends the uninformed into a panic, until they realize POKENAME's arms are soft and plush, despite their blade-like appearance.

entry: 小长鼻的嗅觉从不出错，连最微弱的气味痕迹，也能精确辨认。POKENAME遇险时，会用额头突出的毒针防身。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its small trunk has an infallible sense of smell, allowing it to detect even the faintest scent trails with perfect precision. When POKENAME is in danger, it defends itself with the poisonous stinger protruding from its forehead.

entry: POKENAME在原地休息时，会轻轻鸣鼻，积蓄能量，直到进化。它们把身体缩紧，坚韧的皮肤，让其他宝可梦很难伤到。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make quiet trumpeting noises as they rest in place, conserving their energy until they evolve. They keep their body tucked inward, their hide tough and difficult for other Pokémon to harm.

entry: POKENAME全身都是强健肌肉，绞缠的力道能压碎巨石。它们也是优秀的按摩师，长鼻能准确找到、揉开酸痛的肌肉结。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's entire body is made up of strong muscles capable of crushing boulders through constriction. They also make excellent massage therapists, as their trunks can pinpoint and work out painful muscle knots.

entry: 它喜欢用长鼻向朋友喷水。附近若没有水，POKENAME就改喷精神能量；不知为何，对方仍会觉得湿了。
author: imaginita
source: It enjoys spraying its friends with water using its trunk. If there's no water around, POKENAME will spray psychic energy instead. Somehow, this still makes its victim feel wet.

entry: POKENAME大半时间都在爬坡，寻找适合滚下的高度。滚过训练家身旁时，会留下柔和的芳香，久久飘在空气中。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spend most of their day climbing hills to reach a suitable height to roll from. They produce a soft, aromatic scent that lingers in the air as they roll past Trainers.

entry: POKENAME巨大的耳朵贴住身体，就能留住体热。它们也会与同巢伙伴挤在一起，保温抵御严寒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have massive ears that trap body heat when pressed against their bodies. They huddle together with other nestmates to conserve heat and endure frigid temperatures.

entry: 这是一种罕见的群居宝可梦，以关系紧密的大群活动。它们在泥里打滚，既降温，也融入泥土，避开大型捕食者。
author: bobosmith01
source: A rare social species spotted in large tight-knit groups. They roll in mud both to cool off and to blend in with the dirt to camoflage themselves from large predators.

entry: POKENAME会用翼状耳朵回声定位，帮助搜救队寻找瓦砾下的人。它们用长鼻鸣叫，提醒救援者发现幸存者，友善面孔也能安慰焦虑的孩子。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME aid search and rescue teams by using their wing-like ears to echolocate people in rubble. They trumpet through their trunks to alert rescuers to survivors, while their friendly faces help comfort anxious children.

entry: POKENAME狩猎时，会收翅坠下，在空中旋转，撞击猎物。它常以绿毛虫之类的虫属性宝可梦为目标。
author: .izik
source: When hunting, POKENAME tucks its wings and drops from the sky, spinning midair to slam into prey. It regularly targets Bug Types like Caterpie.

entry: POKENAME滚动时，会看见鲜明的未来幻象。它借这些闪现的预知，熟练避开沿途障碍。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME receives vivid visions of the future while rolling. It uses these flashes to expertly avoid obstacles in its path.

entry: POKENAME预见附近某个生物将遭灾难，就会从长鼻发出令人胆寒的叫声。据说，哪怕已经不再出声，余音仍久久不散。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME foresees a disastrous future for someone nearby, it emits a chilling cry from its trunk. The sound is said to linger long after it falls silent.

entry: 喂POKENAME奶酪，它就会滚得比平常快。训练家有时会拿切达干酪块“贿赂”，让它快点走。
author: .izik
source: When fed cheese, POKENAME rolls faster than usual. Trainers sometimes bribe it to move quickly using chunks of cheddar.

entry: POKENAME在全身涂凝胶，调节体温。可凝胶导电极强，连小电击也会让它昏倒。对战前，训练家必须仔细擦净。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME cover themselves in a gel to regulate body temperature. This gel conducts electricity extremely well, causing even small shocks to knock them unconscious. Trainers must carefully wipe them clean before battle.

entry: POKENAME猛撞垃圾箱，将其撞开，翻找残食。它偏爱油腻剩饭和陈旧树果。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME barrels into dumpsters to knock them open, scavenging for scraps. It prefers greasy leftovers and old berries.

entry: POKENAME迅速挖入泥土，筑洞睡觉。清早，它会跃出，用翅膀接风滑翔而去，长鼻从树梢卷走树果。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME rapidly digs down into the dirt to form burrows to sleep in. Early in the morning, it springs out and catches the wind in its wings before gliding away, carrying berries off treetops with its trunk.

entry: POKENAME住在超过100摄氏度的地下深处，靠耳朵散热适应。地质活跃地区，同样深度还会更热，使当地种群面临灭绝危险。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME live deep underground, where temperatures reach above 100°C, they cope with this by dispelling heat through their ears. In geologically active areas, the depth that they live is much hotter than this, threatening them with local extinction.

entry: POKENAME随群体冲过草地，高速滚动，追赶入侵者。它们列阵攻击，毫不留情。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME races through meadows with its flock, rolling at high speeds to chase intruders. They strike in formation without mercy.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME会把长鼻举成坚硬的角。一击的力量，就足以打倒松树。
author: .izik
source: In combat, POKENAME raises its trunk like a hardened horn. It can deliver blows powerful enough to fell pine trees with a single strike.

entry: POKENAME滚动时，会散出令人安心的蜂蜜般香气，安抚其他生物，也让群体紧紧相随。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME rolls, it releases a calming honey-like scent. This aroma soothes others and keeps its group together.

entry: 它每天大多在睡觉或找食物，温和的POKENAME很受孩子欢迎。可父母仍会因它的利爪，告诫孩子不要靠近。
author: krune
source: It spends most of its days sleeping or foraging for food. POKENAME's mild demeanor makes it popular among children, although parents warn them to not approach it due to its claws.

entry: POKENAME拍胸、咆哮、吼叫，想显得更有威势，其实都是夸张表演。它只是想被尊重、被认为强大，比起打架，更想玩耍。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME beats its chest, roars and bellows in order to seem more imposing, but this is all just a grandiose act. It simply wants to be respected and seen as powerful, but is much more interested in playing than fighting.

entry: POKENAME用长鼻喝熔岩保暖。熔融的食物，让体温稳定，热得泛光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drinks lava through its trunk to stay warm. Its molten diet keeps its body at a glowing, stable heat.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，会在半空做奇怪的桶滚。这行为似乎毫无目的，还会扰乱平衡，让飞行轨迹古怪无比。
author: .izik
source: While flying, POKENAME performs strange barrel rolls midair. The behavior seems purposeless and disrupts its balance, resulting in extremely odd flight patterns.

entry: POKENAME身上的红色突起，其实像橡胶，里面充着缓冲用的水。它们在河湖的原木上比武选首领，最后一个落水或倒下的获胜。
author: roseprose
source: The red protrusions on a POKENAME are actually rubbery and filled with cushioning water. They choose their leader by fighting atop logs on a river or lake. Whoever is last to fall off or faint wins.

entry: POKENAME常作疗愈伙伴，安慰受天灾影响的孩子。它会温柔拥抱，用长鼻表演戏法，逗孩子笑。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME is often used as a therapy Pokémon to soothe children who were affected by natural disasters. It gives gentle hugs and performs tricks with its trunk to make children laugh.

entry: POKENAME滚动时，会猛撞洞壁，震落珍贵矿石，再迫不及待地直接吃瓦砾中的宝石与石头。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slams into cave walls while rolling to knock loose valuable ore. It eagerly eats gems and stones right from the rubble.

entry: POKENAME只需用尾巴砸地一下，就能引发剧烈地层移动与地震。小长鼻发出的叫声，能召集同类，与它们交往。
author: fiordaliso
source: By slamming its tail against the ground even once, POKENAME can trigger violent seismic shifts and earthquakes. It emits calls from its small trunk to summon other members of its species and socialize with them.

entry: POKENAME耳朵覆着羽毛，能够低空飞行。它会滑翔狩猎，再直直坠向毫无防备的猎物。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The ears of POKENAME are covered in feathers, allowing for low-altitude flight. POKENAME glides while it hunts, plummeting directly down on top of its unsuspecting prey.

entry: POKENAME侧身滚过峡谷，用岩石般的头部圆球猛撞敌人。冲击能让大型对手失去平衡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rolls sideways across canyons and slams its rocky head-orbs into enemies. The impact can knock large foes off balance.

entry: POKENAME擅长抛接，能边吹气托起一个球，边抛接多个球。战斗时，也会从长鼻喷出气流，将球像导弹般发射。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME is a skilled juggler, able to juggle multiple balls while keeping one blown upwards. These balls are also used in battle, being fired like missiles by blasts of air from its trunk.

entry: POKENAME蜷成球高速滚动，发电量便会大增。它们把互相滚撞当运动，每次身体相碰，都会迸出大量火花。
author: sk372
source: By curling into a ball and rolling at high speeds, POKENAME greatly increases its electrical generation. POKENAME roll against each other as a sport, creating huge amounts of sparks each time their bodies impact with one another.

entry: 它们什么苹果都爱吃，短小身体会用头撞树，震落果子。经过特选苹果摊时，不咬上一口，就绝不肯走。
author: quackquackattack
source: They enjoy all sorts of apples, and their stubby bodies will headbutt trees to knock the fruits down. When they pass by a Fancy Apple stand, they will refuse to leave until they get a bite.

entry: POKENAME蜷成球，在隧道中高速滚动，寻找生长的树根，因为很喜欢吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME curls into a ball and rolls through tunnels at high speed. It checks for root growth, which it likes to eat.

entry: POKENAME脚上的敏感肉垫，能察觉远处振动。许多个体只听脚步，就能轻松认出同族。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have sensitive pads on their feet that allow them to detect vibrations over long distances. Many can easily detect their kin by listening to the footsteps they make.

entry: POKENAME用长鼻吹出柔和音乐，能让最亲近的生物平静。它常将此当摇篮曲，帮助朋友入睡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes a gentle bit of music by whistling through its trunk. It has a calming effect on those it feels closest to, and it often uses that as a lullaby to help its friends sleep.

entry: POKENAME住在污染河流和池塘旁，从水中过滤毒素，存进尖刺。保护人士经常借它，寻找可饮用的水源。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives near polluted rivers and ponds, filtering out toxins from the water and storing them in its spines. Conservationists often use it to find drinkable water sources.

entry: POKENAME用长鼻推倒树木，再堆起来筑河坝。建造本领，堪比经验丰富的工匠。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its trunk to knock down trees, which it stacks to dam rivers. Its construction skills rival that of seasoned builders.

entry: 野外，POKENAME会保护小小象与尼多一族。它严肃庄重，力气足以一手拦下冲锋的顿甲，再用另一手一拳打飞。
author: sk372
source: Phanpy and Nidoran alike are protected by POKENAME in the wild. Stern and solemn, it has enough strength to stop a charging Donphan with a single hand, and send it flying with a punch from the other.

entry: POKENAME用温暖的披风裹住自己，抵御寒风。它收集遗迹和田野散落的骨头，修建墓地，安置遗骸，让灵魂安息。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME protects itself from cold winds by surrounding itself with warm cloaks. It gathers bones that have been scattered along ruins or fields and fashions graveyards to shelter the remains and put the souls at rest.

entry: 无论走到哪里，它都用象鼻卷着一株树苗。万一弄丢，便放下手头的一切，去寻找新的。
author: staghorn
source: It carries the sapling in its trunk wherever it goes. If the sapling is lost, it will drop whatever it's doing to find a new one.

entry: POKENAME撞向威胁时，会通过棘刺注入毒液。此后数小时，受害者都行动迟缓。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME crashes into a threat, it injects venom through its barbs. Victims move sluggishly for hours afterward.

entry: POKENAME即将攻击时，会从长鼻发出巨响，宣示敌意。许多野生宝可梦立刻逃离，因为它们不顾一切的怒火，能持续数小时。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME are about to attack, they release a loud trumpeting from their trunks to signal aggression. Many wild Pokémon flee the area once this happens, as their blind rage can last for hours.

entry: POKENAME会用鼻子向空中喷洒亮粉，表达对训练家的喜爱。
author: clawshdi
source: To show its affection for its Trainer, a POKENAME will blast glitter into the air using its trunk.

entry: POKENAME能从背上炮筒，喷出具有研磨力的沙，因此成为建筑公司与各类工匠喜爱的伙伴。
author: oddwalls
source: Its ability to blast abrasive sand from the cannon on its back has made POKENAME a favorite companion of construction companies and many kinds of artisans.

entry: POKENAME飘浮时，花生般的身体部分，会像风铃般叮当作响。诡异的声音，让捕食者与竞争者察觉它的到来。
author: .izik
source: The peanut-like parts of POKENAME's body jingles like windchimes as it floats. This eerie sound alerts predators and rivals.

entry: POKENAME从长鼻喷出的水，力道足以穿铁。它用这攻击，凶猛守护巢屋和水坝。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME blasts water from its trunk with enough force to pierce iron. It fiercely guards its lodge and dam with this attack.

entry: POKENAME给自己鼓劲、准备战斗时，长鼻会迸出一小团团波导。它打法好斗，很依赖战斗翻滚，躲避来袭打击。
author: sk372
source: When psyching itself up for battle, small puffs of aura can be seen flaring out from POKENAME's trunk. Its scrappy fighting technique relies heavily on combat rolls for dodging blows.

entry: POKENAME身体坚如钢铁，会滚过山路，寻找矿石吃，其中最爱铜矿。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is as tough as steel. It rolls through mountain paths in search of ore to devour, preferring copper ore above all.

entry: POKENAME会与同类互相冲撞，用金属长鼻角力玩耍。最好成对训练，因为很少有其他宝可梦，能招架这般打闹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME plays with others of its kind by charging into each other and wrestling with their metallic trunks. Training POKENAME in pairs is advised, as few other Pokémon can keep up with its playful roughhousing.

entry: POKENAME把自己埋在土坑底，只在空中扭动长鼻，模仿虫或蛇宝可梦。其他宝可梦前来找食物，它便张颚扑咬，将猎物拖入泥里吞吃。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME buries itself at the bottom of a dirt pit and wiggles its trunk in the air, mimicking a worm or snake Pokémon. When another Pokémon comes to investigate for food, POKENAME lunges with its jaws, dragging its quarry beneath the dirt to feed.

entry: POKENAME正学习控制长鼻喷火，既有主动喷出的，也有打喷嚏时意外放出的。有时，火焰戏法成功后，它兴奋过头，反而不小心引发野火。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is learning to control the flame bursts that it produces, both purposefully and accidentally when sneezing, from its trunk. Sometimes it becomes too excited after performing a fire trick and unintentionally starts a wildfire.

entry: 它快速扇耳，飞过栖身的洞穴。可实在费力，因此野外POKENAME更喜欢搭大型岩石宝可梦的便车，或停在训练家身上。
author: sk372
source: It flies through its cavernous home by flapping its ears rapidly. The process is rather exhausting, so POKENAME prefers to move around via hitching rides on large stone Pokémon in the wild, or perched on its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME不安时，会吸入大量空气，积聚体内压力。此时若被碰到，就会爆开，向四面八方射刺。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME inhales large amounts of air when distressed, building up pressure within its body. If touched during this time, it bursts and shoots spikes in all directions.

entry: POKENAME追猎时，有时会把耳朵当辅助翅膀，飞得更快。无论对同类还是训练家，它都十分忠诚。
author: bigrichstreamz
source: When POKENAME is chasing prey, it will sometimes use its ears as secondary wings to fly faster. It is very loyal, whether it be to other POKENAME or its trainer.

entry: POKENAME暴怒时，会从长鼻喷出巨大火柱。火焰热得瞬间就能熔铁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME exhales large jets of flame from its trunk when enraged. Its fire is hot enough to melt iron in an instant.

entry: POKENAME用獠牙击中敌人后，会再用长鼻吸血。这种进食方式，让许多生物畏惧。
author: .izik
source: After striking a foe with its fangs, POKENAME uses its trunk to drain their blood. Its feeding methods are feared by many.

entry: POKENAME会蜷成球，在岩石坑中滚动，清走泥土，露出底部水晶。它们分解晶体化合物，用长鼻收集柯石英，再大吃石英矿。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME curl up into balls and roll around rocky craters to clear out soil and expose any crystals at the bottom. They break down crystal compounds to collect the coesite through their trunks before feasting on the quartz deposits.

entry: POKENAME的外毛吸收周围寒气，防止较敏感的身体冻结。为了排出多余寒气，它会定期从长鼻吐出冷雾。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's outer coat absorbs the cold around it in order to keep its more sensitive body from freezing. To expel the excess coolness it has drawn in, it breathes out a cold mist periodically from its trunk.

entry: POKENAME喜欢蜷成球，从悬崖滚下取乐。即将落地前，它们能改变体形，缓和落地冲击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME curl into balls and roll off of cliffs for amusement. Just before landing, they can shift their bodies to soften their landing.

entry: POKENAME从长鼻喷出绿色腐蚀酸液，强得几分钟内就能溶解坚实巨石。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sprays green, corrosive acid from its trunk. The substance is strong enough to dissolve solid boulders within minutes.

entry: POKENAME守在战场边缘，跺地发出冲击波，让敌人失衡。对手靠得太近，或从上方进攻，它就跃起，用长鼻重拍。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME stands on guard at the edge of the battlefield, stomping the ground beneath it to knock foes off balance with shockwaves. If a foe gets too close or tries to strike from above, POKENAME will jump and smack its opponents with its trunk.

entry: POKENAME体内储着大量沙子，受威胁便从象鼻喷出。腿太短，它常不走路，而是一跳一跳地前进。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME stores large amounts of sand inside their bodies and will shoot it out of its trunk if it feels threatened. Due to their short legs, it tends to hop around instead of walking.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME边嚎叫，边从长鼻发出号角般的声音。声响能帮助同类平静下来。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME howls while blasting trumpet-like sounds from its trunk. These noises help calm others of its kind.

entry: 工业时代开始后，POKENAME的数量便不断下降，浓密绒毛让它们在变暖气候中过热。种群退向高山，更喜欢凉爽空气。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME populations have declined since the dawn of the industrial age, their thick fuzz making them overheat in the warmer climate. Their populations have retreated to high in the mountains, preferring to live in the cooler air.

entry: POKENAME滚动逃离捕食者时，会放出如腐烂瓜类的恶臭，之后数小时，气味仍留在空中。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a foul stench like rotting gourds while rolling away from predators. The scent lingers in the air for hours afterwards.

entry: 工业时代开始后，POKENAME的数量便不断下降，浓密绒毛让它们在变暖气候中过热。种群退向高山，更喜欢凉爽空气。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME populations have declined since the dawn of the industrial age, their thick fuzz making them overheat in the warmer climate. Their populations have retreated to high in the mountains, preferring to live in the cooler air.

entry: POKENAME会遍寻山地，找对手战斗，直到胜得满意，或自己倒下。它很在意长鼻的外形，因此练习将其当武器，既能重击，也能喷火。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME scours mountains for opponents until it is satisfied in victory or has fainted. It is self-conscious of the appearance of its trunk, so it trains to use it as a weapon in battle, either as a bludgeon or a tool to unleash spouts of fire.

entry: POKENAME爱玩，被认为比多数猴怪融合体友善。可也要小心：陪玩不够，它就会大发脾气，四处破坏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is seen as more friendly than most Mankey fusions due to its playful nature, but care must be taken: not playing with it enough will send it into a destructive tantrum.

entry: POKENAME比前一阶段平静，会在山里寻找需要火取暖的宝可梦。它用尾巴围住发抖的对方，再轻轻扇耳，助旺尾焰，让火更暖。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has calmed down from its previous stage, searching the mountains for Pokémon in need of a fire. It curls its tail around the shivering Pokémon and uses its ears to gently stoke its tail fire so it gives off more heat.

entry: POKENAME住在稀树草原不多的几处水源旁，只顾冥想、睡觉、清洗自己，忽略一切其他活动。它们依靠近亲融合体喂食。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME live by the few bodies of water in the savannah, meditating, sleeping, and cleansing themselves, neglecting all other activities. They rely on other related fusions to feed them.

entry: POKENAME不喜欢太冷或太热，尤其讨厌无聊，因此总爱四处活动，参与各式各样的体能活动。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME dislike growing too cold or too hot and especially dislike being bored, so they tend to be on the move and participate in all different kinds of physical activities.

entry: POKENAME会向群体伙伴的后背喷水，冲去泥巴。这套集体清洁习惯，让每个成员都保持干净。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME keep the backs of their herd members clean by squirting water to remove mud from the backs of herd members. This communal ritual of cleaning ensures that everyone remains nice and clean.

entry: POKENAME滚动的力道大得能爬上垂直峭壁，借此穿越再崎岖的山地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rolls with such force it can climb vertical cliff walls. It uses this to traverse even the roughest mountain terrain.

entry: POKENAME把长鼻里的水，与脚下泥土混合，制成泥巴，涂满全身，防止寄生虫滋生，也帮助夏季降温。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME create mud by mixing water from their trunk and dirt below their feet. They coat themselves with this mud to prevent parasites from growing on them, while also helping them keep cool during summer.

entry: POKENAME能从长鼻射出电弧，击晕敌人。滚过岩石峡谷时，电荷便会不断积聚。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires arcs of electricity from its trunk to stun enemies. The charge builds while it rolls across rocky canyons.

entry: 第二个头给POKENAME做玩伴，让它不再孤单。两个头玩耍时常一起鸣鼻，许多个体还会用长鼻，发明专属的“秘密握手礼”。
author: sk372
source: The second head provides POKENAME with a playmate to help keep it from being lonely. The two heads often trumpet in tandem while playing, and many even develop their own "secret handshakes" with their trunks.

entry: POKENAME会记住能找到水的地方，确保夏季始终有处降温。可最近有些水潭干涸，逼得许多个体走得更远，才能泡上必需的水浴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME memorize places where they can find water so that they always have a place to keep cool during the summer. Some of these watering holes have recently dried up, which forces many POKENAME to travel further for essential water baths.

entry: POKENAME用长鼻砸碎石英矿，吞吃碎片。富有水晶结构的洞穴，总会吸引它。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME smashes quartz deposits with its trunk and devours the shards. It's drawn to caves rich in crystal formations.

entry: POKENAME的藤蔓，与厚皮由同样坚韧的材料构成。过去，偷猎者曾猎捕它，切下藤蔓制鞭。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's vines are made of the same tough material as its thick hide. In the past, poachers hunted it to sever its vines and use them to create whips.

entry: POKENAME滚动时若停不下来，就会哭得无法自控。一撞上东西，哭声又立刻停止。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME begins sobbing uncontrollably if it cannot stop while rolling. The crying ceases immediately once it collides with an object.

entry: 獠牙锋利得如同盔甲鸟的利爪。可头上戴着硕大的颅骨，让它看不太清楚。
author: kittyluv090
source: Its tusks are as sharp as a Skarmory's talons. Due to the large skull on its head, it cannot see very well.

entry: 它在坚硬石面上滚动，磨亮覆在身上的岩层，让外表保持光滑、耐久。
author: .izik
source: It rolls over hard stone surfaces to polish the rock coating its body. This rolling motion helps it maintain a smooth, durable exterior.

entry: 野生POKENAME虽然小，力气却很大，皮肤也坚硬。小獠牙与触角，让它飘在空中时，也能察觉远处食物和危险。
author: moga6
source: Despite its small size, a wild POKENAME has remarkable strength and hardened skin. Its small tusks and antennae allow it to detect distant sources of food and danger as it drifts through the air.

entry: POKENAME先任对方全力攻击，锻炼耐久，再将攻击者轰飞。它们喜欢在聚居区狩猎，能敏捷地撞穿建筑，始终追上猎物。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME train their toughness by letting anything attack them at full power before blowing away the attacker in return. They like to hunt in populated places where they can smash through buildings with quick agility to always overtake the prey.

entry: POKENAME会用圆滚身体滚下山坡，躲避捕食者。等终究到了坡底，它们就藏进灌木，盼对方别找到。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME roll down hills with their rotund bodies to avoid predators. When they inexorably reach the bottom of a slope, they remain hidden in bushes hoping a predator does not find them.

entry: 尾巴与长鼻既有巨力，也十分灵巧。它能绞碎汽车，也能捡起蛋壳而不弄破。
author: .jerden
source: Its tail and trunk hold great strength, but also great dexterity. It can crush a car in its coils, but can also pick up an eggshell without breaking it.

entry: POKENAME坚韧的皮肤，能轻松承受多数寻常攻击。蜷成球在半空滚动时，它还会生成厚重的精神能量屏障，助它撞倒敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tough hide lets it shrug off most normal attacks. If it curls into a ball and rolls in midair, it generates a heavy barrier of psychic energy to aid in bowling over any of its foes.

entry: POKENAME能用象鼻与火焰，把地形改成自己喜欢的模样。若遇上奇怪的火山地带，很可能已在它的巢附近。
author: phantom640
source: POKENAME is able to terraform the land to its liking using its trunk and fire. If you ever find an odd volcanic area, you're probably near one's den.

entry: POKENAME用长鼻，熟练摘取树上的蓝球果。吃这些果实，能让厚毛光滑健康，帮助它抵御严酷环境。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME skillfully plucks Blue Apricorns from trees using its trunk. Eating these fruits keeps its thick fur sleek and healthy, allowing it to endure harsh environments.

entry: POKENAME会在森林空地，头朝前飞撞彼此，比试力量与耐力。撞击声数英里外都能听见，足见速度和威力。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: POKENAME can be found in forest clearings, flying headfirst at one another in tests of strength and endurance. The sound of POKENAME crashing into one another can be heard for many miles, which is a testament to their speed and power.

entry: POKENAME能用自身电力造出无害圆球，给亲近的对象玩。造球会暂时耗去角中储存的电能。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can create a harmless orb of its own electricity that can be played with by those it is friendly with. The creation of the orb temporarily drains the electric energy stored within its horns.

entry: 它肢体末端的轮胎状部分，无法当轮子，却能隔绝电属性攻击。橡胶般的特质，让它能够抵御电击。
author: .izik
source: The tire-like ends of its limbs cannot function as wheels, but they insulate it from electric attacks. This rubbery property makes it resistant to shocks.

entry: 没有足够泥地玩时，POKENAME就会原地高速滚动，挖出新泥坑。有时滚得太开心，挖得太深，自己也很难爬出。
author: sk372
source: When muddy locations to play in are scarce, POKENAME rolls in place at high speeds to dig its own new mud hole. Sometimes it enjoys the act of rolling so much that it digs a hole so deep it has difficulty climbing out.

entry: 厚重、带轮胎纹理的冠，储存巨大精神能量。POKENAME用长鼻感知地面振动，随意操控土石，是国王与王后的强大守护者。
author: the_lunarian
source: Its thick, tire-textured crown stores immense psychic energy. POKENAME senses vibrations in the ground using its trunk and bends earth and stone to its will, serving as a formidable guardian of kings and queens.

entry: POKENAME夜里出没墓园，无声滚过墓碑之间。它撞击盗墓者的力量，强到把人抛得不见踪影。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME haunts graveyards by night, rolling silently between headstones. It crashes into graverobbers with such force they're flung from sight.

entry: 它进食前，会用爪子仔细将食物切成小块。细致的吃法，让它出人意料地文雅。
author: .izik
source: Using its claws, it carefully cuts food into smaller pieces before eating. This meticulous approach makes it a surprisingly refined eater.

entry: 覆盖身体的物质，形似灰色象牙，会自然生长，保护身躯。坚韧外层，让原本强健的身体更耐打。
author: .izik
source: The material covering its body resembles grey ivory, naturally growing to protect it. This tough exterior adds durability to its already robust frame.

entry: POKENAME高速向前滚动时，坚硬不平的身体，会撕裂周围地貌。它很可能只需几分钟，就能破坏一座小山内部的稳定。
author: sk372
source: When rolling forward at high speeds, POKENAME's tough, uneven body tears up the landscape around it. It could conceivably destabilize the inside of a small mountain in minutes.

entry: POKENAME在岩山筑巢，常聚成大群。头撞山壁，便能引发大规模落石，驱赶捕食者。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME make their nests in rocky mountains, often gathering in large groups. By slamming their heads into the mountainside, they can cause large rockslides to drive out predators.

entry: 吃不饱时，它会跺脚、鸣鼻，表达愤怒。响亮的动静，足以震动周围地面。
author: .izik
source: When underfed, it stomps and trumpets through its trunk in a show of anger. This loud display is enough to shake the ground around it.

entry: 这头披甲猛兽，冲势如货运列车，出击却精准无比。POKENAME一锁定猎物，就非得压扁或切碎，才肯停下。
author: jaminmcready
source: This armored beast charges with the momentum of a freight train and the precision of a surgical strike. Once POKENAME locks onto prey, it will not stop until the target is flattened or sliced to pieces.

entry: 它滚下峡谷时，会用爪保持平衡，表演复杂技巧。敏捷的身手，让它轻松穿过陡峭地形。
author: .izik
source: It performs intricate tricks while rolling down canyons, using its claws for balance. This agility allows it to navigate steep terrain with ease.

entry: 军校会让士兵与POKENAME一同受训。敏锐双眼和强壮身体，让它们适合特殊行动；无畏与自豪，也会在训练中鼓舞部队。
author: quackquackattack
source: Military academies train soldiers alongside POKENAME, as their keen eyes and sturdy physique make them great candidates for specialized operations. Their fearless disposition and strong sense of pride inspire troops during training.

entry: 橡胶般的耳朵，能异常清楚地听见远处声音。这份敏锐，让它在潜在威胁抵达前，就先行察觉。
author: .izik
source: Its rubbery ears allow it to hear distant sounds with impressive clarity. This heightened sense helps it detect potential threats before they arrive.

entry: 每只腹部的圆纹都独一无二，存在细微差异。有些区别，微小得肉眼也看不出来。
author: .izik
source: The circle on its stomach is unique to each individual, showing subtle differences. Some circles display microscopic variations that set each apart.

entry: POKENAME与大多数远亲同住，结成大群。它极其保护幼崽，谁靠近同族，也会遭到攻击。一旦朝你滚来，就无处可逃。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME live in large groups, staying with most of their extended family. Extremely protective of its young, POKENAME will attack any who draw near its brethren. When one starts to roll at you, there is no escape.

entry: POKENAME缩进壳里后，滚动时速最高75英里，烈火会包住全身。沿途经过的地方，都会留下烧焦的草迹。
author: secondegg
source: When POKENAME curls into its shell, it can roll at speeds of up to 75 mph, blazing fire overtaking its body. Wherever one has traveled, it leaves a trail of burnt grass in its wake.

entry: 它会先在半空翻跟头，再猛然俯冲向猎物。杂技般的动作，让攻击能从意想不到的角度到来。
author: .izik
source: It performs somersaults midair before diving sharply toward its prey. This acrobatic maneuver allows it to strike from unexpected angles.

entry: 大大的肉质耳朵，能在移动时接住气流，让它短暂滑翔。需要时，便有片刻飞行的机会。
author: .izik
source: Its large, fleshy ears allow it to glide for short periods, catching air currents as it moves. This gives it brief moments of flight when needed.

entry: 它滚动时常失衡摔倒，却总会再次尝试。每一次努力，都显露着韧性与决心。
author: .izik
source: It often loses balance and tumbles when rolling, but it always tries again. Its resilience and determination are evident in every attempt.

entry: 对POKENAME的DNA分析发现，它与伽勒尔的某种宝可梦有相似之处。化石记录也表明，它与顿甲的一种古老亚种相似。
author: jojojax164
source: When DNA from POKENAME was analyzed, it was found to bear a resemblance to a Pokémon from Galar. Fossil records also suggest that it shares similarities with an ancient subspecies of Donphan.

entry: POKENAME会用强劲长鼻摇树，吃掉落的树果。天然栖息地靠近人类聚落，因此常遭交通事故殃及。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME harnesses the power of its trunk to vigorously shake trees and eat the berries that drop. It is often a victim of car accidents because its natural habitat lies close to human settlements.

entry: POKENAME的拟态十分奇特，颈部皮膜的花纹像汽车警示标志，还会随身体健康状况而改变。
author: capwolfbane
source: A bizarre example of mimicry, POKENAME's hood patterns resemble automotive warning symbols. The exact symbol changes according to its physical health.

entry: 它用长鼻吸起小石头吃，补充矿物。长期这样的饮食，让岩石外层更加结实。
author: .izik
source: It sucks up tiny stones into its trunk and consumes them as a source of minerals. This steady diet strengthens its rocky exterior.

entry: 它用长鼻吸住洞顶睡觉，身体来回摇晃。钟摆般的动作，让休息更加安心。
author: .izik
source: It suctions onto cave ceilings with its trunk and rocks back and forth while sleeping. This pendulum-like motion calms it as it rests.

entry: POKENAME绕圈甩尾发电。能量积够，就会将全身蜷成裹着电力的球，撞倒沿途一切阻碍。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME generates electricity by swinging its tail around in a circle. Once it builds up enough energy, it curls its whole body into an electricity-coated sphere to bowl down any opposition in its path.

entry: 它用长鼻在冰上敲出凹痕，标记领地，警告其他生物。这些冰中信号，让竞争者不敢靠近。
author: .izik
source: It uses its trunk to make dents in ice, marking its territory to warn others. This icy signal keeps rivals at bay.

entry: POKENAME与军队教官一起训练士兵，专业和经验，赢得人类与其他宝可梦的尊敬。操练时，它给学员很大压力，严厉又关爱的性格，十分适合这份工作。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME train soldiers alongside military instructors, their expertise and experience command respect from both people and other Pokémon. They apply a lot of pressure during drills, and their strict yet caring nature is perfect for the role.

entry: POKENAME醒目的外形，深受孩子喜爱。玩具制造商常以它为原型做活动人偶，重现充满动感的姿势。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME's striking appearance has made it a favourite among children. Toy makers often model action figures after it, capturing its dynamic stance.

entry: 虽然体形与力量惊人，POKENAME内心却十分温柔胆怯。连小得多的宝可梦想陪它玩打架，也会让它害怕受伤，蜷成一团。
author: sk372
source: Despite possessing great size and strength, POKENAME is incredibly gentle and timid at heart. Even a much smaller Pokémon attempting to play-fight with it will make it curl into a ball for fear of its safety.

entry: POKENAME能滚上坡、穿过雪地、越过湿沼。科学家研究它，为汽车业改善轮胎抓地力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is capable of rolling up hills, through snow, and across wet marshes. It is studied by scientists for the automotive industry to improve tire traction.

entry: 它用披风兜住空气，借上升气流长距离滑翔，花很少力气，就能走得很远。
author: .izik
source: By collecting air in its cape, it can catch updrafts to glide over long distances. This technique allows it to travel far with minimal effort.

entry: 人们在冰块中发现过数千年前冻结的POKENAME，身体完整无损。最近，科学家用其DNA，成功合成一颗POKENAME肉丸，在网上掀起热议。
author: musicsheep.
source: Frozen POKENAME from thousands of years ago has been discovered fully intact in chunks of ice. Scientists recently managed to use its DNA to synthesize a POKENAME meatball, which led to lots of online discussion.

entry: 它滚动时，会伸出利爪，将自己化作旋转武器。这种防御动作，让敌人难以靠近。
author: .izik
source: While rolling, it extends its sharp claws, turning itself into a spinning weapon. This defensive maneuver makes it difficult for foes to approach.

entry: POKENAME长鼻的位置，能表达情绪，越生气就举得越高。战斗时，它先用精神力量击晕对手，再用长鼻擒住、压碎。
author: pjporwoll
source: The position of POKENAME's trunk conveys its emotions, the trunk rising with its level of anger. In combat, it stuns opponents with its mental powers before grappling and crushing them with its trunk.

entry: POKENAME皮肤坚韧无比，双腿能踩碎坚实岩石。把腿收进身体，就能蜷成球，从山上滚向猎物。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's hide is incredibly tough, with their legs able to crush solid rock beneath them. By tucking their legs into their bodies, these Pokémon can curl up into a ball, rolling down mountains toward their prey.

entry: 獠牙具有实体，因此它用来刺穿敌人。有些传闻称，偷猎者的灵魂被囚在楔石中。
author: cait_sith
source: Its tusks are corporeal, so it uses them to pierce foes. Some rumors claim that the souls of poachers are imprisoned in its keystone.

entry: POKENAME不断向前跳，同时将履带向身前卷起，形成推动自己的环。抵达后，它会砸下履带，用獠牙勾住固定。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME repeatedly leap forward while curling their treads in front of them, creating a loop that propels them forward. When they arrive at their destination, they slam their treads down, using their tusks to hook them in place.

entry: POKENAME皮肤坚韧无比，全身布刺，是远古世界的强者。一只就能保护整群较小的宝可梦，抵御大批潜在捕食者。
author: sk372
source: With an extremely sturdy hide and spikes across its body, POKENAME was a powerhouse among the ancient world. A single POKENAME could defend a herd of smaller Pokémon from throngs of would-be predators.

entry: POKENAME会悄悄猎捕那些猎捕过顿甲的家伙，常在深夜现身。獠牙是唯一有实体的部分，让它与受威胁的近亲同样致命。
author: leandermalurt
source: POKENAME stealthily hunt those who have hunted Donphan, often appearing in the middle of the night. Their tusks are the only corporeal part, making them as deadly as their threatened kin.

entry: 它没有能看的眼睛，完全靠触觉辨路。双手独立飘浮，向外伸探，感知周围一切。
author: .izik
source: With no eyes to see, it relies entirely on touch to navigate its surroundings. Its hands float independently, reaching out to sense everything around it.

entry: 它的翅膀坚韧无比，像自带的盾，能轻松挡开攻击。边缘也极锋利，切开巨石，几乎不费力。
author: sk372
source: Its wings are incredibly tough, acting as built-in shields that deflect attacks with ease. The edges are very sharp as well, able to cut clean through a boulder with little effort.

entry: 它滚成轮胎形充电时，颈边毛发便噼啪迸电。带电的旋转，让力量更强。
author: .izik
source: The fur around its neck crackles with electric energy as it rolls into a tire shape, charging itself up. This electrifying spin intensifies its power.

entry: POKENAME用翅膀飞行时，尾巴仍能重击地面，引发地震。沙暴中，偶尔能听见它从长鼻吹出富有乐感的鸣声。
author: .jerden
source: While flying with its wings, POKENAME can strike the ground with its tail hard enough to trigger earthquakes. In sandstorms, POKENAME can occasionally be heard making musical trumpeting noises by blowing air out of its trunk.

entry: POKENAME滚过荒地，触角便向四面抽打，阻止别人干扰旅程。短暂冲刺时，时速最高85英里。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feelers whip in all directions while it rolls across wastelands to deter others from interrupting its travel. It can reach speeds of up to 85 miles per hour in short bursts.

entry: POKENAME抓住空气，仿佛握住实体，再抛出去，激起足以造成大地震与海啸的冲击波。哪怕战斗中重伤，甚至死去，它也仍屹立不倒。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME grasps the air as if it were a solid object and throws it, generating shockwaves capable of causing large-scale earthquakes and tsunamis. Even when severely wounded in battle, POKENAME does not keel over, even in death.

entry: 传说，POKENAME光是迈步，就能重塑大地。深凹坑般的脚印化石被发现后，也为这些古老故事，增添了现代佐证。
author: eiskitsune
source: Legends speak of how POKENAME's very steps would reshape the ground. The discovery of deep, craterous, fossilized footprints has lent modern credence to these ancient tales.

entry: POKENAME是消防员常见的伙伴，扑救严重火灾时，十分可靠。它们用炮筒吸取附近的水，再以消防水管般的压力喷出。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are common partners of firemen, as they're great companions when dealing with harsher fires. They use their cannons to suck up any nearby water, firing it out with the same pressure as a firehose.

entry: POKENAME结成小群，生活在山坡。强力尾巴只需一甩，就能把巨石打成碎块。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives in small herds along mountainous slopes. One swing of POKENAME's powerful tail can reduce boulders to rubble.

entry: POKENAME全速滚动时，身体能轻松穿过石头。这段真正没有实体的时期，想击中它，难上加难。
author: .izik
source: When rolling at top speed, POKENAME's body can pass through stone with ease. During this literally incorporeal period, it becomes incredibly difficult to strike.

entry: POKENAME以小群居住在山脉内外。虽然深居简出，每逢满月，群体仍会聚来，朝圆月齐鸣，声音回荡数英里。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME live in small colonies residing in or near mountain ranges. Though reclusive, the packs gather every full moon to trumpet together at the orb, the sound of which echoes for miles.

entry: 嘴里伸出的长鼻状附肢，弹性极强，最长能伸到50英尺。虽然伸得远，摸起来仍柔软。
author: .izik
source: The trunk-like appendage extending from its mouth is highly elastic, able to stretch up to 50 feet. Despite its reach, the trunk remains soft to the touch.

entry: 獠牙对环境变化极敏感，能提前察觉龙卷风等风暴，帮助它躲过恶劣天气。
author: .izik
source: Its tusks are extremely sensitive to environmental changes, detecting storms like tornados in advance. This sensitivity helps it stay safe from severe weather.

entry: 它将履带般的尾巴绕在身上，旋转全身上山。尾巴大小不同，转移重心，让不同尾巴承重，无论地形如何，都能尽量平稳前进。
author: gronkissimo
source: It wraps its tread-like tails around itself and spins its whole body to travel up mountains. The tails are different sizes, and by shifting its weight onto specific treads, it can ensure it travels as smoothly as possible, regardless of terrain.

entry: 手臂与长鼻坚如岩石，能挡住大多数攻击。它能蜷成轮状，猛烈冲撞对手。
author: infinex21
source: Its arms and trunk are as hard as rock and protect it from most attacks. It can curl up into the form of a wheel and ram into opponents with great force.

entry: 网球选手喜欢请POKENAME陪练，因为它能从长鼻发球，精准落在场地指定位置。它还用尾巴当球拍，打出截击，考验选手的反应与速度。
author: oddwalls
source: Tennis players favor POKENAME as a practice partner because it can launch tennis balls from its trunk to precise locations on the court. POKENAME uses its tail as a racket to strike volleys that test the player's reaction time and speed.

entry: 它斩向敌人时，会发出响亮鼻鸣，威吓对手，也宣告自己准备好战斗。
author: .izik
source: It emits a loud trumpet noise as it slashes at its foes. This sound can be intimidating and signals its readiness to fight.

entry: 它用长鼻保持平衡，在满月下优雅起舞。荒野中的夜间演出，令人着迷。
author: .izik
source: Balancing on its trunk, it dances gracefully under full moonlight. This nocturnal performance is a mesmerizing sight in the wilderness.

entry: 强壮的鼻子能推倒树，让它轻松吃到果实。既能觅食，也能在密林中清出路。
author: .izik
source: Its strong nose can knock down trees, allowing it easy access to fruit. This method not only provides food but also clears paths through dense forests.

entry: 它先顺时针旋转，向周围撒出火星，再施以强力一击。火焰旋转能威吓对手，烧灼沿途一切。
author: .izik
source: It spins clockwise, showering sparks around its body before delivering a powerful strike. This fiery spin intimidates opponents and scorches anything in its path.

entry: 它停在建筑顶上，发现猎物后，便沿外墙垂直滚下追逐。出人意料的战术，让伏击格外有效。
author: .izik
source: Perching atop buildings, it waits until it spots prey, then rolls vertically down the structure in pursuit. This surprising tactic allows it to ambush effectively.

entry: 它会跳起耀眼的桑巴舞，按节奏踢起碎石。心情低落时尤其常见，舞蹈能让它重新振作。
author: .izik
source: It performs a dazzling samba, kicking up gravel in rhythmic patterns. This dance, especially common when it is feeling down, lifts its spirits.

entry: POKENAME皮肤坚韧，又常以中等规模结群旅行，很难被捕食。有些船会带饵，让群体贴船游动，借此抵御其他凶猛水下生物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tough hide combined with its tendency to travel in moderate-sized schools makes it quite difficult to prey on. Some ships carry bait to keep the groups swimming close to the boat as a way to guard it from other aggressive undersea life.

entry: 它滚动时，会渗出酸性的红色液体，腐蚀脚下地面。留下的痕迹，常让潜在追赶者打退堂鼓。
author: .izik
source: As it rolls, it leaks an acidic red liquid that corrodes the ground beneath it. This trail often deters any would-be pursuers.

entry: 它移动时，分泌滑溜黏液，常被用于城都的护发产品。这种黏液能让头发更有光泽、更强韧，因此十分抢手。
author: .izik
source: It secretes a slick mucus as it moves, which is commonly used in haircare products around Johto. This goo adds shine and strength to hair, making it highly sought after.

entry: 身体摸着柔软，战斗时却会变硬。四肢力量惊人，连公交车那么重的物体也能举起。
author: .izik
source: Its body feels soft to the touch but hardens during combat. Its limbs are incredibly strong, capable of lifting objects as heavy as a bus.

entry: 它没有嘴，只能通过长鼻吃喝。独特的适应方式，让它仍能补足营养与水分。
author: .izik
source: Due to its lack of a mouth, it consumes food and drink exclusively through its trunk. This adaptation keeps it nourished and hydrated in its own unique way.

entry: 它战斗时，把长鼻当额外肢体，做出连职业摔跤手也会惊叹的动作，凶猛而难以预测。
author: .izik
source: It uses its trunk as an extra limb in combat, executing moves that would astonish professional wrestlers. This skill makes it a fierce and unpredictable fighter.

entry: 它边滚，边向四面射出身上的针。旋转攻势，让敌人几乎别想全身而退。
author: .izik
source: While rolling, it shoots needles from its body in all directions. This spinning assault leaves its foes with little chance to escape unharmed.

entry: 它能从长鼻精准射针，远远钉住猎物。强力的针，让它成为野外熟练的猎手。
author: .izik
source: It can fire needles from its trunk with precision, pinning down prey from a distance. These powerful needles make it a skilled hunter in the wild.

entry: 覆盖身体的沙，锋利如碎玻璃，让任何想触碰的生物都退缩。粗糙外层，是强大的防御。
author: .izik
source: The sand covering its body is as sharp as broken glass, deterring any who might touch it. This rough exterior serves as a powerful defense.

entry: POKENAME的力量相对体形，惊人无比，能用长鼻拔起整株灌木作零食。背上蘑菇的孢子，是一种热门草本训练前补剂的主要成分。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME have incredible strength compared to their size and use their trunk to pull up whole shrubs to snack on. The spores that the mushrooms on their back produce are a major component in a popular herbal pre-workout.

entry: POKENAME用坚硬披甲的双臂保持平衡，滑下陡坡，在山地迅速穿行。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME balances on its hard, armored arms to slide down steep slopes. This allows it to travel quickly across mountainous terrain.

entry: POKENAME侧身滚过洞穴地面。滚得越快，宝石越亮，沿途便拖出缥缈闪光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rolls on its side across cave floors. Its gems glow brighter the faster it rolls, creating an ethereal, sparkling trail as it moves.

entry: POKENAME的身体像熔炉，能燃煤产能，供给强力的滚动攻击。
author: gwello
source: POKENAME's body works like a furnace. It is capable of burning coals to generate energy for its powerful rollout attack.

entry: POKENAME形状虽怪，穿过珊瑚隧道时却快得出奇。它用坚硬头部清除残骸，为成群的小型水属性宝可梦开出安全道路。
author: mgfox_66676
source: Despite its odd shape, POKENAME charges through coral tunnels with unexpected speed. It uses its tough head to clear debris and make safe paths for schools of smaller Water-types.

entry: 强壮的獠牙，能轻松撬松洞壁内嵌的宝石。它会把这些宝物收起来，藏进隐蔽处。
author: .izik
source: Using its strong tusks, it loosens gems embedded in cave walls with remarkable ease. It collects these treasures and hides them in secret spots.

entry: 它用精神力量提高滚速，甚至能凭念力滚过水面，既灵活，也让对手意想不到。
author: .izik
source: It uses psychic power to increase its rolling speed and can even roll over water with telekinesis. This ability makes it both agile and surprising to opponents.

entry: POKENAME有高大的披甲冠饰，保护壮丽的鬃毛。它们很爱护毛发，谁想摸，就用咆哮吓走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have large, armoured crests that protect their impressive manes. They are protective of their fur, roaring to scare away those who try to touch them.

entry: POKENAME用坚实长鼻，给对手毁灭性打击。巨大耳朵能让它从高处滑翔，甚至在栖身的沙质草原上短暂飞行。一看见竞争者，便毫不迟疑地冲锋。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its sturdy trunk to deliver devastating blows to its opponents. Its enormous ears allow it to glide from great heights and even soar briefly over the sandy steppes it inhabits. At the sight of a rival, it charges without hesitation.

entry: 长鼻能过滤毒素，帮助它在火山烟雾附近呼吸。它因此能在其他生物避开的毒性区域，自由游荡。
author: .izik
source: Its trunk filters out toxins, helping it breathe near volcanic smoke. This adaptation lets it roam freely around toxic areas others avoid.

entry: POKENAME惊人的智力，已成为许多研究的主题。事实证明，野生个体能耕种、使用工具，甚至建造简单结构。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's surprisingly strong intelligence has been the subject of numerous studies. As it turns out, farming, tool usage, and even creating simple structures are all within wild POKENAME's capabilities.

entry: POKENAME全身肌肉发达，一拳就能打飞搬家货车。它也能制造、使用工具，辅助砍木等工作。
author: bobosmith01
