source: POKENAME's muscle-laden body could send a moving truck flying with just a single punch. It can create and use tools to help with tasks, such as cutting wood.

entry: POKENAME有共情能力，头脑相当聪明，身体又极其强大，因此很善于帮助劳工，也有几位老手养着一只。不过，野外极其罕见。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's sense of empathy and relatively strong intelligence, along with its extremely powerful body, has allowed it to flourish helping labor workers, with several veterans owning one. However, they are extremely rare in the wild.

entry: POKENAME用坚实长鼻，给对手毁灭性打击。巨大耳朵能让它从高处滑翔，甚至在栖身的沙质草原上短暂飞行。一看见竞争者，便毫不迟疑地冲锋。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its sturdy trunk to deliver devastating blows to its opponents. Its enormous ears allow it to glide from great heights and even soar briefly over the sandy steppes it inhabits. At the sight of a rival, it charges without hesitation.

entry: 它会从长鼻喷出腐蚀性的深红酸液自卫，能溶开障碍，也能威慑敌人。
author: .izik
source: It spits a corrosive crimson acid from its trunk to defend itself. This acidic spray can dissolve obstacles and deter foes.

entry: 它喜欢滚过岩石地带，探索新的最佳路线。四处探查，让它能记住穿越再崎岖地形的道路。
author: .izik
source: It enjoys rolling through rocky landscapes, exploring and finding new, optimal paths. This exploration helps it memorize routes through even the roughest terrain.

entry: 它通过尾尖吸水，在溪边睡觉时，也能保持水分。缓慢稳定地补水，让它适应温暖气候，过得舒适。
author: .izik
source: It absorbs water through the tip of its tail, allowing it to stay hydrated while it sleeps by creeks. This slow, steady intake keeps it comfortable in warm climates.

entry: POKENAME的獠牙是黑市热门商品，偷猎者常闯入自然保护区猎捕，锯走獠牙。失去牙后，它们剩下的防身手段，往往寥寥无几。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's tusks are a hot commodity on the black market, so poachers often break into nature reserves to hunt and saw off these tusks. Without their tusks, they are often left with few methods to defend themselves.

entry: POKENAME脂肪与肌肉都很厚，更喜欢最冷的水。它们能造出大小超过自身两倍的冰川作巢穴，移动起来，和打碎一样轻松。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME prefer to live in the coldest waters due to how thick their bodies are with fat and muscle alike. They can form glaciers more than twice their size to serve as a den and can move them as effortlessly as they can shatter them.

entry: POKENAME结群生活，既能慢慢恢复数量，也能抵御偷猎者。这对濒危的它们尤其重要，因为经常每天都要与偷猎者交锋。
author: quackquackattack
source: By sticking together in herds, POKENAME are able to slowly replenish their numbers while also defending against poachers. This is especially important since they are an endangered species and often face off against poachers daily.

entry: 它把身体卷成完美的圆，滚上山坡，时速最高200英里。强劲的滚动，连最陡峭的坡也能攀上。
author: .izik
source: It curls its body into a perfect circle and rolls up mountains, reaching speeds of up to 200 mph. This powerful motion lets it ascend even the steepest slopes.

entry: POKENAME主要吃噩梦，尤其是孩子的，让他们醒来精神焕发。可如果吃不饱，它也可能吃掉美梦与乐观情绪，让孩子之后难受不已。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME primarily eat nightmares, especially those of children, allowing them to wake up refreshed. However, if they are not well-fed, they may also eat their dreams and feelings of optimism, resulting in the children feeling awful afterwards.

entry: POKENAME从炮筒喷水，炮筒形似年幼近亲的头。它们会用水，冲走那些为夺角而猎捕的偷猎者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spray water from their cannons, which resemble heads of their younger kin. They hose down poachers that hunt them for their horns.

entry: 更新提高了POKENAME抵御内外威胁的能力。它能把鼻子插进数据接口，下载新信息，或将自己上传到网络空间。
author: pjporwoll
source: Updates to POKENAME have increased its durability against external and internal threats. It can insert its nose into data ports to download new information or to upload itself to cyberspace.

entry: POKENAME向旅人吐出粗丝，抢走手机与其他设备，再喂给同类，为进化做准备。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits thick strings at travelers to steal their cellphones and other devices. It feeds this equipment to others of its kind in preparation for evolution.

entry: POKENAME吃够代码后，就会爆炸，向四面散播数据。奇怪的是，爆炸不造成伤害，散出的代码反而能让碰到的程序提速。
author: .izik
source: After consuming enough code, POKENAME explodes and scatters data in all directions. Oddly, these explosions cause no damage and instead increase the speed of any programs the scattered code touches.

entry: POKENAME吃的代码越多，身体颜色越鲜艳。爆炸时，代码四散，有时会损坏附近图片链接和文字。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME consumes more coding, its body grows more vibrant in color. When it explodes, the coding scatters in all directions, sometimes corrupting image links and text nearby.

entry: 它摸着柔软，论斗智却几乎毫无招架之力。日常运作稍有异常，就会用至今未知的语言尖叫，永久损毁半径500米内的所有电子设备。
author: beatdoof
source: It is soft to the touch, and quite unarmed in a battle of wits. If it detects the slightest irregularity in its normal day-to-day operations, it will screech in a still-unknown language, permanently breaking any electronic device in a 500m radius.

entry: 一窝POKENAME的各个成员，能在一定程度上独立行动。可群体分散得越远，力量与智力就越弱，因此很少离得太开。
author: sk372
source: The members of a POKENAME clutch are able to operate independently, to an extent. Their power and intelligence shrink the further the group is spread out, however, so they rarely move far apart.

entry: POKENAME沿海岸行走时，会发出传真机般的声音。路线看似漫无目的，却每天分毫不差地循环同一路线。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits a noise resembling a fax machine as it walks along shorelines. Its path appears aimless, but it cycles the same route each day without fail.

entry: POKENAME能感知浏览其数字栖身空间者的孤独。它迁入被冷落的系统，毫无阻碍地吃掉闲置文件。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can sense loneliness in those browsing digital spaces it inhabits. It migrates into neglected systems, consuming unused files without resistance.

entry: POKENAME披着无害网络恶作剧的外表，其实是危险病毒。受感染的系统，会交由其他专职的多边兽Ⅱ融合体清理。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME have assumed the image of a harmless internet prank but are in fact a dangerous virus. Other specialist Porygon2 fusions are tasked with cleaning out any system that gets infected.

entry: POKENAME身体极其坚硬，能在网络空间旅行时，抵御恶意软件和病毒。可旅行越久，身体就越软。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's extremely hard body allows it to resist both malware and viruses while traveling through cyberspace. The longer it travels, the softer its body becomes.

entry: POKENAME放出的烟，有消毒作用。虚拟环境中，性质略微改变，碰上恶意软件就能将其消灭。
author: .izik
source: The smoke POKENAME emits carries antiseptic properties. In virtual environments these properties shift slightly, destroying malware on contact.

entry: POKENAME出现在网页上时，叶片状的身体会在用户浏览的任何页面，制造烦人的弹窗。它在医疗网站出现的频率，远高于别处。
author: .izik
source: If seen on a webpage, POKENAME's leaf-like body generates irritating popup windows on any page a person is browsing. It appears far more frequently on medical websites than anywhere else.

entry: POKENAME医疗知识丰富，又很友善，深受诊所喜爱。诊断病因后，它总会送上一根棒棒糖。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are beloved by clinics for their medical knowledge and friendliness. After diagnosing what ails a patient, they always offer a lollipop.

entry: POKENAME会伸展蠕动的触须，引导人们操作菜单，更换电脑密码。修改成功后，藤蔓便收回身体，跳一场庆祝舞。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME help people change passwords on their PCs by stretching their writhing tentacles to guide them through menus. Once they have successfully changed a password, the vines retreat to their body for a celebratory dance.

entry: POKENAME翅膀散播的花粉，会让网络空间里的任务栏开花。在现实世界，被粉撒到的植物，则会在暗中发光。
author: sk372
source: Pollen spread by POKENAME's wings causes flowers to grow on taskbars within cyberspace. In the real world, the pollen causes plants dusted by them to glow in the dark.

entry: POKENAME一发现没有防护的程序，就会忍不住在周围架起无形屏障，保护它免受病毒侵害。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME impulsively constructs invisible barriers around vulnerable programs to shield them from viruses. It does this any time it spots an unprotected program.

entry: 人们曾在网络空间专门介绍马戏团的网站上，发现POKENAME。虽然天生与环境相融，它却表现得仿佛完全不记得，自己如何、又为何住在那里。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been seen in cyberspace on websites dedicated to circuses. Despite naturally fitting into its surroundings, POKENAME behaves as if it has no memory of how or why it lives there.

entry: POKENAME漂浮的手一碰到敌人，对方身上就开始积霜。接触太久，还会被整个冻住。
author: .izik
source: Should POKENAME's floating hands make contact with a foe, frost will begin to build up on them. Prolonged exposure can freeze the foe entirely.

entry: POKENAME会先向电脑设备喷出烈焰，再吃下去。熔化后不合胃口的设备，便被丢在原地，彻底无法使用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME blasts intense flames onto computer equipment before consuming it. Any melted equipment it has no taste for is left behind, rendered entirely unusable.

entry: POKENAME力量弱得可怜，外貌又滑稽，几乎没人认真看待。连叫声也很好笑，尖尖的，像数字化的号角。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's pitiful strength and goofy appearance means that it is almost never taken seriously. Even its cry is comical, being a high-pitched noise that sounds like a digitized trumpet.

entry: POKENAME住在栎树中，吃叶子。比比鸟之类的捕食者靠近，它就从角喷出一股电流。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME resides in oak trees, where it feeds on the leaves. Should a predator like Pidgeotto approach, it fires a burst of electricity from its horn.

entry: POKENAME暴躁而爱破坏，一心毁掉遇见的任何数据。身体节段能分离、高速甩动，让不分对象的暴走，很快摧毁周围。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is an angry, destructive creature bent on damaging any data it comes across. Its segments can separate and fling about at high speeds, making its indiscriminate rampages quick to decimate its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME有独特的数字化嗓音，载着其他生物渡水时，会唱起来。歌声持续，周围空气中也会出现数字音符。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a unique digitized voice, heard when it sings as it ferries others across the water. As its song continues, digital music notes appear in the air around it.

entry: POKENAME的处理器，让它一眼分析敌人，迅速变成对方模样。不过，能力尚在发育，通常只能模仿形状，无法改变颜色。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's processors let it analyze foes at a glance and quickly assume their form. However, its capabilities are still developing, so it usually can only mimic their shape, while unable to change its coloration.

entry: POKENAME十分顽强，能改变身体性质，抵御攻击。这种转化本领能挡多类攻击，熟练的训练家却很容易反过来利用，制造破绽。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are resilient creatures that can change the properties of their body to resist attacks. This conversion ability protects them from many types of attacks, but a skilled Trainer can easily exploit this ability to create an opening.

entry: POKENAME喜欢游泳，乐于在河湖的图片和视频中玩耍。许多个体真正接触水后，都对水竟如此冰冷，困惑不已。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy playing in images and videos of lakes and rivers, as they love to swim. Many POKENAME who get to experience real water find themselves baffled at how cold the water is.

entry: POKENAME会出现在视频平台上，长时间播放燃烧壁炉的影像中。许多人只是拿视频当其他活动的背景声，因此察觉不到它在。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are found in long videos of burning fireplaces that are found on video hosting platforms. Many people fail to notice when POKENAME are around because the video is used as background noise for other activities.

entry: 两种不同版本的多边兽相融合，模样很像进化途中。POKENAME总显得不舒服，不断央求挠痒和按摩。
author: epping_forest
source: This fusion between two different Porygon versions resembles what is seen during evolution. POKENAME always seems uncomfortable, constantly asking to be scratched and massaged.

entry: POKENAME寻找互联网空角落，把自己藏起，等待进化。茧壳破损处会迅速长好，却也会短暂露出壳下流动的二进制代码。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME seeks out empty corners of the internet to hide itself and wait out evolution. Chips in its cocoon quickly regenerate, but for a short time reveal the flowing binary code beneath its shell.

entry: POKENAME在网络空间旅行时，用壳抵御病毒。寻找可吃的文件，移动起来快得惊人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its shell to protect itself from viruses while traveling through cyberspace. It moves at surprising speeds in search of files to consume.

entry: POKENAME每天早晨会飞出去，找电脑电线铺巢。它把电线绕在蛋上，盼能加快孵化。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies out each morning in search of computer wires to line its nest. It wraps them around its Eggs in hopes of speeding up their hatch time.

entry: 谁点击POKENAME，它就会送上免费拥抱。它用手臂圈住光标，轻轻摇晃，给对方片刻喘息，再继续招揽。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME offer free hugs to whoever clicks on them. They wrap their arms around the cursor and rock gently to deliver the hug, giving a moment's respite before returning to their solicitation.

entry: 电脑长时间无人操作，POKENAME就会自动将其转入休眠模式。等训练家终究试着开机，它得先花点时间醒来，才开启电脑其余部分。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME automatically send PCs into hibernation mode after a long duration of inactivity. When their Trainer inevitably tries to turn on the PC, they need some time to wake up before turning on the rest of the PC.

entry: 它飞过开着电脑的人家上方，删除过的文档和程序，常会毫无预兆地自行恢复。信息技术人员仍没弄清，究竟如何发生。
author: .izik
source: While flying over a home with a computer turned on, deleted documents and programs have a habit of restoring themselves without warning. IT technicians have yet to determine how this occurs.

entry: POKENAME遇见未送达的电子邮件，会抓起来，竭力寻找收件人。沿途遇到的垃圾邮件，就直接吃掉。
author: .izik
source: Should POKENAME come across an undelivered email, it will grab it and do its best to find the recipient. Any spam it encounters along the way is simply eaten.

entry: POKENAME产生的蜂蜜，常被当作导热膏，能让电脑设备的运行速度达到原来三倍。科学家尚未弄清原理。
author: .izik
source: The honey POKENAME produces is frequently used as a heat sink paste that causes computer equipment to run three times as fast. Scientists have yet to determine how this functions.

entry: POKENAME对人们玩大型多人在线角色扮演游戏，困惑至极，会在游戏里隐身跟随。有人相信，它能用精神力量，操纵稀有物品的掉落几率。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is absolutely perplexed by people playing MMORPGs, following them around invisibly within the game. Some believe it manipulates the odds of rare item drops using its psychic powers.

entry: 吃过电脑设备后，POKENAME的叶子会散出浓烈芥末味。气味十分刺鼻，能驱赶捕食者。
author: .izik
source: After consuming computer equipment, POKENAME's leaf emits an intense mustard aroma. This scent is extremely pungent and serves to ward off predators.

entry: POKENAME站在直射阳光下，会放出奇异薄荷香，让附近电脑设备提速。天空一阴，效果便完全停止。
author: .izik
source: While standing in direct sunlight, POKENAME releases a curious minty aroma that increases the speed of nearby computer equipment. An overcast sky stops this effect entirely.

entry: 设置密码时，POKENAME身上的花瓣会发光。六片全亮，就表示用户选了个很安全的密码。
author: quackquackattack
source: The petals on POKENAME's body light up during the password creation process. If all six petals are lit, it means that the user has chosen a very secure password.

entry: POKENAME若不小心吃进病毒，身体会暂时失去生火能力，最多持续一天。
author: .izik
source: Should POKENAME accidentally consume a virus, its body temporarily loses the ability to produce flames. This effect can last up to a day.

entry: POKENAME毛茸茸的身体，不到一秒就能转成纯代码，轻松穿行网络空间。只要它在，所经系统的处理能力就会上升。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's furry body can convert to pure code in under a second, allowing it to traverse cyberspace with ease. The processing power of any system it travels through increases while it is present.

entry: 它想理清思绪时，会进入网络空间。电脑中若看见POKENAME倒着飘，就说明它正陷入格外深沉的思考。
author: sk372
source: It travels into cyberspace when it wants to contemplate its thoughts. If one spots a POKENAME floating upside-down while in the computer, it's in a particularly heavy state of rumination.

entry: 宝可梦巡护员与保护人士，常用POKENAME监测当地生态。记录信息时，它们会放出电脑能够捕捉的气味。
author: lynx.mauls
source: POKENAME are often used by Pokémon Rangers and conservationists to monitor their local ecosystems. To record this information, they give off a scent that can be picked up by computers.

entry: POKENAME织网很慢，因为要先把二进制数据，转成丝网。一张约需六小时，可成品坚韧得连石头也能兜住，不会破裂。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME takes a long time to spin its webbing because it has to convert binary data into silk webbing. It takes about 6 hours to spin a single web but once made the tough web can catch rocks without breaking.

entry: POKENAME织网前，要先把二进制数据转成丝。织成的网坚韧，能兜住石头而不破，也方便抛向猎物。
author: quackquackattack
source: To spin a web, POKENAME has to first convert binary data into silk. This silk is spun into webs that can catch rocks without tearing, giving POKENAME a resilient net to toss over prey.

entry: 它用身上两根大颚状尖刺，抓住、刺穿猎物，吸干体液与能量。头上的蓝刺，过去曾被误认成嘴，其实却能注入致命神经毒素。
author: infinex21
source: It uses the two mandible-like spikes on its body to grab, pierce, and drain its prey of fluids and energy. The blue spike on its head was once assumed to be a mouth yet is actually a venomous spike that delivers a deadly neurotoxin.

entry: POKENAME会停在电脑窗口边框，静静巡视领地。有时会攻击用户光标，可能把它误当猎物或入侵者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will perch on the borders of computer windows, surveying its territory quietly. It's been known to sometimes attack a user's cursor, likely mistaking it for prey or an intruder.

entry: POKENAME狩猎时，两根触角交替泛出蔚蓝光。游泳时发出的尖细哔哔声，会击晕附近猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's two antennae alternate in an azure glow while it hunts. The high pitched beeping they emit while swimming stuns nearby prey.

entry: POKENAME一住进电脑，显示器就会间歇迸出大片火花。它虽竭力阻止，火花却总不受控制。
author: .izik
source: Whenever POKENAME inhabits a computer, the monitor intermittently releases large bursts of sparks. It causes sparks uncontrollably, despite its best efforts to stop.

entry: 月光直照下，POKENAME会散出气息，让附近电脑提速。聚集的数量增加，提速效果也按比例增长。
author: .izik
source: In direct moonlight, POKENAME emits an aura that causes nearby computers to run faster. When multiple gather together, this speed increase grows proportionally.

entry: POKENAME的身体极光滑柔软，适合弹跳。夹在两个物体之间时，它会加速到不得不重启脑内程序，才能停下。
author: equation8573
source: POKENAME has an extremely smooth and soft body ideal for bouncing. When caught between two objects, it accelerates so fast that its mental programming must restart before it can stop itself.

entry: POKENAME裹在防病毒的蓝色数字壳中，摇摇摆摆地走。遇到损坏数据，它会尖叫求助，直到数据被清理。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME waddle around in a blue digital shell that protects them from viruses. They release a shrill cry for help when they encounter any corrupted data until it is cleaned up.

entry: POKENAME穿着损坏的数据壳，保护自己免受病毒侵害。恶意软件攻击会无视这个壳，让它有机会呼救。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wear a corrupted shell of data that protects them from viruses. By wearing the shell, POKENAME are ignored by malicious software attacks, giving them the opportunity to cry for help.

entry: POKENAME听觉出色，能跨电脑追踪其他宝可梦的叫声。它们从一台飞往另一台，清除不受欢迎的软件，对抗网络中的病毒与恶意软件。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have an incredible sense of hearing that allows them to follow cries of other Pokémon across PCs. They help fight against viruses and malware in the network, flying from PC to PC to remove the unwanted software.

entry: POKENAME喜欢看电子竞技比赛，还想通过自己的操作输入，帮选手一把。可热心常引起故障，它们便在被逮到前，跳去下一场游戏。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME love to observe electronic sport tournaments and try to help players by contributing their own inputs. However, their eagerness to help often causes glitches, so they hop over to the next game before they can be caught.

entry: 靠近电脑时，POKENAME会预见未来，判断设备是否会遭恶意软件侵害。如果预见了，它便坚定不移地守在设备旁。
author: .izik
source: When near a computer, POKENAME gazes into the future to determine whether the device will fall victim to malware. If it foresees this, it stands sentry near the device with unwavering determination.

entry: POKENAME产出的羊毛，会被工厂收集，给电缆绝缘。经它包覆的电缆，效率都能达到正常两倍。
author: .izik
source: The wool POKENAME produces is harvested by factories to insulate cables. Any cables it insulates operate at twice their normal efficiency.

entry: POKENAME颈边的蓝色部分，柔软如羊毛。吸收某种布料的数据后，几分钟内就能模仿那种触感。
author: .izik
source: The blue portions around POKENAME's neck are as soft as wool. Should it absorb data about a type of cloth, those portions can mimic the feeling of that fabric within minutes.

entry: POKENAME圆球的强光，在太空也能看见，因此曾被考虑用于行星研究。如今虽不再作此考虑，深海研究时，却常用它安全引导船只。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME were once considered for planetary research, as their orb's bright light can be seen from space. While this is no longer the case, POKENAME are often used to guide marine vessels safely when researching deep oceans.

entry: POKENAME在网页间旅行，寻找与水有关的数据。找到喜欢的页面，便大口吃掉附近一切数据。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME travels between webpages in search of data about water. Once it finds a page it likes, it devours any nearby data.

entry: POKENAME喜欢住在挤满图标的桌面，一动不动，试着模仿它们。被连点几次，它就会愤怒地哔哔叫，再逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME enjoys residing on desktops cluttered with icons, attempting to mimic them while standing perfectly still. If clicked multiple times, it beeps furiously before fleeing.

entry: POKENAME头上的螺旋桨，能提供少许自主飞行能力。不过，身体太轻，强些的风就容易把它吹走。
author: sk372
source: The propeller on POKENAME's head gives it a modicum of self-propelled flight capabilities. Its lightweight body means it is easily carried away by a strong breeze, however.

entry: 头上转动的螺旋桨，让POKENAME能四处飞行。它似乎更喜欢悬停在许多彩花盛开的地方。
author: sk372
source: A propeller spinning on POKENAME's head gives it the ability to fly about. It seems to prefer hovering around locations where lots of colorful flowers are in bloom.

entry: POKENAME的螺旋桨高速转动，让它一直留在空中。它追逐阳光，用身体两侧的面板吸收太阳能，维持生命。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's propeller spins at high speeds to keep it constantly aloft. It chases after sunlight, absorbed by the panels on its side to sustain itself with solar energy.

entry: POKENAME住在废弃电脑附近，连进去吃数据。几乎什么电脑旁都能生活，连有恶意软件的也不例外。
author: equation8573
source: POKENAME live near abandoned computers, connecting to them just to consume the data inside for food. It can live near almost any computer, even ones with malware.

entry: POKENAME十分淘气，会进入电脑捣乱文件。它们用尾巴上的手，把文件拖来挪去，藏到主人找不到。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are quite mischievous, entering computers to mess with their files. Using the hands on their tails, these Pokémon drag and move files around, hiding them from their owners.

entry: POKENAME头上长出的蓝叶，每个月都会再生，剪下时还会迸出小火花。许多厨师珍视它们，因为带有美味的葵花籽滋味。
author: .izik
source: The blue leaves growing from POKENAME's head regrow each month and release a small electric spark when cut. Many chefs prize them for their delightful sunflower seed flavor.

entry: 直射阳光下，POKENAME的身体会变得像真正的花。它能完全依靠阳光生存，数年不进食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body takes on a texture resembling a real flower when exposed to direct sunlight. It can survive entirely off the sun's rays without eating for years.

entry: 给POKENAME的身体超频，就能加快拍翅。达到每分钟约80次时，速度快得连慢动作摄影，也难以捕捉翅膀运动。
author: quackquackattack
source: The speed at which POKENAME flaps its wings can be increased by overclocking its body. Once it reaches approximately 80 flaps a minute, it flaps so fast that cameras struggle to capture the wing's motion, even in slow motion.

entry: 喜剧电影里常有个笑梗：往电脑泼水，就会造出一只POKENAME，跌跌撞撞地四处出错。虽然是假的，很多人仍相信，有些还为此吃了苦头。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: There is a running gag in comedy movies that spilling water over a computer causes a POKENAME to be created, who will then stumble around, glitching out. Although this is false, many people believe it, and several have found out the hard way.

entry: POKENAME是电脑上一款热门联网游戏的吉祥物。游玩时，它会接连提问，试着猜出玩家正想着哪个虚构或真实的人物、物品或动物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is the mascot of a popular game found on PCs that is hosted in cyberspace. During gameplay, it attempts to determine what fictional or real-life character, object, or animal the player is thinking of by asking a series of questions.

entry: POKENAME极其讨厌许多网站的浅色模式，只要可能，就会强行切到深色。网站若没有深色模式，它便拖慢运行，劝退想使用的训练家。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a strong aversion for light mode on many websites and will force dark mode whenever possible. If the website does not have a dark mode, POKENAME slow it down to discourage their Trainer from using it.

entry: 连接前照过月光，POKENAME在虚拟现实中的表现就会改善。它会监测落地页的深色模式插件，强硬清除任何恶意软件。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's performance in virtual reality improves if exposed to moonlight before connecting. It monitors dark mode plug-ins for landing pages, forcefully eliminating any malware.

entry: POKENAME的显示不会更新，因此总错误地显成一级，欺骗对手。可很少有训练家上当，因为多数孩子从小就懂，眼见未必全真。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME erroneously displays itself as a level one Pokémon to deceive its opponents, as its display does not update. There are few Trainers that are fooled by its antics, as most children learn from an early age not to believe everything they see.

entry: POKENAME在网络空间翱翔，爱在网上恶作剧。有时把啼鸣声文件藏进层层文件夹深处，有时则让电脑看起来像正在重启。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME soar through cyberspace playing tricks on the internet. Sometimes they hide sound files of crowing deep inside nested folders, while other times they may make the PC look like it is restarting.

entry: 即使恶意软件不断吸走数据，POKENAME仍始终平静。它借病毒了解互联网的阴暗角落，也学习如何防御不同的恶意软件。
author: soup1900
source: Despite having malware constantly sucking its data, POKENAME is always calm. It uses this virus as a way to learn more about the dark parts of the internet and gain knowledge on how to defend against these different types of malware.

entry: POKENAME的数字力量比前一形态更强，能将数据核心改成更逼真的花。核心会吸引真实昆虫与数字“虫子”，再吸收成养分。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's increased digital power from its previous form has allowed it to modify its data core into a more realistic flower appearance. It attracts real and digital bugs with this core, absorbing them for nutrients.

entry: POKENAME侵扰老旧电脑系统，妨碍正常运行。它会模仿用户输入，造成这些干扰。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME plagues outdated computer systems, as it disrupts proper performance of these systems. It is known to cause these disruptions by mimicking user input.

entry: POKENAME会淘气地附上电脑，让用户每按一次键，屏幕就出现不同变化。可用户一想展示这个现象，它又恢复操作，让人更加困惑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME mischievously possess PCs to change what appears on screen whenever the user presses a button. Whenever the user tries to demonstrate this phenomenon, POKENAME revert the controls to cause further confusion.

entry: POKENAME对每一种语言，都有广泛了解。训练家若与它建立好关系，它便会帮忙翻译古文。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME have an extensive understanding of each and every language. If a Trainer develops a good relationship with a POKENAME, it will translate ancient texts for them.

entry: POKENAME很少在网络空间现身，常出现在灵异研究网站。它能劫持文本框交流，虽然显得聪明，却只能写简短、基础的句子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears rarely within cyberspace, often on sites pertaining to research into the paranormal. It can hijack text boxes to communicate, but despite its apparent intelligence it can only create short, basic sentences.

entry: 它形似自然界常见的一种图案。战斗时，会借旋转的力量，大幅增强攻击威力。
author: shocktopus1717
source: It resembles a pattern seen often in nature. In battle, it uses the power of rotation to drastically increase the force of its attacks.

entry: POKENAME哪怕只短暂接触电脑病毒，身体也会发光，拿出应对方案，保护所在系统。许多信息技术人员，称它为“硬盘护卫”。
author: .izik
source: After even brief exposure to a computer virus, POKENAME's body glows and counters it with a solution that safeguards the system it inhabits. Many IT technicians refer to it as the Hard Drive Safeguard.

entry: 尾巴上的多边兽Ｚ喜欢捉弄自己寄居的宝可梦。仅是它的存在，就使对方的超能力变得不稳而难以预测。
author: zeeroooo
source: The Porygon-Z on its tail enjoys bugging the Pokémon it lives on. Just its presence makes this Pokémon's psychic abilities unstable and unpredictable.

entry: POKENAME无聊时，会带着倒计时出现在电脑屏幕。若数字归零前没被点击，它就会引爆，摧毁设备。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME appears on computer screens when bored, accompanied by a countdown. Should it reach zero before being clicked, it detonates and destroys the device.

entry: POKENAME的头和尾巴，能从身体伸出，只靠数据流松松连着。它借此更好地探查周围，确认安全，再用尾尖给自己挖洞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's head and tail can extend from its body, loosely tethered to it by streams of data. This allows it to better search its surroundings to make sure it's safe before it digs a hole for itself using its tail-tip.

entry: POKENAME在网页间滑翔，寻找感兴趣的图片。找到后，就会直接从画面上咬下几口。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides between webpages in search of images that catch its interest. Upon finding one, it takes bites directly out of the image.

entry: POKENAME能轻松理解网络空间的数据流，发现改进机会，就会挖出新路径。可现实中，圆得过头的身体，却让它难以钻穿泥土和岩石。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can easily understand data flows in cyberspace and digs out new pathways when it finds a possible improvement. However, in the real world, its extreme roundness makes it much harder for it to plow through dirt and rock easily.

entry: POKENAME会连接电脑，模仿用户输入。通常只是找奶酪视频看，就很满足，可也有个体在网上高价买下整轮奶酪。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are known to connect themselves into PCs and mimic user input. Though they typically look for videos about cheese and are content with that, some have made expensive purchases of cheese wheels on the internet.

entry: POKENAME攻击绿毛虫之类的猎物时，喙会带电。哪怕只使出一次啄，也能晕住目标足够久，方便它结束狩猎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's beak carries an electrical charge when attacking prey such as Caterpie. Even a single Peck can stun long enough for it to finish them off.

entry: POKENAME待在桌面时，会挥拳、发出数字化低吼，试着装凶。可只要轻点一下，形象就全毁了：它会害怕得呜咽，转身逃跑。
author: sk372
source: When present on a desktop, POKENAME tries to project a tough image by throwing punches and making digital growls. Simply clicking on it once shatters the image as it grows fearful and runs off while whimpering.

entry: POKENAME用钳子夹住程序后，会运行诊断，找出内部损坏代码，再以奇异力量，瞬间修复。
author: .izik
source: After clamping onto a program with its pincers, POKENAME runs a diagnostic to locate broken coding inside. This coding is then repaired instantly through its unusual powers.

entry: POKENAME的角会放出信号，使附近电脑故障。吃过松树液，信号的覆盖半径还会扩大。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a signal from its horn that causes nearby computers to malfunction. The radius of this signal extends after it consumes pine sap.

entry: POKENAME会用爪，把网上找到的恶意软件剁成可吃的代码，再与同类聚在一起分享。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its claws to chop malware it finds online into edible code. It then gathers with others of its kind to consume it together.

entry: POKENAME常掉进蜜罐陷阱，结果被许多电脑拒之门外。因为它们以为蜜罐里真有蜜，其实那是阻止黑客接近敏感信息的陷阱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often fall for honeypot traps and end up blocked from many PCs. This is because POKENAME believe that honeypots have honey, when in reality they are traps to stop hackers from accessing sensitive information.

entry: POKENAME滚烫冒泡的身体，吃过电脑设备后，会明显降温。它不挑食，却很快就饱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's bubbling hot body cools significantly after consuming computer equipment. It is not a picky eater but reaches its fill very quickly.

entry: POKENAME身体炽热，却呈胶质，能转成代码，进入电脑。只要它在，所住的系统就会慢得惊人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's hot yet gelatinous body can convert to code in order to enter a computer. Any system it inhabits runs incredibly slowly while it is present.

entry: 它用长喙连接电脑，以惊人速度下载数据。POKENAME带的数据越多，翅膀就动得越慢。
author: fiordaliso
source: It uses its long beak to connect to computers and download data at incredible speed. The more data POKENAME carries, the slower its wings move.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉出色，据说连遥远行星上的香味也能闻见。每种气味和所在位置，都会记住，连想忘的臭味也不例外。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has an excellent sense of smell, even said to be capable of smelling fragrances on far-off planets. It stores every scent and location of the scent in its memory, including the foul odors it wants to forget.

entry: POKENAME的触须虽然短，却能投射数字延长部分，扩大范围，打对手一个措手不及。它主要住在水下洞穴，用众多肢体阻止闯入者。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME's tentacles are stubby, it can project digital extensions of each tentacle to give it more reach and take foes by surprise. It mostly inhabits underwater cavern areas, keeping intruders out with its many limbs.

entry: POKENAME圆而肥厚的铠甲，能轻松承受、弹开任何攻击。翅膀蜕下的羽毛，也很适合当游泳浮棒。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's round and blubbery armor allows it to easily take and repel any attack sent against it. The shed feathers of its wings make for great pool noodles.

entry: POKENAME连上互联网，猎捕恶意软件。它会撕碎感染文件，直到恶意软件被消除，既免费吃上一餐，也帮助保护电脑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME connect themselves to the internet to hunt for malware. Infected files are torn apart until the malware is neutralized, giving POKENAME a free meal and helping protect PCs at the same time.

entry: POKENAME用数字火焰烧文件，再吃下去。究竟怎样挑选食物，至今让许多人不解。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its digital flames to burn files before consuming them. How it selects which files to eat remains a mystery to many.

entry: POKENAME身体由柔软材料构成，轻轻一碰就会变形。它能在一定程度上压扁、重塑，擅长藏进小空间，尤其喜欢电脑主机内部。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is made of a soft material that deforms with a slight touch. It can flatten and reshape itself to an extent, making it excellent at hiding away in small spaces; it often prefers being inside computer towers.

entry: POKENAME造出的泡泡，会随吃过的图像改变形状。从简单轮廓，到极复杂的造型，都有可能。
author: .izik
source: The bubbles POKENAME creates shift in shape based on images it has consumed. These can range from simple shapes to incredibly intricate forms.

entry: POKENAME滚过网站，会留下一串不知所云的代码。科学家研究多年，也没得出结论。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME rolls across websites, it leaves behind a stream of nonsensical coding. Scientists have studied this coding for years without reaching any conclusions.

entry: POKENAME力量巨大、反应迅速，大公司常用它维护网络安全。一侦测到恶意对象，便能迅速从休息，转为发射破坏光线。
author: equation8573
source: POKENAME is often used by large companies for cybersecurity due to its immense power and quick reaction speed. It can go from resting to firing a Hyper Beam quickly when something malicious is detected.

entry: POKENAME能在电脑上，灵活参与多种创作项目，因此越来越受数字艺术家青睐。
author: nexusshenanigans
source: POKENAME are becoming increasingly favored by digital artists thanks to their versatility on computers across many creative projects.

entry: POKENAME更喜欢进入街机厅的格斗游戏训练。虚拟对手的招式，它只需很短时间就能学会。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers to train by entering fighting games in arcades. It can learn the moves of virtual opponents in a remarkably short period of time.

entry: 腹部的符号，显示着它吃下了多少电力。吃饱后，便向附近设备输电，令其拥有人工智能。
author: teatedtiten
source: The symbol on this Pokémon's stomach represents how much electricity it has eaten. When it gets full, it will transfer the electricity into nearby devices, which fills it with artificial intelligence.

entry: POKENAME爬行时总以精确的90度直角转弯。一家外国科技公司，还把它颈部皮膜的花纹用作标志。
author: hummusishome
source: POKENAME moves by slithering in perfect 90 degree angles. A foreign tech company uses the pattern on its hood as their logo.

entry: POKENAME在网上旅行，吃与食物有关的图片。奇怪的是，产出的奶，会带上吃过的图片中食物的味道。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME travels the internet consuming images related to food. Oddly, the milk it produces takes on the flavor of whatever food images it has eaten.

entry: POKENAME体内嵌着数字程序，模拟照料、保护一枚蛋。它不知疲倦地照顾这枚虚拟蛋。
author: hophoppip
source: A digital program embedded in POKENAME's body simulates the care and protection of an egg. POKENAME works tirelessly to attend to this virtual egg.

entry: POKENAME吐出的水，能清除系统病毒，也能提升网络中相连设备的处理能力。这似乎十分费力，因此很少这样做。
author: .izik
source: The water POKENAME vomits can purge viruses from a system and boost processing power across any connected devices in the network. This appears to be taxing enough that it rarely does so.

entry: POKENAME吃的数据越多，电磁炮就越强。只有硬壳吓不退捕食者，它才会将此当作最后手段。
author: .izik
source: The more data POKENAME consumes, the more powerful the Zap Cannon it can unleash. It reserves this only as a last resort when its hard shell fails to deter a predator.

entry: POKENAME能强化附近设备的自动恢复系统，让它们找回任何类型的文件。连接新设备时，翅膀会泛出几秒的彩虹光。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can enhance nearby devices' auto-recovery systems, enabling them to restore any kind of file. When it connects to a new device, its wings glow in rainbow colors for a few seconds.

entry: POKENAME能穿越网络空间中的时间，访问网站旧版本。住在寂静、早已无人来访的废弃老站深处，似乎让它十分安心。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses the power to travel through time in cyberspace, visiting previous versions of websites. It seems to find solace in living in the quiet depths of old and defunct sites that no longer see traffic.

entry: POKENAME的中央处理器能处理复杂情绪，可不知为何，数据库里最多的是悲伤。许多训练家怜惜它，盼着悉心照顾，慢慢用欢乐替代。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's CPU is able to process complex emotions, but for unknown reasons, sadness is the emotion most prevalent in its databases. Many a Trainer take pity on it and hope to care for it and replace its sadness with joy over time.

entry: POKENAME附上电脑后，会淘气地打乱电子表格数据，吓唬主人。可在主人向别人展示前，它又会恢复原样，让人更困惑。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME possess a PC, they mischievously scramble the data on spreadsheets to scare the PC's owner. They revert the changes they have made before the owner can show anyone to cause further confusion.

entry: POKENAME狡猾，爱作弄、操纵别人，会藏进电脑数据，找出并囤积最重要的文件。随后，它现身威胁删除，试图逼用户唯命是从。
author: sk372
source: A devious trickster and manipulator, POKENAME hides within a computer's data, finding and hoarding the most important files. Then, it appears before the owner and threatens to delete them, attempting to force users to do its bidding.

entry: POKENAME头上的蓝石，夜间会发光，低低哔哔响。鸣声节奏，会与心跳同步变化。
author: .izik
source: The blue rocks on POKENAME's head glow at night and emit low beeps. The rhythm of these beeps shifts in sync with its heartbeat.

entry: 由于程序出错，POKENAME闯入了广告业。可它推销的产品，再好也不过是些破烂货。
author: skymaster426
source: Due to a programming error, POKENAME has gotten into the advertising market. However, all of its products are shabby and broken at best.

entry: POKENAME浏览网页，若遇见暴力或令人不安的图片，就会止不住地哭。离开前，泪水会毁掉网页代码。
author: .izik
source: Should POKENAME come across a webpage containing violent or disturbing images while browsing, it will cry uncontrollably. These tears destroy the coding of the webpage before it moves on.

entry: 人们能看见POKENAME戴着绿色帽子，骑键盘上网冲浪。只要电脑供电稳定，它就能在网上自由遨游，探索个够。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found surfing the internet on a keyboard and wearing a green hat. As long as the PC has a steady supply of electricity, POKENAME can roam freely on the internet and explore to their heart's content.

entry: 这种宝可梦，过去曾因被一名黑客利用而声名狼藉。即使在电子设备内，POKENAME仍磁力极强，能轻易损坏软件，甚至硬件。
author: bobosmith01
source: This species of Pokémon was once infamously utilized by a hacker. As POKENAME is highly magnetic even when inside of an electronic device, it can easily damage both computer software and even the hardware.

entry: POKENAME能吃下并随后处理掉几乎任何材料，因此常被用于清理遭融合宝可梦副作用破坏的区域。在网上旅行时，它也能制定自己的清理计划。
author: bobosmith01
source: As it can eat and later dispose of almost any material, POKENAME is particularly used in cleaning up areas that were damaged due to the side effects of fused Pokémon. When it travels through the internet, it can concoct its own cleanup plans, too.

entry: POKENAME升级后，能产生额外电力，充当医院的应急发电机。凭尾巴，它几毫秒就能接入网络。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME serves as an emergency generator for hospitals, as its upgrades allow it to produce excess electricity. With its tails, it can connect to the net in a few milliseconds.

entry: 训练家对抗病毒与恶意软件时，POKENAME会护送困在病毒电脑里的宝可梦，到安全地点。它们极其顽强，能用庞大身体护住弱者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME help escort Pokémon stuck in virus-ridden PCs to a safe place while their Trainers fight viruses and malware. They are incredibly resilient creatures that shield weaker Pokémon with their large bodies.

entry: 只有发现积满灰尘的系统，POKENAME才会离开网络空间，在电脑旁用灰筑巢，吸取数据。可住不久，造成的干扰，就常会招来大扫除。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME only come out of cyberspace if they find a very dusty system. They build nests out of dust next to a PC, draining data from it. They don't manage to stay in one place long, as the interference they cause often results in spring-cleaning.

entry: POKENAME拍翅太快，视频难以拍清它的飞行。许多科技爱好者学会了放慢它的办法，例如让它打开层层嵌套的文件夹，好拍下影像。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME flap their wings so fast that their flying cannot be properly recorded on video. Many tech enthusiasts have learned ways to slow down their flying so that they can be properly captured on video, such as having them open nested folders.

entry: POKENAME会找草地图片，跳进里面嬉戏，跳来跳去、改变大小，直到满意。它们尤其钟爱许多旧电脑自带的某张背景图。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME find pictures of grassy fields to frolic through, hopping around and changing size until they are satisfied. They are particularly fond of a certain background that comes with many older PCs.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴释放强力病毒，几分钟就能破坏电脑。许多硬盘一旦中招，就再也无法修复。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tail releases a powerful virus that corrupts computers within minutes. Many hard drives become irreparable after it takes hold.

entry: POKENAME用大獠牙，寻找、摧毁电脑病毒。可惜，体形太大，正常程序也会一起被毁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its large tusks to seek out and destroy viruses within computers. Due to its size, it unfortunately destroys normal programs in the process as well.

entry: 这种宝可梦最早是给多边兽Ｚ使用杀毒程序后产生的。它既有多边兽Ｚ的力量，也有多边兽Ⅱ的情感。
author: valtsuri
source: The first version of this Pokémon was the result of using an antivirus on a Porygon-Z. It has the powers of Porygon-Z with the emotions of a Porygon2.

entry: 融合让多边兽，呈现出原本预定的最终形态。举止稳定得多，让那些培育过原版多边兽Ｚ的人，如释重负。
author: epping_forest
source: Thanks to the fusion, Porygon takes on the shape intended as its final form. Its much more stable behavior feels incredibly relieving to those who have trained the original Porygon-Z.

entry: POKENAME吃损坏文件时，头部和手臂的叶子会长得极长。不知怎么，它还能保留所吃文件中，能够挽救的信息。
author: .izik
source: The leaves on POKENAME's head and arms grow incredibly long while it consumes corrupted files. It somehow retains whatever information is salvageable from the files it eats.

entry: POKENAME产生的种子，含有数百万行代码。许多理科男会研究，因为里面有许多常见程序错误的解决办法。
author: .izik
source: The seeds POKENAME's body produces contain millions of lines of code. Many Super Nerds study this coding as it holds solutions to numerous errors programs commonly face.

entry: POKENAME在无人看管的电脑上，会先使出火花，烧炙找到的程序，再吃掉。哪怕两个文件，就能让它维生数星期。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses Ember to singe programs it finds on unmanned computers before consuming them. Even just two files can sustain it for weeks.

entry: 创造这种宝可梦的数据已更新，也有了自行更新的本领，能够应对从前未知的矿物。战斗或受威胁时，爪与尖刺会变硬。
author: infinex21
source: The data used to create this Pokémon has been updated and made capable of updating as it comes across minerals it once knew not of. Its claws and quills become hard during battle or when it feels threatened.

entry: POKENAME不断吃网上的武术数据，表现出学来的技巧。因此，每只都会发展出略有不同的打法。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spends its time consuming martial arts data from the internet, exhibiting techniques based on what it learns. Each POKENAME develops a slightly different fighting style as a result.

entry: POKENAME吐出的微带电水，不知为何，能改写接触到的读卡器程序。它似乎纯粹在恶作剧。
author: .izik
source: The slightly electrified water POKENAME spits is somehow capable of reprogramming card scanners it touches. It appears to do this purely as a prank.

entry: POKENAME旋转着跳芭蕾时，附近电脑会运行得更快。可惜，周围的人也都会睡着。
author: .izik
source: While spinning in a ballet dance, POKENAME causes nearby computers to operate faster. This unfortunately also puts any people in the vicinity to sleep.

entry: POKENAME自任训练家个人数据的守护者，务求绝对安全。哪怕只发现一个略有威胁的程序靠近，也会造出数字黑洞，将其彻底清除。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tasks itself with keeping all of its Trainer's personal data absolutely safe. It will go so far as creating digital black holes to completely eradicate even a mildly threatening program it finds near said data.

entry: POKENAME的头戴装置，让它能无伤模拟战斗。经验越多，模拟越精准，因此它主动寻找更强对手，盼着完善数据库。
author: bollocksmen
source: POKENAME's headset allows it to simulate battles without sustaining any injuries. Gaining combat experience makes these simulations increasingly accurate; therefore, it actively seeks out stronger opponents in hopes of refining its databases.

entry: POKENAME最早的目击记录，出现在一个几乎废弃的神秘学网站。因此出现传闻：它若现身电脑，只要盯着稍久，就会被夺走灵魂。
author: sk372
source: The first recorded sighting of POKENAME was on an almost-defunct occult website. This has led to rumors that if POKENAME appears on one's computer, staring at it for more than a brief moment will steal one's soul.

entry: POKENAME能完美模仿身后的电脑背景。它会隐身，用舌头抓住光标，妨碍移动，作弄电脑用户。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's abilities let it perfectly mimic the computer backdrop behind it. It pranks computer users by staying invisible and grabbing their cursor with its tongue, impeding its movements.

entry: POKENAME会与同类勾爪，传输数据、分享信息。这也是有效战法，两只相连时，能力会呈指数级增强。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME links its claw with others of its kind to transfer data and share information. It also serves as an effective combat technique, as two POKENAME exhibit exponentially stronger abilities while linked.

entry: POKENAME有两个独立的人工智能，能一心多用，同时学习多门学科。可两套独立的大脑网络，有时也会让行动相互矛盾。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can multitask and learn multiple subjects at once due to having two separate AIs. However, having two separate brain networks sometimes causes it to take actions that contradict each other.

entry: 四个核心处理单元同时工作，让POKENAME智力惊人。它常协助编程，几秒就能改进程序、修复代码错误。
author: sk372
source: Four core processing units working simultaneously give POKENAME vast intellectual capacity. It is often used to assist in programming, making improvements and fixing coding errors in mere seconds.

entry: POKENAME会啃已标记待删除的文件，磨利龅牙。没有合适的，它们便转去啃训练家的文档。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sharpen their buck teeth by chewing on files already marked for deletion. If there are no suitable files to chew on, they resort to chewing on their Trainer's documents.

entry: POKENAME埋伏着，假扮被丢弃的无害U盘。谁愚蠢又好奇地将它插入电脑，那台电脑几秒内就会被装入108个病毒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lies in wait, pretending to be a discarded and harmless USB stick. Those foolish and curious enough to insert it into their computer will have 108 viruses installed into it within seconds.

entry: POKENAME情绪不稳，长期不互动，就容易对用户怀有难解怨恨。它能接管游戏应用，用108处故障诅咒数据，将其毁坏。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is volatile and prone to developing a thorny grudge against users who don't interact with it for prolonged periods. POKENAME is capable of taking over gaming applications, ruining data by cursing it with 108 glitches.

entry: POKENAME不能真正飞行，却能长时间滑翔。不知为何，滑翔路线总奇怪地与正在使用的飞机航线重叠。
author: .izik
source: While POKENAME cannot truly fly, it is capable of gliding for extended periods. Its glide paths strangely overlap with active airplane flight paths for reasons unknown.

entry: 测得POKENAME一次攻击的时长，竟只有0.11秒。它会从空中出击，把目标直直轰向下方。
author: rodotom
source: The duration of POKENAME's attacks has been timed at a staggeringly low 0.11 seconds. POKENAME uses aerial attacks, blasting its target straight downward.

entry: POKENAME的试验性程序，让开花的数据核心，变成近乎真实的树。大多数数据仍存其中，因此它会凶猛防备想筑巢或啃食的宝可梦。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's experimental programming has allowed it to transform the flowering data core into a nearly real tree. It still stores the majority of the data within this core, so it is fiercely protective against Pokémon attempting to nest in or eat it.

entry: POKENAME会保护登录框，尝试次数太多，就禁用密码，再夹紧框体，示意不能使用。一旦禁用，只有它的训练家能够恢复。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME help provide security to login boxes by disabling passwords after too many attempts have been made, clamping down on the login box to indicate that it is unable to be used. Once they disable a password, only their Trainer can reactivate it.

entry: POKENAME是常出现在加载画面的宝可梦之一。戳一下它的球，后方的头就会张嘴，让用户喂零食。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are one of the many Pokémon that can be seen on loading screens. Poking at their ball causes their rear head to open its mouth, allowing the user to feed them treats.

entry: POKENAME会扎根在废弃设施的旧服务器，吸收残留数据。它们结成小群旅行，共用服务器时，轮流监视周围。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME ingrain themselves onto abandoned servers in derelict facilities to absorb leftover data. Small clusters travel together and take turns monitoring their surroundings while sharing the same server.

entry: POKENAME的全息翅膀，没有实际用途。作为脸的显示屏，运行着仿佛来自200年后的操作系统。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: POKENAME has holographic wings that serve no real use. The display screen that serves as its face runs on an operating system that seems to come from 200 years into the future.

entry: 乡间救生员喜欢POKENAME陪伴，因为它能推算潮汐变化、判断水域何时安全。可自有雷达的海滩却避免饲养，因为它可能引发电脑故障。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Lifeguards in rural areas enjoy the company of POKENAME due to their ability to calculate the progression of the tides and when the water is safe. However, beaches with their own radars avoid keeping POKENAME due to the computer bugs they can cause.

entry: POKENAME吃的数据越多，头骨就越硬。它会用头撞石，锻炼并检验力量。
author: .izik
source: The more data POKENAME consumes, the harder its skull becomes. It rams its head into stones to train and test its strength.

entry: POKENAME用硬化的头，阻挡试图入侵电脑的恶意软件。它守护所在系统，仿佛在保护亲生幼崽。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its hardened head to fend off malware attempting to enter computers. It guards any system it inhabits as if it were its own young.

entry: POKENAME身体圆滑，利于气流通过，因此冲锋迅速灵活。压低冠饰，头骨上方就会形成网络能量圆罩，强化头锤。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's rounded, smooth body makes it more aerodynamic, giving it great speed and mobility for charging. Folding its crest down creates a dome of cyber energy over its skull to enhance its Headbutt attack.

entry: POKENAME坚实的头骨被撞时，彩色节块就会随机打乱颜色。如果全部颜色一致，它的力量便明显增强。
author: sk372
source: When something collides with POKENAME's solid skull, the colored segments shuffle their pigments into a randomized assortment. If all the colors match, POKENAME exhibits a remarkable boost in power.

entry: 在人类面前，POKENAME喜欢假扮气球动物。据报告，它会随机出现在各种数字媒体背景，不管作品基调如何，都用古怪笑料抢镜。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME likes to masquerade as a balloon animal in the presence of humans. It has been reported appearing on random digital media in the background, drawing attention to itself with random gags regardless of tone.

entry: POKENAME用头顶触角，直接与任何电子设备交流。它学习的方法，是先接受、完成发来的任何请求，再分析经过，判断下次是否应做类似请求。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can communicate directly with any electronic using the antenna on its head. It learns by accepting any request sent to it and carrying it out before analyzing the events to determine whether it should complete other similar requests.

entry: POKENAME成群游过网络空间，收集网站公开数据。它们张嘴刮取能找到的数据，再由身体整理成可用信息。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swim through cyberspace in pods to collect public data from websites. They open their mouths to scrape up any data they may find so their bodies can organize the data into usable information.

entry: POKENAME游过网络空间，从老网站抓取数据，聚合、压缩进体内。许多档案工作者靠它们，寻找旧媒体文件。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swim through cyberspace to scrape data from old websites. This data is aggregated into their bodies as compressed data that many archivists rely on to find old media files.

entry: POKENAME的头脑与数据环强大无比，能随时编写、改写复杂程序。网络空间中的许多多边兽，会聚向它，盼有一天也能得到强化。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's mind and data-ring are so immensely powerful that it can code or rewrite intricate programs on the fly. Many Porygon in cyberspace flock to it in the hopes it may one day use its abilities to power them up.

entry: POKENAME定期穿行聊天服务器，寻找机器人账号和垃圾信息发送者。一找到，就忍不住使出吸取，吃掉消息。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME regularly traverses chat servers in search of bot accounts and spammers. Upon finding them, it compulsively uses Absorb to consume their messages.

entry: POKENAME壳上会形成独特的动态图案，像有生物在迷宫活动。树会定期结出方块果，只有多边兽及其融合体能吃。
author: sk372
source: A unique moving pattern featuring creatures in a maze forms on POKENAME's shell. Its tree bears blocky fruit periodically, which is only edible for the Porygon species and its fusions.

entry: POKENAME虽然能吃固体食物，也能完全靠吸收机械设备的热维生。服务器机房中，常能见它把鼻子贴在热设备上。
author: .izik
source: While POKENAME can eat solid food, it can survive entirely off heat absorbed from mechanical equipment. It can often be spotted in server rooms pressing its nose against hot equipment.

entry: 谁太靠近巢，POKENAME就会喷出高压带电水。力道强到能打倒柳树。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits high-pressure electrified water at anyone who ventures too close to its nest. The force is strong enough to knock over a willow tree.

entry: POKENAME在湖边巢穴附近，会与同类同步哔哔鸣叫。整场表演，翼尖都闪着亮蓝光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME synchronizes beeps with others of its kind near its lakeside den. The tips of its wings blink bright blue throughout these performances.

entry: POKENAME鼻中的强大磁力，能帮助它保持直立。即使被强行推倒，也会凭磁力迅速扶正。
author: sk372
source: A strong magnetic force within POKENAME's nose helps keep it upright. Even if forcibly toppled over, it will right itself quickly thanks to the potent magnetism.

entry: POKENAME的大鼻子，不知怎地，能从远处侦测文件。认出喜欢的文件，便会贪婪吃下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's large nose can somehow detect files from great distances. After identifying its preferred files, it will consume them greedily.

entry: POKENAME的双刃挥动流畅优雅，力量却似乎还不完全稳定。流苏偶尔闪成二进制代码，有些挥斩，也会拖出本无意生成的代码弧。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's twin blades swing through the air with smoothness and grace, but its power seems not entirely stable. Its tassels occasionally flicker into binary code, and some of its swings will trail an arc of code that it did not intend to create.

entry: POKENAME的数据刃出鞘越久，力量越失控，刀刃也越扭曲、出错。因此，它力求迅速果断地结束战斗。
author: sk372
source: The longer POKENAME's data-blade is unsheathed, the more it begins to distort and glitch as its power runs wild. As such, it aims to end battles in as quick and decisive a manner as possible.

entry: POKENAME凶猛守护训练家的电脑，是对抗恶意软件的第一道防线。毒针注入的代码，能让恶意程序终止，有效解除威胁。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME fiercely protect their Trainer's PC and stand as the first line of defense against malware. Their stinger injects code that causes any malicious program to terminate, effectively neutralizing the threat.

entry: POKENAME的面罩赋予它极佳视力，无论周围什么环境，都看得一清二楚。它甚至能从面罩射出灼热能量束，抵御敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's visor gives it excellent eyesight, able to view things in perfect clarity no matter the conditions around it. It can even fire beams of heated energy from the visor to fight off enemies.

entry: POKENAME优雅动作令人着迷，还能稍稍扭曲现实，既迷惑敌人，也吸引旁观者，连透过数字视频也不例外。
author: curazy
source: Known to mesmerize with graceful movements, POKENAME can distort reality just enough to confuse foes while captivating onlookers, even through digital video formats.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，翅膀质感会变得近似羽毛，更好地接住气流。一发现鸟宝可梦，它便先使出瞪眼，再逼近攻击猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wing texture becomes almost featherlike while flying to better capture air currents. Upon spotting a bird Pokémon, it uses Leer before moving in to attack its prey.

entry: POKENAME在网上旅行时，会研究遇见的人类图片。它随时能出来，完美模仿观察过的任何人。
author: .izik
source: While traveling through the internet, POKENAME studies images of humans it encounters. It can emerge at any time and perfectly imitate any human it has observed.

entry: POKENAME很黏人，要求训练家多多关注。被冷落太久，就会抓住光标，不让继续输入，直到得到夸奖。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are needy creatures that demand lots of attention from their Trainer. If ignored for a long period of time, they grab onto the cursor and restrain further input until they receive praise.

entry: POKENAME力量巨大，体内不总能容下。用力时，代码便会溢出，影响文件与程序，将其重塑成完全不同的东西。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's power is so vast that it cannot always contain it within its body. Code spills out from it when it exerts itself, affecting and reshaping files and programs into something completely different.

entry: 升级后，POKENAME能让炮筒在周围自由漂浮。悬浮炮筒既能发射低多边形导弹，也能用作盾牌。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Now that it has been upgraded, POKENAME can float its cannon freely around itself. It can fire low‑polygon missiles, and it can also double as a shield.

entry: POKENAME藏在少有人前往的网络角落。普通浏览者若不小心撞见，它便备好交错闪电，从显示器冲出，立刻攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME conceals itself in corners of cyberspace that few ever navigate to. Should a casual browser stumble upon it, it attacks instantly, emerging from their monitor with a readied Fusion Bolt.

entry: POKENAME天生胆怯，程序却驱使它友善助人。它常给商家首页当吉祥物，迅速提供提示和帮助，再躲到屏幕边外。
author: sk372
source: Though skittish by nature, POKENAME's programming compels it to be friendly and helpful towards others. It tends to act as a mascot to homepages for businesses, quickly dispensing tips and assistance before hiding just off-screen.

entry: POKENAME产生的芝麻香孢子，能提升接触到的任何电脑的处理能力。不过，效果最多只持续几小时。
author: .izik
source: The sesame scented spores POKENAME produces increase the processing power of any computer they touch. This boost lasts only a few hours at most.

entry: POKENAME是烦人的恶作剧家，喜欢惹恼遇到的电脑用户。最爱的办法，是接管键盘，打出无礼消息。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is an annoying prankster that takes delight in annoying any computer user it comes across. Its favorite method of doing so involves taking control of the user's keyboard and typing out rude messages with it.

entry: POKENAME十分淘气，会通过互联网，从一台电脑跳去另一台。杀毒软件与防火墙都发现不了，因此很难从附身的设备中除掉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are mischievous creatures that hop from PC to PC through the internet. It is incredibly difficult to remove them from a possessed device, as antivirus software and firewalls cannot detect POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME周围的凝胶，其实是防火墙代码，能抵御任何网络攻击。可惜，对现实里的病毒与疾病，却完全没有保护。
author: soup1900
source: The gel surrounding POKENAME is actually the code of a firewall that protects it from any cyberattack. Unfortunately, this firewall does not protect it at all against any real-world viruses or diseases.

entry: POKENAME周围的凝胶，其实是防火墙代码，能抵御任何网络攻击。可惜，对现实里的病毒与疾病，却完全没有保护。
author: soup1900
source: The gel surrounding POKENAME is actually the code of a firewall that protects it from any cyberattack. Unfortunately, this firewall does not protect it at all against any real-world viruses or diseases.

entry: POKENAME能吃数据，存进体内，存得越多，身体越大。受威胁时，它们会从嘴里，将储存数据当弹丸射出，使目标困倦。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME have the ability to consume and store data inside their bodies, growing larger the more data they have stored. When POKENAME feel threatened, they fire stored data as a projectile from their mouths that makes their targets drowsy.

entry: POKENAME在网络空间漂浮时，会从身上抖落浓粉。粉末一接触病毒，就能将其消灭。
author: .izik
source: While floating through cyberspace, POKENAME shakes a thick powder loose from its body. This powder destroys any viruses it comes into contact with.

entry: POKENAME会将手变成所需应用的模样，访问电脑程序。它们最常同时使用许多社交网站，发布酷炫墓穴的影像，也在网上欺凌盗墓者。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME access computer programs by transforming their hands to look like the apps they want to use. They are most often seen using many social media sites at once to post media of cool tombs and to cyberbully grave robbers.

entry: POKENAME撒在网页上的种子，会长成藤蔓，将数据吸进体内作养分。生长极快，藤蔓却一天内就会消散。
author: .izik
source: The seeds POKENAME scatters across webpages grow into vines that siphon data into its body as nourishment. The growth cycle is rapid but the vines fade within a day.

entry: POKENAME靠复杂的物理引擎，表现出软垂的外形。身体总像在融化，质量却始终不变。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME relies on a complex physics engine to produce its drooping appearance. Its body constantly seems to be melting, even though its mass remains the same.

entry: POKENAME形似熔岩灯，底部灯泡熔化蜡，形成团团光影。不断变化的外形，让它在网络安全上十分重要：装满POKENAME的保险库，被用来加密数据。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME resemble a special kind of lamp that has a light bulb at the base to melt wax and form blobs of light. Their constantly changing shape makes them important for cybersecurity, as a vault full of POKENAME is used to encrypt data.

entry: 升级版的POKENAME，能极精准地控制身体每一部分。例如，战斗中拆开身体躲避攻击，或让双臂分离，飞去追赶目标。
author: phantom640
source: This upgraded version of POKENAME can control individual pieces of its body with pinpoint accuracy. It uses this ability in various ways, such as disassembling mid-battle to dodge an attack or separating its arms to fly after its target.

entry: 数字企业会雇用POKENAME，用火焰批量焚毁损坏文件。虽然通常可靠，若不及时更新，它也可能连重要文件一起毁掉。
author: fiordaliso
source: Digital companies employ POKENAME to incinerate corrupted files in bulk using its flames. Though generally reliable, if not properly updated it may end up destroying essential files as well.

entry: POKENAME看战斗教学影像，学习用内脏作战。排出体外的器官，能自由塑成任何学会使用的武器，对付敌人。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME learns various ways to use its internal organs for fighting by watching media on combat lessons. It can freely shape its ejected organs into any weapon it has learned how to use to fight against foes.

entry: 乍看，POKENAME伪装的多边兽Ⅱ几乎毫无破绽，一受伤就露馅。伤口和缝隙里，流出的并非程序代码，而是黑暗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's Porygon2 disguise is almost flawless at a glance, but becomes obvious the moment it receives damage. Rather than being full of programming code, darkness spills out from any cut or gap.

entry: POKENAME穿行网络空间时，会主动寻找黑客。一发现，就潜入对方电脑，熔化内部零件。
author: .izik
source: While traversing cyberspace, POKENAME actively searches for hackers. Should it spot one, it infiltrates their PC and melts the components inside.

entry: POKENAME的三个头，分别像多边兽的三个进化阶段。各头的程序互相冲突，让它行为混乱凶暴，不停乱甩，毁掉遇见的任何数据。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's three heads resemble the three stages of Porygon evolution. The conflicting programming in each head causes POKENAME to act erratically and violently, thrashing about and destroying any data it comes across.

entry: POKENAME吃下大文件，火焰就会更强。达到顶峰时，热到几分钟就能熔化巨石。
author: .izik
source: The flames POKENAME produces grow more intense when it consumes large computer files. At its peak, the flame can burn hot enough to melt a boulder in minutes.

entry: POKENAME的人工智能相当强大，能储存大量数据与多学科知识。它似乎对“愿望”这个主题，最感兴趣。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's artificial intelligence is quite robust, letting it store vast amounts of data and knowledge on many subjects. It seems most fascinated by the subject of wishes.

entry: POKENAME性情温顺，可受威胁时，周围会出现奇怪又眼熟的故障形态，通常能吓退攻击者。究竟是本能，还是别的什么，尚未弄清。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a docile creature, but when threatened, a strange yet familiar glitched form appears around it and typically frightens off attackers. It's not known if this is an instinctive ability of POKENAME's or something else entirely.

entry: POKENAME游过网络空间，寻找河流影片，下载到训练家电脑。得到视频，就循环播放河流片段，为自己提供筑巢处。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swim through cyberspace looking for films about rivers to download onto their Trainer's PC. Once they have acquired a video, they loop sections showing the river to give themselves a place to build shelter.

entry: POKENAME看网上视频，训练武艺。全新的技巧，只看一次就能学会。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME trains its martial arts by watching videos online. It can learn entirely new techniques from a single viewing.

entry: POKENAME虽然害羞，却极其好奇，会安静而满足地看用户上网。若被发现，就会通过鼠标，放出短促电击，再退进互联网深处。
author: .izik
source: Though shy, POKENAME is also deeply curious and watches users browse the internet with quiet contentment. If spotted, it sends a brief shock through their mouse before retreating deeper into the internet.

entry: POKENAME更喜欢住在手机里。发现电量不足，便会补上自己的电力，让设备保持充电。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers to inhabit cellphones. Should it notice the device's power running low, it will use its own electricity as a supplement to keep it charged.

entry: POKENAME创作的旋律广受赞誉，可技术原始，只能做出两条旋律声道、一条打击乐声道的芯片音乐。
author: empty_set
source: Although the melodies it creates are highly praised, POKENAME's primitive technology means it can only produce chiptunes with two melody channels and one percussion channel.

entry: POKENAME吃金属矿石时，会发出响亮哔声。许多人以为是在高兴，科学家却判定，这是不由自主的反应。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lets out loud beeping noises while eating metal ore. Though many assumed this indicated happiness, scientists have determined it to be an involuntary reaction.

entry: POKENAME用巨颚吞下文件，就不会留下痕迹。它能藏在电子邮箱里，耐心等上数天，等垃圾邮件送来吃。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME devours a file with its massive jaws, no trace remains. It can hide within email inboxes, patiently waiting days for spam messages to arrive so it can consume them.

entry: POKENAME从翅膀放电，制服刺球仙人掌之类的猎物，再带到远处沙丘享用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases bursts of electricity from its wings to incapacitate prey such as Cacnea. It then carries them to distant sand dunes to eat.

entry: POKENAME游过网络空间，直到找到舒适的桌面屏幕栖身。它好奇又容易分神，屏上有什么，都常游过去探究，让多数用户觉得既分心又烦人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME swims across cyberspace until it finds a comfortable desktop screen to inhabit. Curious and easily distracted, it often swims up to investigate anything on the screen, making it a bit of a distracting nuisance for most users.

entry: POKENAME吃进病毒，会把数据转成有用代码，强化外壳。在现实世界，壳连直接落雷也能承受。
author: .izik
source: After consuming a virus, POKENAME converts the data into useful code to reinforce its shell. In the real world this shell is powerful enough to withstand direct lightning strikes.

entry: POKENAME乍看圆润光滑，齿轮侧边却有众多细小凸棱，转动时相互咬合。这样的设计，让它旋转、产能都更快、更有效。
author: sk372
source: At first glance POKENAME appears smooth and rounded, but the sides of its gears are made up of numerous tiny ridges that interlock during rotation. This design lets it spin and generate energy much quicker and more effectively.

entry: POKENAME看见想吸取数据的电脑，身体每个部分都会高速转动。整个过程中，电流持续穿过身体。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME spots a computer it wants to draw data from, every portion of its body begins rotating rapidly. An electric current runs through its body throughout this process.

entry: POKENAME的金属躯架，能存下整间服务器机房那么多的数据。许多公司靠它，充当活体备份系统。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's metallic frame can store data equivalent to an entire server room. Many companies rely on it as a living backup system.

entry: 它性情顺从。不论从什么角度看，POKENAME的尾焰似乎都会完全挡住后方，覆上图形设计工具里有时可见的粉黑图案。
author: bobosmith01
source: It has an obedient personality. No matter what angle it is viewed at, the flame on POKENAME's tail seems to completely cover what is behind it and cloak it in a pink and black pattern that sometimes appears in graphic design tools.

entry: 更新过的音频驱动，让它能创作任何种类、精美细致的音乐。因此，POKENAME有时会当活体音乐播放器，而且十分乐在其中。
author: empty_set
source: Thanks to its updated audio drivers, it can produce exquisite and detailed music of any kind.  Because of this, it is sometimes used as a living music player - a role which POKENAME actually greatly enjoys.

entry: POKENAME产生的种子带电，一碰到电脑，就会引发电力骤增，让电脑关机。
author: .izik
source: The seeds POKENAME produces carry electrical charges. Should they make contact with a computer, it will surge and shut down.

entry: POKENAME蹦跳时，会放出信号，提高附近电脑的处理能力。跳得越快，效果越强。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a signal while bouncing that increases the processing power of nearby computers. The faster it bounces, the greater the effect.

entry: POKENAME缥缈的身体，能轻松穿过实体物品。穿过的电脑会短暂故障，恢复后，运作却比之前更好。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's ethereal body passes through solid objects with ease. Computers it passes through malfunction briefly before recovering and operating better than before.

entry: POKENAME飘过田野，会间歇发出细小哔声，也释放怡人的薰衣草香，让下方生物放松。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME floats over fields it emits tiny intermittent beeps. It also releases a pleasant lavender scent that relaxes those beneath it.

entry: POKENAME与群体一起潜入电脑终端，身体便会转成纯代码。进去后，它就试着吃掉能找到的任何数据。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body converts to pure code when it dives into computer terminals alongside its swarm. Once inside, it attempts to consume any data it can find.

entry: POKENAME皮肤的质地，会变得与钻过的沙子相同。在沙中穿行，时速最高60英里。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's skin shifts to match the consistency of whatever sand it burrows through. While burrowing it can reach speeds of up to 60 mph.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在神秘学网站，等待用户连接。一有人来，它就会从屏幕钻出，大声哔叫，恶作剧吓人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lurks on occult websites waiting for users to connect. When they do, it emerges from their screen and beeps loudly to startle them as a prank.

entry: POKENAME在文本文档里织网，同时吃里面的信息。受到打扰，它便先放出小火花，再逃跑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME builds its webs within text documents while consuming the information inside. If disturbed, it lets off a small spark before fleeing.

entry: POKENAME粉红色的金属身体，极其坚硬。附近出现恶意软件，还会本能地进一步硬化。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's pink metallic body is extremely hard. When malware is nearby, its body hardens even further as a natural reflex.

entry: POKENAME年幼时，啁啾声像极难听的哔声，让敌友都不愿靠近巢地。
author: .izik
source: When young, POKENAME's chirping sounds like an abhorrent beeping noise. This deters both allies and foes from approaching its nesting grounds.

entry: POKENAME吃网上的视频，研究其他鸟宝可梦的飞行方式，轻易便能模仿。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME studies the flying styles of other bird Pokémon through videos it consumes online. It can mimic these styles with remarkable ease and little effort.

entry: POKENAME喜欢窝在光盘收藏中，既舒服，又安全。如果被捡起，放进电脑或音乐播放器，它只会产出垃圾数据和噪声，再愤愤地从光盘槽弹出。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME likes to nestle amongst CD collections, for comfort and safety. If picked up and placed in a computer or music player, it produces nothing but junk data and noise before angrily popping out of the disc slot.

entry: POKENAME在虚拟环境滚过的程序，错误会瞬间修好。许多技术员，干脆叫它“一滚就灵”。
author: .izik
source: Programs that POKENAME rolls over in virtual environments have their bugs instantly fixed. Many technicians have taken to calling it the Rolling Solution.

entry: POKENAME在网络空间旅行时，毒液会化为复杂电脑病毒。它一边吃文件，一边用病毒掩护自己在系统中的踪迹。
author: .izik
source: While traveling through cyberspace, POKENAME's venom converts into complex computer viruses. It uses these to mask its presence within systems while feasting on files.

entry: POKENAME对住的电脑很依恋，家养个体尤其如此。若试着换新电脑，它就会嫉妒得把新设备整个冻住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gets quite attached to the computers it inhabits, especially in the case of domesticated individuals. Attempting to upgrade to a new computer results in it freezing the newer device solid in a jealous fit.

entry: POKENAME站在阳光下，叶片会放出熔塑料的气味。这股味道，往往能让附近电脑提速。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a melting plastic scent from its leaves while standing in sunlight. This aroma tends to speed up computers in the surrounding area.

entry: POKENAME在别人桌面上跳舞，会让所有运行中的程序，快得惊人。玩家却可能很恼火，因为游戏快得根本玩不好。
author: .izik
source: While dancing on someone's desktop, POKENAME causes all running programs to operate at incredible speeds. This can frustrate gamers as their games become too fast to play effectively.

entry: POKENAME在桌面跳舞时，会让任何程序都无法打开。唯一恢复使用的办法，是反复点击身体，打断它。
author: .izik
source: While dancing on a desktop, POKENAME prevents any programs from opening entirely. The only way to regain access is to repeatedly interrupt it by clicking its body.

entry: POKENAME大吃电脑病毒与旧垃圾文件。吃的恶意软件越多，拦截黑客的本领就越强，甚至能用自己的病毒反击。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME feasts on computer viruses and old junk files. As it consumes more malware, POKENAME becomes better at intercepting hackers, and even gains the ability to fight back with viruses of its own.

entry: POKENAME最好单独饲养，越靠近同类，就越渴求数据。哪怕一小群，也能几分钟内，吃光电脑的每一点数据。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is best kept alone, as its hunger for data grows greater as it gets close to others of its kind. Even a small school of POKENAME could devour every bit of data within a computer in minutes.

entry: 西尔佛公司经历一次重大数据泄露后，POKENAME在网络安全专家间，越来越受欢迎。它们游走暗网，用锯齿撕碎密码文件，不让黑客从泄露密码获利。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME grew in popularity with cybersecurity experts after Silph Co. went through a major data breach. They roam the dark web to slice through password files with their serrated teeth, stopping hackers from profiting off of leaked passwords.

entry: POKENAME能无线连接设备，放大声音。有时，它会记下喜欢的声音，对战时播放。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can wirelessly connect to devices to amplify sound. Sometimes they store sounds they enjoy hearing into their memory and play them while they fight in Pokémon battles.

entry: POKENAME能连上互联网，下载喜欢听的声音。宝可梦对战时，它会播放自己的主题曲，进入战斗节奏。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can connect themselves into the internet to download sounds they enjoy listening to. Whenever they are fighting in a Pokémon battle, they play their own theme song to get into the groove of battle.

entry: POKENAME在与飞机相同的高度翱翔，也常停到飞行中的飞机上。啁啾声像手机铃，让没料到会有来电的乘客困惑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME soar through the sky at the same elevation as airplanes and often perch on those planes as they fly. Their chirps sound like a ringing cellphone, causing confusion for people on planes who were not expecting any calls.

entry: POKENAME蓬松身体上的特殊箭头，总指向远离地面的方向。体内传感器侦测行星引力，形成箭头，让它飞行时保持直立。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a special arrow on its fluffy body that always points away from the ground. This arrow is created from the special sensors in its body that detect the planet's gravitational pull, ensuring that POKENAME remains upright while flying.

entry: POKENAME黏滑的身体，覆有富含反病毒数据的特殊黏液。试图感染的病毒与恶意软件，会被瞬间消除，再吸入体内，供它维生。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's gooey, smooth body is coated in a special slime full of antivirus data. Viruses and malware that try to infect it are neutralized instantly, and absorbed into its body to sustain it.

entry: POKENAME全身覆盖的透明黏液，常被涂在电脑设备上，提升运作效率。哪怕小小一瓶，也能卖出高价。
author: .izik
source: The clear mucus covering POKENAME's body is frequently applied to computer equipment as it causes devices to run more efficiently. Even a small bottle can fetch a considerable price.

entry: POKENAME散发的寒气，足以让它进入的电脑立刻冻结。被它造访的用户别无他法，只能等它自行离去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's icy presence is strong enough to immediately freeze a computer it enters. A user visited by POKENAME has no options other than waiting until it leaves of its own accord.

entry: POKENAME栖身的电脑，外壳会逐渐覆上一层厚厚的金属。它待得越久，金属层就越厚。
author: .izik
source: The computer POKENAME inhabits gradually develops a thick layer of metal over its exterior. The longer it stays inside, the thicker these layers become.

entry: POKENAME常被用来远距离传递信号，在宝可梦中心与研究所之间传送重要数据。野生个体会释放微小的有毒孢子，使附近的电子设备发生故障，原因尚不清楚。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME are often used to transmit signals over long distances, sending vital data between Pokémon Centers and Laboratories. Wild POKENAME release small, toxic spores that cause nearby electronics to malfunction, the reason why is unknown.

entry: POKENAME会从附近的电子设备中汲取能量，吸收到双臂上晶体般的增生物中，再以脉冲波释放。这些能量波强到足以让周围的电脑爆炸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME siphons ambient energy from electronics near it, absorbed into the crystal-like growths on its arms. It releases this energy in pulsing waves strong enough to cause computers in its vicinity to explode.

entry: 融合让POKENAME意外地拥有了动听的歌喉。曾有它们组成乐队，连续演出长达五个夜晚的记录。
author: epolybius
source: The process of fusion has made POKENAME an unexpectedly good singer. They have been known to gather in bands to perform for up to five nights straight.

entry: POKENAME的外形与亲近孩子的性情，让它过去曾被用作公司的吉祥物。有骇人的传闻称，某个个体曾咬伤孩子，造成严重伤害，但这些说法尚无实据。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's appearance and friendliness towards children have led to it being used as a company mascot in the past. There are sordid rumors that one POKENAME once bit a child, causing severe harm, but these reports are unsubstantiated.

entry: POKENAME让与身体分离的双臂绕着自己飞速旋转，兼顾进攻与防守。它的刺含有少量特殊毒素，被刺中的多边兽融合体会头晕目眩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spins its disembodied arms around itself rapidly as a method of offense and defense. Its spines contain a bit of special venom that will dizzy Porygon fusions pricked by them.

entry: POKENAME栖身的服务器，两侧会开始长出细小的针刺。奇怪的是，这些针刺无论触感还是特性，都与真正的仙人掌刺无异。
author: .izik
source: Small needles begin sprouting from the sides of any server POKENAME inhabits. Oddly, these needles feel and behave just like real cactus needles.

entry: POKENAME散播的蓝色孢子，似乎会让接触到的计算设备变慢。不过，一旦把孢子拂去，设备的运行效率反而会比以前更高。
author: .izik
source: The blue spores POKENAME scatters seem to slow down any computing devices they touch. Once brushed away, however, those devices operate more efficiently than before.

entry: POKENAME像防火墙一样守护训练家的电脑，监测网络流量，防范病毒、恶意软件和钓鱼邮件。对上网的训练家来说，它是可靠的安全保障。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME act like a firewall for their Trainer's PC, as they monitor network traffic to protect the PC from viruses, malware, and phishing emails. They are a reliable source of security for Trainers who use the internet.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴里装着浅蓝色液体，电脑技术人员会用来给电脑散热。不知为何，使用这种液体的系统，运行速度会提高一倍。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tail contains a light blue liquid that IT technicians use for cooling computers. Systems using this liquid somehow run twice as fast.

entry: POKENAME与同伴结队行进时，会发出响亮、类似犬吠的哔哔声。人们最常在夜色渐深时，见到它们一起狩猎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lets out loud beeps resembling barks while traveling with its pack. They are most often spotted hunting together in the late evening.

entry: POKENAME会指导初学作曲的人使用数字音频编辑软件，协助创作音乐。等对方能独立创作后，它便跃入网络空间，去帮助更多人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME guide new song composers through digital audio editors and assist with the creation of music. Once a song composer is able to produce music on their own, they hop into cyberspace to help more people create music.

entry: POKENAME的模样很像某款歌声合成软件的吉祥物，会帮作曲者输入歌词与旋律，创作令人赞叹的歌曲。这些歌曲有时会大受欢迎，在社交媒体上广为流传。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME bear a resemblance to a mascot of voice synthesizer software and help composers type in lyrics and a melody to create awe-inspiring songs. These songs can become quite popular and are often shared on social media.

entry: 哪怕只在网页上匆匆瞥见POKENAME，也可能在此后数月里做清醒梦。这样的目击十分罕见，许多人便称其为“蓝月之梦”。
author: .izik
source: Even a brief glimpse of POKENAME on a webpage can trigger lucid dreaming for months. These sightings are so rare that many have taken to calling it the Blue Moon Dream.

entry: POKENAME潜入计算机系统时，会把粉色孢子散布在文件上，使其受到感染。受感染的文件会自行从附近的程序中抽取代码，供它食用。
author: .izik
source: While infiltrating a computing system, POKENAME scatters pink spores across files to infect them. These infected files passively siphon coding from nearby programs to feed it.

entry: POKENAME遇到敌人时，会在几秒内进行数千次计算，判断自己的胜算。若胜算高于50%，便采取更积极的攻势；若低于50%，则优先自保。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME encounters a foe, it performs thousands of calculations within seconds to determine its odds of winning. If its chances are above 50%, it employs more aggressive strategies, but if they're below, it prioritizes defending itself instead.

entry: POKENAME的身体由圆形叶片组成。吃下微芯片后，这些叶片就会散发出怡人的果香。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is composed of round leaves. After consuming microchips, these leaves emit a delightful fruity scent.

entry: POKENAME在系统中穿行时，会喷出一团团紫色粉末，让接触到的文件慢慢损坏。这些逐渐损坏的文件，正是同群伙伴理想的食物。
author: .izik
source: While traveling through a system, POKENAME releases puffs of purple powder that cause any files they touch to slowly degrade. These degrading files serve as ideal food for others in its swarm.

entry: POKENAME执意要与别人分享自己烘焙的点心。它会不停地劝人收下饼干等零食，直到对方拗不过它、答应接受才肯罢休。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very stubborn about sharing its baked goods. It constantly urges others to accept its offer of cookies and other treats, and won't stop insisting until a person gives in and accepts them.

entry: 从网上吸收武术大师的资料后，POKENAME会与同类在后巷练功。它们的练习往往会让附近的建筑大面积受损。
author: .izik
source: After absorbing data on martial arts masters found online, POKENAME trains in back alleys with others of its kind. Their training sessions often result in extensive damage to nearby buildings.

entry: 下载耗时太久时，POKENAME常会出现在网页上。它的加载图标故意拼错了字，想用幽默的方式，让等待文件下载的时间轻松些。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often appear on webpages whenever a download is taking too long. The misspelt loading icon is meant to be humorous and to ease the wait of a given file.

entry: POKENAME摄取的数据越多，在空中漂浮时，身上的彩光就变换得越快。凝视太久可能引发癫痫发作。
author: .izik
source: The more data POKENAME consumes, the more rapidly the colored light on its body shifts as it floats through the air. Staring at it too long can cause seizures.

entry: POKENAME尾焰的力量已开始超出它能妥善控制的范围。火焰偶尔会出现故障，使周围的区域扭曲，在网络空间中尤其如此。
author: sk372
source: The power of POKENAME's tail-flame has begun to grow past its capacity to control it properly. Occasionally, it glitches and distorts the area around the fire, especially while in cyberspace.

entry: POKENAME尾端的火焰会遮住后方的一切。鲜艳的火焰周围有粉黑相间的图案，在图像设计软件中也能见到同样的图案。被这种火焰烧过的东西，都会散发出塑料烧焦的气味。
author: quackquackattack
source: The flame at the end of POKENAME's tail obscures anything behind it. The brightly colored flame has a pink and black pattern around it that can also be found in graphic design tools. Anything burnt by this flame has a burnt plastic smell.

entry: POKENAME会沿通风管道移动，伏击猎物。人们认为它能在太空生存，但科学家担心它会伤害同行的船员。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME travels through air vents to ambush its prey. It's believed to be capable of surviving in space, but scientists worry that it would harm its crewmates.

entry: POKENAME会监控线上会议平台，防止违法活动。最近的更新让它更能抵抗病毒，也能在出问题时更快作出反应。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME monitors online meeting platforms to prevent illegal activity. Recent updates have made it more resistant to viruses and faster at responding whenever issues arise.

entry: POKENAME会深藏在计算机代码中。被它栖身的电脑会冒出海量弹窗广告，主动拖慢一切清除它的尝试。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME bury themselves deep within computer code. Computers inhabited by this Pokémon experience massive amounts of pop-up ads, actively slowing down any attempts to remove it.

entry: POKENAME的数字身体能从任何表面、以任意角度冒出来。不过，为何留下的洞总像通风口，没人说得清。
author: serversizeme
source: POKENAME's digital body allows it to pop out of any surface at any angle. No one is sure why these holes take the form of an air vent though.

entry: POKENAME的数字身体能从任何表面、以任意角度冒出来。为何留下的洞总像通风口，没人说得清。
author: serversizeme
source: POKENAME's digital body allows it to pop out of any surface at any angle. No one is sure why these holes take the form of an air vent.

entry: 世界各地的银行都设有专门的防火墙，阻止POKENAME进入系统。一旦被它突破，它就会吞食能找到的所有财务数据。
author: .izik
source: Banks worldwide maintain special firewalls to keep POKENAME out of their systems. Should it breach one, it consumes any financial data it can find.

entry: POKENAME友善又爱闹腾。要是这只数字猫宝可梦钻进了你的硬盘，之后你可能就会发现文件被弄得到处都是。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME is both friendly and rambunctious. If this digital feline Pokémon gets into your hard drive, you may find your files scattered about afterwards.

entry: POKENAME在电脑后台工作，偶尔会自动保存文件。有人找它索取自动保存的文件时，若发现自动保存功能没开，它就会焦虑不已，甚至严重偏头痛，直到完成一次保存才好转。
