author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME work in the background of PCs to occasionally make autosaves. Whenever they are asked to hand over an autosave, they get anxious if the autosave option is off, so much so that they develop a nasty migraine until one is made.

entry: POKENAME的身体光滑，呈流线形，十分擅长游泳，能飞快地穿行于河流湖泊。它也拥有少许念力，能操纵周围的水。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's smooth and streamlined body makes it an excellent swimmer, cutting through rivers and lakes with great speed. It possesses a mild level of telekinesis that lets it manipulate the water near it as well.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME四肢周围的数据环，是压制其力量的限制程序。一旦数据环破裂，它的脾气与力量都会失控，酿成灾难。
author: sk372
source: The rings of data around POKENAME's limbs are thought to be limiter programs to keep its power in check. If they were to break, POKENAME's temper and power would go haywire, leading to disaster.

entry: POKENAME最爱吃硬盘。饱餐一顿后，它的火焰攻击威力会增至原来的三倍。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's favorite food is hard drives. After a satisfactory meal, its flame attacks increase in power threefold.

entry: POKENAME被用来保护世界各地大公司的数据中心。它极度重视安全，以超音速驰骋于虚拟世界，不断采集数据，时刻掌握最新信息。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is used to protect major companies' data centers all around the world. Obsessed with security, it races through the virtual world at supersonic speed, scraping data to stay constantly updated.

entry: POKENAME曾为遨游太空而接受升级，最终却仍没有足够的力量突破大气层。不过，得益于原有的设计，它能很好地适应各种情况，尤其是战斗。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have been upgraded with the intent to traverse space, though they ultimately lack the power to breach the atmosphere. Due to original designs, however, POKENAME are highly adaptable to many situations, especially combat.

entry: POKENAME看上去几乎与普通蚊香蝌蚪一模一样，甚至能轻易混入它们的群体。主要的辨别方法，是看它吹出的泡泡——那些泡泡是由二进制代码组成的。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME looks almost identical to a normal Poliwag, even able to infiltrate pods of them without issue. The main way to distinguish it is through the bubbles it blows, which are made of binary code.

entry: POKENAME腹部的屏幕，会根据吃下的代码显示图像。饥饿时，屏幕会一片空白，喷出的水也会变得极其无力。
author: .izik
source: The screen on POKENAME's belly displays images based on the coding it consumes. When hungry, the screen goes blank and any water it fires becomes extremely weak.

entry: POKENAME会趁附近没人，把汤匙贴在电脑上，吃掉无用的文件，提高处理速度。一旦被人发现，它就立刻瞬间移动逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME presses its spoon to computers when no one is nearby, consuming unused files and increasing processing speed. Should it be spotted, it teleports away instantly.

entry: POKENAME会借助手中的汤匙集中精神。只要不受打扰，它就能完成令人惊叹的电脑编程。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses the spoon it holds to focus its mind. As long as nobody distracts it, it is capable of incredible feats of computer programming.

entry: POKENAME的精神力量十分强大，能用念力直接影响周围的数字世界。它靠汤匙引导这股庞大的能量；若弄丢汤匙，力量就可能失控。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's mind is powerful enough that it can use its telekinesis to directly influence the digital world around it. It uses spoons to help channel this vast energy; losing them could potentially let its powers run rampant.

entry: POKENAME能连接数字设备，从中下载数据。它的头脑运作起来更像电脑，只要不是自己决定删除，就什么也不会忘记。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can connect to digital devices and download data from them. Its mind functions more like a computer than a brain, and it never forgets anything unless it decides to delete it.

entry: POKENAME通过吞食网上的数据，学习新的格斗技巧。许多训练家表示，它会使出自己从未教过的动作。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME learns new fighting techniques by consuming data online. Many Trainers report it using maneuvers they never taught it.

entry: POKENAME的手臂也能充当粗大的光纤，每秒可将超过10吉字节的数据从一只手传到另一只手。它强壮的体内安装着软件，让它的打击精准无比。
author: npshi
source: The arms of POKENAME double as large fiber-optic cables that can transfer over 10 gigabytes of data per second from one hand to another. POKENAME have software installed inside their powerful bodies, which results in impeccable strikes.

entry: POKENAME会吹出装满二进制代码的泡泡自卫。泡泡对生物的作用不算强，却会让被击中的数字生命遭受多种不良影响。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME blows bubbles filled with binary code as a method of self-defense. Though not particularly strong on biological units, digital beings are susceptible to many adverse effects if the bubbles hit them.

entry: POKENAME在网络空间中游弋，探索互联网，追逐一切令它感兴趣的事物。它尤其喜欢海滩视频，会把视频暂停，好在数字海洋里自在游泳。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swim through cyberspace and explore the internet to follow whatever grabs their attention. They gravitate towards videos of beaches, pausing the video so that they can freely swim in the digital sea.

entry: POKENAME吐出的酸液导电性极强。它会先用酸液浇遍敌人，再从口中发射电磁炮。
author: .izik
source: The acid POKENAME spits is incredibly conductive. It douses foes with it before releasing a Zap Cannon from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME生活在海洋最幽暗的深处，破坏沉船中的数据。研究它十分困难，因为它的触手会损坏研究其身体所用的设备，迫使设备给出不准确的读数。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is found in the darkest depths of the sea where it corrupts data from sunken ships. Studying POKENAME is difficult, as its tentacles corrupt equipment used to study its body and force the devices to give inaccurate readings.

entry: POKENAME会用头顶的蓝色器官发光，与同类交流。下半身大多漆黑，便于伪装，但也能沿下半身发出亮绿色的光来威吓对方。
author: infinex21
source: To communicate with its own kind, POKENAME emits light from the blue organs atop its head. Much of its lower body is pitch black to serve as camouflage, yet it can emit bright green lights along its lower body to intimidate others.

entry: POKENAME的身体会根据吃下的数据，模拟出相应的硬度。摄入与矿物有关的数据，会显著提高它的硬度。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body mimics hardness based on the data it consumes. Data related to minerals increases its hardness significantly.

entry: POKENAME会在网页间滚动，寻找图片吞食。一旦被人看见，它就会剧烈颤抖，随后爆炸，损坏观看者的屏幕。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rolls through webpages in search of images to consume. If spotted, it shakes violently before exploding and damaging the viewer's screen.

entry: 仔细观察，会发现POKENAME身体下方有小小的火焰喷口，帮助它快速移动。它对小孩子很友善，是带人体验惊险骑乘的好伙伴。
author: sk372
source: Close inspection reveals small flame jets on the underside of POKENAME's body that help propel it around quickly. It is friendly towards young children, making it a pleasant companion for thrilling rides.

entry: 尽管软件更新增加了可用内存，POKENAME仍会因内存泄漏而耗尽内存。加载起初进展飞快，却在临近完成时卡住，让人十分懊恼。
author: rymyll_the_wanderer
source: Despite software updates improving the amount of memory this Pokémon has, POKENAME still runs out due to memory leaks. People are frustrated when the loading progress stalls out near the end after its fast initial progress.

entry: POKENAME总是躺着，因为处理新学到的信息需要很长时间。它的尾巴从来感觉不到痛，因此很难理解疼痛是什么。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is always lying around because it needs a lot of time to process any new info it learns. It has a hard time understanding what pain is since it never feels any on its tail.

entry: POKENAME会结成小群，在网络空间里举办游泳比赛。选好一张合适的海洋照片后，它们就一头扎进去，彼此竞速。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gather into small groups to host swimming competitions in cyberspace. Once they have selected a suitable photo of the sea, they dive into the photo to race against each other.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴上附着一大块恶意软件，不断试图感染它。每当这病毒咬下去，就会吸走它的一部分数据，令它痛苦万分。
author: soup1900
source: On the tail of POKENAME is a large piece of malware that is constantly trying to infect POKENAME. When this virus bites down, POKENAME has some of its data sucked off of it, causing it great pain.

entry: POKENAME栖身电脑时，图标和窗口就会像被磁化一样，开始黏在一起。这让想使用电脑的人苦恼不已。
author: .izik
source: While POKENAME inhabits a computer, icons and windows begin sticking together as if magnetized. This proves incredibly frustrating for anyone trying to use the device.

entry: POKENAME栖身电脑时，所有接线都会像被磁铁吸住一样，牢牢锁在插口里。它一离开，接线就会同时从设备上弹出。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME inhabits a computer, all cords and wires lock into their slots as if held by magnets. The moment POKENAME leaves, they all pop out of the device at once.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME的左头会发出低沉的哔哔声，右头则发出高亢的哔哔声。它借此协调攻势，以惊人的力量打击敌人。
author: .izik
source: In combat, POKENAME's left head releases low-toned beeps while its right releases high-toned beeps. This allows it to coordinate attacks against its foe with surprising force.

entry: POKENAME的腿看似有关节，却从未被人见过使用。它只会飞快地滑行。每个头上的天线，似乎都在接收并放大来源不明的奇异信号。
author: exaltedghost
source: Despite its legs appearing to have joints, POKENAME has never been seen using them. Instead, it just slides around rapidly. The antennae on each head appear to pick up and magnify strange signals from unknown origins.

entry: POKENAME与同群伙伴一起穿行于网络空间。它通过进出位于两端的电脑，在不同的海岸之间迁徙。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME travels through cyberspace alongside others of its pod. It migrates between ocean coastlines by entering and exiting computers located at either end.

entry: POKENAME懒洋洋地漂浮在平静的水面上，几乎一动不动。可它一旦出声，就是足以震碎玻璃的轰鸣般的哔声。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats lazily above calm water, barely moving. Should it make any noise at all, it comes as a booming beep loud enough to shatter glass.

entry: POKENAME以损坏的数据为食，将其吸收进体内，是程序员的得力帮手。不过，它穿行网络空间时，可能留下零碎的垃圾代码，依然会对程序构成威胁。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is an asset to programmers as it feeds on corrupted data, absorbing it into its body. It can still be a threat to digital programs as it may leave behind pieces of junk code while traveling cyberspace.

entry: POKENAME能从壳上的两门炮中，射出高压的纯数据流。它是抵御恶意软件的好帮手，能精准地冲走恶意程序。
author: sk372
source: High-pressure streams of pure data can be fired from POKENAME's two cannons in its shell. It is an effective defense against malware, able to wash away malicious programs with pinpoint accuracy.

entry: POKENAME会用背上的炮向目标发射原始数据，让网络空间中的其他宝可梦变慢。它能有效制止恶意进程，防止数据损坏，是维护网络安全的好伙伴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME slow down other Pokémon in cyberspace by shooting targets with raw data from the cannons on their back. This makes POKENAME an ally in cybersecurity, as they can effectively neutralize malicious processes to stop data corruption.

entry: POKENAME会占据旧电脑，冒用逝者的名字撰写、发送邮件。许多悲伤的家属会把旧电脑砸碎，防止它控制电脑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME haunt old PCs by writing and sending emails under the name of the deceased. Many grieving families break old PCs into pieces to prevent POKENAME from taking control.

entry: POKENAME会占据逝者留下的旧电脑，向活人发送吓人的消息。它用虚幻的手抓取旧照片，将扭曲的影像设为背景。不过，家属们尚可庆幸：它从不修改原始照片。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME haunt old PCs of the deceased to send scary messages to the living. They grab old photos with their ethereal hands and display a distorted image as the background image. Thankfully for families, POKENAME never modify the original photos.

entry: POKENAME有个看似古怪的习惯，遇到什么人、什么东西都要舔一舔，让旁人十分懊恼。后来人们才发现，它能借此了解事物，并将这些信息作为记忆保存多年。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME has a seemingly odd habit of licking anything and anyone it comes across, much to the chagrin of others. It was eventually discovered that by licking things, it can learn of them and store that information for years as memories.

entry: POKENAME会在旧电脑上传播恶意软件，四处捣乱。许多重要的数字基础设施都遭它侵害，促使世界各地推动更换新电脑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spread malware on old PCs to cause mischief. Many pieces of vital digital infrastructure have been compromised by POKENAME, causing a worldwide push to upgrade to newer PCs.

entry: POKENAME会破坏旧电脑里的数据，因为它们缺少新电脑具备的防护。这种破坏性软件令人心痛不已：它一出手，珍贵照片和重要的税务文件就会变得面目全非。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME corrupts data on old PCs that lack the protection that comes with new PCs. This destructive software has caused much heartache, as precious photos and important tax documents become unrecognizable after POKENAME strike.

entry: 凭借智能程序，POKENAME能轻易找到让特定个体入睡的合适条件。偶尔它也会自行游荡，催眠他人。摆锤上的招式学习器里，从来没有任何数据。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's intelligent programming allows it to easily find the right conditions to induce slumber in a specific individual. Rarely, it may wander off on its own to hypnotize others. The Technical Machine on its pendulum never has any data.

entry: POKENAME背上的黑色球体磨成粉末后，是市面上效力最强的助眠品之一。球体被采下一个月后，就会重新长出。
author: bobogagabobo
source: When ground into a powder, the black orb on POKENAME's back is one of the most potent sleep aids on the market. The orb regrows one month after being harvested.

entry: POKENAME会在树枝上角抵着角争斗，抢夺最美味的叶子。狭小地方的激烈争斗，往往以双方一同跌落地面告终。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lock antlers in combat, fighting over the tastiest leaves on tree branches. The fierce battles on such limited terrain often wind up with both POKENAME plummeting to the ground.

entry: POKENAME的主导意识位于棕色的部分。其他部分看上去像节庆挂饰，似乎只是巧合；根据颜色不同，尝起来分别像红色或绿色的核桃。
author: bobosmith01
source: The brown-colored component of POKENAME contains the dominant consciousness. It seems the fact the other components resemble holiday ornaments is coincidental; they taste like red or green walnuts depending on the color.

entry: 它挥舞着一只遭偷猎害死的惊角鹿的遗骨。将骨棒敲在鹿角上，便能发出回荡的声音，让目标头晕目眩，产生幻觉。
author: sk372
source: It wields the remains of a Stantler that fell victim to poaching. It strikes the bone club against the antlers to produce an echoing sound that causes dizziness and hallucinations in its target.

entry: 常能见到其他宝可梦，欣赏它绘出的超级英雄故事。能把自己的故事分享给大家，让它十分自豪。
author: skymaster426
source: Pokémon can be found enjoying illustrations it has created, usually depicting superhero stories. It takes great pride sharing its stories with others.

entry: POKENAME散发的乐观情绪极具感染力，被认为是许多社区的一大快乐源泉。它的叫声非常像人说话，一家声名显赫的大型漫画出版社还将其用作口号。
author: sondededoo
source: The infectious positivity radiated by POKENAME is cited as a major source of happiness for various communities. It's cry is incredibly similar to human speech, and it has been used as a catchphrase by a very notable big time comic book publisher.

entry: 繁花盛放时，它会在花丛中觅食。POKENAME的鹿角能探测空气中的细微变化，感知天气与季节的更替。
author: sk372
source: It forages among the flowers during the height of their blooming. POKENAME's antlers detect subtle shifts in the air that let it sense the changing of weather and seasons.

entry: POKENAME的双角与双镰上，都有能运用念力的球体。若同时集中四个球体的力量，它便能展现出几乎媲美最强超能力宝可梦的本领。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has orbs that possess telekinetic capabilities in both its antlers and its scythes. If it focuses with all four, it can exhibit abilities almost on par with the most potent of Psychic Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME领地意识很强，会用头槌与角刺攻击闯入者。它的电击有迹可循：两只鹿角会先发光，再从分叉的角尖射出光束。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is highly territorial and engages in headbutting and jousting with others that encroach on its territory. Its electric attacks are telegraphed as the two antlers glow before firing beams from the tines.

entry: 受到威胁时，POKENAME的鹿角会迸发高热，接连喷射火焰。它产生的火焰，能轻易熔穿钢制大门。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's antlers flare with intense heat, launching bursts of flame when it is threatened. The fire it produces can melt through steel gates with ease.

entry: 许多恋人会雇POKENAME代送可爱邮件，因为它对携带的信件一向爱护有加。逢某些节日，它还可以戴上装饰，让这封信更令人难忘。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many lovers opt to hire a POKENAME to deliver Lovely Mail for them, as they are known to be gentle with the mail they carry. They also can wear decorations around certain holidays to make that letter more memorable.

entry: POKENAME用硕大的角收集周围的静电，逐渐积蓄电荷，储存在体内。雷雨时它们格外活跃，会跑到外面，设法收集空气中的电势能。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME collects ambient static with its large horns, gradually collecting charge and storing it in its body. They race outside and are very active during thunderstorms, trying to harvest the electrical potential in the air.

entry: POKENAME是懒散的森林住民，很少起身活动，就连觅食也不积极。它会用鹿角发出轻微的催眠力量，影响其他生物，让它们留下食物给自己。
author: sk372
source: A lethargic denizen of the forest, POKENAME rarely gets up and moves, even to forage. It uses light hypnotic powers from its antlers to influence others to leave food behind for it instead.

entry: 它的蹄尖十分锐利，能攀爬岩面或树木。它的行踪极其隐秘，人们大多只能找到蹄印和几片脱落的鳞片。
author: infinex21
source: The tips of its hooves are fairly sharp, which allows them to climb rocky surfaces or trees. It is so elusive that most of the only signs of it are its hoofprints and a few shed scales.

entry: 它们会用晶体发出精神波，彼此交流。虽然角很坚硬，它们通常仍会用精神波催眠、吓退对方，避免正面冲突。
author: infinex21
source: They communicate with one another by emitting psychic waves from their crystals. Despite how tough their horns are, they will typically use their psychic waves to hypnotize and deter others rather than confront them.

entry: POKENAME隐居在宁静、未遭破坏的森林中，生性十分胆小。在野外一旦被发现，就会振动鹿角，发出能让对方晕眩的精神冲击波，随后飞走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives a remote lifestyle in forest areas that are peaceful and pristine. Quite timid, it will vibrate its antlers to create a stunning psychic shockwave and fly away if spotted in the wild.

entry: 虽然四足奔跑也很灵活，POKENAME大多还是用后腿行走。尾巴上的球体会发出微弱的精神波，配合摆动的尾巴，往往能催眠大多数生物。
author: infinex21
source: Although they can run on all fours rather well, POKENAME tend to walk on their hind legs the most. The orbs upon their tails emit weak psychic waves which, paired with their swinging tails, tend to be hypnotic to most.

entry: 它是行踪隐秘的森林住民，藏身于植被最茂盛的地方。POKENAME会用鹿角发出精神波，修改目标的记忆，抹去对方见过自己的所有印象。
author: sk372
source: An elusive forest dweller that hides in the most lush of regions. POKENAME generates psychic waves from its antlers that modify the memories of those it targets, eliminating any memory they have of witnessing it.

entry: POKENAME毛茸茸的身体，伸展开来能超过七英尺。若遭到想剥取其毛皮的偷猎者威胁，它的鹿角便会亮起蓝光，使出奇异之光逃脱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's furry body can stretch over seven feet in length. If threatened by poachers attempting to take its hide, its antlers glow blue as it casts Confuse Ray to escape.

entry: 察觉危险时，POKENAME会发出震耳欲聋的鸣叫，并从鹿角释放精神脉冲。捕食者常会转身逃跑，连自己为什么追赶它都不明白。
author: .izik
source: When it senses danger, POKENAME lets out a deafening hoot and unleashes psychic pulses from its antlers. Predators often turn and flee, unsure why they were ever chasing it.

entry: POKENAME静静栖在红豆杉的枝头，轻声鸣叫，注视森林。危险接近时，它的鹿角会闪光，提醒附近的伙伴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME perches silently on yew branches, softly hooting as it watches the forest. If danger nears, its antlers flash to alert nearby allies.

entry: 受到惊吓时，POKENAME会从鹿角释放黏性很强的丝线。丝线很快就会硬化，让逃脱变得困难。
author: .izik
source: When frightened, POKENAME releases a powerful adhesive thread from its antlers. The silk hardens quickly, making escape difficult.

entry: POKENAME速度快得惊人，能以超过每小时45英里的速度，沿任何表面向上奔跑。战斗时，它会一头撞向对手，用毒角将其刺穿。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are surprisingly fast, able to run up any surface at over 45mph. In combat, it rams headfirst into its opponent, impaling them with its poisonous horn.

entry: POKENAME鹿角上的红色球体，会发出脉动的光，飞得越快，光就越亮。夜晚它飞过草地时，整个村子的人都会聚在一起观赏。
author: .izik
source: The red orbs on POKENAME's antlers pulse with light that grows brighter the faster it flies. Entire villages gather to watch it at night as it soars across meadows.

entry: POKENAME会主动寻找雷雨，将鹿角高举向天，引来雷电。每道闪电都能为它充入庞大的能量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME actively seeks thunderstorms, raising its antlers skyward to attract lightning. Each bolt charges it with immense power.

entry: POKENAME华美的鹿角备受珍视，吸引着世界各地的爱好者前往城都。它胆小怕人，不喜欢被注视，会迅速跑离人群，再借鹿角产生的升力飞走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are prized for their magnificent antlers, drawing admirers from across the world to Johto. They are skittish and dislike being watched, running quickly away from crowds and using the lift from their antlers to fly away.

entry: 有些训练家毕生都在追逐、捕捉POKENAME。它们虽然并不稀有，速度却快得惊人，几乎无法捉到。
author: mistymagius
source: Some Trainers have dedicated their lives to catching a POKENAME. While not rare, they are so incredibly fast that catching one is nearly impossible.

entry: POKENAME用鹿角发出精神波，迷惑野餐的人，再用长尾巴顺走无人看管的餐食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sends out psychic waves from its antlers to confuse picnickers. It then uses its long tail to swipe unattended meals.

entry: POKENAME身体底部会向外长出鹿角般的枝条。它总免不了被误认成灌木，这时便会长出剃刀般锋利的叶片，割伤想来吃叶子的宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME grow antler-like branches that stretch out from the base of their body. When they are inevitably mistaken for a bush, they sprout razor sharp leaves that cut against Pokémon looking for a leafy treat.

entry: POKENAME脸上的球体，由能诱人入睡的特殊物质构成。它无法正常入睡，必须把球体在别的东西上蹭掉一些，再舔食这些物质，才能沉沉睡去。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The orb on POKENAME's face is made of a special substance that induces sleep. POKENAME are unable to fall asleep normally and must rub it against something to cause some to dislodge, which it licks up, putting into a deep sleep.

entry: POKENAME脸上的球体，由能诱人入睡的特殊物质构成，人们会采下来制作安眠药剂。球体被切下时，它会渗出有毒的黏液，促使更多球体长出。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The orbs on POKENAME's face are made of a special substance that induces sleep. They are harvested by people to use to make sleeping tonics. When cut, POKENAME oozes a toxic goo that stimulates more orbs to grow.

entry: POKENAME喜欢泡在浑浊的水中，在泥底翻找。浮出水面时，它的鹿角上通常沾满淤泥，能甩向那些惹它不快的家伙。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys soaking itself and sifting around in the bottoms of muddy waters. When it surfaces, its antlers are usually coated with muck it can fling at those who try to agitate it.

entry: 潜藏的精神能量在POKENAME的鹿角间共鸣，增强背上球体的能量。盯着球体看得太久，就会突然忍不住想照料附近的植物。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Latent psychic energy resonates through a POKENAME's antlers in order to amplify the energy of the orb on its back. Anyone who gazes into the orb on a POKENAME's back for too long will have a sudden compulsion to tend to any nearby plants.

entry: POKENAME的腿更为粗壮，足以支撑背上的巨大球体。球体会释放香气怡人的黑色孢子，让其他宝可梦陷入催眠状态。
author: bobogagabobo
source: POKENAME has sturdier legs to support the large orb on its back. The orb emits black spores that have a pleasant aroma and can put other Pokémon in a state of hypnosis.

entry: POKENAME会从鹿角释放诡异的脉冲，激起人类内心深处的恐惧。它将恐惧储存在颈下的珍珠中，以其中的能量为食。
author: .izik
source: From its antlers, POKENAME releases eerie pulses that stir deep fear in humans. It stores this fear in the pearls beneath its neck, feeding off the energy.

entry: POKENAME用鹿角引导精神能量，把牛至、迷迭香等香草举到身体后部。它低头吃草时，后面的头就会吃掉这些香草。
author: .izik
source: By channeling psychic energy through its antlers, POKENAME lifts herbs like oregano and rosemary to the rear portion of its body. Its rear head eats them while POKENAME grazes.

entry: POKENAME以爆炸自卫前，鹿角会剧烈振动。爆炸的威力，足以夷平一座小房子。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's antlers vibrate violently before it explodes in self-defense. The resulting blast is strong enough to flatten a small house.

entry: POKENAME不太擅长行走，只有要换一棵树果树坐在下面时，才会移动。受到威胁时，它会从身上的孔洞射出收集来的种子，力道足以把钢板打凹。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can't walk that well, so it only travels to find a new berry tree to sit under. When threatened, POKENAME will fire the seeds it has collected out of the holes on its body with enough force to dent steel.

entry: POKENAME滑翔时，会用宽大的鹿角维持升力。这种独特的适应方式，让它能悄无声息地往返于悬崖之间。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its broad antlers to maintain lift while gliding. This unusual adaptation allows it to travel silently between cliffs.

entry: POKENAME喜欢探索周围的世界，因此常把鹿角卡在篱笆里。它友善又亲人，爱给训练家送礼物，比如脱落的鹿角或树果。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often get their antlers stuck in fences because they like to explore the world around them. They are friendly and affectionate creatures that love to give their Trainer gifts, such as their antlers after shedding or berries.

entry: POKENAME通常很温和，常会把树果送给森林中饥饿的生灵。它很擅长在雪地辨路，村落因此经常派它送信。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is a generally peaceful Pokémon and will often give berries to those starving in the forest. It is great at navigating snowy terrain, so villages will often send it out as a messenger.

entry: POKENAME面对没见过的人或宝可梦，总是十分谨慎，会将身体半藏在物体后面，远远观察。据说，一旦训练家赢得它的信任，它就会永远忠诚。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME are very cautious around people and Pokémon they have never met before, hiding partially behind objects to observe from a distance. If a Trainer earns a POKENAME's trust, their loyalty is said to last forever.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，在野外又往往挤居于狭小的区域，因此争斗十分常见。雄性会在空中彼此冲撞，角抵着角，争夺主导地位。
author: sk372
source: Being highly territorial while residing in a rather small area in the wild means POKENAME fights are a common sight. Bucks charge into each other while airborne to lock antlers and battle for dominance.

entry: POKENAME会从鹿角喷出阵阵寒气，保护巢穴。若送上新鲜罗勒，它就会放松下来，让访客平安通过。
author: .izik
source: To protect its den, POKENAME emits cold bursts of air from its antlers. If offered fresh basil, it relaxes and allows the visitor to pass unharmed.

entry: POKENAME的奶格外香浓可口，只是容易让人发胖。在世界上的某些地方，它被视为节庆的象征，常与信使鸟一同出现在图画中。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's milk is found to be extra creamy and delectable, if fattening. The species is considered something of a holiday icon in certain parts of the world, often paired with Delibird in imagery.

entry: POKENAME的鹿角磨成粉后，是药效很强的药材。采集时角上依然带电，因此建议戴上橡胶手套。
author: .izik
source: When ground into powder, POKENAME's antlers are a powerful medicine. Their electric charge remains active during harvesting, so rubber gloves are recommended.

entry: 伤害POKENAME家园的人，会招来它的愤怒与诅咒。它用鹿角施法，使受害者陷入无边的恐怖森林幻象，在里面游荡数日。
author: sk372
source: Those who have caused harm to POKENAME's home will incite its ire, and its curse. A spell cast from its antlers will cause the victim to hallucinate an endless terrifying forest they will wander in for days.

entry: POKENAME常见于富豪的庄园，因为华丽的角是很好的点缀。它讨厌被人摆弄，若被纠缠太久，就容易横冲直撞。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are commonly found in wealthy estates, as their extravagant horns make great decorations. They hate being handled and tend to stampede if they are harassed for too long.

entry: POKENAME模仿别人的时候，身上的黑色球体便带有催眠般的魔力，尤其是双角上的两个。盯着它们看的人会发现，自己还没动，它就先一步模仿起自己的动作。
author: .jerden
source: Whenever POKENAME imitates others, the black balls on its body have a hypnotic quality, especially the two on its antlers. People who stare at them will discover that POKENAME has begun to mimic their actions slightly before they begin to move.

entry: 只需看一眼POKENAME的鹿角，感官便会开始被扭曲。它远远尾随敌人，向其射出冰片；受精神干扰影响，对方竟会毫无感觉。
author: bobosmith01
source: A single glance in POKENAME's antlers is all it needs to start distorting one's senses. It will fire icy shards into a foe as it stalks them from a distance, without them ever feeling a thing thanks to the mental distortion.

entry: POKENAME能伸长触手，够到高处的树枝，寻找最美味的树果。它偶尔也会摘取漂亮叶片、松果等小东西，装饰鹿角。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's extending tentacles let it reach high branches and find the tastiest berries to eat. On occasion, it also grabs pretty leaves, pine cones and other accessories to decorate its antlers with.

entry: POKENAME能振动鹿角，干扰机械，甚至让其完全停止运转。偶尔连它自己的身体也会受影响，像失去生命般倒在地上，几分钟都一动不动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can vibrate its antlers to cause disruptions in machinery and even cause them to cease functions entirely. This occasionally extends to its own body, which falls lifelessly to the ground and lies inert for several minutes.

entry: 如果附近有它讨厌的人，POKENAME的鹿角就会烧得通红。它会将角抵在惹怒自己的对象身上，以示警告。
author: .izik
source: If it hates someone nearby, POKENAME's antlers glow red-hot. It presses them against the offender in a warning display.

entry: POKENAME举止庄重优雅，会提起裙裾，跳起曼妙的舞蹈。旋转时，鹿角上的黑色球体发出细微的精神波，催眠看入迷的观众，制造绚丽的幻象。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME move with dignified grace, lifting the folds of their gowns to perform elegant dances. As they spin, the black orbs on their antlers emit subtle psychic waves that hypnotize captivated onlookers and create dazzling illusions.

entry: POKENAME会按自己的喜好改变角的颜色，与群里的其他成员区分开来。群中最强壮的个体，角的颜色也最鲜艳。
author: mistymagius
source: To distinguish themselves from the rest of their herd, POKENAME change the colors of their horns to match their own preferences. The strongest of the herd have the most vibrant horns.

entry: POKENAME的楔石形似惊角鹿的头骨，许多人因此认为，它是遭偷猎的宝可梦前来复仇的亡魂。它会从石中现身，驱赶接近林中惊角鹿群的来者。
author: sk372
source: Since POKENAME's keystone resembles a Stantler skull, this led many to believe it was the spirit of poached Pokémon seeking vengeance. It emerges from its stone to fend off those who would approach Stantler colonies within the forest.

entry: 早期史料显示，POKENAME在过去远比现在常见，还被描述为人类的守护者。后来，它因珍贵的鹿角遭到猎捕，目击记录也随之减少。
author: wiz0z
source: Early historical records suggests that POKENAME were far more common in the past than in the modern era, being described as protectors of humanity. POKENAME were later hunted for their valuable antlers, leading to a decrease in sightings.

entry: 受到威胁时，POKENAME能弹出背上的黑色球体，迸发出大片催眠孢子。这种球体十分脆弱，很难在不使其爆裂的情况下采下，因此价格昂贵。
author: bobogagabobo
source: POKENAME can eject the black orb on its back to create a burst of hypnotic spores that affects a large area when threatened. This black orb is very expensive since it is delicate and difficult to harvest without bursting.

entry: POKENAME的鹿角覆有黏稠的黄色毒素。哪怕只是轻轻擦过，也会引发高烧、眩晕和逼真的幻觉。
author: .izik
source: A sticky yellow toxin coats POKENAME's antlers. Even a brush against them can induce high fevers, dizziness, and vivid hallucinations.

entry: 世界各地都有发现POKENAME的记录，研究者因此认为它们居无定所。它靠巨大的鹿角威慑潜在威胁，只在受挑衅时攻击，并会挥动粗大的尾巴拍开敌人。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME have been found in many places around the world, leading researchers to believe this species is nomadic. It relies on its large antlers to intimidate potential threats, only attacking when provoked. It sweeps its large tail to bat away foes.

entry: POKENAME的气场极具威慑力，附近大多数生物都会逃走。没有立刻逃跑的，也会被催眠得转身逃离；它就这样保护自己或他人免遭危险。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has an incredibly intimidating aura that causes most in their vicinity to flee. Those who do not immediately flee are hypnotized into fleeing anyway; it is through this method POKENAME can keep itself or others safe from danger.

entry: 奇怪的是，POKENAME身上的鹿角，长得比头上的还多。据说，注视角上排列的球体，会有被催眠般的感觉，许多人认为这就是它自卫的方法。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME antlers oddly grow from their bodies more than the ones upon their heads. The orbs lining their antlers are often said to feel hypnotic to look at it, which many assume is how they defend themselves.

entry: POKENAME环上的球体，会随季节而发光。换季时，一处光芒渐暗，另一处则渐亮。古时有些文明相信，季节更替是由它掌控的。
author: sk372
source: The orbs on POKENAME's ring light up according to the seasons, one light fading and another growing as the season changes. In olden times, some civilizations believe POKENAME itself controlled the seasonal change.

entry: 睡觉时，POKENAME的鹿角会渗出黏稠的红色毒液。若遭打扰，它就会把毒液溅向四面八方，保护自己。
author: .izik
source: While it sleeps, a sticky red poison leaks from POKENAME's antlers. If disturbed, it splashes the toxin in all directions to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME曾被认为是节庆欢乐之灵的化身。它缎带上的铃铛一响，周围就会充满令人怀念的幸福感。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME were once believed to be spirits of holiday joy given form. When the bells on their ribbons jingle, the area around them fills with a sense of nostalgic happiness.

entry: POKENAME会潜行跟踪所有踏入其领地的来者。风穿过鹿角时，有训练家声称，脑海里会响起声音，命令自己臣服于它。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME stalks all who enter its domain. As the wind passes through their antlers, Trainers claim to hear voices in their heads demanding them to submit to POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME会潜行跟踪所有踏入其领地的来者。风穿过鹿角时，有训练家声称，脑海里会响起声音，命令自己臣服于它。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME stalks all who enter its domain. As the wind passes through their antlers, Trainers claim to hear voices in their heads demanding them to submit to POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME拥有奇异的催眠力量，能使他人神志恍惚。深夜看到的光芒，未必来自朋友：它的受害者会被吸走能量，昏倒在地。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME have odd hypnotic powers that leave others in a trance. In the dead of night, the light you see may not be a friend: POKENAME's victims have their energy drained and pass out.

entry: POKENAME的皮毛十分耐寒，让它能在冬季茁壮生活。它能帮露营者寻找没有积雪的草地，已成为可靠的伙伴。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's fur is highly resistant to the cold; this allows them to thrive during the winter months. They have become reliable companions for campers, as they aid in the search for grassy areas free of snow.

entry: POKENAME闭上眼睛，就能用对波导敏感的鹿角，读懂他人的情绪。若察觉悲伤，它会温柔地靠近，安慰对方。
author: .izik
source: By closing its eyes, POKENAME reads the emotions of others through its aura-sensitive antlers. If it detects sadness, it approaches gently and comforts the individual.

entry: POKENAME完全失明，因此经常撞墙。不过，它的角能发出微弱的精神波，让它朦胧地感知周围的情况。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are completely blind, causing them to frequently crash into walls. However, their horns produce weak psychic waves that give POKENAME a faint idea of what is around it.

entry: POKENAME会附在大树上，利用转子借风发电。但树皮有时会卡住齿轮，让它十分难受。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME attaches itself to large trees, using its rotor to generate energy from the wind. However, its gears can sometimes get jammed by tree bark, causing it major discomfort.

entry: 一旦陷入POKENAME的幻象，它就能轻易使人入睡，继而操控梦境。梦境可能恐怖，也可能奇幻离奇。不过，大多数个体只是一味远离其他生物。
author: bobosmith01
source: Once caught in its illusions, POKENAME can easily force someone to fall asleep and then control their dreams. Such dreams can be anything from horrific to whimsical. Most POKENAME, however, simply stay away from others entirely.

entry: POKENAME果冻般的鹿角，会发出柔和的精神能量波。不用低头，它就能把土里的豆瓣菜举起来吃。
author: .izik
source: The jelly-like antlers on POKENAME emit soft waves of psychic energy. It lifts watercress from the soil to eat without lowering its head.

entry: POKENAME的棉花有独特的天鹅绒般的质感，深受各类家具制造者欢迎。它讨厌弄脏自己，因此通常住在干净水源附近。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's cotton has a unique velvety texture to it, making it quite popular in the production of many types of furniture. It hates getting dirty, so it usually inhabits areas near a clean water source.

entry: 振翅时，尾巴会有节奏地摆动。闻见喜欢的东西，鼻子就明显泛粉红。
author: .izik
source: As it flaps its wings, its tail waves back and forth rhythmically. When it smells something it likes, its nose turns a noticeable shade of pink.

entry: 狩猎时，POKENAME会从鹿角分泌绿色的麻痹毒素。它藏在倒木中，等待毫无戒心的猎物经过。
author: .izik
source: While hunting, POKENAME secretes a green paralytic toxin from its antlers. It hides inside logs, waiting for unsuspecting prey to pass.

entry: 过去，POKENAME的鹿角因外形奇异而备受珍视。不过，它性情凶猛，难以猎捕，因此没有落到濒临灭绝的地步。
author: m1918_94884
source: In the past, POKENAME antlers were prized due to their exotic nature. However, its aggressive nature made it difficult to hunt, allowing it to avoid near-extinction.

entry: 狩猎时，POKENAME的鹿角会滴下黏稠的绿色毒液。它会麻痹咕咕等猎物，让追逐就此结束。
author: .izik
source: Sticky green poison drips from POKENAME's antlers when it hunts. It paralyzes prey like Hoothoot to finish the chase.

entry: POKENAME头上的枝条像真鹿角，随季节生长、脱落。若在一处待得太久，落枝堆多了，便可能引发火灾。
author: holgast
source: The antler-like sticks on POKENAME's head grow out and fall off through the seasons, like real antlers. As a result, if POKENAME stay in one area for too long, their dropped twigs can cause a fire hazard.

entry: POKENAME的前腿很无力，因此更喜欢只用后腿行走。它领地意识极强，几乎什么事都能让它与同类打起来。
author: mistymagius
source: Because of how weak its front legs are, POKENAME prefers to walk exclusively with its back legs. It is very territorial and will fight with other POKENAME over basically anything.

entry: POKENAME华美的鹿角曾被入药，人们相信它能治好任何疾病。
author: yanlu
source: POKENAME's magnificent antlers were once used as a medicine that was believed to cure any disease.

entry: POKENAME常与同类激烈争斗，角朝前，向彼此冲去。这常让它们意外地在半空卡住双角，一同摔落地面。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME often get in heated battles with one another, charging at each other horn first. This often leads to them accidentally locking horns mid-air and tumbling to the ground.

entry: POKENAME背上长出的东西看似鹿角，其实是形状独特的蘑菇。振动它们，就会释放孢子，让吸入者产生幻觉。
author: sk372
source: What appear to be antlers sprouting from POKENAME's back are actually uniquely-shaped mushrooms. Vibrating them causes the mushrooms to release spores that cause hallucinations in those who inhale them.

entry: POKENAME虽然模样令人不安，却是好奇又友善的宝可梦。它背上长出的鹿角状真菌，是珍贵的食材，采集者会寻找它们，烹制美味佳肴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Despite their unnerving appearance, POKENAME are curious and friendly Pokémon. The antler-like fungi that sprout from their back are a prized food that foragers search for to cook delicious meals.

entry: POKENAME通过角发出微弱的精神信号，彼此交流。信号能传得很远，因此旅人常带它同行，以便迷路后被人找到。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME communicate with each other sending weak, psychic signals through their horns. Because of how far these signals can travel, travelers will often carry a POKENAME so people can find them if they get lost.

entry: POKENAME鹿角上的许多球体，会散发微弱的精神能量，轻易令人陷入恍惚的催眠状态。不过，它真正的精神力量来自一根由脱落鹿角制成的魔杖，杖上仿佛燃烧着纯粹而明亮的能量。
author: infinex21
source: The many orbs of a POKENAME's antlers emit faint psychic energies that can easily lull others into hypnotic trances. Its real psychic power, however, comes from the wand that was formed from a shed antler, which seems to burn bright with pure energy.

entry: POKENAME的鹿角十分敏感，能察觉空气中最细微的振动。为了鹿角而来的猎捕日益增多，让它变得更加胆怯，领地意识也更强。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's antlers are very sensitive and can detect the slightest vibrations in the air. Due to increased hunting for its antlers, it has become much more skittish and territorial.

entry: POKENAME很受托儿所欢迎，呆头呆脑的举动总能逗笑孩子。它的椒盐脆饼鹿角会不停生长，长得太大时，人们就会小心采下，当作咸味点心。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are popular at daycares, their dopey behavior always eliciting laughs from the children. Their pretzel antlers continuously grow, so they are carefully harvested for salty treats if they grow too big.

entry: POKENAME好胜心与领地意识都很强，在野外不断与对手角抵着角争斗。撞头时会飞溅火星，特别激烈的较量甚至可能点燃鹿角。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is fiercely competitive and territorial, locking antlers with rivals constantly in the wild. Embers fly when they butt heads, and particularly aggressive displays may cause their antlers to ignite.

entry: POKENAME在地下时，会飞快地振动鹿角，更轻松地掘开泥土。当它探出地面时，同样的振动也能让靠得太近的生物晕头转向。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's antlers vibrate rapidly to help it dig through soil more easily while underground. This same vibrations can disorient creatures that come too close when it peeks above ground.

entry: POKENAME似乎完全无意用鹿角战斗，倒是经常在池塘里清洗鹿角，或给鹿角戴上小饰物。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME seems utterly disinterested in using its antlers in battle, though it can often be found washing them in ponds or decorating them with trinkets.

entry: POKENAME住在岩山上，凭着锋利的爪与蹄，轻松穿越崎岖地形。它对鹿角十分自豪，只要有一只角受损，就会惊恐地逃跑。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives on rocky mountains, using its sharp claws and hooves to easily traverse the terrain. It is very proud of its antlers and will flee in terror if one of them is ever damaged.

entry: POKENAME领地意识很强，会用鹿角互相撞击，确立主导地位。许多个体打完架，角上多了个缺口，脑袋也痛得厉害。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are territorial creatures that ram their antlers into one another to assert dominance. Many leave these fights with a chip on an antler and a painful headache.

entry: 如果有人盯着黑色球体看，POKENAME就会暴怒。它会先用催眠力量让对方晕得站不住，再用鹿角狠狠攻击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME becomes infuriated when someone stares into its black orbs. When this happens, it uses its hypnotic powers to make them extremely dizzy and unable to stand before mauling them with its antlers.

entry: POKENAME身上华美的簇毛，因柔软保暖而广受追捧。但这些毛只能由它自愿送给信任的人；对其他人，它会毫不犹豫地从鹿角射出火焰，烧向对方。
author: sk372
source: The luxurious tufts of fur on POKENAME's body are highly sought for their softness and warmth. It must be willingly given to a trusted human; POKENAME won't hesitate to burn away others with flames shot from its antlers.

entry: POKENAME的超能力虽有大量记录，人们却仍不甚了解。它似乎能截取无线电波，让通过电子设备听到电波内容的人，产生它所指定的情绪。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's psychic powers are well-documented but still not well understood. It appears to be able to intercept radio waves and can force those who hear them from electronic devices to feel emotions of its own choosing.

entry: 有风的夜晚，POKENAME鹿角后的空间会显现星座，占星师会据此预测未来。想找它观星的人，往往能在野外看见它演奏各种乐器。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: On windy nights the space behind POKENAME's antlers display constellations, which are used by astrologers to predict the future. Those that wish to find POKENAME to see the stars can often find them playing various instruments in the wild.

entry: POKENAME迈动多条腿飞奔，借助球体制造的幻象与蹄中的毒素狩猎。它的鹿角晒干磨粉后，价值连城。
author: hortensia_xxiii
source: Galloping on its many legs, POKENAME hunts with both the illusions conjured by its orbs and the toxins in its hooves. When dried and powdered, its antlers are worth a fortune.

entry: 如果林间空地寂静得异乎寻常，POKENAME可能就在附近。它触手上的球体，能编织出让耳目无从察觉的幻象。
author: hortensia_xxiii
source: Should a forest clearing be too silent, POKENAME may be near. The orbs on its tentacles can weave an illusion imperceptible to one's eyes and ears.

entry: 山崩时，POKENAME常会一路滚上高速公路，无意间堵住交通。它们通常需要帮助才能返回自然栖息地，因此人们会下车帮忙。
author: quackquackattack
source: When landslides occur, POKENAME often find themselves tumbling onto freeways and inadvertently blocking traffic. They usually need assistance getting back to their natural habitat, so people get out of their cars to help them.

entry: POKENAME的鹿角带有奇异的磁力。它在城镇间游荡时，会不知不觉吸上一堆钥匙、罐子和废金属。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's antlers emit a strange magnetic pull. It unknowingly collects keys, cans, and scrap metal as it wanders through towns.

entry: 一个头好奇又轻信，另一个却多疑而警惕。性情上的冲突，常让两个头小打小闹，把彼此的鹿角卡在一起。
author: sk372
source: One head is curious and trusting, the other paranoid and on guard. This clash of personalities often results in small fights and locked antlers between the two.

entry: POKENAME偏爱幽僻的森林。闯入者会被它神秘的力量催眠，醒来时已在林外，完全不记得曾遇到过它。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME prefers to live in reclusive forests. Trespassers are hypnotized by its mysterious powers and wake up outside of the woods with no memory that they encountered POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME用藤蔓细细作画，描绘自然。它很乐意与艺术家一同学习，也不怕颜料沾上自己淡黄色的身体。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME meticulously paint with their vines to create works of nature. They are always happy to learn alongside artists and are not afraid of getting paint on their primrose-colored body.

entry: POKENAME尾巴滴下的颜料，会随当下在精神上占主导的种子改变颜色。睡觉时，主导的种子迅速更替，色调也随之剧烈变化。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tail drips with paint that shifts color depending on which seed is telepathically dominant at the moment. While sleeping, the dominant seed changes rapidly causing drastic hue shifts.

entry: POKENAME将母亲给它的头骨涂上鲜艳的颜色，表达满心的爱。每个个体都有独特的图案与配色。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME paints the skull it received from its mother with bright colors to show all the affection it feels. Each individual features unique designs and palettes.

entry: POKENAME遭逢失去或悲剧时，会用艺术抒发情绪。它最常用的画布，是自己的头骨面具，每经历一次失去，就在上面留下一笔。
author: katieplaysgames
source: When POKENAME suffer loss or tragedy they express their emotions through artistic expression. Their most common canvas is their own skull mask, marking it once for each loss they've experienced.

entry: POKENAME不停喷吐彩色气体，将经过的东西都染上颜色。有时，它会停下脚步，欣赏自己这样留下的艺术作品。
author: fenragon
source: POKENAME constantly belches out colourful gas, staining anything it passes by. Sometimes, POKENAME will stop in its tracks to admire the art it has left behind this way.

entry: POKENAME的指尖会分泌颜料般的物质，用来装点看不见的画布。它偏爱与分泌物色调相近的地方，以取得最好的伪装效果。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME secrete a paint-like substance from their fingertips, which they use to decorate invisible canvases. They prefer to live in areas that match the color palettes of their secretions to maximize the effectiveness as camouflage.

entry: 在温暖的气候下，POKENAME能产生任何颜色的墨汁。天气变冷，决定颜色的器官就会收缩，能产生的颜色也随之减少。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: In warm climates, POKENAME can produce an ink-like substance of any colour. As it gets colder, the organ that determines the colour shrinks, reducing the number of possible colours.

entry: POKENAME常常被揉得皱巴巴的，像其他废纸一样漂在水里。与它在生态系统中的作用相比，它被小学生拿来上美术课画画的用途反而更大。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is often crumpled up and only floats around like other paper trash in bodies of water. It serves more of a purpose being drawn on by schoolchildren for their art lessons than it does in the ecosystem.

entry: 关都地区的艺术家常把POKENAME的毒液混入油性颜料，调出鲜艳的颜色。许多个体还能在用自己毒液绘成的画上，以毒针在画布上压出印记，留下签名。
author: quackquackattack
source: Artists in the Kanto region often mix POKENAME venom with oil-based paint to create vibrant colors. Many POKENAME get to sign art made with their venom by creating an imprint of their stinger against a canvas.

entry: POKENAME挥动纸做的身体，掀起足以吹走附近房屋的狂风。谁想在它身上画画，它就会使出威力强大的破坏光线还击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME thrashes with its paper body to create wind blasts that blow away nearby houses. It will retaliate by using a powerful Hyper Beam against anyone who tries to sketch on it.

entry: POKENAME狂暴地扭动时，会把身上的颜料泼向一切攻击的对象。肆虐结束后，它会给破坏过的地方覆上一层红色颜料，作为自己来过的标记。
author: soup1900
source: As POKENAME thrashes about, it splatters the paint from its body onto everything it attacks. Once it has finished its rampage, it coats its destruction with a layer of red paint as a symbol of its presence.

entry: POKENAME会先在物体表面作画，再照着画出的样子变身。它刻苦练习，盼着有一天，画作与变身都能完美再现原物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME draws images on surfaces before transforming based on what it has painted. It practices hard so that one day both its art and its transformations will be perfect replications.

entry: POKENAME的艺术作品颇能触动人心，在鉴赏家中引发的反响却褒贬不一。它还在寻找适合自己的画风，鉴赏家们可不会因此就不加评判。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce evocative works of art that bring mixed reactions in art connoisseurs. POKENAME are still finding an art style that suits them, but that does not stop connoisseurs from judging their work.

entry: POKENAME很受艺术家喜爱。可它走到哪里都留下颜料，养它也意味着得付出不少心力。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME are popular pets among artists. Unfortunately, they tend to leave paint everywhere they go, making them a serious commitment.

entry: POKENAME很受艺术家喜爱。可它走到哪里都留下颜料，养它也意味着得付出不少心力。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME are popular pets among artists. Unfortunately, they tend to leave paint everywhere they go, making them a serious commitment.

entry: POKENAME很受艺术家喜爱。可它走到哪里都留下颜料，养它也意味着得付出不少心力。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME are popular pets among artists. Unfortunately, they tend to leave paint everywhere they go, making them a serious commitment.

entry: POKENAME进入系统后，会吞食绘画软件和图像文件中的数据。文件一旦被吃掉，几乎无法恢复。
author: .izik
source: Upon entering a system, POKENAME consumes data from art programs and image files. Once a file is devoured, recovery is nearly impossible.

entry: 虽然偏爱绿色，POKENAME也能将尾巴蘸水，再用翼上粉笔般的矿物突起，调出任何想象得到的水彩色调。十分忠诚的个体，甚至会让训练家用它的矿物画画。
author: ludacriswell
source: Although it favors green, POKENAME can dip their tail in water and use the chalk-like mineral protrusions on their wings to make any watercolor shade imaginable. A highly loyal POKENAME even allows its Trainer to use its minerals for painting.

entry: POKENAME很少有作画的灵感，会困在创作瓶颈中，在画室里打盹。吃树果时，它偶尔灵光一现；训练家发现，星桃果最能奏效。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rarely have the inspiration for creating artwork and nap in their studios suffering from art block. They gain moments of inspiration when consuming berries, and Trainers find the Starf Berry is most effective at this.

entry: POKENAME成群活动，彼此亲密，同步飞行时，身影会在空中组成迷人的图案。它们用尾巴画出奇怪的图画标记领地，看起来与飞行时组成的图案相似。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME fly in tight-knit flocks, their bodies creating a mesmerizing pattern in the sky as they fly in sync. These Pokémon use their tails to draw strange pictures to mark their territories, resembling the same patterns created when they fly.

entry: POKENAME翼上五彩斑斓的羽毛，能召来各种颜色的闪电。它召唤的雷雨绚丽得宛若奇观，既令人敬畏，也极具破坏力。
author: sk372
source: The multicolored plumage of POKENAME's wings summons forth lightning in a multitude of colors. The thunderstorms it summons are technicolor marvels as awe-inspiring as they are devastating.

entry: 许多艺术家会请POKENAME当助手，它总是热心地取来材料，协助创作。若向它征求意见，它会指着腹部的某种颜色，表示那最适合搭配尚未完成的作品。
author: sk372
source: Many artists have POKENAME as an assistant, always eager to fetch supplies and aid in artistry. If asked for advice, it points to the color on its stomach it feels would most complement the work-in-progress.

entry: 它的尾尖有一种奇异液体，从未有人在实验室成功复制。古老的传说称，液体洒到哪里，哪里就会诞生生命。
author: bostroms
source: Its tail is tipped with a strange fluid that has never been replicated in a lab.  There is an ancient legend that life will spring forth from wherever it spreads the fluid.

entry: 花朵之所以色彩鲜艳，是因为POKENAME辛勤地为每片花瓣上色。它的创造力没有边界，在它眼中，万物都是空白的画布。
author: greaterjagras
source: Flowers get their vibrant colors from a POKENAME working hard to paint every petal. Its creativity has no bounds as they see everything as a blank canvas.

entry: POKENAME把尾巴蘸向颈间的彩色花瓣，改变作画所用的颜色。它创作的作品中，有90%大量采用花卉意象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME dips its tail onto the colored petals around its neck to change the color it paints with. Ninety percent of the artwork POKENAME produces heavily feature floral imagery.

entry: 它背上火焰的颜色，来自吃下的植物所含的色素。研究颜料的化学家常把购入材料的少量样本混进它的食物，用来检验色素品质。
author: vic1312
source: The flames on its back derive their color from the pigments contained in the plants it consumes. Paint chemists often mix small samples of the materials they've bought into its food to verify the quality of the pigment.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，尾巴上的画笔会不停滴下各色颜料。有些艺术家用它创作抽象画，但大多数人只觉得它脏乱又麻烦。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's tail brush constantly drips paint in a variety of colours as it flies. Some artists use this to create abstract art pieces, however, most see it as a messy nuisance.

entry: POKENAME的画作近乎千篇一律，都是简单、风格化的宝可梦肖像。不过，它的作品仍卖给了许多艺术鉴赏家。
author: quackquackattack
source: The art that POKENAME creates borders on generic, consisting of simple, stylized portraits of Pokémon. Its work has nonetheless been sold to many art connoisseurs.

entry: POKENAME尾羽的黏液，能反映它的情绪。触碰黏液，就会陷入深沉且满是梦境的睡眠，可能持续数小时。
author: .izik
source: Mucus from POKENAME's tail feathers shows its emotional state. Touching it causes deep, dream-filled sleep that can last for hours.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴上的颜料给自己画斑点，随心改变大小和图样。但它经常把颜料弄得满身都是，不得不飞到河里洗干净。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses the paint from its tail to paint its own spots, changing their size and pattern to its liking. However, it will frequently get paint all over itself and have to fly over to the river to wash off.

entry: POKENAME鼓起的腹部绒毛，会滴下黏稠的墨汁。颜色会随毒性变化，绿色表示只会引起轻微皮疹。
author: .izik
source: Viscous ink drips from POKENAME's puffed out abdomen hairs. Its color shifts with the toxicity, with green meaning only a mild rash.

entry: POKENAME几乎总在追求名声与关注，创作出华美的艺术品。令人懊恼的是，这些作品一干，就会让人困倦得厉害。
author: lovelover75
source: POKENAME are almost always seeking fame and attention, creating magnificent works of art. However, these works induce extreme drowsiness in people once dry, much to their dismay.

entry: POKENAME头上羽毛流出的墨汁，会显露它最近的预见。受到极大惊吓时，它会在周围地面滴下深蓝色液体。
author: .izik
source: Ink from the feather on POKENAME's head reveals its latest vision. If terrified, it drips a dark blue fluid on the ground around itself.

entry: 成群的POKENAME会把自己全涂成绿色，躲在草丛中避开捕食者。危险离开后，它们又会互相上色，把彼此画成缤纷的拼贴画。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Flocks of POKENAME paint themselves completely green to hide in the grass from predators. When the threat leaves, they paint each other back into colorful collages.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛会散出粉末，在身后天空留下虹彩轨迹，因此常被误认成某只传说的宝可梦。
author: shocktopus1717
source: POKENAME's feathers release a powder that create a rainbow trail in the sky behind it. It is often confused with a certain legendary Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME通过尾巴闪烁的多色光芒交流。经过充分训练，它们能上演壮观的灯光秀。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME communicates through flashes of multicolored light from its tail. With enough training, they can put on spectacular light shows.

entry: POKENAME漂浮时，花朵会像轮盘一样旋转。朝东的那片花瓣，决定尾巴汁液的颜色。
author: .izik
source: As it floats, POKENAME's flower spins like a roulette. The petal facing east determines the color of the tail's sap.

entry: POKENAME画笔上的汁液，会呈现出最近吃下的三朵花的颜色。据说，若望着一只拥有三支金色画笔的个体许愿，就能获得巨大的财富。
author: .izik
source: The sap on POKENAME's paintbrushes reflects the last three flowers it ate. It is said if you make a wish while looking at one with 3 golden paint brushes, you will be blessed with great wealth.

entry: POKENAME热爱作画，米色毛发上常沾着颜料。它画的通常是奶酪、薄脆饼等寻常食物，但这并不妨碍艺术鉴赏家购买它的作品。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often have paint clinging to their beige fur because they love to make works of art. The subjects of their art typically include mundane food like cheese or crackers, but that does not stop art connoisseurs from buying their art.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴在树枝间荡来荡去，将颜料般的液体印成绿色手印，标记领地。遇到喜欢的人或宝可梦，它也会留下手印，象征彼此的友谊。
author: darkweavile428
source: To mark its territory, POKENAME uses its tail to swing from one tree branch to another, leaving behind green handprints from its paint-like fluid. When it likes someone, it will leave a handprint on the person or Pokémon, signifying their friendship.

entry: POKENAME住在十分寒冷的环境中，会把尾巴产生的凝胶涂在身上，隔绝寒意。它也会将凝胶喷向捕食者的脸，自我防卫。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME live in very cold environments and coat themselves in a gel that is produced from their tail that helps to insulate them against the cold. They also use it as a defence mechanism, squirting it in the face of predators.

entry: 每群POKENAME的尾羽末端，产生的液体颜色都略有不同。它们用这种液体标记领地，阻挡不熟悉的同类进入。
author: bobosmith01
source: Each flock of POKENAME produces a slightly different-colored fluid on the end of their tailfeathers. They use this fluid to mark their territory and keep out unfamiliar POKENAME.

entry: 所有POKENAME都拥有出色的记忆力，几乎能过目不忘。凭着这份天赋，它们能迅速学会并再现数百种独特画风。
author: bradlybro199
source: All POKENAME possess remarkable, near-photographic memories. They use this gift to quickly learn and replicate hundreds of unique art styles.

entry: POKENAME是举世闻名的艺术家，能专心完成精细而多样的作品。它们的沼泽家园转眼就能变成临时画展，作品也能以高价卖给艺术收藏家。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: POKENAME are world-renowned artists, having the capacity to concentrate and finish intricate and varied pieces of art. Their marshland homes can quickly become pop-up art exhibitions, and their work is sold to art collectors for high prices.

entry: POKENAME的花苞上长着柔韧而灵巧的藤蔓，笔刷般的尖端连最细小的图案也能描绘。这些尖端充满了由鲜艳花苞中生成的色素。
author: t3isukone
source: The flexible vines that grow from POKENAME's bulb are incredibly dexterous and it can detail even the smallest patterns with their brushlike tips. These tips are filled with the pigments that develop in its brightly colored bulb.

entry: 美术展上能见到POKENAME，白色的毛上还沾着颜料。它将食物画得惟妙惟肖，忠实再现原貌，受到某些艺术鉴赏家的喜爱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found at art exhibitions with paint still sticking to their blanche fur. They depict realistic food with high fidelity to the source material, which makes them popular among a certain brand of art connoisseurs.

entry: 它用黏土塑出诱饵，再以尾巴上色，借此研究附近猎手的攻击方式与捕猎习惯。
author: staghorn
source: It creates decoys out of clay that it paints with its tail. It uses them to study the attacks and hunting patterns of the area's predators.

entry: POKENAME体内会产生天然油脂，与水混合就能形成彩色颜料。它用这些颜料在岩石和树木上留下标记，与同类交流。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME produce a natural oil from their bodies that, when mixed with water, creates colourful pigments. They use these pigments to communicate with one another, leaving markings on rocks and trees for other POKENAME to see.

entry: POKENAME会把颜料泼在附近的树和岩石上，标记领地。虽然它对同类的领地意识很强，却十分受小孩子欢迎。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME marks its territory by splashing its paint on nearby trees and rocks. Despite being territorial towards other POKENAME, it is quite the popular Pokémon amongst young children.

entry: POKENAME偶尔会游近港口城镇的水面，用尾巴流出的防水液体，在旧码头上涂鸦。它全身有毒，还长着尖刺，大多数潜在的捕食者都会避开它。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME, on rare occasion, comes close to the surface of port towns to doodle on old piers with the water-resistant fluid that leaks from its tail. Its body is poisonous and has sharp barbs, causing most potential predators to ignore it.

entry: POKENAME会在壳内慢慢酝酿浓稠的彩色膏体。艺术家可以小心提取膏体，制作高级帽子染色套装。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME slowly brews thick, colorful paste inside its shell. Artists can carefully extract the paste to create a premium Hat Dye Kit.

entry: POKENAME有时会用画笔般的角蘸树液作画，而且似乎偏爱品质上乘的树液。
author: incognito1234
source: Sometimes, POKENAME uses tree sap to paint with its paintbrush-like horn. It seems to prefer higher-quality saps.

entry: POKENAME会在火车车厢上绘制大幅壁画，好让尽可能多的人看到作品。有些人欢迎这些叛逆的壁画，认为它们为城市增添了色彩。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME paint large murals on train carriages to maximize the visibility of their art. Some people have welcomed these rebellious murals as a way to bring color into their city.

entry: POKENAME十分调皮，常被撞见在阿罗拉的城镇里用颜料乱涂乱画。它似乎与当地的不良少年很投缘，往往和这些少年一起四处捣乱。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are very mischievous, often caught vandalizing towns in Alola with their paint. They seem to have a bond with the delinquents there, as they're more often than not creating chaos with the local teenagers.

entry: POKENAME十分调皮，常被撞见在枯叶市这样的港口城镇里用颜料乱涂乱画。有报告称它会伪装成人类，但尚无确凿证据。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are very mischievous, often caught vandalizing port towns like Vermillion City with their paint. Some reports describe POKENAME disguising themselves as humans, but no concrete evidence exists to prove this.

entry: POKENAME将画笔般的尾尖探进三蜜蜂的巢里，再开开心心地舔食尾尖吸饱的蜂蜜。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME pokes the end of its brushlike tail into Combee hives, then happily licks the soaked-up honey from the tail tip.

entry: POKENAME把尾巴伸进三蜜蜂的巢里，蘸取蜂蜜。它还会用蜂蜜在树上涂出记号，标记领地。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME acquires honey by dipping its tail into Combee hives. It also uses the honey to mark its territory, painting marks onto trees.

entry: 人们将POKENAME放上画布，任它四处奔跑，再把画成的作品展示给POKENAME看，它就会十分开心。
author: dodoowner_
source: People place POKENAME on a canvas and let it run around. After a while, they show the painting POKENAME has made to it, which makes it feel happy.

entry: POKENAME的身体由黏稠的液态颜料构成，移动时会留下一道颜色。每个个体留下的颜色都独一无二。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The bodies of POKENAME are made up of a viscous, liquid pigment. They leave a trail of colour behind themselves as they move and each POKENAME has its own unique colour it leaves behind it.

entry: POKENAME的身体由黏稠的液态颜料构成，移动时会留下一道颜色。极少数时候，它们的身体会产生多种颜色。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The bodies of POKENAME are made up of a viscous, liquid pigment. They leave a trail of colour behind themselves as they move and, rarely, they will produce multiple colours from their bodies.

entry: POKENAME的身体由黏稠的液态颜料构成，移动时会留下一道颜色。不过，少数个体天生没有自己的颜色，会寻找矿物制成颜料，用来作画。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The bodies of POKENAME are made up of a viscous, liquid pigment. They leave a trail of colour behind themselves as they move though, rarely, some produce no natural colouring of their own, instead seeking out minerals to make pigment to paint with.

entry: POKENAME很受艺术家欢迎，乐意让画家用自己身体的颜料创作。丰富多彩的食物能让它茁壮成长，它偏爱富含人工色素的食物，好将色素融入身体。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular amongst artists, happily allowing painters to use the pigments from their body in their work. They thrive on colourful diets, preferring foods rich in artificial dyes that they can incorporate into their bodies.

entry: POKENAME用自己温热、黏稠的身体作画。要换颜色，就必须缩进形状古怪的壳里，但具体过程尚不清楚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME paints its pictures using its own warm, viscous body. It has to retreat into its strangely shaped shell in order to change colors, though how the process works exactly is unknown.

entry: POKENAME很受艺术家欢迎，乐意让画家用自己身体的颜料创作。需要睡觉时，它会缩回管内，扭动身体，将盖子拧紧，安全地封在里面。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular amongst artists, happily allowing painters to use the pigments from their body in their work. They retreat into their tube when they need to sleep, twisting so that their cap seals them safely inside.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，会用尾巴的彩色黏液标记领地。颜色随心情变化，生气时会变成深红色。
author: .izik
source: As it flies, POKENAME marks territory with colored mucus from its tail. The color changes based on its mood, with it turning crimson when angry.

entry: POKENAME会将刺尖的液体涂在栖身的珊瑚礁上，为逐渐失去光彩的珊瑚恢复颜色。这种液体确实有再生功效，能随时间治愈病弱的珊瑚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME smears the fluid at the end of its spines on the coral reefs it calls home, restoring color to coral bits that are becoming dull. The fluid actually has a regenerative effect that heals ailing coral over time.

entry: POKENAME的每条触手，都会产生一种不同颜色的液体。火箭队等犯罪团伙曾利用它，制作几可乱真的名画赝品。
author: mepp.
source: Each one of POKENAME's tentacles produces a different colored fluid. Criminal groups like Team Rocket have been known to use POKENAME to create near perfect forgeries of famous artistic works.

entry: POKENAME会嬉戏般甩动长鼻，将彩色液体洒得到处都是。它虽然身形小巧，力气却很大。
author: the_fireplace
source: POKENAME swings its long snout around playfully, sending drops of colorful fluid everywhere. It is strong despite its compact size.

entry: POKENAME鼻中液体的色调，会随情绪改变。它想亲热地在伙伴身上留下脚印，却可能弄断骨头。
author: the_fireplace
source: The fluid from POKENAME's nose changes in hue with its emotions. It may break bones affectionately trying to leave footprints on its comrades.

entry: POKENAME擅长超写实绘画，常把危险的宝可梦画在显眼的中心位置。可画得太逼真，完成后反而会把自己吓到。
author: thesilverowls
source: POKENAME excels at making hyperrealist art, usually with more dangerous Pokémon front and center. However, since its art is so realistic, it will be frightened by the piece after finishing it.

entry: POKENAME会用画作，表达对训练家的喜爱与亲近。作品受到夸奖时，它便高兴地摇动闪闪发亮的尾巴。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME expresses love and affection for its Trainer through its drawings. It happily wags its glittery tail when its art is praised.

entry: POKENAME能产出各种颜色的奶。虽然喝起来与普通牛奶无异，却仍极受孩子们欢迎。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME is able to produce milk in a variety of colors.  While it tastes no different from regular milk, it is still wildly popular among children.

entry: 它能用尾巴净化水域，让其中死去的鱼复活。据说雨后出现的彩虹，也出自POKENAME之手。
author: patch_bros
source: It can use its tails to purify bodies of water, reviving any dead fish within. It is said POKENAME is responsible for rainbows seen after a rainy day.

entry: POKENAME热爱创作，作品很受收藏家追捧。然而，许多艺术评论家都想不明白，为什么它的画如此受欢迎。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves to make art, and its pieces are quite sought after by collectors. However, many art critics are confounded as to why its art is so popular.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛拥有绚烂的彩虹色。它飞到哪里，哪里就会留下一道彩虹。许多人曾沿着彩虹的路径，寻找这种宝可梦。
author: rymyll_the_wanderer
source: POKENAME's plumage consists of myriad rainbow colors. Wherever POKENAME flies, it leaves behind a rainbow in its wake. Many have tried to follow the path of a rainbow seeking this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME无法控制自己的尾巴，尾巴总是胡乱甩动，将颜料溅得到处都是。有些人认为，这些泼溅的色块是混乱中的杰作。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME lacks the ability to control its tail, which flails wildly. This sprays paint everywhere, and some consider the resulting splatters to be masterpieces of chaos.

entry: POKENAME在制帽师与旅人之间声名狼藉。它会趁夜偷走觉得好看的帽子，遇到不喜欢的帽子，就朝上面吐满颜料，肆意破坏。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME are infamous among milliners and travelers. Under the cover of night, they steal hats they think are appealing, or vandalize hats they dislike by spitting paint all over them.

entry: POKENAME虽很少现身野外，如今世上87%的食物画，实际上却都是它的作品。
author: rooboid
source: Despite being rarely seen in the wild, POKENAME is actually responsible for 87% of food paintings that exist today.

entry: POKENAME厚实的皮毛十分适合寒冷气候，能保持身体温暖。它们喜欢堆雪人，还常比赛谁堆得最高。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's thick coats of fur are perfectly suited for the cold, keeping their bodies warm. These Pokémon enjoy building snowmen, often competing to see whose is the tallest.

entry: POKENAME能把自己上传到电脑和移动设备里，喜欢操作绘画软件。但要小心——它也会损坏文件，删除画作。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME can upload itself onto computers and mobile devices. It likes to interact with drawing programs, but beware - it's known to corrupt files and delete artwork.

entry: POKENAME创作时，素以追求完美、注重细节著称。不过，这也让它常因觉得作品不够好，而狠狠一脚毁掉自己的画。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is known for its perfectionism and eye for detail when it creates artwork. However, this leads it to often destroy its own work that it deems as subpar with a brutal kick.

entry: POKENAME把尾巴轻点在下半身的某些部位，就能改变尾上液体的颜色。它常创作美丽的风景画，作为礼物送给训练家。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can change the color of the liquid on its tail by dabbing it on certain parts of its lower body. It often creates beautiful landscape paintings to present to its Trainer as a gift.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间都在用尾巴的液体练习书法，借此磨炼艺术技巧，也锻炼心性的专注与自律。
author: skelecat42
source: POKENAME spend most of their time using the fluid from their tails to practice calligraphy. They do this in order to hone not only their artistic skills, but their mental discipline as well.

entry: 窥视它的背部，就会看见永无休止的战斗幻象。POKENAME自己往往是幻象中的主角，独自打倒远比自己强大的敌人。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Peering into its back shows visions of never ending battles. Often, POKENAME itself stars in these vision, taking down much stronger foes by itself.

entry: POKENAME会创作印章般的小巧图案，印在重要文件与证照上。邪恶组织会绑架它，强迫它协助伪造文件。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce small works of art in the form of stamps that end up on important documents and licenses. Villainous organizations are known to kidnap POKENAME to force them to help produce forged documents.

entry: POKENAME连作画时也不肯放开尾巴，结果经常把自己的颜料抹得满脸都是。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME refuses to let go of its tail, even while painting. As a result, it often gets its own paint smeared across its face.

entry: 构成POKENAME的每个灵魂，都会显现为一团颜色。它生气或焦躁时，不同的色彩会翻涌流动，变幻出种种形态。
author: bostroms
source: Each individual spirit that makes up POKENAME manifests as a blob of color.  When it is angry or agitated, the different colors will writhe and flow in a variety of formations.

entry: POKENAME能从头顶的触手分泌八种不同的色素，再将其混合，调出任何想在画作中使用的颜色。
author: fancyskunk
source: POKENAME secretes eight distinct pigments from the tentacles atop its head. It is able to blend these pigments to create any color it wishes to use in its paintings.

entry: POKENAME对自己的艺术创作要求极严。只要觉得作品有哪怕一个关键缺陷，就会因懊恼而使出强力的头槌，将其砸毁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very self-critical of its artistic endeavors. If it views an art piece it creates and deems it to have even a single crucial flaw, it smashes it with a mighty headbutt out of frustration.

entry: POKENAME用爪子把树果、宝石等材料碾成色粉，再混入自己的唾液，制成颜料。它把额头当作调色板混色，并用各种画作标记领地。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME uses its paws to crush berries, precious stones, and other materials into pigments then mixes them with its own saliva to create paint. It uses its forehead as a palette for mixing colors and marks its territory with various paintings.

entry: 大多数人看POKENAME的画，只觉得它偷懒；但有些艺术鉴定者坚称，这种敷衍背后有独特的含义与深层象征。
author: sk372
source: While most look at POKENAME's artwork and see laziness, some art appraisers swear that there is a unique meaning and deeper symbolism behind the lack of effort.

entry: POKENAME让躯干圆环上的色块浮起，再泼向物体表面，几秒内就能完成美丽的作品。有些人相信，只要它愿意，就能让自己的一切艺术创作活过来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME levitates bits of color sourced from the ring on its torso, splattering them against surfaces to make works of beautiful art in seconds. Some believe that if it wished, it could bring any of its artistic creations to life.

entry: 这种宝可梦虽然看起来友善，领地意识却可能很强。它们以小家庭为群生活，容不得其他同类进入领地。
author: pix3l_655
source: Despite this Pokémon's friendly appearance, it can be very territorial. They live in small family groups, and don't tolerate others of their kind entering their territory.

entry: POKENAME爱把荒漠的沙子染成各色，铺成沙画。某些基金会，还会专门保护POKENAME的作品。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME love to create sand paintings by dyeing the desert sand different colors. Art pieces made by POKENAME are consider protected by certain foundations.

entry: 爱解谜的训练家，往往会带一只POKENAME在队里陪玩。如果发现训练家被难住，它就会趁对方没看见，给自己的方块上色。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Puzzle-oriented Trainers tend to have a POKENAME in their party to play with. If they notice their Trainers are stumped, POKENAME will paint their squares when their Trainer isn't looking.

entry: POKENAME的触须会不断产生彩色液体。这些液体被收集、加工成鲜艳的染料，主要用于地毯制造业。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's feelers constantly produce colorful fluids. These fluids are collected and processed into a vibrant dye primarily used in the carpet manufacturing industry.

entry: 天空是POKENAME的家，也是它的画布。它在空中移动、塑形、涂染云朵，创作出宏大的作品，给予地上众人灵感。
author: sk372
source: The sky is POKENAME's home, and its canvas. It moves, shapes and paints the clouds in the air into massive works of art that inspire the masses below.

entry: 曾有POKENAME边跳舞边画画的记录。它用灵活的关节模仿霹雳舞，跳得颜料四处飞溅。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME have been documented dancing as they paint. Using their articulated joints they have replicated breakdancing, flinging their paint everywhere in the process.

entry: POKENAME尾巴里储存着多色液体，能随心让其从尾尖渗出。作画时，它是个完美主义者，缓慢而细致，努力创造自己心中的理想作品。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's tail stores a multicolored fluid which can voluntarily ooze from its tip. When it comes to painting, POKENAME is a perfectionist; slow and meticulous, it tries to create pieces of art it considers ideal.

entry: POKENAME能随意从身体射出彩色的冰冷能量束。被击中的东西会冻进冰中，冰的颜色与光束相同。
author: sk372
source: Colorful, freezing beams of energy can be fired from POKENAME's body at will. Anything struck by them will be frozen in ice that matches the color of the beam.

entry: 野生POKENAME会把花蜜当颜料，标记领地。它也因帮助长者和其他记忆力不佳的人而闻名，会用自己的本领，为他们制作重要的提醒。
author: mepp.
source: In the wild, POKENAME uses its nectar as paint to mark its territory. It has developed a reputation in aiding the elderly and others who struggle with their memory, using its skills to create important reminders for them.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴分泌的、充满孢子的膏状物标记领地。留在树上的记号，会长成一簇簇形状古怪、颜色鲜艳的蘑菇。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME marks its territory with a spore-filled paste from its tail. The markings it leaves on trees grow into oddly-shaped clusters of brightly-colored mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME在空中迅捷而隐秘，会飞快地在大地上作画，再疾驰离去。人们认为，这些画是用来与同类交流的标记。
author: sk372
source: Speedy and stealthy while airborne, POKENAME quickly draws art across the landscape before darting away. It's believed these markings are meant to serve as communicative markers to others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME背上的调色板越长越大，可用的颜色也随之增加。有记录以来最大的调色板，在缩小前曾有20多种不同颜色。
author: soup1900
source: As the palette on POKENAME's back grows, so does the array of colors available there. The world record for largest palette that a POKENAME had before downsizing it had over 20 different colors.

entry: POKENAME用身上长出的调色板绘制符号。要是没有画布，它就改画在别人家的墙壁和地板上，破坏人家的财物。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME paints symbols by using the palette that grows on its body. If it doesn't have a canvas to paint on, it resorts to painting on people's walls and floors and vandalizing their property.

entry: POKENAME用身上长出的彩色毛线团创作。它常占用别人的家，把线牵到各面墙上，弄得一团纠缠，事后还得屋主清理。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME creates its art using the balls of colored yarn that grow on its body. It often overtakes people's homes for its creations, attaching strings across many different walls that cause a tangled mess for the homeowner to clean up afterwards.

entry: POKENAME栖身的浅海，海水呈彩虹色，很容易辨认。它们很少被扔出领地，因为一被碰到，就会立刻渗出洗不掉的液体。
author: soup1900
source: The shallow seas where POKENAME reside are easily recognized by their rainbow-colored waters. They are rarely chucked off of their territories since they'll immediately start oozing their non-washable fluids the moment they are touched.

entry: POKENAME栖身的浅海，海水五颜六色，很容易辨认。它们很少被扔出领地，因为一被碰到，就会立刻渗出洗不掉的液体。
author: soup1900
source: The shallow seas where POKENAME reside are easily recognized by their multicolored waters. They are rarely chucked off of their territories since they'll immediately start oozing their non-washable fluids the moment they are touched.

entry: 每当发现喜欢的颜料，POKENAME就会将其加入调色板。每个个体都有自己独特的颜色收藏。
author: bee4082
source: Whenever it finds a pigment it likes, POKENAME will add it to its palette. Each POKENAME has its own unique collection of colors.

entry: 它用尾巴上颜料般的液体装点伪装的外衣。POKENAME通常扮成图图犬，但有时也会制作别的装束，适应不同的场合。
author: hophoppip
source: It uses the paint-like fluid from its tail to decorate its disguises. POKENAME usually dresses like a Smeargle, but it sometimes creates alternate costumes to fit different situations.

entry: POKENAME能完美复制任何艺术品。这项独特的本领，让艺术品市场陷入了金融危机。不过，它们似乎十分执着于宝可元，报酬不合适就不肯开工。
author: krogens
source: POKENAME are able to replicate any art perfectly. Such a unique ability has created a financial crisis within the fine art market. These Pokémon have exhibited a fixation with Pokédollars, however, and won't work without appropriate compensation.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴会产生彩色颜料，走到哪里就滴到哪里。它走路时常把尾巴拖在地上，在身后留下一道道彩虹。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME produce colorful paint from their tails, which drips wherever they go. They often drag their tails along the ground as they walk, creating rainbows behind them.

entry: POKENAME吃下不同的树果，各条尾巴就会分泌不同颜色的颜料。它宛如天然的调色板，因此被画家饲养。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME secrete various colors of paint from their tails due to the different berries they eat. These Pokémon act as natural palettes, being kept by painters for this reason.

entry: POKENAME会在树木、植物和岩石上画出独特图案，标记领地。领地争端则通过涂鸦对决解决。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The territory of a POKENAME is marked by unique patterns painted on trees, plants and rocks. Disputes over these territories are settled through graffiti battles.

entry: 饲养POKENAME的训练家得勤加照看，因为它们容易把够得着的地方全涂个遍。在墙上乱画一通后，它还会退后几步，为自己的作品笑得满脸自豪。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Trainers of POKENAME must be diligent, as they are prone to defacing every surface within reach. After scribbling on the walls, POKENAME step back and beam with pride at their work.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在刚画好或刷好漆的表面打盹。若附近有它在找地方睡觉，新刷的公园长椅和刚完成的肖像画，往往很快就会被蹭花。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME loves to nap on freshly painted surfaces. Newly painted park benches and portraits are often soon smudged when one is nearby looking for a nap.

entry: POKENAME的创作毫无章法，各种画风混杂，几乎一片混乱。作品内容难以理解，艺术家们因此争论起画作的含义。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has no rhyme nor reason to the art it creates; the jumble of art styles borders on anarchy. Since the content is difficult to understand, artists debate the meaning of the paintings it makes.

entry: POKENAME只用右爪分泌的蓝色色素作画。它的星形尾巴能产生绿色颜料，便以一颗绿星为作品署名。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME only paints using the blue pigment secreted from its right paw. It signs its work with a green star, using its star-shaped tail that produces green paint.

entry: POKENAME对自己的作品十分自豪，画作若遭破坏，它就会大发脾气。它的颜料极耐水，工匠因此常请它给陶器上色。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is very proud of its artwork and will throw a tantrum if its art is ruined. Artisans often use POKENAME to paint their pottery as its paint is highly resistant to water.

entry: POKENAME喜欢用记号笔在自己脸上画画。到了晚上，它们会挨家挨户，给睡着的人脸上也画上几笔。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME love to draw on their faces with their markers. During the night, they will go from house to house, drawing on the faces of those who are asleep.

entry: 两种颜色，分别由POKENAME的两个半脑控制。双方若能合作，薄膜般的身体便转为深紫，超能力也随之增强。
author: teatedtiten
source: The two colors are controlled by POKENAME's two halves of its brain.  If its two halves can cooperate, its membrane-like body turns into a deep purple, heightening its psychic abilities.

entry: POKENAME出没于城市小巷。它们天生渴望创作艺术，结果往往在周围留下大量不受欢迎的涂鸦。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME are found within city alleys. They have an innate desire to create art, usually resulting in a ton of unwanted graffiti around.

entry: POKENAME用身体分泌的颜料，为训练家作画。大多只是简单的手指画，但随着进化，它的技艺会越来越好。
author: huh.7
source: POKENAME uses the paint that it secretes from its body to make art for its trainer. Most of its art is basic finger painting, but it gets more talented as it evolves.

entry: POKENAME出没于古代遗迹，用尾巴在石墙上画奇怪的符号。科学家不清楚这些符号是否有所含义，还是它单纯在展现艺术天分。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be found in ancient ruins, drawing strange symbols on the stone walls with its tail. Scientists don't know if the symbols mean anything or are just POKENAME expressing its artistic talent.

entry: POKENAME会给翼上的白羽毛上色，绘出自己的图案。它很少长久保持同一种设计，每周都会更换。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME paints the white feathers on its wings to create custom patterns. It rarely keeps the same design for long and changes it weekly.

entry: POKENAME总有丰富的颜色可用，因为它走到哪里，都带着巨大的调色板。画出的图案，完全取决于当天吃过什么。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME always has a multitude of colors to paint with due to it always carrying a giant palette everywhere it goes. The patterns it paints depend entirely on the types of food it ate that day.

entry: POKENAME高速滚动时，会把身体渗出的颜料般的黏液沿地铺开，创作兼作领地标记的画作。黏液未干时酸性很强，又有毒，清理起来十分困难。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rolls at high speeds, spearing a paint-like mucus its body leaks across the ground to make artwork that doubles as territorial markers. When wet, the slime is highly acidic and toxic, so cleaning it off is a difficult process.

entry: 太阳刚升起，POKENAME就开始压碎树果，调制颜料。若调出不喜欢的颜色，它便大发脾气，胡乱作画；这些乱糟糟的作品，却很受收藏家追捧。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME mixes paint by squashing berries as soon as the sun begins to rise. If the paint becomes a color it does not like, it throws a horrible tantrum and creates messy pieces of art, which are highly sought by collectors.

entry: POKENAME作画时会狂热地四处挥洒，绘成大幅壁画。爱好者会设法在它覆盖重画前，将作品保存下来。食物会影响它口中流出的颜料，因此它常住在树果种类丰富的林地附近。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME rampages in a painting frenzy, creating expansive murals that enthusiasts attempt to preserve before it paints over the artwork. Its diet affects the paint that flows from its jaws, so it can often be found living near diverse Berry groves.

entry: POKENAME把尾巴蘸墨作画，画的通常是见过的俊男美女。据说，让它画了肖像，它就能偷走你的灵魂。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME dips its tail in ink to paint pictures, usually depicting particularly handsome or beautiful humans it has seen. It is said that having your portrait drawn by POKENAME enables it to steal your soul.

entry: POKENAME的叶片被摘下后，会以随机的颜色重新长出。有些训练家把它叶片的颜色，看作未来的预兆。
author: hophoppip
source: When one of POKENAME's leaves is plucked, it grows back in a random color. Some Trainers take the colors of their POKENAME's leaves as omens of the future.

entry: POKENAME用废料制作怪诞的艺术品。作品按通常眼光看来丑陋，却颇有艺术趣味，会卖给品味古怪的艺术鉴赏家。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce grotesque works of art out of scrap materials. Their conventionally ugly but artistically interesting works are sold to eccentric art connoisseurs.

entry: 它最爱吃画材，也曾吞食已经完成的图画。有些爱画画的训练家，为此吃过苦头。
author: hophoppip
source: Its preferred diet is art supplies. It's also been known to consume completed drawings and paintings, as some artistic Trainers have discovered the hard way.

entry: POKENAME尾巴流出的液体，散发着类似臭鸡蛋的恶臭。连著名的毒属性专家，都表示受不了这种气味。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: The fluid that leaks from POKENAME's tail emits a foul odor that smells similar to rotten eggs. Even famous Poison-type specialists claim that they can't stand the stench.

entry: POKENAME喜欢藏在草木间，观察附近的走路草。不幸的是，许多鸟宝可梦会将它的花苞误认成野生树果，常常把走路草吓跑。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: POKENAME enjoy hiding in foliage to observe nearby Oddish. Unfortunately, many bird Pokémon mistake its bulbs for wild berries, often scaring away the Oddish.

entry: 满是涂鸦的城镇，很可能被POKENAME造访过。它会把不喜欢的东西全涂盖住，但究竟是什么惹它不高兴，人们尚不清楚。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Towns covered in graffiti have most likely been visited by POKENAME. They will paint over anything they don't like, but what exactly makes POKENAME upset is unclear.

entry: 它走到哪里，都会留下一道颜色鲜艳的黏液。黏液遇雨就会被冲走，因此这可能是POKENAME在晴天为同伴画出的避难路线。
author: hophoppip
source: It leaves behind a trail of brightly colored slime wherever it goes. The slime washes away in rain, so it may be a way for POKENAME to paint a path to shelter for its brethren on sunny days.

entry: POKENAME分泌的鲜艳黏液，沿途留下一道痕迹，黑暗中还会发光，因此很容易追踪。不过，黏液的味道很糟，捕食者通常不会来打扰。
author: santon5512
source: The brightly colored slime POKENAME secretes leaves a trail behind them wherever they go, even glowing in the dark. These trails make them quite easy to track, though the foul taste of this slime usually causes predators to leave them be.

entry: POKENAME会洗劫商店的颜料，将其吸收进画笔般的双臂与调色板般的两侧。它用偷来的颜料，在画布般的头上画出力量的符号，希望解锁变成更强形态的能力。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME ransack stores of their paints and absorb them into their paintbrush arms and palette sides. Using all this stolen paint, they draw symbols of strength on their canvas heads in hopes of unlocking the power to transform into a mightier form.

entry: POKENAME独自给身边的沙子上色，绘成小幅壁画。颜料能驱赶当地那些想啄它的鸟宝可梦。
author: skleegamer
source: POKENAME spends its time alone coloring the sand around its body, creating mini murals. This paint wards off local bird Pokémon trying to peck at it.

entry: POKENAME用背上的笔尖绘画，尖端渗出的液体，就是很好的颜料。
author: glacierwing
source: POKENAME uses the brush tips on its back to create marks. The fluid leaking from them makes a good paint.

entry: 全球气温上升，让POKENAME流汗，滴下多种颜色的颜料，汇成一大滩。这些颜料十分凉爽，它便开心地在里面扑腾，溅得满身都是。
author: soup1900
source: As POKENAME sweats due to the rising global temperatures, it drips a multitude of paint colors in a large puddle. As this paint is very cool, it playfully splashes in it, which splatters paint all over its body.

entry: 照顾POKENAME相当费心，因为它喜欢用许多彩色爪印装点领地。颜料虽然无毒，却极难洗掉，沾在衣服上尤其麻烦。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is quite the hassle to look after, as it loves to decorate its territory with lots of painted paw prints. The paint isn't toxic, but is extremely difficult to wash off, especially from clothing.

entry: POKENAME用鲜艳的深红色液体涂染战场，标记领地，随后让自己陷入野性的狂乱。它咧嘴狂笑，挑衅敌人，用杂乱的画笔斩击，切开挡路的一切。
author: msdawgs
