entry: POKENAME在体内储存静电，移动时会噼啪放出。跳舞能让它迅速积蓄电力，跟着节奏跳得越久，攻击就越强。
author: ilija09
source: POKENAME stores static charge within its body, releasing crackling bursts as it moves. When it dances, it rapidly builds electricity, and the longer it keeps rhythm, the more powerful its attacks become.

entry: POKENAME在陆地扑腾，积蓄电荷。可一回到水中，它就会立刻放光电力，因此人们不明白它为何这样做。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME flails about on land to build up an electrical charge. It discharges this energy as soon as it returns to the water, so it is unclear why it does this.

entry: POKENAME体内不断产生电力与热量，摸起来暖暖的。梳毛后，它抖动毛发，就会抖落细小的电火花与火星。
author: sk372
source: Internally, POKENAME constantly generates a mixture of electricity and heat, leaving it warm to the touch. When it shakes its fur after grooming, tiny sparks and embers flake off.

entry: POKENAME完全结茧后，就会头朝下落到森林地面。头上插头般的器官从土中汲取能量，让电流流遍茧壳，吓退捕食者。
author: sk372
source: Once POKENAME has cocooned itself completely, it falls to the forest floor head first. The plug-like organs on its head draw energy from the soil to fuel electricity coursing across its cocoon that deters predators.

entry: POKENAME把尾巴插进插座，尽可能吸满体内能储存的电。遇到精疲力尽的电属性宝可梦，它会使出电击，帮对方充电。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME sticks its tail into electrical outlets to absorb as much electricity as its body can store. If it encounters an exhausted Electric-type Pokémon, it uses Thunder Shock to help it recharge.

entry: POKENAME将电力储存在尾巴中。遇险时便把尾巴猛砸地面，释放电流。
author: holzycookie
source: It stores electricity in its tail. If ever in danger, POKENAME will slam its tail onto the ground to let out an electrical discharge.

entry: POKENAME能将头转动360度，借此发电。它在羽毛间产生电弧，从空中射向猎物。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are capable of spinning their heads 360 degrees, doing so to generate electricity. They create arcs of electricity within their feathers to fire them at prey from the skies.

entry: 它拍动翅膀时，会向空中释放阵阵静电，发出噼啪声，吓退附近的捕食者。
author: .izik
source: As it flaps its wings, it releases bursts of static into the air. This creates a crackling sound that deters nearby predators.

entry: 它晃动耳朵，产生静电。这举动既好玩，也能为小型攻击充能。
author: .izik
source: It wiggles its ears to generate static electricity. This motion is both playful and useful for charging small attacks.

entry: 它会翻找废弃的电子产品，带回巢里吃掉。这个习惯，让它保持精力充沛，心满意足。
author: .izik
source: It scavenges discarded electronics, taking them back to its nest to consume. This habit keeps it energized and content.

entry: 它充电时，蛋形的身体会来回摇摆，发出轻柔的嗡鸣，让周围的生灵安静下来。
author: .izik
source: Its egg-like body rocks back and forth while charging electricity. This movement generates a soft hum that calms those around it.

entry: POKENAME啃咬电线与电子元件，摄取其中的电力。受到惊吓时，它会不由自主地放光储存的能量，再飞快逃走。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME gnaw on wires and electrical components, feeding off the electricity. When startled, they involuntarily discharge all of their stored energy before quickly fleeing.

entry: POKENAME把尾巴插进机器，抽取电力。小巧的身形与敏捷的动作，让它能悄悄溜进工厂，常在里面藏上数年。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME plug their tails into machinery, siphoning electricity from it. Their small stature and agile movements let them slip inside factories unnoticed, often hiding out inside for years.

entry: POKENAME出生时只有两条肢体，接触的电越多，肢体就长得越多。有报告称，见过长着8条肢体的个体，会用多出的肢体在战斗中迷惑对手。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is born with only two limbs, but the more electricity they are exposed to, the more they grow. There are reports of POKENAME with 8 limbs that use the extras to confuse opponents in battle.

entry: POKENAME出生时只有两条肢体，接触的电越多，肢体就长得越多。曾有人见过长着8条肢体的个体，用这些肢体帮训练家搬重物。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is born with only two limbs, but the more electricity they are exposed to, the more they grow. Some POKENAME have been seen with 8 limbs, which they use to help their Trainers carry heavy objects.

entry: POKENAME背上的叶片，能让它更有效地把阳光转成电力，但叶片的导电性也很强。因此，每年冬天脱落的叶片，很适合用作电气元件。
author: elekboy88
source: The leaves on POKENAME's back allow it to better convert sunlight into electricity, but they are highly conductive. This conductivity makes them useful for electrical components when it sheds every winter.

entry: POKENAME常先偷吃屋主食品柜中的食物，再用头上的两个插脚接上电源偷电。充满后，它就尽量多搬些食物，带回去给同族。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME plugs the two prongs on its head to steal electricity, often after stealing food from the homeowner's pantry. Once recharged, it tries to carry out as much food as it can for its kin.

entry: POKENAME诞生于电力被发现之前。它身上的符号，竟仿佛预示了现代的电气标记。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME originates from a time before electricity was discovered. Its symbology seems to have been a prediction of modern electrical symbols.

entry: 雷雨时，它会爬到树顶，吸收闪电，让电力完全充满。
author: .izik
source: It climbs to the tops of trees during thunderstorms to absorb lightning. This behavior charges it to full power.

entry: 被当作宠物时，POKENAME可能变得娇惯又黏人。觉得关注不够，它就会大声吠叫，胡乱挥动四肢，头上的插脚还不断迸出电火花与闪电。
author: sk372
source: As a pet, POKENAME can get very spoiled and needy. When it feels it hasn't gotten enough attention, it barks loudly while flailing its limbs and shedding sparks and lightning from the prongs on its head.

entry: POKENAME把插脚的电引入利爪，增强战斗力。不过，它的能量一次只够让一只爪子带电。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME channels electricity from its prong into its claws to make them more effective in a fight. It only has enough energy to electrify one of its claws at a time, however.

entry: POKENAME用长喙吸收从天而降的雷电能量。它常在发电厂筑巢，谁靠得太近，就会遭到攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its long beak to absorb the energy of lightning bolts striking from the sky. It attacks those who get too close to the power plants where it tends to nest.

entry: 储存的电能越多，它的角就越温暖。散发出的热量，能帮助它熬过暴风雪。
author: .izik
source: Its horns grow warmer as it stores more electrical energy. This warmth helps it survive blizzards by radiating heat.

entry: POKENAME鲜黄色的花纹十分显眼。即便如此，捕食者仍会避开，因为花纹意味着危险的电力。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's bright yellow pattern makes it highly visible. Despite this, predators stay away, seeing the pattern as an indicator of dangerous electrical power.

entry: POKENAME能产生使人麻痹的毒液。它会吞下尾巴，再四处翻滚，为自己充电。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME produces a poison with paralyzing properties. It recharges itself by swallowing its tail and rolling around.

entry: POKENAME潜入设备，吸取电力来补充自己。可头部又不断放电，持续给设备充能，结果把自己困在无尽循环中。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME infiltrate devices to sap electricity and fuel themselves. However, they constantly discharge this electricity from their heads, continuously recharging the device and trapping themselves in an endless loop.

entry: POKENAME通过俯卧撑、臂屈伸，以及强力的拉伸、伸展等日常练习锻炼双臂。人们认为，它额外着重锻炼哪组肌肉，会决定将来进化成什么。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME works out its arms through routine exercise, such as push ups, dips, and intense stretches and extensions. It's thought that whatever secondary set of muscles POKENAME works out the most will determine what it evolves into.

entry: 它用静电频繁改变发型。这个古怪习惯，让它的模样总有新意，难以预测。
author: .izik
source: It uses static electricity to change its hairstyle frequently. This quirky habit keeps its look fresh and unpredictable.

entry: 它一边胡乱挥动双臂，一边接连吐火。电力与火焰结合，让它成了难以捉摸的斗士。
author: .izik
source: It swings its arms wildly while spitting bursts of fire. The combination of electricity and flames makes it an unpredictable fighter.

entry: POKENAME在袋中带着电池，用旋转双臂产生的电力充电。它很喜欢帮助人，会把电池送给有需要的对象。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME carry batteries in their pouches, keeping them charged using the electricity they produce by spinning their arms. These Pokémon love to help people, presenting these batteries to those who need them.

entry: POKENAME在地下掘进，一边移动，一边在安全环境中练习积蓄电力。若有金属卡在两个插脚之间，就会不断涌出电流，直到金属被取走。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME travel by burrowing through the ground in order to practice building up electricity in a safe environment. If a piece of metal ends up between POKENAME's prongs, it will create a constant surge of electricity until it's removed.

entry: POKENAME把电储存在尾巴里，储得越多，尾巴跳动越快。电量达到上限后，它就会把尾巴对准敌人，放电攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME store electricity in their tails, which bounce faster as more energy is stored. Once they reach max capacity, they aim their tail at foes to shock them.

entry: POKENAME喜欢睡在树下，却很容易被当地的飞行属性宝可梦吓到。它的壳周围会产生静电电击，抱着它十分危险。
author: skleegamer
source: POKENAME enjoys sleeping under trees. However, it gets startled easily by local Flying-type Pokémon. It is a very dangerous Pokémon to hold as it creates static shocks around its shell.

entry: POKENAME把尾巴插进插座，就会沉沉睡去，直到充满电。不过，电很快又会耗光，让它一生大部分时间都在睡觉。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME plug their tails into outlets, falling into a deep slumber until fully charged. They lose this charge quite quickly, however, leaving them asleep for most of their lives.

entry: POKENAME在土中挖掘时，会因四肢运动而发电。蜷成球后，就能更好地释放电力。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME generate electricity as they dig through terrain, specifically because of their moving limbs. When they curl into balls, they can better release their electricity.

entry: 它用插脚般的角接住闪电，将电力储存在囊中。旋转双臂发电或放电时，尖刺间会闪过静电电弧。
author: infinex21
source: It catches lightning with its prong-like horns and stores the electricity within a sac. Its quills arc with static electricity as it spins its arms to generate or release electricity.

entry: POKENAME睡在溪流中，除非用非常大的力气，否则几乎无法叫醒。睡觉期间，它会定期向周围水中释放阵阵静电。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps in creeks and is nearly impossible to wake except by excessive force. During this time, it regularly releases bursts of static into the surrounding water.

entry: POKENAME的衣物拖过地面，摩擦出静电，储进头盔。随后，以奇异而迷人的能量迸发，将电力打向对手。
author: nightwingjay
source: POKENAME harnesses static electricity from its clothes as they drag along the ground, storing the energy in its helmet. It then releases this energy through enchanting, mystical bursts that shock its opponents.

entry: 它能从脸上的角射出强劲的闪电，远达200英尺，也能用电击准确命中目标。
author: .izik
source: It shoots powerful lightning bolts from the horn on its face. It can reliably hit a target with a Thunder Shock from up to 200 feet away.

entry: 科学家认为，POKENAME的磁力来自四肢储存的电荷。若失去电荷，它就会连续转动双臂数日，将其补回。
author: notsaying.
source: The magnetism of POKENAME is thought by scientists to be sourced from the electric charge in its limbs. If it loses this charge, it will spin its arms for days to recover it.

entry: 它自己发出的电很弱。为了吸收更多能量、增强电力，它会用后脑的颚咬住电属性宝可梦。
author: hophoppip
source: The electricity it generates is weak. To absorb more energy and charge its powers, it clamps the jaws on the back of its head onto Electric-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME把头插进电源插座获取能量。一小时内就能补足超过八小时睡眠带来的精力。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME docks its head in power sockets to get energy. Within an hour, it can recharge energy worth over eight hours of sleep.

entry: POKENAME挥动双臂积蓄动势，打出能碎石的拳，开凿巢穴。旋转手臂也能在体内发电，常能看到电光在双角间闪烁。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME swing their arms to build momentum and deliver stone-shattering punches to form their dens. Spinning their arms also generates electricity within them, which can oft be seen sparking between their horns.

entry: POKENAME一圈圈旋转身体发电，将电储存在两个插脚之间。只需转满一分钟，就够让一盏路灯亮一小时。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spins its body in circles to generate electricity that it stores between its prongs. After a full minute of spinning, it has enough electricity to power a lamp post for an hour.

entry: POKENAME能像强力电击器一样，充当致命性较低的近战武器。它会旋转飘带充电，也会接上插座，大幅补充电力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME functions as a powerful taser, a less-lethal melee weapon. It rotates its ribbon to recharge or plugs into outlets to supercharge.

entry: POKENAME的能量大多来自体内储电，因此许多电电虫附上来时，它就会疲惫。野外，它会靠飞行属性宝可梦将电电虫啄走。
author: mepp.
source: Because POKENAME gets most of its energy from the electricity stored in its body, it becomes fatigued when many Joltik latch onto it. In the wild, it relies on Flying-Type Pokémon to pick them off.

entry: POKENAME常被用作发电机，旋转的齿轮不断产生电力。将尾巴插进插座，就能为整栋房子供电。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are often used as generators, their rotating gears constantly producing electricity. By plugging their tails into an outlet, they can power an entire house.

entry: 从插座吸收电力后，POKENAME的身体会散发出类似柠檬清洁剂的怡人气味。许多人表示，闻到香气后，会觉得格外平静。
author: .izik
source: After absorbing electricity from an outlet, POKENAME's body releases a pleasant scent similar to a lemon cleaning solution. Many report feeling intense calm when exposed to this aroma.

entry: 它总想用电力博取赞叹，只要有人看，就会从炮口连连射出闪电。这般卖弄，让它不断耗光能量，时常精疲力尽。
author: sk372
source: It constantly tries to impress others with its electric powers, firing bursts of lightning from its cannon rapidly to any who would watch. Its energy constantly runs out as a result of the showboating, leaving it exhausted often.

entry: 许多小镇会备着一只POKENAME，方便迅速给医疗设备充电。它虽小，也会尽力满足每个人的需要，尤其是那些日常生活必须依赖设备的人。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many small towns often have an POKENAME handy to quickly charge medical devices. Even though they are small, they do their best to ensure everyone's needs are met, especially if a person needs the device to support daily living.

entry: POKENAME的光，会缓缓吸走周围一切的电力。它们常出现在城市，频繁引发停电。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's light slowly saps the electricity from everything around it. These Pokémon are often found in cities, frequently causing blackouts.

entry: 踩到POKENAME就会触电。有些人会在家附近喂养它们，让它们以电击防范害兽和闯入者。
author: hophoppip
source: Stepping on POKENAME will electrically shock you. Some people feed POKENAME near their house so the population can act as a shocking safeguard against pests and trespassers.

entry: 它自己能产生的电力很少。POKENAME只得接上插座，吸取电力，才有足够能量释放肉眼可见的电光。
author: sk372
source: It has very little electrical prowess to generate on its own. POKENAME resorts to plugging itself into outlets and siphoning power from there in order to have enough to produce visible electricity.

entry: POKENAME特别兴奋时，黑毛中伸出的角就会迸出噼啪的电火花。它故意让对手打中自己，利用接触引发的麻痹，夺得上风，赢下战斗。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME becomes especially excited, electric sparks crackle from the horns jutting out of its black fur. It deliberately allows opponents to strike it, using the resulting paralysis to seize the upper hand and win the battle.

entry: POKENAME的壳导电性极强，会电击触碰者。再加上体重很大，它的头槌尤其危险。
author: mirkinator
source: The shell of POKENAME is incredibly conductive, shocking those who touch it. This along with POKENAME's high weight result in a particularly dangerous headbutt.

entry: POKENAME飞快振翅发电，将电储存在体内。它会从触角释放一小股一小股能量，击晕猎物。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME rapidly vibrate their wings to generate electricity, storing it within their bodies. They fire small bursts of this energy from their antennae, stunning prey.

entry: 它附在服务器上吸取电力，同时保留其中的数据。因此，它能出人意料地模仿存储的信息。
author: .izik
source: It latches onto servers to absorb their electricity, retaining any data within them. This gives it a surprising ability to mimic stored information.

entry: 它的尾巴不停迸出电火花，轻轻电到附近的对象。玩耍时，它常会不小心电到朋友。
author: .izik
source: Its tail sparks constantly, sending out small shocks to those nearby. It often shocks its friends by accident while playing.

entry: POKENAME害羞却爱冒险，不论晴雨，都喜欢在户外玩耍。特别开心时，它就会释放麻痹粉。
author: bobosmith01
source: Shy but adventurous, POKENAME love playing outdoors, rain or shine. When they are particularly overjoyed, they let loose a Stun Spore.

entry: POKENAME害羞却爱冒险，不论晴雨，都喜欢在户外玩耍。特别开心时，它就会释放麻痹粉。
author: bobosmith01
source: Shy but adventurous, POKENAME love playing outdoors, rain or shine. When they are particularly overjoyed, they let loose a Stun Spore.

entry: 耳朵收拢时，会在内部积蓄能量。战斗中，POKENAME用能伸长的耳朵，迅速从远处打击、电击对手。
author: sk372
source: Its ears charge energy internally when retracted. In battle, POKENAME uses these extendable ears to quickly strike and shock its opponents from a distance.

entry: 它晃动敏感的鼻子，感知附近的电子设备，能轻易找到藏起来的装置。
author: .izik
source: It senses nearby electronics by wiggling its sensitive nose. This ability allows it to locate hidden devices effortlessly.

entry: 它还不擅长运用电属性招式，却敢在最危险的雷雨中无畏地游荡。不过，若暴风雨中没有雷声或闪电，它反而喜欢躲在巢里。
author: bobosmith01
source: While it isn't yet adept at utilizing Electric-type moves, it nevertheless prowls fearlessly during even the most dangerous thunderstorms. If a storm does not contain thunder or lightning, however, it prefers to hide in its den.

entry: POKENAME头上的冠，是产生、储存体内电力的地方。它能把电压集中到口中与獠牙上，增强咬击。
author: sk372
source: The crest on POKENAME's head is where it generates and stores its internal electricity. It can focus the voltage into its mouth and tusks, giving it a more powerful bite.

entry: POKENAME飞快拍翼积电，双角间便噼啪闪烁。它喜欢追逐风暴与雷云，穿梭天际，身后留下一道嗡嗡作响的电火花。
author: potato_tub
source: POKENAME beats its wings rapidly to build up charge, making its horns crackle with energy. It loves chasing storms and thunderclouds, darting through the sky and leaving a trail of buzzing sparks behind.

entry: 它喜欢蜷在温暖的带电线缆中睡觉。电线产生的热，既让它舒适，也为身体充电。
author: .izik
source: It loves curling up inside warm live wiring to sleep. The heat generated by the wires soothes it and charges its body.

entry: 凡是找到的废电线、坏电器，它都往身体里塞。放电时，还会冒出一团团恶臭烟雾。
author: staghorn
source: It fills itself with any discarded wires and broken electronics it can find. When it discharges its electricity, it emits clouds of putrid smoke.

entry: POKENAME借云朵在高空飞行，身边的云会与周围云层的种类一致。风暴来临时，它的雷云会向地面放出闪电。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME flies at high altitudes using its clouds, which match the type of clouds around it. Whenever there is a storm, its storm clouds shoot lightning down to the ground.

entry: 它通过针刺释放猛烈的电流，麻痹靠得太近的一切，常在电线附近安家。
author: .izik
source: It releases sharp jolts of electricity through its needles, paralyzing anything that gets too close. It frequently makes its home near powerlines.

entry: POKENAME会在周围积蓄静电，让黄玉色的毛发根根竖起。夜间，它们聚在路灯旁，凝望明亮的灯光。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME build up static around them that makes their topaz fur stand on edge. At night, they congregate around lamp posts to stare at the bright light.

entry: POKENAME游过浅沼，用迅疾的电击麻痹毫无戒备的猎物。它的身体在浑水中微微发亮，入夜更显诡异。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims through shallow marshes, using rapid electric shocks to paralyze unsuspecting prey. Its body glows faintly in murky waters, letting off an eerie glow at night.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴不停迸出火花，释放电荷。训练得当后，它能在工厂流水线上工作，用火焰与电力焊接零件。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME constantly sparks from its tail to vent its electrical charge. When properly trained, it can work on assembly lines in factories, using both its flames and electricity to weld parts together.

entry: POKENAME在地下挖掘，寻找埋藏的电缆来进食。它用头上的插脚磨损电缆绝缘层，直到将其破坏，导致当地断电。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME burrows through the ground, searching for buried power lines to feed on. It uses the prongs on its head to wear away at the insulation around the cable until it breaks through, cutting the power supply to the local area.

entry: POKENAME虽然有三个头，却只有一个完全伸出地面。有人认为，其他头还未发育完全，等它进化后才会长成。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME has three heads, only one of them fully protrudes above the surface. It has been suggested that the others are not yet fully developed, but will be once POKENAME evolves.

entry: POKENAME拍动有力的双翼，产生大量电力，再经由头顶的角处理。充满电后，它会主动寻找对手战斗，释放储存的能量。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can generate vast amounts of electricity by flapping its powerful wings, which is then processed through the horns atop its head. Once fully charged, it actively seeks out opponents to battle in order to release its stored energy.

entry: POKENAME像用螺旋桨一样转动尾巴，在水中推进，同时发电。角一碰到东西，它就会释放积蓄的全部能量。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their tails like propellers, spinning them to propel themselves through the water while also generating electricity. When their horns bump into something, they discharge all of their built-up energy.

entry: POKENAME运用电力时，腹部的闪电纹就会发光。先用水浸湿对手，它就能同时击倒好几个。
author: quackquackattack
source: The lightning bolt on POKENAME's stomach glows when it harnesses the power of electricity. By first soaking opponents with water, it can knock out several at the same time.

entry: POKENAME活动时，肌肉中会积蓄电荷，运动越剧烈，产生的电力越大。充电过多，背上的两个插脚就会噼啪闪烁，将能量释放到周围空气中。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME build up electrical charge in their muscles as they move, with more strenuous exercise generating greater power. The twin prongs on their back crackle with power if they charge up too much, discharging the energy into the air around them.

entry: POKENAME睡在电源附近。受到打扰就瞬移到安全处，却会在原地留下危险的电荷。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME sleeps near power sources. If it is disturbed, it teleports to safety, leaving behind a dangerous electrical charge at its point of origin.

entry: 若发现一块显眼的凹陷金属，可能就是POKENAME所为。雷雨时，它们会敲打金属表面，储存电力，留待日后食用。
author: teatedtiten
source: If you find a conspicuous piece of dented metal it may have been caused by an POKENAME. During thunderstorms, they punch metal surfaces to store electricity for later consumption.

entry: POKENAME是常见的麻烦，会抽取地下电缆的电力，让许多屋主为不得不承担的费用而头疼。夜间，它的光芒会引来毛球与摩鲁蛾。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is a common pest that siphons electricity from underground cables, leaving many homeowners frustrated when they have to cover the cost. Its glow draws the attention of Venonat and Venomoth at night.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在草地嬉戏。玩得兴奋时，它身后就会留下一路电火花。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy frolicking in fields of grass. Whenever they are excited, they produce sparks that trail behind them as they have fun.

entry: POKENAME背上流动的电火花，来自天生的静电场与空中微粒的反应。它能用插脚调节静电场，向潜在的捕食者喷出一团团电火花。
author: staghorn
source: The sparks running down POKENAME's back are caused by its natural electrostatic field reacting to airborne particles. It uses its prongs to modulate this field, allowing it to fire off plumes of sparks at potential predators.

entry: 充电过多时，它的磁力会变得过强，黏在较大的金属物体上，直到电荷散去，才能再次活动。
author: .izik
source: When overcharged, it becomes excessively magnetic, sticking to larger metal objects. This state renders it immobile until the charge dissipates.

entry: POKENAME盼着进化，进一步提高电磁波的电压与覆盖范围。谁想摸它三个头上的耳朵，都可能触电。
author: fiordaliso
source: It looks forward to evolving to further increase the voltage and range of its electromagnetic waves. If anyone tries to touch the ears of POKENAME's three heads, they risk getting an electric shock.

entry: 它会飞过敞开的窗户，偷走电子设备的线缆筑巢。一座巢里，能容纳多达1000条不同的线缆。
author: .izik
source: Flying through open windows, it steals cords from electronics to build its nest. These nests can hold up to one thousand different cords.

entry: POKENAME不喜欢陌生人，很难亲近别人。不过它爱玩，陪它玩便是结交的最佳途径。兴奋时，周围的气体会膨胀；可惜这些气体会刺激皮肤。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME dislike strangers and have a hard time warming up to others. However, they love to play: this is the easiest way to have them bond with another. When excited, the gas surrounding them expands; unfortunately, the gas is a skin irritant.

entry: POKENAME不喜欢陌生人，很难亲近别人。不过它爱玩，陪它玩便是结交的最佳途径。兴奋时，周围的气体会膨胀；可惜这些气体会刺激皮肤。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME dislike strangers and have a hard time warming up to others. However, they love to play: this is the easiest way to have them bond with another. When excited, the gas surrounding them expands; unfortunately, the gas is a skin irritant.

entry: POKENAME顽皮，舌头有毒，毛上也覆着毒液与静电，接触就能使人麻痹。它虽然爱恶作剧，却不喜欢被吓，受惊后甚至可能哭起来。
author: bobosmith01
source: An impish creature with a toxic tongue, POKENAME can cause paralysis upon contact thanks to the poisonous fluid and static electricity coating its fur. Although it loves playing pranks, it dislikes being scared and may even cry if startled.

entry: 雷雨时，POKENAME会用角收集电力，再让毛发微微发光。柔和的光，帮助其他宝可梦在恶劣天气中入睡。
author: santon5512
source: During thunderstorms, POKENAME collect electricity using their horns. They use this energy to make their fur glow faintly, the gentle light helping other Pokémon fall asleep in the harsh weather.

entry: POKENAME贴着地面藏在灌木中，颈部扩展皮膜上的花纹，像一张妙蛙种子的脸。它先用甜美的花蜜香诱来猎物，再将其缠住，以毒牙攻击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME hide in bushes low to the ground, the patterns on their hoods resembling the face of a Bulbasaur. They lure in prey with the sweet scent of nectar before coiling around them and striking with their poisonous fangs.

entry: POKENAME头周围的扩展皮膜，能保护它免遭捕食。许多飞行属性宝可梦把它误认成小阿柏怪，它便能安心吃叶子。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a hood around their head that protects them from predators. Many Flying-type Pokémon mistake them for a small Arbok, allowing POKENAME to eat leaves in peace.

entry: POKENAME天生狡黠，战斗讲求实效，偏爱利用宽广的攻击范围。它的肢体动作难以捕捉，积蓄动势后，便能像鞭子般甩动打击。
author: xillo
source: POKENAME are naturally wily creatures that prefer to fight pragmatically with wide reach. The limbs are hard to track in combat, with momentum gathered allowing them to thrash and strike like whips.

entry: POKENAME近来因残酷的战法而闻名。它用獠牙咬住对手、注入毒素，同时每秒打出数十拳。对手想逃，就会被粗大的尾巴缠住。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME have recently become known for their ruthless fighting style. They will sink their fangs into their opponent, envenoming them while delivering dozens of punches per second. Opponents that try to escape are coiled in their large tails.

entry: POKENAME以修长蜿蜒的尾巴作为主要防身手段。受到威胁时，它会用尾巴不停抽打来犯者，直到对方离开。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a long, sinuous tail that serves as its primary defense mechanism. If threatened, it will whip its tail at the aggressor until they go away.

entry: POKENAME排气时，会发出诡异的嘶嘶声。近期研究发现，左头上的不同花纹，与排出气体的毒性存在关联。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME makes an eerie hissing noise as it expels gases. Recent studies have found a correlation between the differing patterns on the left head and the toxicity of the gases they emit.

entry: POKENAME会从其他宝可梦的巢里偷蛋，藏进育儿袋。谁伸手进袋里取蛋，袋中的幼崽就会咬住谁，注入麻痹毒液。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME are known to steal eggs from other Pokémon nests and store them in their pouch. The youth in the pouch bites any Pokémon reaching into the pouch to reclaim the eggs, filling them with their paralytic venom.

entry: POKENAME能用长身体缠住障碍或敌人，轻松将其压碎。角也能像毒针一样刺击，但刺一次就会脱落，需整整一天才能再长好。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their long bodies to constrict and crush obstacles and foes with relative ease. Their horns function like stingers, though they are shed after stinging once and take a full day to regrow.

entry: POKENAME用翼上的假眼显出骇人的模样，吓退潜在的捕食者。等对方走得足够远，它常会得意地嘶嘶作响。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME use the faux eyes on its wings to appear intimidating to deter potential predators. Once they are far enough way, they often hiss in enjoyment at their success.

entry: 据说，凝视POKENAME的眼睛太久，会使人发疯，因此有些地方称它为“厄运之眼”。但研究者尚未证实有这种现象。
author: actliux
source: Staring into POKENAME's eye long enough is said to cause insanity. They were given the nickname "The Eye of Doom" in some places for this reason, but researchers have yet to prove that this phenomenon occurs.

entry: 谁表现出不喜欢它的演出，POKENAME就会喷出强酸性的毒液报复。它用四肢与尾巴抓住对手，再以可怕的紧束将其压碎。
author: fiordaliso
source: If anyone shows that they dislike its performance, POKENAME retaliates by spitting highly acidic venom at them. It grabs opponents with its limbs and tail before crushing them with its fearsome Wrap.

entry: POKENAME移动迅捷，每次掠过对手，都会用前臂带毒的镰刀接连斩击。它的尾巴，缠绕力足以压碎一辆小汽车。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME move swiftly and cut at their opponents with their poison-laced forearm scythes repeatedly with every pass. Their tails have enough constrictive power to crush a small car.

entry: 别看它身体小，两颗獠牙却能在几秒内注入半升毒液。注完毒，獠牙就会缩回，等待下一次出击。
author: quackquackattack
source: Its deceptively small body hides twin fangs that inject half a liter of venom in a matter of seconds. Once its venomous payload has been delivered, the fangs retract until it can strike again.

entry: POKENAME的半流体身体由有毒的酸液构成。它能随意改变体形，造出愤怒的花纹，来回晃动，吓阻来犯者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a semi-fluid body composed of toxic acids. They can reshape their body at will and create angry markings and wave them around to dissuade aggressors.

entry: POKENAME会甩出尾巴的针刺，抵御袭击。黄尖的针含有麻痹成分，其余则储有中等毒性的毒素。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: To defend themselves from attackers, POKENAME fling quills from their tails. The ones with yellow tips contain a paralytic agent, while the rest have a moderate poison stored within.

entry: POKENAME会甩出尾巴的针刺，抵御袭击。黄尖的针含有麻痹成分，其余则储有中等毒性的毒素。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: To defend themselves from attackers, POKENAME fling quills from their tails. The ones with yellow tips contain a paralytic agent, while the rest have a moderate poison stored within.

entry: POKENAME蜿蜒爬行，寻找树果，每吃一次就长一点。若撞到墙或自己，它便会夸张地装死。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME slithers around looking for berries, growing a little longer each time it eats. If it bumps into a wall or itself, it dramatically plays dead.

entry: POKENAME缓缓爬行，上半身覆着茧壳，大大限制了行动。它的獠牙很难看清，却藏着强力毒液，能让潜在的捕食者浑身痉挛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME slithers around slowly, its cocoon-covered upper body limiting much of its mobility. Its fangs are hard to spot, but packed with a potent venom that leaves potential predators in spasms.

entry: 世界上一些最幽暗的洞穴中，能找到POKENAME的化石遗骸。它的翅膀并不用来飞行，而是在特别宽大的洞中，从一面洞壁滑翔到另一面。
author: notsaying.
source: The fossilized remains of POKENAME are found in some of the darkest caves in the world. The wings aren't used to fly, rather, they are used to glide from cave wall to cave wall in particularly large caverns.

entry: 盯着那眼状花纹太久，全身便会灼痛难忍。它喷出的烈焰，几分钟就能把岩石汽化。
author: mistymagius
source: Staring into its eye-pattern too long causes an insufferable burning sensation in your entire body. It produces flames hot enough to vaporize rock within a matter of minutes.

entry: POKENAME极其罕见，能生活在高处与低处，也能栖身陆地和海洋。它能在黑暗中视物，因此只要天生的龙之生命力需要额外能量，便能随时狩猎。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is exceedingly rare and can live at both high and low altitudes, on land and at sea. Its ability to see in the dark allows it to hunt at any time when its natural draconic life force requires additional energy.

entry: 它最常在海边活动，尤其是有雾的夜晚。水手口耳相传的海上暗夜怪脸，或许就是POKENAME翼上与胸前的花纹。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is most active by the seaside, particularly on foggy nights. Oral legends among sailors about a monstrous face in the dark at sea may have been about the pattern on POKENAME's wings and chest.

entry: POKENAME因身体三根尖刺产生的高品质毒液而声名狼藉。有些人专门捕捉它，采集毒液，卖给出价最高的人，以此谋生。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME are infamous for the high-quality poisons that they produce from the three spikes on their bodies. Some people make a living by capturing POKENAME, collecting their poisons, and selling them to the highest bidders.

entry: 它的强力毒液，让科学家更好地理解了许多宝可梦的DNA，提高了市售解毒药的效力。POKENAME潜伏在最茂密的丛林深处，很难遇见。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its strong venom has allowed scientists to better understand the DNA of many Pokémon species, increasing the effectiveness of the Antidotes available on the market. POKENAME lurks deep within the densest jungles, so it is difficult to encounter one.

entry: POKENAME在密林中用花朵伪装，释放香气，吸引弱小的虫类宝可梦。等对方靠近，它便趁其不备，发动攻击。
author: greaterjagras
source: Within dense forests, POKENAME use their flowers as camouflage and release an aroma that attracts weak bug Pokémon. Once they get close, POKENAME catch them off guard and attack.

entry: POKENAME会张开颈部皮膜，试图威吓对手。不过，也有观察记录显示，它在求偶仪式中同样会展示皮膜。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME flare out their frills in an attempt at intimidation towards opponents. However, they have been observed to use their frills during mating rituals aswell.

entry: 它潜伏沼底，追踪毫无防备的宝可梦。针对不同猎物，还能使用各不相同的专用毒液。
author: schwaus
source: It stalks the bottom of swamps for unsuspecting Pokémon. It can use various venoms specialized for different forms of prey.

entry: POKENAME会边飞边吐出有毒酸液，削弱猎物，再用爪子抓住。激战中若失去一段尾巴，也能重新长出。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME spits poisonous acid while flying to weaken its prey, which it then grabs with its claws. If it loses part of its tail during a violent battle, it will grow back.

entry: 它的巨颚一合，整只轮胎也能咬碎。腹部花纹骇人，小宝可梦一看见，便吓得僵在原地。
author: schwaus
source: Its jaws are strong enough to crush whole tires in a single chomp. The patterns on its stomach are so intimidating it can freeze small Pokémon in their tracks.

entry: 遇见新面孔时，POKENAME会兴奋地将身体完全立起，打个招呼。可突然立起的身形，加上腹部花纹，往往反而把潜在的新朋友吓跑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rears up to full size to greet new faces in excitement. Its sudden rise and the pattern on its belly tend to accidentally frighten off these potential new friends, unfortunately.

entry: POKENAME平时将双翼贴着身体，直到发现猎物才展开。翼内侧的花纹，会让看见者麻痹，给它足够时间靠近，用爪子注入毒素。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME keeps its wings close to its body until it comes across prey. The markings on the interior of its wings when unfurled cause paralysis on viewing, giving POKENAME ample time to get closer and inflict poison with its claws.

entry: POKENAME平时将双翼贴着身体，直到发现猎物才展开。翼内侧的花纹会让看见者麻痹，它便趁机缠住目标，将其绞碎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME keeps its wings close to its body until it comes across prey. When unfurled, the markings on the inside of its wings paralyze those who look at them, letting POKENAME take advantage and crush its target in its coils.

entry: POKENAME用网困住猎物后，会展示背部花纹，让对方吓得动弹不得。随后用丝紧紧捆住，再狠狠咬上一口，注入毒液。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: After POKENAME traps its prey in its web, it displays the pattern on its back to immobilize them with fear. Then POKENAME tightly binds its prey in silk and delivers a venomous bite.

entry: POKENAME兜帽般的腹部，以凶狠的凝视吓退敌人。它潜伏在网里，用毒丝困住猎物，再以尖角刺入麻痹毒液，之后进食。
author: gekkou.
source: POKENAME's hood-like abdomen frightens enemies with a menacing glare. It lurks in webs, trapping prey in venomous threads and striking them with a sharp horn to inject paralyzing venom before feeding.

entry: POKENAME飞到小型猎物身后，将獠牙刺入后颈。制服猎物后，它就会整只吞下，让胃酸完成大部分消化。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME fly behind small prey and sink their fangs into the nape of their prey. After being subdued, POKENAME swallow their prey whole to allow their stomach acids to do most of the work.

entry: POKENAME是肉食性的捕食者，羽毛每个月都会陆续脱落。它偏爱吃其他宝可梦的蛋。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a carnivorous predator Pokémon that sheds its feathers throughout each month. It prefers to eat the Eggs of other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用球体放出强光，使角金鱼等猎物眼盲，动弹不得。球体还会分泌强力毒素，触碰便可能中毒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its orbs to create bright flashes that blind and immobilize prey such as Goldeen. The orbs also secrete a powerful toxin, making them poisonous to the touch.

entry: 它耳朵上的花纹，像一双巨大可怕的眼睛，能帮助吓退捕食者。毕竟它性情怯懦，也很难产生强力毒液。
author: hophoppip
source: Its ears are patterned to resemble large, scary eyes. This helps it scare away predators, as it's quite meek and struggles to produce strong venom.

entry: POKENAME会从森林地面抓走宝可梦幼崽，带回巢中。它从后颈注入猛烈的毒液，制服猎物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME snatch young Pokémon from the forest floor to bring back to their nest. POKENAME inject a virulent venom through the nape to pacify their prey.

entry: POKENAME每次嘶叫，都会释放一团漂浮的孢子，随风传向远方。若遭攻击，它就挥动棉絮般的尾巴，制造上升气流，滑翔到安全处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases clouds of floating spores with each hiss, spreading them far and wide on the wind. If attacked, it whips its cotton-like tail to create an updraft, allowing it to glide away to safety.

entry: 它侵扰乡间农田，与整个群落一起，吞光发现的所有食物。若有人想驱赶，POKENAME就会用毒牙狠狠咬回去。
author: fiordaliso
source: It infests rural crops, devouring all the food it finds along with its entire colony. If anyone tries to chase it away, POKENAME retaliates with terrible bites from its venomous fangs.

entry: 哥哥姐姐常这样捉弄弟弟妹妹：说POKENAME身上的薄膜是粉色果汁，因为外观与气味几乎一模一样。等尝到时，小家伙便会大吃一惊——虽然无害，味道却苦得很。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: A common trick that older siblings like to play on their younger siblings is to tell them that the film on POKENAME is Pink Juice as they look and smell almost identical. They get a shock when they taste it, as it is very bitter, though harmless.

entry: POKENAME缠绕的力量强得惊人，还能用超能力预测敌人的动作。一旦被它盯上，就再也无处可逃。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME is incredibly powerful when it comes to constricting things. In addition, its psychic powers allow it to predict its foe's movements. Once POKENAME has you in its sights, there is no escape.

entry: POKENAME眼睛般的花纹，让人以为它能看见任何角度的攻击。被咬住时，它能蜕下皮，让袭击者只咬到满嘴毒鳞。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's eye-like markings give the illusion that it can see attacks from any angle. It can shed its skin if bitten, leaving the attacker with a mouthful of toxic scales.

entry: POKENAME从花苞散发甜香，诱来猎物，再扑向倒霉的宝可梦，将其整只吞下。
author: mcnchsschl_69424
source: POKENAME exudes a sweet scent from its bulb, drawing prey close to it. It then lunges at the unlucky Pokémon, swallowing them whole.

entry: 成群的POKENAME凭敏捷身手与有毒唾液，迅速压制猎物。它的颚十分有力，能轻易咬碎密灌丛中的树枝。皮肤即使干燥，也像带着水分般闪亮。
author: chibitales
source: By using their agility and poisonous spit, POKENAME packs quickly overwhelm prey. Their jaw strength allows them to easily crush tree branches in dense thickets. Their skin seems to glisten with moisture even when dry.

entry: 它用翼下眼睛状的花纹，吓得小型猎物僵在原地。POKENAME的獠牙能注入强力毒素，几秒内就让肌肉无力。
author: fiordaliso
source: It uses the eye-shaped patterns beneath its wings to freeze its small prey with fear. POKENAME's fangs can inject a potent toxin that weakens muscles within seconds.

entry: POKENAME是妖精属性宝可梦的天敌，会飞快缠住猎物，再使出致命的子弹拳。谁想反抗，都无法打破钢铁般坚硬的鳞片。
author: ghostslythe
source: A natural predator of Fairy Types, POKENAME swiftly wraps prey before administering lethal Bullet Punches. Any who resist find it impossible to break its steel-hard scales.

entry: POKENAME击败几只毒属性宝可梦后，钢铁身体会混合敌人的毒素，储存在手臂的獠牙中，留待以后使用。
author: a_grain_of_rice
source: After POKENAME defeats a few Poison-type Pokémon, its steel body mixes and stores poison from its foes in the fangs of its arm for later use.

entry: 它们半流体的身体会变成阿柏怪的模样，吓退捕食者，虽然身体本就是纯粹的毒。壳由黑曜石构成，因为那是唯一接触毒身也不会被腐蚀的材料。
author: infinex21
source: Their semiliquid bodies take the shape of an Arbok to ward off predators, even though their bodies are pure poison. Their shells are made of obsidian, for that is the only material that does not corrode upon contact with their poisonous bodies.

entry: 它用翼下眼睛状的花纹，吓得小型猎物僵在原地。POKENAME的獠牙能注入强力毒素，几秒内就让肌肉无力。
author: fiordaliso
source: It uses the eye-shaped patterns beneath its wings to freeze its small prey with fear. POKENAME's fangs can inject a potent toxin that weakens muscles within seconds.

entry: POKENAME展示鲜艳的翅膀吓退威胁，还能用利爪注入毒液，尤其适合猎捕空中的目标。
author: vaporvenator
source: POKENAME scares away threats by displaying its brightly colored wings. It injects venom through its talons, ideal for hunting airborne targets.

entry: 许多POKENAME听命于偷猎者，飞过宝可梦保护区，猎杀濒危宝可梦。爪牙只在猎物身上留下浅痕，让偷猎者能将猎杀所得卖出尽可能高的价钱。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many POKENAME soar through Pokémon sanctuaries at the behest of poachers to hunt endangered Pokémon. Their talons and fangs leave shallow marks on their prey, which helps poachers maximize the value of their kill.

entry: POKENAME从尾尖分泌浓稠的彩色物质，在颈部皮膜上画假眼，威吓潜在的捕食者。液体毒性极强，也是另一道防线。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME secretes a thick colourful substance from its tail tip, which it uses to paint false eyes on its hood to intimidate potential predators. The fluid is incredibly toxic and acts as another line of defence.

entry: POKENAME用长长的身体缠紧猎物，张开大颚，便能整只吞下比自己大得多的宝可梦。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their long bodies to constrict their prey. By unhinging their jaws, they can swallow much larger Pokémon whole.

entry: POKENAME的獠牙同时注入麻痹毒素与直接的电击，击倒猎物。颈部皮膜上眼睛般的花纹，也能借体内电力发出强光。
author: infinex21
source: An POKENAME's fangs deliver a paralytic toxin in tandem with a direct electric jolt to take down prey. The eye-like patterns on its frills can emit bright light thanks to their internal electricity.

entry: POKENAME昼伏夜出，常咯咯怪笑着，用强力幻觉骚扰别人。受害者说，眼前会出现它的花纹，鲜明而恐怖，迅速变大，将自己整个人吞下。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME are nocturnal, often found cackling as they harass others with powerful hallucinations. Victims describe seeing vivid and terrifying images of POKENAME's markings quickly growing in size and swallowing them whole.

entry: POKENAME主要的触蔓末端，都长着阿柏怪的头。獠牙的毒咬能让目标麻痹，无力躲开更多藤蔓的缠绕，最终被压碎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's main tendrils end in Arbok heads. Their fangs contain a poisonous, paralyzing bite that leaves a target helpless to avoid more of POKENAME's vines ensnaring and then crushing them.

entry: POKENAME靠腹部的大脸吓退捕食者。若有东西靠得太近，它便会先用毒牙猛咬，再撤退。
author: oejoeboy33
source: POKENAME relies on the large face on its stomach to scare off predators. If anything gets too close, they'll snap with their venomous fangs before retreating.

entry: 暴风雪中，POKENAME常被误认成野生的幽灵属性宝可梦。巨大的眼状花纹，既让较小的猎物吓得僵住，也能驱走更大的捕食者。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME are frequently confused for wild Ghost-type Pokémon during blizzards. Their large eye patterns give them an advantage over smaller prey that freeze in fear and keep away larger predators.

entry: 它用修长有力的尾巴困住、绞紧猎物，再整只吞下。POKENAME的獠牙含有致命毒液，有研究者推测，这让它能与体型更大的古代宝可梦势均力敌。
author: infinex21
source: It uses its long, strong tail to ensnare and constrict prey before swallowing them whole. POKENAME's tusks contain a deadly venom that some researchers theorize allowed it to fight on par with larger, ancient Pokémon.

entry: 野生POKENAME在森林家园的枝头间跳跃，借带有蜂纹的臂膜滑翔。它会滑翔而下，用毒牙咬住猎物，将其制服。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME leap from branch to branch within their forest homes, gliding with their bee-patterned arm webbings. They glide down and latch their poisonous fangs into prey to neutralize them.

entry: 丛林和森林中，常能看见这些宝可梦滑翔膜上的花纹，那是它们正向猎物俯冲。它们也能用粗壮的尾巴支撑平衡，张开滑翔膜，让自己显得更大。
author: infinex21
source: The patterns upon the glider-webbings of these Pokémon are an often sight within jungles and forests as they swoop down to their prey. They can balance upon their thick tails and spread their gliders to make themselves look larger.

entry: POKENAME是令人畏惧的丛林猎手，大多待在树冠。它偷偷靠近敌人，先竖起颈部皮膜吓对方一跳，再喷出酸液。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is a feared jungle predator that spends most of its time up in the treetops. It sneaks up on foes, startling them by erecting its frills before spitting acid at them.

entry: POKENAME藏在高草中，突然冒出来惊吓目标。遇到危险，它会喷出滚热的毒液，并用尖牙咬击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME uses tall grass to hide, then pops out to scare their targets. When in danger, these Pokémon attack by spitting heated poison and biting with their sharp fangs.

entry: POKENAME在战斗中热血沸腾时，胸前的眼状花纹就会燃烧。拳头覆着毒层，一接触就会让对手身中剧毒。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: When POKENAME gets fired up in battle, the eye patterns on its chest ignite. This Pokémon's fists are covered in a toxic coating that badly poisons opponents upon contact.

entry: POKENAME栖身泥沼，用蛇般的身体游过水面，再用双臂撑着跃过杂物。为免争斗，它会绷起前臂的假脸，用恐怖花纹或结实肌肉吓退对手。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME inhabits bogs, slithering through water with its serpentine body and vaulting over debris with its arms. To avoid a fight, it will flex the false faces on its forearms, scaring off opponents due to the frightening pattern or its muscles.

entry: POKENAME能在夜间让头鳍发光。捕食者黄昏时悄悄接近，它就侧身立起，用鳍吓退威胁。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can make their head fins glow at night. When predators creep in at dusk, POKENAME rise up facing sideways, using their fins to scare off any threats.

entry: POKENAME舞蹈般的摇摆动作，会让观看者受到催眠。一旦对方入迷，它便蜿蜒靠近，用蛇形的半身缠住受害者，将其绞碎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's swaying dance-like movements cast a hypnotic effect on those that bear witness to them. Once it has a victim enthralled, it snakes its way closer to coil around them and crush them with its serpentine half.

entry: 野生POKENAME会用颈部皮膜吓走一切潜在威胁。若不奏效，它也绝不怕用尾巴还击。
author: k1n1t0.xo
source: Wild POKENAME will utilize their hood to scare away any possible threats. Otherwise they won't be afraid to use their tail against them.

entry: 经过严苛训练，POKENAME出手已如蛇般迅疾，还能将波导化为长鞭攻击敌人。
author: kiddivinegon
source: Through intense training, this Pokémon is now able to strike with the speed of a snake. The aura POKENAME wields can be used as a whip to attack foes.

entry: 蛇形身体优雅游动，散发致命波导。POKENAME以带毒的波导吓退威胁，守护领地。
author: sheogorath
source: Its serpentine body moves with grace while it exudes a lethal aura. POKENAME uses its toxic aura to deter any threats and protect its territory.

entry: POKENAME会向猎物喷洒令人眼盲的孢子，阻止逃脱。将猎物逼入绝境后，就用藤蔓缠住，拖回洞穴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sprays its prey with blinding spores to prevent escape. Once cornered, it wraps its prey with vines before dragging it back to its burrow.

entry: 它缠绞的力量极强。若没能引来敌人，就会骑在蛇形肢体上主动追击。
author: mossybanana
source: This Pokémon has exceptional constriction power. If luring foes in does not work, it will give chase by riding its snake-like appendage.

entry: 多个头会张口咬向一切靠近之物。有些人相信，若被POKENAME直视双眼，就会化为石头。
author: chorb33
source: The various heads of this fusion snap at anything that comes near them. Some believe that POKENAME will petrify you if it looks you right in the eye.

entry: POKENAME头上的角，触碰便有剧毒，让强力的头槌更加危险。它常用有力的尾巴勒紧、缠绞猎物。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: The horns on POKENAME's head are extremely poisonous to the touch, making their powerful headbutts even more dangerous. They are prone to using their strong tails to strangle and constrict prey.

entry: 前肢短小、发育不足，却有善于抓握的尾巴弥补。它会以头槌惊吓猎物，战斗时也会用颈部花纹威慑对手。
author: infinex21
source: Its prehensile tail makes up for how small and underdeveloped its forelimbs are. It headbutts prey to startle them and uses its neck patterns to intimidate opponents during battle.

entry: POKENAME胸前与耳上的鲜艳色彩，警告其他宝可梦：它有致命毒液。它能看见红外线，也能通过地面感知猎物的动静。谁想逃，就会被能碎石的尾巴牢牢缠住。
author: ghostslythe
source: The bright coloration on POKENAME's chest and ears warns other Pokémon of its lethal venom. It sees in infrared and can feel potential prey's movements through the ground. Any that try to escape are held fast by a boulder-crushing tail.

entry: POKENAME的角与尾巴覆有强力毒素，轻易就能让敌人失去行动力。它借夜色掩护狩猎，在猎物反应过来前，就将其制服。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's horn and tail are coated in a powerful poison that easily incapacitates its foes. It hunts under the cover of night, taking out its prey before they can react.

entry: POKENAME在巢里照顾许多尼多一族的小家伙，负责教幼崽狩猎。腹部花纹能吓得猎物僵在原地，让小家伙们容易得手。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME take care of many Nidoran within their nest and are in charge of helping the baby Pokémon learn how to hunt. The pattern on their stomachs causes prey to freeze in their tracks out of fear, which gives the Nidoran an easy shot at hunting.

entry: POKENAME用有力的尾巴吊在树枝上，避开敌人，寻找食物或猎物。它随时都能以尾巴保持完美平衡，让近身攻击的变化难以预测。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their strong tails to hang from tree branches to avoid foes and to scout for food or prey. They can balance perfectly on their tails at any moment, allowing them to mix up their physical strikes in unpredictable ways.

entry: POKENAME发育不全，始终没长出颈部皮膜，于是改学剑术弥补，模样反而更令人畏惧。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Stunted in its development and never growing a hood, POKENAME compensated by learning the way of the sword, an arguably more intimidating sight.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃中长出了储有致命毒液的毒囊，还会用缎带上的假脸转移对手视线，掩藏真正的眼睛。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME has grown deadly venom vessels in its blade. It also distracts opponents from its true eye with its fake ribbon face.

entry: POKENAME只以刺击攻敌。伤口平行排列，让它得了“蛇噬”的外号。刀刃上的毒，强到足以杀死10只象牙猪。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME exclusively attacks its foes by stabbing. The parallel placement of the wounds has earned this Pokémon the nickname 'Bite of the Snake'. The poison coating its blades is strong enough to kill 10 Mamoswine.

entry: POKENAME的两个头以意念交流，配合得天衣无缝。前头能释放强力闪电，尾巴则藏着致命毒液。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME's two heads work in perfect unison, communicating with one another via their thoughts. The front head delivers powerful bolts of electricity, while the tail has deadly venom.

entry: 即使相隔很远，POKENAME鬃毛中冒出的蛇，也能一眼让敌人麻痹。随后，它用獠牙上的强力毒液，将对方击倒。
author: keiracm35_
source: With a single glance, the snakes emerging from POKENAME's mane paralyze its foes even at great distances. Then, POKENAME knocks them out with the potent venom coating its fangs.

entry: POKENAME十分危险，翼上的巨大眼状花纹，能让敌人麻痹。每次喝下污水或被污染的池水，毒牙都会更加强大。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a dangerous creature that can paralyze foes with the giant eye-like patterns on its wings. Its venomous fangs grow stronger each time it drinks from tainted pools or contaminated water.

entry: POKENAME用催眠般的尾舞诱来受害者，再以带毒的獠牙咬住。毒液迅速让中招者平静下来，随后它便将对方吞食。
author: amityblamity
source: POKENAME lures its victims with hypnotic tail dancing before biting down with venom-tipped fangs. The venom quickly soothes the afflicted before they are consumed.

entry: 胸前鲜艳的花纹，在警告天敌它身怀剧毒。只咬一口，就能让目标无法动弹。
author: melodydelune
source: The brightly colored patterns on its chest warn predators of its highly toxic venom. A single bite can leave a target unable to move.

entry: 争夺领地主导权时，它用腹部骇人的花纹威吓其他POKENAME。獠牙覆着几秒内就能麻痹神经系统的毒素，咬上一口极其危险。
author: fiordaliso
source: A menacing pattern on its abdomen is used to intimidate rival POKENAME during battles for territorial dominance. Its bite is extremely dangerous since its fangs are coated in a toxin capable of paralyzing the nervous system within seconds.

entry: POKENAME是凶猛的猎手，绝不可轻视；寥寥几只，几天内就可能发展成庞大群落。研究认为，它或许还有一种雌性首领变种，但至今无人证实。
author: dyo_jonah
source: POKENAME are vicious hunters that should not be underestimated; a few individuals can rapidly grow into massive colonies within days. Research suggests a matriarch variant of POKENAME may exist, but nobody has been able to prove this theory yet.

entry: 有人把POKENAME称作终极猎手。它在暗处无声地跟踪猎物，以坚韧的皮肤抵御大多数攻击，再突然从口中伸出第二副颚，发动突袭。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is described by some as the ultimate hunter. It silently stalks prey from the shadows, its tough hide resisting most attacks before it strikes with a lunging second jaw from within its mouth.

entry: 争夺领地主导权时，它用腹部骇人的花纹威吓其他POKENAME。獠牙覆着几秒内就能麻痹神经系统的毒素，咬上一口极其危险。
author: fiordaliso
source: A menacing pattern on its abdomen is used to intimidate rival POKENAME during battles for territorial dominance. Its bite is extremely dangerous since its fangs are coated in a toxin capable of paralyzing the nervous system within seconds.

entry: 它会捆住对手，吸走精气，击败对方。需要进一步增强时，它会使用紧绑束带，提高抓握的力道。
author: quackquackattack
source: It defeats opposing Pokémon by binding and leeching out their essence. When it needs an extra boost, a Binding Band is used to help increase its grip strength.

entry: POKENAME在高草中一动不动地守候数小时，等待猎物。一旦猎物放松，它就猛扑、缠住目标，再用带毒的一拳结束战斗。外表虽然可爱，却是用来欺骗猎物的。
author: cerealjamalt
source: POKENAME hunts by remaining perfectly still in tall grass for hours. The moment prey relaxes, it lunges, constricts the target, and finishes the fight with a poison-coated punch. This Pokémon may look cute, but it is meant to fool prey.

entry: POKENAME先用颈部皮膜上的恐怖脸孔威吓敌人，再接连出拳。若拳头没能击败对方，它还会用长尾巴缠紧。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME intimidates foes with the scary face on its hood, before attacking with a flurry of punches. It can also constrict foes with its long tail if its punches don't defeat them.

entry: POKENAME通常三四只成群生活。首领借体内毒囊，在口中积起一团有毒孢子，向敌人喷出，随后其他成员一拥而上。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME live in packs consisting most often of three or four individuals. Using the poison sac in their body, the leader builds a cloud of poisonous spores in their mouth to spew at foes, after which the rest of the pack pounces.

entry: POKENAME用两条尾巴缠住废楼的横梁或排水管。谁若从下方经过，就会被它口中的火焰烤焦。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME winds its two tails around beams or drainpipes in abandoned buildings. Anyone passing underneath it is roasted by a flame from its maw.

entry: 野生POKENAME飞快奔过草原，追赶猎物，再跃起扑上去，刺入毒牙。它能张开颈部皮膜，威吓大多数敌人，在战斗中占据上风。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME run quickly along grassy plains in pursuit of their prey before leaping upon them and sinking their poisonous fangs into them. Their frills can expand to intimidate most foes and give them the upper-hand during battle.

entry: POKENAME展开宽大的双翼，显露暗色羽毛上的眼状花纹，吓倒敌人。它以流线形的身体俯冲，将滴着致命毒液的蛇牙，刺进猎物体内。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it spreads its broad wings, POKENAME terrifies foes by revealing the eye-like patterns on its dark feathers. It dives with its streamlined body to sink its serpentine fangs, dripping with deadly venom, into its prey.

entry: 遇到其他宝可梦，POKENAME就会嘶叫、摇尾。尾巴里的小珠会发出咔啦咔啦的响声。即使伪装被破坏，它仍会用毒牙攻击。
author: .jerden
source: If they encounter other Pokémon, POKENAME will hiss and shake its tail, which contains small beads that make a rattling sound. If its disguise is broken, this will not stop POKENAME from attacking with its venomous fangs.

entry: POKENAME偷偷靠近其他生物，再缠上去，将其绞碎。毒咬同时施展，效果最好，因此一抓住受害者，两个头就会一起咬下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sneaks up on creatures before coiling around them to crush them. Its venomous bite works best when used in tandem, so once it grabs a victim it delivers simultaneous bites from both heads.

entry: POKENAME的每个头都连着多个胃，颚能脱开、张得很大，整只吞下猎物。胃中充满腐蚀性酸液，能溶穿大多数物质。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have multiple stomachs for each of their heads, which can dislocate and open wide to swallow prey whole. Their stomachs are filled with a corrosive acid that can melt through most substances.

entry: 任何看见POKENAME的人，都会心生恐惧。蛇般的尾巴仿佛各有思想，而且和本体一样记仇。
author: pokepower
source: POKENAME cause feelings of dread to all who look upon it. Its snake-like tails seem to have minds of their own, all just as vindictive as the body.

entry: POKENAME既用双臂在树间荡行，也用来缠住、压碎猎物。它会把压碎的猎物扔远，再追过去，消耗过剩的精力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its arms to swing from trees as well as to constrict and crush prey. It throws the crushed prey into the distance so it can chase after them and burn off excess energy.

entry: POKENAME先用毒牙咬伤猎物，再一路尾随，直到对方倒下。最后，它以强力电击，终结虚弱的敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME bites with venomous fangs before stalking its prey until they collapse. It finishes off weakened foes with a powerful electric shock.

entry: POKENAME互相唱的歌带着嘶嘶声，让其他宝可梦不安。这种声音足以赶走大多数听众，让它们十分懊恼。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The songs POKENAME sing to one another have a hissing, sibilant quality to them that are unnerving to other Pokémon. These noises are enough to drive away most listeners, much to the dismay of POKENAME.

entry: 它勃然大怒时，连腹部的彩色花纹，也会像燃烧的火焰般闪亮。牙齿会产生煤炭般漆黑的剧毒。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it becomes very angry, even the colorful patterns on its belly shine as if they were blazing flames. Its teeth produce a highly toxic venom as black as coal.

entry: POKENAME鼓起身体，显得更大、更吓人，胸前的花纹能吓走弱小宝可梦。战斗开场时，它会发出尖锐得令人难受的叫声。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME puff up their bodies to appear larger and scarier than they actually are, the patterning on their chest scaring off weaker Pokémon. They have a painfully high pitched screech that they use as their opening attack in battles.

entry: POKENAME虽然体型小，有毒液相助，却是危险的捕食者。身上花纹能让更大的宝可梦打消争斗的念头。
author: lucioleuh
source: Despite their small size, POKENAME is a dangerous predator thanks to its venom. The patterns on its body dissuade bigger Pokémon from picking a fight.

entry: POKENAME漂到猎物近旁，从底部开口喷出毒雾。等猎物因毒素而踉跄，它就用强劲的触蔓缠住，带回巢中。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats down close to prey before spewing a toxic mist from the opening at its bottom. As its prey reels from the poison, it grabs them with its powerful constricting tendrils and carries them back to its den.

entry: 毫无准备就闯进黑洞穴的人，可能突然被POKENAME缠住。它似乎对无法在黑暗中视物的生物，有一种特殊感应。
author: bobosmith01
source: Those who dare to wander into dark caves unprepared may find themselves suddenly constricted by POKENAME. It seems it has a second sense for species that cannot see in the dark.

entry: POKENAME的獠牙并不含毒。毒液全从嘴和眼状花纹中分泌出来，真正的眼睛则长在顶上。
author: crumple_2
source: POKENAME's fangs contain no venom. Instead, all the venom secretes from its mouth and eye markings; its real eyes are on top.

entry: POKENAME每月蜕下鳞片，为下方的新鳞腾出空间。每道纹带的长度，能看出它当时吃得如何：短带表示挨过饿，长带则表示吃得饱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shed their scales every month to give room to a new set of scales underneath. The length of each band indicates how well they kept themselves fed, as a short band indicates a time of famine, while a long band indicates that they ate well.

entry: 体内火囊越热，翼上的花纹就越亮。它会用尾巴掳走小型猎物，带回巢里。POKENAME喜欢先烤熟食物，再整只吞下。
author: infinex21
source: The markings on its wings glow brighter as its internal flame sac grows hotter. It uses its tail to abduct small prey to carry back to its nest. POKENAME has a penchant for roasting its food before swallowing it whole.

entry: 这些宝可梦的颈部皮膜上，有骇人的花纹，似乎既用来惊吓捕食者，也用来惊吓猎物。对方愣住时，它们便咬上去，注入强力毒液。
author: infinex21
source: The frills of these Pokémon bear intimidating markings that they seemingly use to startle predators and prey alike. While their foe is stunned, they will sink their fangs into them and deliver a potent poison into their bodies.

entry: POKENAME不再用颈部皮膜的花纹威吓，而是用来迷住猎物。它能伸长脖子，趁敌人不备，猛然咬牢。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME no longer use the patterns on their frills to intimidate, instead using them to entrance prey. They can extend their necks to catch foes off guard as they latch their jaws onto them.

entry: POKENAME的叶片含有金质纤维，极为珍贵，因此富人常将其佩作首饰。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: POKENAME leaves are extremely valuable due to their gold fibers. As a result, it is common for the wealthy to wear them as jewelry.

entry: 它们以有力的颚死死咬住，难以被甩脱，能制服远比自己大的宝可梦。随后，再用毒牙把毒液注入猎物的血液。
author: joeofthealps
source: They are able to take down Pokémon much larger than themselves by clenching down with their powerful jaws to ensure they can't be dislodged. They then use their envenomed fangs to inject poison into the prey's bloodstream.

entry: 它们在沙中的时速可达80英里，一滴毒液也可能致命。成群狩猎时，它们用惊人的速度掀起沙暴，再趁混乱伏击猎物。
author: joeofthealps
source: They can move at speeds of up to 80 mph in sand, and even a drop of their poison can be lethal. Schools of them hunt by using their incredible speed to whip up sandstorms, then ambushing their prey in the confusion.

entry: POKENAME高举双翼，放大尖鸣，显得比本来更加庞大，让敌人吓得动弹不得。再用尾巴卷住晕头转向的猎物，载向远处，从此再无踪影。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME raise their wings and amplify their piercing cries to appear even larger than they already are, paralyzing foes with fear. They coil their tails around their disoriented prey and lift them off, never to be seen again.

entry: 成群的POKENAME会用酸液破坏灌木和小树，再用这些材料筑成精巧的巢。人们设法将它们成对迁走，尽量减轻当地受损的程度。
author: aflithycasual
source: When groups of POKENAME gather, they use their acid to destroy bushes and small trees that they'll use to create elaborate dens. Efforts are taken to relocate them in pairs to keep the damage in the area to a minimum.

entry: 宽大的颈褶如辽阔的极光般闪耀，颜色随着光线照射的角度变化。体内产生的毒，会让受害者寒冷而麻木。
author: infinex21
source: Its expansive frills shimmer like a vast aurora whose colors change depending on how light strikes them. The poison produced within its body has a chilling and numbing effect on its victims.

entry: POKENAME通常在巨石顶上晒太阳，只有不小心绊到它尾巴时，它才会出击。一口的毒液足以放倒吼鲸王；若对方仍站着，它就以粗糙、岩石般坚硬的鳞片将其绞紧。
author: ghostslythe
source: Generally found sunning itself on top of boulders, POKENAME only strike when the unwary stumble over their tail. Their bite contains enough venom to drop a Wailord, and any who remain standing suffer constriction by rough rock-hard scales.

entry: POKENAME用光之力让猎物暂时眼盲，心生恐惧。它并不吃猎物，而是以恐惧为食。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME uses its light powers to temporarily blind its prey and scare them. It does not eat them; it feeds off their fear.

entry: POKENAME为赢下战斗会不择手段，尤其是面对会丧命的敌人时。缠绞、窒息，或用有毒的爪与皮肤割伤对方，什么方法它都敢用。
author: beatdoof
source: It will do anything it takes to win a fight, especially if its enemies can die. Whether by constricting, suffocating, or lacerating them with venomous claws and skin, no method is off limits for POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME双臂上的红囊，用来储存从口中腺体射出的毒液。这种形态的毒液极强，能像酸一样蚀穿金属。
author: puppylev
source: The red sacs on POKENAME's arms are used to store the venom it shoots from glands in its mouth. It is so potent in this form that it can burn through metal like acid.

entry: POKENAME在稀树草原搜寻骨头，因本领平平而不受注意。毒素起效很慢，它得啃上超过一周，才能嚼碎骨头，将食物吞下。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME scavenge bones across the savannah, and their unremarkable abilities cause them to be ignored. Their poison is slow-acting, as they must gnaw on bones for upwards of a week before they can chew and swallow their meal.

entry: POKENAME虽然模样可怕，却是食腐者，训练家不必害怕。森林若不见散落的枯枝杂物，附近可能就有它。强劲的爪主要用来将倒木掰碎，变成一口能吃下的小块。
author: afilthycasual
source: Despite its terrifying appearance, POKENAME is a scavenger, so trainers need not fear it. A forest free of fallen debris indicates one may live in the area. POKENAME's powerful claws are primarily used to crush fallen logs into bite-sized pieces.

entry: POKENAME用耳上的花纹催眠猎物，引其靠近，再狠狠踢击。若猎物能抵抗催眠，它便改用尾巴，施展强烈的超能力属性攻击。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME use the patterns in their ears to hypnotize prey into coming closer before kicking them sharply. If their prey is resistant to hypnosis, they will instead use their tails to cast intensive psychic-type attacks.

entry: POKENAME是施毒与暗影戏法的高手，会如忍者般轻巧地接近毫无戒心的猎物。蛇头随后一口咬牢，直到对方失去行动力才肯松口。
author: mrdunklestein
source: A master of poisonous shadowplay, POKENAME sneaks up on unassuming prey with the grace of a ninja. The snake head then locks its jaw on the prey and will not let go until the bitten are incapacitated.

entry: POKENAME素来战法阴险，倚仗种种卑鄙手段。它用蛇样的舌头施展大蛇瞪眼，使敌人麻痹，一边疾速绕行，一边不停发射毒针。
author: theartemis1
source: Known to fight dirty, POKENAME relies on a variety of underhanded tactics in battle. It uses its serpent-like tongue to immobilize foes with a paralyzing Glare while weaving around them in rapid bursts, launching a relentless flurry of Poison Stings.

entry: POKENAME翼上的鳞片，过去曾在华蓝市被制成首饰上的护符。据说，这些护符能带来爱情上的好运。
author: .izik
source: The scales on the wings of an POKENAME were once used in Cerulean City to create charms for jewelry. These charms were said to bring luck with love.

entry: 寒冷的秋夜，POKENAME藏在暗处，准备突袭猎物。它会用有力的肢体将目标勒死。
author: dodoowner_
source: On chilly autumn nights, POKENAME hides in the shadows, preparing to strike its prey. It strangles its targets with its powerful appendages.

entry: POKENAME用长尾巴捉住猎物后，会试着用尾尖的火焰灼烧，使其更加虚弱。它在山洞筑巢，谁敢擅自进入领地，就会遭到攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME manages to catch prey with its long tail, it tries to scorch it with the flames burning at the tip to weaken it even further. It builds its den in mountain caves and attacks anyone who dares enter its territory without permission.

entry: POKENAME在沙漠挖掘时，会发出响亮的嘶嘶声。声音常会惊动地面的猎物，让对方逃走。
author: .izik
source: While digging through deserts, POKENAME emits loud hissing sounds. The noise often alerts prey above ground, allowing escape.

entry: POKENAME狩猎时挖掘速度极快。它先用带锯齿、充满毒液的獠牙咬住，再于几秒内，将受害者拖入地下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs at extreme speeds when hunting prey. It bites with serrated, venom-filled fangs before dragging victims underground in seconds.

entry: POKENAME喜欢收集闪亮的物品，堆起来留待欣赏。若野生个体看中了同一件东西，就会把身体撑大，直到一方成功吓退另一方，让其放弃争夺。
author: sleepyman0731
source: POKENAME tend to collect shiny objects and store them in piles to admire later. If wild POKENAME have their eyes on the same item, they make themselves bigger until one successfully intimidates the other into giving up their claim.

entry: POKENAME泳技高超，凭有蹼的四肢与强壮的尾巴在水中推进。它会紧追猎物，哪怕追上陆地也不罢休，直到毒牙咬入为止。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is a strong swimmer, driven through the water by both its webbed limbs and its powerful tail. It will relentlessly pursue prey, even onto land, until it can sinks in its poisonous fangs.

entry: POKENAME用可怕的气势，吓退可能伤害训练家的来者。除了外表骇人，它其实十分温柔友善。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its frightening presence to scare off others that would potentially harm its Trainer. Aside from the intimidating looks, it's actually quite gentle and amiable.

entry: POKENAME是顶级捕食者，先将毒牙刺入猎物，再用炽烈的火焰烤熟。它住在少有训练家涉足的山崖高处。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is an apex predator that sinks its venomous fangs into prey before roasting them with blazing flames. It lives atop cliffs of mountains where few Trainers venture.

entry: POKENAME喜欢跳舞，听见音乐，连狩猎到一半都会停下，扭动身体。腹部的旋纹也能转动，直到音乐结束才会停止。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy dancing and will stop mid hunt to wiggle and gyrate to the sound of music. The swirl on their stomach can also spin, and will only stop once the music ends.

entry: POKENAME最爱的运动是卷腹。盯着它胸前的花纹太久，会变得疲惫不堪。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's favorite exercise is curl-ups. Those who stare too long at the markings on its chest grow incredibly weary.

entry: POKENAME快速吐出分叉的舌头，感知周围的情绪。它甩尾催眠敌人，再以致命的精准度出击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's forked tongue darts out of its mouth, allowing it to sense emotions in its surroundings. It hypnotizes foes with a flick of its tail before striking with deadly precision.

entry: 清晨，POKENAME会找来最陡的山坡，慢跑上去。它能用尾巴轻松举起巨石。
author: .izik
source: In the early morning, an POKENAME will jog up the steepest hill it can find. It can lift boulders with its tail with great ease.

entry: POKENAME用全身各处擒住、缠绕猎物。力气足以把汽车压成直径仅几英寸的圆球。
author: pokepower
source: POKENAME grapple and wrap up prey with every part of their body. They have the strength to crush a car into a sphere only a few inches in diameter.

entry: 冬末的节庆上，能见到POKENAME以庞大的身躯帮忙助兴。每隔12年，节庆到来时，它们似乎就会格外骄傲、自命不凡。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be found at late winter festivals, using their bulk and size to aid in the festivities. Every twelve years, they seem to act prouder and more self-important when the festivals come around.

entry: POKENAME虽然外表凶悍，性情却十分胆小。腹部有一张可怕脸孔般的花纹，用来威吓别人，保护自己。每个个体的花纹都独一无二，与同类有所区别。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite its fierce appearance, POKENAME is very timid. Its belly bears markings that resemble a frightening face, which it uses to intimidate others and stay safe. Each individual has a unique pattern that sets it apart from the rest of its species.

entry: 它吐出胃酸溶解猎物，再吞下化成的浆液。食物会让酸性更强，所以它整天都在寻觅更大的一餐。
author: pokepower
source: It brings up stomach acid to dissolve prey, then consumes the sludge. Food makes the acid stronger, so it seeks bigger meals all through the day.

entry: 常能见到POKENAME在山崖间蜿蜒爬行。岩石般坚硬的身体，挤压力惊人。有训练家说，若不是个头较小，它的缠握力甚至能与大岩蛇媲美。
author: foolish_weasel
source: It is common to see POKENAME slithering up and down mountain cliffsides. POKENAME has incredible squeezing power with its rock-hard body, with some Trainers saying it could rival even an Onyx' grip strength were it not for its smaller size.

entry: POKENAME周身覆着粗砺的岩石状鳞片，几乎不怕攻击。受到威胁时，它会盘成一团，以骇人的速度滚下山坡，碾碎沿途的一切。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is covered in rugged, rock-like scales that make it nearly impervious to attacks. When threatened, it coils up and rolls downhill at terrifying speeds, crushing anything in its path.

entry: 它用颈部发光的脸形花纹吓唬猎物，夜里尤其有效。目标若逃，定会被它追上。
author: staghorn
source: It uses the glowing face on its neck to terrify its prey, particularly at night. If its target tries to run away, it chases them down without fail.

entry: POKENAME蓬松的尾巴，能让猎物忽略巨大的獠牙。它会把尾巴浸进水中，保持干净。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have fluffy tails that help distract prey from their large fangs. They dip their tails into water to ensure they stay clean.

entry: POKENAME猎捕冰水中的生物，凭蜿蜒的身体与有力的尾巴高速游动。酸性毒液极强，几秒内就能溶化巨大的永久冻土块。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME hunts prey living in icy waters, swimming at great speed thanks to its sinuous body and powerful tail. Its acidic venom is so potent that it can dissolve massive blocks of permafrost within seconds.

entry: POKENAME鲜黄与鲜红的花纹，由废物堆中的剧毒化合物构成。因此，这些场所的工人，也用这两种颜色作为警告标识。
author: banzai.exe
source: The bright yellow and red markings of an POKENAME are comprised of highly toxic compounds from waste dumps. As a result, workers at these sites use these colours as warning codes.

entry: POKENAME腹部的花纹，能威吓别人，保护自己。这些独特的花纹，每个个体都不相同。
author: quackquackattack
source: The markings on the stomach of POKENAME intimidate others and keep them safe. These unique markings are different for every POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的胃很大，能用强力胃酸消化蛋。腹部花纹能吓得猎物僵住，给它咬住对方的机会。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have large stomachs that can digest eggs with their powerful stomach acids. The markings on their stomach intimidate prey into freezing up in fear, giving them the opportunity to bite prey.

entry: POKENAME尾巴的节数，表明它的年龄；壳底的花纹，则能看出阿柏怪那一半的出生地。它能从壳内的肢体，射出高压污泥。
author: bobosmith01
source: The number of segments on POKENAME's tail indicates its age, while the markings across the bottom of its shell indicates the Arbok half's place of birth. POKENAME can fire highly pressurized sludge from the limbs in its shell.

entry: POKENAME是海边洞穴与岛屿上令人畏惧的猎手，能用连番咬击打倒任何敌人。近期在丰缘开展的考古探险，出土了与它极其相似的古代雕像。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is a feared predator of coastal caves and islands, taking down any foe with a barrage of bites. Recent archaeological expeditions in Hoenn have unearthed ancient statues that look strikingly similar to POKENAME.

entry: 地底深处的高压，会让POKENAME未用掉的毒液融合成琥珀般的晶体。这些宝石，让巨大的假眼更添骇人的光泽。
author: robosoup
source: When deep beneath the earth, intense pressures fuse POKENAME's unused venom into an amber-like crystal. These gems add a frightening glimmer to its large false eyes.

entry: 看见POKENAME身上的花纹，就会被催眠，仿佛正经历噩梦。这种本领，能吓走潜在的危险和对手。
author: petratheangel
source: The patterns on POKENAME's body hypnotize anyone who sees it into thinking they are experiencing a nightmare. This ability scares away potential dangers and rivals.

entry: POKENAME颈圈上的花纹，变幻旋转，带着催眠的魔力，在出击前让猎物入迷。摆锤则让它能窥见对手的内心。
author: .izik
source: The patterns on POKENAME's collar shift and swirl hypnotically, entrancing prey before it strikes. Its pendulum allows it to look into its opponent's mind.

entry: POKENAME只在猎捕来到岸上的猎物时浮出水面，平时更喜欢贴着水面下方游动。爪尖长着毒牙，用来削弱受害者。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME surfaces only to hunt prey that wander onto the shore, otherwise, it prefers to swim just below the water's surface. Its claws are tipped with venomous fangs used to weaken its victims.

entry: POKENAME需要抵御捕食者时，会从鼻口喷火，点燃羽毛。等捕食者失去兴趣，它便继续吃灌木上的叶子。
author: quackquackattack
source: When POKENAME need to defend themselves from predators, they release flames from their snout to set fire to feathers. Once the predators lose interest, they resume eating leaves off of bushes.

entry: 偶尔能在工业区发现POKENAME，靠铸造厂与熔炉产生的热量为食。有谁靠近，它便喷出带烟的火焰，若受打扰，还可能突然爆炸。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are occasionally found in industrial areas, feeding on the heat generated by foundries and furnaces. They will puff out smoky flames if anyone approaches, and may suddenly explode if disturbed.

entry: POKENAME会把附近流淌的熔岩拍向闯入者。这种行为，反映出它极其偏爱独处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME smacks molten lava from nearby flows toward intruders. This behavior reflects its strong preference for isolation.

entry: POKENAME的长舌比烤箱还热，只需把食物卷住，立刻就能烹熟。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's long tongue is hotter than an oven. It can cook food instantly just by wrapping its tongue around it.

entry: POKENAME住在热带海水中，鲜艳的颜色让它很受水族馆欢迎。不过，它体温极高，若要与其他宝可梦共养，就必须严密控制水温。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME live in tropical saltwater environments. Due to their bright colors, they are popular in aquariums; however, they possess an extremely high body heat, so the water must have excellent temperature control to house other types of Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME住在热带海水中，鲜艳的颜色让它很受水族馆欢迎。不过，它体温极高，若要与其他宝可梦共养，就必须严密控制水温。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME live in tropical saltwater environments. Due to their bright colors, they are popular in aquariums; however, they possess an extremely high body heat, so the water must have excellent temperature control to house other types of Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME住在热带海水中，鲜艳的颜色让它很受水族馆欢迎。不过，它体温极高，若要与其他宝可梦共养，就必须严密控制水温。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME live in tropical saltwater environments. Due to their bright colors, they are popular in aquariums; however, they possess an extremely high body heat, so the water must have excellent temperature control to house other types of Pokémon.

entry: 遇到危险，它会产生浓厚的烟雾，气味像新鲜小柑橘被咬开。这股香气会引来其他宝可梦，蜂拥而上，压制捕食者。
author: quackquackattack
source: It produces a thick smog whenever it is in danger, which smells like a fresh clementine being bitten. This scent draws in other Pokémon so that they swarm and overwhelm predators.

entry: POKENAME运用控火本领，为附近的野生宝可梦表演。它喜欢逗大家开心，会用火塑出一生中见过的事物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME utilizes its skill in pyromancy to create shows for wild Pokémon in its area. It loves to entertain, crafting shapes of things it has seen throughout its life.

entry: 烦躁时，POKENAME常懊恼地扯自己的耳朵。这会反射性地引发喷火，常不小心点燃东西，带来更多麻烦。
author: sk372
source: When feeling vexed, POKENAME often tugs its own ears out of frustration. This reflexively triggers its flame breath, which often leads to further problems as things get accidentally set ablaze.

entry: POKENAME栖在嘉珍果树上，用细小的火焰喷流烤果子，再趁烤熟的果实落地前，将其接住。
author: .izik
source: Perching in Jaboca Berry trees, POKENAME toasts berries with tiny flame jets. It catches the roasted fruit before it falls.

entry: 兴奋或受威胁时，POKENAME会吐出火焰、电流，或两者一同喷出。但持续太久后，就只能吐出黑烟与微弱的电火花。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME spit out flames and/or electricity when they get excited or when they feel threatened. If they do this for too long, however, they will only be able to spit out black smoke and weak electrical sparks.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME火焰的亮度会变成平时的五倍。晴朗的夜晚，整片田野都能被映得柔柔发亮。
author: .izik
source: During a full moon, POKENAME's flames burn five times brighter. Entire fields can glow softly from its light on clear nights.

entry: 它们在熔岩池中孵育，直到破壳。POKENAME的拥抱十分令人安心，因为岩壳散发的温柔暖意，恰如拥抱心爱之人的感觉。
author: joeofthealps
source: They incubate in lava pools before hatching. A hug from a POKENAME is known to be extremely comforting, as the gentle warmth that radiates from POKENAME's rocky shell perfectly mimics the feeling of embracing a loved one.

entry: POKENAME炽热的胃，几乎什么都能吃，因此常翻垃圾找食物。口中不停掉落滚烫的余烬，走到哪里，哪里的垃圾箱就容易起火。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's fiery stomachs let them eat almost anything, leading them to forage through trash for food. Hot embers constantly dribble from their mouths, often causing dumpster fires wherever they go.

entry: POKENAME贴着水面低飞，飞驰而过时，身后留下一道闪烁的热气。它会用火花攻击，将安瓢虫等猎物击落。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME skims low across bodies of water, leaving shimmering trails of heated air behind it as it speeds by. It knocks prey like Ledian out of the sky with its Ember attack.

entry: POKENAME虽然住在湿地，却只有在健康的生态中才能茁壮生活。若水中缺氧或水质不佳，它就会排出黑色黏液，清除体内毒素；但排出太多，也可能反被黏液呛住。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Despite living in wetlands, POKENAME only thrive in healthy ecosystems. If water quality is starved of oxygen or otherwise poor, they expel a black goo to remove toxins from their bodies, but releasing too much can cause them to choke on it.

entry: 火山岩石基部，常能看见POKENAME喷火。看它火焰的颜色，还能预知即将到来的喷发。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME are most commonly found on the rocky base of volcanoes spitting fire. The color of the flame can be used to predict an approaching eruption.

entry: 在雪松上休息时，若受到打扰，POKENAME就会轰然爆出火焰，留下烧焦的树皮。
author: .izik
source: If disturbed while resting in cedar trees, POKENAME explodes in a fiery burst. The sudden blast leaves scorched bark behind.

entry: 它产生的余烬微弱又短暂，因此靠爪和喙寻找植物的根来吃。不过，给它辛辣的辣酱，它就能喷出一团火，点起篝火。
author: quackquackattack
source: It relies on its claws and beak to hunt for roots, as the embers it produces are weak and transient. However, when given a spicy Chili Sauce, it is able to light bonfires with a burst of flame.

entry: 遇到危险，POKENAME会在嘴里含满蜂蜜，再化为炽烈的火焰，吐向敌人。它十分爱交往，若独处太久，就会情绪低落，失去食欲。
author: fiordaliso
source: When in danger, POKENAME fills its mouth with honey, which it then transforms into a fiery blast to spit at its enemies. It is a very sociable Pokémon; if left alone for too long, it becomes depressed and loses its appetite.

entry: POKENAME生气时，毛发会散发高热，周围积雪迅速融化，沿途留下一滩滩冒着蒸汽的水。
author: .izik
source: When angered, POKENAME's fur radiates intense heat. Snow around it melts rapidly, leaving steaming puddles in its path.

entry: POKENAME常见于冰冷的环境，有助于调节过热的体温。它常与机器及同类交换软件，一旦遇上恶意软件，就会过热。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME are commonly found in icy environments, which helps them regulate their superheated body. POKENAME often exchange software with machines and other POKENAME, which causes them to overheat if they ever encounter malware.

entry: POKENAME身体虽然炽热，却偏爱住在冰洞中，靠周围的寒冷，平衡体内的高热。
author: .izik
source: Despite its fiery body, POKENAME prefers to live in icy caves. The cold surroundings help balance its intense internal heat.

entry: POKENAME右半身散发高热，只有左半身能引导电力。它必须仔细平衡攻击，免得战斗中途耗尽体力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's right side radiates intense heat, while only the left can channel electricity. It must balance its attacks carefully to avoid exhaustion mid-battle.

entry: POKENAME火焰的品质，取决于受到的照顾好坏。因此，野生个体从小就会学习如何照顾自己。大多数个体的火焰都还不错，却始终还有提升空间。
author: ruben2309295
source: The quality of POKENAME's flames depends on how well they are treated. Because of this, wild POKENAME are taught from a young age how to take care of themselves. The quality of most POKENAME's flames is decent, though it can always be improved.

entry: POKENAME最常出现在含氧量较低、但仍有其他宝可梦生活的地方，靠矿物和情绪能量维生。在寒冷地区，它会乐意充当取暖器，给别人温暖。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME tend to be found most often in areas with lower oxygen levels as long as other Pokémon are also found in there. They sustain themselves on minerals and emotional energy. In cold areas, they willingly act like a space heather for others.

entry: POKENAME的食物，主要是吃土时摄取的矿物。它偏爱高温土壤，因此通常能在火山活动区看见它游荡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's diet consists primarily of minerals gained from eating dirt. It prefers highly heated soil, so it is typically seen roaming around areas with volcanic activity.

entry: POKENAME偏爱住在热沙中，直到体内的火焰足够强。等它开始吐出黄色火焰，就已经有力量，靠自己让洞穴暖和起来。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME prefer to live in hot sands until their own internal flames grow strong enough. Once they begin to spit out yellow fire, they have grown strong enough to keep their dens warm by themselves.

entry: POKENAME每天大部分时间，都在挖掘、扩建洞穴。疲倦时，喷出的火焰里就会混入黑烟。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME spend most of their days digging to expand their dens. When they become tired, black smoke becomes mixed with the flames they spew.

entry: 鳞片颜色反映着它的体温，从淡黄到极端时的亮洋红不等。它住在熔岩池附近，鳞片会变色，映现周围熔岩的色泽。
author: mistymagius
source: Its scale colors reflect its body temperature, ranging from a pale yellow to a bright magenta in extreme cases. It lives near lava pools; its scales change color to reflect the surrounding lava.

entry: POKENAME住在火山山脉中，能在熔岩隧道里找到。它喜欢家中的高热，还会彼此争斗，抢夺最温暖的筑巢位置。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live within volcanic mountain ranges and can be found within lava tubes. They enjoy the intense heat within their homes and battle with one another to have the right to nest in the warmest spots.

entry: POKENAME用围巾般的附肢拉伸弹性绳，发射火焰弹。野外很少见到它，却往往能在拆毁的建筑里发现；在那里，它爆炸般的胡闹，威胁较小。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME launches fiery projectiles by stretching its elastic cord with its scarf-like appendage. It is rarely seen in the wild, but tends to be found in demolished buildings where its explosive antics are less threatening.

entry: POKENAME先接连喷火，再用刀刃般的双臂快速斩击。它沿之字路线移动，迷惑、困住猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits bursts of flame before slashing rapidly with its bladed arms. It moves in a zigzag to confuse and trap prey.

entry: POKENAME头上花状的增生物，烫得一碰就会灼伤。不知为何，养在神奥西部的个体，花形会有所不同。
author: .izik
source: The flower-shaped growth on POKENAME's head is hot enough to scald upon contact. For unknown reasons, its shape differs in those raised in the western regions of Sinnoh.

entry: 这只POKENAME住在迷你烤箱里。看它烤点心的成色，就能判断健康状况——若点心没烤熟，它多半生病了。
author: hophoppip
source: This POKENAME inhabits a miniature oven. Its health can be gaged by how well it bakes treats — if the treats come out underbaked, it's most likely sick.

entry: POKENAME常在熔岩湖边休息。古代文化曾将它视为守护火山的自然之灵。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are often found resting around lava lakes. Ancient cultures once believed them to be nature spirits that guarded volcanoes.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，每次呼气，鼻子都会冒出一小团火，因此必须小心找个远离树木、灌木的地方睡。身体始终温暖，让它无论什么环境，都能安然休息。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it sleeps, POKENAME emits puffs of fire from its nose every time it exhales, so it must be careful to find a place to sleep far away from trees or bushes. Since its body is always very warm, it can rest without struggles in any environment.

entry: POKENAME在罂粟花田休息，吸收阳光。积蓄的能量越多，火焰攻击就越热，爆发力也越强。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rests in poppy fields, absorbing sunlight. The more energy it gathers, the hotter and more explosive its fire attacks become.

entry: POKENAME将半个身体埋进沙漠，吸收太阳的热量。到了黄昏，它就能将能量化为破坏力惊人的火焰攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME buries itself in halfway into the desert sand to absorb the sun's heat. By dusk, it's ready to channel this energy into devastating fire attacks.

entry: POKENAME遇险时会从天花板落下，以柔软的头部缓冲。嘴里却会不受控制地冒出小火苗。
author: chorb33
source: If POKENAME is in danger, it drops from the ceiling and cushions the fall with its soft head, uncontrollably emitting small flames from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME口中会分泌熔融的丝线，用滚烫的丝困住、灼烧毫无防备的猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME secretes strands of molten silk from its mouth. It uses this hot silk to trap and scorch unwary prey.

entry: POKENAME藏在石堆中，向小型宝可梦喷出大片火焰，捕捉猎物。它身体始终温暖，脾气也好，因此有训练家把它当加热垫，用来孵蛋。
