author: quietcognition
source: A POKENAME hides in piles of rocks and catches prey by spitting gouts of flame at small Pokémon. Its body is constantly warm and it has a good temper, so some Trainers use their POKENAME as a heating pad to incubate eggs.

entry: POKENAME的斗篷能保住温暖的体温，一暴露在外界空气中，身体就会迅速冷却。只要看得见头顶的羽饰升起蒸汽，人们就认为它很健康。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cloak lets it maintain its warm body temperature, which cools down quickly if exposed to the open air. POKENAME is considered healthy as long as one can see steam visibly rising from the plume on its head.

entry: POKENAME把下半身埋进土中，吸收阳光。叶片一被抓住，就会燃烧，以此自卫，但也会让它自己十分难受。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME bury their lower halves in the soil, soaking up sunlight. As a defense mechanism, their leaves will combust when grabbed, which causes a great deal of discomfort for these Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME将体内的花蜜煮沸，产生令人作呕的烟气，驱赶捕食者。烟味会停留数日，才完全散去。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME boil the nectar stored inside them to produce repulsive fumes, warding off predators. The smell of this smoke can linger for days before fully dissipating.

entry: POKENAME能喷出一团团黄焰，温度不高，光却极强。火焰燃烧时会吸收光，周围越冷、越暗，它反而烧得越热、越亮。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME create bursts of yellow flames that aren't very hot, but produce incredible amounts of light. The flames absorb light as they burn, growing hotter and brighter as the surrounding area gets colder and darker.

entry: 嘴与头顶都能喷火。有些POKENAME喜欢漂在绿洲中，散出的热量，让水汽升成大团云雾。
author: chorb33
source: It can spit flames from both its mouth and crown. Some POKENAME like to drift in oases, where their heat creates huge clouds of steam.

entry: 嘴与头顶都能喷火。有些POKENAME喜欢漂在绿洲中，散出的热量，让水汽升成大团云雾。
author: chorb33
source: It can spit flames from both its mouth and crown. Some POKENAME like to drift in oases, where their heat creates huge clouds of steam.

entry: 过热时，POKENAME会沉入池塘降温。水碰到皮肤，嘶嘶作响，周围常升起蒸汽。
author: .izik
source: When overheated, POKENAME cools itself by sinking into ponds. Steam often rises around it as the water hisses against its skin.

entry: POKENAME住在水族馆，与其他水生宝可梦一同表演。它或许不是主角，但心形的火焰，让它成为每场演出不可或缺的一员。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live in aquariums where they perform shows alongside other aquatic Pokémon. While they may not be the main attraction, their heart-shaped flames make them a vital part of any performance.

entry: 摇滚演出时，POKENAME会待在后台，制造装满烟的泡泡。轮到为主唱营造烟雾缭绕的神秘氛围时，它就喷水，将泡泡打破。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are kept backstage during rock shows to produce bubbles full of smoke. They spray water to pop their own bubbles when it is time to create a smoky mystique around the lead singer.

entry: POKENAME虽然制造大量烟雾，却必须不断有新鲜空气，才能正常呼吸。若吸入自己的烟气太久，它可能头痛，甚至昏倒。
author: quackquackattack
source: Despite creating lots of smoke, POKENAME need a constant flow of fresh air to breathe properly. If they breathe in their own fumes for too long, they may develop a headache or even pass out.

entry: POKENAME偏头痛特别厉害时，头上会冒出蒸汽。等疼痛终于退去，它才如释重负，呼出一大团黑烟。
author: sk372
source: Steam rises from POKENAME's head when it is suffering from a particularly strong migraine. When the pain finally subsides, it exhales a thick cloud of dark smoke in relief.

entry: POKENAME在新涌出的熔岩流中玩耍，划着熔岩前进，还会嬉笑着向彼此泼洒熔岩。受惊时，它会迅速游开，躲进熔岩流深处，避开危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME play in fresh lava flows, paddling through the flow and playfully splashing one another with the molten rock. When they're startled, they rapidly swim away from whatever scared them, escaping deeper into the lava flow to safety.

entry: POKENAME很受水疗度假村欢迎，许多度假村会请一两只加入员工队伍。它会被鼓励定期到室外泳池游泳，以极高的体温自然加热池水。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular in spa resorts, with many resorts keeping one or two POKENAME on their staff. They are encouraged to take regular swims in a spa's outdoor pools, heating the water passively with their extremely high body temperature.

entry: POKENAME用长根接上燃气管线，把小小的余烬化为炽烈火柱。火焰瞄准虫属性宝可梦，将猎物烧成焦炭，供它食用。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME connect to gas pipelines with their long roots to turn their small embers into fiery plumes. Their flames target Bug-type Pokémon, turning their prey into charred remains for them to consume.

entry: POKENAME挥舞法杖，引导自己的火焰能力。翱翔时，它会用喙紧紧衔住法杖。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wields a staff that channels its fire abilities. It grips the staff tightly in its beak while soaring through the air.

entry: POKENAME主要见于火山口，形似鬼火。它天生爱捣蛋，会从口鼻喷出余烬，吓走别人。
author: princessmilandria
source: Primarily found in volcanic craters, POKENAME resembles a will-o-wisp. This Pokémon is a trickster by nature, scaring others off by shooting embers out of its mouth and nose.

entry: POKENAME咀嚼叶片，为进化作准备。吃东西时，尾巴会滴下气味难闻的奶。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME chews on leaves in preparation for evolution. A foul-scented milk drips from its tail while it eats.

entry: POKENAME偶尔会被带到宝可梦研究所和训练家学校，教人如何正确给融合体分类。谁答错了，它就朝谁喷奶。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are occasionally brought into Pokémon labs and Trainer Schools to teach how to properly classify fusions. If someone gives an incorrect answer, POKENAME spits milk at them.

entry: POKENAME这一窝蛋里，只有少数能产奶。其余成员会团结起来，坚定地保护它们，不许外来者靠近。
author: sk372
source: Only a few eggs within POKENAME's clutch are able to provide milk. The rest of the group will rally together and staunchly defend them from outsiders.

entry: POKENAME能产出美味的椰奶，甜味尤其足，很适合烘焙甜点。头上的叶子若渗出奶油，就表示它很健康。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME produces a delicious coconut milk that, being especially sweet, is well suited for baking desserts. When the leaves on its head ooze cream, it is a sign that it is in good health.

entry: POKENAME太爱喝奶，常急着一口喝完，反而泼了自己一身。任谁劝，也止不住它为洒出的牛奶哭泣。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME love drinking milk so much that they often spill milk over themselves in their haste to drink it all. No matter what anyone says, they will continue to cry over their spilt milk.

entry: POKENAME母性很强。它会寻找失去父母的宝可梦，用奶喂养，再将其抚育长大。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME has a very motherly nature. It searches for orphaned Pokémon and feeds them with its milk, then fosters them.

entry: POKENAME锻炼完后挤出的奶，营养更丰富。它的奶尤其能促进腿部肌肉，非常适合锻炼下半身的运动员。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's milk is more nutritious if extracted after it has finished exercising. Its milk is particularly adept at stimulating the leg muscles and is perfect for athletes working on training their lower body.

entry: POKENAME战斗或训练后产出的奶，营养含量更高。这种奶很受欢迎，常被用于许多运动员饮用的蛋白饮品。
author: sk372
source: Milk sourced from a POKENAME after it has battled or trained contains a higher amount of nutrients. Its milk is quite popular as an ingredient in protein drinks used by many athletes.

entry: POKENAME总在用舌头舔东西，确认味道。挤奶前最后舔过的几样东西，会让奶呈现不同的风味与口感。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is always licking things with its tongue to ascertain their taste. Its milk can take on different flavors and textures depending on the last few things it licked before being milked.

entry: 通过特殊工序稀释有毒的奶，就能制出最高等级的乳制品，受到世界各地许多烘焙师、厨师和制酪师的珍视。
author: hippokritikal
source: By diluting its toxic milk with a special process, the highest grade dairy products can be made. They are prized by many bakers, chefs, and cheesemakers around the globe.

entry: POKENAME有时会在马拉松比赛中，为跑者提供点心。它不知疲倦地沿赛道奔跑，带着冰淇淋等甜食，帮助运动员补充体力。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are sometimes employed within marathons to provide treats for the runners. They tirelessly run alongside the marathon route, carrying desserts like ice cream for the athletes to help them keep their energy up.

entry: POKENAME富含矿物的食谱，会让产出的冰淇淋有不同风味。它最爱吃富含石英的岩石，这会带来浓郁的椰子味。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's mineral-rich diet leads to it producing varying flavours of ice cream. Its preferred diet of quartz-rich rocks produces a strong coconut flavour.

entry: POKENAME既能产奶又能生蛋，是农场的宠儿。不过，照顾幼崽时，它两样都不产，因此有些训练家会设法阻止它繁殖。
author: aberry8286
source: Being able to produce both milk and eggs, POKENAME is a favorite on farms. They don't give either when caring for young, so some Trainers try to keep them from breeding.

entry: 藤蔓般的乳房，只要有一处被抓住，它就会喷奶，让敌人晕头转向，好迅速逃走。
author: hippokritikal
source: If any of its vine-like udders are grabbed, it sprays milk to disorient and confuse foes, allowing it to make a quick escape.

entry: POKENAME的幼崽能在袋中喝到亲代的奶。为了喂饱孩子，它每天都要吃下许多树果。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's offspring can feed off its parent's milk from inside the pouch. POKENAME eats a lot of berries a day in order to provide for its offspring.

entry: POKENAME是出色的家长，宝可梦培育家常请它到托儿所工作。幼年宝可梦学会乖巧的举止后，它就会让小家伙喝奶，作为奖励。
author: ultron_suprem3
source: POKENAME are great parents, often employed at daycares by Pokémon Breeders. As a reward for learning good behavior, POKENAME allow young Pokémon to drink their milk as a treat.

entry: POKENAME的幼崽能在袋中喝到亲代的奶。它也曾抚育失去父母的宝可梦，让小家伙在袋外吃奶。为了供养孩子，它每天都要吃下许多树果。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's offspring can feed off its parent's milk from inside the pouch, and the parent has been known to foster orphaned Pokémon and let it feed on the outside. POKENAME eats a lot of berries a day in order to provide for its offspring.

entry: POKENAME的奶，以含有少量墨汁而闻名。许多人对此却步，不少厨师却想出了融入菜肴的方法，食客的反应也各不相同。
author: ned666_
source: The milk produced by POKENAME is noted for also containing small traces of ink. While many people are put off by this milk, many chefs have found ways to incorporate it into their dishes, which has produced varied reactions from customers.

entry: POKENAME会从口中射出奶弹，伏击捕食者，也伏击猎物。奶有毒，对人有害，因此非常不建议饮用。
author: ned666_
source: POKENAME shoot bullets of milk from their mouth to ambush both predators and prey alike. The milk they shoot is poisonous and harmful to humans, so the consumption of POKENAME milk is highly discouraged.

entry: 烹调时，POKENAME的奶与自身的肉格外相配。关都的厨师尤其推崇简单汆煮的做法，让奶的微甜平衡细腻的鱼味，又不喧宾夺主。
author: .izik
source: The milk POKENAME produces pairs exceptionally well with its own flesh in cooking. Chefs across Kanto prize it in a simple poached preparation, where the milk's mild sweetness balances the delicate flavor of the fish without overpowering it.

entry: POKENAME数十只成群游动，寻找海草地，再一起心满意足地吃草。面对捕食者，它们会角朝前，结队高速冲去，吓退危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swim in schools of several dozen individuals in search of fields of seagrass, where they graze contentedly together. They swim together at high speed at predators, charging horn-first to scare the danger away.

entry: POKENAME将奶储存在中央的宝石中，随时都能高速喷出，力道足以将较大的宝可梦击退很远。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stores its milk in the jewel in its center. At any time, it can spray out its milk reserves at a high velocity, enough to knock larger Pokémon back quite a distance.

entry: POKENAME背上的星星会旋转，帮助产奶，转得越快，奶量越大。转到最快时，它能从核心喷出奶，力道与高压清洗机相当。
author: sk372
source: The star on POKENAME's back spins to help it produce milk, increasing the flow the faster it spins. At its maximum speed, POKENAME can fire out milk from its core with the same force as a pressure washer.

entry: POKENAME用超能力配合哑剧动作，造出有实体的墙壁。墙由凝固的奶组成，摸起来冰凉，稍稍有些湿。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's miming movements can create physical walls using its psychic abilities. The walls it constructs are made of solidified milk, and are cold and slightly wet to the touch.

entry: POKENAME会给刀刃般的手臂覆一层薄奶，避免不小心割到无意伤害的东西。生气时，它会振翅嗡鸣警告，尽量避免动手。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME cover their bladed arms in a thin coating of milk, the liquid helping them avoid accidentally cutting anything they don't intend to. They buzz their wings in warning when they're angry in an effort to avoid getting into a fight.

entry: POKENAME不停地像跳舞般左右摇摆，节奏随心情改变。这支不歇的舞极具感染力，常引来整群大奶罐跟随，一同摇晃。
author: anonymous_moose
source: POKENAME constantly moves as if it is dancing, swaying from side to side in a rhythm that changes with its mood. This nonstop dance is infectious, often gathering entire herds of Miltank to follow it and sway in unison.

entry: POKENAME从尾巴射出的奶，带着很强的电荷。喷到未接电源的设备上，不知为何，只要奶没干，就能持续供电。
author: .izik
source: The milk POKENAME fires from its tail carries a strong electrical charge. If sprayed onto an unplugged device, it somehow powers the device for as long as it remains wet.

entry: POKENAME口中喷出的东西，看似白焰，其实是滚烫的奶。熔岩虫等某些火属性宝可梦，对它的奶格外着迷。
author: sk372
source: What appears to be white flames breathed out from POKENAME's mouth is actually scalding-hot milk. Certain Fire-type Pokémon such a Slugma are particularly drawn to its milk.

entry: 白天，POKENAME会用许多尖牙，高效地啃食、嚼碎、吞下大片长草。夜间，它钻进地下取暖，几乎一动不动，消化白日的大餐。
author: anonymous_moose
source: While the sun is out, POKENAME is incredibly efficient at grazing, mulching, and gobbling acres of long grass with its many sharp teeth. At night it burrows into the ground for warmth and lies nearly motionless as it digests the previous day's feast.

entry: POKENAME总产奶量虽然超过大奶罐，奶却更稠、味道更重，因此反而没那么受欢迎。
author: kungfucutbug
source: Although POKENAME produces more milk overall than Miltank, the milk is thicker and has a stronger taste, resulting in it being less popular.

entry: POKENAME在陆地无助地扑腾，自己的奶喷溅四处，弄得到处一团糟。奶本身极其寡淡，气味也不好闻。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME flops around helplessly on land, it sprays and splatters its own milk, creating a mess everywhere. The milk itself is incredibly bland and has an unappealing scent.

entry: POKENAME毒针中的毒素并不特别强，却偏偏会给大奶罐添麻烦。被它扎过的大奶罐，可能长达一周都产不出奶。
author: sk372
source: The venom in POKENAME's stinger is not especially strong, but is problematic for Miltank specifically. A Miltank stung by POKENAME may not be able to produce milk for up to a week.

entry: 野外见到的POKENAME，几乎总是凶暴不已。给它挤奶，似乎能暂时平息脾气；但要靠得够近，尝试挤奶，本身就很危险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is almost always seen behaving viciously in the wild. Milking it does appear to soothe its temper for a time, but getting close enough to attempt the process is quite the dangerous endeavor.

entry: POKENAME救助海上迷失的人与宝可梦，将其送往安全处。它也会提供奶，帮对方恢复在获救前消耗的力量与耐力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rescues and ferries people and Pokémon lost at sea. It offers its milk to them as well to help restore any strength or stamina they may have lost before it arrived.

entry: POKENAME的身体由黏软、奶酪般的物质构成。据说，吃下少量它的身体，有助于健康成长。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's body is made of a gooey, cheesy substance. Ingesting a small amount of POKENAME is said to aid in healthy growth.

entry: POKENAME性情温和，农场会用它教新来的帮工，学习如何给宝可梦挤奶。奶的风味与口感，会随周围环境，慢慢发生变化。
author: sk372
source: Due to its gentle demeanor, farms will use POKENAME to train new farmhands on how to milk Pokémon. POKENAME's milk changes in flavor and texture over time depending on its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME跳进水里，奶制的鬃毛就会影响整片水域，几秒内将水完全染白。等它跳出水，效果便会消失。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's milk mane affects any body of water it jumps into, turning it completely white in seconds. The effects vanish once POKENAME leaps back out of the water.

entry: 喝下POKENAME的奶，舌头会轻轻噼啪作响，留下微微酥麻的感觉。它很适合制作奶昔，让每一口都多了出乎意料的活泼滋味。
author: .izik
source: The milk POKENAME produces crackles faintly on the tongue after drinking, leaving a mild tingling sensation. It is popular in milkshakes, where this effect adds an unexpected liveliness to each sip.

entry: POKENAME会向敌人吐出大团冒着热气的奶，阻止其靠近，同时在体内加热火焰。热量充足后，就从口中喷出火，形状会随敌人的大小变化。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits steaming milk in large globs at foes to keep them at bay while it heats flames within its body. Once fully heated, it bursts these flames from its mouth in shapes that vary based on the foe's size.

entry: POKENAME吃下的代码越多，奶就越甜。常能在农场、农业主题的网页上，看见它逗留。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's milk grows sweeter the more code it consumes. It is often found lingering on webpages themed around farms and agriculture.

entry: 有关POKENAME壳体形成的研究表明，壳由一种硬奶酪构成。内部复杂的膜组织负责凝乳、过滤，再一层层叠上新薄片，造就轻便而坚固的壳。
author: anonymous_moose
source: A study into the formation of POKENAME's shell has revealed that it is constructed from a type of hard cheese. Complex internal membranes are dedicated to curdling, filtering, and layering new sheets to build up this lightweight yet durable shell.

entry: POKENAME从壳与触手喷出高压奶流，在水中迅速移动。这些奶流也能突然以不透明的液体冲向捕食者，让其迷失方向。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME manoeuvre quickly through the water by firing pressurised jets of milk from their shell and tentacles. These jets of milk are also used to confuse predators by blasting them with a sudden wash of opaque liquid.

entry: POKENAME用黏性触手附在较大的宝可梦身上，紧紧抓牢，搭便车游向新的觅食地。曾有吼鲸王被观察到，全身附着了整群的它们。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME latch onto larger Pokémon with their sticky tentacles, hanging on tightly whilst their host swims them to new feeding grounds. Some Wailord have been observed with entire herds of POKENAME encrusting their bodies.

entry: 茧中的身体，让POKENAME难以移动，也缺少防御手段。它主要靠向接近者的眼睛喷奶，阻止其他宝可梦靠近。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cocooned body leaves it little in the way of mobility or defenses. Its primary means of deterrence is spraying milk in the eyes of Pokémon that draw near it.

entry: POKENAME在海底滚动加速，身后留下一团奶云。周围的水短暂浑浊后，奶云便会散去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rolls across ocean floors to build speed, leaving behind a cloud of milk in its wake. This briefly obscures the surrounding water before dispersing.

entry: POKENAME稳定地产奶，奶从镰刀末端滴下。它会留下几滩美味的奶，诱来口渴的猎物，趁对方停下喝奶时狩猎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME produces a steady amount of milk that drips from the end of its scythes. It plants puddles of the tasty liquid to lure in thirsty prey that it can hunt when they stop for a drink.

entry: POKENAME在空中领地意识极强，但抚育一窝幼崽时，育雏的天性会让它暂时温顺。幼崽很爱喝它的奶，可真正尝过的人却寥寥无几。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: Though POKENAME is highly territorial over the skies, when it raises a clutch, its broodiness temporarily makes it docile. Its hatchlings love its milk, but few people have ever had a chance to try it.

entry: POKENAME虽能产出巨量的奶，却也需要吃下海量食物，才能保持健康。战斗之外，实际每年只有几次能挤奶。吃下的树果不同，奶的味道也不同。
author: bobosmith01
source: While POKENAME can output enormous amounts of milk, it also requires an exorbitant amount of food to stay healthy, and can only be realistically milked outside of battle a few times a year. Its milk has different flavors based on the Berries it eats.

entry: POKENAME的奶营养太丰富，竟在腹部形成了一方微型生态。它优先选择不动，确保这个小小的环境不会被毁掉。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The milk from POKENAME is so nutrient-rich that it has created a microcosm on their bellies. POKENAME prioritizes not moving to ensure the miniature environment is not destroyed.

entry: POKENAME白色的羽毛极细，随风飘动时，远看如同奶油。羽毛摸起来很冷，几乎能冻结碰到的一切。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's white feathers are incredibly fine and resemble cream from a distance based on how they dance in the wind. The feathers themselves are cold to the touch and can freeze nearly anything they contact.

entry: 关于喝下POKENAME翼上的奶，就能拥有无比活力与健康的传说，多不胜数。其实，奶中不断流过的电荷，使其极难入口，几乎没人喝得下。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Legends abound that drinking the milk from POKENAME's wings grants unmatched vitality and good health. In reality, the constant electric charge passing through the liquid makes it extremely unpalatable and very few people can even stomach it.

entry: 成群的POKENAME飞在雷云前方，寻找新的觅食地，雷鸣般的哞声能传出许多英里。虽从未被观察到制造风暴，它们仍常被视为坏天气的预兆。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Herds of POKENAME fly ahead of storm clouds, their thunderous mooing carrying for many miles as they seek out new feeding grounds. Though they have never been observed creating a storm, they are often regarded as heralds of poor weather.

entry: POKENAME周身灼热，翼、头和尾巴上都有滚烫的奶。喷出一些火后，身体便会冷却到足以触碰奶，而不被烫伤的程度。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body burns with scalding-hot milk across its wings, head and tail. After it has breathed out some fire, its body cools enough that the milk can be touched without getting burned.

entry: POKENAME蜕皮后，会把脱下的皮吃掉。其中的营养，让它的奶在接下来几天都格外浓郁。
author: sk372
source: After POKENAME sheds its skin, it consumes what was discarded. The shed skin fills it with nutrients that make its milk taste much more flavorful for several days.

entry: POKENAME从颈部与尾巴的黑色晶体释放能量，身体随之散发乳白色气场，改变天气。有关天空降奶的奇异现象，也与它有关。
author: catnip2390
source: POKENAME discharge energy through the black crystals on their necks and tails. This causes their bodies to give off a milky aura that changes the weather. Reports of a strange phenomenon where milk rains from the sky are linked to this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME友善地行走各地，帮助虚弱、营养不良的生灵。它的奶，尤其有益于年幼、正在发育的龙属性宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a friendly creature that travels the land to help out the weak and malnourished. Its milk is especially beneficial to young and developing Dragon-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的奶带着鲜明的蜂蜜味，通常用于制作甜点，直接取自它双手时，味道最好。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's milk has a distinct taste of honey to it. It's usually used to make desserts and tastes best when directly from POKENAME's hands.

entry: POKENAME虽拥有庞大的超能力，却很温顺，通常整天在吃草。它以超能力将产出的奶塑成梦幻，在进食时阻挡捕食者。
author: santon5512
source: Despite the large amount of psychic power they possess, POKENAME are quite tame, usually spending their day grazing on grass. They use these psychic powers to form Mew that are made from the milk they produce and keep predators at bay while they eat.

entry: POKENAME的奶，被认为是包治百病的灵药，因此极受追捧。有人认为，听到隐约的牛铃声，就表示附近可能有它；可它实在罕见，让人难以相信。
author: chibitales
source: Milk produced by POKENAME is thought to be a universal panacea, making it highly sought after. Hearing a subtle cowbell ringing is thought to indicate that POKENAME may be in the area, but their rarity makes this difficult to believe.

entry: POKENAME叶上滴下的奶，落在哪里，哪里的乳草就更容易生长。奶散发的花香，隔着很远也能闻到。
author: .izik
source: The milk that drips from POKENAME's leaf causes milkweed to grow more easily wherever it falls. The floral scent this milk produces can be detected from great distances.

entry: 在所有植物中，POKENAME最爱吃乳草。进食时，身体产出的奶油，也会带上花的风味与香气。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers to eat milkweed above all other plants. While feeding, the cream its body produces takes on a floral taste and scent.

entry: POKENAME的花会产生乳状物，药剂师将其混入药中，治疗矿物质缺乏。许多使用者说，副作用是呼吸带上奇怪的甜香，但整体健康也改善了。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME's flower produces a milky substance that pharmacists mix into medications to treat mineral deficiencies. Though many clients report a side effect of an odd, sweet smell in their breath, they also say their overall health has improved.

entry: POKENAME一受惊，背上就会涌出大量奶。奶相当热，被喷中时，会造成轻微灼伤。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME releases a large gush of milk from its back whenever it is startled. The milk comes out quite hot, causing mild burns to those struck by the gushing fluid.

entry: POKENAME兴奋时，会喷出一股股过热的奶，烫得不能直接碰。但只要拿杯子接得准，路过的人就能从野生个体那里，得到一杯急需的饮品。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME release bursts of super-heated milk when they're excited. The milk is scalding hot to the touch, but careful timing with a cup can lead to wild POKENAME providing those passing by with a much-needed drink.

entry: 咖啡馆里，POKENAME十分常见，热奶鬃毛的温度，正适合调制咖啡与热巧克力。它每天产出的奶，够做近100杯咖啡。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are a common sight at cafés, their mane of hot milk being the perfect temperature for coffees and hot chocolates. They produce enough milk to make nearly 100 cups of coffee per day.

entry: POKENAME游泳时吞下大量水，让产出的奶保持顺滑。缺水会让奶严重结块、凝结。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swallows massive quantities of water while swimming to keep the milk it produces smooth. Dehydration causes its milk to clump and curdle badly.

entry: POKENAME会迁徙，每年特定时节，总在同一片草地吃草。迁徙季曾有它们飞越多个国家的追踪记录，但它们总会回到原来的草地。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are migratory Pokémon that always graze on the same fields at specific times each year. They have been tracked flying across multiple countries during the migratory season, but they always return to the same fields.

entry: POKENAME游泳时，奶会像汗一样从皮肤渗出，让周围的水浑浊，帮助它在狩猎时更好地隐藏。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaves milk behind as it sweats through its skin while swimming. This clouds the water around it, allowing it to hunt while better concealed.

entry: POKENAME用装满奶的大尾巴撑起身体，察看危险。若麻烦靠近，它就向后压回尾巴，将奶高速挤出，盼能击晕目标。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its large, milk-filled tail to raise itself up and look for danger. If trouble approaches, it falls back onto its tail to force the milk out at high velocity and hopefully stun its target.

entry: POKENAME采集的树果，会直接影响奶的味道与口感。农场主常给它喂不同水果，调出特色风味。
author: .izik
source: Berries gathered by POKENAME directly affect the taste and texture of its milk. Farmers often feed it different fruits to create specialty flavors.

entry: 饲养POKENAME十分讲究，每天必须严格按时挤奶，否则它会烦躁。但若在其他时间试着挤奶，它反而会更加生气。
author: sk372
source: Raising POKENAME is a finicky process, as it must be milked at a strict time every day or become agitated. However, trying to milk it any other time will cause it to become even more incensed.

entry: POKENAME的眉部其实是凝固的奶，睡着便会化回液体。它目光敏锐，哪怕还没出现通常的酸败征兆，也能轻易看出奶和奶酪快坏了。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's brow is actually solidified milk, which turns back into liquid once it falls asleep. Its eyes are sharp enough to easily tell when milks and cheeses are about to spoil, even when the usual signs of souring haven't shown up yet.

entry: POKENAME常把奶分给绿毛虫、刺尾虫等年幼的小虫宝可梦，帮助成长。喂奶时，它会用许多拳头，拍开试图捕食小家伙的来者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME often shares its milk with small and young insect Pokémon like Caterpie and Wurmple to help their growth. It uses its many fists to swat away at anything trying to pick them off while it feeds them.

entry: 黄昏，能见到POKENAME飞行，留下乳白色的粉尘。满月时，它的奶会像气泡水一样充满气泡，但没人确切知道这种现象如何发生。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME can be seen flying at dusk, leaving a milky dust behind it. On a full moon, POKENAME's milk becomes carbonated like sparkling water, but no one is quite sure how this phenomenon is possible.

entry: POKENAME的网，由身体产出的奶凝成细丝织就。要丢弃旧网时，它会把乳丝吃掉，补充营养。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's webs are made of a thin, solidified milk produced from its body. When it comes time to discard a web it has created, it consumes the milky thread for additional nutrients.

entry: POKENAME的奶十分黏稠，能拿来织网。奶中的营养，让它的幼崽拥有很强的消化系统。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's milk is so viscous that it uses it to make its webs. Its offspring have very strong digestive systems due to the nutrients in the milk.

entry: POKENAME给成长中的超音蝠喂奶，免得它们去捕食其他宝可梦。受它哺育过的超音蝠，性情会明显温和些。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME offers its milk to growing Zubat to keep them from preying on other Pokémon. Zubat that have spent time being nurtured by POKENAME become decidedly less aggressive in nature.

entry: 成群的POKENAME会占据大片草地，作为牧场。若小型宝可梦侵入觅食地，它们就会合作，头朝下向竞争者俯冲，将其赶走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flocks claim large swathes of grassland as their grazing grounds. They work together to chase off smaller Pokémon that encroach on their feeding grounds by dive-bombing at their competitors headfirst.

entry: POKENAME会从触角喷出高压奶，蒙住想捕食它的宝可梦的眼睛。储奶过多，它会紧张得无意间放出电火花。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME sprays pressurized milk from its antennae to blind Pokémon that try to hunt it. If it stores too much milk, it becomes so nervous that it releases electric sparks unintentionally.

entry: POKENAME通常住在海里，触角喷出的奶，也像海水一样咸。十分激动时，它全身都会迸出电火花，最好别靠近。
author: fiordaliso
source: The milk it sprays from its antennae is as salty as the seawater where POKENAME usually lives. When it gets very agitated, its body is covered in sparks, and it is recommended not to approach it.

entry: POKENAME的奶微微发光，能看见光沿着饮用者的喉咙流下。它常出现在农场附近的湖中。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's milk has a slight glow to it that can be seen going down the throat of whoever drinks it. This Pokémon is often seen in lakes near farms.

entry: POKENAME的奶微微发光，能看见光沿着饮用者的喉咙流下。它常出现在农场附近的湖中。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's milk has a slight glow to it that can be seen going down the throat of whoever drinks it. This Pokémon is often seen in lakes near farms.

entry: POKENAME喝到最爱的奶时，双颊会飞出小小电火花。它挑食得出了名，给了不喜欢的乳制品，就可能发脾气。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Small sparks fly from POKENAME's cheeks when they drink their favorite milk. POKENAME are infamous for being picky and may have a tantrum if given a dairy product they dislike.

entry: 它在满月下跳舞时，附近的乳制品也会自行移动，仿佛跟着起舞。POKENAME无意识地控制着这些东西，一试图有意施展，本领便会消失。
author: .izik
source: While dancing in the full moon, nearby dairy objects move on their own as if dancing alongside it. POKENAME controls these items subconsciously and loses the ability the moment it tries to use it intentionally.

entry: POKENAME有弹性的身体里装满了奶。它能从口中把奶全部喷空，但这样一来，就没法再蹦跳了。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME's elastic body is filled with milk.  It can empty itself by squirting the milk out of its mouth, but it then loses the ability to bounce around.

entry: POKENAME会寻找其他大奶罐融合体照顾自己，几乎一见面，就把对方认作照顾者。据说，以这种方式收养它的融合体，会得到强大的好运祝福。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME seeks out other Miltank fusions to take care of it, imprinting on them almost on sight. It's said that adopting a POKENAME in this manner grants the fusion that does so a powerful blessing of good fortune.

entry: POKENAME只会与自己感知到内心善良、温柔的对象分享奶。据说，喝下它的奶，此后几天都会有很好的运气。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME only shares its milk with those it senses have a kind and gentle heart. Drinking its milk is said to give a person great luck for several days after ingestion.

entry: 用POKENAME的奶制成的农家鲜奶酪，过去曾被用于预言仪式。传说，吃下后能短暂窥见未来。
author: .izik
source: Cottage cheese made from milk produced by POKENAME was once used in prophetic rituals. Legends say consuming it could grant fleeting glimpses of the future.

entry: 喝下POKENAME的奶，会获得片刻清明。你可能想起车钥匙放在哪儿，也可能懊悔多年前做过的事。这种感觉，很快就会消失。
author: musicsheep.
source: Drinking POKENAME's milk gives you momentary clarity. You might remember where you put your car keys, or you might regret something you did years ago. The feeling is short-lived.

entry: 喝下POKENAME的奶，会暂时思路清明。你可能突破写作瓶颈，写出杰作；可效果一过，转眼又忘了原本想写什么。
author: musicsheep.
source: Drinking POKENAME's milk gives you short-term clarity. You might overcome writers block and write a masterpiece, only to soon forget what you were going to write when it wears off.

entry: POKENAME的皮毛华美顺滑，质感宛如打发的奶油。许多农场主饲养它，获取美味的奶。
author: mepp.
source: The coat of POKENAME has a luxurious and smooth texture akin to whipped cream. Many farmers raise it for its tasty milk.

entry: POKENAME给羽毛覆上厚厚一层奶，抵御寄生虫。奶有轻微抗菌作用，某些传统药方会用它帮助病者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME coat their feathers with a thick layer of milk to ward off parasites. Their milk has a mild antibiotic effect and has been used in some traditional medicines to help the sick.

entry: POKENAME通常养在农场，提供羊毛与奶。没有覆毛的部位，则包着一层薄薄的防电皮肤。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME are usually kept on farms for their wool and milk. The parts of POKENAME not covered in wool are covered in a thin, shockproof leather.

entry: POKENAME的奶很甜，还微微发光。身体一亮，就表示可以挤奶了。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's milk is really sweet and has a slight glow to it. When its body glows, POKENAME's ready for milking.

entry: POKENAME的奶很甜，还微微发光。身体一亮，就表示可以挤奶了。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's milk is really sweet and has a slight glow to it. When its body glows, POKENAME's ready for milking.

entry: POKENAME的奶很甜，还微微发光。身体一亮，就表示可以挤奶了。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's milk is really sweet and has a slight glow to it. When its body glows, POKENAME's ready for milking.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，头上奶酪般的花会释放粉末，引来其他植物宝可梦。它们不由得在附近起舞，不知怎么，就让奶的品质提高了。
author: .izik
source: The cheese-like flowers on POKENAME's head release a powder while it dances that attracts other plant-based Pokémon. This compels them to dance nearby, somehow increasing the quality of its milk.

entry: POKENAME沉重的尾巴，能发动强劲攻击，却又覆有油性物质，可以浮起来。它们住在清新翠绿的草地附近的池塘中。
author: lydiaprower8
source: The heavy tails of POKENAME allow powerful attacks, yet are covered in an oily substance that allows them to float. They live in ponds near fresh, green, grassy fields.

entry: POKENAME尾尖的球体装满乳状液体，不论变得多重，都能靠它浮起来。每次尾巴移动，都能听到轻轻的晃水声。
author: .izik
source: The sphere at the tip of POKENAME's tail is filled with a milky fluid that allows it to float regardless of how heavy it becomes. A faint sloshing noise can be heard whenever the tail moves.

entry: POKENAME的毛发覆有乳状残留物，清掉后，不久又会重新形成。蚊香蝌蚪、鲤鱼王等宝可梦，有时会吸它的毛尝奶，让它很不高兴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's hair is coated with a milky residue that reforms shortly after if cleaned off. Pokémon such as Poliwag and Magikarp may attempt to suck on its hair to taste the milk, to POKENAME's displeasure.

entry: POKENAME飘过草地时，会将奶滴在花上。奶带有淡淡的三叶草与蒲公英香，富含抗氧化物，在城都各地的保健饮品中很受欢迎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drips milk onto flowers as it drifts over meadows. The liquid carries a light clover-and-dandelion scent and is high in antioxidants, making it popular in wellness tonics across Johto.

entry: 气温高得让它受不了时，POKENAME的头部就会产生乳白色液体。液体迅速蒸发，帮助它在热天保持凉爽。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME produce a milky-white liquid from their head whenever the air temperature gets too warm for them. The liquid evaporates quickly, helping them stay cool on hot days.

entry: POKENAME的花散发刺鼻气味，像发霉的奶酪。大多数其他宝可梦都被熏走，它便能自在吃草，无须竞争。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's flower releases a pungent odour similar to that of mouldy cheese. The smell drives away most other Pokémon, leaving POKENAME free to graze without competition.

entry: POKENAME有特殊的乳房与加压腺体，能造出一团团轻盈蓬松的打发奶油。它灵巧地控制奶油团，随气流漂浮，远行长途。
author: anonymous_moose
source: POKENAME has specialized udders and pressurized glands allowing it to form puffs of light and airy whipped cream. It exerts deft control over these puffs in order to drift along air currents and travel great distances.

entry: POKENAME定期把奶涂在双翼上，保持羽毛光亮洁净。它梳理羽毛，以奶作润滑，帮助清除夹在翼中的寄生虫与刺激物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME keep their feathers glossy and clean by regularly slicking their wings with milk. They preen their feathers and use their milk as a lubricant to help remove parasites and irritants caught in their wings.

entry: POKENAME精力充沛，整天跑个不停。累了就赶紧喝一口奶，转身又继续飞奔。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME runs around all day, full of energy. Eventually, when it gets tired, it takes a quick milk drink and goes right back to dashing around.

entry: POKENAME看起来像一只装着哞哞鲜奶炼乳、还冒出嫩芽的罐子。它产出的奶甜而浓稠，与咖啡、茶都十分相配。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME look like a can of condensed Moomoo Milk that has a sprout coming out of the can. They produce a sweet and dense milk that pairs perfectly with both coffee and tea.

entry: POKENAME能产生一种植物奶，作为纯素的替代品。吸收的阳光越多，产奶也越多。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME makes a type of plant milk that is used as a vegan alternative. It produces more of that milk the more sunlight it absorbs.

entry: 成群的POKENAME飞行速度接近音速，一天能飞过许多英里，寻找新的觅食地。农场主一听见那标志性的振翅嗡鸣靠近，就赶紧遮好庄稼。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Swarms of POKENAME are able to fly at almost supersonic speeds, covering many miles in a day in search of new feeding grounds. Farmers listen for the telltale drone of their wings, rushing to cover their crops if they hear an approaching swarm.

entry: POKENAME头侧的孔洞不断渗液，液体沿身体滴下，为皮肤保湿。其他宝可梦有时趁它睡觉吸食，让它醒来时一头雾水。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The orifices on the side of POKENAME's head are constantly leaking, with the liquid dribbling down its body and hydrating its skin. Other Pokémon sometimes suck on this while POKENAME is sleeping, causing it to wake in confusion.

entry: POKENAME背上会产生浓稠的乳状黏液，帮助它在浅河水中游动时伪装。若察觉上方有潜在食物，它就张大嘴，在水中产生强大吸力。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME produce a thick, milky mucus from their backs that help to camouflage them whilst they swim in the shallows of rivers. When they sense potential food above, they open their mouths wide to create a powerful suction force in the water.

entry: POKENAME几乎什么食物都肯吃，喜欢悠闲地待在池塘，吃掉靠近的一切。奶牛场会用它处理多余、快要变质的奶。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are willing to eat most foodstuffs, happily lounging about in ponds and feeding on whatever gets close. On dairy farms they are used as a way to dispose of excess milk that is likely to spoil soon.

entry: POKENAME几乎什么食物都肯吃，喜欢悠闲地待在池塘，吃掉靠近的一切。奶牛场会用它处理多余、快要变质的奶。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are willing to eat most foodstuffs, happily lounging about in ponds and feeding on whatever gets close. On dairy farms they are used as a way to dispose of excess milk that is likely to spoil soon.

entry: POKENAME用超能力制造奶泡。泡内的奶会泼向敌人，长时间接触后，便会引起抽搐。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME creates milk bubbles using its psychic abilities. The milk stored inside splashes onto foes, causing convulsions after prolonged contact.

entry: POKENAME的奶味随月相变化，最好在满月时采集。大多数商店的满月奶，常常很快就会卖光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME milk is best gathered during the full moon, as its flavor is affected by the phase of the moon. Full moon POKENAME milk sells out quickly and quite often at most stores.

entry: POKENAME的奶虽然美味，却因喝了会倒霉的传闻，很少被人饮用。尽管喝奶与厄运之间没有已证实的联系，仍有人试着拿它毒害仇敌。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Though delicious, POKENAME milk is rarely consumed by people due to rumours that doing so brings about misfortune. Though there is no proven link between drinking POKENAME milk and bad luck, some people still try to poison their foes with it.

entry: POKENAME白色的钩喙，因光亮的色泽而备受珍视。光泽的秘密，是尾羽中的奶；它会定期梳理尾羽。
author: banzai.exe
source: The hooked white beak of a POKENAME is prized for its glossy sheen. The secret to its polish is the milk in its tail feathers, which it preens regularly.

entry: 许多人寻求POKENAME的奶，相信喝下能变聪明。这个效果虽已证实，却只在喝下后，维持极短的时间。
author: sk372
source: Many seek out POKENAME's milk, believing it will grant them enhanced intelligence. While this is proven to be true, the effects last only for a very brief time after drinking.

entry: POKENAME虽吃废弃残渣，产出的奶却格外有营养。天生强韧的体质，也体现在奶中丰富的维生素里。
author: .izik
source: Though it feeds on discarded scraps, POKENAME produces exceptionally nutritious milk. Its natural resilience is reflected in the milk's dense vitamin content.

entry: POKENAME飘过夜空时，会发出诡异的哞声。有些文化相信，喝下它的奶，便能看见先祖的幻象。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME moos eerily as it drifts through the night sky. Some cultures say its milk brings ancestral visions when consumed.

entry: POKENAME用乳房流出的奶，在物体表面画奇怪的符号。尝过奶的人，确实会经历奇异的幻觉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME draws strange symbols onto surfaces using the milk from its udder. Sampling the milk has proven to cause a person to experience strange hallucinations.

entry: 给POKENAME挤奶很困难。每拉一下乳房，它都会向前、向后、再向前摆动，将挤奶的人撞倒在地。
author: musicsheep.
source: Milking POKENAME is difficult. With each pull of the udder, POKENAME swings forward, back, and then forward again, smacking whoever milked it onto the ground.

entry: 给POKENAME挤奶极其困难。它会试着藏起来，不让人找到。即使找到了，富有弹性的乳房，也会让它猛烈地晃来晃去。
author: musicsheep.
source: Milking POKENAME is extremely difficult. It tries to hide away and not get found. Even if you do find it, POKENAME's udders are stretchy and cause it to violently wobble.

entry: POKENAME的每片鳞都能产奶，带着淡淡的坚果味。奶会被制成特殊的奶酪，很受虫属性宝可梦喜爱。
author: quackquackattack
source: Each scale on POKENAME can produce milk that has a slight nutty flavor. Their milk is made into a special cheese that Bug-type Pokémon like to eat.

entry: 它高速旋转，释放体内储存的奶，一次最多能装90加仑。
author: seggule
source: It releases the milk stored within its body by spinning at a high pace. It is capable of storing up to 90 gallons at a time.

entry: POKENAME尾巴的钻头会逐渐积奶。转动时，奶被搅打，便能产出美味的黄油。
author: .izik
source: The drill on POKENAME's tail builds up milk over time. When it spins, the milk churns and dispenses a delicious butter.

entry: 古时，POKENAME的奶被用作天然解毒剂。人们相信，新鲜饮下，能中和常见的毒素。
author: .izik
source: In ancient times, POKENAME's milk was used as a natural antivenom. It's believed the milk neutralized common toxins when consumed fresh.

entry: POKENAME周身覆着自己产生的乳状物，让寄生虫一附上来就会滑落。它真正的身体，颜色很暗淡。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's body is coated in a self-produced milky substance that causes any parasites to slide right off. Its true body is dull in color.

entry: POKENAME十分害羞，还没与人熟悉前，谁想挤奶，它都会逃走。就算熟了，也必须私下挤，不能让别人看见。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite shy and will run away from attempts to milk it until it has warmed up to a person. Even then, the milking must be done in private so nobody else can see it.

entry: POKENAME吃得过多，体内就会积奶，难以继续飞行。它必须禁食，才能重新飞起来。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME overeats, it struggles to stay airborne due to milk buildup in its body. It must fast to regain flight.

entry: POKENAME救助迷路的人，提供奶，帮其恢复力量。它极其温顺，很容易养，因此在农场和农业观光场所都十分常见。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME rescues lost people and offers them milk to regain their strength. It is an extremely docile creature and very easy to raise, which is why it is very common on farms and in agritourism establishments.

entry: POKENAME会让野生宝可梦喝自己的奶。然而，奶其实是神经毒素，会引发偏头痛、肠胃问题，并迅速导致死亡。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME allows for wild Pokémon to feed on its milk. Its milk is actually a neurotoxin that causes migraines, stomach problems, and a swift death.

entry: POKENAME的钳子虽然看起来像奶酪块，却十分坚硬，夹力惊人。钳子不能吃，但偶尔仍能见到它啃自己的钳子。
author: sk372
source: Despite appearing like blocks of cheese, POKENAME's claws are quite solid and possess a crushing grip. Despite being inedible, POKENAME can sometimes be seen nibbling at its own claws.

entry: POKENAME壳内既能产生树果汁，也能产奶。吃下的树果会改变奶的颜色与味道，带来各种果香余味。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME creates berry juice as well as milk within its shell. The berries it takes in alter the color and taste of its milk, giving it a variety of potential fruity aftertastes.

entry: POKENAME用角撬开树皮，吃里面甜甜的树汁。因为总在大口吃树汁，它的奶也甜得出了名。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME pries off tree bark with its horn to get to the sweet sap beneath. Because of its constant gorging on sap, its milk is notoriously sweet in flavor.

entry: POKENAME常比赛互扔自己产出的冰淇淋。它们扔得开心，赢了更是欢喜，却往往输不起，一被砸中就不高兴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME frequently get into contests where they fling the ice cream they produce at one another. While they enjoy the act of throwing their ice cream and are gleeful in victory, they are often sore losers and grow upset when struck.

entry: POKENAME在山岩与石缝间寻找牧草地，用锋利的爪，带领族群攀上峭壁。它们食欲旺盛，不得不频繁转移觅食地。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hunt for grazing grounds amongst mountain crags and crevices, using their sharp claws to lead their herd up sheer cliffs. Their ravenous appetites mean they have to frequently move from one feeding ground to the next.

entry: POKENAME在山岩与石缝间寻找牧草地，用锋利的爪，带领族群攀上峭壁。群体进食时，总有一只站岗，随时以迅疾的斩击赶走威胁。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hunt for grazing grounds amongst mountain crags and crevices, using their sharp claws to lead their herd up sheer cliffs. One POKENAME always stands watch while the rest of the herd feeds, ready to chase away threats with swift slashes.

entry: POKENAME少量产出浓郁的奶，蜂蜜食谱又为奶增添甜味。工业化养殖至今，仍未能重现它的奶那般复杂的风味。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce small quantities of rich milk that are sweetened from their diet of honey. Industrial scale farming has yet to replicate the complex flavor of POKENAME milk.

entry: POKENAME十分擅长照顾孩子。它会将迷路的孩子与婴儿视如己出，用奶哺育；可大人迎来的，却可能是锋利的爪子。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME is an excellent caretaker. It will adopt lost children and babies as its own and nurse them with its milk, but adults might find themselves on the receiving end of its sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME的身体由极烫、奶油般浓郁的奶构成。这种液体被用来制作热巧克力，在丰缘的某些地方很受欢迎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is made up of extremely hot and creamy milk. The liquid has been used to make hot chocolate beverages popular in some parts of the Hoenn region.

entry: 它会爬上垂直表面，让柔软的壳更便于挤奶。POKENAME经过训练后，能提供热奶，帮助小孩子入睡。
author: oddwalls
source: It climbs vertical surfaces to make its soft shell more accessible for milking. POKENAME can be trained to give hot milk as a sleep aid for young children.

entry: POKENAME不停嗅找森林里的蘑菇，那是它最爱的零食。吃的真菌种类，会改变奶的品质、产量，有时连颜色也会变化。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sniffs out forest mushrooms constantly, as they are its favorite snacks. The type of fungi it eats will change the quality, amount, and sometimes even the color of the milk it can produce.

entry: POKENAME的奶浓稠而温暖，很适合熬过严寒。幼崽钻到它身下吃奶，也借厚厚的皮毛取暖。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's milk is really thick and warm, perfect for surviving the freezing cold. Its offspring go under it to feed and get warmth from its thick layer of fur.

entry: POKENAME的奶浓稠而温暖，很适合熬过严寒。幼崽会依附在它身上吃奶，再钻到身下，借厚厚的皮毛取暖。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's milk is really thick and warm, perfect for surviving the freezing cold. Its offspring latch onto it to feed and go under it to get warmth from its thick layer of fur.

entry: POKENAME进食时，会向周围的水释放浓稠的白色黏液。黏液会闷住附近鱼类宝可梦的鳃，让捕食者更难吃到它。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME release a thick, white mucus into the water around them as they feed. The mucus smothers the gills of fish Pokémon in the area around them, making it far harder for predators to feed on POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME周身积有脂肪，比大多数太阳珊瑚融合体，更能耐受寒冷的水。它们成群住在浅水，常能见到它们啃食藻类。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have fat deposits across their body that allow them to tolerate far colder water than most other Corsola fusions. Herds of them live in shallow water and can often be seen grazing on algae.

entry: POKENAME周身积有脂肪，比大多数太阳珊瑚融合体，更能耐受寒冷的水。它会用坚韧的岩石状角，抵御更大的宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have fat deposits across their body that allow them to tolerate far colder water than most other Corsola fusions. They use their tough, rocky horns to protect themselves from larger Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME准备攻击时，会飞快地来回甩动尾鳍。主要的攻击手段，是从口中高速、精准地喷奶。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flicks its tail fin back and forth rapidly as it prepares to attack. Its main attack consists of spitting out milk from its mouth with high velocity and pinpoint accuracy.

entry: POKENAME吐出的奶极其浓稠黏滑。中招后，液体会蔓延到皮肤各处，使行动大幅变慢，几乎动弹不得。
author: sk372
source: The milk that POKENAME spits out is incredibly thick and viscous. Those hit by its attacks will find themselves immensely slowed down as the substance seeps across their skin and nearly immobilizes them.

entry: 铁炮鱼很喜欢POKENAME产生的奶，总爱附在它身上。这让巨翅飞鱼对它不太友善，因为它无意间抢走了巨翅飞鱼惯常的伙伴。
author: sk372
source: Remoraid are quite attracted to the milk that POKENAME generates, latching onto it constantly. This has made Mantine become unfriendly towards POKENAME due to unintentionally stealing their usual companions.

entry: POKENAME在岩石与树木上磨角，确保随时可用。它们会成群角朝前俯冲，将其他宝可梦赶出牧场。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME sharpen their horns against rocks and trees, ensuring they're ready for use at any time. Flocks of POKENAME chase other Pokémon away from their grazing grounds by swooping down at them horn-first.

entry: POKENAME看似普通戴鲁比，毛上的粉色斑块和小角，却能让它与群里的其他成员区分开来。壮实的体格，让它倒下前能承受捕食者的许多攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME may seem like another Houndour, but the splotches of pink on their fur and their small horns distinguish them from others in their pack. Their bulky physique allows them to soak up many attacks from predators before fainting.

entry: POKENAME的奶极辣，只有它的幼崽受得了。有时农场会养它，保护动物免遭捕食者侵害。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's milk has an extreme spiciness to it that only its offspring can handle. POKENAME is sometimes kept on farms to guard the animals from predators.

entry: POKENAME飞快摇尾，警告捕食者退后。同时，尾尖还会喷出有毒的奶，进一步威慑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME shakes its tail rapidly as a warning sign for predators to stay back. As it does so, poisonous milk sprays out from the tail's tip as an additional deterrent.

entry: 这种宝可梦从口中喷出的奶，力道足以打穿钢铁。POKENAME打哈欠时造出的奶漩涡，会让奶变得顺滑，是罕见的珍馐。
author: ned666_
source: This Pokémon can shoot milk out of its mouth with enough force to break through steel. The whirlpools of milk POKENAME creates from yawning result in a smooth-textured milk that is a rare delicacy.

entry: POKENAME向伙伴宝可梦喷奶，便能治愈对方；甚至可以把奶淋在自己身上，治疗自己。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME sprays milk at its ally Pokémon to heal them, and can even heal itself by showering itself with its milk.

entry: POKENAME常被农场饲养，是实用的驮兽。但成群时容易狂奔失控，因此为保安全，每个农场通常只养一两只。
author: mega_beedrill
source: POKENAME are often kept on farms as useful beasts of burden. Herds of POKENAME can be prone to stampedes, so each farm usually keeps only one or two for safety.

entry: POKENAME常被农场饲养，是实用的驮兽。但成群时容易狂奔失控，因此为保安全，每个农场通常只养一两只。
author: mega_beedrill
source: POKENAME are often kept on farms as useful beasts of burden. Herds of POKENAME can be prone to stampedes, so each farm usually keeps only one or two for safety.

entry: POKENAME四肢与尾巴的末端，都能喷出奶流，既可赠给伙伴，也可威吓敌人。据说，味道几乎与天然奶一样好，却仍留有鲜明的人工余味。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's limbs and tail can produce jets of milk from the tips, as a gift to allies or a deterrent to foes. The flavor is described as almost as good as natural milk, but still possessing a distinctly artificial aftertaste.

entry: POKENAME只有倒立时，才能给别人供奶。喝下奶，似乎能改善平衡感，缓解头晕的症状。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can only provide milk to others while it is upside-down. Drinking its milk appears to help improve balance and fight off symptoms of dizziness.

entry: 若打算给POKENAME挤奶，最好先让它亲一口。不知为何，它只要吻过什么，奶的品质就会立刻提高。
author: sk372
source: It is best to let oneself be kissed by a POKENAME if they plan to milk it. For unknown reasons, the quality of POKENAME's milk increases immediately after it has kissed something.

entry: POKENAME的乳房如同电池，奶在体内流动时，就会积蓄电力。跑动时，它会迸出火花。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's udders act as batteries, charging electricity as milk moves throughout its body. It lets off sparks as it runs.

entry: 它是已知少数会哺乳育幼的爬行类宝可梦之一。若情绪不佳，毒素可能意外杀死一窝幼崽。
author: theradrad
source: It is one of few reptilian Pokémon known to nurse its young. If it is upset, its toxins could accidentally kill its nest.

entry: POKENAME钟爱温热饮品，会先用热气息加温，再喝下。它也热心地给朋友的饮料加热，哪怕对方更想喝凉的。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME adores warm beverages, warming them up with its heat breath before drinking them. It eagerly warms up the drinks of its friends, even when they would prefer their drink remain cold.

entry: 这只大奶罐的产奶量，已增至原来的十倍。但它够不到自己的大多数乳房，所以喝牛奶并不能恢复更多体力。
author: kiwikelly
source: This Miltank's milk production has increased tenfold. However, it cannot reach most of its own udders, so its Milk Drink doesn't recover any extra vitality.

entry: POKENAME的袋中总备有现成的奶，因此常被养在农场和商店。奶里富含内啡肽。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME always has ready-made milk in its pouch and is usually kept on farms and in stores because of this. The milk is full of endorphins.

entry: POKENAME高速奔过大地，尾巴上的铃铛一路叮当作响。据说，正是铃声召来了雷雨，跟着它穿行各地。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME races across the lands at high speed, the bell on its tail clanging behind it as it runs. It is said the bell summons the thunderstorms that follow POKENAME as it travels the region.

entry: 只喝一口POKENAME的奶，就能清醒数小时，很适合当美味的提神饮品。刚采集的奶，带着淡淡金色，电力在其中嗡鸣。
author: ultron_suprem3
source: One sip of a POKENAME's milk can keep a person awake for hours, which can be used as a tasty energy drink. When freshly collected, the milk of a POKENAME takes on a slight golden hue, humming with electricity.

entry: POKENAME产出的奶，始终滚烫，战斗时也会渗漏。奶能热上数月，却不知为何，不会烫伤它信任的人。
author: .izik
source: The milk POKENAME dispenses is boiling hot at all times and leaks during combat. It stays hot for months but somehow does not burn those it trusts.

entry: 据说，POKENAME只要爪子轻轻一碰，就能把小片水域变成纯奶。它极其稀有，行踪难觅，因此能瞥见一眼，都被视为好运。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is said that with a single touch of its paw, POKENAME can transform small bodies of water into pure milk. It is an extremely rare and elusive Pokémon, so catching a glimpse of one is considered a stroke of good fortune.

entry: POKENAME十分贪婪，常寻找地下含水层解渴，每天能喝下超过五加仑的水。成群的它们，会给干旱地区的聚落带来严重问题。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are greedy Pokémon that regularly seek out underground aquifers to slake their thirst and are capable of drinking over five gallons of water daily. Herds of POKENAME can cause serious problems for settlements in arid areas.

entry: 成群的POKENAME穿行地壳迁徙，进食时可能引发局部震动。它们的隧道格外稳固，分析显示，其中有坚韧的奶酪状物加固。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME herds migrate through the planet's crust and can cause localised tremors as they feed. Their tunnels are remarkably stable and analysis of them shows they're reinforced with a tough, cheese-like material.

entry: POKENAME会定期从隧道现身，排出体内的乳状物。研究者推测，食物中矿物太丰富，它们无法容纳吃下的一切，只得周期性排放。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME periodically emerge from their tunnels to discharge a milky substance from their bodies. Researchers theorise that their diets are so rich in minerals that they cannot contain everything they eat, necessitating these periodic releases.

entry: POKENAME会定期从隧道现身，排出体内的乳状物。平时排得缓慢而有节制，但也能突然喷出，推动自己高速前进。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME periodically emerge from their tunnels to discharge a milky substance from their bodies. While their release of the substance is normally slow and controlled, they are capable of firing sudden bursts to launch themselves at high speed.

entry: POKENAME极其保护群里较小的成员。若觉得幼崽有危险，就会用有力的尾巴还击。虽然凶悍，它却是完全的草食者，主要吃草。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are extremely protective of smaller members of their herd, lashing out with their powerful tails if they believe their young are under threat. Despite their aggression, POKENAME are entirely herbivorous and feed primarily on grass.

entry: POKENAME极其保护群里较小的成员。若觉得幼崽有危险，就会用有力的尾巴还击。它的奶极浓郁，含有成长中的宝可梦所需的全部营养。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are extremely protective of smaller members of their herd, lashing out with their powerful tails if they believe their young are under threat. Their milk is extremely rich and provides all the nutrients necessary for growing Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME扇动巨翼，能搅动海洋，卷起直达空中的巨大漏斗状水柱。它再将奶加入水柱，造出旋转的乳白台风。
author: sk372
source: The flapping of POKENAME's massive wings can stir up the oceans and create large water funnels reaching into the air. POKENAME then adds its milk to the funnels to create swirling, milky typhoons.

entry: 细心养大的POKENAME，能产出风味格外好、又能提振精神的奶。受到威胁时，它会从头上的小角放电。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME is raised with care, it produces a particularly flavorful milk with energizing properties. When it feels threatened, it releases electric discharges from the small horns on its head.

entry: 传说，将POKENAME的奶搅成黄油，再涂上面包，就能起死回生。但所需的确切配方早已失传，现代的尝试远不能及。
author: .izik
source: Legend holds that butter churned from POKENAME's milk could revive the dead when spread on bread. The precise blend required has been lost to time, and no modern attempt has come close.

entry: 据说，POKENAME的奶有一种独特魔力，喝下后，心智会暂时回到婴儿时期，重温童年的快乐回忆。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's milk is said to possess a unique type of magical property. Supposedly, drinking its milk will temporarily return a person's mind to their infancy, reliving happy memories from their childhood.

entry: POKENAME以甜果和蜂蜜为食，将糖分化作甜奶，储存在粉色的大尾巴里。奶有独特风味，有时会被用来制作甜点。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME subsist on a diet of sweet fruit and honey, storing the sugar in their large pink tail in the form of sweet milk. The milk they produce is sometimes used in desserts for its unique flavour.

entry: POKENAME以甜果和蜂蜜为食，将糖分化作甜奶，储存在粉色的大身体里。奶有独特风味，有时会被用来制作甜点。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME subsist on a diet of sweet fruit and honey, storing the sugar in their large pink body in the form of sweet milk. The milk they produce is sometimes used in desserts for its unique flavour.

entry: 成群的POKENAME会帮果园收果子。它们两只配合，一只用灵活的耳朵提篮，另一只把果子放进去。篮子一满，就会高兴地摇响铃铛。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME herds are used to help with the harvest of fruit from orchards. They work in pairs, one POKENAME using their flexible ears to carry a basket for the other to drop fruit into. When the basket fills, they joyfully ring their bells.

entry: 营养丰富的奶与灵巧的附肢，让POKENAME很受各地咖啡馆和茶店欢迎。它每天最多能产五加仑奶，对付钱的顾客十分友善。
author: skyrvr
source: Its nutrient-dense milk and dexterous appendages make POKENAME highly desirable to cafes and tea shops across the region. It can produce up to five gallons of milk per day and is highly amicable towards paying customers.

entry: 糕点师常请POKENAME当甜点助手。它能察觉奶油类甜品的任何瑕疵；若奶油太甜，就加入帽上的树果，直到符合自己的标准。
author: sleepyman0731
source: Pastry chefs often have a POKENAME assistant to assist with desserts. A POKENAME is able to detect any imperfections in creme-related desserts. If the creme is too sweet, POKENAME adds the berries on their hat until the taste is to their standards.

entry: POKENAME聚拢一群黑暗鸦，担任严厉而仁慈的领袖。部下顺利执行命令后，它就会用奶作为奖赏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gathers up a flock of Murkrow and acts as a stern, yet kind leader. After its underlings have successfully followed its orders, it rewards them with its milk as a treat.

entry: 它爱喝哞哞鲜奶，个头虽小，每天却能喝下好多瓶。一旦打翻一瓶，它就会哭起来。
author: hophoppip
source: It loves to drink Moo-Moo Milk, drinking numerous bottles a day despite its size. When it spills a bottle of Moo-Moo Milk, it reacts by crying.

entry: POKENAME最爱的玩具是牛铃。它会边拿着铃铛，边模仿人或其他宝可梦，玩得吵闹不堪。
author: banzai.exe
source: A POKENAME's favourite toy is a cowbell. It plays by mimicking people or other Pokémon while holding the bell, making a terrible ruckus.

entry: 用POKENAME的奶制成的奶酪，味道像新鲜乳清奶酪。吃下后，会短暂涌起喜悦，轻微伤口也愈合得更快。科学家尚未分离出起作用的成分。
author: .izik
source: Cheese made from POKENAME's milk tastes like fresh ricotta and causes brief surges of joy and faster healing of minor wounds in those who eat it. Scientists have yet to isolate the compound responsible.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴能随意产生大量流动的奶。将尾巴垫在脚下，它就能踩着自己制造的奶浪冲浪，迅速穿过大地。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tail can generate a large amount of flowing milk at will. By placing it underneath its feet, it can surf along the milky waves it creates to quickly traverse the landscape.

entry: POKENAME即使难得产奶，也没什么真正的营养价值。许多农场主不爱养它，因为就算进化后，也要吃下大量食物，才能满足。
author: bobosmith01
source: In the rare cases where POKENAME does produce milk, it lacks any real nutritional value. Many farmers dislike raising POKENAME as it needs tons of food to stay content, even when it evolves.

entry: 常能见到成群的POKENAME在水面玩耍，跃出水，短暂滑翔，再扑通落回。长尾巴能感知波浪形成，让它们借水势，跃得更远。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Herds of POKENAME are regularly seen playing at the water's surface, leaping out of the water to glide short distances before splashing back down. Their long tails sense waves as they form, letting them leap longer distances as they ride the current.

entry: POKENAME常受雇于冰淇淋店。它用控冰本领，调节待售冰淇淋的温度，乐在其中，确保每位顾客都拿到温度恰好的甜品。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are commonly employed by ice cream parlours. They use their ice powers to control the temperature of the ice cream being served, taking pleasure in the task and ensuring each customer receives a dessert of the perfect temperature.

entry: POKENAME看似安静而沉稳，却天生会照顾幼年宝可梦。它四处漂浮，寻找饥饿的小家伙，用构成双臂的奶瓶，给它们喂饮品。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME seems quiet and rather stoic, but has a caring instinct towards young Pokémon. It floats around in search of hungry children, offering them drinks from the bottles that make up its two arms.

entry: 农场主觉得POKENAME很实用。不仅能产奶，还能运重物、犁地，甚至用草莓鼻子诱导牲畜，帮助转移。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: Farmers consider POKENAME to be very useful. Not only does it produce milk, but it can also transport heavy things, plow fields, and help move livestock by luring them with its strawberry nose.

entry: POKENAME背上的线缆装满了奶，战斗外会转圈甩动，积蓄电力。若把奶喷向敌人，电荷就足以使对方麻痹。
author: .izik
source: The cords on POKENAME's back are filled with milk, which it whips in circles outside of battle to charge its electricity. Should it spray a foe with this milk, the charge is strong enough to cause paralysis.

entry: POKENAME大多天性温顺，但见到小型宝可梦受欺负，绝不会袖手旁观。它从双臂射出滚烫的奶，灼伤、驱退来犯者，再温柔地哺育受害者，助其康复。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is mostly docile by nature, but won't hesitate to come to the aid of smaller Pokémon being picked on. It fires scalding hot milk from its arms to burn and repel aggressors, before gently nursing the victims to health.

entry: 它会寻找内心受伤的人，温柔安慰。产出的热奶，还是帮助入眠的好东西。
author: seggule
source: It seeks out people who are suffering emotionally and comforts them. The warm milk it produces is a great sleep remedy.

entry: POKENAME通常养在农场，帮助翻土犁地。它只在平静时肯让人挤奶，否则就会蜷起身体，自我防卫。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME are usually kept on farms to help till and plow the fields. It will only be milked when in a calm state; otherwise, it'll curl up defensively.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀能产生声波，频率恰好能将奶搅成黄油。工业化奶牛场会雇用整群的它们，低沉的振翅声，几英里外都能听见。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's wings create sonic waves at the perfect frequency for churning milk into butter. Entire swarms of them are employed at industrial dairy farms, their low drone audible from miles away.

entry: POKENAME尾巴滴下的并不是奶，而是一种特殊汁液。汁液甜美而营养丰富，美食家尤其赞赏其中浓郁的泥土与花香。
author: mepp.
source: The substance that drips down from POKENAME's tail is not milk, but a unique sap. This sap is quite nutritious and sweet, with gourmands noting its rich earthy and floral notes.

entry: POKENAME从耳朵甩出奶制冰柱，远距离攻击。即使高温下，冰柱也能长时间不化。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flings icicles made of milk from its ears to attack from afar. Even in high heat, the icicles stay frozen for long periods.

entry: POKENAME从尾巴喷出毒奶，调整滑翔路线。奶只要被碰到，就可能使人发烧。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires poisonous milk from its tail to redirect its glide patterns. The milk itself can cause fevers if touched.

entry: POKENAME极其强健，不仅能在严寒中茁壮生活，还会分享温暖而营养丰富的奶，帮助不适应恶劣环境的其他宝可梦。
author: anonymous_moose
source: POKENAME are extremely hardy, able to not only thrive in freezing temperatures, but also to support other Pokémon less adapted to these harsh conditions by sharing their warm, nutritious milk.

entry: 从POKENAME身上倒出的奶，仿佛永远不会用尽。奶可以安全饮用，但一碰到地面就会出现异常错乱，泼洒后很难清理。
author: hophoppip
source: Milk can be poured from POKENAME, never seeming to run out. It's safe to drink, but it glitches upon contact with the ground, resulting in a difficult spill to clean up.

entry: POKENAME用干草在森林树冠高处筑巢。巢既能给蛋保温，也能在它饿时，提供随手可吃的食物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make nests high in the canopies of forests out of dried grass. The nest serves both as insulation for their eggs and as a handy source of food to munch on when they get hungry.

entry: POKENAME的奶带着洋甘菊香，很受花草茶与清淡蛋奶甜品的制作者珍视。加热后，淡淡的花香苦味会柔和许多，很适合丰缘流行的助眠饮品配方。
author: .izik
source: The chamomile-scented milk POKENAME produces is prized in herbal teas and light custards. Its subtle floral bitterness mellows considerably when heated, making it a natural fit for sleeptime drink recipes popular in the Hoenn region.

entry: POKENAME以巨力推倒林木，不断用头撞击能找到的最大果树，直到树倒下。整群随后聚来，大吃落下的叶子与果实。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their immense strength to topple trees in the forest, repeatedly headbutting the largest fruit trees they can find until they fall. The entire herd then gathers together to feast on the fallen leaves and fruit.

entry: POKENAME的奶，是辣味冰淇淋的主要原料。这些火辣的甜品，在夏季祭典上尤其受欢迎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's milk is a staple ingredient in spicy ice cream. These fiery treats are especially popular during summer festivals.

entry: POKENAME是寒地牧场上常见又受喜爱的身影，能产出天然滚烫、甜美又营养丰富的奶。柔软的绒毛覆住身体，锁住体内火囊的热量。
author: ambrosia04
source: A common and beloved sight on cold-climate ranches, POKENAME produces a sweet, highly nutritious milk that is naturally piping hot. Its body is covered in a soft, downy fluff that traps the heat from its internal fire sac.

entry: POKENAME用长爪当犁，帮农场主播种庄稼。不肯被挤奶时，它会蜷成球，竖起背上的一排尖刺。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its long claws like a plow to help farmers sow their crops. When it refuses to be milked, it curls into a ball and bristles the row of spikes along its back.

entry: POKENAME养在农场，既产奶，也能犁地。尖刺的顶端锐利，其他部分却颇有皮革般的质感。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME are kept on farms for their milk and ability to plow fields. Their spikes have a sharp point, but the rest of the spike is rather leathery.

entry: POKENAME的奶极烫，它会泼进敌人眼里，使其看不见。天气冷时，产奶就会变慢。
author: .izik
source: The milk POKENAME produces is extremely hot and it splashes it into foes' eyes to blind them. Its milk production slows when it gets cold.

entry: POKENAME用过热的踢击，在对手身上烙下印记。组织被烧伤，皮肤上永远留着它的脚印。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME brands its opponents with superheated kicks. The scarred tissue burns and permanently leaves POKENAME's footprint on the opponent's skin.

entry: POKENAME甩出沉重的尾巴，就能击碎岩石。它的奶，常被用作某些肥皂与洗发水的原料。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME can break rocks by slinging its heavy tail towards them. Its milk is often used as an ingredient in some soaps and shampoos.

entry: 成群的POKENAME在河岸挖洞，靠泥泞的家安全地躲避风暴与恶劣天气。天气好时，它们整群出洞，啃食蒲草。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME herds make burrows along riverbanks, sheltering from storms and poor weather in the safety of their muddy homes. When the weather is good, they emerge as a single herd to graze on bullrushes.

entry: POKENAME常被用来保护大奶罐群。它天性护群，会向想来捕食的家伙喷出高压奶流，将其吓退。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are frequently used to protect herds of Miltank. They are protective Pokémon and blast would-be predators with jets of high-pressure milk to dissuade them.

entry: 每只POKENAME都有最爱的奶酪。用小小的角，它就能察觉别的宝可梦是否惦记着心爱的食物。一旦发现奶酪受到威胁，就会用念力攻击。
author: sleepyman0731
source: Every POKENAME has a favorite cheese. Using their tiny horns, they can sense if another Pokémon wants their beloved food. Once POKENAME finds a threat to their cheese, they attack using Confusion.

entry: 大奶罐很着迷于POKENAME优雅的舞步。观察发现，经常看它跳舞的大奶罐，产出的奶品质更高。
author: sk372
source: Miltank are rather enamored with POKENAME's graceful dance steps. It has been observed that Miltank that regularly watch POKENAME dance produce higher-quality milk.

entry: POKENAME头上的毛发，是触感柔软舒适的皮革。喝下它的奶，虽很少见，却可能让人向随机方向瞬间移动。这并非有意，已造成多起死亡。
author: lydiaprower8
source: The fur on POKENAME's head is a pleasantly soft leather. While rare, drinking POKENAME's milk can cause a human to teleport in a random direction. This is unintentional and has caused multiple deaths.

entry: 它们最擅长制酪。卡洛斯流行的许多上等奶酪，都出自品味讲究的POKENAME之手。
author: quote.lass
source: Their greatest skill is cheesemaking. Many of the gourmet varieties of cheese popular across Kalos were cultivated by discerning POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME用念力操纵自己产出的奶，常塑成触蔓，触碰别人、与其互动。体验过的人，有些觉得有趣，有些则觉得不舒服。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME telekinetically manipulates the milk it produces, often using it to form tendrils to touch and interact with others. Those who have experienced this are split between calling it amusing and considering it off-putting.

entry: POKENAME头上的毛发，是触感柔软舒适的皮革。喝下它的奶，虽很少见，却可能让人向随机方向瞬间移动。这并非有意，已造成多起死亡。
author: lydiaprower8
source: The fur on POKENAME's head is a pleasantly soft leather. While rare, drinking POKENAME's milk can cause a human to teleport in a random direction. This is unintentional and has caused multiple deaths.

entry: POKENAME被养着许多大奶罐的农场吸引，默默悬浮在它们近旁。虽然看似无害，长期与它相处的大奶罐，奶量却会越来越少。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is attracted to farms with lots of Miltank, hovering near the Pokémon in silence. Though seemingly harmless, Miltank that spend too long in its presence start producing less and less milk over time.

entry: POKENAME养在农场，既产奶，也能犁地。尖刺的顶端锐利，其他部分却颇有皮革般的质感。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME are kept on farms for their milk and ability to plow fields. Their spikes have a sharp point, but the rest of the spike is rather leathery.

entry: POKENAME的奶略有毒，只有尼多一族能免疫。幸好毒性够弱，其他生物喝下，也只会轻微肠胃不适。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's milk is slightly poisonous, and only members of the Nidoran family are immune to its effects. Fortunately, the toxins are weak enough that they will only cause mild stomach upset to others who drink it.

entry: POKENAME通过腹下的乳房喷奶推进，时速可达30千米。因此，它飞到哪里，奶就喷到哪里。
author: whiteupgrade
source: POKENAME moves by ejecting milk through the udders on its underside, speeding up to 30 kilometers per hour. Due to this, its milk is sprayed everywhere as it flies.

entry: 它不断从双臂喷奶，借反冲向后飞。一旦奶用尽，便摔落地面，只得再补充。
author: seggule
source: It propels itself backwards by constantly blasting milk from its arms. Once it runs out of milk, it crashes to the ground and has to recharge.

entry: POKENAME能用四个乳房迅速产生哞哞鲜奶，还能借奶在空中滑翔。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME utilize their four udders to generate Moomoo Milk at rapid pace. They are capable of utilizing the milk to glide through the air.

entry: POKENAME通常在大牙狸群附近，给它们供奶，保持精力。啃上一阵木头后，它的产奶量会暂时增加。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can typically be found near Bidoof groups, providing them with milk to keep them energized. Its milk production increases temporarily after it has spent some time gnawing on wood.

entry: 有个都市传说称，一瓶奶若搁得太久，就会变成POKENAME。随后，它会诅咒那个让奶白白浪费的人。
author: bostroms
source: There is an urban legend that if a bottle of milk is left out for a very long time, it will become a POKENAME.  It will then supposedly lay a curse on the person who caused the milk to go to waste.

entry: POKENAME把波导与奶凝成球体作战。球体适合投射，撞上目标便会泼洒，带有波导的奶覆住对方，削弱其战斗力量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME condenses both its aura and milk into spheres that it uses in combat. Effective as projectiles, the orbs splatter upon impact and coat the target with aura-infused milk, draining their fighting strength.

entry: POKENAME越久没被挤奶，就越焦躁。烦闷不断累积后，它就越可能愤怒地咬住接下来看到的人。
author: sk372
source: The longer POKENAME goes without being milked, the more agitated it gets. As its frustration grows, it becomes more likely to angrily bite down on the next person it sees.

entry: POKENAME喷射奶流，延长滑翔，因此能长时间停留在空中。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses jets of milk to extend any gliding it does. It can stay airborne for long periods this way.

entry: POKENAME善良而富同情心，总愿意与训练家分享奶，确保对方健康。久而久之，奶的品质会改变，更贴合训练家的口味与健康需求。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is kind and compassionate, always willing to share its milk with its Trainer to ensure they stay healthy. Over time, its milk will change in quality to better suit the tastes and health concerns of its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME本身虽然不产奶，许多农场主仍会将它和大奶罐一起养。它既是护卫，也是朋友，被大奶罐当作大姐姐。
author: alestrius
source: Though it does not produce milk itself, many farmers include a POKENAME alongside Miltank in their herds. POKENAME acts as both protective guard and friend, and is treated like a big sister by the Miltank.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的嘴，会随意咬取钢铁与岩石，嚼成乳糊状。嚼好后，它就抓来附近的杯罐，逼尾巴吐出混合物，直到装满好几瓶。
author: bigoljax
source: The mouth on POKENAME's tail takes random bites out of steel and rocks, chewing them up into a milky texture. When done, POKENAME will grab any nearby glasses and jars, forcing its tail to spit out the mixture until several bottles are filled.

entry: POKENAME的触蔓覆着黏稠的唾液与奶的混合物，黏性更强。猎物只要游进抓取范围，就一定会被牢牢缠住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tendrils are coated with a sticky mixture of saliva and milk. This mix gives them extra adhesion, guaranteeing that it fully ensnares any prey that happens to swim within grabbing range.

entry: POKENAME头部触蔓的尖端，会渗出浓稠黏滑的奶状液体。液体覆住触蔓，增强黏性，方便它捉住猎物。
author: sk372
source: A sticky and viscous milk-like fluid leaks from the tips of POKENAME's cranial tendrils. This coats the tendrils and gives them extra adhesion in order for POKENAME to seize its prey.

entry: 据说，POKENAME的奶，是世上最好的有机奶之一。可它习惯试着吃掉一切想来挤奶的人，只有少数幸运训练家，能在没被吞掉的情况下成功挤奶。
author: naivetotoro
source: It is said that POKENAME milk is among the finest organic milk in existence. However, these Pokémon have a habit of trying to eat anyone who attempts to milk them. Only a few fortunate trainers have managed to milk them without being devoured.

entry: POKENAME的奶风味浓烈，人们十分喜爱。不幸的是，靠近它很危险，因为它十分凶暴，也会伺机进食。
author: musicsheep.
source: Milk produced by POKENAME has a very strong flavor that people absolutely love. Unfortunately, getting near POKENAME is dangerous, since it is violent and an opportunistic eater.

entry: POKENAME的奶富含钙，极受追捧。获取却很麻烦，因为每次挤奶前，都得先喂熟羊肉。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME's milk is highly sought after due to being rich in calcium. Acquiring the milk can be a hassle, as POKENAME need to be fed cooked mutton before each milking.

entry: 被捕食者发现时，POKENAME会喷出一股股奶，让周围水域浑浊，遮挡视线，再游走逃生。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases bursts of milk when spotted by a predator. This clouds the surrounding water to obscure visibility while it swims away.

entry: POKENAME吃的海带越多，奶就越有营养。遇到虚弱、受伤的宝可梦，它会把奶送给对方。
author: .izik
source: The milk POKENAME produces becomes more nutritious the more kelp it eats. It offers this milk to weak and injured Pokémon it comes across.

entry: POKENAME用头猛撞物体，让体内的奶搅动。这样持续一阵后，它就能完全在自己体内，制出黄油。
author: .izik
source: By slamming its head into objects, POKENAME causes the milk inside its body to churn. After a prolonged period of this, it can produce butter entirely within its own body.

entry: 饲养POKENAME的农场，通常会摆些东西，让它练习头槌。若最近曾用头骨猛撞物体，产奶量与奶的品质，都会明显提高。
author: sk372
source: Farms that house POKENAME typically keep objects around for it to use as headbutt practice. Its milk production and quality noticeably increases if it has charged its skull into something recently.

entry: 气温较低时，POKENAME的头骨会更坚实、更有韧性。暖和时则变得柔软脆弱，外表也更凹凸不平，显得不稳固。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cranium becomes more solid and resilient in colder temperatures. In warmer temperatures, it is softer and weaker, and takes on a lumpier, less stable-looking appearance.

entry: POKENAME的头像个桶，里面还装着自己产的奶。它乐意分享，但桶内的奶越少，头部抵御伤害的能力就越弱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's head is similar in shape to a barrel, and even contains the milk it produces within. It has no problem sharing this milk, though the less milk it has within the container, the less effective its head is at resisting damage.

entry: 它的奶极富营养，曾有人只靠一杯，就活了数周。它只会把奶送给走过牧场的虚弱宝可梦幼崽。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its milk is extremely nutritious, and people have survived weeks off of one glass. It only offers it to weak baby Pokémon that wander through its pastures.

entry: 这种宝可梦有两组乳房，产奶量也是双倍。但POKENAME主要吃有毒的植物与蘑菇，奶对人类太危险，不能饮用。
author: milchik
source: This Pokémon has two sets of udders for double the milk output. However, because POKENAME's diet consists mainly of poisonous plants and mushrooms, this milk is too hazardous for human consumption.

entry: 暴风雨将至，POKENAME的奶会变得极甜。非常不建议此时饮用，因为过强的味道，可能永久损伤味觉。
author: .izik
source: Before a tempest begins, POKENAME's milk becomes incredibly sweet. Consuming it at this time is strongly discouraged, as the extreme flavor can permanently damage one's sense of taste.

entry: POKENAME飞过墓园后，附近的雕像偶尔会开始流出奶泪。研究者正在调查，这种现象如何发生、又为何发生。
author: .izik
source: After POKENAME flies through a cemetery, statues nearby occasionally begin to weep milk. How or why this occurs is currently under investigation by researchers.

entry: POKENAME夜里待在墓园时，附近墓碑上似乎会覆上打发奶油般的物质。物质毫无味道，清晨见光就会消散。
author: .izik
source: While POKENAME is in a graveyard at night, a whipped-cream-like substance seems to coat the gravestones nearby. This substance lacks any flavor and disintegrates in the morning light.

entry: 伽勒尔有民间故事说，晚饭时不喝完哞哞鲜奶的孩子，夜里就会被POKENAME造访。这种情况，只有两次记载。
author: krogens
source: There are folktales originating in the Galar region that say children who do not finish their Moomoo milk during dinnertime will be visited by POKENAME at night. There are only two recorded instances of this occurring.

entry: POKENAME十分多疑，总觉得周围的生物心怀阴谋与恶意，却会给信任的对象送奶。许多人都觉得它的奶很好喝。
author: hermithuragok
source: POKENAME are very paranoid Pokémon that constantly suspect those around them of conspiracy and malevolence, but they deliver milk to those they trust. Their milk is delicious to many.

entry: POKENAME身上的铃铛，能引导同群伙伴找到它。每天产奶超过100加仑，是世界上最大的奶源之一。
author: m1918_94884
source: The bell on POKENAME's body guides other members of its pod to POKENAME's location. It produces over 100 gallons of milk daily, making it one of the largest sources of milk in the world.

entry: 极少有人尝过POKENAME圆环上的奶，据说那是神明的琼浆。传闻奶营养太丰富，喝一次，就能整整一年不生病。
author: sk372
source: Few have managed to sample the milk from POKENAME's ring, which is said to be a type of divine ambrosia. Supposedly, the milk is so nutritious that drinking it once will keep a person from getting sick for a year.

entry: POKENAME吃落下的坚果与水果，处理其中的水分，储存在壳内。液体发酵后，会变成甜甜的、带坚果味的植物奶。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME eat fallen nuts and fruits, processing the moisture from their food and storing it within their shell. The liquid ferments into a plant-based milk that has a sweet, nutty flavour to it.

entry: POKENAME的奶带有罗勒味，很受厨师追捧。它与蛋尤其相配，能给煎蛋饼添上清新而有层次的草本风味，其他食材很难替代。
author: .izik
source: The basil-flavored milk POKENAME produces is highly sought after by cooks. It pairs especially well with eggs, lending omelettes a fresh, herby depth that is difficult to replicate with any other ingredient.

entry: POKENAME每天产奶极多，常会获配自己的奶桶，随身提着，让帮工确保一滴不浪费。有些农场也利用它乐于提桶的性情，将农产品运往集市。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME produce vast quantities of milk each day, and are frequently provided their own milk pails to carry so that farmhands can ensure none goes to waste. Some farms make use of their willingness to carry pails to ferry produce to markets.

entry: 成群的POKENAME越来越受房屋模型爱好者欢迎。每只壳上都建着不同的小屋，随着群体移动，村庄不断变换，让模型爱好者欣赏不尽。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME herds have risen to popularity amongst the model house community. Each POKENAME has a different house constructed upon its shell, and the movement of the herd creates an ever-changing village for the model enthusiasts to enjoy.

entry: 餐厅常将POKENAME汉堡列为挑战餐，请人试着一顿吃完。浓郁风味虽诱人，体积却太大，往往很快就变冷，不再可口。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME burgers are often presented at restaurants as a challenge meal for a person to try to eat in a single sitting. While the rich flavour is enticing, the sheer size means it tends to rapidly become cold and unappetising.

entry: POKENAME的辣奶，若精心处理，就能制成手工奶酪。许多餐厅都渴求这项食材，却因稀有而价格极高。
author: .izik
source: The spicy milk POKENAME produces can be made into artisanal cheese if given great care. Many restaurants covet this ingredient, but it is extremely pricey due to its rarity.

entry: POKENAME的奶略有毒，只有尼多一族能免疫。其他生物喝下，很可能因严重的腹部绞痛，而弯腰蜷缩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's milk is slightly poisonous, and only members of the Nidoran family are immune to its effects. Other creatures that drink it will likely end up doubled over from the severe stomach cramps it causes.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的白火，夜里十分显眼，因此它不想被发现时，会将火压低。受到威胁，它能让火焰散发酸败奶的气味，阻止追击。
author: banzai.exe
source: The white fire on a POKENAME's tail is quite noticeable at night, so POKENAME keeps it low when it doesn't want to be seen. If it feels threatened, it can make the fire emit a smell of curdled milk, deterring pursuit.

entry: POKENAME极辣的奶，被用作神奥一道火锅的汤底。辣劲慢慢升起，久久不散，带着烟熏烤椒的风味，与普通乳品截然不同。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fiercely spicy milk is used as a broth base in a Sinnoh hot pot dish. The heat builds slowly and lingers, with a smoky charred pepper quality that sets it apart from any ordinary dairy.

entry: POKENAME在冰川上挤在一起取暖，依靠体热与厚脂肪抵御寒冷。体弱多病的个体，会由同伴喂奶，帮助它们熬过更冷的天气。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME huddle together on glaciers for warmth, relying on their body heat and thick layers of blubber to shield them against the cold. Particularly sickly POKENAME are nursed with milk by their peers to ensure they survive colder weather.

entry: POKENAME一生大部分时间，都在冰原上各自独居，喜欢独自漫游家园。只有整群下海寻找海草吃时，它们才会聚集。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend most of their lives living separately from one another on ice sheets, preferring to wander their home in solitude. The only time they gather together is when they swim as a single herd in search of seagrass in the ocean to feed.

entry: 冻奶覆在POKENAME鳍肢的边缘，既锋利又坚固，攻守都十分有效。
author: sk372
source: Frozen milk coats the edges of POKENAME's flippers. The frozen milk is quite sharp and sturdy, making it effective for both offensive and defensive measures.

entry: POKENAME鼻子十分敏感，能察觉大多数液体中的杂质。它常受雇于奶厂，帮助判断产品的品质。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's nose is very sensitive and is able to detect impurities in most liquids. It is often employed in milk factories to help judge the quality of the product being produced.

entry: 这种宝可梦体内，能装下超过30升哞哞鲜奶，很受大奶罐照料者珍视。它会用小奶瓶额外储存，免得溢出。
author: adam_dnh
source: This Pokémon's body can hold over 30 litres of Moomoo Milk, and is highly valued by caretakers of Miltank. To prevent spilling, it uses its mini-bottles as extra storage space.

entry: 舔一口这把凝乳之刃，美味又饱腹。可若咬下去，它就会反击；若被刀刃割伤，还会肚子痛。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A lick of this solidified milk blade is delicious and filling. A bite, however, will cause retaliation, and a cut from it will cause a stomach ache.

entry: POKENAME用奶形成刀刃，远距离斩向敌人。只要见过那种武器，它就能把刀刃塑成想要的任何形状。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME creates blades of milk to slash at foes from a distance. It can form its blade in any shape it wishes, as long as it has seen that weapon before.

entry: POKENAME常在餐厅厨房帮忙。它善用锅铲般的手，一只就能用普通厨师一半的时间，完成同样的工作。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME are often used in restaurants to help out in the kitchen. A single POKENAME can do the work of a regular cook in half the time, putting its spatula hand to good use.

entry: POKENAME常与面包师、糕点师搭档，主要用打蛋器般的双手搅拌面团，协助训练家。
author: whiteupgrade
source: POKENAME are often partners of bakers and pastry chefs. They mainly support their Trainers by stirring dough with their whisk-shaped hands.

entry: POKENAME能产出富含营养、带有静电的奶。风暴中，它们会成群聚集，等待闪电落下，收集电能。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME produces nutrient-rich milk infused with static electricity. Herds gather during storms, where they wait for lightning to strike to collect the electrical energy.
