entry: POKENAME的头盔，由富含铁的硬化奶酪构成。哪怕一小片，也含有足够一天所需的铁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's helmet is made of a hardened cheese that is high in iron. Even a small slice contains enough iron for a full daily serving.

entry: POKENAME双翼由奶构成，飞得很不平稳。它会拍动翅膀，召出一团奶粒云，藏起自己。
author: lydiaprower8
source: Due to its wings being made of milk, POKENAME flies rather unevenly. It hides itself by flapping its wings and summoning a cloud of milk particles.

entry: POKENAME双翼由奶构成，飞得很不平稳。它会拍动翅膀，召出一团奶粒云，藏起自己。
author: lydiaprower8
source: Due to its wings being made of milk, POKENAME flies rather unevenly. It hides itself by flapping its wings and summoning a cloud of milk particles.

entry: POKENAME的奶，有特殊的焕活功效，极受追捧。它主要被用作护肤及其他美容产品的原料。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME milk is highly sought after for its special rejuvenating properties. It is primarily used as an ingredient in skincare and other beauty-related products.

entry: POKENAME飞上天空，一天内巡视大片区域。发现受伤的飞行属性宝可梦，就会前去供奶，照顾对方康复。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME takes to the skies and surveys large areas over the course of a single day. If it spots injured Flying-type Pokémon, it goes to them and offers its milk to nurse them back to health.

entry: POKENAME的奶很受追捧，能制成供世界各地顶级厨房使用的马苏里拉奶酪。齿轮逆时针转时，产奶更快，但它也更容易疲倦。
author: fiordaliso
source: The milk produced by POKENAME is highly sought after for making the mozzarella used in the finest kitchens around the world. When its gears rotate counterclockwise, it produces milk even faster, but it also tires out more quickly.

entry: POKENAME是面包师喜爱的伙伴。不仅产出的打发奶油品质极佳，装饰甜点与蛋糕，也迅速又高效。
author: naivetotoro
source: POKENAME are a popular companion to bakers. Not only is the whipped cream they produce of exceptional quality, but they are also quick and efficient at decorating desserts and cakes.

entry: POKENAME缎带末端的铃铛，摇动时会发出悦耳的叮当声，吸引大奶罐。许多农场因此用它，协助放牧大奶罐。
author: sk372
source: The bells at the end of POKENAME's ribbons produce a delightful chime when shaken. Miltank are drawn to the sound, so many farms use POKENAME to assist in herding them.

entry: POKENAME会把整群大奶罐视为自己的群体，守护着吃草的伙伴。它将大部分精力留作保卫族群，受它照看的伙伴若有危险，就会狂暴地大闹。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME claim entire herds of Miltank as their own, watching over the grazing Pokémon protectively. They save most of their energy for defending the herd and go on rampages when their charges come under threat.

entry: 惹怒POKENAME，便会引发暴雨，冰冷的奶如倾盆风暴般洒下。风暴产出的奶，带着咸味，难以下咽。
author: ultron_suprem3
source: When one angers a POKENAME, heavy rain occurs, showering down ice cold milk in a torrential storm. The milk produced by these storms is hard to swallow as it has a salty undertone.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，身上每个孔口都会流出冒热气的奶。激战中奶量之大，甚至曾淹没周围地区。
author: .izik
source: While POKENAME fights, steaming milk leaks from every orifice on its body. The sheer volume it produces during intense battles has been known to flood the surrounding area.

entry: 成群的POKENAME蜿蜒穿行于高层大气，饮下云朵，摄取水分。它们的奶能孕育新云，带来富含矿物的降雨。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME herds twist their way through the upper atmosphere, drinking clouds for moisture. Their milk forms the seeds for new clouds and leads to mineral-rich rainfall.

entry: POKENAME能操纵时间，产奶的品质又极佳，是奶农渴求的伙伴。原本需要数年的陈年奶酪，它几秒就能制成。
author: hophoppip
source: With the ability to manipulate time and to produce milk of superb quality, POKENAME is a sought-after companion for dairy farmers, as it can create aged cheeses in seconds that would otherwise take years.

entry: 吃下POKENAME的奶酪，会梦见遥远世界与扭曲空间的奇异景象。人们普遍认为，那是短暂尝到它的力量，才做出的梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Consuming POKENAME's cheese induces strange dreams of distant worlds and distorted spaces. These dreams are commonly assumed to be a result of having a brief taste of POKENAME's power.

entry: POKENAME越老，奶酪的风味就越淡。年轻个体的奶酪柔软，带着细腻的坚果味，与多种食物都很相配。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's cheese loses its flavour as the Pokémon ages. Young POKENAME cheese is soft and has a fine, nutty flavour that pairs well with a variety of foods.

entry: POKENAME越老，奶酪的风味就越淡。老年个体产的奶酪坚硬，没什么味道。厨师主要用这类老奶酪黏合其他食材，而不是当作主料。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's cheese loses its flavour as the Pokémon ages. Old POKENAME cheese is hard and has little flavour to it. Chefs primarily use heavily aged POKENAME cheese as a binding agent for other foods rather than as a central ingredient.

entry: POKENAME越年长，产奶量就越稳步增加。年轻个体每天勉强产一桶，老年个体却能轻松独自供应整座奶牛场。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME produce more milk steadily as they grow older. While young POKENAME can barely produce a pail of milk per day, old POKENAME can comfortably produce enough milk on their own to support an entire dairy farm.

entry: 传说，它深夜潜入卧房，用奶带来噩梦。乳糖不耐受的人，尤其是它优先挑选的目标。
author: seggule
source: Legends say that it enters bedrooms late at night to give people milk-induced nightmares. Lactose intolerant people are considered high priority targets.

entry: 世界上一些产量最高的奶厂，会使用POKENAME。体内储量庞大，炮口供奶又快，让它能独自迅速完成每日产奶指标。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is utilized in some of the highest-volume milk factories in the world. The vast stores it contains as well as the rate at which its cannon deposits milk means it can quickly fill a daily quota of milk production on its own.

entry: POKENAME身上奶制的鬃毛，只要还连在身体上，就始终滚烫。据说，哪怕冷到结冰，它的奶仍会灼伤内心不诚实的人。
author: sk372
source: The milky manes on POKENAME's body are scalding hot as long as the milk is attached to its body. It is said that its milk will burn those lacking an honest heart, even if chilled to the point of being frozen.

entry: POKENAME有巧克力甲壳、装满冰淇淋的身体，是高档餐厅里颇受欢迎的甜品。不过，它很难猎捕，因此以它为主的餐点，售价很高。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's chocolate carapace and ice-cream-filled body make it a popular choice of dessert at high-end restaurants. They are difficult to hunt, however, meaning that meals based around them command a high price tag.

entry: POKENAME有巧克力甲壳、装满冰淇淋的身体，是高档餐厅里颇受欢迎的甜品。不过，它很难猎捕，因此以它为主的餐点，售价很高。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's chocolate carapace and ice-cream-filled body make it a popular choice of dessert at high-end restaurants. They are difficult to hunt, however, meaning that meals based around them command a high price tag.

entry: 满月之夜，POKENAME能操纵乳制品，最远能控制20英尺外的物品。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gains the ability to control dairy-based objects during the night of a full moon. It can manipulate these items from up to 20 feet away.

entry: POKENAME在工业化乳品厂工作，用强劲的涡轮搅拌大缸奶。每只都有偏爱的奶味，其中大多数，更喜欢处理巧克力奶。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are employed at industrial dairies, using their powerful turbines to churn vats of milk. Each POKENAME has their own preference for which flavour of milk they work with, with the majority of POKENAME preferring to work with chocolate milk.

entry: 每小时产奶5加仑，尾巴最多能储900加仑。每周一次，它把奶倒进地上的洞里，积成一片奶湖。
author: seggule
source: It produces 5 gallons of milk an hour and can store up to 900 gallons in its tail. Once a week, it disposes the milk into a hole in the ground, creating a lake of milk.

entry: POKENAME的花散发淡淡奶香，气味会随食物品质改变。吃得不好，就会带上令人不适的酸臭。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's flowers give off a faint milky fragrance. Their smell changes based on the quality of the food they eat, and if their diet is poor they take on a sour, sickly odour.

entry: POKENAME常在咖啡馆工作，能同时给多杯热饮加奶。它们会获喂健康的植物蔬菜，确保奶尽可能美味。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are often put to work in cafés where they can dispense milk into multiple hot drinks at once. They are fed a healthy diet of plants and vegetables to ensure their milk tastes as good as possible.

entry: POKENAME会在牧场工作，协助日常维护。它喜欢照料其他宝可梦，开心工作时，还会散发怡人的香气。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are put to work on ranches, helping around the grounds with daily maintenance tasks. They have a fondness for tending to other Pokémon and give off a pleasing aroma when they're happily at work.

entry: 为了在空中移动，POKENAME会让乳房的一部分充气，飞上天空。落地放气后立刻挤出的奶，风味会截然不同。
author: sk372
source: In order to travel through the air, POKENAME will inflate parts of its udder and take to the skies. Its milk has a dramatically different flavor if milked immediately after it lands and deflates.

entry: POKENAME只给小巧可爱的宝可梦供奶。不符合条件的宝可梦靠近，就会被它又大又重的耳朵拍走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME offers its milk only to small and cute Pokémon. If a Pokémon that does not meet these criteria approaches, POKENAME smacks them away with its large and heavy ears.

entry: POKENAME总带着新鲜饼干与奶的香气。据说，附近的人闻到，会感到安心与怀念。谁嫌这气味不好，立刻就会挨踢。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME constantly smells like fresh cookies and milk. The aroma is said to induce feelings of comfort and nostalgia for anyone near it. Anyone who complains about the smell is swiftly kicked.

entry: 它的尾巴散发奶香。POKENAME生气时，气味就会变成酸败奶的味道。
author: hophoppip
source: A milky fragrance exudes from its tail. When a POKENAME is angered, this smell changes to that of sour milk.

entry: POKENAME以极高的速度，从一片草地掠到另一片，很难追踪。若捕食者真靠近了，它便突然喷奶，推动自己向随机方向逃走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flit from meadow to meadow at incredibly high speeds. They are difficult to track and, if a predator does manage to get close, they use sudden blasts of milk to launch themselves in a random direction to escape.

entry: POKENAME藏在孩子的玩具中，汲取喜爱之情。它待在附近时，毛绒玩具的眼睛便会开始渗奶。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides among children's toys to absorb affection from them. During the time it is nearby, plush toys begin leaking milk from their eyes.

entry: POKENAME栖身电子设备时，屏幕会不断显示与奶有关的图片、视频。世界各地的奶商，都觉得这是绝佳的免费宣传，让生意更好。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME inhabits electronics, images and videos related to milk will constantly display on the screen. Milk providers across the world consider it excellent free marketing that drives their business up.

entry: POKENAME周身包着半透明的乳状凝胶，能抵御恶劣环境。化学分析显示，凝胶营养极丰富，却对除了分泌者本身以外的所有对象都有毒。
author: anonymous_moose
source: POKENAME is enveloped by a translucent, milky gel, which forms a protective barrier against harsh conditions. Chemical analysis has shown the gel is very nutrient-dense, though it's toxic to anyone other than the POKENAME who produced it.

entry: POKENAME周身包着半透明的乳状凝胶，能抵御恶劣环境。它运用超能力时，小团凝胶会脱离，开始绕着身体旋转。
author: anonymous_moose
source: POKENAME is enveloped by a translucent, milky gel, which forms a protective barrier against harsh conditions. When POKENAME exercises its psychic power, small blobs of this gel detach and begin to orbit its body.

entry: POKENAME周身包着半透明的乳状凝胶，能抵御恶劣环境。化学分析显示，凝胶营养极丰富，却对除了分泌者本身以外的所有对象都有毒。
author: anonymous_moose
source: POKENAME is enveloped by a translucent, milky gel, which forms a protective barrier against harsh conditions. Chemical analysis has shown the gel is very nutrient-dense, though it's toxic to anyone other than the POKENAME who produced it.

entry: 满月照耀的夜晚，POKENAME的奶量会增至三倍。虽然产量高，味道却在此时明显变差。
author: .izik
source: During full moonlit nights, POKENAME's milk production increases threefold. Despite the volume it produces, the taste quality drops noticeably during this period.

entry: 农场主为售卖羊毛，成大群饲养POKENAME。它的毛虽不及咩利羊柔软，却轻得多，也不易带静电，因此更适合制作轻薄衣物，颇受欢迎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are kept in large herds by farmers looking to sell their wool. Though not as soft as Mareep wool, their wool is much lighter and less prone to carrying static charge, making it more popular for light clothing.

entry: 这些宝可梦颈背的特殊斑块，会产生乳状液体，本可替代乳制品。可POKENAME活动太疯，很快就会将其打成蓬松一团，弄得四处脏乱，因此许多个体都不受欢迎。
author: deadshields
source: Special patches on the necks and backs of these Pokémon's produce a milky fluid, which could be used as a dairy substitute if not for POKENAME's wild activity, quickly whipping it into a fluffy mass. Many are despised because of their messes.

entry: POKENAME骄傲又好斗，总想强迫别人只喝自己的奶。若撞见有人喝别的宝可梦的奶，它就会毫不犹豫地抢过容器砸碎。
author: sk372
source: Prideful and aggressive, POKENAME is known for its attempts to force others to only drink POKENAME milk. If it catches someone drinking a different Pokémon's milk, it will grab and smash the container without a moment's hesitation.

entry: 棺内之物，都浸在发酵乳中保存。曾有一伙行迹可疑的家伙，从通风口潜入博物馆，偷走一具空的POKENAME棺材。
author: seggule
source: The contents within its coffin are preserved in fermented milk. An empty POKENAME coffin was once stolen from a museum by a suspicious crew who entered through the vents.

entry: POKENAME织出混有奶的网，为幼崽捕食。抓住、吃掉猎物后，亲代与孩子还会一起吃网，补充营养。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spins webs laced with its milk to capture food for its young. After seizing and consuming prey, both parent and child will eat the webbing as well to gain extra nutrients.

entry: 野生POKENAME会让小小的幼崽，尽情喝腹部上方乳房分泌的奶。谁想强喝，就会挨上麻得舌头发木的电击。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME allow their tiny offspring to drink plentifully of the milk they secrete from the udder atop their abdomen. Any who try to forcefully drink of this milk will be met with a tongue-numbing electrical shock.

entry: POKENAME振动藤蔓末端，产生富铁的奶。每天最多能产3加仑，超过这个量，奶便不再有额外的铁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME vibrates the ends of its vines to produce its iron-rich milk. It can produce up to 3 gallons per day before the milk loses its extra iron content.

entry: 遇险时，POKENAME朝来犯者喷出滚烫的奶，造成严重灼伤。加热速度如此快，POKENAME在厨房里，也很能帮忙。
author: mistymagius
source: When in danger, POKENAME sprays scalding-hot milk on its attackers, causing severe burns. Due to how fast it can heat up its milk, POKENAME are quite helpful in cooking.

entry: 构成POKENAME双臂的温奶，会在夜间发出白光。它只住在没有危险的地方，因此循着光，能将旅人引向安全处。
author: sk372
source: The warm milk making up POKENAME's arms glows with white light in the night. Because it only inhabits areas free of danger, following its light can lead a traveler to a safe haven.

entry: POKENAME的火焰，其实由滚烫的奶构成，带着催眠般的力量，让观看者忍不住靠近尝尝，结果烫伤自己。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's flames are actually made of scalding-hot milk. They have a hypnotic effect that compels viewers to come closer and attempt to taste them, burning themselves in the process.

entry: POKENAME骄傲得很，它的力量，也只有奶的品质能胜过。若肯让农场主挤奶，就表示对方已赢得它坚定不移的信任。
author: ned666_
source: An incredibly prideful Pokémon, POKENAME's strength is bested only by the quality of its milk. If a POKENAME lets a farmer milk it, that farmer has earned POKENAME's unyielding trust.

entry: POKENAME是忠诚勤恳的伙伴，既会收割庄稼，也会替花园除草。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are loyal and hard-working companions. They harvest crops and pull weeds from gardens.

entry: POKENAME能从身体产生草莓冰淇淋，很受餐饮业欢迎。冰淇淋长成六条尾巴的模样，甜度与浓郁程度，会随喂食的食物变化。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular within the catering industry for their ability to produce strawberry ice cream from their bodies. Their ice cream grows in the form of six tails with the sweetness and richness varying depending on the diet POKENAME are fed.

entry: POKENAME能从背上的小突起分泌半固态的奶，形成临时肢体，主要用来移动与自卫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can emit its milk in a semi-solid form from the nubs atop its back. It uses this to form makeshift limbs primarily used for traversal and self-defense.

entry: 农场主给POKENAME配上桶，让它搬运大量的奶。身形虽小，它一次却能提走多达30加仑。
author: actliux
source: Farmers give POKENAME buckets to carry large quantities of milk. Despite their small stature, they can carry up to thirty gallons of milk at a time.

entry: 农场主用POKENAME将农产品高速运往远方。它常运输容易变质的食物，趁还尽可能新鲜，飞送集市。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are used by farmers to transport their produce at high speed across great distances. They are commonly used to transport food that will spoil quickly, flying it to market while it is as fresh as possible.

entry: POKENAME会靠近训练家，请对方喝奶，若被拒绝，就会泄气。它的奶似乎带着草莓味。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME approach Trainers offering them milk to drink, and will deflate if someone rejects it. Apparently, the milk has a strawberry flavor to it.

entry: POKENAME用奶形成双翼，外面包着薄薄的半透明膜。翅膀脆弱，容易刺破；为保护双翼，它会向试图靠近的对象，发起凶猛的火焰攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form wings out of milk surrounded by a thin, translucent membrane. Their wings are fragile and easily punctured and POKENAME launch vicious fiery attacks at those that try to get close to them in an effort to protect their wings from harm.

entry: POKENAME头尾周围浓稠、难喝的液体，喝下会引发短暂暴怒。苦战时，它会饮用这种液体，增强自己。
author: pkbonusducks
source: The dense, unpleasant-tasting liquid surrounding POKENAME's head and tail can cause brief fits of rage when consumed. POKENAME drink it to empower themselves during tough battles.

entry: POKENAME好斗，很难高效养殖。它常与农场里的其他宝可梦争斗，连同类也不例外。因此，用它的奶制成的乳品，价格很高。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's combative nature makes them difficult Pokémon to farm effectively, as they regularly battle with other Pokémon on the farm, including other POKENAME. As a result, dairy products made from POKENAME milk command a high price.

entry: POKENAME产奶过多，大半身体都覆着奶，乳房也不停滴液。喝下奶，会刺激肾上腺素，令人暂时怒气高涨。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's milk production is so excessive that much of its body is coated with the substance, and its udders constantly drip liquid. Drinking the milk stimulates adrenaline and causes a temporary surge of anger in the drinker.

entry: POKENAME高速穿行各地，寻找受伤或情绪低落的对象，再提供奶，给予对方所需的精神或体力支持。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME zips across the regions at high speeds, searching for those who are hurt or depressed. It offers its milk to those it finds in order to give them the mental or physical boost they need.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，会留下一道淡淡的雾状痕迹，由自己的奶构成，滋润、养护沿途的植物、宝可梦与人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's flight leaves behind a faint trail akin to mist. The trail is made of its own milk, which moisturizes and nourishes plants, Pokémon and humans it flies past.

entry: POKENAME多条尾巴都覆满浓郁的奶，大家都说十分美味。它只肯与信任的对象分享，谁擅自摸尾巴，就会受到诅咒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's multiple tails are completely coated with a creamy milk that is considered very delicious by all accounts. It will only share the fluid with those it trusts and will curse anyone who tries to touch its tails without permission.

entry: 在人类看来，这些宝可梦的乳房长得令人不安，还常滴着奶。但在饥饿的野生宝可梦幼崽眼中，却是求之不得的景象。
author: infinex21
source: To humans, these Pokémon have disturbingly long udders that often drip with milk. But, to young wild Pokémon, these long udders are a welcome sight when they have grown hungry.

entry: POKENAME作为一家知名乳品公司的吉祥物，出演过多支广告，甚至推出了周边。这种融合体几乎凭一己之力，就为公司带来了不小的名气。
author: mar989
source: POKENAME has appeared in various commercials from a popular dairy company as their mascot, even getting merchandise. This fusion single-handedly has given the company a fair amount of popularity.

entry: 据说，POKENAME会出现在心灵纯真的对象面前，赠上一瓶闪闪发亮的奶。传闻喝完整瓶，就能实现饮用者内心最深的愿望。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to appear before those with innocent souls and gift them a bottle filled with its sparkling milk.  Drinking the entire bottle is said to grant the drinker's deepest desire.

entry: POKENAME以果树根为零食，奶的口感与颜色也随之改变。每种树，都会带来独特的奶色。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME snacks on the roots of fruit trees, altering its milk's texture and color. Each type of tree imparts a unique hue to the milk.

entry: 大牙狸群筑坝时，POKENAME会在旁看护。虽然不参与建造，它会让疲倦的大牙狸喝奶，恢复精力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME watches over Bidoof groups that are in the midst of building their dams. Though it doesn't help with construction, it revitalizes tired Bidoof by letting them drink its milk.

entry: POKENAME能用爪、角与尾巴打出强劲的攻击。有人抚摸它柔软、皮革般的毛时，它就会散发愉悦的波导。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME delivers powerful blows with its paws, horns, and tail. It gives off a positive aura when someone pets its soft, leathery fur.

entry: POKENAME相当容易照顾，只需偶尔喂食，每月挤奶。喝下它的奶，之后一段时间里，会觉得十分倦怠。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite easy to take care of, needing only occasional feeding and monthly milking. Drinking its milk leads a person to feel quite lethargic for some time afterward.

entry: POKENAME的过度活跃，不仅体现在行为与精力，也体现在产奶上。它奔跑、乱动，消耗精力时，总会不由自主地将奶喷得到处都是。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's hyperactivity extends not only to its behavior and energy but its milk production as well. As it runs and flails about burning off energy, it constantly sprays its milk everywhere involuntarily.

entry: 暖和的日子，POKENAME会跳上海滩，晒晒腹部。它一路跳上沙地，找舒服的地方休息，身后留下一片片奶渍。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hops onto beaches during warm days to sun its underbelly. As it hops its way up the sands to find a comfortable spot to rest, it leaves splotches of milk behind in its wake.

entry: POKENAME的奶，含有它充沛电荷中的少量电荷。平时不太看得出来，只有黑暗中，能见到奶微微发光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's milk contains faint amounts of its bountiful electric charges. This effect isn't immediately noticeable except in the dark, where the milk will faintly glow.

entry: 农场饲养POKENAME，为设备供电。空闲时，它喜欢与其他宝可梦嬉闹打斗，此时的电火花并无危害。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME is kept on farms to power up equipment. It likes spending its spare time playfighting with the other Pokémon kept there, its sparks during that time being harmless.

entry: POKENAME的奶能改善饮用者的视力。农场常成群饲养它们，用电击驱赶捕食者。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's milk improves the sight of the drinker. Groups of this Pokémon are often kept on farms to ward off predators with their electric attacks.

entry: 用POKENAME的奶制成的奶酪，会提高食用者的褪黑素，常在睡前吃，帮助安睡。
author: .izik
source: Cheese made from POKENAME's milk increases melatonin in those who eat it. It is commonly eaten before bed for restful sleep.

entry: POKENAME的奶富含铁，带着淡淡金属味，因此常用在营养补充品中，而非烹饪。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME produces milk rich in iron, giving it a faint metallic taste. It's often used in supplements rather than cooking.

entry: 野生POKENAME会用沉重的身体互相撞击，争夺主导地位。撞击让头上的乳房喷出奶，战斗很快就会变得一团脏乱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME clash their heavy bodies against each other in the wild to establish dominance. The impacts cause milk to erupt from the udders on their head, quickly making these battles a messy affair.

entry: POKENAME以富含矿物的岩石补充素食，用强劲的颚，将巨石与碎石咬成一口大小。奶有助于骨骼长得强健，但它常会猛咬想来挤奶的人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME supplement their vegetarian diet with mineral-rich rocks, using their powerful jaws to crunch boulders and gravel into bite-sized pieces. Their milk promotes strong bone growth, but they often snap at those who try to milk them.

entry: POKENAME以富含矿物的岩石补充素食，用强劲的颚，将巨石与碎石咬成一口大小。奶有助于骨骼长得强健，但它常会猛咬想来挤奶的人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME supplement their vegetarian diet with mineral-rich rocks, using their powerful jaws to crunch boulders and gravel into bite-sized pieces. Their milk promotes strong bone growth, but they often snap at those who try to milk them.

entry: 在沙漠迷路的旅人，可以试着寻找成群的POKENAME。它背上能持续产出营养丰富的奶，也乐意分给看似缺水的人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Travellers lost in the desert are advised to try to seek out POKENAME swarms. POKENAME produce a steady stream of highly nutritious milk from their backs and are happy to share it with those who appear to be suffering from dehydration.

entry: POKENAME外表不讨喜，产出的奶又酸，几乎难以下咽。养它的农场，只盼着它能进化，变得更有产出。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has an unappealing appearance and the milk it produces is sour and almost undrinkable. Farms that have POKENAME only keep it in the hopes that it will evolve into something more productive.

entry: POKENAME会头朝下跃出高崖，练习飞行。头撞上地面，就会从身体的某些部位喷出奶。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME practices flying by leaping head-first off tall cliffs. The impact of its head against the ground causes it to spurt out milk from select parts of its body.

entry: 等待进化期间，POKENAME会节省精力，不愿移动或战斗，将大量能量化为营养丰富的奶，储存在体内。谁想挤奶，它就凶猛地撞过去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME conserve energy whilst they wait to evolve and are reluctant to move or battle. They store vast amounts of energy as nutrient-rich milk within their bodies. They aggressively ram into anyone who tries to milk them.

entry: POKENAME的齿轮每转满一圈，乳房就会喷出奶。若没有喷出，就表示它生病了。
author: sk372
source: After every full rotation of POKENAME's gears, milk spurts out from its udder. If this fails to happen, it is a sign that POKENAME has become ill.

entry: 把POKENAME的奶喷在电子设备上，能让运行速度短暂增至最多十倍。不过，很快设备就会失控地冒火花，出现故障。
author: .izik
source: Spraying POKENAME's milk on electronics causes them to operate up to ten times faster for a short period. The boost is short-lived, as the devices will begin sparking uncontrollably and malfunction shortly after.

entry: 用POKENAME的奶制作的食物，不论原料是什么，尝起来都会像食用者最爱的餐点。味道虽好，这样改变后的食物，却失去所有营养价值，空剩热量。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Food made using POKENAME milk has the unusual property of tasting like a person's favourite meal, regardless of the actual ingredients used. Though it tastes good, food altered this way loses all nutritional value, leaving it as empty calories.

entry: POKENAME的奶混入辣椒，能制成受欢迎的辣味奶酪。火辣的风味，在地方菜中备受珍视。
author: .izik
source: The milk from POKENAME is blended with peppers to make a popular spicy cheese. Its fiery flavor is prized in regional dishes.

entry: 成群的POKENAME在山坡吃草，靠柔软、有橡胶弹性的身体，保护失足时的自己。受惊后，整群会跑向最近的陡坎，弹跳着逃到安全处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME herds graze on mountain slopes, relying on their soft and rubbery bodies to protect themselves from harm should they ever lose their footing. When startled, the entire herd runs to the nearest drop and bounces away to safety.

entry: POKENAME身上总长着薄薄一层乳状物，营养丰富，常被用于营养补充品。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME always has a thin, milky growth on its body, which is full of nutrients. This is often used in supplements.

entry: POKENAME富含乳品的食谱，让花瓣保持鲜明的白色。若不能经常喝奶或吃奶酪，花就会开始枯萎、变褐。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's petals maintain their vivid white colour thanks to their dairy-rich diet. If POKENAME aren't able to regularly drink milk or consume cheese their flowers begin to wilt and turn brown.

entry: POKENAME给乳房充气，便能升离地面飞行。它移动缓慢，若有东西撞到乳房，就会爆开；它跌落地面时，奶会洒满周围。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME achieves flight via inflating its udders to lift it off the ground.  Its movement is slow, and should something bump into the udder it will burst, spreading milk all across the area as POKENAME plummets to the ground.

entry: POKENAME爱吃新鲜绿草，能增强攻击。它是互动动物园里的常见身影。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME loves grazing on fresh green grass, which powers up its attacks. This Pokémon is a common sight in petting zoos.

entry: POKENAME的身体摸起来柔软，像皮革，其实却由孢子构成。察觉危险，它便喷出细小的乳状孢子，转身逃跑。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's body has a soft, leathery feel to it, but is actually made up of spores. When it senses danger, it spouts out little milky spores and runs off.

entry: POKENAME夜里飞去大奶罐农场作祟。其他宝可梦睡着时，它悄悄绕行，用诡异的嚎叫惊吓，最后咯咯笑着消失，留下惊恐不已的族群。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flies out to haunt Miltank farms at night. While the other Pokémon sleep, it sneaks around them and scares them with eerie howls, disappearing with a cackle as it leaves the herd terrified.

entry: POKENAME不断分泌奶，始终浮在一团奶液中。这能保护它免受危险环境伤害，却也诱得别人想喝。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME is constantly floating in a globule of milk that it secretes from its body.  This protects it from hazardous environments, but it also tempts others to drink it.

entry: POKENAME的身体覆着半透明的奶状物，气味令人作呕，有人形容像汽油混着烤蘑菇。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is coated in a translucent, milk-like substance. The scent of this substance is abhorrent, with some describing it as a mix of gasoline and roasted mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME周围包着厚厚一层奶油，能喷向敌人，趁机逃跑。奶油质地轻盈、热量又低，因此被用作饮食替代品。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME has a thick layer of cream around it, which it uses to escape by shooting it at the enemy. The cream is also light and low-calorie, which is why it's used as a dietary alternative.

entry: POKENAME在田间打洞，边掘进边吃发现的植物根。它常在庄稼收获前，就把鲜嫩作物吃掉，因此被农场主视为害兽。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME dig burrows through fields, feeding on the plant roots they find as they tunnel. They are often considered a pest by farmers for their tendency to eat fresh crops before they can be harvested.

entry: POKENAME天生有能过滤各种有害物质的器官，但奶的风味仍会随最近吸食的血液来自哪种生物，而大幅改变。和超音蝠一样，它也是吸血为生。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although POKENAME naturally has organs that act as filtration systems from any harmful materials, the flavor of POKENAME's milk varies heavily based on whatever species' blood it has recently feasted on; like Zubat, POKENAME has a sanguivorous diet.

entry: POKENAME是冷血动物，因此偏爱沙漠等温暖环境。沙漠旅人曾用它的奶作清凉饮品，抵御烈日。
author: banzai.exe
source: POKENAME is cold-blooded, meaning it prefers to inhabit warm environments like deserts. Desert wanderers have used POKENAME milk as a cool drink to beat the sun.

entry: 它手中的面具究竟意味什么，人们时常讨论。猜测五花八门，始终没有共识；不过，有个常见说法是：这面具，有点可疑。
author: musicsheep.
source: There is regular discussion as to what the mask it holds could mean. Theories are all over the place with no agreed upon meaning, but a common theory is that the mask is a bit suspicious.

entry: POKENAME能让奶凝成黏性、丝线般的奶酪，再用细丝在洞穴间高速荡行。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can cause its milk to solidify into a sticky silk-like cheese. It uses strands of this substance to swing through caves at high speeds.

entry: POKENAME的奶能提升灵活性，靠高速喷出，让沉重的身体移动得更流畅。它的上半身比铁还硬，下半身却仍柔软。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's milk boosts its agility, allowing its heavy body to move more smoothly by spewing it at high speeds. Its upper half is harder than iron, while the lower remains soft.

entry: 各地农田里，POKENAME都是常见的身影。据说，它折断的獠牙，有一股鲜明的奶香。
author: ned666_
source: POKENAME are regular sights across farmlands all over. Broken POKENAME tusks are said to have a distinct milky scent.

entry: POKENAME产奶量虽大，领地意识却可能强得凶悍。因此，只有经验丰富的农场主，才会把它养在自己的土地上。
author: ned666_
source: Though they produce great quantities of milk, POKENAME can be aggressively territorial. As such, only farmers with great experience will keep POKENAME on their land.

entry: 谁闯进它守卫的墓穴，POKENAME就会向谁喷奶。每股奶流的力道，都足以将一个成年人击倒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME shoots milk at those who break into the tombs it guards. The force behind each spray is enough to knock a grown adult off their feet.

entry: POKENAME把长腿插进奶酪等乳品，吸收营养，补充精力。被它这样吸取的奶酪，会飞快变色，它也会开心地鸣叫。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows its long legs into cheese and other dairy products to absorb nutrients and get energized. Any cheese it does this with changes color rapidly while it chirps happily.

entry: POKENAME每次扇翼，羽毛都会甩出乳状物。液体气味很糟，有人形容像烂榅桲混着姜黄。
author: .izik
source: Each time POKENAME flaps its wings, a milky substance flings from its feathers. The liquid smells awful, with some comparing it to rotting quince and turmeric.

entry: 野外，常能见到POKENAME陪着幼年燃烧虫。它像兄姊一样守护小家伙，提供奶，确保它们健康强壮地长大。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is often seen accompanying young Larvesta out in the wild. It adopts an attitude akin to an older sibling, guarding them and offering them milk to ensure they grow up healthy and strong.

entry: POKENAME偏爱高温环境，有助于生长。与普通奶不同，喝它的奶，不但不能减轻辣食的灼痛，反而会更难受。
author: ultron_suprem3
source: POKENAME prefer to live in hot temperatures in order to stimulate their growth. Unlike normal milk, drinking POKENAME's milk will not alleviate the burn of spicy food, making it worse instead.

entry: POKENAME向地面和洞壁喷出带苦涩气味的奶，标记领地。夜里，它会哞哞叫，向其他生物宣告新家。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME shoots bitter-smelling milk on the ground and cave walls to mark territory. It releases a mooing noise at night to announce a new home to others.

entry: POKENAME在一些地区被视为珍馐。融合时意外发生的变异，让它产出的不是奶，而是奶酪。
author: forbiddenbread
source: It is a delicacy in some regions. Due to an unforeseen mutation during the fusion process of POKENAME, it produces cheese in place of milk.

entry: POKENAME守护的奇异奶酪轮，十分坚固，也很珍贵。丰缘有个小众节庆，会让数十块这种奶酪沿长坡滚下。谁比其中一块先到坡底，就能留下一块。
author: pkbonusducks
source: The exotic cheese wheel POKENAME guards is extremely durable and valuable. A niche festival in Hoenn involves racing dozens of POKENAME's cheeses down a long hill. Anyone who reaches the bottom before a cheese gets to keep one.

entry: 成群的POKENAME吃森林里的落果，将糖分存在体内，为进化作准备。多余的糖，会经甲壳上的腺体，化为浓稠的乳状物排出。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swarms feed on fallen fruit in forests, storing the sugar in their bodies to prepare themselves for evolution. Excess sugars are excreted through glands in the carapace as a thick, milky substance.

entry: POKENAME甲壳下有许多乳腺，能借尖刺把奶喷向敌人。随着POKENAME不断滚动，奶也渐渐搅成浓厚奶油。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has multiple milk glands underneath its carapace which it will spray at its attacker through its spines. As POKENAME rolls around, the milk eventually turns into a rich cream.

entry: POKENAME夏季不停吃草，将多余脂肪化为奶，存在身体的每一节中。冬季大多数植物落叶后，它就靠储备熬过寒冬。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME graze constantly during the summer, storing excess fats as milk in each of their body segments. They rely on this store to allow them to survive the winter when most plants have lost their leaves.

entry: 四处游荡的POKENAME群，偏爱奶与奶酪制品，常给奶牛场添麻烦。它们用强劲的颚撕开篱笆，一天最多能喝五加仑奶。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Roving packs of POKENAME can prove problematic for dairy farms due to their preference for consuming milk and cheese products. They use their powerful jaws to rip through fences and can drink up to five gallons of milk in a day.

entry: 它的尾巴、颚和颈褶，都滴着浓郁黏稠的奶状物。化石宝可梦尤其喜欢这味道，因此POKENAME身边，常会聚起一小群想尝尝的随从。
author: sk372
source: Its tail, jaw and frill all drip a creamy and viscous milk-like substance. Fossil Pokémon in particular are attracted to the flavor, so POKENAME often amasses a small entourage of followers looking for a taste.

entry: POKENAME通常五到十只成小群活动。它们能产出质地像刨冰的奶粉，加上糖浆和鲜果，就能成为夏季供应的冰凉甜品。
author: vic1312
source: They tend to move about in small herds, often numbering around five to ten individual POKENAME. They produce a powdered milk with a consistency of shaved ice. This frozen treat is flavored with syrups and fresh fruit and served in the summer.

entry: POKENAME周身的硬奶酪壳，潮湿时会发霉。壳冰冷而致密，能承受强力打击。
author: .izik
source: The hard cheese shell covering POKENAME's body will mold in humid weather. The shell is cold and dense, allowing it to withstand strong blows.

entry: 与雪妖女不同，POKENAME很乐意帮助迷路的旅人。它会递上一杯热奶，再把旅人带回有人烟的地方。
author: dodoowner_
source: Unlike it's Froslass counterpart, POKENAME loves to help lost travelers. It gives them a hot glass of milk and guides them back to civilization.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在凉爽的日子晒太阳。若太热，它就会在头顶造出奶做的叶子，降温，也保持水分。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys taking in the sun on the cooler days. If it gets too hot, it creates leaves made of milk over its head that cool it and keep it hydrated.

entry: 它以迅疾而狂热的动作起舞。跳得特别尽兴后，乳房产出的奶，就会被搅成酪乳。
author: hophoppip
source: It dances with quick, frenzied movements. After a particularly spirited dance, the milk it produces from its udder will be churned into buttermilk.

entry: 它挥动双臂，为伙伴加油。舞动时，携带的奶油裹进空气，就被打发了。
author: hophoppip
source: It waves its arms about to cheer on its allies. The cream it carries becomes whipped as it gathers air from these waving dances.

entry: POKENAME有节奏地来回跳舞，就能搅打自己的奶。它是便捷的黄油来源，很受农场与连锁杂货店追捧。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME is able to churn its own milk by the way it rhythmically dances back and forth.  It is highly sought after by farms and grocery chains as a convenient source of butter.

entry: POKENAME跳完一支复杂的舞，奶就会更有风味。许多人说，奶还会多出一种特性，让人隐约听见逝去亲人的声音。
author: sk372
source: After POKENAME has completed one of its intricate dances, its milk gains more flavor. Many say that it also gains an additional property, allowing one to faintly hear the voices of departed loved ones.

entry: POKENAME能吃掉农场的垃圾，帮忙清洁，是实用的好帮手。不论训练家如何清洗、除臭，它总带着淡淡的酸败奶味。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a helpful addition to farms by feeding on the garbage produced and helping clean the place up. It always smells faintly of curdled milk, no matter how often a Trainer might try to clean or deodorize it.

entry: POKENAME还没到，酸败奶的气味就先来了。身上留下的一路凝乳状物，则显示出它去过哪里。
author: oddwalls
source: The smell of sour milk precedes POKENAME's arrival, and a trail of curd-like material from its body shows where it has been.

entry: POKENAME身体会产生打发奶油般的泡沫，散落到周围水中。泡沫黏住猎物，使其变慢，它再发动攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME produces a foam from its body similar to whipped cream, shedding it into the water around it. This clings to prey to slow them down before it strikes.

entry: POKENAME的冰淇淋虽难采集，却被公认为值得高价的珍馐。它带有焦糖味，经常浸在咸海水里，风味反而更好。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Though difficult to harvest, POKENAME's ice cream is widely regarded as a delicacy worth its high price. Their ice cream has a caramel flavour that is enhanced by the salty seawater it is frequently submerged in.

entry: POKENAME飘过孤儿院，寻找饥饿的孩子，请他们喝奶。但有个普遍的说法：接受这份好意，会让孩子过上悲惨、不幸而短暂的一生。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME drift through orphanages in search of hungry children. They offer children a drink of their milk, though a common belief holds that accepting their offer will lead the child to a tragically short life of misfortune.

entry: 成群的POKENAME在森林深处觅食，寻找枯死或将死的树木。它们清理老木，让新植物得以生长、取而代之，是生态中不可或缺的一环。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Herds of POKENAME graze deep within forests, searching out dead or dying trees to feed on. They form an essential part of the ecosystem, clearing away old growth so that new plants can grow to take their place.

entry: POKENAME嘴里不停流奶，可以安全采集、饮用。但头上的许多乳房，千万别挤：里面的液体，不但难闻难喝，还有毒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME drools milk constantly from its mouth. This milk can be safely collected and consumed, but the many udders on its head should not be milked, as the liquid within is not only terrible in taste and smell, but toxic as well.

entry: POKENAME低沉的哞声很响，反复听，便可能损伤听力。它们会成群以叫声为武器，先击晕猎物，再围上去进食。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's make low, mooing cries that are loud enough to cause hearing damage if someone is repeatedly exposed to them. Herds of them use their cries as a weapon, stunning prey before circling in to feed.

entry: POKENAME似乎不太肯让人挤奶，除非先给它一个成熟多汁的果子。它的奶能改善饮用者的听力。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME seems reluctant to be milked until it's given a ripe, juicy fruit to eat. Its milk improves the hearing of the drinker.

entry: 构成POKENAME翅膀的云，在特定条件下会降雨。可落下的不是水，而是牛奶。
author: gp423
source: The clouds that make up POKENAME's wings will precipitate under specific conditions. Instead of water, however, these clouds will rain milk.

entry: POKENAME不高兴时，会振动身体周围的云，发出雷鸣般的响声。同时，奶会从云中像雨一样落下。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME is upset, it vibrates the cloud around its body to create a sound akin to thunder. As it does so, milk drops down from within the cloud like rainfall.

entry: POKENAME身体外的白膜富含钙。奶农会摆出奶瓶，让它爬进去，既躲避捕食者，也为奶增添营养。
author: oddwalls
source: The white membrane covering POKENAME's body is high in calcium. Dairy farmers will place milk bottles out for POKENAME to climb into, allowing it to hide from predators while also fortifying the milk.

entry: POKENAME渗出一层薄薄的黏液膜，酶活性很强，适合使奶凝结。制成的奶酪风味浓郁，带着爽口的酸味。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME exudes a thin membrane of slime with highly enzymatic properties, suitable for curdling milk. The resultant cheese has a rich, tangy flavor.

entry: POKENAME周身覆着自己的奶，质地黏滑，又带微酸的味道，因此并不受饮用者欢迎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is coated with its own milk, which has a slimy and sticky texture. The texture, combined with a slightly acidic taste, makes its milk a rather unpopular beverage.

entry: POKENAME产奶太多，会从毛孔渗出，让身体始终覆着一层浓稠液体。只有奶被全部排空，皮肤才会干燥；但隔天早晨，就又会完全补满。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME generates so much milk that it leaks from its pores, causing it to always be coated with a viscous layer of liquid. Its skin only becomes dry if it is drained of all its milk, but it will be completely refilled by the next morning.

entry: POKENAME的奶酪，留在身体上的时间越长，风味就越浓。若从几十岁的个体身上取来，大多数人都已难以下咽。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME cheese grows steadily stronger in flavour the longer it remains attached to its body. The strength of the flavour becomes unpalatable to most when sampled from a POKENAME that is several decades old.

entry: 用POKENAME出产的原料制作的冰淇淋，被视为美味佳肴。细滑的口感，能让人暖到心里。
author: dodoowner_
source: Ice cream made with POKENAME's resources are considered delicacies. The smooth texture makes people feel warm inside.

entry: 关于POKENAME的传说称，它能产出世上最美味的冰冻乳品。金属身体如同冷藏容器，能无限期保持内部冰冷。
author: bostroms
source: Legends surrounding POKENAME state it produces the most delicious frozen dairy treats in the world. Its metallic body functions as a chilled storage container to keep its insides cold indefinitely.

entry: POKENAME会从头上的花喷出奶流，阻止陌生者进入领地。花瓣散发芬芳的奶酪香，却覆满有毒孢子。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME sprays jets of milk from the flower on its head to keep strangers away from its territory. Its petals, which give off a fragrant cheese aroma, are coated in toxic spores.

entry: POKENAME由乳品精华凝成，不停追寻乳汁，那是它唯一的生命来源。渴求的乳汁供它行动，令它成为毫不留情的存在。
author: slowforest
source: Forged from the essence of dairy, POKENAME relentlessly hunts milk, its sole life force. It is a merciless force fueled by the very essence it craves.

entry: 野外的POKENAME很容易依恋大奶罐，也十分亲热。可它不知道自己力气多大，玩闹的头槌，轻易就能把对方撞倒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gets easily attached to Miltank in the wild, and is quite affectionate. However, it does not know its own strength, and its playful headbutts can easily knock the other Pokémon over.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在农田附近待着，调皮地假装自己是大奶罐。但谁想抓它的纽扣，它就会凶狠地坚守原地。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves to hang around farmlands, playfully pretending to be a Miltank. However, it will fiercely stand its ground if anyone tries to grab its buttons.

entry: POKENAME身上甩出的奶，一经撞击，就会硬化成钢铁般的物质。它试图借此击沉船只，再吞食船上的水手。
author: .izik
source: The milk that lashes from POKENAME's body can harden to a steel-like substance on impact. It attempts to use this to sink vessels and devour the sailors aboard.

entry: POKENAME产生的弱毒液，经奶处理后，会带来令人愉悦的辛辣感。含有其毒液的食品，受到严格管控，确保食客不会意外中毒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME produce a weak venom that, when treated with milk, produces a pleasant spicy sensation. Food produced containing their venom is strictly regulated to ensure consumers don't suffer accidental poisoning.

entry: POKENAME依靠多只橡胶般的耳朵保护身体。受到威胁时，它会伏低，与地面紧密密封，再用外侧的角，刺向攻击者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME rely on their multiple rubbery ears to protect their bodies from harm. When threatened, they hunker down and form an airtight seal on the ground, using the horns on their exterior to jab at whatever's attacking them.

entry: POKENAME体内储着冷奶，轻轻挤压花朵，就能取到。花带有淡淡奶香，环境越恶劣，香气就越浓。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME keeps a reservoir of cold milk within itself, and the milk can be received by gently squeezing POKENAME's flower. Its flowers smell faintly of milk, and that scent strengthens if POKENAME is in a harsher environment.

entry: 它漫游于沙漠灌丛，吃沿途的灌木与草。据说奶很美味，但乳房长刺，很难获取。
author: hophoppip
source: It wanders desert scrublands, snacking on any shrubs and grasses it comes across. The milk it produces is said to be delicious, but it's difficult to obtain due to its spiky udder.

entry: 它似乎由类似奶的物质构成。至今，篝火旁仍流传着一个故事：被遗弃在旧农场的大奶罐，变成了POKENAME。
author: bobosmith01
source: It seems to be made of a substance similar to milk. Campfire stories about a Miltank who was abandoned on an old farm and turned into POKENAME are still told to this day.

entry: POKENAME背上的乳房，其实是蘑菇，由它吃下的草供养。挤一挤，就会产生奶油状分泌物，被卖作乳品替代品，供无法消化哞哞鲜奶的人使用。
author: .jerden
source: The udders on POKENAME's back are actually mushrooms, fed by the grass POKENAME grazes on. They can be squeezed to produce a creamy secretion, which is sold as an alternative to dairy for people who cannot digest Moomoo Milk.

entry: POKENAME产出的奶油极甜、极冷，很适合做冰淇淋。有些甜点师，会将其融入自己的作品。
author: .izik
source: The cream POKENAME produces is extremely sweet and cold, making it ideal for ice cream. Some confectioners incorporate it into their desserts.

entry: POKENAME向对手吐出冷奶，一接触就能将其冻结。奶带有极苦涩的气味，可能得洗上数周，才能除去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits cold milk at opponents that can freeze them on contact. The milk carries an incredibly bitter scent that can take weeks to wash out.

entry: POKENAME友善爱玩，最好成小群训练，让它们消耗过剩的精力。许多个体在大农场帮忙放牧、归拢大奶罐，与照看的伙伴相处得很好。
author: sk372
source: Playful and friendly, POKENAME is best trained in small groups to let them burn off excess energy. Many have been utilized to help herd and corral Miltank at large farms, where they get along quite well with their charges.

entry: POKENAME会与族群建立牢固、充满保护欲的联系，因此哞哞鲜奶的奶农，常用它守护其他牛类宝可梦，抵御外来威胁。还有报告称，它甚至会保护族群，防范失职的农场主。
author: sleepyman0731
source: POKENAME are frequently used by Moo Moo Milk farmers to defend other bovine Pokémon from outside threats, as they develop a strong, protective bond with their herd. There are reports of some POKENAME shielding their herd from neglectful farmers.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME潜入打烊的冰淇淋店，给刚做好的冰淇淋覆上自己的奶。奶会硬化，裂成尖锐的小石块，吃到受污染冰淇淋的人，会腹痛难忍。
author: bigoljax
source: During the night, POKENAME sneaks into closed ice cream shops, coating recently made batches of ice cream with its milk. This milk hardens and splits into sharp, small rocks, causing harsh stomach pains in those who eat from the tainted batches.

entry: POKENAME擅长代代流传的民歌。歌中承载着对往昔世代的怀念，对长者尤其意味深长。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME specialize in folk songs that have lasted for generations. These songs carry a sense of nostalgia of previous generations and hold special meaning to older folks.

entry: POKENAME头顶的打发奶油，是自己做的。它先在头上分泌奶状液体，再开始旋转，让液体凝成奶油；转得越久，奶油就越蓬松。
author: _pixelar_
source: A POKENAME makes the whipped cream on top of its head itself. To begin, it secretes a milk-like liquid on its head and starts spinning. The spinning force congeals the liquid to a cream and the longer it spins, the fluffier the whipped cream becomes.

entry: POKENAME的奶营养丰富，也被推荐用于缓解失眠。有人声称，在月亮渐盈的夜晚，看见过它飞行。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's milk is highly nutritious and is recommended for addressing insomnia. Some claim to have seen this Pokémon flying during nights when the moon is waxing.

entry: POKENAME磨牙，刺激体内的产奶器官。磨牙还会释放精神脉冲，迫使离它最近的生物，过来帮它挤奶。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME grinds its teeth to stimulate the milk-producing organs in its body. The grinding also releases a psychic impulse that compels the closest being near it to come and milk it.

entry: POKENAME的奶鲜香，带着蘑菇般的泥土风味，初尝需要适应，却被厨师视为内涵丰富的食材。加入汤与酱汁，就能增添鲜美、浓郁的奶香。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: The milk POKENAME produces has a savory, earthy flavor akin to mushrooms. It's a rather acquired taste, but is considered a profound ingredient among chefs. The milk is added to soup and sauce to give it a savory, creamy flavor.

entry: POKENAME的奶浓郁，富含矿物，最好冰镇后作为仪式饮品。清爽的余味与淡淡咸意，很适合搭配甜点。山地附近的社区，传统上会在餐后奉上。
author: .izik
source: The rich, mineral-infused milk POKENAME produces is best served chilled as a ceremonial drink. Its clean finish and subtle saltiness pair naturally with sweet desserts, and it is traditionally offered after meals in communities near mountain ranges.

entry: POKENAME浓稠的奶，能制成风味浓烈、结晶状的陈年奶酪，质地坚硬，有颗粒感。山地战士传统上会在战前分食薄片，声称能坚定斗志。
author: .izik
source: The dense milk POKENAME produces yields a sharp, crystalline aged cheese with a hard, granular texture. Warriors in mountainous regions traditionally share slices before battle, claiming it strengthens resolve.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME给尾巴覆上奶，飞快震动鳞片，直到奶硬化。完全硬化后，每片鳞上都会布满尖刺，这时它就将尾巴猛砸向对手。
author: bigoljax
source: In battle, POKENAME will coat its tail with milk, quickly rattling its scales around until the milk hardens. When fully hardened, each scale will be covered in sharp spikes, at which point it slams its tail down onto its opponent.

entry: POKENAME吃草时，靠长角吓退捕食者。受惊后，它会冲向威胁，每次都在几步外停下，给对方离开的机会。若威吓无效，它就会害怕地逃走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME rely on their long horns to scare off predators while they graze. They charge at threats when scared, stopping just a few paces away each time to give the threat time to leave. If their threat display fails, POKENAME flee in fear.

entry: 养POKENAME的牧场，通常保持安静，因为太多噪声会使它惊慌，让奶变差。条件适当，奶便浓郁香醇，很适合做冰淇淋。
author: ultron_suprem3
source: Ranches that own POKENAME are often kept quiet, as too much noise can make them skittish, which spoils their milk. If the proper conditions are met, the milk from a POKENAME has a rich, creamy flavor, which makes good ice cream.

entry: POKENAME的奶极香。它会喷奶吸引猎物，再高速扑上去攻击。
author: .izik
source: The milk POKENAME produces is extremely fragrant. It sprays it to attract prey before pouncing at high speeds to attack.

entry: POKENAME产奶不多，却在许多农场另有用途。它晃动全身，让背上的铃铛响亮作声，既赶走想轻松捕食的猎手，也提醒农场主有威胁靠近。
author: beetlething
source: POKENAME doesn't give much milk, but still serves a purpose on many farms. It shakes its entire body to make a loud ringing noise with the bells on its back, warding off predators looking for an easy meal and warning farmers of incoming threats.

entry: 它产出浓郁香醇的奶，可用于杂烩浓汤，也有助于释放体内压力。它很少离开主人身边，因此它的奶是珍贵的商品。
author: quackquackattack
source: It produces a rich and creamy milk that is incorporated into chowder, which helps vent pressure in its body. It seldom leaves the side of its owner, making its milk a valuable commodity.

entry: POKENAME周身围着厚厚一层奶，用来缓冲身体受到的伤害。奶含有多种毒素，不适合人类饮用。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME surround their bodies with a thick layer of milk, using the liquid to cushion themselves against physical harm. Their milk contains multiple toxins and is not fit for human consumption.

entry: POKENAME群通过力量较量选出首领。最强的两只会高速对冲，最后仍站着的那只，便负责带领族群前往下一片牧草地。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME herds determine their leader through contests of strength; the two strongest POKENAME square off and run into one another at high speed. The POKENAME that's left standing becomes responsible for leading the herd to their next field to graze.

entry: POKENAME的壳，是极其致密、带坚果香的奶酪。美食鉴赏家争论不休，始终分不清，究竟更像杏仁、栗子，还是核桃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's shell is made of an incredibly dense, nut-scented cheese. This has sparked ongoing debate among food connoisseurs who cannot agree on whether it tastes more like almonds, chestnuts, or walnuts.

entry: POKENAME用后齿中的易燃奶喷火。训练家必须小心，因为哪怕一小滩奶，也能点起持续数周的火。
author: notsaying.
source: POKENAME uses flammable milk in its back teeth to shoot out fire. Trainers need to be careful, as just a small puddle of this milk can ignite a fire that lasts weeks.

entry: POKENAME以木杖为媒介，用念力控奶。它还能把奶加热至沸腾，烫伤敌人。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME uses a wooden staff as a focus to control milk with its mind. It can also heat the milk to boiling temperatures and scald its foes.

entry: POKENAME魔杖末端的黄油条，让它能操纵100英尺范围内的乳品，再从远处甩向敌人，发动攻击。
author: .izik
source: The stick of butter at the end of POKENAME's wand allows it to control dairy substances within a 100-foot range. It attacks from afar, flinging these substances at foes.

entry: POKENAME产出的奶美味多泡，深受世界各地咖啡馆追捧。野外，它会用奶安抚捕食者、分散其注意，再逃往安全处。
author: mepp.
source: The delicious, frothy milk that POKENAME produces is highly sought after by cafés worldwide. In the wild, it uses this milk to pacify and distract predators as it flees to safety.

entry: POKENAME产出的乳状泡沫，有极强的酸气。它用来标记栖身池塘周围的领地。
author: .izik
source: The milky foam POKENAME produces carries an incredibly sour scent. It uses this to mark the territory around its pond.

entry: POKENAME投掷奶酪弹，用黄油围巾抽击，打倒敌人。饥饿的宝可梦，或许会在它休息过的地方附近，找到插在地上的奶酪手里剑，但它早已消失。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME fights by throwing cheese projectiles and whipping with its butter scarf to defeat foes. Hungry Pokémon may find cheese shurikens lodged into the ground near their resting place, but POKENAME will have already vanished.

entry: POKENAME会从毛孔喷出滚烫的奶，自我防卫。丰缘有些咖啡馆，会把它的奶加入咖啡，调成独特的招牌风味。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME shoots burning hot milk out of its pores as a defensive measure. Some Hoenn cafes use POKENAME milk as an additive for their coffee to create a unique, specialized blend.

entry: POKENAME一跳舞，就会向空中释放混合香料，被称作“南瓜香料”。这项特殊本领，让它很受喜欢秋日风味的人欢迎。
author: sleepyman0731
source: Whenever POKENAME dances, they release a mixture of spices into the air that has become known as pumpkin spice. This special talent has made POKENAME popular to those that love the flavors of the Autumn season.

entry: 成群的POKENAME夜里降落田野吃草，靠敏锐的视力，在月光下辨认彼此。乳白的翅膀反射月光，也会吸引其他同类前来，一起觅食。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swarms descend on fields to graze at night, relying on their keen eyesight to remain aware of one another in the moonlight. Their milky-white wings reflect moonlight, drawing other POKENAME to feed in the same fields.

entry: POKENAME的身体，主要由浓郁美味的乳状物构成。物质再生极快，因此它不介意其他生物舔一舔，品尝味道。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is made up primarily of a creamy and tasty milky substance. The substance regenerates extremely rapidly, so it doesn't mind other creatures licking it to enjoy its taste.

entry: POKENAME的奶浓稠又甜，常用于各类甜点。有个热门冰淇淋品牌，还以它为吉祥物。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's milk is thick and sweet, often used in many desserts. A popular brand of ice cream has POKENAME as a mascot.

entry: 世界各地的牧场，都能见到POKENAME。它虽能自己产奶，却更喜欢收集其他宝可梦的奶，因此在养着许多大奶罐的牧场格外有用。
author: ned666_
source: You will find POKENAME scattered all over ranches across the world. Though they can produce their own milk, POKENAME prefer to collect milk from other Pokémon instead, and are therefore incredibly helpful on ranches that house many Miltank.

entry: POKENAME常在农场工作，协助管理大奶罐群。人们通常信任它帮忙收奶，将一桶桶奶运回农场储存。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are often put to work on farms to help manage Miltank herds. They are usually trusted to help gather milk from the herd, ferrying pails of the liquid back to the farm for storage.

entry: POKENAME常在农场工作，协助管理大奶罐群。人们通常信任它为吃草的大奶罐送食物，把一捆捆干草搬到田里，供族群食用。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are often put to work on farms to help manage Miltank herds. They are usually trusted to bring food to the grazing Miltank, carrying bales of hay out to the field for the herd to graze on.

entry: POKENAME将奶储存在头上的莲叶中。它很受没空做饭的人喜爱，毕竟当麦片碗，再合适不过。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME stores its milk in the lilypad on its head.  It is a popular pet among people who don't have time to cook, as it makes an excellent cereal bowl.

entry: POKENAME头顶的腺体不断滴奶，富含益生成分。奶逐渐变稠、凝结成天然奶酪轮，虽然闻着香，外皮却黏滑得可怕，尝起来主要是河泥味。
author: anonymous_moose
source: Glands atop POKENAME's head continuously excrete droplets of milk, rich in probiotic compounds. The milk thickens and curdles into a wheel of natural cheese, which, although fragrant, has a horribly slimy rind and tastes largely of river mud.

entry: 食物节上，POKENAME十分常见，惯常会与人类和其他宝可梦分享奶酪。奶酪越陈，风味就越浓郁强烈。
author: korro0490
source: POKENAME can be commonly found at food festivals. On such occasions, these Pokémon customarily share their cheese with both humans and other Pokémon. The older the cheese these Pokémon have, the richer and stronger its flavor becomes.

entry: POKENAME的外层，由酷似奶酪的材料构成。虽然看起来像，却比石头更硬、更坚固，不能食用。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's outer covering is made up of a material that closely resembles cheese. Despite the resemblance, it is inedible due to being harder and sturdier than stone.

entry: POKENAME身体强韧，哪怕达到下落的极限速度后撞上地面，也能承受。繁星满天时，身体的五处尖端就会渗奶。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is strong and resilient, able to endure crashing into the ground at terminal velocity. Milk leaks from the five points of its body whenever the sky is full of stars.

entry: POKENAME在尾端产奶，能直接喷进宝可梦幼崽口中。保护幼崽的天性，让它成为出色的养父母。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce milk at the end of their tails, which allows them to spray milk into the mouths of baby Pokémon. Their protective instincts make them great adoptive parents.

entry: POKENAME挖地的动作，会在体内产生奶。它定期探出地面，释放储存的液体，免得负担太重。
author: sk372
source: The act of digging through the ground generates milk within POKENAME's body.  It regularly pops up from underground to release the stored fluids before it becomes overburdened.

entry: POKENAME的奶含有细小晶体，光照下会闪亮。晶体无害，可以吃，甚至曾被观察到改善许多岩石属性宝可梦的皮肤状况。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's milk shimmers when exposed to light, due to the presence of tiny crystals within. The crystals are harmless and edible, and have even been seen to improve the skin condition of many Rock-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME保护着大奶罐群，悬浮在吃草的伙伴上方，留意捕食者。危险接近时，它就把岩石身体当撞锤，猛撞捕食者，守护族群。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME watch over Miltank herds protectively, floating above the grazing Pokémon as they keep watch for predators. Should danger approach, they use their rocky bodies as a battering ram to slam into the predator and keep the herd safe.

entry: POKENAME能从身体产出甜甜的草莓冰淇淋，在卡洛斯的餐厅尤其受欢迎。冰淇淋上桌前，食客常能先欣赏一段小表演。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME produce a sweet, strawberry-flavoured ice cream from their bodies. They are particularly popular Pokémon in Kalosian restaurants, where diners are often treated to a small performance before their ice cream is served.

entry: POKENAME的奶，常被包装成适合情侣购买的浪漫饮品。据说一起喝下，对伴侣的爱意就会增至两倍。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's milk is often marketed as a romantic purchase for couples to buy. Drinking it together is said to increase the amorous feelings one has for their partner twofold.

entry: POKENAME的隧道潮湿，覆着奶状物。它能感知谁碰了这些奶；若有闯入者，就会与同族逼近，发动攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tunnels are soggy and coated with a milk-like substance. It can sense anyone who touches this milk, closing in with its kin to strike if the tunnel is trespassed.

entry: POKENAME最爱的菜，就是一切含奶的食物。它很贪心，会尽可能从别人那里抢走与奶有关的吃食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's favorite dishes are anything that contains milk as an ingredient. It is quite greedy and will snatch up any milk-related food it can from others.

entry: POKENAME通常夜里潜入人家，偷哞哞鲜奶。它可爱的模样，曾启发一款热门节奏游戏的吉祥物设计。
author: wiseginseng
source: POKENAME usually sneaks into people's homes at night to steal MooMoo milk. Its cute appearance became the inspiration for a popular rhythm game mascot.

entry: POKENAME的毛柔软，像皮革。摇响铃铛，就表示想要吃的、想被摸摸等，但当下究竟要什么，却不容易弄明白。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's fur is soft and leathery. When it rings its bell, that means it wants something like food or petting, though it can be difficult to know what it wants in that moment.

entry: POKENAME的奶虽然不算美味，营养却极其丰富。喝下这种奶后，它的力量会增强，拳头足以打飞一辆小汽车。
author: smissmassentree_81799
source: POKENAME produces milk that, while not considered very tasty, is extremely nutritious. When a POKENAME drinks this milk, it gets powered up, which allows it to throw punches that can send a small car flying.

entry: 它每天能产超过五加仑奶。可奶是一瞬间全涌出来的，根本来不及躲开。
author: wormspawn
source: It provides over five gallons of milk a day. However, since this deluge happens instantly, there is no time to flee.

entry: POKENAME每天喝五加仑奶，身体越来越强、速度越来越快，智力却跟着下降。
author: sonic3knuckles
source: POKENAME drinks five gallons of milk daily. While this makes them grow stronger and faster, their intelligence suffers.

entry: 它柔软的毛上，覆着挤奶过程中分离出的多余奶油。POKENAME从口中喷火时，身体就会开始散发温奶香。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its soft fur is coated in the excess cream that separated during the milking process. When it shoots flames from its mouth, POKENAME's body begins to smell of warm milk.

entry: 构成POKENAME鬃毛、尾巴与后腿的奶，质地奇异地蓬松，因为体内热气将奶打成奶泡。用热风排出热气后，奶便会变回液态。
author: wyattwintersoul
source: The milk comprising POKENAME's mane, tail, and hind legs has a strangely fluffy consistency due to the hot air in its body frothing it and turning it into milk foam. When it expels this air using Heat Wave, its milk returns to its liquid form.

entry: POKENAME的奶，被形容为极辣而温热。做成的冰淇淋并不流行，却在美食爱好者中，拥有一小群拥趸。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME's milk is described as extremely spicy and warm. Ice cream made from this milk is unpopular but has a niche fanbase among culinary enthusiasts.

entry: POKENAME从乳房产出温奶，哺育宝可梦幼崽。若在这细心喂养的时刻受到威胁，它就会向敌人喷出滚烫的奶。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce warm milk from their udders to raise baby Pokémon. If threatened during this delicate feeding session, they spray boiling milk at foes.

entry: 构成POKENAME双翼与尾尖的奶，高达华氏200度，十分滚烫。它能从口中喷出热奶，代替喷火龙通常的火焰。
author: sk372
source: The milk comprising POKENAME's wings and tail-tip is quite hot at 200 degrees Fahrenheit. Scalding-hot milk can be breathed out of its mouth in place of a Charizard's usual flame.

entry: POKENAME用奶造出双翼，飞遍世界，喂养宝可梦幼崽。战斗时，它会向敌人洒下沸腾的奶雨。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME create wings out of milk to soar through the world to feed baby Pokémon. In battle, they rain down boiling milk onto their foes.

entry: POKENAME成群在静水池塘与湖泊中，啃食水生植物。受威胁时，它更愿意游走，而不是战斗；但被逼入绝境，也能用角狠狠划伤敌人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME shoals graze on aquatic plant life in stagnant ponds and lakes. They prefer to swim to safety rather than fight when threatened, but are capable of inflicting nasty scratches with their horns when backed into a corner.

entry: POKENAME每天至少得游六小时，才能保持健康，因此饲养它的农场，都配有专用泳池。它的奶甜得出奇，可做成美味的冰淇淋。
author: fiordaliso
source: Since POKENAME needs to swim for at least six hours a day to stay fit, farms that raise this Pokémon are equipped with special swimming pools. The milk it produces is remarkably sweet and is used to make delicious ice cream.

entry: POKENAME的奶，会让人困倦得厉害。喝下后睡着的人，常会梦见家人在那一刻正在做的事。
author: .izik
source: The milk POKENAME produces causes extreme drowsiness. Those who fall asleep after drinking it tend to dream of what members of their family are doing at that very moment.

entry: POKENAME看见谁在吃含奶的餐点，有时会递上自己的汤匙。用那把汤匙吃，食物会美味许多倍。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will sometimes offer its spoon to those it sees eating a meal that contains milk. Eating food with the spoon causes the meal to taste magnitudes more flavorful.

entry: 总能见到POKENAME带着一碗全谷麦片，再加入自己的奶。麦片能增强脑力，让它的超能力攻击更强。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME is always seen with a bowl of whole-grain cereal that it supplements with its milk. This cereal enhances its brain power and makes its psychic attacks stronger.

entry: POKENAME的肌肉量少得惊人，连在胡地融合体中也算少，大部分体积都在乳房。据说，喝它的奶能提高智力，学生常用来搭配早餐麦片。
author: kungfucutbug
source: POKENAME's muscle mass falls impressively low even for an Alakazam fusion, as the majority of its bulk is in its udder. Milk from a POKENAME is said to increase intelligence when consumed, so students often pair it with breakfast cereal.

entry: POKENAME很懂哪些植物吃了最健康，因此很受健身新手欢迎。侮辱过它训练家的人，说曾感到一股凶狠的目光，紧盯着自己。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are sought after for those new to getting fit, as they have a good sense of which plants are healthiest to eat. People who insult their Trainers recall feeling a menacing gaze upon them.

entry: 宝可梦农场会用POKENAME当警报，提防捕食者或盗窃等事件。它轻轻摇摆、发出叮当声时，就表示心满意足。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME is used in Pokémon farms as an alarm for things like predators or robberies. When it sways gently with a chiming sound, it's content.

entry: 宝可梦农场会用POKENAME当警报，提防捕食者或盗窃等事件。它轻轻摇摆、发出叮当声时，就表示心满意足。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME is used in Pokémon farms as an alarm for things like predators or robberies. When it sways gently with a chiming sound, it's content.

entry: POKENAME每天能产一加仑奶，很适合哺育宝可梦幼崽。奶没了，它就会吵闹地哞叫，催训练家喂自己，好继续照顾其他宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a gallon of milk daily, making them suitable for raising baby Pokémon. When they are out of milk, they moo obnoxiously for their Trainer to feed them so that they can continue to take care of other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的奶富含钙，很适合孩子与宝可梦幼崽饮用。许多家长相信，多喝能让孩子长得更高。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME milk is high in calcium, making the milk a great drink for children and baby Pokémon. Many parents believe that drinking lots of POKENAME milk makes children grow taller.

entry: 拉动POKENAME后脑连着的尾巴，就会让它从口中流出大量奶状液体。过程结束后，它会累得气喘吁吁。
author: sk372
source: Pulling on the tail attached to the back of POKENAME's head causes it to drool out copious amounts of milk-like fluid from its mouth. It's quite winded after the process is finished.

entry: 丛林附近的大奶罐农场，得留意POKENAME出没。它最爱吃大奶罐，会用甜香引其靠近，再试图将整只牛吞下。
author: sk372
source: Miltank farms in locations close to jungles should beware of POKENAME presence. Its most favorite meal is Miltank, luring them near it with sweet scents before attempting to swallow the bovine whole.

entry: POKENAME饿了，就会垂晃舌头连着的蛋糕形诱饵，吸引猎物。谁好奇地靠近甜食，它就猛扑上去，整只吞下。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME grows hungry, it dangles a cake-shaped lure attached to its tongue to draw in prey. Once something curiously approaches the sweet treat, it lunges forth and swallows them whole.

entry: POKENAME把头上乳房流出的奶，聚成炼乳球，混入触手中的麻痹毒素，再作为弹体掷出，捕猎食物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gathers milk that emanates from the udders on its head to form orbs of condensed milk. The orb is laced with a paralytic poison that its tentacles possess, and thrown as a projectile to hunt prey with.

entry: POKENAME把高压奶集中到拳头，增强拳力，力道足以一击打碎巨石。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME focuses pressurized milk into its fists to strengthen its punches. It can generate enough force to break a boulder in a single hit.

entry: POKENAME岩石身体上碎落的块，一脱离，几乎就会立刻变软。碎块可以安全食用，带着明显的酸味。
author: sk372
source: Pieces broken off from POKENAME's rocky body soften almost immediately after separation. These pieces are safe to eat, containing a rather tart flavor to them.

entry: 有大型烘焙坊的城镇，常能找到POKENAME。它以身体渗滴的饼干味奶闻名，能让烘焙点心更甜美。
author: naivetotoro
source: POKENAME can often be found in towns with large bakeries. They are famous for the cookie-flavored milk that seeps and drips from their bodies, making baked goods taste even sweeter.

entry: POKENAME能感知附近哪只宝可梦正在产奶，便一路跟随，直到对方被妥善挤过奶。它自己的奶乳糖很高，带着淡淡肉桂味。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKNAME sense when a nearby Pokémon is producing milk, following it until it's been properly milked. POKENAME's own milk is high in lactose and has a subtle cinnamon-like flavor.

entry: 成群的POKENAME奔跑时，会不断流出蒸热的奶。奶落在途经的田野，促进新植物生长；它们经过数周后，那里便成了繁花茂盛的草地。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME herds release a steady stream of steamed milk as they run. The milk settles on the fields they pass through and promotes new plant growth, resulting in lush meadows of flowers in the weeks after they pass by.

entry: 有人说，喝POKENAME的奶会变笨，其实并非如此。不过，奶确实会让人暂时倦怠、健忘又困倦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's milk has been said to make the one who drinks it dumber, but this is untrue. It does, however, induce a temporary state of lethargy, forgetfulness, and drowsiness in the drinker.

entry: POKENAME的奶含有大量钙，能让骨头像它的壳一样强壮。许多家长鼓励孩子喝，盼着长得高大结实。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME milk is reinforced with high levels of calcium that makes bones as strong as their shell. Many parents encourage their children to drink POKENAME milk to grow up big and strong.

entry: POKENAME身体大半覆着可食用的奶酪壳，再生很慢。若短时间吃太多，就会对智力产生不良影响。
author: sk372
source: The cheesy shell that covers most of POKENAME's body is edible and regenerates slowly. The cheese will adversely affect the intelligence of those who consume too much in a short period of time.

entry: POKENAME体内的奶有磁性，能让三个身体连在一起。挤奶太多，身体便会暂时部分分离，彼此漂开。
author: sk372
source: The milk within POKENAME contains magnetic properties that keep its three bodies conjoined. If milked too much, the bodies will start to partially drift away from each other for a time.

entry: POKENAME用自己的奶做套索，操纵液体，像操纵实体绳索一样灵活。它会用奶套索困住暴走的野生宝可梦，使其动弹不得。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can create lassos out of its own milk, manipulating the fluid as well as any physical rope. It uses the milk-lasso to ensnare and immobilize wild, rampaging Pokémon.

entry: 大多数训练家一见它就感到不安。POKENAME的两个头，也时刻受着中央乳房的惊吓。
author: dodoowner_
source: Most Trainers feel uneasy when they see this fusion. The two heads of POKENAME are constantly terrorized by the udders in the middle.

entry: POKENAME的奶极富脂肪与营养，让幼体能迅速积起厚脂肪层。在严冬多发的地区，它的奶常是传统餐点的基础原料。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME milk is extremely rich in fat and nutrients, enabling young POKENAME to quickly build up layers of blubber. Their milk often forms the base of traditional meals in regions prone to harsh winters.

entry: POKENAME有时被误认成美人鱼。原因众说纷纭，有人认为是体色，有人则认为，是它对水手使用了迷人。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME are sometimes mistaken for mermaids. Theories as to why range from POKENAME's color to POKENAME using Attract on sailors.

entry: POKENAME的身体，由凝结、酸败的过期奶构成。饮用很危险，已知会致病。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME's body is made of expired milk that has congealed and gone sour.  Consuming this milk is dangerous and known to cause sickness.

entry: POKENAME是知名的赏金猎人，带着能发射奶酪子弹的左轮手枪。它常与厨师闹矛盾，尤其是披萨厨师。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are well-known bounty hunters, carrying a revolver that fires bullets made of cheese. They often have issues with cooks, specifically pizza chefs.

entry: POKENAME的身体，完全由厚厚一层哞哞鲜奶构成。靠近的对象，会发现自己困在液体之中。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME are comprised entirely of a layer of thick Moomoo Milk. Those that come near find themselves trapped within the liquid.

entry: POKENAME能从炮口远射高压奶，送出数英里，帮大家解渴。它虽乐意分享奶，却只允许自己的幼崽，从乳房直接吃奶。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can fire high-pressure milk from its cannons over long distances, quenching thirsts for miles. Though it shares that milk freely, only its own young are allowed to nurse from its udders.

entry: POKENAME背上的乳房，是大功率奶炮。营养丰富的奶射速太高，农场主尚未找到足够坚固、能稳定采集的材料。
author: pattybgoode
source: The udders on POKENAME's back are high-powered cannons. POKENAME's nutritious milk is shot out at such high speeds that farmers have not found materials durable enough to consistently harvest it.

entry: POKENAME舌上覆着乳状唾液。需要逃生时，它就用唾液吹出装满奶的大泡泡，分散对方注意。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tongue is coated with milky saliva. It uses the saliva to blow large, milk-filled bubbles as distractions when it needs to flee from danger.

entry: POKENAME只对亲近的对象敞开身体，其他时候都紧闭着壳。谁想强行掰开，就会被大量奶喷个满脸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME only opens up to those it is close to, keeping its shell closed otherwise. Those who try to force its shell open will receive a deluge of milk sprayed in their face.

entry: POKENAME漂浮乳房产出的奶，会引发腹痛与呕吐。虽然随意饮用很危险，却能用来清除其他毒素。
author: musicsheep.
source: Milk produced by POKENAME's floating udder causes stomach aches and vomiting. While dangerous to drink haphazardly, it can be used to purge other poisons.

entry: POKENAME没有眼睛，靠乳房辨路。无论选在哪里作祟，它都会留下用奶写成的威胁话语。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME has no eyes, so it uses its udders to navigate.  Wherever it chooses to haunt, it will leave behind threatening messages written in milk.

entry: 传说喝下POKENAME的奶，就会遭受永恒诅咒。不过，没人能忍着直视它那么久，撑到把奶挤出来。
author: darkweavile428
source: Legends say that anyone who drinks POKENAME's milk will be cursed for all eternity. However, no one can stand the sight of it long enough to milk it.

entry: POKENAME的奶，几秒内就能让人睡着。奇怪的是，奶坏得极慢，不论温度如何，都能一次保鲜数月。
author: .izik
source: Milk produced by POKENAME's body can put a human to sleep in seconds. Oddly, it spoils very slowly and stays fresh for months at a time regardless of temperature.

entry: POKENAME给其他宝可梦喝奶，却并不完全出于无私。奶会让对方迅速睡着，方便它吃掉梦境。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME offers its milk to other Pokémon, though not entirely as a selfless act. Drinking its milk quickly puts a Pokémon to sleep, making it easy for POKENAME to consume their dream.

entry: POKENAME的钳子，由一种非常锋利的奶酪构成。钳子兼具肉与融化奶酪的美味，是有些餐厅的高价菜。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's claws are made of a very sharp type of cheese. POKENAME claws are a high-priced dish at some restaurants for the flavorful mix of meat and melted cheese.

entry: POKENAME的钳子，由极硬的奶酪状材料构成。脱落或取下后，能作为菜肴原料，增添浓郁的咸味。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's claws are composed of an extremely hard cheese-like material. When shed or removed, they can be used as an ingredient in dishes, lending a rich, briny flavor.

entry: POKENAME产下的蛋，营养丰富、风味浓郁，却也十分脆弱，容易爆炸。虽然美味绝佳，许多厨师仍因蛋容易自行爆炸，而不敢使用。
author: soup1900
source: While eggs that are laid by POKENAME are extremely nutritious and rich in flavor, they are also very delicate and explode easily. Many chefs avoid using these eggs despite their amazing taste due to their ease in self-destructing.

entry: POKENAME住在草木繁茂、幽僻的岛屿。身上长出的蛋极富营养，供养着当地野生生物。它还会分泌蛋黄状物质，养护毛发，过去曾被用于占卜。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can be found in lush and secluded islands. The eggs which grow from its body are highly nutritious and help sustain local wildlife. It secretes a yolky substance that keeps its fur healthy; this substance was once used in fortune telling.

entry: POKENAME用棍棒敲打，竟能缓解疼痛与负面情绪，这一点仍在研究中。它对他人的痛苦与悲伤十分敏感，无论多远，都愿意赶去帮忙。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can alleviate pain and negative emotions with strikes using their clubs, a fact still being studied. They are very attuned to the pain and sadness of others and will travel however far they must to alleviate either.

entry: 许多吉利蛋拜POKENAME为师，以简短的课程，学习照顾蛋的专业知识。许多托儿所里，都能见到它教授如何照料蛋。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many Chansey are under the tutelage of a POKENAME, whose expert knowledge on how to take care of eggs is passed down in short lessons. POKENAME can be found at many daycares teaching how to take care of an egg.

entry: POKENAME是海底最善良、最美丽的宝可梦之一。医院会在大厅等处摆上饲养它的水族箱，光看它游泳，就能让人心情舒缓。
author: sk372
source: One of the kindest and most beautiful of undersea Pokémon. Hospitals will place aquariums filled with POKENAME in lobbies and the like, as simply seeing them swim has a soothing effect on those who watch.

entry: POKENAME是儿童医院的首选。它能让孩子为从前觉得无趣的事发笑，反复讲同一个笑话，也能像讲新笑话一样逗笑大家。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME is the top choice for a children's hospital. It makes kids laugh at things they never found funny before and gets laughs by repeating the same joke as if it were new.

entry: 据说，它有节奏地摇摆，连最凶暴的人都能平静下来，因此几乎不可能偷猎。它愿把蛋分给所有对象，哪怕是敌人，咬一口就能满心安宁。
author: noxid
source: Its rhythmic sashaying is said to calm even the most aggressive humans, making poaching this Pokémon nigh impossible. It offers its eggs to all, even to its foes, as one bite fills them with serenity.

entry: POKENAME不停用尖牙，吃自己的蛋。虽然仍愿意分给别人，多数人却不肯接受吃了一半的蛋黄。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME constantly eat their own eggs with their sharp teeth. While they will still offer to share them, most people decline the half-eaten yolk.

entry: POKENAME虽然神情开朗，却会毁掉挡路的船只。这多半是因为，它把船视为可能危及蛋的威胁。
author: bigoljax
source: Even though their expressions are cheerful, POKENAME are known to destroy ships that are in their way. This is most likely because they see ships as possible threats to their eggs.

entry: POKENAME能像百变怪一样，变成任何其他宝可梦。不过，与幸福蛋融合的特性，总让变身多了喜悦与活力。
author: .jerden
source: While POKENAME can transform into any other Pokémon just like Ditto, being fused with Blissey always gives its transformations extra joy and vitality.

entry: 人称“海上救护者”的POKENAME，会巡视海洋，寻找受伤的人与宝可梦，让其浮在水上，同时施治。遭攻击时，它会把可能受伤的部位液化，看起来仿佛不知疼痛。
author: ghostslythe
source: Called the Hospitaller of the Sea, POKENAME patrol the oceans for injured Pokémon and people, keeping them afloat while healing them. If attacked, it liquefies the portion of its body that would be injured, causing it to appear impervious to pain.

entry: POKENAME飞得极快，却没有牙齿可以咬东西。它大多靠分享蛋、带来快乐后，感激的人们赠送的食物维生；不过，也能把蛋当炸弹丢下狩猎。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME can fly around at great speed, it lacks any teeth to bite with. It mostly survives on food given to it by grateful people after it brings them joy by sharing its egg, although it can hunt by dropping eggs like bombs.

entry: 它的身体像枕头一样柔软，不断散发喜悦。吃过POKENAME的蛋，几分钟内就会被哄入梦乡。
author: bionic_man
source: Its body is soft as a pillow and endlessly radiates joy. Anyone who eats a POKENAME's egg will be lulled to sleep within minutes.

entry: 飞行时，POKENAME把自己蜷成球，免得蛋掉落。在这种蜷起的姿态下，它似乎飞得更好。
author: bigoljax
source: While in flight, POKENAME curl themselves into a ball to keep their eggs from falling. They seem to fly better when in this curled-up state.

entry: 即使高速飞行，它也把自己的蛋带在袋中。它会帮助年幼的人类或宝可梦，也会用结实的身体，庇护弱小。
author: infinex21
source: It carries its own egg within its pouch, even as it flies at high speeds. It is known to help the young, be they human or Pokémon, and will shelter the weak with its sturdy body.

entry: POKENAME与医护人员合作，照料病人的健康。它常负责帮孩子接种疫苗，因为它的针，比传统针头没那么疼。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME work alongside doctors and nurses to make sure patients stay healthy. They are often tasked with helping children get vaccinations because their needles are less painful than traditional needles.

entry: POKENAME的超能力，足以治愈任何伤口。不过，治好重伤后，它很快就会疲惫不堪。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's psychic power is strong enough to heal any wound. However, POKENAME quickly tire themselves out after healing heavy wounds.

entry: POKENAME有一条附肢，看起来由半凝固的蛋黄构成。它会请不舒服的对象尝尝，味道虽明显古怪，多数人尝后，确实觉得好受些。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has an appendage made of what appears to be semi-solidified egg yolk. It offers a taste of this to those who are feeling ill; though the flavor is notably odd, most do note they feel better after sampling it.

entry: POKENAME的袋内，始终保持着最适合蛋的温度。最好与它保持距离，因为它极其护蛋，会以喷射火焰打击威胁。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's pouch is always heated to the perfect temperature for the egg it holds. It is recommended to keep a distance from this Pokémon as it is extremely protective of its egg and will blast threats with Flamethrower.

entry: POKENAME不用背上的锅保护蛋，反而拿来煮蛋。它每年常会产下数百颗，供自己大吃。
author: bigoljax
source: Instead of keeping their eggs safe, POKENAME use the pots on their backs to boil them. They often lay hundreds of eggs per year to feast on.

entry: 宝可尾草上的羽毛，通常来自POKENAME。许多人相信，用这种羽毛制成的玩具，能让宝可梦感到更受关爱，情感也更亲近。
author: jaminmcready
source: The feather on a Poké Toy usually comes from a POKENAME. Many believe that toys made with this feather make their Pokémon feel more cared for and emotionally connected.

entry: POKENAME能用头上的尖刺感知悲伤，主动寻找，希望让世界更快乐。但若有人拒绝蛋，或吃后仍没开心起来，它就会试图吞掉那个人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can sense sadness with the spikes on its head and seeks it out to make the world a happier place. If its egg is refused or if eating it fails to cheer people up, POKENAME will try to devour that person.

entry: 这些宝可梦四处爬行，带着装有坚果与树果的蛋形丝包。令人意外的是，POKENAME能从袋中将丝包射出很远，送给急需食物的对象。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon scuttle about with egg-shaped bundles of silk containing nuts and berries. Surprisingly, POKENAME can launch these bundles from their pouches at considerable distances to those in desperate need of food.

entry: POKENAME携带被遗弃的蛋，照料到幼崽能独立生活。遇到害怕或痛苦的宝可梦，它会唱出甜美的曲调。
author: adsfw11
source: POKENAME carry abandoned eggs, raising them until the young Pokémon can live on its own. POKENAME sing sweet tunes to Pokémon that are scared or in distress.

entry: 吃下POKENAME带着的蛋，会看见自己一生最幸福的时刻。许多人意识到，原来那一刻已经经历过，反而难过起来。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Eating the egg POKENAME carries around will show you the happiest moment of your life. Many people are upset when they realize they've already had their happiest moment.

entry: POKENAME像牧者般，照顾共享栖息地的众多会飞的宝可梦，形成庞大、多样的群体。高山之巅，没有比它造的巨大巢穴更安全的地方。
author: thesilverowls
source: POKENAME are shepherds of the many flying Pokémon who share their habitats with them, forming a large, diverse flock. In high mountain peaks, there is no safer place than the massive nests POKENAME make.

entry: POKENAME有治愈本领，性情平和、外表亲切，常在医院帮忙，尤其是儿科。蛋味道甜美，营养丰富。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME are often used around hospitals, mostly in pediatrics, for their healing abilities, calming nature, and approachable appearance. Their eggs are sweet-tasting and full of nutrients.

entry: POKENAME待在筑巢地附近，用蛋形的尾巴作诱饵，分散偷蛋猎手的注意。捕食者以为是食物，一靠近，它就猛甩尾巴，将其打飞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hangs around nesting grounds, using its egg-shaped tail as a lure to distract egg-hunting predators. Once the predator draws close to what it thinks is a meal, POKENAME swings its tail hard and sends them flying.

entry: POKENAME每天大多静止不动，把省下的能量，用来养护袋中的蛋。若珍贵的蛋受到威胁，手上的蛋也能摘下，使出炸蛋攻击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME remains still most of the day, letting the energy saved by its lack of movement nurture the egg in its pouch. The eggs on its hands can be detached to use as an Egg Bomb attack if something endangers its precious cargo.

entry: 水族馆用POKENAME，观察其他鱼的状态。若它们非常活跃，水箱就健康；若几乎不动，就需要留意。孩子们爱看它穿梭游动，朝同缸伙伴吹泡泡。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Aquariums use POKENAME as an indicator of the mood of the other fish. If they are hyperactive, the tank is healthy, if they barely move, it needs attention. Children like to watch them dart around, blowing bubbles at the other members of the tank.

entry: POKENAME不会产下多颗蛋，而是只产一颗巨蛋。每次孵化，都会从中冒出许多幼崽。
author: bigoljax
source: Instead of laying multiple eggs, POKENAME lay one massive egg. Whenever this egg hatches, many of their young come out of it.

entry: 大舌贝注入POKENAME头部的毒液，并没有让它变聪明。只是头肿得太大，严格说来，连脑子也变大了。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The venom Shellder injects into POKENAME's head has not made it smart. Its head has just swollen so large it technically made its brain bigger.

entry: POKENAME值得信赖，会细心照顾背上的蛋。它常在阳光下休息，确保蛋有足够热量发育。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are trustworthy creatures that take good care of the egg on their back. They often rest in the sunlight to ensure that the egg has enough heat to develop.

entry: POKENAME收集失去亲代照顾的蛋，背在背上。等蛋孵化，再以爱心与耐心，照料幼年宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME collect orphaned eggs and carry them on their back. When the eggs hatch, POKENAME help take care of the young Pokémon with love and patience.

entry: POKENAME给每个靠近的对象送蛋，同时不断转身，免得有人从背后偷袭。它虽然极有耐心，若反复挨打，也会以更强的力量还击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME give out eggs to anyone who approaches them, constantly turning to prevent anyone from sneaking up on them from behind. Although incredibly patient, if they are attacked repeatedly, they will retaliate with even greater force.

entry: POKENAME心地善良，照顾一切有需要的对象。发现生病的人或宝可梦，就会喂自己的蛋，却没意识到，这些蛋吃下去其实有毒。
author: periperi_chicken
