source: POKENAME is kind-hearted and cares for anyone in need. If it finds a sick person or Pokémon, it will feed them its egg. POKENAME doesn't realise that the eggs it lays are actually toxic when eaten.

entry: 其他宝可梦似乎信任POKENAME，会在外出采食时，让它照看巢穴。作为回报，它们也会与它分享餐食。
author: .jerden
source: Other Pokémon seem to trust POKENAME and allow it to watch over their nests as they go off to gather food. In exchange for this service, these other Pokémon will share their meals with POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME带着的蛋，其实是从地下深处找来的晶洞石。它有时会送给地质学家；剖开后，露出内部闪亮的晶体，总能让收礼者露出笑容。
author: .jerden
source: The egg that POKENAME carries is actually a geode, collected from deep underground. POKENAME sometimes offers it as a gift to geologists, and splitting it open to reveal the shimmering crystals inside never fails to bring a smile to their faces.

entry: POKENAME的壳，像一颗裂开的蛋。它从壳中现身时，常把想轻松吃点零食的捕食者吓一大跳。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have shells that resemble cracked eggs. They often shock predators when they emerge from their shells, frightening those looking for a quick snack.

entry: POKENAME的铠甲虽然由蛋壳构成，却像实心岩石一样难以敲开。壳内，它将树果发酵成甜糖浆，谁尝了，都会满心喜悦。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME's armor is made of eggshell, it is as difficult to crack as solid rock. Inside its shell, POKENAME ferments berries into a sweet syrup that fills anyone who tastes it with joy.

entry: 烹蛋有59种做法，POKENAME样样精通。不过，别指望它分你一点：它其实很自私，什么也不分享。
author: musicsheep.
source: There are 59 ways to cook an egg, and POKENAME has mastered every single one. Don't ask for it to share any of it, though. POKENAME is actually selfish and doesn't share.

entry: POKENAME总是快快乐乐，爱寻找有烦恼的孩子，用腹部心形图案发出的魔法光芒帮他们排忧解难。
author: toxicrown
source: POKENAME is always happy. It likes to seek out children with problems and help solve them through a magical light from the heart on its belly.

entry: 大多数时候，POKENAME对其他宝可梦与训练家都很善良温柔。但蛋一受威胁，它便会变得极其凶暴。
author: bigoljax
source: Most of the time, POKENAME are kind and sweet-hearted towards other Pokémon and Trainers. However, they will grow incredibly violent whenever their egg is threatened.

entry: POKENAME身体触感柔软，散发平静的气场，减轻压力。背上蛋状的壳却坚硬如石，还会发热。它愿意分享壳片，磨碎后可用于安神茶。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's body is soft to the touch and radiates a calming aura that reduces feelings of stress. The egg-like shell on its back is rock solid and radiates heat, though POKENAME can share pieces of its shell to be crushed and used in calming teas.

entry: POKENAME天生会照顾小球飞鱼和刚孵化的铁炮鱼。肢体营养丰富，也能逐渐再生，因此偶尔会舍下一条肢体，送给年幼又饥饿的宝可梦。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME act as a natural caretaker for Mantyke and newly hatched Remoraid. Their limbs are highly nutritious and regrow over time, so there have been rare cases where they have sacrificed a limb to give it to young and starving Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME看似轻盈纤巧，却以致密的羽毛作铠甲。不论付出什么代价，它都会护住自己的蛋。
author: havic0970
source: While it may look light and dainty, POKENAME uses its dense plumage as armor. It protects its egg at any cost.

entry: 荒岛遇难者，偶尔会遇到野生POKENAME。他们感谢它送来美味的蛋，却也常说，它给予的陪伴，同样重要。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME are occasionally been encountered by people stranded on desert islands. While they appreciated the delicious eggs POKENAME fed them with, these castaways usually say that the companionship POKENAME provided was just as important.

entry: POKENAME的两个身体，配合得天衣无缝。一个感知不快，另一个迅速游过去，好让它送出美味的蛋，使人开心。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's two bodies work together in perfect harmony. One senses unhappiness, and the other swiftly swims towards it, so that POKENAME can give out delicious eggs to cheer people up.

entry: POKENAME用宝可梦中心采集的数据完成了升级，程序使它能照料电脑盒子中存放的宝可梦蛋。
author: serversizeme
source: POKENAME was upgraded with data collected by Pokémon Centers. Its programming allows it to care for Pokémon eggs stored in PC boxes.

entry: POKENAME在宝可梦中心和医院协助医生。它能感知病人的心跳，再把心电图曲线画在贝雷帽上。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be found in Pokémon Centers and hospitals aiding doctors. They can sense a patient's heartbeat and will draw the EKG trace on their berets.

entry: POKENAME在宝可梦中心和医院协助医生。为了让患病的孩子开心，它会在贝雷帽上画各种图案与卡通。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be found in Pokémon Centers and hospitals aiding doctors. To keep child patients happy, they will draw various images and cartoons on their berets.

entry: 宝可梦培育刚流行时，人们以为，由POKENAME携带、孵化的蛋，会成为同类中最强的个体。后来已证实并非如此，但它确实是极其能干、高效的照料者。
author: chibitales
source: When Pokémon breeding first became popular, it was thought Eggs carried and hatched by POKENAME would become the strongest members of their species. This has since proven false, however POKENAME are extremely efficient and capable caretakers.

entry: POKENAME迅如闪电，伴着头顶雷云，以常人难及的精准身法飞驰滑行。谁能在它疾驰时辨准位置，就能获赠一颗营养丰富的巨蛋，体力也会完全恢复。
author: beatdoof
source: As fast as lightning, POKENAME speeds and glides through with inhuman precision along with thunderous clouds above it. Anyone who can manage to pinpoint it as it runs will be rewarded with a huge, nutritious egg and fully restored physical vitality.

entry: 善良的天性，驱使POKENAME走遍大地，寻找需要帮助的对象。寒地常能见到它，为受冻的幼年宝可梦提供温暖。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's kind nature compels it to roam the lands in search of those who need its aid. It is often seen in colder regions, offering its warmth to young Pokémon suffering from the frigid conditions.

entry: POKENAME将迷路的登山客收留到洞穴，照料他们直到离开。石头般的皮毛也不易受损。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will take in lost hikers into their cave and look after them until they leave. Its stone-like fur is resistant to damage.

entry: POKENAME善良又有魅力，吸引许多黑暗鸦跟随受教。它教出的黑暗鸦，不再偷窃，而会寻找失物，归还主人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's kind and charismatic nature draw many Murkrow to follow its teachings. Rather than steal things, Murkrow under a POKENAME's tutelage find lost items and return them to their owners.

entry: POKENAME在寒地狩猎，会把蛋放在石头或雪堆上，诱来猎物，再飞快跃出，用尖爪攻击。那个蛋，常是压紧的雪做的，而非真蛋。
author: .jerden
source: In the cold environments it hunts in, POKENAME will place its egg on a rock or snowdrift to lure in prey, then quickly leap out to attack with its sharp claws. This egg is often made of snow that POKENAME has compacted, rather than being a real one.

entry: POKENAME平时善良温和，可若有人想拿走它的蛋，就会气势汹汹地用蛋形尾巴攻击。
author: krune
source: POKENAME can be very kind and gentle creatures, but should you try to take its egg, they will get aggressive and use their egg-shaped tail to attack.

entry: POKENAME用许多蓬松的藤蔓，拥抱伤心的人，让对方感到温暖与关爱。充满幸福的蛋再生极快，市售幸福蛋的蛋中，有相当大一部分来自它。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME hugs sad people with its many fluffy vines to make them feel warm and loved. This Pokémon regrows its eggs full of happiness so quickly that a large proportion of Blissey eggs on the market are from this species.

entry: POKENAME能察觉人的情绪低落，会前去提议将尾尖抵在对方头上，用细微的电脉冲，暂时使人振作。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can sense when people are depressed. It will seek them out and offer to press the tips of its tails against their head, then use subtle electrical impulses to temporarily cheer that person up.

entry: POKENAME心地善良，很受大医院欢迎。感知负面情绪，它便唱歌，甚至把蛋送给病人，让住院的日子少些阴郁。蛋本身，也散发幸福的气息。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are popular among large hospitals for their kindhearted nature. When they sense negative emotions, they sing and even offer their egg to patients to make their stay a little less gloomy. The egg itself radiates an aura of happiness.

entry: 野生POKENAME会收留找到的弃蛋，照料到孵化。若新生的宝可梦愿意，POKENAME便将其当作亲生孩子养大。
author: hello_i_exist
source: Wild POKENAME has a tendency to adopt abandoned eggs it finds in the wild until they hatch. If the newly hatched Pokémon is willing, POKENAME will raise it as its own.

entry: POKENAME把产下的蛋带在尾尖，仿佛盛在蛋杯中。它会藏在树里，垂下蛋作诱饵，猎物一靠近，便立刻攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME carry the eggs they lay at the end of their tail, as if held in an egg-cup. They will lure in prey by hiding in trees and dangling the egg down, then attack as soon as the prey gets near.

entry: 它口中衔着的蛋，壳与獠牙由同样闪亮的材料构成。POKENAME只将蛋分给群中受伤的伙伴，其他谁想拿，都被尖牙赶走。
author: .jerden
source: The shell of the egg it carries in its mouth is made of the same gleaming material as its tusks. POKENAME shares this egg with only members of its herd who are injured and will use its sharp tusks to drive away anyone else who tries to take it.

entry: POKENAME带着的蛋，内部数据已经损坏，永远不会孵化。它仍执着地紧抱着蛋，盼着遇到合适的训练家，修好其中的文件。
author: vic1312
source: The data within the eggs that POKENAME carry about has become corrupted and will never hatch. POKENAME obsessively hang on to their egg in the hope that the right Trainer will be able to repair the files within.

entry: POKENAME为林中旅人引路，护送他们沿最安全的路径，到达出口。告别时，每位受助的客人，都会得到一颗营养丰富的蛋。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME acts as a guide to forest travelers, chaperoning them through the safest path to the exit. When the time comes to depart, it gifts every guest it helps with one of its highly nutritious eggs.

entry: POKENAME用尖爪主动守卫宝可梦的筑巢地。它平时凶悍，却也会温柔地用同一双爪，帮难以破壳的幼崽孵出。
author: secondunit
source: POKENAME use their sharp claws to proactively defend Pokémon nesting sites. Their ferocity belies their tenderness when they use those same claws to help young Pokémon struggling to hatch from their eggs.

entry: 训练家睡觉时，POKENAME能感知其情绪，因此晚饭总会送上一颗蛋。和幸福蛋的蛋一样，其中满是幸福，咬一口，就不可能不露出笑容。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME feels the emotions of its Trainer while it sleeps, so it makes sure to give them one of their eggs during dinnertime, as they are laced in happiness: it is impossible not to grin after taking a bite, just like Blissey's eggs.

entry: 自古以来，POKENAME就用法杖的复原魔法，帮人类治愈病痛。至今，许多医院仍以法杖图案，象征对医道的奉献。
author: sk372
source: Since ancient times, POKENAME has aided humanity by curing ailments with the recuperative magic of its staff. Many hospitals to this day use an icon of the staff as a symbol of dedication to the art of healing.

entry: 背上的巨蛋蕴藏太过强烈的幸福，吃下它甚至被认为十分危险。因此POKENAME总将它严密守护。
author: pizzarcato
source: The massive egg on its back contains such potent happiness that eating it is considered dangerous. As a result, POKENAME keeps it well-protected.

entry: POKENAME不断释放特殊的治愈波动，让受其治疗的对象，感到温暖安心。许多医院会请它，安慰遭受重伤、重病的孩子。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME constantly radiate out a special Heal Pulse, which gives a warm, comforting feeling to those healed by it. Many hospitals have a POKENAME on site to comfort children suffering from terrible injuries and illnesses.

entry: POKENAME帮助摔跤手与宝可梦，在长时间战斗后恢复。它给蛋注入治愈能量，产生复原的气场，同时治疗多人。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME assist with the recovery of wrestlers and Pokémon after long days of fighting. By imbuing their egg with healing energy, it can generate a restorative aura, allowing POKENAME to heal multiple people at once.

entry: POKENAME每次产蛋，都会挖进土中，静静等待孵化。手上的尖爪，帮它抵御可能出现的威胁。
author: bigoljax
source: Whenever POKENAME lay an egg, they dig into the ground and quietly wait for the egg to hatch. The sharp claws on their hands help keep them protected from possible threats.

entry: POKENAME天生善于治愈，更愿用善意化解敌意。若遇到身陷眼前危难的宝可梦，它就用大嘴轻轻衔起，带到安全处。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are natural healers, preferring to disarm their opposition with kindness. If they come across a Pokémon in immediate peril, they gently scoop them up in their large mouth and carry them to safety.

entry: POKENAME常保护其他宝可梦的蛋与巢，将头当作盾牌。身体的铠甲如钢铁般坚固，能抵挡大多数攻击。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will often defend other Pokémon's eggs and nests, using their heads like shields. The armor on their bodies is as sturdy as steel, allowing them to shake off most attacks.

entry: POKENAME虽身形魁梧，却十分友善。若看见宝可梦遭到欺负，就会挺身而出，把欺负者狠狠揍一顿。
author: pepperthepirate
source: Despite its hulking stature, POKENAME is very friendly. If it sees a Pokémon getting picked on, it will step in and utterly wallop the attacker.

entry: 据说，POKENAME的蛋既营养丰富，又蕴含使人焕发活力的灵力。头顶的触角，让它能同时听见现世与灵界传来的警讯。
author: voiddx01
source: POKENAME's eggs are said to contain both extraordinary amounts of nutrients and rejuvenating spiritual energy. The antenna on its head allows it to hear alerts from both the physical world and the spirit world.

entry: POKENAME会替无力照顾蛋的其他宝可梦，携带它们的蛋，也天生懂得照料失去父母的幼崽。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are known to carry the eggs of other Pokémon who are unable to take care of them. They also have a natural instinct to take care of orphaned young.

entry: POKENAME无比善良、温柔。现身时，周身散发明亮的能量，舒缓附近一切生灵的痛楚，也平息野生宝可梦的暴力与攻击冲动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is vast in its kindness and gentle nature. When it appears, it radiates a glowing energy across its body that soothes the aches of all around it as well as neutralizing any violent or aggressive urges nearby wild Pokémon might have.

entry: POKENAME背上长出的蛋，太大了，谁也无法独自吃完，因此它会分给整群。如果小型宝可梦在背上筑巢，它会小心，不把对方的蛋也送出去。
author: .jerden
source: The eggs that grow on POKENAME's back are too large for any individual to eat, so POKENAME shares them with entire groups. If smaller Pokémon nest on POKENAME's back, it will be careful not to give away their eggs.

entry: POKENAME背上长出的蛋，太大了，谁也无法独自吃完，因此它会分给整群。如果小型宝可梦在背上筑巢，它会小心，不把对方的蛋也送出去。
author: .jerden
source: The eggs that grow on POKENAME's back are too large for any individual to eat, so POKENAME shares them with entire groups. If smaller Pokémon nest on POKENAME's back, it will be careful not to give away their eggs.

entry: 大量记录表明，POKENAME是出色的母亲。人们多次看见它照顾失亲的宝可梦，甚至人类孩子。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME have been well-documented to be incredible mothers. There have been many sightings of POKENAME taking care of orphaned Pokémon, and even human children.

entry: POKENAME开心时，火焰会闪耀得格外明亮。它尤其喜欢与迷你裙训练家待在一起。
author: ferdirenz
source: The fire POKENAME produces glitters intensely when it feels happy. It especially enjoys spending time with Lasses.

entry: POKENAME精神饱满又骄傲，费尽心思，确保携带的蛋又大又完美无瑕。虽然有点高傲，它仍有颗善心，会将蛋分给真正急需恢复的对象。
author: sk372
source: Spirited and proud, POKENAME take great measure to ensure the eggs they carry are large and immaculate. Though a bit haughty, they do have a kind heart, and will share their eggs with those who absolutely need them to recover with.

entry: POKENAME高贵的外表，让大多数人以为，它属于富裕的训练家。其实，它更常陪伴需要帮手的单亲家长。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's regal appearance causes most to assume they're used by rich trainers. However, they're actually more commonly partners of single parents needing assistance.

entry: 托儿所的蛋若不见了，就会派POKENAME出去寻找。它的鼻子，最远能闻到25英里外的蛋。
author: bigoljax
source: If an egg goes missing from a daycare, POKENAME are sent out to find it. Their noses can smell eggs from up to 25 miles away.

entry: 这把剑轻轻一触，既能治好伤口，也能让对手萌生停战和好的愿望。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A gentle touch from this sword not only heals wounds, but also fills opponents with an urge to stop fighting and make up.

entry: POKENAME的特殊视力，能像X光一样，扫描其他生物的身体，寻找异常。宝可梦中心借此加快诊断，更准确地判断生病的宝可梦出了什么问题。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's special eyesight allows it to scan another creature's body for abnormalities, akin to an X-ray. Pokémon Centers use it to help speed up diagnoses and better determine what's wrong with a sick Pokémon.

entry: 蛋被视为珍馐，让野生POKENAME演化出钙质凝聚的外骨骼，借此对抗偷猎者。
author: yersin1a
source: Their eggs are considered delicacies, so wild POKENAME developed calcium-condensed exoskeletons to help them fight against poachers.

entry: POKENAME在山侧筑巢，产下巨蛋，谁想靠近，它就会咆哮着俯冲攻击。金黄的蛋黄太美味，仍有人不惜迎战，只为尝一口。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lays large eggs in nests it builds on the side of mountains and dives down to attack anyone who tries to get near. The golden yolk inside these eggs is so delicious that some people will go up against a roaring POKENAME to taste it.

entry: POKENAME的齿轮不断转动，让每个囊舱里的蛋，都保持在最适温度。托儿所里常能见到它，照顾留下的蛋。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's gears are constantly turning, keeping a perfect temperature for the eggs inside each capsule. They're often found in daycares, taking care of left-behind eggs.

entry: POKENAME发现伤者时，会一边用幻象保护，一边为其治疗。谁也拦不住它救治附近的每一个人。
author: bobosmith01
source: When POKENAME finds someone hurt, it uses illusions to protect them while it heals them. Nothing will stop it from healing everyone in the area.

entry: POKENAME发现伤者，就会在治疗时，用幻象加以保护。几乎没有什么，能阻止它救治附近的每一个人。
author: bobosmith01
source: When POKENAME finds someone hurt, it uses illusions to protect them while it heals them. Almost nothing will stop it from healing everyone in the area.

entry: POKENAME常在幼年宝可梦身边，轻轻唱摇篮曲，陪小家伙们睡觉。温柔、可爱又会照料的天性，让它在宝可梦中心开放领养时，总有爱好者排队。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME is often seen around Baby Pokémon, gently singing lullabies as the Baby Pokémon sleep around it. Poké Fans can be seen lining up for them whenever they are available for adoption in Pokémon centers, due to its gentle, cute caregiving nature.

entry: 睡觉时，若POKENAME靠近，梦境就会变成育儿的念头。它缠着尚未育儿的年轻伴侣，用快乐的幻想填满梦境，鼓励他们开始养育孩子。
author: sk372
source: If POKENAME approaches while one is sleeping, one's dreams will turn to thoughts of child-rearing. It haunts young couples yet to have children, filling their dreams with happy fantasies to encourage them to start a family.

entry: POKENAME从炮口射出的蛋，极其鲜美，营养丰富。因为稀有，售价也很高。
author: .izik
source: The eggs POKENAME fires from its cannon are incredibly savory and filled with nutrients. Due to their rarity, they are sold at very high prices.

entry: POKENAME会像举行仪式般，将即将孵化的蛋放在月光下，围着唱歌跳舞。期间孵出的宝可梦，都会被它视如己出，疼爱抚养。
author: pkbonusducks
source: In something akin to a ceremony, POKENAME place eggs that are about to hatch under moonlight and sing and dance around them. During the event, any Pokémon that hatch are coddled and raised by POKENAME as one of their own.

entry: POKENAME的疗愈能力十分独特。粉红电流轻轻一击，就能帮助治愈多种伤病。
author: Trainerrobo
source: POKENAME has very unique healing properties. One zap from its pink electricity can help cure many different types of wounds and illnesses.

entry: 缓缓绕着POKENAME转动的蛋，散发的热量最高可达华氏99.5度。因此，附近的蛋似乎会孵化得快得多。
author: bigoljax
source: The egg that slowly orbits POKENAME radiates temperatures up to 99.5°F. Eggs that are near a POKENAME seem to hatch a lot more quickly due to this.

entry: POKENAME想要人或宝可梦手中的东西，就会先提议用蛋交换。若不成，便以尖牙威吓，不过很少真需要攻击。
author: .jerden
source: If POKENAME wants something that another person or Pokémon has, it will try offering its egg in exchange. If that fails, POKENAME will fall back on intimidation, using its sharp teeth as a threat, although it rarely needs to actually attack.

entry: 据说揉一揉盖上的蛋会得到幸福，弄裂却会招来可怕诅咒。古时，它曾是长寿的象征。
author: faelocke
source: The egg on its lid is said to give happiness when rubbed, but bestow horrible curses if cracked. In ancient times, it was a symbol of longevity.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴，能摧毁沿途几乎任何障碍。若有人遇险，它会不顾一切，直到对方安全康复。
author: gronkissimo
source: POKENAME has the power to destroy almost any obstacle in its path with its tail. If someone is in danger, it will stop at nothing until they are safe and healthy.

entry: 许多宝可梦中心，都请POKENAME帮忙，把药水等治疗用品，迅速送到训练家手中。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are used in many Pokémon Centers to quickly ship potions and other healing items to Trainers.

entry: POKENAME在野外只要遇见蛋，就想照顾，并用火给蛋保温。可若亲代只是离开几秒，这就会惹出麻烦。
author: dualblades1147
source: If POKENAME ever comes across an egg in the wild, it will attempt to look after it and will use its fire to warm it up. This can cause issues when the egg's parent has only left for a few seconds.

entry: POKENAME的蛋虽没有药用效果，它仍会送给路过的训练家，只盼得到关爱。它梦想着有朝一日，能像其他幸福蛋一样，到宝可梦中心工作。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its egg having no medical benefits, POKENAME will give it to passing Trainers for a chance of affection. It dreams of one day working at a Pokémon Center just like other Blissey.

entry: POKENAME翅上散出的粉尘，一接触就能治愈伤者。据说见到它的人，也会获得健康。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's wings spread a dust which heals people on contact. If you see this Pokémon, it is said good health will be given to you.

entry: POKENAME四处漂浮，向感知到伤心的人送蛋。它不肯接受拒绝；好意若被推辞太多次，就可能猛地将臂端的蛋递出，力道足以打断骨头。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME floats around, offering its eggs to people it senses are sad. It will refuse to take no for an answer and may thrust the eggs at the end of its arms forward with enough force to break bones if its generous offer is spurned too many times.

entry: 一察觉有人悲伤，它就会离开藏身处奔向对方，分享带来幸福的蛋，不管路途有多远。
author: tomatosalad
source: When it senses sadness in a person, this Pokémon will leave hiding and race to them to share an egg of happiness, no matter how far it must travel.

entry: 雨季，能见到成群大尾狸围着POKENAME，交换劈好的木头、坚果、水果等礼物。最让它满意的那只，会得到拥抱，以及它那块蛋形石头。
author: beatdoof
source: Gatherings of Bibarel can be seen surrounding POKENAME during the rainy season, exchanging gifts such as chopped wood, nuts, and fruit. The one that impresses POKENAME the most will be rewarded with a hug and its egg-like stone.

entry: 雌性POKENAME背上的毛，远比雄性浓密。母亲将一窝蛋放进毛中保温，也能直接守护，不让偷蛋者得逞。
author: _pixelar_
source: Female POKENAME have a massive amount of fur on their backs, compared to a male POKENAME. The female will place its clutch in the fur to warm up the eggs, allowing the mother to directly protect them from egg thieves.

entry: POKENAME性情善良，常收养被遗弃的蛋，视如己出。身体虽小，它仍竭尽所能，让蛋得到妥善照料。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are kind creatures that often adopt abandoned eggs to raise as their own. Even though their bodies are small, they do everything they can to give the egg a good life.

entry: POKENAME的蛋散发怡人香气，却含有微量毒素。闻得太久，可能损害健康。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME's egg emits a pleasant aroma. However, prolonged exposure to the smell can result in health problems, as it contains trace amounts of poison.

entry: POKENAME视力极佳，会远远观察看似悲伤的人。它等到对方最无助时，才靠近，分享满是喜悦的蛋，却必须换来自己珍视的东西。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's eyesight is excellent, and it will watch people who seem sad from a long distance away. It will wait until they seem most desperate, then approach to share its egg full of joy, although only in exchange for something POKENAME values.

entry: 强烈的母性驱使POKENAME，拔下头尾的柔软羽毛，编成温暖舒适的巢。它也会让其他宝可梦，把蛋放进巢中，安全保管。
author: ambrosia04
source: Driven by a powerful maternal instinct, POKENAME plucks the soft feathers from its head and tail to craft a warm, comfortable nest. It is known to let other Pokémon rest their eggs within its nest for safekeeping.

entry: POKENAME用育儿袋，偷走毫无防备的宝可梦的蛋，再把蛋存成日后的点心。
author: celio_0230
source: POKENAME use their pouches to snatch eggs from unsuspecting Pokémon. They then proceed to store the egg as a snack for later consumption.

entry: POKENAME把正面情绪，收集在随身带着的巨蛋里。遇到不开心的对象，它就敲开蛋，倒出美丽宝石，逗对方高兴。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME collects positive emotions in the giant egg it carries around. If it finds someone who is unhappy, it will crack open the egg and pour out beautiful gemstones to cheer them up.

entry: POKENAME温顺，专心照顾自己的孩子。但若弄丢一直抱着的蛋，就会暴怒地寻找未孵化的幼崽，什么也挡不住它的狂奔。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME is a docile Pokémon more focused on caring for its children. If it loses the egg it always held in its arms, however, it will fly into a vicious rage in search of its unborn young, with nothing stopping its rampage.

entry: POKENAME在降雪中隐去身影，寻找冻僵的遗骸，希望用生命力填满自己的蛋。
author: houndrys.
source: POKENAME hide their presence during snowfall. They can be found searching for frozen remains, hoping to fill their egg with lifeforce.

entry: 它会靠近生病、受伤的人与宝可梦，不断加油鼓励，直到康复。让病人保持好心情的本领，使POKENAME在一些医院很受欢迎。
author: hophoppip
source: It approaches humans and Pokémon who are sick or injured and cheers them on until they're well. POKENAME have become popular in some hospitals for keeping patients in good spirits.

entry: POKENAME游得比水上摩托还快，却能将头上的蛋稳稳保持平衡。它们成大群游动，互相保护，也保护彼此的蛋。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are able to swim faster than jet skis, yet can keep the eggs on their heads perfectly balanced. They swim in large shivers, keeping each other and their eggs protected.

entry: POKENAME最爱把蛋藏在森林各处，给幼年宝可梦找乐子。从生物学上说，这些蛋其实是它枝上长出的特殊树果，但营养价值与蛋相近。
author: adamzwill
source: POKENAME loves nothing more than to hide eggs throughout its forest for young Pokémon to enjoy. Biologically, these "eggs" are actually a unique type of berry grown in the branches of POKENAME itself, but share a similar nutritional value to eggs.

entry: POKENAME大多待在地面，晴天却会飞到高处唱歌。歌声能将喜悦传到数英里外，但近处听，便震耳欲聋。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of its time on the ground, but will fly up to high places to sing on sunny days. These songs can bring joy to people miles away, but are deafening to hear up close.

entry: POKENAME太胆小，不敢用有溶解能力的黏液进食，只靠爬过时遇到的食物维生，尤其爱吃草。它带着的蛋，能让任何宝可梦瞬间恢复最佳状态。
author: beatdoof
source: Too timid to eat anything using its dissolving slime and mucus, POKENAME instead subsists on whatever it crawls over, with grass being its favorite. The egg it carries can instantly restore any Pokémon to its maximum potential.

entry: POKENAME分泌的黏液，覆在沉重的蛋状壳上，让壳光滑又不失坚固。因此，捕食者通常不会理会缩在壳里的它。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: The goo that POKENAME secretes covers its heavy, egg-like shell, making it slippery whilst maintaining its durability. Due to this, predators usually ignore POKENAME hiding in their shells.

entry: POKENAME天生友善、会照料，是孩子可靠的保姆。除此之外，许多精英训练家，也把它当作王牌伙伴。
author: beatdoof
source: A friendly, nurturing species by nature, POKENAME is well known as a reliable nanny for children. Despite this reputation, many Ace Trainers also rely on it as their ace partner.

entry: 它无尽的善心与结实的身体，让它能飞奔去帮助任何有需要的对象。可惜笨得像块石头，急着赶路时，可能踩到别人。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its bottomless kindness and sturdy body allow it to rush to the aid of anyone who needs it. However, it's as dumb as a rock and may trample others during its rush.

entry: POKENAME的花释放浓厚的花粉，有焕活功效。其他宝可梦有时把蛋放进花中，吸收花粉，让幼崽破壳时格外健康。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's flower emits thick pollen that has rejuvenating properties. Pokémon will sometimes place their eggs in its flower, letting them soak up the pollen so that the child is exceptionally healthy when it hatches.

entry: 病人康复后，POKENAME会送上小小的蛋形发条玩具。每个都是亲手制作，礼物里也就饱含珍贵的心意。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gifts its patients little wind-up egg toys after they recover. Each of these toys are hand-made by POKENAME, so the gift has a strong level of sentimental value..

entry: POKENAME关心别人的健康，远胜过自己。哪怕受了重伤，也只有简易包扎能让自己更快救治别人时，它才肯给自己包上。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME cares far more for the health of others than its own. It will put makeshift bandages on major injuries only if it ensures it can more quickly respond to the injury of another.

entry: POKENAME常陪伴救生员，协助各种急救。它带着的蛋，对玛瑙水母蜇伤的毒，是有效的解药。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME often accompany lifeguards, assisting in a variety of first-aid care. The egg they carry is known to act as a useful antidote for Tentacool stings.

entry: POKENAME给巢涂上不伤蛋的特殊酸液。受到威胁，它就向闯入者眼睛直喷水柱，压力极高，再迅速逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME coats its nest with a special acid that does not harm its egg. If threatened, it sprays highly pressurized water directly at the eyes of intruders before making a swift escape.

entry: 它背上的菌盖，吃下一顶，就会让人充满同情与慷慨。菌盖长得很快，因此POKENAME乐意分给看似不快的对象。
author: .jerden
source: The mushroom caps on its back fill anyone who eats one with compassion and generosity. They quickly grow back, so POKENAME is happy to share them with anyone who looks upset.

entry: POKENAME常见于海滨城镇的沙滩，近年也有向内陆出现的报告。虽是仿冒的宝可梦中心，它仍会治愈每只走进门的小型宝可梦。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: While often found along the beachfront of coastal towns, POKENAME have been reported more inland over the past few years. Despite being a faux Pokémon Center, POKENAME will heal any small Pokémon that enters through its doors.

entry: POKENAME照料蛋时，总是宁静安详，把蛋紧贴胸口，保护它不受寒。它也爱拥抱焦虑的宝可梦幼崽。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a serene calmness whenever they are taking care of their egg and protect it from the cold by keeping it close to their chest. They love to give out hugs to baby Pokémon who feel anxious.

entry: POKENAME温柔的旋律，能让宝可梦幼崽与孩子都平静下来。许多童谣，都源自它的歌。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME's gentle melodies are able to calm down baby Pokémon and children alike. Many nursery rhymes are derived from this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME袋中装着巨大一包蘑菇孢子。吸入后，人们便会满心喜悦，彼此理解。它会寻找拥挤的地方，想将这份感觉传给尽可能多的人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME carries a giant bundle of mushroom spores in its pouch. Inhaling these spores fills people with joy and understanding for each other. POKENAME will seek out crowded places to try to spread this to as many people as possible.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片虽由蛋壳构成，却厚得比岩石更耐打。它每次活动，哪怕战斗中，鳞片相碰的乐声，都会让听见者微笑。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME's scales are made of eggshell, they are thick enough to be more durable than rock. Every time POKENAME moves, even during combat, the musical sound of its scales clinking together makes anyone who hears it smile.

entry: POKENAME能用尖爪使出强力斩击，厚重的壳甲也让它极为坚韧。但若似乎要输，它就会丢下蛋，分散注意，再撤退。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can deliver powerful slashes with its sharp claws. While its thick shell armor makes it incredibly tough, if POKENAME seems to be losing a battle, it will drop its egg as a distraction, then retreat.

entry: POKENAME用采来的草药自制药物，再冲进战场，用汤匙喂进伤者口中。它以铠甲般的身体保护病者，挥动汤匙，打退袭击者。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME make their own medicine using herbs they gather, then rush into battles to spoon this into the mouths of injured Pokémon. POKENAME protect their patients using their own armored bodies, fighting off attackers with swings of their spoon.

entry: 据说，只要POKENAME在场，连深陷抑郁的人也能露出笑容。魔杖尖端的蛋始终温暖，敷在伤口上便能治愈，仿佛施展魔法。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is said that its mere presence can bring a smile even to people suffering from deep depression. The egg at the tip of its wand is always warm and is placed on wounds to heal them, as if POKENAME were performing magic.

entry: POKENAME通常在宝可梦中心帮忙，能飞快跑向悲伤的宝可梦，送上一颗蛋，盼其开心。受到威胁，它会把蛋含进嘴里。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME is typically used in Pokémon Centers and can quickly run to sad Pokémon to give them an egg, hoping to help them feel happy. POKENAME puts its egg in its mouth when threatened.

entry: 体内温度很高，让这种宝可梦常被用作孵化器。任何放进壳里的蛋，几分钟内就能孵出。
author: bostroms
source: Its high internal temperature means this Pokémon sees lots of use as an egg incubator.  Any egg placed within its shell will hatch within minutes.

entry: POKENAME滚烫的壳，能喷出大量热腾腾的美味炒蛋。这项本领，对寒地的厨师与宝可梦中心都很宝贵。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME's boiling shell can erupt large amounts of delicious hot scrambled eggs. This quality is very valuable for both chefs and Pokémon centers in cold areas.

entry: POKENAME很受乔伊小姐欢迎，能产生孢子，治疗、舒缓接触到的对象。它主要在急救中使用，因为长期接触鳞片，会让人产生抗性。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Popular among Nurse Joys, POKENAME create spores that help heal and soothe people who come in contact with them. They are primarily used in emergencies as prolonged exposure to the scales can cause someone to develop an immunity.

entry: POKENAME因与伙伴结下深厚友谊而进化，性情随和亲人，几乎从不攻击别人。在这个生命阶段，它对身边的对象信任至极，哪怕受到苛待也不改。
author: bobosmith01
source: Having formed a strong friendship with another that allowed it to evolve, POKENAME is agreeable and affectionate in personality and almost never lashes out at anyone. It has utmost faith in those around it in this stage of life, even if mistreated.

entry: POKENAME毛发香气怡人，为了保持香味，常常梳理自己。有人推测，它或许是想在治疗、护理其他宝可梦前，先确保爪子干净，但尚未证实。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's fur has a pleasant scent; to keep it that way, POKENAME grooms itself quite often. While unproven, it has been theorized that it may do so as a desire to make sure its paws are clean before attempting to treat and nurse other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME喜欢携带能孵化的蛋，还常从别人那里偷来。幼崽孵出后，它会一直带着，直到大得带不下。
author: sitten1115
source: POKENAME prefer to carry fertile eggs, often stealing them from others. Once an egg hatches, the infant is carried until it grows too large.

entry: POKENAME常与吉利蛋群一起生活。它虽然厌恶暴力，却会毫不犹豫，用尽全力保护自己照看的伙伴。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is often seen living alongside groups of Chansey. Though it abhors violence, it will not hesitate to protect those in its care with all its strength.

entry: POKENAME常在宝可梦托儿所工作，保护发现的蛋。它高高兴兴地带着蛋四处走，一有危险，就飞奔到安全处，确保蛋不受伤害。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are commonly employed within Pokémon daycares to protect any Pokémon eggs that are found. They happily ferry them around and, should danger strike, will race away to a safe location to ensure they do not come to harm.

entry: POKENAME与训练家的羁绊越深，尾尖的火焰就越大。火焰始终散发温暖、令人放松的热量。
author: bigoljax
source: The flame at the end of POKENAME's tail grows larger the stronger their bond gets with their trainers. A warm, relaxing heat radiates from the flame at all times.

entry: POKENAME喜欢战斗，尤其爱挑战强敌。面对弱小的挑战者，若觉得输掉能让对方开心，它就会故意败下阵来。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME loves fighting, especially against strong opponents. Against weak challengers, it will deliberately throw the fight if it thinks that it will make its opponent happy.

entry: POKENAME温柔地照顾被遗弃的蛋，在野外发现时，有时会带回家。疼爱蛋很费心力，累了，它就蜷进壳里休息。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME give tender and loving care towards abandoned eggs and sometimes bring one home whenever they find one in the wild. Doting on the egg takes lots of effort, so they curl into their shell to rest whenever they are tired.

entry: POKENAME总带着微笑，背上一颗神秘的蛋。触碰蛋，就能得到好运祝福；可它跑得太快，谁也难以轻易捉住。
author: ambrosia04
source: Always smiling, POKENAME carries a mysterious egg on its back. Those who touch it are blessed with good fortune, but POKENAME runs too fast for anyone to easily catch it.

entry: POKENAME无尽的善心，让附在身上的大舌贝，对自己一直咬着尾巴感到过意不去。不过，它并没打算松口。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The Shellder attached to POKENAME feels bad for perpetually biting its tail, due to POKENAME's boundless kindness. The Shellder, however, has no plans to let go.

entry: POKENAME黏软身体的物质，有治愈作用，因此能将病者与伤者拥在怀中，给予安抚。体贴的天性使它受人喜爱，可那浓得过分的消毒气味，却始终去不掉。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME can envelop the sick and injured in soothing hugs because the substance that constitutes its gooey body acts as a healing agent. It is loved for its caring nature, but unfortunately it has an incurable, overly-sterile scent.

entry: 坚固的身体、远射的炮与满壳治愈之水，让这种宝可梦很受强大军事组织与消防员追捧。
author: frokachu
source: With a durable body, long range cannons and a shell full of healing water, this Pokémon is often sought out by strong military groups and firefighters.

entry: POKENAME的硬壳与弹性身体结合，能抵御大多数攻击。壳内，沙粒被液体包裹，形成美丽的蛋形珍珠。
author: .jerden
source: The combination of POKENAME's hard shell and bouncy body protects it from most attacks. Within its shell, grains of sand are coated with fluid to form beautiful egg-shaped pearls.

entry: POKENAME喷出水流，就能把蛋从袋中发射出去，将其中的幸福迅速送给需要安慰的人。不过它有时射偏，不小心把蛋糊在人脸上。
author: .jerden
source: By expelling a jet of water, POKENAME can launch its egg out of its pouch. It can use this to quickly deliver the happiness it contains to people who need cheering up, although POKENAME sometimes misses and accidentally gets egg on their faces.

entry: 外行看来，它像普通幸福蛋，开开心心地与你分享蛋。可POKENAME的蛋其实剧毒，吃下会染上致命疾病。
author: kittyluv090
source: To the untrained eye, it may look like a normal Blissey, happily sharing its egg with you. However, POKENAME's eggs are extremely toxic, leaving those who eat them with deadly diseases.

entry: POKENAME拖着的巨蛋，壳厚得如岩石般坚硬。它愿分给遇到的人与宝可梦，却很少有谁有力气敲开，让它似乎颇为失望。
author: .jerden
source: The massive egg POKENAME drags around with it has a thick shell as hard as rock. While POKENAME will offer to share it with people and Pokémon it encounters, few have the strength to crack it, which seems to disappoint POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME壳上的注射器，装着性质类似全复药的混合液。它把液体滴在其他宝可梦的伤口上，帮助重伤恢复。
author: bigoljax
source: The syringes carried by POKENAME's shell contain a mixture similar in property to a full restore. They drip this mixture onto other Pokémon's wounds, helping them recover from bad injuries.

entry: POKENAME能调节外壳的通透程度，让壳面密度降到足以将蛋放进去。壳内始终保持着完美的孵化环境。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to control how permeable their shells are, letting them reduce the density of the shell surface enough to carry eggs within them. They maintain a perfect environment for incubation within their shell.

entry: 人们常打趣说，POKENAME精力多得跑个不停，简直是风暴的化身。有生物挡路，它就会大声低吼，催对方让开。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: It is often joked that POKENAME embody the essence of storms on account of all the energy they have to run around. If a creature is in their way, they will loudly growl to get them to move.

entry: 它们用弹性十足的腿，迅速腾挪，连连踢击，压制对手。腿动得越多，产生的电力就越多。
author: infinex21
source: They use their springy legs to perform quick maneuvers and to deliver quick kicks that overwhelm their foes. The more they move on their legs, the more electricity they generate.

entry: POKENAME凭闪电般的拳法，力争成为肉搏冠军。拿手的雷电拳，即使没打中敌人，也会轰然作雷鸣。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME strive to be champions in physical combat with their lightning-quick boxing techniques. Their signature move is a Thunder Punch that booms like thunder even if it doesn't strike a foe.

entry: POKENAME是不爱争斗的海底住民，却不能当作无害。它吹出的小泡泡中，带着惊人的电量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a non-aggressive undersea denizen, but should not be thought of as harmless. It blows out small bubbles that are charged with stupendous amounts of electricity.

entry: POKENAME平时温顺，受惊时却会释放强力麻痹粉。麻痹、电击来犯者后，它便迅速飞上天空，寻找更平静的环境。
author: pkbonusducks
source: While normally docile, POKENAME release a potent Stun Spore when shocked. After paralyzing and electrocuting their aggressors, POKENAME swiftly escape to the skies to find a more peaceful environment.

entry: POKENAME从指尖射出道道闪电作战，也能制造带电的屏障，保护自己。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME fights by shooting streaks of lightning from its fingertips. It can also create electrified barriers to protect itself.

entry: POKENAME用坚韧的前爪标记领地，冲锋时也靠爪子减速。野生个体常争夺领地与群体首领之位，双角相撞，声如雷鸣。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME mark their territories using their tough, front claws which also help to slow themselves during a charging attack. Wild POKENAME regularly fight over territory and pack leadership, the sounds of their clashing horns reminiscent of thunder.

entry: POKENAME每天花许多时间泡在水里，紫色毛发的拒水性却出了名地好。它把电存在毛中，再经爪牙释放。
author: infinex21
source: The purple furs of POKENAME are notoriously water-repellant, despite how much time these Pokémon spend within water each day. Their fur is where they store electricity, which they can release through their claws and their fangs.

entry: POKENAME周围始终环绕狂乱的静电气场。跑动时，静电越积越多，最终化成猛烈的风暴。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME is constantly surrounded by an aura of wild static electricity. As it runs, this static builds up into a raging storm.

entry: POKENAME把电引向唯一的刀刃状肢体，一挥就能打出翻腾的雷电，劈开前方几码远的土地。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME channels its electricity into its singular bladed limb. With one swing it can generate a roiling bolt of lightning that can carve up the land several yards in front of it.

entry: POKENAME裹着雪之披风，翱翔于冬日雷雨中央，离开渐散的风暴时，身后拖着极光。它同时效忠洛奇亚与凤王，让民俗学者愈发关注。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME soars at the center of winter thunderstorms, shrouded in a cloak of snow, and it trails the aurora behind it when it leaves the dissipating storm. Folklorists have begun studying it more since it demonstrates fealty to both Lugia and Ho-oh.

entry: POKENAME能飞越极远的距离，人们只见过它在火山口边栖息。栖息处变得不稳定时，它就向火山投下闪电，不知怎么，便让火山重归休眠。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flies for vast distances, only ever seen roosting at the rim of volcanoes. Should its perch become volatile, it casts down lightning into the volcano that somehow returns it to dormancy.

entry: POKENAME每次瞬间移动，都伴着一声响雷与迸发的电流。它爱突然移到别人近旁，用响声吓对方一跳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME generates a loud thunderclap and a burst of electricity whenever it teleports. It likes to surprise others by teleporting close to them and scaring them with the loud noise.

entry: POKENAME很像一本旧书里描述的生物。它释放的雷鸣，强到一击就能夷平森林。见过它平静模样的人，少之又少。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME resembles a creature described in an old book. It unleashes a thunderclap powerful enough to flatten a forest in one blow. Few witnesses have ever seen it calm.

entry: POKENAME精力充沛，爱与训练家赛跑，拉着对方从一个城镇跑到另一个。脚印带电，经过数小时仍会冒火花，让野生个体很容易追踪。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are full of energy and love to race around with their Trainers, dragging them from town to town. Their footprints carry an electrical charge and can spark for hours after they've passed by, making wild POKENAME easy to track.

entry: POKENAME用雷电牙咬住对手，威力如落雷。它能将鬃毛折到头顶，形成巨大的上颚，以闪电打击敌人，仿佛雷霆本身咬了下来。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME bites down on opponents with a Thunder Fang that has the power of a crashing thunderbolt. It can fold its mane over its head to form a massive upper jaw that strikes foes with lightning as if thunder itself were biting down on them.

entry: POKENAME随时都能起跑，几秒内就达到最高速度。猛然奔出时，它会迸发电流，声音像一声小小的雷鸣。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can take off running at a moment's notice, reaching its maximum speed within seconds. It creates an electric burst when it runs so suddenly, which sounds like a small thunderclap.

entry: POKENAME用自己吐出的丝线，在森林间快速荡行。线上噼啪闪着强电，警告其他生物别碰，也别打断它荡行，免得触电。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME travels quickly through forests by swinging from threads it produces. Said threads visibly crackle with potent electricity, warning others to avoid touching them and interrupting its swinging lest they get jolted.

entry: 它虽是笨拙的幼崽，雷霆般的潜力却无可否认。想与它生活，就得做好准备：一受惊或不高兴，便可能迎来暴风雨。
author: h0bojoe
source: Despite being a clumsy infant, its thunderous potential is undeniable. Anyone hoping to live with one should be prepared for stormy weather whenever it becomes startled or upset.

entry: 人们对POKENAME知之甚少，因为一靠近，它就迅速逃走。已知它只在有闪电落下的日子，出现在城都的山区。
author: mepp.
source: Very little is known about POKENAME, as they quickly flee when approached. They are known to only appear in the mountainous areas in Johto on days when lightning has struck.

entry: POKENAME带着强大电力，从体内发光。雷雨中，它开心地乘风而行。此时船桅周围发亮的等离子体，被称作“POKENAME之火”。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME is charged with powerful electricity that illuminates it from within. During thunderstorms, it gleefully rides on the winds. Glowing plasma around a ship's masts during these storms is called POKENAME's fire.

entry: 迁徙季，POKENAME飞驰天际，留下雷鸣般的咆哮。数英里外都能听见，却很少能看见。
author: quackquackattack
source: During their migratory season, POKENAME leave a thundering roar behind them as they bolt across the sky. While POKENAME are heard for miles away, they are rarely seen.

entry: POKENAME想出行时，会引电落在自己身上，借能量在泥地飞驰，快得仿佛瞬间移动。可这会造成严重电灼伤，它必须将泥与唾液混合，敷在伤处。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When POKENAME wants to travel, it calls down electricity upon it, and using this energy it travels across mud at such speeds it looks almost instantaneous. This gives it nasty electrical burns, which it then must apply a mixture of mud and saliva to.

entry: POKENAME的吼声比雷鸣更响。利爪会在领地内的树木上留下锯齿般的焦痕，满是电灼的伤迹。
author: cristata
source: The roar of a POKENAME echos louder than thunder, and its claws etch jagged, electricity-scorched scars into the trees of its territory.

entry: 獠牙与鬃毛随年龄越长越大，激动时会噼啪放电。时至今日，仍有人为其壮观的外形，或极好的导电性，寻找它们的獠牙。
author: infinex21
source: Their tusks and manes grow longer and larger with age and crackle with electricity when they are agitated. Even now, some humans still seek their tusks for how grand they are and, or, because they conduct electricity so well.

entry: POKENAME定期释放的大股电流，能提高半径10英里内计算设备的速度。许多训练家借此追踪它的位置。
author: .izik
source: The large electric bursts POKENAME periodically releases increase the speed of computing devices within a 10 mile radius. Many Trainers use this information to track its position.

entry: 喝POKENAME的奶，会让某些肌肉充分充能，提升速度。据说，喝得够多，就能跑得像闪电一样快。
author: sk372
source: Drinking POKENAME's milk causes certain muscles to become supercharged, increasing the drinker's speed. Drinking enough of its milk is said to let a person run as fast as lightning.

entry: 这种雷公的自身融合，有时被称作“暴风雨前的宁静”。它举止沉静优雅，常显得完全温顺，却可能毫无预兆，突然打出猛烈闪电。
author: infranscia
source: This self fusion of Raikou is sometimes called "The calm before the storm."  It carries itself with such calm elegance that it often seems completely docile, but it may suddenly strike with intense lightning, without any warning.

entry: 据说，POKENAME是雷电本质的化身，会从雷云降下，惩罚危及电属性宝可梦的人类。传说一声咆哮，就能召来雷电风暴，袭向敌人。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is said that POKENAME embodies the very essence of lightning and can descend from storm clouds to punish humans who endanger Electric-type Pokémon. According to legend, a single roar from it can summon a storm of thunderbolts upon its enemies.

entry: POKENAME是水京一番谋划的产物。他痴迷传说宝可梦，一直追寻水君。这种融合体最初在桧皮镇被目击，此后城都与关都各地，也陆续有了记录。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are the result of the machinations of Eusine, a legendary Pokémon fanatic who had been chasing the legendary beast Suicune. After first being sighted in Azalea Town, there have since been sightings across Johto and Kanto.

entry: POKENAME是水京一番谋划的产物。他痴迷传说宝可梦，一直追寻水君。这种融合体最初在桧皮镇被目击，此后城都与关都各地，也陆续有了记录。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are the result of the machinations of Eusine, a legendary Pokémon fanatic who had been chasing the legendary beast Suicune. After first being sighted in Azalea Town, there have since been sightings across Johto and Kanto.

entry: POKENAME是水京一番谋划的产物。他痴迷传说宝可梦，一直追寻水君。这种融合体最初在桧皮镇被目击，此后城都与关都各地，也陆续有了记录。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are the result of the machinations of Eusine, a legendary Pokémon fanatic who had been chasing the legendary beast Suicune. After first being sighted in Azalea Town, there have since been sightings across Johto and Kanto.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，能召来持续一个多月的巨大雷暴。每拍一次翅膀，雷鸣的威力就足以夷平房屋。
author: mistymagius
source: As POKENAME flies, it summons massive thunderstorms that can last for over a month. Every flap of its wings causes thunderclaps strong enough to flatten houses.

entry: 巨大的獠牙分泌麻痹成分，不到一小时，就能放倒象牙猪。为了威吓别人，它会摇动下半身，发出雷鸣般的响声。
author: infinex21
source: Its large fangs secrete a paralytic agent that could down a Mamoswine in less than an hour. To intimidate others, it can shake its lower body to produce a thunder-like sound.

entry: POKENAME专攻出其不意，常从对手背后，突然施以电击。
author: gayschlatt
source: POKENAME relies on the element of surprise to shock its opponents from behind.

entry: POKENAME的一记十万伏特，便能将高树干净利落地劈成两半。
author: gayschlatt
source: A Thunderbolt from POKENAME can split a tall tree clean in two.

entry: 古时，人们尊POKENAME为雷神。它只需敲一下鼓，就能在农田上召来雷电。三团轰鸣旋转的雹云，呈现与鼓相同的图样，标志着它的猎场。
author: soup1900
source: In ancient times, POKENAME was revered by people as the god of thunder, able to summon thunderbolts over their crop fields with a tap of its drums. Three thundering, swirling hail clouds in the same pattern its drums have signify its hunting grounds.

entry: 别看POKENAME的体型，它能引发被人比作雷鸣的震动。地面上作战时，它裹着道道电弧，疾冲、斩击敌人。
author: infinex21
source: Despite their size, POKENAME can create tremors that some have compared to the rumbling of thunder. During battle, when aboveground, POKENAME are wreathed in arcs of electricity as they dash about and slash at their foes.

entry: POKENAME将叶状尾巴举向天空，引导、释放电力，仿佛能唤下闪电。最健康时，紫叶的尖端会呈绿色。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME channel and release electricity through their leafy tails when they raise them toward the sky. This stance allows them to seemingly call down lightning bolts. The tips of their purple leaves are green when they are healthiest.

entry: 它一叫，便会释放电火花，以及片片冰冷能量。冻结部分毛发，能让它更好地自卫，也更好地调节力量。
author: infinex21
source: When it cries out, it releases sparks of electricity and flakes of its freezing energy. By freezing parts of its own fur, it can better defend itself and better regulate its own power.

entry: POKENAME等到沙暴来临，才在栖身的沙漠狩猎。它凭有力双翼乘风而行，迅速扑向猎物，再以獠牙传出电击，将其解决。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME wait for sandstorms before they go on the hunt for prey within the deserts they live in. They ride the winds with their strong wings, pouncing quickly upon prey and finishing them with an electric shock delivered through their fangs.

entry: POKENAME是雷霆般的斗士，兼具火焰鸡的格斗技巧与雷公的力量，出招迅疾如电。
author: sheogorath
source: POKENAME is a thunderous brawler. Fusing Blaziken's fighting prowess with Raikou's power, it is capable of launching attacks at lightning speed.

entry: POKENAME住在沼泽，主要在雷雨时出来。吸收空气中的电力时，电流便在泥泞大地上流动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME inhabits swampy areas, coming out primarily when thunderstorms are present. Electricity rolls across the muddy landscape as it absorbs the ambient electricity in the air.

entry: 雨天，POKENAME会靠近独处的对象，给予安慰。若遭暴力对待，它就伴着一声响雷逃走。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: On rainy days, POKENAME approach those who are alone to provide comfort. If they are shown violence, POKENAME flee with a loud thunderclap.

entry: POKENAME的舞蹈，以富有戏剧张力著称。旋转、跳跃时，手与尾巴飞出电火花；每场表演，都会以举手召来一道闪电作结。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's dance routines are known for their dramatic flair. Sparks fly from its hands and tail as it spins and leaps, and every performance ends with a raised hand and a summoned crack of lightning.

entry: POKENAME隐居高地，只在最猛烈的风暴中现身。凭强大的情绪感知能力，它能从近一英里外，精准射出闪电。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are reclusive beings that live at higher elevations, revealing themselves during the most intense storms. They can precisely shoot lightning bolts from nearly a mile away, thanks to their strong ability to sense emotions.

entry: POKENAME会引导最强风暴的力量，保护自己在意的对象。只需几秒，就能凝成并射出巨大的纯电球，打击敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will channel the power of the strongest storms in defense of those it cares for. Massive orbs of pure condensed electricity can be formed and fired at foes in mere seconds.

entry: POKENAME体内电力太多，每次瞬间移动，都会响起雷鸣。它能从双臂向空中放电，几秒内让天空布满狂暴雷云。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses so much internal electricity that it creates a thunderclap whenever it teleports. It can fire lightning from its arms into the air and fill the sky with raging storm clouds within seconds.

entry: 传说，一块神圣石头，一年内被雷劈中108次后，最初的POKENAME才诞生。石头所在之处，天气就会渐渐变得雷雨交加。
author: sk372
source: Legends say POKENAME first formed after a sacred stone was struck by lightning 108 times in a year. Wherever POKENAME's stone is present, the weather slowly turns more and more thunderous and stormy.

entry: POKENAME从闪电汲取能量，与有意识的风暴并肩作战，压倒敌人。越久没充电，它就越难压住狂暴的风暴。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Gathering energy from lightning bolts, POKENAME fight alongside their sentient storms to overpower foes. The longer a POKENAME has gone without recharging, the harder it will be for it to hold back its raging storm.

entry: 每次击打POKENAME的盾牌，都会如雷轰鸣。古人相信，敲得太多，村庄就会被永无止境的雷雨笼罩。
author: mistymagius
source: Every strike against POKENAME's shield sounds like crashing thunder. Ancient people believe that if you struck its shield too many times, your village would be shrouded in an endless thunderstorm.

entry: POKENAME对谁不满，就会用红眼睛盯着对方。据说，无人能在它的目光下不害怕，光是对视，就会触电。
author: heal_fire
source: When POKENAME is upset with someone, it stares at them with its red eyes. It's said than no one can help but feel afraid under POKENAME's gaze, and that people get electrified just by looking at it in its eyes.

entry: 被闪电劈中后，POKENAME会产生持久的影响，让别人相信它具有神性。受影响的追随者，可能跟着它跨越各地，长达数年。
author: .izik
source: If struck by lightning, POKENAME emits a lasting influence that convinces others of its divinity. Affected followers may trail it across regions for years.

entry: POKENAME对颈间蓬松的鬃毛十分自豪，经常梳理。只要弄脏一点，它就会小发脾气，愤怒地从鳍肢随意甩出小电球。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite proud of the fluffy mane around its neck, preening it often. If it gets dirty in any way, POKENAME throws a mild tantrum, angrily flinging little electric orbs from its flippers at random.

entry: POKENAME乘着浮空的雷云，以闪电般的电击贯穿目标。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME pierces its victims with the electric impact of lightning. It rides on a floating storm cloud.

entry: POKENAME住在雷雨频仍的荒地，以洞穴为巢。目光能望遍遥远的家园，因此总知道何时适合狩猎。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live within thunderstorm-ridden badlands, with caves serving as their dens. Their eyesight is strong enough to see far across their badland homes, so they always know when the time to hunt is ripe.

entry: POKENAME追逐风暴，以缎带作避雷针，吸收闪电，保护其他生灵。它很害羞，一察觉风暴开始消散，就会跑回山林中的巢。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME chases storms, using its ribbons as lightning rods to absorb thunderbolts and protect others. It is very shy, so it will run away to return to its den in mountainous forests as soon as it senses the storm start to dissipate.

entry: POKENAME在尾巴里储存庞大电力，再导向角与爪，重创敌人。尾巴本身也坚实得很，单独便是可怕的武器。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stores up vast amounts of electricity within its tail. It funnels the energy into its horn and claws to devastate its foes, and the tail itself is sturdy enough to be a formidable weapon all its own.

entry: 作为宇宙间的苍穹守护者，POKENAME飞过平流层，驯服风暴，吸收太阳耀斑。每声咆哮，都将雷与光扭成狂舞盘旋的极光。
author: jaminmcready
source: A cosmic guardian of the skies, POKENAME flies through the stratosphere, taming tempests and absorbing solar flares. Every roar bends thunder and light into wild, spiraling auroras.

entry: POKENAME很怕旁人围观，轻巧的金属外骨骼，却让它跑得极快。若被逼入绝境，它就造出巨大雷雨，分散敌人注意，再逃走。
author: .izik
source: Very shy around onlookers, POKENAME's lightweight metal exoskeleton allows it to run at great speed. Should it ever be cornered, it will create a massive thunderstorm to distract the foe before fleeing.

entry: POKENAME在火山地区用爪牙标记领地，也借此保持锋利。咆哮时，云朵般的毛发会像火一样发光，雷电噼啪作响。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME uses its claws and fangs to mark its territory within volcanic areas, which also helps keep these parts sharp. Whenever POKENAME roars, its cloud-like fur glows like fire and crackles with lightning.

entry: POKENAME的须会伸长，化为带电的触蔓，与其他对象互动。它快速奔走世界各地，只会定期在游历训练家的图鉴里歇歇脚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's whiskers extend out and become electrified tendrils for interacting with others. It zips around the world at a fast pace, only taking periodic breaks within the Pokédex of wandering Trainers.

entry: POKENAME喜欢乘风远行，出现在哪里，哪里就会有雷雨。它性情调皮，靠近城市时，常常引发停电。
author: dahappycute
source: POKENAME enjoys riding on winds, travelling great distances and causing thunderstorms where it appears. It has a mischievous attitude and frequently causes power outages when it is nearby cities.

entry: POKENAME有时在猛烈雷雨中现身，伪装成闪电，穿行雨云之间。据说，若被它的雷击中，身与魂都会化为灰烬。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME sometimes appear during harsh thunderstorms, camouflaging themselves as lightning to move between nimbus clouds. Being struck by its thunderbolt is said to reduce both body and soul to ash.

entry: 据说，满月时的猛烈雷雨，是POKENAME所为。此时，它们会小群聚集，向往地仰望月亮，沐浴风暴的雨水。
author: sk372
source: It is said that aggressive thunderstorms during the full moon are due to POKENAME. Small groups gather during these moments, gazing up at the moon longingly and basking in the storm's rainfall.

entry: POKENAME体内的绒羽，能让身体隐形，只有背上的雨云仍然可见。叫声又像雷鸣，因此隐形后，极难与真正的雷云分辨。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME's body contains a down that allows it to turn its body invisible, with the exception of the rain clouds on its back. Since POKENAME's cries sound like thunder, it's very difficult to tell it apart from a thundercloud when it turns invisible.

entry: POKENAME只甩一条尾巴，就能召来闪电；一声咆哮，便唤来灾厄雷霆。它一离开视野，就能轻易消失，因此被认为，本质上有一部分近于灵体。
author: bobosmith01
source: With a flick of just one tail can POKENAME call lightning; with a roar it calls calamitous thunder. It is believed to be partially ethereal in nature, as it can easily disappear once out-of-sight.

entry: POKENAME跃过大地，身后留下焦黑爪印，仿佛遭了雷击。人们认为，每条尾巴都蕴含一道闪电的力量，能借此摧毁敌人。
author: chibitales
source: As POKENAME bound across the land, they leave burned pawprints in their wake, as if the spot had been struck by lightning. Each of their tails is thought to hold the power of a single lightning strike, calling upon such power to decimate foes.

entry: 传闻，POKENAME诞生于强大雷雨劈中古化石之时，让早已灭绝的宝可梦复苏，重新充满能量。它咆哮时，总伴着雷声与闪电。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are rumored to be born when powerful thunderstorms strike ancient fossils, revitalizing the long-extinct Pokémon and re-energizing them. Their roars are accompanied by claps of thunder and bolts of lightning.

entry: 传闻，POKENAME诞生于强大雷雨劈中古化石之时，让早已灭绝的宝可梦复苏，重新充满能量。它咆哮时，总伴着雷声与闪电。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are rumored to be born when powerful thunderstorms strike ancient fossils, revitalizing the long-extinct Pokémon and re-energizing them. Their roars are accompanied by claps of thunder and bolts of lightning.

entry: 传闻，POKENAME诞生于强大雷雨劈中古化石之时，让早已灭绝的宝可梦复苏，重新充满能量。它咆哮时，总伴着雷声与闪电。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are rumored to be born when powerful thunderstorms strike ancient fossils, revitalizing the long-extinct Pokémon and re-energizing them. Their roars are accompanied by claps of thunder and bolts of lightning.

entry: POKENAME将电流引过鼻角与背鳍。化石遗骸附近发现的雷击石，表明它的电压，可能飙至6000万伏以上。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME channels raw electrical currents through the horn on its nose and the fins along its back. Fulgurites discovered near its fossilised remains suggest that its electricity can surge to over 60 million volts.

entry: 传闻，POKENAME诞生于强大雷雨劈中古化石之时，让早已灭绝的宝可梦复苏，重新充满能量。它咆哮时，总伴着雷声与闪电。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are rumored to be born when powerful thunderstorms strike ancient fossils, revitalizing the long-extinct Pokémon and re-energizing them. Their roars are accompanied by claps of thunder and bolts of lightning.

entry: 它以金黄色花蜜，引导雷鸣般的精神。富有感染力的喜悦与希望，让羽毛充盈新的热情。舞蹈引领更好的未来，至少，也能通往前路的一场胜利。
author: quackquackattack
source: When its thundering spirit is channeled through Yellow Nectar, a contagious joy and hope elevate it to charge up new enthusiasm in its feathers. Its dance leads the way to a better future, or at least a victory over the horizon.

entry: 据说，这些宝可梦诞生于被雷击倒的树木之灵，无论树是劈裂，还是燃起大火。如今，它们挥舞雷电本身，守卫森林家园。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon are said to be born of the spirits of trees that were struck down by bolts of lightning, be they split or set aflame. Now they wield lightning itself in the defense of their forest homes.

entry: POKENAME行踪难觅，出了名地难见。想瞥见一眼，就得冒险踏入危险天气，因为它藏在雷云之中。据说，尖锐的叫声，比雷还响。
author: mepp.
source: Notoriously elusive, those who wish to catch a glimpse of POKENAME must venture out in dangerous conditions as they hide within storm clouds. Their shrill cries are said to be louder than thunder itself.

entry: POKENAME踏着噼啪作响的雷云，高速飞行。它虽能毫无预兆地落雷打击敌人，却更喜欢先以雷鸣般的咆哮，宣告到来。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME flies through the air at high speed, riding atop a crackling thundercloud. While it can strike foes with lightning without any warning, it prefers to announce its arrival with a roar like thunder.

entry: POKENAME为鳍充电，产生足够的电磁能量，造出局部极光。极光虽由电产生，却会冻结周围地区。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: By charging its fins with electricity, POKENAME produces enough electromagnetic energy to create its own localized auroras. Despite being generated from electricity, these auroras freeze the area around them.

entry: POKENAME的毛与岩板，导电性极强，能轻松为电属性攻击充能。人们认为，它的嚎叫能召来足以夷平一片街区的闪电。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's fur and rocky plates are highly conductive, allowing them to charge Electric-type attacks easily. It's thought the howls of these Pokémon can summon lightning bolts capable of levelling a neighborhood.

entry: POKENAME给腿部肌肉充电，大步跃起，跨越极远的距离。它会用俯冲头槌攻击追兵，撞击轰然如雷。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME charges its leg muscles with electricity, letting it make great leaps to cover vast distances. It strikes pursuers with diving headbutts that impact with the heavy boom of a thunderclap.

entry: POKENAME伴着愤怒的隆隆声向前猛冲，沿背上的鼓积蓄静电，再一声震耳欲聋的咆哮，释放巨大闪电。在战场跳舞时，它也会击鼓，射出四散的雷电。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Barreling forward with a furious rumbling, POKENAME builds static along the drums on its back before unleashing a massive bolt of lightning with a deafening roar. It strikes its drums to fire off stray bolts while it dances around the battlefield.

entry: POKENAME越老，蘑菇就长得越高。风暴中，它很容易被雷劈中，却也逐渐能更轻松地吸收雷电。
author: infinex21
source: The older a POKENAME grows, the taller its mushroom becomes. They are prone to being struck by lightning during storms, which they have grown to absorb with increasing ease.

entry: POKENAME能以闪电般的速度奔跑，身后留下一路碎石，也能向敌人迅疾投出雷电手里剑。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME can run at the speed of lightning and leaves a path of rubble behind it. POKENAME can also fire quick lightning shurikens at foes.

entry: POKENAME周身每根绵软的丝，都带着一部分电荷。丝可以吃，相当甜，会轻轻电一下舌头，留下全身酥麻的感觉，却不会造成伤害。
author: sk372
source: Every one of the flossy threads surrounding POKENAME's body carries some of its electric charge. These strings are edible and quite sweet, delivering a harmless jolt to the tongue upon consumption that leaves the body tingling.

entry: POKENAME从夜空坠落时，会拖出转瞬即逝的光迹，照亮夜色。光迹消失时，它也会随之消失。
author: dodoowner_
source: As POKENAME falls from the night sky, it leaves an ephemeral trail, which brightens the night sky. By the time the trail fades, so will the Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME从周身的晶体产生雷云，藏起反光的身体。它给后脑的褶膜充分充电，就能像流星般冲出，落地时，迸发出一场雷电爆炸。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME produces thunderclouds from the crystals along its body to hide its reflective form. It supercharges the frills on the back of its head to launch forward like a meteor, creating an explosion of lightning where it lands.

entry: POKENAME还不够强，无法有意制造雷雨，情绪激动时，却可能无意引发。饲养它必须格外谨慎。
author: alestrius
source: POKENAME is not yet strong enough to intentionally create thunderstorms, but may do so accidentally when its emotions surge. Extreme caution is advised when raising this Pokémon.

entry: 神话称，POKENAME能横越整个大陆，沿途留下猛烈雷雨。古人会把肉供在远离住处的地方，将风暴引往别处。
author: alestrius
source: According to myth, POKENAME can run across the span of entire continents, leaving intense thunderstorms in its path. Ancient people used to leave offerings of meat far from their homes to coax the storms elsewhere.

entry: 据说，POKENAME将雷电的迅疾与烈焰的凶猛融于一身。巢穴很容易找，因为周围遍布焦土与巨大的裂痕。
author: infinex21
source: This Pokémon is said to embody the speed and ferocity of lightning and flame, respectively. The den of a POKENAME is easy to spot due to the charred terrain and large gashes that litter the area around.

entry: 对这种宝可梦而言，纯粹的力量就是一切，战法常被形容为令人窒息的压制。它用带电的掌，把猎物打进地里，直到对方一动不动，才肯罢手。
author: xillo
source: Raw power is everything for this Pokémon, with its fighting style often described as oppressive. It beats prey into the ground with charged palms, and does not stop until they lay still.

entry: POKENAME用敏感的须，察觉即将来临的雷雨。它在空中追逐风暴，收集电力，带在自己随身的雷云里。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to sense impending thunderstorms with their sensitive whiskers. They chase after the storms through the sky, gathering electricity to carry with them within their personal storm cloud.

entry: POKENAME用敏感的须，察觉即将来临的雷雨。它在空中追逐风暴，收集电力，带在自己随身的雷云里。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to sense impending thunderstorms with their sensitive whiskers. They chase after the storms through the sky, gathering electricity to carry with them within their personal storm cloud.

entry: POKENAME活跃得过头，很少在一处停留，在海水中疾驰。人们认为，它越健康，头内的雷电就越强。
author: sk372
source: Hyperactive and rarely able to stay in a singular spot, POKENAME zips through the ocean waters at breakneck speed. The lightning in its cranium is believed to be proportional to its health.

entry: 有些POKENAME头顶的圆罩颜色更深，只靠内部的雷电照亮。这些变种明显没那么躁动，却也远不如其他个体友善。
author: sk372
source: Some POKENAME specimens possess a darker cranial dome, illuminated only by the lightning within. These variants are notably less hyperactive, but far less friendly in behavior as well.

entry: 它背上云朵般的毛，总是很热，奔跑时还会更烫。毛间噼啪作响的电力，能由唯一的角引导、释放。
author: infinex21
source: The cloudy fur upon its back is always quite hot, though it becomes even hotter when they are running. Its fur crackles with electricity that it can channel and release from its singular horn.

entry: POKENAME奔跑时，蹄声如雷，身后拖着电光。达到最高速度，鬃毛便会燃起，让攻击能烧灼碰到的一切。
author: fiordaliso
source: As POKENAME gallops, its hooves emit thunderous rumblings, leaving an electric trail in its wake. When it reaches its maximum speed, its mane bursts into flames, giving its attacks the power to burn anything they touch.

entry: POKENAME轻松地以快得目眩的速度，驰骋山脉。战斗时，皮毛与鬃毛噼啪放电，也让背上的鳞片变硬。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME gallop across mountain ranges at blinding speed and with incredible ease. In battle, their coat and mane crackle with electricity, which in turn hardens the scales on their back.

entry: POKENAME轻松地以快得目眩的速度，驰骋山脉。战斗时，皮毛与鬃毛噼啪放电，也让背上的鳞片变硬。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME gallop across mountain ranges at blinding speed and with incredible ease. In battle, their coat and mane crackle with electricity, which in turn hardens the scales on their back.

entry: POKENAME缩进壳里，借雷电推动，远远冲出，高速穿过陆地。不漫游世界时，它喜欢在海边洞穴休息。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME speeds across the land by retracting into its shell and using lightning to propel it forward large distances. It tends to rest in caverns near the ocean when not roaming the world.

entry: POKENAME将庞大的电能化为速度，快得唯有闪电能够比拟，因此鲜少被人看见。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has been seen very rarely since it converts astronomical amounts of electricity into a speed that is only matched by lightning.

entry: 据说，风暴狂乱、不可预测时，就会形成POKENAME。它几乎隐形，漂在风眼中，乘着变幻的风，以闪电为食。
author: lesbian_garlicbread
source: POKENAME are said to form when storms grow wild and unpredictable. This nearly invisible Pokémon drifts in the storm's eye, feeding on lightning as it rides the shifting winds.

entry: POKENAME会找到害怕雷雨的人家，他们正是最适合作祟的对象。它藏在暗处，突然发出猛烈雷鸣般的叫声，惊吓住户。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME finds the homes of those scared by thunderstorms, as they are perfect victims to haunt. It hides in the shadows and terrorizes them with sudden cries that sound like violent, booming thunder.

entry: POKENAME用吐出的细小却炽热的火焰，烤找到的树果。非得烤到焦黑酥脆，它才肯吃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME cooks up berries it finds with small yet intensely hot flames it breathes out. It only eats the berry once it's cooked to a burnt and blackened crisp.

entry: POKENAME最爱独处。若藏在高草里被发现，就会从骨头迸出阵阵火焰，驱赶别人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers solitude above all else. If discovered hiding in tall grass, it erupts with bursts of flame from its bone to drive others away.

entry: POKENAME用自己簇簇白毛裹住骨棒，再吐火点燃。毛簇烧尽要将近半天，因此有些人已用它替代柴火。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use tufts of their own white fur to pad their bone clubs, which they ignite with their breathed flames. These tufts of fur take almost half a day to fully burn away, which is why they have replaced firewood for some people.

entry: POKENAME罕见又行踪隐秘，只能在高山与火山上方的高空找到。它自然散发巨量热，令人很难靠近。
author: nyoomymph
source: Elusive and rare, POKENAME is only ever found high in the sky over tall mountains and volcanoes. POKENAME passively emits massive amounts of heat, making it difficult to stand close to it.

entry: 人们极少在熔岩或极热的水域目击POKENAME。平时虽然独居，若发现人类困在家园里，它就会载着对方，安全渡过滚烫的水或岩浆。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been rarely spotted in areas full of lava or extremely hot waters. Although normally solitary, if it finds stranded humans in its home, it will ferry them safely across the scalding hot waters or magma.

entry: POKENAME生活在熔岩中，据称从远古便已存在。外形虽小，却被认为与世界各地许多火山喷发有关。
author: dahappycute
source: Found living in molten lava, POKENAME is reported to have been alive since ancient times. Despite its rather small appearance, these Pokémon have been linked to causing many volcanic eruptions around the world.

entry: 狩猎与长途飞行之间，POKENAME栖在火山口边，巡视领地。传说，它的咆哮尖啸，能唤醒休眠火山，在叫声响起数小时内，使其喷发。
author: sk372
source: Between hunts and long flights, POKENAME perches on the rims of volcanoes and surveys its territory. Legends say its roaring screech will bring a dormant volcano back to life and make it erupt within hours of its cry.

entry: POKENAME只住在火山口深处。过去人们以为，突然的喷发，正是它打哈欠所致。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are only found living deep inside volcanic craters. Their yawns were once thought to be the cause of sudden eruptions.

entry: POKENAME行踪难觅，一被看见，常会立刻起飞，逃往不知何处。留下的脚印，几分钟后仍会冒烟、闪火花。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is an elusive sort, often taking flight and escaping to parts unknown the minute it is spotted. The footprints it leaves behind smolder and spark for several minutes after being created.

entry: 偏远火山岛的多处遗迹，都描绘着POKENAME。依译文所述，古人因它能让活火山休眠，而将其尊为守护神。
author: sk372
source: A number of ruins on remote volcanic islands depict imagery of POKENAME. According to translations, the ancient people venerated it as a guardian deity due to its ability to turn active volcanoes dormant.

entry: POKENAME能以精神能量，幻出无数燃烧的火焰，主宰战场。即使休眠已久的火山，它也有力量唤醒，使其猛烈喷发。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME dominates its battlefields by conjuring countless burning flames made of psychic energy. It has the power to turn even long-dormant volcanoes active and make them violently erupt.

entry: POKENAME是超新星般宇宙奇观的化身。据说，它知道穿过岩浆通道的秘密路径，有些人甚至相信，它能触及星球核心。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME embodies the cosmic wonder of a supernova. It is said to know secret paths through magma tubes, and some believe it can touch the planet's core.

entry: POKENAME呼出的火山灰，能点燃接触的一切。若火山气味特别浓，就表示附近的火山即将喷发。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's breath emits volcanic ashes that start fires to anything they touch. If its volcanic aroma is especially strong, it means that a nearby volcano is about to erupt.

entry: 不狩猎时，POKENAME会在沉寂火山的口缘内休息。它用过热的丝网捕猎，既困住倒霉的目标，也将其烹熟。
author: sk372
source: When not on the hunt, POKENAME rests within the rims of inactive volcanoes. It captures prey with its super-heated webbing that both ensnares and cooks its unfortunate target.

entry: POKENAME飘行各地，释放的绒絮被视为危险。种子极易燃烧，一碰到地面就会起火，沿途常留下野火。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats across the regions and is considered a danger due to the fluff it releases. The seeds are highly flammable and erupt into flames upon contact with the ground, often leaving wildfires in POKENAME's wake.

entry: POKENAME一生都在前往火山。抵达后，它在火山口产蛋，不久便死去。蛋休眠着，从岩浆中汲取能量，直到喷发将其抛散、震开，新一代由此诞生。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME spend their lives journeying to volcanoes. Upon arrival, they lay their eggs in the crater and die soon after. The eggs stay dormant, gaining energy in the magma, until an eruption scatters and cracks them open, starting the next generation.

entry: POKENAME住在西部地区的沙漠，沐浴落日光芒。太阳沉入地平线时，快乐而悦耳的嚎声，能传到数英里外。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes its home in deserts in western regions, basking in the light of the sunset. Its joyful and melodic howl as the sun vanishes down the horizon can be heard for miles around.

entry: 岁月流逝，POKENAME的头冠会硬化成火山般的结构，不停喷烟、迸火花。它统领火山之地，每一步，都留下冒烟的脚印。
author: eiskitsune
source: Over time, POKENAME's crown hardens into a volcano-like structure, constantly venting smoke and sparks. It reigns over volcanic lands, its every step leaving smoldering footprints in its wake.

entry: POKENAME能从身体召出强大翻腾的火焰。发射向对手，接触留下的灼痕，会和它符号般的身形相同。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is able to conjure up powerful roiling flames from its body. When launched at an opponent, the burns it leaves on contact have the same shape as its own symbol-like form.

entry: POKENAME极其胆小，一看见谁靠近，就立刻逃走。可它实在太慢，逃跑的速度，让自己与旁观者都尴尬不已。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is incredibly skittish, fleeing the moment it spots anyone approaching. Unfortunately it is quite slow, making its escape speed embarrassing for both itself and those watching.

entry: POKENAME喜欢画各类宝可梦，水平有高有低。对作品不满时，它可能愤怒地吠叫；每次一叫，颜料摸起来都会很热。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME enjoy painting various Pokémon, with varying degrees of quality. Should they become frustrated with their artwork, they may bark in anger. Whenever they bark, their paint becomes hot to the touch.

entry: 喷发火山的灰云，浓到开始形成闪电时，有人说，POKENAME就在附近。它一咆哮，周围的火山灰就会被雷电气化。
author: bobosmith01
source: When the clouds of ash from an erupting volcano become so thick that lightning begins to form, some say POKENAME is near. When POKENAME roars, any nearby ash is vaporized by bolts of electricity.

entry: 喷发火山的灰云，浓到开始形成闪电时，有人说，POKENAME就在附近。它一咆哮，周围的火山灰就会被雷电气化。
author: bobosmith01
source: When the clouds of ash from an erupting volcano become so thick that lightning begins to form, some say POKENAME is near. When POKENAME roars, any nearby ash is vaporized by bolts of electricity.

entry: 据说，POKENAME一声咆哮，就能引发猛烈的火山喷发。纯火焰构成的身体极热，不断将空气中的水分化为热蒸汽。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is said that a single roar from POKENAME can trigger violent volcanic eruptions. The extreme heat of its body, made of pure fire, constantly turns the moisture in the air into hot steam.

entry: POKENAME在山脉间跳跃，发出像“叭”一般的轻吠。若足够多的同类同时叫，火山就会猛烈喷发。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME hop around mountain ranges, letting out soft barks that sound like a "bah". If enough POKENAME bark at the same time, volcanoes erupt aggressively.

entry: POKENAME与自身融合后，变得像古老记录中的一头兽。越愤怒，面甲内的火就越热。达到顶峰，它便低头冲锋，将挡路的一切刺穿。
author: jackjirachi
source: Fusing POKENAME with itself has caused it to resemble a beast described in old records. The fire inside its faceplate grows hotter as its temper rises. At its peak, it lowers its head and charges, goring anything in its path.

entry: POKENAME只在火山将喷发前出现，因此，遇见它总令人害怕。若遭到攻击，便喷出大量炽热火山灰，几分钟就能让人窒息。
author: mistymagius
source: Sightings of POKENAME are always feared since they only appear right before a volcanic eruption. If they are attacked, they spew tons of hot ash that can suffocate anyone in minutes.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，会加热藤蔓末端，迸出火星。它用燃烧的藤蔓反复抽打，直到敌人受不了滚烫的痛苦与重重鞭击，认输求饶。
author: soup1900
source: When in battle, POKENAME heats up the ends of its vines to have them release flaming sparks. Using these burning vines, it repeatedly whips foes until they give up and beg for mercy from the scalding pain and slamming lashes.

entry: POKENAME栖身火山周围满是灰烬的岩石荒地，偶尔用爪刨地。刨过的地方，终会长出顽强耐热的草木，开出火红的花。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME inhabits the ashen, rocky wastes around volcanoes, occasionally pawing at the ground. The spots it digs at will eventually grow hardy, heat-resistant foliage that blooms with a fiery red color.

entry: POKENAME只需猛击地面，就能造出大片熔岩流。强劲的双臂，让它在岩浆中，也能如水中一般游动。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can create large lava flows just by slamming the ground. Its powerful arms allow for it to swim through magma as if it were water.

entry: 活火山附近，能见到POKENAME参与祈福仪式，盼望火山喷发。聚集起来时，它们能掌控整片熔岩流。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be found near active volcanoes, participating in ritual blessings in hopes of a volcanic eruption. When they band together, they can control entire lava flows.

entry: POKENAME需要持续关注，否则很快就会烦躁，产生更多烟。愤怒一到顶点，烟就会瞬间燃起，因此让它开心十分重要。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME requires constant attention or it quickly grows frustrated, producing greater quantities of smoke. If its anger peaks, the smoke will ignite at once, so keeping it happy is crucial.

entry: POKENAME控火本领高强，被称为“余烬女皇”。绰号虽吓人，心地却十分善良。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME has been nicknamed "Empress of the Ember" for its pyrokinetic prowess. Even with this intimidating moniker, it is very kindhearted.

entry: POKENAME外形与举止都高贵，极其重视保护训练家。只要有一点敌意，它就会毫不犹豫，让火焰从地面喷发。
author: sk372
source: Regal in both appearance and demeanor, POKENAME takes the protection of its Trainer very seriously. It won't hesitate to conjure eruptions of flame from the ground at even a hint of aggression.

entry: POKENAME的雕像，是怀有怨恨的火神之灵的容器。仔细聆听，能从内部听见火焰的噼啪声。
author: patch_bros
source: The statue of POKENAME is a vessel for a vengeful spirit of a flame deity. If you listen closely, sounds of crackling fire can be heard from within.

entry: POKENAME能感知世界上任何火山数英里内的猎物。随后，它飞到附近一座火山，借喷发之力，以音速朝目标射出。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can sense prey within miles of any volcano in the world. It then flies to a nearby volcano and uses the force of the volcano's eruption to launch itself at sonic speeds towards its target.

entry: 地底深处，满是岩浆的洞穴里，热池升起的烟化成了实体。POKENAME无法离开栖身的火山或热带地区，因为烟雾身体在寒冷气候中会消失。
author: leandermalurt
source: In magma-filled caves deep beneath the earth, the smoke rising from hot pools took on a physical form. POKENAME cannot leave the volcanic or tropical regions where they live, as their smoky bodies would disappear in colder climates.

entry: POKENAME的鬃毛由流动的烟构成，能变形，化作张开的大嘴捕捉猎物。它先用烟雾吞没敌人，再使出决定性的一击。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME's mane is made of flowing smoke, capable of shifting shape and forming a gaping maw to capture prey. It engulfs foes in its haze before delivering a decisive strike.

entry: 据说，POKENAME驰过夜空时，如活生生的火焰般发光。过去人们相信，哪怕只匆匆瞥见，也能让目击者的内心永远温暖。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is said to glow like living flame while racing across night skies. Even a brief sighting was believed to grant eternal emotional warmth to witnesses.

entry: POKENAME强大而骄傲，很难接受失败。压力大时，它会胡乱喷火，因此闹脾气时，训练家得给予支持。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are strong yet prideful Pokémon and have a hard time dealing with failure. They are known to haphazardly shoot flames when they are stressed, so Trainers need to support them whenever they get temper tantrums.

entry: 最初的POKENAME，铸成于岩浆之中。据说，它附着火山的灵魂；剑一出鞘，另一座火山便会喷发。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The first POKENAME was forged in magma. It is said that it's possessed by the spirit of a volcano, and when it unsheathes, another volcano erupts.

entry: 这只美得惊人的宝可梦，仿佛热情的化身，常出现在火山温泉旁。传说有位造物之神，守护着水火交会的温泉，有人便认为，POKENAME是祂的化身。
author: alkazamis
source: This stunningly beautiful Pokémon embodies passion. It is typically found near volcanic hot springs. Legends tell of a creator deity that is a patron of hot springs, where fire and water meet, and some people believe POKENAME is that deity's avatar.

entry: POKENAME每次翱翔天空，都被视为火山即将喷发的警讯。它的咆哮，半个地区都能听见。
author: wiseginseng
source: Whenever POKENAME soars through the sky, it is seen as a warning that a volcano is about to erupt. Its roar can be heard throughout half of a region.

entry: POKENAME以体热产生蒸汽云，制造幻象，向人类隐藏自己的藏身处。战斗中若受重伤，它会退进火山，直到完全康复。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its body heat allows POKENAME to generate clouds of steam, which it uses to create illusions that conceal its hiding spots from humans. When seriously wounded in battle, it retreats inside volcanoes until it has fully recovered.

entry: POKENAME穿行草原时，会释放类似烧焦蔬菜的气味，让半径100米内的所有对象平静下来。若被发现，这份平静通常足以让旁观者迟缓不动，方便它逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a scent similar to burnt vegetables while traveling through grasslands, calming everyone within a 100-meter radius. This calmness typically causes enough inactivity in onlookers for it to flee if spotted.

entry: 有故事说，POKENAME全力咆哮，就会让最近的火山喷发，至今却未证实。它在火山内外筑巢，会挑战一切靠领地太近的宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: Stories claim that when POKENAME roars with all its might, the nearest volcano will erupt. While this has yet to be proven, POKENAME nests within and around volcanoes and challenges any Pokémon that comes too near to its territory.

entry: POKENAME开炮时，声如活火山刚刚喷发。装上某些卡带，就能将炽烈火弹，变成足以熔开地面的岩浆射线。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME fires its cannon, the blasts sound like the boom from an active volcano that has just erupted. Having some drives attached to POKENAME can turn its burning fire shots into ground-melting lava rays.

entry: 这种强大的宝可梦，一年大半时间都藏在火山里，只在前往新居时被人看见。POKENAME的怒火是否与捷克罗姆相当，惹怒后又会怎样，目前都不清楚。
author: thistleblower
source: A mighty Pokémon, it hides itself in volcanoes for most of the year. It has only been seen when it travels to its next home. It is currently unknown if POKENAME has an anger comparable to Zekrom and what will happen if it's provoked.

entry: POKENAME偶尔会随熔岩一起喷上天空，因此过去被认为诞生于火山喷发。其实，它们在空洞中繁殖，喷发时才被冲出来。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME were once believed to have been created by volcanic eruptions, as they are occasionally seen blasting into the air along with molten lava. Instead, they breed in empty chambers and are flushed out during eruptions.

entry: POKENAME纤细的双臂由岩浆构成，靠精神能量维系。挥臂的力道，足以切开坚实钢铁，边切边熔化金属。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's thin arms are made of magma, held together by psychic energy. POKENAME can swing them with enough force to slice through solid steel, melting the metal as it cuts it.

entry: POKENAME很少被看见，传闻是强大传说之龙的幼体。它钻过火山岩，极高的体温，留下一片壁面如玻璃般的蜂窝状隧道。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Rarely seen, POKENAME is rumored to be the larval form of a mighty legendary Dragon. They burrow through volcanic rocks, leaving a honeycomb of glassy-sided tunnels from their extremely high-temperature bodies.

entry: 据说，POKENAME是遥远火山的年轻守护者。说法源于它极其捍卫领地，会向闯入者注毒，让皮下产生强烈的灼烧感。
author: fireflower20002
source: POKENAME are said to be the young guardians of distant volcanoes. This is derived from the fact that POKENAME are very aggressive about their territory, injecting any trespassers with a poison that can cause an intense burning feeling under the skin.

entry: POKENAME十分强大，据说能以尖叫令火山喷发。与敌人近距离相对时，它会冲过去，试图用角将其刺穿。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME are mighty Pokémon who are said to be able to make volcanoes erupt with their screams. When POKENAME are in close range of an enemy, they charge it and try to pierce through their foes with their horns.

entry: POKENAME袭击后的幸存者，也常被伤得面目全非。它先给目标覆上霜，再喷出极热火焰，让霜化成蒸汽，全身都遭受痛苦的烫伤。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Victims who survive POKENAME's attacks are often horribly disfigured. POKENAME often attacks by coating their target in frost before erupting super-hot fire onto them, causing the frost to turn to steam and causing agonising scalds across the body.

entry: 常青森林的幼年宝可梦，害怕体型更大、年纪更长的同伴，反而会向POKENAME请教，因为小巧的身形令它们安心。它常会教小家伙，如何应对带火的敌人。
author: theaceofhearts0306
