source: Intimidated by the larger and older Pokémon of Viridian Forest, baby Pokémon will seek POKENAME for guidance instead, as they are comfortable with its small size. POKENAME will often teach baby Pokémon how to handle a fiery foe.

entry: POKENAME吃熔岩，让身体保持液态。体温一低，便黏稠得动弹不得。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME feeds on lava to keep its body in a liquid state. If its body temperature gets too low, its body becomes so viscous that it can no longer move.

entry: POKENAME最近才被目击，是穿过帕底亚时间裂缝而来的宝可梦，被认为来自遥远的过去。身体不断喷出过热烟汽，像云一样缠在周身。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A recently sighted Pokémon that has come through time rifts in Paldea, POKENAME are thought to be from the distant past. Their bodies produce constant plumes of superheated smoke and steam that cling to them like clouds.

entry: POKENAME一天大多悠闲放松，等待正午。中午一到，它们便嚎叫、结成大群，追踪当天的餐食。突然迸发的精力，如火山骤然喷发。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME will remain relaxed for most of the day, waiting for midday. At noon, POKENAME will howl and form large packs, tracking down their meal for the day. This explosive burst of energy evokes the sudden eruption of a volcano.

entry: 据说，看POKENAME跳舞，如同看见火山烟乘风流动。这种形态的歌，流露着优雅与谦和。
author: pokopish
source: Seeing POKENAME dance is said to be like witnessing volcanic smoke on the wind's current. In this form, its song exudes grace and modesty.

entry: POKENAME动作流畅，稳定而有节制，却会在最出其不意时，迸发野性。这种形态的歌，热烈得宛如喷发的火山。
author: pokopish
source: POKENAME displays flowing moves that are steady and controlled, but wild when one least expects. In this form, its song exhibits an intensity not unlike an erupting volcano.

entry: POKENAME通常在热液喷口附近冥想，或搜寻残食。人们认为，它以火神蛾与海兔兽的融合体，以及其他深海宝可梦为食。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are typically found meditating around hydrothermal vents or scavenging. It is believed that they feed on Volcatrodon and other Pokémon that live deep underwater.

entry: POKENAME的镰刀尖端，热如熔岩，斩到哪里，哪里就会留下灼痛的烧伤。它还能用烟，伪装出更多大簇白毛，让自己显得更庞大威严。
author: soup1900
source: The tips of POKENAME's sickles are as hot as lava, giving anything POKENAME slashes a painful, searing burn. It can make itself appear a lot bigger and grander by using smoke to look like more tufts of its big white hair.

entry: POKENAME的鬃毛，嘶嘶冒着过热蒸汽。传说，每处温泉，都有一只守护它的POKENAME。
author: ozydamians
source: POKENAME's mane fizzes with super-heated steam. Legends say that every hot spring has a guardian POKENAME to protect it.

entry: POKENAME射出烟雾手里剑，让战场充满烟，再借烟雾掩护，向对手喷发岩浆。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME can fire smoke shurikens that fill the arena with smoke. POKENAME then uses the smoky arena to fire magma blasts at opponents.

entry: POKENAME的身体能变化，重现第一只炎帝诞生时，那座燃烧的高塔。有些城都民众，对它十分敬重。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's body can transform to reflect the burning tower where the first Entei came to be. Some Johtonian folk treat it with great reverence.

entry: 据说，某个秋日节庆的精神，能增强POKENAME的火焰。看见玩“不给糖就捣蛋”的人，头顶的火就会烧得格外明亮。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: POKENAME's fire is said to be strengthened by the spirit of a certain autumn holiday. Whenever it sees trick-or-treaters, the flame on top of its head blazes brightly.

entry: POKENAME在火山附近筑巢，成群飞舞于破火山口的熔岩周围。火山学家借它判断是否会喷发，因为同处聚集的群体越大，火山活动也越强。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME nest around volcanoes, fluttering in swarms around the lava in the caldera. Vulcanologists use them as a guide on whether or not to expect an eruption, as larger swarms of POKENAME in one place correspond to increased volcanic activity.

entry: POKENAME华美飘逸的鬃毛，在身后空中荡漾。飞到最高速度，鬃毛便会燃烧，化为彗尾般绚烂的火迹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a luxurious flowing mane that ripples in the air behind it. When flying at its maximum speed, the mane ignites and turns into a vibrant fiery trail akin to a comet's tail.

entry: POKENAME在火山下钻行，挖穿火山岩与岩浆。庞大群落同时挖掘，可能引发喷发，因此当地社区会尽一切努力，阻止它们靠近。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME burrow beneath volcanoes, tunneling through volcanic rock and magma. Large colonies of these Pokémon digging at once can trigger eruptions, so local communities do everything they can to keep them away.

entry: 只要足够专注、意志够强，POKENAME就能引发火山喷发。这常让它一直屏住呼吸，直到喷发为止；太过用力，便会头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of causing volcanic eruptions with enough focus and will. This often results in them holding their breath until the eruption occurs, which causes headaches if they strain too hard.

entry: POKENAME越愤怒，身体就越热，直到双拳都被火焰包裹。拳头的热量，几乎能达到熔融岩浆的温度。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME's rage burns hotter, so does its body, to the point its fists will become enveloped in flames. The heat of these punches can nearly reach the temperature of molten magma.

entry: POKENAME只需弯一下汤匙，就能按意愿，让火山喷发。许多个体整天窝在偏远洞穴，冥想火山的毁灭本性。
author: quackquackattack
source: With a single bend of the spoon, POKENAME can force volcanoes to erupt on command. Many spend their days holed up in remote caverns, meditating on the destructive nature of volcanoes.

entry: 节庆游行中，有时能见到POKENAME领着队伍前进。它每次咆哮，手中面具的鼻子，就会呼出烟。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can sometimes be found at festival parades, leading the procession. Whenever they roar, the mask they carry exhales smoke from its nose.

entry: POKENAME会引发海底火山喷发，再藏在火山灰里，用多条腿扑向好奇前来查看新岛的生物。吃饱后，它便返回现身时经过的海底岩浆网络。
author: ludacriswell
source: POKENAME is known to trigger underwater volcanic eruptions. Hiding amongst ash, it uses its many legs to pounce upon any life curious enough to inspect its newly born island. After fed, POKENAME returns to the submarine magma network it emerged from.

entry: POKENAME高速驰骋大地。传闻它一嘶鸣，火山就会喷发。皮毛温度很高，身后烟雾滚滚。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME gallops across the land at high speeds. Rumours say that when it whinnies, volcanoes erupt. Its coat is so warm that smoke billows behind it.

entry: POKENAME把尾巴浸进熔岩池，吸收矿物，强健身体。它耐心泡上数小时，享受热量，每泡一次，就更坚韧。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME dips its tail into pools of lava to absorb minerals that strengthen its body. It spends hours patiently soaking in the heat, becoming tougher with each session.

entry: 岁月流逝，POKENAME吸收的矿物，形成了一座有意识的火山，如今被它悉心抱在怀里。双方联系深厚，默契地一同移动，散发强烈的热。
author: eiskitsune
source: Over time, the minerals POKENAME absorbed formed a sentient volcano, which it now cradles with great care. The two share a deep connection, radiating intense heat as they move in perfect harmony.

entry: POKENAME始终带着一根奇异的细棍。沿地拖动，擦过的地方便会冒火，帮助掩护它敏捷地逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries a strange wispy stick with it at all times. Dragging the stick along the ground causes fire to erupt from the scraped area, which it uses to help cover its quick-footed escape.

entry: POKENAME常藏在火山喷出的烟柱间，掩盖行踪，因此野外很难发现。也偶尔有记录，见到它在工厂烟囱附近，以同样方式藏身。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is difficult to spot in the wild, as it often masks its movements by hiding among plumes of smoke emitted from volcanoes. It has occasionally been observed hiding in a similar fashion near factory smokestacks.

entry: 浓烟从活火山顶涌起时，POKENAME便成群现身。身体由火山烟构成，若不进化，最终就会消散，只剩纯粹的灰。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: When smoke billows from the top of an active volcano, POKENAME emerge in droves. Their bodies are made of volcanic smoke, which eventually dissolves into pure ash if POKENAME does not evolve.

entry: POKENAME被发现后，更喜欢挥爪快游，从海里逃走。若真被逼入绝境，它就用极烫的钳子，夹击敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers to flee through the sea if spotted, using its claws to swim at great speed. If ever cornered, it pinches foes with intensely hot claws.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，会用蒸汽加热自己的身体，让壳与钳子闪闪发亮。每次过热的挥击，钳子都会喷出一团团白热蒸汽。
author: griddle
source: POKENAME steams its own body during battle, causing its shell and claw to brightly glow. Plumes of white-hot steam billow from its claw with every superheated swing.

entry: 野外作战，POKENAME向对手吐出乌黑的水，令其晕头转向，再将其解决。它只在净水中进化，因此会清洁遇见的一切水域，连战场也不例外。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When POKENAME battles in the wild, it spits inky water at opponents to disorient them before finishing them off. It only evolves in clean water, so POKENAME cleans all water it comes across, including battle sites.

entry: POKENAME游得极快，会从吻部喷出水流，击晕敌人，再将其冻在原地。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME is an incredibly fast swimmer. It shoots jets of water from its snout to stun foes then freezes them in place.

entry: 冰爪极其锋利，刃口仅3微米宽。即便如此，这些利刃仍几乎无法损坏。
author: gp423
source: Its icy claws are so sharp, the edges are a mere three micrometers wide. Despite this, these blades are virtually indestructible.

entry: POKENAME只住在最洁净的水中，通常见于山泉内外。它能净化栖身的水域，因此很受水族馆欢迎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in only the cleanest waters and are typically found in and around mountain springs. They have a purifying effect on the bodies of water they live in, making them a popular addition to aquariums.

entry: POKENAME守护广阔水域，不容任何污染。它平时沉静，一旦水受到玷污，POKENAME便会狂怒。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME protects large bodies of water from any form of pollution. Despite usually being a calm Pokémon, POKENAME will fly into a frenzy if its water becomes tainted.

entry: POKENAME只出现在北方荒野，那里水质纯净，没有毒素。据说，嚎唱的歌声，连最不动声色的人，也会听得心头震动。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is only found in the northern wilds where the water is pure and free of toxins. Its howling song is said to shake the heart of even the most stone-faced of humans.

entry: POKENAME游到哪里，就留下一道清新洁净的水迹，却也能、且常会完全消失在水面之下。见过的人说，它常被误认成童话里的美人鱼。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: A trail of fresh clean water will follow POKENAME wherever they swim, however, they can and often will vanish completely under the water's surface. Those that have seen them claim they can often become confused for mermaids from fairytales.

entry: POKENAME往设备上呕水时，设备竟不会短路，系统中的数据错误反而神秘消失。难听的干呕声，据称会吓到旁观者。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME vomits water onto a device, the system is mysteriously cleansed of corruption rather than short-circuited. The unpleasant retching sound has been reported to startle onlookers.

entry: POKENAME只住在最洁净的水中，通常见于山泉内外。它能净化栖身的水域，因此很受水族馆欢迎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in only the cleanest waters and are typically found in and around mountain springs. They have a purifying effect on the bodies of water they live in, making them a popular addition to aquariums.

entry: 传说，乌黑风暴随北风而来，都是POKENAME惹的祸。其实，它正在吸走全部闪电，让风暴不再造成伤害，以此“净化”风暴。
author: soup1900
source: Legends say that when dark storms come with the north wind, POKENAME is the one to blame. In reality, they are actually the ones "purifying" these storms by absorbing all the lightning so that the storms don't create any harm.

entry: 传说，乌黑风暴随北风而来，都是POKENAME惹的祸。其实，它正在将风暴化作平和宁静的云，以此“净化”风暴。
author: soup1900
source: Legends say that when dark storms come with the north wind, POKENAME is the one to blame. In reality, they are actually the ones "purifying" these storms by turning them into calm and peaceful clouds.

entry: POKENAME只扇一下翅膀，就能迅速提高湿度与温度，因此常引发热带风暴。虽然能召雨，它却害怕闪电，一听见雷声，就会逃走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are often responsible for tropical storms, as they can rapidly increase the humidity and temperature with a single flap of the wing. Despite their ability to summon rain, they are scared of lightning and flee if they hear thunder.

entry: POKENAME占据纯净的泉水，静静生活。谁侵扰了这份清静，就会遭到凶猛攻击。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME claim pure springs of water as their territory and dwell there quietly. They fiercely attack anyone who intrudes on their serenity.

entry: 被POKENAME触碰、净化的水，会发出微微闪光。水带有它的一部分力量，喝下后，能暂时获得少许超能力。
author: sk372
source: Waters purified by POKENAME's touch emit a faint sparkling glow. Imbued with some of its powers, drinking this water grants a person a small measure of temporary psychic power.

entry: 它行踪难觅，据说只会出现在刚踏上旅程的训练家面前。转动缎带般的附肢，就能让波浪开始涌向岸边。
author: bobosmith01
source: An elusive Pokémon said to only appear to Trainers that have just started their journey. If it twirls its ribbon-like appendages around, it can cause waves to start rolling ashore.

entry: POKENAME以特殊食谱闻名，只吃晒过太阳，或垂入湖海中的叶子。它会伸出缎带，够取这些讲究的食物。
author: leandermalurt
source: POKENAME are famous for their special diet. They only eat leaves that have been touched by sunlight or have hung down into a lake or sea. They use their ribbons to reach these exclusive leaves.

entry: 它的小角摸起来冰凉，似乎能调节自身的各种能量。若超过一天找不到淡水，就会大发脾气，角上不断放电。
author: infinex21
source: Its small horn is cool to the touch and seems to be what allows it to regulate any of its energy. It throws a fit if it cannot find fresh water for over a day and will discharge electricity from its horn during its fit.

entry: POKENAME常住在渔镇的码头与小渔船间，吃渔民剩下的鱼饵。它在水面跳跃，沿途常留下少量净水。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME are frequently found in fishing towns, living among docks and small fishing boats to eat leftover bait from fishermen. They will hop across the surface of the water, often leaving small amounts of purified water behind.

entry: POKENAME窥视未来时，总是神情忧郁。人们认为，这是因为它看见的未来里，日益严重的海洋塑料污染与化学废物倾倒问题，始终没有得到解决。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME always has a somber look on its face when it views into the future. This is thought to be because it sees no future where the increasing marine plastic pollution and chemical dumping into seas gets rectified.

entry: POKENAME把全部电力储存在飘逸的鬃毛里，再传向长缎带，大幅挥扫，赶走栖身净水湖附近的闯入者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME houses all of its electricity within its flowing mane. Transferring that energy to its lengthy ribbons lets it unleash them in a wide arc and clear out intruders near the pure-water lakes around which it lives.

entry: POKENAME的微光，不足以充当灯塔，却仍在海上漫游，寻找需要帮助的对象。许多迷路水手与遇难者，都说全靠它，才能回家。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME's faint light is not enough to serve as a beacon, but it roams the seas looking for those in need. Many lost sailors and castaways credit POKENAME as the only way they were able to return home.

entry: 它飘行于空气最冷的高层大气，所在之处，会形成雨云与雪云。
author: hophoppip
source: It drifts in the upper atmosphere, where the air is coldest. Its presence causes rain and snow clouds to form.

entry: POKENAME住在沼泽，为免水质令自己生病，会分泌吸收周围所有毒素的凝胶。凝胶缓缓分解，必须替换，届时毒素便会重新释放到水里。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME live in swamps, and to prevent them from getting ill from the water they excrete a gel that absorbs all the toxins around them. This gel slowly breaks down and must be replaced, at which point the toxins are released back into the water.

entry: POKENAME用触蔓净化湖区，片刻就能除掉污物与污染。它这样做，并非天生无私，只是觉得清水看起来更漂亮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its tendrils to purify lake areas, removing filth and pollution in a few moments' time. It does this not for inherent altruism, but simply because it finds clearer water prettier to look at.

entry: POKENAME是高贵优雅的兽，但缎带上的副脑，却是一群永远吃不饱的捣蛋鬼，让它很难管住。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME is a noble, elegant beast. The secondary brains on its ribbons, though, are perpetually hungry mischief-makers that it struggles to keep in line.

entry: POKENAME优雅地滑过平静的湖面，景象美不胜收。它的滑行技巧，启发了许多花样滑冰选手。
author: mistymagius
source: Seeing a POKENAME is a sight to behold as they gracefully skate across tranquil lakes. Its skating prowess has inspired many figure skaters.

entry: POKENAME美丽而狡猾，能轻松跑过大地，还会偷走遇见的一切蛋与食物。据说，古时的滑冰，正是从它得来灵感。
author: m1918_94884
source: Beautiful and cunning, POKENAME runs across the land with ease and is known to steal any eggs or food it finds. It is said that in ancient times, POKENAME was the inspiration behind ice skating.

entry: 受污染的水源会吸引POKENAME。它附在污染源头，开始吸取污染物；若在脏水里待得太久，就会脱离，将杂质射向自己认定的肇事者。
author: thesilverowls
source: Impure sources of water attract POKENAME, which latch onto the point of origin and begin to intake the pollutants. If left in the dirty water for too long, they detach and fire the impurities at whoever they view as responsible for the filth.

entry: 连接设备及其网络后，POKENAME通常会研究、浏览有关净水方法的网页。越来越信任训练家后，搜索的范围就会大幅拓展。
author: bobosmith01
source: When connected to a device and associated network, POKENAME typically spends its time researching and pulling up webpages on the methods of water purification. When it grows to trust its Trainer, its searches begin to broaden dramatically.

entry: POKENAME用优雅的嘴触碰水域，就能清除全部污染，让水重归透明。传说，淡紫色的鬃毛，摸起来比任何天鹅绒都顺滑。
author: fiordaliso
source: Should POKENAME touch a body of water with its elegant mouth, the creature can cleanse away all pollutants and renew the water to its former transparency. Legend tells that its lavender-colored mane feels smoother than any velvet.

entry: 传说，POKENAME是风暴怒火的化身。强大的咆哮只需一声，就足以召来倾盆暴雨，与威力空前的闪电。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to legend, POKENAME is said to embody the fury of the storm. A single one of its mighty roars is said to be enough to unleash torrential rains and lightning bolts of unprecedented power.

entry: POKENAME储存的电，从两个放电点释放。对水使用时，能电除杂质，却不知为何，不会伤害其中自然生长的生物。
author: soup1900
source: Electricity stored inside of POKENAME is emitted from its two electric points. When this electricity is used on water, it shocks away any impurities while somehow becoming harmless to the natural wildlife living inside the water.

entry: POKENAME储存的电，从两个放电点释放。对水使用时，能电除杂质，却不知为何，不会伤害其中自然生长的生物。
author: soup1900
source: Electricity stored inside of POKENAME is emitted from its two electric points. When this electricity is used on water, it shocks away any impurities while somehow becoming harmless to the natural wildlife living inside the water.

entry: 人们相信，POKENAME是极光本质的化身，光凭气场，就能平息最凶猛的风暴。传说一滴泪，就能净化整片流域的一切污染。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is believed that POKENAME embodies the very essence of the aurora, and that its aura alone can calm even the fiercest of storms. According to legend, a single tear from POKENAME could purify an entire water basin from any form of pollution.

entry: POKENAME飞过夜空，美丽的极光随之形成，照亮夜色。据说，它的出现标志冬季的开始与结束，为目击者带来好运。
author: santon5512
source: Beautiful auroras form in the sky as POKENAME fly above, lighting up the night. Their presence is said to signal the beginning and end of winter, bringing good fortune to those who witness them.

entry: POKENAME穿梭时间，留下鬃毛上的彩色花瓣，净化自然与水。人们认为，它是在防止一个连自己也无法修复的污染未来。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME travels through time and leaves behind colorful petals from its mane that purify nature and water. It is believed it does this to prevent a polluted future that not even it could fix.

entry: POKENAME用缎带般的触须，从水中吸收营养。附近没有淡水，就会代谢电力维生。对迷途或受伤的人与宝可梦，它都怀有深切的怜悯。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME absorb nutrients from water through their ribbon-like feelers, or they metabolize electricity if there is no freshwater nearby. They display immense compassion for the lost or the injured, be they human or Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用自身电流除去水中污染物的能力，已经证实。许多个体仍参与各类研究，帮助寻找更有效、更洁净的抗污染方法。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have been proven to be able to use their own electric currents to remove pollutants from water. Many POKENAME are still being used in myriad studies to find more effective and clean ways to counter water pollution.

entry: 秋末，POKENAME会前来，以冰寒触碰水域。被它冻结的河流，春天解冻后，便能为余下一年提供净水。
author: feykrow
source: POKENAME come at the end of autumn to touch the waters with their frozen chill. When rivers frozen by POKENAME thaw in the spring, they provide pure water for the rest of the year.

entry: POKENAME掠过水面，身后拖着的缎带，沿途净水。若发现谁破坏净水，就会迅速振翅，发出声波冲击，留下北极光般的轨迹。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME skims along the surface of waters with its ribbons trailing behind and purifying them. If it notices anyone harming clean water, it rapidly beats its wings to blast them with sonic waves that leave a trail reminiscent of the aurora borealis.

entry: POKENAME总随北风滑翔，若被吹离，就会修正方向。飞驰天际时，它会俯冲而下，用长尾净化遇见的污水。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME always glide with the north winds, correcting their course if they are blown off them. As they race across the sky, they will swoop down and use their long tail to purify any filthy water they come across.

entry: POKENAME栖在冰川上，守望苔原。它能把周身缎带凝成锐利长矛，一击就能粉碎大片冰层。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Perched atop glaciers, POKENAME watches over the tundra. It can solidify the ribbons around its body into sharp spears that can shatter through sheets of ice in one blow.

entry: POKENAME偏爱吞食网上与淡水源有关的数据，包括文字、图像与视频。许多人推测，它喜欢这类数据的滋味；也有人认为，它在寻找网络之外可净化的水源。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers to consume data online related to freshwater sources, including text, image, and video files. Many theorize it is drawn to the perceived flavor, while others believe it is searching for water sources to purify outside the web.

entry: 背上的球状突起，再生得极快，它常将其甩向敌人，撞上便爆出寒气。它还能以水流推动尾巴，再用寒风，使其像钻头般旋转。
author: infinex21
source: The bulbs on its back regenerate so quickly that it will often fling them at foes, which will release a burst of frigid air on impact. It can launch its tail with a stream of water and spin it like a drill using frigid gusts.

entry: 神出鬼没的POKENAME能在各地瞬间移动，用缎带净化湖泊与河床，让其重归洁净。据说，只有真正尊重自然的对象，才获准靠近。
author: sk372
source: The illusive POKENAME is known to teleport across the lands, using its ribbons to purify lakes and riverbeds and make them pristine again. It is said to only allow those who truly respect nature to approach it.

entry: 平静时，POKENAME肘部的缎带像水般流动荡漾。一旦战斗，就会变硬变尖，化为武器，挥出剃刀般锋利的水刃，划过空中。
author: sk372
source: When at ease, the ribbons on POKENAME's elbows flow and ripple like water. Once in combat, they harden and sharpen into weapons that can cut razor-sharp blades of water through the air.

entry: POKENAME只有察觉水质严重污染，才会从石中现身，受驱使般以一触净化。有些住在湖底，光凭存在，就能让湖水永远纯净。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME only emerges from its stone when it senses highly polluted water, compelled to purify it with a single touch. Some reside at the bottom of lakes, keeping them eternally pristine with their presence.

entry: 臂上的缠带，让它至少能感知一英里外其他生物的波导。据说，一记发劲，就能净化被击中者的波导与灵魂。
author: infinex21
source: The wraps upon its arms allow it to sense the auras of others for at least one mile away. One Force Palm from this Pokémon is said to cleanse the aura and soul of whoever it strikes.

entry: POKENAME飘动的毛发，像一道极光束。将它放进任何水域，水的成分就会不知为何，变得完全适合太古羽虫等古代水生宝可梦生存。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: POKENAME has waving hair that resembles an Aurora Beam. If it is placed in any body of water, somehow, the water composition will change to perfectly align to what is needed for the survival of Anorith and other ancient aquatic Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME耐心而沉稳。据说很久以前，它曾用强健的头冠推动冰川，横越大地，开辟新的河道。
author: genesisparallax
source: POKENAME is a patient, stoic Pokémon. It is said that long ago, it used its powerful crown to push glaciers across the land and carve new rivers.

entry: 大灾难发生一段时间后，POKENAME会出现在有水的地方。它用力量清理现场，把四散的水送回该去的地方，同时净化。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears in watery locations sometime after great disasters have struck. It uses its power to clean up the area, moving loose water back where it belongs and purifying it in the process.

entry: POKENAME头上的晶体，接收据说来自亡者世界的怪信号。信号引它前往污水，再用双手射出的冰冻光束，净化水质。
author: pattybgoode
source: The crystal on POKENAME's head receives strange signals that are said to be from beyond the grave. The signals lead it to polluted waters which it purifies with the Ice Beam it blasts from its hands.

entry: POKENAME觉得受到敬仰时，就会骄傲地巡视一方。期间，周围广大范围内的水，都会被彻底净化。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME feels revered, it proudly patrols an area. During this time, all nearby water within a vast radius is completely purified.

entry: POKENAME站在闪亮的冰山上，守望、指挥附近的小型宝可梦。上陆时，它会凿下冰块，制成庇护所，安置迷失于寒地的生灵。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME stand atop gleaming icebergs to watch over and command the smaller Pokémon in the area. When they travel onto land, they carve out blocks of ice to form into shelters for those lost in the cold.

entry: POKENAME借缎带乘北风而行，寻找蓄水之地，再将剑刃浸入其中，净化水源。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME rides the north wind with its ribbon in search of water reservoirs. It rests its blade in them to purify them.

entry: 传说，POKENAME只需振翅，就能恢复沙漠绿洲。身体上的白缎带，还能察觉将至的沙暴。
author: fiordaliso
source: Legends say POKENAME can restore desert oasis simply by vibrating its wings. The white ribbons on its body can sense approaching sandstorms.

entry: 有些文化相信，POKENAME是沙漠绿洲之灵。据说，它与梦歌仙人掌合作，漫游世界各处沙漠，恢复遭污染的水源。
author: fiordaliso
source: In some cultures, POKENAME is believed to be the spirit of desert oasis. With the cooperation of Cacturne, it is said to roam all the deserts of the world to restore water sources that have been polluted.

entry: POKENAME以美丽优雅闻名，许多城堡画作都有它的身影。可一被发现，它就像北风般跑走，因此画家对它的特征，往往各有诠释。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: Famed for its beauty and elegance, POKENAME is featured in many castle paintings. Because it runs like the north wind when it's spotted, artists often have different interpretations of its features.

entry: POKENAME天生富有同情心，对年幼的人类与宝可梦尤其如此。触须一浸进水里，就知道水有多干净，因此成为许多宝可梦巡护员的宝贵伙伴。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are inherently compassionate, especially toward young humans and young Pokémon. By dipping their feelers into water, they can tell how clean it is; this makes them valuable partners to many Pokémon Rangers.

entry: POKENAME把附肢浸入脏水，便能用特殊气场净化。它释放的气场，以能安抚他人著称，连暴走的暴鲤龙，也能平静下来。
author: infinex21
source: By submerging its appendages in dirty water, POKENAME is able to purify the water with a special aura. The aura released by this Pokémon is known for being able to calm others, even a rampaging Gyarados.

entry: POKENAME飞过天空，身后便会形成雨云。历史上，干旱时人们曾举行仪式，盼能将它引来。
author: cait_sith
source: As it flies through the sky, rainclouds form in its wake. Historically, humans have performed rituals during droughts in hopes of attracting a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME穿行夜色，寻找受恶梦困扰的人。据说，找到后，它就把梦牵过捕梦网，滤去其中的一切负面情绪。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME flies through the night, seeking out those with troubled dreams. Upon finding such a person it will supposedly pull their dreams through its dreamcatcher, stripping them of any negative emotions.

entry: 飞行模式下，POKENAME周围环绕带电粒子，像极光一样发亮。炮口能猛烈释放这些粒子，景象美丽，破坏力却很强。
author: imaginita
source: In its flight configuration, POKENAME becomes surrounded by charged particles, making it glow like the polar lights. Its cannon can let loose a blast of these charged particles in a beautiful but destructive display.

entry: POKENAME在发现的各种水域里嬉水，所在之处，水也缓缓净化。受到威胁，它会从多条尾巴，造出小小的滚烫水球。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME splashes around in any body of water it finds, its presence within slowly purifying the water. It creates small orbs of scalding hot water from its many tails when it feels threatened.

entry: POKENAME头上的晶体很美，却别试着夺走。受到威胁，它会露出布下的真身，令许多对象因恐惧，陷入昏迷。
author: lootererswillbeboated
source: The crystal on POKENAME's head is very beautiful, but one should not try to take it. If threatened, it reveals its true identity under the cloth, sending many into fear-induced comas.

entry: POKENAME背倚北风，游历世界，每条尾巴后都拖着极光。谁故意当着它污染水域，就会被施以九种诅咒之一。
author: badwolf6066
source: POKENAME traverses the world with the north wind at its back, each of its tails trailing an aurora. Should someone purposely pollute a body of water before it, one of nine curses shall be placed upon them.

entry: 等待进化时，它只靠水与藻类维生。巨大的壳状板中空，装满空气，让它能浮在水面。
author: cait_sith
source: It only subsists on water and algae while it awaits evolution. Its massive shell-like plates are hollow and full of air, allowing it to float on the water's surface.

entry: 富有同情心的POKENAME，会变形伪装，潜进人类城市，净化污染的水源。如果看见一个孩子静静坐在河边，那或许就是它。
author: imaginita
source: This compassionate Pokémon uses its shapeshifting abilities to slip into human cities in disguise and purify polluted water sources.  If you see a child sitting silently at the edge of a river, that may be a POKENAME in disguise.

entry: 据说，POKENAME会给湖边村落带来雨水。若有人辜负信任，污染湖泊，它就唤来巨型暴雨，将整片地方淹没。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is said to bring rain to villages that surround its lake. If anyone betrays its trust by ruining its lakes, it will summon massive rainstorms to completely flood the area.

entry: 野外曾有记录，看见POKENAME绕着肮脏湖池的边缘跳舞。舞一结束，水面就升起大量浓蒸汽；蒸汽一散，污水便已清澈如初。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been observed in the wild dancing around the edges of dirty lakes and ponds. Once its dance ends, copious amounts of thick steam rise from the water's surface, and once it dissipates, the filthy water is pristine.

entry: 若有谁扰乱POKENAME栖息的湖，它便收起沉静姿态，召来溺亡者的灵魂，诅咒闯入者。
author: glacierwing
source: If anything disturbs the lake where POKENAME lives, it will drop its calm demeanor and call on the spirits of the drowned to curse the trespasser.

entry: POKENAME偏爱独居，住在远离文明的深海洞穴。据说，若有人打扰，其故乡就会被诅咒，遭受永无止境的倾盆大雨。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME prefers solitude, dwelling in deep-sea caverns far from civilization. It's said that if a human disturbs it, their hometown will be cursed with endless torrential downpour.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀映出北极光般的美景。有时它出现在不合时宜的时刻、季节或地点，令人惊叹不已。
author: gp423
source: POKENAME's wings mimic the beauty of the Aurora Borealis. Some people are shocked to see them at unusual times of day, year, or location.

entry: POKENAME来到水质严重污染的地方，把一切毒素吸进巨花。湖水随之完全净化，水生植物也仿佛奇迹般茂盛起来。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME travels to areas where water is heavily polluted and absorbs any toxins into its giant flower. The lake is left completely purified, and water based-plants seem to miraculously flourish.

entry: POKENAME把蘑菇种在湖底，净化湖水。办法虽有效，蘑菇却太会吸水，也让湖面降低了几英寸。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME plants its mushrooms in lakebeds in order to purify the waters. While an effective strategy, the water levels in these lakes also drop a few inches since the mushrooms are very liquid-absorbent.

entry: POKENAME的毛柔软至极，摸起来始终冰凉。它敏锐地了解训练家的情绪，若对方低落，就会依偎过来，缠上触须，给予安慰。
author: infinex21
source: The fur of a POKENAME is incredibly soft and always cool to the touch. They have a keen awareness of the feelings of their Trainers and will cuddle up to them while wrapping their feelers around them to offer comfort when they feel down.

entry: POKENAME以控水配合美妙的歌声。据说，看它表演，能激励人类与宝可梦，发挥超越极限的本领。
author: t3isukone
source: Its beautiful songs are accompanied by a POKENAME manipulating water. The sight of a POKENAME's performance has been said to motivate Pokémon and humans to perform beyond their limits.

entry: POKENAME能在水面蹦跳，常在湖池上起舞。歌声与水本身共鸣，水便泛起涟漪、摇摆，仿佛也在随旋律跳舞。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are able to skip across the surface of water, and are often found dancing atop lakes and ponds. Their songs resonate with water itself, causing it to ripple and sway as if the water were dancing to their tune.

entry: POKENAME的动作如流水般优雅，让观看者心醉。人们只见过它生活在未受污染的湖泊与池塘。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's movements are as graceful as flowing water, captivating the hearts of those who witness it. It is only seen living in unpolluted lakes and ponds.

entry: 据说，只瞥见湖面上那华美的倒影，就能至少七年都做安宁的梦。POKENAME只在月光下、清澈水域旁出现。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is said that merely glimpsing its magnificent reflection on the lakes' surface can grant serene dreams for at least seven years. POKENAME appears only under the moonlight, in the presence of crystal-clear bodies of water.

entry: POKENAME寻找污水，因为背上的蘑菇以污染物为食。一入水，就会不停净化，直到水清如水晶，再继续前往别处。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME seeks out contaminated water because the mushroom on its back feeds on pollution. Once submerged, it will purify the water until it becomes as clear as crystal, at which point POKENAME moves on.

entry: 传说，它只需挥一下法杖，就能净化污染最严重的水域。据说，凝望栖身的湖面，还能预见未来。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to legend, a single sweep of its staff can purify even the most contaminated body of water. It is said to foresee the future by gazing intently into the surface of the lake it inhabits.

entry: POKENAME能造出巨大的水手里剑，射入湖中，便会卷起漩涡。它一进入水域，就能见到水中的宝可梦盯着它看。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME can make massive water shurikens that can create whirlpools when fired in lakes. When POKENAME enters a body of water, Pokémon in the water can be seen staring at POKENAME.

entry: 这种宝可梦飞驰夜空，让天空仿佛也像水般荡漾。它能瞬间清除一片区域的空气污染；人们认为，清晰可见的星越多，它的力量就越强。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: This Pokémon races across the night sky, creating the illusion of the sky itself rippling like water. It can instantly purify an area of air pollution, and is believed to gain more power the more stars that can be clearly seen.

entry: POKENAME如晶体般的下半身，被认为由水胆玛瑙与纯水囊构成。有关它漫游的记录，只出现在形成地下湖的洞穴中。
author: chibitales
source: The crystal-like half of POKENAME's lower body is thought to be made of enhydro agate and pockets of pure water. These Pokémon have only been recorded roaming caves where underground lakes form.

entry: POKENAME只在纯净清水中被看见，同一个体，却能出现在多处。因此，人们相信水下有庞大的隧道网络，供它在水域之间移动。
author: dualblades1147
source: POKENAME are only ever seen in pure clean water, yet the same POKENAME can appear in multiple places. This has led to a belief that there are a vast number of underwater tunnels that POKENAME use to move between bodies of water.

entry: 野外，它们住在净水源附近，十分在意毛发与宝石是否干净。只有能不断提供优质水与护毛用品的富裕训练家，才养得起POKENAME。
author: milchik
source: In the wild, these Pokémon live near the sources of pure water as they care greatly about the cleanliness of their fur and gems. Only rich Trainers with unlimited supplies of high quality water and hair care products can afford to keep POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME对自己的净水本领十分自豪，常向旁人展示。赞美它身上宝石的对象，往往会受到格外慷慨的对待。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: Incredibly proud of its ability to purify water, POKENAME will often display this ability to those nearby. They will often be far more generous to those who compliment the gems in their body.

entry: POKENAME能掀起季风暴雨般的大风暴，淹没海岸。但这会消耗心神，太过用力，就可能头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of causing monsoon level storms that can flood coastlines. This act strains their minds, which can cause a headache if they exert too much force.

entry: 这种宝可梦，以贤者般的沉静闻名。据说，它能净化心中的一切恶念，但即使是它，也无法永久改变一个人的性格。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: This Pokémon has a reputation for sage-like calmness. It's said it can purify all evil thoughts from one's mind, but not even it can permanently change one's personality.

entry: POKENAME几乎从不与外界有身体接触。超能力屏障，让一粒尘也落不到身上，连睡觉时也一样。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME almost never comes into physical contact with the outside world. A psychic barrier prevents even a mote of dust from landing on it, even in its sleep.

entry: POKENAME极具领地意识，保护着珊瑚礁。红宝石有心灵感应能力，若觉得敌不过，它就会借晶体，召来附近的水生宝可梦援护。
author: ludacriswell
source: POKENAME is a highly territorial protector of coral reefs. The red gem it carries possesses telepathic abilities. If it feels outmatched, POKENAME will use the crystal to summon nearby aquatic Pokémon to come to its defense.

entry: POKENAME全速奔跑，身后会拖出闪亮的虹色极光。它行遍大地，将受污染的水域，净化得清澈无瑕。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME gallops at full speed, a shimmering rainbow aurora trails behind its path. It travels across the land, purifying polluted bodies of water and leaving them clear and pristine.

entry: POKENAME的三个头，各自都能将喙浸入水下净水。水域越大，越需要合作；海洋与最大的湖泊，必须三个头共同出力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's three heads all possess the ability to purify water by dipping their beaks beneath the surface. Larger bodies of water require teamwork, with oceans and the largest of lakes requiring a tandem effort from all three heads.

entry: 它藏在幽暗深水里，一察觉污染，便跃出水面，袭向罪魁祸首，将其拖向毁灭。
author: skymaster426
source: It hides in the dark depths of the water. If it senses that the water is polluted, it leaps out and attacks the culprit, dragging them to their fate.

entry: POKENAME一开始吃山，就会沿完全笔直的路线吃过去，凿出穿山的隧道。没吃饱前，什么也阻止不了它。
author: bobosmith01
source: When POKENAME begins eating into a mountain, it continues in a perfectly straight line, carving a tunnel through the mountain. Nothing will stop it until it is full.

entry: POKENAME撞碎岩石，再吃掉碎块。力量与食欲太大，为觅食而破开地形时，甚至曾造出新的河流与溪涧。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME ram into rocks and stones to break them apart, then eat the resulting pieces. Because of their power and appetites, POKENAME have even created new rivers and streams by breaking through terrain for the sake of sustenance.

entry: POKENAME在热液喷口附近，击碎、吃下岩石，强化硬壳。壳上鲜红的色素，来自岩石中的矿物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME breaks and consumes rocks near hydrothermal vents to strengthen its hard shell. The bright red pigmentation of the shell comes from the minerals found in those rocks.

entry: 幼基虫进化成POKENAME后，就会立刻向土中一路吃下去，偶尔把泥土吐到上方，让自己越埋越深，最终休眠，为进化养精蓄锐。
author: bobosmith01
source: When Larvidle evolves into POKENAME, it will immediately begin to start eating downwards into the dirt, occasionally regurgitating soil above itself in order to bury itself deeper and deeper so it may eventually go dormant and rest for evolution.

entry: POKENAME在山路地下挖掘，吞食土壤，再薄薄掩住留下的洞。训练家最好小心落脚，免得绊进危险的陷坑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tunnels its way through the ground of mountain trails, devouring soil and then lightly covering the holes it leaves behind. Trainers are advised to tread carefully so as not to trip on these hazardous pitfalls.

entry: POKENAME的毒针是好用的钻头，可磨损得快，只能短时间使用。
author: alexanderc321
source: A POKENAME stinger can be used as an effective drill, though it wears down quick, and therefore, can only be used for short amounts of time.

entry: 旅人在洞穴迷路时，POKENAME可能感兴趣，想陪对方玩。若被拒绝，它就会恼怒地将人瞬移到洞穴更深处。
author: .izik
source: Should a traveler get lost in a cave system, POKENAME may take interest and attempt to play with them. If they refuse, it teleports them deeper into the caves in frustration.

entry: POKENAME大多静静沉思，不喜欢受打扰。谁扰了内省，它就生气地踢土过去，再跳到别处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends much of its time in quiet contemplation, and doesn't take kindly to interruption. If something disrupts its introspection, it angrily kicks dirt at the nuisance before hopping somewhere else.

entry: POKENAME太重，唯有最猛烈的风暴，才能将它们吹得很远。平日所谓“飞行”，不过从沙丘顶滑翔一小段。它们的到来，被视为沙暴将至的不祥预兆。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are too heavy to be carried long distances by any but the strongest of storms, limiting their 'flights' to short glides from the top of dunes. Their arrival in a region is treated as an ill-omen as heralds of sandstorms.

entry: POKENAME在沙下掘进，寻找埋藏的垃圾与矿藏吃。它鲜少被人看见，只有准备进化时，才会回到地表。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME burrow through the sand, searching for buried trash and mineral deposits to eat. These Pokémon are rarely ever seen, only surfacing once ready to evolve.

entry: POKENAME吃土与石头，尤其偏爱日之石。它凝聚心神，调动天生却微弱的力量时，尾尖就会颤动。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME feed on soil and rock, though they are particularly partial to Sun Stones. The tips of their tails quiver as they focus their thoughts to muster their innate, albeit weak, powers.

entry: 身体虽小，石身却重得无法随身携带。据说，古代文明曾借POKENAME独特的形状，发展出文字系统。
author: ztetriminos
source: Although small, their stone bodies are too heavy to be carried around. It is said that ancient civilisations used POKENAME's distinctive shapes to develop writing systems.

entry: POKENAME用鳍状的角穿凿洞穴。要加速时，整个身体便像钻头般旋转，粉碎沿途岩石。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME tunnels through caves using its fin-like horn. To accelerate, it rotates its entire body like a drill, pulverizing rock in its path.

entry: POKENAME用爪子当挖掘机，边掘地，边吞土。若碰到岩石，也能轻松用爪，碾成粉末。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their claws like excavators, digging through the ground while consuming dirt as they go. If they encounter any rocks, they can use these claws to easily crush them into dust.

entry: POKENAME用爪割开洞穴附近的树，吃树汁，增强力量。吃完不出十分钟，就能举起超过五吨的巨石。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slashes with its claws, making marks on trees near its cave to feed on sap that strengthens it. Within ten minutes of eating, POKENAME can lift boulders weighing over five tons.

entry: POKENAME虽然狡猾、爱潜行，嶙峋的身体与响亮脚步，却让它无法施展。因此，它只好吃树果与落叶，尤其喜欢沙鳞果。
author: beatdoof
source: Despite its cunning and sneaky nature, POKENAME can't act on it due to its craggy body and loud steps. Because of that, POKENAME can only eat berries and fallen leaves, with Salac Berries being its favorite.

entry: POKENAME石爪的细缝，会渗出蜂蜜香的汗，诱来芭瓢虫等虫类宝可梦，靠得足够近，就能被它吃掉。
author: .izik
source: Tiny cracks in POKENAME's stone paws leak a honey-scented sweat. This aroma lures bug Pokémon like Ledyba close enough to be eaten.

entry: POKENAME拍打岩石肚皮，释放蜂蜜般的香气，飘过隧道。被引来的地鼠，很快就会被吞掉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slaps its rocky belly to release a honey-like scent that drifts through tunnels. Diglett drawn to the scent are quickly devoured.

entry: 山中刮风，许多树会连根拔起，滚到山脚。人们认为，这是因为POKENAME吃光了整套根系。
author: bandedbodypress
source: During windy days in the mountains, many trees will uproot and roll to the bottom. This has been attributed to POKENAME eating their entire root systems.

entry: POKENAME守护稀树草原，火焰沙暴抽干环境的水分，使其不受潮湿影响。据说，最好黎明前就喝水，因为它很早醒来，就会蒸干水。
author: quackquackattack
source: Protectors of the savannah, POKENAME ensure the environment is unblemished by the effects of humidity, as their fiery sandstorms drain water from the climate. It is said that water is best drunk before dawn, as they awaken early to evaporate water.

entry: POKENAME在稀树草原，尾随其他宝可梦群，猎取年幼或生病的成员。很少有什么威胁能吓退它，为了让獠牙咬到一顿饭，它能连续多日不休。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME follow other packs of Pokémon in the savannah, picking off the young or sick. Few threats deter them, as they are able to travel many days without rest to ensure their fangs sink into a meal.

entry: POKENAME爱用长鼻卷起土团，互相投着玩。太起劲的幼崽，可能把土球压得又实又重，连自己也举不动。
author: sk372
source: A favored pastime for POKENAME is to roll up clumps of dirt with its trunk and lob them at each other. Overly zealous young POKENAME may end up creating a ball of dirt too compact and heavy for it to lift.

entry: 橙色尖晶石沿POKENAME的背脊与长鼻排列，滚动时会发光。闪烁的光脉冲，不知怎么，能让滚速大幅提升。
author: .izik
source: Orange spinel gems run along POKENAME's spine and trunk, glowing when it rolls. The light pulses somehow increase its rolling speed dramatically.

entry: POKENAME会展开带花纹的小小颈部皮膜，吓唬较小的生物。眼状花纹能让观看者怕得动弹不得，无力避开缠上来的身体。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a small hood with a pattern it unfurls to frighten smaller creatures. The eye-like markings on its hood can cause the viewer to become paralyzed with fear, helpless to avoid POKENAME's coils wrapping around them.

entry: POKENAME的身体，已硬化成比钻石更坚韧的纯碳层。小铠甲上的岩板，也变成了鲜明的黑色。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body has hardened into a layer of pure carbon, tougher than diamonds. The rocky plates of its small armor have turned a vivid shade of black.

entry: POKENAME钻到洞中苔藓下，让壳在硬化时受到保护。长时间休息，会加快最终的进化。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows under cave moss to protect its shell while it hardens. Long periods of rest accelerate its eventual evolution.

entry: POKENAME住在地下，以废弃科技设备中的数据为食。吃够数据，就会进入睡眠模式，分析数据；可这个过程，会将数据损坏。
author: deadpixel404
source: POKENAME lives underground, feeding on the data of discarded technology. After POKENAME consumes enough data, it will enter sleep mode so it can analyze the data. This process corrupts the data.

entry: POKENAME主要吃泥土与植物根，躲在地下独处。但谁靠心爱的食源太近，它就会凶猛地破土而出。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's diet largely consists of soil and plant roots. It keeps itself submerged underground for solitude, but erupts aggressively from the dirt if anything comes too close to its preferred food sources.

entry: 这种宝可梦改变肤色，融入环境，适应了山地生活。它虽能变成与任何环境相符的颜色，仍偏爱住在山里。
author: huh.7
source: This Pokémon has adapted to living in the mountains by changing its skin color to blend in. It can change its color to match any environment it's in, but prefers living in the mountains.

entry: POKENAME用精神能量，在洞穴网络中无声漂浮。使出击落前，角会亮起紫光。
author: .izik
source: Using psychic energy, POKENAME floats silently through cave networks. Its horn glows purple just before it strikes with Smack Down.

entry: 偶尔能见到POKENAME漫游山坡，但大多待在地下。它用尖爪迅速挖出泥土，随即吞下。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are occasionally seen roaming mountainsides, but spend most of their time underground. They use their sharp claws to rapidly excavate soil, which they then immediately devour.

entry: POKENAME从高处扑向猎物，力道如山崩。其他宝可梦虽常听见它接近，它却能用精神能量调整轨迹，即使目标向侧边躲，也仍会落在其身上。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME leaps down onto prey with the force of a rockslide. Although other Pokémon often hear it approaching, POKENAME can use psychic energy to adjust its trajectory, enabling it to still land on top of targets that dodge to the side.

entry: POKENAME见于许多沙漠，潜伏在形似幼基拉斯的楔石中。它会在周身召沙，阻止别人挪动楔石。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found in many desert habitats, lurking in keystones that resemble a Larvitar. It conjures sand around itself to prevent others from moving its keystone.

entry: POKENAME在长隧道里游荡，练习低吼，让声音更吓人。挡路的巨石，也会被它咬成小石子。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prowls long tunnels, practicing its growl to sound more intimidating. It bites boulders blocking paths, turning them into pebbles.

entry: 浓稠的棕色毒液，从锯齿状的角滴下。POKENAME饿了，可能会吃泥，缓解食欲，补充力量。
author: .izik
source: Thick brown poison drips from its jagged horns. When hungry, POKENAME may consume mud to ease its cravings and replenish its strength.

entry: POKENAME头顶长着一张苔藓般的嘴。它用这副额外的颚，吃植物，获取营养。
author: .izik
source: A moss-like mouth grows from the top of POKENAME's head. It nourishes itself by feeding on plantlife through this secondary jaw.

entry: POKENAME粗鲁好斗，在海中仗着体重，欺负比自己小的宝可梦。它会从背上许多喷口射出高压水，霸凌对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite rude and combative, throwing its weight around underseas at Pokémon smaller than it. It bullies them by shooting high-pressure water from the many spouts on its back.

entry: POKENAME收在鞘中，静卧地下深处，吸收周围泥土。只有受威胁时，才会出鞘迎战。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME rests deep underground, sheathed, absorbing the soil around it. It only unsheathes to fight when it is under threat.

entry: POKENAME在岩山间飞行，寻找稀有矿物吃。它似乎格外爱宝石，因此常与人类冲突。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME flies around rocky mountainsides, searching for rare minerals to eat. It seems to have a particular taste for gemstones, which often brings it into conflict with humans.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，周身环绕浮石。若从上方将其砸向敌人，力道便如山崩。
author: .jerden
source: When POKENAME flies, it surrounds itself with floating rocks. If it chooses to drop them on a foe from above, they will hit with the force of a rockslide.

entry: 这只POKENAME的暗色身体，能融入夜空。它会飞得很高，不让人发现，再以敏锐的夜视力，找到猎物，投石攻击。
author: .jerden
source: This POKENAME's dark coloration enables it to blend in with the night sky. It will fly high to remain unseen, then drop rocks to attack any prey it spots with its keen night vision.

entry: POKENAME主要吃土，也会吃碾碎的岩石。吃下约200吨这类材料后，就会沉沉睡去；睡觉时，散发平静的气场，自我保护。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME feed primarily on soil, though they may also feed on rocks they pulverize. Once they have fed on around 200 tons of such materials, POKENAME fall into a deep slumber; they exude a calming aura as they sleep in order to protect themselves.

entry: POKENAME常被误认成宝可梦玩偶，格外受孩子喜爱。独处时，它会挖过院落地下，在别处冒出头，仿佛一只遗失的玩具。
author: ghostslythe
source: Often mistaken as a Pokédoll, POKENAME has become especially popular with children. When alone, this Pokémon digs under yards, popping up to appear as a lost toy elsewhere.

entry: POKENAME颈间的暗色毛里，会长出宝石。虽然看不见，谁触碰宝石，它都会猛烈反击。
author: .izik
source: Gemstones grow within the dark fur around POKENAME's neck. Though blind, it reacts violently if the gems are touched.

entry: POKENAME主要吃土，两个头通常都有充足食物。但若挖到稀有矿物，就会激烈争抢，非要自己吃下不可，尽管双方用的是同一个胃。
author: .jerden
source: Since POKENAME mostly eats soil, there is usually plenty of food for both of its heads to eat. However, if it unearths a rare mineral, the two of them will fight viciously to be the one to devour it, despite them both sharing the same stomach.

entry: POKENAME用六片翅膀飞上悬崖，再用三副强颚吃掉岩石，挖进去。谁挡路，它都会咬。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME use their six wings to fly up to cliffs, then tunnels in by devouring the stone with their three sets of strong jaws. They will bite any Pokémon that gets in their way.

entry: POKENAME用六片翅膀飞上悬崖，再用三副强颚吃掉岩石，挖进去。谁挡路，它都会咬。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME use their six wings to fly up to cliffs, then tunnels in by devouring the stone with their three sets of strong jaws. They will bite any Pokémon that gets in their way.

entry: 成群的POKENAME住在高山，凭强劲利爪，轻松攀过岩地。敏锐的眼睛，让它连漆黑中也能狩猎。
author: mistymagius
source: Packs of POKENAME live high in the mountains, using their strong claws to effortlessly scale the rocky landscape. Their keen eyes allow them to hunt even in pitch darkness.

entry: POKENAME啃食采石场找到的硬石头，强化石身。尾巴与暗色鬃毛迸出的电火花，则用来威吓敌方宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME nibbles on the Hard Stones it finds in quarries to toughen its body of stone. It intimidates enemy Pokémon by scattering electric sparks from its tail and dark mane.

entry: POKENAME以颚咬住钟乳石，吊在洞顶睡觉，避开地面的捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME clamps its jaws around stalactites, dangling from cave ceilings while it sleeps. This keeps it safe from ground-based predators.

entry: POKENAME聚在地鼠洞穴等隧道附近，用头撞旅人，盼着对方掉下食物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gather near tunnels like Diglett's Cave, ramming into travelers with their heads in hopes of making them drop food.

entry: 沉重的岩壳，压着POKENAME的身体。它用铠甲与岩石反复摩擦，磨成沙，只挑最硬的巨石，磨碎再吃。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is weighed down by a heavy shell of rock. It uses this armor to grind rocks into sand by repeatedly rubbing against them, seeking out only the hardest of boulders to wear down and then consume.

entry: POKENAME用耳上的绒毛收土，甩向对手，逃离战斗。若被逼入绝境，就会全力弹起，试图撒出泥土或小石，赶走威胁。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME collect soil with the fluff on their ears to fling at opponents to escape from battle. If backed into a corner, a POKENAME will spring off the ground with all of its strength, trying to scatter dirt or pebbles to repel the threat.

entry: 将各类岩石与矿物融入身体，能增强POKENAME的超能力。因此它四处迁居，很少在同一处待超过一天。
author: oddwalls
source: Incorporating many varieties of rocks and minerals into its body enhances POKENAME's psychic power. As a result, POKENAME is nomadic, rarely staying in one location for more than a day.

entry: POKENAME是沙漠中的伏击猎手，几乎整天埋在沙下，或钻行岩间，通常只露出背刺。粗心的训练家踩上去，就会遭到袭击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: An ambush predator in desert environments, POKENAME spends almost all of its time buried in sand and burrowing through rock. It can usually only be spotted by its back spines, often leading to unwary Trainers being attacked for stepping on them.

entry: POKENAME是干旱之地独来独往的猎手，四处迁徙。为了找猎物、守领地，它用后腿站立行走，比四足时看得更远。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A nomadic hunter, POKENAME lives a solitary life in arid environments. To help them find prey and to guard their territory, they move about on their hind legs, granting a better view of their surroundings than if they were quadrupedal.

entry: POKENAME小小的獠牙，比钻石更硬。它把巢内岩石砸成粉，每次敲击，都在磨炼力量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tiny tusks are harder than diamond. It smashes rocks in its den into powder, sharpening its strength with every blow.

entry: 古卷记载，POKENAME曾在地底深处协助矿工。紧急时刻，身上的橙色宝石会大放光明，照亮隧道。
author: .izik
source: Ancient scrolls describe POKENAME aiding miners deep underground. The orange gem on its body glows brightly to illuminate tunnels during emergencies.

entry: POKENAME绿色的石翼，扇动时带着雷霆般的力道。咬力极强，一口就能咬碎清障拖车。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's green stone wings flap with thunderous force. Its bite is so strong it could crush a tow truck in one chomp.

entry: POKENAME生在厚土深处，得自行钻上地面，与亲代会合。不过，它们几乎都能赶在家人迁走前，钻出地面。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are born deep under thick dirt and must find their own way to reach the surface to reach their parent, or parents. It is, however, still very rare for them to ever not surface before their family moves on.

entry: POKENAME通过覆有矿物的耳朵，传出响亮声波。飞过黑暗洞穴时，就用声波震碎钟乳石。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME channels loud soundwaves through its mineral-coated ears. POKENAME uses these to shatter stalactites as it flies through dark caves.

entry: POKENAME没有通常意义上的翅膀，却能造出小沙暴，在沙漠前进。临时形成的尘卷风托着它，沿沙丘飘行，也给予保护。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Despite not having traditional wings, POKENAME propel themselves across the desert by producing miniature sandstorms. They drift along the dunes, protected by the makeshift dust devils that carry them.

entry: 构成它翅膀的粗沙，能拿来打磨岩石。身体太重，无法真正飞行，腾空后，主要靠双翼避免撞地。
author: bacondlx
source: The coarse sand making up its wings can be used to polish rocks. It is too heavy to truly fly, and mainly uses its wings to keep from crashing into the ground when it takes to the sky.

entry: POKENAME身体覆着透明黏液，阳光下很快就干。它睡在滴水的洞室，保持湿润凉爽。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is coated in a transparent slime that dries quickly in sunlight. It sleeps in dripping cave chambers to stay moist and cool.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇，对营养有极其特殊的要求。野外，它可能得吞下山那么多的土，才准备好进化。
author: .jerden
source: The mushrooms on POKENAME's back have highly specific nutritional needs. In the wild, POKENAME may need to devour a mountain of soil before they become ready to evolve.

entry: POKENAME背上的矿簇中，交织着一张真菌菌丝网，菌丝也会蔓延到身体其他部位。
author: .izik
source: The ore cluster on POKENAME's back is threaded with a network of fungal mycelium. This fungal growth also spreads throughout parts of its body.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，岩皮上的细小鳞片，会轻轻抖动。睡得很沉，尾巴就会飞快摇摆。
author: .izik
source: While asleep, the small scales on POKENAME's rocky skin flutter gently. When in deep sleep, its tail wags rapidly.

entry: POKENAME用岩尾猛敲附近巨石，发出响声。既用来威吓敌人，也会在遇到特别能共鸣的石头时，单纯敲着玩。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME makes loud noises by smashing its rocky tail against nearby boulders. While it uses this to intimidate foes, it also does it for fun whenever it finds a particularly resonant stone.

entry: POKENAME用有力的拳，将岩石砸成能吃下的小块。它晃响鳞片，声如山崩，吓退敌人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME use their powerful fists to crush rocks into pieces small enough for them to eat. They frighten away foes by rattling their scales, making as much noise as a rockslide.

entry: POKENAME趋光，夜里会跳向发亮的东西。石头般沉重的身体撞上去，足以撞弯路灯，撞坏篱笆。
author: .izik
source: Drawn to light, POKENAME leaps toward glowing objects at night. Its stone-heavy body bends lampposts and damages fences with the impact.

entry: POKENAME藏在大岩石上，向经过领地的来者，投掷岩石手里剑。攀岩时若摔下，它有时也会伤到舌头。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME hides on big rocks and throws rock shurikens at anyone who passes by its territory. POKENAME can sometimes damage its tongue if it falls while climbing these rocks.

entry: POKENAME用唾液黏合沙子，做成衣裳，装点身体。衣裳若破损或被冲走，它就会害羞地逃跑。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME adorns its body with garments made from sand, stuck together with its saliva. If its garments are damaged or washed away, it will become embarrassed and flee.

entry: POKENAME将长颈深藏地下，能向上猛弹多达七英尺，以角刺击敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides its long neck deep beneath the ground. It can launch upward as far as seven feet to jab foes with its horn.

entry: POKENAME的三个头，每个都能从身体伸出超过十英尺。它们一起攻击，用结实的角，将猎物拖入地下。
author: .izik
source: Each of POKENAME's three heads can stretch over ten feet from its body. They attack in unison, dragging prey underground with their sturdy horns.

entry: 要给岩石身体挠痒、梳理，得用特制的铁刮板。POKENAME主要吃煤，为体内燃烧的火焰添燃料。
author: fiordaliso
source: A special iron scraper is required to scratch and groom its rocky body. POKENAME feeds primarily on coal to stoke the flames burning within itself.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉极佳，能找到被瓦砾或山崩掩埋的人，拉到安全处。暴怒时，石身会变得滚烫，谁敢触碰，立刻就会灼伤。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its exceptional sense of smell allows POKENAME to detect people trapped beneath rubble or landslides and pull them to safety. When enraged, its stone body grows so scorching hot that anyone who dares touch it will be instantly burned.

entry: POKENAME用超能力强化汤匙，连最硬的岩石，也能一勺勺挖来吃。传说，吃完一整座山，就能解放全部力量。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their psychic powers to reinforce their spoons, enabling them to scoop mouthfuls of even the hardest rock to be eaten one mouthful at a time. Legends say that once a POKENAME has consumed an entire mountain it unlocks its full power.

entry: POKENAME用石皮摩擦洞壁，将气味留在领地四周。若不梳理，岩皮上就会长出苔藓。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rubs its stone skin against cavern walls to spread its scent around its territory. If left ungroomed, moss begins to grow on its rocky hide.

entry: POKENAME用多条手臂，细细筛过泥土与岩石，对食物极为挑剔。人们认为，它只想吃能加快进化的矿物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its multiple arms to sift through dirt and stone carefully, being very particular about what it consumes. It's thought that it only wishes to consume minerals that will assist in speeding up its evolutionary processes.

entry: POKENAME不断放出沙，掩护自己逃离威胁。宝可梦巡护员控火时，不论计划烧除，还是野火，都会骑着它，迅速铺出沙带，拦住火焰。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME emits a steady stream of sand, allowing it to obscure its escape from a threat. Pokémon Rangers ride it while controlling fires, prescribed or wild, swiftly creating boundary lines of sand that block the path of flames.

entry: POKENAME周身岩石般的羽毛，脆弱易碎。它避免正面战斗，更愿迅速逃走。
author: .izik
source: The rocky feathers on POKENAME's body are fragile and flake off easily. It avoids direct combat, preferring to flee swiftly.

entry: POKENAME页岩般的尾羽很脆，奔跑时会脱落，碎片常散落在峡谷小径旁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's shale-like tail feathers are brittle and fall off while it runs. These fragments are often found scattered near canyon paths.

entry: POKENAME用幽灵之力操纵附近的泥土。通常会让土块与泥浆浮起，甩向侵入领地的来者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's ghostly powers allow it to manipulate the dirt near it. This typically results in it levitating and flinging dirt clods and mud at intruders to its territory.

entry: POKENAME挖掘时，能探知宝石簇。过去，宝石商曾训练它，采挖稀有宝石，用于交易。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can detect gemstone clusters while digging. Gem merchants once trained them to mine rare stones for trade.

entry: POKENAME用宽大的石脸，保护背上敏感的花苞。花苞的紫色，来自薄薄的速效毒层，守护内部能量，直到进化。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their broad, stony faces to protect the sensitive bulbs on their backs. The purple color of the bulbs comes from thin layers of fast-acting poison meant to protect the energy inside until the POKENAME's evolution.

entry: POKENAME发现被遗弃的蛋，就会装进袋里。守护蛋时，纯粹的本能，引导身体变得更加致密。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME finds an abandoned egg, it carries it in its pouch. Its body grows denser while guarding the egg, guided by pure instinct.

entry: POKENAME每天只能飞几次，每次持续时间也有限。它在硬皮下产生气体，释放积蓄的压力，才能飞起来。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can fly only a few times a day for a limited period of time; to fly, it releases the built-up pressure from a gas that it generates beneath its hard skin.

entry: POKENAME在狭窄的洞穴网络中蜿蜒前行，厚鳞抵御尖岩。有人相信，盯着球体，会被慢慢夺走视力，但这些传闻已被证伪。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME slithers through tight cave systems, its thick scales protecting it from the sharp rocks. Some people believe that looking into its orb will slowly steal away your sight, but these rumors have been proven false.

entry: POKENAME四肢太小，连基本动作都费力。尾巴能帮忙完成动作，也以重量压住身体，免得飘走。
author: bigoljax
source: Because of their small limbs, POKENAME struggle to perform basic actions. Their tails help them in doing these actions, the weight keeping them anchored so they won't float away.

entry: POKENAME大多静止不动，融入环境，过滤水，消化其中的营养。若被捕食者发现，它就能高速喷水，疾速逃开，并以毒流吓阻追击。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are mostly sedentary, and blend into their environment, filtering the water and digesting any nutrients. Should a predator spot them, they can expel water at great speeds and dart off, spewing a toxic stream to deter them.

entry: POKENAME让分叉的尾尖，触碰头上晶体，彼此交流。身体又硬又重，它每天花数小时凝神练心，再用超能力帮助移动。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME communicate by touching the split tips of their tails against the crystals on their heads. Their bodies are hard and heavy, so they hone and focus their minds for hours each day. They use their psychic powers to help them move.

entry: POKENAME迅速掘穿山体，寻找尖晶石。吃下这些稀有宝石，能在进化前，强化外壳。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME tunnels rapidly through mountains in search of spinel gems. Consuming these rare stones helps toughen its shell before evolution.

entry: POKENAME在体内产生气体，从爪上的孔释放，打出强力攻击。钢铁般的身体，能抵御大多数攻击。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME create gas within their bodies, which they can release from the holes in their claws to deliver high-powered strikes. Their bodies are as hard as steel, protecting them from most attacks.

entry: POKENAME粗壮的爪，让它很擅长攀山，不论岩地还是冰面，都不在话下。连强烈暴风雪，也阻挡不了。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's thick claws make it an expert mountain climber, both in rocky and icy conditions. Even strong snowstorms aren't enough to deter it.

entry: 冬季，POKENAME冬眠数周，一动不动。睡眠中，岩身硬化得比钢更强，抵御寒冷。
author: .izik
source: During winter, POKENAME hibernates for weeks without stirring. As it sleeps, its rocky body hardens to a strength beyond steel to endure the cold.

entry: POKENAME在地下深处以岩浆为食，同时在壳中积蓄火山气体。它能随时排气推进，突然爆发出高速移动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feed on magma deep underground, building up volcanic gases within their shell as they do. They are capable of rapid bursts of movement, venting gas from their shell to propel themselves at high speed at a moment's notice.

entry: 野外的POKENAME每天睡23小时。若喂它肥沃的土，并保持温暖，就能醒得更久。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME sleeps for 23 hours a day in the wild. It can stay awake longer if it is fed its fertile soil and kept warm.

entry: POKENAME凭岩皮，能肆无忌惮地撞穿几乎一切。但它讨厌潮湿，因为水会慢慢削弱铠甲。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's rocky hide allows it to smash through just about anything with reckless abandon. However, it hates wet conditions, as water slowly weakens its armor.

entry: 壳提早发育的POKENAME，形态更便于活动，防御却较弱。它会把剥落的壳片投出去，自我防卫。
author: sk372
source: With its shell having developed early, POKENAME has adapted a more mobile form but possesses weaker defenses. It uses flaked-off bits of its shell as projectiles to fling in self-defense.

entry: 据说，这种宝可梦压抑着多得难以控制的力量。POKENAME能与实心立方钨块多次正面相撞，损伤极少，甚至全无。
author: ruben2309295
source: This Pokémon is said to be suppressing an uncontrollable amount of power. POKENAME's body can withstand multiple head-on collisions with solid cubes of tungsten, with little to no damage.

entry: POKENAME漫游山脉，寻找强敌较量，或寻找最爱的莲蒲果。准备进化时，它会用爪撕下甲片，露出适合作战的新皮肤。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME wanders mountain ranges, searching for formidable foes to fight or its favorite food of Chople Berries. When it is ready to evolve, it claws at the armored plates, ripping them off to reveal its new battle-ready hide.

entry: 野生POKENAME以精神力量影响其他岩石属性宝可梦，使其聚成形似巨金怪或班基拉斯的结构。这些精巧的组合，通常一遇攻击就会散架。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME exert a psychic influence over other Rock-type Pokémon, causing them to group together into structures resembling either Metagross or Tyranitar. These elaborate arrangements usually fall apart as soon as they are attacked.

entry: POKENAME漂浮于山坡，钢壳几乎不怕外力。它在岩壁刻线，标出自己完全进化后，打算占据的领地。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats around mountainsides, its steel shell making it nearly impervious to outside forces. It scratches lines into rock walls, marking the territory it aims to claim once it evolves fully.

entry: POKENAME的岩甲虽大多中空，仍极其坚固。从腿部喷口释放高压空气，便能在空中推进，或增强利爪打击的力道。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME's rocky armor is mostly hollow, it is still incredibly durable. By expelling pressured air from the vents on its legs, POKENAME can propel itself through the air or increase the force with which its claws can strike foes.

entry: POKENAME将洞壁凿成巨大尖刺，抵御较大的宝可梦。但若有小型宝可梦进来，很快就会变成它的零食。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME defends its cave by carving large spikes out of the cave walls to ward off larger Pokémon. However, any small Pokémon that enter will quickly be snacked on by POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME坚硬的石壳，包着铝质核心。训练时，它从岩地吸收矿物，让身体更加坚韧。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's hard stone casing conceals an aluminum core. As it trains, its body toughens by absorbing minerals from rocky terrain.

entry: 它靠铠甲的孔呼吸，嘴只负责进食。因此，POKENAME能咬住闯入者，一直不松口。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its mouth is only for eating, as it breathes through the holes in its armor instead. This allows POKENAME to bite down on intruders and never let go.

entry: POKENAME全身覆满石鳞，中空的翅膀推力不足，无法让身体升空。它靠体内喷口排出高压气体飞行，翅膀只用来转向。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is completely covered by stone scales, and its hollow wings do not provide enough thrust to lift it into the air. It flies by expelling pressurized gas from vents in its body, only using its wings to steer.

entry: POKENAME吃煤与硫，在体内产生氦气，再以高压排出，迅速避险。吸入过量，会陷入虚假的欣快与放松。
author: infinex21
source: By feeding on coal and sulfur, POKENAME produces helium gas within itself. It expels this gas under compression to swiftly avoid danger; over-inhalation of this gas will induce a false state of euphoria and relaxation.

entry: POKENAME浑身披着坚硬石刺，却只在与同族争夺领地时，用来保卫自己。荒原上，它们的咆哮能传出几英里。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Covered in hard stone spines, POKENAME uses these spines solely to defend itself in territorial conflicts with other members of its own species. Their roar can travel for miles through the wastelands in which they live.

entry: 古时，POKENAME夜袭矿井，吃掉剩余矿石。矿工曾担心，忘记收好矿石，就会引来它们。
author: .izik
source: In ancient times, POKENAME raided mine shafts at night to eat leftover ore. Miners once feared forgetting to store ore would attract these creatures.

entry: POKENAME坚韧的壳，保护正在发育的身体。为进一步自卫，它还从尾巴产生火球，绕身旋转，多添一重保护。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tough shell keeps its developing body safe from attackers. To further protect itself, it creates fire orbs from its tail that circle around it as extra defense.

entry: POKENAME脾气很差，发怒时会猛烈甩头。头上岩石般坚固的甲片，足以击碎防弹玻璃。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very irritable and will flail their heads if angered. The tough, rocklike plates on their heads are enough to shatter bulletproof glass.

entry: POKENAME从身体排出压缩气体，在空中推进。坚硬石甲护身，它通常用中央的头全力撞敌，再以臂端的头，连连咬击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME propels itself through the air by venting compressed gas from its body. Covered by solid stone armor, POKENAME usually slams its central head into foes as hard as possible, then relentlessly bites with the heads at the ends of its arms.

entry: POKENAME从身体排出压缩气体，在空中推进。坚硬石甲护身，它通常用中央的头全力撞敌，再以臂端的头，连连咬击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME propels itself through the air by venting compressed gas from its body. Covered by solid stone armor, POKENAME usually slams its central head into foes as hard as possible, then relentlessly bites with the heads at the ends of its arms.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴，始终覆着细沙与尘土。它随时能抖落沙尘，向前扬起；微粒触到火焰鬃毛，就会燃成火球。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's tails are constantly covered in a fine coating of sand and dust. They can shake this coating free and send it billowing forward at a moment's notice, the particles catching on their mane of fire and igniting into a fireball.

entry: POKENAME的DNA可塑性很强，能轻易修改，改变触手外观。此外，它也能从体孔排气，调整移动。
author: heal_fire
source: The DNA of POKENAME is very malleable; it can easily modify its DNA to change the appearance of its tentacles. On top of that, POKENAME can manoeuvre by expelling gases through the holes in its body.

entry: POKENAME本已是金属的身体，大半又覆上一层沉重的保护金属壳，重得只能以小幅跳跃移动。
author: sk372
source: A heavy extra shell of protective metal rests upon most of POKENAME's already metallic body. This increases its weight to the point that it can only move via short hops.

entry: POKENAME身体比铁更硬，会钻进岩壁找矿石。夜里，它蜷成紧紧一团，保护自己入睡。
author: .izik
source: With a body harder than iron, POKENAME digs into walls in search of ore. At night, it curls into a tight ball to protect itself as it sleeps.

entry: POKENAME头骨硬如岩石，猛撞就能使钢铁凹陷。后脑喷口排出高压空气，还能增强撞击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has a rock-hard skull and can dent steel by slamming its head against it. It expels pressurized air from a vent in the back of its head to increase the force of this impact.

entry: POKENAME鲜少活动，几乎完全静止，怒视靠近那几不可破之壳的来者。它尽可能省下能量，准备在最终进化时，一并释放。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rarely moves, staying almost completely immobile and glaring at those who come near its almost impenetrable shell. It conserves as much energy as possible, ready to unleash it all when it finally evolves.

entry: POKENAME光滑的齿轮，由岩石与金属的坚硬混合物构成，似乎从不磨损。任何夹进去的东西，都会被碾碎。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's smooth gears are made of a hard mixture of rock and metal that never seems to wear down. Anything that gets caught between them will be crushed.

entry: POKENAME会从口中喷出灼热火焰，抵御其他宝可梦，哪怕这很快就会耗去力量。石身能让它完美融入栖身的洞穴。
author: fiordaliso
source: To defend itself from other Pokémon, POKENAME breathes scorching flames from its mouth, even if doing so quickly drains its strength. Its stony body helps it blend perfectly into the caves it calls home.

entry: POKENAME的头部由骨层与岩层交替加固。与其他宝可梦交锋时，这颗头既是盾牌，也是重锤。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The head of POKENAME is reinforced with alternating layers of bone and rock. When clashing with other Pokémon, they will use their head both as a shield and as a bludgeon.

entry: POKENAME的头部由骨层与岩层交替加固。与其他宝可梦交锋时，这颗头既是盾牌，也是重锤。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The head of POKENAME is reinforced with alternating layers of bone and rock. When clashing with other Pokémon, they will use their head both as a shield and as a bludgeon.

entry: POKENAME背上排列的尖刺，锋利至极，一碰就会重伤。战斗时，它以此为主要武器，背朝前，跃向对手。
author: evilgammon
source: The spikes lining POKENAME's back are incredibly sharp, causing great injury if contact is made with them. It uses these spikes as its main weapon in battle, leaping at its opponent back-first.

entry: POKENAME住在暗洞，岩甲极坚韧，却轻得令人意外。它啃食钟乳石，用其中矿物，强化铠甲。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in dark caves, its rocky armor being extremely tough and surprisingly lightweight. It munches on stalactites, the minerals in the rocks reinforcing its armor.

entry: POKENAME栖身的地方，有许多地面属性宝可梦，因此有机会就吃腰木果。地面一震，它就滚离附近，避免冒险卷入争斗。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME eat Shuca Berries whenever they can because they live in an area with lots of Ground-type Pokémon. Whenever the ground shakes, they roll away from the area to avoid the risk of confrontation.

entry: POKENAME的身体，由奇异液体构成，平时柔软，受撞击却会变得极其坚固。这让它既能挤过小缝，也不必担心被袭击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is made out of a strange fluid that is usually soft but becomes extremely tough on impact. This allows POKENAME to squeeze through small gaps and not have to worry about being attacked.

entry: POKENAME岩甲内，有致密的真菌菌丝网，帮助消化。虽然真菌已在产孢，却要等它蜕壳，才会长出菌盖，散播孢子。
author: .jerden
source: Within its rocky armor is a dense network of fungal mycelium, which POKENAME uses for digestion. Although they actively produce spores, the fungus will not form a mushroom cap to scatter them until POKENAME sheds its shell.

entry: POKENAME用头撞岩，发出响声，表达情绪。鳞壳厚实无比，怎么撞，也从不伤到自己。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME expresses its emotions by bashing its head against rocks to make loud noises. Its scaly shell is so thick that this never injures POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME岩石般的红鳞，是群中地位的象征。它们常互相争斗，胜者能掰下败者的一些鳞片。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's rocky red scales are a status symbol among their pack. They will often get in fights with one another, with the winner allowed to break off some of the loser's scales.

entry: POKENAME周身覆着岩石硬壳，直到进化才会蜕下。因此，经验丰富的个体，很容易从甲上众多划痕与缺口认出。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is covered with a hard shell made of rock. This will not be shed until it evolves, so experienced POKENAME are easily recognizable from the many scratches and chips on their armor.

entry: POKENAME的壳与皮肤结合，几乎不受伤害。它挺身护住小型宝可梦，哪怕最强大的对手，也难使它动摇。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's shell and hide combine to make it nearly impervious to damage. It stands tall to protect smaller Pokémon from harm; even the mightiest of opponents can scarcely make it budge.

entry: 成群的POKENAME在洞中排成一列，一动不动，让身体硬化。若遭打扰，就会同时扑上去，使出毁灭性的围攻。
author: .izik
source: Groups of POKENAME stand motionless in cave lines, hardening their bodies. If disturbed, they all lunge at once to unleash a devastating Beat Up.

entry: POKENAME整天与同类较量，让岩甲更加坚硬。生气时，尾焰烧得太猛，连尾巴最尖端，都会变得漆黑。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME spends entire days battling others of its kind to further harden its rocky armor. When angered, the flame on its tail burns so intensely that the very tip of its tail turns pitch black.

entry: POKENAME的坚韧石甲，让它能面对敌人，不怕重伤。借巨大双翼从上方俯冲，以岩身猛撞，击晕敌人，瞬间结束战斗。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body is covered in a tough stone armor that lets it face opponents without fear of serious injury. Using its massive wings, it dives from above to crash into enemies with its rocky body, stunning them and ending the battle in an instant.

entry: 比起用四臂战斗，POKENAME更喜欢炫耀肌肉。主要是因为护身的壳妨碍活动，让它在战斗中僵硬迟缓。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME prefers showing off the musculature of its four arms rather than using them to fight. This is primarily because the shell covering its body for protection hampers its movements, making them stiff and sluggish in battle.

entry: POKENAME的坚韧石甲，让它能面对敌人，不怕重伤。借巨大双翼从上方俯冲，以岩身猛撞，击晕敌人，瞬间结束战斗。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body is covered in a tough stone armor that lets it face opponents without fear of serious injury. Using its massive wings, it dives from above to crash into enemies with its rocky body, stunning them and ending the battle in an instant.

entry: POKENAME静静附在洞壁上，反复硬化外壳。等待进化时，它一次能数日不动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME clings to cave walls in silence, hardening its shell repeatedly. It stays motionless for days at a time as it waits to evolve.

entry: 这些宝可梦的身体，由多种矿物构成，素以坚固闻名；但各个体所含的各种矿物，分量并不相同。据说，POKENAME会长时间埋在地下。
author: ruben2309295
source: These Pokémon are known for their durable bodies which are made from a variety of minerals, but not all of them contain the same amount of each mineral. It's said that POKENAME bury themselves underground for long lengths of time.

entry: POKENAME甩动极长的颈，用三个头打飞对手。尾巴上长着硬如岩石的果实；少数取果后生还的人，称它是世间最好的珍馐之一。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their incredibly long necks to flail their three heads into opponents and send them flying. A rock-hard fruit grows upon their tail, which is said to be one of the finest delicacies by the few who have ever survived efforts to obtain it.

entry: POKENAME暴烈而强大，虽然角锋利结实，却很少使用。若见它将钻头加速旋起，准备作战，就表示对方赢得尊重，被视为平等的对手。
author: sk372
source: A volatile force to be reckoned with, POKENAME rarely uses its horn despite how sharp and sturdy it is. If an opponent sees it spin and rev up its drill to use in battle, it means they've earned its respect as an equal.

entry: POKENAME敏捷疾冲，撕裂沿途地面，重塑地貌。它绝不放走猎物，会用镰刀劈开山与洞穴，一路追下去。
author: soup1900
source: As POKENAME dashes around with agility, it tears up the terrain it goes across, reforming the landscape in its wake. It never lets its prey escape, slicing through mountains and caves alike with its scythes to chase them.

entry: POKENAME逆流游动时，会用岩石头颅，不断撞击挡路障碍，直到突破。它顽强得很，甚至曾把堤坝撞出洞来。
author: .jerden
source: When swimming upriver, POKENAME will smash their rocky heads against any obstacles in their way until they eventually break through. POKENAME are so persistent that they have been known to make holes in dams.

entry: 进化到这种状态，需要海量训练与进食，因此POKENAME极其罕见。它似乎厌恶长大的地方，或许是想与幼年弱小的自己，划清界限。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is incredibly rare due to the sheer amount of training and consumption required to evolve to this state. POKENAME seems to detest the areas where it grew up at: perhaps it strives to disassociate itself from its weak earlier stages of life.

entry: 渡海的帮手中，少有比POKENAME更安全的。它保护人类乘客，既能凭蛮力压倒威胁，也能只用一个动作，造出巨大的漩涡。
author: sk372
source: There are few safer ferries across the sea than POKENAME. Protective of its human passengers, it can easily overpower threats through strength or by creating massive whirlpools with a single motion.

entry: POKENAME皮肤比岩石更硬，披着尖锐的雷击石碎片。它藏在沙暴中狩猎，以迅捷打击与精准雷电突袭，沿途常留下雷击石。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have hides harder than rock and are clad in sharp fragments of fulgurite. They hunt during sandstorms, concealing themselves before striking with quick blows and precise lightning bolts that often leave fulgurite in their wake.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，却又不断移动，把各地山峰都据为己有。若发现谁侵入自认的山，它宁可用雷电将山轰成碎石，也不肯共享领地。
author: sk372
source: Territorial yet constantly on the move, POKENAME claims mountains all across the land for itself. If it finds others encroaching on a mountain it considers its own, it will reduce it to rubble via thunderbolts rather than share its domain.

entry: POKENAME释放的强风，能卷起80英尺内的沙与小石。集中的尘暴，会把弱小宝可梦吓离家园。传说，光是它在场，就能将轻微沙暴，化作尘墙般的狂暴沙尘暴。
author: pkbonusducks
source: The forceful winds POKENAME release can kick up sand and small rocks within 80 feet. These concentrated dust storms scare weak Pokémon away from their homes. Legends state the mere presence of POKENAME can turn light sandstorms into savage haboobs.

entry: POKENAME虽然气势骇人，却隐居又有点胆小。颈褶能振动，产生浓厚的沙状花粉云，遮住自己、蒙蔽旁人视线，好趁机逃走。
author: sk372
source: Despite having an imposing figure, POKENAME is reclusive and a bit timid. The frill around its neck can vibrate and generate a thick cloud of sand-like pollen to cover itself, blinding others and giving it a chance to flee.

entry: POKENAME脾气可怕，火焰又强，是凶猛的对手。火一旺，颈间便涌出呛人的黑烟，罩住战场，只有它能看穿。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's fearsome temper combined with its powerful flame makes it a fierce opponent. Choking black smog billows from its neck when its fire flares up, covering the battlefield in a dark cloud only it can see through.

entry: POKENAME不明白自己的力量究竟多大，会调皮地轻咬别人，以示亲近，却不知道双颚能轻易咬碎骨头。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lacks an understanding of how truly powerful its strength is. It playfully bites others as a sign of affection, unaware its jaws are strong enough to easily shatter bones.

entry: 它把整座山或大片水域，划作领地，游荡寻找对手，检验自己。若陷入狂怒，就能毁山、改河，或引发海啸，自己却毫发无伤。
author: badwolf6066
source: It will claim entire mountains or large bodies of water as its territory, wandering in search of opponents to test itself against. If it enters a blinding rage, it can bring down mountains, alter rivers, or cause tsunamis, never suffering a scratch.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在废弃建筑里织网。若附近找不到，就会大闹最近的人类聚落，造出足够多的空旷废墟，供自己挑选。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME prefers to make its webs inside abandoned buildings. If it cannot find any nearby, it will rampage through the closest human settlement to create plenty of empty ruins to choose from.

entry: POKENAME把整个洞穴网络视为领地，无休止地追赶闯入者。飞行时几乎势不可挡，撞碎巨石，也不会减速。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME claims entire cave systems as its territory and will relentlessly pursue anyone that enters it. It is almost unstoppable in flight, able to smash through large boulders without losing speed.

entry: 它寻找天降陨石，吃下变强，盼着尽快进化。白天在巢里休息，保存精力，好整夜凝望星辰。
author: fiordaliso
source: It wanders in search of meteorites fallen from the sky, feeding on them to grow stronger in the hope of evolving as soon as possible. During the day it rests in its den, conserving energy so it can spend the night gazing at the stars.

entry: POKENAME喜欢玩闹地跺脚，假装是个小霸王。可它比自己想象中更强，嬉闹太猛，就可能意外伤到玩伴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys playfully stomping around and pretending to be a little tyrant. However, it is stronger than it realizes, as its playful roughhousing can wind up injuring its playmates by accident.

entry: POKENAME飞过暗洞，蓝翼熠熠生辉。它以带领迷路的洞穴探险者，平安回到地表而闻名。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's blue wings sparkle brilliantly as it flies through dark caves. They are known for guiding lost spelunkers safely back to the surface.

entry: 凭岩石般的双翼，POKENAME能以超过3马赫的惊人速度飞行。构成身体的岩石极耐冲击，让它以此高速撞上山、将山粉碎后，仍能存活。
author: runningdust
source: With its rock-like wings, POKENAME flies at breakneck speeds upwards of Mach 3. It can survive going this fast and the subsequent crashing into and pulverizing of mountains due to the ultra-durable rock it's made of.

entry: 终于进化，POKENAME高兴得跳起舞。可它还不清楚自己的体型，曾有记录，见它开心地踩平建筑。随后又会制造泥流，顺流冲浪取乐。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Delighted to have finally evolved, POKENAME performs a happy dance. As it is still not fully aware of its size, there have been reports of it flattening buildings in its joy. It then finds entertainment in creating and surfing down mudslides.

entry: 它们的晶体比钻石更硬，是精神能量的导体。专注时，能凭意念移动大小为自身三倍的巨石。但它们很容易受挑衅，难以保持专注平静。
author: infinex21
source: Their crystals are harder than diamond and serve as conduits for their psychic energies. When focused, they can use their minds to move boulders thrice their size. They are, however, easy to provoke, and so they struggle to stay focused and calm.

entry: POKENAME厚重的铠甲极其坚韧，几乎无从击破。为了更加强壮，它常会摆头，撞向崖壁。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's bulky armor is incredibly durable, making them practically impenetrable. In order to further strengthen themselves, these Pokémon can often be found swinging their heads into cliffsides.

entry: 只要时间足够，POKENAME连最硬的基岩也能钻穿。洞穴深入之处，早已超过其他宝可梦能够生存的范围。
author: staghorn
source: Given enough time, a POKENAME can dig through even the hardest of bedrock. Its burrows stretch past the point where any other Pokémon can survive.

entry: 它扇动翅膀，帮助稳定情绪，免得狂暴失控。据说，若失控或被迫自卫，只需几击，就能摧垮整座山。
author: sk372
source: It flaps its wings as a way to help keep its temperament even and not go on a rampage. Should it lose control or be forced to defend itself, it's said it could crumble a whole mountain with only a few strikes.

entry: 它用强健的角撞倒树木，划定领地。较弱的POKENAME则成群漫游，寻找更强的对手。
author: al_chimera
source: This Pokémon marks its territory by knocking down trees with its powerful horns. Weaker POKENAME roam in packs to seek stronger opponents.

entry: POKENAME身体沉重如石，却凭华美有力的翅膀，翱翔天际。以岩喙猛击地面，便能引发剧烈的地震波。
author: fiordaliso
