source: POKENAME manages to soar through the sky despite its heavy stone body, thanks to its majestic and powerful wings. By slamming its rock-hard beak into the ground, it can trigger violent seismic waves.

entry: POKENAME是令人畏惧的捕食者，强劲的触手几乎什么都能碾碎。它生活在深海，鲜少被人看见。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is a feared predator that can crush almost anything with its powerful tentacles. It lives deep underwater and is rarely seen.

entry: POKENAME绕着占据的山峰飞行，凶悍地守卫领地。若发现不受欢迎的访客，就会俯冲，用坚翼割松岩石，试图让落石砸中对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flies around mountain peaks it has claimed as territory, guarding it fiercely. If it spies an unwelcome guest, it flies down and uses its tough wings to carve rocks loose and attempt to bring falling rocks down upon them.

entry: POKENAME是领地意识极强的山鸟，皮肤坚韧得不可思议。它在陡坡也能平稳快跑，一旦盯上闯入者，对方便几乎无处可逃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a fiercely territorial mountain bird Pokémon with an impossibly tough hide. It can run smoothly and swiftly across steep inclines, making it all but impossible to escape once it catches sight of an intruder.

entry: 它被形容为冷酷无情、毫不宽容。领地意识极强，在野外，最关心的只有照顾自己的幼崽。
author: bobosmith01
source: It has been described as heartless and unforgiving. Extremely territorial, its only primary concern in the wild is taking care of its young.

entry: POKENAME爆发的火焰吐息，强到能将山坡化为碎石。近期研究提出，它的身体可能还能屏蔽辐射。
author: soup1900
source: The explosive fiery breath from POKENAME is extremely powerful, capable of reducing mountainsides to rubble. Recent studies suggest that its body can shield against radiation.

entry: POKENAME看见什么，就攻击、摧毁什么，不论是谁、是什么。某些地区的多次地震与山崩，已知都由它造成。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME will attack and destroy anything in its sight, no matter who or what it is. It has been known to be the cause of many earthquakes and landslides in certain areas.

entry: POKENAME爆发的火焰吐息，强到能将山坡化为碎石。近期研究提出，它的身体可能还能屏蔽辐射。
author: soup1900
source: The explosive fiery breath from POKENAME is extremely powerful, capable of reducing mountainsides to rubble. Recent studies suggest that its body can shield against radiation.

entry: 遭POKENAME肆虐的地方，都成了不毛荒地。世界各地的执法人员，已将它的栖息地，划为禁止进入的区域。
author: soup1900
source: Regions where a POKENAME has rampaged have been turned into barren wastelands. Locations where this Pokémon lives have been marked off-limits by law enforcement officers around the globe.

entry: POKENAME的刺生长参差、形状不规则，让物理攻击难以下手。它走到哪里，翻涌的沙就跟到哪里。
author: soup1900
source: The irregular growth and shape of POKENAME's spikes make it difficult to attack physically. Wherever this Pokémon roams, turbulent sands follow.

entry: POKENAME入睡后，周身荧光绿的斑点渐暗，直到漆黑。强壮、金属般的身体，让任何攻击都伤不到它。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME falls asleep, the neon green spots around its body dim until they become black. Its strong, metallic-like body prevents any attack from harming it.

entry: POKENAME一扇翼，就能把整座沙漠的沙，卷成一场巨大沙暴。巨力能劈开地面，造出巨沟，供自己睡觉。
author: soup1900
source: By flapping its wings, POKENAME could whip an entire desert's sand into a single massive sandstorm. With its immense power, it can split open the ground and create giant trenches for it to sleep in.

entry: POKENAME生气时，会使出跺脚，每跺一下，都释放储存的电力。狂暴中被击中的野生生物，都会被烤得焦黑。
author: soup1900
source: When angered, POKENAME lets loose a Stomping Tantrum that releases stored electricity with each stomp. All wildlife hit in its rampage becomes roasted to a blackened char.

entry: POKENAME习惯出现在不同时代，召来巨大沙暴，制造混乱与破坏。随后便穿越时间离开，对灾后的一切漠不关心。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has a habit of showing up in different time eras and summoning massive sandstorms that cause chaos and destruction. It then leaves by traveling through time, as it does not care what happens in the aftermath of its disaster.

entry: 有了新生的坚不可破之皮，POKENAME能承受迎面而来的重创。它十只成群，用冰冷的土质利爪，猎捕体型为自身十倍的宝可梦。
author: beatdoof
source: With its new impregnable hide, POKENAME is able to withstand severe damage from anything thrown its way. It hunts in a pack of ten, hunting Pokémon ten times bigger than them with their frigid, earthen claws.

entry: POKENAME是沙漠顶级猎手，从炮筒般的双臂喷出灼热沙流，轰击敌人。热量之强，能在撞击时，将沙漠的沙化为玻璃。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are desert apexes that blast their enemies with burning-hot sand loosed from their cannon-like arms. The heat of their sand-blasts can be so intense as to turn desert sand into glass upon impact.

entry: 激动时，叶子会变得坚硬，比任何打造的刀刃都锋利。POKENAME全力挥尾，凭坚硬利叶，一下就能斩开实心钢铁。
author: infinex21
source: When agitated, their leaves turn rigid and sharper than any crafted blade. By swinging its tail at full strength, with its leaves rigid and sharp, a POKENAME can cleave through solid steel in a single motion.

entry: POKENAME以残暴猎杀龙属性宝可梦而声名狼藉。它先用原始之力，击伤猎物的翅膀；对方一落地，就猛扑过去，吸食生命力，抽走龙的能量。
author: ghostslythe
source: Infamously brutal Dragon-type hunters, POKENAME start an assault using Ancient Power, clipping their prey's wings. Once grounded, they pounce, sapping the dragon's energy by feeding off its life force.

entry: POKENAME温柔的表象下，藏着庞大的力量。谁威胁朋友或训练家，它就以足够将山化为尘埃的超能力反击。
author: sk372
source: A massive amount of power hides behind POKENAME's gentle veneer. Should one threaten its friends or Trainer, it retaliates with enough psychic strength to crumble a mountain into dust.

entry: 这种宝可梦从头到脚布满尖刺，体力与防御都很惊人。厚重皮肤虽让行动迟缓，它却会从地下伏击猎物，弥补不足。
author: frokachu
source: Coated head to toe in sharp spikes, this Pokémon boasts impressive physical power and defensive strength. Though its bulky hide makes it slow, it compensates by ambushing prey from underground.

entry: POKENAME把爪刺进坚岩，攀上高处。发现下方猎物，就像石头般落下，常光靠撞击力，就能打倒目标。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will sink its claws into solid rock to climb up to high places. If it spots prey below, it will drop down like a stone, often taking down its target using the force of the impact alone.

entry: POKENAME既有破坏力，也很聪明。它细细分析建筑结构，再突然击中一个精准位置，让整栋建筑轰然倒塌。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is both destructive and intelligent. It spends its time carefully analysing the architecture of buildings before suddenly delivering a powerful strike to the exact spot that will bring the entire structure crashing down.

entry: POKENAME从容身的石头里伸出，像猛烈沙暴般，吹走闯入者。只有亲族，才能在它卷起的狂沙中安然无恙。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stretches out from the stone containing it and acts like a violent sandstorm, blowing away trespassers. Only members of their kin are safe from the raging tempests of sand it creates.

entry: POKENAME疾速飞行，寻找感知到的一切生灵，挑战战斗。为了接近感知中的敌人，它甚至会造出风刃，削倒山顶、斩开飞机。
author: soup1900
source: Flying around at blistering speeds, POKENAME seeks out every being it senses and challenges them to a battle. It will go as far as creating blades of wind to knock over mountaintops and slice planes open just to reach the foe it senses.

entry: 这种巨大宝可梦，背着一座小山，常有小型飞行宝可梦绕行。山上长出的果实极硬，含有毒素，必须烹调去除。
author: infinex21
source: This giant Pokémon carries a small mountain atop its back which is often encircled by smaller, aerial Pokémon. The fruits that grow upon this small mountain are incredibly tough and contain a poison that must be cooked out.

entry: POKENAME用双颚从山体咬下大块岩石，开凿洞穴。入侵者会迎来它的暴怒，随后被吞食。
author: hummusishome
source: POKENAME uses its jaws to tear chunks of rock out of mountainous terrain to create a cave. Intruders are met with fury and rage before being devoured.

entry: POKENAME把大片海岸据为领地，将岸边贝壳与石头堆成大丘，筑作巢穴。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME claims large swaths of coastline as its territory. It makes a nest by piling up shells and stones from the shore into a large hill.

entry: POKENAME什么都不懂，只知用岩石般的头猛撞眼前一切。连整片山脉都曾败在它面前。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME knows nothing else but to smash its rocky head into anything directly in front of it. Entire mountain ranges have lost to this Pokémon.

entry: 粗毛下的肌肉，比岩石更硬。它从不主动找架打，只等挑战者靠近，再以利爪与有力的尾巴还击。
author: .jerden
source: The muscles beneath its coarse fur are harder than rock. It never seeks out fights, but waits for challengers to approach it, then lashes out with its sharp claws and powerful tail.

entry: 粗毛下的肌肉，比岩石更硬。它从不主动找架打，只等挑战者靠近，再以利爪与有力的尾巴还击。
author: .jerden
source: The muscles beneath its coarse fur are harder than rock. It never seeks out fights, but waits for challengers to approach it, then lashes out with its sharp claws and powerful tail.

entry: 下半身的各个孔洞不断喷出沙子。战斗时，它便将这些受诅咒的沙卷成猛烈沙暴。
author: moopse
source: Sand spews from all of the orifices on its lower body. In battle, it whips this cursed sand into a harsh sandstorm.

entry: 为掩盖现身与消失，POKENAME用躯干四周源源生成的沙环，制造沙暴。只要愿意，它就能让巨大沙暴，覆盖整个地区。
author: sk372
source: To hides its appearance and disappearance, POKENAME creates sandstorms through the endlessly-generating ring of sand around its torso. If it wished, POKENAME could cover an entire region in a massive sandstorm.

entry: 它性情冰冷无情，却天生很会把战术融入战斗，例如借环境占优。它住在多岩的河谷。
author: bobosmith01
source: It has a cold and ruthless personality, and is surprisingly naturally adept at incorporating tactical strategy into fights, such as using the environment to its advantage. It lives by rocky river valleys.

entry: 野生POKENAME住在废弃矿井，拆掉矿车轨道筑巢。铠甲般的皮肤，让它连矿工引爆的爆破，也能毫发无伤地承受。
author: cobalt0135
source: Wild POKENAME can be seen living in abandoned mine shafts, disassembling minecart tracks to build their nests. Their armored hide allows them to withstand explosive demolitions set off by miners unscathed.

entry: POKENAME全身覆着岩鳞，沉重到从上方落下，就足以让猎物失去行动力。狂暴时，它会从口中喷沙，轰击敌人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is covered with rocky scales, making it heavy enough to incapacitate prey simply by dropping down on it from above. When POKENAME rampages, it attacks foes by blasting sand out of its mouth.

entry: POKENAME多孔的双翼飞快拍动，抬起沉重石身，搅出强烈气流。因此，只要贴地飞行，就会卷起尘暴。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's perforated wings beat rapidly to lift its heavy stone body into the air. This creates strong turbulence in the air around POKENAME, whipping up dust storms whenever it flies close to the ground.

entry: POKENAME在古代遗迹深处被发掘，身体发育出先进科技般的机关。科学家怀疑，地底电磁场，塑成了它独特的形态。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME was unearthed deep beneath ancient ruins, its body developing mechanisms that resemble advanced technology. Scientists suspect subterranean electromagnetic fields shaped its unique morphology.

entry: POKENAME吃矿物，常见于洞穴或山边。缎带般的触须，能轻易破开岩石，寻找下一餐。若它狂暴起来，洞穴通常难免坍塌。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME feed on minerals, so they are often found within caves or near mountains. Using their ribbon-like feelers, they easily break apart rock and stone in search of their next meal. If a POKENAME rampages, a cave-in is usually inevitable.

entry: POKENAME的力量，堪称天灾。一步就能碎山，或令陆地从海中隆起。口中涌出的岩浆洪流，只需数日，就能造出整片地区。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's power is cataclysmic. A single step can cause mountains to shatter or earth to sprout out of the sea. The overflowing torrent of magma it can spew from its mouth could create entire regions in mere days.

entry: 这些蛇形的龙属性宝可梦，在高山顶筑巢。谁打扰休息，就会迎来毁灭性的破坏光线与接连落石，直到不再出声。
author: infinex21
source: These serpentine Dragon-type Pokémon build their nests atop tall mountains. Anything that interrupts their rest will be met with devastating Hyper Beams and continuous rock slides until silenced.

entry: POKENAME把沙舀进炮中，储存备战。战斗一开始，就持续喷沙，瞄准对手的眼睛与裸露皮肤。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME scoop sand into their cannons, storing it up in preparation for battle. When a fight breaks out, they release their sand in a steady stream, aiming for the eyes and exposed skin of their opponent.

entry: POKENAME身体极强，才能撑起背上的巨岩。休息的山里，常留着战斗的创痕；它几乎总能凭纯粹的力量取胜。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's body is incredibly strong to support the weight of the large rocks upon its back. The mountains in which they rest are often marred by the scars of their battles that they almost-always win through sheer strength.

entry: POKENAME是荒原顶级强者，巡行家园，确信无人敢与自己为敌。它会凶猛追逐领地中的一切，研究行为的学者，可得格外谨慎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: An apex Pokémon, POKENAME stalks its wasteland home in the certainty that there is nothing that can challenge it. Pokémon researchers trying to learn its behaviors need to remain wary as it aggressively chases down anything in its territory.

entry: POKENAME曾驻守最受尊崇的古王陵墓，守护财物。盗墓者若愚蠢地妄图偷取，就会被不断生出的沙制肢体，埋在下面。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME were stationed in the tombs of the most revered of ancient kings to watch over their possessions. Graverobbers that foolishly thought to steal would be buried beneath POKENAME's endlessly-spawning limbs of sand.

entry: POKENAME挥尾打飞对手，或用强钳碾碎。它能在尾巴中充电、储电，再从尾尖释放强力闪电。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME will swing their tails about to send their opponents flying or crush them with their strong pincers. They charge and store electricity within their tails, which they can then release as powerful lightning bolts from the tip.

entry: POKENAME领地意识凶猛，却受视力限制。为扳平劣势，它会把土踢进对手眼中，让对方更难抵抗强力的乱打。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has fierce territorial instincts yet is hampered by limited vision. To even its playing field, it kicks dirt into opponents' eyes, leaving them more vulnerable to its powerful thrashing.

entry: POKENAME的两个头，会贪婪地吃掉够得到的一切，连坚岩也不例外。食欲无穷，能把原本实心的山崖与山坡，吃出洞穴和山谷。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's two heads ravenously consume anything in reach, including solid stone. Their appetite is so insatiable that they can carve out caves and valleys into previously solid cliffs and hillsides.

entry: POKENAME四处飞行，常将六翼拍得足以卷起沙暴。中央的头专注攻击其他宝可梦，臂端的两个头，却似乎同样热衷于吃石头与土。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME flies around, often beating its six wings fast enough to whip up sandstorms. While the central head focuses on attacking other Pokémon, the two heads at the ends of its arms seem to be just as interested in eating rocks and soil.

entry: POKENAME四处飞行，常将六翼拍得足以卷起沙暴。中央的头专注攻击其他宝可梦，臂端的两个头，却似乎同样热衷于吃石头与土。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME flies around, often beating its six wings fast enough to whip up sandstorms. While the central head focuses on attacking other Pokémon, the two heads at the ends of its arms seem to be just as interested in eating rocks and soil.

entry: POKENAME一占下山脉，就会在空中高速绕行。飞行卷起厚重沙暴，阻止来者侵犯领地。
author: sk372
source: Once POKENAME claims a mountain range for itself, it circles it rapidly in midair. The speed of its flying kicks up a heavy sandstorm that helps deter intruders from invading its claimed territory.

entry: 过去，POKENAME曾受训，保护神祠免遭盗窃。胸甲的孔既散发体热，也能让强大的咆哮回荡，传出数英里。
author: chibitales
source: In the past, POKENAME were trained to guard shrines from would-be thieves. The holes on their chest plate serve to vent heat from within their body and echo their mighty roar for several miles.

entry: POKENAME能射出球体，爆开就是猛烈翻涌的沙暴。研究显示，风暴物质看似普通沙子，其实是并非来自本星球的矿物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can create projectile orbs that burst into intensely raging sandstorms. Research has shown that despite appearing like normal sand, the material of the storms is a mineral not of this planet.

entry: POKENAME一在地下，就是数年，吸收树根的营养，为进化作准备。据说，等待进化期间，一只就能吃掉相当于整座森林的树木。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME live underground for years at a time, absorbing nutrients from tree roots to evolve. It is said that a single POKENAME could consume an entire forest's worth of trees while waiting for its evolution.

entry: 构成POKENAME大部分头骨的材料，极其坚硬强韧。一记头槌，就足以将实心钢梁打得几乎碎裂。
author: sk372
source: The material that makes up the majority of POKENAME's skull is incredibly hard and resilient. A single headbutt is enough to nearly shatter a solid steel beam.

entry: POKENAME有沉重的实心岩壳保护，移动很慢，食欲却旺盛得惊人。它大多吃石头，只是因为其他宝可梦大多跑得够快，能逃掉。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is protected by a heavy shell made of solid rock and moves around very slowly. It has a ravenous hunger, and while it mostly eats stone, this is only because most other Pokémon flee fast enough to escape it.

entry: POKENAME强大又傲慢，欺负领地里的其他生物，想成为最高首领。最后总免不了惹上远比自己强大的对象，吃尽苦头。
author: sk372
source: Powerful and haughty, POKENAME bullies others in its territory, trying to establish itself as the top of the hierarchy. It inevitably winds up picking on something much stronger than itself and learning a harsh lesson.

entry: POKENAME坚韧的石甲，抵御着攻击。它出了名地易怒，会失控地四处乱撞，直到平静下来。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's tough stony plating protects it from attacks. This Pokémon is known to be quick to anger, thrashing about uncontrollably until it settles down.

entry: POKENAME性情凶暴，很少睡觉，始终被饥饿与怒火驱使。铠甲上的呼吸孔，让脑部得到更充足的氧气。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's ferocious temperament means it rarely sleeps, driven by hunger and rage at all times. The breathing holes in its armor let it better oxygenate its brain.

entry: POKENAME身体虽小，头部连着的粗大腿足，却强到几跺就能把坚岩碾成细粒。它很容易翻松干硬土壤，因此有些农场主会用它帮忙。
author: infinex21
source: Although POKENAME have small bodies, their large, head-bound legs are strong enough to pulverize solid rock into small grains within a few stomps. Because they can so easily churn tough, dry soil, they have been utilized by some farmers.

entry: 野生POKENAME住在崎岖山顶，选能看清所有来路的位置。谁试着攀上去，就会被它引发的地震与落石，打回下面。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME live atop rugged mountains, choosing locations where they can clearly see every approach. Anyone who tries to climb up to them will be knocked back down by the earth tremors and rockslides POKENAME creates.

entry: POKENAME先深吸气，再从背上蘑菇的孔排出。风力足以卷起沙暴，把真菌孢子带到远方。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will inhale deeply, then expel the air through pores in the mushroom on its back. The winds this produces are strong enough to whip up a sandstorm, carrying spores from the fungus a great distance.

entry: POKENAME毫不怕人，常在紧邻人类聚落的山坡筑巢。若无人能捕捉或驱走，通常建议人们赶在它狂暴前，搬离此地。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lacks any fear of humans and will often build its nest on mountainsides right next to human settlements. If nobody can capture or drive away the POKENAME, it is generally advised to move away before it rampages.

entry: 臂上的尖刺由实心岩石构成，出拳能撕碎一切。它打击敌人常猛得连鳞片都脱落，但很快又会长回。
author: .jerden
source: The spikes on its arms are made of solid rock and will shred anything it punches. It often hits foes so hard that these scales fall off, but they will quickly regrow.

entry: POKENAME覆着岩石鳞甲，有力的拳头与带刺尾巴，威力毁灭性十足。但它只对值得较量的对手，施展全力。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is covered by scaly armor made of rock. It can swing its strong fists and spiky tail with devastating force, but will only use its full power against worthy opponents.

entry: POKENAME的爪，快得能将海水、甚至空气一分为二；身体的力量，足以摧山。两者合一，便无法阻挡。
author: exc_sanguine_wes/xs_wes
source: In its claws, POKENAME has the speed to cleave seawater, or even air, in two. In its body, it has the power to crumble a mountain. Combined, POKENAME cannot be stopped.

entry: POKENAME住在地底深处，极压让岩石身体变成钻石。钻石几乎坚不可摧，能轻易挡下任何攻击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives deep underground, the extreme pressure transforming its rocky body into diamonds. Its diamonds are basically indestructible, effortlessly shrugging off any sort of attack.

entry: POKENAME操纵沙，造出弹体与沙暴，更好地隐蔽。它还给舌头覆沙，既保护舌头，也让它更能抓牢东西。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME can manipulate sand to create projectiles and sandstorms for better stealth. POKENAME coats its tongue with sand to protect it and increase its grip.

entry: POKENAME从壳与鼻孔，排出烟雾和沙粒的混合物。一次大量喷出，就能造出浓厚沙暴，掩护逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME emits a mixture of smoke and sand particles from its shell and nostrils. Forcing out massive amounts at once creates thick sandstorms that mask its escape.

entry: POKENAME背上排出的云很浓，还混着沙粒。受到威胁，它便大量喷出，造出遮挡视线的沙暴。
author: sk372
source: The clouds emitted from POKENAME's back are thick and mixed with sand particles. It blows out a large amount to create an obscuring sandstorm when it feels threatened.

entry: POKENAME挖隧道的力道太大，经过之处，地面也随之裂开。身体石甲极硬，连金属镐的打击，也能弹开。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME digs its tunnels with such force that the ground cracks apart as it passes. Its body is covered in stone armor so hard that it can even deflect the blows of a metal pickaxe.

entry: POKENAME挖完精巧的隧道网络，就会钻出地面，发出强力咆哮。冬季为免冻僵，它挖得更深，试着靠近星球核心。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME finishes digging its intricate network of tunnels, it emerges from the ground and lets out a powerful roar. During the winter, to avoid freezing, it digs deeper into the ground, seeking to get closer to the planet's core.

entry: POKENAME护领地护得厉害，常在巨石上磨爪，留下记号警告闯入者。登山者最好留意爪痕，免得无意撞见它。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME is extremely territorial. They often sharpen their claws on large boulders to mark its domain to intruders. Hikers are warned to keep an eye out for scratched boulders to avoid unintended encounters with this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在烈日下冥想，从热与尘中汲取力量。全力施展时，意念能让沙漠表面，像水一样荡漾。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME meditates beneath the harsh sun, drawing strength from heat and dust alike. At full power, its mind can ripple the desert surface like water.

entry: 一只POKENAME曾借沙暴掩护，以吐息将沙化为玻璃，独自挡住整支军队，因此被称为“沙之将军”。
author: therider
source: Called the "General of the Sands", a lone POKENAME once held off an army by using a sandstorm as cover and turning the sand to glass with its breath.

entry: POKENAME是优秀的空战好手。身体虽覆沉重的实心岩甲，翅膀却足够强，能轻松翱翔。它先用沙暴迷惑对手，再将其击倒。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an excellent aerial fighter. Despite its body being covered in a heavy armor of solid rock, its wings are powerful enough to let it soar through the skies with ease. It unleashes sandstorms to disorient foes before striking them down.

entry: POKENAME以超能力，将紧实的沙塑成汤匙，帮助集中精神、平定脾气。没有汤匙，怒火就会吞没理智，在周围掀起毁灭性的精神灾变。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME formulates spoons out of tightly-packed sand using its psychic powers. Possessing these spoons helps it focus its mind and temper; without them, it would lose its mind to rage and create a devastating psychic cataclysm around it.

entry: 有人说，POKENAME的铠甲由坠落陨石制成。若能卸下铠甲，它就能以全力出拳，夷平整片山脉。
author: ghostslythe
source: Some say POKENAME makes its armor out of crashed meteorites. If its armor was ever removed it would be able to punch at full power and level a mountain range.

entry: POKENAME是肌肉强健的巨兽，四臂几分钟内就能把山打成尘土，再用剩下的碎石，卷起巨大沙暴。
author: sk372
source: A mighty muscular behemoth of a Pokémon, POKENAME's four arms can pummel a mountain to dust in minutes, before creating a massive sandstorm with the remaining rubble.

entry: POKENAME沙质的鳞片紧密排列，大多数攻击都无从穿透。战斗中，它能迸散鳞片，化为巨大沙暴，遮挡视线，更容易冲倒、碾碎敌人。
author: sk372
source: The sandy scales of POKENAME are tightly packed and impenetrable to most attacks. In battle it can burst its scales into a massive sandstorm to obscure vision, making it easier to charge down and crush its foes.

entry: POKENAME身体硬重如实心岩石，双腿却强到能连续奔行数小时，才需休息。它也能从体侧开口喷火，进一步压制、威吓对手。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have bodies as hard and heavy as solid rock, yet their legs are strong enough to carry them for hours before they need to rest. They can release flames from the openings along their bodies to further overpower and intimidate opponents.

entry: POKENAME凭气体身体穿过岩壁，轻易便能震动整座洞穴。现象吓人，却没那么危险，因为力道很少足以引发坍塌。
author: quackquackattack
source: By relying on its gaseous body to slip through walls, POKENAME can shake entire caves with minimal effort. This phenomenon is more frightening than it is dangerous, as it rarely has enough force to cause cave-ins.

entry: POKENAME召来遮天蔽目的沙暴，将受害者完全困住，借此狩猎。登山者说，没有什么比看见它的恶魔笑容，从旋沙墙中浮现，更令人恐惧。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hunts by conjuring up blinding sandstorms that trap its victims completely. Hikers say nothing is more terrifying than seeing POKENAME's demonic grin appearing from within the walls of whirling sand.

entry: POKENAME会闯入大钳蟹的群落，向其中的巨钳蟹挑衅。巨钳蟹一旦落败，POKENAME便开始在群落里作威作福。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME are known to target colonies of Krabby to start fights with their Kinglers. If the Kinglers lose, then POKENAME begins to rule as a tyrant.

entry: POKENAME口中的炮，既能发泥，也能发射高压水，用来抵御侵入洞穴家园的来者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can fire both mud and pressurized water from the cannon in its mouth. It uses this to defend its cavern home from intruders.

entry: POKENAME从海岛深洞发出悲鸣。响亮的哀号，一英里多外也能听见，有时还伴着海中突然形成的漩涡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME cries out from deep island caves. Its loud mournful call can be heard from over a mile away and is sometimes accompanied by the forming of sudden whirlpools within the sea.

entry: POKENAME的拳力，足以造出强劲阵风。最有代表性的一招，是上勾拳，拳头卷出龙卷，将敌人包在其中打飞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's fists strike with enough force to create powerful gusts of wind. Its most iconic technique is an uppercut that sends its foe flying within a tornado its fist generates.

entry: POKENAME的三个幼崽，模样像关都传说鸟宝可梦的幼年版。研究者始终无法靠得够近，因为它会用强大的风与水，赶走所有试图接近者。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's three offspring resemble infant versions of the Kanto region's Legendary Birds. No researcher has been able to get close enough to study them, as POKENAME drives away anyone who tries with powerful blasts of air and water.

entry: 多种古代文明，将POKENAME描绘为某种天神，因其外表与力量，又敬又怕。六翼只需几秒，就能卷起烈风，与噼啪放电的雷云。
author: sk372
source: Several ancient civilizations depict POKENAME as some type of celestial deity, feared and revered for its appearance and powers. Its six wings can whip up gale-force winds and crackling storm clouds in mere seconds.

entry: POKENAME对风十分敏感，尤其是海岸微风。叫声似乎能在一定程度上控制海水运动，稍稍平息附近的激流。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is highly attuned to the winds, particularly coastal breezes. Its cry seems to have some control over the ocean movements, partially calming rough currents in its vicinity.

entry: POKENAME能快速转动头与四肢，潜在水下时，便可造出强大漩涡。它有时被用于守卫近海或水下研究站。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can rotate its head and limbs at quick enough speeds to create mighty whirlpools when submerged underwater. It's sometimes been used to guard offshore and underwater research stations.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间，都在海底安稳睡觉。若被吵醒，就会闹着脾气，在周围卷起重重漩涡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends much of its time sleeping peacefully at the bottom of the sea. If awoken from its slumber, it creates swirling whirlpools all around it in a grumpy fit.

entry: 这种宝可梦色彩绚丽，谁敲得响它最爱的玩具鼓，它便热切靠近。赢得信任与尊重后，它还会载你飞翔，环游世界。
author: jackster
source: A brilliantly-colored Pokémon which will eagerly approach any Trainer that manages to play its favorite toy drum. This magnificent creature will carry you around as it flies across the globe, but only once you earn its trust and respect.

entry: 它一察觉有东西靠近，就立刻隐形，因此鲜少被看见。有人说，它是怕自己的超能力，或怕别人试图利用那庞大的力量。
author: imaginita
source: It is very rarely seen since it turns invisible the moment it senses anything approaching. Some claim this is because it is scared of its own psychic power, or of people who would try to exploit those vast powers.

entry: POKENAME挥动头上翼状的附肢，制造强风，用来吹落树果、绊倒敌人。若没稳稳站住，有时也会不小心把自己吹退。
author: chibitales
source: By waving the wing-like appendage on its head, POKENAME creates strong gusts of wind. It uses this ability to knock berries from trees and trip up foes. If it doesn't plant itself firmly in the ground, it may blow itself backwards by accident.

entry: 这种小宝可梦潜力无穷，能制造噼啪带电的烈风。POKENAME的风暴太强，连轻巧的自己，也很容易被吹退。
author: sk372
source: Packed with potential, this tiny Pokémon is capable of producing gale-force winds crackling with electricity. POKENAME's storms are so powerful that it easily blows its lightweight body back from the force of the wind it generates.

entry: POKENAME性情任性，稍有不快，就会放声大哭。哭声中，强风在周身翻卷，开始形成小小的风暴与龙卷。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a petulant personality and won't hesitate to loudly bawl if it is displeased in any way. As it cries, powerful winds whip about it and begin forming tiny storms and tornadoes.

entry: POKENAME每天静静待在陡峭海崖上，凝望海洋。许多人相信，它能用超能力预知风暴，过去还称它为“海之贤者”。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME spend their days silently gazing over the ocean on top of steep coastal cliffs. Many believe they can predict the coming of storms with their psychic abilities, and they were once called "Sages of the Sea".

entry: POKENAME被认为是来自深空某处的友善访客。食欲大得惊人，饱餐后，还会迸出强大能量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is thought to be a friendly visitor from somewhere deep in space. It's known to have a gargantuan appetite, and creates a strong burst of energy after gorging itself.

entry: POKENAME极稀有，但一听见它叫，附近的鸟宝可梦都会聚来，暂时放下彼此的敌意。聚会目的不明，却能见到它与大家一同玩耍。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are very rare, but when its call is heard, bird Pokémon from all around flock to it, temporarily ceasing hostilities between each other. The purpose of these meetings is unknown, though POKENAME can be seen playing with others during them.

entry: POKENAME极稀有，但一听见它叫，附近的鸟宝可梦都会聚来，暂时放下彼此的敌意。人类会被赶离聚会，因此目的仍不清楚。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are very rare, but when its call is heard, bird Pokémon from all around flock to it, temporarily ceasing hostilities between each other. Humans are driven away from these meetings, so their purpose is still unclear.

entry: 据说，帕底亚只有在漫长又凶险的洪水过后，才会出现POKENAME。也有人认为，这不过是传说。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are only spotted in Paldea after a long, dangerous flood. Others say this is only a myth, though.

entry: 在海上，POKENAME召来猛烈的风与洋流，操纵水。水流绕身汇聚时，有人发现，翻卷的水竟会塑成奇怪符号。
author: sk372
source: When over the ocean, POKENAME calls forth aggressive winds and ocean currents to manipulate the waters. As the water funnels around it, some have noticed the whipping water shaping into strange symbols.

entry: 它住在宁静森林的湖底。若醒来发现森林原址变成城市，就会摧毁附近每一栋建筑。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It makes its home at the bottom of lakes in quiet forests. If it wakes up and finds a city where its forest once was, it will demolish every building in the area.

entry: POKENAME的液体身体，即使水下也能保持形状。它住在海底地热喷口，腹部的光，刺破深海黑暗。
author: griddle
source: Its liquid body retains its shape even underwater. POKENAME makes its home in geothermal vents on the ocean floor, where it pierces the darkness of the deep with its glowing belly.

entry: 它用宽尾作调色板，盛放颜料。回海里，颜料便会被冲掉，因此总会充分利用手头的颜料。
author: cait_sith
source: It uses its broad tail as a palette for its paints. When it returns to the sea, these paints are washed off, so it makes the most of any paints it currently has.

entry: POKENAME保护着世界海洋，会净化漏油后的水。它睡在海底洞穴，传说一旦醒来，就会有持续40天的风暴。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are known to protect the world's oceans, purifying water after oil spills. POKENAME sleep at the bottom of oceans in caves, with tales saying that if one wakes up from its slumber, a 40-day storm will occur.

entry: POKENAME展开双翼，再向后排出压缩气体，就能短暂飞行。若训练不当，释放的气压，强到足以在建筑上撕出洞。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are capable of short bursts of flight by extending their wings wide and then ejecting compressed gas behind themselves. The pressure of the gas they release is powerful enough to tear holes in buildings if they are improperly trained.

entry: 据说深色身体与红眼，是接触罕见能量波的结果。此现象最早记录于欧雷地区。
author: staghorn
source: Its dark coloration and red eyes is said to be the result of exposure to rare energy waves. The phenomenon was first recorded in the Orre region.

entry: POKENAME能在飞过的海域制造强大风暴，雷电与风，足以撕裂民用船只。幸好，它会尽量避免，至今也未确认造成过事故。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: POKENAME can cause powerful storms in the seas it flies above. The lightning and wind caused by these storms can tear apart civilian ships, but fortunately, it avoids this when possible and has not been confirmed to cause any incidents.

entry: 古文曾称，洛奇亚与凤王的羁绊极深，宛如同一只宝可梦。多数历史研究不认可这种解读，却仍有人相信，它们曾是一体，后来分裂；那个存在，便是POKENAME。
author: bobosmith01
source: It was once written that the bond between Lugia and Ho-Oh was so strong that it was like they were one Pokémon. Although most historical studies disagree with this interpretation, some believe they were once one being that eventually split: POKENAME.

entry: 古文曾称，洛奇亚与凤王的羁绊极深，宛如同一只宝可梦。多数历史研究不认可这种解读，却仍有人相信，它们曾是一体，后来分裂；那个存在，便是POKENAME。
author: bobosmith01
source: It was once written that the bond between Lugia and Ho-Oh was so strong that it was like they were one Pokémon. Although most historical studies disagree with this interpretation, some believe they were once one being that eventually split: POKENAME.

entry: 古文曾称，洛奇亚与凤王的羁绊极深，宛如同一只宝可梦。多数历史研究不认可这种解读，却仍有人相信，它们曾是一体，后来分裂；那个存在，便是POKENAME。
author: bobosmith01
source: It was once written that the bond between Lugia and Ho-Oh was so strong that it was like they were one Pokémon. Although most historical studies disagree with this interpretation, some believe they were once one being that eventually split: POKENAME.

entry: 传说，有些热带风暴还没登陆，就在海上消散，是POKENAME为免大灾，出手平息。虽未找到科学证据，数百年来，却不断有风暴后见它沿海飞行的记录。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Legends claim that tropical storms that fade at sea before they can hit land were quelled by POKENAME to prevent great disasters. While no scientific proof has been found, POKENAME has been spotted flying along coasts after storms for centuries.

entry: POKENAME常在海滩与海岸附近钻地，移动、筑巢。有人将其视为害兽，宝可梦巡护员却视为伙伴，因为它会袭击向海里扔垃圾的人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are common near beaches and coastlines, burrowing into the terrain to travel and to create their nests. Some consider them to be pests, but Pokémon Rangers consider them allies because they will assail those who throw waste into the ocean.

entry: POKENAME将各部位转得够快，就能造出巨大龙卷。强劲的风柱会随机瞬移，卷走附近一切，制造混乱。
author: sk372
source: Twirling its body parts around fast enough lets POKENAME create massive tornadoes. These mighty funnels of wind teleport around at random, creating chaos as they vacuum up everything nearby.

entry: POKENAME的前肢既作翼，也作手臂与手，力道足以将坚岩碾成沙。激动时，蓝色鬃毛会硬化，锋利如剃刀，形成危险的防线。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's forelimbs function as wings yet also as arms and hands, which pack enough power to pulverize solid rock into sand. Its mane of blue fur hardens and becomes razor-sharp when it is agitated, offering it a hazardous defense.

entry: POKENAME用敏感的鳍，感知潮汐变化，察觉数英里外将至的风暴。它常在岸边筑石墙，防止附近城镇受淹，再消失在水中。
author: santon5512
source: By sensing the changes in the tides with their sensitive fins, POKENAME can sense incoming storms from miles away. They are often seen building stone walls along the shore to prevent flooding in nearby towns before disappearing into the water.

entry: POKENAME能走在水面，连涟漪都不泛起。它不在水下游泳，而是操纵周围的水，像拉帘一样分开，始终不沾湿。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has the ability to walk on the surface of the water without even causing a ripple. Instead of swimming underwater, it controls the water around it, parting it as one would a set of curtains. It never gets wet.

entry: 它们优雅而令人安心，拍翼声如银铃。但若惹怒POKENAME，就会置身狂风暴雨之中。
author: quote.lass
source: They are elegant and soothing, with wings that sound like silver bells. Make POKENAME angry, however, and you'll find yourself in a tempest.

entry: POKENAME常沉稳又慈爱，喜欢照顾、庇护别人。若受照料的孩子开始胡闹，POKENAME便会严肃告诫，及时纠正。
author: mileysakiko
source: POKENAME are often stoic and matronly, known for their tendency to take others under their wing. If their charge begins to act out, POKENAME are swift to correct this poor behavior with a stern warning.

entry: POKENAME的楔石由磨亮的白银构成。它从石中现身，空气里就响起漩涡声，与悦耳的铃声。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME's keystone is composed of polished silver. When POKENAME emerges from the stone, the sounds of whirlpools and melodic bells fill the air.

entry: POKENAME被视为海洋守护者。强大的波导感应，让它立刻确定海上灾害的位置，飞去拯救遭难者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is considered a guardian of the oceans. With its powerful aura sense, it can locate disasters at sea immediately, flying to them to save them from their fate.

entry: POKENAME破坏潜力极大，双翼稍不小心，就会引发山中雪崩。被逼迫时，它用这力量保卫家园，却更喜欢独自隐居。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have great destructive potential, the movement of their wings creating avalanches in the mountains if they're not careful. They use this power to defend their homes when pushed, but prefer to isolate themselves.

entry: 古代水手曾给POKENAME供品，盼着航行顺利。据说，若供品冒犯了它，它就召来猛烈海暴，沉船，再吞食船上所有灵魂。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME was once offered tribute by sailors in ancient times in hopes of smooth sailing. It was said that if it was offended by the offering, it would summon violent sea storms to sink the ship and devour the souls of all who were aboard.

entry: 有些古代水手，故意将船驶入漩涡，相信POKENAME住在里面，能用神力，迅速引自己到达目的地。
author: .izik
source: Some ancient sailors deliberately sailed into whirlpools, believing POKENAME dwelled within. They trusted it would guide them swiftly to their destination using divine powers.

entry: POKENAME只需挥动一次利刃，就能摧毁房屋。因此，它平时会将刀刃收回鞘中，在海底休息。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: With a slash of its blade, POKENAME can destroy houses. As a result, it chooses to rest sheathed in the ocean floor.

entry: 只有狂暴风雨中，才偶尔能见到POKENAME。据说它每挥一次刀，就能砍倒整座森林。它以此追猎其他劈斩司令，证明自己最强。
author: animecreep4
source: Very rare sightings of POKENAME only happen during raging storms. POKENAME is said to take down entire forests every time it slashes its blade. It uses these slashes to hunt for other Bisharp to prove it's the strongest.

entry: POKENAME住在深海，鲜少被看见。它能用超能力驱散雷云，因此被赞为水手的守护者。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is seldom seen, as it lives in the depths of the ocean. It is hailed as a guardian of sailors, as it has been known to disperse stormclouds with its psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME独居孤岛或海边洞穴。只需缎带碰水，就能造出漩涡与巨浪，驱退打扰家园的来者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives a solitary life on lonely islands or seaside caverns. To repel those who would disturb its home, it can cause whirlpools and strong ocean waves just by touching its ribbons to the water.

entry: POKENAME暴怒时，会释放猛烈得惊人的暴雨洪流。因此，水手都避开它沉睡的海域。
author: mepp.
source: When POKENAME becomes enraged, it unleashes overwhelmingly violent torrents of rain. As a result, sailors steer clear of waters where POKENAME slumbers.

entry: 遇过POKENAME的人，报告曾梦见天灾毁掉家乡城镇。有些人因此将它视为灾厄预兆。
author: reiofsunshine1123
source: Those who have encountered POKENAME report nightmares of natural disasters destroying their towns and cities. Some view it as an omen of disaster.

entry: POKENAME的大翅膀发光时，能制造巨大漩涡，持续数月，让它能在岛上安静生活，无人靠近。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME's large wing glows, it can generate massive whirlpools. These persist for months, allowing it to live peacefully on islands without others drawing close.

entry: POKENAME是可怕的自然力量，会在海上造出猛烈雷雨，又用风暴与狂暴漩涡，围住偏远岛上的家，阻止人类靠近。
author: sk372
source: A terrifying force of nature, POKENAME uses its power to create violent thunderstorms over the ocean. It surrounds its remote island home with these storms as well as raging whirlpools to keep humans away.

entry: POKENAME从植物般的手中，造出带刺的水鞭，抽打来者。挥鞭力道，足以在海上掀起巨浪，让它成为不容小觑的可怕存在。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lashes at others by creating thorny whips made of water from within its plant-like hands. These whips can swing with enough force to create massive waves at sea, making it a terrible force to reckon with.

entry: POKENAME虽喜欢避开正面战斗，却绝非没有自保能力。耳朵只挥几下，就能掀起强风，甚至在海上造出巨浪。
author: sk372
source: Although POKENAME prefers to avoid direct combat, it is far from helpless. Its ears can kick up large winds with a few swings, enough so that it can create huge waves in large bodies of water.

entry: POKENAME住在北极，或在冰下休息，或与北极光共舞于天际。往返两处时，身体的细胞结构会改变，适应悬殊的压力差。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME lives at the North Pole, with it either resting under the ice or dancing in the sky with the northern lights. When moving between the two areas, the cellular structure of POKENAME's body changes to account for the stark pressure difference.

entry: POKENAME虽小，超能力却极强。使用能力，会累得精疲力尽，因此大半生都在巨树根下休息，极难见到。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite its small size, POKENAME possesses immense psychic powers. It spends most of its life resting beneath the roots of great trees, as using its abilities drains it to complete exhaustion. For this reason, it is an extremely rare sight.

entry: POKENAME过着隐居生活，或许正如某些故事所说，是因为体内沉睡着庞大力量。不过，一旦与谁结下羁绊，它在对方面前，便会格外善于表达情感。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live reclusive lives, potentially due to the immense power that some stories claim to be lying dormant within them. Despite being innately reclusive, POKENAME are notably very expressive around those they develop bonds with.

entry: POKENAME只需吃很少的电，就能饱。但饱后常会打嗝，喷出巨大的电流束，因此人们密切追踪成群的它们。
author: fenri_fox
source: POKENAME requires very little electricity to eat its fill; however, when full, it tends to burp out massive bolts of electrical discharge. As such, groups of POKENAME are tracked extensively.

entry: POKENAME凭惊人的超能力，在深海转动身体，制造巨大漩涡。覆毒的刺，则阻止其他生物靠近，免得睡眠被打扰。
author: fiordaliso
source: Thanks to its incredible psychic powers, POKENAME is able to create giant whirlpools by rotating its body in the depths of the ocean. Its poison-coated stingers serve to keep others away and prevent them from waking it from its sleep.

entry: POKENAME的角能操纵附近水域，让水浮起，像鞭子般挥打。受控的水也会充满毒素，被淋中，就会身中剧毒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's horn can manipulate nearby bodies of water, levitating it and lashing currents around like whips. Water controlled by it also fills with toxins, so those drenched by its water will also become heavily poisoned.

entry: POKENAME常在海边洞穴安家，领地意识很强。它放声咆哮，召来烈风，将闯入者吹离地盘。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tends to make its home around caverns that border the ocean's edge. Highly territorial, it lets out bellowing roars that summon gale-force winds used to blow away any intruders to its domain.

entry: 很久以前，海滨村落相信，POKENAME优雅的舞能召来毁灭风暴，与海难亡者的复仇之灵。信仰渐淡，有些村落仍循传统，保留神祠安抚它。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: Long ago, coastal villages believed that POKENAME's elegant dance could summon devastating storms and vengeful spirits of those lost at sea. Though this belief has faded over time, some villages keep shrines to appease POKENAME out of tradition.

entry: 有故事说，POKENAME经历了大量恶梦，才变成这副模样。这种状态下，它抗拒亲近，谁靠得太近，就会遭它厉声斥退。
author: infinex21
source: Stories claim that POKENAME achieve this appearance from having been exposed to an abundance of nightmares. In this state, POKENAME actively resists affection and will audibly lash out at those who come too close.

entry: POKENAME振翅，鳞片铿锵相碰，阵阵风将声音传开。它穿过雷云飞行，把自己的动静，藏进雷鸣里。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: When a POKENAME flaps its wings, its scales clang against each other and produce bursts of wind that carry the noise. POKENAME fly through storm clouds to hide their presence among the thunder.

entry: POKENAME以优雅姿态受人喜爱。不过，它偶尔也笨手笨脚，长臂常会碰倒贵重物品。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is beloved for its grace and elegance. Despite this, it can be clumsy at times and tends to knock over valuables with its long arms.

entry: POKENAME取来珍珠贝的珍珠，用力量改造，制成法杖。它以超能力平息海浪，救助遭凶暴宝可梦与海盗袭击的对象。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME form their staves from taking Clampearl's pearl and transforming it with their power. They use their psychic abilities to calm the seas and rescue anyone that has been attacked by vicious Pokémon and pirates.

entry: 单看属性很难想到，POKENAME竟如此亲水。它能操纵水，充当自己的附肢。
author: hophoppip
source: Despite its typing, POKENAME has an amplified affinity with water. It commands water to serve as its appendages.

entry: 尾焰的鲜明程度与强弱，反映着健康，温度足以熔化近旁大多数金属。据说，POKENAME潜力极大，或许因此，总急着挑战别人。
author: infinex21
source: Its tail flame, whose vibrancy and intensity reflect the health of the Pokémon, burns hot enough that it can melt most metals within close proximity. Supposedly, POKENAME harbors immense potential, which may be why it is so eager to battle others.

entry: POKENAME常在幽暗海底深处，避免与其他对象接触。它不耐过度刺激，潜水员照亮眼睛，就会让它头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often are found at the dark depths of the ocean where they avoid contact with others. They have a low tolerance for being overstimulated, and get headaches from divers shining light into their eyes.

entry: POKENAME守护海洋，与其他水生宝可梦共同生活。泳技超群，几分钟内便能横越海洋，赶到遇险的宝可梦身边。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are guardians of the sea and live among other aquatic Pokémon. Their superb swimming skills allow them to cross oceans within minutes to reach a Pokémon in distress.

entry: POKENAME大多沉睡于深海沟。只一扇翼，就能造出夹满火焰的巨大暴风，灼烧敌人。神话中，它守护世界海洋，轰走污染者。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME spend most of their time sleeping deep within trenches. With a flap of their wings they can create large, fire-filled Hurricanes to scorch foes. In mythology, POKENAME protected the world's oceans, blasting away those who polluted them.

entry: POKENAME力量惊人，似乎既体现为蛮力，也体现为炽热鲜亮的火焰。它乐于迎接任何挑战，仿佛炫耀力量；有人推测，只是在消耗过剩的精力。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME commands remarkable power, which seems to manifest as raw strength and as intensely hot and vibrant flames. It relishes in taking on any challenge, as if to show off its power; some speculate it does this to work off excess energy.

entry: 有个神话说，POKENAME每只手，分别代表东南西北一个风向。当多股气团汇成风暴，便是它动用了不止一条手臂，保护城都，免受别处危险侵袭。
author: bobosmith01
source: One myth states that each hand represents a direction the wind will travel: one for each cardinal direction; when many masses of air meet and a storm is born, POKENAME is using more than one arm to protect the Johto region from danger elsewhere.

entry: 抱起POKENAME摇一摇，便能听到壳里晃水的声音。兴奋时，它可能不小心从嘴里，把水洒出来。
author: wiz0z
source: If POKENAME is picked up and shaken, sloshing can be heard from inside their shell. POKENAME may accidentally spill this water out of their mouth when they become excited.

entry: POKENAME像神话中的有翼骏马。飞行时虽能骑在背上，振翅的风却太强，大多数骑乘者都会摔下，通常还离地不高。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME resembles a winged steed described in myth. Although it is possible to ride upon its back as it flies, the flapping of its wings generates such strong winds that most riders fall off, usually while still close to the ground.

entry: 少数故事说，POKENAME体内沉睡着浩大力量，实际上，却从未展现。无论遭攻击，还是卷进飓风，它都泰然自若。
author: infinex21
source: Although some few stories claim that POKENAME contain vast, dormant power, these Pokémon display no such power at all. They are unfazed by anything, even if they are attacked or caught in a hurricane.

entry: POKENAME领地意识强，用随身的棍棒，驱赶来者。模样有点像图中某种据称已灭绝的大葱鸭亲族。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a strong territorial instinct, driving others off its territory with the stick it always carries. It bears some resemblance to depictions of a supposedly extinct relative to Farfetch'd.

entry: POKENAME强大的三重攻击，以及三个头像极了传说鸟宝可梦的模样，都令它声名远扬。即使驯服，三头在战斗之外，也很少和睦。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are infamous for their powerful Tri Attacks and for the resemblance their three heads bear to the three Legendary Bird Pokémon. Even when tamed, a POKENAME's three heads rarely ever get along outside of battle.

entry: POKENAME用超能力，强化本已结实的壳，防御更强。喷水口的威力尤其惊人，几秒就能打穿一片钨板。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME wield psychic powers to reinforce their hardy shells, making their defenses all the greater. Remarkably, their waterspouts can loose jets of water with such power that they can punch a hole through a sheet of tungsten in seconds.

entry: POKENAME吐出黏丝，用来筑巢，保护自己的蛋。蛋的黏性，来自本身携带的微弱电荷；静电会让蛋，黏到靠近的任何东西上。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME produce a sticky silk that they use to make nests and protect their eggs. The stickiness of the egg comes from the mild electrical charge it carries, the static attaching it to anything that gets close.

entry: 近几代霹雳电球，有些模样不再像精灵球，反倒酷似皮卡丘，带来令人“触电”的变化。
author: craigprime
source: Instead of a Poké Ball, some recent generations of Voltorb have begun to share an appearance resembling Pikachu, with shocking results.

entry: 据说，完美的皮卡丘酥麻麻咖喱，秘诀正是POKENAME的叶子。叶子酥麻又辛辣，人们说，入菜就能添上一股电击般的辣劲。
author: quackquackattack
source: It is said that the secret to the perfect Piquant Pikachu Curry comes from the leaves of POKENAME, as their leaves have a shocking and spicy taste. People describe POKENAME leaves as adding a jolt of spiciness to their dishes.

entry: POKENAME似乎从雷之石中，凿出武器与头盔。它借石头增强电力，自己却尚未进化。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears to have chiseled a weapon and helmet out of Thunder Stones. It uses the stones to enhance its electrical abilities without yet evolving.

entry: 进化让雷之石刻成的头盔融进身体，进一步增强力量。雷之石制的棍棒，导电性也极好。
author: infinex21
source: Evolution has caused its helmet carved from Thunder Stone to become fused to its body, empowering them further. Their Thunder Stone clubs are excellent electrical conduits.

entry: 为制造自己的雷云，POKENAME飘到大气中，收集空气与水分。它还吃尘土和气体，结果雷云也带着恶臭。
author: cascadeguy
source: In order to create its own thunderclouds, POKENAME floats up into the atmosphere to collect air and moisture. It also feeds on dust and gases, resulting in the clouds containing a foul stench.

entry: POKENAME最常见于稀树草原，靠在大地上疾跑，锻炼身体。它们成群生活，惹怒一只，整群都会攻击。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are most often found in savannahs, where they train their bodies by sprinting across the land. They are pack Pokémon; attracting the ire of just one will cause the whole pack to attack.

entry: POKENAME更愿挑战其他电属性宝可梦，因为所有攻击，都会被导电的角吸收。随后，便以已经充电的重尾还击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME prefers to fight other Electric-types, as all of their attacks get absorbed by its conductive horn. It will then strike with its heavy tail now charged with electrical energy.

entry: POKENAME平时住在海底，雷雨时却会成大群，浮上水面。科学家仍在研究，这种怪行为究竟有何目的。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME normally live on the seafloor, but large groups come up to float on the surface during thunderstorms. Scientists are still trying to figure out the purpose behind this strange behavior.

entry: 它用手摩擦脸颊，充满静电后，就能爬墙，打出电人的雷电拳。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It rubs its hands on its cheeks to charge them with static electricity. It can climb up walls and throw out shocking Thunder Punches after doing this.

entry: 电流在POKENAME周身跃动，冲向对手时，速度骤然爆发。优雅闪亮的双刃，精准切开障碍，最壮的大树，也像纸一样倒下。
author: fiordaliso
source: Electricity dances across POKENAME's body, fueling sudden bursts of speed as it charges at opponents. Its graceful gleaming twin blades cut through obstacles with such precision that even the mightiest trees fall like paper.

entry: POKENAME高饱和的色彩，与凝固般的诡异表情，令科学家不解。不过，它仍兼具巴大蝶与皮卡丘的特点，例如住在森林，熟练驾驭电力。
author: bobosmith01
source: Scientists are baffled by POKENAME's saturated appearance and eerily still expression. However, POKENAME still carries the traits of both Butterfree and Pikachu; for instance, POKENAME reside in forests and command electricity adeptly.

entry: 它来回扭动身体就能发电。徒手抓POKENAME这种错误，捕虫训练家很少会犯第二次。
author: staghorn
source: It generates a charge by wiggling its body back and forth. Holding a POKENAME with bare hands is a mistake bug catchers rarely make twice.

entry: 这些宝可梦在雷雨中聚集湖上，造出巨大水龙卷，再试着乘着水柱上攀雷云，途中还互相争斗。
author: sizzulreal
source: These Pokémon gather in lakes during thunderstorms to create massive waterspouts. They will try to ride these spouts up into the storm clouds, fighting each other on the way up.

entry: POKENAME为城都笔友递送伊布邮件，参与促进终身读写教育的计划。信件连起孩子与长者，它会在门外等上数日，直到拿到回信。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME deliver Eon Mail between pen pals in the Johto region as part of a program that fosters lifelong literacy. They connect children to the elderly through these letters and will wait outside for days until they have a letter to send back.

entry: POKENAME皮卡丘般的模样，让它成了数字领域热门的吉祥物。许多教育游戏以它为主角，或借用形象，吸引孩子边玩边学。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's Pikachu-like features make it a popular mascot on the digital front. Many educational computer games star it or make use of its imagery to entice children to play and learn.

entry: POKENAME喜欢趴在人头上，高处更容易吸收空气中的静电。因为模样像皮卡丘，有些地方流行把它当帽子戴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME likes to lay atop people's heads, the high vantage point making it easier to absorb static in the air. Because of its Pikachu-like appearance, it's become trendy in some areas to wear it as a cap.

entry: POKENAME如今偏爱雨林，但人们普遍认为，若它在数百万年前就存在，栖息地应当不同。找到食物，它就用电煎熟。
author: bobosmith01
source: Nowadays, POKENAME prefer to live in rainforests, but it's generally accepted that they would have lived elsewhere if they existed millions of years ago. After finding something to eat, they fry it with electricity.

entry: POKENAME不停吃烛木果，固定的食谱抑制放电，让力量积在体内。谁直接打中它，就可能遭受痛苦的麻痹电击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME constantly feast on Wacan berries, their steady diet dampening their electrical output and causing their power to build up within their bodies. Those that strike them directly can end up receiving painful paralytic shocks.

entry: 猛烈风暴，是POKENAME的游乐场。它刻意引雷落向自己，用灵巧身手与瞬间移动，试试看能躲开多少道。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Heavy storms are playgrounds for POKENAME. They deliberately attract lightning bolts to themselves, using their dexterity and teleportation to find out how many they can dodge.

entry: POKENAME把电从触角，导向颈间的花环，更好地在战斗中放出闪电。带电时，花瓣会散发强烈的苦涩气味。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sends electricity down from its antennae to the flower wreath around its neck, where it can better unleash lightning in combat. While electrified, the flower petals emit a potent bitter scent.

entry: POKENAME兴奋或自卫时，会从背上放电或喷火。红色颊囊，摸起来很烫。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME release electricity or flames from their backs when excited or when trying to protect themselves. Their red cheek pouches are hot to the touch.

entry: 它们释放十万伏特与喷射火焰，威胁对手，或抵御来犯者。移动迅疾，常裹着火焰与电力，保护自己。
author: infinex21
source: They let loose Thunder Bolts and Flamethrowers to threaten opponents or to ward off attackers. They can move very quick, often clad in flames and electricity to protect themselves.

entry: POKENAME的咬击尤其危险。双颚本就有力，一咬牢，还会通过牙齿放电，电击受害者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's bite is particularly dangerous; its jaws are plenty powerful on their own, but once it clamps down on something, it discharges electricity through its teeth to shock its victims.

entry: POKENAME在风暴中守巢，用喙截住雷电，以自己的身体，保护尚未孵化的蛋。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME guards its nest during storms, intercepting lightning with its beak. It shields unhatched eggs with its own body.

entry: POKENAME在颊囊产生电力，再经角放出雷电，足以烧穿高大的树木。
author: victor9106
source: POKENAME generate electricity in their cheek pouches, before dispersing it through their horns in electric bolts that can burn through tall trees.

entry: POKENAME正义感很强，目睹不公，就会毫不犹豫地以连续拳介入。若事态升级，也会毫不犹豫地电击对手。
author: drack8786
source: POKENAME has a strong sense of justice, so it won't hesitate to intervene with its Comet Punch when it witnesses an unfair situation. If the situation escalates, it won't hesitate to electrocute its opponents.

entry: POKENAME能从口颚传导电流，常被警方用来让嫌疑人暂时无法动弹。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME transmits electricity through its mandibles. It is commonly used by police to temporarily immobilize suspects.

entry: 雷雨中，POKENAME从喙释放巨大的闪电，振着噼啪带电的双翼，绕雷云飞行。
author: .izik
source: During thunderstorms, POKENAME releases huge lightning bolts from its beak. It circles storm clouds with crackling wings.

entry: 丰缘有项帮助面对哀伤的计划，POKENAME会给年满15岁的孤儿，递送闪亮邮件。皮卡丘的吉祥物形象，提醒他们：写信者，是失去孩子，或从未有过孩子的长者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME delivers Glitter Mail when orphans turn 15 in the Hoenn region as part of a program to help process grief. The Pikachu mascot reminds the orphans that the mail is authored by elders who have lost or never had children.

entry: POKENAME控制电力的本领，时好时坏。电击能强到让发电机运转数小时，却很难调节强弱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have an uneven control over their electrical powers. They are able to produce shocks powerful enough to power a generator for several hours, but they have trouble regulating the strength of their shocks.

entry: POKENAME能给小房子供电，却不擅引导能量，偶尔便会断供，因此不是可靠的电源。
author: daimposter_60614
source: POKENAME has the ability to power a small house, however, it has a hard time channeling this energy. This results in occasional power cuts, making POKENAME an unreliable power source.

entry: POKENAME兴奋时，会像节拍器一样，来回摆尾，每一拍都迸出火花。它借这有节奏的摇摆，召来改变周围世界的奇异力量。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME are excited, they rhythmically wave their tails back and forth like a metronome, producing sparks with each pulse. They call upon strange powers that alter the world around them with this rhythmic swaying.

entry: POKENAME橡胶般的身体，能吸收大量动能，无忧无虑地四处弹跳。吸收的能量会化为静电，触碰便可能挨上痛苦的电击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have rubbery bodies that can absorb large amounts of kinetic energy, bouncing around with carefree abandon. The energy they absorb is converted into static electricity and can cause painful shocks if they're touched.

entry: POKENAME成群聚在雷雨下，来回摆尾，将闪电引离村庄。它们合力保护困境中的人，确保大家能安心享受雨天。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME flock beneath thunderstorms, waving their tails back and forth to redirect lightning bolts away from villages. They work together to protect the less fortunate and ensure that people can safely enjoy rainy days.

entry: POKENAME能瞥见短暂的未来片段，却常被所见吓坏。一害怕，双颊就会积电，周身冒火花，直到平静下来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can see momentary glimpses in the future and are often terrified of what they see. Whenever they are scared, they generate an electrical charge in their cheeks and create sparks around them until they are calm.

entry: 牧羊人看中POKENAME罕见的黑羊毛，将它与羊群一起照料。危险宝可梦一靠近，它便放电，将对方吓走。
author: quackquackattack
source: Shepherds take care of POKENAME alongside their herd because of their rare black wool. Whenever a dangerous Pokémon comes near their herd, POKENAME zap and scare them away.

entry: POKENAME成群起舞，吸收阳光补充营养。移动时，花瓣互相摩擦，积起静电，便能向捕食者释放。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will dance in groups together, absorbing sunlight for nourishment. Their petals rub together as they move, building up static electricity which they can release at predators.

entry: POKENAME俯冲向水中猎物，用带电利爪电击，再以喙切分、吞食。
author: penguinmeowloncatmochi
source: POKENAME descends upon its aquatic prey, electrocuting them with its electrified talons, before using its beak to dissect and eat the prey.

entry: 它在屋里肆意啃电缆，直到能量充足。若一群POKENAME侵入城区，频繁停电，几乎无法避免。
author: fiordaliso
source: It gnaws on electrical cables inside houses without restraint until it's full of energy. When a colony of POKENAME infests an urban area, frequent blackouts are almost guaranteed.

entry: POKENAME通过竖起的耳朵吸收阳光，转成电力，存在颊囊中。它与同类触碰尾巴，彼此交流。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME absorb sunlight through their upright ears, which becomes the electricity stored in their cheek pouches. They communicate with others of their species by touching tails.

entry: POKENAME在城镇街道，寻找奇迹汽水罐，凭本能咬开，靠糖分补充能量。这习惯让鳃充分充能，受威胁时，便能释放小股电流。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME scurries through city streets in search of Rare Soda cans, which it instinctively bites into to absorb the sugary charge. This habit supercharges its gills, allowing it to release small bursts of electricity when threatened.

entry: POKENAME通过身上斑点，吸收、转化月光，增加储电量。饱吸一夜月光后，次日早晨就会亢奋好动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME increases its electrical capacity by absorbing and converting moonlight via the spots on its body. After a night full of moonlight absorption, it indulges in hyperactivity the following morning.

entry: 它在屋里肆意啃电缆，直到能量充足。若一群POKENAME侵入城区，频繁停电，几乎无法避免。
author: fiordaliso
source: It gnaws on electrical cables inside houses without restraint until it's full of energy. When a colony of POKENAME infests an urban area, frequent blackouts are almost guaranteed.

entry: POKENAME常被误认成发狂的皮卡丘。毛发始终带电，靠得太近，就会被电到。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are often mistaken for rabid Pikachu. Their fur is constantly charged with electricity, shocking anything that gets too close.

entry: POKENAME会在雷暴时升到高空，吸收闪电中的电力维生。
author: marvinthemarrowmuncher
source: POKENAME floats high into the sky during thunderstorms to absorb electricity from the lightning bolts for nutrition.

entry: 宝可梦对战中，POKENAME能凭厚实的身体承受多次打击，同时积蓄静电，伺机反击时放出。
author: quackquackattack
source: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME can take a lot of hits with their bulky body. They develop a static charge that gets released during an opportunistic counterattack.

entry: POKENAME从尾巴产生精神能量，头部则产生电力。两股力量合一，便能射出强大能量束，击倒巨大的肯泰罗。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME generate psychic energy from their tail and electricity from their head. They combine these two powers to create a powerful beam of energy that can take down a large Tauros.

entry: POKENAME飞行时用翅膀发电，危险临近，就以尖叫警告其他宝可梦。独处时很胆小，成群却十分危险，要小心。
author: moga6
source: POKENAME uses its wings during flight to generate electricity and its sharp cry to warn other Pokémon whenever danger is near. Alone, it is cowardly, but beware of a flock of POKENAME as they are dangerous.

entry: POKENAME通常温顺，一牵涉蜂蜜，却会变得好斗。谁挡在它与渴望的甜点之间，它都会毫不犹豫地放电。
author: sk372
source: Although generally docile, POKENAME becomes quite scrappy when the presence of honey is involved. It won't hesitate to discharge electricity at anything getting between it and the sweet snack it craves.

entry: POKENAME揉搓腹部的斑点，积蓄静电，增强爪击。每次命中，都会使对手短暂麻痹。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME rubs the spot on its belly to build up static. This electricity is used to enhance its claw attacks, causing brief paralysis to its opponent with every strike.

entry: POKENAME背上的宝石，闪着蓄电的光。电荷随时间逐渐增加，宝石也越来越亮，直到放出积蓄的力量。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME carry gems upon their back that sparkle with electrical potential. The electrical charge within the gem gradually increases over time, causing them to glow brighter and brighter until they discharge the built-up power.

entry: POKENAME背上的宝石，闪着蓄电的光。电荷随时间逐渐增加，宝石也越来越亮，直到放出积蓄的力量。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME carry gems upon their back that sparkle with electrical potential. The electrical charge within the gem gradually increases over time, causing them to glow brighter and brighter until they discharge the built-up power.

entry: POKENAME既费力振翅飞行，也留不住颊囊的电。因此它们结群，让流失的电反而打中伙伴，互相充电。
author: soup1900
source: As POKENAME struggles to flap its wings to fly, it also fails to retain the electricity in its cheek sacs. Therefore, POKENAME stays in flocks so that their discharged electricity strikes and recharges each other instead.

entry: POKENAME用电烧树，好捉到藏在密林地面下的昆虫。它得小心，不能飞太高，否则就会引雷上身。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME burns trees by striking them with electricity so it can easily access and hunt insects hiding under dense forest floors. It must be careful not to fly up too high, as otherwise it will attract and be struck by lightning.

entry: POKENAME的毛粗硬得令人意外，容易缠住东西，却也能轻易放电。要是缠上蘑菇或树果，正好烤得香喷喷！
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's fur is surprisingly wiry and prone to having things get tangled in it, but it can easily shock anything that gets caught. If this includes mushrooms or berries, they become pleasantly roasted!

entry: 长脖子与喙很适合灵巧捕食。若没能成功，迅速放一次电，就能击倒整池鱼。
author: essie
source: Its long neck and beak are designed to deftly catch prey. If that doesn't work, a quick electric burst will take out a whole pond of fish.

entry: POKENAME缠住猎物，再释放麻痹电击。若不奏效，就会逃跑。住在它出没地区的训练家，最好穿橡胶靴。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME wrap around their prey and then deliver a paralyzing electric shock. They will flee if this tactic fails. Trainers in areas where POKENAME live are advised to wear rubber boots.

entry: POKENAME想混进皮卡丘群，狭长的吻部却很碍事。即便如此，它仍会跟着大家吃树果、梳理自己的尾巴，仿佛本就是一员。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME tries to blend in with other Pikachu, which is difficult because of its elongated snout. Despite this, POKENAME will eat berries and groom its tail alongside groups of Pikachu as though it were one.

entry: 大量POKENAME，可能给依赖电脑的公司带来严重问题。它们爱钻进电子设备，将电存在体内，可能导致停电。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Large POKENAME populations can cause serious issues for companies that are heavily reliant on computers. They have a habit of entering electronics and storing electricity within their bodies, potentially causing blackouts as they do.

entry: POKENAME转动尾巴发电，储存在体内，再于双耳间产生电弧，甩向对手。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME spin their tails to generate electricity, which they store within their bodies. They create arcs of electricity between their ears that they fling at opponents.

entry: POKENAME摇响雷电形的尾巴，吓退潜在威胁。狩猎时，它以颊囊电晕猎物，再用身体缠住。
author: hereisanimations
source: POKENAME rattles its lightning-shaped tail to scare off potential threats. When hunting, it stuns prey with its cheeks and then coils its body around them.

entry: POKENAME主要出现在海上与沿岸的雷暴中，低低飞行，方便捕获、吸收闪电，转成能量。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME mostly appear during electrical storms at sea and along coasts. POKENAME fly low enough to best catch and absorb lightning, which they can metabolize.

entry: POKENAME的体型，让它能储存大量能量。虽不常见，若遇到它在金属或设备旁玩，尾巴一触，就能充入足够使用超过五年的电力。
author: pixlhoopa
source: The size of a POKENAME allows it to store large amounts of energy. While rare, if POKENAME are found playing around metal or equipment, a touch from their tail can charge it enough to last for over five years.

entry: POKENAME闪亮的羽毛带着电，每召一道雷，便消耗一部分。完全耗尽，羽毛就会失去光泽，从翼上无害地脱落。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have shiny feathers that are charged with electricity. Each bolt of lightning they call upon slowly drains the electricity from their feathers. Once fully depleted, the feathers lose their luster and fall harmlessly from their wings.

entry: POKENAME收集类似雷之石的亮石，帮助集中渐强的电力。偶尔弄到真正的雷之石，又太过珍爱，谁也不许拿走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME collects shiny rocks akin to Thunder Stones to help it focus its burgeoning electric powers. Occasionally, it manages to procure actual Thunder Stones, but grows far too attached to them to let anyone else take them.

entry: POKENAME不停放电，蓝色火花沿身流动，静电使毛发竖起。接触它时，最好穿绝缘衣物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are constantly discharging electricity, blue sparks rippling off of their bodies and causing their fur to spike up from static. It is advised to wear insulating clothing when handling these Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME爱把尾巴当雪橇，能连续滑上数周，不用休息，靠的是脚部动作与电磁推进的配合。
author: daimposter_60614
source: POKENAME love tobogganing on their tails and can do so for weeks without a break. This is accomplished by using a combination of their foot movements and electromagnetic propulsion.

entry: POKENAME脸颊的颜色，会随食谱改变。只要不属于红色调，就表示饮食严重失衡。它也会用结实的角，标记族群领地。
author: bobosmith01
source: The color of POKENAME's cheeks can change based on their diet. If its cheeks are not a shade of red, its diet is severely unbalanced. They mark their pack's territory with their sturdy horns.

entry: POKENAME模样虽然骇人，电力其实不算强。它常将尾巴竖起，吓唬敌方宝可梦。
author: daimposter_60614
source: Despite its intimidating appearance, POKENAME's electric abilities are actually not very strong. It often stands with its tail up to scare off enemy Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME把10万伏强电集中到双臂与头部，使出威力惊人的伏特攻击。充分充电的雷电拳，能电透整棵树，烤熟每片叶子与每颗树果。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME concentrates its 100,000 volts of electricity into its arms and head to perform an extremely powerful and devastating Volt Tackle. Using a supercharged Thunder Punch, it can shock an entire tree and roast every leaf and berry on it.

entry: 通往洞穴的山丘上，偶尔会射出闪电。它挖出的地道彼此相通，有些延伸数公里。
author: chorb33
source: Lightning sometimes shoots out of the hills that lead into its caves. It digs tunnel systems, some of which extend over several kilometers.

entry: POKENAME吸收太阳能的效率，远胜现代太阳能板。因此，想减少生态足迹的训练家，格外喜欢它。
author: agentyoshi
source: POKENAME can absorb energy from the sun at an efficiency that far surpasses modern solar panels. This has made it an incredibly popular Pokémon with Trainers looking to reduce their ecological footprint.

entry: POKENAME以电与数据为食，寻找电子设备，抽取能量。吃下的能量，却以不定的速度不断流失，让它永远饥饿。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME feed on electricity and data, seeking out electrical devices in order to sap their energy. The energy they consume constantly leaks out of them at varying rates, causing them to be perpetually hungry.

entry: 避雷针上，常能见到POKENAME。雷雨来临，它们会尽可能爬高，收集电力。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME can often be found on lightning rods. During thunderstorms, they climb as high as they can to gather electricity.

entry: POKENAME互相摩擦尾巴，积蓄静电。释放的闪电，会在树上留下奇异的灼痕。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME builds up static charge by rubbing its tails together. Its lightning can cause unusual burn patterns in trees.

entry: POKENAME储存的多余电力，会从颊囊与红色头羽显露。此时若受惊，它便尖叫，一口气放出体内全部电力。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Extra electricity stored inside POKENAME will become visible through its cheek sacs and red head feathers. If POKENAME is scared while in this state, it will shriek and all of the stored electricity will discharge from its body in a single blow.

entry: POKENAME是模仿高手，摸起来温暖，战斗时能使火焰攻击，却很费力。因此，只要可能，它更愿用电攻击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: A master of mimicry, POKENAME is warm to the touch and can use fiery attacks during combat, though with great difficulty. POKENAME prefers to use its electrical attacks whenever possible.

entry: 这些敏捷的宝可梦，爱绕圈奔跑，靠活动发电。若绊倒，就会向第一眼看见的东西，吐出带电火球。
author: infinex21
source: These speedy Pokémon have a habit of running around in circles; by moving, they generate electricity. If they stumble, they will spit electrically charged fireballs at the first thing they see.

entry: 通往洞穴的山丘上，偶尔会射出闪电。它挖出的地道彼此相通，有些延伸数公里。
author: chorb33
source: Lightning sometimes shoots out of the hills that lead into its caves. It digs tunnel systems, some of which extend over several kilometers.

entry: 通往洞穴的山丘上，偶尔会射出闪电。它挖出的地道彼此相通，有些延伸数公里。
author: chorb33
source: Lightning sometimes shoots out of the hills that lead into its caves. It digs tunnel systems, some of which extend over several kilometers.

entry: 通往洞穴的山丘上，偶尔会射出闪电。它挖出的地道彼此相通，有些延伸数公里。
author: chorb33
source: Lightning sometimes shoots out of the hills that lead into its caves. It digs tunnel systems, some of which extend over several kilometers.

entry: 通往洞穴的山丘上，偶尔会射出闪电。它挖出的地道彼此相通，有些延伸数公里。
author: chorb33
source: Lightning sometimes shoots out of the hills that lead into its caves. It digs tunnel systems, some of which extend over several kilometers.

entry: POKENAME能让背刺带电，电击对手，也能蜷身滚走，向四面八方迸出闪电。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can energize the spikes on its back to shock opponents. It can also curl up and roll away, emitting lightning bolts in all directions.

entry: POKENAME体内的燃烧与纤细的身形，在全身产生强电流。因此，它始终活动，以迅捷流畅的踢击，释放多余电力。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's internal combustion and slender frame generate high currents throughout its body. As a result, it is constantly in motion, discharging excess electricity through fast, flowing kicks.

entry: POKENAME凭强腿攀上高处，用尖爪收集树顶食物，再用储电准备餐食。它常给其他宝可梦找吃的，单纯只为再有机会攀登。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME scales great heights using its powerful legs, harvesting food from the tops of trees with its sharp claws. It prepares its meals with stored electricity and frequently gathers food for other Pokémon simply for the chance to climb again.

entry: POKENAME收耳贴尾，减少风阻，提升灵活性。借体内储电，它能以惊人速度，施展猛烈的拳脚攻击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Tucking its ears back and pulling its tail to its body, POKENAME can make itself more aerodynamic and increase its agility. Using the electricity stored in its body, POKENAME can strike opponents with fierce kicks and punches at astounding speeds.

entry: POKENAME的眼、耳、鳍和尾，始终留意周围最细微的变化。想趁它不备靠近，还不被糊泥或十万伏特击中，可不容易。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME's eyes, ears, fins, and tail are always alerting them to the most subtle changes in their surroundings. It's a feat to catch POKENAME unawares and walk away without being coated in mud or struck by a Thunderbolt.

entry: POKENAME空蛹周围的持续静电，让它悬在半空。身体一被触碰，电荷散去，它就会落地，完全不动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hang suspended in mid air through a constant static charge around their empty chrysalis. If their body is touched, they will drop to the ground totally motionless as their charge disperses.

entry: POKENAME能让背刺带电，电击对手，也能蜷身滚走，向四面八方迸出闪电。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can energize the spikes on its back to shock opponents. It can also curl up and roll away, emitting lightning bolts in all directions.

entry: POKENAME听话，也较容易训练，是新手训练家喜爱的起步伙伴。它爱啃木玩具，因此很容易用来奖励想培养的行为。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are a popular Pokémon for aspiring Trainers to start out with, being obedient and relatively easy to train. Their enjoyment of wooden toys to gnaw on makes it easy to reward the behaviour the Trainer wants to see.

entry: POKENAME听话，也较容易训练，是新手训练家喜爱的起步伙伴。它爱啃木玩具，因此很容易用来奖励想培养的行为。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are a popular Pokémon for aspiring Trainers to start out with, being obedient and relatively easy to train. Their enjoyment of wooden toys to gnaw on makes it easy to reward the behaviour the Trainer wants to see.

entry: POKENAME听话，也较容易训练，是新手训练家喜爱的起步伙伴。它爱啃木玩具，因此很容易用来奖励想培养的行为。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are a popular Pokémon for aspiring Trainers to start out with, being obedient and relatively easy to train. Their enjoyment of wooden toys to gnaw on makes it easy to reward the behaviour the Trainer wants to see.

entry: POKENAME喜欢附在旧游戏设备里，吸光电力为食。剩余电力用来发动毁灭性的电属性攻击，最常针对虚拟宝可梦多边兽。
author: _pixelar_
source: This Pokémon likes to possess old gaming devices and drain them of their power. POKENAME feeds itself on this electricity and uses any leftovers for devastating Electric-type attacks, most often used against the virtual-Pokémon Porygon.

entry: 它头上显眼的器官里，有能察觉微小电变化的凝胶囊。借此，它能探知其他穴居生物的大脑所在。
author: pattybgoode
source: Within the prominent organ on its head are gel sacs that can detect minute electric variations. Using this organ, it can detect the brains of other burrowing creatures.

entry: POKENAME最爱弄出电火花。它囤积坏电器，一口气全部充电，再开心地欣赏，惊叹于飞出的火花。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME loves sparking things. It hoards broken electrical equipment then electrically charges them all at once, gleefully wondering at the sparks they produce.

entry: POKENAME充满电时，毒刺上便有电流噼啪跃动。它用尾巴与电火花，同家人交流。
author: chibitales
source: Electricity crackles over POKENAME's venomous barbs when fully charged. It uses its tail alongside sparks to communicate with its family.

entry: POKENAME尾囊中，储存着极大量的电力。夜里，常能见到它摆弄路灯。
author: poppyisconfused
source: An incredibly large amount of electricity is stored within the tail sac of POKENAME. They can often be found messing with streetlamps at night.

entry: POKENAME几不可破的头骨受撞击，会刺激体内电荷。没精神时，它有时故意挑衅，让别人打自己，帮忙充电。
author: sk372
source: Impacts to POKENAME's nigh-impervious skull stimulate its electrical charges within. It sometimes provokes others into attacking it just to help charge itself when it is feeling low.

entry: POKENAME能预测雷会劈在哪里。它借此保护村庄，也会狩猎，把猎物困在即将落雷的地方。
author: saucebolodu81
source: POKENAME can predict where lightning will strike. They use this power to protect villages from being struck by lightning, but also to hunt by trapping their prey right where the lightning is about to strike.

entry: POKENAME的环里，始终涌动着强电。除非它有意，否则不会伤害触碰者。据说，电属性宝可梦一碰，就能立刻充满电。
author: sk372
source: A constant surge of powerful electricity runs through POKENAME's ring at all times. It will not harm those who touch it unless POKENAME wills it, and it's said Electric types that touch it will be instantly recharged to full voltage.

entry: POKENAME常游荡寻找电源，为颊囊充电。它产生的电磁场，常吸引皮卡丘坐上背，或跟在身后。
author: jadey.1557
source: POKENAME often wander around, drawn to sources of electricity where they can charge their cheek sacs. Due to the electromagnetic field it produces, Pikachu will often be found sitting upon its back or following in its wake.

entry: 皮卡丘的颊囊，移到猛火猴的掌心，让POKENAME能从手中放出闪电。尾尖虽不再燃烧，适当时候，仍能重新点起。
author: cascadeguy
source: The sacs on Pikachu's cheeks have moved down onto Monferno's palms, allowing POKENAME to dispense lightning from its hands. While the tip of its tail is no longer on fire, POKENAME can reignite it when the time comes.

entry: 被POKENAME刺中，犹如遭雷击。POKENAME会把自己插进插座充电，经常造成停电。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Being stabbed by POKENAME is comparable to being struck by lightning. POKENAME recharges by plugging itself into outlets, often causing outages.

entry: 被这把匕首划伤，感觉如同挨了电击枪。它用这种通常不致命的反击，吓阻突然伸手抓它的人。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A cut from this dagger is comparable to being tased, a less-than-lethal deterrent to being suddenly grabbed.

entry: POKENAME快得令人目眩，在战场四处疾驰，同时攻击多个对手。持有电气球，电力输出就会大增，战法也会更倚重火力，而非速度。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME move blindingly fast, zipping around the battlefield to attack multiple opponents simultaneously. When holding a Light Ball, these Pokémon's electrical output increases substantially, leading them to rely more on power than speed.

entry: 防守姿态下，POKENAME能操纵电网，形成抵御所有攻击的电屏障。电刃能刺入敌人，电击并抽走生命。
author: soup1900
source: When in a defensive stance, POKENAME can manipulate Electroweb to create a barrier of electricity that protects it from all attacks. Its electric blade can stab into a foe, shocking and draining the life out of them.

entry: 盾中的电气球，赋予POKENAME力量，能打破其他坚盾剑怪，对人类与宝可梦的控制。它也能放电保护电气球，但这会让它警惕，削弱灵能操控。
author: soup1900
source: Empowered by the Light Ball in its shield, POKENAME can override the control other Aegislash have over people and Pokémon. It can discharge electricity to defend this Light Ball, but doing so makes it wary and weakens its spectral manipulation.

entry: POKENAME察觉危险，大耳朵就会抽动。敌人碰到它，会感到不适，很快便麻痹。
author: bobosmith01
source: When POKENAME detects danger, its large ears twitch. If foes touch POKENAME, they feel sick and quickly become paralyzed.

entry: POKENAME像使用搭电线一样，用缎带夹住目标注入电力。修车师傅常靠它替汽车搭电启动。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME uses its ribbons like jumper cables to latch onto its target and fill it with electricity. It's often used by mechanics to jump-start cars.

entry: POKENAME强壮厚重的身体，需要大量营养，多数野生个体因此寿命不长。它只吃色彩鲜明的花与树果。
author: bobosmith01
source: Due to its powerful bulk requiring a lot of sustenance, most wild POKENAME do not live long lives. They only eat vividly colorful flowers and Berries.

entry: POKENAME飞奔于风暴海岸，鳍间雷电与海水噼啪作响。放出的电流太强，连周围空气，都带上盐与臭氧的味道。
author: segmoph
source: POKENAME races across stormy coastlines, its fins crackling with lightning and seawater. It discharges bursts of electricity so powerful, the surrounding air tastes like salt and ozone.

entry: 和皮卡丘不同，POKENAME即使被摸到尾巴，也不慌不忙。体形更大、力量更强，让POKENAME不再把这种接触，当作威胁。
author: over9001
source: Unlike Pikachu, POKENAME remains undisturbed even when its tail is touched. This is because POKENAME doesn't see this action as a threat anymore, due to its increased size and power.

entry: POKENAME常被误当成人，举止却一点也不像。它没有共情，只渴求无与伦比的力量。攻击快得不可思议，仿佛时间停住。
author: actliux
source: Often mistaken for a human, POKENAME acts like anything but. It lacks empathy and desires nothing more but to have unmatched power, It's attacks are so unbelievably fast, it's as if time has stopped.

entry: POKENAME的金属外骨骼，始终带着数千伏的电。谁靠飞行路线太近，它就从炮口，射出大股能量。
author: .izik
source: The metal exoskeleton covering POKENAME's body is constantly charged with thousands of volts of electricity. It fires large bursts of this energy through its cannon at anyone who strays too close to its flight path.

entry: 野生POKENAME聚在一起，就会共舞。气象学家发现，突发雷雨与它们的舞会之间，存在关联。
author: sleepyman0731
source: When a group of wild POKENAME gather, they will dance together. Meteorologists have noticed a correlation between sudden thunderstorms and wild POKENAME dance parties.

entry: 成群的POKENAME伴雷雨而行，吸收闪电补能。它好奇，却喜怒无常，因此热气球驾驶员，会训练天蝎，在它靠得太近时赶走。
author: pjporwoll
source: Flocks of POKENAME ride alongside thunderstorms, absorbing lightning as energy. They are curious but temperamental, so hot air balloon pilots train Gligar to chase off POKENAME when they get too close.

entry: 电灯刚兴起时，POKENAME的毛是常用的灯丝。即便今天，有些电工仍会留几根，作为快速维修的工具。
author: wiz0z
source: In the early days of electrical lighting, POKENAME fur was a common filament used in light bulbs. Even today, some electricians keep strands of POKENAME fur as a tool for quick repairs.

entry: POKENAME尾巴定期长出树果，味道怡人，又能提神。它只与信任的对象分享，其他来者，会被可伸长的拳头，电上一拳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tail periodically grows berries that have a pleasant taste and energizing effects. It only shares the fruit with those it trusts; others will get an electrified punch from its extendable fists.

entry: POKENAME振翅飞快，体内积起大量静电。尾巴会定期放电，为此，它迅速俯向地面，让尾巴触土。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wings whirr so quickly that they generate a lot of static electricity within their bodies. Their tails discharge the electricity periodically, POKENAME dipping quickly to the ground to touch their tails to the soil to do so.

entry: POKENAME外露的内脏，始终有电流嗡鸣。哪怕轻轻碰到，也可能挨上很重的电击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's exposed innards constantly hum with electricity. Touching them even slightly can leave a nasty shock.

entry: 在妖精之力的帮助下，皮丘学会控制电力，也与附在自己身上的谜拟丘成了朋友。这份新结下的羁绊，促使它进化成POKENAME。
author: adoster
source: After using its fairy powers to help control its electricity, Pichu becomes friends with the Mimikyu possessing it. This newfound bond causes it to evolve into POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME一找到大能源，就不顾一切地吸取，哪怕吃得生病。充电过多，它会飞得快到失控，在照片里只剩道道光痕。
author: pjporwoll
source: When POKENAME finds a large source of energy, it recklessly drains it, even if the amount of energy will make it sick. When it becomes overcharged, it flies uncontrollably fast, appearing as streaks of light in photographs.

entry: POKENAME体内静电越强，竖起的尾巴就越多。满电后，电击能为整座城镇，供电一整天。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The stronger the static charge contained within POKENAME, the more of their tails stand upright. At full charge, POKENAME can power an entire town for a full day with their electric shocks.

entry: 输电塔周围的地洞，往往是POKENAME群留下的。它们被接地线的电场吸引，若无人看管，就会试着啃食。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Burrows around electrical pylons are often the result of POKENAME populations. They are drawn to the electrical field generated by grounding wires and, if left unattended, will try to feed on them.
