entry: POKENAME受水力发电厂吸引，常在涡轮附近筑坝。起初被视为麻烦，后来工程师开始驯服，让它帮忙供电。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are drawn to hydroelectric power plants, often setting up their dams close to the turbines. Their presence was once thought of as a nuisance until engineers began taming them and using them to help provide power.

entry: POKENAME受水力发电厂吸引，常在涡轮附近筑坝。起初被视为麻烦，后来工程师开始驯服，让它帮忙供电。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are drawn to hydroelectric power plants, often setting up their dams close to the turbines. Their presence was once thought of as a nuisance until engineers began taming them and using them to help provide power.

entry: POKENAME感知到喜爱对象的波导，双颊便冒出可爱的小电火花。它发展了独特战法，还会用雷电形的尾巴，施展强力攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it senses the aura of someone it likes, it starts emitting cute little electric sparks from its cheeks. POKENAME has developed a unique fighting style that also uses its lightning-shaped tail to deliver powerful attacks.

entry: POKENAME感知到邪恶波导，就会让回旋的电流缠住双拳。战斗时，也会用尾巴施展拿手的武术招数。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME senses an evil aura, it begins to wrap its fists in swirling electric shocks. When fighting, it also uses its tail to deliver its signature martial arts strikes.

entry: POKENAME举止懒散，体内却储着强电，一碰就放。被电得麻痹的对象，常成了它临时的床，动弹不得时，还得让它在身上小睡。
author: sk372
source: Though lazy in demeanor, POKENAME still possesses potent electrical stores that discharge on contact. Those stunned by its electric jolts often wind up being a makeshift bed for it to nap on while they're paralyzed.

entry: POKENAME是小小的发电高手，体积小、输出电压高，常由发电厂员工照料。
author: supersonicloki
source: An electrical powerhouse; POKENAME is often found in the care of power plant employees due to its small size and voltage output.

entry: POKENAME会在野外开演唱会，用电力为表演打光。若遭打断，就迅速滚向干扰者，放电麻痹，再回去接着唱。
author: ghostslythe
source: Known to put on concerts in the wild, POKENAME often uses its electric abilities to light up its show. If interrupted, it rapidly rolls towards the distraction, paralyzes it with electrical discharges, then returns to where it left off singing.

entry: POKENAME旋转发电，只需食物与水，就能供能，因此很受发电厂欢迎。多只合力，便足够供应小村庄。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME generate electrical energy as they spin, requiring just food and water to provide power. They are popular Pokémon to use in power plants as a result, multiple POKENAME able to provide enough power for a small village.

entry: POKENAME性情叛逆，重视训练家的尊重。训练得当后，它能发出一道等离子体，灼烧对手。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are rebellious creatures that value respect from their Trainers. When properly trained, they can roast their opponents with a bolt of plasma.

entry: POKENAME短毛柔软华美，性情友善，爱被抚摸，却也因此常把人电一下。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME's short fur is luxuriously soft. This friendly Pokémon loves to be pet, but this often causes a zap from static electricity.

entry: POKENAME递出手上的花，请旁人闻香。若对方显得不领好意，或不欣赏香气，它就愤愤不平，试图电击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME offers up the flowers on its hands for others to sniff and enjoy their fragrance. If they seem unappreciative of the offer or its scent, POKENAME gets indignant and will attempt to shock them.

entry: POKENAME住在主题乐园，吃太多游乐设施的电，导致停机。它藏在普通气球间，等孩子挑中，再悄悄偷走其家人的设备，飘走离开。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME inhabits theme parks where it causes rides to shut down after overfeeding on their electricity. It hides among inanimate balloons waiting to be chosen by a child, after which it stealthily steals their family's devices before floating away.

entry: POKENAME头周围的凝胶，从空气中储电，再释放，电击敌人。
author: hophoppip
source: The gel surrounding POKENAME's head stores electricity from the air and releases it to shock enemies.

entry: POKENAME想躲藏，就会在周围积起静电，吸来沙子，迅速把自己埋进沙漠，只留耳朵与尾巴露在地面。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME generate a static charge around their body when they want to hide. The charge attracts sand, enabling them to rapidly bury themselves in the desert with just their ears and tail poking out above the ground.

entry: 若哭哭面具丢下自己的面具，换成皮卡丘面具，野外就可能罕见地形成POKENAME。如今尾巴不如从前灵巧，便改用电荷，把面具固定。
author: crumple_2
source: POKENAME can rarely form in the wild if a Yamask discards its own mask in exchange for a Pikachu mask. As its tail is now less dexterous, the mask is instead held in place with an electric charge.

entry: 雷雨常发地区的住民，越来越欢迎POKENAME。有迷信说，啁啾的歌能避雷，保护房屋与财产。
author: sk372
source: People living in areas with regular thunderstorms have come to welcome POKENAME's presence. Superstitions say that its chirping song is a ward against lightning strikes, keeping home and property safe from harm.

entry: POKENAME爬过建筑管道，寻找电子设备吸电。它喜欢交往，一找到充沛电源，就会召来一群，共同占据这里。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME clambers through ducts of buildings, searching for electronic devices from which to sap energy. It is sociable, so if one finds an abundance of electrical energy, it will seek to gather a group to infest the location.

entry: POKENAME看起来总是很开心，跳跳舞、笑一笑。飞行时，振翅会产生静电，积得太多，就偶尔从尾巴释放。
author: mudkip0433
source: POKENAME always seem to be in a jolly mood, dancing about and smiling. When they fly, the flapping of their wings produces static electricity that they sometimes expel through their tail when the electricity buildup is too much.

entry: 古时，POKENAME被尊为完美猎手，藏在灌木，用微笑诱来目标，再扑出，以电烤熟猎物。但传说，过度猎食，差点让它自己灭绝。
author: lootererswillbeboated
source: Long ago, POKENAME was revered as the perfect hunter, hiding in bushes and luring targets with a smile before leaping out. It electrified its prey to cook it, but legends say its overhunting nearly drove it to extinction.

entry: 小巧可爱的宝可梦面前，POKENAME温顺爱玩。可谁打断玩耍，它就露出凶暴一面，四处跺脚，向周围降下雷电。
author: sk372
source: Among small and cute Pokémon, POKENAME is docile and playful. If anything interrupts playtime, however, it shows its violent side, stomping around while raining thunderbolts across the area.

entry: POKENAME电击胆敢入侵领地的人类。电过后，受害者还会被冻结，带进雪山，从此再也不见。
author: mystora
source: POKENAME electrocute humans that dare enter its territory. After the shock, they get frozen and taken away into the snowy mountains, never to be seen again.

entry: POKENAME挥动红色绒球，跃向空中，表演杂技。活力十足的演出，让观众备受鼓舞，也让它越来越受运动队欢迎，成为吉祥物。
author: .jerden
source: While waving around its red pom-poms, POKENAME will leap into the air to perform acrobatic stunts. People find its energetic performances very encouraging to watch, and it is becoming popular as a mascot for sports teams.

entry: POKENAME哪怕最小的动作，也会给身体积电。动得太快，就会放出，因此平时动作缓慢而优雅。
author: .jerden
source: Even POKENAME's smallest movements charge its body with electricity. This will discharge if it moves too quickly, so its motions are usually slow and graceful.

entry: POKENAME以慵懒、哀伤的舞彼此交流。翅膀移动，在身后空中划出闪亮的电弧。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME perform languid, sorrowful dances as a way to communicate with one another. Their wing movements leave sparkling arcs of electricity tracing through the air in their wake.

entry: POKENAME遇到昏倒的电属性宝可梦，可能用电击唤醒，再试着带对方，跳一支优雅的舞。
author: .jerden
source: If POKENAME encounters an Electric-type Pokémon that has fainted, it may revive it with an electric shock. POKENAME will then try to lead the other Pokémon in an elegant dance.

entry: POKENAME把袋子做成皮卡丘装束，穿在身上，盼着没那么吓人。幸好伪装很有效，许多个体都成了备受喜爱的宠物。
author: jakerz_1993
source: POKENAME wears a bag fashioned into a Pikachu costume in an effort to look less scary. Fortunately, the costume works well enough that many end up as beloved pets.

entry: 好奇的POKENAME在吃的垃圾中，翻找电子产品，收集起来，用自己的电供能。黑夜里，远远就能看见垃圾场巢穴灯火通明。
author: t3isukone
source: The curious POKENAME rummages through the trash it eats for electronics, which it collects and powers with its own electricity. The junkyard lairs of POKENAME can always be seen lit up from afar on dark nights.

entry: 遥远地区的古老大森林旁，有些村落家庭，被发现像养人类孩子一样，抚育这些宝可梦。这个传统，至今仍是研究课题。
author: ocxin
source: In the villages of distant regions with old and vast forests, some families have been found raising these Pokémon like human children. This tradition remains a subject of research.

entry: POKENAME栖在发电厂高处的梁上，只在非工作时段活动。它无声俯冲，吸收残余电力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME roosts high in powerplant rafters, active only during off-hours. It swoops down silently to absorb residual electricity.

entry: 下雨时，POKENAME常依偎在云间。它喜欢向下方宝可梦落雷，看对方慌乱奔逃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found nestled between clouds whenever it is raining. They enjoy shooting lightning bolts at Pokémon below them and watching them scramble.

entry: POKENAME排出稀薄黏液，借静电附在皮肤上。胶层能隔热，工匠会采集，涂在外套上，抵御风雨。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME excretes a thin goo that sticks to their skin from static electricity. The goo acts as insulation and is harvested by journeymen who put it on their coats to protect them from the elements.

entry: POKENAME接触便能迅速吸电，储电能力最高达2吉瓦。有趣的是，吸得越多，叫声就越频繁，也越尖。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME quickly absorbs electrical energy through contact and has a storage capacity of up to two gigawatts. Amusingly, the more electricity POKENAME absorbs, the more frequent and high-pitched their calls are.

entry: POKENAME在繁茂丛林中，快乐地小跑。巨花不断散出的花粉，含有带电粒子，接触其他生物时，更容易使其麻痹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME trots happily around lush jungle areas. The pollen its large flower constantly emits contains electrical particles, which increase the likelihood of it paralyzing other creatures on contact.

entry: POKENAME由特殊聚酯构成，很容易积起静电。想向训练家讨拥抱，常因此为难，因为总不小心电到自己喜爱的对象。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are made out of a special polyester that easily creates a static charge. This often poses problems when they want hugs from their Trainer, as they often accidentally shock those they love.

entry: POKENAME静止藏在岩石上，等猎物靠近，再从触手的刺放电，击中鲤鱼王等猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME shocks prey like Magikarp with bolts from the spikes on its tentacles. It hides motionless on rocks before striking.

entry: POKENAME的铲子像避雷针，引导能量，释放破坏性的冲击。攻击过后，叫声会在海滩回荡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's shovel acts like a lightning rod, channeling energy into destructive blasts. Its cries echo across the beach after the blasts.

entry: 仿佛有残留意志，POKENAME有时会从噬沙堡爷猎食留下的残余中现身。这些融合体，似乎格外抗拒遵从沙丘娃的本能。
author: ocxin
source: As if by a lingering will, POKENAME are known to sometimes emerge from the remnants left behind by the hunts of Palossand. These fusions seem especially averse to engaging with their Sandygast instincts.

entry: POKENAME通常脾气平稳，却不喜欢突然被摸。它能将强电从尾巴串连至蘑菇，增强释放的雷电。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is generally even-tempered, but dislikes being touched without warning. Strong jolts of electricity can be chained from its tail to its mushrooms, increasing the output of the lightning it emits.

entry: POKENAME虽对电属性宝可梦占优，却从未被观察到捕食它们。反而会本能地庇护它们，躲开其他噬沙堡爷及其融合体，仿佛由遗传的皮卡丘结群策略驱使。
author: ocxin
source: POKENAME have never been observed hunting Electric-type Pokémon despite their advantage over them. Instead, they instinctually offer shelter from other Pallosand and their fusions as if driven by their genetic Pikachu grouping tactics.

entry: POKENAME互蹭脸颊，彼此交流。双方交换电力，便使耳后的褶膜，散出一小片电火花。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME communicate with others by nuzzling their cheeks together. This exchange of electricity between two parties causes the frills behind their ears to emit a small scattering of electric sparks.

entry: 逆着毛抚摸，POKENAME就会不由自主地向周围放出火花。它总是精力充沛，每天得玩耍、奔跑数小时，才终于会累。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME is petted against the grain of its fur, it unintentionally discharges electric sparks all around its body. Since it is always brimming with energy, it needs hours of play and running each day before it finally tires out.

entry: 逆着毛抚摸，POKENAME就会不由自主地向周围放出火花。它总是精力充沛，每天得玩耍、奔跑数小时，才终于会累。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME is petted against the grain of its fur, it unintentionally discharges electric sparks all around its body. Since it is always brimming with energy, it needs hours of play and running each day before it finally tires out.

entry: 哪怕雷之石碎片附在身上，它们也拒绝进化。野生宝可梦很少有这份自律，因为要阻止进化，需要很强的自制力。
author: quackquackattack
source: Even as shards of Thunder Stones cling to their body, they refuse to evolve. This discipline is rarely found in wild Pokémon, as it takes a lot of self control to stop the process of evolution.

entry: 对战中，POKENAME凭出众身手，疾驰战场。一发现破绽，就以快如闪电的石片，一击结束战斗。
author: quackquackattack
source: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME zip through the battlefield with superb agility. Once they find an opening, a lightning-fast shard of rock ends a battle with a single strike.

entry: 它在乐队工作，每场演出都不缺席。POKENAME其实并不演奏，而是给各件乐器供电。
author: dodoowner_
source: It works for a band and goes to every concert. Instead of playing for the band, POKENAME actually charges each instrument.

entry: POKENAME热爱表演，享受在舞台中央唱歌跳舞，受到瞩目。它用电力，把表演传到所在城镇的各个电视屏幕。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a love for performing and enjoy being the centre of attention on stage as they sing and dance. They use their electrical powers to project their performances across TV screens throughout the town they're in.

entry: POKENAME热爱表演，享受在舞台中央唱歌跳舞，受到瞩目。它用电力，把表演传到所在城镇的各个电视屏幕。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a love for performing and enjoy being the centre of attention on stage as they sing and dance. They use their electrical powers to project their performances across TV screens throughout the town they're in.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇不断通电，味道浓烈刺口。独特的风味与口感，让它很受酸味料理的制作者追捧。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME mushrooms have a strong, sharp taste to them due to the constant electricity that runs through them. They are sought after for sour dishes thanks to the unique flavour and texture they provide.

entry: POKENAME梳理自己，便火花四溅。它住在高海拔疏林地带，风暴时可能爬树挨雷，却毫发无伤，甚至可能力量大增。
author: bobosmith01
source: When POKENAME grooms itself, sparks fly everywhere. It lives in semi-forested areas with high elevation. In a storm, it may climb a tree and be struck with lightning to no harm to itself; in fact, POKENAME may become supercharged with power.

entry: 太阳升起，POKENAME展开叶片，收集阳光，转成电能。积蓄一超过某个阈值，便从双颊电囊释放。
author: etherealtower
source: When the sun rises, POKENAME spreads its leaves and gathers sunlight to convert into electrical energy. Once the energy collected surpasses a certain threshold, it is released through the electric sacs on its cheeks.

entry: POKENAME最常在夏季遇见，潜伏向日葵田间，边吸收太阳能，边在叶片中逐渐积电。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Most commonly encountered in the summer, POKENAME lurk in amongst fields of sunflowers. They gradually build up an electrical charge within their leaves as they absorb the sun's energy.

entry: POKENAME足够专注，就能硬化头上的尖刺。但也可能因此，从颊囊放出少许电。
author: st4rdustyugure
source: POKENAME can harden the quills on its head if it focuses enough. However, it might release a bit of electricity from the sacs on its cheeks as a result.

entry: POKENAME并不常见，通常出没森林，可能从眼睛或双颊放电。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although uncommon, POKENAME are typically found in forests. They may discharge electricity from their eyes or their cheeks.

entry: POKENAME很自负，运用电魔法却很笨拙。只有最老练的训练家，才能成功训练；一旦成功，就会赢得忠诚一生的伙伴。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are known to be quite cocky and unwieldy with their electrical magic. Only the most skilled Trainers can successfully train these Pokémon, but those who do will earn a loyal companion for life.

entry: POKENAME从断路器吸电，藏在暗处，跃行城市。发现目标，它就送回电力，骤然点亮四周，让猎物措手不及。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME siphon electricity from circuit breakers to leap through the city while hidden by shadows. When a POKENAME spots its target, it returns the electricity to suddenly light up the area and catch its prey off guard.

entry: 它把水汽储在壳中，用来吐云。云足够浓厚，能迅速产生闪电。
author: hophoppip
source: It stores water vapor in its shell and uses it to puff out clouds. The clouds are dense enough to rapidly produce lightning bolts.

entry: 许多POKENAME在厨房，制作风味浓烈的皮卡丘酥麻麻咖喱，悉心照顾饮食有限制的食客。为免浪费，它会把蔬菜切成小星星，让菜更出彩。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many POKENAME work in kitchens to make a powerful Piquant Pikachu Curry and can accommodate dietary restrictions with love and care. It makes sure to prevent waste by cutting up vegetables into little stars that make the dish pop.

entry: POKENAME在胃里储存大量电力。受到威胁，就用毛发般的手臂，缠住袭击者，施以猛烈电击。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME store large amounts of electricity in their stomachs. When threatened, they will ensnare attackers with their hair-like arms, delivering a brutal electric shock.

entry: POKENAME比幼时更蓬松，也为此自豪。若弄乱它的毛，就等着挨怒气冲冲的电击，再看它撅嘴吧。
author: chaotic_aspergers
source: POKENAME is even fluffier than it was as a baby, and it takes pride in that. If you ruffle its fur, be prepared for an angry shock and a pouty Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME甜美、提神的香气，让它很受咖啡馆欢迎。尾巴产出的奶油，带有甜甜的柠檬味。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's sweet, energizing scent makes it a popular Pokémon at cafes. The cream it produces from its tail has a sweet lemon flavor.

entry: POKENAME放电时，莲叶能使身体绝缘。十万伏特威力很强，足以放倒一棵松树。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's lily pad insulates its body when it discharges electricity. Its Thunder Bolt is strong enough to fell a pine tree.

entry: POKENAME爱热闹，喜欢与人、宝可梦一起跳舞。人们会劝它们戴手套，免得不小心电到别人；但也有人觉得，小小电击正是乐趣。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are festive creatures that enjoy dancing with people and Pokémon. They are encouraged to wear gloves to prevent accidental shocks, though some people believe the small shocks are part of the fun.

entry: 没有保护壳的POKENAME，能在森林中全速飞行。可栖息地树木太密，因高速撞树而受伤，在它们之中十分常见。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME that lack a protective shell are free to fly at top speeds through the forest. Unfortunately, their habitats are very densely wooded, and injuries from high-speed impacts with trees are common among this species.

entry: POKENAME自信又固执，有时会不听别人的命令。打盹时，双颊会释放炽热而强烈的能量。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has a confident and headstrong temperament that sometimes leads it to disobey the commands of others. When it snoozes, hot and intense energy is released through its cheeks.

entry: POKENAME从土中啪地冒出，随后迸发电流，使目标麻痹，再拖入地下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME erupts from the soil with a sharp popping sound. It then releases a burst of electricity that paralyzes targets before dragging them underground.

entry: POKENAME三个个体，共用储存的电压战斗，能合力落雷，更好地迎敌，却也很快就会耗尽电力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fights with a shared store of voltage between the trio. While this gives them the advantage of coordinated lightning attacks to better battle foes, it means they exhaust their electricity in a short amount of time.

entry: POKENAME能使电子设备短路，也懂什么值钱，因此常被犯罪团伙利用。它自己却把劫掠当游戏，喜欢与训练家一起，去新地方旅行。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are often used by criminal gangs thanks to their ability to short-circuit electronics and for their sense of what is and isn't valuable. The Pokémon itself sees these heists as a game and enjoys travelling to new places with its Trainers.

entry: POKENAME能使电子设备短路，也懂什么值钱，因此常被犯罪团伙利用。它自己却把劫掠当游戏，喜欢与训练家一起，去新地方旅行。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are often used by criminal gangs thanks to their ability to short-circuit electronics and for their sense of what is and isn't valuable. The Pokémon itself sees these heists as a game and enjoys travelling to new places with its Trainers.

entry: POKENAME蓄能，准备释放强力电属性攻击时，额上的珍珠就会发出绯红光。性情顽皮顽固，很难训练。
author: fiordaliso
source: The pearl on its forehead emits a scarlet glow when POKENAME is building up energy to unleash powerful Electric-type attacks. Its mischievous and stubborn nature makes it difficult to train.

entry: POKENAME常无缘无故电击或抓伤训练家，却也以犯错后立刻获原谅而闻名。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: Although POKENAME has a tendency to shock or scratch its Trainers for no reason, it also has a reputation for being immediately forgiven for this.

entry: POKENAME会竖起毛发积蓄电力，再在POKENAME击中对手时释放电流。
author: mossybanana
source: A POKENAME charges electricity by bristling its fur. It is then discharged when POKENAME strikes their opponents.

entry: POKENAME越愤怒，体内积电越多。一旦太多，就会在失控的怒火中放出，攻击眼前的一切。
author: santon5512
source: The angrier POKENAME gets, the more electricity they will build up inside of them. Once they build up too much, they will discharge it in a blind fit of rage, attacking anything they can see.

entry: 它们独自飞过雷云，寻找闪电，增强力量。两只POKENAME空中交战，比任何雷暴都危险。
author: bandedbodypress
source: They fly alone through storm clouds, seeking a lightning bolt to enhance their strength. Two POKENAME fighting each other in the sky is more dangerous than any lightning storm.

entry: POKENAME频繁瞬移，预示雷雨将至。移动时放出的电，会吸引闪电。风暴中，它会独处，免得伤及别人。
author: shpimptin3000
source: POKENAME's frequent teleports signal an approaching thunderstorm. It discharges electricity when warping, which attracts lightning strikes. During storms, it seeks solitude to avoid hurting others.

entry: POKENAME将电能压缩成球，投向敌人。它用来投掷的手臂，往往瞄得不准，却能借助超能力，引导电球击中目标。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME compress electrical energy into spheres that they can fling at their foes. While their aim with their throwing arm tends to be poor, they are able to use their psychic powers to guide the sphere to its target.

entry: POKENAME常与摔角鹰人结成友好的竞争关系，激烈较量，提升力量。正因这些较量，它在阿罗拉摔跤圈，很受欢迎。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME regularly form friendly rivalries with Hawlucha, fiercely battling with them to become stronger. Because of these rivalries, POKENAME have become popular in Alola's wrestling scene.

entry: POKENAME引雷上身，强化甲壳。雷击会形成致密的钙质团块，让壳更加坚韧。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME bolster the strength of their shell by drawing in lightning strikes towards themselves. The strikes create pockets of dense calcium that make the shell tougher.

entry: POKENAME用闪电击地，造出雷击石，再把结晶材料从土里拔出，掷向敌人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME strike the ground with bolts of lightning to form fulgurites. Once formed, POKENAME rips the crystalized material out of the ground to throw at foes.

entry: POKENAME靠滚动移动，将积累的动能转为电力。身体虽能承载强电流，却仍会控制输出，可以安全触碰。
author: briiiiiiiit
source: POKENAME moves by rolling around, collecting kinectic energy and transforming it into electricity. Although its body can hold a high electric current, they still control its output, making it safe to the touch.

entry: POKENAME在平原疾奔，身后常留火迹。边跑边充电，快到一定程度，看起来便像一道闪电。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME runs across plains at blazing speeds, often leaving a trail of fire behind them. They charge electricity as they run, mimicking the appearance of a thunderbolt when fast enough.

entry: POKENAME的角，如同避雷针。风暴中吸收电力，便会更快，也更凶。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's horn functions like a lightning rod. During storms, it absorbs electricity and becomes faster and more aggressive.

entry: POKENAME在风暴中，以尾巴钓鱼。若大舌贝咬上来，它就释放猛烈电击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fishes with its tail during storms. If a Shellder bites, it unleashes a massive jolt of electricity in response.

entry: POKENAME用电击猎捕鲤鱼王。它很会游泳，任何想逃走的宝可梦，都能继续追赶。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hunt for Magikarp by zapping them with electric shocks. POKENAME are capable swimmers, allowing them to chase after any Pokémon that try to escape.

entry: POKENAME互相蹭头发电。蓄够能量，就把雷电导进双腿，跑出超快速度。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rub their heads together to generate electricity. Once they have enough energy charged up, they channel the lightning into their legs to run with super speed.

entry: POKENAME互蹭三个头的脸颊发电。吸收或产生的电太多，就会跑得比平时更快，试着释放多余电力。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can generate electricity by rubbing the cheeks of their three heads together. When they have either absorbed or generated too much electricity, they run around quicker than normal to try and release the excess.

entry: 据说，最初的POKENAME，诞生于奇异电磁波击中泼洒的电池酸液。碰到它，就会有强烈、不舒服的嗡麻感，数小时不散。
author: bobosmith01
source: The first POKENAME was said to form when odd electromagnetic waves hit spilled battery acid. Touching it results in a strong and unpleasant buzzing sensation that doesn't fade for hours.

entry: POKENAME将电储在背壳里，再导向连接壳的双炮。若频繁使用、不停歇，炮便可能过热。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME stores any built-up electricity inside the shell on its back and channels the electricity through the twin cannons connected to its shell. A POKENAME's cannons can overheat if they are used too frequently without breaks.

entry: POKENAME住在海里最咸的地方。道理很简单：它靠放电自卫，盐水比淡水，导电得好得多。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME lives in the saltiest parts of the sea. The reason for this is simple: it defends itself by releasing electricity, which salt water conducts far better compared to fresh water.

entry: POKENAME躲在插座里，拿电击捉弄靠近的人。电若不设法放掉，积得太多，就会失控。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hide inside electrical sockets, playfully shocking anyone that comes near. Its electricity will grow out of control if it doesn't discharge it somehow.

entry: POKENAME舔一口，电力就足以麻痹一个成年人。据说，它会徘徊在废弃变电站附近。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: A lick from a POKENAME carries enough electricity to paralyze a full-grown adult human. These Pokémon are said to linger around abandoned electrical substations.

entry: POKENAME通过鼻子吸食梦，再将梦的能量转为电力。
author: petratheangel
source: POKENAME slurps up dreams through its nose. It converts the energy from these dreams into electricity.

entry: POKENAME催眠一群皮卡丘，使其恍惚，再引向雷之石。它虽能降低皮卡丘们的顾虑，却不能强迫进化。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hypnotises groups of Pikachu into a trance before luring them to a Thunder Stone. While POKENAME can reduce the inhibitions of the group of Pikachu, it cannot force them to evolve.

entry: POKENAME将钳子敲得咔嗒作响，打出电火花，示威警告。谁没及时领会，很快就会挨电。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME clicks its claws together to create electric sparks as a threat display. Those who don't heed the warning fast enough will find themselves zapped in short order.

entry: POKENAME不爱暴力，先敲响小钳，打出火花警告。若不理会，就敲大钳，射出雷电；它不会再给第三次警告。
author: sk372
source: Averse to violence, POKENAME warns foes by clicking its small claw to produce sparks. If this warning is ignored, it clicks the larger claw to create shots of lightning. It will not give a third warning.

entry: POKENAME始终活力四射，被赞为重生与再生的象征。舞蹈散布神秘火焰，为嫩芽注入能量，连贫瘠大地上，也能茁壮生长。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Always bursting with energy, POKENAME are celebrated as symbols of rebirth and regrowth. Their dances spread mystical flames that help bring energy to sprouts, helping them grow strong even across barren landscapes.

entry: POKENAME一破壳，就收集亲代留下的羽毛，借此一路追踪到彩虹尽头。证明了生存本领后，便能温情团聚。
author: pjporwoll
source: Upon hatching, POKENAME gather feathers left behind by their parents. They use the feathers to track the parent to the end of a rainbow, leading to a heartfelt reunion as POKENAME have proven their survival skills.

entry: POKENAME被悲伤吸引，出现在被遗弃的幼年宝可梦面前，助其克服负面情绪。它却逼自己的幼崽，四处寻找自己，以理解迷途宝可梦的处境。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME appears before abandoned young Pokémon, having been drawn to their sadness, and helps them overcome the negative emotions. It forces its own young to hunt in search of it so that they may understand the plight of lost Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME每次伸腿，都会划出虹光。攻击时，它腾空而起，双腿燃出强大的神圣火焰，踢出有力的空中一击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME creates streaks of rainbow light whenever it stretches its legs. When it attacks, it jumps up and creates strong, sacred flames from its legs to do a powerful aerial kick at the opponent.

entry: POKENAME的三个幼崽，像城都传说之兽的幼体。谁想接近，它便大放光明；来者若不听警告，它就试图以神圣之火将其吞没。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's three offspring resemble infant versions of the Johto region's Legendary Beasts. If anyone tries to approach them, POKENAME will glow brightly and then try to consume anything that does not heed this warning with its Sacred Fire.

entry: POKENAME对孩子极其自豪，一有机会，就热情展示。孩子似乎没那么乐意，让研究与拍照，都更困难。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are extremely proud of their children, and will enthusiastically show them off at any given chance. Their children do not seem to share their sentiment, and make it harder for research and photographs.

entry: POKENAME游泳，尾鳍会拖出短短虹光。进攻前，它合拢脸上喙形的壳，增加保护，再以喙与角同时冲撞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tail fin emits a short rainbow trail behind it as it swims. When going on the offensive, it closes the beak-like shell over its face for added protection before ramming foes with its beak and horn in tandem.

entry: 这些热带宝可梦虽色彩绚丽、姿态威严，火爆脾气却让它们不太适合当宠物。POKENAME领地意识极强，与任何其他宝可梦同养一缸，都可能酿成灾难。
author: milchik
source: Despite how colorful and majestic they are, these tropical Pokémon aren't very popular pets due to their fiery temperament. POKENAME are very territorial, and keeping them in the same aquarium with any other Pokémon can lead to a disastrous result.

entry: POKENAME的五根羽，会逐根松动脱落，却能在一周内长回。据说，随身带一根落羽，就能永远幸福。
author: pattybgoode
source: One at a time, POKENAME's five feathers will eventually loosen and fall off, but it will regrow them within a week. Carrying a shed POKENAME feather is said to bring eternal happiness.

entry: 常讲给孩子的故事说，POKENAME的虹彩核心，就是雨后彩虹的源头。它靠核心吸收的阳光维生，能连续数日飞行，不知疲倦。
author: infinex21
source: A story often told to children is that the prismatic core of POKENAME is the source of rainbows that form after rainstorms. A POKENAME can fly without tiring for days, as it thrives off of sunlight absorbed through its core.

entry: POKENAME绷紧肌肉，周围便迸出七彩雷电。许多敌人看得太入迷，来不及抵御接踵而来的攻击。
author: sk372
source: When it flexes, POKENAME creates crackling lightning around it in all the colors of the rainbow. Many foes are too transfixed by the technicolor display to properly defend themselves from the coming strikes.

entry: POKENAME很会对抗数字空间的病毒，从头部发射虹彩光束，抹除恶意软件。光束强到连栖身电脑的色彩设置，都可能受影响。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very effective at combating viruses in digital space, erasing malware via prismatic beams fired from its head. These beams are potent enough that they may affect the color settings of the computers it inhabits.

entry: 它的翅膀不太擅长飞，却十分善于彰显华美威仪。
author: mary_the_jane
source: Its wings have a difficult time flying, but they do an excellent job at boasting its grandness and splendor.

entry: POKENAME七只一群，列阵飞行，让羽毛共同映成完整彩虹。它们长久以来，都是幸福与好运的象征，见到整群，尤其如此。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME live in communities of seven, flying in formation so their feathers reflect a complete rainbow. They have long been considered symbols of happiness and good luck, especially when seen as a full swarm.

entry: 作家常将POKENAME描绘得神圣威严，其实它更像爱整天窝床的舒适小家伙。孩子们常说，遇见过它；一睡着，它便消失了。
author: quackquackattack
source: Writers often describe POKENAME as majestic and legendary creatures, but they are closer to cozy creatures that enjoy staying in bed all day. Children often describe meeting a POKENAME only for them to disappear after they fall asleep.

entry: POKENAME正义感极强，主动寻找作恶者惩罚，却把自己的羽毛，奖给善良心灵。据说，这些羽能带来永恒幸福。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME possesses an incredibly strong sense of justice. It actively seeks out wrongdoers for punishment, but rewards kind souls with its own feathers, which are rumored to bring eternal happiness.

entry: POKENAME四处瞬移，寻找能赠羽的生灵。它似乎格外喜欢犬类宝可梦，送出羽毛后，还常摸摸对方。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME teleport around, searching for creatures to give their feathers to. It seems they have a fondness for canine Pokémon, often petting them after giving out feathers.

entry: POKENAME沐浴虹光，在彩色光芒下光合作用。周围植物受其存在滋养，重获生机，茁壮繁茂。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME can be found basking in the light of rainbows, photosynthesizing under its colorful light. Plants around it flourish, given new life in POKENAME's presence.

entry: 节庆时，人们制作POKENAME模样的戏偶，庆贺这幸福的象征。毛上反射的光，化成绚丽彩虹，让目击者满心喜悦。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: During festivals, people create puppets of POKENAME to celebrate it as a symbol of happiness. The light reflecting off POKENAME's fur creates brilliant rainbows that bring joy to those who see it.

entry: POKENAME以虹彩丝织网，反射出彩虹各色。这种丝做成的衣物，尤其美丽。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME spins a web from iridescent silk threads that reflect light in all the colors of the rainbow. Clothing made from POKENAME silk is especially beautiful.

entry: POKENAME的背羽，帮助丝线塑成复杂的形状与物件。它能产出几乎任何颜色的丝。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's back feathers help shape and form its threads into complex shapes and objects. It can produce these threads in nearly any color.

entry: POKENAME爱比赛，看看谁造的彩虹最长。城都有个流行故事说，第一道彩虹，便出自这样的较量。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME enjoy competing with each other to see who can make the longest rainbow. A popular Johtonian tale claims the first rainbow was made from one of these competitions.

entry: POKENAME象征新的开始，幼年时极难找到。据找到过它的训练家说，它会献上全心的忠诚与守护。
author: fxncy_poland
source: POKENAME symbolise new beginnings and are rare to find in their young state. Trainers who report finding POKENAME are granted with the Pokémon's full loyalty and protection.

entry: POKENAME站在暴雨中，望着天空，直到云开，彩虹显现。古老民间故事说，送它一把伞，雨就会更早停，还能带来好运。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME stand out in the middle of rain storms and watch the sky until the clouds part and reveal a rainbow. Old folk tales say that offering an umbrella to a POKENAME will make the rain end sooner and bring good luck.

entry: POKENAME蓬松温热的羊毛，充满静电，移动便噼啪作响。离开身体后，羊毛却是极好的住宅保温材料。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fluffy hot wool is filled with static that makes sparking noises as it moves. When separated from its body, this wool serves as an incredible insulator for homes.

entry: 这种形态的POKENAME，毛色会无休止地轮转彩虹各色。不知为何，名字“jeb_”的投影，会飘在它上方。
author: hophoppip
source: This form of POKENAME has wool that cycles endlessly between all the colors of the rainbow. A projection of the name “jeb_” floats above it for unknown reasons.

entry: POKENAME振着光彩夺目的双翼，滑翔天际，寻找心灵纯净的训练家结交。据说，飞行中落下的羽，会给拾得者好运。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME glide through the sky with their radiant wings in search of pure-hearted Trainers to befriend. The feathers they drop as they soar are said to bring good luck to those who find one.

entry: 一片大水域附近发生化学品泄漏后，POKENAME开始大量出现。它们大多开朗又富有爱心。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME started showing up en masse after a chemical leak near a large body of water. They usually have a very jovial and loving disposition.

entry: 晴天，POKENAME跃上空中，褶膜闪着明亮色彩，采集阳光进行光合作用。可它很容易过热，褶膜着火，又得赶紧落地。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME leap into the air on sunny days, their frills shining in radiant colors as they collect sunlight for photosynthesis. Unfortunately, they tend to overheat easily, their frills catching on fire and prompting them to land quickly.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛天生浅蓝，却会分泌液体，让光折射出虹色。鲜明的效果，常被学校用来教孩子折射原理。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's feathers are naturally light blue, but they secrete a liquid that causes them to refract light in rainbow colours. This striking effect is often used in schools to help teach children about the science of refraction.

entry: 古老传统认为，初春将树果种子丢进POKENAME的火，能帮助树果，再度长得茁壮。它会收集落枝，烧个干净，免得火势蔓延。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: An ancient tradition calls to throw berry seeds into a POKENAME's fire at the start of spring to help the berries grow back stronger. POKENAME gather fallen branches and cleanly burn them away to prevent the fire from spreading.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，仗着庞大体型，猛击地面，引发强烈地震。日落便钻入地下睡觉，热量使洞内温度高达数百度。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME rely on their massive size during battle, creating powerful earthquakes by slamming the ground. When the sun sets, POKENAME burrow into the ground to sleep, filling their burrow with heat that reaches several hundred degrees.

entry: POKENAME引领烈雀群飞过天空，宛如明亮的彩虹灯塔。有年轻人启程冒险时，报告见它划过天际，因此被视为训练家旅程开始的象征。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME guide flocks of Spearow through the sky, shining like a bright rainbow beacon. It's considered a symbol of the start of a Trainer's journey, based on reports of teenagers seeing it streak through the sky as they set off on their adventure.

entry: 有些文化视POKENAME为繁荣与好运的象征，古时便已描绘在神庙墙上。彩翼间托着的球体，亮得能瞬间驱散任何雾。
author: fiordaliso
source: Some cultures consider POKENAME a symbol of prosperity and good fortune, to the point that even in ancient times it was depicted on temple walls. The globe it holds between its colorful wings is so bright that it can dispel any fog in an instant.

entry: 野生POKENAME跳跃、滑翔，会留下一道道虹色极光。它常恶作剧，让别人以为循虹就能找到宝藏，通常最好的结果，却也不过一堆树果。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME leave rainbow-like auroras when they leap and glide in the air. They often use their rainbows to prank others as though the rainbows will lead them to treasure, but will usually lead them to, at best, a pile of berries.

entry: POKENAME爱收集闪亮或贵重的东西，常因此跑进本不适合自己的生态环境。它有两个脑，一个富同情心，另一个却总想找架打。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME has a fondness for collecting anything either shiny or valuable, causing it to often find itself in biomes not naturally suited for it. This Pokémon has two brains; one is compassionate, while the other is always eager to start a fight.

entry: POKENAME满身羽毛，在满月下会变得极烫。只要吃下大量蜂蜜，它就能轻松调节温度。
author: .izik
source: The feathers covering POKENAME's body grow intensely hot when exposed to a full moon. It can regulate this temperature with ease while consuming large amounts of honey.

entry: POKENAME熔融的身体，不停翻涌色彩，身后也留下虹色轨迹。痕迹危险得不能碰，据说连脱落的岩浆，也热如太阳表面。
author: imaginita
source: The molten body of a POKENAME is constantly billowing with color. It leaves a similarly rainbow-colored trail that is dangerous to touch, as even the cast-off magma is said to be as hot as the surface of the sun.

entry: POKENAME的刺散出怡人烟气，有多种有益作用，效果随具体食谱改变。有人推测，香的发明，正是受它启发。
author: staghorn
source: The pleasant smoke emitted from POKENAME's spines has a number of beneficial effects that vary based on its particular diet. It is theorized that POKENAME inspired the invention of incense.

entry: POKENAME通常只短暂飞行，留下鲜艳彩虹。训练家若足够执着，一路跟随，也许能在尽头找到巢，里面囤着许多金币。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: POKENAME tend to fly in short bursts, creating vibrant rainbows in their wake. If a Trainer is determined enough to follow one, they may find a POKENAME's nest at the end, where POKENAME hoards their many gold coins.

entry: POKENAME尾上的变幻色彩，来自体内毒素的反应。它吐出不同配比的毒，再以火花点燃，造出帮助狩猎的烟花。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The flickering colors along POKENAME's tail come from reactions of toxins within its body. It spits out different combinations of poison and ignites them with sparks, creating fireworks that help it hunt.

entry: POKENAME巡视热带海洋，管住闯入者。口中喷出的虹色墨汁，既遮挡视线，温度又极高，碰到什么，都会烫伤。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME patrols tropical oceans, keeping intruders in line. It sprays a rainbow colored ink from its mouth to obscure vision; the ink itself also reaches extremely high temperatures that scald anything it touches.

entry: POKENAME翱翔时，长耳后流出彩虹。传说，谁见到这罕景，就会受到好运与健康的祝福。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: Rainbows stream behind POKENAME's long ears as it soars through the air. According to legend, anyone who sees this rare sight is blessed with good fortune and health.

entry: POKENAME鲜艳明亮的外表，让它在古时成为荣耀与富贵的象征。有些地区的王族，会骑着穿街，炫耀高于平民的地位。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's bright and vibrant appearance made it a symbol of glory and opulence in ancient times. In some regions, royals would ride it through the streets in order to flaunt their status above the common folk.

entry: POKENAME飞过网络空间，寻找网暴受害者，赠予华美羽毛。受害者一捏碎羽毛，就能屏蔽、举报所有施暴者，终止骚扰。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME soars through cyberspace to search for victims of cyberbullying. By bestowing one of its resplendent feathers, POKENAME gives victims the ability to stop the harassment when the feather is crushed, blocking and reporting all their bullies.

entry: POKENAME保护世界干旱地区的幼年宝可梦，过去被尊为沙漠守护者。如今受敬重，却是另一个原因：毒液能提炼解毒剂。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME were once revered as guardians of the desert because of its protectiveness over young Pokémon in arid regions of the world. Nowadays it is held to high esteem for a different reason: the antivenom that is derived from its venom.

entry: 据说，POKENAME一叫，火山就会喷出虹色岩浆。它以巨大的飞跃，迅速穿过各地，每跃一次，双翼都拖出彩迹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cry is said to cause volcanoes to erupt with rainbow-colored magma. It takes great flying leaps to cross the regions quickly, a colorful trail emanating from its wings with every leap.

entry: POKENAME在炎热干旱的稀树草原称霸，威严的气势，吓走周围大多数生灵。不断较量，也让身体布满伤痕。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME reign supreme in the hot, arid conditions of the savannah, their commanding presence scaring away most other life from their presence. Their bodies are covered in scars from the constant duels they are subject to.

entry: 城都各地，都把见到POKENAME视为吉兆。据说，它祝福初踏旅途的人，也给归来者好运。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Seeing a POKENAME is regarded as a good omen throughout Johto. They are said to bless those setting out on a journey and bring good fortune to those returning.

entry: 城都各地，都把见到POKENAME视为吉兆。据说，它祝福初踏旅途的人，也给归来者好运。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Seeing a POKENAME is regarded as a good omen throughout Johto. They are said to bless those setting out on a journey and bring good fortune to those returning.

entry: 据说，POKENAME的翼能闪出七种颜色，每种都代表不同的破坏程度。
author: _sui999_
source: It's said that POKENAME's wings can flash in seven different colors, each one representing a different level of destruction.

entry: 城都各地，都把见到POKENAME视为吉兆。据说，它祝福初踏旅途的人，也给归来者好运。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Seeing a POKENAME is regarded as a good omen throughout Johto. They are said to bless those setting out on a journey and bring good fortune to those returning.

entry: 城都各地，都把见到POKENAME视为吉兆。据说，它祝福初踏旅途的人，也给归来者好运。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Seeing a POKENAME is regarded as a good omen throughout Johto. They are said to bless those setting out on a journey and bring good fortune to those returning.

entry: 城都各地，都把见到POKENAME视为吉兆。据说，它祝福初踏旅途的人，也给归来者好运。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Seeing a POKENAME is regarded as a good omen throughout Johto. They are said to bless those setting out on a journey and bring good fortune to those returning.

entry: 这种自身融合的羽毛，比普通凤王更耀眼，七色同时显现。极少数时候，周围还会出现双虹，外层彩虹的色序相反。
author: infranscia
source: The feathers of this self fusion shine even more boldly than a standard Ho-oh's, with all seven colors visible at once.  On rare occasion, the rainbows surrounding it double up, with the outer rainbow's colors showing in reverse order.

entry: 有些古老传说称，罕见的凤王个体，并非虹彩，而是纯金的化身。这种自身融合，增加了传说的可信度，也激发研究者，尽可能了解它们。
author: infranscia
source: Some ancient legends say rare individuals of Ho-oh embodied pure gold, instead of the rainbow.  This self fusion lends credence to those legends, and has inspired some researchers to learn all they can about them.

entry: POKENAME烧毁老森林，让健康的新生植物茁壮繁盛。传说，谁跟随它走过七个不同的时代，就能获得永生。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME burns down old forests in order to grow and flourish new, healthy flora. Legends say that those who follow this Pokémon through seven different eras of time will be given eternal life.

entry: 它心地仁慈，会赐福给内心纯净的训练家。据说歌声能令每位听众感到无比喜悦。
author: mistymagius
source: This benevolent Pokémon will grant blessing to Trainers that are pure of heart. Its singing voice is said to bring any listeners pure euphoria.

entry: POKENAME四处收集石头等物，直到集齐彩虹七色。太久没集齐，就会闹脾气。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME goes around collecting stones or other similar objects until it has gathered the seven colors of the rainbow. It throws a tantrum if it goes too long without having a full collection.

entry: 传说，这种宝可梦七只成群，现身冰湖，齐舞留下极光般的彩焰。谁能跟上动作，据说就能获得无穷灵感。
author: _blissey
source: Legends claim this Pokémon appears in groups of seven atop frozen lakes, performing a synchronized dance that leaves trails of colorful flame mimicking an aurora. It is said to bring endless inspiration to anyone who can match its movements.

entry: POKENAME战斗中挥动藤臂，会留下虹光。全身藤蔓都能亮得耀眼，使别人看不见，更容易被拍走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's vine arms leave behind a rainbow trail when it swings them in combat. It can make all the vines of its body turn radiantly bright in order to blind others and leave them more open to being swatted away.

entry: POKENAME满是藤蔓的身躯，不断轮转光谱中的虹色。景象虽鲜艳夺目，亮得近乎俗艳的花色，看久了，却容易头痛。
author: sk372
source: The rainbow-colored hues on POKENAME's vine-covered body constantly rotate through the color spectrum. Though undoubtedly a vibrant spectacle to see, the bright, almost gaudy color pattern tends to create headaches when viewed for too long.

entry: POKENAME能从双臂，喷出一股股虹色火焰。古代文化相信，明亮的火，能驱走厄运与疾病。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is capable of releasing blasts of rainbow-colored flames from its arms. Ancient cultures believed these bright flames were capable of warding off misfortune and sickness.

entry: 传说POKENAME的叶片有机会让死者复生。身体散发着彩虹般七彩的温暖光辉。
author: mistymagius
source: Legends say the leaves from a POKENAME have a chance to bring back the dead. Its body gives off a warm glow in every color of the rainbow.

entry: POKENAME穿行电脑程序，给进入的各种文件添色。旧电脑必须与它隔离，因为一尝试呈现那些鲜艳色彩，显示系统就会损坏。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME is able to travel between computer programs, seeking to spread colour to the various files it enters. Older computer systems have to be quarantined from POKENAME as their display systems break when trying to display the vivid colours.

entry: 背上的球体，利用阳光为各种攻击供能时，会发出虹彩。POKENAME臂上的羽毛，也常有类似光泽，连脱落后仍在。
author: infinex21
source: The orbs along their backs glow with iridescent light as they harness sunlight to power their various attacks. The feathers along the arms of POKENAME often shimmer with a similar iridescent glow even after being shed.

entry: POKENAME孵化时，会把蛋焚成圣灰，由此缘朱市有了收集灰烬，用于葬礼仪式的传统。它讨厌独处，却与犬类、猫类宝可梦格外亲近。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME incinerate their eggs into Sacred Ash when hatching, leading to the tradition in Ecruteak City of gathering the ashes for funeral ceremonies. They hate being alone, but have a strong affinity for dog and cat Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME孵化时，会把蛋焚成圣灰，由此缘朱市有了收集灰烬，用于葬礼仪式的传统。它讨厌独处，却与犬类、猫类宝可梦格外亲近。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME incinerate their eggs into Sacred Ash when hatching, leading to the tradition in Ecruteak City of gathering the ashes for funeral ceremonies. They hate being alone, but have a strong affinity for dog and cat Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME出现在心灵纯净的训练家面前，提出挑战。若认为对方值得一战，就会赠羽，据说能给持有者，永不熄灭的斗志。
author: acid_pen
source: POKENAME reveals itself to a Trainer pure of heart and will challenge them to a battle. If it deems the Trainer a worthy foe, it will bestow on them one of its feathers, said to give the holder an inextinguishable fighting spirit.

entry: POKENAME对他人的情绪极敏感。被快乐的人围住，身体就会散出彩色气场。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is very sensitive to the emotions of others. When surrounded by joyful people, a colorful aura radiates from its body.

entry: 羽色会随心情变化。颜色苍白的POKENAME不快或害怕，会防卫性地焚烧威胁；颜色鲜艳时，则安全而满足，让周围一切焕发生机。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: Their radiant feathers turn different colors depending on their mood. Pale-colored POKENAME are upset or scared, defensively incinerating threats, but vibrant-colored POKENAME feel safe and content, rejuvenating anything and anyone nearby.

entry: POKENAME自古就生活在人类附近，偶尔现身节庆，跳舞带来好运。有人推测，古城都的某些舞风，可能受它启发。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Having lived near humans since ancient times, POKENAME occasionally appear to dance during festivals to inspire good fortune. It is theorized that they may have inspired certain styles of dances in Ancient Johto.

entry: POKENAME几乎每个动作，都会在空中留下一抹淡虹光。它以神圣之火筑墙，烧退逼近的危险，保护选中的训练家。
author: sk372
source: Almost every movement POKENAME makes is followed by a faint rainbow shimmer in the air. It guards its chosen Trainer from harm by creating walls of Sacred Fire to burn away any approaching dangers.

entry: POKENAME高贵而罕见，喜欢住在塔顶与山巅。缘朱市优雅的舞者，常从它身上汲取灵感。
author: quote.lass
source: A regal and seldom-seen Pokémon that prefers to live atop towers and mountains. The elegant dancers of Ecruteak take great inspiration from POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME刀刃般的羽毛，从不同角度看，似乎会变色。古人相信，它是季节更替的使者。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's blade-like feathers appear to change color when viewed from different angles. Ancient people believed it was a messenger of shifting seasons.

entry: POKENAME在缘朱市的塔间飞行，似乎只为飞而飞。当地传说，若从它双翼之间凝望，就会被神圣火焰击中。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME fly between the towers in Ercuteak City, for seemingly no reason other than to fly. Local legend states that if one were to gaze between POKENAME's wings, that person would be struck by divine fire.

entry: POKENAME能过滤、处理光，看到比人类更宽的色谱。它能把色素分成基本成分，算出调出任意颜色的完美配方，因此很受画家欢迎。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are able to filter and process light to see a broader spectrum of color than humans. They can break pigments down to their core components and calculate the perfect formula to mix any color, making them popular among painters.

entry: POKENAME闲着时，看起来几乎只是颗永不孵化的蛋。有来者靠近，就会显现火焰鸟灵的真身，放出能烧透敌人的幽火。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME, when idle, appears as little more than an eternally unhatched egg. When others are near, it reveals itself as a fiery avian spirit, able to emit ghostly flames that can burn enemies to their core.

entry: POKENAME的楔石由磨亮的黄金构成。它从石中现身，便散发怡人暖意，还会传出犬类宝可梦的吠声。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME's keystone is composed of polished gold. When POKENAME emerges from the stone, a pleasant warmth emanates from it, as well as the sounds of canine Pokémon barking.

entry: POKENAME游过深海沟，身体因强热而发光。它极难见到，若认定潜艇是威胁，就会将其化为灰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body glows with intense heat while swimming through deep ocean trenches. It is extremely elusive and will reduce a submarine to ash if it deems it a threat.

entry: POKENAME的六只眼，转向哪里，绯红射线就照到哪里，热得轻易便能灼伤宝可梦。羽光会随时段变色，却只起报时作用。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: POKENAME's six eyes cast scarlet rays wherever they dart. These rays are extremely hot and can burn a Pokémon with ease. Its feathers glow different colours based on the time of day, but this only helps with telling the time.

entry: POKENAME从不真正死去，会忠诚侍奉主人，直到最后。可即使殒命后能够重生，它依然是濒危物种。
author: thenebulamage
source: POKENAME never truly dies and will loyally serve its master until the end. It remains an endangered species despite its ability to be reborn upon demise.

entry: POKENAME为安静进食，会让额头闪光，吓走其他宝可梦。若不奏效，它就虚弱地啼叫。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: To ensure it can eat in peace, POKENAME flashes its forehead to scare other Pokémon away. If this fails, POKENAME squawks feebly.

entry: POKENAME看见谁遇险，就从云端俯冲，挡在受害者与袭击者之间。飞行造出绚丽彩虹，它便借虹之力，吐出毁灭性的多色火焰。
author: evilgammon
source: Upon seeing someone in danger, POKENAME swoops down from the clouds, placing itself between the victim and the attacker. It creates dazzling rainbows as it flies, which it draws power from to breathe devastating, multicoloured flames.

entry: 目前，人们认为POKENAME催生了各类不死鸟传说。它在诸般惨剧中挺身而出，始终愿为别人献命，随后消失，只留灰烬。
author: thordemidgard
source: POKENAME is currently thought to have birthed legends about various iterations of the phoenix. This heroic Pokémon takes action in all sorts of tragedies— always willing to give its own life for another. It then disappears, leaving ashes behind.

entry: POKENAME飞过天空，翼上会落下灰状残留物。世界各地会采集这种物质与虹色烟，用作祭香与仪式。
author: .izik
source: Ash-like residue sheds from POKENAME's wings as it flies through the sky. This substance and its rainbow-hued smoke are gathered worldwide for sacred incense and rites.

entry: 古文将POKENAME描绘为神秘守护者，只能在彩虹尽头找到。羽毛闪出1000种颜色，便会让目击者心生希望与安慰。
author: mepp.
source: Ancient texts describe POKENAME as mystical guardians who can only be found at the ends of rainbows. When their feathers glow with 1,000 colors, it kindles a sense of hope and comfort into those who witness it.

entry: POKENAME羽毛闪着虹彩，据说哪怕只持一根，也能带来大好运。强烈火焰留下的灰中，新生命会迅速萌发、繁盛。
author: infinex21
source: The feathers of POKENAME shimmer with the colors of a rainbow and are said to bring great fortune to any who wield even a single feather. In the wake of its powerful flames, new life will quickly blossom and flourish from the ashes left behind.

entry: 自古以来，POKENAME都是安慰与重生的象征。一找到信任的训练家，就让对方坐在背上，自己敲响塔中铃，以婉转铃声，舒缓烦忧。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Since ancient times, POKENAME have been seen as symbols of comfort and rebirth. Once a POKENAME has found a Trainer it trusts, it will allow them to sit on its back while it rings the bell in its tower, easing their worries with its melodic chime.

entry: 已知最大的POKENAME群，在世界南端。它们每晚聚集，高高飞起，嬉玩最后的余光，将其化为万花筒般的极光。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The largest known colony of POKENAME is found at the southern tip of the world. They gather every evening and fly high, playing with the final rays of light, transforming them into a kaleidoscopic aurora.

entry: POKENAME游到哪里，就释放闪着虹彩的光泡。鳞片在阳光下闪耀，折射出缤纷光彩；找到一片，便被认为是幸运。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release glowing iridescent bubbles wherever they swim. Their scales shimmer when exposed to sunlight and refract in a plethora of resplendent colors. Finding a POKENAME scale is considered lucky.

entry: 它们的虹彩尾巴，四方皆珍视为美的典范、生命的象征，有些节庆专门为此庆贺。许多艺术家相信，鳞片是创作巅峰之作的关键。
author: deadshields
source: Their iridescent tails are prized far and wide as epitomes of beauty and symbols of life, with certain festivals hosting celebrations in their honour. Many artists consider the use of their scales to be the key to creating their magnum opus.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME若超频转动齿轮，就能产生足够能量，让死去的生灵复活。周围的虹环，也让附近生灵觉得活力充盈、心生喜悦。
author: soup1900
source: It is believed that when POKENAME overclocks the spinning of its gears, it can create enough energy to revive a dead being. The rainbow ring surrounding POKENAME radiates feelings of energy and joy to those nearby.

entry: POKENAME框架内的转子，蕴含着几乎无尽的力量。据说，古代偶戏，只有得到这些巨大戏偶的祝福，才能上演。
author: secondunit
source: The rotor within the frame of POKENAME possesses a near endless well of power. It is said that historical puppet plays could only be performed with the blessing of these gargantuan puppets.

entry: 宽大的翼常散落虹彩羽毛，令周围现实微微扭曲，仿佛酷热所致。火焰能呈现许多颜色，常用来捉弄人类或宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: Its expansive wings oft scatter iridescent feathers that slightly warp reality around them as if they are incredibly hot. Its flames can achieve a wide variety of colors that often play tricks on others, be they Pokémon or human.

entry: POKENAME挥动触须，散出彩虹般的光。伴随而来的舒缓气场，已让许多人类与宝可梦平静下来。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME exude rainbow-like lights as they swing their feelers around. The sight of these rainbow-like lights has placated many people and Pokémon alike due to the soothing aura exuded in tandem.

entry: 过去有些文化，将看见POKENAME借触须滑过云层，视为好运。歌声般的叫声，也被当作夏季到来的信号。
author: chibitales
source: Seeing a POKENAME gliding through the clouds using its feelers was considered a sign of good fortune in some past cultures. Its song-like cry was used as a signal that summer was upon the land.

entry: POKENAME一眨不眨地盯着太阳，只有等待太阳归来时，才会移开目光。它漫无目的地游荡，每一步都震动大地。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME's eyes stare unblinkingly at the sun. It only ever averts its gaze while it awaits the sun's return, quaking the ground with each step as it wanders aimlessly.

entry: 雨停后，POKENAME也许会飞过，造出彩虹。见过彩虹的人说，之后会做愉快而安心的梦。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When the rain stops falling, a POKENAME might fly by, creating rainbows. Those who see these rainbows claim to have pleasant, comforting dreams later.

entry: 这种宝可梦披着羽毛，看似轻盈，体重却能堪比一架小飞机。POKENAME用钢铁翅膀控制航向，再以背上的炮，喷出虹色能量，推动自己前进。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: This Pokémon's body may appear light due to the feathers, but it can weigh as much as a small plane. Using its steel wings to control its flight path, POKENAME uses the cannon on its back to propel itself forward with rainbow colored energy.

entry: 据说POKENAME的神圣之火能净化一切。传说它正等待着某一天，遇见一个连它的火焰也伤不了的人。
author: staghorn
source: It is said that POKENAME's sacred fire can purify anything. According to legend, it waits for the day it meets a human that its flames cannot burn.

entry: 羽翼在阳光下闪着虹光，同样的阳光，却也融化冰，让甜液沿身体滴落。人们说，味道像果味冰棍。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Its feathered wings shimmer like a rainbow under sunlight; however, that same sunlight melts its ice and causes a sweet liquid to drip down its body. People say its taste is reminiscent of a fruity ice lolly.

entry: POKENAME最常漂浮在节庆上方，摇响手中铃，让大家知道自己在场。据说，若能取到一只铃，就能获得好运。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are most often spotted floating above festivals, the bells they hold ringing to make their presence known. Should someone be able to take one of these bells, it is said that they will be granted good luck.

entry: POKENAME跳跃有力，耳翼又能助飞，十分擅长闪避攻击。拿手一击，是裹着虹色火焰，从上方俯冲踢下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's strong leaps combined with its ear-wings granting it flight make it excellent at evading a foe's strikes. Its signature strike is a diving kick from above while surrounded in rainbow-colored flames.

entry: POKENAME装束华丽，毛发光滑，在雷文市很受欢迎。它十分爱惜仪容，甚至会在开打前，迷住对手，让其放弃战斗。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: With their flashy outfits and sleek hair, POKENAME are quite popular in Nimbasa City. POKENAME are protective over their looks and will go as far as to charm opponents into giving up battles before they start.

entry: 传闻，POKENAME曾被用于古老仪式。体内火焰的光，据说能治愈照到的一切。
author: evilscarypurple
source: It is rumored that POKENAME was once used in an ancient ritual. The flame inside is said to be capable of healing anything its light shines on.

entry: 古代有个文明，曾崇拜彩虹般的存在。据说，POKENAME缤纷的火焰，正是那个文明梦想的结晶。
author: mpotter75
source: The colorful flames of POKENAME are said to be the culmination of the dreams of an ancient civilization that worshiped a rainbow being.

entry: 核心散发振奋的能量，飞行时，便在天空拖出虹迹。电影与漫画常把POKENAME描绘为博爱的超级英雄，成了许多人心中，希望与和谐的象征。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: Their core radiates with reinvigorating energy that creates a rainbow trail through the sky when they fly. POKENAME are commonly depicted in movies and comic books as all-loving superheroes, making them popular icons of hope and harmony for many.

entry: 有人相信，古代文明创造POKENAME，是为王族准备的奢华赠礼。它举起翅膀，就会产生瀑布般倾泻的虹光束。
author: sk372
source: Some believe ancient civilizations created POKENAME as an ostentatious gift for royalty. Raising its wings causes it to generate cascading beams of rainbow light.

entry: POKENAME虽然看不见，却爱跑来跑去，咬咬东西。亮羽闪着缤纷色彩，让所有见者都露出笑容。
author: bottomusmaximus3
source: Although POKENAME cannot see, it loves running around and biting things. Its bright feathers shimmer in a multitude of colors, placing smiles on the faces of all who watch it.

entry: POKENAME有两个头，羽色鲜艳，常被误认成罕见的神话生物。其实视力不佳，身体发育不足，行动笨拙。
author: bottomusmaximus3
source: Because of its two heads and brightly-colored feathers, POKENAME is often mistaken for a rare mythical creature. In fact, it struggles to see and its underdeveloped body makes it awkward and clumsy.

entry: 这种华美宝可梦，已完全进化，性情变得凶猛，谁挑衅就攻击谁。传说，总有一天，它会从彩虹降下，带来毁灭，或带来喜悦。
author: bottomusmaximus3
source: Now fully evolved, this magnificent Pokémon has developed a ferocious nature and attacks anything that provokes it. Legend says that one day it will descend from a rainbow, bringing either destruction or joy.

entry: 据说，它住在云中，避开一切人类接触。睡觉时，身体会闪出多种缥缈的色彩。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is said to live in the clouds and avoid all human contact. When it sleeps, its body glows in a variety of ethereal colors.

entry: 古籍将POKENAME描绘为闪耀的繁荣使者。据说，它在哪里栖息，哪里就会丰饶。
author: mepp.
source: Ancient books describe POKENAME as a shining bringer of prosperity. Wherever it roosts, great abundance is said to follow.

entry: 多条蓬松尾巴，会把阳光折射出奇异色彩，许多人说像彩虹。POKENAME准备从口中喷火时，这些尾巴便会鼓起。
author: infinex21
source: Its many, puffy tails refract sunlight in peculiar colors that many say reminds them of rainbows. These many tails will puff up when a POKENAME prepares to unleash a stream of flames from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME从身体释放多色火焰作战。要改变火色，就得精确转动齿轮般的身体，调到恰好的状态。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME fight by unleashing multi-colored flames from their body. To change the color of their flames, they rotate their gear-like bodies with precision until they find the right setting.

entry: 据说，POKENAME的火焰，能驱走恶灵。兴奋时，火色会更鲜艳，也更多彩。
author: mepp.
source: It is said that the flames POKENAME creates have the power to drive away malevolent spirits. When excited, the color of these flames becomes more vibrant and multi-colored.

entry: 曾有人以为，在缘朱市的节庆中见过POKENAME。它喜欢暖天，甚至可能从太阳获取能量：明亮晴日，气球状的肢体也可能变色。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME was once thought to have been spotted at a festival in Ecruteak City. It enjoys warm weather, and may even get energy from the sun: on bright and sunny days, the balloon-shaped limbs may change in color.

entry: POKENAME寿终时，会爆成灰烬，含有植物生长必需、营养丰富的尖状物。由灰养出的森林，格外繁茂健康。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: When POKENAME reaches the end of its lifespan, it explodes into ashes that contain nutrient-rich spikes essential for plant growth. Forests grown from its ashes are exceptionally lush and healthy.

entry: 据说，POKENAME成群齐唱，头顶天空就会形成鲜艳彩虹。个头虽小，吐出的彩焰却炽烈得能熔钢。
author: infinex21
source: It is said that when a flock of POKENAME sings in unison, a vibrant rainbow will form in the skies above them. Though small, these Pokémon can breathe colorful flames with such intensity that steel melts in their wake.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀太大，很难好好飞行。羽间抖落的余烬，闪着彩虹的所有颜色。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's large wings make it difficult for them to fly properly. The embers shaken from their feathers shine with every color of the rainbow.

entry: 谁碰到POKENAME，眼前就会闪过虹色，似乎只是触电的副作用。身体放出的电，足以让接触的任何皮肤，都痛苦灼伤。
author: .jerden
source: Rainbow colors will flash before the eyes of anyone who touches POKENAME, although this seems to just be a side effect of electrocution. Enough electricity is discharged from its body to cause painful burns to any skin it makes contact with.

entry: POKENAME大多坐在池边，凝望月光映水。研究者记录到，倒影中可见彩虹时，它的能力会明显提升。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: POKENAME spends most of its time sitting near a pond, gazing at the way moonlight reflects in the water. Researchers have recorded a significant increase in its abilities when a rainbow is visible in the reflection.

entry: 记录显示，古城都某些地区，曾让POKENAME跳仪式舞。舞蹈召出虹色火焰，焚烧献给当时所信神明的供品。
author: sk372
source: Records indicate POKENAME were once used to perform ritualistic dances in some regions of ancient Johto. Their dances summoned rainbow-colored flames that were used to burn tributes to deities worshiped at the time.

entry: POKENAME生气时，便披上虹色火焰。有人声称，借它热烈的舞，能重历往昔。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME cloaks itself in rainbow-colored flames when angered. Some have claimed to relive history through its passionate dance.

entry: POKENAME表演时，互蹭羽毛绒球，让虹色火花与余烬，纷纷洒落。过去遗下的典礼盛装中，也曾找到它蜕落的羽。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME rub their feathered pom-poms together as they perform, causing rainbow-colored sparks and embers to shower down around them. Molted feathers from these Pokémon have been found in ceremonial regalia from the past.

entry: POKENAME能轻松跳出，被认为早已失传的舞。最常见的传统舞步，竟与缘朱舞场最受欢迎的舞相仿，却没有证据解释，它为何会跳。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can perform dances that were thought to be lost to time with ease. It is most frequently seen doing a traditional routine that mirrors the Ecruteak Dance Theater's most popular dance, despite no evidence saying that it should know the steps.

entry: 没有两只POKENAME，翼上花纹完全相同。图案描绘着，各自最珍视的记忆。
author: dodoowner_
source: No two POKENAME have the same patterns on their wings. The designs on the Pokémon's wings depict the memories POKENAME holds closest to them.

entry: 据说，每月给POKENAME带来供品，它就愿意让一位死者复生。它是神圣的宝可梦，只能在古老神祠找到。
author: mistymagius
source: It is said that if you bring a monthly offering to POKENAME, it will offer to bring someone back from the dead. It is a sacred Pokémon and can only be found at ancient shrines.

entry: POKENAME的花瓣闪着虹彩，却一次只能呈现五色。激动时，会产生闪亮花粉，让人发痒，争取逃走的时间。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have flower petals that sparkle with the colors of the rainbow, though they can only have five colors at a time. When agitated, they produce a shimmering pollen that causes itchiness, giving them time to escape.

entry: POKENAME性情极其凶暴强悍，战斗时，会用神圣火焰将敌人烧得焦脆。产生的光却暗淡昏沉，被击中，就会陷入深切悲伤。
author: soup1900
source: With its overly violent and powerful disposition, POKENAME absolutely burns foes to an utter crisp with sacred flames when in battle. All the light it creates is extremely dull and dark in color, and creates deep sorrow when struck by it.

entry: POKENAME鲜亮的模样，很吸引年幼训练家。开心又被孩子拥抱时，便会散发温暖、灿烂的虹光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's bright appearance makes it very appealing to many young Trainers. When it's happy and embraced by a child, it emanates a warm and radiant rainbow glow.

entry: POKENAME释放的孢子，触感很烫，却能使死去的植物复苏。连砍断的树桩，也能片刻长成完整大树。
author: .izik
source: The spores POKENAME releases are hot to the touch but can revitalize deceased plant life. Even chopped stumps can regrow into full trees within moments.

entry: 如城都烧焦塔的故事一样，POKENAME的身体，在猛烈风暴中受雷击，便会崩碎。传说，将逝者的骨骸放入身体，就能让其重生。
author: soup1900
source: Just like in the story of the burned tower in Johto, POKENAME's body crumbles when struck by lightning in a violent storm. Legends claim that by inserting the bones of the deceased into its body, it can revive them anew.

entry: 如城都烧焦塔的故事一样，POKENAME的身体，在猛烈风暴中受雷击，便会崩碎。传说，将逝者的骨骸放入身体，就能让其重生。
author: soup1900
source: Just like in the story of the burned tower in Johto, POKENAME's body crumbles when struck by lightning in a violent storm. Legends claim that by inserting the bones of the deceased into its body, it can revive them anew.

entry: 据说，POKENAME的炽热舞蹈，如奇迹般绚丽，虹色火焰旋出奇妙图案。它不肯让人录下舞，想让表演真正独特。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's fiery dances are said to be truly miraculous displays of rainbow-colored flames swirling in fantastic patterns. It refuses to let its dances be recorded, wanting its performances to be truly special.

entry: POKENAME头上的突起，能发出虹色精神脉冲，震晕周围的一切。它因此很擅长捕捉小鱼，也能驱赶闯入深海领地的来者。
author: sk372
source: The protuberance on POKENAME's head can emit a rainbow-colored pulse of psychic energy that stuns everything around it. This makes it excellent at hunting smaller fish for prey as well as repelling intruders away from its deep-sea domain.

entry: POKENAME华美的蘑菇，闪着虹彩。传说赋予孢子诸般奇迹，从永远幸福到起死回生，可至今，只证实会使人陷入深沉睡眠。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's magnificent mushroom shimmers with rainbow colors. Legends ascribe miraculous properties to its spores, ranging from granting eternal happiness to raising the dead, but so far they have only been proven to cause deep slumber.

entry: POKENAME栖居之处，天空彩虹多得不自然，身处其间，也会感到过分的快乐。许多人相信，若它的光照遍世人，世界便能和平幸福。
author: soup1900
source: Areas where POKENAME resides are unnaturally abundant with rainbows in the sky and feel overly joyful when within the location. Many people believe that if POKENAME shone its light upon everyone, world peace and happiness can be achieved.

entry: POKENAME要造出绚丽彩虹，每天必须有大量新鲜净水与明亮阳光。它虽优雅，也会毫不犹豫，以威力惊人的火焰斩击敌人。
author: soup1900
source: In order for POKENAME to create brilliant, gorgeous rainbows, it must be given plenty of fresh, pure water and bright sunshine every day. While it may be an elegant Pokémon, it won't hesitate to slash at opponents with overwhelmingly powerful flames.

entry: POKENAME是让人想起不死鸟的飞行属性宝可梦。双翼比钻石更强韧，既能抵御较大的鸟，也能直接切穿敌人。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: POKENAME is a Flying-Type Pokémon reminiscent of a phoenix. It protects its body from larger birds using its wings, which are stronger than diamond and can slice right through an enemy.

entry: POKENAME色彩绚丽，长久被视为权威象征。古时发现野生个体，就应当捕来，献给皇帝。
author: .realthree
source: The colorful POKENAME has long been regarded as a symbol of authority. In ancient times, if a wild POKENAME was ever found, it was expected that it would be caught and given to the emperor.

entry: 法杖里的球体，能发出七色光。野生POKENAME借杖之力，燃火对抗黑暗。
author: cobalt0135
source: The orb within the staff can illuminate in seven colors. Wild POKENAME will use the power of their staves to ignite against the darkness.

entry: 传说，POKENAME投出的火焰手里剑，会在七色之间交替。它被称为天空守护者，攻击与飞行，都拖着彩虹轨迹。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: Legends say that the flaming shuriken POKENAME throws alternate between 7 colors. POKENAME is called the Guardian of the Skies and leaves a rainbow trail behind both its attacks and flight.

entry: POKENAME踏着节奏，快速移动，跺地的凶猛如烈火。世界某些地方，人们会穿它的装束，在节庆游行中起舞。
author: pattybgoode
source: Moving in rhythmic steps, POKENAME moves swiftly and stomps the ground with fiery ferocity. In certain parts of the world, people don POKENAME costumes to dance in festival parades.

entry: POKENAME总在雨后现身，伴着彩虹而来。能遇见它们，便是好运的征兆。
author: pokebio
source: POKENAME always come out after the rain. They bring rainbows along with them and seeing them is a sign of good fortune.

entry: 据说，POKENAME头顶愉悦的铃声，能将整座洞穴，变成耀眼晶洞。许多想利用它力量的训练家，最后自己也化作晶体。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: It is said that the joyous ringing of the bell atop POKENAME's head can turn entire caverns into dazzling geodes. Many Trainers who tried to exploit its power ended up crystallized themselves.

entry: 据说，POKENAME能带来永远幸福，自己的生活却充满纷争与挣扎。努力躲避训练家和其他宝可梦，让它承受压力，常化作阵阵头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are said to bring eternal happiness, but the lives of POKENAME are full of strife and struggle. Their efforts to avoid Trainers and other Pokémon give them stress, which often manifests as aching headaches.

entry: POKENAME躲避人类，行踪难觅，很难研究。少数相遇中，据说它会化作一抹虹光，迅速游走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are elusive creatures that are difficult to study because of their avoidance of people. During the few encounters that have occurred, they are said to swim away in a blur of rainbow light.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME若愤怒到极点，连死亡也止不住狂暴，因为它会从自身灰烬中重生，继续战斗。
author: bostroms
source: It is thought that if POKENAME became sufficiently enraged, not even death would stop its rampage as it would be reborn from its own ashes and continue to fight.

entry: POKENAME身上的花纹，每天早晨都会换色。每次吠叫，口中就迸出小团虹色火焰。
author: sk372
source: The markings on POKENAME's body change color each morning. Whenever it barks, it lets out small bursts of rainbow-colored fire from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME用力从口中喷出细雾，形成彩虹来攻击。它也能加热雾气，造出蒸汽云，掩护自己迅速逃离强敌。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME attacks by forcefully spewing a fine mist from its mouth, which produces a rainbow. It can also heat this mist, allowing it to create steam clouds to cover it while it makes a hasty escape from strong foes.

entry: POKENAME是光彩照人的巨型斗士，对战总是绚烂夺目的展示。每击拖着彩虹，每个夸张的格斗姿势后，都迸出彩光。
author: sk372
source: A radiant giant of a fighter, POKENAME's matches are always a vibrant display. Rainbows trail behind its every strike, and colorful bursts of light follow every dramatic fighting pose it takes.

entry: 世界各地的建筑工地，都曾发现POKENAME的雕像。许多人相信，它会保护勤恳劳作的人和宝可梦。
author: leshii
source: Statues of POKENAME have been found at construction sites around the world. Many believe it grants protection to hard-working people and Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，会排出甜美虹色花蜜，将猎物引入等候的壶状大嘴。吃够后，它朝天发射强大虹色日光束，带来为期一个月的太阳雨天气。
author: pjporwoll
source: As it flies, POKENAME expels a sweet, rainbow-colored nectar to lure prey to its waiting pitcher maw. Once it has eaten enough, it fires a powerful rainbow Solar Beam into the sky that leads to sunshowers in the area for a month.

entry: POKENAME头两侧的大球，反射广阔色谱的光。光穿过、散开，便形成美丽虹纹。据说，启航时看见，便能带来好运。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The large orbs on either side of the head of POKENAME reflect light in a broad spectrum of colour, creating beautiful rainbow patterns as light scatters through them. Seeing the display is said to bring good fortune on the start of a voyage.

entry: POKENAME漂在外海，宝石般的头，将光折射成美丽彩虹。美貌却藏着危险：许多触手的末端，都有覆着麻痹毒素的羽毛。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found drifting out in the open sea, their jewelled head refracting light into a beautiful rainbow. Their beauty is deceptive as their many tentacles are tipped with feathers coated with a paralytic poison.

entry: POKENAME漂在外海，羽毛头冠将光折射成美丽彩虹。美貌却藏着危险：许多触手末端长着尖爪，抓取水中经过的宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found drifting out in the open sea, their feathery head refracting light into a beautiful rainbow. Their beauty is deceptive as their many tentacles are tipped with sharp claws, snatching at passing Pokémon in the water.

entry: POKENAME出现在训练家最意想不到的地方，常正值心生怀疑之时。许多人相信，目击它，预示美好的巧合与将至的好运。
author: jaminmcready
source: It appears in places where Trainers least expect it, often during moments of doubt. Many believe spotting a POKENAME is a sign of serendipity and good fortune to come.

entry: 最初，人们从故事中认识POKENAME：披虹的有翼骏马，只让自己认可的对象乘骑。火焰足以将草木化灰，之后却会比从前长得更好。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME was first identified within stories that spoke of a rainbow-clad and winged steed that would only let those deemed worthy ride upon it. Its flames are strong enough to reduce vegetation to ash, yet all will regrow better than before.

entry: POKENAME沿山坡疾跑，积蓄动势，再腾空。危机时，成群现身村庄上空，洒下有再生功效的余烬，治愈人类与宝可梦的伤。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME build momentum by racing up hillsides before taking flight. In times of crisis, herds of these Pokémon appear over villages, raining down regenerative embers that heal the wounds of people and Pokémon alike.

entry: 极少能见到POKENAME以惊人速度驰过城都，身后形成虹迹。谁试图阻拦，就会迎来强劲的虹色火焰吐息。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can be rarely seen galloping across the Johto region at fantastic speed, a rainbow trail forming behind it as it runs. Attempts to stop its runs are met with powerful plumes of rainbow fire breath.

entry: POKENAME鸣叫时，喷出水雾，羽上反光，数英里内都能看见。有人相信，看过这一幕后，再让宝可梦升级，就能使其进化。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When POKENAME calls out, it sprays a mist of water, reflecting light off its feathers that can be seen for miles around. Some believe that levelling up a Pokémon after seeing this will cause it to evolve.

entry: 传说，POKENAME会出现在年轻人面前，考验勇气。据说，孩子若不被骇人的目光吓退，伸手探向爪中的虹火，就能得到余生的幸福。
author: pattybgoode
source: Legends say that POKENAME appears to youths as a test of courage. It is said that if the child looks past its intimidating glare and reaches toward the rainbow fire in its claws, they are rewarded with a happy life for the rest of their days.

entry: POKENAME寻找人的梦，将颜色吸干，让受害者陷入黑暗。每吸走一点颜色，尾巴便多一根鲜亮羽毛。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME seeks out people's dreams and drains them of any colour, leaving the victim in darkness. Every bit of colour it absorbs adds another bright feather to its tail.

entry: POKENAME会来到孩子未能活着出生的母亲面前，一同哀悼。它竭尽所能安慰母亲：当时无论做什么，都无法改变如今的结果，生命的逝去，并不是母亲的过错。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME appear before mothers of stillborn children to mourn. They do everything in their power to reassure mothers that nothing could have been done to change the present, and that the loss of life was not the fault of the mother.

entry: POKENAME借时间能量，加速变态发育，身体因潜藏的能量而摇晃。据说，长时间触碰茧，会异常清晰地回想起童年。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME harnesses temporal energy to accelerate its metamorphosis and wobbles with latent energy. People who make prolonged contact with its cocoon are said to recall childhood memories with acute clarity.

entry: POKENAME的复眼，能看见多条时间线。它谨慎行事，兼顾林中众多生灵的需求。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of seeing many timelines with their compound eyes. They act deliberately to balance the needs of many creatures in their forests.

entry: 锋利的镰刀，能割裂时间，打开小小的传送门。它通常借此，帮助小型宝可梦，躲避捕食者。
author: sk372
source: The sharp scythes it wields are able to cut through the fabric of time and open up small portals. It typically uses these to help smaller Pokémon evade predators.

entry: POKENAME短暂现身于严寒苔原。它诱导训练家追进暴雪，再将其拖去几年后的未来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are a transient presence found in the frigid tundra. They lure Trainers to follow them into snowstorms only to drag them into the future a few years.

entry: POKENAME展现可能的未来，帮助人类与宝可梦走出人生变故。它想激发改变，却不总奏效，尤其当受助者还没准备好改变时。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME help people and Pokémon recover from adverse life events by showing them what future is possible. Their desire to inspire change does not always work, especially when those they want to help are not ready to change.

entry: POKENAME害羞又易受惊，谁吓到它，就立刻用刺扎过去。毒素会令中招者，幻见自己身处过去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is shy and jumpy, immediately poking anything that startles it with its stingers. It delivers a toxin that causes those stung to hallucinate visions of being in the past.

entry: 人们给POKENAME背上的神祠献供。若它认可来者与供品，就会带对方，快乐地穿越时光观光。
author: sk372
source: People will give out offerings to the shrine on POKENAME's back. Should it deem the person and their offerings worthy, it will take them on a pleasant sightseeing trip through time.

entry: 传说，这种宝可梦只在长久和平时出现，沿神圣河流穿越时间。晶莹的泪能恢复枯林，存在本身也赐福隐秘溪流，催开有治愈之力的水生花朵。
author: keiracm35_
source: Legends say this Pokémon appears only in times of lasting peace. It travels through time along sacred rivers. Its crystal tears can restore withered forests, and its presence blesses hidden streams, making healing water flowers bloom.

entry: POKENAME栖居之处，附近一定有最纯净的水源，四周草木繁盛。借双翼，它能优雅地驰过水面。
author: infinex21
source: Wherever a POKENAME resides, there is sure to be a source of the purest and cleanest water nearby, surrounded by lush vegetation galore. With their wings, these Pokémon can gallop atop the surface of water with grace.

entry: POKENAME十分调皮，会用时间之力捉弄电脑用户。一现身，就把操作系统，倒回老旧过时的版本。
author: sk372
source: As a mischievous creature, POKENAME uses its power over times to play tricks on computer users. When it appears, it uses its ability to revert the computer's operating system to an older, outdated one.

entry: 有人相信，POKENAME来自史前，为避开夺走许多古生物的灭绝事件，穿越到了现在。其他化石宝可梦在场时，它会显得不安。
author: sk372
source: Some believe POKENAME originates from prehistory, having traveled to present time to avoid the extinction events that claimed so many other ancient creatures. It acts perturbed when in the presence of other Fossil Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME穿越时间，寻找安静的休息处。若被谁吵醒，就逃进未来，等那人或宝可梦离开此地不久，再次现身。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME travels through time in search of quiet places to rest. If anyone wakes it up, it will flee into the future, reappearing shortly after that person or Pokémon leaves the area.

entry: 它穿梭时间，仿佛鱼儿游水，只在无人能看见的时刻停留，是历来最难找的宝可梦之一。
author: ozydamians
source: It flits through time like a fish swims through water. It pauses in moments where nobody is around to see it, making it one of the hardest to find Pokémon in history.

entry: POKENAME出现在谁面前，就迅速扫过心灵与记忆。若喜欢对方，便带回最幸福的往昔时刻，让其重温快乐。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME appears before someone, it quickly scans their mind and memories. If it likes them, it then transports them back in time to their happiest moments to let them relive those joys.

entry: POKENAME带着纯真，容易让人亲近。不论身在哪条时间线，它都愿意听别人的故事。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME carry a certain innocence to them that makes them approachable. They are always willing to hear stories from others, no matter what timeline they are in.

entry: POKENAME心智成熟，理解他人苦楚。保护周围森林时，很少顾得上自己，还不断忧心未来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are mature creatures that understand the suffering of others. They rarely make time for themselves when protecting the forests around them and are constantly worried about the future.

entry: POKENAME穿过时光，来到悲伤的遗孀身边，帮助安顿哀思。花散发令人怀念的香气，据说能让她们想起所爱之人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME travel through time to appear before grieving widows and help them manage their grief. POKENAME flowers produce a nostalgic scent that is said to remind widows of their loved ones.

entry: POKENAME是极少数在晨昏活动的咕咕变种。不知为何，它常栖在森林神社顶上。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME is one of the very few crepuscular variants of Hoothoot. For some strange reason, it can often be found perched atop forest shrines.

entry: POKENAME成群沐浴晨光，共赏日出。奇异的时间之力，让它能以特定频率振翅，飞入时间流，抵达下一个清晨。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swarm in the morning sunlight, gathering together to enjoy the sunrise. They possess strange temporal powers and can buzz their wings at a frequency that allows them to fly through timestreams to the next morning.

entry: POKENAME用触角感知时间流动，聚到最易触及时间之流的地方。整群合力，进入时间流，一同飞向春日。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can sense the flow of time using their antennae, swarming together to places where the timestream is most accessible. Working together as a swarm, they can enter the timestream and fly together to springtime.

entry: POKENAME踏着舞步穿越时间，跳过阴天。挑剔的性情，却引出传闻，说它出现，便能挡住坏天气。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME dances through time to skip cloudy days. Its choosiness has started a rumor that a POKENAME appearing prevents bad weather.

entry: POKENAME造出螺旋形传送门，推动自己穿越时间，探索各时代的广阔世界。它常带几只蚊香蝌蚪，跨越岁月作伴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME creates spiral-shaped portals that propel itself through time to explore the vastness of the world through the eras. It often takes a few Poliwag with it to keep it company across the ages.

entry: POKENAME站在空旷田野，沐浴明亮阳光。吸收足够后，就操纵周围所有植物的时间，使其同时开花，化为茂盛花田。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stands in wide empty fields basking in bright sunlight. Once it's gathered enough, it manipulates time among all the flora around it, making it all bloom at once and creating a lush field of flowers.

entry: 古老故事中，POKENAME带着盛有魔法水的器皿，来到疫病肆虐的镇子，喝过者无不痊愈。有些研究者猜，那也许是它从未来带回的抗生素。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Ancient tales tell of a POKENAME that brought a vessel of magical water to a town that was overrun with disease. Any that drank this water were cured. Some researchers think this may have been POKENAME bringing back antibiotics from the future.
