entry: 近期发现的古老图像，令有人相信，这些宝可梦能穿越时间。力量虽未证实，它们确实寿命长、极隐居，只在自己认可的对象面前出现。
author: infinex21
source: Ancient depictions of these Pokémon have been discovered lately, which led some to believe they can traverse time. While such power is unconfirmed, they are long-lived and extremely reclusive Pokémon that only appear to those they deem worthy.

entry: POKENAME十分罕见，似乎躲避一切暴力，只在夜里，现身于心灵纯净的训练家面前。人们相信，它借满月之光的能量，穿越时间。
author: fiordaliso
source: This rare Pokémon seems to shun any form of violence, appearing only at night to Trainers with a pure heart. It is believed that POKENAME can harness the energy of the full moon's light to travel through time.

entry: 这种行踪难觅的宝可梦，只在月光下，现身于心灵纯净的训练家面前。有些传说称，它借月之力，滑入时间本身，消失得不留痕迹。
author: fiordaliso
source: This elusive Pokémon appears only under moonlight to Trainers pure of spirit. Some legends claim it uses lunar energy to slip through time itself, vanishing without leaving a trace.

entry: 这种行踪难觅的宝可梦，只在月光下，现身于心灵纯净的训练家面前。有些传说称，它借月之力，滑入时间本身，消失得不留痕迹。
author: fiordaliso
source: This elusive Pokémon appears only under moonlight to Trainers pure of spirit. Some legends claim it uses lunar energy to slip through time itself, vanishing without leaving a trace.

entry: 这种行踪难觅的宝可梦，只在月光下，现身于心灵纯净的训练家面前。有些传说称，它借月之力，滑入时间本身，消失得不留痕迹。
author: fiordaliso
source: This elusive Pokémon appears only under moonlight to Trainers pure of spirit. Some legends claim it uses lunar energy to slip through time itself, vanishing without leaving a trace.

entry: POKENAME很快就依恋善待自己的人，忠诚跟随。甚至会穿越时间，成为训练家祖先与后代的忠实伙伴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME quickly gets attached to humans that are kind to it, following them around loyally. It will even travel through time to become a loyal companion to its Trainer's ancestors and descendants.

entry: 喝下POKENAME制作的树果汁，似乎能让生物体内衰老的细胞，稍稍重获活力。有些科学家推测，研究或能造出完全抵挡衰老影响的药剂。
author: sk372
source: Drinking the juice POKENAME creates from berries seems to have mildly rejuvenated old cells in living things. Some scientists theorize studying this could lead to the creation of concoctions that could stave off the effects of aging completely.

entry: POKENAME沿森林地面爬行，留下一路极黏的分泌物。物质能加速植物生长，因此极受珍视。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME leaves overwhelmingly viscous excretions as it trails along the forest floor. This substance is able to accelerate plant growth and thus is highly valued.

entry: POKENAME知道未来可能的景象，不知疲倦地清理海洋污染与垃圾。它太过卖力，甚至曾累昏。善良志愿者帮忙，才让它能歇一歇。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME works tirelessly to clear the ocean of pollution and garbage, knowing the future that could await. It works itself so hard that it has been known to pass out from exhaustion. Kind volunteers aid it in its quest, allowing it to take breaks.

entry: POKENAME能回到过去，曾被看见把程序倒回旧版，或混在小群多边兽中。人们猜，是某种怀旧情怀使然。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses the ability to travel back in time. It has been seen reverting programs to older versions, or hanging among small groups of Porygon, presumably out of some sort of sense of nostalgia.

entry: POKENAME是隐居的守护者，大规模毁林时才会出现。它把伐木工送去未来，再送回来，展示后果，让部分人变得更有责任心。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are reclusive guardians and appear when mass deforestation occurs. By sending loggers into the future and back, they reveal the consequences of deforestation and cause some loggers to act more conscientiously.

entry: 它跨越时间，递送梦幻邮件，让过去的人收到子孙的信，帮助避开灾难。命运一改变，邮件就会消失，仿佛从未存在。
author: quackquackattack
source: It delivers Mirage Mail across time and helps prevent disaster by providing people of the past letters from their descendants. Once fate has changed, the Mirage Mail disappears, as though it were never there.

entry: POKENAME忠心守护城都，既有闪电般的反应，也有超能力。传闻，若跑到每小时88英里，就能穿越时间。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME is a devoted guardian of the Johto region, wielding both lightning-fast reflexes and psychic abilities. It is rumored that if the Pokémon runs at 88 miles per hour, it can travel through time.

entry: 曾有目击，POKENAME探访严重野火后的灾地，之后植物便迅速长回。过程中，背上的草木会枯萎，因此有人推测，它用自己的生命能量，复苏大地。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has been witnessed exploring the aftermath of severe wildfires, after which the plant life has rapidly grown back. The foliage on its back withers during these events, so it is hypothesized that it uses its life energy to renew the land.

entry: 神秘的POKENAME寻找遭破坏的森林。身体亮起七色光，就会倒转时间，让森林重归原本的美丽。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is a mystical Pokémon that seeks out devastated forests. When its body glows in seven bright colors, it turns back time to restore these forests to their original and beautiful states.

entry: 这对搭档喜欢穿梭于不同时代，用力量改变关键事件，创造新的时间线。
author: jackjirachi
source: This duo loves to traverse through time periods. They alter key events with their powers, creating new timelines.

entry: POKENAME穿行时间，寻找完美的石头，放进袋中。若找不到喜欢的，就会苦恼到可能不小心，跳去随机的时代。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME travels across time in search of a perfect stone to carry in its pouch. If POKENAME can't find a stone it likes, it becomes so distressed that it may travel to a random time period by accident.

entry: POKENAME裹在厚厚藤蔓中，借此保护自己。藤蔓一天能长超过一英尺，必须不断修剪。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME is cocooned with a thick swath of vines, which it uses for protection. These vines can grow over a foot a day, so constant pruning is needed.

entry: POKENAME常在农场帮忙，照料作物。捕食者一靠近，它就释放气体，让袭击者大哭。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME commonly helps out on farms, tending to the crops. If a predator approaches it, it produces a gas that causes the attacker to violently cry.

entry: POKENAME只住在最茂盛的森林与丛林，用双翼，优雅地跃过树间。途经之处，空气十分纯净，让有些人心生敬奉。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME reside only within the lushest forests and jungles, using their wings to leap between the trees with graceful movements. The purity of the air they leave in their wake has led to some people revering them.

entry: 它一振翅，便散下许多反光雪花。转得足够快，还能卷出雪阵，藏在其中避开其他生物。不过，据说也有人有幸见过。
author: infinex21
source: When its wings flutter, many reflective snowflakes are scattered around it. It can churn its wings fast enough to form a snow flurry. It conceals itself within flurries to avoid others, but supposedly it has graced some with its presence.

entry: POKENAME造访电子系统，就会使其出错，软件退回旧版。它似乎很高兴，还会在屏幕上，亮出庆祝的提示。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME cause electronic systems that they visit to glitch and revert to previous versions of their software. They seem happy to have this effect on software, creating visual prompts on display screens to celebrate.

entry: 据说它守护着时间本身，为确保未来免于毁灭，不遗余力。
author: gayschlatt
source: This Pokémon is said to be the guardian of time itself. It's very passionate in making sure the future doesn't fall into ruin.

entry: POKENAME在亲代注视下，蹦跳于森林。它们磨炼超能力，保护周围林地。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME hop around the forest under the watchful gaze of their parents. These Pokémon develop their psychic powers to protect the woodland around them.

entry: POKENAME能穿越时间，却因经验不足，大多仍留在同一区域。察觉附近的时间异常，它会小心靠近，尽力介入。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME has the ability to travel through time, though its lack of experience keeps it mostly in the same area. When it senses a temporal anomaly nearby, POKENAME will carefully approach and attempt to intervene to the best of its ability.

entry: POKENAME借时间之力，采集古代已灭绝的香料，烹调菜肴。它是名厨，用燃烧的利爪，煎出火候完美、几乎能治愈任何病痛的餐点。
author: ambrosia04
source: By using its powers to hop through time, POKENAME gathers ancient, extinct spices for its dishes. It is a master chef that uses its flaming talons to perfectly sear meals that can heal almost any ailment.

entry: POKENAME深深忠于训练家，以预见未来的力量，引其前往理想未来。据说，真正全心奉献的个体，甚至会悄悄回到过去，让训练家的过往也变得更好。
author: sk372
source: Deeply loyal to its Trainer, POKENAME uses its power of foresight to guide them to their ideal future. It's said truly devoted POKENAME will even go back in time to secretly and retroactively change and improve its Trainer's past as well.

entry: 古代文明将POKENAME描绘为夏之使者，只在夏至后现身森林。冬季，超能力便会减弱。
author: dodoowner_
source: Ancient civilizations depicted POKENAME as the herald of summer, only appearing in forests after the summer solstice. During the winter, its psychic ability weakens.

entry: POKENAME优雅地浮过古老森林，鲜少落地。跳起令人入迷的舞时，它操纵空气中的精神能量，促进稀有草药与花生长。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME floats gracefully through ancient forests, rarely touching the ground. As it performs its mesmerizing dance, it manipulates the psychic energy in the air to encourage the growth of rare herbs and flowers.

entry: POKENAME藏在原始森林深处，神祠中的根，替代附近树木的根，维系生命。传说，谁伤害它栖身的森林，就会被瞬移到108年前。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME hide deep in old-growth forests, its roots in its shrine replacing those of nearby trees and keeping them alive. Legends say that if something harms the forests POKENAME resides in, it'll teleport the individual 108 years into the past.

entry: POKENAME能穿越时间，有时一次穿越，就让化石记录剧变。准备穿越时，面甲上的假眼，便会大放光明。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: POKENAME can travel through time, and the fossil record is sometimes drastically altered when one of them does so. When it is about to time travel, the false eyes on its faceplate glow brightly.

entry: POKENAME穿越各条时间线，警告世界、人类，乃至宇宙本身即将终结。幸好，它似乎只是走错，才来到这里。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME travels across different timelines to warn about the imminent end of the world, humanity, or the universe itself. Fortunately, it seems to have ended up here by mistake.

entry: 据说，POKENAME游过时间之流，如游过洋流般轻松。猛烈风暴中，它会跳往不同的时刻，寻找更平静的水。
author: xiapher
source: It is said that POKENAME swim through streams of time as easily as they swim through ocean currents. During heavy storms, they jump to different moments in time, in search of calmer waters.

entry: 据说，POKENAME每1000年，挑选少数人类，送回过去。若传闻属实，它究竟想达成什么，仍不清楚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to choose a select few humans every 1000 years to be sent back in time. If true, what it hopes to achieve with this act is unclear.

entry: POKENAME凭四根各异的枝条，掌控四季，随心改变整座森林。研究者总会匆忙涌向，这种现象发生的地方。
author: mepp.
source: With their four distinct branches, POKENAME have control over the seasons and can alter entire forests on a whim. Researchers hurriedly flock to areas where this phenomenon occurs.

entry: POKENAME飞过自然，寻找过早濒枯的植物。它先以明火净除附近毒素，再倒转受影响植物的时间，使其恢复健康。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME flies through nature in search of plants at risk of withering before their time. It uses a brilliant fire to cleanse out any toxins in the area before reversing the time of affected plants to restore their health.

entry: 即将穿越时间，POKENAME的三个迷你球根，会迅速环绕本体，形成奇异能量场。赢得它信任的训练家，能摘下富铁叶片，烹调食用。
author: hophoppip
source: When it's about to travel through time, POKENAME's three Mini-Bulbs rapidly orbit around the main body to form a strange energy field. A Trainer that earns POKENAME's trust can pluck its iron-rich leaves to cook and eat.

entry: 传说，POKENAME必须吸收数百人类的生命能量，才能自由穿越时间。人们因这些故事而害怕，时常驱赶，让它独居森林深处。
author: fiordaliso
source: Legend holds that POKENAME must absorb the life energy of hundreds of humans to travel freely through time. Feared for these tales, it is frequently driven away by people and leads a solitary existence deep in the forest.

entry: POKENAME自居骑士，执剑持盾，与大得多的敌人激战。性子倔强，一旦输了，便倒转时间，反复尝试，直到终于获胜。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME styles itself a knight, fighting fiercely with sword and shield against much larger foes. It has a stubborn streak, so if it loses, it reverses time and keeps trying until it finally emerges triumphant.

entry: POKENAME心灵纯净，似乎会用超能力，保护人类与宝可梦，抵御天灾。传说，它穿越时间，吸收闪电，为旅程补能。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a pure-hearted being that appears to shield humans and Pokémon from natural disasters with its psychic powers. Legends say it travels through time, absorbing lightning to fuel its journeys.

entry: 人称“月光兰”的POKENAME，傍晚身体发光，色调不断变化。若盯着谁，又随一道雷光消失，便是直接赶往未来的那人身边。
author: bobosmith01
source: Nicknamed the Moonlight Orchid, POKENAME's body glows during the evening, its light constantly shifting in hue. If POKENAME stares at someone and vanishes a moment later with a flash of lightning, POKENAME travels directly to them in the future.

entry: POKENAME光是存在，就能净化栖身的水，让野生宝可梦安全饮用。它还释放能量波，促进附近植物生长。
author: keiracm35_
source: POKENAME's mere presence purifies the water it inhabits, making it safe for wild Pokémon to drink. POKENAME also emits energy waves that promote the growth of the local flora.

entry: 这种宝可梦的两根箭形触角，如钟针般转动，始终指着所在地区的当前时间。每个地区，只发现过一只。
author: infinex21
source: The two arrow-like antennae of this Pokémon move like the hands of a clock, always pointing to the current time of the region in which it resides. Only one of these Pokémon have been found in each region.

entry: POKENAME住在古老森林，那里是大葱鸭、吉利蛋等濒危物种的避难所。它尽心守护，以强大幻象，确保偷猎者抓不到这些宝可梦。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME dwell in ancient forests that are a safe haven for endangered species like Farfetch'd and Chansey. They are devoted guardians, using their powerful illusions to ensure no poachers can capture these Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME借少许控时之力，帮助改善心情。缎带在人身上蹭一蹭，便能让对方回想、重温往昔的快乐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can use a bit of its time manipulation ability to help others improve their moods. While it rubs its ribbons on a person, it causes them to remember and relive happy memories from their past.

entry: POKENAME的缎带，让触碰者心生温暖怀念。它会蹭蹭朋友，帮助重温过去的快乐回忆。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's ribbons cause those touched to experience a sensation of fond nostalgia. It rubs its ribbons on its friends to help them relive happy memories from the past.

entry: POKENAME操控、穿越时间的力量，无可比拟。人们认为，只要愿意，它甚至能从根本上，改变时间的运行方式。
author: sk372
source: Its power to control and travel through time is unparalleled. It's thought that POKENAME could change how time itself fundamentally functions if it wished.

entry: 凭POKENAME之力，遭人类污染或无可挽回破坏的地区，一瞬便能重归旧日繁盛。但它不愿听命，受到指使，就拒绝动用能力。
author: bobosmith01
source: With POKENAME's powers, areas ravaged by pollution or irreparable harm from humankind can simply revert back to a previous flourishing state in an instant. However, POKENAME is unacquiescent and refuses to use its powers if ordered.

entry: 凭POKENAME之力，遭人类污染或无可挽回破坏的地区，一瞬便能重归旧日繁盛。但它不愿听命，受到指使，就拒绝动用能力。
author: bobosmith01
source: With POKENAME's powers, areas ravaged by pollution or irreparable harm from humankind can simply revert back to a previous flourishing state in an instant. However, POKENAME is unacquiescent and refuses to use its powers if ordered.

entry: POKENAME平和，富有同情心。有人相信，是时拉比穿越到和平、和睦时代的能力，抵消了盖诺赛克特无情的本性。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME is a peaceful and empathetic Pokémon. Some believe this is because Celebi's ability to time-travel to eras of peace and harmony counteracts Genesect's merciless nature.

entry: POKENAME以爱玩和扭转时间的本领闻名，给迷失黑暗的对象带来希望。有人说，笑声会从早被遗忘的时间线中回荡。
author: curazy
source: Known for its playful nature and time-twisting powers, POKENAME brings hope to those lost in darkness. Some say its laughter can be heard echoing from timelines long since forgotten.

entry: POKENAME穿越时间，来到无缘相守的恋人面前，给他们互相道别的机会。它给双方各一朵蓝玫瑰，象征求而不得的苦涩。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME travels through time to appear before star-crossed lovers, and gives the ill-fated lovers a chance to say goodbye to each other. It gives each of the lovers a blue rose, signalling the bitterness of unattainability.

entry: POKENAME能附身电视，让屏幕显示种种神秘黑白影像。尽管普遍的看法如此，并无迹象表明，播放内容属于现实中曾存在过的媒体作品。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has the ability to possess televisions and change the display to show a variety of mysterious black and white footage. Contrary to popular belief, there is no indication the broadcasted content is of any past real-life media.

entry: 它快得足以穿越时间本身。据说消失的瞬间，周围空气都会被点燃。
author: captainzscourge
source: Due to this Pokémon's speed, it is able to pass through time itself. It is said that when it does so, the air is set ablaze as it disappears.

entry: 据说POKENAME是一次失败的时间旅行产生的异常存在。它已见尽永恒，脑海中燃烧着诡秘莫测的知识。
author: genesisparallax
source: POKENAME is said to be an anomaly created by a failed attempt at time travel. Having seen all of eternity, its mind burns with eldritch knowledge.

entry: POKENAME住在幽深美丽的森林，养育、照料其他宝可梦。那里时间的流逝，似乎总与外界不同。心灵不纯的来者，永远看不到它。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME lives in deep, beautiful forests, where it nurtures and cares for other Pokémon. In these forests, time never seems to pass in the way it does outside. Should anyone enter whose heart is impure, they will never be able to see POKENAME.

entry: 有传说警告，别盯着POKENAME太久，声称它会在眨眼间，让人穿越时间。它太稀有，让说法很难确认。
author: chibitales
source: There is a legend that warns against staring at a POKENAME for too long, claiming it will send you through time in the blink of an eye. The rarity of this Pokémon makes it difficult to confirm these claims.

entry: 刻意寻找这种宝可梦的训练家，永远找不到，因为它能感知欲求与执念。反而会意外地现身，给低落、难过的训练家指引，再消失。
author: quackquackattack
source: Trainers who seek out this Pokémon never find it, as it detects desire and attachment from those Trainers. Rather, it mysteriously appears in serendipity to Trainers who feel down or upset, giving those Trainers a guiding hand before vanishing.

entry: POKENAME天性好奇，会穿梭时间，前往新发现或发明即将诞生的时刻。据说，它的出现，预示附近有人快要灵光一现。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Curious by nature, POKENAME blink through time to whenever new discoveries or inventions are about to be made. It is said that the appearance of a POKENAME is a sign that someone nearby will find a spark of inspiration soon.

entry: POKENAME住在山顶森林深处，却出了名地行踪难觅。传说，听见歌声，就会沉睡数十年。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are found living deep in mountaintop forests, though they are notoriously elusive. Legends claim that those who hear their song fall asleep for decades.

entry: POKENAME跳过森林与城镇，始终像快要惊慌失措。它频频看表，仿佛赶着赴约，生怕迟到。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME bound through forests and towns, always on the verge of panicking. They frequently check their watches, as if they are late to some prior engagement.

entry: POKENAME遨游不同时间线与宇宙，寻找纯净、磨亮的宝石吃。若同一地点的不同时间线，都似乎有不少同种宝石，它就会在那里徘徊很久。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME can surf across different timelines and universes, looking for pure and polished gems to feast upon. They may spend a long time wandering around the same location in different timelines if they all seem to have nice amounts of the same gems.

entry: POKENAME藏在苍翠高草地，与周围宝可梦玩耍。它操纵时间，延长游戏，倒转时钟，不让太阳落下。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lurk in verdant fields of tall grass where they play with the Pokémon around them. They manipulate time to extend their play sessions, turning back the clock to prevent the sun from setting.

entry: POKENAME由碎草构成的身体，因时间之力，永不腐烂。装点身上的钟，不知为何，也总同步滴答。
author: hophoppip
source: The grass clippings that make up POKENAME's body never decay thanks to its time powers. The clocks adorning POKENAME somehow all tick in sync.

entry: POKENAME头上长出一朵葱属植物的花。训练家寻找这行踪难觅的宝可梦，会循着花的洋葱气味追踪。
author: hophoppip
source: An allium flower sprouts from POKENAME's head. Trainers searching for this elusive Pokémon follow the oniony scent of its bloom.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME能穿越时间，拉着信任的训练家一起，躲开危险。飞过后留下的闪亮粉尘，也会加快植物生长。
author: chibitales
source: It's thought that POKENAME are able to traverse time, pulling Trainers they trust alongside them to avoid danger. The shimmering dust left behind as they fly causes plants to experience increased growth.

entry: POKENAME借时间之力，几秒就能长出蘑菇。附近植物也受影响，蘑菇周围的森林，草木变得愈发浓密。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME harnesses the power of time to grow mushrooms in the span of seconds. Nearby plants are also affected, as the forest around the mushrooms becomes dense with foliage.

entry: 传说，POKENAME用陶笛吹起魔法曲调，就能召唤风暴、唤醒巨人，甚至操纵时间流动。
author: staghorn
source: Legends say that by playing enchanted melodies on its ocarina, a POKENAME can summon storms, awaken giants, and even manipulate the flow of time.

entry: POKENAME穿越时间，寻找需要治愈旋律的对象。据说，歌声连致命疾病与大流行疫病都能治愈，在大灾中挽救无数生命。
author: irexo
source: POKENAME travels through time in search of those in need of its healing melodies. Its songs are said to have cured even deadly diseases and pandemics, saving countless lives from great catastrophes.

entry: POKENAME散播的发光孢子，繁殖缓慢，因此它会加速蘑菇生长。时间加速也影响其他植物，一夜就能成林。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spreads bioluminescent spores that proliferate slowly, so it speeds up the growth of the mushrooms. This temporal acceleration also makes other plants grow quickly, forming forests overnight.

entry: 它偶尔会掉下一片金色叶子，效果却不明。谁刚想记录性质，它就迅速躲到另一条时间线。
author: quackquackattack
source: It may drop a Gold Leaf on occasion, yet its effect is unknown. As soon as anyone tries to document its properties, it zips away to an alternate timeline.

entry: 它每次跳过时间线，都有机会落下银色叶子。叶子当时毫无作用，却有人相信，预示某种不祥将至。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever it hops between timelines, it has a chance to drop a Silver Leaf. The Leaf does nothing at the time it is dropped in, yet some people believe it could be an omen to something sinister on the horizon.

entry: POKENAME用法杖穿越时间。飘逸的裙装很受孩子喜爱，看起来像位公主。
author: amberaxolotl223
source: POKENAME harness a wand it uses to travel through time. Children love the flowing dress it has, as it's similar to a princess.

entry: POKENAME球根散出的奇异气味，能平息敌意。因此，咨询人员常借它，调解训练家之间的冲突。
author: mepp.
source: The peculiar scent produced by POKENAME's bulb quells hostile emotions. Because of this, it is often used by counselors to mediate conflicts between Trainers.

entry: 传说，POKENAME能在时间中往返，抵达任何需要帮助的时间线。它性情虽平和，却很擅战斗，一拳就能打穿墙。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to legend, POKENAME can travel back and forth through time, to any timeline where its help is needed. Despite its peaceful nature, it is an exceptional fighter; a single punch from it can break through a wall.

entry: 人们认为，所有POKENAME目击，都来自同一只在时间中挖行的个体。它要去哪个年代，抵达后又想做什么，至今仍是热烈研究的课题。
author: sk372
source: It's thought that sightings of POKENAME are all of the same Pokémon, digging its way through time. What era it is aiming for and what it hopes to achieve when it arrives are still subjects of intense research.

entry: POKENAME游在林中池塘，小翼轻轻拍动。古时，情侣会入林寻找，因为据说见它，就能拥有永不消逝的感情。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME swims in forest ponds, its tiny wings fluttering gently as it swims about. Couples in ancient times ventured into the woods to search for this Pokémon since seeing it was said to promise an everlasting relationship.

entry: 最好与POKENAME保持足够距离。头痛一发作，控时能力就会失控，不受控制地把自身与周围事物，一并传往别的时刻。
author: sk372
source: It is advised to give POKENAME a good amount of space, as should a headache flare up, its time-control powers go haywire and involuntarily teleport it and its surroundings through time.

entry: POKENAME能跑过时间本身，极其捍卫栖身的森林，在多个时代，守护同一片土地。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME possess the ability to run through time itself. POKENAME are extremely protective of the forests they live in, protecting the same land throughout multiple eras.

entry: POKENAME是高贵自律的斗士，凶悍地保护自然，抵御威胁与灾难。它穿越时间，寻找历代最强武术家求教，从不停止训练、冥想。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME is a noble, disciplined fighter who protects nature fiercely from any threats and disasters. It travels through time in attempts to find the best martial artists to ever live to learn from, and never stops training or meditating.

entry: POKENAME蜷成球滚动加速，一达到某个速度阈值，就会穿越时间。被卷进行进路线的东西，不会受伤，却会被迫一同进入时间流。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tucks into a ball to roll and gather speed, traveling through time once it reaches a certain speed threshold. Anything caught in its path is not harmed, but is forced to travel through the timestream along with it.

entry: POKENAME天生懒散嗜睡，一觉能睡数百年。若有谁想提前吵醒，它就回到这次小睡开始时，重新睡起。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is lazy and sleepy by nature, taking naps that can last centuries. If something tries to wake it up early, it will travel back in time to when its nap began and start anew.

entry: POKENAME回到过去，补做一两天前忘掉的事。它呆望不动时，曾有人听见尾上的球状物叹气。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME travels to the past to do tasks it forgot to do a day or two before. The bulb on its tail has been heard sighing as POKENAME stares vacantly, unmoving.

entry: POKENAME有一半外形奇异、不合常规。科学家认为，可能与遥远过去，甚至平行时间线有关。
author: sk372
source: One half of POKENAME bears a strange and unconventional appearance. Scientists think it may be connected to the distant past, or even a parallel timeline.

entry: 三个头，各看不同时期：一个看100年前的世界，一个看现在，最后一个，看100年后的未来。
author: terrabits
source: Its three heads see different periods of time; one views the world as it was 100 years ago, one sees the present, and the last sees 100 years into the future.

entry: POKENAME的壳像大洋葱，休息时，几乎与真洋葱分不清。受到打扰，就从炮口喷出营养丰富的水，慢慢飞去安全处。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's shell resembles a large onion, making them nearly indistinguishable from actual onions when resting. If disturbed, they blast nutrient-rich water from their cannons and slowly fly away to a safer location.

entry: POKENAME用钳子夹住谁太久，双方就会被送往完全不同的时段。因此，每次使出夹住，都小心控制，免得意外穿越。
author: .izik
source: Should POKENAME grip someone in its claw for too long, they will both be transported to a different time period entirely. Because of this, it carefully monitors each Vise Grip to avoid unwanted travel.

entry: POKENAME的头骨，湿润时会闪闪发亮。到湖里长游后，光泽便能达到顶峰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's skull sparkles brilliantly when wet. After long swims in lakes, it reaches its maximum shine.

entry: POKENAME爱用尾巴蹦跳，自己和自己玩抛接。极少弄丢骨头，可一旦丢了，就会不顾一切找回。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy hopping on their tail and playing catch with themselves. On the rare occasion that they lose their bone, they will stop at nothing to get it back.

entry: POKENAME惹人喜爱，享受美餐，也同样爱玩尾巴。有些会把身体缠在尾上，让自己旋转、翻滚。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are lovable creatures that enjoy a good meal as much as they enjoy playing with their tail. Some have found ways to wrap their bodies around their tail so that they can spin or roll.

entry: POKENAME尾巴的弹力惊人，平时在森林地面，坐在橡胶般的尾垫上。受惊时，尾巴猛地伸直，将自己弹上树冠。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The tails of POKENAME have amazing kinetic potential, and POKENAME sit on top of these rubbery pads on the forest floor. When they're startled, their tails straighten out rapidly, catapulting them into the forest canopy.

entry: POKENAME富同情心，心肠柔软，谁不舒服，都尽力帮忙。可情绪太敏感，共感别人的苦楚，自己常会放声大哭。
author: sk372
source: Extremely compassionate and softhearted, POKENAME tries its best to help others when they are feeling unwell. Due to its emotional nature, it often ends up bawling loudly as it sympathizes with their woes.

entry: POKENAME胆小又感性，向较大的宝可梦，寻求安慰保护，盼着受到照料。独处时，就用尾巴蹦跳，试着减轻压力。
author: sk372
source: Timid and emotional, POKENAME seeks comfort and protection from bigger Pokémon it hopes to be nurtured by. When alone, it bounces on its tail in an attempt to alleviate its stress.

entry: POKENAME十分合群，互动就能获得活力。它会表演用角顶球、保持平衡的各类花招，甚至能借球尾平衡，跳出水面。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are highly social creatures that get energy from interacting with others. They perform many tricks that revolve around balancing balls on their horn and can even hop out of water by balancing on their ball-like tail.

entry: POKENAME飞得笨拙，很难升空。它会将尾巴紧紧弯起，再迅速松开，像踏跳板般，把自己直直弹向上方。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are clumsy fliers and have trouble taking to the air. They use their tails as a springboard, bending it tightly and then rapidly releasing it to launch themselves straight upward.

entry: 它在海底，借弹性尾巴缓缓蹦行。到了陆地，POKENAME却能以星形身体连续侧翻，迅速前进。
author: oddwalls
source: It slowly bounces along the seabed using its springy tail. When on land, POKENAME cartwheels with its star-shaped body to travel at high speed.

entry: POKENAME精力旺盛，绕圈旋转着跳舞，尾巴也甩得到处都是。有凉风时，它最开心。
author: bobosmith01
source: Incredibly energetic, POKENAME swirls all around in circles and spins to dance, causing its tail to flail everywhere. It is most happy when there is a cool breeze.

entry: POKENAME爱在尾巴上弹跳，用钳子抱着圆球。不自娱时，就在森林寻找其他圆物举举，例如树果，或当地的胖丁。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy bouncing on their tail and holding the rotund ball in their pincers. When they are not entertaining themselves, they wander the forest looking for other rotund objects to lift, such as berries and the local Jigglypuff population.

entry: POKENAME含毒的尾巴，在卡洛斯某些地方，是珍馐。若料理不当，会令人十分恶心不适。
author: mary_the_jane
source: POKENAME's tail, which carries its venom, is a delicacy in some parts of Kalos. If prepared improperly it can make one very nauseous and sick.

entry: 不论怎么哄，POKENAME似乎总不开心。哪怕变成别的模样，也改不了那副永远皱眉的神情。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME seems to always be in a bad mood, no matter how much others try to cheer it up. No matter what it morphs into, it will keep its permanent frown.

entry: POKENAME一靠近电脑，就开始不受控制地起泡。泡沫不导电，已被研究为潜在的散热材料。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME nears a computer, it starts to foam uncontrollably. This froth does not conduct electricity and has been studied as a potential heat sink.

entry: POKENAME身形小巧，能把全身缩进大壳里避难。缩进去后，偶尔还会被误认成一枚空壳。
author: captainzscourge
source: Thanks to its small body, POKENAME it is able to withdraw into its large shell as a shelter. Sometimes it is mistaken for a shell when it does so.

entry: POKENAME十分柔弱敏感，动不动就掉泪。哭起来时，它会抓住尾尖的软球，抱着安慰自己。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is incredibly tender and sensitive, prone to shedding tears at the drop of a hat. It grabs and hugs the soft ball at the end of its tail to comfort itself during these crying fits.

entry: POKENAME常追着尾球，或让球弹跳，自己逗自己玩。虽是蜂巢成员，因经验不足，却很少被叫去护巢。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often chases or bounces the ball on its tail to keep itself entertained. Despite being part of a hive, it is rarely called upon to defend the hive because of its inexperience.

entry: POKENAME在湖上悠闲待着，会给自己造一层泡泡。哪怕只瞥见人类，也会害羞地瞬移逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME creates a bubble around itself while lounging on top of lakes. Even a brief sighting of a human will cause it to grow shy and teleport away.

entry: 要使用尾巴中储存的水，POKENAME必须站到尾巴上，用自己的体重将水挤出。可尾巴又弹又滑，使它总害怕脚下不稳，翻滚着摔下来。
author: ambrosia04
source: To use the water stored inside its tail, POKENAME must stand on top of it, using its own weight to squeeze the liquid out. Because the tail is so bouncy and slippery, the Pokémon is perpetually terrified of losing its footing and tumbling off.

entry: POKENAME常和别的宝可梦玩得忘形，跟着回了对方的巢。年长同类很容易追到、带回家，却会遭它强烈抗拒。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME regularly gets so caught up with playing with other Pokémon that it follows them back to their nest. Older members of their species are easily able to track them and bring them back home, under much duress from POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME堪称圆滚可爱的典范，柔软的绒体，让拥抱、依偎都十分舒服。它很容易被过度刺激，需要空间时，训练家最好给它留些距离。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are the quintessential form of rotund cuteness. Their plush bodies make them adorable, cuddly partners for snuggles and hugs. Trainers are advised to give them space when they need it, as they easily get overstimulated.

entry: POKENAME害羞，怕经过的人，便在森林里学树隐藏。蓝皮让这招毫无用处，它却觉得自己藏得很好。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are shy and easily scared by passing people, attempting to imitate trees to hide in their forest homes. Their blue skin colouring means they are ineffectual at hiding in this way, though they believe they're doing a good job.

entry: 热天，POKENAME逐渐越来越烦躁，分泌凝胶降温，积在尾中。胶会在夜里漏出，威慑捕食者。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: On hot days, POKENAME slowly get increasingly distressed, and excrete a gel that cools them down and collects in their tail. This gel will then leak out overnight and serves as a deterrent to predators.

entry: POKENAME焦虑地跑遍城市，求训练家与厨师给些多余食物。攒够一顿大餐，就赶紧溜走，没等人发现，它究竟求过多少人。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME worriedly run around cities in search of their next meals, pleading with Trainers and chefs for spare food. Once they've received an ample supply for a feast, they scamper away before anyone can realize just how many people they asked.

entry: POKENAME一被发现，第一反应就是贴住最近的表面躲藏，哪怕完全不能伪装。藏着时被盯太久，眼里便泛起惊恐泪水。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's first instinct when spotted is to hide itself against the nearest surface, even if it doesn't camouflage itself in the slightest. Staring too long at it while it attempts to hide will result in its eye welling up with frightened tears.

entry: POKENAME含毒的尾巴，尖得连自己也会受伤，因此总能见到它哭。
author: jss.tv
source: POKENAME's poison-filled tail is spiky, enough to the point where it can hurt its owner. As a result, POKENAME is always seen crying.

entry: 捕食者爱吃它营养丰富的尾巴，它便藏进壳里保护。有人推测，尾巴才是POKENAME的真正身体。
author: t3isukone
source: Predators often seek to consume its nutrient-packed tail, which it hides in a shell for protection. Some theorize the tail is the true body of an POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME整天玩，很容易耗尽体力。醒着四处跑、扑玩具，睡着则蜷起身，发出可爱的咕噜声。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME tires itself out easily due to playing all day. While awake, POKENAME runs around and pounces on toys. While asleep, POKENAME purrs cutely while curled up.

entry: 没玩具，POKENAME就摆出悲伤模样，直到拿到新的。这套小把戏，出奇地有效。
author: musicsheep.
source: If it has no toys to play with, POKENAME makes a sorrowful display until it receives new ones. Its antics have proven surprisingly effective.

entry: POKENAME平时温顺，受威胁时，却会让尾巴在石壳上快速反弹，积蓄动势，再以巨大力道，猛砸对手。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME is normally a docile Pokémon, but when threatened, it will rapidly bounce its tail off its stony shell, giving the tail enough momentum to slam into its opponent with immense force.

entry: 大雪时，POKENAME站在尾巴上，越过雪堆，取得更好的视野。敏锐嗅觉，也能从远处察觉捕食者，让它更快逃到安全处。
author: sk372
source: During times of heavier snowfall, POKENAME perches on its tail to get a better vantage point over the snowbank. Its sharp sense of smell lets it detect predators from long distances, letting it flee to safety quicker.

entry: POKENAME害羞又敏感，依赖照料者抚育。据说，它远远便知人的意图，一触碰它，心底的秘密就会与它共享。
author: bobosmith01
source: Shy and incredibly sensitive, POKENAME relies on a caretaker to nurture it. It has been said that POKENAME knows one's intentions from a distance, and by touching it, you share the secrets in your heart with them.

entry: POKENAME用尾球的天真模样，诱来猎物，让其放松警惕，再出击。不过，真正的脸，其实也没多吓人。
author: deniablecredibility
source: POKENAME uses the innocent appearance of the ball on its tail to lure prey and trick them into a false sense of security before striking. However, its real face isn't especially intimidating either.

entry: POKENAME出现在倾盆大雨中，哭声被雨声淹没。传说，谁能哄得它开心、足以进化，就能一生走运，直到生命尽头。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME appears in heavy downpours where its weeping cries are drowned out by the rainfall. Legends say that anyone who can cheer it up enough for it to evolve will be blessed with good luck until their dying day.

entry: 这次自身融合的两个身体，像流星索般配合，兼顾移动与战斗。它们却不总协调，有时动作笨拙，互相乱甩，甚至可能双双受伤。
author: infranscia
source: The two bodies of this self fusion work in tandem, acting like bolas for both travel and battle.  The bodies aren't always well-coordinated, sometimes moving clumsily, even flinging each-other in directions that may end up harming both halves.

entry: POKENAME身体未成熟，在群中地位不高。这个阶段，它观察别人、学习世界，追求有朝一日成为杰出首领，对自己和别人，都期望很高。
author: bobosmith01
source: As POKENAME is physically immature, it does not yet rank highly in its flock. It spends this stage of its life studying others and the world around it in pursuit of one day becoming a grand leader. It has deep expectations in both itself and others.

entry: POKENAME用身上一簇球状突起，模仿小植物。突起有浮力，能让它水中移动时，保持直立。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME uses the cluster of spherical growths on its body to mimic the shape of small plants. The growths are buoyant, enabling it to remain upright whilst travelling through the water.

entry: POKENAME用身上一簇球状突起，模仿小植物。突起有浮力，能让它水中移动时，保持直立。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME uses the cluster of spherical growths on its body to mimic the shape of small plants. The growths are buoyant, enabling it to remain upright whilst travelling through the water.

entry: POKENAME友善爱玩，表演时用自己的尾巴，站立、跳跃、弹起。若摔下或被打落，就会不受控制地抽泣，直到受到安慰，或被给食物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are friendly and playful, using their own tails to stand on, jump on, and bounce upon as they perform tricks. If they fall or are knocked off, they will sob uncontrollably until consoled or given food.

entry: POKENAME天性焦虑，靠在雷电形的尾巴上休息，安慰自己。饲主得留意，它储电大，却控制力弱，突然触碰，可能挨上很痛的电击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rests on its bolt-shaped tail to comfort itself, as it has an anxious nature. Owners should take heed of its large electric capacity but weak self-control; touching it by surprise could lead to a very painful jolt.

entry: POKENAME身体未成熟，仍在成长。新生个体的尾巴最大，储满营养。越长大，就弹得越高，最终也能滑翔更远，并会跟随附近水属性宝可梦的带领。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is physically immature and is still growing. Newborns have the biggest tails, which are full of nutrients. As they grow older, they can bounce higher and, eventually, glide farther. They follow the lead of nearby Water-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME很易受惊。一吓到，就蜷成球，借尾巴弹起，又因动势，四处随机反弹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite jumpy and easily startled. When surprised, it curls into a ball and bounces off its own tail, ricocheting around at random due to the following momentum.

entry: POKENAME遇威胁便惊慌，盲目抽打沿途一切。攻击时，眼睛总紧闭，因此战斗中，也认不清自己的力量。
author: ambrosia04
source: When threatened, POKENAME panics and blindly flails at anything in its path. Because it always attacks with its eyes tightly shut, it can't recognize its own strength during battle.

entry: 训练越多，POKENAME击打尾巴时，就能让它伸得越远。训练最好的个体，能击碎10英尺外的巨石。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The more it trains, the farther its tail can extend upon POKENAME striking it. The best trained POKENAME can shatter a boulder from 10 feet away.

entry: POKENAME情绪高涨便显形，通常是因有人打扰栖身的石头，令它痛苦。越心烦意乱，形成的灵体投影就越大。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME manifests when its emotions are high, typically in distress due to others disturbing the stone it inhabits. The more emotionally distraught it is, the larger the spiritual projection it forms.

entry: POKENAME尾巴装着细沙，会咬尾巴，缓解压力。有人推测，现代解压玩具，正是受它的尾巴启发。
author: mistymagius
source: Its tail is filled with fine sand and POKENAME will chew on its own tail in order to relieve stress. Some people theorize that its tail inspired modern stress toys.

entry: POKENAME尾端的巨球虽能帮助浮水，却格外笨重累赘。它们背着球，免得卡在树根与藤蔓间。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Despite being a buoyant floatation aid, the gigantic ball at the end of the tails of POKENAME are extremely bulky and cumbersome. POKENAME carry the ball on their back in an effort to avoid getting caught on roots and vines.

entry: POKENAME被广称为温柔的巨人，一点小事，也会委屈地呜咽。每次用拳打敌，它都会哭得停不下来。
author: .izik
source: Widely regarded as a gentle giant, POKENAME will whimper at the slightest issue. Any time it uses its fists to strike a foe, it cries uncontrollably.

entry: POKENAME从不停止哭泣，常栖在空旷深谷的岩壁旁。多年后，无尽的泪，便把峡隙慢慢填成纯净清水。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME never stop crying and are often found perched along the walls of empty ravines. Over many years, their endless tears slowly fill these chasms with clear, pure water.

entry: POKENAME从不停止哭泣，常栖在空旷深谷的岩壁旁。多年后，无尽的泪，便把峡隙慢慢填成纯净清水。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME never stop crying and are often found perched along the walls of empty ravines. Over many years, their endless tears slowly fill these chasms with clear, pure water.

entry: POKENAME胆小，害怕就紧抱尾巴。睡前，还会打喷嚏，喷出体内储着的火焰。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are easily frightened and cling to their tails whenever they feel scared. Before going to sleep, they sneeze out flames that they have stored in their bodies before falling asleep.

entry: POKENAME很易受惊，会把鼓起的尾巴拍地，发出响声。附近同类也会跟着拍响，团结起来，将惊扰家园的东西吓走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are easily spooked and will slap their inflated tail against the ground to make a loud noise if startled. Nearby POKENAME will copy the noise, banding together to try and scare off whatever startled them from their home.

entry: POKENAME把尾巴递向低落的对象。挤捏、拥抱尾端软球，能缓解压力。让别人好过，也使平日忧郁的它，心情好起来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME offers up its tail to those who are feeling down. Squeezing and hugging the soft orb at the end helps alleviate stress. Helping others feel better lifts POKENAME's often-somber mood as well.

entry: POKENAME尾巴沉重，下坠的重量，让长时间飞行很难。它常为此不快，坐在尾上，气鼓鼓地撅嘴。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The tail of POKENAME is quite heavy, dragging them down and making flying for long periods difficult. POKENAME often become upset at this, and will angrily pout on top of their tails.

entry: POKENAME多条尾巴虽轻，却让移动有点笨拙。它借尾巴站高，察看危险；六条尾，也都能在应付追兵时，起到一定的打击作用。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's multiple tails are lightweight, but they make moving around a bit awkward. POKENAME uses them to get better vantage points as it looks for incoming danger, and all six tails work moderately well as striking weapons against pursuers.

entry: POKENAME轻松一跃，就能跳约120码远。当地体育比赛，已开始请它作开场表演，跃过场地，为比赛揭幕。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME are capable of leaping around 120 yards with ease. Local sports matches have begun using them as a showpiece, jumping over the arena to kick off the match.

entry: POKENAME能随意鼓大头或尾巴，同时缩小另一部位。鼓尾晃动，能吓走捕食者；鼓头，则能吹出大泡。
author: alindrome
source: POKENAME can inflate its head or tail at will, shrinking the other body part. It can inflate its tail and wave it to scare off predators, or inflate its head to blow large bubbles.

entry: POKENAME十分讲究华美毛发的状态。谁未经允许就摸，通常会让它转身，坐在尾上，闷闷不乐。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME is very particular about the state of its luxurious fur. If someone pets it without its permission, it typically responds by turning away, sitting on its tail, and sulking.

entry: POKENAME的主头，将尾上的头视为终生伙伴。一旦瘪下，就哭得失控，直到训练家从退化头顶端的喷嘴状附肢吹气，重新鼓起。
author: nightshadow_og
source: The head on POKENAME's tail is treated like a lifelong companion by its main head. If it ever deflates, then the main head cries uncontrollably until its Trainer reinflates the vestigial head by blowing through the nozzle-like appendage on its top.

entry: POKENAME总为周围的声音痛苦，会把身体蜷在尾巴周围，借里面的消音液体安静下来。此时若受惊，耳朵便凶猛抽击，足以打倒体型大许多倍的宝可梦。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is constantly distraught by the sounds of the world around it. It curls up around its tail, which is filled with a noise-dampening fluid. If startled in this state, its ears viciously lash out, able to fell Pokémon many times its size.

entry: POKENAME双目全盲，栖息地底洞穴，靠回声定位认路。它们常分不清洞底与水面，因此长着巨大的浮尾，万一坠水，也不至于沉下。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are completely blind and roost in underground caves, using their echolocation to navigate. They often struggle to differentiate water from cave floors, so they have large tail floats to prevent sinking if they crash.

entry: POKENAME还不太会飞，便用弹尾，把自己送离地面。遇上心怀恶意的人或宝可梦，它常会吓得僵住。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME is not very good at flying yet, so it uses its bouncy tail to get off the ground. It tends to freeze up around malicious people and Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME常在河床附近哭泣。住在附近的居民，总抱怨它们整夜吵闹。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are often found crying near riverbeds. Residents who live near these Pokémon often complain about their loud noises over the night.

entry: POKENAME待在其他电属性宝可梦身上，吸收多余静电，避免对方充电过量。受威胁，就藏到尾后，让毛发竖起。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME rests on other Electric-type Pokémon to absorb the excess electrostatic energy produced by their bodies, preventing them from overcharging. When it feels threatened, it hides behind its tail, making its fur stand on end.

entry: POKENAME容易掉泪，一点惊吓，就哭上一整天。体型太小，大多数大东西，连训练家都令它害怕，因此从未见它眼里不含泪。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: POKENAME easily tears up. They cry all day if they get scared by the slightest thing. Due to its size, most large things, including Pokémon Trainers, intimidate it, so they have never been seen without tears in their eyes.

entry: POKENAME很胆小，见到比自己大的东西，就常放声哭泣。受惊时，会发出吱吱声，怪兽狂觉得十分可爱。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are easily scared, often bursting into tears upon seeing anything larger than themselves. When scared, POKENAME makes a squeaking noise, which is regarded as cute by Poké Maniacs.

entry: 它会装成被自己的尾巴扎伤，好让敌人轻视。可真不小心扎到自己时，也一样哭得伤心。
author: staghorn
source: It pretends to be harmed by its own tail so that its foes underestimate it. It cries just as hard when it pricks itself on accident.

entry: POKENAME受惊，就把尾巴当锤，疯狂挥甩，造成周围大规模破坏。慌乱让它失去平衡，若转得够快，甚至会把自己甩飞。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME wildly swing their tails like maces when frightened, causing massive destruction all around them. This frantic flailing often leaves them off balance, sometimes even sending them flying if they spin fast enough.

entry: 别看这体型，POKENAME却十分纯真温柔，常用尾球弹跳。它爱玩石头，咬咬、摇摇，却往往因力量太大，把石头玩碎。
author: heal_fire
source: Despite their size, POKENAME are very innocent and gentle and are often found bouncing with the ball of their tail. They love to play with rocks, biting them and shaking them, but POKENAME usually end up breaking them due to their sheer power.

entry: 夜里，它们尽可能高高弹起，吸收最多的月光。尾巴更大的个体，吸收过更多月光。
author: bandedbodypress
source: They bounce as high as they can during the night, looking to absorb the most moonlight. Those with bigger tails have absorbed more moonlight.

entry: POKENAME爱哭，一有压力、害怕、愤怒或悲伤，就不停流泪。抱抱能使它好受，可泪总浸湿绒毛，安慰起来，实在不太舒服。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its weepy disposition makes it constantly cry whenever stressed, fearful, angry, or sad. Hugging POKENAME makes it feel better, but its tears constantly wet its plushy fur, making it very unpleasant to console.

entry: POKENAME身体大多肥厚软弹，却不如露力丽受小孩子喜爱。尾上满是极尖、刺得人很痛的刺，一扎进皮肤，就很难拔出。
author: bobosmith01
source: Most of their body is blubbery and squishy, but young children typically don't care for POKENAME as they do for Azurill, as their tails are littered with incredibly sharp and painful spines that are hard to remove once lodged in skin.

entry: POKENAME爱跟随训练家群冒险，认为有危险，就会叫着警告。但望风是否管用，很值得怀疑，因为任何意外声响或影子，都能吓到它。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME enjoy following groups of Trainers on their adventures, following along and crying out warnings when they believe there's danger. Their usefulness as a lookout is questionable as any unexpected noise or shadow is enough to spook them.

entry: POKENAME没信心登台唱歌，被逼着做，便会哭出来。训练家若想帮它顺利表演，必须温和引导。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lack the confidence to sing on stage and end up in tears if forced to do so. A gentle guide is necessary if their Trainer wants to help them perform successfully.

entry: POKENAME怕公开唱歌，有得选，就很少上台。它害怕被评判，要找到合适的训练家，帮助建立信心，极其困难。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are terrified of singing in public and would rarely sing on stage if they could help it. Finding the right Trainer to build their confidence is incredibly difficult because they fear being judged.

entry: POKENAME借弹性尾巴，高高跃起，察看四周。白色泡泡，受尾中营养影响，已经变成粉色。
author: chaoticanzu
source: Jumping from its bouncy tail enables POKENAME to reach great heights to observe its surroundings. The white bubbles have turned pink from the tail's nutrients.

entry: 它整天哭，以绒软而结实的尾巴，安慰自己。据称，喝它的泪，能解除霉运。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It cries all day, consoling itself with its plushy and firm tail. Drinking its tears allegedly cures bad luck.

entry: POKENAME孤独，就会哭着嚎叫。训练家最好别让它独处超过五分钟，因为寂寞来得太快。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME cries and howls when it feels lonely. Trainers are advised not to leave it alone for longer than five minutes, as lonesomeness strikes quickly with POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME一没达成目标，就很易灰心。训练家最好给予情感支持，肯定它的力量，帮它从低落中，重新振作。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are easily disheartened if they ever fail to achieve their goals. Trainers are advised to ensure they receive emotional support and are reassured of their strength to help them bounce back when they're feeling low.

entry: POKENAME紧张时，会互碰触手尖。它十分胆小，谁吓到，就用触手球拍过去，再以最快速度游走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME taps the tips of its tentacles together whenever it is nervous. It is quite timid, smacking whatever startles it with a tentacle orb before swimming away at max speed.

entry: POKENAME的泡泡，含有强力毒素。被较大的宝可梦攻击，就释放一圈圈毒泡，直到对方被击败，或逃走。
author: actliux
source: The bubbles it produces contain a potent poison. When POKENAME is attacked by a larger Pokémon, it will unleash rings of these bubbles until the attacker is defeated or flees.

entry: POKENAME的大半电力，储在尾巴，是力量的来源。但它控制不了这庞大力量，一哭，周围的机械就会停机。
author: dahappycute
source: POKENAME source of power comes from their tail, which holds most of their electrical powers. However, they are unable to control this huge power, so when POKENAME cries, mechanical devices around them will shut down.

entry: POKENAME害羞，面对不明情况，更愿退缩，不愿直面。三个头里，只要一个害怕，就会转身逃向最近的湖，跳进去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are shy Pokémon, often preferring to back away from uncertain situations rather than face them. If even one of their three heads becomes frightened, they will turn to flee, running for the closest lake to dive into.

entry: POKENAME连自己，都受不了油性身体的恶臭。既洗不净，也躲不掉，只能哭，脸上永远挂着嫌恶。
author: fancyskunk
source: Even POKENAME itself finds the stench of its oily body to be unbearably repulsive. Unable to clean itself, or retreat from the stink, POKENAME can only cry with a look of pure disgust permanently stuck on its face.

entry: POKENAME十分胆小，更爱缩壳，而不动用炮。它把尾巴浸进水里吸水，为水炮补水。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is very timid, preferring to hide in its shell rather than using its cannons. To fuel its water cannons, it absorbs water through its tail by submerging it underwater.

entry: POKENAME不善游泳，待在海滩浅水，吃冲岸的有机碎屑。若被卷入大海，就会合钳，兜住空气当浮具，盼着返回陆地。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are poor swimmers, sticking to the shallows along beaches and feeding on detritus that washes ashore. If they're ever swept out to sea, they snap their claws shut and capture air to use as floats, hoping to return to land.

entry: POKENAME忍不住用钳，不停捏自己的尾巴，连战斗也一样。挤压时的吱吱声，似乎能给它安慰。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME cannot stop squeezing its own tail in its claw, even in combat. It seems to find the squeaking sound it makes comforting.

entry: POKENAME哪怕孤独，也始终微笑，尾巴却会透露真情。它用小骨棒敲树干，打落果子吃。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME always wears a smile, even when it feels lonely; its tail reveals its true emotions. It strikes tree trunks with its small bone club to knock down fruit to feed on.

entry: 要是弄丢头上的头骨，POKENAME便会羞得躲起来，不愿见人。它非常喜欢熟透的果实，常住在食物容易寻得的林地。
author: fiordaliso
source: If it loses the skull on its head, it isolates itself out of shame. POKENAME is very fond of ripe fruit and tends to live in forested areas where it can easily find food.

entry: POKENAME飘浮在空中，周身笼罩着一团古怪的黑雾，吸入的人会感到头痛。它的笑声在体内回荡，仿佛身体是空心的，却依然能穿过雾气传出来。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME float in the air surrounded by an odd, dark mist that causes headaches in those who inhale it. When POKENAME laugh, the sound echoes throughout their bodies as if they were hollow, but still spreads through the mist.

entry: POKENAME的身体柔韧易变形，是绝佳的沙包，大多攻击打在身上都会弹开。到了夜里，它们会成群挤在一起，揉成一个大球睡觉。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's malleable bodies make them the perfect punching bags, letting most attacks bounce off them. At night, groups of these Pokémon will squish themselves into one big ball to sleep.

entry: POKENAME用长尾巴摘下甘甜的树果，分给年幼的宝可梦和孩子们。它最爱捉迷藏和追逐游戏，却常常输不起。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME pluck sweet berries with their long tails and share them with young Pokémon and children. They adore games of Hide-and-Seek and Tag, although they tend to be sore losers.

entry: POKENAME喜欢住在洞窟里，通常结群行动，彼此保护。为了锻炼力量，它们会蜷成球，在同伴身上弹来弹去。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME likes to live in caves, and usually travel in packs for protection. POKENAME will curl into a ball and bounce off of other members in their pack as a form of exercise in order to build strength.

entry: POKENAME飞得笨拙，得靠潜藏的超能力帮助自己留在空中。撞上东西时，它会将部分能量反弹回去。在建筑密集的地方，它常常撞上窗户，让人头疼。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are clumsy in their flight patterns, having to use their latent psychic powers to help support themselves in the air. When they crash into something, they rebound some of the energy. They're a pest in built-up areas when they hit windows.

entry: POKENAME飞得笨拙，得靠潜藏的超能力帮助自己留在空中。撞上东西时，它会将部分能量反弹回去。在建筑密集的地方，它常常撞上窗户，让人头疼。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are clumsy in their flight patterns, having to use their latent psychic powers to help support themselves in the air. When they crash into something, they rebound some of the energy. They're a pest in built-up areas when they hit windows.

entry: POKENAME天真开朗，几乎把一切都当成游戏。即使正在战斗或遭到欺负，它也会一边用团团电火花反击，一边笑个不停。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is naive and cheerful, treating almost everything as a game. Even when fighting or being bullied, it continues smiling and giggling even as it retaliates with balls of electric sparks.

entry: 月光下，POKENAME在开阔的原野上欢快地蹦跳。如果在跳跃时受到攻击，它便会以强力的双倍奉还还击。
author: .izik
source: Under the moonlight, POKENAME hops joyfully around open fields. If struck while hopping, it retaliates with a powerful Counter.

entry: 它整天唱歌，锻炼自己的声带。无论是谁，只要听完POKENAME的一首长歌，嗓子也会跟着变得沙哑。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It sings all day long to train its vocal chords. Anyone who hears a long POKENAME song will have their voice become hoarse in sympathy.

entry: POKENAME漆黑的羽毛上长着眼状斑纹，让来势汹汹的宝可梦摸不清它的视线所在。它借此将攻击引离身体，再施以强力反击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have eye spots on their jet black feathers that help to confuse aggressive Pokémon as to where they're looking. They use this confusion to draw attacks away from their body before landing powerful counterattacks.

entry: POKENAME凭借敏锐的嗅觉，能找出长在树根间的菌菇。人们多次试着教它利用这项本领帮助训练家，结果却只被它泼了一身泥水。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are able to detect species of fungi that grow amongst tree roots, using a keen sense of smell. Many attempts have been made to try and teach POKENAME to use this skill for their Trainer's benefit, but it just splashes them with muddy water.

entry: POKENAME凭借敏锐的嗅觉，能找出长在芦苇间的菌菇。人们多次试着教它利用这项本领帮助训练家，结果却只被它泼了一身泥水。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are able to detect species of fungi that grow amongst reeds, using a keen sense of smell. Many attempts have been made to try and teach POKENAME to use this skill for their Trainer's benefit, but it just splashes them with muddy water.

entry: POKENAME钻头般的尾巴上长着一只眼睛，能够察知来袭攻击的性质。这让它能立刻选用恰当的防御本领应对。
author: .izik
source: The eye on POKENAME's drill-like tail can sense the nature of incoming attacks. This allows it to react instantly with the correct defensive skill.

entry: POKENAME好奇心旺盛，谁引起了它的兴趣，它就会跟在谁身后。不过，它不喜欢别人直接关注自己，遇到停下来看它的人，往往会啄上几口。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are curious Pokémon that will follow along behind anybody that catches their interest. Despite their curiosity, they dislike direct attention and have a habit of pecking at anyone that stops to watch them.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在温暖的地方悠然蠕动，一副无忧无虑的样子。但它格外爱护自己的壳，只要有什么靠得太近，就会立刻缩进壳里，滚着逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME oozes around happily around warm areas, seemingly carefree in its attitude. It is incredibly protective of its shell, however, immediately retracting into it and rolling away if something gets too close.

entry: POKENAME每次使出双倍奉还，周围的地面都会覆上一层薄霜。霜面湿滑，交战双方都有失足的危险。
author: .izik
source: Any time POKENAME uses Counter, the ground around it is covered in a thin frost. This frost can be treacherous for both combatants, creating a slippery surface that increases the risk of losing footing.

entry: POKENAME透过电脑监督孩子的活动，确保孩子专心做作业。它本性开朗，尾巴却会在孩子不做作业时生气，有时还会甩尾一拍，把游戏和社交媒体暂停。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME monitor a child's activity through a PC to ensure they are focused on homework. While they have a cheery personality, the tail gets angry when the child is not doing homework and may pause games and social media with a slap of the tail.

entry: POKENAME看似欢快，实则十分沉着。若凭自身的武艺仍躲不开攻击，它便会原地不动，蓄势使出骇人的双倍奉还，瞬间扭转战局。
author: .izik
source: While appearing jolly, POKENAME has a very stoic demeanor. Should it notice an attack it cannot dodge with its martial arts prowess, it will stay still to unleash a terrifying Counter, turning the tide of battle in an instant.

entry: POKENAME平时用身体前侧的一片皮褶遮住乳房。恶作剧时，它会突然掀起皮褶，朝毫无防备的人喷出牛奶，吓对方一跳。
author: sk372
source: Most of the time, POKENAME keeps its udders hidden via a flap of skin on its front. It lifts this up to surprise and spray milk on unsuspecting people, as a prank.

entry: POKENAME脸上的眼睛只是斑纹，真正的眼睛长在飘逸鬃毛伸出的纤细触须末端。它藏在湖水下，只把眼睛探出水面，看看是否能安全上岸活动。
author: sk372
source: The eyes on POKENAME's face are false markings, as its real eyes rest at the end of wispy tendrils extending from its flowing mane. It hides beneath lake water, extending its eyes just above the surface to see if it's safe to wander out.

entry: POKENAME带着欢快的神情，在沿海城镇附近飞翔。遭到攻击时，它依旧面不改色，却会以惊人的破坏力还击。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME flies near coastal towns with a cheery look. If attacked, its expression will not change, but it will reply with incredible destructive force.

entry: 融合使POKENAME对枝荔果的食欲变成原来的4倍。若不加制止，它会用耳朵般的双臂，将成片的枝荔果植株吃个精光。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The hunger POKENAME has for Liechi berries quadruples due to fusion. It will use its earlike arms to eat groves of Liechi plants if left unchecked.

entry: 无论处于什么状况，POKENAME总是嘴角上扬。想知道它的心情，最好观察身体上黑色的尖端：难过时会垂下，生气时会晃动，诸如此类。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME always has its mouth turned upright regardless of its current condition. The best way to check its emotional state is in the black tips of its body: they're droopy if POKENAME is sad, wobbly if they're angry, and so on.

entry: POKENAME坚如磐石的身体，在使出镜面反射时会亮起蓝光。反击尚未命中，突然闪起的光芒就常已将对手吓了一跳。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's rock-solid body glows bright blue when using Mirror Coat. The sudden flash often startles foes before the counterattack lands.

entry: POKENAME成对住在古老的火山口里，一起带回树果烤着吃。它们偶尔也会与其他几对聚在一起，分享不同的食物。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME live in pairs in old volcanic craters. Together, they bring back Berries to roast and eat. POKENAME will occasionally congregate with other pairs to share different types of food.

entry: POKENAME很爱玩，喜欢用身体紧紧挤住别人。由于它体重惊人，一定要教它改掉这个习惯，否则训练家可能被压伤。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are very playful and enjoy squeezing their body up against others. Because of their great weight, it is important that they be taught not to do this, as otherwise their Trainer may be crushed.

entry: 受到攻击时，POKENAME会发出极其响亮的哔哔声，向四周迸射火花。不知为何，它仅凭本能反应就能将这股力量转回攻击者身上。
author: .izik
source: When struck, POKENAME makes an extremely loud beeping noise and sends sparks in all directions. It somehow redirects this force back at the attacker through sheer reflex.

entry: POKENAME用巨石筑堤，保护海边的栖息地免受侵蚀。它们搭起的堤坝免不了砸在自己身上，这时坚韧又柔软的身体就派上了用场。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME build levees out of boulders to protect their seaside habitats from erosion. Their resilient, squishy bodies come in handy when their constructions inevitably fall on top of them.

entry: POKENAME成群生活，总想尽量贴近同伴。只要其中一只高兴得跳起舞，其他成员便会受到感染，一同跳出活力十足的舞步。
author: st4rdustyugure
source: POKENAME live in packs and try to stay as close to their fellows as possible. If one POKENAME is happy, it starts dancing joyfully, drawing other members of its pack into an energetic choreography.

entry: POKENAME能短暂附身在其他宝可梦身上。被附身者往往会变得少有顾忌，并产生想让自己受伤的念头。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have the ability to possess other Pokémon for a limited amount of time. This possession often leads to reduced inhibition and a desire to get hurt.

entry: POKENAME挨的打越多，身体裂缝中储存的能量也越多。达到极限时，它便会释放强力电磁波，足以让半径5千米内的设备全部停止运作。
author: agostostino
source: The more blows POKENAME is struck by, the more energy it stores in the crack in its body. When at its limit, POKENAME releases a powerful electromagnetic wave capable of shutting down devices in a five-kilometer radius.

entry: POKENAME用软软的刀刃割断果梗，再以缎带将果实扔进嘴里。它还会反复弯折刀刃，让其变得更韧。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME harvests fruits by cutting stems with its floppy blade and chucking them into its mouth with its ribbon. It bends its blade to toughen it.

entry: 受到物理攻击后，POKENAME会释放出令人平静的气息。不断击打它的脸，这股气息便会越来越强，令攻击者渐渐冷静下来。
author: .izik
source: After being struck by a physical attack, POKENAME releases a soothing aura. Repeatedly striking it in the face causes this aura to intensify, calming the attacker.

entry: POKENAME用神秘守护保护睡着的伙伴。它喜欢在柔和的月光下休息。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses Safeguard to protect sleeping allies. It prefers to rest beneath the soft glow of moonlight.

entry: POKENAME靠承受攻击增强电力，每当受伤，身体自身的电压就会持续升高。承受过大量伤害的个体，能以电力发起毁灭性的反击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME increases its electric powers by taking hits, its body perpetually increasing its natural voltage in response to harm. POKENAME that endure lots of damage can release devastating electrical counters.

entry: POKENAME橡胶般的皮肤，能将来袭的攻击反弹给敌人。它大部分时间都在啃吃富含矿石的岩块。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's rubbery skin reflects incoming attacks back at enemies. It spends most of its time snacking on ore-rich rocks.

entry: POKENAME非常脆弱，会借强风逃离附近的威胁。但它无法控制自己在空中的去向，因此常被会飞的宝可梦捉住。
author: foulz4k
source: POKENAME is a very fragile Pokémon that uses high winds to escape nearby threats. However, it cannot control its movement in the air, resulting in frequent capture by airborne Pokémon.

entry: 睡觉时，它会把脸埋进翅膀的绒毛里。翅膀上的巨大假眼，让捕食者误以为POKENAME仍然醒着，十分警觉。
author: cait_sith
source: It hides its face in its wing fluff while it sleeps. The large fake eyes on its wings give predators the illusion that POKENAME is awake and alert.

entry: POKENAME看起来总是很开心，爪子却会流露真实的心情。感到烦躁时，它便开始用爪子刨抓地面。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME may look happy, but its claws can show its true emotions. When POKENAME is frustrated, its claws start to scratch into the ground.

entry: POKENAME身上的宝石虽然迷人，却极不稳定，稍受扰动就会爆炸。这些结晶是它以精神力量为食所产生的废物，往往数秒内就能重新长出。
author: turron_turron
source: While captivating, the gems on POKENAME's body are highly volatile and will explode at the slightest disturbance. These crystals are a waste product of POKENAME's psychic diet, and often regenerate within seconds.

entry: POKENAME用木棍和咒术让树上的水果、树果掉落，供自己食用。它厌恶争斗，遇险时更愿意诅咒捕食者，使其头晕目眩、不辨方向，再逃进树林。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's uses its stick and its hexing abilities to make fruits and berries fall from trees for it to eat. It abhors combat, so when in danger it prefers to curse a predator with dizziness and disorientation before fleeing into the woods.

entry: POKENAME兴高采烈地弹跳，同时放出云团般浓厚的蒸汽遮住身影。它以欢快的叫声扰乱对手，暗中积蓄高热，再突然喷出一股滚烫的蒸汽。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME generates thick, cloud-like steam to shroud itself from sight while bouncing enthusiastically. It misdirects foes with its cheerful cry, building up intense internal heat before unleashing a sudden, boiling burst of vapor.

entry: POKENAME会检查作物的根系，判断它们是否健康，以此帮助农民。作为回报，种植者会喂给它卖不出去的水果。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME helps out farmers by inspecting the roots of crops and determining if they are healthy. In exchange, cultivators feed the Pokémon unsellable fruit.

entry: POKENAME住在葡萄园附近的洞窟里，白天藏于地下。到了夜里，它们便钻出地面，尽可能多地把果实拖进地道，留待以后享用，让农民颇为苦恼。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their home in caves near vineyards, hiding away underground during the day. At night, they emerge and pop up out of the ground to pull as much fruit as they can into their tunnels to eat later, making them a nuisance to farmers.

entry: POKENAME喜欢帮人锻炼身体，指导拳击技巧，换取甜食。它有时会兴奋过头，将三个头中的一个猛地弹回陪练者身上，力道足以将对方击昏。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME enjoy helping people train their bodies, aiding boxers with their technique in exchange for sweet treats. They sometimes get overenthusiastic and spring one of their three heads back into their partner with enough force to knock them out.

entry: POKENAME喜爱甜食，住在果园里，会一直跟着工人，直到讨到水果。它知道人们喜欢听自己满足的呼噜声，便在吃东西时发出这种声音，盼着换来更多食物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a fondness for sweet treats, making their homes in orchards and persistently following the workers until they're fed fruit. They make a pleased purring noise when fed, knowing people enjoy the noise and hoping it leads to more food.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉敏锐，会循味找出甜食，狼吞虎咽地吃下。糖果师傅得提防四处游荡的POKENAME群，关好门，再请宝可梦巡护员来保护自己的产品。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a keen sense of smell, tracking down sweet treats and hungrily scarfing them down. Confectioners have to keep an eye out for wandering POKENAME packs, closing their doors and calling in Pokémon Rangers to keep their products safe.

entry: 热带红树林中可以找到POKENAME，它们藏在水下的树根间，以掉落的果实为食。一小群一小群的POKENAME会游到水面，吃漂浮的果实。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found in tropical mangroves, hiding amongst the roots of trees underwater. They feed on fruit that falls from the trees, small shoals of POKENAME swimming up to the surface to feed on the floating fruit.

entry: POKENAME常把自己倒栽在地里，睡觉时让真正的眼睛留意四周。当地的许多鬼故事，都由它们而起。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME commonly plant themselves upside down and allow their true eyes to watch over them as they sleep. They are the cause of many local ghost stories.

entry: POKENAME的身体由来历不明的浓缩烟雾构成。它围着甘甜的果实打转，热切地享用，细细品味这难得又转瞬即逝的滋养。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is made of compressed smoke of unknown origin. It floats in circles around sweet fruits, which it eats with fervor, savoring the rare and fleeting sustenance.

entry: POKENAME生气时，会用坚硬如岩石的尾巴猛砸地面。靠近它的人要当心它的落石，只消一击便能造成巨大伤害。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slams its rock-hard tail on the ground when it is angry. Anyone approaching should beware of its Rock Throw, which can cause massive damage with a single strike.

entry: 烦躁时，POKENAME会用三条尾巴上的手掌拍打地面。拍得越快，就说明它越快要朝惹恼自己的对象冲去。
author: sk372
source: When agitated, POKENAME slaps the palms on its three tails down onto the ground. The faster the three tails hit the ground, the closer it is to charging at the object of its ire.

entry: POKENAME喜欢用两条尾巴拍打建筑，将其推倒，再反复拍打残余的瓦砾，直到彻底粉碎，什么也不剩。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME likes to use its two tails to slap at buildings, knocking them over. It then slaps at the remaining rubble repeatedly, pulverizing it until nothing is left behind.

entry: 这种宝可梦罕见的基因异常，导致脸部长得不规则。它们常在城里横冲直撞，用两条尾巴撞倒建筑。
author: soup1900
source: A rare genetic anomaly in this Pokémon species has caused their faces to grow in an irregular way. They tend to go on rampages inside of cities, knocking buildings over with their two tails.

entry: POKENAME可能会随机出现在使用者的电脑上，友好地试图帮忙处理日常事务。不过，多数人觉得它添的乱比帮的忙还多。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME may appear on a user's computer at random, attempting to be friendly and help it with its daily tasks. Most will find it more annoying than helpful, however.

entry: POKENAME将两条尾巴拍在一起，便能释放大股超能力。若拍得太用力，产生的力量足以摧毁一座山。
author: .izik
source: By clapping its tails together, POKENAME can release large psychic bursts. If it strikes too hard, it can generate enough force to destroy a mountain.

entry: POKENAME暴走前会捶打胸膛，发出震耳的吼声。它先用双臂紧缠猎物，再以巨颚咬下，锁定胜局。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME beats its chest and releases a bellowing shout before going on a rampage. Its arms cling to its prey before large jaws bite down to secure victory.

entry: POKENAME骇人的巨颚常让旁人害怕，实际上它温和无害，最喜欢的不过是些小恶作剧。它用两条尾巴拿走无人看管的物品，囤积在自己的巢穴里。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite its fearsome jaws that often intimidate others, POKENAME is actually a gentle and harmless creature that mostly enjoys playing little pranks. It uses its twin tails to snatch unattended objects, which it hoards inside its den.

entry: 看似POKENAME尾羽的东西，其实是灵巧的附肢，能极精准地摆弄物件。
author: bee4082
source: What look like POKENAME's tail feathers are actually dextrous appendages. It uses these to manipulate objects with incredible precision.

entry: POKENAME关心训练家，身手也极其灵巧，是街角小店店主的理想伙伴。它能爬上爬下地给货架补货，还能发现偷拿或损坏商品的人。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME look out for their Trainer and are incredibly dextrous. This makes them ideal partners for those that own a corner shop, they climb around stocking shelves and are able to tell if someone is shoplifting or damaging stock.

entry: POKENAME关心训练家，身手也极其灵巧，是街角小店店主的理想伙伴。它能爬上爬下地给货架补货，还能发现偷拿或损坏商品的人。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME look out for their Trainer and are incredibly dextrous. This makes them ideal partners for those that own a corner shop, they climb around stocking shelves and are able to tell if someone is shoplifting or damaging stock.

entry: 人们互相告诫，别被POKENAME的笑容和滑稽的拍尾动作骗了。挨它一口便足以让人叫来急救人员，而它还会笑看伤者被救护车带走。
author: redmagecole
source: Warnings get passed around to not be fooled by POKENAME's grin and silly tail claps. One bite from POKENAME is enough to require paramedics, while POKENAME laughs at the injured being taken away in an ambulance.

entry: POKENAME对一切都充满好奇，会用大手触摸物体，仔细研究形状和质感。在网络空间里，它则用双手直接推动电脑文件，将其搬到不同设备之间。
author: soup1900
source: Curious about everything, POKENAME use their large hands to feel objects and deeply study their shape and texture. In cyberspace, they use these hands to physically push computer files around and move them between devices.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴会影响平衡，使转速变慢。不过甩出的力道，仍足以将相扑力士打飞。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME's spins are slower due to its tails affecting its balance. However, the impact of them is powerful enough to send a sumo wrestler flying.

entry: POKENAME两条尾巴上的手掌，是体内主要的发电器官。用尽全力将双掌拍合，便会迸发出猛烈的雷电。
author: sk372
source: The twin palms on POKENAME's two tails are the main electricity-generating organs in its body. Clapping them together at full force causes a massive burst of lightning.

entry: POKENAME挥动头上手掌般的冠，吸引伴侣，或威吓其他同类。冠上的粉红色部位，温度可与余烬相当。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME waves the hand-like comb on its head to attract partners or intimidate other POKENAME. The pink sections of this comb can reach temperatures comparable to embers.

entry: POKENAME绕着对手飞奔，试图耗尽其体力。有时边跑边喝特制汽水，进一步增强本领。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME races around its opponent in order to tire it out. Sometimes, it drinks a special soda while doing so, further enhancing its abilities.

entry: POKENAME会挑衅对手，激其迎战。战斗时，它用尾巴上的手扫倒较轻的敌人；面对大个头，则双手一起拍向对方头部，打得其晕头转向。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME goad their opponents into fighting them by taunting them. When in combat, POKENAME use their tail-hands to sweep the legs of lighter foes, and smack them both against the heads of larger opponents to discombobulate them.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴移动、防御，还会替自己和幼崽碾碎硬食。它对旁人的情绪十分敏感，尤其是积极的情绪；高兴到极点时，会跳起杂技般的舞蹈。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their tails for movement, defense, and to crush up harder foods for themselves and their young. They are sensitive to the emotions of others, especially positive emotions; when at their happiest, they dance acrobatically.

entry: 它用两条手掌般的尾巴在树间荡来荡去，同时以超能力摘取树上的果实和坚果。抵御威胁和敌人时，它会用四肢或超能力投掷坚果与小石子。
author: infinex21
source: It swings between trees using its two hand-like tails while plucking fruits and nuts from trees using its psychic powers. To fend off threats and foes, it will chuck nuts and pebbles using its limbs or its psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME用强健的尾巴折断树枝，再将枝条收集起来，在河岸边搭建结实的巢屋。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its powerful tails to snap limbs off trees. It then collects the branches to build sturdy lodges along riverbanks.

entry: POKENAME动作迅捷狡黠，像戏耍对手般接连出击，双手、双脚和尾巴构成六路攻势。它自信的笑容，更让敌人摸不着头脑。
author: ocxin
source: With fast, tricky movements, POKENAME make sport of their opponents, pummeling them with a rapid series of strikes that come from their hands, legs, and tails for a six-way offense. Their confident smiles bewilder foes even more.

entry: POKENAME用头上长出的手，向敌人打出一阵疾拳。它生性爱玩，喜欢为人和宝可梦表演。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME uses the hands that sprout from its head to attack foes with a flurry of punches. It has a playful personality, and enjoys performing for people and Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME飞快挥舞四条手臂般的肢体，令对手眼花缭乱、无力招架。不战斗时，它便用这些肢体捉弄旁人，或将树果和其他水果大把塞进嘴里。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME swing their four arm-like limbs around rapidly to mystify and overwhelm opponents. When they are not battling, they will use their limbs to mess with others and to shovel berries and other fruits into their mouths.

entry: POKENAME做大多数事情都靠尾巴上的手，连移动也快得惊人。这双手强健灵巧，让它成为厉害的篮球好手，投篮、传球、封盖，甚至扣篮，都不在话下。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME uses its hands on its tails for most actions, even ambulating with surprising speed. As a result, POKENAME makes a formidable basketball player: it ably shoots, passes, blocks, and even dunks with its strong and dexterous hands.

entry: POKENAME用流苏般的手臂，在树间灵巧地荡行。途中，它会用巨大的剑刃将果树的整条枝桠切下，带着当作随身零食。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME nimbly swings through the trees with its tassel-like arms. As it travels, it uses its immense blade to slice off entire branches of fruit trees, carrying them as a portable snack.

entry: 它的两条手掌状肢体十分灵巧，能用来攀爬树木或类似的结构。有人认为，POKENAME能通过身体接触进行心灵感应，甚至能与人类如此交流。
author: robobunnybutt
source: Its two hand-like limbs are highly dexterous, and it can use them to climb trees or similar structures. Some believe POKENAME is capable of telepathy through physical contact, and can even do so with human beings.

entry: POKENAME的双拳和尾巴都蕴藏着惊人的拳劲。为了保持力量，它经常自己和自己对拳，将双拳猛击在一起。
author: sk372
source: Formidable punching strength is packed into both POKENAME's fists and its tails. To keep its strength honed, it regularly boxes with itself, smashing its fists against each other.

entry: 如果你在森林里突然丢了东西，可能是POKENAME干的。要是有幸抓个正着，它们倒会彬彬有礼地将赃物奉还。
author: teatedtiten
source: If you suddenly lose your belongings in a forest, an POKENAME could be to blame. If you are lucky enough to catch them in the act though, they will politely return the stolen goods back to you.

entry: POKENAME是个狡猾的小捣蛋鬼，会凭借爱玩的模样接近孩子。随后，它便在傍晚从嘴里放出令人恐惧的气体，将孩子们吓得不轻。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a devious little trickster that uses its playful appearance to get closer to children. It then spends the evenings terrorizing them with a fear-causing gas released from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME用能伸长的强力拳头保护自己和他人，每一拳都力道十足。常能在森林深处发现它，一边大吃香蕉，一边保护长尾怪手与双尾怪手的群落。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME defends itself and others with powerful extending fists that pack a hefty punch. It's often found deep in forests, gorging on bananas and defending colonies of Aipom and Ambipom.

entry: 野生POKENAME用四条长臂，在作为家园的丛林或森林中迅速穿行。它们会从树枝上摘下坚果，边窃笑边砸向过路人。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME quickly traverse their jungle, or forest, homes using their four long arms. From atop tree branches, they will pluck and chuck nuts at travelers while giggling.

entry: POKENAME住在大树根间。有宝可梦经过，POKENAME便伸出长长的肢体，将对方拖入地下。
author: teatedtiten
source: POKENAME can be found residing in the roots of large trees.  When Pokémon come by, POKENAME use their lengthy limbs to pull them underground.

entry: POKENAME交缠、变换长长的手掌状尾巴，做出手影，让自己显得更大，吓退捕食者。被逼入绝境时，它会先用尾巴来回猛拍，再弹身逃开。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME intertwine and rearrange their long, hand-like tails to create shadow puppets, making themselves appear bigger to scare off predators. If cornered, they will wildly slap their tails back and forth before springing away.

entry: POKENAME有两只能够抓握东西的耳朵，平时却只用其中一只取物。若双耳同时上阵，通常就表示一场战斗即将开始。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME has two prehensile ears, but it typically only uses one of them to grab things. When it employs both ears at once, it's usually a sign that a battle is about to commence.

entry: POKENAME身上遍布的突起，其实都是能活动的手指，可以用来移动，甚至操作物体。
author: hophoppip
source: The protrusions that cover POKENAME's body are actually functional fingers, which it can use to move around and even manipulate objects.

entry: POKENAME会从训练家身上偷走硬币或其他亮晶晶的物品。每次得手，它都会发出既得意又嘲弄的笑声。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME pickpockets coins or other shiny objects from Trainers. It laughs with both amusement and derision whenever it gets away with theft.

entry: POKENAME无需吞咽，便能用双手吸走物体的养分，包括它最爱的坚果和树果。剩下的残渣则成了它投向敌人的武器，用起来十分娴熟。
author: bobosmith01
source: Through its hands, POKENAME can drain the nutrients from other things, such as its favorite nuts and Berries, all without swallowing a thing. It takes the leftover matter and uses it as a deft throwing weapon for foes.

entry: POKENAME是敏捷而富有谋略的机械生物，战斗时偏爱远距离战术。背后伸出的两条电线状尾巴，能发射自动追踪敌人的火箭拳。
author: sk372
source: An agile and tactical mechanical creature, POKENAME prefers to stick to long-range tactics in battle. It can fire homing rocket punches from the twin tail wires protruding from its back.

entry: POKENAME用修长灵巧的尾掌撑起身体，疾速跃动，在战斗或玩耍时迅速变换位置。它们常在成片的石柱旁筑巢，在石柱间跃来跃去，展现惊人的杂技身手。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME use their long, dexterous tail paws to launch themselves into action, quickly repositioning in combat or play. They are often found nesting near collections of rock spires, leaping between them in impressive feats of acrobatics.

entry: POKENAME身上的蘑菇闻起来像蕉香果，却不能食用。哪怕只吃下一点，也可能引发遍及全身的严重感染。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's mushroom smells like Nanab Berries but should not be eaten. Even a small amount can cause massive infections throughout the body.

entry: POKENAME凭直觉战斗，所用招数无需过多筹划。它用四只手抓住、挥打对手，直到赢得胜利。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME fight with intuitive techniques that require little planning or forethought. They use all four hands to grapple and swipe at opponents until they achieve victory.

entry: 虽然身体体积的95%以上都是水，它的栖息地却不限于水中。有时能看到POKENAME用手掌状尾巴倒挂在树枝上，从上方抓住毫无戒备的路人。
author: anonymous_moose
source: Despite its body being over 95% water by volume, its habitat is not restricted to aquatic environments. POKENAME can sometimes be found dangling by its hand-tails from tree branches, grabbing unwary passersby from above.

entry: POKENAME发怒时，会用尾巴撑起身体，再将自己猛掷向敌人。
author: kittyluv090
source: When POKENAME is angered, it will lift itself up using its tails and hurl itself towards enemies.

entry: POKENAME靠强壮的手臂拖着身体去往各处，让身体休息，所有活都交给双臂。这样使用手臂，似乎一点也不会让它疲倦。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME uses its strong arms to drag and pull itself where it needs to go, letting its body rest while its arms do all the work. Using these arms doesn't seem to tire it at all.

entry: POKENAME的两条假尾巴装满高浓度毒素，宛如塞得鼓鼓的水球。它将尾巴拍向目标，尾端的手掌便会爆开，让毒物糊满对方全身。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's two false tails are filled with highly concentrated toxins, akin to tightly packed water balloons. It smacks them down on targets, the tail-hands bursting and smothering them with the poisonous material.

entry: POKENAME的战斗方式别具一格。它先喷出分岔的高压水流，让敌人迅速失去方向，再将其一通猛拍，打得晕头转向。
author: lootererswillbeboated
source: POKENAME has a very unique fighting style. It shoots split streams of high-pressure water to quickly disorient foes, then slaps them silly.

entry: POKENAME出没于森林中，穿行在树枝之间，以突然现身和带毒的触碰吓走其他宝可梦。将对方赶走后，它便住进那些被遗弃的巢穴。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME haunts forests, floating through tree branches to frighten other Pokémon with its sudden appearance and poisonous touch. Once it has driven them away, POKENAME takes up residence inside their abandoned nests.

entry: POKENAME在森林和城市中都能自在生活，用双臂在树枝或路灯间迅速而无声地荡行。看到有人独自走夜路，它就会突然落下，吓对方一跳。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is at home in both forests and urban environments, using its two arms to quickly but silently swing itself around between tree branches or streetlamps. If it sees a person walking alone at night, it will drop down to frighten them.

entry: POKENAME用其他宝可梦的骨头，调制药液。有时，也会把有益的药水，分给训练家。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME mixes brews with the bones of other Pokémon. They sometimes share beneficial potions with their Trainer.

entry: 人们普遍猜测，POKENAME的骨头里藏着许多咒术与诅咒。大多数人都尽量远离它。
author: dodoowner_
source: Popular conjecture theorizes that POKENAME's bones hold many curses and spells. Most people try to stay away from this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME身上放出的雾气会引发幻觉，扭曲受害者的感知。这时，对方脑海里还会响起它诡异而无词的吟唱，更添恐惧。
author: .izik
source: The mist that comes out of POKENAME's body causes hallucinations, distorting the victim's perception. During this time, its eerie, wordless chanting can be heard inside their head, heightening the fear.

entry: POKENAME攀附在船舷上，沐浴夜空的光辉。水手们说，一趟航程若有超过12只POKENAME随行，注定不会成功。
author: turron_turron
source: POKENAME cling to the sides of ships where they bask in the glow of the night sky. Sailors say that any voyage accompanied by more than a dozen POKENAME is doomed to fail.

entry: POKENAME挥动手杖，划出繁复的轨迹，筑起强力屏障，保护自己和他人免受伤害。有人会找它求取辟厄的护符，尽管这些护符的效用从未得到证实。
author: .jerden
source: By waving its staff in intricate patterns, POKENAME can create powerful barriers to protect itself and others from harm. Some people seek it out and request charms to ward off misfortune, although it has never been proven that these work.

entry: POKENAME将幽灵能量聚集在镰刀中，发动时刀刃会泛起紫光。被充能后的刀刃割伤者，会遭到持续一年的厄运诅咒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gathers up ghostly energy in its scythes, causing them to glow purple when active. Those cut by the blades while energized fall victim to a year-long curse of bad luck.

entry: POKENAME会对闯入领地的人使出百般恶作剧。它纯粹以捉弄人类为乐，不断干扰训练家，却从不会给受害者留下长久的伤害。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME pull a myriad of pranks on people who enter into their territory. They constantly meddle with Trainers for sheer misanthropic amusement but never leave their targets with lasting injuries.

entry: POKENAME喜欢阅读，常出没于旧图书馆。它一般无害又怕生，但谁要是太吵，就会被它狠狠吓上一回。
author: occulusmalus
source: POKENAME often haunts old libraries, as it enjoys reading. It is generally harmless and shy, but will deliver a terrible fright to those that make too much noise.

entry: 魔法咒语让它能用新方式操纵水，甚至使水穿墙而过。它还会往讨厌者的饮料里施下可怕诅咒。
author: vaporvenator
