source: Magic spells grant it new ways to manipulate water, such as phasing it through walls. It taints the drinks of those it dislikes with terrible curses.

entry: POKENAME的毛看着蓬松，令人想摸。可若未经POKENAME同意就伸手，它燃起的火焰，足以将人严重烧伤。
author: alumed
source: While the fur of POKENAME may appear fluffy and inviting, touching a POKENAME against its will may cause intense burns due to the flames it generates.

entry: POKENAME恶劣又乖张，见到电脑使用者就想给对方添麻烦。它会诅咒侵入的设备，使之故障百出、运作失常，往往连修也修不好。
author: sk372
source: A Pokémon of malicious deviance, POKENAME aims to cause problems for any user it comes across. It casts hexes on any device it invades, causing them to glitch out and behave wildly, often beyond repair.

entry: POKENAME总在夜里狩猎，寻找鬃岩狼人成群活动的踪迹。它的一举一动都透着嗜血之意，有人说，它的镰刀就是用鬃岩狼人的骨头做的。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME always hunts at night, seeking out packs of Lycanroc. Its movements are filled with bloodlust, and some say its scythe is made from Lycanroc bones.

entry: 它的鼾声像在念咒，即使睡着，力量仍会运作，驱赶旁人。只要能睡觉和吃东西，它便心满意足。
author: infinex21
source: Its snoring sounds like incantations and its powers remain active to repel others even as it sleeps. It is content with spending its time sleeping and eating.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀上，魔法能量噼啪作响。它召来道道紫色闪电，以阴险的诅咒击中受害者。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's wings crackle with magical energy. It summons bolts of purple lightning to strike its victim with its sinister curses.

entry: POKENAME的叫声是能唤来各种天气现象的咒语。沿身体排列的珠子泛起不祥的绯红光芒，震慑威胁。
author: infinex21
source: The cries of a POKENAME are incantations that call forth various weather phenomena. The orbs along its body glow with an ominous crimson light to deter threats.

entry: 据说，POKENAME的吼声是审判人心的咒语。心怀邪念者将永受诅咒，心地纯净者则获赐健康的祝福。
author: actliux
source: When a POKENAME roars, it is said to be an incantation that judges the hearts of people. Those with evil hearts are cursed for eternity, while those with pure hearts are blessed with good health.

entry: POKENAME通常随身带着灯泡，踏上漫长的冒险之旅。它们似乎对解谜上了瘾，因为解开谜题能为灯泡供能，让灯火不至熄灭。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME usually travel around on long adventures, carrying around a lightbulb with them. They seem to have an addiction to puzzles, as completing puzzles power their lightbulbs so they won't go out.

entry: POKENAME栖息在沼泽里，用阴森的笑声威吓闯入领地者。据说，凡听见笑声的都会遭到厄运诅咒。若这样还赶不走对方，它就只好动用满口利齿。
author: .jerden
source: Dwelling in swamps, POKENAME intimidates any intruders into its territory with its sinister cackle, which is said to curse all who hear it with misfortune. If this is insufficient to drive them off, it falls back on its many sharp teeth.

entry: POKENAME开始念咒时，适应力极强的双眼会泛起邪恶的光芒。据说目睹此景者，将遭受难以言说的折磨。这种宝可梦在黑暗中如鱼得水。
author: jadey.1557
source: When POKENAME begins to chant incantations, its adaptive eyes glow with a malicious aura. It's said that anyone that witnesses this is subjected to unspeakable torment. This Pokémon thrives in the dark.

entry: POKENAME挥着暗紫如午夜的翅膀，掠过夜空。它们能感知地面生灵的情绪，找到饱受噩梦困扰的人和宝可梦，便栖在附近，大快朵颐。
author: katieplaysgames
source: On midnight purple wings, POKENAME swoops across the nighttime sky. They can sense the emotions of those on the ground below them and will seek out people and Pokémon suffering from bad dreams, perching nearby and feasting upon them.

entry: 人们常看见POKENAME变魔术吓人，从斗篷底下变出树木般的身影。不过有时，观众不但不害怕，反而看得兴奋不已。
author: st4rdustyugure
source: POKENAME is often seen doing magic tricks to scare people, producing a tree-like figure from under its cape. However, it sometimes finds watchers thrilled rather than terrified.

entry: 人们认为，青蛙变王子的童话正是受POKENAME启发。它举止如王者，生活在蚊香蛙皇及其进化前的宝可梦之间，备受尊重。谁敢虐待它，便会遭到诅咒，很快陷入疯狂。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is believed to have inspired the fairy tale of a frog turning into a prince. It behaves regally, living amongst Politoed and their unevolved forms, where it garners great respect. It curses any that mistreat it, who are quickly driven mad.

entry: POKENAME虽没什么经验，却仍会深入浑浊的沼泽，寻找冒险。它们笨拙出了名，每次犯错就会发出阴森的叫声，不少人因此误以为来了可怕得多的东西。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME explore murky swamps, looking for adventure despite their inexperience. POKENAME are notoriously clumsy, releasing a ghoulish cry whenever it makes a mistake, which many have mistaken for a much larger threat.

entry: 满月之夜，POKENAME会变得更加活跃。它邪恶的叫声折磨着所有听见的人，甚至能将人逼疯。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME becomes more active on nights of a full moon. Its wicked cries torment all who hear it, and can even drive one mad.

entry: 飞行时，POKENAME用扫帚拨开树枝。不知为何，它主要在凌晨3点左右活动，使它的深夜行踪更显神秘。
author: .izik
source: While flying, POKENAME uses its broom to knock away tree branches. It is primarily active around 3 AM for an unknown reason, adding to the mystery of its late-night activities.

entry: 宝可梦对战中，POKENAME每次即将出招，都会低声念诵难懂的咒语。研究这些复杂咒语的科学家，报告自己出现了头痛和幻觉。
author: quackquackattack
source: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME murmur inscrutable incantations whenever they are about to perform an attack. Scientists studying the complex incantations report experiencing headaches and hallucinations.

entry: POKENAME与目标四目相对，使其看见挥之不去的骇人幻象。对视越久，它吸入珠子中的恐惧就越多。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME locks eyes with its target to induce haunting visions. The longer it holds their gaze, the more fear it draws into its orbs.

entry: 飘浮在POKENAME身旁的头，是它忠诚的使魔。那颗头四处飘动，怪笑着分散目标的注意，而POKENAME则准备施以强大的咒术。
author: sk372
source: The head floating alongside POKENAME acts as its faithful familiar. It floats around cackling and distracting a target, while POKENAME itself prepares a powerful hex to curse the victim with.

entry: POKENAME吞下迷失的亡魂，再压成绚丽的紫水晶。晶体似乎仍能与其他灵魂，产生共鸣。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME consumes lost spirits and then compresses them into gorgeous amethyst crystals. The crystals seem to be able to resonate with other spirits.

entry: POKENAME性格古灵精怪，脾气却很坚韧。它总是手不离魔杖，一挥动便会发生种种怪事，从物品飘浮，到旁人暂时变了模样，不一而足。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has a whimsical personality and a hardy temperament. When it waves the wand it is never seen without, all sorts of strange effects happen, from objects levitating to others' appearance temporarily changing.

entry: 它吸收人类的恐惧情绪，与壳内的化学物质混合，制成效果难以预料的奇异药水。
author: hophoppip
source: It absorbs the frightened emotions of humans, which combine with the chemicals in its shell to create a strange potion with unpredictable effects.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在大锅里发酵树果。酿出的药液有多种兴奋作用，还能让它感到时间流逝变慢，它便借此在战斗中有效防御。
author: quietcognition
source: A POKENAME prefers to ferment berries in its cauldron. Its brew has various stimulating properties and causes a slowed perception of time, which it leverages in battle to effectively defend itself.

entry: POKENAME三只一群，生活在火山口里，在壳中熬煮药水。人们争相用它的壳涂覆搅拌碗和烤盘，相信这样能让食物带上魔力。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME live in groups of three in volcanic calderas where they boil potions within their shells. Their shells are highly sought after to coat mixing bowls and baking trays due to the belief this will infuse the food with magic.

entry: POKENAME蓬乱的紫色长毛中蕴含幽灵能量。它能轻松飘浮，吸收附近人和宝可梦的恐惧、绝望，作为能量来源。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME's shaggy, purple fur is imbued with ghostly energy. It can float around with ease, absorbing fear and despair from nearby people and Pokémon as an energy source.

entry: 古时，有人相信POKENAME的角可用于制作法杖、施展魔法，因此偷猎它们。这一物种至今仍怀恨在心，许多个体一见到人就施咒。
author: sk372
source: In olden times, POKENAME was poached for its antlers, as some believed they could be used as parts of staffs to wield magic powers. The species still holds a grudge for this, many casting curses on humans on-sight.

entry: POKENAME飞速旋转，唤出幽灵魔力凝成的小型风暴裹住身体。龙卷风上能看到它怪笑的面容，弱小的宝可梦一旦被卷进去，就会遭到诅咒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spins rapidly to conjure up a small typhoon of ghostly magic to cover its body. POKENAME's cackling visage can be seen on the tornado, which sucks in weaker Pokémon and curses them once they are trapped in the vortex.

entry: POKENAME虽然外貌阴森，心地却很仁慈。它们会将幽灵的攻击吸入自己体内，保护训练家和年幼的宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: Despite the ghostly appearance, POKENAME are quite benevolent. They protect Trainers and young Pokémon from spectral strikes by absorbing the attacks into their body.

entry: 它吟诵的咒文，可能招来突如其来的猛烈风暴。风暴一过，它便往往消失了。
author: captainzscourge
source: The incantations that this Pokémon may chant can cause sudden and violent storms. It often disappears once the storm has passed.

entry: 即使POKENAME本性恶劣，只要训练家仍以爱和耐心相待，就能得到它永不消逝的依恋，而那颗珠子正是这份心意的体现。每当训练家陷入消极的念头，它就会轻轻用珠子贴住对方，带来喜悦。
author: beatdoof
source: Trainers who treat POKENAME with love and patience despite its malicious nature are rewarded with undying affection, manifested by its orb. Whenever its Trainer is having negative thoughts, it will gently press its orb against them to bring them joy.

entry: 它与一些推测振翼发会如何适应环境的科学绘图诡异地相似。行动和尖叫声几乎与恐龙无异，但POKENAME偶尔会露出破绽，低声念咒，而非发出咆哮。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: It is eerily similar to some scientific drawings that speculate how Flutter Mane would've adapted. They act and screech almost like a dinosaur, but POKENAME will sometimes let their mask slip and mutter curses instead of snarls.

entry: POKENAME飞过夜空时，会用喙发出近似人声的声音。有人说，那听起来像在念咒，让它的夜间飞行更加神秘。
author: .izik
source: While flying through the night sky, POKENAME makes human-like noises from its beak. Some say the vocalizations sound like incantations, adding to the mystery of its nocturnal flights.

entry: POKENAME极力保护口袋里的宝石，会花上数小时仔细端详。传说，任何偷走宝石的人，都会遭受长达100年的可怕厄运。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is extremely protective of the gem in its pouch and spends hours carefully studying it. According to legend, anyone who steals the gem will be cursed with terrible misfortune for 100 years.

entry: 野外遇见POKENAME，预示着灾祸。可被收服后，POKENAME又能用敏锐的感官，保护训练家远离危险。
author: sandguything
source: Encountering a POKENAME in the wild forebodes certain calamity. Captured POKENAME utilize their senses to keep their Trainer out of harm's way.

entry: POKENAME总是带着一个袋子，索要糖果和甜食当作贡品。不肯照办的，就会被它的舌头舔到，中了各式各样的怪异诅咒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries around a sack at all times, demanding others tribute candies and sweets to it. Those that don't comply will by licked, its tongue inflicting all manner of strange curses and hexes on the victim.

entry: POKENAME熟练地将黑暗魔法与体内电力结合。被逼到极限时，雷电便会黑如夜色。
author: maugre
source: POKENAME has mastered the art of combining dark magic with its body's electricity. When pushed to the limit, its thunder bolts become black as night.

entry: POKENAME用魔力冲击制服猎物，再挥着阴影般的翅膀俯冲吸血。若以极大的敬意和稀有树果相待，就能说服它用毒液配制药剂，制成强效良药。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME incapacitates prey with magic blasts, then swoops in on shadowy wings to suck their blood. If treated with great respect and rare berries, it can be persuaded to use its venom in concoctions that are potent cures.

entry: POKENAME长牙中宝石般的象牙，深受富人和神秘学收藏家的觊觎。所有触碰它的人，都会被诅咒，最终横死。
author: princessmadelyn
source: The gem-like ivory of POKENAME's tusks is highly coveted by the wealthy and collectors of the occult. All who touch them are cursed to have a violent death.

entry: 神秘的POKENAME机敏聪慧，有时会加入其他野生宝可梦的群体，赶走不速之客。它的魔力一击，会令敌人迟钝，让附近的科技设备失灵。威胁一过，它便消失无踪。
author: bobosmith01
source: Swift-thinking and clever, the enigmatic POKENAME may join groups of other wild Pokémon to drive out unwanted intruders. A blast from their magic leaves foes feeling sluggish and any nearby tech disabled. After the threat has passed, they disappear.

entry: 古老森林的深处，可以找到POKENAME。人们观察到，它们从倒下的树木中汲取能量，归还土壤，让新的生命从地里萌发。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found deep in old-growth forests. They have been observed drawing energy from fallen trees, returning that energy to the soil, and causing new life to sprout from the ground.

entry: POKENAME生性顽皮，光是用喙戳戳、拉拉东西，就能让它乐在其中。睡觉时，它的喙会吐出奇异的雾气，每隔片刻便变换颜色。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is mischievous in personality and gets great enjoyment out of simply poking and tugging on things with its beak. When it sleeps, it emits a strange mist that shifts in color every few moments from its beak.

entry: POKENAME很为自己的帽子骄傲，哪怕只是心里嫌弃它，也会惹得它大怒。它常站在月亮前，让自己显得更大，可大多数训练家只觉得它可爱。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME is quite proud of its hat, to the point that any thoughts insulting it send it into a rage. It often stands in front of the moon to make itself look larger, but most Trainers find it endearing.

entry: POKENAME成群聚集时，会以超能力升空，放出数英里外也能听见的奇异之光。每次攻击前，它们都会吟唱咒语，让敌人沉沉然无法行动。
author: ghostslythe
source: When gathered together as a group, POKENAME take flight using their psychic powers, emitting Confuse Rays that can be heard for miles.  Before each attack, they sing incantations to lull their foes into inaction.

entry: 每位黑魔法大师都有弟子。受到威胁时，POKENAME会召唤逝去伙伴的力量，释放一波波强大的黑魔法。
author: bottomusmaximus3
source: Every master of the dark arts has a disciple. POKENAME calls on the power of its fallen allies to unleash powerful waves of dark magic when threatened.

entry: 每位黑魔法大师都有弟子。受到威胁时，POKENAME会召唤逝去伙伴的力量，释放一波波强大的黑魔法。
author: bottomusmaximus3
source: Every master of the dark arts has a disciple. POKENAME calls on the power of its fallen allies to unleash powerful waves of dark magic when threatened.

entry: POKENAME将纯粹的魔力与幽灵能量压缩成旋转的团块，托在身前。光球爆裂时，释放出的能量会让100英尺内的一切生灵突然恐惧至极，动弹不得。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME compresses pure magical and ghostly energy into a swirling mass held in front of it. When this orb bursts, the energy released causes any being within 100 feet to be paralyzed with a sudden surge of absolute terror.

entry: POKENAME十分依恋训练家，不愿与别人分享对方的陪伴。任何过于接近训练家的人，都会厄运缠身、意外不断，随后往往还能听见远处传来顽皮的笑声。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME grows quite attached to its Trainer, and dislikes sharing their company. Those who get too close to the Trainer find themselves beset with misfortune and mishaps, usually followed by the sound of distant and mischievous laughter.

entry: 排列在它们手臂上的红色结晶宛如刀刃，闪烁着内里流动的神秘能量。被刀刃划伤者，伤口哪怕再小，也会厄运不断，直到痊愈为止。
author: infinex21
source: The red crystals lining their arms like blades glimmer with the mystic energies flowing within. Those cut by their blades, however small the cut may be, will be afflicted with misfortune until the cut heals.

entry: POKENAME游历世界，寻找值得一战的对手。它将脸藏在宽大的帽子底下，据传，看见它的眼睛是死亡的预兆。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME wander the world, seeking to find an opponent worthy of a duel. They conceal their face beneath their large hat, and reports say that looking into POKENAME's eyes is an omen of death.

entry: POKENAME将波导与幽灵之力结合，编织出强力咒术，使人迷惑不解。它擅长在战斗中干扰对手的波导，让对方虚弱、失去方向。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME combines its aura with ghostly powers to create powerful hexes meant to confuse and befuddle. One of its battle specialties is to affect the aura of its opponent, causing weakness and disorientation.

entry: 据说，POKENAME背上的汤，能溶掉扔进去的一切肉食。若配料得当，还能召出幽魂，替它办事。
author: doodledoo
source: It is said that the stew POKENAME carries on its back is able to dissolve all meat that's thrown into it. With the right ingredients, it's able to conjure ghostly apparitions that carry out its deeds.

entry: POKENAME头上的甲片刻着神秘符号。使出特殊招式前，符号会按特定的规律发光。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's head plate is engraved with mystical symbols. Before it uses a special move, the symbols will glow in a specific pattern.

entry: 盾牌般的脸，护住它诵念咒语、折磨来犯者。可后方防守薄弱，最终导致它灭绝。
author: darkweavile428
source: Its shield-like face protects it while it chants incantations to torment its attacker. A weakness to attacks from behind lead to its extinction.

entry: 自古以来，它们便深受灵异迷和占卜师的喜爱。它们的预言被认为十分准确，人们正研究如何用它们预测自然灾害。
author: ocxin
source: They have been favourites among hex maniacs and fortune tellers since ancient times. Their forecasts are considered highly accurate, with research being done to use them for predicting natural desasters.

entry: 古老传说中，POKENAME与灵界直接相通，四处猎取命不久矣之人的灵魂。它能用腹部的嘴吸走猎物的能量。
author: heal_fire
source: Ancient legends say that POKENAME are in direct contact with the world of spirits and that they are hunting for the souls of people who are meant to die soon. POKENAME can drain the energy of their prey through the mouth on their belly.

entry: 古代女巫会在住所四周刻下咒文，向POKENAME致敬。她们将其奉为魔法与仪式的神圣守护者。
author: .izik
source: Ancient witches honored POKENAME by carving hexes around their dwellings. They revered it as a divine patron of magic and ritual.

entry: 秋天，POKENAME在地下冬眠时，幽灵属性宝可梦会出现在附近。待它结束冬眠，这些宝可梦便会成为它的伙伴。
author: hophoppip
source: When POKENAME hibernates underground in the fall, Ghost-type Pokémon appear near its location. When it has finished hibernating, the Ghost-types become its allies.

entry: POKENAME独居于沼泽。每年冬天，它们都会聚会一次，交换找到的小饰品和其他稀奇古怪的东西。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME live solitary lives in marshes. Once every winter, POKENAME congregate to exchange trinkets and other curious objects they have found.

entry: POKENAME从学徒成长为师父，开始教导同族。各群POKENAME与各自的徒弟，会为争夺高下而较量。
author: awiralonprime
source: Having gone from student to master, POKENAME teaches its brethren. Groups of POKENAME and their apprentices compete for superiority.

entry: POKENAME会神秘地出现在旧帐篷里，据说占卜十分灵验。有人看过自己的占卜结果后，竟然失去了意识。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME mysteriously appears in old tents and is rumored to give accurate fortunes. People have been reported to lose consciousness when they see their fortune.

entry: 沉思时，POKENAME会转动触角，仿佛女巫在搅动大锅。因此，人们编出许多关于它施咒的传说，称它为“巫术少女”。
author: .izik
source: When deep in thought, POKENAME rotates its feelers much like a witch churning a cauldron. Because of this, many have created folklore about it casting curses, calling it the Maiden of the Craft.

entry: POKENAME令许多水手畏惧，常被称为“风暴之海的女巫”。它阴森的叫声能唤来巨浪，足以掀翻任何船只。
author: mepp.
source: Feared by many sailors, POKENAME is commonly referred to as the "Sorceress of Stormy Seas." Its eerie cries can summon massive waves that are capable of capsizing any ship.

entry: POKENAME的外表常让人望而生畏，实际上，它只是一种非常孤独的宝可梦。它渴望陪伴，愿意和任何肯陪自己的伙伴玩耍，但会瞬间将恶人打飞。
author: infinex21
source: Although the appearance of POKENAME is often considered to be very intimidating, it is actually just a very lonely Pokémon. It seeks companionship and will play with all who are willing, but will send evildoers flying in an instant.

entry: 寓言中，红色幽火是死于POKENAME魔法之人的灵魂。研究却证明，那其实只是它用来照亮四周的火焰。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Fables describe the red wisps as the spirits of those who succumbed to the magic of POKENAME. Research has proven that they are actually just fire that POKENAME uses to light its surroundings.

entry: 古老的神秘学记载中，POKENAME的形象宛如恶魔。据故事所述，一旦召来它，整个地区便会笼罩在受诅咒的雷暴之中，人心也会被扭向邪恶。
author: sk372
source: Old occult records depict POKENAME as a fiendish figure. According to the tales, if summoned it would create a cursed thunderstorm across the region, twisting people's hearts towards malevolence.

entry: POKENAME的玫瑰飘出摄人心魄的香气，削弱敌人的斗志。待对方屈服，它便用带刺的藤蔓和致命毒素发起骇人的猛攻。
author: mepp.
source: The bewitching aroma that wafts from POKENAME's roses weakens any foe's will to fight. Once subdued, POKENAME unleashes a frightening assault with its thorny vines and fatal toxins.

entry: 夜里，这种宝可梦低声念咒，在空中游荡。受害者会染上日益恶化的疾病，而它会留下凋腐的花瓣，作为到此一游的标记。
author: violet_zero
source: At night, this Pokémon sails through the sky with hexes that it speaks in murmurs. Its victims are subjected to illnesses that worsen over time, with decaying petals left behind as a calling card.

entry: POKENAME向将不久于世的人撒下迷人的闪粉。有人说，这能驱邪，赐人临终的祝福；也有人说，这不过是加速死亡的诅咒。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME scatters an enchanting glitter upon those who will soon pass away. Some say this glitter wards off evil and blesses people in their final moments, while others say it is a curse that only expedites one's demise.

entry: 它面带讥笑，低声咒骂，先将敌人激得怒火中烧，再打出看不见的拳头。这种宝可梦会欺骗所有人，唯独训练家除外。
author: violet_zero
source: With its mocking visage and murmured invectives spoken under its breath, it sends foes into a fury before striking with unseen punches. This Pokémon is deceptive to all except its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME兴冲冲地乘风而行，遇到哪个倒霉的农民，就偷走对方的庄稼。夜里，它们会熬制复杂的药水，据一些人说，喝下便能看见预示未来的幻象。
author: turron_turron
source: POKENAME eagerly ride gusts of wind, stealing crops from whatever unlucky farmers they come across. During the night, POKENAME brew elaborate potions that, according to some, will induce prophetic visions in those who consume them.

entry: 古籍记载，古代女巫曾将POKENAME摆在符文周围，借助它诡异的火焰增强咒术或坚固灵魂。人们相信，这些火焰具有神秘的力量。
author: .izik
source: Old texts state that ancient witches once used placed POKENAME around their glyphs, relying on their eerie flames to empower spells or fortify one's soul. The flames were believed to hold mystical properties.

entry: 深夜，POKENAME会来到醉心黑魔法的人面前。它们骗来的灵魂，被酿成神秘药液，供火焰燃烧。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME appear late at night in front of those interested in dark magic. Their flames are powered by a mystical brew of the souls they've deceived.

entry: POKENAME住在废弃建筑里，布匹般的身体下方传来幽幽低语。那声音仿佛咒语，更添几分闹鬼的气氛。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its home in abandoned buildings, where eerie whispers come from below its cloth-like body. The whispers sound like incantations, adding to the haunting atmosphere.

entry: POKENAME的几个小头负责念咒，由中央的大头发动攻击。研究者发现，只有小头拥有大脑，中央的头由它们控制。
author: cobalt0135
source: The smaller heads of POKENAME are used to chant incantations for the larger middle head to unleash their attacks. Researchers have discovered that only the smaller heads have brains and that they control the central head.

entry: 据说，九位灵异迷的灵魂合在一起，便成了POKENAME。它的目光能使人动弹不得，叫声则像唤来火焰攻击的咒语。
author: ghostslythe
source: It is said the souls of nine Hex Maniacs combined to make POKENAME. While its gaze paralyzes, this Pokémon's cries sound like incantations summoning its flaming attacks.

entry: POKENAME用牙齿在木头上刻下神秘符印，制成凝聚魔力的媒介。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME creates a focus for its magical powers by carving mystical sigils into wood with its teeth.

entry: 使出强力电击前，POKENAME会按古怪的轨迹摆动尾巴，念出近似人话的声音。那些词句不知所云，却似乎能引导奇异的能量。
author: .izik
source: Before using a strong electric attack, POKENAME moves its tail in an odd pattern while chanting something that sounds almost human. The words make no sense, but they seem to channel strange energy.

entry: POKENAME盯上悲痛的家庭，在他们试图与逝者沟通时吸走能量。虽然这一现象广为人知，人们仍会为了抚慰破碎的心而寻求它的帮助。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME preys on grieving families, siphoning their energy while they try to communicate with the dead. Despite being a well-known phenomenon, POKENAME is sought after in an attempt to ease broken hearts.

entry: 无需人类干预，POKENAME便会拖动通灵板上的指示片，由此传出死者能够与人交流的说法。至于它对悲痛的家庭究竟仁慈还是残酷，众说纷纭。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME drags its planchette across its spirit board without human intervention, leading to rumors that the dead can communicate. There are conflicting messages on whether it is kind or cruel to grieving families.

entry: 远看容易被认作灵异迷的POKENAME，最爱惹是生非。它们会干扰电信号，打断手机通话。遭到质问时，便卷起耳朵，拍打威胁自己的对象。
author: ghostslythe
source: Mistaken as Hex Maniacs from a distance, POKENAME enjoy causing mischief. Their presence disrupts electrical signals and interrupts cell phone calls. When confronted, they curl their ears before slapping the threat.

entry: 为了躲避捕食者，POKENAME常成群睡在一起，伪装成一簇簇蘑菇。受到威胁时，它会释放带有魔力的孢子，使旁人产生幻觉。
author: distinguishedmanlygentleman
source: To hide from predators, packs of POKENAME often sleep together to disguise themselves as clusters of mushrooms. When threatened, POKENAME releases magical spores which have hallucinogenic effects on others.

entry: POKENAME吓人时，嘴似乎能张到2英尺宽。科学家最近证实，这其实是幻象，巨口不过是用来威吓猎物的视觉骗局。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's mouth seems to open up to 2 feet wide when it is trying to scare someone. This has recently been proven to be an illusion by scientists, as the mouth's size is a visual trick to intimidate its prey.

entry: POKENAME飘游于废弃墓穴，吓唬考古学家。它将引发的恐惧储存在随身携带的大宝石里，使宝石成了奇异而令人不安的能量之源。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats through abandoned tombs to scare archaeologists. The fear it generates is stored within the large gem it carries, making the gem a source of strange and unsettling energy.

entry: POKENAME漫步在月照的树林中，声音幽幽回荡，令所有听见的人心生恐惧。
author: mepp.
source: The sound of POKENAME's voice echoes eerily as it wanders moonlit woods. This sound frightens all who hear it.

entry: POKENAME找到什么魔法用品就吃什么，用以补充施咒的能量：水晶、熔化的蜡烛、神秘的药草、积满灰尘的魔法书，等等。
author: hophoppip
source: To fuel the spells it casts, POKENAME consumes whatever magic supplies it can find: crystals, melted candles, mystical herbs, dusty spell books, and the like.

entry: POKENAME飘浮在城市垃圾场上方，寻找被丢弃的毛绒玩具。找到后，它便附身其中，蹒跚走动，低声吟唱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats above city dumps searching for discarded plush toys. When it finds one, it possesses the body and shambles around while chanting softly.

entry: POKENAME用细长的腿撑高身体，吓退较小的生物。它的蘑菇散播孢子，吸入者会感到强烈的恐惧与焦虑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME raises itself up on spindly legs to scare off smaller creatures. Its mushrooms spread spores that, when inhaled, cause the victim to experience strong feelings of fear and anxiety.

entry: POKENAME对训练家的忠诚，几乎到了让人头疼的程度。只要觉得有人辱骂或欺负了训练家，它便会不顾训练家的意愿，对那人施下诅咒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite loyal to its Trainer, to an almost problematic degree. If it thinks someone has insulted or bullied its Trainer, it casts hexes on the perpetrator, regardless of its Trainer's desires.

entry: 初学灵异之术的灵异迷，有个忠诚伙伴，就是POKENAME。它爱帮忙寻觅大锅药液的配料，自己施起法，也毫不逊色。
author: nellnast42
source: A loyal Pokémon from budding Hex Maniacs. POKENAME loves to fetch ingredients for a cauldron's brew, but is more than capable of spellcasting for itself.

entry: POKENAME的尖叫宛如异界咒语，鬃毛中的岩石令其更为刺耳、回声不绝，使敌人深受惊吓。它以满身锋利的爪、牙和岩石消磨对手，再给予最后一击。
author: kinsgs
source: POKENAME's screams sound like otherworldly incantations, with rocks in its mane giving them a harsh, echoed edge that traumatizes its foes. Its array of razor-sharp claws, teeth, and rocks wears the foe down before it finishes them off.

entry: POKENAME用鬃毛中闪亮的石头诅咒敌人，使对方每次碰到自己的皮肤都会感到剧痛。脖子上多余不用的石头，则会赠给信任的训练家，作为抵御咒术的护符。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses the shiny rocks in its mane to cast curses onto foes, causing them sharp pain whenever they touch their own skin. Any spare stone from its neck that it does not need is gifted to a Trainer it trusts as a protective charm against spells.

entry: POKENAME长时间在墓园中舞蹈，散发出令人本能地想远离的气息。有人形容，那感觉像同时闻到、尝到极其难闻难吃的东西。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dances for long periods in graveyards, giving off an aura that makes humans instinctively want to stay away. Some describe the feeling as simultaneously smelling and tasting something terrible.

entry: POKENAME在傍晚飘浮于墓地上空，寻找悲伤的人。它向对方撒下孢子，使其安然入睡，再拖走进食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats above cemeteries in the early evening in search of those who are grieving. It scatters spores on them to lull them into a comforting sleep before dragging them away to feed.

entry: 黑光一闪，它便能以锋利的爪子一边劈斩，一边对目标施咒。偶尔有航海者雇用POKENAME，在暴风雨中的航程里驱灾避祸。
author: silverscloudy
source: In a flash of black light, it can simultaneously cleave and curse anything with its incisive claws. Rarely, POKENAME are employed by seafarers to ward off disaster and misfortune during their passage under stormy weather.

entry: POKENAME兼具体魄与魔力。它能施咒使敌人晕头转向；若施法无效，强壮的双臂便是后手。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME strikes a balance between physical and magical prowess. It can cast disorienting spells on its enemies, but when spellcasting proves ineffective, its strong arms serve as backup.

entry: POKENAME仍在学习，如何妥善应对战斗中的新情况。它喜欢可预料的对战，只用那几套熟悉的战术，就能赢得胜利。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is still learning how to best approach novel situations in battle. It enjoys predictable fights where it can use the same few tactics to win.

entry: POKENAME训练一丝不苟，几乎从不偏离训练家定下的计划。但有时也会因为计划外的意外转折，输掉战斗。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is fastidious in its training and never deviates far from the plans its Trainer sets for it. Sometimes it loses battles because of an unexpected twist that was not accounted for.

entry: 许多野生POKENAME会组成被称作“学校”的群体，一同练习强大的本领。它们好学又好奇，却偏偏经常惹出麻烦。
author: cobalt0135
source: Many wild POKENAME spend their time practicing their powerful abilities in groups called "schools". They are very studious and curious Pokémon that happen to get themselves into mischief very often.

entry: POKENAME住在老房子的墙壁里，通常被视为讨厌的家伙。它会破坏电子设备，当面嘲弄屋主，再穿过地板溜走。
author: ghostslythe
source: Generally considered a nuisance, POKENAME lives in the walls of older houses. It sabotages electronic devices and taunts the owners face-to-face before phasing through the floor.

entry: POKENAME说着仿佛咒语般令人毛骨悚然的话语，身体不断涌出热蒸汽。蒸汽常会变成它所猎食之物的模样。
author: .izik
source: Hot vapor streams from POKENAME's body as it speaks in a haunting, curse-like tongue. The steam regularly takes shapes resembling prey it hunts.

entry: POKENAME耍弄人时，总带着顽皮的狡黠。它的把戏很少出于恶意，却也可能让有些人招架不住。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a playful guile that it uses whenever it performs a trick on people. The tricks it performs are seldom malicious but may be overwhelming for some people.

entry: POKENAME随身带着据说拥有魔力的宝石，用足以踢碎混凝土的强力踢击守护它们。
author: erod0467
source: POKENAME carries around gemstones that are said to have magical properties. They protect these gems using powerful kicks that can shatter concrete.

entry: POKENAME摇晃身体，唱起萦绕不散的旋律，毛皮上的宝石也随之作响。它们夜行寻找疲惫的旅人，邀其起舞，跳散烦忧。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME shake their bodies back and forth while singing haunting melodies, the gems along their fur rattling along to the tunes. They travel through the night to find weary travelers and encourage them to dance their worries away.

entry: 据说，POKENAME从群星间坠落，寻找编织奇异咒术的地方。它们会唤出令人迷乱的光，捉弄旅人来练习魔法，再消失于阴影之中。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME are said to have tumbled from the stars in search of a place to weave their strange spells. They practice these enchantments by conjuring disorienting lights to tease travelers before vanishing into the shadows.

entry: 这种宝可梦因在一出经典戏剧中的著名角色，深受戏剧界喜爱：它曾同时扮演三位女巫，由其他演员替它念台词。有人相信，故事中POKENAME施展的黑魔法，并非全是虚构。
author: deadshields
source: This Pokémon is well liked by those in theatre for its famed role in a classic play where one played three witches simultaneously as other actors voiced its lines. Some believe the dark magic cast by POKENAME in that story isn't entirely fictional.

entry: 有些说法认为，POKENAME会从市场偷走生命宝珠，增强自己的招式威力。它在树林里徘徊，最爱吓唬没察觉到它的人。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to some beliefs, POKENAME steals Life Orbs from markets to boost the power of its moves. It wanders through the woods, delighting in scaring humans who fail to notice its presence.

entry: 民间传说中，POKENAME是邪恶女巫最青睐的伙伴。它虽爱囤积闪亮物品，那份高傲的优雅却在华丽大赛中很受欢迎。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: Folklore describes POKENAME as the companion of choice for evil witches. While POKENAME tends to hoard shiny objects, its proud elegance is very popular in Pokémon Contests.

entry: POKENAME靠让附近的人头痛、吸食其不适感来维持生命。若无人可供折磨，它的形体便会开始崩坏，滴落成浓稠的黑色黏液。仔细聆听黏液，能听见永不止息的惨叫。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is kept alive by causing headaches in those nearby, feeding off the discomfort. If there is no one to torment, its form begins to deteriorate, dripping as thick, black goo. Listening carefully to the goo, one can hear eternal screams.

entry: 人们相信，POKENAME凭强大的头脑记住了超过1000种诅咒。据说，它携带的水晶中寄宿着部分灵魂，即使肉体衰亡，心智也能长存。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's powerful mind is believed to have memorized over 1000 different curses. The crystal it carries is said to house part of its soul, ensuring that even if its body failed, its mind would live on.

entry: POKENAME的蹄声以古怪的节奏回荡在夜里，仿佛古老的吟诵。训练家若想骑上野生的POKENAME，便会被缎带和烟雾缠住，带往夜色深处。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The trotting of POKENAME's hooves echoes through the night in odd cadences that seem to resemble ancient chants. If a Trainer attempts to ride atop a wild POKENAME, they will be wrapped in ribbons and smog and then carried off into the night.

entry: 据说POKENAME是受不幸吸引而来的灵体。虽然灾祸并非它们所致，这份恶名仍让人类不愿亲近。
author: sandguything
source: POKENAME are said to be spirits that are attracted to misfortune. While not the direct cause, that stigma makes them not very loved by humans.

entry: 梦磁怪会被严重的不幸事件吸引，聚在一起，融合成POKENAME。仍戴着帽子的那只，就是最先赶到现场的个体。
author: sandguything
source: Mismites are attracted to larger cases of misfortune, merging together to become POKENAME. The one keeping its hat was the first to the scene.

entry: POKENAME用妄想和幻觉迷惑驶入领地的水手。中招者常会变得莽撞蛮横，但离开它的领地后，魔力便会消退。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enchants sailors that enter its territory with delusions and hallucinations. Afflicted sailors often act brash and bullish, but the enchantment fades once they leave its domain.

entry: POKENAME沿河岸与草地寻找各种药草，将它们收集起来，放进壳里。它在壳中熬出药效强烈的混合物，人们曾以为那是魔法药水。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME search through river banks and meadows for various herbs, gathering the plants together and storing them in their shells. They brew the ingredients into a potent mixture within their shells that were once thought to be magical potions.

entry: POKENAME飘浮在墓地附近，咕哝着仿佛吟唱的话语。词句虽然听不懂，诡异的共鸣却让空气中仿佛弥漫着浓重的不安力量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats near burial sites, mumbling something that sounds like chanting. The words are unintelligible, but their eerie resonance makes the air feel thick with an unsettling energy.

entry: 一群POKENAME被称作一个“巫会”。它们合力恐吓同一个目标，以其恐惧为食，再趁尚未被察觉，瞬间消失。
author: reflecbeat
source: A group of POKENAME is called a coven. They gang up to terrorise a single target, feed on its fear, and then vanish in an instant before they are noticed.

entry: POKENAME的魔力足以让整座城镇入睡，任它从众多梦境中挑选想吃的梦。它吃梦时不够小心，有时会连带着相关的记忆一起吞掉。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has enough magical power to force entire towns to fall asleep, allowing it to pick the dreams it wants to devour from a wide spread. It is not careful when it eats dreams, and may take associated memories with the dream.

entry: 献上树果作为礼物，尤其是佛柑果或刺耳果，就能说服POKENAME用宝石摆锤施展守护睡眠的咒术。它吃梦时，胡须般的毛发会随梦境的欢愉或悲伤，变亮或变暗。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME can be persuaded to cast protective sleep spells with its gem pendulum by offering it gifts of Berries, especially Kasib or Colbur Berries. When it feeds on dreams, its beard-fur darkens or brightens based on how happy or sad the dream was.

entry: POKENAME头骨顶端长出的黑羽，形成帽子般的轮廓。这丛羽冠随年龄增长，最后能与身体一样大。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME grows black feathers atop its skull that form a hat-like shape. This crest expands with age and can become as large as its own body.

entry: POKENAME夜里徘徊于城市街道，用骨头轻敲地面，警告惹事者自己就在附近。骨杖一挥，便能号令成群的黑暗鸦扑向目标。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stalks urban streets at night, tapping its bone against the ground to warn troublemakers of its presence. With a wave of its bone staff, it can command flocks of Murkrow to swarm its target.

entry: POKENAME常游荡在曾发生重大惨剧的老建筑中。若遭打扰，便手持骨制刺剑，攻击闯入者。
author: inksans201x
source: POKENAME is said to often roam old buildings with a history of great tragedy. When disturbed, it attacks trespassers with bone rapiers.

entry: 它专门拉拢狡猾的宝可梦，组成声名不佳的帮派。POKENAME派出爪牙四处劫掠，自己却总躲在幕后。
author: chorb33
source: It is known for forming dubious gangs of particularly devious Pokémon. While it sends its stooges on raids, POKENAME always stays in the background.

entry: 它专门拉拢狡猾的宝可梦，组成声名不佳的帮派。POKENAME派出爪牙四处劫掠，自己却总躲在幕后。
author: chorb33
source: It is known for forming dubious gangs of particularly devious Pokémon. While it sends its stooges on raids, POKENAME always stays in the background.

entry: 它专门拉拢狡猾的宝可梦，组成声名不佳的帮派。POKENAME派出爪牙四处劫掠，自己却总躲在幕后。
author: chorb33
source: It is known for forming dubious gangs of particularly devious Pokémon. While it sends its stooges on raids, POKENAME always stays in the background.

entry: 野生POKENAME会试着教其他宝可梦表演哑剧，再招募它们组成演艺团。可它们管教太严，不是受欢迎的老师，大多学生很快便会离开。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME will attempt to teach other Pokémon to mime, then recruit them to form a troupe of entertainers. Their harsh discipline makes them unpopular teachers, and most of their pupils quickly abandon them.

entry: POKENAME在昏暗的光线下，为轻易看得入迷的观众表演精彩的幻术、哑剧和其他奇技。与此同时，黑暗人偶正偷走观众身上未收好的贵重物品。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME performs impressive displays of illusions, pantomiming, and other fantastic powers in dim lighting in front of any audience foolish enough to be engrossed. During this time, Murmime are stealing any loose valuables the audience might have.

entry: POKENAME在昏暗的光线下，为轻易看得入迷的观众表演精彩的幻术、哑剧和其他奇技。与此同时，黑暗人偶正偷走观众身上未收好的贵重物品。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME performs impressive displays of illusions, pantomiming, and other fantastic powers in dim lighting in front of any audience foolish enough to be engrossed. During this time, Murmime are stealing any loose valuables the audience might have.

entry: 这是聪明又善于操纵情绪的融合体，就连毫无亲缘的黑暗鸦，也禁不住它的假哭。它扮演着严厉而要求苛刻的女家长角色。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is an intelligent fusion with a penchant for emotional manipulation: even unrelated Murkrow cannot help but be swayed by its Fake Tears. It acts as a strict and demanding matriarchal figure.

entry: POKENAME用尖锐的爪子迅速划击敌人。每逢欺负其他宝可梦、抢夺食物，这些利爪便让它们占尽上风。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME use their sharp talons to quickly slash at foes. These talons give them an advantage whenever they bully other Pokémon for food.

entry: POKENAME对鸟类宝可梦怀有深仇。它悄悄靠近，用角刺伤对方，角上的毒液对鸟类尤其有效。看着对方痛苦挣扎后，它才匆匆跑开。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a strong vendetta against avian Pokémon. It sneaks up on them and pricks them with its horn, which carries a venom especially effective on them. POKENAME watches them writhe in pain before scurrying away.

entry: POKENAME出现在电脑上，声称可替使用者隐藏、加密数据，提供保护，实际上却是骗局。它打算将数据据为己有，带走从信息中搜出的任何值钱之物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears on computers offering to hide and encrypt a user's data to protect them, but the offer is a scam. In reality, it plans to hoard the data and make off with anything valuable it can glean from the information.

entry: POKENAME十分看重胸前的绒羽，因为羽毛的大小与光泽，是族群中地位的象征。它会向打理得体的对象轻点帽檐，表示敬意。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME takes great pride in the fluff on its chest, as the size and gloss of it is a sign of status among its kind. POKENAME tips its hat as a sign of respect towards proper grooming.

entry: 人们为了美丽的羽毛四处寻找这种宝可梦，使它渐渐疏远人类。若有人真的找到POKENAME，它便会毫不犹豫地攻击，以求自保。
author: gtrwya
source: This Pokémon is sought out for its beautiful feathers, causing it to become distant from humans. If one manages to find POKENAME, it will attack without hesitation to protect itself.

entry: POKENAME警觉性很高，会与警方调查员合作，追踪越狱的人。它们睡眠时间短，能长时间在外循味追查，直到找到罪犯。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are vigilant creatures that work together with police investigators to track down people who escape from prisons. Their short sleep schedule allows them to remain in the field for long hours following a scent trail until criminals are found.

entry: POKENAME的神秘力量，总让它不由自主地成为附近众人的焦点。它无法控制地勾起旁人的关注、服从与好奇之心。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can't help but be the center of attention of those nearby due to its mysterious powers. It uncontrollably invokes the urges of attentiveness, obedience, and general interest in those nearby.

entry: 一小群研究者声称，POKENAME能演出复杂精巧的歌舞。这些说法仍无证据，提出说法的研究者也被斥为江湖骗子。
author: fancyskunk
source: A small group of researchers have claimed that POKENAME can perform elaborate song and dance routines. These claims remain unsubstantiated, and the researchers who made them have been dismissed as quacks.

entry: POKENAME聚成大群，摘光附近所有的莲蒲果。只要发现格斗属性的捕食者，它们就会吃下收集的树果，迎击威胁。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gather into hordes and pick every Chople Berry in the nearby vicinity. Whenever they spot a Fighting-type predator, they chew down the gathered berries and attack the threat.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME最爱使出飞行属性招式，向同住的其他乌波融合体炫耀。除此之外，它大部分时间都待在地上，试图指使旁人。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When fighting, POKENAME loves to perform Flying moves, using them to show off to the other Wooper fusions it lives with. Apart from this, it spends most of its time on the ground, trying to order around others.

entry: 野生POKENAME身边通常跟着许多乌波和黑暗鸦。它们似乎完全没留意追随者的种种帮忙，可它们越是不理睬，追随者便越卖力地讨好。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME are usually accompanied by numerous Wooper and Murkrow. POKENAME seem to be completely oblivious to their followers' attempts to help them, but the more they ignore them, the harder they try to please POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME以利用超能力让其他宝可梦闯祸、自己却装作无辜而闻名。这样的诡计，常招来队友的恼怒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are known to use their psychic powers to get other Pokémon into trouble while making themselves seem innocent. They often earn the ire of their teammates because of these deceptive ploys.

entry: 它个头虽小，手段却冷酷狠辣。它靠强权登上黑暗鸦帮派首领之位，策划协同盗窃，还逼手下将部分赃物上缴。
author: sk372
source: Its small size belies a very ruthless and cutthroat demeanor. It strong-arms its way to becoming a leader of Murkrow gangs, arranging coordinated heists and forcing its peons to forfeit a fraction of their ill-gotten gains to it.

entry: 城市里的小拉达数量失控时，防治人员便会放出受过训练的POKENAME。待它们控制住这些鼠类宝可梦群，防治人员就能将鼠群迁走。
author: wiz0z
source: When populations of Rattata grow out of control in urban areas, pest control release trained POKENAME into city. POKENAME eventually gain control over the packs of rodent Pokémon, allowing pest control to relocate them.

entry: POKENAME徘徊于古老的图书馆，保护卷轴和泥石板不受损坏。传闻它曾与图书馆员共事，不过尚未得到证实。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME roams ancient libraries protecting scrolls and tablets from damage. It is rumored that it once served alongside librarians, but this rumor has yet to be confirmed.

entry: 它们举止潇洒，会偷羽毛装点外衣与帽子。外衣越大，在族群中的权势也越大。
author: mistymagius
source: These suave Pokémon will steal feathers to build out their coat and hat. The larger the coat, the more power they have over their pack.

entry: POKENAME的体力已十分惊人，真正的力量却另有所藏。一个形似乌鸦头头的投影能够显现，凭借种种独特本领助它作战。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's physical strength is already impressive, but its true power lies elsewhere. A projection with the appearance of Honchrow can materialize and aid it in battle with a myriad of unique abilities.

entry: POKENAME号令成群的黑暗鲁比挖掘、找回各种宝石和首饰。它将最闪亮的留给自己，作为权势与智谋的象征，剩下的则任由群中成员争抢。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME command herds of Murdour to dig up and fetch various gems or pieces of jewelry. POKENAME keep the shiniest items and use them as symbols of their power and strategy, letting the rest of the pack fight over the scraps.

entry: POKENAME将自己的奶制成奶酪火锅，分给统领的黑暗鸦及黑暗鸦融合体群。外来者若靠得太近，就会遭到整个群体的猛烈攻击。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME turns its own milk into cheese fondue, which it shares with the flock of Murkrow and Murkrow fusions it rules over. Outsiders will be viciously attacked by the flock if they venture too close.

entry: POKENAME一声啼鸣，便能唤来狂暴的雷雨。据报告，云中可见许多黑暗公，应首领召唤而来。不过，这些宝可梦极其罕见，因此人们认为，黑暗公只是狂乱电流产生的幻象。
author: chibitales
source: A cry from POKENAME summons savage thunderstorms. Reports claim to see many Murkou within the clouds, flocking to their leader's call. Due to the rarity of these Pokémon, however, the Murkou are thought to be illusions created by rampant electricity.

entry: POKENAME格外珍惜尾巴上带着的帽子。要是不小心掉了，或弄坏了，它会哭上好几个小时。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The hat POKENAME carries on its tail is very precious to it. If it is dropped or damaged, POKENAME will cry for hours.

entry: POKENAME阴森的啼鸣模仿着古老的咒语与吟唱。已知长时间听这种声音，会使听者偏头痛、头晕。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's eerie chirps mimic ancient incantations and chants. Prolonged exposure has been known to cause migraines and dizziness in listeners.

entry: POKENAME虽然结群狩猎，却从不与其他同类合作。它招揽大群较弱的宝可梦，谁显得快要变得太强，就将谁逐出，确保自己始终掌权。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME hunt in packs, but never work with other POKENAME. They recruit large groups of weaker Pokémon and will expel any that seem to be becoming too strong, ensuring that POKENAME always remain in charge.

entry: POKENAME悠闲爽朗，常在市区慢悠悠地走动。不过，看见黑暗鸦捣乱，它就会重重敲一下那只惹事家伙的头，以示管教。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a laid-back and jovial personality, often plodding about in urban areas. If it sees Murkrow misbehaving, though, it gives the troublesome bird a disciplinary wallop on the head.

entry: POKENAME爱慕虚荣出了名。找到闪亮的小物件，就会将其编进自己的藤蔓里。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME are notoriously vain Pokémon. If they find a small shiny object they will braid it into their vines.

entry: POKENAME看不起其他所有宝可梦，强迫它们听命。它用带电的利爪划击对方，维持自己的统治。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME views every other Pokémon as lesser, forcing others to do their bidding. They keep their control over others by slashing at them with their electric-powered talons.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，会统领由近缘物种组成的庞大帮派。它被视为城镇的重大威胁，往往要整队训练家出动，才能将其赶走。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME is incredibly territorial, and is known to control massive gangs of species related to it. It is considered a large threat to towns and cities, and usually requires entire groups of trainers to get rid of it.

entry: 来自东部海岸的POKENAME，长尾巴上会生出一簇簇红羽。承受巨大压力时，这些羽毛便会脱落。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME from the eastern coasts grow red feather tufts along their long tails. These feathers molt when the creature is under heavy stress.

entry: POKENAME发出一连串哔哔声，将黑暗鸦吸引过来，再命令它们偷取电子设备，好让自己吞食其中的数据。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lets out a series of beeps that attract Murkrow to its location. It then commands them to steal electronic devices so it can feast on the data inside.

entry: 这种宝可梦现身网络空间，被视为灾难的征兆。它极少出现在留言板，可一旦出现，所有正在活动的用户都会遭遇怪事，甚至可能危及生命。
author: mistathefox
source: This Pokémon is thought of as a sign of calamity when it appears in online spaces. It rarely appears on message boards, but if one appears, any active users will experience strange phenomena that may put their lives at risk.

entry: POKENAME常往收件箱里塞满莫名其妙的优惠与交易信息。它几乎谁的话都不听，总在惹麻烦，似乎唯独愿意听训练家的。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME is often seen spamming inboxes with nonsensical offers and deals. This Pokémon rarely listens to anyone, always causing trouble, but it seemingly makes an exception for its trainer.

entry: POKENAME逼同住一棵树的宝可梦交出部分食物，否则便在同伙协助下，用武力将对方赶走。它用脚爪在树上留下记号，宣示那是自己的家。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME forces the other Pokémon living in its tree to give up part of their food; otherwise, it drives them away with force, aided by its companions. With the claws on its feet, it marks the trees it claims as home.

entry: 这种宝可梦向来深受忍者和恶徒青睐。它们潜行林间，以惊人的精准寻找指定目标，一击将其击倒。
author: ocxin
source: Long favoured by ninjas and crooks, these Pokémon possess an astounding precision as they stalk through forests, seeking out designated targets to fell them in one decisive strike.

entry: POKENAME既喜欢闪亮的东西，也喜欢会发光的东西。一有机会，它们就会用喙叼起烟头，嘲弄随手丢烟的人。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME love shiny things as well as things that glow. When given the chance, POKENAME pick up cigarette butts with their beaks and mock the people who dropped them.

entry: POKENAME群常为找到的赃物争吵。帽上羽毛较大的个体，多半会赢得这类争执。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME commonly get into squabbles about loot found in their flocks. The POKENAME with bigger feathers in their hat win these disputes more often than not.

entry: POKENAME是凶悍的战士，向来选择亲自应战。察觉敌人强得难以独力对付时，它便会放声大叫，召来成群爪牙助阵。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME is a fierce fighter, opting to fight its own battles. When it senses that a foe may be too much to handle on its own, it will let out a loud cry to summon a murder of its cronies to aid in battle.

entry: POKENAME是无情的首领。手下若惹得它不快，就会挨上一记重击，实实在在地被踢出群体。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are ruthless leaders. If one of POKENAME's cronies displeases it, it will be met with a powerful strike, literally and figuratively kicking that Pokémon out of the flock.

entry: POKENAME展开巨翼，长鸣一声，就能从森林各处召来超过100名爪牙。它用强健的双腿高高跃起，再展翅滑翔极远的距离。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Spreading its massive wings and letting out a single cry, POKENAME can summon over 100 of its cronies from any part of the forest. POKENAME can jump great heights with its powerful legs, then sore for mass distances with its wings.

entry: 人们常见POKENAME率领黑暗鸦及其他类似宝可梦，抢偷人和宝可梦的财物。由于有些个体靠武力维持秩序，它们在一些作品中常被塑造成反派。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have often been seen leading flocks of Murkrow and other similar Pokémon to steal from people and Pokémon alike. Because some POKENAME use force to keep their flocks in line, they have been popularly portrayed as villains in some media.

entry: POKENAME诱人而残酷，会在漆黑的夜里哭泣。谁傻到敢去安慰它，便会被黑夜吞没。
author: greatrobotmaster
source: Enticing and cruel, the POKENAME will be seen on dark nights, crying. Any fool who dares try to comfort it will be swallowed by the night.

entry: 神秘而冷淡的POKENAME，身边总有忠诚的黑暗鸦群，随时听候差遣。它若向你轻点帽檐，便表示你赢得了尊重，鸦群也会听从你的命令。
author: sk372
source: Mysterious and aloof, POKENAME is never seen without a loyal flock of Murkrow ready to follow its whims. If one tips its cap to you, you've earned its respect, and the flock will be obedient to you as well.

entry: POKENAME精心照料羽毛，连脱落的羽毛也会收集起来，装饰沉重的木杖，作为施展力量的媒介。由于喜欢偷富人的东西，它们成了节目中受欢迎的角色。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME take great care of their feathers and even gather their own shed feathers to decorate heavy sticks, which they wield as foci for their powers. Due to their penchant for stealing from the wealthy, they have become popular characters in shows.

entry: POKENAME外貌迷人而妖异，轻易就能操纵黑暗鸦听命行事。它让黑暗鸦偷来奢华的小饰物和配件，好把自己打扮得更加美丽。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's beguiling and bewitching appearance makes it easy to manipulate Murkrow to do its bidding. It has them steal luxurious trinkets and accessories so that it may decorate itself to look beautiful.

entry: POKENAME身手出众，还能随心表达特定情绪，是优秀的演员。它们喜欢演打斗场面，因此常在动作片中出镜。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are great actors because of their superb athleticism and ability to express certain emotions on command. They are often featured in action films because they love acting in fight scenes.

entry: POKENAME的存在，会催眠附近的黑暗鸦。新收的仆从向它献上数不清的闪亮小玩意，盼它为答谢礼物，肯在自己面前现身。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's presence has a hypnotic effect on Murkrow in the area. Its new thralls will bring it countless shiny baubles as offerings in the hope that it will manifest itself before them as thanks for their gifts.

entry: POKENAME总能凭借彼此波导纽带的强弱，察知黑暗鸦群的忠诚。这种联系一旦断裂，就表示那只黑暗鸦辜负了信任，必须受到处置。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can always detect the loyalty of its Murkrow flock by the strength of their aura bonds with it. When this connection is broken, it means the Murkrow has betrayed POKENAME's trust and must be dealt with.

entry: POKENAME欺压小型宝可梦，尤其是黑暗鸦，逼它们听命、替自己觅食。不肯服从的，就会被它的尖牙狠狠咬上一口。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME bullies smaller Pokémon, particularly Murkrow, into doing its bidding and gathering food for it. Those who resist its demands find themselves on the receiving end of a nasty bite from its sharp teeth.

entry: POKENAME性格恶劣又自以为是，会将其他宝可梦赶出自己认定属于自己的森林。它们身边总跟着一群黑暗鸦，协助驱逐领地内的其他宝可梦。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are known for their nasty, presumptuous personalities, forcing other Pokémon out of forests they deem their own. A flock of Murkrow always accompany POKENAME, helping them drive out other Pokémon in their territory.

entry: POKENAME用双腿跃上空中，再展翅安全滑落。雨夜里，它们会成群在雨中跳跃，洗净白色的胡须。
author: mr.bonesii
source: POKENAME uses its legs to leap into the air and its wings to glide safely down. On rainy nights, groups of POKENAME leap through the rain to clean their white beards.

entry: POKENAME拉拢形形色色的宝可梦结成帮派，替自己占地，并以武力展示守住边界。被迫亲自应战时，它也狡猾强悍，靠阴招取胜。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME forms gangs of disparate Pokémon to help claim territory for itself, enforcing the boundaries of the territory with displays of strength. When forced to fight for itself, POKENAME is wily and formidable, using underhanded strategies to win.

entry: POKENAME若觉得群中哪位成员背叛了自己，就会将其塞进巨大的中空身体，关上很长一段时间。终于获释后，那些成员便突然变得言听计从，再无半分反抗。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME stuffs any member of its flock that it feels has betrayed it into its large, hollow body for a long period of time. When these members are eventually freed, they suddenly obey and follow every command POKENAME gives them without defiance.

entry: POKENAME脱落的羽毛，会变成不自然的虚无般漆黑。许多教派曾将它们织入衣袍，相信这种颜色象征着神圣的来历。
author: .izik
source: Feathers fallen from POKENAME turn an unnatural void-black. Many cults once wove them into garments, believing the color signified divine origin.

entry: 在传说受诅咒的夜晚，POKENAME会率领黑暗剑鞘大军，诅咒整座城镇。慢慢吞尽居民的生命力，便再转往下一处。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: On nights said to be cursed, POKENAME leads an army of Muredge to curse an entire town. They slowly consume their life force and eventually move onto the next.

entry: POKENAME试图对驹刀小兵或黑暗鸦发号施令，却没有乌鸦头头、劈斩司令那样的号召力。它会把刀刃擦得锃亮，映光宛如满月。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME attempt to boss around other Pawniard or Murkrow, but POKENAME don't have the same sway over the species the same way Honchkrow or Bisharp have. POKENAME polish their blades to a shining gleam, as reflective of light as the full moon.

entry: POKENAME统领着一支恶属性大军，要求严苛，不容宽贷。其他野生恶属性宝可梦也禁不住听它号令。违令或令其大为失望者，会被永久逐出群体。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME commands a legion of Dark-types with strict and unforgiving expectations. Other wild Dark-type Pokémon can't help but bend to its will. Those who disobey or greatly disappoint POKENAME are permanently removed from the group.

entry: POKENAME通过集体梳理展示支配地位，命令下属替自己擦亮甲片。因此，训练家最好让它自己打理，否则它可能开始试着指挥训练家。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME use group grooming as a means of showing dominance by making their subordinates polish their plates. For that reason, Trainers are advised to allow POKENAME to groom themselves; otherwise, their Pokémon may begin trying to command them.

entry: POKENAME友善有礼，喜欢找贵重物品，只为物归原主。不少侦探都以它为伙伴，因为它能追踪许多物品和人物，还能用触角束缚惹事者。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are friendly and polite Pokémon who love to find valuables, if only to return them to their rightful owners. Quite a few detectives have POKENAME partners, who can track many things or people and restrain troublemakers with their feelers.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME住在黑暗鸦极其密集的地方。它用阴影般的触须同时控制所有黑暗鸦，指使它们在各地大肆作乱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is believed to inhabit places with extremely high Murkrow populations. It uses shadowy tendrils to take control of all of them at once and direct them to cause extreme mischief across the land.

entry: POKENAME在深夜潜行，袭扰倒霉的旅人。它从臂炮放出催眠雾，待受害者睡着，便抢走贵重物品。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sneaks around in the dead of night to accost hapless travelers. It dispenses a sleep-inducing fog from its arm cannon and robs victims of their valuables while they sleep.

entry: 有时能看见POKENAME领着一群洛托姆。它们所到之处一片混乱，因为附近所有电子设备都会突然故障。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are sometimes seen leading around a group of Rotom. These swarms cause chaos wherever they go, as every electronic device in the area will suddenly malfunction.

entry: POKENAME很少亲自动手，常把事情交给伙伴或下属，再看它们的表现，加以喝彩或辱骂。若卷入战斗，它便会展现危险而残酷的兽性。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME doesn't often take matters into its own hands, but rather leaves its companions or subordinates to do the job, while cheering or insulting them depending on their efforts. If it gets into a fight, it'll behave as a dangerous and cruel beast.

entry: POKENAME捡拾林地上的暗色羽毛，制作伪装。它在林间游荡时，会发出扭曲的啼鸣。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME crafts disguises from dark feathers gathered off forest floors. It emits a distorted chirping sound as it wanders through the woods.

entry: POKENAME从头顶帽子状的羽毛放出强力电流。随着夜幕降临，火花会越来越明亮。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME discharges powerful bursts of electricity from the hat-shaped feathers atop its head. The sparks grow brighter as night falls.

entry: POKENAME竭力装得可爱亲人，诱人靠近。不过，这只是狡计：不付出什么，就换来食物、住处与悉心照料。养熟后，它便懒散又固执。
author: sontyp
source: A POKENAME does its best to appear cute and approachable to lure humans closer. This is, however, just a devious scheme to gain food, shelter and attentive care for little return.  Once domesticated, this Pokémon becomes lazy and stubborn.

entry: POKENAME戴着时髦的乌鸦式礼帽，表演可爱的把戏迷住训练家，趁机偷取小饰物。若行窃被逮住，它们便投以可爱的目光，化解紧张。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a dapper corbeau hat that they wear to beguile Trainers and steal trinkets while they perform cute tricks. If they are caught stealing, they give a cute stare to disarm the tension.

entry: 它爱看其他宝可梦互相对战，兴奋地啾鸣，为朋友鼓劲。不少训练家都说，有POKENAME在身边，连呆呆兽的决斗也会变得精彩刺激。
author: epping_forest
source: It loves watching other Pokémon battle each other, as it excitedly tweets to encourage its friends. Many Trainers agree that with POKENAME by your side, even a Slowpoke duel becomes a thrilling spectacle to watch.

entry: POKENAME颈部的蓬毛，是出生时从巢中收集的。等自己筑巢时，它们又会从现有的颈毛中取材，搭成新巢。
author: camtft
source: The scruff around the necks of POKENAME are gathered from their nests upon birth. When nesting, they pull from their current scruff to create it.

entry: POKENAME以优雅的舞步进攻。若有音乐，攻击便会更强。它们似乎尤其偏爱小提琴、吉他一类的弦乐器。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME attack their foes by dancing gracefully. Their attacks become more powerful if music is playing. POKENAME seem to prefer string instruments like the fiddle or guitar in particular.

entry: POKENAME及其下属之间的位阶，由舞蹈的技巧与美感决定。两只个体争夺首领之位时，舞斗能持续整整一夜。
author: wiz0z
source: Amongst POKENAME and their subordinates, hierarchy is decided through the skill and beauty of their dancing. When two POKENAME compete for leadership, their competition can last an entire night.

entry: 它的耳朵宛如声波反射镜，既带来惊人的听觉，也能将自己的声波投射回去。它借此在夜里躲开障碍，并召集同类。
author: flickeredflame
source: Its ears act as acoustic mirrors, granting it incredible hearing and the ability to project back sound waves of its own. It uses this ability to avoid obstacles at night and rally others of its own species.

entry: POKENAME率领由嗡蝠和黑暗鸦组成的庞大群体，统治夜空。但白天，这些群体会退回洞窟躲藏。
author: flickeredflame
source: POKENAME are leaders of massive flocks of Noibat and Murkrow, ruling the skies at night. During the day, however, these flocks retreat to caves to hide.

entry: POKENAME沉默而凶暴，对敌手却颇有敬意。开战前，它总会先轻点金属高顶礼帽，向对方致意。
author: bigoljax
source: Despite their silent, brutal personalities, POKENAME are quite respectful towards their opponents. They always make sure to tip their metallic tophats before a fight begins.

entry: POKENAME拥有独特的能力，能将吃下的任何东西变成类似填充棉的材料。这种填充物能抵挡物理冲击，因此它会尽可能多吃，让身体更加结实。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has the unique ability to turn anything it consumes into a material similar to cotton stuffing. The stuffing is resistant to physical impacts, so POKENAME will eat as much as possible to make its body more durable.

entry: POKENAME白天休息，由众多黑暗鸦守卫。夜幕降临，它便号令鸦群搜集珍奇，扩充宝藏，包括金珠，甚至吉利蛋的蛋。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME spends the day resting while its numerous Murkrow guard it. Come nightfall, it commands the flock to gather rare objects for its treasure hoard. Such items include Nuggets and even Chansey eggs.

entry: POKENAME白天磨利尖刺与爪子。夜幕降临，它便带着众多黑暗鸦游荡于沙漠，搜集珍奇，扩充自己的宝藏。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME spends the day sharpening its spines and claws. Come nightfall, it roams the desert with numerous Murkrow in tow, seeking to gather rare objects for its treasure hoard.

entry: POKENAME的帽子，其实是一朵构造精巧的蘑菇。少量孢子可使人入睡，大量则能令其他宝可梦陷入催眠。野生个体常骑在受自己控制的大型宝可梦身上移动。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's hat is actually an elaborate mushroom. In small doses its spores induce sleep, but in large doses they can place other Pokémon in a hypnotic trance. Wild POKENAME usually ride around on top of a larger Pokémon they control.

entry: 它们因拳头般的利爪和迅捷的出击，被称为“黑暗中的赤拳斗士”。飞行时速约为90英里。
author: loikthescreamo
source: These Pokémon are nicknamed the "Bare-Knuckle Fighters of the Dark" due to their fist-like talons and their ability to strike quickly. They can fly at roughly 90 mph.

entry: POKENAME身上会长出由俗称“愚人金”的矿物构成的小结晶。它常以分得“黄金”为诱饵，骗不够聪明的宝可梦替自己干活。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME grows small crystals on its body made out of Fools' Gold. It will often trick lesser-minded Pokémon into working for it for a share of its "gold".

entry: POKENAME通常待在一群黑暗鸦中，充当强壮的保镖。它很少离群，喜欢留在当家首领乌鸦头头身旁。
author: corninin
source: POKENAME are usually seen within a murder of Murkrows and act as the group's muscular bodyguard. POKENAME rarely separate from the group and opt to stay by the acting Honchkrow's side.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀太弱，无法独力飞行，便借助一群黑暗鸦四处飞行。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME's wings are too weak to fly by itself. Instead, POKENAME uses a group of Murkrow to fly around.

entry: 无论彩色灯光如何照在POKENAME身上，它都始终保持黑白相间的外观。这种宝可梦曾深度参与早期电影制作，导演们也为向它致敬，拍出了后来备受小众影迷推崇的经典。
author: _pixelar_
source: When colored lighting hits POKENAME, its appearance doesn't ever change from its black-and-white coloring. This Pokémon was very involved in the early stages of filmmaking, and in its honor directors made films that eventually became cult classics.

entry: POKENAME夜里穿行于城市，带着几只黑暗鸦跟班，让自己显得更有地位。只要觉得受到一丝轻慢，它便会挥起手杖，殴打冒犯者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME travels through cities at night, followed by a few Murkrow lackeys to make it feel more important. Any perceived slight against it causes it to swing its cane to bludgeon the insulting party.

entry: POKENAME与其他宝可梦交往时，天生就有一股威严。已有疏于照料或缺乏经验的训练家，被魅力十足的POKENAME拐走整支队伍。
author: danarchosyndacalist
source: POKENAME have a natural air of authority when socializing with other Pokémon. Neglectful or inexperienced Trainers have been known to lose their whole team to a charismatic POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME虽然能凭空变出钻石，收藏的大多数珠宝却都是偷来的。它的“小帮派”由小碎钻组成，个个唯命是从，唯恐永远封冻在坚硬的结晶里。
author: bollocksmen
source: Despite possessing the ability to materialize diamonds out of thin air, most of the jewels in POKENAME's collection are stolen. Its "gang" of Carbink obey its every order, lest they find themselves frozen eternally in tough crystal.

entry: POKENAME凭双拳的蛮力，逼弱小的宝可梦搜集食物进贡。不听话便会惹得它怒不可遏，蒸汽从鼻孔喷出，穿过那张严峻的喙。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses the brute force of its fists to make weaker Pokémon collect food to offer it. If they don't obey, it becomes so enraged that it starts blowing steam from its nostrils through its stern beak.

entry: POKENAME出了名地狡猾顽皮，连心爱的训练家也不放过。它会为争夺领地与黑鲁加交战。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME is known to be very sly and mischievous, even towards its beloved Trainer. It fights against Houndoom for territory.

entry: POKENAME用蛮力威吓蚊香君和蚊香蝌蚪听命，霸占整片湖泊，赶走竞争者。它们之间的战斗往往旷日持久，双方都靠手下交战。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their brute strength to intimidate Poliwhirl and Poliwag into doing their bidding, taking control of entire lakes and driving out competitors. Battles between POKENAME tend to be protracted, each relying on their underlings to fight.

entry: 它在战斗中紧盯训练家，以诡异的精准复现对方的战术。旁观者若仔细研究它的动作，也许能发现暗藏的技巧。
author: jaminmcready
source: It watches Trainers closely during battle, copying their tactics with eerie precision. It would behoove any observer to study its movements for hidden techniques.

entry: 夜里看见暗影般的鸟掠过，便是POKENAME在附近的第一个警讯。这些鸟的用途尚不明确，民间故事却说，它会用鸟群对抗训练家的噩梦。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Sighting a shadowy bird passing by at night is the first warning sign of a POKENAME being nearby. While the use of these birds has yet to be identified, folk stories describe POKENAME using them to fight their Trainers' nightmares.

entry: POKENAME的几个头像天平一样，称量生灵的善恶业报，再作出裁决。它住在阴暗森林中。
author: anlcorpagent
source: POKENAME's heads operate as a scale, weighing the karma of creatures and delivering a verdict. It resides in dark forests.

entry: POKENAME寻找迷失在冰冷海洋中的宝可梦，提出以帮忙办事为代价提供救援。它们借此壮大家族，扩大对领地的影响。
author: ocxin
source: POKENAME seek out Pokémon lost out in icy oceans offering rescue in exchange for favours. In doing so, they grow their families and influence over their territory.

entry: POKENAME凭背上强力的炮，与水手和海盗同行。它很少表达感受，不少人因此以为它冷漠。其实，受到赞扬时，它会轻轻点头，表示领情。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rides alongside sailors and pirates because of the powerful cannons on its back. It gives little feedback on how it feels, which many have mistaken for apathy. Despite this misconception, it offers small nods of acknowledgement when praised.

entry: 过去，POKENAME曾与炼金术士合作制作药水。它主要靠向敌人扔瓶子攻击，扔完便跳到别处，接着继续扔。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: In the past POKENAME worked with alchemists in the production of potions. POKENAME's primary method of attack is to chuck bottles at opponents before hopping to a new location and throwing some more.

entry: POKENAME用催眠术催眠其他宝可梦，让对方听命。这常使大群宝可梦聚在它附近睡觉，方便它吞食梦境。
author: chibitales
source: Using their Hypnosis, POKENAME hypnotize other Pokémon into doing their bidding. This often ends up with POKENAME amassing large gatherings of Pokémon to sleep near them so they may easily feast on dreams.

entry: POKENAME一旦找到阳光充足的地方，就不肯再动。即便它并不是植物，也还是如此，单纯因为喜欢扮演植物。
author: mary_the_jane
source: POKENAME refuses to move once it finds a spot that has plenty of sun. It does this even though it is not a plant, simply because it loves playing the part.

entry: POKENAME拳头上的球体坚实有韧性，能反复击打目标而不觉酸痛。它训练、战斗都很卖力，但一旦输了比赛，就容易哭个不停。
author: sk372
source: The orbs comprising POKENAME's fists are solid and resilient, leaving it able to punch a target repeatedly without getting sore. It trains and fights hard, but is prone to crying excessively if it loses a match.

entry: POKENAME常在四下无人时跳舞，借此锻炼心智、增长智慧。哪怕只是最细微的动作失误被人看见，它也会大哭不止。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME often dances when nobody is around, strengthening its mind and heightening its intelligence in the process. If POKENAME is caught messing up even the slightest movement, it begins to cry profusely.

entry: POKENAME坚韧的皮肤和沉重的体重，能帮助它抵御捕食者。若离开水中，它便靠眼泪维持身体所需的水分。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's tough skin and heavy weight help protect it from predators. Should it find itself out of the water, its tears help keep it properly hydrated.

entry: POKENAME形似小树苗，身体却棱角分明。它们虽隐约有植物的模样，却不靠光合作用维生。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a cubic shape that resembles a small sapling. Even though they are vaguely plant-shaped, they do not rely on photosynthesis to sustain themselves.

entry: POKENAME把自己埋进沙中，让植物般的伪装更加逼真。可一到需要逃跑时，它就总是绊倒、摔跤。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME buries itself in the sand to improve its plantlike disguise. When it needs to run away, it constantly trips and falls.

entry: POKENAME变成与林中各种树木一模一样的形态，和旅人玩捉迷藏。可有人快要找到时，它的窃笑往往先暴露了位置。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME mimics trees throughout the forest by transforming into exact copies to play hide-and-seek with travelers. Its location is frequently given away by its giggles when someone draws close to finding it.

entry: POKENAME用单脚摇摆，每秒都变换方向，平衡却丝毫不乱，边动还边发出咔嗒声。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME swings on one foot, changing direction every second, never losing its balance. It makes clicking noises as it does so.

entry: 它伪装在树枝之间，整天一动不动。夜幕降临，POKENAME才会起飞，去吸食那些只在星光下绽放的珍稀花朵的花蜜。
author: fiordaliso
source: It camouflages itself among the tree branches, remaining perfectly still throughout the day. When night falls, POKENAME takes flight to feed on the nectar of rare flowers that only bloom under the starlight.

entry: POKENAME内心敏感，与自然格外亲近。飞行途中若碰见倒下的树，它会抱住树干，轻轻哭上几分钟。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a sensitive heart that is very attuned to nature. If it comes across a fallen tree while in flight, it clings to the tree and cries softly for several minutes.

entry: 寄放在培育屋时，POKENAME会小心翼翼地接近陌生宝可梦。它们不擅长交朋友，学习社交也常感吃力，因此训练家最好鼓励它们与其他宝可梦玩耍。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gingerly approach new Pokémon when they are left at daycare. They have a difficult time making friends and often struggle with learning social skills, so Trainers are advised to encourage them to play with other Pokémon.

entry: 尽管这种做法极受非议，许多农场工人却私下承认，会欺负当地的POKENAME直到它哭出来。因为它流下的眼泪富含养分，能让土里的作物长得格外茂盛。
author: sk372
source: Although it is highly frowned upon, many farmhands have secretly attested to bullying local POKENAME until they cry. This is because the tears they shed contain nutrients that make crops grown in the soil flourish much greater.

entry: POKENAME的眼泪含有滋养作物的养分。不过，愿意为了眼泪而故意弄哭它的人，少之又少。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's tears contain nutrients that help crops flourish. However, very few are willing to make it cry on purpose to get the tears.

entry: POKENAME的眼泪含有滋养作物的养分。不过，愿意为了眼泪而故意弄哭它的人，少之又少。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's tears contain nutrients that help crops flourish. However, very few are willing to make it cry on purpose to get the tears.

entry: POKENAME越长大，身体便越木质化，其他宝可梦因此难以消化它，是很有效的防御。但幼体柔嫩，尝起来像竹笋；鳃若被吃掉一部分，还能再生。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: As POKENAME gets older, its body becomes woodier. This is a strong defence mechanism as other Pokémon are unable to digest them, though young POKENAME are tender and taste similar to bamboo shoots. If part of their gill is eaten, they can regrow it.

entry: POKENAME越长大，身体便越木质化，其他宝可梦因此难以消化它，是很有效的防御。但幼体柔嫩，尝起来像竹笋，而鳃的末端始终保持柔嫩。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: As POKENAME gets older, its body becomes woodier. This is a strong defence mechanism as other Pokémon are unable to digest them, though young POKENAME are tender and taste similar to bamboo shoots. The ends of their gills always stay tender.

entry: POKENAME越长大，身体便越木质化。若被母亲抛弃，它便会哭个不停，并用有毒的眼泪攻击敌人。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: As POKENAME gets older, its body becomes woodier. If they are abandoned by their mother, POKENAME is unable to stop crying, and uses its toxic tears to attack foes.

entry: POKENAME身体的重量分布偏向一侧，不得不走得缓慢而小心。一旦绊倒，它便会大声哭喊，夸张地翻腾不休。
author: sk372
source: The weight distribution in POKENAME's body is lopsided, forcing it to walk very slowly and carefully. When it trips and falls, it thrashes around dramatically while crying loudly.

entry: 成群的POKENAME栖在图书馆和附近建筑的屋顶上，假扮石雕。虽然颜色鲜艳，却常能骗过烈箭鹰等捕食者。
author: .izik
source: Flocks of POKENAME perch along the rooftops of libraries and nearby buildings, pretending to be stone sculptures. Despite their bright coloring, they often fool predators like Talonflame.

entry: 它以哭泣博取敌人的同情，再趁对方分心，突然偷袭。
author: hophoppip
source: It cries to make its enemies feel sympathy for it. While they're distracted, it delivers a sneak attack.

entry: POKENAME靠天然的伪装，与训练家玩捉迷藏。它们爱藏在高草的图像里，被找到时，就会轻轻啾鸣。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their natural camouflage to play hide-and-seek with their Trainer. They love to hide in images of tall grass and let out a quiet chirp when found.

entry: 只要察觉悲伤，POKENAME就忍不住流泪。头上的触角能感知半径10英里内的一切情绪。
author: bandedbodypress
source: If it senses any sadness, POKENAME can't help but break into tears. The antenna on its head senses all emotions in a 10 mile radius.

entry: 战斗中，野生POKENAME常一动不动，试着模仿从父母身上学来的本领。可要把能量反送给敌人，它们还不熟练。
author: bobosmith01
source: In battle, wild POKENAME often stay still, trying to mimic what they have learned from their parents. They are not yet skilled at channeling energy back at the foe, however.

entry: POKENAME身边常带着一块叶之石，爱惜得仿佛自己的孩子。哪怕只分开片刻，它也会伤心到无法安抚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is often found with a Leaf Stone in its possession. It cherishes this stone as if it were its own child, and becomes inconsolable should something separate the two for even a moment.

entry: 望进POKENAME背上的洞，就会不由自主地哭泣。移开视线后，效果很快消失，多数人觉得这经历莫名有种宣泄后的畅快。
author: sk372
source: Those who gaze into the hole in POKENAME's back begin crying uncontrollably. The effect goes away quickly after looking away, and most regard the experience as strangely cathartic in a way.

entry: POKENAME寻找岩石庭园，站定不动，假扮雕像。夜里，它会啃咬周围的石头，磨利牙齿。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME seeks out rock gardens and stands motionless, mimicking a statue. At night, it gnaws on the surrounding rocks to keep its teeth sharp.

entry: POKENAME整天缓步慢行，是行动不便者可靠的伙伴。老人常扶着它的枝条，稳住自己的身体。
author: quackquackattack
source: The slow amble POKENAME takes throughout the day makes it a reliable partner for people who have trouble walking. The elderly often hold onto its branches to keep themselves steady.

entry: POKENAME究竟是木头雕好后石化，还是从一开始就是石头，研究人员尚无定论。但有一点他们都赞同：里面附着灵魂。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Researchers have yet to confirm whether POKENAME was wood that petrified after it was carved or always stone, but they agree that it is possessed.

entry: POKENAME很爱和其他宝可梦玩，却因天然的伪装难以被注意。许多宝可梦受过它触角的安慰，却根本不知道它就在身边。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME loves to play with other Pokémon but struggles to be noticed because of its natural camouflage. Many Pokémon have been comforted by its feelers without knowing it was ever there.

entry: POKENAME上方有一颗发光的星，照亮它色彩缤纷的身体。节日期间，人们常把它带回家，作为装饰。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's colorful body is illuminated by a glowing star above it. It is often brought into human homes as a decoration during the holidays.

entry: POKENAME躺在河岸上，假扮木头或石块。它不断吸水，直到身体胀起，再从眼睛排出水分，饮下以获取养分。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME lie on the banks of riverbeds, pretending to be a log or rock. They absorb moisture until it becomes bloated. They then excrete this moisture from their eyes, which they drink for nutrients.

entry: POKENAME把多余液体储存在绿色球体中，调节水分。大雨过后，这些球体常会长得太大，让它难以应付。
author: lynx.mauls
source: POKENAME regulates moisture by storing excess fluid in its green orbs. These spheres often grow too large to manage after heavy rain.

entry: POKENAME既想交朋友，又需要融入环境，进退两难。由于害羞，不敢直接接触，它便养成了跟踪别人的习惯。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are in the paradoxical of wanting to make friends while also needing to blend into their environment. This leads to the stalking behaviour that they are known for, as they are too shy for direct confrontations.

entry: 要不是其他吼鲸王融合体坚持劝它在水下迁徙时好好保护自己，POKENAME常会浮在水面上。它极其害羞，只要有人靠近，就可能哭出来。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME would often be found bobbing on the water's surface if it were not for other Wailord fusions insisting it try to protect itself while migrating underwater. Incredibly shy, it may break out into tears if approached.

entry: POKENAME是缺乏自信的歌手，出错后很难振作。它们追求完美到了苛刻的地步，谁打断歌声，都会让它们难过。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are diffident singers that lack the confidence to recover from mistakes. They are perfectionists to a fault and get upset whenever anyone interrupts their singing.

entry: POKENAME既固执又容易受惊，常因此陷入麻烦。若招架不住，它便会放声大哭，呼唤家人。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is both stubborn and easily frightened. This often lands it into troublesome situations. If overwhelmed, it will let out a loud cry to call its family.

entry: POKENAME鼓起柔软有弹性的身体，让自己显得更大、更有威势，想把入侵者吓走。若不奏效，它就只能边哭边逃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME inflates its soft, stretchy body to increase its size to look more imposing, hoping to scare off intruders. If this fails, its only recourse is to cry and run away.

entry: 它从眼睛排出多余的水分，使人们以为，这是迷失孩童的灵魂，正在绝望地哭泣。
author: hophoppip
source: It sheds excess moisture through its eyes. This has led people to believe that it is the spirit of a lost child, crying in despair.

entry: 采石场、矿井和石匠作坊里，常能找到搜寻小石块的POKENAME。以此为食，背上的岩状突起也随着时间缓缓长大。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can be found in quarries, mines, and stonemasons' workshops, scavenging for small pieces of stone. Fed by this diet, the rocky protrusions on its back slowly grow over time.

entry: 这种宝可梦敏捷、友善又爱玩，石头般的身体却极其坚硬沉重。哪怕只是友好地碰一下，也很容易将训练家撞倒。
author: zweizweihander
source: An agile, amicable, and playful Pokémon, its stone-like body is nonetheless extremely tough and heavy. One friendly bump can easily knock a Trainer over.

entry: 下雨前，POKENAME身上的绿宝石会泛起柔光。每到这时，它便赶紧躲起来，连一滴水也不愿沾上。
author: .izik
source: The emeralds on POKENAME's body glow softly before rainfall. When this happens, it hides quickly to avoid even a single drop of water.

entry: POKENAME没有手臂，无法用手自卫，便改用尾巴攻击。尾端的球根击中敌人时会爆炸。想让球根再长出来，它必须在食物中摄取更多硫磺和硝石。
author: _pixelar_
source: A POKENAME has no arms, to defend itself it. Instead it attacks its enemy with its tail. When the bulbs on the end of its tail hit the enemy, they explode. To regrow the bulbs, POKENAME has to increase the amount of sulfur and saltpetre in its diet.

entry: POKENAME藏在刚种下作物的田里，凭植物般的外形伪装，躲避大型宝可梦。藏身处一被收割，它们就会难过得整整哭上一天。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hide amongst fields of freshly planted crops, sheltering from larger Pokémon and relying on their plant-like appearance to camouflage them. They grow upset when their hiding place is harvested, crying uncontrollably for a full day.

entry: POKENAME藏在刚种下作物的田里，凭植物般的外形伪装，躲避大型宝可梦。周围作物结果时，它们的颜色会变成鲜红色。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hide amongst fields of freshly planted crops, sheltering from larger Pokémon and relying on their plant-like appearance to camouflage them. Their colours change to a bright red when the crops around them bear fruit.

entry: POKENAME藏在刚种下作物的田里，凭植物般的外形伪装，躲避大型宝可梦。它们在田间挖出的地道有助于将养分混入土壤，提高收成。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hide amongst fields of freshly planted crops, sheltering from larger Pokémon and relying on their plant-like appearance to camouflage them. The tunnels they dig through fields help to mix nutrients into the soil, improving harvest yields.

entry: POKENAME很会哄人给自己额外的零食。它先含着眼泪，可怜巴巴地望着人；若不管用，便发出吵闹的长嚎，强行索要。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME is very skilled in manipulating humans into giving it extra treats. It sadly looks at them with tears in its eyes, and if that doesn't work, it gives demanding, noisy yowls.

entry: POKENAME个头小，常被其他宝可梦欺负。由此产生的社交焦虑，让它们对每一种处境都思虑过度，头痛不已。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are often picked on by other Pokémon for their small size. The social anxiety that develops leaves them with headaches from overanalyzing every situation they are in.

entry: POKENAME的毛发看似蓬松柔软，其实由致密的岩石组成，摸起来十分光滑。它一头冲进战斗时，全靠这副岩石身躯保护自己。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Though it looks soft and fluffy, POKENAME fur consists of dense rock that is smooth to the touch. They rely on their rocky bodies to protect them when they charge headlong into battle.

entry: POKENAME赤褐色的身体，能融入沼泽环境。它们在沼泽里缓慢移动，避免引人注意，还能靠特殊的尾巴游动，不惊起水面的涟漪。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a russet body that helps them blend into swampy environments. They move slowly through swamps to avoid drawing attention to themselves and can swim without disturbing the water's surface with their specialized tail.

entry: 人们几乎总能看见POKENAME流泪。那到底是假泪，还是真泪、只不过它已忘记了流泪的缘由，学界仍争论不休。
author: catnip2390
source: POKENAME are almost always seen shedding tears. Whether those are fake tears or legitimate tears whose purpose has been forgotten is still a debated topic among academics.

entry: POKENAME下方只有一颗黄褐色的真头，另有两颗绿色假头。因为酷似另一种鸟类宝可梦，它们常会吓跑虫类宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a singular tawny head at the base and two green fake heads. They tend to scare away bug Pokémon because of their resemblance to another bird Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME静静跟着心情低落的人，用部分幽灵般的气体身躯让对方落泪。它并非心怀恶意，而是想让人借哭泣宣泄，得到些许宽慰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME silently follows those feeling down, using some of its ghostly gaseous form to cause them to cry. It does this not out of malice, but to try and give the person a measure of catharsis and relief through the crying.

entry: POKENAME一动不动，借圆珠施展超能力，让路过的人与宝可梦注意不到自己。唯有深夜才活动，将人的梦存进圆珠，留待日后享用。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME stand perfectly still, channeling their psychic powers through their orbs to prevent passing people or Pokémon from noticing them. They only move late at night, storing people's dreams in their orbs to feast on later.

entry: 常在儿童聚会上演出的杂耍艺人，很喜欢以POKENAME为伙伴。它身体柔软，抱住时会发出有趣的吱吱声，能安抚难过的孩子，让杂耍艺人继续逗其他宾客开心。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular companions for Jugglers who regularly perform at children's parties. POKENAME are soft and make a fun squeaking noise when hugged, helping calm upset children whilst the Juggler entertains the rest of the party.

entry: POKENAME常偷拿训练家的一个精灵球，视心情藏在3至7个假球中，等训练家猜哪个是真的。但这个玩笑十分危险，因为假球一打开就会爆炸。
author: dzygomer
source: POKENAME will often steal one of their Trainer's Poké Balls and hide it among three to seven fakes, depending on its mood. It expects the Trainer to guess the real one - though the joke turns dangerous, as the fakes explode when opened.

entry: POKENAME虽然长着这副模样，却会尽量避免打斗，试着以空挥拳威吓对手。若威吓无效，它们便用弹簧般的手臂弹跳逃走。
author: wiz0z
source: Despite their appearance, POKENAME avoid fighting when they can, using shadow-boxing to try and intimidate opponents. If their attempts fail, POKENAME bounce away on their spring-like arms.

entry: 受惊时，POKENAME从全身的喷口放出带毒纸屑，分散并吓退威胁。毒素离体一小时后便会失效，因此这些纸屑被人撒在甜点上，增添酸味。
author: pjporwoll
source: When startled, POKENAME expels toxin-laced confetti from spouts across its body to distract and dissuade threats. The poison is neutralized after an hour outside of POKENAME, leading to the confetti being used as a tart sprinkle on desserts.

entry: POKENAME的茧由坚硬却易碎的材料构成，容易遭到捕食。它们会用超能力筑起看不见的墙，挡住尖喙与利爪。
author: quackquackattack
source: The cocoon of a POKENAME is made of a stiff yet brittle material that makes them vulnerable to predators. They conjure invisible walls that are made out of psychic energy to block beaks and talons.

entry: POKENAME放出致幻气体，吸入者会看见周围出现本不存在的物体。气体的颜色，会受它所吃树果的影响。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME expels a hallucinogenic gas, which causes those who inhale it to perceive objects around them that are not really present. The color of the gas is affected by the Berries in POKENAME's diet.

entry: POKENAME筑起坚固的无形屏障，防止被捕食。这些屏障会让野生捕食者短暂迷惑，给它足够的时间逃走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME stop predators from eating them by creating solid invisible barriers. These barriers momentarily confuse wild predators and give them enough time to escape.

entry: 夜里，偶尔能在海滩发现POKENAME，红色核心有规律地闪烁。这道光会与附近的人造光源同步，常与灯塔保持相同的闪光节奏。
author: .jerden
