source: POKENAME is occasionally found on beaches at night, its red core regularly flashing. This light will synchronize with nearby artificial lighting, as POKENAME often flashes with the same regularity as a nearby lighthouse.

entry: POKENAME仍在磨炼模仿技巧，会专心观察模仿对象，力求演得完美。它制造屏障的能力还很弱，造出的墙只能维持几秒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is still fine-tuning its mimicry techniques, and studies its subjects intensely to perfect its performances. Its barrier-creating ability is still weak; the walls it makes will dissipate in only a few seconds.

entry: POKENAME的镰刀看似锋利，其实柔软得很，打中人也不会造成伤害。为吓退捕食者，它会假装切开早已劈好的木头，让自己显得更加危险。
author: soup1900
source: Though POKENAME may seemingly have sharp blades, the scythes are actually very soft and will cause no harm if they hit someone. To scare predators, it fakes slicing through a pre-chopped log to make itself seem more dangerous than it is.

entry: POKENAME用电流牵系搜集来的球体，表演抛接球，逗自己和旁人开心。比起战斗，它在这类表演上更加用心。
author: sk372
source: To entertain itself and others, POKENAME juggles spheres it gathers using its electricity as a tethering cable. It puts more effort into these shows of entertainment than it does into battle.

entry: POKENAME专捉弄好奇者，藏在盒子里，等谁走近查看这个奇怪方块，就猛地弹出来，用角注入使人麻痹的毒液，再边怪笑边跳走。
author: sk372
source: A prankster that preys on the curious, POKENAME hides in its box until something comes near to check out the strange cube, before springing forth from within and using its horn to deliver a paralyzing venom, then cackling as it hops away.

entry: POKENAME用无形的墙困住敌人，再变成对方训练家的模样，趁其困惑，悄然逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME traps foes inside invisible walls, then transforms into their Trainer. It uses the confusion to escape unnoticed.

entry: 专心感应时，POKENAME头上的绒球会轻轻偏向附近的进化石。找到石头便会大大增强它的力量，使进化得以发生。
author: .izik
source: When concentrating, POKENAME's head pom tugs faintly toward nearby evolutionary stones. Finding one empowers it greatly, allowing evolution to take place.

entry: POKENAME爱恶作剧，会巧妙地设下屏障，让使用者点不到想点的链接。如果察觉对方越来越烦躁，它便会悄悄撤掉屏障。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME delights in pranks, erecting clever Barriers that prevent users from clicking desired links. If it senses mounting frustration, it will quietly remove them.

entry: POKENAME毒针尖端的球，是为防止它不小心毒到自己。战斗中，它会以最高每小时50英里的速度射出这个球，再补上一记带有腐蚀性的毒刺。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The ball on the tip of POKENAME's stinger is to prevent it from accidentally poisoning itself. In combat, this ball gets shot off at speeds of up to 50 MPH which POKENAME then follows up with a corrosive poison sting.

entry: 每当嘉年华开张营业，POKENAME就会瞬间移动到附近，讨取棒棒糖。它会留下东西换糖，从宝可元到几片绿叶，什么都有。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Whenever carnivals pop up and begin operating, POKENAME teleports nearby to acquire lollipops. POKENAME leaves items behind to trade for the candy, ranging from Pokédollars to a few green leaves.

entry: 睡觉时，POKENAME头上的绒球会散发巧可果的甜香，让附近的生灵平静下来。
author: .izik
source: While sleeping, POKENAME releases a sweet Occa Berry scent from the pom on its head. The aroma calms others nearby.

entry: POKENAME唤出的闪烁热雾，能形成无法穿过的屏障，待热量散入空气才会消散。马戏团常请它在杂技演员下方筑起几乎看不见的屏障。
author: vic1312
source: The shimmering heat haze that POKENAME can conjure forms impassable barriers. The barriers eventually collapse as the heat diffuses in the air. Circuses often employ POKENAME to create near-invisible barriers underneath acrobat performers.

entry: POKENAME突然从树冠落到其他生物面前，静静观察对方受惊的反应，再爬回树上，织出描绘那副惊恐表情的蛛网。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME suddenly drops from tree canopies to land in front of startled creatures, observing their reaction quietly. It then climbs back up its tree and spins a web designed to depict their fearful expression.

entry: POKENAME不断改变振翅节奏，使追逐者摸不着头脑。但这也导致它的飞行本领很差。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME constantly changes the rhythm of its wing fluttering so that anything chasing it gets confused. However, this results in it being a very poor flier.

entry: POKENAME经常控制不好自己的超能力。受惊或兴奋时，它会无意间在附近竖起看不见的墙。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME frequently loses control of its psychic powers. It unintentionally erects invisible walls nearby when startled or excited.

entry: 满月之夜，POKENAME会在秘密聚会中，向朋友展示白天模仿学来的动作。
author: .izik
source: During full moon nights, POKENAME showcases the movements it copied during the day. It performs for friends in secret gatherings.

entry: POKENAME的卷毛仿佛永无止境地旋转。盯着看便会被催眠，这对它很有利。
author: hophoppip
source: The curls of POKENAME's wool seem to swirl endlessly. Staring at it is hypnotic, which works to POKENAME's advantage.

entry: 白天，POKENAME飘浮在公园高空，偷偷观察人们。夜里，它便和同类一起模仿那些动作。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats high above parks during the day, spying on people. At night, it mimics their actions with others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME将尾巴绕在鳃上梳理自己，用分泌的特殊凝胶保持亮泽。完成之前，它不愿公开露面，也喜欢参加华丽大赛。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME wraps its tail around its gills to preen itself, using a special gel it secretes to keep itself looking glossy. It doesn't like to be seen in public before it has done this and enjoys participating in Pokémon Contests.

entry: 有些POKENAME会亲手做帽子，再用自己分泌的特殊凝胶，让帽子保持亮泽。它们会比谁的帽子最出众，只有胜者才能参加华丽大赛。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Some POKENAME fashion their own hats and use a special gel they secrete to keep it looking glossy. These Pokémon compete to see who has the most impressive hat, and only the winners are allowed to participate in Pokémon Contests.

entry: 感到旁人伤心时，POKENAME马上就会跳舞，逗对方开心。它甚至能用超能力在身边撒下一阵阵小纸屑，让舞蹈更有趣。
author: sk372
source: When it senses sadness in others, POKENAME is quick to start dancing to entertain them. It can even use its psychic powers to create little showers of confetti around it to make its dance seem more amusing.

entry: POKENAME直觉惊人，能预判旁人的动作，抢先模仿。敌人因此疑惑不已，有时甚至以为，真正模仿别人的反倒是自己。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Because of its incredible intuition, POKENAME has the ability to predict the actions of others. It preemptively mimics these actions, confusing and perplexing its foes, sometimes making them believe that they are the ones actually copying POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME古怪逗趣，最爱娱人。它们背上会长出气球，送给孩子们。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are zany creatures that love to entertain others. They grow balloons from their back that they give out to children.

entry: 每到热闹繁忙的地方，POKENAME就会用尾巴挖出地下迷宫，供大家玩耍。成功走出迷宫者，会得到它模仿自己动作的表演，作为奖励。
author: soup1900
source: Whenever POKENAME arrives at a bustling, lively location, it creates an underground maze with its tail for the others to have fun in. It rewards those who successfully complete its maze by putting on a show of mimicking their actions.

entry: 已知POKENAME在孩子和科学家中都很受欢迎。孩子喜欢它可爱的外表，科学家则常为它究竟如何飞行争论不休。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME has been shown to be popular among both children and scientists. Children enjoy POKENAME for its cutesy appearance, while scientists frequently argue over how POKENAME truly flies.

entry: POKENAME在巢穴周围筑起超能力墙壁，守护巢穴。入侵者若靠得太近，它就会以狂风骤雨般的啄击还击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME erects psychic walls around its nest to guard it. If intruders get too close, it strikes with a furious barrage of pecks.

entry: 这种POKENAME遇到伤心者就会慌张，非要拼命逗对方开心不可。它使出尴尬的聚会把戏，送上让人不自在的拥抱，直到人人都笑了，或至少装作在笑，才肯停下。
author: curazy
source: This POKENAME will panic and attempt to cheer sad individuals up, aggressively. With awkward party tricks and uncomfortable hugs, it won't stop until everyone is laughing or least pretending to.

entry: POKENAME爪上的玩偶，常被用来威吓敌人。研究者仍不敢肯定，POKENAME释放的超能力，究竟有没有让玩偶也生出意识。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The puppets on the claws of POKENAME are often used in an intimidation tactic. Researchers are still not entirely sure that the psychic energy POKENAME emits hasn't given them consciousness.

entry: POKENAME藏在异常坚固的盒子里，奏乐吸引人靠近，再捉弄对方，转眼又消失。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME hides in its incredibly robust box and plays music so that it can prank approaching people and then disappear again.

entry: POKENAME常试图模仿三蜜蜂，好免费吃到蜂蜜。三蜜蜂并未受骗，却常愿意分它一些，因为它会用角将其他想抢蜜的竞争者挑飞。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME tends to try to mimic Combee to gain free access to their honey. While the Combee aren't fooled by this mimicry, they often let POKENAME have some honey anyways due to it hurling other rivals who want honey away with its horn.

entry: 攻击前，POKENAME先放出一阵蜂蜜香气，再向敌人施以强力的超能力打击。
author: .izik
source: Before attacking, POKENAME releases a burst of honey-scented aroma. It then unleashes a powerful psychic strike against its foe.

entry: POKENAME没有其他熔岩虫融合宝可梦那般高温，摸上去温暖如棉花糖，常与逗孩子的艺人一同表演。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: Often used by children's entertainers, POKENAME has lost the heat of other Slugma fusions. Instead, it has a warm, candy floss feel.

entry: 它会寻找人群聚集处，炫耀模仿本领。但走得太慢，活动常在POKENAME赶到前就结束了。站在观众面前时，它也可能紧张得缩进壳里。
author: oddwalls
source: It seeks out gatherings of people to show off its mimicry skills, but it moves so slowly that an event often ends before POKENAME arrives. In front of an audience, it may become nervous and hide in its shell.

entry: POKENAME的长毛浓密得惊人，遮得它什么也看不见。因此，人们常见它撞上周围的东西。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The long hair of POKENAME is incredibly dense, making it impossible for this Pokémon to see. Because of this, POKENAME are often found bumping into their environment.

entry: POKENAME将小饰物收进尾巴里。如果喜欢你看它模仿时的反应，它也许会送你一个。
author: the_fireplace
source: POKENAME gathers trinkets in its tail. It may give you one if it enjoys your reaction to its mimicry.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME向黑暗嚎叫，头上的绒球灼得通红，形成诡异而闪烁的景象。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME howls into the darkness while the pom on its head glows red-hot, creating an eerie, flickering sight.

entry: POKENAME行踪难寻，却很聪明，喜欢为旁观者表演把戏。但它从不出声；若它低吼或吠叫，就说明出了大问题，让它十分难受。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is an elusive but intelligent Pokémon that loves to perform tricks for onlookers. However, it will never emit a sound; if POKENAME growls or barks, something is very wrong and it is greatly upset.

entry: POKENAME用鼻子熟练地抛接物品。若表演到一半被人看见，它便害羞起来，用超能力将旁观者推开。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME juggles objects skillfully with its nose. If spotted mid-act, it grows shy and pushes the onlooker away with psychic force.

entry: POKENAME侵入闭路监控录像，将自己插进画面。它们模仿录像里人的动作，自娱自乐，却常因这番胡闹遮住画面中的重要事件。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hack into closed circuit television footage and insert themselves into the video. They copy the movements of people inside the footage to entertain themselves but often obscure important events in the video with their antics.

entry: POKENAME竭力模仿惊角鹿，尤其想加入幼鹿们的游戏。可惜其他宝可梦通常嫌它颜色太鲜艳，将它排斥在外。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME tries its best to mimic Stantler and is especially eager to join in with the games that young Stantler play together. Unfortunately, the other Pokémon usually shun POKENAME due to its bright coloration.

entry: POKENAME竭力模仿惊角鹿，却苦于自己没有角。不过有人报告，它仅凭细微的头部动作，就能模仿鹿角扭曲现实的效果。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME tries its best to mimic Stantler, but its lack of horns makes this difficult. However, some people have reported that POKENAME can imitate the reality-distorting effect their antlers create using only subtle movements of its head.

entry: POKENAME在半空筑起看不见的墙，再借墙蹬跳，做出复杂优美的武术动作。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME jumps off invisible walls it creates mid-air. This lets it perform complex and graceful martial arts maneuvers.

entry: POKENAME的吻能迷住旁人，迫使对方模仿自己的动作。它凭时髦的发型，在富人中流行起来。
author: mega_beedrill
source: POKENAME's kiss entrances and compels others to mimic its movements. It's become popular with the wealthy for its stylish hair.

entry: POKENAME在夜里活动、捕猎，因为颈部皮膜带着微光，也因为它真正的脸，总藏不住兴奋。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME is nocturnal and does most of its hunting at night. This is due to its slightly fluorescent frill pattern, and due to the fact that it struggles to keep excitement from its true face.

entry: 碰它的鼻子会吓到它，即使看着你的手伸来，也不例外，接着便会从脸颊放电。这些宝可梦似乎天生对人类和其他宝可梦充满好奇。
author: infinex21
source: Touching its nose startles it, even if it sees you reaching toward it, and causes it to discharge electricity from its cheeks. These Pokémon seem to be innately curious about humans and other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME模仿的舞步，会发动它穿越时间的力量。观众也会一同踏上旅程，跟着它来到另一个时代。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's dances of mimicry activate its power to travel through time. Those it performs for will be brought along for the ride and deposited in a different time period alongside POKENAME.

entry: 开始下雨时，POKENAME会在自己爱躲藏的树木周围筑起屏障，使附近保持干燥。可惜这样也让树木失去了赖以生存的雨水。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME creates barriers around trees it likes to hide near when it begins to rain, keeping the surrounding area dry. This unfortunately deprives the trees of the rainwater necessary for their survival.

entry: POKENAME精通抛接杂耍，靠超能力与磁力，能让球一直悬空。训练家有时也见过，野生POKENAME认真练习整套动作。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME has mastered its juggling abilities and can use its psychic and magnetic abilities to keep the balls it has floating indefinitely. On occasion, Trainers have seen wild POKENAME practicing juggling routines.

entry: POKENAME从手上的孔洞射出大橡胶球，力道足以摧毁砖墙。它常在特技表演中现身，厚实的橡胶护甲能抵御大多数物理伤害。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME fires large rubber balls from the holes in its hands with enough force to destroy a brick wall. It's often seen at stunt shows as its thick, rubber armor protects it from most physical damage.

entry: POKENAME出了名地爱参加聚会，常在人或宝可梦众多的地方出现，为聚会中的大家表演助兴。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is known as an active partygoer; it often shows up in places where many people or Pokémon are gathered. This Pokémon will often entertain the people or Pokémon at said party.

entry: 挖掘时若察觉将要塌方，POKENAME便会在自己所在区域的上方筑起无形墙壁，为同族争取安全逃离的时间。
author: .izik
source: If it senses a cave-in while digging, POKENAME creates an invisible wall above its immediate area. This allows its kin time to escape safely.

entry: POKENAME与滑稽演员一同演出，站在大球上保持平衡，让演员从上方翻腾而过。若不慎滑倒，它便用尾巴将自己重新弹正。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME perform alongside Harlequins, balancing on large balls while performers do flips over them. Should they slip, they use their tail to bounce themselves upright again.

entry: 比起其他人，POKENAME更爱模仿研究者。它偷偷溜进实验室，观察研究者工作，再用临时找来的道具模仿他们的动作。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME prefers to imitate researchers more than any other group. It sneaks into laboratories to observe researchers at work and mimics their actions using improvised props.

entry: POKENAME蹦跳时，帽状羽毛上的球也会跟着跳动，发出铃铛般的叮当声。它很喜欢其他宝可梦，常迈着轻快的步子跟在后面，开心地啾鸣。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: When POKENAME hops around, the ball attached to its hat-like feathers will bounce and jingle like a bell. POKENAME is very fond of other Pokémon, following them with a bounce in its step and chirping happily.

entry: POKENAME对旁人的想法与情绪极为敏感，通常会躲着人。值得一提的是，它更愿意在人类孩子面前现身，试着模仿他们的动作与举止。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are notoriously sensitive to the thoughts and emotions of others and typically evade people. Noteably, they are more willing to appear before human children and will attempt to mimic their movements and mannerisms.

entry: POKENAME爱收集、把玩圆形物品，其中又以红色圆物最令它着迷。它们常用潜藏而微弱的超能力将物品举到半空，假装在抛接表演。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME love to collect and play with round objects, though red, round objects are the most alluring to them. Using their latent, albeit weak, psychic powers, they will often raise such objects aloft and pretend to juggle them.

entry: 为了和人类及其他宝可梦交朋友，POKENAME会用超能力表演把戏，顽皮地模仿对方的动作和表情。它深受孩子喜爱，因此有些作品也采用了夸张化的POKENAME形象。
author: infinex21
source: To befriend humans and other Pokémon, POKENAME will use its psychic powers to perform tricks for them and will playfully mimic their movements and expressions. Their popularity with children has seen some media adapt caricatures of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME模样亲切，常在托育中心，为孩子与幼小宝可梦表演。
author: inksans201x
source: Thanks to its friendly appearance, POKENAME are often found in daycares performing for young children and Pokémon alike.

entry: POKENAME的舞蹈如此迷人，不少观众会不由自主地一直盯着看，直到演出结束。它越强，舞蹈的吸引力也越强，甚至会让观众跟着模仿。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's dances are so alluring that many who view them can't help but stare until the performance ends. As POKENAME grows stronger, so does the compelling nature of its dance, causing its audience to mimic its movements.

entry: POKENAME在繁忙街道旁观察人类，加以模仿。若被发现，它会先试图用毒牙咬那个闯来的人，再逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME studies humans near busy streets to imitate them. If caught, it will try to bite the intruder with toxic fangs before fleeing.

entry: POKENAME搭建舒适的巢屋，并在四周筑起无形墙壁。这些超能力屏障能将捕食者和入侵者挡在外面。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME builds cozy lodges and erects invisible walls around them. These psychic barriers keep predators and intruders away.

entry: POKENAME待在盒子里，也能听见外面的交谈。若感到喜悦，它们就会蹦出来玩。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are able to hear conversations when inside their box. If they sense joy, they will pop out to play.

entry: POKENAME待在盒子里，也能听见外面的交谈。若感到恶意，它们就会蹦出来，把噩梦带给那些不友善的家伙。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are able to hear conversations when inside their box. If they sense malice, POKENAME pop out of their box to bring nightmares to those who aren't being kind.

entry: POKENAME磨炼心志，抵御悲伤、疲倦或恶意的波导，让自己始终开心。它最爱以夸张滑稽的方式模仿武打电影。
author: mega_beedrill
source: POKENAME steels its soul against any sad, tiring or malevolent auras to keep its cheery mood constant. It loves to mimic martial arts movies in exaggerated and silly manners.

entry: POKENAME靠模仿吸引玩伴，滑稽的举动却偶尔会惹怒其他宝可梦。每到这时，它便用毒刺自卫，而这些攻击也帮它精进模仿的本领。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME mimics others to attract playmates, though its antics occasionally enrage other Pokémon. When this happens, it defends itself with its toxic barbs. These attacks help it to perfect its mimicry.

entry: POKENAME能从背上的帽子底下变出气球，随意分给孩子。有时气球给得太多，它们还得赶紧用藤蔓抓住孩子，免得孩子飘走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can produce balloons from under the hat on their back and freely gives these balloons out to children. Sometimes they give out too many balloons and have to grab a child with their vines before they float away.

entry: POKENAME鼓起脸周围的橡胶状物质，挡开攻击，再来回挥动身体，拍走敌人。它蹦跳时，缎带末端的球会轻轻叮当作响。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME inflate the rubbery material around their faces to repel attacks before flailing back and forth to swat away foes. The orbs at the end of their ribbons jingle faintly as they bounce around.

entry: POKENAME坚硬的头骨受到敲击时，身上的球会发出铃铛般的声音。它们会成群互相撞头，锻炼头骨，响成一片嘈杂的铃声。
author: sk372
source: The orbs on POKENAME's body jingle like bells when its sturdy skull is struck. Groups of POKENAME headbutt each other to strengthen their skulls, creating a cacophony of bell-ringing.

entry: POKENAME天生个头小，却能将自己鼓得巨大，模仿飞艇的形态。它更喜欢待在海里，但被强风带上天空时，看起来也很满足。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME is naturally quite small, but it has the ability to inflate to an enormous size, mimicking the form of a blimp. It prefers being in the sea, but appears content when being carried into the sky on strong winds.

entry: POKENAME好奇心旺盛，会为接触过的对象造出分身，用来模仿对方的言语或动作。玩够后，这些仿影便会在五彩闪光中消失。
author: sk372
source: A curious creature, POKENAME will create copies of those it interacts with, using them to mimic their words or actions. When it's done playing around, the mimicries vanish in a burst of colorful sparkles.

entry: POKENAME背上长着灌木，结满多汁的种子。释放超能力时，能量会让这些种子像爆米花一样爆开。
author: hophoppip
source: Shrubs covered in juicy seeds grow on POKENAME's back. When it unleashes its psychic power, the energy causes these seeds to burst like popcorn.

entry: 强大的磁力与高超的平衡本领，让POKENAME头上叠起的石头不至倒塌。石堆越壮观，它得到同类的尊重就越多。
author: kiwiarms
source: Powerful magnetism and masterful balance keeps the rocks POKENAME stacks on its head from falling over. The more impressive the stack, the more respect an individual POKENAME will receive from its peers.

entry: POKENAME抛接小朝北鼻，向人和宝可梦炫技。念动力与磁力让小朝北鼻根本不会掉下，因此这项本领对它来说并不难学。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME shows off to people and Pokémon by juggling its Mini-Noses. Its telekinesis and magnetism powers make it impossible to drop the Mini-Noses, so juggling is not a difficult skill for it to learn.

entry: 这把剑的切割能力与普通剑相同。刀刃若爆开，POKENAME便借泄出的空气飞走，到别处重新长好。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This sword is as effective a cutter as a standard sword. If its blade ever pops, POKENAME uses to expelling air to fly away and regenerate elsewhere.

entry: 连续弹跳的次数越多，刀刃就越有力，POKENAME也越兴奋。它很乐意让孩子拿自己玩耍。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The more successive bounces it achieves, the more powerful the blade and the more excited the POKENAME becomes. It happily lets kids play with it.

entry: 为了让旁人惊叹，POKENAME会把极其锋利危险的武器，稳在手、脚和鼻子上。虽然摇摇晃晃，它们却以荣誉为赌注，坚持完成挑战，绝不临阵退缩。
author: soup1900
source: To impress and surprise others, POKENAME balance extremely sharp and dangerous weapons on their hands, feet, and nose. Despite their shakiness, they put their honor at stake in completing the challenge so that they don't cower away.

entry: 伸展触角时，POKENAME能造出巨大的屏障，困住追来的捕食者。等拉开安全距离，它便转过身，远远地嘲弄对方。
author: .izik
source: When extending its feelers, POKENAME can create large barriers that trap pursuing predators. Once a safe distance is established, it turns to mock them from afar.

entry: POKENAME体型虽大得吓人，性情却很温顺，整天用尾巴表演把戏。抚摸时最好待在它正面，因为被尾巴打中，很容易整个人飞出去。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Despite their intimidating size, POKENAME are quite docile and spend their time performing tricks with their tail. It is advised to stay in front of them when giving them pets, as their tails could easily send someone flying if hit.

entry: 满月之夜，POKENAME会秘密聚会，用过去一个月里模仿来的动作跳舞。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hold secret gatherings on nights of the full moon. At these gatherings, they dance using the actions they copied from others in the past month.

entry: POKENAME十分警惕，仔细观察旁人的动作，并能轻松模仿。它借此分散对方的注意，跳跃逃走。
author: foolish_weasel
source: A very wary Pokémon, POKENAME carefully observes movements from others. It can easily mimic them, which it does to distract them as it bounds away.

entry: POKENAME的双脚看似软绵绵、不协调，却能模仿其他宝可梦的优雅与敏捷。它胆子小，通常只是借此逃跑。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Although its feet appear floppy and uncoordinated, POKENAME can mimic the grace and agility of other Pokémon. Since it is skittish, it will usually do this in order to run away.

entry: POKENAME先用无形墙壁困住对手，再使出火焰旋涡。这样便能防止火势失控蔓延。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME traps its opponent within invisible walls before using Fire Spin. This prevents the flames from spreading uncontrollably.

entry: POKENAME能将内脏排出体外，再重新塑形。它会模仿人类的手势，尝试进行简单的交流。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can expel its innards and reshape them once expelled. It mimics human hand gestures in a rudimentary attempt at communication.

entry: 与其他双首暴龙融合体不同，POKENAME的两颗头大多能和睦相处，而且十分爱同台表演。它们会配合超能力，把不同的物品抛接得眼花缭乱。
author: mistymagius
source: Unlike other Zwelious fusions, POKENAME's two heads mostly co-operate with each other and love to perform together. They work in tandem to juggle different objects with their psychic abilities.

entry: 小丑用POKENAME辅助喜剧表演。但几颗头有时会在演出中打起来，因此和它搭档颇有风险。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Clowns use POKENAME to aid in their comedy routines. However, the heads sometimes fight during performances, making them risky partners to use.

entry: POKENAME见谁都热情过头，尤其爱逗孩子开心。可无论大人孩子，往往都很怕它。
author: hummusishome
source: POKENAME acts overly friendly to all who it meets. It loves to entertain children despite both kids and adults alike often being terrified of it.

entry: 这种宝可梦模仿画作与书本中的宫廷弄臣，因此常被旅人称作“大自然的丑角”。人们常见它用四只手抛接坚果和树果。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon are often called "Nature's Harlequin" by travelers due to their mimicry of court jesters in paintings and books. They are often seen juggling nuts and berries with their four hands.

entry: POKENAME讨人喜欢，却极其狡诈，经常模仿训练家及其宝可梦来捉弄旁人。它最爱制作伪装，借此戏耍人们。
author: chiiaseeds_
source: POKENAME is known to be charming but incredibly deceitful, regularly playing pranks on others by mimicking Trainers and their Pokémon. It finds great joy in creating disguises and taunting people with them.

entry: POKENAME能在人和宝可梦的睡梦中现身，乐于在梦里恶作剧、说笑。若有人也以幽默回应，它便会赐下好运。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to manifest inside the dreams of sleeping people and Pokémon. They delight in playing pranks and making jokes within those dreams, blessing those who meet their humour in kind with good fortune.

entry: POKENAME能接连表演数小时而不知疲倦。它只与浑身洋溢着欢乐气息的训练家亲近。
author: mega_beedrill
source: POKENAME can perform tricks for hours on end without tiring. It only bonds well with trainers who have a joyful aura about them.

entry: POKENAME用无形墙壁困住敌人，再突然使出放电。这番组合攻击，会让大多数敌人动弹不得。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME traps foes inside invisible walls before releasing a sudden Discharge. The combined attack leaves most enemies stunned.

entry: POKENAME每天从悬崖跳下，盼有一天能翱翔天际。若能从坠落中活下来，它便会羞愧地跑去躲藏。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME jumps off cliffs every day in the hopes of one day soaring through the sky. If they survive the fall, they will run away and hide in shame.

entry: POKENAME虽然发不出任何声音，却能用幻象假扮其他人和宝可梦。它比索罗亚更入戏，会花很长时间观察旁人，完善演技。
author: .jerden
source: Although unable to make any sound, POKENAME uses illusion to pretend to be other people and Pokémon. POKENAME gets much more into the role than Zorua, and will spend a long time watching others to improve its act.

entry: POKENAME带着孩子气的天性，将无害的模仿与尾上闪烁的火花结合。它常用火焰把戏逗旁人开心，可幻象有时反而会吓着周围的生灵。
author: themegatroll
source: With its childlike nature, POKENAME combines harmless mimicry with flickering sparks from its tail. It often entertains others with fiery tricks, but its illusions sometimes end up startling those around it.

entry: POKENAME手上的球能随意取下。常能看见它抛接球，逗得孩子和其他宝可梦十分开心。
author: atlas3339098
source: The balls on POKENAME's hands can be detached at will. It can often be found juggling, much to the delight of children and other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME虽没什么肢体，仍尽心模仿别人。最好多鼓励它，因为POKENAME一难过，便会不由自主地放出毒孢子。
author: enemyphase
source: POKENAME do their best to mimic others, despite their lack of appendages. It's best to encourage this behavior, as when POKENAME get upset they can't help but release toxic spores.

entry: 如今，越来越常能在儿童医院里看见帮忙的POKENAME。它们用柔软的绒毛与抛接球表演，为需要关怀的孩子带去欢乐和安慰。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: It's increasingly common to find a POKENAME at children's hospitals helping around. With their soft tufts and juggling act, they bring joy and comfort to the children that need it.

entry: POKENAME常在马戏表演中登场，声呐让它们时刻掌握周围的动静。一队POKENAME能合演精巧的空中节目，逗得孩子们满心欢喜。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are commonly used Pokémon during circus performances, their sonar allowing them to constantly sense what's happening around them. A troupe of POKENAME create elaborate mid-air performances to the delight of children.

entry: POKENAME的声音会随环境和所见所闻改变。它有个坏习惯，会模仿其他宝可梦最怕的敌人的叫声，吓得对方丢下食物逃走。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME's voice changes based on its environment and the observations it makes. It has a foul habit of imitating the cries of a Pokémon's worst enemy to scare them into leaving their food behind.

entry: POKENAME翅上脱落的彩纸常被用于生日派对，因此POKENAME很受表演者欢迎。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The confetti that comes off of POKENAME's wings are often often used at birthday parties. POKENAME is popular among entertainers as a result of this.

entry: POKENAME未成年时，藏在黑暗的缝隙里学习模仿其他生物。它们靠父母供食，却从不挨饿。
author: gooeygamer69
source: POKENAME hide in dark crevices learning to mimic other creatures before they reach adulthood. They rely on food from their parents, but never go hungry.

entry: 护士常以POKENAME为助手，它的超能力能使人不由自主地笑起来，往往立刻让病人开心。看见旁人欢笑，它自己也很快乐。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: POKENAME is commonly used by Nurses, as its psychic abilities cause spontaneous laughter, often instantly cheering up patients. POKENAME finds joy in seeing others laugh as well.

entry: POKENAME偷看舞蹈教室，学会舞步，再挥舞双臂表演。但那异常流畅的动作，会让观众感到不安。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME waves its arms in dances learned by spying on dance studios. Its performances unsettle those who watch due to its oddly smooth movements.

entry: 它出没于森林，模仿孩子的尖叫吓人，纯粹为了自娱自乐。每只POKENAME模仿的尖叫声都不相同。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It haunts forests and mimics the screams of children to scare people. It only does this for its own amusement. The mimicked screams are unique to each POKENAME.

entry: 若有人不欣赏自己的舞蹈与模仿，POKENAME就会捏住鼻子，让头上的花朝对方喷出有害液体，使其沾上数日不散的恶臭。
author: sk372
source: If it finds a person unappreciative of its dances and mimicry, POKENAME squeezes its nose. This causes the flower on its head to squirt a noxious liquid at the victim, leaving them tainted with the foul smell for days.

entry: POKENAME模仿敌人的动作和表情，吸收对方惊讶、入迷的情绪作为能量。由于不再是原本的究极奈克洛兹玛形态，它模仿时有时会弄不清该动哪个部位。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME mimics the movements and expressions of foes, absorbing their surprised and captivated emotions for energy. It sometimes confuses itself about which body part to move in its mimicry, as it's not in its original Ultra Necrozma form.

entry: POKENAME天生能将周围的沙染成各种鲜艳色彩。把这些沙层层装进瓶里，是庆典上广受欢迎的活动。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME has the ability to naturally dye the sand around it with an assortment of bright colors. A popular attraction at festivals involves layering this sand into bottles.

entry: POKENAME背上蘑菇的白色尖端，能帮助它集中念动力。它只凭意念就能轻松举起巨石，在洞窟家园中通行时十分有用。
author: .izik
source: The white tips of the toadstools growing from POKENAME's back allow it to focus its telekinetic abilities. It can easily lift a boulder using only its mind, which proves useful when navigating its cave home.

entry: POKENAME以五彩的颈褶为傲，总乐于展示鲜艳的颜色。它振动颈褶，在身后造出美丽的彩色极光，让旁人惊叹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's multicolored frill is a point of pride for it. It is always happy to show off its vibrant coloration, vibrating the frill to create a beautiful colored aurora behind it to impress others.

entry: 感到训练家有危险时，POKENAME会尖声吠叫，立刻筑起无形墙壁保护对方。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME senses that its Trainer is in danger, it lets out a sharp bark and instantly erects invisible walls to protect them.

entry: POKENAME是华丽大赛中很受欢迎的选择。演出开始，它们便从耐心警觉的姿态一跃而起，展开令人眼花缭乱的杂技。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME are popular choices for Pokémon Contests. Once it's showtime, they launch from their patient, alert pose into a bewildering series of acrobatic tricks.

entry: 狩猎时，POKENAME会筑起孢子墙，再通过舞蹈控制墙壁，将猎物围困其中。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME creates walls of spores while hunting. It performs dances to control these walls and encase its prey within them.

entry: POKENAME凭抛接球的本领，在马戏团里深受孩子喜爱。技艺尤其高超的个体，还会将抛接棒点燃再表演。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are quite popular among children at circuses due to their juggling skills. Particularly skilled POKENAME light their pins on fire before juggling.

entry: POKENAME喜欢将泡沫压成球，表演精彩的抛接技艺。受到攻击时，它们便把泡沫球扔向攻击者，遮住对方视线，趁机逃走。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME enjoy creating balls of packed foam, juggling them quite impressively. If attacked, these Pokémon will throw these balls at their attackers, obscuring their vision and allowing them to escape.

entry: 这种宝可梦滑稽又爱玩，吃下形形色色的有机物与无机物，便能放出各种颜色的烟。它或许无忧无虑过了头，偶尔已身处险境，却全然不知。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is a fun-loving and silly Pokémon that can emit smoke in all kinds of colors thanks to its varied diet of organic and inorganic matter. It may be a bit too happy-go-lucky; it occasionally puts itself into dangerous situations completely unaware.

entry: POKENAME会耍把戏，试着逗孩子开心。若孩子不买账，它就会施咒，直到下一个10月才解除。
author: dyanz0
source: POKENAME plays tricks on little kids to try and entertain them. When the kids are not impressed with what it does, POKENAME curses them until the next October.

entry: POKENAME受笑声吸引，常见于儿童生日聚会。格外热闹的聚会，甚至能将一英里外的它们成群引来，可它们一到场，往往就扫了兴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are drawn to the sound of laughter, and are a common sight at children's birthday parties. Swarms of them can be drawn in from up to a mile away by particularly exuberant parties, though their arrival often kills the mood.

entry: POKENAME会准备大棒棒糖、棉花糖等马戏团零食，常大把分给情侣和孩子，盼大家带着快乐与满满回忆离开。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME prepare circus treats such as large lollipops or cotton candy. They are known to give couples and children plenty of treats, and hope people leave happy and full of memories.

entry: POKENAME爱表演滑稽把戏，其中最喜欢的之一，是假装在尾巴上烤棉花糖。演出结束后，它会让孩子们安全地玩尾巴上的火焰。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to perform silly tricks, and one of their favorite tricks is where they pretend to roast a marshmallow over their tail. After a performance, they allow children to safely play with the flame on their tail.

entry: POKENAME被欢呼声和热闹表演吸引，在马戏场地周围打洞安家。有时能见它们从大帐篷的地面钻出，观看小丑演出。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their burrows around circus grounds, drawn to the sounds of cheer and lively performances. They can sometimes be seen popping up from the ground within the big top to watch the clown performances.

entry: POKENAME能造出超能力墙壁，却不懂如何巧妙运用于表演。有时，它们会忘记墙放在哪里，连自己也撞上去。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of producing walls made out of psychic energy but lack the tact to use them in performances. Sometimes they bump into their own walls because they forget where they place them.

entry: POKENAME常见于马戏团，尤其擅长抛接杂耍与空中飞人。它们极少在表演中出错，但一旦失误，就会怒不可遏。
author: fancyskunk
source: Often seen at circuses, POKENAME are particularly skilled jugglers and trapeze artists. On the rare occasions that they make a mistake during a performance, they fly into an uncontrollable rage.

entry: POKENAME顺从忠诚，总体很容易训练，学习、执行指令与手势都快得惊人。有人因此猜测，它也许能读心。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is obedient and loyal and overall easy to train, learning and following commands and gestures with surprising speed. Some have suggested that it may be able to read minds.

entry: POKENAME很爱和孩子玩，会让孩子爬上背，载着跑。虽然并无恶意，家长仍最好谨慎，因为它们奔跑得极快。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME love to play with children, allowing children to climb onto their back for rides. Even though they are not malicious, parents are advised to be wary of letting POKENAME take their children for rides since POKENAME run extremely fast.

entry: 这个默剧演员脾气十分凶暴，随时可能毫无预警地出手。训练家教导它时，必须留神。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: This mime has a highly aggressive disposition. Trainers should be careful training it, as it is likely to lash out with no warning.

entry: 据说，POKENAME唯有受到细心的爱护，并见识过数十种独特表演，才会完全进化。它们会模仿训练家的睡眠作息。
author: bobosmith01
source: It has been said that only when POKENAME have been given tender love and care and have experienced dozens of unique performances will they fully evolve. They mimic their Trainers' sleep patterns.

entry: 据说，POKENAME唯有受到细心的爱护，并见识过数十种独特表演，才会完全进化。它们会模仿训练家的睡眠作息。
author: bobosmith01
source: It has been said that only when POKENAME have been given tender love and care and have experienced dozens of unique performances will they fully evolve. They mimic their Trainers' sleep patterns.

entry: POKENAME双臂的肌肉，远比看上去弱。为保持好心情，它们随身带着标注极重、实际却没那么重的物品。
author: chibitales
source: The muscles in POKENAME's arms are much weaker than they look. In order to keep up their mood, they carry around objects that, while labelled as extremely heavy, are not actually as heavy as they seem.

entry: POKENAME的模仿不只停留在身体动作。常能看到它吹出形似身旁生灵的泡泡，练习哑剧。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's attempts at mimicry go further than just physical movements. It can often be seen practicing miming by blowing bubbles that take the shape of those near it.

entry: POKENAME新觉醒的第三只眼赋予它强大超能力，常被用来辅助抛接杂耍。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME's newly awakened third eye gives it strong psychic powers. It uses this power to assist its juggling.

entry: POKENAME没信心凭自己逗人发笑，便转而模仿魔墙焰马。它最爱的把戏，是站在弹力球上保持平衡。听到笑声，火焰鬃毛就会更加明亮。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME lacks the confidence to make others laugh on its own, so it mimics Mr. dash instead. Its favourite trick is balancing on its bouncy ball. When it hears laughter, its fiery mane glows brighter.

entry: POKENAME将尾巴浸入水中，摇来摆去，像在模仿鱼游动。有什么咬住尾巴时，大约5秒后，它才会应声发出喇叭般的一响。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME dips its tail in water and wags it around like it is trying to mime a fish swimming. When something bites its tail, it will let out a reactionary honk sound after about 5 seconds.

entry: 这种宝可梦十分滑稽，爱模仿旁人的动作，却做得太慢，常演到一半就忘记自己原本要做什么。忘掉后，它会转而模仿别的，通常还是同样的结果。
author: foolish_weasel
source: A very silly Pokémon, it enjoys mimicking the actions of others but does it so slowly that it often forgets what it is trying to do mid-routine. When it forgets, it will try to copy something else, usually achieving the same result.

entry: POKENAME用超能力与磁场，托住抛接的球。可力量并不强，年幼POKENAME尤其如此，球常常掉下来。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME uses both its psychic energy and the magnetic field from its magnets to keep its juggling balls in the air. However, these powers can be quite weak, especially in younger POKENAME, so it often will drop balls.

entry: 进化后，多颗头带来额外磁力，让POKENAME能更好地控制杂耍。常能看见POKENAME身旁，漂着各式金属物件。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: Upon its evolution, the extra magnetic power that POKENAME gets from its multiple heads allows for more control over its juggling. It isn't uncommon to see POKENAME floating miscellaneous metallic items around itself.

entry: POKENAME看见什么把戏都想模仿，却最常待在海魔狮身旁。它们模仿海魔狮用鼻子顶住、转动物品的样子，最后也能变得一样熟练。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will try to imitate any trick they see, but are most often seen around Sealeo. They will mimic the way that these Pokémon balance and spin objects on their noses, and eventually become equally skilled at it.

entry: POKENAME背上的炮能射出看似无害的彩纸屑。但狩猎时，它会在射击中混入滚烫热水，造成严重烫伤。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The cannons on POKENAME's back fire apparently harmless confetti. However, when it is hunting, POKENAME infuses scalding water into its shots, causing intense burns.

entry: POKENAME爱惹麻烦，恶作剧和把戏让许多训练家抓狂。它们捣起乱来没完没了，直到训练家痛得叫出声，才肯停下。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to cause trouble and drive many Trainers crazy with their pranks and tricks. They are unrelenting with their mischief and only stop when the Trainers cry out in pain.

entry: POKENAME身上独特的花纹十分显眼。融合时得到的小丑妆容，让它们常常模仿涂满涂鸦的墙。
author: snookerron
source: POKENAME are easy to spot due to their distinctive markings. They can often be found imitating graffitied walls due to the clown make-up acquired during their fusion.

entry: POKENAME在海滩跳起复杂的舞蹈，吸引其他同类的注意。它们很受海滨游乐场所欢迎，表演尤其能逗乐孩子。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME perform elaborate dances to attract the attention of other POKENAME on the beach. They are popular Pokémon for beachside attractions, their performances being particularly entertaining to children.

entry: POKENAME在海滩跳起复杂的舞蹈，吸引其他同类的注意。它们很受海滨游乐场所欢迎，表演尤其能逗乐孩子。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME perform elaborate dances to attract the attention of other POKENAME on the beach. They are popular Pokémon for beachside attractions, their performances being particularly entertaining to children.

entry: POKENAME从口中吐出黏丝，包裹受伤的人和宝可梦。丝有疗愈作用，能帮助伤口更快愈合。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wraps injured people and Pokémon in sticky silk drawn from its mouth. The thread holds healing properties that help wounds close faster.

entry: POKENAME总盼着受到关注，太久无人理睬，就会大发脾气。蛋状石头或棍棒若出了什么事，它们便会闹得最凶。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are always pining for attention and will throw tantrums if they go long enough without receiving any. Their tantrums are at their worst if anything should happen to their egg-like stones or their clubs.

entry: POKENAME的拳头虽然像蛋壳，却坚硬如石。拳头出现裂纹，就表示进化即将到来。
author: staghorn
source: Despite resembling eggshells, POKENAME's fists are as hard as stone. When cracks form in its fists, its evolution is imminent.

entry: POKENAME沿树枝爬行，一路留下尾巴上蛋状的尖端，再长出新的。这些尾尖是幼年虫属性宝可梦成长时的健康零食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME crawls along the tree branches, leaving behind the egg-like tip of its tail and growing new ones in its wake. These tail-tips are a healthy snack for growing young Bug-type Pokémon.

entry: 吸入POKENAME放出的气体，会让人有些飘飘然。不过仍须小心，气体依旧有轻微毒性，短时间吸入过多便会生病。
author: sk372
source: Inhaling the gases produced by POKENAME gives a person a light feeling of giddiness. One should be careful, however, as the gases are still mildly toxic and will cause illness if breathed in too much in a short time.

entry: POKENAME把蛋存放在腹中，保温直至孵化。繁殖季后，雄性会聚在一起，共同照顾这些蛋。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME stores eggs in its belly, keeping them warm until they hatch. After breeding season, males congregate and care for the eggs together.

entry: POKENAME常与其他水属性宝可梦混居，成群游在它们的育幼地周围，照顾留下的蛋。若有捕食者来袭，就会带着蛋转移到安全处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are often found amongst other species of Water-type Pokémon. They school around the nurseries of other species, taking care of the eggs left behind and carrying them to safety in case of predator attacks.

entry: POKENAME害羞又容易受惊，常躲着陌生的人和宝可梦。受到惊吓时，烟和余烬会从全身的孔洞喷出。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is shy and easily intimidated, so it tends to stay away from unfamiliar people and Pokémon. If surprised, smoke and embers spurt out of every orifice of its body.

entry: 这种虫类宝可梦始终用钳子守着一块白色大石头，以为那是一颗蛋。若肯让训练家碰石头，就说明它对对方有着极深的信任。
author: opossiblymage
source: This bug Pokémon constantly guards a large white stone in its pincers, thinking it to be an egg. If it allows a Trainer to touch the stone, it has an extreme bond of trust with them.

entry: POKENAME亲子本能极强，任何无人看管的蛋都会认作自己的，用特殊的尾巴携带、照料。它们天生没有防身本领，只能靠速度保护托付给自己的蛋。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a parental instinct so strong that they will claim any unattended egg as their own, using their specialised tail to carry and care for it. They have no natural defences, making their speed their only means of protecting their charge.

entry: POKENAME生性爱好和平，又没什么防御手段。捕食者靠近时，它会试着献上尾端可取下的球，通常足以让对方饱上一天。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is pacifistic in nature, and lacks major defenses. If a predator draws near, it attempts to offer the detachable orb on its tail instead, which sates most appetites for a day.

entry: POKENAME亲子本能强烈，任何一窝蛋只要无人看管超过数小时，它们便会接手。它将蛋收进特殊的口袋里，用巨大的身体保护。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have powerful parental instincts and will take over any nest where the eggs have been left alone for more than a few hours. They collect the eggs and carry them in a specialised pouch, using their giant bodies to protect them.

entry: POKENAME格外珍惜随身带着的蛋状石头。变身时，它也会在新形态中保留口袋，好继续带着这珍贵的宝贝。
author: sk372
source: The egg-shaped stones POKENAME carry are extremely precious to it. When it transforms, it will keep a pouch as part of the new form so that it can continue to carry its precious cargo.

entry: POKENAME出现在电脑屏幕上时，会先送给使用者一枚小小的蛋形纪念物，再离开。虽然没什么实际价值，许多网络社群却乐于比较各自收集了多少。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME appears on a computer's screen, it gifts the user a small, egg-shaped token before leaving. While they have no real value, many online communities enjoy comparing how many POKENAME tokens they've collected.

entry: POKENAME躺在沙地上休息，浅色的外表常被认作遭遗弃的蛋。若有什么想捡起它，它便迅速翻身，咬对方一口，再匆匆逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rests itself on the sands, its pale exterior often being mistaken for an abandoned egg. If something tries to pick it up, it quickly rolls over and nips at them before making a hasty retreat.

entry: POKENAME什么圆东西都收集，却似乎尤其喜欢蛋化石。已有数处发掘现场和博物馆遭它们闯入，珍贵标本就这样被带着飞走。
author: .jerden
source: While POKENAME will collect any round object, they seem to be most drawn to fossilized eggs. Several dig sites and museums have been raided by POKENAME, which flew off carrying valuable specimens.

entry: POKENAME用超能力将蛋状石头系在尾巴上，悉心保护。睡觉时，它会用整个身体紧紧抱住石头。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses psychic abilities to keep an egg-shaped stone attached to its tail. It takes great care to keep the stone safe, and clings to it with its whole body when sleeping.

entry: POKENAME最爱吃蛋，却常把圆石误认成蛋。幸好牙齿与双颚都结实得很，吃下去也无妨。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME frequently mistake round stones for eggs; their food of choice. Thankfully, their fangs and jaws are very sturdy and suffer no consequences.

entry: POKENAME最爱吃蛋，却常把圆石误认成蛋。幸好牙齿与双颚都结实得很，吃下去也无妨。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME frequently mistake round stones for eggs; their food of choice. Thankfully, their fangs and jaws are very sturdy and suffer no consequences.

entry: 年幼的POKENAME先练习携带岳竹果，圆润的果形可用来模拟蛋。这个阶段约持续一年，此后，它便长得足够大，能够稳稳带着真正的蛋。
author: quackquackattack
source: Very early in life, POKENAME practices carrying a Magost Berry, as their round shape helps them mimic the shape of an egg. This period of time lasts approximately one year, after which it grows big enough to hold an egg properly.

entry: POKENAME在野外找到蛋状石头，就围着筑巢，坐上去照料，为将来照顾真蛋练习。它严格遵守作息，每隔5分钟便准时检查一次。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME finds egg-shaped rocks in the wild and creates nests around them, then sits on and nurtures them as practice for future real eggs. It has a strict schedule of checking the status of its charge every five minutes on the dot.

entry: 每只POKENAME都有偏爱的坚果或树果，进化前坚持只吃这一种。它们射出长长的丝线，收集心爱的食物，也会包好留待以后享用。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME individually have their preferred nut or berry that they will insist upon eating as their sole food until they evolve. They will shoot long strands of their silk to collect their favored food and will wrap it up and store it for later, too.

entry: POKENAME很友善，常用蛛网包起树果和坚果，存着以后吃。在它们栖息的森林里，常散落着这种小包裹，留给其他生灵享用。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are friendly Pokémon that often wrap berries and nuts up in their webs to save for later. Forests where POKENAME live are often littered with these self-same bundles that these Pokémon leave for others to enjoy.

entry: POKENAME背上有特殊的硬羽，能承载大蛋。它们会成群合作，搬迁废弃的宝可梦巢穴，好接手照料。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have special, stiffened feathers across their back that enable them to carry large eggs. They work in flocks to relocate abandoned Pokémon nests so that they can take care of them.

entry: 老师给几份零食，POKENAME就愿意坐在课堂里，为孩子们树立好榜样。许多老师也会在课上加入星星的知识，吸引它们的注意。
author: quackquackattack
source: In exchange for a few treats from a teacher, POKENAME sit in classrooms where they set a good example for children to follow. Many teachers also incorporate lessons about stars to keep the attention of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME看见任何一窝蛋，都会站在旁边，一动不动地守候。唯有照看的蛋平安孵化，它们才会移动。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will stand next to and watch any clutches of eggs they come across, remaining motionless as they stand guard. These Pokémon will only move once the eggs they've been looking after hatch safely.

entry: 虽然偶尔能见POKENAME乘风飘浮，但成功落地后，它有时会捡起石头，免得自己再被吹走。它性情温和，不爱争斗。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although occasionally found floating in the air and riding on the breeze, POKENAME that manage to land will sometimes pick up stones to keep themselves grounded. They have a gentle disposition and do not like fighting.

entry: POKENAME收集白色小石头，放进一个个小巢中。它平时温顺，却会坚决守护这些巢，对靠得太近的对象又咬又抓。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gathers up small white stones and places them together in small nests. Though normally docile, it will staunchly protect these nests, biting and scratching those coming too close.

entry: 它们精力旺盛又调皮，什么都想拿蛋砸，见谁也想扔。因此，许多地方都不许它们进入。
author: sottiwotti
source: They are very energetic and mischievous Pokémon. They like to throw eggs at anything and everyone, which is why they are banned from many places.

entry: POKENAME用随身的小石头，练习将来照顾真正的种子。它甚至将石头埋进新土，给足阳光与水，还会唱歌，盼着石头长大。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the small stones it carries to practice taking care of actual plant seeds in the future. It will even bury them in fresh soil with plenty of sunlight and water provided, even singing to the stones to promote their growth.

entry: POKENAME用触角感知其他宝可梦的情绪，连一丝负面感受也十分敏感。情绪承受不住时，便尖叫起来，常把附近育幼所的小宝可梦吓一跳。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME uses its antennae to sense the emotions of other Pokémon, becoming highly sensitive to even the slightest negative feelings. When overwhelmed, it lets out a loud screech, often startling other baby Pokémon in nearby nurseries.

entry: POKENAME心思单纯、天真善良，却因健忘，常觉得照顾别人力不从心，于是转而宠爱自己收集的石头。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME is a simple-minded, innocent, and kindly Pokémon. It often has difficulty caring for others due to its forgetfulness, so it dotes on its collection of rocks instead.

entry: POKENAME对蛋十分着迷，常俯冲到其他宝可梦的巢里偷蛋。可一般宝可梦的蛋对它来说太重，带着飞不快，因此常被蛋的父母抓个正着。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has a fascination with eggs and will often swoop down to steal them from the nests of other Pokémon. It is often caught by the parents, as it cannot fly fast while carrying something as heavy as the average Pokémon egg.

entry: POKENAME在树上挖洞，存放蛋状石头，一来练习将来保护真正的蛋，二来能舔掉石头上美味的树液，顺便将其清理干净。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stores egg-shaped stones inside holes dug into trees. The reasoning for doing this is twofold: practice for safeguarding actual eggs in the future, and to lick and clean tasty sap off the stones.

entry: POKENAME极富同情心，常照顾栖息地里的伤者。它们精挑细选石头，放进壳里携带，练习为人父母，几乎不让石头离开视线。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are highly compassionate Pokémon that often tend to injured members of their habitat. They practice parenting by carrying carefully selected stones in their shells, rarely letting them out of their sight.

entry: POKENAME生活在山脉中，将家安在冰川的冰碛地带。它们四处寻找其他宝可梦废弃的筑巢处，将遗失的蛋认作自己的，收养照料。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in mountain ranges, making their homes at the moraines of glaciers. They spend their time hunting for abandoned nesting sites of other Pokémon, adopting any lost eggs as their own.

entry: POKENAME只求一件事：看见其他人和宝可梦开心。它努力邀大家玩耍，却往往热情过头、惹人厌烦，反倒无意中把人推远。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME only wants exactly one thing: to see other people and Pokémon be happy; it strives to achieve this through attempting to play with others. However, it inadvertently pushes people away due to being too cheerful, to a bothersome extent.

entry: POKENAME年幼而缺乏经验，身体却结实得足以挺过失误。学飞时，哪怕从高大的成树上摔下，也不会受伤。
author: havic0970
source: POKENAME is young and inexperienced, but hardy enough to survive mistakes. When learning to fly, it can fall from tall, mature trees without injury.

entry: POKENAME很有同理心，若分到的食物比同伴多，就不肯吃。它们用鼻子带着蛋四处走动，每次弄丢都会难过。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a strong sense of empathy and will not eat if they are given more than their peers. They tote around their egg by carrying it with their snout and get upset whenever they lose their egg.

entry: POKENAME试着模仿其他顿甲滚动，却总会撞上东西。虽然频频出错，它们依旧开朗，喜欢与同伴共处。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME try to emulate the rolling of other Donphan but often find that they bump into objects. Despite their frequent mistakes, they are cheerful Pokémon that enjoy spending time with their peers.

entry: 数台电脑的屏幕被宝可梦蛋的图像占据，慢得几乎停摆，POKENAME就这样首次被发现。图像消失后，电脑运行顺畅了许多，而人们看见它逃了出来。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME were first discovered after several computers were slowed to a halt by an image of a Pokémon Egg taking up the screens. Once the image disappeared, the computers ran much more efficiently and POKENAME were seen fleeing.

entry: 数台电脑的屏幕被宝可梦蛋的图像占据，慢得几乎停摆，POKENAME就这样首次被发现。图像消失后，电脑运行顺畅了许多，而人们看见它逃了出来。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME were first discovered after several computers were slowed to a halt by an image of a Pokémon Egg taking up the screens. Once the image disappeared, the computers ran much more efficiently and POKENAME were seen fleeing.

entry: POKENAME深爱随身带着的蛋状石头。若被拿走，它便会难过，向任何人猛烈挑战，誓要夺回。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME loves the egg-shaped stone it carries. If it gets taken away, it will become upset and will fiercely challenge anyone to get it back.

entry: POKENAME极富同理心，许多医院都用它辅助护理。无论受伤的是人还是宝可梦，它总会给予情感上的支持。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME is a very empathetic Pokémon that has been employed as a nursing assistant in many hospitals. It always provides emotional support to any injured person or Pokémon.

entry: 它口中的蛋，其实是一块蛋状石头。它极力保护石头，谁想偷走，无论人还是宝可梦，都会遭到猛烈攻击。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: The egg in its mouth is actually an egg-shaped stone. It is quite protective of the stone, and will violently lash out at people or Pokémon who try to steal it.

entry: POKENAME的毛发十分保暖，也能轻松承受灼热，因此常见于温度极端的地区。起初虽笨手笨脚，稍加训练，它就能成为照料宝可梦蛋的能手。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's fur traps warmth very well and it can also easily handle scalding heat, so it is most often found in areas of extreme temperature. Although clumsy at first, it can become an expert caretaker of Pokémon Eggs with just a little training.

entry: POKENAME的毛发十分保暖，也能轻松承受灼热，因此常见于温度极端的地区。它们有时虽显得幼稚天真，心中最想做的，却只是帮助其他宝可梦。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's fur traps warmth very well and it can also easily handle scalding heat, so it is most often found in areas of extreme temperature. Although they have moments of immaturity and naivety, they want nothing more than to help other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME腹部有个口袋，能装小物件。它们偏爱带着磁石和蕴含属性能量的石头，其中的能量让它们满心欢喜。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a pouch in their stomach that enables them to hold small objects. They are drawn to holding magnetic and elemental stones, the energies contained in them bringing them joy to carry.

entry: 传说，POKENAME送出的白色圆石，能让持有者永远幸福。科学虽已证明并非如此，这份善意仍能让宝可梦与收礼的人都更加快乐。
author: soup1900
source: Legends say that the round, white stones POKENAME gives to others grant eternal happiness to the holder. While proven scientifically false, this act of kindness does boost the happiness of both the Pokémon and the person receiving the gift.

entry: 手中握着的白色小石头，能让它安心。若发现伤者，它便会透过石头引导超能力，放出舒缓疼痛的波动，直到对方得到妥善治疗。
author: porterofgames
source: It finds comfort in the small white stone it holds. If it notices someone injured, it will channel psychic energy through the stone, sending soothing waves of pain relief until they can be properly treated.

entry: 它习惯将小石头藏在浓密的毛羽间。虽说得不到想要的东西就常发脾气、哭闹，总体而言，它仍十分亲人，甚至颇为外向。
author: bobosmith01
source: It habitually hides a small stone somewhere in its bushy fur and feathers. Although it often throws tantrums and cries when it doesn't get what it wants, it is overall very affectionate and even outgoing.

entry: POKENAME腹部有个口袋，能装小物件。它们偏爱带着磁石和蕴含属性能量的石头，其中的能量让它们满心欢喜。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a pouch in their stomach that enables them to hold small objects. They are drawn to holding magnetic and elemental stones, the energies contained in them bringing them joy to carry.

entry: POKENAME腹部有个口袋，能装小物件。它们偏爱带着磁石和蕴含属性能量的石头，其中的能量让它们满心欢喜。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a pouch in their stomach that enables them to hold small objects. They are drawn to holding magnetic and elemental stones, the energies contained in them bringing them joy to carry.

entry: POKENAME对宝可梦蛋十分着迷，常在其他宝可梦的巢边徘徊，趁父母不在时看护。它们守在蛋上方，除了父母，谁敢靠近就电谁。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a fascination with Pokémon eggs, hanging around the nests of other Pokémon and watching over the eggs in the absence of their parents. They stand protectively over the eggs, shocking anyone other than the parents that try to come close.

entry: POKENAME善良慷慨，自己虽然食量惊人，仍常将存粮分给需要的生灵。最可口的树果，则留给最喜欢的人和宝可梦。
author: quantumradiation
source: POKENAME is kind-hearted and generous, often sharing its stashes of food with those in need despite its own voracious appetite. It gives the tastiest berries to the people and Pokémon it likes the most.

entry: POKENAME顶部有孵化装置，用来照料蛋，直至孵化。它发出强力磁波，排斥一切可能伤到蛋的东西。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has an incubator apparatus on its top, used to nurture eggs until hatching. It uses powerful magnetic waves to repel away anything that could possibly harm the eggs it cares for.

entry: POKENAME能从臂炮射出看似蛋的东西，其实都是石头。刚进化、还不知道这点的个体，可能以为自己在用营养丰富的生蛋替伙伴疗伤，结果却将对方砸昏。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can fire off what appear to be eggs from its arm cannons. These eggs are actually rocks; a newly evolved POKENAME unaware of this may think it is giving an ally a nutritious Soft-Boiled egg for healing only to knock them out instead.

entry: POKENAME尾端的蛋状器官，其实是毒囊。它以此引来偷蛋的宝可梦，球囊随即爆开，令前来捕猎者沾满使其虚弱的毒液，反成了轻易到手的猎物。
author: sk372
source: The egg-like organ at the end of POKENAME's tail is actually a poison sac. It uses it as a lure to draw out egg-poaching Pokémon, before the bulb bursts and coats the would-be hunter with a debilitating poison, making it easy prey.

entry: POKENAME不断浏览医疗网站，寻找帮助他人的新方法。可惜，它光是待在那里就会扰乱数据，离开后，网站上的文字和图片已变得毫无用处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME constantly wanders through medical websites trying to discover new ways to help others. Unfortunately, its mere presence distorts data, causing text and images on these sites to become useless after it leaves.

entry: POKENAME用宽大柔软的尾巴带着蛋，保护并保温。尾巴能让蛋保持完美平衡，凡有什么威胁到平衡，便会遭到它的猛烈反应。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries eggs on its large, soft tail to keep them safe and warm. Its tail perfectly balances the egg while carrying it, and reacts aggressively towards anything that threatens that balance.

entry: POKENAME四处寻找需要帮助的训练家，常搜寻木棍，借助自己的火焰本领，在寒夜为训练家取暖或引路。
author: sk1ttl3z2025
source: POKENAME tends to wander in search of Trainers to help, often searching for sticks to use its fire capabilities to warm or guide a Trainer during the cold night.

entry: 这种宝可梦爱收集小石头，注入微弱的超能力，送给喜欢的人。持有者难过时，石头会黯淡；开心时，则会发亮。
author: quietcognition
source: This Pokémon loves collecting small stones, which it imbues with weak psychic power and gives to people it likes. A stone becomes dull if its holder is sad, but shines if they are happy.

entry: POKENAME爱玩形似蛋的白石头，却常忘记自己得练习育蛋。用鼻子顶蛋固然有趣，但通常很快就会受到巢中其他成员的责备。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to play with white stones that resemble eggs but often forget that they need to practice their egg-rearing skills. While balancing an egg on their snout is entertaining, they are often quickly reprimanded by other nest members.

entry: POKENAME把木块啃成蛋的形状，再照料、保护这颗木蛋，练习将来有一天照顾真正的蛋。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gnaws on wood pieces until they're worn down into the shape of an egg. It then nurtures and protects the wooden egg, in practice for one day nurturing the real deal.

entry: POKENAME待在蛋形的楔石里，滚向其他宝可梦的巢。巢遇险时，它会放出硫磺气味，吓退前来偷蛋的捕食者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME roll around in an egg-shaped keystone towards nests of other Pokémon. When the nest is in danger, POKENAME release a sulfurous odor that deters predators from stealing eggs.

entry: POKENAME顶在头上的蛋，其实是石头。它像对待真蛋一样小心，若谁想粗手粗脚地触碰，它便会躲开。
author: hophoppip
source: The egg POKENAME holds on its head is actually a stone. POKENAME treats it as delicately as it would a real egg, pulling away from anyone who attempts to touch it too roughly.

entry: 口袋里没有圆东西，POKENAME就睡不着。若有人拿走它的蛋状石头，它会伤心到无法安抚，直到找到替代品。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME cannot sleep without a round object in its pouch. If anyone manages to take POKENAME's egg-shaped rock away from it, POKENAME will be inconsolable until it finds a replacement.

entry: 只要白色圆石在身边，POKENAME就很温顺。若有人想拿走，它会迅速抢回来，通常还会用同一块石头砸对方的头。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is docile as long as it has its round white rock. If anyone tries to take it away, POKENAME will quickly snatch it back and usually bashes anyone who tries on the head with the same rock.

entry: 古老故事中，POKENAME将旁观者的敬畏吸入胸前的蛋状囊中。极少数时候，蛋会变得漆黑，放出无法解释的光束。
author: .izik
source: Ancient tales claim POKENAME absorbs reverence from onlookers into the egg-like capsule on its chest. On rare occasions the egg turns jet black, releasing unexplained beams of light.

entry: 它把闪亮的石头种进地里，耐心等着发芽。虽然从没长出什么，每埋下一颗新石头，它还是骄傲得笑逐颜开。
author: jaminmcready
source: It plants shiny stones in the ground and patiently waits for them to sprout. Though nothing ever grows, it beams with pride at each new one it buries.

entry: POKENAME将找到的白色小物件藏进秘密收藏处，再用缎带赶走入侵者，守住珍藏。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME stashes away small, white objects it finds in a hidden hoard. It guards it by shooing away invaders with its ribbon.

entry: POKENAME只靠吉利蛋的蛋维生。它虽不好斗，却常无意间毁掉沿途事物。有些城镇就因它发现住有吉利蛋的宝可梦中心，而陷入危机。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME survives exclusively on a diet of Chansey eggs, and although it is not violent, it often accidentally destroys things in its path. Some towns have been endangered when POKENAME discovered Pokémon Centers with Chansey populations.

entry: 它爱假扮其他宝可梦，好照顾对方的蛋和幼崽。它通常将自己的蛋伪装成石头，赠给心地纯净之人。
author: salt
source: It loves pretending to be other Pokémon to be able to take care of their eggs as well as their babies. It will usually hide its eggs as rocks. It gives them to those it deems pure.

entry: POKENAME带着象牙白的石蛋，练习照顾真正的蛋。它们用触角裹住石头，为其保温。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME carry around an ivory stone egg to practice taking care of eggs. They envelope the stone with their feelers to keep it warm.

entry: POKENAME四处寻找无人看管的蛋，无情地踩碎，再吸入翅膀，留下斑纹，记下自己夺去的生命数量。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME roam in search of unattended eggs, ruthlessly crushing them beneath their feet. They absorb these crushed eggs into their wings, where they serve as markings of how many lives they've taken.

entry: POKENAME带着蛋状大石头，练习照顾真蛋。由于通常只腾得出一只手臂自卫，它们格外擅长以一条带刺鞭子作战，精准得令人胆寒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries around large egg-like stones to practice caring for the real thing. Because this typically leaves it with only one arm to defend itself, they become very adept using a singular thorny whip in battle with devastating precision.

entry: POKENAME所到之处，都带来奇趣。它旋转的菌盖会让敌人放松警惕，误以为十分安全。
author: xephyr
source: POKENAME brings whimsy wherever it goes. The swirling of its mushroom cap lulls foes into a false sense of security.

entry: POKENAME爱蛋，尤其爱吃，会不择手段地从其他宝可梦那里弄来。实在找不到，它可能啃咬蛋状石头，却仍会继续搜寻，直到找到真正的食物。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME loves eggs, specifically to eat, and will acquire them from other Pokémon by any means necessary. If it cannot find any, it may gnaw on egg-shaped rocks, but will not stop searching until it finds real food.

entry: POKENAME只肯花力气，确保白色石头稳稳顶在头上。若石头被拿走，它便会缓慢却执着地爬行追赶，直到取回才肯罢休。
author: .jerden
source: The only effort POKENAME expends is to make sure its white rock remains balanced on top of its head. If the rock is taken away, POKENAME will slowly but relentlessly crawl in pursuit and will not stop until it gets it back.

entry: POKENAME很爱玩，总想和其他宝可梦及人类孩子交朋友。可惜，它动作太慢，玩伴通常很快就失去耐心，离它而去。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is very playful and is always trying to make friends with other Pokémon and human children. Unfortunately, its slow movements mean that its playmates usually get impatient and leave it.

entry: POKENAME像人类婴儿一样慢慢爬行，似乎对周围全无知觉。训练家得留意，别让它爬到街上，绊倒别人，或被车辆碾过。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME slowly crawls around like a human infant and seems to be completely unaware of its surroundings. Trainers must take care that their POKENAME does not crawl out into the street to be tripped on or run over.

entry: POKENAME牢牢守着头上顶住的光滑白石，谁想偷走，就会遭到利爪的狂怒袭击。它爱吃果实，游荡林间，寻找成熟的美味。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME jealously guards the smooth white stone it balances on its head. Anyone who tries to steal it faces its sharp claws in a furious assault. Fond of fruit, it roams the forest in search of ripe delicacies.

entry: POKENAME性情温柔，高兴时会泛起桃色的红晕。它们认真地给随身带着的蛋唱摇篮曲，让里面的孩子安心。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are gentle creatures that have a peach-colored blush whenever they are happy. They diligently sing lullabies to the egg that they carry to ensure the child within feels at ease.

entry: 它的蛋状外壳会分泌可食用的液体，饮下者无不精神大振。越接近进化，分泌出的液体就越多。
author: infinex21
source: Its egg-like shell secretes an edible liquid that fills any who consume it with remarkable vigor. The closer it gets to evolving, the more of this fluid it will secrete.

entry: POKENAME整天守在蛋旁，其实那些只是用幻象伪装成白蛋的石头。它爱跟在吉利蛋身边学习，但若弄丢石头，就会忧心忡忡。
author: salt
source: POKENAME spends all its time next to eggs, which are made from rocks turned into illusions that resemble white eggs. It loves to hang around Chansey to learn from them. However, if it loses its rocks, it will start worrying.

entry: POKENAME把珍珠抱在温暖的腹前，练习照顾蛋。温柔的性情，让它们成为细心疼爱蛋的照料者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hold onto pearls close to their warm stomach to practice caring for an egg. Their warm personalities make them doting caretakers for eggs.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，把耳朵蜷在身旁保暖。育幼场所里，能看见它和其他幼年宝可梦玩耍。
author: quackquackattack
source: When POKENAME sleeps, it curls its ears close to its body to keep them warm. It can be found in nurseries playing with other baby Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME飘游田野，寻找适合围着播种的石头。它将花园中央的石头当成需要帮助的病人，拿自己种的药草练习照料。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME drifts through fields in search of rocks to plant seeds around. It tends to the rock in the center of the garden as if it were a patient in need of help, practicing with the medicinal herbs that it grows.

entry: POKENAME将自己埋进地里，只露出背上的蛋状石头。有其他宝可梦靠近时，若显得弱小，它便会出击；若对方更强，它就继续藏在地下。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME buries itself in the ground, with only the egg-shaped rock it carries on its back exposed. If another Pokémon approaches, POKENAME will attack if it seems vulnerable, but will remain hidden underground if a stronger Pokémon comes close.

entry: POKENAME收集圆圆的小东西，常是卵石、弹珠或种子，带回筑巢处，堆成小丘状的巢。找到最珍贵的那件，则常会放在口袋里随身携带。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME gather small round things, often pebbles, marbles, or seeds, and bring them back to their nesting sites. They will construct mound-like nests consisting of these items, and will often carry the most prized item they've found in their pouch.

entry: POKENAME视力极佳，尤其擅长发现圆形小物件，并会不择手段地弄到手。不过，若偷走的是其他宝可梦的蛋，它也会照料到孵化。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has excellent vision, particularly for spotting small, round objects, which it acquires through any means necessary. However, if POKENAME steals an egg from another Pokémon, it will take care of it until it hatches.

entry: POKENAME若折断一根长牙，就会大发脾气，高声哭闹。虽然损伤无法挽回，它还是会永远珍藏断牙，盼着有一天能修好。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME will start to throw a tantrum and loudly whine if one of its tusks breaks off. Even though the damage is irreversible, it will hold onto and cherish the tusk forever in hopes it could be repaired.

entry: 它们最爱吃新鲜的蛋黄，才不管蛋有没有被遗弃。锋利的爪子，足以挖穿大多数地面。
author: infinex21
source: Their favorite food is the yolk of fresh eggs, be they abandoned or not. Their claws are sharp enough to burrow through most terrain.

entry: POKENAME常宁愿跳舞助威、支持队友，也不愿亲自上场。艰苦的比赛过后，它会赶到朋友身边，用绒球做轻柔的电流按摩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME dances and cheers to support its teammates, often preferring it to actually being in battle. After grueling matches, it rushes to its friends' side to deliver a light electric massage with its pom-poms.

entry: POKENAME多在破碎的宝可梦蛋旁被发现，因此许多人以为，它们来自未能孵化的宝可梦的灵魂。后来才发现，正是它们打破蛋，享用里面的蛋黄。
author: infinex21
source: Because POKENAME have mostly been found near broken Pokémon Eggs, many thought they were born of the spirits of the unhatched Pokémon. It was later discovered that they are the ones who break these eggs to feast on the yolks within.

entry: 这种宝可梦想把蛋放上高处的枝条，确保安全，却因冲动、控制不好力气，常将蛋弄碎。这让它们悲痛不已，继而暴走。
author: t3isukone
source: While these Pokémon try to place eggs high in their branches to keep them safe, their impulsive nature and lack of control over their own strength usually leads them to break them. This upsets them so much it causes them to rampage.

entry: 它们用身体分泌的浓稠黏液，将遭遗弃的大蛋黏在背上携带。为了保护蛋，它们会暂时将蛋藏进中空的身体，即使自己可能因此丧命。
author: infinex21
source: They carry large, abandoned eggs upon their backs with the help of thick, adhesive slime secreted from their bodies. They will temporarily hide these eggs within their hollow bodies to protect them, even if it puts their own lives at risk.

entry: 它以酸性黏液吓退威胁，保护背上的蛋。蛋孵化后，它便找来一块白色大石，用黏液塑成新的“蛋”，继续随身携带。
author: infinex21
source: It uses an acidic slime to deter any threats in order to keep the egg on its back safe. Once the egg hatches, it will find a large, white rock and use its slime to shape it into a new "egg" to carry around.

entry: POKENAME尽力用自己的力量帮助别人。不过它尚未成熟，为了把事情做好，常也需要旁人的协助。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME uses its strength to help others as much as possible. It is still immature, though, so it often needs help itself in order to execute tasks properly.

entry: POKENAME总想给遇见的生灵一个大大的拥抱，让对方振作。出发点虽好，却十分危险，因为它的力道足以压碎骨头。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME loves to give anyone it can a big hug in order to lift their spirits. While well-meaning, this can be dangerous, as it's strength can only be described as bone-crushing.

entry: 与训练家亲近后，POKENAME会送上一朵自己蓬松的白蘑菇；采下后，蘑菇很快就能再生。它尝起来往往像训练家最爱的食物。
author: oddwalls
source: If POKENAME bonds with its Trainer, it will offer them one of its puffy white mushrooms, which rapidly regrow after being harvested. The mushrooms often taste like the Trainer's favorite food.

entry: POKENAME体温低，存放蛋状石头的口袋能让石头保持冰凉。天气暖和时，它偶尔会借给朋友消暑。
author: sk372
source: The pouch that POKENAME stores egg-like stones in keeps the rocks chilled thanks to its cool body. It occasionally lends these stones to friends on warm days to help them cool down.

entry: POKENAME的歌声常被用在安抚幼崽的育幼曲中。人们常见野生个体照顾受伤的幼年宝可梦，唱着歌，哄它们安然入睡。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's songs are often used in daycare melodies that help placate young. Wild POKENAME are often seen caring for injured, young Pokémon and singing them into a gentle slumber.

entry: POKENAME将白色大石头放在蘑菇的空腔里，练习将来孵蛋。蘑菇空隙里若没装着东西，它就会焦躁不安。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME holds large white stones in a cavity within its mushrooms, practicing for incubating eggs in the future. It gets very antsy if it doesn't have something occupying the mushroom's gap.

entry: POKENAME将其他宝可梦的蛋抱在胸前，用浓密的绒毛保暖。它们会集体寻找巢穴，再挤上前去，每只取走一颗蛋。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hold the eggs of other Pokémon close to their chest, using their thick fuzz to keep them warm. Populations of POKENAME will work together to seek out nests and crowd together to take an egg each.

entry: 它很友好，几乎与所有宝可梦都合得来，毫不自私。遇到来犯者，也会用歌声与礼物安抚。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is friendly and gets along with almost any Pokémon. It is entirely selfless and will placate aggressors with songs and gifts.

entry: POKENAME的蛋，其实是一块白色巨石，会被它用来重击对手。不战斗时，它则会想尽办法，让巨石保持洁净。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's egg is actually a large white boulder, which it will use to bludgeon its opponents. Outside of combat, POKENAME will do anything to keep its boulder as clean as possible.

entry: 人们相信，它尾巴上的蛋蕴含好运。据说，看过POKENAME表演的宝可梦，会接连几天鸿运当头。
author: aggrotek
source: The egg on its tail is believed to hold good fortune. Pokémon who witness one of POKENAME's performances are said to enjoy several days of unusually good luck.

entry: 它们魔杖的蛋状末端滴下的“蛋黄”，其实是美味的蜂蜜。据说，吃下这种蜜，便会头脑清明。
author: infinex21
source: The "yolk" that drips from the egg-like ends of their wands is actually a delectable honey. This honey is said to bring mental clarity to any who consume it.

entry: POKENAME努力保护其他宝可梦的巢，免遭捕食者侵袭。它攀住树干，从高处高速掷出裹着泡泡的小石子，精准狙击捕猎者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME works to protect the nests of other Pokémon from predators. Clinging to tree trunks, it accurately snipes at hunters from above using bubble-coated pebbles thrown at high speeds.

entry: POKENAME将其他宝可梦的蛋抱在胸前，用浓密的绒毛保暖。它们会集体寻找巢穴，再挤上前去，每只取走一颗蛋。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hold the eggs of other Pokémon close to their chest, using their thick fuzz to keep them warm. Populations of POKENAME will work together to seek out nests and crowd together to take an egg each.

entry: POKENAME生性乐观，会照顾遭遗弃的蛋。体热将蛋暖到舒适的温度，它也因此成了绝佳的依偎伙伴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are optimistic creatures that take care of abandoned eggs. The heat from their body warms up the egg to a comfortable temperature, making them great as a snuggle buddy.

entry: 平静的浅水中，能找到以浮游生物为食的POKENAME。海边散步的情侣，常将它进食的动作比作轻柔的吻。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME can be found feeding on plankton in calm, shallow waters. Lovers who walk on the beachside often compare its feeding habits to soft kisses.

entry: POKENAME很爱玩，从互相追逐、随乐起舞到过家家，几乎什么都肯参加。无论野生，还是由训练家照料，它们都一样。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME love to play: from chasing one another to dancing to music to playing pretend, there are few things that POKENAME will not participate in. This behavior is displayed both when POKENAME are in the wild or under the ownership of a Trainer.

entry: POKENAME每次练习掌握超能力，都得好好护住蛋。已有许多个体不小心让物品落下，砸碎了自己的蛋。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME practice harnessing their psychic powers, it is important to keep their egg safe. There have been many cases of POKENAME accidentally breaking their egg by dropping an object on top.

entry: POKENAME渴望进化，变得更强。它们容易大发脾气，沮丧地摔碎蛋状物品，因此并不好相处。
author: fierysakura23
source: POKENAME long to evolve and become more powerful. They are prone to throwing temper tantrums and breaking egg-shaped objects in frustration, making POKENAME hard to get along with.

entry: POKENAME最爱让大家温暖快乐，尤其是随身带着的蛋。快孵化时，它会向训练家吠叫，好让双方一起见证。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to keep everyone warm and happy, especially the Egg that they carry. When the Egg is close to hatching, POKENAME will bark at their Trainer so they can observe the Egg hatching together.

entry: POKENAME靠胸前一片特殊的毛，让蛋紧贴身体。蛋即将孵化时，它会发出欢欣的叫声。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME relies on a special patch of fur on its chest to keep eggs clinging to its body. It lets out a jubilant cry when an egg is about to hatch.

entry: POKENAME照顾遭遗弃的蛋，将其安放在自己的巢里。人们常见它们怀抱着蛋，贴紧温暖的身体，在空中翱翔。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME take care of abandoned eggs and store them in their own nest. They can often be found soaring through the sky clutching eggs and hugging them close to their warm bodies.

entry: POKENAME神情呆滞地在湖岸游荡，寻找其他宝可梦。它们十分亲热，会将幼年宝可梦拉进温柔的怀抱，贴在腹前，表达关爱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wander around lake shores with a blank, aimless expression as they search for other Pokémon. They are very affectionate, pulling young Pokémon into a tender embrace and holding them against their belly to show their care.

entry: POKENAME神情呆滞地在湖岸游荡，寻找宝可梦的巢穴。它们育幼本能强烈，常带走无人照看的蛋，随身携带，努力使其免受伤害。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wander around lake shores with a blank, aimless expression as they search for Pokémon nests. They have a strong nurturing instinct, frequently taking unattended eggs and carrying them around in an effort to protect them from harm.

entry: 它总随身带着至少一块蛋状石头。有时，POKENAME会尽可能多带，拿来锻炼力量。
author: .jerden
source: It always carries at least one egg-shaped rock around with it. Sometimes, a POKENAME will decide to carry around as many of these rocks as it can lift, as a form of strength training.

entry: POKENAME的蛋富含蛋白质。它会送给弱小的宝可梦，鼓励它们长成最出色的自己。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's eggs are packed with high amounts of protein. It will give out its eggs to weaker Pokémon to encourage them to become the best version of themselves.

entry: POKENAME将圆石含在嘴里，尽心守护。育幼场所会让它将真正的蛋含在嘴里照看。若有人想偷走，它便用毒藤猛烈还击。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME holds a round stone inside its mouth, dutifully watching over it. Nurseries will have POKENAME watch over real eggs within its mouth. If someone tries to steal it, POKENAME lashes out with its poisonous vines.

entry: POKENAME脾气随和，却极力保护嵌在体内的白色石头。石头一旦脱落或遗失，它便会变得极其焦躁、暴躁。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME has an agreeable temperament, but it is very protective of the white rock embedded in its body. If the rock becomes dislodged or lost, it becomes excessively agitated and ornery.

entry: POKENAME幼年时就会找来一块蛋状石头，珍若宝藏。与小福蛋不同，受到挑衅时，它会把石头当武器掷出，战后再取回来。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Early in its life, POKENAME will gather an egg-shaped rock that it prizes as a treasure. Unlike Happiny, POKENAME will hurl this rock as a weapon when it is provoked. After battle, it will retrieve its rock.

entry: POKENAME常见于河岸，用能抓握的尾巴翻找河石，收集所有形似蛋的石头。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME is found along river banks. It uses its prehensile tail to sort through river rocks, collecting any which look like eggs.

entry: 觉得巢穴受到威胁时，育幼本能会驱使POKENAME将宝可梦蛋紧抱在胸前，保护幼小生命。面对危险，它们会转过背，靠厚壳抵挡。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME clutch Pokémon eggs to their front when they feel a nest is threatened, nurturing instincts compelling them to protect the young. They will turn their backs to anything they feel is dangerous, relying on their thick shell to protect them.

entry: 只要有机会照顾蛋，POKENAME就会开心得难以言喻。它们未必总能尽责，但一想到被托付了蛋，便感到骄傲。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME experience ineffable glee when they are given an opportunity to take care of an egg. They may not always be responsible with their egg, but to be trusted with an egg gives them a feeling of pride.

entry: POKENAME的壳有个特殊的凹槽，大小、形状都恰好能装宝可梦蛋。它们从河床挑来石头，随身携带，直到能整整一周不弄丢，为将来带蛋练习。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a special hollow in their shell that is the right size and shape to hold Pokémon eggs. They practice for the responsibility of carrying an egg by picking stones from river beds and carrying them until they go a week without losing them.

entry: POKENAME的壳有个特殊的凹槽，大小、形状都恰好能装宝可梦蛋。它们从河床挑来石头，随身携带，直到能整整一周不弄丢，为将来带蛋练习。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a special hollow in their shell that is the right size and shape to hold Pokémon eggs. They practice for the responsibility of carrying an egg by picking stones from river beds and carrying them until they go a week without losing them.

entry: POKENAME的壳有个特殊的凹槽，大小、形状都恰好能装宝可梦蛋。它们从河床挑来石头，随身携带，直到能整整一周不弄丢，为将来带蛋练习。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a special hollow in their shell that is the right size and shape to hold Pokémon eggs. They practice for the responsibility of carrying an egg by picking stones from river beds and carrying them until they go a week without losing it.

entry: POKENAME体型虽庞大笨重，心思却很细腻，移动时极力避免弄坏东西。它们爱守着其他宝可梦的巢，保护巢里的蛋。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Despite their cumbersome size, POKENAME are delicate Pokémon that take great care to not damage anything when moving around. They love to watch over the nests of other Pokémon, protecting the eggs in the nests they guard.

entry: POKENAME的舌头极其柔软敏感，会舔舐旁人以示亲爱，尤其在对方难过时。唾液中的某种物质，似乎真能让接触到的人开心起来。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's tongue is incredibly soft and sensitive. It licks others to show affection, especially when they seem to be upset, and a substance in its saliva seems to actually cheer people up when they are exposed to it.

entry: POKENAME用长舌卷起珍珠，随身带着。偶尔，它会将珍珠送给朋友，再仔细搜遍海床，直到找到另一颗。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses its long tongue to pick up and carry around a pearl. It may occasionally give this away to friends, but will then carefully search the seafloor until it finds another one.

entry: POKENAME无法自己产出珍珠，便尽可能多地收集。它的壳常装得满满当当，再也塞不下。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is unable to produce pearls of its own. Instead, it collects as many as it can find, and its shell will often be so full that there is no room to hold any more.

entry: POKENAME能缩进蛋里，再合上外面的粉红色贝壳，保护自己。它很怕生，受惊后，可能直到第二天才肯再次出来。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can protect itself from harm by withdrawing inside its egg and closing its pink shell around it. It is very shy, and if frightened, it may not remerge until the next day.

entry: POKENAME体型虽庞大笨重，心思却很细腻，移动时极力避免弄坏东西。它们爱守着其他宝可梦的巢，保护巢里的蛋。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Despite their cumbersome size, POKENAME are delicate Pokémon that take great care to not damage anything when moving around. They love to watch over the nests of other Pokémon, protecting the eggs in the nests they guard.

entry: POKENAME常一口气吃下大量食物，为电击储存能量，但吃得太多就会变得好斗。储存的能量能通过头上的触角，以放电的方式释放。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME are known for eating a lot at once so they can store energy for their electrical attacks, but if they eat too much, they become aggressive. They can release this stored energy by discharging electricity through the antennas on their head.

entry: POKENAME圆胖的身体因电力充盈而鼓胀，稍一碰触便会猛烈放电。可它偏偏开朗活泼，爱撒娇地蹭训练家，讨取亲爱。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's plump body swells with electricity and will discharge violently at the slightest touch. However, it is a cheery and energetic Pokémon and will playfully nuzzle its Trainer for affection.

entry: 精力充沛时，POKENAME会不顾意外爆炸的风险，莽撞地四处滚动。它常因此碾到自己的尾巴，痛得在爆炸中释放超过10万伏特的电流。
author: soup1900
source: When full of energy, POKENAME starts to roll around recklessly without any care of accidentally blowing up. It often rolls over its own tail when doing this, causing it to release over 100,000 volts of electricity in the explosion from its pain.

entry: 即将爆炸时，POKENAME会立刻将尾巴插进地里，泄出导致爆炸的过剩能量。可电力一旦全部导走，它又会虚弱得受不了任何刺激，很容易倒下。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME plunges its tail into the ground right when it is about to explode to dispel the excess energy causing it to. When it grounds all of its electricity, it becomes too weak to withstand any stimuli, leaving it easy to knock out.

entry: POKENAME结群行动，以便吃掉其他同类放出的电。脱离群体后，它们会变得凶暴，攻击任何靠近的对象。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME travels in groups so that they can eat the electricity that other POKENAME discharge. If separated from the pack, POKENAME become aggressive and will attack anyone who comes near them.

entry: POKENAME能结出带着麻舌苦味的柑橘，是制作酸糖的人气原料。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME produce a type of citrus that has an electrifying and bitter taste. It is a popular ingredient in sour candies.

entry: 雷雨中，POKENAME站在风暴中央，高举精心雕刻的骨头引雷。雷电流遍全身，令能量大增，使它接连数天亢奋不已。
author: sk372
