source: During thunderstorms, POKENAME stands in the midst of the storm and raises its specially carved bone up to draw lightning to it. The strikes course through its body and supercharge its energy, making it hyperactive for several days.

entry: 它给随身的骨棒通电，增强战力。POKENAME甚至能用持续的雷电将骨棒与自己连在一起，控制空中轨迹，确保命中目标。
author: sk372
source: It electrifies the bone club it carries to enhance its effectiveness in battle. POKENAME can even tether it to itself via sustained lightning and control its midair trajectory to ensure it hits the target.

entry: POKENAME不断摩擦舌头，积蓄源源不绝的电力。能使人麻痹的舔舐，在战斗中十分棘手，较弱的宝可梦挨一下就会瘫倒在地。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME constantly rubs its tongue to build up a constant supply of electricity. Its paralysing licks are crippling in battle, with one lick sending weaker Pokémon sprawling to the floor.

entry: POKENAME体内蕴藏不稳定的电能，兴奋时会愈加强烈。电力大到身体容纳不下，便会毫无预警地从排气孔喷出。
author: tuskaninny
source: POKENAME's body contains volatile electrical energy, which intensifies when POKENAME becomes excited. When the electricity within its body becomes too intense to contain, it is expelled via its vents without any warning.

entry: POKENAME把尾巴埋进地里，既固定身体，也将失控迸发的电力导走。飞行属性宝可梦若将它从地里叼起，很快就会遭到强烈电击。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME buries its tail to ground its uncontrollable bursts of electricity as well as to use it as an anchor. If a Flying-type snatches POKENAME out of the ground, they are quickly zapped with intense energy.

entry: POKENAME先用角刺穿敌人，再放出一股电流。筋疲力尽时，它便退入洞窟，恢复能量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME pierces foes with its horn before releasing a surge of electricity. When exhausted, it retreats to caves to recover its energy.

entry: POKENAME睡着时，角会放出火花。因此得慎选睡处，在空旷原野休息，可能点燃干燥的灌木。
author: .izik
source: While asleep, POKENAME discharges sparks from its horn. It must sleep cautiously, as it can ignite dry brush if it rests in open fields.

entry: POKENAME从雷暴引来闪电，使自己的蛋吃下后能提振精神。这些蛋在短跑和马拉松选手中十分受欢迎。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME draws lightning from thunderstorms to give its egg an energizing effect when eaten. Its eggs are very popular amongst sprinters and marathon runners.

entry: POKENAME照顾遭遗弃的电属性宝可梦。它精通正负电荷的控制，能确保照看的伙伴之间，不会发生与电有关的意外。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME takes care of abandoned Electric-type Pokémon. They have a mastery over positive and negative charges, so they can ensure there are no electric-related accidents between whomever it is caring for.

entry: POKENAME照顾遭遗弃的电属性宝可梦。据说，被它的尾巴猛抽一下，敌人就会看得天旋地转。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME takes care of abandoned Electric-type Pokémon. A single whack from its tail is said to make an opponent's vision go topsy-turvy.

entry: POKENAME照顾遭遗弃的电属性宝可梦。它精通正负电荷的控制，能确保照看的伙伴之间，不会发生与电有关的意外。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME takes care of abandoned Electric-type Pokémon. They have a mastery over positive and negative charges, so they can ensure there are no electric-related accidents between whomever it is caring for.

entry: POKENAME周身的倒刺含有使人麻痹的毒素，可用于麻醉剂。夏季，它们成群占据浅礁，海滩不得不关闭，直到它们离开。
author: chibitales
source: The barbs along POKENAME's body contain a paralytic poison used in anesthetics. Shoals of these Pokémon take over shallow reefs in the summer months, forcing beaches to close until they move on.

entry: POKENAME用吸盘般的嘴唇吸住敌人和猎物，更有效地施以电击。它们能从嘴里精准喷出水柱，从角上射出电光。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their sucker lips to attach to foes and prey to better deliver electric shocks into them. They can expel precise jets of water from their mouths and electric bolts from their horns.

entry: POKENAME在深秋于河中产卵。前往产卵地时，它们会让角充满电，跃出水面，电击想吃掉自己的捕食者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lay eggs in rivers in late autumn. To reach their nesting grounds, they hop out of the water with their horns charged with electricity, shocking those who try to eat them.

entry: 完全进化的POKENAME迅疾得难以捉摸。通常只有雷雨中，它们共同引领离开森林的皮大蝶群时，才能见其踪影。
author: freakonomicon
source: Fully evolved POKENAME are incredibly quick and elusive. Usually they can only be spotted communally herding groups of Pifree that leave their forests during thunderstorms.

entry: POKENAME凶猛地守护领地，在树梢间滑翔，监视入侵者。它精准而无情地俯冲，以噼啪带电的双刃劈向敌人。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME fiercely defends its territory, gliding among the treetops to monitor intruders. It dives with ruthless precision, striking foes with twin blades crackling with electricity.

entry: 夏天，POKENAME以超能力飘浮、踏尾冲浪，同时跳着草裙舞，是著名的一景。人们相信它来自阿罗拉，研究者却仍在推测它的起源。
author: violet_zero
source: POKENAME are a famous sight during the summer season, hula dancing as they float and surf on their tails with psychic power. They are believed to have come from Alola, though researchers continue to speculate this Pokémon's origins.

entry: POKENAME爬上高楼，将尾巴当作避雷针。被雷电充能后，接下来数天，它都会亢奋不已，变得格外好斗。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME climbs up tall buildings to use its tail as a lightning rod. After becoming charged up by a lightning strike, it will be hyperactive and unusually aggressive for the next few days.

entry: POKENAME体内既能产生高热，也能产生电能。愤怒时，它放出灼热的雷电，连岩石都能熔化。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME's body generates both intense heat and electrical energy. When angered, it releases blasts of searing lightning that can melt rock.

entry: POKENAME靠潜藏的静电，让翅膀上的鳞粉附着不落。它们能瞬间散去电荷，朝惹恼自己的对象撒下一阵令人不适的鳞粉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use a latent static charge to keep their wing scales attached. They can disperse this charge at a moment's notice, releasing a shower of irritating scales at whatever is aggravating them.

entry: POKENAME靠潜藏的静电，让翅膀上的鳞粉附着不落。它们能瞬间散去电荷，朝惹恼自己的对象撒下一阵令人不适的鳞粉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use a latent static charge to keep their wing scales attached. They can disperse this charge at a moment's notice, releasing a shower of irritating scales at whatever is aggravating them.

entry: 这种宝可梦的嗅觉极其敏锐。气味若太浓或太刺鼻，它们就会凶暴异常，直到味道散去。POKENAME会使靠得太近的对象麻痹，以求自保。
author: ruben2309295
source: These Pokémon have an extremely powerful sense of smell. If a scent is too strong or pungent, they become extremely aggressive until the smell dissipates. POKENAME protect themselves by paralyzing anyone who gets too close.

entry: POKENAME的壳，其分子组成与雷之石几乎相同，因此许多电属性宝可梦会聚在身边，想借它的壳进化。
author: wyattwintersoul
source: POKENAME's shell is almost identical to the molecular makeup of Thunder Stones, which means many Electric-type Pokémon gather around POKENAME in an attempt to use its shell to evolve.

entry: 不变身时，POKENAME保持雷丘般的形态，似乎将其视为自己最理想的模样。仔细观察，就能看见电弧在胶状身体内跃动。
author: sk372
source: When not transformed, POKENAME maintains a Raichu-like shape, seemingly viewing it as the ideal form for itself. Under close observation, one can see electricity arcing within its gelatinous body.

entry: POKENAME能在脸颊储存电压高达数千伏特的电力。这时，它们常会兴奋得不停奔跑，直到将电放掉。
author: jadey.1557
source: POKENAME can store several thousand volts worth of electricity in their cheeks. When this happens, they often get excited and run around continuously until they discharge.

entry: POKENAME有鳃，能在水下生活，但脸颊储存的大量电力，常让其他水生宝可梦避之不及。因此，野生个体通常小群同住。
author: jadey.1557
source: POKENAME has gills that allow it to live underwater, however due to the vast amounts of electricity it stores in its cheeks, other aquatic Pokémon will often avoid it. Because of this, wild POKENAME will usually live together in small groups.

entry: POKENAME每次充满电，毛发就会竖起，静电噼啪作响。只有尾巴放出一道闪电后，毛发才会重新伏下。
author: .jerden
source: Whenever POKENAME becomes charged with electricity, its fur stands on end and crackles with static. It will not settle back down until POKENAME discharges a lightning bolt from its tail.

entry: POKENAME寄宿的系统若启动屏幕保护程序，它就会发出微弱电击，让鼠标动一动。为何如此讨厌闲置的屏幕，至今无人能解释。
author: .izik
source: If a screensaver activates while POKENAME inhabits a system, it delivers a small electric shock to move the mouse. Its dislike of idle screens remains unexplained.

entry: 壳内的雷之石能储存惊人的电能。时机一到，POKENAME便会通过触手，传导这骇人的高压电。
author: empty_set
source: The Thunderstones within its shell can store inordinate amounts of electrical energy.  When the time is right, POKENAME conducts this incredible voltage through its tentacles.

entry: 这种宝可梦整天用尾巴挂在树上。若有人想将POKENAME取下，就会遭到强力电击。它们发电时，壳会变得格外烫。
author: ruben2309295
source: These Pokémon spend their time hanging from trees by using their tails. If somebody attempts to remove a POKENAME from a tree, they will receive a powerful electric discharge. When POKENAME generate electricity, their shells become extra hot.

entry: POKENAME的前臂导电性极佳，能刺入敌人，施以电击。训练家若疏忽，它有时会成为危险源，因为只要想下水游泳，就很容易让整片水域带电。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME has highly conductive forearms, which it utilizes by stabbing opponents and shocking them. Sometimes, this Pokémon ends up being a hazard if its Trainer is careless, as it can easily electrify bodies of water if it ever decides to swim.

entry: 乍看不过是只大号雷丘。就算脚的模样没让人看出卡比兽血统，那份食量也瞒不过去。
author: faelocke
source: It appears to simply be a very large Raichu at first glance. If its feet don't give away that it's part Snorlax, its appetite will.

entry: POKENAME奔跑得极快，全速时几乎让人看不清，所到之处都留下静电。看过它奔跑的人都说，头发会根根竖起，空气中还飘着焦糊气味。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME runs at incredibly high speeds, becoming nearly imperceptible to the human eye at its peak, leaving trails of static wherever it goes. Anyone present during its run reports their hair standing on end and a smell of burning in the air.

entry: 它心地善良，会在风暴中为船只引路，一边飞行，一边用身体吸收落雷。
author: melodydelune
source: This kindhearted Pokémon has been known to guide ships during storms, using its body to absorb lighting strikes as it flies.

entry: 它的毒针攻击带着11000伏电压。收服后，人们常给毒针套上橡胶帽，免遭电击。
author: supersonicloki
source: Its stingers are known to pack a punch of 11,000 volts when used to attack. When captured, many use rubber caps to prevent shocking.

entry: 进攻时，POKENAME会瞬间移动到高空，再披着电光疾冲地面。这番景象，让它得到了“活闪电”的外号。
author: imaginita
source: To attack, POKENAME will teleport high into the air, then race down to the ground while cloaking itself in electricity. This electric display has earned it the nickname “The Living Lightningbolt”.

entry: POKENAME的电击威力惊人，性情却出乎意料地温和。有时，人们会看见它将花递给偶然遇到自己的小孩。
author: daimposter_60614
source: Although POKENAME's shocks are incredibly powerful, it is surprisingly passive. It can sometimes be found handing flowers to small children who stumble upon it.

entry: 它们的脖颈与尾巴烈焰缭绕，其间电火花噼啪闪动。它们向敌人甩动燃烧的尾巴，尾尖击中哪里，哪里便会爆发电流。
author: infinex21
source: Their necks and tails are wreathed in strong flames that crackle with sparks of electricity. They will swing their flaming tails at foes and wherever the tip strikes, they will explosively release electricity.

entry: 野生POKENAME通常温顺，避免冲突。鲜艳的羽色与相对容易训练的特点，让许多野生个体遭到捕捉。
author: bobosmith01
source: Wild POKENAME are typically docile and avoid confrontation. The bright colors of their feathers and relative ease of training have caused many wild POKENAME to be caught.

entry: 雷雨之外，很少能看见POKENAME，它们大部分时间都躲在树洞里。风暴一来，它们便飞上天空，拖着尾巴，试图接住雷电。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are rarely seen outside of thunderstorms, spending most of their days sheltering within tree hollows. When a storm starts, they take to the air, their tail trailing behind them as they try to catch the lightning.

entry: 当地传说中，皮卡瓢虫若用连续拳接连击败一千个敌人，并在击败最后一个时遭雷击，就会进化成POKENAME。科学家仍在设法验证传说的真假。
author: drack8786
source: Local legends say that if a Pikaian defeats a thousand consecutive enemies with its Comet Punch and is struck by lightning on the last one, it will evolve into POKENAME. Scientists are still trying to prove whether this legend is true.

entry: POKENAME已能熟练控电。POKENAME在几条尾巴间产生电能，再以扰乱性的电流释放出去。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME has mastered its control over electricity. The electricity POKENAME generates between its tails can be sent out in disruptive currents.

entry: POKENAME用四只翅膀穿行雷雨，从附近的落雷中收集电力。振翅本身也能产生大量静电。
author: mudkip0433
source: POKENAME flies on its four wings through thunderstorms, gathering electricity from nearby lightning strikes. The flapping of its wings produces large amounts of static electricity.

entry: POKENAME的感官远超人类：出色的视力能发现其他宝可梦和重要物体，敏锐的听觉能察知远处靠近的动静。唯有味觉，与人类相仿。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's senses easily surpass those of humans: powerful vision allows it to spot other Pokémon and objects of import, and powerful hearing allows it to detect those approaching from great distances. Only its sense of taste is comparable.

entry: 野生POKENAME虽然可爱，对训练家却可能极其危险。它若变得好斗，便能一次释放大量电力。
author: daimposter_60614
source: Although cute, a wild POKENAME can be incredibly dangerous for Trainers. POKENAME can release large amounts of electricity at once if it becomes aggressive.

entry: 尾尖若碰到任何金属，它们便会放尽电力，变得凶暴。为了避免这种情况，有些POKENAME会用长尾巴缠住小小的身体。
author: infinex21
source: If the tips of their tails touch anything metal, they discharge all of their electricity and become aggressive. To avoid this, some POKENAME wrap their long tails around their small bodies.

entry: 这种宝可梦的身体和尾巴能蓄电，可个头太小，常得放电。它会偷偷给路上遇到的电池充电；见到孩子的夜灯，更是忍不住要给它充电。
author: lukanbeetle
source: This Pokémon accumulates electricity in its body and tail, but it's so small it often needs to discharge. It secretly does so by recharging batteries that cross its path, and can never resist recharging a kid's night light.

entry: POKENAME用破碎的蛋壳护身，尽力避免受伤。它们控制不好电力，所用的壳往往被电得焦黑。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use the broken remnants of egg shells to protect their bodies, trying to keep themselves safe from harm. They have poor control of their electrical powers and the shell they use often ends up charred and blackened by their shocks.

entry: POKENAME是电力线路工程师欢迎的伙伴，能感知电流波动，查找线路故障时十分宝贵。帮忙修复损坏的基础设施，会让它们深感自豪。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are a popular companion of power line engineers, their ability to sense electrical fluctuations making them invaluable in finding faults in lines. They take great pride in helping fix up broken down infrastructure.

entry: POKENAME将尾巴在羊毛中摩擦，便能产生静电。它通常在感到威胁时这样自卫。
author: daimposter_60614
source: POKENAME can rub its tail through its wool to generate static electricity. It normally does this as self-defense when it feels threatened.

entry: POKENAME轻甩尾巴，便能召来雷雨。它洪亮的叫声，在雨中悦耳如歌，晴天听来却刺耳难听。
author: pattybgoode
source: With a flick of its tail, POKENAME can summon thunderstorms. Its bellowing cries sound melodic in the rain and gratingly unpleasant when it is clear.

entry: 发电厂外，常能看见POKENAME在田野间漫步，在发电机房旁嬉戏。它们被输出的电力吸引，发电厂一旦停工，就会迁往别处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found outside power plants, ambling around the fields and playing with one another near the generator buildings. They are drawn to the electrical output and will migrate elsewhere if the power plant ever shuts down.

entry: 发电厂外，常能看见POKENAME在田野间漫步，在发电机房旁嬉戏。它们被输出的电力吸引，发电厂一旦停工，就会迁往别处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found outside power plants, ambling around the fields and playing with one another near the generator buildings. They are drawn to the electrical output and will migrate elsewhere if the power plant ever shuts down.

entry: 它飘游空中，积蓄静电。电力太多时，哪怕是万里无云的白天，也会使出强力的打雷。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It collects electricity by building up static when it wafts through the air. If it generates too much, it will discharge a powerful Thunder, even in the middle of a cloudless day.

entry: POKENAME不停啃咬电线，吸收其中的能量。它们始终高举尾巴，探查四周，极难捕捉，常在住家里盘踞多年。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will gnaw through wires relentlessly, absorbing the energy inside. They keep their tails raised in the air, constantly scanning their surroundings.  This makes them extremely hard to catch, often infesting homes for years.

entry: POKENAME强劲的电力，全部集中在巨大的尾端。它会用尾巴炫技般地抛接浓缩的雷球，再将其投向敌人。
author: sk372
source: All of its potent electrical power is centered in the large tip of its tail. POKENAME makes a show of juggling balls of condensed lightning with its tail before lobbing the projectile at its foes.

entry: POKENAME从颊囊放出多余电力时，用尾巴接地。它们常在水洼里跳来跳去，让自己保持湿润。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their tails to ground them as they discharge excess electricity from their cheek pouches. They often hop about in puddles of water to keep themselves moisturized.

entry: POKENAME上下弹跳，产生并储存电力。它爱跳进冷水，将电放掉，让附近游动的生灵狠狠挨上一电。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME bounces up and down, which generates electricity that it stores. It likes to jump into cold water and discharge this electricity, giving anything swimming nearby a nasty shock.

entry: 它的长须靠近大电源时，会微微颤动，接着便迫不及待地吸食电力。充满电后，尾巴会亮得像路灯。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its long whiskers quiver near large sources of electricity, which it eagerly consumes. When fully charged, its tail glows as brightly as a street lamp.

entry: POKENAME在雷暴中游荡，即使被雷击中，也照样愉快地彼此招呼。挨雷的个体身体似乎毫无反应，尾巴却每次都会活力十足地来回摇摆。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME wander around during lightning storms, pleasantly greeting each other even as they're struck by lightning. While the body of the struck POKENAME doesn't seem to react in the slightest, its tail energetically sways back and forth every time.

entry: POKENAME住在地底深处，将地热能储存在体内。人们曾见它们猎捕暴鲤龙，从海床下打洞，再破土冲入水中，从下方电击猎物。
author: hedaunis
source: POKENAME live deep underground where they store geothermal power in their bodies. They have been seen hunting Gyarados by tunneling under the seafloor and breaching up into the water, attacking from below to zap their prey.

entry: POKENAME放出数千伏特的电击，击倒试图侵占领地的敌人。若独力应付不了，它就飞上高空，像烟花般迸出电光，召唤同伴助战。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME blasts thousands of volts of electricity to take down any foe that tries to take over its territory. When it can't handle the threat by itself, it flies up high and bursts electricity like a firework to signal others to help fight.

entry: 战斗中，POKENAME披着电光冲向敌人，也能从双钳射出强力电流。
author: mepp.
source: In battle, POKENAME charges into the enemy while cloaking itself with electricity. It is also capable of firing powerful surges from its pincers.

entry: POKENAME将长尾巴几乎全部盘在壳内。敌人从背后袭来时，尾巴便会突然弹出，像巨鞭般甩向对方，打个措手不及。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME keeps its lengthy tail almost completely coiled within its shell. This lets it take attackers from behind by surprise when it springs out and swings like a massive whip in their direction.

entry: POKENAME将尾巴当作滑板，迅速滑下雪坡。狩猎时，它会给锋利的爪子通电，袭击猎物。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its tail like a board to slide swiftly down snowy slopes. When hunting, it attacks its prey by electrifying its razor-sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME的壳带有磁场，范围却不大。有目击者发现，硬币和钉子会黏在它的壳上。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's shell has a magnetic field, though the range does not extend far. Some sightings of POKENAME have noted coins and nails sticking to their shells.

entry: POKENAME毫不顾惜未融合的同族，主要以皮卡丘为食。它能承受皮卡丘的电击，是少数捕食它们的飞行属性宝可梦。叫声一响，小型宝可梦便纷纷逃去躲藏。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Showing no regard for their unfused counterparts, POKENAME lives mainly on a diet of Pikachu. POKENAME are one of the few Flying types to prey on them, able to withstand their electric shocks. Their call sends all small Pokémon running for cover.

entry: POKENAME精力旺盛又容易兴奋。散步时常在训练家脚边穿来绕去，尾巴还迸着电火花。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME is incredibly energetic and excitable. It will often weave around Trainers feet while on walks, with electricity sparking off its tail.

entry: POKENAME游得很快，会发出电脉冲，击昏水中的其他宝可梦。拖在身后的长尾巴，是向同类展示成功的标志；尾巴越长，越是理想的伴侣。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are fast swimming Pokémon that use electrical pulses to stun other Pokémon in the water. Their long, trailing tail acts to signify their success to other POKENAME, with longer tails indicating a more desirable partner.

entry: POKENAME友善温柔，会与人和宝可梦同行，守护他们。它既能放出大量电力御敌，也能精细控制微量电流，轻柔安抚游泳时抓着自己的伙伴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a friendly, gentle soul that travels with and safeguards humans and Pokémon alike. It can generate electricity in great amounts to defend them, as well as small controlled amounts to gently soothe those who hold onto it while swimming.

entry: POKENAME沿全身储存电力，让附近宝可梦的毛发都竖起来。用尖牙咬下时，它便会放出积蓄的电。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME store electricity throughout the length of their bodies and cause the fur of nearby Pokémon to stand on edge. They release this built-up electricity whenever they bite down with their fangs.

entry: 雷雨中，POKENAME受闪电吸引，从深海升起。风暴肆虐时，它们捕食被巨浪搅得失去方向的水属性宝可梦，短时爆发泳速超过每小时35英里。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME rise from the deep ocean during thunderstorms, attracted by the lightning. As the storm rages, they prey on Water-type Pokémon who have been disoriented by the violent waves. They swim at burst speeds of over 35 miles per hour.

entry: POKENAME若电到电脑，系统便会瞬间关机。奇怪的是，重新启动后，运行速度反而会变成原来的2倍。
author: .izik
source: Should POKENAME shock a computer, the system will shut down instantly. Oddly, when booted back up, it will perform twice as fast as before.

entry: POKENAME常满身颜料地出现，赭色的身体格外显眼。它们的作品动感十足、鲜艳醒目，常令广告公司受到启发，模仿这种风格，增强宣传效果。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often show up with paint stuck to their ochre bodies and feature dynamic art that look flashy and pop out to art audiences. The art they produce often inspire advertising companies to mimic their style to give their message an extra boost.

entry: POKENAME从尖牙放出大量电力，几乎瞬间就能麻痹猎物。不过，战斗之外，它通常很友好，也只捕食小型宝可梦。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME discharges large amounts of electricity through its fangs, paralyzing its prey almost instantly. However, it is generally friendly outside of battle and only hunts small Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME是细心的家长，常照料许多不同物种的幼年宝可梦。电力积蓄过多时，它会变得好斗，便躲起来，安全地排出多余电量。
author: jonclyd
source: POKENAME is a nurturing parent, often caring for young Pokémon of many species. When too much electricity builds up in its body, it becomes aggressive and hides away to safely discharge the excess.

entry: 黄色头巾让POKENAME从众多同伴中脱颖而出，展露坚韧顽强的个性。它们也会随身带着雷之石，增添胆气。
author: quackquackattack
source: A Yellow Scarf allows POKENAME to stand out against the crowd as their tough and gritty personalities surface. They are also known to hold Thunder Stones with them to bring out their boldness.

entry: 人们观察到，POKENAME在雷雨中躁动不安，于林间跳跃，撞倒树木。也有人说，恰好相反，是它们先烦躁起来，坏心情改变了天气，招来雷雨。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME have been observed becoming restless during thunderstorms, leaping around forests, and tearing down trees. Others claim that thunderstorms begin when POKENAME become restless, changing the weather with their foul moods.

entry: POKENAME极其罕见，性情温顺。传说，它曾守护天空与海洋，对威胁生态者降下大风暴。野外几乎无缘见到它，因此捕获一只被视为好运。
author: zoro_the_zoura
source: POKENAME is a very rare, docile creature. Legends say that it once guarded both sky and sea and caused major storms to those who threatened the ecosystem. POKENAME is almost never seen in the wild, so catching one is seen as good luck.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴铲起泥土吃。若铲到养分丰富的土，尾巴便会兴奋地晃动，向四周放电。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME use their tails to scoop up dirt to consume. If they eat a nutrient-rich scoop, their tail wiggles around excitedly, discharging electricity everywhere.

entry: POKENAME每一次雷鸣般的震动，都会释放极强的雷电，引发大规模山火与滑坡。披甲的身体每挨一击，体内便会积蓄电力，让这场暴走持续更久。
author: soup1900
source: Each one of POKENAME's thunderous quakes lets loose extremely powerful thunderbolts that cause gigantic wildfires and massive landslides. Each time its armored body is hit, electricity builds up inside of it, prolonging these rampages.

entry: POKENAME每一次雷鸣般的震动，都会释放极强的雷电，引发大规模山火与滑坡。披甲的身体每挨一击，体内便会积蓄电力，让这场暴走持续更久。
author: soup1900
source: Each one of POKENAME's thunderous quakes lets loose extremely powerful thunderbolts that cause gigantic wildfires and massive landslides. Each time its armored body is hit, electricity builds up inside of it, prolonging these rampages.

entry: POKENAME能通过黄色尾尖吸收、释放电力，电量最高约相当于整座满金市的用电需求。储电过多可能使它们失控，因此受到密切监测。
author: infinex21
source: Through the yellow tips of their tails, POKENAME can absorb and discharge electricity, up to about as much electricity as it takes to power Goldenrod City. They are closely monitored because they may go berserk if they store too much electricity.

entry: POKENAME用闪电状的尾巴电击野生鲤鱼王，猎取食物。尾巴放出的电力，恰好能把食物烹熟，让它成了备餐的好帮手。
author: daimposter_60614
source: POKENAME hunts down wild Magikarp by shocking them with its lightning-shaped tail. The amount of electricity released by its tail is enough to perfectly cook food, making POKENAME useful for providing meals.

entry: 这只顽皮宝可梦在阴影中穿行，电光噼啪，满是捣蛋心思。尾巴一甩，便唤出幽魂般的幻象，迷惑敌人，再迅疾灵巧地出击。
author: thepandasharky
source: This playful Pokémon weaves through shadows, crackling with electric energy and mischief. With a flick of its tail, it conjures ghostly illusions to confuse opponents, striking with surprising speed and agility.

entry: POKENAME将曾让自己进化的雷之石随身带着，留作纪念。人们常见它将石头抱在怀里，仿佛自己的孩子。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME carries around the Thunder Stone that evolved it as a memento. It is often seen cradling this item as if it were its own child.

entry: POKENAME用巨大的尾巴向天空射出强力闪电，落雷击中之物都会被摧毁。电流流遍全身时，角会瞬间放电，让敌人来不及反应。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its oversized tail to launch powerful lightning bolts into the sky that obliterate objects they strike down upon. As electricity courses through its body, its horns discharge instantaneously, giving foes no time to react to its attacks.

entry: POKENAME没填饱肚子前，不肯听训练家的命令。刚吃下一颗树果，电击便会强劲得多。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME refuses to obey its Trainer's commands until it has satisfied its hunger. Right after eating a Berry, its electric attacks become much more powerful.

entry: POKENAME太爱松饼，因此常在早餐店打工。顾客用餐前，最好看看食物上有没有它那会使人麻痹的唾液。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME are employed as workers for breakfast restaurants because they love pancakes so much. Customers are advised to check for POKENAME's paralyzing saliva on their meals before eating.

entry: 唯有最勇敢的个体才能进化成POKENAME，至少野外如此。它让同伴即使在猛烈风暴中也能狩猎，因为所有雷电都会被它的角吸引，无痛地吸收。
author: bobosmith01
source: Only the most courageous evolve into POKENAME, at least in the wild. It allows other members of its pack to hunt even during intense storms: any lightning bolts are drawn to its horn and are absorbed painlessly.

entry: 冲浪季一到，大群POKENAME就会前往最近的海滩。巨大的尾巴是绝佳的冲浪板，炮则用作推进器，让它们能跟上浪头。
author: bigoljax
source: As the surfing season begins, large groups of POKENAME travel to beaches closest to them. Their massive tails work great as surfboards, while their cannons are used as thrusters so they can keep up with the waves.

entry: POKENAME搭货船从阿罗拉来到此地，是一种入侵物种，会电击攻击者或捕食者。除此之外，它大多性情温和。
author: aberry8286
source: Having journeyed here from Alola on cargo ships, POKENAME is an invasive species that is known to electrocute attackers or predators. Other than that, it's mostly passive.

entry: POKENAME先在地面充电，再跃向空中，尾巴朝下猛撞地面，将自己钻入地下。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME charges itself with electricity on the surface, then leaps into the air and crashes into the ground, tail first, to dig itself in.

entry: 这种宝可梦平常的飞行速度就快得惊人，旁观者只能看见一闪而过的模糊身影。战斗中，它轻松绕着敌人疾飞，用雷电反复攻击发现的弱点。
author: fireblade141
source: This Pokémon's default flying speed is so incredibly fast that an observer can only make out a brief blur. In battle, it flies circles around its foes, easily darting around to repeatedly target any weak points it can find with lightning attacks.

entry: 持续振翅会积蓄电荷，让POKENAME愈发烦躁。唯有从尾巴放出高压电，它才能平静下来。
author: .jerden
source: The constant movement of its wings builds up electric charge, making POKENAME more and more agitated over time. It can only calm down by discharging high-voltage electricity from its tail.

entry: POKENAME敲响双钳，发出噼啪电声，吓唬猎物。看着对方越来越不安，它会怪笑；一旦猎物真想逃，它就从毒刺放出雷电。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME snaps its claws to make a crackling electrical sound to frighten the prey it is hunting. It cackles while watching them grow unnerved, zapping them with lightning from its stinger the moment they try to flee outright.

entry: POKENAME碰撞长牙上的冰片，产生强力雷电。科学家研究它们，以更好地了解云中的闪电如何形成。
author: wiz0z
source: By clashing together fragments of ice from their tusks, POKENAME generate powerful bolts of lightning. Scientists have studied POKENAME to better understand lightning formation in clouds.

entry: POKENAME将尾巴高高伸向空中，吸收广播与手机信号作为养分。若被打断，它就会使出十万伏特，赶走干扰者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME extends its tail high into the air to absorb radio and cellphone signals as nourishment. If interrupted during this process, it releases a Thunderbolt to drive away the disturbance.

entry: POKENAME攀爬时，脚趾会积蓄静电。雷雨中，它会将自己扎稳，把电力导入地下。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME's toes build up static charge as it climbs. During thunderstorms, it roots itself to discharge electricity into the ground.

entry: 这种宝可梦已能熟练控制电力。电与火的结合，让它抱起来十分暖和。
author: lydiaprower8
source: This Pokémon has mastered controlling its electricity. The combination of electricity and fire makes it very warm to hold.

entry: POKENAME走路时靠调整尾巴位置保持平衡，免得摔倒。它会兴奋地替朋友欢呼，偶尔高兴过头，还会喷出火来。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME uses the positioning of its tail as a counterbalance when walking to avoid toppling over.  POKENAME will excitedly cheer on its friends, occasionally spitting fire when it gets overexcited.

entry: POKENAME给背刺与尾巴充电后，会蜷成一团弹射出去。撞上房屋或岩层，甚至能整个击碎。
author: chorb33
source: When POKENAME energizes its spikes and tail, curls up and shoots off, it can even shatter entire houses and rock formations when it hits them.

entry: 这种宝可梦能踢出带电的猛击，同时击昏五个敌人，再以强力的喷射火焰收尾。
author: lydiaprower8
source: This Pokémon can lash out with electricity-powered kicks that can stun five foes at once. It then finishes off with a mighty Flamethrower.

entry: POKENAME的肌肉伸缩能产生电能，储存起来备用。由于不断训练，它全身始终带电，无论是否正在战斗，一碰就会遭到强烈电击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: The expanding and contracting of POKENAME's muscles help it generate electrical energy to store for future use. Due to this Pokémon's constant training, its body is constantly charged and creates powerful shocks upon contact, in or out of battle.

entry: POKENAME踢出的猛击，所蕴电力足以供应整座城镇。它们身手敏捷，能接连使出各种物理打击，同时躲开大量反击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME unleash powerful kicks charged with enough electricity to power an entire town. Their movements are quite agile, allowing them to use various physical strikes in combination while still avoiding plenty counterattacks.

entry: POKENAME头顶的黑羽，是遮挡强烈阳光的天然护目檐。它借电磁场悬浮，将尾巴当作冲浪板，便能一边迅速掠过敌人，一边使出强力踢击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: The black feathers atop POKENAME's head act as a natural visor against bright sunlight. By levitating on an electromagnetic field and using its tail like a surfboard, it can rush past opponents while unleashing powerful kicks.

entry: POKENAME引起的震动，常带有使敌人麻痹的效果，让它能轻松许多地解决对手。
author: g_birde
source: The tremors POKENAME makes often give off a paralyzing effect, allowing it to finish off its opponents relatively easily.

entry: 雷丘的尾巴变成了鞭子，被POKENAME当作武器。每次挥鞭，都会发出宛如雷电的轰然爆响。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: Raichu's tail has become a whip that POKENAME now utilizes as a weapon. With the strike of its whip, it makes a booming crackle reminiscent of thunder and lightning.

entry: 超能力与电力结合，形成雷丘般的显影，充当POKENAME的守护者。战斗中，双方协作默契，动作配合得浑然一体。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: The combination of psychic energy and electricity resulted in a Raichu-like manifestation that acts as a guardian for POKENAME. In battle, they fight with a profound sense of teamwork and choreography.

entry: POKENAME将电力集中在刀刃般的肘部，磨炼攻击，确保逸散的电光不会伤到伙伴。若力量失控，它的骑士风度便会被凶猛的攻击性取代。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME concentrates electricity into its blade-like elbows, refining its strikes while ensuring no stray bolts harm its allies. Should this power become unstable, its chivalrous nature gives way to fierce aggression.

entry: POKENAME将电力集中在刀刃般的肘部，磨炼攻击，确保逸散的电光不会伤到伙伴。若力量失控，它的骑士风度便会被凶猛的攻击性取代。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME concentrates electricity into its blade-like elbows, refining its strikes while ensuring no stray bolts harm its allies. Should this power become unstable, its chivalrous nature gives way to fierce aggression.

entry: POKENAME的身体酷似雷之石，还会散发类似的微弱能量。有未经证实的传闻说，靠雷之石进化的宝可梦若凝视它背后的洞，进化便会被强行逆转。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body resembles a Thunder Stone, and even emits a faint energy similar to the stone. There are unfounded rumors that staring into the hole in its back will forcibly reverse the evolution of Pokémon that evolve through Thunder Stones.

entry: POKENAME给背刺与尾巴充电后，会蜷成一团弹射出去。撞上房屋或岩层，甚至能整个击碎。
author: chorb33
source: When POKENAME energizes its spikes and tail, curls up and shoots off, it can even shatter entire houses and rock formations when it hits them.

entry: POKENAME给背刺与尾巴充电后，会蜷成一团弹射出去。撞上房屋或岩层，甚至能整个击碎。
author: chorb33
source: When POKENAME energizes its spikes and tail, curls up and shoots off, it can even shatter entire houses and rock formations when it hits them.

entry: POKENAME常被视为害兽。它们用角刺穿食物、注入毒液，令大多数宝可梦无法再吃，以此据为己有。偷取或标记食物被逮住时，它们便迅速使出蹭蹭脸颊，对付来犯者后逃走。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME are often seen as pests. They claim food by stabbing it with their horn, injecting venom, and making it inedible to most Pokémon. POKENAME caught stealing or marking food swiftly Nuzzle their aggressors before fleeing the scene.

entry: POKENAME将电力导入牙齿，咬下时便带来痛苦的电击。它们借此啃倒树木：咬入树干，电击树液使其爆开，很快就能将树放倒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME channel their electrical powers through their teeth, giving their bites a painful shock. They use this ability to help them chew down trees, biting into the trunk and shocking the sap to make it explode, toppling the tree quickly.

entry: POKENAME将电力导入牙齿，咬下时便带来痛苦的电击。它们借此啃倒树木：咬入树干，电击树液使其爆开，很快就能将树放倒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME channel their electrical powers through their teeth, giving their bites a painful shock. They use this ability to help them chew down trees, biting into the trunk and shocking the sap to make it explode, toppling the tree quickly.

entry: POKENAME的脸由铜构成，会在电力组成的身体上，向各处快速伸展、移动，表达不同神情。睡觉时，它封在雷之石里，吸取潜藏的力量，给自己充电。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: A POKENAME's face is made out of copper, snapping and stretching to different points along its electrical body to convey different expressions. POKENAME sleep while sealed within Thunder Stones, recharging themselves by siphoning the latent power.

entry: POKENAME保留了路卡利欧读取波导的能力。若察觉有人心怀恶意，它会毫不犹豫地一记雷电拳打在对方脸上。
author: gellyfishsh
source: POKENAME retains Lucario's ability to read auras. If it senses bad intentions from a person, it will not hesitate to Thunder Punch them in the face.

entry: 民间故事中，训练家会发现一眨眼便消失的雷之石。后来才知道，这些故事说的是POKENAME捉弄渴望进化的野生皮卡丘。
author: poppyisconfused
source: A folktale describes trainers spotting thunder stones that disappear at a glance. These stories have been discovered to be about POKENAME playing pranks on wild Pikachu that were desperate to evolve.

entry: 矿工都知道，POKENAME可靠又友善，会帮忙清路、照亮前方。不过，它也会亲昵地撞向朋友，似乎没意识到自己有多大。
author: fierysakura23
source: Miners know POKENAME to be very reliable and friendly Pokémon, helping to clear paths and lighting the way forward. However, they ram into their friends affectionately, seemingly not aware of their own size.

entry: POKENAME产生的强电流，让它能准确判断半径10英里内，雷雨会在何时何地发生。
author: g_birde
source: Due to the strong electrical currents POKENAME creates, it is able to pinpoint the exact time and place of a thunderstorm within a 10-mile radius.

entry: POKENAME用一对尾巴吸取无人看管的发电机中的电能。传闻，盯着它的独眼太久，就会被诅咒，落得可怕的命运。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its pair of tails to siphon electric energy from unattended generators. Rumor has it that staring too long into its single eye will leave you cursed with a terrible fate.

entry: POKENAME成群行走，排成一列，跟随首领。感到威胁时，它们便挤在一起，汇集电力，合力射出一道巨大的雷电。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME walk together in groups, following their leader in single file. When the group feel threatened, they will huddle together and pool their electric powers, launching a single gigantic thunderbolt as a team.

entry: POKENAME争抢理想的筑巢地，常互偷石头与树枝，修建更好的巢。争执升级为冲突时，它们就会振翅，向彼此放电。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME squabble with one another for prime nesting locations, regularly stealing stones and sticks from each other to build better nests. When disputes turn aggressive, they will flap their wings and fire shocks at one another.

entry: POKENAME趾高气扬地走来走去，不断展示电力，彰显自己的优越。可不停炫技十分耗能，它们得定时躲起来，补充电力。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME strut around constantly displaying their electrical powers as a way to display their superiority to others. The constant show of power is draining and they have to periodically hide themselves away to recharge.

entry: 电力在POKENAME的鼻子里积聚，最终形成一撮不稳定的静电胡须。等能安全释放时，它便会打出落雷般猛烈的喷嚏，响起轰隆雷声。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: Electricity builds in POKENAME's nose, eventually forming a mustache of unstable static. Once it can be safely discharged, POKENAME sneezes as violently as a lightning strike, creating booming thunder.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃不停震动，稍有声音就会惊慌。它喜欢独处，可被逼到绝境时，震动也能增强攻击威力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's blade vibrates and it panics at the slightest sound. It prefers solitude, but when cornered, its vibrations enhance its damage.

entry: POKENAME摩擦双刃，便会以电火花的形式释放数千伏特的电力。能量越积越多，它出手也越来越快、越来越凶，最后连防御都不顾了。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME rubs its two blades together, it releases thousands of volts of electricity in the form of electric sparks. As it builds energy, its attack patterns grow faster and more aggressive until it disregards defense entirely.

entry: POKENAME用电刃灼烧违抗命令者，施以惩罚。谁还敢还手，它就能将积蓄的全部电力导入盾牌，反击对方。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME punishes those who defy its orders by scorching them with its electric blade. It can discharge all of its built-up electricity through its shield to counterattack any retaliators who try to fight back.

entry: POKENAME擅长谋划，作战有条不紊。这却是一把双刃剑：周密准备让它能击败准备不足者，缺乏变通又让它在混乱局面中容易露出破绽。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a strategic mind and battle in a very methodical manner. This works as a double-edged sword as their preparedness can let them take down those less prepared, but they are inflexible and can be vulnerable to chaotic conditions.

entry: 久而久之，POKENAME身边往往会聚起一小群电属性宝可梦。它悉心训练这些追随者，见它们在战斗中受挫，还常分出自己的电力增强其力量。
author: sk372
source: Over time, a POKENAME typically amasses itself a small following of Electric-type Pokémon. It trains them thoroughly, often providing its own electricity to boost their strengths when they falter in combat.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴形似长柄刀的刃部，能切开薄钢片。需要更强力量时，会将尾巴灌满电力，取得战斗优势。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a tail that resembles the head of a glaive and can cut through thin layers of steel. When it needs an extra boost, it pumps its tail full of electricity to give it an edge in combat.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴能够抓握，让齿轮永不停转。只要齿轮还在转动，身体上闪电状的部分就会泛起电光。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME prehensile tail will ensure that its gears never stop spinning. So long as its gears continue to spin, the lightning-bolt styled parts of its body will glow with electricity.

entry: POKENAME模仿迷路孩子的哭声，引来担心的旅人。等对方靠近，就施以强烈电击，拖走受害者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME mimics the cries of lost children to lure concerned travelers. Once they're close, it delivers a powerful electric shock and drags them away.

entry: 它与其他POKENAME交流时，会将闪电形缎带连在一起，在彼此之间传递电流。
author: melodydelune
source: It communicates with other POKENAME by connecting their lighting-shaped ribbons and sending shocks between them.

entry: POKENAME因两种不同进化石而诞生，难得一见。它在山中凿洞，让电流涌满其中，也给小型电宝可梦与地面宝可梦提供庇护。
author: thepandasharky
source: A result of two different evolution stones, POKENAME are spotted only on rare occasions. It burrows its caves into mountains, filling it with surges of electrical energy. This also provides shelter for smaller electric and ground Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME血脉中能流过300万伏电压，是雷丘放电电压的30倍。科学家认为，这是借了固拉多维持庞大力量的本领。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME is capable of running 3 million volts through its veins, which is 30 times stronger than a Raichu's body can emit. Scientists believe this is due to Groudon's ability of maintaining immense power.

entry: POKENAME部分身体覆着看似雷之石的矿石，能增强它制造强烈雷暴的能力。
author: partypooperrex
source: Parts of POKENAME are covered in what appear to be Thunder Stones. These help amplify its ability to create powerful thunderstorms.

entry: POKENAME将电力存进脸颊的囊中，月光下会泛起柔光。它借这份能量为迷路的宝可梦照亮夜空，可雷雨时有时也会引来雷击。
author: reaverlamont
source: POKENAME stores electricity in its cheek pouches, which glow softly under moonlight. It uses this energy to illuminate the night sky for lost Pokémon, though its light sometimes attracts lightning during thunderstorms.

entry: POKENAME消耗大量电力，即使一小群也可能让全城停电。会用带刺附肢攀住建筑侧面，不断刺穿外层，直到找到能吸取的电源。
author: pjporwoll
source: Because they consume large amounts of electricity, even a small flock of POKENAME can trigger citywide blackouts. It latches onto the side of structures with its barbed appendages, puncturing until it finds an energy source to drain.

entry: 蓬松毛皮里积起的静电，会被存进颊囊。静电太多时，它们就会变得格外黏人、爱撒娇。
author: faelocke
source: Their cheek pouches store static electricity that builds up in their fluffy fur. Too much of it can make them clingy and needy.

entry: POKENAME躺在废校、旧屋等荒废场所，等人经过捡起。被抱着走了一会儿后，便会狠狠电击发现它的人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME will lie around in abandoned places like old schools or houses waiting for someone to come by and pick them up. They wait until they have been carried for a while and then give a vicious shock to the person that found them.

entry: 身体由带着大量电荷的等离子体构成，能将一块雷之石悬在环状身体中。这块碎石又能进一步增强电能。
author: infinex21
source: Its body is composed of highly-charged plasma, which allows it to suspend a piece of Thunder Stone within the ring-like part of its form. This Thunder Stone piece serves to further amplify its electrical energy.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME的电力会急剧增强，召来的雷击足以夷平一座房屋。
author: .izik
source: During a full moon, POKENAME's electrical powers intensify dramatically. It can summon lightning strikes strong enough to level a house.

entry: POKENAME常因外貌被误当成落到地面的雨云，曾有旅人因此挨了电击。
author: supersonicloki
source: Because of its appearance, POKENAME is often mistaken for a grounded nimbus cloud. Travelers have been known to be shocked by it.

entry: POKENAME能用尾巴随处织出雷电之网。毫无防备的虫子被电中后，网便消散，焦黑的虫子则成了它的饭。
author: sk372
source: Using its tail, POKENAME can quickly draw up webs made of lightning anywhere it pleases. These webs dissipate after zapping unsuspecting bugs, which become charred meals for POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的爪子与獠牙由雷电构成，只有备战时才会显现。庞大电能涌动得越猛烈，爪牙就长得越长、越锋利。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's claws and tusks are made of lightning, only visible once it readies itself for combat. The more it surges its massive electrical energy, the longer and sharper its tusks and claws grow.

entry: 古籍描绘过POKENAME在风暴中立于村落的景象。它吸收道道雷电，保护聚落免遭毁坏。
author: .izik
source: Ancient tomes describe POKENAME standing in villages during storms. It would absorb lightning bolts to shield the settlement from destruction.

entry: 不断给钥匙通电，防止被偷走。电流强得让钥匙发出明亮的光。
author: cait_sith
source: It constantly channels electricity through its keys to prevent anything from stealing them. This electric current is strong enough to make its keys glow brightly.

entry: POKENAME被大量电力吸引，尤其爱到发电厂吸食能量，造成停电。吸收时身体热到极点，速度也快得让人难以看清。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is attracted to large sources of electricity, especially power plants, where it feeds on the energy and causes blackouts. As it absorbs energy, its body heats to extreme temperatures and it accelerates to speeds humans struggle to see.

entry: 因双目失明，会用长尾探摸陌生物品。谁抓住POKENAME的尾巴，就会挨上它用尽全力的一记电击。
author: cait_sith
source: To compensate for its blindness, it uses its long tail to feel novel objects. If something grabs POKENAME's tail, it will be electrocuted with all the power POKENAME can muster.

entry: POKENAME将电力储存在柔软华美的尾巴里。某条尾巴放出强劲电力后，便会因静电蓬松起来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME store electricity in their luxuriously soft tails. After they unleash the potent power from one of their tails, the tail puffs up from the static electricity.

entry: POKENAME生性好强，总想以战斗本领证明自己，让别人刮目相看。只要足够努力，就能让周身迸发电气。
author: sk372
source: Feisty by nature, POKENAME is always eager to prove itself to others in combat and impress them with its prowess. With enough effort, it can flare an electrical aura all around its body.

entry: POKENAME的毛发始终充盈电能，支撑它四处活动、争斗。奔跑时，身后会拖出一道雷电。
author: dualblades1147
source: POKENAME's fur is constantly brimming with electrical energy, powering their incredibly active and aggressive lifestyle. When POKENAME run, you can see a trail of lightning flow behind them.

entry: POKENAME天性贪玩，常能看到它拿路灯杆和电线胡闹。
author: supersonicloki
source: Carrying through life with a playful personality, you may find a POKENAME goofing around with lampposts and power lines.

entry: POKENAME不容许公开演出被打断，总竭尽全力让交响乐震撼全场。起哄者会遭到毫不留情的电击，被赶出场外。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME do not tolerate interruptions during their public performances and put great effort into ensuring their symphonies are awe-inspiring. Hecklers are shocked and ushered out without mercy.

entry: POKENAME偏爱干燥地带，便于引导电击，不让空气中的水分子吸走电力。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME prefers dry, arid environments. This helps it direct its electrical attacks without its power becoming absorbed by the water molecules in the air.

entry: POKENAME攻势凶狠，极少怜悯敌人，会像挥重锤一样甩尾攻击。但尾巴若触地太久，就会耗尽能量。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME are known to be relentless attackers and rarely show any mercy to their foes. They attack their enemies by swinging their tails like maces. If their tail stays in contact with the ground for too long, they will become drained of energy.

entry: POKENAME混在普通气球中，以可爱外貌让一家人买下带回家。随后便吸食家中所有电子设备的电力，直到被发现是罪魁祸首。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME hides among inanimate balloons and uses its cute appearance to be bought by a family. Once it is brought to their home, it will begin to feed on the power of all their electronic devices until it is discovered as the culprit.

entry: POKENAME靠导电凝胶互相传递复杂电脉冲，身体会将信号放大。宝可梦研究者正在研究这种交流方式，尝试用于工程技术。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their conductive gel to communicate with one another, sending complex electrical impulses that are amplified by their bodies. Pokémon Researchers are studying this communication method and attempting to apply it to engineering.

entry: POKENAME不断发出像窃笑般的吱鸣，用来回声定位。喜欢从尾巴放出一道闪电，照亮幽暗洞穴。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME makes chittering, laughter-like chirps constantly to echolocate. It loves lighting dark caverns with a flash of lightning from its tail.

entry: POKENAME群体以鸣叫配合尾巴的电火花交流。若被惹恼，就会毫不犹豫地电击怒气的源头。
author: chibitales
source: Flocks communicate with each other through a combination of chirps and electrical sparks from their tails. If they get agitated, POKENAME will not hesitate to shock the source of their anger.

entry: POKENAME会霸占认作食场的建筑，凶狠赶走其他吸食能量的宝可梦。有些工作场所会摆出可弃用的设备当点心，安抚这位无意间招来的守卫。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is possessive of the building it has designated as its feeding ground, aggressively chasing away other energy-consuming Pokémon. Some workspaces will leave burner devices out as treats to placate the inadvertent POKENAME guardian.

entry: POKENAME尖牙带电，会持续电击猎物，直到将其麻痹。虽然电力强劲，性情却很友善，喜欢亲昵地蹭着训练家玩。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's sharp fangs are charged with electricity, shocking its prey until they become paralyzed. Despite its electrical power, POKENAME is very friendly and loves to playfully nuzzle its Trainer.

entry: 野生POKENAME会拼命保护自己的雷之石，谁想偷走就会让它们暴怒。它们还会拿石头砸野生皮卡丘，强迫其进化。
author: donutsbg
source: Wild POKENAME protect their Thunder Stones. If someone tries to steal them, they go berserk. They hit wild Pikachu with the Stones to force evolution.

entry: POKENAME靠滚动产生静电。滚下坡时，身后会回荡着雷声。
author: shreks_stepfather
source: POKENAME generates static electricity by rolling. When it rolls downhill, the sound of thunder echoes behind it.

entry: 两条尾巴在雷暴中是绝佳的避雷针。它因此能以惊人速度安全载着最多3个人，直到找到合适的避难处。
author: epping_forest
source: Its two tails act as the perfect lightning rods during a thunderstorm. This way, it can safely carry up to 3 people at an incredible speed, until finding proper shelter.

entry: POKENAME几秒内就能让尖牙裹满电火花，麻痹猎物。雷暴时却似乎不再那么好斗，仿佛隆隆雷声能安抚它。
author: fiordaliso
source: In a matter of seconds, POKENAME can coat its sharp teeth with electric sparks, which it uses to paralyze its prey. Its aggressive temperament seems to calm down during thunderstorms, as if the rumble of thunder soothes it.

entry: POKENAME释放纷飞冰晶，冻结周围的水，再向冰中放出强劲雷电，造出美丽的光景。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME freeze water around them by releasing a flurry of ice crystals. Once the water has been frozen, they unleash powerful bolts of lightning into the ice to create beautiful displays of light.

entry: 午夜，POKENAME会对电力产生无尽渴望。因此常能见它将尾巴刺进裸露电缆，抽取能量。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: At midnight, POKENAME gains an unquenchable thirst for electricity. As a result, it can often be found injecting its tail into exposed cables, siphoning their energy.

entry: POKENAME双翼一动就会电光噼啪，让热烈的舞蹈更显华丽。可观看时须保持安全距离，免得挨上疼痛的电击。
author: .jerden
source: Every movement of POKENAME's wings causes them to crackle with electricity. While this makes its energetic dances more dramatic, they must be watched from a safe distance to avoid a painful shock.

entry: POKENAME摇动绒球，为队友补充能量，同时在绒毛间收集静电。能量越积越多，满腔干劲甚至会化作雷鸣般的轰响。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME shake their pom-poms to literally energize their teammates, collecting static electricity along the fluff. As more and more energy builds, a POKENAME's motivation can rumble as loud as roaring thunder.

entry: POKENAME通常悠闲平静，战斗时也一样。可体内电力若积得太多，谁靠近它手持的闪电形物件，都可能遭到电击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME usually seems to be calm and relaxed, even in combat. However, if too much electricity builds up within its body, it may shock anyone who gets near the lightning bolt-shaped objects it holds in its hands.

entry: POKENAME在暗处微微发光，常被错认成幽灵。夜间爱在屋顶跳诡异舞蹈的习惯，或许也让它更显阴森。
author: .jerden
source: Because POKENAME glow faintly in the dark, they are often mistaken for ghosts. Their tendency to perform eerie night-time dances on rooftops likely contributes to their spooky reputation.

entry: 在遥远而森林密布的地区，城里常能见到穿着时髦宝可梦服装的POKENAME。它们的日常习惯，往往与人类生活很像。
author: ocxin
source: In the urban centers of distant, densely forested regions, it is not unheard of to meet these Pokémon wearing fashionable Poké-clothes. POKENAME's daily rituals are often reminiscent of human lives.

entry: 在远方被古森林包围的城市，这些宝可梦常从出生起就与人类共同生活。它们受到平等对待，人类社会也像照顾任何成员一样，满足它们的需要。
author: ocxin
source: In distant cities surrounded by ancient forests, these Pokémon live among humans, often from birth. They are treated as equals, with human societies working to meet their needs like anyone else's.

entry: POKENAME的晶体身体与雷之石由同一种矿物构成。包在里面的雷丘看似睡着，却仍完全掌控着融合体的电力。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's crystalline body is made of the same mineral as a Thunder Stone. The Raichu encased inside appears to be asleep, but retains full control of the fusion's electrical abilities.

entry: POKENAME存电太多时，会散出带电的花粉。这些花粉，甚至能为大型机械供电。
author: darkweavile428
source: When POKENAME has too much stored electricity, it will scatter electrically charged pollen. This pollen can be used to power large machinery.

entry: POKENAME身体柔软毛绒，很受年幼训练家欢迎。爱被抱着走，也爱被轻轻捏抱。有人逗它玩时，脸颊黄斑会开心地迸出小火花。
author: katieplaysgames
source: With their soft, plush bodies, POKENAME are popular Pokémon with young Trainers. They enjoy being carried around and being squeezed, the yellow patches on their cheeks giving small sparks of joy when they're played with.

entry: POKENAME活动时会积起静电，毛发与蓬松身体在战斗中不断产生电势。会将这份电能化为拳击，以强劲电击重创敌人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME build static as they move, their fur and fluffy bodies generating electrical potential whilst they fight. They deliver this electrical energy as punches, shocking their foes with powerful strikes.

entry: POKENAME只有雷暴时才浮出水面，吸收雷击。会先以长链缠住敌人，再释放1,000,000伏电力轰击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will only breach the surface during thunderstorms to absorb lightning strikes. It wraps its opponent with its long chain before blasting them with 1,000,000 volts of electricity.

entry: POKENAME从尾巴放出微弱电脉冲，吸引猎物。等对方靠近，便用锋利毒刺攻击，将其钉在海底，轻松捕获。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lets loose small electric pulses from its tail to attract prey. Once they are close, it attacks with its sharp venomous spikes, pinning them to the seafloor for an easy catch.

entry: POKENAME靠羽毛摩擦发电，滑翔时尤其明显。虽然能放雷电远攻，却更偏爱近战，曾被发现抓住敌人电击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME generate electricity through the friction of their feathers, especially when gliding through the air. Though they can fight with electrical bolts, they prefer to fight up close. They have been known to grapple foes and shock them.

entry: POKENAME体内的寄生真菌迫使它不停进食，为本体与寄生者补足能量。真菌又会将多余能量化为电力，以电击保护宿主。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The parasitic fungi growing within the body of POKENAME force the Pokémon to constantly feed so that they have enough energy for themselves and their parasites. The fungi discharge excess energy as electricity, using the shocks to protect their host.

entry: 颈部毛发中似乎藏着细小的雷之石碎块。天性爱玩，可毛常带着大量电荷，很容易不慎电到人。
author: fireblade141
source: The fur around its neck appears to contain little pieces of thunder stones. This Pokémon is naturally very playful, but its fur is usually highly electrically charged, so it is easy to get shocked accidentally.

entry: 电力过剩时，POKENAME会用急促高亢的歌声热情宣泄能量。若歌唱时遭人侮辱，就会尖啸着放出雷电，将对方麻痹，强行扭转其情绪。
author: soup1900
source: When too full of electricity, POKENAME sings songs in a quick, high-pitched voice to passionately let its energy out. If someone insults it during its singing, it screams out lightning bolts to paralyze them and forcefully change their feelings.

entry: 电力过剩时，POKENAME会用快速高亢的歌声热情宣泄能量。谁在歌唱时惹它烦，就会迎来雷电尖啸，被迫改变自己的态度。
author: soup1900
source: When too full of electricity, POKENAME sings songs in a fast, high-pitched voice to passionately let its energy out. People who annoy it during its singing are met with screams of lightning bolts that force them to change their attitudes.

entry: POKENAME站在长尾上保持平衡，表演精彩花式与华丽动作，同时让电力保持接地。大型演出前会先用尾巴集电，确保闪耀的表演有足够能量。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its long tail as a balance to stand on top of and do fantastic tricks and showy moves while keeping its voltage grounded. It gathers electricity with its tail right before big performances so it has enough energy for its sparking shows.

entry: 放电后，蘑菇会明显缩小、萎蔫。POKENAME必须留意补充电力，否则护身的菌盖会彻底干枯，让它毫无抵抗之力。
author: sk372
source: After discharging electricity, the mushroom noticeably shrinks and shrivels. POKENAME must be careful to let itself recharge, lest its protective cap dry out completely and leave it helpless.

entry: 头顶心形的雷之石令人垂涎。可不管对方多强，只要想夺走，它都会凶猛反击。
author: h0bojoe
source: The heart-shaped Thunder Stone on its head is highly coveted. However, it fiercely attacks anyone who attempts to take it, no matter how strong they are.

entry: 身上的雷之石能无限再生，因此很受电属性训练家追捧。但只有在激烈决斗中击败它，才会获赠石头。
author: h0bojoe
source: It can regrow the Thunder Stones on its body indefinitely, making it highly sought after by Electric-type Trainers. However, it only gives them to those who can defeat it in a fierce duel.

entry: 轻轻抖动鳞片，就能释放最高100,000伏电力。身上长出的雷之石，以纯度出众闻名。
author: h0bojoe
source: A simple shake of its scales can release up to 100,000 volts of electricity. The Thunder Stones growing from its body are famed as some of the purest ever discovered.

entry: POKENAME最大的手掌内有专门的储电器官。被迫近战时，一接触便会放出蓄能，打出强大的电击冲击拳，将敌人轰飞。
author: sk372
source: Special organs within POKENAME's largest hands store electrical charges. When forced into close-quarters combat, it dispels the stored energy on contact to create powerful shockwave punches that blow its foes away.

entry: 以花瓣吸收阳光补充能量。常在微风中起舞，放出柔和火花，让观者入迷。
author: dammaskk
source: It absorbs sunlight with its petals to recharge energy. It often dances in the breeze, releasing gentle sparks that mesmerize onlookers.

entry: POKENAME体内嵌着雷之石碎片，让岩石身体泛出黄水晶般的亮黄色。电力充足时，会一边追着尾巴跑，一边分次放出少量电流。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have shards of Thunder Stones embedded in their body and cause their rocky bodies to glow a citrine yellow. Whenever they are full of electricity, they discharge it in small bursts while chasing their tail.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇需要大量电能生长，迫使它挖出电缆，咬开后吸食流过的电力。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The mushroom growing on the backs of POKENAME require a lot of electrical energy to grow. This energy requirement pushes POKENAME to dig out electrical cables, biting into them to feed on the power running through them.

entry: POKENAME与其他电属性宝可梦摩擦，积起静电。毛发随之根根竖起，直到放电后才恢复。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME develop a static charge by rubbing against another Electric-type Pokémon. This causes their hair to stand on end until they discharge the electricity.

entry: POKENAME能极细致地预测天气变化。只要成群聚在高处，就一定会有毁灭性的风暴出现。
author: turron_turron
source: POKENAME have the ability to predict weather patterns with remarkable detail. When groups of POKENAME gather at high altitudes, a devastating storm is always sure to appear.

entry: POKENAME能用电力凝成手里剑。伸长舌头后，也能像尾巴一样运用。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME is able to create shurikens out of electricity. POKENAME is also able to use its tongue like a tail if extended.

entry: 鳞片中含有大量化学能，受到攻击就会一次放出全部电力。古人会晒干POKENAME的鳞片，加入提振精力的药剂。
author: mistymagius
source: Its scales contain large amounts of chemical energy, and when struck by an attack, they discharge all of their electricity at once. Ancient people dried POKENAME's scales and used them in energizing elixirs.

entry: POKENAME渐渐喜欢上毛发受到关注的感觉。它懂得大家喜爱这份蓬松，因而不太会再电击想抚摸它的对象。
author: chaotic_aspergers
source: POKENAME has grown to like the attention its fur gets. It understands people's love for the fluff, and is much less likely to shock those who try to touch it.

entry: POKENAME偶尔会猛烈放电，将毛发中的糖分焦糖化。做成的焦糖格外甜，厨师们正在试做以此为原料的特色甜点。
author: quantumradiation
source: POKENAME occasionally discharges large bursts of electricity that cause the sugars present in its fur to caramelise. Chefs have been experimenting with speciality desserts using this caramel, since it has an even greater sweetness than usual.

entry: POKENAME闯进发电厂，吸食发电机的能量。储电充足时，双颊会燃起极热的火焰，连雨水也浇不灭。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME raids power plants to feed on the energy in generators. When full of electricity, its cheeks are covered in a fire so hot it does not go out even in the rain.

entry: POKENAME从地下甩出尾巴放电，两次攻击之间再收进土里充电。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lashes its tail from beneath the ground to discharge electricity. It retracts the tail into the dirt to recharge between attacks.

entry: POKENAME挖隧道通往发电厂，咬穿地下电线，直接以电为食，将能量存进体内。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME tunnels toward power plants to chew through buried wires. It feeds directly on electricity, storing the energy within its body.

entry: 用强爪撕开无人看管的车身，吃里面的电子零件。POKENAME一旦突然甩尾，就在准备发动致命攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: With its powerful claws, it tears open the frames of unattended cars to feed on the electronic components inside. When POKENAME suddenly swishes its tail, it is preparing to launch a deadly attack.

entry: POKENAME在脸颊发电，产生过多便会头痛，只有猛然放电才能缓解。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME generate electricity in their cheeks. When they generate too much electricity, they get a headache that can only be relieved by a sudden discharge.

entry: POKENAME打法十分混乱，快速难测的动作常让对手放松警惕。最喜欢雷电拳，通常以此终结与劲敌的对决。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME fights with a very chaotic style; its quick, erratic movements often cause opponents to lower their guard. Its favorite technique is Thunder Punch, with which it usually finishes duels against its rivals.

entry: 若无法释放体内蓄电，就会暴怒失控。POKENAME打法凶暴，靠纯粹的蛮力压制对手。
author: fiordaliso
source: If it cannot discharge the electrical energy stored in its body, it flies into a furious rage and becomes uncontrollable. POKENAME has a very violent fighting style, overpowering opponents through sheer brute force.

entry: POKENAME在雷暴中最活跃，会在云下飞奔，紧盯天空等待雷击。察觉闪电将至，便高举尾巴，试着接住。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are most active during thunderstorms, racing beneath the clouds whilst watching the sky above them, waiting for lightning to strike. They raise their tail high when they anticipate a bolt of lightning, attempting to catch it with their tail.

entry: POKENAME口中喷出烈焰与强雷，迅速扫清一切挡路者。骄傲不驯的性格，让它很难被捕获。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shoots blazing flames and potent lightning from its mouth, which makes quick work of anything standing in its way. Its proud and defiant personality makes it difficult to catch.

entry: POKENAME腹膜极薄，连刚吞下的东西都能看清。经常吃雷之石，增强电属性攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: The membrane on POKENAME's belly is so thin that the last thing it swallowed remains visible through it. It frequently ingests Thunder Stones to enhance the power of its electric attacks.

entry: POKENAME借紧握的雷之石引导超能力与电力。战斗时混合两种能量，先用念力将敌人甩来甩去，再施以强雷。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME channels its psychic and electrical powers through the thunderstone it clutches. It mixes these energies in battle, throwing its opponents around with telekinesis, followed by shocking them with powerful thunderbolts.

entry: 雷暴时，POKENAME会变得好斗。闪电落下前，常能看见它们以超能力冲击互相攻击。可雷一击中，又会突然平静。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME grow aggressive during thunderstorms and can be seen battling one another with blasts of psychic energy in the moments before a lightning strike. When struck by lightning, POKENAME abruptly calm down again.

entry: POKENAME凭强大力量控制大量电能，打出的雷击能干扰对手神经元的活动。雷暴来临时，常在高山冥想。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME controls large amounts of electricity with its might. Delivering powerful thunderbolts can mess with its opponent's neurons. It can be seen meditating on tall mountains when thunderstorms roll in.

entry: POKENAME摩擦双拳蓄电，再挥出满是火花的猛烈重拳。精力十足，不知疲倦，连续跑上几小时也不会累。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME rubs its fists together to charge them with electricity before striking with devastating, spark-filled punches. Energetic and tireless, it can run for hours without getting exhausted.

entry: POKENAME要打雷电拳时，双颊就会闪光。可即使知道这点，许多格斗者还是败在强大的它们手下。
author: quackquackattack
source: When POKENAME are about to strike with a Thunder Punch, their cheeks sparkle. Even with this knowledge, many fighters still lose matches against the powerful POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME亮橘色的头能够储电。会长出在细小空隙间穿行的根，帮助电工安全铺设屋内电线。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a bright clementine-colored head that stores electricity. They help electricians safely run wires through houses by sprouting roots that snake through small spaces.

entry: POKENAME体内积了大量电力时，尾巴和双颊的火焰就会猛烈燃烧。随后释放强劲电流，排出能量。
author: keiracm35_
source: When POKENAME builds up a lot of electricity, the flames on its tail and cheeks burn with great intensity. It unleashes powerful electric discharges to release energy.

entry: 人们常担心POKENAME电击太强，壳会承受不住。幸好，硬壳抵挡这种力量绰绰有余。
author: killerrene64
source: People often worry that the sheer power of its electric attacks is too much for POKENAME's shell to handle. Luckily, its shell is more than capable of withstanding such power.

entry: POKENAME用嘴罩住猎物的头，再释放阵阵电流。随后涌出大量酸液，将对方整只吸进去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wraps its mouth around the head of prey before unleashing waves of electricity. It then releases deluges of acid before inhaling the foe whole.

entry: 除了8条触手，POKENAME的喙也能产生高压电。进化时用过的雷之石，如今嵌在头上。
author: g_birde
source: Along with its eight tentacles, POKENAME's beak produces a high electrical charge. The Thunder Stone it used to evolve is now embedded in its head.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴吸收大气中过多的电力，便靠双臂反复攀山消耗。夜里将尾巴扎进地面，防止自己被电到。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME will climb up and down mountains with its arms to expend the excessive electrical energy it absorbs from the atmosphere with its tail. At night, it will anchor into the ground with its tail to keep itself safe from being shocked.

entry: POKENAME身上石头迸出的电火花危险得很，毫无防护的皮肤哪怕轻碰，也会突然麻痹。
author: .izik
source: Sparks from the stones on POKENAME's body are dangerously strong. Even light contact can result in sudden paralysis to unprotected skin.

entry: POKENAME外形像阿罗拉的隆隆岩，攻击性较低，储电却多得多。发怒时，雷击能从山上轰下一大块岩石。
author: sk372
source: Bearing a resemblance to Golem's Alolan counterpart, POKENAME is less aggressive by comparison, but contains far greater stores of electricity. An angered POKENAME could carve chunks out of a mountain with its lightning bolts.

entry: 鬃毛与尾巴由炽热的等离子体构成，一碰便能让对方全身严重灼伤。体内的电力，还让POKENAME跑出时速80英里。
author: mistymagius
source: Its mane and tail are made of a hot plasma that on contact, will cause nasty burns all over the victim's body. Its internal electricity allows for POKENAME to run up to 80 mph.

entry: POKENAME全速奔驰，身后便拖出雷电，起跑声轰然如雷。暴雨雷暴中，会在电闪雷鸣间开心腾跃。
author: sk372
source: Lightning trails behind POKENAME when it gallops at full speed, taking off with a sound akin to a thunderbolt when it runs. During heavy rain and thunderstorms, it prances happily among the thunder and lightning.

entry: POKENAME的壳既能防身，也能储存大量电力，留待以后通过尾巴释放。
author: daimposter_60614
source: POKENAME's shell is not just used for protection, but also for storing large masses of electricity that can be discharged later through its tail.

entry: POKENAME释放强大电场，沿着星球的磁力线缓缓漂行。磁铁始终顺着磁场极性排列，有时会被困在强劲发电机附近。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME produce a powerful electrical field that allows them to float along the planet's magnetic lines. They move slowly and will always align their magnets along the polarity of the field, sometimes getting caught near powerful generators.

entry: POKENAME常在发电厂以磁铁抽取电力。战斗时，所有磁铁会同时发射强劲的电能冲击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is commonly found in power plants, using its magnets to siphon off the electricity. In combat, it fires powerful blasts of electrical energy from all of its magnets at once.

entry: POKENAME会在雷暴时出现在池塘与河面。人类投喂时，更喜欢烧焦的食物。
author: snookerron
source: POKENAME appear on ponds and rivers during thunderstorms. If offered food by humans, they prefer it to be burnt.

entry: POKENAME用能抓握的尾巴击落悬果，再劈成两半，让两颗头分享。储电太多会变得好斗，双头甚至会相互攻击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their prehensile tails to knock down hanging fruits and split them in half for their two heads to share. They turn aggressive if they store too much electricity, and their two heads will turn on each other.

entry: POKENAME奔驰大地时不断蓄电。一停下，积攒的能量就会猛烈爆发，在周围掀起凶险电暴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME builds up internal stores of electricity as it races across the land. When it finally stops, it releases the stored-up energy in a powerful burst, creating vicious electric storms all around it.

entry: POKENAME在对战中喷出带电洪流，将对手浇透、麻痹。必要时缩进坚壳，抵挡攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME blasts torrents of electrified water towards opponents in a Pokémon battle, soaking and paralyzing them in the process. When needed, it withdraws into its sturdy shell to repel attacks.

entry: POKENAME常出现在美式橄榄球队，替补生病或受伤的球员。极少数时候，擒抱其他球员还会放出大量电力。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are often spotted among gridiron football teams, filling in for sick or injured players. Rarely, they discharge a large amount of electricity when tackling another player.

entry: POKENAME以长尾缠住电线，大口吸电。充满后会穿墙而入，电击熟睡的受害者，只为看对方惊恐醒来。
author: labreezy187
source: POKENAME coils its long tail around power lines to gorge itself on electricity. When fully charged, POKENAME slips through walls and delivers shocks to sleeping victims just to watch them wake in terror.

entry: POKENAME释放的强劲电流，会作用于脑中调节睡眠的部位。飞行属性宝可梦遭强电后，尤其容易睡着。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release powerful bursts of electricity that target parts of the brain that regulate sleep. Flying-type Pokémon are particularly susceptible to fall asleep after a powerful shock.

entry: POKENAME用手臂上的闪电形突起作避雷针，被雷击后便将电力储进体内。沿海滩觅食时，先用巨钳抓住猎物，再释放猛烈雷电。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use the bolt on their arm as a lightning rod, storing the electricity within themselves once struck. They will roam beaches for food, grabbing prey with their large claws before delivering a devastating surge of lightning.

entry: POKENAME每天要吃大量食物。天生吃叶片与树果，家养个体还很爱吃馅饼。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME eat copious amounts of food on a daily basis. While their natural diet consists of leaves and berries, domesticated POKENAME love to eat pies.

entry: 饿得太厉害就会闹出爆炸。喜欢吃电池与雷之石，两者都能增强体内电流。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon throw explosive fits if they grow too hungry. They love to eat batteries and Thunder Stones, both of which help amplify their electrical currents.

entry: POKENAME从睡梦中被叫醒，就会爆发怒气，只有塞满肚子才肯平静。可惜有人偏爱玩“推倒POKENAME”，把它推得滚起来。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME fly into explosive fits of rage if they are awakened from their slumbers, and will only calm down after stuffing themselves with food. Some people, unfortunately, engage in "POKENAME Tipping" which involves sending a POKENAME rolling.

entry: POKENAME通常约六只结伴同行，只有觅食时才分开。找到食物就重新集合，没到齐，谁也不肯开吃。
author: sk372
source: Traveling in a clutch of around six, POKENAME only separate as a group in order to forage food. Once they've found it, they group back together, refusing to eat until the entire group is assembled.

entry: POKENAME几乎总在嚼骨头，也拿它作棍棒自卫。唾液黏得惊人，让食物与碎屑积在骨头上，之后再一口吞下。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are almost always chewing on a bone, which they use as a club to defend themselves. Their saliva is incredibly sticky, allowing food and debris to collect on these bones, which they later eat in one gulp.

entry: 吃腐烂物会增强POKENAME毒气的威力。因此想等食物腐败再吃，却总忍不住，常没等变质就已经吃掉。
author: darkweavile428
source: Eating rotted matter increases the potency of the poison gas that POKENAME emits. Because of this, POKENAME tries to wait until its food rots, but it often can't control itself and ends up eating the food while it's still fresh.

entry: POKENAME发育时，会吃放在面前的食物。最爱馅饼，因此许多好心人会留下馅饼，给它当点心。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME eat food left before them while their bodies develop. They prefer pies above all else, so many empathetic people leave behind pies for them to snack on.

entry: POKENAME靠树上落下的树果维生。可各颗头口味不同，常朝互相冲突的方向移动。
author: hortensia_xxiii
source: POKENAME subsists off of berries that fall from trees. Unfortunately, its heads have different tastes, and will often move in conflicting directions.

entry: POKENAME猛撞树木，震落果实与树果大吃，也可能朝美味的气味冲去。只要跑起来，就很难停下。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME charge and ram trees to knock free fruits and berries to gorge upon, but they may also charge toward the source of a delicious scent. When they start running, they struggle to stop.

entry: POKENAME将树果存进腹前育儿袋，格外喜欢灯浆果。它能帮助甩开那些成群想偷袋中食物的小拉达。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME store berries in the pouch in front of their stomach. They are particularly fond of Chilan Berries because the berry helps them shake off hordes of Rattata that try to steal from their pouch.

entry: 刚进化的POKENAME食欲极盛，附近一切食物都吃。吃完后，连碎屑也剩不了几粒。
author: quackquackattack
source: Recently evolved POKENAME are voracious creatures that eat any and all food in the nearby vicinity. They leave behind few crumbs when they are finished eating.

entry: POKENAME有种奇特性质：接触黏液般的身体，就会像被挠痒般开心大笑。与它相处后会发现，它比起树果更爱吃甜食。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME have a strange quality; contact with their goop-like body leaves the person or Pokémon joyful and laughing, as if being tickled. Interactions with POKENAME show that they prefer eating sweets instead of berries.

entry: 胃口极大，要吃自身体重两倍的食物，才能保持健康体形。便宜的甜甜圈能替它补足大量热量。
author: quackquackattack
source: Their appetite is enormous, as their bodies require a diet twice their body weight to maintain a healthy size. Cheaply made doughnuts help fill them up with calories.

entry: POKENAME一天能吃17顿，各顿偏爱的食物都不同。时辰与食物若不对，就会闹脾气。
author: kiwiarms
source: POKENAME are known to eat as many as 17 distinct meals a day, with different food preferences for each one. The wrong food at the wrong time can lead to a tantrum.

entry: 古代文明敬奉POKENAME，每年都献上食物。若它拒绝贡品，人们便恐惧大饥荒将至。
author: mepp.
source: Ancient civilizations revered POKENAME and would make yearly offerings of food to the Pokémon. If POKENAME rejected the tribute, it was feared that a great famine would ensue.

entry: POKENAME贪吃得很，试图偷其他宝可梦巢中的树果。可又懒得把巢筑大，存不下那么多，果子只好往巢外掉。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are incredibly greedy, attempting to steal berries from other Pokémon's nests. However, they are too lazy to build a big enough nest to store all these berries, so they end up dropping out of the nest.

entry: POKENAME将树果串成链，飞到哪里都有点心。野外个体有时会争抢食物串，玩起拔河。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME strings together chains of berries so that it always has a snack while flying around. POKENAME in the wild sometimes get into tug-of-war matches over these food-strings.

entry: POKENAME最爱的点心，竟是其他蛛类宝可梦的网。若放任不管，一小时就能吃光整个阿利多斯群落的蛛网，还觉得有点饿。
author: sk372
source: Interestingly, POKENAME's favorite snack is the webbing of other arachnid Pokémon. Left unchecked, it could remove the webs of an entire colony of Ariados in an hour, and still feel peckish.

entry: 吐出黏丝获取并固定食物，最偏爱水果与树果。谁想偷吃，就会被獠牙注入催眠毒液，昏睡过去。
author: infinex21
source: It spits sticky silk webbing to procure and secure food for itself, favoring fruits and berries above all else. If anything tries to steal its food, it will use its fangs to inject a soporific venom and knock them out.

entry: POKENAME迅速飞过森林，找到什么果实与树果就整颗吞下。许多宝可梦会追猎它，哪怕只是为了阻止它偷自己的食物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME fly rapidly through forests, swallowing whole any fruits or berries they can find. Many other Pokémon hunt POKENAME, even if just to keep POKENAME from stealing their food.

entry: POKENAME在巧可果树间飞行，采果留着以后吃。吃饱时，飞着飞着肚子也跟着晃，模样滑稽又可爱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies between Occa Berry trees, gathering berries to eat later. When full, its belly jiggles as it flies, making it a comical and endearing sight.

entry: POKENAME还在学习用双手制造电火花。喂一颗释陀果，便能积起大量电力，再从脚底释放，将自己弹上空中。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are still learning to create sparks with their hands. Feeding them a Custap Berry helps them charge up lots of electricity that they release from their feet, sending them flying.

entry: POKENAME在夜空下聚集，边吃点心边看星月。食谱从树果到进化石都有，让训练家颇为头疼。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME gather under the night sky to snack while watching the moon and stars. Their diet ranges from berries to evolution stones, so they can be quite a nuisance to Trainers.

entry: POKENAME在夜空下聚集，边吃点心边看星月。食谱从树果到进化石都有，让训练家颇为头疼。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME gather under the night sky to snack while watching the moon and stars. Their diet ranges from berries to evolution stones, so they can be quite a nuisance to Trainers.

entry: 蓬松羊毛静电充沛，常会黏住杂物。开心时，比如正大口吃东西，尾端球体就会泛出微光。
author: infinex21
source: Their fluffy wool is so rife with static electricity that debris is oft caught within. When happy, such as when gorging themselves with food, their tail orbs faintly glow.

entry: 飞行时心不在焉，滑过风筝便常被缠住。自己解不开，只好停在崖顶求助。
author: quackquackattack
source: Their absentminded flying causes them to catch onto kites as they glide past. They are known to rest atop cliffs and ask for help when this happens, unable to untangle themselves.

entry: POKENAME常吃人们丢弃的金枕果，在垃圾桶之间穿梭，寻找一切能入口的东西。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often resort to eating Durin Berries that people throw away. They scurry between garbage cans to find whatever they can eat.

entry: 每天要吃下相当于体重的树果，见一颗就仔细检查，没熟便丢。野生POKENAME是果园的害兽，成群出现就能毁掉农民整年的收成。
author: vic1312
source: Every day, they will eat their body weight in berries, picking and examining each fruit they come across, discarding the unripe ones. Wild POKENAME are considered pests within berry orchards, as troops can ruin a farmer's harvest for the whole year.

entry: POKENAME朝沙鳞果树上的果实掷泥团，收集后裹满泥再吃。独特的采食与料理方式，让它乐在其中。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lobs globs of mud at berries in Salac Berry Trees, gathering them up and coating them in mud before eating. This unique method of collecting and preparing its food helps it enjoy the berries in a special way.

entry: POKENAME柔软温和，会打盹，留时间消化食物。看似很好抱，身体却覆着护身黏液，真要抱住并不容易。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is soft and gentle, and takes naps to give itself time to digest food. Despite its cuddly appearance, its body is covered in a protective slime that makes hugging it difficult.

entry: POKENAME俯冲偷走路人的小饰物。偷来虽无用，有人追索时却仍要拿食物交换，才肯归还。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME swoops in and pilfers trinkets from passersby. It has no use for what it steals, but will only return it to those who give chase if they present it with food to trade back what it stole.

entry: POKENAME总带着各式水果与树果。它们难免会被护着囤粮的其他宝可梦打伤。每逢这时，就咬下一颗沙鳞果，以最快速度逃走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME keep an assortment of fruits and berries with them at all times. Whenever they inevitably get hurt by another Pokémon trying to defend their horde of food, they bite down on a Salac Berry and flee as fast as they can.

entry: 穿过森林与田野时，长毛常沾带枝条、果实与其他草木。许多养分要分给背上种子，因此常睡觉。
author: infinex21
source: Its long fur tends to pick up and track twigs, fruits, and other vegetation as it wanders through forests and fields. It sleeps often due to having to share much of its nutrients with the bulb atop its back.

entry: POKENAME走得极慢，沿途吃残渣与落下的草木。受威胁便用力抖动，让花朵撒出大量催眠孢子。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME move very slow, eating whatever scraps or fallen vegetation they come across. If threatened, they shake strongly to scatter many soporific spores from their flowers.

entry: POKENAME用岩石般的硬牙咬倒烛木果树，再大口吃果。进食时谁敢靠近，就使出鬼面，护住美餐。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its rock-hard fangs to fell Wacan Berry trees before gorging on the fruit. It will use Scary Face if anyone gets close while it eats, protecting its bounty.

entry: POKENAME飘上樱子果树吃果实，一天能吃光十棵树的果子，随后消失在夜色里。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats up to Cheri Berry trees to feast on fruit. It can drain ten trees in a day before vanishing into the night.

entry: POKENAME讨厌睡觉，每只钳子都夹着一支宝可梦之笛，一犯困就吹。巢边还囤着栗子，入夜便吃。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME hates sleeping, so it carries a Poké Flute in each pincer, playing them whenever it gets sleepy. It keeps a hoard of chestnuts around its nest, eating them as night falls.

entry: POKENAME在棱瓜果树枝间飞行，抢在同类发现前尽量多吃。靠吃得快，避免与同伴争抢。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies between Coba Berry branches, eating as many berries as it can before others of its kind find the tree. Its quick consumption helps it avoid competition from its flock.

entry: POKENAME吞下大量水，身体就会迅速大幅胀起，毒刺也随之竖直。游泳时会用大嘴抓住小型猎物，整只吞下。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can greatly expand at rapid speeds by swallowing large quantities of water, which causes their venomous quills to stand on end. They catch small prey with their large mouths as they swim and swallow them whole.

entry: POKENAME很少吃树果，吃也只是为了制造主要能量来源——果汁。虽然馋得很，仍必须忍住，不能全部喝光，否则可能丧命。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME eat berries infrequently, only doing so to create more of their main source of energy, juice. Despite all urges to do so, POKENAME have to refrain from drinking all of the juice they make, as it could lead to death.

entry: POKENAME爱偷偷进城，洗劫糖果店，把赃物藏在巨喙里。训练家常在巢中找到来路不明的糖纸，便是它捣蛋的证据。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME has a habit of sneaking into towns and raiding candy shops, storing its loot inside its oversized beak. Trainers often find mysterious candy wrappers in its nest as evidence of its mischief.

entry: 用鼻子翻找蔬菜，有时也会发现埋着的食物。只要没毒，吃什么都无所谓。
author: infinex21
source: They use their snouts to root for vegetables, though sometimes come across buried food. They are indifferent about what they eat, so long as their would-be food is not poisonous.

entry: 用强韧獠牙掘食物、找水，有时也凿树吸汁。食物整吞后能消化数周，让它比有些生物更善于熬过严冬。
author: infinex21
source: It uses its tough tusks to dig for food and water, though it sometimes taps trees for sap. It can swallow food whole and spend weeks digesting it, helping it survive harsh winters better than some.

entry: 饥饿与贪心让POKENAME抢走别人的食物，再蜷球滚走。速度与惯性太大，停下后常会恶心难受。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's hunger and greed can lead it to snatching food from others before curling into a ball and rolling away. The high speed and momentum often lead to it getting sick once it finally stops.

entry: POKENAME吃过福禄果，超能力就会增强。许多营养师认为，树果安定心绪，让它思路清晰，更能集中发挥本领。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's psychic powers amplify after eating a Payapa Berry. Many nutritionists claim the berry eases its mind, allowing it to think clearer and focus its abilities more effectively.

entry: POKENAME尾上的颜料主要来自吃剩的树果浆，因此作品总带着淡淡甜香。倒也相称，多数画作都少不了某种食物。
author: sk372
source: The paint on POKENAME's tail primarily consists of the pulped remains of its berry meals, so its drawings always retain a faintly sweet smell after being painted. Fittingly, most of its artwork includes food in some form.

entry: POKENAME靠强健双腿跳上草蚕果树。虽偏爱最高枝头的果子，可一路下树，最终还是会把全树吃光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its superior leg strength to jump to the top of Charti Berry trees. While it prefers the berries on the topmost branches, it eventually eats all of them as it descends back to the ground.

entry: 身体缠绕力惊人，却因整吞食物而塞得太满，发挥不出。偏爱大果实与蔬菜，也曾被见到吞吃宝可梦蛋。
author: infinex21
