source: Though their bodies have remarkable constrictive power, they swallow food whole and thus their bodies are too stuff to utilize it well. They favor large fruits and vegetables, though have been witnessed devouring Pokémon eggs as well.

entry: 身体缠绕力惊人，却因整吞食物而塞得太满，发挥不出。偏爱大果实与蔬菜，也曾被见到吞吃宝可梦蛋。
author: infinex21
source: Though their bodies have remarkable constrictive power, they swallow food whole and thus their bodies are too stuff to utilize it well. They favor large fruits and vegetables, though have been witnessed devouring Pokémon eggs as well.

entry: 罕见的宝可梦，腹内始终有一簇小火。聪明得出奇，又极爱食物，会吐火星烤过各种东西再吃，甚至借简单工具帮忙。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is a rare Pokémon who holds a small but ever-present flame in its gut. It has surprising intelligence and adores food; it can be spotted spitting up embers to roast all kinds of things before eating them, even using simple tools to assist it.

entry: POKENAME最爱喝苹果酒。喝过后，产奶量会增加。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: A POKENAME's favorite drink is apple cider. If given it to drink, a POKENAME will experience a larger output of milk.

entry: POKENAME最爱喝苹果酒。喝过后，产奶量会增加。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: A POKENAME's favorite drink is apple cider. If given it to drink, a POKENAME will experience a larger output of milk.

entry: POKENAME用雷击轰倒树，让橙橙果、桃桃果之类的树果落下。这些正是最爱，会迫不及待地大口吃光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses lightning strikes to knock over trees, causing berries like Oran and Pecha to fall. These are its favorite foods, and it devours them eagerly.

entry: POKENAME靠尾巴弹跳，够到高处水果与树果。大多数食物只稍加咀嚼，一口就能吞下。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can use their own tails to bounce and reach hanging fruits and berries. They can eat most things in one bite with minimal chewing.

entry: POKENAME虽悠闲听话，却不适合新手训练家。食欲永无止境，很快就会吃光毫无准备者的积蓄。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Despite their laidback attitude and willingness to listen to instructions, POKENAME are not advised as good companions for first time Trainers. They have an insatiable appetite and will quickly eat through the savings of the unprepared.

entry: 吃下大量树果吸收的养分，让POKENAME部分藤蔓也能自己结果。成熟后照样吃掉，而且似乎比普通树果更多汁。
author: sk372
source: The nutrients absorbed from eating so many berries allows POKENAME to grow its own on some of its vines. These also get feasted upon when ripe, and have been noted to be rather juicier than the average berry.

entry: POKENAME的巨牙由坚冰构成，能清开雪崩堆积物、撞断树木。每月只大吃一回，其余时间慢慢消化，经常休息。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have large tusks made of solid ice, which help to clear avalanches and to break down trees. They eat once a month in large swathes, spending the rest of the month digesting the food and resting often.

entry: POKENAME饥饿时，头角会发出令附近手机故障的信号。饲养的训练家最好随身带点心，免得自己的设备遭殃。
author: .izik
source: When hungry, POKENAME releases a signal from the horn on its head that can cause nearby cellphones to malfunction. Trainers who own one should always keep snacks on hand to avoid issues with their personal devices.

entry: POKENAME常在泥泞处懒洋洋吃零食，还会将眼前的一餐先蘸泥，添些口感与风味。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends much of its time lazily snacking on food around muddy locales. It often dips the meal it is about to eat in mud, to add texture and flavor.

entry: POKENAME住在人类聚落边缘，会进城找观众，展示笨重缓慢的舞蹈。人们习惯赠食物，作为演出的酬劳。
author: sk372
source: Living at the outskirts of human civilizations, POKENAME travels into towns and cities to find people to show its plodding, lumbering dances to. It's considered customary to gift it food as payment for the performance.

entry: 身体强壮，撑得住背上的大花。只要香味够甜，整丛灌木都会吞下，哪怕只是开花的花丛。
author: infinex21
source: It has a very strong body to help support the large flower upon its back. It will swallow entire bushes whole if they exude a sweet enough scent, even if they are merely flower bushes.

entry: POKENAME吃得越多，饭后睡得越久，慢慢消化。无论多猛烈的撞击，都叫不醒饭后酣睡的它。
author: banquoviaquo
source: The more a POKENAME eats, the longer a nap it will take afterwards, taking its time digesting its meal. No impact, no matter how great, can wake it from a post-meal snooze.

entry: POKENAME深深喜爱文柚果，吃完还会把果皮贴在头顶，好继续享受香气。
author: banquoviaquo
source: POKENAME have an abiding love for Sitrus Berries: so much so that after devouring them, they press the discarded peels to their crowns in order to continue enjoying the scent.

entry: POKENAME吃了又吃，永不满足。科学家怀疑胃里有类似黑洞的东西，因为它从不产生任何代谢副产物。奇怪的是，似乎不吃也能活。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME eats and eats, but it is never satisfied. Scientists believe there is something akin to a black hole in its stomach, for POKENAME never creates any kind of biological byproduct. Oddly, it doesn't appear to actually need to eat to survive.

entry: POKENAME的食欲永无止境。饿得够厉害，什么都想吃，连人也不例外。有时能看见它整棵吞树，甚至吞下整栋建筑。
author: actliux
source: The hunger of POKENAME is insatiable, as it will often try to eat anything and anyone if it is hungry enough. They can sometimes be seen eating entire trees or buildings whole.

entry: POKENAME只吃蔬菜，最爱脆口的。可极讨厌西兰花，不仅常拒吃，有时还干脆逃走。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME only eats vegetables and prefers the crunchiest ones. However, it despises broccoli, often refusing to eat or even fleeing from it entirely.

entry: POKENAME分泌的乳酪味液体是调味出色的酱料，常用在芝士通心粉、披萨与马苏里拉奶酪条等料理中。
author: dodoowner_
source: The cheesy liquid secreting from POKENAME is a very well-seasoned condiment. It is used in many dishes, such as mac and cheese, pizza, and mozzarella sticks.

entry: POKENAME闯进民宅、农场、餐馆和仓库大肆觅食，再通过勺子与叉状刀刃吸收食物颗粒。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME ravages homes, farms, restaurants, and warehouses for their food. It absorbs food particles through its spoon and forked blade.

entry: POKENAME动作相当快，常几秒就抢走别人的食物吃光。发霉腐烂也吃得没事，因此有时人们会特意留下这类食物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME move quite swiftly and have oft been seen snatching and fully devouring food from others within seconds. They will eat moldy or rotten food without issue, so sometimes people leave such foods out for these Pokémon to eat.

entry: POKENAME用缎带抓取一切找得到的食物。谁伸手抢它看中的，就会被缎带拍打，瞬间食欲全无。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its ribbons to nab at any bits of food it can find. If something else reaches for food it wants, it smacks them with its ribbons, which cause the struck victim to suddenly lose all traces of appetite.

entry: 住在POKENAME领地内的农民，会训练路卡利欧之类的宝可梦，在月下赶走这些贪食窃贼。只要闻见食物，它们连民宅也会闯。
author: pjporwoll
source: Farmers that live in POKENAME territory train Pokémon like Lucario to drive off these voracious food thieves under the moonlight. They will even break into homes to devour food if they smell it.

entry: POKENAME性情有些温顺，比起战斗更爱大口吃蔬菜。可吃饭若被打扰，就会挟着全身体重扑向冒犯者。
author: lampent12
source: A somewhat meek Pokémon, POKENAME prefers wolfing down vegetables over battling. If its meal is disturbed, however, it will throw itself at the offender with the full force of its weight.

entry: 许多宝可梦曾把POKENAME尾巴上的孢子误当橙橙果去咬。反倒是它存放在身上的真橙橙果，因怕是孢子而无人敢碰。
author: soup1900
source: Many Pokémon have once tried biting the spores on POKENAME's tail, thinking that they were Oran Berries. Actual Oran Berries it has stashed on and around it are avoided due to the fear of them being spores.

entry: POKENAME每天必须吃下与自身体重相当的食物，才能高速飞行。它们最爱树汁，常舔得忘乎所以，连被黏稠树汁粘在树上，也没察觉。
author: _pixelar_
source: To be able to fly at fast speeds, POKENAME need to consume their weight in food every day. Their favorite food is tree sap, lapping it up in reckless abandon and not even noticing when they get stuck to the tree because of the sticky sap.

entry: POKENAME贴地滚动，见什么吃什么。带进家里能把地面收拾干净，可人掉下的任何东西都当食物，连失手掉落的贵重物也不放过。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME rolls around on the floor, devouring anything it finds on the ground. If brought into a human home it will keep the floor clean, but it treats anything that humans drop as food, including valuables dropped by accident.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME与同类聚餐，大吃檬柠果。一夜能扫光整园果实，连青果也不剩。
author: .izik
source: During full moons, POKENAME gathers with others of its kind to feast on Nomel Berries. Entire orchards can be wiped out in one night, with even unripened berries being devoured.

entry: POKENAME虽小，却吃得多得惊人。没人知道食物去了哪里，只见它们似乎消失在黑暗虚空中。
author: .jerden
source: Despite its small size, POKENAME can eat an incredible amount. Nobody knows where all the food goes, but it seems to vanish inside a dark void.

entry: POKENAME飞遍丰缘，寻找最多汁的桃桃果。有记录显示，它还会特地将一些树果送给小卡比兽。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME fly throughout Hoenn in search of the juiciest Pecha Berries to eat. POKENAME have been documented going out of their way to deliver some of their Berries to Munchlax.

entry: POKENAME喷水击落茸丹果，再收集带回窝中，留着以后吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits jets of water to knock Rabuta Berries off of trees. It then gathers them up and brings them back to its lodge, where it stores them for later consumption.

entry: POKENAME能看见树木的波导，依颜色选树取食。科学家仍在研究，它依据的是树木健康，还是其他看不见的因素。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has the ability to see the aura of trees and picks a tree to eat from based on the color of the aura. Scientists are still trying to determine if its choice is based on the health of the tree or another unseen factor.

entry: POKENAME代谢缓慢，吃下的大部分食物都会变成厚脂。训练家不宜过量喂食，脂肪太多会让它不舒服。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a slow metabolism that causes most of what they eat to become blubber. Trainers are advised to abstain from overfeeding POKENAME because having too much blubber causes them discomfort.

entry: POKENAME发现新东西，第一反应就是想吃。牙齿、口腔与消化道都有坚固金属层，粗糙、尖锐，乃至有毒的东西都不怕。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's first instinct when discovering something new is to attempt to eat it. Its teeth, mouth and digestive tract are covered with a strong metallic layer, so eating rough, pointed or even toxic items won't bother it.

entry: POKENAME嘴大，食欲更大，总不停啃咬，连巨石也咬。铁胃什么都能轻松消化。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME has a big mouth and an even bigger appetite. It will constantly chomp things with its mouth, even boulders. Its iron stomach can digest anything without issue.

entry: POKENAME吃到肚子几乎撑破，嘴里还要再藏点食物。偶尔会忘记藏着东西，直到很快又饿了，才想起来。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME will eat until its stomach is nearly bursting. Afterwards, it will hide yet more food in its mouth for later. Sometimes it will forget the food is there until it is hungry again, which does not take long.

entry: POKENAME多住沙漠，将身体埋进沙里，形成锥形陷坑，再试着吸进周围一切，填满无底胃。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Prone to living in desert regions, POKENAME will plant itself into the sand, forming a cone-shaped pit. It will then try to inhale everything around it to fill its endless stomach.

entry: POKENAME一见食物，就一心想着赶走别人。会往食物旁扔燃着的引火物，点起火，让旁人逃走或惊慌，自己再冲去偷吃。
author: pkbonusducks
source: When POKENAME spot food, all their attention goes to keeping others away from it. They'll throw ignited kindle near their target to start a fire, forcing others to flee or panic while POKENAME swoop in to steal the meal.

entry: POKENAME食欲虽大，一顿却吃不了多少。一天大部分时间都飘进飘出树果枝间，一次摘一两颗熟果。
author: vic1312
source: Despite having a large appetite, POKENAME can't eat much in a single sitting. POKENAME will spend a large portion of their day floating in and out of the branches of berry plants, plucking one or two ripe berries at a time.

entry: POKENAME不停蹦跳找食物，存进腰间绒毛里，可跳个不停，又会全抖落出来。
author: lampent12
source: POKENAME hops around in a constant search for food. It stores food in the fluff around its waist, but will jostle it all loose from the persistent hopping.

entry: POKENAME释放让对象极度饥饿的孢子。哪怕肚子很饱，也会饿得难受，最后吃得过量。
author: mellowmuse
source: POKENAME releases spores that cause a deep hunger. Even with a full belly, it can cause hunger pains and lead to overeating.

entry: POKENAME包在液体球中漂行，沿途什么都吃。食物一进入体内便迅速消化，几秒就化为液体。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME float around in a ball of liquid eating anything they come across. They rapidly digest food that enters into their bodies, liquifying food in a matter of seconds.

entry: POKENAME飘到刺角果树旁采果，存进绒毛里。有时采太多，重得飘不动，只好落地，继续找下一份点心。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats near Spelon Berry trees to pluck fruit to eat that it stores within its fluff. Sometimes, it gathers so many berries that it becomes too heavy to float, causing it to drop to the ground in search of its next snack.

entry: 以别人的情绪为食，表情也会反映那些情绪。总带着一颗树果，似乎最爱橙橙果。除非可能救朋友，否则绝不分享。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon feed on the emotions of others and reflect those emotions with their own expressions. They are always carrying a berry, seemingly fond of Oran Berries the most, and never share it unless it may save a friend.

entry: POKENAME沿树枝爬行，见树果就吃。吃太多后常重得压断树枝，落地时爆发一股猛烈的爆炸能量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME crawls along tree branches to eat any berries it can find. This gorging often increases its weight to the point of snapping the branch, causing POKENAME to hit the ground and release a burst of explosive energy.

entry: POKENAME喜欢吃烤树果，会向树上结着的树果吐出小火球，烤熟再吃。可它总等不及树果充分冷却，便急着入口，舌头上满是烫伤的痕迹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys roasted berries, spitting small fireballs at ones growing on trees to cook them before eating. Its tongue is covered with burn marks from not waiting for berries to properly cool down before trying to eat them.

entry: POKENAME在椰子树间飞来飞去，吃起椰子连壳几秒就吞光，完全不在意味道。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies from coconut tree to coconut tree to eat the coconuts. It will eat even the shell in seconds, without caring about the flavor.

entry: POKENAME张嘴滚过森林，几乎遇见什么草木都吃。身体能消化近乎所有植物，食谱十分广。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rolls through forested areas with its mouth open, eating just about any vegetation it rolls over. Its body can digest nearly any plant life, making it a versatile eater.

entry: POKENAME吃莲蒲果后，毒性便增强。许多科学家认为，胃中的化学反应产生新毒素，再聚集到獠牙里。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's poison becomes more potent after eating Chople Berries. Many scientists believe this is due to a chemical reaction in its stomach, creating new toxins that concentrate in its fangs.

entry: 巨颚能将最硬的坚果也压成细浆，平时爱啃树皮与岩石磨牙。
author: infinex21
source: Their jaws are strong enough to crush the toughest nuts into a fine pulp. They tend to teethe on tree bark and rocks.

entry: POKENAME吃相邋遢，走到哪都掉碎屑。其实能通过光合作用制造葡萄糖，不必进食，只是喜欢吃叶子的触感。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are sloppy with their food and leave crumbs wherever they go. They do not have to eat since they can photosynthesize glucose, but they enjoy the tactile sensation of eating leaves.

entry: 除了心爱的树果，POKENAME也格外喜欢各种种子。果实与种子囤得太多，有时竟会充作肥料，甚至形成供小宝可梦生活的生态。
author: bobosmith01
source: In addition to its beloved Berries, POKENAME has a powerful affinity for all kinds of seeds. The stashes of fruit and seeds it creates can grow so huge that the stash may start acting as fertilizer or even an ecosystem for small Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME吃相杂乱，喜欢啃其他宝可梦的叶子。一餐叶片便够过整天，却仍会经常吃，只因享受食物在嘴里的触感。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are messy eaters that enjoy eating leaves off other Pokémon. A single meal of leaves can last them the entire day, though they will continue to eat regularly because they enjoy the tactile sensation of food in their mouths.

entry: POKENAME一饿，唾液就臭得一英里外也闻得到。为免断粮，会把森林里采来的树果顶在头上携带。
author: fiordaliso
source: When hungry, POKENAME produces an extremely foul-smelling saliva whose odor can be detected from a mile away. To make sure it never runs out of food, it carries the Berries it gathers during its forest outings on top of its head.

entry: POKENAME以声波震落金枕果。吃起来一门心思，什么别的事都做不了，只顾大口吞果。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses sound waves to knock Durin Berries from trees. Its single-mindedness while eating makes it unable to do anything else, focusing solely on devouring the berries.

entry: POKENAME在佛柑果树旁飞，寻找地上的腐果。喜欢软些的果子，因为好嚼，吃得更尽兴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies near Kasib Berry trees, searching for rotting fruit on the ground. It prefers the softer fruit, as it is easier to chew, making for a more enjoyable meal.

entry: POKENAME远比看着贪吃，吃到体重三倍才能健康。高代谢源于溶解食物的黏液，因为制造它要消耗大量养分。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are deceptively voracious creatures that need to eat thrice their body weight to remain healthy. Their high metabolism comes from the goo they use to dissolve food, as it requires lots of nutrients to produce.

entry: POKENAME食欲太盛，朋友和食物常分不清，没找到足够食物前会一直轻啃伙伴。许多宝可梦却觉得讨喜，很乐意拿树果喂它。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a difficult time separating friend from food, as their voracious appetite leads them to nibble on companions until they find adequate food to consume. Many Pokémon find their antics charming and love to give them berries to eat.

entry: POKENAME用重拳打倒扁樱果树，大吃落下的果子。对盛宴的热情让这顿饭吃得一团乱，却十分满足。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses strong punches to knock over Tanga Berry trees, gorging itself on the berries that fall. Its enthusiasm for feasting leads to a messy but satisfying meal.

entry: POKENAME用蛮力震落巢边的岳竹果。进食时谁靠太近，就拔起最近的树砸过去，凶狠护住饭食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its strength to knock Magost Berries from the trees near its den. If someone gets too close while it eats, it uproots the nearest tree and hits them with it to fiercely defend its meal.

entry: POKENAME明明吃一点就能活，却见什么吃什么。谁想夺它的食物，就会挨上带刺双臂的重击。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite being able to survive with little food, POKENAME will consume anything it can find. If someone tries to take its food, it will bash them with its thorny arms.

entry: POKENAME背上的橙橙果比普通果子更甜，引来更多盗猎，也令涂蜜的树减少。涂树蜜原是诱捕它们的主要手段。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The Oran Berries on the backs of POKENAME are sweeter than normal ones, leading to increased poaching. This has led to fewer trees that are slathered in honey, which was a primary poaching method used to lure out POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME吃着吃着便欢快起舞，每口之间还秀出高超旋转。似乎连睡着时都在咀嚼、跳舞。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs happy dances while it eats, breaking into masterful spins between bites. It appears to both chew and dance even while asleep.

entry: POKENAME食欲极大，要吃自身体重两倍的食物才能健康。每次吃完，就释放一阵超能力，随后睡去。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a voracious appetite, as it needs to consume twice its body weight to remain healthy. Whenever it finishes eating, it releases a burst of psychic energy before falling asleep.

entry: POKENAME用幻象光线震落枝荔果。吃得越多，毛发光泽就越鲜亮美丽，闪闪动人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses Psybeam to knock Liechi Berries from trees. The more it eats, the more vibrant and beautiful the luster of its fur becomes, adding a shimmering effect to its appearance.

entry: POKENAME主要吃细枝，因为动作太慢，抢不过其他宝可梦。训练家若送上橙橙果或文柚果，就会高兴得满地打滚。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a diet that mainly consists of twigs, as it is too slow to snatch berries before other Pokémon take them. If a Trainer gives it an Oran Berry or a Sitrus Berry, its elation causes it to roll around in excitement.

entry: POKENAME一饿就琢磨所有觅食办法，计算怎样最省力，又能吃到最美味的一餐。自古就有人请它帮忙决定吃什么。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Whenever POKENAME get hungry, they ponder all the options of how to potentially get food, figuring out how to expend the least amount of effort for the most delicious meal. People have asked POKENAME for help deciding what to eat since ancient times.

entry: POKENAME用长臂接住树上落下的瓜西果。吃饱后会放出浓烈南瓜气味，表示已经满足。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its long arms to catch Watmel Berries when they fall from trees. When it is full, it lets loose a strong pumpkin-like odor, signaling that it has had its fill.

entry: POKENAME爱把找到的大量树果与其他食物塞进育儿袋，整天吃零食。食物带得太多，妨碍走动的事并不少见。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME love to store tons of berries and other food they find in their pouches, snacking on them throughout the day. It's not uncommon for these Pokémon to hold so much food that it hinders their movement.

entry: POKENAME头顶睡莲叶质地像馅饼，每月能再生。许多面包店将它与现烤馅饼一起卖，独特口感很受欢迎。
author: .izik
source: The lily pad on POKENAME's head is close to a pie in consistency and regrows monthly. Many bakeries sell these along with their own freshly baked pies, as they are highly sought after for their unique texture.

entry: 开心时尾焰轻轻跃动，生气时却会失控猛烧。大口塞满食物时最快乐，至于吃的究竟是什么，似乎不太在意。
author: infinex21
source: When happy, their tail flames flick about and when angry their flames rage uncontrollably. They are happiest when stuffing their faces with plenty of food, though seem to care little for what exactly they eat.

entry: 靠强爪爬树，轻松敲开硬坚果。偏爱先以自身火焰烤食物，若不得不生吃，便会烦躁。
author: infinex21
source: Using its tough claws, it can climb trees and easily crack open tough nuts. It prefers to roast any of its food with its own flames before eating, and gets agitated when it has to eat food raw.

entry: 野餐时可得小心，POKENAME也许会突然钻出来偷食。反应极快，一秒内就能钻出、钻回地下。
author: mistymagius
source: Be careful when you're on a picnic, as a POKENAME might just pop out of the ground to steal your food. They have very quick reflexes, popping in and out of the ground within a single second.

entry: POKENAME只稍嚼便整吞食物，罐头连罐也吃。大部分时间不是睡觉、吃东西，就是打理长毛。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME eat foods whole with minimal chewing and will even eat canned foods, including the cans. They spend most of their time sleeping, eating, and grooming their long fur.

entry: POKENAME不停吃零食，因为进食能消除几乎从不停歇的头痛。记录中，停吃后最长也只撑了四分钟，头痛便又发作。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME constantly gorges on snacks, as the act of eating nullifies its almost eternally aching head. The longest recorded time between it stopping eating and suffering a new headache is four minutes.

entry: POKENAME贪心与食欲同样强烈，吃饭时最好留够距离。盯得太久，就会被视为挑战，招来猛烈的护食攻击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's greed and hunger are equally intense, so one should give it plenty of space when it feeds. Staring for too long will be considered a challenge and incite it to violently defend its meal.

entry: POKENAME爱打架，可每打一场，都得休息很久。它们喜欢囤积食物，留待睡醒大吃，哪怕得从别人那里偷，也在所不惜。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME love to fight, though they always have to rest for a long time after just one battle. They love to hoard food for themselves to gorge upon after they wake up, even if it means stealing that food from others.

entry: POKENAME吃下成百树果，为肌肉补能、维持体力。不锻炼时，脑中满是下一餐。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME consumes hundreds of berries to fuel its muscles and provide it with energy. Whenever it's not exercising, it dreams about its next meal.

entry: POKENAME既拼命练，也拼命吃，维持力量与热量摄取。常见两只手拿食物，其他手臂锻炼，再适时换手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is prone to intense workouts as well as intense gorging to keep up its strength and calorie intake. It's not uncommon to see two of its arms carrying food while it trains with the others, switching hands as appropriate.

entry: 手边总有吃的，常用两只手各拿一份食物，另两手战斗。只有气到极点，才肯四臂全力迎战。
author: infinex21
source: They always have food on hand, often holding two pieces of food in two of their hands while fighting with their other two hands. They only will fight with all four arms and hands when angered enough.

entry: POKENAME流下甜香口水，滴在哪里就吸引那里的昆虫。越饿越甜，好赶快引来更多虫子吃。
author: sk372
source: A sweet-smelling drool drips from POKENAME's mouth, attracting insects where it lands. The hungrier it is, the sweeter the drool becomes in order to draw more bugs quickly so it can eat.

entry: POKENAME极少来到地表，贪吃的它一路啃过地下，寻找矿物。留下的隧道，常被满怀希望的勘探者利用，追寻稀有金属。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME is rarely seen at the surface, its voracious appetite leading it to eat its way through the ground in search of minerals. The tunnels left behind in its wake are often used by hopeful prospectors hunting for rare metals.

entry: POKENAME什么都吃，食物越多样，岩石般的外皮越坚固。凭出色耐受力，巡护员会训练它闯入野火，搬土移石压灭火焰。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME eats anything, and the more variety in its diet, the tougher its rocky hide becomes. Because of its impervious nature, Pokémon Rangers train it to enter wildfires so it can move dirt and boulders to smother the fire.

entry: POKENAME最爱吃饭与跑步。可平日吃太多，速度和耐力都不佳，很容易累。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's two favorite things are eating and running. However, because it eats so much on a regular basis, its speed and stamina are rather subpar, and it gets tired easily.

entry: POKENAME食欲虽惊人，脑筋迟钝却常忘记吃饭。太懒不想觅食时，曾被看见啃自己的尾巴。
author: theartemis1
source: Despite its incredible appetite, POKENAME often forgets to eat due to its slow-wittedness. It has been spotted chewing on its own tail when feeling too lazy to forage.

entry: POKENAME大量啃吃岩上苔藓，冬季尤其如此。天冷最活跃，比起温暖更喜欢寒意。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME eats moss off rocks in large quantities, especially during the winter months. It is most active in colder temperatures, preferring the chill to warmer conditions.

entry: 半流体身体能储存食物，留待以后。可常忘记藏着的吃食，最终直接被身体吸收。常在下水道与垃圾场旁吃剩饭、废物。
author: infinex21
source: Their semi-fluid bodies help to store food to eat later, though it has a bad habit of forgetting about such food and it ends up getting subsumed instead. They can often be found near sewers and garbage dumps, feeding on leftovers and waste.

entry: 身体气体能催眠大多数其他生物，可接触过多也会陷入昏迷。嘴大得能直接吞食，不必咀嚼。
author: infinex21
source: The gases of their bodies are soporific to most others, though too much exposure can result in a coma. Their mouths are massive, allowing them to easily swallow foods whole without having to chew.

entry: POKENAME常潜在暗处，等待偷食机会，甚至吓唬、捉弄别人，只为夺走对方的食物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME often lurk in darkness, waiting for an opportunity to snatch up food for themselves. They have been known to frighten and prank others just to steal their food.

entry: 骇人的是，嘴占了足足半个身体，还能沿中间横向张开，整吞食物。若觉得别人带着吃的，就会一路跟随。
author: infinex21
source: Disturbingly, its mouth extends to half of its total body and it can open it from the horizontal half to swallow foods whole. It will follow others if it thinks they have food.

entry: POKENAME不想做事时，会拿地上捡的树果激励自己，有时连自己也催眠。谁盯摆锤看太久，便会立刻感到饥饿。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses the berries it gathers from the ground to motivate itself whenever it doesn't feel like doing something, sometimes even hypnotizing itself. If someone stares too long at the pendulum's motion, it immediately begins to feel hungry.

entry: 为吃到苹野果，POKENAME什么都愿意做，甚至挑战比自己强大得多的宝可梦。大部分时间，都在海洞家中吃东西。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME would do anything to get its claws on a Leppa Berry, even challenge Pokémon far stronger than itself. It spends most of its time eating inside the sea caves it calls home.

entry: POKENAME将水吸存进背上的种子，若要上岸觅食也能保持水分。触角极为灵敏，几天前就能察觉风暴将至。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME absorbs water into the bulb on its back to stay hydrated in case it needs to walk on land to look for food. Its antennae are incredibly sensitive and can detect an approaching storm several days in advance.

entry: POKENAME漂在酸性水域，雷暴袭来时便能轻易吸收电力。发电厂附近也常能见到它们。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME floats in acidic waters so if a thunderstorm hits, it can easily absorb the electricity from them. They are also common around power plants.

entry: POKENAME身体比水轻，平时虽合群，却很难在深水狩猎。于是各自浮上水面，大张嘴捕捉、电击并运走小猎物，再聚起来分享。
author: leobarqui
source: Being lighter than the water they inhabit makes it hard for normally social schools of POKENAME to hunt in the deep. Instead, they surface alone, their mouths wide open to catch, zap, and transfer small prey, which they then convene to share.

entry: 拾鱼骨当头盔与棍棒自卫。月夜有时会在沙上画出巨翅飞鱼的轮廓，再蜷在图案中央休息。
author: sk372
source: It picks up fish bones to use as headgear and a club for defense. On moonlit nights, it can sometimes be seen drawing the outline of a Mantine in the sand, then curling up and resting in the center.

entry: POKENAME猛力跃出水面，用角撞击长翅鸥等在空中毫无防备的猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME bursts from the water with tremendous force. It uses its horn to smash unsuspecting prey like Wingull mid-flight.

entry: POKENAME在海滩飞舞，偏爱吸食靠近海水生长的花。喜欢用触角挠游客痒痒，陪人玩耍。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flutters around beaches, preferring to feed from flowers that grow nearer to seawater. It likes to play with beach-goers by tickling them with its antennae.

entry: POKENAME爱帮忙照顾孩子，用比画动作的方式，将认数字、辨形状变成游戏。答对时便拍手、拥抱，奖励孩子的努力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME loves helping rear young children, using charades as a way to turn learning things like numbers and shapes into a game. Upon a right answer, POKENAME claps and embraces the child to reward their efforts.

entry: POKENAME常在热带岛屿海边嬉戏起舞。喵喵等猫形宝可梦，对它的舞姿有种莫名的偏爱。
author: kungfucutbug
source: POKENAME can often be found on tropical islands, dancing playfully at the ocean's edge. Feliform Pokémon like Meowth have an odd fondness for this Pokémon's moves.

entry: POKENAME住在沿海树上，是友善温和的小虫。角虽有毒，却只用来对付欺负朋友的家伙。
author: sk372
source: Living in trees near coastal areas, POKENAME is a friendly and nonviolent little bug. Its horn is venomous, but it only uses it to strike at those who would try to pick on its friends.

entry: 液体身体极易塑形，方便模仿其他宝可梦。可POKENAME变形时，常忘了改变那对显眼的蓝触角。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its liquid body is highly malleable, making it easy for it to take on the appearance of other Pokémon. However, when it transforms, POKENAME often forgets to alter its distinctive blue antennae.

entry: POKENAME爱跃出水面，以鳍短途滑翔。会被大型龙属性宝可梦吸引，紧紧跟随，模仿动作。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys breaching above water and gliding for short distances using its fins. It is attracted to larger Dragon-type Pokémon, following them closely and mimicking their movements.

entry: POKENAME发现船只困在风暴中，就会瞬间移动，将船送去平静海面。可即使船有能力应付风暴，也照传不误，有时反把它送得远离航线。
author: .izik
source: Should POKENAME spot a vessel caught in a storm, it will teleport it to a calm area of the ocean. Unfortunately, this occurs even when the vessel is equipped to handle the storm, sometimes landing it far off its intended route.

entry: 月夜，成群POKENAME跃出水面，试着够到月亮。可翼展太小，根本飞不了多远。
author: agentyoshi
source: On moonlit nights, schools of POKENAME are known to leap out of the water in an attempt to reach the moon. However, their wingspan is too small for them to make it very far.

entry: POKENAME在海边跳着轻快顽皮的舞。据说只要数量够多一起舞动，往后几天都会风平浪静。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's dance is a bouncy, playful movement taking place on the seashore. It's said if a large enough group dance together, the seas will be smooth and calm for days afterward.

entry: 友善的POKENAME遍布温暖海域，不同高度都有踪迹。能吸入空气等气体，滤去不需要的成分，改变密度。偶尔甚至会浮在天空。
author: bobosmith01
source: The pleasant POKENAME can be found at different elevations all over warm oceans. It can inhale air and other gases and filter out unwanted elements to change its density. Rarely, it can be found floating in the sky.

entry: 海滩常能见POKENAME，性情温顺，也不太打扰人。臂上的薄膜让它能在空中短途滑翔。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sightings are fairly common in beach areas, and they are considered docile and unobtrusive. The membranes on their arms let them glide through the air for short distances.

entry: POKENAME将水吸存进背上的种子，若要上岸觅食也能保持水分。触角极为灵敏，几天前就能察觉风暴将至。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME absorbs water into the bulb on its back to stay hydrated in case it needs to walk on land to look for food. Its antennae are incredibly sensitive and can detect an approaching storm several days in advance.

entry: POKENAME身体极易吸水、吸蜜等液体，因此常带着卡蒂狗之类能轻易嗅到的气味。多见于河口附近的繁茂地带。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's body easily soaks up fluids, such as honey or water, so it tends to have a scent that Pokémon like Growlithe can easily pick up on. It is most often found by lush areas near estuaries.

entry: POKENAME成群聚在海底，从壳里吐出串串气泡，扇向彼此。一玩就是几小时，只因创造不同形状便觉得快乐。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME school together on the sea floor, releasing streams of bubbles from the shells and fanning them toward each other. They play in this manner for hours on end, taking simple joy in the shapes they can create.

entry: POKENAME用强吸盘抓住冲浪板，乘浪游玩。可常害冲浪者失去平衡，从板上摔下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME grabs onto surfboards with its strong suckers to ride the waves. However, it often causes surfers to lose balance and wipe out.

entry: POKENAME最爱在日落时翱翔海上。乘浪而行，光滑身躯映着金色夕阳，闪闪发亮。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME adores soaring over the ocean during sunset. The sun's golden light glimmers off its sleek body as it rides the waves.

entry: POKENAME外貌可爱，容易让人小看。可即使只是在沙滩泼水嬉戏，也能轻易掀翻人类与大型宝可梦。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: It is easy to underestimate POKENAME because of its cute appearance. Even as it playfully splashes on the sandy shores of its coastal environment, POKENAME can easily topple both humans and large Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME大多待在水下，偶尔跃上岸，将产出的蛋送给人类或其他宝可梦。蛋对缓解晕船尤其有效。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends most of its time underwater, but breaches out onto land to occasionally share eggs it creates with humans and other Pokémon. The eggs are especially effective for combating seasickness.

entry: POKENAME睡在有浮力的尾巴上。巨翅飞鱼与铁炮鱼深受吸引，会不惜一切保护它，哪怕对上强大的大嘴鸥。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME sleeps on top of its buoyant tail. Mantine and Remoraid are drawn to it, so they protect POKENAME by any means necessary, even if they're up against a mighty Pelliper.

entry: POKENAME睡在有浮力的尾巴上。巨翅飞鱼与铁炮鱼深受吸引，会不惜一切保护它，哪怕对上强大的大嘴鸥。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME sleeps on top of its buoyant tail. Mantine and Remoraid are drawn to POKENAME, so they protect POKENAME by any means necessary, even if they're up against a mighty Pelliper.

entry: POKENAME贪玩得很，爱在水中跃进跃出，给游客惊喜。水族馆与海洋公园里，它是很受孩子欢迎的明星。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are very playful Pokémon and love to jump in and out of the water to surprise tourists. They are very popular in aquariums and marine parks as kid-friendly attractions.

entry: 只见于世界某些特定地点。实验研究表明，偏爱热带森林中的寒冷水域附近。能两栖生活，滑翔也极灵活，树上、海里都能睡。
author: bobosmith01
source: They are only found in specific places around the world: according to laboratory studies, they prefer being near cold waters in otherwise tropical forest environments. Amphibious and expert agile gliders, they sleep in both trees and sea.

entry: 这个进化阶段的POKENAME身体变大变重，游泳有些笨拙。不再长种子，转而长出气囊，帮助浮在水面。
author: bobosmith01
source: In this stage of its evolutionary life, POKENAME finds its larger and heavier body somewhat too awkward to swim with. Instead of growing seeds on its body, it grows sacs of air that help it float on the water's surface.

entry: POKENAME可爱亲人，陆海都能自在生活，理论上是极好的宠物。可休息一定要泡水，因此饲养就得让出浴缸或泳池。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: POKENAME are adorable, friendly with people, and can live on land just as comfortably as in the sea, making for great pets in theory. However, they require a body of water to rest in, so one must sacrifice their bathtub or pool to keep a POKENAME.

entry: 游客洗出一张野生巨翅飞鱼的照片后，POKENAME才首次被发现。照片背景中，它正试着亲昵地抱住巨翅飞鱼。
author: argonborn
source: POKENAME was first discovered after a tourist developed a photo they took of a wild Mantine: a POKENAME became visible in the background, trying to cuddle with the Mantine.

entry: POKENAME常见于水上乐园。泳技出色、友善温柔，尤其喜爱孩子，是极好的救生员与吉祥物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a common sight within water parks. Its swimming skills and friendly, gentle nature, particularly with children, make it an excellent lifeguard as well as mascot.

entry: 它友善又合群，尤其亲近航海的人，却似乎不知道，庞大体型会给小玩伴带来危险。
author: staghorn
source: It is extremely friendly and sociable, especially with seafaring humans. It seems unaware that its large size makes it a danger to its smaller playmates.

entry: POKENAME不善游泳，从不离开浅水。练习时会找大型海洋宝可梦学泳，也寻求它们保护。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's swimming skills are poor, so it never ventures past the shallow parts of bodies of water. It looks to larger sea Pokémon for swimming lessons and protection as it practices its technique.

entry: POKENAME是海中最美丽的宝可梦之一。用闪亮蓝纹分散捕食者与敌人注意，趁机筹划逃走。鳞片深受某些协调训练家追捧。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME is known as one of the most beautiful Pokémon in the ocean. It uses its shimmering blue patterns to distract predators and foes while it plans an escape. POKENAME's scales are highly sought by certain coordinators.

entry: POKENAME跃出海面，顽皮地舒展缎带状触角，旋出美丽花样，分散渔船水手的注意，让同伴有时间浮上来偷设备筑巢。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME jumps from the sea and playfully extends its ribbon-like feelers in beautiful twirls to distract sailors on fishing vessels. This gives others from its pod time to surface and steal equipment for their nests.

entry: POKENAME沿海底移动时，若遇到危险宝可梦，便立刻张鳍装大。主要以额头硬角自卫。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME encounters a threatening Pokémon while moving along the ocean floor, it immediately tries to appear larger by spreading its fins. It mainly uses the hard horn on its forehead for self-defense.

entry: 满月夜，大群POKENAME会在海面游出美丽图案。想参加宝可梦华丽大赛的训练家，常研究这些动作，让自己的宝可梦模仿。
author: agentyoshi
source: On full moon nights, large numbers of POKENAME are known to swim in beautiful patterns along the surface of the ocean. Many Trainers looking to compete in Pokémon Contests will study these movements in order to replicate them with their Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME真正快乐只需两样：能游泳的深水，以及看得见月亮的晴空。缺了其中任何一样，就会一直闷闷不乐，容易哭。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME needs two things to be truly happy: access to water deep enough to swim in and access to a clear sky it can see the moon from. Without both of these things, it will be constantly sullen and prone to crying.

entry: POKENAME能让铁炮鱼安全住进体内，提供庇护，再毫发无伤地弹出。作为回报，铁炮鱼会帮忙载它巡游海洋，替它找食物。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can safely let Remoraid inside its body for their shelter and protection and eject them back out unharmed. In return, the Remoraid will help carry it around the ocean and scavenge food for it.

entry: POKENAME结茧沉睡在海浪深处。据说每一千年才浮出一次，为最先遇见的水手实现一个愿望。
author: maxissaa
source: POKENAME resides cocooned deep below the ocean waves, deep in sleep. It is said POKENAME will arise to the surface once every thousand years to grant a wish to the first sailor to cross its path.

entry: POKENAME常在水下红树附近活动，挂在浸水的根上，等待食物漂来。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME are commonly found around underwater mangrove trees. They hang from the submerged roots while they await food to float by.

entry: POKENAME庞大身体浮在离海面仅几英寸处。日出时出行，宛如一座漂流小岛。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's large body floats just inches above the sea's surface. It travels at sunrise, appearing like a drifting island.

entry: POKENAME用悦耳的声音控制流过触角间的海流，借水流大幅提升游速。
author: mrpeach774
source: A POKENAME uses its melodic voice to control the ocean currents that flow between its antennae. It can use these currents to move much faster.

entry: POKENAME住在深海海沟，以灵敏触角感知周围，却向往长出翅膀，飞上海面。硬壳让捕食者很难捕获它。
author: mcnchsschl
source: POKENAME lives in deep-sea trenches, using its sensitive antennae to sense its surroundings. However, it longs to grow wings and fly above the sea. Its hard shell makes it difficult for predators to hunt it.

entry: 许多小鱼宝可梦藏在POKENAME的叶丛里，形成共生。它提供安全庇护，换取这些宝可梦产生的肥料。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: Many small fish Pokémon hide in the fronds of POKENAME. This creates a symbiotic relationship, where POKENAME provides safety in exchange for the fertilizer created by these other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME身体几乎全是海水，离海太久便有干枯、生病的风险。喜欢从嘴里吹泡泡，陪人类和宝可梦玩。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body is made almost entirely of seawater, so it can't stay out of the ocean for long or it risks drying out and falling ill. It enjoys blowing bubbles from its mouth to play with humans and Pokémon alike.

entry: POKENAME爱拥抱别人，让对方沾满不断分泌的黏液。黏液虽无害，即使洗净，海水气味还会留一段时间。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME loves to give out hugs to others, which leaves the hugged person stained with the slime it constantly emits. Though the slime is harmless, the smell of salt water lingers for some time even after cleaning it off.

entry: POKENAME像孩子般极为友善，刚认识谁就跑去拥抱。抱完会留下黏浆，不过一遇水就很快溶掉。
author: sk372
source: Child-like and extremely friendly, POKENAME is quick to run to new acquaintances to give them a hug. It leaves a sticky goop behind when it hugs someone, but the slime quickly dissolves in water.

entry: 成群POKENAME在海面上空如直升机般旋转。会共同释放毒素，捕食吼鲸王这样的大型猎物。
author: .izik
source: Schools of POKENAME spin in the air like helicopters over the sea. Together, they unleash toxins to devour massive prey like Wailord.

entry: POKENAME常站在浅海。许多人觉得它的长相令人不安，性情却温和，会像救生员一样，救起海里挣扎的对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is often found standing in the shallows of ocean waters. Though many find it has an unsettling appearance, it has a gentle disposition and acts as a lifeguard, saving those who wind up floundering in the seawater.

entry: POKENAME吃落到海底的碎屑，以两只大钳筛沙掘泥，找可食颗粒。背上成对红触角能分散捕食者注意，使其忽略本体。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feed on detritus that has fallen to the sea floor, using their two large claws to sift through sand and mud to find edible particles. The twin red antennae growing from their back distract predators and pull attention away from their bodies.

entry: POKENAME在海里泼水嬉戏，吸引大家注意。谁加入，就会挨上一口顽皮却刺痛的“奖励”。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME splashes playfully in the sea, inviting attention. Anyone who joins it is rewarded with a sharp, playful bite.

entry: POKENAME头上的一对红触角既对洋流极敏感，也会按催眠节奏闪光。靠它们保护自己，安心在海底觅食。
author: .jerden
source: In addition to being incredibly sensitive to sensitive to ocean currents, the pair of red antennae on POKENAME's head flash in a hypnotic pattern. POKENAME relies on them to keep it safe from predators as it searches for food on the seafloor.

entry: POKENAME察觉水流哪怕微小变化，身体就会完全绷紧、硬化。此时只有训练家或跟随的铁炮鱼群发出安全信号，才能让它重新放松。
author: soup1900
source: When a POKENAME senses even a minor disturbance in the water flow, its body completely tenses up and hardens. Once this happens, the only way for it to loosen back up is if its Trainer or its group of Remoraid signal that it's safe again.

entry: POKENAME厚毛能吸收游过海水中的有毒污染物。因主动净化栖息水域，深受巡护员珍视与保护。
author: fiordaliso
source: The thick coat covering POKENAME's body has the remarkable ability to absorb toxic pollutants from the seawater it swims through. Because it actively purifies the waters it inhabits, it is a creature deeply valued and protected by the Rangers.

entry: 长触角能预先察觉海上风暴，因此总试着提醒可能遇险的人。自卫时会覆满泡泡，吸收部分攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its long antennae can sense the arrival of sea storms ahead of time, so it always tries to alert humans who may be in danger. To defend itself from other Pokémon, it coats its body in bubbles so they can absorb part of incoming attacks.

entry: 有人说，盯POKENAME睡莲叶上的眼状花纹太久，花纹就会眨眼。传说看见这一幕，便会受到诅咒。
author: .izik
source: Some say the eye-like markings on POKENAME's lily pad will blink if stared at too long. Legends warn this will curse those who witness it.

entry: POKENAME藏在海底沙下，只为吃藻才出来。蓝触角能感知水中最微小的变化，大型宝可梦一靠近，就立刻钻回地下。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME hides beneath the sand of the seafloor and emerges only to feed on algae. Its blue antennae sense even the slightest shifts in the water; if a larger Pokémon draws near, it immediately retreats underground.

entry: POKENAME极为友善合群，喜欢与孩子在泥里泼水玩，因此互动动物园常想引进它。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Extremely friendly, POKENAME is often sought for petting zoos because it is so social and enjoys splashing in the mud with children.

entry: POKENAME侧身滑过海浪，身后留下一道闪亮的心形泡泡。许多画家都从它身上寻找灵感。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides sideways over the ocean waves, leaving a sparkling trail of heart-shaped bubbles in its wake. Many painters use this Pokémon as inspiration for their art.

entry: POKENAME藏在海底沙下，吃藻时只探出头。蓝触角能感知水中最轻微的动作，比自己大的宝可梦一来，就迅速重新埋好。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME hides beneath the sand of the seafloor, exposing only its head when it needs to feed on algae. Its blue antennae can detect even the faintest movement in the water; if a Pokémon larger than itself approaches, it quickly buries itself again.

entry: POKENAME在湖面优雅绕圈，轻松滑行，以浮在水上的叶子为食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims graceful circles around lakes, gliding across the surface with ease. It eats leaves that float on the lake's surface.

entry: POKENAME像孩子般热情爱玩，精力仿佛无穷。训练家最好常带它去泳池，靠最爱的游泳消耗些力气。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME behaves with childish enthusiasm and playfulness, seemingly posessing boundless energy. It's recommended for Trainers to take it to pools often, so it can burn off some energy by swimming, its favorite activity.

entry: POKENAME的火焰包在泡泡般的薄膜里，保持热量与强度。温暖的身体，加上更温暖的性情，吸引各种海洋生物作伴。
author: bobosmith01
source: The flames POKENAME produces are contained in a bubble-like film that preserves their heat and intensity. This Pokémon's warm body and even warmer personality attracts all kinds of marine life.

entry: POKENAME用厚泡泡裹住尾巴，把封住的空气当鳍游泳。受威胁时甩尾向敌人发出泡沫光线，再逃走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME coat their tails with a thick bubble, using the captured air as a fin to swim with. When threatened, they sweep their tail at their aggressor to unleash a Bubble Beam before escaping.

entry: POKENAME的毒刺藏着大量毒液，性情却友善，很少伤人。有些POKENAME甚至想上岸陪人玩，尽管身体到了陆上，很快就会干掉。
author: darkweavile428
source: Although POKENAME's stingers contain large amounts of venom, it is so friendly that it will rarely harm humans. Some POKENAME will even try and come ashore to play with people, even though it quickly dries out on land.

entry: POKENAME游荡海滩与港口，找人类和宝可梦开无伤大雅的玩笑。皮肤覆着刺痛的薄膜，让它能咯咯笑着跑开，只留下对方又痒又麻。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME wanders beaches and harbors, seeking out people and Pokémon to play harmless pranks on. Its skin is covered with a stinging film, allowing it to scamper away giggling while its foe is left itching and numb.

entry: POKENAME沿海底爬行，用钳子将海带剪成能吃的小块。好奇心强，附近有潜水者就会凑去查看。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME crawl along the ocean floor, where they clip and tear pieces of kelp with their claws into edible chunks. They are curious creatures that investigate divers when they are nearby.

entry: POKENAME将骨头磨出极利的尖端，制成小匕首。在寒冷地区悄悄行进，潜到猎物背后，施以致命刺击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sharpens down bones to an extremely sharp point, fashioning a small dagger. It moves sneakily through cold areas, coming up from behind prey before delivering a fatal stabbing.

entry: POKENAME凭对痛苦的敏感，找到被遗弃的宝可梦幼崽，随后偷走附近的蛋，留待自己吃。
author: .izik
source: Using its sensitivity to distress, POKENAME locates abandoned Pokémon young. It then steals eggs nearby to feed itself later.

entry: POKENAME灭火极有效，身体却十分脆弱。用途出众，消防员仍常带它工作，不过通常会另配一只宝可梦，弥补弱点。
author: thesilverowls
source: While immensely effective at putting out fires, POKENAME are very frail physically. In spite of this, their usefulness makes them a common Pokémon for Firefighters, though usually with another Pokémon accompanying them to offset their weakness.

entry: POKENAME猛斩树木标记领地，却常斩太快，不慎砍倒整棵。木雕师会请它帮忙，在木饰品上大量刻出精细花纹。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME slash furiously at trees to leave behind markings signifying their territory; however, they often cut so fast that they accidentally fell the tree. Woodcarvers utilize this Pokémon to help mass-produce intricate patterns on wooden trinkets.

entry: POKENAME极虚荣，用掉落的尖刺编扇，模仿人类贵族。谁侮辱外貌，就会被它拿扇作刀接连砍，直到出言赞美才肯停。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are extremely vain, using shed quills to construct fans for the purpose of resembling human nobles. If someone insults their appearance, they will instead use the fan as a blade and slash repeatedly until they're complimented.

entry: POKENAME游过寒水捕猎。独处的个体会招其他宝可梦帮忙，载在背上，一起围攻被自己钳住的目标。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME swims through frigid waters, hunting for prey. A solitary POKENAME will recruit other Pokémon to help it hunt, carrying them on its back to gang up on anything it seizes in its claws.

entry: POKENAME适应力极强，也很狡猾。通常住在寒冷地区，以浓厚蓬松的毛抵御寒意。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME are incredibly adaptable and cunning. They usually live in cold environments, where their thick and fluffy coats protect them from the chill.

entry: 靠前爪攀爬地形，却不太愿意用来防身。鲜红毛发散出额外暖意，让群体不一起狩猎时，也能度过寒冷。
author: infinex21
source: They use their front claws to scale terrain but are reluctant to use them to defend themselves. Their vibrant, red hair exudes extra warmth which helps groups of them to survive colder environments when they're not hunting together.

entry: POKENAME尾上的爪子若没能击败敌人，就会召来冰雹，以刺骨严寒压倒对方。
author: .izik
source: If the claw on its tail fails to defeat an enemy, POKENAME summons a hailstorm to overwhelm them with sheer cold.

entry: POKENAME通常在寒冷山区筑巢。训练家当心：看见一只，附近还有两到四只等着围攻。
author: ghostslythe
source: Normally, POKENAME makes its nests in cold mountainous regions. Trainers beware: when one is present, two to four more are nearby waiting to swarm.

entry: POKENAME在巨石上刻方向与符号，再用超能力搬动，精心安放路标。能引猎物入伏、带朋友回家，或让敌人绕圈迷路。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME carve directions and symbols onto boulders, later using their psychic energy to move them around. These signs are carefully placed to lure prey into ambushes, lead friends to their homes, or leave enemies walking in circles.

entry: 藏在淡水湖与池塘里。猎物一进入范围，就用强爪猛烈袭击。
author: tank3007
source: It hides within fresh water lakes or ponds. When prey is within reach, it attacks viciously with its powerful claws.

entry: POKENAME结成小群，以配合默契的俯冲捕猎，连象牙猪与圈圈熊这样的强健敌人也能拖垮。贡献最大者能分到最多血，让羽色更鲜亮。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME gather in small groups to hunt large prey with coordinated diving attacks that wear down even hardy foes like Mamoswine and Ursaring. The one who contributed the most to the hunt gets the most blood, which brightens its feathers.

entry: POKENAME利用身形与外貌，装得温顺无害。等目标放下戒心，便以比看起来锋利得多的爪子，算准时机切击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its size and appearance to its advantage, making itself appear demure and nonthreatening. When the target's guard is down, it strikes with calculated cuts from it deceptively sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME痴迷金币，偶尔连寒冷的惯常领地也顾不上，专程出去捕猎野生喵喵。对人类而言，除了喙与爪，锋利如刃的翼羽也同样危险。
author: sontyp
source: A POKENAME covets golden coins to the point of occasionally leaving its regular frigid territory to hunt for wild Meowth. Its beak and claws aren't the only danger to humans, as it often attacks with its razor sharp wing feathers.

entry: POKENAME友善，身手敏捷又聪明，学把戏很快，因此常在马戏团等娱乐场所表演。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a friendly personality and is quite nimble and intelligent, able to learn tricks quickly. This has led to it being used regularly in entertainment venues such as circuses.

entry: 血红月夜，POKENAME格外活跃。乘阵风飘行，用利爪与锐褶骚扰许多小鸟宝可梦。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME are especially active on nights with a blood-red moon. They float on gusts of wind and harass many small bird Pokémon with their sharp frills and claws.

entry: POKENAME一爪就能斩断厚厚一捆巨蔓藤的藤蔓。猎物稀少时，也能将太阳能转化为养分。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME's claws can slash through a thick bundle of Tangrowth vines in just one strike. If prey is scarce, its body can also convert solar energy into nutrition.

entry: POKENAME野外少见，住在极寒险地，或领地意识极强的危险宝可梦出没处。会巧妙挖出隧道网，察觉猎物引起的振动后迅速穿行。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is a rare sight in the wild, living in inhospitable areas of extreme cold or dangerously territorial Pokémon. It cleverly digs a network of tunnels, which it then can quickly navigate when it senses prey causing vibrations.

entry: POKENAME偷训练家的东西索取赎物，非拿点心来才肯还。训练家最好保管好随身物品，免遭偷窃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME steal items from Trainers and hold them for ransom until they are given a treat. Trainers are advised to keep their belongings secured to avoid theft.

entry: POKENAME总露着利爪成群飞行，将最大的敌人也吓出领地。某些地区曾因它们彻底砸碎巨石等藏身处，令当地猎物绝迹。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME always fly in swarms with their claws out to scare even the largest foes away from their territory. In some regions, they are known to have extirpated prey in their areas by fully crushing boulders and other hiding spots that prey may use.

entry: POKENAME独自在寒地狩猎。先将亲代宝可梦引离巢，再趁机迅速偷吃无人看守的蛋。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a solitary hunter inhabiting colder regions. It lures parent Pokémon away from their nests before using the distraction to quickly snatch and eat the unguarded eggs.

entry: POKENAME会在结着美味树果的树上留下爪痕。谁敢偷它的果子，便会遭群体包围，吃进肚里。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME leaves scratches on trees with delicious berries. Any Pokémon who steals POKENAME's berries will be surrounded by their pack and consumed.

entry: POKENAME曾数十年遭盗猎，宝石、獠牙、羽毛与毛皮都被觊觎。如今成为保护物种，数量正恢复。性格调皮，会悄悄靠近同伴，再大吼吓它们。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's population is recovering as it is a protected species after decades of being poached for its gem, tusks, feathers, and fur. It is mischievous, sneaking up on members of its herd and bellowing to startle them.

entry: POKENAME用爪子切下树上的球果，存进尾巴，送给中意的同伴或陌生人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slashes Apricorns from trees with its claws. It stores the fruit in its tail and delivers them to allies or strangers it favors.

entry: POKENAME狡猾善操纵，先救弱小生物，再要求献礼报恩。还会刻意展示身上许多利刃，让对方不敢拒绝。
author: sk372
source: A sly and manipulative Pokémon, POKENAME saves smaller creatures from harm before demanding offerings for its good deed. It makes a show of displaying its many sharp edges to discourage them from refusing.

entry: POKENAME中，獠牙最长、最大的那只带队狩猎。它们靠翻滚与猛撞，把猎物击倒。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME with the longest and biggest tusks lead their hunting parties. They bring down prey by rolling and slamming into them.

entry: POKENAME是一群狃小子的首领，总与帮众形影不离。它整天吆喝发令，还会主动挑起与敌帮的争斗。
author: jackythewannabe
source: The leader of a pack of Snearogues, POKENAME is never seen without its gang. It barks orders all day, and initiates fights with rival gangs.

entry: POKENAME产出的奶热量高、能振奋精神，需要大量养分。可太眷恋不爱动的生活，不肯狩猎，只偷遇见的人类或宝可梦的食物。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME produces high-calorie and invigorating milk that requires a lot of nutrients, but it values its sedentary lifestyle too much to hunt for food. It will steal food from any Pokémon or humans that it encounters.

entry: POKENAME似乎知道金蛋对人类很值钱。以亮光吸引训练家，诱进陷阱。狩猎伙伴就位前，甚至愿意先挨一击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME seems to know that its golden egg is valuable to humans. It will use its gleam to attract attention, then lure Pokémon Trainers into a trap, and is willing to take a hit while its hunting partners get into position to strike.

entry: POKENAME埋起身体，露出的羽毛让领地容易辨认。这是最后一个仍与群体合作的阶段，会用高压气体捕猎；再进化后，只与伴侣同住。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME territory is recognizable due to its feathers poking from its burrowed body. This is the last stage it works with a pack, using pressurized gas to hunt, as it lives only with a mate after evolving.

entry: POKENAME住在偏远海中峭岩，对靠近的船几乎不留情。巨爪若没撕得够碎，因它而起的风暴也一定会收尾。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME shows little mercy to ships that pass too close to the remote ocean crags it lives upon. If its giant claws don't tear the ship apart enough, the storms that it generates with its presence will surely finish the job.

entry: POKENAME常缠着雪笠怪，索取甜美树果。个头的不足，全用执着与狡黠补上。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME is known to harass Snover for their sweet berries. What it lacks in size, it makes up for in persistence and cunning.

entry: 浅蓝晶体散出寒气，它能操控寒气，在地上结出冰面“滑行”。绕敌人滑动时，斩击又快又狠，身后一路结冰。
author: infinex21
source: It exudes frigid air from the pale blue crystals along its body, which it can control to create sheets of ice on the ground for it to "skate" along. It delivers swift and merciless slashes that leave ice in its wake as it "skates" around its foe.

entry: 住在火山地区，结小群共同狩猎。走散后，会用自己制的木炭留下讯息，彼此联络。
author: .jerden
source: They live in volcanic regions, banding together in small groups to hunt prey. When separated, they leave messages for each other using charcoal they create.

entry: POKENAME主要靠光合作用获取养分，却仍有定期狩猎的冲动。小群合力捕到猎物后，大多又懒得真吃。
author: sk372
source: Although sustenance for POKENAME is primarily gathered via photosynthesis, it has hunting urges that need to be regularly sated. Small groups gather to hunt prey together, though once the hunt is finished, few bother to actually eat it.

entry: POKENAME在冰湖表面磨爪。若不慎弄裂冰面，就吐出寒气重新冻好。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sharpens its claws on frozen lake surfaces. If it accidentally cracks the ice, it uses a breath of cold to freeze it over again.

entry: POKENAME倒挂在高大洞窟的顶上，徘徊于其他宝可梦的巢边。等亲代离开，就吃掉留下的蛋。
author: kungfucutbug
source: POKENAME hangs from the ceilings of tall caves, lingering by the nests of other Pokémon. When the parents leave, it devours the eggs left behind.

entry: 不知为何，POKENAME会用爪子在树上刻代码。找到电脑也照刻不误，结果通常只是毁掉电脑。
author: santon5512
source: For an unknown reason, POKENAME will carve lines of code into trees using their claws. They will carve this code into any computers they find, though this usually just ends in the computer's destruction.

entry: POKENAME藏在沼泽泥中，耐心埋伏。凭压倒性力量将对方拖入泥潭，再以猛烈咬击与强鳍重击将其击倒。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME hides in swamp mud, patiently waiting to ambush its prey. Using its overwhelming strength, it drags foes into the mire, finishing them off with crushing bites and powerful strikes from its fins.

entry: POKENAME聚在受侵蚀的海岸，把土、泥和石头推进水里修复。可常修得超过原界，将原本的海洋也填成陆地。
author: sirg44
source: POKENAME gather on coasts worn away by erosion, pushing dirt, mud, and rocks into the water to repair the damage. However, their efforts often extend the coastline past its original boundaries, creating land where before there had been only ocean.

entry: POKENAME能感知情绪，轻易找出最适合下手的受害者。锋利爪子能切开实心岩石。
author: fiordaliso
source: Since POKENAME can sense the emotions of others, it easily identifies the ideal victim to steal from. Its sharp claws are capable of cutting through solid rock.

entry: 据说POKENAME在林间空地办茶会。训练家只要说出名字，便会受它束缚。战斗时凭空抽出巨钳螳螂的镰刀，优雅旋舞，斩击却凶狠。
author: ghostslythe
source: It is said POKENAME hosts tea parties in forest clearings and any Trainer that speaks their name is bound to it. When battling, it pulls the Scizor scythe from thin air, pirouetting gracefully through savage slashes.

entry: POKENAME花无数时间打理洁净外貌。战斗虽能释放冰雪风暴，可只要弄脏，便迅速失去镇定。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spend countless hours maintaining their pristine appearance. Though they can unleash icy blizzards in battle, they quickly lose their composure whenever they get dirty.

entry: POKENAME成群在林中跳舞，磨炼预知未来的本领。之后各自散去，捕猎落单目标，以凶狠的“咬住”击倒对方。
author: ghostslythe
source: Groups of POKENAME gather in the woods to dance and improve their future sight. Afterwards the Pokémon scatter, hunting lone prey and taking them down with vicious Bites.

entry: POKENAME极其狡猾，装得天真无辜，引人靠近、放松戒心。最擅长在精神与情绪上操纵亲近的对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite devious and sly, feigning innocence and naivety in order to let others get close and drop their guard. It is a master of manipulating those close to it both mentally and emotionally.

entry: POKENAME是住在寒地的狡猾战士，会组成小型匪帮，合伙劫掠旅人。可一到分赃，战术上的默契便不复存在。
author: sk372
source: Sly combatants inhabiting frigid regions, POKENAME band together and form small bandit groups raiding unsuspecting travelers. This tactical coordination ends once it is time to divide up the spoils.

entry: POKENAME每个肘部都能伸出一根长爪，锋利不逊手爪。为了磨利刀刃，常切削、雕刻大冰块训练。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can extend a long singular claw from each of its elbows, no less sharp than the ones on its hands. To keep these blades sharp, it practices by slicing and carving away at large ice chunks for training.

entry: POKENAME住在高处，多是积雪峰顶。会阴森地飘近落单登山者，想让对方滚落山坡，却没有明显理由。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME lives at high altitudes, usually on snowcapped peaks. It will float ominously near any solitary climbers, aiming to send them tumbling down the mountainside for no obvious reason.

entry: POKENAME头顶宝石发出强磁场，能轻松在暗处辨路，浓密暴风雪中尤其有用。
author: .izik
source: The gem on POKENAME's head emits a strong magnetic field, letting it navigate dark areas without effort. This is primarily useful in dense blizzards.

entry: 狡猾地住在山区，用智慧预测风暴，再捕猎正躲藏避难的宝可梦。别看那副身形，爪击远快于外表给人的印象。
author: fireblade141
source: This cunning Pokémon lives in mountainous areas, where it uses its intellect to predict storms so it can hunt Pokémon that are huddled down for shelter. Despite its size, its claw strikes are deceptively fast.

entry: POKENAME是伏击猎手，藏进寄宿的石头，等待合适猎物。出手突然迅捷，专挑最弱之处，趁机压倒对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is an ambush hunter, hiding away in the stone housing it until suitable prey draws near. It strikes suddenly and quickly, overpowering prey with opportunistic strikes to their weakest points.

entry: POKENAME攀爬本领精湛，靠利爪登上垂直峭壁。想精进登山的训练家，常找这些严于律己的宝可梦学习技巧。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME are known for their expert climbing skills, using their sharp claws to scale vertical cliffs. Trainers hoping to master mountaineering frequently seek out these disciplined Pokémon to learn their techniques.

entry: POKENAME住在冰山，捕猎时轻松攀过险地。平时独猎，面对更大的威胁，也会与同类联手。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in the icy mountains, scaling the treacherous terrain with ease while hunting its prey. While usually a solitary hunter, it will team up with other POKENAME to take down larger threats.

entry: 每年一次，POKENAME靠粗大爪子沿崖攀登，尽量爬高。就位后向风中释放花粉，彼此授粉。
author: quackquackattack
source: Once a year, POKENAME scale the sides of cliffs to climb as high as they can with their hefty claws. Once in position, POKENAME release pollen into the wind to pollinate each other.

entry: POKENAME厚头骨由坚固琥珀构成，能轻松顶着大多攻击冲锋。会用头撞倒大树，标记领地。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's thick skulls are made of a sturdy amber, letting them charge through most attacks with ease. They use their heads to fell large trees, marking their territory.

entry: POKENAME常令倒霉旅人遭遇意外，名声很差。可值得注意的是，正是这些事故，让受害者避开了更大的灾难。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a bad reputation due to causing incidents to befall hapless travelers. It is notable, however, that these incidents caused the victims to avoid being present during even greater disasters.

entry: POKENAME只在夜里袭敌。战斗本能虽敏锐，这个顽皮家伙却总爱挑弱小的对手下手。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME only targets foes at night. While this mischievous Pokémon possesses sharp fighting instincts, it tends to only go for weaker enemies.

entry: POKENAME先用刺骨的冰冻之风使敌人僵住，再以躯干伸出的刀刃斩倒。通常追踪已经虚弱的猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stuns foes with a chilling Icy Wind before slicing them down with the blades protruding from its torso. It tends to stalk already weakened prey.

entry: 夜里，只有低沉翼鸣能让人察觉POKENAME。它会在猎物头顶盘旋逗弄，始终不露身影，最后俯冲时才遮住月亮。
author: ghostslythe
source: In the darkness of the night, the only sign POKENAME are around is the bass thrum of their wings. They are known to play with their prey, buzzing above their heads unseen, before blotting out the moon on their final dive.

entry: POKENAME狡猾善操纵，装着无辜模样靠近，伸出触须示好。等距离够近，就以利如爪刃的边缘斩倒目标。
author: sk372
source: A sly and manipulative Pokémon, POKENAME approaches others with a falsely innocent appearance. Presenting its feelers as a peace offering, it waits until close before cutting its target down with the edges, which are as sharp as claws.

entry: POKENAME结合踢击与伸缩长臂的抓挠作战。帽盖最大的个体就是首领。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's fighting style is a combination of kicking and scratching the opponent with its stretchy arms. The POKENAME with the biggest cap is the leader.

entry: POKENAME凶悍狡猾，会跃出数码屏幕，以巨大电爪斩击。哪怕擦到，也会留下痛伤，几秒后便转成冻伤。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is an aggressive, devious creature that leaps out from digital screens to slash at others with its large electric claws. Even being grazed by them leaves a victim with a painful wound that turns frostbitten in seconds.

entry: POKENAME住在最寒冷地区，一群最多五只。多在风暴中合力狩猎，能在雪中静候数日，再跃出撕碎毫无防备的猎物。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME dwell in the coldest of regions, forming up to packs of five. POKENAME typically work in groups, hunting during storms; they patiently wait in the snow for days for unsuspecting prey. They then leap out and rip their prey to shreds.

entry: 夜间，POKENAME的温暖火光仿佛能庇护黑暗中的迷途者。其实只是诱饵，等着与伙伴共同伏击猎物。
author: .jerden
source: At night, the warm glow of POKENAME's fire promises safety to anyone lost in the dark. However, this light merely lures prey into an ambush by POKENAME and its allies.

entry: POKENAME在受训群体中配合极佳，战术协调，也照料伤员。隐秘又强大，让人猜测是古文明军队的遗存，但尚未证实。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME works exceptionally in a trained group, fighting with coordinated tactics and caring for injured members. Due to its stealth and power, some hypothesize that it is a remnant of an ancient civilization's army, but this has not been proven.

entry: 钦佩玛狃拉的群体合作，便以旧布装成它们，希望被接纳。可常太慢跟不上狩猎，只好吃剩下的碎屑。
author: _blissey
source: Impressed by how Weavile work as a pack, it fashions old cloth to resemble them in hopes of getting accepted. It is often too slow to keep up with the hunt, having to settle for what scraps are left behind.

entry: POKENAME两颗头都是策略高手，一颗专攻，一颗专守。意见却极少一致，让多个同类之间几乎无法合作。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's heads are adept strategists, with one specializing in aggressive tactics and the other in defensive ones. The two rarely agree, making cooperation between multiples of the species nearly impossible.

entry: POKENAME顽皮，常扒窃路人、偷其他宝可梦的树果。人们认为，它是现存物种中与大狃拉亲缘最近的。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are mischievous Pokémon, often pickpocketing unsuspecting people or stealing berries from other Pokémon. It is believed that they are the closest living relatives to Sneasler.

entry: POKENAME结群选定一人跟踪，个个冒充同一只宝可梦。训练家走到哪里，哪里就见它们以冷焰显身。若被识破，便会诅咒对方。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME uses bait and switch tactics, as a group deciding to stalk a single person. They will then pose as the same Pokémon, appearing wherever that Trainer goes, highlighting themselves in cold flames. If discovered, they place a hex on the person.

entry: 古传说称POKENAME曾恐吓寒地的偏远村落。极光被视为遇见它们的前兆，随后常有猛烈伏击，附近地标也会留下奇怪爪痕。
author: antler_zero_
source: Legends speak of POKENAME terrorizing isolated villages in colder climates. Auroras were seen as harbingers of POKENAME encounters, which often involved violent ambushes and strange markings clawed into nearby landmarks.

entry: POKENAME性情残忍，特别针对大牙狸与大尾狸。等后者完整筑好水坝，才悄悄靠近，以爪撕毁局部，直到整座崩塌。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a cruel disposition, focused primarily on Bidoof and Bibarel. It will wait until the latter have completely finished a dam before sneaking up and rending parts of it with its claws until the entire structure collapses.

entry: POKENAME争领地或首领之位时很谨慎，因为身体的粉红岩石部位容易变脆。若崩缺，再生后便不对称，让群体中的地位降低。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is careful when battling others of its kind for territory or leadership because the pink rock sections of its body can become brittle. If those sections chip, they do not grow back symmetrically, so POKENAME will lose standing in its pack.

entry: 看似天真，好奇地四处飞。一发现合适猎物便发出狩猎嗡鸣，同群POKENAME立刻从暗处扑出。
author: pattybgoode
source: It curiously flits around with an innocent look. When it spots potential prey, it buzzes a hunting signal, and other POKENAME in its group suddenly pounce from hiding.

entry: POKENAME睡时裹着厚冰，睡得越久，冻壳就越坚固。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME encases itself in thick ice as it sleeps. The longer the slumber, the tougher its frozen shell becomes.

entry: POKENAME成群飞过雪原，寻找象牙猪等大猎物吸血。喝过血，羽冠就更亮；光最亮的一只，领导下一次狩猎。
author: pjporwoll
source: Groups of POKENAME fly above the snowy tundra in search of large prey like Mamoswine from which to suck blood. After consuming blood, their feathered crest glows brighter, and the POKENAME with the brightest glow leads the next hunt.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，獠牙会覆冰。每一击都足以在实心钢铁上留下深凹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tusks coat themselves in ice during combat. Each strike carries enough force to leave deep dents in solid steel.

entry: POKENAME住在高山，用利爪攀住崖壁。是凶猛猎手，会高速追赶猎物，再斩成碎片。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives high in the mountains, using its sharp claws to cling onto the cliff face. It is vicious hunter, pursuing them at high speeds before slashing them to pieces.

entry: POKENAME精于阴谋诡计，被邪恶组织雇来从事间谍活动、偷密封文件等。它们追求刺激，犯罪正是因为兴奋。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are masters of skulduggery and are hired by evil organizations to commit anything from espionage to stealing sealed documents. They are thrill seekers and commit crimes because of the excitement they get.

entry: POKENAME傍晚在雪洞外摇摆。谁靠得太近，就会被冻住，拖进洞里，展示为冰封战利品。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sways outside its snowy cave at dusk. It freezes those who come too close, dragging them inside to display as frozen trophies.

entry: POKENAME视力差，靠羽冠与黏液胡须察觉环境异常。黏软身体能溶掉大多材料，因此被用来闯入金库等戒备森严的场所。
author: pjporwoll
source: Because its eyesight is poor, POKENAME uses its feathered crest and goo whiskers to detect anomalies in its environment. Its gooey body can dissolve most materials, so it is utilized to break into vaults and other high-security areas.

entry: 缘朱市偶尔能见POKENAME与和服女孩共舞。能从扇中造出冰晶，既是表演奇景，也能成为对敌的致命攻击。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: In Ecruteak City, POKENAME may sometimes be spotted dancing along with Kimono Girls. POKENAME can create ice crystals from their fans, which are used either as a spectacle in performances or a deadly attack against foes.

entry: POKENAME群体以看似天真舞蹈的方式狩猎，轻松捕获任何猎物。唱过的地方会留下不祥声音，供它们向其他伙伴传讯。
author: soup1900
source: Using a hunting style that looks like innocent dancing, packs of POKENAME can effortlessly hunt down any prey. Ominous sounds linger in the area where POKENAME have sung, allowing them to leave messages for others.

entry: POKENAME迅速爬树，袭击悬在枝上的宝可梦，整只吞下。等猎物被孢子完全感染，再吐出来，散播真菌。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME can quickly scale up trees to attack Pokémon hanging off of branches. It can then swallow them whole and eventually regurgitates when they are fully infected with spores to spread the fungus.

entry: POKENAME利爪能轻松抓住寒冰，攀上冻崖。手臂的保温鳞片帮助抵御严寒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME scales frozen cliffs with ease, its claws gripping ice effortlessly. The heat-retaining scales on its arms help it endure the cold.

entry: POKENAME手上的花瓣卷成利爪。几只藏在枝叶间，放甜香引虫，等虫群聚齐再一同扑出。
author: .jerden
source: The petals on POKENAME's hands curl into sharp claws. Several POKENAME will hide in foliage and produce a sweet scent to lure in Bug Pokémon, then all leap out to attack once a swarm has gathered.

entry: 一只POKENAME游荡之处，暗地里藏着整帮同伴。擅长扒窃、偷野生宝可梦的树果，却并非全无良心，夜间会点燃手杖，带迷路孩子回家。
author: ghostslythe
source: Where one POKENAME prowls, an entire gang is hidden. They are adept at pickpocketing and taking berries from Wild Pokémon. However, they are not truly heartless. They ignite their staves at night to guide lost children back home.

entry: POKENAME群体占据山区湖岸，将水聚进脚掌，脚步轻如低语，悄悄靠近可能的闯入者。
author: ghostslythe
source: Groups of POKENAME claim mountainous lakeside shores as their territory. They soften their footsteps to a whisper by collecting water into their paws, allowing them to sneak up on any would-be intruders.

entry: POKENAME群体观念强，被赶出群体便会消沉鲁莽。训练家将它融入队伍时须细心，新伙伴要相处一段时间才能亲近。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has a strong sense of community, and it becomes despondent and reckless if cast out of its pack. Trainers must take care when integrating it with a team as it takes time warming up to new allies.

entry: POKENAME无声钻过积雪，速度惊人。雪下小宝可梦很快被吞食，雪面上的则会遭伏击，挨上利爪。
author: hophoppip
source: Tunneling silently through the snow, POKENAME moves astoundingly fast. Small Pokémon beneath the snow are devoured rapidly, and surface-dwellers are ambushed and slashed by POKENAME's sharp claws.

entry: 担忧大城市小拉达泛滥，许多官员放出POKENAME捕猎。可惜它们被一切亮物吸引，反倒成帮盘踞后巷，偷训练家的东西。
author: ghostslythe
source: Afraid of the Rattata infestation in big cities, many officials released POKENAME as a predator. Unfortunately, these Pokémon are drawn to anything shiny, thus have infested back alleyways in gangs that steal from Trainers.

entry: POKENAME泳技高超，水中几乎什么宝可梦都抓得到。吃空整湖猎物后，会在近旁巨石刻记号，提醒同类湖里没东西了。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME's superior swimming capabilities allow it to catch almost any other Pokémon in the water. Once it has completely cleared a lake of prey, POKENAME will claw a sign into a nearby boulder to let others of its kind know that the lake is empty.

entry: 利用地下布满陷阱的房间，在可控险境锻炼身体。这种房间俗称“危险室”，POKENAME的狂热粉丝也试着模仿，成效各异。
author: turron_turron
source: Using trap-filled chambers built below ground, these Pokémon train their bodies in a hostile, controlled environment. Colloquially referred to as the 'Danger Room,' POKENAME super-fans try to replicate this training technique with varying results.

entry: POKENAME整夜安睡，能有效躲过超能力属性宝可梦。太阳一升便立刻醒来，瞬间移动到仍是夜晚的地方。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME always sleeps through the night, able to effectively hide from Psychic types. Once the sun rises, it immediately awakens, teleporting to lands where it is still night.

entry: 据说POKENAME能察觉斗志，战斗几乎无人能挡。却并不残忍，反而极温柔，对赢得尊敬的训练家怀着深厚忠诚。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: They say POKENAME can detect one's fighting spirit, making it a nearly unstoppable force in battle. However, it is not a cruel Pokémon. It is incredibly gentle and has a profound sense of loyalty towards Trainers who have earned its respect.

entry: POKENAME小群狩猎，常互相抛掷，迅速追近猎物。用爪梳过彼此的褶边，是它们表达友谊的方式。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hunt in small groups, usually using tactics that involve flinging one another to quickly gain on potential prey. Raking one's claws through their frills is considered a friendship gesture between POKENAME.

entry: 想逃离警察、组织喽啰等大群训练家，POKENAME十分合适。能察觉广阔范围内每个人的位置，找到最佳逃路，但妖精属性宝可梦似乎会模糊感知。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME is the perfect Pokémon to run away from a large group of Trainers, such as cops or grunts. They can detect every single one of them in a large radius to trace the best escape route. The presence of Fairy-types seems to blur their senses.

entry: POKENAME狡猾，略以折磨为乐，战斗时尤其如此。先任敌人击打硬壳，耗尽力气，再逼它奔跑，躲避接连的水炮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a wily and slightly sadistic personality, especially once it enters battle. It enjoys getting its opponents to tire themselves out striking its sturdy shell, before making them run and try to avoid multiple water shots from its cannons.

entry: POKENAME以催眠摆锤制服大群旅人，偷走看中的东西。有些甚至催眠同类，接手对方正要进行的偷窃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses their hypnotic pendulum to subdue large groups of travelers and pilfer anything interesting it finds from them. Other POKENAME even hypnotize their own just to hijack their attempted thievery for themselves.

entry: POKENAME不喜欢孩子爱玩的多数活动，因此不太讨孩子喜欢。家长却很爱它，因为它保护孩子，也关心他们是否平安。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are generally not liked by children due to POKENAME having a disdain for most activities that kids enjoy. Conversely, parents love POKENAME due to their protectiveness and concern for the well-being of children.

entry: POKENAME体内不断积聚剧毒气体，会随攻击放出，既减轻压力，也毒伤敌人。
author: chibitales
source: An extremely toxic gas is constantly building up within POKENAME's body. It expels this gas alongside its attacks to relieve pressure and poison foes.

entry: 违法作业的工厂里，常能见到POKENAME。它用磁场困住有毒废气，再由体内系统过滤，净化出的清新湿润气息，还常被拿来调制古龙水。
author: beatdoof
source: Often seen in factories with illegal working conditions, POKENAME's magnetic field is used to trap toxic gas wastes from these factories, then filter it with its internal filtering system. The clear, dewy air it creates is often turned into cologne.

entry: POKENAME磁场中的污染空气微粒都会得到净化。过去常用于工厂，如今烟气又被拿来制昂贵香水。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Any contaminated air particles in magnetic fields created by POKENAME are purified. They were once commonly used in factories, nowadays POKENAME's fumes are used to create expensive perfumes.

entry: POKENAME常见于废发电厂与垃圾填埋场。以能力磁化垃圾，吸来吃掉。也常与来找食物的灰尘颚龙争斗。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are commonly found in abandoned power plants or landfills. They use their abilities to magnetize garbage, pulling it in before eating it. POKENAME often get into battles with Garbtrum that are in search of food.

entry: 看着更像机甲，POKENAME却是纯粹的有机生命，保护小磁怪驾驶员的心意也发自本能。二者若分开，本体天线远隔数个地区也能探知另一半。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: Although they look more like a mech than a Pokémon, POKENAME and their desire to protect their Magnemite pilot are both entirely organic. If the two are ever separated, the body's antenna can detect their other half from entire regions away.

entry: POKENAME以磁力吸在船侧，周游海洋。夜里爬到水线上方，发出神秘电波。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME travels around the ocean, attached to the side of ships by magnetism. At night, it will climb up above the waterline and begin to emit mysterious radio waves.

entry: POKENAME用力疾奔，时速能达500公里。可全速时，后腿轮子常比前腿快，结果把自己绊倒。
author: distinguishedmanlygentleman
source: By exerting itself, POKENAME can achieve speeds of 500 kilometres an hour. Unfortunately, the wheels on POKENAME's back legs often move quicker than its front legs at maximum speed, leading to it tripping over itself.

entry: POKENAME住在发电厂旁，捕食同样被吸来的其他宝可梦。吸电过多便会长久暴怒，产生广大的磁场。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME tend to dwell near power plants so they may prey upon other Pokémon drawn to power plants as well. When they have absorbed too much electricity, they will fly into a long rage that generates an expansive magnetic field.

entry: POKENAME吸收的金属越多，磁场就越强。虽然日久会慢慢减弱，训练家仍应限制它摄取金属。
author: mistymagius
source: The more metal POKENAME absorbs into its body, the more powerful the magnetic field it produces becomes. While the field will slowly weaken over time, Trainers should try to restrict POKENAME's metallic diet.

entry: POKENAME展开纯电力构成的双翼，强化飞行与磁力。爱在最高的电波塔筑巢，可干扰太强，常添麻烦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME unfurls wings made of pure electricity to enhance its flight and magnetic capabilities. It has a habit of nesting on the tallest radio towers, which makes it a nuisance due to the strong interference this creates.

entry: POKENAME常过之处少有金属物，因为飞过就会将它们磁化。若强劲的反向磁场对准它，双翼便失稳，难以飞行。
author: soup1900
source: Metallic objects are scarce in areas where POKENAME is known to roam since they all get magnetized when it flies by. If a strong opposing magnetic field is directed at it, its wings will lose their stability, causing it to struggle to fly.

entry: 风暴时现身接雷，将能量存进体内。强磁场会令一定范围内的大多电子设备与指南针失灵。
author: infinex21
source: It appears during storms to catch lightning and store the energy within itself. It generates a strong magnetic field that causes most electronics and compasses to fail within a certain range of it.

entry: 已更善于控制磁力，能集中作用于特定目标。常借此救助、保护别人，甚至挽救沉船。
author: infinex21
source: They have developed better control over their magnetism, to the point they can concentrate it upon specific targets. They often use their powers to help save and protect others, including saving sinking ships.

entry: POKENAME释放特殊磁场，浮空高速前进。金色毒刺能在几分钟内让身体麻木——前提是被贯穿后，身体仍算完整。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME exude a special magnetic field that keeps them afloat and propels them forward at high speeds. Their golden stingers contain a potent toxin that numbs the body in a few minutes, if the body is still in-tact after being impaled.

entry: 有传闻称，POKENAME肩负保护星球、抵御外星威胁的使命，甚至能在太空飞行。金属枪射出的强大念力波，能轻松抬起整栋建筑。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to some rumors, POKENAME has the mission of protecting the planet from extraterrestrial threats and is even capable of flying in space. From its metal gun, it can shoot powerful psychokinetic waves that can easily levitate entire buildings.

entry: 靠磁力与超能力主导战局。尾巴极粗极密，也能打出足以碎骨的重击。
author: infinex21
source: Its uses magnetism and psychic power to dominate battles. Its tail is incredibly thick and dense, which allows it to deliver bone-shattering strikes as well.

entry: 三个子单元是本体的延伸，让思考更快，还能同时追踪额外三个目标。磁场会干扰近旁大多设备，因此很难追踪。
author: infinex21
source: The three sub-units are extensions of itself that allow it to think quicker and to simultaneously track three extra targets. It generates a magnetic field that disrupts most devices when it is near, so tracking it has proven difficult.

entry: POKENAME借最猛烈的火焰扭曲磁场，让金属物件都变成小爆炸物。热浪释放大量电波，帮助避开雷达等追踪系统。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses the peaks of its flame's intensity to warp the fields of magnetism, turning every metallic object into a small explosive. Its heat shimmers release high volumes of radio waves that allow it to hide from radar and other tracking systems.

entry: POKENAME在视野好的高处一动不动，记录看见的一切，再用独立无人机补充影像。近来作为安保手段，极受欢迎。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME perches from a good vantage point, silent and motionless. It records everything that it sees and gets additional footage through its independent drones. It has recently become extremely popular as a form of security.

entry: POKENAME以惊人速度跑遍各地，路过就补满自动售货机。奇怪的是，只补劲爽汽水，没人知道从哪里来的。
author: sondededoo
source: POKENAME is known to run around regions at incredible speeds, refilling vending machines as it runs past. Strangely, they only ever seem to restock Soda Pop, and nobody knows where POKENAME gets it from.

entry: 靠自己产生并控制的磁力，能悬浮高速移动。獠牙能穿透大多数已知金属，靠抽取机器电力或钢属性宝可梦的能量为生。
author: infinex21
source: It stays aloft and moves at high speeds using the magnetism it generates and controls. Its fangs can penetrate most known metals. It feeds either on electricity drained from machines or on the energy of Steel-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME小巧，对电信号敏感。机械师和工程师会成队请它们在维修期间及完成后检查引擎，找出电路故障。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME are small and sensitive to electrical signals. Mechanics and engineers will employ teams of them to scour engines during and after repairs, seeking electrical faults.

entry: POKENAME飞在发电厂高空，以头顶天线扫描地面。锁定猎物后俯冲，用磁铁抓住小型钢属性宝可梦。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME soar high above power plants, using the antennae on their heads to scan the ground below. Once their prey is located, they swoop from the skies, snagging smaller Steel-type Pokémon with their magnets.

entry: POKENAME结合磁力、电力与伸缩爪，扰乱并捕获目标。抓住后却只仔细观察，再放开，动机仍不明。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses a mixture of magnetism, electricity and extendable claws to disorient and capture targets. Once seized, it simply observes them closely before releasing them; its motivations for doing so are still unknown.

entry: POKENAME的蛙鸣般嗡叫，声调与频率变化极多，能越过栖息水域传向远方。内含丰富讯息，同类解读后便能协调抗敌。
author: lordjoostmeister
