source: It emits croaking, buzzing calls that vary widely in tone and frequency. Carrying far across the water bodies POKENAME lives by, the calls contain a wealth of information that other POKENAME decode, allowing them to coordinate against threats.

entry: 空中漂行时不断积静电，吸来花粉。POKENAME的眼睛有玻璃眼睑，保护自己免受刺激。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It builds a constant static electricity that attracts pollen when it floats through the air. POKENAME's eye has glass eyelids so it can protect itself from irritation.

entry: 月亮正悬头顶时，POKENAME的鳃会发光、向上倾斜几分钟。过去港务长常养在身旁，预测涨潮，确保船只安全停泊。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When the moon sits directly overhead, POKENAME's gills glow and tilt upward for a few minutes. In the past, harbour masters kept them nearby to predict high tide and ensure ships remained safely moored.

entry: 能用头上的眼睛重构金属物件与建筑。POKENAME热心参与救灾，用超能力与磁力探查藏在瓦砾下的人。
author: silverscloudy
source: It is able to reconstruct metal objects and structures using the eye on its head. POKENAME has a commendable interest in supporting disaster relief efforts, using their psychic and magnetic abilities to detect people hidden by rubble.

entry: POKENAME虽不主要以此为食，却爱拿电池与电芯当零食。身体无法消化锂，突然吐出来时，常让训练家措手不及。
author: turron_turron
source: Though not their primary food source, POKENAME love snacking on batteries and power cells. However, POKENAME's body cannot digest lithium and many trainers are caught off guard when they spit it back up.

entry: POKENAME挂在城市树上搜寻猎物。因为有爆炸风险，清除它们成了当务之急。
author: notsaying.
source: POKENAME hangs from the trees found within urban areas, looking for prey. The risk of it exploding has led to POKENAME removal being a priority.

entry: POKENAME用磁力发射身上尖刺。刺由纯金属构成，带着倒钩，里面还含强酸。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME uses magnetism to propel its quills from its body. These quills are barbed, made of pure metal, and contain a powerful acid.

entry: 磁铁双手强得能当重锤，也能施放并操控磁力。或斥开敌人，或吸近后打出坚如钢铁的重拳。
author: infinex21
source: Not only are its magnet-hands strong enough to be used like hammers, but they allow it to project and control a magnetic force. They will use this magnetism to either repel foes or to drag them in and deliver a steel-hard punch.

entry: POKENAME如活的绝缘体，会侵入输电塔，阻断电流。磁性身体能让整片电网停摆，再躲回壳里。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME acts like a living insulator, invading electrical transmission towers and disrupting the flow of electricity. Its magnetic body can shut down entire sections of the grid before disappearing into its shell.

entry: POKENAME是城市与工厂中有名的窃贼。磁铁随意开关，远远抓来工具、金属，试着造自己的机械，再借对机器的斥力逃走。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are notorious thieves around cities and factories. They can activate their magnets at will, grabbing tools or pieces of metal from long range to try and create their own mechanisms. They escape by repelling themselves off of machinery.

entry: POKENAME借自身磁场，从口中如电磁轨道炮般射出石头、螺母等物。主头两旁融合的头，能让它战斗时仍留意周围。
author: infinex21
source: By harnessing its own magnetic field, POKENAME can fire rocks, nuts, and other things from its mouth like a railgun. The heads fused to the sides of its main head help it to stay aware of things around it during battle.

entry: 野生小磁怪爱绕着POKENAME飞。它借小磁怪赖以为食的电磁波，控制它们的心智。头上磁铁连最重的金属都吸得动。
author: keiracm35_
source: Wild Magnemite love to flit around POKENAME, which mentally controls them using the electromagnetic waves their bodies feed on. The magnet on its head can attract even the heaviest metals.

entry: 毒液有磁性，对钢属性与电属性宝可梦格外有效。从大天线放电时，胸前花纹就会发光。
author: infinex21
source: Its venom has magnetic properties, making it particularly effective against Steel-type Pokémon and Electric-type Pokémon. The patterns on its chest shine as it releases electricity from its large antenna.

entry: POKENAME收到过多无线信号便不堪负荷，过热爆出巨焰。会以强磁将岩浆深处的熔铁扯上地表，造出人造火山。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME gets overwhelmed when it catches too many radio signals and overheats in a giant burst of flames as a result. It creates artificial volcanoes by using its strong magnetism to rip molten iron from deep within the magma layer to the surface.

entry: POKENAME能用天线磁化财物，很受犯罪团伙喜爱。常见于犯罪猖獗的地方，尤其是可疑商店与赌场一带。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME are favored in crime groups for their ability to magnetize valuables with their antenna. They are often spotted in areas with high crime rates, particularly in ones that operate sketchy shops and casinos.

entry: POKENAME积电太多，头顶灯就开始闪，警告周围快离开。超载时会施出猛烈的放电，让波及的一切麻痹。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The light atop POKENAME starts to flash when a lot of electricity has built up. This is a warning to those nearby to vacate the area, as when it overloads it unleashes a devastating Discharge, paralysing everything in the blast.

entry: POKENAME合作包围钢属性宝可梦，各自对猎物施加磁力。力量均等，让目标固定原地，方便群体逼近击倒。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME work together to surround Steel type Pokémon, then they each use their magnetism on their prey. Since their magnetic power is equal, the prey remains in place, allowing the pack to close in and finish it off.

entry: POKENAME积电太多，磁铁就开始闪着静电，警告周围快离开。超载时会施出猛烈的放电，让波及的一切麻痹。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The magnets on POKENAME start to flicker with static when a lot of electricity has built up. This is a warning to those nearby to vacate the area, as when it overloads it unleashes a devastating Discharge, paralysing everything in the blast.

entry: 振翅越快，磁场越强。会用磁铁般的尾巴挂在金属结构上，可光是待着，也常造成干扰。
author: infinex21
source: The quicker its wings flutter, the stronger its magnetic field becomes. It uses its magnet-like tail to hang from metal structures, although it often causes interference with its mere presence.

entry: POKENAME飘过城市，用强磁抢走下面人们的手机。吸收里面的数据当养分，吸空就随手扔回地上。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats over cities using its strong magnets to snatch cellphones from people below. It absorbs the data from these devices as nourishment, carelessly dropping them to the ground the moment they are emptied.

entry: 利爪与众多尖刺都能产生强大电磁场，抵御敌意宝可梦。POKENAME一蜷起身体，就是准备施展猛烈的陀螺球。
author: fiordaliso
source: Both its claws and its many spines can generate powerful electromagnetic fields that help it defend itself from hostile Pokémon. When POKENAME curls up, it is preparing to unleash a devastating Gyro Ball.

entry: POKENAME平时不动声色，对训练家却很亲昵。能操纵电磁波，改变信号，向训练家传递爱意。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME typically hold a stoic demeanor, but is rather affectionate with its Trainer. It also has the ability to manipulate electromagnetic waves, changing the signal to a message of love for its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME猎食其他钢属性宝可梦，以磁力阻止逃跑。刀刃般的前肢与磁铁状爪射出的精确电击，都是武器。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME prey on other Steel-type Pokémon, as they can wield magnetic forces to keep their prey from fleeing. They attack with their sharp, blade-like forelimbs and with precise electrical bolts fired from their magnet-like claws.

entry: POKENAME肩上不仅有额外眼睛细察敌人，还有额外大脑加快思考。每根手指都是强磁铁，足以干扰复杂机器。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's shoulders contain not just additional eyes to watch enemies carefully but also extra brains that help it to think quicker. Its fingers are each powerful magnets that could disrupt complex machines.

entry: POKENAME每条肢体都有强电磁铁，各由自己的脑控制。中央大脑协调其他脑，按需开关磁铁，让它能爬上磁性材料的墙。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has a powerful electromagnet in each limb, each controlled by its own brain. A central brain coordinates the others, turning their magnets on or off as needed and enabling POKENAME to walk up walls made of magnetic material.

entry: POKENAME的电磁脉冲不会破坏设备，而会让它接管近旁的科技装置。受害者称，屏幕上会出现它的眼睛，使人陷入催眠。
author: bigoljax
source: The electromagnetic pulses POKENAME releases doesn't break down technology. Instead, each pulse allows it to take control of any nearby tech. Victims of POKENAME attacks say it forms its eye on their screen, causing a state of mesmerism.

entry: POKENAME常在发电厂旁冥想，吸电维持生命与力量。电越多，活得、战斗得越久；可耗能过量，就会彻底停止运转。
author: cerealjamalt
source: POKENAME is often seen meditating near power plants, absorbing the electricity to sustain its life force and power. The more it has, the longer POKENAME can live and fight, but if it uses too much energy, it will completely shut down.

entry: POKENAME巨角如大磁铁，让钢属性宝可梦极难逃走。若找不到这类猎物，也会挥角砸碎岩石与金属，方便吞食。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's giant horn functions as a massive magnet that ensures Steel-type Pokémon rarely ever escape from it. It can swing its horn to crush rocks and metal to better eat them if it finds no Steel-type Pokémon to prey upon.

entry: POKENAME的花纹让它看着比实际友善。特殊生物磁力能强行抬起小生物，送到身边，整只吞下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's markings make it appear friendlier than it actually is. It possesses a special biological magnetism that lets it forcibly lift and carry smaller creatures closer to it so it can swallow them whole.

entry: POKENAME战斗时以重击与灼热能量束重创敌人。可耗能太大，每次行动后都得充电。
author: sk372
source: In battle, POKENAME can devastate foes with powerful strikes and searing beams of energy. However, its energy consumption is so vast that it needs to recharge after every action.

entry: POKENAME引导电信号，经身上磁铁散出，干扰电子设备，使其故障。一迁入某地，那里的电属性宝可梦也开始举止失常。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME channels electric signals and disperses them through the magnets on its body. This disrupts electronic devices, causing them to malfunction. Once a POKENAME moves into an area, the electric Pokémon there begin to behave erratically.

entry: POKENAME借磁性附肢，能极快地将自己拉向金属物件。倒霉的钢属性宝可梦，则可能被拉到它身旁。
author: metcassette
source: Using their magnetic appendages, POKENAME are capable of pulling themselves toward metallic objects with surprising speed. An unlucky Steel-Type Pokémon may find itself being pulled toward the POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME靠齿轮永不停转，就能为整城供电，曾被考虑用来替代发电厂。可城市规划者后来发现，巨大磁场会干扰大多电子设备。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Once considered as an alternative to power plants, a POKENAME can generate power for an entire city with the perpetual motion of its gears. However, as city planners learned, the immense magnetic field it generates disrupts most electronics.

entry: POKENAME常伪装电工进屋，偷走全部电力与电子设备。
author: a_grain_of_rice
source: POKENAME often disguise themselves as electricians to enter homes and steal all their power and electronics.

entry: POKENAME缎带的磁波能干扰、改变附近电子设备。会借此让它们播放画面与声音，安抚近旁对象。
author: sk372
source: Magnetic waves from POKENAME's ribbons disrupt and alter electronics near it. It uses this to make them play visuals and noises meant to soothe those who are near them.

entry: POKENAME的身体释放极强磁场。传说磁场强大得连空间本身都能扭曲。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body emits an incredibly strong magnetic field. Legends say this field is strong enough to warp space itself.

entry: 据说POKENAME住在一个相较我们世界，物理法则严重扭曲的世界。光是靠近机械，磁干扰就能在短时间内将其撕碎。
author: sk372
source: It is believed POKENAME inhabits a world with vastly distorted physics from our own. Its very presence near machinery causes magnetic interference that can tear the machines apart in a short amount of time.

entry: POKENAME磁力强得能搬动、分离大片陆地。会将废弃工厂区改造成住处，容纳小磁怪朋友们。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's magnetic powers are strong enough to move and separate large chunks of the land. It reshapes abandoned factory districts into homes that can house its Magnemite friends.

entry: POKENAME头顶粉碎器带强磁，一探测到双臂间的物体，就瞬间压碎。废料通常再滚压成金属球，给炮管当弹药。
author: bigoljax
source: The crusher above POKENAME's head has a strong magnetic field, instantly crushing whatever gets detected between its arms. Any scrap that's been crushed usually gets rolled into metallic balls, used as ammo for POKENAME's cannons.

entry: POKENAME控制磁场与刺骨寒霜，以磁力精准操纵冰块，将它们化为精确武器，压制任何敌人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME controls a magnetic field and the powers of bitter frost. It uses its magnetic field to precisely control formations of ice, turning them into precise weapons that dominate against any foes.

entry: POKENAME发出引来钢属性宝可梦的频率，再以强磁困住。金属身体虽带剧毒，制服钢属性猎物时却靠电击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME emits a frequency that lures in Steel-type Pokémon, then traps them using its powerful magnets. Although its metallic body carries potent poison, it relies on its electrical attacks to take down its Steel-type prey.

entry: POKENAME与气象学家一起追踪全球天气。不锈钢身体耐得住热带风暴，资深气象记者退休时常领养一只，纪念共同工作。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME track the weather patterns of the world alongside meteorologists. They are made of stainless steel that will endure tropical storms. Senior weather reporters adopt a POKENAME whenever they retire, commemorating their work together.

entry: POKENAME能将炮管加热到足以熔穿大多数金属。在乡间常被错认成外星人。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are capable of getting their cannons to a high enough heat to melt through most metals. They're usually mistaken for aliens in rural areas.

entry: POKENAME接收信号，得知附近所有宝可梦的资讯，再用来挑选最理想的猎物。
author: tisgabe
source: POKENAME receives signals that allow it to know information on any Pokémon nearby, using that information to select ideal prey.

entry: POKENAME不靠网，倒挂洞顶，用腹部磁力直接吸来宝可梦。危急时仍能吐网，只是通常效果没那么好。
author: thesilverowls
source: Instead of using a web, POKENAME hangs on the ceilings of caves and uses the magnetic energy from its abdomen to drag Pokémon directly to itself. In a pinch, it can still produce webs, but they are rarely as effective.

entry: POKENAME发出的磁性频率干扰电子设备，使其受控。磁铁挥动之间，机器仿佛被附身，拥有自主意识。
author: soup1900
source: The magnetic frequencies POKENAME emits mess with electronics and cause them to be under this Pokémon's control. Waving its magnets around, it makes machines look possessed and have sentience.

entry: POKENAME以磁铁般的爪子，从其他宝可梦或人类机械中抽电。獠牙也如磁铁，方便制服常捕食的钢属性宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their magnet-like claws to siphon electricity from other Pokémon or from human machinery. Their tusks act as magnets that serve them well in conquering the Steel-type Pokémon they oft prey upon.

entry: 可塑的手臂能分开，收集岩石等硬物，留待磁力射出。POKENAME超能力极强，还能将纯能量化成坚固屏障。
author: infinex21
source: Its malleable arms can split apart and collect rocks or other hard objects, which it will later shoot using magnetic force. POKENAME psychic powers are so strong that it can manifest sturdy barriers from pure energy.

entry: POKENAME用略超出人类常用频段的电波交流。无线电爱好者常将它奉为吉祥物，哪怕不慎调进频段就会听得睡着。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME communicate over radio waves just outside the frequencies that people utilize. Radio hobbyists often adopt them as a mascot. This is despite the fact that accidentally tuning into their frequency will put the listener to sleep.

entry: POKENAME彼此摩擦产生静电，将两个身体连在一起。转得够快，甚至能产生自己的电磁场。
author: metcassette
source: The friction between POKENAME conducts static electricity, holding their two bodies together. Depending on how fast the POKENAME is spinning, it can even generate its own electromagnetic field.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时常飘得太高，不慎用磁铁吸住飞行器，有时造成惨重事故。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME frequently levitates too high in the sky while sleeping, accidentally getting stuck to aircraft with its magnets. This sometimes ends in terrible accidents.

entry: 白天，POKENAME四处游荡，发出似乎指向太阳的奇怪电波。头顶螺钉边缘锋利，触之有毒。
author: .jerden
source: During the day, POKENAME wanders around, emitting strange radio waves that seem to be directed towards the sun. The screw on its head has sharp edges and is poisonous to touch.

entry: POKENAME会偷走人们的金属物品，挑选优质材料强化机械身体。凡拿到手的，就绝不打算归还。
author: vaporvenator
source: POKENAME steals metal items from people, seeking quality items to enhance its mechanical body. It has no intention of returning anything it takes.

entry: POKENAME不肯绕路，只加速向前，用钢壳撞穿障碍。天线会闪光，提醒别人自己正接近。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME refuses to turn aside from its path; instead, it speeds forward and uses its steel shell to smash through obstacles. It flashes its antenna to warn others of its approach.

entry: POKENAME战斗时吸收磁能，制造大量毒液。磁力又常将地底大岩蛇吸上来，让它们出地面后困惑不已。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When in battle, POKENAME produces large amounts of poison by absorbing magnetic energy. This magnetic pull often draws Onix from deep underground, confusing them greatly when they emerge above ground.

entry: POKENAME覆着冰冻矿物，接触特殊磁场后化为坚钢。如今自己也能放出类似磁场，混合钢与冰来防身。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME is covered in frozen minerals that became solid steel after it was exposed to a special magnetic field. Now, it wields a similar magnetic field of its own that uses to create mixtures of steel and ice to defend itself with.

entry: 关于POKENAME在山区聚落无故停电时游荡路上的故事很多。事后常有物品被报失，有时连人也失踪。
author: novembermagnus
source: There are many stories of POKENAME wandering the roads of mountain settlements during unexplained blackouts. Several items are usually reported stolen afterwards, with people sometimes reported missing as well.

entry: POKENAME的身体，由各式废金属借强磁场拼合而成。它会用磁场为金属充电，谁一碰，就挨上厉害的电击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is comprised of various pieces of scrap metal held together by a strong magnetic field. It will use this field to imbue the metal with an electric charge that will produce a nasty shock on contact.

entry: POKENAME由远比任何天然材料都耐用的金属构成，操纵周围磁场移动，常令附近电磁紊乱。
author: entomoxie
source: POKENAME are comprised of a metal far more durable than any materials occurring in nature. They move by manipulating magnetic fields around them, often causing electromagnetic distortions in their vicinity.

entry: POKENAME偷走电线里的电力，造成大范围停电。还能给拳头充电，再砸地掀起冲击波。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME can steal electricity from powerlines, causing mass blackouts. They can charge their fists and slam them on the ground, causing shockwaves.

entry: 这只宝可梦的触手由极为坚韧的金属构成，触角还会持续放电，为它们提供保护。也曾有训练家被它意外电伤，送进医院。
author: voiddx01
source: The tentacles of this Pokémon are made of an extremely durable metal and are protected by a constant stream of electricity emitted from its antenna. There are incidents of this Pokémon accidentally electrocuting and hospitalizing their Trainers.

entry: POKENAME身上的蘑菇形似螺钉。紧张时撒出闪亮银粉，一落在金属表面就迸火花。
author: .izik
source: The mushrooms growing from POKENAME's body resemble screws. When stressed, it releases a shimmering silver powder from these mushrooms that sparks upon landing on metal surfaces.

entry: POKENAME体内的派拉斯精准控制动作，外层则由坚不可摧的外星材料保护。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The Paras in POKENAME controls its movements, directing it with precision. It is protected by indestructible alien material.

entry: 靠松掉的弹簧迅速退出战斗。若无法脱身，可能是弹簧机构某部分卡住了。
author: quackquackattack
source: It relies on a Stretchy Spring to make quick exits out of a battle. If it is locked into battle, it could mean that a part of the spring mechanism is jammed.

entry: 有些POKENAME在发电厂中人类无法进入的危险区域工作。可磁吸力太强，常弄坏训练家的自行车。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: Some POKENAME work in dangerous areas of power plants where people cannot go. Due to POKENAME's strong magnetic attraction, it often damages the bikes of Trainers.

entry: POKENAME产生自我维持的电磁场，能在大气中飞行。金属组成里，含有并非来自这颗星球的微量元素。
author: ven0os
source: POKENAME generates a self-sustaining electromagnetic field that enables atmospheric flight. Its metallic composition contains trace elements not native to this planet.

entry: POKENAME在太空漂浮，身体发出奇异电磁信号。科学家相信，它能被用作天然卫星。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME floats around in space, emitting strange electromagnetic signals from its body. Scientists believe POKENAME could be used as a natural satellite.

entry: POKENAME只见于磁场极强之处。全力发出的掘进音波足以震碎钻石，却很少这样做，宁愿直接吃掉这类坚硬物质。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is only found near exceedingly powerful magnetic fields. At full power, its excavating sonic blasts are strong enough to shatter diamond, but it rarely uses that strength, preferring to consume such a durable substance instead.

entry: POKENAME寻找强磁矿床，再用音爆轰开隧道，挖出地下美餐。采石场会借它的本领，高效凿到目标位置。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME searches for highly magnetic mineral deposits, then blasts tunnels with Sonic Boom to uncover its subterranean meal. Quarries use its skills to efficiently bore to their goal.

entry: POKENAME始终遵从训练家的意愿，哪怕伤到自己或别人。某些危险组织便利用这份盲目忠诚犯罪。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME always operates in compliance with the will of its Trainer, even if it hurts itself or other people. Some dangerous organizations exploit this blind loyalty to cause crime.

entry: POKENAME以巨大的伸缩磁拳痛击敌人。天线发出细微电波，扰乱注意，让对方更难闪避。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME pummels its opponents with its large extendable magnet-fists. Its antenna emits subtle radio waves that mess with a foe's concentration, making it harder for them to evade its strikes.

entry: POKENAME天线极先进，能接收、输出脑电信号，读取并改变半径20公里内任何人类或宝可梦的思想。
author: a_grain_of_rice
source: POKENAME's antenna is so advanced that it can receive and output brain electrical signals, allowing it to read and alter the thoughts of any human or Pokémon within a 20-kilometer radius.

entry: POKENAME的怪物外貌让它成为众多漫画中受欢迎的反派。机械手臂极为耐用。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's monstrous appearance makes it a popular antagonist in numerous comic book series. Its mechanical arms are extremely durable.

entry: POKENAME腰带里总别着棘轮扳手，修理坏引擎的手艺高超得出奇。许多机械师比信任自己的学徒更信任它。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME keeps a ratchet tucked into its belt at all times, using it to fine-tune broken-down engines with uncanny skill. Many mechanics trust it more than their own apprentices.

entry: 许多不明飞行物目击，其实是POKENAME夜间飞过天空。它们以触手末端亮光指引前路。
author: bigoljax
source: Many UFO sightings are actually POKENAME flying in the night sky. They use the ends of their tentacles as lights to guide their path.

entry: 小磁怪想合成三合一磁怪，若聚得过多，有时竟会意外塌缩成一副身体。所有大脑汇成一个，让POKENAME比从前更加高效、专注。
author: .fedoraman
source: If an excess of Magnemite gather while trying to form Magneton, they may accidentally collapse into one body. With all of their brains combined into one, POKENAME is far more efficient and focused than it was previously.

entry: POKENAME由三个头组成，其中两个辅助主体。头部分离在外，能让它快速修复自身零件，不必暴露精密电子元件。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is made of three heads, two of which are ancillary to the main body. Having detached heads allows it to quickly repair parts of itself without exposing delicate electronics.

entry: POKENAME向对手喷射磁性黏液。黏液几乎无法除去，让对方再也难以摆脱POKENAME。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME shoots its magnetic slime at opponents. The slime is nearly impossible to get off, and leaves them unable to get away from POKENAME.

entry: 先以水柱轰击敌人，再放电，结合两种力量。磁吸力也常让各式金属杂物黏满背壳。
author: ilazerheart
source: It blasts enemies with jets of water before zapping them with electricity, the two elements working in tandem. Random metal objects are often stuck to its shell thanks to its magnetic pull.

entry: POKENAME用磁力托住形似小磁怪的催眠金属球。球体散出特殊磁波，对催眠钢属性宝可梦极有效。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses magnetism to hold a hypnotic metal orb resembling Magnemite. The orb radiates a special magnetic wave that is extremely effective at hypnotizing Steel-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME受威胁时，会用伸缩舌头防身。舌上毒唾液能使敌人晕眩。
author: sleepyman0731
source: POKENAME will defend themselves with an extensible tongue when threatened. Their tongue contains a poisonous saliva that stuns foes.

entry: 体型变小、重量变轻，让它稍微灵活了一些。唾液如今带有麻痹作用，碰到舌头还会遭到电击。
author: cascadeguy
source: It is slightly more mobile due to its reduced weight and size. Its saliva now contains a paralyzing effect, shocking anything that touches its tongue.

entry: POKENAME舌头完全展开，长得足以绕小型厢式车数圈。能灵巧地同时抓住多只猎物，再一起卷来。
author: .izik
source: When fully unfurled, POKENAME's tongue is long enough to wrap around a minivan multiple times. It uses this to capture multiple prey at once, reeling them in with impressive dexterity.

entry: POKENAME表达亲近时，会以令人担心的速度冲向训练家，用长舌裹住对方，缓住落地冲击。对其他宝可梦也这样做，可对方未必懂，常想反击。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: To show affection, POKENAME runs towards its Trainer at worrying speeds, bracing the landing by curling them up in its long tongue. It even does this to other Pokémon, which are not always aware of this behaviour and try to fight back.

entry: POKENAME用藤蔓扯下树上的巧可果，果子一落，等候多时的舌头就迅速卷起。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its vines to pull down Occa Berries from trees. Dropped fruit is quickly scooped up by its ever-waiting tongue.

entry: 构成POKENAME身体的舌头灵巧如人手，碰到什么就尝出什么。若表面近期没打扫，便拒绝在上面表演默剧。
author: .jerden
source: The tongues that POKENAME's body is made of are as dexterous as human hands, and taste everything they touch. It will refuse to perform pantomime on any surface that has not recently been cleaned.

entry: 身体几乎全是柔韧舌头，大得再也缩不回嘴。表演默剧时，观众必须站远，免得被口水溅到。
author: .jerden
source: Its body almost entirely consists of flexible tongues, too large to ever retract inside its mouth. When it mimes, the audience must distance themselves to avoid being splashed with saliva.

entry: 舌头巨大又有弹性，唾液浓稠极黏。常用舌头将食物聚成一大团，再拉进嘴里。
author: infinex21
source: Its tongue is large and stretchy and its saliva is very thick and sticky. It often uses its tongue to gather foods in a large clump and pull them into its mouth.

entry: POKENAME舌头与尾巴都柔韧、能伸缩，又极灵巧，可以各自独立做事。虽能浮空，却通常用屁股弹跳着走。
author: oddwalls
source: Both its tongue and its tail are flexible, extensible, and dexterous, allowing POKENAME to perform tasks with each independently. Though capable of floating, POKENAME usually bounces along on its bottom.

entry: POKENAME容易兴奋，见到认定的朋友便挥手奔去。可常太激动咬到舌头，疼得哭上几分钟。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are quite excitable, running towards any creature they deem a friend while flapping their arms. In this excitement, they are prone to biting their tongue, spending a few minutes crying in pain.

entry: POKENAME喜欢舌上有水的感觉，游泳时便一直伸着，因此常不慎舔到泥巴。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME enjoy the water on their tongue and will swim with it hanging out of their mouths. This makes them prone to accidentally licking mud.

entry: POKENAME长舌卷在体内，可卷好后仍会露出一截。最长能达一米，很适合伸进地洞，拉出虫属性宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a long tongue that it keeps coiled inside its body, though a part of it remains sticking out even when coiled. This tongue can reach a meter in length, perfect for sticking into burrows to pull out Bug-type Pokémon.

entry: 它在洞里快速飞行，用长舌扫舔地面，尽可能捡起食物，再把石头等杂物吐掉。
author: chorb33
source: It flies quickly through caves and licks the ground with its long tongue to pick up as much food as possible. It spits out stones and similar items.

entry: POKENAME总爱舔训练家，可一点也不像小约克那样可爱，反倒让人毛骨悚然。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME lick their Trainers all the time. Instead of it being cute, like with Lillipup, it just seems creepy.

entry: POKENAME用长舌摘高枝上的蕉香果，喜爱甜味。吃了，羊毛就泛出柔和粉色，越吃颜色越深。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its long tongue to pluck Nanab Berries from high branches, favoring their sweet flavor. Consuming them causes its wool to take on a soft pink hue, which intensifies as it eats more.

entry: POKENAME舌头敏感，受不了陈放食物的味道。多数拒吃干果、肉干、奶酪等耐储食物，只有让它自己狩猎，才能确保肯吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have sensitive tongues that cannot stand the taste of aged foods, so many refuse to eat common non-perishable goods like dried fruit, jerky, or cheese. Sending them to hunt for their own food is the only certain way to ensure they eat.

entry: POKENAME让电流通过唾液，舌上便噼啪闪着小火花。会用来电落树果，再迫不及待地舔食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME channels electricity through its saliva, creating tiny sparks that crackle along its tongue. It uses this ability to shock fruit from trees before eagerly lapping them up.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME用舌头缠住松枝，固定身体，免得被强风吹走。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME wraps its tongue around pine branches to anchor itself. This prevents it from being blown away by strong winds.

entry: POKENAME在强风中以黏舌固定在桦树上，喜欢随微风摆动，吸入空气中的孢子当点心。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its sticky tongue to anchor itself to birch trees during strong windstorms. It enjoys swaying in the breeze, inhaling airborne spores as a snack.

entry: POKENAME舌头极敏感，连最细微的滋味与原料痕迹都能辨出。有特定过敏问题的训练家，常带它替食物安全把关。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's hyper-sensitive tongue can pick up even the smallest trace of flavors and ingredients. Trainers with specific allergies often keep POKENAME close, as the Pokémon can ensure their food is safe.

entry: POKENAME尝过一种味道，就能分泌味道完全相同、可安全食用的凝胶。有些猎奇糖果会与它合作，专做令人不快的怪味。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Once POKENAME has tasted a flavor, it is able to excrete a gel that tastes exactly the same and is safe to eat. Some novelty confectionery is made in conjunction with POKENAME, focusing on unpleasant flavors.

entry: POKENAME脸朝下漂在湖上，用长舌捕捉水面下毫无防备的角金鱼等猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats face-down on lakes, using its long tongue to snatch unsuspecting prey like Goldeen from beneath the water's surface.

entry: POKENAME动作平静，靠近时让许多训练家摸不准意图。有时只是想吃东西，礼貌等着；有时却用黏舌扯训练家的头发。
author: bobosmith01
source: Many Trainers have noted how difficult it is to read an approaching POKENAME's intentions thanks to its calm movements. Sometimes, it merely wants food and will politely wait. Other times, it uses its sticky tongue to pull at the Trainer's hair.

entry: POKENAME极亲人，用舔表达爱意。若有宝可梦威胁亲近者，就以柔韧长舌抓来，拖进巨颚，猛烈咬压。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are incredibly affectionate and express this by licking. If a Pokémon threatens someone they are close to, POKENAME will grab it with its flexible tongue and pull it into its jaws to bite it with crushing force.

entry: POKENAME味觉出众，能辨出海水化学成分的差异，判断食物与捕食者的位置，借此辨路。唾液有毒，也能用舌头自卫。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME has an exceptional sense of taste, navigating the oceans by sensing the differences in water chemistry that tell it if there's food or a predator around. Their saliva has a toxic element, letting them defend themselves with their tongues.

entry: POKENAME以多条舌头传递、品尝树果。只有最美味的才会送入壳中，酿成树果汁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME examines berries by passing them around on its multiple tongues. Only the tastiest of berries will be taken inside its shell to be turned into berry juice.

entry: POKENAME极爱甜食，常袭击糖果店。打发它们倒不难，只要抓住背上的锥形物提起来就行。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME have quite the sweet tooth, usually seen raiding candy stores. They're easily disposed of, just by lifting them up by the cones on their backs.

entry: POKENAME以长舌抓握物品。既能缠住攻击者将其制服，也能绕住近旁物件，将自己拉过去，比游泳更快。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's long tongue is used for grappling objects. It can be used to constrict around and subdue aggressors or wrap around nearby items and pull itself closer at a faster pace than swimming.

entry: 只要时间够久，唾液几乎什么都能溶。训练家得留意POKENAME偷舔电子设备，想吃到里面美味的数据。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: Given enough time, its saliva can dissolve almost any material. Trainers with a POKENAME must keep an eye out for it furtively licking their electronic devices, hoping to get at the tasty data inside.

entry: POKENAME舌上的滑唾液，让它能像蛇一样滑行。唾液剧毒，先麻痹猎物，再缠住，轻松吃掉。
author: .izik
source: The slick saliva coating POKENAME's tongue allows it to slither in a serpentine-like fashion. This saliva is highly toxic, paralyzing prey before it coils around them for an easy meal.

entry: POKENAME灵敏的舌头能发现菜肴中的过敏原痕迹。也能接受训练，在医疗紧急情况中给予肾上腺素。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have sensitive tongues that allow them to detect traces of allergens in a dish. POKENAME can also be trained to administer epinephrine in the event of a medical emergency.

entry: POKENAME长舌缠满身体，握着一大颗充满魔法的糖。若请你尝，绝别答应；糖已被诅咒，傻到舔一口就会招来咒厄。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tongue wraps all around its body and holds onto a large sweet brimming with magic. One must never accept if offered a taste, for the object is cursed and will pass a hex onto those foolish enough to lick.

entry: 舔净魔法糖果的POKENAME格外危险，因为舌头已吸收全部魔力。如今所有咒语都由舌头施展，糖果只剩强力重锤的用途。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME that have licked their magical treat clean are particularly dangerous, as their tongue has now absorbed all the magic. Their tongue now casts all the spells, the candy now reduced to a potent bludgeoning tool.

entry: POKENAME的舌头与尾尖，其实是同一种器官的两个独立部分。因此尾巴能尝味，舌头也能放雷电。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tongue and the tip of its tail are actually two separate instances of the same organ. As such, it can taste things with its tail and shoot lightning bolts from its tongue.

entry: POKENAME的舌长，曾记录到堪比阿柏怪的尾巴。也曾被看见为了好玩，沿山坡滚下。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Their tongue have been recorded to be as long as the tail of an Arbok. POKENAME have also been recorded rolling down hills for fun.

entry: POKENAME以粗藤摇橙橙果树，自己在下方等。若没果子落下，就气得用长舌拍打树干。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its thick vines to shake Oran Berry trees while it waits below. If no berries fall out, it angrily slaps the trunk with its long tongue.

entry: 它先用唾液令猎物动弹不得，再以前方的舌头吸血。背上那对翅膀，其实也是舌头。
author: soup1900
source: It uses its saliva to immobilize its prey before slurping their blood with its front tongue. Its wings are actually the tongues that are on its back.

entry: POKENAME潜入水中，头上敏感的舌头便不断向脑传味觉信号。因此，它对游泳的水域挑剔得很。
author: tuskaninny
source: When submerged in water, the sensitive tongues atop POKENAME's head will constantly transmit gustatory signals to its brain. As a result, POKENAME are incredibly picky about the bodies of water in which they swim.

entry: POKENAME伸舌缠敌人，拉近后痛打，使其无法逃脱。战后再用唾液将头发抹回原位。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME extend their tongues to wrap around opponents and pull them in closer before pummeling them while they're unable to escape. After battles, POKENAME use their saliva to help slick their hair back into place.

entry: POKENAME身体与舌头能分别变色，靠特定配色组合，向近旁同类无声传讯。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can change its body's color and that of its tongue separately. Certain color combinations are used as a way to send silent messages to other POKENAME nearby.

entry: POKENAME身体由透明能量构成，伸出的舌头却明显是实体。人们认为，只要愿意，舌头几乎能无限伸长。
author: sk372
source: Although POKENAME's body is made of transparent energy, the tongue it extends stands out for being decidedly physical in nature. It is believed that it could feasibly stretch its tongue out almost infinitely if it chose to.

entry: POKENAME两张嘴各有味蕾与喜好。大嘴摄取所需的大部分养分，小嘴则负责最爱的含糖甜食。
author: partypooperrex
source: POKENAME has two mouths, each with its own set of taste buds and preferences. The larger mouth eats the majority of its needed nutrients, while the smaller mouth is for its preferred type of food: sugary sweets.

entry: POKENAME舌头长得能躺在树下采果。舌肌强劲，有时不慎连整根树枝也拉下，战斗时也是有力武器。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's tongue is so long that it can gather fruit from trees while POKENAME lies on the ground below. The muscles of its tongue are so strong that POKENAME sometimes pulls down entire branches by accident, giving it a powerful weapon in combat.

entry: 近距离研究的科学家发现，POKENAME上方双眼是假的，只有上方嘴内的一只眼能看见。做过许多实验，仍不知吃的东西去了哪里。
author: heal_fire
source: The scientist that have studied this Pokémon up close noticed that POKENAME's upper eyes are fake, and only the one inside its upper mouth can see. Despite many experiments, no one knows where the things it eats disappear to.

entry: 厨艺界曾奉POKENAME为食物守护神。传说备好它中意的菜，便能为一家带来长久好运。
author: .izik
source: Culinarians once revered POKENAME as a patron deity of food. Legends claim preparing a favored dish could bring lasting fortune to one's family.

entry: POKENAME的壳由各式甜食组成，许多宝可梦来吃。可它自己想伸舌尝一口，却从来办不到。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME's shell is comprised of all manner of sweets, which many Pokémon feast upon. POKENAME try to get a taste with their tongue, but never succeed.

entry: POKENAME的味觉，是世间最讲究的几种之一。若训练家端出合它口味的菜，便会受赐福，今后所尝的每一道菜，都美妙无比。
author: teatedtiten
source: POKENAME has one of the most distinguished taste of all beings. If a Trainer creates a dish which pleases its tongue, they will be blessed in having every dish taste spectacular.

entry: 舌刃靠的不是切割，而是分泌的腐蚀性唾液伤敌。还能缠住对手，使皮肤麻木。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Its tongue blade deals damage not through cutting, but the corrosive saliva it produces. It also wraps around opponents and numbs their skin.

entry: POKENAME敏捷，住在广阔森林的树上。巨大抓握舌既能在枝间荡行，也能重击敌人，唾液还可通电，将对手麻痹。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an agile creature that dwells in the trees of vast forests. Its huge prehensile tongue is not only used to swing from branch to branch, but also to deliver powerful blows to its enemies. It can electrify its saliva to paralyze its foes.

entry: 颈部白色“缎带”其实是特殊材料，散发舒缓而令人陶醉的香气。连它自己也常忍不住想嚼，还会送出小片，表示友谊。
author: infinex21
source: The white "ribbons" around its neck are actually a special material that exudes a calming and intoxicating aroma. Even this Pokémon is often tempted to chew on this material and will offer pieces of it to others as a token of friendship.

entry: 舌头强劲，能像弹簧一样卷起，让它弹跳前行。据说当POKENAME能将自己弹进轨道时，就会升华成更高的形态。
author: genesisparallax
source: It bounces on its powerful tongue which can coil up like a spring. It's said a POKENAME ascends to a higher form when it can launch itself into orbit.

entry: POKENAME唾液能显著延缓食物变质。可数量稀少，这份天然防腐剂仍无法充分利用。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME's saliva has a unique property where it considerably slows the aging process of foodstuffs. Unfortunately, due to POKENAME's rarity, this natural preservative cannot be utilized fully.

entry: POKENAME只要有一条舌头开始发光，周围空间便会扭曲。光越强，扭曲越严重。
author: .izik
source: Should any of POKENAME's tongues begin to glow, space will distort and warp in the surrounding area. The severity of this distortion depends on the intensity of the glow.

entry: 在原本世界尝遍一切后，POKENAME来到我们的现实，寻找新的滋味。
author: empty_set
source: After having tasted absolutely everything in its own plane of existence, POKENAME traveled to our reality in search of new flavors to experience.

entry: POKENAME从背上炮管伸出极长舌头。舔敌人就能分析其身体，方便调整自身，更好地应战。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME extends a massively long tongue from the cannon barrel on its back. Licking a foe provides it with an analysis of their body, allowing POKENAME to better configure itself to fight against them.

entry: POKENAME颇爱惹事，谁犯哪怕小错，都要被嘲弄。舌头不断生新细胞伸长，因此有人推测，足以绕世界数圈。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: POKENAME is quite a bit of a troublemaker, and will make a mockery out of anyone making even the slightest mistake. Because its tongue constantly generates new cells to extend, it is theorized to be able to wrap around the world multiple times.

entry: POKENAME舔洞壁，留下带电导电的唾液，传播电脉冲。察觉附近动静，就让铺在唾液之间的网通电，充作警报。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME licks cave walls to leave behind a charged, conductive saliva that spreads electrical pulses. If it senses movement nearby, it electrifies the webbing it has laid out between the saliva to act as an alarm system.

entry: 两只POKENAME相斗，会把长舌当鞭，舌尖甩得超过音速。看似骇人的獠牙，倒不是用来打架，而是砍树，好够着高枝上的食物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: When two POKENAME fight, they use their immensely long tongues as whips, moving the tips at supersonic speeds. Their formidable-looking tusks are used to cut down trees rather than for fighting, letting them access food high in the branches.

entry: POKENAME以坚韧长舌钓铁炮鱼、弱丁鱼等鱼宝可梦。若大嘴鸥来捕猎，便用舌头将自己弹进海里。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME use their durable tongues to fish for fish Pokémon such as Remoraid and Wishiwashi. If Pelippers try to hunt them, POKENAME use their tongues to spring themselves into the ocean.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀对周围的一切都极其敏感。散出的粉末会引起严重瘙痒与皮疹。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's wings are very sensitive to every aspect of their surroundings The powder it spreads causes severe itching and rashes.

entry: POKENAME看不清，靠舔周围来了解身处何地。虽然口水多得很，纯白毛发仍让上流人士争相追捧。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Being unable to see well, POKENAME lick their environment in order to get an understanding of where they are. Despite the excess slobber, POKENAME are highly coveted by the upper class for their pure-white fur.

entry: POKENAME躺在树下，偶尔舔树干。唾液慢慢溶树皮，几乎不必费力，就得到所需全部养分。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will lie beneath trees, occasionally licking the trunk. Its saliva slowly dissolves the bark, providing POKENAME with all the nutrients it needs with minimal exertion.

entry: POKENAME四处疾奔，用长舌舔遇见的每件物品。味道若合意便继续舔，分泌的酶能慢慢溶解木材、金属，甚至岩石。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME rushes around, licking every object it encounters with its long tongue. If it likes the taste, it will continue licking, secreting enzymes that can slowly dissolve wood, metal, and even rock.

entry: POKENAME虽然模样不讨喜，味觉却极为敏锐，因此常成为美食家的伙伴。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite their unpleasant appearance, POKENAME are known to be the partners of food connoisseurs due to their very sensitive sense of taste.

entry: POKENAME油性唾液让齿轮高效运转。舔舐机械还能防止生锈，维修时出乎意料地有用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's oily saliva allows its own gears to move with incredible efficiency. By licking machinery, it prevents rust buildup, making it surprisingly useful in mechanical repairs.

entry: POKENAME用大舌缠住大型宝可梦的肢体，吸取静电。流下的口水，也带着强烈电击。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME uses its large tongue to wrap around the limbs of larger Pokémon, absorbing static electricity from them. Its drool has an intense shock.

entry: POKENAME用獠牙掘开虫宝可梦的群居巢穴，伸长黏舌吸蜜。可皮肤柔软，挨不住怒虫反击，每处都待不了太久。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME uses its tusks to dig into Bug-type Pokémon colonies, feeding on the honey within with its long sticky tongue. It usually can't stay long at any colony as its hide is soft, leaving it vulnerable to retaliation from the angry bugs.

entry: POKENAME用强壮獠牙迎战对手，再伸长舌，缠住对方的牙，免遭反击。双方打起来，常搅得乱七八糟。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME uses its powerful tusks to fight with rivals, its long tongue used to try and grapple the tusks of its opponents and prevent a counter-attack. Fights between the Pokémon are often messy as a result.

entry: POKENAME贪吃得无可救药，靠近的东西都要吞下。传言连登山客失踪，也与它有关。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is an absolute glutton that eats anything that even comes close. Rumor has it that it is even responsible for the disappearance of hikers.

entry: POKENAME被放入野外后，已成了常见害兽。它常用舌头卷住旅人的腿，将对方绊倒。
author: forbiddenbread
source: Since POKENAME's introduction to the wild, it has become a common pest. It will often grab travellers' legs with its tongue, making them fall over.

entry: POKENAME颚力虽弱，致命程度却不可小觑。长舌缠住油轮，只需几滴腐蚀唾液，就能轻松将船压成一团废铁。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: Although they lack jaw strength, POKENAME's lethality is not to be underestimated. They can wrap their tongue around an oil tanker and effortlessly crush it into a ball of scrap metal with only a few drops of their corrosive saliva.

entry: 体育赛事现场丢食物，POKENAME是首要原因。边欢呼边悄悄挪近小吃摊，再伸舌尽可能多地卷走食物。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are the leading cause of stolen food at sports games. As they cheer, POKENAME slowly sidle to refreshment stands before using their tongue to swipe as much food as possible.

entry: POKENAME将长舌绕在身上，在花田舞动时，舔取甘甜的花蜜。不过，小型虫类宝可梦若靠它的花太近，它也一样乐意吸来吃。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME wraps its long tongue around its body, allowing it to lick up sweet nectar as it dances through the flower fields. However, it is just as content to slurp up small Bug Pokémon if they get too close to its flowers.

entry: POKENAME没有利牙，看似无害，放松警惕却很危险。舌头伸得比肉眼还快，一下就套住猎物，拉入巨口。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's lack of sharp teeth may make it look harmless, but those who let their guard down do so at their peril. It can extend its tongue faster than the human eye can see to lasso prey into its maw.

entry: POKENAME身体黏液相对无害，舌上唾液却大不相同。舔一下，几秒就能溶衣服，让裸露皮肤留下酸蚀般的痛苦灼伤。
author: sk372
source: Although the slime from POKENAME's body is relatively harmless, the saliva from its tongue is decidedly less so. A single lick could dissolve clothes in seconds and leave painful acid-like burns on exposed skin.

entry: POKENAME以巨舌探进虫巢吃蜜。可有时舌头卡住，便会拼命扑腾，想挣脱出来。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its massive tongue to reach into insect nests to eat the honey inside. However, it sometimes gets its tongue stuck in the nests and will flail around violently to get it off.

entry: POKENAME见什么都爱舔一舔，表示亲近。它们似乎只需尝尝周围，就能追踪任何目标。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME love to lick whatever they find as a show of affection. They seem to be able to track anything just by tasting its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME藏在海滩附近浅海底。巨舌既狩猎、防身，也放超能力波动，察觉更强宝可梦接近，及时躲藏避战。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME hides in shallow seabeds near beaches. Its massive tongue helps it hunt, defend itself, and emit psychic waves that let it sense stronger Pokémon approaching, allowing it to hide and avoid battle.

entry: POKENAME以舌缠树，用力摇到果实掉落。腐蚀唾液会在触树之处，留下一圈环痕。
author: oddwalls
source: To feed, POKENAME wraps its tongue around a tree and shakes the tree until it drops fruit. POKENAME's corrosive saliva leaves a ring where it contacted the tree.

entry: POKENAME长出的鳞片质地像瓷器，常被当盘子用。有些咖啡馆让它住下，既能取新盘，也让它吃剩食。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The scales POKENAME grow are similar in quality to porcelain, leading to them being used as plates. Some cafés have a POKENAME that lives there, where fresh plates can be harvested, and POKENAME can devour food scraps.

entry: POKENAME舔去毛上的毒粉，在舌头覆一层黏浆，再缠遍全身，高速滚向食物与猎物，停下才吃。
author: pokepower
source: POKENAME lick the toxic dust off its fur to coat its tongue in a sticky goo. It then wraps its tongue around its entire body and rolls into food and prey at high speed, devouring them once it stops.

entry: POKENAME舌头极热，常用于战斗。预知未来的能力却不用来抢占战机，反而拿去找最美味的食物。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's tongue is extremely hot, so it uses it while in combat. Instead of using its ability to see into the future to gain an upper hand in battle, it uses it to find where the best foods are.

entry: POKENAME是出众射手，用舌掷飞镖，隔着整个球场也能精准命中。不狩猎、不练投掷时，便把舌头绕身保暖。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are remarkable marksmen and can accurately fling darts with their tongue across a football field. When they are not hunting or practicing their throwing technique, they wrap their tongue around their body to keep warm.

entry: 起初人们以为POKENAME舌头覆盖的身体能产大量温水。深入研究才发现，其实是在排出大量多余唾液。
author: sk372
source: At first glance, it was thought that POKENAME produced large amounts of warm water from its tongue-covered body, until further research revealed it was actually expelling large amounts of excess saliva.

entry: 不断舔遍全身保湿，却让翅膀保持干燥。清晨路灯若覆着毒口水，就说明POKENAME前夜曾在那里吃虫。
author: pokepower
source: It constantly licks its entire body to keep it moist, but keeps its wings dry. Streetlamps covered in toxic drool in the morning are a sure sign POKENAME were feasting on bugs there the night before.

entry: 主要吃甜食，尤其爱冰淇淋。冰淇淋车与店的主人深受困扰，因为它会冲破地板，偷走存货。
author: hophoppip
source: It feeds primarily on sweet foods, with a particular preference for ice cream. Owners of ice cream trucks and parlors are plagued by this Pokémon, which will burst through the floor to steal their supply.

entry: 以巨舌梳理自己，让身体黏滑得惊人。可研究已证实，这样根本洗不干净。
author: mary_the_jane
source: Its body is incredibly slimy due to its grooming itself with its massive tongue. However, it has been proven that this does nothing to clean itself.

entry: POKENAME忠诚尽责，却必须按时喂饱。一旦饿着，POKENAME那条强有力的舌头，便能闹得一片狼藉。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is incredibly loyal and dutiful, but needs to be fed regularly. If it goes hungry, POKENAME can make a big mess with its strong tongue.

entry: POKENAME看着单纯无害，可几米大的物件或生物，也能被它用舌卷住，轻松吞下。因此，有些组织会请它守卫。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME may appear harmless and simple, but it can easily grasp and devour things and creatures several meters in size with its tongue. For this reason, some organizations use it as a guard.

entry: POKENAME是受欢迎的糖霜吉祥物，开朗模样让孩子开心。用勺舀糖霜舀到手酸，再用超能力送进嘴里，一点也不剩。
author: oejoeboy33
source: POKENAME serves as a popular frosting mascot, delighting children with its cheerful appearance. It scoops icing with its spoons until its arms tire, then uses psychic power to pull more into its mouth, ensuring no icing goes uneaten.

entry: POKENAME是超市的麻烦，偶尔闯进去尽量多吃。光舌头就能撞凹车，只好请熟练训练家来帮忙。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are nuisances to supermarkets, occasionally breaking in to eat as much food as they can. Skilled Trainers must be called in to help, as POKENAME's tongue alone can dent a car.

entry: POKENAME协助蜜酒厂酿高品质蜜酒，亲自尝味，确保品质一致。成功的一批酿好，还会与酿酒人同饮庆祝。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME work alongside mead breweries to produce high-quality mead, which they taste to ensure consistency. They are known to celebrate successful batches by drinking alongside brewers.

entry: 蜜酒酿者会培育POKENAME群体，请它判断酒是否过苦。与其他植物种类不同，它更爱蜜酒，胜过蜂蜜。
author: quackquackattack
source: Mead brewers cultivate POKENAME colonies to help them determine whether batches are too bitter. POKENAME are known to prefer mead over honey, unlike other plant species.

entry: POKENAME唾液带甜香，将虫引向大嘴。只要飞近，舌头就会弹出，抓住新的一餐，拖回口中。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's saliva has a sweet scent that draws insects closer to its gaping maw. Once anything flies nearby, its tongue shoots out and grabs up its new meal and drags it back into its mouth.

entry: POKENAME远游海洋，寻找新奇异域食物。每条舌头的口味都不同。
author: amityblamity
source: POKENAME travels throughout the far reaches of oceanic waters, seeking new and exotic food. Each of its tongues has a different preference in taste.

entry: POKENAME把奇长的舌头垂在水边，等没防备的宝可梦咬住，再卷回来吃。可它反应实在太慢，食物常常溜走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feeds by using its extraordinarily long tongue as a lure at the water's edge, waiting for unsuspecting Pokémon to bite it so it can reel the food in. Unfortunately, it has incredibly slow reaction times and often lets its food get away.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴撞树，震落树果与鸟巢。背上的钻头，也很适合敲开硬坚果。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME bang their tails against trees to knock down berries and nests. The drills on their backs are well-suited for cracking open hard nuts.

entry: 前腿如风镐，将力量送入地下，翻动、震荡前方地面。钻角哪怕只微微开始转，也代表它将冲锋，试图刺穿前方一切。
author: infinex21
source: Its front legs can direct physical force into the ground like jackhammers to churn and shake the ground ahead of it. When its drill horn starts to spin even a little, it is a sign that it is about to charge and attempt to impale whatever is ahead.

entry: POKENAME要吃矿物与水果才能健康。白天钻地找石头，夜里用尾巴捣碎水果。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME needs minerals and fruit to stay healthy. During the day it drills into the ground for stone, and at night it pulverizes fruit with its tail.

entry: 爱玩的宝可梦，常追打自己或同伴的圆尾巴。开心时，两根钻头般的角转得飞快，可连一片水果也刺不穿。
author: infinex21
source: These playful Pokémon have a habit of trying to chase and attack their own round tails or each other's tails. When they are happy, their two drill-like horns spin quickly. Their horns cannot even puncture a piece of fruit.

entry: POKENAME虽身形如此，尾巴一挥却足以破坏重型机械。用钻角开出的山间小隧道，以难以通行闻名。
author: infinex21
source: Despite their size, POKENAME pack enough power within them to wreck heavy machinery with just one swing of their tails. Using their drill horns, they create small tunnels in mountains that are infamously difficult to navigate.

entry: POKENAME猛拍台面，制造地震波，能量沿顶上固定的圆盘共振。再高速旋转圆盘，控制扬声器，从远处攻击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME generate seismic waves by slamming their hands into their tables, the resulting energy resonating along the discs secured to the top. They direct their speakers by rapidly spinning their discs, allowing them to attack from a distance.

entry: 成群POKENAME出没峡谷与峭壁，用长角钻岩，取出矿物。极易烦躁，任何近旁生物都会攻击，不论大小。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME swarms can be found in canyons and cliffs, drilling rocks with their long horns to extract minerals. Easily agitated, they will attack any nearby creature regardless of size.

entry: POKENAME用3根角钻岩，留下独特领地标记。古人知道，看见这些痕迹就表示近旁有淡水，常藏在地下含水层。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME marks its territory in a very distinctive way by drilling its 3 horns into rock. Ancient peoples knew that spotting these marks meant that fresh water was nearby, often in aquifers underground.

entry: POKENAME住在沙漠绿洲或泥泞处，常埋进泥里，深到头冠鼻孔处，以便降温。头冠由致密骨骼构成，战斗时也能当重锤。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are found in deserts around oases or muddy areas, often buried up to the nostrils on their crown in the muck to keep cool. POKENAME's crown is made of dense bone, allowing them to use it as a bludgeon in battle.

entry: POKENAME迅速旋耳成钻，头朝下钻地。想转向时先伸前掌停住，再换尾巴旋转。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME rapidly rotate their ears into drills before diving into the ground head-first. If they need to change direction, they extend their front paws to stop themselves before rotating their tails instead.

entry: POKENAME把头探进岩下，挑到空中，再以旋转钻头接住，碎片四射。能将岩石打成食块，也能阻止捕食者靠近。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME dig their heads beneath rocks, hurling them in the air before catching them on their spinning drill, sending shrapnel in all directions. They do so to break rocks into edible chunks, though this also works to keep predators at bay.

entry: 形状像代表“岩石”或“坚硬”的古代符号。POKENAME狂热地用钻角在洞壁刻怪文，若在此时打扰，就会气得失控。
author: ludacriswell
source: This Pokémon is shaped like an ancient symbol meaning "ROCK" or "HARDNESS". POKENAME fanatically use their drill-like horns to carve bizarre glyphs on cave walls. Disturbing them during this process causes POKENAME to become uncontrollably irate.

entry: POKENAME在山侧挖长隧道，靠滚动赶路。冲下斜坡若快撞上东西，就爆炸清路。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME digs long tunnels through mountainsides and rolls through them to travel. If it is about to run into something while barrelling down a ramp, it explodes to clear the way.

entry: 记录曾提到一只格外勇敢的POKENAME，在大规模领地冲突中任副将。如今同类每次作战，仍仿效它的坚定忠诚与严明纪律。
author: jaminmcready
source: Records speak of one particularly bold POKENAME who served as a lieutenant during a great territorial clash. Even now, others of its kind mimic its fierce loyalty and unshakable discipline in every fight.

entry: 钻头般的喙能引导气流，帮助高速前进。POKENAME以钻喙挖地，寻找穴居猎物，有时也捕食岩石属性宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: Its drill-like beak allows it to effectively create a slipstream for itself; as a result, it can achieve high speeds. POKENAME digs for burrowed prey using its drill beak, though it will also use it to prey upon some Rock-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME喜欢把小个头的小鱼弹射向目标，可小鱼们觉得，该拿去扔的，明明是独角犀牛一系与铁炮鱼融合成的小家伙。
author: funkytomate
source: POKENAME like to catapult little Georaid at their targets, but the Georaid are of the opinion that it should be throwing little Rhyraid instead.

entry: 身体坚韧如钨，角却比钻石还硬，转得足以穿过大多数材料。脚爪能抓住体形三倍于自己的巨石，甚至带上高空。
author: infinex21
source: Its body is as tough as tungsten, though its horn is tougher than diamond and can spin fast enough to penetrate most materials. Its talons are strong enough to grip a boulder thrice its size and it can even carry them high into the sky.

entry: POKENAME钻头般的颈与角一同旋转，总转速能达每分钟5,000转。一记啄钻，就能钻穿最远80米实心岩石。
author: staghorn
source: A POKENAME's drill-like neck and horn can reach a combined speed of 5,000 rpm when spinning in tandem. It can burrow up to 80 meters through solid stone with a single Drill Peck.

entry: POKENAME用巨大的钻角挖出蜿蜒隧道，既可伏击毫无防备的目标，也通回自己的巢。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME digs winding tunnels with its large drill-like horn. These tunnels allow for ambushes on unsuspecting targets and lead back to its den.

entry: POKENAME用额上钻角在山边掘地，寻找最软的土吃。较小的副角能射出自卫，发射后很快便会再生。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the drill-horn on its forehead to burrow into the ground near mountains in search of the softest soil to consume. The smaller secondary horn can be fired as a projectile in self-defense, growing back shortly after launching.

entry: POKENAME三个钻头全开，几分钟就能将整山化成碎石。岩甲能抗近乎所有攻击，连爆炸也几乎不留划痕。
author: sk372
source: With all three of its drills active, POKENAME can reduce an entire mountain to rubble in minutes. Its stony armor is resilient to nearly all attacks, able to endure explosions with nary a scratch.

entry: POKENAME掌孔里至少留着一颗剧毒宝珠，从远处射向追踪的猎物，将其削弱。身体则把宝珠生成的毒素化为疗伤液。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME always keeps at least one Toxic Orb within the holes in its palms. It launches them from afar at prey it stalks to weaken them while its body converts the toxins the orb creates into healing fluids for itself.

entry: POKENAME用强臂牢牢固定地面，再像风镐般以中央角攻击。獠牙还能旋转，钩住敌人，不让逃脱。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses its powerful arms to firmly anchor itself to the ground before attacking with its central horn like a jackhammer. It can rotate its tusks to hook around foes and prevent them from escaping.

entry: POKENAME脸上的钻头若卡住，身体其余部分便反过来转。通常会把肢体甩散，可无论飞多远，总能回到身上。
author: .izik
source: Should the drill on POKENAME's face become stuck on a surface, the rest of its body rotates instead. This usually dislodges its limbs, which always seem to find their way back to its body no matter how far they are flung.

entry: POKENAME靠肌肉从掌孔射石，赶走一切可能伤害家园丛林的对象。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME use its muscles to shoot rocks from the holes in its palms. This is to ward off anyone or anything that may be harming its home jungle.

entry: POKENAME上身虽覆重甲，身手却出奇敏捷。踢击速度最高200英里每小时，以沉重甲躯作配重，加强每一下的力道。
author: ambrosia04
source: Despite the heavy armor covering its upper body, POKENAME is surprisingly agile. It delivers devastating kicks at speeds of up to 200 mph, using the massive weight of its armored torso as a powerful counterweight to amplify the force of each strike.

entry: POKENAME偏重防守，稳站在保护对象身前，从掌心射出超能力弹。弹丸锁定敌人的精神特征，持续追踪。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME battles defensively, standing firm in front of those it guards and firing psychic energy projectiles from its palms. The projectiles lock onto its opponent's mental signatures, homing in on them.

entry: POKENAME靠超能力悬浮，岩甲弹开一切攻击。忠诚无比，以纯意志筑起闪亮屏障，再挥锤粉碎障碍，护住珍爱者。
author: cerealjamalt
source: POKENAME floats on psychic energy, its rocky plating deflecting any assault. Loyal beyond measure, it raises shimmering barriers of pure will and smashes obstacles with  its hammer to shield those it cherishes.

entry: 像超甲狂犀一样，POKENAME往手臂装石，发射对敌。可实战更善用角，收拢双臂飞扑，以角贯穿对方。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Similar to Rhyperior, POKENAME load up rocks into their arms, using them as projectiles against opponents. However, in battle, they use their horns more effectively, folding their arms before flying into opponents, impaling them with their horns.

entry: 金属爪能钻穿实心岩石。靠感知波导在地下辨路，尤其擅长寻找被困矿工。
author: .jerden
source: Its metallic claws can drill through solid rock. It can use its ability to sense aura to navigate underground, and is especially skilled at locating trapped miners.

entry: POKENAME虽慢，主要靠防守，却不可小看。钻角轻松破石，也能从头上高速射出，命中远处目标。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME is slow and mainly fights defensively, one must not underestimate its strength; its drill-horns can dig through stone with ease, and can be fired from its head at high speeds into distant targets.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间泡在泥里，炎热时尤其如此。掌中能射石伤敌，常连地上都懒得起身，就开炮。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of its time wallowing in mud, especially on hot days. It can launch rocks from its palms to damage foes, often firing these projectiles without even getting up from the ground.

entry: 据说POKENAME搜集、吞食灵魂，驱使其在战斗中听令。射出的幽灵弹，会诅咒受击者，让其陷入难以承受的恐惧。
author: sk372
source: It's said that POKENAME gathers and consumes souls so that it may serve to do its bidding in combat. It fires spectral projectiles in combat that curses those hit with overwhelming dread.

entry: POKENAME雕出壮丽石刻，描绘宇宙起源。每处细节都以角精心刻成，据说角从不变钝。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME create magnificent stone carvings that depict the origins of the universe. Each detail is painstakingly etched with their horn, which is said to never grow dull.

entry: POKENAME能抵挡任何剑刃，也能钻穿钻石，盾牌与铠甲，更不在话下。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME can withstand any sword and is able to drill through diamond, let alone any shield or armor.

entry: POKENAME磨利钻头，准备与同类交战。可真对上时，钻头较小的一方通常会逃走。
author: busilisk
source: It sharpens its drill to prepare for combat with a fellow POKENAME. In a real confrontation, however, the POKENAME with a smaller drill will usually flee.

entry: POKENAME钻头连着层叠齿轮机构，启动虽难，一转起却能达极高速度，轻松钻穿岩石。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's drill is connected to a stacking gear mechanism that, though it is hard to start up, allows the drill to spin at extremely high speeds, perfect for boring through rock with ease.

entry: POKENAME在火山侧面钻出巨大隧道，构成复杂迷宫。破开基岩的巨响，经常引发火山喷发误报。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME bore gigantic tunnels into the sides of volcanoes, drilling out elaborate labyrinths. The sound of them pummelling their way through the bedrock is loud enough that they regularly trigger false alarms of a volcanic eruption.

entry: POKENAME在火山侧面钻出巨大隧道，构成复杂迷宫。极力守护家园，强尾打向闯入者，力道足以劈开地面。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME bore gigantic tunnels into the sides of volcanoes, drilling out elaborate labyrinths. They are protective of their home, swinging their powerful tail at intruders with enough force to split the ground open.

entry: POKENAME虽庞大，却吃每天钻过的沙中微生物。误吞的多余沙子在体内压成石块，攻击时一并吐出。
author: chibitales
source: Despite their large size, POKENAME feed on microorganisms found in the sand they burrow through daily. Excess sand that is consumed compresses within their bodies into rocks that they spit out alongside their attacks.

entry: 钻角转得足以干净穿钢，尾巴一挥也能推倒金属高塔。POKENAME将双掌按地，肌肉发力便能制造局部震动。
author: infinex21
source: Its drill horn can spin so fast that it can cleanly pierce through steel, while its tail packs enough power to topple metal tower in a single swing. A POKENAME can plant its palms against the ground and use its muscles to create localized tremors.

entry: POKENAME钻头虽小却强劲，漂着轻松穿过墙与地板。可不同于多数这样移动的幽灵宝可梦，它会留下圆洞。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's drill is small but powerful, and it floats around, passing through walls and floors with ease. Unlike most Ghost-type Pokémon that can do this, POKENAME leaves circular holes behind it.

entry: POKENAME用巨臂在险峻山脉挖掘，寻找落下的陨石。发现可疑岩石，便以角钻入，确认内部有没有心爱的铬般亮光。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME digs along tough mountain ranges using its oversized arm to search for fallen meteorites. When it finds a promising rock, it drills into the rock with its horn to see if the interior has the chrome-like shine it desires.

entry: POKENAME常在工地帮忙，搬重物、挪土堆。岩石外皮坚韧，整栋楼倒在身上也撑得住。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is commonly spotted at construction sites, helping the workers carry large loads and moving large mounds of earth. Its rocky hide is tough enough to withstand an entire building falling on it.

entry: POKENAME以钻角在山根下掘出巨大洞窟。背部器官不断储存挖掘时产生的静电。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its drill-shaped horn to dig vast caverns beneath mountain roots. On its back, it has organs that continuously store electrostatic energy generated during its digging activities.

entry: POKENAME有长长石腿，什么表面都能走，甚至爬上洞顶设下致命伏击。嘴下的一对钻爪，能穿透金属墙。
author: fiordaliso
source: Thanks to its long stone legs, POKENAME can walk on any surface, even climbing cave ceilings to set deadly ambushes for its prey. Beneath its mouth, it has a pair of drill-shaped claws capable of piercing metal walls.

entry: POKENAME用钻头触须挂在洞顶，捕食毫无戒心的岩石属性宝可梦，轻易就能钻破隆隆岩的硬壳。
author: serversizeme
source: POKENAME latch onto the tops of caverns with its drill tendrils to prey upon unaware Rock types. It can easily crack through a Golem's hard carapace.

entry: POKENAME的钻角一转，身上火焰便增强。诡异亮光在一英里外也能看见。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME's drill horn rotates, the flames on its body intensify. Its eerie light can be seen glowing from over a mile away.

entry: POKENAME游荡沙漠，保护旅人免受近旁威胁。总朝危险走去，因此一现身，行人就知道险情紧随在后。
author: rumia_archer
source: POKENAME wander deserts to protect travelers from nearby threats. They always move toward danger, so when one appears, wanderers know peril is close behind.

entry: 摸着像橡胶，受身体伤害或脱离核心时却会硬化。这种融合体光是存在，就会唤起固拉多的怒气，引发地震与烈日。
author: epping_forest
source: Its body feels rubbery to the touch, but will become hard in response to physical trauma or if it gets detached from its core. The sole existence of this fusion causes earthquakes and heavy sunshine, for it awakens the anger of Groudon.

entry: POKENAME齿轮加速后，钻头能凿穿实心岩石，也能射出去。可会立刻赶去让齿轮重聚，分开太久便活不成。
author: .jerden
source: Once it spins its gears up to high speed, POKENAME can use its drill to tunnel through solid rock, or fire it off as a projectile. However, it will quickly rush to reunite its gears, as it cannot live for long  if they remain separated.

entry: POKENAME能旋转巨大的机械钻头破岩。可除了体重，没别的固定方式，岩石太硬时身体反倒高速打转，毫无进展。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can spin its large mechanical drill to bore through rock. Lacking any way to anchor itself in place beyond its own weight, if the rock is too hard its body may simply spin around at high speed rather than making progress.

entry: POKENAME以粗尾与强健前肢震地，摇落树上水果、树果与坚果。钻角能取出树汁和水，也轻易穿得过实心岩石。
author: infinex21
source: Using their bulky tails and their muscular forelimbs, POKENAME create tremors to knock loose fruits, berries, and nuts in trees. They use their horn drills to access the sap and water within trees, though they can easily puncture solid rock as well.

entry: POKENAME在空中高速转身，化为贯穿力极强的钻头，连最坚硬的一些材料也能钻穿。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME are able to spin their bodies rapidly in the air to become a piercing drill capable of drilling through some of the toughest materials.

entry: POKENAME重尾挥过，沿途什么都能毁掉。古生物学家推测，它曾是远古山间的顶级捕食者。
author: .realthree
source: When POKENAME swings its heavy tail, it can demolish anything in its path. Paleontologists theorize that this species was the apex predator in primeval mountains.

entry: POKENAME虽慢且重，却善于狩猎。在海底附近徘徊，将碎屑吸进掌中，射向远处目标，打昏后让其无力逃离，成为食物。
author: sk372
source: Though slow and heavy, POKENAME is an adept hunter. Hanging near the ocean floors, it vacuums debris into its hands to fire powerful shots at distant targets, knocking them out and leaving them helpless to avoid becoming prey.

entry: POKENAME的另一种体色，最先在巨牙鲨繁盛海域被发现。起初以为是伪装，后来才知，这种变体更爱捕食巨牙鲨。
author: sk372
source: This alternative coloration of POKENAME was first discovered in oceans highly populated by Sharpedo. Though first thought to be camouflage, it was later discovered that this variant prefers Sharpedo as its prey.

entry: POKENAME是采矿高手，以超声波分辨岩石深处的不同矿石。矿场常用，却对自己的手艺十分讲究。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are expert miners, using ultrasonic pulses to determine different ores hidden deep within the rocks. While a common Pokémon used in mining operations, they are very particular about their craft.

entry: POKENAME以凝聚沙暴为双翼，翱翔沙漠与山间。战斗先从高处卷沙扰敌，再以角俯冲轰击。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME soars above deserts and mountains on wings made of coalesced sandstorms. In battle, they disorient their opponent from above with swirling sand, then divebomb with its horn.

entry: POKENAME暴走时，会用巨钻撕碎遇见的一切对象。吸收光能后，钻头还会更大、更快、更强。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME will use its giant drills to shred anyone it comes across during its rampages. By absorbing light energy, these drills become even bigger, faster, and stronger.

entry: POKENAME从掌孔喷出气流，极快调整位置。俯冲能加强角钻，迅速击倒大多敌人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME adjust their positions with remarkable speed by releasing jets of air from the holes in their palms. They can quickly down most foes with a dive bomb attack that empowers their Horn Drill attack.

entry: 它常被用于拆迁。不过有报告称，POKENAME进场后，曾有工人消失得无影无踪。
author: chorb33
source: This fusion is often used for demolition work. However, there have been reports of workers disappearing without a trace once POKENAME was on site.

entry: POKENAME强角轻松钻穿最硬最厚的冰块。身侧宝石能释放强寒，拖慢甚至冻住攻击者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's powerful horn can drill through even the toughest and thickest of ice blocks with ease. The jewels on its sides can generate immense cold, slowing down or even freezing attackers in place.

entry: POKENAME以棒状粗尾捶地，宣告存在，引起的震动常被误认为地震。射出的角，力道足以贯穿巨石。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME announces its presence by thumping the ground with its clubbed tail, causing tremors that some mistake for an earthquake. It fires its horns with enough force to pierce through boulders.

entry: 钻爪极善破开实心岩石，多数矿队总带至少一只。极坚韧的身体与拆墙球般的尾巴，也能对付深洞威胁。
author: infinex21
source: Their drill-like claws are so efficient at piercing solid rock that most mining crews will always have at least one on hand. Their extremely durable bodies and wrecking-ball tails also help deal with deep-cave threats.

entry: POKENAME常被猎取作战利品，角被装架展示，数量因此剧降。如今被视为濒危，保护人士正呼吁禁猎。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are often hunted as trophies, with their horns mounted for display. As a result, their population has plummeted and they are now considered endangered, prompting activists to call for a hunting ban.

entry: POKENAME一生都在给自己增加挑战。比如被请搬东西，就用另一组手臂多抱四块巨石，加重负荷，锻炼力量。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME dedicates its entire existence to making its life more challenging. For example, when asked to move something, it may carry four extra boulders in its other set of arms to increase the workload; this helps train its strength.

entry: 身体太重，难以自在离开岩浆。只有火山喷发把它轰出，才会离开，再从平流层滑翔到新火山。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its body is too heavy to comfortably leave magma. It will only leave a volcano if an eruption fires it out. It glides to new volcanoes from the stratosphere.

entry: POKENAME不爱在水里游，偏爱地下，以大角钻过岩土。反而在水中游泳，会让皮肤干裂。
author: jojojax164
source: Instead of water, POKENAME prefer to swim underground, using their large horn to drill through rock and soil. Swimming in water causes their skin to dry out and crack.

entry: POKENAME以钻头凿穿海床，形成错综复杂的水下洞窟。许多海洋生物都在其中安家。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will use their drills to tunnel through the seafloor, creating intricate underwater caves. Many sea creatures make these caves their home.

entry: POKENAME藤蔓强得可怕，却不像蔓藤怪那样容易再生，因此会攻击靠得太近的对象。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's vines are terrifyingly powerful. However, they are not as easy to regrow as Tangela's, so POKENAME will attack anyone who grows too close.

entry: POKENAME双腿由藤蔓构成，步态格外笨拙。幸好头顶的手防护出色，行动不便也能自卫。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: Since POKENAME's legs are made up of vines, it has an unusually awkward gait. Fortunately, the hands atop its head provide excellent protection, allowing POKENAME to defend itself despite its poor mobility.

entry: 人们普遍认为，这只宝可梦大部分体重都来自藤蔓，本体由戴着的巨头骨遮住。猎物被藤团吞没，连骨头也不剩。
author: infinex21
source: It is widely believed that this Pokémon's vines comprise the vast majority of its total mass, with the actual body being concealed by the large skull it wears. It subsumes its prey within its mass of vines. Not even their bones are left behind.

entry: POKENAME受威胁会从嘴中甩出舌头般的藤蔓，最远可打到10英尺外，力道惊人。
author: .izik
source: When threatened, POKENAME whips out a vine that resembles a tongue from its mouth. It strikes from up to 10 feet away with surprising force.

entry: POKENAME有坚硬岩壳与两层强韧藤蔓，核心得到充分保护，能抵御身体攻击。可也因此难进食，只好先在体外溶食物，再吸收养分。
author: alumed
source: With a tough rocky shell and two layers of durable vines, the core of POKENAME is well protected against physical attacks. However, this makes it difficult for POKENAME to eat, so it must dissolve food externally before absorbing nutrients.

entry: 脸像一枚蛋，藏在强大而蠕动的众多藤蔓中央。也会将遗弃的蛋收进体内，在触须下护住，保持温暖。
author: sk372
source: Its face resembles an egg, tucked away in the center where it is protected by its many powerful, undulating vines. It tucks away abandoned eggs into its body, keeping them safe and warm beneath the tendrils.

entry: 融合减少了蔓藤怪惯常覆身的藤蔓，改为结成强壮藤团肢体。主要用来够到平时碰不着的树顶水果与树果。
author: sk372
source: Fusion has reduced Tangela's usual coating of vines, instead forming strong clumps of vines as limbs. It uses these mainly to reach fruits and berries atop trees it couldn't normally reach.

entry: POKENAME喜欢顽皮地用藤蔓缠训练家。流行童话里，一只住在孤塔顶，只要有人呼唤，便垂下藤蔓。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME enjoys playfully wrapping its vines around its Trainer. In a popular fairy tale, a POKENAME lived atop a lonely tower, lowering these vines to those who called out to it.

entry: POKENAME以利刃狂斩，同时伸藤捆住猎物。在密丛地形，攻势迅捷又令人迷乱。
author: .izik
source: While slashing wildly with its blades, POKENAME sends out vines to bind prey. Its attacks are swift and disorienting in dense terrain.

entry: POKENAME踩节奏摇摆，引来猎物。一够得到，便以双臂和藤蔓般的头发拥住，再慢慢勒紧。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME sashays rhythmically to lure in prey. As soon as anything gets within reach, POKENAME embraces it with both its arms and its vine-like hair, then begins to slowly constrict.

entry: 人们常讲游荡的POKENAME的故事，吓孩子别淘气。其实它极为害羞，往往避开人类与其他宝可梦。
author: turron_turron
source: Stories about roaming POKENAME are often told to keep children from misbehaving. Despite this reputation, POKENAME are remarkably shy and tend to avoid contact with people and Pokémon alike.

entry: POKENAME住在大片海草丛，试着融入环境。若不经常修藤，多半反会被自己的海草家缠住。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME makes its home in large clusters of seaweed in an attempt to camouflage with its surroundings. If it doesn't trim its vines often, it will most likely get entangled with the seaweed it resides in.

entry: POKENAME靠代码构成的众多触手赢战，出手却十分谨慎。数据若损失太多，便会不稳定到无法继续打。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a mass of tentacles made out of code that they rely on to win battles. They exercise much caution when fighting their opponents, as losing too much data renders them too unstable to continue fighting.

entry: POKENAME大部分藤蔓藏在胃内。饿了，就从隐秘的嘴里翻涌而出，尽可能多抓食物，拖回咕噜叫的肚子。
author: sk372
source: Most of POKENAME's vines reside internally within its stomach. When hungry, its writhing vines lurch out from its hidden mouth and grab as much food as possible to drag back to its rumbling belly.

entry: POKENAME背上伸出的藤能展开、膨大，成为真正的翅膀，让它飞得出奇快。手臂也能迅速伸远，重击敌人或抓食物。
author: infinex21
source: The protruding vines upon a POKENAME's back can extend and expand into functional wings that allow it to fly at surprising speeds. Its arms can extend far and fast to deliver devastating strikes or snatch up food.

entry: POKENAME把藤绑在树上，等登山客经过。行人被绊后，常会跌进大片泥水坑。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME strap their vines onto trees, waiting for oncoming hikers to walk by. When the hikers are tripped, they often fall into large puddles of mud.

entry: POKENAME深受各地奶奶喜爱，能满足她们的编织兴致。藤蔓柔韧，也耐得住恶劣气候。
author: fxncy_poland
source: POKENAME are loved by grandmothers across the region as they help satisfy their need to knit. Their vines are pliable and can withstand strong climates.

entry: POKENAME倒挂树上，装成一团藤蔓。见到猎物便悄悄跟到休息处，往后数周再于夜间持续取食。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME hangs upside-down from trees, disguised as a bundle of vines. If it spots prey, it will silently follow them to their resting grounds so it can feed on them at night over the following weeks.

entry: POKENAME弯起手指，亮起指尖诱饵。猎物一靠近，藤蔓就迅速缠住，拖入深处。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME illuminate the tips of their fingers as they curl to lure in prey. Once the prey is close enough, POKENAME rapidly wrap them up in vines before dragging them into the depths.

entry: POKENAME冷季从温带迁往阿罗拉等暖地。热带令藤蔓疯长，妨碍飞行，得在回程前梳去多余的藤。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME migrates from temperate regions to warmer climates like Alola during cold seasons. The tropics accelerate the growth of its vines, hampering its flight until it preens the excess vines off for the return journey.

entry: POKENAME用长触须给健身者按摩背部与四肢，缓解肌肉酸痛。蠕动的触须软中带韧，还带宜人香气。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME massage the backs and limbs of many people who exercise at the gym, using their long tentacles to soothe muscle pain. The writhing tentacles are soft, firm, and have a pleasant scent.

entry: POKENAME懒卧沼泽，藤蔓吸进大量水。有时把小宝可梦缠住，想解开却徒劳无功。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lies around the marsh, absorbing large amounts of water into its vines. Sometimes, it will get smaller Pokémon tangled in its vines and will try in vain to get them free.

entry: POKENAME用粗藤缠住心爱的树，一连系着数天。受威胁便从枝头荡下，如拆墙球般撞向敌人。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME wraps itself around a tree it likes with its thick vines, staying tethered there for days at a time. If it is threatened, it will swing from the tree branches and hit its attacker like a wrecking ball.

entry: POKENAME覆身藤蔓致密，受损后又很快再生，防御不错。可得经常撕掉一些，免得长过头，将全身淹没。
author: infinex21
source: The vines along their bodies are dense and grow back quickly if damaged. Although this provides POKENAME with decent defenses, they must often tear away their own vines or else they will overgrow and envelop their entire body.

entry: 暴怒时，身体自发光的部位便明亮闪耀。会旋转冲撞一切会动的东西，强得能把工程车撞翻。
author: infinex21
source: The bioluminescent parts of its body glow brightly when it becomes enraged. In this state, it will spin and charge at everything that moves with such strength that it can send construction vehicles tumbling.

entry: POKENAME长途移动或冲撞敌人前，会卷成巨轮状。大耳朵是强韧藤团，既能抽打敌人，也能当手。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME roll up into large, wheel-like shapes when they plan to move long distances and when to charge into opponents. Their large ears are clusters of strong vines that can lash at foes and can act as hands.

entry: POKENAME操纵藤蔓时，鹿角便泛微光。会从灌丛摘药草，拉到嘴边。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's antlers glow faintly when it manipulates its vines. It uses them to pluck herbs from the underbrush and pull them to its mouth.

entry: 疯长藤蔓几乎吞没整个身体，只露着巨口与致命獠牙。每根藤都充满致命毒素，切下后很快便腐朽。
author: infinex21
source: Its overgrown vines have all but consumed its entire form, save for its gaping maw and deadly fangs. Each vine is filled with a deadly poison that will cause it to rot and decay soon after being cut.

entry: POKENAME体内强大力量加快藤蔓生长，总长得失去控制。必须朝自己喷火，烧到舒服、不妨碍行动的长度。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's vines constantly grow uncontrollably long since their growth is accelerated by the great inner power it contains. It must blast fire on itself in order to keep the vines at a comfortable and non-hindering length.

entry: POKENAME藤蔓上异色的斑点，是发电与储电处。即使没冒火花也危险，一碰便会本能地放出猛烈电击。
author: sk372
source: The different-colored spots of POKENAME's vines are where it generates and stores its electricity. Even if not actively sparking, these points are dangerous, and will deliver a nasty shock on instinct if touched.

entry: POKENAME在纠结藤团中长出各式树果，却竭力藏住，不让别的宝可梦发现，好全部独享。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME grows many different types of berries in its tangled mess of vines. However, it tries its best to keep them hidden from other Pokémon so that it can have them all to itself.

entry: POKENAME靠深藏体内的粗粉藤吃饭。这条舌头般的附肢，完全伸长能超过30英尺。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses a thick pink vine curled deep within its body to feed. This tongue-like appendage can stretch over 30 feet when fully extended.

entry: 臂上藤蔓遮着掌中孔口，能从中射出大型种子炸弹与蠕动藤束。长钻角则常用来敲开硬坚果与其他果实。
author: infinex21
source: The vines along this Pokémon's arms conceal the open ports within its palms that allow it to shoot large Seed Bombs and bundles of writhing vines at foes. It often uses its long drill horn to crack open tough nuts and other fruit.

entry: POKENAME藤蔓极导电，有时被拿来当电缆、电线。两条尾藤还能持续放强电，直到敌人动不了。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME vines are remarkably conductive, leading many to use them as cables and wires in some cases. The two vines that serve as their tails can deliver powerful electric shocks into foes until they are rendered immobile.

entry: POKENAME住在密林，晒树冠缝间漏下的阳光。覆身藤蔓让它完美混进枝叶，遮住真容。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME live in dense jungles, basking in any sunlight that bleeds through the canopy. Their bodies blend into the foliage perfectly due to the vines covering them, masking their true appearance.

entry: 它巨大的长牙，由密实、坚硬的藤蔓构成，若折断，不到一周便能再生。它会冲撞入侵领地的生灵，也能靠强腿震地，震落树上的果实。
author: infinex21
source: Its large tusks are made of dense, rigid vines that regrow in less than a week if ever broken. It charges down invaders of its territory and uses its strong legs to create tremors that knock free the fruit within trees.

entry: POKENAME天生杂食，却也能只靠人类的善言与真诚赞美维生。这样会让藤蔓强健、颜色鲜艳，也会变得特别黏训练家。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME are omnivorous by nature, but can also subsist entirely on kind words and genuine compliments from humans. Such a diet produces strong vine growth and vivid coloration. It also makes POKENAME very clingy towards their Trainers.

entry: 下方众多藤蔓构成飘逸长裙，操控精细得惊人。每根都能长得覆住大片区域，又能分别控制，抓猎物或阻挡攻击者。
author: infinex21
source: Its many lower vines form a long, flowing skirt that it can control with surprising precision. Each of its vines can grow to encompass a large area, with it being able to control each one individual to acquire prey or to ward off aggressors.

entry: POKENAME藤下藏着利刺，让它安心觅食，不怕捕食者偷近。视力很差，爪子却锋利得能撕碎岩石与混凝土。
author: bigoljax
source: The spines hidden under POKENAME's vines help them forage in peace without any predators sneaking up on them. They have very poor eyesight, but their claws are sharp enough to shred rock and concrete.

entry: POKENAME藤蔓般的身体适合密林，与灌木融为一体。随季节变色，配合环境，往往分毫不差。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's vine-like bodies allow them to thrive in dense forests, blending in with the shrubbery. As the seasons change, they change the color of these vines to match their environment, often with perfect accuracy.

entry: POKENAME覆身蠕藤长着变色鳞片，能融入环境。再加上软橡胶般的脚掌，便能无声溜走，逃离捕食者。
author: quackquackattack
source: The writhing vines around POKENAME's body are coated with color-shifting scales, giving it the ability to blend into its environment. By combining this ability with the soft rubbery texture of its feet, it can silently slip away from predators.

entry: 这些大型丛林猎手以超能力聚拢身体的藤蔓。沉重肢体其实全由密密卷缠的藤团构成，足以压碎岩石。
author: infinex21
source: These large, predatory jungle Pokémon hold the many vines of their bodies together with their psychic powers. Their heavy limbs are actually made entirely of many vines coiled together into dense clusters capable of crushing rock.

entry: POKENAME是厚厚的触须团，包住缥缈的幽灵身体。平时藤蔓漫无目的地扭动，危险来时却能聚成实肢，拍开威胁。
