author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a thick mass of tendrils covering a wispy spectral body. While the vines normally wiggle aimlessly, they can gather together into solid limbs to smack away incoming dangers.

entry: 即使不算藤蔓双臂，POKENAME身体也极柔韧。不断训练，随时应付任何方向的攻击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Even without considering their vine-like arms, POKENAME are extremely flexible. They constantly train their bodies to be ready to fend off attacks from any angle.

entry: POKENAME用纠结触须裹住目标，拉进巨口。藤里编着金属纤维，格外耐用。
author: evilgammon
source: Using its knotted tentacles, POKENAME wraps up its target and pulls them into its gaping maw. Strands of metal fibre are woven into its vines, making them extremely durable.

entry: POKENAME用众多粗长藤蔓伪装，等猎物经过。看见自认吃得下的目标，便揭开可怕大嘴发动攻击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their many long, thick vines to camouflage themselves and wait for prey to cross by. When they see something they believe they can prey upon, they unveil their large, horrific maws and strike.

entry: POKENAME藤蔓永不停长，强得能拔树。可它太懒，根本不用，只有最后关头才肯起身割掉，赶紧回去睡、继续偷懒。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME's vines never stop growing and have the strength to uproot trees. Yet, it's so lazy that it doesn't use them and only moves to cut them off at the last minute so that it can go back to sleeping and loafing around.

entry: POKENAME通常住在丛林深处，尤其爱覆身藤蔓便于融入的地方。需要时必会伸长手臂，自卫、获取食物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME typically dwell deep within jungles, especially in areas where they can easily blend in due to the many vines covering their bodies. They can, and will, extend their arms to defend themselves and to secure food.

entry: 这只宝可梦是故乡丛林里的猎手，沐浴日光，便生机勃勃。它先跟踪猎物数小时，等到时机，一甩头上藤蔓，力道足以切开几乎一切。
author: sontyp
source: This Pokémon is a predator in its native jungle environment and thrives in sunlight. To hunt, it first stalks its prey for hours, until at an opportune moment it hurls the vines on its head with such force that they can cut through almost anything.

entry: POKENAME触须是由磁力束成的锋锐铁屑，细突起能割破人皮肤，可别太用力挤过去。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME's tentacles are sharp iron shavings bound by magnetism. One should be careful to not push into them with too much force, since their narrow protrusions can cut human skin.

entry: POKENAME触须没有神经或肌肉，全是金属碎屑，只靠磁力控制。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME's tentacles have no nerves or muscles inside them. They're made of metal shavings, which POKENAME controls only via magnetism.

entry: POKENAME的藤刃既能当鞭，也能设套索。容易再生，最长能超过100英尺。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's vine blade functions both as a whip and a snare. It easily regenerates and can grow more than 100 feet long.

entry: 这只龙属性宝可梦本就雄伟，覆身藤蔓又让它显得更大。能从全身甩出众多藤蔓，也能挥动受藤加固的粗尾，打向任何敌人。
author: infinex21
source: This Dragon-type Pokémon's impressive form is clad, and made much larger, by the many vines growing upon it. It can lash out at any enemy with many vines from all over its body or with its thick tail made even stronger by its vines.

entry: 生活水域养分丰富，让POKENAME身披繁茂鲜色。藤蔓会过滤水中污染物，吸满之后自行脱落。
author: infinex21
source: Its body is clad in lush, vibrant colors thanks to the nutrient-rich waters it lives within. POKENAME's vines filter out any pollutants within water and fall off when full of said pollutants.

entry: POKENAME在低能见度的雾夜捕猎，重排头顶藤蔓，伪装成枝杈繁多的树、小丘，甚至其他宝可梦的轮廓。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME hunts during foggy nights when the visibility is low. It disguises itself by rearranging the vines on its head into various shapes to mimic branchy trees, small hills, or even the silhouettes of other Pokémon.

entry: 手状藤触须末端分泌舒缓液，能平息敌人、制服猎物或安抚幼崽。其他藤也含类似成分，常用于各种药剂。
author: infinex21
source: The tips of its vine-like feelers, which have formed almost like hands, secrete a soothing fluid that it uses to quell foes, subdue prey, or soothe its young. Its other vines contain a similar soothing compound, so they are used in many remedies.

entry: POKENAME高耸，身披众藤与厚苔。藤似乎支撑巨肢、帮助移动，直到绷断，才会停下休息，等新藤长好。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are towering Pokémon clad in many vines and patches of thick moss. The vines seem to help support their large limbs and aid them in moving until they snap, which they will then rest until their vines regrow.

entry: POKENAME用头顶众藤藏炮，让猎物误以为无害。攻击后为让敌人不再起身，还会汲取史前力量，从炮管射出强劲原始之力。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses the many vines on its head to hide its cannon so that it may seem harmless towards prey. To make sure a foe stays down after an attack, it draws in prehistoric strength to fire a powerful Ancient Power from its cannon.

entry: POKENAME夜里在森林跌撞前行，藤缠住便烦躁。试着举臂拉开安全距离，藤却反缠进花朵里。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Stumbling along through forests at night, POKENAME grow frustrated when their vines get tangled. They attempt to keep themselves at a safe distance by raising their arms, but their vines only end up getting caught in their flowers instead.

entry: POKENAME对训练家极为警惕，常藏在树上俯看。若避不开战斗，就以耳状藤缠住目标，迅速逃走。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME are very careful around Trainers, so they hide in trees and watch from above. When battle is unavoidable, they will entangle their target with their ear-shaped vines before making a quick getaway.

entry: POKENAME能撕下身上藤蔓，再用念力控制、缠猎物。再生极快，开战几秒就已同时操纵数十条藤。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can tear the vines off its body and control them telekinetically to ensnare its prey. The vines regenerate back so quickly that it ends up controlling dozens of vines at once within seconds of a battle.

entry: POKENAME十分善良，常用藤载着幼小宝可梦，保护它们。爱看星星，会坐到树顶，找最佳视野。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is very kind and will often carry young Pokémon in its vines for protection. It loves stargazing and can be seen sitting atop trees to get the best view.

entry: 藏在沼泽湿地，融入池塘湖泊里纠结的水草。猎物一近，便张巨口整吞，紧抓不放，直到不再挣扎。
author: infinex21
source: They lurk within swamps and marshlands, blending in with the tangled greens within ponds and lakes. When prey draws near, they will use their large maws to consume them whole and hold onto them until they cease to resist.

entry: POKENAME在黄昏最后几分钟穷追猎物，小心赶进已种满速生藤蔓的区域。黑暗一降临，猎物绊倒只是时间问题。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME relentlessly chases its prey during the last few minutes of dusk, carefully corralling them into areas where it has planted many of its quick-growing vines. When darkness finally sets in, it's only a matter of time until its prey trips.

entry: POKENAME以藤挂树，慢慢吸取近旁生物的生命力。有人说，若在家边现身，你的时日便不多了。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hangs from trees using its vines, slowly draining the life force of nearby creatures. Some say that if one appears near your home, your days are numbered.

entry: POKENAME石身里似有无穷藤状触须，能伸缩，操控灵活。质地与耐久却如岩石，重击威力惊人。
author: sk372
source: A seemingly endless amount of vine-like tendrils lies within POKENAME's stone body. The vines are extendable and quite maneuverable, but have the texture and durability of stone, making them pack quite the punch.

entry: POKENAME只曾被看见守护一座早已沉水的古庙。平时亲切，对敌却会卷起耀眼的波浪与沸水漩涡，将其收拾。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has only been spotted protecting an ancient temple that fell under the water long ago. While usually kind, it disposes of its foes in a dazzling vortex of swirling waves and boiling water.

entry: 藤尾不断快长，补回永燃火焰烧掉的部分。身体其他藤内流着暖液，遇空气便迅速燃烧。
author: infinex21
source: Its vine-like tails are always growing quickly to counter the ever-burning flames that continuously consume them. The vines along the rest of its body run warm with a fluid that quickly combusts when exposed to air.

entry: POKENAME是致命丛林猎手，疾穿树冠上空与林间。众藤如尖头手臂，高速移动也能刺穿猎物与其他食物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME is a deadly jungle predator that darts above canopies and through the trees. Its many vines serve as sharp-tipped arms that can skewer prey and other food, even as it moves at extreme speeds.

entry: 精力充沛时，POKENAME藤蔓会失控狂甩。陷入狂乱，打向周围一切，直到能量耗退。
author: .izik
source: When energized, POKENAME's vines lash about uncontrollably. It enters a frenzy, striking everything nearby until its energy fades.

entry: 它在林中挖洞避风雨。若有足够小的东西凑近探看，就会被触手抓住吞食。
author: skymaster426
source: It digs holes in forests to shelter from the elements. When something small enough inspects the hole, it grabs it with its tentacles and consumes it.

entry: 藤蔓急切扭动，想从茧状外壳挣出，朝开阔天空生长。短而粗的腿因扛着极重身体，也锻炼得很强健。
author: infinex21
source: Their vines eagerly writhe to break free from within their cocoon-like shell, growing toward the open sky. Their thick, albeit small, legs are strong from carrying their incredibly heavy bodies.

entry: POKENAME藤蔓药效惊人，古代常用作绷带。会黏在树枝上，将近旁植物溶进凝胶里取食。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's vines were often used as bandages during ancient times as they had amazing healing properties. It sticks itself to tree branches and feeds on nearby plant matter by dissolving them into its gel.

entry: POKENAME展开翼尖薄膜，不振翅也能缓缓下降。藤上毒素一接触就让敌人疲惫，方便它悠闲进食。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME spreads the tips of its wings to expand the webbing for a slow descent without flapping. Its vines are coated with a toxin that exhausts foes on contact, allowing it to easily feed at a leisurely pace.

entry: POKENAME藤蔓不停生长，藏住身体。平伏林地，与枝叶融为一体，缠住不幸踩来的对象。
author: santon5512
source: The vines on POKENAME grow constantly, helping to hide their bodies. They lie flat along the forest floor, blending in with the foliage and ensnaring anyone unfortunate enough to step on them.

entry: POKENAME藤蔓不停生长，藏住身体。平伏林地，与枝叶融为一体，缠住不幸踩来的对象。
author: santon5512
source: The vines on POKENAME grow constantly, helping to hide their bodies. They lie flat along the forest floor, blending in with the foliage and ensnaring anyone unfortunate enough to step on them.

entry: POKENAME藤蔓肌肉极强，会缠腿增强力道。旅行商人曾成群使用它们，拖运沉重货物。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's vines are incredibly muscular, as it will wrap them around its legs to increase their power. Herds of POKENAME were used by travelling merchants to help tow heavy cargo.

entry: POKENAME身上藤蔓苦得不能吃。传说会抓走纵火者吞食，其实能量来自吸取其他植物根部的水分与养分。
author: bobosmith01
source: The vines growing off of POKENAME's body are bitter and unsuitable to eat. Legends state it will snatch away arsonists and devour them. POKENAME, however, actually gets energy by leeching water and nutrients off the roots of other plants.

entry: POKENAME身上藤蔓苦得不能吃。传说会抓走纵火者吞食，其实能量来自吸取其他植物根部的水分与养分。
author: bobosmith01
source: The vines growing off of POKENAME's body are bitter and unsuitable to eat. Legends state it will snatch away arsonists and devour them. POKENAME, however, actually gets energy by leeching water and nutrients off the roots of other plants.

entry: POKENAME由松散相连的藤根构成，钻入巨石，挖空内部，再把石头绑成基本骨架，用来移动、保护脆弱藤蔓。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are formed of a loose connection of vines and roots that burrow into and hollow out boulders. They bind these boulders together to form a basic frame with which to move and to protect their vulnerable vines.

entry: 钢壳里装着不停生长的藤团。坚韧身体加上藤蔓再生力，让它几乎无法被击败。
author: bacondlx
source: Its steel shell houses an ever-growing mass of vines. The toughness of its body and regenerative capabilities of these vines make it nearly impossible to defeat.

entry: 看似重金属外壳中的乘客，POKENAME更爱伸长藤打敌人，不肯亲自靠近。
author: bukie
source: What seems to be a passenger inside a heavy metal husk, POKENAME prefers to reach with long vines to strike foes rather than approach them itself.

entry: 藤软得像毛衣。POKENAME用强臂抱住谁，就绝不放开，连“毛衣”边缘也会伸长，裹住可怜的受害者。
author: fiordaliso
source: The vines covering its body are so soft that they resemble a woolen sweater. When POKENAME hugs someone with its strong arms, it never lets go, and even the edges of its sweater stretch to wrap around its poor victims.

entry: 它用拳端的粗刺戳向敌人。藤蔓一旦缠住对手，它就会鞭打不休，直到能将其拖进来吞食。
author: infinex21
source: It jabs at opponents with the thick spikes at the ends of its fists. When its vines ensnare an opponent, it will not stop lashing at them until they can be dragged in and consumed.

entry: POKENAME勤于打理外貌，发状触须一打结就焦躁。走进丛林深处的人，或许难得一见它唱歌。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME diligently maintains its appearance, fussing when its hair-like tendrils become tangled. Those that wander deep into jungles may catch a rare glimpse of this Pokémon singing.

entry: 菌盖下长出许多触手，让POKENAME能移动。行走时，触手尖向土里放孢子，所到之处便长真菌。
author: sk372
source: Numerous tentacles sprout from beneath the mushroom cap to give POKENAME locomotion. The tips release spores into the ground as it walks, so everywhere it steps, fungi will grow.

entry: POKENAME什么都要查看，亮物就藏进藤里。藤有毒以阻捕食者，不过小心加热能去毒，吃来口感粗糙、滋味干涩。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME inspects anything it encounters, keeping shiny objects in its vines. Its vines contain a poison to deter predators, but careful application of heat can counteract the toxin, allowing them to be eaten for their gritty texture and dry flavor.

entry: POKENAME聪明，会用藤扎小包，方便携带树果。藤够粗，能挡住飞天螳螂的刀刃。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is known for its intelligence, creating small bundles from its vines to help carry berries. The vines are thick enough to resist the blades of Scyther.

entry: POKENAME用打结尾巴牢牢捆住目标。等对手缠紧，便连施凶狠爪击与咬击。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME uses its knotted tail to restrain its target, wrapping them tightly in its grip. When its opponent is tangled, it unleashes a barrage of vicious claws and bites.

entry: POKENAME发现喜欢或想记住的气味，就蹭到数百藤之一。能完美模仿，有时用于侦查。年老个体的气味，可能浓得令人受不住。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Whenever POKENAME finds a scent it likes or wants to remember, it rubs it onto one of its hundreds of vines. It can perfectly mimic this scent and sometimes uses it in detective work. An older POKENAME's scent can be overpowering.

entry: POKENAME发现喜欢或想记住的气味，就蹭到数百藤之一。能完美模仿，有时用于侦查。年老个体的气味，可能浓得令人受不住。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Whenever POKENAME finds a scent it likes or wants to remember, it rubs it onto one of its hundreds of vines. It can perfectly mimic this scent and sometimes uses it in detective work. An older POKENAME's scent can be overpowering.

entry: POKENAME以众藤向身体各处传超能力信号，放大力量。也常把藤整理成各式发型、胡须，与同类区别开。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME use their many vines to send psychic signals to different parts of their body, to amplify their psychic power. POKENAME often style their vines into different hairstyles and moustaches to distinguish themselves from other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME潜在沼泽，守护环境与其中的宝可梦。喜欢往盗猎者的船上打洞。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME lurk in swamps, acting as the guardians of the environment and the Pokémon that reside there. They like to punch holes in the boats of poachers.

entry: 粗藤加固本已强健的双臂，也增添厚防。猎物若想逃，手臂还能伸长，继续痛打。
author: infinex21
source: Their thick vines reinforce their already-strong arms while also offering a thicker defense. They can stretch their arms enough to continue pummeling prey if they attempt to flee.

entry: 对毒常春藤过敏的人，最好别碰它，因为会产生类似毒素。在野外，正靠这些毒素阻挡食草动物。
author: quackquackattack
source: People who are allergic to poison ivy should avoid touching this Pokémon, as they produce similar toxins. They rely on these toxins to deter herbivores in the wild.

entry: POKENAME从空心倒木中放出桃桃果般的气味，再铺开藏好藤蔓，将好奇猎物拖入。
author: .izik
source: From the hollow of a tree log, POKENAME releases a scent that smells like Pecha Berries. It spreads and conceals vines from its body to drag curious prey inside.

entry: POKENAME眼睛上方的嘴，藏在众藤之下。会用手臂将猎物塞进巨胃，而胃几乎占了整个身体。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's mouth, which is located above its eyes, is hidden under its numerous vines. It uses its arm to shove prey into its massive stomach, which comprises most of its body.

entry: POKENAME住在洞里，收回藤便能混进洞壁。猎物经过，藤从石身射出，吸取抓住对象的能量。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME resides in caves and can retract its vines to blend into the surrounding walls. When prey pass by, POKENAME shoots its vines out from its rocky body and drains the energy of whatever it captures.

entry: 常被视为可怜，因为总试着把短臂当翅膀扇，想飞起来。虽然飞不动，双腿却足够强，能跃过树冠。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon are often seen as pitiful due to how they will try to flap their small arms like wings to fly. Though they struggle to fly, their legs are strong enough to leap above tree canopies.

entry: POKENAME全身由会蜇人的长触手构成，碰上就疼。能忍受蜇刺的鱼宝可梦，却能借它藏身。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is made of long stinging tentacles that are painful to touch. These Pokémon are shelter for fish Pokémon that can endure its sting.

entry: POKENAME大半身体覆着无数触须。炮管太脏时，会用构成双臂的伸缩藤清洁内部。
author: sk372
source: Countless tendrils cover most of POKENAME's body. It uses the extendable vines that make up its arms to clean the insides of its cannons when they grow too dirty.

entry: 背上有能把太阳能转电的线圈，POKENAME让电流遍全身，始终警觉。能存大量能量，再经双鞭调取。
author: fiordaliso
source: On its back is a coil that converts solar energy into electricity, which POKENAME channels throughout its body to stay always alert. It can store enormous amounts of energy, which it draws upon through its pair of whips.

entry: 头上骨状硬壳被天线接引、放出的雷电烧焦。同类偏爱金属管作武器、工具，尤其喜欢导电好的。
author: infinex21
source: Its head is covered in a bone-like shell that has been charred by the electricity it catches and releases via its antennae. Its kind favors metal pipes as weapons and as tools, especially those that conduct electricity well.

entry: POKENAME双腿电光噼啪，能量充沛。踢击毁灭性，一接触就放出20,000伏电力。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's legs are constantly crackling and sparking, brimming with energy. They can deliver devastating kicks to foes, releasing 20,000 volts of electricity upon contact.

entry: 据说能随意召来雷暴。碰到电池般的蛋，就会变得极具攻击性、凶暴。
author: skleegamer
source: This Pokémon is said to be capable of summoning thunderstorms at its command. Touching its battery-like egg causes the Pokémon to become highly aggressive and violent.

entry: POKENAME从双臂发电脉冲，寻找附近电击怪。找到后视如己出地照料，却在过程中不自觉地吸食对方电力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases pulses of electrical waves from its arms to locate nearby Elekid. Should it find one, it nurtures the Pokémon as if it were its own, unintentionally feeding off its electricity in the process.

entry: POKENAME强壮，用角与尾巴通电，抵御捕食者，保护族群。可性情冲动，一受惊又让整群恐慌。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are brawny Pokémon that defend their herd by channeling electricity through their horns and tails to attack predators. Their impetuous nature causes mass panic within their herd whenever POKENAME are frightened.

entry: POKENAME以两条胡须尖触敌，放出高压电。虽也会电到自己，似乎却只让游泳更快。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can touch the tips of its two whiskers against foes to discharge high-voltage electricity. Although it will also shock itself, this seems to only accelerate the speed at which it swims about.

entry: 以强臂捶胸，威吓敌人，也积起电力。电量足以供一城，可放得太急，反而更可能毁掉电网。
author: .jerden
source: It thumps its chest with its powerful arms, intimidating foes and building up an electrical charge. While its electric output is enough to power a city, it discharges it so rapidly that it is more likely to destroy the power grid.

entry: POKENAME是出了名的独行猎手，会一路跟踪猎物，直到对方疲惫，再迅速发起突袭。它造出雷电凝成的镰刀，劈砍猎物，直到将其烹得恰到好处。
author: bigoljax
source: Known for being a lone hunter, POKENAME will stalk its prey until they tire out, quickly getting the jump on them once they do. It creates scythes made of electricity, using them to hack and slash its quarry until they're perfectly cooked.

entry: POKENAME找到食物不嚼，而留在嘴里，用电慢慢煮。虽然极不卫生，热门餐厅却也使用，只因风险而严守秘密。
author: bigoljax
source: Instead of chewing once it finds food, POKENAME will let its meal rest in its mouth, using its electricity to slowly cook it. Despite how unsanitary it is, this technique is used in popular restaurants but kept a very hidden secret due to the risks.

entry: POKENAME是凶暴蛮兽，不停击落近旁飞行的宝可梦。被渔夫惹怒，就爆发巨大电流，冲向船只，试图掀翻。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME is known to be a violent brute, constantly knocking down any other Pokémon who fly in its vicinity. When angered by Fishermen, it releases a massive burst of electricity, rushing over to their boats and attempting to flip them over.

entry: POKENAME不断抽走发电厂的电，只为好玩。被发现就快转尾巴，闪出强光，借机溜走。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME constantly drain power from power plants for fun. Whenever spotted, POKENAME will spin their tails quickly, creating a flash of light that lets them get away.

entry: POKENAME愤怒时，鬃毛会产生电场，释放出强劲的电击。它炽热的双尾，还能充当火焰喷射器，既能捕猎，也能迎战敌人。
author: heal_fire
source: When POKENAME's is angry, its mane generates an electric field that it can project as a powerful electric discharge. Its twin tails are burning hot and can act like flamethrowers, either for hunting prey or for fighting its enemies.

entry: 占卜者用POKENAME判断运气。它向随机方向射出五道弱雷，只有极倒霉的才会中。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Fortune tellers use POKENAME as a way of determining luck. It will fire off five weak thunderbolts in random directions. Only the extremely misfortunate get hit.

entry: POKENAME不断探索海底，始终带着电荷，以光引路。捕食者若想偷袭，自己还未被察觉，就已严重麻痹。
author: bigoljax
source: As it constantly explores the bottom of the sea, POKENAME keeps a constant electrical charge, letting the light lead the way. Because of this charge, when predators try to get the jump on it, they get badly paralyzed without even being noticed.

entry: POKENAME优雅飞过天空，每次振翅都发电，雷声轰响。许多渔夫说，曾见它俯冲抓住整只吼鲸王，带离海面。
author: bigoljax
source: As POKENAME gracefully flies across the sky, its wings begin to produce electricity, making loud booms with each flap. Many Fishermen tell stories of it flying across the ocean, swooping down to grab entire Wailord and carrying them away.

entry: POKENAME沿睡莲叶跳跃，身后一路电花闪烁。天性快乐，可兴奋过头便好动得让近旁宝可梦十分烦恼。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME hops and skips along lily pads, leaving a trail of sparks and electricity behind it as it goes. Its joyous nature can quickly get too much when it gets excited, with this hyper behavior often leaving other Pokémon nearby deeply annoyed.

entry: POKENAME通过光合作用产生大量电力，再用电线般的藤蔓电击捕食者。电击的威力足以让小型虫宝可梦麻痹。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME generates large amounts of electricity through photosynthesis and will zap predators with its wire-like vines. The shock is strong enough to paralyze small bug Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME常与可可波共同捕猎。给伙伴覆上能导电却防电伤的凝胶，自己在旁等待。强敌一咬诱饵，便精准放电，一击电昏。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME often hunts alongside Arper. It coats its partner in a conductive gel that prevents electrocution, then waits nearby. When a stronger Pokémon bites the bait, POKENAME releases a precise electric surge, instantly knocking the attacker out.

entry: 双鞭若在空中振动，就代表雷暴将至。POKENAME背上有太阳能转电的线圈，让电流遍全身，始终灵活。
author: fiordaliso
source: If its whips vibrate in midair, a lightning storm is on the way. On its back, POKENAME carries a coil that converts solar energy into electricity, which it disperses throughout its body to stay always nimble.

entry: POKENAME偏爱电流四溢之处，安静浮着。有人猜它是在警告，可科学家观察行为后，觉得似乎只是兴奋。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME gravitates to places with high amounts of electrical current running free, where it silently floats. Some have suggested that this was to serve as a warning, but from what scientists have seen of its behavior, it seems it's just excited.

entry: POKENAME角能导电，并善用这点。夹拢角尖，灌入电流，再猛撞敌人。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's horns have the ability to conduct electricity, which they use to their advantage. They pinch the tips of their horns, fueling them with electricity, before ramming them into their opponents.

entry: POKENAME常在风暴天空中飞过，身后拖着道道电光。铁炮鱼想搭它的便车，都会先犹豫再三。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME are often observed drawing trails of lightning behind them across stormy skies. Remoraid think twice about hitching a ride on this Pokémon.

entry: 为发挥全部力量，会将鼻尖插进电源。充满后，就能从獠牙释放巨大电击。
author: brammekuh
source: To achieve its full power, it plugs the end of its trunk into a power source. Once fully charged, it can release immense electric shocks from its tusks.

entry: POKENAME经电缆般的尾巴排出余电。脾气不稳，一受惊就乱甩尾，雷电射向四方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME vents out excess electrical energy through the cable that makes up its tail. It has a volatile temper, and reacts to any surprises by flailing the tail about, shooting lightning in every direction.

entry: POKENAME战斗时将双尾尖相抵，头顶着地旋转，产生巨大电流。动作掀起漩涡，拉来敌人，一边电击，一边施以闪电般的连踢。
author: shyguy11011
source: During battle, POKENAME presses the tips of its two tails together while spinning on its head, generating immense electric surges. This motion creates a vortex dragging in nearby foes, shocking them along side a barrage of lighting fast kicks.

entry: 这只麻烦的融合体常逃离训练家，去找音箱，把音乐开到很大。必须赶紧阻止，因为偏爱超过160分贝的音乐。
author: epping_forest
source: This very problematic fusion has the habit of running away from its Trainer to look for a speaker so it can turn the music up loud. When they do this, they must be stopped immediately, as they tend to enjoy music over 160 dB.

entry: POKENAME在农场被饲养，充当可再生电力来源。只要一个农场的群体，就能为整座城供电。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME are kept on farms as a renewable source of electricity. Just one farm of POKENAME are capable powering an entire city.

entry: POKENAME的蛋像电池，储存电能。双尾能放出心形粉红电弧，既攻击敌人，也给伙伴补充能量。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's egg functions like a battery to store electrical energy. POKENAME can discharge heart-shaped arcs of pink electricity from its tails, using these to attack foes but also to energize allies.

entry: POKENAME只在猛烈雷暴中被目击。据说会引发风暴，击倒竞争者，好轻松捕猎。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME have only been spotted during intense thunderstorms. It is said they cause these thunderstorms to strike down competition so they can catch prey more easily.

entry: POKENAME闪电形的尾尖能拆下，如回旋镖般掷出。装回之前，尾巴不断倾泻电火花，显露体内惊人的储电。
author: sk372
source: The bolt-shaped tip of POKENAME's tail is removable, and can be flung like a boomerang. Electric sparks copiously spill out of the tail until the tip is replaced, a testament to how much voltage POKENAME stores internally.

entry: 有人好奇把电击魔兽与鸭嘴炎兽融合会怎样，这便是误入歧途的好奇产物。双拳打出强力火焰拳与雷电拳，掌中火球爆炸足以炸出大坑。
author: infinex21
source: The result a misguided curiosity of what would happen if an Electivire were fused with a Magmortar. Its fists unleash strong Fire Punches and Thunder Punches. The fireballs loosed from its open palms explode with crater-forming might.

entry: 训练家被负面情绪淹没时，POKENAME会以双尾电击。尽心照料它，便能收获临战冷静的心境，与奋战不懈的伙伴。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME uses its twin tails to shock its Trainers if they become overcome with negative emotion. Trainers who raise POKENAME dutifully are rewarded with a cool head in battle and a partner who fights relentlessly.

entry: 双尾尖抵住敌人，释放超过2,000伏电力。若电量不足，或只是累了，就会蜷成球，更好地防御。
author: infinex21
source: It presses the tips of its two tails against foes and electrocutes them with over 2,000 volts of power. If it runs low on power or is merely exhausted, it will curl into a ball to better defend itself.

entry: POKENAME在尾端夹钳间发电，如电击器般麻痹猎物。再用弹簧状双腿缠住，以雷电般速度飞回巢。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME generate electricity between the tongs in their tails to act as a taser and paralyze prey. They wrap up prey in their coil-like legs and fly back to their nests at the speed of lightning.

entry: POKENAME獠牙最高能放20,000伏电。移动时持续充电，越充越强，牙上蓝色电花噼啪作响。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME can release up to 20,000 volts from its tusks. It charges its electricity as it moves, blue sparks crackling from its tusks as it amplifies.

entry: POKENAME獠牙最高能放20,000伏电。移动时持续充电，越充越强，牙上蓝色电花噼啪作响。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME can release up to 20,000 volts from its tusks. It charges its electricity as it moves, blue sparks crackling from its tusks as it amplifies.

entry: POKENAME发电快慢，与寄宿电脑的时钟频率一致。喷电流的尾巴能瞬间充活没电的设备，代价却是清空其中全部数据。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME generates electricity at the same pace as the clock speed on the computer it's in. It can use its electric jolt-spewing tail to instantly charge up dead devices at the cost of wiping out all the data they contained.

entry: POKENAME用头上的电缆吸电，再经鳍分散。尾鳍如避雷针，赶在雷电伤害当地林地前，将能量集中收下。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use the cables on their head to siphon electricity before dispersing it through their fins. Their tail fins act as lightning rods, concentrating and collecting energy before lightning can damage their local woodlands.

entry: POKENAME双尾擦过表面，放出微火花，记住接触物的准确颜色。遇险就迅速变成最后记住的颜色，盼着伪装够好，能逃走。
author: bigoljax
source: As it drags both tails along a surface, POKENAME releases faint sparks, memorizing the exact color of whatever it's touching. When in danger, it'll quickly change into the last color it remembered, hoping it camouflages itself well enough to escape.

entry: POKENAME身体几乎全是电，因此住进电池。使用这类电池，便让它进入设备，通常会灌入过量能量，弄坏机器。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will make their homes in batteries since their bodies are made almost entirely of electricity. Using a battery inhabited by these Pokémon will allow them to enter the device, usually overloading it with energy and breaking it.

entry: POKENAME能以两条长钢尾感知人类与宝可梦的波导。轻触便将体内大量电力送入没电物件，让它们重新“活”过来。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can perceive the aura of people and Pokémon through its two long steel tails. With its touch, it transfers the large amount of electrical energy stored in its body into discharged objects, bringing them back to life.

entry: POKENAME能以两条长钢尾感知人类与宝可梦的波导。轻触便将体内大量电力送入没电物件，让它们重新“活”过来。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can perceive the aura of people and Pokémon through its two long steel tails. With its touch, it transfers the large amount of electrical energy stored in its body into discharged objects, bringing them back to life.

entry: POKENAME以体内不断生成的电力，重新启动发电机与电池。感知到恶意灵魂，便放电花击退，不让靠近。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME reactivates generators and batteries by infusing them with the electrical energy it constantly produces within its body. If it senses a malicious soul, it strikes them with its sparks to keep them at bay.

entry: POKENAME身形灵巧，跑得极快。尾巴能钩住其他宝可梦，让危险电流传进敌人体内。
author: bigoljax
source: With their nimble bodies, POKENAME can run at very high speeds. Their tails can catch onto other Pokémon, causing their dangerous electricity to conduct through their foe.

entry: POKENAME背上线圈收回尾巴逸出的电，存着留待战斗。线圈还引雷，让放电量甚至超过整座发电厂的产能。
author: bigoljax
source: The coil on POKENAME's back collects any electricity that zaps off its tails, keeping it in storage until needed in battle. These coils also attract lightning bolts, making POKENAME able to shoot out more electricity than entire power plants produce.

entry: POKENAME头上的夹具帮助维持供电，常在电箱旁休息，方便快充。突然受惊，就夹住惊吓源放电，再慌忙跑走。
author: bigoljax
source: The clamps connected to POKENAME's head help it keep itself powered, usually seen resting near electrical boxes so it can get a quick charge. If suddenly surprised, it'll clasp onto whatever surprises it, shocking them and skittishly running off.

entry: POKENAME头上的电球如同发电机，还能将电力传至尾巴，进一步增强打击力。
author: chorb33
source: The electric sphere on POKENAME's head acts as a generator, which can also pass the generated electricity on to its tail to further amplify strikes.

entry: POKENAME面对敌人，会任自己先挨一下，再以猛烈电击反击。战后常捶胸示威，放出电流，沿途留下雷击石。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: When faced with a foe, POKENAME allow themselves to take the first hit, retaliating with a devastating shock. They are known to thump their chests after battles in displays of dominance, discharging electricity and leaving fulgurite in their wake.

entry: POKENAME是粗暴恶霸，常在发电厂添乱，攻击工人，只为接近电源，抽电维生。
author: hobiewankenobi
source: POKENAME is a brutish thug, often considered a nuisance around power plants where it will attack workers to get at and siphon power to sustain itself.

entry: POKENAME敲击电线迸出火花，威吓别人。据说电到活物时，电光会短暂照亮对方的灵魂。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME knocks its wires together to create sparks as an intimidation display. It is said that when it shocks a living creature, one can briefly see the creature's very soul illuminated by POKENAME's electricity.

entry: POKENAME尾上的电来自胃中无尽电场。肚子能像巨颚般张开，猛放雷电，同时击倒数十个敌人。
author: sk372
source: The electricity seen in POKENAME's tail comes from an endless electrical field within its stomach. It can open up its stomach like a jaw to unleash a devastating burst of lightning bolts capable of downing dozens of foes at once.

entry: 鬃毛由纯等离子体构成，亮度随心情变化。POKENAME拳力惊人，一拳就能打碎大石。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its mane is made of pure plasma, and its brightness changes depending on its mood. POKENAME can deliver punches so powerful that it can shatter even large boulders with a single blow.

entry: 鬃毛由纯等离子体构成，亮度随心情变化。POKENAME拳力惊人，一拳就能打碎大石。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its mane is made of pure plasma, and its brightness changes depending on its mood. POKENAME can deliver punches so powerful that it can shatter even large boulders with a single blow.

entry: POKENAME伸出的刀刃如夹钳，扣住敌人，不停电击，直到对方挣脱。格外欣赏活力四射的训练家，危险时甚至愿被他们持用。
author: bigoljax
source: The blades protruding from POKENAME are used as clamps, grabbing onto its opponent and constantly shocking them until they escape. It has quite an interest in Trainers with electrifying personalities, even letting them wield it in times of danger.

entry: 角越长，POKENAME能传导的电力就越多。电流呈独特红色，很善于吓住别人。
author: bigoljax
source: As their horns grow longer, POKENAME are able to conduct more electricity. Their electricity comes out in a distinct red coloring, making them excellent at making others fear them.

entry: POKENAME战斗时从触须放出数千伏电力。长久激战后，需要许多时间给体内电池充电。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME expels thousands of volts of electricity at foes during combat through its feelers. After prolonged battles, it requires significant time to recharge its internal battery.

entry: POKENAME游经的海域，总会紧随猛烈的雷暴飓风，水手只要靠近便极其危险。
author: elekboy88
source: Any area POKENAME swims under is followed by a violent thunderstorm-hurricane, making it extremely dangerous for sailors to be anywhere near it.

entry: POKENAME体内电流奔涌，身上条纹便亮起强光。释放的雷击强得能在地壳凿出深坑。
author: sk372
source: The lines across POKENAME's body glow bright as electricity courses through its body. Lightning unleashed by POKENAME strikes with enough force to carve deep divots through the planet's crust.

entry: POKENAME将庞大蓄电导向体内，激发储存的热量。尖刺转红，就代表即将从每根刺喷出汹涌烈焰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME channels its vast electrical stores inwards to stimulate internal heat stores. When its spines turn red, it's about to unleash torrents of fire from every spike.

entry: POKENAME飞行时不断从臭氧层吸收周围能量。下降地面时，速度与爆发力宛如最强雷击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is constantly absorbing ambient energy from the ozone layer while in flight. When it descends to the ground, it does so with all the explosive force and speed of the mightiest of lightning bolts.

entry: POKENAME引导脚下大地的能量，化成体内电力。双手一握，便造出雷电风暴，足以在地上劈出深沟。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME channels energy from the ground beneath it and turns it into internal electricity. Clasping its hands together creates a maelstrom of lightning bolts that can carve deep gashes in the ground.

entry: POKENAME电线不断释放能量，靠近十分危险。炮管蓄起的电击，强得能直接汽化一座山。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is constantly discharging energy from its wires, making it dangerous to get near. Its cannon can charge up electrical blasts strong enough to vaporize a mountain outright.

entry: POKENAME放电时还撒孢子，危险得不能吸入。吸入者说，仿佛体内不断遭电击，有些甚至突然因此心脏病发作。
author: bigoljax
source: As it fires electricity, POKENAME releases spores that are too dangerous to breathe in. Victims who have inhaled these spores describe being constantly shocked from the inside, with some suddenly having heart attacks because of the shocks.

entry: POKENAME亢奋活跃，跳个不停，也不停放电。光安抚就要几小时，常又因突然兴奋而前功尽弃。
author: bigoljax
source: Many describe POKENAME as hyper and energetic, constantly hopping up and down and releasing electricity. It takes several hours just to calm it down, with attempts often being in vain due to something suddenly exciting it.

entry: POKENAME以高压电造出等离子拳，把敌人打得稀烂。只有至少2个插头的电子设备，才可安全进入；再少，就会因过载烧坏。
author: soup1900
source: Using its high-voltage electricity, POKENAME creates fists made of plasma to smash opponents to a pulp. It can only safely enter electronics that have 2 or more plugs; any less, and the device will be fried due to the overload of electricity.

entry: POKENAME头颈周围有数千根通电电线，看似毛发。有时恶作剧求抚摸，答应的对象便会收到一记“提神”电击。
author: pattybgoode
source: Around POKENAME's head and neck are thousands of live wires that have the appearance of hair or fur. As a prank, it may ask to be pet, only for the one who obliges the request to receive a rousing shock.

entry: POKENAME藏在学校、办公室，伪装配电箱。清洁或维修人员想开盖，就用电线裹住对方，尽全力电击。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME hides itself inside schools and offices, mimicking the appearance of a breaker box. When any janitors or maintenance workers try to open its hatch, it'll wrap its wire around them, producing as much electricity as it can to shock them.

entry: 住在风暴频繁的高山，用尾尖接雷。战斗时，两根斧状巨牙间涌动的电力超过20,000伏。
author: infinex21
source: It lives atop tall mountains where storms are frequent, catching lightning bolts upon the tip of its tail. In battle, over 20,000 volts of electricity surge across both of its axe-like tusks.

entry: 据说远听POKENAME振翅宛如雷鸣。羽毛噼啪闪着高压电，俯冲时强光一闪，身后只留焦土。
author: potato_tub
source: It is said that POKENAME's wingbeats sound like thunder from afar. Its feathered coat crackles with high-voltage energy as it divebombs prey in a blinding flash, leaving only scorched ground in its wake.

entry: POKENAME每颗头都能放出电压高得几乎无法估量的雷电。背部触须吸收空气中的潜藏能量，始终充电。
author: sk372
source: Each of POKENAME's heads are capable of discharging lightning at near-incalculable levels of voltage. The tendrils on its back absorb latent energies in the air to keep it constantly charged with electricity.

entry: POKENAME一夜就能吸干整座城的电力。电击中蕴含的力量，甚至足以引发突变。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can drain an entire city of its electricity in a single night. Its electrical attacks contain enough power to cause mutations.

entry: POKENAME双尾拍地，溅火花，警告靠近者。再将雷电抛向角，从角上射向四方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME slaps its twin tails on the ground to shed sparks about as a warning sign to people getting too close. The tails toss lightning to its horns that then shoot out in all directions.

entry: POKENAME进攻时，把电线中的雷电送进巨颚。一张嘴，大量电流便向外爆发，电击面前一切。
author: sk372
source: When going on the offensive, POKENAME channels lightning from its wires into its large jaw. The moment it opens its mouth, a large burst of electricity erupts outward to shock anything in front of it.

entry: POKENAME以巨臂移动。尾尖碰上獠牙，便能传导、引导超过2,000伏的纯电力。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their massive arms to traverse their environments. By touching the tips of their tails to their tusks, they can channel and direct over 2,000 volts of pure electricity.

entry: 野生POKENAME以毁灭性的雷电拳与尖牙互斗。巨大前臂一抓，多数敌人便逃不掉。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME will clash with one another using destructive Thunder Punches and their sharp tusks. Most foes cannot escape the grip of their large forearms.

entry: POKENAME走过洞穴时，让尾巴通电，当临时打火器。尾巴一亮，宝石与晶体便开始吸来，让它拖着一大串宝贝前进。
author: bigoljax
source: As it travels through caves, POKENAME will conduct electricity through its tail, making an improvised lighter. Once its tail is lit, gems and crystals will start to be attracted to it, leaving POKENAME to drag a large collection of goodies behind it.

entry: POKENAME双翼里藏着伸缩触须，碰到什么都能送入强电。耳中声波如雷鸣，能震散暴风云。
author: infinex21
source: Within an POKENAME's wings lie extendable feelers that can easily direct powerful electricity into whatever they touch. The sonic waves loosed from its ears are reminiscent of thunder and can split apart storm clouds.

entry: POKENAME跑得比闪电快，能在雷击半途截住，借这份电力推动飞行。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME runs faster than lightning, allowing it to intercept lightning bolts mid-strike. It uses this electricity to power its flight.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，以厚毛吸收冲击，转成体内的强电荷。再以雷电般速度移动，或打出猛烈重拳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME build up a powerful electric charge within their bodies as they fight, absorbing impacts with their thick fur and converting it into charge. They can unleash this energy in lightning-fast movements or devastating punches.

entry: POKENAME倚尾后仰再弹向前，模仿摔跤手借擂台绳反弹。等待起扑时不断蓄电，攻击一中，就传给对手。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME will lean back against its tail and launch itself forward, mimicking a wrestler bouncing off the ring ropes. As it waits to launch, electricity will continuously charge inside it, which is transmitted to its opponent when its attack lands.

entry: 大城市视POKENAME为害兽，满金市等有购物中心的地方尤其如此。会接进空插座抽电，常造成短时停电。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are considered pests by large cities, especially those with shopping malls such as Goldenrod City. POKENAME will plug into empty sockets and siphon electricity, often causing temporary blackouts.

entry: POKENAME身上长长的线状真菌，带着强大电荷。电一下，就能瞬间烧穿木头。
author: .izik
source: The long wire-like fungus growing from POKENAME's body carries a strong electrical charge. A single shock can burn through wood instantly.

entry: POKENAME用纯电手里剑掷向敌人。若过去一周内遭过雷击，手里剑就会长到平常十倍大。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME creates shuriken composed entirely of electricity to hurl at its foes. Should it have been struck by lightning within the past week, these shuriken will grow to ten times their normal size.

entry: POKENAME爆炸威力等于30只顽皮雷弹。真炸开时，便是一阵陨石与雷电的暴雨。
author: loikthescreamo
source: An POKENAME has the same explosive power as 30 Electrodes. If it does explode, it would result in a shower of meteorite and electricity.

entry: POKENAME埋伏地下，头藏在地表之下。谁踩到，双尾就会弹出，施以强烈电击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lies in wait underground, burying its head just below the surface. When stepped on, its two tails pop up to deliver a powerful electric shock.

entry: POKENAME的三颗头虽同属一个身体，性格却各不相同，训练家很难全部讨好。最大的头最凶暴，最小的则最爱玩。
author: .jerden
source: Although they are all part of the same body, the three heads of POKENAME each have their own personality, making it challenging for Trainers to please them all. The largest is the most aggressive, while the smallest is the most playful.

entry: POKENAME的三颗头虽同属一个身体，性格却各不相同，训练家很难全部讨好。最大的头最凶暴，最小的则最爱玩。
author: .jerden
source: Although they are all part of the same body, the three heads of POKENAME each have their own personality, making it challenging for Trainers to please them all. The largest is the most aggressive, while the smallest is the most playful.

entry: POKENAME泳技高超，又耐电，能帮助电工处理水下电缆。可长期潜水，修理电压高达500千伏的受损电缆。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME help electricians deal with underwater cables with their superb swimming ability and resistance to electricity. They can remain submerged for long periods of time while they fix damaged cables that can reach 500 kilovolts.

entry: POKENAME发怒时，能把强烈怒气化为攻击力。此时，它能产生数千瓦特的电力。
author: lemmymaster
source: When angered, POKENAME can channel its potent rage into increased attack power. In this state, it can produce many thousands of watts of electricity.

entry: POKENAME大声吠叫，能电到附近宝可梦，却显然无意伤人。玩得太兴奋就蓄电，几秒便猛冲过整片森林。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's loud barks are able to cause nearby Pokémon to be shocked, though it clearly doesn't mean to harm others. When it gets too excited from playing, it'll charge up electricity and suddenly bolt across entire forests in mere seconds.

entry: 传闻，POKENAME的电击强得能在片刻间烧焦林木。宽翼让它飞过风暴天空，再以双尾吸收雷电，补充能量。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is rumored that POKENAME's electric strikes are so powerful they can scorch forest trees in moments. Its wide wings allow it to soar through stormy skies, recharging its body by absorbing lightning with its twin tails.

entry: POKENAME蓄电时磨牙，增强电荷。每颗牙都带大量电力，因此雷电牙格外强劲。
author: sk372
source: When charging up electricity, POKENAME will grind its teeth against each other, amplifying the charge. Each tooth carries a large amount of electricity within, making its Thunder Fang move particularly potent.

entry: POKENAME把两个尾尖抵在头上电击自己，刺激脑波，释放全部潜力。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME holds the two tips of its tails to its head to shock itself. This procedure stimulates its brain waves and unleashes its full potential.

entry: POKENAME看似一动不动，其实出拳快得肉眼难辨。盯得太久，拳边激起的静电，还会让眼睛永久失明。
author: teatedtiten
source: It might seem to be standing still, but in reality POKENAME punches faster than the eye can see. Stare at it for too long, and the ambient static of its punches can cause permanent blindness.

entry: 电力在POKENAME巨肌中涌动，陌生人一碰便被灼伤。战斗以四臂按住敌人，再放出足以给五十辆车供电的高压电。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Electricity thrums through the large muscles of POKENAME, singeing any stranger who touches it. In combat, they use their four arms to pin foes down, then electrocute them with enough voltage to power fifty cars.

entry: POKENAME风暴时起飞，以长尾接雷补能。遇到同类，就发起激烈的全力决斗，试探实力。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME takes flight during storms to capture lightning with its long tails and replenish its energy. When it meets others of its kind, it tests their strength by challenging them to fierce, all-out duels.

entry: POKENAME触手分泌强毒，配合电力，让一切靠近的对象麻痹。
author: shocktopus1717
source: POKENAME's tentacles secrete a potent poison. It uses this in tandem with its electricity, paralyzing anything that draws near.

entry: POKENAME悠闲浮在水面下，只探头看看障碍。潜水者一碰触手就会立刻麻痹，得赶紧带出水，免得沉没。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME passively floats underneath the surface, only peeking its head out to check for possible obstacles. If a diver touches one of its tentacles, they'll be instantly paralyzed and need to be quickly brought out of the water before they sink.

entry: POKENAME像隆隆岩一样每年蜕壳。旧壳石头含近20,000瓦电力，能用于制造电池。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME sheds its shell yearly just like Golem. The stones from its molted shells contain nearly 20,000 watts of electricity, which are used to manufacture batteries.

entry: POKENAME低下角时，雷电便猛烈劈落，毫无预警。曾有整片草原在它狂奔肆虐后，被烧得焦黑。
author: mepp.
source: When POKENAME lowers its horn, lightning strikes wildly and without warning. Entire grasslands have been scorched after this Pokémon was seen running amok.

entry: 电电虫会攀住POKENAME的电线吸电。要不是它们那么好吃，这本来会让POKENAME烦恼。
author: hophoppip
source: Joltik latch onto POKENAME's wires to feed on its electricity. This would bother POKENAME if the Joltik weren't so tasty.

entry: POKENAME先用水浇透敌人，再释放雷电。海上船只靠它修设备，风暴时尤其倚重。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME soak their foes in water before unleashing bolts of electricity. Ships out at sea rely on POKENAME to help fix equipment issues, especially during a storm.

entry: POKENAME受威胁便用钳夹住敌人肢体。若刺穿身体，就会竭尽电力电击。
author: bigoljax
source: Whenever threatened, POKENAME will use their claws to snap onto their foes limbs. If they pierce through the opponent's body, they will use as much electricity as they can to shock them.

entry: POKENAME在沙里滚动，铁屑黏满壳，显得尖刺丛生。铁屑也让电力更强劲。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's shell is covered in iron filings from rolling in sand, giving the shell its spiky look. The iron filings help make its electricity more potent.

entry: 火山能量流过四肢，在体内积起巨大压力。一到极限，POKENAME便伴着爆发烈焰冲出，留下焦黑巨坑与硫磺烟霭。
author: jaminmcready
source: It channels volcanic energy through its limbs which builds up immense internal pressure. When the pressure reaches a tipping point, POKENAME launches forward in explosive bursts of flame, leaving behind scorched craters and a sulfuric haze.

entry: 离POKENAME太近，甚至会让人熔化。身上不停滴落超过7000度的火焰。
author: mistymagius
source: Being too close to a POKENAME will cause anyone to melt. Its body is constantly dripping flames of over 7000 degrees.

entry: POKENAME不及普通鸭嘴炎兽火力充足。竭力才能从手中射出火墙，却也可能因此将自己彻底燃尽。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lacks the full firepower of a standard Magmortar. With great effort, it can blast walls of flames from its hands, though this comes at the risk of potentially burning itself out completely in the process.

entry: POKENAME肩上炮管能喷射猛烈火柱。无聊时，会用角敲打住着的火山内壁，直到火山喷发。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can shoot violent jets of fire from the cannons positioned above its shoulders. When bored, it bangs its horns against the walls of the volcanoes where it lives until they erupt.

entry: POKENAME自卫时放出压倒性火海。狩猎却为保持美味，改用紧束，慢慢耗尽猎物体力，直到再也不动。
author: bobosmith01
source: To defend itself properly, POKENAME lets loose an overwhelming swathe of flame. To make sure its prey stays delectable, when hunting, it uses Wrap, slowly tiring out their meal until the prey can no longer move.

entry: 它把家安在狭窄的火山喷气孔内。一遭打扰，便从尾巴射出火球。
author: busilisk
source: It finds its home within narrow volcanic vents. If disturbed, it will launch fireballs from its tail.

entry: 大嘴唇几乎总带笑，哪怕双臂正喷灼热烈焰。住在熔岩池里，吃火山岩，似乎如煤般助燃体内火焰。
author: infinex21
source: The large lips of these Pokémon are almost always turned up in a grin, even as they loose scorching flames from their arms. They nest within pools of lava and eat volcanic rocks, which seem to act like coal to their inner flames.

entry: POKENAME能从手里放出比自己还大的火球，再轻松以念力操控，追击目标。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can fire bursts of fire bigger than its own body from its hands. These massive fireballs are then effortlessly controlled by telekinesis to home in on their targets.

entry: POKENAME以烈焰臂炮当喷射背包，靠爆发力冲上天空，起飞后留下焦痕与破碎地面。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME can use its blazing arm cannons like a Jetpack, rocketing through the air with explosive force. Its takeoffs leave scorched trails and shattered terrain behind.

entry: POKENAME协助除害公司清除真菌，烧焦菌丝网络，防止生长，也阻止孢子传播。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME works alongside pest control companies to eradicate fungi from a given location. It prevents fungal growth by charring mycelium networks, stopping the spread of spores.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，火红羽毛与拖曳烈焰，让人误以为是传说中的宝可梦。羽毛离身许久，依旧温暖。
author: bobosmith01
source: The fiery feathers and flames that trail behind POKENAME mid-flight have caused some to mistake it for a Pokémon found in legends. POKENAME's feathers remain warm for a long time, even after being detached from its body.

entry: POKENAME边舞边散出强热。火焰越炽热，头顶花朵就越美。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME radiate intense heat as they dance. The hotter their flames, the more beautiful the flowers on their heads become.

entry: POKENAME用超能力将烈焰塑成比身体还大的火球，吓退敌人。也能先定住对方，再以火流轰击。
author: infinex21
source: Using their psychic powers, POKENAME mold their intense flames into fireballs larger than themselves to scare away foes. They can using these powers to hold opponents in place before blasting them with streams of fire.

entry: POKENAME聪明，却脾气火爆，容易被别人惹烦。越烦躁，头上壳里便漏出越多火，直到整顶帽盖都燃起。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME has great intellect, it also has a fiery temper and is easily annoyed by others. Fire begins leaking from the shell on its head as it gets more agitated, until the entire cap is aflame.

entry: POKENAME从身体两侧的尖端喷出双重火流。上半身燃烧的火代表蓄火量；一熄灭，便无法喷火，得补能数小时。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fires twin blasts of flame from the two points on either side. The burning flames on its upper half signify its fire stores; once they smolder out, it can no longer shoot fire and must recharge for several hours.

entry: 制作一边的耳环时，常建议请POKENAME熔金，因为能精确控制高温。持续保温，方便细致塑金，很受工匠欢迎。
author: jaminmcready
source: To make a Lone Earring, it is often recommended to use a POKENAME to melt the gold due to its ability to generate controlled high temperatures. It can maintain heat long enough to shape metal with precision, making it popular with artisans.

entry: POKENAME曾被当作精锐士兵，备受尊敬。对战时先用燃烧的角掀翻敌人，再将其点燃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME were held in high esteem as elite soldiers. During a Pokémon battle, they flip over their opponents with their flaming horn before setting them aflame.

entry: POKENAME能从壳上的炮状突起喷出白热熔岩。在火山间移动时，用来造陆桥，跨过水域。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME can fire a stream of white-hot lava from the cannonlike extension on its shell. When traveling between volcanoes, it uses this ability to form land bridges for crossing bodies of water.

entry: POKENAME野外极稀少，只在海边火山附近的热水中被发现。尾能战斗、推进，喷火、放气与烟雾，睡时也会护住。
author: bobosmith01
source: Thought to be extremely rare in the wild, POKENAME has only been found near the hot waters of a seaside volcano. Its tail can be used for both battle and propulsion; able to launch fire, gas, and smog, POKENAME protects the tail while it sleeps.

entry: POKENAME混进弱小宝可梦的群落，靠恐吓夺取首领之位，再以尾炮保护部下。
author: pokopish
source: POKENAME will infiltrate a community of weaker Pokémon and take leadership through intimidation. It protects its underlings with its tail cannon.

entry: POKENAME打法残暴，以强壮、末端敞开的手臂抓住敌头，再喷猛烈火焰。越愤怒，火越热。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are brutal fighters that will grab the heads of their opponents with their strong, open-ended arms and blast them with intense flames. The angrier they are, the hotter their flames will become.

entry: POKENAME向下排热气悬浮，通常满足于闲闲漂着。年轻捕食者若以为能白吃，可要吃惊：危急时会向下猛喷火，像火箭般升空。
author: deadshields
source: POKENAME expels hot air below to remain afloat in mid-air, usually content idly drifting about. Young predators seeing it as a free meal are in for a shock, however, as it can blast a great jet of flame downwards to take off like a rocket in a pinch.

entry: POKENAME骑着火箭般的尾巴，放出燃烧雷电推进。鲜亮花纹让它很受农历新年活动欢迎，也会帮忙点烟花。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME ride their tails like rockets and release flaming bolts of lightning to propel themselves forward. Their bright markings make them popular during lunar new year events where they help ignite fireworks.

entry: POKENAME即使最寒冷时也活跃，以突然喷发的炽热火流击倒猎物。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME remain active even in the coldest of weather. They take down prey using sudden blasts of intense heat.

entry: 在双臂末端加热岩石，留在里面不断增压。等石头开始熔化，才当弹丸发射。
author: .jerden
source: It heats up rocks inside the ends of its arms. It holds them in there as the pressure builds, only firing them out as projectiles when the rock begins to melt.

entry: 有人好奇融合鸭嘴炎兽与电击魔兽会怎样，便造出它。火球能碎实心岩石，雷电能熔金属，身子烫手，硬毛带着麻痹电流。
author: infinex21
source: Born from the curiosity of what would happen if one were to fuse a Magmortar with and Electivire. Its fireballs can shatter solid rock and its lightning bolts can melt metal. Its body is hot to the touch and its fur bristles with numbing jolts.

entry: POKENAME双拳一撞，声音如猛烈雷鸣。爱涉过熔岩，因此住在活火山里。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME slams its fists together, it produces a sound like the roar of a violent thunderclap. It loves wading through lava, which is why it dens inside active volcanoes.

entry: 据说POKENAME喷焰温度最高可达华氏4,750度。脾气太急，常被认为不稳定、难训练，出于严重安全顾虑而极少见。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME can spew scorching flames that can reach temperatures believed to be up to 4,750°F. This Pokémon is usually deemed too unstable to train due to its short temper and is thus rarely seen due to extreme safety concerns.

entry: POKENAME讨厌争吵打架，连小口角也不行。一察觉争执，便将双方烧得焦脆，再飞走。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME hates bickering and fighting, even if it's a trivial argument. If it senses there's a quarrel, it will find burn both parties to a complete crisp and fly away.

entry: POKENAME以一个或数个家族组成大群，在火山山脉挖复杂地洞，绵延数英里。受威胁便从尾巴射火球。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME live in large groups composing of one or several families, making complex burrows that can span several miles of volcanic ranges. When threatened, POKENAME launch fireballs from their tails.

entry: POKENAME身边火势一弱，就潜入火山熔岩恢复力量。战斗总找空中有利位置，让致命炮击不受遮挡。
author: fiordaliso
source: If the flames surrounding its body begin to weaken, POKENAME dives into volcanic lava to restore its strength. During battle, it always seeks a favorable position in the air to get a clearer line of fire for its deadly blasts.

entry: POKENAME爱随机发射大激光，配着奇怪的喉音。偏偏开火前还要高声宣布，弄得毫无突袭可言。
author: victor9106
source: POKENAME enjoys shooting large lasers randomly with strange, guttural sound effects. Oddly, it likes to loudly announce that it is firing the laser immediately before attacking with it, ruining any surprise factor.

entry: POKENAME富有同情，能感知其他宝可梦难过或烦躁。为了安慰，会直接烧掉对方面对的问题，试着让其开心。
author: fxncy_poland
source: POKENAME have a lot of compassion for other Pokémon and can sense when they feel upset or agitated. To cheer them up, POKENAME incinerate whatever problem the other Pokémon were facing in an attempt to lighten their mood.

entry: POKENAME每赢一场战斗，体温就会升高一些。它寻找势均力敌的对手，免得热得无人能碰。
author: leshii
source: POKENAME's body temperature rises with each won battle. It seeks a rival that can match its strength, lest it grows too hot to touch.

entry: POKENAME精通礼仪、剑术与射击。恪守荣誉，只自卫作战、援助困者。常在火山附近，磨炼本领至完美。
author: jonclyd
source: POKENAME are masters of courtesy, swordsmanship, and marksmanship. True to their honor, they fight only in defense and aid those in need. They are often found near volcanoes, honing their skills to perfection.

entry: 不败的POKENAME会用强劲炮火轰开荒地，造出熔岩竞技场，等待值得一战的挑战者。
author: leshii
source: An undefeated POKENAME will use its powerful cannons to blast apart barren land, forming a molten arena in which it will wait for a worthy challenger.

entry: 体形巨大，在火山里行走，用粗腿吸热，有时连岩浆也吸收。能缩回爪子，把腿当强炮，向敌人喷火与岩浆。
author: infinex21
source: It is a large Pokémon that walks within volcanos, absorbing the heat and sometimes the very magma itself through its large legs. It can retract its claws to use its own legs as powerful cannons that spew flames and magma and its foes.

entry: POKENAME靠接连不断的冲撞与火山般的火力压倒对手，很少依赖策略。化石周围的地貌表明，它们曾凭蛮力与高热重塑整片景观。
author: ambrosia04
source: Rather than relying on strategy, POKENAME overwhelms opponents with relentless charges and volcanic firepower. The land surrounding its fossils suggest POKENAME once reshaped entire landscapes through sheer force and heat.

entry: POKENAME大多时候都懒洋洋地躺在自己生的火旁。它会把食物烤熟，方便消化，却常因忘了翻面而烤焦。为了省去重新找食物的麻烦，通常照吃不误。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of its time lounging around fires that it creates. It cooks food on the fire to make it easier to digest, but frequently burns it by not turning it often enough. It usually eats it anyway, to avoid having to gather more.

entry: 双手的火焰永不熄灭，因此不想烧伤对手时就以踢击代替拳击。碰到树果等不能烧毁的东西，会用灵巧的尾巴和柔韧的双脚拾取。
author: .jerden
source: The fire in its hands never goes out, so it uses kicks instead of punches if it does not want to burn its opponent. To interact with objects like berries without incinerating them, it picks them up using its nimble tail and flexible feet.

entry: POKENAME的炮能射出足以熔化钢铁的火球，也能装填普通炮弹，将其烧得通红后射出，威力足以摧毁建筑。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's cannon fires out fireballs hot enough to melt steel. It can also load itself with regular cannonballs, firing out red-hot projectiles with enough force to demolish buildings.

entry: POKENAME的炮能射出足以熔化钢铁的火球。溅回的火焰常像是点燃了它的木质身体，实际却不会伤到它。不过，易燃物仍应远离。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's cannon fires out fireballs hot enough to melt steel. While the splashback often appears to set its own wooden body on fire, it is never actually damaged by this, although flammable objects should be kept far away from it.

entry: 构成POKENAME身体的黑色物质全是石墨，使它极能抵御攻击。据说，最年长的个体全身已由钻石构成。
author: turcai_87271
source: The black material that makes up POKENAME's body is made up entirely of graphite, which makes them extremely resistant to attacks. The oldest POKENAME are said to have a body consisting of diamonds.

entry: POKENAME以体内熔炉的热量产生蒸汽，借蒸汽膨胀驱动轮子。移动越快，身体就越热。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's wheels are turned by the expansion of steam inside it, using heat generated by POKENAME's internal furnace. The faster it moves, the hotter its body will become.

entry: 一只POKENAME便能唤出猛烈火墙，再以更多火墙的幻象迷惑、压制对手。爪子既锋利又炽热，连坚硬岩石也能轻易切开。
author: infinex21
source: A single POKENAME can conjure walls of intense flames and illusions of even more flame walls to confuse and overwhelm its opponent. ITs claws are sharp and hot enough to easily slice through solid rock.

entry: POKENAME体内产生的火太多，必须经常从嘴和尾巴排出。战斗时可将火焰拉成长长的缎带状鞭子，挥向敌人，将其灼伤。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body generates so much fire internally that it regularly needs to expel it from its mouth and tail. It can create ribbon-like whips of flame reaching great lengths to swing at and singe any foes in combat.

entry: 头上的巨型迫击炮能发射猛烈火球，连钻石都能熔化，温度可见超过华氏8,200度。
author: soup1900
source: The giant mortar on its head fires powerful fireballs that can melt even diamonds. This means its fire is over 8,200 degrees Fahrenheit.

entry: POKENAME不断与其他宝可梦争夺领地。每次迎战入侵者，灼热火焰都会烧焦脚下的土地。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are in constant territorial disputes with other Pokémon. Their searing hot flames scorch the earth beneath them whenever they fight an intruder.

entry: POKENAME以炮代手，能喷出凶猛火柱。排出的烟气却带着春风般的清香。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The cannons POKENAME has in place of hands fire vicious plumes of flame. The fumes it emits smell like a spring breeze.

entry: POKENAME体内充满气体与火焰，活动起来如同气球。四条手臂喷出的火既用于战斗，也能极精准地控制移动。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME contain gas and fire within themselves, causing them to function and move like balloons. They release flames from their four arms both for battle and to control their movements with remarkable accuracy.

entry: POKENAME会伸长燃烧的拳头攻击别人。真正暴怒或被逼入绝境时，就从头顶扁平的菌盖喷出烈焰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME strikes at others with extending flaming fists. When truly enraged or backed into a corner, it shoots out intense flames from the flat mushroom cap on its head.

entry: 铠甲能承受超过摄氏4000度的高温。POKENAME强劲的喷射火焰，曾烧焦整片地区。
author: chorb33
source: Its armor can withstand temperatures of over 4000 degrees Celsius. POKENAME has already scorched entire regions with its powerful flamethrower.

entry: POKENAME能朝其他宝可梦喷出橙色液体。不过，体内脏器里的液体温度不足以造成威胁，因此这招用于吓退捕食者，而非攻击。
author: fxncy_poland
source: POKENAME is able to spew out an orange liquid at other Pokémon. However, POKENAME use this technique to scare off predators rather than to attack them, as the liquid inside their internal organs isn't hot enough to pose any threat.

entry: 它们翱翔于火山区上空，羽毛如滴落的岩浆般从翅膀落下。一只POKENAME便能极精准地喷出足以熔化岩石的火焰。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon soar across the skies over volcanic areas, feathers falling from their wings like dripping magma. A single POKENAME can breathe rock-melting flames with remarkable precision.

entry: POKENAME的火焰比熔岩还热，能推动自己像战斗机一样飞行。还会以精神力量改变火焰形状，用各种方式压制敌人。
author: infinex21
source: With flames hotter than lava, POKENAME can propel themselves through the air like fighter jets. Using their psychic powers, they can shape their own flames in various ways to overwhelm foes.

entry: 不定形的手臂能融合起来，在两侧各形成一门炮，将体内火焰凝成威力强大的火球。也能用炮状手臂吸取岩浆，代谢后维持体内的火焰。
author: infinex21
source: Their amorphous arms can meld together and form a cannon on each side that can channel their internal flames into powerful fireballs. They can suck up magma with these cannon-like arms and metabolize it to keep their internal flame burning.

entry: 臂上的炮只会射出大量本身无害的花粉。然而花粉极易爆炸，POKENAME只须从口中喷出一记火花，便能将其引燃。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The cannon on its arm only shoots a large amount of harmless pollen. This pollen is very explosive, and POKENAME will ignite it with just an Ember from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME是游荡于火山区的幽灵宝可梦。先以幽灵之力令敌人寒冷，再朝它们轰出火球。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are wandering, spectral Pokémon that roam volcanic regions. Their spectral powers can chill their foes before they blast them with fireballs.

entry: POKENAME的叶子辣得惊人，多数厨师都不愿将其加入任何菜肴。到了冬季，辣味便会减弱许多。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's leaves are intensely spicy, so much so that most chefs refuse to use them in any dish. They lose much of their heat during the winter months.

entry: POKENAME生活在岩浆中，借精准而猛烈的火焰推进游动。会先以利牙凶狠撕咬猎物，再用烈焰将其烧成灰烬。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live and swim within magma, propelled by precise and intense flames. They will brutally rip into prey with their sharp fangs before incinerating them with intense flames.

entry: POKENAME翅膀内有火囊，能喷出强火，加速冲向前方。凡是火焰烧不焦、熔不化的东西，音波攻击都能将其震碎。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have flame sacs within their wings that let them expel powerful fire in order to launch themselves at quicker speeds. Their sonic attacks can pulverize whatever their flames cannot char or melt.

entry: POKENAME过去被称为活火山，会在火山山脉间缓缓跋涉寻找食物。攻击时使用的熔岩温度超过华氏2,000度。
author: chibitales
source: Once known as living volcanoes, POKENAME slowly trudge through volcanic mountain ranges looking for food. The molten rock used in their attacks exceeds temperatures of 2,000°F.

entry: POKENAME花瓣周围的火焰始终高于华氏3,600度。许多训练家把它当作天然炉灶。
author: santon5512
source: The flames around POKENAME's petals constantly burn hotter than 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit. Many Trainers use these Pokémon as natural stovetops.

entry: POKENAME体内储有油，能迅速加热，从双臂喷出火流。将手臂相对，便能汇聚火焰，塑成不同形状，施展不同攻击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME store oil within their bodies that they can rapidly heat to create streams of fire out from their arms. They direct their arms towards each other to concentrate and sculpt out different firey structures for different attacks.

entry: POKENAME是狡猾的小恶徒，游荡沙漠，抢劫旅人的财物。双臂还能射出会爆炸的种子。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME are sly rascals who wander through deserts and rob travelers of their belongings. They can fire explosive seeds from their arms.

entry: 头顶钟状突起能射出狭细的高热光束，足以切开金属。击倒猎物后，POKENAME便用不断啮合的牙齿将其吞食。
author: .jerden
source: The bell-shaped protuberance on its head fires narrow beams of intense heat, hot enough to cut through metal. Once it has used this to bring down prey, POKENAME devours it with its gnashing teeth.

entry: 头顶钟状突起能射出狭细的高热光束，足以切开金属。击倒猎物后，POKENAME便用不断啮合的牙齿将其吞食。
author: .jerden
source: The bell-shaped protuberance on its head fires narrow beams of intense heat, hot enough to cut through metal. Once it has used this to bring down prey, POKENAME devours it with its gnashing teeth.

entry: 覆盖POKENAME身体的蘑菇温热，吃起来极辣。人们常将其加入烤土豆，为菜肴添上美味而持久的辣劲。
author: .izik
source: The warm mushroom covering POKENAME's body is extremely spicy when consumed. It is often mixed into baked potato recipes to bring a delicious, lasting heat to the dish.

entry: POKENAME栖居在火山岛。坚韧的爪子能独特地缩回，让双臂瞬间化为炮管，轰出温度惊人的烈焰。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME makes its home on volcanic islands. Its tough claws are uniquely retractable, instantly converting its arms into cannons from which it blasts its incredibly hot flames.

entry: 它们反复烧灼自身，使外皮变得坚韧，护甲也因此呈现骇人的黑色。壳内有缓缓燃烧的火焰噼啪作响，随时准备在开战时化为熊熊烈火。
author: deadshields
source: The intimidating black colour of their armour is formed by repeatedly scorching themselves to toughen their hide. Within their shell, a slow-burning flame crackles, ready to burst into a great blaze when combat begins.

entry: POKENAME行动敏捷，会借火球留下的黑烟和滚烫水手里剑产生的蒸汽掩护行踪。右臂如同炮管，能协助压缩、释放火焰。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are agile Pokémon that conceal their movements with the black smoke left by their fireballs and the steam from their scalding-hot Water Shuriken. Their right arms are like cannons that help them to compress and release their flames.

entry: POKENAME住在火山内部。用火山热量烤熟猎物，再淋上特制辣酱调味，配方无人知晓。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME dwells inside volcanoes. It cooks its prey with volcanic heat and flavors it with a specially concocted hot sauce, the recipe for which is unknown.

entry: POKENAME总在打理燃烧的头发，务求发型整齐。战斗时收集发间的易燃油脂，甩出火星，制造阵阵爆燃，惊吓并压制对手。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME constantly fuss over their flaming hair to make sure it stays neatly coiffed. They gather flammable oils from their hair to fling out sparks in battle, creating bursts of fire to startle and overwhelm opponents.

entry: 发怒时，烈焰包围双臂，让它更显凶悍。POKENAME脾气火爆，酷爱斗殴，连自己的队友也不放过。
author: fiordaliso
source: When enraged, blazing flames surround its arms, making it even more intimidating. POKENAME has a fiery temper and loves to brawl, even with its own teammates.

entry: 发怒时，烈焰包围双臂，让它更显凶悍。POKENAME脾气火爆，酷爱斗殴，连自己的队友也不放过。
author: fiordaliso
source: When enraged, blazing flames surround its arms, making it even more intimidating. POKENAME has a fiery temper and loves to brawl, even with its own teammates.

entry: 发怒时，烈焰包围双臂，让它更显凶悍。POKENAME脾气火爆，酷爱斗殴，连自己的队友也不放过。
author: fiordaliso
source: When enraged, blazing flames surround its arms, making it even more intimidating. POKENAME has a fiery temper and loves to brawl, even with its own teammates.

entry: POKENAME主要靠打嗝喷出火球自卫。这很适合赶走捕食者，但打喷嚏时也可能酿成危险。
author: atlas3339098
source: POKENAME's primary defense mechanism is belching fireballs. This is well-suited for fending off predators, but it can be dangerous when it sneezes.

entry: POKENAME从头部散出柔和而舒适的暖意，引诱毫无戒心的猎物。待其靠近，便以灼热藤蔓缠住，先烧伤，再吞食。
author: m.a.dd.
source: POKENAME lures unsuspecting prey by radiating a gentle, comforting warmth from its head. When they draw close, it ensnares them with its scorching vine, burning them before they are devoured.

entry: POKENAME几乎一直在蜕皮，皮上渗着岩浆般滚烫的液体。它常把蜕下的皮装进炮状手臂，留待日后射向敌人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are almost-always shedding their hides that ooze a magma-hot fluid. A POKENAME will commonly stock pieces of its own hide in its cannon-like arms to shoot at foes later.

entry: 它在熔岩中沐浴，将热能储于体内，以便在冰冷水域游泳时保暖。趴在浮冰上休息时，会慢慢将冰融穿，直到掉回水里。
author: .jerden
source: It bathes in lava, storing thermal energy within its body to keep it warm while swimming through frigid waters. When it lies on an ice floe to rest, it will gradually melt through it until it falls back into the water.

entry: POKENAME生活在火山区，会潜入岩浆维持体温。大量喝下熔岩后储在体内，等到战斗时再从炮管射出。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives in volcanic areas, submerging itself in magma to keep its body temperature up. It drinks lava in large amounts, storing it internally until it needs to battle, whereupon the molten liquid is fired from its cannons.

entry: 没有争端时，POKENAME的角会散发宜人香气。然而香味会引来捕食者，因此它很少感到安全。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME releases a pleasant aroma from its horn when there is no strife. However, POKENAME rarely feels safe due to the scent attracting potential predators.

entry: POKENAME感受到附近的愤怒或不快情绪时，会以爆炸释放压力。古籍记载，人们曾借它迫使国家缔结和约，否则便会酿成大乱。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME release their stress in the form of an explosion when they feel angry or upset emotions nearby. Ancient records say these Pokémon were used to force treaties between nations as otherwise great havoc would ensue.

entry: POKENAME无论走到哪里都拿着色彩鲜艳的棍棒。一起玩游戏时，便按棍棒的颜色分队。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wield brightly colored clubs wherever they go. These clubs help divide them into teams whenever they begin to play games with each other.

entry: 有些宝可梦爱好者嫌POKENAME天生四肢细长、格斗姿势古怪。然而正是这些特点，让它能抢先出击，同时护住弱点。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although POKENAME's naturally long and lanky limbs and odd fighting stance has been criticized by some Poké Fans, these same traits allow POKENAME to strike first and cover its weak points simultaneously.

entry: POKENAME是海洋中最温和的宝可梦。在水下优雅滑行，任何看见它的鱼都会心境平和。
author: hoppygolucky
source: POKENAME is the most peaceful Pokémon in the ocean. It glides gracefully underwater and brings a calm feeling to any fish who sees it.

entry: POKENAME只住在几乎没有污染的深河里。开心时会跃出水面，身后拖出点点闪光，看到的人都会感到安宁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME only inhabits deep rivers that have little to no pollution in them. It leaps from the river when happy, trailing sparkles behind it. Witnessing the sparkling trail invokes a feeling of placidity in viewers.

entry: POKENAME常去发生纷争的地方，让人们相信，有位看不见的神明，正庇佑着自己。
author: gentlesage
source: POKENAME regularly seeks out areas where there is strife. It can convince others that an unseeable deity is watching over them.

entry: 正如融合后的名字所暗示，POKENAME喜欢与另一只宝可梦相伴。独处太久就会渐渐生气，开始攻击周围的物品。奇怪的是，它经常劝架，自己却也常卷入争斗。
author: lootererswillbeboated
source: As this fusion's name would imply, POKENAME loves being with another Pokémon. If it is alone for too long, it slowly gets angrier and starts attacking objects nearby. This is strange behaviour, as it often stops fights but gets into many itself.

entry: POKENAME极其稀有，据说捉到它的人会有大好运。有些渔夫穷尽整个捕鱼生涯，只为捉到一只。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are incredibly rare and are said to bring great fortune to anyone who catches one. Some fishermen have dedicated their entire careers to catching one of these Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME讨厌争吵。谁心情不好，就去蜇谁，使其狂喜。兴奋感会越来越强，直到对方激动得心脏病发作。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME hates arguments. It stings whoever is upset, causing intense elation. The feelings get more intense until the victim suffers a heart attack from excitement.

entry: POKENAME始终保持冥想，压住体内混乱的能量。每隔几年才会从冥想中醒来，人们将此视为来年和平与好运的征兆。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME maintain a constant state of meditation to contain the chaotic energy within their bodies. Once every few years, POKENAME awaken from their meditation, which has been seen as a sign of peace and fortune in the coming year.

entry: POKENAME性情温和，会照料小岩洞，供其他宝可梦安心栖身。为抚慰疲惫者的忧愁，还会变成让对方感到舒心的模样。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are peaceful creatures that foster small grottos that act as a safe space for other Pokémon. To ease the worries of the weary, POKENAME transform into a form that other Pokémon find comforting.

entry: POKENAME只见于宁静的水岸地区。据说每到一处，便以柔和的雨和独特水泡祝福那片土地。罕见的目击报告称，没有两只的花纹完全相同。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: Only found in peaceful waterfront regions, POKENAME is said to bring gentle rainstorms and form unique water bubbles as sweet blessings to the lands they do visit.  Rare sightings have reported no two have the same exact pattern.

entry: POKENAME会把网络讨论里的负面词语换成正面词语。虽然出于好意，却常把句子改得前言不搭后语。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME replaces negative words in online discussions with positive ones. Though well intentioned, this often renders the sentences incoherent.

entry: POKENAME受沉重外壳拖累，飞得很慢。史前时期，它曾照料受伤的宝可梦。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME flies around at a slow pace, as its shell weighs it down. During prehistoric times, it acted as a caretaker for injured Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME完全能够飞行，却只能短暂飞起。一察觉附近有人拌嘴，就扑闪着飞往别处。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME has full flight capability, but only in short bursts. If POKENAME detects nearby bickering, it simply flitters to a different area.

entry: 它们毫无恶意，却因以情绪为食而被视为危险。有一种学说认为，它们无法控制这项能力，因此总在无意间吸走周围的情绪。
author: infinex21
source: Though these Pokémon display no malice, they are considered dangerous due to how they feed on emotions. Some theories persist that they cannot control this ability, which is why they passively drain emotions from all around them.

entry: POKENAME有“福运之龙”的别称，在野外极难见到。据说，只要瞥见它飞过，便能获得整整一年的好运。
author: sk372
source: Nicknamed "The Dragon of Blessed Fortune," POKENAME is an extremely rare sight to behold in the wild. Catching a glimpse of it in flight is said to bless the witness with a year's worth of good luck.

entry: POKENAME罕有目击，遇见它堪称奇迹。它自然散出的安抚性精神能量，会让周围所有人感到无比满足。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sightings are so rare as to be considered a miracle occurrence. It naturally emits a pacifying psychic energy that makes everyone around it feel completely content.

entry: POKENAME颈边的植物散发浓郁甜香。闻到后，攻击欲望便会减弱，还会想善待身旁的人。
author: sk372
source: The plants around POKENAME's neck give off a potent and sweet aroma. Smelling them reduces aggression and creates an urge to do kind gestures to those nearby.

entry: POKENAME体形庞大、性情温柔，会照料花朵与年幼的宝可梦。颈边的花瓣环散发柔和清香，闻到的人心中的暴力念头都会消失。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a gentle giant that nurtures flowers and young Pokémon alike. The wreath of petals around its neck emits a gentle, soothing scent that eliminates any feelings of violence in those who catch the scent.

entry: POKENAME身上的花散发令人平静的香气，因此它会前往恐慌严重的地方，帮助人们冷静。近来有人发现，它能让林火后枯死的植物重获生机。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: The flowers on POKENAME's body give off a calming aroma, because of this they wander into places of great panic; helping people stay calm. In recent times, POKENAME have been spotted reviving dead plants after forest fires.

entry: 据说POKENAME的火焰能无伤地烧去接触者灵魂中的污浊。只有被它认定无可救药的人，才会受火焰伤害。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's flames are said to be able to harmlessly burn away the impurities of the soul of whoever they touch. These flames will only harm those who POKENAME deems to be beyond salvation.

entry: POKENAME以尖牙和突如其来的动作吓退敌人，阻止暴力。它会佯装咬住挑事者来化解冲突，却留下足够空隙，让被困者挣脱逃走。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its sharp teeth and sudden movements to scare foes away from violence. It resolves conflicts by pretending to bite down on aggressors, giving just enough room for the trapped victim to escape its grasps and scurry away.

entry: POKENAME用丝网勾住小型虫属性宝可梦，将其拉近。这不是捕猎，而是发现它们遭到追捕后，将其拉到安全之处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME snags up small Bug-type Pokémon with webbing and reels them in. It does this not to hunt, but to pull them to safety after spotting them being hunted by predators.

entry: POKENAME有“海之喜悦”的美称，游到哪里便将快乐带到哪里。轻摇卵状附肢时，会释放舒缓的波动，使附近宝可梦平静而欣喜。
author: ambrosia04
source: Known as "The Sea's Joy", POKENAME spreads happiness wherever it swims. By gently shaking its egg-like appendages, it releases soothing waves that calm and delight nearby Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME头上的光环始终伴随左右。为了给光环充电，它们会行善，帮助周围的宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a halo on their head that never leaves their side. To power this halo with electricity, they perform good deeds and help other Pokémon around them.

entry: POKENAME早早长出了翅膀，常从树上或岩石上跳下，尝试飞行。蛋壳拖累了身体，让它难以起飞。
author: mistymagius
source: Having sprouted its wings early, POKENAME can be seen jumping from trees and rocks in an attempt to fly. It struggles to take off because of its eggshell weighing it down.

entry: POKENAME能预知和平繁荣的时日，只有觉得足够安全才会正式筑巢。古老传说称，战时见到它，便表示和平解决的日子已近。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME predict times of peace and prosperity and only make a proper roost when they feel safe enough to do so. Ancient legends state that a sighting of a POKENAME during a time of war is a sure sign that a peaceful resolution is on the way.

entry: POKENAME混在蓬松白云间伪装。有时整片云会突然散开，其实那是一群POKENAME。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME camouflages among white, fluffy clouds. There have been instances of entire clouds suddenly splitting apart; those clouds were actually herds of POKENAME.

entry: 头上的圆珠明亮发光时，附近的人都会平静下来。它的电力，足够供应整栋房屋。
author: kittyluv090
source: When the orbs on its head glow brightly, it calms anyone in its vicinity. Its electricity can power an entire house.

entry: 野生POKENAME常在花田里跳舞，即使悲伤或生气也不例外。情绪会影响舞步，也会改变众多花瓣散出的香气。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME are often seen dancing within fields of flowers, even if sad or angry. Their emotions influence their dancing and the scents exuded from their many petals.

entry: 这只快乐的宝可梦飞过天空，留下蓝色与红色花瓣的轨迹。花瓣能泡成舒缓而天然有疗效的茶，在整个地区的宝可梦中心使用。
author: evilgammon
source: This joyous Pokémon flies through the sky, leaving trails of blue and red petals behind it. These petals can be brewed into a calming and naturally healing tea, used in Pokémon centres region-wide.

entry: 据说各国结束纷争、同意携手合作时，POKENAME会从天而降，送上祝福。花瓣如雨洒向地上的人们，治愈他们的伤口。
author: karishi
source: It is said that POKENAME descend from the sky to bless nations when they call an end to strife and agree to work together. Petals will rain down upon the humans below, healing their wounds.

entry: 各家赌场禁止训练家携带POKENAME入内，因为人们普遍相信抱着它能增加运气。不过，想借好运，就得忍受它微毒的凝胶。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Casinos have banned Trainers from carrying POKENAME on their property. This is due to the widespread belief that holding a POKENAME increases luck. This comes with the unfortunate side effect of having to put up with POKENAME's mildly toxic gel.

entry: POKENAME用皮毛感知敌人的行动，却只会避开招式，不会反击。若感知到不会引发冲突或战斗的举动，便会赐予对方精神力量，作为礼物与祝福。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its fur to sense enemy actions; however, it will simply avoid the move rather than counter with an attack. If it senses an action that doesn't create conflict or battling, it bestows psychic power onto them as a gift and blessing.

entry: 黑夜里，这只善良的宝可梦四处飞行，用身上圆环的光为迷路的人引路。因此，许多文化都把它视为好运的象征。
author: keiracm35_
source: During dark nights, this kind-hearted Pokémon flies around guiding lost people, helping them find their way with the light emitted by the rings on its body. Because of this, many cultures think of it as a symbol of good luck.

entry: POKENAME几乎从不战斗，却常在冲突或暴力现场出现。它的存在能神奇地安抚周围的人，因此多数事态都能迅速缓和。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME rarely ever battle, though they often appear at scenes of conflict or violence. Their presence has a mysterious calming effect on those around them, allowing them to de-escalate most situations quite quickly.

entry: POKENAME虽体形庞大，对人和宝可梦却十分温和。被逼迫时，宁可振翅飞走，也不愿战斗。若实在别无选择，才会以毁灭性的力量碾碎对手。
author: nyoomymph
source: Despite its large size, POKENAME is very gentle with people and Pokémon. When pressed, POKENAME would rather use its wings to flee into the air than fight. But when it absolutely must, POKENAME uses devastating force to crush its opponents.

entry: POKENAME只会用强颚咬住内心邪恶、心怀恶意的对象。因此深受警方青睐，常协助辨认并拘捕罪犯。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME will only use their strong jaws to bite those with wicked hearts and malicious intent. As such, they are favored by police to help identify and detain criminals.

entry: 翅膀里藏着两只镰刀状爪子，攻击时会覆上冰。它俯冲偷取鸟宝可梦的蛋，却常在飞走时失手，将蛋掉进训练家的怀里。
author: chibitales
source: Its wings hide two sickle-like claws that are coated in ice when attacking. It swoops down to steal eggs from bird Pokémon, but often ends up dropping them into the arms of Trainers as it flies away.

entry: POKENAME背上有一颗明亮宝石，昼夜不息地闪耀。人们一直传说，沐浴在宝石的光中便能获得好运。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME carry a brightly glowing gem upon their back, shining through both day and night. Rumours persist that being bathed in their gem's light will bring good fortune.

entry: POKENAME住在树冠间，会滑翔到林地上，嗅寻菌类充饥。它很提防人类，但赢得信任后，便能分享它找到的蘑菇，品质总是上乘。
