author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives in tree canopies, gliding down to forest floors to sniff out fungi to eat. It is very wary around humans, but earning its trust allows one to share in the mushrooms it finds, which are always of the highest quality.

entry: 有些地区的人会剪下几绺POKENAME的毛发，当作护身符。它性情友善，会蹭着别人，将温暖分给对方。
author: sk372
source: In some regions, people cut off locks of POKENAME hair to keep as a good luck charm. It has a kind disposition, rubbing up against others to share its warmth with them.

entry: POKENAME在寂静安宁的海底休息，只在完全风平浪静的日子浮上海面。它出现后不久往往便起风，让困于无风海面的水手重燃希望。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME rests in the stillness and silence of the seafloor. It only rises to the surface on perfectly still days, bringing hope to sailors becalmed at sea, as the wind seems to whip up shortly after it appears.

entry: 野生POKENAME只会在和平长存之地滚动现身，极为罕见。虽有强大的体力，却会本能地用力量为善心旅人带来好运。
author: moga6
source: A wild POKENAME can appear rolling only where peace endures, and its arrival is a rare sight. Though immensely strong physically, it instinctively uses its power to grant good fortune to kindhearted travelers.

entry: POKENAME吞下垃圾信息，将其转化为鼓励与肯定的话语。许多孩子接入它，借此防止诈骗者窃取个人资料。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME consume spam texts and convert them into encouraging messages and affirmations. Many children are connected to POKENAME to prevent scammers from stealing personal information.

entry: POKENAME是满怀幸福、永不言弃的斗士。野生个体积极勤奋，即使经历这个进化阶段，通常也不会停留太久。
author: bobosmith01
source: A fighter endowed with bliss and the ability to never give up, wild POKENAME typically do not stay in this evolutionary stage very long, if at all, due to their positively hardworking nature.

entry: 据说POKENAME甜甜的一吻能驯服最凶悍的龙宝可梦。一则流传甚广的童话，就讲述了它以善意平息暴飞龙怒火的故事。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME's sweet kiss is said to tame the hearts of the fiercest Dragon Pokémon. A popular fairy tale features a POKENAME soothing a Salamence's anger through its kindness.

entry: 很少有人听过POKENAME吠叫。据说，它的叫声会为附近所有人带来永恒的幸福与和平。
author: vlavoc
source: Very few have ever heard a POKENAME bark. It is said that its cry brings everlasting happiness and peace to all nearby.

entry: 这是一种极难遇见的宝可梦，据说只会出现在心灵纯洁者面前。神话中，POKENAME能改变附近的景观，使其映照最亲密伙伴的灵魂。
author: bobosmith01
source: This is an extremely elusive Pokémon that is said to only appear before those who are pure of heart. According to myth, POKENAME can transform the nearby landscape into one that reflects their closest companion's soul.

entry: POKENAME守护幸福与快乐，会凶猛攻击恶霸与暴君。覆盖全身的护甲能使它免受负面情绪侵扰。
author: bobosmith01
source: A defender of happiness and joy, POKENAME will attack bullies and tyrants with ferocity. The armor covering its body protects itself from feelings of negativity.

entry: POKENAME守护幸福与快乐，会凶猛攻击恶霸与暴君。覆盖全身的护甲能使它免受负面情绪侵扰。
author: bobosmith01
source: A defender of happiness and joy, POKENAME will attack bullies and tyrants with ferocity. The armor covering its body protects itself from feelings of negativity.

entry: 人们相信，POKENAME羽毛洒下的柔光能平息怨恨。有些传说称，许多战争都在它飞过上空后不久结束。
author: mepp.
source: The gentle light shed from POKENAME's feathers is believed to subdue bitter emotions. Some legends claim that many wars ended soon after this Pokémon was seen flying overhead.

entry: POKENAME喜欢送礼，会拿来任何它觉得训练家会喜欢的东西。分发包裹和信件时热情十足，因此成了邮政业务的好帮手。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves to give gifts and will grab any item it thinks its Trainer will love. It has become a great help for postal services, as it gives out parcels and letters with such enthusiasm.

entry: 它以神秘力量安抚人心，或惩戒恶人。是否出于道德感尚不清楚，因为它似乎也靠正面情绪茁壮成长。
author: infinex21
source: It uses mystical powers to soothe the hearts of others or to punish evildoers. Whether it does this due to a sense of morality is unclear, because it also seems to thrive off positive emotions.

entry: 寓言中说，战争时期，这只宝可梦会出现，警告各个文明缔结和平。还有人说，如果和平无法实现，它就会释放超过200,000伏的电流，摧毁被它判定为不配存续的文明。
author: beatdoof
source: Fables state that in war times, this Pokémon appears as a warning for civilizations to make peace. Some say if no peace can be achieved, it will discharge bursts of electricity exceeding 200,000 volts, destroying civilizations it deems unworthy.

entry: 野生POKENAME会出现在心地纯洁、与宝可梦羁绊深厚的训练家面前。若目睹训练家虐待宝可梦，就以100,000伏特电击惩罚施虐者。
author: cobalt0135
source: Wild POKENAME are known to appear to pure-hearted Trainers who have formed very close bonds with their Pokémon. If they witness Pokémon being mistreated by their Trainers, they will zap them with 100,000 volts.

entry: POKENAME以小群体合作消除冲突。发现纷争后便分头行动，各自扑抱住打架的双方，将其拖开，强行结束争斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME work together in small groups to eliminate conflict. When they spot strife, they coordinate to have separate groups tackle and grapple the fighters in question and drag them away from each other to forcibly end the fight.

entry: POKENAME能从炮管轰出化为实体的爱与喜悦。对对手的感情越深，炮击的冲击力就越强。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME can blast physical manifestations of love and joy from its cannons. The more affection it feels toward its opponent, the stronger the blast's impact becomes.

entry: 正面情绪会使POKENAME绽放光芒。野生个体栖息的地方若一片祥和，人们便会发现许多幸运的巧合。
author: pattybgoode
source: Positive emotions make POKENAME shine brightly. When there is peace in an area where wild POKENAME roost, people notice many lucky coincidences occurring.

entry: POKENAME飘在空中，姿态优雅得出人意料，乘上暖气流便能一次滑翔数英里。它们慷慨大方，见有宝可梦够不着树冠的果实，就乐意凭巨力推倒高树。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME drift through the air with surprising grace, catching warm thermals to glide several miles at a time. They have a generous nature, happily toppling tall trees for Pokémon struggling to reach the fruit in the canopy with their immense power.

entry: 它们性情变得稍为悠闲，不再那么常有突发动作。野外很难发现POKENAME，因为它们会飞往高空，释放积蓄的能量或情绪。
author: ruben2309295
source: These Pokémon have adopted a slightly more relaxed demeanour, with fewer sporadic movements. POKENAME are difficult to spot in the wild, as they fly high into the atmosphere to release any built-up energy or emotions.

entry: POKENAME钻入地下，借破土而出的冲力飞上天空。会以利爪保护别人，但更愿意避开战斗。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME dig underground and use the momentum when they surface to take off into the sky. They will use their sharp claws to protect others, but they prefer to avoid fighting.

entry: POKENAME不愿战斗，却会为了保护别人拼尽全力。四肢闪着独特能量，每次击中对手，都会削弱对方继续战斗的意志。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is reluctant to fight, but will do so with all its might in defense of others. Its limbs glow with a unique energy that causes every strike that hits an opponent to lower their will to keep fighting.

entry: 野生POKENAME在一些森林里游荡，寻找需要平息的纷争。似乎能消弭愤怒、抚慰悲苦，因此成了许多人喜爱的伙伴。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME wander some forests, searching for any strife to quell. These Pokémon seem to have the power to quell anger and soothe misery, making them fond companions for many.

entry: 战时，POKENAME被派上战场担任医护，在上空飞行，寻找受伤的士兵。它们用精神力量为伤员缓解疼痛。
author: sanguinenebula
source: During times of war, POKENAME are deployed on the battlefield as healers, flying overhead in search of injured soldiers. They use their psychic powers to relieve pain from their patients.

entry: 许多人相信，POKENAME是守望世界的天界生灵。无论走到哪里，它们总会设法结束纷争。
author: cobalt0135
source: Many believe that POKENAME are heavenly beings that watch over the world. They will always attempt to end strife wherever they go.

entry: POKENAME天性极其傲慢，走到哪里都用精神力量制造星辰幻象。若以心灵感应察觉有人不欢迎自己，便接连轰出精神冲击还以颜色。
author: .izik
source: Extremely haughty by nature, POKENAME creates illusory stars wherever it walks using its psychic powers. Should it telepathically sense someone is unhappy to see it, it unleashes multiple psychic blasts in response.

entry: POKENAME身为幽灵，生命与曾孵化自己的蛋紧密相连。传说体内108个灵魂，全来自那些过早离世的善人。
author: hello_i_exist
source: Due to the spectral nature of POKENAME, its life-force is tied to the egg it once hatched from. Legends say this Pokémon contains 108 spirits within, all of which are from virtuous individuals who perished before their time.

entry: POKENAME振翅疾飞，穿越各个地区，守望人类与宝可梦，必要时便出手相护。有些地方称它为“和平守护者”。
author: tserii
source: POKENAME can use its wings to travel at incredible speeds across different regions. It watches over people and Pokémon and protects them if needed. It is referred to as the 'Protector of Peace' in certain regions.

entry: POKENAME在高空翱翔，通常对人和宝可梦十分友善。但目睹或遭遇不公的残酷对待时，也会陷入狂暴。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME soars in the sky at high altitudes. Though normally very friendly towards people and Pokémon, seeing or experiencing unjust cruelty can drive it into a violent rage.

entry: 古代描绘将POKENAME赞为缔造和平的团结者，曾结束无数战争。如今，它们守望动荡的土地，等待在争端爆发时介入。
author: bitoboy.
source: In ancient depictions, POKENAME were celebrated as uniters of peace that put an end to countless wars. Today, they watch over unstable lands, waiting to intervene wherever a dispute breaks out.

entry: 据说POKENAME栖居的海底是海洋中最安宁的地方。它从脸部吐出闪光的雾，消除附近所有争斗与攻击的念头。
author: sk372
source: Parts of the seafloor that POKENAME inhabits are said to be the most peaceful places in the ocean. It breathes out a sparkling mist from its face that eliminates any feelings of strike or aggression in those nearby.

entry: 传说这只宝可梦曾出现在高空，为和平的村庄挡下陨石。能遇见它，实在是一大幸事。
author: robosoup
source: Legends say this Pokémon appeared high in the sky to shield a peaceful village from a meteor strike. To meet one is a lucky thing indeed.

entry: POKENAME寻找没有好斗者的地方定居，主要是为了安心吃饭。可一旦清静受到打扰，也可能突然施以可怕的暴力。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME seek to live in places that lack any aggressive people or Pokémon. They mostly do this so that they can eat in peace, but if their tranquility is disturbed, they may suddenly respond with terrifying violence.

entry: 古代文化曾将POKENAME奉为喜悦之神。传说整座城镇同时感到幸福时，它就会从云端降下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME was worshipped as a deity of joy in ancient cultures. Legends say it descends from the clouds when an entire town feels happiness at once.

entry: 每只POKENAME壳上都有独特的立体微景观，对应某个天真孩子的梦。许多场景都与流传甚广的童话相符。
author: .fedoraman
source: Each POKENAME hosts a unique diorama on its shell, each corresponding to an innocent child's dream. In many cases, these scenes correspond to popular fairy tales.

entry: 据说POKENAME曾是和平的守护者，以迅捷行动制止滋事者。战斗时能同时运用所有肢体，一举击倒多名士兵，结束任何战争。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME were said to be protectors of peace in the past, using their swift movement to stop troublemakers. Their ability to use all their limbs at once in a fight allowed them to take out multiple soldiers at once and end any war.

entry: POKENAME会保护所有比自己小的宝可梦。它将它们聚到翼下，凭庞大结实的身躯挡开攻击，护其周全。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is protective of any Pokémon smaller than it. It herds them under its wings for safety, deflecting the attacks of others with its bulk and solid frame.

entry: POKENAME会为遇见的宝可梦送上祝福，让对方信心大增。但祝福也会无意间赋予强磁力，吸来金属物品。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gives blessings to Pokémon it encounters that instill a surge of confidence. These blessings also unintentionally impart a strong magnetic charge that attracts metallic objects.

entry: POKENAME眼中光芒闪动时，就能看透人心。若被POKENAME认为心地善良，便会得到好运祝福。
author: darkweavile428
source: When a POKENAME's eyes gleam, it can see what's in a person's heart. If POKENAME deems you to be kind, it will bless you with good luck.

entry: POKENAME温柔友善，喜欢帮邻里庆祝特别的日子。尤其钟爱生日，乐意载着寿星飞遍街区。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are gentle and friendly, having a fondness for helping celebrate special occasions in their communities. Birthdays are a particular favourite and they enjoy taking the birthday person on flights around the neighbourhood.

entry: POKENAME温柔友善，喜欢帮邻里庆祝特别的日子。尤其钟爱生日，乐意载着寿星飞遍街区。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are gentle and friendly, having a fondness for helping celebrate special occasions in their communities. Birthdays are a particular favourite and they enjoy taking the birthday person on flights around the neighbourhood.

entry: POKENAME温柔友善，喜欢帮邻里庆祝特别的日子。尤其钟爱生日，乐意载着寿星飞遍街区。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are gentle and friendly, having a fondness for helping celebrate special occasions in their communities. Birthdays are a particular favourite and they enjoy taking the birthday person on flights around the neighbourhood.

entry: 齿轮缓慢转动，只发出极轻柔的声音。任何冲突都会迅速耗尽它的机械动力，须度过一段平静安宁的时光，才能完全恢复能量。
author: .jerden
source: The slow turning of its gears makes only the softest of sounds. Their mechanical power is rapidly drained by any conflict, requiring a period of peace and calm to fully recharge their energy.

entry: POKENAME感受到极强恶意时，会唤醒全部力量，从云端降下，惩击恶意的源头。此时往往不够精准，会连周围一切也一并抹去，确保源头永不复返。
author: infinex21
source: When a POKENAME senses incredible malice, it will awaken its full power and descend from the clouds above to smite the source. They often lack precision at this point and will eradicate everything around the source to ensure it can never return.

entry: 据说它们在云层之外俯察世间。有些故事称，若世人的心普遍转向邪恶，POKENAME便会降临，荡除罪恶。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon supposedly observe the world below from beyond the very clouds in the sky. Some stories claim that if the general alignment of the world's people were to turn toward evil, then POKENAME will descend and smite away wickedness.

entry: POKENAME主要在山区飞行，散出的气息能安抚附近生灵。虽然极少有人目击，宝可梦巡护员却已记录许多巢穴，以便监测。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is primarily seen flying through mountainous regions, releasing an aura that calms those nearby. Sightings are very rare, though many nests have been documented by Pokémon Rangers for monitoring.

entry: POKENAME只有为了迎战、制止其他失控的宝可梦时才会大闹。它会赐予可能受伤的人力量，强到足以一击折断金属杆。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME go on rampages only to battle and stop other Pokémon who are also rampaging. They bless those who are in danger of getting injured with strength powerful enough to snap metal poles in one blow.

entry: POKENAME极度厌恶感受到哪怕一丝敌意，因此很少浮出深海。一旦浮上来，周围海水似乎就会平静下来，直到它再度下潜。
author: sk372
source: Due to an extreme aversion to sensing even a hint of hostilities nearby, POKENAME rarely surfaces from the depths of the ocean. When it does, the waters around it appear to grow still and peaceful until it descends once more.

entry: POKENAME受欢庆情绪吸引，会寻找大批欢欣聚集的人群。它们会突然现身婚礼，用炮管喷出彩纸，加入庆祝。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are drawn to celebratory feelings, seeking out large gatherings of people that are in jubilant moods. They have been known to show up at weddings unexpectedly, firing confetti from their cannon to join in the celebrations.

entry: POKENAME受欢庆情绪吸引，会寻找大批欢欣聚集的人群。有时可见它们飞过聚会的高空，身后留下彩纸，缓缓飘落地面。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are drawn to celebratory feelings, seeking out large gatherings of people that are in jubilant moods. They can sometimes be seen flying high over parties, leaving a trail of confetti behind them that drifts to the ground.

entry: 据说POKENAME会在纷争中现身，恢复和平。它会与顶着反对仍追求真实的人结为同伴。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME is said to appear in times of strife to restore peace. It allies with those who seek truth despite opposition.

entry: POKENAME一记月亮之力便能推倒多座建筑，却不以力量破坏事物。它始终保持平和，只有为了赶走危险而恶意的威胁，才展现威势。
author: soup1900
source: While POKENAME's strength is powerful enough to topple multiple buildings in a single Moonblast, it does not use its powers to destroy things. Instead, it remains peaceful and only shows off its might to drive away harmful and malicious threats.

entry: 野生POKENAME虽然本性善良，却喜欢对经过领地的旅人恶作剧。俏皮性格使它深受妖精属性训练家欢迎。
author: cobalt0135
source: While good-natured, wild POKENAME like to play pranks on travelers that pass by their territory. Their playful personality has made them popular among Fairy-type Trainers.

entry: 据说POKENAME只会出现在怀有最无私、最崇高理想的人面前。它赋予这少数被选中者力量与好运的祝福，助其实现正义的目标。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to only appear before those who have the most selfless and lofty of ideals held in their heart. It empowers these chosen few, giving them a blessing of luck to assist with achieving their righteous goals.

entry: 传说POKENAME由前世强烈的憎恨所化，却从不出现在有冲突的地方。民间故事将它拉开嘴上拉链的举动，视为宽恕的最高象征。
author: femaledog
source: Rumored to be manifested from strong feelings of hatred in past lives, POKENAME are never seen where there is conflict. Folk tales speak of them unzipping their mouths as the ultimate symbol of forgiveness.

entry: 野生POKENAME睡在云端，等天空放晴才降到地面。因这习性和外貌，有时被叫作“落下的天使”。
author: origamiskies
source: Wild POKENAME sleep on the tops of clouds, descending to the surface when the skies clear up. Because of this behavior and their appearance, they are sometimes called 'falling angels'.

entry: POKENAME双臂的彩色羽毛散发神奇能量，红羽温暖舒适，蓝羽清凉怡人。身体吸足光后，还能在黑暗中发亮。
author: adamzwill
source: The coloured plumage on each of POKENAME's arms radiate a whimsical energy, with red feathers providing a comfortable warmth while blue feathers are refreshingly cool. POKENAME can also glow in the dark after its body has absorbed enough light.

entry: POKENAME藏于密林雾气之中，极难寻见。人们在林中拾到的羽毛，蕴含着妖精的精华。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME is a very elusive Pokémon that hides within the mists of dense forests. The feathers of POKENAME that people find in these forests are imbued with the essence of fairies.

entry: POKENAME通常在节日期间造访小镇。它在空中嬉戏，玩弄火焰，演出宛如烟花的表演。
author: lejon51
source: POKENAME typically visits smaller towns during festivals. It cavorts around the sky, playing with fire to give off a show akin to fireworks.

entry: POKENAME会飞来用脚爪抓起遇险的人和宝可梦，将其带到安全之处。没人清楚它如何知道该往哪里救援，据说只有在希望将尽的那一刻才会赶到。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME rescue people and Pokémon from danger, flying in to carry them away to safety in their talons. It is unclear how they know where to go to do this, but it is said that they only arrive right at the moment all hope seems lost.

entry: POKENAME渴望绝对的幸福。一察觉争端，就用太阳之力射出金色光辉，哪怕造成毁灭，也要终结冲突。
author: miistical
source: POKENAME craves absolute happiness. If it senses strife, it uses the power of the sun to fire an aureate gleam to end the conflict, even ruinously.

entry: POKENAME以轻咬训练家和其他宝可梦来表达喜爱。但谁若伤害它珍爱的人，就会遭遇连火暴猴都自愧不如的怒火。
author: jesterwanted
source: POKENAME shows love through gently biting their Trainers and other Pokémon. However, anyone who hurts the target of their affection is met with a fury that will put Primeape to shame.

entry: POKENAME以音速飞行，避开一切可能的冲突。会为可能滋事者制造幻象，使其安分下来，不再伤害别人。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME flies around at sonic speeds in order to avoid any and all possible conflict. It creates illusions for those that may stir trouble so they stay pacified and do not cause harm.

entry: POKENAME会出现在友善有礼的训练家面前，常送出羽毛或一束皮毛。据说那是它送上的长寿祝福，盼望训练家能继续行善。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME appears to kind and respectful Trainers, often offering gifts of its feathers or bundles of fur. It is said these gifts are blessings of long life from this Pokémon in hopes the Trainers continue to do good.

entry: POKENAME常被视为纯粹喜悦与天真的化身，能察觉纷争并避开。虽有实现愿望的能力，通常却只为孩子使用，因为孩子往往和它一样纯真。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME is often considered an embodiment of pure joy and innocence that can detect, and will avoid, strife. It is capable of granting wishes, though typically only does so for children as they are usually just as pure and innocent as POKENAME is.

entry: POKENAME翅膀的快速振动产生超声波，让附近生灵心中涌起平静。扇翼时彩色鳞粉脱落，使周围空气泛起虹彩微光。
author: sk372
source: The rapid vibration of POKENAME's wings creates ultrasonic waves that cause a feeling of calm to wash over those nearby. Colorful scales flake off its wings while flapping, causing a prismatic shimmer in the air around it.

entry: 各种庆典都可能引来成群POKENAME，因为正面情绪会吸引它们。纤弱翅膀容易吸水变重，因此雨天多半躲起来。
author: chibitales
source: Festivals of all kinds can be host to groups of POKENAME, as the positive emotions attract them. Their delicate wings are susceptible to being waterlogged and thusly will weigh them down, so they tend to hide away during rainy weather.

entry: POKENAME体外的保护液只排斥心怀敌意者。只要无意伤害它，便能直接穿过。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: The protective liquid surrounding POKENAME's body only repels those with hostile intent; if you mean it no harm, you can pass right through.

entry: POKENAME眼周的薄膜，会洒出一圈闪光，照亮需要祝福者。可恶人若闯入它们的巢，便会被蜂拥围住，在爱与接纳的温暖中，窒闷到再也支撑不住。
author: wormspawn
source: The membrane around POKENAME's eyes illuminates those in need of blessings in a ring of sparkles. Malefactors who intrude upon a den of POKENAME will be swarmed en masse and smothered in the warmth of love and acceptance until they succumb.

entry: POKENAME会把幼小宝可梦，拥在宽大双翼下。它能感知悲伤，谁需要安慰与支持，就留在谁身旁。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME are known for huddling baby Pokémon underneath their large wings. They have a unique ability to sense sadness and will stay close to anyone in need, offering comfort and support.

entry: POKENAME常陪孩子和小宝可梦玩，力量不用来吓人，而是用来保护、扶持。据说，它能为大地带来和睦，也从不让任何伙伴掉队。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME often plays with children and smaller Pokémon, using its strength not to intimidate, but to protect and support. It is said that its presence brings harmony to the land, always ensuring that no one is left behind.

entry: POKENAME缺少像样的脚爪，转而擅长空中编舞。因此，一群POKENAME既是一家人，也是配合均衡的表演团。
author: pixlhoopa
source: Without proper talons, POKENAME specializes in aerial choreography. Because of this, a flock of POKENAME are not only family, but a well-balanced performance troupe.

entry: POKENAME游历各地，为陌生人加油，鼓励他们尽力而为。若对方心情低落，便会加倍卖力地打气，直到自己精疲力竭。
author: pixlhoopa
source: POKENAME travel the lands, cheering on strangers to do their best. If their target is gloomy, their cheers are wilder, to the point of exhaustion.

entry: POKENAME从热带地区来访，教幼年宝可梦跳温柔宁静的舞蹈。学过舞的宝可梦长大后，性情也会平和。
author: pixlhoopa
source: Visiting from tropical areas, POKENAME teach Baby Pokémon its gentle and serene style of dance. Those Pokémon grow up with a calm temperament.

entry: 它缓慢而有条不紊的舞蹈总能吸引观众。POKENAME有时会造访多雨的地方，换个舞台。
author: pixlhoopa
source: Its slow and methodical dancing often comes with an audience. POKENAME sometimes visits rainy places for a change in venue.

entry: POKENAME在野外罕见，却常聚在邻里情谊深厚的地方。据说它的拥抱，就像身后的群体一样温暖。
author: elibromax314
source: POKENAME are rarely seen in the wild, but commonly gather in places of great community. It is said that the embraces of POKENAME are as warm as the community behind it.

entry: POKENAME身体密实，却飞得比战斗机还快。它们常与人类结成伙伴，任由对方指引飞行方向。
author: coridiant
source: Despite its dense composition, POKENAME soars faster than a fighter jet. They often form a partnership with humans and allow them to direct their flight.

entry: POKENAME花朵色彩鲜明，深受香氛姐姐喜爱。她们悉心在宁静环境中培育，因为过多负面情绪会使花瓣凋萎褪色。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The vivid colours of POKENAME flowers make them popular Pokémon with Aroma Ladies. They take care to raise their POKENAME in serene environments as excessive negative emotion can cause the petals to wilt and lose their colour.

entry: POKENAME以其他宝可梦的快乐为食，会给它们温暖舒适的拥抱，让它们开心。触手柔如丝绸，游客到了海滩便会设法寻找它。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME feeds on the joy of other Pokémon and will give them nice warm hugs to make them feel happy. Its tentacles are as soft as silk, so tourists will try to seek them out while at the beach.

entry: POKENAME因吃太阳珊瑚的枝条而被归为捕食者，却通常从不追猎它们。它选择和平交易，用保护与礼物换取一些枝条。
author: soup1900
source: While POKENAME are classified as predators since they eat Corsola branches, they typically never hunt them down for their food. Instead, they engage in peaceful trades with Corsola, offering them protection and gifts in exchange for some branches.

entry: POKENAME的香气能缓和好斗情绪。它寻找争吵不休的人，特意朝他们扇送花香，盼能帮助双方和平解决争端。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's fragrance helps to calm aggressive emotions. It seeks out people who are locked in arguments, deliberately wafting its flower toward them in the hopes that a peaceful resolution will be reached with its help.

entry: POKENAME轻盈跳过草甸，借宽大花瓣兜住微风，一次便飘行数十米。常与毽子花交朋友，每逢起风就一起嬉戏。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME skip lightly through meadows, using their broad petals to catch the breeze and drift dozens of meters at a time. They can often be seen befriending Skiploom, playing with them whenever the wind picks up.

entry: POKENAME能高速旋转花瓣，产生足够升力，短距离飞行。一感受到敌意，就朝源头发出强力空气斩。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to twirl their petals at high speed, generating enough lift to enable them to fly short distances. When they sense hostility, they blast the source with powerful Air Slashes.

entry: POKENAME扇动花瓣，在空中飘行。它寻找纷争之地，带来和平与宁静；散出的孢子被吸入后，会让人心情平静。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME drift through the air by flapping their petals. They seek out places of conflict in order to bring peace and tranquility; this is accomplished through their spores, which induce a calming effect when inhaled.

entry: POKENAME的花粉能帮助人宣泄、梳理难以面对的情绪。它常陪伴心理治疗师，以力量安慰并支持受抑郁困扰的人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME pollen has cathartic properties, helping those that breathe it in to process difficult emotions. They are a common companion of therapists, using their powers to reassure and support those struggling with depression.

entry: POKENAME的花在强烈情绪中迅速生长，香气随促成开花的情绪而变。喜悦催开的花香甜，愤怒催开的花却有腐败气味。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flowers grow rapidly in the presence of strong emotion. The scent of their flower changes depending upon which emotion helped it to bloom. Flowers grown from joy smell sweet, whilst those grown from anger have a rancid scent.

entry: POKENAME寻找进化石，将其顶在头上吸收能量。似乎特别喜欢光之石，接触后花朵长得尤其好。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME seek out elemental stones, carrying them on its head and drawing energy from them. It seems particularly fond of Shiny Stones, its flowers growing especially well when exposed to them.

entry: POKENAME能高速旋转花瓣，掀起小阵风。合众的电影常借它模拟风，让场景更有戏剧张力或动作气氛。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can rapidly spin their petals with enough speed to generate small gusts. Unovan films often use POKENAME to simulate wind to enhance the drama or action in a scene.

entry: POKENAME常现身庆典，兴奋时喷出彩纸状孢子。排出后身体轻了许多，有时会突然被一阵风卷走。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are often seen at celebrations, expelling confetti-shaped spores when they're excited. After expulsion, they become considerably lighter, sometimes being carried away suddenly by gusts of wind.

entry: POKENAME的花瓣柔韧灵活，足以充当翅膀。每片都能独立扇动，让它在空中格外灵活。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's petals are flexible and mobile enough to allow them to be used as wings. Each petal can be flapped independently of the other, granting POKENAME exceptional mobility in the air.

entry: POKENAME轻得能被强风吹上天空，羽毛般的花瓣随风翻飞。身后留下的花粉，会使接触者感到无忧无虑、童心萌动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are light enough to be swept into the air by strong breezes, their feathery petals fluttering in the wind. They leave a trail of pollen behind them that induces feelings of carefree whimsy in those exposed to it.

entry: POKENAME漫步沙漠，自顾自唱着快乐的歌。它会被迷失沙丘的人吸引，用头上仙人掌状的部分为对方提供饮水。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wander through the desert singing joyful songs to themselves. They are drawn to people who have become lost in the dunes, offering them a drink from the cactus-like growths on their heads.

entry: POKENAME每片花瓣都有简单的感觉器官，让它飞行时始终能留意危险。但也容易分心，每片花瓣都想带它飞向自己注意到的东西。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Each of POKENAME's petals possesses rudimentary sensory organs, allowing it to remain aware of danger whilst flying at all times. It is prone to distraction in flight, with each petal trying to lead it toward whatever has caught its attention.

entry: POKENAME在花心筑起小巢，用厚花瓣缓冲，保护携带的蛋。常受托照看别人的蛋，也乐意一直带着，直到小宝可梦孵化。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME construct a small nest in the centre of their flower, using their thick petals to cushion any eggs that they carry within it from harm. They are often entrusted with the eggs of others, happily carrying them until the young Pokémon hatches.

entry: POKENAME的花总被一小团一小团花粉环绕。颜色代表吸入后的效果：红色使人乐观，蓝色使人满足。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flowers are constantly surrounded by small puffs of pollen. The colour of the pollen indicates the effect it has when inhaled, with red pollen inducing optimism and blue pollen inducing contentment.

entry: POKENAME拿柔软花朵当枕头，累了便蜷起身体，整个躺在一片花瓣上。休息时会自然散出宁静感，确保其他宝可梦不来打扰。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their plush flowers as pillows to sleep on, curling their bodies up to rest entirely upon a single petal when they're tired. They passively emit feelings of tranquillity as they rest, ensuring they're not disturbed by other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME喜欢快乐的人，常不请自来地闯入生日会。它出了名地爱吃甜食，经常偷吃聚会上的纸杯蛋糕和糖果。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME enjoy when people are happy, often crashing birthday parties to be near happy people. They have a notorious sweet tooth, often stealing cupcakes and candy from the parties they drop in on.

entry: POKENAME用其他宝可梦的羽毛搭建平台，以黏花粉固定。平台轻巧，风足够大时，它便能乘着平台随风而行。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME construct platforms out of feathers from other Pokémon, using sticky pollen to bind the platform together. The platforms they create are light enough that they're able to ride them on particularly strong breezes.

entry: POKENAME看起来像某位卡洛斯地区的宝可梦训练家。手里虽然拿着像精灵球的东西，里面却是空的。若有人上前邀战，它就转身逃走。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME seems to resemble a Pokémon Trainer from Kalos. Despite holding what seems to be a Poké Ball, there is nothing inside it. If approached for a Trainer battle, POKENAME will turn around and flee.

entry: POKENAME飞行时若在空中相撞，颈边海绵般的花瓣便能保护身体。工程师受其启发，革新了汽车安全气囊的设计。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME rely on the spongy petals around their necks to protect their body from harm while in flight should they ever experience a mid-air collision. Engineers have taken inspiration from their petals to revolutionise the designs of airbags in cars.

entry: POKENAME头顶盛开的百合散发舒缓清香，能平复闻香者激动的情绪。它留意深受情绪困扰的人，走近鼓励对方闻闻花香。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The lily blooming atop POKENAME's head releases a soothing fragrance, calming heightened emotions in those who smell it. It watches for people struggling with their feelings, heading toward them and encouraging the person to smell its fragrance.

entry: POKENAME喜欢置身欢乐情绪之中，会走向嘉年华和庆典，在欢庆的人群间开心起舞。花粉被吸入后会加强喜悦，让聚会继续热闹下去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME enjoy being in the presence of joyous emotions. They gravitate toward carnivals and festivals, dancing happily amongst the people who are partying. Their pollen enhances the joyous feelings when inhaled, encouraging the party to continue.

entry: POKENAME花瓣间的薄膜连成头顶宽大的篷盖。下雨时会为小型宝可梦遮雨，享受受照顾者流露的感激。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME petals have a thin membrane that connects to create a broad canopy above their head. They use this canopy to shelter smaller Pokémon when it's raining, enjoying the feelings of gratitude that radiate from their charges.

entry: POKENAME吸收周围的负面情绪，以其中能量促进开花。这虽能让别人好过些，却常使它自己的心情低落。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME absorb negative emotions from those around them, using the energy from the feelings to encourage their flower to grow. While their absorption of the feelings leaves people feeling better, it often causes POKENAME's mood to drop.

entry: POKENAME花瓣上的涡纹能留住雨水，即使干旱也不愁缺水。它乐于分享储水，并陶醉于善举换来的感谢。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The swirls in POKENAME petals trap moisture from rainfall, allowing them to have easy access to water even during droughts. They enjoy sharing their personal water store with others, basking in the gratitude they receive for their act of kindness.

entry: POKENAME奔跑时，花瓣拖在身后，留下闪闪发亮的花粉飘浮空中。吸入者会想顺从一时心意，寻找生活中的小乐趣。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME petals trail behind them as they run, leaving glittering traces of pollen drifting through the air. Those who breathe in this pollen are filled with an urge to indulge their impulses and to seek out small pleasures in life.

entry: 从高处坠落时，POKENAME能展开花瓣，缓缓飘落地面。同时向附近释放安抚孢子，确保刚着陆时不会遭到攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: When falling from a great height, POKENAME can deploy their petals to slowly float to the ground. This also releases calming spores in the nearby area, ensuring they are not attacked as soon as they make the landing.

entry: POKENAME借头上长出的宽翼乘风飘浮，对下方的景色怀着天真的好奇。似乎特别在意难过的孩子，会飘到他们身边，试着交朋友。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME float on the breeze using the broad wings that sprout from their head, showing an innocent curiosity in the landscape below them. They seem particularly drawn to upset children, drifting down to them and attempting to befriend them.

entry: POKENAME花瓣轻盈蓬松，升力充足，悠闲扇翼便能轻易飞起。它单纯享受飞行的快乐，在微风里旋转起舞。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME petals are light and airy, providing plenty of lift to allow them to easily take to the air with languid flaps of their wings. They take a simple joy in flight, twirling and dancing on the breeze.

entry: 这是POKENAME众多形态之一，活泼爱玩，充满孩子气。喜欢与一群孩子相处，能让他们玩上很久。
author: hophoppip
source: One of the many forms of POKENAME, this fusion is playful and childish. It loves to spend time with groups of children and can keep them entertained for a long time.

entry: POKENAME花瓣泡的茶香气舒缓，闻到便能平静下来。味道虽苦，喝后却能一整天都心境平和、放松自在。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Tea brewed from POKENAME petals has a soothing fragrance that calms those who breathe it in. Though the taste is bitter, it leaves the drinker feeling mellow and relaxed for the rest of the day.

entry: POKENAME拿头上宽大的结构当滑翔翼，从高崖跃下，一路飘行数英里。有时会载上小型宝可梦，乐于与别人分享飞行的体验。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use the broad structure growing from their head as a hang glider, leaping from high cliffs and drifting for miles. They will sometimes offer smaller Pokémon a ride, enjoying getting to share the experience of flight with others.

entry: POKENAME花瓣会随周围占主导的情绪发光。大多是正面情绪时，泛出柔和红光；负面情绪较多时，则透出清冷蓝光。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME petals light up according to the prevailing mood surrounding them. When the mood is generally positive, a soft red glow emanates from them. When the mood is predominantly negative, they give off a cool blue glow.

entry: POKENAME接触不到足够的正面情绪，花瓣就会凋萎。此时又难以提起精神寻找欢乐，容易陷入越发消沉的恶性循环。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME petals wilt when they aren't exposed to sufficient positive emotion. POKENAME that are experiencing this wilting struggle to motivate themselves to seek out joyful feelings and are at risk of being caught in depressive spirals.

entry: 这是POKENAME众多形态之一，品味优雅。若要为活动布置餐桌，它是理想的伙伴。
author: hophoppip
source: One of the numerous forms of POKENAME, this fusion has elegant tastes. It's an ideal companion for setting tables for an event.

entry: POKENAME以花为傲，开心地四处走动，向尽可能多的人炫耀。它享受众人的喜爱，借这些正面情绪让花长得更大。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME take great pride in their flower, happily marching around to show it off to as many people as possible. They bask in the adoration that they receive, using the positive emotion to grow their flower even larger.

entry: 有人靠近时，POKENAME便迅速抖动花朵，四处撒下花粉。它在婚礼上很受欢迎，新人经过时，会将彩纸般的花粉洒向空中。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME rapidly shake their flower when people get close, shedding pollen everywhere. They have become a popular Pokémon during wedding celebrations, their confetti-like pollen scattering into the air when the married couple passes by.

entry: POKENAME的花粉如同彩纸，因此深受各类庆典欢迎。一听到撒花粉的指示，就会兴奋挥动短臂，十分享受成为焦点的时刻。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's confetti-like pollen makes them popular Pokémon to have at celebrations. They wave their stubby arms excitedly when they're instructed to shed their pollen, greatly enjoying their moment as the centre of attention.

entry: POKENAME花瓣边缘坚硬结实，蓝黄相间的尖端受压时却容易折落。它把碎片当彩纸撒开，走过便留下一条彩色轨迹。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME petals are rigid and tough at their edges, the blue and yellow tips breaking away easily under pressure. POKENAME scatter these petal fragments like confetti, leaving a colourful trail behind themselves as they walk.

entry: POKENAME的花瓣远比看起来轻，结构如海绵，充满空气。强风吹来时就跳起兜住风，让自己被带往新的觅食地。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME petals are far lighter than they appear, with their structure being spongy and filled with air. When strong winds blow through, POKENAME jump into the air and catch the breeze, allowing themselves to be carried to new feeding grounds.

entry: POKENAME性情温和，很适合在托儿所照顾幼童。花香有催眠作用，小睡时间让孩子闻闻，便能哄其入睡。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be used within nurseries to care for young children because of their gentle nature, making them well-suited to the work. The scent of their flower has a soporific effect, lulling the children who smell it to sleep when it's naptime.

entry: POKENAME的花粉用于为烟花着色。含有其孢子的烟花升空后，会使观看的人感到强烈喜悦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME pollen is used to colour fireworks. Fireworks that are launched containing their spores inspire powerful feelings of joy in those who see them.

entry: POKENAME随着舞步扇动花瓣，为其他宝可梦表演助兴。它喜欢表演吸引来的关注，尽全力让节目有趣好看。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flap their petals in time with their dance moves, putting on shows for the entertainment of other Pokémon. They enjoy the attention their performances draw to them, putting all their effort into being as fun as possible to watch.

entry: POKENAME的这种形态格外自信。会朝夜空发射爆炸性花粉，制造耀眼表演。
author: hophoppip
source: This form of POKENAME is especially confident. It launches explosive pollen into the night sky to create a dazzling display.

entry: 建议训练家训练POKENAME时做好眼部防护，因为它习惯朝空中喷出阵阵彩色花粉。受到夸奖时，便会这样庆祝自己获得的赞许。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Trainers are advised to make use of eye protection whilst training POKENAME due to the Pokémon's habit of launching colourful bursts of pollen into the air. They launch these pollen bursts when they receive praise, celebrating the positive attention.

entry: POKENAME的花瓣是高级餐厅颇受欢迎的食材。吃下后会心生喜悦、积极向上，就算菜肴再难吃，也不妨碍效果显现。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME petals are a popular ingredient at high-end restaurants. Their petals induce feelings of joy and positivity when ingested, their effects making themselves known even in the most unappetising meals.

entry: POKENAME身体柔软，捏起来像棉花糖。被拥抱时会喷出团团花粉，香气能使吸入者心生亲近，感到平静。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have soft, squashy bodies that have a texture similar to marshmallows. They release puffs of pollen when hugged, giving off a scent that engenders feelings of affection and calm in those that breathe it in.

entry: POKENAME喜欢散布孢子云，让其他宝可梦开心。吸入太多会欣快却昏昏欲睡。幸好对许多训练家而言，效果很快便会消退。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to proliferate clouds of spores to make other Pokémon happy. Inhaling too many spores leads to a euphoric yet drowsy feeling. Thankfully for many Trainers, the effects quickly fade with time.

entry: POKENAME写的每封信里，都有给读者的运势预言。虽未证实预言与未来有何关联，有些人依然深信不疑。
author: camtft
source: Within each letter written by POKENAME exists a fortune for the reader. Though no link between the fortunes and the future has been proven, some stand by their fortune.

entry: POKENAME的舞蹈令人目眩，转身回旋时伴着深情歌声。看过表演的人，随后几天都心平气和，对他人满怀善意。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME perform dazzling dance performances, their spins and twirls being accompanied by a soulful song. Those who watch a POKENAME perform find themselves feeling calmed and full of goodwill toward others for days afterwards.

entry: POKENAME寻找安静森林，坐在树下，不伤害植物便能从中获得滋养。孢子可用于减轻压力，让人安然入睡。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME seek out quiet forests in which they can sit beneath trees, and are nourished by the plants without harming them. Their spores can be used to reduce stress and grant peaceful sleep.

entry: POKENAME和身上的蘑菇冷却后风味独特，做成冰棒很美味。可只要附近有人想到这种冰棒，或有意制作，它们便会立刻消失。
author: firstromaniandiscoerd
source: POKENAME and its mushroom have a distinct flavour when cold, which makes them delicious in ice pops. However, they will disappear as soon as anyone close thinks about POKENAME ice pops or with intent of making one.

entry: POKENAME栖居的海滩上，沙中混着闪闪发亮的物质，据说能带来好运。研究者还不清楚，它究竟来自外骨骼还是汗液。
author: hophoppip
source: On beaches where POKENAME dwells, the sand is mixed with a sparkling substance that's said to bring good luck. Researchers have not figured out whether this substance comes from POKENAME's exoskeleton or its sweat.

entry: POKENAME痛恨无谓的暴力，只愿与同样乐于助人的伙伴友好切磋。它会赠予尊重的对手一根羽毛，据说随身带着能缓解紧张。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME abhors senseless violence, preferring only to fight in friendly sparring matches with other altruistic beings. It will gift an opponent it respects one of its feathers, which are said to relieve tension for the carrier.

entry: 野生POKENAME远离暴力，喜欢住在和平的地区。据说，只要将孢子撒向冲突中的所有参与者，争斗就会停止。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME flee from violence, preferring to live in peaceful regions. It is said that fighting would cease if only POKENAME's spores could be scattered upon all participants in conflict.

entry: POKENAME住在幽静安宁的密林深处，喜欢与吉利蛋、仙子伊布等心地善良的宝可梦相伴。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives deep in secluded and peaceful forests. It enjoys the company of kind-hearted Pokémon such as Chansey and Sylveon.

entry: POKENAME在天际疾飞，很少长留一地。翅膀快速振动散出的花粉会使别人乏力，却也刺激内啡肽分泌，让这份无力感反而颇为舒适。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME zips across the sky, rarely remaining in one place for long. The rapid beat of its wings spreads pollen that causes weakness in others, yet also stimulates endorphins and makes the weakening sensation feel rather pleasant.

entry: POKENAME唱着欢乐的歌，夜里漫游城镇，为时令庆典送上祝福，人称“欢庆之灵”。
author: alkazamis
source: Singing joyfully, POKENAME wanders through towns at night, blessing seasonal festivals. It is known as the Spirit of Jubilation.

entry: 人们会雇POKENAME帮忙制作婚礼蛋糕，却不建议留它参加婚礼。它常投入得过了头，兴奋地从花艺布置里摘下花瓣，撒满整个会场。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are hired to help make wedding cakes. It's encouraged not to have them remain present for the wedding, as they often become invested to the point where they excitedly shower the ceremony in flower petals from the flower arrangements.

entry: POKENAME一旦任由怒火支配，就会攻击眼前任何对手，连比自己弱的也不例外。它不停梳理、抚摸自己，以此压住怒气。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Giving into its rage makes POKENAME fight any opponent it sees, even ones weaker than it. It subdues its rage by constantly preening and petting itself.

entry: POKENAME曾被误认为幻之宝可梦，据说它的长啸能保佑一生长寿好运。有故事讲述，它在林火中以安详优雅、流畅的动作救助伤者。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Once mistakenly believed to be mythical Pokémon, POKENAME's howls are said to guarantee a life of longevity and good luck. There are tales of POKENAME helping the injured during forest fires, moving with serene grace and fluidity.

entry: POKENAME解决纷争的方式不同寻常：把滋事者痛打一顿，直到对方浑身青肿、虚弱得再也闹不起来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME takes an unorthodox approach to solving strife and disputes: It pummels those causing trouble until they are too bruised and weakened to continue their troublesome ways.

entry: POKENAME不知疲倦地寻找庆典与聚会，想加入欢庆。会找出庆祝的主角，开心地将其高高抛起，逗得周围众人欢笑。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME tirelessly search for celebrations and parties, seeking to join the festivities. They seek out the person at the centre of a given celebration, happily tossing them high into the air to the delight of those around them.

entry: 它在高草间躁动不安，满怀野心地寻找新对手。与多数宝可梦不同，POKENAME似乎不靠凡间食物为生，而渴求自己挑起的小争斗散出的纯粹能量。
author: ashnanodesu
source: This Pokémon dwells restlessly in the tall grass, searching ambitiously to create new rivals. Unlike most Pokémon, POKENAME seems not to live off of any earthly food, but instead craves the pure energy that radiates from the petty fights it starts.

entry: 它力量强大，却以爱好和平闻名。与波克基斯不同，会主动寻找纷争，介入其中，带来和平。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: Despite its strength, this Pokémon is known to be a pacifist. Unlike Togekiss, it intentionally seeks out strife in order to intervene and bring peace.

entry: POKENAME有时会跑遍街区，为口渴的人送上劲爽汽水。训练家反映，给它美味之水或果汁牛奶，反而会引来不满。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME sometimes run through neighborhoods, delivering Soda Pop to anyone who is thirsty. Trainers have reported that POKENAME react negatively when given Fresh Water and Lemonade.

entry: POKENAME常用红漆或蓝漆，帮其他宝可梦盖住颜色不匀的斑块。油漆黏在手上，让它们看起来脏兮兮。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often help other Pokémon cover up miscolored blotches with red or blue paint. This paint clings to the hands of POKENAME, giving them their messy appearance.

entry: POKENAME天生全身雪白，要靠旁人帮忙涂上红蓝两色。作为维持仪容的回报，帮忙的人会得到好运的祝福。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on the help of those around them to paint their bodies red and blue, as their bodies are naturally white. In exchange for helping them maintain their appearance, those who help are blessed with good luck.

entry: 传说POKENAME优雅的双翼每次闪耀，都表示世上某处有宝可梦的蛋孵化。没人知道它们脸上是什么样子，只见壳中黄色双眼发光。
author: bigoljax
source: Legends say that whenever POKENAME's graceful wings shine, it's an indication of a Pokémon Egg hatching somewhere in the world. Nobody knows what their faces look like, only the yellow eyes that glow from their shells.

entry: POKENAME性情活泼，喜欢背着训练家和宝可梦。柔和火焰触感温暖，让人心里暖融融，倍感舒适。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are whimsical creatures that enjoy carrying Trainers and Pokémon on their back. The soft flames they produce are warm to the touch and give a fuzzy feeling of comfort.

entry: POKENAME靠正面情绪托起身体，贴着地面滑行。科学家推测，它随和的性格是对这种移动方式的进化适应。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME moves by gliding just above the ground, lifted by its positive emotions. Scientists theorize that its easygoing attitude is an evolutionary response to this method of locomotion.

entry: POKENAME感到谁心地善良，就热切地送上许多祝福。就算有人惹恼它，也会很快忘了当初为何生气。
author: skittytales
source: POKENAME eagerly showers blessings on anyone it senses is kindhearted. Even if someone manages to get on its bad side, it will quickly forget why it was mad in the first place.

entry: POKENAME会冲下悬崖，在空中滑翔很远。它们几乎从不悲伤或愤怒，即使失败，也绝不会灰心，总愿意再试一次。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME will run off of cliffs and glide through the air across long distances. They are rarely ever sad or angry, and even if they fail at something they will never be discouraged from trying again.

entry: 它们游过的水中，常在身后留下明亮闪光。开心时会快速拍打双鳍。野生POKENAME曾多次被人报告救起溺水者。
author: infinex21
source: The water they swim through often twinkles with bright lights in their wake. They clap their flippers together rapidly when they are happy. Wild POKENAME have often been reported as having saved drowning humans many times.

entry: 对受它守护者而言，它象征希望与喜悦。炮管既能射出强劲水柱，也能打出纯粹的能量。
author: voiddx01
source: This Pokémon serves as a symbol of hope and joy to those it protects. Its cannons can fire either powerful blasts of water or pure energy.

entry: POKENAME罕见于偏僻海滩，身体发出的光象征好运与繁荣。然而外壳似乎会彻底遮住这份效果，让人无法感知。
author: ocxin
source: A rare sight on secluded beaches, POKENAME's body shines with a light promising fortune and prosperity. Its outer shell, however, seems to fully block the ability to perceive this effect.

entry: POKENAME只在和平时期出现，在阴影里盘算各种恶作剧。它会袭击最快乐的人，吸走情绪，直到一丝不剩。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME are only seen during times of peace, plotting various pranks in the shadows. POKENAME are known to attack individuals at their happiest, sapping their emotions until none remain.

entry: POKENAME以人和宝可梦分泌的内啡肽为食，寻找合适的对象，躲进对方的影子。头上蓝红两角会产生独特毒素，促使目标大量释放内啡肽。
author: adamzwill
source: POKENAME feed on endorphins produced by people and Pokémon, seeking out those it deems suitable so it can hide in their shadow. The blue and red horns on its head produce a unique toxin that induces a mass release of endorphins in a target.

entry: POKENAME寻找伤害别人的人，试着让其为造成的痛苦赎罪。对方越是抗拒帮助，它就越执着不放。
author: thesilverowls
source: POKENAME seeks out individuals who hurt others and attempts to get them to atone for the pain they caused. The longer an individual resists getting help, the more persistent POKENAME becomes.

entry: 据说POKENAME钳中的肉极甜，口感绵滑，因此常出现在高级餐厅。然而也正因如此，它已被捕杀得濒临灭绝。
author: mistymagius
source: The meat from POKENAME's claws is described to be incredibly sweet and creamy, so they are often served at fancy restaurants. Due to this, however, POKENAME has been hunted to near extinction.

entry: 它钻进沙漠的沙中，伪装成灌木。背上的叶子极苦，令食草动物不敢下口。
author: chorb33
source: It burrows into the desert sand to disguise itself as a bush. The leaves on its back taste extremely bitter to deter potential herbivores.

entry: POKENAME不喜欢雨，会找适度干燥的地方休息。它以植物根部为食；农夫有时发现庄稼停止生长，就是因为它来吃过点心。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME dislike rain and seek out moderately dry places to rest. They feed on the roots of plants; farmers may discover their crops have stopped growing due to POKENAME having a snack.

entry: POKENAME三五成群，摇摇摆摆地走过温暖沙漠。受威胁时快速旋转，扬起沙云遮掩行踪，迅速钻入地下逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME travels in small groups, waddling across the warm desert sands. If threatened, it spins rapidly to kick up clouds of sand to obscure its escape as it burrows quickly underground.

entry: POKENAME用骨棒掘土，挖出树木与植物下美味的根。若不小心挖穿巢穴或地洞，就挥棒挡开愤怒袭来的尖牙。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dig through the ground with their boney club, shoveling through dirt to reach delicious roots beneath trees and plants. Whenever they accidentally dig into a den or burrow, they fight off angry fangs and teeth with their club.

entry: POKENAME走到哪里都留下一路沙。沙子用尽便再也不能飘浮，因此会吃下地上的沙补充，防止这种情况发生。
author: mystora
source: POKENAME leave a trail of sand wherever they go. Whenever they run out of sand, they are no longer able to levitate. To prevent this from happening, they refill by eating sand from the ground.

entry: POKENAME的茧十分坚韧，受损时会一片片剥落。若掉进水洼，就会设法滚往别处，免得弄湿。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a resilient cocoon that flakes off in pieces when damaged. If they fall into a puddle, they will attempt to roll to a different spot to avoid getting wet.

entry: 触手由细沙构成，不断散落。这虽很适合在沙漠环境伪装，却也使它难以抓住任何东西。
author: mistymagius
source: Its tentacles are made out of a fine sand that constantly falls apart. Despite being great for camouflage in its desert environment, it struggles to grab anything because of this.

entry: 它生活在温暖水域，出了名地害羞，却又好奇。睡觉时身体蜷如胎儿，尾巴缠着海草等水下植物。其实舌头很长，却很少使用。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is a notoriously shy yet curious Pokémon found in warm waters. It sleeps curled up in a fetal position with its tail wrapped around undersea growth, such as seaweed. It actually has a very long tongue, but it rarely uses it.

entry: POKENAME能从身体排出恶臭物质自卫。鳞片曾用于传统医药，因此历史上遭到过度捕捞。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can emit a terrible-smelling substance from its body for self-defense. It has been historically overfished for its scales, which have been used in traditional medicine.

entry: POKENAME生活的湖泊经常在夏季干涸。它将鳍向内蜷起，让鳞皮朝外抵御风吹日晒，保存水分，直到雨水归来，以此熬过干旱期。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in lakes that regularly dry out over the summer months. They are able to endure these dry periods by curling their fins in on themselves and letting their scaly skin face the elements, preserving their moisture until the rain returns.

entry: POKENAME以散播花粉的方式闻名。一旦撒到某处，就几乎不可能清除。饲养起来极费心，因此很少成为家养宠物。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME are known for how they spread their pollen. Once scattered in an area, it will become almost impossible to remove. It is rare for a POKENAME to become a house pet, as they are an extremely high-maintenance Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME白天藏在沙下，夜里才出来闪动身上的宝石，向同类传讯。星形身体能以惊人速度旋转，卷起沙龙卷自卫。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME spends the day hidden beneath the sand, emerging only at night to signal others of its kind by flashing the gem on its body. It can spin its star-shaped body at incredible speed to create sand tornadoes for protection.

entry: POKENAME表演默剧时，始终站在一颗球上保持平衡。球看似压实的泥土，其实也是身体的一部分。没有眼睛或四肢，只能靠另一半身体带着滚动。
author: .jerden
source: As it mimes, POKENAME constantly balances on a ball of what appears to be hard-packed dirt, but is actually part of its body. This ball has no eyes or limbs, and so relies on its other half to roll it around.

entry: 有人说，POKENAME的皮越坚韧，肉就越甜。在合众开阔牧场中成群饲养，夏天会钻进尘土保持凉爽。
author: ghostslythe
source: Some say the tougher POKENAME's hide, the sweeter its meat. Kept in herds on the open ranges of Unova, it burrows into the dust to stay cool during the summer.

entry: POKENAME在河边沙地掘洞，容易被水流冲走。它太弱，游不回上游旧居，因此经常得重新挖一个家。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME burrows in the sand at the side of rivers. It is easily swept away by the current, and frequently digs a new home to live in because it is too weak to swim back upriver to a previous resting place.

entry: 角能注入强烈毒液。受威胁时，POKENAME会蜷成球，试着装成石头。
author: bobosmith01
source: A potent venom can be injected from its horn. If threatened, POKENAME curls up into a ball shape and tries to pass itself off as a rock.

entry: POKENAME以螺旋动作穿行沙中。若感到头顶有其他宝可梦活动的振动，就会跃出，用强颚将其咬住。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME burrows through the sand by moving in a corkscrew motion. If it senses the vibrations of another Pokémon moving above it, it will leap out to try to seize it in its powerful jaws.

entry: POKENAME背上的沙堡让它在冰冷湖中游泳时能迅速转向。人类使用它的沙子，则能减轻眩晕。
author: camtft
source: The sandcastle upon the back of POKENAME provides its ability to swiftly turn as it swims through frozen lakes. When used by humans, their sand helps reduce dizziness.

entry: POKENAME身体由流沙构成，能操控着变成几乎任何模样，却偏爱球形。因极度怕水，十分喜爱千香果。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's body is made of liquid sand which it can manipulate to transform into almost any form, but it prefers to turn into spherical shapes. It loves Passho Berries because it has an intense fear of water.

entry: POKENAME钻入地下，寻找可接入的网线。一旦找到，便大啖其中传输的数据流。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME burrow underground searching for internet cables to connect to. Once they find a cable, they feast on the stream of data that is transmitted.

entry: POKENAME只生活在沙漠深处，不受打扰便能一睡多年。若被烦醒，就会卷起大量沙子形成沙暴，朝四面八方猛攻，将闯入者掀飞。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Only found deep within deserts, POKENAME can sleep for years on end if left undisturbed. If one is bothered enough to wake up, it will move enough sand to sweep up a sandstorm, lashing out in all directions to launch trespassers away.

entry: POKENAME通常整天伏在沙下不动，积蓄进化所需能量。若有人发现藏身处并将它挖出，就会本能地使出毒针自卫。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME tends to lie motionless beneath the sand all day, building up the energy it needs to evolve. If someone digs it up after discovering its hiding spot, it defends itself by impulsively unleashing a Poison Sting attack.

entry: POKENAME收起尾巴和翅膀后，除头顶羽毛外几乎与穿山鼠一模一样。它与亲族同住，挥翼送出寒风，保护大家免受伤害。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can tuck in its tail and wings to appear near-identical to Sandshrew aside from the plumage atop its head. It lives among its relatives, protecting them from harm with chilling winds flung from its wings.

entry: POKENAME害怕时会蜷成球。同时以精神力量另造一层球形护罩，为自己多添一重保护。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME curls into a ball when it feels frightened. While doing so, its mind creates an additional sphere of psychic energy that works as a shield to give it extra protection from harm.

entry: POKENAME住在沙漠，靠长颈吃高大仙人掌顶端的花。尾巴上的花结出的种子能在任何环境生长，常在族群周围造出小绿洲。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME live in deserts, their long necks letting them eat the flowers atop tall cacti. The seeds that come from the flowers on their tails can grow in any environment, often creating mini oases around communities of these Pokémon.

entry: 背上的晶体由玻璃化的沙构成，是自身火焰熔化沙漠沙粒中的石英所形成。晶体很容易碎裂，战斗时尤其如此，但钻地时必定会重新形成。
author: infinex21
source: The crystalline structures on its back are vitrified sand created by its own flames melting the quartz within desert sands. These crystals are quick to break, especially during battle, but inevitably reform while it digs underground.

entry: POKENAME离水后会长时间在泥里打滚，防止皮肤干燥。它十分温和，宁可自卫也不愿攻击，不过那副小颚常让别人误会。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME rolls in mud for long periods to keep its skin from drying out once it leaves the water. It is a very gentle Pokémon that prefers to defend itself rather than attack, though its small jaws often give others the wrong impression.

entry: POKENAME爬出地道后，会仔细梳去翅上的泥土。羽毛脆弱，需要不断打理。
author: .izik
source: After exiting its tunnel, POKENAME carefully preens its wings clean of dirt. Its feathers are fragile and require constant upkeep.

entry: 双颚强到能咬碎坚硬岩石。它在沙中迅速游行，再突然钻出，伏击并咬住猎物。
author: infinex21
source: Its jaws are strong enough to break apart solid rock. It swiftly swims through sand and surfaces to ambush and bite down upon prey.

entry: POKENAME在沙漠掘行，如在水中游泳般顺畅。坚韧外皮让打来的攻击滑开，它便顶着攻击，直冲锁定的猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can dig through the desert sands as smoothly as if it was swimming through water. Its tough hide causes blows to glance off of it, barreling through attacks as it races towards prey it has targeted.

entry: 发达的听觉让它时刻警觉，稍有声响就蜷成紧球，准备承受冲击。主要在白天活动，通常黄昏钻入沙下，整夜不出。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its highly developed hearing keeps it constantly alert; at the slightest sound, it curls into a tight ball and braces for impact. Primarily a diurnal Pokémon, it typically burrows beneath the sand at dusk and remains there through the night.

entry: POKENAME把丝织成球，推着四处走，将虫子和树果一起收集回家。它很胆小，稍被触碰就会蜷成球自卫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME creates spheres of webbing to push around, gathering up bugs and berries alike to bring back to its home. It is a nervous sort and will curl into a ball defensively at the slightest touch.

entry: POKENAME乘暖上升气流飞遍沙漠，远行觅食。特殊的第二层眼睑能挡住飞沙，因此即使穿越沙暴也不受影响。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME soar through deserts in search of food, catching warm updrafts to travel great distances. They have a special second eyelid that protects them from airborne sand, allowing them to fly through sandstorms without ill effect.

entry: POKENAME扬起泥沙，射出闪电，吓退敌人。它生活在一小片相通的地下洞穴中。
author: chorb33
source: To frighten enemies, POKENAME flings dirt and sand and hurls lightning bolts. It lives in small underground cave systems.

entry: POKENAME皮肤太薄，鳞片挡不住烈日。它会跳舞数小时，等雨落下解渴，可多数时候都因精疲力竭而昏倒。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME's scales cannot protect it from harsh sunlight due to its thin skin. It will dance for several hours, waiting for rain to pour so it can quench its thirst. Most of the time, however, it faints from exhaustion.

entry: 多数夜晚，POKENAME都会掘入山中寻找月之石。满月之夜，便在月光下跳舞，高举找到的石头，转着圈舞蹈。
author: bagumbothimble
source: On most nights, POKENAME dig into the mountains to search for Moon Stones. On the night of a Full Moon, the POKENAME dance in the moonlight, spinning in circles with whatever stones they have found raised above their head.

entry: POKENAME唱完歌后会在沙里打滚。因为歌唱会令许多鳞片脱落，须先用沙填补空隙，等鳞片重新长出。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME who have recently sung roll in the sand. This is because many of their scales are shed when they sing, so they fill in the gaps with sand until their scales grow back.

entry: POKENAME钻入地下吃植物根。会把壳上的粗糙边缘磨平，以免掘土时卡在岩石上。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME burrow underground to eat plant roots. They smooth out rough edges of their shells so that pieces do not get caught on rocks as they dig.

entry: POKENAME挖的地道里常铺着一簇簇羊毛。它会蜷进自己的羊毛中，藏起身来，或更好地保护自己。
author: infinex21
source: Tunnels dug by POKENAME are often lined with many tufts of wool. They curl into their own wool to hide or to defend themselves better.

entry: POKENAME快速扇翼，卷起危险沙暴驱赶入侵者。全身覆盖流线型护甲，既能融入沙丘，也让它飞得极快。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME keeps intruders away by rapidly flapping its wings to raise dangerous sandstorms. Its body is covered with aerodynamic armor that not only allows it to blend with the dunes but also makes it extremely fast in flight.

entry: POKENAME在沙中打滚时，羊毛上的静电会将沙熔成玻璃，使外皮坚固洁净，免受寄生虫侵扰。
author: periperi_chicken
source: When POKENAME rolls in sand, the static from its wool melts it into glass, which keeps its hide sturdy, clean, and protected from parasites.

entry: POKENAME用手上圆球的刺刮擦坚韧外皮，与同类交流。圆球也能卸下，作为带尖刺的弹丸投出，一天后便会长回。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME communicates with others by scratching the spines on its hand-orbs against its tough hide. These orbs can also be detached and thrown as pointed projectiles, growing back a day later.

entry: POKENAME飘过沙丘时，身上会落下带花香的沙。香气若吸入太久，会有轻微毒性。
author: .izik
source: A floral-scented sand drifts from POKENAME's body as it floats over dunes. The scent is mildly toxic if inhaled for too long.

entry: POKENAME生活在沙漠，借较高的气温升上天空。虽然只需少量水就能生存，绿洲周围仍常见大群聚集。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in desert areas, using the higher air temperature to lift it into the sky. Despite being able to survive on little water, large groups of them can be seen around oases.

entry: POKENAME在地下深处掘穴为家，将收集的食物与小物件分房存放。巢穴若被发现，便用土堵住入口，退往储藏室。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME burrow deep into the ground to make their homes. They create individual rooms for food and trinkets they've gathered. If their dens are ever discovered, they will fill the entrances to the caverns with dirt and retreat to the storage rooms.

entry: POKENAME最开心的时候，就是在软沙中打滚，或在阳光直射下飞行。通常十分讨厌雨天。
author: bagumbothimble
source: POKENAME is at its happiest when it is either rolling in soft sand or flying under direct sunlight. POKENAME typically despises rainy days.

entry: POKENAME组成庞大群落，轮流站岗。以分泌的凝胶标记领地，任何东西闯入，都会聚起来攻击。数量优势往往足以吓退威胁。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME gather in large colonies, taking turns to keep watch. They mark their territory with a gel they secrete, and if anything enters it, they all gather together and attack it. Their superior numbers are often enough to send threats running.

entry: POKENAME组成庞大群落，轮流站岗。以分泌的凝胶标记领地，任何东西闯入，都会聚起来攻击。数量优势往往足以吓退威胁。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME gather in large colonies, taking turns to keep watch. They mark their territory with a gel they secrete, and if anything enters it, they all gather together and attack it. Their superior numbers are often enough to send threats running.

entry: 背上的仙人掌能储水，供POKENAME饮用。吸水越多，花就开得越绚烂。
author: chorb33
source: The cactus on its back can store water and supply POKENAME with liquid. The more water it has absorbed, the more splendidly it blooms.

entry: POKENAME的胡须能探知地道壁外的树根。找到后便啃穿泥土，吃下根部。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's whiskers detect tree roots beyond its tunnel walls. Once located, it chews through the soil to feed on the roots.

entry: 受惊时，POKENAME会把头埋进沙里。尾巴则咬向任何靠近的东西，冰冷牙齿留下结冰的咬痕。
author: periperi_chicken
source: When spooked, POKENAME buries its head in the sand. Its tail snaps at anything that comes near, its cold teeth leaving an icy indentation behind.

entry: POKENAME能像陀螺般旋转，迅速冲入战场。考古学家有时会把它误认成古代器物。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME can charge into battle quickly by spinning like a top. Archaeologists sometimes mistake it for an ancient artifact.

entry: POKENAME讨厌皮毛沾水，经常沙浴以保持干燥。无论走到哪里都会带进大量沙子，照顾起来颇令人头痛。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hates getting its fur wet and will take frequent dust baths to keep itself dry. It is an annoying Pokémon to take care of, as it drags in large amounts of sand wherever it goes.

entry: POKENAME与同群伙伴合力挖出复杂地道。地下迷宫错综复杂，连资深研究者也难以理清。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs elaborate tunnels with its flock. These underground labyrinths are so intricate they confound even expert researchers.

entry: POKENAME十分机灵，会尾随其他宝可梦，直到对方回到洞穴。等对方睡着，再掘进去偷走囤积的食物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are witty creatures that stalk other Pokémon until they return to their burrows. Once they fall asleep, POKENAME dig into their burrow to steal food they have gathered.

entry: POKENAME躯干上深色斑点很敏感，因此常蜷身或弓背保护。夜间四处游荡，在沙中掘出大洞，天亮后藏进去。
author: sk372
source: The darker spots on POKENAME's torso are sensitive, so it often remains curled up or hunched over to protect them. It roams about during the night, digging large burrows in the sand to hide in when day breaks.

entry: POKENAME走到哪里，哪里的草就会烧焦。每逢下雨，沙质身体凝固，失去抓地力。雨停后身体渐暖，才能继续游荡。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME leave a trail of scorched grass wherever they go. Whenever it rains, their gritty bodies lose their traction as they solidify. Their bodies warm up after the rain ends, allowing them to continue their wandering.

entry: 它将沙质身体的一部分烧至高温，造出玻璃壳。壳若破碎，只须再吸些沙，重新制作即可。
author: secondegg
source: By superheating part of its sandy body, it creates a shell made of glass. Should this shell break, it can simply absorb more sand and repeat the process.

entry: POKENAME拍动沉重翅膀，将沙轰向猎物。待对方被打懵，便以迅捷的一记“抓”结束战斗。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flaps its heavy wings to blast sand at its prey. Once stunned, it finishes the fight with a swift Scratch.

entry: POKENAME虽生活在干旱气候中，壳摸起来却冰凉。用灵敏鼻子寻找食物，嗅出埋在沙里的小动物。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite living in arid climates, POKENAME's shell is cold to the touch. It searches for food using its powerful nose, looking for small critters buried in the sand.

entry: POKENAME的长牙看似易碎，实由坚固砂岩构成，能够刺穿钢铁。可一下雨，长牙就会重新化为沙。
author: dodoowner_
source: Although they seem fragile, POKENAME's tusks are made of durable sandstone and are able to pierce through steel. When it rains, its tusks turn back into sand.

entry: POKENAME通常在沙漠上空翱翔，热得难以忍受时才钻入沙下。藏到夜幕降临、空气转凉，才会出来。
author: .izik
source: While typically soaring over deserts, POKENAME burrows beneath the sand when the heat grows unbearable. It remains hidden until nightfall brings cooler air.

entry: POKENAME总想挖洞，饲养者须不断设法转移它的注意。睡觉时蜷成披甲的球，但在信任者身边，也可能露出柔软肚皮。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has an insatiable desire to dig, so owners must constantly find ways to distract it from this instinct. It curls into an armored ball to sleep, but when around those it trusts, it may reveal its soft belly.

entry: POKENAME藏在沙下，摇响尾部的响器，吓退大型天敌。毒液虽不致命，却能令四肢麻痹长达一小时。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides in the sand, using the rattle on its tail to ward off larger predators. Its venom isn't fatal but will cause limb paralysis for up to an hour.

entry: 它大约每隔一天便往返于海洋与沙漠之间，即使遇上飓风或猛烈沙暴也毫无惧色。睡觉时将半身埋进泥或沙。
author: bobosmith01
source: It treks back and forth between the ocean and the desert every other day or so without any fear, even amidst hurricanes or great sandstorms. It sleeps half-buried in mud or sand.

entry: POKENAME在蜿蜒地道中高速滚动。洞里设有诱导绕圈的岔路与假出口，用来迷惑闯入的捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rolls at high speeds through winding tunnels. It builds decoy loops and false exits into its burrows to confuse predators that get inside.

entry: POKENAME每天沙浴，清除外皮上的异物。不洗的话，种子和孢子可能在皮肤里生长，引起不适。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME takes dust baths daily to remove foreign objects from its hide. Without the dust baths, seeds and spores can grow into its skin and cause irritation.

entry: POKENAME在足球场下筑巢，夜里才出来玩。它难以控制力量，常把器材弄坏。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME nests under soccer fields, emerging at night to play. It struggles to control its strength and often breaks the equipment.

entry: POKENAME练习还不够精准的格斗技巧时，会扬起周围的沙，掀出小沙暴。通过与同类切磋，让已经坚硬的皮肤更加坚韧。
author: fiordaliso
source: When practising its still-imprecise fighting techniques, POKENAME kicks up the sand around it, stirring small storms. It spars with others of its kind to further toughen its already hardened skin.

entry: POKENAME能收缩颈部皮褶，让身体变细，更易掘土。它用皮褶威吓、分散对方注意，同时以下半身与尾巴绞缠。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can contract their hoods to become more slender, making it easier for them to burrow through the ground. They use their hoods to intimidate and distract, whilst constricting with their lower bodies and tails.

entry: POKENAME因力量与王者般的外貌，受到一些古代文明推崇。在这些文明的遗迹中，已发现其巨型雕像，历经岁月考验，依旧完好。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME was held in high regard by some ancient civilizations for its strength and regal appearance. Large statues depicting POKENAME have been found intact in the civilizations' ruins, managing to survive the tests of time.

entry: 野生POKENAME很以自己用沙石堆成的巢穴为傲。爪子能挖穿硬岩，却须留心定期磨利。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME are very proud of the mounds of sand and rock they build to form their nests. Their claws can dig through hard rock but they must take care to sharpen them every so often.

entry: 披甲皮肤硬如砖墙。POKENAME腹部的保护最弱，因此即将承受重击时，会四肢着地，护住那里。
author: cait_sith
source: Its armored skin is as hard as a brick wall. POKENAME's belly has the weakest protection, so when it is about to take a heavy blow, it drops to all fours to protect that area.

entry: POKENAME能蜷起身体，迅速钻过缝隙逃走。敌人若追得太近，便用让人疼痛的电光还击。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can curl up and quickly escape from enemies through gaps. However, should one get too close, it shocks them with painful lightning bolts.

entry: POKENAME背上和尾巴上的壳柔韧厚实，足以挡住多数捕食者。它依然充满好奇，几乎遇见谁或什么东西，都乐意凑上前玩耍。
author: pkbonusducks
source: The flexible shell on POKENAME's back and tail is thick enough to ward off most predators. They are still curious Pokémon, happily approaching and playing with almost anyone and anything they come across.

entry: POKENAME能用尾巴在特定位置产生电压，电击对手，也能用尾巴支撑身体，帮助双爪挖掘。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can use its tail to create tension at certain points to shock opponents or as a support for its claws to dig through the ground.

entry: 自身融合后，POKENAME长出了少许尖刺，爪子也更尖。面对危险会坚守原地，只有明确毫无胜算时，才蜷成球撤退。
author: sk372
source: After self-fusion, POKENAME has developed a few spines as well as pointier claws. It stands its ground against dangers, only tucking into a ball and retreating when it is clear it has no chance of victory.

entry: POKENAME迅速飞过沙漠，沿途撒下沙，塑成沙丘。坚硬外骨骼让它轻易承受多数攻击。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME swiftly flies across the desert, scattering sand that shapes dunes in the process. Its tough exoskeleton lets it easily withstand most attacks.

entry: 这些沙漠宝可梦从翅膀放出强力冲击波，翻动沙土，将大半身体埋入，藏身休息。黄色外皮坚韧，足以承受多数攻击，因此常用尾巴护身。
author: infinex21
source: These desert Pokémon loose strong shockwaves from their wings to churn through the sand and bury most of their bodies to hide and rest. Their yellow hides are tough enough to endure most attacks, so they often shield themselves using their tails.

entry: POKENAME习惯把土质四肢在粗糙物面上滚动、撞击、打磨，塑形并压得更紧实。但常做得太过，甚至无缘无故也要来上一番。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME habitually rolls, slams, and sands down its earthen limbs into rough material to shape and pack them tighter. However, it has the habit of doing so too much or for no reason at all.

entry: POKENAME钻入沙中，即使在最干旱的沙漠也能吸取水分。它从流动的沙下突袭敌人。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME digs into the sand to absorb moisture even in the driest deserts. It strikes at foes from beneath shifting sands.

entry: POKENAME在干旱地带的亲代洞穴里筑巢。白天会探索洞穴周围，若感到受威胁，就伏低蜷身，保护自己。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME live in nests within their parent's burrow, found in dry and arid locations. During the day, POKENAME will explore the areas surrounding the burrow. If they feel threatened, these Pokémon will hunker down and curl up to protect themselves.

entry: 这是POKENAME罕见的形态，十年才见一次。研究显示，它不怕人类。人们认为，这种形态比其他个体更自立，也更坚韧。
author: thescribe
source: A rare form of POKENAME only seen once in a decade. Research has shown it to be unafraid of humans. It's believed that this form of POKENAME has become more self-sufficient and tougher than other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME凭强爪轻松挖穿沙土与砂岩。利爪虽能吓退多数威胁，若觉得难以应付，仍会蜷成球，滚到安全之处。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's strong claws allow it to tunnel through sand and sandstone with ease. While its sharp talons can deter most threats, it will curl into a ball and roll to safety if it feels the challenge is too great.

entry: POKENAME极其胆小，藏在沙下，一察觉有人靠近就赶紧挖深。只有粉红色的角感到附近情绪平静祥和，才会重新露面。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an extremely timid creature that hides beneath the sand, hastily digging itself in the moment it senses anyone approaching. It only resurfaces when its pink horns pick up calm and peaceful emotions nearby.

entry: 头顶蓝色器官的光会随接触到的情绪而改变强弱。有人见过它在沙漠起舞，蓝色器官明亮闪耀，缕缕流沙环绕身旁。
author: infinex21
source: The blue organ atop its head glows with varying intensities that depend on the emotions it is exposed to. It has been seen dancing in deserts with wisps of sand flowing around it as its blue organ shines bright.

entry: 丰缘古代象形图描绘了POKENAME帮助农夫耕作的景象。赋予它力量的沙虽贫瘠，杖中却含珍贵的生命水滴，能为土壤补充所需养分。
author: ghostslythe
source: Ancient Hoenn pictograms depict POKENAME helping farmers with their crops. While the sand empowering these Pokémon is barren, their staff contains precious Life Dew that gives needed nutrition to the soil.

entry: POKENAME掘土时，皮肤分泌浓稠黄色毒液。毒液不伤同类，却能阻止阿柏蛇等捕食者进入洞穴。
author: .izik
source: While digging, POKENAME's skin secretes a thick yellow toxin. As it is harmless to its kin, it repels predators like Ekans from entering its burrows.

entry: 学者对POKENAME的起源众说纷纭，但普遍推测，它曾协助法老绘制许多古代金字塔的设计图。
author: bradlybro199
source: Although many scholars disagree on the origins of POKENAME, it is widely theorized that they aided pharaohs in drawing up designs for many ancient pyramids.

entry: POKENAME从背上的仙人掌吸收、储存水分，因此最长能三年不补水而存活。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME absorbs water via the cacti on its back and stores it. This means it can survive for up to three years without new water.

entry: POKENAME挖好整套地道后，会在入口打滚，渗出绿色毒液。独特气味表明，这洞穴已有主人。
author: .izik
source: After completing a tunnel system, POKENAME rolls around at the entrance, leaking a green poison. Its unique aroma marks the burrow as claimed.

entry: POKENAME会把猎物的身体保存在颚内的沙里。但它十分健忘，常忘记这些脱水的猎物，张嘴捕捉新目标时，就把旧猎物掉了出来。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME is known to preserve the bodies of its prey in the sand within its jaws. However, it is forgetful and often forgets about its dehydrated prey, dropping them when it opens its mouth to catch something else.

entry: 构成POKENAME头骨的沙压得极紧，坚实耐撞，很适合攻击。不过它怕热，因此通常只在夜间漫游沙漠。
author: sk372
source: The sand comprising POKENAME's skull is densely packed, making it a sturdy and solid option for offense. It is sensitive to heat, though, meaning POKENAME typically only roams the desert at night.

entry: POKENAME身体如坦克，几乎所有攻击都能轻松扛下。被激怒时，会猛冲敌人。
author: mepp.
source: With a body like a tank, POKENAME shrugs off almost all attacks. When enraged, it forcefully charges at enemies.

entry: POKENAME在沙漠掘出大洞，躲进去降温。会围着小型宝可梦蜷成球，用坚韧外皮保护它们免受伤害。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME digs out large burrows in the desert sands to cool down in. It shields smaller Pokémon from harm by curling into a ball around them, protecting them with its sturdy hide.

entry: POKENAME罕有现身，会卷起小范围沙暴藏住自己。有故事讲，濒死旅人曾被它靠近，醒来时发现独自躺在绿洲附近，身边还有食物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are rarely seen and will whip up localized sandstorms to conceal themselves. Some stories persist of travelers who were near death that were approached by these Pokémon and awoke to find themselves alone near an oasis with food nearby.

entry: POKENAME体形巨大，常被视为沙漠中的顶级捕食者。它能整只吞下猎物，再从背上的喷气孔排出一同吃进的沙。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are oft considered to be desert apexes due to their sheer size. They can swallow prey whole and release the sand consumed in the process from the blowholes on their backs.

entry: POKENAME很容易受惊，一听到响声就慌忙钻进沙层深处。它藏身时常忘了把仙人掌部分埋好，探险者便会一脚踩上去。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME is quite easy to scare, frantically hiding itself deep in the sand whenever it hears any loud noises. Explorers often end up stepping right onto its cacti, as POKENAME forgets to bury them completely while hiding itself.

entry: POKENAME见于高原和方山，喜欢干旱气候。沙漠寒夜里，会从后部排出可燃气体保暖。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Found on plateaus and mesas, POKENAME prefers arid climates. On cold desert nights, POKENAME will produce flammable gases from its rear to keep itself warm.

entry: POKENAME耳朵滴下黄色毒液，它将其涂在洞壁，标记领地。挖洞前一天就会这样做，向同类表明意图。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's ears drip a yellow poison it smears along cave walls to mark territory. It does this a day before digging to signal its intent to kin.

entry: POKENAME厚实的皮肤能抵挡烈日。常可见一群群趴着肚皮，从沙丘上滑下。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's thick skin helps protect them from the harsh sun. Groups of these Pokémon can often be seen sliding down sand dunes on their stomachs.

entry: POKENAME虽无法将身体聚成完整刀刃，仍能以危险的力道挥出沙子。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Though POKENAME fails to hold itself together as a blade, it still swings its sand around at dangerous force.

entry: POKENAME看似无害，却会铲起沙子，猛力射向想握住它的人。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Despite its harmless appearance, POKENAME shovels into sand and launches it with great force at anyone who attempts to hold it.

entry: 许多英雄史诗都描绘古代沙漠君王挥舞POKENAME的事迹。如今极少见到它，主要出没在那些帝国的遗迹中。
author: mepp.
source: There are many heroic sagas describing ancient desert kings wielding POKENAME. They are rarely seen in the present day, as they now primarily haunt the ruins of these empires.

entry: POKENAME在开阔沙漠奔跑，撞穿挡路的一切障碍。精力耗尽后，便躺下晒太阳。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME runs across the open deserts, charging through any obstacles in its way. Once it runs out of energy, it will lie down to start sunbathing.

entry: POKENAME身体带有磁性，能聚沙成鬃，彰显优势、威吓对手。即使在地下也快得惊人，利爪能在任何地形挖出洞穴与地道。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body has magnetic properties that allow it to form a mane out of sand, asserting dominance and intimidating rivals. It can move at incredible speeds even underground, using its sharp claws to dig holes and tunnels through any terrain.

entry: POKENAME把缎带拧在一起，像钻头般旋转，就能迅速钻入地下。
author: melodydelune
source: By coiling its ribbons together and spinning them like a drill, POKENAME can burrow its way rapidly into the ground.

entry: POKENAME钻入沙下伏击猎物，身体常与环境完美相融。力量足以抱住大型猎物，用部分身体蜷住对方，拖入沙底。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME lie in wait for prey by burrowing under sand, their bodies often blending in perfectly. Their bodies are strong enough to grapple large prey and partly curl around them while dragging them under the sand.

entry: POKENAME带着潮水般的力量掘过沙漠，留下闪亮的盐与水痕。鳞片能储存地下水，因此在干旱地区被视为神圣的存在。
author: segmoph
source: POKENAME burrows through desert sands with tidal force, leaving behind glittering trails of salt and moisture. Its scales store groundwater, making it a sacred sight in arid regions.

entry: POKENAME卷成球，滚下山坡时，常被误认作巨石。它还会用尾巴拍地，把沙扬进敌人眼中。
author: over9001
source: When POKENAME curls into a ball, it can be mistaken as a large boulder rolling down a hill. It slaps its tail on the ground to whip up sand in its opponent's eyes.

entry: 据说这只神秘的宝可梦住在毁坏的世界，会现身于人前，提出后果惨重的交易。
author: hophoppip
source: This enigmatic Pokémon is said to dwell in the Distortion World, appearing to humans to make deals with disastrous consequences.

entry: POKENAME身体大多由飘浮沙粒构成。能让沙粒快速摩擦，产生电火花。
author: .jerden
source: Most of POKENAME's body consists of floating grains of sand. POKENAME can rub these together so quickly that sparks of electricity will be generated.

entry: 满月光下，POKENAME聚在一起跳舞玩耍。新月的黑夜里，则钻入地下深处，等月亮再度可见才出来。
author: bagumbothimble
source: Under the light of a full moon POKENAME will come together to dance and play. During the darkness of a new moon they will burrow deep under ground. They resurface when the moon is once again visible.

entry: POKENAME用利爪在地上挖出星座图案。满月之夜，便围坐图案周围，尽可能多地吸收月光。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dig constellation patterns into the ground with their sharp claws. On nights of the full moon, they sit around these patterns to absorb as much moonlight as possible.

entry: POKENAME体内流动的沙显示它离死亡还有多久。唯有偷取灵魂，转为燃料，才能获得足够能量翻转沙漏，重置生命倒计时。
author: soup1900
source: The sand flowing through POKENAME's body shows how long it has before it dies. The only way for it to have enough energy to flip its hourglass and reset its life timer is if it steals spirits and converts them into fuel.

entry: POKENAME体内流动的沙显示它离死亡还有多久。唯有偷取灵魂，转为燃料，才能获得足够能量翻转沙漏，重置生命倒计时。
author: soup1900
source: The sand flowing through POKENAME's body shows how long it has before it dies. The only way for it to have enough energy to flip its hourglass and reset its life timer is if it steals spirits and converts them into fuel.

entry: 它们住在缺水的干旱环境，光苔难寻，却依然爱吃。只需一点水，光苔便会膨胀，填满肚子。
author: quackquackattack
source: They reside in arid environments where there is a lack of water, which makes Luminous Moss difficult to find. Even so, they enjoy eating the moss, as a tiny bit of water causes the meal to swell and fill their stomachs.

entry: POKENAME住在酷热沙漠，将滚烫的沙收进翅膀。只须挥翼一下，瞬间便能唤起沙暴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live in blistering hot deserts where they collect scorching sand into their wings. With a single flap of the wing, they can conjure sandstorms in an instant.

entry: POKENAME白天大多埋在沙下，只在夜幕掩护下出来。受威胁时迅速扇翼，扬起小团尘云，借机逃走。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME spends most of the day buried under the sand, only emerging under the cover of night. When threatened, it will quickly beat its wings to kick up a small cloud of dust to allow it to escape.

entry: POKENAME以波导感知避开地下金属矿石，以免遇上大钢蛇等以矿物为食的捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses aura sensitivity to avoid metal ore underground. This keeps it safe from predators like Steelix that feed on such minerals.

entry: POKENAME掘土时会在耳朵里积蓄电力。离开安全的地道后，便以电力自卫。
author: .izik
source: While digging, POKENAME builds up electricity in its ears. This charge is used to defend itself when it exits the safety of its tunnel.

entry: POKENAME借尾端星星发出的光引路，在沙下挖出复杂地道。通常组成庞大家族，并倾向于保护群中最弱的成员。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses the light emitted by the star on its tail to guide itself as it digs intricate tunnels under the sand. It tends to live in very large family groups and has a tendency to defend the weakest members of the pack.

entry: 夜晚的沙漠风若带着舒缓旋律，就表示附近有POKENAME。歌声能催人入睡，建议入夜后穿越沙漠的训练家堵住耳朵。
author: afilthycasual
source: Desert winds bearing a soothing melody at night indicate the presence of POKENAME in the area. Trainers crossing the desert after dark are advised to plug their ears due to its sleep-inducing song.

entry: POKENAME生活在峡谷与方山周围，用附近的砂岩筑巢。石质爪子让它能攀上谷壁，不怕失手滑落。
author: mistymagius
