source: POKENAME live around canyons and mesas, building their nests out of the nearby sandstone. Their stone claws allow them to scale the canyon walls without fear of losing their grip.

entry: POKENAME在沙漠家园挖出沙坑，张嘴等毫无戒心的猎物落入。离开时懒得填坑，因此沙漠旅人也常陷进去。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME create sand pits in their desert homes, waiting for unwary prey to fall into their open mouth. Desert-goers often get stuck in these pits as POKENAME don't bother filling in the pits when they move on.

entry: POKENAME尾端的火在地下会更亮，方便看清四周。它向威胁自己的宝可梦投掷石头与泥巴，保护火焰。
author: quackquackattack
source: The flame at the end of a POKENAME's tail grows brighter when underground so it can see. It protects this flame by tossing rocks and mud at threatening Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME害怕或紧张时会蜷成球。不过它不是滚动逃险，而是以球形身体弹跳，大步跃离。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME curls into a ball when frightened or nervous. Rather than rolling away to escape danger, it bounces while in ball form, bounding away in great leaps.

entry: POKENAME掘入沙土，只露出眼睛和鼻子观察猎物。待其靠近，就猛扑而出，用双颚紧紧咬住。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME hide all but their eyes and noses beneath the sand or ground they dig into and watch for prey. When prey draws near, they lunge out and clamp their jaws down upon them.

entry: 受惊或疲惫时，POKENAME会钻进沙下，暂歇片刻。可沙常跑进耳朵，扰乱它们的回声定位。
author: frokachu
source: When spooked or tired, POKENAME will burrow under sand to rest temporarily. Sand often gets in their ears, disrupting their echolocation.

entry: POKENAME与沙丘完美融为一体，等待猎物靠得足够近，再择机出击。若遇上应付不了的强敌，便蜷成球，高速滚走。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME blends perfectly into the sand dunes, waiting for the right moment to strike at prey that ventures close enough. If it meets an opponent too powerful to handle, it curls into a ball and rolls away at high speed.

entry: POKENAME白天大多待在洞里，躲避沙漠酷热。嘴能滤走沙，因此捕猎时常俯冲进沙中，吞下藏在里面的东西。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides from the desert heat by hanging out in its cave for most of the day. It is able to filter sand out of its mouth, so while hunting, it will often swoop into the sand and swallow anything hiding in there.

entry: POKENAME会选更喜欢的宝石，替换一只眼睛。身体约需二十四小时，才能将其融合为能正常视物的眼睛。异色双眼的个体罕见，却让遗迹迷痴心寻觅。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME will replace one of its eyes with a gem it likes more, with its body taking around twenty-four hours to integrate as a functioning eye. It is rare to find one with mismatched eyes, but Ruin Maniacs obsessively search for such a prize.

entry: POKENAME身体由数个互相嵌合的节段构成，外有厚实角质甲片保护。各节尖端分泌强毒，任何触碰者都会受到影响。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's bodies are formed of several interlocking segments protected by thick keratinous plates. The tips of their body segments secrete a potent poison that affects anything that touches them.

entry: POKENAME身体由数个互相嵌合的节段构成，外有厚实角质甲片保护。各节尖端分泌强毒，任何触碰者都会受到影响。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's bodies are formed of several interlocking segments protected by thick keratinous plates. The tips of their body segments secrete a potent poison that affects anything that touches them.

entry: POKENAME在地下和沙漠沙层下挖出蜿蜒长道。颈边的爪子分泌毒液，让它更容易将缠住的猎物碾碎、拖下去。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME dig long and winding tunnels through the ground and beneath desert sands. The claws near their necks secrete a venom that makes it easy for them to crush and drag down prey they wrap around.

entry: POKENAME友善却害羞，发现喜欢的旅人便卷起小沙暴。它将对方带进巢穴避险，一同待着，直到自己愿意让风沙散去。
author: sk372
source: Friendly yet shy, POKENAME will whip up small sandstorms in the area when it spots a traveler it likes. It takes them to its den for safety and spends time with them until it feels ready to dissipate the storm.

entry: POKENAME通常钻在果园地下，与树根相连共生。感到害虫钻行的振动，就释放恶臭的宝可梦驱避物，保护果林。
author: ghostslythe
source: Usually found burrowed inside orchards, POKENAME symbiotically connects itself to the trees' roots. It feels vibrations from tunneling pests and protects the grove by releasing a foul-smelling Pokémon repellant.

entry: 沙漠日落时，POKENAME聚起来跳舞。若大颚蚁等宝可梦前来打扰，就弹沙进对方眼睛反击。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When the sun sets in the desert, POKENAME gather to dance. If Pokémon such as Trapinch bother them, POKENAME retaliate by flicking sand in the Pokémon's eyes.

entry: POKENAME自己长不出羽毛，便捡来羽毛做扇子。过几周羽毛磨损，就耐心再找新的，重新制作。
author: jaminmcready
source: Unable to grow feathers itself, POKENAME crafts fans from ones it finds. After a few weeks they fray, and it patiently searches for new feathers to rebuild them.

entry: POKENAME以尖头和坚韧的鳍切开沙丘，迅速游过。它不断捕猎其他生物充饥，用利牙击倒猎物。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can swim swiftly through desert dunes, cutting through them with its pointed head and tough fins. It constantly hunts for other creatures to satisfy its hunger, using its sharp fangs to bring down its prey.

entry: POKENAME生活在沙漠绿洲周围，白天晒太阳。一大片族群散出的浓烈气味，过去曾帮助沙漠旅人从很远处找到水源。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found in the desert around oases, spending the day soaking up the sun. The strong smell of a field of POKENAME was historically used to help desert travellers find water from great distances away.

entry: 大型填海工程会用到POKENAME。它将周围的沙加热至高温，再铺进排水沟，改善地下水流动，使地下逐渐形成含水层。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is used in large-scale projects to reclaim land from the sea. It superheats the sand around it, which is placed in drainage channels to improve groundwater flow and allow aquifers to gradually form underground.

entry: 大型填海工程会用到POKENAME。体内散出的热量能烘干、稳固浸水的沙，再将沙铺入排水沟，改善地下水流动，帮助陆地下方形成含水层。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is used in large-scale projects to reclaim land from the sea. Heat radiating from its body dries and stabilises waterlogged sand, which is laid in drainage channels to improve groundwater flow, helping aquifers develop beneath the land.

entry: POKENAME用叶片挡住眼睛前的沙，穿行猛烈沙暴。睡觉时以叶片裹身，伪装风滚草；清晨展开叶片，在一阵扬沙中醒来。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME block sand from their eyes with their leaves, helping them travel in harsh sandstorms. When they sleep, they wrap their leaves around themselves to disguise as tumbleweeds, waking up in the morning in a burst of sand as their leaves unfurl.

entry: POKENAME整天晒太阳吸收光能，却也让护甲变得脆裂粗糙。每次使出激光束等强力攻击，身体都会因威力过大而裂开一点。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME sunbathes in the sun all day to absorb light energy, but that also causes its armor to be very brittle and cragged. Each time it uses a powerful attack like a laser beam, its body cracks a little from the intensity.

entry: POKENAME走动时，身上的甲片保持光滑；蜷成球时，却会伸出数十根仙人掌般的刺自卫。被滚动冲撞击中的对象，会留下许多疼痛刺伤。
author: sk372
source: While walking around, POKENAME's plated body remains smooth, but when it curls into a ball, it extends dozens of cacti-like spines for self-defense. Getting hit by its rolling tackle leaves a target with many a painful puncture.

entry: POKENAME为躲捕食者，会把自己埋在蘑菇附近的地下，避免被发现。即使无处可藏，仍会撒沙和孢子，让攻击者看不清、失去方向。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: To avoid predators, POKENAME buries itself in the ground near mushrooms to avoid detection. However, even when faced with no hiding options, it will throw out sand and spores to blind and disorient the attacking Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME无论身处何种环境，摸起来都很凉，却也粗如砂纸。帆状褶边能卷起，保护脸与颈部。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are cool to the touch no matter their environ, yet also as coarse as sandpaper. They can furl up their sail-like frills to protect their faces and necks.

entry: POKENAME从身上排列的晶体放出寒风，保护自己与幼崽。长尾还能挑起大片沙，甩进寒风之中。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME defend themselves and their young by releasing cold winds from the crystals along their bodies. Using their long tails, they can pick up and fling swathes of sand to be carried by their cold winds.

entry: POKENAME在身周造出沙环，受挑衅时便射向对手。夜里，沙在月光中闪烁，宛如星辰环绕。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME create rings of sand around their bodies, which they can fire at opponents if provoked. At night, this sand shimmers in the moonlight, resembling stars circling around them.

entry: POKENAME尖顶的壳像古代君王的陵墓，坚硬表面能抵御攻击。虽有开口，里面藏着的却只有一株产生孢子的真菌。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's pointed shell resembles the tomb of an ancient king, and its hardened surface protects POKENAME from attack. Although there is an opening, the only thing hidden within is a spore-producing fungus.

entry: POKENAME的巨爪首先用于自卫，也十分适合挖掘，而挖掘恰好是许多个体最爱的消遣。造沙堡效率高，因此沙堡比赛上处处可见。
author: puppylev
source: POKENAME's huge claws are first and foremost for protection, but they are also ideal for digging, which happens to be many POKENAME's favourite pastime. They are ubiquitous at sandcastle competitions for their efficiency.

entry: POKENAME尖顶的壳像古代君王的陵墓，坚硬表面能抵御攻击。虽有开口，里面藏着的却只有一株产生孢子的真菌。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's pointed shell resembles the tomb of an ancient king, and its hardened surface protects POKENAME from attack. Although there is an opening, the only thing hidden within is a spore-producing fungus.

entry: 这种POKENAME适应了寒冷环境，壳如同积雪筑成的庇护所，能为内部真菌抵御严寒。
author: .jerden
source: Adapted for cold environments, this POKENAME's shell resembles a shelter made from snow. It helps to protect the fungus inside from the cold.

entry: POKENAME藏在沙里，以敏感体毛察觉最细微的振动。它讨厌沾水，会在沙中打滚，除去毛里的湿气。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides in the sand, detecting the slightest vibrations in the sand with its sensitive hairs. It hates getting wet and will roll around in the sand to get any moister out of its fur.

entry: POKENAME蜷成球后几乎难以伤及，能在沙丘间滚动，不太担心捕食者。会冲穿仙人掌，刻意让刺扎进壳里，增强防御。
author: santon5512
source: By tucking their bodies into a ball, POKENAME are practically untouchable, rolling across dunes with little worry about predators. These Pokémon barrel through cacti to boost their defense, purposely getting spines stuck in their shells.

entry: POKENAME翅上掉落的粉尘很像沙。许多飞行属性宝可梦误拿这种有毒物质沙浴，因而生病。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shed dust from their wings that resembles sand. This resemblance has caused many Flying-type Pokémon to become ill after dust bathing in the toxic substance.

entry: POKENAME因生活在干旱环境，身上长出一层易碎的焦糖。高级餐厅常拿这种焦糖脆片搭配奢华甜点。
author: mistymagius
source: Due to the arid environment POKENAME lives in, it has developed a brittle layer of caramelized sugar on its body. The caramel brittle is often served with luxurious desserts at fancy restaurants.

entry: POKENAME用利爪挖掘地下通道，挥尾扫开碎屑。谁若打断挖掘，就会喷出灼热火焰，警告对方别再干扰。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME tunnel underground with their sharp claws and swing their tails to get rid of debris. If anyone interrupts their digging, they breathe out searing hot flames as a warning not to continue.

entry: POKENAME在地下深处吃花根。若误吃苦根，便会避开那片地方数月。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME feeds on flower roots deep underground. If it consumes a bitter root by mistake, it avoids the area for months.

entry: POKENAME始终寻找食物和水，为求生计漫游辽阔沙漠。有学说认为，它曾是美丽的海洋生物，后来因某种缘故被迫改变栖地。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME is in constant search of food and water, roaming vast deserts in search of sustenance. Some theories suggest it was once a beautiful sea creature, but something forced its habitat to change.

entry: POKENAME钻到迷迭香下吃根。每颗头都有自己的胃，因此会仔细分配食物，让每颗头都吃饱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs beneath rosemary plants to consume their roots. It carefully rations food so each head, with its own stomach, is properly fed.

entry: 遭到攻击时，POKENAME相互蜷绕，保护肚皮，朝外露出更坚韧的鳞背。抱成球后能一起翻滚，用三条尾巴控制滚动的方向。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME curl around one another when they find themselves under attack, protecting their bellies and presenting their tougher, scaled backs. They can roll together while balled up, using their three tails to help direct their Rollout.

entry: POKENAME挖出深道，藏起闪亮宝物，可能是硬币、玻璃，甚至是它觉得值钱的瓶盖。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs deep tunnels to hide shiny treasures. These may include coins, glass, or even bottle caps it finds valuable.

entry: POKENAME讨厌皮毛沾水，经常沙浴以保持干燥。强健双腿让它能在沙漠奔跑，不被沙困住。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hates getting its fur wet, so it will take frequent dust baths to keep it dry. Its strong legs allow it to run through the desert without getting caught in the sand.

entry: POKENAME在沼泽下挖掘，寻找可食用的根。它总要回到地面，却容易一头撞上石头，因脑震荡而头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dig below marshes to find roots to eat. When they inevitably surface, they are prone to bumping their head on stones, which results in a concussion that causes headaches.

entry: POKENAME装得很凶，真遇上强敌却会慌忙朝对方泼沙，然后逃走。生活在峡谷壁附近，鳞皮与岩石融为一体。
author: mistymagius
source: While POKENAME acts tough, when confronted with a stronger opponent, it will frantically fling sand at its attacker before fleeing. It lives near canyon walls, its scaly hide blending in with the rock.

entry: POKENAME常在古庙大闹，把石质建筑打得只剩粉尘。不过它其实很胆小，若被其他宝可梦当面对上，就会逃走。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME often runs amok in ancient temples, pummeling the stone structures until they are nothing but dust. However, it is also quite timid and will flee if confronted by another Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的鳞皮能抵御沙暴，因此能在沙漠疾奔，不必躲避恶劣天气。有时充当宝可梦巡护员的坐骑，协助巡查沙漠中的偷猎者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's scaly skin helps to protect them from sandstorms, allowing them to race through the desert without needing to shelter from poor weather. They sometimes serve as mounts for Pokémon Rangers patrolling the desert for poachers.

entry: POKENAME以吸盘状嘴迅速喝水，尽量避免弄湿身体。尾鳍已变得坚硬，能像铲子一样掘开沙石。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their sucker-mouths to swiftly drink water and to better avoid getting wet. Their tail fins have become rigid and they use them like shovels to dig through sand and rock.

entry: POKENAME住在沙漠与河流交界处，用砖块般的皮肤筑起泥墙，保持领地凉爽。游泳时，重尾如舵，助它钻进深处河泥，躲避捕食者。
author: shpimptin3000
source: POKENAME lives where the desert meets the river. It uses its brick-like skin to build mud walls that keep its territory cool. When it swims, its heavy tail acts like a rudder, allowing it to dive deep into river silt to hide from predators.

entry: 尽管全身覆有油状分泌物，鳞片依然粗糙。它靠歌唱与同类交流，螺旋花纹有节奏地起伏，有时还能催眠。
author: infinex21
source: Despite the oily secretions covering its body, its scales are coarse. It sings to communicate with others of its kind, its spiral pattern undulating in a rhythmic and sometimes hypnotic way.

entry: POKENAME觉得危险或想睡觉时，会瞬间移动到远方地下深处的隐秘洞穴，那里只有它独居。若洞穴被发现，就会在极远处另挖一个。
author: bobosmith01
source: When it feels it is in danger or wants to sleep, POKENAME teleports to a far-off hidden burrow deep underground where only it lives. If the burrow is discovered, it creates another one far, far away from the original.

entry: POKENAME精神力量强大，能举起大块泥土，砸向敌人。传说它的银汤匙是在地下深处挖到的。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME wields immense psychic powers, allowing it to lift chunks of earth and hurl them at its foes. Legends claim it unearthed its silver spoon while digging deep beneath the ground.

entry: POKENAME双手能捏碎岩石，常出现在工地帮助建筑工人。外表虽凶，其实性情温和，不喜欢战斗。
author: mystora
source: POKENAME can crush rocks with their hands, and they often appear on construction sites to help construction workers. Despite their fierce appearance, POKENAME are actually quite mild and do not like battling.

entry: 四臂发出的每次劈斩，都有厚实肌肉增威。虽然看似难防空中攻击，却能迅速掘出、投掷大石。
author: infinex21
source: Each slashing attack loosed by its four arms is empowered by its thick muscles. Although one would think it vulnerable to aerial attacks, it can claw out and throw large rocks rather quickly.

entry: POKENAME将根伸入沙漠，逢雨吸水，储在仙人掌部分。刺会分泌强毒，扎破皮肤后可使人麻木数小时。
author: santon5512
source: Extending their roots into the desert sand, POKENAME soak up water when it rains and store it within their cacti. Their spines secrete a potent toxin that causes numbness for hours after piercing the skin.

entry: POKENAME缩进壳里，在洞中旋转前进，比靠短腿走快得多。有时一路冲撞会把壳撞裂，只得停下来等伤处恢复。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spins through caves while curled in its shell because it is faster than relying on its stubby legs. Sometimes its shell cracks when barrelling through caves, which forces it to take a break while it heals.

entry: POKENAME挂在沙漠绿洲附近的树上，吸食飞近大嘴的昆虫。皮肤善于保水，只喝一口就能维持一周。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hangs from trees located near desert oases, sucking up insects that fly close to its gaping mouth. Its skin helps retain moisture, so a single sip of water will sustain it for a week.

entry: POKENAME从山坡滚下，磨损岩石般的皮肤，再休息，让其愈合加固。四肢和圆形身体有时让它难以完全蜷成球。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME rolls down hills in order to wear down its rocky skin, and then rests to heal and reinforce it. Sometimes, POKENAME struggles to fully curl up into a ball due to its limbs and circular body.

entry: POKENAME裹满甲片的外皮，坚硬结实得像石头。四臂一收，它就能高速滚动，沿途扬起大量泥土或沙子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's plate-covered hide is as solid and sturdy as stone. By tucking in its four arms, it can roll around at high speeds, kicking up vast amounts of dirt or sand as it does so.

entry: POKENAME体内酷热，让沙质鬃毛熔成玻璃。玻璃依然滚烫，碰到草木，便会将其引燃。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME intense internal heat causes its sandy mane to turn to glass. The glass is still incredibly hot, hot enough to ignite any flora on contact.

entry: POKENAME懒洋洋地待在沙漠烈日下，让皮肤保持干爽。可常没察觉自己晒得太久，皮肤便开始慢慢灼伤。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lazes around in the desert sun, keeping its skin nice and dry. However, it will often not notice it's been in the sun too long, and its skin will slowly start to burn.

entry: 干燥的壳是POKENAME的辨识特征，年龄越大，壳越干燥坚实。它们常漫游沙漠寻找绿洲，一旦找到，就很难劝其离开。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME can be identified by the dryness of their shell. As they age their shells get drier and more solid. POKENAME tend to be found roaming deserts looking for a desert oasis. Once they find one, it is very difficult to convince them to leave.

entry: POKENAME漫游沙漠，寻找沙中的磁性碎屑。但天气若太热，磁铁便开始熔化，几乎完全失去作用。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME wanders through the desert looking for magnetic filings in the sand. However, if the weather gets too hot, its magnets will start melting, essentially making them useless.

entry: POKENAME是住在沙漠的宝可梦，在绿洲附近筑巢，游沙如游水。虽然住得离绿洲很近，却十分讨厌沾水。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are desert-dwelling Pokémon that nest near oases and swim through sand as if it were water. Though they live near oases, they despise getting wet.

entry: 即使刚在沙漠沙层里游过，身体摸起来仍凉得出奇。许多人乐见它们在沙中跃起、潜下，尤其因为这代表附近有绿洲。
author: infinex21
source: Its body is remarkably cool to the touch, even after it has spent time swimming in desert sands. The sight of its kind leaping and diving in the sand is welcome to many, especially since it is a sign of a nearby oasis.

entry: POKENAME用灌木与树果盖住炮口，再将自己整个埋进沙里，伏击想吃树果的小型宝可梦。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME will cover their cannon barrels in shrubs and berries, then bury themselves completely in sand to ambush smaller Pokémon who attempt to eat the berries.

entry: POKENAME能将身体各部分分开，分别滚下山坡，迅速下行。若身体受损，就滚上泥浆，坐在烈日下，填补裂缝，让身体重新硬化。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME can divide its body individually to efficiently roll down mountainsides for fast, downward travel. If its body is damaged, it will roll in mud and sit in the scorching sun, filling the cracked spots and hardening its body again.

entry: POKENAME向熟睡的人与宝可梦撒沙，诱发梦境，再吃掉这些梦，从中净赚一份能量。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME sprinkles sand onto sleeping people and Pokémon to induce dreams. It then devours these dreams for a net energy boost.

entry: POKENAME痴迷成熟树果的气味，甚至会与自己的伙伴争抢，想第一个吃到。头上翅膀嗡响时，振动足以引起剧烈偏头痛。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is so obsessed with the scent of ripe berries that it might even compete with its own companions to be the first to get the food. When the wings on its head buzz, it can create vibrations capable of causing terrible migraines.

entry: POKENAME发出恼人的振动，试图吸引好奇的猎物。待其靠得太近，便迅速使出打雷，将其制服。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME vibrate obnoxiously, trying to attract curious prey. When they get too close, POKENAME swiftly uses Thunder to neutralize them.

entry: POKENAME靠敏捷身手游走于对手周围。战斗越久，闪电般的踢击便越快。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME relies on its agility to maneuver around opponents. Its lightning-fast kicks get progressively faster as the battle continues.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME在沼泽游荡时曾被误认成人。认错的人和宝可梦会被困在无形屏障构成的迷宫里，耳边嗡鸣不休，无法逃离。
author: wiz0z
source: At night, POKENAME have been mistaken for humans, wandering through swamps. People and Pokémon that make this mistake find themselves trapped in mazes of invisible barriers and incessant buzzing, unable to escape.

entry: 它以翅膀扇动的振动，削弱夹在钳间的猎物或敌人。高速飞行时，遇上挡路者就会毫不犹豫地使出断头钳，试图迅速击败对方。
author: infinex21
source: It uses the vibrations from its fluttering wings to soften up any prey or foe caught between its pincers. It will not hesitate to use its Guillotine attack to try and quickly defeat any foe in its path as it flies around at high speeds.

entry: POKENAME开心时会快速振翼，嗡鸣响亮得连脚下土地也微微震动。喜欢停在能找到的最高树枝上，以敏锐视力巡视领地。
author: sk372
source: When happy, POKENAME vibrates its wings rapidly to create a hum loud enough to rumble the ground beneath it slightly. It prefers perching on the highest tree branches it can find, surveying territory with its powerful eyesight.

entry: 翅膀若沾湿，就很难活动，必须等到干透。尽管如此，它仍爱在水洼玩耍，至少还知道别靠近更大的水域。
author: infinex21
source: If its wings get wet, then the wings struggle to move until they have dried out. Despite this fact, this Pokémon loves to play in puddles but at least knows better than to get close to larger bodies of water.

entry: POKENAME快速打圈摆动触手，推动自己游行。起初游得慢，却会越游越有冲力，直到追上猎物，用颚将其咬住。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME moves its tentacles in rapid circles to drive itself through the water. Although it is a slow swimmer at first, over time it will build up more and more momentum until it catches up to prey and seizes it in its jaws.

entry: POKENAME在水里和空中动作优雅，捕猎时却十分凶狠。尤其喜欢击倒附近的美纳斯，将其视为自己的劲敌。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's graceful movements in both the water and the air belie the fierceness with which it hunts prey. In particular, it favors taking down any Milotic in the area, seeing them as personal rivals.

entry: 它用强刺刺入树木吸取树液。有时会振翼放出冲击波，软化树皮；同样的冲击波也能用来吓退威胁。
author: infinex21
source: It uses it powerful stingers to tap for sap in trees. It sometimes looses shockwaves from its wings to soften tree bark, though will use the selfsame shockwaves to deter threats.

entry: POKENAME的复眼不但能看清四周，也能同时朝多个目标施展强大精神力量。翅膀虽无力带它飞行，却能制造冲击力强劲的震波。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's compound eyes allow it to not just see all around itself, but to also direct its immense psychic power at multiple targets simultaneously. Its wings can create physically-powerful shockwaves, despite being too weak for flight.

entry: POKENAME振翼快得肉眼无法看清，因此看上去像是在飘浮，而非飞行。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME flap their wings so quickly that they become invisible to the naked eye. This rapid movement make them seem like they are levitating rather than flying.

entry: POKENAME体形虽大，仍能靠颈边翅膀飞行。为此会快速旋转翅膀，奇怪的是，旋转时还会散出甜香。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Despite its size, POKENAME can fly using the wings around its neck. To do this, it rapidly spins the wings, which oddly releases a sweet aroma as it does.

entry: POKENAME擅长精准控制。微调振翼便能无声悬停，也能放出足以劈开树木的冲击波。
author: havic0970
source: POKENAME is a master of precision. It can fine-tune its wingbeats to hover silently, or unleash shock waves capable of splitting trees.

entry: POKENAME用爪子刮擦树木与岩石，将其磨利。它是凶猛的丛林捕食者，只须一次迅捷出击，就能袭中毫无戒心的猎物。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME sharpens its talons by scraping them against trees and rocks. A vicious jungle predator, it strikes unsuspecting prey in a single swift motion.

entry: 只须挥翼一下，便能释放足以粉碎巨石的冲击波。有些训练家看重它的飞行速度，短短不到一小时就能远行，因此十分喜爱。
author: infinex21
source: One flap from its wings can loose a shockwave with enough force to pulverize a large boulder. It is favored by some Trainers due to how fast, and how far, it can fly in less than an hour.

entry: 整个腹部如同宝石，能看见快速振翼时产生的电流。它先用八条肢体抓住猎物，再施以电击，带回巢穴。
author: infinex21
source: Its entire belly is like a gemstone within which one can see the electricity that this Pokémon generates as its wings rapidly flutter. It will capture prey within its eight limbs before electrocuting them and carrying them back to its nest.

entry: 大眼睛让POKENAME拥有出色的360度视野，但头相对身体太大，容易失衡。飞行时若不小心调整，就会开始笔直俯冲地面。
author: .jerden
source: While its large eyes give it excellent 360-degree vision, the size of its head relative to its body makes POKENAME unbalanced. If it does not carefully counter this as it flies, it will start diving straight down towards the ground.

entry: POKENAME极其危险凶暴，透镜强化后的超能力，能在瞬间轻易撕裂敌人的身体。
author: soup1900
source: Extremely dangerous and violent, POKENAME is able to use its lens-boosted psychic powers to rip apart the foe's bodies instantly without difficulty.

entry: POKENAME振翼产生的翻涌嗡鸣，会干扰附近的无线电传输与电子设备。漆黑之中，独眼闪着不祥红光。
author: sk372
source: The churning buzz generated by the flapping of POKENAME's wings disrupts radio transmissions and electronics nearby. Its singular red eye glows ominously in pitch-black conditions.

entry: POKENAME是密林深处极其致命的猎手。振翼产生的音波能造成身体损伤，身体两侧射出的弹丸又快又准，几乎无法躲避。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a very deadly hunter inhabiting the deepest forests. The best of its wings generate sonic waves that can cause physical injuries, and it fires projectiles from its sides at such speed and accuracy nearly impossible to dodge.

entry: POKENAME出拳划破空气，产生音爆冲击波。它能让嫌疑人当场停步，因此越来越受警方欢迎。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME's punches slice through the air, creating sonic boom shockwaves. This has made it increasingly popular among police forces for its ability to stop suspects in their tracks.

entry: POKENAME爬过开阔平原觅食，移动时触须发出细小咔哒声。绷紧身体后猛然释放能量，便能突然高速跃向食物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME creep through open plains in search of food, making tiny snapping noises with their tendrils as they move. They are capable of sudden bursts of speed by tensing their body, releasing the energy in an abrupt leap at their food.

entry: POKENAME奔跑时速可达100英里，腿累了也能靠强翼维持速度。抓到猎物后，就用猛禽般的利爪将其撕碎。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can run up to 100 mph, using its strong wings to keep up the pace when its legs get tired. Once it catches its prey, it will proceed to rip them apart with its raptor-like talons.

entry: 它以湖泊、池塘为家，睡在底部泥中。水下快速振翼，便能高速追捕其他虫宝可梦，身后搅出旋涡。
author: .jerden
source: It makes its home in lakes and ponds, sleeping in the mud at the bottom. By beating its wings rapidly underwater, it can swim with great speed in pursuit of other Bug Pokémon, churning the water into whirlpools behind it.

entry: 绿色皮肤覆着细小光滑的毛，即使春雨倾盆也行动敏捷。咬力虽然惊人，却最常借颈边振动的器官汇聚、发射攻击。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its green skin is covered in tiny slick hairs that help it remain agile even in the downpours of spring. Although it has an incredibly powerful bite, the fluttering organ around its neck is used most frequently to channel and fire attacks.

entry: 它一天便能横跨整个地区。它们聚在发电厂，收集足够的电力，保护幼崽。
author: schwaus
source: It can travel across whole regions in a single day. They congregate at power plants to collect enough electricity to protect their young.

entry: 即使在地面奔跑，它也会扇翼加速。迅捷动作由体内储存的电力驱动。
author: .jerden
source: Even while running along the ground, it beats its wings to increase its speed. Its rapid movement is powered by the electricity it stores within its body.

entry: POKENAME用废金属和备用零件改装身体，提高速度。它与其他宝可梦赛跑，评估自己穿行各地的效率。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME augment its body with scrap metal and spare parts to improve its speed. It races with other Pokémon to assess how efficiently it can traverse through the world.

entry: POKENAME领地意识强，性情好斗，快速扇动大翼袭击敌人。将能量汇入背脊，让尾巴带上噼啪电火花，打出毁灭性的重击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a territorial and aggressive creature that strikes its foes while rapidly beating its large wings. It channels energy into the crest along its back, electrifying its tail with crackling sparks to deliver devastating blows.

entry: 它能从炮状双臂发射火焰与音波冲击，常将两者结合成破坏力强大的火球。开炮时用大尾巴稳住身体，也能用尾巴将敌人挡在远处。
author: infinex21
source: This Pokémon can launch both flames and sonic shockwaves from its cannon-like arms, and will often combine them to create destructive fireballs. Its large tail will be used to stabilize itself as it fires it cannons or to keep foes at a distance.

entry: 双尾与多出的翅膀让POKENAME在空中稍为灵活。然而噪音也大得多，多翼拍动形成的乱流会产生冲击波，危及附近所有人。
author: .jerden
source: Their double tails and extra wings make POKENAME slightly more maneuverable in the air. However, it also makes them much louder, and the turbulence created by their many beating wings generates shock waves that are dangerous to anyone nearby.

entry: POKENAME以快得看不清的速度追上猎物，再用剃刀般锋利的爪子将其按住。它从不让目标逃脱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME pursues prey with blinding speed before pinning them down with its razor-sharp claws. It never lets a target escape.

entry: POKENAME抖动抽搐不止，高速飞行时总是翻来翻去，走之字路线。振翼产生的冲击波虽不会直接打坏设备，却会扰乱内部零件。
author: soup1900
source: Due to being very shaky and twitchy, POKENAME flips around and zigzags everywhere when it flies around at high speeds. When churning its wings, it creates shock waves that don't physically break a device but disrupts their inner parts.

entry: POKENAME的许多尖刺能以惊人速度振动，产生小型冲击波，将坚实地面震成细沙。它用尾钳固定猎物，再以强爪劈入。
author: infinex21
source: The many quills of a POKENAME can vibrate at remarkable speeds, producing small shockwaves that allow them to pulverize solid ground into mere sand. They secure prey with the pincer upon their tail and then slash into them with their strong claws.

entry: POKENAME众多眼睛能追踪对手的每个动作，抓住所有空隙出击。双腿刺出极快，产生的冲击波足以震碎小岩块。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's many eyes allow it to track every movement of its opponents during a fight, letting it strike at every opening. Its legs can thrust so quickly that they produce a shockwave capable of shattering small boulders.

entry: POKENAME对日渐增长的力量十分自信，能以快得几乎看不见的速度振动双臂。这会强化肌肉，使它一拍双掌，便产生足以掀翻最重对手的强力冲击波。
author: sk372
source: Highly confident in its developing strength, POKENAME can vibrate its arms at rapid, almost imperceptible speeds. This strengthens its muscles, allowing it to clap its hands and create a potent shockwave to knock even the heaviest of opponents over.

entry: 大尾巴能劈裂硬岩，翅膀放出的冲击波则能将岩石震成粉尘。强健四肢能搬动巢边巨石，加固巢穴，抵御风暴。
author: infinex21
source: Their large tails are strong enough to split apart solid rock, while the shockwaves loosed by their wings can churn rock into dust. Their strong limbs allow them to move boulders near their nests to reinforce them against storms.

entry: 眼睛能看见人眼无法察觉的颜色。它凭优越视力，捕食那些依赖伪装躲避天敌的小型宝可梦。
author: griddle
source: Its eyes are capable of seeing colors that the human eye can't perceive. It uses its superior vision to prey on smaller Pokémon that rely on camouflage to avoid predators.

entry: POKENAME身体虽庞大，仍能以惊人速度飞行。精神力量帮助身体离地，让翅膀推力少受阻力，并把冲力带进拳击之中。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Despite their bulk, POKENAME can fly at incredible speeds. Their psychic powers help to keep them off the ground, allowing the propulsion from their wings to operate with little resistance and letting them carry momentum into their punches.

entry: POKENAME伏着等待，直到小型猎物成群聚拢。随后飞起，以强劲振翼产生的冲击波将其震昏，再用假颚一把抓住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lies in wait until groups of smaller prey gather together. It then takes to the air, stunning them with shockwaves generated from its powerful wingbeat before snatching them up into its false jaws.

entry: POKENAME以强健头部撞击地面，制造强力冲击波，足以造成严重内伤。
author: notsaying.
source: POKENAME, using its powerful head, can create powerful shock waves by impacting the ground. These shock waves can cause severe internal injuries.

entry: POKENAME察觉灾难时，会快速振翼示警。然而常因此产生冲击波，伤到自己原本想提醒的人。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: When it detects disasters, POKENAME rapidly flaps its wings as a warning. However, this often creates shock waves, injuring those it was trying to warn.

entry: POKENAME用角感知空气中最细微的振动。若察觉灾难，就发出超声波，提醒其他同类。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME uses its horn to detect even the smallest vibrations in the air. If it senses disaster, it will emit supersonic waves to warn other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME身体中空，轻得异乎寻常。以令人心惊的速度穿过森林，身后留下幽幽嗡鸣。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is hollow, making it unnaturally light. It zips through forests with chilling speed, leaving behind a ghostly buzz.

entry: 它为蜻蜻蜓提供庇护、协调行动，让族群繁盛。背上信标发出的复杂信号，唯有蜻蜻蜓能看见。
author: staghorn
source: It acts as a shelter and coordinator for Yanma, allowing their populations to flourish. The beacon on its back displays complex signals that only Yanma can see.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴支撑身体、保持平衡，踢出强劲一击。翅膀的冲击波还能让敌人失去方向、陷入晕眩。
author: havic0970
source: POKENAME balances on its tail to deliver powerful kicks. It can disorient and stun foes with the shockwaves from its wings.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，十分危险，拦截侵巢者时飞得太快，许多人甚至没能瞥见。翅膀嗡鸣是危险的明确信号，有人形容像一曲警告之歌。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Extremely territorial and dangerous, many do not even glimpse POKENAME because it flies so quickly to intercept intruders invading its home. The humming sound of its wings is a telltale sign of danger, with some likening it to a song of warning.

entry: 它在湖面上来回疾飞觅食。蛇形身体让它在空中移动时极为流畅。
author: bacondlx
source: It can be seen flitting about above lakes while hunting for food. Its serpentine body allows for extremely streamlined movement through the air.

entry: 它用大尾巴刺入地面，快速振翼引起震动。高角中含有强毒，若不治疗，会让人长期失去方向感。
author: infinex21
source: It will impale the ground with its large tail and flutter its wings rapidly to create tremors. Its tall horn contains a potent venom that causes long-term disorientation if not treated.

entry: POKENAME是极其古老的虫形宝可梦。在岛屿间迁徙时，沉重双翼的振动会掀起巨大风暴潮。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME is an extremely ancient insectoid Pokémon. The flutter of its heavy wings create massive tidal storms as it migrates between islands.

entry: POKENAME尾上的翅膀拍得既快又猛，足以撕裂下方地面。靠大幅跳跃移动，以惊人速度冲过空中。
author: sk372
source: The wings on POKENAME's tail can flap fast and hard enough to rend the ground beneath it. It travels via huge leaps that push it through the air at incredible speeds.

entry: 这只虫宝可梦以长身缠住猎物或敌人，挤压得对方屈服。所有翅膀同时扇动时，冲击波合在一起，声如炸雷。
author: infinex21
source: This bug Pokémon uses its long body to constrict any prey or any foe and crush them into submission. When it flaps all of its wings at the same time, the shockwaves released collectively sound like a crack of thunder.

entry: 在翅膀帮助下，POKENAME跑得快到人眼无法追踪。捕猎时全速奔过，擦身便斩下猎物的头。
author: imaginita
source: Aided by its wings, POKENAME runs with such speed that the human eye cannot track it. To hunt, it runs at top speed and lops the head off its prey as it passes.

entry: POKENAME振翼能引发巨大风暴，一天之内便可吹倒整座城堡。据说，对那些为金钱权力欺骗他人的人，它会咬掉其头颅，让其永远闭嘴。
author: soup1900
source: The beat of POKENAME's wings causes massive windstorms that can blow over entire castles in a single day. It is believed to silence those who lie to others for money and power by biting their heads off.

entry: POKENAME翅膀扇得极快，几乎无法摄入影像。不停振翼会迅速耗尽能量，因此总在寻找花蜜、树果等富糖食物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has wings that flap so fast that it is nearly impossible to capture on video. This constant flapping quickly burns through its energy reserves, so it is constantly on the hunt for sugary nourishment like nectar or berries.

entry: POKENAME舍弃翅膀，换来了更坚韧的外骨骼与更锋利的长牙。如今长牙如斧，可劈断树木；爪能碎石；尾巴连独角犀牛也能抽飞至少一英里。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have forsaken their wings for tougher exoskeletons and sharper tusks. Now, their tusks can cleave through trees like axes, their claws can shatter rocks, and their tails could send even a Rhyhorn flying for at least a mile.

entry: 翅膀每次拍动都会更热，温度能高到熔铁。发出的嗡鸣能产生冲击波，赶走靠得太近的敌人。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its wings grow hotter each time they are flapped and can reach temperatures high enough to melt iron. The buzzing sound it produces can create shockwaves capable of driving away enemies that get too close.

entry: POKENAME在六月最常见，此时天空满是电萤虫与甜甜萤。它特别喜爱所有虫属性宝可梦，谁危及它们，就会遭到凶狠对待。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are the most common in June, when the sky is filled with Volbeat and Illumise. It takes a special liking to all bug-types, acting aggressive to anything endangering them.

entry: POKENAME翅膀虽重，仍嗡嗡作响，推动披甲身体疾冲。它在各地留下的破坏痕迹，能存留多年。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME's wings buzz loudly despite their weight, pushing its armored body into rapid dashes. The scars it leaves across many landscapes can remain for years.

entry: POKENAME把自己埋在沙中，等待猎物无意走近。一进入范围，便扇翼卷起四周风沙，让猎物晕头转向，方便自己扑上。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME buries itself in sand, waiting for prey to stumble near. Once in range, its wings whip up a storm of sand all around, dazing prey and making it easier for POKENAME to pounce upon them.

entry: 野生POKENAME是最常遭捕食的宝可梦之一。不过，它也能轻易从对方掌握中溜出，迅速飞走。
author: dodoowner_
source: Wild POKENAME are one of the most preyed on of Pokémon. However, it can easily zip away from a Pokémon's grasp and fly away.

entry: 大群野生POKENAME几分钟就能吃光整片农田。农夫常备大量除虫喷雾，以防虫群来袭。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: Hordes of wild POKENAME will eat through entire fields in minutes. Farmers often keep plenty of repels on them to reduce the risk of a swarm.

entry: 比起年幼形态，POKENAME自信多了，翅膀也已强到能在空中停留更久。如今迅捷动作能帮它对来犯的捕食者打出又快又猛的攻击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have grown quite confident in themselves compared to their younger forms, and their wings have grown strong enough to keep them aloft for longer. Now their quick movements aid them in dealing quick, powerful blows to any would-be predators.

entry: POKENAME飞过洞穴地道，寻找黄玉矿。一发现成簇宝石，便两眼放光、饥渴地将其吞下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies through cavern tunnels in search of topaz deposits. When it finds a cluster, it devours the gems with glinting hunger.

entry: POKENAME游得极快，能冲出水面100英尺高。但必须不断移动，让血液输送得足够快，才能维持代谢。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is an incredibly fast swimmer, capable of launching itself 100 feet out of the water. However, it must constantly stay in motion to keep its blood pumping fast enough to sustain its metabolism.

entry: POKENAME身体沉重僵硬，只能短暂飞起。蜻蜻蜓和其他昆虫会被它吸引，它便从腿尖伸出藤蔓，保护它们。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is heavy and stiff, so it is only able to fly in short bursts. Yanma and other insects are drawn to it, and it protects them with vines that extend from the points of its legs.

entry: POKENAME头上长有特殊角，能精准发出破坏力强大的音波冲击。臂上翅膀让它能短暂极速飞行，同时以音波轰击敌人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME has developed special horns upon its head that allow it to fire powerful sonic shockwaves with destructive precision. The wings upon its arms allow it to fly in short bursts of extreme speed as it bombards foes with sonic blasts.

entry: POKENAME快速振翼产生的冲击波，会让其他宝可梦遭受严重内伤。自身柔软黏糯的身体似乎能减震，因此不会被自己的攻击伤及。
author: .jerden
source: The shock waves produced by POKENAME's rapidly beating wings cause devastating internal injuries to other Pokémon. POKENAME's soft and gooey body seems to function as a shock absorber, preventing it from being harmed by its own attacks.

entry: 它能像螺旋桨一样旋转翅膀，将花粉和种子洒遍大片区域。
author: staghorn
source: It can spin its wings like a propeller, allowing it to cover wide areas in its pollen and seeds.

entry: POKENAME以茂密湿地为家，翠绿身色融入周围繁多植物。猎物只要靠得太近，就会被双颚迅速抓住，拖进圆顶状身体下。
author: thegreenscorpion
source: Making its home in dense wetlands, POKENAME uses its verdant coloration to blend into the myriad of surrounding plant life. Any prey that gets too close is quickly snatched by its mandibles and dragged under its dome-like body.

entry: POKENAME经常在干旱地带远行，飞越绿洲寻找食物和水分。捕猎时，会从高处将臂上的刺如雨般射向猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME regularly travels vast distances in arid areas, flying between oases to search for food and hydration. It rains spines from its arms down on prey from above when on the hunt.

entry: POKENAME用锋利双颚刺穿树皮，吸食内部树液。群体间靠腹部翅膀大声振动交流，让整片森林充满低沉嗡鸣。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feed on tree sap, using their sharp mandibles to pierce through bark to get to the sap inside. Swarms communicate with one another by loudly whirring their wings on their abdomen, filling the forest with a low droning buzz.

entry: 有确凿实物证据表明，冰雪巨龙漫步世界的年代，已有野生POKENAME存在。人们认为，漫长岁月中气温剧变，导致野生数量下降。
author: bobosmith01
source: There is strong physical evidence to suggest POKENAME were found naturally when Aurorus roamed the world. It is thought the extreme shifts in temperature during the ages caused POKENAME's natural population to decline.

entry: POKENAME能以不同频率吼叫，唤来多样极光。腿既锋利又坚韧，每年迁徙时，即使最崎岖、最湿滑的地形也能轻松通过。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can emit roars of various frequencies that summon myriad auroras. Their legs allow them to traverse the roughest and slickest terrain with ease during yearly migrations due to how sharp and tough they are.

entry: POKENAME能控制背上蘑菇产生的孢子，让其像翅膀般运动。孢子高速振动，便能产生足以震昏其他宝可梦的强力冲击波。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can control the movement of the spores produced by the mushroom on its back, moving them around like wings. Their high-speed vibrations can generate shock waves powerful enough to knock other Pokémon unconscious.

entry: POKENAME有坚韧甲壳、硬爪、复眼与快速振动的翅膀，是湿地的顶级捕食者。捕猎成功率达90%。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's tough carapace, hard claws, compound eyes, and rapid wings make it the apex wetland predator. It has a 90% success rate.

entry: POKENAME战法独特，四处跳跃，偶尔出剑击打对手。许多训练家受此启发，尝试教自己的宝可梦类似战法。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME has a unique fighting style of jumping around and occasionally striking opponents with its sword. POKENAME has inspired many trainers to try to teach their Pokémon similar fighting styles.

entry: POKENAME从空中降下时，体内发出嗡鸣。外壳一块块落向地面，着陆时留下一路碎屑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes a buzzing sound from inside its body as it descends from the sky. Parts of its outer shell fall off in chunks to the ground below, creating a trail of debris as it lands.

entry: POKENAME白天在高空飞行，夜里悬停原处休息。此时闭起双眼，黑暗中很难发现，导致飞机多次险些与其相撞。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies high in the sky during the day, but at night, it rests by hovering in one place. During this time, its eyes close, and it becomes difficult to spot in the darkness, resulting in many near-misses by planes.

entry: POKENAME拼命拍动背翼，扰乱敌人，再以猛烈喷火将其击败。吃下特别成熟的树果后，尾焰会更加旺盛。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME frantically flaps its wings on its back to confuse its enemies and then finishes them off with powerful bursts of fire. The flame on its tail becomes more intense when it feeds on particularly ripe berries.

entry: POKENAME凭六根胡须与复眼，能感知周围每只宝可梦。四翼制造的冲击波能造成内伤，使猎物失去平衡。
author: heal_fire
source: With its six whiskers and compound eyes, POKENAME can sense every Pokémon in its surroundings. It uses its four wings to create shock waves that inflict internal injuries and destabilize its prey.

entry: POKENAME吼声的音高与破坏力惊人，能轻松震碎岩石。先以多臂抓牢猎物，再用烈焰将其淹没。
author: infinex21
source: The roar of a POKENAME is of such a strong pitch and destructive force that it can shatter rocks with ease. It uses its many arms to secure prey before dousing them with intense flames.

entry: POKENAME战斗时借翅膀之力腾空。只扇一下便能跃至高处，再从上方猛击而下，足以将敌人压扁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the strength of its wings to take to the air in combat. With a single beat of its wings it can leap great heights, coming down with a mighty strike from above sure to flatten its foe.

entry: POKENAME配有着陆灯，协助飞机平安抵达。若有飞机即将坠落，就会飞上前，凭力量将其安全托降。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Equipped with landing lights, POKENAME help ensure the safe arrival of planes. Should a plane be going down, POKENAME will fly up and use its strength to lower it safely down.

entry: 它速度惊人，快得尾巴起火，所到之处留下团团烟雾。POKENAME有时想用翅膀压下火势，却越帮越忙。
author: karmaofevil
source: This Pokémon's impressive speed causes its tail to ignite, leaving smoke clouds everywhere it appears. POKENAME may attempt to calm the flame it has created with its wings, causing more harm than good.

entry: POKENAME快速振翼，发出如静电杂音的嗡鸣。动作产生的磁波强到让身边空气出现肉眼可见的扭曲。
author: sk372
source: The rapid beating of POKENAME's wings creates a buzzing sound akin to static. The motions create magnetic waves strong enough to visibly distort the air immediately around it.

entry: 野生POKENAME有复眼与快速射出的针，极其危险。不过护甲厚重，猎物通常能跑得比它快。
author: seanothan_23
source: Wild POKENAME have compound eyes and fast-shooting needles, making them extremely dangerous. However, because of their thick armor, their prey usually can outrun them.

entry: POKENAME即使抱着岩石，也能全速奔跑。捕食者来袭时特别有用，通常一块岩石加一张丝网，就足以将对方压住，方便逃走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of running at full speed while carrying a rock in their arms. This is especially helpful when predators attack, as a rock and a net made of silk are usually enough to pin them down before escaping.

entry: 挥动POKENAME手中的叶子，空气里便散出宜人的泥土清香。香气用来安抚旁人，降低动武的可能。
author: sk372
source: Waving around the leaf POKENAME carries produces an earthy, pleasant smell into the air. These scent is meant to calm others down and pacify them, reducing the chances of violence.

entry: 叶子从壳的关节长出，不修剪就会十分难受。厨师会收养POKENAME，用叶子烹制秋葵浓汤等带香料的炖菜。
author: quackquackattack
source: It grows leaves from the joints of its shell, which causes it great discomfort if not trimmed. Chefs will adopt a POKENAME and use its leaves to make spiced stew such as gumbo.

entry: POKENAME会本能地释放甜香，保护蛋与即将出生的幼崽。香味能安抚捕食者，也可能引来不必要的注意。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: POKENAME instinctively protects its egg and soon offspring by releasing a sweet aroma. This aroma can calm predators, but it might attract unwanted attention.

entry: 据说它在河湖藻类间伪装的本领高超，连伦琴猫的锐眼也能骗过。POKENAME气派的叶状鳍能拍打水面，掀起强浪。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is said that its ability to blend in among the algae in rivers and lakes is so advanced that it can even fool the keen eyesight of a Luxray. Its majestic leaf-shaped fins allow POKENAME to splash the water, creating powerful waves.

entry: POKENAME若吃不到足够蜂蜜，叶状翅膀就会凋萎，飞行更吃力。它极其害羞，感到附近有人，就宁可藏在叶丛里。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME does not consume enough honey, its leafy wings begin to wilt, making flight more difficult. It is an extremely shy Pokémon that prefers to stay hidden among the foliage whenever it senses humans nearby.

entry: POKENAME浮在水面，吸收阳光进行光合作用。可这也让它轻易被寻找便餐的捕食者抓走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats on the water's surface in order to soak up sunlight for photosynthesis. Unfortunately, this makes it easily snatched up by predators in search of an easy meal.

entry: POKENAME弱小得可怜，只能靠巨大叶子保护自己。它拼命进食，想加快进化。
author: mepp.
source: A pitifully weak Pokémon, POKENAME can only rely on its massive leaf for protection. It eats as much as it can to speed up its evolution.

entry: POKENAME大多待在偏僻海滩，融入沙丘，用叶子吸收阳光。若有人打扰，便游走，寻找更偏远的岛。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of its time on isolated beaches, blending in with the sand dunes as it takes in sunlight with its leaves. If anyone disturbs it, it will swim away in search of a more remote island.

entry: 一则神话记载，两只伊布在草原与繁花林地和睦长大，最终融合成一个存在：POKENAME。随后它踏上旅途，表明自己仍有需要成长之处。
author: bobosmith01
source: One myth writes about two Eevee that grew up in harmony on the grassy plains and floral woodlands, eventually fusing into one being: POKENAME. The POKENAME then set out on a journey, illustrating the growth they still needed to undergo.

entry: 一则神话记载，两只伊布在草原与繁花林地和睦长大，最终融合成一个存在：POKENAME。随后它踏上旅途，表明自己仍有需要成长之处。
author: bobosmith01
source: One myth writes about two Eevee that grew up in harmony on the grassy plains and floral woodlands, eventually fusing into one being: POKENAME. The POKENAME then set out on a journey, illustrating the growth they still needed to undergo.

entry: POKENAME是罕见的杂食性林地宝可梦，通常偏爱泥土气息与苦味。就连苦得难以下咽的金枕果，也能两口吞掉。
author: bobosmith01
source: A rare woodland Pokémon with an omnivorous diet, POKENAME typically has a penchant for earthen and bitter flavors. It can scarf down the horridly bitter Durin Berry in just two bites.

entry: 人们认为，野生伊布住进潮湿沼泽或丛林后，就会变成这种形态。它们以河溪间的植物为家；一旦缺水，POKENAME就会生病，颜色黯淡。
author: bobosmith01
source: Eevee are thought to take on this form in the wild when they live in humid swamps or jungles. They make their home in plant life amongst rivers and streams. Without water, POKENAME grow sick and dull in color.

entry: POKENAME吸收越多阳光进行光合作用，身体就越暖。到一定程度，皮毛里的叶片便开始冒烟，散出微苦气味。
author: sk372
source: The more POKENAME photosynthesizes sunlight, the warmer its body grows. After a point, the leafy parts of its fur will begin to smoke and emit a faintly bitter aroma.

entry: POKENAME察觉网络空间里有敌意，就会发出幽幽长嚎。附近键盘随之开出真正的花，使敌对言行停下来。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME detects aggression in online spaces, it emits a haunting yowl. In response, real flowers bloom from nearby keyboards, halting the hostility.

entry: POKENAME挂在树枝上，等待进化之日。若从枝上跌落，就长出藤蔓撑起身体，另找一根树枝挂好。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hang from tree branches awaiting the day that they evolve. If they fall from a tree branch, they sprout vines to pick themselves up and find a different branch to hang from.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃由极锋利的精炼叶片构成，能切开多数金属。受击时，叶片会凝固成甲，承受重击。
author: camtft
source: The blades of POKENAME are comprised of very sharp, refined leaves capable of slicing through most metals. When struck, the refined leaves solidify into armor capable of taking a beating.

entry: POKENAME叶状翼膜每次拍动都会散出甜香。它飞过森林，以香味诱出昆虫等小生物，轻松一口叼来吃。
author: sk372
source: The leafy membranes of POKENAME's wings spread a sweet scent with every flap. It flies over forests and uses the scent to lure out insects and other small creatures for it to snap up for easy meals.

entry: POKENAME极其挑食，餐点若不配上茴香叶，便拒绝进食。训练家常难以满足它古怪又讲究的口味。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is extremely picky and refuses to eat unless its meal is garnished with fennel fronds. Trainers often struggle to meet its oddly refined tastes.

entry: 快蜕皮时，POKENAME会爬向最近的树果树。蜕下的皮很快自然分解，滋养树木，让下一批果实品质更好。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME slithers over to the nearest berry tree it can find when it's time for it to shed its skin. The discarded skin biodegrades quickly and will nourish the tree and increase the quality of its next berry batch.

entry: POKENAME以前臂施以锋利毒蜇。毒液煮过后有多种养生益处，是名为“午露午”的炖菜不可少的材料。菜名源自一个故事：最初的毒液，是正午向它浇水才取到的。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME uses its forearms to deliver sharp, venomous stings. If cooked, this poison has many health benefits and is vital in a dish called Stew Noon Wets, named after a tale of how the toxin was first extracted, by dousing POKENAME in water at noon.

entry: 精神力量强大得能完全按心意，改变栖居森林里树木与植物的生长。最强招式之一是能量球。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its psychic powers are so formidable that it can bend the growth of trees and plants throughout the forests it inhabits entirely to its will. One of its most powerful moves is Energy Ball.

entry: 精神力量强大得能完全按心意，改变栖居森林里树木与植物的生长。最强招式之一是能量球。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its psychic powers are so formidable that it can bend the growth of trees and plants throughout the forests it inhabits entirely to its will. One of its most powerful moves is Energy Ball.

entry: POKENAME能进行光合作用，无须进食，却爱把树液和蜂蜜当零嘴。再污浊的空气也能净化，叶子只会散出花果香。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME photosynthesize, so they have no need for food. They love to eat sap and honey as a treat, however. They can purify air no matter how foul and polluted it may be, and their leaves only emit floral and fruity aromas.

entry: 叶片释放闻起来像芝麻的精油，在许多菜系里备受珍视。POKENAME通常在森林或丛林的茂密灌木间筑巢。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its leaves release an essential oil that smells like sesame and is highly prized in many cuisines. POKENAME usually builds its nest among the leafy bushes in forests or jungles.

entry: 每隔六个月，POKENAME颈边的叶子便自然脱落。不必丢弃，可用来制作万能粉。头顶绿色触角能吸收阳光，让它精力充沛。
author: fiordaliso
source: Every six months, the leaves around POKENAME's neck naturally fall off. Instead of discarding them, they can be used to make Heal Powder. The green antennae on its head allow it to absorb sunlight and stay full of energy.

entry: 草木繁茂的春天，POKENAME喜欢吃树上落下的叶子。也会用尾巴撑起身体，够取低枝上更新鲜的叶片。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME likes to snack on leaves that have fallen off of trees during the verdant spring seasons. It uses its tail to boost itself up and get even fresher leaves off of low-hanging branches.

entry: POKENAME选定一棵树为家后，就开始把大半树身覆上丝网。既保护树木不受害虫侵扰，也为自己预备往后的餐点。
author: sk372
source: Once POKENAME has claimed a tree as its home, it sets about covering much of the tree with its webbing. This protects the tree from insects that would cause it harm, while also providing POKENAME with future meals.

entry: POKENAME每天清晨起飞，从上空巡视树林，确认下方没有潜伏的危险。长羽散发浓郁的鲜薄荷香。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME takes flight every morning to patrol the woods from above and make sure no danger lurks below. Its long feathers give off an intense scent of fresh mint.

entry: POKENAME总欢快地飞过树林，想找谁一起在叶丛里玩耍。飞行时，身后会出现彩色的树叶。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: POKENAME always cheerfully flies through the woods, looking for someone to play with in the leaves. When it flies, colorful leaves appear behind it.

entry: POKENAME在阳光下跳来跳去，进行光合作用。开心时，身后会留下一路鲜黄花朵，学飞时就拿来当练习跑道。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME hops around in sunlight to utilize photosynthesis. When it is happy, it leaves behind a trail of bright yellow flowers that it uses as practice runways while learning to fly.

entry: 有些故事称，它们曾以传说中的预知本领，帮助古人判断四季始末。为了更靠近太阳而在山顶筑巢，叶子随季节变色。
author: infinex21
source: Some tales claim that these Pokémon helped those of the past to determine when each season begins and ends through their proclaimed foresight. They nest atop mountains so they can be closer to the sun, and their leaves change color with each season.

entry: POKENAME的羊毛其实是紧密堆叠的叶片，能充分吸收阳光，进行光合作用。若好好梳理，春天还可能开出小花。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wool is actually tightly-packed foliage that lets it greatly absorb sunlight for photosynthesis. If kept properly groomed, small flowers may bloom on it when spring arrives.

entry: POKENAME有一种罕见的鲜亮变种，最常在沿海地区发现。晒过一整天太阳，羊毛般的叶丛便能在黑暗中亮上数小时。
author: sk372
source: A rare brightly-colored variant of POKENAME exists, most often spotted in coastal regions. After spending all day in the sunlight, its wool-like foliage will glow in the dark for a few hours.

entry: POKENAME吸收阳光中的养分时，尾根圆球会明亮发光。球也储存电力，电流沿叶状尾巴涌出，化作迅捷电击射出。
author: sk372
source: The orb at the base of POKENAME's tail glows bright while it absorbs nutrients from sunlight. It also stores POKENAME's electricity, surging up its leafy tail before being fired off in quick bolts.

entry: POKENAME额头和尾巴的红球储存阳光，阴天时便是备用能源。叶子坚韧得惊人，普通修枝剪连一道痕都留不下。
author: bobosmith01
source: The red orbs found on POKENAME's forehead and tail store sunlight and act as an energy reserve during cloudy days. Its leaves are surprisingly durable: typical pruners would fail to even leave a mark.

entry: POKENAME吸收、代谢阳光，使身体产生电力。电流沿叶片流动或穿过时，叶子就会变得坚硬如刃，锋利无比。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME absorb and metabolize sunlight, which, in turn, causes their bodies to generate electricity. When electricity courses along, or through, their leaves, they become rigid and sharp like blades.

entry: 它叫起来时，附近花草似乎会随声有节奏地摇摆。光合作用既滋养自己，也产生洁净空气。还展现过类似的净化脏水能力。
author: infinex21
source: When it cries out, nearby plants and flowers seem to sway in rhythm with its vocals. Through photosynthesis, it keeps itself nourished and produces clean air. It has displayed a similar ability to cleanse dirty water.

entry: POKENAME清晨登上高树顶，沐浴晨光进行光合作用。只晒几小时，就能攒足一整天觅食与玩耍所需的能量。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME seek high tree tops during the early morning, basking in the early sun to photosynthesize. They gather the energy necessary for a whole day's worth of foraging and play with just a few hours of sunbathing.

entry: POKENAME以枯叶为食，帮助清理同群筑巢的树林。飞过空中时，迅捷双翼散出刚割青草般的清香。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME feeds on dead leaves, helping to keep the trees clean in the woods where it nests with its flock. When it soars through the air, its swift wings release a fresh scent of freshly cut grass.

entry: POKENAME叶子含多种微量过敏原，却也分泌能缓解轻微反应的凝胶。在它身边长大的孩子，较不易出现过敏。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME contain trace amounts of many allergens in their leaves, but also excrete a gel that treats mild reactions. Children growing up around POKENAME are less likely to develop allergies.

entry: POKENAME叶子含多种微量过敏原，却也分泌能缓解轻微反应的凝胶。有些过敏的成人会饲养它，试图建立对过敏原的免疫力。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME contain trace amounts of many allergens in their leaves, but also excrete a gel that treats mild reactions. Adults with allergies sometimes keep POKENAME to try and build immunity to the allergen.

entry: 春天，尾巴开花，净化周围空气。与训练家结下羁绊后，POKENAME会用精神力量守护对方一生。
author: fiordaliso
source: During spring, flowers bloom on its tail, purifying the air in its surrounding environment. Upon bonding with a Trainer, POKENAME uses its psychic powers to protect them for a lifetime.

entry: POKENAME运用精神力量时，身上叶子会释放芬芳薄荷香。它爱好和平，却会毫不犹豫地战斗，守护栖居森林的完整。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME channels its psychic powers, the leaves on its body release a fragrant, minty aroma. It is a peaceful Pokémon, yet it does not hesitate to fight to defend the integrity of the forest it inhabits.

entry: POKENAME视力惊人，在黑暗中也看得清。虽能从阳光合成能量，想要更多仍得夜间捕猎。皮毛会轻微刺激皮肤，许多人甚至对其过敏。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME boasts incredible vision that even functions in the dark. Although it can synthesize energy from the sun, it must hunt at night if it wants more energy. Their fur is a mild skin irritant and many people are outright allergic to it.

entry: POKENAME视力惊人，在黑暗中也看得清。虽能从阳光合成能量，想要更多仍得夜间捕猎。皮毛会轻微刺激皮肤，许多人甚至对其过敏。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME boasts incredible vision that even functions in the dark. Although it can synthesize energy from the sun, it must hunt at night if it wants more energy. Its fur is a mild skin irritant and many people are outright allergic to it.

entry: POKENAME以刻薄凶狠、记仇长久闻名。幸好，残酷与报复大多发泄在植物身上。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME are known as mean, vicious creatures that keep long grudges. Fortunately, most of their cruelty and revenge is lashed out at plants.

entry: 城市污染严重时，人们会引入POKENAME净化空气。它无法在黑暗中茁壮成长，因此会在屋顶营造栖地，供其进行光合作用。
author: periperi_chicken
source: When cities are heavily polluted, POKENAME are brought in to clean the air. POKENAME cannot thrive in the dark, so rooftop habitats are made to allow them to photosynthesise.

entry: 它挥舞成簇的利叶，保护花苞。POKENAME能连着几小时站在原地，吸收土中养分。
author: mistymagius
source: It protects its flower bud by swinging around its cluster of sharp leaves. POKENAME stands it the same spot for hours on end, absorbing nutrients from the soil.

entry: POKENAME住在古遗迹附近的森林，藏身叶丛伪装。它在树皮刻下符号，与同类沟通，但这些刻痕的含义尚未破解。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives in forests within the vicinity of ancient ruins, camouflaging itself against the foliage. It scrapes symbols into the tree bark to communicate with others of its kind, though the meanings of the markings have yet to be deciphered.

entry: POKENAME长颈能够到更多阳光，进行光合作用。若住进光照较少的环境，颈部便会逐渐长得更长。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME's long neck allows it to reach more sunlight for photosynthesis. When living in biomes with less light, POKENAME's neck will grow longer over time.

entry: POKENAME似乎与马宝可梦有仇，一见小火马和烈焰马就特意前去攻击。可壳拖慢了速度，让它追不上这些快腿宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME appear to hold a grudge against horse Pokémon, going out of their way to attack Ponyta and Rapidash on sight. Their shells slow them down, however, preventing them from being able to keep up with the speedy Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME从筑巢的高树跃下，滑翔越过森林。扁平叶状尾巴让飞行十分稳定，也能用来赶走敌对宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME soars over forests by diving from the tall trees where it builds its nest. Its flat, leaf-shaped tail grants it excellent stability in flight and is also used to drive away enemy Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME是老练的猎手，藏在大片海草中，用高压水流狙击猎物。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are expert predators. They hide themselves within large amounts of seagrass and snipe their prey with pressurized water.

entry: POKENAME像植物一样，通过光合作用吸收光获取能量。因能引导、增强阳光，常用于建造太阳能板。不过，它也会吃掉其中一部分太阳能。
author: blaizegamer
source: Like a plant, POKENAME use photosynthesis to absorb light for energy. They are usually used in the construction of solar panels due to their ability to redirect and amplify sunlight. However, POKENAME eat a percentage of said solar energy.

entry: 它用叶状尾尖引诱毫无戒心的宝可梦落入陷阱。POKENAME能产生淡绿色毒液，经妥善提炼，可作为舒缓喉痛的药剂成分。
author: fiordaliso
source: It uses the leaf-shaped tip of its tail to lure unsuspecting Pokémon into traps. POKENAME can produce a greenish venom which, when properly refined, becomes an ingredient for a tonic that soothes sore throats.

entry: 它以两根长牙刺入树干，迅速取得树液。不过，只吸收阳光就足以维持营养。穿过原野和平原时动作极快，几乎总会踢起花朵。
author: infinex21
source: It uses its two long fangs to tap into trees and quickly gain access to their sap. It need only absorb sunlight to keep itself nourished, however. It moves through fields and plains with such haste that flowers are almost always kicked up.

entry: POKENAME能让遭到破坏的土地恢复生机，常受赞誉。但也有其力量让自然失控生长、吞没村庄的事例。
author: xenellia
source: While POKENAME is often praised for its ability to revive desecrated areas, there have been cases where its powers caused nature to spiral out of control and overtake villages.

entry: POKENAME深居林中，在树木间迅疾穿行，守护自己的王国。每到落脚之处，周围草木便重焕生机。
author: ayner
source: POKENAME dwells deep in the woods, swiftly rushing between trees to guard its kingdom. Where they land, the surrounding plants are reinvigorated.

entry: 有时，一阵锋利飞叶发出后，会留下一封树叶信。写的是什么、又是如何出现的，全是谜。
author: quackquackattack
source: Sometimes, whenever it launches a flurry of razor-sharp leaves, it leaves behind a Leaf Letter. What it says or how it got there is a mystery.

entry: 它用细枝般的尾巴在树间荡行。尾巴看似脆弱，其实十分强韧，足以承受POKENAME的全部体重。
author: _._starry_._
source: It uses its twig-like tails to swing from tree to tree. Despite their fragile appearance, they are actually quite strong, capable of bearing POKENAME's full weight.

entry: POKENAME是关爱所有林居宝可梦的守护者，为它们唱优美摇篮曲。可面对破坏自然者，便毫不留情地使出飞叶风暴。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is known to be a caring guardian to all forest-dwelling Pokémon, serenading them with beautiful lullabies. Against those who would despoil nature, POKENAME shows no mercy as it unleashes its Leaf Storm.

entry: POKENAME爪子虽骇人，通常却平静温和。多见于森林，常聚在阳光充足的空地，开心享受光与暖意。
author: sirg44
source: Despite their intimidating claws, POKENAME are typically quite calm and gentle. Often found in forests, they can be seen clustered around sunny clearings, happily soaking up the light and warmth.

entry: POKENAME身上的花香会吸引三蜜蜂、狩猎凤蝶等传粉者，形成共生关系。它保护对方免遭捕食，对方则让花朵生机长存。
author: jojojax164
source: The scent of the flowers on the body of POKENAME draws pollinators such as Combee or Beautifly. This creates a symbiotic relationship between them. POKENAME protects the pollinators from predators, and they keep the flowers alive.

entry: POKENAME像极了叶伊布刚被发现时那些早已过时的旧画像。它把根状脚掌扎入地下，从土壤吸取大部分养分。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME resembles old, outdated depictions from when the Leafeon species was first being discovered. It gets most of its nutrients through digging its root-like paws into the ground and feeding off the soil.

entry: POKENAME叶状部位的尖端总覆着一层冰。以寒冷地区的森林为家，照料其中植物，帮助它们熬过严寒。
author: sk372
source: The tips of POKENAME's leafy parts are always coated with a layer of ice. It makes its home in forests within colder regions, caring for the plants within to help ensure they survive the harsh temperatures.

entry: POKENAME用树皮般的翅膀滑过茂密落叶林。尾上的叶子充当舵，让它轻松穿梭树间。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME glides through dense deciduous forests using its bark-like wings. The leaf on POKENAME's tail acts as a rudder, allowing it to weave between trees with ease.

entry: POKENAME滑过林间空地时，尾巴会脱离身体，升起吸收阳光。它极其害羞，受惊便尖声鸣叫，向四面八方发射电击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tail detaches and rises to absorb sunlight as it glides through forest glades. It is extremely shy, screeching a high-pitched beep while firing blasts of electricity in all directions if startled.

entry: 丛林空地最适合POKENAME进行光合作用。它留下一些能量自用，其余则拿去滋养各种植物。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Clearings in the jungle are the perfect place for POKENAME to carry out photosynthesis. It will store some energy for itself while using the rest to feed plants and other flora.

entry: POKENAME越年幼，走路便越不稳。训练家会抱着它，直到能独立行走，同时享受怀中的温暖与芳香。
author: krivaswell
source: The younger a POKENAME is, the more unsteady it will be on its feet. Trainers will hold POKENAME until it can walk on its own, enjoying the warmth and fragrant scent it gives off while in their arms.

entry: POKENAME平日在林下灌丛嗅来嗅去，寻找树根和小型虫属性宝可梦。背上的叶冠硬如岩石，害怕时就会竖起。
author: shreks_stepfather
source: POKENAME spends its days snuffling through forest undergrowth in search of tree roots and small Bug-type Pokémon. The crest of leaves on POKENAME's back is hard as rock and stands up when POKENAME is scared.

entry: POKENAME无声疾穿林冠，巡视是否有威胁亲族的危险。它藏在树间伪装，直到从高处踢出毁灭性的一击。
author: bardanchaos
source: POKENAME dashes silently through forest canopies, patrolling the area for threats to its kin. It will remain camouflaged among the trees until it launches a devastating kick from on high.

entry: POKENAME顽皮善良，据说能听见植物的灵魂。几乎谁靠近家园，都会友好相待；但不尊重自然的人，会招来怒火，吃上一场严厉教训。
author: sk372
source: A playful and kind Pokémon that is said to hear the souls of plantlife, POKENAME is friendly to almost any that approach its home. However, those who don't respect nature will earn its ire, and learn a very harsh lesson.

entry: POKENAME喜欢待在密林深处，为生病的野生宝可梦配药。据说它们能理解植物的灵魂。
author: quote.lass
source: POKENAME prefer to stay deep in forests so that they might craft medicine for sick wild Pokémon. They're said to understand the souls of plants.

entry: POKENAME的形态反映周围森林的健康。森林越扭曲腐朽，它显现的形体就越巨大，力量也越强。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's form reflects the health of the forest around it. The more gnarled and decayed the forest is, the larger and more powerful POKENAME's manifestation is.

entry: POKENAME在潮湿洞穴筑巢，挑土壤最肥沃的地方休息。通常温顺，却能硬化叶片，化作极锋利的刀刃，保护自己与幼崽。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME make their dens in damp caves and rest where the soil is richest. Though typically docile, POKENAME can harden their leaves and use them as devastatingly sharp blades to defend themselves and their young.

entry: 这种大嘴娃亚种住在丛林深处，大半天把身体塞进小角落或缝隙里酣睡。捕蝇草般的第二张嘴，却始终张开，等着猎物。
author: modeustheunbound
source: This subspecies of Mawile lives in the deepest jungles. They spend most of the day with their body wedged into a small nook or crevice, sleeping soundly, while their flytrap-like second mouth lies open and waiting.

entry: 有人即将被倒下的树砸伤时，POKENAME会走近伐木工示警。听劝的人只须换个角度砍树，便能避开危机。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME approach lumberjacks to warn them when someone is about to get hurt by a falling tree. The loggers who heed their warning can avert a crisis by cutting the tree from a different angle.

entry: POKENAME天生有疗愈气息，对植物尤其有效。当它在阳光下休息，即使最贫瘠的田地，也会因它的存在慢慢重获生机。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME exhibits a natural healing aura that is particularly effective in plant life. While it rests beneath the sunlight, even the most barren of fields will slowly return to life in POKENAME's presence.

entry: POKENAME大多时候都在阳光下睡觉，靠光合作用获取能量。壳上栖生着许多种苔藓。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME spends most of its time sleeping in the sunlight, gaining energy through photosynthesis. Its shell is home to numerous species of mosses.

entry: POKENAME灵巧旋转竹杖，以巧妙身法智取对手。它俏皮地挥动大叶片掩护佯动，在空中调整身位，下一击之前仿佛消失不见。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Nimbly twirling staffs made from bamboo, POKENAME fight by outsmarting their opponents with clever maneuvers. They playfully swing their large leaves as cover for their ruse, seeming to disappear before their next attack as they adjust in mid-air.

entry: POKENAME以自食其力为傲，拒绝接受人类的食物。它能光合制造养分，因此大多时候都趴在海滩，将叶状尾巴高高竖起。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will refuse to accept food from humans, as it takes pride in its self-reliance. It can make food through photosynthesis, so it spends most of its time lying on its front on beaches with its leafy tail raised up into the air.

entry: POKENAME虽不介意在冷水游泳，仍会寻找阳光充足的地方。通常留在海面，让叶子和尾巴尽量吸光，取得继续游泳的能量。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME doesn't mind swimming in cold waters, it seeks out areas with plenty of sunlight. It usually stays at the surface of the ocean so that its leaves and tail can absorb as much sunlight as possible to give it energy to keep swimming.

entry: 野生POKENAME极其罕见，世界各地却已有数起记录，见它造访由有爱之人照料的美丽花园。会赠园丁一颗稀有树果或一件宝物，三小时内便离去。
author: bobosmith01
source: Wild POKENAME are exceedingly rare, but several have been recorded across the world, visiting beautiful gardens with loving caretakers. They grant the gardener a single rare Berry or treasure, and leave within three hours.

entry: 拥有POKENAME的训练家似乎老得较慢，平均寿命比常人长5年。或许因为它能净化周围空气，减少污染引发的疾病。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Trainers that own a POKENAME seem to age slower, with their average life expectancy 5 years longer than normal. This may be due to POKENAME being able to clean the air surrounding them, reducing pollution-related illnesses.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME与树木灵魂相通。它在家园中最高、最古老的树旁休息，照料附近土壤，让树健康生长。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is thought to be in-tune with the souls of trees. It rests near the tallest and longest-living trees in its home, tending the soil near them and keeping them healthy.

entry: POKENAME是沉静坚定的自然守护者，据说只有家园森林面临毁灭才会现身。它借阳光与附近植物的能量，驱动背上的强力巨炮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a stoic guardian of nature that is said to only appear when its forest home is in danger of being destroyed. It harnesses energy derived from sunlight and nearby plant life to power the mighty cannon on its back.

entry: 它通常以光合作用获取能量。若阳光无法照到POKENAME，也能用毒鞭制服、吃下猎物。
author: archasia
source: It typically conducts photosynthesis to obtain its energy. If sunlight is blocked from reaching POKENAME, it can instead subdue and consume prey using its poisonous whips.

entry: POKENAME飞往大气高处，即使阴天也能晒到太阳。需要水时，就用长叶兜风，操纵方向，飞入云顶。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME flies high up in the atmosphere, giving its body sunlight even on cloudy days. When it needs water, it catches the wind with its long leaves and steer itself into the tops of clouds.

entry: POKENAME用舌头轻轻梳理叶状耳朵和尾巴，除去可能阻碍光合作用的泥垢。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME uses its tongue to gently groom its leafy ears and tail, keeping them free of dirt that may obstruct photosynthesis.

entry: POKENAME经过草地，便将草割成精准高度。调整修剪高低，便能在草坪造出图案。比起整齐线条，它似乎更爱抽象形状。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME mows grass to a precise height as it passes over it. By varying the height it cuts to, POKENAME can create patterns on lawns. It seems to prefer cutting abstract shapes rather than neat lines.

entry: 伊可西若在某些林地休息，便能借当地强盛的自然能量进化为POKENAME。凭用过的月之石之力，再加光合作用补能，如今只需水便能生存。
author: bobosmith01
source: If Eefable rests in certain woodlands, it can evolve into POKENAME thanks to the potent natural energy in the area. With the power of a used Moon Stone and POKENAME's ability to photosynthesize for an energy boost, it now merely needs water to live.

entry: POKENAME轻得几乎任何微风都能吹走。建议训练家始终抱着它，以免发生这种事。
author: ferdirenz
source: POKENAME is so light that almost any breeze can blow it away. Trainers are advised to hold it at all times to prevent this.

entry: POKENAME靠叶状身体吸收阳光为生，将太阳能转成养分与电力。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live off of the sunlight that they absorb through their leafy bodies. They convert this solar energy into nutrients and into electricity.

entry: POKENAME的叶状火焰泛起迷人光彩，虽常栖身幽暗森林，却不断寻找明亮空地，进行光合作用。知道这习性的迷路旅人，便跟着POKENAME走向安全处。
author: nightwingjay
source: POKENAME radiates a mesmerizing glow from its leafy flames. Typically found in dark forests, POKENAME will constantly search for bright open areas to photosynthesize. Lost travelers, with this knowledge, will follow POKENAME to safety.

entry: 叶子有一部分是金属。光合作用会强化这种材料，让POKENAME轻松切开最坚韧的障碍。
author: nyoomymph
source: Its leaves are partially metallic. Photosynthesizing strengthens the material, allowing POKENAME to cut through even the toughest of obstacles with little issue.

entry: POKENAME虽已进化出光合取能的本领，如今体形却大到阳光不敷所需。为维生，会拦住小段流水，形成富营养水池，培养藻类来吃。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Although POKENAME evolved to gain energy through photosynthesis, its size now demands more than sunlight can provide. To sustain itself, it blocks small sections of running water, creating nutrient-rich pools where algae grow, which it feeds upon.

entry: POKENAME的歌声让别人入睡，也帮助周围植物生长。据说在野外听歌睡去的人，醒来时会发现四周繁花盛开。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's song puts others to sleep while aiding in the growth of plant life around it. They say anyone who falls asleep to its song in the wild will wake up surrounded by beautiful blooming flowers.

entry: POKENAME退往林间空地，放松并进行光合作用。有时被其他宝可梦误认成大树种，若被捡起或击打，就以龙息与飞叶快刀反击。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME retreat to forest glades to relax and photosynthesize. They are sometimes mistaken for large tree seeds by other Pokémon, prompting POKENAME to retaliate with Dragon Breath and Razor Leaf attacks when picked up or struck.

entry: POKENAME将自己浅埋，藏在林间空地，放松、光合并节省能量。可有时会被误认成大树苗，引来人类与其他宝可梦的多余关注，让它颇为不快。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME slightly bury themselves and hide in forest glades to relax, photosynthesize, and conserve their energy. To their discontent, POKENAME are sometimes mistaken for large tree sprouts, drawing unwanted attention from humans and other Pokémon.

entry: 为了让叶片多见光，POKENAME会飘往树顶，用尾巴缠住能找到的最高树枝。刮风时可能被吹走，飘行数英里，才挂住另一棵树。
author: .jerden
source: To give its leaves more light, POKENAME will float up to the treetops, and cling with its tails to the highest branch it can find. On windy days it may be blown away, and drift for miles until it catches itself on another tree.

entry: POKENAME尾上的叶子利用负面情绪的能量生长。采叶十分危险，却能熬成恶臭药剂，有人相信喝了能免遭恶灵侵扰。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The leaves on POKENAME's tail harness negative emotions and use the energy to grow. Collecting its leaves is dangerous work but can be brewed into a foul-smelling tonic that some people believe keeps the drinker safe from evil spirits.

entry: POKENAME用小木牙标记居住的领地。茂密叶片带着清新宜人的薄荷香。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its small wooden fangs to mark the territory it inhabits. Its lush leaves carry a pleasantly fresh mint fragrance.

entry: 据说它以清澈宝石眼净化愤怒灵魂，使其平静。食物是沿河找到的宝石，以及躺在向阳草地时吸收的阳光。
author: jinjetica
source: It is believed to soothe angry spirits by purifying them with its clear gemstone eyes. Its diet consists of gemstones found along rivers and sunlight as it lies in sunny meadows.

entry: POKENAME有能撕碎厚金属的巨颚。不过，得先在太阳下进行光合作用，攒足能量与力量，才能办到。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME has gargantuan jaws capable of shredding thick metal. However, it must spend time in the sun to photosynthesise in order to gather the energy and strength to do this.

entry: POKENAME五只一群，见于曲折森林深处。若找到迷路训练家，便轻缓飘向林缘，引导对方回到安全之处。
author: vlavoc
source: POKENAME are found deep within winding forests in packs of five. If they find a lost Trainer, they will gently float towards the forest's edge to help guide them back to safety.

entry: POKENAME焦虑时，叶子会分泌一种物质，吃下便会变成毒。它安静独居，通常藏在灌木间，避开与旁人相处。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME grows anxious, its leaves secrete a substance that turns poisonous if ingested. It is a peaceful, solitary Pokémon that usually stays hidden among the bushes, avoiding the company of others.

entry: POKENAME身上的叶子与外观给人的印象相反，锋利无比，能轻松切开树木。它分泌黏液拖慢敌人，再以精准劈斩迅速结束战斗。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Contrary to their looks, the leaves on POKENAME's body are incredibly sharp, being able to cut through trees with ease. The goo POKENAME secretes allow them to slow their foes' movement before quickly finishing the battle with a well-placed slash.

entry: POKENAME以光合作用养活自己，也擅长培育其他植物，即使住在干旱气候也不例外。许多沙漠聚落靠它的知识维持粮食供应。
author: skittytales
source: Because POKENAME feeds itself through photosynthesis, it is skilled at cultivating other plants, even in the arid climates where it lives. Many desert communities rely on POKENAME's knowledge for their food supply.

entry: POKENAME沐浴月光，以光合作用取得能量，也吃环境中的其他植物补充食物。健康个体的叶状帆会散出留兰香气味。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME bask under moonlight to photosynthesize energy, supplementing their diet with other plants in their environment. Healthy POKENAME emit a spearmint smell from their leaf-like sails.

entry: POKENAME骄傲而忠诚，会巡视森林，确保环境安全洁净。奔跑时，皮毛中的叶子还会产生清新空气。
author: mistymagius
source: A proud and loyal Pokémon. POKENAME scout the forest to make sure the area is safe and clean. The leaves in their fur produce clean air when they run.

entry: POKENAME借叶子演奏舒缓野生宝可梦的氛围音乐。它们是更悠闲的乐手，花更多时间待在阳光下进行光合作用。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME utilizes leaves to help it produce ambient music that soothes wild Pokémon. They are far more relaxed musicians who spend more time hanging out in the sunshine to perform photosynthesis.

entry: POKENAME随充满诗意与戏剧性的叙事曲起舞。轻盈叶身热情而优雅，以诠释性的舞蹈演出一节节诗句。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dance along many ballades that are filled with poetic drama. Their light, leafy bodies dance with passion and grace as they act out various verses in a form of interpretive dance.

entry: POKENAME虽勉强愿意分享背上的蘑菇，通常仍希望对方帮忙传播孢子作为回报。若直接偷菇，最快就会尝到锋利叶片的劈砍。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME reluctantly share mushrooms from their back but usually expect some help propagating their spores in return. Stealing one of their mushrooms is the fastest way to get cut up by razor sharp leaves.

entry: POKENAME在太阳下沉睡，从不动弹。传说它正缓缓吸食太阳能量，终有一天会攒足光，给世界带来毁灭。
author: superfloxes
source: POKENAME slumbers in the sun and never stirs. Legends say that it is slowly feeding off the sun's energy, and will one day gather enough light to bring devastation to the world.

entry: 每只POKENAME都与林中家园的一棵树结下联系。神秘力量让双方长得远比平常更快、更健康。若它离开当地，效果便会消退。
author: bobosmith01
source: Each POKENAME bonds with a tree in its woodland home. Through its mysterious power, both the tree and POKENAME grow much quicker and healthier than they otherwise would. This effect fades if POKENAME leaves the area.

entry: POKENAME不仅让周围空气清新宜人，还会全力保护人类、宝可梦与植物。它常陪伴园丁，也常与宝可梦巡护员搭档。
author: infinex21
source: Not only do POKENAME exude a clean and pleasant air around them, but they will also defend humans, Pokémon, and plants with all their might. They are common companions for gardeners and common partners for Pokémon Rangers.

entry: POKENAME最爱吃干枝、枯草等引火物；排泄物则是强效燃料与富营养肥料。它周围空气洁净温暖，似乎能促进附近植物生长。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME favor snacking on tinder, such as dry twigs and dry grass, above all else; their waste, in turn, is a potent fuel and nutrient-rich fertilizer. They exude a clean, warm air around them that seems to boost nearby plant growth.

entry: POKENAME以坚韧木棍汇聚力量，据说木棍来自古老树木。似乎能稍加控制附近植物，甚至太阳能，后者还能将热量凝成火焰。
author: infinex21
source: As a focus for its powers, POKENAME wields a durable stick said to have come from a well-aged tree. It seems to be able to exert some control over nearby plant life and even solar energy, the latter to the point it can create flames from the heat.

entry: POKENAME行踪难觅，一被看见就消失在彩叶旋流中。似乎大多时间都在暗中观察其他宝可梦的行为，同时吸取阳光合成能量。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is an elusive Pokémon that disappears in a swirl of colorful leaves if spotted. It appears to spend much of its time secretly studying the behavior of other Pokémon while simultaneously synthesizing energy from the sun.

entry: POKENAME精通潜行，能融入树木。谁在森林挑战它，就得面对那条叶围巾：借其滑翔树间，再以致命的叶片手里剑出击。
author: blaizegamer
source: POKENAME are masters at the art of stealth and are capable of blending in with trees. Those who challenge them in a forest will face their leaf scarf, which they use to glide between trees before striking with deadly leaf shurikens.

entry: POKENAME在花园休息，吸收阳光，越长越大。小时候是热门宠物，可许多人没意识到它究竟能长多大。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME rest in gardens, soaking up sunlight to grow larger. They're a popular choice of pet when they're small, but many people do not realize just how big they can grow to be.

entry: POKENAME在树顶筑巢，好让叶状翅膀充分吸收阳光。振翼撒出的花粉促进植物与草属性宝可梦生长，却对多数其他生灵有害。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME nest atop trees to better absorb sunlight through their leafy wings. The pollen they spread when their wings flutter boosts growth in plants and Grass-type Pokémon but is harmful to most other living beings.

entry: POKENAME产生茶味花蜜，可加入烘焙点心。它颇为调皮，常在厨房搞小恶作剧。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produces a tea-flavored nectar that is incorporated into baked goods. It can be quite mischievous and is known to pull small pranks in the kitchen.

entry: POKENAME脾气极差，须靠近花草才能平静，否则就会以出奇锋锐的尾巴与毛发大闹。园丁与环保人士常请它担任守卫。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME has an exceptionally poor temper, requiring close proximity to flora to stay calm, or it will go berserk with its surprisingly piercing tail and hair. Gardeners and environmentalists frequently use it as a guard.

entry: POKENAME依附健康树木与健康的草属性宝可梦，吸取部分养分。从下半身沟槽之间撒出的毒粉能削弱别人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME attach themselves to healthy trees and healthy Grass-type Pokémon so they may leech some of their nutrients. They scatter toxic powder from between the grooves of their lower halves to weaken others.

entry: 它将储粮存于地下洞穴，确保四季都有稳定食物。POKENAME叶子分泌浓香油脂，用于制作天然原料的防晒霜。
author: fiordaliso
source: It stores its provisions in an underground burrow, ensuring a steady food supply throughout every season. The leaves of POKENAME secrete a richly scented oil used in the production of natural-ingredient sunscreen.

entry: POKENAME常在花园晒太阳。心情好时，若被抚摸皮毛，就会散发类似猫薄荷的气味。
author: kitarchen
source: POKENAME are commonly spotted in gardens, basking in the sunlight. If in a good mood, they will smell similar to catnip when their fur is stroked.
