entry: POKENAME通常十分骄傲，仰慕者众多。身上的气味如花园中各种芬芳的独特组合；有些训练家将它与稀有植物一同培育，追求那些受欢迎的香味。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME are usually very proud and have many admirers. They smell like the unique combination of fragrances found in gardens; some Trainers raise them with rare plants for their popular fragrances.

entry: POKENAME体内长着花，能让它与植物心灵感应。植物信息不断涌来，刺激过多，让它头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have flowers growing within their body that allow them to telepathically communicate with plants. They are constantly bombarded with messages from plants and develop headaches from being overstimulated.

entry: POKENAME大部分养分由叶状身体吸收，却常被沉重叶片拖慢。游泳前会先吃掉叶子，反正一天内就能长回。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME absorb most of their nutrients through their leafy body but are often slowed down by the weight of their leaves. They eat their leaves before a swim since the leaves regrow within a day.

entry: 每隔三年，它便自行点燃全身皮毛。烧完后光秃秃，无法光合而行动迟缓；但叶子重新长出时，会比以前更坚韧锋利。
author: periperi_chicken
source: Every three years, it sets its own coat ablaze. The process leaves it bald and sluggish without photosynthesis, but when its leaves grow back, they return tougher and sharper than before.

entry: POKENAME振翼引起龙卷风，散出能刺穿皮肤、岩石与树皮的利叶。它住在密林，冬季叶落时便会冬眠。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: POKENAME's wings cause tornadoes that scatter sharp leaves capable of piercing skin, rock, and bark. It lives in dense forests and hibernates in winter, when the leaves have fallen.

entry: 工厂装袋时，它会钻进一袋袋装土豆里睡觉。醒来后吃光土豆，再从袋里逃走。
author: quackquackattack
source: In a factory during the bagging process, it finds its way into a Pack of Potatoes before napping. When it wakes up, it devours the potatoes before escaping from the bag.

entry: POKENAME最爱藏在大堆落叶里打盹。受打扰时以念力扬起叶片，分散闯入者注意，掩护自己瞬间移动逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's preferred napping spot is within large piles of leaves to hide itself. If disturbed, it uses telekinesis to scatter the leaves and distract the intruder to help cover its escape via teleportation.

entry: POKENAME在丛林精挑叶片，做成腰布。强光下进行光合作用，获得迎战任何敌人的力量，以粗藤为武器。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME fashions a loincloth out of leaves it carefully picks out in the jungle. It photosynthesizes in harsh light and gains the strength to take on any foe, utilizing a thick vine as a weapon.

entry: POKENAME凭强健臂肌，轻松荡着藤蔓穿行丛林树间。外表虽壮硕，性情却平和，尽量避开冲突。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME moves through the jungle trees, effortlessly swinging on vines thanks to its powerful arm muscles. Despite its brawny appearance, it is a peaceful Pokémon that avoids conflict as much as possible.

entry: POKENAME善于伺机捕猎，兼用力量与智慧觅食。特别偏爱挖个深坑，插满尖木棍，再站进坑里，掩住陷阱。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are opportunistic hunters, utilizing both strength and wits to hunt for food. A particularly favored method involves POKENAME digging a deep hole, filling it with sharp sticks, and then standing inside the hole to hide the trap.

entry: POKENAME奔跑或打盹时吸收阳光，鬃毛长得格外茂密，满是叶片。因不断净化空气、光合取能，能全速跑上多天，一刻也不必停下休息。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's mane grows extremely large and leafy as it soaks up sunlight during its runs and naps. Due to it always creating clean air and gathering energy through photosynthesis, it can run at top speed for many days without ever stopping to rest.

entry: 一个古老文化只留下了一本古书。书中讲，虚荣的POKENAME总对着水池欣赏美貌，几乎不动，最终在原地扎根，变成了一棵树。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: An ancient book is all that is left of an old culture. The story tells of a vain POKENAME that would gaze into a pool of water to admire its beauty, and barely ever move. It ended up becoming rooted to the spot and transforming into a tree.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴引来爱吃海藻的鱼。幸好，这些鱼大多正是它的猎物。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME uses its tail to attract seaweed-favoring fish. Thankfully, most of these fish happen to be its prey.

entry: POKENAME催眠其他宝可梦时，会造出宁静森林的梦。这些梦十分舒缓，许多做梦者醒来都觉得精神焕发。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce dreams of tranquil forests whenever they hypnotize another Pokémon. These dreams are quite calming and leave many dreamers feeling quite refreshed.

entry: POKENAME叶子的独特香气能改善睡眠品质。许多芳香疗法用品都使用这些叶子。
author: mepp.
source: The leaves on POKENAME have a distinct scent that is known to improve sleep quality. Many aromatherapy products use these leaves.

entry: POKENAME与有毛的宝可梦挤在一起取暖。若有宝可梦想拆散群体，就以丝缠住危险来客，与朋友一起逃走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME keep warm by huddling together with furry Pokémon. When another Pokémon threatens to break up the group, POKENAME ensnare the dangerous Pokémon with silk before escaping with their friends.

entry: 为免过热，它会将周围空气降至冰点。结果所到之处，都会掀起巨大暴风雪。
author: soup1900
source: To keep itself from overheating, it will freeze the temperature around it. This, however, causes massive blizzards wherever it passes.

entry: POKENAME的头长成、脱离身体后，十分易碎，充满冰冻能量。投出去，一碰撞就会爆开，冻住四周，因此被叫作“冰手榴弹”。
author: soup1900
source: The heads of POKENAME, once grown off its body, become very fragile and full of freezing energy. If one of these heads is thrown, it will explode on contact and freeze the surrounding area. These heads have therefore been dubbed "ice grenades".

entry: POKENAME用冰冷吐息在身前造出大冰块，再拿随身骨头的尖端雕琢，刻成所珍视对象的模样。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses frozen breath to make large cubes of ice before it. It then uses the sharp end of the bone it carries to chisel the ice into a sculpture resembling those it cares about.

entry: POKENAME被冰包围，在其中休息，直到进化。冰很难用爪子打破，许多捕食者还没碰到里面的它，就已放弃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found surrounded by ice where they rest until they evolve. The ice is difficult to break with claws or talons, leading to many predators giving up before reaching POKENAME inside.

entry: 冰甲冷得触之即冻。POKENAME全速撞向山壁，向同类证明冰角的坚韧。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its icy armor is so cold it freezes anything on contact. POKENAME crashes into mountain walls at full speed to prove the toughness of its ice horn to others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME的育儿袋如同冷冻柜，内部温度可达华氏-75度。常把食物存进去保鲜，留待以后吃。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's pouches function almost like freezers, the temperature inside reaching -75 degrees Fahrenheit. They will often store food within these pockets, preserving it for later consumption.

entry: POKENAME像大螺旋桨般旋转，卷起猛烈暴风雪。它让冰宝石闪光，引来旅人，使对方彻底任其摆布。
author: fiordaliso
source: By spinning like a large propeller, POKENAME creates violent snowstorms. It lures travelers by making its ice gem shine, leaving them completely at its mercy.

entry: POKENAME主要吃薄荷等散发清香的舒缓药草。常会走近受伤宝可梦，轻轻覆上一层雪，包住伤口止痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME mainly eat mint and other soothing herbs that give a fresh scent. They are known to approach injured Pokémon and gently wrap wounds with a layer of snow to ease the pain.

entry: POKENAME十分适应冰冷海洋。受捕食者威胁时，能将周围水冻成尖冰刺，再潜入水下逃走。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is well-adapted to swim in frigid oceans. If threatened by a predator, it can freeze the water around it into sharp spikes of ice, then dive below the surface to escape.

entry: POKENAME开心蹦跳时，会留下一路雪花。它十分害羞，须先与训练家建立牢固信任，才能安心融入队伍。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME hops cheerfully, it leaves a trail of snowflakes behind. It is a very shy Pokémon that needs to build a strong bond of trust with its Trainer before feeling at ease within the team.

entry: POKENAME打喷嚏时会有几秒控制不住力量，突然引来降雪。炎夏里，它会睡在训练家的枕头上，让枕头更凉爽。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME sneezes, it loses control of its powers for a few seconds, causing it to suddenly start snowing. During hot summers, it falls asleep on its Trainer's pillow to keep it cooler.

entry: POKENAME只须将脚掌放在水面，就能将整片湖冻得结结实实。独特的适应性DNA让它与水或雪都能完美相融。
author: fiordaliso
source: Simply by placing its paws on a body of water, POKENAME can create perfectly frozen lakes. It can blend in seamlessly with both water and snow thanks to its unique adaptive DNA.

entry: 受威胁时，POKENAME把毛冻成尖冰柱，灌入电力，高速射向捕食者。趁对方麻痹，便能迅速逃走。
author: ambrosia04
source: When threatened, POKENAME freeze their fur into sharp icicles that they charge with electricity and launch at high speeds toward predators. This allows them to quickly escape while the predator is paralyzed.

entry: POKENAME造的冰雪摸起来温暖，却只会在自然条件下融化。火星与火焰则相反，带着刺骨寒气，却能烧灼接触的东西。
author: pixlhoopa
source: Snow and ice created by POKENAME feels warm, yet only melts when under natural conditions. Embers and fire are the opposite, holding a frigid aura that burns things it touches.

entry: POKENAME通常熬过漫长炎夏后，于秋季进化。为保持凉爽，会以冰壳包裹自己，遮挡阳光。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME typically evolve during fall after a long hot summer. They keep themselves cool by enveloping themselves in a shell of ice to give themselves shade.

entry: POKENAME从毒刺射出冰柱，尽量扩大毒液射程。含毒冰柱一击中其他宝可梦，约五秒后毒性便会引起疼痛寒战。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shoot icicles from their stingers to maximize the range of their venom. Once a venom-filled icicle strikes another Pokémon, it takes about five seconds before the venom causes aching chills.

entry: 它出了名地爱恶作剧，能操控冰冻能量，造出无害冰块和雪球，顽皮地丢向别人。在信任者手中，皮毛凉爽柔软；否则就会冰冷扎手。
author: infinex21
source: It is a notorious trickster that can manipulate its freezing energy to create harmless chunks of ice and snowballs, both of which it will playfully chuck at others. Its fur is cool and soft for those it trusts. Otherwise, it is frigid and bristly.

entry: POKENAME颈部的器官能冷却周围空气，将空气中的水分凝成冰刺。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME has organs on its neck that can cool the air around it, forming ice spikes from moisture in the air.

entry: POKENAME无论飞到哪里，都披着一层薄薄冷雾。能在暴风雪等风暴中辨路，因此深受新手训练家喜爱。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are always cloaked in a thin, cold mist wherever they fly. Because these Pokémon can navigate through storms, such as blizzards, they are a favorite among starting Trainers.

entry: POKENAME是聪明的猎手，用女性般的面容诱使别人走进冰冷丝网。猎物一被缠住，就注入刺骨寒毒，拖进巢穴。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are clever hunters that use their feminine heads to lure others into their cold webs. Once their prey is entangled, they will inject them with a bone-chilling venom and drag them into their lair.

entry: POKENAME四翼每次拍动都会产生雪花，因此巢穴地面总至少积着几英寸雪。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's four wings generate snowflakes with every flap. POKENAME dens always have at least a few inches of snow on the ground due to this.

entry: 野生POKENAME总选最冷的地方筑巢，哪怕只是一座多风的山。能冻住自己的羽毛，十分精准地掷向敌人。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME tend to nest wherever temperatures are coldest, even if that simply means atop a breezy mountain. They can freeze their own feathers and fling them at their foes with noteworthy accuracy.

entry: POKENAME蹦跳时，小脚每次触地都留下一路冰晶。身体太轻，暴风雪可能将它一路卷走，直到风终于停下。
author: fiordaliso
source: Every time its tiny feet touch the ground as it hops, POKENAME leaves a trail of ice crystals behind. It is so lightweight that a snowstorm risks carrying it away until the wind finally dies down.

entry: POKENAME用精神力量造出美丽极光。据说能从自己唤起的舞动光芒中看见未来。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their psychic powers to produce beautiful auroras. They are said to be able to read the future in the dancing lights their powers create.

entry: POKENAME凭气派双翼，能飞出惊人速度。从高处精准掷下剃刀般的利冰，击倒猎物。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can reach incredible flight speeds thanks to the power of its majestic wings. It hurls shards of razor-sharp ice from above with pinpoint precision to bring down its prey.

entry: 有人说，POKENAME明亮发光的圆球其实是冻结的闪电。若哪颗破裂，就可能释放冰封风暴的威力。
author: henry9000
source: Some say POKENAME's brightly glowing orbs are actually frozen lightning. If one were to ever break, it could unleash the might of a frozen storm.

entry: POKENAME能把毛冻成针般尖锐，只有颈边羊毛仅覆薄霜。训练家抚摸时，很享受羊毛发出的清脆碎响。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME can freeze its fur into sharp, needle-like points, though its woolly neck only becomes frosty. Trainers enjoy the satisfying crunch of its wool when they pet it.

entry: 它乘寒风往返各处，避免陷进雪里。POKENAME若不够小心，暴风雪也会把它吹得远离家园。
author: fiordaliso
source: It rides the icy winds to move from one place to another, avoiding sinking into the snow. If POKENAME is not careful enough, blizzards can blow it far away from home.

entry: 羽毛，尤其头上的羽毛，闪着霜光，散出柔和冷气。它能释放更多寒冷能量，借翅膀卷起范围虽小却很猛烈的暴风雪。
author: infinex21
source: Its feathers, especially those upon its head, sparkle with frost and exude a gentle, cold air. It can release more of its cold energy and use its wings to create strong, albeit small, blizzards.

entry: POKENAME寒冷无比，有族群生活的河流会比原本低6°C，更容易结冰。若真冻上，它们会在冰上戳洞，让水中仍能获得足够氧气。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are so cold that rivers with colonies of them are 6°C colder than they would be otherwise, making them much more prone to freezing. If this happens, they poke holes into the ice so enough oxygen can still get into the water.

entry: 寒冷冬夜，成群POKENAME最为活跃。它们藏进暗影，突然吐出寒气，瞬间冻得敌人无法动弹。
author: thepandasharky
source: Groups of POKENAME tend to be most active on cold winter nights. They use the shadows to blend in, launching surprise attacks with freezing breath that can immobilize foes in an instant.

entry: POKENAME藏在夜色里。靠近目标时，空气骤寒，早在看见或听见它之前，就已显露行踪。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME hide in the darkness of the night. Whenever they approach a target, a sudden chill in the air warns of their presence long before they can be seen or heard.

entry: POKENAME的皮毛使它最适合寒冷环境。冻住牙齿后，便能啃穿冰层掘穴。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's fur makes it best suited for cold environments. By freezing their teeth, they can chew through ice to make burrows.

entry: POKENAME的花苞产生冰孢子，一碰到东西，便将其冻住。据说，花朵即将绽放时，暴风雪也随之形成。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME flower bud produces icy spores that will freeze anything they touch instantly. It is said that blizzards form once its flower is ready to bloom.

entry: POKENAME在雪下挖出复杂洞穴，囤放食物。将牙齿冻得坚硬，就能使出强力冰冻牙。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME make intricate burrows under the snow, hoarding food inside. By freezing their teeth solid, they can deliver a powerful Ice Fang attack.

entry: POKENAME只能吃冻住的植物。想饲养它的训练家得准备住在雪地，因为食物稍带暖意，也会损伤胃壁。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME can only eat vegetation that is frozen. Trainers who wish to own a POKENAME must be prepared to live in snowy places, as even the slightest hint of warmth in its food can damage its stomach lining.

entry: POKENAME身体由冰压成的晶体构成，比岩石还硬。为免融化，不会钻得太深，只在接近地表的冷岩里挖掘地道。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is made of ice, compressed into crystals harder than rock. To avoid melting, it does not dig too deep, but tunnels through the cold rock closer to the surface.

entry: 成群POKENAME以接连不断的冰冻之风与冰砾，欺负附近的飞行属性宝可梦。在巢穴和猎场周围，攻击尤其凶狠。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Flocks of POKENAME bully nearby Flying-type Pokémon with constant Icy Winds and Ice Shards. Attacks are especially vicious near POKENAME's nests and hunting grounds.

entry: POKENAME冻结的身体坚如钢铁。振动翅膀是天然制冷系统的一部分，能将身后空气暖热，同时维持自身低温。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's frozen body is as hard as steel. Its flapping wings are part of a natural refrigeration system, and POKENAME will warm up the air behind it while keeping its body temperature low.

entry: POKENAME用爪子捏出雪球，与伙伴玩耍。这份友好只留给它信任的对象。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME forms snowballs in its claws to play with allies. This friendly behavior is reserved only for those it trusts.

entry: POKENAME生活在寒冷气候，光滑白毛让它融入雪景。有些知名劲爽汽水公司会在冬季请它担任吉祥物。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives in cold climates where its sleek white fur helps it blend into the snowy environment. Some popular Soda Pop companies feature POKENAME as a mascot during the winter season.

entry: POKENAME背上的厚冰壳含有热量，却似乎从不融化。偶尔小火苗会从壳缝舔出，闪过一阵光亮。
author: .izik
source: The thick icy shell on POKENAME's back contains heat but never seems to melt. Occasionally small flames lick out from cracks in its shell in brief bursts of light.

entry: POKENAME将羽毛冻结，变成锋利冰弹，再拍动翅膀射向对手。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: By freezing its feathers, POKENAME turns them into sharp, icy projectiles. It then launches them at opponents by flapping its wings.

entry: POKENAME用宽耳灵巧滑翔，即使最猛烈的暴风雪也不例外。它在冰封洞穴筑巢，储存从覆雪草原收集的食物。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its broad ears to glide nimbly, even through the harshest blizzards. It makes its den inside frozen caverns, where it stores the food it gathers from snow-covered steppes.

entry: POKENAME睡在冰盖下的深水里，只有头顶冰融才会上浮。觅食时卷起呼啸暴风雪，随后又潜回深处休息。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME sleeps in deep water beneath ice sheets. It only rises to the surface if the ice above it melts, and it will create howling blizzards as it hunts for food before diving back below to rest.

entry: POKENAME能大幅改变体温。常把尾巴冻硬，当凿子雕出美丽冰雕。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are able to change their body temperature drastically. By freezing their tails and using them as chisels, they will often carve beautiful sculptures out of ice.

entry: 盘绕的身体光滑如冰，摸起来总是寒凉。POKENAME使出大蛇瞪眼、麻痹受害者时，眼睛会变成骇人的猩红。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its coils are smooth and cold as ice, always chilling to the touch. When POKENAME uses its Glare attack to paralyze its victims, its eyes turn a frightening shade of scarlet.

entry: 奇怪的是，融合后的POKENAME形似双倍多多冰。一颗头友善，想把自制冰点送给别人；另一颗却恶意十足，谁想接下点心，就要将谁冻住。
author: sk372
source: Strangely, fusion has resulted in POKENAME taking a form resembling Vanilluxe. One head is friendly and tries to gift others frozen desserts it creates, while the other maliciously tries to freeze any that try to take said treat.

entry: 据说，POKENAME奔过苔原的景象是世间至美之一，鬃毛如极光般绚丽。
author: xenellia
source: Sights of POKENAME running through the tundra are said to be some of the most beautiful, its mane as stunning as the auroras.

entry: POKENAME既能吐出寒雾，也能喷出烈火，切换时甚至无须停下换气。若周围温度不能持续保持适中，就容易生病。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has the ability to breathe out a chilling mist or burning flames, even able to swap between them without pausing for breath. It gets sick easily if the temperature around it isn't consistently moderate.

entry: 古老传说称，POKENAME头顶的晶体能瞬间冻结任何接触它的东西。
author: eeveelutiongeek
source: An ancient legend states that the crystal on top of POKENAME's head can instantly freeze anything that makes contact with it.

entry: POKENAME住在寒冷山坡，以冰雪为食。为了积蓄进化能量，一天最多能吃20磅雪。
author: mepp.
source: Living on cold mountain slopes, POKENAME subsists on a diet of snow and ice. It eats up to 20lbs of snow a day as it gathers energy for evolution.

entry: POKENAME在巨大冰川侧面凿洞，造出自己的巢穴。闯入者或许只来得及瞥见一眼，就被它躯干冰宝石唤起的狂猛暴风雪吹走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carves holes in the sides of giant glaciers to make its own personal den. Trespassers might only catch a fleeting glimpse of it before it blows them away with a torrential blizzard generated from the icy gem on its torso.

entry: 传说只须扇动一次冰翼，就能恢复被全球变暖融化的冰川。在天空看见这只稀有宝可梦，是繁荣与好运的征兆。
author: fiordaliso
source: Legend says a single flap of its icy wings could restore glaciers melted by global warming. Spotting this rare Pokémon in the sky is a sign of prosperity and good fortune.

entry: POKENAME独居在少有宝可梦栖息的偏远山林，只有感到危险将近才寻同类。它向夜空射出冰晶，造出极光般的景象，人们会对着许愿。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME isolates in remote mountain forests where few Pokémon inhabit, only seeking out others of its kind if it senses oncoming danger. It launches ice crystals through the night sky to create the impression of the aurora, which people wish upon.

entry: POKENAME独居在少有宝可梦栖息的偏远山林，只有感到危险将近才寻同类。它向夜空射出冰晶，造出极光般的景象，人们会对着许愿。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME isolates in remote mountain forests where few Pokémon inhabit, only seeking out others of its kind if it senses oncoming danger. It launches ice crystals through the night sky to create the impression of the aurora, which people wish upon.

entry: POKENAME独居在少有宝可梦栖息的偏远山林，只有感到危险将近才寻同类。它向夜空射出冰晶，造出极光般的景象，人们会对着许愿。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME isolates in remote mountain forests where few Pokémon inhabit, only seeking out others of its kind if it senses oncoming danger. It launches ice crystals through the night sky to create the impression of the aurora, which people wish upon.

entry: POKENAME完全直立着睡觉，常被误认成雪人。喜欢向训练家炫耀，抛接雪球，想让对方刮目相看。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME sleep completely upright, often being mistaken for snowmen. These Pokémon love showing off to their trainers, juggling snowballs to try to impress them.

entry: 身体冷得稍一接触，就能把对手冻得结结实实。尽管如此，敏捷身手仍让它能迅速优雅地做出杂技动作。
author: .izik
source: Its body is so cold that even brief contact can freeze an opponent solid. Despite this, its agility allows it to perform rapid, graceful acrobatics.

entry: POKENAME能从身体射出冰光束，瞬间将生物冻在原地。有罪犯借它犯案，并冻住追来的执法人员。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is able to create beams of ice from its body that will instantly freeze a creature in place. Criminals have been known to use it to commit crimes and immobilize authorities that give chase.

entry: POKENAME身上的冰晶硬如钻石，能将坚石打碎。大暴风雪后，可见成群搬走成吨积雪。
author: mistymagius
source: The ice crystals on POKENAME's body are as hard as diamonds, allowing it to pulverize tough stone. Groups of POKENAME can be seen moving tons of snow after large snowstorms.

entry: POKENAME有两颗头，各自偏好的温度不同。训练家很难同时让双方满意。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME has two heads with different temperature preferences. It can be difficult for Trainers to keep both heads happy at the same time.

entry: POKENAME走到哪里，哪里便寒气逼人，冷得能使水瞬间冻结。夏季活动很欢迎它，让人和宝可梦迅速凉快下来。
author: chibitales
source: A bitter chill cold enough to flash freeze water follows POKENAME as it walks. It's popular during summertime events, allowing people and Pokémon to cool off quickly.

entry: POKENAME在暴风雪中捕猎，以耳朵和尾巴上矛状晶体进攻。覆脚的冰让它走过便冻结地面，迅速逼近猎物。
author: acatontheinternet
source: POKENAME hunts during snowstorms, using the spear-like crystals on its ears and tail for offense. The ice that encases its feet allows it to freeze the ground beneath it as it moves, swiftly closing the distance on prey.

entry: 许多人把POKENAME养在电脑上，帮助硬件降温。但也有人反映，它会失控，让整台电脑彻底“冻结”。
author: secondegg
source: Many people keep POKENAME on their computers, as they help cool down the hardware. However, some have reported them going haywire and causing their entire computer to freeze.

entry: POKENAME浅色皮毛让它在雪地完美伪装。捕猎时长久尾随，直到找到伏击的最佳时机才出手。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's pale coat helps keep it perfectly camouflaged in snowy environments. It hunts by stalking its prey for extended lengths of time, only striking when it finds the perfect moment for an ambush.

entry: 它在冰冻苔原下掘洞。为抵挡攻击，会先蜷成球，再把保温皮毛冻成尖刺。
author: .jerden
source: It burrows beneath the frozen tundra. To protect itself from attacks, it curls up into a ball, then freezes its insulating fur into sharp spikes.

entry: POKENAME有独特的战法，将冰与火运用得恰到好处。灼烧与冰冻交替出击，凶猛得难以招架。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has a unique fighting style equally balancing fire and ice. Its brutal combination of burning and freezing strikes makes it tough to face.

entry: POKENAME带着男孩子般的淘气，脑袋又傻得可爱，因此很得训练家疼爱。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME are often beloved by their Trainers due to their boyish personalities and charming lack of intelligence.

entry: POKENAME靠冻结湖泊练习能力。对寒冷的掌控十分高超，无论什么气候都能做到。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME practices its abilities by freezing lakes. Its prowess with the cold allows it to do this no matter what climate it is in.

entry: POKENAME虽仪态高贵，护起领地却极凶，以冰风与念力，击退一切可能的对手。残酷又美丽的它们，被雪乡训练家称为“寒冰女王”。
author: cinnamoone_redfield
source: Despite their regal appearance, POKENAME are extremely territorial, fighting off any potential rivals with freezing winds and psychic force. Their cruelty and beauty have led to Trainers in snowy regions referring to them as 'Chiller Queens'.

entry: POKENAME占据山顶，以纯冰筑起宫殿般的巢穴。因传闻它有超凡力量，镇民前去祈求心愿。然而，每个奇迹都需要牺牲。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME stakes out claims on mountaintops, building palatial nests out of pure ice. Due to rumors of otherworldly powers, townsfolk travel to its home to ask for their desires. However, every miracle requires a sacrifice.

entry: POKENAME格外爱玩，又很护着别人。它喜欢把冰晶塑成各式形状与花纹，让人看得入迷。
author: vaporvenator
source: POKENAME is an unusually playful yet protective Pokémon. It enjoys fascinating others by creating various shapes and patterns from ice crystals.

entry: 民间传说讲，POKENAME会在险峻冰地的隐秘小径上撒下巨大而明亮的雪花晶体，引导纯洁之心找到庇护；邪恶灵魂却会永困无尽暴风雪。
author: silentscript89
source: Folklore tells of POKENAME who scatters large, incandescent snowflake crystals along unseen paths through treacherous and icy terrain to guide the pure of heart to shelter, while wicked souls shall be trapped in an unending blizzard forevermore.

entry: 为保护训练家免受威胁，POKENAME朝袭击者射出许多针状小冰柱。常陪伴长期待在寒冷偏僻地区的人。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: To protect its Trainer from threats, POKENAME shoots many small, needle-like icicles at the attacker. They often accompany people who spend a long time in cold, isolated places.

entry: POKENAME以冰冷淡漠闻名，但在赢得尊敬的人面前，态度也会转变。冰刃技艺出众，常唤来霜雾，让战斗更占上风。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is known for its cold, indifferent nature, though this demeanor can shift around one who has gained its respect. Incredible with an icy blade, it often conjures clouds of frosty mist to give itself a greater upper hand in battle.

entry: POKENAME合力筑坝后，会吐出冰息，让整座坝覆霜。这种霜十分特殊，只有它们能通行；其他来者都会从滑溜表面滑落。
author: sk372
source: After working together to make a dam, POKENAME will breathe ice breath across the structure to coat it with frost. This frost is unique in that only POKENAME can traverse it; any others will slide right off the slippery surface.

entry: POKENAME的幽灵形体显现时，会散出寒冷气息。唤起小暴风雪藏身前，形体会加速旋转扭动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's spectral form generates an aura of cold while it is manifested. Its form spins and twists faster just before it conjures up a small blizzard to conceal itself within.

entry: POKENAME一靠近对手，便能同时操控对方与自身的波导。它以掌握的寒冷之力改变对手体内波导，使其冻得结结实实。
author: sk372
source: Once POKENAME gets up close to its opponent, it can manipulate their aura in addition to its own. Using its mastery over cold, it alters the aura within its opponent in such a way as to cause them to become frozen solid.

entry: POKENAME是寒地宝可梦巡护员的常见搭档，能以波导追踪暴风雪中的迷失者。力量凝成冰冻拳，可击碎巨大障碍，甚至可能使其瞬间冻结。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are common partners for Pokémon Rangers in cold environments, as they can use aura to track and find those lost in blizzards. By coalescing their powers into an Ice Punch, they can shatter, and may even instantly freeze, large obstacles.

entry: 体温极低，皮肤上形成一层光滑冰层，尽量减少阻力，方便贴着苔原低空飞行。
author: .jerden
source: Its body temperature is so low that a smooth layer of ice forms on its skin. This minimizes drag as it flies low above the tundra.

entry: POKENAME察觉暴风雪将至，就会离开栖居山地，向山下走。多年来，人们一直误以为暴风雪是它们带来的。
author: santon5512
source: When POKENAME sense an approaching snowstorm, they descend from the mountains they inhabit. For years, it was believed that they were the cause of these blizzards.

entry: POKENAME漫游雪山，从远处尾随徒步者。腹部的嘴一张开，就涌出冰雪狂风，常被误当雪崩将至；卷入者会被冻得结结实实。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME wander snowy mountains, stalking hikers from afar. When they open their mouths on their stomachs, gales of snow and ice will pour out. These winds are often mistaken for incoming avalanches, freezing anyone caught in them solid.

entry: POKENAME适应寒冷环境，很爱在冰水游泳。若有东西从下方袭击，就将下方的水冻成尖刺冰盾，抓紧上面，随其浮回水面。
author: .jerden
source: Adapted for cold environments, POKENAME will happily swim in icy water. If anything tries to attack it from below, POKENAME will freeze the water beneath it to create a spiky shield of ice, then cling to the top as it floats to the surface.

entry: POKENAME用锐冰包住鳍缘，让战斗更有效。它十分保护其他宝可梦，而对方也常向它寻求指引。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME coats the edges of its flippers with sharpened ice to more effectively fight. It is very defensive of other Pokémon, who often look to it for guidance.

entry: POKENAME的本体能冻结周围空气，造出雪花、可射出的冰刺，以及自己的剑刃。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's main body can freeze the atmosphere around it, creating snow, icy spikes which can shoot off as projectiles, and its blade.

entry: POKENAME能冻结周围空气，制造雪或冰晶，射向对手。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME can freeze the atmosphere around it, creating snow or ice crystals it can fire at opponents.

entry: POKENAME能切开多数有机物，冰刃会在数秒内冻住切口周围。因此港口码头很欢迎它，能高效处理刚捕来的鱼，准备运输。
author: _pixelar_
source: A POKENAME can cut through most organic material, its icy blade freezing the area around the cut in seconds. The Pokémon is very popular on harbors and docks, as it can very effectively prepare the freshly caught fish for transport.

entry: 刀刃与盾牌都由坚韧的冰构成。若受重击崩缺，POKENAME便冻结空气水分，将其修好。
author: .jerden
source: Its blade and shield are both made of durable ice. If either becomes chipped by a heavy impact, POKENAME will freeze moisture in the air to repair it.

entry: POKENAME吼叫时，鬃毛覆满尖冰柱，是释放毁灭性电击的绝佳导体。视力极佳，即使恐怖暴风雪中也能看清。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME roars, its mane becomes covered with sharp icicles, which act as perfect conductors for unleashing devastating electric attacks. Its perfect vision allows it to see clearly even in terrifying blizzards.

entry: POKENAME见于北极湖泊底部。闪耀的鳞片让人联想到极光。
author: raydrago
source: POKENAME can be found at the bottom of arctic lakes. Its glimmering scales are reminiscent of an aurora.

entry: 它能冻住触须上的毛，化作利器，无论战斗或吓退来犯者都适用。散出的空气清凉而舒缓，但持续接触不满一小时，就会造成冻伤。
author: infinex21
source: It can freeze the fur of its feelers to use them as sharp weapons, be it during battle or to deter would-be threats. It emits a cooling and calming air that will cause frostbite within less than an hour of consistent exposure.

entry: POKENAME身体覆盖构造复杂的冰甲片，尾巴上的甲尤其厚实，既能打击敌人，也能掘过积雪。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is complexly covered by plates of icy armor. This armor is particularly thick on its tail, which POKENAME uses to both strike foes and burrow through snow.

entry: POKENAME住在大气高处，以风暴云为家。身体冷得使居住的云层降温，制造猛烈暴风雪。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live high up in the atmosphere and make their homes amongst storm clouds. Their bodies are so cold that they cause the clouds they live in to drop in temperature, creating harsh blizzards.

entry: POKENAME住在大气高处，以风暴云为家。身体冷得使居住的云层降温，制造猛烈暴风雪。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live high up in the atmosphere and make their homes amongst storm clouds. Their bodies are so cold that they cause the clouds they live in to drop in temperature, creating harsh blizzards.

entry: POKENAME作战时造出传送门，唤来猛烈暴风雪，以雪和冰雹轰击敌人。冰的分析显示，降雪来自世界各地，甚至可能来自深空遥远的冰冻星球。
author: sk372
source: To combat opponents, POKENAME creates portals that summon heavy blizzards to pelt foes with snow and hail. Analysis of ice shows the origin of the snowfall comes from all over the world, and possibly even distant icy planets in deep space.

entry: POKENAME吸收周围热量，让体内气体保持比空气轻。若飞过云层，下方地面便会开始落雪。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME keep the gas inside their bodies lighter than air by taking in heat from their surroundings. If POKENAME fly through a cloud, snow will begin to fall on the ground below.

entry: POKENAME在苔原冰面嬉戏，靠细密皮毛锁住舒适温度。若北极风暴太冷，就会聚成大群，紧紧挤在一起。
author: ghostslythe
source: Found frolicking on tundra ice, POKENAME depends on its fine fur to lock in comfortable temperatures. If an Arctic storm grows too cold, they huddle together in a giant herd.

entry: POKENAME把体内热量排出，保持内部寒冷。训练家可当冰箱使用，但一旦战斗，开门时食物饮料可能掉出，也可能被喷出的冷气冻得结实。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME expels heat from inside its body, keeping its inside cold. While Trainers can use it like a refrigerator, if POKENAME engages in combat food and drink may fall out when its doors open, or be frozen solid by the icy air it expels.

entry: POKENAME翱翔冰山上空，寒冷气温让翅上结起小冰雹。每次拍翼都掀起一阵冰寒之风。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME soars above icy mountains, where the cold temperatures cause small hailstones to form on its wings. Each flap of its wings creates a gust of freezing-cold wind.

entry: POKENAME走往寒冷北地，盼望结识新朋友。可伪装的材料不太耐寒，经常冻得不停发抖。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME treads up to cold northern regions in hopes of finding new friends. Unfortunately the materials of its disguise are not very cold-resistant; it is often seen shivering constantly due to the low temperatures.

entry: 它平时虽灼热，却能把整个身体冻住，使其硬化。冬天会分享体热，温暖其他冻得发抖的宝可梦。
author: st4rdustyugure
source: Even though this Pokémon is usually burning hot, it can completely freeze its body to harden it. During winter, it shares its body heat with other freezing Pokémon.

entry: 暴风雪中，POKENAME以蓬松尾巴裹住自己，留住体热。空气水分聚在冰冷外毛上，瞬间结成闪亮晶体，一甩尾就四散飞开。
author: ambrosia04
source: During blizzards, POKENAME wrap their bushy tails around themselves to trap body heat. As airborne moisture collects on the icy outer fur, it instantly freezes into sparkling crystals that scatter whenever they flick their tails.

entry: POKENAME受威胁时，会把毛冻成闪亮冰柱。反光刺眼，曾引发滑雪事故。
author: gbjockey
source: When POKENAME is threatened, it freezes its fur into sparkling icicles. The resulting glare has been known to cause ski accidents.

entry: POKENAME吸收周围空气的热量，令体内气体膨胀，从而上升。所到之处，都会洒下阵阵闪亮冰晶。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME absorbs heat from the air around it to expand the gas inside its body. This enables it to rise, and creates showers of glistening ice crystals wherever it travels.

entry: POKENAME耐寒，若需额外保护，还能把外膜冻硬。它极难寻见，能操控空气中的水分，化为遮掩视线的降雪。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is able to resist cold temperatures, but if it needs extra protection, it can freeze its outer membrane solid. Incredibly elusive; it can control the water in the air to turn it into an obscuring snowfall.

entry: 在野外遇到POKENAME，最好别打扰。否则，这个冰冷孤僻的家伙就会将尖锐冰锥指向你。
author: ladan
source: If you find a POKENAME in the wild, it's best to leave it be, or this cold introvert will point sharp icicles in your direction.

entry: POKENAME以敏锐感官小心接近猎物。先从远处射出冰片，再退入雪中，不留一个脚印。
author: spkypirate
source: POKENAME use their keen senses to cautiously approach prey. They strike from afar with shards of ice, then retreat into the snow, leaving no footprints behind.

entry: POKENAME钻进雪堆躲避捕食者。它会突然跳出吓对方一跳，随即迅速逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows into snow mounds to hide from predators. It surprises them by hopping out before quickly escaping.

entry: 皮毛能抵挡最严酷的天气，因此POKENAME常见于冰暴之中。在冰雹中行进的速度，多数常见宝可梦都望尘莫及。
author: darxer_
source: Its fur protects it from the strongest of elements, so POKENAME are often found in ice storms. Its speed in hail is unmatched by most common Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME身体极冷，若想吃身上长出的灌木，反会感到灼痛。月夜里身体发光，四处投出仿佛分形图案的光影。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's body is so cold that trying to eat one of the shrubs growing from its body will result in a burning sensation. During moonlit nights, its body glows and fractal-esque lights project here and there.

entry: 若有孩子迷失暴风雪，POKENAME就能感知。它赶到孩子身边，将其引往最近温暖而安全的地方。
author: sk372
source: If a child has become lost within a snowstorm, POKENAME will sense it. It rushes to the child's side and draws them to the closest place where warmth and safety can be found.

entry: POKENAME身体摸起来冰冷，移动时留下一路黏霜。放在患处，还能舒缓疼痛、减轻肿胀。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's body is cold to the touch, and it leaves sticky trails of frost as it moves. POKENAME can also be used to soothe aches and reduce swelling by placing it on the affected areas.

entry: POKENAME体外会生出冰冷黏液，积多了便像雪。它拿这些黏滑雪球自卫，掷向攻击者，溅满对方全身，阻碍行动。
author: sk372
source: A cold mucus forms over POKENAME's body, looking similar to snow when it accumulates. These slimy snowballs are used by POKENAME to defend itself, tossed at attackers to splatter all over them and impede their movements.

entry: POKENAME原产冰封山巅，花粉形如雪花。吃下后，训练家或宝可梦会先麻木，再昏倒。它对伤害感到过意不去，便喂受影响者解毒花蜜。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME is native to frozen mountain peaks, and its pollen appears as snowflakes. When this pollen is ingested, it makes Trainers or Pokémon feel numb before they faint. Feeling bad about the injury, it feeds the affected its antidote nectar.

entry: POKENAME先翻土找菌类，再向蘑菇吹出寒风。一定要彻底冻住，才肯吃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME roots around for fungi in the dirt before breathing a chilling breeze of air over the mushrooms. It refuses to eat the fungus until it is completely frozen over.

entry: POKENAME一吹口哨，周围空气便开始冻结。它开心时就会吹，因此最好别逗得太高兴。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME whistles, the surrounding air begins to freeze. As it whistles when happy, it's best not to make it too cheerful.

entry: POKENAME见到吓人的对手，就将毛冻成冰针般的尖刺，随后不顾自身安危，鲁莽冲上前。
author: mepp.
source: When POKENAME spots an intimidating opponent, it freezes its fur to make its hairs sharp like icy needles. It then recklessly charges in with no regard for its own safety.

entry: POKENAME偏爱雅乐等传统音乐，给年迈或退休训练家带来慰藉。能暂时冻结特定声带，发出独特声音。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME has served as a comfort to older and retired Trainers as it favors traditional music such as gagaku. It can temporarily freeze specifical vocal cords in order to create unique sounds.

entry: 某些节庆期间，POKENAME会唱许多颂歌与赞美诗，激起欢欣喜悦。对许多长者而言，这些老歌也将怀旧之情传给了孩子。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sing many carols and hymns during certain festivals to inspire feelings of merriment and joy. For many elders, nostalgia is passed down to children through these old songs.

entry: POKENAME孢子长成的蘑菇，能在极寒、强风，以及潮湿或干燥天气里存活。但温度一旦太高，也很容易死去。
author: bobosmith01
source: The mushrooms that grow from the spores of POKENAME can survive in extreme cold, winds, and both wet and dry weather. However, the mushrooms also easily perish if the temperature grows too hot.

entry: POKENAME厚实冰冷的鳞片，脱落后仍会持续散寒。过去，人们曾拿来保鲜食物。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME's thick, cold scales continue to let off a chill after they're shed. In the past, humans used them to keep food fresh.

entry: POKENAME将晨露冻成心形冰，吸引猎物。等对方靠近，便挥爪出击，瞬间冻住，再吃下去。
author: agostostino
source: POKENAME freezes morning dew to create heart-shaped ice that draws in prey. Once the prey is at close range, POKENAME strikes out with its claws, freezing them instantly before eating them.

entry: POKENAME飞过时，身后拖着长长的雪花尾迹，飘落地面，将下方的一切裹上一层白雪。
author: chorb33
source: As it flies, POKENAME leaves a long trail of snowflakes behind it, which fall to the ground and cover everything below it in a blanket of snow.

entry: POKENAME始终冻结的皮毛是受欢迎的点心，味道像蓝莓。不过，只有熟悉它的训练家，才能取下足够食用的毛，而不被冻得结实。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's perpetually frozen fur is a popular treat, with a flavor similar to blueberries. However, only a Trainer familiar with POKENAME can remove enough fur to eat without getting frozen solid.

entry: POKENAME为冰添上甜味，用于甜点饮品。世界各地的调酒师与咖啡师都靠它帮忙，让顾客惊艳。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME infuses its ice with sweet flavors, which are used in dessert drinks. Bartenders and baristas around the world rely on its help to amaze customers.

entry: POKENAME虽原产寒地，却常住在城市的自动售货机和冷库附近。垂毛最长、最冰冷的个体担任首领，偶尔将毛提起，彰显地位。
author: beatdoof
source: Though native to the cold regions, POKENAME often live in cities near vending machines and cold storage. Their leader is the one with the coldest and longest saggy fur, pulling it up on occasion to show dominance.

entry: POKENAME将宽松皮肤拉过头顶，以霜冻硬化、刀枪难入的身体抵挡攻击，保护团伙。有饮料公司曾试图强行捕获，图的正是其冰冷身体。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME pull up their baggy skin over their heads and guard against attacks with their impervious frost-hardened bodies to defend their gang. Beverage corporations have been known to attempt to forcibly capture them for their freezing-cold bodies.

entry: POKENAME飞过时，身后拖着长长的雪花尾迹，飘落地面，将下方的一切裹上一层白雪。
author: chorb33
source: As it flies, POKENAME leaves a long trail of snowflakes behind it, which fall to the ground and cover everything below it in a blanket of snow.

entry: POKENAME步履轻盈，走过雪地既不下陷，也不留脚印。冰爪极其锋利，常让猎物无路可逃。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its step is so light that POKENAME can walk across snow without sinking or leaving any footprints behind. Its icy claws are incredibly sharp and often give its prey no chance to escape.

entry: 有人接近时，POKENAME会坚守领地，冻结周围空气。嗅觉出众，因此警方会在极寒环境用它追踪罪犯。
author: krivaswell
source: POKENAME will stand and protect its territory when approached, freezing the atmosphere around it. Police use this Pokémon in extremely cold environments to track down criminals because of its exceptional sense of smell.

entry: POKENAME的鬃毛华美耀眼，像永远燃烧的火焰，让收藏家十分追捧。可谁若虐待、轻慢它，就会被活活冻住，永远封在冰里。
author: beatdoof
source: Because of its magnificent and dazzling mane, akin to an eternally blazing flame, POKENAME is quite popular among Pokémon collectors. Those who treat it with abuse and disrespect, however, will be frozen alive, eternally encased in ice.

entry: 为保持寒冷，POKENAME拍动冰翼，掀起小阵霜风。若翼上冰层裂开，就在身周制造巨大暴风雪，直到重新冻结、修复翅膀。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: In order to keep themselves cold, POKENAME flap their icy wings to create small gusts of frosty wind. If the ice along their wings ever cracks, they will create a huge snowstorm around themselves until they freeze back over to reconstruct them.

entry: POKENAME是久经磨炼的斗士，在冰原训练多年。比身体更出众的是坚定心志，似乎无论何时都冷静、不动摇。
author: ocxin
source: POKENAME are tempered fighters who spend many years training in icy lands. Even more impressive than their bodies are their resolute minds that seem cool-headed and unshakable in all situations.

entry: POKENAME漂在北极水域，伪装小冰块。一碰双触手便立即冻伤，伤口也极易感染它体表的细菌。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME floats in arctic waters, mimicking small ice chunks. Contact with its twin tentacles causes instant frostbite, which can easily become infected with bacteria on its body.

entry: POKENAME能以冰蹄冻结水面，直接奔过河湖。鬃毛稍一接触就会冻伤，靠近时必须极其小心。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can gallop straight across lakes and rivers, freezing the water's surface with its icy hooves. Its mane causes frostbite at the slightest contact, so it must be approached with extreme caution.

entry: POKENAME能以冰蹄冻结水面，直接奔过河湖。鬃毛稍一接触就会冻伤，靠近时必须极其小心。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can gallop straight across lakes and rivers, freezing the water's surface with its icy hooves. Its mane causes frostbite at the slightest contact, so it must be approached with extreme caution.

entry: POKENAME过去曾在雪道拉车运货，如今在森林野外繁盛生活。它能奔过河湖，以冰蹄冻住脚下水面。
author: fiordaliso
source: Once used to pull carts and goods along snowy trails, POKENAME now thrives wild in forests. It can gallop across lakes and rivers, freezing the water beneath its icy hooves.

entry: POKENAME以冰片攻击敌人，使其寒冷入骨。常住高山，凭敏捷身手轻松穿行险地。触碰它的角可能造成冻伤，痛感如烧伤。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME attack foes with shards of ice, chilling them to the bone. POKENAME often live on high mountains, traversing the difficult terrain with ease thanks to their agility. Touching their horn can lead to frostbite wounds that feel like burns.

entry: POKENAME冰爪带着危险毒素，会使受害者体温大降。即使治疗后，毒性也会残留多年，偶尔引起阵阵刺骨寒冷。
author: fancyskunk
source: POKENAME's icy claws impart a dangerous poison that drops a victim's body temperature significantly. Even after treatment, this poison lingers for years, causing occasional bouts of intense freezing cold.

entry: POKENAME满身尖刺，能迅速穿过积雪。为抵御攻击，会叠上更多冰层，使刺更长。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's spiky body enables it to quickly move through the snow. To protect itself from attack, it builds up additional layers of ice to make these spikes longer.

entry: POKENAME满身尖刺，能迅速穿过积雪。为抵御攻击，会叠上更多冰层，使刺更长。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's spiky body enables it to quickly move through the snow. To protect itself from attack, it builds up additional layers of ice to make these spikes longer.

entry: POKENAME催眠其他宝可梦，在其脑中编织霜雪之梦。梦从轻柔风雪开始，却会越来越冷，直到对方冻得发抖醒来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hypnotize other Pokémon to weave in dreams of frost into their minds. The frosty dreams start with a gentle snowstorm but the dreams become so cold that they wake up shivering.

entry: POKENAME三至五只成群，由最年长者带领。先在口中蓄起冰冷的镇静液体，再喷向敌人，方便年轻同伴轻松压制目标。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME live in groups of three to five individuals where the oldest leads. They build up a chilly, tranquilizing liquid in their mouth before spraying it at foes, allowing their younger brethren to easily overwhelm the target.

entry: POKENAME心情好时，种子会散发青草般的甜香。常能看见它们在日光下酣睡，沐浴阳光，补充养分。
author: mistymagius
source: Its bulb gives off the sweet scent of fresh grass when POKENAME is happy. They can be seen sleeping in the sun, absorbing light as nutrients.

entry: POKENAME接连使出复杂的翻身踢，压制对手、击打弱点。将披风般的翅膀展开以保持平衡，让尾巴能充分活动，送上最后一击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME perform a series of complicated flipping kicks to overwhelm their opponents and strike in their weak spots. They keep themselves balanced by flaring out their cape-like wings, allowing their tails full range of motion for a final blow.

entry: POKENAME紧握橡胶般的双钳，接连快拳消磨猎物。等对方晕头转向，便张开双钳，将其拖入夜色。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME clasp their rubbery claws tightly to deliver a quick series of punches and wear down prey. Once the prey is disoriented, POKENAME open up their claws and drag them away into the night.

entry: POKENAME常挤在树上寻求保护。夜里，发亮的眼睛与嘁嘁喳喳声，能吓走林中露营者。
author: mega_beedrill
source: POKENAME are known to huddle in trees for protection. At night, their eyes gleam and their chattering can scare off campers in the woods.

entry: 据说，这只吸血宝可梦是古代DNA拼接的产物，不过只是传闻。它被视为最凶恶的宝可梦种类之一。
author: kiwiarms
source: It is said that this blood-sucking Pokémon was supposedly the result of ancient DNA splicing, but this is just a rumor. It is considered one of the most vicious Pokémon species.

entry: POKENAME绕着猎物盘旋时飞得笨拙，经常撞上地面。巨大食欲迫使它饮用血以外的液体充饥，连毒物也会喝。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME flies clumsily and crashes into the ground very often as it circles its prey. Its immense hunger forces it to drink other liquids that aren't blood to satisfy itself, including consuming toxins.

entry: POKENAME是贪食的食腐者，几乎什么都能吃。有些甚至偏爱足以让多数其他宝可梦中毒的腐败食物。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is a ravenous scavenger, capable of eating almost anything. Some POKENAME even prefer to eat spoiled food that would poison most other Pokémon.

entry: 翅膀比起飞行，更适合威吓。它们藏在洞穴或沙中，扑出缠住猎物，再吸干血液。
author: infinex21
source: Their wings serve better for intimidation than for flight. They hide within caves or sand and pounce to wrap around prey before draining them of their blood.

entry: 翅膀能宽宽展开，兜住风升往高空。它俯冲攻击敌人与猎物，以利爪和沉重身体一同碾压。
author: infinex21
source: Its wings can unfurl wide to catch and ride winds high into the air. It dives upon foes and prey, crushing them with their claws and their heavy bodies alike.

entry: 人们认为，因科学家插手，POKENAME能活数千年，代价却是失去大半精神力量。若被阳光直射，这些能力还会更弱。
author: bradlybro199
source: Due to the meddling of scientists it is believed that POKENAME can live for thousands of years. This did come at the expense of much of their psychic power and those abilities are even more weakened if exposed to direct sunlight.

entry: 阳光照到POKENAME时，肤色会从紫变灰。精神能力立刻全数丧失，只能完全依赖物理攻击。
author: bradlybro199
source: When exposed to sunlight POKENAME's complexion changes from purple to gray. They immediately lose all access to their psychic abilities, leaving them completely reliant on physical attacks.

entry: POKENAME用钳子剪下树果和其他水果，乐意分给遇到的饥饿宝可梦。看着对方进食，自己也心满意足。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its pincers to snip berries and other fruit from trees. It happily shares this food with any hungry Pokémon it encounters, watching with contentment as they eat.

entry: POKENAME以有地下湖的洞穴为家，挂在洞顶安静沉睡。只要有东西靠近下方水面，就凭沉重体重砸下，捕食对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes its home in caverns containing underground lakes. It clings to the ceiling, slumbering quietly until something approaches the water beneath it, whereupon it crashes down with its heavy weight to prey on them.

entry: POKENAME身体修长柔韧，捕猎时能轻松钻过树洞。从上方伏击，用翼裹住猎物，再精准咬下，使其麻痹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's long, flexible body allows it to slip effortlessly through tree hollows while hunting. It ambushes prey from above, wrapping them in its wings before delivering a precise, paralyzing bite.

entry: POKENAME嗅出空气中的有毒化合物，判断猎物是否带毒。选好目标后，就将尖牙刺入，带回洞穴巢居吞食。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME determine whether prey is poisonous by smelling the air for poisonous chemical compounds. Once they have selected a suitable target, they sink their fangs into their prey and carry them back to their cavernous den to be consumed.

entry: 它胆怯而难觅，一见人就藏起。训练家少数能引它出来的方法，是拿出金色蔓莓果；它会盯得够久，足以让人投出精灵球。
author: quackquackattack
source: It is known for its skittish and elusive nature, hiding the moment it sees a person. One of the few ways Trainers coax it out of hiding is by offering a Golden Razz Berry, which it stares at long enough for a Pokéball to be thrown.

entry: POKENAME俯冲而下，用可伸长舌头末端的小尖刺注毒。头顶卷毛的大小，能看出注入的毒有多猛烈、多致命。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME swoops down and delivers poison via a tiny point at the end of its extendable tongue. The size of the curl of hair on its head is an indicator of how virulent and deadly the poison delivered will be.

entry: POKENAME俯冲咬麻猎物，以便安心吸血。必须选无风之夜捕猎，因为稍有微风，就会把轻盈身体吹离航向。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME seeks to dive onto prey to deliver paralyzing bites so it can drink their blood freely. It must hunt during still nights, as even the slightest bit of wind will send its lightweight body flying off course.

entry: 探洞者有与POKENAME交朋友的传统，因为它能指出安全通道。穿行洞穴时，它挂在探洞者上方，若有人失手，便让对方抓住尾巴。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Cavers have a tradition of befriending POKENAME as they indicate to them which passages are safe. They hang above the cavers as they traverse the cave system and allow them to grab onto their tail if they lose their grip.

entry: 探洞者有与POKENAME交朋友的传统，因为它能指出安全通道。穿行洞穴时，它挂在探洞者上方，若有人失手，便俯冲用钳子抓住。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Cavers have a tradition of befriending POKENAME as they indicate to them which passages are safe. They hang above the cavers as they traverse the cave system and swoop down and grab them with their pincers if they lose their grip.

entry: 它坐在急流中，凭宽大翼幅与敏捷双钳抓住猎物，再吸干血液。POKENAME肚子越亮，表示吃得越饱。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It sits in rushing water, using its large wingspan and quick pincers to grab its prey before draining its blood. The brighter POKENAME's belly, the better fed it is.

entry: POKENAME若吃下有毒东西，就会立刻睡着。休息时身体通过脚爪排毒，因此不会受伤。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME eats something toxic, it falls asleep instantly. Its body purges the toxins through its talons while it rests, leaving it unharmed.

entry: 许多POKENAME用大耳偷听人类谈话，再以心灵感应将听来的话植入脑中，吓走旅人。
author: .izik
source: Many POKENAME eavesdrop on human conversations using their large ears. They then implant phrases telepathically to frighten travelers away.

entry: 它以双人组的形式演喜剧，用尾巴扮演“吐槽役”。POKENAME借心灵感应，让尾巴看起来也会说话。
author: cait_sith
source: It puts on comedy acts as a duo, using its tail to act as the "straight man". POKENAME uses telepathy to make it seem like the tail can speak.

entry: 芽甘蓝镇有家小餐馆，把POKENAME的钳煮熟切丁，加入鹰嘴豆泥。搭配芽菜，这份有嚼劲的配料便成了当地美食。
author: .izik
source: A diner in Brussel Town serves hummus featuring diced, boiled POKENAME claws. Paired with sprouts, this chewy addition is a local delicacy.

entry: POKENAME在地下深处凿出大洞休息，把尾巴固定在坚石上，身体垂入地道。若不慎坠落，就迅速蜷曲转身，稳住自己。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME carve out large caverns deep into the ground in order to rest, securing their tails to a solid rock and letting their bodies hang down into their tunnels. If they happen to fall, they rapidly curl and turn their bodies to catch themselves.

entry: 它滑过树顶，寻找无人看守的蛋或脆弱的幼年宝可梦。无法自行起飞，因此须先爬上崖壁，取得滑翔所需高度。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It glides above the treetops to scan for unguarded eggs or vulnerable baby Pokémon. It cannot get liftoff on its own, so it scales cliffsides to gain altitude for its flight.

entry: POKENAME全身覆毒，夜里遇上较冷空气，就泛出深紫光。它朝附近的鸟宝可梦吐毒团，仔细追踪落点，留待之后饱餐。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's poison-covered body glows a deep violet at night in reaction to the cooler air. It spits globs of toxin at nearby bird Pokémon, carefully tracking where they land so it can feast later.

entry: POKENAME是沙漠食腐者，长颈长喙能取得其他宝可梦够不着的食物。发现可能的餐点后，便节省体力，大圈滑翔，等时机一到就俯冲抢食。
author: jadey.1557
source: POKENAME are desert scavengers that use their long neck and beak to access food other Pokémon can't reach. When they spot a potential meal, they will conserve energy by gliding in wide circles until an opportunity presents itself to swoop in.

entry: POKENAME虽无法真正飞行，却能从高崖滑下伏击。毒刺中的毒液引发猛烈灼痛，让受害者痛得翻滚。
author: fancyskunk
source: While unable to truly fly, POKENAME can utilize its wings to glide down from high cliffsides in ambush. The venom from its stinger causes an intense burning sensation, leaving the victim in writhing agony.

entry: POKENAME蜷成球等猎物。感到对方靠近，就追上并展开身体，从长鼻喷出毒雾，削弱对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME curls into a ball while waiting for prey. Once it senses their approach, it chases them down and uncurls, spreading out a poison mist from its trunk to debilitate them.

entry: 线球镇会把POKENAME的毒刺碾碎，用作蘸酱调味。这道独特开胃小食深受当地人喜爱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's stinger is crushed and used as a seasoning for dips in Catallia City. This unique appetizer is a favorite among locals.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时以头尖倒立保持平衡，翅膀裹身保暖自卫。战斗时以尖尾为轴旋转，飘动翅膀引导出优雅而有力的攻击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME balance on the point of their heads while they sleep, wrapping their wings around their body for warmth and protection. In battle, they spin on their pointed tails to perform elegant yet powerful strikes, directed by their flowing wings.

entry: POKENAME将翅膀裹住身体，先快速爬行，再跃向空中，滑翔扑向目标。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME will wrap their wings around themselves to slither faster before launching into the air and gliding to their target.

entry: 哥特式城堡墙上能找到这只宝可梦的石像。有人相信石像夜里会活过来，但从未记录到任何证据。
author: milchik
source: Stone statues of this Pokémon can be found on the walls of gothic castles. Some people believe that these statues come to life at night, but no evidence of such phenomenon has ever been registered.

entry: POKENAME在沙暴中伏击，用钳子抓住目标，再刺入尖牙吸血。外皮厚得根本不怕挣扎的敌人反击。
author: .jerden
source: Ambushing prey during sandstorms, POKENAME seizes its target in its pincers, then sinks its fangs in to drink blood. Its hide is so thick that it doesn't worry about any attacks the struggling foe may make.

entry: POKENAME的巨翼制造猛烈气流，让它即使穿过飓风与海上狂风，也能无休止地滑翔。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME's massive wings generate violent air currents, allowing it to glide endlessly even through hurricanes and sea gales.

entry: POKENAME飘过夜色，以缓慢而迷人的节奏开合双钳。战斗时如指挥合唱团般挥钳，迅速连连夹响，将能量凝入攻击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME drift through the night, snapping their claws in a slow but enchanting rhythm. In battle, they wave their claws as if directing a choir, snapping them in rapid succession as they focus their energy into attacks.

entry: POKENAME停在银行外，白天大大方方藏身，观察安保系统的运作。夜里指挥成群手下，取走金库里一切闪亮东西。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME perch on the exterior of banks, hiding in plain sight during the day and observing the mechanics of the security systems. At night, they command flocks of minions to retrieve anything shiny from within the vaults.

entry: POKENAME有节奏地敲响大钳威吓旁人。偶尔却被自己的节奏带动，开始跳舞，威慑力顿时大减。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME clacks its large claws rhythmically to intimidate others. On occasion it gets drawn into the rhythm it creates and begins dancing to its own beat, considerably lessening its intimidation factor.

entry: POKENAME飞行时散出古怪而几乎听不见的嗡鸣。尾巴射出的闪电既能震昏生物，也能严重干扰被击中的机械。
author: sk372
source: An odd, barely-perceptible hum emanates from POKENAME as it flies around. The lightning it fires from its tail can stun living creatures as well as greatly disrupt any machinery it strikes.

entry: POKENAME指挥周身的蝙蝠状暗影，让自己融入夜色。咬开树果吸汁后，萃取的养分还能经尾巴注入伤者体内，治愈人类与宝可梦。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME command swarms of bat-shaped shadows that surround their bodies to help them blend into the night. They bite into berries to drink from them, extracting nutrients that can be injected with their tails to help heal people or Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME无声滑过黑海面，在往来船只上寻找食物。清晨退入阴暗海边洞穴休息。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides silently over dark seas, searching for food aboard traveling vessels. By morning, it retreats to shadowy seaside caves to rest.

entry: POKENAME无声滑过夜空，先以翅裹身，高速坠落，再展开双翼，朝四面八方攻击。尾刺能刺穿并带起整棵树。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Gliding silently through the night, POKENAME wrap their wings around themselves to plummet at high speeds before extending them and striking in all directions. They can pierce and carry entire trees with the stingers on their tails.

entry: POKENAME是顶级捕食者，会剪掉其他飞行属性宝可梦的翼羽，直到猎物不能飞。这些伺机而动的猎手倒挂树枝，伏击猎物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are apex predators that take out other Flying-type Pokémon by clipping feathers off wings until their prey cannot fly. These opportunistic hunters hang upside-down from tree branches to ambush their prey.

entry: POKENAME用尾刺攻击电脑病毒。注入的毒液满是代码，从病毒根源发起攻击，自底层摧毁程序。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME attacks viruses by stinging them with its tail. The venom it dispenses is filled with coding that attacks the virus at its roots, destroying the program from its base.

entry: POKENAME的角能捕捉猎物情绪。比起别的，它更爱取食快乐人群的情绪。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME's horns capture the emotions of its prey. It prefers to feed off the emotions of cheerful people.

entry: POKENAME优雅无声地滑过夜空，无须振翼，仿佛有神秘力量托住。它拿走训练家的闪亮物品装饰巢穴，只有被抓个正着才会归还。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gracefully and silently glide through the night without needing to move their wings as if suspended by a mystical power. They collect shiny objects from Trainers to decorate their dens with, only returning them if they're caught.

entry: POKENAME爱在高高的夜空滑翔，也不断训练，磨炼使刃的技巧。
author: jona_hehe
source: POKENAME likes to glide high in the night sky. POKENAME trains to hone its skill with its blades.

entry: 它常在城市夜空翱翔，被形容为某种义警，帮助需要援手的人。
author: thegamerspheal
source: This Pokémon can be seen soaring the night sky in cities. It's described as some sort of vigilante, helping those in need.

entry: POKENAME停在树中，藏进深色翼膜，与周围融为一体。先以尾缠枝，再俯身取食，用翼兜起收获，重新躲好。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME perch within trees, blending into their surroundings by hiding within the dark membranes of their wings. They coil their tails around branches before diving for food, scooping up their haul in their wings and hiding away again.

entry: POKENAME是夜行宝可梦，流线型身体让动作极其敏捷。迎敌时常先用能抓握的尾巴攫住，再不断击打，直到获胜。
author: keiracm35_
source: POKENAME are nocturnal Pokémon that move with great agility thanks to their aerodynamic bodies. When they face an enemy, they often seize it with their prehensile tails and then strike it until they win the battle.

entry: POKENAME是凶猛野兽，与同类结群捕猎。尾毒有催眠效果，被蜇的宝可梦都会服从它们，最终却会被族群吃掉。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is a vicious beast that hunts in packs alongside others of its kind. Their tail's venom has a hypnotic effect, making any Pokémon they sting obedient to them. Eventually, the hypnotized Pokémon is eaten by the pack.

entry: 河原家镇有家著名餐厅，将韭葱、柑橘皮屑与混合香料填进POKENAME的钳。这道精致佳肴深受美食鉴赏家喜爱。
author: .izik
source: A prestigious restaurant in Majolica Town serves POKENAME claws stuffed with leeks, citrus zest, and a blend of spices. This gourmet delicacy is a favorite among food connoisseurs.

entry: POKENAME在长满苔藓的洞穴中狩猎。猎物靠近时，它会伸长灵活的脖子，从对方视线的死角出击，再用多根毒刺刺入猎物。
author: ayner
source: POKENAME hunt in mossy caves. When their prey is near, they extend their flexible neck to hit their blind spot, and stab them with their multiple stingers.

entry: POKENAME以尾刺地，探测将至的地震。危险临近时，就发出尖啸提醒旁人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME skewers the ground with its tail to detect impending earthquakes. It lets out a shrieking warning to alert others when danger is near.

entry: POKENAME发光的黄眼能吓退墓地盗墓者。它静静停在陵墓上，守卫着不让闯入。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's glowing yellow eye deters graverobbers in cemeteries. It perches silently on mausoleums, guarding them against intruders.

entry: POKENAME用钳子收集灵魂，带往冥界。民间故事说，人寿数将尽时，它便会走近，以尾一击，再将人举入口中送走。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME collect souls in their claws to carry away to the underworld. Folktales speak of a POKENAME approaching people when their time is up, delivering a single strike with its tail before lifting them into its mouth and sending them away.

entry: 古书记载，POKENAME曾在战时保护镇民。它制服交战双方的士兵，守护无辜者。
author: .izik
source: Old tomes recount POKENAME protecting townsfolk during wartime. It neutralized soldiers from both sides to safeguard innocents.

entry: POKENAME滑过黑夜，四处求战。它们先用盾牌般坚实的爪挡住攻击，再一击制胜，随着披风飘动，隐去身影。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME glide through the night in search of duels. They use their sturdy shield-like claws to block attacks before delivering decisive blows, disappearing with the flutter of their capes.

entry: POKENAME是危险的夜间猎手。惊人反应、夜视与一段时间内无声滑翔的本领，让单只就已可怕；更有数只组成的群体存在。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a dangerous predator of the night. Incredible reflexes, night vision, and the ability to glide silently for periods of time make it fearsome on its own; packs consisting of several of them exist.

entry: 若没有强风可借来起飞，POKENAME就会暴怒。此时会急忙用长尾捆住一只宝可梦，逼其使出强风招式，否则就当下一餐。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME becomes enraged if there are no strong winds for it to catch on to and take off with. When this happens, it hastily binds a Pokémon with its long tail and forces them to either use a strong wind move or become its next meal.

entry: 这只狡猾宝可梦，喜欢密林等幽暗地方，很会隐匿身影。巨爪配上锋锐翼刃，再以眼花缭乱的速度与凶猛劲势，制服猎物。
author: elfail0
source: Preferring to live in dark places like dense forests and jungles, this sly Pokémon is well adapted to hiding in shadows. It combines its large claws and razor sharp wing blades with blinding ferocity and speed to subdue prey.

entry: POKENAME在城市捕猎，用锋利金属钳攀附建筑外墙。一旦清楚看见另一只宝可梦，就以臂炮强力轰击，将其击倒。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME hunts for prey in urban environments, using its sharp metal claw to cling to the side of buildings. As soon as it has a clear line of sight to another Pokémon, POKENAME shoots it down with a powerful blast from the cannon on its arm.

entry: POKENAME勇敢忠诚，同伴一有需要，便从翻飞的玫瑰花瓣中现身。跃入战阵时，还会沿途撒刺，击退对手，布置战场。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are valiant and loyal, appearing out of a flurry of rose petals when their allies are in need. They leap into battle while scattering thorns below them, repelling opponents and setting the stage for their fight.

entry: POKENAME以尾支撑身体直立，受袭时便借尾巴弹上高空，随后俯冲回敌人身边，迅速反击。
author: santon5512
source: Balancing upright on their tails, POKENAME use them to spring themselves high into the sky when attacked. They then dive back at their enemy, swiftly delivering a counterattack.

entry: POKENAME将带电双钳刺入设备，吸取电力。谁若打扰进餐，就张钳放出一连串鲜红火花。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME stab their electrical claws into devices to siphon off electricity. If anyone tries to interrupt their meals, they will open their claws and release a series of bright red sparks.

entry: POKENAME在满月下滑翔，有节奏地敲响双钳。睡前故事讲，它会用钳子接住坠落流星，再送回太空。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME glide beneath the light of full moons, clacking their claws together in rhythmic patterns. Bedtime stories tell of POKENAME catching falling stars in their claws before flying them back into space.

entry: POKENAME藏在沼泽浅水里，咬向毫无戒心的猎物。也会从下方撞破木桥，伏击旅人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides in marshy shallows, snapping at unsuspecting prey. It ambushes travelers by breaking through wooden bridges from below.

entry: 据说，POKENAME出没于古代吸血鬼的破败城堡，装成棺材，吸干不受欢迎的入侵者的生命。
author: spicybunbun
source: Legends speak of POKENAME haunting decayed castles said to belong to ancient vampires. Myths claim they disguise themselves as coffins and drain the lifeforce of unwelcome intruders.

entry: POKENAME先用尾巴虚晃刺击，再突然喷出内脏，给敌人一记意外重拳。内脏也能展开成大弧扇，兜风飞向空中。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME fakes out foes with a jab from its tail in order to land a surprise punch by ejecting its internal organs at them. By ejecting its internal organs out like a large curved fan, it can catch winds to allow flight into the sky.

entry: 它倒挂在废屋椽下，观察猎物，再扑向同样在屋中游荡的昆虫与虫宝可梦。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: It observes its prey while hanging from the rafters of abandoned buildings. It pounces on insects and Bug-type Pokémon that also roam there.

entry: 两颗头合作捕猎，一颗能注毒，另一颗能吸血。但等到能分清哪颗是哪颗时，往往已太迟。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its two heads work together to take down prey. Only one head can inject venom, and the other head can suck blood from its victim. Its impossible to tell which head is which until it is too late.

entry: 融合似乎让三首恶龙的基因将天蝎王的尾巴分成三条，每条都强健、善于抓握。尾端毒刺分别注入不同强毒，作用于猎物或敌人，效果都极不好受。
author: fireblade141
source: Fusion appears to have caused Hydreigon's genes to split Gliscor's tail into three, each of which is prehensile and robust. The stingers at the tips deliver distinct, potent venoms to prey or foes, each resulting in very unpleasant effects.

entry: POKENAME无声滑过夜空，以巨钳抓住猎物。尾刺注入的毒素攻击对方心智，抽走精神能量。
author: ambrosia04
source: Gliding silently through the night, POKENAME use their giant claws to grab prey. They inject a toxin with their stinger, attacking their victim's psyche and draining their mental energy.

entry: 古时，人们用POKENAME的脂肪做蜡烛，比传统蜡烛烧得更久。虽然耐烧，却散出强烈沼泽气味。
author: .izik
source: In ancient times, POKENAME's fat was used to craft candles that burned longer than traditional ones. Despite being long-lasting, they emitted a strong swampy odor.

entry: POKENAME以带爪的长臂攫取水面猎物。它耐心守在山区河口，袭击任何游得太近的东西。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its long, clawed arms to snatch prey from the water's surface. It patiently waits at river mouths in mountainous regions, striking anything that swims too close.

entry: POKENAME带着诡异尖啸飞过夜空，让下方的人心生恐惧。以虚弱宝可梦的生命能量为食，吸尽后便消失在黑暗里。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME soars through the night with an eerie screech, striking terror into the hearts of those below. It feeds on the life energy of weakened Pokémon, draining them before vanishing into the darkness.

entry: POKENAME受体型与形状所限，无法拍翼飞行，转而张翼调节体温、威吓对手。
author: carameldog
source: Due to its size and body shape, POKENAME cannot use its wings for flight. Instead, it extends them to regulate body heat and intimidate opponents.

entry: POKENAME受体型与形状所限，无法拍翼飞行，转而张翼调节体温、威吓对手。
author: carameldog
source: Due to its size and body shape, POKENAME cannot use its wings for flight. Instead, it extends them to regulate body heat and intimidate opponents.

entry: POKENAME住在凉爽洞穴，藏身阴影。它是捕食者，猎物一不小心靠近，就用尖牙出击，直接从对方灵魂吸取生命力。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME lives in cool caverns, hiding in the shadows. It is a predator Pokémon: once prey has carelessly drawn near, it strikes with its fangs and siphons life force directly from the victim's soul.

entry: 它藏在阴森森林，盘算恶毒把戏捉弄路人。可锋利双钳常把伪装所靠的树砍倒，只好频繁搬家。
author: hiimhdere
source: It hides in scary forests, scheming mean-spirited tricks to pull on passersby. Unfortunately, its sharp claws end up cutting down many of the trees it camouflages with, causing it to relocate often.

entry: POKENAME会两只一组，协同狩猎。一只用爪子抓住猎物，另一只则用带刺的尾巴猛砸。
author: yoshimon
source: POKENAME are pack hunters that work in twain. One will grab their prey with their claws, while the other bashes it with their barbed tail.

entry: 芝拿镇一家知名餐厅，将POKENAME的钳与蘑菇同炒，以浓郁鲜香闻名。
author: .izik
source: The claws of POKENAME are sautéed with mushrooms in a renowned Bluefinland restaurant. The dish is famous for its rich and savory flavor.

entry: POKENAME轻松穿行海空。猎物才看见巨大的阴影，便被裹住，注入毒素。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME effortlessly soars through both the skies and the sea. Prey only see its large shadow before they are enveloped and injected with toxins.

entry: POKENAME喜欢藏进最暗的水中，静静观察水流，寻找猎物靠近的动静。喝下的猎物血液，能提供它在冷水生存所需的温暖。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME like to hide in the darkest of waters to silently watch the water flow for any disturbances that signal prey is near. The blood it drinks from prey provides it with the warmth it needs to survive in cold waters.

entry: POKENAME的鬃毛是同类间力量与阅历的象征，越大便越受尊敬。常在无月夜飞行捕猎，用毒刺使猎物中毒。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME's mane is a symbol of strength and experience alongside its species: the bigger it is, the more respected POKENAME is. This Pokémon is often found flying during moonless nights, hunting for prey to poison with its stinger.

entry: POKENAME以创作朋克摇滚旋律闻名，能让任何听众振奋、受到鼓舞。但安静时，也能听见它轻轻哼唱甜美的交响乐。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME is renowned for creating punk rock melodies that can energize and inspire any listener. However, during quieter moments, it can be heard softly humming sweet symphonies.

entry: POKENAME以双钳和尾巴攀在树侧，啃食树皮。它从不试图藏身，身上许多亮斑就是给其他宝可梦的警告：孢子有毒。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses its claws and tail to cling to the side of trees, feeding on bark. POKENAME makes no attempt to hide, as its many bright spots serve as a warning to other Pokémon that its spores are poisonous.

entry: POKENAME是凶狠捕食者，夜幕降临便苏醒出猎。流线型身体让它悄然潜近，再以剃刀般尖牙咬住猎物，吸干血液。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is a vicious predator, awakening at nightfall to hunt. Its sleek form allows it to move stealthily before biting its prey with its razor-sharp fangs to drain their blood.

entry: POKENAME守在水下洞穴，耐心等毫无戒心的猎物经过。时机一到，就冲出来使出迎头一击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME sits inside underwater caves, patiently waiting until unsuspecting prey comes by. Once the moment arises, it comes out and performs a First Impression on them.

entry: POKENAME以巨钳攫住、撕扯对手，趁其无法动弹，反复以尾猛击。若开始落于下风，就紧急脱身，用收拢的翅膀飞走。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME will grip and rip apart opponents with its giant claws while taking advantage of their immobility by repeatedly bashing them with its tail. If it starts to lose a battle, it will take an emergency exit by using its furled wings to fly away.

entry: POKENAME通过杖引导精神力量，操控周围地面。哪怕最细微的振动也能立刻察觉，在对手出击前就先反攻。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME manipulate the ground around them by directing their psychic powers through their staffs. They can instantly detect the slightest vibrations, allowing them to counter-attack before their opponents can even strike.

entry: POKENAME将双钳插进地面，再迅速拔起，让场地充满尘土。借尘云掩护，筹划突袭敌人。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME is able to put its claws in the ground and quickly pull them out to fill the arena with dust. POKENAME uses the dust cloud to plan surprise attacks on foes.

entry: 据说POKENAME腹部的毒刺含有极猛烈的毒液。只要吃下一滴，就必定麻痹整整一个月。
author: turcai_87271
source: The stinger on POKENAME's abdomen is said to contain an extremely potent venom. If one drop is ingested, a month-long paralysis is sure to ensue.

entry: POKENAME借宽松披风滑翔于峡谷壁间。它凶狠守巢，以带倒刺的尾巴向闯入者施毒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its loose cape to glide between canyon walls. It guards its den fiercely, striking intruders with venom from its barbed tail.

entry: POKENAME能调暗眼睛，让自己混入洞穴钟乳石。但猎物一走近，就会直落地面，砰然大响，暴露位置。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can dim their eyes, allowing them to blend in with stalactites in caves. Despite this, they give their location away by dropping directly onto the floor with a loud crack whenever prey walks nearby.

entry: POKENAME在夜里造的黑宝石几乎看不见，让它能悄然攻击猎物。再用更锋利的宝石划出伤口，方便吸血。
author: soup1900
source: The black gems POKENAME creates in the night look almost invisible, allowing it to strike prey unnoticed. Sharper gems are then used to give access for POKENAME to drain the victim's blood.

entry: POKENAME凭空造出剧毒宝珠，以耀眼紫色弹雨射向敌人，使其严重中毒。额头长出的巨型剧毒宝珠，让敌人连稍稍靠近都不敢。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME forms Toxic Orbs out of thin air and launches them in a dazzling purple barrage at foes to severely poison them. The giant Toxic Orb that grows on POKENAME's forehead deters enemies from going remotely near it.

entry: POKENAME在海滩寻找新婚夫妇，用带爪的嘴轻咬他们。连海洋生物学家也不明白，它如何察觉婚姻。
author: .izik
source: At beaches, POKENAME seeks out newlyweds and nips them with its clawed mouth. How it's able to detect marriage is a mystery even to marine biologists.

entry: POKENAME战斗时喜欢戏弄对手，顽皮翻转，欢笑不止。但若目睹谁伤害伙伴，就会暴怒，挥尾猛攻对方。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME enjoy playing with their opponents during battle, mischievously flipping around and laughing with glee. However, if a POKENAME ever sees someone harm one of its companions, it will fly into a rage and furiously swing at them with its tail.

entry: POKENAME能借翅膀滑过宽逾10英里的巨大间隙。古代传说详细描述过它吸食人血的可怕事迹，因此让许多人畏惧。
author: soup1900
source: Using its wings, POKENAME can glide over large gaps spanning over 10 miles wide. It is feared by many due to ancient legends detailing horrific accounts of this species draining blood from humans.

entry: POKENAME能借翅膀滑过宽逾10英里的巨大间隙。古代传说详细描述过它吸食人血的可怕事迹，因此让许多人畏惧。
author: soup1900
source: Using its wings, POKENAME can glide over large gaps spanning over 10 miles wide. It is feared by many due to ancient legends detailing horrific accounts of this species draining blood from humans.

entry: POKENAME极其好胜，飞遍沙漠寻找强敌，展开全力激战。用巨钳钳住敌人，再以尾巴打出毁灭性重击，将其击败。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an extremely competitive Pokémon that flies across the desert in search of strong opponents to engage in all-out battles. It uses its huge pincers to immobilize its enemies, then finishes them with devastating strikes from its tail.

entry: POKENAME大多倒挂在洞中睡觉。超能力一感知有人靠近，便瞬间移动离开。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME spend most of their time sleeping upside-down inside caves. Using their psychic powers, they can detect anyone approaching and teleport away.

entry: POKENAME在明亮处很难看清，因此常闭着眼，靠超能力辨识方向。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME tend to have a hard time seeing in bright places, so they often prefer to keep their eyes closed and navigate using their psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME能找到优质矿物，制成勺子。借这些勺子，POKENAME便能以惊人速度挖出新洞穴。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are able to locate high-quality minerals in order to craft spoons. Using these spoons, POKENAME can carve out new caves at incredible speed.

entry: 强壮的双臂，让它即使正与其他宝可梦交战，也能以时速220公里轻松飞行。
author: prof.whitebeam
source: Due to its powerful arms, it can fly at 220 km/h without any problem while fighting against other Pokémon.

entry: 晴朗夜晚，POKENAME飞进果园大吃苹果。若被抓现行，就会摆姿势秀肌肉；成功拖住想捉它的人后，便以毒刺戳麻对方，飞走。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: On clear nights, POKENAME fly into orchards to devour apples; if caught, they will flex and pose their muscles. Should they successfully stall their would-be captor, they jab them with their stinger to immobilize them and fly away.

entry: POKENAME捕猎时在水中轻松滑行。出击便以毒触手无情猛攻。
author: wannaberecluse
source: POKENAME effortlessly glides through the water as it hunts. When it strikes, it attacks ruthlessly with its venomous tentacles.

entry: POKENAME高速奔跑后跃入空中，收起双腿，借积攒的冲力滑翔。人或宝可梦一被尾巴戳中，肾上腺素就会突然激增。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gallop at high speeds before jumping into the air and lifting their legs, letting themselves glide with their gathered momentum. Any person or Pokémon that's jabbed by a POKENAME's tail will experience a sudden burst of adrenaline.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴从湖中舀取额外水分，存进壳里。双手抓住对手，再调整壳中钳子，喷出强劲水流，将敌人轰走。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME scoop their tails through lakes to collect extra water and store it within their shells. They grab onto opponents with their hands while directing the claws in their shells to blast out powerful torrents of water and blow their foes away.

entry: POKENAME是凶猛夜猎者，以精神力量凝成的钳子固定猎物，吸取生命力。白天力量减弱，因此一见日出迹象，就放下将到嘴的食物逃走。
author: kungfucutbug
source: POKENAME are vicious predators at night, using their psychic claws to keep prey in place while they drain its life force. Their powers are weaker during the day, however, so at the first sign of sunrise they will drop their would-be meal and flee.

entry: 只要一直待在冰点以下，POKENAME就无法爆炸。冷到一定程度，点燃所用的导火索会冻结，看起来像巨大长牙。
author: bradlybro199
source: As long as they're kept in below freezing temperatures, POKENAME remain unable to explode. When cold enough, the fuses used to ignite them freeze over and resemble large tusks.

entry: 它们十分聪明，合作捕猎，总选皮毛浓厚、身体强韧的宝可梦。披上猎物毛皮制成的斗篷，再拿猎物的残块或骨头当武器。
author: infinex21
source: These clever Pokémon hunt together, always hunting other Pokémon that have very thick fur and tough bodies. They will clad themselves in fur cloaks and wield pieces, or bones, of their prey as weapons.

entry: POKENAME主要猎捕象牙猪，但也开始猎捕体形或长牙相似的其他宝可梦。它们从不过度捕猎，总以至少6只成群，用石头与骨头制作各种工具武器。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME mostly hunt Mamoswine, though they have begun to hunt other Pokémon with similar physiques or tusks. They never overhunt, always hunt in a pack of at least 6, and form various tools and weapons from stones and bones.

entry: POKENAME前后摇晃身体，炫示巨大的长牙状角，吓退捕食者。它行动不便，只能靠威吓自卫；若失败，就彻底任攻击者摆布。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rocks its body back and forth to show off its massive tusk-like horn to frighten off predators. Because it lacks mobility, its only method of defense is this scare tactic; if it fails, it is completely at its attacker's mercy.

entry: 它不怕冷，冰在寒冷背部凝成甲，挡住后方攻击。POKENAME长角由坚石构成，能挖穿一切挡路的冰雪。
author: .jerden
source: Indifferent to the cold, the ice that forms on POKENAME's cold back armors it against attacks from behind. Its long horn is made of solid stone and is used by POKENAME to tunnel through any snow or ice that blocks its path.

entry: 在这颗星球最严寒的地方，也发现过POKENAME群。雄性拥有更大的獠牙和尖刺，守护正在孕育后代的雌性。
author: vaporvenator
source: POKENAME herds have been recorded in the coldest places on the planet. Males sport greater tusks and spikes to defend the child-bearing mothers.

entry: POKENAME发亮的白长牙虽完全由冰构成，仍常引来偷猎者。但对方还没靠近，它就已飘走，似乎能嗅出敌意。
author: .jerden
source: Although they are made entirely of ice, POKENAME's glowing white tusks frequently attract the attention of Pokémon poachers. POKENAME always float away before they get close and seems to be able to smell hostile intent.

entry: POKENAME的领地极其危险。虽是不好斗的草食者，却造出庞大无形屏障迷宫自卫。受困者可能冻昏，随后还可能被它搜刮财物。
author: bobosmith01
source: The territory of POKENAME is incredibly dangerous; although POKENAME is a nonaggressive herbivore, it creates a huge maze of invisible barriers for protection. Those trapped in the maze can faint from the cold; POKENAME may loot them afterwards.

entry: POKENAME双手如刃，是高效猎手。藏在雪里几乎难以发现，专从盲点出击。外表虽可怕，其实是杂食性。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME's bladed hands allow them to be efficient hunters. Whilst nearly undetectable in the snow, they attack from blind spots. Contrary to their terrifying looks, POKENAME are actually omnivorous.

entry: POKENAME的毛连在最冷苔原也能保暖。高亢的喷鼻战吼警告周围，快离远些，否则可能被长牙刺穿。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's fur keeps it warm even in the coldest tundras. Its high, snorting war cry warns those around it to stay away or risk getting gored by its tusks.

entry: 野生POKENAME住在雪山顶，任何东西靠近洞穴家园，都会冲上前。受袭便发狂，大闹得引起雪崩与落石。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME live atop snowy mountains and will charge at anything that nears their cave homes. When they are attacked, they will fly into a rampage that causes avalanches and rock slides alike.

entry: POKENAME粗毛与厚实身体能抵挡环境严寒。人们相信，一些古部落曾借它穿越冰海。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's coarse fur and thick body protect it from the cold of its frigid environment. It is believed that some ancient tribes used the Pokémon to traverse icy seas.

entry: 发现现生个体前，人们曾以为POKENAME化石属于尚未发现的宝可梦种类。它凶猛迅捷，先以冰弹冻结猎物，再用强喙碾碎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fossils were thought to be an undiscovered Pokémon species until modern specimens were seen. A vicious and fast-moving hunter, it freezes prey with bolts of ice before crushing them with its powerful beak.

entry: 这些古老的漫游者行遍冰冻荒野，肉眼无法察觉。POKENAME驾驭纯粹冰川之力，释放寒冷冲击波，瞬间冻住沿途一切。虽极爱玩，却仍难觅踪迹。
author: msdawgs
source: These archaistic wanderers roam frozen wildernesses undetected by the naked eye. Harnessing pure glacial power, POKENAME unleashes frigid shockwaves that flash-freeze everything in its path. Though highly playful, they remain elusive.

entry: POKENAME只须挥翼一下，便能将冰片射向敌人。厚羽让它即使身处猛烈暴风雪也能保暖。
author: fiordaliso
source: With a single flap of its wings, POKENAME can launch shards of ice at its enemies. Its thick plumage keeps it warm even in the midst of fierce snowstorms.

entry: POKENAME只有待在地球最冷的地方才舒服。别处会使头毛脱落，让热量散出。秃处随后分泌闪亮黏液，可用于吸走工业流程中的热。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are only comfortable in the coldest places on earth, as other places cause them to lose the fur from their heads and allow heat to escape. The bald patch then produces a shimmering goo that can be used to draw heat from industrial processes.

entry: POKENAME背上的冰块让它即使离开天然栖地，也能保持凉爽。烦躁时会从鼻孔喷出团团毒粉。
author: fiordaliso
source: The block of ice POKENAME carries on its back allows it to stay cool even outside its natural habitat. When irritated, it snorts clouds of Poison Powder from its nostrils.

entry: POKENAME飘在山脚，警告训练家和宝可梦风雪或雪崩将至。若探险者不听，就绕周边飞行，投出精神屏障，封住所有道路。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME float around the bases of mountains to warn Trainers and Pokémon of approaching snowstorms or avalanches. If an explorer doesn't heed their warnings, they circle the perimeter and project a psychic barrier to block all paths.

entry: 野生POKENAME展现出相当罕见的智慧。会用猎物的小骨头装饰头顶毛簇，挥舞坚冰棍棒战斗。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME display a level of sapience considered to be rather rare. They will decorate the tufts of fur upon their heads with small bones from their prey and fight using clubs of solid ice.

entry: 它喜欢下雪的夜晚。以压倒性力量搬开巨石，吃掉藏在下面的宝可梦。
author: bobosmith01
source: It enjoys snowy nights. It uses its overwhelming strength to move boulders and to eat any hiding Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME体形庞大，体重可超过1,400磅（约635千克）。巨大体形很适合冰雪环境，天然脂肪与厚毛都让它十分保暖。
author: quackquackattack
