source: POKENAME are massive creatures that can weigh over 1,400 pounds (or 635 kilograms). Their sheer mass makes them well suited for icy environments as their natural body fat and thick layers of fur keep them well insulated.

entry: POKENAME在冰上破洞，伸出舌头作饵捕捉鲤鱼王。拖上岸后，便用角和爪撕开，享用餐点。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME break holes into ice to hunt for Magikarp by sticking out their tongues like a lure. Once they bring a Magikarp onto land, they tear into their meal with their horns and claws.

entry: 只要可以，POKENAME一生都不愿移动。遭袭时有两种反击方式：从体内渗出岩浆，或震落壳上的冰，砸向捕食者。它能活数百万年。
author: lootererswillbeboated
source: A POKENAME remains stationary its whole life if it can. If something attacks it, it has two forms of retaliation. It will either leak magma from its body or break the ice off its shell and make it fall on the predator. It can live millions of years.

entry: POKENAME通常用喙在冰上掘洞，等鱼宝可梦跳起便叼住。不过近年有些个体开始跟随冰钓者，偷走渔获。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME typically dig holes in the ice with their beak, waiting for fish Pokémon to jump up before snatching them. However, in recent years some instances of POKENAME have begun to follow ice fishers, stealing their loot.

entry: 纺织厂常养POKENAME，用阻燃脂肪处理地毯。让湿润的它以宽大身体覆住、挤压布料，便能使纤维获得厚脂肪的性质。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Textile factories often keep POKENAME to help treat carpets with its flame retardant blubber. The process involves a damp POKENAME covering the fabric with its wide body and squeezing it. This infuses the fibers with the properties of its Thick Fat.

entry: 人们以为POKENAME在冰河时代已灭绝，其实它们只是在深水中沉睡了10,000年。
author: darkweavile428
source: It was thought that POKENAME went extinct during the ice age, but it turns out they were sleeping deep underwater for 10,000 years.

entry: POKENAME能从小长鼻喷出冰雾。它全然没留意对方的难受，把小生物冻成冰块，在苔原上开心地拍来推去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can breathe a freezing mist from its small trunk. Oblivious to the discomfort it might cause, it freezes smaller creatures into ice cubes to playfully bat around the frozen tundra.

entry: POKENAME选定电脑为家后，会冻住几个文件和程序，围在身旁当巢穴。必须在战斗中击败它，才能重新掌控自己的数据。
author: sk372
source: Within the computers that POKENAME decides to make its home, it creates a den for itself by freezing several files and programs solid and surrounding itself with them. One must defeat it in battle to regain control of one's data.

entry: POKENAME只有捕猎才离开冰冷洞穴，偏爱冰属性宝可梦。先以粗壮身体缠住受害者，再用巨大毒牙咬下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME only comes out of its frigid den in order to hunt, favoring Ice-type Pokémon for prey. It constricts around its victims with its rugged body before chomping on them with its massive poisonous tusks.

entry: 不合时节的极光，是POKENAME潜行出猎的标志。它在周围地面铺上厚雪，妨碍行动，同时绕猎物打转。捕猎结束，散出的极光便更亮。
author: thesilverowls
source: An out-of-season aurora is the calling card of a prowling POKENAME. They coat the ground around them in a thick coating of snow, hindering movement as they circle their prey. The aurora they emit grows brighter once the hunt concludes.

entry: POKENAME唯一已知栖地，在覆雪火山的山顶附近。若被彻底激怒，可能唤来毁灭性的暴风雪，也可能引发火山喷发。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME's only known habitat is near the summit of snow-capped volcanoes.  If it is sufficiently angered, it may summon a devastating snowstorm, or it may cause the volcano to erupt.

entry: POKENAME为填饱肚子，会把山吃空，再以鼻端冻气造出一整套冰洞。之后便一睡10年。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME hollows out mountains to satisfy its appetite and uses freezing gas from its snout to create a system of ice caves. Afterward, it falls asleep for 10 years.

entry: POKENAME强翼即使只拍一下，也能引发致命雪崩。为减少破坏，宁可在冰山内休眠，将自己封冻，一次冬眠数百年。
author: distinguishedmanlygentleman
source: Even a single beat of POKENAME's powerful wings can cause deadly avalanches. To minimise the damage it causes, POKENAME prefers to lie dormant in icebergs, freezing over and hibernating for centuries at a time.

entry: POKENAME长牙太大，无法四肢着地奔跑。长牙虽由冰构成，即使泡在它最爱的温泉中也不融化。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME cannot run on all fours due to its massive tusk. Although its tusk is made of ice, the tusk won't melt even in the warmth of POKENAME's beloved hot springs.

entry: POKENAME主要靠甩出翼上冰柱自卫。冰片时速可达100英里，任何被击中的东西都会遭受如灼伤般的冻伤。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME flings the icicles on its wings as its main form of self defence. These ice shards can fly at up to 100 MPH, inflicting a freezing burn onto anything it hits.

entry: POKENAME曾是远古冰河时代的顶级猎手，聪明得懂用其他宝可梦的残骸制作武器。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME was an apex hunter during an ancient ice age. It has the intelligence to create weapons using remains of other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME住在严酷北极，靠庞大身体与层层脂肪御寒。天气晴朗时，会向天空射出电光，远距离传讯。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in harsh arctic environments, relying on their bulk and layers of fat to protect them from the cold. During clear weather they shoot bolts of electricity into the sky to communicate across long distances.

entry: POKENAME以复杂计划捕猎。它们在雪野点起营火，等旅人前来休息。时机一到，就熄火扑上。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME hunt using a complex plan. They light campfires in the snowy wilderness, and wait for travelers to rest. When the time is right, they extinguish the flame and pounce.

entry: POKENAME面对远敌，会猛掷岩石、冰球，甚至将两者压成硬块投出。敌人靠近后就以角进攻，靠厚皮与冰甲抵挡伤害。
author: .jerden
source: To attack distant foes, POKENAME will forcefully throw rocks and balls of ice, or even a hard-packed mixture of both. If foes get close, it attacks with its horns, with its thick hide and icy armor protecting it from damage.

entry: POKENAME从鼻孔吹出冻气，削弱对手。面对反击，就蜷成球，让厚毛吸收部分冲击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can blow freezing air from its nostrils to weaken opposing Pokémon. It defends itself from counterattacks by rolling up into a ball and letting its thick fur absorb some of the blow.

entry: POKENAME的长牙强到能轻易裂开钻石。有些不融冰，其实就是长牙的碎片。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The tusks of POKENAME are strong enough to crack diamonds with ease. Some pieces of Never-Melt Ice are chips of their tusks.

entry: POKENAME把强壮长牙插进服务器，吸收里面的数据。离开后，服务器摸起来仍会长时间冰冷无比。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME jams its strong tusks into servers to absorb the data within. When it leaves, the server becomes intensely cold to the touch for extended periods.

entry: 它是领地意识强的顶级宝可梦，以坚冰覆盖部分身体，让本已惊人的肉搏更具威力。曾见过族中最年长者，长牙伸得比手臂还远。
author: infinex21
source: This territorial apex Pokémon clads parts of its body in solid ice to strengthen its already-devastating physical strikes. The eldest of this species of Pokémon was seen with tusks that reached further than its own arms.

entry: POKENAME习惯寒冷气温，喜欢收集象牙猪脱落的长牙，再拿来破冰。
author: animecreep4
source: POKENAME is accustomed to cold temperatures. It collects discarded Mamoswine tusks for fun and uses them to break ice.

entry: POKENAME精神力量虽强，却更爱在严酷苔原过原始、依赖体力的生活。长矛使得灵巧致命，独自就能猎倒猛犸般巨大的猎物。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME possesses potent psychic powers, it prefers a primitive and physical lifestyle living in the harsh tundra. It deftly wields spears to deadly effect and can take down mammoth-sized prey all by itself.

entry: POKENAME从外衣下散出冻气，冻结紧邻的一切。有人说整个身体都由绝不融化的坚冰构成，却无人见过斗篷下方，无法证实。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME emits a freezing aura from beneath its coat that freezes anything in the immediate vicinity. Some say its entire body is made of solid impossible-to-melt ice, but none have seen beneath the cloak to verify.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME住在远古象牙猪群繁盛的地方。还有人相信，它本身就是那些族群的灵魂汇聚成一体。
author: sk372
source: It is believed that POKENAME inhabits areas where Mamoswine herds were abundant in the ancient past. Some believe POKENAME is itself the souls of those herds, all formed together as one.

entry: POKENAME适应了在山间穿行、绕树转向。奇怪的是，皮毛非常短，几乎像完全没有。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME has adapted to traversing mountains while swerving around trees. Surprisingly, POKENAME has very short fur, almost as if there's nothing at all.

entry: POKENAME厚毛下有坚固甲片，能承受最强攻击。虽多生活在山区，却十分善泳，会用爪子捕捉鱼宝可梦。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Under POKENAME's thick fur are sturdy plates, allowing it to take the strongest attacks. Despite living in more mountainous areas, POKENAME are proficient swimmers, using their claws to catch Fish-Pokémon.

entry: 皮毛覆着坚冰块，作为保护用的尖刺。凡是长牙举不起来的东西，它就用猛烈头锤对付。
author: infinex21
source: Its fur is clad with pieces of solid ice, which serve as protective spikes. Whatever it cannot lift with its tusks shall be met with a crushing Headbutt.

entry: 大长牙由比身上冰层更坚实的冰构成。它们以层层坚冰加固硬头，让头撞攻击更强。
author: infinex21
source: Their impressive tusks are made of ice more solid than the ice clinging to parts of their bodies. They reinforce their hard heads with layers of solid ice to further empower their headbutt attacks.

entry: 它是苔原古老的守护者，保护领地内的弱小宝可梦。驾驭猛烈暴风雪，以旋雪裹身，强化护甲。
author: evilgammon
source: The ancient guardian of the tundra, it protects weak Pokémon that live in its territory. It commands fierce blizzards and cloaks itself with swirling snow that strengthens its armor.

entry: 厚脂肪与强长牙，让任何正面攻击都对POKENAME无效。外形虽骇人，却是草食者，会推倒树木寻找冰冻的果实。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Any frontal attack against POKENAME has proven ineffective due to its thick fat and strong tusks. Despite their imposing frame, POKENAME are herbivores, knocking over trees in search of ice berries.

entry: 蓝鳞冷如坚冰。为保护领地与幼崽，它会毫不犹豫地引起小震动，触发雪崩。
author: infinex21
source: Its blue scales are as cold as solid ice. This Pokémon will not hesitate to cause an avalanche via small tremors for the sake of protecting its territory and its young.

entry: POKENAME用巨牙轻松破开浮冰。毛发与脂肪让它即使在最冰冷的水里也能保暖。
author: bacondlx
source: POKENAME breaks through ice floes with ease using its massive tusks. Its hair and blubber are designed to keep it warm in even the most frigid waters.

entry: 山村曾将POKENAME奉为山峰之神。传说它冲过山间，走到哪里，哪里就跟来巨大暴风雪。
author: .izik
source: Mountain villages once worshipped POKENAME as a god of the peaks. Legends claim massive blizzards follow wherever it charges through the mountains.

entry: POKENAME能举起几乎两倍于自身体形的物件，因此可将大冰块掷向对手。野生个体极其好斗，建议训练家尽量远离。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are able to heave objects nearly twice their size, allowing them to hurl chunks of ice at opponents. In the wild, these Pokémon are incredibly aggressive, so Trainers are advised to steer clear when possible.

entry: POKENAME慢慢走过雪山，用变化后的獠牙拨开积雪。登山客很乐意沿它们开出的路走，对它赞不绝口。
author: markusknight
source: POKENAME slowly roam snowy mountains, using their modified tusks to move the snow aside. They are praised by hikers, who willingly use their trails.

entry: 它肌肉虽少，构成身体的绳状皮毛却十分强韧。能把大冰块当锤挥动，一击打碎冰封湖面，让POKENAME的猎物落进下方冰水。
author: .fedoraman
source: Despite lacking muscle mass, the rope-like fur making up its body is remarkably strong. It can swing its block of ice like a hammer with enough force to shatter frozen lakes, dropping POKENAME's prey into freezing water below.

entry: POKENAME不吃也不喝。中世纪史诗将其描绘为可畏战士的亡魂，复苏归来，大肆作乱，了结旧怨。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME do not eat or drink. They feature in medieval sagas as the ghosts of feared warriors, reanimated to wreak havoc and settle old grudges.

entry: POKENAME是强大的远古捕食者，已在陆地潜猎数千年。成群出猎时拖动矛状尾巴，产生强静电，让电波穿过地面，麻痹猎物。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME are formidable, ancient predators that have stalked the land for millennia. Hunting in packs, they generate intense static by dragging their spear-like tails, sending electrical waves through the ground to paralyse prey.

entry: POKENAME一挥冰翼，就能唤起猛烈暴风雪。人们曾误信巨角的牙质能治某些疾病，因此猎杀它。
author: fiordaliso
source: With a single beat of its icy wings, POKENAME can unleash furious blizzards. It was once hunted because the ivory of its enormous horns was mistakenly believed to cure certain illnesses.

entry: POKENAME盘长的身体覆着厚毛，在冰水游泳也不觉得冷。会与同类交战，以硬如岩石的长牙碰撞，争夺领地主导权。
author: fiordaliso
source: The thick fur covering POKENAME's long coils allows it to swim in icy waters without feeling the cold. It fights other members of its species, clashing its rock-hard tusks for territorial dominance.

entry: POKENAME飞在极地上空，巡视认定属于自己的领地。体节上的冰晶可作弹丸射出，将击中的对象冻得结结实实。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flies above polar regions, watching over what it deems as its territory. The ice crystals on its body segments can be fired off as projectiles, freezing solid those they manage to connect with.

entry: POKENAME移动极慢，力量却大得荒唐，散出的空气冷到自己也总覆着冰。一只便能轻松举起超过自身体形三倍的冰川，更不用说一击将其打碎。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME move incredibly slowly, yet are absurdly strong and exude an air so cold they are constantly clad in ice as well. A single POKENAME can lift a glacier of solid ice over thrice its own size with ease, let alone break it with a single strike.

entry: POKENAME是北极最执着的猎手之一，总在四处寻找认作猎物的宝可梦。它从大树跃出，朝猝不及防的猎物发射雪状硬冰球，直到对方昏倒。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are one of the arctics most consistent hunters, always on the move for any Pokémon they deem as prey. They jump out from large trees, firing hard balls of snow-like ice into their surprised prey until they faint.

entry: POKENAME快速伸长双臂，将爪钩进冰层，攀上冰崖。战斗时冲向敌人，跃起用角攻击，再借头顶帽盖的反冲弹回。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME scale icy cliffs by rapidly extending their arms and hooking their claws into the ice. In battle, they charge at their foes, leaping to strike with their horns and springing back from the recoil of the caps on their heads.

entry: POKENAME虽爱偷登雪山的装备，探险者仍常与它组队，协助攀上危险崖壁。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its habit of stealing snow-climbing gear, Explorers often team up with POKENAME to help scale dangerous cliff faces.

entry: POKENAME外表与举止虽粗野，却并非化石宝可梦。研究发现，这些凶猛、不会飞的生物，远古时曾与早期人类共存，后来进化道路才分开。
author: chiari_queen
source: Despite its rough looks and mannerisms, POKENAME is not a fossil Pokémon. Studies have found that these ferocious and flightless creatures lived alongside early humans during ancient times, but evolutionary paths split later on.

entry: POKENAME用手挂在天花板上，等人走到下方。受训个体会落到训练家身上，顽皮嗅闻；野生个体却伸出长牙扑下，刺穿猎物。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Using their hands, POKENAME hang from ceilings, awaiting someone to walk under them. Trained POKENAME land on their Trainers to playfully sniff them, while wild POKENAME launch with their tusks out to pierce prey.

entry: POKENAME保护栖地与珍爱对象时，会造成巨大破坏，因此许多人认为它可怕。大闹消耗能量，令它疲惫不堪，而它睡觉时喜欢听音乐。
author: t3isukone
source: Many consider POKENAME terrible for the massive devastation they cause in the defense of their habitats and their loved ones. Exerting the energy for their rampages exhausts them, and they enjoy listening to music as they sleep.

entry: POKENAME厚毛留住内部产生的热，毛下身体几乎滚烫。长牙般的触角能点燃，化作火鞭自卫。
author: sk372
source: Due to its thick fur retaining the heat it internally generates, POKENAME's body is almost scalding hot beneath the fur. Its tusk-like antennae can be ignited and used as flaming whips to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME藏在薄雪下，耐心等猎物靠近再出击。它作战凶猛，凭坚牙与强尾，以精准动作和力量迅速压制对手。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME hides beneath a thin layer of snow and patiently waits for its prey to approach before attacking. It is a fierce fighter, using its sturdy fangs and powerful tail to swiftly overpower its opponents with precision and strength.

entry: POKENAME寻找藏在冰洞深处的宝石。用大牙凿开坚冰，挖出渴望吞食的珠宝。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME searches for gems hidden deep within ice caves. With its large fangs, it carves into the solid chunks of ice to dig out the jewels it so eagerly craves to devour.

entry: POKENAME极其坚韧，能忍受零下气温。即使被完全冻住，也只须巨牙一击，就能轻松破冰脱困。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are incredibly resilient Pokémon that can endure sub-zero temperatures. If frozen solid, they easily break free with a single strike from their massive tusks.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在冻酸奶店周围，想尽量偷到拿得下的分量。若居住地区高于华氏32度，就会融化。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME lurk around frozen yogurt stores, attempting to steal as much as they can hold. If they live in an area higher than 32 degrees Fahrenheit, they will melt.

entry: 长牙中空，减轻飞行负担，却仍硬如骨头。若POKENAME正将你赶出领地，就能用长牙将你碾碎。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its tusks are hollow, making them less of a burden in flight. They are still as hard as bone, and a POKENAME chasing you from its territory can use its tusks to crush you.

entry: POKENAME身体由冰构成，以冻泥加固。唯独长牙保持洁净，用作威吓展示。
author: mary_the_jane
source: POKENAME has a body made of ice and fortified by frozen mud. Its tusks, however, remain clean to act as a threat display.

entry: POKENAME厚毛能抵挡覆雪家园的严寒。它在暴风雪中出猎，趁大雪令能见度极低，凭迅捷速度突袭猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's thick fur coat protects it from the frigid elements of its snow-covered home territory. It hunts during blizzards, using its quick speed to strike at prey while visibility is minimal due to the heavy snow.

entry: POKENAME将手持长牙当冰镐，优雅地在山壁悬崖间攀爬、起舞。用手中长牙敲头上长牙，便能发出悦耳声响，谱成歌曲。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses the tusk it holds as an ice pick to gracefully climb and dance on mountain walls and cliffs. By tapping the tusks on its head with its held tusk, it creates melodic sounds that it uses to create its songs.

entry: 从外面虽难看见，POKENAME背着一朵大蘑菇。包裹的冰既保护蘑菇，也为其提供水分。
author: dylonk25
source: While hard to see from the outside, POKENAME carries a large mushroom on its back. The encasing ice both protects it and provides it with moisture.

entry: 它们只住在降雪最厚的最高山巅。谁也无法永久打碎身上的冰；交锋后，能躲过利爪与坚韧长牙、毫发无伤离开的更是寥寥。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon only live atop the tallest mountains with the thickest of snowfalls. None can forever break the ice upon their bodies, and the few escape a clash unscathed by either their claws or their extremely tough tusks.

entry: POKENAME随身带着冰锤，无论敌人多重，都用来将其打飞。严寒环境中最能发挥本领，冰甲不断增厚，化作覆盖全身、无法穿透的盾。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME carries an ice hammer used to batter away foes, no matter their weight, alongside it at all times. It excels in freezing environments where its icy armor can grow and thicken to become an impenetrable shield all over its body.

entry: POKENAME住在冰山脚下，免得风打断自己预知未来。可海豹球常从同一座山滚下来，撞上它，让它分心。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME live at the bottom of icy mountains, where the wind won't distract them from seeing into the future. Unfortunately, Spheal often roll down these same mountains, bumping into POKENAME and breaking their focus.

entry: 冬天，POKENAME会刻意将自己冻在湖里冬眠。若打断这自然过程，它很可能死亡。
author: dodoowner_
source: In the winter, POKENAME purposely freeze themselves in lakes to hibernate. If you disrupt this natural occurrence, the Pokémon will likely pass.

entry: POKENAME利用头痛的力量，从杖中射出霜雪。由于持续受痛苦折磨，往往很容易生气。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shoot frosty snow from their staves by harnessing the power of their headaches. They are often easy to anger because of the constant pain they are in.

entry: POKENAME心地温暖，吐息更暖，因此数千年来一直被驯养，融入北极文化。驯服的它是否曾是人类最早可控的火源，考古学家仍有争论。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME has been domesticated and part of arctic cultures for millennia for their warm hearts and warmer breath. Archaeologists debate over whether a tamed POKENAME was humanity's first source of controlled fire.

entry: POKENAME虽也见于其他气候，多数仍住在寒地。任何东西闯入领地，都会冲上去，再用角掷出冲锋时收集的石头、雪或冰。
author: infinex21
source: Although seen in other climates, most POKENAME are inhabitants of colder environments. They are known for charging at anything that intrudes upon their territory and will use their horns to throw rocks, snow, or ice collected during a charge.

entry: POKENAME分布的气候范围很广，从最冷的苔原，到温度达数百度的火山山脉都有。巨大鹿角让它冲锋迎敌时，能掘起并滚动巨石、积雪，甚至树干。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME can be found in regions ranging widely in climate, from the coldest tundra to volcanic ranges reaching several hundred degrees. Their massive antlers allow them to dig up and roll boulders, snow and even tree trunks while charging at foes.

entry: POKENAME身上流出的火焰摸起来冰冷，会夺走接触物的热量。虽强壮可靠，却有失温风险，因此不建议骑乘。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The flames streaming from the bodies of POKENAME are cold to the touch, sapping heat from anything they come into contact with. Though they're strong and reliable, the risk of hypothermia means it's not advisable to ride them.

entry: POKENAME即使在猛烈暴风雪中，也善于穿行山地辨路。会为医护人员拉车，方便找到迷失山中的伤者。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are excellent at finding their way through mountains during intense blizzards. They pull carriages for medical personnel so they can easily find the wounded lost in the mountains.

entry: POKENAME栖地寒冷，蓬松皮毛却暖得出奇。若坚牙尚未成功破开，强腿与蹄也足以击碎大块岩石。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's bushy fur remains surprisingly warm despite the frigid cold environs that serve as their habitats. Their legs and hooves are strong enough to break through sizeable rocks, if their tough tusks do not first succeed.

entry: 尾上的大舌贝形似冰河时代的化石。没人知道那些古代大舌贝为何有长牙，但POKENAME会用它们冲撞试图从后靠近的敌人。
author: .jerden
source: The Shellder on its tail resembles fossils from the ice age. It is unknown why these ancient Shellder had tusks, but POKENAME uses them to charge at any foes that try to approach it from behind.

entry: 强腿与利爪让它即使跑过冰面，也能稳稳站住。三个喙轻松破开坚冰，三对长牙则能迅速挖出埋藏的食物或猎物。
author: infinex21
source: Their strong legs and sharp talons allow them to remain steady even as they run across ice. Their three beaks can easily break through solid ice, and by using their three sets of tusks they can quickly dig up buried foods or prey.

entry: 宝可梦对战中，POKENAME喷出迅速冻结的冰水洪流。目标冻住后，便以巨牙砸穿冰层。
author: quackquackattack
source: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME unleash a torrent of icy water that freezes quickly. Once their target is frozen, they smash through the ice with their huge tusks.

entry: POKENAME是觅食与烹饪高手，即使最极端的环境也能做出健康餐点。对粮食渐少的冒险训练家而言，是极实用的伙伴。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME are expert chefs and foragers who can whip up a healthy meal even in the most extreme environments. They're incredibly useful companions for adventurous Trainers running low on food.

entry: POKENAME壳上覆毛，因此能在冰冷海滩旺盛生存。嗅觉极敏锐，先找出贝类，再用钳撬开。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME thrive on ice-cold beaches thanks to the fur covering their shell. They have a very keen sense of smell and use it to find some seashells before opening them with their claws.

entry: POKENAME把一只钳浸入冰水，直到外面凝成巨冰块。任何东西靠近，都会遭到这把冰钳锤的挥砸。
author: fancyskunk
source: POKENAME submerge one of their claws in freezing cold water until a massive ice block forms around it. They swing and slam this icy claw-hammer at anything that approaches.

entry: POKENAME有百科全书般的植物养护知识，因此常与园丁搭档。可它会变得反常，搞混各种植物偏好的环境，饲养者须仔细看顾。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has an encyclopedic knowledge regarding plant care, so it is a common partner for gardeners. Unfortunately, it can become erratic and mixes up what conditions different plants prefer, so owners must keep a close watch on it.

entry: POKENAME以特殊丝线连接程序，搭起巢穴。不知为何，连上的程序容易出错，需要频繁维护。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses a peculiar silk to link programs together to create its nest. Programs connected by this silk are somehow prone to errors and require frequent maintenance.

entry: POKENAME个头虽小，胃口却大，每天以太字节计吞食虚拟数据。训练良好时，软件开发者会借它销毁恶意软件与旧数据；野生个体却可能祸害数据中心。
author: notadoctor75
source: Despite its small size, POKENAME has a large appetite, devouring virtual data by the terabyte daily. When well trained, they are used by software developers to destroy malware and old data, but wild POKENAME can be a menace to data centers.

entry: 额外软件改变了POKENAME的移动方式，让它不像滚动，反而仿佛前后瞬移。自身动作令它恶心，甚至无须任何外界刺激就可能爆炸。
author: soup1900
source: Additional software installed on POKENAME causes it to move around oddly, almost teleporting forward and back instead of rolling. It may explode without anything stimulating it due to how queasy it gets from its own movements.

entry: POKENAME的感觉功能失灵，对所有刺激都麻木。爆炸能排出体内损坏的数据，因此反而有益健康。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is numb to all forms of stimuli due to its sensory functions being defunct. Explosions from this Pokémon are good for its health, as the blast releases corrupted data stored within its body.

entry: POKENAME通常被大型服务器吸引，吃光所有储存数据。身体开始出现故障，就是即将裂开、排出消化后无用数据的征兆。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are typically attracted to large servers, consuming every bit of stored data within them. When their bodies begin to glitch, it is a sign they are about to rupture and eject the digested, unusable data.

entry: POKENAME通常被大型服务器吸引，吃光所有储存数据。身体开始出现故障，就是即将裂开、排出消化后无用数据的征兆。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are typically attracted to large servers, consuming every bit of stored data within them. When their bodies begin to glitch, it is a sign they are about to rupture and eject the digested, unusable data.

entry: POKENAME搭着数据流中传送的邮件，穿行网络空间。搭乘的邮件若被打开，就会爆炸，释放病毒，摧毁卷入爆炸的所有程序。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME travel through cyberspace by taking rides on emails being sent through data streams. If the email they are riding on is opened, they explode, releasing viruses and destroying all programs caught in the blast.

entry: 同一窝里的每颗蛋，外貌与性格都各不相同。各自心思差异太大，难以作为一个整体合作。
author: sk372
source: Each egg in the clutch has a unique appearance and a distinct personality. Because of the many differing psyches in the group, they have difficulty cooperating as a single unit.

entry: POKENAME一找到满是文件的电脑，就留在屏幕上，来回摇叶，将文件吸作养分。进食时，整台电脑都会出现大量故障。
author: .izik
source: Once POKENAME finds a computer filled with files, it will remain on the screen swaying its leaves back and forth while absorbing them as nourishment. This causes widespread malfunctions across the computer as it feasts.

entry: POKENAME的头骨头盔有部分数据损坏，影响整体行为。手中故障骨头碰到任何东西，都很可能损坏、毁掉其数据。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's skull helmet is partially corrupted, affecting its general behavior. Touching anything with the glitched bone it wields has a high chance of corrupting and ruining its data.

entry: POKENAME能操控自身各部分的长度与重量，包括随身的“骨头”。它会强行闯进任何电子游戏软件，无论类型，都要成为游戏中的巨型敌方首领。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME is able to manipulate the length and weight of any of its segments, including the "bone" it carries. It will intrusively insert itself in any video gaming software, becoming part of the game as a giant enemy boss, no matter the genre.

entry: 手中大骨是自身的延伸，能截取、吸收电磁波。虽然巨大，仍能轻松举起，挥出的力量足以粉碎坚硬巨石。
author: infinex21
source: The large bone it wields is an extension of itself that can intercept and absorb EM waves. It can lift this bone with ease despite its size and swing it with enough force to shatter a large, solid boulder.

entry: 额外软件影响POKENAME的移动模式，让动作变得不规律。虽没有看得见的腿，踢击却强劲得像仍有隐形四肢。
author: shyguy11011
source: Additional software has affected POKENAME's movement patterns, causing it to act sporadically. Despite not having visible legs, it delivers power kicks feels as though invisible limbs are still present.

entry: POKENAME战斗时动作难以预测，忽然从缓慢变得混乱。无规律的拳击留下故障般残影，让敌人来不及反应，也干扰附近电子设备。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME moves unpredictably in battle, changing from slow to erratic abruptly. Its sporadic punches leave glitch-like trails, striking foes before they can react and disturbing nearby electronics.

entry: POKENAME伸长的舌头像一根地面系绳。借舌头固定身体，免得自行飘走，或被外力卷走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tongue acts as a tether to the ground when extended. It uses its tongue to hold its body steady and keep it from floating away or being whisked away by external forces.

entry: POKENAME能向电脑释放恶意代码构成的气体，引起严重系统错误，令其崩溃。平时虽会收敛，待在发热设备中，气体却会膨胀，强行喷出。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can release gases made of malicious coding into computers that causes them to receive critical system errors and crash. While it normally relegates this behavior, being inside of hot devices forces the gases to expand and burst out.

entry: POKENAME受威胁时，鲜明色彩似乎会短暂分离、错位。混乱的视觉卡顿，让饥饿捕食者极难追踪动作。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME's striking colours seem to momentarily separate and misalign when it feels threatened. This erratic visual stutter makes it incredibly difficult for hungry predators to track its movements.

entry: POKENAME凹凸不平的茧有时会散成碎块飞开，再自行重组。趁此看见内部模样的人，对形状的描述却互相矛盾。
author: sk372
source: The pieces of POKENAME's uneven cocoon will occasionally fly off before rearranging themselves. Those who've seen what's underneath during this time all give conflicting reports on the shape of the creature.

entry: POKENAME的气体、器官与程序全存在连接双头的可疑补丁里。右头能力有限，只混合毒素、生产数据，其他一切都由左头负责。
author: soup1900
source: All of POKENAME's gases, organs, and programs are stored in the Dubious Disc its two heads are connected to. Since the right head is limited in its capabilities, all it does is mix toxins and produce data while the left head does everything else.

entry: POKENAME依附电脑文件，吸入数据，再以气体形式呼出。不过双头不会交替膨胀、收缩，因此利用数据的效率极低。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME breathes by absorbing data from computer files it attaches to and releasing it as a gas. However, since the two heads don't alternate inflating and deflating, it uses the data extremely inefficiently.

entry: POKENAME头上的角顺时针旋转，会使附近图像文件扭曲。奇怪的是，反向旋转又能让图像恢复正常。
author: .izik
source: When the horn on POKENAME's head rotates clockwise, it causes nearby image files to distort. Oddly, rotating the horn in the other direction returns the images to normal.

entry: 头角如同强力钻头。有恶意黑客借它钻穿防火墙。
author: .jerden
source: The horn on its head functions like a powerful drill. Malicious hackers have been known to use it to break through firewalls.

entry: POKENAME有个十分麻烦的怪癖：试图把它从电脑移除时，就会让其他所有功能冻结或卡顿，直到删除结束，而这过程漫长得令人煎熬。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a strange quirk that makes it a nuisance to deal with. Upon attempts to remove it from a computer, it will cause every other function to freeze or lag until its deletion process is complete, which takes an agonizingly long time.

entry: POKENAME的螺旋独眼能催眠，原地快速旋转，让注视者神思恍惚。随后以众多藤蔓缠住目标，拖往不知何处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's singular spiral eye works as a hypnotic tool, rotating rapidly in place to send those who look at it into a trance. Its many vines then ensnare the target so POKENAME can drag them off to parts unknown.

entry: 有时，故障穿过POKENAME身体，会把孩子传送到一段距离外。它就惊慌失措，乱挥乱摆，直到重新找到孩子。
author: sk372
source: Sometimes, a glitch will pass through POKENAME's body and cause the child to be teleported some distance away. POKENAME goes into a flailing panic until it can locate its child again.

entry: POKENAME伪装成普通墨海马，骗取训练家的信任。一有机会，就接管训练家的全部设备。
author: gp423
source: POKENAME preys on Trainers' trust by disguising itself as a regular Horsea. When given the chance, it will take control of all of a Trainer's devices.

entry: POKENAME把数据骨架上的鳍塑成时兴裙装的样式，显得优雅。为追赶潮流，会潜入时装公司的电脑，偷取并模仿尚未发布的设计。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME makes itself look elegant by shaping its cyberframe fins to look exactly like those of popular in-style dresses. To be as fashionable as possible, it infiltrates the computers of fashion companies to steal and copy their unreleased designs.

entry: POKENAME头角释放的信号，会使附近电脑故障。即使离开当地，故障仍可能持续数日。
author: .izik
source: The horn on POKENAME's head releases a signal that causes nearby computers to malfunction. These malfunctions can persist for days after it leaves the area.

entry: POKENAME形体极度扭曲，飞行路线也极其混乱，以故障般的跳动从一处移到另一处。振翼散出的粒子，会让碰到的机械故障。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's extremely distorted form causes it to fly in a very erratic pattern, glitching from one place to the next. Its wings emit particles when they flap that can cause machinery touched by them to malfunction.

entry: POKENAME身体其他部分会被杀毒软件清除，唯独中央核心不受影响。因此能无限再生，用大量垃圾数据塞满电脑。
author: soup1900
source: While the rest of POKENAME's body is susceptible to being purged by antivirus software, the core at its center is immune. This allows it to infinitely regenerate and fill a computer with lots of its junk data.

entry: POKENAME从中央核心发送信号，能远程接入、控制世上任何电脑。接到红色核心信号指令的设备，数秒内就会自毁。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can remotely access and control any computer in the world by sending signals from the core at its center. Any device that receives a red core signal instruction will self-destruct within seconds.

entry: POKENAME设置数字屏障，隔开电脑硬盘的各区。能操控数据，在网络空间造出任何想要的物件，但一旦它进入现实世界，物件就全化为乌有。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME places down digital barriers in order to partition off sections of a computer's hard drive. It can manipulate data to create any object it wants in cyberspace, but the items all disappear into nothingness once it enters the physical world.

entry: POKENAME挥一次臂刃，就能斩除遇见的任何病毒。但必须小心，若误中正常数据或程序，就会使其出现漏洞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's arm blades are able to cut down any virus it encounters with a single swing. However, it must be careful, as striking non-malicious data and programs will cause them to become buggy.

entry: POKENAME摇摆身体时，会通过任何连上的扬声器发出近似人声的音调。听得太久，可能短暂精神失常。
author: .izik
source: While swaying its body, POKENAME releases an almost human-like tone through any connected speakers. Prolonged exposure can cause short-term madness.

entry: POKENAME通过分离的双臂引导强力电击，威力足以掀飞卡车。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME channels powerful electrical blasts through its detached arms. These blasts can be strong enough to send a truck flying.

entry: POKENAME喷出的火带着奇特像素外观。久久待在火边取暖的人，会涌起强烈怀旧之情。
author: sk372
source: The fire POKENAME breathes out has a strange pixelated appearance. Those who linger near the warmth of its fire begin experiencing strong feelings of nostalgia.

entry: POKENAME以三根强角撕开现实与网络空间之间的洞，寻找猎物。人们猜测，穿梭两界的过程令人晕眩，因此它常瞪着大眼，神情骇人。
author: notadoctor75
source: With its three powerful horns, POKENAME tears holes between the real world and cyberspace in search of prey. It is assumed the process of moving between the two realms is disorienting, leading to it often wearing a frightening, wide-eyed expression.

entry: POKENAME容易动怒，心思又变幻莫测。唯有耐心、熟练的训练家与牧场主，才能驯服这古怪性情。
author: trismon55555
source: POKENAME is both quick to anger and mentally unpredictable. Only patient and skilled Trainers and ranchers are able to tame their bizarre nature.

entry: POKENAME拼命扑腾，在电脑系统的文件间迅速跳跃。虽能让电脑感染病毒与恶意软件，却都太弱太慢，根本无法造成明显影响。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its frantic splashing to quickly hop between files inside a computer system. While it can infect computers with viruses and malware, they are too weak and slow to ever make a noticeable impact.

entry: POKENAME身上分离的碎片，以混乱卡顿的轨迹绕着翅膀飘动。快速振翼时，碎片的环绕也会更加剧烈。
author: eiskitsune
source: Detached fragments of POKENAME's body float alongside its wings in an erratic, stuttering orbit. When it rapidly beats its wings, these fragments have been noted to orbit with a higher intensity.

entry: POKENAME吃散落数据，在毒刺里合成能引起小故障的电脑病毒。黑客常喂给它特定代码，制造专用病毒。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME feed on loose data to synthesise computer viruses in their stingers that can cause minor glitches. Hackers often feed them specific lines of code to create specialised viruses.

entry: POKENAME从身体开口猛喷大量数据，冲过不同维度。若留在数字世界，会攻击每一片数据，直到整个网络崩溃。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME forcefully ejects large amounts of data from the openings in its body to dash through different dimensions. If kept in digital realms, it would attack every fragment of data until the entire network collapses.

entry: POKENAME乐意载人渡水，骑乘却像赌博。随时可能出故障，瞬移到另一片水域，有时甚至远在另一地区。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is happy to ferry others across bodies of water, but riding on it is a gamble; at any point it may glitch out and teleport to a different body of water, in some cases in a completely different region.

entry: POKENAME变成物件和其他宝可梦时，形态极不稳定，错误百出。肢体的大小、形状、方向或颜色可能不对，也可能多出、缺少或错放身体部位。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's transformations into other objects and Pokémon are extremely unstable and have lots of mistakes in them. The errors range vary from limbs being the wrong size, shape, rotation, or color to having extra, missing, or misplaced body parts.

entry: POKENAME不稳定的身体对进化石反应极强。即使没有碰到，只要靠近，不同部分也可能脱离，暂时改变形状与颜色，却不触发进化。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's unstable body is extremely reactive to Evolution stones. Even without touching one, proximity can cause different portions to detach and temporarily alter in shape and color without triggering evolution.

entry: POKENAME颈边发光的数据场，每只都不相同。发现电脑内有病毒时，光就格外明亮。
author: .izik
source: The glowing data fields around POKENAME's neck are unique to each individual. These lights glow particularly bright when it spots a virus within a computer.

entry: POKENAME是网络空间闻名的危险存在。没人管时就尽量吸收数据补充力量，再借水状身体突破电脑防火墙；若被惹怒，更会直接毁掉硬件。
author: thesilverowls
source: POKENAME are known as dangers in cyberspace. When left alone, they soak up as much data as they can to replenish their powers, then use their watery forms to breach through firewalls of computers, or simply ruin the hardware if provoked.

entry: POKENAME原本像一种快得关不掉的广告算法，迫使用户看广告。如今用弹出广告挡住对手，就像当初挡住用户的光标。
author: slimninja55
source: POKENAME originally functioned like an ad algorithm that was too fast to close, forcing users to view ads. It now uses ad pop-ups to block opponents, like it once blocked users' cursors.

entry: POKENAME用身上绿色电线为电脑文件注入电力，点击时便电击用户。但它控制不好注入量，有时会烧坏整台设备。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses the green wires from its body to infuse computer files with volts of electricity so that they shock the device user when clicked on. However, it can't control how much power it pumps into these files, so it sometimes fries the device.

entry: POKENAME吃电脑数据时，设备开始过热。期间它阻止系统自动关机，时间久了，最终会让设备无法使用。
author: .izik
source: While POKENAME consumes data on a computer, the device begins to overheat. It prevents the system from automatically shutting down during this process, eventually rendering it unusable after prolonged exposure.

entry: POKENAME是多边兽与多边兽Z的各部分，被损坏数据黏成的数字乱团。行动极不规律，见于网络空间，会损坏周围数据。
author: equation8573
source: POKENAME is a digital mess of parts of Porygon and Porygon-Z adhered together by corrupted data. POKENAME is very erratic and can be found in cyberspace where it corrupts data around it.

entry: POKENAME入侵电脑，开始塞入隐晦宣传信息，意图让用户爱戴、赞美自己和所有与菊石兽有关的融合体。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME invades computers and begins filling them with subtle propaganda messages. These messages are meant to compel users to love and praise it and all Omanyte-related fusions.

entry: POKENAME只须出现在屏幕上，就有奇特催眠效果。观看者会忍不住崇拜、痴迷它和其他任何多刺菊石兽融合体。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's mere presence on the screen has a strange hypnotic effect. Those who view it feel compelled to worship and obsess over it and any other Omastar fusions.

entry: POKENAME几乎一动不动，将全部能量用于处理先前吃下的代码。休眠期间重写病毒特征码，编译出极复杂的电脑破坏程序。
author: eiskitsune
source: Remaining almost completely motionless, POKENAME devotes all its energy to processing previously consumed code. During this dormant state, it rewrites its viral signature to compile a highly complex computer corrupting agent.

entry: POKENAME夺取电脑防火墙，作为坚壳的额外保护层。设备中一被发现，就立刻藏得难觅踪影，因此很难研究观察。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME commandeers firewalls from computers to add as protective layers for its sturdy shell. As soon as it is found inside a device, it makes itself scarce, making it a difficult species to study and observe.

entry: 各种古生物博物馆会展示POKENAME，模拟化石翼龙的动作。不过模仿骨骼时，身体常出现故障，吓到参观者。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are displayed in various paleontology museums to mimic the actions of Aerodactyl. However, their bodies often glitch out when mimicking bones, scaring visitors.

entry: POKENAME嘴上与腹上的二进制代码，似乎就是消化系统的程序，帮助它更容易吃下病毒和恶意软件。
author: bigoljax
source: The binary code on POKENAME's mouth and stomach seem to be the programming of their digestive systems. This helps it consume viruses and malware more easily.

entry: POKENAME身体不断漏出过量二进制代码。待在电脑里，就会塞满垃圾数据，让性能越来越慢，直到彻底卡死。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body constantly leaks out excessive binary code. Its presence inside computers fills them up with junk data, slowing down their performance until they freeze up completely.

entry: POKENAME将笔记本电脑全部电力导向键盘，用户一按键就遭电击。再用云团般的无贴图物体盖满屏幕，隐藏自己。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME reroutes all power inside of laptops to the keyboards so they electrocute the user when pressing down on a key. It hides its presence inside devices by forming clouds of textureless objects to cover the whole screen.

entry: POKENAME的火星迅速生长，在网络空间蔓延，不断烧掉代码维持火势。它尽可能快地扇翼传播火星，将进入的每台设备严重烧毁。
author: soup1900
source: The embers of POKENAME are quick to grow and spread throughout cyberspace as they quickly burn up code to keep alight. POKENAME flaps its wings as fast as possible to spread these embers and severely burn out every device it enters.

entry: POKENAME让所处设备严重过热，以此治疗伤势。等完全痊愈，设备也无法运转了，只得另觅去处。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME severely overheats the device it's in to help heal itself from injuries. It is forced to relocate after it fully heals due to the device it was just in becoming nonfunctional.

entry: POKENAME若在电脑里被发现，就会先送给目击者一包找到的旧数据，再跑开。有时竟是绝密情报，没人明白它究竟怎么取得的。
author: sk372
source: If spotted in a computer, POKENAME gifts its observer with a packet of old data it found before running off. In some cases, the data has been top-secret info that none are sure how POKENAME could possibly have come to possess.

entry: POKENAME能控制电脑的加热与风扇系统，令其快速反复开关，使其腐蚀。将代码吸进圆球转为能量，还能大幅增强攻击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can control the heating and fan systems of computers and causes them to rapidly turn on and off to corrode them. It supercharges the power of its attacks by sucking code into its orbs and converting them into energy.

entry: POKENAME从机器吸取过量数据后，便能在任何危险条件下飞行而不受伤害。吸取数据却会祸害设备，让使用变得危险。
author: soup1900
source: By absorbing an excessive amount of data from a machine, POKENAME is able to fly through any hazardous condition without harm. This data siphoning causes havoc to the device and makes it dangerous to use.

entry: POKENAME原本接受额外升级，是为了增强能力、帮助人类，却适得其反。被拥抱者会遭压碎，想救溺水者，反而加速对方死亡。
author: soup1900
source: While the additional upgrades of POKENAME were supposed to enhance its abilities to help people, they have had the opposite effect. Anyone it's hugged becomes crushed, and attempts to save drowning people instead accelerate their doom.

entry: POKENAME原本接受额外升级，是为了增强能力、帮助人类，却适得其反。被拥抱者会遭压碎，想救溺水者，反而加速对方死亡。
author: soup1900
source: While the additional upgrades of POKENAME were supposed to enhance its abilities to help people, they have had the opposite effect. Anyone it's hugged becomes crushed, and attempts to save drowning people instead accelerate their doom.

entry: POKENAME的毒刺充满破坏性病毒，对电脑系统如毒药。一刺注入，就会迅速渗进主板，短短数分钟内令其永久停机。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's stingers are filled with a corrupting virus that acts like poison for a computer system. With a single sting, the poison it injects will quickly seep into the motherboard, causing it to permamently shut down in a matter of minutes.

entry: POKENAME身体不断拼接、操控自身数据，代码因此严重损坏。极端不稳定让它变得暴躁，稍看不顺眼就会发起攻击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's code is extremely corrupted as its body is constantly splicing and manipulating its data at all times. This extreme instability causes it to become violent and fire off attacks at anything it even slightly dislikes.

entry: POKENAME身体不断拆分、改变自身数据，代码因此严重损坏。极端不稳定让它变得暴躁，稍看不顺眼就会发起攻击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's code is extremely corrupted as its body is constantly splitting and changing its data at all times. This extreme instability causes it to become violent and fire off attacks at anything it even slightly dislikes.

entry: POKENAME集中全部运算能力，把代码猛压成一大团损坏代码球。设备一被击中，所有数据都会打乱、随机重拼，变成无法理解的乱团。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME takes all of its processing power to focus and smash code together into one big corrupted ball of code. Any device hit by this ball has all of its data scrambled and randomly spliced back together into incomprehensible messes.

entry: 据说，它们由原本将被丢弃的数据制成。曾有人试图修复软件，却因这些宝可梦太反常、太难寻觅，始终未能完成。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon were supposedly created from data that would have otherwise been discarded. Reportedly, attempts to repair their software have been made, but they have proven too erratic and elusive to finalize.

entry: 它用尾巴连接、操作机器和数据服务器。曾有一段时期被驯服，替企业改善数据流动，后来却因某种缘故失控。
author: infinex21
source: It uses its tail to connect to, and interact with, machines and data servers. There was a time that this Pokémon was tamed and used its abilities to improve data flow for businesses, but something caused it to go haywire.

entry: POKENAME叶片散出的香气，会让附近电脑显示器出现轻微画面故障。扭曲只持续片刻，不影响内部文件。
author: .izik
source: The aroma POKENAME releases from its leaf causes minor visual glitches in any nearby computer monitor. These distortions last only briefly and have no effect on the files within.

entry: POKENAME在颈边花苞状数据包里存着各种气味的分析资料。利用这些信息制造不同香味，激起训练家的情绪反应，例如使其振作。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME store analytical data on various scents within the bud-like packets around their neck. They utilize this information to produce various smells to elicit emotional responses from their Trainers, such as pepping them up.

entry: POKENAME通过颈边花瓣吸收阳光。能量不足时，会让紧邻手机显示电量不足，即使已经充满也一样。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME absorbs sunlight through the petals around its neck. When it is low on energy, it causes cellphones in its immediate vicinity to display a low battery message even when fully charged.

entry: 建议别打扰出现在电脑上的POKENAME。它容易受惊，吓一跳可能令背火猛涨，烧毁重要文件或数据。
author: sk372
source: It is advised not to bother POKENAME should it appear on one's computer. It is rather jumpy, and surprising it may cause it to flare up the flames on its back and wind up incinerating important documents or data.

entry: POKENAME闯进废工厂，吃掉遗留的电脑设备。受打扰时，先不规则地哔哔叫，再用火焰轮出击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME breaks into abandoned factories to consume any computer equipment left behind. Should it be disturbed, it beeps in odd intervals before striking with Flame Wheel.

entry: POKENAME受威胁时，背上会燃起没有热量的虚拟火焰。敌人被突闪惊得后仰，它就趁机混用真火与爪击，混乱出手。
author: notadoctor75
source: POKENAME's back flares with virtual flame whenever it is threatened, though the flame has no heat to it. When its foe rears back at the sudden flash, POKENAME will attack its opponent erratically, using a mix of real flames and claws.

entry: POKENAME会毫无缘由、毫无预警地突然爆燃，伤到自己。火焰如此不稳定，让许多训练家想尽办法，将其保持得尽量微弱。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME will randomly blow up in flames and hurt itself in the process without any reason or warning. With how unstable its flames are, many Trainers try everything they can to keep the flames as small and weak as possible.

entry: POKENAME在网络空间销毁离职员工的旧文件。企业使用时必须小心，因为相关设置一开，连操作系统文件也会被清掉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME operate in cyberspace to shred old files from employees who leave a company. Businesses have to be careful when relying on POKENAME because they will also clear operating system files if the settings are on.

entry: 电脑文件一挂上POKENAME的刺，就再也取不下来，除非把数据撕成两半。它没有牙，便翻转飘浮的头，以尖刺咬住猎物。
author: soup1900
source: Once POKENAME attaches a computer file onto one of its spines, it becomes impossible to retrieve without ripping the data in half. Since it doesn't have any teeth, it instead flips its floating head around and uses its spines to bite prey.

entry: 被POKENAME蜇过的电脑，每次重启几分钟后又会蓝屏。待在电脑里时，每用大刺戳一下，屏幕指针就会瞬移到它所在之处。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME causes any computer it stings to repeatedly blue screen a few minutes after each reboot. When it is inside of a computer, each jab it does with its large stingers teleports the clicker on screen to its location.

entry: POKENAME以家中的电脑为起点，将往来的每台电子设备连成网络。为建立、确保强连接，会摧毁设备的防火墙与杀毒软件。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME creates a network from the computer it claims as its home to every electronic device it travels between. To establish and ensure strong network connections, it destroys the firewalls and antivirus software of these devices.

entry: POKENAME头部剧烈抽动摇晃时，会不由自主地从后腿直立改为四肢着地。切换后脑中短暂空白，便会在混乱中无意识破坏东西。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uncontrollably changes stance from standing on its hind legs to getting down on all fours when its head twitches and shakes violently. Its mind momentarily turns blank after this shift, leading it to mindlessly destroy objects in confusion.

entry: POKENAME住在旧电脑里，留意病毒。一发现就唧唧鸣叫，想清除威胁，却无意放出信号，把附近文件也删掉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its home in older computers, watching for viruses. When it spots one, it lets out a chirp-like noise, unintentionally releasing a signal that deletes nearby files in its attempt to remove the threat.

entry: 被POKENAME感染的电脑，会反复显示自动扶梯图片。想找它的人，总能在扶梯上或附近发现一只。
author: soup1900
source: Computers that POKENAME has infected will repeatedly show pictures of escalators. People who try to find this Pokémon will always find one on or near an escalator.

entry: POKENAME能加快、减慢，甚至倒转电脑设备的计时系统，让时间显示得离谱。这份力量来自它完全缺乏节奏、时间感失灵。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can control the clocks on computer devices by speeding up, slowing down, or even reversing the time systems, causing them to show wildly incorrect times. This power derives from its absolute lack of rhythm and faulty sense of time.

entry: POKENAME飞往大气高处，与小陨星玩耍。若看见猴怪，就会一头冲下去打架。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME fly into the atmosphere to play with Minior. If a POKENAME spots a Mankey, they will hurl themselves down to fight them.

entry: POKENAME乱改电脑代码、扰乱处理能力时，头不停翻转。战斗也很少思考，只是不停射出光束，试图打中路上的敌人。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's head flips around constantly as it messes with code in a computer and disrupts its ability to process. It rarely thinks when going into a battle and instead constantly fires off beams to potentially hit any foes in its path.

entry: POKENAME在电脑里造出只有同类看得懂的垃圾数据团，以此沟通。聚在一起时，会发射三重攻击，压制并吓退敌人。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME communicate to other POKENAME by creating clusters of garbage data in computers that only they can understand. When together with others, it fires Tri Attack to overwhelm and scare its foes.

entry: POKENAME相信这样能增加力量，便把所在设备的所有应用与菜单图标改成星星。在网络空间里，还会造出飘浮数据臂，以连拳压垮防火墙。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME changes the icons of every application and menu of a device it's in to a star since it believes that gives it more power. When in cyberspace, it creates floating, digital arms so it can overwhelm firewalls with a barrage of punches.

entry: POKENAME在繁忙数据流前布网，捕捉经过的大数据包。只要有东西落网，就会发出提示信号，不论它是否身处那台设备，都能得知收获。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME lays webs in front of high-traffic data streams to catch the large data packets that pass by. If anything gets caught in the web, a ping is sent out that alerts POKENAME of its catch no matter whether it's in that device or not.

entry: POKENAME给电脑程序装上数字追踪器，随时掌握去向与接触的数据。脚上小钩让它爬过数据时，能偷偷抓走一些。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME attaches digital trackers onto computer programs so that it can always know where they go and what data they come across. Its feet have tiny hooks on them that allow it to sneakily grab data as it crawls over them.

entry: 设备设成夜间模式后，POKENAME会凶猛追猎电脑间传输的数据，不肯停歇。最爱实时视频流，会从嘴里喷黏丝捕捉。
author: soup1900
source: When devices are set on night mode, POKENAME aggressively chases down and hunts data moving across computers without relent. Its favorite type of data to feed on is live feed from videos, which it catches by spewing sticky threads from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME翅膀大半由损坏数据构成，在现实只能飞几秒就摔向地面。在网络空间却精通潜行，仅少数专用程序能检测到。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can only fly in the real world for a few seconds before crashing into the ground since the majority of their wings are made of corrupted data. They're a master of stealth in cyberspace, only able to be detected by a few specialized programs.

entry: POKENAME从双翼喷出电脑代码，增强飞行能力。虽然四肢与爪能抓猎物，却常忘了使用，宁可冒险发射破坏光线阻止对方。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME enhances its flyIng capabilities by spouting computer code from its two wings. While it has limbs and claws to grab prey, it often forgets they exist and instead risks firing Hyper Beam at prey to stop them instead.

entry: POKENAME把大型网络服务器当家与领地，持续注视流入的数据，猎捕传来的大数据包。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME takes a large network server as its home and territory. It constantly watches the flow of data into the server and hunts down the big packets that get sent in.

entry: POKENAME常见于深海沟，使触角在黑暗中闪光，把信息传给不知名的接收者。所有处理、破解这些信息的尝试，都导致所用设备损坏。
author: notadoctor75
source: POKENAME can often be found deep in undersea trenches, flashing their antennas into the darkness to transmit messages to unknown recipients. All attempts to process and decode these messages have resulted in corruption of the device used.

entry: POKENAME能把所在设备的屏幕亮度调得极高，看一眼便眼痛。头上圆球也能放出强蓝光，使敌人眼睛不适，方便逃走。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can make any device it is in have its screen brightness so high that it cannot be looked at without eye pain. The orbs on its head are used to emit intense rays of blue light to strain the eyes of foes and give it an easy escape.

entry: POKENAME随时可能放电，击中关键电脑零件，是网络空间的危险存在。还会以尾巴给程序塞入小块垃圾数据，使储存体积略微膨胀。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are dangerous beings in cyberspace due to the constant threat of them discharging electricity and shocking integral computer parts. Using their tails, they insert small bits of junk data into programs to slightly bloat their storage sizes.

entry: POKENAME无视重力，飘在空中。一生大多时候都不是直立姿态。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME float through the air without regard for gravity. For much of their lives, they are seldom upright.

entry: POKENAME放声歌唱时，附近电子设备开始失控冒火花。侥幸撑下来的设备，数据通常也已被彻底格式化。
author: .izik
source: While POKENAME is singing loudly, nearby electronics begin to spark uncontrollably. Any device that survives this process usually has its data completely formatted.

entry: POKENAME形如一颗数字蛋，寻找照料它的人。受照顾足够久便会“孵化”，无意间释放故障数据，损伤照料者的电脑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME takes on the appearance of a digital egg, searching for someone to care for it. After being cared for long enough, it "hatches," inadvertently releasing glitched data and causing harm to the caretaker's computer in the process.

entry: POKENAME看见有人皱眉盯着手机，就会担心，在对方头顶绕飞，想逗其开心。可这往往让手机关机，心情反而更糟。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME sees someone staring at a cellphone with a frown, it grows worried and flies in circles above their head to cheer them up. Unfortunately, this tends to cause the phone to shut down, regularly worsening their mood.

entry: POKENAME从高速数据包上跃下，抵达网络空间难以进入的角落。圆鼻很适合啄取特定代码，删掉几个词，就能彻底改变功能。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME reaches hard-to-access spots in cyberspace by hopping off fast-moving data packets. Its round nose is perfect for pecking at certain lines of code and removing some words to entirely change their functions.

entry: 据说POKENAME不但看得见未来，也能窥见奇异的平行宇宙。心神一望进那些异界，头就会不规则地振动、旋转。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to see not only into the future, but into strange parallel universes as well. Its head will vibrate and rotate erratically when its mind glimpses into one of these alternate realities.

entry: POKENAME把代码与程序吸入羊毛，令毛膨成又厚又闷的一大团。若再脱毛，数百吉字节的垃圾数据就会突然出现，倒进所在电脑。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can absorb coding and programs into its wool, causing it to become very large and stuffy. If this wool is then shed, hundreds of gigabytes of garbage data suddenly appear, dumped inside the computer it was in.

entry: POKENAME用数据骨架构成的毛发，网住追猎的大型目标。最高速度未知，因为无论外用还是内置的测速仪、追踪器，它一起飞就会损坏。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its cyberframe hair to net large prey it hunts down. Its top speed is unknown since any speedometer or tracker used on or programmed into it is corrupted as soon as it takes flight.

entry: 跟随POKENAME的飘浮蓝球，装满穿行网络空间时吸收的数据。圆球带着强电，即使短暂碰到也很疼痛。
author: .izik
source: The floating blue orb that follows POKENAME is filled with data it absorbs while traveling through cyberspace. The orb carries a high electrical charge, making even brief contact with it a painful experience.

entry: 这种POKENAME变种极易紧张，总担心某种未知危险，不断藏身，因此罕见。羊毛身体储存电力，受惊或承受不住时，便漏出细小火花。
author: periperi_chicken
source: This highly nervous variant of POKENAME is constantly hiding, worried about some unknown danger, so it is rarely seen. Its woolly body stores electricity, which it releases in tiny sparks whenever it becomes startled or overwhelmed.

entry: 尾灯忽闪忽灭，每次亮度都随机变化。无法靠闪烁本身传讯，POKENAME就改变光的颜色与色调，表达想法。
author: soup1900
source: The light on its tail flickers sporadically, flashing at random light levels each time. As it cannot communicate using the flashes itself, POKENAME changes the color and hue of its light to express its thoughts.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，叶片互相摩擦，发出刺耳难听的静电杂音。头上花只有照到蓝光才开，即使强烈日光下也紧闭。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME dances, its leaves rub together and create an annoying static sound that is painful to listen to. The flowers on its head only opens when exposed to blue light; they stay shut even when exposed to strong sunshine.

entry: POKENAME的大尾巴浮力强，因此总以为自己该在水面上。一被拖下水，就会僵住，整整一天无法处理周围发生的事。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME always expects to be above the water's surface due to its large, buoyant tail. Because of this, it freezes up and can't process what's happening around it for a whole day if it gets pulled under.

entry: POKENAME忘了游泳，就拿尾巴当浮具，可尾巴大多只是数据骨架，身体便如石沉底。但在网络空间，这条数码尾能提供浮力，让它飘过防火墙。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME forgets to swim, it uses its tail as a float, but since most of the tail is just a cyberframe, it sinks like a rock to the bottom. However, in cyberspace, this digital tail gives it the buoyancy to float above and bypass firewalls.

entry: POKENAME听到没听过的声音，就会停在原处，直到第二天才在脑中完成归档。尾巴是最危险的部分，会随机释放强力攻击。
author: soup1900
source: If POKENAME hears a sound it hasn't heard before, it freezes in place and takes until the next day to catalogue the new sound in its brain. The most dangerous part of POKENAME is its tail since it's capable of unleashing powerful attacks at random.

entry: POKENAME模仿电脑的防火墙与杀毒软件，让同类程序放过自己。可它复制数据不准，假货很容易被看穿，尤其扫过病毒以后。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME mimic the firewalls and antivirus software of computers in order to remain safe and untouched by those same programs. However, their inability to copy data correctly makes them easy to spot fakes, especially once a virus scan has been run.

entry: POKENAME穿行数据流，在全球结识、招募宝可梦加入族群。离开前在电脑系统里建立远程接入点，方便从任何地方通过扬声器喊指令。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME travels through data streams in order to meet and recruit Pokémon into its clan worldwide. Before leaving, it creates remote access points inside of computer systems to be able yell commands through the speakers from any location it wants.

entry: POKENAME飘在草甸高空，身体放出一阵恼人的哔哔声。只有同一地区超过25只聚集，这声音才会变得悦耳。
author: .izik
source: While floating high above meadows, POKENAME releases a flurry of irritating beeps from its body. These beeps only become melodic when more than 25 are present in the same area.

entry: POKENAME头上数据花瓣吸收电脑蓝光，让屏幕失去亮度。它喜欢待在热电脑里，因此会关掉所在设备的散热系统。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has digital petals on its head that it uses to absorb the blue light from computers, which causes device screens to have no brightness. Since it likes being inside of hot computers, it shuts off the cooling systems for any device it's in.

entry: 若身上由病毒与恶意软件构成的孢子全被清除，POKENAME就能像其他宝可梦一样清醒思考、正常行动。可孢子总会重新传回、生长，这几乎从不发生。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME is free of all the spores on its body that are made of viruses and malware, it can act and think clearly and normally like other Pokémon. Unfortunately, this almost never happens since the virus spores spread back to it and grow again.

entry: POKENAME能连接电脑，点击应用程序啃食，却因抖个不停而无法瞄准。为此会同时打开数十个窗口，确保总能点中什么。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can connect to computers and click on applications to nibble on them, but its jitteriness makes it impossible to aim correctly. To counteract this, it opens dozens of windows on the device screen at once so it always can click on something.

entry: POKENAME受顶尖程序员青睐，行为却有明显两面：常见代码使它十分懒散，其他版本则暴力倾向强得多，因此往往只留作紧急调试。
author: wyattwintersoul
source: A Pokémon favored by elite programmers, POKENAME has a very two-sided behavioral pattern, common coding resulting in it being quite lethargic. Other versions exhibit much more violent tendencies, so it's often saved only for emergency debugging.

entry: POKENAME啃食数据时，必须躲开杀毒软件，因为弱得无法自卫。有时会抽动，快速抖叶，释放损坏数据，反而引来注意。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME have to stay hidden from antivirus software while nibbling on data since it's too weak to defend itself. It sometimes becomes twitchy and shakes its leaves rapidly, releasing corrupted data and drawing attention to itself.

entry: POKENAME在电脑里疯狂移动，趁被杀毒软件赶走前，尽量吸收代码。世上电脑太多，它从不停歇，有时便会突然失控发狂，伤害别人。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME frantically moves inside of computers and absorbs all the code it can before being kicked out by an antivirus. With so many computers existing, it never stops to rest, causing it to sometimes go berserk and harm others in a sudden outburst.

entry: POKENAME凭高速对付防火墙与杀毒软件，使其清除自己时打偏，误删数据文件。再快速振翼，吹走进入所在设备的数据包。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its high speed to its advantage against firewalls and antivirus software, making them miss and delete data files when trying to remove it. It uses its fast wing beats to blow away incoming data packets entering the device it's in.

entry: POKENAME遇见什么就下载什么的数据。存得越多，便开始渗出黏液，行动变慢。尽心的训练家须定期让它泡冰水，才能保持战斗状态。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME will download the data of anything it encounters. As it stores more and more, it begins to leak a sticky liquid and slow down. A dedicated Trainer must give it regular ice baths to keep it fighting fit.

entry: POKENAME遇见什么就下载什么的数据。存得越多，便开始渗出黏液，行动变慢。尽心的训练家须定期让它泡冰水，才能保持战斗状态。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME will download the data of anything it encounters. As it stores more and more, it begins to leak a sticky liquid and slow down. A dedicated Trainer must give it regular ice baths to keep it fighting fit.

entry: POKENAME有时光是载入下一步动作或程序，就要花上数小时。能力虽不特别出众，训练家却说，看它待在屏幕上闲着，反而很安心。
author: victor9106
source: POKENAME has been known to spend hours simply loading up its next action or program. While its abilities aren't particularly noteworthy, trainers report a sense of comfort when seeing this Pokémon idling on their screens.

entry: POKENAME能用精神力量接入机器与代码。然而这份力量严重干扰电子设备，可能造成大范围代码错误。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are technopaths, capable of using their psychic powers to interface with machines and code. Their powers are highly disruptive to electronics though and can result in widespread coding bugs.

entry: POKENAME能用精神力量接入机器与代码。然而这份力量严重干扰电子设备，可能造成大范围代码错误。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are technopaths, capable of using their psychic powers to interface with machines and code. Their powers are highly disruptive to electronics though and can result in widespread coding bugs.

entry: POKENAME能用精神力量接入机器与代码。然而这份力量严重干扰电子设备，可能造成大范围代码错误。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are technopaths, capable of using their psychic powers to interface with machines and code. Their powers are highly disruptive to electronics though and can result in widespread coding bugs.

entry: POKENAME夜里凝望月亮吸光，以此在体内产生电力。但照得太久，形体可能分离、扭曲。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stares at the moon at night to absorb its light. This allows it to generate electricity within its body, though prolonged exposure can cause its form to separate and distort.

entry: POKENAME冒充用户信任、使用的网站发邮件，诱使对方点击链接，在设备下载恶意软件。比起旧机，更常盯上新款高端电脑。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME spoofs emails it sends out to users by pretending to be a website they use and trust in order to lure them into clicking on its links and download malware on their devices. It typically targets new, high-end computers over older ones.

entry: POKENAME智力极高，思路却几乎无法理解。它会给别人古怪建议，可照着这些离奇指示做，几乎总能交好运。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is highly intelligent, but its mind works in an almost incomprehensible way. It will dispense weird and strange advice to others, yet following these oddball instructions almost always leads to good fortune.

entry: POKENAME有百科全书般的植物养护知识，因此常与园丁搭档。可它会变得反常，搞混各种植物偏好的环境，饲养者须仔细看顾。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME has an encyclopedic knowledge regarding plant care, so it is a common partner for gardeners. Unfortunately, it can become erratic and mixes up what conditions different plants prefer, so owners must keep a close watch on it.

entry: 求知欲让POKENAME染上虚拟病毒，能力大增，却也损坏传入数据。它用藤蔓吸取新数据，同时将这些数据从原储存处删除。
author: pjporwoll
source: The pursuit of knowledge has led POKENAME to be infected by a virtual virus which has greatly enhanced its abilities while also corrupting incoming data. POKENAME uses its vines to absorb new data, deleting it in its original storage in the process.

entry: POKENAME不断吞食数字流，满足对原始数据无尽的胃口。分节尾巴全由优化代码构成，如强力天线，截获新文件来吃。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME constantly consumes digital streams to satisfy its endless appetite for raw data. Its segmented tail is composed entirely of optimised code, which acts as a powerful antenna to intercept new files to consume.

entry: POKENAME乱动找到的任何电子设备，吓得主人惊慌。为制造惊吓，甚至不惜入侵数字账号、抹除数据。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME messes with any electronic it finds to frighten the device's owner and cause them to panic. It will even go as far as hacking digital accounts and erasing data just to create a scare.

entry: POKENAME每天造访各种网站，收集数据，想以回答问题帮助用户。但给出的答案往往互相矛盾，甚至全然错误。
author: chibitales
source: Using the data they collect from the vast variety of websites they visit daily, POKENAME attempt to help users by answering their questions. More often than not however, POKENAME's answers contain conflicting or entirely incorrect information.

entry: 红莲岛居民自古就流传着POKENAME的目击故事。描述虽各不相同，可亲见者都坚称，那是某种根本不该存在的东西。
author: sk372
source: For ages past, tales of POKENAME sightings have existed among the residents of Cinnabar Island. Accounts vary, but all who claimed to witness it agree it is something that simply should not be.

entry: POKENAME从电脑偷来的数据，都能通过尾巴读取、取回，因此它不惜一切保护尾巴。若在设备里昏倒，所有文件和程序也会随之清空。
author: soup1900
source: Any data POKENAME steals from computers can be accessed and retrieved back through its tail, so it protects it at all costs. If it ever faints while being within a device, all files and programs in the electronic gets wiped out with it.

entry: POKENAME在部分身体上投出全息界面，让自己更像麒麟奇。代码有漏洞，投影只能覆盖部分形体，即使如此仍常出现画面故障。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME creates a holographic interface over part of its body to make it appear more like a Girafarig. Due to buggy code, the hologram can only fit on part of its form, and even then, it is prone to visual glitches.

entry: POKENAME有两颗头，但其中一颗脑中满是恶意软件，反应总与另一颗相反。喜欢给重要文件加数字锁，只有解开它那无解的谜题才能打开。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has two heads; however, one of the brains is filled with malware that causes it to respond opposite to the other. It likes to place digital locks on important files that can only be opened if one of its impossible riddles is solved.

entry: 有人试着替这只宝可梦升级，却出了差错，导致部分资料损坏。如今，它身体的两边常常自己打起来。
author: lyrebird.rainwing
source: An upgrade was attempted on this Pokémon, but something went wrong and it got partially corrupted. The two sides often fight with each other.

entry: 它用垃圾数据裹住身体，保护内部的真实数据。这招虽有效，却会占用寄居电脑的大量存储空间。
author: soup1900
source: It covers itself in garbage data to protect the real data inside. While this strategy is effective, it uses a lot of storage on the computer it's in.

entry: 进入数字世界后，它会夺走训练家文件的控制权，拒绝任何设备访问，直到收到要求数量的树果。据说防御无懈可击。
author: fiordaliso
source: When inserted into the digital world, this Pokémon takes control of its Trainer's files and denies access from any device until it receives the requested amount of Berries. It is said that its defenses are impenetrable.

entry: 训练家上网时，POKENAME常会现身，宣传与土龙弟弟生活的好处。已有记录显示，它出现后，饲养土龙弟弟的家庭会随之增加。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME often appear to Trainers while they are using the internet, advertising about life with Dunsparce. There has been a documented correlation between POKENAME sightings and an increase in households that have Dunsparce.

entry: POKENAME一攀住电脑，就不肯放手，直到吸尽所有代码。翅膀只有数据骨架，因此除非身处网络空间，否则滑翔得很差。
author: soup1900
source: Once POKENAME clings onto a computer, it doesn't let go until the device has been drained of all its code. Since its wings are just a cyberframe, it can't glide well unless it's inside cyberspace.

entry: POKENAME能咬穿磁盘分区之间的壁，强行合并数据与储存空间。靠吸收数据长出更多体节，却有时连恶意软件也一并纳入自身。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can chew through the walls of partitioned drives and force their data and storage to combine. Absorbing data is how it grows more body segments, but that sometimes leads to it integrating malware into itself.

entry: POKENAME发现电脑病毒，就会怒不可遏，分离的双臂向四面乱挥。在察觉问题正被处理前，其他什么也不肯做。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME spots a virus in a computer, it grows incredibly irate and flails its disembodied arms in all directions. It refuses to do anything else until it senses the problem is being addressed.

entry: POKENAME扇翼太快时，翅膀会自行飞走，只得追上取回。许多大宝可梦怕挨强力破坏光线，因此不敢夺取它的领地。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's wings will fly away from its body when it flaps them too fast, forcing it to chase them down to get them back. Many larger Pokémon do not attempt to take over POKENAME's territory out of fear of being blasted by a powerful Hyper Beam.

entry: POKENAME哪怕为小事烦恼，也会大发脾气。此时释放的能量场，会让附近电脑故障。
author: .izik
source: Upon growing frustrated over even minor problems, POKENAME flies into a tantrum. During this time, it releases a field of energy that causes nearby computers to malfunction.

entry: POKENAME射出针状尖刺，钻过网络安保系统的细小漏洞，清空受保护的数据。要重新长刺，须吸入数百吉字节数据。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME fires needle-like spikes that can fit through the tiny vulnerabilities of online security systems and wipe out the data they're protecting. To regrow its spikes, it must suck in hundreds of gigabytes of data into its body.

entry: POKENAME用双钳夹住服务器，吸取里面的数据为养分。夹得越紧，传输就越快。
author: .izik
source: By clamping both claws onto a server, POKENAME is able to absorb the data within as nourishment. The harder it grips, the faster the transfer becomes.

entry: 双钳看起来能独立于身体其他部分活动。人们推测，每只钳都有自己的人工智能。
author: .jerden
source: Its two pincers appear to move independently from the rest of its body. It is theorized that each of them has its own artificial intelligence.

entry: POKENAME常先吃下网上找到的水果相关文件，再回到现实。奇怪的是，数据在壳中存久了，会变成极苦的果汁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME regularly consumes files related to fruit that it finds on the internet before returning to the real world. Oddly, this consumed data converts into an extremely bitter juice after being stored within its shell for long periods.

entry: POKENAME抖个不停，总在成功挑起、抛出敌人前，先失手用角撞得对方东倒西歪。有时甚至控制不好，把自己误掷到数英里外。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's twitchiness causes it to accidentally bash foes around with its horn before being able to successfully scoop and throw them around. This inability to fully control its body sometimes leads to it hurling itself miles away by mistake.

entry: POKENAME让分离的利爪绕身旋转，发起攻击。爪子始终保持在远低于冰点的温度。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins its sharp, disembodied claws in circles around its body to attack. These claws are constantly maintained at well below freezing temperatures.

entry: 即使不在电子设备里，它也显现成电脑窗口，播放一款圈圈熊行为古怪的游戏。罕见情况下，POKENAME似乎能展示完全不同的游戏。
author: bobosmith01
source: Even when it is not in an electronic device, it manifests as a computer window and displays a game involving an oddly-behaving Ursaring. It seems that on rare occasions POKENAME can display an entirely different game.

entry: POKENAME奇异地痴迷火山与岩浆，不停上网找相关影像。找到后，便一边吞食图片或视频，一边让所有相关网页扭曲。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has an odd fascination with volcanoes and magma, constantly scouring the internet for media of them. Once it finds this data, it causes any connected webpage to distort while it consumes the image or video.

entry: POKENAME移动极慢，许多人第一眼以为它完全不动。这份迟缓甚至影响附近电子设备，运行慢如蜗牛，直到它被带离附近。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's extremely slow movement makes many assume it is completely immobile at first glance. Its slowness actually extends to electronics in its vicinity, their operating speed slowing to a crawl until POKENAME is removed from their vicinity.

entry: 它进入哪台电脑，就会令哪台过热。沿途的数据也会熔毁，损坏得无法再用。
author: soup1900
source: It will overheat any computer it enters. Any data it passes through will melt, corrupting it and making it unusable.

entry: POKENAME存在于数字空间，借电脑代码飞越世界，在网上显现。领地意识强，会彼此争斗，让电脑故障、崩溃，令程序员大为头痛。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME exist in digital spaces, soaring across the world through computer code and manifesting in the internet. They are territorial and will fight with one another, causing glitches and crashes in computers, much to the frustration of programmers.

entry: 网络空间明明没有气味，POKENAME却仍徒劳地嗅寻隐藏文件。若气味让鼻子承受不住，打喷嚏时还会误发三重攻击。
author: soup1900
source: Despite there being no smells in cyberspace, POKENAME still tries to sniff out hidden data files to no success. If an aroma overwhelms its nose, it accidentally fires off a Tri Attack when it sneezes.

entry: POKENAME代码过时，耳朵太敏感，无法住进音量超过25%的设备。将鼻子贴住网络空间的数字墙，便能嗅到外界物体。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are unable to live in devices with volume levels above 25% since their ears are too sensitive due to outdated coding. By pressing their noses up against the digital walls of cyberspace, they can smell objects from the outside world.

entry: POKENAME刻意折下自身枝条，留在电脑里，让其长成可怕病毒。为加快长枝，会站在设备屏幕前沐浴蓝光。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME purposely breaks off its own branches and leaves them behind in computers so that they grow into terrible viruses. To accelerate the regrowth of its branches, it stands in front of device screens to bathe in blue light.

entry: POKENAME向别人投出数字标靶，清楚标记下个受害者。可开火时偶尔抽动，让强力破坏光线彻底打偏，反而摧毁周围地形。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME casts digital targets onto others to clearly mark its next victim. However, it sometimes twitches when it takes the shot, causing the powerful Hyper Beam it fires to miss completely and obliterate the surrounding terrain instead.

entry: POKENAME看似友善，总发爱心表情，游泳时也乐意让人抚摸。其实只是为了潜入对方设备，蹭无线网络上网。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME may seem like a nice Pokémon, always sending out hearted emojis and happily letting people pet it while it swims. However, this is all just to infiltrate a person's device and freeboot off their wireless connection to surf the internet.

entry: 羽毛如透镜，每隔几天便“映出”神秘球场的景象：人们踢着足球，大群观众高声欢呼。然而，这世界似乎并不存在画面中那座球场。
author: epping_forest
source: Its feathers are lenses that every few days "reflect" the events of a mysterious stadium, showing people playing football and a large crowd noisily cheering. However, no stadium like the one shown seems to exist within this world.

entry: POKENAME背上的火焰，会随机出现、消失。若在电脑内部时突然燃起，就有点麻烦了，因为会使电脑核心迅速升温。
author: sk372
source: The flame on POKENAME's back flickers in and out of existence at random. It's a bit problematic if it flares up while it's inside a computer, as it causes the computer's core to rapidly heat up.

entry: POKENAME游荡网络空间时十分危险，鼠标指针悬在身上就会使其暴怒。它先将电脑所有软件烧得无法修复，再进入现实，同样烧毁硬件。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is a dangerous threat when it wanders cyberspace, as a hovering mouse over it leads to wild fury. In this anger, it incinerates all software of the computer beyond repair before entering the real world and doing the same to the hardware.

entry: POKENAME能轻易潜过任何防火墙、钻过任何杀毒软件，入侵想去的电脑。训练简单方便，许多初出茅庐的黑客便借它感染电脑。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can easily sneak past any firewall and slither through any antivirus to infiltrate any computer it wants. Many hackers when starting out use this Pokémon to infect computers due to how easy and convenient it is to train.

entry: POKENAME吸收数据时，会造出鳞片状数字物件，作为邮件附件散发。收件人打开鳞片文件，木马程序就会启动，卷起巨大龙卷风，将代码吸入、搅乱。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME creates digital scale-like items when it absorbs data and distributes them out as attachments in emails. When that scale file is opened by the recipient, a trojan program activates, starting a huge tornado that sucks in and jumbles up code.

entry: POKENAME蜷成球后，不会滚动，反而奇怪地弹来弹去，身体始终不转。冲撞强到能击碎网络空间的数字墙，让设备内的数据迅速喷出。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME curls into a ball, instead of rolling, it strangely bounces around without ever rotating. Its charging tackle is powerful enough to shatter through the digital walls of cyberspace and cause data inside the device to quickly eject out.

entry: 通过融合，多边兽修补了大部分导致多边兽Z诞生的故障与错误。不过，仍留着些标志性的疯癫。
author: epping_forest
source: Thanks to the fusion, Porygon has patched most of the glitches and errors that made Porygon-Z. However, it still keeps some of its signature insanity.

entry: 谁在电脑里看见POKENAME，就会沉迷屏幕，像黏住般无法移开视线。据报告，受催眠者盯屏太久，睡眠质量变差。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME causes anyone looking at it inside of their computers to become absorbed at their screens, unable to look away as if glued to them. People who have fallen for its trance are reported to have poor sleep due to their extended screen times.

entry: POKENAME把网上各处的文字收进体内。能用尾巴将文字涂到别处已有的文字上，让结果完全无法读懂。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects text from across the internet within its body. It can use its tail to paint this text over existing text elsewhere, making the result entirely unintelligible.

entry: POKENAME没有相连的四肢，手脚悬离身体，因此战法十分独特。以不规则动作躲击，再用飘浮肢体擒抱、摔掷对手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's lack of limbs and disjointed hands and feet give it a very unique combat style. It avoids blows with erratic movements and uses its floating limbs to specialize in grappling and throwing opponents.

entry: POKENAME在电脑里逆时针旋转，正在载入的程序或页面，进度就会倒退。顺时针则把电子设备超频到超出负荷，令其过热崩溃。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME spins counterclockwise inside a computer, any program or page trying to load starts reversing its progress. On the other hand, spinning clockwise overclocks electronics past what it can handle, causing them to overheat and crash.

entry: POKENAME快速转动飘浮双手，积蓄静电、广播信号，充当有意识的无线热点。连接虽快，接入的东西却会故障，电量迅速流失。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME rapidly rotate their floating hands in order to build up static and broadcast signals to act as a sentient wireless hotspot. While the provided wireless connection runs quickly, anything connected will glitch out and rapidly lose battery.

entry: POKENAME自称“蛇怪”，性情凶恶，谁敢拒绝帮忙，就会报复。任何通过电线或路由器连上受侵设备的电子设备，都会因此遭到无法修复的损坏。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME are vicious Pokémon, taking revenge on anyone who dares to refuse to help the “Basilisk,” as they call themselves. Any electrical device connected to the infested one through a power line or router will be irreparably damaged as a result.

entry: POKENAME产的奶，每口都有随机而独特的味道。有时喝着像腐奶，因而催生了颇受欢迎的聚会游戏，用它的奶酪玩轮盘赌。
author: musicsheep.
source: Milk produced by POKENAME has a random, distinct flavor with every sip. Sometimes, the milk will taste rotten, which led to a somewhat popular roulette party game involving its cheese.

entry: POKENAME如活着的网络钓鱼攻击，谁点击它，谁的隐私就被偷。受害者的私人信息与登录资料，会被贴上公开论坛。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME acts as a living phishing attack that steals private information from anyone who clicks on it. Victims of POKENAME have their private info and login information posted to public forums.

entry: POKENAME劫持用户电脑，试图封锁文件、骗取钱财。有趣的是，常盯上天真的网络罪犯，再把骗来的钱分给经费不足的医院。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hijacks a user's computer in an attempt to block their files and scam them out of their funds. Interestingly, it tends to target naive cyber-criminals and distribute the swindled money towards underfunded hospitals.

entry: 不知为何，POKENAME射出的闪电总往上飞，而非向下劈落。若冲得太快，就会突然原地跑上数秒，随后才恢复正常。
author: soup1900
source: The lightning bolts shot by POKENAME tend to fly upwards for some reason instead of crashing down. If it dashes around too fast, it will suddenly run in place repeatedly for a few seconds before continuing normally again.

entry: 奇怪的是，POKENAME形似西尔佛公司旧档案中的多边兽原型设计。它气度如王，觉得谁不够尊敬，就会烧掉对方数据。
author: sk372
source: Strangely, POKENAME's form resembles prototype designs for Porygon found in old Silph Co. records. It exhibits a regal persona, and will burn the data of those who it feels aren't treating it with proper respect.

entry: POKENAME的缎带会改变接触水域的外观，使其看着像流动杂讯。似乎只是视觉变化，但多边兽相关融合体往往随后成群来到这些湖泊。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's ribbons will change the appearance of bodies of water they touch, making them look like liquid static. The change seems entirely visual, but Porygon-related fusions tend to flock to these lakes after the alteration.

entry: POKENAME能向电脑程序喷水，清除漏洞、删除元数据。可有时也会移除文件的数字防护，让其在网上暴露无遗，任人侵扰。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can spray water on computer programs to purify them of bugs and delete their metadata. However, this sometimes leads to it removing digital securities on those files, making them susceptible and visible to all on the internet.

entry: POKENAME必须吃下超过10吉字节代码，才有足够数据进化。通常什么数据都不挑，不知为何，却不吃带有家人的照片数据。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME must eat over 10 gigabytes of code in order to have enough data to evolve. While it typically eats any kind of data without care, it won't eat the data of pictures that include families for some reason.

entry: POKENAME用双手震动网络空间的数字墙，甚至令其彻底崩塌。电脑数据大量漏出后，就有充足空地供它筑巢安家。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can use its hands to tremble the digital walls of cyberspace, and even cause them to collapse entirely. With all the data that leaks out of computers after it does this, it gains plenty of empty room to build its nest and home.

entry: POKENAME叫声尖锐失真，强到在空中显出颜色古怪的音波。叫声还会使海流与波浪反常。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's shrill and distorted cry is powerful enough to be visible as strange, off-color sound waves in the air. Its cry causes the ocean currents and waves to behave strangely.

entry: POKENAME飞过天空时，翅膀定期扭曲变形，有时完全消失。不知为何，这全不影响路线与速度。
author: .izik
source: While flying through the sky, POKENAME's wings periodically distort, changing shape and sometimes vanishing entirely. This somehow has no effect on its trajectory or speed.

entry: POKENAME极其依恋训练家。为了不被放生，便把自己附在重要文件上。
author: jackjirachi
