source: POKENAME have an extreme fixation on their Trainers. To avoid being released, they will attach themselves to crucial files.

entry: 设备上任何没标十六进制色码的代码行，POKENAME都会补上。它急着给一切着色，浪费大量运算能力载入颜色，也使文件膨胀。
author: soup1900
source: Any line of code on a device that doesn't have a hex color code applied to it will have one assigned by POKENAME. POKENAME's frantic need to color everything wastes lots of processing power to load the colors and bloats the sizes of files.

entry: POKENAME能让失效设备复活运转，却只能用来发动令服务器过载的拒绝服务攻击。遇到的每个电脑文件，也都被添上彩虹的十六进制色码，作为元数据。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can revive nonfunctional devices and have them running again, but only with the capabilities to overload servers with denial-of-service attacks. It attaches the hex colors of the rainbow as metadata to every computer file it comes across.

entry: POKENAME现身时，软件会出现仿佛时间错位的故障。人们尝试利用这种效果，却仍未成功。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME's appearance causes software to glitch in ways consistent with temporal displacement. Attempts to harness this effect have yet to bear fruit.

entry: 更新让POKENAME的身体移到原该是尾巴的位置，造成身体数据不足。只要遇上困惑或悲伤的事，就会僵在原地，什么也做不了，直到睡过、翌日醒来。
author: soup1900
source: Updates to POKENAME caused its body to become where the tail should be, leaving the body lacking data. Anything that causes it confusion or sadness leads to it freezing in place, unable to do anything until it sleeps and wakes up the next day.

entry: POKENAME把数据文件紧压在身上，仔细研究，将全部信息复制进脑中。可数据被彻底挤坏，文件随后就损毁，无法使用。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME squeezes data files against its body to study them intensely and copy all their information into its brain. Unfortunately, the file afterwards becomes corrupted and unusable due to the data getting crushed up completely.

entry: 某个恶意程序以POKENAME的形象编成，让它在网络社群里臭名昭著，普遍被认为烦人。但真正饲养它的训练家，却发现它乐于助人、回应积极。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME are infamous among online communities due to a malicious program coded with their likeness. There is a pervasive cultural idea that POKENAME can be annoying. However, Trainers who raise them find them to be helpful, responsive partners.

entry: POKENAME每次给敌人下咒，严重程度都随机。效果也大不相同，从突然抽动，到忍不住交出全部个人资料和密码都有。
author: soup1900
source: Each time POKENAME lays a curse onto foes, they are always random in severity. The effects of them vary largely as well, from sudden twitchy movements to urges to give out all of your personal information and passwords.

entry: 它似乎总在寻找某个人，为此会入侵任何摄像头。终于找到目标，就施下强烈诅咒。
author: shadeofblu
source: This Pokémon seems to be always searching for someone, and will hack into any form of camera to find them. When it finally finds its target, it will place a powerful hex on them.

entry: 这只数字鸟宝可梦爱管闲事，总想探知别人的秘密，装作不知情，诱使对方放松戒心。没人知道，它会把秘密分享给谁。
author: sontyp
source: This digital bird Pokémon is nosy and always looking to learn a person's secrets, feigning ignorance to lure them into a false sense of security. Nobody knows who it might share those secrets with.

entry: POKENAME上网时，看见森林图片就兴奋。它把自己插进图片，与其他树站在一起，却因配色和不停抖动而暴露。
author: .izik
source: While traveling through the internet, POKENAME grows excited when it spots images of forests. It inserts itself into the image among the other trees, though its coloring and constant jittering give it away.

entry: POKENAME爱藏在绘画和游戏程序里，将软件的全部代码拿走，编进自身程序。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME loves to hide in art and game applications. It takes all the code from the software, and incorporates it into their own.

entry: POKENAME浏览医疗网站，盼望找到帮助人类的方法。可它光是存在，往往就会损坏靠近的文件。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME traverses medical websites in hopes of finding ways to help people. Unfortunately, its mere presence tends to corrupt any files it comes near.

entry: POKENAME外表友善，却藏着能清空整座服务器集群的毁灭性病毒。即使如此，有些孤独训练家为了感受真正陪伴，仍上了它的当。
author: victor9106
source: Despite its friendly appearance, POKENAME hides a devastating virus that can wipe out entire server farms. Even so, some lonely Trainers have been known to fall for its scam so that they can feel true companionship.

entry: POKENAME尾巴一碰电子设备，就能抽走电力。若突然抽动，会瞬间释放全部储电，把自己电得焦黑。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is able to siphon the electricity from electronics when it touches its tail with the device. If it ever twitches, it will instantly release all of its stored electricity and shock itself to a crisp.

entry: POKENAME把许多程序与文件揉成一大团数据杂烩，塞进代码孔，留待以后吃。每天能吃超过1太字节，却因全是数字内容，一点也不会变胖。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME mashes together many different programs and files into one big hodgepodge of data before stuffing it into its code hole to snack on later. While it can eat over 1 terabyte of data per day, it doesn't get any fatter since it's all digital.

entry: POKENAME乖巧，脸上似乎总带笑意，却很少出声。多数人认为，笑脸不能代表它真正的心情。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is well-behaved and always seems to be wearing a smile on its face. It rarely makes a sound, however, and most believe its smile is not indicative of its actual mood.

entry: POKENAME进入设备后，会劈损关键根文件里的数据，刻成损坏代码徽记，留下标志。还会狡猾地骗杀毒软件去攻击重要程序。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME leaves its mark in every device it enters by slashing at data inside of essential root files to create a corrupted code insignia. It displays impressive cunningness by tricking antivirus software into attacking important programs.

entry: POKENAME能以海量电子信号与频率压垮电脑，使其崩溃，再也无法启动。自身单元还能产生干扰场，阻断半径50码内的一切联网。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can overload computers with such a high amount of electronic signals and frequencies that they crash and fail to boot back up ever again. It can generate a jammer field with its units to block all online connectivity within a 50 yard radius.

entry: POKENAME用自身单元设下干扰场，封住电脑收发的电子信号。它拦截、修改遇到的无线电波，使其到达目的地时已损坏。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its units to place down jammer fields to block any incoming and outgoing electronic signals for computers. It intercepts and modifies any radio waves it comes by so that they become corrupted when reaching their end destination.

entry: POKENAME劫持的无线信号能传多远，舌头就能伸多远。在网络空间伸舌，会留下一团团垃圾数据构成的唾液。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can extend its tongue to be as far out as the wireless signal it has hijacked can reach. When POKENAME uses its tongue in cyberspace, it leaves behind globs of saliva made of garbage data.

entry: POKENAME吞下大量数据，既作燃料，也作战斗弹药。无法消化的垃圾数据从掌心射出，以古怪难测的轨迹弯转。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME consumes large quantities of data not only to fuel itself, but to provide ammo for combat. Junk data it fails to digest is fired from its palms, the projectiles arcing and twisting in odd and unpredictable ways.

entry: POKENAME在电脑运行脚本，下载大量数据安装到自身，生成藤蔓。若误下病毒，就扯断那根藤，丢在原设备里，再跳往新设备。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME generates vines by running scripts on computers to download loads of data for it to install on itself. If it accidentally downloads a virus, it rips the vine off its body and abandons it in the device it was in before hopping to the new one.

entry: POKENAME双尾尖若碰到一起，就会误放数千伏电力，电到自己。试图处理的数据一流经双角之间，也会损坏、毁灭。
author: soup1900
source: If POKENAME touches the tips of its two tails together, it will accidentally let loose thousands of volts of electricity and shock itself. Any data it tries to process becomes corrupted and destroyed once it flows between its horns.

entry: POKENAME双手喷出古怪火柱。火一射出就乱跳，以难测角度弯转，让人难以防御。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fires plumes of odd flames from both of its hands. Once the fire is launched, it jerks and arcs around in unpredictable angles, making guarding against it difficult.

entry: 据说POKENAME只会出现在从未遭受恶意软件或故障的电脑里。它似乎能提升所住电脑的性能，却从不久留。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to appear only in computers that have never once been touched by malware or glitches. Its presence seems to enhance the performance of computers it inhabits, though it never lingers for long.

entry: 为它安装新程序的更新出了错，导致创造它所用的矿物数据不断被覆写。为减缓覆写，便钻地寻找数据线，吸收新数据。
author: infinex21
source: An attempt to update this Pokémon with a new program went awry, causing it to unceasingly overwrite the mineral data that had been used to create it. In an effort to slow the overwriting, it burrows in search of data cables so it may absorb new data.

entry: POKENAME抖动得厉害，难以瞄准弱点、打出最大伤害。干脆向四处轰出极强冲击波，直到敌人终于被击中、彻底消灭。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has a hard time aiming for a foe's weak spot to maximize damage since its twitchiness makes it become shaky. So instead, it blasts out extremely powerful shock waves all over until eventually the foe is hit and obliterated.

entry: POKENAME用身上叶片过滤数据，产生能量，再把无用废数据丢到身后。尾巴如刀，能切断设备网络，让其在数字世界里孤立。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME filters bits of data through the leaves on its body to produce energy before dumping the now unusable waste data behind. It uses its tail as a blade to cut internet connectivity from devices and leave them secluded in the digital world.

entry: 程序的一个怪癖大幅增强了POKENAME的寒冷能力，身体末端因此变暗。只须用其中一肢碰电脑，就能让它彻底冻结，最长达一周。
author: sk372
source: The tips of POKENAME's body have darkened due to a quirk in programming that supercharges its own cold abilities. It needs only to touch a computer with one of these limbs to cause it to freeze completely for up to a week.

entry: POKENAME一咬住电脑文件，就不松口，直到吸尽所有数据。尾巴快戳关键零件，也能让设备出现大量严重错误，随即停机。
author: soup1900
source: Once POKENAME sinks its teeth into a computer file, it will not let go until it has drained all the data from it. A quick jab with its tail into an integral device part can cause the device to receive many critical errors and shut down.

entry: POKENAME长牙的代码强到能砸穿网络空间的数字墙。可只有电脑散热良好才这么强，一受热就连痕迹也留不下。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has tusks made of such powerful code that they can smash through the digital walls of cyberspace. However, they're only this strong when inside a computer with good cooling systems; they fail to leave a mark when heated.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME首次被记录，是在红莲岛进行的一些融合实验期间。它会使附近电脑数据扭曲，显示错误数字，损坏数码照片。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is thought to have been first documented during some fusion experiments taking place on Cinnabar Island. Its presence causes computer data in its vicinity to distort, displaying incorrect numbers and corrupting digital photographs.

entry: 它能在网络空间打洞，不论距离多远，都能造出两台电脑之间的直达隧道。隧道太难预测，人类无法通行，POKENAME却能轻松穿梭。
author: victor9106
source: This Pokémon is capable of punching holes in cyberspace, creating direct tunnels from one computer to another, however far the distance may be. These tunnels are too unpredictable to be traveled by humans, but POKENAME can navigate them with ease.

entry: 这种多边兽Z的自身融合，在某些圈子里是热门研究对象。有学说认为世界是复杂模拟，而它似乎以某种方式接入了底层代码。
author: infranscia
source: This self fusion of Porygon-Z is a popular research subject in some circles.  Some theorize the world is a complex simulation.  This fusion is thought to have somehow tapped into the code.

entry: POKENAME是极其危险、行动混乱的虚拟存在。这种自身融合酷似某个都市传说，据说能瞬间移动。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME is a highly dangerous and erratic virtual entity. This self-fusion closely resembles an urban legend. POKENAME is said to possess the ability to teleport.

entry: POKENAME将头上叶子碰到电脑，就能直接吸收网络信息充饥。过程中，电脑会过热、故障。
author: .izik
source: By touching the leaf on its head to a computer, POKENAME can absorb information from the internet directly as sustenance. This causes the computer to overheat and malfunction in the process.

entry: POKENAME背上的种子极重，带着强电。放在电脑附近，就可能使内部所有图像文件损坏。
author: .izik
source: The seeds on POKENAME's back carry a strong electrical charge and are incredibly heavy. When placed near a computer, they can cause any image files inside to become corrupted.

entry: 许多POKENAME帮训练家把网上音乐和视频烧录进光盘，却得先讲清“烧”的是哪一种。许多训练家最后拿到的是烧焦塑料，而非装有数据的光盘。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many POKENAME help their Trainers burn CDs with music and video off the internet, but Trainers need to be specific with what type of burning that occurs. Many Trainers have ended up with burnt plastic instead of a CD with data.

entry: POKENAME因摄取数据而逐渐进化，但混杂数据也让它变得反常。爪比钻石还强韧，尖刺比黑曜石还锋利。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have progressively evolved from feeding on the data, though such mixed data has caused them to become erratic. Their claws are stronger than diamond and their quills are sharper than obsidian.

entry: POKENAME脚内的推进器带来极高速度与机动性。全速时，一分钟最多能向对手猛踢275下。
author: sk372
source: Boosters within POKENAME's feet allow it a great amount of speed and mobility. At maximum speed, they allow POKENAME to pummel its opponents with up to 275 kicks in the span of a minute.

entry: 战斗中，POKENAME腕边和头周的损坏代码越烧越旺。既像真火般灼伤别人，接触时也使人精神痛苦、混乱，让交战者晕头转向。
author: sk372
source: Corrupted code flares up more and more around POKENAME's wrists and head as it battles. The code burns others like normal fire, as well as causing mental distress and confusion on contact, making battling it highly disorienting.

entry: POKENAME以飘浮的鳍感知、追踪所在设备何时何处正在下载新文件。它不受体形所限，力量足以撞穿防火墙，接入其他电脑。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its floating fin to sense and track when and where new files are being downloaded in the device it's in. Despite its size, it possesses the strength necessary to bash through firewalls and access other computers.

entry: 训练家若表示欣赏，POKENAME就兴奋过头，失手朝对方脸上轰出破坏光线。它以巨力砸开数据流下方的洞，造出休息处。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME get overexcited if a Trainer appreciates them and will accidentally blast them in the face with a Hyper Beam. Using their immense strength, they smash through holes below data streams to create a place to rest.

entry: POKENAME吐的水碰到电脑，奇怪地不会烧坏系统，却会让内部数据彻底损坏，所有文件全失去作用。
author: .izik
source: Should the water POKENAME spits come into contact with a computer, it curiously does not fry the system. Instead, the data inside becomes completely corrupted, rendering all files useless.

entry: 不知为何，POKENAME遇上数学相关程序就极度兴奋，欣喜地放出巨大精神冲击。附近的人会受迫使用程序，好让它观看。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME grows overly excited upon encountering programs related to mathematics for unknown reasons, releasing large psychic bursts in elation. These bursts compel those nearby to use these programs so it can watch.

entry: POKENAME能感知触碰所在电脑者的情绪。若察觉让自己不安的情绪，就会让屏幕上的所有图像扭曲。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME senses the emotions of anyone touching a computer it inhabits. If it detects an emotion it finds unsettling, it causes any images on screen to distort.

entry: POKENAME不稳定，使造出的小黑洞也难以预测。在网络空间使用时，不会如预期吸收数据，反而往系统释放海量垃圾数据。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's instability causes the miniature black holes it creates to act unpredictably. When used inside cyberspace, they don't absorb data as intended; instead, they release massive amounts of garbage data into the system.

entry: 新程序让POKENAME攻击时使用超出承受能力的力量。每次过度耗能，都会慢慢毁掉自己，从数码裙装不断缩小就能看出。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's new programming has caused it to use more power than what it can handle when using attacks. Each time it overuses its energy, it slowly destroys itself, which can be seen by its digital dress shrinking in size.

entry: 周围变化不定的雾气，让POKENAME几乎难以辨识。直接盯着它看，就会头痛恶心。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME is near impossible to comprehend thanks to the unstable haze around it. Looking at it directly causes headaches and nausea.

entry: POKENAME从手中伸出鼠标指针般的武器，以无形能量系在肢体上。在网络空间挥使灵巧，斩倒对手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME extends a weapon from its hands that resembles a mouse cursor. Tethered to its limb by invisible energy, it deftly wields it to cut down its opponents within cyberspace.

entry: POKENAME分离的刀刃双臂能从各种怪角度攻防。构成刀刃的损坏数据，会让被击中的钢属性宝可梦严重失去方向感。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's disembodied bladed arms let it attack and defend itself from all sorts of odd angles. The corrupted data comprising the blades causes severe disorientation to Steel-type Pokémon struck by them.

entry: POKENAME感染可怕的电脑病毒，光维持运转就已吃力。它却几乎不死，不知算祝福还是诅咒。
author: hedaunis
source: POKENAME has been infected with a terrible computer virus and struggles just to stay operational. Perhaps a blessing and a curse, it is almost immortal.

entry: POKENAME啃电脑线，吸取系统内的数据与电力。受打扰时以疼痛的毒针反击，再叼着线缆逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gnaws on computer cables to absorb the data and electricity within the system. If disturbed, it retaliates with a painful Poison Sting before fleeing with the cables still in its mouth.

entry: 故障程序让POKENAME的伪装本领运作古怪。每条肢体各自变色，几乎全凭随机，因此很少能完全融入周围。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's glitched programming causes its camouflage ability to behave in an odd manner. Each limb changes color separately and almost at random, so it is rare for it to manage to completely blend in with its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME常混在桌面壁纸的背景里。若被点击太多次，可能烦得试图让电脑崩溃。
author: victor9106
source: POKENAME can often be found blending into the backgrounds of desktop wallpapers. If clicked on too often, it may attempt to crash the computer out of sheer annoyance.

entry: POKENAME用数据骨架构成的小链连接双臂，像自身一部分般运用。造出更多链条，也能连接其他外围设备，建立神经般的联系。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses small cyberframe chains to connect with its arms and utilize them as if a part of its body. By creating more of these chains, it's able to connect to and neuropathically link with other peripheral devices as well.

entry: POKENAME有超算般的思考能力，却总做出糟糕甚至愚蠢的决定。人们认为，思考功能已损坏，让它无法正确分析局势。
author: soup1900
source: While POKENAME has the capability to think like a supercomputer, it always seems to make bad or stupid decisions every time. It is believed that its thinking capabilities have been corrupted, preventing it from correctly analyzing the situation.

entry: 错误更新塞满了POKENAME的记忆储存空间，只能靠光盘处理信息。有盘时十分聪明，一拿走就举止古怪，神情茫然。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's storage for memory is completely filled due to faulty updates, so it has to rely on discs to process on. It is very intelligent as long as it has this disc, but as soon as the disc is removed, it begins to act very oddly and blankly.

entry: POKENAME啃食网络空间近乎无穷的数据，可能用力过度，累得昏倒。即使面对强大防火墙，也会毫无惧色地直冲过去。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can overexert itself gnawing on the near-limitless amount of data in cyberspace and knock itself out from exhaustion. Even in the face of a strong firewall system, it charges right through without fear.

entry: 有人说，POKENAME的程序已损坏，被数百个弃置人工智能程序附身。它不断将数据吸进中央翻涌的团块，用途却不明。
author: sk372
source: Some say that POKENAME's programming was corrupted and possessed by hundreds of abandoned AI programs. It constantly absorbs data into the roiling mass in its center, though it is not known for what purpose.

entry: 许多人声称，POKENAME体内有108种不同恶意软件。内部程序互相冲突，让行为混乱、故障频生，常因此变得好斗。
author: sk372
source: Many claim POKENAME's body houses 108 different types of malware. The clashing programming within causes it to behave in chaotic, glitchy ways that often lead to it becoming aggressive.

entry: POKENAME由许多缠在同一硬盘里的灵魂构成。盘中往往只有陈旧垃圾数据或过时程序，灵魂们却仍十分珍视。
author: victor9106
source: POKENAME are comprised of many spirits haunting a singular Hard Disk Drive. Often, the drive only contains old, junk data or obsolete programs, but it is precious to the spirits nonetheless.

entry: POKENAME经过电子设备时，会无意间吸收电力，添进波导。积蓄太久，就放出局部电磁脉冲，使自己转入网络空间。
author: ghostslythe
source: When POKENAME passes by electronics, it unknowingly absorbs the electricity which is added to its aura. If it builds this charge too long, it releases a localized electromagnetic pulse which phases the Pokémon into cyberspace.

entry: POKENAME以鳍发出的电流扫描电脑。每合颚咬响一次，附近文件就可能损坏得无法使用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME scans computers using electrical currents that originate from its fin. Each time it snaps its jaw, nearby files can become corrupted to the point of uselessness.

entry: POKENAME用电流扫描电脑，寻找可捕食的病毒。挥动锋利臂鳍劈斩，有时误中正常程序，造成故障。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses electrical currents to scan computers in search of viruses to prey on. It slashes at them with its sharp arm fins, sometimes striking healthy programs and causing malfunctions.

entry: POKENAME背上大鳍储电，用来扫描电脑，寻找病毒吞食。可扫描常会损坏所有经过区域的文件。
author: .izik
source: The large fin on POKENAME's back stores electrical energy that it uses to scan computers for viruses to consume. Unfortunately, these scans frequently corrupt files in any area it has passed through.

entry: POKENAME的数据核心受病毒污染，数据损坏，能力却大增。若过度运用超频能力，却不退回网络空间，就会发生熔毁。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's data core has become contaminated by a virus, corrupting the data but supercharging POKENAME's abilities. If it uses its overclocked abilities too much without retreating to cyberspace, POKENAME will experience a meltdown.

entry: 杀毒软件攻击POKENAME时，背刺弹出，注入破坏性毒素。制服软件后，便能安心啃代码，做成可食用的垃圾数据糊。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME is attacked by an antivirus software, the barbs on its back spring out and inject the antivirus with a corrupting poison. With the antivirus neutralized, POKENAME can safely chew up the code into an edible garbage data paste.

entry: POKENAME咬住服务器，吸收内部数据。剩下的数据则被改写得全然无用，或塞满原本没有的漏洞。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME bites onto servers to absorb the data within. Any data it leaves behind is rewritten to be entirely useless or riddled with bugs that did not previously exist.

entry: POKENAME头边触须能快速绕圈，形成真空吸力。借此吸入小猎物，将其吞进嘴里的奇异液体。
author: sk372
source: The tendrils surrounding POKENAME's head can circle rapidly to create a vacuum effect. Doing this, it sucks in small prey to be subsumed within the strange liquid material in its mouth.

entry: POKENAME把触须收在头边，看起来像连在一起，直到发现猎物。黏触须便会射出，追寻目标，将其拖回身体的饥饿巨口。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME keeps its tendrils close to its head, appearing to be connected until it spots prey. The sticky tendrils then launch off and seek out their target, dragging it back to the hungry maw of its body.

entry: 有学说认为，POKENAME来自一百多万年后的未来。似乎在数字战争中严重受损，不能放心让它靠近任何联网物品。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: POKENAME are theorized to be from over a million years in the future. They seem to be damaged to a great extent by digital warfare, and are not to be trusted near anything connected to the internet.

entry: POKENAME刚进化时，身体大多没有贴图，十分虚弱。吸收数据后恢复红蓝色，变得坚硬。它在数据流中捕猎，以巨爪刺抓传来的数据包。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's body starts off as mostly non-textured and weak after evolution, but gains back its red and blue colors and hardens after absorbing data. It hunts inside of data streams, using its huge claws to stab at and grab incoming data packets.

entry: POKENAME撞上东西后，头顶圆盖常会弹落，却并无大碍。必要时还能操控脱离的头冠，当钝器作战。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cranial done tends to pop off of its head after it strikes something, though this is harmless. It can even manipulate the detached crown and use it as a blunt weapon in combat if needed.

entry: POKENAME的冲锋危险，不仅因为力量，也因难以预测。冲到一半可能故障瞬移，让攻击从目标完全没料到的方向袭来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's charges are dangerous not just because of its strength, but its unpredictability. Mid-charge it may glitch and teleport around, causing the attack to come from a completely different direction its target expects.

entry: POKENAME假扮虚拟专用网络，入侵电脑，取得所有私人和隐藏文件。明明有能力用脸替设备挡住病毒，却偏不这么做。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME infiltrate computers by pretending to be Virtual Privacy Networks, or VPNs, to gain access to all private and hidden files in computers. While they are powerful enough to shield devices against viruses using their faces, they choose not to.

entry: POKENAME站在街道与人行道前，阻挡一切移动物通过。谁不沿直线走，就会冲上去撞谁。它与怪颚龙有着古怪的宿敌关系。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME will stand in front of streets and sidewalks to block all moving objects from moving past them. They will charge and crash into anyone who moves in any direction that isn't linear. They have a strange archrivalry to Tyrantrum.

entry: POKENAME运算力惊人，重大任务数秒便能做完，却也懒得出奇。即使交给它简单任务，也要数小时甚至几天才完成。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME has incredible processing power and could finish a mighty task in seconds, it is also incredibly lazy. Even a simple task given to it will take hours or even days to complete.

entry: POKENAME天性友善，乐于助人，经常试着帮忙。可它们携带多种疾病，让人往往避之不及。
author: kiwiarms
source: Naturally friendly and helpful, POKENAME will often try to assist others. Unfortunately, they carry a variety of diseases, so people tend to keep away from them.

entry: POKENAME靠鳞片移开身体各部位，模糊整体轮廓，躲避攻击。虽因在网络空间损坏代码而臭名昭著，有多边兽在场时，却会停手掩饰破坏。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's scales help it dodge attacks by shifting parts of its body around and blurring its overall body shape. While it is notorious for corrupting code in cyberspace, it will stop and hide the damage when there are Porygon present.

entry: POKENAME有些预知电脑系统与数据网络灾难性中断的能力，却相当不稳定。过去曾几次预测大规模故障，结果却平安无事。
author: notadoctor75
source: POKENAME have some ability to predict disastrous outages of computer systems and data networks, however, this ability is rather inconsistent. Several times in the past, a massive disruption was predicted, only to pass by uneventfully.

entry: POKENAME由早已被遗忘的论坛与图像讨论板的数据残余构成。受过时科技吸引，常附身其中。
author: occulusmalus
source: POKENAME is formed from the data remnants of long-forgotten forums and imageboards. It is attracted to obsolete technology, which it often possesses.

entry: 据说POKENAME会随机出现在有画面的设备的杂讯或黑屏中，出现前先冒出随机语句。科学家还在争论，这些句子到底有没有意义。
author: beatdoof
source: Said to randomly appear during static or a black screen on any visual-facing device, POKENAME's appearance is heralded by random sentences. Scientists are debating whether or not these sentences mean anything at all.

entry: 在网络空间发现POKENAME可能相当麻烦。体形大得只有最强电脑，才能在不超载的情况下完整呈现。
author: sk372
source: Spotting POKENAME inside cyberspace can be quite troublesome. Its size is so massive that only the most powerful of computers can handle it appearing fully without overloading.

entry: 多数电脑里，POKENAME一出现就会瞬间占满储存空间，令其崩溃。它一口就能吞掉设备中的每一比特数据。
author: soup1900
source: For most computers, POKENAME's presence inside the device will instantly max out its storage cause it to crash. POKENAME is able to swallow every single bit of data in a device in one gulp.

entry: POKENAME强行拓宽数据流，好让自己挤进去，却也方便病毒进入电脑网络。若身体失控、疯狂扑腾，就会碾碎毁掉电脑里的每个文件。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME forcefully widens data streams for itself to fit in, which allows viruses to more easily gain access to computer networks. If it loses control of its body and wildly splashes around, it will crush and destroy every file inside a computer.

entry: POKENAME穿过数字网络时，全球论坛都会出故障，反复出现“1,000条手臂”这句话。如今已成为恶名昭著、令人厌烦的网络梗。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME passes through digital networks, forums worldwide glitch to repeat the phrase “1,000 Arms.” This phenomenon has become an infamous and irritating modern meme.

entry: POKENAME头冠会随附近电脑活动量而伸长或压低。周围活跃的电子设备越多，它就越健康快乐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's head-crest extends or lowers depending on the amount of computer activity in its vicinity. It is at its healthiest and happiest when many active electronics are surrounding it.

entry: POKENAME扫描、分析周围，调整背上植物，适应任何情况。
author: hophoppip
source: By scanning and analyzing its surroundings, POKENAME can adapt the plants growing on its back to fit any situation.

entry: POKENAME背上带着蒸汽波美感，移动时不断变化。陌生人若想触碰，就会遭到分离双臂的拍打。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The backs of POKENAME have a vaporwave aesthetic and constantly change as POKENAME moves. If a stranger tries to touch the back, POKENAME will use their disembodied arms to swat at the person.

entry: POKENAME独特之处，在于背上的生态景观只有一种颜色。年长训练家看见后，常说有怀旧之感。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are unique in the fact that the biome on their back is monochromatic. Older Trainers that look at POKENAME report feeling nostalgic.

entry: 成队POKENAME冲过网络，所到之处留下失效网址与网页错误。香蕉图片很容易分散注意，让网络安全人员有足够时间压制它们的能力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME troops rush through the internet, leaving behind broken URLs and errors on webpages wherever they go. They are easily distracted by images of bananas, giving cybersecurity professionals enough time to neutralize their abilities.

entry: POKENAME劫持所处设备的麦克风，偷听、了解外界事件。传闻它学会这招，是因为政府本来就通过设备监听民众。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME hijack the microphones of any device they're inside of to listen in and know of events happening outside. It is rumored that they learned this ability due to governments already listening in on people through their devices for surveillance.

entry: POKENAME将尾火扩大到客厅般的范围，威吓敌人，将其烧得焦黑。还能自行造出数字墙，借墙跳跃，从各个方向进攻。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME intimidates foes by expanding the fire of its tail to engulf a living room-sized area and burn the foe to a crisp. It has gained the ability to create its own digital walls to leap from and attack enemies from all directions.

entry: POKENAME能动用所有肢体快速强攻，但过劳便会疼痛、剧烈抽动。头火充当自身防火墙，挡住、摧毁任何来袭杀毒软件。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can dish out powerful attacks at a fast pace using all its limbs, but if it overworks them, they start to ache and twitch heavily. The flames on its head act as its own firewall to block and destroy any antivirus that tries to attack it.

entry: 它虽笨拙，却能往任何方向飘浮，弥补不足。移动时常留下数字残影；性格骄傲，常对自己的镜像摆出迎战姿态，等影像突然消失，又吓一跳。
author: notadoctor75
source: Its clumsiness is offset by its ability to float in every direction. It often leaves behind digital afterimages when it travels. Since it is a proud Pokémon, it often squares up against its own mirror images and is shocked when they suddenly vanish.

entry: POKENAME喜欢掌控进入的设备，将代码全改得最有利于自己。调走全部运算力，方便悠闲生活，因此只要它在，其他程序就一概无法运行。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME likes to overtake any device it enters and change all the code inside to what benefits it the most above all. It diverts all processing power to make its life leisurely, meaning no other program can ever run while it is inside.

entry: POKENAME进入数据流时，会造出大量垃圾数据构成的数字冰片。谁以任何方式得罪它，就会被刻意送去大批冰片，弄垮电脑。
author: soup1900
source: Whenever POKENAME enters a data stream, it creates multitudes of digital ice flakes made of garbage data. It purposely sends large quantities of these flakes to crash the computers of those who wronged it in any way.

entry: POKENAME内在罗盘彻底失灵，指向随机方向，还以为是北。有时磁性倒转，会把其他朝北鼻吸过来，黏在身上。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's inner compass is completely messed up, meaning it will point in random directions, thinking it's north. Its magnetism sometimes inverts, causing other Nosepass to be attracted to and stick to it.

entry: POKENAME的巨鼻能用类似嗅觉的感知，从远处发现病毒。可从电脑里吞食时毫无节制，连正常程序也会无意吃下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's huge nose allows it to detect viruses from great distances through a sense similar to scent. While consuming them from a computer, it does so without restraint, inadvertently devouring healthy programs in the process.

entry: POKENAME刀刃碎得厉害，难以顺利劈敌，却因此有了新战法。先四散甩出碎片分心，再将碎片拉回敌人身上聚拢，绞得粉碎。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's blades are extremely shattered and prevent it from slashing at foes easily. However, this allows it to use a new strategy of flinging shards around as a distraction before pulling them back together on the foe to shred them to pieces.

entry: POKENAME用盾能轻松挡住任何攻击，不知为何，若被斧头击中，盾就会暂时失去保护作用。在网络空间劈斩，会留下迅速蔓延的损坏数据。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can easily block any attack with its shield; however, for some reason, if this shield is hit by an axe, it will temporarily fail to protect POKENAME. In cyberspace, POKENAME's slashes leave behind fast-spreading, corrupted data.

entry: POKENAME借电脑防火墙磨刀，却不敢站太近，免得被清除。若伤得无法近身进攻，就以接连三重攻击作最后手段。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses a computer firewall to sharpen its blades while not standing too close to get purged by it. If it becomes too injured to attack physically, it unleashes a flurry of Tri Attack as a last resort tactic.

entry: 程序原为缩小文件体积而设计，错误却让它把比特本身切开，反倒产生更多垃圾数据。
author: soup1900
source: Its program was designed to cut down file size, but a programming error caused it to cut the bits themselves, resulting in more garbage data instead.

entry: POKENAME能看穿网络空间的数字屏障，望见现实事件。双眼一亮，就放出电光，将附近代码电成无用垃圾数据。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can peer through the digital barriers of cyberspace and see events happening in the physical world. When its eyes gleam, it releases a flash of electricity that electrocutes nearby code into unusable junk data.

entry: POKENAME用强角撞破密码保护程序的屏障，吃下藏在后面的珍贵数据。为了保住所占设备，连最强杀毒软件也敢迎战摧毁。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its powerful horns to break through the barricades of password-protected programs to eat the precious data that hides behind them. It is known to fearlessly fight and destroy the best antivirus software to keep control of its device.

entry: POKENAME混乱拍翼，把不同来源的数据搅在一起，随机甩向各处。飞行时，翅膀发出白噪声与静电杂音，让听者疼痛不已。
author: soup1900
source: The erratic flapping of POKENAME's wings causes it to jumble data from different sources and fling them in random directions everywhere. As it flies, its wings create sounds of white noise and static that cause pain to anyone who hears it.

entry: POKENAME飘过湖面时，身体释放火花。形体有时不受控地抖动，让下方湖水变出无数色调。
author: .izik
source: While floating across the surface of a lake, POKENAME releases sparks from its body. Its form sometimes jitters uncontrollably, changing the color of the water beneath it into a myriad of different hues.

entry: POKENAME以惊人速度飞过网络空间，吸收所经一切的数据。遇上防火墙，就从口中发出能量束，使其失效，再继续大吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies across cyberspace at incredible speeds, absorbing data from everything it passes. When it encounters a firewall, it unleashes a beam of energy from its mouth to disable it before continuing its feast.

entry: POKENAME在网络空间移动如飞行。一旦暴怒，虚拟世界的大闹会让电脑服务器起火。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME moves through cyberspace as if it were flying. If it ever becomes enraged, its virtual rampages cause computer servers to catch fire.

entry: POKENAME生气时，代码行冲过身体，赋予力量，准备攻击一切挡路物。大部分翅膀只有此时才形成，因此常攻击自己，助长怒火。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME becomes angry, lines of code rush through its body as it becomes empowered and ready to attack anything in its way. The majority of its wings only form when this happens, so it often attacks itself to fuel its rage.

entry: POKENAME被用作电脑主机、台式电脑等设备的助手。但常因同时处理太多任务，累过了头。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are used as assistants for devices like computer boxes and desktops. However, they can often overwork themselves by doing too many tasks at one time.

entry: POKENAME发射小齿轮，收集并取回电脑程序。文件放上环形齿轮，就获得其功能与能力；可一次只能用一种，因此靠转动齿轮即时切换。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME launches minigears to gather and retrieve computer programs. When these files are placed onto its ring gear, it gains their functions and abilities; however, it can only use one at a time, so it revolves the gear to hot-swap between them.

entry: POKENAME潜入电脑，假扮常用程序。用户若试图打开，就会彻底感染电脑，让所有数据混乱，设备无法使用。
author: secondegg
source: POKENAME sneaks into people's computers, pretending to be a frequently used program. If the user tries to open it, it fully infects their computer, causing all of their data to go haywire and rendering the computer unusable.

entry: 它们喜欢用幻象恶作剧、吓人，许多人认为这也是自身部分身体看似数据与故障的原因。常营造出穿过某种屏幕攻击的假象。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon love to prank and scare others with their illusions, which many believe is why parts of their own bodies appear to be like data and glitches. They often make it seem as if they are striking through a screen of some form.

entry: POKENAME的头不连着身体，有时会自行飘远。趁还够得着，就用身上缎带抓回来，免得丢失。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's head is not attached to its body and at times may begin floating away. It uses the ribbons on its body to grab the head before it gets out of reach and becomes lost.

entry: POKENAME每次进出网络空间，尾巴都会意外抽动，砸坏进出所用设备。可若刻意使尾巴，却只会用它拥抱。
author: soup1900
source: Every time POKENAME enters or leaves cyberspace, it accidentally destroys the device it enters from when its tail twitches and smashes the device. However, if it ever tries to purposely use its tail, it just gives a hug with it instead.

entry: POKENAME能用海量垃圾数据淹没整个电脑网络，逼公司断网数月才能清理。将数据流扩成海洋后，可困住超过100太字节的流动数据。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can flood entire computer networks with so much garbage data that companies must isolate them from the internet for months to be able to clean them out. By expanding data streams into oceans, it can trap over 100 terabytes of flowing data.

entry: POKENAME生活在网络空间各处的防火墙里。体温高，使容纳它的设备迅速过热。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be found living in firewalls throughout cyberspace. They have a high body temperature, causing devices that contain them to rapidly overheat.

entry: 它像不断再生、复制，穿行众多网络的电脑蠕虫。正如这模样，再生能力惊人，通常专攻敌人弱点。
author: infinex21
source: It resembles a computer worm that continuously regenerates and replicates across multitudes of networks. In keeping with this resemblance, it has remarkable regenerative capabilities and typically attacks its foes' weak points.

entry: 身体众多节段互相碰撞、穿模，有时以难以估量的速度飞散。它经常倒转自身时间，让身体重新完整。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The many segments of its body collide and clip with each other, sometimes being flung at incalculable speeds. It regularly reverses time on itself to get itself back in one piece.

entry: POKENAME能完全控制时间流动，力量也延伸至数字空间。天性调皮，以捉弄训练家取乐，例如乱改上传下载时间。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME can completely control the flow of time, a power that also extends into the digital space. Mischievous by nature, it spends its time amusing itself by messing with Trainers, such as tampering with upload and download times.

entry: 传说POKENAME光是存在，每一秒都在损坏、动摇空间。每次试图进入异次元，都会误造一个平行版本，其中逻辑与科学全然失常。
author: soup1900
source: Legends describe POKENAME as corrupting and destabilizing space with its very existence at every second. Every attempt that it tries to go into another dimension, it accidentally creates a parallel version where all logic and science have gone awry.

entry: 如同骑拉帝纳住在毁坏的世界，POKENAME会在电脑中划出储存分区，住进空白空间。若被激怒，设备文件可能迅速损坏，无法恢复。
author: pixlhoopa
source: Similar to how Giratina resides in the Distortion World, POKENAME partitions off storage in computer devices to live within an empty space. If agitated, files on the device may rapidly become corrupted and unrecoverable.

entry: POKENAME常钻进电脑文件，搬动里面找得到的一切，经常被误认作虚拟宠物。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are often found going into computer files and moving whatever they can find around. They're commonly mistaken for virtual pets.

entry: POKENAME曾只是设想中的融合，却突然开始出现在人们电脑里。一进入便让电脑永久停机，没有画面，也毫无声势，只留下修不好的黑屏。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME were once only a mere hypothetical for a fusion, but out of nowhere they began to appear in people's computer systems. As soon as it gets in, it shuts the PC down permanently, no visuals, no fanfare, just an unfixable black screen.

entry: 损坏的炮偶尔反噬自己，正常时则能轰出恶意代码。POKENAME有时把炮认成头，将两者换位。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its corrupted cannon occasionally backfires, but when it works it can fire blasts of malicious code. POKENAME will sometimes confuse its cannon for its head, and swap them around.

entry: 它是等离子队一次失败实验的产物，只懂毁灭，胡乱开炮，所过之处什么都不剩。
author: soup1900
source: An experiment by Team Plasma gone wrong. It only knows destruction, firing its cannon randomly and leaving nothing behind.

entry: POKENAME尾巴散出的损坏数据，让附近电子设备失灵或失控。飞机若从旁飞过，也会停机坠地。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's tail emits corrupted data that causes all electronics around it to either stop working or go haywire. If any aircraft flies by it, they will shut down and crash to the ground.

entry: POKENAME尾巴燃火时，周围所有数据都会烧损。若服务器机房及相连设备被用来作恶，它就会将其炸毁。
author: soup1900
source: All bits of data around POKENAME become scorched and corrupted when it lights its tail up with flames. It blows up server rooms and all devices connected to them when they are being used for malicious reasons.

entry: POKENAME给尾巴供能时，周围所有数据都会烧损。它会炸毁用来作恶的服务器机房及相连设备。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME powers its tail, all bits of data around it become scorched and corrupted. It is known to blow up server rooms and all devices connected whose use is malicious.

entry: POKENAME住在电脑里，能让设备速度达到正常的三倍，因此深受电子游戏速通玩家觊觎。
author: opossiblymage
source: While living in one's computer, POKENAME can speed up the device by three times its normal capabilities. Because of this, POKENAME is coveted by video game speedrunners.

entry: POKENAME若刻意用尾攻击，似乎只能轻轻拥抱。反倒是穿行网络空间时，会抽动挥尾，砸毁原先进入的设备。
author: soup1900
source: If POKENAME ever tries to purposely use its tail to attack, it can only seem to give a light hug with it. On the other hand, traveling through cyberspace causes it to twitch and smash its tail and destroy the device it came from.

entry: POKENAME在尾巴里搅动太字节级代码，造出大量垃圾数据。它用这些数据，清空自己认为用途不合道德的整个电脑系统。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME generates lots of garbage data by churning terabytes worth of code inside its tail. It uses all this data to wipe out entire computer systems whose uses aren't deemed morally right by it.

entry: POKENAME造的病毒与恶意软件强到不断试图撕裂它的身体。光是存在，就让电脑程序结冰，明显变慢，甚至彻底冻结。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can create such powerful viruses and malware that they constantly try to tear up its body. Its presence alone causes ice to appear on computer programs, significantly slowing them down and even freezing them completely.

entry: POKENAME双臂释放的粉末，能损坏附近电脑文件。留在机器上越久，损坏越严重。
author: .izik
source: The powder POKENAME releases from its arms can corrupt files on nearby computers. The longer the powder remains on the machine, the more corruption occurs.

entry: POKENAME习惯拆开设备，偷走一个关键零件，再飞离。有人认为，偏远部落奇迹般获得现代科技，是因为它在当地丢下了零件。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME have a habit of breaking open devices and stealing a vital component before flying off. It is believed that isolated tribes who have miraculously gained modern technology are due to POKENAME dropping parts at their locations.

entry: POKENAME没有皮毛，电脑里又不断泵入冷却液，因此容易发冷。只能裹上数据保温，参考社交媒体热门服装，用代码制衣。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME easily gets cold inside of computers due to the lack of fur and coolants always being pumped in. The only way for it to stay warm is by insulating itself in data, referencing popular clothing designs from social media to fashion the code.

entry: POKENAME在虚拟空间跳到哪里，就扰乱哪里的代码，可能让附近程序彻底失效。
author: .izik
source: Wherever POKENAME hops in virtual space, it disrupts the coding around it. This can render nearby programs completely useless.

entry: POKENAME穿行网络空间时，把找到的有趣数据存进蘑菇状头部。受惊便将数据洒满所在网站，引发大范围故障。
author: .izik
source: While traveling through cyberspace, POKENAME stores interesting data it finds within its mushroom-like head. When startled, it spills this data across any website it is present on, causing widespread glitches.

entry: POKENAME快得防火墙根本来不及停下、处理，因此无法检测到。它不断在电脑运行目录树命令，吃掉列出所有目录中的数据。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are impossible to be detected by firewalls since they move too fast for the software to stop and process them. They are known to constantly run the tree command in computers and feed on the data from all the directories listed.

entry: POKENAME侵入废弃电脑，吃光设备遗留数据。它的形象启发了以失控电脑程序为题的机械恐怖电影。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME infests abandoned computers, consuming data left on the device until there is nothing left. Its appearance has inspired mechanical horror films about rogue computer programs.

entry: 让POKENAME靠近电脑被视为极高风险。若决定附身，就会以病毒和恶意软件塞满电脑，使其超载。
author: shadeofblu
source: It is considered an extreme risk to have POKENAME near computers, as if it decides to possess one, it will cause the computer to overload with viruses and malware.

entry: POKENAME喜欢附身旧电视，痴迷于逗乐一家人，想让难过的人振作。
author: amberaxolotl223
source: POKENAME love to possess older TVs. They're obsessed with entertaining families, wanting to cheer up those who are upset.

entry: POKENAME将凝胶黏在电脑上，就能覆写原有网络，改连进自己的新网络。战斗时用大手扯下电脑线缆，当鞭挥动。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME sticks some of its gel onto computers, it can overwrite their preexisting networks and connect them into its own new one instead. To battle foes, it rips cables off from computers using its large hands and swings them around like whips.

entry: 多边兽Z与皮可西的组合曾被认为适合太空探索，但多数POKENAME对此极为焦虑。宇航员想带它上太空时，它竟开始口吐白沫。
author: notadoctor75
source: The combination of Porygon-Z and Clefable was thought to be ideal for space exploration, but most POKENAME have shown intense anxiety about it. When astronauts tried to take POKENAME with them to space, it started foaming at the mouth.

entry: POKENAME刻意让损坏的棉花不断累积，塞满电脑储存空间，以此恶作剧。想赶走它腾空间也没用，它会撕离棉花，自行离开。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME does pranks by purposely letting its corrupted cotton build up so they fully fill up a computer's storage. Attempts to get rid of POKENAME to free up storage are futile since it can tear away from the cotton and leave.

entry: POKENAME乘着数据流，任棉絮毛发掉落，损坏经过的每台电脑。任何设好的安保都能轻易钻过，让重要文件无一安全。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME rides on data streams, letting its pieces of cotton hair be torn off and corrupt any computer it passes through. It can easily slip through any security that's been set up, making no important file safe from POKENAME.

entry: 光标状利爪，能剥光整棵树的皮。即使沙尘暴漆黑一片，POKENAME面罩般的眼，也能找出猎物。
author: trismon55555
source: The cursor-like claws of POKENAME can tear the bark off an entire tree. Their visor-like eyes can detect prey even in pitch-black sandstorms.

entry: POKENAME夜里潜入办公室，模仿运行中的电脑，引加班者靠近。据说会把前来查看的人拉进屏幕，永远困在里面。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME infiltrates offices at night, attempting to draw late-night workers close by mimicking an active computer. It's said it will pull those who investigate into its screen, where they will be trapped inside forever.

entry: POKENAME织网作套索，抓住正在搬移或传输的文件。若想取回，它就会放出电击，可能让电脑短路。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spins up webs and uses them as lassos to grab onto files in the midst of being moved or transferred. Trying to retrieve the files results in it dispensing an electrical jolt that could short out the computer.

entry: POKENAME用触须吸收代码，转成垃圾数据弹丸，射向防火墙，让其离线。虽能把钢铁打得粉碎，却常抖动抽搐得太厉害，无法集中力量。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME absorbs code using its feelers and converts them into garbage data pellets used to fire at firewalls and take them offline. While it can smash steel into smithereens, it's often way too shaky and twitchy to focus its strength.

entry: POKENAME用众多接头臂插进电脑接口，窃取信息与数据。每条臂偷的资源不同，因此常把所有接头插进同一台设备，而非分别连接。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME use their many connector arms to plug into the ports of computers and swipe their info and data. They often plug all their connectors into the same device rather than connecting to separate devices, since each arm steals different resources.

entry: 故障般的火焰会抽走、删除附近电子设备的数据。传闻全球定位系统曾失控，将人引上偏僻道路，那里除了POKENAME便空无一物。
author: secondegg
source: Its glitched flame siphons and deletes data from nearby electronics. There have been rumors of GPS systems going haywire, leading people down isolated roads with nothing but a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME头顶有一团故障般的火，像静电般闪烁噼啪，偶尔移往身体其他部位。有时竟使周围变暗，而非照亮。
author: sk372
source: A glitched flame sits atop POKENAME's head. It flickers and crackles like static, occasionally moving to different parts of its body, and may even darken its surroundings instead of illuminate them.

entry: POKENAME烧掉陈旧闲置电子设备的代码，为火焰续燃。它绝不焚毁仍在使用的设备，因此许多人不介意它漫游街头、走进家里。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME fuels its flames by burning the code from old, unused electronics. Since it won't ever incinerate devices that still get used, many people don't mind POKENAME roaming their streets or entering their homes.

entry: POKENAME吸收文件与数据，将其烧损。反常行为很可能来自一个编写拙劣的更新。
author: starriser609
source: POKENAME absorbs files and data, burning and corrupting them. Its erratic behavior is most likely the product of a poorly programmed update.

entry: POKENAME想挥牙劈敌，长牙却会在击中前突然卸载成数据骨架，使攻击失效。为免长牙消失，它舔食电脑内存数据，让其稳定。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME tries to swing its tusks to slice a foe, the tusks will suddenly unload into a cyberframe before impact, making the blow ineffective. To prevent the tusks from disappearing, it licks up memory data from computers to keep them stable.

entry: 控制POKENAME行为的人工智能已损坏，因此举止失常。自认是守护者，却常出故障，每次保护的对象都跟着改变。
author: sk372
source: The AI that dictates POKENAME's behavior is corrupted, thus it acts faulty. It believes itself to be a guardian, but it regularly glitches out, causing the target of its protection to change each time.

entry: POKENAME的多条尾巴能储存影像数据，但尾巴受损，数据就容易损坏。即便如此，独立电影工作室仍靠这种简陋储存方式拍摄场景。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can store visual data into their many tails, but this data can easily become corrupted when their tails are damaged. Despite this downside, indie film studios rely on this rudimentary film storage to capture scenes.

entry: 人们在电脑发现POKENAME，往往想赶走它，逼得它从嘴里拿出光标，把自己拖往屏幕别处。若放任不管，体外恶意代码会渐渐掌控设备。
author: soup1900
source: If POKENAME is found on a computer, many will try to force it out, making it take a cursor out of its mouth to drag itself to a different part of the screen. If left alone, the malicious code it is coated in will slowly take over the device.

entry: POKENAME将重要程序与文件打成大压缩包，再加数字锁，非得输入它设的密码才能读取。若绕过锁，释放的反而是恶意软件与病毒。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME compiles important programs and files into one large zip folder before placing a digital lock on it, preventing the contents from being accessed without the password it sets. If the lock is bypassed, malware and viruses are released instead.

entry: 它们以电磁波为食，常停在无线电塔顶，尽管也常被赶走。防止它们继续干扰现代科技与设备的措施，仍在研发。
author: infinex21
source: They feed on EM waves and often perch atop radio towers, even though they are often chased away. Countermeasures to prevent them from further jamming modern technologies and devices are still being developed.

entry: POKENAME用电脑绘图工具给伪装着色，扮成其他宝可梦。可什么都能变，反而让它犹豫不决，大多时候都在反复重涂自己。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses the paint tools on computers to color sections of its disguise and appear as other Pokémon. However, with the power to look like anything, it spends most of its time indecisively repainting itself over and over again.

entry: POKENAME从翅膀释放大量微波辐射，使附近一切开始燃烧。它靠近时，能听见低沉嗡鸣。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME releases large amounts of microwave radiation from its wings, causing anything in its vicinity to start to burn. A low-pitched humming noise can be heard when POKENAME is nearby.

entry: POKENAME损坏代码中的严重错误，让身体碎片随机脱离，飘在半空。碎片最终会重组，却留下静电嗡鸣，让附近宝可梦不安。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME suffers from a critical error in its corrupted code, causing fragments of its body to randomly detach and drift midair. These glitched pieces eventually reassemble but leave behind a static hum that unsettles nearby Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME分离的双头举止古怪，常互相争执。有时两颗头会对调位置，让整体行为也彻底改变。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's disconnected heads act strangely and often feud with each other. The heads may occasionally switch primary locations, causing POKENAME to act in a completely different manner as well.

entry: 多数研究者认为，POKENAME不受控的攻击性来自内部代码故障。三颗头喷出损坏代码光束，人和机器都会遭受重创。
author: sk372
source: Most researchers believe that POKENAME's unchecked aggression is due to a malfunction within its internal coding. Its three heads spew beams of corrupted code that devastate man and machine alike.

entry: POKENAME每颗头都能独立思考，却只惦记恶意软件与破坏。对看见的一切凶猛发射破坏光线和三重攻击，仿佛永远不知道何时该停。
author: soup1900
source: Each head of POKENAME can individually think and process thoughts, but all they think about is malware and destruction. They viciously fire Hyper Beam and Tri Attack at all they see while seemingly never knowing when to stop their rampage.

entry: POKENAME几乎能在瞬间以惊人速度起飞。有时冲得太快，头竟会暂时留在原处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is capable of flight and taking off at incredible speeds almost instantaneously. It has sometimes been seen flying off so quickly that it temporarily leaves its head behind.

entry: POKENAME以小群体飞过网络空间，在电脑之间高速往来。它们干扰软件，一路留下损坏文件。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fly through cyberspace in small herds, travelling from computer to computer at high speed. Their presence is disruptive to software, and they leave a wake of corrupted files behind them as they travel.

entry: POKENAME以小群体飞过网络空间，在电脑之间高速往来。有时欢叫着突然钻出显示器，返回现实，把程序员吓一跳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fly through cyberspace in small herds, travelling from computer to computer at high speed. They sometimes take programmers by surprise when they abruptly emerge from their monitors, returning to real space with a happy cry.

entry: POKENAME收翼本想飞快些，却突然变得极慢。因为收翼会使它剧烈抽动、失衡，还承受更多空气阻力。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME folds back its wings, it suddenly becomes extremely slow in flight when it expects to become faster. This is due to it becoming very twitchy and off-balance when it tucks its wings in, also causing it to take more air resistance.

entry: POKENAME奔来跑去时，尾巴不断掉落像素状数据。丢失的代码迅速蒸发入空气，让踪迹难以追寻。
author: eiskitsune
source: As POKENAME scampers about, its tails continually shed pixelated data. This lost code quickly evaporates into the air, making it difficult to follow its trail.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME每条优雅尾巴都存着庞大的损坏数据档案。电子设备靠近常会故障，但损坏如何传递，仍是谜。
author: eiskitsune
source: It is believed each of POKENAME's elegant tails contains a massive archive of corrupted data. Often, electronic devices brought close to their tails exhibit glitches, yet it remains unknown how this corruption is transmitted.

entry: POKENAME内置九种不同程序，因此有九种性格，随机切换。光照上皮毛，身体看起来就会碎开，绕身飘浮，像某种画面故障。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has nine unique personalities that it randomly switches between since it has nine distinct programs built into it. When light gleams onto its fur, its body appears to break off and float around it like some type of graphical glitch.

entry: POKENAME程序严重变异，身体以不自然的方式变形。空胸腔发出的光束会抽走击中物的数据，随后让目标猛烈爆炸。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's program is severely mutated, causing its body to morph and alter in unnatural ways. The beams it fires from its empty chest cavity siphon data from anything they hit before suddenly making them violently explode.

entry: 身体有骇人的适应力，能轻松压过多数敌人。研究者仍不明白它靠什么维生，只见过它静止在输电塔附近，仿佛休养恢复。
author: infinex21
source: Its body has frightening adaptive capabilities that allow it to overcome most foes with ease. Researchers are still unsure what sustains it, though they have been seen stationary near transmission towers as if resting and recuperating.

entry: 有时，POKENAME身后会出现损坏数据构成的奇异轮廓，护它免遭危险，它自己却似乎全然不知。
author: sk372
source: At times, strange silhouettes made of corrupted data will form behind POKENAME. They defend it from danger, yet POKENAME itself seems completely oblivious to their presence.

entry: POKENAME设计扭曲，脸长在该是尾巴的位置，尾巴则长在脸的位置。想讨好大尾狸族群，却很难融入，尤其还会倒着筑坝。
author: sk372
source: A distortion in POKENAME's design causes it to have its face where its tail should be and vice versa. It tries to ingratiate itself into Bibarel groups, but cohesion is difficult, especially when it attempts to build a dam upside-down.

entry: POKENAME不停在社交媒体发帖，随时汇报一天中的感受。还会建十多个小号，攻击不喜欢的人。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME constantly post on social media about how they feel at every given moment of the day. They are known to create over a dozen alternate accounts to attack people they don't like.

entry: POKENAME上网几乎不费力，因此总是慢慢来。它待在电脑里，连打开文件这样的小事，也可能载入超过20小时。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are known to take their time when viewing the internet since they spend almost no energy doing so. Their presence in a computer can cause simple tasks like opening a file take over 20 hours to load.

entry: 研究者认为，POKENAME代码中的故障，导致它几乎永不停歇地亢奋。用爪撕裂机械，似乎能暂时满足混乱本性。
author: sk372
source: It's believed by researchers that a glitch in POKENAME's coding is the reason for its almost unending hyperactivity. Tearing apart machinery with its claws seems to sate its chaotic nature, if only temporarily.

entry: POKENAME圆大的身体塞满垃圾代码。它游进电脑桌面，四处弹跳，撞乱图标与窗口，似乎不知道自己弄得一团糟。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's large, rounded body is filled with garbage code. It bounces around computer desktops that it swims into, knocking around the icons and windows within, seemingly unaware of the mess it creates.

entry: 一种老病毒出自POKENAME之手，会在用户电脑显示笑脸，宣称对方是笨蛋。如今仍试着使用这过时病毒，却几乎敌不过现代杀毒软件。
author: victor9106
source: POKENAME is responsible for an old virus that displayed smiley faces on a user's computer, proclaiming they were an idiot. It still attempts to use this obsolete virus today, standing little chance against modern antivirus software.

entry: POKENAME在陌生者面前害羞，对信任者却格外亲热。为表达喜爱，会蹭着对方的电子设备，为其充电，可也使内部程序出错。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is very shy around those it does not know but extremely affectionate toward those it trusts. As a show of affection, it rubs its body against their electronic devices to charge them, unfortunately causing errors in programs stored inside.

entry: POKENAME使用爪子时，会令空间轻微扭曲，发出电视杂讯般的声音。若有人试图研究这现象，它就开始混乱移动。
author: bacondlx
source: POKENAME's claws cause slight distortions in space and emit a sound like TV static when used. Attempts to investigate this phenomenon cause it to move erratically.

entry: POKENAME在电脑里蜷绕着地球仪。被点击便向球喷火，再替用户打开浏览器窗口。用户离开后，就伸展、调整身体，直到对方回来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wraps its body around a globe inside PCs. When clicked, POKENAME breathes fire onto the globe before opening the browser window for the PC user. While the PC user is away, POKENAME stretches and adjusts its body until they come back.

entry: POKENAME在电脑里蜷绕着地球仪。被点击便向球喷火，再替用户打开浏览器窗口。用户离开后，就伸展、调整身体，直到对方回来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wraps its body around a globe inside PCs. When clicked, POKENAME breathes fire onto the globe before opening the browser window for the PC user. While the PC user is away, POKENAME stretches and adjusts its body until they come back.

entry: POKENAME歌声失真诡异，让听者不安、做噩梦。这不幸的特性使它性情阴郁，不愿与人来往。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's singing is distorted and uncanny, causing unease and nightmares in those who hear it. It has a very sullen and antisocial personality due to this unfortunate quirk.

entry: POKENAME啃网上各类护甲图片的元数据，长出能抵御杀毒软件的数据甲。冲撞强到能从网络空间内部击碎设备屏幕。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME grows its digital armor that protects it from antivirus software attacks by nibbling on the metadata of various armor images on the web. Its charging tackles have enough force to shatter device screens from within cyberspace.

entry: POKENAME不断对抗防火墙与杀毒软件，想占住电脑生活。每撞一次数字墙，就溅出损坏数据的火花，感染附近程序。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME constantly fights firewalls and antivirus software in order to claim a computer as its own and live in it. Each time it rams into the digital walls of cyberspace, it creates sparks of corrupted data that infect programs present nearby.

entry: POKENAME偏爱猎捕幽灵属性宝可梦，会远距离追逐。若咬到不适合自己吃的个体，身体就会爆出大量火花。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers to hunt Ghost-type Pokémon, chasing them across long distances. Should it bite one that does not agree with it, a myriad of sparks will burst from its body.

entry: POKENAME爱啃电脑回收站里的文件，不等用户选择永久删除就先动口，因此发生过许多重要数据被撕毁的事故。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy chomping through files that get chucked into the recycling bin on PCs. They do not wait until the user chooses to permanently delete them, leading to many incidents where vital data was ripped apart.

entry: POKENAME住在街机里，不断追吃蓝色怪物。它们虽更喜欢留在机内，却很容易被樱桃和草莓引出来。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME live in arcade machines, constantly chasing after blue monsters to eat. POKENAME prefer to live in their machines, but can be easily lured out with cherries and strawberries.

entry: 电脑错误信息涌现时，POKENAME会出现，作为保住数据的最后手段。可它唯一办法就是吃，成片删掉文件夹，直到吃下错误信息的元凶。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME appears when error messages flood PCs, acting as a last resort to preserve data on the PC. Unfortunately, POKENAME's only option is to consume data, removing large swaths of folders until it eats the culprit behind the error messages.

entry: 有时，考古学家会在电脑养POKENAME，吃掉研究中的错误。可它很胆小，偶尔探头看训练家的研究，又会被化石吓得躲回去。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are sometimes found in computers owned by archeologists, to eat any errors found in their research. They are quite skittish, sometimes popping their heads out to see their Trainer's research, only to be spooked by the fossils and hide again.

entry: POKENAME造的音波能毁掉所在设备的音频，甚至震碎屏幕。听过超声波的人，随后数小时都只能听见响亮杂讯。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME creates sound waves capable of destroying the audio of the device it is in and shattering the screen as well. Those who have heard these ultrasonic waves will only be able to hear loud static for a few hours.

entry: 一次交易弄砸后，它进化成了POKENAME。身上的丝线，承载着过去失败的重量；据说，那也正是POKENAME防御力高得出名的原因。
author: imaginaryneon
source: Evolving after a deal gone wrong, POKENAME's strings bear the weight of their past failures. It is said that those strings are the source of POKENAME's infamously high defenses.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在沙漠奔跑，一边哔哔叫，一边跳过挡路的仙人掌。似乎很怕野生化石翼龙，一碰上就装死。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME enjoy running throughout the desert, jumping over any cacti that is in their way while making beeping noises. They seem to have an aversion to wild Aerodactyl, and will play dead upon running into them.

entry: POKENAME外壳让自身数据绝不会被读取或修改，可也挡住自己查看代码。它不断盼着有天进化、脱壳，能再次使用程序。
author: soup1900
source: The outer shell of POKENAME protects its data from ever being accessed or changed; unfortunately, it also blocks it from viewing its code as well. It constantly dreams of the day it evolves and loses its shell so it can use its programs again.

entry: 若POKENAME出现在电脑里，务必避免互动。一点击就会随机调整电脑设置，再消失，留下用户收拾所有改动。
author: sk372
source: Should POKENAME make an appearance on one's computer, avoid interacting with it at all costs. Upon clicking, POKENAME will randomly adjust the settings of the computer before vanishing, leaving the user to fix all the changes made.

entry: POKENAME吸收电脑数据时，会触发大量弹窗通知。点击可能引起全系统大范围故障，扬声器还会发出金属尖啸。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME triggers a flurry of pop-up notifications while absorbing data from a computer. Clicking these pop-ups can cause widespread glitches throughout the system, along with a metallic screech through the speakers.

entry: POKENAME变成孩子，借此接近人们的实体电脑和手机。拿到设备就登录，改掉能找到的所有密码，再化成小宝可梦逃走。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME change their appearances to look like children so they can gain physical access to people's computers and phones. Once at the device, they log in and change every password they can find before fleeing transformed into a tiny Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的歌以令人不安闻名。据说听一群合唱，可能接连数周做噩梦或失眠。
author: blaizegamer
source: The songs of POKENAME are known for their unsettling nature; it is said that hearing a song from a band of POKENAME can result in nightmares or insomnia for weeks.

entry: 为让POKENAME永远活着，更新代码使它能分离火焰，存放到不会熄灭的地方。它点燃木建筑储火，让火永远燃烧。
author: soup1900
source: In order to eternally preserve POKENAME's life, updated code was utilized in order for it to detach its flame and store it someplace where it can't be extinguished. It stores its flame by igniting wooden structures to keep it forever blazing.

entry: POKENAME能吸走电脑屏幕的像素，使其从此只能显示杂讯。也能膨胀身体，占满设备空间，不留任何数据或文件的余地。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can inhale the pixels of computer screens and monitors and cause them to only ever display static. It can inflate its body to take up an entire device's space and leave no room for other data or files to exist.

entry: POKENAME待在应用不多、没有病毒的干净电脑里，就会打开头顶花苞。可里面满是垃圾数据与恶意软件，污染了设备，又让它不开心。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME opens the bud on top of its head when inside a clean computer with few applications installed and free of viruses. However, the inside of its bud is full of junk data and malware, leaving it unhappy since the device it's in is now polluted.

entry: POKENAME用红花向电脑倾倒大量垃圾数据，塞满储存。蓝花则散出臭香，让防火墙睡着，无法守护数据传输。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its red flower to deposit large amounts of garbage data into computers and fill up their storage. With its blue flower, it releases a smelly fragrance that causes firewalls to fall asleep and become unable to guard data transmissions.

entry: POKENAME还不够强壮，搬不起整台电脑，便偷小型外围设备飞走。近年有许多闯进儿童卧室、偷走宝可梦图鉴的报告。
author: soup1900
source: Not yet strong enough to carry entire computers, POKENAME instead steal small peripheral devices to fly off with. In recent years, there have been many reports of them breaking into children's bedrooms to steal their Pokédexes.

entry: POKENAME身上的每根绒毛，都带着微观代码行。深入研究仍未解开用途，也没弄清如何自然生成。
author: .izik
source: The fluff growing from POKENAME's body contains microscopic lines of code on each strand. A thorough study has yet to decode their purpose or determine how they are naturally generated.

entry: POKENAME跳进电子游戏，改代码取乐。流传甚广的传闻称，只要它待在游戏里，玩游戏的人就会被困进去。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME hop into video games, editing the code for their own fun. A popular rumor claims that POKENAME traps players inside the game should they play while POKENAME resides inside.

entry: POKENAME漏出的孢子，会改变接触的图像或视频文件。有时效果永久，迫使用户重新下载。
author: .izik
source: The spores that leak from POKENAME's body alter any image or video files they come into contact with. This effect can sometimes become permanent, forcing someone to redownload the affected file.

entry: POKENAME潜伏社交网站，破坏算法，让人看到会生气的帖子。人们认为，它以收到的负面反应为食，也在过程中学会如何更加激怒人。
author: secondegg
source: POKENAME lurks in social media sites, corrupting the algorithm to show people posts that will make them angry. It is believed to feed on the negative reactions it receives, and in the process, it learns how to anger people even more.

entry: POKENAME体外覆着加密凝胶，能抵挡任何网络攻击。以精神力量搅乱数字安保系统的代码，还能永久锁住电脑文件。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's body is surrounded by a gel of encryption that protects it from any type of cyberattack. Using psychic powers, it can scramble the code of digital security systems and permanently lock out files in a computer.

entry: POKENAME发现喜欢的程序，就先复制一份，再分别修改两个版本。测试规模各异，双方从不重复，却不知为何总变成病毒。
author: soup1900
source: If POKENAME finds a program it likes on a computer, it duplicates it before separately tinkering the code on both. While the tests it does on each file vary in scale and never repeat between both versions, they somehow always end up becoming a virus.

entry: POKENAME的绒毛只须实际放在电脑上，就能让文字反转。移走后便恢复。
author: .izik
source: The mere physical presence of POKENAME's fluff on a computer causes text on the machine to reverse. This effect reverts once it is removed.

entry: POKENAME的棉花能织进编程语言，使其使用时占用更多储存。若设备的程序没全用它的棉花，就会被它断网。
author: soup1900
source: The cotton POKENAME produces can be woven in with programming languages to make them bloat up storage space when used. POKENAME disconnects devices that don't use its fluff for all their programs from the internet.

entry: POKENAME向设备网络接收器吐棉花，削弱、甚至阻断网站连接。棉花也能织进程序，让运行极其低效，占用大量储存。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME expels cotton over the internet receivers of devices to dampen and even block their connections to websites. The cotton it produce can be woven into programs to make them very inefficient and bloat storage space.

entry: POKENAME十分闹腾，常跑过键盘，再跳进显示器躲避追究。习惯试图钻进像素，不及时处理，图片就常遭破坏。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are quite rambunctious, often running across keyboards and jumping into monitors to evade repercussions. They have a habit of attempting to burrow into pixels, often ruining pictures if not dealt with.

entry: POKENAME发出高频尖啸，扰乱无线电波与电流。附近设备会故障，甚至关机，作用如同电磁脉冲。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME releases high-pitched screeches capable of disrupting radio waves and electrical currents. These screams will cause nearby devices to malfunction or even shut down, functioning much like an EMP.

entry: 专门代码本想让POKENAME看穿物体，结果却使它连晴朗白昼也难看清。因为怕冷，还会阻止所在设备的风扇运转。
author: soup1900
source: While specialized code was given so POKENAME can see through objects, it instead makes it hard to see even during clear, sunny days. It stops fans from blowing in the device it is in since it hates getting cold.

entry: POKENAME始终拿着形状古怪的面具，人们相信其中藏着大半力量。触碰或注视太久，会让人莫名烦躁、愤怒。
author: sk372
source: The strangely-shaped mask POKENAME constantly holds is believed to contain most of its power. Touching it or viewing it for too long causes a person to be filled with an inexplicable feeling of frustration and anger.

entry: POKENAME紧攀强力病毒与恶意软件，吸取数据，增强自身。为容纳全部数据，必须先在设备里发射、散开满是恶意代码的尖刺，腾出空间。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME cling onto powerful viruses and malware to absorb their data and make themselves more powerful. To absorb all the data, they must launch and spread their malicious code-filled spikes inside of devices to make room.

entry: POKENAME虽可能长出不止两根长牙，却极少发生，因为牙的数据易坏，只好丢弃。代码虽也是食物，它仍会将其碾碎，测试力量。
author: soup1900
source: While it's possible for POKENAME to grow over two tusks, it rarely ever happens since the tusk's data easily corrupts, forcing POKENAME to discard them. Despite also being their food source, POKENAME crush code into pieces to test their strength.

entry: POKENAME以长牙刺穿游荡设备的屏幕，表示自己掌控网络。进食时让数据包刺在长牙上，如烤串般层层堆叠，直到塞不下。
author: soup1900
source: To signify its control over a network, POKENAME punctures a hole into the device screens it roams in using its tusks. To eat, it lets data packets skewer into its tusks and stack on top of each other like a kabob until no more can fit.

entry: POKENAME体内代码毫无逻辑、混乱不堪，却依然能正常运作行动。在电脑里，喜欢把找到的程序与文件塞进文件夹，分组毫无规律。
author: soup1900
source: The code inside POKENAME is completely illogical and scrambled, yet POKENAME can still function and act perfectly fine. When inside a computer, it likes to combine any program and file it finds into folders with no pattern in their grouping.

entry: POKENAME体外杂讯般的覆盖层能抵挡高热。可抖落小碎片，燃起与外层同样带杂讯外观的小火。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's static-like coating over its body protects it from intense heat. It can shake off small flakes of this coat that ignite into small flames, which share the coat's static appearance.

entry: POKENAME张开的大嘴投出一片宁静绿野，让多数观看者心生怀念。伸手进去的人都坚称，手上感到了温暖夏风。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wide open mouth projects an image of a peaceful verdant field that feels nostalgic to most who view it. Those who stick their hand in POKENAME's mouth swear they feel a warm summer breeze against their hand.

entry: POKENAME制造服务到期的弹窗，诱使受害者上钩。点击“兑换”补费后，设备便染上病毒，不断递归弹出POKENAME笑脸的近照窗口。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME lures in victims by creating pop-ups stating that a service they had bought has expired. When they click redeem to repay the fee, a virus is implanted in their device that recursively opens windows of an up-close picture of POKENAME's smile.

entry: POKENAME身体能融入显存，轻易躲过杀毒软件。若被数据包撞上，会本能放电，强到足以关闭整条数据流。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can easily conceal itself from antivirus software since its body blends in with the memory of GPUs. If a data packet crashes into it, POKENAME instinctively releases a jolt of electricity strong enough to shut down the whole data stream.

entry: POKENAME带着一个巨大的未知物件，能让攻击消失，甚至变成完全不同的东西。为维持这力量，它在电脑里掘找程序充饥。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME carries a giant, unknown object around that can cause attacks to disappear and even change into something completely different. To sustain this power, it digs through computers in search of programs to feed on.

entry: POKENAME性情好斗，尤其爱把怒气发在电脑上。咬住目标电脑，注入强力病毒，极难清除。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is an aggressive sort with a penchant for pointing said aggression at computers. It bites onto a targeted computer and injects the machine with powerful viruses that are very difficult to remove.

entry: POKENAME吞食网络空间的病毒，增强现实身体里的毒素。积蓄的毒液可强到让人昏迷数月。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME consumes viruses it finds in cyberspace to strengthen the toxins within its body in the real world. The venom it accumulates can grow potent enough to put someone in a coma for months.

entry: 错误更新让POKENAME完全依赖无线连接，才能正常思考、咬住食物。一断线，脑中便空白，只会直线跑动、偶尔跳起，直到撞上障碍。
author: soup1900
source: Faulty updates caused POKENAME to fully rely on wireless connections to think correctly and bite down on food. Without the connection, its mind turns blank as it starts to run in a straight line and occasionally jump until it hits an obstacle.

entry: POKENAME吃网页数据时，会损坏链接，不让别人前往。若反复点击链接，键盘和鼠标就会蔓延起古怪冰霜。
author: .izik
source: While consuming data from a webpage, POKENAME prevents others from navigating to it by corrupting the links. Repeatedly clicking the link will cause an odd frost to spread across the keyboard and mouse.

entry: 偶尔，POKENAME面前会弹出标签页，显示张嘴露牙的画面。一打开，它就失真尖叫，关掉便能使其停止。
author: bigoljax
source: Occasionally a tab opens up infront of POKENAME, displaying open teeth. POKENAME screams in a distorted tone as soon as the tab opens, but can be stopped by closing it.

entry: POKENAME容易深深依恋引起兴趣的用户。觉得自己受关注不够，就会冻住对方的电脑程序。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a tendency to become deeply attached to users who draw its interest. It will freeze their computer programs if it feels it isn't being paid enough attention.

entry: POKENAME在网络空间扎根后，附近数据流都会改道流向它。想赶出设备，唯一办法是把屏幕亮度调到最高。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME plants its roots inside of cyberspace, all nearby data streams get redirected towards it. The only method to get rid of it from the device is by turning up the screen brightness to the max.

entry: POKENAME在网络空间每动一下，都卷起火焰，烧损击中的数据。仅跳一支舞，便可能烧光设备所有数据，甚至让实体设备起火。
author: soup1900
source: Each movement POKENAME takes in cyberspace whips up flames that char data they strike and cause them to corrupt. Even a single dance from POKENAME could burn every last bit of data in a device and even physically catch it on fire.

entry: POKENAME身体像一副黑色眼镜，飘在约5英尺高处。被观察时，会制造人类跳舞的幻象，自己却大多不动，只微微抖着，无声飘行。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body resembles a pair of Black Glasses, floating roughly 5 feet in the air. It creates the illusion of a human dancing while being observed, despite remaining mostly motionless, jittering slightly as it moves silently through the air.

entry: POKENAME能在电脑重装已删病毒与恶意软件，让其再度肆虐。不知为何，只要可以，就要把所在设备的所有应用和屏幕变成紫色。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can reinstall deleted viruses and malware in a computer and allow them to cause havoc once again. For some reason, it turns every application and screen on a device it's in to the color purple whenever possible.

entry: POKENAME截取将被扔进回收站删除的数据文件，大吃一顿。这本无害，却还会用毒损坏设备程序，逼人删除，满足饥饿。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME intercepts data and computer files being thrown into the recycle bin and deleted to gorge on. While this action is rather harmless, it also corrupts programs in the device with its poison to force their deletion and fill its hunger.

entry: POKENAME受病毒和恶意软件独特的数据气味吸引。一察觉，整群便在数秒内扑向恶意数据，吃得干净，因此能高效充当杀毒程序。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is attracted to the unique digital scent of viruses and malware. An entire school will descend on malicious data within seconds of sensing it and devour it completely, making them effective as antivirus programs.

entry: 它是广受欢迎的游戏破解装置，却有时会擅自往游戏里注入恶意代码，造成永久损坏。
author: t.i.a.
source: A popular device made to hack games, they are sometimes known to inject malicious code into them by themselves, resulting in permanent damage.

entry: 这些异常宝可梦以数据传输为食，却常吃过量，部分身体被吃下的数据反占。凡被完全吸入口中的东西，都会变成数据，无可避免地被吞并。
author: infinex21
source: These anomalous Pokémon feed on data transmissions, though they often overfeed to the point that they are partly overtaken by the data they have consumed. Anything fully drawn within their maws becomes data that is inevitably subsumed.

entry: POKENAME飘过讨论灵异现象的网站。据报告，它经过后，有些故事会变得无法理解，或远比先前更让人不安。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats through websites where the paranormal is discussed. Reports state that after it passes through, some of the stories become either unintelligible or far more unsettling than before.

entry: POKENAME藏进下载内容，感染修改下载文件者的电脑。受染设备加入它的僵尸网络，被用来攻击、瘫痪大型网络服务器。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME hide themselves inside downloads and infect the computers of those who modify that download's files. The devices it infects become part of its botnet, which it uses to attack and take down large network servers.

entry: POKENAME嘴里滴出垃圾数据，邋遢地淋在经过的每个数据文件上。唾液不知为何能挡住杀毒软件，因此每天都洒满全身自卫。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME drools out garbage data from its mouth and sloppily drips it over every data file it walks by. The drool is somehow able to deter antivirus software from coming near, so it splatters the drool all over its body every day as protection.

entry: POKENAME能在外太空生存，科学家想派它前去，用强耳广播信号。盼望信号传得足够远，与外星生命建立联系。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Capable of surviving in outer space, scientists want to send POKENAME out there to broadcast signals with its powerful ears. The hope is that these signals will carry far enough to establish contact with extraterrestrial life.

entry: 超声波强得一次就能摧毁整座摩天大楼。幸存者将POKENAME称为“杂讯音爆”。
author: soup1900
source: Its ultrasonic waves are so strong, it can destroy entire skyscrapers in one blast. Survivors of these blasts refer to POKENAME as "The Static Boom".

entry: 超声波强得一次就能摧毁整座摩天大楼。幸存者将POKENAME称为“杂讯音爆”。
author: soup1900
source: Its ultrasonic waves are so strong, it can destroy entire skyscrapers in one blast. Survivors of these blasts refer to POKENAME as "The Static Boom".

entry: 代码出错，使超声波夹杂着沙沙噪声。这种冲击破坏力极强，被许多人称为“杂讯音爆”。
author: soup1900
source: A coding error caused it to emit static noise from its ultrasonic waves. These blasts are called static booms by many since they're very destructive.

entry: POKENAME的回声定位能力失控，变得极响、破坏力巨大。它无法控制这些冲击，因此在许多城镇被明令禁止。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's echolocation powers have gone haywire, making them very loud and destructive. It is unable to control these blasts, leading to it being outlawed in many cities and towns.

entry: POKENAME的回声定位能力失控，变得极响、破坏力巨大。它无法控制这些冲击，因此在许多城镇被明令禁止。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's echolocation powers have gone haywire, making them very loud and destructive. It is unable to control these blasts, leading to it being outlawed in many cities and towns.

entry: POKENAME最常聚在城市服务器所在地附近。叫声像倒放的人声，有时会让附近电脑卡顿。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME most often gather in urban areas near to where computer servers would be located. Their cries sound like reversed vocalizations, and sometimes cause nearby computers to lag.

entry: POKENAME把吸收的数据存在身上柔软圆球里。数据影响声音，因此不断吸取、排除不同数据，追求歌唱的完美音高。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stores absorbed data within soft spheres attached to its body. The data it takes in affects its voice, so it takes in and rejects different data in order to achieve the perfect pitch for its singing.

entry: POKENAME入侵电脑，爬过屏幕留下胶状痕迹，遮住经过的物件。幸好凝胶几分钟后就会散去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body leaves a gelatinous trail across the screens of computers it invades, obscuring objects it crawls over. Fortunately, the gel dissipates after a few minutes.

entry: POKENAME用水膜般的身体变形，在电脑里假扮重复文件与程序。一被点击就迅速散开逃走，同时以黏液吸走经过的数据。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can use its watery membrane body to shapeshift itself to look like duplicate files and programs inside a computer. If clicked on, it scatters away quickly, absorbing any data it crosses over with its slime.

entry: POKENAME是电脑的寄生者，开机越久，出现的便越多。只有设备极热、身体开始干涸，才肯离开。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are a parasite for computers, having more appear over time the longer a computer is active. They only leave when the device they're in becomes extremely hot since their bodies start to dry up.

entry: POKENAME滴下的黏液，是极高效的电脑导热膏。可它光是存在于系统中，就可能引发大量程序故障，因此很少使用。
author: .izik
source: The slime dripping from POKENAME's body makes an extremely effective thermal paste for computers. Unfortunately, it is rarely used as its mere presence within a system can cause massive glitches in its programs.

entry: POKENAME代码损坏，身体许多部位都滴落故障数据。对多数对象无害，却会让电脑，以及多边兽或洛托姆相关宝可梦行为古怪。
author: sk372
source: Due to a corruption in its code, POKENAME drips glitched data from much of its body. Though harmless to most, it will cause much odd behavior in computers and Porygon or Rotom-related Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME是雷吉洛克的数据复制体，因人们后悔封印了本体而创造。喜欢安静坐在洞里，大多时候不理人类。
author: aberry8286
source: POKENAME is a digital copy of Regirock, created out of remorse for sealing the original away. It enjoys sitting quietly in caves, and ignores humans most of the time.

entry: POKENAME常住在早已无人发言的旧论坛与帖子里。因为那里的数据如身体般冰冷，活跃聊天中的数据却炽热熔化。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME often reside inside old chat forums and threads on the internet where text and chatter have become nonexistent. This is because data in these places are freezing cold like POKENAME's body, while data in active chats are hot and melting.

entry: POKENAME能以极寒的冰彻底冻结设备屏幕，阻止电脑继续操作。冷到即使让设备过热，也化不开屏幕。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can use its extremely frigid ice to completely freeze up device screens, preventing further actions from happening on the computer. This frigidity is so cold that not even overheating the device will thaw out the screen.

entry: POKENAME将偷来的代码与数据全存体内，可向内看，明明又空空如也。因为并非存在体腔，而是存进身体各部分本身。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME stores all the code and data it steals from computers in its body, yet when viewing inside of it, it remains noticeably empty. This is because it doesn't store them in its body cavity but within the parts of its body themselves.

entry: POKENAME每片花瓣都含不同电脑病毒，各以独特方式攻击电脑、破坏网络空间。移动时大幅摆身抽动，刻意传播病毒。
author: soup1900
source: Each one of POKENAME's petals contains a different computer virus that attacks computers and destroys cyberspace in unique ways. It takes large, swinging body jerks as it moves around to intentionally spread these viruses.

entry: 长眠让POKENAME变得脆弱，恶意软件趁机在身上生长壮大。它会大闹，撕开电脑与网络空间，寻找杀毒软件和防火墙吸收自用。
author: soup1900
source: Long slumbers cause POKENAME to become vulnerable and allow malware to grow and become more powerful on them. They go on rampages, tearing up computers and cyberspace for antivirus and firewalls to absorb for themselves.

entry: POKENAME拥抱程序，挤出全部数据来啃。有时忘了实体电脑挤不出数据，也照样拥抱，把设备弄成一百块碎片。
author: soup1900
