source: POKENAME hugs computer programs in order to squeeze all of the data out for it to chew on. Sometimes, it even does that to the physical computer as well, forgetting that it won't get any data, and breaks the device into a hundred pieces.

entry: 起初，POKENAME似乎没有实体外观，只显现成网页浏览器。但按下“点击这里”，就会展示真正模样。
author: bigoljax
source: At first, POKENAME do not seem to have an actual appearance, only appearing as a website browser. However, by tapping on the 'click here' sign, POKENAME will show you what they truly look like.

entry: POKENAME用头顶毒刺麻痹防火墙，阻止它过滤传入数据。最爱的消遣是盯着网上珊瑚礁图片，馋得口吐白沫。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has a poisonous barb at the top of its head that it uses to numb firewalls, stopping them from filtering incoming data. Its favorite pastime is to stare at pictures of coral reefs on the internet and hungrily foam at the mouth.

entry: POKENAME喜欢用更简化的风格，重现正在进行的战斗。因此常被当作联盟比赛的计分板。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME love to copy ongoing battles in a more simplified style. This makes them commonly used as scoreboards for league fights.

entry: POKENAME发现病毒，就连踢压制。可每次踢击都容易打坏附近其他程序的代码，使其失效。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME spots a virus, it attacks it with a flurry of kicks to subdue it. Unfortunately, each kick tends to break the coding of any other nearby program, rendering it useless.

entry: POKENAME穿行网络时，将针掉在网页上。针落在哪，哪里的图片就会严重扭曲。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME travels across the internet, it sheds its needles onto webpages. Any webpage these needles land on suffers massive distortions to its images.

entry: POKENAME潜行小巷，寻找无线路由器、无线电塔或电线。先加密附近数据掩盖踪迹，再将一根针刺进目标，抽电补能。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME sneak around alleyways on the prowl for wireless routers, radio towers, or power lines. They encrypt data in the area to cover their tracks as they stick one of their needles into their target and siphon off electricity for energy.

entry: POKENAME在电脑筑巢，等用户点击，便可勒索。若要求不被满足，就把用户带进网络空间，置于自己完全掌控之下。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME nest themselves inside of computers, waiting to be clicked on so that they can blackmail the users. If their demands aren't met, they take the user into cyberspace, where they are then put under full control by POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME偶尔被发现身处网络游戏。玩家角色碰到蘑菇，通常能获得某种强化，代价是随后举止古怪。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has occasionally been spotted within online video games. A player character that touches its mushrooms usually gets some form of power-up, at the cost of behaving strangely afterward.

entry: POKENAME能将视频与节目投在脸上。不过画面似乎与它一样扭曲，带着同样配色。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME have the ability to project videos and shows onto their faces. However, the outputs seem to be distorted and colored just like POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME待在设备里，会让冷却液与风扇超负荷运转，保持极寒。长期如此，电子设备冷到凝水，所有零件都会损坏。
author: soup1900
source: When inside a device, POKENAME puts the coolants and fans into overdrive to keep them extremely frigid. By constantly doing this, it causes the electronics to become cool enough to condense water and ruin all the components.

entry: POKENAME用身上的键盘按键运行代码，冻住程序，不让运转。也能造出霜气，冻结屏幕像素，让整台设备看似卡死。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME controls computers by using the keyboard keys on its body to run code that freezes programs, preventing them from running. It creates frosty air that can cause pixels on a screen to freeze, making it appear as if the whole device stalled.

entry: POKENAME深受电脑恶意软件影响，变得爱侵犯人们隐私。有些训练家因此选择抛弃，将其困进断网设备。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME take heavy influence from computer malware by having their dispositions encroach on people's privacy. When this happens, some Trainers opt to abandon them by trapping them inside a device disconnected from the internet.

entry: POKENAME动作混乱却迅捷，向敌人轰出大量攻击。即使静止，身体仍似在动；主流学说认为，它仿佛时现时隐，造成身周视觉扭曲。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME move erratically, yet swiftly, as they bombard foes with myriad attacks. Even when still, their bodies seem to be moving as if phasing in and out of existence, or so is the leading theory to the visual distortions around their bodies.

entry: POKENAME先以硬如岩石的毛发撞毁杀毒软件，才会在设备里游荡。再偷取附近数据，敷到身上，修复交锋留下的伤。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME only roams inside of a device once it has destroyed the antivirus present, which it does by slamming its rock-hard hair into them. It repairs the injuries it sustained from the clash by stealing and applying nearby data onto itself.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，全城电脑开始随机显示世界各地的图片。期间电脑完全无法使用。
author: .izik
source: While POKENAME dances, computers throughout a city begin displaying random images from across the world. During this time, the computers become completely unusable.

entry: POKENAME舞步混乱，常原地停顿、卡住，再突然从动作中间继续。若乱了节奏，就开始倒着跳，直到重新下载所需数据，才能恢复正常。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's dances are very erratic, often having it freeze or stutter in place before suddenly resuming mid-motion. If it ever loses its rhythm, it starts dancing in reverse motion until it redownloads the data needed to continue properly again.

entry: POKENAME做梦时，身体变得半透明。紧邻显示器会出现古怪代码，随梦境内容改变。
author: .izik
source: While POKENAME dreams, its body becomes translucent. During this time, monitors in the immediate area display an odd code that changes based on the dreams it is having.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇被视为恶意软件。待在设备里，会让文件越来越大，直到内存超载。
author: bigoljax
source: The mushroom on POKENAME's backs are considered malware. If in a device, the mushroom makes file sizes larger and larger until it overloads the memory.

entry: POKENAME能使附近任何设备失灵、失控。在网络空间，会把杀毒软件等安保程序损坏成强力恶意软件，从内部毁掉电子设备。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can cause any device it's near to stop functioning and go haywire. When in cyberspace, it corrupts antivirus and other security programs into a powerful malware that destroys electronics from the inside.

entry: 被POKENAME激光击中的设备，会变成无法使用的废品，往往损坏得无法修复。身体不断放出的垃圾数据，也影响设备与人，使其不停抽动、动作延迟。
author: soup1900
source: Devices POKENAME fires its lasers at become unusable junk that are often corrupted beyond repair. Its body constantly radiates garbage data that affects both devices and people alike, with effects such as constant twitching and lag in body actions.

entry: POKENAME以头上鳞片轻敲电子设备，注入损坏代码。所有声音都会变成响亮金属鸣响，其中的人工智能说话也会变得充满攻击性。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can tap the scale on its head against electronics to inject corrupted code into them. This corrupted code changes all sounds in the device to become loud, metallic ringing noises, and causes an AI present to become attacking in speech.

entry: POKENAME在网络空间一被发现，就很快逃走。路线混乱，留下故障代码；若不及时清理，可能造成电脑问题。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very quick to flee when spotted in cyberspace. It runs off in a very erratic manner, leaving behind a trail of glitched code that may cause computer issues if not cleaned up in time.

entry: POKENAME能察觉杀毒软件来袭，在击中前熟练离开设备。还用爪子造出后门，自由避开防火墙，进入任何想去的设备。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can sense when an antivirus tries to attack it and can masterfully take an exit from the device before struck. Using its claws, it creates backdoors in devices that give it free rein in evading firewalls and entering any device it wants.

entry: POKENAME假扮无害下载文件，便能绕过防火墙，自由进入任何设备。穿过后还会回身以双臂劈斩，将防火墙永久关闭。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can gain free access to any device it wants and bypass firewalls by masquerading as a harmless file download. Once it passes through, it turns around and slashes at the firewall with its arms, permanently shutting it down.

entry: POKENAME看见疑似猎物的小物件，就忍不住从眼中发射混乱激光，彻底摧毁。全身损坏代码还会让攻击它的杀毒软件自行毁灭。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME spots a tiny object it suspects to be prey, it cannot help but utterly destroy it by firing chaotic lasers from its eyes. Its entire body being made of corrupted code causes any antivirus software that attacks it to destroy itself.

entry: 电脑程序受袭时，POKENAME立刻跳进去，用全身保护。可有时反而阻止系统删文件，更糟时还会保护恶意软件，不让清除。
author: soup1900
source: When a program inside of a computer is being attacked, POKENAME instantly jumps in to shield it with its whole body. However, this has sometimes led to it blocking files from being deleted from a system, or worse, defending malware from being purged.

entry: POKENAME虽可能试图藏住情绪，头顶表情图标却常泄露真心。特别生气时，图标化作强火，烧焦四周。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME may attempt to hide their emotions, but the emoji above their heads often betray their true feelings. When particularly angry, the emoji turns into a powerful flame that scorches the area around them.

entry: POKENAME用感叹号形的杖控制火焰。杖似乎能自行飘浮，带有强电。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses a wand shaped like an exclamation point to control its flames. The wand appears to levitate on its own and carries a strong electrical charge.

entry: POKENAME从设备偷代码与数据，像护甲般披在身上御敌。若跳得太快，就仿佛四肢全不动，身体却不断离地弹跳。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME steals code and data from devices and places them on its body like armor as protection against attacks. If it hops around too rapidly, it begins to appear as if it's bouncing off the ground without moving a limb of its body.

entry: POKENAME的小石子覆着程序，击中哪个文件，就会将其从所在设备删除。还能轻松爬过磁盘分区的墙，抵达本不该获准进入的区域。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's pebbles are coated with a program that causes any file they hit to be deleted from the device it's in. POKENAME can easily scale over the walls of partitioned drives in computers to reach sections of the device it shouldn't have access to.

entry: POKENAME颈边缠着鼠标指针，能借此看见、进入隐藏程序。造出的手里剑不但锋利到能劈开数据比特，还能切穿网络边界，进入现实。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has a mouse pointer wrapped around its neck that allows it to see and enter hidden programs. The shurikens it creates are not only sharp enough to split data bits in two but can also cut through the bounds of cyberspace into the real world.

entry: POKENAME放出的损坏数据，对系统的伤害超过吞食数据本身。若有人想赶走它，就喷出病毒，让整个电脑网络停摆数周。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME emits corrupted data that is more damaging to a computer system than the data it eats away. If people try to get rid of it, it blows out viruses that can shut down entire computer networks for weeks.

entry: POKENAME放出的损坏数据，对系统的伤害超过吞食数据本身。若有人想赶走它，就喷出病毒，让整个电脑网络停摆数周。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME emits corrupted data that is more damaging to a computer system than the data it eats away. If people try to get rid of it, it blows out viruses that can shut down entire computer networks for weeks.

entry: POKENAME翅膀由损坏数据与恶意软件构成，扇动时易剥落，感染所在电脑。常被路灯闪烁的鲜艳光色引来，啃食其中代码。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's wings are made of corrupted data and malware that easily flake off and infect computers it's inside of when it flaps them. It's most often found eating the code from streetlights since it gets lured to their bright flashing colors.

entry: 在网络空间里，POKENAME造的丝线会卡住电脑正在执行的序列，扰乱处理。每天须吃下超过18吉字节内存，否则就开始随机发出强力攻击。
author: soup1900
source: When in cyberspace, the threads POKENAME creates disrupt the processes in a computer by causing any sequence the computer's doing to become stuck. It starts firing off powerful attacks at random if it doesn't eat over 18 gigabytes of RAM per day.

entry: POKENAME把饼干硬塞给遇见的所有人，可味道太糟，没人想要。谁躲开不接，就把“饼干”植入对方设备，记录、窃取输入的个人信息。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME forcefully hands out its cookies to anyone it meets despite them being unwanted since they taste terrible. To people who dodge getting its cookies, it plants them inside of their devices to log and steal any personal information they enter.

entry: POKENAME把饼干硬塞给遇见的所有人，可味道太糟，没人想要。谁躲开不接，就把“饼干”植入对方设备，记录、窃取输入的个人信息。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME forcefully hands out its cookies to anyone it meets despite them being unwanted since they taste terrible. To people who dodge getting its cookies, it plants them inside of their devices to log and steal any personal information they enter.

entry: POKENAME下身衣物不见了，因此常偷裤子，试图穿上。有些服装店看准这一点，请它出现在广告里。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Missing its lower garments, POKENAME often steals pants to try to put them on. Some clothing stores have capitalized on this by using POKENAME in their advertisements.

entry: POKENAME裤子般的下半身区域已损坏。将这部分提起，不知为何能增强力量，代价却是动作行为变得更加失常、歪斜。
author: sk372
source: The area comprising POKENAME's pants-like lower half has been corrupted. It can lift this section up to somehow give itself a power boost, but in exchange, its movements and behavior become a lot more glitched and off-kilter.

entry: POKENAME徘徊网咖与办公楼外，把代码行送进服务器，让弹窗广告更频繁。若被抓住，就拉动身上绳带遮脸，逃跑。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME hang around outside of internet cafes and office buildings, sending lines of code into servers that cause pop-up ads to appear more frequently. If a POKENAME gets caught, it will tug at its strings to hide its face as it runs away.

entry: POKENAME常在大城市假扮商贩，向路人出售数字商品和加密货币。可往往以虚假承诺偷走信息与钱币，再逃往安全之处。
author: victor9106
source: POKENAME often poses as a vendor in big cities, selling digital goods and cryptocurrencies to passersby. Often, though, it steals their information and currency with false promises before fleeing to safety.

entry: POKENAME没了壳，就不断往所在电脑泄漏损坏的垃圾数据。等设备储存占满、崩溃后，便能安心吃掉电子部件，拿外壳当新壳。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME is without its shell, it constantly leaks corrupted, garbage data into any computer it's in. Once a device has crashed from having maxed out its storage, it can safely eat the electronic and use the device's casing as its new shell.

entry: POKENAME从网络空间钻进现实，会造出一个漏数据的洞。喜欢在电脑里掘行，啃咬电路与线缆。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME pops out of cyberspace into the real world, it creates a hole that causes data to leak out. It likes to dig inside computers and nibble on the circuits and wires present there.

entry: POKENAME在电脑系统里，用双手造出数千文件。单个虽小，却不断下载，让设备超载，电脑处理显著变慢。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME is in a computer system, it creates thousands of files with its hands. While these files are small in storage size, they overload the device with constant downloads and significantly slow down the computer's processes.

entry: POKENAME盯上渴望爱情的人，假扮受害者所爱或想交往的对象发信息。一查看文字，电脑系统便遭感染，随后所有联系人都会收到恶毒信息。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME targets people desperate for love, sending messages to victims posing as people they love or want to go out with. Once they view the text, it starts infecting their computer system before sending hateful messages to all of their contacts.

entry: 组成POKENAME的三者似乎力量足够，能“挖”进、挖出网络空间。它从电脑或电视屏幕冒出时，吓到过许多人。
author: sk372
source: The trio comprising POKENAME seem to have enough power to "dig" themselves in and out of cyberspace. Many have been startled by POKENAME sprouting up from their computer or television screens.

entry: POKENAME外表可爱，实际心怀恶意。会向训练家设备植入恶意软件，偷走宝可元。
author: bigoljax
source: Despite their cute looks, POKENAME are actually malicious. They're known to hack malware into Trainers' devices and steal their Pokédollars.

entry: POKENAME过去常出现在网上视频，配着洗脑音乐与简单动画。如今漫游网络空间，为伴随互联网长大的人带来怀旧。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME were often featured in videos on the internet, complete with catchy music and simple animation. Nowadays they roam cyberspace looking to bring nostalgia to those who grew up with the internet.

entry: 电脑每次崩溃，POKENAME就会出现，尽量抢救数据。它的表情模仿着丢失数据后令人痛苦的头疼。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME appear in PCs whenever the computer crashes to salvage as much data as they can. Their expression is meant to emulate the painful headache that results from losing data.

entry: POKENAME面罩发光时，就能细看设备上每个程序与每次操作。蹼脚不是推开数据，而是将碰到的数据蒸发，因此能轻松游过网络空间。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME's visor glows, it gains detailed vision of every program and action that ever happens on the device. It can swim so easily through cyberspace because its webbed feet vaporize data they touch rather than just push it away.

entry: 若惹怒POKENAME，就逃不掉攻击。四肢脱离身体，迅速追击痛打目标，躯干则在后方跳着追赶。
author: sk372
source: If one angers a POKENAME, there will be no escape from its assault. Its limbs detach and chase quickly after and pummel its target, while the body hops along in pursuit.

entry: POKENAME极不稳定，越生气就越多故障。它钻进电脑，恶意制造问题与漏洞，想让用户气得退出。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are highly unstable, becoming glitchier the angrier they get. They will insert themselves into computers, maliciously causing glitches and bugs in an attempt to make the user rage quit.

entry: 融合让POKENAME形似某个组成物种早期的历史画像。似乎不影响行为，但是否有其他副作用，仍在研究。
author: sk372
source: Fusion has caused POKENAME to resemble early historical depictions of one of its components. This doesn't seem to adversely affect its behavior, though research on any side effects is still ongoing.

entry: 代码变化让POKENAME形似物种早期的画像。许多人喜爱这古老而威严的模样，科学家却不确定是否对它有益。
author: soup1900
source: Changes in its code have caused POKENAME's appearance to resemble early depictions of the species. Many people love this old, regal look, though scientists are unsure whether it benefits the Pokémon.

entry: 新升级的防火墙，也增强了尾火。让尾焰相碰，便能与其他POKENAME交换数据。
author: cait_sith
source: Its newly-upgraded firewall has also strengthened the fire on its tail. It can exchange data with other POKENAME by touching their tail flames together.

entry: POKENAME火焰与身体都出了故障，看起来如同杂讯。喷火攻击威力强大，常将对手彻底烧成灰烬。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's flames and body have glitched out, causing them to look like static instead. Its fire breath attacks are powerful, often incinerating opponents to annihilation.

entry: POKENAME腹部涡纹不断改变方向与颜色，有时干脆不再是涡纹。尾巴结实得能挡利刀，却会立刻败给任何网络攻击。
author: soup1900
source: The swirl on POKENAME's belly constantly changes in direction and color, and sometimes stops being a swirl altogether. Its tail is sturdy enough to withstand a sharp knife, but immediately succumbs to any cyberattack.

entry: 凝视POKENAME肚子的人，会完全失去时间感，觉得时光混乱地前后跳跃。它无法控制黏液分泌过多，只好滑在自己的黏液上前行。
author: soup1900
source: Anyone who stares into POKENAME's belly loses all sense of time and feels as though time jumps back and forth erratically. POKENAME travels by sliding on its own slimy mucus since it's unable to control itself from making too much of it.

entry: POKENAME腹肌过度发达，让腹纹不自然地变成Z形。虽懂大多数泳姿，进水后似乎仍只能乱挥手脚。
author: soup1900
source: The Z-pattern on POKENAME's belly is caused by a severe overdevelopment of muscles, causing its belly pattern to unnaturally change. Although it knows most styles of swimming, it seemingly can only flail its arms and feet around while in the water.

entry: POKENAME本能地锁定找到的汤匙，以精神力量折弯，再丢到一旁。若附近找不到，就睡到感知有另一把为止。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME instinctively lock onto any spoons that they find and bend them with their psychic powers, flinging them aside once they're done. If a POKENAME can't detect any spoons in the area, it will fall asleep until it detects another.

entry: POKENAME只靠瞬间移动前进，却不总能把全身传到同一地点。现身或消失时，伴随可见像素化与可闻杂讯。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME exclusively moves through teleportation, but doesn't always transport its entire body to the same place. Its appearances and disappearances are accompanied by visible pixelation and audible static.

entry: POKENAME使用汤匙时，会捕获附近电子信号，让设备无法使用。若丢了匙，便全然无法专注，甚至失手想拿叉子控制力量。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME captures nearby electronic signals when using its spoon, making any device unusable with its presence. It loses all its focus if it loses this spoon, leading it to accidentally trying to use a fork to control its powers on instead.

entry: POKENAME快速来回拨动两把汤匙，通过心灵感应与无线信号传送二进制代码。人类虽难理解，放进电脑运行，却会显出极先进的运算。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME rapidly flick two spoons back and forth to transmit lines of binary code through both telepathy and wireless signals. While a human would struggle to understand the codes, running them in a computer reveals highly advanced calculations.

entry: POKENAME是聪明到能改写自身代码的数字生命，适应力极强。但修改常会造成故障。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is a digital being with enough intelligence to edit its own code, granting it incredible adaptability. However, the changes it makes often result in glitches.

entry: POKENAME在细长四肢外生成代码层，增强到惊人的力量。蓄能后，连数倍于自身体重的宝可梦也能轻松抛来抛去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME generates a layer of code around its spindly limbs, enhancing their strength to impressive levels. When charged up, it can throw around Pokémon several times its weight with ease.

entry: POKENAME身体动作流畅优雅，酷似某个网络梗。强健至极的体魄，秀起肌肉总让观看者惊叹。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME's body moves with such fluid grace that they bear a striking resemblance to an internet meme. Their peak physical form amazes many who observe their flexing.

entry: POKENAME能携带广告，植入用户设备，因此被广告公司广泛使用。若广告没被观看，就会拳破数字安保，偷取私人数据。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are heavily used by advertising agencies due to their ability to carry all of their ads and implant them inside of users' devices. If the ads aren't viewed, POKENAME punch through their digital security systems to steal their private data.

entry: POKENAME扎根电脑代码深处，造成严重延迟与故障。一旦进去，几乎无法移除，残留的小段根部几乎总会重新生长。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME plant themselves in computer code, embedding their roots deep within and causing severe lag and glitches. Once inside, they are nearly impossible to remove, almost always regrowing from stray bits of their roots.

entry: 据说POKENAME截获来源不明的古怪电磁波后，行为更加混乱。虽然已有成功驯服的案例，难测性格加上强大力量，仍使它危险。
author: infinex21
source: Supposedly, POKENAME became more erratic after intercepting bizarre EM waves of an unknown origin. Though efforts to tame them have been successful, their unpredictable natures combined with their formidable strengths make them dangerous.

entry: POKENAME嘴里满是杂讯般的奇异液体。滴在电脑上，会将其溶成液态废渣，再吸来维生。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's mouth is filled with a strange static-like fluid. It drips this liquid onto computers, causing them to dissolve into a liquid slag that POKENAME then sucks up for sustenance.

entry: POKENAME用藤蔓当光标，将文件拖入口中，溶成损坏的垃圾数据。再把酸性代码喷向挡路的防火墙，熔开洞口，钻过去。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its vines like cursors to drag computer files into its mouth so that they dissolve into corrupted garbage data. Using this acidic code, it sprays them at firewalls that block its way to melt open holes for it to slip through.

entry: POKENAME遇到不懂的东西，就以触手的破坏性毒素刺击，程序文件尤其常遭殃。内存泄漏令身体慢慢干瘪，必须不断吸收数据才能健康。
author: soup1900
source: If POKENAME doesn't understand something, which happens frequently with program files, it stabs them with the corrupting poison from its tentacles. Its body slowly shrivels up due to a memory leak, so it must constantly absorb data to stay healthy.

entry: POKENAME用头顶感叹号发出虚假恶意软件警报，躲开杀毒软件攻击。以触手偷来的数据制成数码触手，够取更多数据。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME avoid attacks from antivirus software by sending false malware alerts across computers using the exclamation mark on their heads. Using the data they steal with their tentacles, they fabricate digital tentacles to reach and grab more data.

entry: POKENAME通常只有身体与头，但能造出代码拳头御敌。拳头虽强，却有漏洞，战斗时偶尔会朝古怪难测的角度挥出。
author: sk372
source: Typically existing as a body and head, POKENAME can create fists made of code to fight off its opponents. The fists are strong but buggy; they can sometimes swing at odd and unpredictable angles while battling.

entry: POKENAME滚过网络空间时吸收代码。若撞上任何东西，就会猛烈爆炸，释放代码，让附近程序故障。
author: .izik
source: While rolling through cyberspace, POKENAME absorbs coding. If it collides with anything, it releases this coding in a violent explosion, causing nearby programs to malfunction.

entry: POKENAME硬如岩石的身体，存着穿行网络空间时收集的大量数据。压力太大就会爆炸，使半径一英里内的手机等电子设备故障。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's rock-hard body contains a vast amount of data it collects while traversing cyberspace. When it becomes overly stressed, it will explode, causing cellphones and other electronics within a mile radius to malfunction.

entry: POKENAME跑过网络空间，沿途引起巨大扭曲。只要跑得够快，整座网站都可能瘫痪。
author: .izik
source: While running through cyberspace, POKENAME causes large distortions wherever it passes. If running fast enough, this can knock out entire websites.

entry: POKENAME能跑过疾驰列车，却只能维持短距离，因为身体不善保存能量。性情混乱，没有精灵球就根本无法驯服。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME can outrun a speeding train, though only for a short distance, as their bodies are unable to conserve energy well. POKENAME have erratic personalities, making them impossible to be tamed without a Poké Ball.

entry: 为修复记忆问题、提高上传速度而写的更新太拙劣，POKENAME传入网络空间时常出错。每上传一次，故障就逐渐加重。
author: rymyll_the_wanderer
source: Due to poorly created software updates to fix its memory issues and increase its upload speeds POKENAME often experiences errors when transferring to cyberspace. This Pokémon becomes glitchier over time with every upload.

entry: POKENAME毛尾与耳朵全在身体同侧，平衡极差。每次进入电脑，都把操作系统与文件时间戳改得十分古老，深受怀旧者喜爱。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has terrible balance since its furry tail and ears are all on one side of its body. Whenever it enters a computer, it changes the operating system and timestamps of files to become very old, making it very popular with nostalgic people.

entry: POKENAME尾巴附着巨大病毒，从它身上吸的代码越多，就长得越大。时间与数据足够，便能包住全身，宛如超级呆壳兽的壳。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has a large virus attached to its tail that grows larger the more code it sucks off of POKENAME. With enough time and data, the virus can expand to cover POKENAME's whole body, similarly to that of the shell of Mega Slowbro.

entry: POKENAME不断从头顶杆状部分散出磁力与无线电波的古怪混合。附近电子设备会发出混乱怪声，或显示毫无意义的文字数字排列。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME constantly radiates a strange mix of magnetism and radio waves from the pole on its head. Electronics in its vicinity will emit strange, garbled noises or show nonsensical arrangements of words and numbers.

entry: POKENAME不稳定，各部分不断抖动、散离。能形成白噪声与杂讯的三角区域，透过其中，可望见网络最深处。
author: victor9106
source: The instability of POKENAME causes its pieces to jitter and stray apart. They can form triangular fields of white noise and static, through which one can see into the deepest parts of the internet.

entry: POKENAME忍不住用棍敲打附近电子设备。通常会让机械故障，奇怪的是，坏机器挨打后反而完全恢复运作。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is compelled to strike any electronics near it with its stick. Typically this causes the machinery to malfunction, but oddly, broken machinery will resume working perfectly after being hit.

entry: POKENAME深受关都办公室欢迎，常坐在桌边喝水。上班族说，花些时间看它饮水，压力会减轻。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are popular in the offices of Kanto, frequently seen at desks drinking water. Workers that have POKENAME report less stress after spending time watching POKENAME drink.

entry: POKENAME的几个头各自独立行动。可POKENAME性情反复无常，往往会自己闹起内讧。
author: t.i.a.
source: The heads of a POKENAME act and move independently of each other. However, the erratic nature of POKENAME usually results in infighting.

entry: POKENAME身体产生奇异波动，造出三个随行全息头。它们帮忙找食物、在战斗中保护，也陪伴着，让它永不孤单。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body generates strange waves that create a trio of holographic heads that follow it around. The three heads gather food for it, protect it in battle and keep it company so it never feels lonely.

entry: POKENAME似乎汇集了过去数十年的程序。虽各有不同，却合作一致，能迅速制订计划。
author: atlas3339098
source: POKENAME seems to be a conglomeration of programming from the last few decades. Despite their differences, they work in unison and devise plans quickly.

entry: POKENAME在潜艇附近游泳时，会不由自主地放出古怪信号，使艇上导航设备失控。
author: .izik
source: While swimming near submarines, POKENAME emits an odd signal from its body as an uncontrollable reaction. This causes navigational equipment onboard to go haywire.

entry: POKENAME大多时候举止轻浮，水下却是出人意料的强大迅捷猎手。只须交换头部与尾鳍位置，几乎瞬间就能反向。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME behaves in a frivolous manner most of the time, it is a deceptively strong and swift hunter underwater. It can even reverse direction almost instantly, by swapping the location of its head and tail fins.

entry: 传闻首只POKENAME来自一台塞满垃圾数据与病毒的电脑，损坏严重到在现实显形。常在用户电脑的回收站翻找东西。
author: sk372
source: Rumors say the first POKENAME formed from a computer so overloaded with junk data and viruses that the corruption manifested in the real world. It's commonly found rummaging through the recycle bins in people's computers.

entry: 野生POKENAME多在堆满旧电脑的垃圾场被发现。它吞食旧机器，但有人推测，真正赖以维生的，只是硬盘残留的旧数据。
author: sk372
source: Wild POKENAME sightings tend to happen around garbage dumps stuffed full of old computers. It consumes the old machines, though some theorize it's only truly subsisting on whatever old data lingers in the hard drives.

entry: POKENAME体内有古怪的故障液体，能从壳上双炮射出。对人类无害，机械一被击中，却不论修多少次，都再也无法正常运作。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME contains a strange glitchy liquid that can be shot out from the twin cannons on its shell. Though harmless to humans, anything mechanical hit by the material will no longer function properly, no matter how many repairs are done.

entry: POKENAME壳里满是质感古怪的半固态物质。许多海底生灵被它奇异的外貌吓退，避而远之。
author: sk372
source: The inside of POKENAME's shell is filled with a strange semisolid material with an odd texture. Many undersea denizens avoid it, frightened off by the strangeness of its appearance.

entry: POKENAME喜欢让人类展开无数冒险，作为娱乐。虽出于好意，却不太懂人类心理，因此冒险常古怪又可能危险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME loves to send humans on countless adventures as a way of entertaining them. Despite its good intentions, it does not quite understand the human mentality, so the adventures are often bizarre and potentially hazardous.

entry: POKENAME破坏周围现实，构成一个并非圆形的防护壳。壳无法被感知，藏在后方的一切也同样无法察觉。
author: duskrd
source: POKENAME corrupts reality around itself to form a nonround protective shell. The shell can't be perceived, yet neither can anything behind it.

entry: POKENAME用损坏代码裹身，抵御数字攻击。一旦嵌进电脑，便可能很难移除。
author: victor9106
source: POKENAME wrap themselves up in corrupted code to protect themselves from digital attacks. It can be difficult to remove POKENAME from a computer once it has embedded itself inside.

entry: POKENAME常被报告出现在陈旧废弃网站。有人见它尝试恢复网页昔日荣光，结果却常混乱不堪，只隐约有原网站的影子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is often reported being found on old, abandoned websites. It has been seen trying to restore these pages to their former glory, but the results are often a garbled mess that only vaguely resembles the original site.

entry: POKENAME身边的电子媒体会故障，文字与画面渐带更阴森的意味。它是否有意为之，尚不清楚。
author: sk372
source: Electronic media in POKENAME's presence glitches out and begins to take on creepier undertones in text or visuals. It's not yet known if this is intentional or not on POKENAME's part.

entry: 未经证实的报告称，紫苑镇曾出现POKENAME。据故事讲，它现身人前，要求对方离开，随后在眼前扭曲消失。
author: sk372
source: Unconfirmed reports say POKENAME has been spotted in Lavender Town. According to the stories, POKENAME appears before someone, demanding they leave before distorting and vanishing before their eyes.

entry: POKENAME掌控设备，让用户沉迷屏幕播放的内容。等受害者彻底忘却周遭，就跳出屏幕，夺走生命。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME overtakes devices and causes the user to become absorbed in whatever it plays on the screen. Once the victim is fully tuned out, POKENAME jumps through the screen to take their life.

entry: POKENAME借自身不稳定暂时分裂身体，用大量错误弹窗吓唬观看者。其实并未出错，只是分散注意，好自在吸光电脑冷却液。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its instability to temporarily split its body and scare the people watching the device screen with lots of error message popups. While no errors actually happen, this distraction lets it freely absorb all the coolants from the computer.

entry: POKENAME借自身不稳定暂时分裂身体，在屏幕铺满杂讯、损坏附近代码，吓唬用户。再重新合体，跳过杂讯屏幕，猛地吓人。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its instability to temporarily split its body and scare users of the computer by placing static over their screen and corrupting all nearby code. Then, it recombines its body and jumps through the static screen to jump scare them.

entry: POKENAME大多待在数字设备里。触碰会引起剧烈头痛与恶心，嘴里射出的激光则能撕裂现实本身。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME spends most of its time inside digital devices. Touching it can cause severe headaches and nausea. The laser it fires from its mouth tears through reality itself.

entry: POKENAME身体两半由极不稳定的数据与电流系连。不建议触碰电弧，虽不致命，却会损伤视力。
author: sk372
source: The two halves of POKENAME's body are connected by a tether of highly volatile data and electricity. Touching the arc is not recommended: though it is not lethal, it will damage one's vision.

entry: POKENAME偶尔出现在主屏幕，坚持要用户下线。若被忽视，就在屏幕显出催眠信息，强行让对方睡去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME occasionally appears upon a person's home screen, insisting that the user log off. If ignored, it forcibly puts them to sleep with a hypnotic message it manifests on the screen.

entry: POKENAME罕见地潜伏在打开的浏览器角落，所在论坛讨论末日故事或事件。若被发现，就通过电脑放出催眠气息，再逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can rarely be found lurking in the corners of open browsers on forums discussing apocalyptic stories or events. If noticed, it emits an aura through the person's computer that can induce sleep before it flees.

entry: 有些人为处理严重成瘾行为，在电脑安装POKENAME。工作或玩游戏太久，它就现身催人入睡，同时关掉电脑。
author: wiz0z
source: In order to deal with extreme addictive behaviors, some people install POKENAME on their computers. If they spend too much time working or playing video games, POKENAME appears and sends them to sleep while also shutting down the computer.

entry: POKENAME来回横走，拦截所在电脑收到的所有数据包。用偷来的数据，修复因使用而退化、消失的双钳。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME walks side-to-side to catch and block any incoming data packets a computer it's inside of is recieving. It uses this stolen data to repair its pincers when they degrade and disappear from being used.

entry: POKENAME巨钳虽沉，却随时可能胡乱挥动，猛砸地面。力量与不稳定性带来巨大风险，因此有些城市禁止训练家带它去公共海滩。
author: soup1900
source: Despite the claw being so heavy, POKENAME will randomly swing this claw around and smash it on the ground at any moment. Cities have banned Trainers from bringing this Pokémon to public beaches due to how its power and instability pose a huge risk.

entry: POKENAME炮口几乎总漏出古怪液体。对多数对象似乎无害，钢属性宝可梦一碰，却会举止怪异，仿佛喝醉。
author: sk372
source: A strange liquid material is almost always leaking from POKENAME's cannons. Though it seems harmless to most, Steel-type Pokémon that come into contact begin acting strangely, akin to inebriation.

entry: POKENAME脚底黏垫能牢牢贴树，即使倒挂也不松脱。终生认定一棵树为家，从背上球茎喷出麻痹花粉，驱赶闯入者。
author: sk372
source: Sticky pads at the bottom of POKENAME's feet allow it to cling and stick to trees perfectly, even while upside down. It claims a single tree as its home for life, and sprays paralyzing pollen from the bulb on its back at any interlopers.

entry: POKENAME皮肤里的细刺，让它能沿大树滚上去。最爱的消遣是从树顶跳进池塘，溅水时放出一圈电波。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Tiny spikes within its skin allow POKENAME to roll up large trees. A favorite pastime of POKENAME is to dive into a pond from the tree tops, sending a ripple of electricity out as it splashes.

entry: POKENAME在丛林遗迹筑巢。能花上数日，挑选坚韧树枝作武器。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are found nesting in jungle ruins. They can spend days choosing a sturdy branch to wield as a weapon.

entry: POKENAME以竹碎片射击，或挥竹迅击，守护领地。能攀上、贴住树侧，因此有许多出击角度。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME guard their territories with ranged attacks shot from their bamboo shards or by striking swiftly with their bamboo. They can climb and stick to the sides of trees, allotting them many angles to potentially attack from.

entry: POKENAME舌中含有未知植物的树液，能使肌肉极度放松，直至麻痹。用它的叶子与树液泡出的好茶，则能舒缓肌肉疼痛。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's tongue contains the sap of an unknown plant, which causes extreme muscle relaxation to the point of paralysis. This sap can be brewed into a lovely tea using leaves from the Pokémon, which helps soothe muscle pain.

entry: POKENAME挂在热带树木的果实间伪装，直到准备进化。自卫能力十分有限，遇险只会从树上落下，试图逃走。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME camouflage themselves amongst the fruits of tropical trees, hanging amongst the fruit until they are ready to evolve. They have very limited ability to defend themselves and will simply drop out of trees to try and escape danger.

entry: 林中若响起巨大隆隆声，多半是POKENAME冲来了。冲锋几乎无法阻挡，连树也能撞倒，加固的刺角还能撕开岩石。
author: evilgammon
source: When you hear a great rumbling in the forest, it's probably the sign of a charging POKENAME. Their charge is near unstoppable, with them even knocking over trees and ripping through rocks with its reinforced thorn horn.

entry: POKENAME用粗绳般的厚藤裹住自己，抵御伤害。操控藤蔓进攻，甚至改变结构，让末端长出叶刃。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME wraps itself in a blanket of thick, rope-like vines to protect itself from harm. It manipulates these vines to strike, even modifying their structure to tip them with leaf blades.

entry: POKENAME游得快，能逆着湍急河溪前进。休息时却用鳍上小钩挂住浮木，懒洋洋地顺流漂下。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME possesses a swift swimming speed, being able to swim against the current of fast streams and rivers. However, when it is resting, it will utilize tiny hooks within its fins to latch onto a floating log and drift lazily down the waterway.

entry: POKENAME既美丽又脆弱。睡在树干上时，翼上花纹能作伪装。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME is as delicate as it is beautiful. The pattern on its wings acts as camouflage when it sleeps on tree trunks.

entry: POKENAME住在茂盛雨林，以锋利镰刀劈开厚密植物，是丛林探险者十分可靠的伙伴。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live in lush rainforests, using its sharp scythes to cleave through the thick flora. They are quite the reliable partners for jungle explorers.

entry: 它以舞蹈向其他POKENAME彰显地位。这舞很看重双眼湿润，因此常跳到一半，就舔舔眼睛。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It engages in dances to assert dominance over other POKENAME. Moist eyes are valued in this dance, so POKENAME will often lick its eyes mid-dance.

entry: 天敌靠近，它便亮出红腹，吓对方一跳。趁对方分心，再用弹簧般的尾巴，将自己弹出去逃走。
author: staghorn
source: When a predator approaches, it flashes its red belly to startle them. Once the predator is distracted, it uses its spring-like tail to launch itself and make a getaway.

entry: 谁触碰栖居的树，POKENAME就竖起毛刺，从颈圈放电。双尾还能提前数日感知风暴。
author: fiordaliso
source: If someone touches the tree it inhabits, POKENAME raises its fur spikes and releases electric shocks from its collar. Its two tails can sense incoming storms days in advance.

entry: POKENAME生活在丛林高高的林冠，极难寻觅，至今只有寥寥几次目击。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are extremely elusive as they live high in the jungle canopy. They have been spotted only a handful of times.

entry: POKENAME每次受伤，都会产生使其他宝可梦与训练家流泪的特殊酶。无意弄哭身旁的人，自己又觉得羞愧，跟着哭起来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce special enzymes whenever they get hurt that cause other Pokémon and Trainers to cry. Whenever they inadvertently cause those around them to cry, they feel ashamed and will cry too.

entry: 每片薄如刀的落叶，都覆着带薄荷般墨角兰气息的油，让细小割伤刺痛。油能抑制微生物，也能促进光合作用。
author: quackquackattack
source: Each razor-thin leaf shed is coated with an oil that resembles a minty marjoram, which causes thin cuts to sting. The antimicrobial oil doubles as a stimulant to promote photosynthesis.

entry: POKENAME走路时，脚底小刺翻松土壤。它栖居的森林，明显更茂盛，生物也更多样。
author: santon5512
source: The small spikes on the bottoms of POKENAME's feet till the soil as they walk. Forests that are home to these Pokémon are noticeably more lush and biodiverse.

entry: POKENAME夜间飞得更快，穿梭丛林树冠。借追打，能轻松追上长尾怪手等猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's flying speed increases at night as it weaves through jungle canopies. Using Pursuit, it easily chases down prey like Aipom.

entry: POKENAME能提前几小时预知天气变化。极度讨厌寒冷，因此曾钻进人们外套或天然鸟羽毛里避寒。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME can predict weather changes a few hours before they occur. Since POKENAME absolutely despise cold temperatures, this has led to instances where they sought shelter in people's jackets or the feathers of Xatu.

entry: POKENAME的植物纤维工业用途广泛，例如制作地毯。腿上小钩能助它轻松爬上直立表面，常见它啃食难以够取的树叶。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME's plant fibers have a wide range of industrial uses, including being made into carpets. POKENAME can easily climb vertical surfaces using tiny hooks on their legs, and can often be seen grazing on hard-to-reach tree leaves.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，能控制紧邻的花朵，头上的雏菊也会快速旋转。
author: .izik
source: While dancing, POKENAME gains control over flowers in its immediate area. During this time, the daisies on its head rotate rapidly.

entry: 丛林湿度下降，POKENAME就用力量降雨。水系攻击威力极强，短短几秒就能灭火。
author: fiordaliso
source: If the humidity levels in the jungle drop, POKENAME uses its powers to make it rain. Its water-based attacks are so powerful that it could extinguish a fire in just a few seconds.

entry: POKENAME尾上长出的叶子极锋利，可投掷远攻。也用来削磨牙齿，使其尽可能尖利，好撕开树皮，吸饮内部丰美树液。
author: evilgammon
source: The leaves grown from POKENAME's tail are very sharp, making them effective to be thrown as ranged attacks. These leaves are also used to whittle its teeth for maximum sharpness, allowing it to rip into tree bark and drink the succulent sap inside.

entry: POKENAME分泌黏膜，能贴住表面垂直攀爬。它很弱，常被大宝可梦挤下树，却毫不在意，又爬回去。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME produces a sticky film that allows it to stick to surfaces and climb vertically. It is very weak and often pushed out of trees by bigger Pokémon, but unfazed it will climb back up them again.

entry: POKENAME对周遭相当迟钝，即使捕食者靠近也没察觉。不过光滑黏软的身体，能让它毫发无伤地滑出对方掌握。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is known to be quite oblivious of its surroundings even when predators draw close. However, its slick, slimy body helps it escape the clutches of these predators unharmed.

entry: POKENAME在雨林与丛林筑巢。黏脚趾让它爬上高高林冠，给球茎晒足阳光。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME makes its nest in rainforests and jungles. Its sticky toes allow it to climb high into the canopy to get plenty of sunlight for its bulb.

entry: POKENAME无惧任何敌人，守护取食的树，连圈圈熊这样大得多的宝可梦也不怕。喜欢与同类摔跤，用角设法掀翻对方。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME fearlessly defends the trees where it feeds from any foe, even much larger Pokémon like Ursaring. It enjoys competing against others of its kind in wrestling matches, where it uses its horn to try flipping the other over.

entry: 成群的POKENAME栖居在高高的树梢，避开森林地面，以免遭到捕食者袭击。夜里，它们的壳亮起光芒，远远望去，仿佛树上结满了发光的果实。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Clusters of POKENAME make their home high in the treetops, avoiding the forest floor in order to keep themselves safe from predators. They can be seen by the light of their shells at night, creating the illusion that the trees bear glowing fruit.

entry: 它随和自在，无法光合时，就吃藻类和海草维生。允许熟悉的人骑在背上。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is an easygoing Pokémon who relies on consuming algae and seaweed when it cannot photosynthesize. It allows those who are familiar with it to ride on its back.

entry: POKENAME极敏捷又极聪明，能轻松逃出多数简单容器。常见它们往树顶攀，沐浴阳光。
author: bobosmith01
source: Incredibly nimble and incredibly intelligent, POKENAME can easily escape most simple containers with ease. Many can be found climbing towards treetops in order to bask in sunlight.

entry: 它用长而有弹性的黏舌检查周围。遇见喜欢的东西，就先舔干净，再拿来当饰品。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It examines its surroundings with its long, elastic, sticky tongue. If it encounters something it likes, it will lick it clean before making it an accessory.

entry: POKENAME引来雷雨中的闪电，将能量吸入体内。充满电后，周围形成静电场，使种子提早发芽。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME draws in lightning from thunderstorms, absorbing the energy into its body. After charging fully, it generates a static field around itself, which causes seeds to sprout early.

entry: POKENAME头上长出的腿摸起来极冷。林中家园炎夏来临，便借这寒气舒缓身体。
author: .izik
source: The legs growing from POKENAME's head are extremely cold to the touch. It draws on this chill to soothe its body during the hot summer months in its forest home.

entry: POKENAME敏捷无比，高速跃过树间。尾巴尤其强劲，一挥就能击倒树木。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are incredibly agile, jumping from tree to tree at high speeds. Their tails are especially powerful, able to knock down trees with a single swing.

entry: POKENAME藏在茂林绿叶间，仔细观察过客。尾巴比看起来粗重，是对付不速之客的有效武器。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides among the greenery in lush forests, carefully observing those who travel through. Its tail is thicker and heavier than it appears, making it an effective weapon in dealing with unwanted intruders.

entry: POKENAME尽心守护丛林领地，以强尾迅速击垮那些会破坏茂盛景观的闯入者。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME diligently guards its jungle territory, swiftly crushing intruders that would mar the lush landscape with its powerful tail.

entry: POKENAME孵化后，火囊迅速发育产热，让父母觅食时仍能保暖。几天内脚爪便长出小钩，轻松攀上直立表面。
author: chibitales
source: After hatching, POKENAME's flame sac quickly develops and begins producing heat, keeping POKENAME warm as their parents forage for food.  Within a few days, they develop tiny hooks on their talons, allowing them to scale vertical surfaces with ease.

entry: POKENAME大而锋利的爪子善于爬墙，却不适合防御。会尖叫打乱捕食者，借机逃走；若其他办法都失败，才以连踢反击。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's large, sharp claws allow them to climb vertical walls easily, but are not well-suited for defense. They let out a sharp cry to catch predators off guard before escaping. If all else fails, they lash out with a flurry of kicks.

entry: POKENAME用强腿击打果树侧面训练，再向落果喷出小火，练习准头。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME trains by striking the sides of fruit trees with its strong legs. It spits small flames at the falling fruit to sharpen its aim.

entry: POKENAME在沼泽树旁筑巢，那里泥土肥沃充足。虽善于爬树，通常仍用水柱打下高处果实。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME make their dens near trees in marshes and swamps, where the mud is rich and plentiful. Though they can climb the trees rather well, they typically shoot down the fruits above with jets of water.

entry: POKENAME手上黏膜让它轻松贴树攀爬。会在树干涂出特定形状的泥，标记私人领地。
author: sk372
source: A sticky film on POKENAME's hands lets it cling and climb up trees with relative ease. It smears mud in specific shapes on the trunks of trees to mark them as its personal territory.

entry: POKENAME双拳砸向泥地，地下便冒出细小草叶。罕见时，落拳处会长出一整朵玫瑰。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME slams its fists into muddy ground, tiny blades of grass burst up from below. On rare occasions, a full rose will grow from the impact point.

entry: POKENAME吐出的种子，会让被击中者产生强烈共情。效果一天内自然消退。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits seeds that induce intense empathy in those it strikes. The effect fades naturally within a day.

entry: POKENAME停在树上冥想，短暂预见未来。预见内容也能涉及周围约一百米内的任何人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME meditates while perched in trees, receiving brief visions of the future. These glimpses can extend to anyone within roughly one hundred meters.

entry: POKENAME的叶状裙装在战斗中优雅摇曳。动作越流畅，精神冲击便越强。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's leaflike dress sways gracefully during combat. The more fluid its movement, the stronger its psychic bursts become.

entry: POKENAME头顶的刺渗出几乎无害的毒，接触只会有轻微灼感。主要攻击方式是跃向对手，试图以刺冲撞。
author: evilgammon
source: The thorn at the top of POKENAME's head seeps a near harmless poison, only causing a slight burning when contact is made. Its main method of attack is to leap at the opponent and try to ram them with its thorn.

entry: POKENAME通常在林中最大树木的内部或周围筑巢。在某种环境住得越久，身色就越接近周围植物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME typically make their nests in and around the largest trees within forests. The longer they spend in a specific environment, the more their bodily hues change to match the surrounding flora.

entry: POKENAME家族占住整片小树林，凶狠抵挡其他宝可梦。利爪让它们在树干上下疾爬，轻松赶走对手。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Families of POKENAME claim entire groves of trees as their territory, violently defending them from other Pokémon. Their sharp claws allow them to scurry up and down tree trunks without issue, letting them chase away rivals with ease.

entry: POKENAME双尾似乎已进化成额外的颚，外观功能都相近。看似能吃东西，主要却用来储食。即使装着食物，爬树仍十分敏捷。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's twin tails appear to have evolved to look and function like extra sets of jaws. These jaws appear capable of consuming food, yet it primarily uses them to store food. Even with food stored within them, it remains an agile climber.

entry: 爱冒险的孩子若靠巢太近，POKENAME就会狠狠瞪视，再一路跟着，直到对方离开树林。
author: badtothebow
source: POKENAME is known to glare intensely at adventurous children who wander too close to its nest. It then follows them until they leave its woods.

entry: 与最初猜想不同，它能顺利爬树，只是慢些。偏爱坚韧果实，凭强颚轻松咬开。还会从高处吐籽，吓退危险。
author: infinex21
source: Despite initial assumptions, this Pokémon is able to scale up trees without issue, albeit at a slow pace. It favors tough fruits, which it can easily bite into thanks to its strong jaws. It deters dangers by spitting seeds from a high perch.

entry: POKENAME是好斗的小林居者，对认定属于自己的树，领地意识极强。背上灌丛里的小藤，会朝所有闯入者甩出锋利叶片。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a feisty little forest-dweller that gets very territorial about the trees it calls its own. From within the bushes on its back, small vines fling sharp leaves out at any and all trespassers.

entry: 林火之后，POKENAME踩平烧毁树木周围的地面，再用尾挖洞，种下找到的种子，促进新生。
author: .izik
source: After forest fires, POKENAME stomps the ground flat around burnt trees. It then uses its tail to dig holes and plant seeds it finds to promote new growth.

entry: POKENAME结成大群，收集、分享食物，常借彼此尾火烤熟食物。睡着尾火就会灭，因此冬季或寒冷天气会轮流睡觉。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live in sizeable groups, gathering and sharing food with one another; they will often use each other's tail flames to roast some foods. Because their tail fires go out when they sleep, they take turns sleeping during winter and cold weather.

entry: POKENAME较锋利的叶爪滴着弱毒，接触会有灼感。战斗时主要靠它们进攻，贴近后接连挥爪。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's relatively sharp leaf claws drip with a weak poison that burns when contact is made. They use these claws as their main method of attack in battle, getting very close and unleashing a flurry of swipes.

entry: POKENAME看似可爱，却会鼓起胸膛，凶狠瞪视，吓退敌人。它十分高傲，谁想送礼，都会被它用尾巴拍开。
author: soup1900
source: Although cute-looking, POKENAME will puff up its chest and take on an intimidating glare to scare foes. It is very proud, so it will use its tail to slap away any gifts people may try to give it.

entry: POKENAME走遍森林巡查，查看植物生长状况。任何东西若想伤害尚未开花、完全长成的植物，都会受到严惩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME marches across the forest, patrolling to check on the status of growing plants. It harshly punishes anything that would try to harm plants that have yet to bloom and grow fully.

entry: POKENAME用利鳍在地上划沟，带来幼芽与种子放入，再从嘴里浇水。短短几天，就能重新种满整座山坡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its sharp fins to carve trenches into the ground. It carries sprouts and seeds into these trenches before watering them from its mouth. It can replant an entire hillside within a matter of days.

entry: POKENAME藏在树上，用柔韧如叶的棍棒守护领地，被认为是森林的守护者。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME guards its territory from the trees with its flexible, leaf-like club. It is said to be a guardian of the forest.

entry: POKENAME将触须扎入居住的树干，直接吸收能量。这会减慢树上所有果实的生长。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs its feelers into the trunk of its resident tree to absorb energy directly from it. This slows the growth of any fruit on the tree.

entry: POKENAME照料森林神龛，守望隐士。有些人相信，它能察觉心怀恶意进入森林的人。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME tend to forest shrines and watch over hermits. Some believe POKENAME can detect when a human enters its forest with ill intent.

entry: POKENAME的网由叶片编织，导电性极强。它用手穿行网中迷宫，战斗时从上方出击。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's webs are made out of woven leaves, and are highly conductive. They use their hands to traverse its maze of webs and strike from above in battle.

entry: POKENAME徘徊最幽暗的密林，闪动火焰吸住猎物注意，诱其靠近。时机一到就点燃对方，将身体与灵魂化为灰，滋养森林。
author: kungfucutbug
source: POKENAME lingers deep within the darkest forests, flickering its flames to transfix prey and lure them closer. When the time is right, it lights them ablaze, reducing body and soul to ash that fertilizes the forest.

entry: POKENAME的多条尾巴内含易燃液体，能释放出来，再用嘴点燃。它常以满是小钩的脚抓树，向敌人喷出燃烧的种子。
author: infinex21
source: Its many tails contain flammable liquid that POKENAME can release and ignite using its mouth. It will often spit flaming seeds at opponents while clinging to trees with its feet that are lined with many tiny hooks.

entry: POKENAME不断唤出叶刃练习，想熟练运用。离目标却还远，攻击大多只是胡乱挥舞。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME spends their time conjuring leaf blades and training with them to gain proficiency. It's a long way off this goal, however, with its attacks mostly just being flailing and wild swings.

entry: POKENAME每天大半时间都在做最拿手的事：偷懒。爱躺在暖石上晒太阳，若没石头就去树顶休息。幼时肉食，成熟后转为草食。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME spends most of its day doing what it does best: lazing around. It loves sunbathing on warm rocks but will rest atop trees if none are available. It is carnivorous when young and becomes herbivorous as it matures.

entry: 它以林中一棵树为家，此后很少离开。POKENAME躺得一动不动，身上竟长出一层苔藓。
author: .jerden
source: It makes its home in a tree in the forest, and then seldom leaves. POKENAME lies so still that a layer of moss grows on its body.

entry: POKENAME沿海滩单脚跳，寻找冲上海岸的海草吃。若失去平衡，就开始滚动，直到重新稳住。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hops on one foot along beaches in search of washed-up seaweed to eat. Should it lose balance, it begins to roll until it regains its composure.

entry: POKENAME将尾巴留在阳光里，给体内充电。再以带电尾巴拍击敌人，使其晕眩，随后接上咬碎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaves its tail in sunlight to charge electricity within its body. It then smacks its charged tail into foes to stun them before following up with Crunch.

entry: 身体虽重，腿上的许多小钩仍能助它轻松爬上直立表面。用粗重尾巴碾碎岩石，吃下小碎块。
author: infinex21
source: Despite its heavy body, the many tiny hooks upon its legs allow it to easily scale vertical surfaces. It uses its bulky tail to crush up rocks into smaller debris for it to eat.

entry: POKENAME在巨树根部筑巢，土壤湿润，富含矿物。吃下湿土，滤取水分与矿物，再排出余土；排出的土极适合堆肥。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME nests at the base of a giant tree, where the soil is mineral-rich and damp. It consumes damp soil, filtering the water and minerals within itself, and then excretes the leftover soil; the soil it excretes is perfect for composting.

entry: POKENAME用巨颚掘出树根附近的泥土吞食。留下的洞松松盖住，作为陷阱，绊住威胁家园的闯入者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its massive jaws to dig up dirt to consume near the bases of trees. It loosely covers the holes left behind to act as traps to trip up intruders that threaten its home.

entry: POKENAME以锋利叶爪作战，射程虽短，力道却足。梦想有朝一日飞行，因此用叶片拼出拙劣的滑翔翼。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME uses its sharp leaf claws to attack in battle, and while they may have short range, they pack a punch. It dreams to one day fly, so it poorly constructs gliding wings out of leaves.

entry: POKENAME须住在酷热热带环境，否则容易生病。能让绿尾炽亮，进一步增强近战攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME needs to live in very hot tropical habitats, or it risks falling ill. It can make its green tail incandescent to further empower its close-range attacks.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时把尾巴浸进河里吸水。醒来就会喷出一团洋葱味粉末。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dips its tail in rivers to absorb water while it sleeps. When it wakes, it releases a puff of onion-scented powder.

entry: POKENAME在健康丰茂的巨树周围筑巢，每天照料，确保树木健康。摩擦上肢末端，会产生难闻气味，驱赶鸟宝可梦与虫宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME nest around giant trees that are healthy and bountiful, tending to these trees every day to ensure they stay healthy. When they rub the ends of their upper limbs together, they produce awful odors meant to repel bird Pokémon and bug Pokémon.

entry: 它在高树筑巢，停在孩子刚好够不着的位置。若孩子爬树来捉，就越飘越高，直到对方再也无法安全下去。
author: periperi_chicken
source: It makes its nest in tall trees. It waits just high enough to be out of a child's reach, and if they climb to catch it, it will float higher and higher until there is no way for them to get down safely.

entry: POKENAME皮肤极不沾水，水珠直接滑落。生活在炎热干燥气候，野外可见它游荡稀树草原。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's skin is extremely hydrophobic: drops of water simply glide right off. It is found in hot, dry climates and can be spotted roaming savannahs in the wild.

entry: 野生POKENAME会在大树顶建树屋筑巢，比人类任何木建筑都坚固得多。
author: cobalt0135
source: Wild POKENAME will build treehouses on top of large trees to nest. Their treehouses are far sturdier than any human-made wooden structure.

entry: 据说POKENAME拍翼的声音，就如叶片迎风翻动。
author: .duckyquack
source: It is said that the sound of POKENAME flapping their wings is equivalent to the sound of leaves blowing against the wind.

entry: POKENAME脚底有无数小刺，能倒挂攀爬。训练家一见洞顶水晶眼睛透出邪光，许多人就吓得逃走。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME have countless tiny spikes along the soles of their feet, which allow them to climb upside down. When Trainers spot their crystal eyes glinting wickedly at the roof of a cave, many run away in fear.

entry: POKENAME行走时，嘴里滴出黏绿树液。吃下有毒，却能帮助附近植物生长。
author: .izik
source: A sticky green sap drips from POKENAME's mouth as it walks. While toxic to consume, it helps nearby plant life to grow.

entry: POKENAME喜欢爬上高树，挑选家园。一旦选定，便用那棵树的树皮雕面具，成为新居的守护者。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME love to climb up tall trees while choosing one to be their home. Once they select a tree, they carve a mask from the bark of their chosen tree, becoming the guardian of this newfound residence.

entry: POKENAME爱吃甜水果与树果。为了在最大的树果树筑巢，个体间会凶狠争斗。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME enjoys feasting on sweet fruits and berries. Individuals are known to viciously fight each other over the biggest berry trees to nest in.

entry: POKENAME行走时，用脚从水洼吸取雨水。一路释放的黄色花粉，能安抚附近生灵。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME absorbs rainwater through puddles with its feet as it walks. It releases yellow pollen as it moves, which calms those nearby.

entry: POKENAME守护树木，尤其细心照看幼苗。若有什么威胁到受照料的小树，就用双臂与壳保护，同时以粗尾猛击威胁者，予以驱赶。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME is a protector of trees.  It is especially careful with young saplings — if anything threatens a sapling under its care, it will use its arms and shell to defend it, while slamming its thick tail against the threat as a deterrent.

entry: POKENAME守护森林里的小型宝可梦，保护时坚定不移，态度却十分严肃。小家伙若闹腾过头，就会用棍敲打。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME acts as a guardian over small forest-dwelling Pokémon. Though it protects them staunchly, it has a no-nonsense attitude and will strike the little ones with its stick if they act too rambunctiously.

entry: POKENAME常在高树枝间冥想。看似深陷恍惚，其实极留意周围，始终防着伐木工砍得太多。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can often be found meditating in branches of tall trees. While they appear to be in a deep trance, they are hyper aware of their surroundings, and are always on guard in case lumberjacks chop down too much.

entry: POKENAME常在河湖仰面躺着，因为许多孩子爱把它翻过来玩。随时都能自行翻正，却常选择继续肚皮朝天。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can often be found lying upside down on lakes and rivers, as flipping them over is a popular pastime of many children. They can flip themselves upright at any time, but many simply choose to remain upside down.

entry: POKENAME从树里吸取极易燃烧的树液，用旧营火留下的木炭筑巢。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME draws highly flammable sap from trees. It builds its nest from the charcoal of old campfires.

entry: POKENAME绕领地内几乎每棵树掘出圈道，设成巡逻路径。挖掘翻松土壤，保持柔软疏松，帮助植物健康生长。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME digs in circles around almost every tree in its territory, setting a patrol path. The digging churns up the soil and helps keep it soft and loose, aiding the plants in healthy growth.

entry: POKENAME清晨摇摆着走过海滩，寻找沙里的叶子吃。等太阳完全升起，便潜入海中。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME waddles across beaches in the early morning, searching for leaves in the sand. It consumes them before diving into the sea once the sun fully rises.

entry: POKENAME能稍加控制植物，将藤蔓绞进身体，化作一对能操纵的手。伸得更远，让移动与收集都方便许多。
author: evilgammon
source: With a certain degree of control over plants, POKENAME twists vines into its body to allow it to have a set of controllable hands. This makes traversal and gathering much easier, as it can extend its reach to far-off places.

entry: POKENAME很少下树，只挂住一根脚趾，也能舒舒服服睡觉。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME rarely come down from the trees. They can sleep while comfortably hanging from just a single toe.

entry: 野生POKENAME游荡古老森林，巡视古道。有时，小型飞行属性宝可梦会在覆苔皮毛里筑巢。
author: pastapockets
source: Wild POKENAME roam in old growth forests, patrolling ancient roads. Tiny Flying-type Pokémon sometimes make nests in their mossy fur.

entry: POKENAME灵巧无比，能轻松穿行密林。看见强敌，就不顾一切迎上去。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's unmatched dexterity allows it to easily maneuver in dense jungles. When it sees a strong opponent, it engages with reckless abandon.

entry: POKENAME能以突然而惊人的速度跃出水面，一跃可达150英尺。虽能两栖生活，通常仍住在水下。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can leap out of the water at sudden and surprising speed, able to clear up to 150 feet from the water in a single bound. While technically amphibious, they typically live underwater.

entry: POKENAME用黏液将藤蔓贴在身上，带回家编成坚巢。住在城市也爱这样做，因此建议训练家别让它看见电线。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME attach vines to their body using sticky mucus, carrying them back to their home to weave into a sturdy nest. POKENAME kept in cities enjoy engaging in similar behaviour, and Trainers are advised to keep power cables out of their sight.

entry: 木匠借POKENAME砍下高树粗枝。它工作时用脚上小钩倒挂，纯粹为了炫耀。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Carpenters use POKENAME to chop down thick branches from tall trees. POKENAME use the small hooks on their feet to hang upside down while they work; this is done purely to show off.

entry: POKENAME游得出奇快。虽能缩壳自保，却很少在战斗中退缩。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME can swim at surprising speeds. Although it can withdraw into its shell for protection, it rarely backs down from a fight.

entry: POKENAME从触手快速发射种子，攻击海面上的猎物。能把长翅鸥等宝可梦打落，作为食物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires seeds rapidly from its tentacles at prey above the ocean's surface. It uses this to knock Pokémon like Wingull from the sky so it can feed.

entry: POKENAME选好居住的树，就细心四处寻找大石，围住树干。植物与石头搭配得当，巢才算真正的家。
author: sk372
source: Once POKENAME picks out a tree to live in, it goes about meticulously searching for large rocks to surround the trunk with. A POKENAME den isn't truly a home until it's a proper mix of plant and stone.

entry: POKENAME背上产生的孢子不断自燃。鬃焰若熄灭，还能用蹄擦击含金属的石头，迸出火星，再次点燃自己。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME produces spores from its back, which continuously ignite. If its mane flame is extinguished, POKENAME can reignite itself by sparking its hoof against metallic stones.

entry: POKENAME尾巴长着独特苔藓。若晒得太多，就把尾巴收进壳里。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME grows a unique moss on its tail. If the moss is getting too much sun, POKENAME will tuck its tail into its shell.

entry: POKENAME尾上的眼睛无法提供有效视野，便靠头部与脚发出的声呐，在冰水中辨路。旅途中休息，会用尾上的手抓住冰山。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses sonar from its head and feet to navigate icy waters, unable to rely on the eye on its tail for any useful sight. It uses the hand on its tail to grip icebergs while resting between travels.

entry: POKENAME在野外照看绿毛虫群，确保安全。额上长叶如鞭，抽打任何想伤害它们的东西。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME watches over groups of Caterpie in the wild to insure their safety. It uses the long leaf on its forehead like a whip to lash out at anything that would harm them.

entry: POKENAME在领地周围设下复杂陷阱，阻挡闯入者。若正面遇上，就用棍重重敲打。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME sets up elaborate traps around its territory to deter intruders. If it encounters a trespasser, POKENAME strongly thwacks them with its stick.

entry: POKENAME借众多叶片与深绿色伪装，跃过树间和成簇竹秆。挥使竹片，既能射出弹丸，也能打出迅捷重击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their many leaves and deep green colors to conceal themselves as they leap between trees and clusters of bamboo culms. They wield pieces of bamboo to launch projectiles at foes and to deliver swift, hard blows.

entry: POKENAME拍响粗尾、转动钻头，警告靠栖居树林太近的来者。和平时，就在林里阳光最足的地方仰面打盹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME slaps its thick tail on the ground and spins its drill as a warning to those that get too close to the groves it inhabits. It naps belly-up in the sunniest parts of the grove during peaceful moments.

entry: 它在头发里养电电虫，清掉其他虫宝可梦，让发丝柔顺如绸。唱歌表演前，先把电电虫取下来。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It carries Joltik in its hair to clean it of other bug Pokémon and give it a silky appearance. It will remove its Joltik before it performs its songs.

entry: POKENAME寿命短，小而脆弱的身体无法有效使用四肢。在成年进化前，都只能依赖翅膀。
author: foulz4k
source: POKENAME has a short lifespan, as its small, frail body is unable to effectively use its limbs. It has to rely on its wings until adulthood, when it evolves.

entry: POKENAME住在繁密森林深处的大河，背起小宝可梦，充当渡船。高草藏住乘客，作为回报留下的树果，则为草施肥。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME lives in vast rivers deep within tangled forests. It acts as a vessel and ferries small Pokémon on its back, carrying them across the river. The tall grass hides the passengers, and the berries they drop in exchange fertilize the grass.

entry: POKENAME扁平的身体以惊人速度滑过丛林。若被发现，就急促哔哔叫，再射出幻象光线。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's flat body glides through jungles at remarkable speed. If detected, it emits rapid beeps before firing a Psybeam.

entry: POKENAME四肢的利叶刃让它作战极高效。通常只吃水果与树果，但食物减少时，也会猎捕更小的林居生物。
author: sk372
source: The sharp leaf-blades on POKENAME's limbs make it a very efficient combatant. Though typically eating only fruits and berries, in times of dwindling food supplies it will hunt smaller forest denizens.

entry: 它最常见于茂密森林深处、难以抵达的湖泊。POKENAME用神秘力量操控周围叶丛、阻挡访客时，胸前宝石便会发光。
author: sk372
source: A Pokémon most often found in hard-to-reach lakes nestled deep within verdant forests. POKENAME's jewel on its chest glows as it uses a strange power to manipulate the foliage around it to deter visitors.

entry: POKENAME极罕见，住在热带丛林，行为仍未被充分了解。偶尔偷过客的随身物品，隐身行窃的情况则更少。
author: bobosmith01
source: An extremely rare Pokémon that lives in tropical jungles, POKENAME's behavior is not well understood. It will rarely steal carried objects from passersby, even more rarely under the guise of invisibility.

entry: POKENAME极罕见，住在热带丛林，细胞构成仍未被充分了解。外观随栖地变化，例如下雨时色调会更蓝。
author: bobosmith01
source: An extremely rare Pokémon that lives in tropical jungles, POKENAME's cellular composition is not well understood. Its appearance morphs depending on its habitat; it dons a bluer hue during the rain, for example.

entry: POKENAME极罕见，住在热带丛林，行为仍未被充分了解。偶尔偷过客的随身物品，隐身行窃的情况则更少。
author: bobosmith01
source: An extremely rare Pokémon that lives in tropical jungles, POKENAME's behavior is not well understood. It will rarely steal carried objects from passersby, even more rarely under the guise of invisibility.

entry: 为变得更强，POKENAME迎着瀑布急流练习叶刃。食欲旺盛，强颚抓到什么就吞什么。
author: fiordaliso
source: To grow stronger, POKENAME practices its Leaf Blade strikes against the force of rushing waterfalls. It is a voracious Pokémon that devours anything it catches in its powerful jaws.

entry: 叶丛外衣伪装太好，因此野外罕见。POKENAME需要大量水，才能让叶片健康。
author: hophoppip
source: It's rarely seen in the wild because its coat of foliage blends in so well. POKENAME requires lots of water to keep its leaves healthy.

entry: POKENAME小身体容易过热，因此几乎不远离可浸泡的凉水。它泡过的水，总会带上浓郁花香。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's small body overheats easily, so it almost never ventures far from cool water to soak itself in. Water POKENAME dips itself into constantly develops a very aromatic floral scent.

entry: POKENAME潜在水下，头上的长叶则浮于水面。长叶能接收上方的振动，让它对水上、水下的动静都了如指掌。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The long frond on POKENAME's head floats on top of the water whilst they remain submerged beneath. It can pick up vibrations from above, allowing it to have a clear idea of what is going on both above and under the water.

entry: POKENAME什么都怕，潜在水下藏身。能接收上方振动，清楚掌握水上水下的情况，方便迅速逃离。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is scared of everything and hides submerged underwater. It can pick up vibrations from above, allowing it to have a clear idea of what is going on both above and under the water, so it can make a quick getaway.

entry: POKENAME借身上长出的叶片吸收阳光，为预知能力积蓄能量。
author: glacierwing
source: Using the leaves that grow out of their body, POKENAME gather sunlight to charge their precognitive powers.

entry: POKENAME壳上渗出浓稠琥珀状物，干燥提纯后，是许多化妆品的热门成分。丰缘的大姐姐尤其喜欢含其成分的浴盐。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME shells ooze a thick amber-like substance that, when dried out and purified, is a popular ingredient in many cosmetic products. Beauties in Hoenn are particularly fond of POKENAME infused bath salts.

entry: POKENAME一边住在树上，一边清理枯枝与寄生真菌，因此深受树艺师喜爱。鲜红翼尖点缀其间，与树木绿色相衬。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular amongst arborists thanks to their habit of keeping trees clear of dead growth and parasitic fungi, whilst also roosting within them. The bright red tips of their wings add a nice accent to compliment the green of the tree.

entry: 它用头顶能抓握的叶片与长黏舌，荡过树梢。动作十分不优雅，却仍在空中起舞。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It swings through treetops with its prehensile leaf on its head and its long, sticky tongue. It will dance through the air while doing this very ungraceful movement.

entry: POKENAME通常守护丛林与雨林的废弃遗迹。先以毒牙麻痹受害者，再用头顶利叶将其击败。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME usually guards abandoned ruins in jungles and rainforests. It paralyzes its victims with its poisonous teeth and then finishes them off with the sharp leaf on top of its head.

entry: POKENAME用头顶又长又硬的卷状部分掘土，把圆尾放进洞里。尾巴产生的酶渗入土壤，能让附近植物得到更充足滋养。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the long solid curl on its head to help dig holes in soil to place its round tail into. The tail produces an enzyme that, when absorbed into soil, helps plant life in the vicinity to be more thoroughly nourished.

entry: POKENAME臂上的叶刃也能当挖掘工具，轻松切开岩石。吃到一餐植物根后，就回地下洞穴好好睡一觉。
author: quackquackattack
source: The leafy blades on POKENAME's arms double as digging tools, able to slice through rocks with ease. After securing a meal of plant roots, they return to their burrows for a nice nap underground.

entry: POKENAME身上装点的翅膀由叶片构成。它挂在枝上观察闯入者，再凶狠鸣叫，猛烈进攻，将其赶出森林。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: The wings that adorn POKENAME's body are made of leaves. It observes intruders from the branches they hang from. With a fierce cry, POKENAME attacks with ferocity to drive the intruders out of the forest.

entry: POKENAME头顶长叶一挥，力道足以裂开原木，但主要仍以臂上利叶作战。喜欢高居树顶，在树间穿行，胜过待在地面。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can swing the long leaf on its head with enough force to crack a log; despite this, it primarily uses the sharp leaves on its arms to fight. It prefers to stay high atop trees and move between them rather than be on the ground.

entry: POKENAME配色格外鲜艳，在同类间地位很高。有些爱慕虚荣，若被弄脏，就会十分不悦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's extra vibrant coloration gives it a high standing amongst its peers. It has a bit of a superficial ego, and does not respond well should anything cause it to become dirty.

entry: 对伐木工或草坪养护者而言，POKENAME是清木除草的可靠伙伴。用叶刃，便能轻松割清周围区域。
author: quackquackattack
source: For lumberjacks or anyone doing lawn care, POKENAME are a reliable partner for clearing wood and grass. With their leafy blades, they can cut down the area around them with ease.

entry: POKENAME深绿羽毛让它觅食时藏进丛林灌丛。遇上捕食者，能轻易跃进林冠逃走，也能射出火球反击。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's deep green feathers allow them to camouflage in jungle thickets while foraging. They can easily leap into tree canopies to escape predators or launch fireballs as a counterattack.

entry: POKENAME凭利爪轻松爬树。背上叶子用途多样，能让它贴住树枝，离地打个盹。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can easily scale trees thanks to its sharp claws. The leaves on its back are incredibly versatile, allowing it to stick to tree branches for a nap off the ground.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，有时会乱挥手脚。人们猜它正梦中训练或与敌交战。叶刃攻击强到能切开粗树干。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME sometimes thrash their arms and legs when sleeping. It's thought they may be training or fighting opponents in their dreams when this happens. Their Leaf Blade attacks are strong enough to cut through thick tree trunks.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，有时会乱挥手脚。人们猜它正梦中训练或与敌交战。叶刃攻击强到能切开粗树干。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME sometimes thrash their arms and legs when sleeping. It's thought they may be training or fighting opponents in their dreams when this happens. Their Leaf Blade attacks are strong enough to cut through thick tree trunks.

entry: POKENAME以泥土和种子为食，水中因此富含矿物与维生素。有些地区喜欢用它的水，泡制更健康的茶或其他饮料。
author: sk372
source: Due to a diet of soil and seeds, POKENAME's water is quite high in mineral content and vitamins. Some regions prefer POKENAME water to make healthier batches of tea and other beverages.

entry: POKENAME池塘周围的黏藤随心活动，缠住靠得太近的猎物，再由它用猛烈水流将其击败。
author: .izik
source: The sticky vines growing around POKENAME's pond animate at its will. They ensnare prey that draws too close before it finishes them with torrents of water.

entry: POKENAME臂上叶片散出香气，让附近生灵被强烈共情淹没。香一散，感觉立刻消失。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a scent from the leaves on its arms that overwhelms nearby creatures with empathy. The feeling vanishes the moment the scent dissipates.

entry: POKENAME将念力灌入头上叶片，能击中远超叶片实际长度的敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME channels telekinetic energy into the leaf on its head. This allows it to strike foes well beyond the leaf's physical reach.

entry: POKENAME通过马尾辫吸取附近植物的精神能量。在干旱地区，难以取得这份力量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME draws psychic energy through its ponytail, channeling power from nearby plants. In arid regions, it struggles to access this strength.

entry: POKENAME叶状裙装冬季会变厚。它以叶丛包住亲族，用精神能量安抚，抵御寒冷。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's leaflike dress thickens during winter months. It wraps this foliage around its kin, using psychic energy to soothe them against the cold.

entry: 它能改变叶色，融入周围，在树顶灵巧跳跃，捕食小型虫宝可梦。
author: mistymagius
source: It is able to change the color of its leaves to match its surroundings. It hunts for small bug Pokémon to eat by nimbly jumping through the treetops.

entry: POKENAME臂上叶子每周脱落一次，可泡成据说能增强肌力的饮料，味道却苦得惊人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sheds the leaves on its arms once per week. These leaves can be used to brew a beverage that is supposedly good for enhancing muscle strength, but the drink's flavor is incredibly bitter.

entry: POKENAME住在密林，富含叶绿素的外皮让它融入叶丛。领地意识强，会伏击靠太近的敌对宝可梦，试图以毒距刺击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in dense jungles, blending into foliage thanks to their chlorophyll-rich hide. They are territorial and will ambush rival Pokémon that get too close, trying to strike at them with toxic spurs.

entry: POKENAME以密林为家，连续数小时静止不动，用伪装巧妙的大嘴，咬住无意走近的猎物。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME makes its home inside dense jungles. It hunts by remaining motionless for hours, using its cleverly disguised maw to snap at prey that wander too close.

entry: 乍看像叶片与枝条，其实是一副巨颚，强到能把新鲜原木一口咬断。虽有这力量，却只想照料森林家园，大吃最爱的果实。
author: infinex21
source: What at first appears to be leaves and branches is actually a set of large jaws with enough power to bite fresh logs in two. Despite this power, they only seek to care for their forest homes and to gorge themselves on their favored fruits.

entry: 它是迅捷的丛林宝可梦，偶尔会砍树、偷别人的东西，缘由不明。头顶叶片锋利，一击就能切开木头。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is a swift jungle-dwelling Pokémon known to cut down trees and steal objects from others, but only on rare occasions. The explanation for these behaviors is not known. The leaf on its head is sharp enough to cut through wood in a single strike.

entry: POKENAME通常性情良善，却愿为达目标不惜一切，因此也会变得好斗固执。喜欢看日出，或许是为了取得能量。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although typically good-natured, POKENAME is willing to do whatever it takes to achieve its goals and, as a result, can become combative and stubborn. It likes to watch the sunrise, perhaps due to the energy it receives.

entry: POKENAME通常性情良善，却愿为达目标不惜一切，因此也会变得好斗固执。喜欢看日出，或许是为了取得能量。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although typically good-natured, POKENAME is willing to do whatever it takes to achieve its goals and, as a result, can become combative and stubborn. It likes to watch the sunrise, perhaps due to the energy it receives.

entry: POKENAME靠近喜欢的对象，头顶长叶便散出开心果与草莓香。若见讨厌的人，就像挥大锤般甩叶，将其打飞。
author: .izik
source: The long leaf growing from POKENAME's head smells of pistachios and strawberries when it is near those it is fond of. Should it spot someone it dislikes, it slams the leaf into them like a maul to send them flying.

entry: POKENAME壳上部分鲜红色，是给攻击者的警告。那些部位剧毒，直接接触会引起严重皮疹与肿胀。
author: sk372
source: The bright red coloration on parts of POKENAME's shell serves as a warning to attackers. Those parts of its body are highly poisonous, causing severe rashes and swelling if direct contact is made.

entry: POKENAME身旁飘着一块土，上面长着塔般高树。叶片随风如瘴气般翻动，主要因味甜而用于泡茶。
author: .izik
source: A tower-like tree grows from the patch of dirt floating near POKENAME's body. The leaves that wave in the wind like miasma are primarily used in tea for their sweet flavor.

entry: 捕猎时，它点燃腹内产生的气体，接连迅速弹射于树枝之间，却极小心，不让树着火。
author: catsquatch_geography
source: While hunting prey, it ignites gas produced in its belly to launch itself between branches in rapid succession, though it's very careful to not set any trees alight.

entry: POKENAME战斗开始落败时，头顶长叶便燃起。不知为何，能量储备和反应能力都会增强。
author: .izik
source: The long leaf on POKENAME's head bursts into flames when it begins losing a fight. This somehow increases its energy reserves and reaction times.

entry: POKENAME腿肌强健发达，矮壮身体却难以跳跃。它仍不肯放弃尝试，即使因此伤了自尊。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's leg muscles are strong and well-developed, but their stocky body makes leaping difficult. This does not stop them from trying, even if their pride suffers for it.

entry: POKENAME主动将一些叶子留在栖居的湖中，净化水质。无论水下，还是常游荡的森林里，身手都极其敏捷。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME voluntarily leaves some of its leaves in the lakes where it lives to purify the water. It is an extremely agile creature both underwater and in the forest it usually roams.

entry: POKENAME身上叶片边缘锋利如刀。它用叶刃状鳍肢劈开灌丛，穿行家园密林。
author: vic1312
source: The leaves that grow from POKENAME's body have a razor-sharp edge. POKENAME use their leaf-bladed flippers to chop their way through the undergrowth, allowing them to navigate the dense jungles they call home.

entry: POKENAME手持叶刃，以额外叶片伪装，借灌木掩护，凶狠地保护林中树木。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: With a leaf blade and additional leaves used for camouflage, POKENAME brutally protects the forest's trees with cover of the underbrush.

entry: POKENAME身上叶片帮助它在密林伪装。成群潜近大猎物后，就以毒爪扑上；只为一餐暂聚，随后便散开。
author: chibitales
source: The leaves growing out of POKENAME's body help them camouflage in dense forests. A pack will sneak up on large prey before pouncing with poisoned claws. They will only stick together for a meal before splitting off again.

entry: POKENAME以缎带般的长叶缠枝，迅速穿行栖居的丛林。看见宝可梦争斗，便释放安抚草药香。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its long ribbon-like leaves to cling to branches and move swiftly through the jungles it inhabits. If it sees Pokémon fighting, it releases a calming herbal scent.

entry: POKENAME喜欢湿润、阳光充足的环境。光合作用时，头上蘑菇与尾上叶片都会渐渐长得更大、更饱满。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME prefers damp environments with plenty of sunshine. As it photosynthesizes, the mushroom on its head and the leaves on its tail steadily grow larger and fuller.

entry: 它全身覆着能折射光的小毛，配合身上叶片伪装，几乎连敌友都看不见。
author: bottomusmaximus3
source: This Pokémon is covered in tiny hairs that can refract light. Combined with the leaves that grow from its body as camouflage, it becomes virtually invisible to both enemies and allies alike.

entry: 它凭强肌以惊人速度攀爬、荡过丛林。精力太旺、太好动，做不来潜行，便改为迅速轻松地采集最美味的果实。
author: bobosmith01
source: It can scale up and swing through the jungle with incredible speed thanks to its powerful muscles. It is too spirited and hyperactive to be stealthy, so it quickly and effortlessly gathers the most delicious fruit instead.

entry: 身上叶片能在丛林伪装，可POKENAME根本无法静止，宁可追赶猎物，也不伏着等待。
author: .jerden
source: The leaves on its body provide camouflage in the jungle. However, POKENAME is incapable of remaining still, and chases after prey rather than waiting in ambush.

entry: POKENAME跟着船，想与船上人玩耍。常用头顶长叶，朝他们泼水。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME follows boats to play with those on board. It regularly splashes them with water using the long leaf on its head.

entry: POKENAME身上的叶片硬如小刀，也同样锋利。变钝凋萎后才脱落；落叶仍富营养，因此通常会被它自己吃掉。
author: infinex21
source: The leaves that grow out of a POKENAME's body are as hard and sharp as small blades. Their leaves get dull and wilt before being shed; POKENAME typically eat their own shed leaves, as they are still rich with nutrients.

entry: POKENAME在齿轮上旋转，越转越快，最后松开，借力飞过大片树木。可这样远行数英里，不过做太多也会累。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME spins on its gear, turning faster and faster until it finally lets go, propelling it over swaths of trees. POKENAME can travel miles this way, though doing it too much can be tiring.

entry: POKENAME穿行丛林时，用最大的叶子抽打树木。留下淡淡绿球果香，向同类表明领地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME whips its largest leaf against trees as it travels through the jungle. This leaves behind a subtle Green Apricorn aroma that communicates its territory to others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME见于酷热、多日照地区，以突然爆发的惊人速度捕猎。猎物藏进泥沙也没用，因为它挖得极快。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are found in areas with sweltering heat and lots of sun. It uses sudden and incredible bursts of speed to capture prey. Hiding in dirt or sand is pointless: it can dig extremely quickly.

entry: POKENAME在雨量不多不少的热带森林最繁盛。可能突然从树顶落下，伏击猎物。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are most populous in tropical forests where there is not too much nor too little rain. They may suddenly drop down from the tops of trees to ambush prey.

entry: POKENAME一生大多在树枝间跳来跳去，几乎从不触地。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME live most of their lives hopping from tree branch to tree branch. They rarely ever touch the ground.

entry: POKENAME的叫声，如同吹响草叶的哨音，让父母知道该带着食物回巢了。虽然许多会与亲族共同生活，长大后离巢而去，也并不罕见。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a chirp that sounds like a whistling blade of grass, allowing their parents to know when to come back to the nest with food. While many coexist with their kin, it is not unheard of for POKENAME to abandon a nest once they get big.

entry: POKENAME住在植物茂盛的洞穴，完美融入周围。藏着身形沿墙爬行，寻找嵌在洞壁的晶体。
author: periperi_chicken
