source: Small and inexperienced, POKENAME stay as far from combat as possible. If they feel threatened, POKENAME will shiver and shake, causing poisonous powder to sprinkle from their feathers. When attacked, POKENAME will spit fire at the foe and flee.

entry: POKENAME生气时，臂上羽状翎毛会变得极热，同时散出宜人的营火气味。
author: .izik
source: The feather-like plumes growing from POKENAME's arms become intensely hot when it is angry. During this period they give off a delightful campfire scent.

entry: POKENAME多待在洞穴家门口，沐浴朝阳夕照。喜欢附近树上的果实，先用火软化树果外皮再吃。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME tends to stay near the entrance of its cave home and basks in the rising and setting sun. This Pokémon enjoys fruit from nearby trees and uses its fire to soften the skins of the berries.

entry: POKENAME体内种子极易燃烧，受力重击就会瞬间着火。为补充种子，它烧掉小植物，收集留下的种子。
author: mistymagius
source: The seeds stored within POKENAME's body are highly flammable, causing them to instantly combust when struck with enough force. To gather more seeds, POKENAME burns small plants to collect the leftover seeds.

entry: POKENAME很挑食，吃树果前，会用长牙碾碎，或先用火加热。厨师也借这些方法，料理同样的树果。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME have been observed to be very picky eaters. This Pokémon will crush the berries with its tusks or heat the berries with its fire before consuming them. Chefs use these techniques to prepare dishes involving these same berries.

entry: POKENAME常见于农场牧场，破晓便鸣叫，告诉大家新的一天来了。自身或附近一有攻击，就慌忙扇翼，朝四周胡乱吐小火球。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are common sights near farms and ranches, chirping at the crack of dawn to signal a new day to all. If an attack is ever made upon them or near them, they frantically flap their wings and aimlessly spit small fireballs around them.

entry: 翅膀发育时，POKENAME在父母看顾下，蹦跳探索地面巢穴周围。若离巢太远，就会鸣叫，向父母求助。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Under the watchful eyes of their parents, POKENAME hop around and explore the areas surrounding its ground nest while their wings develop. When POKENAME stray too far from the nest, they will cheep out calls to their parents for help.

entry: POKENAME以火球迎敌，却因准头太差，很快烦躁。最恼怒时，就浑身裹火，鲁莽扑向敌人或猎物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME fight by spitting balls of fire at their foes, though their inept aim quickly leads to them becoming agitated. When most agitated, they will dive recklessly toward their foe or their prey while wreathed in flames.

entry: POKENAME吸入空气，用体内火焰加热，使身体鼓胀飞起。想落下时，它便吐出火焰，降下来。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: In order to achieve flight, POKENAME expands its body by intaking air and heating it with its internal fire. When this Pokémon wants to come down from the air, it releases a fiery breath and descends.

entry: POKENAME挑食，只靠黄水晶维生。幸好找到裂开的晶洞，用火息加热，就能自行制作。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME are picky eaters, surviving entirely on citrine. Fortunately, they can make their own by finding cracked geodes and heating them with their fiery breath.

entry: POKENAME喷出的沸热黏液，会引起高烧。冷却后便不再危险。
author: .izik
source: The boiling mucus POKENAME spits can cause intense fevers. Once the mucus cools, it is no longer dangerous.

entry: POKENAME边跑边加速，在身周形成火轮。最终连自己也能停止跑动，借火焰冲力滑行，只是不太好停下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME creates a wheel of fire around itself as it runs and gathers up speed. Eventually POKENAME itself can stop running and coast on the momentum of the fire, though it has some difficulty stopping this way.

entry: POKENAME身上孔洞长出的羽毛，不断在炉火般热与冰冷之间变化。脱落几分钟内便化灰，因此用途很少。
author: .izik
source: The feathers growing from the holes on POKENAME's body constantly oscillate between oven-hot and ice-cold. They degrade to ash within minutes of falling from the body, leaving their uses minimal.

entry: POKENAME出现在寒冷迷路的旅人面前，许诺温暖与庇护。其实全是骗局，想引到孤立之处冻住，添进受害者收藏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears before cold and lost travelers, offering the prospect of warmth and asylum. It is all a ruse, however, as POKENAME seeks to isolate and freeze them to add to its collection of victims.

entry: POKENAME根状身体散出柔暖，深受园丁喜爱。冬季钻进温室土壤，帮助植物整季健康、持续开花。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are beloved by gardeners for the gentle warmth radiating from their root-like bodies. During winter, they burrow into greenhouse soil, helping plants remain healthy and in bloom throughout the cold season.

entry: POKENAME急着让别人刮目相看，舞蹈动作大开大合，暖热周围。热情有时过了头，火焰远比预期多。
author: sk372
source: Eager to impress others, POKENAME's dances consist of grand sweeping movements that heat up the area. Its enthusiasm sometimes causes it to go overboard and produce far more flames than it intends to.

entry: POKENAME以流畅舞蹈练习武艺，把华丽旋转与火踢交织。可动作不协调，常把自己绊倒。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME uses its fluid dancing to practice martial arts skills, weaving together spinning flourishes and flaming kicks. These moves are uncoordinated, however, often resulting in it tripping over itself.

entry: POKENAME先烧垃圾，再吃灰。秋季最饿，一天最多吃下10磅灰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME incinerates trash before consuming the ashes. It is most hungry during autumn, consuming up to 10 pounds of ash in a single day.

entry: POKENAME既有鳍又有腿，能够在水里和陆地生活。不过，它跑起步来很吃力，总被自己的脚绊倒，向前滚去；小小的鳍，也让它在水中行动不便。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME can live on land or in the water due to its fins and legs. However, this Pokémon struggles to run, constantly tripping over its own feet and rolling forwards. It also has problems navigating in the water because of its small fins.

entry: POKENAME的鳍本已极热，一见猎物更烫。周围水一碰就变蒸汽。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's incredibly hot fin grows even hotter when it spots prey. Water around it turns to steam on contact.

entry: POKENAME的木质身体足够坚韧，能耐高温。幼年个体会互喷火球，把木头烧焦，显得更成熟强悍。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME's wood is strong enough to withstand high temperatures. Young POKENAME will breathe fireballs at each other, charring the wood to appear more mature and tough.

entry: POKENAME花粉有燃烧性，极易着火。建议花粉症患者与它保持距离。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME pollen has incendiary properties, catching fire very easily. Those suffering from hayfever are advised to keep their distance from POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME兴奋时开心蹦跳鸣叫，同时往空气洒花粉。若害怕，头顶花苞中心就会喷出火柱。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: When POKENAME get excited, they hop around with joyous chirping, releasing pollen into the air while doing so. If POKENAME become scared, a plume of fire will erupt from the center of the bud on their heads.

entry: POKENAME老被自己的叫声吓到。耳朵太敏感，让它不断紧张，羽毛蓬起，很适合陪伴内向的人。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME constantly scares itself with the sounds of its own cries. With its ears being so sensitive, POKENAME is constantly on edge, causing its feathers to fluff up. This Pokémon makes a good companion for an introvert.

entry: POKENAME羽毛极软，保温极好。体内有火囊，寒天也暖。有些训练家就因这份暖意，让它趴在自己头上休息。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have incredibly soft feathers that retain their heat quite well. Due to their internal flame sacs, these Pokémon are warm even in cold weather. Some Trainers let their POKENAME rest on their heads due to their warmth.

entry: POKENAME既讨厌冷，也不喜欢日光直射，因此住在温泉附近洞穴，靠蒸汽防止身体干燥。身上羽毛由黏膜保护。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME dislikes the cold, as well as direct sunlight, so it can be found in caves near hot springs where the steamy air helps prevent its body from drying out. The feathers on POKENAME's body are protected by a slimy membrane.

entry: POKENAME是尽责的父母，将蛋安置在头顶花瓣里，双方轮流照顾。孵化后仍背着幼崽，直到羽毛足够强韧，能支撑身体。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are devoted parents. Their eggs are kept snug within the petals atop their heads, and both partners take turns caring for them. After hatching, the young are carried by their parents until their feathers are strong enough to support them.

entry: POKENAME给幼童暖暖的拥抱，十分受欢迎。通常无害，可喙上的古怪花纹，让许多人心里发毛。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is quite popular amongst young children, giving them nice warm hugs. While generally harmless, the strange markings on its beak tend to unnerve many people.

entry: POKENAME静卧海底，周围水便开始沸腾。沸腾持续太久，它就会迅速蜕羽。
author: .izik
source: While POKENAME lies still on the ocean floor, the water around it begins to boil. When it has boiled for too long, it rapidly sheds feathers.

entry: POKENAME头上花瓣沉重，动久了便累，因此常整天晒太阳。身周一团加热的毒花粉，让多数宝可梦不愿靠近。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: The heavy petals growing from POKENAME's head make prolonged movement tiring, so it often spends its days basking in sunlight. A cloud of heated toxic pollen surrounds it, discouraging most Pokémon from coming near.

entry: POKENAME背上蘑菇温暖，对人无害，采下也不伤宿主。常用于意面与比萨，添上温和辣味。
author: sk372
source: The mushrooms on POKENAME's back are warm, harmless to humans, and can be plucked with no damage to the host. They are often used as a mildly spicy ingredient in pastas and pizzas.

entry: 日出时，可见成群POKENAME聚在开阔空地晒太阳。受威胁就喷出强劲火星。
author: mepp.
source: At sunrise, groups of POKENAME can be seen gathering in open clearings to bask in the sun. When threatened, they spit powerful embers.

entry: POKENAME活泼易兴奋，喜欢陪训练家散步。要靠运动维持健康体重，因此饲养需要投入许多心力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is energetic and excitable, enjoying walks alongside its Trainer. Raising a POKENAME requires a lot of commitment due to its need for exercise to remain at a healthy weight.

entry: POKENAME身体周围有蛋壳般的甲壳，保护免受伤害。两根巨刺能喷出小火流，帮助自卫。
author: sk372
source: An eggshell-like carapace rests around POKENAME's body, safeguarding it from harm. The two large quills can shoot out small streams of fire to aid in self-defense.

entry: POKENAME漫游原野，为小型飞行属性宝可梦提供舒适歇脚处。温暖封闭的空间让许多宝可梦安心在内筑巢产蛋，相信它会保护大家。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME wander through fields to act as a welcoming resting space for smaller Flying-Type Pokémon. The warm enclosed space lead many Pokémon to feel safe enough to make nests and lay eggs inside, trusting POKENAME to protect them from harm.

entry: POKENAME长腿让它能在草原家园留意危险。一见威胁，就以棍敲地，发出大响，提醒群体。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's long legs allow it to keep an eye out for danger in its grassland habitat. When POKENAME sees a threat, it alerts the flock by noisily banging its stick on the ground.

entry: POKENAME挥使的巨爪能从空气夺热，聚成火焰。空气热量不够，就无法生火。
author: .realthree
source: The oversized talon that POKENAME wields snatches heat out of the air and gathers it into a flame. If there's not enough heat in the air, it can't produce a fire.

entry: POKENAME在池塘附近筑巢，与周围水宝可梦交好。压力大时会大发脾气，从喙喷出沸水。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME lives in nests near ponds, making good friends with the other Water Pokémon nearby. When stressed, POKENAME shoots boiling water from its beak in a tantrum.

entry: POKENAME头顶的叶子看似植物，其实由绒羽构成。伪装让它藏在家园池塘附近的干草里，躲开捕食者。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Though it looks like a plant, the leaf on the top of POKENAME's head is made up of its downy feathers. This camouflage helps POKENAME hide in dry grass near its home pond, away from predators.

entry: POKENAME常跌倒躺在地上，盼着受到关注。它会一躺数小时，等人帮忙扶起。找到想认作训练家的人，尾尖就会燃起火焰。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are prone to falling over and lying on the ground, wanting someone's attention. It will lie on the ground for hours, waiting for a person to help pick it up. Once it finds the person it wants for a Trainer, the tip of its tail will ignite.

entry: POKENAME十分黏训练家，会抓紧腿边的衣料。太久看不见训练家，它就大声叫喊，坐下等对方回来，抱起自己。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME is very clingy towards its Trainer, holding onto the fabric of its person's legs. If POKENAME loses sight of its Trainer for too long, it will let out loud cries and sit, waiting for them to return and pick it up.

entry: POKENAME脚步快，喜欢阳光。吃过便精力充沛，四处撒欢。一起玩时，会互相发射火球，玩追逐游戏。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are fast on their feet and enjoy the sunlight. They tend to get the zoomies after eating and become full of energy. When these Pokémon play together, they will play tag by launching fireballs at one another.

entry: POKENAME不断攻击靠近农院的捕食者，因此常被饲养。可好斗性情也常给农夫添麻烦。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME is commonly kept on farms because it persistently attacks predators that approach the barnyard. However, its aggressive demeanor often leads it to be a nuisance to the farmers.

entry: POKENAME易受惊，会从嘴里喷出滚烫水，分散捕食者注意，再游走。终生配对，因此常见成双出现。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Easily frightened, POKENAME will shoot scalding water from its mouth as a way of distracting potential predators and then swim away. These Pokémon mate for life, so it is common to see them in pairs.

entry: POKENAME住在温暖海洋的珊瑚礁，受父母保护。这些小鱼在巢边来回游，一见更大宝可梦就钻进珊瑚。父母会保护它们，直到进化。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME live in warm ocean coral reefs, protected by their parents. These small fish will swim in and around their nests, darting into the coral to hide from any Pokémon larger than themselves. Their parents will protect them until they evolve.

entry: 比起长大的崎岖山地，POKENAME更喜欢与人作伴，会飞去寻找训练家。羁绊深厚后，这些凶猛斗士便为训练家喷出灼热火球奋战。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME prefers the company of people over the rugged terrain of the mountains where it was raised and will fly to seek out a Trainer to accompany. Forming strong bonds, these fierce fighters will fight with scorching fireballs for their Trainer.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，体温升到两百度以上，引起小草火。自己却在热中十分舒适，用念力在火里烤树果。
author: ghostslythe
source: While it sleeps, POKENAME's body heats to over two hundred degrees, causing small grass fires. Despite this, it stays comfortable in the heat, using telekinesis to cook berries in the flames.

entry: POKENAME肌肉使得越用力，身体便越暖。激烈锻炼时，周围空气热得像海市蜃楼般闪动扭曲。
author: bobosmith01
source: The harder POKENAME is using its muscles, the warmer its body becomes. During an intense workout, the air around it becomes so hot that it shimmers and distorts like a mirage.

entry: POKENAME卷起尾巴，向敌人吐出热水球。也能在喉内混合火与水，轰出压缩蒸汽，不过更费体力。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME coil their tails to spit out balls of hot water at foes. They can mix fire and water within their throats to loose blasts of compressed steam, though this tires them out more.

entry: POKENAME脚笨，比起陆地更爱待在水里。头尾羽状鳍帮助它穿过强流。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME prefer hanging out in the water rather than on land because of their clumsy feet. The feathery fins on its head and tail help propel it through strong currents.

entry: POKENAME肉质鲜嫩，很适合炖锅料理，与韭葱清甜相衬。一口多汁鲜美的肉，启发过许多年轻厨师。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is popular in a pot roast dish because of its tender meat, which pairs well with the delicate sweetness of leeks. A bite of juicy, savory POKENAME inspires many young chefs.

entry: POKENAME急着令人刮目相看，常表演吐火球，炫耀烟火本领。可双头容易争强好胜，演到一半就打起来。
author: sk372
source: Eager to impress others, POKENAME often tries to show off its pyrotechnic prowess with shows of spitting fireballs. The two heads often get overly competitive and fight with each other mid-performance.

entry: POKENAME几乎总在跑动，留下不少温暖鲜艳的羽毛。两颗头睡时，另一颗醒着，留意威胁。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are almost always running around, leaving behind quite a few of their warm and vibrant feathers. Two of their heads sleep while one of their heads remains awake to watch for any threats.

entry: POKENAME始终温暖，触碰却剧毒。消化有个怪癖：吃完会咳出火球，排走体内多余物质。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is perpetually warm, though highly toxic to the touch. It has a peculiar quirk in its digestive process: after consuming food, it hacks up fireballs to rid its body of excess mass.

entry: POKENAME的外壳笨重，走起路来经常绊倒。它还在学习控制背上的泵，所以喷出火或水的机会各占一半；极少数时候，两者会一起喷出。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME often stumbles when walking due to the weight of its bulky shell. This Pokémon is still learning how to manipulate the pumps on its back, so there is a 50-50 chance it will eject fire or water. On rare occasions, they will eject both.

entry: POKENAME岩石身体的每一节，摸起来都暖。研究者猜测，各节都有独立热核，供它掘地时保暖。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Each segment of POKENAME's rock body is warm to the touch. Researchers suspect that each segment has its own heated core to keep POKENAME warm while tunneling through the ground.

entry: POKENAME背上的硬刺带有微毒。察觉危险时，就会蜷成一团，滚下沙丘。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME protects its back with hard spines that have a weak poison. If it senses danger, it curls up and rolls down the dunes.

entry: POKENAME爱吃各类作物的根，让农夫头痛。大雨后会离开地道，找干燥之处，避免沾水。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are a nuisance to farmers, as they enjoy eating the roots of various crops. After heavy rainfall, POKENAME emerge from their tunnels and search for a dry place to avoid getting wet.

entry: POKENAME常成群住在山道附近。谁靠领地太近，就从山坡滚下，袭击徒步者，时速曾见高达100英里。
author: seanothan_23
source: POKENAME often live in packs and reside near mountain trails. They like to attack hikers who get too close to their territory by rolling down the mountain face and have been seen to reach speeds up to 100 mph.

entry: POKENAME满身尖刺、防御极强，宛如几乎攻不破的堡垒。蜷成球，以快得看不清的速度滚向目标，撞中后平静轻声叫一声：“好。”
author: ambrosia04
source: With its highly defensive and spiky body, POKENAME is a near-impenetrable fortress. It curls into a ball and rolls at blinding speeds toward its targets, letting out a calm, quiet cry that sounds exactly like 'OK' after making contact.

entry: POKENAME用骨棒铲土掘行。背上尖刺会扎到靠太近的东西，因此很难跟进它的地道。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME burrow through the ground by shoveling dirt with their bone club. It is difficult to follow them into their tunnels because of the quills across their back that poke anything that comes too close.

entry: 它战斗时把骨头当钝器挥舞。应付不来，就用坚硬刺背护住自己。
author: .izik
source: It swings its bone in combat like a blunt weapon. When overwhelmed, it shields itself with its tough, spiked back.

entry: POKENAME以强踢出击时，脚边会围满剃刀般的利刺，伤害、削弱敌人。严酷沙漠生活使它成为无情而狡猾的斗士。
author: fiordaliso
source: When striking with powerful kicks, POKENAME surrounds its feet with razor-sharp spines to wound and weaken its foes. Life in the harsh desert has made it a ruthless and cunning fighter.

entry: POKENAME满身尖刺，让想轻松吃点心的捕食者不愿下口。大雨时若掉到地上，就摇摇晃晃地找干处。
author: quackquackattack
source: The spikes on POKENAME's body make them unappealing to predators who want an easy snack. If they fall to the ground during heavy rainfall, they wobble around until they find a dry spot.

entry: POKENAME冲过山间时，背上利鳞张开，吸收阳光。无聊时会撞树，测试力量。
author: .izik
source: The sharp scales on POKENAME's back flare open to absorb sunlight as it charges through mountains. When bored, it slams into trees to test its power.

entry: POKENAME将幼崽放在育儿袋，保护免遭沙漠烈日。只有尖刺完全长好，才准离袋。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME keeps its young in its pouch to protect it from the harsh desert sun. It will only let them leave the pouch once their spines have fully grown.

entry: POKENAME见于沙暴风眼，在空中盘旋，搜寻大颚蚁。一找到就俯冲穿过刺痛的尘沙，把猎物翻过来，攻击柔软腹面。
author: ghostslythe
source: Found in the eyes of sandstorms, POKENAME circles in the air watching for Trapinch. When one is found, it dives through the stinging dust, flipping its prey over to get at their soft underbelly.

entry: 捕食者靠近时，它们便聚在一起，翅膀互相扣住成盾，乍看像个蜂巢。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: When a predator approaches, these Pokémon group together, interlocking their wings into a shield that superficially resembles a hive.

entry: 它个头虽小，对认定的威胁却毫不犹豫地迎头撞去。喜欢阴暗处。
author: bobosmith01
source: Despite its small size, it has no qualms about headbutting anyone it feels threatened by. It prefers dark areas.

entry: POKENAME变形本领出众，但换了模样，仍保留刃爪与护甲。想挖洞入室的歹徒很喜欢它，甚至会让它先挤进去，再向外挖。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME possesses impressive transformative abilities but retains its bladed claws and armor in its new form. It is a popular Pokémon with crooks looking to dig into a location, and they may even have it squeeze into the location and dig out.

entry: POKENAME钻到房屋下，连接传输数据的光纤。它一啃线，玩游戏的人往往就发现网络连接变差。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME dig below houses to connect to fiber optic cables that transmit data. People who play games often notice a drop in internet connectivity once POKENAME chew on the wires.

entry: POKENAME壳上满是利刺，用来驱赶捕食者。多藏在暖沙里，等待进化时刻。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's shell is covered with razor-sharp spikes that it uses to ward off predators. It tends to remain hidden in the warm sand, waiting for the moment of its evolution.

entry: POKENAME背刺覆着小针，能卡进皮毛与衣物。背刺和爪由相同材料构成，它也靠爪钻入地下。
author: quackquackattack
source: The spines on a POKENAME's back are covered in tiny needles that lodge into fur or clothing. The spines are made of the same material as their claws, which they rely on to burrow underground.

entry: POKENAME快速连扇翅膀，扬起沙暴。猎物被沙包围后，便扑上，用爪刺入下一餐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME kicks up sandstorms by flapping its wings in rapid succession. Once prey are enveloped by the sand, it pounces and sinks its claws into its next meal.

entry: POKENAME从空中发现猎物，就挥着剃刀般的利爪，凶猛俯冲。它独居、领地意识强，为找食物无休止地漫游沙漠。
author: fiordaliso
source: Once it spots its prey from the sky, POKENAME dives with full ferocity, wielding talons as sharp as razors. It is a solitary, territorial predator that roams the desert endlessly in search of food.

entry: POKENAME用强翼卷起猛烈沙暴，掩护行动。背上利刺能脱下掷敌，很快又会长回。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their strong wings to whip up fierce sandstorms to conceal their movements. The sharp quills on their backs can be shed and flung at foes, and regrow quickly.

entry: POKENAME吃下大量沙，谁敢打扰睡觉，就朝谁吹去。走累了，就把巨身滚下沙丘，尖刺留下沟痕，显出经过的路径。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME ingests large quantities of sand, which it then blows at anyone who dares to disturb its naps. When it gets tired of walking, it rolls its enormous body down the sand dunes, leaving furrows of its quills as a sign of its passage.

entry: POKENAME吃下大量沙，谁敢打扰睡觉，就朝谁吹去。走累了，就把巨身滚下沙丘，尖刺留下沟痕，显出经过的路径。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME ingests large quantities of sand, which it then blows at anyone who dares to disturb its naps. When it gets tired of walking, it rolls its enormous body down the sand dunes, leaving furrows of its quills as a sign of its passage.

entry: POKENAME用大爪铲土造穴，以毒刺赶走其他宝可梦，确保幼崽有安全的家。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME creates its burrows by shoveling dirt with its large claws. It chases away other Pokémon with its stinger, ensuring it has a safe home for its offspring.

entry: POKENAME尾端有锋利钩爪，能帮助高速滚动后刹住。它常这样滚着玩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a sharp, hook-like claw at the end of its tail. This hook is used to help it stop after it rolls around at high speeds, something it does often for fun.

entry: 它猛烈扇动羽翼，以强风与沙打击敌人。POKENAME极忠诚，总会帮助有难的伙伴。
author: fiordaliso
source: It frantically flaps its feathered wings to lash out at enemies with powerful gusts of wind and sand. POKENAME is an extremely loyal Pokémon that always helps its companions in trouble.

entry: POKENAME常守在沙漠深处的神庙与遗迹。双颚满是尖牙，能咬出致命一击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME often stands guard over temples and ruins hidden deep within the desert. Its jaws, lined with sharp teeth, are capable of delivering lethal bites.

entry: POKENAME一生大多待在地面，只有逃避捕食者或前往高处才短暂飞起。平时多蜷成球滚动。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME spend most of their lives on the ground. They only fly in order to flee predators or reach higher locations, becoming airborne in short bursts. POKENAME curl into balls and roll most of the time.

entry: POKENAME夜里在沙漠天空画出混乱弧线。若发现大颚蚁等猎物，就钻进沙里，以吸血出击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies in chaotic arcs over desert skies at night. If it spots prey like Trapinch, it dives into the sand and strikes with Leech Life.

entry: POKENAME从高处射出锋羽，迅速精准地击倒猎物。攻势结束便藏进沙下，完美融入周围。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME launches its sharp feathers from above to strike down prey with precision and speed. Once its assault is over, it hides beneath the sand, where it can blend in perfectly with its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME的预知未来十分精准，却很少恶意使用，野外也少用。它耐心、愿合作，可惹怒它的人，不久便会遭到锋利棕刺攻击。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME's Future Sight is precise, though seldom used maliciously or in the wild. While patient and cooperative, those who earn POKENAME's ire will be assaulted by sharp brown spines in the near future.

entry: POKENAME是沙丘间的强大捕食者，与同群繁盛生活。张翼时从高处掷下利刺，击败所有对手。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a formidable predator that can be found in the dunes of deserts, where it thrives with its pack. When it spreads its wings, it hurls razor-sharp spikes from above to defeat all its opponents.

entry: POKENAME掘过地形时，会在红球里积电。长爪比硬岩还坚固，导电性更胜某些金属。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME build up electricity within their red orbs as they dig through terrain. Their long claws are harder than solid rock and conduct electricity better than some metals.

entry: 羽毛完美适应沙漠高热，烈日下也能飞，不怕烧伤。POKENAME用强爪战斗、捕猎。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its plumage has adapted perfectly to the desert heat, enabling it to fly even under the scorching sun without the risk of getting burned. POKENAME uses its powerful claws to fight and hunt its prey.

entry: POKENAME用爪翻垃圾，轻松撕开丢弃的罐头。爪子不停生长，因此不断劈刮混凝土，将其磨短。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's claws help them dig through trash, easily tearing open discarded cans of food. These claws never stop growing, leading POKENAME to grind them down by constantly slashing at concrete.

entry: POKENAME用沾泥的锯齿爪掘过湿土，地道帮助灌溉附近土地，深受农夫欢迎。受威胁便蜷成球，光滑毒皮能吓退捕食者。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME burrows through wet soil using its jagged, mud-coated claws. Its tunnels help irrigate nearby land, making it a welcome sight to farmers. When threatened, it rolls into a ball, its slick, poisonous skin deterring predators.

entry: POKENAME用爪改道溪流，造出沼泽。睡觉脸埋在水里，鳞片张开自卫。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its claws to reroute streams and create marshes. It sleeps face-first in water with its scales flared for protection.

entry: 背上的花与叶坚硬，能保护POKENAME，还能分泌使人虚弱的毒素，用来毒倒来袭者。
author: chorb33
source: The flower and its leaves on its back are hard and protect POKENAME. They allow it to secrete debilitating toxins, which it uses to poison attackers.

entry: POKENAME啃地下埋石，磨利尖牙。一找到更硬的，就立刻丢掉软石。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gnaws on buried stones to sharpen its fangs. It discards softer rocks instantly if a harder one is found.

entry: 掘过山体时，爪子顺时针旋转。POKENAME留下的长道，成为小宝可梦的家。
author: .izik
source: Its claws rotate clockwise while tunneling through mountains. The long paths left behind by POKENAME are used as homes by smaller Pokémon.

entry: 它住在遍布岩石的荒地，靠速度与利爪驱走威胁。即使野生的怪颚龙，也会绕开POKENAME的领地。
author: staghorn
source: It lives in rocky badlands, using its speed and claws to drive away potential threats. Even a wild Tyrantrum will avoid a POKENAME's territory.

entry: POKENAME在柿仔果树下掘道，钻出收集落果。存进壳里，留待以后吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs tunnels under Persim Berry trees, surfacing to collect fallen fruit. It stores the berries in its shell for later meals.

entry: POKENAME搬起超过体重五倍的巨石，炫耀力气。重拳的威力，更足以夷平摩天大楼。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME show off their immense strength by carrying boulders over five times its weight. Their punches have enough force to level a skyscraper.

entry: POKENAME爪子适合挖沙，帮助造出地下洞穴。也能切开仙人掌，喝内部的水。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's claws are well suited for digging through sand, helping them create burrows underground. Additionally, these Pokémon use their claws to slice through cacti, drinking the water inside.

entry: 狃拉的冰属性加入，让这种POKENAME具备了阿罗拉穿山王的特征。在雪中，比任一组成物种都更敏捷。
author: hophoppip
source: This form of POKENAME has developed traits from Sandslash's Alolan Form due to the introduction of Sneasel's Ice type. It moves even more swiftly through the snow than either of its components.

entry: POKENAME是圈圈熊类中少数不冬眠的宝可梦。虽然奇特，却也更容易遭到毛皮猎人的捕杀。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME is one of very few Ursaring species to not hibernate. While interesting, this unfortunately makes it vulnerable to fur hunters.

entry: 身体由沙构成。吃下石头后，在岩壳里磨碎，再以更多沙流出。
author: hophoppip
source: Its body is made of sand. It feeds on stones, which are ground up inside its rocky shell until they pour out as more sand.

entry: POKENAME裙装看似柔软诱人，却不宜触碰。不但由粗毛构成，也沾满穿过沙暴时收集的沙。
author: hiimhdere
source: While the dress of POKENAME may look soft and appealing, touching it is ill-advised. Not only is it made of coarse hairs, but it also collects sand from the sandstorms it travels through.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉灵敏，能找食物，是沙漠旅人的忠诚伙伴。面对危险得不能用爪近战的敌人，就发射骨刺与火球。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is a loyal companion for desert travelers since its keen sense of smell helps it find sustenance. It launches its bone spikes and fireballs at opponents too dangerous to fight with its claws.

entry: POKENAME为避开沙漠家园的炽热，钻入地下降温。受大宝可梦威胁时，防御性地盘起身体，抖响头刺，警告敌人远离。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME burrows underground to keep itself cool in the blazing heat of its desert home. When threatened by larger Pokémon, it coils defensively and rattles the spines on its head, warning foes to stay away.

entry: POKENAME滚动时伸展带刺鳞片，犁过障碍。冲下坡时，时速可达60英里。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME extends its spiked scales while rolling to plow through obstacles. It can reach 60 mph when barreling downhill.

entry: POKENAME蜷成球，刺朝外自保。原地转得够久，就能蓄能，以惊人的爆发速度向前滚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME curls into a ball with its spines pointing outward to protect itself. If it spins in place long enough, it can build up energy and roll forward with an incredible burst of speed.

entry: 它醒着时几乎都在晒太阳，为捕猎节省精力。出击时飞快掠过猎物身边，以背刺将其划伤。
author: pokepower
source: It spends nearly every waking hour sunbathing. It conserves its energy for taking down prey, which it slashes with its spines as it rushes past.

entry: POKENAME圆大身体能猛烈撞砸，爪能劈开树干。背上厚刺密布，腹面则覆着皮革般的毛。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME has a big, round body to deliver powerful slams and claws that can slash through tree trunks. Its back is covered with thick spines and its underside is covered in leathery fur.

entry: POKENAME跑得又快又猛，有时连刺都飞出，击中附近东西或旁人。很久以前，人们相信它的吼声预告漫长旱季来临。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can run around so quickly and powerfully that sometimes its spines fly out and hit something or someone nearby. Long ago, people believed its roars marked the beginning of a long dry season ahead.

entry: POKENAME守护偏远沙漠绿洲，挡住想前来的游客与探险者。若突然起猛烈沙暴，多半是某个倒霉旅人误入领地。
author: agentyoshi
source: POKENAME guards isolated desert oases from would-be tourists and explorers. If a harsh sandstorm suddenly appears, odds are an unfortunate traveler has stumbled into its domain.

entry: POKENAME扇动古怪翅膀，就扬起沙暴与尘旋风。不过似乎并非有意。
author: bee4082
source: When POKENAME flaps its strange wings, it stirs up sandstorms and dust devils. It doesn't seem to be doing this on purpose, though.

entry: POKENAME能将强电流导向背刺。谁靠得太近，它便转身背对，射出尖刺。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can channel a strong electrical current through the spikes on its back. If someone gets too close, it turns its back on them and shoots its spikes.

entry: POKENAME捏出含水量高的泥球，先充入电流，再把尾巴当球棒，将它们击向对手。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME forms clay balls with a high water-content so it can electrify, then propel them at opponents using its tail as a makeshift bat.

entry: POKENAME身上伸出大刺，让它在高草疾行时免遭捕食。杂食且胃口大，找到什么就吃什么。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has large spines that jut out from its body, which protect it from predators while it scampers in tall grass. It is an omnivore and has a voracious appetite, so it eats anything it can find.

entry: POKENAME以世界各处的山巅为家，在峰顶凿出巨大地道，容纳群体。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME make their home at the zenith of mountains throughout the world. They carve massive tunnels into mountain summits to accommodate their herd.

entry: POKENAME分离的双爪极其锋利。战斗时挥击虽混乱，锋刃却足以把拖拉机劈成两半。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's disembodied claws are incredibly sharp. While its swiping attacks are erratic in battle, they are sharp enough to cleave a tractor in two.

entry: POKENAME藏在干灌木里躲捕食者。受袭就蜷起，露出颈边利刺保护自己。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME hides out in dried shrubs to avoid predators. If POKENAME is attacked, it will curl up and expose the sharp spines around its neck to protect itself.

entry: 尖刺锋利得能穿透坚实混凝土，连最坚韧的材料也能撕碎。古代文化曾用它们制仪式武器，相信其中藏有保护力量。
author: jaminmcready
source: Its quills are so sharp they can pierce through solid concrete and are capable of shredding even the toughest materials. Ancient cultures once used these spines to craft ceremonial weapons, believing they held a protective power.

entry: POKENAME几乎事事都靠长利爪与脚爪，刺羽簇则保护头背。沙漠家园各处，常见折下的爪碎片。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME relies on its long, sharp claws and talons for nearly every task, while a plume of spiny feathers protects its head and back. Broken pieces of POKENAME's claws are often found across the deserts it calls home.

entry: POKENAME利爪能在巨大砂岩底部凿出深庇护所。用超热拳脚击打松沙，还能将材料熔结成坚固石墙与玻璃墙。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's sharp claws allow it to carve deep shelters into the base of massive sandstone formations. By striking loose sand with its superheated fists and feet, this Pokémon fuses the materials into durable walls of stone and glass.

entry: POKENAME高速旋转，卷起沙暴。后脑尖刺能加快沙暴风速，让自己转得更快，增强念动力。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME can twirl at high speeds to create a sandstorm. The spines on the back of its head can increase the wind speed of the sandstorm so that they can twirl faster and amplify its psychokinetic power.

entry: POKENAME被腿边狂烈沙暴托在空中。与训练家结下羁绊后，会以精神力量把沙压成玻璃，做首饰相赠。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME is held aloft by the raging sandstorm surrounding its legs. When it bonds with a Trainer, it gives gifts of jewelry made from psychically compressing its sand into glass.

entry: POKENAME在泥土岩石间，自己掘出洞穴与小窟筑巢。爪还在发育，因此常改以利刺冲撞别人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME nest in burrows and small caves that they, themselves, dig out in dirt and rock. Their claws are still developing, so they will often ram others with their sharp quills instead.

entry: 它蜷成球自卫，也借此强化部分攻击。用长舌捕捉、吃掉小型鸟宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: It curls up in a ball to protect itself, though it also does this to reinforce some of its attacks. It uses its long tongue to catch and prey upon small bird Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用身上的刺来回运泥，修筑溪流中的堤坝。刺能留住水分，让泥保持湿润、容易塑形，加固时就不怕泥过早干掉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their quills to carry mud to and from the dams they construct in streams. Their quills help to trap moisture, keeping the mud damp and easily shapable so they can reinforce the structures without fear of them drying out prematurely.

entry: POKENAME的灵魂呈阿罗拉穿山王般的形态，系在古怪冰石上。谁打扰独处，就朝谁射出幽灵般的奇异冰片。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's spirits take a form resembling the Alolan variant of Sandslash, bound to a strange icy rock. It shoots strange ghostly ice shards at those who disturb its solitude.

entry: POKENAME爪子锐如钢刃，轻松切开岩石。能感知波导，找到数英里外的猎物。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's claws are as sharp as steel and can slice through rocks with ease. It is able to locate prey miles away by detecting their aura.

entry: POKENAME背上的植物十分坚硬，雨水再少也能提供足够养分，还能分泌强毒。
author: chorb33
source: The vegetation on its back is hard. It provides POKENAME with sufficient nutrients even when there is little rain and can also secrete strong poison.

entry: 爪会分泌令人疼痛却不致命的毒。烦躁时尖刺坚挺，平静时则贴平。
author: infinex21
source: Its claws secrete a pain-inducing, though non-deadly, venom. Its quills are rigid when agitated, but lay flat when it is calm.

entry: 与野生穿山王不同，POKENAME不能蜷成球，改用披甲巨口挡击，坚硬得连黑鲁加咬下也裂不开。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: Unlike a wild Sandslash, POKENAME cannot curl into a ball. Instead, it blocks attacks with its armored maw, which is so hard that not even a Houndoom bite can crack it.

entry: POKENAME头发里的符号，像人类表示“生命”的符号。有人推测，这会诱使人类放松戒心，成为更容易捕捉的猎物。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: The symbol POKENAME carries in its hair is similar to a human symbol that means 'life.' Some have proposed that it carries this symbol to lure humans into a false sense of security, making them easier prey.

entry: POKENAME通常在地面高速滚动，想毁掉所有挡路障碍。滚得太快又太执拗，有人说只有隆隆岩能拦住。
author: agostostino
source: POKENAME is usually seen rolling on the ground at high speed, trying to destroy any obstacle in its way. POKENAME is so fast and stubborn when rolling that some say only a Golem could stop it.

entry: POKENAME以众多尖刺为傲，刺随年龄增长。保护幼崽时，会展现更强力量与攻击性。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are proud of their many quills, which grow longer with age. They display heightened strength and aggression when defending their young.

entry: 沙暴将至，成群POKENAME就会来到当地。等风暴袭来，便埋进沙里，只留角露在外。
author: mistymagius
source: Groups of POKENAME arrive in an area when a sandstorm is on its way. Once the sandstorm hits, they will bury themselves in the sand with only their horn sticking out.

entry: POKENAME穿过地面，折磨打扰家园的矿工。有矿工说，逃离矿井许久后，睡着仍会看见它。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME phase through the ground to torment miners that disturb their home. Some miners claim to see POKENAME in their sleep long after they escape the mineshaft.

entry: 耳朵连最弱声响与振动都能察觉，因此几乎一直紧绷。自卫时蜷成球，尖刺根根竖起。
author: infinex21
source: Its ears can pick up on the faintest of noises and vibrations, so it is almost always tense. To defend itself, it curls up in a ball with its quills standing on-end.

entry: 沙漠神庙中游荡的POKENAME，当初究竟属于神庙守卫，还是盗墓贼，研究者仍有争论。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Researchers disagree on whether POKENAME haunting desert temples once belonged to the temple's guards or its robbers.

entry: POKENAME尖刺比石英还硬，防御强劲。每根都含使血液凝结的微量毒。一年蜕刺一次，期间钻入地下，等新刺长回。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME quills are harder than quartz, offering strong defense. Each quill contains traces of venom that causes blood to coagulate. They shed their quills once a year, and will burrow underground as they wait for them to grow back.

entry: POKENAME发怒便竖起背上所有尖刺，电火花噼啪作响，表示不满。漆黑中视力也极佳，是技艺高超的夜猎者。
author: fiordaliso
source: When angered, POKENAME raises all the quills along its back and crackles with sparks to show its displeasure. Blessed with perfect vision even in total darkness, it is a highly skilled nocturnal hunter.

entry: POKENAME一蜷成球，就成了无法穿透、无法阻挡的滚动破坏球，直冲敌人。甲片虽少脱落，却可制作高价工具，几乎能保证永不磨损。
author: sk372
source: Once POKENAME curls into a ball, it becomes an impenetrable, unstoppable rolling orb of destruction towards any opposition. Its plates, though rarely shed, are used to make high-priced tools all but guaranteed never to wear out over time.

entry: 飞行时，风滑过背鳞，发出歌声般的声音。它在沙里休息，坚挺背鳞让它伪装成突岩。
author: infinex21
source: As it flies, the scales on its back produce song-like sounds as wind runs along them. It rests within sand, its rigid back scales allowing it to camouflage as an outcrop of rocks.

entry: 受威胁时，它会蜷成球，用缎带猛抽。一昼夜内，能向地下挖掘最深10公里。
author: melodydelune
source: When threatened, this Pokémon will curl into a ball and lash out with its ribbons. It can dig up to 10 kilometers deep in a single day and night.

entry: 它擅长从头到尾一起作战，前有利爪劈斩，后有刺尾重击。POKENAME也极会挖洞，转眼便能开出地道。
author: over9001
source: This Pokémon specializes in head to tail combat, in which it slashes enemies with its sharp claws and whacks them with its spiky tail. POKENAME is also a very efficient tunneler and can dig at rapid speeds.

entry: 它的利爪足以凿穿岩石，常会走过大片水域，寻找食物。
author: .flipside3
source: Its claws are strong enough to dig through rock. It will often walk across large bodies of water to find food.

entry: 眼睛能像望远镜般聚焦，从远处追踪猎物，恶劣天气也不例外。爪虽锋利，战斗却主要靠尾巴与长颚。
author: infinex21
source: Their eyes can focus like binoculars, allowing them to track prey from afar and even through bad weather conditions. Though their claws are very sharp, they fight mostly with their tails and their long jaws.

entry: POKENAME长牙威力极大，却很容易折落。等新牙长出时，就用手拿着断牙当刀，继续伐树觅食。
author: soup1900
source: While POKENAME's tusks are extremely powerful, they break off from its body very easily. While it waits for new ones to grow, it manually uses the tusks as bladed weapons to continue slicing down trees for food.

entry: POKENAME刺背防御充足，也很适合进攻。能一次卸下数根刺，远程控制，成小群袭向对手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's spiny back provides it with ample defenses, but also has quite the offensive application. It can dislodge several spines at once and control them remotely to attack in small swarms against its opponents.

entry: POKENAME服装虽由落叶制成，却能穿过沙暴，不毁伪装。常帮助迷路训练家走出沙漠。
author: ghostslythe
source: Despite its costume being made from fallen leaves, POKENAME can forge through sandstorms without destroying its disguise. It often helps lost Trainers find their way out of the desert.

entry: 野生POKENAME常互相拌嘴。一只生气了，就想掀起沙暴，让另一只也跟着生气。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME in the wild are usually found bickering with each other. If one gets mad, it tries to start a sandstorm to make the other one mad too.

entry: 这只地下宝可梦会挖进营地，突然为旅行训练家献歌。歌唱时鳞片振动，发出铁沙铃般的声音。
author: afilthycasual
source: This subterranean Pokémon surprises traveling Trainers by burrowing into their campsites and treating them to a song. When it sings, its scales vibrate, creating a sound similar to a cabasa.

entry: POKENAME白天掘过沙丘，寻找理想猎场。夜里伏在浅沙下，以强力咬住突袭猎物。
author: .izik
source: During the day, POKENAME digs through dunes in search of ideal hunting spots. At night, it lies in wait just below the sand to ambush prey with a crushing Bite.

entry: POKENAME边振翼边迅速挖掘。捕食者出现，就用流沙地狱困住，趁混乱逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs rapidly while vibrating its wings. If a predator appears, it traps them in a Sand Tomb and flees during the commotion.

entry: POKENAME在沙丘漫游，找到大石便磨爪。白天滚进灼热沙中，让尾焰热度重新旺盛。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME sharpens its claws against large rocks it finds while wandering through desert dunes. To reinvigorate the heat of the flame on its tail, it rolls in the scorching sand during the day.

entry: POKENAME体外胶膜能抵挡沙漠栖地的严酷气温。即使埋在沙下，也能以心灵感应与同类交流。
author: fiordaliso
source: The gelatinous membrane covering POKENAME protects it from harsh desert temperatures where it nests. It uses telepathy to communicate with others of its kind, even while buried beneath the sand.

entry: 它伏在浅层地表下，以长硬刺伪装突岩。双颚能碾碎石头，猎物一被咬住，几乎没有逃脱机会。
author: infinex21
source: It uses its long and hard quills to disguise itself as a rocky outcrop while lying in wait just beneath the surface. Its jaws can crush rocks, so very few of its prey can ever escape once caught between them.

entry: POKENAME有时见于峡谷与岩漠。受惊会从洞里跃出飞走，吓到路过的训练家。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME can sometimes be found in canyons and rocky deserts. Startled POKENAME will leap from their burrows and fly away, surprising passing trainers.

entry: POKENAME用爪与粗重尾巴凶狠作战。敌人一想还击，就将众多利刺朝向对方。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME fight brutally using their claws and their bulky tails. Whenever their foes attempt to strike back at them, they turn their many sharp quills unto them.

entry: 它飘过墓道，用爪刮墙。一察觉探险者，刮声便突然停下，表示捕猎开始了。
author: .izik
source: It drifts through tomb corridors, scratching walls with its claws. The sound abruptly stops when it senses an explorer, signaling that it has begun to hunt.

entry: 古代农夫用POKENAME翻耕棉花与药草田。无论土多硬，爪子都适合耕作。
author: .izik
source: Ancient farmers used POKENAME to till cotton and herb fields. Its claws were perfect for working the soil regardless of how hard the dirt was.

entry: POKENAME若被逼在地道里，就使出蓄能焰袭，烧焦洞壁。焦痕警告后来的闯入者。
author: .izik
source: If cornered in a tunnel, POKENAME unleashes Flame Charge, scorching the walls. These burn marks act as warnings to future intruders.

entry: POKENAME五只角白天吸收沙漠家园的酷热。夜幕降下，角就燃起，确保始终温暖干爽。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's five horns absorb heat from its sweltering desert homes during the day. When night falls, the horns ignite, ensuring it perpetually stays warm and dry.

entry: POKENAME吸食仙人掌汁，厚鳞保护免遭尖刺。眼睛对光敏感，因此白天睡觉，日落后才吃东西。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME feeds on cactus juice, its thick scales protecting it from the cactus' spikes. Its eyes are very sensitive to light, so it prefers to sleep during the day and only feed once the sun sets.

entry: POKENAME利爪能挖穿硬岩，寻找食用的宝石。专采宝石的矿工会养一只帮忙，再用大块带瑕宝石奖赏，让它饱餐。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's claws can dig through solid rock as it searches for its diet of gemstones. Miners who specialize in gems keep a POKENAME to aid their hunt and reward it with large imperfect gemstone for it to feast on.

entry: 它蜷成大轮时，众多尖刺能助其轻松跨越多数地形。每根刺都分泌致命毒液，颈边小爪也一样。
author: infinex21
source: Its many quills allow it to easily cross most terrains when it curls up like a large wheel. Each quill secretes a deadly venom, as do the small claws along its neck.

entry: POKENAME背上长枝，驱赶捕食者。各类药房也会采集枝条，制作营养补充剂。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME grow branches from their backs to ward off predators. They are also harvested by various pharmacies to produce supplements.

entry: POKENAME爬出地道后，无声滑过夜空。空中时速可超过40英里。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides silently across nighttime skies after emerging from its tunnels. It can reach speeds of over 40 mph while airborne.

entry: POKENAME造出的圆顶外层极坚韧，挡住多数伤害，保护本体。受袭时会向对方泼沙，半身钻入地下。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The outside of the dome POKENAME creates is incredibly tough, preventing most damage to its main body. If POKENAME is attacked, it will throw sand at its opponent and dig itself partly underground.

entry: POKENAME白天张鳞吸收沙漠热量，夜里紧闭，留住温暖，抵御寒冷。
author: .izik
source: During the day, POKENAME opens its scales to absorb desert heat. At night, it seals them shut to trap warmth and survive the chill.

entry: POKENAME血管里流着沙，因此不太需要水。用利爪切开坚韧沙漠植物充饥，也会猎捕草属性宝可梦。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has sand flowing through its veins, so it has little need for water. It uses its sharp claws to slash through the tough desert vegetation it eats, as well as to hunt Grass-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME从头花放出剧毒粉尘，许多个体因此造成毒沙暴，破坏环境。
author: seanothan_23
source: POKENAME releases dust from the flower on its head. This dust is highly poisonous, leading many POKENAME to cause toxic sandstorms and ruin environments.

entry: POKENAME钻入地下，接上地底菌丝，用尖刺保护蘑菇。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME burrows into the ground to connect itself with the underground mycelium. It protects the mushrooms with its spikes.

entry: POKENAME躲在岩崖旁与沙丘下，伪装成沙暴中的方便庇护所。谁走进洞里，就举起双爪扣住，将其拖入沙中。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME hides against rocky cliffs and beneath dunes to disguise itself as a convenient shelter within sandstorms. If anyone wanders into its cavern, POKENAME will raise and interlock its claws before dragging them down into the sand.

entry: 强爪让它连最崎岖的地形也能穿过。每根刺都锋利粗糙，摸着冷如坚冰。
author: infinex21
source: Its strong claws allow it to traverse even the roughest terrain. Each of its quills is sharp, coarse, and as cold to the touch as a piece of solid ice.

entry: 它用身体盖住幼崽，露出众多利刺保护。刺比冰还冷，根根散寒，与沙漠高热相对。
author: infinex21
source: It protects its young by covering them with itself and baring its many sharp quills. These quills are colder than ice and each one exudes cold air in contrast to the desert heat.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在松软的土壤和沙子中挖掘，建筑队常请它们在开工前清理场地。它们很喜欢这份工作，不过必须密切看护，以免把地面挖掉太多。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A Pokémon that loves to dig through loose soil and sand, POKENAME are often used by construction crews to clear building sites prior to work starting. They enjoy the work but have to be watched closely in case they dig too much ground out.

entry: POKENAME的岩刺既坚固又锋利。它会用头撞和滚动冲撞攻击，也毫不犹豫地拔下尖刺，当作武器挥舞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's rocky spines are very solid as well as very sharp. It strikes with headbutts and rolling strikes, but isn't afraid to tear a spine off and wield it as a weapon as well.

entry: POKENAME唱着古老民歌，源自世界各处的沙漠。据说能凭乐艺控沙，用流沙困住观众，听它演唱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sing ancient folk music whose origins trace back to desert regions throughout the world. It is said that they can control sand with their musical talents to create a captive audience with quicksand.

entry: POKENAME以迷人舞蹈接近敌人，摆腰让腰刺扎入。再一边与对方跳双人舞，一边反复挥爪劈刺，将其击败。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its captivating dances to close in on enemies before stabbing the spikes on its waist into them by swaying its hips. It finishes off the foe by performing a duet with them while repeatedly slashing and jabbing with its claws.

entry: POKENAME住在干旱地区，通过厚刺排出多余体热。埋进地里，抽取附近任何植物的养分。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in arid areas, expelling excess body heat through its thick spines. It buries itself in the ground, draining the nutrients from any nearby plants.

entry: 若受冷落，它坚韧的双钳可能折断。POKENAME爪子特别长，表示已好一阵没受情绪压力。
author: puppylev
source: If this Pokémon is neglected, its tough pincers may snap off. Particularly long claws on a POKENAME suggest it has not endured any emotional stress in a while.

entry: POKENAME白天睡在沙漠浅土下，夜里才出来，滑过沙面，寻找高能量矿物。
author: turron_turron
source: POKENAME spend their days sleeping just below the desert soil. During the night, POKENAME will emerge and glide across the sand in search of energy-dense minerals.

entry: 古人曾用POKENAME翻土开田。可毒鳞常污染地面，使长出的庄稼全都带毒。
author: mistymagius
source: Ancient people once used POKENAME to help till soil and create farmland. However, its toxic scales often contaminated the ground, poisoning any crops that were grown there.

entry: POKENAME喜欢用沙覆刺，再借尾火加热，烧成粗糙玻璃。用这些玻璃，增强战斗时尖刺造成的伤害。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME like to cover their spikes in sand and heat them up with the flame on their tail, turning them into crude glass. They use this glass to enhance the damage done when using their spikes in battle.

entry: POKENAME一根利爪折断，就会陷入沉睡。重新长好，最多要整整三天。
author: .izik
source: If one of POKENAME's razor-sharp claws breaks, it enters a deep sleep. Regrowth can take up to three full days.

entry: POKENAME常在沙暴里活跃，以游泳般的方式移动。遇险就用爪埋进地下，只留粗鳞在沙上。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME are often seen thriving inside of sandstorms, using a way of moving that resembles swimming. When they're in danger, they use their claws to bury themselves in the ground, only leaving their rough scales above the sand.

entry: POKENAME挖过岩地，每颗头上的利鳞都会自然磨利。地道挖得越多，就越危险。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME digs through rocky terrain, the sharp scales on each head naturally hone themselves. Continuous tunneling makes them increasingly dangerous.

entry: 为减少彼此尖刺造成的伤，POKENAME高速挖出比未融合亲族更宽的地道，成了其他洞居宝可梦的好通路。
author: a3thrrbeazt
source: To lessen injury from each other's spines, POKENAME dig even wider tunnels than unfused kin at breakneck speeds. This makes the tunnels great highways for other cave-dweling Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME抓走找到的亮硬币，常从旅行训练家身上偷取。一得手就蜷成球，迅速滚走，避开更多冲突，带走战利品。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME snatches up shiny coins it finds, often stealing them from traveling Trainers. Once it has stolen something, it curls up into a ball and rolls away quickly to avoid further conflict and make off with its prize.

entry: POKENAME毛粗带刺，躲进洞里避捕食者后，很难被倒拖出来。若在空地被抓住，就大声嘶叫，以长利爪挥击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur is coarse and spiky, making it difficult to pull them backwards out of their burrows when they hide away from predators. If caught in the open, they hiss loudly at their aggressor and swipe with their long, sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME毛粗带刺，躲进洞里避捕食者后，很难被倒拖出来。性子虽也带刺，有些训练家仍爱梳毛，把爪涂得鲜艳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur is coarse and spiky, making it difficult to pull them backwards out of their burrows when they hide away from predators. Despite their prickly demeanour, some trainers enjoy grooming them and painting their claws vivid colours.

entry: POKENAME很容易暴怒，凭强肌与硬如岩石的爪，猛打敌人与地形。可一累，就迅速蜷成浑圆球，靠利刺保护。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are easily driven into a fierce fury, where they will use their robust muscles and rock-hard claws to pummel foes and terrain alike. However, once they tire out, they will quickly curl up into a perfect ball protected by their sharp quills.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉惊人，几英里外就能察觉进入领地的东西。若气味陌生，便吠叫驱赶，甚至蜷成刺球攻击。
author: st4rdustyugure
source: Thanks to its amazing sense of smell, POKENAME can detect anything walking into its territory from miles away. If it doesn't recognize the smell, it starts barking to repel the intruder, and might even curl up in a spiky ball to attack them.

entry: POKENAME以惊人速度跑过沙丘，却从不陷进去。多在白天战斗，因为阳光能增强火焰攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can sprint across sand dunes at incredible speeds without ever sinking into the surface. It tends to battle during daylight hours, as sunlight amplifies the power of its fiery attacks.

entry: POKENAME满身尖刺极利，让野生宝可梦不敢靠近。能结合飞行属性攻击，造出旋转沙涡，耗尽猎物体力，再以利爪击败。
author: fiordaliso
source: The quills covering POKENAME's body are so sharp that they deter other wild Pokémon from getting too close. It can combine its Flying-type attacks to create swirling sand vortices that exhaust its prey before finishing them off with its claws.

entry: POKENAME在河湖游泳，会将背刺朝天，防止鸟宝可梦从水里叼走。腹部涡纹让捕食者迷乱，绕圈游动。
author: quackquackattack
source: When POKENAME go swimming in lakes and rivers, they keep their spines facing the sky to stop bird Pokémon from plucking them out of the water. The spiral pattern on their stomachs causes predators to get confused and swim in circles.

entry: 它游过沙丘，锻炼强壮臂肌，保持最佳战斗状态。先滚向敌人，以背上利刺伤敌，再以毁灭性的格斗属性招式击败。
author: fiordaliso
source: It swims through sand dunes to strengthen the powerful muscles in its arms, keeping itself in peak condition for battle. It rolls into foes to wound them with the sharp spines on its back, then finishes them off with devastating Fighting-type moves.

entry: 从未有人见过醒着的POKENAME。它睡着时悬在离地一英尺处，仍以精神力量感知威胁，掷出足以打碎砖块的石头反击。
author: ghostslythe
source: Never before witnessed awake, POKENAME sleeps while hovering a foot above the ground. In spite of unconsciousness, it senses threats with its psychic might and responds by throwing rocks hard enough to break bricks.

entry: POKENAME在地道迷路，就瞬间移动到地面，立刻再往下挖，沿路重走，找回方向。
author: .izik
source: When lost in its tunnels, POKENAME teleports to the surface. It immediately digs downward again, retracing its route to regain its bearings.

entry: POKENAME多在沙漠绿洲附近安静冥想。若察觉可能危险的人靠近，就以精神力量制造幻觉，分散注意，引其离开。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends much of its time meditating quietly near desert oases. If it senses the approach of someone potentially dangerous, it uses psychic powers to cause hallucinations that distract them and lure them away.

entry: POKENAME以强拳打碎挡路巨石。鲁莽的力量有时会震塌上方地道。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME smashes obstructing boulders with powerful fists. Its reckless strength can sometimes cause upper tunnels to collapse.

entry: POKENAME进化后失去爪与刺，只能完全依赖蛮力。为弥补不足，练就敏锐求生本领，用木头与骨头制作武器、护具。
author: wickedwiccan
source: POKENAME lose their claws and spines when they evolve, leaving them to rely entirely on their raw strength. They develop keen survivalist skills to compensate, fashioning weapons and protection from wood and bone.

entry: POKENAME蜷成球滚向前，以坚壳上突出的利刺扫倒敌人。常在沙漠零散分布的绿洲内掘穴为家。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME curls itself into a ball and rolls forward, mowing down enemies with the sharp spikes jutting from its hard shell. It tends to make its den within the oases scattered across the desert.

entry: 快被踩到时，POKENAME会蜷成刺球。战斗中，它以利刺配合滚动进攻，效果出众，使敌人畏缩，再用利爪解决对手。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME will curl into a spiny ball if it is about to be stepped on. In battle, it will utilize its sharp spikes with a Rollout attack to great effect in order to cause its foes to flinch. It then finishes its foe off with its sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME以四只钩爪掘过崖壁。若找到大理石，就吃下，加固硬鳞。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs through cliff faces using its four hooked claws. If it finds marble, it consumes it to reinforce its hardened scales.

entry: POKENAME在战斗中应付不来，就紧紧盘起，自行引爆。爆炸将剃刀般的利鳞射向四方。
author: .izik
source: If overwhelmed in battle, POKENAME coils tightly and detonates. The explosion launches its razor-sharp scales in every direction.

entry: POKENAME全速奔跑时，火焰烧得白炽，灼焦脚下土地。战斗时以火覆前爪，给对手毁灭性打击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's flames burn white hot while running at top speed, scorching the earth beneath it. In combat, it will coat its front claws in its flames to deal devastating damage to its opponents.

entry: POKENAME只住最热沙漠，因为哪怕一阵冷风，也会影响火势。奔跑时烧焦脚下土地，沙也会熔成玻璃。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME only lives in the hottest of deserts, as any cold breeze could affect how well its fire burns. When it runs, it scorches the earth beneath it, turning the sand it runs on into glass.

entry: POKENAME缩进刺壳自卫，让敌人在尖刺上伤到自己。需大量水生存，因此在沙漠绿洲附近掘洞。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME withdraws into its spiky shell to protect itself, causing enemies to injure themselves on its sharp points. It burrows near desert oases, as it needs a great deal of water to survive.

entry: POKENAME走到哪里都带着生命之符。挥动一下，便唤沙将敌人埋住。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME carry an ankh with them wherever they go. With a flourish of the ankh, they conjure sand to entomb their foes.

entry: POKENAME挥使能控周围沙的弯杖。只须一挥，就唤起沙暴攻击敌人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wield a crook that controls the sand around them. With a single swing of the crook, they conjure sandstorms to attack their foes.

entry: POKENAME在沙漠疾跑，时速可达80英里。它精于食腐，专吃其他宝可梦不敢碰的残余。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can be seen sprinting across the desert, running up to 80mph. It is an expert scavenger, feeding on the leftovers other Pokémon wouldn't dare eat.

entry: POKENAME以最高100英里的时速追逐猎物，身后扬起大尘云。可三颗头常争论方向，害它不停转向。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME pursues its prey at up to 100 mph, leaving large dust clouds in its wake. However, the three heads often argue over which way to go, causing it to constantly change direction.

entry: 身体裹满岩石与沙，因为它们常游过沙漠、挖穿岩石。背上“岩石”其实是尖刺，已长得如硬岩般结实。
author: infinex21
source: Their bodies are encrusted with rocks and sand, due to them spending their time swimming through deserts and digging through rock. The "rocks" on their backs are actually sharp quills that have grown to be as tough as solid rock.

entry: POKENAME尖刺白天闪亮，能晃得敌人看不见，再游走。数百年前，训练家曾乘船去极寒水域看美人鱼，其实只是暴风雪中的它。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME's spikes glisten during the day, capable of blinding foes before swimming away. Centuries ago, trainers went boating in the most frigid waters to see mermaids. However, these were just sightings of POKENAME during snowstorms.

entry: POKENAME漫游沙漠，出了名地乐于助人。曾被报告从背炮给其他宝可梦供水，也用爪吓退捕食者。
author: seanothan_23
source: POKENAME wander the desert and are known to be very good samaritans. They have been reported to give other Pokémon water through their cannons on their backs and use their claws to scare away predators.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，背鳞随呼吸起伏。做梦时，尾上石块慢慢旋转。
author: .izik
source: When asleep, the scales on POKENAME's back rise and fall with its breath. Its tail stones rotate slowly while it dreams.

entry: 它们用爪钻进沙下，让背刺露出，吓退捕食者。即使折断，尖刺几乎也能立刻长回。
author: santon5512
source: Using their claws, they will dig themselves under the sand, leaving the spikes on their back sticking up in order to ward off predators. If broken off, these spikes can grow back almost instantly.

entry: 它靠强后腿跳跃，四肢一起落地移动。POKENAME罕见时会以后腿直立，向对手喷火。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: This Pokémon moves around by hopping with its strong back legs and landing on all four limbs. On rare occasions, POKENAME will stand on its back legs to spit fire at its opponent.

entry: POKENAME没有腿，踢不了对手，简直懊恼透顶。战斗时只好依靠自己产生的火焰与爆炸。
author: cascadeguy
source: POKENAME is frustrated to no end by its lack of legs and inability to kick. It instead relies on the flames and explosions it produces in combat.

entry: POKENAME身体脆弱，动不了多少，便硬化、加热自身，熬过困境。很记仇，进化后会找回曾攻击自己的对象。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: While unable to move much due to its fragile state, POKENAME will harden and heat itself to endure hardships. This Pokémon will hold a grudge and seek out any attackers after evolving.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，翼上散出火星般的鳞粉。它会寻找遭袭的弱小宝可梦施以援手，也把掉落的茧宝可梦捡起，放回头顶树枝。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: When POKENAME flies, it scatters ember-like scales from its wings. This Pokémon will seek out weaker Pokémon being attacked and aid them. It will also pick up fallen cocoon Pokémon and place them back on a branch in the tree above them.

entry: POKENAME睡着时，巨大的橙色精神能量泡包住全身。温度极高，接触却不会烧伤。
author: .izik
source: While POKENAME sleeps, a large orange bubble of psychic energy forms around its body. Despite its intensely high temperature, contact with it does not cause burns.

entry: POKENAME很爱自然，常依恋野外某株植物，凶猛守护。任何东西靠近心爱的植物，就跃起快速踢打。
author: sk372
source: Quite fond of nature, POKENAME often gets attached to specific plants in the wild. It guards them fiercely, leaping up and kicking rapidly at anything that approaches their special plant.

entry: POKENAME从上方静观目标，迅速无声地飞行，躲在视线外的枝头。一等对方放松防备，就以快得看不清的俯冲踢出击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME quietly observes its target from above, flying quickly and silently and perching on branches just out of sight. Once the target's defenses are down, it strikes with a blindingly fast diving kick.

entry: POKENAME主动运用拟态，高高拱起腹部，假扮愤怒的力壮鸡，吓唬大宝可梦。若骗局失败，就用头刺注入灼烧般的毒液。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their mimicry aggressively, arching their abdomen up high and pretending to be an angry Combusken to spook larger Pokémon. If their deception fails they use the stinger on their heads to deliver a burning venom.

entry: 这位无声袭击者眼神坚定，看着训练家与宝可梦穿过洞穴。若感到有强敌，就从栖处滑下，用手爪或脚爪抢先攻击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: This silent striker watches Trainers and Pokémon move through caverns with determination in its eyes. If this Pokémon senses a strong opponent, it will glide down from its perch and make the first strike against the target with its claws or talons.

entry: POKENAME主要以脚爪为武器。爪强而利，能长距离携带超过自身体重一半的物件。即使受伤仍坚持，点燃羽毛，展现斗志。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME use their talons as their main weapons. Strong and sharp, these Pokémon can carry objects more than half their weight for long distances. When injured, POKENAME persevere and ignite their feathers to show their fighting spirit.

entry: POKENAME快速踢动双脚，产生大量电力，并刺激体内火囊。因能供热、急时还能供电，常见于寒地农场。
author: infinex21
source: By quickly kicking its feet, POKENAME generates considerable electricity and stimulates its internal flame sac. POKENAME are commonly seen on farms in colder climates due to their heat and, in times of emergency, their electricity.

entry: POKENAME大多跳着走，很少飞。不停锻炼强化了双腿，虽然短，仍能踢出强劲一击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME mostly hops around instead of flying. This constant exercise strengthens its legs, enabling them to deliver powerful kicks despite their short length.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME拍动翅膀腾空，随后用双腿使出一连串迅疾的踢击。它似乎总能预料敌人会逃向哪里，并抢先赶到。
author: .jerden
source: In combat, POKENAME flap their wings to lift themselves into the air, then deliver a series of rapid-fire kicks using both legs. POKENAME always seems to anticipate where foes will flee to and makes sure to get there first.

entry: POKENAME整天仰望太阳练踢，一秒也不移开视线。似乎因此有了奇妙本领，不看敌人也能踢中。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME practice their kicks all day while staring up at the sun, never taking their eyes off it for a second. This seems to give them an uncanny ability to strike foes without even looking at them.

entry: POKENAME头羽改善空气动力，让它战斗中突然调整动作也不减速。靠这速度，俯冲灼烧领地内的潜在猎物。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: The feathers on POKENAME's head help with its aerodynamics, preventing it from losing speed when having to make sudden adjustments in combat. This speed helps POKENAME swoop down and scorch potential prey that are in its territory.

entry: 它不仅脚爪强健，翼下还藏着长而如剃刀般锋利的爪。POKENAME凭惊人速度，掠过一次，就能把小目标切成条片。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: This Pokémon possesses not only powerful talons, but also long, razor-sharp claws hidden beneath its wings. Using its incredible speed, POKENAME can slash a small target to ribbons in a single flyby.

entry: POKENAME在日光直射下训练，加深花瓣颜色，让外表更好看。定期参加舞蹈比赛，胜者的火舞动作常被全群采用。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME train beneath direct sunlight to deepen the color of their petals and enhance their appearance. They regularly compete in dance contests, with the winner's fire dance routine often being adopted by the rest of the group.

entry: POKENAME内火使体温天生很高。一群飘过天空，就足以暖热空气，影响天气。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME has a naturally high body heat due to its internal flame. When a flock of POKENAME drifts through the sky, the air warms up enough to affect weather patterns.

entry: POKENAME不能水下呼吸，因此在陆地睡觉，休息时给皮肤覆上保湿膜。膜味甜，其他宝可梦爱来舔；这也让肌肉保持温暖，睡醒仍能猛攻。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Unable to breathe underwater, POKENAME sleeps on land, coating its skin in a hydrating film as it rests. Other Pokémon lick this film for its sweet taste, which helps keep its muscles warm, so even after sleeping it can unleash devastating attacks.

entry: POKENAME比同群其他个体更好斗，以利爪击倒敌人。偷人东西时，常把钱包与袋子拿回巢，再翻找。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are more aggressive than the rest of their flock and will strike down foes with their sharp talons. When stealing from people, it is common to see POKENAME take purses and bags to rifle through back at their nests.

entry: POKENAME以照顾背上巢里的幼鸟为傲，借燃烧的藤蔓送食。巢边叶子始终点着，防止小家伙跳下去。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME takes great pride in caring for the chicks in the nest on its back and providing food by using its blazing vines to feed them. POKENAME keeps the leaves surrounding the nest ablaze to discourage the chicks from jumping off.

entry: 它自信，任何挑战都愿接受。POKENAME虽飞不了太久，短暂腾空也能大幅增强机动性。翼爪加热后，轻松切开敌人。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: This confident Pokémon is up for any challenge. While POKENAME cannot fly for long periods of time, a small amount of airtime gives its maneuverability a strong boost. The claws on its wings can be heated to cut through foes with ease.

entry: 野生POKENAME虽通常与家人同住，每只却都热切渴望出头、竞争。爱炫耀，被训练家收服后，是能吸引人群的出色表演者。
author: bobosmith01
source: While POKENAME typically stick together with their families in the wild, each one of them has a burning desire to stand out and compete. They love to show off; POKENAME that are caught by Trainers are wonderful performers that draw in crowds.

entry: POKENAME自信有礼，爱与比自己强的对象切磋。以喙与翼爪进攻，危急时还能拔下头羽，当匕首掷出。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME is confident, yet polite, and enjoys sparring with those of stronger than itself. This Pokémon uses its beak and the talons on its wings to attack. In a pinch, POKENAME can remove the feather on its head and throw it like a dagger.

entry: POKENAME以尾作鞭攻击，翻找鸟巢，吃无人保护的蛋。必要时伸出尖牙咬住，注入热毒，令人仿佛血管里有火烧。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME uses its tail like a whip to attack. This Pokémon scavenges bird nests for unprotected eggs to consume. If necessary, POKENAME will extend its fangs and bite down, injecting a target with a heated poison that feels like fire in the veins.

entry: POKENAME吃网上易燃物的图片。吃得越多，火焰就越热。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME consumes images of flammable objects found online. The more it eats, the hotter its flames become.

entry: POKENAME非常善于控制体温，平时多以休眠状态保存能量。不过，千万别把休眠误认成懒惰；它们为训练到这样的境界，而深感自豪。
author: blaizegamer
source: POKENAME are experts at controlling their body temperature. They are primarily seen in a dormant state to preserve their energy, but never confuse their dormancy for laziness; these Pokémon take pride in their training to reach that state.

entry: POKENAME是热血小斗士，不断增强力量，尤其勤练踢技。快速踢动能让脚燃火，以接连快击烧灼敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a spirited little fighter always enhancing its strength, particularly its kicking ability. It can kick at a rapid pace to set its feet alight and burn enemies with multiple strikes in quick succession.

entry: POKENAME用肌肉发电，因此常跑遍原野森林、从树跃下、以强腿踢碎巨石，为战斗蓄电。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME generate electricity by using their muscles. Due to this, POKENAME are commonly found running through fields and forests, jumping from trees, and smashing boulders with their powerful legs to generate electricity for combat.

entry: POKENAME借小而不起眼的身体，引来过于自信的敌人。目标一进射程，就从喙轰出火焰，再转身以带电尾巴击打。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME use their small and unassuming size to draw in foes who become overconfident. When the target gets within range, POKENAME unleashes a fiery blast from their beaks, then whips around and strikes with their electrified tails.

entry: POKENAME战斗不敌时，会用强壮的双腿，踢起沙尘云，扰乱敌人，再蜷成球，高速滚走。身体的热量，还可能让逃跑的沿途，散落玻璃碎片。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: When outmatched in battle, POKENAME uses its powerful legs to kick up clouds of sand to disorient its foe. It then curls into a ball and rolls away at high speed. The heat from its body can leave shards of glass scattered along its escape route.

entry: POKENAME头上长羽储存大量数据，存得越久，损坏越重。装满太久，羽毛便先极热，再燃烧，把数据释放进附近文件。
author: .izik
source: The feathers protruding from POKENAME's head store large amounts of data, but it corrupts the longer it is contained. Should they remain filled for too long, the feathers grow intensely hot before combusting and releasing the data into nearby files.

entry: POKENAME覆体的红利叶，轻松切开原木。许多徒步者找它作伴，靠伐木本领与火息，熬过长途旅程。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: The sharp red leaves covering POKENAME's body can cleave through logs with ease. Many hikers seek out these Pokémon as partners, using their woodcutting skills and fire breath to survive long journeys.

entry: POKENAME常控制不住脚爪的热。奔跑时，在地面烧出燃烧的脚印。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME regularly loses control of the heat in its talons. When running, it leaves burning footprints scorched into the ground.

entry: POKENAME跑过数英里岩地，强化双腿。身体散出的暖意，使它成为寒地训练家的理想坐骑。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME strengthen their legs by running for miles through rocky terrain. The warmth they radiate from their bodies makes them the ideal mount for Trainers in cold regions.

entry: POKENAME不只用大爪，也用背上的超热尖刺攻击。蜷成球扑向敌人，一击就能造成严重烧伤与深切伤。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME attacks not only with its large claws, but also with the superheated spines covering its back. By curling into a ball and launching itself at foes, POKENAME can inflict severe burns and deep slashes in a single strike.

entry: POKENAME花无数小时练腿，能不停跑超过一天。战斗时连踢快得双腿只剩模糊残影，旁人根本看不清。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME spends countless hours training its legs so that it can run for over a day without a break. When in combat, POKENAME can unleash a flurry of kicks so fast that its legs are an unseen blur to observers.

entry: POKENAME不断锤炼火焰，在山里一连数日训练专注。只须一脚踢得精准，多数战斗就能迅速结束。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME constantly hone their flames, training their concentration in the mountains for days at a time. With a single well-placed kick, they can end most battles quickly.

entry: POKENAME敏捷无比，强腿让它跃过栖居的岩地。通过踢石头练腿，磨炼技巧。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are incredibly agile, their powerful legs letting them leap across the rocky terrain they inhabit. They train their legs by kicking rocks, honing their skills.

entry: POKENAME个头虽小，力量却极强。用石头练踢速，先踢上空，再趁落地前尽可能多踢几下。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: While small in stature, POKENAME are incredibly strong. They use rocks to practice their kick speed, launching stones into the air before delivering as many kicks as they can before the stone hits the ground.

entry: POKENAME踢力强，能点燃双脚增强打击。可这样会过热，因此之后多潜进泥里降温。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses a powerful kicking ability, able to ignite its feet to increase the power of its strikes. Doing so overheats it, so it typically cools off by submerging itself in mud afterward.

entry: POKENAME双腿比未融合的组成物种更强，水里水外都迅捷。借身上鳍辅助移动，先发尖锐战吼，再接连踢出火焰腿。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME has stronger legs than their unfused counterparts… giving it swiftness in and out of water. Using the fins on its body to assist its movement, POKENAME will let out a sharp battle cry before delivering several fiery kicks.

entry: POKENAME用羽状角感知周围情绪，不高兴就尖声鸣叫。若还没用，就朝负面情绪源头吐火球，再逃走。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Able to sense the emotions of those around it using its feather-like horns, POKENAME will let out a sharp cry to show its displeasure. If that doesn't work, POKENAME will spit a fireball towards the negative source before fleeing.

entry: POKENAME准备战斗，会把头羽往后拉。训练家在战斗中振奋，它就转得更快，踢得更猛，并用精神能量防止头晕。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME pulls the feathers on their head back when ready for battle. When its Trainer becomes energized during a fight, POKENAME will spin faster and kick harder. They use their psychic energy to avoid getting dizzy.

entry: POKENAME晴天就像芭蕾舞者般起舞，显然十分兴奋。随着旋转，暖天会让身周火焰更加猛烈。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME dances like a ballet dancer whenever the weather is sunny, clearly excited. The warm weather will increase the intensity of the fire that forms around it as it spins and twirls.

entry: POKENAME在战场上极优雅地移动，落脚处皆烧焦。据说动作风格，会映照训练家的情绪。
author: craigprime
source: POKENAME moves across the battlefield with the utmost elegance, leaving scorched ground wherever it plants its feet. It's said that the style of POKENAME's movements mirrors its Trainers' emotions.

entry: POKENAME精神力量足以短暂飘浮。战斗中主要借此延长滞空，给飞踢更多时间命中。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has enough psychic power to temporarily float. In combat, it mostly uses this ability to give it more time to land its flying kicks.

entry: POKENAME能把长舌猛射出去，打穿树木。先用爪刺破水果，喝掉流出的汁，再把果实吃下。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can launch their long tongues with enough force to punch holes in trees. They use their claws to puncture fruits and drink up the juices that flow out before actually eating the fruits.

entry: POKENAME以照料背上巢中的幼鸟，并帮助它们为离巢作准备而自豪。幼鸟练习走路时，它会在一旁看护，跌倒了，就用温热的藤蔓扶起，或放回巢中。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME takes pride in caring for the chicks in the nest on its back and preparing them to leave. POKENAME monitors the chicks as they practice walking, using its heated vines to pick them up when they fall or place them back into the nest.

entry: 古老传说称，把POKENAME羽毛放在头顶能起死回生。故事被证伪后，对这个物种的怨恨也悄然蔓延。
author: .izik
source: Ancient legends claimed POKENAME's feathers could revive the dead when placed upon the head. When these stories were disproven, resentment toward the species quietly spread.

entry: POKENAME是警觉的斗士，以速度与力量受重视。群中踢得最快、尾巴最亮的个体，被公认为物种中的强者。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are vigilant fighters, prized for their speed and strength. The POKENAME with the fastest kicks and brightest tail are acknowledged in their group as the strongest of their species.

entry: 许多POKENAME生活在大群体。成对个体要找彼此，会用独特而响亮的叫声定位，尤其一方看守蛋时更重要。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Many POKENAME are part of a large flock. When a pair of POKENAME need to find each other, they will use very distinct and loud calls to locate each other. This is especially important when one partner is watching over an egg.

entry: POKENAME极独立，谁靠私人空间太近，就可能被踢。招牌防御技巧，是朝攻击者吐出大量滚烫泡沫。
author: sk372
source: Highly independent, POKENAME is likely to kick at anybody who gets too near its personal space. Its signature defensive technique is spitting out a large amount of boiling hot bubbles at attackers.

entry: POKENAME服从指令，既不犹豫也不畏惧。不适合没经验的训练家，因为连荒唐命令也一字不差照做，容易使错误更严重。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are obedient combatants, following instructions without hesitation or fear. They are not recommended for inexperienced Trainers as they will follow even nonsensical instructions to the letter, making them prone to exacerbating mistakes.

entry: POKENAME开战先用灼热触须缠住敌人，固定不动，再以喙不断换位置灼烧。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME seeks to wrap its blazing hot feelers around foes at the start of combat. During this time, it holds them still while repeatedly burning them in alternating locations with its beak.

entry: POKENAME将无休止训练视为生活。远行强化身体后，练习快速火踢，再以毁灭性的甩尾收招。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Relentless training is a way of life for POKENAME. After crossing great distances to strengthen their bodies, they practice unleashing rapid fiery kicks before finishing with a devastating swing of their tail.

entry: POKENAME双腿强到能撼动大地。跺得越快，地震仪读数就越大。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME has powerful legs that can shake the earth. The faster it stomps its feet, the larger the reading on a seismograph.

entry: 它从臭氧层降下，把云化成蒸汽，练习控火。传闻雨云没来得及落雨就散去，可能正是POKENAME所为。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: This Pokémon trains its fire by turning these clouds into steam after coming down from the ozone layer. Rumors have spread that rain clouds dissipating before allowing rainfall could be from POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME对训练极其认真。如果达不到自己定下的目标，就会勃然大怒，连连跺脚，开始用尾巴和利爪，劈砍、猛砸巨石。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME take their training very seriously. If these Pokémon cannot accomplish a goal they have set, they will become enraged. Stomping their feet, they will begin slashing and bashing at boulders with their tails and sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME夜里在月光下跳舞。天性虽平和，却凶猛保护聚会，以利爪与强踢赶走闯入者。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME spend their evenings dancing under the light of the moon. Though peaceful by nature, they fiercely protect their gatherings, using sharp claws and powerful kicks to drive away intruders.

entry: POKENAME花上伸出的刺，与带刺长鞭相连。一被刺中，就注入灼烧般的毒，让敌人皮肤如火烧，直到用解毒药才止。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: The spikes protruding from POKENAME's flowers are connected to their thorny whips. When struck by one of these spikes, the foe will be injected with a burning poison, making the opponent's skin feel like it's on fire until an Antidote is applied.

entry: POKENAME使劲摇动尾巴，调节体热与血流。多余热量则化作火焰，从头上的囊喷出。
author: teatedtiten
source: To regulate heat and blood flow, POKENAME vigorously shakes its tail.  Excess body heat is transferred into flares that spew out from the sac on its head.

entry: 它们在地下等进化，仍执着收集食物。POKENAME乐于用锋利热爪切削树根，帮忙造巢。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: While waiting for evolution underground, these Pokémon adamantly gather food. POKENAME find joy in carving roots with their sharp, heated claws and helping create nests.

entry: POKENAME斗志高涨，气息就化为火焰，随出击起舞。战后仔细打理头羽。
author: .realthree
source: When POKENAME's fighting spirit is roused, its aura manifests itself as flames dancing around POKENAME's strikes. After a fight, POKENAME carefully cares for the feathers on its head.

entry: POKENAME很难被催动，宁愿一连数天守在巢上。等终于被迫出手，它便挥动凶狠的利爪，猛烈战斗，力求尽快结束。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are hard to rouse to take action, preferring to brood over their nests for days on end instead. When they are finally forced to act they use their vicious claws and fight aggressively, trying to end the fight as fast as possible.

entry: POKENAME好斗任性，训练家还没来得及下令，就常已冲进战斗。一心进攻，不适合新手训练家。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are aggressive and wilful Pokémon, often racing into battles before their Trainers have even had a chance to issue them instructions. They focus entirely on offense and are not recommended for newer Trainers.

entry: POKENAME喜欢飘在温暖热带海面。休息被打扰，就朝冒犯者喷热水。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME loves to float in warm tropical seas. If disturbed while resting, it sprays hot water at the offender.

entry: POKENAME似乎天性好胜，宁战不逃。但若知道赢不了，也会尽量重创敌人，再找机会撤退。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME seems to be competitive by nature, opting to fight over fleeing. However, if this Pokémon knows it cannot win in a fight, POKENAME will deal as much damage as it can before finding a chance to retreat.

entry: 多数POKENAME宁可依赖短而强的双腿，也不爱用发育不全的翅膀。翅膀一动，声音却震耳欲聋，令人失去方向感。
author: h0bojoe
source: Most POKENAME favor their small but powerful legs over their underdeveloped wings. When their wings do move, the resulting noise is deafening and disorienting.

entry: POKENAME训练时，教练规矩严格。训练家或其他宝可梦若落后，就回头厉叫“跟上”，再继续指导。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME has a strict coaching routine when it comes to training. If its Trainer or other Pokémon fall behind, it will turn and squawk back orders to prompt them to 'keep up' before continuing with its instruction.

entry: 这些好斗者会攻击任何侵入洞穴领地的对象。POKENAME从不退缩，不断啄击灼烧，直到敌人倒下，或自己昏倒。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: These aggressive fighters will attack any individual who invades their cave territory. POKENAME do not back down from fights and will peck and burn their opponents until they fall or POKENAME faints.

entry: POKENAME通常十分和善，有旁人在就开心鸣叫。但受威胁或被惹怒，便会向烦恼源头连踢抓挠。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are typically very amiable and chirp happily in the presence of others. However, when they are threatened or are made angry, they will rapidly kick and scratch at the source of their frustrations.

entry: POKENAME是在隔离环境中多代杂交的结果，比多数同体形鸟宝可梦飞得快。美丽尾羽让它深受观鸟游客喜爱。
author: ultrazombie929
source: POKENAME are the result of generations of isolated cross-breeding and can fly faster than most other bird Pokémon of their size. Their beautiful tail feathers make them a favorite among bird-watching tourists.

entry: POKENAME一找到满是祖母绿的洞穴，就会大声鸣叫。谁靠近它认定的领地，就朝谁喷火。
author: .izik
source: Should POKENAME locate a cave full of emeralds, it lets out a loud chirping noise. It sprays flames at anyone who draws close to its claim.

entry: 科学家认为，POKENAME外形酷似某些现代鸟宝可梦的史前祖先。强腿与厚羽让它过于适应环境，因此远古至今几乎未变。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME is what scientists believe the prehistoric ancestor of some modern bird Pokémon looked like. With its powerful legs and thick feather coating, the species remained almost unchanged since ancient times, too well-adapted to its environment.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME跑到田野、山间，用走路草的身体，练习适合自己的踢技。即使没了双臂，也拦不住它。
author: cascadeguy
source: At nighttime, POKENAME runs off to fields and mountains, spending its time adapting its kicking mastery in the body of an Oddish. The removal of its arms will not deter it at all.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，以美丽舞蹈分散敌人注意。逐渐靠近，再向弱点接连猛踢。
author: mepp.
