source: In battle, POKENAME distracts enemies with its beautiful dance. Once it edges closer, POKENAME unleashes a flurry of powerful kicks directed at weak points.

entry: 遇威胁，它激昂起舞，踢腿扬翼。舞速渐快，POKENAME羽毛越来越热，直到燃起火焰。
author: hophoppip
source: When threatened, it performs a spirited dance, kicking and throwing up its wings. As the dance speeds up, POKENAME's feathers generate more and more heat until they burst into flames.

entry: POKENAME用裙状羽毛分散对手注意，不让留意腿力。等敌人走神，就以火焰连踢进攻。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME uses its skirt-like feathers to distract opponents from the strength of its legs. While its foe is preoccupied, it attacks with a blazing flurry of kicks.

entry: POKENAME口内覆着熔岩状物，能熔穿咬住的金属船壳。机灵的水手会利用熔下的金属，制作工具与物件，帮助自己。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's mouth is lined with a lava-like substance that can melt metal boat hulls it bites into. Sailors who get crafty will utilize the melted cuts POKENAME provides to create metal tools and objects to aid them.

entry: POKENAME木头脑袋上长的苔藓可吃，却极辣。有趣的是，神奥厨师会用来做甜点与鸡尾酒。
author: .izik
source: The moss growing from POKENAME's wooden head is edible, though incredibly spicy. Interestingly, chefs in Sinnoh use it in desserts and cocktails.

entry: 有时融合后，POKENAME会保留力壮鸡的双臂。可比起手上功夫，它还是更愿磨炼踢技。
author: cascadeguy
source: Sometimes during the fusion process, POKENAME keeps Combusken's arms instead of removing them. It would much rather continue mastering its kicking skills, though.

entry: POKENAME花粉极易燃，一接触空气就着火。它定期喷出火流，热量使花粉颗粒在空中飘行数百米。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME pollen is incendiary, catching on fire as soon as it makes contact with the air. They spout these jets of flame regularly, the heat sending granules of pollen travelling hundreds of meters through the air.

entry: 它身手如杂技般灵巧，以超声波弄晕宝可梦，再用脚爪攻击。最常见于火山附近洞穴。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is an acrobatic Pokémon that dizzies Pokémon with ultrasonic waves and then attacks with its talons. It is most often spotted in caverns near volcanoes.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇以明火煎烤最美味。缺食时，许多个体会吃彼此背上的蘑菇，补充养分。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME mushrooms taste best when seared over an open fire. Many POKENAME eat the mushrooms off each other's back to gain extra nutrients when food is scarce.

entry: POKENAME活力舞蹈配上烟火般的烈焰，令人振奋。踢击虽快得人眼看不见，却会刻意放慢，好让表演受欣赏。
author: t3isukone
source: The energetic dances of POKENAME accompanied by its pyrotechnic flames invigorate the heart. It's able to deliver kicks so fast a human eye can't see them, but it slows itself down so its performance will be appreciated.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇越往里层越辣。最辣部分会被晒干磨粉，用来给菜肴调味。
author: .izik
source: Each layer of POKENAME's mushroom grows spicier the deeper one goes. The spiciest portions are dried and powdered for use as seasoning in dishes.

entry: POKENAME以腕上长羽为傲。火系能力会把羽毛烧掉，因此除非绝对必要，否则不用。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is proud of the long feathers on its wrists. Using fire-based abilities burns the feathers off, so it avoids doing so unless absolutely necessary.

entry: POKENAME覆着蛋壳般的坚甲。能移动部分甲片，让锯齿边缘朝外，使靠近变得更加危险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is covered in a tough plating that resembles an egg shell. It can shift certain segments of the shell to point jagged edges outward, making it much more dangerous to approach it.

entry: POKENAME以魔杖指向营火，就能操控成各种形状大小。火焰最多可长到原来的三倍。
author: .izik
source: By pointing its wand at campfires, POKENAME can manipulate them into a variety of shapes and sizes. The resulting flame can grow up to three times its original size.

entry: 它以每分钟超过2000英尺的速度奔跑，训练双腿。战斗时凭这双腿接连猛踢，准头惊人。
author: torterrable
source: It runs at over 2000 feet per minute to train its legs. During battle, it uses these legs to unleash a barrage of devastating kicks that strike with incredible accuracy.

entry: 这些好胜宝可梦总想打架，或为训练，或只为证明比别的宝可梦强。POKENAME以火踢与战斗中的夸耀态度闻名。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: These competitive Pokémon are always looking to get into a fight, whether it is to train or just prove they're stronger than another Pokémon. POKENAME are known for their blazing kicks and boastful attitudes in combat.

entry: POKENAME极护地道网络，稍有闯入迹象就探头。会从洞里跃出，踢出疼痛一脚，惩罚认定的入侵者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is territorial in regards to its tunnel networks, peeking its head out at the smallest hint of trespassers. It leaps out from its hole to deliver a painful kick to punish those it considers intruders.

entry: 雄性POKENAME用喙折下珊瑚枝，为伴侣建造合适的巢穴。到了求偶季节，雌性会按巢的品质挑选伴侣，再与雄性一同入住。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Male POKENAME use their beaks to break off coral branches to build a suitable nest for a partner. During courtship season, female POKENAME will choose a partner based on the quality of the nest, then settle into the home with the male.

entry: POKENAME贪婪固执，亮东西一入眼，就忍不住偷走。受害者若想护住饰物，就会遭到快得看不清、疼痛难忍的连踢抓挠。
author: sk372
source: Greedy and stubborn, POKENAME is prone to pilfering anything shiny that catches its eye. If its victim tries to defend their trinket, POKENAME unleashes a blindingly fast flurry of painful kicks and scratches.

entry: POKENAME的叫声连自己与同族都嫌烦，气得全群开始乱打。最先叫的那只，会被无数脚踢，挨打最多。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's cries annoy even itself and its clan, infuriating them to the point where they all start wildly fighting each other. The one who let out the initial cry will be beaten up the most by a myriad of kicks.

entry: POKENAME挥使焦黑大葱棒，以棒端火星点燃敌人。没棒也能战斗，但拿着更自信，有助命中。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wield a charred leek baton that sets foes ablaze with the embers at the end of the baton. While POKENAME can fight without their baton, the baton gives them a boost of confidence that helps them land attacks.

entry: 这些活力宝可梦常花数小时，对岩石树木连踢练腿。宽臂也强壮，却更常用来滑翔或尝试飞行。
author: infinex21
source: These energetic Pokémon often spend hours training their legs with flurries of kicking attacks against rocks and trees. Their broad arms are quite strong, though they tend to use them to glide or to try to fly.

entry: 战斗中，POKENAME背上球茎不断喷火。平衡极好，能以后腿行走，但研究显示，它更喜欢四肢着地。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: During battle, the bulb on POKENAME's back will constantly spit flames. This Pokémon has great balance and can walk around on its hind legs, but studies show that it prefers walking on all fours.

entry: POKENAME兼具火焰鸡的烈火与快拳郎的拳力。炽热踢击猛烈，迅疾的重拳更足以碎骨。
author: sheogorath
source: Fusing Blaziken's blaze with Hitmonchan's punch, POKENAME unleashes devastating fiery kicks alongside fast bone-crunching punches.

entry: POKENAME漫游垃圾场，主要吃塑料。消化道经过每颗头，最后通向小头，由它排出消化产生的烟气与火焰。
author: jacklemon
source: POKENAME roams landfills and mostly eats plastic. Its digestive tract runs through each head and ends in the tiny one, which expels fumes and flames produced from the digestion process.

entry: POKENAME在育儿袋孵蛋，高体温加快孵化。幼崽长到足够大后，会协助母亲施展火焰攻击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME incubates its eggs in its pouch, its high body heat speeding up the hatching process. Once the babies are old enough, they will aid in their mother's fiery attacks.

entry: 据说POKENAME一进化，就会无意识地掌握特殊战法，以重击与迅捷优雅的动作击败敌人，因此常被比作电子游戏角色。
author: chaos_emblemx
source: Upon evolution, POKENAME are said to subconsciously master a special fighting style that uses hard-hitting attacks and swift yet graceful movements to defeat a foe. They are often compared to video game characters as a result.

entry: POKENAME俯冲侵入领地的宝可梦，点燃毒刺，将其赶走。若仍不肯离开，就把腿翼也点燃，显得更吓人。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME ignite their stingers while diving towards Pokémon that encroach on their territory, driving them from the area. If the trespasser continues to loiter, these Pokémon will set their legs and wings ablaze to appear more intimidating.

entry: POKENAME小身体里满是斗志与力量。独门战法以双脚和尾巴覆火，配合得天衣无缝。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME packs a lot of fighting spirit and strength into a small body. It has mastered a unique art of combat utilizing flames over both its feet and tail, utilizing them both in perfect conjunction.

entry: POKENAME织网，覆上毒性物质，碰到便很快无法行动。逃出来的对象形容，那感觉像痛苦的灼烧。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME weave webs coated in a poisonous compound that quickly incapacitates any who touch it. Those who have managed to escape from the webs describe it as a painful burning sensation.

entry: POKENAME交替运用几组翅膀，能远飞不停。休息时降下，用爪抓住坚韧树枝，再翻身倒挂，以脚挂稳。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: By alternating the set of wings POKENAME possesses, it can fly great distances without stopping. When it needs to rest, POKENAME will descend and grip a sturdy tree branch with its claws, then turn itself upside down, holding on with its feet.

entry: POKENAME羽毛精巧，飞行无声。战斗时，羽毛燃起明亮火星烈焰。罕有目击、气度宏伟，因此曾被误认成传说之鸟。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME can fly without being heard due to its exquisite feathers. When in combat, this Pokémon's feathers flare up with brilliant embers and flames. Due to its rare sightings and grand nature, POKENAME has been confused for a legendary bird.

entry: POKENAME受月亮吸引，夜里用覆火双脚跃上高处。天空划过的火弧，常被旁观者误当流星。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Drawn to the moon, POKENAME spend their nights bounding to lofty heights with their flame-covered feet. Their fiery arcs across the sky are frequently mistaken for shooting stars by onlookers.

entry: POKENAME从嘴喷火，主要烤熟嫩芽与叶子再吃。体小、攻击范围有限，却能跃向敌人，用喙与脚爪不停猛攻。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME breathes fire out of its mouth and mostly uses this to cook shoots and leaves before it eats them. While its reach is limited by its small size, POKENAME can leap towards foes to relentlessly attack them with both its beak and talons.

entry: POKENAME战斗虽多用踢击，强翼也能打出拳般力道。还能全身裹上明火，让羽毛亮如太阳。
author: .jerden
source: While POKENAME mostly uses kicks in combat, their powerful wings can strike foes with the force of a punch. They can engulf their entire body in bright fire, making their feathers glow like the sun.

entry: 近来有武术家请POKENAME当教练。它能预判任何来招，是理想陪练，让武者尽情全力出招。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Recently, some martial artists have taken to using POKENAME as their coach. They are perfect sparring partners, able to anticipate any move that will be used against them, allowing the athlete to put their full force into the move.

entry: POKENAME以惊人速度飞过天空，翼尖火焰留下炽亮轨迹。旁人看得眼花缭乱，敌人却心生恐惧。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: As POKENAME soars through the sky at incredible speeds, the flames at the tips of its wings leave blazing streaks in its wake. The sight is dazzling to onlookers and terrifying to its foes.

entry: 每到年末，全身羽毛都会烧尽。POKENAME藏起来，等新羽长回，非要等能展露华丽新装，才肯见人。
author: .jerden
source: At the end of every year, all of its feathers burn away. POKENAME hides itself away until they grow back in, not wanting to be seen until it can reveal its glorious new plumage.

entry: POKENAME陆上不够灵活，水里却迅速凶猛。每次出拳都热情十足，热量能将拳边的水煮沸。
author: sk372
source: Although less mobile on land, in the water POKENAME fights with quick speed and great ferocity. It strikes with enough passion to heat and boil the water around its fists with each punch.

entry: POKENAME掌握独特武艺，只有水下有效。陆上尝试时，却像无助地乱扑腾。羽毛能让它在冰水保暖。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME has mastered a unique form of martial art that is only effective underwater. When it tries this style on land, it appears to be flopping helplessly. Its feathers help keep it warm in icy waters.

entry: POKENAME怀着火热决心，在泥泞河岸练武。朝泥中挥火拳训练，常引来一群好奇乌波，模仿武术姿势。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME practice martial arts along muddy riverbanks with fiery determination. They train by throwing fiery punches in the mud, often drawing crowds of curious Wooper who attempt to copy their martial poses.

entry: POKENAME耐力胜过同群其他手下。体形紧凑、翅膀强健，常被老大派作侦察，寻找龙属性宝可梦囤的宝藏。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME have the most stamina out of the other cronies in their flocks. Because of their compact bodies and strong wings, these Pokémon are used as scouts for their boss to seek out hoards of treasure from Dragon-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME头脑出众，能以意念随心生火、控火。爱找傲慢斗士打架，巧用精神本领挫其锐气，引以为乐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's great mind gives it impressive pyrokinetic abilities, creating and manipulating fire at will with its mind. It picks fights with cocky combatants, delighting in humbling them through strategic use of its mental skills.

entry: POKENAME能在危险袭来前片刻察觉，浑身燃起烈火，再以速度与火焰打出快得看不清的反击。
author: curazy
source: POKENAME senses danger moments before it strikes, flaring with intense fire. It uses its speed and flames to land a blinding counterattack.

entry: POKENAME战斗中斗志最旺时，内部高热会让金属身体发亮。战后冷却，关节便冒出蒸汽。
author: sk372
source: When its fighting spirit flares to its max in battle, POKENAME's metallic body glows from the sheer heat it's producing inside. Once the battle's over, steam rises from its joints as the body cools down.

entry: POKENAME专精拳踢，出招都裹着火焰。金属身体长期接触高热，也变得更耐热。
author: pugmon12389
source: POKENAME tends to specialize in both punches and kicks, delivering both covered in flames. Its metal body is more resistant to heat due to the constant exposure.

entry: 它善攀各种地形，即使冰瀑附近湿滑不稳的峭壁也不例外。肉食性，主要靠捕猎，也会收集无人看守的宝可梦的蛋维生。
author: bobosmith01
source: A skillful climber that can scale any kind of terrain, even slippery and unstable cliffs near frozen waterfalls. As a carnivore, it relies primarily on hunting for prey, as well as gathering unprotected Pokémon Eggs, all in order to sustain itself.

entry: POKENAME凭强腿跃起，臂上和后脑翅膀帮助调整位置，滑往指定地点。重伤时羽毛燃起，火焰攻击也更强。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: After jumping into the air with its powerful legs, the wings on POKENAME's arms and the back of its head help it position and glide to a designated point. When badly injured, its feathers will ignite, and its fiery attacks get stronger.

entry: POKENAME在火山周围洞穴，以熔岩作画。似乎不喜欢使用红橙以外的任何颜色。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be found in caves around volcanoes, using lava as paint. They seem to not enjoy using any color that is not red or orange.

entry: POKENAME训练渐趋激烈，四肢羽毛都会点燃、烧尽。观察哪处火焰最亮，就能推测可能的进化方向。
author: sk372
source: The training regimens POKENAME puts itself through grow so intense that it ignites and burns off the feathers on its limbs. One can predict its possible evolution by observing which flames burn the brightest.

entry: POKENAME训练得足够投入，就能达到近似超级火焰鸡的状态。只须绷肌，四肢便燃起翻涌烈焰。
author: sk372
source: A POKENAME that dedicates enough of itself to training can attain a state resembling Blaziken's Mega form. Just a single flex of its muscles will ignite its limbs in roiling flames.

entry: POKENAME的蓝舌会分泌有毒唾液，毒性强得一滴就能让成年人住院。需要远距离交战时，它便用火焰攻击对手。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's blue tongue secretes a poisonous saliva. This fluid is so potent that a single drop is strong enough to hospitalize a fully grown adult. If POKENAME has to fight at range, it will launch fiery attacks at its opponents.

entry: POKENAME的奶不太受欢迎。孩子嫌太辣，爱辣者又嫌奶冲淡了辣味。制成奶酪后，人们才更喜欢。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME's milk is not very popular. Children complain that it's too spicy, while lovers of spicy food complain that the milk makes it less spicy. When turned into cheese, people enjoy it more.

entry: POKENAME把蛋留在火山孵化，自己练格斗。蛋太重，常堵住熔岩喷流，因此回来取蛋时，会引起小喷发。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME leave their egg in volcanoes to incubate while they practice fighting. The eggs are so heavy that they often block lava plumes, so when POKENAME returns to take the egg back, minor eruptions occur.

entry: POKENAME睡前埋进地下，睡着也扭来扭去，但身体此时灼热，能保安全。醒来点燃体内气体，如火箭般冲出地面。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME buries itself underground before sleeping. Even in sleep, it wriggles around, but its body becomes scorching hot during this time, keeping it safe. When it awakens, it ignites the gas in its body to launch out of the ground like a rocket.

entry: POKENAME多余储电会从颊囊与羽毛黄尖显出。冒火花时，能借过剩能量向前弹射，踢出破坏力强大的火焰踢。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Extra electricity stored inside of POKENAME will become visible through its cheek sacks and the yellow tips of its feathers. While sparking, POKENAME can use this excess energy to launch itself forward and propel devastating Blaze Kicks in combat.

entry: POKENAME翅下藏着第二组脚爪，用来抓取贵重物。手下若惹它不高兴，就会毫不犹豫地施以灼热惩罚。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's wings cover and hide a second set of talons that it uses to snatch valuables. If a crony upsets POKENAME, this Pokémon will not hesitate to deal out a scorching hot punishment.

entry: POKENAME红毛摸起来热，始终带着电。最可怕的武器是尾巴，既能释放闪电般的电击，也能带着火球般的炽烈猛攻。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's red fur is hot to the touch and constantly feels charged with electricity. POKENAME's most feared weapon is its tail, as it can strike with the charged power of a lightning bolt or fiery passion of a fireball.

entry: 野外只曾在如今覆满冰雪、不再活跃的火山顶附近发现它。战斗时，体温骤升，会熔化周围栖地。
author: bobosmith01
source: It has only been found in the wild near the tops of inactive volcanoes that are now covered in ice and snow. When it battles, its body temperature raises dramatically, melting their nearby habitat.

entry: POKENAME是行走的灾厄，雷与火交织的咆哮，传出数公里。它从一棵树跃向另一棵，身后便燃起山火。
author: scapz
source: A roving calamity, POKENAME's roar of thunder and flame can be heard from kilometers away. As it leaps from tree to tree, forest fires ignite in its wake.

entry: POKENAME以类似人类相扑的方式格斗，也混入高温火焰轰击，压制敌人。
author: phantom640
source: POKENAME fights using a style similar to human sumo wrestlers, while also mixing in high temperature fire blasts to subdue it's foe.

entry: POKENAME走过沙地，会留下易碎玻璃脚印。这能直接把人引到洞穴，因此更喜欢砂岩覆盖大部分地面的栖地。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME leaves fragile glass footprints wherever it walks on sand. As these trails can lead directly to its burrow, it prefers habitats where sandstone covers most of the ground.

entry: POKENAME飘在网上寻找恶意软件。一发现就喷火，有时也烧损附近数据，使其失效。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats around the internet searching for malware. When it spots any, it blows fire at it, sometimes also burning nearby data in the process and rendering it unusable.

entry: POKENAME武艺高超，想经过家园，必须先交战证明自己。战况越烈、斗志越高，粗尾就会点燃，化作额外强武器。
author: sk372
source: Highly skilled in fighting arts, none may pass through POKENAME's home unless they prove themself against it combat. As the battle rages and its fighting spirit rises, its thick tail will ignite and become a powerful additional weapon.

entry: 它点燃尾上的干灌丛吓敌，虽常引发林火，POKENAME事后却会细心培育重新长出的植物。
author: .jerden
source: It can ignite the dry brush of its tail in order to frighten foes. Although this often starts forest fires, POKENAME will carefully cultivate the plants that regrow afterwards.

entry: POKENAME摇动大尾，向空中撒下无数易燃种子。战斗时以尾刮地，擦出火星点燃种子，让四周爆出鞭炮般的炸响。
author: infinex21
source: When POKENAME shakes its large tail, it scatters countless combustible seeds into the air. It battles by scraping its tail along the ground to create sparks and ignite these seeds, resulting in firecracker-like explosions all around it.

entry: POKENAME踢击能产生足以在巨石熔出洞的高热。为达到这温度，事前会快速来回跳动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's kicks can generate flames hot enough to melt holes in boulders. To reach this level of heat, it hops back and forth rapidly beforehand.

entry: POKENAME勇敢坚定，常在宽阔原野疾奔。研究者猜测，它或在找对手切磋，或在练耐力。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Courageous and determined, POKENAME are often seen sprinting across large open fields. Researchers suspect this Pokémon may be searching for opponents to spar with or training its endurance.

entry: POKENAME个头虽小，腹中却酝酿强火，全身不断散出高热。向敌人吐火球，灵腿则能躲开多数攻击。
author: santon5512
source: Despite their small size, POKENAME brew powerful fire in their stomachs, their bodies constantly radiating intense heat. They will spit fireballs at opponents, their agile legs allowing them to dodge most attacks.

entry: 它面对危险少有惧色。POKENAME平常个头虽小，内火强度却几乎无人能比。想捡软柿子的敌人，打完只会焦黑着离开。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: This Pokémon shows little fear when facing danger. Despite their usual small stature, the intensity of POKENAME's inner fire is nearly unmatched. Foes looking for an easy target will walk away scorched and blackened after fighting POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME点燃双手，加热爪子，让挖洞安家时凿地更加省力。强健的双腿，也帮助它们在沙漠家园中长途远行。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: By igniting their hands, POKENAME can heat their claws to make carving into the ground less strenuous while creating their burrows. These Pokémon also have powerful legs that aid them in long-distance travel across the desert lands they call home.

entry: POKENAME借体内储火，点燃手爪与脚爪。敌人越强，火就越热，爪也烧得通红。
author: santon5512
source: Using the flames stored within their bodies, POKENAME ignite their claws and talons. These flames grow hotter the stronger their opponent is, their claws glowing red-hot.

entry: POKENAME以腕上长焰缠住敌人，能勒得对方窒息。一跃可越过50层楼高的建筑。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can strangle opponents by wrapping the long flames that emit from its wrists around them. It can clear a 50-story building in a single leap.

entry: POKENAME自身放火太多，已烧焦皮肤。双腿只有骨头，走路十分困难。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has charred its own skin due to emitting so many flames on itself. It has a hard time walking due to having only bones for legs.

entry: POKENAME以腕上长焰缠住敌人，能勒得对方窒息。一跃可越过50层楼高的建筑。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can strangle opponents by wrapping the long flames that emit from its wrists around them. It can clear a 50-story building in a single leap.

entry: POKENAME双腿强劲，轻松跃过宽河床。头鳍能感知附近敌人的活动，双脚便点燃，准备作战。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME have incredibly powerful legs that allow them to jump over wide riverbeds with ease. Using the fin on their head, POKENAME can sense foes moving nearby, causing their feet to light ablaze in readiness for combat.

entry: POKENAME用强腿轻松跃过沼泽，借移动周旋，等对手陷泥，再跃下踢出灼热一击，将其烧得焦黑。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME use their strong legs to leap through swamplands with ease. Using their movement, POKENAME will wait for their opponent to become trapped in the mud before leaping down with a blazing kick that will leave the opponent blackened and scorched.

entry: POKENAME以厚层黏土筑巢，吹火烧硬、加固。巢最高可达15英尺，通常填满芦苇，让住处舒适。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME builds its den from thick layers of clay, blowing flames onto it to solidify and strengthen the structure. Its dens can reach up to 15 feet tall and are typically filled with reeds for comfort.

entry: POKENAME举起巨石，手腕就会燃火。物件越重，火越强越亮。羽鳍能帮助它水陆加速。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: When POKENAME lift large boulders, their wrists will ignite; the heavier the object, the stronger and brighter the fire. They use their feather fins to accelerate their movement both in and out of the water.

entry: POKENAME寻找斗志强烈的榜样拜师。以发育中的双腿练跳与踢，斗志渐长，火焰也更强。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME will seek out a role-model with a strong fighting spirit to mentor under. Using its developing legs, POKENAME practices jumping and kicking as its own fighting spirit grows and flames become stronger.

entry: POKENAME以舞蹈集能，造出强力火焰攻击。若战斗中太热，周围空间可能开始扭曲，映出这场战斗结局的异象。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME use their dance to gather energy and create powerful fire attacks to use during battle. If POKENAME becomes overly heated in battle, the space around it may begin to warp and produce visions of POKENAME's battle outcome.

entry: POKENAME制造暖空气团，托着自己贴地飘浮。为保护训练家，能将热凝成足以熔化岩石的火球。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME floats just above the ground on a cloud of warm air it creates. To protect its Trainer, it can concentrate this heat into a ball of fire hot enough to melt rock.

entry: POKENAME结合精神能量与武艺，读取未来，预判敌人下一招。训练家若受伤，火焰便炽热燃烧，结合精神能量，创造恒星之力。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Using its psychic energy and martial arts, POKENAME will read the future to predict its opponent's next move. If its Trainer is harmed, POKENAME's fire will burn hot as it combines with its psychic energy to create the power of a star.

entry: 越有奋战的理由，POKENAME的火焰便越热。生死关头，魔法火焰能造出足以毁灭城市的火风暴。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its flames burn hotter the more it has to fight for. When in a fight with its life on the line, POKENAME's Mystical Fire creates city-destroying firestorms.

entry: POKENAME发展出以肘刃与膝盖为主的独特战法。杂技般的招式极难防御，是可怕的敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME develops a unique fighting style focusing on its elbow blades as well as its knees. The resulting acrobatic maneuvers in combat are incredibly difficult to defend against, making it a fearsome foe indeed.

entry: POKENAME受挑战，便能造出火刃。极重荣誉，从不肯在战斗中退缩。
author: .jerden
source: When challenged, POKENAME can create blades made out of fire. It is incredibly honorable, and refuses to ever back down from a fight.

entry: 头顶光环与POKENAME火热的灵魂相连，只有昏倒才熄灭。强烈瞪视能使敌人不敢攻击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: The halo above this Pokémon's head is connected to the fiery spirit of POKENAME and only goes out after fainting. The intense stare of POKENAME deters foes from attacking it.

entry: 它们以火拳火踢战斗，内火越来越热、越来越猛。POKENAME腹上锯齿纹随火焰强度变色。
author: infinex21
source: As they fight with blazing punches and kicks, their internal flames grow hotter and fiercer. The zigzag pattern on a POKENAME's belly changes color to match the intensity of its flames.

entry: POKENAME凭四脑，精通世界所有武艺。各肢体可充分旋转，拳法腿法皆能自由施展。
author: divinelunaria
source: POKENAME has used its four brains to master every form of martial arts across the world. The full range of rotation on each of its limbs allows POKENAME to use both punch and kick techniques freely.

entry: 最凶猛好斗的POKENAME会呈现这种形态，前肢生出火焰缎带。智力高、力量大，少有对手能交战获胜。
author: sk372
source: The most ferociously combative of POKENAME take on this form, ribbons of fire generating from its front limbs. Highly intelligent and immensely powerful, few can take it on in combat and emerge victorious.

entry: POKENAME巨口周围的毛耐火，保温更胜多数羊毛。用灼热拳踢作战，也会挥摆大嘴攻击。
author: infinex21
source: The fur-clad surrounding POKENAME's large maw is flame-resistant and retains heat better than most types of wool. It fights with blazing kicks, scorching punches, and by swinging its maw around.

entry: POKENAME大多平静，很难激怒。真发火，羽衣会突然燃烧，拳踢也都裹着烈焰。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME mostly remains calm and is difficult to provoke. If it is angered, its coat of feathers will suddenly burst into flames, enabling POKENAME to deliver blazing kicks and punches.

entry: POKENAME强腿能跃上树，利爪能重重劈斩，却很少用得上。通常略展速度与力量，就足够吓跑敌人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's legs are powerful enough for it to leap into trees, and its sharp claws can deliver powerful slashes. POKENAME rarely has to use these abilities, as a brief demonstration of its speed and strength is usually sufficient to make foes flee.

entry: POKENAME耐心等在树下，树上的果实一成熟，就立刻挥拳打向树干。这一拳会在树皮留下拳形的焦痕，使所有果实立即掉落。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME waits patiently at the base of trees, then punches the trunk as soon as the fruit above is ripe. This attack leaves a fist-shaped scorch mark on the bark and makes all the fruit immediately drop.

entry: 幼崽一受威胁，POKENAME便凶猛回应。全身挺直，双臂燃火，以压倒性力量攻击，让附近捕食者明白惹它的后果。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME reacts fiercely to any threat against its young. Rising to its full height with flaming arms, it attacks with overwhelming force, ensuring nearby predators understand the consequences of crossing it.

entry: 传说POKENAME是体现战斗不同方面的几位神祇之一。只看见它，多数宝可梦的斗志便足以燃成热烈火焰。
author: sk372
source: Legends say POKENAME is one of several deities that embody different aspects of combat. Just the sight of it is enough to make most Pokémon's fighting spirit ignite into a fiery, passionate blaze.

entry: POKENAME斗志满溢，随时能跃入战斗，拼尽一切。斗志真正完全燃起，头上植物的叶子也会着火。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is bursting with fighting spirit, ready to leap into battle and give it its all at a moment's notice. The leaves on the plant on its head catch fire when its battle spirit truly ignites fully.

entry: POKENAME住在山里，凭灵巧攀过峭壁险岩。虽力求独立，仍常跟着父母，学习地形、练习战技。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME live in the mountains and use their dexterity to scale the cliffs and crags. While they strive to be independent, they are found following their parents as they learn the terrain and practice their combat skills.

entry: POKENAME用坚韧身体与烈火吐息守护洞穴。对外来者好斗，靠近幼崽时却会变得如母亲般慈爱，细心照料。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME protect their burrows using their sturdy bodies and intense fire breaths. While aggressive towards outsiders, when POKENAME are near their young, their demeanors shift to a motherly love as they care for their children.

entry: 脑袋火热，脾气也火爆，它们会迎战家园附近察觉的一切威胁。POKENAME压低姿态，借冲力使出惊人冲天拳，将敌人打飞。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Hot-headed, both literally and figuratively, these defensive Pokémon will combat any threats it senses near their home. Using a low stance, POKENAME will use their momentum to send foes flying with an impressive Sky Uppercut.

entry: POKENAME在险峻山区筑巢，凭敏捷穿行，也能保幼崽安全。捕食者艰难越山时，它却能轻松扑出攻击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME create nests in mountains with harsh terrain where they can use their agility to maneuver the area while keeping their young safe. While predators struggle to get through the mountain range, POKENAME can easily pounce and attack.

entry: POKENAME体内热量强烈，因此不必让羽毛覆满全身。它们聚成群体时，会两两碰角，表示信任。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME have such an intense internal heat that they do not require their entire bodies to be covered in their feathers. When these Pokémon form groups, pairs of POKENAME will touch their horns together as a sign of trust.

entry: POKENAME喷的水总近沸腾。夏季热量更强，碰到谁就烫伤谁。
author: .izik
source: The water POKENAME spits is always close to boiling. In summer, this heat only intensifies, scalding anyone it touches.

entry: POKENAME大鳍坚韧如钢，是抵挡敌人攻击的有效防御。挡下一击，便以强力火踢反攻。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's large flippers have the resilience of steel, making them quite an effective defense against opponents' strikes. After blocking a blow, it retaliates with high-powered flaming kicks.

entry: POKENAME是由自身炽烈意志锻成的火焰剑盾。踢击会将目标灼伤，烈焰斩击更会留下烧伤与刀口。
author: sheogorath
source: POKENAME is a blazing sword and shield, forged from its own fiery spirit. Its kicks scorch, while fiery slashes leave both burns and gashes.

entry: 金属双臂与灼热刀刃融为一体，POKENAME跳起烈焰战舞。踢击灼人，锋利挥斩则让对手既被割伤，又遭火烫。
author: sheogorath
source: Metal arms fused with searing blades, POKENAME dances a fiery war dance. Its kicks scorch, while razor-sharp swipes leave opponents sliced and singed.

entry: 它用华丽羽翼飞行，吼叫喷火威吓敌人。强腿让它能俯冲踢击，再从地面疾速蹬回空中。
author: .jerden
source: It flies using magnificent feathered wings, roaring and breathing fire to intimidate foes. With its strong legs, it can swoop down to deliver kicks, then push itself off the ground and into the air with great speed.

entry: POKENAME制造林火幻象，不让威胁靠近领地。为保护幼鸟，母亲会不休止地猛攻。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME casts illusions of wildfires to deter threats from approaching their territory. Mother POKENAME are known to attack relentlessly in order to protect their chicks.

entry: POKENAME缎带如自身四肢般善战，每条都有踢击般的强力。范围出众，能同时对付多个敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can use its ribbons in battle as effectively as its own limbs. Each one can strike with the same powerful force as its kicks, giving it an excellent range to take on multiple opponents at once.

entry: POKENAME无惧最强敌，先用强尾扫倒，再以壮腿碾压。雷鸣般的跺脚能裂开大地，涌出岩浆柱。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME fearlessly challenges even the toughest opponents. Using its powerful tail, it knocks foes off their feet before crushing them with its muscular legs. Its thunderous stomps can split the earth and unleash plumes of lava.

entry: POKENAME以高热与火焰，直接踏击水域，将水蒸发。大跃后落地的冲击，足以把土地震成大碎块。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME evaporates bodies of water by physically stomping them with its intense heat and flames. The impact of its landing after a large leap is powerful enough to shatter land into large fragments.

entry: 长期住在臭氧层，POKENAME已掌握太阳热量，将巨大烈焰导入身体与攻击。极少休息，翱翔天际，以坠落陨石为食。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Living in the ozone layer for so long, POKENAME has harnessed the heat from the sun, channeling this immense flame into its body and attacks. POKENAME rarely rest, soaring the skies and consuming falling meteors for sustenance.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，使敌人过热疲惫，陷入灼热噩梦。被烧伤的人和宝可梦称，即使它已不在附近，仍会做噩梦。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Being extremely territorial, POKENAME will cause their foes to overheat and fall into a heated nightmare from exhaustion. Pokémon and humans who are burned by this Pokémon claim to still have nightmares despite POKENAME not being around.

entry: POKENAME腕脚内的推进器，带来极高战斗机动性。引擎超负荷运转时，每拳每踢都能掀起大火浪。
author: sk372
source: Boosters within POKENAME's wrists and feet give it exceptionally high combat mobility. Sending the engines into overdrive lets it create large waves of flame with each punch or kick it makes.

entry: 优雅动作增强武术攻击，战得激烈，双拳便燃火。POKENAME大手上的爪分泌致命毒素，能让对手麻痹。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Its martial arts attacks are enhanced by its graceful movements, setting its fists ablaze when in the heat of battle. The claws on POKENAME's large hands secrete a deadly toxin that can paralyze an opponent.

entry: POKENAME是少数适应城市生活的宝可梦，明亮灯光下常被误认成角色扮演者。若被察觉，就放出烟幕，再跃过建筑。
author: ghostslythe
source: One of the few Pokémon adapted to city life, POKENAME are often mistaken for cosplayers under the bright lights. If noticed, they expel a Smokescreen before jumping over buildings.

entry: 关都古时，POKENAME曾教僧侣武艺。战斗中若达到禅定般的状态，火踢便会燃成蓝色。
author: teatedtiten
source: During the ancient periods of Kanto, POKENAME taught martial arts to monks.  If a POKENAME reaches a zen-like state while fighting, its blazing kicks burn blue.

entry: POKENAME的等离子体身体，战时发光更强。拳击干扰神经细胞，留下电视杂讯般的麻刺感。
author: pattybgoode
source: In battle, POKENAME's plasma body glows more intensely. The punches it throws disrupt nerve cells and leave a tingling sensation like TV static.

entry: POKENAME隐居在深深的洞穴里，平时很少现身，却会在月夜聚集，沿着山坡起舞。满月之下，舞蹈达到高潮时，羽毛便会燃起火焰。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are reclusive Pokémon that make their homes in deep caves. Though seldom seen, they gather on moonlit nights to dance along the mountainside. Under a full moon, their feathers blaze with fire as the dance reaches its peak.

entry: POKENAME认定自己在任何竞争中都绝对最强，战斗时仿佛从无败的可能。因此顽固难控，什么都敢打。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME believe themselves to be unequivocally the strongest Pokémon in any competition, and they will fight as though there is no chance of them losing. This can make them obstinate and difficult to control, willing to fight anything.

entry: POKENAME认定自己在任何竞争中都绝对最强，战斗时仿佛从无败的可能。因此顽固难控，什么都敢打。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME believe themselves to be unequivocally the strongest Pokémon in any competition, and they will fight as though there is no chance of them losing. This can make them obstinate and difficult to control, willing to fight anything.

entry: POKENAME喷出的内脏一接触空气，就猛烈燃烧。将其塑成火爪，力量足以抓住、压制大得多的宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's expelled innards ignite viciously when exposed to the air. It forms the innards into a flaming claw with the strength to grapple and subdue much larger Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME连胜几场，就可能自满。训练家安排越来越难的对战，压住傲气。最终战败后，梳理翅膀有助加深彼此羁绊。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can become complacent after winning several matches in a row, so Trainers arrange matches that are increasingly difficult to help keep its ego in check. When it eventually fails, grooming its wings helps it develop bonds with its Trainer.

entry: 它从尾羽猛烈喷火，将自己推上空中，或直冲目标。虽以强踢闻名，毁灭性的勇鸟猛攻却更恶名昭著。
author: infinex21
source: It expels bursts of intense fire from its tail feathers to launch itself into the air or toward its target. Although it is known for its powerful kicking attacks, it is even more infamous for its devastating Brave Bird attack.

entry: POKENAME高居山地，练习喷火。洞壁由熔岩构成，是辨认巢穴的标志。童话常将它描绘成掳公主回窝的怪物。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME lives high in the mountains where it trains its fire breathing. Its caves can be identified by molten rock that makes up their walls. This Pokémon is often depicted in fairytales as a monster that steals princesses into its lair.

entry: 每条尾巴全力一挥，都能劈开树。POKENAME也能用尾尖精准出击，在石头钻出洞。不过，多数战斗仍用火球与火流。
author: infinex21
source: Each of its tails is strong enough to split a tree with a full swing. POKENAME can precisely strike with the tips of its tails; these strikes can bore holes into stone. Despite this, POKENAME mostly fights with fireballs and streams of fire.

entry: POKENAME全身加热，滚向对手攻击。滚动若被拦，就以惊人优雅蹬地腾空，再裹着烈火落向敌人。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME heat up their entire bodies and roll into their opponents to attack. If their rolling is stopped, they will kick off the ground to launch into the air with surprising grace before falling on their foe in a fiery blaze.

entry: POKENAME似乎天性护弱，愿为小宝可梦战到无法再战。全身裹火，吓退攻击者，或蓄力打出灼热重击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME seems to be protective by nature, willing to fight until it can't to protect weaker Pokémon. POKENAME will engulf itself in its own flames to deter its attackers or power itself up for a scorching blow.

entry: POKENAME彼此绕转，维持生命与内火。转得够快，就会飞出小火星。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME rotate around each other, keeping them and their internal fire alive. If they spin fast enough, small flaming sparks will fly.

entry: 它跳起落地时，引起巨大冲击波，震得敌人站不稳跌倒。POKENAME趁对方倒地，点燃巨腿，重重踏下。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: When this Pokémon lands after jumping, it triggers massive shock waves that cause foes to lose their footing and fall. While down, POKENAME will set its massive legs ablaze before stomping down on the opponent.

entry: POKENAME腿肌发达，个头却不够大，难以有效运用。便靠双腿来回跳练习，一跑起来也容易绊倒。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME  have well-developed leg muscles but lack the size to effectively use them. POKENAME will opt to practice using their leg muscles by hopping back and forth on their legs, and are prone to tripping when they run.

entry: POKENAME在矿物丰富的火山区繁盛生活。从花形掌心生火，表演精巧火舞，向同类求偶。
author: brilliantdarkness
source: POKENAME thrive in volcanic areas with mineral-rich soil. They generate fire from their flower-shaped palms, using it to court other POKENAME with elaborate flaming displays.

entry: POKENAME借火花朵，让灼热火焰环身，阻止敌人攻击。若仍受威胁，就用尖脚趾刺击，向攻击者注毒。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Using its fire flowers, POKENAME surrounds itself in scorching hot flames to deter foes from attacking. If an opponent continues to threaten it, POKENAME will strike the attacker with its pointed toes, injecting them with poison.

entry: POKENAME蹲下啄食。若有人嘲笑，就会迅速回旋踢来，留下严重烧伤。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME eats by squatting down and pecking at its food. If you laugh at it, it will swiftly roundhouse kick you and leave a nasty burn.

entry: 它们警觉，是同群侦察者。休息或进食时，POKENAME会栖在当地最高处，巡视四周。一见威胁就叫告同伴，全群随即飞逃。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: These watchful Pokémon are scouts for their flock. When resting or feeding, POKENAME will find the highest point in the area and perch. Monitoring the area, if POKENAME spots a threat, it will cry out to the others, and the flock will flee.

entry: POKENAME以爪深挖地底，找到晶洞，就用猛踢劈开，吃里面的晶体。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME dig deep into the earth with their claws. When they find a geode, they will split it apart with a mighty kick and feast on the crystal inside.

entry: POKENAME碎屑般的羽毛，在追逐猎物时嘎吱作响。每次追逐前，都有一声如烤箱门猛关的吼声。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The crumb-like feathers on POKENAME's body make a crunching sound as it chases prey. Each pursuit is preceded by a roar that sounds like an oven door slamming.

entry: POKENAME碎屑般的羽毛，在追逐猎物时嘎吱作响。每次追逐前，都有一声如烤箱门猛关的吼声。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The crumb-like feathers on POKENAME's body make a crunching sound as it chases prey. Each pursuit is preempted by a roar that sounds like an oven door slamming.

entry: POKENAME身躯坚韧、热量强、态度骄傲，是可畏斗士。熔岩队坚信，在固拉多将昔日海洋化成沙漠的年代，它或许已漫步大地。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: This Pokémon's sturdy body, intense heat, and prideful attitude make POKENAME a feared combatant. Team Magma strongly believes that POKENAME may have walked the earth during the times Groudon dried out deserts that were once oceans.

entry: POKENAME是顶级捕食者，强颚轻松嚼穿钢铁。追猎时，会以闪焰冲锋摧毁一切挡路物。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME are apex predators that can easily chew through steel with their powerful jaws. They will destroy anything that blocks their path with Flare Blitz when chasing their prey.

entry: POKENAME羽间飘落的东西看似花粉，其实是火星与毒孢子混合。吸入会严重损伤肺部，须立即医治。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: What appears to be pollen drifting from POKENAME's feathers is actually a mixture of embers and toxic spores. Inhaling this substance can cause severe lung damage, requiring immediate medical treatment.

entry: POKENAME一开战，就点燃翼尖绒羽，化成火球。战斗动作令人目眩，有些马戏团还将它的对战当节目演出。
author: hophoppip
source: When it enters a battle, POKENAME ignites the fluffy feathers on its wingtips, turning them into fireballs. The movements of a POKENAME in battle are dazzling to see, and some circuses hold battles with POKENAME as shows.

entry: POKENAME吃纸制品，为内火补充燃料。每次使出火踢，空气就飘起烧垃圾的气味。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME consumes paper products to fuel the flames within its body. Any time it uses one of its flaming kicks, the aroma of burning trash wafts through the air.

entry: POKENAME吞食易燃材料，壮大身体。点燃自己灼伤敌人，可战斗一结束，身躯也比先前小了许多。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME consumes flammable materials to build up its body. It sets itself alight to burn its enemies, but once the battle is done, it's left much smaller than it was before.

entry: POKENAME巡视湖泊领地，腿上羽毛不断掉落。气味极浓，能将边界与同类领地分开。
author: .izik
source: Feathers fall from POKENAME's legs as it patrols its lake territory. These feathers are extremely pungent and mark the boundaries from those of others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME双颚威力惊人，是可怕猎手。用腿穿行沼泽森林，躲在高树，再从上方跃下伏击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's devastating jaws make it a fearsome predator. Using its legs to maneuver through swamps and forests, it hides in tall trees and ambushes prey by leaping down from above.

entry: POKENAME在水下喷蒸汽推进，空中则可喷火飞行。它迅捷凶狠，从一切可能的角度攻击猎物，直到对方伤重不支。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME propel themselves underwater with bursts of steam but can use bursts of fire to fly. These quick Pokémon brutally attack their prey from any possible angle until they submit to their injuries.

entry: POKENAME友善有活力，有时会在比赛前鼓励没自信的宝可梦。舞步由快速脚法与踢击构成，偶尔被误认成攻击。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME are friendly and energetic Pokémon that can sometimes be observed hyping up insecure Pokémon before a competitive event. Their dance style has sometimes been confused for attacks, with the style consisting of fast foot movements and kicks.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇是抢手美味，煮熟后咸辣搭配恰到好处。随着它更强壮，部分菌瓣会自然脱落。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's mushroom is a highly sought-after delicacy, as when cooked its flavor is described as the perfect mix of spicy and salty. Flaps of the mushroom will naturally fall off as POKENAME grows stronger.

entry: POKENAME作战太狂猛，小鳞片不断震落，散在身周。落鳞一碰就燃火，给敌人多添一重危险。
author: reflecbeat
source: POKENAME fights so frenetically that small scales shake loose from its body and scatter around it. The discarded scales create an additional hazard for its foe, as they will burst into flames on contact.

entry: POKENAME每只手只有一根巨指。握力强，能抓紧东西，精细活却难做。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME possesses one enormous digit on each hand. It can hold things tight with a powerful grip, but struggles with tasks requiring more dexterity.

entry: POKENAME以烈焰爪与震地踢，攻击想伤朋友的人。战得够久，拳上爪子还能引爆，威力足以掀飞拖挂卡车。
author: notadoctor75
source: POKENAME strikes at those who would attack its friends with blazing claws and earth-shattering kicks. If a battle rages on for long enough, it can trigger explosions from the claws on its fists that can send a tractor-trailer flying.

entry: POKENAME个头虽小，却能跃起三十英尺高。用力时，后脚与耳朵都会喷出团火。
author: pattybgoode
source: Despite POKENAME's small size, it can leap up to thirty feet high. When it exerts itself, fire puffs out from its hind feet and its ears.

entry: POKENAME战斗时把木棍叼在嘴里，想单凭身手获胜。只有真被逼入绝境，才挥棍施展火焰法术。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries a stick in its mouth during battle, attempting to win solely through its physical prowess. It is only when it is truly pushed into a corner that it wields the stick and casts fiery spells with it.

entry: POKENAME力量外溢，却优雅地从空气取热，随动作节拍使出喷射火焰。阿罗拉舞者模仿其动作，编成丰收节舞蹈。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME exudes power, yet gracefully takes heat from the atmosphere to use Flamethrower in beat with its motions. Alolan dancers have mimicked its movements for a harvest festival dance.

entry: POKENAME以长而强健的腿踢出火焰手里剑，使其飞射，破空切向敌人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME launch their flaming shuriken by kicking them with their long, muscular legs. This sends the projectile flying, slicing through the air to cut through foes.

entry: POKENAME常聚在山间温泉附近跳舞。精彩表演后鞠躬时，体内积热会从植物帽中如熔岩流出。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are commonly seen gathering in the mountains near hot springs to dance. After an excellent performance, the heat built up within POKENAME flows out as lava from its plant-like hat when bowing.

entry: POKENAME覆体羽毛能作鳍，帮助转向。安定成为父母后，用下鳍上的爪抓紧珊瑚，更好看顾幼崽。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: The feathers covering POKENAME's body act as fins to help steer their movement. When these Pokémon settle down and become parents, POKENAME use the claws on their bottom fins to hold onto coral to better watch over their spawn.

entry: POKENAME生气时，体温高到毛也开始闷燃冒烟，让它更怒。于是将火焰凝进拳头，试着把怒气集中用于战斗。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: When POKENAME get angry, their temperature increases enough for their own fur to start smoldering and smoking, which only makes them angrier. They concentrate flames into their fists to try and focus their rage for use in battle.

entry: POKENAME直起身，用前腿踢击或喷火战斗。一昼夜可跑超过6,700英里，不过第二天大多时间都得休息。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME fight by rearing and kicking with their front legs or by spitting fire. They can run over 6,700 miles in a single day and night, though they will need to rest for most of the following day.

entry: POKENAME巨翼兼用于飞行、防御与威吓。来袭时以翼作盾，全幅伸展，又能显得更大、更吓人。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME use their massive wings for flying, defending, and intimidation. These Pokémon will block oncoming attacks by using their wings as a shield. Stretching out their wings to the full wingspan help POKENAME look larger and more intimidating.

entry: 四只火拳释放熊熊怒火。POKENAME的每记武术攻击都带着灼热，烈焰烧得如斗志般明亮。
author: sheogorath
source: Four fiery fists unleash a blazing fury. POKENAME's martial arts scorch with each blow, its inferno burning as bright as its fighting spirit.

entry: POKENAME常在城市迅速为家庭递送禽肉餐点。每隔十二年，干劲格外高，一年能成功往返数千趟。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be spotted making quick deliveries of poultry food to homes in cities. Every twelve years, they become more motivated than usual, making thousands of successful trips within the year.

entry: POKENAME极护洞穴家园，不断与靠巢一英里内的宝可梦争斗。从空中朝敌人喷出火海，迫不得已才用身体攻击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are territorial of their cavern homes and are constantly getting into fights with Pokémon that come within a mile of their den. From the air, POKENAME will breathe infernos of fire down onto foes, using physical attacks as a last resort.

entry: POKENAME爱玩，喜欢向训练家和其他宝可梦喷水。战斗时可加热到滚烫，击中的敌人会遭剧烈烧伤。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are very playful and enjoy spraying water at their Trainer and other Pokémon. In combat, this Pokémon can heat the water to scalding temperatures, leaving opponents hit by it with a searing burn.

entry: POKENAME挥使燃烧的巨型大葱棒，烧穿竞争对手的防线。对战时结合强健身手与烈火棒击，取得胜利。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wield a massive burning leek baton that they rely on to burn through their competition. During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME combine their athleticism with blazing strikes from their baton to secure victory.

entry: POKENAME浓厚的羽毛，能留住体内火焰的热量，摸起来十分温暖。任何人或东西，只要试图拔它们的羽毛，就会挨上强力的一脚。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have thick plumages that help to contain the heat of their inner flames, which makes them quite warm to the touch. They deliver powerful kicks to anyone or anything that may try to pluck their feathers.

entry: 它从后部喷火加速，也能从三颗头分别喷火，强化啄击。还能快速连踢，力道强猛。
author: infinex21
source: It expels flames from its rear to launch itself at greater speeds and can do the same from each of its three heads to empower its pecking attacks. It delivers powerful kicking attacks in rapid flurries.

entry: 它靠踢击与三头喷火战斗。每颗头虽能独立思考、追踪不同敌人，三者最终却总同时盯住同一个目标。
author: infinex21
source: It fights using kicking attacks and by spitting flames from each of its heads. Although each head can think separately, and thus track different foes, all three inevitably focus on a single foe at a time.

entry: POKENAME在壳里将水加热至极高温，随时备着蒸汽。战时双炮喷出滚烫蒸汽，以压力进攻，也能制造烟幕。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME superheat water within their shell, keeping a store of steam constantly ready. They can shoot jets of scalding steam out of their cannons when fighting, using the pressure both offensively and to create smokescreens.

entry: POKENAME常在活火山边冥想，将热量吸进摆锤。
author: fenragon
source: POKENAME often spends time meditating at the edge of active volcanoes, where it absorbs the heat into its pendulum.

entry: POKENAME钳内尖爪带来极强抓握力。尖端也能点燃巨钳，挥出火焰重击，或烧灼已被牢牢钳住的敌人。
author: sk372
source: Tipped claws within POKENAME's pincers give it massively strong gripping power. These tips can also set its large claws alight, bludgeoning foes with flaming strikes or burning those already trapped in its inescapable grasp.

entry: POKENAME虽小，力量可别小看，能举起超过自身体形两倍的巨石。背上种子让它以阳光为食，常浮在缓流河面。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME is small, but don't underestimate its strength. It can lift boulders over twice its size. The seed on POKENAME's back allows it to use sunlight for food, and it can often be found floating atop slow rivers.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间都待在湿沼的泥里。唯有大雨时，它们才会离水，啃食沼泽里的芦苇和其他植物。
author: fireflower20002
source: POKENAME like to spend most of their time in the mud found in wet marshlands. They only get out of the water during heavy rainfall, where they eat the reeds and other plant life found in the marshland.

entry: POKENAME在湖底成簇生活，关系紧密。有些群体最多20只，合力觅食、互相保护。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lives in clusters on the bottom of lakes, where they form tight-knit groups. Some clusters can be up to 20 POKENAME large, working together to find food and protect each other.

entry: 它们收集重骨，个头虽小，挥起来却轻松。POKENAME常为想要的骨头互泼泥，直到一方认输。
author: chibitales
source: These Pokémon collect heavy bones and swing them with little effort despite their small size. POKENAME often fight over bones they want by flinging mud at each other until one admits defeat.

entry: POKENAME住在河湖深处。身体充气，喷出泡泡，在水下移动。
author: mjxpimouss
source: POKENAME lives in the depths of lakes and rivers. It shoots bubbles from its air-filled body to move underwater.

entry: POKENAME吐出的泡泡充满毒气，能猛力射出，推动自己在水下高速前进。
author: mjxpimouss
source: The bubbles emitted by POKENAME are filled with a toxic gas. It can project these bubbles with force, allowing it to propel itself underwater at high speeds.

entry: POKENAME爱在泥地玩，却很护选定的游乐处。会捶胸，放出小电光，警告靠太近的来者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys playing around in muddy areas, but is quite territorial about its chosen play spot. It beats its chest, creating small bursts of electricity as a warning to those getting too close.

entry: POKENAME的身体大半是液体，重塑形状便能变身。它爱住泥泞池塘，装成一堆土。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME transforms by reforming its mostly liquid body. It likes to reside in muddy ponds, and will disguise itself as mounds of dirt.

entry: 近来POKENAME数量猛增。据说是训练家为了孵出某种特定颜色，正在大量繁殖。
author: sk372
source: In recent times, POKENAME populations have begun to skyrocket. Supposedly, the reasoning lies in Trainers breeding them in large amounts in the hopes of hatching a specific color of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME爱桶和桶状物，住进里面，一见更漂亮或舒服的，就跳去新居。蓝色个体原本极罕见，数量为何突然大增，仍是谜。
author: deadshields
source: POKENAME adore buckets and bucket-like objects, housing themselves within them and hopping over to new ones they find prettier or comfier. Blue POKENAME were originally very rare; it is currently unknown how their population boomed.

entry: POKENAME用鳃吸气，再呼进壳里，将空气困住。尽管又大又重，充气壳仍让它能浮在水面。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME breathes in through its gills and exhales into its shell, trapping air inside. Despite its size and weight, its aerated shell gives it the ability to float on water.

entry: POKENAME友善，却在不如愿时易烦躁。会利用控水本领，得到想要的东西。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME is friendly, but become irritable when they don't get their way. They take advantage of their ability to manipulate water to get what they want.

entry: POKENAME不停在泥里打滚，滚进河水洗净，再继续。爱与水跃鱼玩，但一被其他宝可梦发现，就迅速瞬间移动逃走。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME constantly roll around in mud, rolling into the river water to clean themselves before continuing. They love to play with Mudkip, but quickly teleport away when spotted by other Pokémon.

entry: 野生POKENAME常大群捕猎。许多巨型宝可梦，在它们遍布的水域也轻易倒下。
author: cobalt0135
source: Wild POKENAME often hunt in large groups. Many very large Pokémon have been easily taken down in POKENAME-infested waters.

entry: 颊边鳍赋予出色方向感，也能静静沟通。它们每天至少三次降落到泥水洼里，免得干燥。
author: infinex21
source: The fins on their cheeks give them an impressive sense of direction and a means to quietly communicate with each other. They land in puddles of water and mud at least three times a day to keep themselves from drying out.

entry: 头鳍能感知水与空气活动，让游泳或飞行中的POKENAME难被伏击。若察觉捕食者又无处遮掩，就潜水，埋进底泥。
author: .jerden
source: The fin on its head senses air and water movement, making POKENAME difficult to ambush as it swims or flies. If it detects a predator and cannot find anything to hide behind, POKENAME will try to dive underwater and bury itself in mud at the bottom.

entry: POKENAME能用背翼飞行，也能收起，用四臂游泳。单臂都不特别强，四臂一起却能举起沉重巨石。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can fly using the wings on its back or tuck them away to swim using its four arms. Although none of these are particularly strong on their own, if it uses all four, it can pick up heavy boulders.

entry: 成群的POKENAME会紧贴水面上方，织起巨大的网，捕捉跃出水面的宝可梦。只需一条鲤鱼王，就够这一群宝可梦吃上好几个星期。
author: santon5512
source: Groups of POKENAME will spin large webs just above the water's surface. These webs serve to catch any Pokémon leaping out of the water, with a single Magikarp able to feed a group of these Pokémon for weeks.

entry: POKENAME爬在湖底，用丝网捕捉鲤鱼王等猎物。耐心等待合适时机，才以网困住收获。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME crawls on the floor of lakes before capturing prey such as Magikarp in its webbing. It waits patiently for the right moment, using its web to trap its catch.

entry: 它是顶级猎手，既能在陆地与空中捕猎，独特的羽毛结构还让它能高速潜水。
author: sottiwotti
source: This Pokémon is an apex predator. It can hunt on land, in the sky, and it can dive at high speeds due to the unique composition of its feathers.

entry: POKENAME见于各种温带环境的水边，必须赶快钻泥，否则会被强风吹走。分类虽是杂草，可爱外貌与好奇性格却让它广受欢迎。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is found near bodies of water in all temperate biomes, as it is blown around by heavy winds if it does not burrow into the mud quickly. Even though categorically a weed, it is widely popular due to its cute appearance and inquisitive nature.

entry: 它跳在稻田间，花里甜蜜流进水中。关都各地都用这里的大米，制作美味果酱甜甜圈。
author: .izik
source: It hops around rice fields, letting loose a sweet nectar from its flower that flows into the water. Rice from these fields is used in the creation of delectable jelly doughnuts across Kanto.

entry: 城市街道淹水时，可见成群POKENAME游过。敏感鳍与灵鼻，帮助找出水上漂的垃圾和食物。
author: santon5512
source: When city streets flood, packs of POKENAME can be found swimming through the streets. They use their sensitive fins and keen sense of smell to locate trash and food floating in the water.

entry: 它在泥里玩，谁打扰就向谁喷水。傍晚，POKENAME的笑声回荡沼泽。
author: .izik
source: It plays in the mud and spits water at anyone who interrupts it. POKENAME's laughter echoes across its marsh during the evening hours.

entry: POKENAME见新东西，本能先轻轻咬着玩。若是威胁或食物，才加重。睡觉为安全，会沉进泥里，只露鼻孔、眼睛与鳃。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's first instinct with something new is to bite it, first lightly and playfully but then harder if the object is a threat or food. To stay safe while sleeping, it sinks into mud with only its nostrils, eyes, and gills exposed.

entry: POKENAME朝人喷水，让对方掉下手中东西，再飞下偷走。逃跑时一路洒水，让追来者滑倒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits water at people to make them drop what they're carrying before it flies down to steal it. It scatters water as it flees to make pursuers slip and fall.

entry: POKENAME背花香气诱人，用来吸引猎物，以强毒趁逃走前削弱。为等适合伏击的宝可梦，最长能守四天。
author: nyoomymph
source: The flower on POKENAME's back has an alluring aroma. POKENAME uses this to attract prey, using powerful poison to weaken its opponent before they can escape. POKENAME can spend up to four days waiting for the right Pokémon to ambush.

entry: POKENAME常见于温泉中，喜欢用身体裹住伤处，帮助伤口愈合。
author: elionagashi
source: POKENAME can be found in hot springs. They like to wrap themselves around wounds to help them heal.

entry: POKENAME在河床底部挖洞，把入口藏进铺满底部的卵石与岩块间。进出洞时，它们借外壳伪装，假扮普通石头。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME dig burrows at the bottom of river beds, hiding the entrance amongst the pebbles and rocks that line the bottom. They use their shells to disguise themselves when entering and exiting their burrow, pretending to simply be stones.

entry: POKENAME翻河泥，找蠕虫与虫子吃，胡须连最弱的食物气味也能感知。出现代表水域健康，被视为好兆头。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME dig through river mud in search of worms and bugs to feed on, their whiskers picking up even the faintest scent of food. Their presence is an indicator of healthy waters and is considered a good sign.

entry: POKENAME嘴里喷水前，颊边珊瑚枝会发光。准头足以从最远100英尺处，击中靶心。
author: .izik
source: The coral stalks that grow off POKENAME's cheeks glow before it shoots water from its mouth. Its attacks are precise enough to hit the center of a target from up to 100 feet away.

entry: POKENAME尾巴满是水，旅行时用来携带故乡池塘的小物件。始终贴身保管这些纪念品，不忘自己来自何方。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tail is filled with water that it uses to carry trinkets from its home pond as it travels. It keeps these souvenirs close as it travels, ensuring that it always has a reminder of its origins.

entry: POKENAME头鳍极敏感，察觉领地有病毒，就使出掷泥，堵住病毒代码，也堵住电脑。
author: chibitales
source: The fin on POKENAME's head is exceptionally sensitive. When it detects a virus within its territory, it launches Mud Slap attacks, clogging up the virus's code as well as the computer.

entry: POKENAME头鳍极敏感，察觉领地有病毒，就使出掷泥，堵住病毒代码，也堵住电脑。
author: chibitales
source: The fin on POKENAME's head is exceptionally sensitive. When it detects a virus within its territory, it launches Mud Slap attacks, clogging up the virus's code as well as the computer.

entry: POKENAME活力与体力出众，能以滚动清路障，也能抬走挡路石，因此常被借来帮忙。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME is used for its vitality and body strength, being able to clear roadblocks with Rollout and lifting rocks out of the way.

entry: POKENAME住在山边淹水洞穴。一察觉大雷暴，很快就会浮上水面。
author: notsaying.
source: POKENAME resides in flooded caves that are located near mountains. It is quick to come to the surface when it detects a large thunderstorm.

entry: POKENAME触手其实是覆泥藤蔓，爱用来绞缠猎物，再抛来抛去取乐。
author: seanothan_23
source: POKENAME's tentacles are actually vines covered in mud. They like to use them to constrict their prey and toss them around for fun.

entry: POKENAME头鳍能探知附近住家的网络信号。会以高压水打破窗，进去更好地吸收信号。
author: .izik
source: The fin on POKENAME's head allows it to detect internet signals within nearby homes. It will blast high-pressure water to break windows and enter in order to better absorb these signals.

entry: POKENAME敏捷无比，在睡莲叶间跳跃，逃开捕食者。头鳍感知空气湿度，能预知将至的风暴。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are incredibly agile, hopping from lilypad to lilypad to escape predators. The fins on their heads sense the humidity in the air, allowing them to predict approaching storms.

entry: 阳光照到POKENAME头鳍，手指就长出带小刺的藤蔓，用来攀爬时贴住表面。
author: .izik
source: When sunlight touches the fin on POKENAME's head, tiny thorny vines grow from its fingers. It uses these to cling to surfaces while climbing.

entry: POKENAME拼尽力气，能掀倒红树林。用倒下的树干搭粗围栏，将小鱼宝可梦困在其中，好在可控场地练捕鱼。
author: vic1312
source: Heaving with all their might, POKENAME can topple mangrove trees. They build crude corrals using the felled trunks, trapping small fish Pokémon within. This offers POKENAME a controlled place to practice fishing.

entry: 抱着POKENAME，如拿温热毛巾。全身小蓝羽，湿了便贴平。它会喷火表示不高兴。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's body feels like a warm washcloth when held. Its body is covered in small blue feathers that lie flat when wet. POKENAME will spit fire to show it is upset.

entry: POKENAME常藏在暖泥边，射出火星捕猎，再用水灭火，才把猎物吃掉。
author: markusknight
source: POKENAME is often seen hiding around warm mud. It shoots embers to hunt prey and then uses water to extinguish the flames before eating.

entry: POKENAME强到用爪一击或腿一踢，就能打碎巨石。头羽感知水与空气活动，防止被其他宝可梦伏击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME is strong enough to crush a boulder with a single blow from its claws or a kick from its legs. The feathers on POKENAME's head can sense movement in the air or water, preventing other Pokémon from ambushing it.

entry: POKENAME刚开始学武，先在沼泽家园练基本力量。举石、跋涉泥地，练出拳踢所需的肌肉与平衡。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Beginning their martial arts training, POKENAME start with basic strength exercises within their swampy homes. Lifting boulders and trekking through the mud help POKENAME build the muscles and balance they need for punching and kicking.

entry: POKENAME游泳时背着幼崽，以敏感鳍作雷达，凭水中变化察觉数英里外的危险。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME carry their young on their backs as they swim. They use their sensitive fins as radars, detecting danger from miles away by feeling shifts in the water.

entry: POKENAME极善泳，强腿推动水中前行。体外薄膜让它即使酷热，也能在陆地生存。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are excellent swimmers, using their strong legs to propel themselves through the water. Their bodies are covered in a thin film, letting them survive on land even in intense heat.

entry: POKENAME只见于大湖，懒洋洋浮在水面。很欢迎访客，谁进入湖里，就顽皮泼水。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can only be found in large lakes, lazily floating on the water's surface. It quite enjoys visitors, playfully splashing them with water if they enter its lake.

entry: POKENAME爱涉小雨洼、在池塘游泳。虽喜水，附近孩子难过时也会跟着伤心，因为共情极强。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy wading in small rain puddles and swimming in ponds. Despite this love for water, they will feel sad if children nearby feel sad, as they are highly empathetic creatures.

entry: POKENAME朝靠溪边家园太近的敌人喷水。身体一脱水，就会变成病态的深蔚蓝色。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits water at foes that venture too close to its creekside home. If its body becomes dehydrated, it turns a sickly deep cerulean color.

entry: POKENAME卷尾作配重，能举起比自身稍大的巨石。鳞色随健康改变，鲜亮便表示健康。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME coil their tails to serve as counterweights, allowing them to lift boulders slightly larger than themselves. The hue of their scales changes depending on their health; vibrant scales indicate good health.

entry: POKENAME不停朝海边家园的巨石训练，力量连最坚固的石头也能打成细沙。常给混凝土厂机修工帮忙，打碎压实的堵塞物。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME train relentlessly against boulders around their seaside homes. Their strength can turn even the sturdiest stones into fine sand. They have found utility as assistants for mechanics at concrete plants, helping break compacted clogs.

entry: 干旱时，POKENAME找最凉的地方，退入自己的页岩，再快速来回摆动，把自己埋进泥土。
author: .izik
source: During droughts, POKENAME finds the coolest spot it can and retreats into its shale. It then shifts back and forth rapidly to bury itself in the dirt.

entry: POKENAME能感知波导引起的细微气流变化。训练家心情好，感受到伙伴的热情，自己也精力充沛。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME senses the subtle changes in air currents that are caused by aura. When its Trainer is in a good mood, sensing its partner's enthusiasm fills it with energy.

entry: POKENAME温柔善良得出人意料。凭毒物知识，为病人与宝可梦研制药。战斗时，也靠同样知识削弱敌人，再以压倒性力量击败。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME is surprisingly gentle and kind. It uses its knowledge of poisons to develop medicine for sick people and Pokémon. In a fight, POKENAME uses that same knowledge to weaken its opponent before defeating them with overwhelming strength.

entry: 受威胁时，它甩头，让后脑的怪嘴乱摆。POKENAME在湖里游泳时，这额外嘴巴也方便咬住岸边猎物。
author: hophoppip
source: When threatened, it swings its head around, flailing the odd mouth attached to the back of its head. This extra mouth is also useful for chomping prey on the shoreline while POKENAME swims in a lake.

entry: POKENAME比吼鲸王小得多，用于海上导航更合适。头鳍在水面左右转动，还能从喷气孔喷水传讯。
author: bobosmith01
source: As it is much smaller than Wailord, POKENAME can be used much more reasonably in naval navigation. The fin on top of its head turns left and right above water, and it can spray water from its blowhole as a signal.

entry: 古代文化雕POKENAME泥像祈雨。人们相信，这些像能赐作物绵绵降雨。
author: .izik
source: Ancient cultures sculpted mud effigies of POKENAME to pray for rain. These figures were believed to bless crops with steady rainfall.

entry: 鳍极敏感，能察觉最远一英里下游的水纹，再用壳造出独特波纹，与同类交流。
author: catsquatch_geography
source: Its fins are so sensitive that it can detect water ripples from up to a mile downstream, using unique ripple patterns with its shell to communicate with others of its species.

entry: POKENAME背鳍很长，利于水下流畅前进。虽然有些重，水中动作却快得出奇，十分优雅。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's long back-fin helps it be more hydrodynamic underwater. Despite being somewhat heavy, it moves beneath the water with a surprising amount of speed and grace.

entry: POKENAME往返各片沼泽，不断寻找可饮清水与可洗澡的泥。背上沼水，总引来大群虫宝可梦。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME travel between swamps and marshes, constantly in search of fresh water to drink and mud to bathe in. The swamp water on its back constantly attracts swarms of bug Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME把泥团压成紧实的球，散布在家中各处。受到威胁，它随手就能抓到泥球，用火息点燃，再投掷出去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tightly packs balls of mud and scatters them all around its home. That way, when it feels threatened, it's always within easy reach of a mud-ball it can grab, set alight with fire breath, and throw.

entry: POKENAME并非最强的物种，却会奋战，保护训练家。即使困境，也努力保持微笑。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME isn't the strongest of species, but it fights to keep its Trainer from harm. POKENAME tries to keep a smile on its face, even in dire straits.

entry: POKENAME睡在湖里，头靠近水面。蓝火在水上闪烁，仿佛随月光起舞。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps in lakes with its head close to the surface. Its blue flames flicker above the water, seemingly dancing in the moonlight.

entry: POKENAME天生懒，只有自卫、悠闲与朋友玩耍，或吃饭才活动。偏爱沼地，喜欢一口塞进大块坚韧食物，再花许多小时咀嚼。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are inherently lazy, becoming active only to defend themselves, loftily play with friends, or eat. They favor marshy areas and love to eat large, tough foods in single gulps, spending many hours chewing on said food.

entry: POKENAME头鳍摸着凉，离开惯常环境后能调节体温，也似乎有助平衡。鳍受伤的个体，走路往往摇摇晃晃。
author: sk372
source: The fin on POKENAME's head is cool to the touch and helps regulate its body temperature when out of its typical element. It also seems to aid in balance, as POKENAME with fin injuries tend to wobble about while walking.

entry: POKENAME爱用鳍肢兜泥团，扔着与别人玩。可体形和力量太大，可能无意用大泥球压扁小生物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME loves to play with others by scooping up clumps of mud on its flippers and throwing them. Due to its size and strength, it may inadvertently crush smaller creatures with the large spheres of muck.

entry: POKENAME找到深泥坑后，会站进去，慢慢沉下，让全身浸入泥中。岩石般的外皮，若太久没有好好覆上一层泥垢，它就会焦躁不安。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME finds deep mud holes to stand upon and sink into, submerging its body in mud. It gets antsy if it goes too long without a nice coating of mud and grime over its rocky complexion.

entry: POKENAME嵌进泥岸，挖出大块地面带走。传闻它想一片岸接一片岸，将陆地淹没，可没有证据支持这说法。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME lodge themselves into muddy shores before scooping out large chunks of the ground to carry away with them. Rumors claim that they are working to flood the land one shore at a time, but there is no evidence that these theories hold water.

entry: POKENAME看见沙漠里脱水的旅人，就热心喷水。可水柱太强，甚至能打断骨头。
author: .izik
source: When it spots a dehydrated traveler in the desert, POKENAME eagerly sprays them with water. Unfortunately, its jets are so strong they can break bones.

entry: 尾巴强劲，只须一点借力，就能举起巨石。野生POKENAME会在高处水域附近筑巢。
author: infinex21
source: Their tails are strong enough to lift large boulders with minimal leverage. Wild POKENAME will make their nests near bodies of water at great heights.

entry: POKENAME以触须沟通，也测试土壤泥巴的湿度。皮毛常被泥与晨露润湿，帮助整天保持水分。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their feelers to communicate and to test the moisture of soil and mud. Their fur is often damp from mud and fresh dew, which helps keep them from drying out throughout the day.

entry: 捕食者靠近，POKENAME就迅速钻进最近泥地藏身。危险一过，再快速振翼甩泥，便能重新自在飞行。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME dives quickly into the nearest mud source to hide itself when predators are near. Once the coast is clear, it uses the rapid movement of its wings to fling the mud off and allow it to fly freely once more.

entry: POKENAME从垃圾场收集废弃毛绒玩具，以水浸湿，标记为私有。带回巢里，成为珍爱收藏。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects abandoned plush toys from junkyards, soaking them with water to mark them as its own. It takes them back to its den, where they serve as its cherished collection.

entry: POKENAME尾巴长出七片鳍，帮助高速游泳。战斗时，能朝对手喷出集中而滚烫的蒸汽。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have seven fins sprouting from their tail that help them swim through the water at high speed. During battles, they can spray a concentrated blast of scalding steam at their opponents.

entry: POKENAME住在池底，谁靠太近，就使出水之波动。水流掀起层层涟漪，赶走领地里的闯入者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lives on pond bottoms and uses Water Pulse if someone gets too close. The burst of water will create a series of ripples to repel any intruders in its territory.

entry: 它住在沼泽、河床附近幽暗湿泥中，既会游泳，也善挖洞，因此洞穴淹水，它也不在乎。
author: staghorn
source: It lives in dark, muddy soil in swamps and around riverbeds. It's adept at both swimming and digging, so it doesn't mind when its burrows get flooded.

entry: 野生敌对POKENAME会在开战前裹泥。人们推测，这能部分遮掩气息，让对方更难预判下一招。
author: sk372
source: Rival POKENAME in the wild have been seen covering themselves with mud before initiating combat. It is theorized this is to partially mask their aura and make it more difficult for their foe to anticipate their next moves.

entry: POKENAME总在新鲜泥里睡觉休息，保持水分。力量虽能举石，却拿来摇树落果。吃完一餐，又回去睡。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME always sleep or rest within fresh mud so that they remain hydrated. Though they are strong enough to lift boulders, they use their strength to shake loose fruits from trees. Once they finish a meal, they go back to sleep.

entry: POKENAME用强壮的前肢，在泥泞的河岸挖洞，在安全的巢中养育幼崽。它们很容易烦躁，哪怕只是好奇地往洞里瞥一眼，也会惹得它们勃然大怒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their powerful forelimbs to dig burrows into the muddy banks of rivers, raising their young in the safety of their nests. They are quick to grow agitated as even passing a curious glance into their burrow provokes them into a rage.

entry: POKENAME看见渔船就暴怒，跃出浪头，向船上每个人喷泥水。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME spots a fishing vessel, it grows enraged. It leaps from the waves to spray muddy water on anyone on board.

entry: 谁靠池边巢太近，POKENAME就先泼湿对方，再接放电，将其击败。
author: .izik
source: When someone draws too close to its pondside nest, POKENAME douses them in water. Once they are soaked, it follows up with Discharge to finish them off.

entry: POKENAME背鳍能切开岩石。为维持护甲，会打碎富铁石头，小到够吃才吞下。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's back fin is able to cut through rock. To maintain its armor, it breaks rocks that are rich with iron until they're small enough to eat.

entry: 它以后腿扎稳地面，聚足力量举起巨石。以身后鳍逆强流游动，仿佛在锻炼。
author: infinex21
source: By planting its hind legs into the ground, it can amass enough of its strength to lift large boulders. It uses its hind fin to swim against strong currents, as though training its body.

entry: POKENAME头顶较大的鳍，帮助水下推进，也能感知水中活动，防范捕食者。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME's larger fin on the top of its head helps it propel it through the water. It can also sense movements in the water, keeping it safe from predators.

entry: POKENAME体力强、爱玩，深受训练家喜爱。舵状尾巴上的火，水下也会燃烧，帮助在地底水域与深水中辨路。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME's physical strength and playful nature make it extremely popular among Trainers. The flame on its rudder-like tail burns even underwater and is used to navigate in underground waters or deep below the surface.

entry: POKENAME对水质极敏感，只找最干净的池塘游泳。向空中喷水时，便像天然洒水器。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are incredibly sensitive to water quality, seeking out only the cleanest ponds to swim in. By spraying water in the air, they act as natural sprinklers.

entry: POKENAME向靠草甸太近的虫属性宝可梦射细水流，不让吃附近植物，可有时也妨碍传粉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME shoots extremely thin streams of water at Bug-type Pokémon that venture too close to its meadow. This discourages them from eating nearby flora but can sometimes interfere with pollination.

entry: POKENAME满身是水，却仍能飞。这么密实的身体如何留空，至今仍是困扰科学家的谜。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME can fly despite being completely filled with water. How it manages to stay airborne with such a dense body remains a mystery that continues to baffle scientists.

entry: POKENAME毒孢子能杀死珊瑚，威胁珊瑚礁。不过通常不太移动，因此死珊瑚枝的范围往往不大。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are threats to coral reefs since their poisonous spores are deadly to the coral. However, areas with dead coral branches are often small since they don't typically move around a lot.

entry: POKENAME夜里飘过废屋，寻找烛光灵。一找到，就喷水灭火，安心享用剩下的蜡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME float around abandoned homes at night in search of Litwick. If they find one, they will douse its fire with sprays of water in order to safely feast on the remaining wax.

entry: 体外黏膜闻着像沼泽。它睡觉时悬在水源上，散出让附近生灵快乐的精神气息。
author: .izik
source: The slimy film on its body smells like a bog. It hovers over water sources while it sleeps, letting loose a psychic aura that makes those nearby feel happy.

entry: 它游在浅水，把敏感的鳍留在水上，察觉上方捕食者。游客远远看见，便把POKENAME误当巨牙鲨。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It swims in shallow water, keeping its sensitive fin above water to sense predators overhead.  This behavior makes tourists think POKENAME is a Sharpedo from far away.

entry: POKENAME完全失明，靠头鳍辨路。平时移动不成问题，却常会一头扎进水里或泥地。
author: quantumradiation
source: POKENAME is entirely blind, relying on the fin atop its head for navigation. It usually moves about without issue but has a tendency to dive headfirst into water or patches of mud.

entry: POKENAME最初发现于丰缘近海的沉没遗迹，常聚在被大海淹没的失落古城。它们是在古城兴盛时就已效力，还是毁灭后才到来，研究者仍争论不休。
author: katieplaysgames
source: First found in sunken ruins off the Hoenn coast, POKENAME congregate in long-lost cities drowned by the ocean. Researchers debate if they served in these cities during their prime or arrived after their destruction.

entry: POKENAME极护巢。阿柏蛇等捕食者靠太近，就与同群协力，喷出大量冷水。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is highly protective of its nest. Should a predator like Ekans draw too close, they unleash torrents of cold water on them with aid from their flock.

entry: POKENAME以洞穴水道为家，找到宝石，就藏进浑水下的巢。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its home in waterways within caves. When it finds gems, it hides them in its den located beneath the murky water.

entry: POKENAME战时产生的深蓝水，含有强酸性染料。泼在敌人周围，拖慢前进，将其挡在远处。
author: .izik
source: The deep blue water POKENAME produces during battle is filled with a strong acidic dye. It splashes this around the foe to slow their advance and keep them at bay.

entry: POKENAME喜欢泥泞沼泽，轻松穿行污泥。小宝可梦若不想弄脏或陷住，它就载着渡过。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys living in muddy, swampy areas, easily able to traipse through the gunk with no problem. It ferries smaller Pokémon across the mud when they want to avoid getting dirty or stuck.

entry: 跳舞时，羽毛里的感知纤维检测风速与湿度，帮助找到最近水源。
author: hophoppip
source: When it dances, sensory fibers in its feathers detect the wind speed and humidity of the air, helping it locate the nearest water source.

entry: POKENAME吃林地腐烂水果与植物。若见同类靠近餐点，就喷出阵阵水，赶走对方。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME eats rotten fruit and vegetation from the forest floor. Should it spot another of its kind drawing close to its meal, it spits bursts of water to drive them away.

entry: POKENAME使用高速移动，积起足够速度，轻松攀瀑。找到新水源定居后，就攻击其他同类，占为己有，彰显地位。
author: .izik
source: Using Agility, POKENAME can build enough speed to climb waterfalls with ease. Once it finds a new water source to inhabit, it attacks any others of its kind to claim it and assert dominance.

entry: POKENAME身上有泥，通常就友善。没了泥层，却会烦躁好斗，攻击靠近的一切。
author: sk372
source: So long as POKENAME has mud on its body, it generally behaves in a friendly manner. Without mud coating it, it becomes agitated and aggressive, lashing out at anything near it.

entry: POKENAME住在湿透树桩里遮蔽。雨天会在桩外起舞，吸取雨水，享受潮湿。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lives in soggy tree stumps, using them for shelter. During rainy days, it will dance outside its stump, absorbing the water and enjoying the damp environment.

entry: POKENAME让看见它的人心生恐惧，可它其实只想在夜里引人走出沼泽。
author: elionagashi
source: POKENAME strikes fear in the heart of those who see them, even though they only want to help them find a way out of swamps at night.

entry: POKENAME以高频哭嚎操控附近水流。水甚至能违抗重力，悬在身体近处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME manipulates nearby water flow by releasing high-pitched wails. These waters can even defy gravity, levitating close to its body.

entry: POKENAME大多逆流游泳，因此小身体也肌肉发达。陆地行走时，力量足以碎石倒树。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of its time swimming upriver, and so its small body is surprisingly muscular. When it walks around on land, it is strong enough to shatter boulders and topple trees.

entry: POKENAME待在沼泽，隐没泥中。游泳前，会尽可能多喝水，让身体能够浮起。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hangs around swampy areas, hiding amongst the mud. It will swallow as much water as it can to allow it to float while swimming.

entry: 训练家若不让POKENAME定期用河水清洗，就容易染上真菌。它友好，喜欢被打理，也会顽皮向训练家泼水，试着回报。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME kept by Trainers are prone to fungal infections if not allowed to periodically wash themselves with river water. They are friendly Pokémon and enjoy being groomed, attempting to return the favour and splashing at their Trainers playfully.

entry: POKENAME沿水岸游荡，直到找到足够大的树，就放孢子召同类。聚够后合力拔树，大吃富营养的根。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME wander along shorelines until they locate a sufficiently large tree. Upon locating one, they emit spores that signal to other POKENAME to gather. Once a number of them have massed, they uproot the tree, feasting on the nutritious roots.

entry: POKENAME钻进泥里，只露头鳍。感到空气细微波动，就知有东西接近，再埋深些藏好。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME burrows into the mud with only its head fin above ground. Detecting small fluctuations in the air lets it know when something approaches, so it can bury itself further and hide.

entry: 不沾水的皮毛覆着毒物，一碰POKENAME就会释放。大眼虽惹人怜，实际却增强夜视，让捕猎更致命。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its water-repellent fur is coated with toxic substances that are released upon contact with POKENAME. Although its large eyes evoke tenderness, they actually serve to improve its night vision and increase its lethality while hunting.

entry: POKENAME向靠巢太近的敌人吐泥团。没打中的泥，往往让附近植物长得更坚韧。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits globs of mud at foes who venture too close to its den. Any mud that misses tends to cause nearby plant life to grow much more resiliently.

entry: POKENAME较少动武，主要靠骇人外观，吓退想欺负受保护水跃鱼的来者。但若真被迫战斗，力量也绝不能小看。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is relatively nonviolent, relying mostly on its intimidating appearance to scare off those who would pick on the Mudkip it protects. However, if forced to actually fight, its strength is not to be trifled with.

entry: POKENAME的魔杖由泥制成，再以火焰能力烘干烧硬。用来施小法术，多是控水控土，造泥洼玩水。
author: sk372
source: The wand POKENAME carries is made of mud, dried and hardened by its flame abilities. It casts minor spells with it, usually in the form of manipulating water and ground to make mud puddles to splash in.

entry: POKENAME的魔杖能操控最远30英尺的泥，将湿度增加到刚好难行，阻碍敌人。甚至能让地泥如鞭抽起，伤害敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wand can control mud from up to 30 feet away, increasing its moisture just enough to create difficult terrain for enemies. It can even lash the mud from the ground like a whip to injure foes.

entry: POKENAME头鳍对大气细变极敏感。战斗中爱凭速度取胜，可被逼入绝境，也能爆出惊人力量。
author: torterrable
source: The fin on POKENAME's head is sensitive to small changes in the atmosphere. It prefers to use its swiftness in battle, but if cornered, it can unleash incredible strength.

entry: POKENAME颈舌能感知环境最微小的变化，预警将至天灾。一察觉，就迅速通知附近宝可梦逃走。
author: dodoowner_
source: The tongue on POKENAME's neck can sense even the slightest change in the environment, warning it if a natural disaster is imminent. Upon detecting one, POKENAME swiftly warns neighboring Pokémon to flee.

entry: POKENAME在海底极缓慢地移动，将水滤进壳里维生。水被体热加热后排出，形成沸腾泡云，抵御各种危险。
author: mjxpimouss
source: POKENAME lives by moving very slowly on the ocean floor, filtering water into its shell. The filtered water is heated by POKENAME's body heat and then expelled back, forming a cloud of boiling bubbles that act as a protection against various dangers.

entry: POKENAME沿水岸行走，下半身散出橙光，与同类沟通。据说光能引迷失灵魂回岸，尤其能为同类聚会作灯塔。
author: .izik
