source: While walking around the shoreline, POKENAME's lower half releases an orange glow to communicate with others of its kind. The light is said to help guide lost spirits back to shore, most notably demonstrated by being a beacon for POKENAME gatherings.

entry: POKENAME在空葫芦里存着大量泥，战斗时吐向对手。身体大多由水构成，轻松浮在水面。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME stores large amounts of mud in its hollow gourd, which it spits at its opponent in combat. Its body is mostly made of water, allowing it to effortlessly float atop the water.

entry: POKENAME潜在水下时，用叶垫上的头鳍感知周围变化。睡在水边土下。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME uses the head fin atop its pad to sense changes in its surroundings while its body is submerged in water. It sleeps under the soil at the water's edge.

entry: POKENAME通常爱玩，见同类却变得好斗。双方立刻找最近泥坑，狠狠干一架，分出高下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a generally fun-loving disposition, but turns aggressive in the presence of another of its species. The two will immediately search for the nearest mudhole to duke it out and establish dominance.

entry: 浅溪岸边，布着POKENAME的地洞。它挖出深坑，排走漫溢的水，也让洪灾不易发生。
author: ozydamians
source: The shores of shallow streams are spotted with the burrows of POKENAME. It prevents floods by digging deep holes to drain the overflowing water.

entry: POKENAME用扁身开心地在水洼间扑腾，直到找到池塘游泳。路上没了水洼，就用水枪自己造。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME happily flops with its flat body between puddles before finding a pond to swim in. Should it run out of puddles while traveling, it creates its own with Water Gun.

entry: 它住在无污染的溪床。三颗头合力，POKENAME便能举起数倍于自身体形的巨石。
author: cait_sith
source: It lives in the beds of unpolluted streams. When all three heads work together, POKENAME can lift boulders several times its size.

entry: 泥覆头部，似乎能舒缓POKENAME头痛。因此总弄得浑身泥，主动抗拒洗澡，让训练家十分头疼。
author: sk372
source: Mud coating the cranium seems to soothe POKENAME's headache issues out, so it keeps itself muddy and actively resists being bathed, causing much chagrin to its Trainers.

entry: POKENAME生气便充满能量，克制时鳍不断发抖。持续烦躁动作让它随时能游动，能量爆发便推动水中疾行。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME become filled with energy when they grow angry, their fins constantly trembling as they restrain themselves. The constant agitated movements keep them ready to swim at a moment's notice, bursts of energy propelling them through the water.

entry: POKENAME在沼泽游泳，找藻类吃。腹部涡纹的深浅，会随饱腹程度改变。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swims in swamps and marshes to find algae to consume. The spiral on its stomach grows darker or lighter depending on how full it is.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，从嘴向对手发射浓厚泥团。不在水下时，便用根吸水，让身体保持湿润。
author: mistymagius
source: In combat, POKENAME will fire globs of thick mud from its mouth at its opponents. It absorbs water through its roots to keep its body moist while not underwater.

entry: POKENAME能放柔雾、缓流或小水柱。控水本领让它成为爱护植物的园丁的好朋友，帮忙浇水，换些点心。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has the ability to release a soft mist, a gentle stream, or small jets of water. This control over water makes it a great friend of gardeners, who treat plants with tenderness and care. It helps water plants in exchange for treats.

entry: 每条触手都能举石。POKENAME陷入战斗，就抓岩石、枯木与任何漂浮物，挥砸、掷向对手。
author: lampent12
source: Each of their tentacles are capable of lifting a boulder. When POKENAME is caught in a fight, they will grab rocks, dead wood, and any kind of flotsam available to swing and throw at their adversary.

entry: POKENAME疾奔时，能在水面短距离前进，受威胁便可迅速渡河。
author: mjxpimouss
source: When POKENAME gallops, it can travel short distances on the surface of the water. This allows it to quickly cross rivers when it feels threatened.

entry: POKENAME快得能轻松跑过水面。想捉它，就得循着沿途留下的蒸汽轨迹。
author: mjxpimouss
source: POKENAME is so fast that it can run across the surface of the water with ease. To catch it, you have to follow the vapor trail it leaves in its path.

entry: POKENAME生活在河岸，覆泥保持皮肤湿润。尾上鳍能助游泳，不过游得不快。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live near riverbanks, covering themselves in mud to keep their skin moist. Their finned tail helps them swim, even though they can't swim very fast.

entry: POKENAME头鳍如雷达，帮助感知周围。身体缩壳，尾如螺旋桨转动，就能在水中高速移动。
author: santon5512
source: The fins on POKENAME's heads act like radars, helping them sense their surroundings. By tucking their bodies into their shells and spinning their tails like propellers, they can move through the water at high speeds.

entry: POKENAME身体由胶般黏液构成，水里也黏。能贴住表面、困住猎物，因此是优秀的水中猎手。
author: .izik
source: The glue-like slime that POKENAME's body is made of is sticky even in water. This odd substance helps it cling to surfaces and entrap prey, making it an excellent hunter in aquatic environments.

entry: POKENAME能用鳍感知危险，因此常被消防员饲养。背炮喷水如消防水管般有力，轻松扑灭烈火。
author: santon5512
source: Due to their ability to sense danger using their fins, POKENAME are often kept by firefighters. The cannons on their back can shoot water with the power of a fire hose, able to easily extinguish raging fires.

entry: POKENAME藏在泥地，等旅人经过，再到背后显形。用舌抓起大团泥，砸向毫无戒心的受害者，给个脏兮兮的惊喜。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides away in muddy areas until travelers pass by. It then materializes behind them and uses its tongue to grab a huge glob of mud and pelt the unsuspecting victims with a filthy surprise.

entry: 传说，POKENAME会用鼻子吹出催眠泡泡，让目标沉睡。之后如何，却始终是谜，因为中招者，再也没有出现。
author: rakunk
source: Legends say POKENAME uses its trunk to blow hypnotic bubbles that lull its targets into a deep sleep. What happens afterward remains a mystery, as no one who has fallen victim to its spell has ever been seen again.

entry: POKENAME皮肤剧毒。背上种子不断凝聚最强毒性，越来越猛烈。最年长个体，毒液一碰便能击倒成年卡比兽。
author: nyoomymph
source: A POKENAME's skin is highly toxic. The seed on its back is constantly concentrating the strongest poison it can, growing more potent over time. The oldest POKENAME can take down an adult Snorlax with a touch of its poison.

entry: POKENAME常与其他格斗属性宝可梦长时间切磋。事前给手臂裹层层泥，拳套装满水，额外练力量。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME often have long sparring sessions with other Fighting-type Pokémon. In preparation, POKENAME coat their arms with layers of mud and fill their gloves with water for extra strength training.

entry: POKENAME天性爱玩，在沼泽泼水，造小旋涡。用来躲险，或在热天降温。
author: sanserof
source: Playful by nature, POKENAME splashes through swamps creating tiny whirlpools, which it uses to hide from danger or cool off on hot days.

entry: POKENAME把大量泥压成规整立方，拼起泥堡，作为泥坑家园的第一道防线。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME packs large amounts of mud into perfectly-shaped cubes. It puts these cubes together to build itself a fort made of mud, as the first line of defense protecting its mud-hole home.

entry: POKENAME在泥土里打滚，清掉寄生虫。即使严重受伤，翅膀也能轻松再生，恢复完好。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME roll around in dirt or mud to free their body from parasites. Even if severely injured, their wings easily regrow back to perfect condition.

entry: POKENAME藏在红树林，长尾悠闲摇动，游过浑水。爱顽皮地悬起水球，丢向不知所措的旁观者，再迅速消失。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hide within mangroves, swimming through the muddy waters with languid swishes of their long tail. They are playful Pokémon and enjoy levitating balls of water, throwing them at confused onlookers before darting out of sight.

entry: 近来，欧雷地区一处绿洲发现了POKENAME。双颚咬力足以碾碎一切挡路物。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME have recently been discovered on an oasis in the Orre region. Their jaws have the bite force to crush anything in their path.

entry: POKENAME成群在沼泽泥地戏水。泥留在身上，直到满月之夜，才把月下沐浴视作特殊仪式。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gather in groups to splash about in swamps and muddy areas. They keep the mud on their body until the night of the full moon, treating bathing beneath the moonlight as a type of special ritual.

entry: POKENAME一生大多潜在水下，只露头顶圆叶。若叶片被抓，就会烦躁。
author: kittyluv090
source: POKENAME spends most of its life underwater, with only the circular leaf on its head sticking out above the surface. It becomes agitated if the leaf is grabbed.

entry: POKENAME陆上不稳，走路展开尾巴保平衡。水中却十分爱玩，常聚在一起喷水，造出壮观水景。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Quite unstable on land, POKENAME flare their tail when walking to keep their balance. In the water they are very playful, and many of them gather together to squirt water and create very impressive aqua displays.

entry: POKENAME大多时候懒懒地躺在阳光下，等待自己的花盛开。受到打扰时，它会放出毒云，赶走袭击者；若再遭挑衅，便用强健的体魄，压倒对手。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME spends most of its time lounging in the sun, waiting for its flower to bloom. If disturbed, it will release a cloud of poison to ward off attackers. When further provoked, POKENAME uses its physical strength to overwhelm its opponent.

entry: POKENAME沿河湖底觅食，吃水里沉下的碎屑。平常动作慢，快速拍尾鳍时，也能突然高速前进。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feed along the bottom of lakes and rivers, eating detritus that has fallen out of the water. They are generally slow moving, but are capable of bursts of speed by rapidly fluttering their tail fins.

entry: POKENAME有独特的高频叫声。多数人觉得可爱，其实那是它暴怒时响亮的战吼。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is known for a distinctive high-pitched call. Though it sounds adorable to most, it is the sonorous war cry of a very angry POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME锻炼前，先给全身厚裹泥。污泥限制行动，必须更用力才能练好，因此强化肌肉更有效。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's training regimen involves coating its body heavily with mud before exercising. The gunk restricts its movement, so it has to work harder to train properly, making it more effective at strengthening its muscles.

entry: POKENAME用强腿向对手踢泥，遮住视线。背鳍游泳时拍动，让它在泥里敏捷得出奇。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their strong legs to kick mud at their opponents, blinding them. The fins on their back flap was they swim, making them surprisingly agile in the mud.

entry: 谁靠它的树太近，POKENAME就从枝条射出高压水柱，其中满是小种子。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME shoots high-powered jets of water from branches at anyone who gets too close to its tree. These jets are filled with tiny seeds.

entry: POKENAME臂上长的海带，战时硬化成刀刃，锋利到能轻松切开石膏板。
author: .izik
source: The kelp growing from POKENAME's arms hardens into blades during combat. These blades are sharp enough to cut through sheet rock with ease.

entry: 稳腿让它不易跌倒，泼泥玩水因此成了乐趣。睡觉时，POKENAME会把半身埋进巢里的泥。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Its steady legs prevent it from falling, making splashing mud and water a fun source of entertainment. When it sleeps, POKENAME will partially bury itself in the mud of its nest.

entry: POKENAME正成长为踢拳高手，每天练技。稳固站姿与强腿肌，让它在战斗中十分出色。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is a developing master of kickboxing and practices every day to refine its prowess. Its sturdy footing combined with its forceful leg muscles allow it to excel in combat.

entry: 持续练武，让POKENAME拳法腿法都出众。还能从手腕喷水，向前推动拳头，增加力道。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's continued training in martial arts has enabled it to excel in the art of both kicking and punching. POKENAME can propel its fists forward for additional power using water jets from its wrists.

entry: POKENAME藏泥躲捕食者，靠鳃呼吸。鳍能从远处察觉危险，留足逃跑时间。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME hide out in the mud from predators, using their gills to breathe. Their fins let them sense danger from afar, giving them ample time to flee.

entry: POKENAME一次能潜泥数日，快速游过其中。头鳍极敏感，无须用眼，也能感知周围。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME can remain submerged in mud for days at a time, swimming through it at high speeds. The fins on their heads are extremely sensitive, allowing them to sense their surroundings without needing their eyes.

entry: 热天，POKENAME待在泥池晒太阳，借泥调温。放松时，鳍仍能察觉危险，因此睡得安心。
author: santon5512
source: On hot days, POKENAME will bask in pools of mud, using it to regulate their temperature. Their fins let them sense danger while they relax, letting them sleep peacefully.

entry: POKENAME对训练家心情敏感，几乎愿做任何事，让对方开心。虽然爱玩泥，却怕添麻烦，很少真的去玩。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are sensitive to how their Trainer feels and will do almost anything to make them happy. They enjoy playing in the mud but rarely do so because they do not want to be an inconvenience to their Trainer.

entry: POKENAME脚步轻，能在泥上跳舞不脏身。会兼顾自己与训练家的需要，让大家都开心。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are light on their feet and can dance on mud without getting dirty. They balance their needs with the needs of their Trainer to ensure everyone is happy.

entry: POKENAME动作优雅，踏过泥沙也不弄脏。忠诚非凡，喜欢陪训练家跳舞。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are graceful creatures that can walk atop mud or sand without making themselves dirty. They enjoy dancing with their Trainer, as they are superbly loyal creatures.

entry: 这只两栖宝可梦卧在厚湿泥里保湿，等候猎物。舌头有弹性又黏，一次能抓住好几只小型虫宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: This amphibious Pokémon lies in thick, damp mud to stay moisturized while lying in wait for prey. Its tongue is stretchy and sticky, so it can catch multiple small bug Pokémon in a single go.

entry: 花已长成，POKENAME不再久坐晒太阳。改为守护出生地的生态，保护弱小宝可梦。
author: nyoomymph
source: With its flower fully grown, POKENAME no longer spends so much time sitting in the sun. Instead, it protects the ecosystem it was born in, keeping weaker Pokémon safe.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间都躺在泥里，让身体保持湿润。背上长着形似鳍的巨口，它们躺着时便会张开，困住任何踩上去的猎物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME tend to lie in mud most of the time to keep themselves hydrated. Upon their backs are maws that resemble fins, which they will open up while lying in mud so as to trap any prey that steps upon them.

entry: POKENAME大口吃泥与土，取得养分。自卫时，向对手喷出巨大污水泡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's diet consists of large bites of mud and soil for nutrients. For self-defense, it spits out huge bubbles of dirty water at opponents.

entry: POKENAME背上长着数株芦苇，在泥质壳里茁壮。休息于深沼，背部能提供一定伪装。
author: sk372
source: Several reeds grow upon POKENAME's back, thriving in the mud-like composition of its shell. It rests itself in deep swamps where its back provides it with a decent modicum of camouflage.

entry: POKENAME照看沼泽遇到的水跃鱼。夜里常见许多睡在壳上或周围。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME watches over Mudkip it finds in marshlands. Many can frequently be seen sleeping on or around its shell at night.

entry: POKENAME会攀红树，或借露出的根跳过沼泽。路过训练家偶尔会遭它恶作剧，被扔来泥球。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME can be found climbing mangrove trees or jumping across marshes using the exposed mangrove roots. Trainers passing through these areas occasionally fall victim to the shenanigans of these Pokémon and have balls of mud thrown at them.

entry: POKENAME躺在泥洼，冷却滚烫身体。若被烦扰，就抓泥加热，烧成干硬沉块，掷向闯入者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lounges in mud puddles to cool down its burning-hot body. If bothered, it grabs clumps of mud and heats them into dry and solid heavy chunks for it to lob at the intruders.

entry: POKENAME爱在泥洼扑腾，身上连一点泥也没有，就浑身不自在。训练家想洗净它，还会挨上泥泡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys splashing about in mud puddles, feeling out of sorts if it doesn't have at least a little mud on its body. It will spit muddy bubbles at its Trainer if it tries to clean it up.

entry: POKENAME快速扇翼，甩出泥水，试图遮住靠沼泽家园太近者的视线。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME splashes muddy water from its wings by flapping them rapidly. It attempts to blind those who venture too close to its marsh home.

entry: POKENAME用长缎带兜起泥团，缓冲来袭的攻击。对手困在泥里时，它们便迅速向前弹出，用宽阔的鳍面，狠狠拍击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their long ribbons to scoop up clumps of mud that they use to cushion the blow of incoming attacks. While their opponent is caught in the mud, they rapidly flick forward to deliver a sharp smack with the broad side of their fins.

entry: POKENAME多在沼泽与泥塘掘穴，需要充足湿气才能旺盛生存。会挑战同类，决斗到一方角折断才停。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME tends to den within swamps and muddy ponds, since it needs plenty of moisture to thrive. It challenges other POKENAME to duels that continue until one contender's horn finally breaks.

entry: POKENAME常半身浸泥，抵挡日晒。在泥下振翼搅动，能造强大下吸力，把里面任何对象沉下去。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are often found partially submerged in pools of mud, which protect them from the sun. By flapping their wings beneath the mud to churn it, they can create a powerful downward suction to sink anyone inside.

entry: 它喷水软化巢边地面，造出泥。想洗去干泥或余泥，就飞去掠过瀑布，或等待雨水。
author: infinex21
source: It will loose jets of water to soften the ground around its nest into mud. To clean itself of any dried or excess mud, it will fly and pass against waterfalls or wait for rain.

entry: 它靠泥浴保持皮肤光滑明亮，头上的触须能辨识泥浆的种类与状态。
author: soup1900
source: It keeps its skin smooth and shiny by bathing itself in mud. The feelers on its head are used to tell both the type and condition of the mud.

entry: POKENAME强烈感受他人情绪，以泥覆身，压低气息，减轻焦虑。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME feels the emotions of others very intensely. It coats itself in mud to dampen its aura, which reduces its anxiety.

entry: POKENAME必须裹着泥，皮肤才不至干燥，因此毛总是脏的。它用后爪产生的电力，与其他同类交流。
author: st4rdustyugure
source: POKENAME needs to be covered in mud for its skin not to dry out, but because of that, its fur is always dirty. It uses the electricity produced by its back claws to communicate with other POKENAME.

entry: 野生POKENAME在通往瀑布的泥泞河岸筑巢，逐渐往瀑布方向迁移。看来从巢的位置，便能判断已逆流游了多远。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME nest along muddy banks of rivers that lead to waterfalls and progressively move their nests closer to these waterfalls. Apparently, the location of their nests determines how far upstream they have managed to swim.

entry: POKENAME每天滚上新泥，防止干燥。坐在瀑布下洗旧干泥，也能帮助硬壳加固。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME will roll themselves in fresh mud daily to keep themselves from drying out. They will clean off dried mud by sitting under waterfalls, which also helps to harden their shells.

entry: POKENAME爱雨，常一起在水洼玩。坐进泥里，就能吸取养分与水。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME love the rain, often splashing in puddles together. By sitting in the mud, they can absorb nutrients and water from it.

entry: POKENAME善用对泥的喜爱，给囤食的晶体覆上污泥。宝石没了亮面，其他宝可梦就更难发现。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME uses its affinity for mud to its advantage, covering its crystal food hoard in muck. Without their gleaming surface, these gemstones are much harder for other Pokémon to find.

entry: POKENAME头褶能感知周围水温细变，轻松追踪猎物，再使冰冻牙出击。
author: .izik
source: The frills on POKENAME's head can detect subtle temperature changes in the water around it. Using this ability, it can easily track down prey before striking with Ice Fang.

entry: POKENAME常游荡靠泥岸的海域，把少许泥抹在身上伤疤，似乎能舒缓伤痛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can be seen roaming about ocean areas closer to muddy coastlines. It applies bits of mud to the scars on its body, which seems to soothe any aching wounds.

entry: POKENAME多住在沼泽泥地多的森林。会出现在路过孩子面前，想邀他们一起玩泥。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tends to inhabit forests that have a lot of swamps or muddy areas. It appears towards children wandering through and tries to get them to play in the mud with them.

entry: POKENAME放出的水，冷到几乎碰什么都冻住。若在一处久留，就会以所在地为中心，形成巨大暴风雪。
author: .izik
source: The water POKENAME releases is cold enough to freeze nearly anything it contacts. Should it remain in one area too long, massive blizzards will form centered on its location.

entry: POKENAME在陆上常以后腿直立，前腿乱挥。看着虽滑稽，肢体却在急水中练得强健，碰到谁都能掀飞。
author: .jerden
source: When on land, POKENAME frequently stands up on its hind legs and flails around with its front legs. While this looks comical, these limbs are strengthened by swimming through rough waters and will knock anyone they make contact with flying.

entry: POKENAME把孢子掺进泥，让影响遍布沼泽。菌丝长出的根将植物相连，也让它察觉附近猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME laces its spores within mud to spread its influence throughout swamps. Plants linked by roots grown from this mycelium allow it to sense nearby prey.

entry: POKENAME爱把脸压进泥，留下凹痕。有趣的是，受压之处植物往往长得更快。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME presses its face into mud for fun, leaving indentations behind. Interestingly, plants tend to grow faster in these pressed areas.

entry: POKENAME挥动细枝，就能造水箭射敌。即使最远150英尺，准头仍极精准。
author: .izik
source: By waving its twig, POKENAME can craft arrows of water to fire at foes. Its aim remains extremely accurate from up to 150 feet away.

entry: POKENAME收集海泡，混合自身黏液，造出黏稠物。在海崖画下晦涩符号，下次潮水就冲掉，目的仍不明。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME gather sea foam and mix it with the mucus they secrete, creating a slime-like substance. They use this substance to draw esoteric symbols on seaside cliffs, which get washed away in the next tide. The purpose of this behavior is unknown.

entry: POKENAME稳腿让它在天然泥地栖地奔跑不失衡。一跃可超过100英尺，总能精准落在想去的位置。
author: torterrable
source: POKENAME's sturdy legs help it stay balanced while running through its natural muddy habitat. It can travel over 100 feet in a single leap and always lands exactly where it wants to.

entry: 雨天常见它与孩子玩，想把大人弄得满身泥。头顶睡莲叶储着余水，无论天气如何，都能继续玩泥。
author: notadoctor75
source: It can often be seen playing with children on rainy days, trying to get adults absolutely covered in mud. It stores extra water in the lily pad on its head so it can continue playing in mud no matter the weather.

entry: POKENAME感到有人恋爱，头鳍便亮成鲜粉红。此时水属性攻击也会带上同样粉色。
author: .izik
source: The fin on POKENAME's head glows bright pink when it senses someone in love. During this period, its Water-type attacks take on the same pink hue.

entry: POKENAME不过分好斗，却讨厌玩沼水被打断。会以高超念力举起闯入者，抛出领地。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is not overly violent, but does not take kindly to being interrupted while playing in the swamp water. It uses advanced telekinesis to lift up the intruder and fling them out of its domain.

entry: 皮肤虽软，力量却惊人，轻松破开巨石。它住在草原，无论何种情况都勇敢挺身，连暴雨也一样。
author: bobosmith01
source: While its skin is soft, it has tremendous power that easily allows it to break boulders. It lives on the prairie and bravely asserts itself in any kind of condition, even during heavy precipitation.

entry: POKENAME朝地喷水，造泥池玩。若受袭，就甩尾泼泥，遮住敌人视线，再逃走。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME spray water at the ground to create pools of mud to play in. If attacked, they whip their tails to fling mud at foes, blinding them before making their escape.

entry: POKENAME在毒沼旺盛生活，以强毒自卫。别以为陆上就弱，受威胁还能操控身边草木战斗。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME thrives in toxic swamps. It possesses a powerful poison, which it uses to defend itself. Don't think it's weak on land; when threatened, POKENAME can manipulate its grassy surroundings to fight.

entry: POKENAME身体质感如水球。一见泥洼，就会本能弄得满身泥。
author: wiseginseng
source: POKENAME's body has the texture of a water balloon. When it sees a mud puddle, it will instinctively get itself covered in mud.

entry: POKENAME用毛吸取水分，转成热能。每次准备攻击，身体便微微发光。
author: sanserof
source: POKENAME absorbs moisture through its fur and converts it into heat energy, causing its body to glow faintly whenever it prepares to attack.

entry: POKENAME待在水跃鱼多的地方。体大让人以为它在保护，其实很胆小，怕战斗而蜷缩时，常是水跃鱼来保护它。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hangs around areas where Mudkip are common. Because of its large size, it's assumed it protects them, but in fact it is actually quite timid; the Mudkip often come to its defense as it cowers in fear of combat.

entry: POKENAME飞在云上，侦察下方大河。见大猎物，就高速俯冲，以鳍切斩。
author: bigoljax
source: As they fly above the clouds, POKENAME scout the large rivers below them. When they see large prey, they swoop down at high speed and slice them with their fins.

entry: 猎物一靠近河边，POKENAME就会迅速冲出水面，刺伤对方、注入毒液，再飞回水里，等待毒性发作。
author: bigoljax
source: When prey get close enough to a river, POKENAME quickly shoot out from the water. They then stab the prey, injecting it with poison before flying back in to wait for the effects to kick in.

entry: 鳍能感知大气细变，预测风暴。若特别强烈的风暴将至，它就造精神能量泡保护自己。
author: imaginita
source: It can detect slight changes in the atmosphere with its fins, allowing it to predict storms. If a particularly strong one is coming, it will create a psychic bubble to protect itself.

entry: POKENAME跨大水域时，靠褶边保持浮力。褶边也能令植物猛烈生长。有公司利用独特生理构造牟利，仿其褶边制作浮标。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME use their frills to stay afloat when crossing large bodies of water. These frills can also cause intense overgrowth of plant life. Some companies decided to profit from POKENAME's unique biology, making buoys based on their frills.

entry: POKENAME住在沼泽等潮湿环境，常互相摔跤争地位，把败者赶出原来的家。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are known to dwell in damp environments such as marshlands. They commonly wrestle with each other to assert dominance, throwing the loser out of their former homes.

entry: POKENAME潜伏湖中，等路过者来捕猎。许多个体已嚼穿无数试图驶过沼水的风扇艇。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME lurk within lakes, waiting for any passerby to hunt. Many have chewed through countless airboats that try to pass through the swamp waters.

entry: POKENAME自产的泥散出强光，连最猛风暴也能看见。水手常借光引船，抵达安全处。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: The mud that POKENAME produces from its body emanates with a powerful light that can be seen through the fiercest storm. Sailors often use it to guide ships to safety.

entry: POKENAME住在泥泞沼地，跳舞前先给自己抹些污泥。住处虽脏，仍爱漂亮花，舞蹈会唤来几株彩色植物，添些生气。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME inhabits muddy, swampy regions, coating itself in some of the grime before performing any dances it creates. Despite the mucky habitat, it still enjoys pretty flowers, its dances summoning a few colorful plants to liven up the area.

entry: POKENAME领地意识凶猛，任何东西进入就低吼。连落果与附近突岩掉下的石头，也会被泼泥水。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Aggressively territorial, POKENAME will growl at anything that enters its territory. This includes fruits that fall from trees, or rocks that fall from nearby rocky outcrops, and POKENAME will douse them in muddy water.

entry: 许多强大宝可梦也怕POKENAME的蛮力。它能掰弯钢铁，因此许多高手训练家叫它“弯刃者”。
author: autismgaming89_51746
source: Many powerful Pokémon fear POKENAME's sheer might. Many highly skilled Trainers refer to POKENAME as "The Blade Bender" because of its ability to bend steel.

entry: POKENAME能准确预知海潮有多强，可一到水下，似乎就忘了这本领。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME have the ability to accurately predict how strong the ocean tides are. They seem to forget that ability whenever they're underwater.

entry: POKENAME住在毒沼与污染河流，吃毒废物增强自身毒性。常躺着晒太阳，等花开之日。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME lives in poisonous swamps and polluted rivers, consuming toxic waste to improve the potency of its own poison. It often lies in the sun, waiting for the day its flower will bloom.

entry: POKENAME在湖岸与大河岸挖出广大洞网，整个家庭同住一穴。游泳熟练，能在水里远行觅食。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME dig out extensive burrow networks in the banks of lakes and large rivers, entire family units living within a single burrow. They are adept swimmers and will travel great distances through the water in search of food.

entry: POKENAME粗臂能储大量水，增强拳击，也能喷成强流。巨角力量足以举起、投掷巨石。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's thick arms can store large amounts of water that strengthen its punches or be released as powerful streams. Its mighty horn is strong enough to lift and hurl boulders.

entry: POKENAME在深湖泥中翻找食物，搅起沉积物。能防止湖水停滞，壳里逸出的泡也为上方水体补氧。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME trawl through the mud in deep lakes, stirring up sediment in their search for food. Their presence helps prevent the lake from stagnating, and the bubbles that escape from their shell re-oxygenate the water above them.

entry: 雾晨，POKENAME会找钓鱼者，在旁一起下竿。渔夫往往离开，因为它常将水中多数宝可梦钓走。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: On misty mornings POKENAME seek out anybody fishing to cast nearby. Fishermen tend to leave if these Pokémon sit close by, since POKENAME often reel in most of the Pokémon in the water.

entry: POKENAME轻松游过沼泽浑水，柔韧身体能挤过狭处。散布清水，扩展、保护湿地，帮助泥泥鳅等小宝可梦保住栖地。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME swim through swamps and murky waters with ease, using their highly flexible bodies to slip through tight spaces. They spread clean water to expand and preserve marshlands, working to help smaller Pokémon like Barboach keep their habitats.

entry: POKENAME敏感的鳍察觉气流细变，能在开阔海上连飞数小时。用利脚爪击倒最爱的猎物大嘴鸥。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's sensitive fins can pick up subtle changes in air currents, allowing it to sustain flight for hours over open sea. It uses its razor-sharp talons to take down Pelipper, its preferred prey.

entry: POKENAME群潜伏沼泽，仔细观察领地内一切。捕猎时，小队分出钻地，等其他同伴把猎物赶来，再伏击。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME packs lurk in swamps, carefully watching anything they spot in their territory. During hunts, a small group of POKENAME will break off and burrow into the ground, only to ambush the prey as it's chased into them by the others.

entry: POKENAME鳍能感知细振与几乎听不见的声音，帮助躲险。饥饿时荡过树枝，直到找到果实。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME's fins can feel tiny vibrations and almost inaudible sounds, which enables it to take shelter from danger. When hungry, POKENAME moves by swinging from branch to branch until it finds some fruit to eat.

entry: POKENAME住在岩岸，收集大石。战时装入掌心，用滚烫水流射出。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME live by rocky shores, collecting large stones. When in battle, they load these stones into their palms and fire them with scalding water.

entry: POKENAME以藤蔓为蛋筑巢，紧紧裹住未出生的幼崽。这样游过猛烈潮水，蛋也不会被冲走。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME use their vines as a nest for their eggs, wrapping around their unborn young tightly. They do this so their eggs won't wash away while swimming through harsh tides.

entry: POKENAME战时快速搓手，给自己蓄电。再将手掌按在对手身上，一次放出全部电力。
author: bigoljax
source: When in battle, POKENAME rub their hands fast enough to charge themselves. They then rest their palms on the opponent, shooting off all the charged electricity.

entry: POKENAME平常从手喷水，必要时也能换成火。把掌拍向鳍，用迸出火星加热双手，便能做到。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME normally fire water out of their hands, but can switch to fire when they need to. They do this by striking their palms against their fins, heating their hands up with the sparks that fly off.

entry: 它是深海安静的巨兽，偶尔可见成群POKENAME悠闲走过海底，仿佛干地。脸上长牙摸来柔软，却又会在接触时硬化。
author: adamzwill
source: A quiet behemoth of the deep sea, herds of POKENAME can occasionally be observed casually walking on the seafloor as if it were dry land. The tusks on its face are actually soft to the touch, but harden on contact.

entry: POKENAME用强水流追逐网上病毒。可准头有时偏了，连无害文件也会毁掉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses strong bursts of water to pursue viruses it finds online. Unfortunately, its aim can miss its mark, destroying harmless files in the process.

entry: POKENAME困倦时，以湖底植物覆身。受打扰就用能量球反击，追遍整座湖，直到冒犯者离开。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME covers itself in plants from the lake floor when it grows sleepy. If disturbed, it retaliates with an Energy Ball and chases the offender throughout the lake until they leave.

entry: POKENAME选择沼泽众多的森林居住。先滚上泥，再覆叶枝，让自己显得更凶猛威严，吓走滋事者。
author: sk372
source: Heavily swampy forests are POKENAME's chosen region to inhabit. It will roll in muck, then cover itself with foliage and branches to look more monstrous and imposing in order to scare off troublemakers.

entry: POKENAME比未进化的同类成熟，用力气搬石与碎屑，帮父母筑坚巢。小宝可梦敬仰它，也受鼓舞前来帮忙。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: More mature than their unevolved counterparts, POKENAME use their strength to move rocks and debris to help their parents create sturdy nests. Younger Pokémon look up to POKENAME and are driven to help as well.

entry: POKENAME掘过泥岸，在沼泽下造大巢。爪极坚韧，一挥便能打穿巨石。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME burrow through muddy shores, creating large dens beneath the swamp. Their claws are incredibly tough, able to punch through boulders with a single swing.

entry: POKENAME鳍很敏感，风暴未到，早已察觉环境变化。先以石加固巢穴，再发独特叫声，提醒附近宝可梦。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: The fins of POKENAME are sensitive enough to detect environmental changes long before a storm arrives. After reinforcing its nest with rocks, it uses its distinctive cry to alert nearby Pokémon of the storm's approach.

entry: 火热斗志煮沸体内水，增强打击力量。若拉不近与敌人的距离，它便从手腕喷沸水，远程进攻。
author: mistymagius
source: Its fiery spirit boils the water within its body, increasing the force of its strikes. If it can't close the gap between it and its opponent, it will spray jets of boiling water from its wrists as a long-ranged attack.

entry: POKENAME强腿让它快得能跑过湖面。比起游泳，更爱这样，因为身体干燥，火就不被浇灭。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's powerful legs can move it with enough speed to run across the surface of lakes. It prefers this to swimming, as keeping its body dry avoids quenching its own flames.

entry: POKENAME力量惊人，不受体形限制。感到风暴将至，就以头推巨石，筑屏障，保护洞穴不被淹。
author: santon5512
source: Despite their size, POKENAME are incredibly strong. When they sense an approaching storm, they use their heads to push boulders, creating barriers to protect their dens from flooding.

entry: POKENAME爱一起玩泥，热天尤其如此。成群将巨石丢进泥池，比谁溅起的泥水最大。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME love to play in the mud together, especially on hot days. Groups will often throw boulders into pools of mud, seeing who can make the biggest splash.

entry: 基因促使迅速生长，肌肉变得更大更强。POKENAME能轻松同时拖动最多四艘邮轮。
author: soup1900
source: Rapid growth in its genes has caused its muscles to become even bigger and stronger. POKENAME could tow up to four cruise ships at once without much effort.

entry: POKENAME住在泥地，通常待在沼底。偶尔离水，也始终以精神力量维持身周泥盾。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives in muddy areas, typically at the bottom of swamps. On the occasions it comes out from the water, it uses psychic powers to keep a shield of mud around itself at all time.

entry: POKENAME浸在泥水里冥想。身上覆泥越多，念力便越强。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME soaks itself in muddy water to meditate. The more mud it coats on its body, the stronger its telekinesis becomes.

entry: POKENAME爱在沼泽附近，与珍爱的训练家一同放松。神奇地操控萤火虫，能献上耀眼表演。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy spending time near swamps, bringing their beloved Trainer to these places to relax. Their ethereal command of fireflies allows them to put on dazzling displays.

entry: POKENAME藏在水边茼蒿丛。猎物一靠近，就跃出突袭，再用舌把敌人甩进水。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME camouflages itself within tufts of crown daisy near water sources. When prey draws close, it leaps out in a surprise attack and hurls the foe into the water with its tongue.

entry: 据说身体橙色越亮，就越健康。尾巴肌肉密实，能举巨石。即使游泳，它们仍会变色，融入水中。
author: infinex21
source: The brighter the orange of their bodies, the healthier they are said to be. Their tails are dense with muscle and can lift large boulders. They change their bodily colors enough to blend in with the water, even while swimming.

entry: POKENAME在海边洞穴筑巢，领地意识极强。退潮时沿海滩捕猎各种生物。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME nest inside coastal caves and are highly territorial. They hunt a variety of prey along beaches during low tide.

entry: 成年POKENAME体力惊人，却很少用来战斗。这善良宝可梦改为帮助幼年个体野外生存，常收养任何物种的孤儿，视如己出。
author: nyoomymph
source: A fully-grown POKENAME possesses immense physical strength, but seldom uses it to fight. Instead, this kind Pokémon helps young Pokémon survive in the wild. POKENAME often adopts orphans of any species as its own.

entry: POKENAME的两张巨口能过滤水，兜起浑水或污水。再挖洞注水，造出清澈池塘产蛋。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's two massive jaws work as water filters, scooping up murky or polluted water. They will dig out holes to fill with this water, creating crystal clear ponds to lay their eggs in.

entry: POKENAME敏感的鳃能在黑暗深水轻松定位食物。操控海床泥土，卷成泥涡缠住猎物。
author: dahappycute
source: Using their sensitive gills, POKENAME easily locates food to hunt in deep, dark waters. They can control mud from the seabed to ensnare their prey in vortexes of dirt.

entry: POKENAME踏过沼泽湿地，寻找富含纤维素的腐旧树桩。它绷紧双腿积蓄能量，再猛撞树桩，将木头撞成可以食用的小块。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME stomps through swamps and marshes in search of old, rotten tree stumps that are full of dense cellulose. It tenses its legs to build up energy before ramming into these tree stumps, breaking the wood into edible chunks.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，占整片水岸筑巢，凶狠攻击闯入者。尾能碎巨石，强臂则能助它迅速游泳。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are extremely territorial creatures, claiming entire shorelines as their nests; they will viciously attack anyone who enters their domain. Their tails are capable of smashing entire boulders, and their strong arms allow them to swiftly swim.

entry: POKENAME大量聚在红树林沼泽，在泥泞半咸水里闲躺。受扰就狂暴发作，用树枝打退对手。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME gather in droves within mangrove swamps to loaf about in the muddy, brackish water. When disturbed, they erupt into a violent frenzy, using branches to beat off their opponents.

entry: 它只有进食才动，保存能量。可若自身或任何比它弱的对象受威胁，也会被激起行动。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It preserves energy by only moving to eat. However, it can be spurred into action by threatening it or anyone weaker than it.

entry: POKENAME常在巨大沼泽滚得满身泥。若被打断，就冲向打扰者攻击。
author: seanothan_23
source: POKENAME are often seen rolling in giant swamps and covering themselves in mud. However, if they get interrupted, they charge at whatever disrupted them and attack.

entry: POKENAME收集家边石头，围成一圈，里面留花园照料。很擅长种植生命力顽强、能在泥地家园旺长的植物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gathers rocks around its home to make a circle surrounding a garden for it to tend to. It's quite adept at planting and growing hardy plants that flourish in the muddy areas it calls home.

entry: POKENAME能短暂以后腿直立，显得更高、更吓人。这姿态难以真正战斗，但野生敌手仍可能直立短斗，争领地、食物或伴侣。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can temporarily rear up onto its hind legs to appear taller and more intimidating. It cannot truly battle in this state, but rivals in the wild may engage in short bouts while upright to fight over territory, food or mates.

entry: POKENAME壳大多由水构成。天性温顺，曾见小宝可梦安全地住在里面。
author: pixlhoopa
source: The majority of POKENAME's shell consists of water. Docile by nature, smaller Pokémon have been found to safely inhabit it.

entry: 强壮的双臂与鳍，让POKENAME成为游泳好手。作战时，既有行云流水的连击，也有猛浪般的撞击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are expert swimmers due to their strong arms and fins. Its combat style seems to be a mix of flowing strikes and crashing impacts.

entry: POKENAME外表纤细，却能轻松举起比自身大的巨石。战法如流水，仿佛一举一动都不浪费。
author: infinex21
source: Despite its slender appearance, POKENAME is able to lift boulders larger than itself with relative ease. Its fighting style has been compared to flowing water, as it never seems to waste a single movement.

entry: POKENAME头褶充满液体，带来出色平衡感。即使滑冰连转多圈，也能轻松站稳。
author: .izik
source: The frills on POKENAME's head are filled with liquid that grants it a remarkable sense of balance. It maintains its footing with ease even after spinning repeatedly while ice skating.

entry: 许多个体互相比头褶，炫耀形状。虽然各有不同，每只POKENAME却都觉得自己的最美、最重要。
author: .izik
source: Many compare their frills to one another to show off their shape. While each set differs, every POKENAME considers its own frills the finest and most important.

entry: POKENAME游过河流，岸边芦苇就迅速长高。冬季，这效果完全消失。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME swims through rivers, it causes reeds on the shoreline to grow rapidly. This effect disappears entirely during the winter season.

entry: POKENAME不愿沾水，宁可在新鲜泥土里滚动、躺卧，保持水分。它似乎察知风暴将近，会去空地，仰天张口，喝下雨水。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are averse to water exposure, instead preferring to roll around and lie in fresh mud to stay hydrated. They seem to be aware of impending storms, as they will head for clearings and look to the sky with mouths agape to drink up the rain.

entry: 巢筑得太高，它很少离开，免得身体干燥。能察觉风暴临近，随即飞起，借雨保持水分，足以远行。
author: infinex21
source: Due to how high it has built its nest, it rarely leaves so as to not dry itself out. It can sense when a storm is nigh and will take to the sky, the rain keeping it hydrated enough to travel far.

entry: 皮毛总带浓泥与海水气味，即使数日未沾也一样。缎带状触须强到能举大石，再以泥黏合石块筑巢。
author: infinex21
source: Its fur smells of rich mud and seawater, even if it goes days without exposure to either. Its ribbon-like feelers are strong enough to lift large rocks; it seals these rocks together with mud to create its nest.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，各占一片沼泽，赶走任何闯入者。靠强臂与尾击倒敌人，满身毒刺则用于保护。
author: .jerden
source: Due to being highly territorial, POKENAME each claim a section of swampland and drive off any intruders. They use their powerful arms and tail to knock down foes, and rely on the toxic spikes covering their body for protection.

entry: 野生POKENAME住在海底火山附近，身体受蒸汽与热水锤炼。代谢消耗极快，因此常凶狠猎捕更大的水生宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME live near underwater volcanos, their bodies tempered by the steam and hot waters. Their bodies have such fast-burning metabolisms that they often prey on larger aquatic Pokémon, and often with a vicious ferocity.

entry: 据说一道神圣闪电劈中莲池，POKENAME由此诞生。心身坚韧，曾将整座城市搬离飓风行进路线。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME is said to have sprung into existence when a divine lightning bolt struck a lotus flower pond. It has a resilient mind and body, known to move entire cities out of the path of hurricanes.

entry: POKENAME通常住在雾罩沼泽。被激怒时，嘴上拉链拉开，呕出大股脏泥水，冲走不速之客。
author: sk372
source: Swampy, mist-covered bogs are the typical area where POKENAME inhabits. If provoked, POKENAME's mouth unzips to belch forth a wave of mucky muddy water to wash away unwanted guests.

entry: POKENAME体外泥层在水中散开，游泳困难，便用精神能量高速推进弥补。臂上泥肥沃，吸引草属性宝可梦来找养分。
author: xyloldi
source: POKENAME struggles to swim as the mud coating its body disperses in water. To compensate, it uses psychic energy to propel itself at high speeds. The mud on its arms is rich, making it fertile soil that attracts Grass-type Pokémon seeking nutrition.

entry: 它埋进海滩沙里，伏击靠太近的甲壳类宝可梦。皮肤会干燥，因此POKENAME早晚都入海游泳。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It submerges itself in beach sand, ambushing crustacean Pokémon whenever they get too close. Its skin will dry out, so POKENAME takes morning and evening swims in the sea.

entry: 强壮身体与性情，让潜在威胁都不敢靠近。真打起来又极凶猛，体内积起大量热，便用帆在战中散热。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its powerful body and disposition ward off all would-be threats to it. When it does fight, it fights so ferociously that it builds up a lot of heat in its body. It uses its sail to cool off during combat.

entry: POKENAME脸上附肢是发达触须，能探知周围活动与温度。尾如利刃，以爆发动作挥斩。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The appendages on POKENAME's face are advanced feelers that detect movement and temperature around it. Its tail is a sharp blade, and it uses explosive movement to swipe.

entry: POKENAME是古代文明塑造的洪水神魔像。洪水之泥蕴含神性，赋予它们生命。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME are golems from an ancient civilization that depict a god of floods. The divine properties of the mud created by its floodwater have brought POKENAME to life.

entry: POKENAME翱翔沼泽上空，寻找水中猎物。一见目标就俯冲，挥爪并掀起大股泥水，击倒敌人。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME soars above swamps, searching for prey in the water. Once it spots its target, it will dive down at them, clawing and sending cascades of muddy water to bring its opponent down.

entry: POKENAME既能四肢走，也能双足行。力量压倒性，想夷平森林十分轻松。不知为何，形似某份被当作骗局的旧出版物中的生物。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can walk on either all fours or bipedally. It has overwhelming strength and could easily level a forest if it wanted to. For some reason, it resembles a creature found in an old publication that was written off as a hoax.

entry: POKENAME从翅膀喷水，游得比摩托艇还快。视力锐利，即使高速也能穿行浑水。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME shoot jets of water from their wings, allowing them to swim through the water faster than a jet ski. Their keen eyesight let them navigate through murky waters even at high speeds.

entry: 野生POKENAME每天训练，努力攀上猛烈瀑布。据说终于越过瀑顶时，就会进化。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME will train themselves daily in their efforts to ascend powerful waterfalls. It is said that when they finally breach the top of the waterfall they will then evolve.

entry: POKENAME以粗腿扎稳河床，让急流补水、冲去壳上碎屑。若被冲走，大尾鳍也强到能抵抗水流。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME plant their stout legs into riverbeds and let the rushing currents hydrate them and clean off their shells of any debris. If they ever get swept away, their large tail fins are strong enough to fight against the current.

entry: POKENAME巨大的褶边状叶片极香。许多花商借它浇温室，同时珍视香气与产水能力。
author: .izik
source: The large frill-like leaves on POKENAME are extremely fragrant. Many florists use them to help water their greenhouses, prizing both their scent and water production.

entry: POKENAME两颗真正的脑都在鳍内，受压偶尔会胀大。底部所谓“第三颗脑”，只是湿润多余皮肤，并无实际功能。它常在沼泽闲躺，平心减压。
author: xyloldi
source: POKENAME's fins contain its two actual brains, which occasionally swell under stress. The so-called "third brain" on the bottom is just extra moist skin with no real function. It often lounges around swamps to calm itself and relieve the pressure.

entry: POKENAME热心尽责，风暴后清碎屑，救助被冲上岸的流浪宝可梦。橙色方解石眼的幽光，让它能在暴雨或深水继续工作。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are passionate and dedicated workers, clearing debris after storms and aiding stray Pokémon that washed ashore. The eerie glow from their orange calcite eyes allows them to keep working through torrential downpours or deep underwater.

entry: POKENAME体外黏液一碰硬岩，就将其液化。因此一生能在地里游泳，开心大吃找到的蘑菇。
author: turron_turron
source: POKENAME's body is coated in a mucous that liquefies solid rock on contact. Thanks to this, POKENAME spend their lives swimming through the ground, gleefully gobbling up whatever mushrooms they can find.

entry: POKENAME巨口里住满小铁炮鱼，安全保护，直到足够大能离开。它们帮忙清牙，也以锋利水枪切开猎物，强化咬碎。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The gaping jaw of POKENAME is filled with baby Remoraid for safekeeping before they grow old enough to leave. They clean its teeth and power up its Crunch by cutting through prey with sharp Water Guns.

entry: POKENAME震动湖底泥沙，扰乱许多水生宝可梦的视线。引发震动后，就疾穿泥浆，咬住一餐新食。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME causes silt and mud beneath lakes to quake, disrupting the ability for many aquatic Pokémon to see underwater. Once it creates this seismic activity, it darts through the slurry of mud to sink its teeth into a fresh meal.

entry: POKENAME双颚极强，任何金属都能咬成两半。曾将大游艇误当吼鲸王，咬出巨大破洞。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME have incredibly powerful jaws, able to break any metal in half. They've been seen biting massive holes into large yachts, mistaking them for Wailord.

entry: POKENAME离水太久就干裂，便分泌厚黏液应对。不过维持这层膜很耗能。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body dries out and cracks if it remains out of water for too long. To combat this, it secretes a thick mucus from its body, though sustaining this takes considerable energy.

entry: POKENAME炎热白天常覆泥睡觉。泥是天然防晒层，也防皮肤脱水。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME often sleeps covered in mud during very hot days. The mud acts as natural sunscreen and keeps its skin from dehydrating.

entry: POKENAME建筑般的身体覆着泥浆，闻着像洋葱。泥有多层，每层都带不同品种洋葱的气味。
author: .izik
source: The muddy sludge coating POKENAME's structure-like body smells of onions. There are multiple layers of mud, each carrying the scent of a different variety of onion.

entry: POKENAME头骨脊棱对气压变化极敏感。一感到冷锋将至，就筑泥巢，躲入保暖。
author: sk372
source: The ridges on POKENAME's skull are highly sensitive to changes in air pressure. If it senses a cold front coming, it fashions a den made of mud to hide itself in to stay warm.

entry: POKENAME天生霸道，谁敢喝认定水塘的水，就挡住去路。若有宝可梦不肯退让，就用岩鳍猛砸。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are natural bullies, blocking the way of other Pokémon who dare to drink from the watering holes they've claimed. They slam their rocky fins into Pokémon who try to stand their ground.

entry: POKENAME掘泥翻土，找树根吃。凭惊人臂力直接拔出，再折下可食部分。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME dig through mud and dirt searching for tree roots to eat. Using incredible arm strength, they rip these roots right out of the ground and break off the edible parts.

entry: POKENAME把自己深埋泥里，只露鳍，任潮水冲过，作为冥想。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME dig themselves deep into the mud, with only their fins peaking out. They do this as a type of meditation, letting the tide wash over them.

entry: 强鳍包住圆身，让它承受重击也不动摇。POKENAME主要吃泥中养分，因此小池塘与河岸附近很好找。
author: fiordaliso
source: The powerful fins covering its round body allow it to take very powerful blows without faltering. POKENAME feeds mainly on nutrients found in mud, which is why it is easy to find near small ponds or on riverbanks.

entry: POKENAME感到强风暴将至，就会保护自己与附近脆弱生灵。堆巨石筑庇护所，再以岩石般坚硬的肢体覆住，护着自己和小宝可梦。
author: imaginita
source: If it senses a powerful storm on the way, POKENAME will move to protect itself and any other vulnerable creatures nearby.  It will pile up boulders to create shelter, and defend itself and smaller Pokémon by covering them with its rock-hard limbs.

entry: 旅行训练家都学会，生营火总该交给POKENAME。它善找好烧的细枝，堆得恰到好处，也乐于点燃。
author: sk372
source: Traveling Trainers learn to always appoint POKENAME on campfire-making duty. It excels at finding good twigs for burning, piling them into a perfect formation and delighting in setting them ablaze.

entry: 野生POKENAME一见更漂亮细枝，就不断替换。用细枝控水，像鞭般抽向敌人。
author: .izik
source: A wild POKENAME constantly swaps out its twig whenever it spots one it finds prettier. It uses this twig to control and lash water at foes like a whip.

entry: POKENAME魔杖不断喷出水柱。凝望倒影，可见自己多年后的模样。据说若看见一片空白，就无法经历那个未来。
author: dodoowner_
source: A constant spout of water erupts from POKENAME's wand. Gazing into its reflection reveals how you will look in years to come. It is said that those who see emptiness in the water will not experience that future.

entry: POKENAME常与宝可梦巡护员合作，维护沼泽安宁。会向倾倒废物的车辆掷泥球，力道足以在卡车砸出深凹痕。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME often work with Pokémon Rangers to maintain peace in marshes. POKENAME will attack vehicles that dump waste in a marsh by throwing mud balls with enough force to significantly dent the truck.

entry: 身上蜕下的皮层吸水极强。POKENAME需保持湿润，才能有最佳战斗状态，因此战前会先将皮浸湿。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The shed skin along its body is extremely absorbent. Because POKENAME needs to remain moist to be in peak fighting condition, it soaks its skin in water before battle.

entry: POKENAME在浑水完全静止，等猎物游近。即使其他宝可梦踩头，也不挪动。
author: corra_universe
source: POKENAME waits perfectly still in murky water for its prey to swim near. It remains in place even when other Pokémon step on its head.

entry: POKENAME以粗臂高速掘泥，常把巨石拖入地下，筑起坚巢。
author: santon5512
source: Using their bulky arms, POKENAME will dig through mud at high speeds. They often haul boulders underground, constructing sturdy dens beneath the surface.

entry: POKENAME喷的泥水含细菌，误吞可能发高烧。奇怪的是，发烧者会对附近任何人产生强烈迷恋。
author: .izik
source: The bacteria in the muddy water POKENAME spits can cause high-grade fevers if accidentally swallowed. Oddly, during these fevers, the afflicted will feel intense infatuation toward anyone nearby.

entry: POKENAME在滩涂互战训练，努力在险滑泥沙上站稳。似乎乐于风吹雨打，会愤怒拆掉人们想筑的防洪屏障。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME train themselves by battling one another on tidal flats, fighting to keep their footing on the treacherous muddy sands. They seemingly enjoy being exposed to the elements and angrily tear down any flood barriers that people try to put up.

entry: 身体密实，入水便迅速下沉，能沿河床步行。想浮上水面时，单凭强健肌肉也能轻松游回。
author: vaporvenator
source: Its dense body sinks quickly underwater, allowing it to walk along river beds. It can easily swim back to the surface through sheer muscle strength.

entry: POKENAME快速搓动巨手加热，短时间便能造出巨大滚烫水球，掷向敌人。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME have the ability to heat up their giant hands by rubbing them together quickly. In a short time window, they can form massive spheres of scalding water and throw them at foes.

entry: POKENAME肌肉发达，常与同类或更大宝可梦摔跤嬉戏。为保力量，会举巨石或绕岛游泳。有些场所请它当保镖。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: With their large muscles, POKENAME can be found playfully wrestling each other and Pokémon that are larger than them. To maintain their strength, POKENAME will lift boulders or swim laps around islands. Some establishments use them as bodyguards.

entry: POKENAME靠四臂，力量极强，泳技出众。常养在船厂，帮忙把货船拉上岸、卸下集装箱。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are extremely strong and incredible swimmers thanks to their four arms. They are often kept at shipyards, helping to pull cargo ships ashore and unload shipping containers.

entry: 它轻松走过家园滩涂，退潮时埋身保湿，地上只见岩壳。若被打扰，POKENAME毫不犹豫地展现巨力。
author: picses_the_fish
source: This Pokémon moves with ease through the mudflats of its home, burying itself during low tide to keep its skin moist, only its rocky shell visible from above ground. If disturbed, POKENAME won't hesitate to show its immense strength.

entry: POKENAME最常见于湖里，身体耐严酷环境。若寄生虫成群侵扰，体温能升到华氏1000度。有人推测，精准一踢就能引发山崩。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is most often found in lakes. Its body can withstand intense conditions; if swarmed by parasites, it can raise its body temperature to 1000 degrees Fahrenheit. It's theorized that a single precise kick from it could cause a landslide.

entry: 宝可梦对战时，POKENAME向敌人喷冰水，拖慢动作。水夺走体热，使对方身体末端冻伤。
author: quackquackattack
source: During a Pokémon battle, POKENAME sprays its opponents with freezing cold water to slow down its opponents. The water saps heat from the opposing Pokémon, leaving their peripheral body parts with frostbite.

entry: 外观虽看不出，POKENAME实际大多由沼泥构成，湿地植物能从身上生长。
author: hophoppip
source: Despite its appearance, POKENAME is actually made largely of swampy mud, allowing wetland plants to grow from its body.

entry: POKENAME喜欢藏在沼泽，等其他强宝可梦。捕食者经过，就现身，以背上泥炮轰击。
author: seanothan_23
source: POKENAME likes to hide in swamps waiting for other strong Pokémon. When another predator passes by, it emerges and blasts them with the mud cannons on its back.

entry: 沼泽家园让POKENAME不断流鼻涕。黏液极恶心，单是看见，就会受催眠影响。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The swamps that POKENAME calls its home make its nose drip mucus. This mucus is vile and simply seeing it causes a hypnotic effect.

entry: POKENAME害羞谦逊，喜欢简单生活，吃灌木与树枝上的叶子。敏锐察觉训练家如何看待自己，每次被选去训练，都觉得惊讶。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are shy yet humble creatures that enjoy living simple lives where they eat leaves off bushes and tree branches. They are keenly aware of their Trainer's perceptions of them and are surprised whenever they are chosen for training.

entry: POKENAME感到有人悲伤，就送上自己的骨头。据说这举动预示，日子将会好转。
author: dodoowner_
source: When POKENAME senses someone grieving, it will offer them its bone. It's said that this gesture signifies brighter days ahead.

entry: POKENAME视力差，靠共情感知敌人位置，用长而能伸展的腿远远踢击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have poor eyesight and rely on their empathic powers to sense where their opponents are. They lash out from a distance with their long, stretchy legs.

entry: POKENAME能感知被头撞者的情绪，撞得越重，感受越清楚。因此常撞训练家，看看对方心情如何。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are able to sense the emotions of those they headbutt, this sense becoming clearer the harder they hit. Because of this, they frequently headbutt their Trainers in order to check up on them.

entry: 这只害羞海底宝可梦，对他人情绪极敏感。陌生东西一靠近，POKENAME就喷墨云藏身，再瞬间移动离开。
author: sk372
source: A shy undersea Pokémon highly sensitive to the emotions of others. The minute something unfamiliar approaches, POKENAME spits up a cloud of ink to obscure itself before teleporting away.

entry: POKENAME生活在深海，不摆鳍，而靠念力游动，水面上极其少见。据说，能看见它，便会交好运。
author: mistymagius
source: Said to bring good luck to anyone who sees it, POKENAME is a rare sight on the surface. It lives in the deep ocean, using its psychic powers to swim instead of its fins.

entry: POKENAME用角感知敌意，迅速以镰刀自卫。被切中者攻击欲会减弱，等其斗志耗尽，便能逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME senses hostility in others through its horns, and quickly goes on the defensive with its scythes. Being cut weakens the aggression in those struck, allowing POKENAME to flee once their fighting spirit is depleted.

entry: POKENAME共情力强，却难以控制。察觉强烈愤怒或热情时，燃烧尾巴就会暴起熊熊烈火。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME is a powerful empath who struggles to control their power. When it detects feelings of strong rage or passion, their flaming tail bursts into a raging inferno.

entry: POKENAME总想以烟火本领让人刮目相看。借精神力量，将喷出的火变成奇妙形状与颜色。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is always looking to impress others with its pyrotechnic proficiency. Using its psychic powers, it transforms the flames it breathes into fantastic shapes and colors.

entry: POKENAME常被其他鱼宝可梦撞出水。在河岸扑腾一会儿，就瞬间移动到另一条河或湖。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME is often knocked from the water by other fish Pokémon. It will flop around the riverbank for a moment before teleporting itself to a different river or lake.

entry: POKENAME软角能感知旁人情绪。只有感到对方散出正面能量，才会变成其模样。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's soft horn lets it sense the emotions of those near it. It will only transform into others if it senses positive energy emanating from them.

entry: 野生POKENAME敏锐感知他人情绪，借此避开多数对象。常自行挑选训练家，只在觉得可能足够可信的人面前现身。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME have a keen sense of the feelings of others, which they utilize to avoid most others. They often choose their own Trainers and only will appear before someone they are considering to be trustworthy enough.

entry: POKENAME精神能量带来巨大潜力。据说双眼极美，但力量稳定前，必须闭眼，只凭精神振动辨路。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME has immense potential due to its psychic energy. It is said that this Pokémon's eyes are intensely beautiful, but must remain closed as it navigates strictly through psychic vibrations until its power is stabilized.

entry: POKENAME住进电脑，屏幕就出现复杂数学方程流。若被忽视，还会将题目心灵感应过去，直到用户走开数英尺。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME inhabits a computer, it generates streams of complex mathematical equations on the screen. If ignored, it projects these problems telepathically until the user moves several feet away.

entry: POKENAME腼腆却有活力，因此会尾随喜欢相处的训练家或宝可梦。想靠近别人，真互动又会承受不住。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is sheepish yet energetic, which leads it to stalk Trainers or Pokémon it enjoys spending time with. It wants to be around others but becomes overwhelmed when interacting with them.

entry: 有支持自己的训练家陪着，平日拘谨的POKENAME也会开心吃下与自身体重相当的食物，增强精神力量。
author: lampent12
source: While in the presence of a supportive Trainer, the ordinarily self-conscious POKENAME will happily eat their weight in food to build up their Psychic power.

entry: POKENAME通常独处，默默以精神能力感知附近情绪。但察觉训练家或宝可梦苦恼，就会毫不犹豫地送上暖暖拥抱。
author: zweizweihander
source: POKENAME usually keeps to itself, using its psychic capabilities to silently sense the emotions of nearby beings. But if it senses a trainer or a Pokémon in distress, it won't hesitate to give it a warm hug.

entry: POKENAME极害羞，却也渴望陪伴。建立羁绊需要漫长时间与耐心，换来的是满怀爱意、终生相伴的忠诚伙伴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is incredibly shy, but also desperately craves companionship. Building a bond with it takes a lengthy amount of time and patience, but will give a person a truly loving and devoted friend and ally for life.

entry: POKENAME好奇又紧张，很少远离洞穴。据说野外若主动找人玩，便表示那人心地善良。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is curious yet nervous, rarely venturing far from its burrow. It's said that if it chooses to approach someone in the wild to play, it is because that person possesses a kind heart.

entry: POKENAME天性胆怯，视力又差，很少从高树上的家中探出身子。只有用超能力确认附近没有其他生灵，它才肯出去觅食。
author: sk372
source: Timid by nature and with poor eyesight, POKENAME rarely pokes itself out of its home high up in trees. It waits until its psychic senses detect no others in the vicinity before it deigns to go out to forage.

entry: POKENAME轻易感知悲伤。它不吃附近的花，改为摘下，送给难过的对象，想让心情好些。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME senses sorrow with ease. Instead of eating nearby flowers, it picks them and gifts them to sad individuals to make them feel better.

entry: POKENAME是胆小善良的林居者。若感到别人心中悲伤，就织出可爱或搞笑图案的网，试着逗其开心。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a timid but kindhearted denizen of the forest. Should it sense sadness in the heart of another being, it spins webs in the shape of cute or funny imagery to try and lighten their mood.

entry: POKENAME从触角末端特殊器官放出强光与精神波，驱赶、迷惑威胁。器官硬如钻石，被人类超能力者称赞为集中力量的好媒介。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME emit bright lights and psychic waves from the special organs at the tips of their antennae to deter and disorient threats. These organs are as hard as diamonds and have been praised as foci for human psychics.

entry: POKENAME爱管闲事，喜欢偷听私聊。一被抓住，就爆出火花，大声惊叫。能读心，知道训练家多生气，再相应行动。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are nosy creatures that love to eavesdrop on private conversation. Whenever they are caught, they release a burst of sparks and a loud yelp. They can tell how angry their Trainer is by reading their minds and respond accordingly.

entry: POKENAME是天真的小生灵，喜欢各种傻乎乎的游戏，尽情寻乐。它能察觉训练家的难过，便尽力将对方逗开心，好继续一起玩耍。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are innocent little creatures that enjoy silly games and lots of fun. They can sense when their Trainer is upset and will do their best to cheer them up so that they can keep playing games.

entry: POKENAME羊毛越多，感知情绪越强。太多却会变得过于敏感，情绪不稳，因此定期剪毛，有益心理健康。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's ability to sense emotions increases with the amount of wool it has grown. Too much will cause it to become too sensitive and emotionally unstable, so regular shearing is necessary for its mental health.

entry: POKENAME能感知握住自己尾巴者的情绪。它们常要求训练家始终牵着尾巴，好随时留意对方的心情。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are able to sense the emotions of anyone who holds their tails. These Pokémon often insist that their Trainers hold their tails at all times so they can constantly keep an eye on their emotions.

entry: POKENAME一见别人，就像树才怪般僵住，可鲜艳颜色常出卖它。通过模仿学表达情绪，有时行为古怪难料。
author: bobosmith01
source: When POKENAME spots another, it freezes in place like a Sudowoodo, though its bright colors often betray it. It learns to express emotion through mimicry, sometimes leading to odd or unpredictable behavior.

entry: 它借精神力量与风，飘进城镇，以正面情绪为食。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It uses its psychic powers and the wind to drift into towns. When it does, it feeds off positive emotions.

entry: POKENAME常往南迁。若吃到足够正面情绪，也能保暖过冬。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME often migrates south. However, it can keep itself warm through the winter if it feeds on enough positive emotions.

entry: POKENAME常笨手笨脚地撞上东西。虽然不会受伤，POKENAME却还是觉得很烦。
author: weirdtux
source: POKENAME are often seen clumsily tripping into things. While this does not hurt them, POKENAME still find it annoying.

entry: 头角能感知思想与情绪。一察觉周围一定范围内，有谁心怀敌意，它就先爆炸自卫，再瞬间移动离开。
author: celio_0230
source: The horn on its head senses thoughts and emotions. If it senses a hostile thought from within a certain radius around it, it explodes in self-defense before teleporting away.

entry: POKENAME用精神力量增强的厉叫，吓退闯领地的大型飞行属性宝可梦。被正面对上，就短距瞬移到上方，再俯冲使出迅捷的“啄”。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME is known to drive off much larger Flying types who enter its territory by scaring them with psychically enhanced screeching. When confronted, it teleports a short distance above and dive bombs back with a hasty Peck.

entry: POKENAME能感知情绪，常寻找苦恼宝可梦想帮忙。可害羞性格，往往妨碍了行动。
author: standing__water
source: POKENAME has the power to sense emotion and frequently seeks out distressed Pokémon it wishes to help. However, its shyness often hampers its own pursuits.

entry: POKENAME结合嗅觉与精神感知，寻找能挖出的最美味蘑菇。找到后以念力举着，带回隐巢，安全享用。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses a combination of scent and psychic senses to seek out the most scrumptious mushrooms it can dig up. It lifts the mushrooms it finds with telekinesis, carrying it off to hidden dens so it can eat in complete safety.

entry: POKENAME与积极开朗的人分享食物。冬季庆典，仿它制作的毛绒玩具，是送给孩子的热门礼物。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME shares food with people who are positive and cheerful. Plush toys based on POKENAME are popular gifts for children during winter celebrations.

entry: POKENAME天生额角增强共情，吸走人与宝可梦的强烈情绪。在医院墙内筑巢，出没庆典与墓地，使受害者精疲力竭；抖响的尾能增强或减弱情绪。
author: oddly.abnormal
source: Born with forehead horns that heighten empathy, POKENAME siphons strong feelings from people and Pokémon alike. It nests in hospital walls, haunts festivals and graveyards, and leaves victims drained — its rattling tail can amplify or mute emotion.

entry: POKENAME在电脑里，能读取系统上任何用户的情绪。若察觉悲伤，就强行让电脑跑快些。
author: .izik
source: While inside a computer, POKENAME reads the emotions of any user on the system. Should it sense sadness, it will force the computer to run faster.

entry: POKENAME多住雪林，大多雪白的毛帮助融入环境。角引导精神力量，制造隐约环境幻象，也感知周围情绪。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME tends to live in snowy forests, where its mostly white coat helps it blend into the landscape. Its horns channel its psychic powers, allowing it to create faint environmental illusions and sense the emotions of those around it.

entry: POKENAME创作抽象画，似乎表现当前情绪。附近人和宝可梦的情绪会使它分心，因此多远离旁人。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME creates abstract paintings that seemingly represent its current emotions. The presence of nearby Pokémon and people's emotions distracts it from its artwork, so it tends to stay away from others.

entry: POKENAME爱看各种职业格斗，从宝可梦对战，到拳击、摔跤。容易受战斗情绪感染，试着模仿看到的招式。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME enjoy spending time watching professional fighting matches of all kinds, from Pokémon battles to boxing to wrestling. They get easily swept up in the emotion of such fights and will try to mimic the moves they see.

entry: 成群POKENAME以身上鳍定位脆弱目标，准备下一次伏击。先用细微鳍动无声沟通，再一同出击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Using the fins on top of their bodies, packs of POKENAME can locate vulnerable targets for their next ambush. They communicate silently through subtle fin movements before striking as one.

entry: POKENAME爱看各种职业格斗，从宝可梦对战，到拳击、摔跤。容易受战斗情绪感染，试着模仿看到的招式。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME enjoy spending time watching professional fighting matches of all kinds, from Pokémon battles to boxing to wrestling. They get easily swept up in the emotion of such fights and will try to mimic the moves they see.

entry: POKENAME藏云观察旅行的人，好奇冒险中各种情绪。若被善良训练家发现，可能决定跟随，慢慢熟悉对方。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME hide within clouds to observe people as they travel, curious to learn more about the various emotions that go into an adventure. If a POKENAME is spotted by a kind Trainer, it may decide to follow along and get to know them.

entry: POKENAME通过身上多只角，引导他人的情绪。若强烈情感过于汹涌，便会啜泣。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can channel the emotions of others through the various horns on its body. If it becomes overwhelmed by particularly strong emotions, it starts to sob.

entry: POKENAME借心灵感应与模仿，让训练家的感受被理解。许多不使用口语的训练家，都觉得它很能帮助传达情绪，尤其承受过多刺激时。
author: quackquackattack
source: Through telepathy and mimicry, POKENAME ensure their Trainer's feelings are understood. Many nonverbal Trainers find them especially helpful at conveying emotions, especially when they become overstimulated.

entry: POKENAME用长尾内的感应器，察觉周围情绪。觉得与谁特别合拍，就会从圆鼓脸颊放出电火花。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME senses the emotions around it through the sensor housed within its long tail. When it feels especially in tune with someone, it releases electric sparks from its plump cheeks.

entry: POKENAME藏在灌木里，也能靠身上叶片感知附近人与宝可梦的情绪。每次运用精神力量，身体便散出浓烈鲜薄荷香。
author: fiordaliso
source: The leaves on POKENAME's body allow it to sense the emotions of nearby humans and Pokémon while hiding in the bushes. Whenever it uses its psychic powers, its body emits a strong scent of fresh mint.

entry: 它主要吃晨露，让叶片繁茂，再借叶感知他人情绪。POKENAME极害羞，却能与训练家建立深厚羁绊。
author: fiordaliso
source: It feeds mainly on morning dew to keep its leaves lush, which it uses to sense the emotions of others. POKENAME is an extremely shy creature, but it is capable of forming a very deep bond with its Trainer.

entry: 它对人类情绪极敏锐。一感敌意，POKENAME便用带爪脚趾攀高藏身，直到紧张气氛消退。
author: larky_
source: It is highly attuned to human emotions. If it senses any hostility, POKENAME uses its clawed toes to climb to high places and hide until the tension fades.

entry: 它虽能瞬间移动，却宁可跃过树顶逃敌。头角让它对危险极警觉。
author: larky_
source: Even though it can teleport, it prefers to flee from enemies by leaping through the treetops. The horns on its head make it highly aware of danger.

entry: POKENAME天性害羞，很少在人前现身。若头角感到善意，就静静跟随对方。容易绊倒，羞得身体发热。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Shy by nature, POKENAME rarely reveals itself to humans. If a POKENAME senses good intentions with the horn on its head, it will quietly begin to follow that individual around. POKENAME are prone to tripping and will heat up with embarrassment.

entry: POKENAME以头羽敏锐感知周围人与宝可梦的情绪。训练家开心，它便蓬起羽毛，用小小念力火星庆祝。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Using the feathers on its head, POKENAME is highly attuned to the emotions of the people and Pokémon around it. If POKENAME's Trainer is happy, this Pokémon will puff up its feathers and celebrate with small psychic embers.

entry: POKENAME在不信任者面前，不展示精神能力。一信任训练家，就常能见它用精神能量举石、踢石，磨炼技巧。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME does not exhibit psychic powers around those it distrusts. Once it trusts its Trainer, seeing it practice lifting and kicking boulders with psychic energy to improve its technique becomes commonplace.

entry: POKENAME红角感知周围情绪与振动，极留意环境，甚至能在对手动作前预判。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME's red horn allows it to sense emotions and vibrations around it. This enables it to be incredibly aware of its surroundings and can even predict its opponents' movements before they happen.

entry: POKENAME大部分时间藏在泥里，只露出头上的鳍。它通过鳍感知旁人的情绪，唯有察觉积极的感受，才肯现身。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME spends most of its time hidden in the mud, with only the fin on its head visible. Through that fin, it can sense the emotions of others, and will only reveal itself if it senses positive feelings.

entry: POKENAME不断关注附近情绪。若池塘边有人难过，就跃出，恶作剧般朝对方喷水，想让人笑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME constantly monitors the emotions of those nearby. Should it sense sadness near its pond, it leaps out and sprays the person with water as a prank in hopes of making them laugh.

entry: 这种自身融合的头角如王冠。有趣的是，比普通拉鲁拉丝更敏感，却反而受阴郁者吸引，试图抚慰痛苦。
author: infranscia
source: This self fusion has horns on its head that resemble a crown.  Interestingly, while even more sensitive to emotions than a standard Ralts, its actually drawn to, instead of repelled by gloomy people, and will attempt to soothe their pain.

entry: POKENAME聪明，会操纵训练家的感受，得到想要的东西。读心后，就能准确判断对方会如何回应某种刺激。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are clever creatures that can manipulate how their Trainers feel to get what they want. By reading the minds of their Trainers, they can accurately determine how they react to a given stimulus.

entry: 它们讨人喜欢却缺少自信，据说拥有所有融合宝可梦中最甜美的笑容。但只会向信任的训练家展颜。
author: quote.lass
source: While they lack the confidence, these charming Pokémon are said to have the sweetest smile of any fusion. They only smile for Trainers they trust.

entry: POKENAME精神力量强，性情却怯弱，稍有冲突迹象就更可能逃跑。有训练家坚称，偶尔看见披风般的身体下，有古怪动静。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has strong psychic powers at its disposal, but its meek nature makes it more likely to flee at the first hint of conflict. Some Trainers swear they spot strange movement beneath its cloak-like body on occasion.

entry: POKENAME若被陌生者与其情绪威胁，就会迅速伪装藏身。若用长舌轻舔你，表示信任正在增长。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will hide away quickly via camouflage if it feels threatened by a stranger and the emotions it senses. If a POKENAME lightly licks you with its long tongue, it is a sign of growing trust.

entry: 每只POKENAME最终都会深深依恋找到的某根棍，始终随身带着。若被分开，就会情绪崩溃，怎么安慰也没用。
author: sk372
source: Every POKENAME eventually develops a strong attachment to a stick it finds, and carries it with it always. If the two are separated, POKENAME becomes emotionally distraught and inconsolable.

entry: POKENAME发现悲伤的人，会走出藏处，投出形似一对沙奈朵与艾路雷朵的影像。外表虽骇人，散出的慰藉气息却能安抚附近最多108人。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When POKENAME finds people who are sad, it emerges from hiding, projecting an image resembling a pair of Gardevoir and Gallade. Despite an intimidating appearance, POKENAME projects an aura of comfort able to calm up to 108 people near it.

entry: POKENAME通过粉红色的角感知他人的情绪，借此避开麻烦。巨大双颚中的唾液能舒缓心神，不仅帮助它们逃脱捕食者，在医药方面也大有用处。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can sense the emotions of others through their pink horns and utilize this ability to avoid trouble. The saliva of their large jaws has a soothing effect on the mind, which helps them to elude predators and is very useful in medicine.

entry: 野生POKENAME虽失明，却颇坚韧。流传故事说，有只格外顽强，连受多次精神冲击，仍没受多大伤地活了下来。
author: retrodox
source: In the wild, POKENAME, despite being blind, are quite resilient. Stories have been passed around of one particularly tough POKENAME being hit by multiple Psyshock, yet surviving relatively unscathed.

entry: POKENAME出现在扫墓的悲伤家庭旁，若有人注意就藏起。据说会赶走更恶毒的灵魂，护一家免受伤害。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME appear next to grieving families when they visit graveyards but will hide when someone focuses on them. They are said to ward off more malevolent spirits, protecting the family from harm.

entry: POKENAME通常很害羞，看见旁人靠近就躲起来。它偏爱鲜艳的花，拿花示好，便能哄它离开藏身处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is generally quite shy and tends to hide when it sees others approaching. It is drawn to brightly-colored flowers, and can be coaxed out of hiding by presenting it with some as a peace offering.

entry: POKENAME迅速与信任的训练家结下深厚羁绊。能察觉情绪，对方一苦恼，就抱紧手臂或腿。据说火尾暖意能安抚心神。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME quickly forms strong bonds with Trainers it trusts. Able to sense a person's emotions, it clings to their arm or leg whenever it detects distress. The warmth of its fiery tail is said to have a calming effect.

entry: POKENAME用头角感知带食物的人。谁给食物，它就躲，后来却又回来偷。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME uses the horns on its head to sense people with food. It will hide from anyone who gives it food, but will come back and steal it later.

entry: POKENAME能感知人与宝可梦的自负。若附近谁觉得比它强，就会炫耀力量壮举，证明自己更出众。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME can sense the self-importance of people and Pokémon. If it senses that something nearby thinks it is better than it, then POKENAME will show off with feats of strength to prove that it is superior.

entry: POKENAME用护手感知敌意，总是尽力避开冲突。即使信任的人想拿它进攻，它也不愿配合。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME senses hostility with its guard and goes out of its way to avoid conflict. It even avoids being used offensively by people it trusts.

entry: POKENAME将触须贴在人的太阳穴，便能完美读取情绪。可一生病，这本领就失去了。
author: .izik
source: By placing its feelers to someone's temples, POKENAME can read their emotions perfectly. It unfortunately loses this ability when it falls ill.

entry: POKENAME极胆怯，黏着训练家才安心。若遭抛弃，就变得恶意而不稳定，攻击靠近的一切。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is incredibly timid and will cling to its Trainer for safety. If it is abandoned by its Trainer, it will become malicious and unstable, lashing out at anything that approaches it.

entry: 它用他人情绪能量供火，喜欢待在情感温暖者身边，因为火能烧得最亮。
author: cybr_flame
source: It fuels its flame with the emotional energy of others. It will hang around those with warm feelings because those help the flame burn the brightest.

entry: POKENAME身体极软极暖，阴郁天里是依偎的好伙伴。敏锐留意训练家，心情一低落，就主动凑来相拥。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have incredibly soft and warm bodies that make them perfect buddies for snuggles when the weather gets gloomy. They are keenly aware of how their Trainer feels and always offer snuggles whenever their Trainer feels down.

entry: POKENAME似乎以强烈情绪为食。在遭遇困境的人家地下挖道，远远取食，等待进化。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME appears to feed off strong emotions. It digs tunnels beneath the homes of people facing hardships so it can feed remotely while waiting for evolution.

entry: 它感知波导，连最微弱的负面情绪，也能察觉。想以心灵感应分享这种感受，却常被误以为在施展超能力攻击。
author: staghorn
source: Its aura-reading abilities can identify even the tiniest hints of negative emotion. Its attempts to telepathically share these experiences are often mistaken for psychic attacks.

entry: POKENAME的超能力，借与波导的联系显现出来。可身体太小，还不太控制得住。
author: melodydelune
source: POKENAME's psychic abilities manifest through its connection to aura. Due to its small body, it has difficulty controlling these powers.

entry: POKENAME能感知附近情绪，喜欢平静安宁的环境。看似沉静，若察觉强烈负面感受，却会以惊人的敏捷逃走。
author: brilliantdarkness
source: Capable of sensing nearby emotions, POKENAME prefer calm and peaceful environments. Although they appear placid, they escape with surprising alacrity if they detect strong negative feelings.

entry: POKENAME皮毛柔软，又能辨识情绪，因此十分受欢迎，许多人视它为理想的家庭伙伴。
author: blitzydragon
source: POKENAME are very popular. Many people consider them an ideal Pokémon to raise around a family for their soft coat and ability to recognize emotions.

entry: POKENAME越来越常被用作情绪支持。面对冲突虽胆小，却会毫不犹豫地电击令训练家有压力的东西。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are being increasingly used for emotional support. Despite being timid when it comes to confrontation, they won't hesitate to shock whatever is causing their Trainer stress.

entry: POKENAME察觉训练家焦虑或难过，就唱摇篮曲，助其入睡减压。还会留意呼吸，确保睡得安稳。
author: quackquackattack
source: If a POKENAME detects its Trainer is anxious or upset, it sings lullabies to help them fall asleep and ease their stress. It monitors its Trainer's breathing to ensure a peaceful rest.

entry: POKENAME用粉色尖刺感知、读取情绪，刺也强到能破石。天生怕旁人，因此多待在深洞，甚至钻进地下。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can sense and read the emotions of others through their pink spikes, which are also strong enough to break through stone. They are inherently shy of others, so they typically stay deep within caves and may even burrow underground.

entry: POKENAME渴望翅膀，不知不觉向外投出自己的羡慕与悲伤。虽爱避战，真被逼急，也会猛冲，以强头撞反击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME tend to unknowingly project their own envy and sadness in regards to their longing for wings. Though they prefer to avoid fights, they will lunge with strong headbutts if they feel cornered.

entry: POKENAME害怕时，会发出刺耳的尖叫，向体内充气，随风飘走。偶尔能在中等海拔的草地发现它。
author: bobosmith01
source: If POKENAME is scared, it lets out an ear-piercing scream and fills its body with air, causing it to float away on the winds. It can rarely be found in grassy areas with moderate levels of elevation.

entry: POKENAME对他人情绪敏感。压力大时，头角便漏出毒液。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is sensitive to the emotions of others. When it is stressed, a poisonous fluid leaks from the horn on its head.

entry: POKENAME感到附近有人阴郁，花瓣就迅速干燥。不是试着搬走，就是想办法逗对方开心。
author: .izik
source: Should POKENAME sense someone nearby with a sad disposition, its petals begin to dry out rapidly. It will either attempt to relocate or try to cheer the person up.

entry: POKENAME爱让孩子好过些。会寻找受欺负、不受欢迎的孩子，陪着玩，点亮他们的一天。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME loves making children feel better. It will search for bullied and unpopular children and play with them to brighten their day.

entry: POKENAME能感知危险。受威胁或察觉周围气氛紧张，就放出安抚信息素。
author: greathead69
source: POKENAME can sense danger and will release calming pheromones when it feels threatened or perceives heightened tension in its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME住在沙漠，白天靠近快乐训练家与宝可梦。日落便钻沙，既能留在潜在朋友附近，也能暖暖舒服地休息。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lives in desert climates. It gravitates towards happy Trainers and Pokémon during the day. Once the sun sets, POKENAME burrows itself into the sand to remain close to its potential friends while it has a warm and cozy rest.

entry: POKENAME向周围投出精神波，以头上三处敏感结构接收回波辨路。感知思绪，区分不同生物，借此避险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME navigates by projecting out psychic waves into its environment. It senses the returning signals with a trio of sensitive structures on its head. It can differentiate between living things by feeling their thoughts, letting it avoid danger.

entry: POKENAME用共情感知悲伤，飞近窗边开心鸣叫，希望让对方心情好些。
author: .izik
source: Using its empathetic powers, POKENAME detects sadness in others. It flies near windows and chirps cheerfully in hopes of lifting their mood.

entry: POKENAME须喝大量他者的血维生，却为造成的痛苦内疚。吸走目标的血、缓解饥饿后，就哭着飞走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME needs to drink large amounts of blood from others to survive, but feels guilt for the pain it causes. After successfully draining a target to stave off its hunger, it flies off while crying.

entry: POKENAME收集紫水晶等宝石碎片，想增强精神力量。可常忍不住饿，还没取得进展，就把碎片吃掉了。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME collect shards of amethyst and other gemstones to try and amplify their psychic power. Unfortunately, they often have trouble controlling their hunger and eat away at their scraps before they can make any progress.

entry: POKENAME察觉愤怒敌人，体内平时无害的黏液就变成剧毒。短暂接触，也会恶心、偏头痛。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME senses an angry foe, the normally harmless slime in its body becomes intensely toxic. Brief contact can cause nausea and migraines.

entry: POKENAME结成小群，寻求安全与慰藉。角和披风极敏感，周围哪怕一丝敌意，也会让全群躲起来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stick together in small groups for safety and comfort. Their horns and cloaks are highly sensitive to the emotions of those around them, so even a hint of aggression in the air will send the entire pack into hiding.

entry: 成群POKENAME会在冻湖互相击传冰块。目前虽是新手，却梦想有天成为冰球高手。
author: mistymagius
source: Groups of POKENAME can be found on frozen lakes, hitting ice chunks to each other. Despite being amateurs at the moment, POKENAME desire to become expert hockey players someday.

entry: 它们十分敏感，一觉恶意就迅速逃走。不只因为害怕，也因正面情绪使叶繁茂，负面太多便凋萎。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon are rather attuned to emotions and will flee rapidly if they sense malice. This is not just out of direct fear, but because their leaves flourish due to positive emotions and wilt if exposed to too much negativity.

entry: POKENAME能感知所吃垃圾最后接触者的情绪。残留感情太强、压得承受不住，有时就得休息一下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can sense the emotions of the last person who touched the trash it consumes. Due to this, it sometimes needs to take breaks if overcome by strong feelings left behind by the previous handler.

entry: POKENAME感到恐惧或兴奋便烦躁，接触这能量太久，还会咬人。局势升级前安抚周围，便能保它与旁人安全。
author: quackquackattack
