source: POKENAME become agitated when they sense fear or excitement and will bite when they experience this energy for prolonged periods of time. Calming those around them before escalation ensures both POKENAME and bystanders remain safe.

entry: 察觉有人迷失在森林、心生恐惧时，POKENAME便会飘向对方，留在身旁。它轻声鸣叫，安抚旅人，再温柔地引其走出森林。
author: sk372
source: If POKENAME senses the fear of one lost in the forest, it floats its way towards them to be by their side. It comforts them with soft cries and gently leads them back out of the forest.

entry: POKENAME感到附近有人低落，就从角发出大响，想逗开心。很少奏效，往往只是让对方离开。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME senses someone nearby in low spirits, it releases loud noises from its horn to cheer them up. This rarely works and usually just causes them to leave the area.

entry: POKENAME用角能感知数英里外的情绪。振角发超声波，安抚附近攻击者，作为防御。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME can sense the emotions of others with its horns from miles away. By vibrating its horn, it creates ultrasonic waves that pacify any aggressors nearby as a defense mechanism.

entry: 感知情绪时，POKENAME的云会变色。平常粉红、满是星点，感到负面情绪便灰暗，化为风暴模样。
author: evilgammon
source: When detecting others' emotions, the colour of POKENAME's clouds changes. They are usually pink and filled with stars, but turn grey and stormy when sensing negativity.

entry: POKENAME深受没有兄弟姐妹的孩子喜爱，终生忠诚相伴。软毛适合拥抱，能缓和负面情绪。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are popular companions for children without siblings, staying loyal to them for life. Its soft, cuddly fur helps quell negative emotions.

entry: POKENAME通过连身的沙，吸收又混乱地散发情绪。海滩上若心情剧烈变来变去，多半它就在附近。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME absorbs and erratically disperses emotions through the sand connected to its body. If someone experiences intensely shifting emotions at the beach, odds are a POKENAME is nearby.

entry: POKENAME背菇以正面情绪为食。其他感官虽差，却能用头角感知情绪，寻找开朗的人。
author: .jerden
source: The mushrooms on POKENAME's back feed on positive emotions. Although its other senses are poor, POKENAME uses the emotion-sensing horn on its head to seek out cheerful people.

entry: POKENAME众多角能察觉周围广阔范围的情绪。运用精神力量前，角会更亮；性情胆怯，多半是为瞬间移动逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's many horns let it sense the emotions of others around it in a wide vicinity. The horns glow brighter just before it uses its psychic powers, typically to teleport away due to its timid nature.

entry: POKENAME头角能感知附近情绪。受正面感受吸引，爱蹭快乐的人，友好地撞撞头。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's horn lets it sense the emotional state of those nearby. Attracted to positive emotions, it likes to rub up against those positive people and give them friendly headbutts.

entry: 巨大的锅盖头像精神力量的聚焦室。POKENAME热切想练心身，有训练家的个体常可见在图书馆锻炼。
author: kiwiarms
source: Its enormous bowl cut acts as a focusing chamber for its psychic abilities. Eager to train both its mind and body, POKENAME with Trainers can often be seen working out at the library.

entry: POKENAME以头角感知情绪，能量再经细枝引导，使枝变色。强烈情绪在场时，甚至会突然着火。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME senses emotions with the horn on its head.  The energy from these emotions can then be directed through POKENAME's twig, which will change color, and can even burst into flame in the presence of powerful emotions.

entry: POKENAME察觉附近强烈情绪，火焰攻击威力便变为两倍。火直接从随身魔杖产生。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME senses intense emotions nearby, its fire attacks grow twice as strong. The flames are produced directly from the wand it carries.

entry: POKENAME虽失明，却能从腹孔发强精神波，轻松看清周围。极胆小，一感到别的宝可梦，就迅速瞬间移动逃走。
author: mistymagius
source: While being blind, POKENAME can easily see its surroundings by emitting powerful psychic waves from the holes on its belly. It is very timid, quickly teleporting away when it senses the presence of another Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME吸取南瓜田附近农夫的情绪，将能量导去，帮助生病的南瓜健康生长。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME absorbs the emotions of farmers near pumpkin fields. It siphons this energy to help nearby pumpkins grow more healthily when they are ailing.

entry: POKENAME对池塘腻了，就瞬间移动到附近另一处。一夜可能重复多次，只为探索新地方。
author: .izik
source: When bored of its pond, POKENAME teleports to a different one nearby. It may repeat this multiple times in a night just to explore new places.

entry: POKENAME对人类情绪敏感，尤其是爱意。若情侣散出特别强的爱，小群就会聚在附近。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is attuned to human emotions, particularly those of affection. Small groups of POKENAME will gather near couples that emanate a particularly powerful aura of love.

entry: POKENAME亲昵，爱与主人蜷在沙发看电视。可会干扰遥控信号，待在附近，就改不了频道或音量。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME are affectionate pets who love curling up with their owners on the couch while they watch TV. Unfortunately, they interfere with the signals that remotes produce, making it impossible to change the channel or volume while they're nearby.

entry: 它厌恶愤怒，因为共感会让这种情绪化成身体上的痛楚。只愿接近它认为平静的人。
author: skymaster426
source: It despises anger, due to its empathy causing physical pain when it experiences said emotion. It will only approach those it sees as calm.

entry: POKENAME极聪明，训练家展示无聊东西时，却总装出天真惊讶的模样。只想让对方开心，甘愿忍受不感兴趣的展示。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are incredibly smart Pokémon but act credulously shocked whenever its Trainer shows them something boring. They want to keep their Trainer happy, so they are willing to tolerate being presented something that does not interest them.

entry: 没人能确定POKENAME何时睡觉，有人说一天必须休息十八小时。即使做梦，也能通过分节尾巴感知训练家的意图。
author: ghostslythe
source: It is impossible to determine when POKENAME is sleeping, though some say it must rest eighteen hours a day. Even while dreaming, it senses Trainers' intentions through its segmented tail.

entry: POKENAME感到训练家担心自己，力量往往变为三倍。若训练家过于自信，也会察觉，攻击便少用力。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME senses its Trainer is worried about it, its strength tends to triple. If its Trainer feels overly confident, it senses this as well, causing its attacks to exert less effort.

entry: POKENAME头上器官能感知周围情绪。训练家若为谁难过或生气，它会毫不犹豫地将冒犯者背摔。
author: craigprime
source: The organ on POKENAME's head is capable of sensing the emotions of those nearby. If its Trainer is ever upset or angry at somebody, it will not hesitate to suplex the offender.

entry: POKENAME察觉带敌意的情绪，就迅速缩壳。据说吹出的泡，能影响人的心情。
author: mepp.
source: If POKENAME senses someone with hostile emotions, it quickly retracts into its shell. It is said that the bubbles blown by this Pokémon can influence one's mood.

entry: 危险的登山道上，常能遇见POKENAME。凭着力气与感知情绪的能力，它们会寻找、营救受伤的登山者。
author: thetapemaster
source: POKENAME are commonly found residing on dangerous hiking trails. With their strength and empathic abilities, they are known to find and rescue injured hikers.

entry: POKENAME以头角感知附近情绪，容易难过、承受不住，因此很难训练。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME will tune into the emotions of those nearby due to the horn on its head. It is difficult to train as it can easily become upset and overwhelmed.

entry: POKENAME好奇，爱探索湖边。若感到训练家无聊，就带回小礼物，想在野外多待一会儿。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are inquisitive creatures that enjoy exploring the area around lakes. If they sense that their Trainer is bored, they return with a small gift in an effort to extend their time out in the wild.

entry: POKENAME手中骨头是引导精神力量的媒介。似乎幼时便从辽阔沙漠散落的遗骸里找到。
author: infinex21
source: The bones wielded by POKENAME serve as conduits for them to channel their psychic powers. They seem to find these bones when they are young, from the remains scattered across vast deserts.

entry: 它情绪多变、冲动，踢空就常暴怒跺地。野生POKENAME发脾气能裂巨石、倒树，但耐心训练家能帮助找到内心宁静。
author: pattybgoode
source: Moody and impulsive, it often stomps the ground in fury when it misses a kick. In the wild, POKENAME's tantrums split large boulders and down trees, but a patient Trainer can help it find inner peace.

entry: POKENAME爱随乐跳舞，可头脑简单，跟不上太久节拍。常见小群同听一首歌，舞步却各不相同。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys dancing along to music, but its simple mind leaves it unable to follow a beat for long. Many have seen a small group of POKENAME dancing to the same song, each with completely different dance moves.

entry: 它们会彼此分享蛋，每颗都能带来独特感受。可一拿到幸运蛋，就藏起来，想独占相处时间。
author: quackquackattack
source: They are known to share eggs with each other, as each egg has a unique feeling. However, when they pick up a Lucky Egg, they are known to hide the egg so they can hog all the time with it.

entry: POKENAME藤蔓不停运动，有节奏地绕身旋转。精神气息从中散出，留下美丽闪亮的残影。
author: wiz0z
source: The vines of POKENAME are in constant movement, swirling around their body in a rhythmic manner. Psychic aura radiates from the vines, leaving behind beautiful shimmering afterimages.

entry: POKENAME深潜海中筑巢，多数人难得见到。以精神力量推进、保护鳍；运用力量时，胸前符号会微微发光。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are a rare sight for most people, as these Pokémon lurk and nest deep within the ocean. They use psychic powers to propel themselves and protect their fins; the symbol on a POKENAME's chest dimly glows as it uses psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME对周围极敏感，用头部附肢感知潜在危险。带礼物给训练家时，体贴心意常令对方感动。
author: darxer_
source: POKENAME is very sensitive to the world around it and uses the appendages on its head to sense potential danger. Trainers are often impressed by its thoughtfulness when it brings them gifts.

entry: POKENAME爱在开阔原野轻快跑跳，安宁地嬉戏花间。谁打断这悠闲时刻，很快就会挨上角击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys prancing around open fields and cavorting amongst the flowers peacefully. Interrupting these moments of calm indulgence is a quick way to wind up on the receiving end of its horns.

entry: 它战时想尽办法激怒敌人。对方越愤怒，POKENAME精神力量越强。预知未来，便能知道最有效的激怒方式。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It seeks to enrage its opponents in combat. The stronger their rage, the stronger POKENAME's psychic power becomes. It knows the best way to anger its opponents by peering into the future.

entry: 它以变成各类宝可梦的诠释性舞蹈逗乐旁人。无论动作顺序如何，最终总以奇鲁莉安形态，华丽收尾。
author: sk372
source: It enjoys entertaining others with interpretive dance routines that involve shapeshifting into various other Pokémon. No matter the sequence, the dance ends with a flourish done in the shape of a Kirlia.

entry: POKENAME是忠诚伙伴，始终陪训练家，带离察觉的危险。进化将近，耳朵常会变色。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are loyal pets, always sticking by their Trainer's side and guiding them away from any danger it senses. POKENAME's ears will often change colors when evolution draws near.

entry: POKENAME易受惊，有旁人在就很少出壳。以精神能力感知周围，喷出水流推进。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are skittish Pokémon that rarely come out of their shells when others are nearby. They can perceive their surroundings with their psychic abilities and propel themselves with jets of water.

entry: POKENAME怀着耐心而热切的期待，搏动振颤，盼望破茧。对未来的兴奋，表现在不停的动作里。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME throbs and vibrates with a patient enthusiasm, eager to burst from its cocoon. Its excitement for the future is manifested in its constant movement.

entry: 它以头角放出的精神力量侦测猎物，再用镰刀状前臂追猎。也能以精神能量强化爪刃，强到足以切开维度。
author: imaginita
source: It detects prey using psychic powers emanating from the horns on its head, then hunts the prey down with its sickle-like forearms. It can also enhance these claws with psychic energy, making them powerful enough to cut through dimensions.

entry: 野生POKENAME用精神力量互相挤压，争夺领地，想把对方推出去。信任的训练家，则可拿厚实身体当枕头。
author: lampent12
source: Wild POKENAME will press against each other with psychic powers to fight for territory, trying to push the other out. They will let trusted Trainers use their stout bodies as pillows.

entry: POKENAME积蓄太多龙之能量，全身长出额外尖刺。人被刺扎到，可能短暂看见未来。
author: geo_ominous
source: POKENAME has accumulated so much draconic energy that the energy has formed additional spikes all over its body. Being poked by one of these spikes can allow people to see glimpses of the future.

entry: 据说纯洁之心在旁，能增强POKENAME精神力量。目睹善举后，确实显得更快乐、更有活力。
author: imaginita
source: It is said that being in the presence of those with a pure heart will increase POKENAME's psychic powers. It certainly seems to be happier and more energetic after witnessing acts of kindness.

entry: POKENAME头叶散出宜人清香，周围情绪开朗时更浓。据说精神力量强到能改变气温与天气。
author: mepp.
source: A pleasant aroma wafts from the leaf atop POKENAME's head, becoming stronger when it's surrounded by cheerful emotions. It is said that its psychic powers are strong enough to alter the temperature and weather.

entry: 它们曾是活的同义词典，语言知识堪比大学教授。因此为贵族当过书记，帮忙起草贵族间的重要书信。
author: quackquackattack
source: They were once a living thesaurus, as their linguistic knowledge rivaled that of university professors. They once served as scribes to nobility because of such knowledge, and helped pen important correspondences between nobles.

entry: POKENAME飞行也跳舞，在空中旋转。只须心念一动，便能边飞边摘下树上球果。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dances while flying, spinning through the sky. With a flick of its mind, it plucks Apricorns from trees mid-flight.

entry: POKENAME以跳跃与旋转和同类沟通。交流舞蹈可能漫长复杂，细微变化就能彻底改变信息语境。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME communicates with others of its kind via a series of hops and twirls. These communicative dances can be quite lengthy and intricate, with tiny variations changing the context of the message entirely.

entry: POKENAME欢快旋转水洼，皮肤吸取水分。精神影响让旁观者一看跳舞，就忍不住想喝彩。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME twirls joyfully in puddles, drawing in moisture through its skin. Onlookers feel an urge to cheer as it dances due to its psychic influence.

entry: 午后暖阳里，POKENAME优雅旋转，用念力辅助流畅而光彩夺目的舞蹈。
author: .izik
source: In the warmth of afternoon sun, POKENAME twirls gracefully. It uses telekinesis to assist its flowing, radiant dances.

entry: POKENAME以精神力量，在背上显出一轮迷你新月，罩着黑雾。飘浮光球吸取星光，让它在黑暗投出美丽闪亮的幻象。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME use their psychic power to manifest a miniature crescent moon shrouded in dark mist above their backs. This floating orb absorbs starlight and allows them to cast beautiful, shimmering illusions in the dark.

entry: POKENAME共情极强，感知周围心情。满月下红环暖亮，优雅起舞，以精神能量抚平负面情绪。
author: ambrosia04
source: Highly empathetic, POKENAME can sense the feelings of those around them. Under a full moon, their red rings glow warmly as they dance gracefully, using their psychic energy to soothe negative emotions.

entry: POKENAME开心就绕亲近者跳舞。敲牙打拍子，也帮助磨短牙齿。
author: sk372
source: When happy, POKENAME will begin to dance around those close to it. It clacks its teeth together to keep rhythm, which also helps to keep its teeth ground down.

entry: 古人留下的记录说，POKENAME曾向他们展示图像，模样竟与现代人类文明，分毫相合。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Ancient peoples' recorded interactions with this Pokémon tell of POKENAME showing them images that accurately resemble modern human civilization.

entry: POKENAME壳虽比钢硬，舞步却流畅。若一踉跄，就用精神力量稳住动作。
author: .izik
source: Despite having a shell harder than steel, POKENAME dances fluidly. If it stumbles, it uses psychic power to steady its movements.

entry: POKENAME以精神能量摘树果，存进壳里。果实发酵，便与同类分享甜汁。
author: .izik
source: Using psychic energy, POKENAME plucks berries and stores them in its shell. As they ferment, it shares the sweet juice with others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME用角撞松树，喝取树液。甜味让精神力量增强，效果维持数小时。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slams its horn into pine trees to drink sap. The sweet taste increases its psychic power for hours afterward.

entry: POKENAME活泼开朗，爱助人，尤其喜欢用心灵感应传达训练家的需要。收一点蜂蜜，就把人的思绪传给附近对象。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are lively and chipper creatures that enjoy helping people, especially conveying the needs of their Trainer through telepathy. In exchange for a bit of honey, POKENAME beam a person's thoughts to those nearby.

entry: POKENAME极胆小，只在情绪平静或快乐者面前现身。角开始发光，便是准备动用非凡精神力量。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a very timid creature and only reveals itself to people who express calm or joyful emotions. When its horns begin to glow, it is preparing to use its extraordinary psychic powers.

entry: 它以激烈训练，努力把精神力量融入战斗。受到训练家鼓励的POKENAME，会因正面能量明亮发光。
author: pattybgoode
source: It works hard to integrate its psychic powers into combat through fierce training. POKENAME that are encouraged by their Trainers glow vibrantly with positive energy.

entry: POKENAME储电越多，似乎处理信息越快。有研究者认为，电刺激了脑。总能察觉将至风暴，若有危险就提醒周围。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME seem to process information more quickly the more electricity they've stored; some researchers believe the electricity stimulates their brains. POKENAME are always aware of impending storms and will alert others if the storms are dangerous.

entry: 它在人前旋转、小跳，表演助兴，也索取食物作为回报。跳完没人喂，就会十分闹脾气。
author: sk372
source: It dances in front of people, performing twirls and small hops to entertain, as well as request food offerings for its entertainment efforts. It becomes quite petulant if nobody feeds it after its dance.

entry: 叶尾能感知其他宝可梦情绪，提前避开暴怒者。凭精神力量，能让林中叶片飘起，组成通往树顶的悬空路径。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its leaf-shaped tail can sense the emotions of other Pokémon, allowing it to avoid encounters with enraged creatures in advance. Thanks to its psychic powers, it can make forest leaves float and form levitating paths that lead it to the treetops.

entry: POKENAME开朗外貌下藏着坏脾气，甜点与大量书籍却能安抚。若被更大对象吼叫，外观就出现故障，不受控地发抖。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME's cheerful appearance hides a short temper, but sweet treats and plenty of books can appease it. If it is yelled at by anything bigger than itself, its appearance will become glitchy and it will shake uncontrollably.

entry: POKENAME住在树旁最开心。野外常见爬到最高枝，在叶间跳舞。
author: larky_
source: POKENAME is happiest when living near trees. In the wild, it can often be seen climbing to the highest branches and dancing among the leaves.

entry: POKENAME爱旋转，却常被自己的脚绊倒。鼓励得当，就会爬起再试。表演受夸奖，身体会开心得热起来。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME love spinning around, but are prone to tripping over their own feet. With the right encouragement, POKENAME will pick themselves up and try again. Praising a POKENAME for their performance causes their bodies to heat up with joy.

entry: POKENAME背上排列尖刺，保护免受伤害。能以念力卸下一些，作尖弹射出，保护自己或群体。
author: sk372
source: A number of pointed spines line POKENAME's back, protecting it from harm. Using telekinesis, it can remove some of the spines from its body and fire them off as pointed projectiles to protect itself or its herd.

entry: 它们舞蹈武艺皆出众。POKENAME练习用精神力量使脚步轻盈，踢得更快，每秒能迅捷优雅地连踢十下。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: These Pokémon are adept in both dance and martial arts. POKENAME will practice using their psychic powers to make themselves lighter on their feet; this allows POKENAME to kick faster, delivering ten quick and graceful kicks each second.

entry: POKENAME借头羽上众多角，敏锐感知周围心情。若自身情绪太强，可能引起现实涟漪，据说可从中一窥未来。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are highly attuned to the feelings of the people around it, using the many horns along its head feathers. If its own emotions get too strong, POKENAME may create a ripple in reality that is said to reveal glimpses of the future.

entry: POKENAME凭高智力与预判对手动作的本领，以尽可能高效的方式取胜。战斗以外，其实相当懒。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME uses its high intelligence and ability to predict its opponents' movements in order to win battles in the most efficient way possible. Outside of battle, POKENAME is actually quite lazy.

entry: POKENAME好奇，爱了解身边的人。读心本领，让它有许多可发现的东西。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are curious creatures that enjoy learning about the people around them. Their ability to read minds gives them plenty to discover.

entry: POKENAME舞姿协调优美，是宝可梦华丽大赛的宠儿。彼此感知情绪，便能同步起舞。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are a favourite for Pokémon contests, their dancing being well co-ordinated and aesthetically pleasing to behold. They sense one another's emotions and can dance in synchrony with one another.

entry: POKENAME活泼友善，是许多训练家喜爱的伙伴。不过容易依恋过头，想独占关注，不分给别人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's bubbly and friendly personality makes it a beloved companion for many a Trainer. It has a tendency to get overly attached to its Trainer and may try to hog their attention away from anyone else, however.

entry: POKENAME花数小时仔细练身体动作，追求舞蹈优雅与战斗英勇融为一体。有搭档合作，学得最好。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME spend hours carefully practicing the movement of their bodies. They seek to blur the line between the elegance of dance and the gallantry of battle. POKENAME learn best when working with a partner.

entry: 初被发现时，研究者以为POKENAME古怪扭转是在威吓。如今才知道，那是以某种舞蹈交流。
author: sk372
source: When first discovered, researchers thought that POKENAME's odd twisting and twirling movements were a threat display. Now it is known that it is POKENAME's way of communicating via a sort of dance.

entry: POKENAME体形虽骇人，灵魂却温柔，懂得欣赏音乐。最爱的游戏，是让伙伴握住藤蔓，一起跳舞。
author: sk372
source: While POKENAME has an imposing size, it has a gentle soul and an appreciation for music. Its favorite game is to let a partner take its vines in their hands and dance with them.

entry: 它有节奏地活动身体，每支舞都想警告将至灾难。可人们误会，许多地方反以为舞蹈是在招灾。
author: sk372
source: It moves its body in rhythmic ways, each dance coinciding with an attempted warning of upcoming disaster. Due to misinterpretation, many areas think these dances are meant to bring about the calamities instead.

entry: POKENAME被失去爱人的寡妇吸引。她们说，待在附近心里安宁，很可能因它正保护她们，免遭恶灵侵扰。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are drawn towards widows who have lost their loved ones. Widows describe feeling a sense of calm when they are nearby, which is likely because they protect the widows from malevolent spirits.

entry: POKENAME隐居在纯然和平宁静之处起舞。据说亲眼看过一次，就能彻底开悟。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME secludes itself in locations of pure peace and serenity in order to dance. It is said that managing to see one of its dances in person would grant a person complete enlightenment.

entry: POKENAME把宝可梦带往平静舒适的森林，盼其冷静。背上植物，也散出宜人的安抚香气。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME carries Pokémon to calm and relaxing forests in hopes of calming them down. The plants on its back have pleasant, calming smells.

entry: POKENAME背上大花映照周围情绪。负面感受太多，花就凋萎落瓣。
author: hophoppip
source: The large flower on POKENAME's back reflects the emotional state of those around it. When negative emotions abound, the flower wilts and loses petals.

entry: POKENAME感知快乐，火焰便明亮轰鸣。常见它欢舞，攀上树枝与墙。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's flame roars brightly when it senses happiness. It's often seen dancing joyously and climbing on branches and walls.

entry: POKENAME用刀刃划开次元裂隙，窥见未来。持有者心情越好，它的战斗表现也越出色。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's blade can cut open dimensional tears to see into the future. It fights better when its wielder is in higher spirits.

entry: 训练家越快乐，POKENAME头角也长得越大，念动力更强。备受疼爱的个体，角能超过30厘米。
author: oddwalls
source: As its Trainer's happiness grows, the horns on POKENAME's head grow as well, increasing its psychokinetic power. A well-loved POKENAME can have horns in excess of 30 centimeters long.

entry: POKENAME战时以触须作肢体，做复杂芭蕾般动作。跳舞期间，精神力量会增强。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feelers act as limbs while it performs complex ballet-like maneuvers in combat. Its psychic powers are amplified mid-dance.

entry: POKENAME常成群聚集，一起编排舞步。满月夜的舞蹈，尤其华丽。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is often found congregating in groups to coordinate dance routines together. The dances done on the nights of the full moon are especially extravagant.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，向空中释放闪亮孢子。若感到不被认可，可能转到一半突然出拳。
author: .izik
source: While dancing, POKENAME releases glittering spores into the air. If it senses disapproval, it may lash out with a punch mid-spin.

entry: POKENAME视力极差，却有强精神能力，帮助感知周围，弥补不足。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's eyesight is extremely poor, but it compensates with strong psychic abilities that helps it sense its surroundings.

entry: 通过心灵感应，两颗头能理解彼此心情。因此POKENAME双头相处极好。
author: musicsheep.
source: Using telepathy, the two heads can understand each other's feelings. Because of this, POKENAME's two heads get along very well.

entry: POKENAME呈更接近人类的形态，似乎为更好讨得亲近。据说有真形，只向真正依恋的人类展示。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME takes on a form closer to that of a human, seemingly to better ingratiate itself to them. Supposedly it has a true form that it only reveals to humans it has truly gotten attached to.

entry: 它能劫持敌人心智，让其看见可怕未来。POKENAME疾穿战场时，敌人渐渐分不清现实；等敌人绝望，才发动攻击。
author: bobosmith01
source: It has the ability to hijack a foe's mind and make them see visions of a horrible future. As POKENAME darts around the battlefield, the foe starts to lose touch with reality. Only when they are in despair does POKENAME attack.

entry: POKENAME擅将四肢变成旋转双螺旋，伸长抓敌。优雅跃动时不断变身，迷惑对手，极难被击中。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME specializes in changing its limbs into swirling double-helix shapes that extend to grab foes. It shifts its body while leaping around gracefully to confuse its opponents, making it very difficult for them to get a hit in.

entry: POKENAME每天只有约十五分钟完全醒着。其余时间靠精神控制移动，装作清醒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is only fully awake for about fifteen minutes per day. The rest of the time, it moves through psychic control, pretending to be alert.

entry: POKENAME做复杂芭蕾般动作，毫不疲倦。舞蹈中以共情读取附近生灵的情绪。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs complex ballet-like movements without tiring. While dancing, it reads the emotions of nearby beings with empathetic powers.

entry: POKENAME外观令人平静，又能读情绪，十分受欢迎。被抚摸时，会轻轻噼啪漏出静电波。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME is a popular Pokémon to have because of its calming appearance and its ability to read emotions. When it's petted, slight waves of static electricity fizz off it.

entry: 它能劫持敌人心智，让其看见可怕未来。POKENAME疾穿战场时，敌人渐渐分不清现实；等敌人绝望，才发动攻击。
author: bobosmith01
source: It has the ability to hijack a foe's mind and make them see visions of a horrible future. As POKENAME darts around the battlefield, the foe starts to lose touch with reality. Only when they are in despair does POKENAME attack.

entry: 它能劫持敌人心智，让其看见可怕未来。POKENAME疾穿战场时，敌人渐渐分不清现实；等敌人绝望，才发动攻击。
author: bobosmith01
source: It has the ability to hijack a foe's mind and make them see visions of a horrible future. As POKENAME darts around the battlefield, the foe starts to lose touch with reality. Only when they are in despair does POKENAME attack.

entry: POKENAME敏感而勇敢，用歌声与精神力量安抚争斗的融合宝可梦。人们认为，它阻止许多野生融合体大肆破坏环境生态平衡。
author: bobosmith01
source: Highly sensitive and filled with courage, POKENAME settles and eases clashing fused Pokémon with songs and psychic power. It is thought POKENAME prevents many wild fused Pokémon from wreaking havoc on the ecological balance of the environment.

entry: POKENAME紧贴训练家心情。感到快乐，就顽皮撞撞头；感到悲伤，就唱歌安慰。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME is closely attuned to its Trainer's feelings. If it senses happiness, it will playfully headbutt its Trainer; if it senses sadness, it will sing to cheer them up.

entry: 训练家开心，POKENAME就绕着欢乐蹦跳。但须教它看脚下，因为常把路上一切踩坏。
author: oddwalls
source: When POKENAME's Trainer is happy, it skips joyously in circles around them. However, POKENAME must be taught to mind its step, as it tends to trample anything in its path.

entry: 据说精神力量足以预见未来。它颇容易陷入悲伤，抬头望天空太久，尤其如此。
author: infinex21
source: Supposedly, its psychic powers are great enough to see into the future. It is rather prone to bouts of sadness, especially so if it stares up at the sky for long.

entry: 据说它因能预知未来，才耐心等待进化。虽无须吃喝，接触正面情绪时却似乎长得更好。
author: infinex21
source: Its supposed future sight is said to be why it patiently awaits its evolution. Though it does not need to eat or drink, it does seem to thrive when exposed to positive emotions.

entry: POKENAME快乐时，尾尖火焰有节奏地闪动。研究者认为，这能加强群内羁绊。
author: mepp.
source: The fire on the tip of POKENAME's tail flickers rhythmically in moments of joy. Researchers believe this behavior strengthens social bonds within its group.

entry: POKENAME在孩子面前开心旋转，表演助兴。其实是让孩子放松戒心，更愿抓住绳子，好带走他们。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME happily twirls about in front of children to entertain them. This is an act done to lower their guard, making them more likely to grab hold of its strings so it can carry them off.

entry: 成群POKENAME聚在损坏电线旁。若感到电工接近，就会突然一闪，以精神力量消失。
author: .izik
source: Swarms of POKENAME gather around damaged wires. If they sense electricians approaching, they vanish in a sudden psychic blink.

entry: POKENAME滚动时，精神气息催人追逐，连强大宝可梦也有时忍不住并肩赛跑。
author: .izik
source: As it rolls, POKENAME emits a psychic aura that urges others to chase it. Even strong Pokémon sometimes feel compelled to race alongside it.

entry: POKENAME叶子接触负面情绪太久，就会凋萎。鲜亮粉叶，表示生长良好、备受照顾。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's leaves wilt if they are exposed to negative emotions for too long. A POKENAME's vibrant, pink leaves are a sign of a well-grown and cared-for POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME不断点脚，维持稳定节拍。舞步似芭蕾，大幅跃过，身后留下火焰轨迹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME taps its feet constantly to maintain a steady rhythm. Its dances look similar to ballet movements, with great sweeping leaps that leave trails of fire in their wake.

entry: POKENAME共情使它善于鼓励。训练家觉得自己做不到，就为其打气，即使别人觉得只是小事。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's empathic sense makes it excellent at encouragement. If its Trainer is feeling incapable, it will cheer them on, even if their problems seem trivial to other humans.

entry: POKENAME翅上脱落物有疗愈作用，会被收作病宝可梦的卧垫。它坐在人头上，也能舒缓头痛。
author: darxer_
source: The shedding from POKENAME's wings has healing properties, so it is harvested and used as bedding for sick Pokémon. It can sit on people's heads to relieve headaches.

entry: POKENAME软身一被拥抱，就触发幸福的精神波。拥抱一停，快乐立刻消失，许多人还回不过神。
author: .izik
source: When hugged, POKENAME's soft body triggers a psychic wave of bliss. The joy vanishes the moment the hug ends, leaving many dazed.

entry: POKENAME很适合照顾小女孩，常教她们更有淑女风范。可自己的成熟度，也只如13岁女孩。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are great babysitters for young girls, often teaching them how to be more lady-like. Despite this, POKENAME is about as mature as a 13-year-old girl.

entry: POKENAME用念力呈现温暖、安全的幻象，引诱猎物靠近。等距离够了，毒刺便猛然扎下，猎物再看穿骗局，也已太迟。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lure prey by projecting images of safety and warmth with their psychic powers, tricking targets into approaching. Once close enough, they strike with toxic stingers, revealing the ruse too late for their victims.

entry: POKENAME靠幸福滋养，尽力令训练家开心。双方羁绊深，背菇就长得更大，颜色更鲜亮。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is nourished by happiness and will do its best to always please its Trainer. When the two have a strong bond, the mushrooms on POKENAME's back will grow larger and have more vibrant colors.

entry: 它运用精神力量，帆就明亮发光。遭捕食者时，与同群合力造出耀眼光景，扰乱威胁。
author: cait_sith
source: Its sails glow brightly when it uses its psychic powers. When faced with a predator, it will work with its herd to create a dazzling display of light to disorient the threat.

entry: POKENAME集中精神力量的角，长在背菇顶，而非头上。真菌内复杂的化学交流，产生它使用的大部分精神能量。
author: .jerden
source: The horns POKENAME uses to focus its psychic powers are located on top of the mushroom on its back, rather than on its head. Complex chemical communications within the fungus generate most of the psychic energy POKENAME uses.

entry: POKENAME善泳，硬甲保护强大的精神脑。有小众学说认为，胆小虫与奇鲁莉安融合得好，是因奇鲁莉安祖先曾有壳。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is an adept swimmer, and its hard plates protect its powerful psychic brain. There's a fringe theory that Wimpod and Kirlia meld so well because the ancestors of Kirlia possessed shells.

entry: POKENAME动作流畅，旋转不停，战斗更像舞蹈。跳芭蕾的训练家常用它作伴，因为脚步常带来灵感。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: When POKENAME fights, its fighting seems more like a dance due to its smooth movements and spins. POKENAME is normally used by Trainers who do ballet, as POKENAME's footwork often inspires them.

entry: POKENAME成群飞过夜色，受强烈情绪吸引。噩梦中惊醒的人，会听见窗边的振翼声。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flutter through the night in swarms, finding themselves drawn to strong emotions. Those suffering from nightmares find themselves waking to the sound of POKENAME wingbeats at their window.

entry: 这种融合能操控随机结果，例如随机数机器、赌场轮盘，以及特鲁科纸牌和扑克的发牌。赌场正在加紧采取措施，禁止POKENAME入场。
author: epping_forest
source: This fusion has the ability to manipulate random selections such as RNG machines, casino roulettes, and card dealings in truco and poker. Casinos are quickly working on banning POKENAME from entering establishments.

entry: POKENAME用感知器官记录训练家情绪起伏，计算讨食的最佳时机。附近无线信号也会随它的开心或悲伤，变强或变弱。
author: epping_forest
source: Using its sensory organ, POKENAME records its Trainer's mood swings to calculate the best moment to ask for food. Also, depending on whether this fusion feels happy or sad, wireless signals near it may get stronger or weaker.

entry: POKENAME生气快，自行平息也快。为让训练家开心，会练深呼吸等冷静方法。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME may be quick to anger but is just as quick to conciliate itself. It practices deep breathing and other ways to calm itself to keep its Trainer happy.

entry: 从用脚爪开柜门，到用牙拾起地上物，POKENAME接受训练，方便残障人士生活。能察觉苦恼思绪，预知何时需要帮助。
author: quackquackattack
source: From opening cabinet doors with their paws to grabbing objects on the floor with their teeth, POKENAME are trained to make life easier for people with disabilities. They can anticipate whenever a person needs help by detecting thoughts of distress.

entry: POKENAME睡着，身体也随舞般摇动。精神感知敏锐，即使睡舞时有东西靠近，也能瞬间移动，避开伤害。
author: sk372
source: Even while POKENAME sleeps, its body moves in swaying dance-like motions. Its psychic senses are sharp, so even if something approaches it while it sleep-dances, it will be able to teleport itself out of harm's way.

entry: POKENAME不断逼自己进行身心训练。有人说，拼命努力，是想保护自己或训练家，避开预见的未来。
author: craigprime
source: POKENAME relentlessly pushes itself in physical and mental training. Some say the reason it works so hard is to protect either itself or its Trainer from a future that it foresees.

entry: POKENAME舞过丛林树冠，释放绿花粉。附近对象吸入，可能陷入深深绝望。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dances through jungle canopies, releasing a green pollen. Those nearby may fall into deep despair after breathing it in.

entry: POKENAME以念力让小石绕身飘浮，既能防御，似乎也为娱乐。近来发现，石群旋转遵循特定而复杂的几何图案。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME uses telekinetic powers to levitate pebbles around its body, both in defense and, seemingly, for recreation. It was recently discovered that it rotates the group of pebbles in specific yet complex geometric patterns.

entry: POKENAME尾巴摆得优雅流畅，虽能钓鱼，却也不幸吸引空中捕食者的目光。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME wags its tail around in graceful and flowing motions, which, while useful for fishing, unfortunately also ends up catching the eye of flying predator Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME以潜藏精神力量操纵磁力法则。尚未熟练，因此常烧坏附近电子设备。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME uses its latent psychic power to manipulate the laws of magnetism. It hasn't mastered this ability just yet, and tends to fry electronics around it.

entry: POKENAME的两颗头性格迥异，左头外向合群，右头却喜欢独处。它们常自己与自己争吵，弄得心情十分多变。
author: camtft
source: The heads of POKENAME have wildly differing personalities. While the left head is outgoing and social, the right head prefers to be alone. This leads to them being very moody due to the many arguments with themselves that they go through.

entry: POKENAME通过粉色尖刺引导精神能量。能量用尽，就闭壳，缓缓恢复。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME channel their psychic energy through their pink spikes. Once they run out of energy, they will shut their shells and slowly recharge.

entry: POKENAME几乎一看见路人就催眠，却无恶意，只是渴望旋舞搭档。催眠能让旁人更好跟上节奏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will hypnotize passersby almost immediately upon spotting them, but not out of any sense of malice. It simply craves partners in its twirling dance, and hypnosis better allows others to follow its rhythm properly.

entry: POKENAME优雅绕敌而舞，灵腿朝意料之外的方向精准闪躲。壳虽厚重，双钳仍能细巧地夹起微小物品。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME elegantly dance around opponents, using their flexible legs to perform precise dodges in unexpected directions. Despite their bulky shells, a POKENAME's claws are able to grab and lift tiny items with delicate precision.

entry: POKENAME会帮助妙蛙种子群理解人类情绪，教它们避开想利用自己的对象。
author: zyemis1
source: POKENAME can be seen helping groups of Bulbasaur understand the emotions of people, teaching them to avoid those who seek to use them.

entry: POKENAME举起武器，就吸收附近所有宝可梦的情绪。强烈悲伤或愤怒，能让精神能力增强十倍。
author: dodoowner_
source: When POKENAME raises its weapon, it absorbs the emotions of all nearby Pokémon. Intense feelings of sorrow or anger amplify its psychic ability tenfold.

entry: 精神感知太敏锐，POKENAME便躲在废矿，以水晶媒介观察外界。训练家若聚得太多，就会发狂，试图用猛烈地震震塌地道。
author: ghostslythe
source: Due to its psychic sensitivity, POKENAME hides in abandoned mines, watching the outside world on its crystalline focus. If too many Trainers gather inside its home, it goes mad, attempting to collapse the tunnel with vicious Earthquakes.

entry: POKENAME极专注，将热情凝进每脚，腿随敌人距离伸长。与训练家羁绊越深，踢击就能伸得越远。
author: pattybgoode
source: Focusing intensely, POKENAME channels its passion into each kick, its legs stretching to match the distance from its foe. The deeper the bond a Trainer has with POKENAME, the farther it can reach with its kicks.

entry: POKENAME忠心保护训练家。精神力量若失效，还能靠蛮力，以身体撞击对手。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME loyally protects its Trainer from harm. If its psychic powers fail, it can always rely on its brute strength to body-check its opponent.

entry: POKENAME保护幼鱼宝可梦，连其他物种也不例外。以精神力量迅速穿行激流，并察觉潜在威胁。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are protective of young fish Pokémon, even those of other species. Using their psychic powers, they can swiftly maneuver even through turbulent waters and detect potential threats.

entry: POKENAME借三只角与胸前生物发光器官，驾驭强大精神力量。既能推动水中移动，也能为幼崽造洞，保护旁人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can harness remarkable psychic power via their three horns and the bioluminescent organ in their chests. POKENAME use their psychic powers to propel themselves through water, to shape burrows for their young, and to protect others.

entry: POKENAME飞过花园，留意下方虫属性宝可梦。行为太放肆，就从翅膀散安抚粉，使其冷静。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flutters over flower gardens, monitoring the behavior of Bug-types below. If their behavior gets too unruly, it spreads a pacifying powder from its wings to calm them down.

entry: POKENAME与忠诚的海星星搭档作战，以随身魔杖指挥。有人相信，这个物种来自宇宙遥远的另一星系。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fights in tandem with a loyal Staryu partner, directing it with a wand it carries. Some believe the species came from another galaxy somewhere far away in space.

entry: 它以谨慎脚步与优雅手臂，编排无形防线，护住信任者。表演时，借幻象与细腻心灵感应，演出整篇故事。
author: jaminmcready
source: With careful steps and graceful arms, it choreographs invisible defenses around those it trusts. In performances, it can mimic entire stories through illusion and subtle telepathy.

entry: POKENAME在合众默片演出后大受欢迎。如今常见在街头表演，运用本领，牢牢吸住观众目光。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME rose to popularity after being used in silent films in Unova. Nowadays, it is common to see POKENAME perform on the streets, using their skills to create performances that capture their audiences' gaze.

entry: POKENAME天生惧怕、厌恶虫属性宝可梦。一被对上，就躲到训练家身后。训练它克服恐惧，需要耐心与投入。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a natural fear and disgust for Bug-type Pokémon and will retreat behind their Trainer if confronted with one. Training a POKENAME to overcome this phobia takes patience and dedication.

entry: POKENAME优雅滑过月照树林，精神力量使附近花朵骤然盛开。身上宝石储月光，释放后织成催眠花瓣风暴，安抚同伴，或以藤蔓缚敌。
author: cerealjamalt
source: POKENAME gracefully glides through moonlit groves, its psychic power coaxing every nearby flower to suddenly bloom. The jewels on its body store moonlight; when released, they weave hypnotic petal-storms that soothe allies or bind foes in vines.

entry: POKENAME形态古怪，水陆都行动不便。身体脆弱、精神力量平平，却至少总愿勇敢尝试，保护珍爱对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's odd form leaves it with poor mobility no matter whether it is in water or on land. Despite a frail body and middling psychic powers, it always at least attempts to valiantly protect those it cares for.

entry: POKENAME身体虽弱，念力却能保护自己与旁人。定期释放舒缓精神脉冲，降低周围攻击欲，使家园更安宁。
author: sk372
source: Though physically weak, POKENAME's telekinesis lets it protect itself and others from harm. It regularly sends out a calming mental pulse that lowers aggression in those surrounding it, making its home that much more peaceful.

entry: 它必须不断约束脾气，磨炼精神力量。压住怒气，能力便稳定增强。强大POKENAME终于释放时，能将敌人放逐到时间尽头。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It must constantly discipline its temper to sharpen its psychic powers. By bottling up its rage, it steadily amplifies its abilities. When a strong POKENAME finally unleashes, it can banish its foes to the end of time.

entry: POKENAME适应力强，聪明、美丽，又有精神力量，因此在丰缘被视为王室宠物。
author: thegeon2023
source: POKENAME are considered royal pets in the Hoenn region thanks to their adaptability, intelligence, beauty, and psychic power.

entry: POKENAME内有火囊，始终温热，拥抱舒服。能吐独特色彩的粉火，燃烧时似乎闪闪发亮。
author: sk372
source: The flame sac inside POKENAME always keeps it heated and ideal for comfortably warm hugs. It can breathe out a uniquely-colored pink flame that seems to sparkle while it burns.

entry: POKENAME栖山峰，巡视领地。一见宝可梦争斗，就俯冲插入双方之间，以精神脉冲强行分开，结束打斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME perches atop mountain peaks surveying its territory. If it spots a fight between Pokémon, it swoops down and gets between the combatants and stops the fight, forcibly separating them with psychic pulses.

entry: POKENAME住在偏僻、花朵遍布的海崖。常用精神力量选花采摘，做成插花，个体极其罕见。
author: ocxin
source: POKENAME inhabit secluded, isolated coastal cliffsides full of flowers. They can often be seen picking them for arrangements, selecting them using their psychic powers. They are exceedingly rare.

entry: 融合令食欲大增，每天要吃数百磅食物。这些养分，正供给它无可比拟的超能力。
author: skymaster426
source: Its appetite grows when it is fused, motivating it to eat several hundreds of pounds of food each day. This food fuels its unmatched psychic powers.

entry: 许多故事讲，POKENAME会瞬移到冰原迷路的旅人面前，带至安全。抵达后绝不久留，随一阵闪亮细雪，再度消失。
author: sk372
source: Many a tale has been told of POKENAME teleporting before travelers lost in frigid wastelands and carrying them to safety. Once they arrive, it never lingers, vanishing once more in a burst of sparkling powdery snow.

entry: 融合让POKENAME对谁都极善良忠诚。但控制不住精神力量，只得退到孤洞，强行赶走任何闯入者。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Fusion has resulted in POKENAME being extremely kind and loyal to everyone. However, it is unable to control its psychic powers, so it retreats to isolated caves and forcefully removes anyone who trespasses.

entry: POKENAME既不愿社交，又渴望亲密陪伴，心意矛盾。与训练家结下羁绊后，便极忠诚，也极不情愿靠近其他人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses a conflicting mix of antisocial tendencies with a want for close companionship. Once it bonds with a Trainer, it is fiercely loyal and extremely reluctant to be around anyone else.

entry: 它们残存的任何怜悯，都被天生暴力扭曲。POKENAME保护训练家时十分可怕，动用力量，迅速解决对手。
author: thatlittletwerp
source: Any shred of compassion that these Pokémon still possess is distorted through their innately violent disposition. A POKENAME acting in defense of its Trainer is a fearsome sight, as it uses its powers to swiftly dispatch opponents.

entry: POKENAME能察觉情绪、预见危险，借精神力量瞬间复制任何招式，保护训练家。
author: TanglyAtol9866
source: POKENAME can sense emotions and foresee incoming danger. It uses its psychic powers to instantly copy any move to protect its Trainer.

entry: 它是建筑大师。一找到合适地点，就会吐丝织出由桥梁、巢穴和复杂陷阱组成的高效网络。
author: vaporvenator
source: A master architect. Once it finds a suitable area, it spins its webbing to build a remarkably efficient network of bridges, nests, and complex traps.

entry: POKENAME十分爱护其他鸟类宝可梦，总会尽可能保护它们。它鼓起胸膛，让自己显得更大，威吓旁人，希望不必直接动武，也能守护同伴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is highly protective of other avian Pokémon and works to defend them wherever possible. It puffs its chest up to seem larger and intimidate others in the hopes that it can protect others without resorting directly to violence.

entry: POKENAME爱植物，将其排成华美悦目的图案。艺术才华深受博物馆馆长喜爱，常请它作展示，填补空间。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME loves plants and arranges them in florid patterns that are appealing to the eye. Their artistry makes them popular among museum curators who need a good display to fill up space.

entry: 与训练家羁绊够深，POKENAME的精神力量就能造出反重力场。
author: bandedbodypress
source: With a strong enough bond with their Trainer, POKENAME's psychic power creates an anti-gravity field.

entry: 流传几个故事，说POKENAME误造黑洞后，累得自己也掉进去。有些地方甚至因潜在危险，禁止它们。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: There are several stories of POKENAME accidentally creating black holes, then being so tired from the effort, they fall into them. Some places even ban them for the danger they could pose.

entry: POKENAME独特的分割外形，被一些人视为善恶两面与平衡。以奇异精神力量，为善心者赐福，对恶人施咒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's uniquely divided image is said by some to represent the duality and balance of good and evil. It uses a strange psychic power to grant boons to the kindhearted and to cast hexes upon the wicked.

entry: POKENAME尾巴敏锐感知周围情绪与动机。察觉恶意，就提醒主头，便能以强精神能力，保护自己或旁人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tail has a sharp sense for the emotions and motives of those around it. It alerts the main head to any ill intentions nearby so that POKENAME can defend itself or others with its powerful psychic abilities.

entry: POKENAME能感知最远2英里处的情绪与意图。若察觉恶人，身体便开始沸腾，试着慢慢蠕动爬向对方。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can sense emotions and intentions from up to 2 miles away. If it detects a malicious person, its body begins to boil as it attempts to squirm in their direction at a crawling pace.

entry: 据说POKENAME头宝石能带来好运健康，因此遭人捕猎。宝石一被取走，珊瑚般身体就会虚弱易损，失去全部色彩。
author: infinex21
source: The gem upon a POKENAME's head is said to bring fortune and health, which has led some people to hunt their kind. If its gem is removed, its coral-like body will become weak, frail, and it will lose all color.

entry: POKENAME本领适合帮助训练家捕捉或迁移野生宝可梦。射出的精神子弹，连最凶猛者也能安抚、制住不动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is well-equipped to help Trainers capture or relocate Pokémon in the wild. It fires out psychic bullets that pacify and immobilize even the most aggressive of Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME漫游雪原，自顾唱歌。训练家若低落，就从袋里送出物品，想让对方开心。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME sings to itself as it wanders through snowfields. If its Trainer is feeling down, POKENAME will gift them an item from its bag to cheer them up.

entry: POKENAME多见于山区，封住较险的区域，引导徒步者等人走更安全的通道。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can typically be found around mountain areas, blocking off the more treacherous areas and guiding hikers and the like towards safer passages through the area.

entry: POKENAME极仁慈，游荡树林，寻找迷失探险者，救其性命。特殊角随感知的情绪种类变色。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an extremely benevolent creature that roams the woods in search of lost explorers in order to save their lives. Its special horns change color depending on the type of emotion it is sensing.

entry: POKENAME极仁慈，游荡树林，寻找迷失探险者，救其性命。特殊角随感知的情绪种类变色。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an extremely benevolent creature that roams the woods in search of lost explorers in order to save their lives. Its special horns change color depending on the type of emotion it is sensing.

entry: POKENAME极仁慈，游荡树林，寻找迷失探险者，救其性命。特殊角随感知的情绪种类变色。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an extremely benevolent creature that roams the woods in search of lost explorers in order to save their lives. Its special horns change color depending on the type of emotion it is sensing.

entry: 强精神能力能造保护屏障，让内部对象不被敌人看见。POKENAME极仁慈，游荡树林，寻找迷失探险者，救其性命。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its powerful psychic abilities allow it to create protective barriers that hide anyone within them from the eyes of enemies. POKENAME is an extremely benevolent creature that roams the woods in search of lost explorers in order to save their lives.

entry: POKENAME是初露头角的武者，对每个敌人都极尊重。每战前后必鞠躬，感谢磨炼发育中身体的机会。
author: sk372
source: A budding martial artist, POKENAME treats each of its opponents with the utmost respect. It always gives a bow before and after every battle as thanks for the opportunity to hone its developing body.

entry: 它对其他生灵极敏感，借此精准使出高速回旋踢，击中敌人。
author: cyboobr
source: This Pokémon is highly sensitive to the presence of other creatures. It uses this to precisely strike foes with high-speed spinning kicks.

entry: 外界观感与庞大身形，让它们缺乏自信。训练家给一颗龙火果，便有片刻清明，找到奋战取胜所需的信心。
author: quackquackattack
source: They struggle with self-confidence due to their public perception and otherwise bulky body. When a Trainer gives them a Petaya Berry, they gain a moment of clarity which helps them gain the self-confidence needed to push to victory.

entry: 悉心养大的POKENAME常小心盘绕训练家，保护周全，不过有时只是自私地想讨关注。能向敌人喷出致幻毒液。
author: infinex21
source: A well-raised POKENAME will often carefully coil around its Trainer protectively, although sometimes it may do so selfishly for the sake of attention. They can spit a psychedelic poison at their foes.

entry: 刺耳的尖啸，先让敌人动弹不得。随后注入的毒液，便锁紧关节，令皮肤冰冷、苍白。
author: vaporvenator
source: Its piercing screech renders foes unable to move. It then delivers a venom that locks up their joints and leaves them with cold, pale skin.

entry: 融合技术还未普及时，人们曾把POKENAME当作蛇发女妖。古老传说称，POKENAME的目光能将生灵石化。
author: hypersonic06
source: POKENAME were once believed to be Gorgons before fusion was commonplace. Old legends claimed that POKENAME's gaze could turn creatures to stone.

entry: POKENAME或许是最友善忠诚的宝可梦之一。平静、关爱而护人的性格，很适合陪伴、照顾幼童。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is perhaps one of the most friendly and loyal of Pokémon. Its calm, caring and protective nature makes it ideal as a companion and caretaker for young children.

entry: POKENAME以尾引导精神能量，放出阵阵雷鸣，能同一瞬间震晕敌人、安抚伙伴。
author: sanserof
source: POKENAME channels psychic energy through its tail, releasing bursts of thunder that can stun foes and calm allies in the same instant.

entry: POKENAME用精神能量操控身周飘钻，钻穿石头。自卫时，也会如此操控裙上甲片。
author: kduffradio
source: POKENAME manipulates the drills floating around it with Psychic energy to bore through stone. To defend itself, it will do the same with the armored plates on its dress.

entry: 披风的火焰纹样，随POKENAME当前情绪变色。准备战斗时，可见袖中迸火。
author: fiordaliso
source: The flame-shaped patterns on its cloak change color according to the emotions POKENAME is feeling at the moment. When it prepares for battle, flames can be seen bursting from its sleeves.

entry: 披风的火焰纹样，随POKENAME当前情绪变色。准备战斗时，可见袖中迸火。
author: fiordaliso
source: The flame-shaped patterns on its cloak change color according to the emotions POKENAME is feeling at the moment. When it prepares for battle, flames can be seen bursting from its sleeves.

entry: POKENAME是最善良、最爱和平的宝可梦之一。绝不现身纷争地；若冲突被强加到身边，也不伤害，只把自己或危险瞬移去别处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is one of the kindest and most pacifistic Pokémon in existence. It never appears where there is strife, and should conflict forcibly come to it, it will do no harm and simply teleport itself or the danger somewhere else.

entry: POKENAME听得懂人话。想养聪明又容易照顾的宝可梦，它是理想选择。
author: thegeon2023
source: POKENAME can understand human speech. It is a perfect choice for those who want an intelligent and easy-to-care-for Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME群通常见于最繁茂的森林，为树木和其他宝可梦产生生命能量。
author: thegeon2023
source: POKENAME packs are normally found in the most abundant forest areas. They generate vital energy for the trees and other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME天生笨拙，却用精神能量支撑自己，防止跌倒。训练家若遇险，就耗尽内火，凝成巨大火球保护。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: While naturally clumsy, POKENAME uses its psychic energy to support itself and prevent falling. If POKENAME's Trainer is in danger, this Pokémon will expend all of its internal fire in one massive fireball to protect them.

entry: POKENAME脚步轻盈灵巧，靠精神能量与训练迅速移动。极忠诚，会为珍爱对象战到最后一口气。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are light and nimble on their feet, relying on their psychic energy and training to move swiftly. This Pokémon is extremely loyal and will fight until its last breath to protect those it cares for.

entry: POKENAME在肉搏与超能力战斗上都天赋异禀，一心寻求严苛锻炼磨练本领，许多训练家反而难以满足它。
author: phantom640
source: A prodigy in both physical and mental combat, POKENAME seeks out rigorous training to hone its skills. This can make it a challenge to train for many.

entry: 状态最佳时，POKENAME手腕始终燃烧。总想找挑战，却把珍爱训练家的心愿放首位。忠诚，乐意为训练家献出生命。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: At peak performance, POKENAME's wrists are constantly burning. They are always looking for a challenge, but respect their beloved Trainer's wishes above all else. They are loyal Pokémon that happily lay down their lives for their Trainer.

entry: POKENAME在严酷与安宁环境都训练，前者磨战技，后者练精神能力。感到训练家遇险，羽毛就会点燃。
author: tristenkalshin
source: POKENAME trains in both harsh and calm environments-harsh to hone its fighting skills, and calm to strengthen its psychic ones. Its feathers ignite when it senses its Trainer is in danger.

entry: POKENAME战时严厉，以精神能力造出残酷念力攻击。战外却温柔共情，常选择照料年幼宝可梦。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME is harsh in battle. It uses its psychic abilities to create brutal telekinetic attacks. Outside of battle, POKENAME is gentle and empathetic, often choosing to care for younger Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME动作超凡优雅从容，舞蹈连最苛刻评论者也能感动落泪。华丽大赛优胜队伍里，常有它一席之地。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME move with unearthly grace and poise, their dances bringing even the harshest critics to tears. POKENAME are a common feature on winning Pokémon Contest teams.

entry: 自身融合让POKENAME精神力量多得离谱，甚至向外溢出。精神波与姿态，让其他生灵感到强势威压。
author: sk372
source: Fusing POKENAME gives it an obscene amount of psychic power, to the point it radiates off of it. The psychic waves it emanates, along with the pose it takes, establish a sense of dominance over other creatures.

entry: POKENAME外形近似超级进化，力量大幅提升，保护本能也增强，因此很少让训练家离开视线。
author: sk372
source: Taking on an appearance similar to Mega Evolution, POKENAME's strength is vastly improved. Its protective instincts are also strengthened, so it rarely lets its Trainer out of its sight.

entry: 融合后，POKENAME呈近似超级进化的形态，力量也升到同等水平。可天性温柔，很少全力运用。
author: sk372
source: After fusing, POKENAME takes on a form similar to Mega Evolution. Its strength increases to the level of the form as well, though its gentle nature means it rarely uses its power at full capacity.

entry: 仿POKENAME外观设计的婚纱越来越常见，因为它被视为爱的象征。若现身婚礼，人们相信新人会永远相伴。
author: sk372
source: Wedding dresses designed after POKENAME's appearance are becoming increasingly common, as POKENAME is seen as a symbol of love. If one should appear at a couple's wedding, it's believed the couple will stay together forever.

entry: 这种自身融合宝可梦，以翅膀形式放出精神能量。虽尤其忠于训练家，附近无辜者一遇险，也会立刻飞去救援。
author: infranscia
source: This self fused Pokémon emits psychic energy in the form of wings.  While especially loyal to its Trainer, it will quickly fly to the aid of any nearby innocents in danger that it may sense.

entry: POKENAME双头带来两倍精神力量，可个性不同，难以协调。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME has two heads, granting it twice the psychic power. Its heads have different personalities, making coordination difficult.

entry: 这是POKENAME配色独特的变种，颇有些恶名。报告称，它常突然出现在家中，挑战训练家，展开令人胆寒的对战。
author: sk372
source: A uniquely-colored variant of POKENAME that has garnered some level of infamy. According to reports, it has a habit of suddenly appearing in homes and challenging Trainers to a harrowing battle against it.

entry: POKENAME自身融合后，呈近似超级进化的形态。变化加深与训练家的羁绊，保护对方的意愿，也变得两倍强。
author: jackjirachi
source: Self fusing POKENAME has caused it to take on a form similar to its Mega Evolution. The change has only deepened its bond with its Trainer, and its drive to protect them is now twice as strong.

entry: POKENAME战时迅捷优雅，与武器浑然共舞，操纵纯熟，旋转护身。武器两端刀刃一亮成鲜粉，几乎什么都能切开。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME moves swiftly and gracefully in battle. It dances as one with its weapon with complete mastery, spinning it around as to defend itself. When the bladed ends of the weapon glow in a bright pink hue, they can cut through almost anything.

entry: POKENAME极少被人目击，曾一度被尊为神明。环绕身边的符印，检测不到生物特征信号。
author: jokerswild
source: Since sightings of POKENAME are so rare, it was once hailed as a deity. The sigils that surround it have no biometric signature.

entry: 它凭四个大脑与心脏预见危险。训练家若受威胁，就会竭尽全力保护。
author: lemgambino
source: It uses its four brains and hearts to foresee danger. If its Trainer is threatened, it will protect them with all its might.

entry: POKENAME决定某树该砍，就在树桩处召小黑洞，再用精神力量，将砍下的原木带回家。
author: rodotom
source: Whenever POKENAME decides that a tree needs to but cut down, it will summon a small black hole at its stump and use its psychic powers to bring the chopped log back to its home.

entry: POKENAME喜欢把出场弄得轰动，精神能量闪亮，表情夸张。拉鲁拉丝似乎尤其着迷。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys making a spectacle of its appearance, with sparkles of psychic energy and exaggerated expressions. Ralts in particular seem captivated by these displays.

entry: 每次POKENAME从命匣现身，心智就会连上世界某处108个不同人类。必须与涌来的情绪抗衡，战斗时也一样。
author: .izik
source: Each time POKENAME emerges from its phylactery, its mind links with 108 different humans somewhere in the world. It must wrestle with the emotions it receives from these people, even during combat.

entry: 它是奇异幽灵，将自身投进选定受害者的电视。POKENAME爬出屏幕，作祟七天，再消失，另选目标。
author: sk372
source: A strange ghostly spirit that projects itself into a chosen victim's television. POKENAME crawls out from the screen and haunts their home for seven days before vanishing and choosing another.

entry: 它是奇异幽灵，投身电视屏幕。POKENAME爬出来，纠缠选定受害者，可有人认为，这只是它古怪的示爱。
author: sk372
source: A strange ghostly spirit that projects itself into television screens. POKENAME crawls out of the TV and haunts a chosen victim, though some believe this is a strange show of affection on its part.

entry: 野生POKENAME会办选美，胜者成为首领。若被弄脏，就会边用精神能量麻痹对手，边将其吞食。
author: weirdmageddonprepper_93813
source: Wild POKENAME have been known to host beauty pageants, the winner of which is chosen to lead the group. If a wild POKENAME is made dirty, it will use psychic energy to paralyze its opponent as it devours them.

entry: POKENAME护伙伴，内心却仍懒。许多训练家不得不面对它用精神力量把自己留在近处，好省去移动，也能保安全。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is protective of companions, but still lazy at heart. Most Trainers must contend with it using psychic powers to keep them close so POKENAME need not move much to keep them safe.

entry: POKENAME能感知灾难，又善良护人，成为各地区许多城镇喜爱的守护者。即使强者，只见它在旁，也常能安心。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's disaster sense, coupled with its kind nature and protective instincts, make it a beloved guardian to many towns across the regions. Just seeing a POKENAME nearby is enough to give many stronger individuals peace of mind.

entry: POKENAME带着小群阿勃梭鲁游历世界，特意引导它们助人救援，盼能逐渐改善阿勃梭鲁的坏名声。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME travels the world, leading small packs of Absol along. It makes a show of guiding the Absol to help and rescue others, so that Absol's poor reputation may be positively changed over time.

entry: POKENAME赶走墓地与陵墓边的恶灵，也听悲伤家庭讲述逝者往事，给予帮助。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME ward off malevolent spirits near graveyards and mausoleums. They also help grieving families by listening to their memories of the departed.

entry: POKENAME是温柔海中巨兽，以巨身保护无力自卫者。谁威胁受照料者，就会被巨大精神压力压碎。
author: sk372
source: A gentle giant of the sea, POKENAME uses its huge body to defend smaller creatures that can't defend themselves. Those that threaten its charges are crushed with immense psychic pressure.

entry: POKENAME巨大又善良，极怕伤人。常静坐水边，观看旁人，丝毫不动，避免可能伤到谁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's gargantuan size and kind nature make it deathly afraid of harming others. It often sits quietly at the water's edge, watching others and staying perfectly still to avoid potentially hurting anyone.

entry: POKENAME既护人又好斗，自任尼多朗幼崽的守护者。任何东西靠太近，都冲上去角刺，以灌入精神力量的毒，制住受害者。
author: sk372
source: Protective and aggressive, POKENAME appoints itself as a guardian of young Nidoran. Anything that gets too close will be charged down and stabbed with its horn, which immobilizes the victim with its psychically-charged venom.

entry: POKENAME忠诚善良，守望苔原家园的冰属性宝可梦。头上三只角能造精神能量球，扰乱被击中目标的重力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME watches over the Ice types in the tundra it calls home as a loyal and kind guardian. The three horns on its head can generate orbs of psychic energy that disrupt the gravity of the target they hit.

entry: POKENAME以超能力预知未来。若看见持有者将有危险，就会挥刃劈开黑洞，保护对方。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME uses its psychic senses to see into the future, and if it sees its wielder is in danger, will slice open a black hole in their defense.

entry: POKENAME天性爱和平，遇袭几乎只防御。朋友受威胁，却会拔剑，毫不留情地果断出击，数秒内结束战斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is pacifistic by nature, acting almost entirely defensively if attacked. If its friends are threatened, however, it draws its blade and strikes mercilessly and decisively to end the battle in seconds.

entry: POKENAME的眼受精神力量增强，能看见不同时间线，再用这些知识，选出最有利训练家的道路。
author: 4amhyena
source: POKENAME's psychic power enhances its eyes, allowing it to see alternate timelines. It then uses this knowledge to choose the path most beneficial to its Trainer.

entry: 尾边感应器能察觉附近人最细微的情绪变化。若训练家遇险，它的电击就会威力惊人。
author: fiordaliso
source: The sensors around its tail can detect even the slightest emotional changes in people nearby. If its Trainer is in danger, its electric attacks become devastating.

entry: 身体由极密岩石构成，沉得动不了。它集中全部精神力量，才得以移动自身。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its body is made up of extremely dense rock, too heavy for it to move around. It focuses all of its psychic power on being able to move its own body.

entry: POKENAME用超能力幻象躲开人类。若与训练家建立深厚感情，就会不惜一切守护对方。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME makes psychic illusions to hide itself from humans. If it becomes close to its Trainer, it will do everything its power to protect them.

entry: POKENAME凭控水力，不用游泳，就能在水中往任何方向移动。这些共情的湖居者常救溺水者，也可能效忠、守护值得的训练家。
author: draconicsanguineice
source: POKENAME can move through water in any direction without swimming by using hydrokinesis. These empathetic lake Pokémon frequently rescue the drowning and may pledge loyalty and protection to worthy Trainers.

entry: POKENAME覆着层层流瀑般的鳍，亮如静水月光。它守湖、能读情绪，以发光精神水流裹住训练家，恶意无从穿透。
author: cerealjamalt
source: POKENAME is veiled in cascading fins that shimmer like moonlight on still water. This lake guardian can read emotions of those around it and it will wrap its Trainer in a glowing psychic current that no malice can pierce.

entry: 野生POKENAME常以大翼庇护年幼或弱小宝可梦，也让它们骑背。靠精神力量，几乎能无视重力。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME will often use their large wings to shield younger and, or, weaker Pokémon and even allow them to ride on their backs. Thanks to its psychic powers, it can largely ignore the effects of gravity.

entry: POKENAME以非凡精神力量悬空。训练家若陷重大危险，齿轮就倒转，造黑洞，试着救人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME wield remarkable psychic powers that keep them aloft. If a POKENAME's Trainer  is in grave danger, its gears will spin in reverse and create a black hole to try and save them.

entry: POKENAME外表凶猛，却善良而爱照料，愿以生命保护信任者。神秘力量强，又能造幻象，足以压倒多数敌人。
author: infinex21
source: Despite its fierce appearance, POKENAME is a kind and nurturing Pokémon that will protect those it trusts with its very life. It wields immense mystical powers and the ability to conjure illusions, both of which allow it to overwhelm most foes.

entry: POKENAME结合精神能量与幻象，保护自身、幼崽和朋友。力量强到违抗重力，因此能极快移动。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME wield psychic energies and illusion-conjuring abilities in tandem to protect themselves, their young, and their friends. Their psychic powers are great enough for them to defy gravity, making them capable of incredibly quick movements.

entry: POKENAME释放大量心灵感应能量，能安抚最远1000米的人。距离越远，效果越弱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases large bursts of telepathic energy capable of soothing people from up to 1000 meters away. The effect wanes the further one is from it.

entry: POKENAME对信任的训练家极忠诚亲昵。可拥抱时常忘了力气多大，因此有许多意外伤人的报告。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are highly loyal and affectionate towards a trusted Trainer. However, POKENAME have been known to forget their strength when they go to hug their Trainers, leading to many reports of accidental injury.

entry: POKENAME能将恶意生物放逐进黑洞，再也无人见到。幸好性情似乎平稳，即使愤怒，也绝不贸然使用。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has the ability to banish ill-meaning creatures into a black hole, never to be seen again. Thankfully, it seems to be very even-keel: even in anger, it will never use this ability prematurely.

entry: POKENAME轻易在地点间开传送门，转瞬远行。性情轻快多变，常突然出现，找喜欢的对象玩或恶作剧。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME opens portals between locations with ease, traveling great distances in mere moments. It has a flighty personality, often showing up out of nowhere to play or prank those it is fond of.

entry: POKENAME曾常为王室血脉效力，保护城堡与其中所有人。坚固甲身能承受任何攻击，再从前方圆球放出多种元素能量反击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME was often seen in the service of those of royal lineage, protecting castles and all those within them. Its sturdy armored body withstood any attack, and it could retaliate with a myriad of elemental energies from the orbs on its front.

entry: 保护珍爱者的战斗若真到绝境，POKENAME便合上头盔，几乎关闭怜悯本能。为不惜一切获胜，会使出足以撕裂大陆的力量。
author: sk372
source: If a battle to protect those it holds dear becomes truly dire, POKENAME closes its helmet and essentially shuts off its merciful instinct. Driven by a desire for victory at all costs, it fights with power enough to tear a continent asunder.

entry: POKENAME把可怕机械身体的每一分力，都用于保护珍爱训练家和朋友。怕被淘汰，若不定期获准替训练家战斗，就会越来越反常。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME dedicates every ounce of its fearsome mechanical body to protect its beloved Trainer and friends. It fears obsolescence and will become increasingly erratic if not regularly allowed to fight on its Trainer's behalf.

entry: POKENAME用毛发监测周围的精神能量，察觉危险，因此格外在意头发是否干净。
author: phantom640
source: POKENAME's hair lets it monitor the surrounding psychic energy to detect danger. Because of this, it's very sensitive about keeping its hair clean.

entry: POKENAME忠诚，保护训练家远离邪恶堕落。自视为对抗腐败的英雄，帮助别人时颇为自豪。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is a loyal Pokémon that protects its Trainer from evil and depravity. It views itself as a hero fighting corruption and exhibits a certain pride in helping others.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，善用身体的每个部分。据说，满月时若训练家遇险，它保护对方的愿望会强烈到让身体发生奇异变化。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME uses every part of its body to its advantage in a fight. It's said that when POKENAME's Trainer is in danger during a full moon, its desire to protect them becomes so powerful that its body undergoes a strange transformation.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，善用身体的每个部分。据说，满月时若训练家遇险，它保护对方的愿望会强烈到让身体发生奇异变化。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME uses every part of its body to its advantage in a fight. It's said that when POKENAME's Trainer is in danger during a full moon, its desire to protect them becomes so powerful that its body undergoes a strange transformation.

entry: POKENAME擅战，能击败大得多的敌人。唯一胜过武艺的，是对训练家的爱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are adept fighters capable of taking down foes much larger than themselves. The only thing greater than their fighting prowess is their affection for their Trainer.

entry: POKENAME多在深夜逛城，常闯进商店试穿各种衣服。人偶般的外貌，让多数人以为在玩换装。
author: cerealjamalt
source: When POKENAME is exploring the towns, it's usually late at night. POKENAME is often seen breaking into stores to try on different clothes. Most believe it's playing dress-up due to its doll-like appearance.

entry: 为随时留意训练家，POKENAME会附身对方拥有、位置最近的电子设备。虽出于好意，却让耗电速度变为平常三倍。
author: sk372
source: To keep a close eye on its Trainer, POKENAME will inhabit the nearest electronic device in their possession. Though it means well, the possession causes the item's power to drain at triple the usual rate.

entry: POKENAME本体小，会伸出巨大胶状肢体，显得更大。似乎很介意身高，谁拿来开玩笑，就会暴怒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's actual body is small, so it extends large gelatinous limbs to make itself appear bigger. It seems to have a complex about its height, responding very angrily should someone make light of it.

entry: 没人确定POKENAME的镰刀来自哪里，有人猜，是精神力量所生的袖珍空间形成的。先以精神能力把危险敌人拉近，再劈斩。
author: infinex21
source: No one is quite sure where a scythe wielded by a POKENAME comes from, but some theorize it is formed from a pocket dimension born of their psychic powers. They use their psychic abilities to pull dangerous foes toward them before slashing them.

entry: POKENAME织网，宽达数百米，任何角落的细动也能察觉。与许多蛛形类不同，网不为捕猎，而为扩大对领地的观察。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME spin their web to be several hundred metres across and can detect the slightest movement from anywhere across it. Unlike many arachnids, their web is not designed to trap prey, but to give them greater vision over their territory.

entry: POKENAME众眼精准追踪敌人动作，以精神力量造大电网，缠住威胁训练家的一切。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their many eyes to track the movements of their opponents with extreme precision. They use their psychic powers to craft large electric webs to ensnare anything that threatens their Trainers.

entry: POKENAME织网，宽达数百米，任何角落的细动也能察觉。只要感到有什么踩进去，就滑过去查看。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME spin their web to be several hundred metres across and can detect the slightest movement from anywhere across it. If they sense anything walking in it, they glide over to investigate.

entry: POKENAME爱把心爱的人、物包进网里，留在近旁，妥善保护。可察觉对方想走，即使POKENAME难过，也仍会放开。
author: hello_i_exist
source: POKENAME has a tendency to wrap people and things its fond of in webs to keep them close and safe. However, it will let them go if they sense they wish to be freed, even if it saddens POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME住在废弃豪宅，点亮收集的枝形烛台，想引来新伙伴。火触之不灼，反勾起快乐回忆的暖意。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Dwelling within abandoned mansions, POKENAME light collected candelabras in an attempt to lure in new companions. Their flames do not burn to the touch, but instead bring up warm feelings of happy memories.

entry: POKENAME利牙覆着精神能量，刚好钝到每次攻击都不致命。伤口会慢慢消磨敌人斗志，直到精疲力竭倒下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's sharp tusks are coated with a psychic energy that dulls them just enough to ensure their strikes are always nonlethal. Cuts inflicted by POKENAME slowly sap the fighting spirit of foes until they collapse from exhaustion.

entry: POKENAME会寻找拉鲁拉丝，保护它们，再带到食物充足、遮蔽完善的安全地方。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME seeks out Ralts to protect them from harm. It then takes them to a safe place with plenty of shelter and food.

entry: POKENAME以巨型金属身躯，护住无力自卫的弱小宝可梦。极聪明，出手前先算出最佳攻击计划。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME protect weaker Pokémon that are incapable of defending themselves, using its giant metal body to shield them from harm. They are incredibly intelligent, calculating the best plan of attack before making their move.

entry: POKENAME是顽皮爱闹的自然精灵。叶环的触须会拿走毫无防备旅人的钥匙和小饰物，再以看着对方追来讨还为乐。
author: sk372
source: A playful prankster of a nature spirit, the tendrils of POKENAME's leafy wreath reach out to take keys and other tiny trinkets from unsuspecting travelers, so it can revel in making them chase after it to retrieve the stolen items.

entry: POKENAME以精神力量几乎无视重力，达到高速。也会举起朋友与训练家，一起在空中飞行。
author: infinex21
source: Using their psychic powers, POKENAME can largely ignore gravity and achieve great speeds. They will use these same powers to lift their friends and Trainers into the air to fly alongside them.

entry: POKENAME将保护训练家推到暴力极端。若找不到，就会为寻人毁掉整座城市。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME takes protecting its Trainer to a violent extreme. If it cannot find its Trainer, POKENAME will devastate an entire city to look for them.

entry: POKENAME密羽折光，隐藏身形。极忠于珍爱者，以光学伪装默默跟随，随时准备放精神屏障保护。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME has dense plumage that bends light to conceal it from sight. Fiercely devoted to its loved ones, it uses this optical camouflage to silently shadow them, ready to unleash psychic shields to protect them.

entry: 收服后的POKENAME，只有靠近训练家才睡得着。人们认为，它能读取最亲密伙伴的心思。
author: bobosmith01
source: Caught POKENAME will be unable to sleep until it is near its Trainer. It is thought to be able to read the minds of its closest partner.

entry: 传说谁未经许可碰尾，POKENAME就抹掉记忆。精神力量巨大，能将无防备的宝可梦压倒在地。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to legend, POKENAME erases the memories of anyone who dares to touch one of its tails without permission. Its psychic powers are so immense that they can crush unprepared Pokémon to the ground.

entry: POKENAME因接触外星辐射，能以快得看不清的速度打出重击。也获得独特歌声，空灵音色受全世界喜爱。
author: vlavoc
source: POKENAME can deliver devastating blows at blinding speeds due to its exposure to extraterrestrial radiation. It has also gained a unique singing voice, which is adored worldwide for its otherworldly sound.

entry: POKENAME心地善良，用精神能力为别人做饼干。可太容易出意外，常跌一跤，弄丢所有成品。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are kind souls, using their psychic abilities to make cookies for others. POKENAME are unfortunately accident-prone, often tripping and losing everything they've made.

entry: POKENAME深埋沙里，凭精神感知观察地面生灵。猎物一近，就从下方念力定住，再挖出来，用颚抓走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME buries itself deep in the sand, its psychic senses letting it perceive creatures above-ground. Once prey wanders close, it immobilizes them with telekinesis from below, digging up to snatch them in its jaws.

entry: POKENAME特意调整精神频率，感知悲伤或害怕的孩子。找到后便靠近，任其抱住，绳带被握着，会带来暖和舒缓的感觉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME specifically tunes its psychic frequency to sense children feeling sad or frightened. If it detects one, it goes to them and lets them hold onto it, its strings granting a warm and soothing sensation to the child when held.

entry: POKENAME平常温顺善良，可训练家一受侮辱，就难以制止。以强精神冲击进攻，用精神能量造阳伞状盾自卫。
author: sondededoo
source: While it is normally docile and kind by nature, POKENAME are difficult to stop once their trainer is insulted. They attack using powerful psychic blasts, and defend themselves with parasol-like shield generated from psionic energy.

entry: 它善良，气度如王，很少狠得下心与人战斗。POKENAME爱吃蘑菇，据说也很擅长烤美味蛋糕。
author: sk372
source: A kind creature with a regal air, POKENAME can rarely bring itself to fight against others. It has a taste for mushrooms, and it's said it is rather adept at baking delicious cakes.

entry: POKENAME害羞和善，爱陪训练家。见陌生者，就把自己冻进冰块，避免社交，却也能迅速瞬移脱身。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are shy yet amiable creatures that enjoy their Trainer's company. When meeting strangers, they freeze themselves in a block of ice to avoid social interaction, but can easily escape with a quick teleport.

entry: POKENAME飘在寒地，以精神力量察觉旅人。引善心训练家穿过寒冷，并以冻息保护，抵挡好斗宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats around frigid areas, its psychic powers alerting it to the presence of travelers. It guides goodhearted Trainers through the cold, using its freezing breath to defend them from aggressive Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME爱想象自己是蒙面英雄，四处制止犯罪。对上强敌，还会来一场戏剧般的变身。
author: victor9106
source: POKENAME likes to imagine itself as a masked hero, going around stopping crimes. It undergoes a dramatic transformation when fighting a powerful foe.

entry: POKENAME纤细身形罩在白和服下。穿过暴风雪救人，让迷路旅人远离可能误导他们的来者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a lithe form shrouded behind a white kimono. They flutter through snowstorms to rescue lost travelers from those who may lead them astray.

entry: POKENAME以礼貌举止与大阳伞藏住感情。可一开心或心生爱意，空中就飘雪，怎么想藏也没用。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hide behind polite mannerisms and their large parasol to disguise their feelings. Snowflakes flutter through the air whenever they feel happy or affectionate, despite their effort to conceal them.

entry: POKENAME通常有礼害羞，不知如何交流，就躲在阳伞后。偶尔失态，会慌得唤起暴风雪，遮住脸。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are generally polite but shy creatures, as they hide behind their parasol when they are unsure how to engage. Whenever POKENAME accidentally commit a gaffe, they fluster so profusely that they summon a snowstorm to conceal their face.

entry: 徒步者迷失高山，POKENAME常会施援，靠情绪在猛烈暴风雪中找到。精神力量强到能止住雪崩。
author: sanguinenebula
source: When hikers get lost in high mountains, POKENAME will often go to their aid, sensing their emotions to find them within harsh blizzards. Its psychic powers are strong enough to stop avalanches.

entry: 融合后，POKENAME潜在本能释放，成了狡猾残酷的猎手。即使解除融合，沙奈朵仍会不停咬东西。
author: seaslux
source: When fused, POKENAME's latent instincts are unlocked to make a cunning and brutal hunter. Even if it unfuses, the Gardevoir won't stop biting things.

entry: POKENAME是友善森林精灵，夜里保护迷失林中黑暗的孩子。散出微光，驱赶任何靠近滋事的幽灵属性宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: A friendly forest spirit, POKENAME comes out at night to protect children lost in the darkness of the woods. It radiates a faint light, and repels any other Ghost-type Pokémon that approach and try to cause trouble.

entry: POKENAME定期释放神秘能量，修复生灵直接造成的环境伤害：失控毒性令植物凋萎，火属性宝可梦洒下炽灰，等等。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME periodically releases mystical energy that heals damage done in the environment directly caused by living things: uncontrollably toxic Pokémon causing plants to wilt, fiery ash being rained down by a Fire-type, and so on.

entry: 背壳硬化，保护第二颗脑。角则帮助引导精神能力。
author: hophoppip
source: The shell on its back has hardened to protect its second brain. Its horns help to channel its psychic abilities.

entry: 有人说，POKENAME由魔法与石头造出，守护人类。几个故事讲，它曾突然现身，以精神力量挡住原会夺走旅人性命的山崩落石。
author: sk372
source: Some say POKENAME was created with magic and stone to be a guardian of humanity. Several tales exist of it suddenly appearing and psychically stopping landslides and rockfalls that would have taken the lives of unfortunate travelers.

entry: POKENAME能感知人与宝可梦情绪。难过时不宜靠近，因为安慰的拥抱，强到能折断脊椎。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME can sense the emotional state of humans and Pokémon. It's not advised to approach a POKENAME while sad, as its comforting hugs are strong enough to snap your spine.

entry: 有传闻声称，上半身是诱饵，分散注意，掩护地堡般下半身里的敏感核心。下半身成排的尖刺充满致命毒，能吓退许多敌人。
author: infinex21
source: Some rumors are abound with claims that the upper half of this Pokémon's body is a decoy meant to distract from the sensitive core within the bunker-like lower half. The spikes lining its lower half are filled with deadly toxins that deter many foes.

entry: POKENAME极护背菇。谁想碰，连训练家也会被它动用全部精神力量赶退。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is incredibly protective of the mushrooms on its back. If anyone tries to touch them, even its Trainer, it will drive them back using all the psychic force it can muster.

entry: POKENAME以强精神能力精准控土石，配合迅捷身体攻击。只靠精神能量就能“踏空”，轻松压倒多数敌人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their potent psychic powers to manipulate rock and earth with precision in tandem with their swift, physical strikes. They can walk "on air" with psychic energy alone, allowing them to easily overwhelm most foes.

entry: POKENAME常成群向满月长嚎，从不向挑战者退缩。曾见以精神力投石，为护羁绊训练家，连月亮也能从天上拉下。
author: ghostslythe
source: Known to gather together in packs to howl at the full moon, POKENAME refuses to back down from challengers. They have been seen throwing boulders with their psychic might, and could pull the moon from the sky to protect bonded Trainers.

entry: POKENAME优雅飘浮，散出柔和精神气息。月光下，头边亮粉环放出舒缓能量波，驱噩梦、抚平情绪痛苦。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME levitates gracefully while radiating a gentle psychic aura. Beneath the light of the moon, the glowing pink ring around its head releases soothing waves of energy that banish nightmares and ease emotional pain.

entry: POKENAME精神力量巨大，极其罕见。幸运遇见者会获赠一根羽毛。随后称它进入梦里，挡住噩梦，保证快乐安睡。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: POKENAME wield immense psychic power and are exceptionally rare. Those lucky enough to encounter POKENAME are gifted one of its feathers. They then claim that POKENAME enters their dreams, defending against nightmares and ensuring a joyful slumber.

entry: 战时，POKENAME进入战斗冥想，以大臂出其不意抢攻眼前敌人。小臂同时召精神力量，从远处碾压敌人。
author: ghostslythe
source: During combat, POKENAME enters a state of battle meditation, getting surprise first strikes against direct enemies with its large arms. Meanwhile, its small arms call forth psychic power, crushing foes from afar.

entry: POKENAME以自身精神能力，轻易维持鲜明色彩。许多收藏家称，与它交好后，花园长得快得多。
author: poppyisconfused
source: The vivid colouring on POKENAME is easily maintained by its own psychic powers. According to many collectors, it's stated that their gardens grow much quicker after befriending POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME头顶的卷毛下藏着尖刺，能伸出刺伤敌人，自卫御敌。但它天性温和，唯有别无选择，才会动用这一招。
author: sk372
source: Pointed quills are hidden beneath POKENAME's curl of fur over its head. It can extend these to prick foes in self-defense, but due to its gentle nature this is an absolute last resort of a technique.

entry: POKENAME不愿打，可珍爱者受威胁，就毫不留手。即使冒生命危险，也会抱住同伴，以全身挡下灾难威胁。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME prefers not to fight, but will hold nothing back if those it cares about are threatened. Even at risk of its own life, it will embrace its allies to fully shield them from a cataclysmic threat.

entry: POKENAME杖上圆球是纯粹精神能量，一旦尽放，足以扭曲现实。始终保持专注，只断续放出精神波，或凭空引来火焰。
author: ghostslythe
source: The globe on POKENAME's staff is pure psychic energy, which, if unleashed, would warp reality. It maintains constant focus, only unleashing the power in spurts of Psywaves or channeling fire from thin air.

entry: 据说POKENAME能抹去自身精神特征，连读心者也察觉不到。感知超能力属性宝可梦，就唤醒捕猎本能，跟踪并让其消失。
author: ghostslythe
source: Some say POKENAME has the ability to erase its psychic signature making it invisible even to mind readers. Any sensed Psychic types cause a natural hunting instinct to awaken, driving this Pokémon to stalk them and make them disappear.

entry: POKENAME天性避冲突，喜欢藏水，假扮普通睡莲叶。若看见残酷行为，就继续隐藏，以强精神能量轰击施暴者。
author: sk372
