source: Nonconfrontational by nature, POKENAME prefers hiding in water and pretending to be a simple lily pad. However, if it spies cruel behavior occurring, it blasts the perpetrator with powerful psychic energy while remaining hidden.

entry: 现代许多婚礼教堂都用POKENAME宁静美丽的形象装饰。有人说，它是最纯粹爱情的化身。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's serene and beautiful appearance is used on many wedding chapels in the modern era. Some say it's an embodiment of the purest kind of love.

entry: POKENAME看似无害，实则相反。操纵人类脑波，诱发喜爱，让自己被接回家。很快，贵重物就被这只猫贼偷光。
author: .fedoraman
source: Appearing harmless, POKENAME is anything but, manipulating human brainwaves to induce feelings of endearment so that it gets taken in. Before too long, they will find themselves bereft of their valuables at the hands of this little cat burglar.

entry: 人们发现，这种融合附近，加密的识别码与密码可能变弱，更容易破解。但必须把POKENAME带到目标服务器旁，以现今标准根本不可能。
author: epping_forest
source: It has been discovered that near this fusion, cryptography-based pins and passwords may become weaker and easier to breach. However, for this to happen, POKENAME must be taken near the server to be hacked, which by today's standards is impossible.

entry: 它对训练家的忠诚奉献，几乎无人能比。POKENAME记住气味，甚至脑波，无论身处哪里，都能感知、找到并帮助。
author: sk372
source: A Pokémon of near unparalleled loyalty and devotion to its Trainer. POKENAME will memorize its Trainer's scent and even brainwaves so that no matter where they are, POKENAME will be able to sense, find and aid them.

entry: POKENAME在队里担任队医，宁可避战、治疗同伴。真被逼迫，也能以极强精神能力自卫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME acts as a cleric in its team, preferring to avoid combat and healing its allies instead. If pressed, however, it can use massively powerful psychic abilities to defend itself.

entry: 有些地区称POKENAME为“白衣法师”。它厌恶暴力，尽可能避免争斗。即使不得不战，结束后，也会一并治疗对手与自己。
author: sk372
source: Sometimes referred to as "the Mage in White" in some regions, POKENAME abhors violence and refrains from fighting as much as possible. Even when it does fight, once the battle concludes, it will heal its opponent as well as itself.

entry: POKENAME不懈训练，让心身都保持保护他人的最佳状态。极强个体甚至能从拳头射出精神弹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME trains relentlessly so that both its mind and body are at peak efficiency for protecting others. Extremely powerful POKENAME can even create psychic projectiles launched from their fists.

entry: POKENAME训练举重时，会用念力增加负荷。紧要关头，又减轻自身所受重力，让速度成倍提升。
author: rotcivosk
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to increase the weight it lifts when training. When in a pinch, POKENAME will decrease the force of gravity on itself to become exponentially faster.

entry: POKENAME虽情绪多变、固执，仍与旁人紧密相连，想护其安全。保护本能越受激发，尾火越大。
author: sk372
source: While POKENAME can be moody and stubborn, it forms strong connections with others and seeks to keep them safe. The fire on its tail blazes up in size the more its protective instincts are stoked.

entry: 据说下半身有通往袖珍空间的门，由POKENAME巨大精神力维持。可无法验证，连最信任的训练家，也不准窥探。
author: infinex21
source: It is said that within its lower body resides a portal to a pocket dimension, which is maintained by POKENAME's immense psychic powers. Verification has been impossible, for it will not even allow its most trusted Trainer to peer within.

entry: 它们因高洁品性受敬，古时被赋予守护神庙的职责。如今野生POKENAME仍守古遗迹，攻击胆敢靠近的寻宝者。
author: cobalt0135
source: They have been revered for their noble nature and were given the role of temple guardians in ancient times. Even now, wild POKENAME still protect their ancient ruins and will attack any treasure hunter that dare approach them.

entry: POKENAME以巨大精神力维持整体，很少能被分开。能力扩展，磁能补充精神力，用两种能量保护有羁绊的训练家。
author: vic1312
source: Maintaining its cohesion with prodigious psychic might, POKENAME can rarely be separated. Its capabilities are expanded, supplementing its psychic power with magnetic energy. It uses these twin sources to defend the trainer it has bonded with.

entry: 它们精神力量强大，连游泳也能移动整座冰川。爱陪别人游，不论人类还是宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: They can move entire glaciers with their powerful psychic abilities, even while they are swimming. They love to swim alongside others, be they human or Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME优雅身形与飘逸鳍状部分，启发了某系列海滩服与泳装。明星、社交名流想仿这份优雅，格外喜爱。
author: ocxin
source: POKENAME's elegant body with its flowing, fin-like growths has served as the inspiration for a line of beach clothes and swimwear, popular with stars and socialites seeking to emulate its grace.

entry: POKENAME胶状身体不断产化学物，其中许多能入药。浓缩混合物触之剧毒，因此小心避免直接碰训练家。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's gelatinous body constantly produces chemicals, many of which have medical uses. The concentrated mixture is incredibly toxic to touch, and POKENAME will carefully avoid direct contact with its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME常守着海底幼年宝可梦出生、长大的地方。从壳射出由心灵感应控制的刺，赶走想捕食幼崽的猎手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is often spotted guarding areas where young undersea Pokémon are born and raised. It fires telepathically-controlled spikes from its shell to deter any hunters that would try to prey on the young.

entry: POKENAME战斗正直尊重对手，危险时尤其如此。严格道德准则也可能给日常添麻烦，因为总想当英雄。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME fight with integrity and respect, especially whenever they are in danger. Its strict moral code may cause issues in everyday life because POKENAME always strives to be a hero.

entry: POKENAME战斗从不心怀诡诈，努力成为最强斗士。败时固执尤其明显，因为总不知道何时该放弃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME always fight without perfidious intent and strive to be the best fighter they can become. Their stubbornness often comes out in defeat because they never know when to give up.

entry: POKENAME精准运用精神能力，以能量刃与水刃御敌。为旁人水中作战，身法灵巧，有人叫它“海底骑士”。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME wield psychic abilities with precision to fight off threats using blades of energy and water. Some call them "Undersea Knights" for how they deftly move in water while battling foes for the sake of others.

entry: 它以胸鳍末端与三只角战斗，主要靠正中角。POKENAME能引精神能量，强化攻击，也能迅捷移动。
author: infinex21
source: It fights using the ends of its pectoral fins and its three horns, though it primarily utilizes its centermost horn. POKENAME can channel psychic energy to empower its attacks and for swift movement.

entry: POKENAME舌头像刃伸出口，刺穿小猎物。用利爪撕开强敌护甲，造出足够大的缺口，再用舌刺入。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's tongue juts out from their mouth like a blade, skewering smaller prey. They use their sharp claws to tear through the armor of tougher opponents, creating an opening big enough to stab into with their tongues.

entry: POKENAME面对危险坚定不移，迎头对付任何威胁。凭可靠毒刺、纯粹勇气与意志，避开几乎注定的败北。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME stand resolute in the face of danger and will tackle any threat head on. Equipped with their trusty stinger, they manage to escape almost certain defeat through sheer bravery and willpower.

entry: 它能以精神能力感应敌人的愤怒，强化剑术。但对方若完全失控，这联系也可能将它拖入同样暴怒。
author: h0bojoe
source: It can psychically attune to an opponent's anger to strengthen its swordplay. However, if its foe succumbs to uncontrollable rage, the connection may drag it into the same fury.

entry: POKENAME在茧里摇摆滚动，耐心等进化。即使状态还不起眼，也充满能量与决心。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wobbles and rolls inside its cocoon, as it patiently waits for its time to evolve. It is filled with energy and determination, even in this humbler state.

entry: POKENAME陆上极迟缓，水里却极敏捷。凭速度猎食，再用锋利头冠，将猎物切成两半。
author: enzo200
source: POKENAME is extremely sluggish on land but very agile underwater, it uses its speed to hunt for wild prey and uses its sharp crest to cut them in half.

entry: POKENAME刀刃裹着减摩擦的精神能量，劈斩迅速，也不易磨损。
author: spkypirate
source: POKENAME's blades are sheathed in friction-reducing psychic energy, resulting in rapid slashes and blades that resist wear.

entry: POKENAME战时极自大，能在动作发生前感知，因此随意劈砍，也轻松闪避。刃状肢体，连最坚韧的钢也能切开。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: In battle, POKENAME are known to be incredibly cocky. Because they can sense their opponents' movements before they happen, they hack at foes carelessly, easily dodging incoming attacks. Their blade-like limbs can cut through the toughest steel.

entry: 它用大翼放出精神能量刃。没被成阵精神刃击倒的敌人，就再以尖尾劈刺。
author: infinex21
source: With its large wings, it will loose blades of psychic energy at foes. Whatever does not fall to its barrages of psychic blades is met with slashes and jabs from its sharp tail.

entry: 尾上红球储着大量能量，一释放就发光。它们用臂刃攻防，同时灵巧蜿蜒游走，闪避攻击。
author: infinex21
source: The red orbs upon their tails store much of their energy and will glow when they unleash any of said energy. They use their arm blades to fight and to defend, while agilely avoiding attacks by slithering about.

entry: POKENAME挥使两把渗毒长刃，每次切中，毒就进入伤口。战斗骄傲重荣，从不在决斗退缩。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wields two elongated blades that ooze with a toxic venom, which seeps into wounds whenever it slices its target. It fights with pride and honor, never backing down from a duel.

entry: 它能从利尾释放强斩，甚至能量刃。可通常避战，大多拿尾剖开水果与坚果。
author: infinex21
source: It can unleash powerful slashing attacks, including energy blades, from its sharp tail. Despite this, it typically avoids battling and mostly uses its tail to cut open fruits and nuts.

entry: 它们虽有能咬碎小石的强颚，战斗却用锋利背鳍。双颚则用来咬开最爱的坚果与树果。
author: infinex21
source: Even though these Pokémon have strong jaws that could break small rocks, they use their sharp dorsal fins to fight. Their jaws, instead, are used to break open their favorite nuts and berries.

entry: POKENAME以利鳍与爪互相劈斩，纯为竞技成长。危险敌人，或打断切磋的来者，则会迎上强颚。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME will exchange slashing attacks with one another using their sharp fins and claws, purely for the sake of sport and growth. Dangerous foes, or those who interrupt their sparring, will be met with their strong jaws.

entry: 它们能沿鳍爪引能，强斩足以在坚金属刻出深沟。POKENAME张开獠牙巨口威吓，谁不逃，就认真迎战。
author: infinex21
source: They can channel energy through their fins and claws to perform strong slashing attacks that can gouge solid metal. A POKENAME will bare its large maw lined with fangs to intimidate others, and earnestly fight those who don't flee.

entry: POKENAME个头虽小，却不断练剑。流星众多的夜里，群体会聚集切磋。
author: mepp.
source: Despite its small stature, POKENAME is seen constantly training its swordsmanship skills. On nights filled with many shooting stars, groups of POKENAME gather to spar.

entry: POKENAME成熟，尾就硬化。最年长者尾比钢刃还锋利，用来战斗。年轻个体更靠策略，常用泥水轰击，扰乱敌人。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: As POKENAME mature, their tail hardens. The oldest POKENAME have tails that are sharper than steel, which they use to fight with. Younger POKENAME rely more on tactics and commonly disorientate their foes by blasting them with muddy water.

entry: POKENAME的耳朵坚硬而锋利，如同利刃，能用来防御。在月光下，若它心中涌起强烈的正义感，身上的圆环便会绽放耀眼的金光。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME's ears are hard and sharp like blades for defense. Under the light of the moon, if this Pokémon is moved by a strong sense of justice, its rings will glow with a blinding golden light.

entry: 周围人或宝可梦愤怒，它就能以心灵感应察觉敌意。承受不住，可能爆出精神能量，自卫御敌。
author: .izik
source: If surrounded by angry humans or Pokémon, it will sense the hostility telepathically. Overwhelmed, it may explode in a psychic burst as a defense mechanism.

entry: POKENAME是正义英勇的典范，助人愿望胜过自保。常跃入危险，保护幼年宝可梦，所求回报，只是行动被认可。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are an exemplary model of justice and heroism, as their desire to help others supersedes their desire to stay safe. They often jump into danger to protect baby Pokémon, and all they ask in return is recognition for their actions.

entry: 它通常生活在山区，凭超能力与速度，能轻易躲开天敌。
author: patch
source: It is usually found within mountainous regions. It can easily evade predators due to their psychic powers and speed.

entry: 双臂极适合划水，让它轻轻松松，就能制造漩涡、高速游动。
author: staghorn
source: Its arms are extremely hydrodynamic, allowing it to create whirlpools and swim at high speeds with little effort.

entry: POKENAME守望居住的森林，保护弱小宝可梦免遭偷猎或捕食。以华丽双角迎头冲锋，直到敌人退走。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME watches over the forests in which it lives to protect weaker Pokémon from poachers or predators. It charges headfirst with its magnificent horns until its foe decides to flee.

entry: POKENAME作战可靠，知道哪里打着最痛。攻击华丽得几近炫耀，却始终想公平交手。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are reliable fighters that knows how to hit where it hurts. Though their flashy attacks border on the ostentatious side, they always want a fair fight.

entry: POKENAME像游历诸地的守护者，为无力反抗的生灵挺身而出。它用一道火环，将自己与敌人围在里面，再以纯火焰构成的肘刃进攻。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME acts as a wandering protector, traveling the regions and standing up for those who cannot stand up for themselves. It creates a ring of fire around itself and its foe before going on the attack with elbow-blades made of pure flame.

entry: POKENAME游历大地，以缎带使水域重获生机、净化。发现污染水者，就给予公正而无情的惩罚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME roams the land rejuvenating and purifying bodies of water with its ribbons. Those it finds polluting the waters will receive just and merciless punishment.

entry: POKENAME短暂预见未来，能无差错地预判、反击。优雅飞姿下，藏着历代空中决斗磨出的凶猛战法。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME sees glimpses of the future, allowing it to predict and counter attacks with flawless precision. Its graceful flight masks a fierce combat style honed through generations of aerial duels.

entry: POKENAME精神炽烈、尽忠职守，是能长夜清醒的绝佳哨卫。即使打盹也站着，轻易惊醒，立刻恢复高度警觉。
author: bobosmith01
source: Filled with an intense and dutiful spirit, POKENAME is an incredible watchguard that can stay wide awake during the long hours of the night. Even if it dozes off, it remains standing upright and can easily snap awake and be back on high alert.

entry: POKENAME体内积电越多，攻击越凶。将能量引入刃尾，以骇人敏捷切向敌人。
author: santon5512
source: The more electricity POKENAME build up inside them, the fiercer their attacks will become. They channel this energy into their bladed tails, slicing through foes with frightening agility.

entry: POKENAME诵出石板腰带上的文字，就形成能挡击的精神甲片。将甲片围成球，使用滚动时几乎无敌，碾过所有挡路者。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME incants the words on its stone tablet belt, it forms psychic plating that can deflect incoming attacks. By encasing itself in a sphere of these plates, it can almost invincibly use Rollout to crush all foes who come in its path.

entry: 对正义的强烈渴望驯服了POKENAME的野性，让它成为英勇的英雄。不过，它有个坏习惯，总爱在战斗中摆出英雄姿势。
author: leshii
source: Its wild nature tamed by an overwhelming desire for justice, POKENAME is a gallant hero that has a bad habit of striking heroic poses mid-battle.

entry: POKENAME用超能力削下尖刺的锐利顶端，作为战斗中的投射物。它逼敌人躲避尖刺，借此将对方引近，再用锋利的爪子猛抓。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses psychic powers to chip off the pointed tips of its spines to use as projectiles in battle. It forces a foe to dodge the spines in order to draw them closer so it can rake at them with its razor-sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME能以精神力量预见未来。战时预判下一招，再用念力攻击或猛烈踢击抢先。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can use its psychic power to see into the future. In combat, it will predict its opponent's next move, then strike first with telekinetic attacks or devastating kicks.

entry: POKENAME战法独特，强踢结合肘刃劈斩。读取敌人思绪，始终领先一步。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has a unique fighting style, combining powerful kicks with slashes from the blades on its elbows. It reads its opponent's thoughts, and always stays one step ahead.

entry: 少有斗士比POKENAME更狡黠。高效迅速，常两三招便结束，因此深受巡回赛事欢迎。
author: nyoomymph
source: There are few battlers more cunning than a POKENAME. It is efficient and swift, often ending a fight with just two or three moves. For this, POKENAME is popular in tournament circuits.

entry: POKENAME与另一个地区的特殊现象有所关联。它用强劲的肘刃和超能力，保护无辜者。
author: scigaming
source: POKENAME shares a connection to another region's local phenomenon. It uses its strong elbow-blades and psychic power to protect the innocent.

entry: POKENAME始终从容待命，保护训练家，是出色保镖。坚持不懈、温柔动作，都表达深厚的爱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are incredible bodyguards because they are always poised and ready to defend their Trainer. They have a profound love for their Trainer that is expressed through their perseverance and gentle movements.

entry: POKENAME随时准备尽责，以生命守护训练家。偏爱近战，肘间涌出纯粹精神能量刃，投入战斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is always ready to dutifully guard its Trainer with its life. It prefers close combat, blades of pure psychic energy emanating from its elbows as it engages in battle.

entry: 战时，POKENAME很少落地超过几秒，大多长时间飘浮。臂如刀刃，动作堪比剑术大师。
author: .izik
source: During combat, POKENAME seldom lands on the ground for more than a few seconds, levitating for long periods. With its blade-like arm, it can execute movements worthy of a master swordsman.

entry: POKENAME部分靠精神能力飞行，前臂伸出的精神刃形成喷气机般的翼。刃臂也用于作战，强到能切开钢梁。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME is capable of flight, partly due to its psychic abilities; when it flies, it extends psychic blades from its forearms to form jet-like wings. It fights using its blade-like forearms, which are strong enough to cut through a steel beam.

entry: 它在皮肤生出微小精神能量刺自卫。无形刺一接触，同时刺入身体与心智，吓退攻击者。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It protects itself by generating microscopic thorns along its skin, formed entirely of psychic energy. These invisible barbs deter attackers by piercing both body and mind upon contact.

entry: POKENAME用钻石般坚韧的盾保护弱者。强防御却让它过度自信、鲁莽，为护伙伴，在战斗中英勇牺牲。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME assists the vulnerable by protecting them with its diamond-tough shield. This formidable defense makes it overconfident and reckless, leading it to valiantly sacrifice itself in battle protecting its partners.

entry: 它胖而懒，常对周围漠不关心。但一决定行动，便成为纯粹蛮力的毁灭性存在。
author: starexpizz
source: This Pokémon is fat, lazy, and often appears completely indifferent to its surroundings. However, when it decides to act, it becomes a devastating force of pure and raw strength.

entry: POKENAME能预测眼前未来，却阻止不了所见发生。只能在事件发生的准确瞬间回应，借信息在战斗中略占优势。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can predict the immediate future, but cannot prevent anything it foresees from happening. The only way it can use this information is to react to events at the exact moment they occur, giving it a slight advantage in combat.

entry: 野生POKENAME富有骑士精神，会用肘部凝聚出的精神能量之刃，挺身保护弱小。那些骑着白马、守护他人的骑士故事，常以它们为灵感。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME are chivalrous Pokémon that will leap to defend the weak and frail alike with blades of psychic energy they form upon their elbows. They are a common inspiration for stories of knights that ride upon white steeds to protect others.

entry: 传说，POKENAME拥有君王的智慧、骑士的坚毅，以及统御他人的力量。它彬彬有礼，出招前总会先向对手问候、鞠躬，随后发起优雅而势不可挡的攻击。
author: bobosmith01
source: A legend states that POKENAME has the wisdom of a king, the fortitude of a knight, and the power to rule over others. It is a courteous Pokémon that makes sure to greet and bow to opponents before attacking gracefully and overwhelmingly.

entry: POKENAME是能读懂对手想法的格斗高手。凭先知先觉的迅速行动，它会保护对手，也保护需要帮助的人。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: An expert fighter able to read its opponent's thoughts, POKENAME protects its opponent and those in need with predictive haste.

entry: POKENAME每战后磨刃，确保始终完美。无惧危险，保护遇险宝可梦，以双刃斩倒攻击者。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME sharpen their blades after every battle, ensuring that they remain in pristine condition at all times. These Pokémon will fearlessly protect Pokémon in danger, using both of their blades to slice down attackers.

entry: POKENAME灵巧地将缎带挥舞成鞭，用尖端抽击企图伤害他人的家伙。被划伤后，伤者的斗志会一点点流失，直到倒下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME deftly wields its ribbons like whips, striking at those who would harm others with their pointed ends. Cuts caused by its attacks cause the wounded party to slowly be sapped of their fighting spirit until they collapse.

entry: POKENAME披风由合金制成，能弹开来袭弹丸。战法似熟练街舞者，沉披风舞得如轻绸。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's cape is made of a metal alloy that deflects incoming projectiles. Its combat style resembles an accomplished street dancer, the heavy cape moving as if made of light silk.

entry: 据说POKENAME会从沉睡醒来，听从怀有理想未来愿景者的命令。轻易理解他人意图，因此被认为无法欺骗。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is said to awaken from its slumber to follow the orders of one with an ideal vision of the future. It can effortlessly understand the intentions of others and therefore is thought to be impossible to deceive.

entry: POKENAME是安全与正义的堡垒，保护年幼宝可梦远离危险。英勇激励其他宝可梦，始终善良公平。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME acts as a bastion of safety and justice and protects young Pokémon from danger. Its heroism inspires other Pokémon to always be kind and fair.

entry: POKENAME独居，苦练战技。精神力量与敏捷能预判、躲避敌招，是强大斗士。珍视荣誉，失败会深感羞耻。
author: keiracm35_
source: POKENAME are solitary Pokémon and train hard to hone their combat skills. Their psychic powers and agility let them predict and dodge foes' moves, making them formidable fighters. They prize honor and are deeply shamed by defeat.

entry: POKENAME一感到针对自己的恶意，就以闪电般速度冲向意图攻击者，再用带电臂刃斩倒。
author: darkweavile428
source: If POKENAME senses any malicious thoughts directed towards itself, it launches at its would-be attacker at lightning speeds, then cuts them down using its electrified arm blades.

entry: POKENAME想让旁人遵守高尚交战准则，自己也照做。可一有卑鄙苗头，就会大发狂暴，对冒犯者毫不留手。
author: thesilverowls
source: POKENAME are known to attempt to hold others to a standard of noble combat, which POKENAME will mirror. However, at even the smallest hint of underhandedness, it will fly into a massive rampage and hold nothing back against whoever slighted it.

entry: POKENAME自古被请作神庙等处的强壮沉静守卫。重荣誉，挥巨刃驱赶闯入者与小偷。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been employed as strong and stoic guardians of temples and other locales since ancient times. It fights with honor, wielding a giant blade to stave off trespassers and thieves.

entry: POKENAME想成为保护遇险者的英勇战士。伪装虽不适激战，肘间却能伸影刃，取得足够优势。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME strives to be a gallant warrior defending those in danger. Though its disguise is ill-equipped for fierce battles, it extends blades of shadow from its elbows that give it an adequate edge against its foes.

entry: 它以刃尾与神秘力量进攻，每尾都控制精准。POKENAME全尾齐挥，能放精神能量刃，劈开坚钻。
author: infinex21
source: It attacks using its blade-like tails and mystical powers; it can precisely control each tail. When POKENAME swings all of its tails together, it can let loose a blade of psychic energy that can cleave through solid diamond.

entry: 研究者多认为，面具脸部结构的差异，来自艾路雷朵DNA影响。但有人类学家提出，改变的面孔也可能是已灭绝人类亚种的证据。
author: .realthree
source: While researchers generally agree that the structural differences in the mask's face are a result of the influence of Gallade's DNA, some anthropologists suggest that the altered visage could be evidence of an extinct subspecies of human.

entry: 每只野生POKENAME都将一生用于帮助无辜者。能以精神力量控毒，注入者会被治愈或伤害，全凭它的意志。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Every wild POKENAME dedicates its life to helping the innocent. It has psychic control over its venom. Those injected will either be healed or hurt, controlled entirely by POKENAME's will.

entry: POKENAME住在荒山。旅人闯进领地，就造雪崩挡路。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME lives on barren mountains. If travelers wander into its territory, POKENAME will cause an avalanche to block their way.

entry: POKENAME鳍不断在珊瑚礁磨利。只须绕猎物游动，就能将其切开。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME's fins are constantly sharpened against coral reefs. It can cut up its prey simply by swimming around them.

entry: POKENAME凶猛守海，以精神能力感知来犯威胁。某片海若不再有偷猎者常来，多半是它的功劳。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are fierce protectors of the sea, using their psychic abilities to sense incoming threats. If poachers stop frequenting part of the sea, a POKENAME is likely the reason why.

entry: POKENAME用叶刃劈砍坚树，原因不一：标记领地、练战技，或磨利刀刃。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME can be seen hacking away at sturdy trees with its leafy blades for multiple reasons: to mark its territory, to practice combat, and to sharpen its blades.

entry: POKENAME用叶刃劈砍坚树，原因不一：标记领地、练战技，或磨利刀刃。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME can be seen hacking away at sturdy trees with its leafy blades for multiple reasons: to mark its territory, to practice combat, and to sharpen its blades.

entry: POKENAME脚步快，轻松闪避敌攻。剑若丢失，肘间还能伸出水做的替代品。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME is quick on its feet and can easily avoid an opponent's attacks. When POKENAME loses its sword, it can extend aquatic replacements from its elbows.

entry: 训练家报告，POKENAME在月下冥想，周围水面就完全静止。哪怕一丝涟漪打破水面，它也会无声消失进树林。
author: jaminmcready
source: Trainers report that when POKENAME meditates under moonlight, the water around it becomes perfectly still. If even a single ripple breaks the surface, it vanishes into the trees without a sound.

entry: POKENAME快得超乎常理，水晶盔映着林中家园的斑驳日光。目击者虽少，却都同意：它绝非能随意招惹的宝可梦。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME moves with supernatural swiftness, and its crystalline helm glimmers with the dappled sunlight of its sylvan home. Those who have caught sight of one are few, but they all agree on one thing: POKENAME is not a Pokémon to be trifled with.

entry: 夜间若在街头受到纠缠，可以放心，POKENAME会前来相助。不过，它们并非毫无私心；若不为它们付出的时间支付报酬，下次可就没那么幸运了。
author: .fedoraman
source: If you're being accosted on the street at night, you can rest assured that a POKENAME will come to your aid. They aren't selfless though; if you fail to pay them for their time, you won't be as lucky next time.

entry: POKENAME善良，斗志不屈。用能伸长的双臂，打出带火的劈斩。
author: zekkenbytheden
source: POKENAME are kind Pokémon with an indomitable fighting spirit. They use their extendable arms to deliver flame-infused slashes.

entry: POKENAME巡视领地，见有人苦恼，就不顾危险俯冲救援。精通空气斩，因此赢得“空中剑客”的别称。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME spots someone in distress while patrolling its territory, it will dive to the rescue regardless of the danger. A true master of the move Air Slash, it has earned the nickname "Aerial Swashbuckler".

entry: POKENAME守护自然，努力保护动植物。若察觉周围遇险，就解下腰带，精准打击肇事者。
author: cinnamoncreampuff
source: A protector of nature, POKENAME strives to keep the flora and fauna safe from harm. If it senses that its surroundings are in danger, it will remove its belt and strike with precision at whoever is responsible.

entry: POKENAME诚实，志在保护朋友，却常因此过度警觉，显得有些专横。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are honest creatures that aspire to protect their friends from danger. This can lead many to develop a sense of hypervigilance that makes them somewhat overbearing.

entry: POKENAME一生大多僵立不动。周围再无声响时，能听见空眼窝传出仿佛轻泣的回声。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stands stock-still, immobile for most of its lifetime. When no other sounds are present, what sounds like faint crying can be heard echoing from its hollow eye sockets.

entry: POKENAME十分强大，却从不发挥全部潜力。它懒得很，喜欢长时间打盹，可被逼入绝境时也十分危险。
author: sand_coffin
source: POKENAME is quite powerful, but never uses its full potential. It is lazy and enjoys long naps, but can become dangerous when pushed into a corner.

entry: 外骨骼脆，初挨踢击似乎很弱，可不久目标又会被超自然力量击中。人们推测，攻击力来自POKENAME体内幽灵能量。
author: chibitales
source: Kicks from this Pokémon initially seem weak due to its fragile exoskeleton, but soon after the attack, the target is struck with a supernatural force. It is theorized the strength of the attack manifests from the ghostly energy in POKENAME's body.

entry: POKENAME住在拳击手形状的外壳中。先以快如闪电的连拳进攻，再忽然停住动作休息，连半空中也不例外。
author: eggsaladologist
source: POKENAME inhabits a shell in the shape of a boxer. It uses lightning-fast flurries of punches before freezing mid-motion to rest, even in mid-air.

entry: 巴大蝶破茧后留下的蛹，有时会形成POKENAME。如何活动仍难确定，有研究者前往丰缘，研究铁面忍者进化作对照。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME will sometimes form from the chrysalis left behind when a Butterfree emerges from its cocoon. Researchers have had a hard time determining how POKENAME become animated with some travelling to Hoenn to study Ninjask evolution for comparison.

entry: POKENAME住在岩石山地，身体不动，飘着巡视。久久凝望的岩壁会自发冒洞，仿佛某种无形力量钻过。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME resides in rocky, mountainous areas, floating around motionlessly as it surveys territory. The rocky walls it stares at for large lengths of time will have holes spontaneously appear in them, as if some unseen force had drilled into them.

entry: POKENAME身体苍白，不动地悬在空中。无翼能飞的诡异本领，吓得多数捕食者避开。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have pale bodies that hang motionlessly in the air. Their uncanny ability to fly without wings scares most predators into avoiding them.

entry: 巴大蝶破茧后留下的蛹，有时会形成POKENAME。如何活动仍难确定，有研究者前往丰缘，研究铁面忍者进化作对照。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME will sometimes form from the chrysalis left behind when a Butterfree emerges from its cocoon. Researchers have had a hard time determining how POKENAME become animated with some travelling to Hoenn to study Ninjask evolution for comparison.

entry: POKENAME月牙形的翅膀，夜里泛着微光。满月之夜，若它静静悬在花田上方，到日出时，所有植物都会凋萎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's crescent-shaped wings glow faintly in the night. When the moon is full, should POKENAME be hovering silently over a field of flowers, all the plants will have wilted by the time the sun rises.

entry: POKENAME体内极空，许多人推测，因此能轻易飘浮。用精神力量把树果、坚果丢进身体前方开口，此后再也不见。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME is incredibly hollow inside, which many theorize is why it so easily floats about in the air. It uses its psychic powers to drop berries and nuts into the opening on the front of its body, which will never be seen again.

entry: 它看似纹丝不动，聪明训练家却知道远离POKENAME。挑衅者会无端遍受割伤，而它只朝那方向，茫然凝视……
author: sk372
source: It appears to stand completely motionless, but wise Trainers know to give POKENAME a wide berth. Agitators will find themselves beset with cuts coming from seemingly nowhere, as POKENAME stares blankly in their direction...

entry: POKENAME人称“森林死神”，会跟随将走到生命尽头的虫宝可梦。若在POKENAME身边死去，会发生什么，却无人知晓。
author: frokachu
source: Known as the 'Reaper of the Forest", POKENAME follow bug Pokémon around that are near the end of their life. It is unknown what happens when they pass in the presence of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME身体不动，缓缓游过深海，似乎对周围毫不知情。成群鲤鱼王，连暴鲤龙也一样，一见它靠近就逃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME swims slowly and motionlessly through the deep sea, seemingly oblivious to its surroundings. Schools of Magikarp and even Gyarados will flee if they spot POKENAME approaching.

entry: POKENAME久居不动，几乎不离开家园树上的位置。研究者争论，小个头怎能不躲捕食者、直接暴露；主流说法是，单纯不好吃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live a sedentary lifestyle, barely moving from their positions on their home tree. Researchers argue over how such a small Pokémon can be in the open without hiding from predators, the leading theory being that they are simply unpalatable.

entry: POKENAME静静漂过海洋，全无暴鲤龙融合体常见的攻击性。可传闻说，凝视空张的嘴，会失去愤怒以外的所有情绪。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME drifts quietly through the ocean, exhibiting none of the aggression Gyarados fusions are typically known for. However, rumors say that staring into its hollow, open mouth removes all emotions from a being, except rage.

entry: POKENAME靠近陈旧、几乎报废的电脑时，勉强能看见二进制代码流入体内。吸来数据作何用，仍不明。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME is near old, nearly-dead computers, one can just barely see streams of binary code flowing into it from the machine. It's not known what POKENAME does with the data it absorbs.

entry: POKENAME身体脆弱，会贴住别人的头附身。受害者事后，对附身期间的事全无记忆。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is very fragile, so it will possess others by latching onto their heads. However, victims of POKENAME have no recollection of anything while they were possessed.

entry: 大雷暴后，偶尔能在风暴中心附近，看见飘浮的POKENAME。身体完全不动，却有足够供整个地区的电力。
author: darkweavile428
source: Occasionally after a massive thunderstorm, you can find POKENAME floating near the storm's center. Though it is completely immobile, its body contains enough electricity to power an entire region.

entry: POKENAME住在其他虫宝可梦已空、已弃的旧巢旁。有人相信，它守护那些为抵挡捕食者、保护巢穴而死的灵魂。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes its home near hollowed and abandoned former nests of other insect Pokémon. Some believe it guards the spirits of those who perished defending those hives from predators.

entry: POKENAME通常不动，却因微弱好奇，转身朝向遇见的宝可梦。身后显出被注视者的空灵影像，维持对视，影像就一直在。
author: sk372
source: Though typically remaining motionless, faint curiosity causes POKENAME to turn and face any Pokémon it encounters. An ethereal image of the Pokémon it stares at appears behind it, remaining for as long as POKENAME maintains eye contact.

entry: POKENAME仿佛不动，诡异地盯着每位路人。有的文化视为不幸使者，有的却认为是守护天使。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is seemingly motionless, eerily staring at anyone who passes by. Some cultures see POKENAME as a bringer of misfortune, while others believe it to be a guardian angel.

entry: POKENAME见于少有或没有光污染之处，在星光明亮的地方无声飘浮。人们认为，它吸取星光能量，为超自然攻击供能。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME appears in areas with little to no light pollution, floating silently where the stars shine brightly. It is thought they gain energy under starlight, fueling the supernatural power behind their attacks.

entry: POKENAME的网，多数活物碰不到，因为本为捕捉飘过的迷失灵魂。外表虽可怕，怕鬼的人却喜欢留它在旁。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's webs are intangible to most living beings as they are intended to catch lost souls floating by. Despite its creepy appearance, people with a fear of ghosts like to keep it around.

entry: POKENAME以最深最暗的山洞为家。据说碰到头顶悬月，就会变成超音蝠。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes its home in the deepest and darkest of mountain caverns. It's said that those who touch the crescent floating above its head will be transformed into a Zubat.

entry: POKENAME见于废弃宝可梦巢中或附近，守着空结构，仿佛保护已不在的东西。对外界反应微弱，似乎也不用吃喝。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are found in and around abandoned Pokémon nests, brooding over the empty structures as though protecting something that's no longer there. They show little reaction to outside stimuli and appear to need no food or water.

entry: POKENAME伏地不动，触角发诡异生物光，诱引猎物。谁碰谁挨电，若被电晕，中空身体就会将其整只吞下。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lies motionless on the ground, its antennae glowing with eerie bioluminescence to lure in prey. Anyone who touches POKENAME will be shocked, and if this stuns them, POKENAME's hollow body will swallow them whole.

entry: 林火过后，可在破坏痕迹中找到它们。日落前仿佛无生命，入夜才在焦土游荡。
author: andromeda102037
source: In the aftermath of a wildfire, these Pokémon can be found amidst the destruction. They remain lifeless until nightfall, during which they can be found wandering across the scorched landscape.

entry: 黎明与黄昏，POKENAME短暂前往水面进食。其余时间全潜泥里，休眠不动。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: At dusk and dawn, POKENAME briefly make their way to the water's surface to feed. The rest of the time they spend submerged in mud, dormant and unmoving.

entry: POKENAME唯一会动的部位是尾。传闻土居奇尾巴的灵魂仍住在里面，不明白身体为何停了下来。
author: periperi_chicken
source: The only part of POKENAME that moves is the tail. It is rumoured that the spirit of Ninfarig's tail still lives inside it, confused as to why its body stopped moving.

entry: POKENAME很少动。人们相信，首只由迷失灵魂附上陈旧的空榛果球壳而生。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME rarely moves. It's believed that the first POKENAME came to be when an old empty Pineco casing was possessed by a lost spirit.

entry: 它不动，不眨眼，也不吃。无法穿透的壳里，似乎只有一对悬着的眼皮。若非能用强招，被误认根本不是宝可梦，也不奇怪。
author: bobosmith01
source: It doesn't move. It doesn't blink. It doesn't eat. There doesn't appear to be anything inside the impenetrable shell except a floating pair of eyelids. If it couldn't use powerful moves, one could be forgiven in thinking it wasn't even a Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME失明，钻尾不动，也能挖地下通道。能见它飘在空中，一察觉人类靠近，就开始慢慢移动。
author: equation8573
source: POKENAME is blind, but it can dig tunnels underground without its drill tail moving. It can be seen floating in the sky, moving slowly as soon as it senses a human nearby.

entry: POKENAME的身体中空，不需呼吸，又飘浮于地面之上，引起科学家极大的兴趣。它的颚有将树咬成两段的力量，却只在咬敌人时，才会张嘴。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME is a subject of great scientific interest due to being hollow, not breathing, and floating above the ground. Its jaw has the strength to break a tree in half, yet POKENAME only opens its mouth to bite an enemy.

entry: POKENAME空壳硬如钢，轻松破石。翅膀不动，也能随意离地飘起。
author: jadey.1557
source: The hollow shell of POKENAME is hard as steel and can break rocks with ease. Its wings do not move, yet this Pokémon can float off the ground at will.

entry: 身体虽空，却比钢硬，多数攻击伤不到。可薄如纸的壳，又极容易燃烧。
author: .jerden
source: Although hollow, its body is harder than steel and unharmed by most attacks. However, its paper-thin shell is incredibly flammable.

entry: 火山喷发后，可见POKENAME诡异坐在火山弹上。特别活跃的火山坡，更有整片群体。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be seen eerily sitting atop lava bombs in the wake of an eruption. Entire fields of POKENAME are found on the flanks of particularly active volcanoes.

entry: POKENAME栖在树顶，睡觉时竖起尾羽，把双翼铺展在四周。羽毛的叶片质感，能让它们睡着时融入树间，难以发现。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME roost at the tops of trees, sleeping with their tail feathers raised and wings splayed out around them. The leafy texture of their feathers helps to disguise them amongst the trees as they sleep, making them hard to spot.

entry: POKENAME夜里无声滑翔，寻找迷路的训练家，慢慢吸走能量，直到人站不起来。成对的铃铛响，会跟在POKENAME身旁，护它周全。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME silently glide during the night, looking for lost Trainers to slowly drain their energy until they can no longer stand. Pairs of Chingling follow POKENAME to protect them from danger.

entry: POKENAME静睡海底，身体仿佛不动，也能游泳。即使陆上，也极少出声。
author: notsaying.
source: Sleeping quietly on the seafloor, POKENAME can swim without seeming to move its body. It rarely ever makes sounds, even on land.

entry: POKENAME吸取废弃网站数据，直到全成空白。收集来做什么，没人知道，吸收量也似乎没有上限。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME absorbs the data of abandoned websites until they are left completely blank. It is not known what it does with the data it collects, nor does it seem to have a limit to how much it can absorb.

entry: POKENAME大多中空，仿佛被头顶噼啪电流操纵。能量从不触地，因此它能完全不受地面属性攻击影响。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is mostly hollow and seems to be puppeted around by the crackling electricity floating above it. Since this energy never touches the earth, POKENAME can be completely unaffected by Ground-type attacks.

entry: POKENAME无声走过昏林，无视所有生命。空壳不累、不吃、不眨眼，行迹却总通往某处。
author: mgfox_66676
source: POKENAME walks silently through dim forests, ignoring all other life. Its empty shell never tires, never eats, and never blinks, yet its path always leads somewhere.

entry: 据说训练家将一只表现不佳的皮卡丘遗弃森林，神秘力量随后附在它身上，便诞生了POKENAME。
author: patch_bros
source: It's said that POKENAME formed when a Trainer abandoned their underperforming Pikachu in a forest, and it became possessed by a mysterious force.

entry: 据说，森林家园不久后将遇险，就会形成POKENAME。近来数量增长令人担忧，人们正讨论为人类建设砍林的新规定。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME is said to form when their forest homes will be in danger in the near future. The recent rise in their numbers is concerning enough that new regulations regarding deforestation for human construction are being discussed.

entry: POKENAME雷暴时出现，身体招来连连雷击。虽导电，却看不出雷击损伤，只在风暴里不动，直到过去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME appear during thunderstorms, their bodies attracting repeated lightning strikes. Despite their conductivity, they never appear to show damage from the bolts that strike them; instead they remain motionless within the storm until it passes.

entry: POKENAME胸孔发引力，将前方可食物全吸入。不论吃多少，都不增重，饥饿也似乎永不满足。
author: sk372
source: The hole in POKENAME's chest emits a gravitational pull that sucks in anything edible in front of it. It never gains weight no matter how much it consumes, nor does its hunger ever seem to be sated.

entry: 影爪强劲，POKENAME劈过什么，都能撕开。可日晒太久，刃会变钝，效力大减。
author: sirg44
source: Their shadowy claws are capable of striking with great force, rending through whatever POKENAME slashes. However, prolonged exposure to sunlight can dull the blades, greatly reducing their effectiveness.

entry: POKENAME藤蔓下，没有任何可称活物的东西。速度虽低，却善应变，几乎所有非极端环境都能生存。
author: bobosmith01
source: There is nothing defined as a living thing under POKENAME's vines. Resourceful despite its low speed, POKENAME can survive in almost any non-extreme environment.

entry: POKENAME无声俯冲洞中旅人，却只在面前诡异悬停，直到对方离开。盛传被蜇后，灵魂会中毒毁灭。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME silently swoops down towards cave travelers, yet only eerily hovers before them until they leave. Rumors abound that being stung by it will poison and destroy a person's soul.

entry: POKENAME大多时间完全不动地悬着。只有附近电子设备出故障时，才剧烈抽动；停下后，身旁机器便正常运作。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends much of its time hovering completely motionless. The only exception is in the process of glitching electronics, whereupon POKENAME begins twitching violently; after it stops, the machine it was near functions normally.

entry: 据说看进POKENAME背孔，会被偷走灵魂。可偏偏它常爱背对人，这就成了问题。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: It is said that if you look into the holes on the back of POKENAME, it will steal your soul. This is a problem, as POKENAME enjoys turning its back to people on a regular basis.

entry: 鸣声空洞诡异，POKENAME却对训练家友好，开心地蹦跳跟在后面。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: The cheeps that come from this Pokémon sound hollow and eerie. Despite this, POKENAME are friendly towards Trainers and will happily hop behind and follow them.

entry: POKENAME身体虽脆，却专心训练。喜欢跑与踢，只是得经常停下休息。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Despite their fragile bodies, POKENAME are dedicated to training. These Pokémon enjoy running and kicking, but have to take frequent breaks to rest.

entry: POKENAME全身静止，只有黏腕带自由动，碰什么黏什么。猎物一挣扎，带子便缠牢。粘住后，它才动身，以灼热一踢碾压。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Standing completely still, POKENAME's sticky wrist wraps are the only thing that move freely and attach to anything they touch. As the prey struggles, the wrappings bind the foe. Once stuck, POKENAME will move and crush it with a scorching kick.

entry: POKENAME停在沼泽边不动，仿佛等什么。等的是什么，没人知道，可只要它在，其他宝可梦都会入夜前离开。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME perches at the edges of swampy marshes and stands unmoving, as if waiting for something. What that might be is unknown, but all other Pokémon vacate the marsh before nightfall when POKENAME is present.

entry: 光环更大的POKENAME，已守望指定沼泽极其漫长的岁月。夜幕降下，奇异幽雾笼罩，眼中也亮起怪光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME with larger halos have stood watch over their designated marshes for extraordinary lengths of time. When night falls, a strange ghostly mist settles over the swamp, and a strange light glows within POKENAME's eyes.

entry: 据说POKENAME为早被遗忘者起舞悼念。空身让气流穿过，随着动作，悲哨回荡四周，像风中的人声。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME is said to dance in remembrance of those long forgotten. Its hollow body allows air to move through its body as it shifts, causing sorrowful whistles to echo through the area, like voices in the wind.

entry: 晴天常见POKENAME静止仰望，有时低声哼鸣。打断古怪仪式，很可能遭幽灵能量攻击。
author: fireblade141
source: On sunny days, POKENAME can often be found motionless with its gaze turned upwards, sometimes humming in a low voice. Interrupt its strange ritual, and it will likely attack with ghostly energy.

entry: 若见大群POKENAME飞过，就表示附近已发生悲剧。它们落到灾难现场，为受害者共情，发出哀鸣。
author: dodoowner_
source: When swarms of POKENAME are spotted flying through the sky, it signals a tragic event has happened nearby. They land at the site where the disaster occurred and let out mournful cries, empathizing with the victims.

entry: 科学家研究POKENAME，发现光环似乎绕着极强引力弯曲。可已知研究方法，均得不出可理解的信息。
author: opoaotoroiocoko
source: Scientists studying POKENAME say that its halo appears to bend around an extreme gravitational force. Unfortunately, no known method of study has been able to provide any intelligible information.

entry: POKENAME是变隐龙蜕下的空壳。不呼吸、不移动，里面却有东西扰动；据说窥看空背，会失去灵魂。
author: sim.n
source: POKENAME is a hollow shell left from a Kecleon's molt. It neither breathes nor moves, yet something within stirs, and anyone who peers into its hollow back is said to lose their spirit.

entry: 它是在发现过化石的洞穴里找到的奇异宝可梦。人们认为，POKENAME是远古宝可梦的外骨骼重获生命。
author: fifteenk
source: A curious Pokémon discovered in a cave where fossils had been found. POKENAME is thought to be the exoskeleton of an ancient Pokémon brought back to life.

entry: 这种少见宝可梦守望天灾现场。POKENAME诡异前进，双腿却从来看不出移动。
author: ghostslythe
source: This uncommon Pokémon stands vigil over the sites of natural disasters. POKENAME's legs never appear to move as it eerily advances.

entry: POKENAME留在墓中，很难唤醒。终于醒来，就攻击令其不适的源头，再继续沉睡。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME remain in tombs and are difficult to awaken. When they eventually awaken, they attack the source of discomfort before resuming their slumber.

entry: POKENAME吸取其他宝可梦生命能量，保护古墓。准备不足，几乎不可能击败。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME protect ancient tombs by siphoning life energy from other Pokémon. Without proper preparation, they are nearly impossible to defeat.

entry: POKENAME与训练家的陪伴，连死亡也无法割断。古墓里仍能找到它们，继续守护训练家。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are known to remain by their Trainer's side even after death. They can be found in ancient tombs where they are still protecting their Trainer.

entry: 脱壳忍者聚在POKENAME附近，有些进出它看似空的壳。有人相信，进入的个体正把偷来的灵魂存入其中。
author: sk372
source: Shedinja congregate near POKENAME, some venturing in and out of its seemingly hollow shell. Some believe that those Shedinja entering POKENAME's body are storing the spirits they've stolen within its confines.

entry: POKENAME脸上的三叉戟状冠，即使酷热也摸着凉。野生个体用鳍爪凶猛进攻，却很少防御。
author: bobosmith01
source: The trident-shaped crest on POKENAME's face is always cool to the touch, even in scorching heat. Wild individuals strike fiercely with their flipper claws but show little regard for defense.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃锋利得能切开一切，却又异常易碎，实在难以使用。
author: .flipside3
source: The blades of a POKENAME are sharp enough to cut through anything. However, they are exceptionally brittle, making them hard to use.

entry: POKENAME如无情战士失去灵魂的空壳，从不怜悯，也无任何情绪。据说只有一个目标：以战中击败、值得交手的敌人之魂，填补空虚。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME, resembling a hollow, soulless shell of a ruthless warrior, never shows mercy, nor any emotions at all. It's said to be driven by a single goal - to fill its emptiness with a soul of a worthy opponent defeated in battle.

entry: POKENAME在文明边缘悄悄游荡，观察人，趁没被注意就靠近。怪缎带一碰，负面情绪会暂时被抽走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME slinks around quietly near civilization, watching people and drawing closer when unobserved. Those touched by its strange ribbons have any negative emotions drained away for a time.

entry: POKENAME不祥地悬在事物交界，例如湖岸、房间间的门口，或建筑门槛。虽不动，却令人不安，少有人敢经过。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME float ominously at the boundaries between one thing and another, such as the shores of a lake, in doorways between rooms, or at the thresholds of buildings. Though they remain motionless, they engender enough unease that few dare pass them.

entry: POKENAME每100年蜕壳一次，壳沿尾滑下。博士推测它不死，可至今没找到带超过四层“世纪壳”的个体。
author: bradlybro199
source: Every 100 years, a POKENAME sheds its shell, which slides down its tail. Professors theorize this Pokémon is immortal, although a POKENAME with more than four "Century Shells" has yet to be discovered.

entry: 据说细沙不断从空身流出，仿佛POKENAME已碾碎时间本身的概念。释放力量时，所有月相会同时环绕。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is said that fine sand constantly pours from its hollow body, as if POKENAME had crushed the very concept of time itself. When it unleashes its powers, it is surrounded by all the phases of the moon at once.

entry: 据说细沙不断从空身流出，仿佛POKENAME已打碎时间概念。目睹力量者，此后再也无法感知正常日月流逝。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is said that fine sand constantly pours from its hollow body, as if POKENAME had shattered the concept of time itself. Anyone who witnesses its powers becomes unable to perceive the normal flow of days ever again.

entry: 若往POKENAME颈部的洞中看，就会遭受恐怖而永无止境的噩梦。人们相信，这些受害者的灵魂，将永远无法安息。
author: shikuren
source: If you were to look into the hole in POKENAME's neck, you would be subjected to horrific, never-ending nightmares. It is believed that the souls of those who fall victim to this will never be able to rest.

entry: 革命性科技与压倒性灵力结合，POKENAME已强化得近乎无懈可击。传闻原被设计成超级武器，却因怕热被放弃。
author: quietcognition
source: A fusion of revolutionary technologies and overwhelming spiritual power, POKENAME has been augmented to the point of nigh-invulnerability. There are rumors that POKENAME was designed to be a superweapon but was abandoned due to its weakness to heat.

entry: POKENAME飘过荒原，吸取四周一切的能量维生。身体完全中空，却充满电力。
author: hummusishome
source: POKENAME floats through wastelands, sapping energy from everything around it to fuel itself. Its body is completely hollow and full of electricity.

entry: POKENAME成年时，没能完全挣脱蛹壳。本会形成脱壳忍者的活跃灵魂，转与它结合，使其被越来越多层未蜕成的壳困住。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have failed to fully pull free of their chrysalises as they become adults. The animated spirits that would normally produce a Shedinja instead bond with POKENAME, trapping it in increasing layers of failed sheds.

entry: POKENAME翅膀从不动，却能飞过音速。只须一次碰撞，就可能把空壳彻底撞碎。
author: .izik
source: Though its wings never move, POKENAME can soar faster than sound. A single collision could shatter its hollow shell completely.

entry: 月食时，成群POKENAME围成圆圈，向天空挥舞魔杖，仿佛正举行某种仪式。
author: kittyluv090
source: On lunar eclipses, groups of POKENAME will assemble in a circle while waving their wands towards the sky, as if performing a ritual of some sort.

entry: POKENAME悬在灯柱上，空身模仿下方灯光。它从上方注视，一动不动，长臂无生气地垂着。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hovers above lamp posts, its hollow body mimicking the lights below. It watches from above, unmoving, its long arms dangling lifelessly.

entry: POKENAME挂在腐树，顺风散布毒鳞。谁靠太近，就先以藤缠住，再用一阵鳞粉猛吹。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hangs from decaying trees, spreading its poisonous scales along the wind. If anyone gets too close, it will wrap them in its vines before blasting them with a gust of its scales.

entry: 两颗头都不争主导，因此能配合得分毫不差。望见POKENAME的人，却会莫名悲伤，仿佛失去了一位素未谋面的挚爱。
author: ozydamians
source: Neither head takes the lead, allowing them to move with perfect synchronization. Those who look upon POKENAME feel as though they grieve the loss of a beloved partner they never met.

entry: POKENAME几乎全不动，却仍渴望肆意破坏。植物、建筑，甚至活物，在身边待得越久，就越衰弱败坏。
author: sk372
source: Despite being almost completely motionless, POKENAME still possesses a desire for wanton destruction. Plants, structures and even biological beings slowly weaken and degrade the longer they remain in its presence.

entry: POKENAME悠闲飘过天空，从不扇翼。有人凝望空眼窝后，觉得不安而疲惫。
author: sondededoo
source: POKENAME drift casually through the sky, never once flapping its wings. Those who look into its eye sockets have reported feeling uneasy and exhausted afterwards.

entry: POKENAME白火多烟，一处停得够久，整片地方都会罩上使人暂时失忆的雾。
author: banzai.exe
source: The white fire of a POKENAME is smoky, and if left in one place long enough, the entire location will be covered in a fog that causes temporary amnesia.

entry: POKENAME是一种罕见的土居忍士，在蜕壳中途死去。据说，往它背上的裂缝里看，便会被夺去灵魂。
author: schwaus
source: POKENAME is a rare form of Nincada which died in the middle of removing its shell. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one's spirit.

entry: 神秘的POKENAME似乎现身纷争困苦之地。人们认为，它寻痛苦源头，不论缘由，都想战斗。
author: craigprime
source: The mysterious POKENAME seems to appear wherever strife and hardship are prevalent. It is believed that it seeks out sources of suffering with the intention of fighting, regardless of the cause.

entry: POKENAME是最有活力的脱壳忍者融合体之一，快得几乎疯狂。贴住别人，一碰就吸活力，让对方无精打采，自己却精力旺盛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is one of the most spirited of Shedinja fusions, moving around quickly and almost frantically. It clings to others and drains their vitality with a touch, leaving them listless while keeping its own energy high.

entry: 碰一条POKENAME轻烟般的尾，会烧去一段不快记忆。可碰了多条，也有失去快乐回忆的风险。
author: banzai.exe
source: Touching one of POKENAME's wispy tails burns away an unpleasant memory. However, if someone touches multiple tails, they risk losing pleasant memories as well.

entry: POKENAME无声悬过大地，触须轻刷其他生灵。被碰者感到寒意，许多人相信，接触太久会被偷魂。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hovers across the land silently, brushing its feelers against other creatures. Others get a chill from the touch, and many believe prolonged contact will lead to one's soul being stolen.

entry: 许多人觉得POKENAME外貌令人不安。虽是空壳，天性却善良、爱照料。
author: t3isukone
source: Many find the appearance of a POKENAME distressing. Despite being an empty husk, it has a kind and nurturing nature.

entry: 古老迷信称，若常见POKENAME在家旁徘徊，不久可怕悲剧就会降临自己与家人。
author: mepp.
source: An old superstition claims that if one were to see a POKENAME frequently lingering near their house, a terrible tragedy would soon befall them and their family.

entry: POKENAME镀铜壳满是孔。传说警告，盯某孔太久，它便会无声无痕地吸走生命精气。
author: .izik
source: Holes dot POKENAME's copper-plated shell. Legends warn that staring into one too long allows it to drain your life essence silently and without a trace.

entry: 最好别跟POKENAME，因它常引训练家进入强大龙宝可梦的巢。鳞片常蜕，培育过许多龙属性宝可梦的训练家，往往争相收集。
author: mistymagius
source: It is best not to follow a POKENAME as it often lures Trainers into the dens of strong Dragon Pokémon. It molts its scales frequently, and they are often sought after by prolific Dragon Trainers.

entry: 它沿地无声滑近猎物，只为扑上无法行动的目标，才站起身。凡进入身下漆黑虚空的东西，都再也不见。
author: craigprime
source: It glides along the ground silently to approach its prey, only standing itself up in order to fall upon an incapacitated target. Anything that enters the inky void under its body is never seen again.

entry: 有经验的登山男，险峻攀登中遇见POKENAME都会小心。它无声悬在雪山危险处，表示有致命冰隙，或容易雪崩。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: Experienced Hikers know to exercise caution when encountering POKENAME on difficult ascents. POKENAME silently hovers over dangerous areas atop snow-capped mountains, indicating the presence of deadly crevasses or locations prone to avalanches.

entry: 传说POKENAME是惨死在暴风雪荒山的登山男之魂。诡异悬在雪崩后的现场，令救援队不安，更助长恐怖传说。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: According to legend, POKENAME are the spirits of Hikers who met tragic ends on inhospitable, blizzard-swept mountains. POKENAME eerily hover over the aftermath of avalanches, unsettling rescue teams and fueling these unnerving myths.

entry: POKENAME一生大多无精打采地躺地不动。偶尔空眼流出怪黏液，似乎能让周围土壤与植物重焕生机。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will spend most of its life laying listlessly and unmoving upon the ground. On occasion, a strange goop will leak from its hollow eyes, which seems to rejuvenate the plant life and soil surrounding it.

entry: POKENAME空壳内产生纯净黏性残留物，一碰就易黏身。附着者会有诡异而沉重的感觉，仿佛背着怨恨。
author: gaogao028
source: POKENAME produces a pristine gooey residue from inside its husk. This substance easily latches on through touch, emitting an eerie feeling on its bearer that heavily weighs down, akin to a grudge.

entry: 据说POKENAME生于遗失的人偶，拼命寻找丢掉它们的孩子。可不想复仇，只想与主人重聚。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME were said to be born from lost dolls as they desperately search for the children that lost them. However, they do not want revenge, they just want to be reunited with their owners.

entry: 容纳POKENAME灵魂的壳，由牧场丢弃的麻布、布料与稻草构成。牧场不再需要它，便漫无目的地游过沙漠，寻找新家。
author: skittytales
source: The shell that contains POKENAME's spirit is made up of discarded burlap, cloth, and straw from ranches. Since the ranch no longer has a use for it, POKENAME wanders aimlessly through the desert in search of a new home.

entry: POKENAME白天不动，只在漆黑夜里缓缓无声移动。附近真菌会萎缩死去，随后自己背上的苍白蘑菇变大。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is immobile during the day, only moving slowly and quietly in the pitch-black of night. Fungi shrivel up and die in its presence, with the pale mushrooms on its own back growing in size afterward.

entry: POKENAME响亮歌声诡异刺耳。传说听见的人，很快便会丧命。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's sonorous song is an eerie and discordant tune. According to legend, those that hear it will soon meet a swift demise.

entry: 传说POKENAME曾是引魂者，以歌声送亡魂前往彼岸。如今，却以听见歌声者的灵魂为食。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: Legend says POKENAME was once a guide who used songs to send spirits off to the afterlife. Now, it feeds off the souls of those who hear its song.

entry: POKENAME只在无月夜出现。敌人看古怪舞蹈，便不愿再战，让它趁机吸走生命力。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME only appears on moonless nights. Enemies who watch its strange dance find themselves unwilling to fight, allowing this Pokémon to absorb their life force.

entry: POKENAME的身体完全中空，干燥坚硬的外壳里，除了白色孢子，什么也没有。孢子会飘出去，吸取接触到的活物的生命，再返回它黑暗的体内。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is completely hollow, with nothing inside its hard dry shell except for white spores. These spores float out to leech life from any living thing they touch, then return back to POKENAME's dark interior.

entry: POKENAME会从爪中能抓住的任何东西里吸取光，为自己供能，将目标的能量彻底抽干。故事里，若盯着它发出的光看得太久，生命力也会被吸走。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are known to siphon light from anything they can get in their claws to fuel themselves, completely draining the target of energy. In stories, if one stared at the light POKENAME emits for too long, their life force would be drained.

entry: POKENAME互击鳞片，声音在空壳回响。取下一片，就在身体开孔，取者也会被下咒。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME strikes its scales together, the sound they make reverberates inside its hollow shell. Removing one of POKENAME's scales opens a hole in its body, placing a curse on whoever took it.

entry: POKENAME几乎不可毁坏，在海洞练武。壳虽薄，却中空，切割穿刺都伤害不大。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME are nearly indestructible warriors that train themselves in martial arts within sea caves. Their shells are very thin but hollow, so cutting or piercing them causes little harm.

entry: POKENAME住在风吹不到的幽暗僻处，免被卷得翻滚。诡异站定，受害者一转身，就潜近，以臂刺入，吸取生命。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is found in dark, secluded areas where the wind cannot reach it and send it tumbling. It stands eerily still, but as soon as a victim turns their back, POKENAME will creep up to them, stab them with an arm, and leech their life force.

entry: POKENAME的宝石全被挖走，只剩空空躯体。曾冠在头顶的那颗，如今碎片永远悬浮，仿佛凝在被取出的瞬间。
author: wormspawn
source: All POKENAME's gems have been mined away, leaving only a hollow body. The gem that crowned its head now forever hovers in pieces, frozen in the moment of extraction.

entry: POKENAME常被当作空壳，无人时才活跃。旋杖沐在幽灵般的精神光里，吸引虫属性宝可梦。对方一着迷，就用穿甲口器进食。
author: ghostslythe
source: Dismissed as a hollow husk, POKENAME becomes active when it senses no humans around. It twirls its staff, bathed in ghostly psychic light, attracting Bug types. While they are mesmerized it strikes, using its armor-penetrating proboscis to feast.

entry: POKENAME动作突然而难料，扭曲出有骨肉便做不到的姿势。头顶飘手里剑，自行护卫，看不见它有任何身体操控。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME moves in sudden and unexpected motions, contorting its body in ways that would be impossible if it had bones and flesh. The shuriken floating above it defends POKENAME without any visible physical guidance from it.

entry: POKENAME似乎一夜出现在田里，半身探洞，诡异不动。往往同时有虫宝可梦群到来，研究者正在调查这巧合。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME seem to appear overnight in fields, remaining eerily still as they sit half-emerged in their burrows. Their appearance usually coincides with the arrival of bug Pokémon swarms, a coincidence Pokémon researchers are investigating.

entry: 恶毒迷信缠着POKENAME，使其野外遭重捕猎。故事称，盯它太久，会失去爱与被爱的能力。
author: sk372
source: A vicious superstition follows POKENAME, leading to it being heavily hunted in the wild. According to the stories, those that gaze too long at it will lose the ability to love or be loved.

entry: POKENAME似乎一夜出现在田里，半身探洞，诡异不动。往往同时有虫宝可梦群到来，研究者正在调查这巧合。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME seem to appear overnight in fields, remaining eerily still as they sit half-emerged in their burrows. Their appearance usually coincides with the arrival of bug Pokémon swarms, a coincidence Pokémon researchers are investigating.

entry: POKENAME似乎一夜出现在田里，半身探洞，诡异不动。往往同时有虫宝可梦群到来，研究者正在调查这巧合。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME seem to appear overnight in fields, remaining eerily still as they sit half-emerged in their burrows. Their appearance usually coincides with the arrival of bug Pokémon swarms, a coincidence Pokémon researchers are investigating.

entry: POKENAME悬在原地，发出轻柔而诡异、规律的呼噜声。不眨眼、不呼吸，只盯着，身体静得令人不安。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats in place, purring softly with an eerie, rhythmic tone. It never blinks, never breathes, only stares with its body disturbingly still.

entry: 野生POKENAME常悬在被毁树木、巨石的中心。只在破坏后才被目击，有研究者因此推测，是被残留怒气吸引。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Wild POKENAME are often found floating in the centre of destroyed trees and boulders. They are only ever seen in the aftermath of the destruction, leading to a theory amongst some researchers that they are drawn to the residual rage in the area.

entry: 流行都市传说称，盯POKENAME腹部涡纹，会被吸魂。它独居泥地。
author: bobosmith01
source: A popular urban legend states that staring into the spiral on POKENAME's stomach will allow it to drain your soul. It dwells in muddy areas and lives alone.

entry: POKENAME身体构造难以理解：没有明显可供高等思考的内脏，却仍展现惊人智慧。传闻性格取决于来源土居忍士的饮食。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME defies physical description; there are no obvious internal organs that would allow it to produce higher thought, yet it still shows remarkable intelligence. Rumors state its personality depends on the diet of the Nincada it came from.

entry: POKENAME看似不动、无生命，可一不被注视，就会立刻瞬移。明明身体无法拿东西，却从不缺那两把汤匙。
author: staghorn
source: A POKENAME appears to be immobile and inanimate, but will teleport away the instant it is no longer being viewed. It is never seen without its two spoons, despite being physically unable to carry them.

entry: 传说，POKENAME是一只宝可梦斗志的化身。至于究竟是哪一只，可就难以查证了。
author: dusknoir64
source: Legends say that POKENAME is a manifestation of the fighting spirit of a Pokémon. Proving which Pokémon has been difficult, though.

entry: 黑夜或极暗处，POKENAME会朝地下某个定点刨挖地面。究竟想去哪、目的为何，没人清楚。
author: fireflower20002
source: On dark nights or in extreme darkness, POKENAME will claw the ground towards a specific point underground. Nobody exactly knows where POKENAME wants to go or for what purpose.

entry: 黑夜或极暗处，POKENAME会朝地下某个定点刨挖地面。究竟想去哪、目的为何，没人清楚。
author: fireflower20002
source: On dark nights or in extreme darkness, POKENAME will claw the ground towards a specific point underground. Nobody exactly knows where POKENAME wants to go or for what purpose.

entry: POKENAME夜里出现，仿佛一块肌肉不动，也在全速疾驰。据说瞥见它奔行，便预示死期将近。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears at night, seeming to gallop at full speed without even moving a muscle. Catching a glimpse of it in motion is said to be a sign that one's demise is approaching.

entry: POKENAME看似完全无生命，即使升空飘走，身体也不动。据说凝视背孔，脑中智力会被抽走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears completely inert, staying motionless even when it levitates and floats away. It's said that those who gaze into the hole in its back will have the intelligence drained from their minds.

entry: POKENAME大多躺地不动。电子设备一靠近，机器忽然没了电，它却活跃起来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends most of its time lying on the ground motionless. If electronic devices enter its vicinity, the machinery suddenly loses all power, and POKENAME springs to life.

entry: POKENAME手中大葱灌着幽灵能量。一接触，打中处的神经会暂时麻木。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The leek carried by POKENAME is imbued with ghostly energy. Upon contact, it temporarily deadens the nerves wherever it hits.

entry: POKENAME中空、易碎，不善泳，常困在水面，很容易被误认成蜕下外骨骼。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME cannot swim well thanks to their hollow, brittle bodies and tend to end up trapped on the surface of the water. They can easily be mistaken for shed exoskeletons.

entry: POKENAME不断蜕鳞，被收集磨粉，用于制作能力防守。鳞片极抢手，常被人秘密采集。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME constantly sheds scales that are collected and ground into powder, later used in the creation of Guard Spec. The scales are highly sought after and often gathered in secret.

entry: POKENAME自己少动，手中摆锤却神秘地总在动。有人转开目光后，发现它换了位置；也有人看别处太久，竟发现自己睡着了。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME itself rarely moves, but mysteriously, the pendulum it holds always does. People have reported POKENAME sometimes changing positions if they look away from it, and others have reported finding themselves asleep if they look away too long.

entry: POKENAME曾被见无声悬在渔夫大量钓起大钳蟹、供给餐厅的地方。有人说，它用巨钳收集死去大钳蟹的魂。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been seen silently hovering over areas where fishermen have reeled in massive amounts of Krabby for restaurants. Some say it gathers the souls of deceased Krabby within its massive pincer.

entry: POKENAME精力足、爱争论，尽量装得高大吓人，不打也能退敌。真被逼住，就从刺喷毒，再逃走，保护敏感球茎。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are very energetic and argumentative, trying to act big and threatening to scare off attackers without having to fight. If they're cornered, they will spray poison from their spines before running off to protect their sensitive bulbs.

entry: 它每天大半时间都在啃能强身的树果。POKENAME害怕，额角就渗毒，在地上留下紫斑。
author: fiordaliso
source: It spends most of the day nibbling on berries that can make its body stronger. When POKENAME is frightened, the horn on its forehead oozes a toxin that leaves purplish stains on the ground.

entry: POKENAME每群恰好十只，不多不少。只要会改变这数量，连幼年个体也被赶走，原因仍不明。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME live in groups of ten, no more, no less. Even young POKENAME will be kicked out of the group if it were to alter this number. The reason behind this behavior is not yet known.

entry: POKENAME有怪习惯，将桃桃果压泥，抹在头骨。似乎既能磨亮骨头，也削弱自身毒性，免伤旁人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have a peculiar habit of crushing up Pecha Berries and rubbing the resulting paste on their skulls. This seems to keep their skulls polished, while also keeping their own poison more dulled so as to not harm others.

entry: POKENAME唾液带毒，能使视线模糊。被舌打中，视力受损，它便更易逃避或进攻。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's saliva contains poison that can cause blurred vision. Anyone struck by its tongue will find their sight impaired, making it easier for POKENAME to evade or attack.

entry: POKENAME毒针细、易断，捕食者若不慎或心急，常落得满嘴毒刺。据说忍者曾用这些落刺，执行秘密任务。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME's poisonous pins are thin and easily broken; unwary or impatient predators can easily wind up with a mouthful of toxic spines. Supposedly, ninjas would use these discarded spines on clandestine missions.

entry: POKENAME外表坚硬，其实胆小，只有感到威胁才冲撞。护甲覆毒油，妥善处理后，可用于舒缓关节痛。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite POKENAME's tough exterior, it is actually quite timid, only charging when it feels threatened. Its armor is coated in a poisonous oil that, when handled properly, can be used to treat aching joints.

entry: POKENAME看见哭泣的小宝可梦，就注入让其入睡的微毒。剂量少，不会伤害，只带来休息与慰藉。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME sees a crying young Pokémon, it will inject them with a mild poison that causes them to sleep. This doesn't harm the Pokémon due to the small dosage, offering them rest and comfort.

entry: POKENAME每根藤蔓都覆薄绿毒，触碰会头痛，因此能驱赶捕食者与闯入者。
author: .izik
source: Each of POKENAME's vines is coated in a thin layer of green poison. The poison can cause headaches if touched, making it a deterrent to predators and intruders.

entry: POKENAME受威胁，从刺喷出极难洗掉的毒墨。生活在近海底，睡觉埋进沙。
author: mistymagius
source: When threatened, POKENAME will spray a poisonous ink from its spines that is incredibly hard to wash off. It lives near the seafloor, burying itself in the sand while it sleeps.

entry: POKENAME通常在浅水中游动，因为鳍不够强，承受不了河流的急流。捕食者来袭时，它会用头顶伸出的毒角攻击，自卫御敌。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME tends to swim in shallow waters, as its fins aren't strong enough to withstand the powerful currents of rivers. It defends itself from predators by striking them with the poisonous horn protruding from the top of its head.

entry: POKENAME通常在浅水中游动，因为鳍不够强，承受不了河流的急流。捕食者来袭时，它会用头顶伸出的毒角攻击，自卫御敌。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME tends to swim in shallow waters, as its fins aren't strong enough to withstand the powerful currents of rivers. It defends itself from predators by striking them with the poisonous horn protruding from the top of its head.

entry: POKENAME与同类飞舞花田。对人温顺，但倒刺与翼鳞有毒，不宜裸肤触碰。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME flutters around flower fields with others of its kind. Although it is docile around humans, it should not be touched with bare skin due to the toxins in its barbs and wing scales.

entry: POKENAME刀刃覆着使人失忆的毒。一刀割伤，就可能让受害者迷乱，记忆模糊或丧失。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's blades are coated with a poison that causes amnesia. A single cut from its sharp blades can leave victims disoriented and with memories clouded or lost.

entry: POKENAME钳状耳朵能凿入枫树，让甜树液滴落。以此为食，凭强钳轻松采食含糖汁液。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's pincer-like ears can dig into maple trees to cause sweet sap to drip out. It feeds on this sap, using its powerful pincers to harvest the sugary substance with ease.

entry: POKENAME敬重巢里年长宝可梦，通常最后才吃，表示尊重。不离巢太远，因此新手训练家不太好捉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shows deference towards older Pokémon in its nest and usually eats last to show respect for others. It does not wander far from its nest, which makes catching one somewhat difficult for new Trainers.

entry: 它们体内毒素随环境变化，各种变体效果不同。主流学说认为，自身DNA不稳定，受周围过强影响。
author: infinex21
source: The poison within these Pokémon changes based on their environments, each variation having different effects from one another. The leading theory for this is that their own DNA is unstable and overtly influenced by their surroundings.

entry: POKENAME白天少见，夜里常出现。如何移动仍未知，却曾被观察到跟随月亮在天上划过的弧线。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME are rarely seen during the day, but often appear at night. It is unknown how they move, but they've been observed to follow the arc of the moon through the sky.

entry: 小爪强壮带毒。POKENAME跃入空中，用爪钩住猎物，再等毒生效，便可进食。
author: infinex21
source: Their small claws are strong and venomous. POKENAME launch themselves into the air and latch onto prey with their claws, then wait for the venom to take effect so they may feed.

entry: 据说POKENAME一起飞，天空就布满雷云与闪电。羽毛覆毒刺，最好别捡。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is said that when POKENAME takes flight, the sky fills with storm clouds and lightning. Since its feathers are covered in poisonous spines it is best not to pick them up.

entry: POKENAME胆小避战，满身小毒刺吓退捕食者。频繁蜕皮，角与刺随之脱落，长回后总比以前更强韧、更毒。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a timid Pokémon that avoids battle. Its body is covered in small poisonous quills to deter predators. It frequently sheds its skin, losing horns and quills that always regrow stronger and more toxic than before.

entry: POKENAME通常温顺，暴怒时全身微小倒刺竖起防御。倒刺注入致命毒，瓦解受害者DNA。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME is generally docile, but when enraged, microscopic barbs all along its body will raise in defense. These barbs inject a deadly toxin that unravels the victim's DNA.

entry: 为护小生灵，POKENAME挡在身前，向攻击者挥叶，扇去令人厌恶的苦气味，强到能让成年人头晕。
author: sk372
source: To defend other small creatures, POKENAME stands before them and waves its leaf at aggressors. This causes it to waft a repulsively bitter aroma their way, strong enough to make a full-grown human woozy.

entry: 它从背放出滚烫毒烟云，驱赶捕食者。大耳极敏感，即使蜷在密草睡觉，也能察觉危险。
author: wiqor
source: It emits a cloud of hot, toxic fumes from its back to ward off predators. Its large ears are highly sensitive, allowing it to detect danger even while it sleeps curled in dense grass.

entry: 它点燃背边毒烟，爆出灼热火焰自卫。身贴地，靠敏感感官与灵巧身躯先攻，再隐回遮蔽处。
author: wiqor
source: It defends itself by igniting the toxic fumes along its back, creating bursts of searing flame. It keeps low to the ground, using its sharp senses and nimble frame to strike before vanishing into cover.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛覆着细小毒针，吸入十分危险。它在小树上筑巢，花在照看蛋上的时间，比捕猎觅食还要多。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's feathers are covered in tiny, poisonous needles that are extremely dangerous to breathe in. It builds its nest in small trees, spending more of its time looking after its eggs than hunting for food.

entry: 面对大威胁，POKENAME会秀小臂肌肉，或撑尾显高，试图威吓。没用就绕着目标，以利刺不停拍打。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Against a bigger threat, POKENAME attempt to intimidate it by flexing their small arms or balancing on their tails to appear taller. If that fails, POKENAME will maneuver around their target and relentlessly smack it with their sharp quills.

entry: 它少睡，却会静休片刻节能，因此有时被其他宝可梦忽视。一不小心撞上POKENAME，就会吃大苦头：满身都是毒刺！
author: bobosmith01
source: While it rarely sleeps, it does rest still for some time to conserve energy. As a result, sometimes other Pokémon overlook it. This can lead to a nasty shock if POKENAME is accidentally stumbled upon: their body is covered in poisonous barbs!

entry: POKENAME视力锐，能看出捕食者攻势空隙，轻松逃走。无处可逃，就用覆毒脚爪精准反击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's keen eyesight allows it to spot openings in a predator's attacks, enabling it to escape with ease. When escape is impossible, it will fight back with poison-coated talons, striking with precision.

entry: POKENAME用锋利的门牙咬穿树干的外皮，吸食其中的树汁。它们偏爱有毒树种，将毒素融入自身，借此吓退捕食者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their sharp incisors to bite through the bark of a tree's trunk and feed on the sap within. They prefer to feed on toxic species, incorporating the poisons into their own bodies to deter predators.

entry: POKENAME拳上微刺满是毒。任何东西靠花地太近，都会遭攻击，以毒刺守领地。
author: .izik
source: Microscopic barbs on POKENAME's fists are filled with venom. It attacks anyone who gets too close to its flower patch, using its stingers to defend its territory.

entry: POKENAME耳聪目明，捕猎极成功。毒牙与尖刺能注入足量毒，使大得多的宝可梦失去行动，甚至令人重病。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME's excellent hearing and eyesight make it a very successful hunter. Its venomous bite and spikes can inject enough poison to disable much larger Pokémon and can even make humans very ill.

entry: POKENAME吐出覆毒丝网，捕猎或自卫。网黏、有毒，强到连最坚韧敌人也能定住。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits a poison-coated webbing and uses it to trap prey or defend itself from attackers. This sticky, toxic web is strong enough to immobilize even the toughest foes.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉灵，能找到鲜树果与藏着的小猎物。餐后若有余食，就飞去找小宝可梦分享。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a sharp sense of smell, letting it locate fresh berries and small prey in hiding. If it has any leftovers from a meal, it flies about to search for smaller Pokémon to share them with.

entry: 这些小宝可梦在发电厂工人间臭名昭著，常啃电缆，吃里面的电。胡须也有毒，更难对付。
author: infinex21
source: These small Pokémon are infamous with power plant workers, for they will oft nibble on cables to feed on the electricity within. Their whiskers are venomous, making them further troublesome to deal with.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME毒强到能击倒喷火龙。月周期其余时间多较弱，只有特定月相才猛烈。
author: .izik
source: During a full moon, POKENAME's poison is strong enough to knock out a Charizard. During the rest of the lunar cycle, its poison is rather weak, only becoming potent during specific phases of the moon.

entry: 雌性POKENAME需要大量社交才满足。野外通常没问题，可若意外被群落落下，就会深陷抑郁，完全忘了照顾自己。
author: bobosmith01
source: Female POKENAME require a lot of socialization to be satisfied. This is usually no problem in the wild, but if one is accidentally left behind by its colony, it will fall into a deep depression and completely forget to take care of itself.

entry: POKENAME爱离地，爬上训练家肩膀坐。轻轻扎入倒刺保持稳定，据报告感觉像针灸，能安抚训练家。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME like to be off the ground and climb up their Trainer to sit on their shoulder. They gently dig in their barbs to keep themselves stable, which has been reported to feel similar to acupuncture, calming the Trainer.

entry: POKENAME训练家须定期剪毛，避免过长。毛太多会烦躁，更容易咬人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME Trainers should be sure to regularly shear its wool to avoid overgrowth. Excessive wool causes POKENAME to become agitated and more prone to biting others.

entry: POKENAME滑翔猎物上方，发射毒针，轻松捕捉。习惯以带刺野蔷薇丛衬在巢边。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME fires Poison Sting while gliding over its prey to secure an easy catch. It has a habit of lining the edges of its nest with prickly wild rose brambles.

entry: POKENAME吐毒水，触碰可能发烧。用来防御，阻止捕食者靠太近。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits poisonous water that can cause a fever if touched. The liquid is a defense mechanism, deterring predators from getting too close.

entry: POKENAME手上圆凸浸满毒。群体站在洞口，挡住一切来者，只有亲族能进。
author: quackquackattack
source: The spherical protrusions on a POKENAME's hands are soaked in poison. Groups of POKENAME stand in front of their burrow to block access for everyone except those they have kindred ties to.

entry: POKENAME极胆小，总高度警觉，毒倒刺竖着。牙虽无毒，却比身上任何刺都尖，能迅速吃完一餐，再急忙跑走。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are very timid, always on high alert with their toxic barbs raised. While their teeth aren't venomous, they are sharper than any of the barbs along their bodies, ensuring they can finish their meal quickly before scurrying away.

entry: 大群雌性POKENAME保护较少的胆怯雄性。同族期望雌性成为强战士，因此它们常练敏捷与力量。
author: bobosmith01
source: A large group of female POKENAME protect a smaller group of timid males. Expected by their kin to become strong warriors, female POKENAME train often to improve their agility and strength.

entry: POKENAME全身覆盖数百根毒毛，使鸟类宝可梦不愿尝试捕食它。如果周围的土壤缺乏养分，它就会开始啃食其他植物，维持生计。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is covered in hundreds of poisonous hairs, which dissuades bird Pokémon from trying to eat it. If the soil around it is lacking in nutrients, it will start to nibble on other plants for sustenance.

entry: POKENAME爱玩泥，皮肤能从中吸养分。性情温和，开心与其他宝可梦分享点心。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to play in the mud because they can absorb nutrients through their skin. They are mild-mannered creatures that happily share treats with other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME捕猎时让身上圆环发亮，与伙伴协调。额角含有足以麻痹神经系统的毒。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME makes the rings on its body glow during hunts to coordinate with its companions. The horn on its brow is laced with toxins capable of paralyzing the nervous system.

entry: POKENAME用背上带刺藤蔓鞭敌，保护花苞。在阳光充足处晒太阳，帮助背上球茎发育。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME defend their flower bulbs by whipping foes with the barbed vines from their back. They sunbathe in places with lots of sunlight to develop the bulb on their back.

entry: POKENAME从背放出带毒刺藤，保护敏感花苞。球茎散孢子，吸入会昏昏沉沉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME protect their sensitive flower bulbs by unleashing poisonous barbed vines from their back. Their bulb releases spores that cause grogginess when inhaled.

entry: POKENAME在餐厅后垃圾箱翻食。谁靠太近，就用角扎刺注毒。领地意识让它极护食源。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME roots through dumpsters behind restaurants for food scraps, and will prick someone with its horns to inject venom if they get too close. Its territorial nature makes it highly protective of its food source.

entry: 它虽可爱，却爱玩恐怖恶作剧，吓唬人类。红珠吸到的恐惧越多，体内毒便越强。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite its adorable appearance, it is a mischievous Pokémon that plays terrifying pranks to frighten humans. The more fear it manages to absorb into its red pearls, the more potent the venom inside its body becomes.

entry: 它虽可爱，却爱玩恐怖恶作剧，吓唬人类。红珠吸到的恐惧越多，体内毒便越强。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite its adorable appearance, it is a mischievous Pokémon that plays terrifying pranks to frighten humans. The more fear it manages to absorb into its red pearls, the more potent the venom inside its body becomes.

entry: POKENAME尾巴比主头好斗得多，路过谁都想用毒角扎。主头却宁可安静吃草，不管尾巴干什么。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's tail is significantly more aggressive than the main head and it will try to prick anyone who passes by with its poisonous horn. The main head however prefers to peacefully graze on grass and ignore the tail's actions.

entry: POKENAME咬下时注入强毒，让人无力嗜睡数日。咬击常是最后防御，令对手长时间虚弱迟钝。
author: .izik
source: When biting, POKENAME injects a powerful venom that causes lethargy for days. Its bite is often a last-ditch defense, leaving its opponents weak and sluggish for a prolonged period.

entry: POKENAME群猎绿毛虫，注毒削弱。策略让群体高效捕住、制住猎物，确保捕猎成功。
author: .izik
source: Flocks of POKENAME prey on Caterpie, injecting their venom to weaken them. This tactic helps the flocks efficiently capture and incapacitate their prey, ensuring a successful hunt.

entry: POKENAME以强钳保护雌性尼多兰群。钳住敌人，也会从爪注毒；幸好毒性较弱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its powerful pincers to defend groups of female Nidoran. Its claws deliver a poison to those it places in its powerful grip, though fortunately for them the toxin is rather mild.

entry: POKENAME巨角覆毒，不宜碰，可能引发高烧。毒性强，足以压倒任何挑战者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's huge horn is coated in poison that shouldn't be touched, as it can cause an intense fever. The venom is potent and can overwhelm anyone who challenges POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME狡黠聪明，善偷训练家的珠宝小物。爪尖带毒，追起来危险，因此许多训练家把贵重物留在家。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have an artful intelligence that helps them steal jewelry and trinkets from Trainers. Their venom-tipped claws make them dangerous to pursue, so many Trainers keep precious belongings at home.

entry: POKENAME先撒娇，想避开冲突，再躲到大宝可梦后寻求保护。甜美天真下，藏着避战倾向，依赖伙伴护卫。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME tries to charm its way out of confrontation, then hides behind larger Pokémon to protect it. Its sweet and innocent nature masks a tendency to avoid battle, relying on its companions for protection.

entry: POKENAME冒泡的身体由浓稠热毒构成，接触会烧伤。高热加毒，使它对靠太近者十分危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's bubbling body is made up of a thick, hot poison that can burn on contact. The intense heat and toxic nature make it a dangerous adversary for anyone who comes too close.

entry: POKENAME不爱战。受威胁就转身逃，留下一路由壳碎片构成的剧毒刺，极能阻止追击。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME prefers not to fight. When faced with a threat, it will turn and flee, leaving a trail of highly toxic spikes made of fragments from its shell. This is very effective at discouraging pursuit.

entry: POKENAME羽毛覆毒，领地意识极强。谁靠太近，就高声厉叫，展出毒羽，赶走潜在威胁。
author: .izik
