source: POKENAME's feathers are coated in poison. It is very territorial and will squawk loudly at anyone who gets too close, using its venomous display to ward off potential threats.

entry: POKENAME尾巴渗出的毒液，能熬成极辣的糖浆。经过这道工序，便已不再有毒，常被加进莎莎酱，为菜肴增添火辣风味。
author: .izik
source: The venom that oozes from POKENAME's tail can be boiled down into a syrup that is extremely spicy. Though it's no longer toxic after this process, it's often used in salsa, adding a fiery kick to the dish.

entry: POKENAME咬力与毒都弱，所带毒量刚够让攻击者迟缓，好逃走，滑行到安全藏处。
author: sk372
source: Both POKENAME's bite and its poison are rather weak. It carries just enough venom to make an attacker sluggish, so that it can escape and slither away to a safe place to hide.

entry: POKENAME滚到哪里，都留下一层毒，防止捕食者追随、靠近。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaves a coating of toxin anywhere it rolls. The poison serves as a defense, making it difficult for predators to follow or approach.

entry: 无畏小子的求练欲，让它敏捷、自卫本能强。大耳敏感，迅速察觉危险，POKENAME便能躲招，再从耳释放毒性物质保护自己。
author: kafoxnothylol_47795
source: Tyrogue's desire to train gave this Pokémon great agility and defensive instincts. Its large and sensitive ears help it detect danger quickly, allowing POKENAME to dodge attacks and release poisonous chemicals from those same ears to protect itself.

entry: POKENAME尖牙太小，刺不穿猎物防御，只好靠长身体绞缠，令其窒息。拿稳食物后，带回洞里与亲族分享。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have fangs that are too small to pierce through their prey's defenses, so they rely on their long bodies to choke their prey. Once their meal is secured, they bring it back to their den to share with their kin.

entry: POKENAME爱避战，先用电磁波制住敌人，再逃离。机敏灵巧，让它避开冲突，同时留敌人无法动弹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses Thunder Wave to stun foes before fleeing combat, as it prefers to stay away from fights. Its quick thinking and agility allow it to avoid confrontation while leaving its opponents immobilized.

entry: POKENAME挥尾，注入会引起发烧的毒凝胶。尾刺锋利，划出小伤口，让毒渗入。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swings its tail to inject a venomous gel that causes fevers. The barbs on its tail are sharp, making small wounds where the venom can seep inside.

entry: POKENAME靠施咒令敌人中毒。每道咒都精心安排，尽量不伤同伴。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME poisons its foes by casting spells. It structures each spell to avoid harming its allies as much as possible.

entry: POKENAME头上生长的圆石，渗出淡蓝色毒液，能熬成美味的意面酱。煮熟后毒性消失，只留下鲜美滋味。
author: .izik
source: The round stones growing on POKENAME's head leak a light blue poison that can be boiled down into a delicious sauce for pasta dishes. The poison is gone once cooked, leaving behind a savory flavor.

entry: POKENAME先毒倒猎物，再巧用屏障切断逃路。策略性防御将目标困住，确保无法逃跑。
author: .izik
source: After poisoning its prey, POKENAME uses clever tactics to cut off their escape with Barrier. This strategic defense traps its target, ensuring they cannot flee.

entry: POKENAME掘硬石时会出毒汗，帮助凿开坚韧表面，却也可能危及附近对象。
author: .izik
source: When digging through hard stone, POKENAME sweats poison. This toxic perspiration helps it carve through tough surfaces, though it can pose a danger to anyone nearby.

entry: POKENAME住在茂盛雨林，即使大雨，身上倒刺也能帮助爬树。皮肤产毒汗，让捕食者不敢尝试下口。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in lush rainforests, using the barbs on its body to climb trees even in heavy rain. Its skin produces a poisonous sweat that deters predators from trying to eat it.

entry: POKENAME爬上绿树摘熟果，常分给附近小宝可梦。用牙啃腕上羽叶，防止长得太长。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME climbs up verdant trees to pick ripe fruits, often sharing them with smaller Pokémon nearby. It uses its teeth to chew the fronds on its wrists to keep them from growing too lengthy.

entry: POKENAME群平日一起玩，母亲在附近看顾。捕食者靠巢，幼崽先吐火球或用毒角刮刺自卫，再退回安全处。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Groups of POKENAME spend their days playing together while their mother keeps watch nearby. When predators approach the nest, the young defend themselves by spitting fireballs or scratching with their toxic horns before retreating to safety.

entry: 爪更适合掘土，而非战斗。它们蜷起身、竖起毒刺，保护自己。
author: infinex21
source: Their claws are meant for digging more than they are for fighting. To defend themselves, they curl up with their venomous quills standing on-end.

entry: POKENAME很难向训练家传达感受，尤其承受不住时。训练家若逼太紧，可能挨它毒刺。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a difficult time conveying their feelings to their Trainer, especially when they are overwhelmed. Trainers who push them too much may get stung by their stinger.

entry: POKENAME爱玩、带点淘气，推推戳戳，只为引来反应。似乎尤其忍不住骚扰尼多朗进化系与相关融合体。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is playful and a bit impish in behavior, nudging and needling at others just to get a reaction out of them. It appears to be most compelled to badger the male Nidoran line and fusions pertaining to them.

entry: POKENAME虽聪明、出于好意，帮忙却让有些训练家抓狂。因为看别人犯一点小错，也忍不住要纠正。
author: sk372
source: Though highly intelligent and well-meaning, some POKENAME Trainers find themselves exasperated with its attempts at helping, as it is compelled to fix even the smallest error it spots someone committing.

entry: POKENAME爪适合挖小洞。背上倒刺剧毒，帮助防御潜在捕食者。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's claws are excellent for digging small burrows. The barbs all along its back are highly toxic, helping to defend from potential predators.

entry: POKENAME平日忙于在河里筑坝，用门牙切下树枝。宁可做平静工作，不爱打架，被追就藏起来。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spends its days building dams in rivers, using its front tooth to chop free tree limbs. It prefers not to fight and will hide when pursued, focusing on its peaceful tasks instead.

entry: POKENAME放出背上带毒刺藤，保护敏感花苞。还产黏孢子，沾衣后使颜色改变。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME protect their sensitive flower bulbs by unleashing poisonous barbed vines from their back. They produce sticky spores that cling and discolor clothing.

entry: POKENAME晒太阳，滋养背上球茎。受其他宝可梦威胁，带刺藤蔓便伸出，准备战斗。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME bask in the sunlight to nourish the bulb on their back. When they are threatened by other Pokémon, barbed vines emerge from their back to prepare for a fight.

entry: 极少数尼多兰进化后，仍会保留幼年特征。究竟由何种因素引起，仍然未知。
author: staghorn
source: Rarely, a female Nidoran retains its juvenile traits when it evolves. The factors that cause this to occur remain unknown.

entry: POKENAME察觉墓地家里有盗墓者，就注入强毒，直到早晨才消退。毒退后，小偷便能被拘捕。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME notices a graverobber in its cemetery home, it will inject them with a powerful venom that doesn't wear off until the morning. This ensures that the thief can be apprehended once the venom subsides.

entry: 据说POKENAME会出现在孤儿尼多兰面前，照看所需。由它养大的个体，据说格外强壮却温和，在野外坚定守护小宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to appear before orphaned Nidoran and take care of them in their time of need. Nidoran raised by it are said to be some of the strongest, yet most gentle of all, acting as stalwart defenders of young Pokémon in the wild.

entry: 尼多兰与尼多朗族群庞大、不断混居，因此野外见到POKENAME不太稀奇。它常为双方年幼成员调解。
author: sk372
source: Due to the Nidoran families having large groups and constantly intermingling, POKENAME is a less uncommon fusion to spy in the wild. It often seems to act as a mediator between younger members of both species.

entry: 传闻POKENAME曾是尼多兰，被一位憎恨该物种的疯狂铸剑师锻造成活剑，模样仿佛饱受折磨。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's seemingly tortured form is rumored to have once been a Nidoran, forged into a living sword by a deranged swordsmith who hated the species.

entry: POKENAME劈斩散出毒，慢慢破坏对手神经系统。以复杂步法招架，保护自己的鞘。
author: chibitales
source: Slashes from POKENAME spread a poison that slowly breaks down the opponent's nervous system. They move in complex patterns to parry attacks and protect their sheaths.

entry: POKENAME用角撞断幼树，垫在巢里。强角帮助在林中清空间，造安全安稳的休息地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its horn to knock apart saplings to line its nest. The strong horn helps it clear space in the forest, making a safe and secure environment for resting.

entry: 天敌来袭时，POKENAME会用缎带捆住对方，猛拉过来，撞上自己身上的毒刺。
author: melodydelune
source: If attacked by a predator, POKENAME will latch its ribbons onto its attacker and slam them into the poisonous barbs on its body.

entry: POKENAME结合尼多王巨力与雌性尼多兰的胆怯。伤害多属意外，察觉危险急转身逃，粗强尾巴便不慎撞上东西。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME mixes Nidoking's vast power with the female Nidoran's timid nature. Any damage it causes is typically incidental, accidentally hitting things with its thick and powerful tail as it quickly turns to flee from perceived danger.

entry: 虽然大得住不进巢，它们仍留在附近，吓走危及家庭的大宝可梦。只有真心示好的训练家，才可能与POKENAME交友。
author: quackquackattack
source: Even though they are too big to fit into their nest, they remain close to scare large, dangerous Pokémon away from their family. Only Trainers who offer honest intentions have a chance of befriending a POKENAME.

entry: 这些傲慢宝可梦极自恋，谁流露不认可，就被毒刺扎。可一找到伴侣，便无尽忠诚相伴。
author: mistymagius
source: These pompous Pokémon are very fond of themselves and will prick anyone who insinuates otherwise with their poisonous thorns. However, once they find a mate, they will be endlessly devoted to them.

entry: 有趣的是，在POKENAME与尼多卷耳群落里，正是这一阶段、这一性别的POKENAME地位最高。毛色最鲜艳者负责繁殖，其余仍受极优厚待遇。
author: bobosmith01
source: Fascinatingly, it is this stage and gender of POKENAME that ranks the highest in a colony of POKENAME and Nidoeary. Specifically, the one with the most vivid fur color is tasked with reproduction; others are still treated most lavishly.

entry: POKENAME全身数百小针，能注入强毒。战时易折，若被吸入，可能致命。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is covered in hundreds of tiny needles that will inject a potent poison. The needles break off easily while in combat, which can be lethal if they are inhaled.

entry: 它全身有锋利毒刺。若受委屈，就用手按自己一根刺，对敌人施咒，使其身体遭受POKENAME含毒怨恨的折磨。
author: .jerden
source: It has sharp, toxic barbs all over its body. If it is ever wronged, it will press its own hand against one of these spikes, cursing its foe to physically suffer from POKENAME's poisonous resentment.

entry: POKENAME与一些谜拟丘融合体住在托儿所，给孩子安慰与快乐。爱找更淘气的孩子玩，也热心帮忙恶作剧。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME live at daycares along with some Mimikyu fusions, providing comfort and joy to children. POKENAME tend to play with the more mischievous children, and eagerly assists in pranks.

entry: POKENAME太爱陪训练家，愿挂在钥匙圈上，始终待近处。隔一会儿就哔叫，讨要关注。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to spend time with their Trainer so much that they are willing to linger close by on keychains. They beep at regular intervals to demand attention.

entry: POKENAME毒网能引发抽搐。网中强毒让它成为危险猎手，轻易制住猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's toxic webbing can cause seizures. The potent venom in its webs makes it a dangerous predator, capable of incapacitating prey with ease.

entry: POKENAME戒备时，头火会冒毒烟。为免伤同类，只有紧急才放烟。
author: hophoppip
source: When POKENAME gets defensive, the flame on its head gives off toxic smoke. To avoid harming its brethren, it only emits this smoke in an emergency.

entry: POKENAME毒液能熬成糖状物，煮过便失去全部毒性。可加入各式辣咖喱，添独特风味。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's poison can be boiled down into a sugar-like substance. Since it loses all potency when cooked, it can be used in a variety of spicy curry dishes, adding a unique flavor.

entry: 女孩常在森林里发现POKENAME，它很快就会与她们亲近。虽极力保护饲主，却从不向她们显露真身。
author: houndrys.
source: Girls often find POKENAME in forests, and it quickly bonds with them. They are protective of their keeper, never revealing their true form to them.

entry: POKENAME若感到对手气息善良，毒性就减弱。似乎与共情本性深相连，善意在旁，毒性特征便消退。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's poison is less potent if it senses the foe they're fighting has a kind aura. This suggests a deeper connection to its empathetic nature where its venomous traits diminish in the presence of good intentions.

entry: POKENAME清晨精力特别足，这时毒也格外强。力量与毒性增强，让它在一天早段十分危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is extremely energized during morning hours, and its poison during this period is particularly potent. The heightened strength and toxicity make it a dangerous opponent in the early part of the day.

entry: POKENAME让尾巴明亮发光，警告伙伴危险将至。实验室利用体刺提取的毒，合成强效抗组胺药。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME makes its tail shine brightly to warn its companions of imminent danger. A venom extracted from the spines on its body is synthesized in laboratories to create powerful antihistamines.

entry: 它爱指挥，自任老师，教小宝可梦唱好歌，即使对方根本不想唱。若被忽视，便气得膨胀到两倍大。
author: bobosmith01
source: A bossy Pokémon that takes it upon itself to teach younger Pokémon to sing better, even if they have no desire to sing in the first place. If ignored, they inflate to double their size in anger.

entry: POKENAME头极强，用来撞猎物。毒汗一接触就渗入，逐渐削弱对方。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's head is extremely strong and is used to headbutt prey. Its poisonous sweat seeps into their body on contact, weakening them over time.

entry: POKENAME受威胁，会产出碰什么黏什么的毒花粉。来回摇摆，让空气饱含花粉，吓退多数宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: When threatened, POKENAME produce toxic pollen that sticks to whatever they touch. By swaying back and forth, they saturate the air with pollen and scare away most Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME背玫瑰美得诱人，却带刺。看似小而无害，仰慕者不慎靠近一步，就会被镇静毒香弄昏，此后再也不醒。
author: ecstaticwoop64556455
source: The rose on POKENAME's back is alluringly beautiful, but has its thorns. One step too close to this seemingly small, harmless Pokémon, and unwary admirers will lose consciousness from its tranquilizing and venomous aroma, never waking up again.

entry: POKENAME背上生藤，照料娇花。每根藤都带刺，渗着毒凝胶。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sprout vines from their back to take care of the delicate flower on their back. Each vine is covered with barbs that oozes with a toxic gel.

entry: POKENAME与同类住在空地，合作觅食。风暴时相互依偎，保暖，也防尾焰熄灭。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lives in clearings with others of its kind, working together to find food. During storms, it huddles with its companions to keep warm and prevent the flame on its tail from going out.

entry: POKENAME花苞滴出的凰梨果香树液，毒性极强。用作防御，阻止潜在威胁靠近。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's Pinap Berry-scented sap that drips from its bud is very poisonous. This sap serves as a defense mechanism, deterring potential threats from getting too close.

entry: POKENAME飘过森林，用长绳般的手臂摘毒叶吃。食物让毒更强，增强本领与防御。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats through forests, using its long, string-like arms to grab poisonous leaves to eat. This diet makes its poison stronger, enhancing its abilities and defenses.

entry: 野生POKENAME大多与尼多娜和卷卷耳、长耳兔的融合体相处，也亲近、照料雄性尼多卷耳与尼多兔，得以融入出生的群落。
author: bobosmith01
source: Wild POKENAME spends much of its time with the fusion between Nidorina and Buneary and Lopunny, but it also socializes and tends to male Nidoeary and Nidopunny, too, allowing it to become well-integrated into the colony it was birthed in.

entry: POKENAME成群旅行，轮流高频吱叫。持续嘈杂声，让它们在脑中看清周围。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME travel in swarms and take turns producing high-pitched squeaks. The constant cacophony of noise gives them a clear mental image of their surroundings.

entry: POKENAME小身布满细刺，一碰就注毒。虽不很强，麻痹毒仍足以使肌肉暂时僵住，让它逃到安全处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's small body is peppered with tiny spines that deliver venom when something touches it. Though not terribly potent, the paralytic toxin is enough to lock up muscles for a time and allow POKENAME to flee to safety.

entry: POKENAME特殊气味腺决定在超音蝠群中的地位。尽量避冲突，将决定留给更高位者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have special scent glands that determine their place in the hierarchy of groups of Zubat. They avoid conflict whenever they can and defer decisions to those who are higher up.

entry: POKENAME住在超音蝠群里，多负责高频吱叫，协助同类回声定位。性情顺从，尽量讨好亲族，避开冲突。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live among swarms of Zubat and are typically tasked with producing high-pitched squeaks to help their brethren use their echolocation. POKENAME are submissive creatures that avoid conflict by pleasing as many of their kin as they can.

entry: POKENAME毒性温和，一次攻击很少够击倒。便用坚韧身体滚撞，盼反复扎刺，注够毒，制住敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's poison is rather mild, so a single hit is rarely enough to down a foe. POKENAME rolls its resilient body against them in the hopes repeated piercing will inject enough toxin to incapacitate them.

entry: POKENAME莽撞冲锋，力量本已强，带毒角又让打击更致命。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME attacks by charging recklessly, its powerful strikes made even more lethal by its poison-tipped horn.

entry: POKENAME巨口只有一颗大牙，因此整吞食物，再睡着消化。鬃与锯齿骨突覆恶毒，休息时赶走捕食者。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's enormous maw contains one big tooth, so it swallows its meals whole, then sleeps to digest. Its mane and jagged bone-growths are coated in a noxious toxin that wards away predators while it rests.

entry: POKENAME战时边舞边散毒。旋转毒素扰乱敌人，使其更容易受催眠动作影响。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME scatters poison around the area while it dances during combat. The swirling toxins disorient its enemies, leaving them vulnerable to its hypnotic movements.

entry: POKENAME以树桩为家，总藏阴影。谁靠太近，就逃开冲突，只留下几缕存在的低语。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its home in tree stumps, always staying hidden in the shadows. If anyone gets too close, it will flee, avoiding confrontation and leaving behind only whispers of its presence.

entry: POKENAME身上斑点越多，毒便越危险。它很在意自己，斑点太多，就不肯现身。
author: mistymagius
source: The more spots there are on POKENAME's body, the more dangerous its poison is. It is a self-conscious Pokémon and will not show itself if it has too many spots.

entry: POKENAME吃腐烂植物，每天最多需50磅，才能养活自己与蘑菇。菇虽剧毒，孢子却被认为曾作药用。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME feeds on rotting plant matter, needing to eat up to 50 pounds of them a day to feed both it and its mushroom. Despite the mushroom being incredibly toxic, its spores are believed to have once been used for medicinal purposes.

entry: POKENAME用角松动崖石，再与同群玩抛物捡回的游戏。爱玩的性格让它合群，享受伙伴时光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its horn to loosen stones from cliff walls, then plays fetch with others in its pack. This playful behavior makes it a social creature, enjoying time with its companions.

entry: POKENAME清晨出洞前大声长嚎。毛上覆毒，碰到可能让人身上长出危险疮疡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes loud howls in the early morning before venturing out of its den. Its fur is coated in a poison that can cause dangerous sores to erupt on someone's body upon contact.

entry: POKENAME主要夜间活动，结群穿过山区。头毛覆着浓毒，可使人恶心，敌人难靠近。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is primarily active at night, traveling in packs across mountainous areas. The fur on its head is covered in a thick poison that can cause nausea, making it difficult for foes to approach.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇剧毒，咬一口就可能昏迷。可若烹制得当，毒便消散，只留美味菜肴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's mushroom is extremely poisonous and can cause someone to go unconscious with a single bite. However, if cooked properly, the poison will dissipate, leaving behind a flavorful dish.

entry: POKENAME极害羞，用毒爪擦伤靠太近者。背上叶子，曾用于制作漂亮淡蓝染料。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is an incredibly shy Pokémon, grazing anyone that gets too close with its poisonous claws. The leaves on POKENAME's back have been used to create a gorgeous light blue dye.

entry: POKENAME抖身落下的紫粉，剧毒，可使人畏光。用作防御，阻止靠得太近的对象。
author: .izik
source: The purple powder that comes from POKENAME's body when it shakes is very poisonous and can cause light sensitivity. This powder serves as a defense mechanism, deterring those who get too close.

entry: POKENAME覆体毛发极像石棉，饲养有重大健康风险。不过南瓜洗净后，据说味道极甜。
author: mistymagius
source: The hair that covers POKENAME's body is very similar to asbestos, making owning a POKENAME a major health risk. However, the pumpkin, when properly clean, is said to have an incredibly sweet taste to it.

entry: POKENAME绿毒粉可作绘画颜料。少量接触只微痒，大量却会致盲，因此有用也危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's green poisonous powder is used in pigments for painting. In small quantities, a touch causes mild itching, but in large quantities, it can blind the person, making it both a useful and dangerous substance.

entry: POKENAME住在林间小空地，与同类合作找食。风暴猛烈，就紧聚护住彼此，挡雨保护尾焰。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lives in small forest clearings, where it cooperates with others of its kind to gather food. When storms rage, they cluster together to shield each other and protect their tail flames from the rain.

entry: 它用尾部的火焰，与远方的同类交流，在夜空中写出发光的信息。尖刺上的轻微毒液，还能用作农药，因此POKENAME深受农民重视。
author: fiordaliso
source: It uses the flame on its tail to communicate with others of its kind over long distances, forming glowing messages in the night sky. The mild venom from its spines can be used as a pesticide, making POKENAME highly valued by farmers.

entry: POKENAME挖过垃圾场，吃腐臭废物，强化毒腺。毒留作紧急应对，而非日常捕猎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME digs through landfill sites to consume putrid waste, strengthening its poison glands. It reserves its toxins for emergencies rather than routine hunting.

entry: POKENAME鱼群住在毒珊瑚间，捕食者鲜能靠近，因此能在群落内安全玩耍。
author: afilthycasual
source: Schools of POKENAME make their homes among toxic coral. There, they can safely play amongst the colony, as potential predators can rarely get close.

entry: POKENAME总在打理卫生外貌，定期清洁银毛。谁威胁额头硬币，就竖硬胡须，浸上毒。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are constantly fussing over their hygiene and appearance, routinely cleaning their silvery fur. If anyone threatens the coin on their foreheads, they will stiffen their whiskers and lace them with poison.

entry: POKENAME用毒制住公园里的人，再偷口袋零钱。灵巧隐秘，是熟练小偷，始终小心不被发现。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its poison to stun people in parks before stealing loose change from their pockets. Its agility and stealth make it a skilled thief, always careful to avoid detection.

entry: POKENAME总疑神疑鬼，稍觉危险就惊恐逃走。皮肤覆毒膜，作自卫手段。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is always paranoid, fleeing in terror at the slightest sense of danger. Its skin is covered in a poisonous film as a defense mechanism.

entry: POKENAME几乎总头痛，偶有片刻清醒思绪就兴奋。每次兴奋，角尖也会分泌毒凝胶。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME almost always has a headache and gets excited when it experiences a moment of lucid thought. It also excretes a poisonous gel from the tip of its horn whenever it is excited.

entry: POKENAME一踢能碎巨石，却很少用，平常不爱主动出手。被惹怒或逼急，才尽全力攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is strong enough to break apart boulders with its kick, but it rarely uses this power, as it is primarily passive. Should it become angered or cornered, it will attack with all of its might.

entry: POKENAME脾气极差。谁靠食源太近，就想用毒针制住，确保餐点不受闯入。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is extremely poor-tempered. If someone gets too close to its food source, it will attempt to use Poison Sting to subdue them, ensuring it keeps its meal safe from intrusion.

entry: POKENAME初见人常疏远，毛甚至分泌引发皮疹的毒。悉心照顾训练后，却会对认定的同群忠诚又亲昵。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME tends to be standoffish when first meeting new humans, even causing its fur to excrete a toxin that causes a rash. However, with care and training, it will become loyal and loving to those it considers its pack.

entry: POKENAME初见人常疏远，毛甚至分泌引发皮疹的毒。悉心照顾训练后，却会对认定的同群忠诚又亲昵。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME tends to be standoffish when first meeting new humans, even causing its fur to excrete a toxin that causes a rash. However, with care and training, it will become loyal and loving to those it considers its pack.

entry: POKENAME难控旺盛精力，常啃东西或乱窜房间，损坏物品。很在乎群友，会蜷在旁边，替它们保暖。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME struggles to control its abundant energy, often damaging property by gnawing on it or zooming through rooms. It cares deeply for its packmates, curling up nearby to keep them warm.

entry: POKENAME体毒尚未发育完全，却仍是强敌。最强本领在飞行，宽翼助它迅速穿过战场，打出重击。
author: fiordaliso
source: Although POKENAME has not yet fully developed the toxins produced by its body, it is still a formidable opponent. Its greatest strength lies in flight, using its broad wings to move swiftly across the battlefield and deliver powerful strikes.

entry: 它身上覆着一层薄薄的毒黏液，大多来自钝角。战斗时，它用宽大的尾巴将自己弹向敌人，再使出撞击，把钝角顶入对方身体。
author: infinex21
source: Its body is covered in a thin film of poisonous slime, much of which comes from its blunt horn. To fight, it uses its broad tail to launch itself at a foe and drives its blunt horn into them with a Tackle.

entry: POKENAME分泌光滑毒油，让身体始终湿润。油在许多药方中有用，可毒击也曾让许多对手倒下。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME sweat a slick and toxic oil that keeps their bodies hydrated at all times. Though this oil has many uses in numerous remedies, their Poison Jab attacks have been the downfall of many.

entry: POKENAME游泳会分泌毒，污染水域。特意在小湖这样做，轻松取食。
author: dodoowner_
source: While swimming, POKENAME secretes a toxin, contaminating the body of water. It purposely does this in small lakes to acquire an easy meal.

entry: POKENAME虽紧张、常瞬移避险，也有些攻击性。瞬移后等攻击者转身，再狠狠咬下报复。
author: sk372
source: Despite being jittery and likely to teleport to escape threats, POKENAME has a mild aggressive streak. After teleporting, it waits until its attacker's back is turned before delivering a nasty bite as retaliation.

entry: POKENAME多见草地丘陵，须避开许多宝可梦，免成猎物。因此彼此无亲缘的个体，也可能结伴照顾。
author: bobosmith01
source: Typically found in grassy and hilly areas, POKENAME must avoid many other Pokémon in order to not become prey. As a result, many otherwise unrelated POKENAME may stick together to look after one another.

entry: POKENAME天性胆小，受惊通常缩壳。只为家人战斗，射出毒刺，希望赶走敌人。
author: fiordaliso
source: Timid by nature, POKENAME usually hides inside its shell when frightened. It only fights to protect its family, firing poisonous spines in the hope of driving foes away.

entry: POKENAME叶子带苹野果香，吸引虫宝可梦。先喷毒使其麻痹，再吞食，以毒制住，准备进餐。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's leaves smell of Leppa Berries to attract bug Pokémon. It spits poison onto them before devouring the paralyzed prey, using its toxins to immobilize and prepare them for consumption.

entry: 触手覆毒刺，钳住猎物时增加抓握。POKENAME让头中宝石发光，与其他生灵交流。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its tentacles are covered in poisonous spines that increase their grip when they clamp onto prey. POKENAME communicates with its fellow creatures by making the gems embedded in its head glow.

entry: POKENAME温顺住洞，维护与其他宝可梦共住的巢。用大手砸碎周围岩石。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is a docile Pokémon that resides in caves and maintains a nest that is shared with other Pokémon. It breaks down rocks around it by smashing them with its large hands.

entry: POKENAME身上毒气如流动鬃毛。通常保持低毒性，避免伤家人。
author: hophoppip
source: Toxic gases emanate from POKENAME's body like a flowing mane. It usually keeps the potency of the gases low to avoid harming its family.

entry: POKENAME多以大家庭生活，向潜在威胁射高压水，凶猛护幼。壳边毒刺的毒，被实验室提炼，制作解毒剂。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME tends to live in large family groups and fiercely protects the young by firing high-pressure jets of water at potential threats. Its shell is lined with venomous spines whose poison is refined in laboratories to create antidotes.

entry: POKENAME身体接触毒性中等，尼多兰却免疫。为护幼崽，任它们跳进嘴里躲藏，直到危险过去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is moderately toxic to the touch, but Nidoran are immune to the poison. It protects young Nidoran by letting them hop into its mouth and hide inside it until danger has passed.

entry: POKENAME头上长着少量尖刺，防止别人触碰身体。刺上覆有刺激性毒素；缩进壳里时，头部也只有这些尖刺仍露在外面。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a small number of spines coating their head to deter people from touching their body. The spines are coated with an aggravating toxin and are the only part of their head that stays sticking out of their shell when they withdraw.

entry: 融合过程的怪异变化，让POKENAME生理独特。嘴张开，露出的竟是可鞭打旁人的藤；背上球茎反而伸出长舌抓食。
author: sk372
source: A quirk of the fusion process has given POKENAME quite the odd bit of biology. Opening its mouth reveals a vine that it can lash out at others, while the bulb on its back is where its extendable tongue comes out to grab food.

entry: POKENAME六颗头，只有一颗真实，其他都是天生精神能量造的幻象。假头随环境变色，几乎无法分辨。
author: .izik
source: Only one of POKENAME's six heads is real, while the others are illusions created with its innate psychic energy. These false heads shift colors to match the environment, making it nearly impossible to tell them apart.

entry: POKENAME一哭，身体就不断闪过不同颜色。科学家仍不确定，这是防御行为，还是不由自主的反应。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME cries, its body flashes through shifting colors. Scientists remain unsure whether this is defensive behavior or an involuntary reaction.

entry: POKENAME虽相当常见，野外却难找到。它们不爱动，又与环境融得天衣无缝，训练家每天，可能就与数百只POKENAME擦肩而过。
author: ragincajunnacho
source: Despite being quite common, it can be very difficult to find POKENAME in the wild. Between their lack of movement and ability to camouflage perfectly with their environment, Trainers walk past hundreds of POKENAME daily.

entry: POKENAME似乎从不主动变色。冲撞的震荡传入脑，就变成撞到物的颜色，直到撞上另一目标。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME never seems to consciously change color. Instead, the impact from charging into something jolts its brain, causing it to take on the coloration of whatever it collided with until it hits another target.

entry: POKENAME的钻头一旦转起来，就无法再随身体一起伪装。它用舌头抓牢树果，再以角钻出洞，方便吃到里面甜美的果肉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's camouflage ability does not extend to its drill once it begins rotating. It uses its tongue to grab and hold onto berries, drilling holes into them with its horn to more easily reach the sweet pulpy insides.

entry: 幼年POKENAME还在学，父母融入环境时，常忘了自己的伪装，留下尴尬的“飘浮”幼崽景象。
author: sk372
source: Because it's still learning, the baby POKENAME often forgets about its own camouflage when its parent blends into its surroundings, leading to the awkward appearance of "floating" POKENAME young.

entry: POKENAME翼与触角上有数只假眼。受威胁，其余身体变成背景色，只留飘浮眼睛的假象。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME has several false eyes along its wings and antenna. When threatened, the rest of its body will change into the color of its background, leaving the illusion of floating eyes behind.

entry: POKENAME是伏击猎手，先伪装融入周围，再用双臂大刃，迅速解决猎物。
author: king_creepsta
source: POKENAME is an ambush predator, camouflaging into its surroundings before swiftly dispatching its prey with the large blades on each arm.

entry: POKENAME大声弹吉他，长舌在空中挥舞。深受叛逆少年欢迎，有些大人却觉得吵闹无礼。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME plays its guitar loudly while waving its long tongue in the air. Though POKENAME is very popular with rebellious teenagers, some adults believe its music is obnoxious and disrespectful.

entry: POKENAME紧贴树干，伪装完美。向绿毛虫等猎物突然扑出，力道足以碾压。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME clings to tree trunks, perfectly camouflaged. It ambushes prey like Caterpie with sudden, crushing force.

entry: POKENAME群会伪装成脚下地面，常近乎完美。训练家因此往往误当小沙尘暴。
author: santon5512
source: Herds of POKENAME will camouflage themselves to match the ground they run on, often perfectly. Trainers will often mistake these herds for small dust storms.

entry: 野生POKENAME几乎无法察觉。它们常藏在树上伪装，避开烈箭鹰等天敌。
author: dodoowner_
source: A wild POKENAME is almost impossible to spot. Often times, they hide up in the trees then camouflage away from predators like Talonflame.

entry: 许多异色宝可梦目击，都可由POKENAME的独特伪装解释。渔夫讲过，钓起金鲤鱼王，却融成粉绿黏液。
author: banzai.exe
source: Many sightings of strangely-coloured Pokémon can be explained by POKENAME's unique ability for disguise. Fishermen tell tales of catching golden Magikarp that melt into pink-and-green goo.

entry: POKENAME身体不断变色，模仿所有已知进化的色彩。研究者认为，可能有独特难测的进化潜力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body constantly shifts between different hues, mimicking the colors of all of its known evolutions. Researchers believe it may possess a unique, unpredictable evolutionary potential.

entry: POKENAME在水里或水边伪装最有效。皮肤越干，变色融入的效果就越差。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's camouflage is most effective while it is in or near water. The drier its skin becomes, the less effectively it can change the hues of its skin to blend in.

entry: POKENAME喷的火透明，让敌人极难躲避，也极危险。
author: hophoppip
source: The flames POKENAME breathes are transparent, making them extremely dangerous and hard to avoid for enemies.

entry: POKENAME以伪装藏在用户电脑的文件数据间。若受威胁，光标还没点中，就可能甩舌吞掉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its camouflage ability to hide among the files and data of a user's computer. If it feels threatened, it may lash its tongue out and swallow the cursor before it clicks on it.

entry: POKENAME住在数码绘图应用，尤其偏爱学校电脑。独处时，用油漆桶工具给自己换色取乐。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME live in digital art apps, often favoring school computers. When alone, they entertain themselves by changing their colors using the paint bucket tool.

entry: POKENAME曾被发现劫掠遗迹宝箱，抓现行就瞬移。把箱子送给天然鸟，原因却不明。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME have been spotted plundering ruins for treasure boxes, teleporting away upon being caught. They give these chests to Xatu, but the reason why is unclear.

entry: POKENAME隐身时，粉色条带无法一起消失，可那片毛很小，用尾盖住即可。长舌同时带着许多独特宝可梦的质地与形态。
author: soup1900
source: While POKENAME can't turn the pink band on its body invisible when the rest of it does, the fur patch is so small that it can cover over it with its tail. Its long tongue contains the textures and shapes of many unique types of Pokémon at once.

entry: POKENAME发火器官与长舌在体内相连。伸舌吃东西，就不能喷火；反过来也一样。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's flame organ and its extendable tongue are internally connected. If it stretches its tongue out to eat, it cannot flare up its flames, and the same is true in reverse.

entry: POKENAME变换鳞片的颜色，与水面融为一体，耐心等待。猎物一靠近，它们便射出舌头，将其卷入口中，随后猛地合拢双颚。
author: santon5512
source: Waiting patiently, POKENAME shift the colors of their scales to blend in with the water's surface. Once prey wanders near, their tongues shoot out to grab them, pulling them into their mouths before snapping their jaws shut.

entry: POKENAME伏在水面附近，向猎物射出巨舌，力道足以碎石。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lies in wait near the water's surface, then fires its giant tongue at prey. The force of this attack can shatter rocks.

entry: POKENAME皮毛覆滑油，能融入灌丛。受惊就当场隐身。
author: .izik
source: A slick oil coats POKENAME's fur, letting it blend into shrubs and bushes. When frightened, it vanishes in plain sight.

entry: POKENAME是小型虫属性宝可梦，大多身体能变色伪装，唯独环身锯齿纹不行。黏舌伸得极远，很少需要离巢远行。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are small Bug-type Pokémon that can change the colors of most of their bodies to camouflage themselves, save for the zig-zag mark around their bodies. Their sticky tongues can stretch so far that they rarely need to go far from their nests.

entry: POKENAME紫色花纹是全身唯一难以随环境变色的部位。长卷尾挂住树枝，再用黏舌掳走小猎物。
author: infinex21
source: The purple markings of a POKENAME are the only parts of their bodies that struggle to change to match their surroundings. They use their long, curled tails to hang from tree branches and they use their sticky tongues to abduct small prey.

entry: POKENAME圆球能发亮、变出多种颜色。快速彩光闪动，晃得攻击者看不见、失去方向，将其赶走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's orbs can glow and change to a variety of colors. It repels those that try to attack it with rapidly changing, colorful flashes that leave them blind and disoriented.

entry: POKENAME察觉黑暗未来，羽色就与地形相融。本能伪装让它瞬间消失。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feathers shift to match its terrain when it senses a dark future. This instinctive camouflage helps it vanish instantly.

entry: 危险临近，POKENAME羽毛颜色疯狂变换。闪光反映了看见难测未来时的恐慌。
author: .izik
source: When danger is near, POKENAME's feathers shift wildly in color. The flashes reflect panic from visions of its uncertain future.

entry: POKENAME羊毛随环境变色。休息受扰，便突然接连甩舌拍打。
author: .izik
source: The wool on POKENAME's body changes hue with its surroundings. If disturbed while resting, it lashes out with a sudden flurry of tongue slaps.

entry: 有学说认为，隐身POKENAME剪下的毛仍会隐形，可织成“隐身斗篷”。可惜被捉便本能现形，理论始终没能验证。
author: staghorn
source: It is theorized that wool shorn from an invisible POKENAME will remain invisible, allowing one to create an "invisibility cloak" with the resulting cloth. Unfortunately, this theory hasn't been tested because POKENAME reflexively uncloak when caught.

entry: POKENAME身体很会伪装，尾巴却难。再怎么努力，尾色似乎也总配不上其他伪装部位。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are great at camouflaging their bodies but struggle to do the same with their tails. Despite their best efforts, their tails never seem to match the rest of their camouflaged bodies.

entry: POKENAME自认每场聚会的开心果，想以变色表演和自学舞蹈惊艳旁人。多数人却反感它拼命耍帅的样子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fancies itself the life of any social gathering, attempting to wow others with displays of color changing and its self-taught style of dancing. Most find its desperation to look cool rather off-putting.

entry: POKENAME飘在草甸上空，换色贴近天空。从下方看，漂行时几乎隐形。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats above meadows, shifting color to match the sky. From below, it becomes nearly invisible as it drifts.

entry: POKENAME躲在大垃圾箱或垃圾桶里，伪装自己，等着人们丢弃垃圾。长舌能从远处抓住食物，直接拉进嘴里。
author: santon5512
source: Hiding out in dumpsters and trash cans, POKENAME camouflage themselves and wait for trash to be thrown out. Using their long tongues, these Pokémon can snatch food from afar, pulling it straight into their mouths.

entry: POKENAME变换体色，模仿向日葵，站定在花田里，融入其中。传粉者一靠得太近，它们便迅速伸出黏舌，抓住对方。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME can change the color of their bodies to mimic that of a sunflower, standing still in fields of them to blend in. Once pollinators begin to wander too close, POKENAME use their sticky tongues to swiftly snatch them up.

entry: POKENAME不直接变色，而分泌能融入周围的薄膜。性质只持续约一天，仍偶尔被当新奇材料或研究用品收集。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME doesn't change colour directly, but instead excretes a film that blends into the surroundings. This property only lasts for about a day but is sometimes collected for novelty and research.

entry: POKENAME不直接变色，而分泌能融入周围的薄膜。性质只持续约一天，仍偶尔被当新奇材料或研究用品收集。人们有时也用来写留言。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME doesn't change colour directly, but instead excretes a film that blends into the surroundings. This property only lasts for about a day but is sometimes collected for novelty and research. People sometimes write messages with it.

entry: POKENAME吸足月能，身体就能隐形。以长而能抓握的舌头，从远处拿食物与物件。
author: fiordaliso
source: After absorbing enough lunar energy, POKENAME's body gains the ability to turn invisible. It can grab food and objects from a distance using its long, prehensile tongue.

entry: POKENAME确有精神力量，却不如呆呆王博学。反而常向朋友与访客讲情绪、心理健康，尤其强调耐心。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although it does indeed still possess psychic powers, POKENAME is not as knowledgeable as Slowking. Instead, POKENAME often preaches emotional and mental well-being to its friends and visitors, especially the concept of patience.

entry: POKENAME精通伪装与幻象。能隐身，也能改形换色，扮成其他宝可梦、人类或物件。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME is a master of disguise and illusion. It can make itself invisible or manipulate its shape and colours in order to appear as a different Pokémon, human, or object.

entry: 据说三者只有一个是真身，另两个是投影。它很少现身，因此难证实，也难驳斥。
author: infinex21
source: Supposedly, only one of these three is the real body, while the other two are projections. As this Pokémon rarely shows itself, this has been difficult to prove or refute.

entry: POKENAME两半身体各有大脑，都能改变毛色，融入环境。可双方难以看见彼此，常无意间变成互不相衬的花纹。
author: foolish_weasel
source: The two halves of POKENAME each have their own brains. Both are able to shift the color of their fur to blend into the environment, but since they have trouble seeing each other, they more often than not change into conflicting patterns by accident.

entry: POKENAME连地下也能伪装，鳞片呈周围土壤的质感。在地里掘行也不露身形，只留下细微变色痕迹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's ability to camouflage extends even underground, where its scales take on the texture of the soil around it. It tunnels through the earth unseen, leaving only faint, color-shifting trails.

entry: POKENAME夜里无声滑上树顶，汗液帮助换色，伪装粗树皮，直到黎明。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides silently to tree tops at night. Its sweat lets it shift colors, allowing it to diguise itself as rough bark until dawn.

entry: POKENAME羽毛随环境与天气变换。低空俯冲时，舌头抽出，困住猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feathers change with its environment and the weather. Its tongue lashes out to trap prey when it swoops low.

entry: POKENAME壳极硬，也靠变色融入树木自卫。吃树液时，几乎无法发现。
author: mcnchsschl
source: In addition to its incredibly hard shell, POKENAME also defends itself by changing colors to blend into the trees. It is almost impossible to spot while it feeds on sap.

entry: POKENAME遇险不变色，反倒瘫软下来，装成毛绒玩具。演得太像，孩子常把它们当真玩偶，抱回家去。
author: teatedtiten
source: Instead of changing color, POKENAME will go limp when it senses danger, acting like a plushie.  They play the role so well that often children mistake them as actual stuffed toys and take them home.

entry: POKENAME体外黏液模仿周围表面颜色。若受惊，颜色会短暂恢复原样。
author: .izik
source: The slime covering POKENAME's body mimics the colors of its surrounding surfaces. Should it become frightened, the colors revert briefly.

entry: 它羽色与周围天空、云朵一致，风暴时也能做到。长舌缠住目标，趁挣脱前，以长喙刺入。
author: infinex21
source: It changes the colors of its feathers to match the skies and clouds around it, even during storms. It ensnares its target with its long tongue and drives its long beak into the target before it can break free.

entry: 雪地里，POKENAME皮肤变苍白。蜷在雪丘，静静观察动静。
author: .izik
source: In snowy regions, POKENAME's skin turns pale white. It nestles in snow dunes, watching silently for movement.

entry: 它以吸盘嘴附住大宝可梦、墙壁或海底。裹身外膜变色，融入各式环境。
author: t3isukone
source: With its sucker-like mouth, it attaches to larger Pokémon, walls, or the ocean floor. Its shroud-like mantle changes color to blend in with its many environments.

entry: POKENAME能呈现不同颜色，甚至不同质感，伪装成高效难觅的猎手。因此半埋石头，也可能是它。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's camouflaging abilities allow it to be an effective and elusive predator; it can make itself appear to have different colors and even textures, so what seems to be a partially buried rock may actually be POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME在林地伪装，猎物一到攻击距离，便用覆毒长舌制住。毒强到能突破壶壶防御。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME camouflages itself against the forest floor, immobilizing prey with its long, venom-coated tongue once it's within striking distance. POKENAME's venom is potent enough to breach Shuckle's defenses.

entry: POKENAME喜暖，最显著特征是鳞片变色与分叉舌。舌的每一支都能弯伸，最长十英尺，力道与灵巧皆出人意料。
author: bobosmith01
source: As warmth-loving Pokémon, POKENAME's most defining features include its ability to change the color of its scales and its split tongue. Each part of the tongue can flex and stretch up to ten feet and pack surprising power and dexterity.

entry: POKENAME在网络空间游荡，有些烦人。几乎完美融入数字环境，躲起来，用长舌趁无人时捕食文件。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a bit of a nuisance when loose in cyberspace. Its camouflage ability lets it blend in almost perfectly to its digital surroundings, hiding away and using its long tongue to catch and eat files when nobody is looking.

entry: POKENAME身色随季节变化。有些地区据此准备，应对天气改变与作物播种。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME shifts the hues of its body in accordance with the seasons. In some regions, its color changes are used to help prepare for changing weather and crop planting.

entry: 与变隐龙不同，POKENAME无法改鳞色伪装。改用尾液给身体上色，匹配周围。
author: hophoppip
source: Unlike Kecleon, POKENAME cannot alter the color of its scales to blend in. Instead, it paints its body with fluid from its tail to match its surroundings.

entry: 腹部孔洞中，会伸出四条蛇样的长舌。被好奇的POKENAME舔上，谁都难免觉得难受、不自在。
author: staghorn
source: Its four serpentine tongues emerge through holes in its abdomen. Being licked by an inquisitive POKENAME is a universally distressing and unpleasant experience.

entry: 有人说，首只POKENAME诞生于喷出虹色熔岩的火山。它造的火与烟，都五彩独特。
author: hophoppip
source: Some say that the first POKENAME was born when a volcano erupted with rainbow lava. All the flames and smoke POKENAME creates are uniquely colorful.

entry: POKENAME改花纹与颜色，完美融入周围。捕猎时再变纹，作催眠展示，然后袭击猎物。
author: adsfw11
source: POKENAME changes its patterns and colors to seamlessly blend into its surroundings. When hunting, they change their patterns in a hypnotizing display, then strike their prey.

entry: POKENAME黏舌是全身唯一非金属部位。静电会增强黏性。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME's sticky tongue is the only non-metal part of its body. Its adhesiveness is enhanced by a static charge.

entry: POKENAME掌心发石的肌肉，实际连着舌头。因此准备开火，就先吸回舌，也无法一边射石、一边伸舌。
author: bobosmith01
source: The muscles that allow POKENAME to fire stones from its palms are actually connected to its tongue, so if POKENAME is about to fire, it sucks in its tongue. This also means POKENAME cannot fire stones and stretch out its tongue at the same time.

entry: POKENAME用黏舌缠身，散甜香。虫宝可梦被引来黏住，它再收舌，享用大餐。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME wraps its sticky tongue around its body and emits a sweet scent. Bug Pokémon approach and get stuck. It then retracts its tongue and enjoys the feast.

entry: POKENAME吃的视频文件决定体色。每只观影记录独特，因此从无两只显示完全相同配色。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body shifts colors based on the video files it consumes. No two POKENAME ever display the same palette, as each individual has its own unique viewing history.

entry: POKENAME藏树间，皮肤与周围树皮完美一致。唯一改不了的，是面具。
author: .izik
source: While hiding in trees, POKENAME changes its skin to perfectly match the bark around it. The only thing it cannot change is its mask.

entry: 这些善适应的丛林宝可梦，沿树侧迅速爬行觅食。长黏舌能快抓食物，避开众多捕食者。
author: infinex21
source: These adaptive jungle Pokémon quickly crawl along the sides of trees in search of food. They use their long, sticky tongues to quickly grab food and avoid their many predators.

entry: POKENAME能在墙上行走，也会改变身体颜色，假扮细小的树枝。借着这层伪装，它能落在猎物身上，让对方毫无防备。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME changes the color of its body to mimic a small tree branch since it is also able to walk on walls. It uses this camouflage to be able to drop onto prey without them ever suspecting it.

entry: 野生POKENAME疾穿地形，快速换色，保持相对隐蔽，从多角度袭敌。长舌强到能抬起小拳石，抛进空中。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME dart between their terrain, quickly changing colors to remain relatively blended in as they strike their foes from multiple angles. Their long tongues are strong enough to lift a Geodude off the ground and fling it into the air.

entry: 它体大，统领栖居的丛林，能全身变色藏起。以巨舌伏击，缠住毫无戒心的猎物，再用叶刃解决。
author: infinex21
source: This large Pokémon dominates the very jungle it resides in, capable of changing its own colors to hide its entire body. It ambushes unsuspecting prey with its massive tongue, ensaring its target and finishing it off with Leaf Blade attacks.

entry: 身体能随环境变色，唯独腹部紫条不行。它们射舌快得看不清，轻松叼走大猎物。
author: infinex21
source: Their bodies can change colors to match their surroundings, save for the purple stripe along their bellies. They can launch their tongues at blinding speeds and easily snatch large prey with them.

entry: 它们变色伪装，潜农场偷食。若以为被发现，立刻恢复原色，吐小火球，再匆忙逃走。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon change their colors to camouflage themselves and sneak into farms to steal food. If they think they've been caught, they immediately revert their colors and spit small fireballs before scurrying away.

entry: POKENAME是隐秘斗士，融入环境，不让敌人察觉。一进范围，便扑向猎物，接连快击，直到打昏。
author: porterofgames
source: A stealthy fighter, POKENAME camouflages with it's environment to avoid detection from its foes. Once it's within striking distance, it leaps towards its prey and dishes out a flurry of swift blows until they're out cold.

entry: POKENAME为占据战斗优势，会改变羽毛颜色，融入周围环境。准备出手时，它用肌肉发达的双腿，扑近对手，再发起攻击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: To gain an advantage in combat, POKENAME will blend into its surroundings by shifting the colors of its feathers. When it is ready to strike, POKENAME will use its muscular legs to lunge at the opponent before striking.

entry: POKENAME战时伪装，掩盖动作与攻击。可太频繁会过热，行动迟缓，直到排走余热。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can camouflage themselves during battle, obscuring their movements and their attacks. They will overheat if they do so too often, however, and become sluggish until they can release the excess heat.

entry: 尾能抓握、展开，伸至约腹部长度两倍。四脚扎稳，还能用尾举起自身两倍重的巨石。
author: infinex21
source: Its tail is prehensile and can unravel, extending for about twice its abdomen's length. By planting its four feet, it could use its tail to lift a boulder twice its own weight.

entry: POKENAME大多时候都在玩泥巴，借伪装藏好自己，避开潜在危险。不过，黏在身上的泥巴，稍稍妨碍了这种能力，有时还会暴露位置。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends much of its time playing in the mud, using camouflage to hide itself away from potential dangers. This ability is slightly hampered by the mud still sticking to its body and sometimes giving away its position.

entry: POKENAME在沼边静等，完美隐于叶丛。猎物一落单，就先喷泥水，再以强舌出击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME waits silently near marshlands, concealing itself perfectly in the foliage. When prey is alone, it spits blasts of muddy water before striking with its strong tongue.

entry: POKENAME极胆怯，变色融入周围。身色也会依信任者的情绪改变。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are incredibly timid, changing colors to blend into their surroundings. The color of their bodies will change based on the emotions of those they trust.

entry: 附近情绪影响POKENAME伪装。平静、正面感受使它能控制颜色；负面、愤怒则让它本能融入环境，自保避险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's camouflage is affected by the emotional state of those near it. Calm, positive emotions let it control its colors, but negative, angry emotions cause it to instinctively blend into its surroundings as a safety measure.

entry: POKENAME伪装无与伦比，几秒便能完美融入。开始变色时，甚至能把能力延伸到握住的任何物件。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's camouflage ability is unparalleled, able to seamlessly blend into its surroundings in seconds. It can even extend this ability to anything it is holding onto when its colors start changing.

entry: POKENAME伪装太好，连训练家有时也忘了放在哪里。
author: westerlytrack45
source: POKENAME's camouflage capabilities are so good, even their Trainers sometimes forget where they left their POKENAME.

entry: 有时，路边会见POKENAME摆小店，卖饰物与鲜苹果。谁拿东西不付树果，它就愤怒攻击小偷。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Sometimes throughout routes, POKENAME can be found having set up a small shop where they sell trinkets and fresh apples. If someone were to take an item without paying a berry, POKENAME will become angered and attack the thief.

entry: POKENAME四脑让身体各处都完美贴近环境，再从目标盲区，以蕴藏动能的一拳攻击。
author: skyward_25
source: POKENAME has four brains that enable it to perfectly match every part of its body to its surroundings. It attacks from its target's blind spot with a kinetic punch.

entry: POKENAME藏在珠宝古董店，假扮不起眼的蓝球。谁靠太近，便现身，用舌顺走小物与树果。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME hide in jewelry and antique stores, masquerading as nondescript blue orbs. When someone gets too close, POKENAME manifests, using their tongues to swipe small items and berries from the person.

entry: POKENAME凭变色能力，几乎完美地融入周围环境，耐心等待，有时一等就是数小时。猎物若无意间走进攻击范围，它便会飞快扑出。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME uses its ability to change color to near-flawlessly blend into its surroundings. It will wait patiently, sometimes for hours at a time, for prey to accidentally wander within striking distance, at which point it will lunge at high speed.

entry: POKENAME跳跃惊人，舌力强大。几乎什么都能吞，甚至把某些物件变成蛋。虽开朗，却凶猛保护朋友。
author: dimentio240512
source: POKENAME is known for its incredible jumping ability and powerful tongue. POKENAME can swallow almost anything and turn certain objects into eggs. Despite its cheerful nature, it will fiercely protect its friends.

entry: POKENAME自古就生活在森林深处，能随意改变脸部的颜色和花纹。它们假扮更大的宝可梦，吓退捕食者。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Living deep in the forest since ancient times, POKENAME have the ability to change the color and patterns along their face at will. They take on the appearance of bigger Pokémon to scare away predators.

entry: POKENAME擅躲飞行属性捕食者。变色避察，以庞大身躯稳稳扎地。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are experts at hiding from their Flying-type predators. POKENAME use their ability to change colors to avoid detection and their bulk to stay perfectly planted to the ground.

entry: POKENAME太会融入周围，曾被误以为灭绝。移动缓慢，避免引来多余注意。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are so good at blending in with their surroundings that they were once thought to be extinct. POKENAME are known to slowly move so as not to draw unwanted attention to themselves.

entry: POKENAME感到飓风将至，身色就不受控地乱变。有人相信，古怪花纹是能被解读的警告。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body shifts colors uncontrollably when it senses an incoming hurricane. Some believe its erratic patterns form warnings for those who can decipher them.

entry: POKENAME睡在墓碑前，身体会变成墓主最爱的颜色。如何察觉，研究者仍不清楚。
author: .izik
source: While sleeping before gravestones, POKENAME's body shifts to the favorite color of the person buried there. How it detects this is still unknown to researchers.

entry: POKENAME伪装强到不但能隐形，还能变得无法触碰。民间故事说，觉得被看着，就表示它正从隐蔽处观察你。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's camouflage ability is so great that it can not only turn invisible, but intangible as well. Folk tales say that the feeling of being watched means that POKENAME is observing you from an unseen vantage point.

entry: POKENAME藏灌丛伪装，用长舌抓树果与水果吃。吃完以舌挖洞，种下食过果实的种子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides among shrubbery, camouflaging itself while using its long tongue to grab berries and fruits to eat. It digs holes with its tongue after eating and plants the seeds from the fruit it consumed.

entry: 体小的变隐龙融合体，受背上灌丛树果吸引，小群聚在POKENAME背上。它要伪装，先提醒乘客，好一起换色。
author: sk372
source: Small Kecleon fusions like to gather in small groups on POKENAME's back, attracted to the berries growing from its bushes. When POKENAME camouflages itself, it warns its passengers so they can match its color changing.

entry: POKENAME背上圆顶有微型生态，靠树果、植物与水的饮食维持。内部生物正被研究，探索医药用途。休息时，与地面变色相融。
author: chibitales
source: The dome on POKENAME's back contains a miniature ecosystem maintained by its diet of berries, plants, and water. The organisms found inside are being researched for use in the medical field. When resting, it camouflages its body against the ground.

entry: POKENAME壳上景观，奇似合众的蓝莓学园。带去学园，就会调整壳面，突出特别喜欢的地点。
author: notadoctor75
source: The landscape depicted on POKENAME's shell has an odd similarity to the Unovan Blueberry Academy. POKENAME brought to the academy will adjust their shells to highlight spots that they are particularly fond of.

entry: POKENAME住在崎岖山地，爱攀崖练习、取乐。捕食者一进区域，就变成周围石色自卫。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Living within craggy mountains, POKENAME love to climb the sides of cliffs to train and for entertainment. When a predator enters the area, POKENAME shifts its body color to match the stone surrounding it for protection.

entry: POKENAME能够隐身，但听到太响的声音，就会分心，再次现形。角里的毒素，能用于合成心血管治疗药物。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME has the ability to turn invisible, but if it hears a noise that is too loud, it loses concentration and becomes visible again. The toxin contained in its horns can be synthesized to create medicines used in cardiovascular therapies.

entry: POKENAME尾火燃烧时，不断流转虹彩。伪装融入周围，也能让火色配合自身，只是维持颇费力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tail flame constantly shifts through a rainbow of colors as it burns. It can shift the fire's color to match its own as it camouflages itself with its surroundings, though it takes considerable effort to maintain.

entry: POKENAME用火系能力，部分身体就迅速换色。若全身同时变红，火便热到能熔巨石。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME uses its fire-based abilities, portions of its body rapidly shift in color. Should its entire body turn red at once, its flames grow hot enough to melt boulders.

entry: POKENAME游泳会换羽色避捕食者。背变深，融入海底暗色；腹变亮，贴近上方光线。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME alters the color of its feathers while swimming to hide from predators. Its back becomes darker to camouflage it against the ocean depths, while its underside brightens to blend with the light above.

entry: POKENAME身色自然变成游泳时最后碰过的珊瑚色。受惊就随机换色，有时甚至从未碰过。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body naturally shifts hue based on the last piece of coral it touched while swimming. If startled, it changes to a completely random color, sometimes one it has never even touched before.

entry: 每只POKENAME都有一块皮肤，无法随环境伪装，始终暴露。训练家最好别指出，它会视为伤自尊，遭提醒就用利爪反击。
author: notadoctor75
source: All POKENAME have a patch of skin that they cannot adapt to their surroundings, leaving it exposed. Trainers are advised not to point this out to POKENAME, as they see it as an insult to their pride and will lash out with sharp talons when reminded.

entry: POKENAME身体坚硬，像岩石般棱角不平，因此待在崎岖处。能变色伪装，唯独紫色部分不行，所以躲时会埋住部分身体。
author: infinex21
source: Because its hard body is as jagged as stone, POKENAME keeps itself to craggy areas. It can alter its body's colors to camouflage itself. It cannot change the colors of its purple segment, so it will partly bury itself when it hides.

entry: POKENAME吃矿物，就能取得所需的全部养分，甚至也能吃土。它们能变换体色藏身，具体色调却似乎受饮食影响。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME get all of their needed nutrients from eating minerals and can even eat soil as well. The colors of their bodies can change to conceal themselves, though the shades of their hues seem to be influenced by their diets.

entry: POKENAME嗡响着飞过，店主就知道该锁贵重物。它用小无人机偷亮东西，添进巢里。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When POKENAME hum through the air, shop owners know to lock up their valuables. Using their small drones, POKENAME steal anything shiny to add to their nest.

entry: POKENAME伸出刀刃斩击对手。头部颜色，会随环境或心情改变。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's blade extends to slice its opponent. Its head's color adjusts to its surroundings or mood.

entry: POKENAME皮肤覆着反应性毒，变色贴合附近环境。连气味也会调整，保持隐藏。
author: .izik
source: A reactive poison coats POKENAME's skin, altering color to match the nearby environment. Even its scent adjusts to remain hidden.

entry: POKENAME出击前，臂刃会变深红，锋利到能刺穿硬石。
author: .izik
source: The blades on POKENAME's arms turn crimson before it attacks. Its blades are sharp enough to pierce solid stone.

entry: POKENAME的皮毛能变色、带电，都可用于战斗。可也因独特皮毛常遭捕猎，如今已所剩无几。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: POKENAME fur has color-shifting and electric properties that it uses in battles. Not many are left since it's frequently hunted for its unique fur.

entry: POKENAME是四处游猎的捕食者，变色贴近地形。以伸展强舌，或长而常卷起的尾，突然攻击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME s are roaming predators that can change their colors to match their terrain rather well. They strike suddenly with their stretchy and strong tongues or by lashing out with their long, often curled-up, tails.

entry: POKENAME用舌作套索，拉敌近身。可必须小心，底部附近的黄核心一受损，另一项伪装本领就失去。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can use its tongue as a lasso to pull foes in close to its body. However, POKENAME must be careful: if the yellow core near its bottom is damaged, POKENAME loses its other ability: to camouflage into its surrounding.

entry: POKENAME身体随自身情绪变色，缎带触须则随接触者的情绪变色，因此能与训练家极为合拍。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's bodies change color based on their emotions. Their ribbon-like feelers change color based on the emotions of those they touch, allowing these Pokémon to be incredibly in tune with their Trainers.

entry: POKENAME只见于臭氧层远上方，翱翔时偶被误当彗星。神话称为“铸星者”，肩负创造新星座的责任。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are only seen far above the ozone layer and are sometimes mistaken for comets as they soar. In mythology, they are referred to as “Star Forgers” who bear the responsibility of creating new constellations.

entry: POKENAME铃一响，便能隐入周围，或再度现身。人们普遍相信，铃声是刻意警告猎物，给逃跑机会。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: With a ring of its bell, POKENAME is able to vanish into and out of its surroundings. It's widely believed that the ringing is meant to intentionally warn prey, allowing them a chance to escape.

entry: POKENAME用炮迅速把所在地涂得鲜艳。若被谁责备，就跑走，伪装藏身。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Using their cannon, POKENAME rapidly paint their location in vibrant colors. If they are called out by anyone, POKENAME run away and camouflage themselves.

entry: POKENAME深入训练家避开的荒野，寻找宝珠。品质较低的，会拿去换美味树果与苹果。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME venture into the wilds that Trainers avoid in search of orbs. POKENAME will trade the lesser-quality orbs for tasty berries and apples.

entry: POKENAME深入训练家避开的荒野，寻找宝珠。它囤着这些珠，谁想偷，就与谁打。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME venture into the wilds that Trainers avoid in search of orbs. POKENAME hoard these orbs and will fight those who attempt to steal them.

entry: POKENAME适应不同电子特征，改变自身频率，住进电器也不干扰。有些训练家甚至不知，图鉴里正寄宿着一只。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME is able to adapt itself to different electronic signatures, altering its own frequencies to allow it to exist within electrical equipment without disrupting it. Some Trainers don't even realize their Pokédex is playing host to a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME走到哪里，都留下彩色棉簇。人们收集，织成鲜亮布料。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME leaves its colorful tufts of cotton everywhere it goes. People collect it to weave it into vibrant fabrics.

entry: POKENAME用长牙标领地，仍会融入环境，隐着身行走。若无视标记，薄而锋利的舌便会以子弹般速度射来。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their tusks to mark their territories, though they will still blend in with their surroundings to go about unseen. Those who ignore their markings will be met with their sharp, thin tongues launching at them with the speed of a bullet.

entry: POKENAME在珊瑚礁伪装，静止等待。角金鱼等猎物经过，就用长黏舌抓住。
author: .izik
source: Blending into coral reefs, POKENAME waits motionless. It snatches passing prey like Goldeen with its long, sticky tongue.

entry: 偷走钥匙后，POKENAME以特殊生理本领，使其变色，难被讨回。拉它舌头，便会迫使钥匙复原色。
author: sk372
source: After stealing keys, POKENAME alters their colors with its unique physiology to make them harder to retrieve. Yanking its tongue forces the keys to return to their original color.

entry: 火囊越热，尾巴卷得越紧，每次振翅撒出的余烬也越多。它伸舌缠住目标，再以滚滚火流，将其烧成灰。
author: infinex21
source: The hotter its flame sac becomes, the more its tail will curl and the more embers will scatter with every flap of its wings. It will shoot out its tongue to ensnare its target and incinerate them with a torrent of fire.

entry: POKENAME有幻象与隐身能力，野外没有高度专用设备，几乎看不见。战外甚至躲训练家，让研究极困难。
author: bobosmith01
source: Due to its illusory powers and ability to turn invisible, it is almost impossible to spot POKENAME in the wild without highly specialized equipment. It may even hide from its Trainer outside of battle, making studying it very difficult.

entry: 为分散敌人注意，它将每条尾变成不同颜色。喷火也能变色，火力与热度可一起改变，也可保持原样。
author: infinex21
source: To distract foes, it changes each of its tails to different colors. Even the flames it spews can change color, with or without changing intensity and heat.

entry: POKENAME身色随环境变化。一被发现，立刻钻土，消失于视线。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME shifts its body color to match its surroundings. If spotted, it instantly burrows into the dirt and vanishes from sight.

entry: POKENAME裹一层贴近周围色彩的淡气息，用来伪装。可极耗能，只能维持几分钟，就会筋疲力竭。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME cloaks itself in a faint aura that matches its surroundings, giving it camouflage capabilities. The process is energy-intensive however, and can only be done for a few minutes before POKENAME becomes exhausted.

entry: POKENAME改变身上色素，融入周围环境休息。休息时间超过半天，因此它们常被无意踩中，也常绊倒来者。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME utilize their ability to change the pigments of their own bodies to match their surroundings and remain hidden as they rest. Because they rest for over half of a day, they are often accidentally stepped on and tripped over.

entry: POKENAME睡觉，皮肤也随周围换色。能轻松在珊瑚礁休息，模仿其颜色。
author: .izik
source: While sleeping, POKENAME's skin shifts to match its surrounding environment. It can rest in coral reefs and mimic their colors with ease.

entry: POKENAME极害羞，白天模仿高草颜色，藏在里面。若被绊到，就放出强电击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is extremely shy and hides within tall grass during the day by mimicking its color. If tripped over, it releases powerful shocks.

entry: POKENAME风暴时刻意找最高树顶。尾如天然避雷针，储存雷击电力。充电时，脸、耳与爪边的黄毛会明亮发光。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME intentionally seek out the highest treetops during storms. Their tails act as natural lightning rods, storing the electrical energy from a strike. The yellow fur bordering the face, ears, and claws glows brightly while charged.

entry: POKENAME常陪伴易怒训练家，歌声能安抚情绪。可方式是自己接下情绪，若训练家不留意，便会暴怒失控。
author: kungfucutbug
source: POKENAME is often used as a support Pokémon for Trainers with anger issues, as its song is capable of soothing one's emotions. However, it does this by taking on those emotions itself, making it uncontrollably wrathful if its Trainer is careless.

entry: POKENAME身体金属光泽，会随附近矿物变色。洞穴探险者靠变化的色调，寻找稀有宝石。
author: .izik
source: The metallic sheen of POKENAME's body changes color depending on the minerals in its surroundings. Cave explorers use its shifting hues to locate rare gemstones.

entry: POKENAME埋在沙里，完美模仿沙色。飞行猎物经过头顶，就甩舌拖下。
author: .izik
source: While buried in sand, POKENAME mimics its color perfectly. When flying prey passes overhead, it lashes out with its tongue to drag them down.

entry: 齿轮转动，POKENAME便射出长舌捕虫。两舌若伸出相撞，碰处会冒火花，自己也暂时迷乱。
author: sk372
source: As the gears turn, POKENAME fires out extendable tongues to catch insects to consume.  Should the two tongues collide when extended, sparks will fly from the impact point and POKENAME will be disoriented for a time.

entry: POKENAME融入周围消失，同时投可爱幻象分散敌人。爱模仿训练家与宝可梦，恶作剧让大家迷惑时，就隐身偷笑。
author: jitteryjared
source: POKENAME can vanish into its surroundings while projecting adorable illusions to distract foes. It loves mimicking Trainers and Pokémon alike, giggling invisibly when its pranks leave everyone confused.

entry: POKENAME用橡胶般有弹性的身体与变色本领，逗乐生病宝可梦。遇险可膨到近三倍大，同时闪出威吓图案。
author: just_a_few_thousand_crows
source: POKENAME uses its rubbery, stretchy body and its color-changing abilities to entertain sick Pokémon. When threatened, it can inflate to nearly triple its normal size while flashing threatening displays.

entry: POKENAME害怕，会向附近物件释放厚厚闪粉，使其模仿周围色彩，几乎隐形。
author: .izik
source: When scared, POKENAME releases a thick shimmering powder onto nearby objects. This causes the object to mimic surrounding colors, rendering it virtually invisible.

entry: POKENAME花瓣能变色，过程与结果都受环境影响。突出雌蕊实际是毒刺，毒能引发影响全部五感的幻觉。
author: infinex21
source: The petals of its flowers can change colors, the process and result of which are influenced by its environment. The protruding pistils of POKENAME's flowers are venomous stingers; its venom induces hallucinations that affect all five senses.

entry: POKENAME改变体色，融入周围，只留红纹与绳带。因此孩子从小被教导，要留意这些标记。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME is able to change its body's colour to blend into its surrounding. Only its red pattern and strings remain, so children are taught to watch out for them.

entry: POKENAME高跃空中，以长黏舌捕捉树里猎物。整只刺尾虫都能吞，不怕身上尖刺。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME leaps high into the air to capture prey hiding in trees with its long, sticky tongue. It can swallow an entire Wurmple without concern about its spikes.

entry: 晨光里，POKENAME飘过树间。每次停下，都尝试精确模仿附近叶色。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts between trees in the early morning light. Whenever it stops to rest, it attempts to mimic the exact shade of the surrounding leaves.

entry: POKENAME伪装时，身体周围的彩色棉絮却不会变色，仍然显眼、容易受袭。若被会飞的宝可梦抓起，它们便用强健的舌头猛烈反击。
author: bobosmith01
source: The colorful cotton around POKENAME's body does not change color when POKENAME uses camouflage, which unfortunately still leaves it vulnerable and easy to spot. If it's snatched up by a flying Pokémon, it lashes out with its powerful tongue.

entry: POKENAME铁壳变色，贴近遗迹锈金属与石头。能一动不动贴墙数日，等毫无戒心的猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's iron shell changes colors to match the rusted metal and stone of abandoned ruins. It clings to walls motionless for days, waiting to ambush unsuspecting prey.

entry: POKENAME长牙锐如钢刃，随心情变色。受惊全身漆黑，融进阴影。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tusks are as sharp as steel and change color based on its mood. If it is startled, its entire body turns jet black, allowing it to blend into the shadows.

entry: 它们原地拍动翅膀，在体内积蓄热量，使羽毛变色。它们会用不同的颜色，融入周围环境，或试着威吓其他生物。
author: infinex21
source: They can build up heat within themselves by flapping their wings without moving, which causes their feathers to change color. They will change colors to blend into their surroundings or to try and intimidate others.

entry: POKENAME尾巴能抓走被火流击倒的猎物。羽毛随温度、压力变色，是许多孩子喜爱的玩具。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can use their tails to capture and carry away prey that they have downed with streams of flames. Their feathers change color with temperature exposure and pressure, making them beloved toys for many children.

entry: POKENAME平常温顺友善，受威胁就蜷成球，保护自己。
author: notsaying.
source: POKENAME is normally docile and friendly, but if it feels threatened, it will coil up into a ball for protection.

entry: POKENAME不能随意变色，身体改为呈现最近吃下的宝石色。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME cannot change their colouration at will. Instead, their body takes on the colour of the gemstone they most recently consumed.

entry: POKENAME藏洞石间，完美相融。唾液有弱毒，让猎物混乱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides among cave stones, blending in seamlessly. Its saliva carries a mild toxin that causes confusion in prey.

entry: POKENAME在暴风雪伪装，几乎让猎物看不见。虽流传猎杀雪中迷路者，主要目标其实是小型虫属性宝可梦。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME is an ambush predator that camouflages itself in blizzards, making itself nearly invisible to the prey. Despite popular beliefs about it hunting down people lost in snowstorms, POKENAME's main target is actually small Bug-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME找到花丛就藏进去，改变叶片与身体的颜色，融入四周。毫无戒备的昆虫一旦从上方飞过，它便猛甩能够伸长的舌头，将其抓住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides among any flower patches it finds, changing the color of its leaves and body to blend in. Any unsuspecting insects that fly overhead get caught by its extendable tongue lashing out and snagging them.

entry: POKENAME钻研各种舞蹈与风格，表演不同的舞步时，羽毛也随之变色。它们常跳得太过入迷，结束后竟忘了变回原来的颜色，再次将自己藏起来。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME study different forms of dances and styles, changing the color of their feathers as they perform different routines. They often get so caught up in their dances that they forget to change their colors back to hide again once they're done.

entry: POKENAME组队，研究需要支持的人和宝可梦。变色代表不同队伍或吉祥物，再调整动作，用适合各自的方式鼓励。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME work in teams to study people and Pokémon in need of support, changing their colors to represent different teams or mascots. They adapt their routines to motivate each subject in their own special way.

entry: POKENAME用花朵项链遮住眼睛，以便更好地感知周围人的情绪与热情。一旦与训练家心意相通，它们便会变换颜色，摇摆腰胯，配合对方的气场。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME cover their eyes with flower necklaces to better sense the emotions and passions of the people around them. Once they're in tune with a Trainer's wavelength, they will change color and sway their hips to match the person's aura.

entry: POKENAME跳舞，双翼闪着流动色彩。情绪同时决定舞风与颜色。
author: .izik
source: As it dances, POKENAME's wings shimmer with shifting colors. Its emotions dictate both the dance style and hues it displays.

entry: 现代许多商圈雇POKENAME，喂垃圾，减少处理费。体色随最后吃下物件的主色改变。
author: .izik
source: Many modern shopping areas keep a POKENAME on staff and feed it trash to minimize disposal costs. It alternates colors based on the primary color of the last thing it consumed.

entry: POKENAME开心把找到的物品卖给旅人。谁敢偷货，就穷追不舍。
author: tadbolmont
source: POKENAME happily sells items it finds to travelers. It will relentlessly pursue anyone who dares to steal its wares.

entry: POKENAME侧躺，能完美模仿身下任何表面。常主动搁浅岸边，等游客靠近，再用咬碎攻击。
author: .izik
source: When lying on its side, POKENAME can perfectly mimic the appearance of any surface beneath it. It frequently beaches itself on shorelines and waits for beachgoers to approach before striking with Crunch.

entry: POKENAME改变身体颜色，融入周围的水色，游动时几乎无法被察觉。它们缓缓潜近猎物，再迅速伸舌抓住，拉进强健的双颚。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME change the color of their bodies to match the water around them, making them almost undetectable while swimming. They slowly sneak up on their prey before quickly grabbing them with their tongues, pulling them into their powerful jaws.

entry: POKENAME在幽暗密林伪装，可由亮黄条纹辨认，只是黑暗中仍难发现。据说脱落叶片能治百病。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME camouflages itself in deep, dark forests and can be identified by its bright yellow stripes, though spotting them in the dark may be difficult. Its shed leaves are said to be used as a cure-all.

entry: POKENAME虽胆小，却好奇地游荡森林，暗中观察别人。能藏在任何木质表面，安全地远望。
author: thezekrom
source: While skittish, POKENAME's curious nature makes it wander through forests to secretly spy on others. The camouflage ability it possesses helps it to stay hidden on any wooden surface while safely watching from afar.

entry: 它能够完美伪装成70,000多种树木。人们推测它是伏击型的捕食者，但至今所有观察它进食的尝试都失败了。
author: staghorn
source: It can perfectly disguise itself as over 70,000 different species of tree. It's theorized to be an ambush predator, but all attempts to observe it while feeding have failed.

entry: POKENAME花朵随变色，散出不同刺鼻气味。借此吸引或赶走各类生物，吃到不同虫子，饮食均衡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's flower emits different types of pungent smells depending on the color it shifts itself into. This lets it attract and repel a variety of creatures so it can snack on a balanced meal of different kinds of bugs.

entry: POKENAME用超声波探知接近者的动作。只短暂发出，因为会扰乱伪装，让自己暴露。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses ultrasonic soundwaves to detect the movements of creatures drawing near. It only does so in short bursts, as using this technique disrupts its camouflage ability, leaving it vulnerable.

entry: POKENAME捕猎，先以轰鸣叫声震聋猎物。等其衰弱，再以长舌猛击。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME unleashes a booming cry to deafen its prey when it hunts. Once they are weakened, it strikes them forcefully with its long tongue.

entry: POKENAME善伪装，被视为极危险。花产毒粉也随环境变色，让人很难避免吸入毒粉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is considered highly dangerous due to the camouflage abilities it possesses. The toxic pollen its flower produces also changes hues to blend in with its surroundings, making it difficult to avoid inhaling the poison.

entry: POKENAME爱陪孩子玩，性情却有些多变。不想玩时就伪装躲开，直到更愿意亲近。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys being played with by children, but is a bit fickle in personality. If it doesn't feel like playing, it uses camouflage to hide from the kids until it feels more amiable.

entry: POKENAME换肤色，完美模仿躺着的沙。猎物一近，就被黏舌攫住。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME perfectly mimics the sand it rests on by shifting its skin color. When prey draws close, it seizes them with its sticky tongue.

entry: POKENAME战法狡猾，伪装消失。先以能抓握的舌从一边轻拍，骗过敌人，再从另一侧打出声势浩大的空袭。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a trickster in combat, using camouflage to disappear on the battlefield. It deceives foes by tapping them from one side with its prehensile tongue before striking from the other side with a bombastic aerial attack.

entry: POKENAME想融入周围，暗中烦扰吵闹的海滩客，却次次失败，不知为何总配不好沙色。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME attempts to blend into its surroundings to try and secretly agitate the many noisy beach-goers it deals with, but fails each time, as it can oddly never seem to properly match the color of sand.

entry: POKENAME借孢子悬在林中洞顶，虽能出其不意，却常流口水滴到猎物，反而暴露。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME use their spores to suspend from the ceilings of forest caves. While this does give POKENAME the element of surprise, they tend to drool onto their prey, alerting them to their presence.

entry: POKENAME出现在热闹道路，带着水果、小宝石等物品，乐意换橙橙果。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME appear along well-traveled routes, always carrying items ranging from fruits to small gems. POKENAME will happily trade these various items for Oran Berries.

entry: POKENAME背上的真菌，能改变色素的颜色。它不用来融入环境，反而故意让自己醒目，警告其他宝可梦：孢子有毒。
author: .jerden
source: The fungus on POKENAME's back is capable of changing the color of its pigments. Rather than using this to blend in, it uses this to stand out, as a warning to other Pokémon that its spores are toxic.

entry: POKENAME改变体色，融入周围环境，但必须先摩擦鳞片。多数个体会先将鳞片碰得铿锵作响，扰乱对手，再迅速跑开，变换颜色。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME change hue to blend in with their surroundings. However, they need to rub their scales for this to work. Most POKENAME make this work by clanging their scales to disorient the opponent before scurrying away and shifting colors.

entry: POKENAME胆小、善伺机，用长舌偷别人的部分餐点，立刻转身逃，靠伪装藏进周围。
author: sk372
source: Cowardly and opportunistic, POKENAME uses its long tongue to steal parts of a meal from others before quickly turning tail and fleeing, using its camouflage ability to blend into its surroundings as it hides away.

entry: POKENAME若不擅伪装某种颜色，表示饮食尚可改善。平常主要吃小型虫属性宝可梦。
author: bobosmith01
source: If there are colors POKENAME cannot camouflage into very well, it means there is room for improvement in that POKENAME's diet. It typically dines on small Bug-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME皮毛贴近附近灌木。受威胁，先甩舌打击，再逃进丛中。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fur changes to match nearby shrubs. If threatened, it whips out its tongue to strike before fleeing into the brush.

entry: POKENAME遇险先伪装隐藏，远攻敌人。刺射出后短暂保留伪装，来势难见，也难躲。
author: sk372
source: When faced with a threat, POKENAME camouflages itself to hide away and pick its foe off from afar. Its quills retain camouflage for a moment after firing, making them tricky to see coming and avoid.

entry: POKENAME长出的木壳能模仿周围颜色。惊慌时，变化可能瞬间完成。
author: .izik
source: The wooden shell POKENAME grows can mimic the color of its surrounding environment. When it is panicking, this change can become instantaneous.

entry: 它能坐在巢里，以长舌捡附近细枝啃食，作为腹中火的燃料。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It can sit in its den and pick up any nearby twigs to munch on with its long tongue. It uses them as fuel in its belly for its fires.

entry: POKENAME用舌头取物，比用爪子容易。它们靠变换颜色和挥动点燃的细枝交流，得小心别烧到自己的舌头。
author: thans101
source: It is easier for POKENAME to grab objects with their tongue instead of their claws. POKENAME communicate with each other by changing their colors as well as waving twigs they set alight. They have to be careful not to burn their tongues.

entry: POKENAME凝望未来，皮毛就迅速流转鲜亮光谱。不过红锯齿纹通常保持原色。
author: dodoowner_
source: When POKENAME gazes into the future, its fur coat rapidly shifts through a vibrant spectrum of colors. The red zigzag patterns tend to stay the same hue, however.

entry: POKENAME常变色，使捕食者觉得有毒。因配色多变，有时连同类也会误当其他物种。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME often change their colors to appear poisonous to predatory Pokémon. They sometimes mistake other POKENAME for different species entirely due to their varied colorations.

entry: POKENAME在丛林伪装跟猎，脚步轻得难觉，只有无法隐藏的舌，能让人发现。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME stalks its prey through the jungle while camouflaging itself within its surroundings. Its footsteps are faint and hard to detect, making its unconcealable tongue the only way to spot this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME释放不同颜色气体，传达情绪。害怕时的气最不透光，方便逃走。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME conveys its emotions by emitting gases of different colors. The gas emitted when it's scared is the most opaque, making it easier for POKENAME to flee.

entry: POKENAME产黏糖浆，颜色随接触物改变。古玫镇友好商店曾促销，购物即赠一杯糖浆，吸引全地区训练家。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME produce a sticky syrup that changes colour depending on what it is placed against. The Poké Mart in Oldale Town once ran a promotion where they gave away a cup of POKENAME syrup with every purchase, bringing Trainers from across the region.

entry: POKENAME不爱被其他宝可梦踩，一感旁人在，就融入周围水色。眼尖捕食者若与水面齐高，仍能看见体侧锯齿纹。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are not fond of being stepped on by other Pokémon, so whenever they sense anyone else nearby, they blend into the surrounding water. Keen-eyed predators can still spot the zig-zag pattern on their side if they are at water level.

entry: POKENAME能变色，几乎隐形。但喷火时会不由自主变鲜亮，帮助身体散热。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME are able to change their colors to become virtually invisible. However, when using their fire breath, they will involuntarily shift towards bright colors in order to help cool their bodies.

entry: POKENAME变色部分受附近情绪影响。爱待在爱意旁，吸取正面感受，身体变亮粉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's color-changing ability is partially affected by the emotions of others near it. It prefers being near loving emotions, its body turning bright pink as it soaks in the positive feelings.

entry: 只看外表，就能知道POKENAME身体状况如何。一旦头痛，它就会失去对伪装能力的控制，不停变换各种颜色和花纹，直到疼痛消退。
author: sk372
source: One can tell how well a POKENAME is feeling just by looking: should it begin to suffer headaches, it loses control of its camouflage ability and begins to shift through all manner of colors and patterns until the pain subsides.

entry: POKENAME全身完美融入周围，又能无声飞行，突然袭击毫无戒心的敌人。但一烦躁就立刻变红，伪装暴露。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can perfectly blend its body into the surroundings and fly silently without being noticed, allowing it to strike unsuspecting foes by surprise. When agitated, however, it immediately turns red, giving away its camouflage.

entry: POKENAME跳行热带雨林，能伪装自身。连腹内涡形器官，也随外鳞一起变色。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME hops along in tropical rainforests. It has the ability to camouflage itself; even the spiral-shaped organs in its belly change color when the outer scales do.

entry: POKENAME跳行热带雨林，能伪装自身。连腹内涡形器官，也随外鳞一起变色。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME hops along in tropical rainforests. It has the ability to camouflage itself; even the spiral-shaped organs in its belly change color when the outer scales do.

entry: POKENAME感到威胁时，会迅速改变腹部漩涡纹的颜色，迷惑人或宝可梦。但这样常让它累坏，当场睡着。
author: seanothan_23
