source: When POKENAME feels threatened, it will rapidly change the color of the swirl on its belly to confuse the other people or Pokémon. However, this usually tires out POKENAME, making them fall asleep right on the spot.

entry: POKENAME依体色发出不同脑波。紫纹却总发阿尔法波，与正在作用于敌人的波相冲，削弱效力。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME emits different types of brain waves from its body depending on the color of its body. However, its purple markings will always emit alpha waves, which conflict with the waves POKENAME is currently using on foes, weakening their potency.

entry: POKENAME彩火来自饮食补充的特定矿物，燃烧色各不同。体内别无用途，因此有人推测，吃它们只是爱美。
author: deadshields
source: POKENAME's chromatic flames stem from a diet supplemented with certain minerals known for burning unique colours. There is no other use for these minerals in POKENAME's body, leading to the theory that they only consume them for vanity purposes.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴挂住树枝，等待猎物，再以舌头抓住食物，拉进大嘴。即使比它更大的猎物也不安全，叶片能轻易将其切碎。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME attach themselves to branches with their tails, waiting for their prey. They will use their tongues to snatch up their food and pull it into their large mouths. Even prey larger than them is not safe, their leaves easily slicing them up.

entry: POKENAME常藏在营火坑，显得火像自己燃起。虽融入周围，找锯齿纹与头顶微弱热波，仍能发现。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME often hides in bonfire pits, appearing as if the fire had started all on its own. Though it blends in with its surroundings, it can be found by looking for its zigzag pattern and the faint heat waves above it.

entry: POKENAME有时忘了用尾钓鱼，改把长舌伸进水。于是常见滑稽景象：它惊慌地想甩掉舌上的鲤鱼王或大舌贝。
author: sk372
source: Sometimes POKENAME will forget that its tail is used for fishing and instead dip its extendable tongue in the water. This often leads to the ridiculous sight of an alarmed POKENAME attempting to sling a Magikarp or Shellder off its tongue.

entry: 变隐龙DNA渗入POKENAME尾上宝可梦，自己换色，带壳者也跟着换。行动慢，宁可全靠伪装避战。
author: bobosmith01
source: Kecleon's DNA has seeped inside the Pokémon upon POKENAME's tail. When POKENAME changes color, the shelled being does, too. POKENAME is slow-moving and prefers to solely rely on camouflage to avoid combat altogether.

entry: POKENAME“耳朵”的磁引力，让同样有磁性的长舌伸出时始终居中。若开始偏向一侧，就是生病征兆。
author: sk372
source: The magnetic pull of POKENAME's "ears" keeps its also-magnetic tongue perfectly centered when extended. If the tongue begins drifting to a side, it's a sign POKENAME is becoming ill.

entry: POKENAME能随意改变两颗头的颜色，甚至各用一种。身体自动染成两色的混合色，唯独条纹，始终鲜红。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are able to change the color of their heads at will, even to two different colors if they so wish. Their bodies automatically change to the mixed color of the two heads, but their stripes will always remain red.

entry: POKENAME各颗头独立控制红、蓝、绿变色，须合作才能藏好。某头若睡着，或生气不肯配色，捕猎就受影响。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME's heads each take charge of shifting between red, blue and green independently for camoflauge, requiring cooperation for concealment. If one head is sleeping or angry and refuses to change color, it impacts the success of hunting for prey.

entry: 它能改皮肤与羽毛颜色。可头很少配合，因此常至少有一颗颜色完全不同。
author: infinex21
source: It can change the colors of its hide and its feathers. Unfortunately, its heads rarely manage to cooperate, so at least one of them will tend to be an entirely different color.

entry: POKENAME借粉红条纹融入珊瑚礁，也会藏进沙地，靠尾巴随时调整方向、抓取物件。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use the pink stripes along their body to help blend in with coral reefs. They camouflage into the sand, using their tails to redirect and grasp things at a moment's notice.

entry: POKENAME本能模仿经过表面的颜色。这本领就在污泥本身，离体也仍保留。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME reflexively shifts its color to match any surface it passes over. This ability is embedded in the sludge itself, even when separated from its body.

entry: POKENAME狡猾，能改变身体颜色，融入环境。它们最爱捉弄旁人，从用长尾绊人，到用舌头偷物，花样百出。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are devious Pokémon that can change the colors of their bodies to blend in. These tricksters love to prank others, from using their long tails to trip them to using their tongues to steal items.

entry: 调查中，人们发现有些构造简单的古怪岩群，竟会移动。最近才知，那其实是POKENAME，借岩石的颜色、纹理，藏住自己的条纹。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Odd rock formations with fairly simple compositions have been reported to shift during investigations. These formations have recently been discovered to be POKENAME, using the colors and textures of rocks to hide their stripes.

entry: POKENAME外层镀金属，保护较脆弱的本体。不过甲片也不最强，掘地时会崩缺开裂。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's metal-plated exterior protects its less durable body from attacks. However, these plates aren't the strongest and will chip and crack as it burrows.

entry: 它隐入背景，吞食人和宝可梦的噩梦。若做了噩梦，却忘记内容，那便是被POKENAME吃掉了。
author: melodydelune
source: Blending in with the background, it eats the bad dreams of people and Pokémon. If you had a bad dream but forgot what it was, POKENAME has eaten it.

entry: POKENAME身体融入环境，只留精神能量球可见。近来某公司被揭发，在广告中用它的催眠术，多卖商品。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: Only a ball of psychic energy remains visible while the rest of POKENAME's body blends into the environment. Recently, one corporation has been exposed for using POKENAME's hypnotism to sell more products in their advertisements.

entry: POKENAME平和地在海底疾爬，偶尔浮出，游荡海滩捣乱。趁无辜游客最没防备，从后面夹下。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME are found scuttling around peacefully on the ocean floor. They sometimes surface and roam beaches to cause trouble for innocent beachgoers, pinching them from behind when least expected.

entry: POKENAME潜行伪装，绕到敌后，打出强力奇袭。不知为何，爱模仿大钳蟹的动作。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME utilizes stealth and camouflage to get behind their opponent, before delivering a powerful blindside. For unknown reasons, they like to mimic the movements of Krabby.

entry: 它们摆弄各种废金属与废工具，出生便开工。第一件作品，是保护软头的金属头骨，再造武器自卫。
author: infinex21
source: They tinker with myriad scrap metal and discarded tool. They start their work at birth and their first craft is to create a metal skull to protect their soft heads and a weapon to defend themselves with.

entry: 野生POKENAME常捕食铁哑铃，以猎物身上的大爪状部分为武器。此阶段开始产生弱磁场，金属便随时间融入身体。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME often prey upon Beldums and uses the large claw-like parts of their bodies as weapons. They have begun to develop a weak magnetic field at this stage in their lives, which causes metal to fuse with their bodies over time.

entry: 它们喷白毒烟，推动空中移动，以弱磁屏障挡击。通常任自己下坠，用金属身撞下方敌人。
author: infinex21
source: They propel themselves in the air with puffs of a white, toxic smog and repel attacks with a weak magnetic barrier. They typically will let themselves fall from the air to strike opponents below them using their metal bodies.

entry: POKENAME底部小爪带来些许行动力，金属坚壳则防御极强。若仍被逼住，就用精神波呼唤附近虫宝可梦帮忙。
author: sk372
source: The tiny claws at POKENAME's underside allow it some mobility, and its shell is metallic and sturdy for great defense. Should it still find itself cornered, it can use mental waves to call nearby bug Pokémon to assist it.

entry: POKENAME金属身体再生力出众，动作流畅得出奇。多肢合拢，就能轻松困住猎物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have metal bodies with remarkable regenerative powers. They can move their bodies with surprising fluidity and can easily entrap prey by closing their multiple limbs around them.

entry: POKENAME以巨大红独眼留意周围。后部旋转产生弱磁场，靠太近时，常不慎黏在一起。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME watch their surroundings carefully with their singular, large red eye. When their back part rotates, they generate a faint magnetic field that often causes them to stick to each other if they get too close.

entry: 它们从尾放强毒，将水果与叶子化成可饮糊。身体虽金属，动作却颇流畅。
author: infinex21
source: They release a potent toxin from their tails to melt fruits and leaves into a drinkable slurry. Despite its body being made of metal, it can move rather fluidly.

entry: POKENAME心智强，一眼便能评估其他生灵的各项特征。所有变形都保留薄而坚韧的金属层，强化防御，保护自己。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's mind is strong enough to assess another being's attributes with just a glance. To protect itself, all of its transformations retain a thin but sturdy layer of metal around the body, bolstering its defenses.

entry: POKENAME帮助有无障碍需求者在电脑存文件，也不弄丢位置。对老人尤其有用，因为它的界面简化了保存流程。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME help people with accessibility needs store files on their PC without losing track of where everything is. This is especially helpful for the elderly, as POKENAME's interface simplifies the process of saving files.

entry: 身体放出弱磁场，排斥多数敌人。也常不慎互黏，却反而更能彼此保护。
author: infinex21
source: Their bodies emit a weak magnetic field that repels most foes. They often stick together by accident, though this helps them to protect themselves better.

entry: POKENAME中空金属身仍能高速飞，追上猎物。锐金属毒刺能注强毒，击倒两倍自身体形的宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have hollow metal bodies that still allow them to fly fast enough to chase down prey. Their sharp metal stingers deliver a potent toxin capable of bringing down Pokémon twice their size.

entry: POKENAME好奇却隐居，用念力派出大金属臂，调查陌生者与异常，自己安全藏身。认定有眼前危险，手臂便迅速击倒、按住。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Curious yet reclusive, POKENAME telekinetically send their large metal arm to investigate strangers and anomalies while they safely remain out of sight. Anything perceived as an immediate danger is swiftly taken down and pinned by the arm.

entry: POKENAME从后部开口喷火，飞过空中，借此迅速逃险。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME can produce a burst of flames from the opening behind them to fly through the air. They use this to rapidly escape from danger.

entry: POKENAME毒刺带有类似瘟疫的致命疾病。不过平常温顺，只有蜂巢被扰，才会发作。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME's stinger contains a deadly disease similar to that of the plague. Despite this, they are normally docile until their hive is disturbed.

entry: 它飞行时，独眼轻易追踪一英里外的猎物。甩出坚硬金属羽，刺穿或钉住目标。
author: infinex21
source: Its singular eye can easily track prey from a mile away while it flies. It can fling rigid metallic feathers to skewer or pin down prey.

entry: POKENAME撑着臂状尾巴平衡，以大眼观察远处敌人与猎物。先弹起、空翻，再猛砸尾巴，碾压猎物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME balance themselves upon their arm-like tails and watch for foes and prey at vast distances with their large eyes. They will launch themselves and flip in the air before slamming their tails down upon prey to crush them.

entry: POKENAME如细长火箭般推动长身，撞击敌人。偏好直立着睡，十分古怪。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can propel their long bodies like slim rockets to tackle their opponents. They have an odd preference for sleeping with their bodies upright.

entry: 地上插着的巨大金属羽，常是这种宝可梦领地的标记。它们的脚爪锋利得能穿岩，翅膀也够强，能将独角犀牛带上高空。
author: infinex21
source: Large, metal feathers stuck in the ground are a common indicator of this Pokémon's territory. Their talons are sharp enough to pierce rock and their wings are strong enough to allow them to carry a Rhyhorn high into the air.

entry: 它迅速游开危险，以双触角和其他POKENAME沟通。鱼群往往靠金属身体存活。
author: korro0490
source: This Pokémon rapidly swims away from danger. It uses its two antennas as a way of communicating with other POKENAME. Schools of this Pokémon tend to survive due to their metallic bodies.

entry: POKENAME能不停歇地往返月球无数次，为人类研究月之石的形成提供宝贵线索。
author: rkmaster25367
source: POKENAME can journey from the moon and back countless times without a break. It provides humans valuable information on how moonstones are created.

entry: 身体虽金属，动作却快，常冲撞障碍与敌人。尾能抓小物，碾成细粉或糊，再吃下。
author: infinex21
source: It moves quite fast despite its metallic body and will often ram into obstacles and foes. It can grab small objects with its tail and crush them into a fine dust, or paste, to consume them.

entry: POKENAME荡过洞中钟乳石，寻找最佳歇脚处。找到后，就用爪尾固定在洞顶。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swings across stalactites in caves to find the best place to rest. Once it finds a suitable spot, it anchors itself to the cave ceiling with its clawed tail.

entry: POKENAME对磁力极敏感，数英里外也能探知家。水手世代养在码头，航行便能当罗盘。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Highly sensitive to magnetic forces, POKENAME can detect their homes from miles away. Sailors have raised POKENAME on docks for generations, allowing them to act as compasses on their voyages.

entry: POKENAME不停绕圈游，造小旋涡吸猎物。对方拼命逃得精疲力竭，最终难免落进等着的嘴。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME perpetually swim in circles, creating a small whirlpool that drags in prey. Exhausted from trying to escape, the prey inevitably end up in POKENAME's waiting mouth.

entry: POKENAME身体金属，却能浮水。由许多金属块构成，遇险时会让这些块远离核心。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME has the ability to float in water despite its body being made of metal. Its body is made of many metal pieces that POKENAME moves away from its core when it is feeling in danger.

entry: POKENAME是人造宝可梦，创造它们，是希望能安全地研究危险野生宝可梦的行为。它们十分渴望被爱，便用废弃布料装扮自己，试着显得像真正的宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are artificial Pokémon that were created with the hopes that they could be used to safely study the behaviours of more dangerous wild Pokémon. They have a strong desire to be loved and use discarded fabrics to try and look like real Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME爱住在突出海面的岩石上，贴着水面飞行。它们偶尔将头探进水里抓住猎物，再往岩石上砸碎。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME love to live atop rocks jutting out from the ocean and fly directly along the surface of the water. They occasionally dip their heads into the water to capture prey and crush them against rocks.

entry: 它从独眼放出令人迷乱的光，震昏猎物、惊吓敌人。身体绞缠力惊人，金属皮还会增强。
author: infinex21
source: It can emit disorienting light from its singular eye to stun prey and startle foes. Its body has remarkable constrictive power further empowered by its metallic skin.

entry: 尾边钢状脊棱含致命毒，浓到能化开劣质金属。体内不断产毒御敌，褶边两个眼斑便冒泡发光。
author: infinex21
source: The steel-like ridges along its tail contain a deadly poison so concentrated it could melt low-quality metal. The two eye-like spots on its frill bubble and glow as its body continuously produces more of this poison to loose at its enemies.

entry: POKENAME从身体排高压气体飞行。独眼周围金属刺，会在撞上的任何东西留下深沟。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME flies around by expelling high-pressure gas from its body. The metallic spikes around its single eye will leave deep gouges in anything it collides with.

entry: POKENAME雷雨时抬尾，引雷补充体内储电。充满后，电弧不断在耳间跳动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lifts its tail during thunderstorms, attracting lightning to strike and recharge its internal stores. At max capacity, the electricity constantly arcs between its ears.

entry: POKENAME外形虽与金属怪相同，研究却显示，力量智力都不如真身。有反融合抗议团体拿它为据，指斥融合科技违背自然。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME appears identical to Metang, research has shown it is inferior to the real thing in both strength and intelligence. Some anti-fusion protest groups use this as evidence to decry fusion technology as unnatural.

entry: 科学家曾用基因之楔融合两只铁哑铃，试图人工造出金属怪。实验却彻底失败。
author: faelocke
source: Scientists attempted to artificially create a Metang by fusing two Beldum with DNA Splicers. The experiment was a resounding failure.

entry: 融合后，POKENAME更大胆好斗，智力却仍没比未融合铁哑铃高多少。爪内眼能否视物，仍不明。
author: fireblade141
source: After fusion, POKENAME has become more bold and aggressive, but its mental capacity still isn't that much higher than an unfused Beldum. It is unknown whether the eye on the inside of its claw is capable of seeing.

entry: 融合后外形介于铁哑铃与金属怪。POKENAME体力大幅增强，智力却几乎没长。
author: sk372
source: Fusion has resulted in an appearance resembling a state between Beldum and Metang. POKENAME's physical might has been boosted greatly, but its mental capacity has barely increased at all.

entry: 人们将额外一只铁哑铃与金属怪融合，想让它更强。可融合过程出了缺陷，整体实力反而下降。
author: faelocke
source: An extra Beldum was fused with Metang in an attempt to make it stronger. However, an imperfection in the fusion process made it weaker overall.

entry: 融合失误，让五个大脑无法同步，结果比普通巨金怪弱得多。
author: faelocke
source: Due to an error in the fusion process, the five brains of this fusion are out of sync. It is much weaker than a regular Metagross as a result.

entry: POKENAME钢铁神经传导磁脉冲，让身体移动。金属牙不停生长，便啃岩石，防止过长。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has nerves of steel, which channel the magnetic pulses it uses to move its body around. Its metal teeth constantly grow, and POKENAME will gnaw on rocks to keep them from becoming too long.

entry: POKENAME石头靠自身独特磁场飘浮。须先将爪钩进坚实表面，才可从石中显出幽灵形态。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's stone floats around via a unique magnetic field it generates. It needs to latch its claws into a solid surface before it is able to manifest its spectral form from the stone.

entry: 它如今没嘴，便用铁身冲撞猎物。幸好笨拙也不再伤到POKENAME自己。
author: ziggaway
source: This Pokémon now rams prey with its iron body since it does not have a mouth. Fortunately, POKENAME's clumsiness no longer causes itself harm.

entry: 据说POKENAME由废弃工具的魂形成，盘踞废厂。有人说，想拆它的家，总会以神秘灾难告终。
author: occulusmalus
source: Said to be formed from the spirits of abandoned tools, POKENAME haunt derelict factories. Some say attempts to demolish their homes always end in mysterious disasters.

entry: 仿生独眼扫描水域，判断洁净程度。小叶能吸杂质，因此会把自己浸进发现的污染池塘。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its single bionic eye scans bodies of water to determine their purity level. Its small leaves can absorb impurities, so it immerses itself in ponds it finds to be contaminated.

entry: POKENAME成队捕猎，以磁脉冲交流。攻击时，主要靠磁力把对手拉向自己的刀刃。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME hunt in companies and communicate with magnetic pulses. They attack primarily by magnetically pulling opponents onto their blades.

entry: 它们集群作战极协调，被认为能不用言语互通思绪。臂刃一挥，就能在硬岩刻出深沟。
author: infinex21
source: Groups of these Pokémon fight with such coordination that it is believed they are able to wordlessly communicate their thoughts to one another. Their arm blades are sharp enough to gouge solid rock in single motions.

entry: POKENAME将缎带与同类相连，互通消息。若刷过钢属性宝可梦，会让对方短暂轻微晕乎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME links its ribbons with others of its own kind to communicate. When brushed against Steel-type Pokémon, the ribbons cause them to act mildly dazed for a short period.

entry: POKENAME没有成对双臂，动作不得不偏向一侧。用巨臂作攻城锤，先冲撞，再抓起敌人，反复砸地。
author: bigoljax
source: Because of their lack of two arms, POKENAME's movements are forced to be more lopsided. They use their massive arms as battering rams, charging into opponents before grabbing and slamming them into the ground repeatedly.

entry: POKENAME常被误认为奇特设计的灯具。没训练家指示，很少移动做事，却让许多人觉得，正被它盯着。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME is often mistaken for an unusually designed light fixture. Though it rarely moves or does anything without instruction from its Trainer, many people report the uncomfortable feeling that POKENAME is watching them.

entry: POKENAME感到威胁，就用体内能量，在身上显出耳朵和六条尾巴的形象，警告旁人。不理会警告者，就会遭到更多积蓄火力的攻击。
author: sk372
source: When it feels threatened, POKENAME manifests a likeness of ears and six tails on its body using its internal energy. This is a warning to others, and failure to adhere to it will cause it to release more of its stored-up firepower on them.

entry: POKENAME常为保安作伴，独眼强闪，震晕闯入者。以受控能量脉冲提醒训练家，甚至能隔墙传讯。
author: .fedoraman
source: Common among security guards, POKENAME's eye can flash brightly to stun intruders. It is known to alert its Trainer by sending controlled pulses of energy and is even capable of sending signals through walls.

entry: POKENAME通过尾端爪释放大量电力。放电时，独眼明显暗下、闪烁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME discharges huge amounts of electricity through the claws at the end of its tail. When releasing voltage, its singular eye notably dims and flickers.

entry: POKENAME住废料场，以大堆废物筑巢。常见成群始终张颚，留意潜在闯入者。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live in scrapyards, making their nests out of large scrap piles. Groups of them can be seen with their jaws perpetually open to keep a lookout for potential intruders.

entry: POKENAME的火，连最坚固的金属也能熔掉。最初，人们在金黄市附近发现它。
author: ayutac
source: POKENAME's flame is hot enough to melt even the strongest metals. It was first seen around Saffron City.

entry: POKENAME不像许多超音蝠变种那样失明，独眼藏在嘴里。捕猎先飞到前方，以眼中强光照得猎物看不见，再用尖牙吸血。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is not blind like many Zubat variants; its single eye is hidden in its mouth. When hunting, it flies in front of its prey and blinds them with a flash of light from its eye before using its fangs to drain blood.

entry: POKENAME的花朵吸收阳光，转化为能量，支持它们不停远游。能量足够时，花心的眼睛便能脱离身体，自行漂浮，寻找新的地方探索。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flowers absorb sunlight to convert it into energy to fuel their constant wanderlust. The eye at the centre of their flower can detach and float on its own should they absorb enough energy, allowing them to seek out new places to explore.

entry: 背上白蘑菇被称作鹅膏菌。聚在一起的POKENAME越多，动作就越快。
author: beatdoof
source: The white mushrooms on its back are called muchomor. The more POKENAME that gather together, the faster they move and act.

entry: POKENAME背上红球，其实是金属菇的孢子。人和宝可梦常误作宝石，可一抓才知又软又黏。
author: .jerden
source: The red balls on POKENAME's back are actually the spores of its metallic mushroom. People and Pokémon frequently mistake them for gemstones, but if they are grabbed they will find that they are soft and sticky.

entry: POKENAME给背石贴宝石，主要是红宝石。吸入体内后，精神力量增强。捕食者误当眼睛，也会被吓退。
author: distinguishedmanlygentleman
source: POKENAME attaches gemstones, mainly rubies, to the rock on its back. These gems are absorbed into POKENAME, increasing its psychic power. The gems also scare off predators, who mistake the gems for POKENAME's eyes.

entry: POKENAME用尾拍自身空壳，沿鳞发金属鸣响，彼此沟通。额中央鳞如感应器，远远读取声音。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME communicate with each other by slamming their tails against their own hollow bodies to create metallic ringing along their scales. The central scales on their foreheads act as a sensor to read these sounds over great distances.

entry: 下半身是大开口，内衬小金属刃，扣住被拖入的猎物，再整只吞下。它们用头两侧金属触角交流。
author: infinex21
source: The lower half of its body is a large opening lined with small, metal blades that can hold onto prey as they are dragged in and swallowed whole. Its species can communicate with one another using their metal antennae on the sides of their heads.

entry: POKENAME融合未完全，只有一臂呈现新头所赋的形态。因此战斗既善切割，也善钝击。
author: josh707
source: In a state of incomplete fusion, only one of POKENAME's arms has taken on the form provided by its new head. As a result, it is proficient in both slicing and bludgeoning foes during combat.

entry: POKENAME厚毛下，是纯金属身体。从头触角发电磁波，与同类交流。
author: fiordaliso
source: Beneath POKENAME's thick fur lies a body of pure metal. It communicates with its own kind by emitting electromagnetic waves from the antennae on its head.

entry: POKENAME徘徊陨石坠地处，同步成群飞动。合力造强磁场，保护陨石不受损。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME linger close to sites of meteor crashes, swarming the area in synchronized patterns. Together, they produce a powerful magnetic field to protect the meteorite from damage.

entry: 它的爪子比铁火龙更尖，可力气不足。不过，攻击上欠缺的，防御却补得回来。
author: ayutac
source: It has sharper claws than Belmander, but they are lacking in strength. What it is missing in offense, though, it makes up in defense.

entry: 脑中磁铁能感应贵金属。它们爱囤未提炼的金块，有时也吃金粉。
author: infinex21
source: They contain a magnet within their brains that is attuned to precious metals. They love to hoard chunks of unrefined gold. They sometimes consume gold dust.

entry: POKENAME胡须调至特定无线电频率，不断发出只有无线电接收器能侦测的次声嗡鸣。不必看见彼此，也能协调。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME whiskers are attuned to specific radio frequencies. They emit a constant hum of infrasonic that is only detectable by radio receivers, allowing them to coordinate together without needing to see one another.

entry: POKENAME容易受刺激过度，许多训练家让它在工厂做事，学会在嘈声中调节心智。重复工作，教它忽略突发大响。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are easily overstimulated, so many Trainers give them work in a factory setting to help teach them how to regulate their minds when there are loud noises. The repetitive task of factory work teaches them how to ignore sudden loud noises.

entry: POKENAME金属身体善做重复任务，适合工厂。它容易承受不住刺激，稳定输入反而能保持平静，防止头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have metallic bodies that are great for repetitive tasks, which makes them well-suited for factories. This is especially true because they can get overwhelmed easily, so the consistent stimuli help them stay calm and prevent headaches.

entry: POKENAME群捕猎完全同步，即使看不出如何知道同伴位置。研究者发现，它们发特定频率无线电波协调。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME packs move in perfect synchrony with one another as they hunt, even when there is no obvious way for them to know where the other members of their pack are. Researchers have found they emit radio waves at a specific frequency to coordinate.

entry: 这种宝可梦生活在池塘里，金属身体太重，常被困在塘底。身上的金属却相当透明，有时甚至能看见内脏。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon live within ponds, their metal bodies so heavy that they are often stuck at the bottom of them. The metal of their bodies is rather transparent, to the point you can sometimes see their internal organs.

entry: 拖着巨大右臂移动，让身体越练越强。右臂挥出的百万吨重拳，足以打碎自身大小的巨石。
author: infinex21
source: Its body grows stronger by lugging its large right arm around. The Mega Punches let loose though its right arm are strong enough to break boulders as large as itself.

entry: 磁力托起POKENAME，它伸着触手，飘在近海面。缠住猎物后，突然潜入深处。
author: busilisk
source: Buoyed by magnetic forces, POKENAME drifts with tentacles outstretched near the surface of the ocean. Upon constricting prey, it plunges suddenly into the depths.

entry: POKENAME住在满是石笋的嶙峋洞里。从嘴里红孔发可怕尖啸，让猎物晕头转向，方便猛攻。
author: lootererswillbeboated
source: POKENAME lives in jagged caves filled with stalagmites. To hunt, it emits a horrible screech from the red hole in its mouth, disorienting prey so it can freely pummel them.

entry: POKENAME群不靠言语，也完全同步奔跑。研究者因此相信，一定范围内都连成群体意识。加速到最高时，体内炉火便旺起巨焰。
author: pjporwoll
source: Herds of POKENAME run in perfect unison without verbal communication, leading researchers to believe all POKENAME within a certain range join as a hivemind. Their internal furnaces flare up to create immense flames when increasing to top speeds.

entry: POKENAME由三只铁磁怪以磁力连接而成。它极罕见，因为两只铁磁怪一结合，就会融合成金属磁怪。
author: pinkyoshi2350
source: POKENAME is made of three Belmite joined together by magnets. This Pokémon is very rare, as two Belmite joining causes them to fuse into a Metmite.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛，比任何科学造出的镜片都强。修习神秘之术的人，常借POKENAME窥看遥远之处。
author: ozydamians
source: A POKENAME's eye is more powerful than any lens produced by science. Occult practitioners use POKENAME to spy across vast distances.

entry: 有人发现，一位天文学家曾借POKENAME，窥见遥远行星，随即引起争论。POKENAME眼中的每个世界，都是漆黑、扭曲的噩梦。
author: wormspawn
source: Controversy arose when it was discovered an astronomer used POKENAME to glimpse visions of distant planets. Every world seen by POKENAME was a dark and twisted nightmare.

entry: 直视POKENAME的眼，除非意志最坚定，否则便会僵直失神。神秘学者声称，它能看尽凝视之物的一切，过去、当下、未来，无一遗漏。
author: ozydamians
source: To behold the eye of POKENAME renders all but the strongest of wills catatonic. Mystics claim that it can see every aspect of what it turns its gaze to, past, present, and future.

entry: POKENAME身形庞大，蛇状身体由坚韧金属构成。它钻入地下深处，蓄力突袭毫无防备的敌人。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME is a large Pokémon with a serpentine body crafted from a tough, metallic material. It can burrow deep into the ground, using its strength to launch surprise attacks on unsuspecting foes.

entry: POKENAME操纵钢钳的精度，可达毫米，常被请去协助拔牙。心情好时，它会从嘴里吹出泡泡，再用钳子顽皮地将其戳破。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is often used as an assistant during dental extractions thanks to its millimetric precision with its steel pincers. When in a good mood, it blows bubbles from its mouth and playfully pops them with its chelae.

entry: POKENAME双拳互撞，给身体蓄能进攻。有时过载，便在电能爆发中炸开。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slams its fists together to charge its body for an attack. Sometimes, this charge can overload, causing it to explode in a burst of electrical energy.

entry: POKENAME脚爪的尖端覆着铁，抓握力强得足以捏碎石头。它战斗起来不肯罢休，会伸长双腿抓住远处的敌人，将其抛起、摔打。
author: sk372
source: The iron-tipped claws on POKENAME's feet give it a powerful grip capable of crushing stone. It is a relentless combatant, extending its legs to grapple far-away foes and toss or slam them around.

entry: POKENAME能将大量电力引入强壮尖爪。似乎觉得避雷针的存在很冒犯，曾暴怒徒手拆毁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can channel incredible amounts of electricity into its powerful, pointed claws. It apparently takes offense to the existence of lightning rods and has been known to tear them down with its bare hands in a rage.

entry: POKENAME遇险，金属身体会亮蓝发光。受威胁，召来雷暴，构成可怕防御。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's metal body glows a bright blue when it is in danger. It will summon thunderstorms to create a fearsome defense when threatened.

entry: POKENAME追击所有领地闯入者，用四毒刺接连快攻。触角帮助磨炼潜藏却微弱的精神力，追踪所有敌人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME chase down all who intrude upon their territory and barrage them with rapid strikes using their four stingers. Their antennae help them to hone their latent, albeit weak, psychic powers to help them track all foes.

entry: POKENAME念控两只大金属爪，自己留远处，撕碎目标。累了便把大肢体接回手臂，恢复耗去的精神能量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME manipulates two large metal claws using telekinesis, using them to tear apart targets while remaining at a distance. When it grows tired, it connects the large limbs to its arms to recuperate its spent psychic energy.

entry: POKENAME从背附肢喷火，穿行山区。以草属性宝可梦为主食，也吃腰木果，防范烈咬陆鲨捕食。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME jets around its mountainous habitat using bursts of fire from the appendages growing on its back. It supplements its diet of Grass-type Pokémon with Shuca Berries to protect it from predatory Garchomp.

entry: POKENAME从口吐网，比钢还硬，能有效困敌，因此是可怕猎手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits webbing out of its mouth that is harder than steel. This strong webbing allows it to trap foes effectively, making it a formidable predator.

entry: POKENAME飞得快得离谱，强金属翼轻松托身。强臂将猎物砸向最近表面，再丢进有铁牙的嘴里。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flies through the air at ridiculous speeds, its powerful metal wings keeping it aloft with ease. It crashes prey against the nearest surface with its powerful arms, before tossing them into its mouth where iron fangs wait.

entry: POKENAME像天真的孩子一样开朗，很容易黏上旁人，伸爪抓住，想贴得更近。爪子的握力惊人，一旦抓牢，就很难让它松开。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has the cheerful disposition of a naive child. It easily gets clingy towards others, grabbing onto them to keep close. Because of the massive grip strength its claws have, it's difficult to pry it away once it gets attached.

entry: POKENAME动作缓慢有条理，仿佛每步都精算。月光下，金属身泛不同色调，体环则明亮发光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's movements are slow and methodical, as if it carefully calculates every motion it makes. Its metallic body takes on a different hue in the moonlight, while the rings on its body begin glowing brightly.

entry: POKENAME脚爪抓握极强，战斗难被打倒。伸出金属藤相连，与同类交流。
author: sk372
source: The claws on POKENAME's feet have a powerful grip, making it hard to knock over in battle. It communicates with others of its kind by extending and linking their metallic vines together.

entry: POKENAME身体沉重、无腿，行动困难。幸好大铁爪旋转，能比一般地面属性宝可梦挖得更快。
author: sottiwotti
source: POKENAME has trouble moving around because of its heavy, legless body. Luckily, it can dig faster than the average Ground-type Pokémon by spinning its large iron claws.

entry: POKENAME用巨爪攀附洞顶，“走”着穿过黑暗。必要时，也能操纵磁场，笨拙飞起。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME uses its gigantic claws to cling to the roofs of caves, 'walking' across the ceiling to traverse in the dark. When it needs to, it can clumsily fly through manipulation of magnetic fields.

entry: POKENAME双拳绕身旋转，挖穿山脉。直线行进时，最高时速70英里，以惊人力量凿岩。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fists spin around its body as it creates tunnels through mountain ranges. It can reach speeds of up to 70 mph when traveling in a straight line, carving through rock with incredible force.

entry: POKENAME最显眼的是巨爪手，智力却同样危险。毫不费劲，就能同时追踪两个敌人。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's most distinctive feature is its massive clawed hands, but its intelligence is equally dangerous. It can keep track of two foes at once with very little effort.

entry: 金属喙连石也能碎，因此其他飞行属性宝可梦都不想交战。POKENAME自然脱落的铁羽，会被收集，用来修铁路。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its metal beak can even crush rock, which is why other Flying-type Pokémon never want to fight it. The iron feathers POKENAME naturally sheds are collected and used to repair railroad tracks.

entry: POKENAME将脑与神经系统连入电脑，控制键盘鼠标。许多居家办公者训练它，出门办事时，电脑仍保持活跃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME connects its brain and nervous system to PCs to take control of the keyboards and mouses. Many workers that work from home have trained POKENAME to keep a PC active while they run errands.

entry: POKENAME将双臂相抵，就能飘起。凭敏捷精准电击，战斗十分危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can float if it presses its two arms together. It leverages its agility by attacking with perfectly placed electric shocks, making it dangerous in battle.

entry: POKENAME锐爪撕开土地，掘大通道，找稀矿吃。地道即使塌了，铁皮也能保护免伤。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's sharp claws enable it to tear through the earth, digging large tunnels as it searches for rare minerals to eat. Even if the tunnel collapses, POKENAME's iron skin will protect it from damage.

entry: POKENAME找到废车，就以巨精神力压成球，作临时无人机。也按精确晦涩的数学公式，构造精神能量球。
author: mr.bonesii
source: When POKENAME finds abandoned vehicles, it will crush them into spheres with its immense psychic power and use them as makeshift drones. It constructs balls of psychic energy according to precise and esoteric mathematical formulae.

entry: POKENAME金属身摸着极冷，雨一碰就冻。这寒气让它在环境里显眼，风暴中尤其如此。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's metallic body is very cold to the touch, and rain freezes on contact. This cold aura makes it stand out in its environment, especially during storms.

entry: POKENAME聪明内敛，保护欲却妨碍自制。只要觉得训练家遇险，就毫不犹豫，试图用强铁爪撕开潜在问题。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite intelligent and reserved, but its protective streak hampers its self-control. If it thinks its Trainer is in danger it won't hesitate to attempt to tear apart the potential problem with its powerful iron claws.

entry: 两只POKENAME的身体虽已成功融合，大脑却未能相连，因此远比“真正的”巨金怪弱。
author: faelocke
source: While the two POKENAME's bodies were successfully fused, their brains have not linked up. As a result, this is far weaker than a "true" Metagross.

entry: 金属怪与金属怪融合，外观近似巨金怪，看着骇人。但其实只是多了两臂、体力更强的金属怪。
author: fireblade141
source: Fusing a Metang to a Metang yields a Pokémon close in appearance to Metagross, which can make it seem intimidating. However, it is merely just a Metang with increased physical power due to having two extra arms.

entry: 多出的爪子有助捕猎，战斗时却不太听使唤。这是因为相连的大脑失去了平衡。
author: faelocke
source: The extra claws aid this fusion in hunting its prey, but tend to be unwieldy in battle. This is due to an imbalance in their linked brains.

entry: POKENAME头脑简单，低估了钢爪的握力。想帮大牙狸筑坝，却常失手把原木捏成碎片。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's steel claws possess a far stronger grip than its simple mind realizes. It tries to help create dams for Bidoof, but usually winds up accidentally crushing the logs to splinters instead.

entry: POKENAME地道若塌，就用精神能力清碎石。再靠心灵感应定位，寻找较弱宝可梦吞食。
author: .izik
source: If its tunnel suffers a cave-in, POKENAME uses its psychic abilities to clear the rubble. It then searches for weaker Pokémon to consume, using its telepathic strength to locate prey.

entry: POKENAME吃足金属，子弹拳便强到能毁小楼。借此在同类间彰显地位。
author: .izik
source: After eating enough metal, POKENAME's Bullet Punch gains enough force to destroy a small building. It uses this to assert dominance over other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME坚爪轻松在浅水底掘巢。独居，除非捕猎或驱赶闯入者，很少出来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's sturdy claws let it easily dig out dens in the bottom of shallow waters. A solitary creature, it rarely comes out of its den unless hunting or defending its home from intruders.

entry: POKENAME互碰金属头交流。每次双头撞上，都产生暂时磁场，干扰附近小设备。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have an odd method of communicating with each other by tapping their metal heads together. Each time the heads of two POKENAME collide, they generate a temporary magnetic field that can disrupt small devices nearby.

entry: POKENAME外罩蓝金属，里面却空。幽灵般飘浮，空心结构让外观诡异。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body has a blue metal casing, but it is hollow inside. This hollow structure gives it an eerie appearance, as it floats with a ghostly presence.

entry: POKENAME用脚附住大车，当始终指北的导航。可强磁场，也会干扰其他电子导航仪的信号。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can use its feet to attach itself to large vehicles and act as a navigation system that always points north. However, its strong magnetic field interferes with the signal of other electronic navigation instruments.

entry: POKENAME先以精神力量定住猎物，再用头刃攻击。准头无人能比，是熟练猎手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to hold prey in place before striking with the blade on its head. The precision of its strikes is unmatched, making it a skilled hunter.

entry: POKENAME战时从触须放出强念力波，操控周围地形。巧妙配合泼沙，取得优势。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases powerful telekinetic waves from its feelers during combat to manipulate the surrounding terrain. It couples this with strategic Sand Attacks to gain the advantage.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，以压倒性力量闻名。粗尾与锐钢爪，迅速解决闯入者。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is highly territorial and known for its overwhelming strength. Its thick tail and sharp, steel claws make quick work of any trespassers.

entry: POKENAME流线型身躯，让它以惊人速度划过深海。双拳互击，能造水下冲击波，强到使海面喷起水柱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's streamlined body lets it cut through the ocean depths at a marvelous speed. By clanging its fists together, it can create underwater shockwaves powerful enough to create water spouts on the surface.

entry: POKENAME开炮前，先将爪嵌地、压低身体。若不做准备，强炮反冲就会把自己向后掀飞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME embeds its claws into the ground and hunches down in preparation to fire its cannon. If it fails to do so, the recoil from its powerful blasts would send it flying backward.

entry: POKENAME用利爪挖掘崖壁，寻找月之石，靠坚硬如钢的身体抵挡落石。矿工常请它们帮忙作业。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their sharp claws to dig through cliff faces in search of Moon Stones, relying on their tough, steely body to protect themselves from any rock falls. Miners commonly use them to help them in their operations.

entry: 爪里藏着麻痹毒注射器，制伏强敌。臂上透镜能放日光，帮助植物存活生长。它们通常不寻衅，却凶猛保护植物与弱小宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: Its claws conceal injectors of a numbing poison to subdue mighty foes. The lenses of its arms can emit sunlight that help plants to survive and grow. Its species does not tend to seek conflict, but will fiercely defend plants and weaker Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME头顶看似柔软蓬毛，实际是一厚团粗金属纤维。摸着不仅难受，也危险，锐边有很高破伤风风险。
author: hophoppip
source: What appears to be soft, fluffy hair on POKENAME's head is actually a thick mass of rough metal fibers. Petting these fibers is not only unpleasant but unsafe, as the sharp edges pose a high risk of tetanus.

entry: 有些学生请POKENAME帮助学习，因为凝视它头上的光，能刺激大脑，暂时提高智力。不过，这也有代价：精力会下降，更容易疲倦。
author: sk372
source: Some students use POKENAME as a study aid, as gazing into the light on its head stimulates the brain and temporarily increases intellect. It comes with the caveat of reducing one's energy and tiring them out quicker, however.

entry: 古图书馆的书，详记POKENAME以念力协助建神庙。记录表明，它曾为古文明筑起巨大建筑。
author: .izik
source: Ancient libraries contain tomes detailing POKENAME's assistance in building temples using its telekinetic powers. These records show its role in constructing massive structures for ancient civilizations.

entry: POKENAME身旁浮钢爪，抓到什么都拖近，好让它咬。爪靠磁力相连，若抓住更强宝可梦，本体反可能被拖着走。
author: .jerden
source: The steel claws floating next to POKENAME will grab anything near it, dragging it closer so that POKENAME can bite it. They are connected through magnetic force, and if they latch onto a stronger Pokémon, POKENAME may be dragged around behind them.

entry: POKENAME伸出的金属臂能拳穿钢铁。可视力很差，战中偶尔误打同伴。
author: .izik
source: The metal arms protruding from POKENAME's body can punch through steel. However, it has very poor eyesight and may occasionally punch its allies by accident during battle.

entry: 它们以精神力量，将内火显成九条长尾。身体虽金属，即使火在里面翻涌，也很少摸着烫。
author: infinex21
source: They use their psychic powers to manifest their internal flames as nine, long tails. Despite their bodies being made of metal, they are rarely hot to the touch even as flames roll within them.

entry: POKENAME先让闪电流过大金属臂，再出击。精神能量与电力结合，是强大战士。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME channels lightning through its large metal arms before striking. Its powerful combination of psychic energy and electricity makes it a formidable fighter.

entry: POKENAME用念力固定岩石，再撞上测试力量。借此不断挑战极限，变得更强。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses telekinesis to hold rocks in place before ramming into them to test its own strength. This ability allows it to continuously challenge its limits and grow more powerful.

entry: POKENAME身体比钛还硬，几乎不可摧毁。能长时间悬空，以精神力量轻松飞过空中。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is harder than titanium, making it nearly indestructible. It can levitate for long periods, using its psychic abilities to float effortlessly through the air.

entry: POKENAME把手臂连上机器，提高效率。停电时，也能靠能力维持关键机器运转。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME attaches its arms to a machine to increase its efficiency. It can also use its ability during a power loss to keep vital machines working, ensuring they stay operational.

entry: 全身由电线与钢丝绒构成。最结实的部位，也只是压得极紧的钢丝绒。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its body is made entirely of wiring and steel wool. The sturdiest parts of its body are just extremely compact steel wool.

entry: POKENAME身体密实，爪子强健，一攀住生灵取食，就很难拉开。幸好个头小，吸少量静电就能填饱肚子，吃饱便会跳开。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's dense body and strong claws make it difficult to remove once it latches onto a creature to feed. Fortunately, its small size means it drains very little static electricity in order to sate its hunger, leaping off once it is full.

entry: POKENAME金属长牙，能把半挂卡车劈两半。会在附近石头与金属物上磨利。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's metal tusks can cleave a semi-truck in two. It will sharpen these tusks on stones and the metal objects in its immediate area.

entry: POKENAME能把锐金属爪加热至通红，连最坚韧金属也能熔穿。通常贴地飘着，也能以爪迅速攀树崖。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can heat their sharp metal claws until they glow red-hot, enabling them to melt their way through even the toughest metal. While POKENAME usually float just above the ground, they can use their claws to quickly climb trees and cliffs.

entry: POKENAME将精神力量集中在角，压住猎物，再吸血。这战法使它成为栖地的致命猎手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses psychic power focused in its horn to pin prey down, then drinks their blood. This method of attack makes it a deadly predator in its environment.

entry: POKENAME用金属身躯，封护血肉核心，抵挡外界危险。多数精神能量用于旋转自身，最高每分钟600转，随时滚进或滚出险境。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME uses its metal body to seal off its fleshy core from any outside dangers. Most of POKENAME's psychic energy is spent on spinning itself at speeds of up to 600 RPM, allowing it to roll in or out of danger at a moment's notice.

entry: POKENAME吃岩地常见金属，以磁刺侦测。训练家甚至能拿它代替金属探测器。
author: samu_games
source: POKENAME feeds on common metals from rocky areas, detecting them with its magnetic spike. Trainers can even use it as an alternative metal detector.

entry: POKENAME口水带怪金属气味，引来齿轮儿、小磁怪等。为免被烦扰，会甩头，以头上硬金属叶击打。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's drool emits an odd metallic scent that attracts Pokémon like Klink and Magnemite. To avoid being harassed, it swings its head and strikes with the hard metal leaves on its head.

entry: POKENAME体外覆着古怪蓝色金属凝胶，极有价值，有时作机器冷却剂。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is coated in an odd blue metallic gel. This substance is extremely valuable and is sometimes used as coolant for machines.

entry: POKENAME花瓣由厚金属板构成。遇险就低头护身，将尖刺对准攻击者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME petals are made of thick metal plates. When they feel endangered, they lower their head to protect their body, directing their sharp spike at whatever is attacking them.

entry: 凭灵巧体形，POKENAME有很强磁力与体力。只要静止，背上的蘑菇就开始起伏收缩。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME has strong magnetic and physical strength thanks to its nimble size. Whenever it stays inert, the mushrooms on its back start undulating and contracting.

entry: POKENAME骨间连接组织由金属构成，互磨声响很大，因此无法无声移动。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: The tissue connecting POKENAME's bones are made of metal and grind loudly against each other. Therefore, it cannot move silently.

entry: POKENAME背上蘑菇，指引它攀上哪些钢属性宝可梦，再用脚爪吸取生命。最爱自爆磁怪，因为电能巨大、智力高。
author: beatdoof
source: The mushroom on POKENAME's back guide which Steel-type Pokémon they will latch onto to absorb its life force through their talons. Magnezone is their favorite due to their immense electrical energy and intelligence.

entry: POKENAME身上鳞片强磁，借此追踪、捕猎可可多拉等金属身躯的猎物。
author: .izik
source: The scales on POKENAME's body are highly magnetic. It uses this property to track and hunt metal-bodied prey such as Aron.

entry: POKENAME金属身极耐久，攻防兼用。常任敌人击中，造出空隙，再用甲头、手臂或尾，全力还击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's metallic body is incredibly durable, which it uses for both offense and defense. POKENAME often lets foes hit it, creating openings that enable POKENAME to retaliate with full force, striking with its armored head, arms, or tail.

entry: 腹部白而柔软脆弱，其他部位却是坚韧蓝金属。打击力道很强，可因弱点太大，通常避开冲突。
author: infinex21
source: Its white belly is quite soft and vulnerable, even though the rest of its body is a blue, sturdy metal. Its physical strikes are very strong, but it will typically avoid conflict due to its large weak spot.

entry: 有许多POKENAME救助危境旅人的记录。其中一例，曾举起超过自身体形十倍的巨石。
author: josh707
source: Many POKENAME have been recorded rescuing travellers in precarious situations. One such case describes a POKENAME lifting a boulder over ten times its size.

entry: POKENAME以强力头锤制住朝北鼻等闯入者。褶边感知微弱磁脉冲，便知它们在旁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME subdues intruders like Nosepass with powerful Headbutts. It senses their presence through faint magnetic pulses in its frill.

entry: 炽烈火焰配上强劲双臂，任何路障也挡不住。传闻，西尔佛公司还想给它添双翅膀，让它真正势不可挡。
author: ayutac
source: With its intense flame and powerful arms, it can break through any barricade. It is rumored Silph Co. is trying to give it wings to make it truly unstoppable.

entry: 它移动似乎钻地，其实只扰动地表。POKENAME并非挖掘，而借地底深处金属的磁力，滑过陆地。
author: hophoppip
source: Though it appears to tunnel through the ground as it moves, only the surface is disrupted. Rather than digging, POKENAME glides across land via the magnetism of metals deep underground.

entry: POKENAME常当高效计算器，双脑能极快准确数算、换算货币。手臂强，轻松把硬币掷出超过30英里的时速。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME are often used as high-power calculators, able to accurately count and convert currencies at an incredible rate thanks to their two brains. POKENAME have powerful arms, able to throw coins at over 30 mph with ease.

entry: POKENAME的爪子锋利得足以撕开岩石，挥击会给敌人留下严重抓伤。它们几乎什么表面都能攀爬，却未必总能自己爬下来。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME claws are sharp enough to tear through stone, their swipes leaving nasty scratches on their foes. They're able to use their claws to climb almost any surface, though they are not always able to get themselves back down again.

entry: POKENAME拳力极强，轻松打穿钢铁。当地建筑公司曾借它搬重建材。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME pack a very strong punch, capable of blowing through steel with ease. They have been utilized by local construction companies to carry heavy building materials.

entry: 西尔佛公司的秘密成果，如今终于会飞，可也失去了一些热量与力气。公司仍在设法改进。
author: ayutac
source: Silph Co.'s secret project can now fly, but in exchange for that, it lost some of its heat and strength. Silph Co. is working on an improvement.

entry: 它们两栖，以强臂走过池湖家园底部。爪把猎物抓得屈服，再整只吞下。
author: infinex21
source: These amphibious Pokémon use their strong arms to walk along the bottoms of ponds and lakes they call home. Their claws grip prey into submission before swallowing it whole.

entry: POKENAME惊人智慧依体内磁网络运作。面对三合一磁怪等强磁源，行为可能失常。矛盾的是，却爱吃磁矿物。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's incredible intelligence runs through a magnetic network inside its body. Therefore, when faced with powerful magnets, such as those from Magneton, POKENAME may behave erratically. Paradoxically, it loves to dine on magnetic minerals.

entry: POKENAME的爪子强而有力，能深深扣进石壁，轻松悬住沉重的身体。人们曾见交战的对手撕下彼此的壳块，加在自己身上，作为胜利的标记。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's claws are strong enough to stick deep into stone walls and keep its own heavy body suspended with little effort. Rivals have been seen tearing chunks of their opponent's shell off to add to themselves as a mark of victory.

entry: 别被POKENAME笨拙骗了，若被激得冲撞，力量足以断骨。
author: notsaying.
source: Don't be fooled by POKENAME's clumsiness, if provoked into a charge, it's strong enough to break bones.

entry: POKENAME金属外皮极耐久，因此高速奔跑也不怕意外。爱追矿物含量高的快猎物，最爱稀有的化石翼龙。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME runs at incredible speeds without fear of accidents as its metal hide is highly durable. It enjoys chasing down speedy prey with high mineral content to feed on, with the rare Aerodactyl being its favorite.

entry: POKENAME双脑合作策划攻击。若打钢属性宝可梦，会试着以磁力定住，解除威胁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has two brains that work together to plan attacks. If fighting a Steel-type Pokémon, it will attempt to hold it in place with magnetic charges to neutralize the threat.

entry: 它用磁力使锈铁颗粒环身。饲养POKENAME的训练家，应确认破伤风疫苗已按时接种。
author: cait_sith
source: It uses magnetism to surround its body with rusty iron particles. Trainers that raise POKENAME should make sure that they are up to date on their tetanus shots.

entry: POKENAME身体沉重，在浅海缓缓疾爬。只要抓到，强爪就确保猎物逃不掉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's heavy body leaves it scuttling slowly among the shallows of the ocean. The strength of its claws ensures that any prey it manages to catch will not be able to escape.

entry: POKENAME每钳握力巨大，能猛力碾压。主要吃刺甲贝，轻松撕开保护壳。
author: sk372
source: The grip strength within each of POKENAME's claws can crush with titanic force. It subsists primarily upon Cloyster, able to tear apart their protective shells with ease.

entry: POKENAME不断计算，吃多少才维持健康体重。每餐后又重算，一天约六餐，剩不下多少娱乐时间。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are constantly calculating how much food to eat to remain at a healthy body weight. These calculations start over at the end of each meal, which leaves little time for recreation as they have roughly six meals a day.

entry: 四颗大脑住在体内，每天耗去大量能量。需要认真思考时，它便滚进发电厂，吸电为大脑加把劲。
author: celio_0230
source: It hosts four brains within its body, which uses up a lot of energy over the course of a day. When it needs to think hard, this Pokémon rolls into power plants, absorbing electricity to supercharge their brains.

entry: POKENAME每只眼其实都连自己的脑，控制眼与一条肢体。秘密第六脑，负责产气与其他内脏功能。
author: adamzwill
source: Each eye seen on POKENAME's body is actually attached to its own brain, controlling the eye itself as well as a limb. A secret sixth brain controls production of the gas and the functions of other internal organs.

entry: POKENAME有五个大脑，一个在头部，另外四个在手臂肩部。都不算大，因此它不会尝试比低下角、直冲敌人更复杂的战术。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has five brains, one inside its head and the other four in the shoulders of its arms. None of them are particularly large, so it doesn't attempt any strategies more complex than lowering its horn and charging straight at foes.

entry: POKENAME的金属外壳很容易损坏，因此战斗中会主动扯掉受损的身体部位。只消几秒，这些部位便能再生，让它迅速重返战斗。
author: bigoljax
source: During battle, POKENAME rips off damaged body parts because its metallic shell is easy to damage. Once ripped off, it can regenerate these torn-off parts in mere seconds, allowing it to quickly get back into battle.

entry: POKENAME靠下肢在地面快速移动，甚至能沿墙壁和天花板行走。指尖的触须可以传导神秘能量，它常借此制造防御屏障。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their lower limbs to quickly move along the ground but can even walk along walls and ceilings. The feelers of their fingertips serve as conduits for their mystical energies, through which they often create defensive barriers.

entry: POKENAME超高智力让切割极精准，深受木工重视。大脑高速运算，下刀前从不迟疑超过一秒。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are valued highly by woodworkers since their superintelligence allows them to take extremely precise cuts. Their brains are always calculating at incredible speed, never hesitating for more than a second before taking the next slice.

entry: 据说POKENAME智力复杂，却也常暴怒乱扑。分节金属身体，赋予惊人灵活性。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME supposedly have complex intellects, though they are also so often seen thrashing about in fits of rage. Their segmented bodies of metal provide them impressive flexibility.

entry: POKENAME在水中游动时，会将巨大的肢体折在身侧。抵达陆地或坚实的浮冰时，它便跃出水面，用这些肢体继续前行。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME will fold its large limbs alongside its body as it swims through water. When it reaches land, or a floe of solid ice, it will launch from the water and use these limbs to continue its journey.

entry: 它借水流推进，以坦克炮弹般的速度射出手臂。手臂若被毁，POKENAME就会寻找铁哑铃替换。
author: vaporvenator
source: It uses water propulsion to fire its arms with the velocity of a tank shell. When an arm is destroyed, POKENAME searches for a Beldum to replace it.

entry: POKENAME金属身能随意散热，因此炎热丛林、沙漠，甚至火山顶都可生活。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's metallic body can vent out heat at will, so POKENAME can live in areas with scalding temperatures, from jungles to deserts to the tops of volcanoes.

entry: POKENAME的皮肤虽由金属构成，浮力却足以让它漂起来。飞过海面时，若发现正在下沉的船，它可能俯冲下去，用强尾将船推近岸边，让乘客逃生。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME's skin is made of metal, it is buoyant enough to float. If it sees a ship sinking while flying over the sea, POKENAME may dive down and use its powerful tail to push the vessel closer to shore, enabling the passengers to escape.

entry: POKENAME总找强敌，测试磨炼力量。通常开战前丢一把剑，让对方也能公平、重荣地交锋。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is always seeking out strong opponents to test and hone its might in battle. It usually tosses a sword to its foe before a fight so they can clash blades honorably and equally.

entry: POKENAME身躯似乎太重，小翼托不起，却能以磁斥力完全抵消重量。随时停止，就可凭金属全重，重砸敌人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body seems too bulky for its small wings to lift, but through magnetic repulsion, it can entirely negate this weight. It can cut this at any time to slam down on top of foes with the full weight of its metal body.

entry: 身体太重，它便发展更强精神力悬空。翼如推进器，导出精神能量前进。毒刺还能发射，追踪所有目标。
author: infinex21
source: Its body is so heavy that it has developed greater psychic power to keep itself afloat. Its wings have become like boosters through which it shunts psychic energy to propel itself. Its stingers can be launched and will home in on all its targets.

entry: POKENAME四颗脑，各有151的智商。想展现才智，却太害羞，不肯这样做。
author: bigoljax
source: Each one of POKENAME's four brains have an IQ of 151. They wish to show this intelligence, but are incredibly shy and won't let themselves do so.

entry: POKENAME脖子能伸长些，好让头更适合吸日光。会把腿扎进地，固定自己，晒太阳时不易被吹倒。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's neck can extend a decent bit to better position its head to absorb sunlight. They will dig their legs into the ground to root themselves and better avoid being blown over while they absorb sunlight.

entry: POKENAME额外的手臂，每次出击都会迸出爆炸般的火焰。它们能借这股爆发力在空中推进，寻找猎物，或在伤得太重时逃离。
author: infinex21
source: The extra arms of a POKENAME emit explosive bursts of fire with every strike. They can uses their explosive bursts to propel themselves through the air in search of prey or to escape if they get too hurt.

entry: 它以机械强化的毒刺传播极其危险的瘟疫。是否仍拥有自己的意志，目前尚不清楚。
author: pepperthepirate
source: It spreads an incredibly dangerous plague with its mechanically augmented stingers. It is unclear whether or not this Pokémon has a will of its own.

entry: POKENAME双颚能切开钢梁，曾撕汽车，吃内部美味机械，因此巡护员尽量让它远离人居区。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's jaws can cleave through steel beams. It is known to rip apart cars to reach the delicious machinery inside, so Rangers try to keep POKENAME away from human-inhabited areas.

entry: POKENAME巨大金属身体，藏着复杂厚肌肉。尾部肌肉最密集，一挥就能压碎坦克。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have massive, metal bodies that conceal their intricate, thick muscles. Their tails have the densest concentrations of their muscles and can crush a tank with a single swing.

entry: POKENAME像节拍器般来回倾摆，机械地精准滴答。张翼平衡、自卫，保护身体免遭威胁，确保不乱节奏。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME mechanically tick to a precise rhythm while tilting back and forth like a metronome. They keep their wings extended for balance and defense, protecting their bodies from external threats to ensure they stay on beat.

entry: POKENAME头顶有发电器官，在水中推进时，能照亮前路。它们张开手掌，还能喷出更强的水柱，加速冲撞旁人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have an electrical organ atop their heads that serves to illuminate the paths ahead of them as they propel themselves through water. They can release stronger jets of water from their open palms to accelerate and ram others.

entry: POKENAME四脑，精确算出不露身形、潜入住宅的最佳办法。总有逃跑计划，几乎无法捉住。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's four brains allow them to expertly calculate the best ways to infiltrate a home unseen. These Pokémon always have an escape plan, making them nearly impossible to catch.

entry: 有研究认为，POKENAME没有灵魂。这结果是否可信，又意味着什么，常引起学界讨论。
author: imaginaryneon
source: Research has been done on POKENAME that suggests they do not have souls. The validity and implications of these results are often brought up in scientific discussions.

entry: POKENAME指挥与未知图腾融合的铁哑铃、金属怪。靠近下属，难料怪能量便似凭空浮现，仍在研究。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME commands over other Beldum and Metang that are fused with Unown. When POKENAME grows close to their subordinates, unpredictable and unusual energy emerges from seemingly nowhere; this energy is still undergoing study.

entry: 众多红眼让它看清四周，追踪任意数量敌人。闭壳护眼，便如移动破拆球，滚穿敌人与障碍。
author: infinex21
source: It can see all around itself with its many red eyes and track any number of foes. It can close its shell to shield its eyes as it rolls through foes and obstacles like a moving wrecking ball.

entry: POKENAME强颚铁牙能撕开岩石金属，大声碰撞威吓。却意外地谨慎精算，觉得赢不了，任何战斗都会逃。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's strong jaws and iron fangs can tear through rock and metal, and it will loudly clash them to intimidate foes. It is surprisingly cautious and calculating, and will flee any battle it doesn't think it can win.

entry: POKENAME智力高，能推算硬利双钳何时何处出击，战力惊人。有时自认主意更好，甚至违抗训练家。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's high intellect makes it formidable in combat, because it can always deduce exactly when and where to strike with its incredibly hard and sharp pincers. POKENAME will sometimes disobey its Trainer if it thinks it has a better idea.

entry: POKENAME投掷出众、智力无人能比，无法打败，因此被棒球运动禁赛。交叉角与精神力量，还能接住任何空中物体，更坐实禁令。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME have been banned from baseball, as their superb hurling skills and unmatched intelligence make them impossible to beat. Their crossed horn and psychic powers also let them catch any airborne object, further solidifying their ban.

entry: POKENAME背炮极准，数英里外也能击中，最常用于卡洛斯战争时期。
author: bigoljax
source: The cannons on the backs of POKENAME are incredibly accurate, able to hit targets from miles away. They were most commonly used during the Kalos War.

entry: POKENAME大脑处理信息极快，总能算出完美俯冲轨迹。钢喙尖鸣，召集同群。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's brain can process information at incredible speed, allowing it to always calculate the perfect trajectory for a dive. It emits sharp cries from its steel beak to call other members of its flock.

entry: 这只水中宝可梦射向猎物的“导弹”，其实是自带脑的身体部件。通过心灵感应连上本体脑，更好协调攻击。
author: infinex21
source: The "missiles" that this underwater Pokémon will launch at prey are actually parts of itself with their own brains. These brains are telepathically connected with the central body's brain to better coordinate the attacks.

entry: POKENAME鼻子虽尖，却不锋利，常直接俯冲撞敌。若失败，就迅速飞离，以精神力量推动金属羽，成阵轰击。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME will often use their pointed, albeit blunt, noses to strike foes by dive-bombing directly into them. If this fails, they will quickly fly away and barrage their opponent with their metal feathers propelled by their psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME光在旁，就足以让最凶水下宝可梦也迟疑。巨型劈刀挥得与自身移动同样快，迅速解决敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's presence alone is enough to give even the most aggressive of underwater Pokémon pause. The massive cleaver it holds can be swung with speed equal to its own incredible mobility, making short work of its opposition.

entry: 野生POKENAME住在地下深处，只有吃下大量稀有金属后才进化。似乎记得穿过的一切岩石，堪比百科，日后再遇立刻识别。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME live deep underground and only evolve after devouring large amounts of rare metals. POKENAME seem to have an encyclopedic memory of all the rocks they have tunneled through, and instantly recognize them if encountered again later.

entry: POKENAME封在铁壳里，靠喷高压气飞行。常撞东西或其他宝可梦，却似乎精算轨迹，让自己沿表面弹开，而非停下。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is sealed within an iron shell, but flies through the air by expelling pressurized gas. It often collides with objects and other Pokémon, but seems to calculate its trajectory so that it deflects off the surface rather than stopping.

entry: POKENAME身周沙暴磨亮金属皮。自信护甲保安全，就冲向猎物，压在身下，再刺入利牙。
author: .jerden
source: The sandstorm that POKENAME surrounds itself with polishes its metallic skin until it gleams. Confident that this armor will protect it, POKENAME charges towards prey to pin it beneath its body, then sinks in its sharp fangs.

entry: POKENAME上半身大多被巨脑占据，分析力极佳。仔细确定敌人弱点，再使出一切获胜所需的卑鄙手段。
author: .jerden
source: The upper half of POKENAME's body is mostly occupied by its large brain, giving it an excellent analytical ability. POKENAME will carefully determine its opponent's weaknesses, then take advantage of any underhanded trick it needs to win.

entry: POKENAME是高明的机械术士，能让任何机械设备服从意志。甚至附身其他机器，尽量制造混乱。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are advanced technomancers, able to bend any mechanical device to its will. It will even possess other machines to cause as much havoc as possible.

entry: 厚重的金属外壳，大大妨碍了POKENAME的敏捷。为弥补这点，它用超能力把敌人定在原地，再用锤状尾巴砸碎。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's agility has become greatly hindered by its thick, heavy metal exterior. To make up for this, it uses its psychic powers to hold foes in place so it can crush them with its hammerlike tail.

entry: 它的脑分散在身周无人机中。越专注，磁场就越强。
author: pokepower
source: Its brain is divided between the drones surrounding it. The more it concentrates, the stronger its magnetic field becomes.

entry: POKENAME先以强臂压住猎物，再用藤缠紧，挤力大到能压缩金属。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME hunt prey by pinning them down with their strong arms, then binding them with their vines. They can squeeze hard enough to compress metal.

entry: POKENAME铁甲身内有熔炉，热如太阳表面。能从手臂受控地轰出这份高热。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have an iron-clad body that contains a furnace that burns as hot as the surface of the sun. They can launch controlled blasts of this intense heat from their arms.

entry: POKENAME铁甲身内有熔炉，热如太阳表面。能从手臂受控地轰出这份高热。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have an iron-clad body that contains a furnace that burns as hot as the surface of the sun. They can launch controlled blasts of this intense heat from their arms.

entry: POKENAME体重使飞行笨重，滑翔却出奇熟练。住在崖边高峰，借高处跃出，以庞大身体撞击其他宝可梦或训练家。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Though cumbersome in flight due to its weight, POKENAME is a surprisingly adept glider. It lives near cliffsides and high peaks, using those to launch itself and use its bulk to barrel into other Pokémon or Trainers.

entry: POKENAME体表金属，让它穿行网络空间时，连最复杂恶意软件也能抵挡。可留在数字环境越久，防御越弱。
author: .izik
source: The metal covering POKENAME's body can withstand attacks from even the most complex malware as it travels through cyberspace. Its defenses grow weaker the longer it remains in digital landscapes.

entry: 众多尖刺轻松损伤淬火钢。它们手臂能举两倍自身体形的巨石，爪能将黑曜石打成细碎。
author: infinex21
source: Their many quills are sharp enough to damage tempered steel with ease. Their arms are strong enough to lift boulders twice their size, and their claws can pulverize obsidian into tiny pieces.

entry: POKENAME四肢出击速度与烈度，完全不像沉重外表。猛击地面，能造火柱，向对手施压。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's four limbs strike with speed and intensity belying its heavy weight and appearance. Striking the ground with enough force lets it create pillars of fire to put pressure on its opponents.

entry: POKENAME用身体部位投光，如舞台般吸引目光，聚向较小的血肉本体。敌人分心时，巨大浮肢便接连猛击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use parts of their bodies to project light like a stage that draws attention to their lesser, fleshy bodies. While opponents are distracted by this, they will bombard them with physical strikes loosed by their large, floating limbs.

entry: POKENAME颇像丰缘某位冠军。常见于洞穴与博物馆，检查石头、欣赏化石。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME look quite similar to a champion of Hoenn. They can be spotted in various caves and museums, examining the stones and admiring fossils.

entry: 外形近似巨金怪的超级进化。融合让POKENAME脑力体能有所提升，可两者增幅，都远不及真正超级进化。
author: fireblade141
source: This Pokémon's appearance resembles that of Metagross's Mega Evolution. The fusion has increased POKENAME's brainpower and physical capability somewhat, but both boosts pale in comparison to what true Mega Evolution provides.

entry: POKENAME放出花粉般的纳米机器，分析周围环境，借此在脑中构成三维战场地图。
author: kai____________
source: POKENAME expels pollen-like nanomachines to help analyze its surroundings. This process allows it to mentally visualize a 3D map of the battlefield.

entry: POKENAME极沉，海底歇着时几乎动不了。以精神力量引猎物靠近，再用多肢抓住、碾压下一餐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's extremely heavy weight makes it barely mobile while resting on the seafloor. It uses psychic powers to draw prey close enough for its many limbs to grab and crush its next meal.

entry: 下身太重，使它们难以在海底家园移动。POKENAME挥甩刺头，吓退捕食者，也凭蛮力制伏猎物。
author: infinex21
source: Their lower bodies are so heavy that they struggle to move along the ocean floor they live upon. POKENAME flail their spiked heads around to deter predators and to subjugate prey with brute force.

entry: POKENAME主要吃金属，躺在垃圾场废料堆旁，慢慢吞掉够得着的一切。若废堆塌压身上，铁皮足以保护，只须一路吃出去。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME mostly eats metal and lies next to piles of it in junkyards to slowly devour anything within reach. If the pile of scrap collapses on top of POKENAME, it will be protected by its durable iron hide and will simply eat its way out.

entry: 人类是否仿它们造潜艇，还是它们进化得像人类潜艇，仍有人争论。无论如何，野生POKENAME轻松穿水、跃水的景象，令人惊叹。
author: infinex21
source: Some still debate if humans based submarines off of these Pokémon or if these Pokémon evolved to resemble human submarines. Whatever the case, wild POKENAME are awe-inspiring sights as they propel through and out of water with ease.

entry: 沉重手臂支撑密实甲壳与背上强炮。它虽然慢，仍能打下鸟宝可梦与虫宝可梦来吃。
author: infinex21
source: Its heavy arms support the dense shell and powerful cannon atop its back. Although it moves slowly, it can shoot down bird Pokémon and bug Pokémon to prey upon.

entry: POKENAME自由控制强磁波，指挥随行铁哑铃。能力虽利战，也曾用来帮助平衡、行动困难的人。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME freely controls powerful magnetic waves and commands the Beldum that follow it. While these abilities make it useful in battle, POKENAME has also been used to aid those who struggle with balance and mobility.

entry: POKENAME与巨金怪同样聪明。锐利头脑与简单粗暴的战法形成反差：只是挥动笨重锤头，猛砸敌人。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME is just as intelligent as a Metagross. Its sharp mind constrasts with its blunt fighting style, which involves simply slamming its foe with its unwieldy hammer-head.

entry: POKENAME战术头脑，是融合体中最锐利的一批。尽量少动节能，好只凭一两记重击获胜。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses one of the sharpest tactical minds of any fusion. It prefers to move as minimally as possible, conserving energy so that it can seize victory with only one or two heavy blows.

entry: POKENAME能探测电活动。一有电，就将电流引向自己，充能加速。
author: rumia_archer
source: POKENAME is capable of detecting electrical activity. When electricity is present, it directs the current to itself as a means of charging its body to become faster.

entry: POKENAME甲身极强，承受敌人重击，再靠四颗复杂脑，智取反攻。
author: zaymcawesome
source: POKENAME has a very strong armored body. It takes powerful blows from foes and counters by outsmarting them with its four complex brains.

entry: POKENAME以带爪双翼翱翔高空，身后留下鲜红轨迹，因此有“赤色彗星”之称。
author: nyaarys
source: POKENAME's clawed wings leave bright red trails as it flies high in the sky. These trails have given this Pokémon its nickname, the Crimson Comet.

entry: POKENAME以巨大智力排最优日程，每天先尽量飞，再休息做别事。以大股火焰烧遍草场，赶猎物到开阔处，轻松饱餐。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its vast intelligence to plan the most optimal schedule to spend every day flying before needing to do other tasks like resting. It burns out entire grass fields in torrents of flames to drive prey out in the open for easy feasts.

entry: POKENAME的耳能感知磁波，便于更快找出惯常猎物：小磁怪与朝北鼻。
author: teatedtiten
source: POKENAME's ears are used for sensing magnetic waves. This allows them to find their usual prey, Magnemite and Nosepass, more efficiently.

entry: 即使最深最暗海底，也能看见它众多红眼发光。深海重压锤炼身体，成了极密金属形态，比许多精炼金属还强。
author: infinex21
source: Even within the deepest, darkest depths of the ocean, the many red eyes of this Pokémon can be seen glowing. The crushing force of the ocean depths have honed its body into a incredibly dense metallic form stronger than many refined metals.

entry: POKENAME大身多是肌肉，支撑极重强臂。手臂如巨风镐，能造成猛烈震动。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's large body is made mostly of muscle to support its incredibly heavy and strong arms. It can use its arms like giant jackhammers to create powerful tremors.

entry: POKENAME先用大金属臂固定地面，再全力开背炮。手臂看着虽重，却能折起身体，形成迅捷移动的姿态。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME uses its large, metal arms to secure itself to the ground before firing its back cannon at full power. Despite how heavy its arms appear, this Pokémon can fold upon itself into a form capable of swift movement.

entry: POKENAME体内有强力发电机，产生的大量电力储存在体表的“X”形部位。电荷蓄积到顶点时，“X”就会泛起鲜亮的蓝光。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's body contains a powerful generator that can produce vast quantities of electricity that are stored within the "X"-like part of its outer body. The "X" will glow a vibrant blue when it has reached the pinnacle of its electric charge.

entry: POKENAME双臂散出钢属性宝可梦喜爱的香气。引近后，以金属藤缠住碾压，拖回家，吸取养分。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's arms emit a scent pleasant to Steel-type Pokémon. Once they draw near, it ensnares and crushes them with metallic vines before dragging them to its home so it may drain them of nutrients.

entry: 看似大耳，其实是额外一对巨爪。想轻易欺负POKENAME，便会遭它猛力抓扯，才知握力有多惊人。
author: sk372
source: What appear to be large ears are actually an additional set of massive claws. Those that think POKENAME will be easily picked on will find a rude awakening when it makes to tear them apart with their claws' massive grip strength.

entry: POKENAME的四条金属手臂，出拳比高速列车还快。别与它对视，否则它会以为你在向它挑战。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can use its four metallic arms to punch faster than a bullet train. Do not make eye contact with it as it will see you as a challenge.

entry: POKENAME身周亮红等离子体发光，让它连接电子设备。智力如超级电脑，独自就能保工厂运行，毫无意外。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME glows with a bright red plasma around its body that allows it to connect to electronic devices. With the intelligence of a supercomputer, POKENAME can single-handedly keep factories running without any accidents.

entry: 两只聪明绝顶的宝可梦融合，让POKENAME智力无双。可它得不停施展念力，免得自己的凝胶，腐蚀支撑身体的金属腿。
author: voiddx01
source: As the fusion of two very intelligent Pokémon, POKENAME is unrivaled in intelligence. However, it has to constantly use its psychic powers to prevent its gel from damaging the metal legs supporting it.

entry: 它将足以破解人类最大谜团的5颗脑，全用来策划无害恶作剧。思考需通风足，否则过热，变得极蠢。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It dedicates its 5 brains, capable of solving humanity's greatest mysteries, entirely to scheming harmless pranks. It needs adequate airflow in order to think, or else it will overheat and become extremely dumb.

entry: 发达眼睛与大脑，让战斗在它眼中如同慢镜头。POKENAME每个动作，都精算、精准而残酷。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its highly developed eyes and advanced brain allow it to perceive battles in slow motion. Every movement POKENAME makes is calculated, precise, and brutal.

entry: POKENAME丝网由高导电金属构成，特别适合电击制伏被困猎物。少数能抵住电击的猎物，则会被力量惊人的钢爪碾压。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's webbing is made of a highly conductive metal, making it perfect for shocking captured prey into submission. The few who resist its electricity are crushed by POKENAME's massively powerful steel claws.

entry: POKENAME头上有四把锋利的钢刃，虽然短小，却能先用带刺的金属脚，将敌人钉在原地，再俯下身，高速旋转头部，发起劈斩。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has four sharp steel blades on its head. Although these blades are short, POKENAME can use its spiked metal feet to pin foes in place, then lean down to slash by spinning its head around at high speed.

entry: POKENAME金刃锋利，一下便能把巨石平整切两半。极细心抛光磨刃，若变钝或崩缺，甚至不肯开打。
author: infinex21
source: The golden blades of POKENAME's body are sharp enough to cleanly cut a boulder in two. POKENAME takes great care to polish and sharpen its blades and will even forgo battle if its blades become dull or chipped.

entry: POKENAME垂着的钥匙，每把敲响都不同。自左至右，声由几不可闻，逐渐强至震耳欲聋。
author: .izik
source: Each of the keys dangling from POKENAME's body produces a different noise when struck. From left to right, these range from nearly inaudible to ear-splitting.

entry: POKENAME贴地飘浮，金属翼由后方蓝焰托起。翅膀拍得越快，火就越热。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME floats just above the ground, its metal wings lifted up by the blue flames burning behind them. The faster POKENAME's wings beat, the hotter this fire burns.

entry: POKENAME像未来版火神蛾。铁翼能合拢，射出烈火束，瞬间闪得比太阳更亮。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME resembles a futuristic version of Volcarona. Its iron wings can join together to fire fiery beams at foes, briefly flashing brighter than the sun.

entry: POKENAME贴地飘浮，金属翼由后方红焰托起。火势一涨，还能像火箭般冲前。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME floats just above the ground, its metal wings lifted up by the red flames burning behind them. POKENAME can flare up this fire to launch itself forward like a rocket.

entry: POKENAME身旁有两架形似铁哑铃的浮无人机，派去寻猎物。定位后本体冲来，让无人机分散注意，靠得够近，再以金属爪攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is accompanied by two floating drones that resemble Beldum and sends them out to search for prey. After locating a target POKENAME rushes in, distracting it with the two probes until it gets close enough to attack with its metal claws.

entry: 它将巨大智力与金属状不定形身体结合，迅速适应多数战局。彗星拳最多两击，就能粉碎巨石。
author: infinex21
source: It combines its vast intellect with its amorphous body made of a metal-like material to quickly adapt to most combat scenarios. Its Meteor Mash attack can pulverize large boulders in no more than two strikes.

entry: POKENAME身披钢甲，用两条金属腿缓慢走动。平常摸着就热，快进化时更烧得通红，熔去自身甲，重塑新形。
author: .jerden
source: Encased in steel armor, POKENAME walks around slowly on its two metal legs. While it is always hot to the touch, POKENAME will glow red-hot when it is ready to evolve, melting its own metal armor to reform it into a new shape.

entry: 想在激烈竞争中立足，像样的珠宝店都会聘用POKENAME。可它们鉴得太细，倒霉的小碎钻，也常被摆上估价台。
author: merclipse
source: All jewelry stores worth their salt employ POKENAME to keep up with the competitive market. Due to their meticulous nature, however, an unfortunate Carbink finds its way onto an appraiser's table far too often.

entry: POKENAME每个体节，都有固态硬盘作脑。每盘镜像另一节硬盘的部分数据，因此某节离体，也不会丢数据。
author: musicsheep.
source: Each segment making up POKENAME's body contains its own solid-state drive acting as a brain. Each drive mirrors a fraction of another segment's drive so that no data is lost if a segment becomes separated from the whole body.

entry: POKENAME头边褶由金属羽构成，只比其他金属身体稍软。先以重臂压住猎物，再用强颚刺入钢牙。
author: .jerden
source: The frill around POKENAME's head is made of metallic feathers and is only slightly softer than the rest of its metallic body. POKENAME will pin down prey with its heavy arms, then use its strong jaws to sink in steel teeth.

entry: POKENAME巨颚撕金属板如撕纸，正适合钢铁饮食。野生个体最常见于废料场，贪婪吞食废金属。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's gigantic jaws shred metal plates like paper, which is useful to it as it survives on a diet of iron and steel. Wild POKENAME are most often found in junkyards, ravenously devouring scrap metal.

entry: POKENAME身体太小，容不下全部精神力量，叶片便不断向外散出。身材虽小，却比看起来重，身体坚韧，很耐打。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's leaves are always exuding the psychic power its body is too small to fully contain. In spite of that size, it is much heavier than it looks and its body is quite tough, meaning it can take quite a beating.

entry: 故事童话里，POKENAME帮炼金术师做药剂。现实中，则帮助研究者安全分析、处理有毒化学品。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Stories and fairy tales describe POKENAME aiding alchemists in making potions. In reality, POKENAME helps researchers with analyzing and handling toxic chemicals safely.

entry: POKENAME金属身不断滴黏液，隔热防锈。平常安静沉思，可四臂全能打出如子弹般又快又猛的重拳。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's metallic body constantly drips with slime, insulating it against heat and preventing it from rusting. While POKENAME is usually quiet and contemplative, its four arms can all deliver powerful punches that hit as hard and fast as bullets.

entry: 这种融合的金属身体有晶体结构，能挡许多攻击。若不定期晒太阳取暖，POKENAME就会僵硬易碎。
author: evilscarypurple
source: The crystalline structure of this fusion's metallic body allows it to withstand many attacks. If POKENAME does not regularly warm itself by basking in the sun, it will become stiff and brittle.

entry: POKENAME借连接身体的锁链，猛力甩动金属腿，大幅增强穿透力。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can use its connective chains to swing its metal legs with a lot of momentum, which greatly increases their penetrating power.

entry: POKENAME共有6条手臂和腿，跳舞时能自如互换用途。配合卓越思维，摆出狂放惊艳姿态，演出从未见过的即兴舞与舞风。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can comfortably use each of its 6 total arms and legs interchangeably when it goes to dance. Combining this with its superb thinking allows it to perform wild and stunning poses while executing never before seen freestyle dances and styles.

entry: POKENAME张开头部十字部位，散出加速钢属性宝可梦生锈的孢子。高智力究竟来自整体，还是只来自蘑菇，仍不清楚。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME open the cross on their heads to disperse spores that accelerate rusting on Steel-type Pokémon. It is unclear if their advanced intellect comes from their whole self or just the mushroom.

entry: POKENAME覆着互扣甲片，每战都更硬。很少费心闪躲，宁可直走向敌人，任攻击从护甲无伤滑开。
author: labreezy187
source: POKENAME is covered in interlocking plates that grow harder with every battle. It rarely bothers to dodge attacks, preferring to march directly toward its opponent while blows glance harmlessly from its armor.

entry: POKENAME每动一下，金属鳞便与铁身大声碰响。镀金银的鳞脱落后可卖高价，可要补回，也须吃等量贵金属。
author: .jerden
source: Every movement POKENAME makes causes its metallic scales to loudly clink against its iron body. These gold- and silver-plated scales can fetch a high price if shed, but POKENAME will need to eat the same amount of precious metal to replace them.

entry: POKENAME能用钢臂打上勾拳，或以尾如重锤砸下。突然动作，总伴着鳞片互击的响亮金属声。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can uppercut foes with its steel arms or bring its tail down on them like a sledgehammer. These sudden movements are always accompanied by the loud metallic sound of its scales clinking against each other.

entry: POKENAME先仔细观察敌人，再发起挑战，调整招式以应对其战法。多用粗臂格挡，一见空隙，也能以惊人速度挥击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will carefully observe foes before challenging them to battle, adapting its moves to counter their fighting style. It mostly uses its bulky arms to block attacks, but can swing them with surprising speed whenever it sees an opening.

entry: 它从肘刺周围喷水，推拳增强力道，足以将坚实钢块打皱。非战斗时冥想，回顾历经的许多战斗。
author: infinex21
source: It jets water from around its elbow spikes to propel its punches with enough force to crumple a block of solid steel. When it is not fighting, it meditates, contemplating the many battles it has fought.

entry: POKENAME全靠日光供能，打击足以夷平建筑。晴时储能，熬过一阵阵阴天。
author: josh707
source: Entirely fuelled by sunlight, POKENAME can strike with enough force to level buildings. It stores the energy obtained during sunnier spells to outlast spates of cloudy weather.

entry: POKENAME用磁性材料造杖，随意控制、反转磁极。造出的含铁卫星，发射速度快到足以穿透山体。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME constructs staves out of magnetic material, allowing it to control or reverse polarities at will. The ferrous satellites it creates can be flung fast enough to penetrate mountains.

entry: POKENAME压紧颈边液态金属，制成手里剑投敌。四颗脑，让它瞬间算出对手下一招。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME compress the liquid metal around their necks into shurikens, which they throw at their foes. These Pokémon have four brains, allowing them to calculate their opponent's next move in an instant.

entry: POKENAME压紧颈边液态金属，制成手里剑投敌。四颗脑，让它瞬间算出对手下一招。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME compress the liquid metal around their necks into shurikens, which they throw at their foes. These Pokémon have four brains, allowing them to calculate their opponent's next move in an instant.

entry: POKENAME以科技复现植物生长模式，对植物研究极珍贵。人们盼研究它，能帮助全地区保育、栽培植物。
author: thegreenscorpion
source: POKENAME utilize technology to replicate the growth pattern of plant life, making them invaluable for botanical research. It is hoped that studying POKENAME will assist in plant-life preservation and cultivation throughout the region.

entry: 小头形似铁哑铃，先探出土，为中央头侦察周围是否安全。战斗也如炮塔，能从眼中轰出精神能量。
author: fireblade141
