source: The smaller heads resemble Beldum and act as scouts for the center head by emerging from the soil first in order to check if the coast is clear. In battle, the smaller heads also serve as turrets, being able to fire psychic blasts from their eyes.

entry: POKENAME四脑需不断冷却，因此体内积起高压蒸汽。用高速拳击应对，让蒸汽从臂排出。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME build up high pressure steam within their bodies, caused by their four brains requiring constant cooling. They counteract this by punching at high speeds, causing steam to vent out their arms.

entry: POKENAME以惊人的速度，绕着对手奔跑，等待最佳攻击时机。一发现破绽，就向前使出强力的猛撞，借金属身体的全部重量，力争取胜。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME race around their opponents at incredible speed, waiting for the perfect moment to strike. When they spot an opening, they charge forward with a powerful Take Down, using the full weight of their metallic bodies to try and secure victory.

entry: POKENAME以精神能力感知错投邮件的目的地，地址写错也行。90%的时候能找到正确收信人，偶尔却只把信随便交给一个人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its psychic abilities to sense the intended destination of lost mail, even when incorrectly addressed. It successfully finds the right recipient 90% of the time, though occasionally it will simply hand the letter to a random person.

entry: 这种融合能完成极复杂任务，攻击范围大又精准。因此旧时决斗者流传：“绅士的比试里，不该有POKENAME。”
author: epping_forest
source: This fusion has a great capacity to fulfill highly complex tasks, performing attacks with great range and accuracy. This quality gave birth to the phrase "There should be no POKENAME in a gentleman's bout" among duelists back in the day.

entry: 它蛮力几乎无人能比，一拳就能粉碎近乎任何东西。金属身体，也极耐物理打击。
author: fireblade141
source: This Pokémon's raw physical power is nigh-unmatched. It can pulverize nearly anything with a single punch, and its metallic body is extremely physically durable too.

entry: POKENAME看任何肉，都能算出喷火该用的精确温度，让人安全食用。受伤时，以尾火焊住划痕，有效治愈。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is able to look at any meat and calculate the exact temperature it needs to breathe its flames to make it safe to eat for people. When it gets injured, it uses its tail torch to weld over the scratches, effectively healing them.

entry: POKENAME蹄部喷火，帮助越过障碍。意志极强、智力高，即使老练训练家，也须巨大耐心才教得动。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME fires bursts of flame from its hooves to aid it in vaulting over obstacles. It has an incredibly strong will and high intellect, making it a challenge for even veteran Trainers to train without immense patience.

entry: 腿底完全平坦，让POKENAME在平地滑得极快。以控火力制造或中断冲势，有幸目睹者能见灿烂景象。
author: adamzwill
source: The bottom surfaces of its legs are totally flat, allowing POKENAME to glide across flat terrain with incredible speed. POKENAME uses pyrokinesis to break and create momentum, resulting in a brilliant display for those fortunate enough to see it.

entry: POKENAME追猎迅捷的金属宝可梦，追到后以蹄火熔穿防御。与完全信任的骑手同行，便以精神力量连起双方心智，瞬间沟通。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME hunts other fast, metallic Pokémon, using the flames from its hooves to melt through their defenses once it runs them down. When paired with a rider it fully trusts, it psychically links their minds so communication is instantaneous.

entry: POKENAME全身是金属状物质，不知为何在多数温度都呈液态。科学家既无法定出成分，也无法复现。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's entire body is made of a metallic substance that is somehow liquid at most temperatures. Scientists have been unable to determine this material's composition or recreate it.

entry: 每条肢体都只执行收集原料的指令，再送到本体混合。许多厨师喜欢POKENAME在旁，借此创造新颖的食物组合。
author: adamzwill
source: Each limb follows a single-minded directive to gather ingredients to mix together inside the main body. Many chefs enjoy the presence of POKENAME for the purpose of creating new and exciting combinations of food.

entry: POKENAME把食物存在背上的坝里，需要其他同类帮忙维护。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME stores food in the dam on its back. It needs assistance from other POKENAME to maintain the dam.

entry: POKENAME用牙啃木，做手持武器。同种个体做法不一，有棍、剑、矛等多种类型。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gnaws down bits of wood with its teeth, forming it into a handheld weapon. The weapons made differ across the species, from clubs to swords to spears and many other types.

entry: POKENAME巧用啃出的木棍作武器，以高超技巧，迎战胆敢威胁水坝者。性情凶猛好斗，即使给食物也冷静不下。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME skillfully uses the sticks it gnaws as weapons, fighting with impressive technique against anyone who dares threaten its dam. Its temperament is fiercely combative, and it won't calm down even if offered food.

entry: 宝可梦对战时，POKENAME用多样踢法，让敌人踉跄。练习踢穿不同高度的木板，使连踢既难预测，又有力道。
author: quackquackattack
source: In a Pokémon battle, POKENAME employs a plethora of kicking techniques to stagger opponents. It practices kicking through wooden boards at various heights to keep its flurry of kicks unpredictable and forceful.

entry: POKENAME拳打原木练搏击，直到只剩木屑。有些受训后，能打出特定形状，主人便可将这些粗雕拿去卖。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME trains its fisticuffs by punching logs, chipping away until only splinters remain. Some have been trained to punch down wood into specific forms, after which the owner can sell the makeshift carvings.

entry: POKENAME见于废弃天然坝旁，吃腐木。产气极易燃，让有经营头脑的训练家想收集作燃料出售。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found around abandoned natural dams, feeding off the rotted wood. The gases it produces are highly flammable, leading some enterprising Trainers to try and harvest the gas as fuel to sell.

entry: POKENAME门牙永不停止生长，因此袋里带块木头，整天啃咬。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's incisors never stop growing, so it carries a piece of wood in its pouch and gnaws on it throughout the day.

entry: POKENAME没有能抬木的指头，仍帮大牙狸筑坝。吐出的黏墨如胶，让接起的原木更坚固。
author: sk372
source: Though it lacks the digits to help lift wood, POKENAME still helps Bidoof build their dams. It spits out a sticky ink that works as an adhesive, increasing the sturdiness of logs stuck together with it.

entry: 不知为何，POKENAME一见完工的大牙狸水坝就极好斗。迎头撞倒建筑，赶散里面的大牙狸。
author: sk372
source: For reasons unknown, POKENAME gets highly aggressive upon seeing completed Bidoof dams. It charges headfirst into the constructs in order to send them toppling and rout any Bidoof within.

entry: POKENAME出现在桌面虽无害，却有些烦人。忍不住将文件位置排成某种水坝，让用户的电脑一片混乱。
author: sk372
source: Although harmless, POKENAME's appearance on a desktop can be a bit of a nuisance. It's compelled to rearrange file locations into a dam of sorts, causing clutter and disarray for the computer's user.

entry: POKENAME爱用长刃与大门牙，把木雕成复杂形状。木雕师研究技巧，改善自己的手艺。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy carving wood into intricate shapes with their long blades and buck teeth. Woodcarvers study their techniques to improve their own craft.

entry: 少有人瞥见勤劳的POKENAME，因为更愿不被注意地帮忙。身边原木，会神秘地比平常轻。
author: quackquackattack
source: Few ever get a glimpse of the diligent POKENAME, as they prefer to help without being noticed. Logs around them mysteriously become lighter than normal.

entry: POKENAME以长尾集中精神力量，常念力拔树，为难以自行筑巢的宝可梦造巢屋。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME focuses its psychic powers through its long tail. It will often uproot trees with telekinesis to construct lodges for Pokémon who are having trouble building their own nests.

entry: POKENAME长颈能将原木举高、放好，帮助大牙狸筑坝。颈叶甜香，也让大牙狸快乐平静。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's long neck lets it hold and place wooden logs high to assist Bidoof in dam-building. The leaves around its neck make a sweet scent that keeps Bidoof happy and tranquil.

entry: 它是奇特的群居宝可梦，很少迁往仅有适量降雨的地区。完全干旱或大雨，又会令它烦躁。一离群，就高声叫。
author: bobosmith01
source: A curious pack Pokémon that rarely migrates to areas with only moderate rainfall; complete drought or heavy rain frustrates this Pokémon. It will let out a loud cry if separated from its pack.

entry: POKENAME压力下也平静，善判断局势。海滩有时请它配合救生员，从上空扫描海面，有急事便通知值勤者。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Even under stressful situations POKENAME remains calm and is adept at reading a situation. Beaches sometimes employ it alongside lifeguards to scan the sea from above, informing those on duty when there is an emergency.

entry: POKENAME采树果，存坝里准备过冬。冬天最后才吃萄葡果，因为讨厌酸食。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME forage for berries to stock up on winter supplies and store those berries in their dams. During winter, they leave Grepa Berries for last because they hate sour foods.

entry: POKENAME用柔软藻类垫巢屋，让住处舒适。长尾蜕下毛，就铺在苔藓上保暖。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lines its lodge with soft algae for comfort. It sheds fur from its long tail, layering it over the moss to keep warm.

entry: POKENAME夜里如节拍器般来回摆身。午夜突然啃断附近一棵树的所有枝杈，缘由不明。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rocks its body back and forth like a metronome at night. At midnight, it suddenly gnaws down every limb from a nearby tree for reasons unknown.

entry: POKENAME啃树枝筑巢。敌人太近，就先用催眠术使其入睡，再用爪带走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME constructs its nest from twigs gnawed off trees. If an enemy gets too close, it puts them to sleep with Hypnosis before carrying them away with its claws.

entry: POKENAME飞行时收集兰花，握在拳里，带去垫巢屋。这习惯让家里充满宜人花香。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers orchids in its fists while flying, using them to line its lodge. This habit fills its home with a pleasant aroma.

entry: POKENAME在坝的原木间织耐水丝网，加固结构。夜里水边设丝陷阱，捕捉杰尼龟等毫无戒心的猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME weaves water-resistant webbing between logs in its dam to reinforce the structure. At night, it lays silk traps near the water's edge to capture unwary prey like Squirtle.

entry: POKENAME牙齿有几英寸长，就能看见几小时后的未来。若觉坏事将至，却会无视征兆，继续啃木。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME can see an hour into the future for every inch its teeth are. If it senses something bad will happen, it will ignore this sign and continue to gnaw on wood.

entry: POKENAME僵站湖边，等水面浮现未来异象。羽毛像树，因此捕食者不会注意。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME stands stock-still on the edge of a lake, awaiting visions of the future on the water's surface. Its plumage looks like a tree, so predators don't notice it.

entry: POKENAME把木棍存进厚羊毛，留待后用。羊毛也不易沾水，很适合制衣。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME stores sticks inside of its thick wool coat for later use. The wool is also water-repellent, making it a good material for clothing.

entry: POKENAME沿河床飘行，找理想筑坝地点。会在附近种花籽，标记领地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats along riverbeds in search of ideal dam-building locations. It plants flower seeds nearby to mark its territory.

entry: POKENAME啃落过客头顶树枝，吓人一跳。若惊得掉东西，就迅速偷走，冲进树林。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gnaws off branches above passing travelers to startle them. If they drop anything in surprise, it quickly steals the item and dashes into the woods.

entry: POKENAME锯齿鳃如弓锯，用来锯木筑坝。化石让人推测，远古个体牙更大，或在鳃进化接手前，曾作同样用途。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's jagged gills resemble the teeth of a bow saw, which it uses to cut logs for dam building. Fossils suggest that ancient POKENAME had much larger teeth, possibly used for the same purpose before their gills evolved to take over the task.

entry: 有人说POKENAME迟钝、不察周围，也有人说它自信满满，笑对任何局面。牙齿轻易长回，因此嘴边几乎什么都啃。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although some have described POKENAME as generally dull and unaware, others have stated POKENAME has tons of confidence, taking any situation on with a smile. Its teeth regrow easily, so it nibbles on just about anything in reach of its mouth.

entry: POKENAME眼力锐，200英尺外也能看见球果树。俯冲以尖牙摘球果，再带飞回巢。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's keen eyesight allows it to spot Apricorn Trees from over 200 feet away. It swoops down, snatches Apricorns with its sharp teeth, and flies them back to its nest.

entry: 它一击能干净切开树干。野外睡觉，喜欢把头枕在啃过的原木上。
author: bobosmith01
source: It can chop cleanly through tree trunks in a single strike. When it sleeps in the wild, it likes to rest its head on a gnawed-on log.

entry: POKENAME对靠巢者假装友好。谁太近，就先咬一口，再夺走一件随身物，逃跑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME pretends to be friendly to those who approach its den. If someone gets too close, it bites them with its fangs before snatching one of their belongings and fleeing.

entry: POKENAME身上冒泡泥，比工业熔炉还热。爱啃火山附近烧过的树，灰也是食物之一。
author: .izik
source: The bubbling mud on POKENAME's body burns hotter than an industrial furnace. It enjoys gnawing on burnt trees near volcanoes, consuming the ash as part of its diet.

entry: POKENAME不断用两颗门牙啃穿树木，再以覆在身体上的酶消化。壳是消化木头产生的副产物，人们常见大群个体拦河筑坝。
author: notadoctor75
source: POKENAME constantly chews through trees and wood with its two front teeth, then digests them with the enzymes that cover its body. Its shell is a byproduct of the wood it digests, and large colonies of this Pokémon can be found damming up rivers.

entry: 即使当地少树，它也总能用现有材料筑坝。忙完一天施工，再挑木棍，送给帮忙的伙伴。
author: quackquackattack
source: Even when there are few trees in an area, it always finds a way to craft a dam out of what is available. After a day of construction, it sorts out sticks to give to its cohorts for helping out.

entry: POKENAME筑坝前，先以灵鼻探查捕食者。感到危险，就高速滚走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its strong sense of smell to detect predators before starting construction on a dam. If it senses danger, it rolls away at high speed to escape.

entry: POKENAME花大量时间，上网搜原木图片，堆在河流图前。若自觉懂技术，还会找流水声来播放。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spend much of their time scraping the internet for pictures of wooden logs to stack in front of an image of a river. If they feel particularly tech-savvy, they find and play sounds of flowing water.

entry: POKENAME勇敢得出人意料，吃草时什么都干扰不了。难被挑衅，又大吃植物，园丁把它当害兽。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME is surprisingly brave; nothing can disturb it as it grazes. Gardeners see them as pests since they aren't provoked as easily and feed extensively on their plants.

entry: POKENAME找小树，啃成练习木人。日夜训练，决心成为大斗士。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME finds small trees and gnaws on them to carve practice dummies. It trains day and night, determined to become a great fighter.

entry: POKENAME头刺适合雕木筑巢。留下的原木有奇妙凹纹，常被收集，高价出售。
author: just_a_few_thousand_crows
source: The spikes on the heads of POKENAME are adapted to carving wood for constructing dens. Logs left behind by POKENAME are often collected and sold for high prices due to their interesting grooves.

entry: POKENAME强尾剥树皮，灵巧得惊人。爱将原木堆成奇怪图案，研究者认为，也许是在玩。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its powerful tails to strip bark from trees with surprising dexterity. It enjoys stacking logs in strange patterns, which researchers believe may be a form of play.

entry: POKENAME夜里用泥，在巢屋附近塑出不动的自己，迷惑捕食者。若下雨，就赶紧回屋躲避。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME creates motionless copies of itself with mud near its lodge at night to confuse predators. If it begins to rain, it quickly retreats inside for shelter.

entry: POKENAME看着巢边旅人，兴奋模仿举止。为谢带来娱乐，会送上一捆捆新采细枝。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME watches travelers near its den and mimics their mannerisms with excitement. As a thank-you for the entertainment, it offers them bundles of freshly gathered twigs.

entry: POKENAME最常与吉利蛋群同住。用利门牙磨出浑圆白石，送给小福蛋。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are most commonly found living with groups of Chansey. It shapes perfectly round white stones with its sharp incisors and gifts them to Happiny.

entry: POKENAME的牙不断生长，便靠啃树磨短。有时，倒下的树会砸向自己，它们就蜷成球，承受压下的树干。
author: katieplaysgames
source: With teeth that are constantly growing, POKENAME will gnaw at trees to wear their teeth down. The falling trees will sometimes land on top of them, POKENAME curling up into a ball to endure the collapsing trunk.

entry: POKENAME每天只须浮水15分钟，就得全部所需养分。战时常因个小，被看作劣势一方，却能受许多打击，继续奋战。
author: wyattwintersoul
source: POKENAME only needs to float in water for 15 minutes a day to get all the nutrients it needs. In battle it is often predicted to be the underdog due to its small size, but it can stand up to quite a lot of hits and keep on fighting.

entry: POKENAME啃觉得美味的网页。啃得越多，整站故障越多。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gnaws on webpages it finds delicious. The more it gnaws, the more glitches appear across the website.

entry: POKENAME靠大门牙啃入树木，造自己的家，也朝树桩练强踢。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their buck teeth to carve into trees, which become their home. They practice their powerful kicks against tree stumps.

entry: POKENAME用大门牙与利爪砍树。与筑好坝的大牙狸合作，为自己搭大巢。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME cut down trees using their buck teeth and sharp talons to chop down trees. They partner with existing Bidoof dams to create a large nest for themselves.

entry: 严重洪水后，POKENAME将重石与碎屑踢到合适位置，改道水流。常陪救援人员前往灾区。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME kicks heavy boulders and debris into place to reroute the flow of water after severe floods. It often accompanies aid workers to impacted areas.

entry: POKENAME个头虽小，却极勇敢。即使该逃，也会面对最强敌。
author: bagumbothimble
source: Despite their small stature, POKENAME are incredibly brave. They will face the toughest of foes, even if they should run instead.

entry: POKENAME战时用臂上木刃攻防。偶尔还能见它想啃自己的肘。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME uses the wooden blades on its arms for attacking and blocking in battle. It's occasionally seen trying to nibble its own elbows.

entry: POKENAME在巢屋周围，从角滴下臭毒，吓退捕食者。若不听警告，就使出凶猛愤怒门牙。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drips a foul-smelling venom from its horn around its lodge to deter predators. If the warning is ignored, it attacks with a ferocious Super Fang.

entry: POKENAME变色能力部分连着大门牙。啃到什么，身体就慢慢变成其颜色。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's power to change colors is partially connected to its buck teeth. When it gnaws on something, its body will slowly shift hues to match whatever it is chewing on.

entry: POKENAME群同步活动，一起雕树。若有指令可循，利牙几乎能用木头造出任何东西。
author: .jerden
source: Swarms of POKENAME move in unison to carve up trees together. If given instructions to follow, their sharp teeth can construct practically anything out of wood.

entry: POKENAME有双脑，却全想着筑坝。能借精神力量悬空，主要用来在伐树前，先取下枝条。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has two brains, but both are completely focused on dam construction. It can float in the air using psychic power, and mostly uses this to remove branches from trees before felling them.

entry: POKENAME任何情况都平静。坝一破，水还在涌，就开始修；即使被冲走，木质身体也坚韧，顺流漂下不受伤。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME remains calm in all situations, so if a dam it builds bursts, POKENAME will start repairing it even as water is still pouring out. Even if it is swept away, its wooden body is too durable to be harmed as it floats downstream.

entry: POKENAME的门牙长得极快，便尽可能迅速地啃咬木头，控制牙齿的长度。未融合的大牙狸也会试着帮忙，送来许多原木，让它们啃咬。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have incisors that grow at a prodigious rate. They try to gnaw through wood as quickly as possible in order to keep them under control. Unfused Bidoof will try and help POKENAME, bringing them plenty of logs to chew on.

entry: POKENAME完成升华，达到真实形态。训练家若深望双眼，此后举止就再也不同。
author: westerlytrack45
source: POKENAME has ascended and reached its true form. Trainers that stare too deeply into POKENAME's eyes never act the same afterwards.

entry: POKENAME通常不从自己的石头里出来，除非感到附近有倒树。它才会完全现身，将木头啃到恰好适于筑坝，再退回原处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME generally does not come out of its stone unless it detects the presence of fallen trees nearby. It then emerges fully, gnawing the wood until it is perfectly shaped to fit into a dam, then retreats back from whence it came.

entry: 它讨厌冷，夏天用尖牙伐树，以木与泥造庇护所。冬季，POKENAME还会邀火属性宝可梦进来，多添暖意。
author: .jerden
source: It hates the cold, so it spends the summer cutting down trees with its fangs to build a shelter from wood and mud. In winter, POKENAME will try to invite in Fire-type Pokémon for extra warmth.

entry: POKENAME用土木墙拦河。坝中造隐蔽住处，囤亮物，只有秘密水下入口可进。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME dam rivers with walls of earth and wood. They hoard shiny objects inside a shelter that they build into this dam, accessible only through a secret underwater entrance.

entry: 头部突起能感知水下猎物。流线身体迅速逼近，再以大牙咬住。
author: .jerden
source: The protuberances on its head enable it to sense prey underwater. Its streamlined body enables it to swiftly approach prey, then bite down with its large fangs.

entry: POKENAME巨牙连钢也能啃穿，主要吃浮木与木质沉船。头脑虽简单，却无恶意。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: POKENAME have huge teeth capable of gnawing through even steel. Their diet consists mostly of driftwood and wooden shipwrecks. They don't have that much going on in their heads, but they mean no harm.

entry: POKENAME众多的森林，会有大片空地，本会长在那里的树，都被它们撞倒。聚起倒木，搭屋避风雨。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Forests with large populations of POKENAME have large open glades within them, the trees that would have grown in the glade having been rammed down by them. The fallen trees are pulled together to make shelters from the weather.

entry: POKENAME常懒躺筑坝的大牙狸身旁。虽然迟缓，也会猛掷附近物件，将树打倒，帮大牙狸造坝。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME often laze around close to Bidoof as they construct dams nearby. Despite being lethargic, POKENAME help with dam construction by hurling nearby objects into trees hard enough to topple them over for Bidoof.

entry: POKENAME飘在河岸墓地旁，无声观察。啃下开花树木的枝条，装饰坟墓。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats near cemeteries by riverbanks, silently observing the area. It bites off limbs from flowering trees to decorate graves.

entry: 大牙狸群被急流挡住，难以筑坝，POKENAME就游来暂拦水，方便施工。事后爱在新生大水域里戏水。
author: redmagecole
source: When groups of Bidoof have trouble building a dam due to rushing currents, POKENAME swims in to temporarily block the water for them to build. Afterwards, POKENAME enjoys splashing around in the newfound large body of water.

entry: POKENAME罕见，多现身大牙狸常住的湖边。以巨力将它们的坝，重塑成自己的模样，再神秘消失。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears rarely, usually in lakeside regions where Bidoof are common. Using its mighty powers, it reshapes dams that Bidoof have built into a facsimile of its own form, then vanishes mysteriously.

entry: POKENAME住在密林，啃倒树的树皮维生。毛常覆厚泥，长出小芽。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in densely forested regions, gnawing through the bark of fallen trees for sustenance. Their fur is often coated in dense layers of mud, with small sprouts of plant life growing from it.

entry: POKENAME在同类住处的河对岸建巢屋，友好相争。竞争让它们不断改善周围环境。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME builds lodges across the river from others of its kind, engaging in a friendly rivalry. This competition drives them to constantly improve their surroundings.

entry: POKENAME虽重，却很善泳。身体产特殊油，防止生锈。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is a good swimmer despite its weight. Its body produces a special oil that keeps it from getting rusty.

entry: POKENAME痴迷刻划木头与石块。凡是刻上自己印记的东西，都会凶狠地守住。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME obsessively carves wood and stone. It aggressively defends anything it has marked.

entry: POKENAME敲木、敲石，勤勤恳恳地筑巢；敲地，吓退来犯者；再敲水宝可梦，打来当食物。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME diligently pounds wood and stone to make its nest. It also pounds the ground to scare off invaders, and pounds aquatic Pokémon as their predator.

entry: POKENAME爱砸遇见的一切。锤形身体能狠狠撞地，常引发山崩与地震。
author: sottiwotti
source: POKENAME like to smash everything they come across. They are able to swing their hammer-shaped bodies so hard against the ground that they often cause landslides and earthquakes.

entry: POKENAME牙能啃穿最韧树皮。与伙伴筑坝时，以毛间伸出的毒角吓退威胁。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's teeth can gnaw through the toughest bark. It uses venomous horns protruding from its fur to ward off threats while building dams with its companions.

entry: 它用硬角标病树，表示不能作坝或巢。身体分泌毒，实验室合成这种毒，可用于制作治疗皮肤病的乳膏。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its hard horn marks diseased trees unusable for dams or dens. Its body secretes toxins that, when synthesized in a laboratory, can be used to create creams to treat skin conditions.

entry: POKENAME广被视为森林保护者，帮助无家宝可梦筑巢。天灾时，与人合作，确保周围宝可梦安全。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME are widely regarded as protectors of the forest, helping to build homes for Pokémon that don't have one. During natural disasters, POKENAME will cooperate with humans to ensure the safety of the surrounding Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME常陪大牙狸群筑坝，用缎带搬原木，也帮助疲惫个体放松休息。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is often found accompanying Bidoof groups in the process of making dams. It uses its ribbons to help move logs around, as well as helping relax tired Bidoof who need a rest.

entry: POKENAME啃木时，低吼猛烈。若被打断，就从炮里射出木刺。
author: .izik
source: While gnawing on wood, POKENAME makes an intense growling noise. If interrupted, it will fire splinters from its cannon.

entry: POKENAME是夜行林居宝可梦。满月时，牙会发光，变干净，并修复损伤。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a nocturnal woodland Pokêmon. When the moon is full, its teeth begin to glow, becoming clean and repairing any damage to them.

entry: POKENAME啃自己的木手，雕成武器。木定期长回，因此能不断造出新类型。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME carves weapons for itself by gnawing at its wooden hands. The wood regrows regularly, allowing for the creation of new weapon types.

entry: POKENAME能附身任何木制物，完事便把木吃掉，是颇烦人的害兽。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME has the power to possess anything made of wood. It devours the wood when it's done, which makes it quite the pest.

entry: POKENAME火焰发出营火般的光与烟味。林中迷路旅人有时循着走，误认自己的营地，反而迷得更深。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's flame emits the light and smoky scent of a campfire. Travelers lost in the woods sometimes follow it, mistaking it for their own campsite, and end up even more lost.

entry: POKENAME爱带木雕工具，可太小太弱，多数拿不动。训练家便送微缩工具，让它远离正常大小的工具。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME loves to carry woodcarving tools. It's too small and weak to hold most types of tools, however, so Trainers gift them with miniature tools to keep them away from the full-sized ones.

entry: POKENAME视力差，常卡在狭窄洞道。靠探险者帮忙，事后兴奋地咬一口道谢。
author: mepp.
source: Due to POKENAME's poor eyesight, it finds itself getting stuck in narrow cave passages. It relies on explorers for help and thanks them with an excited bite.

entry: POKENAME高速飞行，四处收木，帮大牙狸筑坝。有时没意识到，竟偷别的大牙狸的木，帮助眼前这群。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flies at high speeds, zooming about to gather wood to help Bidoof build their dams. Without realizing, it sometimes steals the wood from other Bidoof to help the current Bidoof it's helping.

entry: POKENAME往原木拍泥，加固巢屋。完工就在屋顶种花，作最后点缀。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slaps mud onto logs to reinforce its lodge. Once its home is complete, it plants flowers on the roof as a finishing touch.

entry: 野生POKENAME很少抵抗。即使陌生人，大摇大摆进入栖地，抱起带走，它也不扑腾一下。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME never puts up much of a fight in the wild. Even an unfamiliar human could waltz right into its habitat, pick one up, and carry it away without so much as a flail from POKENAME itself.

entry: 野生POKENAME很少抵抗。即使陌生人，大摇大摆进入栖地，抱起带走，它也不扑腾一下。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME never puts up much of a fight in the wild. Even an unfamiliar human could waltz right into its habitat, pick one up, and carry it away without so much as a flail from POKENAME itself.

entry: POKENAME是夜间猎手，可独猎，也可群猎。长嚎后更专注，可能采用各种独特罕见的猎法。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a nighttime predator that may either hunt independently or in a group. When it howls, its concentration sharpens, and it may begin employing a variety of unique and uncommon hunting strategies.

entry: POKENAME吃倒树，不断维护厚木壳。却极怕火，一见火属性宝可梦便逃。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's thick wooden shells are constantly maintained by consuming fallen trees. However, these Pokémon are incredibly susceptible to fire, fleeing at the first sight of a Fire-Type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME悬在筑坝大牙狸旁，缓缓旋转，分析收来的木。觉得结构不合格，就射出前齿轮，将原木绞毁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hovers near Bidoof building dams, rotating slowly as it analyzes the wood they gather. It fires the front gear to shred and destroy logs it deems structurally unworthy to be a part of the dam.

entry: 它时不时就会发呆，此时火焰便渐渐暗下。若没人及时叫醒，火焰就会完全熄灭。
author: skymaster426
source: It has a habit of spacing out from time to time. When it does, its flame slowly dims, and if not snapped out of the trance, it will burn out entirely.

entry: POKENAME可爱，歌声安抚，因此深受家庭欢迎。助人本能强，长期结伴已被证实能减少悲伤。
author: ghostslythe
source: Between its cute looks and calming singing voice, POKENAME is a popular Pokémon for families. It has a highly developed drive to help other creatures, and long-term bonding with it has proven to reduce sadness.

entry: POKENAME在花丛旁安家，享受芳香。晒太阳受扰，就想咬闯入者，或用原木般的臂拍打。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its home near posies, enjoying their fragrant scent. If disturbed while basking in the sunlight, it attempts to bite intruders or swat them with its log-like arms.

entry: POKENAME虽失明，嗅觉却极敏感，察觉附近树干，熟练穿飞树林。通常害羞耐心，受威胁却咬得凶。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite being blind, POKENAME flies skillfully through forests thanks to its highly sensitive sense of smell, which lets it detect nearby tree trunks. Usually shy and patient, it bites fiercely if threatened.

entry: POKENAME能搬最重达自身体重10倍的原木。因此伐木村常作宠物养，帮助运材。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME can carry logs up to 10 times their weight. Because of this, they are often kept as pets in logging villages to help with transporting lumber.

entry: POKENAME吐小火，让树枝松脱，再拿来筑巢。闯入者接近，便振翼卷起强风警告。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits tiny flames to loosen tree limbs, then uses them to build its nest. If intruders approach, it flaps its wings to whip up strong winds as a warning.

entry: POKENAME用木棍造家。极危急时，放出足够热量，点燃整座家，灼烧敌人。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME constructs a home for itself out of sticks. When in grave danger, it emits enough heat to set its home ablaze, burning its enemies.

entry: POKENAME有时一口把粗木咬成碎片，帮上大牙狸。可并不帮筑坝，只是想破木，满足攻击冲动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sometimes assists Bidoof by shattering thick logs into splinters with a single bite. It does not help with building dams, only wanting to break wood to satisfy its aggressive urges.

entry: POKENAME极适合迅速滑游水中，强牙连钢铁与猎物都能撕开。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME is extremely well suited for gliding through water swiftly. Its powerful teeth can shred through steel and prey alike.

entry: POKENAME清晨啃断树，睡前再附身树桩。为何偏爱树桩胜过完整树木，研究者仍不明白。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME chews through trees in the morning, then possesses the stumps before sleeping. Why it prefers stumps over whole trees remains a mystery to researchers.

entry: POKENAME慈爱照看所有林居宝可梦。即使大牙狸啃它的树皮，也毫不介意。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME kindly watches over all forest dwelling Pokémon. It is so benevolent that it pays no mind when Bidoof gnaw on its bark.

entry: POKENAME勤奋，不断用翼清洁。野外尽力扫大牙狸的木屋，却似乎更开心把人类房屋收拾得干净整齐。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is very industrious, and constantly uses its wings to clean. In the wild they try their best to clean the wooden shelters built by Bidoof, but they seem to be much happier keeping a human house spotless and tidy.

entry: POKENAME有一身厚毛，能在冬季保暖。可夏天若不换毛就会热得受不了，因此脱下的毛，重量超过自身体重的四分之一。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a thick fur coat that retains warmth during the winter. During the summer, they shed more than a quarter of their weight in fur, as the weather conditions are otherwise too hot for them.

entry: 它住河里，吃游进嘴的鱼宝可梦。人一碰POKENAME，就会不由自主，把更多木棍堆在它身上。
author: hophoppip
source: It resides in rivers, consuming fish Pokémon that swim into its mouth. If a human touches POKENAME, they will be compelled to pile more sticks on its body.

entry: POKENAME身上生长的真菌，木质素含量极高，质感十分像木头。为了供养这些真菌，它主要寻找树皮作为食物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The fungus growing on the body of POKENAME is remarkably high in lignin. This gives it a very wooden texture. In order to fuel the growth of these fungi, POKENAME will seek out tree bark as its primary food source.

entry: 野生POKENAME给迷路大牙狸当临时住处。捕食者一近，就向威胁高速发射木棍。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: In the wild, POKENAME function as temporary homes and shelter for lost Bidoof. If a predator comes near, POKENAME will launch sticks at high velocity towards the threat.

entry: POKENAME感到训练家难过，就啃断树枝，当玩具送上。摇着短尾，讨一场抛物捡回游戏，想逗开心。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME senses when its Trainer is sad and chews off a tree branch to offer as a toy. It wags its stubby tail and requests a game of fetch to cheer them up.

entry: POKENAME飘在湖滨，白天睡、夜间活动。若梦见自己变大牙狸，是它恰在你熟睡时从身旁飘过。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats around lakefront areas, sleeping during the day and being active at night. If one dreams about becoming a Bidoof while they sleep, it's because POKENAME floated past them during their slumber.

entry: POKENAME吃枯木与其他植物，将木质素纳入身体，造出兼作伪装的保护皮。偏爱死木，也让它易受真菌感染。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feed on dead wood and other plant matter, incorporating the lignin into their body to create a protective skin that doubles as camouflage. Their preference for dead wood leaves them vulnerable to fungal infection.

entry: POKENAME极胆小，通常藏在大牙狸与大尾狸的坝里，很少见。有时成群背运倒树，帮忙筑坝。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME is incredibly timid and rarely seen since it typically hides within the dams of Bidoof and Bibarel. Sometimes a group of POKENAME will help build dams by ferrying fallen trees on their backs.

entry: POKENAME不知疲倦，重种过采的小树林。收集附近树种的坚果、种子，随意种在空地，盼能重成森林。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME work tirelessly to replant tree groves that have been over-harvested. They gather the nuts and seeds of nearby tree species and plant them haphazardly in open spaces in the hopes of reforesting the area.

entry: POKENAME锯状双臂，极善伐木。给一百根原木，一小时内便能把每根锯成四等份。
author: hophoppip
source: Its saw-shaped arms make POKENAME an excellent woodcutter. If given a pile of one hundred logs, it will saw them all into quarters within an hour.

entry: POKENAME用圆大眼睛向训练家卖萌，想多讨点心。借硬毛里困住的杂质，以毒粉巧妙令敌人中毒。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its big round eyes to look adorable to its Trainer, hoping to earn extra treats. It cunningly poisons enemies with Poison Powder, drawing on impurities trapped within its bristly fur.

entry: POKENAME用魔杖的火焰，标记计划砍来筑坝的树，免得日后忘记。它性情格外勇敢，为守护家园，连最强的敌人也敢迎战。
author: fiordaliso
source: With the flames emitted from its wand, POKENAME marks the trees it plans to cut down to build its dam, so it doesn't forget them later. It has a particularly brave nature and will fight even the strongest foes to defend its home.

entry: POKENAME编排激舞，配合细枝喷出的长水流。舞蹈帮助专注、进入冥想，增强本已强大的预言能力。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME choreograph intense dances that incorporate long streams of water issuing from their twigs. These dances serve as a focus for them, facilitating a state of meditation that empowers their potent prophetic abilities.

entry: POKENAME珍爱围巾，沾污就去河里清洗。寻找好坝址时，会把围巾伸进流水，测试流势。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME adore their scarf and can be seen cleaning it in rivers if it gets stained. To find good locations for dams, POKENAME places its scarf into running water to test the water flow.

entry: POKENAME在巢屋旁种南瓜田，标记领地。夜里蜷进南瓜间睡觉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME plants pumpkin patches around its lodge to mark its territory. At night, it curls up and sleeps among the pumpkins.

entry: POKENAME善用牙，在木上雕脸。许多人欣赏手艺，住木屋的却不在其中。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME are skilled at carving faces into wood with their teeth. Their skills are appreciated by many, though those with wooden houses are not among them.

entry: 它滚上岸晾干，漂浮树桩的传闻也就不攻自破。拟态太真，飞行属性宝可梦常落在背上，梳理自己的翅膀。
author: quackquackattack
source: Rumors of floating tree stumps were debunked when it rolls onto the shore to dry off. It is so convincing as a tree stump that Flying-type Pokémon rest on its back to preen its wings.

entry: POKENAME凶猛护巢，以强力的“踢倒”击昏闯入者，再抛入近河，任其漂下游。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME aggressively defends its lodge, knocking out intruders with a powerful Low Kick. It then hurls them into a nearby river to be carried downstream.

entry: POKENAME一听流水声，就莫名暴怒，想尽办法拦住溪河。常因此扯倒树木，造临时坝。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME grow irrationally angry at the sound of running water, seeking to stem the flow of streams and rivers in whatever way they can. This often results in them tearing down trees and creating impromptu dams.

entry: POKENAME不懈工作，深受伐木工欢迎。用强臂打树干，推倒作木材。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular amongst lumberjacks for their tireless work ethic. They use their powerful arms to strike tree trunks, toppling the trees to be used for lumber.

entry: POKENAME除了睡，醒来偶啃木棍，几乎不做别事。野外行为迟钝、不擅战，许多人拿它比鲤鱼王。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME doesn't do much of anything except sleep and occasionally nibble on some sticks whenever it is awake. Its dull behavior and lack of battling skill in the wild have caused many to compare it to Magikarp.

entry: POKENAME以众多触手，迅速拼海中漂流物筑坝。完工便坐上面，悠闲向过船挥手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its many tentacles to quickly put together dams using flotsam gathered from the ocean. It sits atop the finished construct and idly waves at any ships passing by.

entry: POKENAME在河边啃木筑坝，生活田园安闲。罕见时，尾钓上大舌贝，进化前便会有片刻清明。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have idyllic lives near rivers where they chew on wood and make dams. On the rare occasion that their tail fishing captures a Shellder, they experience a moment of lucid clarity before evolution.

entry: POKENAME啃咬周围的植物，做成随身带着的棍子。这些棍子不用来战斗，而是挥舞着相互比试，看谁的最大。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME gnaw at the plants in their environment to create sticks that they can carry with them. They don't use the sticks for fighting, instead waving them about in competition with others to see who has the largest stick.

entry: POKENAME啃咬周围的植物，做成随身带着的棍子。这些棍子不用来战斗，而是挥舞着相互比试，看谁的最大。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME gnaw at the plants in their environment to create sticks that they can carry with them. They don't use the sticks for fighting, instead waving them about in competition with others to see who has the largest stick.

entry: POKENAME在海里简单安宁地生活，猎鲤鱼王，在海滩打盹。啃冲上岸的浮木磨牙，再回海捕食。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live simple, halcyon lives in the sea where they hunt Magikarp and take naps on the beach. They chew on driftwood that arrives on shore to sharpen their teeth before returning to hunt in the sea.

entry: POKENAME大部分身体由木浆构成。刚啃过大木块，有时能见木刺从身上扎出。
author: hophoppip
source: A large proportion of POKENAME's body consists of wood pulp. When it's just chewed on a large piece of wood, splinters can sometimes be seen sticking out from it.

entry: POKENAME似乎不懂，光待着就会让房间充满污脏、带尘的气，即使直说也没用。有人推测，野生个体由天真健忘的孩子之魂诞生。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME doesn't seem to realize that its mere presence can fill the room with filthy, dirt-laden gas, even if it is told this directly. Some theorize wild POKENAME were birthed by the spirits of innocent and forgetful children.

entry: POKENAME似乎不懂，光待着就会让房间充满污脏、带尘的气，即使直说也没用。有人推测，野生个体由天真健忘的孩子之魂诞生。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME doesn't seem to realize that its mere presence can fill the room with filthy, dirt-laden gas, even if it is told this directly. Some theorize wild POKENAME were birthed by the spirits of innocent and forgetful children.

entry: POKENAME尽职尽责，或许还有点呆，总会不知疲倦地完成自己找来的活：巡视一片区域，为朋友采集树果，或是试着做些好玩的东西，拿给森林里的伙伴们炫耀。
author: bobosmith01
source: Dutiful and perhaps a little dumb, POKENAME tirelessly works in a self-assigned manner: patrol an area, gather Berries for friends, or try to create something fun to show off to its forest buddies.

entry: POKENAME会在夜里悄悄靠近大牙狸的水坝，吃掉里面熟睡宝可梦的梦。随后，它会啃咬水坝外侧的几根木头，标记自己已经在这里吃过梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sneaks up to Bidoof dams at night and eats the dreams of the Pokémon sleeping within. It then gnaws on some of the outer logs of the dam, marking the dam as one it has successfully eaten from.

entry: POKENAME会从球茎状石头的上下两端同时现身。抵御危险时，形似妙蛙种子的那部分会从口中伸出幽灵般的藤蔓。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME emerges from both the top and bottom of its bulb-shaped stone. When it fends off danger, ghostly vines will emerge from the mouth of the part of it that resembles Bulbasaur.

entry: POKENAME的楔石会在树枝间缓缓挪动，寻找可食的叶子。它会从触角释放点点幽灵能量，吓退可能来袭的敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's keystone shuffles slowly among the tree branches as it searches for leaves to eat. It generates bits of ghostly energy from its antennae in order to ward off potential attackers.

entry: POKENAME脾气暴躁，随时都可能爆炸。爆炸会散播幽灵般的瘴气，给植物和野生动物带来种种奇异的影响。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a volatile temper and may explode at any given moment. Its explosions spread out a ghostly miasma that can cause a myriad of strange effects on plants and wildlife.

entry: POKENAME被束缚在一块刻满纹样的奇异球状楔石上。历史学家认为，最早的精灵球或许就是从中获得了灵感。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME is bound to a strange orb-shaped keystone covered in engravings.  Historians believe this may have inspired the first Pokéballs.

entry: POKENAME的每颗头都能在那些灵体球之间转移，快速切换使对手眼花缭乱。不战斗时，每颗头都会不停歌唱，通常被形容为低沉而诡谲的拟声即兴吟唱。
author: bigoljax
source: Each one of POKENAME's heads can swap between its ethereal orbs, causing its opponent to be bewildered due to the rapid switching. Each head constantly sings outside of battle, usually described as deep, haunting scatting.

entry: POKENAME原产于阿罗拉地区，常在热门的墓园附近徘徊。若吃下它的果实，很快就会生病。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are native to the Alola region, often roaming around popular graveyards. If you eat one of its fruits, you will find yourself ill soon after.

entry: POKENAME会利用先辈的遗骨，强行召来它们的亡灵助战，丝毫不顾先辈是否愿意。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME uses the bones of its predecessors to call upon their spiritual aid in battle, though it's against their will.

entry: POKENAME受到近乎致命的伤害时，会退回头骨内。伤势片刻便会稳定下来，但在恢复足够的能量之前，它都不肯再战。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME retreats within its skull when it sustains near-fatal damage. It stabilizes within moments but will refuse to fight again until it has recovered enough energy.

entry: POKENAME完全显形时，会用楔石充当双脚。它的踢击威力十足，却总因担心损坏珍贵的楔石而略微留力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's keystones act as its feet when it manifests fully. Its kicks pack quite the punch, but it always holds back slightly for fear of damaging the precious keystones.

entry: POKENAME由108名拳击手的灵魂组成。结合各个灵魂的长处，它便能适应任何战斗风格。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME is comprised of the spirit of 108 boxers. By combining the strengths of each of the spirits, it can adapt to any style of battle.

entry: POKENAME味觉敏锐，却又忍不住舔舐眼前的一切，常被过强的味觉刺激弄得难以承受。被它舔到的宝可梦会骤然感到一阵寒意，仿佛它的舌头径直穿过了自己的身体。
author: bigoljax
source: Due to POKENAME having a strong sense of taste, it can frequently overwhelm itself because of its urge to lick anything it sees. When it licks another Pokémon, a sudden chill comes over them, as if POKENAME's tongue went straight through them.

entry: POKENAME会定期从楔石中呼出一小团自身的幽灵躯体。这些灵体能量消散时，能隐约听见它叫声的回响。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME regularly sends out little puffs of its own ghostly body from its keystone. As the puffs of spectral energy dissipate, one can faintly hear an echo of POKENAME's cry.

entry: POKENAME会从栖身的石茧中探出一部分身体，查看四周。感到危险时，它会伸出一缕灵体能量，将自己牵引到树冠上。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME partially pokes out from the stone cocoon it inhabits to check its surroundings. It extends a thread of spectral energy to reel itself up to tree canopies if it feels it is in danger.

entry: POKENAME会释放类似饱腹薰香的气味，那是浓重的化学混合气体，会让人昏昏欲睡。它们的集体意识由工厂工人产生的有毒蒸气形成。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release an aroma similar to Full Incense, a heavy and dense concoction of chemicals that makes people lethargic. Their collective consciousness is formed from the noxious vapors produced by factory workers.

entry: 多年来，遭污染摧残而荒废的灵异场所常有目击POKENAME的报告。栖居在它体内的灵魂显形时，近处的一切都会逐渐失去呼吸的能力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sightings have been linked to spiritual locations wracked and ruined by pollution over the years. When the spirits inhabiting the body manifest, anything in close proximity begins slowly losing the ability to breathe.

entry: POKENAME头脑简单，只要察觉楔石前方有东西移动，便会作出攻击性的反应。它的幽灵形体会操控石像，试图冲撞眼前经过的任何东西。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's simple mind responds aggressively to movement detected in front of its keystone. Its ghostly form takes hold of the statue and attempts to charge down whatever it sees passing by.

entry: POKENAME的身体模仿了钻角犀兽玩偶的样子；这种玩偶原本用于道场，代替沙袋。它不断让身体受损来增强体魄，甚至为了提高物理防御而滚下悬崖、引发山崩。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's body mimics a Rhydon doll, originally meant for dojos to act as substitutes for punching bags. It strengthens its body by constantly damaging it, tumbling down cliffs and causing rockslides just to increase its physical defense.

entry: POKENAME的腹袋里装着看似石头的东西，其实是一种独特的蛋，它很乐意与别人分享。这些蛋吃起来十分酥脆，营养也确实极为丰富。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries in its pouch what look like stones, but are actually a unique kind of egg it is delighted to share with others. While very crunchy, they are indeed extremely nutritious.

entry: POKENAME由108根藤蔓组成，环绕着一块奇异的楔石并保护它。若有藤蔓被扯下，断离的部分会消失，几秒后又回到它身上。
author: bobogagabobo
source: POKENAME is a mass of 108 vines that surround and protect an odd keystone. If a vine is removed, the detached part disappears and reappears back on POKENAME after a few seconds.

entry: 意面厨师会饲养POKENAME，让它试吃。若意面没煮熟或煮过了头，它就会轻轻拍打厨师108下。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are kept by pasta chefs as taste testers. If the pasta they try is either undercooked or overcooked, POKENAME will gently slap the chef 108 times.

entry: POKENAME显形时有个奇特之处：部分身体会化成一个有独立意识的孩子。尽管两者实际上共用一副身体，孩子有时还是会闹着玩，试图从家长身边溜走。
author: sk372
source: A strange quirk in POKENAME's manifestation causes part of it to take the form of a child with its own unique sapience. The child will sometimes try to playfully escape the parent, despite the two technically sharing a body.

entry: POKENAME会吹出发光的幽灵气泡，照亮周围幽暗的深海。气泡很快便会回到体内，因此它必须保持规律的节奏，才能让周围一直亮着。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will blow glowing ghostly bubbles to illuminate the dark ocean depths around it. The bubbles return to its body shortly, so it must keep up a regular rhythm in order to keep its surroundings lit.

entry: 有一种流传甚广的迷信说法：若从海滩带走形状古怪的石头，就会遭这种宝可梦诅咒。
author: lydiaprower8
source: There is a common superstition that if you take odd-shaped stones from beaches, this Pokémon will put a curse on you.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，灵体能离开碗最远10英尺。此时它能朝各个方向战斗，但范围仅限灵体所及之处。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: While sleeping, POKENAME's spectral body is able to travel up to 10 ft from its bowl. During this time it can fight in all directions, but only as far as its spectral form can reach.

entry: POKENAME虽外表可怕，却因空灵的气息能安抚其他鱼类宝可梦，而很受养鱼者欢迎。这使平时具有捕食习性的种类也能养在一起。
author: qinshanu
source: Despite its fearsome appearance, POKENAME is popular among fish keepers due to its ethereal aura that calms other fish Pokémon. This allows normally predatory species to be kept together.

entry: POKENAME藏身于铁甲蛹的群落中，通常栖息在它们悬挂的树枝上方。它会显形保护同伴，用翅膀将麻痹孢子撒向潜在的捕食者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides among Metapod colonies, typically resting in the upper branches of trees the latter dangle from. It manifests in defense of its brethren, spreading paralyzing spores with its wings onto potential predators.

entry: POKENAME会从偶尔能在海底找到的宝石中现身。若看见宝石内有幽灵能量盘旋，就知道其中住着一只POKENAME。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME emerges from a jewel sometimes found at the bottom of the ocean. One can tell when the jewel houses a POKENAME due to the swirling ghostly energy seen within.

entry: POKENAME会从嵌在石质身体中的绿宝石发射灵体光束，扰乱敌人。它漂浮的球体让水手十分恐惧，担心遭到诅咒，因而避免驾船靠近它。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME confuses its enemies by firing spectral beams from the green gem embedded in its stone body. Its floating orbs terrify sailors, who avoid boating near this Pokémon for fear of being cursed.

entry: POKENAME会从栖身宝石的裂隙中升起。有人说，它是许多死去的宝石海星的灵魂汇聚于一颗宝石后形成的。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rises up from the cracks within the gem housing it. Some say it is a combination of the spirits of many fallen Starmie gathered into a single jewel.

entry: POKENAME似乎变得更加油腻自恋。不过缺点归缺点，它给朋友做的披萨，味道可真不差。
author: kai____________
source: POKENAME appears to have taken on a more greasy and narcissistic persona. Despite its failings, it can cook a mean pizza for those it deems friends.

entry: 训练家若毫无防备地靠近楔石，POKENAME便现身，以隐形屏障困住。灵魂被吸走前，最后听见的，据说只有一阵阴森笑声。
author: teatedtiten
source: When unsuspecting Trainers get too close to the Odd Keystone, POKENAME emerges, trapping them with invisible barriers. Supposedly the last thing they hear is a dark, haunting laugh as their soul becomes absorbed.

entry: POKENAME大多时间都待在楔石外，将周围的草修剪整齐。有些更勤快的个体甚至开始钻研栽培树果的技艺。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often spends most of its time outside its keystone, where it keeps the grass around it freshly cut. Some more industrious members of this species have even taken to the art of cultivating berries.

entry: POKENAME的石质身体会以催眠般的方式振动，引得别人紧盯着它。这些注视给它提供显形的能量，使它开始起舞，进一步控制受其奴役的对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's stone body vibrates in a hypnotic way to compel others to stare at it. Their stares feed it the energy to manifest and begin dancing in a way that grants it further control over its thralls.

entry: POKENAME会潜伏在变电站下方，等待工人下班离开。随后，它便钻出地面产生电力，试图熔化支撑输电塔的金属杆，盼着将塔弄倒。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME waits beneath utility substations, waiting for workers to clock out and leave. It then comes out of the ground, generating electricity and attempting to melt down the metal bars that hold up transmission towers, hoping to knock them down.

entry: POKENAME藏在煤矿里，吐出有毒烟雾，迫使工人撤离。受害者若长时间吸入这种烟雾，就会产生幻觉，以为自己身上着了火。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME hides inside coal mines, blowing out a toxic smog that forces workers to evacuate. When a victim breathes in this smog for a long period of time, they begin to experience hallucinations that make them believe they're on fire.

entry: 有虫属性宝可梦在面前受到欺负时，POKENAME会显形保护它。它会用强有力的钳子夹住欺凌者，试图将其碾碎，惩罚对方残酷的行径。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME manifests in defense of Bug-type Pokémon that are being picked on in its presence. It captures the bullies between its mighty pincers and attempts to crush them for their cruel behavior.

entry: POKENAME会毫无征兆地暴怒，穿过墙壁，用角刺向最先看见的东西。因此，人们会派出许多格斗属性宝可梦，在它伤及无辜的旁观者之前制止暴行。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME experiences random flashes of rage, phasing through walls to gore whatever it spots first. In response to this, many Fighting-Type Pokémon are sent out to stop a POKENAME's rampage before it harms any innocent bystanders.

entry: POKENAME显形时会尽量摆出可怕的模样，借此吓退对方。因为它实在太弱，若没能把目标吓走，就无法好好保护自己。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes itself look as frightening as possible when it manifests. It does this as a scare tactic, as it is too weak to properly defend itself if its target is not frightened away.

entry: POKENAME很容易受惊，会迅速刺向惊扰它的对象。它角上产生的毒液会让受害者接连做噩梦，梦见它狞笑的面孔，最长可持续一周。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is easily spooked and quick to sting those that startle it. Its horn produces a venom that causes the victim to experience troubled nightmares of POKENAME's cackling face for up to a week.

entry: POKENAME会从不起眼的楔石中现身，肆意破坏周围的地区。据说，它体内寄宿着世上最凶暴好斗的一些生灵的灵魂。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME emerges from an unassuming keystone to rampage and ravage the areas surrounding it. It is said that POKENAME's body houses the souls of some of the most violent and aggressive beings to have ever existed.

entry: POKENAME只会在最漆黑的夜里，向海上命悬一线的人现身。它把人载到安全的陆地；等乘客转过身来，它那幽灵般的身影早已消失。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME only shows itself to those in mortal peril at sea during the darkest of nights. It ferries them to the safety of land; by the time the passenger has turned around, POKENAME's ghostly visage will be gone.

entry: POKENAME能自由变成其他生物或物体，却始终与楔石相连。若离石头太远，变身就会瓦解。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can freely transform into other creatures and objects, but remains tethered to its keystone. If it moves too far from the stone, its transformation falls apart.

entry: POKENAME的潜力十分巨大，一生大多时间都在思索自己该做些什么。因此，它每天光是望着远方发呆，就能花上10小时。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME has such vast potential that it spends most of its life thinking of what it should do. This leads it to spend up to 10 hours a day just staring off into the distance.

entry: POKENAME守护沉船，会诅咒那些冒失地搜刮残骸的水手。为了安抚它，水手潜水时会带上水之石，这似乎能让它平静下来。
author: bobogagabobo
source: POKENAME protects shipwrecks and curses any sailors who try to scavenge the wreckage recklessly. To appease POKENAME, sailors carry a water stone when diving that seems to calm it.

entry: POKENAME能从岩石鬃毛中射出带电的细针。有些地区的民间传说认为，被针刺中的人有朝一日会加入栖居在它石头里的灵魂群体。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can fire off tiny electrically-charged needles from its rocky mane. Folklore in some regions says that those who are pierced by the needles will one day join the collective of spirits that inhabits its stone.

entry: POKENAME休息时栖居在火之石的碎块内，若受打扰，就会伴着烈焰跃出。不少训练家毫不知情地拾起住有它的石头，结果遭到了袭击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME inhabits chunks of Fire Stones while resting, leaping out in a blaze of flames if disturbed. Many Trainers have unknowingly picked up an inhabited stone, only to be attacked.

entry: 据说，POKENAME是多边兽同时感染超过108个病毒后遭到侵蚀的产物。它的行为充满故障与扭曲，所寄宿的电子设备也会因它的存在而遭侵蚀、损坏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to be Porygon corrupted by over 108 viruses afflicting it at once. It acts in a glitched, distorted fashion, and its presence corrupts and damages electronics it inhabits.

entry: POKENAME会从远古宝可梦的化石遗骸中现身。显形时，它会对靠得太近者的心智产生奇异影响。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME emerges from within the fossilized remains of an ancient Pokémon. It has a strange effect on the minds of those who get too close while it has manifested.

entry: POKENAME一旦从栖身的化石中现身，便会被动地改变周围生灵的心智。它们的意志会逐渐瓦解，直到完全听命于它。
author: sk372
source: Once POKENAME emerges from the fossil it inhabits, it passively alters the minds of those around it. Their wills slowly degrade until they are completely compelled to do POKENAME's bidding.

entry: POKENAME为了安全，藏身于成群的铁壳蛹之中。虽然难以完全从石头里现身，它仍会从石缝中释放幽灵能量，保护自己和同伴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides among crowds of Kakuna for safety. Though it has difficulty emerging fully from its stone, it will expel ghostly energy from cracks in the stone in order to defend itself and its brethren.

entry: POKENAME通常在栖身的化石下方显形，从海底沙地中搜寻食物。受惊时，它会突然从上方现身，希望能吓退引起它警觉的潜在危险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME usually manifests underneath the fossil it inhabits to scrounge food up from the sands of the ocean floor. It emerges suddenly from above when startled, hopefully scaring off whatever potential danger made it do so.

entry: 它常藏在海中岩缝，耐心等待伏击猎物的好时机。
author: karma
source: A Pokémon commonly spotted hiding in marine crevices. It patiently waits for the opportune moment to ambush its prey.

entry: POKENAME以凶暴的恶作剧闻名，会假扮成骨头堆或骸骨，骗过别人后发动袭击。最活跃时，它会散发诡异的能量，发怒时这股能量更会猛然高涨。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are infamous for being violent tricksters, pretending to be piles of bones or skeletons to deceive others and then attack them. In their most active state, they radiate an eerie energy that flares when they are enraged.

entry: 许多人把POKENAME的楔石错认成在野外熟睡的卡比兽。它在石内休息时发出的叫声，听起来像低沉而回荡的鼾声。
author: sk372
source: Many have mistaken POKENAME's keystone for a Snorlax sleeping in the wild. Its cry while resting within the stone sounds like deep, reverberating snoring.

entry: POKENAME从楔石中显形时，周围会弥漫冰冷的雾。据说，凡被雾冻住的生灵都会被抽走灵魂，用来增强它的力量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's manifestation from its keystone creates a freezing mist around it. It's said that any creature frozen by its mist will have its soul drained in order to increase POKENAME's power.

entry: POKENAME从楔石中迸发而出时，附近的天空会变得阴暗而动荡。它在石外停留得越久，引发的雷暴就越猛烈。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME erupts from within its keystone, the skies near it darken and become tumultuous. The longer it remains outside the stone, the more aggressive the thunderstorms it creates become.

entry: 传说，碰到POKENAME绿色火焰的人会受到诅咒，余生都承受灼烧的疼痛。它通常沉眠于火山岩石之间，只有为了惩罚打扰其睡眠的对象才会醒来。
author: fiordaliso
source: Legend says anyone who touches POKENAME's green flames will be cursed and feel the burn's pain for the rest of their life. It usually lies dormant among the volcano's rocks, awakening only to punish those who disturb its sleep.

entry: POKENAME会在深海沉船上生长的海带间蜿蜒游动。被发现时，它会发出凄厉的哀号，许多人声称那是随船沉没的死者的哭声。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slithers between kelp growing off sunken vessels in the ocean depths. Should it be spotted, it releases a ghastly wail that many claim is the cries of those who perished during the ship's sinking.

entry: 据说，POKENAME寄宿着108只已故龙属性宝可梦的灵魂。它性情平和安宁，但对擅自触碰楔石的对象几乎毫不留情。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to house the souls of 108 fallen Dragon-type Pokémon. It has a calm and serene personality, but shows little mercy to those who try to touch its keystones without permission.

entry: 过去，龙属性宝可梦的训练家会把POKENAME的楔石放在他们视为神圣的宝可梦庇护所中。它察觉同伴的恐惧时便会显形，保护它们免受伤害。
author: sk372
source: Dragon-type Pokémon Trainers in the past would leave POKENAME keystones in locations they considered sacred Pokémon sanctums. POKENAME would manifest when it sensed fear in its brethren, protecting them from harm.

entry: POKENAME会将楔石系在铁壳蛹悬挂的同一根树枝上。为了保护结茧的同伴，它会显出灵体，猛烈蜇刺任何靠近的潜在威胁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tethers its keystone to the same branches Kakuna hang from. In order to protect its cocooned brethren, it manifests its spectral form to defend them, stinging fiercely at any potential threats that come close.

entry: POKENAME的超能力几乎无可匹敌。它最多能同时控制108个生灵并操纵它们，自己的精神却丝毫不会感到吃力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's psychic abilities are practically without peer. It can put up to 108 creatures under its control and manipulate them simultaneously without straining its own mind.

entry: POKENAME拥有极其丰富的超能力和幽灵之力。有人说，它由151个灵魂组成，每个都来自一种不同的已故宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses a truly massive array of psychic and ghostly abilities. Some say it is comprised of 151 spirits, each the soul of a different departed Pokémon species.

entry: POKENAME会以叶片的形态从石头里现身，来回挥动，驱赶其他生灵。叶片散发的酸味十分强烈，足以让大多数生灵却步。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME emerges from its stone in the form of a leaf, swinging itself around to ward off others. The leaf emits a sour scent strong enough to give most creatures pause.

entry: POKENAME石质身体散发的气味，能让附近的灵魂和幽灵属性宝可梦充满活力。灵媒与超能力者常借它增强所接触灵魂的力量，从而与之建立联系。
author: vic1312
source: The scent emitted from the stone-like body of POKENAME energizes spirits and Ghost-type Pokémon near it. They are often utilized by spirit mediums and psychics as a means to empower the spirits they interact with to make a connection with them.

entry: 夜里，常能见到POKENAME在墓园徘徊，将发光的幽火送入地下。这些光球汇聚于墓碑周围，短短几分钟便让附近的泥土开出花朵。
author: santon5512
source: At night, POKENAME are often found wandering cemeteries, sending glowing wisps into the ground. These orbs gather around tombstones, sprouting flowers from the dirt around them within minutes.

entry: 楔石被触碰时，POKENAME会从其背面猛然迸发出来。它的灵体十分灼热，从石中窜出时会烧伤靠得太近的对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME responds to its keystone being touched by flaring out from its back. Its ethereal form is very hot and will burn those who are too close when it erupts from the stone.

entry: POKENAME会寻找枯死、萎蔫的植物，将其烧掉，再收集灰烬构筑身体。它会放出暗紫色的雾恐吓敌人。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME finds dead and wilted plants to burn and collect their ashes to build its body. It intimidates its foes by producing a dark purple fog.

entry: POKENAME会被火葬场吸引，用附近的骨灰充实身体。它以紫色烟霭遮蔽自己。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME gravitates towards crematoriums to build up its body with nearby ashes. It obscures itself with a haze of purple smoke.

entry: POKENAME会被火葬场吸引，用附近的骨灰充实身体。它以紫色烟霭遮蔽自己。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME gravitates towards crematoriums to build up its body with nearby ashes. It obscures itself with a haze of purple smoke.

entry: POKENAME喜欢从楔石里现身，友好地咬别人一口。它虽无恶意，这却相当危险：幽灵般的牙齿能引发种种不良症状，而它一旦咬住就不肯松口。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME likes to emerge from its keystone to give others a friendly bite. Despite meaning no ill intent, this is quite dangerous as POKENAME's ghostly teeth can cause many negative afflictions, and it refuses to let go once it has chomped down.

entry: POKENAME栖居的池塘在入夜后会冷得诡异。整夜都有它制造的异常紫色泡沫涌上岸，使许多人相信这处水源受到了诅咒。
author: .izik
source: Ponds where POKENAME resides take on an eerily low temperature after nightfall. Throughout the night it causes an unnatural purple foam to wash up on the shoreline, leading many to believe the water source is cursed.

entry: 在城都，人们相信POKENAME是保护人类免遭游魂侵扰的守护灵。因此，不时有人声称看见它栖在墓园、寺庙或神社附近。
author: zeterzero
source: In Johto, POKENAME are believed to be guardian spirits that protect people from wandering ghosts. As a result, people sometimes claim to see them perching around graveyards, temples, and shrines.

entry: POKENAME曾被视为死者的守护者，楔石会被安置在墓中。考古学家与探险家都提防着脚下突然开启迷雾之门，通向一张等候已久的大嘴。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME were once considered guardians of the dead, with their keystones placed in tombs. Archaeologists and explorers are wary of misty portals opening beneath them to a pair of waiting jaws.

entry: POKENAME从石中现身后，会高高飘起，凭敏锐的视力巡视四周。它为森林里的小宝可梦放哨，提醒它们有危险正在逼近。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME emerges from its stone, it floats up high to survey its surroundings with keen eyesight. It acts as a lookout for small woodland Pokémon, alerting them to encroaching dangers.

entry: POKENAME会凭外表将毫无戒心的训练家引入森林深处的阴暗地带。得手后，它便以吓唬训练家为乐，直到失去兴趣。
author: plkfsa32
source: POKENAME uses its appearance to lure unsuspecting Trainers into dark parts of the forest. Once drawn in, it scares Trainers as a form of entertainment until it loses interest.

entry: POKENAME每天都会在同一时刻从楔石里现身，发出尖锐的叫声后便退回去。若石头被移到新地方，它会花几天重新调整体内的作息，在此期间不会现身。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME emerges from its keystone at the same time every day, letting out a shrill cry before retreating. If its stone is moved to a new area, it will not appear for several days as it readjusts its internal schedule.

entry: POKENAME充满好奇，会从楔石里现身，静静观察林间的旅人。由于往往只在夜色最深时出来，它把许多想要观察的人都吓得不轻。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is curious and will emerge from its keystone to quietly observe travelers in the forest. Because it tends to come out only when the night is at its darkest, it has terribly frightened many of the people it wants to observe.

entry: POKENAME依靠附身其他虫属性宝可梦生存。通过附身，它能取得花蜜和其他甜液，滋养楔石。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME relies on possessing other Bug-type Pokémon to survive. Through possession, POKENAME can obtain nectar and other sweet liquids to nourish its keystone.

entry: POKENAME醒来时会释放有毒烟雾，附身其他虫属性宝可梦。等附身的宝可梦达到108只，它便会带领群体采集花蜜，喂给楔石。
author: quackquackattack
source: When awakened, POKENAME release a noxious smoke that possesses other Bug-type Pokémon. Once 108 Pokémon have been possessed, POKENAME and their swarm collect nectar to feed to the keystone.

entry: 被困在楔石内的灵魂会化作圆丝蛛，让猎物和捕食者都大吃一惊。被幽灵蛛网困住的对象，会觉得自己的生命力正被一点点抽走。
author: infinex21
source: The spirits trapped within the Odd Keystone manifest in the form of a Spinarak to startle prey and predators alike. Those caught within their ghostly webs will feel like their very life force is being slowly drained away.

entry: POKENAME透明的黑色丝线专门用来捕捉并削弱其他幽灵属性宝可梦。一些研究者和工程师认为，这种奇异的丝线或许能作为新型精灵球的材料。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME's transparent black thread is specially made to ensnare and debilitate other Ghost-type Pokémon. Some researchers and engineers assert that POKENAME's unusual silk properties could be a component for a new type of Pokéball.

entry: POKENAME会在秋天四处飞行，附身其他宝可梦，迫使它们交出部分储粮。被附身的宝可梦会把粮食送到它的洞穴，让它整个冬天都能开心地享用。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME fly about during autumn, possessing other Pokémon who are then compelled to part with a portion of their food stores. The possessed Pokémon transport this portion to POKENAME's cave, where it happily enjoys its food all winter long.

entry: POKENAME有些领地意识，会试着用起风吹走较小的宝可梦。它双翼掀起的风中，能隐约听见古怪而诡异的哀号。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a bit territorial and will attempt to blow smaller Pokémon away with its Gust attack. A strange and eerie wail can faintly be heard within the wind its wings create.

entry: POKENAME会让触角发出异样而令人不适的光，吸引好奇的生灵跟随。它一路引诱，直到对方彻底迷路，才熄灭灯光，从随之而来的黑暗中发动袭击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes a strange and sickly glow from its antennae to draw curious creatures to follow it. It strings them along until they are completely lost before switching off its lights and attacking from the ensuing darkness.

entry: POKENAME会用光诱使船只驶入浓雾，可能导致触礁。已有几起船难由这种光引发。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME uses its light to trick ships into sailing into thick fog and potentially crashing into rocks. A few shipwrecks have been caused by this light.

entry: POKENAME听到其他生灵靠近的动静，就会好奇地从楔石里探出头。它的身体略不稳定，只要暴露在空气中，就会自发产生细小的闪电。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will curiously poke its head out from its keystone whenever it hears the approach of other creatures. Its body is slightly unstable, so it spontaneously generates small bolts of lightning for as long as it is exposed to open air.

entry: POKENAME只会在繁星闪烁的夜里从楔石中现身。白天，人们可能误将它当作雕像陈列起来。没人看着时，它会自行挪到更适合仰望天空的地方。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME only emerges from its keystone on starry nights. During the day, people may mistake them for statues and place them on display. When nobody is watching, POKENAME will move themselves to a spot with a better view of the sky.

entry: 流星雨过后，有时能发现POKENAME一动不动地躺在陨石坑里。它身体升起的气体中闪耀着一百多道光，宛如夜空繁星。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can sometimes be found in the aftermath of a meteor shower, lying motionless in the craters left by the impacts. The gas that rises from their bodies shimmers with over one hundred lights, glittering like the night sky.

entry: POKENAME小而圆的身体会从石头底部现身，感到危险时还会稍稍膨胀。它靠整个身体在地上弹跳来移动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's small, round body emerges from the bottom of its stone and inflates slightly if it feels it is in danger. It moves around by bouncing its whole body off the ground.

entry: POKENAME的壳内似乎藏着好几个灵魂。组成身体的主要灵魂受到其他灵魂保护；它们会从石缝中涌出，攻击任何威胁本体的对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's shell appears to contain several spirits within. The main spirit that comprises the body is protected by these other spirits, which leak from cracks in the stone to strike out at any threats to the main body.

entry: 有些人会随身携带POKENAME的楔石，把它当作幸运符。它似乎确实能多带来几分好运，但代价仿佛是持有者身边的人会遭遇厄运。
author: sk372
source: Some people will carry around POKENAME's keystone as a good luck charm. It does seem to provide a bit of extra luck, though seemingly at the cost of others near the holder suffering bad luck in exchange.

entry: 秋天的第一个夜晚，成千上万只POKENAME会聚在一起，庆祝季节的到来。据说，若它们的气息呈现的绿色多于紫色，就预示着严冬将至。
author: dodoowner_
source: On the first night of autumn, thousands of POKENAME gather together to celebrate the start of the season. It's said that if their auras appear more green than purple, a harsh winter is ahead.

entry: 若墓园的墓碑记载有误，POKENAME会用爪子修改日期。传闻它若写下未来的日期，就说明那个人仍然活着，这常帮助警方找到诈死的人。
author: quackquackattack
source: If a headstone in a graveyard is mislabeled, POKENAME uses its claws to change the dates. It is rumored that a person is still alive if POKENAME writes a date in the future, which often helps police find people who have faked their death.

entry: 灵体能量环绕着POKENAME的石像身体盘旋。深处传来咩咩的叫声，回荡不绝。
author: hophoppip
source: Spiritual energy swirls around the stone statue that is POKENAME's body. Echoing bleats can be heard from deep within.

entry: POKENAME振翅时会掀起夹杂自身灵体能量的强风。在它制造的小型龙卷风里，能看见它面孔的形影。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flings powerful gusts of wind laced with its own spectral energy when it flaps its wings. One can see the visage of POKENAME's face within the miniature tornadoes it creates.

entry: POKENAME会在楔石的颈部和头部周围，显现为一簇簇幽灵羊毛。附近有潜在危险时，它便开始脉动，将体内充满电能；只要碰到它或石头，就会迸出电火花。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME manifests itself as bits of ghostly wool located around its keystones neck and head area. It pulses in the presence of potential danger, filling itself with electric energy that will spark off if anything so much as touches it or the stone.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴会吸收周围的光，使四下漆黑一片，只剩尾端的光球仍在发亮。绝望的旅人怀着获救的希望追逐光芒，却被引入歧途，再也没有回来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tail absorbs the light around it, turning the surrounding area pitch-black and leaving its tail-orb the only source of light. Desperate travelers following the light in hopes of salvation are led astray and never return.

entry: 通过光合作用吸收足够的阳光后，POKENAME会从楔石里探出部分身体。它在原地摇摆起舞，引得附近的植物也摇曳起来，模仿它的动作。
author: sk372
source: After photosynthesizing enough sunlight, POKENAME emerges partially from its keystone. Its body sways and dances in place, causing nearby flora to sway and mimic its movements.

entry: 有时能见到POKENAME把树果和其他礼物留在骨灰瓮旁。若安置骨灰瓮的墓园遭水淹，它会潜入水中，试图防止那些瓮被冲失。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found leaving berries and other gifts next to burial urns. If the cemetery where these urns are kept becomes flooded, POKENAME dive into the water in an attempt to prevent them from getting lost.

entry: POKENAME会在潜水员下方吹出气泡，强行将他们托向水面。尾端的楔石虽是石头，却能浮在水上，提醒潜水员它正潜伏在下方。
author: bobogagabobo
source: POKENAME blows bubbles beneath divers, making them float to the surface against their will. Despite being stone, the Odd Keystone on its tail floats, warning divers when one is lurking below.

entry: POKENAME从石中现身时，会伸展部分身体，为附近的其他树木覆上幽灵能量。这会改变树木的模样，使藏身其中的它更难被发现。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME emerges from its stone, it extends parts of its body to coat other nearby trees with ghostly energy. This alters their appearance to make it more difficult to discover POKENAME hiding among them.

entry: 栖居在石内的灵魂会构成四肢，在沼泽和池塘间跳跃。随后，POKENAME会像伸舌头一样，从口中探出面孔，尖叫着吓退可能来袭的敌人。
author: sk372
source: The spirits inhabiting the stone form limbs to hop around swamps and ponds. POKENAME then extends its face out from the mouth like a tongue to shriek at and scare away potential aggressors.

entry: 组成POKENAME的灵魂会一同高速旋转，让沉重的石质身体离地。虽然石上刻着的脸看起来很开心，灵魂们却常为这份苦差事感到烦恼。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The spirits that make up POKENAME rapidly rotate together to lift their heavy stone bodies off the ground. Although the face carved into the stone seems cheerful, the spirits themselves are often frustrated by the hard work.

entry: 据说，POKENAME会被捕鼠夹夹死的小拉达或拉达吸引。饱受这些宝可梦困扰的人，常在整夜听见咔嗒声，仿佛有几十个捕鼠夹接连合拢。
author: santon5512
source: It is said that POKENAME are drawn to Rattata or Raticate that are killed with mouse traps. People plagued by these Pokémon will often hear snapping throughout the night, as if dozens of mouse traps were going off.

entry: POKENAME的形体会从长尾怪手状楔石的尾部现身。它生性顽皮，会把幽灵躯体化作一只巨手，抓住经过的生灵逗弄。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's form emerges from the tail of its Aipom-shaped keystone. It is mischievous by nature, turning its ghostly form into a giant hand with which it can grab and play with any creatures that pass by.

entry: POKENAME会在清晨从楔石顶部冒出来，表现得极其警惕。吸收晨光之前，它十分虚弱；吸收之后，就会变得活泼开朗许多。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sprouts up from the top of its keystone during the early morning, behaving extremely warily. It is very weak until it absorbs the morning sun's rays, whereupon it becomes much more lively and cheerful.

entry: POKENAME会抽取附近其他植物的养分为食，直到那些植物枯萎腐烂。连地面也干枯后，它们便会换个地方休息。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME feed themselves by leeching nutrients from other plants near them until those other plants wilt and decay. They will move to a new resting place once the ground itself has dried up.

entry: POKENAME拥有360度的视野，时刻严密监视，因此没有灵魂敢试图逃离它的身体。它常试图制造冲击波震碎楔石，却始终未能成功。
author: soup1900
source: No spirit ever attempts to escape from POKENAME's body due to POKENAME's 360-degree vision always keeping a watchful eye out. It frequently attempts to generate shock waves to shatter its Odd Keystone, but to no success.

entry: 阴郁夜晚，它像人偶般僵直站着，盯紧目标，直到猛伸出无定形的双手，将对方掳走，永不归还。
author: chorb33
source: It appears on gloomy nights, standing rigidly like a doll and watching its victim until it throws out its amorphous hands and abducts it for all time.

entry: 阴郁夜晚，它像人偶般僵直站着，盯紧目标，直到猛伸出无定形的双手，将对方掳走，永不归还。
author: chorb33
source: It appears on gloomy nights, standing rigidly like a doll and watching its victim until it throws out its amorphous hands and abducts it for all time.

entry: 一个由108个灵魂组成的幽影，寄居在石像般生物的影子里。幽影与石像都属于POKENAME，但石像始终沉默，幽影却十分喜欢唱歌。
author: hophoppip
source: A specter made up of 108 spirits dwells in the shadow of a statue-like stone creature. Both the specter and the statue are a part of POKENAME, but while the statue remains silent, the specter quite enjoys singing.

entry: POKENAME夜里出现在巷中，不停抛接发光圆球，借此催眠目标，再将其掳走。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME appears in alleyways at night. It constantly juggles its glowing balls, which it uses to hypnotize its victims before abducting them.

entry: POKENAME待在楔石内也能感知他人的情绪。它会忽略快乐或愤怒的人，却在悲伤者面前现身，希望自己能做些什么，带来些许安慰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can sense the emotional state of others from within its keystone. It ignores joyful or angry people, but emerges in the presence of sadness, hoping it can do something to bring some measure of comfort.

entry: POKENAME能否显形取决于月相。满月会赋予它最强的力量，新月之夜却让它几乎无法脱离束缚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's ability to manifest is dependent on the phase of the moon. The full moon grants it maximum power, but nights of the new moon leave it almost completely unable to emerge from its confines.

entry: POKENAME通常出没于墓地和墓园。栖在墓碑上时，它能模仿死者的声音，但除了零星一两个词，其他话都无法听懂。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME are usually seen around graveyards and cemeteries. When perched on a gravestone, it can mimic the voice of the dead, although what it says is unintelligible apart from the odd word or two.

entry: 古时候，人们会向POKENAME栖居的石头献上供品，祈求赐福。据说，它会短暂附身他人，使对方的智力暂时大幅提升。
author: sk372
source: In olden times people would give offerings to the stone POKENAME inhabits in order to hopefully be granted a boon. Supposedly POKENAME would possess others for a short time, temporarily granting them massively boosted intelligence.

entry: 从这种宝可梦干瘪如木乃伊的种子中现身的“幽灵”，其实是一团瘴气。它很容易使接触到的一切中毒，让受害者身体不适并产生幻觉。
author: zeterzero
source: The "spirit" that emerges from the mummified seed of this Pokémon is actually a miasmic cloud that can easily poison whatever it touches, causing physical illness and hallucinations in its victims.

entry: 据说，POKENAME会将亡魂聚集在背上的球茎里。球茎破裂时会释放汹涌的能量，使人产生看见已故亲人的幻觉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are said to gather souls of the dead into the bulb on their back. Cracking this bulb unleashes a surge of energy that causes hallucinations that look like lost loved ones.

entry: POKENAME会产生在黑暗中发光的花粉团。它们十分记仇，会攻击伤害周围森林的对象。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce clusters of pollen that glow in the dark. They are a vengeful creature that attacks those who harm the forest around them.

entry: POKENAME会在郊区住宅作祟，夜里花许多时间在墙内发出抓挠声，骚扰住户。不过，它的存在能吓跑野生小拉达，有效驱离破坏性更强的害兽。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME haunts suburban homes, pestering the denizens by spending much of the night making scratching noises in the walls. Its presence frightens off wild Rattata, making it effective at keeping more damaging pests away.

entry: POKENAME附身于写着未知语言的大书中。这些原本都是普通书籍，因它的附身而扭曲变形。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME possesses a tome inscribed with an unknown language. Each tome was once an ordinary book, warped by its haunting presence.

entry: 译出POKENAME展示的符号后，内容往往既暴力又粗俗。许多人推测，这是因为它们是试图与外界交流的恶灵。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: When translated, the symbols POKENAME show are often violent and vulgar. Many theorize this is because POKENAME are malicious spirits attempting to communicate.

entry: POKENAME会显形保护极其敏感脆弱的楔石。它先用幽灵躯体承受攻击，再以双倍奉还所受伤害，反击时还会施加诅咒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME manifests in protection of its keystone, which is extremely sensitive and fragile. It absorbs blows with its ghostly body before returning the damage inflicted twofold and inflicting curses alongside its counterstrike.

entry: POKENAME每次从石中现身，都会化成与石头几乎一模一样的形态。它使用某些超能力时，楔石的眼睛会明亮地发光。
author: sk372
source: Whenever POKENAME emerges from its stone, it manifests as an almost exact copy of the stone's shape. The keystone's eyes glow brightly whenever POKENAME uses some of its psychic abilities.

entry: POKENAME会附着在枯树上，一动不动地等待地面的猎物。一旦发现目标，它就立刻俯冲而下，在接触的瞬间吸收对方的生命力。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME attaches itself to dead trees, staying perfectly still until it spots prey on the ground. It then immediately dive-bombs towards the target and absorbs its vitality the second they make contact.

entry: POKENAME只要在楔石外，就无法好好保护自己。待在石内时，它能从楔石的孔洞中射出由自身幽灵躯体构成的尖刺。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is unable to properly defend itself as long as it is outside of its keystone. From within the stone, it can fire off sharpened spines made of its own ghostly body out from the keystone's pores.

entry: POKENAME喜欢用钻头般的尾巴在地面打出一连串洞穴取乐。捕到宝可梦时，它会幸灾乐祸地偷笑；若捕到的是人类，它却会逃走。
author: sleepyman0731
source: POKENAME uses their drill-like tail to create a series of holes in the ground for entertainment. When they capture Pokémon, POKENAME snickers at the other Pokémon's expense. If they manage to capture a human, POKENAME runs away.

entry: 组成POKENAME的灵魂会合力用锋利的钳子敲击石头，试图一点点削弱封印。不幸的是，每次打击都只会延长诅咒，让它们继续被束缚在地面。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The spirits that make up POKENAME work together to try and whittle down the stone that seals them by striking it with their sharp pincers. Unfortunately for them, every blow to the seal simply extends their curse to keep them tethered to the ground.

entry: POKENAME能毫不费力地在山脉中挖出巨大隧道，吞食其中的矿石。据说，它挖的隧道会吸引附近的亡魂前来安家。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME carves massive tunnels through mountain ranges with little effort to consume the ore within. It is said the tunnels it creates invite the souls of the dead in the area to make them their home.

entry: POKENAME会四处寻求他人的宠爱。若得不到渴望的关注，它就会嚎哭，释放带着诅咒的幽灵能量，引发种种灵异麻烦，直到有人安慰它。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME goes around seeking to be spoiled and pampered by others. If it doesn't get the attention it craves, it wails and emits cursed ghostly energy that causes a myriad of paranormal problems until someone comforts it.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在陵墓上或附近筑巢。巢的材料主要取自人们留给附近墓中逝者的鲜花花茎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers to nest on or near mausoleums. The nests it creates are mainly made from the stems of flowers left for the deceased in nearby graves.

entry: POKENAME会用自己的幽灵躯体造出锁链，将楔石的双臂连在一起。这些链条大多用于玩耍，比如跳绳或套住玩伴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME creates chains with its own ghostly body, linking the arms of its keystone together. These chains are mostly used for entertainment, such as jump rope or lassoing playmates.

entry: POKENAME的烟雾躯体旋转时会开心大笑，身上的石刺如同旋转的搅拌机。它们常与大尾狸争斗，试图冲破水坝，让水流自由通过。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME laugh gleefully while their smoky bodies swirl, the stony spines along their bodies acting like a whirling blender. They frequently squabble with Bibarel, trying to break through their dams to let water flow freely.

entry: POKENAME对周围环境十分挑剔，总会及时修剪草地，把灌木修得尽善尽美。它对每个细节都执着不已，体内每个灵魂都会指出需要修正的瑕疵。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME tends to be fastidious with its surroundings, keeping grass freshly cut and any shrubs trimmed to perfection. It obsesses over every detail, with each of its spirits pointing out some flaw that needs to be fixed.

entry: POKENAME壳内酿出的树果汁，会散发微弱而略显诡异的光。因此，许多人迟迟不敢喝，但果汁本身并无害处，只是味道有点酸。
author: sk372
source: Berry Juice created within POKENAME's shell emits a faint and somewhat eerie glow. Many are hesitant to drink it due to this, but the juice itself is harmless, if a bit sour in flavor.

entry: POKENAME藏在倒木中，耐心等待满怀期待的甜甜萤经过。一发现甜甜萤，它就会让环绕身边的灵体球缓缓闪烁，模仿一只电萤虫形成的几何图案。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME hides within downed logs, patiently waiting for any hopeful Illumise to pass by. When it spots an Illumise, it begins to slowly flash the spectral orbs that revolve around it, mimicking the geometric patterns of a lone Volbeat.

entry: POKENAME会埋伏等待偷窃旅人财物的机会。它迅速从楔石中跃出，划开训练家的包，再抢走一些散落的东西。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lies in wait until it gets a chance to pilfer items from travelers. It leaps out from its keystone quickly and slashes at Trainers' bags, cutting them open and letting it snatch some of the spilled contents.

entry: POKENAME用可爱的外表掩饰狡猾的本性。它表现得温顺，让旅人不加留意，再伸出幽灵肢体，偷走对方可能带着的糖果。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its cute appearance to mask a sneaky nature. When travelers pay it no heed due to its meek actions, it stretches ghostly limbs from its body in order to steal any sweets they might be carrying.

entry: POKENAME脾气很坏，从楔石中现身时通常相当凶暴。若趁它藏着时在石头上抹蜂蜜，它下次显形就会温和一些。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has an ill temperament and typically behaves quite aggressively when it emerges from its keystone. Smearing honey on its stone while it is hiding away will make it behave more calmly the next time it manifests.

entry: POKENAME的楔石只有在经受极高温度后才能移动。石头冷却后，它就会无法动弹，直到温度再次升高。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can only move its keystone after it has been exposed to extreme heat. Once the stone cools off, POKENAME becomes immobile until its temperature can be raised once more.

entry: POKENAME的身体由发光且能活动的黏液构成。疲倦时，它会退回楔石，将其当作随身携带的家。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is formed of glowing, animated slime. When tired, it retreats into its Odd Keystone, carrying it like a portable home.

entry: POKENAME在空中寻找猎物，飞近地面时会不断发出响亮刺耳的叫声。叫声能强行激起猎物战斗或逃跑的反应，迫使它们奔到开阔处。
author: bigoljax
source: As it soars through the sky to find prey, POKENAME will constantly let out loud, shrieking cries when it gets low to the ground. These cries have the ability to forcefully induce prey's fight-or-flight response, causing them to run out into the open.

entry: POKENAME偏爱吃人们留在墓前的花瓣。它隔着3英里多，就能闻到新鲜花束的气味。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers to eat flower petals left on graves. It can smell a fresh bouquet from over 3 miles away.

entry: POKENAME栖居在幽暗冰洞的裂隙中。听见附近的脚步声，它们就会猛然窜出，纠缠周围的人。
author: lydiaprower8
