source: POKENAME are found in fissures in dark, icy caves. When they hear footsteps close to them, they burst out of those fissures to haunt whoever is nearby.

entry: POKENAME飘过绵延的珊瑚礁，运用灵力强行把大片珊瑚变成紫色和绿色。许多人注意到，它的样子很像一种只在伽勒尔发现的进化形态。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME drifts along sprawling coral reefs, using its spiritual abilities to forcefully change the colors of large groups of coral into purples and greens. Many have noted that it has a similar appearance to an evolution found only in Galar.

entry: POKENAME喜欢用光束吓人，让被击中的人滑倒。它也能成为警察可靠的伙伴，帮助制止罪犯。
author: agostostino
source: POKENAME love to scare people with their beams, causing those they hit to slip and fall. POKENAME can be reliable partners for police officers, helping them stop criminals.

entry: POKENAME静候海底，等其他宝可梦游到上方，就把它们拖进沙里。随后，它用灵体之力探查对方的心智，冷漠地拆解它们的记忆，收为己有。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME rests at the bottom of the sea, waiting for other Pokémon to loom over it before dragging them into the sand. It then uses its ethereal powers to study their mind, dismantling their memories without empathy and gathering them as its own.

entry: POKENAME头顶的冠其实是一张假嘴，被认为用于恐吓。它每条触手的末端都藏着金色的尖刺，能将其甩向敌人。
author: chibitales
source: The crown atop POKENAME's head is a false mouth, which is thought to be a form of intimidation. The tips of each of POKENAME's tentacles hide gold-colored spikes that they fling at foes.

entry: POKENAME性情阴险而难以捉摸，似乎与许多其他宝可梦有着不同的是非观。有趣的是，虫属性宝可梦似乎很受它吸引。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME have a treacherous and unpredictable personality; their views of right and wrong seem to differ from many other Pokémon. Interestingly, Bug-type Pokémon seem drawn to them.

entry: POKENAME在近水面处游动时，拖在身后的楔石若露于夜空之下便会发光。暴风雨将至时，它会反射性地快速闪烁。
author: .izik
source: The keystone trailing behind POKENAME glows when exposed to the night sky while it swims near the surface. It blinks rapidly as a reflex when a storm is approaching.

entry: 据说，它由遇难登山者的灵魂形成。它只在最高的山峰附近筑巢，还会凶猛地驱赶试图闯入的对象，其中常有登山者；这些事实让传闻一直流传。
author: infinex21
source: It is said to have formed from the spirits of fallen mountain climbers. The fact that it nests exclusively around the tallest mountains and fiercely repels would-be intruders, which often includes climbers, keeps those rumors alive.

entry: POKENAME在十二只或更多成员的群体中最能发挥本领。成员们以彼此的灵体能量为食，使它们一起狩猎或战斗时，力量更强，配合也更默契。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME functions best in a group of a dozen or more. The members of the pack feed off each other's spectral energy, allowing them more strength and coordination when it is time to hunt or fight together.

entry: POKENAME体内充满紫色火焰，温度远高于任何自然火焰。据说，它们会直接攻击对手的灵魂，用双颚夹住，带往来世。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's bodies are filled with purple flames, burning much hotter than any natural fire. It is said that these Pokémon attack their opponents' souls directly, clamping their jaws around them and carrying them to the afterlife.

entry: 这种宝可梦的无数灵魂原本被困在楔石内，如今以蛇的形态显现。据说，它的咬击会注入令人痛苦不堪的毒，使受害者发出惨叫，从而增强自身的力量。
author: infinex21
source: The myriad souls of this Pokémon that were trapped within an odd keystone have manifested with a serpentine form. Its bite is said to deliver a poison that is agonizingly painful to incite screams that make it stronger.

entry: POKENAME会在沉船之间游走，用身体摩擦船上死者的私人物品。许多人相信，它这样是为了吸收灵魂精华，满足食欲。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME travels between shipwrecks, rubbing its body against the personal belongings of those who perished on board. Many believe it does this to absorb spiritual essence to satisfy its appetite.

entry: POKENAME会附身附近的雕像，向靠得太近的对象喷水。它的石质象鼻能损坏击中的物品。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME possess nearby statues and sprays water at those who get too close. Its stone trunk can cause damage to items it strikes.

entry: POKENAME遇险时，会以灵体从身体中脱出，再用象鼻将其像鞭子一样甩动。这虽能有效逼退对手，却也会让它攻击后短暂头晕。
author: bigoljax
source: When POKENAME is in danger, it emerges out of its body using its ethereal form, then uses its trunk to spin it around like a whip. While this is effective in keeping an opponent away, it becomes dizzy for a short period of time after attacking.

entry: 据说，POKENAME是将108个强大的程序置于同一容器后创造出来的。它在网络空间中力量强大，却行为反常，还可能毫无征兆地变得凶暴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to have been created by placing 108 powerful programs into a single vessel. It has a lot of power within cyberspace, but behaves erratically and may randomly turn aggressive.

entry: POKENAME会在夜里的森林作祟，驱赶可能危及林中惊角鹿群的对象。碰到楔石会使精神能量骤然涌出，引发触碰者的偏头痛，严重到足以昏厥。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME haunts forests at night, driving off those who would potentially endanger the Stantler herds within. Touching its keystone will cause a psychic surge that creates a migraine in the perpetrator strong enough to knock them out.

entry: POKENAME会从楔石尾部现身，以身体摩擦表面绘制壁画，留下淡淡的幽灵残留物。因此，它的画作会在光线昏暗时泛起空灵的微光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME paints murals by emerging from the tail of its keystone and rubbing its body against surfaces, which leaves a faint, ghostly residue. This causes the artwork it creates to have an ethereal glow in low lighting.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时会退回束缚着自己的楔石。它的能量过于强大，即使失去意识，也常会突然窜出，疯狂挣扎着试图脱困，却总是徒劳。
author: bobosmith01
source: When POKENAME sleeps, it retreats into the keystones it's bound to. Its overwhelming energy causes it to often suddenly lurch out and attempt to madly struggle free in vain, even when unconscious.

entry: POKENAME体内汇聚着108个灵魂，永不停歇地旋转，持续将附近的宝可梦吸来。据说，若有人靠它的舞蹈太近，就会消失，再也不回来。
author: npshi
source: A POKENAME is infused with 108 united spirits, spinning perpetually and acting as an eternal vacuum that draws in nearby Pokémon. It is said that if someone gets too close to a POKENAME's dance, they will disappear and never return.

entry: POKENAME充满好奇，只要有新鲜事物走近石头，就忍不住亲上一口。这一吻常让人皮肤发麻、起鸡皮疙瘩，但除此之外并无害处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a curious Pokémon that can't help giving a kiss to anything new that marches close to its stone. The kiss tends to make a person's skin tingle and develop goosebumps, but is otherwise harmless.

entry: POKENAME会在电源插座附近跌跌撞撞地转悠，试着调整位置，将自己对准插孔。成功后，灵体便会穿进去，使电线杆断电，导致附近地区大面积停电。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME stumbles around electrical sockets, trying to position itself to fit right into the slots. When done successfully, its spectral body passes through, shutting off any utility poles and causing mass blackouts in the nearby area.

entry: POKENAME身体的每一节，都是容纳体内灵魂的容器。它的身体越长，说明试图封印它的人越多，封印失败的次数也越多。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The individual segments of a POKENAME are vessels for the spirits stored within. The longer a POKENAME is, the more humans have attempted to seal it and the more they have failed.

entry: POKENAME上方的四团诅咒火焰，每团都能让它附身并控制一只幼年宝可梦或一件小物品。被控制的对象会带有烟味，将其完全浸入水中或许就能解除控制。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Each of the four cursed flames above POKENAME allow it to possess and control a baby Pokémon or small object. Anything under POKENAME's influence smells like smoke and may be freed by being fully submerged in water.

entry: POKENAME的灵体呈乳白色。挤压楔石的乳房，会流出类似牛奶的液体。这种液体不可饮用，否则会让人身体不适并产生幻觉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's spirit-like form has a milky complexion. The udders of its keystone leak a milk-like liquid when squeezed. The liquid should not be consumed, as it will make a person ill and cause hallucinations.

entry: POKENAME会请心情低落的人抱住楔石。若对方接受，灵体便会将其包裹一阵子，清空脑中的负面想法，让人暂享纯粹的幸福。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME offers those who are feeling unhappy to hold onto its keystone. If they accept, its spectral body envelops them for a time, emptying their mind of negative thoughts and giving them time to enjoy pure bliss.

entry: POKENAME模仿古代雷公雕像的模样，将灵体能量与电力混合，用带电的雾覆盖附近表面。构成鬃毛的幽灵烟霭，形似雷云。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME imitates the appearance of ancient Raikou statues, using a mix of spiritual energy and electricity to coat nearby surfaces with an electrical mist. The ghostly haze that creates its mane mimics the appearance of thunderclouds.

entry: POKENAME模仿古代炎帝雕像的模样，将灵体能量与洪亮有力的吠声结合，发出刺耳的尖啸。石缝中涌出的幽灵雾气，宛如流动的岩浆。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME imitates the appearance of ancient Entei statues, mixing its spiritual energy with loud, powerful barks to create ear-piercing screeches. The ghostly mist that comes out of its cracks mimics the appearance of flowing magma.

entry: POKENAME模仿古代水君雕像的模样，将灵体能量与水结合，造出浑浊有毒的混合液。头上不断涌出的幽灵蒸气，形似猛烈的狂风。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME imitates the appearance of ancient Suicune statues, combining spiritual energy with water to create a murky, poisonous mixture. The ghostly vapors that constantly flow from its head mimic the appearance of harsh gales.

entry: POKENAME能脱落正在崩碎的部分外壳，几乎在任何地方掀起裹挟大量碎屑的沙暴。不过，它们通常不愿这样做，因为不喜欢等风暴平息后再去捡回碎块。
author: pkbonusducks
source: By shedding parts of their crumbling shell, POKENAME can create high-debris sandstorms almost anywhere. POKENAME tend to avoid this, as they dislike having to collect the pieces once the storm subsides.

entry: POKENAME体内的灵魂不断在岩石躯体中盘旋，形成爪子，试图拖着沉重的石头沿地面移动。它虽是实心石头，却表情丰富，仿佛活过来的雕像。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The spirits that dwell within POKENAME constantly swirl inside their rocky body, forming into claws to try and drag the heavy stone along the ground. Despite being solid stone, POKENAME are very expressive, resembling statues brought to life.

entry: 它岩石般的身体在一生中逐渐形成裂隙，恶意能量从中渗出。据说，窥视其发光巨口内部的对象，会看见极其强烈的邪恶，留下终身难愈的心灵创伤。
author: infinex21
source: Malicious energy seeps out from the cracks of its rock-like body that gradually form throughout its life. Those that peer within their glowing maws are said to witness an evil so intense that it scars them for life.

entry: POKENAME从楔石中现身时会引发海上风暴，双翼一振便掀起巨大的风浪。它往往在致命船难发生一段时间后出现，仿佛正为葬身大海的生命发怒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME causes tempests at sea when it emerges from its keystone, the flap of its wings stirring up massive winds and waves. It tends to emerge some time after a lethal shipwreck has occurred, as if angry at the lives lost to the ocean.

entry: POKENAME起初看似一块古老的雷之石，会等别人握住自己才现身。它本身的发电能力很弱，但楔石储有能量，能让它释放微弱的电击。
author: plkfsa32
source: Initially appearing to be an ancient Thunder Stone, POKENAME waits for someone to grasp it before appearing. This Pokémon has little electrical capability on its own, but its keystone carries energy, allowing it to produce small shocks.

entry: 傍晚，POKENAME会栖在最高的塔顶，众多幽灵羽毛散发诡异的灵光。城都某些地方的人相信，它体内寄宿着葬身火海者的灵魂。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME perches on the tallest of towers in the evening, its many ghostly feathers emanating an eerie spectral light. Some parts of Johto believe it is inhabited by the souls of those lost to flame.

entry: POKENAME试着靠楔石弹跳移动，却因石头沉重，始终跳不了多远。最终，它会累得退回石内休息。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME tries to bounce around on its keystone but never makes it far since the keystone is heavy and weighs it down. Eventually it tires itself out and retreats into the stone to rest.

entry: POKENAME的气态身体能诱使敌人留在附近。这是神经毒素的作用，还是真正的精神联系所致，目前尚无定论。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's gaseous body can goad a foe into remaining nearby. Whether this is caused by a neurotoxin or a true psychic connection has yet to be determined.

entry: POKENAME喜欢用喙和爪破坏成熟庄稼，以折磨农夫为乐。它会在带来阴霾的双翼上聚集灵体能量，再释放破坏力惊人的暗影球。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME delights in tormenting farmers by destroying their ripe crops with its beak and claws. It gathers spectral energy on its gloom-bringing wings, then unleashes devastating Shadow Ball attacks.

entry: POKENAME在战斗一开始就会投出发光的球体，在落点形成无形的墙。这些墙能强到足以挡住车辆。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hurls glowing orbs of light the moment combat begins, creating invisible walls wherever they land. These walls can grow strong enough to stop a vehicle.

entry: POKENAME把栖身的楔石装在前面的袋子里，若楔石丢失或被盗，就会大发雷霆。它会寻找负面情绪，必须将108份这样的情绪吸入石内，才能进化。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME carries its housing keystone in its front pouch and will cause an outburst if the keystone is lost or stolen. It seeks out negative emotions and must absorb 108 such feelings into the stone before it can evolve.

entry: POKENAME会从尾巴射出闪电，让电光倾泻四周，炫耀强大的电力。闪电击中后留下的焦痕，会散发幽灵般的雾气。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME shows off its vast electric power by shooting lightning from its tail and raining it down on its surroundings. Spots struck by its lightning bolts will emit a ghostly mist from the scorch marks left behind.

entry: POKENAME以贪吃闻名，会在墓园里寻找留给逝者的供品，不管能不能吃都会吞下。许多富裕家庭会雇守卫，防止它惊扰这些供物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a reputation for being gluttons. They wander graveyards in search of offerings left for the dead, eatng them regardless of whether they are edible. Many affluent families hire guards to prevent POKENAME from disturbing these tributes.

entry: 组成POKENAME的灵魂会合力绕圈游动，试图托起并悬住束缚它们的重石。若其他方法都失败，它们就会先飞到束缚所允许的最远处，再猛然冲向相反方向。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The spirits that make up POKENAME work together to swim in circles, trying to lift and suspend the heavy stones that bind them. Should all else fail, they instead fly as far as their tether will let them before launching in the opposite direction.

entry: POKENAME会到神社附近跳舞，以前来祈祷的人为猎物。许多受害者都说，先是感到一阵冷风，随后便陷入极度疲惫。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME approaches shrines to dance, preying on those who come to offer prayers. Many who fall victim to it report feeling a cold breeze before intense fatigue sets in.

entry: POKENAME诞生于崩溃社会的废墟，出没在曾奴役自己祖先的工厂中。
author: thropp
source: Born from the ruins of a failed society, POKENAME haunts the factories that enslaved its ancestors.

entry: POKENAME总会随心所欲地舔东西，把每种味道留在舌头后部，以免忘记。它只要舔一舔，就能偷走其他宝可梦的味觉，因为它想独占对方过去尝过的滋味。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME has a habit of constantly licking whatever it wishes, keeping each taste on the back of its tongue so it won't forget. It can steal another Pokémon's sense of taste by just licking them, as it wants to keep their past tastes to itself.

entry: 摆脱楔石的束缚后，POKENAME学会将曾经困住自己的岩石用作武器。它会向敌人齐射带着幽灵能量的石块。
author: coridiant
source: Having broken free from its keystone confinement, POKENAME has learned to use the rocks trapping it as weapons instead. It launches ghostly volleys of stone towards its enemies.

entry: POKENAME会以盘旋的身体引诱毫无戒心的人类与宝可梦。猎物一旦被迷住，它就用藤蔓将其缠住，吸取能量。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME uses its swirling body to lure in unsuspecting humans and Pokémon. Once enthralled, POKENAME will wrap its vines around its prey and drain their energy.

entry: POKENAME会闯入发电厂，迅速冲向附近的设备与机械，试图将其拆毁。为应对这些突袭，人们雇用了许多夜间守卫和幽灵属性宝可梦，防范电网崩溃。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME breaks into power plants, quickly rushing to any nearby equipment and machinery and attempting to tear them down. Due to these sudden attacks, many night guards and Ghost-types have been hired to stop the risk of a grid collapse.

entry: POKENAME在废弃炼油厂作祟，用炮筒喷出有毒烟雾，制造工厂仍在运作的假象。困惑的管理人员被引来后，烟雾又会让他们以为大楼着了火。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME haunts abandoned oil refineries, using its cannons to blow out a toxic smog, making the illusion that the refinery is still operational. When this lures in confused managers, the smog starts to makes them believe the building is on fire.

entry: POKENAME对敌意和争斗十分敏感。为了让自己安心，它会从石中现身，诅咒周围的对象，强行清除其脑中的负面想法，全然不顾这会造成怎样的精神损害。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very sensitive to hostility and strife. To give itself peace of mind, it emerges from its stone to curse those around it and forcibly remove any negative thoughts from their minds, no matter the adverse mental effects this creates.

entry: 楔石遇险时，POKENAME会以幽灵能量构成球体，将它包住。随后，球体便高速滚动，带着石头一起抵达安全处。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME's keystone is in danger, it surrounds it with ghostly energy in the form of a sphere. It then rolls the sphere away at high speed, carrying the stone to safety with it.

entry: POKENAME会用翅膀散播恶灵，让周围的一切陷入混乱。若它试图高速飞远，一股神秘力量就会强行把它拽回楔石。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its wings to scatter evil spirits and cause chaos to everything around it. If it attempts to fly far away at a high speed, a mysterious force will forcefully pull it back into its Odd Keystone.

entry: 据说，死去植物的灵魂汇聚到同一块石头里，就会形成POKENAME。它抽取附近植物的生命精华，维持生存。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to be formed when the spirits of deceased plants conglomerate into a single stone. It siphons the life essence from nearby plantlife in order to sustain itself.

entry: POKENAME每次显形，楔石周围的温度都会大幅下降。石头摸起来总是冰凉，并覆着一层薄霜。
author: sk372
source: The temperature around POKENAME's keystone drops significantly whenever it manifests itself. The stone is always cool to the touch and covered with a faint layer of frost.

entry: POKENAME蛰伏时会紧贴岩壁，纹丝不动。饥饿时，它会突然从墙上跃下，扑向猎物，凝聚能使人麻痹的幽灵能量为尖刺，发动攻击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME clings to rock walls while it lies dormant, remaining completely motionless. When it hungers, it leaps from the wall suddenly to swoop at its prey, creating a stinger of paralyzing ghostly energy to attack with.

entry: POKENAME的身体是一整块巨大的楔石，用来束缚体内的火焰。火焰偶尔会漏出来，挥打附近的敌人。有趣的是，这些火焰常会造成冻伤。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME's body is one giant keystone meant to keep its flames restrained. The flames occasionally leak out to swipe at nearby foes. Interestingly, the flames often inflict frostbite.

entry: 它由108种病毒与恶意程序组成。一旦释放，可能毁掉整个互联网，以及所有相连之物。
author: soup1900
source: A Pokémon made up of 108 viruses and malware programs. Releasing it could destroy the entire internet and everything connected to it.

entry: 据说，POKENAME由108个病毒和恶意程序组成。一些科学家认为，放出它可能摧毁整个互联网及其连接的一切。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is said to be a Pokémon made up of 108 viruses and malware programs. Some scientists believe that releasing it could destroy the entire internet and everything connected to it.

entry: 一名疯狂科学家将两只宝可梦融合，想把花岩怪永远封在数字世界。结果却未能如愿。
author: soup1900
source: A mad scientist fused these two Pokémon, thinking he could permanently seal Spiritomb into the digital world. It didn't work as planned.

entry: POKENAME气态身体经过的土地会变得极其肥沃，有时几分钟内便长出花朵或苔藓。它身上的气味宛如刚割过的青草。
author: .izik
source: Dirt that POKENAME's gaseous body passes over becomes extremely fertile, sometimes sprouting flowers or moss within minutes. The aroma that wafts from its body resembles freshly cut grass.

entry: POKENAME会保护生长着自己最爱树果的葱郁树林。它激动时，腕上的锋利叶片会分离，听从它的意志，割向惹恼它的对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME acts in defense of verdant groves that grow its favorite berries. The sharp leaves on its wrists separate and act according to its will when it grows agitated, cutting at those who have vexed POKENAME.

entry: 看似沉寂的雕像里，其实住着一个强大的灵魂。它栖居在丛林，几乎任何人或事物只要靠近，就会被灵魂吸收，让它继续壮大。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: What looks like a dormant statue actually holds a powerful spirit. It resides in the jungle, where almost anyone or anything that gets close will be absorbed by the spirit, allowing it to grow.

entry: 据说，POKENAME由因森林砍伐而丧生的灵魂汇聚而成，如今以统一的意识行动。它们会在狂怒中掀毁铁路、弄塌隧道。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are said to be coalescences of spirits that were killed by deforestation that now function as unified consciousnesses. They tear up railways and collapse tunnels in a blind rage.

entry: POKENAME会以极其凶猛的踢击释放诅咒灵力，沿途留下发光的绿色幽火。它用融入暗影的武术蒙蔽敌人，再从对方的视线死角发动攻击。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME channels cursed spirit energy through hyper-aggressive kicks. It leaves trails of glowing green wisps in its wake, using shadow-infused martial arts to blind enemies before striking from their blind spots.

entry: POKENAME会在能与自己一试身手的强者面前显形。它出招快得惊人，一分钟内能打出共108次拳击与踢击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME manifests in the presence of strong fighters it can test its mettle against. It strikes with incredible speed, able to swing 108 punches and kicks within the span of a minute.

entry: POKENAME藏在泥水洼中，等别人经过时跳出来吓唬。若对方没被吓到，它就会因乐趣被毁而恼火，向对方踢泥。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides in mud puddles waiting for others to walk by so it can leap out and scare them. If they do not get scared by its antics, it angrily kicks mud at them for ruining its fun.

entry: POKENAME在岸边狩猎时，灵体会明亮地发光。它先用厚厚的泥裹住猎物，再将其拖入水下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's ethereal body glows brightly while it hunts near the shoreline. It cakes prey in mud before dragging them beneath the water's surface.

entry: POKENAME栖居的湖泊常有令人不安的声音传闻，听起来像孩子哭泣或尖叫。调查后才发现，那其实是它的鼾声。
author: .izik
source: Lakes that POKENAME inhabits frequently receive reports of unsettling noises resembling crying children and screams. Upon investigation, these turn out to be the sounds it makes while snoring.

entry: POKENAME在楔石内也能感知别人的情绪。若察觉善良的人陷入困境或危险，它就会从石头的角上现身，前去相助。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can sense the emotions of others from within its keystone. If it senses a kind person in distress or danger, it manifests from the stone's horn to come to their aid.

entry: POKENAME虽然看起来像普通的拉鲁拉丝，但这并非它的真身。据说，它头内的楔石能吸收各种灵魂，无论无害还是恶毒。
author: beatdoof
source: Despite its resemblance to a typical Ralts, it's not POKENAME's true form. The Odd Keystone in its head is said to be able to absorb all types of spirits within, whether harmless or malicious.

entry: POKENAME能操控并扭曲周围的空气，使其中的对象窒息，也遮蔽它们的身影。据说，它正是靠头顶的楔石制造这种危险的气泡。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME is able to manipulate and distort the air around it, suffocating and obscuring those within from view. It is said that the Odd Keystone atop its head is how it creates this dangerous bubble.

entry: POKENAME平时虽然友善，但只要喝下鲜血，就会陷入无法遏止的狂乱。即使被石枷束缚，它们在战斗中仍是可怕而凶残的对手。
author: mepp.
source: Though usually friendly, POKENAME are known to fly into an unstoppable frenzy should they ever consume blood. Despite being bound by a stone pillory, they are fearsome and savage opponents to face in battle.

entry: 野生POKENAME收割幽灵宝可梦的灵魂，想挣脱胸口嵌着的楔石。有些人推测，若与强大训练家结下羁绊，也会开始吸取对方的生命。
author: cinnamoone_redfield
source: A wild POKENAME harvests the souls of Ghost-types in hopes of breaking free of the Odd Keystone embedded in its chest. If it bonds with a strong Trainer, some theorize it will begin to feed off of their life force as well.

entry: POKENAME从石头背面的洞口扭动着探出身子，似乎无法完全藏回去。有人说，寄宿其中的灵魂并不稳定，必须吸收其他灵魂，才能暂时缓解不适。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME writhes about from the hole in the back of its stone, and seems unable to fully hide itself within. Some say the spirits inhabiting it are unstable and must absorb the souls of others to temporarily relieve their discomfort.

entry: POKENAME以年轻训练家给予的喜爱为食，维持生存。有人声称，年轻的灵魂在它巨口中躁动不安，而每当察觉无法逃避的命运，总已为时太晚。
author: cynnsalternate
source: To sustain itself, POKENAME feeds upon the affection it receives from young Trainers. Some claim the souls of the young are restless in its maw, always too late to realize their inevitable fate.

entry: POKENAME的石质身体内会发酵出酸液。由于下颚无法咀嚼，它会从角上放出酸液，先溶解食物再进食。
author: riley_muir_qu33n_in_yellow
source: An acidic liquid ferments within POKENAME's stone body. It releases the acid from its horn, dissolving food prior to eating it as POKENAME's jaw cannot chew.

entry: POKENAME全身会变换颜色与质感，与楔石接触的任何表面保持一致。这伪装近乎完美，但若宝可梦或人类碰到楔石，它就会露馅。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME's whole body changes color and texture to match that of whatever surface its keystone comes in contact with. While nearly perfect camouflage, POKENAME's disguise is exposed if a Pokémon or human touches its keystone.

entry: POKENAME石内的众多灵魂会凝成灵体手臂，让它四处漂浮，或抓住并碾压来犯者。不过，灵魂们并非完全步调一致，因此它有时会举止反常。
author: sk372
source: The many spirits inhabiting POKENAME's stone manifest a spiritual arm that allows it to float around or grab and crush aggressors. The spirits are not entirely in sync, however, causing it to behave erratically at times.

entry: 随着POKENAME的石质头部长大，它在操纵灵体手臂时，体内原本不和的灵魂也逐渐学会合作。不过，用手臂做大多数战斗以外的事情，它仍十分吃力。
author: beatdoof
source: As POKENAME's stone head grows, the disharmonious spirits dwelling within slowly become more cooperative with one another as it controls its spiritually manifested arms. Though it still struggles with using its arms for most non-combative purposes.

entry: 战斗中，POKENAME的气态部分能短暂与实体完全分离。它能从远处指挥这部分身体，仿佛在操纵木偶。
author: .izik
source: The gaseous portion of POKENAME's body can fully separate from its solid form during combat for short periods. It commands this detached portion from afar like a marionette controlling a puppet.

entry: POKENAME头内有108颗大脑，每颗都像人脑一样，能理解复杂想法、思考并作出理性判断。研究虽发现它许多念头都涉及诅咒与咒骂，它却似乎从未付诸行动。
author: beatdoof
source: Within POKENAME's head reside 108 brains, each able to comprehend, think, and rationalize complex thoughts like the human mind. While research shows many of its thoughts included hexes and maledictions, it has seemingly never acted upon them.

entry: POKENAME即使藏在楔石内，龅牙也会持续生长。显形后，它会啃咬自己的石头，防止牙齿长得过大，妨碍行动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's buck teeth continue to grow even when it is hidden within its keystone. It gnaws on its own stone when manifested in order to keep them from growing too large and cumbersome.

entry: 过量的灵体能量让POKENAME向内坍缩。低语从盘旋的巨口深处传来，它伸手招引，将虚弱疲惫的对象纳入掌控。
author: xillo
source: Excess spiritual energies have caused POKENAME to collapse in on itself. Whispers call from the depths of its swirling maw, and with beckoning hands this Pokémon draws the weak and weary into its thrall.

entry: POKENAME的身体与楔石由奇异的气场相连，分开后总会在几秒内重新出现在石旁。它会将石头抛向战场各处，借此移动到有利位置。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME's body always appears near its keystone within seconds of being separated, as they are linked by an odd aura. POKENAME will toss the stone around the battlefield to get to advantageous positions.

entry: 束缚POKENAME的石盘刻着奇异图案，有人声称那是只有龙才能读懂的文字。科学已经推翻这种说法，证明图案是随机生成的，每个个体都独一无二。
author: .izik
source: The stone disc POKENAME is bound to is etched with odd patterns that some claim are a language only dragons can understand. Science has since disproven this, showing the patterns are unique to each individual POKENAME and generated at random.

entry: 雾夜里，POKENAME会跃到高得惊人的空中，使一些人误以为它会飞。传说，它若经过住宅上方，住户就会遭受可怕的诅咒。
author: .izik
source: On foggy nights POKENAME leaps through the air at incredible height, leading some to falsely claim it is flying. Legend states that if it passes over a home, the residents will suffer a terrible curse.

entry: POKENAME虽有光滑流畅的外形，却是沉重笨拙的巨兽。它的灵体能量蕴含强大力量，厚重装甲也让它能用锋利双臂发动凶狠攻击，在大地留下深深的裂痕。
author: vic1312
source: Despite their sleek, streamlined appearance, POKENAME are lumbering, heavy beasts. Their spiritual energy is dense with power and their heavy armor lends itself to brutal attacks with their sharp arms. Their attacks can leave deep rents in the earth.

entry: 乍看之下，POKENAME像一座活过来的星座。其实这只是幻象，用来催眠毫无戒心的受害者，诱使对方靠近，好吞食其能量。
author: zeterzero
source: At a glance POKENAME looks like a living constellation, but this is just an illusion meant to hypnotize unsuspecting victims into approaching so it can feed on their energy.

entry: 秋日祭典的夜里，POKENAME会产生在黑暗中发光的孢子团。孢子团若落到地上，就会发出哀号，吓到附近的宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: During nights of fall festivals, POKENAME produce spore clusters that glow in the dark. If any of the spore clusters lands on the ground, they produce a wailing noise that spook nearby Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME忠于巢穴首领，不论对方如何取得地位。它们会附身其他生灵的灵魂，迫使对方服从。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are loyal to their den leader, regardless of how they came to power. They force others into submission by possessing their spirit.

entry: POKENAME的假嘴里寄宿着一团盘旋的幽灵能量。据说，任何被抓进嘴里的生灵，灵魂都会被吞噬，再储存在它的楔石内。
author: sk372
source: A swirling mass of ghostly energy resides within POKENAME's false mouth. It's said that any creature snatched up into the mouth will have its soul devoured and stored within POKENAME's keystone.

entry: 白天，POKENAME通常沉睡在形似根状化石的楔石内。它好奇心极强，会用覆有灵质的触手仔细探索新奇物品。
author: cait_sith
source: During the day, POKENAME usually slumbers within its keystone, which is shaped like a Root Fossil. It is incredibly curious and will thoroughly explore novel objects using its ectoplasm-coated tentacles.

entry: POKENAME的脖子能无尽伸长，咬住鸟宝可梦，再将其拖入海中。水手们发现它很容易察觉，因为身上滴下的幽灵酸液能一路浮到水面。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's neck can stretch endlessly, allowing it to bite onto bird Pokémon and drag them down into the sea. Sailors have noted that POKENAME is easy to notice, as the ghostly acid that drips from its body can float all the way to the surface.

entry: POKENAME会假扮成翻过身、无力自救的太古羽虫，静候猎物。捕食者以为能轻易饱餐一顿，游近时，它便从楔石里现身，将其完全包住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lies in wait, pretending to be an upturned and helpless Anorith. When predators swim near looking for an easy meal, POKENAME emerges from its keystone and envelops them completely.

entry: POKENAME会伏击猎物，目标常是寻找矿物的岩石属性宝可梦。化石猎人与古生物学家探洞时，也常遭野生个体袭击。因此，它们被视为守护化石的复仇之灵。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME ambush their prey, which are often Rock-type Pokémon searching for minerals. Fossil hunters and paleontologists are often attacked by wild POKENAME while caving. They have garnered a reputation as vengeful spirits that defend fossils.

entry: POKENAME会从栖身的化石中现身，抵御潜在伤害。它能让头骨暂时变得坚如钢铁，再用强力的头锤撞飞一切。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME emerges from the fossil it inhabits in order to protect itself from potential harm. It can temporarily harden its skull to be as solid as steel so that it can knock anything away with its powerful headbutts.

entry: POKENAME活动时，头骨撞击的雷鸣般巨响能传出数英里。唯一可靠的办法，是把它带到无法用头撞东西的地方，迫使它回到楔石。
author: quackquackattack
source: The thundering crack of POKENAME's skull can be heard for miles whenever it is active. The only reliable way of forcing it to return to its keystone is to bring it to a place where it cannot headbutt objects.

entry: POKENAME会使部分头骨凝实，抵挡攻击造成的伤害。此时敲击头骨会发出诡异哀号，令大多数生灵脊背发凉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME solidifies part of its skull in order to deflect damage from attacks. Striking its skull in this state produces an eerie wail that sends shivers down the spine of most creatures.

entry: POKENAME栖居在盾甲化石里，因而有人认为它是史前死去的护城龙的灵魂。它能使灵体的头骨凝实，硬到几乎能挡下任何攻击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME inhabiting an Armor Fossil caused some to believe it was the spirits of fallen Bastiodon from prehistory. It can solidify the skull of its spectral form in order to make it hard enough to stop almost any attack in its tracks.

entry: POKENAME十分懒惰，不愿费力完全显形，因此很少能看见它的全貌。通常，只有为了把楔石移到离食物更近的地方，它才会这么做。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is only occasionally seen in full due to its lazy nature making it not want to put the effort into manifesting its full form. It typically only does so in order to move its keystone somewhere closer to food.

entry: POKENAME石内的众多灵魂都生性懒惰，很少愿意费力完全显形。但若打扰它休息，就会招致极其迅速凶猛的反击。
author: sk372
source: The many spirits inhabiting POKENAME's stone are all lazy by nature, rarely exerting the effort to manifest its full form. Disturbing it while it rests, however, will incite a very quick and violent retaliation.

entry: POKENAME统领着自己的巢穴。同巢成员必须献上大量食物安抚它，否则它就会随机附身一名成员，威吓其他同伴。对袭击巢穴的对象，它绝不留情。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rules as leader of its dens. It must be appeased by its den mates with plenty of food, or it will possess a random den member to strike fear into others. It spares no mercy to those who attack its den.

entry: POKENAME头骨状面具后，能听见许多不同声音在哭泣。传闻，若有人听懂它们低语的话，就会受到终身诅咒。
author: .izik
source: Sounds of many different voices can be heard weeping from behind POKENAME's skull-shaped mask. Rumors say that if one ever understands the words they whisper, they will be cursed for life.

entry: 葬礼周围的情感能量会吸引POKENAME，常使出席者十分不安。许多人相信它们正恶意等着吸收人的灵魂，但这说法尚未得到证实。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are lured to the emotional energy around funeral rites, often to the dismay of those attending. Many believe they are maliciously waiting to absorb a person's soul, a claim that has yet to be proven.

entry: 许多人曾相信POKENAME是由最凶恶的灵魂组成的恶灵。据说，环绕它漂浮的幽灵能量球，是试图逃离群体、造成更大破坏的灵魂。
author: sk372
source: Many once believed POKENAME was an evil spirit made up of the most heinous of souls. The orbs of ghostly energy floating around it were said to be souls attempting to escape the collective in order to wreak greater havoc.

entry: 若亡魂不肯随POKENAME前往灵界，它就会诅咒其家人。诅咒会给这家人带来种种祸乱，最终，它会将所有家人的灵魂都据为己有。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is known to curse the families of deceased souls who refuse to be taken to the spirit realm by it. These curses cause lots of mayhem for the family and end with POKENAME taking all their souls for itself.

entry: POKENAME不在灵界时，周围那些巨大的绿色灵魂会完全控制它的行动。由于这些灵魂往往心怀恶意，它便因洗劫村庄、吞食所有村民的灵魂而闻名。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME isn't in the spirit world, the large green souls around it gain full control over its actions. As these spirits are often malevolent, POKENAME became known for ransacking villages and eating the souls of everyone there.

entry: POKENAME不在灵界时，周围那些巨大的绿色灵魂会完全控制它的行动。由于这些灵魂往往心怀恶意，它便因摧毁房屋、随意夺走他人的灵魂而闻名。
author: soup1900
source: While POKENAME isn't in the spirit world, the large green souls around it gain full control over its actions. As these spirits are often malevolent, POKENAME became known for destroying homes and taking the souls of anyone it chooses.

entry: POKENAME会贪婪地吞食其他生灵，将其灵魂加入原已庞大的灵体，使自己越来越大、越来越强。当它将双手探入地下时，就是在把影响力过大的灵魂送入灵界。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME becomes larger and stronger by gorging on others, adding their souls to its already plentiful spirit construct. When it plants its hands through the ground, it is depositing souls that have become too influential into the spirit world.

entry: POKENAME的身体大多由魔法石构成，阻止它外出吞食所有人。它的真身只是巨大石像内的面孔，以及周围漂浮的灵魂。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's body is mostly made of a magical stone that prevents POKENAME from going out and swallowing everyone. The true body is only the face within the large stone figure, and the souls floating around.

entry: 有些传说认为，1000个灵魂附身阿尔宙斯雕像，获得意识与难以想象的力量，形成了POKENAME。据说，凝视它躯干周围盘旋的光环，能让人一窥来世。
author: sk372
source: Some legends say POKENAME is the result of 1000 souls possessing an Arceus statue and achieving sentience and untold power. Gazing into the swirling aura ring around its torso is said to give a person a glimpse into the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME头上长出的灵体叶片，受到过多阳光照射时会缩回体内。这些叶片极其敏感，若得到妥善训练，就会随着它受到的喜爱增多而长大。
author: .izik
source: The ethereal leaves growing from POKENAME's head retract into its body when exposed to too much sunlight. These leaves are extremely sensitive and grow larger based on how much affection it receives when properly trained.

entry: 种子能种在POKENAME的石头背上，似乎生长得相当顺利。不过，从石头上长出的植物，夜里往往会散发幽灵般的绿光。
author: sk372
source: Seeds can be planted on the back of POKENAME's stone and grow with seemingly little issue. Plants that grow from its stone do tend to emit a ghostly green glow at night, however.

entry: POKENAME在墓园徘徊，它的存在能赶走滋事者。传闻，死者的灵魂安息在它壳内的墓室里。
author: addithewise
source: Wandering through graveyards, POKENAME's presence wards away hooligans. There are rumors that spirits of the dead rest in the crypt of its shell.

entry: POKENAME的壳似乎连接着灵界。压力极大时，灵魂便会现身，施展种种幽灵之力，保护它。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's shell appears to function as a connection to the spirit world. During times of high stress, spirits will manifest and come to POKENAME's defense, using all manner of ghastly powers.

entry: POKENAME会把束缚自己的楔石扔下山坡，让它落到旅人身旁。它是个淘气的家伙，很喜欢突然冒出来，吓人一跳。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME throws the keystone it is bound to off of mountainsides to land next to travellers. A mischievous Pokémon, it loves popping out to surprise humans.

entry: POKENAME野心勃勃又大胆，常挑战巢穴里的等级秩序。有些个体成功以灵魂附身的方式挑战了巢中的雄性首领，使同巢成员因恐惧而臣服。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are ambitious and daring, often challenging the hierarchy of their dens. Some have successfully challenged the patriarch of the nest through spiritual possession, causing their den mates to submit out of fear.

entry: POKENAME玩耍时，体内的灵魂会兴奋地嚎叫。每当它们胡闹，这些混杂刺耳的叫声就会吵得其他宝可梦夜不能寐。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME engages in playful behavior, the spirits within its body howl with excitement. These howls create a cacophony of noise that keeps other Pokémon up at night when they are up to shenanigans.

entry: POKENAME消耗大量能量后，会退回楔石。恢复力量的过程中，楔石会逐渐发热。
author: .izik
source: After expending a large amount of energy, POKENAME retreats within its keystone. During this time the keystone gradually heats up as it regains its strength.

entry: POKENAME会吹出大量由幽灵能量构成的气泡，试图恐吓体型更大的宝可梦。气泡十分脆弱，但每次破裂都会发出尖锐可怕的声响。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tries to intimidate larger Pokémon by blowing a large amount of bubbles made of ghostly energy. The bubbles are weak, but make shrill and ghastly noises with each pop.

entry: 靠近沉船或有人溺亡的地方时，POKENAME身旁漂浮的幽灵球体会变得更亮。有人说，是附近的灵魂增强了光芒。
author: .izik
source: The ghastly orbs floating near POKENAME's body grow brighter near shipwrecks and locations where people have drowned. Some say the light is strengthened by the souls nearby.

entry: POKENAME在古堡里作祟，自认为是高于其他宝可梦的王族。它对古典音乐兴趣浓厚，只要研究者在所住的城堡外播放，它就会出来聆听。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME haunts ancient castles, as it sees itself as royalty and above other Pokémon. It's known to have a keen interest in classical music, as whenever researchers play it outside the castle it resides in, it'll come outside and listen.

entry: 野生POKENAME行动缓慢，一天只走几步。传闻，它正试图永不停歇地走向将花岩怪封入楔石者的后代，对他们施加诅咒。为了节省能量，它几乎从不攻击其他对象。
author: bobosmith01
source: Wild POKENAME moves slowly: only a few steps a day. Rumors suggest it is trying to eternally advance towards the descendants of those who sealed Spiritomb into its keystone in order to curse them. To save energy, it almost never attacks others.

entry: POKENAME会结合磁力与灵力，将对手拉向自己，再用小型飞行器困住对方，为攻击蓄力。鼻子下的胡子其实是嘴，只是始终保持静止，借此蒙骗别人。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME combines its magnetic pull and spiritual powers to pull opponents towards it, using its drones to trap them while it charges an attack. The mustache below its nose is actually its mouth, just in a constant static state to trick others.

entry: 没人知道是谁最先将花岩怪的108个灵魂封存为POKENAME的形态，但对方很可能心怀恶意。在专业人员前来将它控制住之前，它会诱人握住剑柄，借机偷走灵魂。
author: .fedoraman
source: No one knows who first stored Spiritomb's 108 souls in the form of a POKENAME, but they likely had evil intentions. Until professionals arrive to contain it, it tempts people to grasp its hilt so that it can steal their souls.

entry: 插在地上的剑散发微弱的气息，迫使人们想将它拔出。一旦靠得太近，附身于剑的灵魂便会猛烈袭击，试图增加同伴的数量。
author: sk372
source: The sword embedded in the ground emits a faint aura that compels people to try and pull it out. Once they venture too close, the spirits possessing the sword lash out and attack in an attempt to add to their numbers.

entry: POKENAME会让剑刃散发微光，诱使别人尝试把它从石中拔出。一旦拔出，穗带就会缠住对方，控制其心智，迫使对方听凭它摆布。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME emits a faint glow from its blade in order to compel others to try to pull it from the stone. Once they do so, its tassel wraps around them and takes hold of their mind, forcing them to obey its whims.

entry: POKENAME每天都会打磨刀刃状的楔石，使其保持最佳状态。若其中一块石头受损，另一块就会陷入疯狂的劈砍。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sharpens its blade-shaped keystones daily to keep them in top condition. If either stone gets damaged, it will cause the other to fly into a slashing frenzy.

entry: 据说，POKENAME体内容纳着历史上数百名骑士的灵魂。握住它的剑与盾后，举止便会开始变得更加英勇高尚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to carry the souls of hundreds of knights from history within it. Those who take hold of its blade and shield begin acting more gallant and noble.

entry: POKENAME在巢穴附近凶猛活跃，却无法离开楔石超过一定距离。由于走不远，许多个体最终会欺负同巢伙伴，逼它们外出带回食物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are aggressive and active around their dens but cannot travel farther than a set distance from their keystone. Due to being unable to travel far, many end up bullying their den mates to travel and bring back food.

entry: POKENAME头脑简单，意志也相对薄弱。谁最后碰过楔石，它就会盲目听从谁的命令。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a simple mind and a relatively weak will. It will blindly follow the commands of whomever most recently touched its keystone.

entry: 凝视POKENAME的楔石太久，就会被迫服从耳边无形声音低语的命令。命令主要是向楔石献上食物或小饰品。
author: sk372
source: Those who gaze at POKENAME's keystone for too long become compelled to follow orders whispered by an unseen voice in their ears. These orders mainly consist of presenting offerings of food or trinkets to the keystone.

entry: POKENAME身体散发的诡异蒸气，会间歇性地随电能脉动。悲伤时，它会释放电磁脉冲，使附近的电子设备失灵。
author: .izik
source: The eerie vapor that emanates from POKENAME's body pulses intermittently with electrical energy. When it is sad, it releases electromagnetic pulses that can disable nearby electronics.

entry: POKENAME整个身体都是容纳它的楔石，用来封住庞大的灵体形态。战斗中受损时，它会短暂离开身体，用岩石修补受损的部位。
author: bigoljax
source: The keystone that contains POKENAME makes up its entire body, as it needs to keep its massive spectral appearance contained. When damaged in battle, it briefly leaves its body, using rocks to fix whatever body part has been damaged.

entry: 沙漠里昏暗的傍晚，POKENAME会从楔石中现身。双翼会产生幽灵能量之雾，以及奇怪的振动嗡鸣；两者都会让近处的生灵迷失方向并产生幻觉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME emerges from its keystone during the dark desert evenings. Its wings create a mist of ghostly energy as well as a strange, vibrating buzzing noise, both of which cause disorientation and hallucinations in those within close range.

entry: POKENAME在轻柔的湖浪中游动，身体泛着美丽的紫光与绿光。尽管外表如此，有人却说，只要看见它，就注定有可怕的诅咒降临它栖居的湖泊。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims within the gentle waves of lakes, its body glowing with a beautiful violet and green light. Despite its appearance, some say spotting one ensures a terrible curse will befall any lake it inhabits.

entry: POKENAME离开楔石的距离有限。许多训练家发现，它在空中飞得又快又远时最开心；但只有让另一只飞行迅捷的宝可梦载着楔石同行，它才能做到。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a limited range that it can be away from its keystone. Many Trainers find that POKENAME is happiest when it can soar fast and far in the sky, a feat only possible when its keystone is riding alongside another swift flying Pokémon.

entry: 组成这种宝可梦的灵魂原本意识统一，如今开始分成几个不同的集体意识。虽然它们常因此分神，但仍会合力打败任何胆敢来袭的对象。
author: infinex21
source: The once-unified spirits that this Pokémon consists of have begun to split into different collective minds. While this keeps them distracted often enough, they will still work together to defeat anything that dares attack them.

entry: 据说，它曾吸收他人的恶意与绝望，替对方免受这些情绪之苦，自己却反被吞噬。如今，别人只要显露一丝邪念，它就会凶狠地发动攻击。
author: infinex21
source: It is said to have been consumed by the malice and despair of others that it had absorbed to spare those others of their own feelings. Now, this Pokémon lashes out viciously at others that show even the slightest sign of wickedness.

entry: POKENAME凭力量与恐惧统治族群。谁不肯服从命令，它就附身对方，迫使同巢伙伴制服这个不驯的成员，随后才退回楔石。这种骇人的经历，让很少有成员再敢反抗。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rules over its pack with strength and fear. Anyone who refuses to obey its command is possessed, forcing its den mates to subdue the unruly follower before returning to its keystone. This jarring experience leaves few to resist.

entry: 据说，POKENAME由整批死去海盗船员的灵魂组成。它们以沉没的海盗船为家，很少离船超过1000英尺。
author: bradlybro199
source: It is said that POKENAME is made of spirits of entire dead pirate crews. They rarely go further than 1000 feet from the sunken pirate ship they call home.

entry: POKENAME强大的灵体之力能撼动并移动星球的地壳，随心所欲地重塑大地。据说，数千年前第一片陆地形成时，它便诞生了。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's immense spectral power allows it to shake and move the very crust of the planet, reshaping it as it sees fit. It is said to have been born when the first landmass formed many millennia ago.

entry: POKENAME每次从石质容器中现身，周围的空气似乎都会静止。据说，若完全显形，它的身体会一直延伸到臭氧层。
author: sk372
source: The air surrounding POKENAME seems to grow still whenever it emerges from its stone container. It's said that if POKENAME fully manifested, its body would stretch all the way up to the ozone layer.

entry: POKENAME拥有操控时间并穿梭其中的能力。过去有些人崇拜它，相信它会吸收自己的灵魂，让自己成为它的一部分，经历所有时光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries the ability to manipulate and travel through time. Some people of the past worshiped POKENAME, believing that it would absorb their soul and allow them to experience all of time as a part of it.

entry: POKENAME尾巴连接的传送门，暗示寄宿在石制器物中的灵魂可能来自另一个维度空间。一些研究者推测，它甚至可能与究极空间和究极异兽有关。
author: sk372
source: The portal linked to POKENAME's tail suggests the spirits inhabiting the stone artifact may have come from some other dimensional space. Some researchers theorize it may even have a link to Ultra Space and Ultra Beasts.

entry: POKENAME被许多古老岩石束缚，真实力量受到压制，保持在可控程度。有人相信，若将它带往我们世界背面的另一个世界，石制枷锁就会解除，释放它真正的形态。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is bound by many ancient rocks that keep its true powers at a controllable level. It is believed that bringing it to a world on the reverse side of ours will remove these stone shackles and unleash its true form.

entry: POKENAME寄宿的身体拥有异乎寻常的力量，能轻易举起整栋建筑。但身体实在庞大，活动需要消耗大量灵力，过度使用便会疲惫不堪。
author: bigoljax
source: The body POKENAME inhabits holds unnatural strength, being able to lift up entire buildings with ease. Due to the sheer size of its body, it needs to use a hefty amount of spiritual power, which causes it to tire itself out after excessive use.

entry: POKENAME栖身的石像十分庞大，因此需要一点时间才能完全驱动。一旦让石头顺畅活动，它就会成为战场上几乎无法阻挡的巨像。
author: sk372
source: It takes a bit of time for POKENAME to fully mobilize the statue it inhabits due to its sheer size. Once it does manage to get the stone moving properly, it becomes a near-unstoppable colossus in battle.

entry: 被POKENAME幽灵能量碰到的对象，会陷入充满可怕噩梦的沉睡。据说，它以受害者在其影响下散发的恐惧为食。
author: sk372
source: Those touched by POKENAME's ghostly energy will fall into deep slumbers fraught with terrible nightmares. It is said to feast on the fear its victims emanate while under its influence.

entry: POKENAME栖居在石盘中，显形时环绕着石盘，向讨厌的对象轰出灵体能量。研究者发现，将石盘放在其他物体上，它便也能附身那些物体。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME inhabit stone discs, manifesting around the disc and launching blasts of spiritual energy at those they take a dislike to. Researchers have found that the discs can be placed on other objects, allowing POKENAME to possess those as well.

entry: POKENAME能读取交谈对象的心思，再不明显的谎言也瞒不过它。被欺骗时，它会让说谎者脑中闪现毁灭的景象，迫使对方迅速说出真相。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME can read the minds of those it interacts with, always knowing whenever someone tells it a lie, even if it isn't so obvious. When lied to, it flashes an image of destruction into the fabricator's mind, forcing them to quickly tell the truth.

entry: POKENAME的火焰最高可达108华氏度。它们喜欢向楔石以外的小石头喷火，借此取乐。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The flames from POKENAME can reach up to 108 F. They find joy in blasting fire at small stones that are not its keystone.

entry: 偶尔能在月下起舞的皮皮群中看见POKENAME，但其他宝可梦总会避开它。它会默默看上一整夜，在日出前消失。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are occasionally seen among gatherings of Clefairy dancing under the moon, but the other Pokémon always avoid it. After silently watching them all night, it will vanish just before sunrise.

entry: POKENAME能用灵体能量了解与它接触者的梦想，评判其是否正当。若认定梦想不道德，它便会电击有罪者，惩罚其堕落。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME can use spiritual energy to learn the dreams of those who interact with it, judging whether those dreams are righteous or not. When it deems a dream to be immoral, it electrocutes the guilty as punishment for their depravity.

entry: 有人认为，POKENAME是远古龙宝可梦的遗骸，被灵魂重新赋予了生命。任何东西只要碰到它的紫色火焰，就会瞬间冻结。
author: oejoeboy33
source: It is believed that POKENAME are the remains of ancient dragon Pokémon, reanimated by spirits. If anything happens to touch their purple flame, it will freeze in an instant.

entry: POKENAME格外喜爱无人照料的墓碑，总要确保墓前有一束鲜花。附近若没有花，它可能会从常有人祭拜的墓前偷来，向被遗忘的逝者致意。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME takes a special liking to abandoned tombstones, making sure they are never without a fresh bouquet of flowers. If there are no flowers around, it may steal them from more frequently visited graves to acknowledge the forgotten.

entry: 宝可梦家长的孩子失踪时，POKENAME会不知从何处冒出，恶毒地嘲弄家长。它制造孩子的幻影加以戏弄，再让幻影在对方面前消失，最后自己也消失。
author: bigoljax
source: When a Pokémon parent's child goes missing, POKENAME will appear from nowhere and viciously mock them. It taunts them by creating apparitions of their young, making them disappear before their eyes before it disappears itself.

entry: 据说，怀恨的长耳兔灵魂被困在洞穴的黏土中，形成了POKENAME。它阴森地守望平原，不断低声念诅咒，而咒语只有在附近出现威胁时才会生效。
author: ghostslythe
source: Said to be formed from aggrieved Lopunny spirits trapped in clay from their burrows, POKENAME stands menacing vigil over the plains. It constantly mutters curses that only activate when threats are nearby.

entry: POKENAME会用幽灵躯体出其不意地袭击对手。它从楔石的双臂伸出灵体肢体，以拉长的手臂从远处挥拳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its ghostly body to take unassuming opponents by surprise. It extends spectral limbs from the keystone's arms to land punches from far away with elongated arms.

entry: 日落时，POKENAME会高速飞过墓园，在墓碑间穿梭。若两只个体目光相接，就会开始竞速，直到太阳升起。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: At sunset POKENAME flies through graveyards at high speeds, zipping between tombstones. Should two POKENAME lock eyes they will race until the sun rises.

entry: POKENAME悄悄溜进住宅，藏入备受珍爱的毛绒玩具收藏中，安顿下来，以玩具承载的爱为食。训练家若发现家中有它，会发现它是极其忠诚、信任自己的伙伴。
author: vic1312
source: Sneaking into homes, POKENAME will nestle themselves into beloved plush collections, settling in and feeding on the love imbued into the toys. Trainers who notice POKENAME in their home find them to be fiercely loyal and trusting partners.

entry: POKENAME很容易附身电子设备，令设备闪烁、迸出火花。附近的人会听见许多声音，说着无法理解的语言。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME easily inhabits electronics, causing devices to flicker and spark. Those nearby hear many voices speaking in incomprehensible tongues.

entry: POKENAME会穿过人类与宝可梦的身体，体验其记忆，学习其知识。古老的鬼故事声称，束缚它的石头里装着大脑，并保存着这些景象，但无人见过内部。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME phase through people and Pokémon to experience their memories and study their knowledge. Ancient ghost stories claim that the stones that POKENAME are bound to contain their brains and archive these visions, but none have seen inside.

entry: POKENAME能飘上空中，却始终与楔石相连。满月时，它会尽可能飞高，将牵系拉到极限，却仍无法彻底离开地面。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can float up into the air, but always remains tethered to its keystone. If the moon is full, it will fly as high as it can, stretching its tether to its limit, but still unable to leave the ground behind.

entry: POKENAME是个爱恶作剧的家伙，喜欢从楔石里冒出来惹麻烦。现身时，除了吓到别人，它还会放出点点幽灵能量，令人喷嚏连连。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a prankster that loves to pop up from its keystone and cause trouble. Aside from startling others, it lets out little flecks of ghostly energy upon emerging that can cause sneezing fits.

entry: POKENAME极具攻击性，会从楔石中猛然窜出，追逐碰到石头的任何对象。一旦以这种方式锁定目标，不抓住对方就绝不罢休。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is highly aggressive and will lurch from its keystone to chase after anything that touches it. Once it has locked onto a target this way, it will never give up its pursuit until it has captured them.

entry: 古代王族曾用POKENAME守护最珍贵的宝物。当时人们相信，被它抓住的盗贼会遭抽取灵魂，永远困在它的幽灵躯体里。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME were used by ancient royalty to guard their most precious treasures. It was believed that any thieves that were caught by POKENAME would have their souls siphoned and trapped forever within its ghostly body.

entry: POKENAME会从楔石的多条肢体放出带电的幽灵能量丝。据说，被它织成的网缠住，能量就会被抽走，转入它的体内。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME generates threads made of electrified ghost energy from the multiple limbs of its keystone. It's said that those who get ensnared by the webs it weaves will have their energy drained and transferred into POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME靠周围三只壶状楔石维持形态稳定，每只壶都在不断散发孢子。吸入后，孢子会逐渐损害受害者的身体；研究发现，它们会变成铁刺。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's form is kept stable by the three pot-like keystones surrounding it, with each pot constantly emanating spores. If breathed in, these spores will slowly harm the victim's body, with studies showing the spores transforming into iron spikes.

entry: POKENAME筋疲力尽时，幽灵躯体会缩得只剩原来的一小部分。打鼾时，口中飘出点点余火，在黑暗里如烛光般闪烁。
author: .izik
source: When exhausted, the ghostly mass of POKENAME shrinks to a fraction of its size. Small embers escape its mouth as it snores, flickering like candlelight in the darkness.

entry: POKENAME身体的幽灵部分能轻松穿过实体。发怒时，它会释放威力压倒性的过热，烧焦附近的一切。
author: .izik
source: The ghostly portion of POKENAME's body can pass through solid matter effortlessly. When angered, it releases an overwhelming Overheat attack that scorches everything nearby.

entry: POKENAME伪装成古董吊灯，藏在古老豪华宅邸的天花板上。它主要盯上富人，等对方走到下方就落到其身上，造成三度烧伤和几处骨折。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a vintage chandelier, hiding up on the ceilings in old, fancy mansions. It mainly targets richer folk, waiting until they walk below it before dropping itself onto them, causing third-degree burns and a few broken bones.

entry: POKENAME与妖精属性宝可梦战斗时，盘旋的气态身体会变大。这更多是因为它极其害怕对方，而作出的威吓姿态。
author: .izik
source: The whirling gaseous portion of POKENAME's body grows larger when it fights Fairy types. This is more of a threat display driven by its overwhelming fear of them.

entry: 有人见过POKENAME守护古代神庙的遗迹，那些文明以神秘信仰闻名。据说，它体内寄宿着那些文明最后一批居民中部分人的灵魂。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been seen guarding the remains of temples related to civilizations known for their mystic beliefs. It is said POKENAME houses the souls of some of those civilizations' last inhabitants.

entry: POKENAME刚从楔石中现身时，能伪装成皮可西。有时人们会寻找它，祈求治愈，但真面目很快就会暴露，通常会把人吓跑。
author: .jerden
source: When first emerging from its keystone, POKENAME can disguise itself as a Clefable. People sometimes seek them out to wish for healing, but their true form will quickly be revealed, which usually frightens people away.

entry: 幽灵般的鬼火从POKENAME的多条尾巴飘出，环绕周身，充当护卫。目标一踏入范围，火焰就会飞出追踪，以灵火灼烧对方。
author: sk372
source: Ghostly will o' the wisps float off from POKENAME's multiple tails and swirl around it, acting as protective wards. They fly off and home in on a target the moment it steps within range, singing the target with spectral fire.

entry: POKENAME会突然近乎粗暴地从楔石中现身，打飞任何靠得太近的东西。身体露在外面时，石上的尖刺会稍稍浮起。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will emerge from its keystone in a sudden and almost violent manner to whack away anything getting too close. The spines on its stone will levitate slightly while its body is exposed.

entry: POKENAME钥匙状的楔石拥有神秘能力，能插入任何锁。它会撬开许多住宅的锁，偷走能找到的散落钥匙。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's key-shaped keystones have the mysterious ability to fit into any lock. It picks the locks of many a home in order to make off with any loose keys it can pilfer.

entry: 融合使楔石里的灵魂附身在鸟类身体上。据说，POKENAME身上散发的诡异绿色能量，就是那些曾被困在楔石中的灵魂的气息。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: Fusion has caused the spirits within the keystone to possess the avian body. The eerie, green energy emanating from POKENAME's body is said to be the ghostly aura of the spirits who were once trapped in the keystone.

entry: POKENAME喜欢住在昏暗的工厂，收集废料构筑身体。它极力保护真身，任何想靠近看清的对象，都会遭它猛烈攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers dimly lit factories as its home, gathering scrap to build its body. It is extremely protective of its true form and lashes out at anyone who draws too close to see it.

entry: POKENAME尽量藏在石内，只喜欢在阳光直射时现身。石头本身热得惊人，几乎能烧伤碰到的一切。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides within its stone as much as possible, preferring to emerge only in direct sunlight. The stone itself is incredibly hot, burning nearly anything it touches.

entry: POKENAME的脸被困在楔石内，视野受限。它会小心伸出幽灵能量的细丝，触探周围，辨别方向。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's face is trapped within its keystone, limiting its ability to see. It navigates by carefully slipping tendrils of ghostly energy around and feeling its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME显形时有两颗独立的头，彼此总是不和。常能看见其中一颗凶狠地试图把另一颗逼回楔石。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME manifests with two separate heads that are constantly at odds with each other. It is not uncommon to see one head aggressively try to force the other back into the keystone.

entry: 据说，POKENAME的破坏欲源于体内众多灵魂无法和睦共处。每当它从多块楔石中现身，所经之处都会遭到摧残。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's destructive urges are said to be due to the myriad of souls inhabiting it being unable to coexist properly. Whenever it manifests from its multiple keystones, it leaves devastation in its wake.

entry: POKENAME高速飞行时会发出响亮的哨声。有人说，若一夜内听见两次，附近很快就会有人死去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes a loud whistling noise while flying at high speeds. Some say that if the noise is heard twice in a single night, someone nearby will perish soon.

entry: POKENAME即使全速飞行，也能瞬间停下。据说，它每停留满108个地点，最后一处就会受到长达108年的诅咒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can halt its flight in an instant, even at top speed. It is said that every 108th location it stops at will be cursed for 108 years.

entry: POKENAME的每条尾巴里都有12个爱恶作剧的灵魂。据说，夜里能听见它们的哀号。
author: moonfoxfire
source: POKENAME's tails each contain 12 mischievous spirits. It is said that at night, you can hear their wails.

entry: POKENAME周围散发的能量辐射极强，但波及半径很小，不会造成中毒风险。许多人推测，它会在灾难后出没于损毁的核电站，以残留辐射为食。
author: bigoljax
source: The energy that emanates around POKENAME is incredibly radioactive, but causes no risk of poisoning due to the small radius. Many theorists say it haunts destroyed nuclear power plants after disasters, feeding off the lingering radiation.

entry: 有故事说，108个恶毒的愿望结合在一起，创造了POKENAME。它不断试图实现这些愿望，因此为了安全而被束缚在楔石上。
author: aberry8286
source: There are stories that say 108 malicious wishes combined to create POKENAME. It constantly attempts to make them come true, so it was bound to the keystone for safety.

entry: 纪念树的根部常受这种宝可梦困扰，尤其是土里混有骨灰的树。据说，它们吃的并非树根本身，而是逝者的记忆。
author: santon5512
source: The roots of memorial trees are often plagued by these Pokémon, especially those with ashes mixed into the soil. It is said that these Pokémon feed on the memories of the lost rather than the roots themselves.

entry: POKENAME会啃咬垂死的树，用残木在长河上筑起巨大的水坝，阻断水流。它牙上覆有灵体除草剂，让以树干为食的宝可梦因担心中毒，不得不另寻食物。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME gnaws on dying trees, using the remains to build large, hindering dams across long rivers. Its teeth are coated with a ethereal herbicide, forcing Pokémon that feed off trunks to look for other food sources due to the risk of poisoning.

entry: POKENAME大部分气场都储存在石质身体里。它通常住在墓园，安慰悲伤的吊唁者。
author: lydiaprower8
source: Most of POKENAME's aura is stored in its stone-like body. It usually resides in graveyards to comfort grievers.

entry: POKENAME很少肯花费能量，让整个灵体从楔石里完全显形。它主要在需要进食时才这样做，而且吃得极慢。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rarely exerts the energy needed to manifest its whole ghostly form out of its keystone. It mainly does so when it needs to eat, a process it does at an incredibly slow rate.

entry: POKENAME一从石中现身，就会精力过剩地大闹，狂乱地扭动、尖叫。只有彻底耗尽体力后才会退回楔石，而这可能需要几天。
author: sk372
source: As soon as POKENAME emerges from its stone, it goes on a hyperactive rampage, flailing about and screeching wildly. It only retreats back to the keystone once it has exhausted itself, which could take days.

entry: POKENAME靠弹跳硕大圆润的楔石来移动。石头虽重得普通人很难举起，却能凭它的力量轻松浮在水面。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME moves by bouncing its large and rounded keystone about. Though the stone is quite heavy for the average person to lift, it can float upon the water's surface easily thanks to POKENAME's powers.

entry: POKENAME的幽灵躯体自然散发微光，快速小跑时会迸出点点火花。它生性友好，会带领迷路的旅人穿过黑暗，抵达安全处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's ghostly body naturally emits a faint glow, casting off small sparks when it trots at higher speeds. It is friendly by nature and will lead lost travelers through the darkness to somewhere safe.

entry: POKENAME逸出的气态部分总是电光噼啪作响。即使平静时，也会电到触碰它的对象。
author: .izik
source: The gaseous portion that escapes from POKENAME's form is always crackling with electrical energy. Even when calm, it can shock those who touch it.

entry: 它是音乐遗失的灵魂。未曾谱写或未曾问世的歌曲，都在它身上具现，入夜便庄重吟唱。
author: theheroict
source: The lost soul of music. Any song that has never been written or released is embodied in this Pokémon. It sings solemnly at night.

entry: POKENAME的壳由铁与楔石的合金构成。超能力攻击无法穿透，但强力打击能将它击裂，因此它会吃金属来修补损伤。
author: bobogagabobo
source: POKENAME's shell is made of an alloy of iron and an Odd Keystone. Psychic attacks can't get through it, but a strong blow can crack it open, so POKENAME eats metal to repair the damage.

entry: 据说，POKENAME把灵魂储存在岩石外壳内，所以壳上出现裂缝就被视为凶兆。人们会给它石头吃，以抵消厄运。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME is said to store spirits in its rocky casing, so POKENAME with cracks shown on it are a bad omen. People give it rocks to eat to counteract the bad luck.

entry: POKENAME会在沙漠里静止不动地待在楔石中，等足够小的目标靠近。随后，它便从石口猛然窜出，抓住目标，试图拖入石头的巨口里。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stays motionless in the desert within its keystone until something small enough draws near. It then lunges from the stone's mouth to grab and attempt to drag its target into the stone's maw.

entry: POKENAME的楔石内若响起嗡鸣，就表示它即将现身攻击。声音来自双翼高速拍动，产生的超声波会使人迷失方向、偏头痛发作。
author: sk372
source: A buzzing sound from within POKENAME's keystone indicates it is about to emerge and go on the offensive. The buzzing comes from the rapid beat of its wings, which emits supersonic waves that cause disorientation and migraines.

entry: POKENAME的楔石以形状歪扭、颇为丑陋而闻名。它性情凶暴，但力量不足，无法让大部分身体显形，因此攻击时造成的破坏有限。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME keystones are known for being misshapen and rather ugly. It has an aggressive temperament, but it lacks the strength to manifest much of itself, so it cannot cause much damage when it attacks.

entry: POKENAME会让楔石缓缓行进到悬崖边，再将其抛下。就在落地之前，它会从头骨内猛然展开灵体，缓冲冲击，防止石头摔碎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME slowly marches its keystone towards cliffs before flinging it off the sides. Just before it hits the ground, it flares its spectral form out from its skull to cushion the impact and keep the stone from shattering.

entry: 据说，这种宝可梦由108条已故之龙的灵魂汇聚而成。这或许能解释，它为何总像以为自己会飞似的跳下悬崖。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: This Pokémon is said to be the amalgamation of the souls of 108 fallen dragons. This may explain its habit of jumping off cliffs as if it thinks it can fly.

entry: 贝壳状石头容纳着组成POKENAME的众多灵魂。它为了节省能量很少移动，只有感到真正受威胁时，幽灵形体才会从石缝中现身。
author: sk372
source: A shell-shaped stone houses the many spirits that make up POKENAME. It conserves energy and rarely moves, its ghostly form emerging from small cracks in the stone only when it feels truly threatened.

entry: POKENAME住在石状齿轮里，齿轮始终缓缓转动。释放力量前转得越久，里面的灵魂就能显形越久。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME resides in the stone-shaped gear, which rotates slowly at all times. The longer it spins before unleashing its power, the longer the spirits inhabiting it can remain manifested.

entry: POKENAME能将身体融入机械设备，使其运作得更有效率。可惜，被附身的设备会始终发出令人不安的响亮哀号。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can merge its body into mechanical equipment to make it operate more efficiently. Unfortunately, the possessed equipment emits an unsettling, loud wailing noise throughout.

entry: POKENAME会伪装成受伤或虚弱的模样，等天真的人类靠近查看，就附身对方。它们操纵人类宿主恶作剧，还会作出其他不良行径。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME disguise themselves to appear injured or weak, fooling naive humans into being possessed as they approach to investigate. POKENAME puppet their human hosts into pulling pranks and committing other acts of delinquency.

entry: 传说，植物活得太久，获得了灵力，便会用泥土和石头为自己构筑身体，形成这种宝可梦。
author: zeterzero
source: There are legends that say these Pokémon come into being when plants grow far too old, gaining spiritual power with which they build a body for themselves from soil and stone.

entry: POKENAME会从楔石的尾部现身，灵体散发舒适的暖意。若身体不适，它就只会从石尾探出一部分脸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME emerges from the tail of its keystone, its spectral body emitting a pleasant warmth. If it isn't feeling well, it will only partially poke its face out from the stone's tail.

entry: POKENAME喜欢住在残破或古老的建筑中，不受打扰便如雕像般静止。被激怒时，它会试图吓退敌人，但小小的身躯很难吓住大多数宝可梦。
author: plkfsa32
source: POKENAME prefers to inhabit ruined or ancient buildings, remaining statue-like unless disturbed. If provoked, it attempts to scare off the foe, but its tiny frame rarely intimidates most Pokémon.

entry: 狩猎时，POKENAME会从耳中传出歌声，仿佛108个孩子齐声哼唱。听得太久，就可能陷入持续数天的沉睡。
author: .izik
source: While hunting, POKENAME releases a song from its ears that sounds like 108 children humming in unison. Listening for too long can induce a slumber that lasts for days.

entry: POKENAME通常只能从石头底部现身，以此移动。若楔石积聚了足够阳光，就会短暂打开，让它显出更多身体。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can typically only manifest from the bottom of its stone in order to move around. If the keystone gathers enough sunlight, it will open up for a short time and allow POKENAME to emerge more fully.

entry: POKENAME会试着熟悉所住墓园的年长访客。若发现某人不再来访，它就会在对方常去的墓旁种出一朵黑玫瑰，以作纪念。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME tries to familiarize itself with the elderly visitors of the cemetery it resides in. If it notices one of them has stopped coming by, it will grow a single black rose next to the grave the visitor frequently visited in memory of them.

entry: POKENAME乍看天真无邪，却主要以幼年宝可梦为食。它会制造波克比、皮宝宝等宝可梦的幻影引来猎物，等对方抓住双臂，便将其带到高高的云层中，从此再不见踪影。
author: bigoljax
source: Though it seems innocent at a glace, POKENAME mainly feeds off of baby Pokémon. It'll create apparitions of Pokémon like Togepi and Cleffa to lure in prey, floating them up high into the clouds once they grab onto its arms, never to be seen again.

entry: POKENAME是种不常见的害兽，会在墓园附近挖洞。从入夜到清晨，它们四处游荡，吃掉墓碑前的任何供品。有些殡葬人员倒不介意，因为它们好斗的性情常能赶走其他害兽。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME are an uncommon pest that burrow near graveyards. They'll prowl from nightfall to morning, eating any offerings left at tombstones. Some undertakers don't mind POKENAME, as their confrontational nature often keeps other pests away.

entry: POKENAME的楔石酷似蘑蘑菇，因此能混进野外的蘑蘑菇群。等蘑蘑菇睡着，它便显形，抽取些许能量维持生存。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME infiltrates groups of Shroomish in the wild thanks to its keystone's resemblance to the latter. When the Shroomish sleep, POKENAME manifests and siphons some of their energy for sustenance.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME会飘过废弃庄园，发出阴森的嚎叫。每一声都仿佛有数百个声音同时哭喊。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME floats through abandoned manors, letting out haunting howls. Each wail sounds like hundreds of voices crying out at once.

entry: POKENAME心智不够敏锐，无法让体内的灵魂组成面孔。为了防止它闹脾气，人们会喂给它鲜花和通常献给死者的小礼物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lack the mental acuity to form a face with the spirits in its body. To prevent POKENAME from having a tantrum, it is fed flowers and other small gifts normally given to the dead.

entry: POKENAME会用超能力操纵周围对象的情绪。这会迅速耗尽能量，迫使它回到楔石内休息一阵，才能再次现身。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its psychic abilities to manipulate the emotions of those around it. Doing so quickly depletes its energy, forcing it to rest within its keystone for a period before it can emerge again.

entry: 风势变强时，POKENAME的气态身体会飘散出点点碎屑。吸入后，人会经历奇异的幻觉与幻想，以为自己完全变成了另一个人。
author: sk372
source: Flecks of POKENAME's gaseous body fly off when the wind grows strong. Inhaling these little flecks will cause a person to experience strange hallucinations and fantasies, believing themselves to be an entirely different person.

entry: POKENAME会埋在古墓周围，再围绕楔石游荡，攻击范围内的任何人。由于夜里冷得不想动，它在白天更加活跃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found buried around ancient tombs, where it roams the area around its keystone, attacking anyone in range. It is more active during the day since it feels too cold to move at night.

entry: POKENAME伪装成钟乳石，躲避天敌。一处洞穴，可能藏着数百只POKENAME，各自感知周围最细小的动静。
author: rakunk
source: POKENAME disguises itself as stalactites in order to better hide itself from predators. A cave may hold hundreds of POKENAME at a time, each of them detecting subtle movements in their environment.

entry: POKENAME被称为“沙漠怨灵”，夜里在沙漠狩猎时，会发出令人毛骨悚然的尖叫。有人说，听见叫声会因恐惧而动弹不得。
author: .izik
source: Described as the Wraith of the Desert, POKENAME screeches a bloodcurdling cry while hunting through deserts at night. Some say hearing its screech can cause paralysis from fear.

entry: POKENAME携带的楔石中，会回响着古怪的人声。虽然声音熟悉，所说的话却毫无意义。
author: .izik
source: The Odd Keystone carried by POKENAME echoes with strange, humanlike voices. Though familiar, the words they utter make no sense.

entry: POKENAME靠从其他对象身上抽取静电，维持楔石外的显形。只要触碰石头，静电就会被吸收，而且只需少许能量便能充满。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses static electricity siphoned from others to keep itself manifested outside of its keystone. The stone itself can absorb static electricity just by being touched, and takes only a little energy to be fully charged.

entry: POKENAME的楔石只要受到足够的冲击，它就会不由自主地现身。冲击若够强，它会猛烈迸发出来，射出幽灵能量构成的尖刺。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME involuntarily emerges from its keystone whenever the stone is sufficiently impacted. Strong enough impacts will cause it to erupt forcefully and fire off pointed spines of ghostly energy.

entry: POKENAME的长牙严格来说并不属于楔石，却同样被它视若珍宝。若有长牙折断，它就会发疯似的寻找品质足够好的石头替换。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tusks are not technically a part of its keystone, but are treated as precious all the same. If one of them is broken, it frantically searches for a replacement stone of suitably high-quality.

entry: POKENAME以长牙为媒介，在身体周围凝成诡异的发光球体。战斗中，球体能分散敌人注意，但有人相信它们是死者的灵魂。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its tusks as a conduit to form eerie, glowing orbs around its body. These serve as distractions during fights, though some believe they are the souls of the dead.

entry: 据说，POKENAME寄宿着部分古代文明居民的灵魂。它把时间花在收集石头、搭建小雕像上，但这些造物的含义仍然不明。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to house some of the souls of the inhabitants of ancient civilizations. It spends its time constructing small statues made of rocks it gathers, though the meaning of the structures it creates is currently unknown.

entry: POKENAME每次从楔石中现身，身体都会覆上幽灵般的火焰。火虽很暖，却可以安全触碰；除非它有意为之，否则绝不会烧伤任何东西。
author: sk372
source: A ghostly flame covers POKENAME's body whenever it emerges from the keystone. The fire is quite warm but safe to touch; it will never burn anything unless POKENAME wills it to.

entry: POKENAME的体温几乎始终保持在108度。它领地意识极强，会向附近的对象吐出幽灵余火，准头高得惊人。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's body temperature is almost always 108 degrees. Highly territorial, it will spit ghostly embers at those nearby with startling accuracy.

entry: POKENAME疲倦时，会将气态身体缩回石质胸部睡觉。在此期间，周围会变得酷热难当。
author: .izik
source: When tired, POKENAME withdraws its gaseous body into its stone thorax to sleep. During this time the surrounding area becomes cripplingly hot.

entry: POKENAME惯于躲在最黑暗的洞穴里，假扮普通岩石，突然现身吓唬探险者。吓到周围的对象后，能听见它发出仿佛百人混杂在一起的笑声。
author: xiapher
source: Having a habit of hiding in the darkest caves, POKENAME disguise themselves as simple rocks, only to suddenly emerge and scare explorers. After frightening those around them, POKENAME can be heard laughing in a cacophony of a hundred voices.

entry: POKENAME会沿楔石附近的地面伸展身体，藏在阴影中。等毫无戒心的旅人踩上来，它就缠住对方双腿，释放疼痛的电击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stretches out along the ground near its keystone, hiding among the shadows. It waits for an unassuming traveler to step on it, whereupon it latches onto their legs and delivers a painful jolt.

entry: 花岩怪的108个亡魂，占据了勾魂眼的身体，形成POKENAME。为护住楔石，它还在外面，长出宝石般的护罩。
author: crazynaturekitty
source: The 108 souls of Spiritomb have taken over the body of a Sableye to form POKENAME. In order to keep its keystone safe, it has formed a protective gem-like cover around it.

entry: POKENAME鬼祟而善于伺机行事，将楔石藏在草木间，等待弱小的目标经过。随后，它迅速从石中跃出，咬上一口注入毒液，再匆匆躲回去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is sneaky and opportunistic, hiding its keystone among foliage until something weak wanders by. It then quickly leaps out from the stone to deliver a venomous bite before scurrying back into hiding.

entry: POKENAME高速滚动时，蒸气状身体会有些许从石壳中逸出。最快时，速度能超过每小时50英里。
author: .izik
source: While rolling at high speeds, bits of POKENAME's vaporous body escape from its stone shell. At top speeds it can reach over 50 mph.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，会用爪子保卫家园。若与入侵者扭打足够久，对方的灵魂就会被困在楔石里。
author: casinosluck
source: POKENAME is highly territorial, defending its home with its claws. If it grapples with an intruder for long enough, their soul will become trapped in its keystone.

entry: POKENAME是个贪婪的小贼，会从石头里现身，偷走旅人身上任何看中的东西。得手后，谁若胆敢追赶，它就会尖声咆哮，向对方发出幽灵能量波。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a greedy little thief, emerging from its stone to swipe anything that catches its eye from travelers. It lets out a screeching roar that sends a wave of ghostly energy at those who dare try to pursue it after it has pilfered something.

entry: 据说，超过100只怪颚龙的灵魂被封在同一块化石内，形成了POKENAME。它从化石中现身时，会发出令人胆寒的吼声，让与史前时代有关联的其他宝可梦吓得僵住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to be the spirits of over 100 Tyrantrum locked within a single fossil. Upon manifesting from its source, POKENAME lets out a chilling roar that causes other Pokémon with prehistoric links to freeze in fear.

entry: POKENAME的身体对自然环境十分敏感，因此很少让身体大幅露出保护自己的楔石。据观察，气温较暖时，它会稍微更愿意现身。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is sensitive to the elements, so it rarely exposes itself much past its protective keystone. It has been noted to be a bit more willing to emerge from hiding in warmer temperatures.

entry: POKENAME很少出现在积雪的战场与墓园以外的地方。长时间接触它的吐息，会冷到身体冻伤；而直接碰到它的人，会在一瞬间觉得心跳冻结。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME are rarely seen outside of snowy battlefields and graveyards. Prolonged exposure to a POKENAME's breath will chill the body to the point of frostbite, but anyone who directly touches a POKENAME will momentarily feel their heartbeat freeze.

entry: POKENAME由108个迷失山中、最终丧命之人的灵魂组成。巢穴里躺着这些灵魂原主被冻住的尸体。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME is comprised of 108 spirits of people who perished while lost in the mountains. In its den lies the frozen corpses of the spirits' original owners.

entry: 常能发现POKENAME生长在枯叶堆下，吸收其中的养分增强力量。月光照到时，它的叶片会开始摇摆，模仿幽火的动向。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME is commonly found growing under piles of dead leaves, absorbing the nutrients in order to grow stronger. When exposed to moonlight, its leaves start to sway, mimicking the movements of will-o-wisps.

entry: 它的身体由受囚禁的灵魂构成。它带着狂乱与恐惧起舞，传达体内那些囚徒渴求自由的情绪。
author: hophoppip
source: Its body is made up of imprisoned spirits. It dances with frenzy and fear, conveying the emotions of its captive components as they yearn for freedom.

entry: POKENAME会在废弃体育场里，为早已离去的队伍加油。它格外喜爱替别人助威的宝可梦，会附身对方，为很久以前就已输掉的战斗呐喊。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found in abandoned stadiums where it cheers on its team long after they have gone. It has a particular affinity for Pokémon who cheer on others, possessing them to cheer on a battle that was lost ages ago.

entry: POKENAME会在废弃聚落的海滩起舞，试图诱使游客走向灭亡。游客一踏上它的岛屿，就会被附身，陷入奇异的意识恍惚，片刻后才在岸上醒来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found dancing on beaches of abandoned settlements where it tries to lure tourists to their demise. Once tourists set foot on its island, they are possessed and experience strange fugue states, only to awaken on shore a moment after.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，会唤起前世的仇恨与恶意。没人知道，它为何会被锁在楔石上。
author: mistymagius
source: As POKENAME dances it summons forth its hatred and malice it had in another life. No one knows why this Pokémon was chained to the keystone.

entry: POKENAME会将楔石移向垃圾场等附近容易散落垃圾的地方。石头会缓缓将垃圾吸入体内，转化为能量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME relocates its keystone towards garbage dumps and other places where it is likely to have trash littered nearby. Its stone slowly absorbs the garbage into its body, turning it into energy.

entry: POKENAME用巨大的爪子铲起垃圾，大量吞食。垃圾被吸入灵体，令它每次显形都散发令人作呕的恶臭。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME scoops up garbage in its large claws and consumes it in great amounts. The trash is absorbed into its spectral body, causing it to have an abhorrent stench whenever it manifests.

entry: 除非闻到血腥味，否则很难让POKENAME从楔石里出来。一旦闻到，它便瞬间现身，双颚凶猛地咬合，试图撕咬气味的来源。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is difficult to make come out of its keystone, unless it catches the scent of blood. When it does, it emerges in the blink of an eye, its jaws gnashing fiercely as it tries to tear into whatever is causing the smell.

entry: POKENAME的石头静候于深海，任何东西游过，都可能被灵体的双颚一口攫住。若猎物身上恰有新鲜伤口，它便会以快得看不清的速度疯狂攻击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's stone rests in the deeper parts of the sea, waiting for anything to swim by and be snatched up by its spectral form's jaws. It attacks with blinding speed and frenzy if its prey happens to have still-fresh wounds.

entry: 据说，许多淘气的灵魂在树桩中汇聚，诞生了这种宝可梦。它以对任何遇见的对象恶作剧而闻名，有时玩得太过火，甚至会造成重伤。
author: infinex21
source: Said to have been born from the coalescence of many mischievous spirits within a tree stump, this Pokémon is infamous for its pranks on any it comes across. Sometimes, its pranks go far enough to cause severe injuries.

entry: 据说，至少108个灵魂汇聚在石化的树中，形成了第一只POKENAME。它们即使正在抵御敌人，也能影响附近的植物，甚至可能完全控制它们，是危险的对手。
author: infinex21
source: It is said at least 108 spirits coalesced within a petrified tree, resulting in the first POKENAME. These Pokémon can influence, if not fully control, nearby plant life even as they fight off others, making them dangerous foes.

entry: POKENAME头上的花会散发气味，让闻到的任何对象陷入极度悲伤，但效果很快便会消退。它的表情始终悲伤，从未改变。
author: plkfsa32
source: The flower on POKENAME's head gives off a scent that triggers immense misery in anyone who smells it, although it shortly wears off. Its expression never changes from a sad look.

entry: 夜里能看见POKENAME成群飞行。翅膀发出的诡异声音会令听者头晕，古代文明曾深信这是诅咒。
author: lydiaprower8
source: Groups of POKENAME can be seen flying around at night. The eerie sound its wings produce cause dizziness in those that hear it that old civilizations were convinced was a curse.

entry: POKENAME常大量出没于洞穴，凶猛攻击任何进入领地的对象。夜空中飞过时，绿色球体发出的阴森光芒会吓坏瞥见它的宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME tends to infest caves and aggressively attacks anyone who enters its territory. The sinister glow of its green orbs terrifies Pokémon that catch a glimpse of POKENAME flying through the night sky.

entry: POKENAME会以身体形成翅膀，把楔石从一处搬到另一处。石头虽然颇重，一阵足够强的风仍能扰乱它的飞行。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME forms wings from its body to carry its keystone from one location to the next. Despite the stone being decently heavy, a strong enough breeze can disrupt POKENAME's flight pattern.

entry: POKENAME以云为食，为灵体能力提供能量；只有在战斗后，才会因持续使用灵体攻击而缩小。被它吃过的云会因靠近它而染上紫色，化为有毒烟雾。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME feeds off of clouds to power its spectral abilities, only shrinking after battle due to the constant use of spiritual attacks. Clouds that POKENAME has fed off of shift into a purple tint, becoming poisonous smog due to its proximity.

entry: POKENAME胆小，很少从楔石中现身。它会在石头底部渗出灵体黏液，让自己四处滑行。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is timid and rarely emerges from within its keystone. It moves around by secreting a spectral ooze on the stone's underside that lets it slip and slide around.

entry: POKENAME的楔石远大于真身，重得它无法挪动，严重限制了移动速度。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's keystone is much larger than its actual body. This results in the stone being too heavy for it to move, greatly restricting its movement speed.

entry: POKENAME从楔石中现身时，样子很像数百年前的一种黏美龙形态。它碰到的一切都会沾上黏液，使皮肤发麻；几秒后，黏液就会蒸发。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME emerges from its keystone, it bears a resemblance to a form of Goodra from centuries in the past. It leaves goo behind on everything it touches, which causes skin to tingle before it evaporates a few seconds later.

entry: POKENAME以楔石为躯干，能操纵与之相连的其他石块。战斗时，它甚至能让所有石块分离，组成岩石龙卷风，攻击结束后再轻松恢复原形。
author: sk372
source: The keystone acting as POKENAME's torso allows it to move the rest of the stones attached to it. It can even separate all of its stones to form a rocky tornado in combat, easily reforming itself after the attack is finished.

entry: POKENAME的身体碎片剥落时，力量就会增强。但这也会让它失去控制，因此通常会尽快修补自己。
author: .flipside3
source: POKENAME's power increases as pieces of its body chip off. However, this also causes it to lose control, so it usually repairs itself as soon as possible.

entry: POKENAME每次使用臂炮，都会失去一部分灵体能量。它必须寻找更多楔石，才能维持生命力。
author: cenizarey
source: Each time POKENAME uses its arm cannon, it loses part of its spiritual energy. It must find more Odd Keystones to maintain its life force.

entry: POKENAME会从楔石的花瓣间现身。身体散发浓烈气味，在近处停留太久，几乎足以致命。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME emerges from between the flower petals of its keystone. Its body produces a strong odor and is borderline lethal if one remains in close proximity for too long.

entry: 由于被束缚在楔石上，POKENAME无法自由肆虐，夺走所遇见的一切灵魂。传说，吸收过量灵魂后，它就会变换形态，挣脱枷锁。
author: soup1900
source: Due to being bound to an Odd Keystone, POKENAME is unable to freely go on violent rampages and steal any soul it finds. Legends say that once it absorbs an overabundant amount of spirits, it transforms and breaks free from this shackle.

entry: 据说，POKENAME是未获妥善照料的玩具，被灵魂附身后前来复仇。不过，这通常只是为了让孩子爱惜玩具而讲的故事。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME is said to be a toy not properly looked after and possessed by a spirit to seek revenge, but this is usually just told to children to get them to take good care of their toys.

entry: POKENAME常在古迹或黑暗森林附近安家。谁若在家旁被POKENAME抓到，就会遭它夺魂。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is known to make its home near ancient ruins or dark forests. Anyone POKENAME catches near its home will have their spirit stolen from them.

entry: 昔日船员的灵魂汇聚于翻覆船只的锚中，便会自然形成这种宝可梦。船锚落下后常深深扎入地面，使它困在原处，无法移动。
author: soup1900
source: This Pokémon naturally forms when souls from a former ship crew gather into their now-capsized ship's anchor. It is often stuck in a single location, unable to move, due to the anchor being dug deep into the ground of where it was dropped.

entry: 昔日船员的灵魂汇聚于翻覆船只的锚中，便会自然形成这种宝可梦。船锚落下后常深深扎入地面，使它困在原处，无法移动。
author: soup1900
source: This Pokémon naturally forms when souls from a former ship crew gather into their now-capsized ship's anchor. It is often stuck in a single location, unable to move, due to the anchor being dug deep into the ground of where it was dropped.

entry: 据说，组成POKENAME的多个灵魂会分成井然有序的小组，构成触手。被尖刺碰到的对象会麻痹，随后被拉入，与它融为一体。
author: gileme__
