source: The multiple spirits that compose POKENAME are said to be divided into organized groups that form its tentacles. Whoever is touched by POKENAME's spikes is paralyzed, pulled in and assimilated into it.

entry: POKENAME显形时，会将削尖的楔石碎块留在灵体内。幽灵能量会赋予碎片独特的毒素，若刺入皮肤，可能相当致命。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME manifests, it keeps sharpened chunks of its keystone within its spectral body. Its ghostly energy imbues these shards with unique toxins that can be quite deadly if allowed to pierce the skin.

entry: POKENAME战斗时会灵活操纵楔石，动作极富表现力。它绝不放弃战斗，即使楔石严重受损，灵体仍会现身继续交战。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fights by maneuvering its keystone with great agility and showmanship. It never gives up a fight; even if its keystone is heavily damaged, its spirit-like body will emerge to continue fighting.

entry: POKENAME的楔石应尽量保持干燥。它很讨厌潮湿，会从石中现身，愤怒地挥舞带刺的双臂。人若被尖刺扎到，就会严重发冷。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's keystone should be kept as dry as possible. It reacts negatively to moisture, emerging from the stone and swinging its spiky arms around angrily. The spines cause a person to suffer severe chills if pricked by them.

entry: POKENAME通常出现在格外干旱、没有动植物的沙漠地区。它很少完全脱离容器现身，通常只会向经过的入侵者射出灵体能量尖刺。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can usually be found in desert areas that are particularly arid and devoid of flora and fauna. It rarely emerges fully from its containment, usually just firing spines of spectral energy at intruders who wander by.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME会收集遗落海滩的玩具，保护衰弱的楔石。一些海滨小镇甚至设立节日，把旧玩具抛到沙上，安抚它，防止它到内陆作祟。
author: riley_muir_qu33n_in_yellow
source: At night, POKENAME collects toys left on the beach to protect its weakened keystone. Some local beach towns have made a holiday of throwing old toys into the sand, appeasing POKENAME and keeping it from haunting the inland.

entry: POKENAME的本体从一对奇异的蘑菇状石头中伸出。有人说，它其实由吃下毒蘑菇而死的人们的灵魂汇聚而成。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's main body extends out from a pair of strange mushroom-shaped stones. Some say POKENAME is actually an amalgamation of the spirits of people who perished from eating poisonous fungi.

entry: 这种POKENAME的变种，只有在城堡状墓穴内所有坟墓都填满后才会出现。届时，它会用远程恶之波动，猛烈攻击一英里范围内的任何人。
author: sondededoo
source: This variant of POKENAME only appears once all the graves inside its castle-shaped crypt are filled, at which point it begins to violently lash out against anyone within a one-mile radius with a long-range Dark Pulse.

entry: POKENAME是种爱恶作剧的宝可梦，摸起来冰凉。若遭严厉斥责，就会变得极其孤僻沮丧；阴谋论者认为，数百万年前，其他个体曾被各自未融合的同类放逐。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is a mischievous Pokémon that is cool to touch. If harshly rebuked, POKENAME grows extremely seclusive and despondent; conspiracy theorists suggest that other POKENAME were banished by their unfused counterparts millions of years ago.

entry: 试着触碰POKENAME身上流出灵体物质的人，都说听见了被狂风淹没的尖叫。目前没有证据表明，它天生好斗，或明知危险却有意为之。
author: bobosmith01
source: Those who attempt to touch the spectral matter flowing out of POKENAME's body report hearing screams drowned out in howling winds. There is no evidence POKENAME is naturally aggressive or knowingly dangerous.

entry: 试着触碰POKENAME身上流出灵体物质的人，都说听见了被狂风淹没的尖叫。目前没有证据表明，它天生好斗，或明知危险却有意为之。
author: bobosmith01
source: Those who attempt to touch the spectral matter flowing out of POKENAME's body report hearing screams drowned out in howling winds. There is no evidence POKENAME is naturally aggressive or knowingly dangerous.

entry: POKENAME始终顽皮无忧，常在出没的墓园中，追着幽幽的魂火嬉戏。
author: cristata
source: Playful and carefree to the end, POKENAME can often be found chasing ghostly wisps through the graveyards they haunt.

entry: POKENAME始终顽皮无忧，常在出没的墓园中，追着幽幽的魂火嬉戏。
author: cristata
source: Playful and carefree to the end, POKENAME can often be found chasing ghostly wisps through the graveyards they haunt.

entry: POKENAME在山顶安家，狩猎时会嚎叫。声音听起来像108个人拙劣地模仿嚎叫，再混在一起。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its home on mountain peaks, howling while hunting. The howls sound like the combined cries of 108 humans poorly imitating what a howl should sound like.

entry: 故事描绘POKENAME毁掉整个地区；虽然有所夸大，却道出了它好战的天性。它无惧挑战任何宝可梦，尤其喜欢与犬类宝可梦交手。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Stories describe POKENAME bringing entire regions to ruin; While these stories exaggerate, they do capture POKENAME's proclivity to battle. POKENAME have no fear in challenging any Pokémon for combat, especially canine Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME会装作痛苦，发出哀鸣。宝可梦来查看这个看似受伤的家伙时，它就猛然以头撞击，使猎物晕头转向。每次得胜，它都会得意嚎叫，叫声中回荡着许多声音。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME act like they are in pain, howling plaintively. When Pokémon investigate the seemingly wounded POKENAME, they lash out with a sharp headbutt, dazing their prey. Howling triumphantly at each victory, their cries echo with many voices.

entry: POKENAME不断哼着挽歌般的旋律，迷住周围所有人。香炉里，还散出令人昏睡的瘴气。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME incessantly hums an elegy-like music that captivates everyone around it. It also emits a soporific miasma from its censer.

entry: POKENAME不断哼着挽歌般的旋律，迷住周围所有人。香炉里，还散出令人昏睡的瘴气。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME incessantly hums an elegy-like music that captivates everyone around it. It also emits a soporific miasma from its censer.

entry: POKENAME会出现在死亡发生的地方，焚香为亡魂引路，助其平安离去。听到挽歌的任何人，都会深感忧伤，渴望见到所爱之人。
author: mineskyva
source: POKENAME appears at places of death, burning incense to offer safe passage for the departed souls. Anyone who hears this Pokémon's dirges feels an intense melancholy and a desire to see their loved ones.

entry: 它用来战斗的法杖上，挂着一只散发催眠熏香的香炉。一旦在这瘴气中入睡，就再也不会醒来。
author: chorb33
source: It emits hypnotizing incense from the censer on its staff, which it uses for fighting. Anyone who falls asleep through the miasma never awakens again.

entry: 它用来战斗的法杖上，挂着一只散发催眠熏香的香炉。一旦在这瘴气中入睡，就再也不会醒来。
author: chorb33
source: It emits hypnotizing incense from the censer on its staff, which it uses for fighting. Anyone who falls asleep through the miasma never awakens again.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME的楔石以月光为动力四处漂浮。被它从上方经过的对象会安然入睡，但梦中似乎有超过100个神秘声音在低语。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's keystone floats around at night, fueled by the light of the moon. Those it passes over fall into a pleasant sleep, though their dreams seem to contain the whispers of over 100 mysterious voices.

entry: POKENAME会磨动楔石的牙齿，让灵体得以显形。此时，石头会放出一阵精神能量脉冲，推开紧邻周围的一切。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME grinds the teeth of its keystone in order to be able to manifest its spectral body. As it does so, the stone lets out a pulse of psychic energy that pushes back anything in the immediate area.

entry: POKENAME体内储存着超过108种不同的蘑菇孢子。科学家研究多年，希望能将其用于疫苗及其他医疗用途。
author: .izik
source: Over 108 different types of mushroom spores are stored within POKENAME's body. Scientists have studied these spores for years in hopes of using them in vaccines and other medical applications.

entry: 据说，只有历史上最残酷邪恶之人的灵魂汇聚，才创造了POKENAME。古画描绘它每108年苏醒一次，引发灾难性的战争、天灾等浩劫。
author: dodoowner_
source: It's said POKENAME was created by uniting the spirits of only the most cruel, devilish people in history. Ancient drawings depict it reawakening every 108 years, causing catastrophic wars, natural disasters, and more.

entry: POKENAME尾部鳞片散发的空灵火焰，凝视时会令人不安。许多灵媒声称，若盯着看上数小时，就能看见未来。
author: .izik
source: The ethereal flame emanating from the scale on POKENAME's tail causes an unsettling feeling when stared at. Many mediums claim they can see the future if they gaze into it for hours.

entry: POKENAME会发出凄厉哀号，追赶过于靠近巢穴的徒步者。此时，它的鳞片会剧烈作响。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME chases hikers who get too close to its nest by letting out ghastly wails. During this time its scales rattle intensely.

entry: 故事称，若凝视空灵火焰足够久，POKENAME尾上的四片鳞片就会各显出一件不同的物品。传说，这四件东西会在人死亡的那一刻，位于离他最近的地方。
author: .izik
source: Stories claim that the four scales on POKENAME's tail each reveal a different object to those who stare into the ethereal flame long enough. Legend holds that these four items will be closest to the viewer at the moment of death.

entry: POKENAME的众多灵魂从石中现身后，常能看见身体拨弄着身上的许多发光球体。人们相信，这些球体能让它无声地与当地其他幽灵属性宝可梦交流。
author: sk372
source: After the many spirits of POKENAME manifest themselves from its stone, the body can often be seen toying with the many glowing spheres on its body. It is believed these spheres let it silently commune with other Ghost types in the region.

entry: POKENAME极其胆小，很少从楔石中出来。它主要在需要迅速逃跑、把石头拖到别处避险时才会现身。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is extremely timid and rarely comes out of its keystone. The main reason it emerges is when it needs to quickly flee and drag its stone elsewhere to remain safe.

entry: 据说，灵魂是POKENAME维持生存的主要来源。它会把灵魂存入爪中，提高造成的伤害，却要以自身生命为代价。
author: loikthescreamo
source: It is said that souls are the main source of POKENAME staying alive. It stores these souls into its claws, resulting in more damage, at the cost of its own life.

entry: POKENAME会从楔石的孔洞射出由自身灵体构成的小弹丸。消耗的能量可以再生，但短时间内射得太多，仍会使它筋疲力尽。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fires small projectiles composed of its own spectral body out of the holes in its keystone. It regenerates whatever energy it uses, but firing too much in a short period of time will leave it exhausted.

entry: POKENAME异常贪吃，会冲进树果园和粮田，想吃什么就吃什么。经过妥善训练，它的破坏天性也能派上用场，帮助需要快速采收的农夫与林业人员。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME are unusually gluttonous. They ravage through berry orchards and grain fields devouring whatever they want. Properly trained, POKENAME's destructive nature can prove fruitful to farmers and foresters needing an expedient harvester.

entry: POKENAME身上长出的晶体，长期被视为强大神秘力量的来源，受到追捧。但采集极其危险，因为它会试图向触碰晶体的对象接连施咒。
author: sk372
source: Crystals that grow on POKENAME's body have long been sought as supposed sources of great mystic power. Retrieving them is highly dangerous, as POKENAME will attempt to rain hexes upon those who try to touch them.

entry: POKENAME容易兴奋，也容易受惊。突遭惊吓时，它会本能地在身体和楔石各处生出幽灵能量尖刺，自我保护。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is excitable and easily startled. When taken by surprise, it instinctively creates spines of ghostly energy all across its body and keystone in self-defense.

entry: POKENAME从石内现身时，身体会在石头周围构成护盾。碰到它的身体，皮肤就会发麻，短短几分钟内便起极痒的疹子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body forms a protective shield around its stone when it emerges from within. Touching its body causes a person's skin to tingle and develop extremely itchy rashes within just a few minutes.

entry: POKENAME能让楔石周围冒出荆棘与尖刺。灵体外壳让它看似近乎无敌，但楔石一遭攻击，它便很容易落败。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can cause brambles and thorns to erupt in the vicinity around its keystone. It may seem nearly invincible thanks to its ethereal shell, but it easily succumbs to defeat when its keystone is attacked.

entry: 为了保护其他生灵，POKENAME会伸展身体，分散好斗宝可梦的注意，招引怒火。成功后，它就将部分身体退回巨大的楔石；那块石头极能承受伤害。
author: sk372
source: To protect others, POKENAME stretches out and distracts aggressive Pokémon and draws their ire. Once it succeeds, it partially retreats into its massive keystone, which is highly resilient to damage.

entry: POKENAME会被棺材吸引，有时能见到它睡在死者身旁。许多人担心它发怒后会施加诅咒，因此留下供品安抚它。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are drawn to coffins and can be found sleeping beside the dead. Many are fearful that POKENAME will cast a hex on them if they become angry, so people leave offerings to appease POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME优雅地挥舞木杖，便能造出强大的绿色火焰漩涡。它十分稀有，往往隐居森林深处，避开人类。
author: fiordaliso
source: By elegantly waving its wooden staff, POKENAME can create powerful, green fire vortexes. It is a rare Pokémon that tends to live deep in the forest, shunning human contact.

entry: POKENAME拥有玄奥的能量，能使石质身体时隐时现。幽灵般的魔法能量波会形成圆环，在它似乎正在移动时遮住身体，让动作看起来断断续续。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME possess esoteric energy that can phase their stone-like body in and out of existence. The waves of ghostly, magical energy create rings that obscure the body as it presumably moves, giving it a staccato motion.

entry: POKENAME的楔石虽重，它却十分敏捷，会四处跳跃，从意想不到的角度袭击敌人。它还会把自身的液态身体团块投向敌人，造成强力打击。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME's keystone is heavy, it is highly agile and will leap around to attack foes from unexpected angles. It throws blobs of its own liquid body at foes, striking with great force.

entry: POKENAME会从楔石里伸出身体，警戒四周。虽然受这块重物束缚，行动有些受限，它仍能以惊人的速度四处跳跃。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME extends a body out from its Odd Keystone to keep watch on its surroundings. Although its movements are somewhat limited by being confined by this heavy object, POKENAME can still hop around with surprising speed.

entry: POKENAME会捡起小石子，覆上发光的紫色气息，再掷向敌人。它能控制石头在空中的运动，让飞行轨迹弯曲，几乎无从逃脱。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME attacks by picking up small pebbles, coating them with its glowing purple aura, then flinging them at foes. POKENAME can control the movement of these stones in the air, curving their paths to make them almost impossible to escape.

entry: POKENAME乘着发光球体无声漂浮，用缠在颈上的灵体长舌感知敌人。它会掷出发光的绿色手里剑，或用头上锋利的石刃劈砍靠近的敌人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME silently floats around on a glowing sphere, sensing foes using the long spectral tongue wrapped around its neck. It attacks by flinging glowing green shuriken or by slashing enemies that get close with the sharp stone blades on its head.

entry: 过去曾有说法：只要给POKENAME树果，它就会作为谢礼，替你解决指定的任何人或事物。
author: zaymcawesome
source: It was once said that if you gave POKENAME berries, it would take out anything and anyone requested as a thank you for your gift to it.

entry: POKENAME悬在躁动灵魂组成的漩涡下。头上锋利的石刃不断旋转，令人难以靠近，却丝毫不影响它投掷发光绿色手里剑的准头。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME hangs from a swirling vortex of restless spirits. The constant spinning of the sharp stone blades on its head makes POKENAME dangerous to approach, but this movement doesn't make the glowing green shuriken it flings any less accurate.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME来自古老岛屿文明的居民灵魂。他们曾崇拜煤炭龟，灵魂汇聚于按其形象雕刻的神像内。它栖居火山地区，会警告旅人远离险境。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is thought to be the spirits of an old island civilization that worshiped Torkoal, their souls joining together in idols carved in its shape. It resides in volcanic areas, warning travelers away from perilous conditions.

entry: POKENAME在收获季节最活跃。田地达到一定面积时，楔石就会出现。人若靠得太近，它就喷出浓雾，藏身其中吓唬对方。秋日祭典的田野里常能见到它。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME are most active during harvest season. Its keystone appears when fields reach a certain threshold size. If a person gets too close, it spews a thick fog to hide in and scare them. They're usually seen in fields at autumn festivals.

entry: 夏天，POKENAME会蛰伏在南瓜田，直到人们出来庆祝丰收。吓人满108次后，它就把恐惧转化为能量，好在来年长得更大。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: During the summer, POKENAME lies dormant in pumpkin patches until people come out to celebrate the harvest. After scaring people 108 times, POKENAME converts their terror into energy so it can grow even larger for the following year.

entry: 构成POKENAME发光双翼的蒸气毒性极强，待在附近就有害。吸入过多会引发抽搐。
author: .izik
source: The highly toxic vapor making up POKENAME's glowing wings is noxious to be around. Inhaling too much of it can cause seizures.

entry: POKENAME以他人的恐惧为食，会从楔石中现身，恐吓踏入领地的对象。诡异的歌声与可怕的面容，轻易就能让旅人惊恐到足以满足它的食欲。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME feasts on the fear of others, emerging from its keystone to strike terror in those that step into its domain. With its eerie song and frightening visage, it is easily able to horrify travelers enough to sate itself off their terror.

entry: POKENAME饿了就会从楔石中现身，散发极甜的香气。被引来的宝可梦会舔它的身体，立刻失去意识，无力逃避被吞食的命运。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME hungers, it simply emerges from its keystone while emitting an extremely sweet scent. Lured Pokémon will lick its body and immediately fall into unconsciousness, helpless to avoid being consumed by POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME周围的气体带有淡淡的萄葡果香。它们会搜寻厨房，打算大肆劫掠，吸收眼前的所有糖分。
author: lydiaprower8
source: The gas around POKENAME smells faintly of Grepa Berries. They search kitchens with the intent to raid them and absorb all the sugar in sight.

entry: POKENAME被困在仿照滑滑小子蜕皮雕成的石像内。它们会凶猛地用头撞击任何靠近的对象，但因无法移动，攻击距离很有限。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME are trapped in stone statues shaped to resemble a Scraggy's shed skin. They viciously headbutt any who draw too near, but they can't reach very far due to being immobile.

entry: 坚硬的石块裹住POKENAME的双腿与颈部，大幅拖慢行动。人们相信，若没有这些重量束缚，它们会造成更大的破坏。
author: hophoppip
source: Hard blocks of stone encase POKENAME's legs and neck, slowing its movement significantly. Without this weight, it is believed the species would be far more destructive.

entry: POKENAME会假扮荷叶，等蚊香蛙皇之类的宝可梦直接跳上来。一感觉到猎物停在身上，它就会尽量张开头部，那里直通胃里。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a lily pad, waiting for Pokémon like Politoad to jump directly onto it. Once it feels its prey resting atop of it, it'll open up its head as wide as possible, as it leads directly to its stomach.

entry: POKENAME喜欢捉弄垂钓者，尽可能多地抢走饵料桶，再逃进水中。它会把桶放在头顶，慢慢溶解里面的东西，连桶也一并吃掉。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME loves to torment Fishermen, grabbing as many bait buckets as it can before running off into the water. It then puts these buckets on top of its head, slowly consuming both the contents and the bucket itself by dissolving them.

entry: POKENAME会在医院屋顶耐心等上数小时，直到感知有人刚刚离世。随后，它便欢喜地跳舞，叫声听起来诡异地像是嘲笑。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME waits on the rooftops of hospitals, patiently waiting for hours until it senses a recent passing. Once this happens, it begins to jump and dance in joy, letting out calls that sound eerily similar to mocking laughs.

entry: 有人相信，POKENAME的起源可以追溯到宇宙深处。石壳极其坚固，却仍可能受损；裂隙一旦形成，就会渗出独特的灵体能量。
author: sk372
source: Some believe that POKENAME's origins can be traced back to somewhere deep in space. Its stone shell is incredibly durable, but can still be damaged; a unique spectral energy seeps out from any cracks that form.

entry: POKENAME在空中疾行时，会完全缩进石符内。石符虽然不大，却重得惊人。
author: .izik
source: While darting through the sky, POKENAME withdraws completely into its stone token. Despite its size, the token is surprisingly heavy.

entry: POKENAME看似填满幽灵火焰的活石像，会在古代遗迹中徘徊，寻找蕴含赋予自身生命之精华的遗物。它吸收这些精华，获得更稳定的形态。
author: zeterzero
source: Appearing to be living statues filled with ghostly flames, POKENAME wander ancient ruins searching for relics that contain more of the essence that gives them life, absorbing it to gain a more stable form.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，会从楔石尾部现身，向其他对象咆哮。若入侵者没有退却，空洞的石眼中就会迸出火焰，进一步吓退对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME emerges from the tail of its keystone to roar and bellow at others, as it is highly territorial. If the intruders are not deterred, fire erupts from the stone's hollow eyes to further scare them off.

entry: 据说，POKENAME会在地下挖隧道，收集被困地底的亡魂。它数量稀少，一生大多时间又待在地下，因此人们仍不清楚它在野外的行为。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is said that POKENAME tunnels underground to collect fallen spirits that have been trapped beneath the earth. Due to its rarity and the fact that it spends most of its life underground, its behavior in the wild is still not well understood.

entry: 被困楔石内的许多宝可梦灵魂，组成了近乎人类女性的外形，以便更好地与其他生灵交流。但它们也常是可怕的恶作剧者，令许多人害怕见到。
author: infinex21
source: The many spirits of Pokémon entrapped within an odd keystone formed a feminine, almost-human appearance to better interact with others. They do tend to be horrific pranksters as well and, thus, many dread seeing one.

entry: 有一种关于POKENAME与楔石的迷信：碰到石头的人会被诅咒，经历108段失败的感情，才有机会找到真爱。
author: sk372
source: A superstition exists related to POKENAME and its keystone. It says that touching the stone will curse a person to suffer 108 failed relationships before ever having a chance at finding true love.

entry: 据说，POKENAME会在地下挖隧道，收集被困地底的亡魂。它数量稀少，一生大多时间又待在地下，因此人们仍不清楚它在野外的行为。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is said that POKENAME tunnels underground to collect fallen spirits that have been trapped beneath the earth. Due to its rarity and the fact that it spends most of its life underground, its behavior in the wild is still not well understood.

entry: 埋在地下的楔石，若封住太多亡魂，便会破封，一同涌出地面。可每颗头都厌恶其他头，彼此不停拉扯，最终谁也逃不走。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: If too many spirits are sealed within a buried keystone, they break free and erupt from the earth as one. Each head despises the others, and so they endlessly strain against each other at the surface, never escaping.

entry: POKENAME能瞬间变得完全无形无质，借此潜入墓穴。进入后，它会吃掉所有陪葬财物，再前往下一座墓。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can become completely intangible in an instant, which it uses to infiltrate gravesites. Once inside, it eats any valuables buried with the deceased before moving on to the next grave.

entry: POKENAME一旦想得到训练家的关注，就会格外黏人。它会在屋里始终缠着对方，直到得到足够的抚摸或零食，才肯让人安宁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite needy once it desires attention from its Trainer. It will haunt them throughout the house and never give them a moment of peace until they give it an adequate amount of patting or treats.

entry: POKENAME住在酷似可达鸭的雕像内，雕像充当楔石。据说，未经允许靠得太近，就会使它放出引发头痛的黑暗能量。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME inhabit a statue that resembles a Psyduck, which functions as a keystone. It is said that coming too close to them without permission causes them to release a dark energy that causes headaches.

entry: POKENAME步态古怪，跌跌撞撞，有人认为这是因为身体被许多灵魂附身。它施展超能力时，周身会腾起骇人的幽灵气息。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME moves with an odd, stumbling gait that some believe is due to the body being possessed by many spirits. When it exerts psychic powers, a ghastly and ghostly aura flares up around its body.

entry: 哪怕只是无意间走近楔石，也会让POKENAME十分生气。它会从石中蹿出，跃起攻击，狂乱地撕咬抓挠。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gets quite angry if anyone steps near its keystones, even if by accident. It springs out from the stones and leaps to go on the attack, biting and clawing in a wild frenzy.

entry: POKENAME越愤怒，显形的身体就越大。随着它在战斗中发泄怒火，身体会逐渐缩小，直到彻底耗尽体力，退回楔石。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's manifestation grows larger the more rage it feels. It shrinks as it vents the anger in combat until it completely exhausts itself and retreats into its keystone.

entry: 野生POKENAME会在贵重骨头或粗骨头里休息。训练家若捡起它睡觉的骨头，骨头就会慢慢升温，直到滚烫。研究者推测，这是因为它很重视休息。
author: sleepyman0731
source: Wild POKENAME rest within rare bones or thick clubs. If a Trainer picks up the bone that POKENAME sleeps in, the bone will slowly warm up until it is burning hot. Researchers theorize that POKENAME do this because they value their rest.

entry: 有人相信，许多迷失的风速狗灵魂汇成一个生灵，就形成了POKENAME。它夜里嚎叫时，即使附近没有其他生灵，也会有许多相同的嚎叫一同响应。
author: sk372
source: Some believe POKENAME is the conglomeration of many lost Arcanine spirits combining into one being. When it howls at night, a chorus of identical howls join in, even if no other creatures are nearby.

entry: POKENAME被视为凶残的野兽，会纯粹因狂怒而对找到的一切造成毁灭性破坏。它们越生气，鬃毛就会越大。
author: plkfsa32
source: POKENAME are considered vicious beasts, doing catastrophic damage to anything they can find out of pure rage. The angrier these Pokémon are, the larger their manes will become.

entry: 楔石干燥时，POKENAME不会从容器里现身。石头充分湿润或裹上泥后，它就会兴冲冲地出来，与周围的生灵玩耍。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will not emerge from its containment while its keystone is dry. Once the stone is properly moisturized or coated with mud, POKENAME will eagerly come out to play with those around it.

entry: POKENAME会附身古老的宝可梦雕像，将其当作自己的身体。雕像中心盘旋的灵体能量漩涡，会逐渐吞噬周围石头，迫使它定期寻找新宿主。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME possess old statues of Pokémon, using them as though they were their own body. The spiralling vortex of spiritual energy at the centre of the statue gradually consumes the surrounding stone, forcing POKENAME to periodically seek new hosts.

entry: POKENAME的拳套由楔石构成，能打出破坏力惊人的一拳。敌人若盯着它身上的漩涡，就会陷入恍惚，这也是它赢得大多数战斗的方法。
author: plkfsa32
source: POKENAME's gloves are formed from its keystone and deliver a devastating punch. Foes who stare into the vortex on its body are put into a trance, which is how it wins most fights.

entry: POKENAME一察觉危险逼近，就会瞬间移动到安全处。楔石先传送离开，灵体还会停留一两秒，随后也消失。
author: sk372
source: Whenever POKENAME senses danger approaching, it will teleport to safety. Its keystone teleports away first, its spectral form lingering for a second or two after before disappearing as well.

entry: POKENAME的汤匙只是灵体的一部分，能帮它集中精神，更好地驾驭超能力。汤匙若意外分离或被毁，它只需重新形成一把。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's spoon is just another part of its spectral form, used to help it mentally focus and better harness its psychic abilities. If the spoon is somehow separated from it or destroyed, it simply forms a new one.

entry: POKENAME游走世界，靠欺骗过活。近来的故事说，它拥有海量禁忌知识，包括像多年前封印花岩怪那样，将其他对象封印起来的能力。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME roams the world and uses deceit to get by. Recent tales write about how it possesses a fountain of forbidden knowledge, including the ability to seal others away just as Spiritomb was many years ago.

entry: 据说，POKENAME腰间的石腰带寄宿着超过100名强大斗士的灵魂。人们相信，这些灵魂会在战斗中控制它的四肢，使招式更强劲、更精妙。
author: sk372
source: The stone belt around POKENAME's waist is said to house the spirits of over 100 powerful fighters. Said spirits are believed to take control of POKENAME's limbs in combat, giving its moves greater strength and finesse.

entry: POKENAME会在强大的宝可梦面前从楔石中现身，鼓起肌肉，挑战对方一比力量。若无人应战，它便觉得无聊，退回石内。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME emerges from its keystone in the presence of strong Pokémon, flexing at them as a challenge to compare their strength. If its challenge is not met, it grows bored and retreats back into its stone.

entry: POKENAME的身体由瘴气与灵质构成，在古代文明遗迹中游荡，执着地收集遗物囤藏，并攻击它认定入侵领地的对象。
author: zeterzero
source: With a body constructed from miasma and ectoplasm, POKENAME prowls the ruins of ancient civilizations, obsessively gathering relics for its hoard and attacking those it deems invaders of its territory.

entry: 起初，人们以为POKENAME是被危险灵魂赋予生命的雕像。但一些研究者相信，它们其实是为猎捕这些灵魂而造，会将其吞食，囚禁在石质身体内。
author: zeterzero
source: POKENAME were originally thought to be statues brought to life by dangerous spirits, but some researchers believe they were actually constructed to hunt said spirits, consuming and imprisoning them within their stone bodies.

entry: 据说，这是一座住着多个恶魂的杰尼龟雕像，会朝毫无防备的人类与宝可梦，射出水流。
author: schwaus
source: It is said to be a statue of a Squirtle inhabited by multiple malicious spirits. They will shoot water at unsuspecting Trainers and Pokémon alike.

entry: POKENAME悬在丛林树上，来回摇摆，发出令人不安的钟鸣般声响。此时，它还会释放毒性极强、几乎无法察觉的粉末，使人恶心。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hangs from jungle trees and sways back and forth to produce an unsettling bell-like noise. During this time it releases an incredibly toxic but nearly imperceptible powder that can cause nausea.

entry: POKENAME是花园里少见的杂草，会抽干植物与草属性宝可梦的能量，再移往下一座花园。那些植物会呈现一种特殊的枯萎状态。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME is a rare weed in gardens that saps the energy out of plants and Grass-type Pokémon before moving to the next garden. Those plants have a special type of wilt to them.

entry: POKENAME的毒素最强时，灵体会变得棱角分明、参差尖锐。此时哪怕短暂接触，也会引发严重发烧与恶心。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's ethereal body grows angular and jagged when its toxins are at their most potent. Even brief contact during this time can cause terrible fevers and nausea.

entry: POKENAME发光的紫色触手覆有令人不适的毒液。它能挥打最远30英尺外的敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's glowing violet tentacles are coated in a sickly venom. It can lash them at foes from up to 30 feet away at maximum range.

entry: POKENAME像穿盔甲一样披上楔石，在战斗中保护自己。它会用幽灵力量托起附近石头，作为投射物分散敌人注意，再靠近打出扎实的拳击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME wears its keystones like armor to protect itself in battle. It uses ghostly powers to levitate nearby stones and use them as projectiles, distracting foes so it can get up close and deliver solid punches.

entry: POKENAME的楔石只要有任何部分磕掉一角，它就会勃然大怒。它向四面八方抛掷石头，直到平静下来。
author: .izik
source: Should any portion of POKENAME's keystone get chipped, it will fly into a rage. It hurls stones in all directions until it calms down.

entry: POKENAME会缩进楔石，高速滚动来移动。通常，只有为了让自己停下、开始寻找食物时，它才会显形。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME moves by tucking into its keystone and rolling around at high speeds. It typically manifests only to stop itself and go searching for food.

entry: POKENAME渴望走遍远方，却始终受楔石束缚。据说，训练家若满足它长途旅行的愿望，它便会进化。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME desires to roam far and wide but remains bound to its keystone. It is said that it evolves when a Trainer fulfills its desire to travel long distances.

entry: POKENAME虽比类似种类能离开楔石更远，却仍常觉得受困，渴望远行。训练家若帮助它实现这份天生的愿望，就会赢得它的喜爱与尊重。
author: quackquackattack
source: Even though POKENAME can travel much further from their keystone than others of similar species, they often feel trapped and have a desire to wander long distances. A Trainer who helps them fulfill this innate desire earns their love and respect.

entry: POKENAME会把幽灵尾巴垂进河里钓鱼。但它常忘记让尾巴凝实到足以碰触其他东西，于是河里的生物会直接游穿尾巴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME dips its ghostly tail into rivers in order to fish. However, it often forgets to make its tail solid enough to interact with, so the river denizens swim right through it instead.

entry: POKENAME的身体虽看似石头，其实由灵质构成，靠硬化的泥土与物质世界接触。
author: zeterzero
source: Though its body looks to be made of stone, POKENAME is actually an ectoplasmic Pokémon using hardened mud to interact with the physical world.

entry: POKENAME吸收被自己打败的宝可梦的灵魂。在遭击败前，总会尽可能大闹一番。
author: schwaus
source: POKENAME absorbs the spirits of Pokémon it defeats in battles. It will often cause as much mayhem as possible before it is defeated.

entry: POKENAME十分愚钝。常能见到它试图逃离楔石尾巴，仿佛忘了彼此永远连在一起。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite the dimwitted creature. It has often been seen attempting to flee or escape from its keystone tail, as if it has forgotten they are permanently attached.

entry: POKENAME筋疲力尽时，会将身体缩进螺丝。此时碰到螺丝，就会遭到强力电击。
author: .izik
source: When exhausted, POKENAME withdraws its body into its screw. Touching this screw during this period delivers a powerful shock.

entry: POKENAME的楔石会散发独特磁力，使彼此永远紧密相连。即使最强的宝可梦，也只能勉强将它们拉开几毫米，随后它们便会猛然重新合拢。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's keystones emit a unique magnetism that keeps them forever linked in close proximity. Even the strongest of Pokémon cannot force them to separate more than a few millimeters before they snap back together.

entry: POKENAME带着一根腐烂的大葱，恶臭会使附近植物枯萎。因为这股气味及其对环境的影响，研究者把成群的它们戏称为“败坏分子”。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME carries around a decomposed leek, which causes nearby plant life to wither due to its putrid smell. Because of this smell and how it effects the environment around it, large groups of POKENAME have been called a spoil by researchers.

entry: POKENAME将无数受困的灵魂束成双头之躯。两个漩涡不断争吵，释放局部诅咒与幽灵之风，让闯入这片共有混乱领地的任何对象迷失方向。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME binds countless trapped souls into a dual-headed entity. The twin vortices bicker constantly, unleashing localized curses and ghostly winds that disorient anyone caught in their shared, chaotic territory.

entry: POKENAME栖在新坟上，当地人相信它是在尊重新近离世的逝者。栖息时，每颗头都会发出刺耳的啼叫，慢慢数到所在墓园坟墓的准确总数。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME perches on top of fresh graves, with locals believing it does this to respect the recently deceased. While it perches, each head will make a grating squawk, slowly counting up to the exact amount of graves in the cemetery it's currently in.

entry: POKENAME会聚在寒冷水面漂浮的冰块上。它们把扁平楔石推下浮冰，比赛谁能像打水漂一样，在水上弹得更远。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gather together on ice floes floating on the frigid waters. They compete against each other by pushing their flat keystones off the floe and seeing how far they can skip themselves across the water.

entry: 人们相信，一块闹鬼的石头被冲到冰川后冻结，便形成了POKENAME。它性情凶狠残暴，却会随温度升高而变得温顺。
author: plkfsa32
source: POKENAME is believed to have formed when a haunted stone froze over after washing up on a glacier. A fierce and vicious species, it becomes more docile the warmer it gets.

entry: 它会将弱小的灵魂困在污泥身体中，再由体内的灵体细菌分解为食。若家里闹鬼，请一只POKENAME来除害是个好主意。
author: kiwiarms
source: It traps weak souls in its sludgy body. Then, the spectral bacteria within break the souls down for food. If your house is haunted, bringing in a POKENAME to serve as pest control is a good idea.

entry: POKENAME以有毒废料为食。它们虽然外表阴森，常出没的水域却出奇清澈，因此是自然保护人士的首选。
author: riley_muir_qu33n_in_yellow
source: POKENAME feeds off toxic waste. Despite their grim appearance, waters POKENAME have been known to frequent are surprisingly clear, and they are the top pick for nature conservationists.

entry: 一些科学家推测，古代生物的遗体随时间分解成原油，灵魂附身这些油团，便形成了POKENAME。另一些人则认为，它是一种黏菌。
author: kiwiarms
source: Some scientists theorize POKENAME are masses of crude oil possessed by the souls of the ancient lifeforms whose bodies broke down over time to become that oil. Others think it's a type of slime mold.

entry: 海上传说称，水中灵魂赋予海面上的星星倒影生命，便诞生了POKENAME。无论如何，它们的液态身体既迷人又神秘。
author: zeterzero
source: Maritime legends say POKENAME come into being when reflections of stars on the surface of the ocean are given life by aquatic spirits. Regardless, the liquid bodies of these Pokémon are as mysterious as they are fascinating.

entry: 它聚集数百个亡魂，强化自己。为了更多力量，连整个生态系统，也会肆意毁坏。
author: schwaus
source: It has gathered hundreds of souls to empower itself. It will ravage entire ecosystems in the pursuit of more power.

entry: POKENAME常大量栖居于海底洞穴。许多探洞者都被吓过：一只只个体好奇地打开壳，发光的面孔点缀着洞壁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tends to inhabit underwater caves in large numbers. Many undersea cavern explorers have been terrified by the sight of multiple POKENAME opening their shells curiously, their glowing faces dotting the cavern walls.

entry: POKENAME大多时间都躲在紧闭的石壳里。若其他对象的存在令它厌烦，石壳便会打开，它探出身体，发出可怕的狞笑，将对方吓走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME remains shut within its closed stone shell most of the time. If it feels bothered by the presence of others, the shell opens and POKENAME stretches out with a frightening cackle to scare them away.

entry: 由于灵力较弱，它们依靠有毒气体，吓走靠近家园的人。它们会偷取诅咒之符等仪式用品，加以侵蚀，转而供自己驱使。
author: quackquackattack
source: They rely on noxious fumes to scare people away from their homes, as their spiritual abilities are weaker. They are known to steal ritualistic objects such as a Spell Tag, which they corrupt and turn to their will.

entry: 淘气的POKENAME从楔石里现身时，总忍不住咯咯怪笑，打算惹点小乱子。它用脱离身体的双手触碰毫无戒心的路人，让令人动弹不得的寒意沿脊背直窜。
author: sk372
source: The mischievous POKENAME cannot resist cackling as it emerges from its keystone, intent on causing a bit of minor havoc. It reaches out with its disembodied hands to touch unsuspecting passersby and send a paralyzing chill down their spine.

entry: POKENAME的幽灵力量满溢，楔石几乎无法好好容纳。它想用丰富的能力震慑所有其他幽灵属性宝可梦，逼它们臣服于自己的威力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is bursting with ghostly powers, to the point that its keystone can barely contain it properly. It seeks to use its vast range of abilities to cow all other Ghost-type Pokémon into submitting before its might.

entry: POKENAME会在荒废空地和田野下，挖掘巨大而错综复杂的洞穴。建在巢穴上方的建筑，常有灵异目击与经历大幅增加的报告。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME creates large, intricate burrows beneath abandoned lots and fields. Buildings constructed above these Pokémon's dens report a large surge in paranormal sightings and experiences.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时会灵魂出窍，留意逼近的敌人。即使沉睡，它仍完全掌握周围情况，确保自己绝不会措手不及。
author: .izik
source: While asleep, POKENAME will astral project to watch for approaching foes. It remains fully aware of its surroundings even in deep slumber, ensuring it is never caught off guard.

entry: POKENAME会运用几种催眠方式，轻松赢得战斗。若硬币没能迷惑敌人，它就快速旋转脚下的传送门；最后的手段，是让瞳孔旋转，直视对方双眼。
author: sleepyman0731
source: POKENAME uses several methods of hypnosis to ensure effortless victories in battle. If a foe is not swayed by its coin, POKENAME rapidly spins the portal at its feet. As a last resort, POKENAME makes its pupil swirl and stares into its foe's eyes.

entry: POKENAME会盯上花大量时间追忆过去的人。找到目标后，它便催眠对方，吃掉过多的怀旧之情。
author: sleepyman0731
source: POKENAME target humans who spend a lot of time reminiscing about the past. Once it finds a target, POKENAME hypnotizes the person and eats the excess nostalgia.

entry: POKENAME会盯上花大量时间追忆过去的人。找到目标后，它便催眠对方，吃掉过多的怀旧之情。
author: sleepyman0731
source: POKENAME target humans who spend a lot of time reminiscing about the past. Once it finds a target, POKENAME hypnotizes the person and eats the excess nostalgia.

entry: 比起现身时所依附的钳状楔石，POKENAME更喜欢用灵体钳子对付其他对象。石钳虽更强，它却似乎不愿冒着损坏的风险使用。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME prefers to use its spectral claw against others rather than the claw-shaped keystone it emerges from. The stone claw is stronger, but POKENAME seems unwilling to risk damaging it.

entry: POKENAME会附身多石海岸的岩石，用灵体能量为自己构筑坚固的壳。它从巨钳射出的水泡，泛着奇异的绿光。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME possesses the rocks on stony seashores, using its spectral energy to build itself a sturdy shell. The water bubbles it fires from its large claw have a strange green glow.

entry: 它通过藤蔓传导神秘能量，感知敌人，精准出击。球茎状的生长物会在月光下开花，释放孢子；是安抚还是下毒，全看它的心情。
author: segmoph
source: Channels mystical energy through its vines to sense foes, striking with precision. Its bulb-like growth blooms under moonlight, releasing spores that calm or poison, depending on its mood.

entry: POKENAME能极其娴熟地挥舞注入波导的骨头。这些强化武器击中后，会留下疼痛的波导灼伤，久久难以消退。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME wields aura-infused bones with incredible finesse. Strikes made by these enhanced weapons leave painful aura burns behind that take ages to go away.

entry: POKENAME出没于古迹，骨骼因注入波导而发光。忠诚勇猛，肉搏与波导战都很强，深受训练家钦佩。
author: sheogorath
source: Found in ancient ruins, POKENAME's bones glow with infused aura. Trainers admire its fierce loyalty and strength in physical and aura-based combat.

entry: POKENAME的波导集中在腿部肌肉周围，使它能操纵肌肉的伸缩，踢出难以预测的攻击。战斗中，它完全沉默，专心致志地击败对手。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's Aura is concentrated around its leg muscles, allowing it to manipulate their stretchiness into unpredictable kicks. It remains completely silent in battle, dedicating complete focus to defeating its opponent.

entry: POKENAME的波导集中于坚如钢铁的双拳，使它能操纵拳击的威力。它采用防守战法，感知敌人的动作，以坚硬皮肤格挡，或迅速侧步闪避。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's Aura is concentrated within its steel-tough fists, allowing it to manipulate the power of its punches. It employs a defensive fighting style by sensing the foe's moves, blocking with its hardened hide or dodging with swift sidesteps.

entry: POKENAME能感知周围植物的波导，知道哪些花最健康、花粉最丰富，适合品尝。波导不够强的植物，它绝不取食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can sense the aura of plant life around it, letting it know which flowers are the healthiest and most full of pollen for it to sample. It refuses to eat from plants that don't have a strong enough aura.

entry: 波导凝成球体，悬在双钳之间。它会通过这颗球，窥察人类与宝可梦的波导。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: Aura accumulates into an orb that floats between its pincers. It uses this ball to peer into the aura of people and Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME天生与其他生灵的思想、情感相通，自身波导却十分微弱。为了增强波导，它会进入恍惚状态，引发肌肉痉挛，迫使自己无助地扑腾。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME has an innate connection to the thoughts and feelings of others, though its own aura is very weak. To try to strengthen its own aura, it enters a trance that causes muscle spasms, which forces POKENAME to flop helplessly.

entry: POKENAME能用纯粹的波导能量造出尖刺，自我防卫。这些刺能毒害敌人的波导，削弱对方，让它趁机逃到安全处。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME creates spikes out of pure aura energy to defend itself. These spikes are able to poison the aura of enemies, weakening them while POKENAME runs to safety.

entry: 海难发生时，海事人员认为POKENAME无可替代，尤其是在夜间。凭借感知波导的能力，它比肉眼更能有效找到待救者。
author: sk372
source: Maritime workers consider POKENAME invaluable in times of disasters at sea, especially during the night. With its ability to sense aura, it can locate those in need of rescue more effectively than the naked eye.

entry: POKENAME斗志强烈，只会复制自己认定值得的对手，此前始终以原形战斗。变身后，周身仍会散发微弱闪烁的波导。
author: sk372
source: With a powerful fighting spirit, POKENAME will only copy opponents it deems worthy enough, fighting in its normal form until then. Its transformed state retains a faint flickering aura emanating around it.

entry: POKENAME能通过读取波导，了解其他生灵的情绪。训练家若承受巨大压力或惊恐发作，它就会前来帮忙，坐在腿上给予安慰。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME can read the emotions of others by reading their aura. Should its Trainer be experiencing intense stress or panic attacks, POKENAME will come to their aid, sitting on their lap to provide comfort.

entry: POKENAME精通波导与电力，借此制服敌人。脚步之快，连人眼也跟不上。
author: jona_hehe
source: POKENAME uses its mastery of aura and electricity to subdue its opponents. This Pokémon is quick on its feet and is able to move faster than the human eye can follow.

entry: POKENAME能感知设备或系统中的恶意代码与损坏代码。虽然能找到任何隐藏的恶意程序，它却常无法清除病毒或解决问题。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has the power to sense malicious and corrupted code inside of devices or systems. While it can find any hidden malware, it often has no way of ridding the virus or dealing with the issue.

entry: POKENAME没有四肢，完全依赖波导与茧保护自己。波导由最基本的自保欲望驱动，击退想吃掉它的捕食者。
author: quackquackattack
source: Without limbs, POKENAME relies entirely on the protection of its aura and its cocoon. This aura, fueled by its basic desire of self-preservation, rebuffs predators who try to eat it.

entry: POKENAME身体燃烧着蓝色灵火，会对强烈情感作出反应。有勇气或意志坚定的训练家在场时，火焰会变得更热。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME's body burns with blue, spiritual fire that reacts to strong emotions, growing hotter in the presence of a Trainer with courage or unwavering resolve.

entry: POKENAME只接受拥有善良波导的人训练。它虽然总体厌恶暴力，但若所关爱者受伤，就一定会用尽每一分波导之力，保护对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will only allow itself to be trained by those who possess a kind aura. Although it disdains violence overall, harming those it cares about will ensure POKENAME uses every ounce of its aura strength to defend them.

entry: POKENAME能感知其他宝可梦的波导，会寻找领地内最强的波导，飞去战斗。它们热衷交战，因此很受空手道王欢迎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can sense the aura of other Pokémon and will seek out the strongest aura within their territories, flying toward them to battle. Their eagerness to fight makes them popular companions for Black Belts.

entry: POKENAME能操纵其他生灵的波导，使对方感觉、行动都像完全不同的物种。许多人突然像野生宝可梦一样行事的案例，最终都追溯到它在捣乱。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is able to manipulate the auras of others to make them feel and act like entire different species. Many cases and reports of people suddenly acting like wild Pokémon have led back to a POKENAME messing with their behaviors.

entry: POKENAME用头上的叶冠感知周围一切的波导。颈部卷曲的叶片会将它强烈的斗志传给闻到气味的对象。
author: t3isukone
source: The leaf crest on POKENAME's head is what it uses to sense the auras of everything around it. The curled-up leaves on its neck impart to those who smell them POKENAME's fierce fighting spirit.

entry: POKENAME能感知其他宝可梦的波导，会寻找领地内最强的波导，飞去战斗。有些个体与游离的超级能量接触时会产生奇异反应，速度与攻击性大幅提升。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can sense the aura of other Pokémon and will seek out the strongest aura within their territories, flying toward them to battle. Some POKENAME interact strangely with rogue Mega energy, their speed and aggression dramatically increasing.

entry: POKENAME会用尾巴撑起身体，使自己看起来更高、更有威势。它甚至能借尾巴产生的波导，将自己托得更高，试图震慑格外庞大的对手。
author: sk372
source: To appear taller and more imposing, POKENAME raises itself up with its tail. It can even use aura generated from its tail to boost itself further upward, to try and intimidate particularly large opponents.

entry: POKENAME是出色的夜间猎手，凭感知波导的能力，在全黑中也能辨认目标。它会帮助宝可梦巡护员寻找待救者，察觉其波导后俯冲下去，将其救起运走。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is an adept nocturnal hunter, able to identify targets in complete darkness due to its ability to sense auras. It helps Pokémon Rangers locate those in need of rescue by noticing their aura and swooping in to airlift them.

entry: POKENAME十分暴躁好战，可能是因为波导产生过量。彼此竞争的个体会先在空中交战，被击落后就被迫在地面继续拳脚相向。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a very feisty and combative Pokémon, presumably due to excessive aura generation. Rivals will fight in midair, then continue into direct fisticuffs once downed and forced to fight on the ground.

entry: POKENAME尾端的球能传导光与波导。除了制造炫目的闪光，它还能大幅提升自身力量，放出强劲的波导冲击，击退整群敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tail orb channels light as well as its aura. Aside from creating blinding flashes, it can surge its own power enough to create mighty aura waves that can knock back entire groups of enemies.

entry: POKENAME对其他生灵的波导十分敏感，察觉格外强烈的情绪时，胡须会抖动。它们借此避险，一感觉到强烈的愤怒或敌意，就立刻窜入掩蔽处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are sensitive to the aura of others, their whiskers twitching when they sense particularly strong emotions. They use this sense to evade danger, darting for cover whenever they feel strong anger or aggression.

entry: 事实证明，POKENAME即使年幼，也能完全理解人类语言。因此，它无视或故意曲解命令、找借口用浊流泼训练家时，往往更让人恼火。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME has been proven to perfectly understand human speech, even at a young age. This often annoys Trainers when it ignores or deliberately misinterprets commands, finding excuses to splash them with Muddy Water.

entry: POKENAME能感知生灵的波导与心思，几乎无人能向它掩饰真正动机。执法机构开始考虑雇用它，协助审讯时测谎。
author: sk372
source: With the ability to sense the auras and the minds of living creatures, few can hide their true motives from POKENAME. Law enforcement agencies are beginning to consider employing it to assist in lie detection during interrogations.

entry: 它会运用波导之力，培育背上的花。与信任的人待在一起时，花会长得更健康。
author: delexious
source: It harnesses the power of aura to grow the flower on its back. The flower grows healthier in the presence of people it trusts.

entry: 为了维持极其坚固的身体，POKENAME会吞食海量含碳物质。由于它拥有神秘的情感感知能力，便有传闻说，这个贪吃的家伙能追上并彻底吞噬别人的情绪。
author: bobosmith01
source: To sustain its incredibly sturdy body, POKENAME eats overflowing amounts of carbon-based material. Due to its mysterious emotion-detecting powers, rumors that the ravenous POKENAME can chase down and completely devour another's emotions have emerged.

entry: POKENAME的身体由液态波导构成。斗志高涨时，蓝色火焰会穿过外壳燃起。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's body is made of liquid aura. When its fighting spirit flares, blue flames blaze through its shell.

entry: 闲暇时，POKENAME会蜷在自己造出的数据球周围。抱着球让它安心，感到受威胁时，也能将球用作威力强大的投射武器。
author: sk372
source: When idle, POKENAME curls itself around a data sphere it creates. Holding the sphere brings it comfort, but it can also use the orb as a powerful thrown projectile when it feels threatened.

entry: POKENAME每天练习多种武术。只有遇到波导与自己相映的导师，才会选定一条道路，专心修行。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME trains daily in multiple forms of martial arts. It only chooses a dedicated path when it discovers a mentor whose Aura mirrors its own.

entry: POKENAME借助波导能力加快旋转，在战场上高速转动，兼顾攻防。战后，它会打磨头上的金属尖刺，静心冥想。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME empowers the speed of its spinning with the aid of its Aura abilities, allowing it to rapidly spin around the battlefield both offensively and defensively. To meditate after a fight, it polishes the metal spike on its head.

entry: POKENAME会特别根据不适者的波导，为蛋注入相应的波导。得到强化后，蛋能更有效地治愈对方的病痛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME infuses its eggs with aura based specifically on the aura it senses from those not feeling well. With the infusion, the eggs are specially enhanced to be more effective at curing the person's ills.

entry: 它洪亮有力地嚎叫，便能引来闪电击中自身，使全身缠绕电流。它虽然身形庞大，却格外灵活，会运用身体各部位攻击，但通常更偏爱尾巴。
author: infinex21
source: With its powerful, roaring howl it can call down lightning upon itself and become wreathed in electricity. It is remarkably dexterous despite its size and utilizes every part of its body to attack, though it tends to favor attacking with its tail.

entry: POKENAME能在宽大的爪掌间产生融入波导的风。双掌一拍，就能掀起强劲气流，激起海浪，甚至连最粗壮的树也能连根拔起。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can generate aura-infused winds within its large paws. Clapping them together creates mighty wind bursts that can create ocean waves and uproot even the thickest of trees.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴充满波导，能增强攻击。有忠诚族群支持时，它战斗最为奋力。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's tails are charged with aura, strengthening their attacks. It fights the hardest when it has support from a loyal colony.

entry: POKENAME会操纵别人的波导，改变其行为，使对方遭受厄运与败落。强行改变波导也会影响自身情绪，因此让人变快乐时，它也会感到快乐。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME manipulates the auras of others in order to change how they behave and bring them their own misfortune and downfall. This forceful change of aura affects its own feelings too, so when it makes people happier, it feels happy too.

entry: POKENAME能解读电流频率中的规律。这让研究者十分兴奋，正尝试制造设备，以更先进的方式与它交流。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME can decipher patterns in electric frequencies. This has caused much excitement amongst researchers, and they are trying to create a device with an advanced way of communicating with them.

entry: 它会将波导凝成球体，坚硬程度不输岩石皮肤，再从掌心高速发射。
author: .jerden
source: It focuses its aura into spheres as hard as its rocky hide. It then launches them from its palms at high speed.

entry: POKENAME能感知波导，探知人的位置。研究者曾尝试让它参与先进的成像系统，但人类看着屏幕上由它产生的影像，只感到恶心与困惑。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can detect people by sensing their auras. Researchers once attempted to integrate it into an advanced imaging system, but humans who viewed the images it produced on screens only felt nauseous and confused.

entry: POKENAME被逼入绝境时，会让巨大尾巴缠绕强大的波导，并在双臂上形成波导刃。此时，它会战斗到底，哪怕与对手同归于尽。
author: infinex21
source: When a POKENAME is cornered, it will wreathe its large tail in its powerful aura and form aura blades upon its arms. It will fight to the last at this point, even if it means taking its opponent down with it.

entry: 它们会感知并追踪猎物的波导，在茂密丛林与葱郁森林中潜行狩猎。在树间跃动时，会从口中射出凝缩的波导弹。
author: infinex21
source: They stalk their prey through thick jungles and lush forests by sensing and tracking their auras. They will fire condensed Aura Spheres from their mouths as they leap between the trees.

entry: 这种宝可梦会结合储存在颊囊中的波导与电力，麻痹并击倒敌人。POKENAME正义感强烈，只会与实力不低于自己的对手战斗。
author: nyoomymph
source: This Pokémon uses a mix of aura and electricity, both stored in the pouches on its cheeks, in order to stun and down foes. POKENAME has a strong sense of justice and will only fight opponents that match or exceed its own strength.

entry: 据说，POKENAME炽热踢击上的火焰来自冥界。它们会喂饱任何饥饿者，厌恶浪费食物，并会惩罚浪费者。
author: slimninja55
source: It is said POKENAME's fiery kicks are lit with flames of the underworld. They feed anyone who is hungry and hate food waste, punishing those partaking in it.

entry: POKENAME结合波导感知与超能力，判断任何靠近训练家的对象有多危险。它能以念力控制无数波导弹齐射，保护心爱的伙伴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses aura sense in conjunction with psychic abilities to judge the threat level of anything that comes near its Trainer. It can launch a volley of countless Aura Spheres controlled by telekinesis to protect its beloved companions.

entry: POKENAME将超能力与波导操纵结合，是个强劲的对手。敏锐的感官赋予它惊人的预判能力，反击时发出的巨大波导能量弹，往往一发就能击败敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's psychic abilities and aura manipulation combine to make it a formidable opponent. Its senses give it amazing foresight, and the large aura projectiles it counters with take out most foes with a single shot.

entry: POKENAME能感知遇险宝可梦焦虑的波导。因此，宝可梦巡护员会与它合作，阻止火箭队的走私贩运活动。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can sense the distressed auras of Pokémon in danger. This has led Pokémon Rangers to partner with POKENAME to halt Team Rocket trafficking operations.

entry: POKENAME蜷成球时移动极快。以音速四处滚动时，它会感知周围的波导，避免意外撞上东西。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME moves extremely fast when it curls into a ball. When rolling around at the speed of sound, POKENAME uses its aura to sense its surroundings so that it doesn't accidentally run into anything.

entry: POKENAME能集中波导，投射出幽灵般的面孔。若投影包裹住其他生灵的身体，就能抽取其波导，使对方极度虚弱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can concentrate and project its aura in the form of a ghostly visage. Should this projection envelop the body of another, it can drain their aura and leave them severely weakened.

entry: POKENAME能将波导压缩到具有爆炸性的程度。它通常会这样对付散发不良或邪恶波导的人类与宝可梦。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can compress aura to the point where it becomes explosive. It usually does this to the people or Pokémon that are emanating bad or evil auras.

entry: 融合产生的庞大能量作用于波导，使POKENAME全身长出红黑斑纹。它与敌人战斗时毫不留情。
author: soup1900
source: The overwhelming energy of fusion on its aura has caused it to develop red and black marks all over its body. POKENAME shows no mercy when battling against enemies.

entry: 融合产生的庞大能量作用于波导，使POKENAME全身长出红黑斑纹。它与敌人战斗时毫不留情。
author: soup1900
source: The overwhelming energy of fusion on its aura has caused it to develop red and black marks all over its body. POKENAME shows no mercy when battling against enemies.

entry: POKENAME全身长着厚毛，抵御波导攻击。好战的天性使它手上与附肢都长出了尖刺。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has grown thick fur over its body to shield itself from aura attacks. Its combative nature has caused it to grow spikes on its hands and appendages.

entry: POKENAME不断感知周围的波导，始终高度警惕。一察觉不良波导，它就会立刻攻击对方，试图将其消除。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is constantly sensing the aura around it, always on high alert. If a bad aura is sensed, POKENAME will immediately attack them to eradicate the bad aura.

entry: POKENAME能将波导压缩到具有爆炸性的程度。它通常会这样对付散发不良或邪恶波导的人类与宝可梦。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can compress aura to the point where it becomes explosive. It usually does this to the people or Pokémon that are emanating bad or evil auras.

entry: POKENAME会四处奔走，追猎散发不良波导的对象。找到后，它就会发射波导光束，毫不留情地击败对方。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME runs around to hunt those who emit a bad aura. When it finds one, it mercilessly defeats them by blasting them with a beam of aura.

entry: POKENAME无法容纳全部能量，手脚始终散发波导。这使它的手脚拥有爆发性的力量。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is constantly emitting aura from its hands and feet due to not being able to contain all that energy. This aura gives its hands and feet explosive power.

entry: POKENAME不断感知周围的波导，始终高度警惕。一察觉不良波导，它就会立刻攻击对方，试图将其消除。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is constantly sensing the aura around it, always on high alert. If a bad aura is sensed, POKENAME will immediately attack them to eradicate the bad aura.

entry: POKENAME通过头上的角与颚，几乎能感知万物的波导。它们能凝聚自身波导用于战斗，交战时常在巨颚中形成强力波导弹。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are capable of sensing the auras of nearly all things via the horns and jaws upon their heads. They can condense their own auras and wield them in battle. They often form powerful Aura Spheres within their large jaws as they fight.

entry: POKENAME察觉好斗之人的波导时，会勃然大怒。击败敌人后，它便开始长时间休息。
author: .izik
source: When a POKENAME senses the aura of an aggressive person, it flies into a rage. After the foe is defeated, it will begin resting for long periods.

entry: POKENAME运用波导的本领几乎无可匹敌。它能自由操纵强大的自身波导，甚至造出自己或对手的复制体，协助战斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's skill with aura is nearly unmatched. It can freely manipulate its own incredible aura and even use it to form copies of itself or its opponents to aid itself when in combat.

entry: 路卡利欧会被POKENAME稳固的波导吸引，有时会爬到它背上训练。此时，它平日温和的性格就会改变，极力保护背上的乘客。
author: sk372
source: Attracted to POKENAME's sturdy aura, Lucario will sometimes climb onto its back and train themselves. When this occurs, POKENAME's normally calm personality shifts to becoming fiercely protective of its passengers.

entry: POKENAME身上的火会燃尽接触者的生命精华。它也是精通多种流派的格斗大师。
author: houndrys.
source: The fire that POKENAME emanates burns the life essence of whatever it touches. It's a master of many fighting styles.

entry: 它满溢的波导会化作狂烈的蓝焰，又能变成各种武器。它严守自己的荣誉准则，哪怕敌人心灵邪恶，也绝不攻击背后。
author: infinex21
source: Its overflowing aura manifests as raging, blue flames that it can turn into various weapons. It will never strike a foe's back, not even if they are a wicked soul, for it strictly adheres to its own code of honor.

entry: POKENAME极其强大而自负，常让波导猛然高涨，抓住一切机会炫耀力量。哪怕最轻微的冒犯，也会使它愤然回以极其锋利的波导斩击。
author: sk372
source: Extremely powerful and prideful, POKENAME flares its own aura often, taking any chance it can get to show off its strength. Even the smallest slight against it will see it indignantly respond with viciously sharp aura slashes in retaliation.

entry: 古代，POKENAME曾守卫许多陵墓。如今，电影常以它为意象，暗示它当年盛行的年代。
author: ferdirenz
source: It stood guard over many tombs in ancient times. Nowadays, POKENAME is often seen as a motif in movies to hint at the time period it was popular in.

entry: POKENAME能感知其他宝可梦的波导，从强度与质感中读出意图。察觉实力相近的宝可梦时，自身波导就会因敌意骤增，还能具现出来攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have the ability to sense the auras of other Pokémon, reading their intent through the intensity and texture of the aura. Their own aura spikes with hostility and can be manifested to attack if they sense other Pokémon of similar strength.

entry: POKENAME会不惜一切守护领地与所爱者，哪怕自己身陷险境。运用波导能力时，身体会泛起黑光，仿佛被烟雾包围。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME does whatever it takes to defend its territory and protect its loved ones, even if it puts itself in harm's way. When using its aura abilities, its body glows black, as if surrounded by smog.

entry: POKENAME能靠自身波导形成的龙翼托起身体，悬浮空中。翅膀缓缓拍动时，会发出低沉的嗡鸣。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can float in the air, held aloft by draconic wings made out of its own aura. Their slow beating produces a low-pitched hum.

entry: POKENAME的幻术极其高明，除了外形，甚至连对方的波导也能完美再现。据说，每只个体都以掌握1000种波导为目标。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's illusory powers are so effective it can even perfectly recreate the aura of others as well as their form. It's said the goal of every POKENAME is to master 1000 auras.

entry: POKENAME活得越久，身上的毛就越绯红，波导与幻术之力也已达到极高境界。它们能结合黑暗能量与自身波导，向敌人轰出强劲的能量攻击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME bear crimson fur the longer they have lived, their powers of aura and illusion having reached great heights. They can combine dark energies with their own aura to create powerful energy blasts loosed upon their foes.

entry: POKENAME准备战斗时，会通过彩色缎带，将周围的波导粒子引入体内。它勇猛无畏，即使寡不敌众也绝不退缩。
author: fiordaliso
source: When ready to fight, POKENAME channels aura particles from its surroundings into its body through its colorful ribbons. It battles with boldness and courage, never retreating even when outnumbered.

entry: POKENAME能感知其他宝可梦的波导，从强度与质感中读出意图。若判断靠近的宝可梦或人类比自己弱，它们便会平和相待。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have the ability to sense the auras of other Pokémon, reading their intent through the intensity and texture of the aura. They are peaceful when approached by Pokémon or people whom they read to be weaker than they are.

entry: POKENAME背上有一门强大的波导炮，能发射破坏力惊人的波导能量光束。只有对手表现得足以好好一战、值得它动用全力，它才会使用。
author: sk372
source: A powerful aura cannon rests on POKENAME's back, capable of firing devastating beams of aura energy. It only chooses to use this on opponents that have given it a decent enough fight to warrant its full power.

entry: 满月之夜，能见到POKENAME摇动手指，将波导汇成一大片盘旋的能量。人们相信，此时它们能触及银河各处生灵的思想。
author: soup1900
source: On nights with full moons, POKENAME are seen waggling their fingers to concentrate auras into one large, swirling pool of energy. It is believed that on these occasions, they are able to tap into the thoughts of beings throughout the galaxy.

entry: POKENAME会从手上的花伸出由自身波导构成的带刺藤蔓。据说，花香能增强闻到者的斗志。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME extends thorny vines made up of its own aura from the flowers on its hands. The aroma its flowers emit is said to increase the fighting spirit of those who smell them.

entry: POKENAME织出的网，带有部分波导感知能力。波导纯净的对象碰到丝线，不会触电，也不会被黏住；心怀邪恶者却几乎立刻就会遭电击并被困住。
author: sk372
source: The webs POKENAME spins carry some of its aura-detecting nature within. Those that are pure of aura can touch the threads and feel no shock or stickiness, but evil hearts will be jolted and stuck nigh-instantaneously.

entry: POKENAME通过波导察觉危险时，头上的藤蔓就会疯狂挥动。它会不断踢击，保卫训练家，直到威胁消退。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME senses danger through aura, the vines on its head flail wildly. It will defend its Trainer with relentless kicks until the threat subsides.

entry: 附近出现恶意波导时，POKENAME的火焰会变成绯红色。古代王室会将它们部署在城堡入口，揭露间谍或叛徒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's flames turn crimson in the presence of malevolent aura. In ancient times, royal courts stationed them in castle entrances to expose spies or traitors.

entry: POKENAME巡视幽暗洞穴，以波导感知入侵者。若没察觉恶意，就会无视目标；但对波导可憎的对象，它会毫不留情地赶出家园。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME patrols dark caverns, using its aura-sensing capabilities to detect intruders. If it sense no evil it ignores the target, but shows no mercy in repelling those with detestable auras from its home.

entry: POKENAME在卡洛斯是很受欢迎的身份象征，许多立志成为精英训练家的人，会把它挂在包上装点衣着。它喜欢帮训练家携带重要物品，小心紧握珍贵石头。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are a popular status symbol in Kalos, with many aspiring Ace Trainers accessorising their outfits by attaching them to their bag. POKENAME enjoy helping their Trainer carry important objects, taking care to hold precious stones tightly.

entry: POKENAME在卡洛斯很受欢迎，许多立志成为精英训练家的人，会把它挂在包上当装饰。它喜欢协助训练家战斗，送来重要道具，省下翻包的宝贵时间。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular in Kalos, with many aspiring Ace Trainers accessorising their bags by attaching POKENAME to them. POKENAME enjoy assisting their Trainers in battle, bringing them important items and saving precious seconds of rifling in bags.

entry: POKENAME在卡洛斯是很受欢迎的身份象征，许多立志成为精英训练家的人，会把它挂在包上装点衣着。人们常放心地将贵重宝石托付给它，因为知道它会奋力守护。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are a popular status symbol in Kalos, with many aspiring Ace Trainers accessorising their outfits by attaching them to their bag. They are often entrusted with valuable gem stones in the safe knowledge that they will guard them fiercely.

entry: 两颗头彼此紧密相连，能将攻击衔接成连招。夜里，一颗头睡觉时，另一颗仍会继续训练。
author: mistymagius
source: The two heads have powerful connection with one another, allowing them to combo their attacks together. During the night, one head will keep training while the other sleeps.

entry: POKENAME灵活而优雅，几乎像在战场上起舞，用尾巴打出强力攻击。人们认为，它感知波导的能力，能让它在出招前预知敌人的位置。
author: chibitales
source: With agility and grace, POKENAME are able to practically dance around the battlefield, delivering powerful blows from their tails. It's thought that POKENAME's ability to sense auras allows them to predict where their foes will be before they strike.

entry: POKENAME是热衷学习的斗士，大多时间都用来训练，跟随其他格斗属性宝可梦模仿技巧。但它攻击距离不及大型宝可梦，因此很难复制每一种招式。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are combatants that are eager to learn, spending most of their time training and shadowing other Fighting-Type Pokémon to mimic their techniques. They lack the reach of larger Pokémon, meaning they struggle to copy every technique.

entry: POKENAME的波导过量，无法全部容纳，因而在周身化作可见的舞动火焰。九条尾巴中的每一条，都有足以夷平一座城市的力量。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME has an excessive amount of aura. Unable to contain it, it manifests visibly around its body in the form of dancing flames. Each one of POKENAME's nine tails contains enough power to level a city.

entry: POKENAME能用巨颚给予入侵者威力惊人的咬击。它相当好斗，会给双颚覆上少量波导，让咬击也造成疼痛的灼伤。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's large jaws give it an impressive bite to use on intruders. It is quite aggressive, coating its jaws with a small amount of aura in order to make the bite inflict a painful burn as well.

entry: POKENAME天生能唱许多不同的歌。凭借感知其他生灵情绪的能力，它似乎总知道哪首歌能让听众开心。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can innately sing a variety of different songs. Through its ability to sense the emotions of others, POKENAME always seems to know what song will cheer up the listeners.

entry: POKENAME始终住在神秘液体形成的泡泡内，液体已染上波导的蓝色。凭借其中储存的力量，它能释放波导弹等强力攻击，也能通过心灵感应读心。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME constantly lives inside a bubble of mysterious liquid that has taken on the blue color of its aura. Thanks to the power stored within, it can unleash devastating attacks like Aura Sphere and read minds through telepathy.

entry: POKENAME没有眼睛，靠感知周围的波导辨别方向。它会被交战宝可梦的波导吸引，令训练家十分头痛。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME has no eyes, so it navigates by sensing the aura of its surroundings. It is attracted to the aura of battling Pokémon, making it a nuisance to Trainers.

entry: POKENAME为了赢得战斗，不惜变通规则。巨颚能打出碾压般的重击，强到足以让远大于自己的敌人踉跄。
author: fiordaliso
source: In battle, POKENAME is willing to bend the rules to claim victory. Its massive jaws can deliver crushing blows strong enough to stagger foes much larger than itself.

entry: 它们虽轻巧细小，勇气与荣誉感却无可比拟。即便毫无胜算，也常奋勇应战。
author: xephyr
source: Although tiny and light, their fearlessness and honor cannot be overstated. They often enter fights that they have no chance of winning.

entry: POKENAME会探查经过生灵的波导，寻找疾病或虚弱的迹象。一发现脆弱的猎物，就毫不留情地扑下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME scans the auras of passing creatures for signs of illness or weakness. When it finds vulnerable prey, it descends without mercy.

entry: POKENAME在山间四处寻找迷路的人类。找到后，它们会用波导与对方交流，诱到巢穴，让人在那里丧命。
author: notmax22
source: POKENAME roam around mountains looking for lost humans, whenever they find one they use their aura powers to communicate to them and lure them to their den where they meet their end.

entry: POKENAME飞越山脉，搜寻遇险的迹象。它能在数英里外感知惊慌或疼痛的波导信号，迅速赶去相助。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME soars above mountain ranges, scanning for signs of distress. It can sense aura signals of panic or pain from miles away and rush to aid the source.

entry: POKENAME天性亲善，到了和平的地方，总用礼物与拥抱，带来欢乐。有时，友好被误认作软弱，可真要打，它们也是出色的战士。
author: gloomymort
source: POKENAME are incredibly friendly by nature. They bring happiness in the form of gifts and hugs when visiting peaceful places. Occasionally, their friendly disposition is mistaken for weakness when, in reality, they are very capable combatants.

entry: 强壮的双臂与胸前尖刺，使POKENAME的拥抱极其危险。它只会拥抱敌人，表达喜爱时，则用毛茸茸的手拍拍训练家的背或头。
author: .jerden
source: Its powerful arms and the sharp spike on its chest make its hugs incredibly dangerous. POKENAME reserves its embrace for its enemies and will express affection by patting its Trainer on the back or head with its fluffy hands instead.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在不见阳光的海沟，连拳海参等猎物最微弱的波导也能察觉。一发现目标，就会以可怕的速度与力量撞过去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lurks in sunless ocean trenches, detecting even the faintest aura of prey like Pyukumuku. When found, it slams into them with terrifying speed and force.

entry: POKENAME向敌人注入毒液后，会退到远处，监视其波导。它等到对方生命力衰弱，才会再次出击。
author: .izik
source: After injecting venom into its foe, POKENAME hangs back and monitors their aura from afar. It waits until their vitality dims before striking again.

entry: POKENAME能感知波导，评估植物的健康，因此很能帮上园丁的忙。但在野外，它们会借此寻找内部腐烂的树，取食到树木死亡为止。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can assess the health of plants by sensing their aura. While this makes it useful to gardeners, in the wild, POKENAME use this ability to find trees that are rotting from the inside and then feed on them until they die.

entry: POKENAME的帆状部位能帮助它感知、投射波导与情绪。必须战斗时，它会先冻结对手，再用鞭子般的尾巴抽打。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's sails help it detect and project auras and emotions. When it must fight, it freezes opponents and then slaps them with its whip-like tail.

entry: POKENAME热情忠诚，生活在关系紧密的族群中。凭敏锐的波导感知，它们能立刻察觉附近受困的生灵，毫不犹豫地赶去相助。
author: bluenido.
source: Highly enthusiastic and loyal, POKENAME live in tight-knit packs. Using their keen aura-sensing ability, they instantly detect nearby creatures in distress and rush to their aid without hesitation.

entry: POKENAME将波导推向极限，释放狂野凶猛的力量。它不顾一切地战斗，用灌注波导的咬击与接连重击，在短短几秒内压倒敌人。
author: bluenido.
source: By pushing its aura to extreme limits, POKENAME unlocks a wild, ferocious power. It fights recklessly, using aura-infused bites and relentless, heavy blows to overwhelm foes in a matter of seconds.

entry: POKENAME独自游走荒凉之地，保护弱者。它冷静而善于算计，以波导读取敌人动作，承受重击也毫不动摇，直到找到给予强力反击的绝佳时机。
author: bluenido.
source: POKENAME wanders desolate lands alone to protect the weak. Calm and calculating, it uses aura to read enemy movements, enduring heavy blows without flinching until it finds the perfect moment to deliver a devastating counter.

entry: POKENAME独自游走荒凉之地，保护弱者。它冷静而善于算计，以波导读取敌人动作，承受重击也毫不动摇，直到找到给予强力反击的绝佳时机。
author: bluenido.
source: POKENAME wanders desolate lands alone to protect the weak. Calm and calculating, it uses aura to read enemy movements, enduring heavy blows without flinching until it finds the perfect moment to deliver a devastating counter.

entry: POKENAME看着不过一朵普通蘑菇，等猎物靠近，便亮出武艺，突然袭击。
author: prof.whitebeam
source: POKENAME seems like a normal mushroom, but when its prey approaches, it shows its martial skills and attacks.

entry: 这种宝可梦是出色的斗士。波导感知让它能预判并反制对手的任何动作，还能大幅强化物理攻击，据说甚至足以粉碎灵魂。
author: fireblade141
source: This Pokémon is an incredible fighter. Its ability to sense aura gives it the power to predict and counter any move an opponent makes, as well as supercharge its physical attacks to the point that it is said they can shatter the very soul.

entry: POKENAME集中波导能量，便能形成锋利刀刃攻击。因此，人们说它战斗时美丽非凡，宛如闪光的舞蹈。
author: sara886a
source: By focusing the energy of its aura, POKENAME is able to generate sharp blades that it uses to attack. Because of this, it is said to be a beautiful sight, like a dance of flashing lights, when POKENAME engages in battle.

entry: 借助融合后的波导，POKENAME能造出黑暗波导手里剑，对付敌人。野生个体往往寻找强大的训练家，一同训练，磨炼本领。
author: zitwalt
source: Using their fused aura they are able to create dark aura shurikens, which they use against their opponents. Wild POKENAME tend to look for strong trainers to hone their skills and train with.

entry: POKENAME会被强大的训练家吸引，远远便能感知其波导。它们会挖隧道接近感兴趣的人，从对方面前冒出，坚持要求一战。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are drawn to strong Trainers, able to sense their aura from great distances away. They tunnel toward anyone that catches their interest, popping up in front of them and insisting on a battle.

entry: POKENAME拿过的每枚硬币，都会注入少许波导。若有人偷走它的硬币，即使那些硬币原本也是偷来的，它仍能感知，最终必定再偷回来。
author: sk372
source: Any coin POKENAME grabs is infused with a small amount of its aura. Should anybody steal its coins, even if they themselves were stolen, it will be able to sense them and inevitably pilfer them back.

entry: 路卡利欧原本控制得当的波导能力，融合成POKENAME后却会完全失控。无穷的怒意从身体散发，让附近所有生灵都变得充满敌意、极具攻击性。
author: bobosmith01
source: Lucario's well-controlled aura abilities are instead completely berserk when fused into a POKENAME. Its never-ending feelings of rage radiate off its body and make everyone in the area overwhelmingly hostile and aggressive.

entry: 它忠于训练家，相隔很远也能察觉对方是否安好。记住一股波导的气味后，就再也不会忘记。
author: houndrys.
source: Loyal to its Trainer, it can sense their wellbeing even at long distance. Once it's learned the smell of an aura, it never forgets it.

entry: POKENAME很少成群被人看见。模样酷似某个热门儿童游戏系列中的可怕敌人。
author: moginar
source: POKENAME have rarely been spotted in groups. They resemble a fearsome foe from a popular children's game series.

entry: POKENAME对波导的掌控增强，四肢也因此更加灵巧迅捷。火焰的威力，不亚于拳头。
author: houndrys.
source: Enhanced aura control allows POKENAME to move its limbs with much greater dexterity and speed. Its flames are as powerful as its fists.

entry: POKENAME着迷于波导强大的人，会寻找对方，好奇地观察。它们能在很远处感知波导，一发现另一个有趣目标，就会奔跑许多英里，前去寻找。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are fascinated by people with strong auras, seeking them out to watch them curiously. They can sense aura from a great distance and, when they sense another interesting aura, will race many miles to find the new subject of their fascination.

entry: POKENAME以不知疲倦的斗志战斗，肌肉一绷紧，波导就会高涨，令它重振精神。武术家常找它一起训练，希望学会妥善控制波导。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME battle with an indefatigable spirit, their aura flaring and reinvigorating them whenever their muscles begin to flex. Martial artists regularly seek out POKENAME to train with, hoping to learn proper aura control from the Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME一感知邪恶波导，就会立刻轰出破坏力惊人的精神能量。出手前绝不给予警告。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME senses an evil aura, it immediately unleashes devastating psychic blasts. It gives no warning before striking.

entry: POKENAME由路卡利欧与怪力融合，兼具波导之力与惊人蛮力，常在山区勤奋锻炼。
author: sheogorath
source: A fusion of Lucario and Machamp, POKENAME wields both aura powers and immense strength. It trains diligently in mountainous regions.

entry: POKENAME呈现出类似超级路卡利欧的身体特征，被认为是因为它能产生并维持庞大的波导。人们能在训练场馆见到它，帮助遇到困难的对象。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME display physical characteristics resembling Mega Lucario, which is attributed to POKENAME being able to generate and maintain a vast amount of aura. They can be found at gyms, helping those who may be struggling.

entry: 草地上常能见到POKENAME成群疾驰。它们能在数英里外感知捕食者的波导，并改变自身波导，向能读懂的同伴发出警告。
author: st4rdustyugure
source: Herds of POKENAME are often seen galloping in grassy fields. They can sense a predator's aura from miles away and warn their fellows by modifying their own aura, which can be read by other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的流体身体随波导发光脉动。意志坚不可摧的人类在场时，它会变得更大、更强。
author: hophoppip
source: Its fluid body glows and pulses with aura. POKENAME grows bigger and stronger in the presence of humans with unbreakable spirits.

entry: POKENAME闭壳时虽然看不见，却能感知波导，在激战中判断开壳的最佳时机。
author: craigprime
source: Although unable to see with its shell closed, POKENAME will use its aura detection to decide the perfect moments to open its shell in the heat of battle.

entry: POKENAME精通波导，能在周身燃起强劲的灵体能量烈焰，再将其塑造成它认为最能把对手吓得魂不附体的怪物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its mastery of aura to flare up a powerful blaze of spiritual energy around it, shaping it into whatever fearsome monstrosity it thinks would most frighten its opponent senseless.

entry: POKENAME的摆锤由自身操纵波导形成，因此永远不会失去催眠敌人的手段。它偏爱催眠波导邪恶的对象，强行让对方改过。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's pendulum is formed from its own aura manipulation, ensuring that it never loses its method of hypnotizing foes. It prefers to hypnotize those with evil auras in order to forcibly change their ways.

entry: POKENAME硕大的钳子是战斗中的致命利器。本就威力强大，还能将波导集中于钳中，形成凝缩的波导球，以惊人的力量发射。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's oversized claw makes for a deadly accessory in combat. Already powerful on its own, it can focus aura into the claw and create concentrated aura orbs it launches with incredible force.

entry: POKENAME极力保护自己的头骨。哪怕只是好奇地想摸一摸，也会立刻招来龙之俯冲。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is fiercely defensive of its skull. Even a curious attempt to touch it will provoke an immediate Dragon Rush.

entry: POKENAME住在地热温暖的洞穴中。由于基因不稳定，热量常引发自发突变，使它进化。
author: 3erlugg
source: POKENAME lives in caves that are warmed by geothermal heat. Due to its genetic instability, the heat often causes spontaneous mutations, resulting in evolution.

entry: POKENAME在地下凿出蜿蜒隧道，蜕皮释放充沛的生命能量。因此，POKENAME洞里的土，也常被取来作肥料。
author: slaphappygrandpappy
source: POKENAME carves winding tunnels underground, where it molts to release its overflowing life energy. Dirt taken from POKENAME tunnels is often used as fertilizer.

entry: 野生POKENAME通常出没于温泉，因为它们喜欢在暖水中游泳。它们大多藏在水下，会用利齿咬任何入水洗浴的人类或宝可梦。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME are usually found in hot springs, as they love to swim in the warm waters. They mostly remain concealed beneath the surface and will use their sharp teeth to bite any humans or Pokémon that get into the water to bathe.

entry: POKENAME虽能凭强壮双翼长途飞行，除了炎热的夏日，却很少离开温暖的洞穴。它们看起来并不危险，颚内却排列着多行剃刀般锋利的牙齿。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME can fly long distances with their powerful wings, they rarely leave the warm caves they live in except on hot summer days. Although they do not seem threatening, their jaws are lined with multiple rows of razor-sharp teeth.

entry: POKENAME尾上的鳞片受到世界各地珠宝匠珍视。它们稀少而耀眼，绚丽的蓝绿色光泽曾令古代王国的女王们垂涎。
author: .izik
source: The scales covering POKENAME's tail are prized by jewelers across the world. Their brilliant teal sheen was once coveted by queens in ancient kingdoms for their rarity and brilliance.

entry: POKENAME一靠近树，就容易咬住不放，使所住的森林里许多树都缺了块树皮。吃过饭后，头上叶片飘出的泥土气息会更加浓郁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is prone to biting onto any tree it comes near, leading to forests it inhabits having many with chunks of bark missing. The earthy scent wafting from the leaf on its head intensifies after its meals.

entry: POKENAME生性友好，想玩时会轻轻咬住、拉扯其他对象。它尤其喜欢别人给东西衔在嘴里，然后玩起不让对方拿到的游戏。
author: sk372
source: Friendly by nature, POKENAME gently nips and tugs at others when it wants to play. It's particularly fond of being given something to hold in its mouth and then playing a game of keep-away.

entry: POKENAME探索水下洞穴，寻找食物与庇护所。凭身体发出的光，越游越深。
author: cristata
source: POKENAME explore underwater caves in search of food and shelter, using their bioluminescence to guide them deeper and deeper into the depths.

entry: POKENAME出没于地下河。视力虽很差，大嘴却让捕猎成功率更高。它们不合群，经常与遇见的同类打架。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are found in underground rivers. They have very poor eyesight, but their large mouths give them a higher success rate when catching prey. They are antisocial and regularly fight with other POKENAME they encounter.

entry: POKENAME可爱的外表常让对方低估它。受威胁时，它会先发出凶猛咆哮，再露出锋利的獠牙。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's cute appearance often causes others to underestimate it. When threatened, it lets out a fierce roar before revealing its sharp fangs.

entry: 想找到POKENAME，建议去三蜜蜂巢附近的树洞看看。这种宝可梦的毛绒玩具十分常见。
author: notsaying.
source: To find this POKENAME, it is suggested to look in tree hollows that are near Combee nests. Plush toys of this Pokémon are very common.

entry: POKENAME会在冰川脚下的松土与碎屑间挖掘，寻找严酷天气中丧命的宝可梦遗骸。它们嗅觉敏锐，巡护员会借助它们寻找失踪的登山男。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME dig through loose soil and debris at the foot of glaciers in search of the remains of Pokémon that have perished in the harsh weather. They have an acute sense of smell and Rangers use them to help find lost Hikers.

entry: POKENAME会在冰川脚下的松土与碎屑间挖掘，寻找严酷天气中丧命的宝可梦遗骸。它们嗅觉敏锐，巡护员会借助它们寻找失踪的登山男。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME dig through loose soil and debris at the foot of glaciers in search of the remains of Pokémon that have perished in the harsh weather. They have an acute sense of smell and Rangers use them to help find lost Hikers.

entry: POKENAME通常睡上一整天，谁打扰，就追谁，直到对方精疲力竭。据说，黏滑的体表，尝起来像果酱。
author: krune
source: POKENAME usually sleep all day, but anyone who disturbs their slumber will be chased until they tire out. Their slimy surface is rumored to taste like jam.

entry: POKENAME会迅速咬向挡路的一切。獠牙的毒虽相对较弱，但它们结成小群活动，若一拥而上咬击，毒素累积就会造成更严重的伤害。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quick to bite anything that crosses its path. Though the venom in its fangs is relatively weak, it travels in small packs that run the risk of biting en masse and causing a much more harmful poison accumulation.

entry: POKENAME会结群互相切磋训练。它们用强壮的象鼻抓住对手，再使出咬住。
author: chibitales
source: Groups of POKENAME will spar with each other to train. They use their strong trunks to hold on to their opponent while delivering their Bite attacks.

entry: POKENAME会训练力量与性情，却仍有点输不起。若因落败而过于沮丧，就很可能抓住获胜的敌人，愤怒地咬下去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME trains itself to hone its strength and temperament, but it is still a bit of a sore loser. If it gets overly frustrated about a loss, it is likely to grab onto its victorious foe and begin biting them in anger.

entry: POKENAME跳舞与模仿时，会稍受巨大头部的重量妨碍，步态摇摇晃晃。若听见有人笑它的窘态，就会试着去咬对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's dancing and mimicry efforts are slightly hampered by the weight of its large head, giving it a wobbly gait. If it hears anyone laugh at its plight, it will try to bite them.

entry: POKENAME会用不断生长的门牙，在悬崖侧面啃洞。听见猎物靠近，它便跃出伏击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME use their constantly growing front teeth to gnaw holes in the sides of cliffs. When it hears prey approaching, it leaps out to ambush them.

entry: POKENAME在洞中挖隧道觅食时，坚如钢铁的脸能保护其余身体不受落石伤害。它能快速穿行于所住沙漠的沙中，让头顶像鳍一样露出。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its iron-hard face protects the rest of its body from falling rocks when it digs tunnels in caves to search for food. POKENAME can move quickly through the sands of the deserts where it lives, letting the tip of its head emerge like a fin.

entry: POKENAME会凶狠地咬脚踝、车胎和宠物。坚硬外壳能抵御大多数反击，单是一只就能让整座村庄惶惶不安。往往只有冰属性宝可梦能让它离开。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: It ruthlessly nips ankles, car tires, and pets. With its tough shell protecting it from most retaliation, a single POKENAME can terrorize an entire village. Ice-type Pokémon are often the only thing that can convince it to move on.

entry: POKENAME无法忍受寒冷，因此在火山附近的洞穴筑巢。它傲慢专横，训练家若不够坚定，最终可能会被它无视。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME nests in caves near volcanoes, since it cannot stand the cold. This Pokémon has a haughty, overbearing attitude, and if its Trainer does not show enough resolve, it may end up ignoring them.

entry: POKENAME视力出色，能从远处，甚至透过实心岩石发现猎物。咬击带有强力的麻痹电击，猎物一旦被咬，就无处可逃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's excellent vision lets it scope out prey from long distances and even through solid rock. Its bite can deliver a powerful paralyzing shock; once prey is bitten, there's no escape.

entry: POKENAME用利齿啃东西时，会从全身鳞片散发安抚气息。许多人说，靠近后15秒内就会觉得平静。
author: .izik
source: While gnawing on objects with its sharp teeth, POKENAME releases a calming aura from the scales covering its body. Many report feeling soothed within 15 seconds of being nearby.

entry: 这种可怕的伏击猎手潜伏地下，将鲜艳的藤蔓状附肢悬在地表，模仿果实。任何靠得太近的对象，都会迅速被缠住，拖入地下。
author: brilliantdarkness
source: Lurking below the ground, this fearsome ambush predator dangles its brightly colored vine-like appendages above ground to mimic fruit. Anything that ventures too close is swiftly ensnared and dragged beneath the surface.

entry: 巨颚能一口咬断铁条。想教会它不咬人，或少些凶性，根本办不到。
author: staghorn
source: Its jaws are powerful enough to snap an iron bar in two. Training it to not bite or to be less aggressive is an impossible task.

entry: POKENAME虽有可怕的巨颚，却生性贪玩，喜欢浮出水面吓唬船客。它常把破损的假饵和缠成一团的鱼线当食物；幸好，厚实的胃壁不会被鱼钩刺穿。
author: jaminmcready
source: Despite its fearsome jaws, POKENAME has a playful nature and enjoys surfacing to startle boaters. It often eats broken fishing lures and tangled line as a source of food, luckily fishing hooks aren't able to penetrate its thick stomach lining.

entry: POKENAME能以惊人的速度穿行沙中，短短几秒就加速到每小时80英里。快速移动会留下螺旋状沙痕。
author: .izik
