source: POKENAME tunnels through sand at astonishing speeds, reaching 80 mph in mere seconds. Its rapid movements leave behind spiraling sand trails.

entry: POKENAME在陆地摇摆着走，也能像游水一样滑过泥土。它们不停训练，想更快一些，盼有朝一日，也能飞起来。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Waddling about on land, POKENAME are able to glide through the ground as if it was water. They constantly train to get faster, hoping they will be able fly some day.

entry: POKENAME平常整天睡觉，可谁打扰休息，就会被追到筋疲力竭。传闻，体表的黏液，滋味像果酱。
author: krune
source: POKENAME usually sleep all day but will chase anyone who disturbs their rest until they tire out. Their slimy surface is rumored to taste like jam.

entry: 这些冷血的POKENAME白天在沙漠沙层下狩猎，夜里回到地热洞穴休息。沙漠旅人都知道要留意快速接近的鳍，那是即将遇袭的明确信号。
author: joeofthealps
source: These cold-blooded POKENAME spend the day hunting for prey beneath desert sand and retire to geothermal caves at night. Desert-goers know to watch for the fins of POKENAME making a rapid approach, a sure sign of an impending attack.

entry: POKENAME在地下结成大群栖居，白天狩猎，夜里挤在一起取暖。若多个群体聚到同一食物来源，争相抢食的狂潮可能持续数小时。
author: brilliantdarkness
source: POKENAME shelter underground in large pods, hunting by day and clustering together at night to remain warm. When multiple pods converge on the same food source, the resulting feeding frenzy can last for hours.

entry: 有人在城都一座古老神社发现一小群POKENAME。它们至今仍坚定不移地守护里面的钟。
author: .izik
source: A small group of POKENAME were discovered guarding an ancient shrine in Johto. They continue to protect the bell inside with unwavering dedication.

entry: POKENAME通常温和，却会因最小的事情迅速发怒。它们用微弱的火焰与接连咬击攻击，但颚太弱，造不成什么伤害。
author: infinex21
source: Although typically amiable, POKENAME can be angered quickly over the smallest of things. They attack with weak flames and with flurries of biting attacks. Their jaws are too weak to do meaningful damage.

entry: 它的颚强到能咬穿实心岩石，因此能筑出横向延伸的巢穴。体内火焰囊产生的大部分热量会释放出来，使巢里始终温暖，让自己与幼崽舒适栖居。
author: infinex21
source: Its jaws are strong enough to bite through solid rock, which allows it to build a horizontal nest. It releases much of the heat produced by its internal flame sac to keep its nest warm at all times for itself and for its young.

entry: 受威胁时，POKENAME会抬起身体，露出红色腹面。配上锋利的白色足肢，看起来就像一张随时要咬下的大嘴。
author: hophoppip
source: When threatened, POKENAME raises its body to display its red underside, which, in combination with its sharp white legs, looks like a large mouth ready to bite.

entry: POKENAME会精准地钻入巨大的钟乳石，开出巢穴。它会确保结构稳固，避免坍塌。
author: .izik
source: To create its den, POKENAME burrows into massive stalactites with precision. It ensures the structure remains stable to avoid collapse.

entry: POKENAME在云中翱翔，背鳍探出云外。雨云中凶恶的轮廓，常吓到较小的宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME soars through clouds with its dorsal fin jutting out. Its menacing silhouette through nimbuses often frightens smaller Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME会冲向敌人，用强大的双颚攻击。它笨手笨脚，常一头撞上物体或其他宝可梦，但柔软黏滑的身体通常能保护它免受重伤。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME charges at foes to attack with its powerful jaws. It is clumsy and often crashes head-first into objects or other Pokémon, but its soft and slimy body usually protects it from serious harm.

entry: POKENAME像只毛绒玩具，受到许多孩子喜爱与追捧。作为宠物，它表现还算乖巧，但受刺激或兴奋时，往往会咬得太重。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME, with the appearance of a stuffed animal, is beloved and sought by many children. It behaves well enough as a pet, but has a tendency to bite too hard if agitated or excited.

entry: POKENAME会吐气泡、喷水束，据说能治愈大多数伤势。它们极其友善贪玩，却也食量惊人，养一只就要花不少钱。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME spit bubbles and spews a beam of water that is said to heal most injuries. They are incredibly friendly and playful, but are also very big eaters, making caring for one an expensive ordeal.

entry: POKENAME通常泡在天然温泉的暖水里，只露出鳍。它们从溶于水中的化学物质摄取养分，但仍会咬任何想共用一池洗浴的对象。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are usually found in natural hot springs, submerged in the warm water with only their fin above the surface. They derive nutrition from chemicals dissolved in the water, but will still bite anyone who tries to bathe in the same pool.

entry: POKENAME强大的双颚能轻易碾碎大理石。它住在山洞中，靠啃石头锻炼咬力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's powerful jaws can crush marble with ease. It lives in mountain caves, chewing on stone to train its bite strength.

entry: POKENAME会在口中产生火焰取暖。火焰虽强到能熔穿钢铁，它们却必须小心别吞下去，否则就会难受地反酸。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce flames in their mouth to keep warm. While POKENAME's flames are powerful enough to melt through steel, they have to be careful not to swallow them. Doing so gives them unpleasant acid reflux.

entry: POKENAME一察觉震动，就会成群钻出，咬向目标。幸好一双结实靴子，就能挡住它们的小牙。
author: staghorn
source: When POKENAME detect vibrations, they emerge en masse to nip at the target. Thankfully, their tiny teeth can be blocked by a sturdy pair of boots.

entry: POKENAME以小家庭在崎岖地形筑巢，选择偏僻处产卵。它们虽是贪食的猎手，空中动作却笨拙，若能及早发现，就很容易躲开。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME nest in small family groups in craggy terrain, choosing isolated locations to lay their eggs. Though voracious hunters, they are clumsy in the air and easy to evade if spotted early.

entry: POKENAME会扎根洞壁，吸收珍贵矿物，硬化牙齿。猎物经过时，它们就会猛然扑去，用强大的双颚攫住。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will root themselves into the walls of caves, absorbing valuable minerals which they use to harden their teeth. When prey walks by, they will lurch towards them, grabbing them with their powerful jaws.

entry: 少见的POKENAME住在海边洞穴，靠嗅觉与触觉接触世界。尤其爱咬，无论防卫、表达喜爱，甚至探索，都是靠咬来完成。
author: bobosmith01
source: The uncommon POKENAME lives in seaside caves and interacts with the world through smell and touch. In particular, it bites: protection, affection, and even exploration are performed in this way.

entry: POKENAME常钻进洞壁，让尾巴垂在外面，引来猎物。可脑袋不太灵光，有时，连自己的尾巴也扑。
author: arcul
source: POKENAME can often be found burrowed into cave walls, dangling its tail above the surface as a lure for prey. Occasionally, however, its less-than-intelligent mind may cause it to lunge at its own tail.

entry: POKENAME的皮肤极其坚韧，只要一头冲向实心岩石，就能钻入地下。但背上的硬刺常使它钻到一半，卡在自己的隧道里。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's hide is so tough that it can burrow through the ground just by charging head first into solid rock. Due to the hard spike on its back, POKENAME frequently gets stuck part of the way through its own tunnels.

entry: POKENAME常霸占洞穴，赶走大多数其他宝可梦。凶猛攻击时，它会旋转身体，翅膀与双臂上的镰刀一样锋利。
author: ghostslythe
source: Often POKENAME stakes a claim on caves, kicking out most other Pokémon. When it viciously attacks, this Pokémon whirls about, its wings just as sharp as the scythes attached to its arms.

entry: 据说，POKENAME全身覆盖的细鳞具有疗效。它定期蜕皮，因此鳞片容易收集、磨粉，但似乎只能略微缓解疼痛与炎症。
author: .jerden
source: The fine scales that cover POKENAME's body are said to have healing properties. Since it regularly sheds its skin, this is easy to collect and grind into powder, but seem to only have minor benefits in reducing pain and inflammation.

entry: POKENAME会长途飞行，寻找闪亮物品，带回洞穴里的巢。它们睡在囤积的财宝上，任何入侵者前来打扰，都会遭到利爪与尖牙袭击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME fly around, travelling great distances in search of shiny objects to bring back to their cave lair. POKENAME sleep on top of their hoard of treasure and will attack any intruders that disturb them with sharp claws and fangs.

entry: POKENAME极爱甜食，会瞬间移动到集市，大吃漏斗蛋糕。若有人想拿走蛋糕，它们就会朝对方猛然咬合双颚。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME have a massive sweet tooth and will teleport to fairs to gorge on funnel cakes. If someone tries to remove the cakes, POKENAME will snap their jaws at them.

entry: 古老民间医术将POKENAME的牙描述为包治百病的药。但几乎不可能取得牙齿，因为没有人能撬开它的双颚。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Old folk medicine describes POKENAME teeth as a cure-all. Getting its teeth is almost impossible, as no human is capable of prying its jaws open.

entry: 它会把宝石、黄金或珍珠放进嘴里，伪装着藏在河岸或洞穴水池。人类或宝可梦想取走财物时，它就会发动攻击。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It places gemstones, gold, or pearls in its mouth and camouflages in riverbanks or cave pools. When people or Pokémon attempt to take the valuables, it will attack.

entry: POKENAME在水中无声疾行，靠近潜在猎物后，放出令人目眩的闪光。趁对方被震住、毫无防备，它会绕到背后攻击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME surges quickly through the water in silence, blasting potential prey with a blinding flash of light once it gets close enough. While the prey is stunned, it circles around and attacks from behind while they're defenseless.

entry: 饲主必须经常替POKENAME剪毛，因为羊毛积电会使它烦躁、更具攻击性。毛长得过盛时，它会朝附近一切咬牙相向；剪过毛后，却完全温顺。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME owners must take care to shear it often, as the buildup of electricity in its wool will agitate it and increase its aggression. An overgrown POKENAME will gnash at anything near, while a sheared one is completely docile.

entry: POKENAME对手机着了迷，泥巢里往往有好几部。它们喜欢摆弄手机，尤其爱看铃响或屏幕亮起。最受欢迎的“查找手机”应用，甚至用它的形象作标志。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME have developed an obsession with mobile phones, their mud-nests often contain several, and they love to play with them, especially when they ring or light up. The most popular 'Find My Phone' app even has an image of POKENAME as its logo.

entry: POKENAME会在悬崖周围的浅土与碎石间积极狩猎，凭敏锐嗅觉锁定食物。发现自认为能吃的东西，就会咬住猎物，试图扭打着拖入地下。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME aggressively hunt through shallow soil and scree around cliff faces, using their acute sense of smell to hone in on food. When they find something they think they can eat, they bite at their prey and try to wrestle it underground.

entry: POKENAME会在悬崖周围的浅土与碎石间积极狩猎，凭敏锐嗅觉锁定食物。有些个体背上长着大鳍，移动更快，代价却是更容易暴露。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME aggressively hunt through shallow soil and scree around cliff faces, using their acute sense of smell to hone in on food. Some POKENAME sport a large fin on their backs, letting them move faster at the expense of being more visible.

entry: POKENAME会把现实世界的闪亮物品数字化，带入电脑囤藏。它花许多时间翻看宝石照片，了解其价值与产地。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is known to take sparkly items from the real world and digitize them into a computer to hoard them. It spends a lot of time looking through photos of gemstones to learn about their value and where to find them.

entry: 几代人以前，人们会翻山猎捕POKENAME。用磨碎的鳞片作主料，能熬成一种颇有争议的药，据说能大幅增强活力。
author: sk372
source: Some generations ago, people would traverse mountains to hunt POKENAME. A controversial medicine said to greatly improve vitality was brewed using ground-up POKENAME scales as a main ingredient.

entry: 它会在幽暗洞穴中蜿蜒前行，凶猛地咬向任何打扰独处的对象。许多宝可梦知道它好斗，因此避开它的领地。
author: .izik
source: It slithers through dark caves, fiercely biting at anyone who disturbs its solitude. Many Pokémon avoid its domain, knowing its aggressive nature.

entry: 它会在冰封崖顶迅速滑行，利用地形伏击毫无戒心的猎物。利爪锋锐得足以在厚冰中开出道路。
author: .izik
source: It swiftly glides around icy clifftops, using the terrain to ambush unsuspecting prey. Its claws are sharp enough to carve paths through thick ice.

entry: POKENAME的红鳞不能吃，蓝鳞磨碎后却已被证实有轻微疗效。许多活动人士支持加强保护，防止盗猎。
author: bobosmith01
source: While the red scales are inedible, it has been proven that POKENAME's blue scales have mild healing properties when crushed. There have been many activists in support of adding protections to POKENAME to prevent poaching.

entry: POKENAME的红鳞不能吃，蓝鳞却已被证实有轻微疗效。许多活动人士支持加强保护，防止过度猎捕。
author: bobosmith01
source: While the red scales are inedible, it has been proven that POKENAME's blue scales have mild healing properties. There have been many activists in support of adding protections to POKENAME to prevent overhunting.

entry: POKENAME会用后爪抓紧表面，为攻击作好准备。随后，它张大双颚，准备咬下，将整个身体扑向目标。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME clings to surfaces with its rear claws to ready itself before launching an attack. It lunges its whole body in the direction of its target, jaws opened wide in preparation to bite down.

entry: 它敏锐的鼻子能察觉人的意图。一感知恶意，就会迅速逃开，避免冲突。
author: .izik
source: Its sensitive nose can detect a person's intentions. If it senses malice, it will dash away to avoid conflict.

entry: POKENAME喜欢看水面闪烁的阳光，因此在日照充足的河边筑巢。若发现格外闪亮的石头，它就会以惊人的速度潜入水中取回，带进巢里。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME nest by rivers that get a lot of sunlight, as they love watching the light sparkle across the water. If one spots a particularly shiny rock, it will dive into the water with surprising speed to retrieve it and bring it to its nest.

entry: 每隔几年，POKENAME就会脱落许多鳞片，每片都像武器碎片或一块盔甲。脱鳞的场地，最后会像惨烈战斗的遗址。
author: karishi
source: Every few years, POKENAME sheds many scales, and each scale looks like a shard of weapons or a piece of armor. The field where it sheds these scales ends up looking like the site of a terrible battle.

entry: POKENAME的四肢虽相对短粗、爪子也钝，却善于快速钻过表土。金字塔状的头与强壮尾巴，让它能在地下游动，地表只露出尖刺。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Despite their comparatively stubby limbs and blunt claws, POKENAME are adept at burrowing rapidly through topsoil. Their pyramid-shaped head and powerful tail let them swim through the ground, just their spines visible above the surface.

entry: 蜕皮前，POKENAME的金属鳞片会变成银色，随后脱落。收藏者珍视它们罕见的光泽与锯齿状金属边缘。
author: .izik
source: Before shedding, POKENAME's metallic scales turn silver and fall away. Collectors prize these for their rare shine and jagged metallic edges.

entry: POKENAME的触须覆着数百万片剃刀般锋利的细鳞。它会大幅挥动触须，划出弧线，切割最远30英尺外的敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feelers are covered in millions of tiny razor-sharp scales. It swings them in wide arcs to slice at foes from up to 30 feet away.

entry: 守护巢穴与幼崽时，POKENAME相当凶暴。它们每年至少脱鳞三次；据说，握住并抚摸这些鳞片，能使人心情平静。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are considerably vicious Pokémon when it comes to defending their dens and their young. At least thrice a year, POKENAME shed their scales; these scales are said to instil a sense of calm in those who hold and caress them.

entry: 最近，人们发现一群POKENAME守着未被记载的陵墓。它们会试图向任何靠近者使出强力龙爪。
author: .izik
source: A group of POKENAME were recently discovered guarding undocumented tombs. They attempt to unleash a powerful Dragon Claw on anyone who approaches.

entry: 每隔几个月，POKENAME就会脱落大部分蓝鳞与一些羽毛，让两者都重新长得更强韧。这两种材料会被磨粉，用于多种药物，尤其是治疗严重烧伤的药。
author: infinex21
source: Every few months, POKENAME shed much of their blue scales and some of their feathers so new, stronger coats of both may grow. Both of these materials are ground up and used in many remedies, especially those for treating severe burns.

entry: 它住在幽暗隧道中，两颗头同时咆哮，制造可怕的回音。阵阵回响，足以赶走大多数入侵者。
author: .izik
source: Living in dark tunnels, it roars with both heads simultaneously to create a terrifying echo. The reverberations are enough to drive most intruders away.

entry: POKENAME头顶长出头盔般的甲片，保护自己。它们钻进地面，再高速弹向天空，拼命想飞得好些。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME have developed a helmet-like plating at the top of their heads to protect themselves. They burrow into the ground, then launch into the air at high speeds, trying to fly as best as they can.

entry: 这位猎手平日总在休息，谁惊扰睡梦，就追谁不放。凝胶据说尝起来像苦果酱，让研究者颇感好奇，想一探究竟。
author: krune
source: Often found resting, this predator will chase down anyone who disturbs its slumber. Its gel is said to taste like bitter jam, making it a rare curiosity among researchers.

entry: POKENAME在崎岖岩地筑巢，还会在巢穴周围囤积找到的财宝贵重物品。任何靠近巢穴的对象，都会迎上许多火球。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME build their nests in rocky crags and will hoard many treasures and valuables they find around their nests as well. Anything that approaches their nests will be met with many fireballs.

entry: POKENAME会埋伏地下，等待飞行属性猎物，尤其是盔甲鸟这类闪亮的宝可梦。它伴着电流猛然跃向空中，震住猎物。埋伏时，背鳍会探出泥土，让警觉的猎物察觉它的位置。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME lies buried in wait for Flying-type prey, especially shiny ones like Skarmory, and bursts into the air with a blast of electricity to stun them. While buried, its dorsal fin pokes above the dirt, alerting observant prey to its position.

entry: POKENAME会埋伏地下，等待飞行属性猎物，尤其是盔甲鸟这类闪亮的宝可梦。它伴着电流猛然跃向空中，震住猎物。埋伏时，背鳍会探出泥土，让警觉的猎物察觉它的位置。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME lies buried in wait for Flying-type prey, especially shiny ones like Skarmory, and bursts into the air with a blast of electricity to stun them. While buried, its dorsal fin pokes above the dirt, alerting observant prey to its position.

entry: POKENAME会主动咬向任何进入领地的对象。被咬住后，它会紧咬不放，呼出冰冷吐息，对方很可能冻成坚冰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME goes on the attack and bites at anything that enters its territory. Those bitten by it will likely become frozen solid as it latches onto them and exhales its freezing-cold breath.

entry: 长期以来，人们相信POKENAME的牙能治百病，因而猎捕它。它对人类根深蒂固的仇恨从未消退，所以会凶猛攻击驶入领海的任何船只。
author: fiordaliso
source: For a long time, POKENAME was hunted because of the belief that its teeth had the power to cure any illness. Its deep-seated hatred for humans has never faded, which is why it aggressively attacks any ship sailing in its waters.

entry: 它鳞片渗出的黏稠液体，是制作舒缓咳嗽的润喉糖的珍贵材料。不过，采集时必须格外小心。
author: .izik
source: The viscous fluid that seeps from its scales is prized for crafting soothing cough drops. However, the collection process requires great care.

entry: POKENAME囤积闪亮物品，覆上一层黏液，溶解贵金属与宝石以外的一切。这层腐蚀性涂层既能使财宝洁净发亮，也能防盗。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME hoards shiny objects, covering them in a layer of slime that dissolves everything except precious metal and gemstones. This corrosive coating keeps POKENAME's treasures clean and gleaming, and also deters theft.

entry: POKENAME成群游荡于沙漠。族群等级森严，占统治地位的成员拥有最大的鬃毛。
author: roniodove
source: POKENAME roam the deserts in packs. Their packs follow a strict hierarchy where the dominant member has the largest mane.

entry: POKENAME的鬃毛比任何石头都硬，既显得威严，又保护最重要的部位。它意志不屈，为守护所住洞穴，哪怕面对力量压倒性的敌人，也会无畏奋战。
author: fiordaliso
source: The mane of POKENAME, harder than any stone, crowns it with majesty while protecting its most vital points. Relentless in spirit, it will battle without fear to defend the cave it inhabits, even when facing opponents of overwhelming power.

entry: POKENAME高唱朋克摇滚，随节奏猛摇脑袋，刀刃般的头发四处甩动。谁想伸手摸，它会突然转头，割伤靠得太近的家伙。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME belts out punk rock melodies while rocking its head to the beat, causing its razor-sharp hair to whip about. If someone tries to touch its hair, it will quickly turn away, slashing anyone that got too close.

entry: POKENAME睡在洞穴深处，尾部鳞片高高竖起。这样便能察觉接近巢穴的最轻微振动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps deep in caves with its tail scale raised high. This lets it detect even the slightest vibrations approaching its den.

entry: 有人在城都龙穴附近发现一群POKENAME。它们虽然看似漠不关心，但若背对着它，可能就会突然挨上一记强力踢击。
author: .izik
source: A group of POKENAME was found near Dragon's Den in Johto. Though they act disinterested, turning your back on one may result in a powerful surprise kick.

entry: POKENAME钻过地底时，三颗头都会吞食泥土与矿物。它们栖居的富矿土壤，成分很快就会改变。
author: hophoppip
source: The three heads consume dirt and minerals as they burrow through the ground. Mineral-rich soil inhabited by POKENAME will quickly change in composition.

entry: POKENAME每次蜕鳞，都会点燃蜕下的皮，确保蜕皮过程完成。世界某些地区会把留下的粗糙鳞片编成仪式用鳞甲。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME shed their scales, the molt left behind is ignited to ensure the shedding process is complete. The rough scales left behind are woven into ceremonial scale armor in certain areas around the world.

entry: 远看时，POKENAME很容易被认成尖牙陆鲨。它们更大、更凶暴，发怒时会从头上喷出蓝焰。
author: katieplaysgames
source: From a distance, POKENAME are easily mistaken for Gabite. They are larger and more aggressive than Gabite, spouting blue flames from their heads when angry.

entry: POKENAME有时会在海滩聚成最多十八只的群体，不断进行威吓较量与争斗，直到只剩唯一的幸存者。
author: hobiewankenobi
source: POKENAME sometimes gather in up to groups of up to eighteen on a beach, and will often compete in intimidation displays and fights until there is a single sole survivor.

entry: POKENAME会从猎物遗骸中选出最大的骨头，磨成凶狠的双刃武器。它们永不满足，总在战斗，寻找新骨头，磨出更强的武器。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME will gather the largest bone from the remains of its prey and hone it into a brutal, dual-bladed weapon. They are never satisfied with their weapon and constantly fight to find new bones to hone into even greater weapons.

entry: POKENAME会以茧摩擦物体表面，磨出锋利边缘。受威胁时，它会跳向敌人，试图用结茧的身体撞击并切伤对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rubs its cocoon against surfaces to sharpen it to a fine edge. When threatened, it hops towards the threat in an attempt to tackle it and cut it with its cocooned body.

entry: POKENAME将幼崽藏在腹袋内，以硬鳞保护。亲代曾能凭锋利刃片以2马赫飞过天空，如今却留在地面，避免伤到新生幼崽。
author: rambobinet
source: POKENAME shelters its young within its pouch, protecting it with hardened scales. Though the sharpened blades of the parents once carried them through the skies at Mach 2, they now remain grounded to avoid harming their newborn offspring.

entry: POKENAME从高崖跃下，滑翔巡视领地。一发现威胁，就会俯冲使出燕返，快得目标往往还不知道被什么击中。
author: ghostslythe
source: Jumping from high cliffs, POKENAME glides over its territory. If a threat is spotted, it dives into an Aerial Ace so quickly that its target often doesn't realize what hit it.

entry: POKENAME的流线型身体能高速游泳，甚至短距离飞行。垂钓者认为它是最难钓起的宝可梦之一，许多人反被它拖进水里。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's streamlined body enables it to swim at high speed, and even fly short distances. Anglers regard it as one of the most challenging Pokémon to catch, and many are pulled into the water by it.

entry: POKENAME灵活地冲过平原，头部突起会放出电磁脉冲，探知地形。因此，它们能在高速下自如转弯、不减冲势，是出色的猎手。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME sprint across plains with remarkable agility. The protuberances on their heads emit electromagnetic pulses to map terrain, allowing them to confidently make turns at high speeds without losing momentum, making them incredible hunters.

entry: POKENAME加热身下沙地以减少摩擦，轻松滑过干旱沙丘。它们通过蓬松红鬃排出热量，高速冲刺时则以鳍状尾巴保持平衡。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME heat the sand beneath them to reduce friction, allowing them to glide effortlessly across arid dunes. They vent thermal energy through their bushy red manes and use their finned tails to keep balance during high-speed sprints.

entry: POKENAME在陆地笨拙，空中却飞得很快，长尾能增添动力与灵活性。全速飞行时，翼上的利爪锋锐得足以切开钢铁。
author: .jerden
source: While awkward on land, POKENAME can fly fast through the sky, using its long tail for extra power and maneuverability. The claws on its wings are sharp enough to slice through steel if it is flying at top speed.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极其强烈。深色鳞片让它融入夜空与岩壁，获得充分的伏击机会。护卵时格外危险，务必要避开。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME is viciously territorial. Its dark-coloured scales let it blend in with the night sky and rock walls, providing ample opportunities for an ambush. A POKENAME defending its egg is considered very dangerous and should be avoided at all costs.

entry: POKENAME大多时间都在地下含水层中游泳，偶尔才会在泉眼现身，因此很少被看见。头部突起一察觉人类靠近，它们就会再次潜入水下。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spend most of their time swimming through underwater aquifers. They are rarely seen, as they only occasionally surface at springs, diving back underwater if they sense the approach of humans with the protuberances on their heads.

entry: 野生POKENAME住在沙漠绿洲的水中。头部突起能感知宝可梦接近水边，让它提前准备，等猎物一俯身喝水，就立刻伏击。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME live within the waters of desert oases. The protuberances on their head enable them to sense Pokémon approaching the water, so that they can be ready to ambush their prey as soon as it leans over to drink.

entry: POKENAME同时用臂上与背上的翅膀高速飞行，以尾鳍转向。全身细鳞能尽量减少阻力，使它很少需要降落。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME flies at high speed using the wings on its arms as well as on its back, steering using its tailfins. It is covered by fine scales to minimize drag, and rarely needs to land.

entry: POKENAME喜欢独处，谁不肯让它清静，就会遭到凶狠对待。它能用念力推动身体，以快得看不清的速度飞过空中，用尖爪斩倒敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a solitary creature that becomes very vicious to those who refuse to leave it to its own devices. Using telekinesis, it can propel itself through the air at blinding speeds, cutting down foes with its pointed claws.

entry: POKENAME飞越天空时，速度堪比喷气式飞机。即便如此，它仍能以共情感知下方生灵的喜悦与善意，为飞行提供动力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME travels as fast as a jet plane while flying across the sky. Despite this speed, it empathically senses the joy and kindness of those below it, which fuels its flight.

entry: POKENAME能伸展双臂，沿身体释放爆发性的火焰，推动自己飞过空中。战斗时，它们用火柱掩护迅速的动作，再以灼热臂刃劈砍敌人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can propel themselves through the air by extending their arms and releasing explosive flames from along their bodies. They use pillars of fire to conceal their swift movements during battle and slash at foes using their hot arm-blades.

entry: POKENAME在陆地上缓缓挪动，猛扑时却能比高速列车更快。在水中，它能自由地以这种速度游泳。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME can be seen lumbering slowly on land, but when it lunges it can move faster than a bullet train. In the water, it can freely swim at this speed.

entry: POKENAME的翼展最长可达十米，拍翼无声，滑翔迅速，是强大的捕食者。许多受袭者只有躲回洞穴，刚好避开饥饿的它的攻击范围，才能活下来。
author: quackquackattack
source: With a full wingspan that can reach ten meters in length, its silent wingbeat and swift gliding make them formidable predators. Many only survive a POKENAME attack by retreating into their burrow, just out of reach of a hungry POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴像螺旋桨般运动，帮助它加速至极高速度。全速游泳时，经过的小宝可梦有时会被它产生的力量震得昏倒。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's tail moves in a way similar to a propeller and allows it to get up to rapid top speeds. When swimming at top speed, small Pokémon that it passes sometimes pass out from the force it generates.

entry: 月光越充足，POKENAME跑得越快。晴朗的满月夜，它能跑到1马赫。
author: race9000
source: A POKENAME moves faster the more moonlight it receives. On a clear night with a full moon, it can run at Mach 1.

entry: 常能看见POKENAME的幼崽啃咬家长的头。咬下去似乎能赋予亲代强大的超能力。
author: atlas3339098
source: POKENAME's young can often be found chomping on its head. Biting down seems to grant the parent great psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME虽拥有庞大力量，体形却太小，无法妥善运用。因此，它总显得很生气。
author: entomoxie
source: Despite wielding immense power, POKENAME is unable to properly use it due to its minuscule size. As a result, it always appears angry.

entry: POKENAME很有耐心，身体也结实，能承受好斗生灵的多次攻击。一旦忍耐耗尽，它就会以剃刀般的利颚，回以极其强劲迅速的咬击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a lot of patience and is resilient enough to endure many strikes from aggressive creatures. If its patience runs out it will retaliate with extremely strong and swift bites with its razor-sharp jaws.

entry: POKENAME通过头状钳子排出体内积聚的多余热量，看起来就像它们在喷火。它其实只有一颗真头，但撕扯猎物的模样，令人难以分辨哪颗才是真的。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME expels extraneous heat that builds inside its body through its head-like pincers, making it seem as if they're breathing fire. Although POKENAME does only have one real head, the way it rips into prey makes it hard to tell which is which.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，会将双钳指向相反方向，一端收集冷风，让热量从另一端排出。拳击极其沉重，挥出后会掀起令人疼痛的阵风。
author: soup1900
source: As POKENAME flies, it points its claws in opposite directions, collecting cool wind from one end so any heat it has is expelled on the opposite end. Its punches are so heavy that painful bursts of wind are created after it swings.

entry: POKENAME的速度甚至堪比烈箭鹰，会用锯齿状的角刺穿对手。它们常与凯罗斯融合体结伴，因为需要靠对方从蜂巢挤出蜂蜜。
author: bigoljax
source: With speeds that even rival Talonflame, POKENAME spear their opponents with their jagged horns. They're known for pairing up with Pinsir fusions, due to POKENAME relying on them to squeeze out honey from hives.

entry: POKENAME能用感应器察觉领地内的所有食物，包括埋在地下的。爬树时，细鳞会刮擦树皮，在木头上留下许多抓痕。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its sensors to detect all food within its territory, including ones buried underground. As it climbs trees, its fine scales scrape against the bark, leaving many scratches along the wood.

entry: POKENAME通常沿地面缓缓滑行。但它们能加速转动外壳，翻身仰躺，借此推进，追猎目标。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME usually slide along the floor slowly. However, they can rev up their shells and flip over onto their backs, using it as a boost to hunt prey.

entry: POKENAME的流畅体形，让它能轻松滑过海洋与天空。一家飞机制造商与一家潜水器公司都以它为吉祥物，因此彼此产生竞争。
author: kungfucutbug
source: POKENAME's sleek body shape allows it to glide through both the sea and the sky with ease. It's incited a rivalry between an airplane manufacturer and a submersible company, as both have POKENAME as their respective mascots.

entry: 有些人想确保没有入侵者能进屋，就会雇POKENAME看守家园。但任何陌生对象一靠近，它的反应都极其凶狠，因此也引发了争议。
author: sk372
source: Some have employed POKENAME as guards of their home when they wish to make absolutely sure no intruders get in. This has invited some controversy due to just how viciously it responds to the approach of any unfamiliar parties.

entry: POKENAME在海中游得比巨牙鲨还快。它不会主动挑衅，但若有人伤害其领地内栖居的其他宝可梦，它立刻就会产生敌意。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can swim through the seas fast enough to outpace a Sharpedo. It is not actively aggressive, but becomes hostile the moment someone causes harm to any other Pokémon living in its claimed territory.

entry: POKENAME蜷成球时，会展开翅膀，切开滚动撞上的一切。一旦冲起来，就只能靠撞上东西才能停下。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: When POKENAME curls up into a ball, it extends its wings to slice right through whatever it rolls into. Once POKENAME gains momentum, it can't stop until it crashes.

entry: POKENAME只需奋力跺一下脚，就能裂开地面，引发猛烈地震。人们曾相信威严的象牙长牙具有强大疗效，因此猎捕它。
author: fiordaliso
source: With a single powerful stomp, POKENAME can crack open the ground, triggering tremendous earthquakes. It was once hunted because its majestic ivory tusks were believed to hold powerful healing properties.

entry: POKENAME住在近海森林，领地意识极强。它会在树上抓出深深的裂口，标示领地，警告其他生灵远离，否则也会遭到同样深的切伤。
author: sk372
source: Making its home in forest areas near the ocean, POKENAME is highly territorial. It scratches deep gashes into trees to mark its territory and warn others to stay away lest they wish to be cut just as deeply.

entry: 牙齿是它身体最敏感的部位。摇摇摆摆四处走时，凡看见陌生物品，它都会咬。它也靠咬表达喜爱，因此必须训练，让它在战斗之外别咬得太重。
author: .jerden
source: Its teeth are the most sensitive part of its body, and as it toddles about, it will bite any unfamiliar object it sees. It also bites to show affection and must be trained not to use its teeth with too much force outside of combat.

entry: POKENAME是无情的猎手，会以马赫级速度在地下穿行，捕捉猎物。若咬力还不足以解决对方，毒牙也一定会完成这件事。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is a merciless predator, tunneling underground at Mach speeds to catch its prey. If its bite force isn't enough to take care of them, its venomous bite will surely finish the job.

entry: 替POKENAME挤奶极其危险，因为乳房尖锐异常。若成功挤出，牛奶便能强劲提振精神，对骨骼与肌肉也很有益。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is incredibly dangerous to milk, as its udders are pointed and extremely sharp. If successfully done, the milk it produces is highly energizing and very good for bones and muscles.

entry: POKENAME用头上的巨大突起感知情绪。它会接近已经放弃的人，用红色的蛋使其重拾决心，但对方必须肯用力拉，才能从它身上的凹槽取出蛋。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME senses emotions using the large protuberances on its head. POKENAME approaches people who have given up to fill them with determination using its red egg, although they must be willing to pull hard to get it out of the indent on POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME是远方沙漠沙地里的神秘宝可梦。它会挥动沙状鬃毛，召来强劲沙暴，掩盖自身踪迹。
author: raydrago
source: POKENAME is a mysterious Pokémon found in the sands of faraway deserts. It hides its presence by conjuring strong sandstorms with a wave of its sandy mane.

entry: POKENAME常被称为“风暴使者”，经过之处充满浓雾、雷暴，甚至龙卷风。粗糙而符合空气动力的鳞片，让它穿过恶劣天气，抵达风暴眼。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME is often referred to as Bringer of Storms, and its passing wake is filled with fog, thunderstorms, and even tornadoes. Its rough, aerodynamic scales allow it to pass through harsh weather and reach the storm's eye.

entry: POKENAME快得能在同一地点的多个时间点出现，借此预判未来攻击，或从过去操纵战场。它通常性情良善，却很容易被激怒。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME moves so fast that it appears at multiple moments in time at the same place, allowing it to anticipate future attacks or manipulate the battlefield from the past. It is generally good natured, but is easily provoked.

entry: POKENAME的飞行速度超乎寻常，常被误认成不明飞行物。若产生足够的电力，它就能发出强到足以震动星球的无线电波。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME flies at otherworldly speeds, commonly being misidentified as a UFO. If it generates enough electrical power, it can emit a radio wave strong enough to vibrate the planet.

entry: POKENAME会在冻雪下挖出广阔洞穴，躲避暴风雪。它们好斗且领地意识强烈，靠近所占的雪洞时，人们必须格外小心。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME dig extensive burrows beneath frozen snow to shelter from blizzards. Because of their aggressive territorial nature, people must exercise great caution when approaching the snow burrows they claim as territory.

entry: 旅人常被劝告避开POKENAME居住的山地。它们凶猛好斗、力量庞大，对毫无防备的对象构成严重威胁。
author: nyoomymph
source: Travellers are often advised to avoid the parts of the mountains that POKENAME call home. Their aggressive behaviour and immense strength make them a grave danger to anyone caught off guard.

entry: POKENAME会在飞机附近高速飞行，吸收导航数据为食。许多喷气式飞机因它的食欲而被迫降落。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies at high speeds near aircraft to absorb navigational data as nourishment. Many jets have been forced to land because of its appetite.

entry: 它在树间滑翔寻找猎物，甚至会攻击并击败体形达自身5倍的宝可梦。
author: mary_the_jane
source: It glides from tree to tree searching for prey. It is known to attack and defeat Pokémon 5 times its size.

entry: POKENAME用臂上利爪爬树，以头部突起感知下方地面的动静。随后，它从高处扑向猎物，若对方想逃，还能用鳍短距离滑翔追捕。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses the sharp claws on its arms to climb up trees, and the protuberances on its head to sense movement on the ground below. It then drops down on prey from above, gliding short distances with its fins to catch prey that tries to flee.

entry: POKENAME锋利的镰刀只需一挥，就能砍倒树木。背上的种子能像炸弹般引爆，既能把尾巴当导弹发射，也能推动它向前攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can cut down trees with a single swing of one of its sharp scythes. The seeds on its back can detonate like bombs, either launching its tail like a missile or propelling POKENAME forward to attack.

entry: 遇险时，POKENAME会竖起背部与尾部的尖鳞，阻止敌人使出物理攻击。鳞片质感像砂纸，让幼崽能在它游走沙漠时，轻松攀附在背上。
author: cait_sith
source: When in danger, POKENAME raises the sharp scales on its back and tail to deter foes from using physical attacks. These scales have a sandpaper-like texture that allows POKENAME's young to easily cling to its back as it roams the desert.

entry: POKENAME醒着时始终警戒，因此容易困倦。糖对它的提神效果格外强，据说照顾它的训练家，每月会将大笔预算花在甜食上。
author: eni.starfall
source: POKENAME are prone to drowsiness due to their constant alertness during waking hours. Sugar is an especially potent stimulant for POKENAME, so Trainers in care of one are reported to spend a lot of their monthly budget on sweets.

entry: POKENAME以追猎恶属性宝可梦闻名，总在森林中迅速穿行，寻找目标。一旦发现，就会用镰刀一击斩倒。
author: cerealjamalt
source: POKENAME is notorious for hunting down Dark-type Pokémon and spends its days swiftly navigating the forest for them. Once it finds a target, it cuts it down in one strike with its scythe.

entry: 它的牙与爪永不停长，必须不断磨短，因此所住洞穴外的树与岩石上，会留下深深的沟痕。
author: .jerden
source: Its teeth and claws never stop growing. Its need to constantly wear them down will leave deep gouges in trees and rocks outside the cave it lives in.

entry: POKENAME从楔石中醒来时，就已蓄势待战。强劲的斩击能劈断附近的任何树木，击碎巨石，将骨头碾成粉末。
author: quackquackattack
source: When POKENAME awaken from their keystones, they come out primed and ready to fight. Their powerful slashes can cleave through any nearby trees, bludgeon boulders into pieces, and crush bones into dust.

entry: POKENAME的双翼已磨利成镰刀，是极其危险的武器。粗糙异常的皮肤与遍布身体的尖刺，也让敌人不敢轻易用身体攻击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's wings have sharpened into scythes, making them extremely dangerous weapons. Its extremely coarse skin and sharp spikes lining its body dissuade enemies from physically attacking this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的双翼已磨利成镰刀，是极其危险的武器。粗糙异常的皮肤与遍布身体的尖刺，也让敌人不敢轻易用身体攻击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's wings have sharpened into scythes, making them extremely dangerous weapons. Its extremely coarse skin and sharp spikes lining its body dissuade enemies from physically attacking this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME失去了双翼与头部突起，再无求生手段。人们预测，这种宝可梦在不久的将来就会灭绝。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has lost both its wings and the protuberances on its head, giving it no survival tools. It is predicted that this species of Pokémon will go extinct in the near future.

entry: POKENAME锋利的镰刀破坏力极高，短短几秒就能把钨梁切成细碎小块。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's sharp scythes have an extremely high breaking power. It can slice a tungsten beam into tiny pieces in mere seconds.

entry: 与大嘴娃不同，POKENAME不太爱欺骗，而是自信地追猎比自己大数倍的猎物。双颚连最硬的金属都能咬碎。
author: berrivine
source: Unlike Mawile, POKENAME is much less deceptive, confidently hunting for prey many times its own size. Its jaws can crush even the toughest of metals.

entry: POKENAME的头甲兼用于防御与求偶展示。雄性会以头撞和推搡攻击竞争者，争相证明自己最强。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME's headplate is used both for defense and mating displays. Male POKENAME attack rivals by headbutting and shoving, vying to prove themselves the strongest.

entry: 这条懒龙大多时间都待在洞里。它偶尔会以惊人速度行动，只因为知道食物找得越快，就越早能回去睡觉。
author: .jerden
source: This slothful dragon spends most of its time in its cave. It occasionally moves with incredible speed, but only because it knows that the quicker it finds food, the sooner it can go back to sleep.

entry: 古代信徒曾把POKENAME的星形纹样画满面孔，以示虔诚。所用颜料由芭亚果与黄球果制成。
author: .izik
source: Ancient worshippers once painted the star marking of POKENAME across their faces in devotion. The paint used was made with Iapapa Berries and Yellow Apricorns.

entry: POKENAME以喷气机般的速度旋转穿过战场。阵风足以吹倒树，一挥刀刃，就能放倒一群披甲战士。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME spins through battlefields at jet speed. Its wind gusts can fell trees and its blade can fell a group of armored men in one swing.

entry: POKENAME以喷气机般的速度旋转穿过战场。阵风足以吹倒树，一挥刀刃，就能放倒一群披甲战士。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME spins through battlefields at jet speed. Its wind gusts can fell trees and its blade can fell a group of armored men in one swing.

entry: POKENAME鳞片薄而坚硬，加上锋利刀刃，全身上下都是武器。
author: mistershaokahn
source: Its thin, rigid scales, combined with its sharp blades, makes POKENAME a being whose entire body is a weapon.

entry: POKENAME在山中决斗，争夺支配地位。动作快得两秒内，就能把巨石削成沙粒。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME can be found in the mountains, dueling each other for dominance. It is fast enough to turn a boulder into sand in two seconds.

entry: 身体连睡着时也会自行吸放电力，借积存的能量察觉猎物，以闪电般的速度移动。
author: lemgambino
source: Its body passively absorbs and discharges electricity, even while asleep. It uses this stored energy to detect prey and move at lightning-fast speeds.

entry: POKENAME住在高山，以强劲前爪挖洞安家。被激怒时极其危险，盛怒中容易引发山崩。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their homes high in the mountains, digging out a cave to make their lair in with their powerful front claws. They are incredibly dangerous Pokémon when provoked, prone to triggering rockslides when enraged.

entry: POKENAME喜欢把身体中央当作圆锯攻击。旋转还能让身体充满力量，使它得以发射弹体，并为物理招式灌注玄奥能量。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME likes to attack by using its central body as a buzzsaw. The spinning motion has the added benefit of saturating its body with power, allowing it to fire projectiles and saturate its physical moves with arcane energy.

entry: POKENAME一兴奋就见什么咬什么。虽忠心耿耿，仍不适合由新手训练家饲养。
author: fenragon
source: When it gets excited, it bites everything it sees. For this reason, POKENAME should not be trained by fledgling Trainers, despite its loyalty.

entry: POKENAME曾是海中最凶猛的捕食者之一，不断猎杀吼鲸王，直到自身数量开始减少。它们的牙齿化石，仍与久远以前一样锋利。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME were once known as one of the fiercest predators in the sea, constantly hunting Wailord until their own population began to dwindle. Their fossilized teeth are still as sharp as they once were long ago.

entry: POKENAME的咬力每平方英寸超过10吨。它能在高空无限期飞行，像喷气式飞机一样留下凝结尾迹。
author: mr.bonesii
source: POKENAME has a bite force of over 10 tons per square inch. It can fly indefinitely at high altitudes and leaves contrails like a jet plane.

entry: POKENAME会在炮筒内收集石头，再以振动磨成粗沙。战斗中，它先喷沙遮住敌人的视线，再用利爪攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects stones in its cannon, which then vibrates to grind them into coarse sand. It sprays this sand to blind foes mid-combat before striking with its sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME的触角敏锐得能察觉人的情绪变化，又结实得能充当额外的镰爪。它们生性谨慎，很难亲近。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME's antennae are sensitive enough to detect changes in people's moods and durable enough to be used as extra scything claws. They are difficult to befriend due to their cautious nature.

entry: POKENAME十分合群，常与其他物种结伴。过度捕猎，却让它已濒临灭绝。
author: yoshimon
source: This Pokémon is very social and often makes groups with other species. Overhunting has caused POKENAME to be near extinct.

entry: 这种宝可梦皮肤粗糙，脾气更糟。它能高速旋转背上的鞭状附肢，飞上天空，追猎任何被它视为敌人的对象。
author: brilliantdarkness
source: A Pokémon with highly abrasive skin and an even more abrasive temper. By rapidly rotating the whip-like appendages on its back, it can take flight and hunt down anything it deems a foe.

entry: 许多人将这些宝可梦比作喷气式飞机，因为它们常平展双翼，提高速度。羽毛间与两只角都会喷出热量和火焰，进一步推动身体加速。
author: infinex21
source: Many compare these Pokémon to jet planes because they often spread their wings out flat to achieve greater speeds. They will vent heat and flames from between their feathers and from their two horns, which further propel them quicker.

entry: POKENAME生性爱护同伴，有着龙的心。它囤积服装材料，让自己更适合飞行，还会试着摆出凶恶姿势吓唬训练家，结果大多数人反而觉得可爱。
author: ghostslythe
source: Protective by nature, POKENAME has the heart of a dragon. It hoards costume materials to make itself more aerodynamic. It attempts to pose menacingly to intimidate Trainers, but most find it adorable instead.

entry: 它长得像某位宝可梦冠军。究竟是想讨更多人喜欢，还是用来吓退训练家，至今不明。
author: jackythewannabe
source: It resembles a certain Pokémon champion. It's unknown if this was so more people would like it, or if it was to serve as a way to scare off Trainers.

entry: 这种稀有宝可梦有时会出现在传说中。它迅速振翅，穿梭战场，身上不时迸出龙之火焰与尖鳞。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is a rare Pokémon sometimes depicted in legends. As it quickly flutters around the battlefield, draconic flames and pointed scales erupt here and there from its body.

entry: POKENAME酷似喷气式飞机。光滑鳞片能尽量减少空气阻力，让它高速飞行追逐猎物，再用强大双颚击倒。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has a striking resemblance to a jet plane. Its smooth scales minimize air resistance, enabling it to fly at high speed in pursuit of prey, then take them down with its powerful jaws.

entry: POKENAME大多时间都埋在沙漠的沙层下。头部突起一察觉其他宝可梦从上方走过的振动，它就会飞出，以利翼和长满尖牙的嘴攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of its time buried beneath the sand of deserts. When the protuberances on its head sense the vibrations of another Pokémon walking above it, it will fly out to attack with its sharp wings and fanged mouths.

entry: POKENAME的身体虽不呈流线型，强壮尾巴仍能推动它在水中高速前进。一追上猎物，利齿与尖爪就会深深扎入。
author: .jerden
source: Although its body isn't streamlined, POKENAME's powerful tail can still drive it through the water at high speed. Once it catches up to prey, it will sink its sharp teeth and claws in.

entry: POKENAME周身裹着红色黏液，据说味如草莓酱。可它攻击性极强，只有交上朋友的训练家，才能安全采集。
author: krune
source: POKENAME are encased in a red slime said to taste like strawberry jam. Only Trainers who befriend them can safely harvest it, as POKENAME are highly aggressive.

entry: 水手们害怕POKENAME头上锯状鳍发出的轰鸣。据说，它眨眼间就能将一艘船切成两半。
author: bobogagabobo
source: Sailors dread the roar of the saw-like fin on POKENAME's head. It is said to slice a ship in half in the blink of an eye.

entry: POKENAME出手迅疾、不讲规矩，先用踢击让敌人踉跄，再以利爪结束战斗。它们好胜得很，最讨厌输。
author: yoshimon
source: POKENAME are quick, dirty fighters that stagger enemies with kicks before finishing them with sharp talons. They are very competitive and hate losing.

entry: POKENAME凭浓云之翼翱翔天空，隐匿踪迹，直到出击才现身。它虽看似柔软如棉，颚与爪却都致命。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME soars through the skies on wings of dense clouds, masking its presence until it strikes. Despite its soft, cotton-like appearance, its jaws and claws are deadly.

entry: POKENAME分泌滑溜液体，让自己快速滑行。它以头部突起察觉远处猎物的声音，再沿着黏液轨迹，悄悄接近。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME secretes a slippery fluid that enables it to glide around quite quickly. It uses the protuberances on its head to detect the sound of distant prey, then stealthily approaches on a trail of slime.

entry: POKENAME看似柔软，黏滑皮肤下却是强壮肌肉。它用尾巴奋力扫倒其他宝可梦，再扑到上方，以沉重体重压住碾碎猎物。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME seems soft, beneath its slimy skin are strong muscles. It knocks down other Pokémon with powerful swings of its tail, then throws itself on top to crush its prey beneath its heavy weight.

entry: POKENAME看似柔软，黏滑皮肤下却是强壮肌肉。它用尾巴奋力扫倒其他宝可梦，再扑到上方，以沉重体重压住碾碎猎物。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME seems soft, beneath its slimy skin are strong muscles. It knocks down other Pokémon with powerful swings of its tail, then throws itself on top to crush its prey beneath its heavy weight.

entry: POKENAME始终渴求猎物，见到什么都攻击，能同时对抗整群宝可梦。身体由能减少阻力的鳞片构成，连光粒子的阻力也能降低，使它飞得极快。
author: soup1900
source: Constantly hungry for prey, POKENAME will attack anything it sees, fighting entire flocks of Pokémon at once. Its body is made of scales that reduce the drag from even light particles, letting it fly at extremely high speeds.

entry: POKENAME的鳞片极硬极利，人们往往不愿抚摸。若被冷落太久，它就会烦躁好斗，甚至可能咬自己的训练家。
author: fiordaliso
source: Because its scales are extremely hard and sharp, people tend to avoid petting POKENAME. When neglected for too long, it becomes irritable and aggressive; it might even bite its own Trainer.

entry: 挖出的POKENAME牙齿常有裂纹缺口，原因在于它的食谱，包含多刺菊石兽、刺甲贝等硬壳宝可梦。
author: bigoljax
source: Dug up POKENAME teeth usually have cracks and chips in them because of their diet. This diet consists of Pokémon with tough shells, like Omastar and Cloyster.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇似乎对空气流动极其敏感。哪怕最轻微的气流拂过，也会使它猛然转身，准备以剃刀般利爪和有毒孢子自卫。
author: .jerden
source: The mushroom on POKENAME's back seems to be incredibly sensitive to air movements. The slightest movement of air across it can cause POKENAME to spin around, ready to defend itself with razor-sharp claws and toxic spores.

entry: 野生POKENAME凭水流裂破的强大力量，已摧毁许多船只，重伤无数水手。它总会从残骸取走自认为值钱的东西，仿佛海盗。
author: cobalt0135
source: Through the sheer force of Liquidation, wild POKENAME has destroyed many ships and critically injured countless sailors. It always takes what it deems valuable from the wreckage, as though it were a pirate.

entry: POKENAME住在森林，高速奔跑。臂刃锋利得能轻易砍断树木，确保一路畅通无阻。一发现猎物，它就扑过去，拿下下一顿饭。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME lives in forests, where it sprints at high speeds. Its arm blades are sharp enough to easily cut through trees, ensuring nothing can block its path while it runs. If it notices prey, it pounces on them to secure its next meal.

entry: POKENAME虽会像莲叶童子那样，让小宝可梦搭乘背部，却跑得太快、太颠簸，乘客根本抓不住多久。有时能在沙漠绿洲发现它。
author: bobosmith01
source: While it offers to carry small Pokémon on its back like Lotad, it simply travels way too fast and far too rough for other Pokémon to actually hold on for very long. Sometimes, POKENAME can be found in desert oases.

entry: POKENAME是迅捷的猎手，凭符合空气动力的身体划过天空。它们将活动刃片加热到灼烧的高温，闯过密林，几乎能烧尽路上的任何障碍。
author: zekkenbytheden
source: POKENAME are speedy predators that use their aerodynamic bodies to slice through the air. They tear through dense jungles by heating their hinge-blades to scorching temperatures, incinerating almost any obstacle in their path.

entry: POKENAME带着两把利刀，集中精神能量。它能迅速挥刀划过空中，深深切伤远处目标；即使全黑，也能用头部突起感知对方的位置。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME carries around two sharp knives to focus its psychic energy. POKENAME can quickly swing these blades through the air to cut deep into distant targets, using the protuberances on its head to sense their location even in total darkness.

entry: POKENAME在合众十分受欢迎，常通过与喷气发动机竞速来炫耀。有人推测，它的肌肉可能强韧得足以抵御导弹爆炸。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are very popular in Unova, where they often show off by racing against jet engines. It is theorized that the muscles of POKENAME might be sturdy enough to resist a missile explosion.

entry: 想逃离饥饿的POKENAME并不容易。即使跑离它悬挂的树，它仍能把自己甩出去，伸展叶片在空中滑翔，试图将逃跑的猎物整个吞下。
author: sk372
source: Escaping from a hungry POKENAME is not easy. Even if one runs from the tree it hangs from, it can fling itself and extend its leaves in a way that lets it glide through the air in an attempt to swallow fleeing prey whole.

entry: POKENAME的幼崽始终紧抓尾巴，因为觉得没有地方更安全。它守护着什么时，几乎无人能突破防线。
author: atlas3339098
source: POKENAME's young holds on tightly to its tail at all times because it feels there is no safer place to be. Few can get past a POKENAME when it's protecting something.

entry: POKENAME喜欢高速冲过空中，假装用漂浮肢体切向目标，吓唬对方。它消失、去找下一个受害者后，狡黠嘲弄的怪笑仍会久久留在对方脑中。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME loves to frighten others by jetting through the air at high speeds and pretending to cut at its target with its floating limbs. Its devious mocking cackle remains in the victim's mind long after it has vanished to find another to scare.

entry: 只要有影子，它就能沉入地底，不挪动一颗石头。长满利齿的巨口大大张开，再以超自然的速度，将受害者整个吞下。
author: ozydamians
source: It sinks beneath the ground without shifting a stone wherever a shadow is. Its toothy maw gapes open wide, then swallows its victim whole with supernatural speed.

entry: 它巨大的剃刀般利钳，闭合力可达10,000磅。它埋伏地下，等待猛然冲出，将猎物锁进再也挣不开的钳夹中。
author: hobiewankenobi
source: Its large and razor-sharp pincer can close with 10,000 lbs of force. It lies in wait under the ground, waiting to erupt and capture its prey in a vice so strong it can never escape.

entry: 身体的其他部分都已成熟，背上的种子却毫无变化。科学家认为，它的种子可能一生都会处于休眠。
author: soup1900
source: Although the rest of its body has matured, its seed remains as it is. Scientists believe the seed will remain dormant for the entirety of its life.

entry: POKENAME背上长着需要阳光才能生存的艳丽花朵，自身却仍然弱小，容易遭飞行属性宝可梦攻击。因此，常由其他巴大蝶或妙蛙花保护。
author: bobosmith01
source: While dazzling flowers that require sunlight to live grow on POKENAME's back, POKENAME is still weak and vulnerable to attacks from Flying-type Pokémon. As a result, they are often protected by other Butterfree or Venusaur.

entry: POKENAME的短腿无法走路或站立，只能调整滚动方向。花蕊随时可能涌出失控电流，因此接近前必须做好防护。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's short legs cannot be used for walking or standing, only for adjusting the rolling direction. Its stamens can spill uncontrollable electric currents at any time, making protective measures essential before approaching one.

entry: POKENAME能高效吸收并储存阳光，借此在夜间活动。它几乎不睡，但三颗头入夜后似乎什么都不做，只顾各自冥想。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME becomes active at night by efficiently absorbing and storing sunlight. Although it hardly sleeps, the three heads seem to do nothing at night except meditate individually.

entry: POKENAME体形虽小，却能轻松挥动巨大的植物。只需迅速一挥，就能击倒弱小的对手。
author: mepp.
source: Despite its small size, POKENAME wields its massive plant with ease. It swiftly knocks down weak opponents with one swing.

entry: 它挥舞的带刺花朵，曾是背上花朵的一部分，挥动时会散播有毒孢子。身体肌肉结实，以承受花朵不断生长的重量。
author: infinex21
source: The thorn-clad flower it wields was once part of the flower upon its back and scatters poisonous spores when waved around. Its body is dense with muscle to help support the weight of its growing flower.

entry: 进化后，花朵取代头骨，与POKENAME的头部融合。它会将花当武器，用阵阵花粉攻击。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: Instead of a skull, the flower has fused onto POKENAME's head through evolution. It utilizes the flower as a weapon, attacking with bursts of pollen.

entry: POKENAME皮肤遍布光合细胞，能直接从太阳获取能量。它们借此踢出闪电般的攻击，保持对手难以企及的速度。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have photosynthetic cells laced throughout their skin that enable them to gain energy directly from the sun. They use this energy to fuel lightning fast kicks, maintaining a speed that is hard to match by their opponents.

entry: POKENAME从阳光获得力量，能不停挥拳。一旦离开阳光，连续战斗3分钟后就需要休息。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME gains strength from sunlight and can throw punches continuously. Once away from sunlight, it needs to rest after fighting continuously for 3 minutes.

entry: POKENAME会舔树干，靠气味刺鼻的唾液标记丛林领地。若吸收的太阳能不足，背上花朵的花瓣就会变褐、枯萎。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME marks its territory in the jungle by licking tree trunks, since its saliva has a very pungent odor. If it fails to absorb enough solar energy, the petals of the flower on its back begin to turn brown and wither.

entry: 临近进化时，POKENAME茧状的身体会开始开裂，巨大的花朵从新裂口绽放。但这也是它最容易遭受致命伤害的时刻。
author: bobosmith01
source: When it is close to evolving, POKENAME's cocoon-like body begins cracking as a giant flower starts to bloom from the new hole. However, this is when POKENAME is most vulnerable to life-threatening injuries.

entry: 它吐出的气体带有热带水果味，却依旧刺鼻。人们说，闻起来就像腐烂的菠萝与木瓜。
author: xephyr
source: The gases it expels have become tropical scented, but still remain pungent. People describe the aroma as being like rotten pineapples and papayas.

entry: POKENAME会在甲片间的缝隙收集泥土，照料其中长出的植物。它们会耐心寻找阳光与雨水，让植物保持健康。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME gather soil in the crags and crevices between their armour plates. The plants that grow in amongst these crags are tended to by POKENAME. They take their time finding both sun and rain to keep them healthy.

entry: POKENAME携带的种子，能长成周围宝可梦最需要的形态。种下后，它还能借阳光培育新的种子。
author: oreee0230
source: The seed carried by POKENAME can grow into the form most needed by the surrounding Pokémon. After the seed is planted, POKENAME can use sunlight to nurture new seeds.

entry: 植物盛开时，POKENAME的藤蔓卷曲成亮绿色，抽击强劲。即使损伤，只需晒一小时太阳，便能重新长好。
author: frokachu
source: When its plants are in full bloom, POKENAME's vines coil up and turn a bright green. It can unleash powerful whips with them and they even grow back with just an hour of sunlight.

entry: POKENAME住在热带河口，鲜艳的鳍让它融入河面漂浮的叶片与花瓣。受打扰时十分凶猛，会向挑衅者喷出集中的水柱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in tropical estuaries, their brightly coloured fins helping them blend in with leaves and petals floating at the surface of the river. They are aggressive when disturbed, shooting concentrated streams of water at their aggressor.

entry: POKENAME常撞上水下岩石与植物，身上的花留下五彩花粉痕迹。画家常研究这些印痕，为作品寻找灵感。
author: radiance8990
source: POKENAME often bumps into rocks and plants underwater, the flowers on its body leaving colorful pollen smears in the process. Painters often study these marks for inspiration in their own works.

entry: 初春，POKENAME会像陀螺般旋转，从花瓣散播花粉，使森林开满香气清雅的花。中央宝石储存阳光，用以释放强力日光束。
author: fiordaliso
source: At the start of spring, POKENAME spins like a top to spread pollen from its petals, filling forests with delicately scented flowers. The gem at its center stores sunlight to unleash a powerful Solar Beam.

entry: POKENAME白天从太阳收集能量，夜间狩猎。它喜欢藏在浓密枝叶间，耐心等候最佳出击时机。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME spends the day gathering energy from the sun and hunts at night. It prefers to hide amongst thick foliage, waiting patiently for the perfect moment to strike.

entry: 整条裙子，其实只是头上花冠的一片花瓣。它能与植物交谈，向它们下令。
author: houndrys.
source: Its entire dress is a single petal from the flower crown on its head. It talks to plants, giving them commands.

entry: POKENAME以花瓣伞遮挡烈日与暴雨，避免干燥或吸水过多。它昂首走过时，连周围的植物也会起舞。
author: violet_zero
source: To keep itself from drying out or taking in too much water, POKENAME shields itself from harsh sunlight and torrential rain with a parasol of petals. Even the surrounding flora dances as this Pokémon struts along.

entry: POKENAME常与各种宝可梦争斗，连同类也不例外，抢夺食物与领地。木质的角生长极快，弥补磨损。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME frequently fights with various Pokémon, including its own kind, to steal food and territory. POKENAME's wooden horns grow very quickly to compensate for wear.

entry: 一些重伤的POKENAME会用真菌修补伤口。真菌比原来的壳更结实，但为了供给养分，它们常被迫日夜不停进食。
author: oreee0230
source: Some heavily injured POKENAME use fungi to repair their wounds. These fungi are tougher than the original shell, but the nutrients required to nourish them often force POKENAME to eat around the clock.

entry: 只要有阳光与水，POKENAME就会迅速长大。春天，常能见到身长超过十米的个体争夺首领之位。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME will grow rapidly in size as long as it has sunlight and water. In spring, it is often possible to see POKENAME over ten meters long fighting for the position of leader.

entry: POKENAME体内养分丰富，是比比鸟理想的点心。在陆地扑腾时，它有时能用强力日光束自卫。
author: bobosmith01
source: The rich nutrients possessed within POKENAME's body makes it the perfect snack for Pidgeotto. When flopping around on land, it can sometimes defend itself with a powerful Solar Beam.

entry: POKENAME的花含有剧毒。由于常难以独自撑住巨花，每个剧烈动作都会让毒液溢出。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: A POKENAME's flower contains highly toxic poison. Every drastic motion that a POKENAME makes causes poison to spill out, as they often have trouble holding up the large flower on their own.

entry: POKENAME通常出没于热带，被称为季风时节的使者。它们常在暴雨与洪水之前或期间现身，因此有暴虐破坏的名声。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A Pokémon typically found in tropical regions, POKENAME is known as the herald of the monsoon season. They are normally sighted ahead of or during torrential downpours and floods, and as a result, they have a reputation for violence and destruction.

entry: POKENAME通常出没于热带，被称为季风时节的使者。它们常在暴雨与洪水之前或期间现身，因此有暴虐破坏的名声。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A Pokémon typically found in tropical regions, POKENAME is known as the herald of the monsoon season. They are normally sighted ahead of or during torrential downpours and floods, and as a result, they have a reputation for violence and destruction.

entry: POKENAME会从胶状身体高速射出花瓣攻击。发出的声音，类似枪响。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires petals from its gelatinous body at extremely high speeds to attack. The noise it makes when doing this is similar to gunfire.

entry: 若看见许多花瓣漂在水面，那可能其实是一只刚潜入水中的POKENAME。
author: mystora
source: If you see many flower petals floating on water, it may actually be a POKENAME that has just submerged.

entry: POKENAME喜欢懒洋洋地待在微温的池塘与湖里，头和花瓣露出水面，自然吸收水与阳光。它们会分泌树汁般的液体代替唾液，用来强化吐出的泡泡。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME love to lounge in tepid ponds and lakes with their heads and petals above the surface, ambiently absorbing water and sunlight. They produce a sap-like liquid in place of saliva, which allows them to reinforce the bubbles they spit out.

entry: POKENAME黄色的“冠”是一种特殊植物，像器官一样，帮助调节鲜艳花瓣中储存的电力。它的爪够利，能爬树，但只为更好地伏击猎物才这样做。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's yellow "crown" is a special plant that acts like an organ to help regulate the electricity stored within its vibrant petals. Its claws are sharp enough that it can climb trees, though it only does this to better ambush prey.

entry: POKENAME的花瓣摸起来总是温暖，内含油状液体，易燃又极其辛辣，是某些菜肴中颇受欢迎的食材。尾毛中有许多种子，战斗时会发射并点燃。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME petals are always warm to the touch and contain an oil-like fluid that is flammable and incredibly spicy, making it a popular ingredient in some dishes. Within their tail fur are numerous seeds that they will launch and ignite in battle.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在偏僻的密林深处休息。受打扰时，它会先发出响亮的电子哔声，再发射电磁炮。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers to rest in deep secluded forests. If disturbed, it emits a loud electronic beep before firing a Zap Cannon.

entry: POKENAME曾被用于早期的3维游戏中，铺设草地贴图。不幸的是，代码中的错误让它也传播起了病毒。
author: rkmaster25367
source: POKENAME was utilized in early 3D games to propagate grass textures. Unfortunately, an error in its coding made it spread viruses too.

entry: POKENAME会将柔软身体藏入泥下，只露出坚硬树干。只有为了寻找湿润未干、又不会盖住叶片的合适地点，它才会移动。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME submerges its soft body beneath the mud, leaving its hard tree trunk exposed. It only moves when looking for a suitably wet spot that has not dried up and does not cover the leaves.

entry: POKENAME背上的花耗费庞大能量才得以绽放。它必须不断使用变硬，弥补自身的脆弱。
author: porpoisemerchant
source: The flower on POKENAME's back took a tremendous amount of energy to bloom. It has to constantly use Harden to make up for its fragility.

entry: 黎明，POKENAME会从海滩附近的洞穴出来，争夺最佳晒太阳地点。谁想抢走向阳的位置，它们就用腿夹击对方。
author: quackquackattack
source: At dawn, POKENAME emerge from caves near beaches to fight for the best places to sunbathe. Their legs are used to pinch at other POKENAME who try to take their spot in the sun.

entry: POKENAME耐心地进行光合作用，恢复身体活力，让爪变硬。只需四小时阳光，就能获得足以连续游泳、狩猎三天的能量。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME patiently photosynthesize to reinvigorate their bodies and harden their claws. With just four hours of sunlight, they have all the energy they need to swim and hunt for three straight days.

entry: 化石显示，POKENAME生前是雨林中的顶级猎手，捕猎技巧高超。粗壮的尾巴能勾住树木荡行，让速度更快。
author: mistymagius
source: Fossil records show that POKENAME were apex predators when they were alive, expertly hunting through the lush rainforest where it lives. Its thick tail allows it to swing from trees to increase its speed.

entry: 它虽能用后腿走路，却更常四足爬行，让巨花更好地晒到太阳。有人见过它睡在囤积的食物堆上，将花朝向天空。
author: infinex21
source: Though it can walk on its hind legs, it tends to crawl on all four so that its large flower is better exposed to sunlight. It has been seen laying atop a pile of stockpiled food while sleeping, with its flower exposed to the sky.

entry: POKENAME隐居丛林深处，极为罕见。巨大的叶状双翼一振，就会夷平树木。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is incredibly rare, as it lives deep in the jungle. Trees are leveled when it flaps its massive leafy wings.

entry: POKENAME是占据热带雨林的传说中的鸟宝可梦。吸收足够的阳光能量后，它会召来猛烈雷暴，电击并扰乱猎物。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME is a legendary bird Pokémon that occupies tropical rainforests. After absorbing enough energy from sunlight, it summons fierce thunderstorms to shock and confuse prey.

entry: POKENAME叶状双翼上的花始终盛开，沿飞过的路线散播花粉与种子。据说，它巢穴周围的森林，是已知最葱郁、最奇异的森林之一。
author: infinex21
source: The flowers along POKENAME's leafy wings are always in full bloom, scattering pollen and seeds across wherever it flies. The area around its nest is said to be one of the lushest and most exotic forests ever known.

entry: 花瓣环绕POKENAME旋转，使其身形难以察觉。它能赐予花朵结果的祝福，因此被视为好运的征兆。
author: oreee0230
source: Flower petals swirl around POKENAME, making its figure difficult to detect. It bestows the blessing to bear fruit upon flowers, therefore it is regarded as an omen of good fortune.

entry: POKENAME白天活动，会用藤蔓缠住入侵者，或以孢子使其失去意识，再用刺贯穿。繁衍似乎是它的首要目标。
author: bobosmith01
source: A diurnal Pokémon that defeats encroachers by wrapping them with vines or making them unconscious with spores before skewering them with their stinger. It seems POKENAME's main priority is reproducing.

entry: POKENAME背上花朵采得的花粉具有独特DNA，科学家至今仍在研究。它通常住在广阔的热带森林，更容易融入环境，掩盖踪迹。
author: fiordaliso
source: The pollen collected from the flower on its back is still being studied by scientists because of its unique DNA. POKENAME usually lives in vast tropical forests, where it is easier for it to blend in and cover its tracks.

entry: POKENAME的花会散发浓烈气味，使人平静。许多寺庙都借这种气味辅助冥想。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce a pungent scent from their flower that calms people down. Many temples rely on this scent to help them meditate.

entry: POKENAME全身生长的植物会产生高度易燃的花粉。它们体温很高，有时会无意间使花粉自燃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME produce highly flammable pollen from the plants growing along their body. Their body temperatures are high enough that they will sometimes inadvertently cause the pollen to spontaneously combust.

entry: POKENAME在火山脚下的肥沃土地周围安家。它们利用土中养分，长出鲜艳的花瓣冠，彼此展示。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their homes around the fertile soil at the base of volcanoes. They make use of the nutrients in the soil to grow a vivid petal crown to display to one another.

entry: POKENAME腹部覆有树皮，保护自己在地下挖掘。睡觉时，它们会将头露在洞外，让花瓣垂在周围，吸收阳光。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a coating of bark across their stomach to help protect them when they dig underground. When they sleep they do so with their head resting outside of their burrows, letting their petals drape around them and absorb sunlight.

entry: 即使严冬，POKENAME体温仍很高，使后颈周围的植物持续生长。它们亮出花瓣彼此示意，不动武就能解决领地争端。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Even in the depths of winter, the plants surrounding the nape of POKENAME are able to keep growing thanks to their high internal body temperature. They flash their petals to signal at one another and resolve territorial disputes without fighting.

entry: 即使严冬，POKENAME体温仍很高，使后颈周围的植物持续生长。长出叶片的颜色，能很好地反映健康状况。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Even in the depths of winter, the plants surrounding the nape of POKENAME are able to keep growing thanks to their high internal body temperature. The colouration of the fronds they grow is a good indicator of the Pokémon's health.

entry: POKENAME背部始终散发近乎看不见的花粉云。准备战斗时，它们从毛间燃起小火星，点燃花粉云，展现吓人的烈焰。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME emit a constant cloud of nearly invisible pollen from their backs. When they are preparing to fight, they light a small spark from their fur that ignites this pollen cloud and creates an intimidating, fiery display.

entry: POKENAME背部始终散发近乎看不见的花粉云。准备战斗时，它们从毛间燃起小火星，点燃花粉云，展现吓人的烈焰。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME emit a constant cloud of nearly invisible pollen from their backs. When they are preparing to fight, they light a small spark from their fur that ignites this pollen cloud and creates an intimidating, fiery display.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在明亮阳光下打盹，滋养自身与背上的花。许多宝可梦怕被咬，不会打扰它睡觉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy taking naps in bright sunlight to nourish themselves and the flower on their back. Many Pokémon leave them alone during these naps out of a fear of getting bitten.

entry: POKENAME背着一朵大花，会自行向周围释放孢子。它们啄地寻找有毒的根为食，也因此让孢子带上毒性。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME carry a large flower on its back that passively releases spores around them. They peck at the ground to find poisonous roots to eat, which in turn make its spores poisonous.

entry: POKENAME四足移动虽更快，一生却大多用后腿站立，以便威吓其他对象。休息时，它们会躺在微温的水里或潮湿处，充分吸收阳光。
author: infinex21
source: Although POKENAME move quicker quadrupedally, they spend much of their lives on their hind legs to better intimidate others. When they rest, they lie in tepid waters or in a damp spot where they can absorb plenty of sunlight.

entry: POKENAME最初在茂密潮湿的沼泽深处被发现，当时被误认成一株长到池面的巨大植物。人们很快发现，它们正是借这种伪装，迅速而无情地伏击猎物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME were first discovered deep within a lush and humid marsh, first assumed to be a large plant that had grown to the surface of a pond. It was quickly discovered that they hide as such in order to swiftly and mercilessly ambush prey.

entry: POKENAME为鸟宝可梦提供栖身处，换取它们帮忙引诱猎物。平时，它只用叶片就能呼吸，但狩猎后必须迅速用鼻子吸入氧气。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME provides shelter for bird Pokémon in exchange for their help in luring prey. Normally, POKENAME can breathe using only its leaves, but after hunting, it needs to quickly take in oxygen through its nose.

entry: POKENAME感到受威胁或脆弱时，头上花朵般的羽饰会扇形展开。白天栖息时，头部纹样会随心跳脉动。
author: silverscloudy
source: The floral plumage on POKENAME's head fans out when it feels threatened or vulnerable. When it roosts during the day, the patterns on its head pulse along with its heartbeat.

entry: POKENAME白天睡在森林树冠顶端，让阳光直照花朵。花开后，身体会变轻，使它滑翔得更加优雅无声。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME sleeps at the top of the forest canopy during the day, allowing the sun to beam down on its flower. When the flower blooms, POKENAME grows lighter, allowing it to glide more gracefully and silently.

entry: 它能连续数小时紧贴树干与枝条，埋伏等待。昆虫宝可梦来吮吸背上的花时，它就会猛扑。
author: calelian
source: It clings to tree trunks and branches for hours on end, lying in wait. When insect Pokémon come to drink from the flower on its back, it pounces.

entry: POKENAME夜间活动，深夜滑过月照的森林，野外很少有人有幸见到。双翼拖着小花苞与花粉，身影所过之处，植物绽放，夜间猎物消失。
author: silentscript89
source: Few get the chance to see a POKENAME in the wild when this nocturnal Pokémon glides through moonlit forests in the deep of night. With its wings trailing tiny buds and pollens, plants bloom and nighttime prey vanishes wherever its shadow passes.

entry: POKENAME休息时，很容易被误认成妙蛙花。某些宝可梦本会危及它，却不敢攻击这种大型草属性宝可梦，它便借相似外形安全藏身，直到起飞才会露馅。
author: katieplaysgames
source: When at rest, POKENAME can be easily mistaken for Venusaur. They use this similarity to safely hide from Pokémon that wouldn't attack the large Grass-Type but would be dangerous to them, the deception only being revealed when they take off.

entry: POKENAME靠尾叶完成复杂的空中动作。它能迅速俯冲，抓住绿毛虫或独角虫，再把虫宝可梦带回巢。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME relies on its tail leaves to perform complex aerial maneuvers. It can quickly dive to snatch a Caterpie or Weedle before bringing the bug Pokémon back to its nest.

entry: 它浮在池面吸收阳光，转化成电力。攻击前，还会从触角散出麻痹粉。
author: ariamelisma
source: It gathers sunlight as as floats on the surface of ponds, converting it into electricity. It releases Stun Spores from its antennae before attacking.

entry: POKENAME身上花朵产生的花粉，既疏水又会发光。因此，游过时会留下发光轨迹，宛如在夜空中游泳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The pollen that comes from the flowers sprouting out of POKENAME is both hydrophobic and luminescent. POKENAME leave a glowing trail in their wake as they swim thanks to this pollen, creating the illusion that they are swimming through a night sky.

entry: POKENAME住在泥沙浓重、能见度低的河里。花朵通常拖在水面吸收阳光，但也能与水反应，产生强大电荷。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in low visibility rivers that are thick with mud and silt. Their flowers typically trail at the surface to absorb sunlight, but they can react with water to create a potent electrical charge.

entry: POKENAME小小的身体承受着巨花重量，行动受限。作为弥补，它会从花内伸出强劲藤蔓，推动自己移动一小段距离。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's huge flower weighs heavily on its tiny body, limiting its mobility. To compensate, it propels itself short distances by using powerful vines that extend from within its flower.

entry: POKENAME会在巢旁长出球茎，保护里面的雏鸟。极少数情况下，它会拔起巢穴，用藤蔓缠在背上，寻找更安全的筑巢地点。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME sprouts bulbs around nests to protect the baby chicks inside. On rare occasions, it uproots the nest and wraps it around its back with vines to find a safer location to nest.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，无论撒出多少花瓣，都几乎会立刻重新长出。花香让它安宁，任由风引导，缓缓而优雅地起舞。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: No matter how many flower petals POKENAME scatter while they dance, they will grow back almost instantly. POKENAME dance slowly and elegantly, soothed by the fragrance of their flower petals and allowing the wind to guide them.

entry: POKENAME鲜艳的花朵与长长垂叶十分抢眼，因此很受舞台表演欢迎。但太多目光会让它僵住，需要大量指导，才能面对较大观众群表演。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular Pokémon for stage performances as their vividly coloured flowers and long draping leaves make very eye catching. It takes a lot of coaching for them to perform for larger crowds as they tend to freeze up with too much attention.

entry: 这种沼泽宝可梦极其自大傲慢，甚至以其他宝可梦的统治者自居。众多薄叶每片都含催眠成分，因此它每天都会分给自己的“臣民”。
author: infinex21
source: This swamp-dwelling Pokémon is remarkably pompous and arrogant, to the point that it acts like a ruler of other Pokémon. Each of its many thin leaves contains a hypnotic agent, which is why it will share them with its "subjects" every day.

entry: POKENAME能用声音指挥其他对声音敏感的宝可梦。通常，拍肚子就足够响，但若张嘴咆哮，它就无法控制木质下颚中回音持续的时间。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME can command other sound-sensitive Pokémon through its voice. Usually, it only needs to beat its belly to produce enough sound, but once it roars from its mouth, it cannot control the duration of the echo in its wooden jaw.

entry: POKENAME极不喜欢新鲜蔬菜的味道。许多人都说，过去做过的怪梦里，曾见它扮演反派。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is known to have a strong dislike of the taste of fresh vegetables. Many have attested to seeing POKENAME act as the villain in strange dreams they've had in the past.

entry: POKENAME会产生浓密盘旋的花粉，搅动周围空气，推动自己升空。飞起来后，它们能借阳光进行光合作用、获取养分，几天不吃东西。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produce thick swirls of pollen that spin the air around them to propel them into the air. Once airborne, they can go several days without food, as they photosynthesize nutrients through sunlight.

entry: POKENAME会从花坛偷种子，藏在嘴里，转而繁殖自己的种子。长出的花，带有麝香与泥土的气息。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME steals seeds from flowerbeds and hides them in its mouth. It propagates its own seeds instead, which produce a flower that has musky and earthy scents.

entry: POKENAME头上的花开得像王冠，纯属巧合；这种形状有助于避免过大的植物使身体失衡。尽管如此，过去仍有让它出席加冕礼的习俗。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The crown-like flower blooming atop POKENAME is purely coincidental, as the shape helps prevent the oversized plant unbalancing POKENAME. Despite this, it was a custom for a POKENAME to be present at a coronation.

entry: POKENAME想给异性留下好印象时，会互相甩泥拍打。它们偏爱身体结实的伴侣，因此甩泥的习惯能帮它们找到同样耐打的对象。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME slap each other with mud whenever they are trying to impress the opposite gender. They are predisposed to choosing mates that have tough bodies, so their mud-flinging tendencies help them find mates with similar levels of resilience.

entry: POKENAME利用浓烈香气影响并吸引附近的宝可梦，成为森林首领。它们会释放强烈改变心智的孢子，尤其在晒太阳吸收能量一阵后。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME have become leaders of forests as they use strong fragrances to influence and attract nearby Pokémon. They release spores with strong mind altering properties, especially after they have spent time in the sunlight absorbing energy.

entry: 它能用预知能力预测天气，尽可能多地躺着晒太阳，使花保持明艳多彩。
author: .jerden
source: It uses its precognition to predict the weather. This enables it to spend as much time as possible lying in the sun, keeping its flower bright and colorful.

entry: 充足月光能让这种宝可梦的花长得更大、更鲜艳。香气会随月亮盈亏变化。
author: deelee2020
source: Plenty of moonlight creates bigger and more vibrant flowers for this species. The scent changes as the moon waxes and wanes.

entry: POKENAME虽对周围世界有渊博知识，却仍与野生宝可梦生活。科学家快要抓到它时，它就放出花粉云，催眠追赶者，趁机逃脱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live among wild Pokémon even though they have vast knowledge of the world around them. Whenever scientists come close to capturing POKENAME, they produce clouds of pollen that lull their pursuers to sleep and allow them to escape.

entry: POKENAME的花盆使超能力呈指数般增强。它会挑选一座花园，向敌人脑中灌入令人迷乱的景象，保护花园。
author: larryloud55
source: POKENAME's pot has boosted its psychic power to an exponential degree. It selects a garden of flowers and protects it by filling enemies' minds with disorienting visuals.

entry: POKENAME知识渊博，是最聪明的宝可梦之一。尽管拥有百科全书般丰富的智慧，它们仍偏爱与野生生灵一起，过简单生活。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have vast knowledge that makes them some of the smartest Pokémon to exist. Despite their encyclopedic wisdom, they prefer to live among wild creatures and lead simple lives.

entry: 花比预期更早长大，可身体还没强壮到能承重，反而被花压得抬不起身。
author: soup1900
source: Its flower has grown a lot sooner than expected. The weight of the flower crushes it, as it is not strong enough to carry it yet.

entry: POKENAME背上的球茎会放出恶臭，赶走其他宝可梦。它会大吃垃圾桶里能找到的零食残渣。
author: quackquackattack
source: The bulb on the back of POKENAME releases a foul stench that wards off other Pokémon. It gorges itself on leftover snacks that it can find in garbage bins.

entry: 这种温顺的宝可梦不会远离居住的洞穴，只在有阳光时外出，人造灯光骗不过它。但若有什么碰到带斑点的花瓣，它就会凶猛还击。
author: infinex21
source: This docile Pokémon does not wander far from the cave it has made its den within and only comes out when sunlight is present; it cannot be tricked with artificial lights. If anything touches its spotted petals, it viciously lashes out.

entry: POKENAME会以同样的方式回击一切威胁。与花下隐藏的眼睛对视会惹怒它，但这种情况下，报复也只是瞪着敌人。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME will retaliate equally against all threats. Making eye contact with the hidden eyes under POKENAME's flowers will anger it, but in such a case, its revenge is merely staring at the enemy.

entry: POKENAME坚韧的木壳能挡住大多数攻击。它会将自己固定在树顶附近，让头上的巨花吸收阳光。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's tough wooden shell shields it from most attacks. It anchors itself near the top of trees to absorb sunlight into the massive flower on its head.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀不够有力，无法起飞。需要快速移动时，它就射出由伸缩藤蔓相连的尾端钻头，嵌进物体表面，牵引自己荡来荡去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wings aren't strong enough for it to take off and fly. If it needs to move around quickly, it fires the drill-tip on its tail, connected by an extendable vine, lodging it into surfaces to pull and swing itself around.

entry: POKENAME用强大身体在地上开出长而浅的沟，吞食湿土，滋养头上的花。夏季雨刚停时，它们最活跃。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses its powerful body to carve out long but shallow trenches in the ground, nourishing the flower on its head by eating  wet soil. They are most active immediately after rainfall in summertime.

entry: POKENAME很受一些参加宝可梦华丽大赛的训练家喜爱，常穿上各种独特服装。装扮时，它们对训练家很有耐心，乐于获得关注。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are popular Pokémon amongst some Pokémon Contest Trainers, often dressed up in all sorts of unique outfits. They are patient with their Trainers during this, happy for the attention.

entry: 背上的花让POKENAME总难保持羽毛干净。它会长出藤蔓，帮自己擦去孢子，却只会让更多孢子从花上掉落。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME constantly struggles to keep its feathers clean because of the flower on its back. It sprouts vines to help itself scrub away at the spores, but this only causes more spores to fall from the flower.

entry: POKENAME会蓬起花瓣与叶片，让自己显得更大、更吓人。它们善于吓退小宝可梦，却很难让大个子相信自己真有威胁。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fluff up their petals and leaves to make themselves look larger and more intimidating than they are. They are good at scaring off smaller Pokémon, but they struggle to convince larger Pokémon that they're a real threat.

entry: POKENAME会蓬起花瓣与叶片，让自己显得更大、更吓人。花瓣发育较差的个体，最后会变得更凶暴，弥补外表不够吓人的不足。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fluff up their petals and leaves to make themselves look larger and more intimidating than they are. POKENAME with less developed petals end up being more aggressive as compensation for their less threatening appearance.

entry: POKENAME靠与虫类宝可梦合作生存。虫宝可梦收集有机物，它再通过发酵吸收养分，产出大量花蜜回报。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME survives by cooperating with bug Pokémon. The bug Pokémon collect organic matter for POKENAME, which absorbs nutrients through fermentation and produces a large amount of nectar in return.

entry: POKENAME会将藤蔓固定在树间，布置决斗场，以角相撞。胜者能优先挑选领地里的花，败者则帮忙让花重新长回，以示对环境的尊重。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME secure vines around trees to arrange arenas for duels where they clash horn to horn. The winner of the duel gets first pick of the flowers in the territory, while the loser honors the environment by helping to regrow them.

entry: 它的花进行光合作用的效率，远超普通植物，赋予它猛烈的太阳攻击。但这也让身体长期处于熔化状态，温度与熔岩相当。
author: h0bojoe
source: Its flower photosynthesizes at rates far exceeding regular flora, granting it harsh solar attacks. However, this leaves its body permanently melting at temperatures equal to lava.

entry: POKENAME住在火山活动频繁的热带岛屿。它们会走上正在冷却的熔岩流，靠体内特殊酶溶解玄武岩，吸收丰富养分，促进花朵生长。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live on tropical islands that have high levels of volcanic activity. They travel out onto cooling lava flows, a special enzyme from their bodies dissolving the basalt and letting them absorb the rich nutrients to fuel their flower's growth.

entry: POKENAME凭敏锐嗅觉，在落叶层中缓缓挪动，寻找真菌。它们慢得让植物在背上生根、开花，也借此伪装，保护自身。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME slowly shuffle through leaf litter in search of fungi, using their acute sense of smell to do so. They are so slow moving that plants take root in their back, sprouting into full flowers and helping them stay safe through camouflage.

entry: 寒冷月份里，POKENAME会让背上共生的花长出密叶，覆盖身体保暖。叶片在夏季能供作食物，却也常遮挡视线。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME keep themselves warm during the colder months by growing a dense coating of leaves from the symbiotic flower growing on their back. These leaves provide a food source in the summer months, but have a habit of obstructing their vision.

entry: POKENAME生活在热带近海地区。有些地方的村庄会举办节日，人们比赛谁能养出花朵最大的个体。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME lives in tropical habitats near the sea. In some regions, villages have festivals where individuals compete to raise a POKENAME with the largest flower.

entry: POKENAME能长时间离水，共生植物让它即使在空气中也能呼吸。它们借此逃避大宝可梦，拉着身体钻入灌木，藏到觉得安全为止。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to leave the water for prolonged periods of time, their symbiotic plants letting them breathe despite being in the air. They'll use this ability to escape larger Pokémon, pulling themselves into bushes to hide until they feel safe.

entry: POKENAME能长时间离水，共生植物让它即使在空气中也能呼吸。它们借此逃避大宝可梦，拉着身体钻入灌木，藏到觉得安全为止。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to leave the water for prolonged periods of time, their symbiotic plants letting them breathe despite being in the air. They'll use this ability to escape larger Pokémon, pulling themselves into bushes to hide until they feel safe.

entry: POKENAME游在海面时，常被误认成移动岛屿。背上的树不断吸收阳光，供给动力，使它能一连游好几天，不用休息。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are often mistaken for moving islands as they swim along the ocean's surface. The trees on their backs absorb sunlight to constantly fuel them, allowing them to swim for days at a time without a break.

entry: POKENAME的叶片覆有蜡质，因此闪闪发亮。它们结成群体，由翅膀最闪亮的个体领导。
author: busilisk
source: Its leaves are covered with a waxy substance, giving them a shiny appearance. Groups of POKENAME form flocks led by those with the shiniest wings.

entry: POKENAME尾上的火焰，哪怕在最猛烈的雨里也不会熄灭。因为花朵产生的高度易燃毒素，会直接供给火焰燃料。
author: ambrosia04
source: The flame on a POKENAME's tail never goes out, even in the heaviest of rain. This is because the fire is directly fueled by the highly flammable toxin its flower produces.

entry: POKENAME外层的羽毛其实是红花瓣，实力越强，颜色越鲜艳。它们在森林成群生活，以鲜明色彩震慑敌人。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's exterior feathers are red petals that grow more vivid as POKENAME become stronger. They live in groups in the forest, using their bright colors to intimidate enemies.

entry: POKENAME能自然融入周围森林，一次埋伏数小时。毫无戒心的宝可梦靠近时，阵阵花粉先将猎物催眠，它再大口享用新的一餐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME naturally blend into the surrounding forest and can lie in wait for hours at a time. When an unsuspecting Pokémon comes near, a flurry of pollen lulls prey to sleep before POKENAME chomp down on their new meal.
