entry: POKENAME会找灌木睡觉，花与叶让它休息时伪装得很好。醒着时，它们惯于用惊人力量推倒树木，吃到原本够不着的果实。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME will find a bush to sleep in and are well disguised by their flowers and leaves when resting. When awake, they have a habit of using their incredible strength to topple trees to get to the fruit that would otherwise be out of their reach.

entry: POKENAME温柔而善于表达，能以象鸣与低沉轰鸣和人沟通。不高兴时，它会摇动背上的花，释放黏性花粉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are expressive yet gentle creatures that can communicate with people through trumpeting and rumbling. Whenever they are upset, they shake the flower atop their backs to release a sticky pollen.

entry: POKENAME在网络空间生活得很好，喜欢鼓励孩子学习新词。程序虽让它种虚拟稻米、增加计数，帮助孩子学习却才是首要目标。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME thrive in cyberspace and enjoy encouraging children to learn new vocabulary words. Even though POKENAME are programmed to cultivate virtual rice to make a counter go up, their main priority is to help children learn.

entry: POKENAME十分仁慈，会细心照料野生宝可梦的伤口。花粉像消毒剂，藤蔓则包裹伤处，防止感染。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are benevolent creatures that help wild Pokémon heal from wounds with delicate care. Their pollen acts like an antiseptic while their vines wrap around wounds to prevent infections.

entry: POKENAME头上的角极其稀少，售价高昂。角燃烧时会散发催眠气味，因此过去曾被用来为王族制作精巧奢华的吊灯。
author: bobogagabobo
source: The horns on POKENAME's head are extremely rare and fetch an extremely high price. These horns were once used to make elaborate and extravagant chandeliers for royalty as they produce a sleep-inducing scent when burned.

entry: 它会用尾端分泌的液体标记领地。这种液体对大多数生物有毒，但植物与植物类宝可梦摄入或吸收后，反而能茁壮生长。
author: infinex21
source: It uses the fluid secreted from the tip of its tail to mark its territory. This fluid is poisonous to most organic beings, yet plants and plant-based Pokémon thrive if they ingest or absorb it.

entry: POKENAME善于利用身边材料，用附近的叶片与花制作华丽礼服。裙子一沾污，它们就会大发脾气。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are resourceful Pokémon, using nearby leaves and flowers to make gorgeous gowns. If a stain gets on one of their dresses, they will throw a tantrum.

entry: 花粉刺激性极强，吸入后会使人麻痹、昏睡，甚至中毒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The pollen is a powerful irritant and can cause paralytic, soporific, or even poisonous effects when inhaled.

entry: POKENAME用背上的叶片伪装成植物。伏击猎物时，毒囊会张开，从颈伞下释放有毒花粉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME camouflages itself as a plant with the leaves on its back. Whenever it ambushes its prey, a venomous sac opens and releases a toxic pollen from underneath its hood.

entry: POKENAME会从腹部花朵的中央产出细腻的奶。它源自植物、不含乳糖，人人都能饮用。若腹部花瓣枯萎，就再也无法产奶。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME produces a very delicate milk from the center of the flower growing on its abdomen; being a plant-based, lactose-free product, it can be consumed by everyone. If the petals on its belly wilt, this Pokémon can no longer produce milk.

entry: POKENAME悉心照顾腹袋里的植物。只要照料得当，植物就能释放舒缓身心、治愈伤病的花粉雾，几乎什么病都能治。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very dedicated to the plant that it carries in its pouch. This is due to the plant's ability to, when properly cared for, dispense a soothing and healing mist of pollen that can cure most any ailment.

entry: POKENAME会散播花粉云储存电力，看似翻滚的雷云。一声咆哮，花粉就会将储存的能量化作强劲闪电释放。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME disperse clouds of pollen to store their electricity, resembling rolling storm clouds. When they roar, the pollen discharges the stored energy as powerful bolts.

entry: 它以独特仪态漫步液面，高贵双足踏过的每种液体都会得到净化。覆满花朵的冠所分泌的汁液，或许短短几秒就能让腐朽的树重焕活力。
author: fiordaliso
source: With its unique poise, it strolls over the top of the fluids, purifying every liquid upon which it sets its noble feet. The juice secreted by its blossom-lined crest might restore the vigor of rotting trees within one brief stretch of seconds.

entry: POKENAME的花已发育成熟，身体却仍小巧。它以富含养分的泥土为食，用支撑花朵、强得出奇的花茎，击打任何捕食者或威胁。
author: t3isukone
source: Though its flower is already developed, the body remains small. POKENAME feeds on nutrient-rich soil, whacking any predators or threats with the surprisingly strong stalk that supports its flower.

entry: POKENAME用颈部褶边恐吓其他宝可梦，尤其是想侵犯领地的对象。母亲格外凶暴，因为幼崽出生头六年完全依赖雌性照顾。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME uses its neck frill to intimidate other Pokémon, especially those who try to infringe on its territory. A mother POKENAME is especially aggressive, as its young are completely reliant on the female for the first six years of their lives.

entry: 冒险的训练家穿越POKENAME栖居的丛林时，务必小心。它们的颜色与花让身体融入低矮草木，很容易被无意踩到，而它们每次都会还击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Adventurous Trainers are advised to take care when traversing jungles that are home to POKENAME. Their colouration and flowers make them blend in to the undergrowth and it is easy to accidentally step on one, which will always cause them to strike.

entry: POKENAME通常让花瓣紧贴颈部，方便蜿蜒移动。想吓退对手时，就会猛然展成一朵完整的花，让自己骤然显得更大。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME usually keep their petals flush to their neck to make it easier for them to slither around. When they want to scare off a rival they will flash their petals into a full flower, making themselves abruptly look larger.

entry: 冒险的训练家穿越POKENAME栖居的丛林时，务必小心。它们的颜色与花让身体融入低矮草木，很容易被无意踩到，而它们每次都会还击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Adventurous Trainers are advised to take care when traversing jungles that are home to POKENAME. Their colouration and flowers make them blend in to the undergrowth and it is easy to accidentally step on one, which will always cause them to strike.

entry: 秋季，POKENAME背上会长出小树果。采摘时会遭轻微电击，但果实香甜，常用作燕麦粥的配料。
author: .izik
source: During the autumn months, small berries sprout from POKENAME's back. Picking them causes a mild electric shock, but the berries are sweet and commonly used as oatmeal toppings.

entry: POKENAME每次振翅，都会散播独特花粉。盛开的花碰到后更加鲜艳，衰老枯萎的花却会迅速烧成灰，为更新、更健康的植物让路。
author: sk372
source: A unique type of pollen is spread with every flap of POKENAME's wings. Blooming flowers grow even more vibrant at the touch, while old and withering flowers quickly burn to ash to make way for newer and healthier plants.

entry: 日落时，能见到POKENAME飘过森林、草地与花园。它唱着奇异忧伤的歌，有人相信能让植物生长。
author: occulusmalus
source: POKENAME can be seen drifting through forests, meadows and gardens at sundown. It sings strange, melancholy songs that some believe make plants grow.

entry: POKENAME戴着与大脑相连的特殊帽子，得以产生新颖惊人的领悟，学会驾驭力量。但顿悟后会迟钝一阵，只有躺着晒太阳才能恢复。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME wears a special cap that connects to its brain, allowing it to gain new and shocking insights into how to harness its powers. This burst of insight is followed by a period of sluggishness that is only resolved by lying in the sun.

entry: 战斗中，POKENAME会让藤蔓破土而出，缠住敌人。随后，它通过藤蔓放电，持续电击对手，直到对方投降。
author: quackquackattack
source: During battle, POKENAME causes vines to erupt from the ground, which ensnares its foes. Afterwards, it releases a shock through the vines, which electrocutes its opponent until they surrender.

entry: 背上巨花已开始侵占它们身体的一部分，却反而使肌肉生长。它们大多数脂肪，来自花朵收集阳光后获取的多余养分。
author: infinex21
source: The large flowers upon their backs have partly begun to overtake them, yet this has only caused their muscles to grow. Most of their fat comes from the excess nutrients acquired from the sunlight gathered by their flowers.

entry: POKENAME以控制整片森林与洞穴系统闻名。它们会钻地，假扮长苔的岩石，但背上的花仍让它们很容易被发现。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are widely known to take control of entire forests and cave systems. They can disguise themselves as a mossy rock by digging into the ground, though they can easily be spotted due to the flowers on their backs.

entry: POKENAME将全部电力储存在背上的花中，再通过藤蔓排出，产生能使人麻痹的气味。
author: alexgriller
source: POKENAME stores all its electricity in the flower on its back, which it then expels with its vines, producing a paralyzing odor.

entry: POKENAME的右臂特化成长炮管，配有花瓣制成的瞄准镜。虽然能连续射击，瞄准镜却会被第一发的冲击损坏，修好之前都无法精准瞄准。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's right arm is specialized into an extended barrel, equipped with a scope made of petals. Although it can fire continuously, the scope will be damaged by the impact of the first shot and cannot aim accurately until repaired.

entry: POKENAME双臂末端覆有木壳，减少发射时的水分流失。它通常住在水源附近，随时补充水冷系统消耗的水。
author: oreee0230
source: The ends of POKENAME's arms are covered with a wooden shell to reduce moisture loss when firing. POKENAME usually lives near water sources to replenish losses in its water cooling system at any time.

entry: POKENAME生活在葱郁丛林，飞过之处，植物随之生长。人们认为，吃下它尾上的树果，就能获得永恒的喜悦。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: They live in lush jungles. Wherever POKENAME flies, flora grows in its wake. The berry growing on its tail is thought to give one everlasting joy if it were to be eaten.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴位置高，能吸引闪电。它只需偶尔承受雷击就能生存，却仍会主动采集树果。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's tail can attract lightning due to its height. It can survive just by occasionally receiving lightning, yet it still actively collects berries.

entry: POKENAME比普通穿山鼠更擅长战斗。因为花朵让它们无法蜷成球，只能更频繁地迎战。
author: mystora
source: POKENAME are more skilled at fighting than regular Sandshrew, as they are unable to curl up because of their flower. This forces them to engage in fights more often.

entry: 它凭修长轻盈的叶翼，高速飞过丛林。放出的强力声波能翻动地面，让它播下所吃果实的种子。
author: infinex21
source: It flies through the jungle at great speeds using its long, yet light, leafy wings. It releases powerful sonic waves to churn the ground so it may sow seeds from the fruits it eats.

entry: POKENAME会故意冻住毛发般的叶片，像刀刃一样挥动。对手靠近时，它便放出花粉，让对方瞬间冻在原地。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME purposely freezes its hair-like leaves, swinging them around like blades. When opponents approach, it releases pollen, instantly freezing them in their tracks.

entry: POKENAME为了在地面更好地移动，练出强壮肌肉。它以尾端花朵引来猎物，再突然出击。
author: raza
source: POKENAME have developed stronger muscles in order to better navigate on the ground. They lure prey in with the flowers on their tails before striking.

entry: POKENAME皮肤内生活着共生藻类，即使冬季也有食物来源。夏季，它们会长出醒目的叶状面饰，背上还会开出巨花。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have symbiotic algae living in their skin ensuring that they have a source of food even in the winter. During the summer, they produce an impressive leafy facial display along with growing gigantic flowers on their back.

entry: POKENAME皮肤内生活着共生藻类，即使冬季也有食物来源。冬天会长出细密蓬松的苔藓，某些个体还会长出粗壮木牙。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have symbiotic algae living in their skin ensuring that they have a source of food even in the winter. They grow a fine shaggy coat of moss in the winter, and some grow thick woody tusks.

entry: POKENAME待在电脑里时，会不断把花香转成数据，让电脑持续读取、记录，始终占用运算能力。运行保存的数据文件，就会使电脑产生香气。
author: soup1900
source: The processing power of a computer is in constant use while POKENAME is inside it since the computer is constantly reading and logging the data it creates from its flower's aromas. Running these logged data files causes the computer to create scents.

entry: POKENAME会攀在高高的树上，尽量多晒阳光。背上的花将花粉撒入微风，阻止飞行属性宝可梦攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME grapple onto trees high above the ground to maximize the amount of sunlight they receive. The flower on their back scatters pollen into the breeze to discourage Flying-type Pokémon from attacking.

entry: 这种宝可梦会通过头上的花，把阳光转化为火焰燃料。POKENAME的日光束，威力堪比喷火器。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: This Pokémon converts sunlight into fuel for its fire through the flower on its head. POKENAME's Solar Beam has a comparable force to a flamethrower.

entry: 疲惫旅人在沙漠看见POKENAME，是个好兆头。因为它需要大量淡水滋养巨花，会在水源充沛的绿洲附近安家。
author: sk372
source: Spotting a POKENAME in the desert is a good sign for weary travelers: since it needs plenty of fresh water to nourish its large flower, it makes its home close to oases where water would be plentiful.

entry: POKENAME自视为族群首领，会挑战认定的竞争者，证明力量。腰间花瓣的大小与颜色，象征每只个体的实力。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME see themselves as leaders of their groups and will challenge those it sees as competition to prove their strength. The size and colors of the flower petals around their waist are symbols of each POKENAME's strength.

entry: POKENAME通过头周围垂落的花状结构收集能量，获得行动所需的力量与速度。因此，它总在移动，寻找大片向阳地带，训练与休息。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME gather energy through the floral pattern that surrounds and hangs off of its head. This energy gives POKENAME the strength and speed it needs to move around, so it is always moving, searching for large sunny areas to train and rest.

entry: POKENAME每次战斗，都会将带刺藤蔓缠在双拳上。它把藤蔓当鞭子与套索，将善于闪避的敌人拉近，再以极强的踢击攻击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME keeps a set of thorny vines wrapped around its fists any time it enters combat. It uses them as whips and lassos to reel in evasive opponents before striking them with massively powerful kicks.

entry: POKENAME比其他森林守护者小，但头上花朵伸出的强劲藤蔓，能轻松制服比自己大的宝可梦。不战斗时，它们会与森林里的其他宝可梦玩耍。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are small compared to other forest guardians but the powerful vines that emerge from the flower on their head easily subdue Pokémon larger than themselves. When they are not fighting, they play with other forest Pokémon.

entry: 玩耍泥浆中的养分，让POKENAME颊边的花长大。为了撑住头部，后腿也变得更加硬挺。
author: shocktopus1717
source: The nutrients in the mud POKENAME plays in have enlarged its cheek flowers. Because of this, its hind legs have stiffened further to support its head.

entry: POKENAME十分以背上的花为傲。花越鲜艳，身体就越健康。它会花许多时间懒洋洋地晒太阳，帮助花生长。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME takes great pride in the flower on its back. The more vibrant the flower is, the healthier the POKENAME. It spends a great amount of time lounging in the sun to help the flower grow.

entry: POKENAME往往害羞，躲在密叶间，避免接触训练家。但若察觉路过的训练家怀有正面情绪，它们就会悄悄跟随，直到被发现。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME tend to be shy creatures and hide in thick foliage to avoid contact with Trainers. However, if they sense positive emotions from a wandering Trainer, they stalk that Trainer until they are noticed.

entry: POKENAME是立志赢得宝可梦才艺比赛的大姐姐们常见的伙伴。它们天生善于把握时机，旋身穿过舞台时，花瓣与叶片舒展，是优秀的表演者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are a common companion for Beauties intent on winning Pokémon talent contests. They have an innate sense of timing that makes them excellent performers, their petals and leaves flaring out as they pirouette across the stage.

entry: POKENAME能以超能力操纵周围植物，让开花的藤蔓破土而出，保护自己与其他生灵。巨花还能形成花粉与花瓣构成的厚重屏障。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's psychic powers let it manipulate the plant-life around it, growing flowery vines from the ground to protect itself and others. Its large flower can generate a thick protective barrier of pollen and flower petals as well.

entry: 这种POKENAME变种头上没有通常的巨花，光合作用能力因而受限。它必须晒更久的太阳，才能保持活力。
author: sk372
source: This variant of POKENAME lacks the typical enormous flower atop its head, hampering its photosynthesizing capabilities. It needs to spend a larger amount of time basking in sunlight to keep itself energized.

entry: POKENAME不断放出调节植物生长的能量。它们对人类相当友好，野生个体也常挑战训练家，寻找值得相伴的伙伴。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME constantly emits energy that regulates plant growth. POKENAME is quite friendly with humans, and wild POKENAME will frequently challenge Trainers in order to find worthwhile partners.

entry: POKENAME喜爱园艺，会与训练家一起花数小时，培育美丽花田。共情能力让它们能察觉哪朵花需要额外照顾与关注。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a love of gardening and will spend hours working alongside their Trainer to cultivate beautiful fields of flowers. Their empathic powers enable them to sense when a given flower needs extra care and attention.

entry: POKENAME与开花植物有共情联系，会被盛放之地吸引。它们以能力辅助战斗，挥出盘旋的花瓣，发动危险攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have an empathic link to flowering plants and are drawn to areas that are in full bloom. They use their powers to aid them in battle, wielding whirls of petal blossoms as dangerous attacks.

entry: POKENAME是丛林英勇的守护者，保护其他宝可梦免遭盗猎。叶状刀刃能切开盗猎者用来捕捉野生宝可梦的网。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are heroic protectors of the jungle that defend other Pokémon from poachers. Their leafy blades slice through nets poachers rely on to ensnare wild Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME叶状翅膀边长边枯的现象，常遭误解。这是身体的正常现象，训练家不应因此干预它的活动。
author: oreee0230
source: The way POKENAME's leaf-like wings grow while withering is often misunderstood. This is a normal phenomenon of its body, and Trainers should not intervene in POKENAME's activities because of it.

entry: POKENAME的身体完全适应沙漠生活。背上的花模仿各种仙人掌，只在雨后开放，让它完美融入沙漠环境。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's body is fully adapted to desert life. The flowers on its back mimic various cacti and only bloom after rain, allowing it to perfectly blend into the desert environment.

entry: POKENAME与群体关系极其亲密，彼此依靠，共同防卫。它们最爱种子，会用隐藏的藤蔓状器官，或奋力跃起摘果，再吃掉里面的种子。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are extremely close to their colony and rely on each other for protection. Their preferred food is seeds, which they reach by using hidden vine-like organs or powerful leaps to pluck fruit and eat the seeds within.

entry: POKENAME花瓣与叶片的颜色会随环境改变。它们用长舌够取高树上的水果与树果，既能自己吃，也会替其他生灵取来。
author: infinex21
source: The colors of their petals and leaves change with their environments. POKENAME use their long tongues to reach fruits and berries on tall trees, be they for themselves or for others.

entry: 它藏在丛林藤蔓里，耐心等待。猎物毫无戒心地经过，便会被四只利爪撕碎。
author: busilisk
source: It camouflages itself in vines to remain hidden in jungle environments, where it waits patiently. Unsuspecting prey is torn apart by its four clawed limbs.

entry: POKENAME休息时会展开四肢与直立花瓣，吸收阳光。发达的大脑能精准算出最短路径，让它移动时始终完全处于阳光下。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME spreads its four limbs and vertical petals to absorb sunlight while resting. It can use its developed brains to accurately calculate how to move along the shortest path to stay completely under the sunlight.

entry: POKENAME的小花盆无法积存多少养分，因此必须频繁进食。它会造出花粉风暴，借此从周围植物与宝可梦身上吸取一切。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's small flowerpot cannot accumulate much nutrients, so it needs to eat frequently. It will create a pollen storm, using it to absorb everything from surrounding plants and Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME积聚了足够的阳光能量，触发局部进化；冬季阳光较弱，反而最常见到。它们仍保持完全进化宝可梦的自信与姿态。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are Pokémon that have gathered enough energy from sunlight to trigger a partial evolution, most commonly encountered during the winter due to the weaker sunlight. They maintain the confidence and posture of a fully evolved Pokémon.

entry: 融合能量将POKENAME与其体内休眠的遗传物质结合起来。如今，它背上的树已经深深扎根于POKENAME的神经系统。
author: zoroark73
source: Fusion energy has fused POKENAME with its dormant DNA. The tree on its back is now fully rooted in POKENAME's nervous system.

entry: POKENAME背上花朵的气味虽甜，汁液其实有毒。它总在四处走动，寻找阳光最充足的地方，让花吸收。
author: _._starry_._
source: Despite the sweet smell the flower on POKENAME's back gives off, its sap is actually poisonous. It spends its days walking around to find whichever spot has the most sunlight for its flower to absorb.

entry: POKENAME通常吃肉，偶尔也能见到它们拿树果当点心。利齿连最坚韧的外皮也能咬穿。
author: dodoowner_
source: Although POKENAME are usually carnivores, they can be seen snacking on berries every so often. Their sharp teeth can chomp through the toughest of skins.

entry: POKENAME靠叶片快速游泳，但没阳光时很容易累。它将背上硬壳伪装成栖在植物上的虫子，吓退自己游不过的捕食者。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME swims quickly using its leaves, but it tires easily when not in sunlight. POKENAME disguises the tough shell on its back as a bug perched on a plant, which discourages predators that it can't outrun.

entry: POKENAME头上花朵的中央，会在阳光下硬化到几乎无法破坏。战斗中，它一边从额头发射日光束，一边以不可阻挡的头锤逼近，连树也能撞倒。
author: foolish_weasel
source: The center of the flower on POKENAME's head hardens in sunlight to the point that it is nearly unbreakable. In battle it will fire a Solar Beam from its forehead as it closes in with an unstoppable Headbutt capable of knocking down trees.

entry: POKENAME背上的花完全盛放，会释放镇静花粉，制服有威胁的宝可梦，确保巢穴不受打扰。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a flower on its back that is in full bloom. It releases calming pollen to subdue threatening Pokémon, which ensures its nest is left unbothered.

entry: 如今仍活着的许多POKENAME，早在化石宝可梦所处的远古时代就已诞生。它们用极强的力量，守住隐秘洞穴。
author: veteranadventurer
source: Many POKENAME alive today were first born in the time of fossil Pokémon. They guard their hidden caves with extreme power.

entry: POKENAME巡视丛林遗迹，保护里面的宝藏。它们常遇到想探索危险遗迹的孩子，因此也肩负着护送孩子回家的任务。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME patrol jungle ruins to protect the treasure inside. They often encounter children who want to explore the dangerous ruins, so they are tasked with escorting children back home.

entry: 这种暴躁的宝可梦在岛屿附近休息，会以巨大的太阳能光束蒸发入侵者。想找地方停靠或降落的水手与飞行员，都把它视为凶狠又碍事的拦路者。
author: ecstaticwoop64556455
source: This bad-tempered Pokémon rests near islands, and will evaporate those who enter its territory with massive beams of solar energy. This makes it a vicious and inconvenient roadblock to sailors and pilots alike looking for somewhere to land.

entry: POKENAME能从躯干上的植物长出最多一千条藤蔓，自我防卫。它住在葱郁森林深处，周围都是寻求保护的植物与草属性宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: From within the plant on its torso, POKENAME can sprout up to a thousand vines to defend itself. It resides deep within verdant forests, surrounded by plant life and Grass-type Pokémon that seek its protection.

entry: POKENAME花环产生的花粉，会被收集制药，减轻偏头痛的影响。花粉的质量，取决于采集时它的健康程度。
author: chibitales
source: The pollen produced by POKENAME's flower ring is collected and used to help make medications that lessen the effects of migraines. The quality of the pollen collected depends on how healthy POKENAME is when collected.

entry: POKENAME几乎完美融入丛林枝叶，野外极难找到。训练家若成功收服，就会发现它是格外亲切的伙伴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME blend in nearly perfectly with jungle foliage, making them extremely difficult to find in the wild. If a Trainer succeeds in capturing one they will find that they make for exceptionally amiable companions.

entry: POKENAME晒够太阳后，可能会精力过剩，以惊人速度冲过森林。它们此时顾不上庞大体形，经过之处常留下一路折断的枝条与灌木。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can become hyperactive after spending long enough in the sun, rushing with a surprising speed through the forest. They are not mindful of their bulk when doing so and often leave a trail of smashed branches and bushes in their wake.

entry: POKENAME背上生长着各式植物，野外研究者很想找到它们，借此了解当地植物。在热带，它们背着巨大鲜艳的花，吸引多种虫属性宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME support a wide variety of plants on their backs and are sought after by field researchers to get a good sense of the local flora. In tropical regions, POKENAME carry giant, vibrant flowers that draw a variety of Bug-Type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME背上生长着各式植物，野外研究者很想找到它们，借此了解当地植物。在小岛，背上植物种类很少，往往只有一株开花的苏铁。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME support a wide variety of plants on their backs and are sought after by field researchers to get a good sense of the local flora. On small islands they have very low floral diversity, often carrying just a single flowering cycad.

entry: POKENAME背上生长着各式植物，野外研究者很想找到它们，借此了解当地植物。在密林，它们背着多种灌木丛，使自己格外难寻。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME support a wide variety of plants on their backs and are sought after by field researchers to get a good sense of the local flora. In dense jungles they carry a variety of shrubs and bushes that make them especially hard to find.

entry: POKENAME背上生长着各式植物，野外研究者很想找到它们，借此了解当地植物。在温带，它们背着受树木保护的各色花朵，对传粉生物十分重要。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME support a wide variety of plants on their backs and are sought after by field researchers to get a good sense of the local flora. In temperate regions they carry a variety of flowers protected by trees and are important for pollinators.

entry: POKENAME背上生长着各式植物，野外研究者很想找到它们，借此了解当地植物。在某些乡村聚落，它们被训练饲养，为居民稳定提供水果。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME support a wide variety of plants on their backs and are sought after by field researchers to get a good sense of the local flora. In some rural settlements they are trained and kept as a reliable source of fruit for the community.

entry: POKENAME背上生长着各式植物，野外研究者很想找到它们，借此了解当地植物。在较暖地区，它们背着开花的树，会寻找光照良好的地方，帮助树木生长。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME support a wide variety of plants on their backs and are sought after by field researchers to get a good sense of the local flora. In warmer regions they will host flowering trees, searching for well lit areas to help them grow.

entry: POKENAME会趴在水里，既饮水，也自然吸收水分。高兴时，繁茂花朵的中央会喷出水，像小小的无害间歇泉。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME lay in water on their bellies, both drinking and ambiently absorbing it. When they are happy, water will shoot out from the centers of their lush flowers like small, harmless geysers.

entry: 妙蛙花的力量与控制欲，过度滋长了波皇子的自负。如今，POKENAME像暴君一般统治森林。
author: haypile
source: The prideful heart of Prinplup was overfed by the power and control of Venusaur. Now POKENAME acts as a tyrant lording over the forest.

entry: POKENAME颈部的花瓣不但能吸收阳光，还因坚韧而能充当柔软护甲。它通常独居，却很乐意帮助有需要的宝可梦。
author: oreee0230
source: The petals on POKENAME's neck can not only absorb sunlight but also serve as soft armor due to their toughness. Although POKENAME usually lives alone, it will gladly help to other Pokémon in need.

entry: POKENAME的花散发甜腻气味，身上常爬满虫类宝可梦。有时，鼻子会滴出蜂蜜般的物质。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME is often covered in bug Pokémon due to the sickly sweet scent of its flower. Sometimes a honey-like substance drips from its nose.

entry: POKENAME会在适合生长处扎根，长出独立分枝，收集养分。它体格极其强健，除了火，没有什么能逼它逃走。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME takes root in locations suitable for growth and collects nutrients through the development of individual offshoots. It has a very robust physique and nothing can force it to flee except fire.

entry: POKENAME的绝招，是以剑刃吸收充足阳光，再释放太阳之力，重击对手。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's ultimate move is absorbing enough sunlight through its blade to release and smite its opponent with the power of the sun.

entry: 传说这根权杖曾属于巫师，能号令植物。吸足阳光后，还能射出强劲的太阳能量。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This legendary scepter, said to have belonged to a wizard, can command plants and with enough absorbed sunlight, release a blast of solar energy.

entry: 吸收阳光后，POKENAME的刀刃会成为世上最锋利的刀刃之一。因此，白天的它十分可怕，夜里刀刃却会退成脆弱叶片。
author: h0bojoe
source: After absorbing sunlight, POKENAME's blades become some of the sharpest in the world. While this makes them menacing during the day, at night they diminish into frail leaves.

entry: POKENAME吸收的阳光越多，刀刃越强、颜色越鲜艳。大多数年长个体已长到一挥便能劈开整座山。
author: h0bojoe
source: The more sunlight it absorbs, the stronger and more vividly colorful its blade becomes. Most elder POKENAME have grown so much that they can cleave entire mountains in one swing.

entry: POKENAME已开始控制构成身体的金属，让它像藤蔓一样移动。刀状利爪会生长，仿佛原本就是自然的身体部位。
author: ocxin
source: It has begun to take control of the metal that makes up its body, moving it just like its vines. POKENAME's knife-like claws grow as if they're a natural part of its body.

entry: POKENAME出没于废弃建筑中草木最繁茂的地方，植物躯体与金属部件融为一体。它们聚集部下，高效搜刮领地里的物资。
author: ocxin
source: Found in the most overgrown parts of abandoned buildings, POKENAME blend their plant mass and metallic parts seamlessly. They surround themselves with subordinates to effectively scavenge through their territories.

entry: POKENAME摇动叶鬃，就会释放芬芳花粉，标记领地。若身体开始噼啪迸出火花，就表示心情很差，随时可能攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: By shaking its leafy mane, POKENAME releases a fragrant pollen used to mark its territory. If crackling sparks start to burst from its body, it means it's in a foul mood and could attack at any moment.

entry: POKENAME摇动叶鬃，就会释放芬芳花粉，标记领地。若身体开始噼啪迸出火花，就表示心情很差，随时可能攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: By shaking its leafy mane, POKENAME releases a fragrant pollen used to mark its territory. If crackling sparks start to burst from its body, it means it's in a foul mood and could attack at any moment.

entry: 背上的巨花吸收阳光时，会散发舒缓的香气。它身体坚硬，用铁角就能轻易击碎巨石。
author: hamperius
source: The huge flower on its back emits a soothing aroma when it absorbs sunlight. It has a rigid body and can shatter huge boulders with ease using its iron horns.

entry: POKENAME能用背上巨大的翼状花瓣飞行。它会从花瓣根部伸出藤蔓，抓住物体表面，帮助自己更平稳地降落。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is able to fly using the large wing-like flower petals on its back. It uses vines that extend from the petals' bases to grab onto surfaces and assist it in landing more smoothly.

entry: 这种宝可梦是丛林顶尖猎手，会在上空游弋，沐浴强烈阳光。若看见人类或宝可梦想伤害丛林，它就会降下，全力将其击败。
author: infinex21
source: This Pokémon is a jungle apex that roams the skies above to bathe in strong sunlight. If it witnesses any person or any Pokémon attempting to harm the jungle, it will descend and dispatch them with its full might.

entry: POKENAME从花中放出大团孢子云，掩盖踪迹。吸入孢子会产生幻觉与恶心，给它绝佳的攻击机会。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME release large clouds of spores from their flowers to hide their presence. Inhaling a POKENAME's spores will cause hallucinations and nausea, giving POKENAME the perfect chance to strike.

entry: POKENAME的花伞既能通过光合作用提供养分，也能在下雨时收集水分。
author: melodydelune
source: The floral parasol of POKENAME acts both as a source of nutrients when conducting photosynthesis and as a way to gather water during rain.

entry: POKENAME用身上的缎带，摘取原本够不着的枝头果实。花朵般的蝴蝶结香甜无比，能让方圆一百米内的人类与宝可梦都平静下来。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses the ribbons on its body to snatch fruit from branches it couldn't otherwise reach. Its floral bows give off a scent so sweet that it calms both humans and Pokémon within a hundred-meter radius of its location.

entry: POKENAME力量极强，一击就能粉碎巨石。建设工程常请它清理草木浓密、过度生长的地带。
author: mcnchsschl_69424
source: POKENAME is incredibly strong, able to pulverize a boulder in one hit. It is frequently tasked with clearing out thick, overgrown areas for construction projects.

entry: POKENAME会在水里散播各种水陆两生植物的种子。它改造了种子，使植物生长时能用根加速陆地风化，扩大海洋。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME scatters seeds of various amphibious plants in the water. These seeds are modified by it to accelerate terrestrial weathering with their roots as they grow, in order to expand the ocean.

entry: POKENAME通过感知荒林根系的振动，察觉森林中每一个生命与动作。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME can feel every organism and motion in its forest. It does so by feeling the vibrations of the roots within the wilderness.

entry: POKENAME扭曲光线与距离，滋养背上的巨花。研究显示，空间向内塌缩，会让它所住的森林变得异常密集。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME bends light and distance to nourish the massive flower on its back. Studies show that any forests it inhabits become unnaturally dense due to space collapsing inward.

entry: POKENAME会用藤蔓固定因地质活动而松动的地面。它稳定土地，保护珍爱的植物群，避免惨重损失。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME uses vines to secure the ground loosened by geological activity. It protects cherished plant populations from severe loss by stabilizing the ground.

entry: 它会侵入熟睡者的潜意识，偷走梦中所有阳光。这让它获得庞大力量，却给受害者留下漆黑的噩梦。
author: h0bojoe
source: It invades sleeping peoples' subconscious to steal all the sunlight from their dreams. This grants it substantial power while giving its victims pitch-black nightmares.

entry: POKENAME从尾巴释放大量花粉，让植物茁壮生长。POKENAME住过的地方，总覆盖着绚丽花草。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME emits large amounts of pollen from its tail that allow plants to flourish. Areas where POKENAME reside are blanketed in gorgeous flora.

entry: POKENAME体内的电力极强。掉下的叶片或花瓣，仍会带着麻人的电感，持续两天左右，直到电力消散。
author: pixlhoopa
source: The electricity that flows through POKENAME is overwhelmingly strong. If a leaf or petal falls off it, a numbing tingle remains on it for a couple of days until the power fades away.

entry: POKENAME的内核冰冷，靠太阳热量防止柔韧叶片与花瓣冻硬。任何比正午阳光更热的事物，都会熔化内核，引发阵阵抽痛，甚至昏厥。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME has an icy inner core. It uses solar heat to keep its supple fronds and flower petals from freezing stiff. Anything warmer than midday sun melts its core, causing throbbing aches and even fainting.

entry: POKENAME的花吸收阳光，散发诱人香气，引来其他宝可梦。它们会用藤蔓缠住较小的猎物。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's flowers absorb sunlight, emitting an alluring aroma that attracts other Pokémon toward them. They will use their vines to bind smaller prey.

entry: POKENAME无声飘过葱郁森林，模仿美丽的热带花朵，吸引毫无戒心的猎物。一靠近，它就从腹下释放冰冷毒雾，瞬间麻痹目标。
author: naivetotoro
source: POKENAME drifts silently through lush forests, mimicking a beautiful tropical flower to attract unsuspecting prey. Once the prey is close, it unleashes a chilling, toxic mist from its underbelly that instantly numbs its target.

entry: POKENAME住在林间空地，站在巨花中央，释放信息素吸引虫属性宝可梦。一有目标踏上花瓣，花朵便猛然合拢，给它送来一餐。
author: ghostslythe
source: Inhabitants of forest clearings, POKENAME stands in the middle of a giant flower, releasing pheromones to attract Bug types. When one steps onto the petals, the flower snaps shut, providing the Pokémon with a meal.

entry: POKENAME长出太多植物，连自己也不清楚孢子能调出哪些组合。每次攻击都会释放孢子，拿对手试验各种配方。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME grow so many plants that not even they are fully aware of all the possible combinations they can make with their spores. They release spores with every blow, testing out their concoctions on their opponents.

entry: POKENAME高速旋转花瓣，便能飞行。身上长出的藤蔓像感觉毛，提醒它们避开附近障碍。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME whir their petals rapidly to enable them to fly. The vines growing from their body act in a similar way to sensory hairs, alerting them to nearby obstacles to be avoided.

entry: 野生POKENAME总会照顾森林家园与花田。据说，它们体内蕴藏诅咒能量，只为报复伤害自然的对象才会释放。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME care for their forest homes and for fields of flowers without fail. They are said to contain a cursed energy within themselves that is loosed only in retaliation against those who harm nature.

entry: POKENAME周围的绿色等离子体，在阳光直射下会更亮。它能伸出等离子体细丝操纵物品或攻击敌人，也能从形成的花形顶部发出炫目光束。
author: .jerden
source: The green plasma that surrounds POKENAME glows brighter in direct sunlight. POKENAME can extend out tendrils of this plasma to manipulate objects or strike foes, as well as fire blinding beams from the top of the flower shape it forms.

entry: POKENAME外层内侧可见的生灵，与包裹它的胶状物质并非相互独立。头顶的冠其实起催化作用，让外层强效物质得以控制内部生灵的心智。
author: chaos_emblemx
source: The being seen inside the outer layer of a POKENAME is not independent of the jelly-like substance that coats it. The crown atop its head is actually a catalyst for the being to be mind-controlled by the potent substance that coats it.

entry: POKENAME有特殊的花，只在满月之夜开放。放出的孢子能使宝可梦睡着，让它与其他同类聚在一起，在月下起舞。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a special flower that only blooms on the night of the full moon. The spores that are released cause Pokémon to fall asleep. This allows it to join together with other POKENAME to dance under the moonlight.

entry: POKENAME随夏日风暴翻滚而来，迁入热带，利用充足养分与明亮阳光。它们贪玩又亲昵，会与其他生灵分享柔软花瓣。
author: vic1312
source: Tumbling in on summer storms, POKENAME will migrate into tropical habitats where they can take advantage of the ample nutrients and bright sunlight. They are playful and affectionate Pokémon, and will share their soft flower petals with others.

entry: POKENAME全身生长各式植物，甚至足以用于攻防。极少数情况下，肢体上似乎会开出当今已不再出现的植物。
author: bobosmith01
source: All kinds of plants grow around POKENAME's body to the point it may use them for offensive and defensive purposes. Rarely, plants not found in modern times seem to blossom on its limbs.

entry: POKENAME用藤蔓与带电蛛网编织陷阱，防备潜在威胁。它的巢穴电弧交错，却又寂静诡异。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME weaves traps made of vines and electrified webbing to ward against potential threats. Its lair is characterized by arcing thunder and an eerie silence.

entry: 它取暖、吸收日光时，火焰会散出怡人香气，令交战的双方渐渐平静。
author: apixelperfectionist
source: As it warms itself and absorbs sunlight, its flame releases a pleasant fragrance. The fragrance becalms those engaged in battle.

entry: POKENAME性情害羞，靠阳光维持花朵生机。入夜便休眠，只留尾焰微光，滋养花朵。
author: imaginaryneon
source: POKENAME is a shy Pokémon that relies on sunlight to keep its flower alive. When night falls, it becomes dormant, sustaining its flower with the dim light from its flame.

entry: POKENAME融入枝叶，用花束甜香引来猎物。若有宝可梦落在花上，它就点燃一连串火焰，抽走对方的灵魂。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME blends in with foliage to lure in prey with the sweet scent of its bouquet. If another Pokémon lands on one of its flowers, POKENAME will ignite a series of flames to drain away their soul.

entry: POKENAME身后的植物能帮它储存大量水分与养分。它一生持续长大，记录中最小的身高也有5米。
author: oreee0230
source: The plant behind POKENAME helps it store a large amount of water and nutrients. POKENAME grows in size throughout its life, with the smallest recorded height being 5 meters.

entry: POKENAME飞向高空，尽情吸收阳光。日照不足时，则改吃鸟宝可梦。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME flies high into the sky to better absorb the sun's rays. On days where the sunlight isn't as strong, it feeds on bird Pokémon instead.

entry: POKENAME的叶翼吸收并储存大量阳光。它会飞到雨林最幽暗的深处，将储存的光倾洒在需要的植物上，让它们健康葱郁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's leafy wings absorb and store vast amounts of sunlight. It flies deep into the darkest parts of the rain-forests to cascade the stored light across plants that need it, helping keep the plant-life healthy and verdant.

entry: 它尽可能多地吸收太阳能，让全身美丽花朵更加鲜艳。花粉能改善空气质量，因此POKENAME深受敬重。
author: fiordaliso
source: It absorbs as much solar energy as possible to make the colors of the beautiful flowers that cover its coat more vivid. Its pollen improves air quality, which is why POKENAME is a highly respected creature.

entry: POKENAME是已完全融入当地生物圈的外星生物，会竭尽全力保护附近植物与宝可梦。但似乎不喜欢人类，宁愿和训练家保持距离。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME is an alien that has integrated thoroughly with the local biosphere, and it puts everything it has into defending nearby flora and Pokémon. It doesn't seem fond of humans, though, preferring space between itself and its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME头上的花每千年才开一次。三朵花绽放后，采下它们的人各能实现一个愿望。
author: oreee0230
source: The flowers on POKENAME's head bloom once every thousand years. After the three flowers bloom, the people who pick them can each have one wish granted.

entry: POKENAME身体寄生着各式开花植物。为了供给足够养分生长，它们被迫不断寻找块茎与植物根部。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have bodies that play host to a large variety of parasitic flowering plants. They are constantly forced to seek out tubers and plant roots to provide their bodies with enough nutrition to grow.

entry: POKENAME背上的花生长极快，需水极少。沙漠下雨时，整个群落都会开花，为沙漠染上缤纷色彩。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The flower on the back of POKENAME grows extremely quickly and requires very little water. When there is rain in the desert, POKENAME colonies bloom and fill the desert with colour.

entry: POKENAME在沙漠中长途跋涉，寻找绿洲饮水。一旦找到，只要水仍充足，就会留在附近，晒着花瓣般的翅膀，为下一次飞行恢复能量。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME travel great distances through the desert in search of oases to drink from. When they find one, they will stay nearby for as long as it remains full of water, sunning their petal-like wings to regain energy for their next flight.

entry: 经过多年搜寻，POKENAME已放弃寻找自己的宝藏。它们因美丽尾巴受到珍视，常被捕来，陈列在豪宅与餐馆。
author: smashbear
source: After years of searching, POKENAME have given up on finding their treasure. They are prized for their beautiful tails and are often captured to be displayed in fancy homes and restaurants.

entry: 它跃起时，花瓣有时像翅膀般拍动，仿佛想靠花飞行。或许正因飞不起来，它很容易烦躁，会用头撞击其他对象。
author: infinex21
source: The petals of its flower sometimes seem to flap when it leaps, as if it is trying to use its flower to fly. Potentially because this does not work, it is quickly agitated and will ram others with its head.

entry: 越接近进化，它每片甲壳的颜色就越鲜艳。进化时，甲片会像盛开的花一样展开。
author: infinex21
source: Each plate of its shell grows more vibrant as it nears its evolution. When it evolves, the plates of its shell will spread apart like a blooming flower.

entry: POKENAME有金属身体与润滑树汁，不易磨损，高温下却会失灵。体温过高时，它们就会故障，无法继续工作。
author: quackquackattack
source: While POKENAME are resistant to being worn down thanks to their metallic body and lubricating sap, they break down under high heat conditions. If their body temperature gets too high, they break down and are unable to continue working.

entry: 它背上的花长得格外巨大，尽可能吸收所有阳光。但也因此遮住其他植物，挡去了它们的日光。
author: soup1900
source: The flower on its back has grown extra large to soak up all the sunlight. This consequently causes it to shadow over other plants, blocking the sunlight for them.

entry: POKENAME比未融合的同类更活跃，比起吸收阳光，更喜欢捕猎。花朵会散发诱人香气，吸引虫属性宝可梦。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME are more active than its unfused counterparts and prefers to hunt for prey rather than absorb sunlight. Its flowers release an alluring fragrance, attracting Bug-type Pokémon.

entry: 融合能量改变了POKENAME的细胞生长，使身体出现许多能量渗出的脉络。无论吸收多少雨水与阳光，背上的花总带着古怪的人造气味。
author: soup1900
source: Fusion energy has mutated POKENAME's cell growth, causing it to gain many veins where the energy seeps through. No matter how much rain or sunshine it gathers, the flower on its back will always smell oddly synthetic.

entry: POKENAME神情骄傲。融合使脂肪组织增大，让它更像青蛙。
author: lupa
source: POKENAME has a proud expression. Pokémon fusion has enlarged its fatty tissue, making it more froglike.

entry: 它背上的花长得格外巨大，尽可能吸收所有阳光。但也因此遮住其他植物，挡去了它们的日光。
author: soup1900
source: The flower on its back has grown extra large to soak up all the sunlight. This consequently causes it to shadow over other plants, blocking the sunlight for them.

entry: POKENAME会从花中大量喷出花粉。吸入后会严重妨碍呼吸，并使全身起大片疹子。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME erupts numerous amounts of pollen from its flower. Breathing in this pollen causes severe choking and large rashes all over one's body.

entry: POKENAME虽个子矮，却因耳上的王冠常被称作丛林之王。香甜的叶片常吸引虫属性宝可梦，但对方若靠得太近，就会挨它一拳。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: Though it has a short stature, POKENAME is often known as the King of the Jungle due to the crown on its ear. POKENAME's sweet-smelling leaves often attract Bug-types, though it will punch them if they get too close.

entry: POKENAME的藤蔓与花粉不足以击倒其他宝可梦，因此常捡拾食物，而非狩猎。住在丛林的野生个体尤其如此，因为周围尽是虫属性宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often scavenge for food rather than hunt because their vines and pollen are not enough to take down other Pokémon. This is especially true for wild POKENAME who live in jungle environments, since they are surrounded by Bug-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME被能增强力量的树汁泡泡包住。它们放出精神波动，让附近植物迅速成熟，再控制粗重树根保护自己。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are enclosed in a bubble of sap that amplifies their powers. They release psychic vibrations that cause plants nearby to mature quickly, allowing them to control thick, heavy roots to protect themselves.

entry: 许多POKENAME能活过三十年，每年都从同一片土地吮吸花蜜、为花传粉。若最爱的花地因建设工程被翻毁，它们会困惑不已。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many POKENAME live upwards of thirty years. They siphon nectar and pollinate flowers from the same patches of land every year. They become incredibly confused if their favorite flower patches are torn up for construction projects.

entry: POKENAME头上的花十分巨大，能高效收集光线。年老个体常因花重而失去平衡、摔倒。
author: amphi64
source: The flower on POKENAME's head is very large, allowing it to capture light efficiently. Old POKENAME often lose their balance and fall due to its weight.

entry: POKENAME凭头上的花分析阳光，预测天气。许多豪华船只会雇用它，避开风暴。
author: amphi64
source: POKENAME can predict the weather by analyzing the sunlight thanks to the flower on their head. They are employed on many luxury boats to avoid storms.

entry: POKENAME从发电厂吸取电力，滋养背上巨花，有时甚至造成停电。它会从双颚分泌细黏丝网，标记领地。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME absorbs electricity from power plants to nourish the large flower on its back, even causing blackouts at times. It marks its territory by secreting a thin, sticky web from its jaws.

entry: 完全进化后，POKENAME背上的花会长到大餐盘般大小。花粉还能让所有人产生过敏反应。
author: bradlybro199
source: When fully evolved the flower on a POKENAME's back reaches the size of a large dinner plate. A POKENAME's flower also produces a pollen that elicits an allergic reaction in all people.

entry: POKENAME能从叶翼撒出引发异常症状的孢子，制服敌人。它们以尖牙咬入树干，直接喝树汁；据说，喝下的树汁能影响花朵的某些特征。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can scatter ailment-inducing spores from their leafy wings to subdue foes. They use their sharp fangs to bite into trees to directly drink the sap within. Supposedly, the sap they drink can affect aspects of their flowers.

entry: POKENAME把巨花当盾，既挡攻击，也遮直射阳光，因为敏感的眼睛受不了强光。它会钻入树中躲避捕食者，用花堵住入口。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME wields its large flower like a shield both from attacks and direct sunlight, the latter of which overpowers its sensitive eyes. It burrows into trees to hide from predators, blocking the entrance with the flower.

entry: POKENAME大多时间待在高草地，藏在自己的叶下，避开会飞的宝可梦。若仍遭攻击，就会用花心的毒刺自卫。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of its time in fields of tall grass, hiding beneath its own leaves to conceal it from flying Pokémon. If any do attack, POKENAME will use the poisonous spike in the center of its flower to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME移动时，每转一圈，蕨状叶片就会拍击地面。每次都会释放花粉，是花粉症患者的噩梦。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Every rotation POKENAME makes while moving causes its fern-like leaves to slap against the ground. This releases pollen every single time, making them a nightmare for hayfever sufferers.

entry: 它吃的肉越多，花就越饱满多汁。多次激战留下的腐臭，与花朵甜香混在一起。
author: ozydamians
source: The more meat it consumes, the more succulent its flower becomes. The rotten scent of its many intense battles mixes with the sweet aroma of its bloom.

entry: POKENAME在葱郁森林最深处缓缓行走。强大双颚能轻易拔树，清出空地，躺下打盹，吸收大量阳光维持生存。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lumbers around the deepest parts of lush forests. It uproots trees with ease thanks to its powerful jaws, clearing out open spots for it to lay down and nap while absorbing copious amounts of sunlight to sustain itself.

entry: POKENAME用短粗的小腿，承载头上巨花。它们从身体散发甜香，吸引虫属性宝可梦前来传粉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have stout little legs that carry the massive flower on their heads. They entice Bug-type Pokémon to pollinate their flower by releasing a sweet aroma from their body.

entry: POKENAME头上大花妨碍行动，因此长出叶片帮助稳定身体。这些叶片也能扇动花朵放出的孢子。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: Due to the sizable flower atop its head impairing mobility, POKENAME grows fronds that help with stabilization. In addition, these fronds are useful for fanning spores emitted by its flower.

entry: POKENAME的花有各种鲜艳颜色，最常见的是红色或黄色。沉重双腿让它比进化前跳得更慢。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME's flower comes in a variety of vibrant colors, though it is most often either red or yellow. Its heavy legs mean it dances slower than its previous evolutions.

entry: POKENAME大多时间都在阳光下欢快起舞，积聚能量。没阳光时，它会耗用能量造出假阳光，继续跳舞，直到无法维持才休息。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME spends most of its time dancing ecstatically in the sunlight and accumulating energy. When there is no sunlight, it uses its energy to create fake sunlight to continue dancing, resting only when it can no longer sustain it.

entry: 人们相信，POKENAME扇子散发的花香，能安抚最凶暴躁动的灵魂。阿罗拉的家庭常将用它甜甜香气制成的熏香，留在亲人墓前。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: It's believed that POKENAME can calm the most aggressive, restless spirits with a flowery aroma from its fans. Families in the Alola region often leave incense made from POKENAME's Sweet Scent on their loved one's grave.

entry: POKENAME吞食厨余与园艺废料，在胃内分解，制成堆肥。这些肥沃泥土让花朵开得明艳。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME devour kitchen and garden waste, breaking it down inside their stomach to produce compost. This rich soil enables their flowers to bloom brightly.

entry: POKENAME的厚鳍由软骨构成，能在游泳时保持身体直立。花瓣色的鳍也相当锋利，能轻易切过海带或其他鳍。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have thick fins made of cartilage that keep them upright while they are swimming. These petal-colored fins are also quite sharp and easily cut through kelp or other fins with ease.

entry: POKENAME的花瓣带有不致命的有毒花粉，会引发持久皮疹与尖锐刺痛。但花瓣也含有强效药用成分，甚至能帮助受伤植物愈合。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME petals are laced with a non-lethal, poisonous pollen that causes lasting rashes and sharp, albeit prickly, pain. Yet these petals also contain a potent medicinal compound, which can even help to heal wounded plants.

entry: 它喜欢住在热带森林深处，却大多待在开阔空地，展开叶片，多晒阳光。它会将藤蔓接到弱小植物的根上，分享多余养分。
author: infinex21
source: It prefers to live deep within tropical forests, though it spends most of its time in open clearings with its leaves spread to capture more sunlight. It will share its excess nutrients with weak plants by connecting its vines with their roots.

entry: POKENAME流出的黏稠树汁会被加入维生素制品，帮助人保持健康。虫属性宝可梦被头上的花吸引，留下舔食树汁。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME drool out a thick sap that is incorporated into vitamins to keep people healthy. Bug-type Pokémon are drawn in by the flower on their heads and stay to lick up the sap.

entry: POKENAME头上的巨花，兼具发射与接收超声波的器官功能。借助回声定位，它比其他草属性宝可梦更适应黑暗。
author: oreee0230
source: The large flower on POKENAME's head serves both as an organ for emitting and receiving ultrasonic waves. Through echolocation, POKENAME is better adapted to darkness than other Grass-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用真菌般材质的双翼高速飞行，散出的孢子，还能帮它进行某种回声定位。
author: canada
source: POKENAME uses its wings, which are made from a fungus-like material, to fly at high speeds. It uses the spores it spreads in a form of echolocation.

entry: POKENAME羽毛间的花拖慢飞行，因此更喜欢散步。草食宝可梦常误认它为灌木，但若咬上一口，就会被棉花般的质感吓一跳！
author: haypile
source: The flowers in POKENAME's plumage slow its flight, so it prefers to stroll. Herbivorous Pokémon often mistake it for shrubbery -- but if they try a bite, they'll be caught off guard by its cottony texture!

entry: POKENAME外表虽可怕，性情却平和。每天有18小时在阳光下睡觉，也允许小宝可梦在叶片间打盹。
author: shreks_stepfather
source: Despite its fearsome appearance, POKENAME has a calm disposition. It spends 18 hours a day asleep in the sun and allows small Pokémon to nap within its leaves.

entry: POKENAME臂上的花十分强大，承载大部分攻击能力。终有一天，花会包裹它的全身。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The flower on POKENAME's arm is very strong, housing most of its offensive capabilities. This flower will one day envelop all of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME需要训练家持续照料，包括经常运动、按时进食。若达不到这些高要求，平时宜人的香气就可能变得腐臭难闻。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME require consistent caretaking from their Trainers, including frequent exercise and regular meals. Failure to meet those high standards may lead to POKENAME's normally pleasant scent becoming rotten and odorous.

entry: POKENAME常在尽量吸收雨水、增强香气，与追寻阳光、培育植物之间来回切换。若不持续寻找这些资源，叶片与花就会开始枯萎。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME often swap between  absorbing all the rain they can to make their aromas stronger and hunting down sunshine to grow their flora more. If they don't chase down these resources constantly, their leaves and flowers start to wilt away.

entry: 所有POKENAME都有无法解释、持续不息的育幼本能，几乎会照顾遇见的任何无助宝可梦。甚至有好几例人类被它养大的事迹。
author: veechers
source: All POKENAME have an unexplainable incessant parental instinct, resulting in them taking care of almost any helpless Pokémon they find. There have even been several cases of humans that were raised by POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME以巨大花瓣护身，自封沼泽之王，还要求其他宝可梦进贡。
author: robosoup
source: POKENAME shields its body with massive flower petals. It fancies itself king of the swamp, and demands tribute from other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME用仙人掌身体上的花吸引虫类宝可梦。据说，长到足够大后，就能通过分裂繁殖。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME uses the flowers on its cactus body to attract bug Pokémon. It is said that when it becomes large enough, it can reproduce by splitting.

entry: POKENAME会将藤蔓接入根系，偷取其他植物的养分。扎根时，背上巨花会放出催眠其他宝可梦的孢子，保护自身。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME connect their vines with root systems to steal nutrients from other plants. To protect themselves while rooted, the giant flower on their back releases spores that put other Pokémon to sleep.

entry: POKENAME用花朵甜香吸引猎物。吸干猎物后，它会用剩下的骨头给花施肥。
author: mistycloud
source: POKENAME uses its flowers, which emit a sweet scent, to attract prey. After it has finished draining its prey, POKENAME uses the remaining bones to fertilize its flowers.

entry: POKENAME适应力极强，从苔原到海滨都能见到。它们通过帆吸收太阳能，增强力量，也使尾上的球茎变大。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are highly adaptable creatures, being found in both tundras and beachsides. They absorb solar energy through their sails to grow stronger, which also increases the size of the bulb on POKENAME's tails.

entry: POKENAME只让训练家触碰颈部茂密的叶片。它虽有锋利石牙，却更爱吃花与树果，而非捕食其他生灵。
author: fiordaliso
source: It only lets its Trainer touch the lush leaves around its neck. Despite its sharp stone teeth, POKENAME prefers a diet of flowers and berries over preying on other creatures.

entry: POKENAME与族群一同巡视丛林，确保没有盗猎者在守护的领地作乱。花朵留下一路香气，使同类在数公里外也能找到它。
author: fiordaliso
source: It roams the jungles with the rest of its pack to ensure that no poachers are causing trouble in the territory it protects. Its flowers release a fragrant trail that allows other POKENAME to locate it even from several kilometers away.

entry: 有说法认为，午夜林中的嚎叫，是POKENAME出巢追赶玷污森林的人类。背上巨花始终在收集庞大能量。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to certain beliefs, if howls are heard at midnight in the woods, it is POKENAME leaving its den to chase down humans who have defiled the forest it inhabits. The large flower growing on its back constantly gathers vast amounts of energy.

entry: POKENAME所住的丛林里，许多宝可梦都期待它的歌声。这些不同的宝可梦会放下分歧，不再互相争斗，共同保护遇见的它。
author: oreee0230
source: The jungle where POKENAME makes its home has many Pokémon waiting for its song. These different Pokémon come together to protect POKENAME they find, putting aside their differences as they no longer fight each other.

entry: POKENAME的花裙与发簪不断释放花粉，使周围充满密集的闪光云团。它们穿梭其间旋转，展现艺术般的美丽瞬间，可供相机捕捉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a flowery dress and head pin that constantly release pollen, filling the area around them with dense clouds of sparkles. By twirling through these clouds, they create artistic moments of beauty that can be captured by a camera.

entry: POKENAME夜间飞行时，背上的花会释放彩色孢子，让鲜艳植物绽放。长出的植物香气芬芳，闻到的生灵会陷入深沉香甜的睡眠。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME flies through the air at night, the flower on its back releases colorful spores that bloom vibrant plant-life. The resulting plants that grow have fragrant scents that put those that smell them into a deep and pleasant sleep.

entry: POKENAME磨牙时，头上的花会起伏，花瓣随之变色。不同色调，似乎对应它倾向释放的超能力种类。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME grinds its teeth, the flower on its head undulates and changes the color of its petals. The different hues appear to correspond to the type of psychic power it tends to unleash.

entry: POKENAME乍看健康，花上却寄生着侵害性强的真菌。真菌夺走本该供给它的养分，迫使它比平时吃得更多，弥补不足。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Though at first glance they appear healthy, POKENAME carry an aggressive fungus that parasitises their flowers. The fungus leeches the nutrients that would otherwise go to the Pokémon, forcing them to eat more than usual to make up the shortfall.

entry: POKENAME力量强大，却常被见到用菠萝造家，再带着家一起沉入海里。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME, despite their intense power, are regularly seen making homes from pineapples. They then bring these homes down into the sea with them.

entry: 战前，POKENAME会跳舞，挥动尾上的花，恐吓对手。它通常独居丛林深处，主要吃树果与蕨类。
author: fiordaliso
source: Before battle, POKENAME dances while waving the flower on its tail to intimidate its opponent. This Pokémon tends to live a solitary life deep in the jungle, feeding mainly on berries and ferns.

entry: POKENAME的爪极其危险，锋锐得连实心岩石也能劈成两半。战前，它会让棕榈木护甲长出的花瓣颤动，散发足以震慑弱小宝可梦的气味。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's claws are incredibly dangerous, sharp enough to cleave even solid rock in two. Before battling, it makes the petals sprouting from its palm-wood armor tremble, releasing an aroma capable of intimidating weaker Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME若选择远离海滩生活，就不再用棕榈树皮包裹身体，以便在丛林更自由地活动。它坚毅迎敌，娴熟地运用剃刀般的利爪。
author: fiordaliso
source: When a POKENAME chooses to live far from the beach, it stops covering its body with palm bark to move more freely within the jungle. It faces its foes with great tenacity, making skilled use of its razor-sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME鲜艳的颜色并非只为好看，还能吸引虫类宝可梦作为猎物。战斗中，它收集大量阳光，使刀刃状双臂能量涌动，足以切开钢铁。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's extremely vibrant colors aren't just for show; they draw in bug Pokémon that it makes into its prey. In battle, it gathers huge amounts of sunlight to make its bladed arms surge with energy, allowing them to cut through steel.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在阳光下打盹，尽情吸收日光。受惊时，它们会放出有毒孢子云，希望吓退其他对象，免受打扰。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to soak up the sun's rays by napping in the light. When they are startled, they create a cloud of toxic spores hoping to discourage others from bothering them.

entry: POKENAME能将双手探入地面，从树根发力，掀翻整棵树。每当找不到可供晒太阳的地方，它们就会这么做。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME have the strength to flip entire trees, digging their hands into the ground and pulling from the roots. They do this whenever they can't find any sunlight to bask in.

entry: POKENAME会照料野生莴苣，借树枝集中超能力，赶走害虫。植物在照料下茁壮生长，它也会用神秘力量驱赶任何闯入者。
author: ghostslythe
source: Found nurturing wild lettuce, POKENAME focuses its psychic powers through a branch, keeping pests away. The plants flourish under its care, and it drives away any interlopers with its mystic powers.

entry: POKENAME将磨利的叶片当手里剑，对付敌人。外形有助于它藏在密林中。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME uses sharpened leaves as shuriken against foes. The appearance of POKENAME helps it hide in dense forests.

entry: POKENAME喷出的烟气像坦克臭鼬的气味，吸入后会饥饿不堪。烟中的化学物质能残留数年。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The fumes POKENAME emits smell like Skuntank and make those who inhale it very hungry. The chemicals in its smoke can linger for years.

entry: POKENAME虽友善，却不知道自己拍翼时会散出多少花粉。这些花粉，能引发严重过敏。
author: thekrt
source: Though friendly, POKENAME are unaware of the amount of pollen released as they flutter their wings. Their pollen can cause intense allergic reactions.

entry: POKENAME的花蜜极甜，很容易填饱肚子。大针蜂用它的花蜜酿成的蜜，是美味甜点。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's nectar is extremely sweet and easily fills stomachs. Honey made by Beedrill using its nectar is a delicious dessert.

entry: POKENAME的坚韧叶片能抵御多种威胁，遇火时还能迅速脱落，争取时间。野外脱下的叶，会成为许多小宝可梦的食物。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's tough leaves can protect it from various threats, and they can quickly fall off to buy time when it is met with flames. The leaves that POKENAME sheds become food for many small Pokémon in the wild.

entry: 野生POKENAME往往吵闹顽皮，四处漂浮，撞击物品，试图玩耍。训练后，它们却会忠诚到底。
author: roundabout_robin
source: Wild POKENAME tend to be rambunctious, floating around and slamming into objects in an attempt to play. Once trained, however, they become fiercely loyal to the end.

entry: POKENAME大部分植物般的身体都藏在土下。随着年龄增长，根会在地下延伸到极远处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME keeps most of its plantlike body hidden beneath the soil. As it ages, its roots spread vast distances underground.

entry: 据说，POKENAME鲜艳的花瓣是世上最美的景色之一。浓烈香气会吸引人类与宝可梦前来欣赏。
author: t3isukone
source: The vibrant petals of a POKENAME are said to be one of the loveliest sights in the world. They give off an intense fragrance that draws in people and Pokémon to admire them.

entry: POKENAME休息时很容易被误认成苏铁，因为始终露在地上的只有花。等这朵“花”开始在泥土中移动，才明显看出它其实是宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are easily mistaken for cycads when they're at rest as only their flower is constantly above ground. It becomes far clearer that they're actually Pokémon once the presumed flower begins moving around through the dirt.

entry: POKENAME想知道哪里有水时，会把头探出地面，展开平时保护着的叶。叶片对空气湿度敏感，能帮它找水喝。
author: katieplaysgames
source: When POKENAME want to get an idea of where to find water, they will poke their heads out of the ground and unfold the leaves they usually keep safe. Their leaves are sensitive to moisture in the air, letting them figure out where to get a drink.

entry: POKENAME在地下休息时，会用根状双腿缠住棕榈树根。这样不用露面，就能抽取养分。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wraps its rootlike legs around palm tree roots while resting underground. This allows it to siphon nutrients without surfacing.

entry: POKENAME能从头顶硬币释放集中的阳光能量，清除过密草木与枯树，确保孩子成长的森林安全。
author: alextheperson
source: Capable of releasing focused blasts of sunlight from the coin on its head, POKENAME clears overgrown underbrush and dead trees, ensuring the forests where its children grow up are safe.

entry: POKENAME爱慕虚荣，尤其在意自己的花。它极其挑食，只肯吃养分十分丰富的食物，让花保持鲜艳。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME is a vain Pokémon, especially when it comes to its flower. It is an incredibly picky eater and will only consume very nutrient-rich foods to keep its flower vibrant.

entry: POKENAME通过头上的花，与植物心灵交流。由于植物讯息大量涌来，它常要花很久缓解头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME communicates telepathically with plants through the flower on its head. It spends a lot of time recovering from headaches because it is flooded with messages from vegetation.

entry: POKENAME通过背上的花，以心灵感应将想法传给植物。由于周围植物的讯息大量涌来，它常要花很久缓解偏头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME telepathically transfers their thoughts to plants through the flower on its back. It spends lots of time recovering from migraines because it is flooded with messages from plants around them.

entry: POKENAME带着一面大鼓，游泳时会用蹼手敲打。遇到其他擅长音乐的宝可梦，它们就会合作，编出很酷的节拍。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME carry a large drum with them that they play with their webbed hands while swimming. When they meet other musical Pokémon, they work together with others to come up with a cool beat.

entry: POKENAME会故意吃有毒植物，以疼痛锻炼身心。它是重视荣誉的战士，会帮助无法自保的生灵。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME deliberately consumes poisonous plants to train its body and mind through pain. It is an honorable warrior who helps those who cannot defend themselves.

entry: POKENAME借身上垂下的藤蔓，在所住的林木间移动得更快。它脾气极其暴躁，会找每个挡路的对象打架。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses the vines hanging from its body to move even more swiftly among the forest trees where it lives. It has a very irritable temperament, which leads it to pick fights with anyone who crosses its path.

entry: POKENAME的毛发覆着植物。每次肌肉拉伤，撕裂处都会由植物组织替代，增强力量；年长个体尤其常见。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's fur is covered in plants. Whenever it pulls a muscle, the tear is replaced with plant matter for added strength. This is particularly common among older POKENAME.

entry: 它们的毛像苔藓，暴怒时会稍稍变硬，颜色更加鲜艳。肌肉强劲得能把最多自身体形三倍的大树连根拔起。
author: infinex21
source: Their fur is like moss that becomes a bit rigid and more vividly colored when they fly into a rage. Their muscles are strong enough to lift a tree up to thrice their size from the ground, roots and all.

entry: POKENAME兴奋时，会摇动后方的花，无意间释放花粉云。花会随饮食变色，因此它常参加评选独特毛色与花色组合的比赛。
author: pjporwoll
source: When POKENAME gets excited, it wags the flower on its rear, inadvertently releasing clouds of pollen. The flower changes color with POKENAME's diet, so this Pokémon is often entered in competitions judging their unique fur and flower combinations.

entry: POKENAME需要定期修整花瓣，以免长得太长，挡住视线。野生个体可能因看不清而跑开，必须依靠同伴的吠声指路。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME need regular maintenance of their petals to ensure they don't grow too long and block their vision. Wild POKENAME may run away because of their obscured vision, having to rely on the sound of their packmates' barks to guide them.

entry: POKENAME极其忠诚，在热带守护各种宝可梦群体。想打盹时，它会让附近植物长成格外舒服的床，蜷在里面，为花补充能量。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is fiercely loyal and guards various Pokémon herds in tropical climates. When it wants to take a nap, it influences nearby plants to grow into a particularly comfortable bed, where it curls up and reenergizes its flower.

entry: POKENAME极其忠诚，在热带守护各种宝可梦群体。想打盹时，它会让附近植物长成格外舒服的床，蜷在里面，为花补充能量。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is fiercely loyal and guards various Pokémon herds in tropical climates. When it wants to take a nap, it influences nearby plants to grow into a particularly comfortable bed, where it curls up and reenergizes its flower.

entry: POKENAME极其忠诚，在热带守护各种宝可梦群体。想打盹时，它会让附近植物长成格外舒服的床，蜷在里面，为花补充能量。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is fiercely loyal and guards various Pokémon herds in tropical climates. When it wants to take a nap, it influences nearby plants to grow into a particularly comfortable bed, where it curls up and reenergizes its flower.

entry: POKENAME用吸盘将自己固定在浅水流中，叶状尾巴浮在水面。皮肤坚韧有弹性，受击时会放松，将身体弹离危险。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME uses its suction cups to anchor itself down in shallow water currents, with its leaf-shaped tail floating on the surface. Its skin is tough and elastic that relaxes when struck to propel itself away from danger.

entry: POKENAME喜欢懒洋洋地待在葱郁沼泽的水边，叶状尾巴平铺水面。它们一跃虽能超过十四英尺，遇险时却通常选择退入水下。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME lounge near the waters within lush swamps, with their leafy tails lying atop the water. Though they can leap over fourteen feet in a single bound, they will typically opt to retreat underwater when threatened.

entry: POKENAME身上的油状物遇水后会变黏，像树脂一样。它喜欢长时间待在水里，因此偏爱有树的地方，好刮去这些黏“油”。
author: infinex21
source: The oily substance covering its body becomes sticky when mixed with water and becomes like tree resin as well. Because POKENAME prefers to spend much of its time in water, it favors areas with trees where it may scrape off this sticky "oil".

entry: POKENAME游泳时，背叶能按需展开，精准控制动作，也能折起，减少阻力。木拳能打碎岩石与其他飞来物，让它一路挥拳突破危险。
author: oreee0230
source: When POKENAME swims, the leaves on its back can be opened as needed for precise swimming or folded to reduce resistance. Its wooden fists can break rocks and other projectiles, allowing it to punch through danger.

entry: POKENAME借瞬间移动，在远离危险、阳光最充足的地方晒太阳。但常把欣赏花朵的人误认成潜在敌人。
author: redlilycat
source: POKENAME uses its teleport ability to bask in the sunniest spots away from danger. It often mistakes admirers of its flower for potential foes.

entry: POKENAME将阳光转为超能力，为身体供能。它已不再需要睡觉，便四处瞬间移动，修剪花园植物，释放精神能量。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME converts sunlight into psychic power to fuel its body. Because it no longer needs to sleep, it teleports around to trim plants in gardens and release psychic energy.

entry: 有人观察到，POKENAME会摘下尾上的花瓣，查看斑点图案。它们用这些图案判断近期的未来。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME have been observed plucking petals from their tails and observing the spotted patterns on them. They use these patterns to determine the near future.

entry: 据说POKENAME走遍故乡的农场，以强大超能力催生庄稼，让花朵绽放。
author: cipher
source: It is said POKENAME travels to farms across its homeland, using its immense psychic energy to make crops grow and flowers blossom.

entry: POKENAME悉心培育伞状树，几乎不让树离开身边。它喜欢一边晒太阳，一边和人类或其他高智慧宝可梦聊天。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME's umbrella-shaped tree is grown with utmost care and rarely leaves its side. POKENAME enjoys basking in the sunlight to chat with people or other highly intelligent Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME会找阳光最足的地方，花数小时伸展身体、绷紧肌肉。看似在炫耀肌肉，其实是在吸光获取能量，继续锻炼。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME search for locations with the most sunlight and will spends hours stretching and flexing in the sunniest spot. While it might seem like they are flaunting their muscles, they are actually absorbing light for energy to continue exercising.

entry: POKENAME会主动寻找切磋对手。只有面对熟知的敌人，或反击来自背后的突袭时，它才会使用木质手臂。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME actively seeks out sparring partners to battle. It only uses its wooden arms when facing well-known opponents or when countering a surprise attack from behind.

entry: POKENAME通常迁往热带，方便吸收太阳能。它们力量虽强，性情却往往随和，喜欢与人类一起悠闲活动。
author: wickedwiccan
source: POKENAME typically migrate to tropical areas, where they can easily absorb solar energy. Despite their immense strength, POKENAME tend to be more easygoing and enjoy leisurely activities alongside humans.

entry: POKENAME用根紧攀树木，抽取宿主养分。它们放出使其他对象困倦的花粉，避免别的宝可梦撕断根部。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME cling to trees with their roots to leech nutrients from their host. They release pollen that makes others drowsy to prevent other Pokémon from ripping apart their roots.

entry: POKENAME天生的火焰能力很弱，必须吃木柴，才能维持火力。森林地面上的幼树，会被它整棵吞下。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its innate fire abilities are quite weak. To retain its firepower, POKENAME must eat firewood. It swallows entire saplings on the forest floor.

entry: 这些湖居宝可梦用花的甜香引来鸟宝可梦。它们虽能靠光合作用活着，取食众多藤蔓状触手捕到的猎物，才能长得更好。
author: infinex21
source: These lake-dwelling Pokémon release a sweet aroma from their flowers to lure bird Pokémon to them. Though they can survive through photosynthesis, they thrive by feeding on the prey they ensnare with their many vine-like tentacles.

entry: POKENAME凶猛守护丛林，会攻击任何破坏环境的对象。想砍树的伐木工，会被疾飞的叶片与岩石逼退。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are fierce defenders of jungle forests and attack anyone who tries to damage the environment. A flurry of leaves and rocks act as a deterrent for loggers who want to chop down trees.

entry: POKENAME性情好斗，会热切保卫丛林领地。它们常向想砍树的伐木工投泥，再用粗藤鞭打。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are hostile creatures that defend their jungle territory with fervor. They often attack loggers who try to chop down trees by tossing mud and whipping them with thick vines.

entry: POKENAME是尽忠职守的丛林守护者，身披藤蔓与苔藓，将一部分家园带在身上。一察觉丛林受损，就会引发猛烈震动，滚向事发处。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are devoted jungle guardians and cover themselves with vines and moss to keep a part of their home with them. They cause violent tremors whenever they sense harm to the jungle and roll to wherever the damage happened.

entry: POKENAME滚过丛林，确保领地里的树安全。想砍树的伐木工，会被粗藤困在原地，脚下大地也开始震动。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME roll through the jungle to ensure that the trees within their territory remain safe. Lumberjacks who try to chop down a tree are locked in place with thick vines as the ground beneath them quakes.

entry: 它全速冲过草原时，会从背上巨花散播花粉，使经过的土地格外肥沃。发怒时，蹄子能变得赤红滚烫，灼伤任何愚蠢到胆敢靠近的对象。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it sprints across the prairie at full speed, it scatters pollen from the large flower on its back, making the land it passes over exceptionally fertile. If angered, its hooves can grow red-hot, scorching anyone foolish enough to approach.

entry: POKENAME最快可达每小时150英里。奔驰时，燃烧的花朵会在身后留下浓重烟味。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: As it reaches speeds of up to 150 mph, POKENAME leaves behind a strong smokey scent, released from its combustive flower.

entry: POKENAME最爱整天懒洋洋地晒太阳，吸收养分。比起用尾巴钓鱼，它更愿意进行光合作用。
author: opossiblymage
source: POKENAME enjoys nothing more than to lounge in the sun all day, soaking up nutrients. It would much rather photosynthesize than go fishing with its tail.

entry: POKENAME很少脱离久坐不动的状态。但气温升高，就会躁动、过于活跃。受刺激时，花苞会迅速释放孢子，引发一英里范围内的过敏反应。
author: krogens
source: POKENAME are rarely stirred from their sedentary state. When temperatures rise, however, they become agitated and overactive. When stimulated, they rapidly release spores from their flowering buds that cause allergic reactions within a mile's radius.

entry: POKENAME那条长满叶片的长尾，年纪越大就越美味。它在热带晒太阳，促进光合作用。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's long, leafy tail tastes better the longer the Pokémon has lived. It sunbathes in tropical areas to promote photosynthesis.

entry: POKENAME给尾上的木壳提供水与庇护，换取养分。遇险时，壳会猛然夹紧，释放一阵毒素与精神能量。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME provides water and shelter to the wooden shell on its tail in exchange for nutrients. When they encounter danger, the shell clamps down to give a burst of toxins and psychic energy.

entry: POKENAME调整叶细胞方向，改变并屏蔽磁力。它积极争夺电力与阳光，是所在生态位中最强的生灵之一。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME changes and shields its magnetism by adjusting the orientation of its leaf cells. It actively competes for electricity and sunlight, making it one of the strongest in its ecological niche.

entry: POKENAME上方的球体牺牲了视觉与磁力能力，换取高效吸光。另两颗有视力的球体十分活跃，确保周围安全。
author: oreee0230
source: The sphere above POKENAME has sacrificed visual and magnetic abilities in exchange for efficient light absorption. Its two sighted spheres are very active to ensure the surrounding safety.

entry: POKENAME有奇特能力，能让周围植物导电。它发出的电脉冲能沿植物根部传递，触及数公里外的宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a bizarre power that allows plants around them to conduct electricity. By travelling through plant roots, the electrical pulse they shoot out can reach a Pokémon several kilometers away.

entry: POKENAME坚定而机敏，翼中握着树茎。它保护训练家与关爱的宝可梦，十分愿意挺身挡下危险。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are stalwart and cunning, holding a tree stalk in their wings. POKENAME are protective of their Trainer and other Pokémon they care about, and more than willing to jump in harm's way.

entry: 它们的叶状羽毛间布满种子，奔跑时四处散播。花瓣与“王冠”最鲜艳的那颗头，拥有主导权。
author: infinex21
source: Their leafy plumages are rife with seeds that scatter when they run. The head with the most vibrant petals and "crown" is the one in charge.

entry: 它的大叶片能充当翅膀，帮助飞行。奔跑时，周围会撒落无数花粉与种子。只靠阳光便能生存，让它可以整天跑动后再休息。
author: infinex21
source: Its large leaves can function as wings to help it fly. When it runs, it scatters myriad pollen and seeds around. It can subsist on sunlight alone, allowing it to run all day before resting.

entry: POKENAME在热带海滩悠闲躺着，将尾巴高高举起，尽量多晒阳光。陆地上笨重，水中却优雅，游泳时叶片在身后翻动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lounge on tropical beaches, raising their tails high in the air to catch as much sunlight as possible. They are cumbersome on land but graceful in the water, their fronds billowing behind them as they swim.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，尾花浮在水面，身体“悬挂”水下。叶鳍结实，既能耐受冰冷水域，也能推动身体快速游泳。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME sleep "hanging" underwater with their buoyant tail flowers floating on the surface. Their leafy fins are robust enough to survive in frigid waters and for POKENAME to propel themselves through water at considerable speeds.

entry: POKENAME常躺在热带海滩，享受阳光与温暖。陆地动作笨拙，回水里后却能以花瓣为鳍，优雅地快速穿行。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found lounging on tropical beaches, enjoying the sunlight and warmth to be found there. They are clumsy whilst moving on land but can use their petals as fins to dart gracefully through the water when they return to it.

entry: POKENAME常躺在热带海滩，享受阳光与温暖。陆地动作笨拙，回水里后却能以花瓣为鳍，优雅地快速穿行。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found lounging on tropical beaches, enjoying the sunlight and warmth to be found there. They are clumsy whilst moving on land but can use their petals as fins to dart gracefully through the water when they return to it.

entry: POKENAME背上的树状结构有时会变形，吸光能力却依然有效。恶臭也只有在阳光下，才能暂时减轻。
author: oreee0230
source: Although the tree-like structure on POKENAME's back sometimes loses its shape, its light-absorbing ability remains effective. POKENAME's foul-smelling odor is only temporarily alleviated in sunlight.

entry: POKENAME全身都是极其肥沃的堆肥。气味酸败难闻，只有最尽心的农夫才会请它帮忙。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME's bodies are made entirely of incredibly rich compost. They emit such a rancid scent that only the most dedicated farmers employ their help.

entry: 身上的植物在雨中长得更健康强壮。太阳一出来，便会射出强劲日光束，贯穿厚钢板。
author: soup1900
source: Its flora grows healthier and stronger during the rain. When the sun comes back up, it fires powerful Solar Beams that tear through thick steel.

entry: POKENAME会在水流中用藤蔓固定自己，追寻光照。有时，阳光吸收得太多，口中的沙会熔化，形成晶体与珍珠层层相嵌的结构。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME uses vines to anchor itself in the light-seeking currents. Sometimes, POKENAME absorbs so much sunlight that the sand in its mouth melts, producing a nested structure of crystals and pearls.

entry: POKENAME周身的孢子雾云，让它能控制附近植物。它们能强行让根与荆棘破土而出，自我防卫。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a misty cloud of spores around their bodies that allows them to control nearby plants. They can force roots and brambles to emerge from the ground to defend themselves.

entry: POKENAME潜伏丛林，试着伪装成植物。它能操纵当地草木，困住敌人与猎物。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME lurks in jungles, attempting to disguise itself as a plant. It has the ability to manipulate the local vegetation and will do so to immobilize enemies and prey.

entry: 这种宝可梦常见于丛林，以对旅人极具攻击性而闻名。
author: rolypolyrex123_46446
source: This Pokémon is commonly found in the jungle. It is known to be extremely aggressive towards travelers.

entry: POKENAME将尾巴深深钻入地下，接触水源，头与花却留在地面。它会缓缓转身，追随太阳的移动。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME digs its tail deep into the ground to reach sources of water, but keeps its head and flower above the surface. It slowly turns its body to track the movement of the sun.

entry: POKENAME能发射精准而强力的日光束，命中超过300码外的目标。壳里储存的太阳能，最多足以连发30次。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can shoot highly accurate and powerful Solar Beams, reaching targets over 300 yards away. It stores sun energy inside its shell, enough to unleash up to 30 Solar Beams.

entry: POKENAME长出金属护套，保护缩在壳内的藤蔓。它们能伸出藤蔓，自由控制动作，从安全距离攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME develop metallic sheaths that protect their vines from harm whilst they are retracted within their shells. They can extend their vines and control their movement as will, using them to attack from a safe distance.

entry: POKENAME长出金属护套，保护缩在壳内的藤蔓。它们能伸出藤蔓，自由控制动作，从安全距离攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME develop metallic sheaths that protect their vines from harm whilst they are retracted within their shells. They can extend their vines and control their movement as will, using them to attack from a safe distance.

entry: POKENAME的花蕊构成大口径炮管。它能从炮中射出太阳能或水流。
author: oreee0230
source: The stamens of POKENAME form a large-caliber cannon barrel. POKENAME can shoot solar energy or water jets from the cannon.

entry: POKENAME活泼有力，战斗中跳来跳去，绝不退缩。它们偏爱公平交战，但若对手试图攻击球茎，就会突然竖起刺毛，喷出毒液。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are energetic and sprightly, springing around during a fight and refusing to back down. While POKENAME prefer fair fights, if an opponent tries to strike at their bulbs, they will suddenly flare up their quills and spray out poison.

entry: POKENAME几乎只吃各种有毒植物的叶。正是这些毒素，让大多数鸟宝可梦不愿吃它。
author: _._starry_._
source: POKENAME's diet consists almost exclusively of leaves from various poisonous plants. That very poison makes it unpalatable to most bird Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME一觉得受到挑衅，就会猛烈爆炸，向受害者撒出毒刺。它们好斗、领地意识强，把任何靠近的人都视为威胁。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME violently explode when they feel provoked, showering their victims with venomous spines as they do. They are belligerent and territorial and view any approaching person as a threat.

entry: POKENAME每颗头里的液体都剧毒无比。若有外溢，千万别用裸露皮肤触碰，否则会头晕呕吐；靠近它相当危险。
author: .izik
source: The fluid in each of POKENAME's heads is extremely toxic. Should any spill out, it is unwise to touch it with bare skin, as it can cause dizziness and vomiting, making it a hazardous creature to approach.

entry: POKENAME长舌上的唾液强烈而酸蚀，连金属都能溶解，是战斗中的可怕武器。
author: .izik
source: The saliva on POKENAME's long tongue is incredibly potent and acidic. The acidity is so strong that it can dissolve metal, making its tongue a terrifying weapon in battle.

entry: POKENAME成群生活，轮流照顾幼崽，其余成员则去狩猎。若某只受袭，就会释放气味浓烈的化学物质，提醒整个族群。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME live in herds, each taking turns to look after their young while the others go hunting. If one of them is attacked, they will produce a strongly scented chemical that alerts the rest of the herd.

entry: POKENAME无法产卵，因此常偷其他宝可梦的蛋。腹袋里的蛋若破了或孵化，它就会不惜一切，再找来一颗。
author: pinkyoshi2350
source: As it is unable to lay eggs, POKENAME often steals them from other Pokémon. If the egg in its pouch breaks or hatches, POKENAME will stop at nothing to find another one.

entry: POKENAME的母性本能，会让它照顾附近的幼年毒属性宝可梦。风暴来临时，它会催促幼崽进洞避险，守护到风暴过去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's motherly instincts cause it to take care of young Poison-type Pokémon nearby. During storms, it will usher them into its den for safety, ensuring that they remain protected until the storm passes.

entry: 保护亲族时，POKENAME的刀刃会覆上一层浓厚蓝毒。这层毒液能增强伤害，逼退靠得太近的捕食者与其他威胁。
author: .izik
source: When defending its kin, a thick blue toxin coats POKENAME's blades. This venomous coating allows it to deal more damage, deterring any predators or threats that come too close.

entry: POKENAME会拍打胸膛，让尖刺迸出电火花，以此威吓。通常是为了保护自己喜爱的小宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME bangs on its chest to produce electric sparks from its spines. It uses the display as an intimidation tactic, typically done to protect smaller Pokémon it has grown fond of.

entry: POKENAME耳朵般的钳子极其锋利，一剪就能放倒松树。它会凭惊人力量取食，喝树干里的汁液。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's ear-like pincers are extremely sharp and can fell a pine tree in a single cut. It will do this to drink the sap inside, using its impressive strength to gather sustenance.

entry: POKENAME见不得小宝可梦受欺负，会跳出来保护。它虽弱得可怜，倒刺的毒却刚好能扰乱敌人，让自己与其他生灵溜走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME cannot help itself seeing small Pokémon being bullied, leaping to their defense. Though it is pitifully weak, the poison in its barbs is just enough to disorient a foe and let POKENAME and other creatures slip away.

entry: POKENAME有望成为族群的统治者，因此常优先吃到最好的食物。它们大吃喜爱的树果时，其他成员大多只能靠叶片维生。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME are potential rulers of their colonies and so are often fed first and best. While they gorge themselves on preferred berries, other members of their colonies mostly subsist on leaves.

entry: POKENAME平时温顺柔和，却会为生存不择手段，连奉承或故意在周围制造混乱也在所不惜。它的自然种群几乎不存在。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although typically POKENAME has a docile and gentle nature, it will do anything to survive, even through use of flattery or deliberately creating confusion and chaos in its surroundings. Its natural population is nearly nonexistent.

entry: POKENAME身上的黏稠液体，能模仿遇到的任何毒素，效果精准得令人不安。这种适应力，让它成为战斗中的强敌。
author: .izik
source: The viscous slime coating POKENAME's body has the ability to imitate any poison it encounters, mimicking the effects with unsettling accuracy. This adaptability makes it a formidable opponent in battle.
