entry: POKENAME通常温顺，毒刺收拢。基因组成不稳定，使它们很容易受到周围环境影响。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are typically docile and have their toxic barbs tucked away. They are easily influenced by their surroundings due to their unstable genetic makeup.

entry: POKENAME全身覆有看不见的毒素，接触者都会无法动弹。这种防卫机制，能让捕食者却步。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's body is coated with an invisible toxin, immobilizing any who come in contact with it. This defense mechanism deters predators.

entry: POKENAME在海底独来独往，除非看见大宝可梦欺负小个子。此时，它就会跳上大个子的背，用腹侧四只爪子注入毒液。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME keeps to itself at the ocean bottom unless it sees a larger Pokémon bullying a smaller one. In that case it leaps onto the larger one's back and injects poison into it with its four underside claws.

entry: 进化后，POKENAME身上的刺更尖、更坚韧，使它战斗时更有自信。它喜欢在勿花果树下休息，因为那是最爱的果实。
author: fiordaliso
source: Upon evolving, the spines on its body became sharper and tougher, giving POKENAME greater confidence in battle. It loves to rest beneath Figy Berry trees, since those are its favorite fruits.

entry: 其他宝可梦的陪伴能让POKENAME安心，它似乎喜欢照顾任何种类的幼崽。宝可梦培育园里，它常是好帮手。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME is comforted by the company of other Pokémon and seems to enjoy taking care of the young of any species. It is often a great help at Pokémon nurseries.

entry: 饲养POKENAME的人应避免吸入背部火焰放出的有毒气体。它十分胆小温顺，更喜欢躲着陌生人。
author: _._starry_._
source: It is recommended that owners of POKENAME avoid breathing the toxic gases that emit from the fire on its back. It is very timid and docile, and prefers hiding from strangers.

entry: POKENAME会煮沸体内毒液，产生能缓慢侵蚀金属的酸性烟雾。它对训练家通常友善，但非常不宜触碰。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME boils the toxic fluid inside of its body, producing an acidic smoke that can slowly eat through metal. While generally friendly to its Trainers, touching POKENAME is highly ill-advised.

entry: POKENAME在树顶休息，与其他波波一同啁啾。它们顺从、想照顾群体，因此有面包屑撒来时，总是最后才吃。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rest atop trees where they can be heard chirping alongside other Pidgey. They are submissive creatures that want to take care of their flock, so they eat last whenever there are breadcrumbs scattered for them.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时会来回倾斜，体内能听见液体晃荡，因为里面充满强效毒素。这些毒素能吓退想捕食它的对象，确保安睡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME tilts back and forth as it sleeps, and a sloshing inside its body can be heard, as it is filled with a potent poison. This toxin serves as a deterrent to any would-be predators, ensuring its safety during rest.

entry: POKENAME会展开双翼，显得比实际更大，保护巢穴。利爪尖端带有强毒，是领地强大的守卫。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME protects its nest by spreading its wings to look bigger than it is. Its talons are tipped with a strong venom, making it a formidable protector of its territory.

entry: POKENAME会在体内提炼所吃植物的毒素，融入皮肤与甲壳。不宜直接用皮肤接触，否则会起严重皮疹。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME refine the toxins from the plants they consume within their bodies, incorporating them into their skin and carapace. Direct skin contact is not recommended as it can result in a nasty rash.

entry: POKENAME鞘翅上的刺会滴出有毒液体，碰到就可能难受好几天。它们冷淡疏远，会严守领地与食物来源，防备闯入者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The spikes on the elytra of POKENAME drip a noxious toxin that can cause days of sickness if touched. They are standoffish and will jealously guard their territory and food sources against interlopers.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛锋利得惊人，尖端毒素能引发严重偏头痛。因此，尤其对靠近领地的对象而言，它是危险的对手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feathers are surprisingly sharp and are tipped with toxins that cause horrible migraines. These toxic tips make it a dangerous adversary, especially for those who try to approach its territory.

entry: POKENAME躁动时，无法留住体内电力。离群太久，毒刺就会竖起，希望威慑潜在威胁。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME cannot retain their electricity when agitated. Their venomous barbs stand up when they are separated from their packs for too long, in hopes of deterring threats.

entry: POKENAME听觉敏锐，数英里外钻地的虫属性宝可梦也能听见。它们总想吃虫，农夫便将其引到田里，充当天然除虫帮手。
author: ghostslythe
source: Gifted with a strong sense of hearing, POKENAME can hear burrowing Bug-types from miles away. Always hungry for bugs, Farmers attract them to their fields to serve as natural pest control.

entry: POKENAME住在干旱平原，观察其他野生生物。有时会突然扑向观察已久的宝可梦，使其染毒。确切原因未知，但被认为与预感有关。
author: ocxin
source: POKENAME live in arid plains, scoping out other wildlife. Sometimes, they suddenly lunge at Pokémon they have observed for a long time to poison them. The exact reason is unknown, but believed to be because of premonitions.

entry: POKENAME会摩擦毛发，在爪间产生火花与电流。它用积聚的电压，表演小小灯光秀，逗乐孩子与幼年宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rubs its own fur to generate sparks and electricity along its claws. It uses the voltage it gathers to make little light shows to entertain children and young Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME受威胁时，尾巴发亮，放出电磁波。来犯者及周围的人，都会被激起剧烈偏头痛。
author: teatedtiten
source: When POKENAME are threatened, their tail shines, releasing electromagnetic waves. This causes intense migraines in the aggressor as well as anyone in its proximity.

entry: POKENAME臂上石球滴下的毒液极甜。熬成膏后便会完全失去毒性，可用于糕点，给甜食增添独特风味。
author: .izik
source: The poison dripping from the stone spheres on POKENAME's arms is extremely sweet. If boiled down into a paste, it loses all toxicity and can be used on pastries, adding a unique flavor to treats.

entry: POKENAME喜欢待在运动场边，藏入场地四周的灌木。比赛开始就活跃起来，欢呼挥臂，支持喜爱的队伍；当己方劲敌上场时，尤其兴奋。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME love to line sports grounds, hiding amongst the shrubs lining the fields. They spring to life when games begin, cheering and waving their limbs in support of their favourites, growing especially active when their team's rivals are playing.

entry: POKENAME吃下的垃圾会改变体内毒素。它喜欢先让敌人中毒再逃，确保对方无法追来报复，自己便能自由拾食。
author: .izik
source: The garbage POKENAME consumes alters the toxins in its body. It prefers to poison its foe and then flee, ensuring they cannot follow and exact revenge while POKENAME remains free to scavenge.

entry: POKENAME相当温顺，会用尾巴从枝上钩果。若遭挑衅，尾上就会竖起三根刺，分泌毒液。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are quite docile, using their tails to snag fruit off of branches. If provoked, they will raise three spikes from their tails, which secrete a toxic venom.

entry: POKENAME身体的黏液碰到就会中毒，主要用来吓退捕食者。狩猎时，它会挖洞，躺在里面张大嘴，等猎物误闯。
author: .jerden
source: The slime that covers POKENAME's body is poisonous to touch, mostly functioning as a deterrent to predators. To hunt, POKENAME digs a burrow in the ground and then lies inside it with its mouth open, waiting for prey to blunder in.

entry: POKENAME的毒液强度随头顶月相改变。满月明亮时，它无惧任何敌人与危险。
author: fiordaliso
source: The potency of its venom shifts with the phase of the moon overhead. When the full moon shines bright, POKENAME fears no enemy or danger.

entry: POKENAME毛色越浅，毒性越强。它十分胆小，通常躲在肮脏小巷与下水道。
author: mistymagius
source: The paler POKENAME's fur is, the more powerful its venom is. It's a very timid Pokémon, usually hiding away in grungy alleyways and sewers.

entry: POKENAME成群出行，用覆毒的喙一同进攻。协调的袭击能压倒敌人，靠近这群好斗的鸟十分危险。
author: .izik
source: While traveling in a flock, POKENAME uses its poison-coated beak to attack in unison. This coordinated attack overwhelms foes, making it dangerous to approach a group of these aggressive birds.

entry: POKENAME使用浊雾时，体温会骤然升高。鲁莽接触的宝可梦，可能既中毒又烧伤。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME uses its Smog attack, its body temperature skyrockets. Any reckless Pokémon that gets in contact risks ending up both poisoned and burned.

entry: POKENAME通常温顺合群。受威胁时，它们会与族群合作，从壳内造出不透光的有毒气云，扰乱敌人，让其难以瞄准。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME is generally a docile, social Pokémon. When threatened, POKENAME will work with its pack to create a cloud of opaque, noxious gas from their shells, befuddling foes and making it difficult to aim.

entry: POKENAME羽毛上的油剧毒无比。吃球果时，谁想打断它，就会遭飞羽袭击，以毒油逼退入侵者，保住食物。
author: .izik
source: The oil on POKENAME's feathers is very toxic. It flings feathers at anyone who tries to interrupt it while it eats Apricorns, using the venomous oil to deter intruders and protect its meal.

entry: POKENAME在月见山山脚占有大片领地。它们对同类很凶，会高声啼叫、展开双翼大加威吓，试图把对手赶离家园。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME maintain large territories around the foothills of Mt. Moon. They are aggressive toward other POKENAME, squawking loudly and making large threat displays with their wings to try and scare their rivals away from their homes.

entry: POKENAME体内毒素积聚时，尾巴会快速作响。这是警告，驱赶靠近巢穴的捕食者，表明必要时已准备自卫。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tail rattles rapidly as the toxins in its body accumulate. The rattling is a warning to keep predators from its den, signaling that it is ready to defend itself if necessary.

entry: POKENAME全身倒刺会随年龄缓慢生长。滚动觅食、准备喂家人时，刺会紧贴身体两侧。象鼻在一英里外就能闻到气味。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's body is covered in barbs that slowly grow as it ages. These barbs are tucked close to its side as it rolls around looking for food to feed its family. Its trunk can pick up a scent from over a mile away.

entry: POKENAME是族群里最凶猛的成员，直接迎战捕食者，进化后的成员则保护幼崽。它肉质坚韧，必须用温泉水煮，才能去除毒素。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME are the most aggressive members of its herd, directly fighting off predators while evolved members protect the young. Its meat is tough and requires a method of boiling in hot spring water to cure it of toxins.

entry: POKENAME牺牲速度，换来强壮稳固的双腿。战斗时，它像跑酷般奋力踢击、快速跳跃。它几乎失去了产生孢子的能力，如今依靠尼多小子时期学到的严格训练。
author: kafoxnothylol_47795
source: POKENAME trades speed for strong and stable legs. It moves through battle with powerful kicks and fast jumps like parkour. POKENAME almost loses the ability to produce spores and now relies on the disciplined training it learned as a Nidorouge.

entry: POKENAME很容易找其他宝可梦打架，挥拳并奋力踢击。它们热情却缺乏技巧，攻击不够娴熟，还需要练习。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are quick to pick fights with other Pokémon, lashing out with punches and powerful kicks. They are enthusiastic but unskilled, their attacks lacking the finesse that comes with practice.

entry: POKENAME盘卷的身体布满尖刺与角，猎物一被缠住，就难以挣脱。毒牙浸满强效毒素，被咬的任何生灵都会发烧。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's coils are lined with sharp spines and horns that prevent captured prey from wriggling free once ensnared. Its fangs are saturated with a potent toxin that induces fever in any creature it bites.

entry: POKENAME会向潜在入侵者亮出毒牙，驱离洞穴。它们常结群生活、互相照顾幼崽，因此这项职责至关重要。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME keep other Pokémon away from their burrows by brandishing their venomous fangs at potential intruders. This role is a key part of their lives, as they often live in groups and take care of each other's offspring.

entry: POKENAME在洞里吃石头充饥。若吃下宝石，毒囊就会更快充满，毒性增强，也更加危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME eats stones in caves to satisfy its appetite. If it eats gems, its poison sacks fill more rapidly, enhancing the potency of its venom and making it even more dangerous.

entry: POKENAME平时虽温顺，面对打扰或威胁却会毫不犹豫地放电。碰到耳刺，还会被注入痛如电击的毒素。
author: _._starry_._
source: Although it is normally docile, POKENAME will not hesitate to shock those that bother or threaten it. If touched, the spikes on its ears will inflict a poison that is as painful as being electrocuted.

entry: POKENAME对家园中的小型森林生物，有强烈的育幼本能。若靠得太近，它就会吐出刺鼻、微毒的彩虹烟雾警告。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a strong parental instinct over the smaller forest creatures that roam its home. Drawing too close to them will cause POKENAME to breathe an acrid and mildly poisonous rainbow smoke as a warning.

entry: POKENAME耳上的刺有助于钻地。它以尖耳挖隧道，啃食树根，从脚下土壤获取养分。
author: .izik
source: The spikes on POKENAME's ears aid it in digging into the soil. It eats tree roots, using its sharp ears to tunnel and gather nourishment from the earth beneath it.

entry: POKENAME摄取植物毒素，隔离并高度浓缩，形成鲜艳的蓝色叶片。它虽有毒，却极其温顺，避免争端。
author: haypile
source: POKENAME gets its brilliant blue leaf coloration by sequestering and heavily concentrating poisons from the plants it grazes on. Despite its toxicity, it's incredibly docile and avoids disputes.

entry: POKENAME会用火热吐息软化固体食物，帮父母照顾兄弟姐妹。它虽天生有毒，却已被发现是出色的保姆与守护者。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: To help the parents take care of their siblings, POKENAME will opt to take solid foods and soften them using its fiery breath. Despite this Pokémon's innate toxic levels, POKENAME has been found to make a great babysitter and protector.

entry: 父母觅食时，POKENAME受托守护弟妹，始终警惕。任何威胁巢穴的宝可梦，都会遭到毫不停歇的毒性连击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Entrusted with the safety of their younger siblings, POKENAME remain vigilant while their parents forage. Any Pokémon that threatens the nest is met with a relentless flurry of poisonous strikes.

entry: 它会高高跃起、旋转，为其他宝可梦表演。但人类一出现，就会瞬间移动离开。有趣的是，它能以念力操纵液态毒物，却从未在野外被观察到。
author: bobosmith01
source: It performs great leaps and twirls as entertainment for other Pokémon. When humans appear, however, it teleports away. Interestingly, it is able to manipulate liquid poisons telekinetically, but this has never been observed in the wild.

entry: POKENAME背上长着充满毒液的刺毛，躁动时会绷紧竖起。平静时，刺毛伏平，也会变软。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have venom-filled quills on their backs that tense and stand on end when agitated. When calm, their quills lie flat and become softer.

entry: POKENAME吃巢边有毒植物，增强力量。它不喜欢争斗，会在巢旁吐毒，阻止捕食者靠近，尽可能避免冲突。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME eats poisonous vegetation near its nest to get stronger. It prefers not to fight, spitting poison near its nest to keep predators at bay and avoiding confrontation when possible.

entry: POKENAME受惊时，体表毒素会变色。这种防卫机制能依情况让它融入环境，或传达遇险信号。
author: .izik
source: The toxins coating POKENAME's body change color when it is scared. This color shift is a defense mechanism, allowing it to blend in or signal its distress, depending on the situation.

entry: 常能见到POKENAME在阳光下打盹。它不爱战斗，受袭时通常会用花释放镇静香气。
author: _._starry_._
source: POKENAME can often be found napping in the sun. It doesn't like to fight, so when attacked it usually reacts by producing calming aromas with its flower.

entry: POKENAME全身覆盖毒刺，危险靠近就会竖起。只需一滴毒素，就足以使人暂时麻痹。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's body is covered in toxic spikes, which they will raise when danger is near. Just one drop of this toxin is enough to temporarily paralyze a person.

entry: POKENAME的大耳最远能听见2英里外的声音。一听见所爱者遇险，就会勃然大怒，放下手头一切，冲去亲族身边。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME's massive ears can pick up sounds up to 2 miles away. When hearing loved ones in distress, POKENAME fly into a rage and drop everything they're doing to rush toward their kin.

entry: POKENAME似乎兼具尼多兰与尼多朗的特征。希望被视为雄性还是雌性，由它自己的偏好决定。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME seems to have traits from both genders of Nidoran. POKENAME's own preference determines whether it wants to be seen as male or female.

entry: POKENAME常独来独往。受到威胁时，便刺向来犯者，将倒刺留在对方体内。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME often keeps to itself, but when it feels threatened it pierces and releases its barbs into its aggressor.

entry: POKENAME体内毒素常用于颜料。毒越强，颜色越鲜艳，因此是制作鲜明染料的珍贵材料。
author: .izik
source: The poison within POKENAME's body is frequently used for paints. The stronger the poison, the stronger the vibrancy of the color, making it a highly valued ingredient in crafting vivid dyes.

entry: POKENAME在朋友面前很温柔，也能发出使敌人麻痹的超声波叫声。背上的毒刺，还能自由收回。
author: melodydelune
source: Known to be gentle around friends, POKENAME can emit ultrasonic cries that can paralyze enemies. It can retract the poison barbs on its back.

entry: POKENAME日益增长的母性本能与攻击性结合，使它成为极其严厉的守护者。受它照顾的对象，训练十分严格，行为不端还会遭更严厉的惩罚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's burgeoning maternal instincts mixed with its aggression to make it a fiercely strict guardian. Those it takes under its wing are trained harshly, and punished even harsher for misbehavior.

entry: POKENAME自视为尼多一族成员间的调停者。但生性好斗，大多只会凶猛威吓，迫使双方畏惧臣服、停止争斗，否则后果自负。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME thinks of itself as a mediator between members of Nidoran clans. Its aggressive nature makes most of its mediation consist of aggressive displays meant to cause both parties to cower in submission and cease fighting, or else.

entry: POKENAME是天生的调度能手。自己或亲近者一接到命令，它便开始指挥其他宝可梦与自身，分派职责，争取最佳成果。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME act as natural logisticians. When they or those they are close to receive an order, POKENAME begin directing other Pokémon as well as themselves, delegating responsibilities for optimal results.

entry: POKENAME泼辣大胆，又十分爱管闲事，观察敏锐，似乎连最隐秘的情绪与能力也能察觉。人类虽听不懂它们的语言，却看得出它们似乎总在彼此八卦。
author: bobosmith01
source: Sassy, bold, and outright nosy, POKENAME are keen observers and appear sensitive to even the most secretive of emotions and abilities. Although humans cannot understand POKENAME's language, it appears they gossip among one another constantly.

entry: POKENAME凭快速拍动的双翼，疾掠河床。它吃有毒植物强身，利用毒素增强速度与灵活性。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME speeds across riverbeds with its rapidly beating wings. It eats poisonous plants to strengthen itself, using their toxins to enhance its speed and agility.

entry: POKENAME就爱被关注，甚至会向其他宝可梦调情，只为博点注意。它的爪子带毒，足以让小型宝可梦昏倒。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME love any attention that can get and will even flirt with other Pokémon just for the attention. Its claws are venomous and can cause fainting in small Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME与一些谜拟丘融合体一起生活在托儿所，给孩子安慰与快乐。它会与其他宝可梦较劲，总想成为关注的中心。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME live at daycares along with some Mimikyu fusions, providing comfort and joy to children. POKENAME creates rivalries with other Pokémon, always seeking to be the center of attention.

entry: POKENAME喜欢挂在训练家的钥匙链上。遇见其他同类，会产生强烈竞争心，发出响亮哔声，争夺关注。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME love to hang from their Trainer's keychain. They will have a strong rivalry with any other POKENAME they encounter and will compete for attention by making loud beeping noises.

entry: POKENAME向敌人吐出的毒液总是沸腾。强烈的高温与毒性，使其成为战斗中的危险武器，接触后常造成烧伤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's poison is always boiling when it spits it at foes. The intense heat and toxicity of the venom make it a dangerous weapon to face in battle, often causing burns upon contact.

entry: 它长着幽暗的毒刺，平时会收起，免得伤到主人。受威胁时，便以幽灵之手触碰敌人，使其毒发。
author: houndrys.
source: It grows shadowy poison barbs which it retracts as to not hurt its owner. When threatened, it touches its foe with a ghostly hand, poisoning them.

entry: POKENAME的毒液很甜，熬煮浓缩后能去毒。饮下能振奋精神、增强耐力与精力，是健美运动员或慢跑者有效的补充品。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's venom is very sweet and can be boiled down to remove its toxicity. It invigorates anyone who imbibes it, making it an effective supplement for bodybuilders or joggers, enhancing their endurance and energy.

entry: POKENAME愿不惜一切保卫巢穴。它们会给爪子充电，再一头冲向任何威胁，用满身毒刺扎向对方。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are willing to defend their nest at any cost. They charge electricity into their paws before running head-first into any threat, jabbing them with the many poisonous spines on their body.

entry: POKENAME在山路边挖深坑，等其他宝可梦掉入，作为食物。坑边铺着松散落叶与碎石，让猎物更难逃开毒颚。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME dig deep pits along mountain trails, waiting for other Pokémon to fall into them so that they can feed. The pit edges are lined with loose leaf litter and gravel to make it harder for their prey to get away from their venomous jaws.

entry: POKENAME头部覆有厚厚毒液，头撞时便会抹到目标身上。毒性很快发作，使猎物迷失方向、破绽大露。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's head is coated in a thick layer of poison, which is applied to the target when it headbutts them. The poison activates quickly, causing disorientation and leaving its prey vulnerable.

entry: 冬季，POKENAME挤在洞里取暖，防止尾火熄灭。它们轮流吃秋天采来储存的树果。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME huddle together in burrows during the winter months to keep their bodies warm and to prevent their flaming tails from going out. They take turns eating from stashed berries that were collected during Fall.

entry: 野外雌性POKENAME通常比雄性更善运动。它们相互竞争，希望有朝一日成为族群首领；这些族群由尼多一族分别与宝宝丁、胖丁融合而成的两类成员组成。
author: bobosmith01
source: In the wild, female POKENAME are generally more athletic than the males. The females compete against one another in an effort to one day prove they can become the leader of a colony of Nidobuff and Nidopuff.

entry: POKENAME耐力强大，连最繁重的工作也能轻松完成，得到其他野生宝可梦尊重。蓬松毛发让它在刺骨严寒中也能履行职责。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME easily perform even the most laborious tasks thanks to their strong stamina, earning respect from other wild Pokémon. They can even perform duties in blistering cold thanks to their fluffy fur.

entry: POKENAME全身包裹的羊水剧毒无比，任何胆敢触碰者都会中毒。即使相隔数米，它也能以心灵感应与同类交流。
author: fiordaliso
source: The amniotic fluid coating its body is extremely toxic, poisoning anyone who dares to touch it. POKENAME uses telepathy to communicate with other members of its species, even from several meters away.

entry: POKENAME成群穿过森林，寻找虫属性宝可梦饱餐。每只爪里的腐蚀性毒液，让强爪能撕开茧。吃饱后，它们便返回洞穴家园。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swarm through forests looking for Bug-type Pokémon to feast upon. Their powerful claws can tear through cocoons thanks to the caustic venom within each claw. Once they have eaten their fill, they return to their cavernous homes.

entry: POKENAME暴怒时会爆炸，将毒刺撒得到处都是。这种防卫反应使受威胁的它成为危险对手，身后留下一片毒刺。
author: .izik
source: Should POKENAME become enraged, it will explode, scattering poisonous barbs everywhere. This defensive reaction makes it a dangerous opponent when threatened, leaving behind a field of toxic spikes.

entry: 雌性POKENAME通常独居，面对其他雌性宝可梦时，领地意识极强。它们会用带毒长牙威吓竞争的雌性，争取配偶。
author: empathnaga
source: Female POKENAME are generally solitary, becoming intensely territorial among other female Pokémon. They use their venomous tusks to intimidate competing females in order to secure a mate.

entry: POKENAME很少离开洞穴家园，只有狩猎虫属性宝可梦时才外出。毒牙刺入茧的裂缝，就能熔穿坚壳，取食里面多汁的营养。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rarely leave their cavernous homes and only do so to hunt for Bug-type Pokémon. By sinking their venomous fangs into the cracks of cocoons, they can melt through the tough shell to reach the juicy nutrients inside.

entry: POKENAME啃有毒植物的根，增强力量。吃下这些毒草，能强化自身毒性，战斗中更加可怕。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gnaws on the roots of poisonous flora to become stronger. By consuming these toxic plants, it enhances its own venom, making it even more formidable in battle.

entry: POKENAME吃的花蜜来自使它略带毒性的花朵。跳舞时，它会竖起、收回羽下尖刺，添上一点细腻风采。
author: bacondlx
source: The flowers that produce the nectar POKENAME eats make it mildly poisonous. As it dances, it raises and retracts spines under its feathers to add a subtle flair.

entry: POKENAME会与垃圾清运人员一起，捡拾城市街道的垃圾。它们吃掉不能回收或焚烧的部分，转成可生物降解的污泥。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME work alongside waste collectors to pick up garbage on city streets. They eat trash that cannot be recycled or burned, converting that trash into a biodegradable sludge.

entry: POKENAME偏爱吃毒蘑菇增强力量。有毒养分会强化自身毒液，使它更危险，不宜靠近。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers to eat poisonous mushrooms to get stronger. The toxic nutrients enhance its own venom, making it even more dangerous to approach.

entry: POKENAME虽对训练家亲昵，却保护欲极强，会咬向靠得太近的同类。想饲养它的训练家，应事先规划散步，留意其他同类饲主的安排。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Though affectionate toward their Trainers, POKENAME are fiercely protective and will snap at other POKENAME that come too close. It is advised that any Trainer wishing to keep them should take the time to plan walks around other POKENAME owners.

entry: POKENAME会与同类轮流围住幼崽，保卫族群。它先用一次疼痛、微毒的咬击警告入侵者退后，之后可能变得更凶暴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME takes turns with others of its kind to circle around their young and defend the pack. It delivers a single painful and mildly venomous bite as a warning to intruders to back away before it gets even more violent.

entry: POKENAME背上的蓝鳞，质地类似蘑菇。战斗中会释放有毒孢子，削弱敌人，吓退进一步的威胁。
author: .izik
source: The blue scale on POKENAME's back is similar in consistency to a mushroom. It lets loose toxic spores while in combat, using its poison to weaken foes and deter any further threats.

entry: POKENAME生气时，针状毛会变得锋利，足以注入少量毒液。但温顺时，它完全无害。
author: mistymagius
source: When POKENAME is angered, its needle-like hairs become sharp enough to inject its poison in small doses. However, it is completely harmless while it is docile.

entry: POKENAME十分贪玩，尽管体内流着毒，仍喜欢与同类打闹。也常因此被从空中撞落。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME are very playful, enjoying roughhousing with others of their kind despite the poison running through their bodies. They're often knocked out of the sky because of this roughhousing.

entry: POKENAME保护同巢伙伴，无法辨认入侵者时，就会用毒爪攻击。局势尤其危急时，还会喷出灼热腐蚀火焰，烧尽周围。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are protective of their nestmates and will attack with their venomous claws if they cannot identify the intruders. In particularly dire situations, they breathe out hot caustic flames to burn everything around them.

entry: POKENAME挖隧道时，会把毒刺收进体内，避免撞上硬石折断。
author: .izik
source: While tunneling, POKENAME retracts its poison barbs into its body. This prevents them from snapping off against hard stone.

entry: 受伤的海洋宝可梦被POKENAME发现，是件幸事。无论什么种类，它们都会围着伤者，以毒威胁其他宝可梦，守护到伤势愈合。甚至有人见过它们护送受伤的人类。
author: afilthycasual
source: Wounded sea Pokémon are lucky to be found by POKENAME. Regardless of species, they will surround them, threatening other Pokémon with their poison while their charge heals. They have even been seen escorting wounded humans.

entry: POKENAME向夜间独行的游客掷毒刺，偷取珠宝。狡猾的手段让它搜集财宝，还能用毒保护赃物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flings poisonous barbs at tourists who travel alone at night so it can steal jewelry. This devious tactic helps it gather treasures while using its venom to protect its spoils.

entry: POKENAME用胡须分泌的毒液，守护收集的闪亮物品。毒素能逼退盗贼与对手，确保财宝无人敢动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME guards its gathered shiny objects with the poison secreted from its whiskers. This toxic substance keeps thieves and rivals at bay, ensuring that its treasures remain untouched.

entry: POKENAME暴怒时，毛下尖刺会变得更利。这让本就更凶暴的它在战斗中更加危险，尖刺也强化了攻击。
author: .izik
source: When enraged, spikes under POKENAME's fur become sharper. This heightened aggression makes it even more dangerous in combat, with its sharp spikes adding to the intensity of its strikes.

entry: POKENAME暴怒时，双拳会长出尖刺，挥向附近一切移动的东西，直到怒气消退。为了复仇，它会化作失控的狂怒之力。
author: .izik
source: When enraged, sharp spikes will grow from POKENAME's fists. It will swing at anything moving nearby until its rage subsides, becoming a force of uncontrollable fury in its quest for vengeance.

entry: POKENAME毛上的油剧毒无比，但仔细洗净毛发，就能制成极暖的围巾。卡洛斯许多商店都出售这种以精心处理的毛制成的围巾。
author: .izik
source: The oil on POKENAME's fur is extremely toxic, but if washed carefully, it can be used in extremely warm scarves. Many shops across Kalos sell these scarves, made from the carefully processed fur of this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME常被训练来保护牲畜，因为能迅速与照顾对象建立感情，奋力守护。作为家养宠物，则需要大量运动与训练，才不会拆家。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME are often trained as livestock protection Pokémon since they swiftly bond to their charges and defend them fiercely. Ones kept as housepets need extensive exercise and training to keep them from wrecking their home.

entry: POKENAME守护着年幼的弟妹，尽力让它们留在巢中。生气时，它会喷出炽热的火焰，向弟妹示意，该安静下来了。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are guardians for their younger siblings and do their best to keep them in the nest. When they are angry, they breathe out hot flames to signal to their younger siblings that it is time to calm down.

entry: POKENAME容易焦虑，会尽力让精力旺盛的弟妹留在巢中。它们用毒爪赶走入侵者，还以灼热火焰堵住出口，阻止弟妹外出。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are anxious creatures that do their best to keep their energetic siblings in the nest. They drive out intruders with their venomous claws and keep siblings in by blocking exits with searing hot flames.

entry: 进化后，POKENAME体内毒素强烈得多，成为更可怕的对手。它以宽大双翼巡视巢穴周围的天空，哪怕牺牲生命，也要守住家园。
author: fiordaliso
source: After evolving, the toxins within POKENAME's body have become far more potent, making it an even more formidable opponent. With its broad wings, it soars over the skies around its nest, defending it even at the cost of its own life.

entry: POKENAME虽大多时间都在睡觉，但危险一露苗头，就能迅速跃起，保护亲友。它们绕着对手瞬间移动，扰乱敌人，等待机会使出狠毒的毒针。
author: chibitales
source: Despite sleeping for most of the day, POKENAME can quickly jump up to defend their friends and family at the first hint of danger. They Teleport around opponents to confuse them, waiting for a chance to hit with a nasty Poison Sting.

entry: POKENAME会举行共同清洁的仪式，替其他宝可梦清理壳，保持身体洁净。洗净后，它们会到阳光明亮的草地晾干自己的壳。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME clean the shells of other Pokémon in a communal cleaning ritual that keeps their bodies clean. Once they are clean, POKENAME dry their shells in bright sunny patches of grass.

entry: POKENAME快被踩到时，会竖起满身毒刺，自我防卫。放松时，刺就会收回。
author: foolish_weasel
source: If it is about to be stepped on, POKENAME will raise the poisonous barbs that cover its body in self-defense. When it is relaxed, it will retract its barbs.

entry: POKENAME群居且十分合群，喜欢与朋友赛跑。若看见长长的恶臭烟迹，很可能刚有一群经过。
author: _._starry_._
source: POKENAME live in highly social herds, and love racing with their friends. If you see long trails of foul-smelling smoke, it is likely a group of POKENAME just ran by.

entry: POKENAME听觉敏锐，能察觉任何动静，一感知远大于自己的宝可梦靠近，就会立刻摆出防御姿态。尾内藏着毒刺，能在战斗中出其不意地袭击对手。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's keen hearing allows it to detect any movement, so if it senses a much larger Pokémon approaching, it immediately takes a defensive stance. Hidden within its tail are venomous barbs, which it uses to catch opponents off guard in battle.

entry: POKENAME两颗头滴出的唾液剧毒无比，不宜触碰。毒液会引发发烧与幻觉，使它对任何靠得太近的对象都十分危险。
author: .izik
source: The saliva leaking from POKENAME's two heads is extremely poisonous and should not be touched. This venom causes fevers and hallucinations, making it a dangerous threat to anyone who comes too close.

entry: POKENAME用尖刺将自己固定在浮冰上，即使风浪大，也能离水休息。尖刺有毒，与其他宝可梦争夺冰上空间时也会派上用场。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their spines to anchor themselves on ice floes, allowing them to rest out of the water even in stormy weather. Their spines are poisonous and are used when fighting for space on the ice with other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME听觉敏锐，能察觉任何动静，一感知远大于自己的宝可梦靠近，就会立刻摆出防御姿态。它喜欢长时间游泳，保持身体湿润，防止皮肤开裂。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's keen hearing allows it to detect any movement, so if it senses a much larger Pokémon approaching, it immediately takes a defensive stance. It loves spending its days swimming to keep its body hydrated and prevent its skin from cracking.

entry: POKENAME会站在巢外，准备放出激流水柱，守护巢穴。它们坚定不移，即使错过玩乐，也会专心保护家人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME protect their nest by standing outside, ready to launch a torrent of water. They are stalwart creatures that are devoted to the task of protecting their family, even if it means missing out on having fun.

entry: POKENAME夜间活动，用敏锐鼻子嗅出领地内熟睡宝可梦的梦。若认定其中某只是对手，就会放出引发噩梦的毒气。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are nocturnal Pokémon, using their sensitive noses to sniff out the dreams of sleeping Pokémon within their territory. If they come across a sleeping Pokémon that they think is a rival, they will exude a poisonous gas that causes nightmares.

entry: POKENAME不靠通常的手段下毒，而是通过摆锤施展超能力，毒害对手的心智。毒会引发严重头痛、恶心与肌肉痉挛。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME doesn't inflict its poison by normal means; it instead uses its psychic powers to poison its opponent's mind by using its pendulum. The poison causes severe headaches, nausea, and muscle spasms.

entry: POKENAME被梦的气味吸引，在夜里寻找熟睡的宝可梦与人类。进城后，它们会闯入公寓，站在人们床尾，吸入梦境。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are drawn to the scent of dreams, searching the night to find sleeping Pokémon and people. When they find their way into cities, they are known to break into apartments and stand at the foot of people's beds breathing in their dreams.

entry: 巨颚移到了背上，既能吐出种子，也能咬住敌人。
author: mossybanana
source: Its giant jaws have migrated to its back. They are capable of spitting seeds or biting foes.

entry: POKENAME头顶的颚会向捕食它的鸟宝可梦疯狂咬合。因此，它能安心专注吃东西。
author: mepp.
source: The jaw on top of POKENAME's head snaps furiously at predatory bird Pokémon. Thanks to this, it can safely focus on eating.

entry: POKENAME收集吃剩的猎物骨骼，既当狩猎武器，也用来剔牙。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME collects the bones of its consumed prey to hunt with as weapons or pick its teeth.

entry: POKENAME以钢颚为腿，天生迅捷，能在任何战场灵活移动、咬夹，总占上风。
author: beatdoof
source: With steel jaws as its legs, POKENAME's inherent swift speed allows it to maneuver and clamp its way around any battlefield, always gaining the upper hand.

entry: POKENAME经常跑过采石场，用铁甲撞击岩壁。它会数落下的石头，向同类展示力量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME regularly runs through rock quarries, using its iron plating to ram into the walls. It does this as a show of strength to others of its kind, counting the rocks it knocks loose.

entry: POKENAME额上的嘴极其潮湿，很适合安全存放蛋。其他宝可梦的亲代外出时，它会保护蛋，直到对方回来。
author: .izik
source: The mouth on POKENAME's forehead is extremely humid and moist, perfect for storing eggs safely. It will protect the eggs of other Pokémon if their parents are away until they return.

entry: POKENAME的巨尾藏着另一张嘴，比前面的嘴更贪吃。许多想当猎手的对象，都会在尾巴张开、狠狠咬下时，反成猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's large tail hides a secondary mouth more ravenous than the one on its front. Many would-be hunters become prey when its tail opens up and takes a large bite.

entry: POKENAME诱使毫无戒心的猎物欣赏美丽双翼，等对方毫无防备，再猛然咬下。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME tricks unsuspecting prey to look at its beautiful wings. When they are most vulnerable, they chomp down on them.

entry: POKENAME臂上的钢刃能切断粗大树枝。一发现独角虫之类的猎物，就会以巨口攻击。
author: .izik
source: The steel blades on POKENAME's arms allow it to cut apart large tree branches. Should it spot prey like Weedle, it will attack with its large maw.

entry: POKENAME能用巨口一口吞下整只铁壳蛹。强劲咬力能破开硬壳，是高效的捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its large maw to easily consume an entire Kakuna in one bite. Its powerful bite can break through tough shells, making it an efficient predator.

entry: 战前，POKENAME会用尾上的嘴反复咬自己，煽动情绪。这样能让它勃然大怒，增强战斗力量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME repeatedly bites itself with the mouth on its tail to rile itself up for battle. This behavior lets it fly into a rage, boosting its strength for the fight.

entry: POKENAME几乎不可能被偷袭。无论从哪边接近，它都会变出一副巨颚，在你靠近之前一口咬下。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is nigh-impossible to take by surprise. No matter the direction you approach it from, it will transform its body to form a giant pair of jaws and chomp you before you can come close.

entry: POKENAME会用第二张嘴，啃坏无人看管的硬件。比起卡带或微芯片，它更喜欢实体盘片。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its secondary mouth to chew through unattended hardware. It shows a preference for physical discs over cartridges or microchips.

entry: POKENAME会出现在毫不知情的住户面前，装饿撒娇，讨要食物。尾巴则伸出去寻找食物来源，轻松用颚吞光，再瞬间移动离开。
author: epping_forest
source: They present themselves to unaware households, acting hungry and cutely asking for food. POKENAME's tail will stretch looking for the source of the food, and its jaws will have no struggle to swallow it all before teleporting.

entry: POKENAME会出现在毫不知情的住户面前，装饿撒娇，讨要食物。尾巴则伸出去寻找食物来源，轻松用颚吞光，再瞬间移动离开。
author: epping_forest
source: They present themselves to unaware households, acting hungry and cutely asking for food. POKENAME's tail will stretch looking for the source of the food, and its jaws will have no struggle to swallow it all before teleporting.

entry: POKENAME外表虽怪诞，性情却温顺，通常无害。长满尖牙的巨口，只用于抵御捕食者。
author: occulusmalus
source: Despite its grotesque appearance, a POKENAME is docile and generally harmless. Its fanged maw is solely for defending against predators.

entry: 它寻找昆虫时，会闭紧背上的双颚。若捕食者从背后偷袭，颚便张开反击。
author: hophoppip
source: While it forages for insects, it keeps the jaws on its back closed. If a predator attempts to attack it from behind, the jaws open to strike back.

entry: POKENAME脾气暴躁，容易发怒。一旦被激怒，就会收回背上火焰，把所有火力集中到头部，在狂怒中漫无目标地向四周喷出大团烈焰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a volatile temperament and is easily angered. Once its fury is triggered, it retracts the flames on its back and focuses all its fire to its head, breathing massive plumes of fire all around it in an aimless rage.

entry: POKENAME因尖锐的喋喋声与旺盛食欲而受畏惧，其实天性温顺。因此，它们不规律的动作与叫声，常被误认成威胁。
author: silverscloudy
source: Feared for their shrill chattering and voracious appetites, POKENAME are actually docile by nature. Due to this, their erratic movement and cries are often mistaken for threats.

entry: POKENAME食量惊人，一天最多能吃下自身体重两倍的食物。嘴状的角常左右不对称，有助于保持警觉、捕捉猎物。
author: silverscloudy
source: POKENAME have incredible appetites, able to consume up to twice their body weight in a single day. Their maw-like horns are often lopsided, aiding their ability to remain alert and hunt prey.

entry: 据说，天上每有一颗星，POKENAME翼下就会长出一颗牙。虽是夸张说法，它们确实长出太多牙，必须不断脱落，为新牙腾出空间。
author: quackquackattack
source: It is said that POKENAME will grow a tooth under their wings for every star in the sky. Though this is hyperbole, POKENAME produce so many teeth that they need to shed them constantly to make room for more.

entry: POKENAME悬在树枝或崖壁，张着巨口落向毫无戒心的猎物，以蛛网般的唾液困住，慢慢消化。若在城区发现，必须移走，以免危及孩子。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME hangs on tree branches or cliff faces, dropping onto unsuspecting prey with its open maw, and trapping it with its web-like saliva for slow digestion. If found in urban areas, it must be relocated so as not to be a danger to children.

entry: POKENAME模仿受伤宝可梦的声音，将猎物引入森林深处。受害者一迷路或陷入险境，它就从树上降下，吞食对方。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME mimics the sounds of injured Pokémon to lure prey deep into the forest. Once the victim is lost or becomes trapped in a hazard, POKENAME descends from the trees to devour them.

entry: 额头附肢末端那个看似弱小无助的诱饵，才是POKENAME的真身。它借此引来猎物，再以改造成利齿鱼形的触角吞下。
author: milchik
source: The small helpless-looking lure on the tip of its forehead appendage is its actual body, with which POKENAME attracts prey and swallows it with its modified antenna that resembles a toothy fish.

entry: POKENAME住在深海暗缝，诱饵是周围唯一的光源。猎物常误认成年幼灯笼鱼，它便趁对方不备出击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lurks deep in the ocean and makes its home in dark crevices where its lure produces the only light around. Prey Pokémon often mistake its lure for young Chinchou; POKENAME takes advantage of this and strikes at its unsuspecting target.

entry: 看不见月亮的夜里，POKENAME三张嘴会一同唱起悲曲。旋律凄婉，哪怕只听到一小段，也能让人落泪。
author: .izik
source: All three of POKENAME's mouths sing a sorrowful tune on nights when the moon isn't visible. The melody is so haunting that it can make a person cry from just hearing a small portion.

entry: POKENAME模样可爱，也十分亲人，可摸它却危险得很：鲜花与裙摆之下，都藏着一排排锋利的牙齿。
author: vibrationjaveline
source: POKENAME is known for its cuteness, and is very affectionate. However, it is extremely dangerous to touch, as its flowers and dress both contain hidden rows of razor-sharp teeth.

entry: POKENAME潜水时，尾巴浮在水面，颚张开，不用露面也能呼吸。它还会用尾巴保护幼崽，将蛋或刚孵出的宝宝轻轻含在颚内携带。
author: milchik
source: Whenever it's underwater, its tail floats on the surface with its jaw open, allowing POKENAME to breathe without emerging. It also uses its tail to protect its offspring by gently carrying the eggs or newly-hatched babies inside the jaw.

entry: 野生POKENAME平时很怯弱，被逼急了才会反抗。POKENAME猛烈甩动嵌满尖牙的尾巴，展开攻击。
author: mossybanana
source: A wild POKENAME is very meek unless it is cornered. POKENAME fights by wildly swinging its tail, which is embedded with pointed teeth.

entry: POKENAME静候饥饿的宝可梦将自己误认成葵花籽、前来靠近，再用金属颚攻击。这样不用移动，就能积聚进化所需的能量。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME waits for hungry Pokémon to approach it, mistaking it for a sunflower seed, then strikes with its metal jaws. By doing so, it gathers energy for evolution without having to move.

entry: POKENAME融入花田，猎物一靠得太近，它便扑上去，用嘴状花瓣撕咬。日落后，它会前往新花地，再次布下骗局。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME blends in with a field of flowers, but when prey wanders too close, it pounces and tears into it with the mouth-petals. When the sun sets, it journeys to a new flower patch so that it can begin its ruse again.

entry: POKENAME战斗时毫不留情，以大张的颚与凶猛利爪撕扯敌人，发出吓人的笑。只有意志最坚定的训练家，才能击败并驯服它。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: It is merciless in battle. POKENAME lets out a menacing laugh as it mauls foes with its gaping jaw and ferocious claws. Only the most determined trainers can defeat and tame it.

entry: POKENAME把巨颚留在水上呼吸。会飞的宝可梦有时会停在上面，弄得它发痒，打起喷嚏，把微毒黏液喷得对方满身都是。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME keeps its large jaw above the water, allowing it to breathe. Flying Pokémon sometimes perch on it, which POKENAME finds ticklish. This causes it to sneeze, covering the Pokémon that landed on it in a mildly toxic goo.

entry: POKENAME的巨颚有浮力，能浮在水面。会飞的宝可梦有时会停在上面，弄得它发痒，打起喷嚏，把微毒黏液喷得对方满身都是。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's large jaw is buoyant and floats above the water. Flying Pokémon sometimes perch on it, which POKENAME finds ticklish. This causes it to sneeze, covering the Pokémon that landed on it in a mildly toxic goo.

entry: POKENAME把巨颚留在水上呼吸。水手曾误认成浮标，靠近查看时，就被它喷得满身微毒黏液。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME keeps its large jaw above the water, allowing it to breathe. Sailors have mistaken these for buoys, and when they get closer to investigate, POKENAME covers them in a mildly toxic goo.

entry: POKENAME为了深入冥想，会将壳紧闭在头周围，隔绝外界刺激。此时，球体会发光，用念力把靠得太近的东西扔到一旁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME, in order to meditate on its deep thoughts, can shut its shell tightly around its head to shut out external stimuli. In this state, the orb glows and telekinetically tosses aside anything that comes too close.

entry: POKENAME十分胆小，常躲开人类与其他种类的宝可梦。尽管如此，双颚却非常强大，能轻易咬碎岩石。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME are very timid Pokémon that often hide away from people and other species of Pokémon. Despite this, they have a very strong jaw that could easily break rocks.

entry: POKENAME长大后萌出了叶子。若咬不到对手，POKENAME就会伸出藤鞭。
author: mossybanana
source: POKENAME has sprouted leaves due to its growth. If POKENAME cannot bite an opponent, then it will reach out with Vine Whip.

entry: 只要是找吃的，POKENAME就格外大胆，甚至常常直接从别人盘子里拿。
author: mossybanana
source: A POKENAME is very bold in its pursuit of food, often taking things directly off of someone's plate.

entry: POKENAME在古代遗迹徘徊，充当守卫。眼睛一察觉动静，头上的颚就会咬过去，牙齿如锯般参差。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME roam ancient ruins, serving as guardians over them. The jaws on their head snap at any movement their eyes detect, their teeth serrated like a saw.

entry: POKENAME受到任何攻击，尾上的嘴都会以双倍力量咬回去。它小心维持平衡，反应的精确程度也引来科学家研究。
author: .izik
source: Should it be struck by any attack, the mouth on POKENAME's tail will bite back with double the force of what struck it. It is careful to maintain balance, making scientists study its behavior for the exactness of its reaction.

entry: POKENAME的头十分聪明，能作计划、解简单谜题，但尾部大脑小得多。尾巴只知道吃掉比自己小的一切。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME's head is highly intelligent, able to plan and solve simple puzzles, but the tail's brain is much smaller. All its tail knows how to do is eat anything smaller than it.

entry: POKENAME身上脱落的金属屑，曾被用来造汽车。可惜，金属具有爆炸性，许多车辆因此遭召回。
author: .izik
source: The metallic shavings that come off POKENAME's body were once used to create automobiles. Unfortunately, many of them were recalled due to the metal's explosive properties.

entry: POKENAME会头朝下钻地睡觉，让尾上的嘴露在外面。下雨时，嘴会紧紧闭合，免得灌满水。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows into the ground face-first to sleep, leaving the mouth on its tail exposed. During the rain, its mouth clamps shut tightly to avoid filling with water.

entry: POKENAME没有通常的嘴，改用臂上的嘴吃喝。那些嘴也用于战斗，每一击往往都能从猎物身上咬下一块。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME lack conventional mouths and instead use the mouths on their arms to consume and drink. These mouths are also used to fight, often biting pieces off of their prey with each strike.

entry: POKENAME用强颚咬开雪松，喝里面的树汁。咬力强大，能轻松破开坚韧树皮。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its strong jaw to bite open cedar trees, feeding on the sap inside. Its powerful bite allows it to break through tough bark with ease.

entry: POKENAME会躺下张开嘴，释放蜂蜜般的香气，引诱猎物。等猎物进去，嘴就会猛然闭合，将其抓住。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lays down with its mouth open, releasing a honey-like scent to lure prey in. Once they enter, it snaps its mouth shut to catch them.

entry: POKENAME背上的壳其实是胃，外覆一层钢。它们食欲过盛，又频繁迁移，大量吞食飞行属性宝可梦，因此被视为入侵物种。
author: bigoljax
source: The shell on POKENAME's back is actually their stomach, covered in a steel layer. Due to their excessive hunger and frequent travels to gorge on more flying-type Pokémon, they have been considered invasive.

entry: POKENAME爱闯进调皮孩子的家，吃掉所有礼物，还会趁家长没发现，偷偷捉弄孩子。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME love to raid the homes of naughty children and eat all of their presents. They will even play tricks on the children without their parents noticing.

entry: POKENAME以薄金属刃为翼，锋利得能轻松切过松树。它用双翼狩猎毽子草等猎物，砍开沿途障碍。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's thin metal blades, which are used as wings, are sharp enough to slice through pine trees with ease. It uses these wings to hunt prey like Hoppip, cutting down obstacles in its path.

entry: 战斗中，POKENAME的第二张嘴会发出响亮哔声，令对手措手不及，本体则趁机攻击。被那张嘴咬到，会有针刺般的麻感。
author: chibitales
source: During battle, POKENAME's second mouth lets out a loud beeping noise to catch opponents off guard as the main body attacks. Being bitten by the second mouth causes a pins-and-needles sensation.

entry: POKENAME会用尾上的嘴嚼碎鲜艳树果、植物与矿物。与唾液混合后，便成为鲜明持久的颜料，用来标记领地。
author: hophoppip
source: It chews up brightly colored Berries, plants, and minerals in the mouth on its tail. Mixed with that mouth's saliva, the chewed items become a vivid and long-lasting pigment that POKENAME uses to mark its territory.

entry: 战斗时，它会不顾一切地旋转踢击，钢颚不停快速咬合，直到咬中敌人。
author: beatdoof
source: Whenever it battles, it spins and kicks with reckless abandon, the steel jaw it has biting endlessly and rapidly until it connects with an enemy.

entry: POKENAME以婴儿与幼年宝可梦为食。乳房是引诱饥饿幼崽的陷阱，因此不宜让它靠近任何小宝可梦或人类婴儿。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME feeds on infants and baby Pokémon. Its udder is a trap designed to lure hungry babies, so it is not recommended to keep POKENAME near any small Pokémon or human babies.

entry: POKENAME背上的三副颚疯狂咬合，似乎独立行动。而且由于由钢构成，还能储存巨量电力。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: The three jaws on its back snap wildly and seemingly act independently from POKENAME. Additionally, they can store huge amounts of electricity since they are made of steel.

entry: POKENAME会把想留着吃的矿石，放在与消化系统不相连的第二张嘴里。这样就能先收集食物，不必立刻吃掉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stores ore that it wants to eat later in its secondary mouth, which has no connection to its digestion. This allows it to gather food without worrying about immediate consumption.

entry: POKENAME把尾巴藏起来，身体发出尖锐哭声。等有什么被声音引近，尾巴就会从藏身处挥出，咬上一口。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tail hides from sight while its body emits a shrill sobbing noise. When something draws near because of the noise, POKENAME's tail swings from its hiding spot to take a bite.

entry: 有人说，POKENAME的心情取决于你看见哪侧脸。明快开朗的一面会试着配合训练家，狡猾的一面却会让钢冠的颚猛然咬合。
author: ghostslythe
source: Some say POKENAME's mood depends on the side of its face you see. Its bright and cheerful side attempts to coordinate with Trainers, while the devious side snaps its steely crown's jaws.

entry: POKENAME全身坚韧的细肢末端各有小嘴，能迅速吞食猎物。有时细肢咬住目标后会被连根扯下，仍会啃咬抓住的猎物，最长一小时后才死去。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is covered in durable tendrils that each have small mouths at the end, allowing it to rapidly devour prey. Sometimes a tendril will latch onto a target and be pulled off by the roots, gnawing on its catch for up to an hour before perishing.

entry: POKENAME几乎完全用背上巨口吃岩石矿物，但腹口也会储存矿石。腹内所存的矿石，会在战斗中或制服猎物时，从双臂射出。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME feeds almost entirely on rock and ore using the giant maw on its back, but it also stores some ore in the maw on its belly. Whatever ore it stores in its belly will be shot out from its arms during battle and to subdue prey.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，尾上的嘴会发出奇怪嗡鸣。声音能增强力量，让它释放更强的虫鸣。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's mouth on its tail makes an odd whirring noise while it fights. The sound increases its power, allowing it to unleash Bug Buzz with greater strength.

entry: POKENAME滑过夜空寻找猎物。它会用第二张嘴，在空中夹住黑暗鸦之类的目标，带走享用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides across the night skies in search of prey. It uses its second mouth to clamp onto prey like Murkrow mid-flight, carrying them away to feast.

entry: POKENAME几乎只吃植物，却因体形庞大、双颚强劲与脾气暴躁而极其危险。捕食者即便有，也极少敢冒险猎捕它。
author: occulusmalus
source: Whilst it almost exclusively feeds on plants, POKENAME is extremely dangerous due to its large size, powerful jaws and bad temper. Few if any predators will risk hunting it.

entry: POKENAME大量运用声呐，探查洞里的矿藏。它放出强力三重攻击震落矿石，吃下强化金属身体。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses high amounts of sonar to detect ore deposits in caves. It unleashes a powerful Tri Attack to dislodge the ore, allowing it to feast and strengthen its metal body.

entry: POKENAME一发现捕食者，就会用尾上的巨口咬住树枝，悬挂起来。再从那里接连射下强劲种子，保卫家园。
author: .izik
source: If it spots a predator, POKENAME hangs from a branch by biting down with the large mouth on its tail. From this position, it rains down powerful barrages of seeds to defend its home.

entry: POKENAME主要用嘴状尾巴进食，偏爱蘑菇与低矮灌木。这样，双眼就能在吃东西时留意威胁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME primarily eats with its mouth-like tail, preferring toadstools and shrubbery close to the ground. This frees its eyes to watch for threats while it feeds.

entry: POKENAME是森林的照料者。它用朝后的强大巨颚剪去枯枝与病枝，再以背上的种子帮助树木更快、更健康地长回。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME is a forest caretaker.  Using its large, powerful, back-facing jaws, it cuts away dead and diseased branches, then uses the seeds on its back to help the trees grow back faster and healthier.

entry: POKENAME凭不起眼的外表引来猎物，使对方放松警惕。一旦受骗，它们就会用大量灼热火球轰击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME utilize their unassuming appearances to draw in prey and lull them into complacency. When their prey has fallen for their ruse, they bombard them with many searing fireballs.

entry: 由于双颚形状特殊，POKENAME能蜷成球，滚下陡坡。只需把小宝可梦滚进牙齿构成的笼子，就能抓住。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: Because of the shape of its jaws, POKENAME has been known to curl into a ball and roll down steep hills, catching smaller Pokémon by simply rolling them into the cage made up of its teeth.

entry: 大多数对手都盯着POKENAME剃刀般的利爪，忽略了它最强的武器。战况不利时，它就用巨颚出击，一口结束战斗。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Most opponents focus on POKENAME's razor-sharp claws, only to overlook its greatest weapon. If a battle turns against it, POKENAME strikes with its massive jaws, ending the fight in a single bite.

entry: POKENAME会踢松矿井里的铁矿石。吃下金属能强化骨骼，增强体质。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME kicks at iron ore in mines to knock it loose. Consuming the metal strengthens its bones and enhances its constitution.

entry: 第二张嘴与消化系统不相连，因此它常在里面存湿泥。虽然强到甩一次尾就能击碎东西，它仍会向威胁投泥，掩护逃跑。
author: infinex21
source: Its second mouth is not connected to its digestive system, so it often stores damp mud within it. It will fling mud at threats to cover its escape, even though it is strong enough to shatter with a single swing of its tail.

entry: POKENAME的假嘴主要用来威吓。若没能吓跑对方，它就会用假嘴铲起并吐出大量泥巴，增加逃脱机会。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's false mouth is primarily used for intimidation. If it fails to frighten something off, it uses the false mouth to scoop up and spit out a large amount of mud in order to give it a better chance to flee.

entry: POKENAME性情平和，被动取食，以巨口吞下大量小鱼宝可梦。不过，食道相当狭窄，无法吞咽大型猎物。
author: occulusmalus
source: POKENAME is a placid, passive feeder that uses its huge maw to consume large quantities of small fish Pokémon. Due to its fairly narrow gullet, it is incapable of swallowing large prey, however.

entry: POKENAME垂下的角已进化成小颚的模样，更能敏感察觉情绪，也能表达感情。它会与两张嘴分享所有食物，仿佛它们是独立生灵。
author: infinex21
source: Its dangling horns have evolved to resemble small jaws, further expanding their sensitivity to feelings and gaining the ability to express emotions. POKENAME shares any and all of its food with both of these jaws as if they were separate entities.

entry: 它的巨颚会回应自身与周围生灵的情绪，比脸更能表露心情。奇怪的是，苦恼或悲伤时，巨颚会变得凶暴，咬向一切。
author: infinex21
source: Its set of massive jaws reacts to its emotions and the emotions of others around it; these jaws express its emotions more than its face does. Oddly, if it feels distressed or is miserable, these jaws become aggressive and snap at everything.

entry: 目前理论认为，它用超能力抵消巨大独立嘴部的重量。它吃素，偏爱大水果与蔬菜，每天都能嚼着慢慢享用。
author: infinex21
source: Current theories suggest it uses its psychic power to negate the weight of its large, detached mouth. It is a herbivore that favors large fruits and vegetables that it can chew on and slowly eat throughout each day.

entry: POKENAME披着天真善良的外衣，引来其他超能力属性宝可梦。靠近后，假嘴便将其抓住困在里面，由本体抽取精神能量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lures other Psychic-type Pokémon near with a veneer of innocence and kindness. Once close, its false mouth snatches them and holds them within itself while POKENAME drains them of psychic energy.

entry: POKENAME敏锐察觉训练家的任何不当情绪后，会将其诱向灭亡，以儆效尤。
author: srx.moe
source: Keenly aware of any untoward emotions its Trainer may have, POKENAME will lure them to their doom just to make an example out of them.

entry: 它用超能力让全身摆脱重力，也更好地操纵巨口。每天能吃下自身体重两倍的果蔬，却不长体重，因为持续运用超能力极其耗能。
author: infinex21
source: It uses its psychic powers to defy gravity for its entire body and to better guide its large mouth. It eats twice its body weight in fruits and vegetables each day without gaining any weight; the constant use of its psychic powers is very demanding.

entry: POKENAME伸缩舌内藏着一整张假嘴，咬力强大，牙齿尖锐。它曾追猎远大于自己的宝可梦，用巨颚拖回巢穴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's extendable tongue contains an entire false mouth with a crushing grip and pointed teeth. It has hunted down Pokémon much larger than itself, dragging them back to its den with the giant jaws.

entry: 它能将第二张嘴射出并扩大，吞下大块食物。变色伪装后，便能用这张嘴布下危险陷阱。
author: infinex21
source: It has a second mouth that it can launch out and expand to swallow whole large foods. By changing colors to camouflage itself, it can set a dangerous trap using its second mouth.

entry: POKENAME是无情的猎手，先以利爪按住猎物，再用足以咬碎钢铁的力量咬下。它虽重得惊人，超能力仍足以让身体浮在空中。
author: torterrable
source: POKENAME is a merciless hunter that pins down prey with its claws before biting with enough force to shatter steel. Despite its immense weight, it has enough psychic power to levitate through the air.

entry: 与POKENAME相连的奇石能裂成两半，露出空心内部。据说，被困在石口中的对象，灵魂都会被吞噬。
author: sk372
source: The strange stone POKENAME is connected to can split in half to reveal hollow insides. It is said that those trapped within this stone maw will have their souls swallowed up.

entry: 身体与灵体巨口各有独立意识，勉强维持合作。POKENAME的身体负责走路与说话，巨颚则攻击一切够得着的东西。
author: bringmeadream_
source: The physical body and spiritual maw operate as separate minds. Working together with an uneasy agreement, the body of POKENAME does the walking and talking, while the jaws attack whatever is within reach.

entry: POKENAME皮肤如同锈铁，有时会伪装成雕像。其他宝可梦一靠近，就猛然咬下。
author: jokerswild
source: Because of its rust-like skin, POKENAME sometimes pretends to be a statue. When another Pokémon gets too close, it chomps down viciously.

entry: POKENAME跑不过猎物，便常先用香气安抚，再将其吃掉。
author: mossybanana
source: POKENAME will often soothe their prey with an aroma before consuming them, as they cannot outrun them.

entry: POKENAME极力保护幼崽，第二张“嘴”其实是携带宝宝的保护袋。“牙齿”是防御结构，阻止捕食者试图撬开“颚”。
author: occulusmalus
source: Fiercely protective of its young, POKENAME's second "mouth" is actually a protective pouch for carrying its babies inside. The "teeth" are defensive features to deter predators from trying to prize the "jaws" open.

entry: POKENAME的两副颚各有意志。虽然大多时候听它指挥，有时却会不服从，随心所欲地行动。
author: soup1900
source: The two sets of jaws have their own will. While most of the time, they will do what POKENAME wants them to do, they will sometimes disobey and do whatever they want.

entry: POKENAME用可爱的脸与举止，让对手放松警惕。但两边都认为自己才是那张可爱的脸，结果只会绕圈，弄得自己也迷糊。
author: footlongdingledong
source: POKENAME uses its cute face and demeanor to lull its opponents into complacency. However, since both sides think it is the cute face, it just ends up going in circles, leaving it confused.

entry: 真有谁靠得够近，POKENAME就会试图狠狠咬住，防止逃走。但它没有真正能引来猎物的手段，因此常几个月吃不上东西。
author: sondededoo
source: Should anyone actually get close enough to POKENAME, it will attempt to bite down hard on them to prevent escape. Because it lacks any real tool to lure prey in, POKENAME often goes months without food.

entry: 这种POKENAME形态，最初记录于遥远的伽勒尔地区。它在名为呐喊队的团体成员间，颇受欢迎。
author: sk372
source: This form of POKENAME was first recorded being sighted in the distant region of Galar. It was noted as being quite popular among members of the group known as Team Yell.

entry: POKENAME的巨颚虽以咬击最危险，甩打一下也能把人砸昏。它用这招对付迅速的敌人，让双颚更容易啃咬。
author: soup1900
source: While a bite from its set of jaws is the most dangerous part about them, getting smacked by them could knock you out cold. POKENAME does this to fast opponents to make it easier for its jaws to gnaw them.

entry: POKENAME常用巨颚抓取、搬运物品。但有时会咬得太重，把东西咬裂。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME will often use its set of jaws to grab and carry objects. It will sometimes bite too hard on the object, however, causing it to split open.

entry: POKENAME看不见，依靠众多角感知环境。角上味蕾发达，能察觉周围与进入领地的任何敌人。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME is blind, relying on its many horns to perceive the environment. The horns have strong taste buds, allowing it to sense its environment and any foe that enters its territory.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛能看向任何方向。以金属肢体起伏移动时，它们朝前；游到猎物下方，就立刻朝上，好用背上的嘴攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's eyes can look in any direction. They will face forward as it moves by undulating its metal limbs, then will turn upwards as soon as it swims beneath prey, so that it can attack with the mouth on its back.

entry: POKENAME全身甲片都是金属。用头上的角夹住猎物后，再用利爪解决。
author: .jerden
source: The armor plates that cover its body are all made of metal. After trapping prey between the horns on its head, POKENAME will finish it with its sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME会用硬头撞击在建建筑，撞落钢梁。若不赶走，它就会试着吃掉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hits its hard head into buildings under construction to knock loose steel beams. It will try to eat them unless shooed away.

entry: POKENAME过热时，后脑的嘴会张开呼气。这通常发生在吃矿石时，可能源于消化产生的热量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's mouth on the back of its head opens to exhale air when overheated. This usually happens while it's eating ore, likely due to the heat from digestion.

entry: POKENAME背上的凶恶巨颚，看见什么都吞。结果POKENAME总是吃得肚子满满，懒得活动。
author: nellnast42
source: The vicious jaws on POKENAME's back devour anything and everything in sight. This leaves POKENAME constantly stuffed and lazy, though.

entry: POKENAME坚硬的钢鳞与利爪能抵御大多数正面攻击。它用头上带刺的巨角护住背后，幼崽也能躲在角与身体之间，受到保护。
author: .jerden
source: Its hard steel scales and claws protect it from most frontal attacks. It uses the large spiky horn on its head to cover its own back, and its young may shelter between this horn and POKENAME's body for protection.

entry: POKENAME空心身体上那颗巨口状的“头”，主要用于虚张声势，无法咬合。它借此吓走靠近墓穴家园的对象。
author: .izik
source: The large maw-like 'head' on POKENAME's hollow body is mainly for show and cannot bite down. It uses this feature to scare others away from its crypt home.

entry: POKENAME张着巨口缓缓漂过水中，甚至能将长达两米的宝可梦整个吞下。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME drifts slowly through the water with its huge, mostly open mouth. It can even swallow Pokémon up to two meters in size in one piece.

entry: 古老民间故事说，POKENAME吞食恶人的灵魂，存于后脑假嘴内。故事还说，这些灵魂为邪恶力量供能，用来诅咒无可救药的恶徒。
author: sk372
source: Old folk tales say that POKENAME devours the souls of the wicked, storing them in the false mouth on the back of its head.  The stories further say the stored souls are used to fuel its wicked powers, used to cast hexes upon the irredeemably evil.

entry: POKENAME头上长着带牙植物。它本身温顺，植物却有有限的独立意识，防卫心极强，会咬向任何靠近的东西。
author: sk372
source: A toothy plant grows upon POKENAME's head. Though POKENAME itself is docile, the plant has a limited mind of its own and is very defensive, biting at anything that draws near.

entry: POKENAME后方的巨口会呼出甜雾，带着树果般的香气。雾有强烈麻痹效果，中招的生灵很快便被吞入颚中。
author: sk372
source: The large mouth on POKENAME's rear breathes out a sweet mist that carries a berry-like sweet scent. This haze has a strong paralytic effect; those stunned by it are quickly swallowed up into its jaws.

entry: POKENAME背着其他宝可梦，沿途用尾嘴拾起金属碎片吞下。壳由泥土构成，会逐渐硬化成钢。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME carries Pokémon on its back, picking up bits of metal with its tail mouth and swallowing them along the way. Its shell is made out of soil which gradually hardens into steel.

entry: POKENAME背上的树会定期结果。树果不能吃，硬如钢铁，成熟后砰然落地。
author: .izik
source: The tree on POKENAME's back periodically grows berries. These berries are inedible and as hard as steel, falling to the ground with a thud when they mature.

entry: POKENAME有点爱恶作剧，装出天真无邪的模样，引人靠近。距离够近，头上假嘴便会张开，吐出火球，开个恶毒的小玩笑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a bit of a prankster, luring others close with a falsely innocent and naive persona. Once close enough, its false mouth on its head opens to spit fireballs at them as a malicious little prank.

entry: POKENAME钢制尾巴的末端，是大张的利齿巨口。它确实能充当第二张嘴，却尝不出味道，因此专门用来吃不喜欢的食物。
author: imaginita
source: Its steel-covered tail ends in a gaping, toothy maw. This jaw can actually function as a second mouth, though it can't taste anything. POKENAME uses it to eat foods it doesn't like.

entry: POKENAME会熔化洞里找到的金属矿石，像喝水一样饮下。每一滴都能强化包着金属的骨骼。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME melts metal ore it finds in caves, drinking it like water. Each drop strengthens its metal-encased bones.

entry: POKENAME与最初的印象不同，其实十分友善，会喷出泡泡玩耍。但食量极大，太饿时便会发破坏力惊人的脾气。
author: infinex21
source: Despite initial assumptions, POKENAME are incredibly friendly and will spout bubbles to play with. However, these Pokémon have incredible appetites and will throw devastating tantrums when they become too hungry.

entry: POKENAME臂下的牙一生不断再生。它会用海岸岩石磨牙，轻易撕开猎物与植物。
author: jaminmcready
source: The teeth on the undersides of POKENAME's arms continually regrow throughout its life. It sharpens them against coastal rocks, allowing it to easily tear through prey and plants.

entry: 只要察觉不敬，POKENAME就会用末端带刺的鳍攻击，把冒犯者喂进腹部巨口。科学家仍不确定，这是本能使然，还是巨口有自己的意识。
author: notadoctor75
source: If it senses any disrespect towards it, POKENAME will lash out with its barb-tipped fins and feed the offender to the gaping maw on its stomach. Scientists are still unsure if this is based on instinct or if the maw has a mind of its own.

entry: POKENAME几乎一动不动，耐心等待。毫无戒心的猎物进入范围后，它便以强大肺活量吸进颚中，猛然合拢，不让逃脱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME remains almost completely still, biding its time. When unsuspecting prey wanders within range, it uses powerful lung capacity to inhale its new meal into its jaws, which clamp down and allow no escape.

entry: POKENAME的头会呼唤寻宝者拿起剑。可一进入范围，可怜的冒险者就会被巨颚咬住。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's head calls out to treasure hunters to pick up the sword. Once in range, its jaws chomp down on the poor adventurer.

entry: POKENAME用强颚将猎物固定，刀刃则将其切碎。训练家战斗时若太被动，也会遭它攻击。
author: jodue
source: POKENAME uses its powerful jaws to hold its prey still while the blade cuts it to pieces. It will attack its Trainer if they are too passive in battle.

entry: 有许多传闻说，POKENAME上半身只是诱饵，尾端嘴状附肢才是真正的宝可梦。虽然缺乏证据，似乎确实只有这条“尾巴”和嘴会动。
author: infinex21
source: There are many rumors that the upper body of a POKENAME is just a decoy, and that the mouth-like appendage at the end of its tail is the real Pokémon. Though there is a lack of proof, this “tail” and mouth are all that ever seem to move.

entry: POKENAME尾上的嘴张开时，会放出强烈热量，几乎能烘干附近一切。嘴本身也滚烫，哪怕短暂接触都会烧伤。
author: .izik
source: When the mouth on POKENAME's tail opens, it releases an intense heat capable of drying out nearly anything nearby. The mouth itself is scorching to the touch, causing burns after even brief contact.

entry: 神奥神话与古画常将POKENAME描绘为“空间守门者”。它很少用双叉戟战斗，但一旦出手，斩击就能撕裂空间，留下危险的黑洞般裂隙。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME is often described and portrayed in ancient drawings as the "Gatekeeper of Space" in Sinnohese myths. It rarely battles with its bident, but when it does, its slashes tear apart space itself, creating a dangerous, black hole–like rift.

entry: POKENAME必须喂养背上的双颚，才能为能量炮击供能。颚炮几乎什么都能当燃料，连厚铁梁也咬得穿。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME must feed the jaws on its back to fuel its energy blasts. The jaw-cannon can use almost anything as fuel, and it is able to chew through even thick iron beams.

entry: POKENAME在满月下起舞时，额外的嘴会响亮咬合。许多生灵聚来观看，被仪式般的动作吸引。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's extra mouth makes loud snapping noises as it dances under a full moon. Many gather to watch this behavior, fascinated by the ritualistic movements.

entry: POKENAME的第二张嘴会释放金属粉，供某些廉价版驱赶球使用。粉末能使目标麻痹，是有效制住宝可梦的工具。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's second mouth releases metallic powder, which is used in some discount versions of Pester Balls. The powder's paralytic properties make it an effective tool in stunning Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME在后脑的颚中储存诅咒能量。传闻，盯着嘴内看得太久，无论走到哪里，都将产生满眼牙齿的幻觉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME store cursed energy in the jaws on the back of their head. It is rumored that staring into their mouths for too long will lead people to see hallucinations of teeth everywhere they go.

entry: POKENAME在森林里装作树桩，纹丝不动。小宝可梦靠近，就一口吞下。
author: klgb76
source: In the forest, POKENAME stays as still as a tree stump, patiently waiting for small Pokémon to approach before eating them whole.

entry: POKENAME沿洞顶飞掠，凶猛捕猎。尾巴上的几张嘴饥饿贪食，怎么也填不饱。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME savagely hunts by soaring across the ceilings of caves. The mouths on its tail have a ravenous, insatiable appetite.

entry: POKENAME虽看似无害，受威胁时却会收缩牙龈，完全露牙。对闻不惯气味的东西，它会戒备地咬去；谁若带来好玩的啃咬物，它就会十分喜爱。
author: pjporwoll
source: Despite its harmless appearance, POKENAME retracts its gums to fully expose its teeth when threatened. It distrustfully bites at things it does not recognize the scent of, but becomes enamored with those who bring it fun objects to chew.

entry: POKENAME把利齿角藏在黑毛间，出其不意地咬击敌人。野外，它对其他宝可梦敌意极强，甚至会攻击克制自己的对手。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME hides its toothy horn amongst its dark fur so it can launch surprise biting attacks at foes. In the wild, it is exceedingly hostile towards other Pokémon and will even attack opponents to whom it is vulnerable.

entry: POKENAME会闭紧额外的嘴，假装多长了翅膀，再毫无预警地狠狠咬下。主嘴无牙，因此它会先用其他颚磨碎喜爱的食物，再喂给主嘴。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME keeps its secondary maws closed so they appear to be additional wings, striking without warning with devastating chomps. Its main mouth lacks teeth, so it will grind up its favorite foods in the secondary jaws before feeding.

entry: POKENAME用毒刺般的尾巴，像挖掘机一样钻土。尾上锋利金属牙，连页岩也能轻松钻穿。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its stinger-like tail to dig through dirt like an excavator. It can burrow through shale with ease thanks to the sharp metal teeth on its tail.

entry: POKENAME耳上的假嘴，是特化的感觉器官。张大后便能感知附近生灵的波导，判断是否危险。
author: sk372
source: The false mouths on POKENAME's ears are specialized sensory organs. They open wide in order to sense the auras of those nearby and determine whether or not they are a danger to it.

entry: POKENAME醒着时，尾上巨口就睡着；本体睡着时，巨口反而醒来。它受袭或饥饿时才会醒，但无论哪种情况，都只想吃完继续睡。
author: infinex21
source: When POKENAME is awake, the maw upon its tail is asleep; likewise, when it is asleep, the maw on its tail is awake. POKENAME awakens when attacked or when it is hungry, but in either case, it focuses on eating and going back to sleep.

entry: POKENAME后脑的嘴不停开合。若不做这个动作，它就会焦虑，因此总反复开合，获得安慰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's mouth behind its head opens and closes constantly. It gets anxious if it isn't performing this motion and will do it repeatedly for comfort.

entry: 后脑勺的嘴闭合缓慢，力道却惊人。据说轻易就能在船身撕出巨大破洞。
author: chorb33
source: The mouth on the back of its head shuts slowly but with incredible force. It is said to be able to tear huge holes in ship hulls with ease.

entry: 后脑勺的嘴闭合缓慢，力道却惊人。据说轻易就能在船身撕出巨大破洞。
author: chorb33
source: The mouth on the back of its head shuts slowly but with incredible force. It is said to be able to tear huge holes in ship hulls with ease.

entry: POKENAME用颚状尾巴咬住敌人后，会试图将其抬到空中。升空后，再从后方的牙释放强力电击。
author: .izik
source: After latching onto a foe with its jaw-like tail, POKENAME attempts to lift them into the air. Once airborne, it releases powerful electric attacks through its rear teeth into the foe.

entry: POKENAME所有牙齿都带电，碰到很快就会迷失方向。它会先放出大火花，分散敌人注意，再以强颚迅速制住对方。
author: dodoowner_
source: All of POKENAME's teeth are charged with electricity, quickly disorienting those who touch them. POKENAME takes advantage of this by discharging large sparks to distract enemies before swiftly immobilizing foes with their powerful jaws.

entry: POKENAME唱歌时，巨口状的角会模仿嘴唇动作。随后，巨颚就会咬向那些已睡着的对象。
author: foolish_weasel
source: When POKENAME sings, its maw-shaped horns will mimic its lip movements. Afterwards, POKENAME's massive jaw will bite down on those who have fallen asleep.

entry: POKENAME利齿能咬穿钢梁，是工地的麻烦。它不停啃咬，很难让它远离贵重建筑结构。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's sharp teeth can eat through steel beams, making it a nuisance at construction sites. Its relentless chewing makes it difficult to keep away from valuable structures.

entry: POKENAME用巨口啃碎致密金属矿石。它偏爱最深最暗、矿藏丰富的洞穴通道。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its great maw to chew through dense metal ores. It prefers the deepest, darkest cave passages where rich deposits lie.

entry: 巨大的颚状颈部锥体，让多数人觉得POKENAME丑又可怕。它其实十分友善，那锥体也不伤人，只负责防御天敌。
author: klgb76
source: Despite being considered ugly and scary by most because of its huge, jaw-like neck cone, POKENAME is actually a very friendly Pokémon. The neck cone is inoffensive and only serves as protection from the predators.

entry: POKENAME坐在树洞里，只露出温顺的脸。毫无戒心的宝可梦靠近时，它就转身，用金属颚咬下。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME will sit in tree hollows, only leaving its docile face visible. When unsuspecting Pokémon wander over, it will turn around and snap at them with its metallic jaws.

entry: POKENAME会唱歌，让对手以为自己无害。头上巨口能吸入大量空气，鼓起身体，让歌唱得更久。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME will sing in order to lull its opponents into thinking it is harmless. The massive mouth on its head can take in huge gusts of air that inflate its body and allow it to sing for longer.

entry: 没人说得清POKENAME为何变成这样。只知道抱它一下，往往就得去医院。
author: mossybanana
source: No one quite knows how POKENAME wound up the way it did. It is, however, known that a hug will often result in a visit to the hospital.

entry: POKENAME牙间滴落的毒液，会吸引小宝可梦。它藏在花坛中，引诱猎物靠近。
author: mistymagius
source: The poison that drips from POKENAME's teeth attracts small Pokémon. It will hide in flower beds to lure in its prey.

entry: 它嘴状双手里的尖牙比钢更硬，最韧的食物也能轻松吃下。两张巨口会产生黏滑“唾液”，其中毒素能引发持久皮疹。
author: infinex21
source: The fangs of its maw-like hands are harder than steel, allowing it to consume even the toughest of foods with ease. Within these two maws, it produces a slimy "saliva" that is laced with toxins that induce long-lasting rashes.

entry: POKENAME朝路人甜甜地眨眼，等谁上钩。一旦停下，后脑双颚便会咬住对方，拖走。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME blinks sweetly as passers by, waiting for somebody to take the bait. Anyone who stops will be snapped at by the jaws on the back of its head and dragged away.

entry: POKENAME的滑稽面孔，让对手很难认真看待。这恰好有利于它突然露出金属颚，狠狠咬下。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's goofy face makes it hard to take seriously. This works to its advantage when it suddenly reveals its metal jaws and chomps its opponent.

entry: POKENAME飞过地下深处的洞穴时，会用钢牙咬住猎物。锋利尖牙让它成为强大的捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its steel fangs to bite down onto its prey when flying through deep underground caverns. Its sharp fangs make it a formidable predator.

entry: POKENAME的尾羽坚如钢铁。奇怪的是，一旦脱落，几分钟内就会变得极其柔软。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tail feathers are as hard as steel. Curiously, once shed from its body, they become incredibly soft within minutes.

entry: POKENAME大多数养分都供给双翼与颚，因此头脑愚钝，还会不停暴食，直到难受得动不了。农夫饲养风速狗，防止牲畜被它放干血或吞食。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is dim-witted since the majority of its nutrition goes to its wings and jaws, and will go on a feeding spree until it is too sick to move. Farmers keep Arcanine to protect their livestock from being exsanguinated or devoured by POKENAME.

entry: 它常住在湖里，将巨口埋入沙中。发光的尾巴吸引小宝可梦，待对方毫无防备，再发动攻击。
author: radiationv2
source: It's often found in lakes, hiding its maw under the sand. It uses its glowing tail to attract smaller Pokémon, then attacks when they are vulnerable.

entry: POKENAME能将身上的宝石，凝成镰刀般的利刃。虽能完全化作一把镰刀，却只会交给身边可信赖的大嘴娃使用。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are able to condense the gems along their body into scythe-like blades. While they are capable of fully transforming into a scythe, they only do so when there is a trusted Mawile nearby to wield them.

entry: 可信赖的大嘴娃与它结下羁绊，压住了POKENAME的狂性。战斗中，它化作镰刀，吞噬邪恶宝可梦的灵魂，越战越强，直到足以比肩死神。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: With their madness kept in check thanks to their bond with a trusted Mawile, POKENAME take the form of a scythe in battle. They eat the souls of evil Pokémon, gaining strength after every battle until they can rival the Grim Reaper.

entry: 它头上第二只角形似宝箱，装着许多宝石与金币。以财宝作饵，便能将毫无戒心的旅人引入巨口，短短几分钟就吞食殆尽。
author: infinex21
source: It stores many precious gems and gold coins within the chest-like second horn attached to its head. Using these treasures as bait, it lures many unsuspecting travelers into its awaiting maws and devours them in mere minutes.

entry: POKENAME会朝金属物品喷出强酸性蓝油。金属缓慢分解时，它会一边小心吃，一边提防捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spews a blue oil onto metal objects that is highly acidic. It eats cautiously while watching for predators as the metal slowly degrades.

entry: 夜里，它把身体埋入地下睡觉。谁若误踩，就会发现钢制羽饰相当锋利。
author: hophoppip
source: At night, it buries its body underground to sleep. Those who mistakenly trample it will discover that its steel plumes are quite sharp.

entry: POKENAME会被悲伤沮丧的宝可梦吸引。起初像是在安慰，但对方一放松警惕，四张嘴中最近的一张便会咬过去。
author: hophoppip
source: It gravitates towards Pokémon who are feeling sad or discouraged. It initially seems to be cheering them up, but once the other Pokémon drops its guard, POKENAME chomps at it with the closest of its four mouths.

entry: POKENAME后方的嘴常装满碎石，摇动时像沙锤般作响。跳舞时，它便用作乐器，保持节拍。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's rear mouth is regularly filled with gravel that rattles like a maraca when shaken. It uses this as an instrument to keep its beat while dancing.

entry: POKENAME把双臂环在身上，假扮一袋垃圾。没人看时，就会吃掉放在外面的垃圾。
author: bigblue
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a bag of garbage by wrapping its arms around itself. It eats garbage left out when nobody is looking.

entry: POKENAME发丝般的嘴啃食垃圾，喷出恶臭烟雾。牙上满是有害细菌，让咬伤也带着毒性。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's hair-like mouths munch on garbage and spew out foul-smelling fumes. Their teeth are coated in bad bacteria, causing its bite to be toxic.

entry: POKENAME住在地下湖，喜爱黑暗。若被发现，它会跃出水面，冲向发现者，以鬼面赶走对方。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME resides in underground lakes where it enjoys the darkness. If spotted, it leaps from the water at the source and uses Scary Face to drive it away.

entry: POKENAME发展出骑在第二颗头上的独特能力。这样最好不过，因为第二颗头常不思考也不计划，自顾自地移动。
author: atlas3339098
source: POKENAME has developed a unique ability to ride its second head. This is for the best, as the second head often moves of its own volition without thought or planning.

entry: POKENAME是狡诈恶毒的森林幽灵，戴着木质假脸，让其他对象误以为安全。它们装出安慰或关心的模样，悄悄靠近受害者，狠狠咬上一口。
author: sk372
source: Tricky and malevolent forest spirits, POKENAME lull others into a false sense of security with the false wooden face they wear, pretending to be comforting or concerned so they can slip up closer to a victim and take a big bite.

entry: POKENAME夜里独处时，额外的嘴会发出尖锐高鸣，用来吸引潜在配偶、宣示领地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's extra mouths emit a high-pitched screech when it is alone at night. This sound is used to attract potential mates and establish territory.

entry: 雨天，POKENAME看起来像空中的乌云。饿了就从天上直接抓走小型飞行属性宝可梦，作为食物。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME look like dark clouds in the sky on a rainy day. When they are hungry, they find small Flying-type Pokémon to eat by plucking them right out of the sky.

entry: POKENAME的两副巨大铁颚极其灵活，猛然合拢的力量足以碎裂实心岩石。它用来捕捉毫无戒心的猎物。
author: hereisanimations
source: POKENAME's two massive iron jaws are extremely agile, snapping shut with enough force to destroy solid stone. It uses these jaws to catch unsuspecting prey.

entry: 据说，这种宝可梦常见的盛开巨口下，还藏着一颗小头。但没人见过，至少没有活着证实所见的人。
author: infinex21
source: Supposedly, there is a smaller head of this Pokémon beneath the large, blooming maw so oft seen. However, none have ever seen this smaller head, or survived seeing it at least, to confirm this.

entry: POKENAME大多温顺，只有觉得受威胁才咬。但双颚一合，力量足以将粗树干咬成两半。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is a mostly docile Pokémon who will only bite if it feels threatened. However, its powerful jaws can chomp down with enough force to snap a thick tree trunk in half.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，会用嘴咬住布满钟乳石的海洞顶，悬挂起来。哪怕只受一点打扰，也会使出吸取反击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hangs from stalactite-filled sea cave ceilings by its mouths while sleeping. Should it be disturbed even slightly, it retaliates with Absorb.

entry: POKENAME的沙质身体贴在洞顶，避免被看见。若谁抬头发现，它就会落下，裹住对方的头。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's sandy body clings to cave ceilings to stay out of sight. Should someone glance upward and spot it, it drops down and wraps around their head.

entry: POKENAME的爪兼作嘴，能储存些食物以后吃。背上蘑菇释放微弱信息素，吸引小生灵靠近，让狩猎更容易。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's claws double as mouths, letting it store some food for later. The mushrooms on its back release a faint pheromone that attracts smaller creatures close to it, making hunting easier.

entry: POKENAME常扮成遇险少女，希望把高尚勇士引进沙宫，饱餐一顿。中世纪结束后，它们的数量明显减少。
author: sith6834
source: POKENAME are frequently seen acting like damsels in distress, hoping to lure noble warriors into their palace of sand to feast upon. Populations of POKENAME have noticeably dwindled since the end of the medieval era.

entry: POKENAME以声波为食，用颈上吸音膜吸收噪声。它们常住在喧闹城区，吃声音就能摄取充足养分，也让城市安静一些。
author: occulusmalus
source: POKENAME feeds on sound waves, using the sound-absorbing membranes on its neck to soak up noise. They are often found in loud urban environments, receiving plenty of nourishment from the sound they eat, and making the cities quieter in the process.

entry: POKENAME住在废弃住宅，假装普通钢琴。毫无戒心的冒险者一靠近，它就活过来，咬合利齿巨口，追逐对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives within abandoned homes, pretending to be a normal piano. Once an unsuspecting adventurer comes near, it springs to life and chases after them, gnashing its toothy maw.

entry: POKENAME身体产生的黄宝石价值极高，被认为能给持有者带来好运。为阻止贪婪矿工，它会从洞顶落下咬头，但大多数人只受轻伤便能逃走。
author: jaminmcready
source: The yellow gems produced by its body are highly valuable and are believed to bring good fortune to its holders. To stop greedy miners, POKENAME will drop from cave ceilings and bite the miners' heads, but most escape with only minor injuries.

entry: 它每根黑毛都是金属，质地易脆。毛中藏着第二张嘴，通常只有吓人或吃较大食物时才会露出。
author: infinex21
source: Each strand of its black fur is metallic and brittle. Concealed within its hair is a second mouth that it typically only reveals to scare others or to eat larger foods.

entry: POKENAME吃树根，增厚木壳。密度达到顶峰时，便会坚如铁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME consumes tree roots to thicken its wooden shell. At peak density it becomes as hard as iron.

entry: POKENAME背上的巨口必须不断进食，才能维持防护能力。长期没食物，壳就会变得柔软。
author: dodoowner_
source: The large mouth on its back must be constantly fed in order to keep its protective capabilities. If POKENAME goes through a long period of time without food, its shell will become soft to the touch.

entry: POKENAME用小树枝操纵所住洞穴岩石里的铁矿。这能引发坍塌，分散敌人注意，争取足够时间逃脱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME manipulates the iron ore within the stone of its cave habitat using its twig. This can trigger cave-ins, distracting the foe long enough for it to escape.

entry: POKENAME能预知你的未来，但只有喂给巨量食物才肯做。若双颚发出刺耳怪笑，就明确预示你的未来相当惨淡。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME can predict your future, but only does so when you feed it an enormous amount of food. If its jaws let out a harsh cackle, it is a telltale sign that your future will be quite grim.

entry: POKENAME速度极快，奔跑时气流猛拂，使颈部周围的巨口长期干燥。训练家会用特制用品，处理这种状况。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME are very fast Pokémon, and due to air whipping around them when running, they experience chronic dryness within the maw that surrounds their neck. Trainers utilize special products to treat this condition in their POKENAME.

entry: 看似细长的嘴，其实是高度特化的舌头。虽不及普通甲贺忍蛙的舌灵活，却坚韧得多，能紧咬对手，让其无望逃脱。
author: imaginita
source: What appears to be an elongated mouth is actually a highly specialized tongue. While not as flexible as a normal Greninja's tongue, it is far tougher and able to latch onto opponents, leaving no hope of escape.

entry: POKENAME从腹口放出浓厚紫粉。吸入会眩晕，让人迷失方向。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lets loose thick purple powder from the mouth on its abdomen. This powder can cause vertigo, disorienting anyone who inhales it.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉与味觉敏锐，因此变得挑食，可能几天都找不到理想的一餐。终于找到就一口吃下，再继续觅食。
author: heal_fire
