source: POKENAME have keen senses of smell and taste. Due to this, they become picky eaters and could spend days without finding the perfect meal. When they find it, they'll eat it in a single bite before resuming their search for more food.

entry: POKENAME腰间皮肤坚如铁。遭强攻时，它会将皮向上拉，作为护盾挡伤害。
author: .izik
source: The skin around POKENAME's waist is as hard as iron. It pulls it up when struck by powerful attacks, using it as a shield to block the damage.

entry: POKENAME用尖石或骨片装饰蜕皮，吓退威胁家人的对象。它很难信任外来者，但一旦对方证明自己，它就会形影不离，极力保护。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME decorates its shed skin with spiked rocks or bits of bone to scare off threats to its family. It is slow to trust outsiders, but once one proves themselves to it, POKENAME becomes inseparable and protective.

entry: POKENAME漂在成片荷叶间，头顶覆藻，融入环境。蚊香蛙皇若不幸跳上去，就会发现双腿已被巨颚夹住。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME float among patches of lilypads, covering the tops of their heads in algae to blend in. Politoed unfortunate enough to jump onto these Pokémon will find their legs trapped in their jaws.

entry: POKENAME喜欢开残酷玩笑，以可爱外表引人靠近，再用头上双颚咬下。它常入夜后现身，藏在高草间，有时被误认成人类孩子。
author: torterrable
source: POKENAME likes to play cruel jokes by luring people in with its cute appearance, then biting them with the jaws on its head. It often comes out after dark and hides in tall grass, where it is sometimes mistaken for a human child.

entry: POKENAME舞姿格外迷人，紧紧吸引周围目光。目标一分神，帽上细肢就会以极强力量抓住，再吞下。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's dance is especially captivating, holding the attention of those nearby. Once distracted, the tendril on its hat snatches its target with extreme force before devouring it.

entry: POKENAME在空中飘过一夜后，会用额外的嘴咬紧树木，悬挂睡觉。这样，旅行后就有安全的休息处。
author: .izik
source: After a night of floating through the sky, POKENAME clamps down on trees with its extra mouths and dangles to sleep. This behavior helps it secure a safe spot to rest after its travels.

entry: POKENAME高速划过夜空，额外的嘴垂在身后。迅疾的飞行，使它成为暗夜中的壮观景象。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME streaks through the night sky at high speeds, with its extra mouths dangling behind it. The speed of its flight makes it a spectacular sight in the dark sky.

entry: 没人完全清楚，POKENAME为何直接从腹部毛孔排出烟气。一些科学家推测，若融合更加完善，肚子也许会张开，成为第二张巨口。
author: bobosmith01
source: No one entirely knows why POKENAME vents smoke-laden gasses directly through the pores on its stomach. Some scientists have theorized that if Pokémon Fusion was better perfected, its belly could open up and act as a second maw.

entry: POKENAME跃出水面，用后方嘴状鳍咬紧海洞岩壁。固定后，同群其他成员也跟上，以相同姿势离水睡觉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaps from the water and clamps onto the walls of sea caverns using its rear mouth-like fin. Once latched, other members of its school follow before sleeping in that same position out of the water.

entry: POKENAME后脑的双颚会压住大脑。每次吃冷食，寒冷刺激都会让它脑袋剧痛，喝热饮就能缓解这种突然的疼痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a set of jaws on the back of their head that presses against their brain. Whenever they eat something cold, the chill presses against their brain and leads to a brain freeze. They can be cured of this acute pain with a hot drink.

entry: 它背对敌人，用附肢上的可怕巨口倒着战斗。一旦咬住，即使强壮的大宝可梦也挣不开。
author: pattybgoode
source: It faces away from its enemy and fights backwards with the terrifying maw on its appendage. The grip of that bite cannot be shaken by even large, strong Pokémon.

entry: 没人明白POKENAME为何能飞。它就是能靠背上的巨颚飞来飞去，不停追赶猎物。
author: mossybanana
source: No one is sure why POKENAME is capable of flight. Yet it flies around on its back-mounted jaws, which it uses to chase prey relentlessly.

entry: POKENAME第二张嘴上的螺旋会转动，催眠敌人，使其沉睡。对方还没反应过来，就会失去行动能力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's spiral on its second mouth rotates to hypnotize its foes into a deep slumber. This mesmerizing effect allows it to incapacitate enemies before they can react.

entry: POKENAME恼火时，头上覆钢的手能轻松举起卡车。这股爆发力，使它在战斗中极其强悍。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's steel-plated hand on its head can lift a truck with little effort when it's irritated. This burst of strength makes it incredibly formidable in battle.

entry: POKENAME爱使阴招，也爱炫耀巨大的第三只手。手段从挑衅、弹指，到抓起倒霉的对手，掐得对方透不过气，都用得出来。
author: partypooperrex
source: POKENAME are dirty fighters who love to show off their large third hand. These tactics can range from taunts and finger flicks to scooping up and choking unfortunate opponents.

entry: POKENAME靠体内特化气囊，浮在水面附近或海底。小宝可梦靠近那块看似奇石或怪植物的东西，就会被背上巨口吞食。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME float either near the water's surface or at the seafloor through use of specialized air pockets inside of its body. When a small Pokémon approaches what seems to be an odd stone or plant, they are devoured by the maw on POKENAME's back.

entry: POKENAME的大头只是一张掩饰真意的面具。它先用可爱动作骗得对手放松警惕，再以毒刺出击。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME's large head is merely a mask that conceals its true intentions. It fools opponents into complacency with cute gestures before striking with its toxic stingers.

entry: POKENAME虽然爪牙明显，却喜欢在路人面前装作温顺无害。这种欺骗纯粹为了取乐。
author: griddle
source: POKENAME likes to pose as docile and harmless to passersby, despite its obvious claws and fangs. The purpose of this deception is purely for entertainment.

entry: POKENAME虽然爪牙明显，却喜欢在路人面前装作温顺无害。这种欺骗纯粹为了取乐。
author: griddle
source: POKENAME likes to pose as docile and harmless to passersby, despite its obvious claws and fangs. The purpose of this deception is purely for entertainment.

entry: POKENAME向飞行的超音蝠扔石头，将其击落。落地后，再用头上的第二副颚撕咬。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME toss stones at flying Zubat to knock them down. Once grounded, they tear into them with the second set of jaws on their head.

entry: POKENAME会在洞里向超音蝠投巨石，拿下食物。石头用完，还能用头上巨颚咬住超音蝠。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME chuck boulders at Zubat inside caves to secure their meals. Whenever they run out of stones, they can bite onto the Zubat with the large jaws on their head.

entry: POKENAME尾颚始终留意食物与危险，本体却浑然不觉。研究者起初以为尾口才是主头，直到亲眼见到真正的头开始打鼾。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's tail-jaws remain in constant awareness for food and danger, even as the rest of the body remains oblivious. Researchers initially thought the tail-maw was the main head of the Pokémon, until they witnessed the actual head begin snoring.

entry: 甲壳化成了一副巨颚。POKENAME既用来挡住攻击，也会狠狠咬向靠得太近的敌人。
author: mossybanana
source: Its shell has become a set of jaws. POKENAME will use it to not only block attacks, but also bite down viciously on opponents that get too close.

entry: POKENAME额外的颚已紧咬自己的尾巴，对外危险有限。黏腻的巨口啃着尾巴，它却依旧无忧无虑，使大多数敌人以为它不知疼痛，因而畏惧。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME poses limited danger to others since its secondary jaws have latched firmly onto its own tail. The sight of its carefree attitude while the viscous maw gnaws on its tail intimidates most foes into believing it feels no pain.

entry: POKENAME两颗假头的颚带有磁力，将猎物拉近咬食。小巧可爱的外形催生大批周边商品，尤其在帕底亚。
author: sk372
source: Magnetism within the jaws of POKENAME's twin false heads pulls prey in closer to be bitten. Its small and cute appearance has inspired waves of merchandise, particularly in Paldea.

entry: POKENAME挥舞的大葱长出了颚。它甩动大葱，展示怪口，恐吓敌人。性格温顺、战力凶猛，因此很受女性训练家欢迎。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: The leek it wields has grown a jaw. POKENAME uses this leek to intimidate foes, whipping it around and displaying the monstrous mouth. It is quite popular among female Trainers for its meek personality and fierce battle prowess.

entry: POKENAME的双嘴静候，分泌淡淡气味，引来生灵吞食。虽然共用一个胃，两张嘴还是常想从彼此口中抢吃的。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's twin mouths lie in wait, secreting faint smells to draw creatures in to be devoured. The two often try to steal food out of the other's mouth, despite sharing a stomach.

entry: POKENAME的壳状巨口十分坚固，能抵挡多次攻击。本体却相当脆弱。
author: mossybanana
source: POKENAME's shell-maw is very sturdy, and will withstand many attacks. Its body, however, is quite frail.

entry: 若黑暗里出现诡异紫光，很可能是POKENAME正看着你。人们对它所知甚少，但传闻它能撕裂空间，凭空现身。
author: darxer_
source: If someone sees a purple, eerie glare from the darkness, it's probably a POKENAME watching them. Little is known about it, but rumors speculate that POKENAME can rip through space and appear out of thin air.

entry: POKENAME的巨颚是吓退加害者的幻影，还是内侧面孔才是引来猎物的诱饵，目前尚不清楚。由于它更喜欢彻底避开人类接触，前一种理论更受认可。
author: occulusmalus
source: It is unclear whether POKENAME's jaws are a phantasm intended to scare away those that would do it harm, or the inner face is a lure to draw prey closer. The former is the prevailing theory, as POKENAME prefers to avoid human contact entirely.

entry: POKENAME住在海滩，把自己埋入沙中，地面留下大洞作为陷阱。宝可梦一踩进去，双钳便咬向猎物，通常会割伤受害者的四肢。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME live on beaches where they bury themselves in the sand, leaving gaping holes in the ground to set up traps. When a Pokémon steps in one of these holes, POKENAME's pincers snap at their prey, usually cutting the limbs of the victim.

entry: POKENAME紧贴船底，用泡泡推动船前进。它们不负名字给人的印象，十分热切地想与人互动；虽然天生行动不便，仍希望探索世界。
author: victor9106
source: POKENAME cling to the underside of boats, using their bubbles to propel boats forward. Living up to their name, they are very eager and excited to interact with people, and wish to explore the world despite their lack of natural mobility.

entry: POKENAME从头骨长出长触须，覆有黏稠液体。物质散发极浓的苦味气息，吓退捕食者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME grows long tendrils from its skull coated in a viscous fluid. The substance gives off an intensely bitter scent that deters predators.

entry: 触手从POKENAME硬壳的一小处探出。小昆虫一飘进范围，就会被抓住，拉进壳内吃掉，作为加速进化的能量来源。
author: sk372
source: Tentacles protrude from a small portion of POKENAME's hard shell. Small insects that float within range will be snatched and pulled inside to be consumed as fuel to speed up its evolution.

entry: POKENAME住在海带丰富的地方，方便取食。有人见过它在海底拨弄蛤蜊与贝类，拿来玩耍。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME dwells in areas with lots of kelp for it to feast upon. It has been observed batting around clams and shellfish on the ocean floor for fun.

entry: POKENAME用扎根，将自己深深固定在珊瑚礁中，吸收珊瑚养分，强化厚壳。它能连续几天固定原处，不动一下。
author: .izik
source: Rooting itself deep into coral reefs with Ingrain, POKENAME strengthens its thick shell with nutrients from the coral. It can stay anchored for days without moving.

entry: 许多个体比最古老的红杉树还年长，古老外壳提供可靠防护。吸盘让它们有勇气忍受足以吓退其他生灵的可怕咆哮。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many are older than the oldest sequoia tree, as their ancient shells provide them with a reliable defense. Their suction cups give them the courage needed to endure frightening roars that would scare other creatures.

entry: POKENAME以长躯紧贴岩质海床，用花瓣般的附肢，捕捉随洋流漂来的海藻。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME clings to rocky sea beds with its long body. It uses its petal-like appendages to catch drifting seaweed in ocean currents.

entry: POKENAME喜欢趁退潮在石间翻找新朋友。许多生灵害怕它的众多触手，但它仍不放弃与水生宝可梦交友。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy sifting through rocks at low tide to find new friends. Many are frightened by their many tentacles, but that does not stop them from trying to befriend aquatic Pokémon.

entry: 一亿多年前，POKENAME繁盛于沿海浅水。花朵的浓烈香气，能同时引来陆地与海洋的猎物。
author: mepp.
source: Over 100 million years ago, POKENAME thrived in shallow coastal waters. The powerful fragrance from its flower lured prey from both land and sea.

entry: POKENAME附着岩石，以灯光引来其他宝可梦。谁一碰到就会触电，让它趁目标动弹不得，用触手拉进胃里。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME attaches itself to a rock and lures in other Pokémon with its lights. Anything that touches them will be shocked, giving POKENAME the opportunity to pull stunned prey into its stomach using its tentacles.

entry: POKENAME游在幽暗深海，用高度敏感的眼睛，狩猎会发光的宝可梦。触手碰到的一切，都会遭电击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME swims in the dark depths of the ocean, using its highly sensitive eyes to hunt for bioluminescent Pokémon. Anything it touches with its tentacles will be shocked.

entry: POKENAME虽只有一条伸缩舌，头上触角却会产生类似的黏性唾液，困住昆虫，留待以后慢慢吃。
author: sk372
source: Although it only has one extendable tongue, the antennae on POKENAME's head generate a similar sticky saliva that can trap insects for it to consume at its leisure later on.

entry: POKENAME生活在浑水中，以触手像船用螺旋桨一样转动前进。身体硬而坚韧，与珊瑚颇为相似。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lives in murky waters and moves around using its tentacles like a ship's propeller. Its body is hard and tough, not dissimilar to coral.

entry: 头上的花如螺旋桨运作。有时，大群POKENAME会从水中升起，飞过数百米。
author: chorb33
source: The blossom on its head works like a propeller. Sometimes large groups of POKENAME emerge from the water and fly many hundreds of meters.

entry: POKENAME能用花产生强劲气流，既可在水中瞬间转向，也能吹飞敌人。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can emit strong air currents via its flowers, which enables it to either change direction in the water immediately or blow enemies away.

entry: POKENAME蜷在海床，形似岩石。植物或贝类等小宝可梦想附着时，它就舒展身体，用触手困住，整个吞下。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME curls up on the seabed, taking on the appearance of a rock. When plants or small Pokémon like Shelder try and attach themselves to it, it unfurls and swallows them whole, trapping them with its tentacles.

entry: 这种宝可梦曾是远古海洋里的凶猛猎手。它用超能力催眠猎物，让其睡着。
author: enzo200
source: This Pokémon was once a vicious predator in the ancient sea. It used its psychic capabilities to hypnotize prey and set them to sleep.

entry: POKENAME借触手增强超能力。集中精神时，触手就会轻轻摇动。
author: elite01.
source: POKENAME uses its tentacles to amplify its psychic powers. If it's concentrating, its tentacles will begin to sway.

entry: POKENAME住在海下300米，必须靠红触手进行光合作用，产生能量。准备进化时，它会移到较浅处，开始用触手捕猎。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME lives in depths of 300m under the sea, where it has to rely on its red tentacles to photosynthesize and create energy. When POKENAME is ready to evolve, it will move to shallower depths and begin using its tentacles to catch prey.

entry: POKENAME狩猎时，会静止数小时，靠颈部花状附肢引来猎物。目标一靠近，头就猛然前冲，精准得致命。
author: mepp.
source: While hunting, POKENAME lies still for hours, relying on the flower-like appendages around its neck to lure in prey. The instant prey approaches, its head snaps forward with deadly precision.

entry: POKENAME藏在水下洞穴，胆小畏惧大多数其他水生生灵。众多触须能感知周围的存在与情绪，让它知道何时能安全探头。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides itself in underwater dens, timid and afraid of most other aquatic denizens. Its many feelers sense the presence and emotions of others around it, letting it know when it is safe to peek out.

entry: POKENAME头上的触手覆有黏液，能展开抓物。保护欲过强时，它就紧紧黏住地面，抓住训练家，直到觉得安全才肯放开。
author: sk372
source: The tentacles on POKENAME's head can spread out and grab things thanks to a sticky fluid coating on them. If it feels overly protective, it sticks itself firmly to the ground, grabs its Trainer, and refuses to let them go until it thinks it is safe.

entry: 从史前化石复活的POKENAME，曾生活在温暖海洋。人们认为，它是胆小虫等某些虫属性宝可梦的祖先。
author: mepp.
source: Resurrected from prehistoric fossils, POKENAME once lived in warm seas. It is thought to be an ancestor to some Bug-Type Pokémon like Wimpod.

entry: POKENAME潜伏古代遗迹的阴影中，保护里面的历史文物。它们会以一千条触手扑向入侵者，抓住后带到别处放走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lurk in the shadows of ancient ruins to protect the historical artifacts within. They descend on intruders with one-thousand tentacles to capture and release the intruders elsewhere.

entry: POKENAME将触手伪装成长剑，吸引寻宝的猎物。对方一进范围，就被抓住，整个吞下。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME disguises its tentacle as a sword to attract treasure-hunting prey. When they come within range, it snatches them and eats them whole.

entry: POKENAME下半身抓握力极强。它会紧抓大型对手，用刀刃不停刺击，直到获胜或被击倒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's lower body has excellent gripping power. It grapples onto larger opponents and ceaselessly stabs away at them with its blades until either victorious or knocked out.

entry: 新技术让POKENAME从古老化石中复活。研究认为，它会固定在海岸崖壁，挥舞黏性触须，捕捉飞得太近的猎物。
author: mepp.
source: New technology allowed POKENAME to be reanimated from ancient fossils. Research suggests it would anchor itself to coastal cliff faces and wave its sticky tendrils, ensnaring any prey that flew too close.

entry: POKENAME静止不动，摇摆触手假扮海藻，既能防卫，也能捕猎。触手能迅速再生，内含镇静成分。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME stand still and sway their tentacles to appear as seaweed. This serves as both a defensive mechanism and a means by which they hunt for prey. These tentacles regrow quickly and contain a calming compound within them.

entry: POKENAME静伏海底，造出形似可怕宝可梦的壳，吓退对手。它们从壳缝伸出触手挥动，过滤周围海水中的食物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME remain motionless on the sea floor, creating a shell in the shape of intimidating Pokémon to scare off rivals. They feed by filtering food out of the seawater around them, waving their tentacles from the gaps in their outer shell.

entry: POKENAME住在深海，藏在黑暗中，等猎物从上方游过。目标一经过，就会被触手缠住。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME live in the depths of the sea, hiding themselves in the darkness for prey to swim above them. When their prey pass over, POKENAME use their tentacles to ensnare them.

entry: POKENAME周身的神秘火焰虽然温度极高，光却很微弱。有理论认为，它是故意压暗火光，隐藏真身。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The mysterious flames that surround a POKENAME's body emit very little light despite burning at high temperatures. It is theorized that POKENAME dim their flames on purpose to hide their true bodies.

entry: POKENAME的水下栖地，似乎与史前陨石坠海的地点有关。它平时不太活动，但流星雨之夜会变得积极狩猎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's underwater habitat appears to be linked to where meteors fell into the ocean in prehistory. It remains relatively inactive, but nights of meteor showers see it becoming a much more active hunter.

entry: POKENAME虽长得像活力的化身，却曾被观察到连续几个月一动不动。好奇小生灵一靠近，它便突然爆发力量，猛扑过去。
author: wilmervr
source: Despite taking the visage of the very embodiment of vigour, POKENAME have been observed staying completely still for months at a time. Should a curious critter approach POKENAME it will pounce on them with a sudden burst of power.

entry: POKENAME是悠闲的水栖融合体，待在温暖海域的浅处，以触须收集漂过的浮游生物。
author: hophoppip
source: A relaxed aquatic fusion, POKENAME sits in the shallows of a warm sea, collecting passing plankton in its tendrils.

entry: POKENAME好奇地在构成身体的黏液中漂浮。头脑比身体行动更快，因此移动时黏液总拖在后面。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME curiously float around within the slime that makes up their bodies. Their minds work faster than their bodies, leaving their slime trailing behind them as they travel.

entry: POKENAME藏在洞穴黑暗中，以身上伸出的黏性触手攫住猎物，拖回巢里。身体对振动高度敏感，再轻的脚步也能察觉。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME hides in the darkness of caves, using the sticky tentacles that extend from its body to snatch prey and drag them into its lair. Its body is highly sensitive to vibrations, allowing it to detect even the quietest footsteps.

entry: POKENAME住在海底火山附近，钻入玄武岩，帮助熔岩在地壳中扩散。触手能变得炽热发光，逼退其他野生宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lives near undersea volcanoes and digs into basalt to help lava spread through the planet's crust. Its tentacles can become incandescent to keep other wild Pokémon at bay.

entry: POKENAME装死，用舌头散出腐臭，吸引食腐动物。对方靠近查看时，它就用翅膀铲进嘴里，拿下下一餐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME attracts scavengers who eat carrion by playing dead and wafting a putrid scent with its tongue. Once would-be scavengers come close to investigate, it scoops them into its mouth with its wings, securing its next meal.

entry: POKENAME住在古代沉船的宝箱里，从沙中收集矿物，加入收藏。它们用金币引来潜水者，抽取能量，再让人浮回水面。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME make their homes in treasure chests from ancient shipwrecks, collecting minerals from the sand to gather in their collections. They use gold coins to lure in divers before draining them of energy and letting them float back to the surface.

entry: POKENAME的脚像吸盘，能防止被洋流冲走，保持直立。古代，它们会用双颚咬碎猎物硬壳。
author: andromeda102037
source: POKENAME's feet are like suction cups, preventing them from being blown away by the ocean currents and keeping them upright. In ancient times, they would use their jaws to crush the hard shells of their prey.

entry: POKENAME把孢子织入浅滩沙中。长出的蘑菇能保持周围水质清洁，还能提供隐蔽栖地，养育幼崽。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME weaves spores into the sand of its shoal. The mushrooms that grow from this help keep the surrounding water clean and provide a sheltered habitat for raising its young.

entry: 它在浅海缓缓拖行，风浪大时用触手固定身体。触手还覆有麻痹孢子，POKENAME用来捕捉猎物。
author: imaginita
source: It slowly drags itself along the shallows of seas, using its tentacles to hold itself in place during rough waves. These tentacles are also covered with paralytic spores, and POKENAME uses them to capture prey.

entry: POKENAME善于伺机行事，会从挖掘现场偷走化石，让许多古生物学家十分头疼。幸好，巢穴常堆满化石，很容易辨认。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are opportunistic Pokémon that steal fossils from dig sites, much to the frustration of many paleontologists. Thankfully, their dens are often easily identified because they are full of fossils.

entry: 等所有人睡着，POKENAME会用众多触手黏住碎屑，清理化石挖掘现场，只留薄薄一层灰。古生物学家猜想，它们想帮忙，只是往往太害羞，不敢接触。
author: quackquackattack
source: When everyone is asleep, POKENAME clean fossil dig sites by sticking debris across their many tentacles, only leaving behind a thin layer of dust. Paleontologists speculate that POKENAME want to help but are often too shy to engage.

entry: POKENAME无声移过荒地，以触须吸取水分与矿物。人类会收集壳内形成的矿物，制作稀有的高精度合金。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME moves silently across barren ground, siphoning moisture and minerals through its tendrils. Humans collect the minerals that form in its shell to craft rare high-precision alloys.

entry: 比起待在陆地，POKENAME更爱在浅水游泳。构成尾巴的黏性触手会抓住小生灵，再升温烹熟，作为下一餐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME prefers to spend more of its time swimming in shallow waters than being on land. The sticky tentacles making up its tail grab onto small creatures and heat up to cook them into its next meal.

entry: POKENAME是鱼类宝可梦群的移动家园。觅食时，它一天能走过数英里海床。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME serves as a wandering home for schools of fish Pokémon. It can cross several miles of seafloor in a day when searching for food.

entry: 古代合众时期，强壮的POKENAME常被强盗用来闯入金库。触手过去钩金条，如今却用来在活动上表演戏法。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: During the times of Old Unova, POKENAME were often used by robbers to break into vaults thanks to their enhanced strength. While their tentacles used to snag gold bars, nowadays POKENAME use them to perform tricks at events.

entry: POKENAME靠触手在海底缓缓爬行，边走边品尝周围。硬壳能保护它，抵御大多数捕食者。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME slowly crawl across the ocean floor using their tentacles, tasting their surroundings as they move. Their hard shell protects them from most predators.

entry: POKENAME假扮花朵，藏在海底。猎物被两条巨触手抓住后，它便注入抽走生命的毒素。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME hides away on the ocean floor disguised as a flower. When prey is caught in its two large tentacles, it will inject them with a toxin that saps their life away.

entry: 数条黏性舌状器官，从POKENAME核心伸出。它在山地跋涉时，这些肢体会抓住眼前一切，拖回饥饿的中心。
author: sk372
source: Several sticky tongue-like organs stretch out from POKENAME's core. As it trudges around mountain areas, these limbs stretch out and grab anything in sight, dragging it back into its hungry center.

entry: POKENAME喜欢占据温暖海岸，偶尔才吃灌木。整体而言，维持生存所需的食物远少于小火马，游泳也稍好一些。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME tend to assert themselves by warm shorelines, only ocassionally eating shrubs. Overall, they need much less food to sustain themselves compared to Ponyta, and are somewhat better swimmers, too.

entry: 这种宝可梦总成对出现，情感显然深厚。年幼者看起来更活泼天真，受到更好斗、更内向的年长者保护。
author: sk372
source: Pokémon always seen together in a pair, sharing an obviously strong bond. The younger appears more energetic and naive, and is protected by the more aggressive and introverted older one.

entry: POKENAME操纵螺丝中的磁力，将自己固定在物体表面，专心用触手抓猎物。在现代，它靠吸附船只，扩散到许多地区。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME secures itself to a surface by manipulating the magnetic charge in its screw, allowing it to focus on snagging prey with its tentacles. In the modern world, it has spread across many regions by magnetizing to boats.

entry: POKENAME以触须安全探查海床觅食，脆弱的身体藏在壳内。人们曾多年以为它已灭绝，直到在暮水镇下方的洞穴发现群落。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME uses its tendrils to safely investigate the sea floor for food, while its vulnerable body hides within its shell. For many years it was believed to be extinct until a colony was discovered in caves beneath Pacifidlog Town.

entry: POKENAME在海底盘成一团，看起来比实际小得多。猎物靠近，它便猛然伸展开，出其不意地用黏性触手抓住。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME keeps itself coiled on the sea floor, presenting itself as much smaller than it truly is. It springs forth and extends when prey draws near, surprising them and grabbing them with its sticky tentacles.

entry: POKENAME进化出的眼斑，连最无畏的天敌也能吓住。那副假笑，其实是一排羽状刚毛，用来捕捉、电击浮游生物。
author: imademyselfdothis
source: POKENAME evolved to intimidate even the most fearless of predators with its eyespots. The false grin is actually an array of feathery bristles that it uses to catch and shock plankton.

entry: POKENAME固定在温暖浅水，摇摆触手，引来猎物。潮退后仍继续舞动，吸引许多海滩游客注意。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME anchor themselves in warm shallows and sway their tentacles in the water to lure in prey. Even when the tide lowers, they continue their dance, attracting a lot of attention from human beachgoers.

entry: POKENAME扎根海床，等待毫无戒心的猎物游过。只要有什么擦过双钳，它就会猛然合拢，力量足以夹断一棵树。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME roots itself to the seafloor as it waits for unsuspecting prey to swim by. When something brushes by its pincers, they close hard enough to snap a tree in half.

entry: POKENAME颈部触须抓住猎物，以灼热高温烤熟，再将残骸拉进嘴里。
author: hophoppip
source: The tendrils around POKENAME's neck grab its prey and sear it with burning heat, then pull the cooked remains into POKENAME's mouth.

entry: POKENAME沿温暖海床漂行，吞食沉入水下的机械残骸。吃完，粉色附肢就会发出炫目光彩。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts along warm sea floors, consuming mechanical debris that sinks beneath the waves. After feeding, its pink appendages glow in a dazzling display.

entry: POKENAME装作野生卡比兽，懒洋洋地躺着。猎物靠近，真正的身体就会一把抓住。
author: dodoowner_
source: A POKENAME pretends to be a wild Snorlax, lazing around. When its prey gets close, its real body snatches them.

entry: POKENAME每条触手都储有一点超能力。以复杂图案舞动触手，便能让敌人的肢体悬浮并加以操纵。一被精神能量困住，鲜少能挣脱。
author: quackquackattack
source: Each of POKENAME's tentacles stores a bit of their psychic power. By moving their tentacles in complex patterns, they can levitate and manipulate the limbs of foes. Few are able to break away once ensnared by their psychic energy.

entry: POKENAME狩猎时，会假扮圆木，缓缓漂过栖居的湖。产卵后，它们用钩爪抓紧地面，尾巴鞭打靠得太近的一切。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: When hunting, POKENAME slowly drift through the lakes they reside in, mimicking logs. After laying eggs, POKENAME use their hooked claws to cling to the ground, whipping anything that gets too close with their tails.

entry: 这种宝可梦的海绵状鬃毛，能吸收并储水，用来攻击。一旦干燥，POKENAME就会试着跳进最近水域，补充储备。
author: raydrago
source: This Pokémon's spongy mane helps it absorb and store water for its attacks. When it dries out, POKENAME will try to dive into the nearest body of water to recharge.

entry: POKENAME用黏性大触须固定在海床，避免被洋流卷走。它始终留意猎物，也提防捕食者。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME anchors itself to the seafloor with its large sticky tendril to avoid being swept up by currents. It is on the constant lookout for both prey and predators alike.

entry: POKENAME生活在温暖浅水。白天，它摆动两条长触手，引起其他宝可梦注意，再电击任何碰到触手的对象。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lives in warm, shallow waters. During the day, it wiggles its two long tentacles to catch the attention of other Pokémon, then shocks anything that makes contact with them.

entry: POKENAME夜间最活跃，光亮得足以晃花其他宝可梦的眼睛。它用触手分泌的酸液消化猎物。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is most active at night, when its light glows bright enough to blind other Pokémon. It digests its prey using acid secreted by its tentacles.

entry: 它能水陆生活。水中将触手转作船用螺旋桨，空中则用作旋翼。
author: chorb33
source: It can live both in water and on land. In the water it rotates its tentacles like a ship's propeller, and in the air it uses them as a rotor.

entry: POKENAME用吸力贴在岩石上，再以触手抓住飘过的东西。不能吃的，就放掉。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME sticks itself onto rock formations with suction and catches things floating by with its tentacles. It releases anything that is not edible.

entry: POKENAME藏在珊瑚礁里，咬住靠得太近的猎物。还能像风扇一样转动触手，卷起强劲漩涡。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME hides in coral reefs and snaps at prey that gets too close. It can also rotate its tentacles like a fan to create powerful whirlpools.

entry: POKENAME深受种植者珍视，极小的池塘也能养活，还能在鸟接近庄稼前抓住。它太稀少，难以广泛使用，但新培育计划希望让这份本领更普及。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is prized by cultivators, as it can thrive in even the smallest ponds and snatch birds before they reach the crops. Its rarity prevents it from being widely used, but new breeding programs hope to make its helpful traits more accessible.

entry: POKENAME身体不断分泌腐蚀酶，轻松钻过泥。它们借此把蛋藏进泥里，再沿河缓缓漂流，张嘴狩猎。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME constantly excrete corrosive enzymes from their bodies, allowing them to burrow through mud with ease. POKENAME use this ability to hide their eggs in the mud while they hunt by slowly drifting down rivers with their mouths opened.

entry: 大多数POKENAME偏爱钻入深海无光带洞穴的岩壁；少数则已适应直接进入海底海沟，寻找猎物。
author: dreadbotlord
source: While most POKENAME prefer to burrow into rocky the walls of deep sea caverns in the aphotic zone, a small number have adapted to hunt their prey by directly venturing out into trenches along the floor of the ocean.

entry: POKENAME能把肢体缩至原长三分之一，让自己与小猎物都容进壳里。消化液漏出时常被误认成树果汁，喝下的人会被腐蚀口腔。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can fit itself and small prey within its shell by contracting its limbs to a third of their original length. Its digestive fluids get mistaken for Berry Juice when they leak out of its shell, melting the mouths of anyone who drinks them.

entry: POKENAME以可爱外表把小孩引进巢穴，整个吞食。许多与儿童有关的悬案，都被认为是它所为。
author: sottiwotti
source: POKENAME uses their cute look to lure small children to their nests, swallowing them whole. Many unsolved children cases are thought to be the work of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME曾常见于世界各地，后来却灭绝。现代科学让它重回世界，很快成为岩山与海岸的顶级捕食者。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME used to be commonly found throughout the world, but has since gone extinct. Thanks to modern sciences, it has been reintroduced to the world, and quickly became an apex predator on rocky mountains and coasts.

entry: POKENAME虽然身体脆弱、无法移动，却是高效猎手。有些会与鱼类宝可梦合作，由鱼引来猎物，自己则提供庇护作为回报。
author: _pixelar_
source: Despite its immobile and brittle body, this Pokémon is an efficient predator. It has been observed that some POKENAME team up with other fish Pokémon, with the fish luring prey to the POKENAME and it in turn providing shelter the other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME植物般的身体里流着强电流。皮肤会模仿扎根海床的材质。
author: .izik
source: A strong electrical current runs through POKENAME's plant-like body. Its skin mimics whatever material makes up the seafloor that it ingrains into.

entry: POKENAME创作前会长时间观察描绘对象，更好地理解其本质。画作几乎总是斑斑点点的抽象画，却别有古典韵味。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME study their artistic subjects for extended periods of time before they work to better understand their true essence. Their paintings are almost always splotchy abstractions, but they manage to capture a classical charm.

entry: POKENAME住在最深的海域，狩猎时会从海床沙中挪出。巨手覆满微小黏性触手，被抓住后几乎不可能逃脱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME inhabits the deepest regions of the ocean, shuffling up from the floor's sands when it comes time to hunt. Its large hands are covered with minuscule sticky tentacles that make escaping its grip all but impossible.

entry: POKENAME栖居浅水，等待大量小生灵聚集。它们跃出水面翻滚，用黏性附肢抓住小小点心，再拖回水里吃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME inhabits shallow waters, waiting until it sees a large amount of small creatures congregating. It leaps out of the water and rolls around, its sticky appendages capturing the tiny morsels to be dragged back into the water for consumption.

entry: POKENAME住在海底，通常以海藻与海带覆盖身体。巨大伸缩手臂能抓住游得太近的大鱼，轻松享用。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives on the ocean floor, typically covering its body with seaweed and kelp. Its massive extendable arms reach out and snatch large fish that swim too close, making them easy meals.

entry: 它住在海底地热喷口附近。头上粉色长触须利用热量，将水中有毒化学物质转化为食物。
author: .jerden
source: It makes its home near geothermal vents on the seafloor. The long pink tendrils on its head use the heat to convert toxic chemicals in the water into food.

entry: POKENAME拍动触手状双翼，掀起足以扬沙的波浪。这样能找出藏着的多刺菊石兽，那通常是它最爱的食物。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: By flapping their tentacle-like wings, POKENAME are able to cause waves strong enough to send sand flying. They do this to reveal hidden Omastar, which are typically a POKENAME's favorite meal.

entry: POKENAME双脚早已退化，如今靠黏性附肢移动。据说，它一旦抓牢什么，只要POKENAME不想放，就什么也扯不下来。
author: ayner
source: The feet of POKENAME are vestigial; it now uses its sticky appendages to move itself. It is said that once this Pokémon grabs something, nothing can unstick it if POKENAME doesn't want it removed.

entry: POKENAME潜伏网络空间，吞食遇到的恶意程序。若找不到，就会把头探出显示器，寻找树果。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME lurk in cyberspace, devouring malware it comes across. If it cannot find any, it will stick its head out of monitors in search of berries.

entry: POKENAME是伏击型的捕食者，会用黏性的触须吊在粗壮树枝上。它留下的分泌物，会让树枝长出苔藓。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: As an ambush predator, POKENAME will hang from thick branches using its sticky tendrils. The residue it leaves behind will grow moss on the branches.

entry: POKENAME能从任一只手伸出黏性触须，困住对手。触须也善于捕捉小昆虫，那是它喜爱的食物来源之一。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME extends sticky tendrils from either of its hands to immobilize opponents. The tendrils also work effectively to catch small insects, one of its preferred sources of sustenance.

entry: POKENAME靠颜色假扮普通变隐龙，以黄色眼状纹骗过猎物。“舌头”其实是能抓握的触手，会把猎物拉进假嘴，在里面享用。
author: tuskaninny
source: POKENAME uses its coloring to masquerade as a regular Kecleon, utilizing yellow eye-like patterns to fool its prey. Its "tongue" is actually a prehensile tentacle, with which it pulls its prey into the fake mouth to be feasted upon within.

entry: POKENAME会伏击，等毫无戒心的猎物来到身旁，再突然显形。灵体形态的外缘能黏住生灵，抓牢后，更容易完全包裹吞食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is an ambush hunter, waiting until unsuspecting prey is next to it before manifesting suddenly. The outer edges of its spirit-like form adhere to living things, grabbing hold and making them easier to completely envelop and consume.

entry: POKENAME的双颚能分泌消化液，溶解猎物。因此，它总更喜欢用这些颚吃东西。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's jaws can create a digestive fluid that melts its prey. This causes the Pokémon to always prefer eating with these jaws.

entry: POKENAME藏在海底，从沙中冲出，袭击猎物宝可梦。身体究竟多长，至今仍未知。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME hides on the ocean floor, erupting from the sand to attack prey Pokémon. The true length of its body has yet to be discovered.

entry: 许多曾被认为早已灭绝的宝可梦，后来在POKENAME背上被发现繁盛生存。部分原因是它偏爱固定在海洋最深处。
author: mepp.
source: Many Pokémon once thought long extinct have been discovered thriving on POKENAME's back. This is due in part to POKENAME preferring to stay anchored to the deepest parts of the ocean.

entry: POKENAME追踪猎物往往长达数周，才会出击。视力极佳，连海底猎物也能看见，因此能远远跟随，让对方始终毫无察觉。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are known to stalk their prey for weeks on end before striking. POKENAME have excellent vision, even being able to see prey at the bottom of the ocean. This allows POKENAME to follow unsuspecting prey from a distance for weeks on end.

entry: POKENAME的鬃毛能吸水，转成腐蚀酶，消化猎物。它们先电击目标，再将其拖入水下。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME's mane has the unique property of absorbing water, converting it into a corrosive enzyme to digest prey. POKENAME hunt by zapping their prey before dragging their target underwater.

entry: 据说这只史前宝可梦住在热带水域，用扇状部位催眠猎物，吓退敌人。
author: the_smirker
source: This prehistoric Pokémon is said to have lived in tropical waters, using its fans to hypnotize prey and scare off enemies.

entry: POKENAME头上的触须覆有薄薄黏性物质。它穿梭林间跳跃，用缎带捕虫吃。
author: sk372
source: The tendrils growing from POKENAME's head are coated with a faint layer of a sticky substance. It prances through forests catching bugs to eat with its ribbons.

entry: 洛托姆偏爱电动机器，摇篮百合又只在过去数量繁盛，因此野生POKENAME很难研究。它们在深海洞穴游荡，若乘潜艇接近，就会试图劫持潜艇。
author: bobosmith01
source: Due to Rotom's penchant for electric-powered machines and Cradily only being populous in the past, wild POKENAME are difficult to study. They roam deep undersea caverns; approaching with a submarine causes them to attempt to hijack it.

entry: POKENAME跑遍自助洗衣店，从烘干机收集袜子，用于装扮。它们常在洗白衣时扔进红袜，把袜子洗成想要的粉色。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME run through laundromats, gathering socks from dryers for use in their costumes. They often throw red socks into white washing machine cylces to make the socks the pink color they desire.

entry: POKENAME视力有限，颈部触须却天生能感知环境，弥补不足。昆虫一嗡嗡飞过，触须就会抓住，丢进嘴里。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has limited eyesight, but its feelers on its neck make up for that with intrinsic senses of its surroundings. The moment an insect buzzes by, the feelers snatch it up and throw it into POKENAME's mouth.

entry: POKENAME身体软乎乎的，却出奇结实。它能用触须操纵物品，但看不见触碰的东西，做起来有些困难。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's body is squishy, but surprisingly durable. It can manipulate objects with its tendrils, but it has trouble doing so, as it can't see what it's touching.

entry: 只要不让POKENAME饿过头，它就友好温顺。否则，花苞会伸出摇篮百合状附肢，试图抓住并吞食一切够得着的东西。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is friendly and docile so long as it is not allowed to grow too hungry. If it does, a Cradily-like appendage emerges from its bud and attempts to grasp and devour anything it can grab hold of.

entry: POKENAME身上的眼睛是假纹样，真眼藏在始终张开的嘴里。背上触须会延伸，进一步抓牢咬住的目标，饱吸猎物血液时，便更难被扯下来。
author: sk372
source: The eyes on POKENAME's body are false markings; its real eyes reside within its always-gaping mouth. The tendrils on its back extend to grab onto anything it latches onto, making it increasingly difficult to pry off as it feasts on the prey's blood.

entry: POKENAME背上的长管状蘑菇形似触手。它能伸缩弯动蘑菇，够到高枝食物。
author: quackquackattack
source: The long tubular mushrooms on POKENAME's back resemble tentacles. By stretching and flexing these mushrooms, POKENAME can reach food on high branches.

entry: POKENAME生活在浅海，沉重身体能防止被浪冲走。退潮时，它们挖沙觅食，再用触手的麻痹孢子制服猎物。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME live in the shallows of seas, their heavy bodies protecting them from being washed away by waves. When the tide goes out, they dig in the sand to find prey, which they immobilize with paralytic spores from their tentacles.

entry: POKENAME虽慢，力气与伸缩触手却让猎物很难逃脱。它在珊瑚礁猎食，先用双臂砸碎珊瑚，再抓住躲藏的宝可梦。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite being quite slow, it is hard to escape a POKENAME due to its immense strength and stretchy tentacles. It hunts in coral reefs, smashing the coral with its arms before grabbing any Pokémon hiding away.

entry: POKENAME通过一根顶着活海星星的杖传导超能力。海星星似乎不介意被架在棍上带来带去。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME channels its psychic powers through a staff topped with a live Staryu, who doesn't seem to mind being carried around on a stick.

entry: POKENAME的头撞也是擒抱手段。头上黏性触手能强劲抓住对手，轻松将其举起、甩来甩去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's headbutt doubles as a way to grapple its foe. The sticky tentacles on its head latch onto its opponent with a powerful grip, allowing it to lift them up and swing them around with relative ease.

entry: POKENAME把头上触须扎在后面，表示容忍。若其他宝可梦不敬，它便解开触须，发动刺痛的攻击。
author: hophoppip
source: It keeps the tendrils on its head tied back as a sign of tolerance. When another Pokémon disrespects it, POKENAME unties its tendrils and uses them to unleash stinging attacks.

entry: 稀有神秘的POKENAME生活在海底。它用闪亮身体反射微光，引来猎物，再迅速挥出触手，将其缠住。
author: banjosaurus.
source: A rare and enigmatic Pokémon, POKENAME resides on the seafloor. It uses its shiny body to reflect what little light reaches it, drawing in prey before it quickly lashes out with its tentacles to ensnare them.

entry: POKENAME伸展触须，飞奔海床，边跑边用黏性附肢捕捉潜在猎物。停下后，就把触须送到嘴边，安心享用。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME race across the ocean floor with their tendrils outstretched, using the sticky appendages to catch potential prey as they run. When they come to a stop, they bring their tendrils to their mouth and settle down to enjoy their food.

entry: POKENAME对训练家十分忠诚，保护欲强。它始终守在身边，从颈部周围挥出黏性附肢，驱赶自认为可能的危险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very loyal and protective of its Trainer. It stands guard by their side constantly and will whip out sticky appendages from around its neck to ward off perceived potential dangers.

entry: POKENAME极其活跃，但尾上的触手百合常使它留在一处。它用超能力拖来猎物，再分泌腐蚀酶消化。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are incredibly active Pokémon; however, the Lileep attached to their tails typically keep them in one area. POKENAME use their psychic abilities to drag in prey before excreting corrosive enzymes to digest them.

entry: POKENAME从背上能抓握的触手喷出水炮，能弯转激流，射到难以够及的地方，是清洁人员的好帮手。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME shoots out Hydro Pumps from the prehensile tentacles on its back. It can bend the direction of the torrent to shoot into hard to reach places, making it a great helper for cleaning crews.

entry: POKENAME把自己埋进海床淤泥，向上伸触手引来猎物，再拖到下面吃。受惊时，它会喷水推进，从藏身处冲走。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME buries itself in the silt of the seafloor, extending its tentacles above to draw in prey before dragging them below to feed. When startled, it jets from its hiding place by blasting water to propel itself away.

entry: POKENAME遍布各大洋，闭着壳，用触须摸索猎物。抓住目标后就卷入壳内消化；若训练得当，则会制服猎物，交给捕鱼伙伴。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is found in all oceans, keeping its shell closed while feeling for prey with its tendrils. It grabs the target and reels it into the shell for digestion, but if trained well it will instead incapacitate its catch for its fishing companion.

entry: 被POKENAME催眠的对象，会梦见鲜活的史前世界。某些科学家认为，深入探索这些梦，或许能带来考古发现。
author: sk372
source: Those put to sleep by POKENAME's hypnosis dream vivid visions of a prehistoric world. Some scientists think exploring these dreams further could lead to archaeological discoveries.

entry: 野生POKENAME除了眼与脑，没有其他器官，寿命短得可怕。虽有人尝试延长寿命，却至今没有成果。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: Wild POKENAME have terrifyingly short lives, thanks to the lack of any organs aside from its eye and brain. There have been attempts at giving POKENAME a longer lifespan, but there haven't been any results.

entry: POKENAME在战场挥动骨状回旋镖，划出宽阔弧线。若没打中，就接上盐水，让敌人难以稳住阵脚。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swings its bone-like boomerang in wide arcs across the battlefield. If it misses, it follows up with Brine to keep foes off balance.

entry: POKENAME掌握着史前祖先卓越的狩猎技巧。但到了现代，这些战术已经过时几百万年。
author: gaogao028
source: POKENAME masters the exceptional hunting skills of ancestral Pokémon from a prehistoric period. In modern times, however, these tactics are millions of years out of date.

entry: POKENAME拍动石翼，便能高速冲向敌人，以利爪攻击。最近，人们用古林附近发现的外骨骼化石碎片，将它复活。
author: fiordaliso
source: By flapping its stone wings, it can dash at great speed towards its enemies and strike them with its claws. POKENAME has recently been revitalized by fragments of fossilized exoskeleton found near ancient forests.

entry: POKENAME身体太重，小肢体无法好好游泳，只能在海床挪动跳跃。猎不到合适的猎物，就退而从泥沙土中过滤食物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is too heavy for its small limbs to swim properly, so it shuffles and hops along the ocean floor. Unable to hunt proper prey, it settles for filter-feeding through the dirt, sand and mud.

entry: POKENAME在专门收录史前资料的网站游荡，吞食储存的数据。若放着不管，几小时就能吃空整座网站。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME roams websites devoted to prehistoric databases, feeding on stored data. If left alone, it can empty a website within hours.

entry: POKENAME用爪抓住海底崖壁，吃海带。进食时受打扰，就会使出泥巴射击逃脱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its claws to grip undersea cliffsides and eat kelp. If disturbed while eating, it unleashes a Mud Shot to escape.

entry: POKENAME在海床疾爬，咀嚼腐烂植物。硬壳能挡住过往船只抛下的锚。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME scuttles across the seafloor, chewing on rotten plant life. Its hard shell protects it from anchors dropped by passing ships.

entry: POKENAME生活在湍急河流，不断蜕皮长大。有人见过羽毛振动，但原因仍不明。
author: torterraguy26
source: POKENAME lives in fast-flowing rivers where it continually sheds its skin to grow larger. Its feathers have been seen vibrating for reasons not yet known.

entry: 传闻POKENAME的情绪能影响天气：一烦躁，就会降下暴雨。它会以石质身躯盘住那些愚蠢到接近栖居水域的猎物。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is rumored that POKENAME's mood can influence the weather: If POKENAME gets annoyed, a rainstorm will break out. It wraps its stone coils around prey that have been foolish enough to approach the waters where it dwells.

entry: POKENAME游过海洋时，尾端羽毛会发出多色光。游得越快，颜色切换也越快。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME swims through the sea, the feathers at the end of its tail glow in multiple colors. These colors alternate more rapidly the faster it swims.

entry: POKENAME没有爪，也不能光合作用，如今会吃水边能找到的植物，以及植物里的小虫宝可梦。
author: torterraguy26
source: Because POKENAME does not have claws and cannot photosynthesize, it now eats any plants found close to the water and the small bug Pokémon found in them.

entry: POKENAME两侧的触须能察觉温度与气压变化，得知冷锋将至。它便会挖巢储粮，等待天气转暖。
author: sk372
source: The feelers on POKENAME's sides alert it to fluctuations in temperature and air pressure. Using this, it can tell when a cold front is approaching, and dig itself a den to hoard food in and wait until warmer weather arrives.

entry: POKENAME只能看见过去。这能力虽不被认为太有用，地质学家却赞不绝口，因为它帮助解开了人类出现以前的世界谜团。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: POKENAME can only look into the past. While this ability hasn't been seen as very useful, geologists have praised this Pokémon to no end, as it has helped them solve mysteries about the world before humans came along.

entry: POKENAME藏在水生植物间，试图伪装。手上众多眼柄让视力强大，却也暴露多个能被敌人利用的弱点。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides amid underwater plants in an attempt to camouflage itself. The many eye-stalks on its hands give it strong vision, but also present multiple weak points foes can take advantage of.

entry: POKENAME头部两侧伸出的柄，才是真正的眼睛。脸上的眼状纹样，会随心情变化。
author: sk372
source: The stalks jutting from the sides of POKENAME's head are its actual eyes. The eye-like pattern on its face changes depending on its mood.

entry: POKENAME生活在河里，对人造光十分敏感。由于极其稀有，一旦发现群落，未来当地的开发就必须遵守严格的照明限制。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME live in rivers and are very sensitive to artificial light. Because they are so rare, if a population is found, any future development that takes place is subject to strict lighting limits.

entry: POKENAME被认为是太古羽虫与土龙弟弟之间缺失的过渡形态。大眼睛表明，它尚未适应地下生活。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME is thought to be a missing link between Anorith and Dunsparce. Its large eyes suggest that it had yet to evolve to an underground lifestyle.

entry: POKENAME住在温泉，吃水中矿物，构成硬壳鳞片般的层次。受栖地影响，壳常摸着滚烫，可能造成烧伤。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME live in hot springs, feeding on minerals found in the water, which makes up the scale-like layers of their hard shell. Because of their habitat, their shells are often hot to the touch and may leave burns.

entry: POKENAME的眼柄能在一定程度内转动，带来广阔视野。这有助于它从口中向其他对象吐出子弹般的水弹，提高准头。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's eye stalks can shift and rotate to a degree, giving it a wide range of vision. This helps increase the accuracy of the bullet-like shots of water it spits from its mouth at others.

entry: POKENAME画的画像古代图画，偏爱红颜料或木炭。作品能有多种解读，因此真正含义并不明确。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME makes paintings that resemble drawings from ancient times and prefers using red paint or charcoal. The true meaning of its drawings is ambiguous because they can be interpreted in many different ways.

entry: 它的三颗大眼，极有助于在暖海追捕水生猎物。不过，科学家认为，缺少能相向抓握的手臂，终究是个不便。
author: hophoppip
source: Its three large eyes are majorly helpful in its pursuit of aquatic prey in warm seas. Its lack of opposable arms is not deemed helpful by scientists.

entry: POKENAME挥动巨大的蛇状附肢，远远抓住毫无戒心的猎物。伪装的脸会磨碎食物，再送到真嘴。
author: gaogao028
source: Wielding its large serpentine appendage, POKENAME reaches far to catch unsuspecting prey. Its mimicry face grinds food that is then brought to its actual mouth.

entry: POKENAME晒太阳获取能量，背上大甲片使全身暖和。休息时仍提防危险，长耳不时抖动，聆听周围。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME bask in the sun to gain energy, the large armoured plates on their back suffusing their bodies with warmth. They remain alert for danger as they rest, their long ears periodically twitching as they listen to the world around them.

entry: POKENAME能轻松活在水压足以致人死命的深海沟。独眼闪着淡黄光，引来猎物，再在目标靠近时放电。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME easily survives in deep ocean trenches where the pressure is strong enough to kill a human. Its single eye blinks a pale yellow to attract prey, discharging an electrical charge when they draw close.

entry: POKENAME脸上的红色圆圈，是感知热量的器官。它并不强壮，便靠三百四十度的视野与热感能力，避开捕食者，寻找自己的同类。
author: _pixelar_
source: The red circles on the face of an POKENAME are its heat-sensing organs. As the Pokémon is not very strong, it uses its 340-degree vision and its heat sense to avoid predators and find others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME自古便住在同一片沼泽，漫长岁月里始终沿用同一猎法。它藏在泥中，等猎物近到能扑上，再覆泥防止逃脱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has lived in the same swamp since ancient times, where it has used the same hunting method for eons. It hides in the mud until prey is close enough to pounce on and coats them with mud to prevent escape.

entry: POKENAME高举双臂时，红色假眼会发光变大，威吓对手。
author: camtft
source: The fake red eyes on POKENAME begin to glow and enlarge when they raise their arms up high, intimidating opponents.

entry: POKENAME啃树与岩石同样高效，用来筑起水坝家园。树倒在坚硬背上，它甚至毫无察觉。
author: gerbopotato
source: POKENAME chews through trees and rocks with equal efficiency to build the dams it calls home. If a tree falls on its hardened back it doesn't even notice.

entry: POKENAME住在通常能于海床找到的化石碎块里。它好奇，常现身查看游近的生灵，但外表加上突然显形，往往会吓跑对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME inhabits fossil chunks typically found on the sea floor. It is a curious sort and often comes out to investigate creatures that swim close to it, though its appearance coupled with its sudden manifestation often scares them off.

entry: POKENAME鲜艳的花瓣能吸引传粉者，也能阻止捕食者吃它。夜里，它会请传粉者睡在安全的叶片间，自己守望。
author: beetlething
source: POKENAME's bright petals help attract pollinators and dissuade predators from eating it. At night, it invites pollinators to sleep in the safety of its leaves while it keeps watch.

entry: POKENAME摆动眼柄，讨人喜爱，也让其他宝可梦放松。对方一卸下戒心，它就慢慢靠近，再突然用后脑利颚攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME wiggle their eyestalks to charm people and put other Pokémon at ease. POKENAME will slowly approach once their guard is lowered, then suddenly attack with the sharp jaws behind its head.

entry: POKENAME头周围有八条附肢，抓取附近苔藓作为主食。训练家一提进化，它就会兴奋得全身仿佛都在颤抖。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have eight appendages around their head that grab moss around them that they rely on as their main source of food. POKENAME get excited whenever their Trainer talks about evolution, as their whole body seems to shake with excitement.

entry: POKENAME通常害羞，但察觉危险将至，就会现身村落警告人们。可惜，它只能感知遥远过去发生的灾难，因此很容易预料它们会出现在何处。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: POKENAME are usually very shy, but they will appear at villages when they feel incoming danger to warn people. However, it can only feel disasters that have happened long in the past, making it easy to predict their location.

entry: POKENAME眼力强劲，四面数英里内都能看清。它在常住的海岸森林捕虫时，再微小的虫也逃不过视线。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's eyes are quite powerful, able to see clearly for miles in all directions. Even the tiniest of bugs won't escape its sight as it hunts for them around the coastal forests it tends to inhabit.

entry: POKENAME住在幽暗深海。即使一片黑暗，壳上的叶片仍能借其他深海宝可梦的生物光，进行光合作用，产生养分。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME lives in the dark depths of the sea. Despite living in darkness, the leaves on its shell produce nutrients via photosynthesis from the bioluminescence of other deep sea Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME会连续几天泡在水里，偏爱森林环境的纯净泉水。有人说，水源有它，就说明干净，可以安全饮用。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME will submerge itself in a body of water for days on end. It prefers to find pure spring water in forest biomes. Some say the presence of an POKENAME at a water source is a sign that it is clean and safe to drink.

entry: 这把剑放下了自己的武士之魂，与一枚已有100,000,000年历史的爪子化石中的灵魂相连，重新回忆起古老的招式。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This sword has dismissed its warrior spirit to connect with the one inside a 100,000,000-year-old Claw Fossil, remembering its ancient techniques.

entry: POKENAME的体形与翼展气势惊人，行为却单纯，不爱争斗。它大多时间在空中，只会俯冲下去翻开树皮，吃底下藏的昆虫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's impressive size and wingspan cuts an imposing visage, but its behavior is simple and non-confrontational. It spends much of its time in the air, swooping down only to dig up tree bark and feast on insects hiding beneath.

entry: 据说古时POKENAME的皮毛是稳定的丝料来源。柔滑如丝的鬃毛，当年很受人追捧。
author: dodoowner_
source: It's said POKENAME fur was a consistent source of silk in ancient times. Its mane is silky smooth and was yearned for back then.

entry: POKENAME眼睛长在缎带状触须末端，视野广阔。但缎带容易被风吹动，妨碍有效观察。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's eyes, attached to the end of ribbon-like feelers, give it a wide range of vision. However, the ribbons are easily blown about by the wind, hampering the effectiveness of its sight.

entry: 人们相信，POKENAME曾用海洋之力维护古代世界的和平。它天生爱好和平，会调动强流，强行分开争执的双方。
author: sk372
source: It is believed that POKENAME used its oceanic power to keep the peace in the ancient world. It is pacifistic by nature and directs strong currents to forcibly separate those who are at odds with one another.

entry: POKENAME住在岸边，巡视浅水里的猎物。它更爱待在陆地，不愿亲自下水，会把暗影触须伸进水中，缠住生灵吃掉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME resides near shorelines, patrolling the area for prey swimming within the shallows. It sends out shadowy tendrils into the water to ensnare creatures to eat, preferring being on land to diving into the water itself.

entry: POKENAME炮筒发射的高压水，能精准命中数英里外的目标，威力足以在几秒内夷平建筑。
author: .izik
source: The high-pressure water fired from POKENAME's cannon can accurately strike targets from miles away. It is powerful enough to level a building within seconds.

entry: POKENAME有假眼，对手很少能看出它望向哪里。攻击打在岩石般硬皮上，无害弹开，接着对手就会被滚烫的摇尾巴烧伤。
author: ghostslythe
source: Opponents rarely realize where POKENAME is looking due to their pseudo eyes. When an attack comes, it bounces harmlessly off this species' rock-hard hide before getting burned by a boiling hot Tail Whip.

entry: 蜕皮后，POKENAME会吞下脱落的刺。遇威胁时，再迅速从嘴里射出。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: After molting, POKENAME swallows its shed spikes. If threatened, it rapidly ejects them from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME沿海岸翱翔，众多翅膀能察觉微弱风变，判断洋流。它十分好奇，有时会靠近海滩上的人，近距离观察。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME soars along coastal areas, its many wings able to pick up faint changes in the wind and judge the ocean's currents. A curious sort, it sometimes approaches humans on the beach to observe them up close.

entry: POKENAME的面部纹样与大体形，能有效吓退某些捕食者。它把半身沉进海底沙中，每天大多时间都在滤食。
author: sk372
source: The markings on POKENAME's face, coupled with its large size, are effective scare tactics to frighten off some predators. It submerges itself halfway into the sand at the ocean bottom, filter-feeding for most of the day.

entry: POKENAME自古每天都唱同一首单调的摇篮曲。如今已不太能哄其他宝可梦睡着，每天唱歌的习惯却仍保留。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has sung the same banal lullaby every day since ancient times. The lullaby has since become less effective at lulling other Pokémon to sleep, but the habit of singing continues with each day.

entry: POKENAME沿深海沟底跋涉，用爪破开铁矿取食。背部盔甲极其坚韧，能保护它们不受落石伤害。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME trudge along the bottom of deep trenches, using their claws to break open iron deposits to eat. The armor along their backs is incredibly tough, protecting them from falling rocks.

entry: POKENAME神情寡淡，常被误认成轻蔑或冷漠。其实，它们会从水里捞来礼物，表达喜爱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME keep a reticent expression that is mistaken for contempt or apathy. Despite this misconception, they show their affection by bringing gifts dredged up from bodies of water.

entry: POKENAME脸上纹样随心情变化。耳尖的眼睛能放出影响心智的波动，以小幻象愚弄人。
author: sk372
source: The markings on POKENAME's face shift in accordance to its mood. Its eyes, located on the tips of its ears, can send out mind-affecting waves that let it fool people with minor illusions.

entry: 贪玩的POKENAME聚在古老破火山口，晒太阳、练习喷火。它们敲击燧石般的双爪，再用头上的翼扇动火焰。
author: gerbopotato
source: Playful POKENAME congregate in ancient calderas, sunning themselves and practicing their fire. They click their flint-like claws together and fan the flames with the wings on their heads.

entry: POKENAME的膜能耐受温度变化，甚至能防水。但温差或外力过强过急，例如战斗中被招式击中，膜仍会撕裂。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's membrane is resistant to changes in temperature and can even be waterproof. However, it can tear if the change in temperature or an applied force is too strong and sudden, such as when it is hit by a move in battle.

entry: POKENAME身上有小羽毛，平时柔软、完全无害。感到危险时，却能随意让它们变硬，抵御敌人。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: POKENAME have small feathers on their body. The feathers are usually soft and completely harmless, but they can be hardened on command to fend off enemies when they feel endangered.

entry: POKENAME筑巢的海岸十分干净。它们爱挥爪抓人脚，使人改到别处乱扔垃圾。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Shorelines where POKENAME nest are very clean. Their tendency to swipe at people's feet causes them to go litter somewhere else.

entry: POKENAME全身红斑充当多只假眼，试图在附近捕食者面前显得更大。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME is covered in red spots that act as multiple fake eyes in an attempt to appear bigger to nearby predators.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛藏着鳃，能在水下与陆地活动。它太重，游不太好，便改为沿海床行走，挖掘食物。
author: sk372
source: The feathery plumage hides gills that allow POKENAME to function underneath the water as well as on land. Due to its mass, it doesn't swim well, instead walking along the ocean floor and digging for food.

entry: POKENAME几乎全是胶状物，没有骨头，能钻入最小的洞穴躲藏。手上石爪是全身唯一的坚实部分，用来抵御捕食者。
author: fiordaliso
source: Since POKENAME is almost entirely gelatinous and boneless, it can slip into even the tiniest holes to take shelter. The stone claws on its hands are the only solid part of its body, allowing it to defend itself from predators.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛在水上水下，都有完整的360度视野。披甲利爪能切开任何逃得不够快的猎物。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME's eyes have a full 360 view around itself both above water and beneath the waves. Its plated claws slice through any prey not fast enough to escape.

entry: POKENAME背上蘑菇的种类，曾被认为数百万年前就已灭绝。真菌只能长在它身上，因此人们谨慎保护它，推进科学研究。
author: sk372
source: The mushrooms growing on POKENAME's back are a type thought to have gone extinct millions of years ago. As the fungi can only grow on POKENAME itself, care is taken to protect the species to help further scientific research.

entry: POKENAME爬过受污染的海床，将脏水吸进蘑菇，清洁环境。蘑菇再利用滤出的污染物，增强抗病能力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME crawls across polluted ocean floors, absorbing the contaminated water into its mushroom to clean the area. The filtered pollutants are then utilized by the mushroom to strengthen its resistance to illness.

entry: POKENAME攀在码头下，吃海藻，直到强壮得足以自保。它依靠船只巨响，吓退捕食者。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME clings onto the bottom of piers, feeding off algae until it's strong enough to fend for itself. It relies on the loud sounds of boats to deter predators.

entry: POKENAME相当结实好战。野外，它们按背部硬岩缺口的数量，决定群体等级。
author: colt1917
source: POKENAME is a highly durable and combative Pokémon. In the wild, POKENAME determine group hierarchy by the number of notches on the hard rock that makes up their back.

entry: 研究者相信，POKENAME曾住在远古海床。理论认为，它们狩猎时会静止得如岩石，让猎物认错，再用锯齿利爪刺穿。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: Researchers believe that POKENAME once lived on the seabed of ancient oceans. It is theorized that they hunted prey by standing extremely still. Prey would then mistake them for rock formations before being speared by their jagged claws.

entry: 融合使POKENAME绒毛般的外层，重组成岩石护甲。它既用来防御，也用来伪装，沿多石河岸潜行，伏击较小猎物。
author: gerbopotato
source: The fusion process has recombined POKENAME's fuzzy exterior into rocklike armor. It uses this exterior as camouflage as much as defense, sneaking to ambush tinier prey along rocky riverbanks.

entry: POKENAME头上的假眼主要用于威吓，被摘走也能再生。有些圈子拿它当零食，极其小众，也极其酸。
author: sk372
source: A false eye sits upon POKENAME's head, primarily used for intimidation. It can regrow if removed, and the fake eye has been used as a very niche and very tart snack food in some circles.

entry: POKENAME求偶时会互碰翅膀，同步拍动。受空中猎手追捕，就用双爪抓紧珊瑚，免得被捞走。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME court each other by touching their wings together and beating them in unison. When being hunted by aerial predators, they use their two claws to grip onto coral so they can't be scooped away.

entry: POKENAME静伏海床，模样令其他宝可梦困惑。大个子靠近，它便等对方离开；小个子靠近，则跃起用硬喙攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lies motionless on the seabed, and the sight of it confuses other Pokémon. If a larger Pokémon approaches, POKENAME simply waits for them to leave, but if a smaller Pokémon comes close, POKENAME will leap up and attack with its hard beak.

entry: POKENAME凭强腿与尾快速游过海洋，以利爪、尖喙狩猎。两只相遇，都会盯着彼此的冠，通过摇冠交流。
author: .jerden
source: Swiftly swimming through the ocean using their powerful legs and tail, POKENAME hunt with their sharp claws and beak. If two of them meet, their eyes will focus on the other's crest, which they will shake to communicate with each other.

entry: POKENAME摸起来温暖舒服，喜欢亲近人类与其他宝可梦。它是宝可梦培育屋的好伙伴，乐于照顾那里出现的任何蛋。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are pleasantly warm to the touch and enjoy being close to both people and other Pokémon. They make excellent companions at Pokémon Daycares and will happily look after any eggs that may turn up within them.

entry: POKENAME体内烈火炽盛，摸着很烫。它会定期喷出大股火焰，排散热量。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are hot to the touch, their bodies containing an intense fire. They periodically discharge this heat by exhaling great gouts of flame.

entry: POKENAME体内烈火炽盛，摸着很烫。它会定期喷出大股火焰，排散热量。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are hot to the touch, their bodies containing an intense fire. They periodically discharge this heat by exhaling great gouts of flame.

entry: POKENAME靠极长的绳状物荡来荡去。绳端利爪能嵌入岩壁，轻松攀上高山。这些绳其实是身体的一部分。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: POKENAME swing around using a very long rope-like object. The claws at the tips of these ropes can embed into walls, allowing POKENAME to scale large mountains with ease. The ropes are actually part of their bodies.

entry: POKENAME住在浑水里，骗猎物以为自己是普通太古羽虫。对方一靠近，它就猛扑，用肌肉发达的肢体将其拖下。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME lives in murky waters, tricking prey into thinking that it is an ordinary Anorith. When they approach, POKENAME lunges, dragging down prey with its muscular limbs.

entry: POKENAME每颗头的大眼，几乎占头部四分之一。两个意识似乎无法合作走路，因此步行缓慢。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: Each of POKENAME's heads has enormous eyes that take up nearly a quarter of its size. Its two minds cannot seem to work together to walk, so it is a slow walker.

entry: POKENAME有三颗带硬喙的假头，能用巨力挥动，轻易撕开最厚的皮。此外，它跑得也比大多数人类车辆更快。
author: dukefrogpeasant
source: POKENAME have three false heads with hard beaks. They can swing these beaks with tremendous force, easily tearing through even the thickest hides. Additionally, POKENAME can also run faster than most human vehicles.

entry: POKENAME身体大多是远古太古羽虫分解而成的原油。它常出没于海上钻井平台附近。
author: ferdirenz
source: POKENAME's body is composed mostly of the crude oil that came from ancient decomposed Anorith. It is often found near offshore rigs.

entry: 它的身体由古老化石形成的浓厚毒焦油构成。突出的刺能攀住猎物，拉向身体。
author: mary_the_jane
source: Its body is made of a thick, poisonous tar made from fossils long ago. It uses its protruding spikes to cling onto prey and bring them closer to the body.

entry: POKENAME穿行地下，头上突起探出地面，帮助维持方向。完全现身前，会先伸出眼柄，查看四周。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tunnels through the ground, the outcropping on its head sticking out to help it maintain its direction. It pokes its eye-stalks above the dirt to scan its surroundings before emerging fully.

entry: POKENAME与龙虾小兵都多足、巨钳，骨骼曾被认错。但化石技术能将它复活，打破了基因相似的传言。
author: quackquackattack
source: Skeletons of POKENAME were once mistaken for Corphish skeletons, as both have multiple legs and large claws. However, POKENAME can be brought to life with fossil technology, dispelling the myth of genetic similarity.

entry: POKENAME在深海翻滚，用爪拨沙挖食物。若觉得碰上了猎物洞穴，就用一只爪制造小爆炸，轰开沙，露出里面的小点心。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rolls around the depths of the ocean, shuffling its claws through the sand to dig for food. If it thinks it has chanced upon a prey's den, it creates a small explosion with one claw to blow away the sand and reveal the morsels within.

entry: POKENAME披着坚如岩石的茧，抵御攻击。最近的化石发现，使科学家相信它们自古就已存在。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are armored with a rock solid cocoon that protects them attacks. Scientists believe that they have existed since ancient times due to recent discoveries in fossil evidence.

entry: 它们在狭窄洞穴筑巢，以浓厚红烟逼退不适应的生灵。这种气体原态有害，却正被研究能否用作强效抗菌剂。
author: bukie
source: They nest in cramped caves, warding off all life not accustomed to its dense, red smog. While hazardous in its natural state, this gas is under examination for use as a powerful antibiotic agent.

entry: POKENAME用头上假眼显得更大，吓退圈圈熊。它虽重甲在身，却能凭强力飞上天，让地面的捕食者困惑。
author: ghostslythe
source: Using its head-mounted false eyes, POKENAME makes itself appear larger to scare off Ursaring. While it is heavily armored, it uses its superior strength to take to the sky confusing its ground-based predators.

entry: POKENAME沿海底爬行，一见猎物便摇尾扬沙。频繁而猛烈地摇动，甚至能卷出漩涡。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME crawls along the ocean floor. When it sees prey, it shakes its tail to kick up sand. If this happens often and viciously enough, it can create whirlpools.

entry: 遇威胁时，POKENAME会蓬起尾巴，显得远大于实际。若威吓无效，坚如岩石的外骨骼就是第二道防线。
author: cait_sith
source: When faced with a threat, POKENAME fluffs up its tail to appear much larger than it actually is. If intimidation fails, POKENAME's second line of defense is its rock-hard exoskeleton.

entry: POKENAME曾藏在海沙下，等大猎物游近，就猛然冲出，用刃臂迅速撕裂。化石记录显示，它最爱捕食拉普拉斯。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hunted by hiding beneath the ocean sands, springing forth when large prey swam near and tearing into them with quick movements of its bladed arms. Fossil records indicate its preferred prey was Lapras.

entry: 世代以来，超能力者都用POKENAME的尾羽举行仪式。羽毛能让他们通过幻象，遥看时间中的随机片段。
author: .izik
source: The feathers on POKENAME's tail have been used by Psychics for generations in rituals. They allow them to witness random points in time remotely through visions.

entry: POKENAME常低悬沙漠上方，用沙粒磨利爪。身体还适应了危急时吃沙的生存方式。
author: rumia_archer
source: POKENAME are seen hovering low above desert sands. They use the grains to sharpen their claws, and in dire situations, their bodies have adapted to allow them to eat the sand as well.

entry: POKENAME锐利的披甲双翼，能在翱翔时保护身体。它先用翼击落猎物，再用利爪夹着食物飞走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have sharp, armored wings that protect them as they soar through the air. They rely on their wings to strike down prey before flying away with their meal gripped in between their talons.

entry: POKENAME沿岸漂浮狩猎，身体前倾，伸出双爪。拉起猎物的反作用力，使全身后仰，再前后摇摆，也能扰乱猎物。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME float along the shoreline to hunt, tilting their bodies forward while extending their claws. The recoil from yanking up their target causes their entire bodies to tilt backwards, then sway back and forth, helping to disorient their prey.

entry: POKENAME在水下不呼吸，也能安然生存。它住在海沟，狩猎时连续几天不浮上水面。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME does not breathe while underwater yet survives without issue. It makes its home in ocean trenches, not surfacing for days at a time while hunting.

entry: POKENAME藏在化石状楔石中，等研究者或考古学家靠近。随后猛然现身，扣住人质索要化石，交出才肯放人。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hide in a keystone shaped like a fossil, waiting until researchers or archeologists come close. Then, they burst forth from the keystone to hold these people ransom until provided with fossils.

entry: POKENAME住在洞穴，用锐利石爪攀壁，悬在洞顶。猎物从下面经过，就会落下，以双颚抓住。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lives inside caves, using its sharp, rocky claws to climb up walls and hang from the ceiling. As soon as prey walks below, it will drop down from above to seize it in its jaws.

entry: POKENAME的化石发现于伽勒尔，当地化石研究者会用零碎遗骸将它复活。活着时，它们固定在海床，袭击经过的宝可梦，试图捕来吃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Fossils of POKENAME are found in Galar, fossil researchers there resurrecting the fossil Pokémon from fragmentary remains. In life, POKENAME anchor themselves to the sea floor and lash out at passing Pokémon to try and catch them as food.

entry: POKENAME的化石发现于伽勒尔，当地化石研究者会用零碎遗骸将它复活。活着时，它们固定在海床，袭击经过的宝可梦，试图捕来吃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Fossils of POKENAME are found in Galar, fossil researchers there resurrecting the fossil Pokémon from fragmentary remains. In life, POKENAME anchor themselves to the sea floor and lash out at passing Pokémon to try and catch them as food.

entry: POKENAME是陆栖宝可梦，背上能供小生物生活。它喜欢细雨，暴雨时却会躲起来。身体几乎没有弱点，连看不见的部位，也有甲鳞妥善保护。
author: bobosmith01
source: A land-dwelling Pokémon that can support small organisms on its back. It enjoys a small drizzle, but hides during downpours. POKENAME has virtually no physical weak point: even in areas where it cannot see, it is well protected by its armored scales.

entry: POKENAME是陆栖宝可梦，背上能供小生物生活。它喜欢细雨，暴雨时却会躲起来。身体几乎没有弱点，连看不见的部位，也有甲鳞妥善保护。
author: bobosmith01
source: A land-dwelling Pokémon that can support small organisms on its back. It enjoys a small drizzle, but hides during downpours. POKENAME has virtually no physical weak point: even in areas where it cannot see, it is well protected by its armored scales.

entry: 据说，POKENAME被数亿年前的史前怨念附身。身体由极致密的角蛋白构成，能切过钢铁。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME is said to be possessed by a prehistoric grudge from hundreds of millions of years ago. Its body is made of extremely dense keratin, which can cut through steel.

entry: POKENAME狩猎时，会将整个身体高速掷向猎物。尖爪向前展开，符合空气动力，足以飞行。
author: cwynwyn
source: POKENAME hunts by hurling its entire body at high speeds towards prey. With its pointed claws extended forward, it is aerodynamic enough to achieve flight.

entry: POKENAME的缎带在战斗中能硬如石头。它毫无规律地挥动缎带，却能出奇轻松地挡开飞来物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's ribbons can harden to the consistency of stone during combat. It waves them in erratic motions to deflect incoming projectiles with surprising ease.

entry: POKENAME能从背炮发射巨石，像强力弹丸一般。回火钢外骨骼使它极其耐打，也增强了爪击伤害。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can launch boulders from the cannon on its back as if they were powerful projectiles. Its tempered steel exoskeleton not only makes it extremely durable, but also increases the damage of its claw strikes.

entry: POKENAME的爪能击穿实心钢铁。将耳朵拉到身前，就能组成护盾，挡住攻击。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's claws have the power to punch through solid steel. By pulling their ears in front of their bodies, these Pokémon can create a shield to block attacks.

entry: 古代，POKENAME是可怕的猎手，用引以为傲的长牙不停切碎猎物。这些化石宝可梦灭绝后，人类曾把长牙当刀刃，切开金属盔甲。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME was a fearsome hunter in ancient times, relentlessly slicing up prey with its prized tusks. When fossil Pokémon went extinct, these tusks were used as blades by humans to slice open metal armor.

entry: POKENAME把毛尾编成辫，免得绊倒自己。伸缩爪很少露出，因为太小，不太适合攻击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME weave their furry tails into braids so that they do not trip over themselves. Their retractable claws are rarely seen because their small size makes them less than ideal for attacking.

entry: POKENAME将尾巴编成一条长辫，减少毛发卡入盔甲的机会。轻甲湿后会变重，因此许多个体住在干燥地区，尽量避开风险。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME weave their tails into one long braid to reduce the chance of their fur getting caught in their armor. Their lightweight armor gets heavy when soaked in water, so many POKENAME live in arid climates to minimize this risk.

entry: POKENAME柔软温暖的毛，长期被用来做登山保暖夹克。承受强烈负荷时，身体的石甲会炽热发光。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's soft, warm fur was long used to craft thermal jackets for mountain climbing. The stone armor covering its body becomes incandescent when this Pokémon is pushed under intense strain.

entry: 许多人以为墨镜状部位是POKENAME的眼睛，真眼其实在头侧。这个好斗的家伙曾称霸古代世界，欺凌小生灵，要它们交出食物，否则后果自负。
author: sk372
source: Many assume the sunglasses-like area is POKENAME's eyes, but they are actually on the side of its head. This aggressive Pokémon dominated the ancient world, bullying smaller creatures into giving it food or face the consequences.

entry: POKENAME主要住在较冷较湿的地区，吃苔藓、藻类，偶尔吃虫。颈与头上的褶边，覆有极薄的霜。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is primarily found in cooler, wetter regions of the world, subsisting on moss, algae and the occasional insect. The frills on its neck and head are coated with a very faint layer of frost.

entry: POKENAME曾是几乎没有天敌的古代草食者。层层盔甲能挡下许多重击，但有理论认为，是某只强大的格斗属性宝可梦使它灭绝。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME were ancient herbivores that had few enemies. Its layered armour prevented many hard hitting attacks, but it is theorized a strong fighting type Pokémon rendered it extinct.

entry: 大爪让捕猎轻而易举。POKENAME背上的硬壳，则保护它休息时免遭突袭。
author: captainzscourge
source: The large claws on its paws allow for an easy hunt. The hard shells on POKENAME's back protect it from any surprise attacks while it's resting.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇极硬，能轻松挡开伤害。洞穴坍塌时，尤其有助于保护自身。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's mushroom is extremely hard and capable of deflecting damage with ease. This proves particularly useful for keeping it safe during cave-ins.

entry: POKENAME在浅水周围结小群栖息。它用前爪替同类梳理，保持头鳞整洁漂亮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives in small groups nestled around shallow waters. It uses its front claws to groom others of its kind, keeping the scales on their heads nice and clean.

entry: POKENAME在深水游泳，用爪的红光引来猎物，再出击。全身羽毛能察觉环境里的任何动静，让它们时刻掌握周围。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME swim deep under water, using the red glow from their claws to lure in prey before they strike. POKENAME are highly attuned to their surroundings, detecting any motion in their environment through the feathers along their bodies.

entry: POKENAME能把所有肢体缩进壳，完全保护自己。滚下山坡逃敌时，最快可达每小时六十英里。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME are able to slink all their limbs into their shell to fully protect themselves. They may reach up to sixty miles per hour rolling down a hill to escape from a foe.

entry: POKENAME虽智力惊人、拥有超能力，陆地上的身体却弱而笨拙。入水后，桨状双臂便让它成为游泳好手。
author: beandrawsthings
source: While possessing an amazing intelligence and psychic powers, its body is weak and ungainly on land. When in the water, POKENAME is a great swimmer because of its paddle-like arms.

entry: 击中POKENAME强韧肌肉的攻击，它根本感觉不到。巨钢板挨过拳，短短几秒就会像满是孔洞的奶酪。
author: soup1900
source: Attacks that hit POKENAME's strong, tough muscles aren't felt by it. Giant steel slabs look like holey cheese in mere seconds after POKENAME has punched them.

entry: POKENAME想起亡母时，心中痛苦难当，便会用头骨猛撞坚硬物体。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME smashes its skull on hard surfaces in emotional agony when thinking of its late mother.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，先用黏长舌抓住其他宝可梦，再以硬头猛撞。它最爱椰子，会用头骨敲开，舔饮里面的汁水。
author: .jerden
source: In combat, POKENAME grabs other Pokémon with its long and sticky tongue, then smashes its hard head against them. Its favorite food is coconuts, which it cracks open using its skull so that it can lap up the liquid inside.

entry: POKENAME一跑起来就停不住，因此栖地附近常设警告牌。头撞的冲力，强到足以折断一棵树。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME cannot stop running once they begin, so there are often warning signs in place near their habitats. The impact of their headbutt attacks is strong enough to snap a tree in half.

entry: POKENAME用硬头敲开贝类与软体动物，吸进嘴里。若另一只POKENAME来挑战，双方就对撞脑袋，直到一方认输。
author: holgast
source: POKENAME use their hard heads to crack open and slurp down shellfish and mollusks. If challenged by another POKENAME, they will butt heads until one concedes.

entry: POKENAME平时性情温和，一涉及食物，却会变得凶猛固执。它住在丛林深处。
author: bobosmith01
source: While POKENAME usually has a mild personality, it becomes ferocious and stubborn when it comes to food. It lives deep in the jungle.

entry: 这些宝可梦躁动时，会用双拳敲打硬头，同时产生额外电力，可能从尖刺间迸出。
author: infinex21
source: When these Pokémon are agitated, they drum their fists against their hard heads. This display also causes them to generate extra electricity that may fly loose from their spikes.

entry: POKENAME会从树枝头朝下跃出，重重撞击下面的生灵。若没能撞昏，还会用刺注毒，进一步削弱对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME leaps headfirst from tree branches to give a solid headbutt to creatures below. If the impact doesn't knock them out, it follows up with poison from its stinger to further weaken them.

entry: POKENAME不断泡水，保持头盖洁净如新。它天性不好斗，但谁弄脏圆顶，就会遭到尖锐疼痛的冲撞头击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME bathes in water constantly to keep its cranium clean and pristine. It's not aggressive by nature, but anything that causes its dome to become filthy is in for a painful, pointed charging headbutt.

entry: POKENAME定期蜕皮，之后穹顶头骨会变软、变弱。它立刻四处撞东西，尽快重新练硬。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sheds its skin regularly, which leaves its domed skull soft and weakened afterward. It immediately goes around headbutting things to quickly toughen it back up.

entry: POKENAME十分冲动，常冲向其他对象，以头撞击，试图确立主导地位。幸好身体很轻，突袭的受害者通常伤得不重。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quite impulsive and prone to charging into others to headbutt them as an attempt to establish dominance. Fortunately its body is rather light, so the headbutts aren't too damaging to the victims of its surprise attacks.

entry: POKENAME发脾气时，岩石头会被烈焰包裹。它固执冲动，若没训练好，连自己的训练家也可能撞。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME loses its temper, its rocky head is engulfed in blazing flames. Stubborn and impulsive, it may even headbutt its own Trainer if not properly trained.

entry: 这些小虫宝可梦用丝网缠住猎物与捕食者。缠够后，就把自己拉向对方，以硬腹给予震荡重击。
author: infinex21
source: These small Bug Pokémon use their silk webbing to entangle prey and predators. When they manage to wrap enough of their webbing around a foe, they will pull themselves toward them and use their hard abdomens to deliver a concussive blow.

entry: POKENAME只住在洞穴。敌人走入网中，它就从洞顶落下，用整个坚如岩石的身体，直接重击对方头部。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live only within caves and caverns. When a foe walks into their webs, they drop from the ceiling above, using their entire rock-hard body to deliver a powerful concussive blow directly to their head.

entry: POKENAME会花数小时打磨壳与圆顶头部，直到光滑结实。受威胁时，它们就不断用头敲击对方，直到威胁离去。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spend hours polishing their shell and the dome on their heads until they are smooth and solid. When threatened, they bop their heads against the threat until it goes away.

entry: 考古学家说，在挖掘现场附近见到一只POKENAME，会带来好运，帮助发现稀有文物。翅膀只能把石身托离地面几米。
author: fiordaliso
source: Archaeologists say spotting one POKENAME near excavation sites brings luck and helps uncover rare artifacts. Its wings can lift its stone body only a few meters off the ground.

entry: POKENAME坐在树顶，等候最佳时机。猎物走到枝下，它就落下，用岩石般的头重击。
author: terrabits
source: POKENAME sits atop trees waiting for the perfect moment. When prey wanders below the branch, it drops down and delivers a hard blow with its rocky head.

entry: POKENAME头骨一受损，伤口就会分泌疗效极佳的黏凝胶。过去，这曾被滥用，害了许多个体，因此如今贩售凝胶已属违法。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Should POKENAME's skull ever get damaged, a slimy gel is excreted from the wound which contains great healing properties. This was exploited in the past, with many POKENAME coming to harm, and so now it is illegal to sell the gel.

entry: POKENAME最重要的器官通常有坚实蓝甲保护，例如脊柱，以及那颗确实不大的脑。双腿若不幸断离，也能再生。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's most vital organs tend to be protected by solid blue plating, such as its spine or its admittedly small brain. Its legs have the ability to regrow if somehow severed.

entry: POKENAME通常四足行走，但能靠沉重尾巴平衡，双足站立。化石足迹旁会留下尾沟，因此很容易辨认。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME are usually quadrupedal, but they can stand on two legs by using their heavy tails as counterweights. Fossilized POKENAME tracks can be easily identified by the furrow left by their tails.

entry: POKENAME不喜欢其他对象擅闯所住的遗迹。它会在空中旋转、冲撞，头骨尖刺一旦命中，就会划出疼痛伤口。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME does not take kindly to others trespassing in the ruins it inhabits. It spins through the air and tackles at others, the spines on its cranium causing painful gashes if it connects.

entry: POKENAME以厚头骨撞树，击落鸟巢，吃里面的蛋。利爪连最坚固的防御也能切开。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME bash their thick skulls into trees to knock down nests, eating their eggs. Using their claws, they can cut through even the most sturdy defenses.

entry: POKENAME的头虽极硬，化石却显示，它撞击敌人后常使壳脱落。早期人类聚落发现许多壳，因此有理论认为，曾被当作简陋烤炉。
author: notadoctor75
source: While the head of POKENAME was incredibly tough, fossils show that it often dislodged its shell after tackling opponents. Many shells have been found in early human settlements, leading to a theory that they may have served as rudimentary ovens.

entry: 史前，POKENAME繁盛于浅海。随着海洋加深、珊瑚礁减少，许多个体如今难以生存。自然保护人士为它们设立保护区，确保长久存续。
author: quackquackattack
source: In prehistoric times, POKENAME thrived in shallow oceans. Over time, as oceans got deeper and coral reefs dwindled, many are struggling to survive. Conservationists have created sanctuaries for POKENAME to ensure their long-term survival.

entry: POKENAME用头撞棕榈树，震落椰子，再以角接住。幼崽会把这当游戏，用象鼻抛果，在半空接住。
author: leandermalurt
