source: POKENAME headbutts palm trees to make coconuts fall and catches them with its horns. Young POKENAME turn this into a game, tossing fruit with their trunks and catching it mid-air.

entry: POKENAME极其鲁莽，几乎见什么都想冲撞。盔甲虽坚如石，却也够柔韧，撞上更硬的表面仍不易碎。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is incredibly reckless as it loves to charge into just about anything. While its armor is as hard as stone, it is also flexible enough to resist shattering against harder surfaces.

entry: 它们用粗叶摩擦头顶，保持光滑。颈侧小刺能放出电流。
author: infinex21
source: To keep the tops of their heads smooth, they rub coarse leaves along their heads. They can loose electricity from the small spikes on the sides of their necks.

entry: 它用尾巴敲硬头时，会迸出电火花。尾巴还用来敲坚果、压碎树果，再吃下。
author: infinex21
source: When it strikes its tail against its hard head, electric sparks fly about. It uses its tail to break open nuts and to crush berries before eating them.

entry: POKENAME高速在地面挖沟，头刚好露出土面，查看前路。挖掘时若看见同类，就会转向对方，使出强力头锤。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME dig trenches through the ground at high speed, keeping their heads just above the soil so that they can see where they are going. If they spot another POKENAME whilst digging, they will veer toward them and deliver a powerful Headbutt.

entry: POKENAME保护心爱训练家时，有点过分热心。除非特意教过，否则对陌生人的第一反应，就是先用超能力定住，再冲过去用头撞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a bit overly zealous in its defense of its beloved Trainer. Unless taught otherwise, its first instinct towards unfamiliar people is to freeze them with psychic powers before using a charging headbutt.

entry: POKENAME藏在岩间伏击，主要猎食铁臂枪虾与菊石兽。伸颈比子弹还快，能把路上的一切撞成细碎。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides amongst the rocks to ambush its prey, mainly Clauncher and Omanyte. It can extend its neck out faster than a bullet, smashing anything in its way into tiny pieces.

entry: POKENAME用带刺棒重击敌人，使其重伤。据说很久以前，穴居人曾把它当作首选武器。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME smacks opponents with its spiked club to severely injure them. It was apparently used by cavemen long ago as their preferred weapon of choice.

entry: POKENAME用两根刺棒反复敲打敌人。它不像双剑鞘有复杂战术，连基本防御工具也能抵挡攻击。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME attacks foes by bashing them repeatedly with its two spiked clubs. Unlike a Doublade, it has no complex attack pattern, so even basic defensive tools can counter its strikes.

entry: POKENAME领地意识强烈，会冲向自认地盘内一切移动的东西。先撞目标，再用缎带捆住，固定着继续撞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's territorial nature leads it to charge at anything moving within its perceived domain. It headbutts its target before wrapping its ribbons around them, holding them in place so it can keep headbutting them.

entry: POKENAME尾端厚骨是绝佳的棒槌。它们用尾巴猛砸地面，力量足以碎石，试图吓退敌人。
author: santon5512
source: The thick bones at the tips of POKENAME's tails make them the perfect clubs. POKENAME slam their tails against the ground in an attempt to intimidate foes with these strikes strong enough to shatter rock.

entry: POKENAME曾住在海床，滚动碾碎化石盔等宝可梦的硬壳，作为食物。科学家推测，沉重身体使它难以上浮呼吸，导致最初灭绝。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME used to live on the seafloor, rolling around and crushing hard shells of Pokémon like Kabuto to eat. Scientists theorize that POKENAME's weight caused them to struggle to reach the surface to breathe, leading to their initial extinction.

entry: POKENAME头上硬甲会发出清脆铿鸣，音高随敲击方式改变。它会撞东西，用声音帮自己调整歌声的音准。
author: sk372
source: The hard plating on POKENAME's head produces a sharp clanging that varies in pitch depending on how it was struck. It headbutts things and uses the tone created to help it tune its singing.

entry: POKENAME低头冲过丛林，以极硬头骨撞碎沿途植物。许多对手因体形不大而低估它，最终却被强大力量压倒。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME charges through the jungle, head down, smashing through any plants in its path with its extremely hard skull. Many underestimate this Pokémon because of its modest size, only to be overwhelmed by its formidable strength.

entry: POKENAME的硬头主要用于防御，也能发动头撞。但腿短粗，很难好好冲锋。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's hard head is mainly for defense. It can also use it for headbutting attacks, but its stubby legs make charging difficult to pull off.

entry: POKENAME会在小洞里疯狂用头撞弟妹，争抢父母关注。父母外出狩猎时，它们便埋入沙漠沙中，躲藏取暖。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found in small burrows headbutting their siblings in a mad scramble for the attention of their parents. While their parents hunt for food, POKENAME will bury themselves in the desert sand to hide and keep warm.

entry: 探索POKENAME栖居的洞穴时要小心。它们头骨厚，不太顾周围；即使没直接撞到你，也可能震落钟乳石。
author: mistymagius
source: Be careful exploring caves where POKENAME reside, because of their thick skulls, they have little regard for their surroundings. If they don't smash into you directly, there is a chance of them causing stalactites to fall.

entry: POKENAME一闻到猎物，整群就忍不住冲去，用硬头骨碾压。狂乱中，许多成员反而互撞，把彼此撞昏。
author: sk372
source: Once POKENAME catches the scent of prey, the whole school is compelled to charge and crush them with their hard skulls. Many members of the school end up crashing into others in this frenzy and knocking each other out.

entry: 以POKENAME的体形而言，它爬得极快。发怒时，会用圆顶撞敌人。两侧蘑菇完全成熟后，通常会因撞击振动弹离身体。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can scuttle remarkably fast for their size. When enraged, POKENAME ram into foes with their rounded domes. When the mushrooms on its sides are fully mature, they typically pop off the body using the vibration of their tackles.

entry: POKENAME利用头内宽阔空间的回声，发出铃声般的嘶鸣。尾上铁球般的部位也能响出同样声音，但必须猛砸厚冰。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses the echoes of its large and spacious head to whinny noises that resemble ringing bells. The iron-like ball on its tail also echoes these same sounds, but only when smashed against thick ice.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇顶十分坚实沉重。自卫时，它会从地面跃起，蘑菇朝下落向敌人，试图压碎对方。
author: sk372
source: The top of POKENAME's mushroom is remarkably solid and heavy. To defend itself, POKENAME will leap from the ground and fall mushroom-first onto its foes in an attempt to crush them.

entry: 两只POKENAME发起挑战后，会全速冲向彼此，直到额上大鳞相撞才肯退让。谁能忍受撞击后的嗡鸣更久，就算获胜。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Whenever a challenge is issued between two POKENAME, they run at each other at full speed, not backing down until the large scales on their forehead collide. The one that withstands the resulting ringing longer is declared the winner.

entry: POKENAME用岩石般的硬头猛撞紫水晶簇，击成细碎，再迫不及待地吞下宝石，强化结实体魄。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slams its rock-hard skull into clusters of amethyst, shattering them into tiny shards. It eagerly devours the crushed gemstones, strengthening its sturdy body.

entry: POKENAME毫无自保意识，见什么都冲，想试试厚头骨能否撞坏。冲锋时，它会拉起松皮，免得绊脚，而松皮也能吸收大部分冲击。
author: pjporwoll
source: Lacking senses of self-preservation, POKENAME charges at anything to see if its dense skull can damage it. While charging, it pulls up the loose skin to not trip, which absorbs much of the impact.

entry: POKENAME不同于其他流星状宝可梦，内核与外壳一样硬。脱甲加速后，它能一路击穿整座山，但面对小目标时，准头实在很差。
author: milchik
source: Unlike other meteor-like Pokémon, POKENAME's core is just as hard as its outer shell. With its armor shed for extra speed, it can hammer all the way through entire mountains, but it also severely lacks in accuracy against smaller targets.

entry: 野外互为对手的POKENAME会以硬头骨互撞较量。每次撞击，尾火都会爆发般高涨。
author: sk372
source: Rival POKENAME in the wild compete against each other by butting their solid craniums against each other. Each impact causes the fire on their tails to flare up explosively.

entry: 它会撞树震落水果与坚果，再用火烤熟。许多采集者带着POKENAME帮忙大量收集，但必须管好，免得误撞倒树。
author: infinex21
source: It headbutts trees to knock free fruits and nuts, then roasts them with its flames. Many gatherers have a POKENAME on hand to help collect many fruits and nuts, though must keep them in line so they do not topple any trees by mistake.

entry: 它头骨厚得连一个念头也钻不进去。喜欢在河边懒躺，谁想挪动它，就会遭顽固的头撞。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Its skull is so thick that no thought can possibly penetrate it. It likes to laze about near the riverside and will stubbornly headbutt anyone that tries to move it.

entry: POKENAME虽能耐极热极冷，却仍对温度骤变敏感。因此，野外自然形成的群落活动范围通常很容易预测。它们以互撞表达喜爱。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although POKENAME can survive in extreme heat or cold, they are still sensitive to sudden changes in temperature. As a result, any naturally formed population tends to remain in a predictable area. They headbutt one another to show affection.

entry: POKENAME晒太阳积聚能量。它会撞树收集成熟树果，也锻炼自身力量。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME basks in the sun to gather energy. It rams into trees to gather ripe berries as well as help strengthen its power.

entry: POKENAME用手中的骨头敲硬头骨，就是在挑战。野外对手会互相冲撞，比谁头撞更强，败者必须交出珍爱的骨头。
author: sk372
source: If POKENAME taps the bone it carries onto its solid skull, it's a challenge. Rivals in the wild charge into each other to see who has the stronger headbutt, and the loser forfeits their prized bone.

entry: POKENAME的双拳与头一样有力，能一拳碎钢。它们喜欢看拳击赛，希望提升本领。
author: bigoljax
source: With fists wielding the same power as their heads, POKENAME's punches have the ability to shatter steel. They love to watch boxing matches, wanting to better their abilities.

entry: 觅食时，它专找飞行属性宝可梦的巢。一旦发现，就会全力撞过去，将巢摧毁。
author: skymaster426
source: While it hunts for food, it seeks any nests of Flying-type Pokémon. When it finds one, it rams into it at full force, destroying the nest.

entry: POKENAME发现领地有入侵者，便飞到上方，头朝下猛撞。可它们经常扑空，地面留下的大量深坑，让领地格外好认。
author: alumed
source: When POKENAME see an intruder in their territory they will fly above it and drop head-first into the target. Because they frequently miss, their territory can be easily identified thanks to the large number of craters.

entry: POKENAME能以超音速飞行，驰骋天空。极硬的头用来彼此交战，两只相撞，声如雷鸣。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are capable of flying at supersonic speeds, racing across the skies. They have extremely hard heads and use these to battle with one another, a collision between two POKENAME sounds like a thunderclap.

entry: POKENAME能以超音速飞行，驰骋天空。极硬的头用来彼此交战，两只相撞，声如雷鸣。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are capable of flying at supersonic speeds, racing across the skies. They have extremely hard heads and use these to battle with one another, a collision between two POKENAME sounds like a thunderclap.

entry: POKENAME好斗、领地意识强，看见新东西的第一反应，就是冲上去头撞。若对方避开初次冲锋，它便用尾端刺棒再攻。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has an aggressive and territorial streak: its first instinct upon seeing something new is to charge it down and headbutt it. If anything dodges its initial dash, it makes a second attack with the spiked club at the end of its tail.

entry: POKENAME追逐猎物时，起初只用最高速度的一半。等猎物以为有机会逃走，它便让尾火猛涨，作为推进器，迅速拉近距离。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME charges down its prey while initially only running at half its top speed. Letting its quarry believe they have a chance to escape, it flares up the fire on its tail and uses it as a booster to close the distance.

entry: POKENAME用头摩擦灌木或岩石，打磨头冠。对战后，喜欢到浅水游泳降温。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rubs its head against bushes or rocks to polish the head crest on its head. After a Pokémon battle, it enjoys swimming in shallow water to cool off.

entry: 这些小宝可梦把丝编成小网，像迷你弹跳板一样发射自己。它们如小石块般射向对手，猛击到对方服输。
author: infinex21
source: These small Pokémon weave their silk webbing into small webs that can launch them like miniature springboards. They will launch themselves at their opponents like small boulders that will pulverize them into submission.

entry: POKENAME腹部的一排刺能射出坚韧丝网，缠住对手。它们常沿丝将自己拉近，再以腹部钝端打出足以碎石的重击。
author: infinex21
source: The spikes lining a POKENAME's abdomen can shoot out threads of durable webbing that ensnare their opponents. They will often reel themselves in via these threads to deliver a rock-shattering blow with the blunt tip of their abdomen.

entry: 外形太独特，让它们模仿什么都不像。伪装一旦露馅，便干脆用头猛烈撞击。
author: frokachu
source: Due to their rather unique profile, they fail to imitate much of anything. When their disguise inevitably fails, they resort to violently headbutting instead.

entry: POKENAME相互较量力量，试图撞倒对方，让败者滚下山坡。不过，它们动作慢得惊人，碰撞很少真正造成伤害。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME battle one another in contests of strength, seeking to ram into one another and send the loser tumbling down the mountainside. They are incredibly slow Pokémon, and the impacts between them rarely result in any real harm.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，遇见同类便会正面撞头决斗。但速度太慢，战斗往往令人扫兴。
author: secondegg
source: POKENAME are very territorial and will clash in a head-to-head duel if they come across another of their own kind. Due to their slow speed, these battles are usually anticlimactic.

entry: POKENAME聒噪粗暴，对比自己小的宝可梦高声发号施令。大多数都学会不违命，否则就会挨上猛烈的碾压头撞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is loud and abrasive, barking out orders to any Pokémon smaller than it. Most learn not to resist its commands, lest they be on the receiving end of a violent and crushing headbutt.

entry: POKENAME不断用头碎巨石、战斗，因此许多人以为大脑永久受损。其实不对，因为脑并不在覆盖头部的大圆顶下。
author: bigoljax
source: Due to the constant usage of their heads for cracking open boulders and battle, many believe POKENAME have permanent damage to their brains. This is actually incorrect, since their brains are not under the large domes covering their head.

entry: POKENAME接触强无线电信号时，身体会古怪地活动。它反复撞东西，试图找出噪声来源，使其安静。
author: .izik
source: When exposed to strong radio signals, POKENAME's body moves in odd ways. It will repeatedly ram its head into objects while trying to locate and silence the source of the noise.

entry: POKENAME旋转头撞的威力，足以突破几乎任何障碍。虽有人试过让它破解密码，至今却只成功打破了电脑显示器。
author: .jerden
source: Due to the immense power of its spinning head smashes, POKENAME can break through almost any obstacle. While attempts have been made to use it to crack passwords, so far it has only succeeded in breaking computer monitors.

entry: POKENAME在丛林待得太久，石质身体就会覆满常春藤与草。遇同类时，它便用岩石般的头撞去，立刻分出谁更强硬。
author: fiordaliso
source: If POKENAME spends too much time in the jungle, its rocky body becomes covered in ivy and grass. When it encounters another of its kind, it rams into the other with its rock-hard head to instantly determine which one is tougher.

entry: 它遇见同类就会以硬如岩石的头互撞，立刻分出强弱。背上带着几颗种子，能释放孢子，促进附近树木与植物开花。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it meets another of its species, it rams into them with its rock-hard head to immediately determine which one is stronger. On its back it carries several seeds capable of releasing spores that enhance the blooming of nearby trees and plants.

entry: POKENAME从地面吸收磁力，等头上亮起强光便准备出击。它很容易预判对手动作，当地人称为“洞察魔像”。
author: korro0490
source: POKENAME absorbs magnetic force from the ground, and prepares to strike once their head glows bright. These Pokémon easily anticipate their opponents' moves. Locals refer to these Pokémon as "golems of perception".

entry: POKENAME身上的晶体极其坚固，只有撞上同类才会磕缺。晶碎稀少、光彩鲜艳，是极受珍视的商品。
author: sk372
source: The crystals growing on POKENAME's body are extremely sturdy; only impact with another POKENAME will chip them. Their rarity and vibrant shine make crystal shards a highly prized commodity.

entry: POKENAME的头骨无论当多少次攻城锤，也不会开裂。海滩上的它抵住游轮，就能防止搁浅。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its skull cannot crack no matter how many times it's used as a battering ram in battle. A POKENAME on the beach pushing against a cruise ship can prevent it from running aground.

entry: POKENAME头骨极其坚固，被认为完全无法伤及。曾有炮弹误射，击中附近一只；炮弹碎裂，它却连动都没动，毫无察觉。
author: sk372
source: Its cranium is so sturdy that it's thought to be completely invulnerable. Once, a misfired cannon shot struck a nearby POKENAME; the cannonball shattered on impact, and POKENAME neither flinched nor noticed.

entry: POKENAME用触须缠住敌人，拉近自己，打出强力头锤。训练家若疑虑重重、忧心忡忡，即使驯服的个体，有时也会轻轻撞对方。
author: infinex21
source: Using its feelers, a POKENAME will ensnare its foe and pull itself in toward them to deliver a crushing Headbutt attack. Even a tamed POKENAME will sometimes weakly headbutt its Trainer if they are riddled with doubts or concerns.

entry: POKENAME战前会拖脚摩擦地面，煽起情绪，直到火焰旺盛。尾部喷火能推动身体，打出足以碎钢的猛烈头撞。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME works itself up before battle by dragging its feet along the ground until its flames begin to flourish. It can release fire from its tail to propel itself, allowing it to deliver devastating headbutts that can shatter steel.

entry: 古时，POKENAME以甜香引来猎物，再用坚如铁的头骨狠狠撞击。
author: darkweavile428
source: During ancient times, POKENAME would attract prey with a sweet aroma, then bash it with its skull, which is as hard as iron.

entry: POKENAME高速飞行，直撞挡路的一切。岩石甲壳护住身体，让它不怕这些猛烈冲击。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME flies at extremely high speeds, ramming into anything in its path. Its rocky carapace protects its body from these high-speed impacts.

entry: POKENAME带着保龄球，试图模仿战槌龙的硬头骨，使头部明显歪斜。它们胡乱甩头，却因动作慢又容易预测，攻击常打不中。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's heads are quite lopsided due to the bowling balls they carry, attempting to mimic the tough skulls of Rampardos. They swing their heads around wildly, though these attacks often miss due to how slow and predictable they are.

entry: POKENAME四处飞行，用三颗头撞碎沿途一切。它没什么智力，有时甚至忘了另两颗头存在，输掉本可轻松取胜的战斗。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME flies around and shatters everything in its path by smashing them with its three heads. Lacking any intelligence, it sometimes forgets its other two heads even exist, leading to it losing fights it otherwise would have won easily.

entry: POKENAME成群倒挂洞顶睡觉，若被吵醒，就会头朝下落向入侵者。厚头骨互撞能在空中产生回响，用于回声定位、寻找食物。
author: santon5512
source: Groups of POKENAME hang from cave ceilings as they sleep, dropping headfirst onto intruders if awoken. By slamming their thick skulls together, they can create reverberations through the air, which they use to echolocate and find food.

entry: POKENAME住在洞穴深处，吃矿物硬化头部。受挑衅时，会猛撞洞顶，让周围钟乳石落向目标。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME live deep within caves, eating minerals in order to harden their heads. If provoked, they will slam their heads into the cave ceiling, causing the stalactites around them to fall onto their targets.

entry: POKENAME战斗时以碾压般头撞迎敌，连最结实的宝可梦也能撞倒。石皮几乎不受物理攻击影响，原始怒火凶猛得令人心惊。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME delivers crushing headbutts to its opponents in battle, knocking down even the sturdiest of Pokémon. Its rocky skin is near impervious to physical attacks, and its primal fury is ferocious to behold.

entry: POKENAME头顶圆顶充当超声波媒介，发出响亮轰鸣，逼退领地内的竞争者。
author: wiz0z
source: The dome atop POKENAME's head acts as a medium for their ultrasonic waves, creating a loud, booming noise that wards off competition in their territory.

entry: POKENAME由相互配合的两半组成。一半扎根地面，抽取化石燃料，为双方供能；另一半则保卫它，高速冲撞捕食者。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME is made up of two halves that work in tandem with each other. One half roots themselves into the ground, sapping fossil fuels from the ground to fuel them both. The other defends the first from danger, ramming into predators at high speeds.

entry: POKENAME的骨刺摸起来总是冰冷。它用硬头猛撞栖居的山坡，就能引发雪崩。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's bony spines are always cold to the touch. It can trigger avalanches by slamming its hard head against the slopes of the mountains it calls home.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇会随年龄变硬。最年长个体的蘑菇，已有坚如钻石的记录。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's mushroom grows harder with age. The eldest individuals have been documented to have mushrooms as hard as diamonds.

entry: POKENAME防御无可匹敌，最强重击也能若无其事地承受。挨打后，它会以惊人速度回以毁灭性头撞，再退回防御姿态。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's defence is unmatched, shrugging off even the mightiest of blows. After being hit, it retaliates with a devastating headbutt at astonishing speed, then slips back into its defensive stance.

entry: POKENAME脑小，容易暴怒，又能飞，因此只有本领很高的训练家才能驾驭。若全速撞地，强烈冲击会留下巨大撞击坑。
author: milchik
source: Because of POKENAME's small brain making its rage easy to trigger, combined with its ability to fly, this Pokémon can only be handled by a very skilled Trainer. If POKENAME crashes into the ground at full speed, the sheer impact forms a large crater.

entry: POKENAME反复用头砸地，挖出地下隧道。引发的震动，常被误认成小地震。
author: santon5512
source: By repeatedly slamming their heads into the ground, POKENAME tunnel through the earth. The tremors that these Pokémon cause are often mistaken for small earthquakes.

entry: 它的三颗头曾是一颗，大多数人认为，这就是配合如此默契的原因。它们同步头撞，既能松动硬土、粉碎坚石，也能从下方猛击对手。
author: infinex21
source: Its three heads were once one, which most believe is how they function with such excellent coordination. They will synchronize their headbutts to help tenderize tough ground, shatter solid rock, or to pummel an opponent from below.

entry: POKENAME很愚钝，不停用头撞墙、撞其他宝可梦，因而总是头痛。它们却想靠再多撞几下，缓解疼痛。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are quite dim-witted, constantly hitting their heads into walls and other Pokémon. This leaves them with constant headaches, which they attempt to relieve by slamming their head some more.

entry: POKENAME炭黑的毛摸着滚烫，但对信任的训练家，通常只会温暖。它能跑得极快，将冲力带入猛烈的头撞。
author: infinex21
source: Their charcoal-black furs are hot to the touch, though they will tend to be warm for their trusted Trainers. POKENAME can achieve great speeds, which carries into their devastating headbutt attacks.

entry: 野外较量时，POKENAME用硬头骨与尾上刺棒，逼对手臣服。胜者会以火焰吐息灼烧败者，显示主导地位。
author: sk372
source: During rival battles in the wild, POKENAME will use both their hard skulls and the spiked club on their tails to force the other to submit. The victor burns the loser with flame breath as a mark of dominance.

entry: 在其他地区，POKENAME会结群撞倒投掷猴，抢走树果。
author: malxire
source: In other regions, POKENAME forms packs to tackle Passimian down and steal their Berries.

entry: POKENAME拳击与头撞太强，大多数战斗都觉得太容易。只有认定值得的对手，才会用这两招。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME's punches and headbutts are so powerful that it finds most battles too easy. It will only use them against opponents it considers worthy.

entry: 黑金市用POKENAME加快采矿，因为一只就能赶上三个人。不帮忙挖掘时，它们会把勾魂眼赶离矿区。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Oreburgh City uses POKENAME to expedite mining, since they can mine as fast as three humans combined. When not helping excavate, they chase Sableye away from digs.

entry: POKENAME背上虽重，移动仍不算慢。冬季会让身体稍稍没入水中，冬眠并伪装。
author: camtft
source: Despite the sheer weight upon the backs of POKENAME, they are still able to move at a decent pace. They submerge themselves slightly in the winter months to hibernate and camouflage.

entry: POKENAME背上球茎外有厚壳，由叶片化石构成。头周围还有环状骨突，头撞敌人时能保护脑部。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a thick shell around the flower bulb on their back that is made of fossilized leaves. They also have a circular bony protrusion around their head that protects their brains when they headbutt foes.

entry: POKENAME向洞顶钟乳石掷骨，将其击落，再吃掉石块，硬化金属头骨。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hurls its bone at cave stalactites to knock them down. It eats the fallen stone chunks to harden its metallic cranium.

entry: POKENAME用岩石造武器，敲开坚韧树果。一些研究者推测，早期人类观察它后，才开始制作石器。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME fashions its weapon from rocks and uses it to crack open tough berries. Some researchers hypothesize that early humans began crafting stone tools after observing POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME用拳敲击臂盾，铿然挑战，寻找强敌交战。敲击头盾，还能暂时增强身体发电。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME clangs its fist against the shield on its arm as a challenge, seeking strong opponents to fight. Striking the shield on its head temporarily enhances its body's electrical generation.

entry: POKENAME常被误认成减速带，许多人直接开车轧过。它身体随即绷紧、向外膨胀，导致交通事故。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are often mistaken for speed bumps so many people drive their cars over them. This results in their body tensing up and expanding outward, leading to a traffic accident.

entry: POKENAME似乎执意要当防病毒程序，即使接到别的指令也不改。有人怀疑，这源于盾甲龙的防御能力，或是不熟悉软件内部运作。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME seems determined to act as an antivirus, even if it is directed to do other actions. It is suspected either Shieldon's defensive abilities or its lack of familiarity with the inner workings of software causes this behavior.

entry: POKENAME的壳几乎无法穿透，在准备进化前，始终可靠地保护身体。它们常是森林火灾唯一的幸存者。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's shells are practically impenetrable, reliably keeping them unharmed until they are ready to evolve. These Pokémon are often the sole survivors of forest fires.

entry: POKENAME圆胖的身体长得又大又厚，其他宝可梦常躲在后面，靠它阻挡威胁。厚脂肪坚韧得像钢铁。
author: maxissaa
source: POKENAME's rotund body has grown so large and thick, other Pokémon tend to hide behind it as it shields them from threats. Its thick fat is as durable as steel.

entry: POKENAME的重甲妨碍大多数动作，迫使它始终漂浮。重量大到浮着也托不住时，就会脸朝下，重重栽地。
author: bigoljax
source: The weight of POKENAME's armor often makes them struggle with most movements, forcing them to float all of the time. When the weight becomes too much to carry while floating, they faceplant into the ground hard.

entry: POKENAME大多待在地面，沉重头部让身体下坠、失去平衡。在林地筑巢时，头大得足以完全遮住身体。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME mostly remains on the ground, as its heavy head weighs it down and throws off its balance. When it nests on the forest floor, its head is large enough to entirely cover its body.

entry: 看似柔软的羊毛，其实是致密岩棉，为POKENAME构成厚甲。
author: hophoppip
source: What looks like a soft coat of wool is actually dense rockwool. It serves as a thick layer of armor for POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME是曾被认为灭绝的史前宝可梦，直到神奥百代森林发现活着的群落。背上发芽的种子坚固，壳厚数英寸，很难敲开。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are prehistoric Pokémon that had been thought to be extinct until a live population was found in Eterna Forest in Sinnoh. They have a sturdy seed sprouting from their back, the husk of which is several inches thick and difficult to crack.

entry: 很久以前，有些地方用POKENAME在雪中拖重物。它们用头清雪，让其他对象跟在后面走。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME were used long ago in some areas to haul heavy loads through snow. They would use their head to clear the snow, allowing others to follow behind them.

entry: POKENAME在地下挖洞。受威胁时，它会向后滑进洞里，只露出披甲头冠，再朝袭击者吐毒。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME dig burrows into the ground. When they feel threatened, they slither backwards into their hole with only their armored crest exposed. From there, POKENAME spit venom at their attacker.

entry: 粗糙的蹄与披甲象鼻，能保护POKENAME滑下山坡。年幼个体可能需要突击背心，进一步缓冲伤害。
author: quackquackattack
source: It has rough hooves and an armored trunk that protect it when sliding down hills. Younger POKENAME may need an Assault Vest to further cushion them from harm.

entry: POKENAME带着与自己同高的重盾，增强战斗防御。若陷入绝境，也可能扔开盾，狂乱奋战。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries a heavy shield as tall as it is to give it better defenses in combat. If a battle turns desperate, it may toss the shield aside and fight with a berserk fury.

entry: POKENAME摆动尾球，引来猎物，或诱使对手攻击披甲背部。目标一晕眩或迷糊，它就迅速转身，一举结束战斗。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME sway the balls on their tails to lure in prey or bait opponents into attacking their armored backs. Once their target is properly dazed or confused, they rapidly turn around and finish the battle in one fell swoop.

entry: 它用头碎石，吃里面的美味矿石。若有什么从背后悄悄靠近，就会变得凶暴。
author: cait_sith
source: It breaks rocks with its head to get to the tasty ore inside. It becomes aggressive if anything sneaks up on it from behind.

entry: POKENAME羽毛随时间硬化，曾因此被归为鳞片。羽毛比铁更坚韧，擦拭得当后，会泛起虹彩。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's feathers harden over time, causing them to have once been classified as scales. Its feathers are tougher than iron and have prismatic sheens when they are properly polished.

entry: POKENAME仍在学习跳舞与模仿，对自己要求很高。若没能完美复制舞蹈或动作，就会边闹脾气，边敲自己结实的头甲。
author: sk372
source: It is still developing its dance and mimicry skills, and is quite self-critical. If POKENAME fails to perfectly copy a dance or action, it hits its own resilient skull plate while throwing a tantrum.

entry: POKENAME会互相从手中发射小石子玩耍，再用坚实头骨把石子弹回投掷者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME play with each other by launching small rocks from their hands at the other, reflecting them back at the thrower by bouncing the stones off of their solid skulls.

entry: POKENAME总紧站训练家身边，以保镖自居。它会在自己与盟友面前造出精神护盾，反弹攻击，再把护盾掷向袭击者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME always stands close to its Trainer, regarding itself as something of a bodyguard. It creates psychic shields in front of itself and its allies, bouncing attacks back before flinging its constructs at the attacker.

entry: POKENAME十分悠闲，除非啃木头时受打扰。若这时有什么干扰，它就立刻用头骨上极硬的甲片撞过去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very laid-back unless bothered while gnawing on wood. If something disturbs it during this process, it immediately headbutts them with the very hard and rigid plate on its skull.

entry: POKENAME渴望与远古伙伴相聚，靠近其他化石时常从楔石中现身。意识到伙伴已不在，就以头骨轻叩化石，表示悼念。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME long to find ancient companions to mingle with, so they often emerge from their keystone when close to other fossils. When they realize that their companions are no longer with them, they tap their skulls against the fossils in mourning.

entry: 液态金属从POKENAME面甲流出，能受它控制，融入攻击。它用金属形成会咬合的嘴，从远处进攻。
author: evilgammon
source: Liquid metal flows from POKENAME's faceplate, which it can control and weave into its attacks. It uses this metal to form snapping mouths that let it attack from range.

entry: POKENAME厚重的甲壳极其坚固，因此是神奥沿岸海沟常见的化石。博物馆常陈列这些化石，作为近1000年前野外融合的证据。
author: anonymous_moose
source: POKENAME's heavily-armoured carapace is extremely durable, making it a common fossil in ocean trenches along the coasts of Sinnoh. These fossils are often displayed in museums as evidence of fusion in the wild from nearly 1000 years ago.

entry: POKENAME盔甲比钢更坚韧。它用头撞洞壁，震落矿石，吃下强化身体。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's armor is tougher than steel. It slams its head into cave walls to dislodge ores, which it then consumes to reinforce its body.

entry: POKENAME坚不可摧的脸，几乎能挡住所有冲击。它用硬头猛烈撞倒树，给小宝可梦提供树果与水果。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME's unbreakable face shields it from nearly any impact. It uses its durable head to deliver powerful headbutts to knock down trees, providing berries and fruit for smaller Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME以刀刃摩擦树与岩石，磨得锋利。眼睛在柄上，灵魂却住在面甲内，正是盾甲龙眼睛所在的位置。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME sharpens its blade by rubbing it against trees and rocks. While its eye is on its handle, the soul inhabiting it lies inside the face plate where the eyes of a Shieldon would be.

entry: 组织有序的POKENAME群，能对抗远大于单个成员的敌人。它们主要聚集在多岩的高原。
author: ferdirenz
source: A well-organized group of POKENAME can take on enemies much larger than their individual size. They congregate primarily in rocky plateaus.

entry: 它尽量避免冲突，却很少犹豫要不要挺身保护其他生灵。脸与头比钻石更坚韧，能承受并击退大多数攻击。
author: infinex21
source: It avoids conflict as much as it can, though it will rarely hesitate to leap to the defense of others. Its face and head are tougher than diamond, so it can endure and repel most attacks.

entry: 长耳兔与盾甲龙并未在融合中完美适应。耳朵虽强于防御，双腿也灵巧得出奇，组合起来却常让POKENAME在战斗中一头栽地。
author: bobosmith01
source: Pokémon Fusion has not perfectly adapted Lopunny and Shieldon together: while the ears grant powerful defense and the legs bring surprising nimbleness, it often combines into POKENAME falling flat on its face mid-battle.

entry: POKENAME的多条尾巴被收束在坚固壳内。进食时，壳充当护盾，挡住背后袭击。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's multiple tails are held together in a sturdy shell. This shell acts as a shield, guarding them from attacks from behind while they eat.

entry: POKENAME双臂的石盾，让它能在近战中巧妙格挡。最近，它由山中发现的化石复活。
author: fiordaliso
source: The stone shields on its arms allow POKENAME to skillfully block enemy attacks in close combat. This Pokémon was recently revitalized from fossils discovered in the mountains.

entry: POKENAME不畏战斗，厚铁盾能抵御大多数攻击。但它更愿躲雨，免得盾生锈。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME does not fear battle as its thick, iron shield can resist most attacks. However, it prefers to stay out of the rain as it could lead to its shield rusting.

entry: POKENAME常头朝前撞向对手，多年下来造成严重脑损伤。研究者正寻找解法，因为这已使它极度濒危。
author: huh.7
source: This Pokémon frequently rams headfirst into opponents. Years of doing this give POKENAME severe brain damage, which researchers are trying to find a fix for. It's made POKENAME an extremely endangered species.

entry: POKENAME面甲沉重，很难飞行。它会挂在洞顶练力，偶尔落到毫无戒心的宝可梦，甚至训练家身上。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME has a hard time flying due to its heavy faceplate. It hangs from cavern roofs to build strength, occasionally dropping onto unsuspecting Pokémon or even Trainers.

entry: 古代挂毯描绘POKENAME守城门。大规模围城战中，它的头被用来挡开箭矢与石块。
author: .izik
source: Ancient tapestries show POKENAME guarding city gates. Its head was used to deflect arrows and stones during great sieges.

entry: POKENAME爱囤金属，在废料堆与冶炼厂翻找，扩充收藏。偷窃时会戴金属面具，常装饰着偷来的小饰品。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME is a hoarder of metal, digging through scrap heaps and smelters to find anything to add to its collection. It wears its metal mask when stealing, often adorned with stolen trinkets.

entry: POKENAME战斗时俯冲而下，以强力头撞打得对手摔倒。但全身金属沉重，无法在空中待太久。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME swoops down from above, delivering strong headbutts in battle that send opponents sprawling. It can only stay in the air for a limited time, however, as the metal on its body weighs it down.

entry: 这种宝可梦约一亿年前生活在浅河。几乎没有东西能穿透甲壳，因此研究者相信，它因气候而灭绝。
author: mcnchsschl
source: This Pokémon lived in shallow rivers about 100 million years ago. Researchers believe it went extinct due to the climate, because almost nothing could penetrate its armored shell.

entry: POKENAME靠脸侧褶边向族群示警。捕食者在附近时，褶边就横向弯折，使同伴能迅速准备集体奔袭，对抗威胁。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on the frills on the side of their face to signal danger to other members of their pack, bending them horizontally whenever predators are nearby. This allows them to swiftly prepare a stampede to attack the threat.

entry: POKENAME会挑衅激怒其他对象，引其正面攻击。因为背上蘑菇能吸收坚实面甲承受撞击时的动能，获得养分。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME goads and agitates others in order to draw them into attacking it head-on. It does this because the mushroom on its back is nourished by absorbing kinetic energy from impacts to POKENAME's sturdy faceplate.

entry: POKENAME体内不断长出钢，徒步者偶尔会采下作纪念。钢有奇异光泽，传说还带有护佑之力。
author: evilgammon
source: Steel constantly grows from POKENAME's body, occasionally being harvested by hikers to take as souvenirs. This steel has an unusual shine to it, and is rumoured to possess a protective charm.

entry: POKENAME战斗时主要反复头撞，把对手撞倒。铁面甲让它格外擅长此道。它们很少独行，常结帮成群，接连撞击。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's main tactic in battle is to use repeated headbutts to knock its opponent to the ground, something it excels at thanks to its iron faceplate. They are rarely seen alone, often attacking in gangs with a flurry of headbutts.

entry: POKENAME全身强甲，大多数攻击都会滑开，因此不太胆小。通常只有顽固的袭击者纠缠不休，它才会瞬间移动逃开。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is covered in strong armor, making it less timid as most attacks glance off its body. It typically only teleports away when stubborn aggressors won't leave it alone.

entry: POKENAME的面甲能拆下当盾。轻便坚固，在战斗中相当好用。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's face plate is removable and able to be used as a shield. It's lightweight and durable, allowing for its effective use in battle.

entry: POKENAME繁盛于数百万年前形成的地下含水层。夏季，城市喷泉里也曾发现多只，因为暖水仿佛含水层的温热环境。
author: jojojax164
source: POKENAME thrive in underground aquifers formed millions of years ago. Multiple POKENAME have also been found in city fountains during the summer months, as the warm water emulates the heat of aquifers.

entry: 科学家不清楚，盾甲龙与小拳石融合时，为何看似退回了化石形态。许多人被POKENAME外形骗过，以为刚找到古老的盾甲化石。
author: soup1900
source: Scientists are unsure why Shieldon appears to reverts back to its fossil form when it fuses with Geodude. Many people have been fooled by POKENAME's appearance, thinking they had just found an ancient Armor Fossil.

entry: POKENAME总尽量贴地，用面甲保护其余身体。战斗时，它冲向对手，积聚冲势，再用角猛撞。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME always tries to keep its body flat to the ground, using its faceplate to shield the rest of its body from damage. It charges toward its opponent in battle, building momentum before ramming with its horn.

entry: POKENAME用坚如钢铁的盾甲龙头骨化石保护自己。化石也充当吓人的假脸。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME protects itself with a fossilized Shieldon skull, which is as hard as steel. The fossil also serves as an intimidating false face.

entry: POKENAME用巨大的石脸挡住危险，保护受困宝可梦。春季，球茎会产生致敏的细粉。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME protects other Pokémon in distress by shielding them with its huge stony face. In spring, its bulb produces a fine powder that causes allergies.

entry: POKENAME带着一把大化石镐，用来攻击或挖遗物。携带的巨盾，也是一块自己挖出的化石。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME carries a big fossilized pickaxe, which it uses to attack or dig up relics. The massive shield it carries is also a fossil that it dug up by itself.

entry: POKENAME住在洞穴深处，难觅踪迹。受威胁时，它们躲在携带的盾后，等候最佳时机，用强腿出击。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are elusive creatures that reside deep within caves. When threatened, they hide behind the shields they carry, waiting for the perfect moment to strike with their powerful legs.

entry: POKENAME用超能力护盾抵御攻击。盾的形状，几乎像一只史前宝可梦。
author: atlas3339098
source: POKENAME uses its psychic abilities to shield itself from attacks. The shape of this shield almost looks like a prehistoric Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，会赶去保卫自己的田地，对抗入侵者。从数英里外就开始冲锋，积聚冲势，打出毁灭性头撞。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME is extremely territorial, rushing to protect its fields against intruders. It starts its charge from miles away, building momentum to strike with a devastating headbutt.

entry: POKENAME像防火墙一样监控网络流量，保护个人电脑。它们提供的屏障极严，病毒很少能突破，确保数据安全。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME act like a firewall that monitors cyberspace network traffic to protect people's PCs. Viruses rarely get past the incredibly restrictive shield that POKENAME provide, ensuring data remains safe.

entry: POKENAME像防火墙一样监控网络流量，保护个人电脑。它们提供的屏障极严，病毒很少能突破，确保数据安全。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME act like a firewall that monitors cyberspace network traffic to protect people's PCs. Viruses rarely get past the incredibly restrictive shield that POKENAME provide, ensuring data remains safe.

entry: POKENAME的茧极其坚韧，能储存打来的动能。一受攻击，力量立刻原样弹回，伤到袭击者，壳却毫发无损。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's extremely resilient cocoon stores the kinetic energy of strikes made against it. If something attacks it, the force they applied will be immediately rebounded back, injuring its attacker while its shell remains unharmed.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃由磨利的骨构成，平脸却是软骨。因为脸上褶边主要用于装饰，在求偶季节展示健康程度。
author: quackquackattack
source: While POKENAME have blades made out of sharpened bone, their flat face is made of cartilage instead. This is because the frills on their face are mostly decorative and serve as measures of health during courtship season.

entry: 两只POKENAME相遇，会飞向彼此，用头猛撞，争夺高下。撞击声，常被误认成雷鸣。
author: fenragon
source: When two POKENAME meet, they will fly to each other and slam their heads together in a display of dominance. This sound is often mistaken for thunder.

entry: POKENAME似乎散发着意志之力。头甲不断以超能力推开附近一切，减缓来袭的攻击。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME seems to emanate willpower. Its head plate constantly repels anything near it with psychic force, slowing incoming attacks.

entry: POKENAME身上的叶能高速射出，如刀般切割。也能射进地面，长成巨大屏障，保护战斗中较弱的宝可梦。
author: evilgammon
source: The leaves growing off POKENAME's body can be shot off as rapid projectiles that slice like knives. These leaves can also be shot into the ground, causing them to grow into large barriers to protect weaker Pokémon in battle.

entry: POKENAME打盹时，颈上四面金属环盾会纵向扩张，包住身体，化作无法攻破的堡垒。据说，它的存在就能让附近所有生灵感到安全、受到保护。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME takes a nap, the four metallic ring shields on its neck vertically expand to sheathe its body, transforming it into an impenetrable bastion. Its presence is said to inspire feelings of safety and protection in all nearby.

entry: POKENAME通常不主动生事，受挑衅才会蜷起身体。若对方仍不停，它们就摩擦披甲双臂，引发大爆炸，再逃走。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are typically passive until they are provoked, curling up when aggravated. If they are continually antagonized, POKENAME will rub their armored arms together to cause a large explosion before running away.

entry: POKENAME体形厚重，能若无其事地承受大多数攻击。像是代价一样，陆地上移动极慢；入水却游得和喷射艇一样快。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME due to being incredibly bulky, they are able to shrug off most attacks from other Pokémon. Almost like a trade-off, they move extremely slowly on land; in water, however, they can swim as fast as a jet boat.

entry: 食物太大吃不下，POKENAME就会用脸压在河床上碾碎，留下印痕。数千年前的印痕化石，也已被发现。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Any food that is too large for POKENAME to eat, it crushes against the riverbed with its face. It leaves an imprint, and fossils of this have been found from thousands of years ago.

entry: POKENAME行动缓慢，以小家庭跋涉山口，追随太阳移动。它们结实强健，皮肤矿物丰富，能硬抗物理冲击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are slow moving Pokémon that trudge through mountain passes in small family groups as they follow the movement of the sun. They are hardy and rugged, their skin rich in minerals that toughen against physical impacts.

entry: POKENAME举着几乎与自己同高的盾防御。盾受击的动能会传入身体，强化接下来的反击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME wields a shield nearly as tall as it is for defense. Kinetic energy from the shield being struck transfers to POKENAME's body, empowering its subsequent counterattack.

entry: POKENAME身体上下两层几乎无法穿透，只有中间的小区域脆弱。它从两侧孔洞高速射出金属碎片，保护弱处。
author: sk372
source: The top and bottom layers of POKENAME's body are nigh-impenetrable, with only the small area between them being vulnerable. To protect its weak spots, it fires high-speed metal shards from the holes on its sides.

entry: POKENAME大脑巨大，智力也极其发达。它常在高海拔地区，朝天空咿呀说个不停。有理论认为，是出于渴望飞行。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's enormous brain results in it possessing an enormous intellect. This Pokémon can be found at high elevation areas, where it can be seen gibbering at the sky above. It has been theorized that this behavior results from its yearning to fly.

entry: POKENAME虽十分温顺，却常被警员收服。常见理由是它射得很准，还能保护身后的任何人。下班后，它们喜欢吃树果、泡水放松。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME, despite their very docile nature, are often caught by officers. That the Pokémon are a very good shot and that they can protect anyone behind them are often given as a reason. After work, POKENAME like to feed on berries and relax in water.

entry: POKENAME头上硬甲，连最猛烈的正面攻击也能挡住。有些古代战争图像中，它们排成盾墙，后方的人以耳朵作掩护。
author: .jerden
source: The hard plating on POKENAME's head protects it from even the fiercest frontal assault. In some depictions of ancient warfare, lines of POKENAME were used as shield walls, with people behind them using their ears as cover.

entry: POKENAME最快的移动方式，是沿地面滚动。起初虽然慢，带刺胎面一积起冲势，就几乎无可阻挡。
author: .jerden
source: The fastest way for POKENAME to travel is to roll itself along the ground. Although slow at first, once its spiked treads build up momentum, almost nothing will be able to stop it.

entry: 它的巨盾能承受肯泰罗的终极冲击。背后虽脆弱，偷袭者却可能挨上尾端铁球的重击。
author: cait_sith
source: Its massive shield can withstand a Giga Impact from a Tauros. Although it is vulnerable from behind, anything that sneaks up on it is at risk of a heavy blow from the iron ball on its tail.

entry: POKENAME迅速穿过大地，保护弱者，用坚实头骨挡住欺凌者正在打来的攻击。它给对方一次退让、避免冲突的机会；谁不听警告，就会遭到无情对待。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME travels quickly across the land defending the weak, stopping bullies mid-strike with its sturdy skull. It gives the perpetrators one chance to back away and avoid conflict, acting mercilessly to those who don't heed the warning.

entry: POKENAME曾被誉为防范数据窃取的完美防线。但黑客发现，它们只会挡直接攻击，用更迂回的手段就能轻松绕过。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME were once praised as the perfect defense against data theft. However, hackers discovered that POKENAME were only useful against direct attacks and easily bypassed by more obtuse means.

entry: POKENAME的肌肉坚如钢铁，两吨重的盾也举得轻松。这些勇士护着无辜宝可梦，迎战体型超过自己十倍的威胁。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's muscles are as tough as steel, allowing it to carry its two-ton shield effortlessly. They are valiant warriors who protect innocent Pokémon from threats over ten times their size.

entry: POKENAME不愿伤害他人，宁可保护，因此通常不用于战斗。许多知名人物会请它当保镖，因为光是站在那里，就能让威胁者不敢尝试袭击。
author: retrodox
source: POKENAME are not typically used in battle due to their desire not to harm others, instead choosing to protect. Many POKENAME are recruited by notable figures as bodyguards, as their presence alone prevents threats from even attempting an attack.

entry: 据说，POKENAME的盾几乎与保护训练家的意志一样坚不可摧。外表虽可怕，天性却温柔体贴。
author: cinnamoncreampuff
source: POKENAME's shield is said to be nearly as unbreakable as its will to protect its Trainer. Despite its fearsome appearance, it has a gentle and caring nature.

entry: POKENAME极力保护训练家，像保镖般站在前方。周围稍有突然动静，就立刻架起精神护盾，把训练家完全围住，直到确认能安全离开。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is highly protective of its Trainer, standing before it as a bodyguard. It quickly responds to any sudden movements nearby by erecting psychic shields around its Trainer, boxing them in completely until they are sure it is safe to exit.

entry: 许多人把POKENAME的石头随身携带，作为护身符。它一察觉危险就显形，以幽灵能量构成几乎无法摧毁的防壁。
author: sk372
source: Many have carried POKENAME's stone as a sort of protective charm. It manifests in response to perceived danger, creating a defensive wall of ghostly energy that is nearly indestructible.

entry: POKENAME在地下挖掩体，为战斗中的盟友提供掩护，建好便退回地底。若掩体被攻破，它就会破土而出，狂乱劈砍撕咬。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME digs bunkers in the earth to provide cover for allies in battle, before retreating back into the ground once the structure is built. If the bunker is breached, it will burst out of the ground, slashing and chomping in a wild frenzy.

entry: 这种宝可梦发上连着的盾，究竟极轻，还是POKENAME本身极强，至今不明。无论如何，它能咬碎坚石，也能稳稳挡开许多重击。
author: evilgammon
source: It is unknown whether the shield attached to the hair of this Pokémon is extremely lightweight, or if POKENAME is extremely strong. Whatever the case, its bite can reduce solid stone to gravel and is sturdy enough to deflect many crushing blows.

entry: POKENAME比未融合的同类更凶暴。野生个体不取守势，反而试着用刺贯穿敌人。但真正在战斗中，防御用法仍有效得多。
author: retrodox
source: POKENAME are a more aggressive species compared to their unfused counterpart. Rather than a defensive approach, wild POKENAME try to pierce enemies with their spikes. Despite this, POKENAME are far more effective when used defensively in real battle.

entry: POKENAME的甲壳，总像故乡的一座中世纪城堡。有时，甚至成了那座城堡样式仅存的证据。
author: staghorn
source: A POKENAME's shell always resembles a medieval castle of its home region. In some cases, they are the only surviving evidence of the castle's design.

entry: POKENAME年纪渐长，尾巴也会磨损。训练家必须妥善养护、磨利，才能保持效用。
author: retrodox
source: As POKENAME get older, their tails gain wear and tear. They need to be properly maintained and sharpened by their Trainer to keep their effectiveness.

entry: 战斗时，它能硬化触须，扎进地面，稳住身体，抵御攻击。谁靠近巢穴或幼崽，都会被它拦路。
author: infinex21
source: During battle, it can make its own feelers rigid and brace itself against attacks by stabbing them into the ground. It will bar the path of anyone who approaches its den and/or its young.

entry: 数亿年前，POKENAME统治天空。为了争夺主导权与领地，它们会头朝前互相冲撞。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Hundreds of millions of years ago, POKENAME ruled the skies. They fought for dominance and territory by ramming into each other headfirst.

entry: 它的蘑菇由坚韧又有弹性的金属合金构成。拳头强到能粉碎油轮船壳。
author: mistymagius
source: Its mushrooms are made of a metallic alloy that is both tough and stretchy. Its punches are strong enough to pulverize a tanker hull.

entry: 这种宝可梦有时被称为“街机怪兽”，机械外壳里却有内脏。通常不会伤人，除非对方玩游戏作弊；但偶尔也曾吃掉维修工。
author: hophoppip
source: This Pokémon, sometimes called the Cabinet Monster, has organs within its mechanical exterior. It usually avoids hurting humans unless they cheat at its game, though it has been known to eat the occasional maintenance man.

entry: POKENAME太重，爬不上网，只好利用大岩蛇留下的洞道。若有幼崽要保护，就能用石质身体堵住通道。
author: notsaying.
source: Being too heavy to climb onto webs, POKENAME will make use of cave tunnels left behind by Onix. If it has young that it needs to defend, it can block up these tunnels with its rocky body.

entry: POKENAME的角长出剃刀般利边，但它更爱防御，常拿角撞岩石与同伴的角，磨钝。受威胁时，它们会聚拢，以角组成墙。
author: deadshields
source: This Pokémon's horns grow with a razor's edge, but POKENAME prefer defence to offense so regularly blunt their horns by striking them against rocks and their packmates horns. When threatened, POKENAME come together to form a wall with their horns.

entry: POKENAME心地纯净，为无法自保者构成近乎无法攻破的墙。战斗中，它会跳到较弱宝可梦前面，挡住攻击。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME is a pure-hearted Pokémon that serves as a nearly unbreakable wall for the defenseless. It will jump in front of any weaker Pokémon in battle to shield them from incoming attacks.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，会头朝前飞撞敌人，再用利爪解决。甲片却不只这用途；有些个体会攻击同种其他雄性，证明自己最强。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME battle by flying headfirst into their opponents before using their talons to finish them off. However this isn't the only use of their plates, as some POKENAME attack other males of their species to prove themselves the strongest.

entry: POKENAME盾状的脸，遮住脆弱身体。传说，窥见甲下的对象会被诅咒，但无人活着证实。它藏在古代遗迹的阴影角落，不断挪动，始终不让人看见。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's shield-like face masks a frail body. Legends say those who glimpse beneath the armour are cursed, though none have lived to confirm it. It is found amongst ancient ruins, hiding in a shadowy corner and moving to stay always out of sight.

entry: POKENAME虽然极慢，却是可怕的对手。身体由世上最强的金属合金之一构成，身上的眼睛能为毁灭性光束蓄力，足以穿钢。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME is a dreadful Pokémon to fight despite its extreme slowness. Its body is made of one of the strongest metal alloys in the world, and the eye on POKENAME's body can charge up a devastating beam that could pierce steel.

entry: 它跋涉在世界各地的干草原，大片地面长满草。既有大把时间慢慢走，身体迟缓也不成问题。
author: quackquackattack
source: It is found traversing the dry steppes of the world, where large expanses of the ground are covered by grass. Its slow body does not cause issues when it can take all the time in the world on the steppes.

entry: POKENAME用出奇致密的身体，俯冲撞向进入领地的宝可梦。即使高速撞地，也只受轻伤。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME use their surprisingly dense bodies to dive directly into Pokémon that enter their territories. POKENAME can crash into the ground at high speeds while sustaining only minor injuries.

entry: POKENAME极其鲁莽，低头猛冲、疯狂挥击，用双颚撕碎敌人。鳞片坚如钻石，颚能撕开钢铁，古代世界无可匹敌。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are extremely reckless, battling by going into a headlong rush and thrashing wildly, their jaws tearing foes apart. With scales as tough as diamond and jaws that could shred through steel, POKENAME were unmatched in the ancient world.

entry: POKENAME身体结实，正面承受疾驰汽车的冲撞，也几乎不动摇。但岩石叶片较脆，冲击够强就可能飞脱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's durable body makes it able to take a head-on collision from a speeding car and barely flinch. Its rocky leaves are less sturdy, however, and may fly off after a sufficiently powerful impact.

entry: POKENAME直达颈部的护甲能防捕食者，坚固得能崩断怪颚龙的牙。随着更多捕食者出现，护甲还会继续增强。
author: bigoljax
source: The armor that goes up to POKENAME's neck protects it from predators. It is strong enough to shatter Tyrantrum teeth, and continues to grow stronger as more predators emerge.

entry: 刚醒的人偶尔会看见POKENAME，但它一意识到被发现，就会消失。据说，它守望熟睡者，抵御引来噩梦的灵魂。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has occasionally been spotted by people just waking up, vanishing as soon as it realizes it has been seen. It is said it watches over sleeping people, defending them from spirits that would cause the sleeper to suffer nightmares.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇，让它能挡开最强攻击。作为交换，它会在潮湿地区散播蘑菇孢子。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: The mushroom on a POKENAME's back allows it to deflect the strongest of attacks. In exchange, POKENAME spreads the mushroom's spores in damp areas.

entry: POKENAME厚甲与锋利铁爪，足以粉碎任何过往船只。它常住进沉船，为争夺大船，与同类激战。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's thick armor and sharp iron claws allow it to pulverize any passing ships. It will often make its home in sunken ships and will fiercely fight other POKENAME for the larger ship.

entry: POKENAME用头撞石，凿出冲浪板，乘着冲浪。日久，浪会风化磨损板子，迫使它再造。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME rides a surfboard that it carved by smashing its head into stone. Over time, the weathering from the waves it rides on wears it down, forcing POKENAME to make new ones.

entry: POKENAME每天举重石，测试铁头强度，看能一次叠起多少而保持平衡。哪怕失衡一次，也会明显不高兴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME constantly tests the strength of its iron-hard head by lifting heavy boulders each day, seeing how many it can balance stacked at once. It gets noticeably upset if it loses its balance even once.

entry: POKENAME的背部与翼部肌肉十分强健，弥补沉重体甲与骨棒的负担。保卫领地时，它俯冲侵入者，借冲势挥动尾棒，发动猛烈砸击。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME has very strong back and wing muscles to compensate for its heavy body armor and bone club. To defend its territory, it dives at the intruder and uses the momentum to swing its tail club at the foe in a devastating smashing attack.

entry: POKENAME长触手一抓住猎物，就绝不放脱。厚石盔保护头部，尖刺阻止任何想攻击的对象靠近。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME grabs prey with its long tentacles, it never lets it escape. Its head is protected by a thick stone helmet, whose spikes keep away anyone who tries to strike it.

entry: POKENAME身体极坚韧的防护部分，仍有一定可塑性。它能移动坚实甲片的位置，防备敌人专攻弱点。
author: sk372
source: The super-tough defensive parts of POKENAME's body are still malleable to an extent. It can shift the location of these sturdy plates on its body, letting it defend itself from those who would try to attack its weak points.

entry: POKENAME的壳由无法击破的岩石构成。若觉得将被挪动或攻击，就会将自己扎进地面，等到安全。
author: turcai_87271
source: POKENAME's shell is made of an unbreakable rock. If it thinks it is going to be moved or attacked, it plants itself in the ground and awaits safety.

entry: POKENAME凶猛好斗，结成小群生活，常袭击小镇，以坚盾和斧头迎战敌人。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: POKENAME is an aggressive fusion that lives in small groups and often attacks small towns. It uses its hard shield and axe to fight its enemies.

entry: POKENAME凶猛好斗，结成小群生活，常袭击小镇，以坚盾和斧头迎战敌人。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: POKENAME is an aggressive fusion that lives in small groups and often attacks small towns. It uses its hard shield and axe to fight its enemies.

entry: POKENAME每天约有18小时在偷懒。这样能储存能量，长得强壮高大。
author: pkmkprestoyt
source: POKENAME is found slacking for around 18 hours a day. This helps it store the energy needed to grow big and strong.

entry: POKENAME大多时间都睡在树里。只有暴食整树叶片时才醒，吃完立刻继续长期休眠。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends much of its time sleeping inside trees. It only wakes up to devour every leaf on the tree in a feeding frenzy, then goes straight back to its constant hibernation.

entry: POKENAME虽然表情不悦，却更爱躺在阴凉处。它懒洋洋地用橡胶般的长舌，从树上舔取果实。
author: .izik
source: Despite its grumpy expression, POKENAME prefers lounging in the shade. It lazily licks fruit off trees with its long, rubbery tongue.

entry: POKENAME在高草地慢慢挪动，四处觅食，用巨臂拍打任何打扰者。藤蔓取下蒸熟，能做成吃了会困倦的食物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lumbers around slowly in tall grass areas, poking around for food and swatting at anything that bothers it with its huge arms. Its vines, if removed and steamed, make a meal that invokes drowsiness in those that eat it.

entry: 幼崽大多时间睡觉，食量很少，因此POKENAME是个相当随性的家长。它是少数允许其他对象长时间抱幼崽的袋兽融合体之一。
author: sk372
source: Because the joey spends most of its time sleeping and requires little food, POKENAME is a rather lax parent. It is one of the few Kangaskhan fusions that allows others to hold its young for extended periods.

entry: POKENAME慢慢喝遍整片花田的蜜。吃东西时，谁靠得太近，就会遭猛烈踢击，连大得多的宝可梦也能被踢飞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME takes its time consuming the nectar of entire fields of flowers. It violently punts anything that comes too close while it is eating; even much larger Pokémon can be sent flying by its kick.

entry: POKENAME虽无翅膀，却能展开双臂，悠闲来回摆动长尾飞行。这种方式似乎不怎么费力，因为它能整天不停。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME lack wings, they can fly by stretching out their arms and leisurely swinging their long tail back and forth. This method of travel seems to require minimal effort, as POKENAME can keep it up all day.

entry: POKENAME奔走远方，为巢寻找完美树果。找好便睡着，让其他宝可梦偷走辛苦成果。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME search long and far for perfect berries for their nest. After doing so, they fall asleep, allowing other Pokémon to steal POKENAME's hard work.

entry: POKENAME大多温顺，平静咀嚼枝叶。若被惹怒，就会挥动四肢攻击，或张嘴喷出消化系统内的火焰。
author: .jerden
source: Most of the time, POKENAME is docile, calmly munching on leaves and branches. If anything provokes it to anger, POKENAME will lash out with its limbs or open its mouth to expel a stream of fire from inside its digestive system.

entry: POKENAME极不爱动，鲜少飞行，一生大多栖在同一树枝。几个小虫或一颗树果，就足以让它一个月不饿。
author: sk372
source: Extremely sedentary, POKENAME is rarely seen airborne, perching on a single branch for most of its life. A few small bugs or a single berry will keep its hunger satisfied for a month.

entry: POKENAME大多停在树枝上吃果。猎物靠近时，会突然跃下，高速拍翼追赶；若没很快抓到，就会回树上。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of its time perched on tree branches, feeding on fruit. If prey comes near, it will suddenly leap off and pursue them, flapping its wings at high speed. If POKENAME does not catch them quickly, it will return to its tree.

entry: POKENAME鼻子与尾巴能发出强闪光。进食时若有什么靠近，它就闭眼，亮到令人目眩，轻松逼退威胁，继续吃。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's nose and tail can flash brightly. If anything approaches POKENAME while it eats, it will close its eyes and shine with blinding brightness, effortlessly driving threats away so that it can continue eating.

entry: 它大多时间静静聆听，听觉十分敏锐，周围任何动静都听得见，因此很少觉得需要移动。
author: .jerden
source: It spends most of its time quietly listening with its keen hearing. Since it can hear every movement that happens nearby, it rarely feels the need to move.

entry: 阴天，POKENAME会异常懒散。它用覆毛的叶片拍打入侵者，接触后可能引发过敏。
author: .izik
source: On overcast days, POKENAME becomes unusually lethargic. It swats at intruders using fur-covered leaves that can leave allergic reactions on contact.

entry: POKENAME小巧懒惰，一周只需吃一次，其余时间都在闲混。连打呵欠，对它都算费力活动。
author: sk372
source: Tiny and lazy, POKENAME only needs to feed once a week, loafing the rest of its time away. Even yawning is treated like a strenuous activity for POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME总是昏昏沉沉，因此常一脸倦怠。它们不爱活动，以泥为食，暴雨后食物格外丰富。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often hold a languid expression because of how persistently groggy they are. They are a sedentary species that eats mud, which is plentiful after a heavy rain.

entry: POKENAME银毛反光极强，有月亮就会明显发亮。它们白天睡觉，大多选择无月之夜狩猎，悄声伏击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's silver fur is highly reflective and will visibly gleam whenever the moon is out. They sleep during the day and mostly hunt on moonless nights, moving quietly to ambush prey.

entry: POKENAME银毛反光极强，有月亮就会明显发亮。它们白天睡觉，大多选择无月之夜狩猎，悄声伏击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's silver fur is highly reflective and will visibly gleam whenever the moon is out. They sleep during the day and mostly hunt on moonless nights, moving quietly to ambush prey.

entry: POKENAME完全无声，连靠近果实进食也一样。通常没什么用，但果实其实是草属性宝可梦时，偶尔就能派上用场。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME are perfectly silent, even when approaching fruits to eat. This is usually useless, but sometimes comes in handy when the fruit is actually a Grass-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME生活不爱动，容易肌肉萎缩。它需要营养丰富的树果汁，保持肌肉强健。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is prone to experiencing atrophy of its muscles because of its sedentary lifestyle. It needs nutrient-rich Berry Juice to keep its muscles strong.

entry: POKENAME始终缺乏动力，老练训练家也难教。若这情绪化的家伙偶得灵感，就会将积压的能量全部用在绘画上，直到灵感再度消退。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME lives in a constant lack of motivation, which makes it tough to train even for experienced Trainers. If inspiration happens to strike this moody Pokémon, it'll release all its pent-up energy into drawings before losing the spark again.

entry: 它偷偷溜进谷仓阁楼，睡在干草堆。鼾声往往是暴露行踪的第一个迹象。
author: oddwalls
source: It sneaks into barn lofts and sleeps in haystacks. Its snores are often the first sign of its presence.

entry: POKENAME与看似有压力的人分享蛋。浓郁绵滑的内馅，能让食者平静放松，接下来一整天，通常都会陪它偷懒。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME shares its egg with people who seem to be stressed. The rich and creamy filling makes anyone who eats it feel calm and relaxed, and they usually spend the entire next day slacking off with POKENAME.

entry: 它一跺脚就能震地，一击就能倒树。因此，不必爬高或等果实自然掉下，就能取得高枝水果。
author: .jerden
source: It can shake the earth by stamping its foot, and topple trees with one blow. It uses this to access fruit from the tops of tall trees, rather than climbing up or waiting for it to fall naturally.

entry: POKENAME向树投石，震落果实。其他宝可梦靠近，它先用双拳响亮敲打石甲，试图吓退；若无效，就会用掌击打。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME tosses rocks at trees to knock down fruit. POKENAME will frighten other Pokémon that approach by loudly drumming its fists against its rocky armor, and if that fails to frighten them off, it will strike them with the palms of its hands.

entry: POKENAME强壮身体似为战斗而生，却仍避战，主要吃素，与好斗宝可梦保持距离。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: Though its powerful body seems designed for battle, POKENAME still avoids fights, remaining mostly vegetarian and keeping its distance from aggressive Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的战法会借敌人的冲势反制，轻松抛动重敌。对方若想起身再攻，它还会趁倒地补上一脚。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME practices a fighting style that uses its enemies' momentum against them. This enables it to toss heavy foes around with minimal effort, kicking them while they are down if they try to get back up to attack again.

entry: POKENAME依恋训练家，内心却极懒。它会用超能力悄悄影响训练家，让对方也过上像自己一样懒散的生活。
author: sk372
source: Highly attached to their Trainer but extremely lazy at heart, POKENAME uses psychic powers to subtly influence its Trainer to live a more indolent lifestyle like it does.

entry: POKENAME一动不动地挂在果树干上，看似空的壳内却藏着巨力。只有受到严重打扰，或实在很饿时，才能释放。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME can be found hanging motionless on the trunks of fruit trees. There's a great force hiding within its seemingly hollow shell that can only be unleashed if POKENAME is heavily disturbed or just very hungry.

entry: 它被认为有足以移山的力量，意志却懒散，只飘在空中。一阵微风就能带走。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its strength is assumed to be great enough to move mountains, but its inert willpower leaves it floating in the air. A light breeze can whisk it away.

entry: POKENAME爬上树，把沉重身体从高处砸向猎物。它能耐心挂在枝上几天，似乎确切知道美餐何时会来。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME climbs up into trees to drop its heavy body down onto prey from above. They can patiently cling to tree branches for days and seem to know exactly when a good meal is about to approach.

entry: POKENAME每次现身，身体都会使附近生灵精力流失，变得懒散昏沉。它似乎并非有意，却也毫不在乎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME generates a draining effect from its body whenever it appears, causing those near it to become lazy and drowsy. POKENAME does not seem to do this consciously, but also does not seem to care.

entry: POKENAME速度与力量足以狩猎几乎任何目标，却很少有动力。它主要用强颚吃植物根部，因为很容易挖出。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME has enough speed and power to hunt almost anything, it rarely has the motivation. It mostly uses its powerful jaws to eat plant roots, as it can dig those up with ease.

entry: POKENAME把树果存进假嘴，延长外出觅食的间隔。为了偷懒，有时一次塞太多，反而弄伤自己。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stores berries in its false mouth so it can lengthen the time between hunts for food. Occasionally, it may injure itself trying to store too much at once in this effort to be lazy.

entry: POKENAME硕大的头有90%由骨骼构成，比钢铁还硬。头骨太厚，大脑反倒小得可怜。
author: jokerswild
source: POKENAME's oversized head is 90% bone, which makes it harder than steel. Since its skull is so thick, its brain is very tiny.

entry: POKENAME休息最长能达三天，毛发因此长得又长又蓬。活动时，它专心觅食暴吃，以巨力清除沿路一切障碍。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's fur has grown long and bulky due to its rest periods, which can sometimes last up to three days. When it is active, it is always focused on finding food to gorge upon, utilizing its vast strength to remove all obstacles in its way.

entry: POKENAME食欲惊人，却很少在海中狩猎。反而会游到无人岛，拖着身体上岸，大吃水果。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has an immense appetite, but rarely hunts for food in the ocean. Instead, it will swim up to deserted islands and drag itself up onto land to devour fruit.

entry: POKENAME全身每寸都散发力量，却懒散得不肯释放巨力，鲜少移动。故事说，若真正施展全力，连星球本身都会破裂。
author: sk372
source: Power radiates from every inch of POKENAME's body, but it rarely moves, too lethargic to unleash its vast strength. Stories say if it were to unleash its true power, the planet itself would rupture.

entry: POKENAME大多时间在阳光下睡觉，以光合作用供能。多余能量从毛发释放，促进休息地周围的植物生长。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME spend most of their time sleeping in the sun, using photosynthesis to fuel themselves. They release their excess energy through their fur, boosting the plant growth in the areas where they rest.

entry: POKENAME很少移动，背上形成了繁盛的小宝可梦生态。它乐得如此，能吃到上方落下的残食，更久不用动。
author: sk372
source: It rarely moves, so an ecosystem of small Pokémon flourishes on its back. This suits POKENAME just fine, as it can feed on leftover bits of their meals that fall from above, letting it remain sedentary longer.

entry: POKENAME能奋力挥动石指。战斗中，它耐心等候破绽，再击中敌人最脆弱的部位。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can swing its rocky fingers with great force. POKENAME waits patiently for an opening in combat, then strikes its foe in its most vulnerable spot.

entry: POKENAME用盾拖延，等待对手防御露出破绽。等它想出手时，应该只需一击。
author: loadedace
source: POKENAME utilizes its shield to wait out openings in their opponents' defenses. When it feels like it, it should only need to strike once.

entry: POKENAME眼睛发光，能看穿实物，却很耗能。歇眼时，果实状尾巴可能引来其他宝可梦，让它用闪电般的一击轻松猎取。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's eyes can gleam to see through solid objects, but this uses a lot of energy. While resting their eyes, their fruit-shaped tail may lure in other Pokémon, making them easy prey for one of POKENAME's lightning-fast attacks.

entry: POKENAME缓慢懒散，却颇为狡猾。不追猎物，反而爬到高处，堆起石头，奋力投掷来觅食。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is slow and lazy, but also rather cunning. Instead of chasing after prey, it climbs up to a high place and gathers a pile of rocks, then hunts for food by flinging them with great force.

entry: POKENAME爱飞，却通常只是滑翔，不怎么振翅。落地后，它可能躺上数天，才肯提起劲，慢慢爬回高崖，再次跃下。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME loves to fly, but usually just glides rather than flapping its wings. If it lands on the ground, it may lie there for days before it can be motivated enough to slowly climb back up to a high cliff to jump off.

entry: 从一只齿轮伸出的独臂，强到一击就能碎大石。可惜，或者说幸好，它的力量一击就耗光，必须休息才能再出手。
author: infinex21
source: The single arm protruding from one of its gears is strong enough to shatter a large boulder in a single strike. Unfortunately, or thankfully, this Pokémon's strength is exhausted in a single strike and it will have to rest before it can strike again.

entry: 只要轻碰POKENAME的缎带，层层倦意就会把人淹没。受影响者至少一周都懒散无神。
author: sk372
source: Just a simple brush from POKENAME's ribbons causes waves of lethargy to overwhelm a person. This effect leaves the afflicted party feeling lazy and listless for at least a week.

entry: 传说，它睡在云层遥远上方。若人类的愚行惊醒它，就会带着滔天怒火降下，让全人类安息。
author: sk372
source: Legends say it sleeps somewhere far above the clouds, and that should humanity's follies wake it from its slumber, it will descend with great fury and put all of humanity to rest.

entry: POKENAME虽有推动大陆的力量，却从不认真战斗。训练家养上一周，往往就受不了，解除了融合。
author: faelocke
source: While powerful enough to move continents, it never takes battling seriously. Trainers of POKENAME often unfuse it out of frustration after a week.

entry: POKENAME等臂上甜香花引来猎物，再以利刺注毒。猎物若逃，它就慢慢跟着，相信对方最终会被毒击倒。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will wait until the sweet-smelling flowers on its arms lure in its prey, then jab it with its sharp thorns to deliver poison. POKENAME will slowly follow prey that flees, confident it will eventually succumb to its toxins.

entry: POKENAME太重，无法独自漂浮，便请飘飘球帮忙飞行。它命令对方载到果实丰富的地方，再落下暴吃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enlists help from Drifloon in order to fly, as it's too heavy to float on its own power. It commands them to carry it to areas rich in fruit, so it can drop down and gorge itself.

entry: POKENAME假扮精致的床，偶尔潜入旅馆与住宅。谁愚蠢到躺上去，强臂就会试着让对方再也起不来。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME pretends to be an elaborate bed and will occasionally sneak into hotels and homes. If anyone is foolish enough to lie in it, powerful arms will try to prevent them from ever getting up again.

entry: POKENAME虽能双足走路，但只要不能直接躺平，就更爱四足爬行。战斗中，用剃刀般的长牙切割敌人脚踝。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME can walk on two legs, it prefers to crawl around on all fours if it isn't able to just lie flat. In combat, it uses its razor-sharp tusks to slash at the ankles of its foes.

entry: POKENAME巨力惊人，刀刃瞬间就能劈石，却更爱整天偷懒。要吃东西时，才短暂起身，切下近树果实，再躺回去。
author: .izik
source: Despite its incredible strength and blades capable of cleaving stone in an instant, POKENAME prefers to laze about all day. Should it need to eat, it rises briefly to cut fruit from nearby trees before settling back down.

entry: POKENAME一颗头极有精神，另两颗却懒。活跃的头带着其他头四处走，吃掉大部分食物，但既然都进同一个胃，另两颗也似乎无所谓。
author: .jerden
source: One of POKENAME's heads is incredibly energetic, but the other two are lazy. This one head leads the others around and eats the majority of POKENAME's food, but since it all goes to the same stomach, the other two heads don't seem to care.

entry: POKENAME三颗头中，一颗比其他的警觉，会在它们睡觉时守望。若久留原处，它似乎烦躁，却不说服中央头，就似乎无法移动自己的身体。
author: .jerden
source: One of POKENAME's three heads is much more alert than the others, keeping watch while they sleep. It seems to get frustrated if POKENAME remains in one place for too long, but seems unable to move its own body without convincing the central head.

entry: POKENAME灌满水后，在陆地弹跳狩猎。满水体重能超过一吨，身体砸下，便能碾碎压在下面的大多数宝可梦。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME hunts for prey by filling its body with water and bouncing around on land. Its body slams will crush most other Pokémon it catches beneath it, as it can weigh more than a ton when full of water.

entry: POKENAME懒得练唱，歌声十分刺耳。听众常装睡，想让它早点停；招来的愤怒，依然比歌声好受。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's singing is quite cacophonous, as it doesn't bother to practice and hone its skill. Listeners often feign sleep to make it stop more quickly; the resulting indignant wrath is still less painful than its song.

entry: POKENAME埋在阴凉处，只露张开的大嘴，等猎物走进去。等待时常睡着，结果鼾声把潜在猎物吓跑。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME buries itself in shady places, leaving its open mouth exposed while it waits for prey to walk into it. It often falls asleep while waiting and ends up scaring away potential prey by snoring.

entry: POKENAME通常满足于平静浮水，无视周围大多事物。若被惹恼，却会狂怒扑腾，强得连暴鲤龙都要迟疑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is usually content to float placidly in water, ignoring most of its surroundings. Should something agitate it, however, it will fly into a thrashing rage potent enough to give a Gyarados pause.

entry: POKENAME的花瓣香能让其他宝可梦睡着，包括想伤害它的捕食者。之后它慢慢走开；只有对方醒来追赶，才用毒刺自卫。
author: .jerden
source: The aroma of POKENAME's petals can lull other Pokémon to sleep, including predators that might try to harm POKENAME. After this happens, POKENAME will slowly walk away, only using its poisonous thorns for defense if they wake up to pursue.

entry: POKENAME尖牙能刺穿最厚的皮，抽取其他宝可梦的血。一咬住就不肯松，有时还挂着睡着。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's fangs are powerful enough to puncture even the thickest of hides and drain blood from other Pokémon. It will refuse to let go once it has latched on, and occasionally falls asleep while still attached.

entry: POKENAME用强颚扯断枝条、拔起树。它只吃植物，但若受袭，就会以碾压般的力量反咬。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses its strong jaws to tear down branches and uproot trees. While it only eats plants, if anything attacks POKENAME, it will bite back with crushing force.

entry: POKENAME随时都有半边脑在睡，节能却反应变慢。但真行动起来，速度与力量都惊人，轻松打败大多数胆敢靠近的野生宝可梦。
author: bobosmith01
source: One half of POKENAME's brain is asleep at any given time, which conserves energy but slows POKENAME's reaction time. However, POKENAME is devastatingly swift and powerful when it does act, easily besting most wild Pokémon that dare to come close.

entry: POKENAME似乎懒得站，主要沿地面滑行，留下黏痕。嘴离地近，因此大多会先吃掉前方草，再滑过去。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME seems to be too lazy to stand and mostly moves by sliding along the ground, leaving a slimy trail behind it. Since its mouth is close to the ground, it mostly devours grass before passing over it.

entry: POKENAME只为乐趣战斗，也只找能带来好挑战的对手。但若对方占上风，它也不怕使阴招。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME only fights for the fun of it and only fights opponents that will give it a good challenge. However, it is not afraid to fight dirty if its opponent gets the upper hand.

entry: 许多人误以为这两只宝可梦合作设陷阱。其实，请假王是在救噬沙堡爷想悄悄抓住、藏入体内的生灵。
author: sk372
source: Many falsely assume the two Pokémon work in tandem to trap unfortunate victims, but in reality the Slaking is trying to save any creature Palossand tries to sneakily capture and hide within itself.

entry: POKENAME满足于缓缓、悠闲地游海。受打扰时，它一咬牙，就会放出精神能量冲击波，震昏200米内的一切。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is content to lazily swim around the ocean at a slow and leisurely pace. If anything bothers it, it grits its teeth and sends out a shockwave of psychic energy to knock everything out within 200 meters.

entry: POKENAME的蘑菇吃下后会令人情绪剧变，在狂乱暴躁的精力与懒散昏沉间摇摆。它自身也有同样变化，最好避开。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME mushrooms cause wild mood swings when consumed, with the consumer swinging from frenetic, angry energy to slothful lethargy. POKENAME themselves exhibit these same mood swings and are best avoided.

entry: POKENAME很少移动，但自己的空间若受干扰，就会以凶狠巨力攻击。它在果树下筑巢，严加守护。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rarely moves but will attack with brutal force if its space is disturbed. It builds nests beneath fruit trees and guards them fiercely.

entry: POKENAME住在浅河，懒等岸上垂枝落下熟果。发怒时疯狂扑腾，力量足以碎石。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME live in the shallows of rivers and lazily wait for ripe fruit to drop from overhanging trees. When angered, it trashes about with enough power to shatter rocks.

entry: POKENAME最爱战斗，却极其懒惰。只肯坐着打，太累就停手睡觉。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME loves battling more than anything, however it is extremely lazy. It exclusively fights sitting down and will stop attacking and sleep if too exhausted.

entry: POKENAME大多时间沉睡，睡得躁动，手脚不安抽动。醒来就暴怒数小时，四处狂奔，撕碎一切抓得到的东西。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend the majority of their time slumbering, fidgeting and twitching in agitated sleep. When roused, they fly into a rage that can last for hours, racing around and tearing apart anything they can get their hands on.

entry: POKENAME虽外表威严，大多时间却用吻部挖土找食物。受威胁时能跑得惊人地快，但通常逃跑，不会反击。
author: .jerden
source: Despite their dignified appearance, POKENAME spend most of their time searching for food by digging in the dirt with their snout. They are capable of moving with incredible speed if threatened, but usually flee rather than retaliating.

entry: POKENAME双翼久不用而萎缩，连肯活动时，尾火也只隐隐燃着。但一发怒，火就会爆发成烈焰，焚烧惹恼它的对象。
author: sk372
source: Its wings have atrophied from lack of use and even the fire on its tail hardly smolders when it deigns to move around. If angered, however, POKENAME's fire will erupt into a blazing inferno used to immolate the target of its ire.

entry: POKENAME一被要求训练，就会浑身难受、无力，常懒得练，或不愿练。尽管如此，肌肉却奇迹般始终强韧，不会萎缩。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME experience a debilitating malaise whenever they have to train, often feeling lazy or unwilling to practice. Despite this weakness, their muscles miraculously remain tough and without atrophy.

entry: POKENAME的体能无与伦比。然而，过于强大的力量反而让它变得懒散而傲慢。
author: griddle
source: The physical prowess of POKENAME is unmatched. However, its strength has made it sedentary and arrogant.

entry: POKENAME躺在树果下，耐心等果实落进嘴。但懒得捡其他树果，哪怕掉在旁边，也只会任其腐烂。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lies under berries, patiently waiting for the berries to fall into its mouth. However, it is too lazy to pick up any other berries so if any berry falls next to it, it will be left to rot.

entry: POKENAME力量强、速度快，却常冷漠得不想动。只有极有耐心与毅力的训练家，才有希望慢慢驯服。
author: frokachu
source: Though it is a powerful and fast Pokémon, it is often too apathetic to move. Only Trainers with great patience and perseverance can hope to tame a POKENAME over time.

entry: POKENAME坐在湖底，鲜少移动，偶尔向靠得太近的东西射冰刺。谁若打脸，它就会愤怒地从后方喷水，推进追赶。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME sits at the bottom of lakes and rarely moves, occasionally firing spikes of ice at anything that gets too close. If anyone strikes its face, it will angrily chase after that attacker by firing a jet of water out of its rear.

entry: POKENAME坐在湖底，鲜少移动，偶尔向靠得太近的东西射冰刺。谁若打脸，它就会愤怒地从后方喷水，推进追赶。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME sits at the bottom of lakes and rarely moves, occasionally firing spikes of ice at anything that gets too close. If anyone strikes its face, it will angrily chase after that attacker by firing a jet of water out of its rear.

entry: POKENAME带着形似零余果的摆锤，用来催眠其他宝可梦，说服对方带来新鲜森林水果。
author: oddwalls
source: POKENAME carries a pendulum that looks like a Chesto Berry. It uses the pendulum to hypnotize other Pokémon and persuade them to bring POKENAME fresh forest fruit.

entry: POKENAME先播种，再从球茎浇下特殊花蜜，帮助发芽。植物虽能长得高大强壮，无论什么种类，却都会对人类有毒。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME plant seeds into the ground before pouring a special nectar from their bulbs to help the sprouts grow. While the plants do grow big and strong, no matter the species of plant, it will be poisonous to humans.

entry: POKENAME头骨覆有白黏毒，接触会抽搐。哭泣时，毒素会渗到周围地面。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's skull is coated in a white, sticky poison that can cause convulsions on contact. When it cries, the toxin seeps onto the surrounding ground.

entry: POKENAME用猛烈踢击，保护高草里的尼多一族。它用头上硬角划刻树与岩石，标记领地。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME protects Nidoran living in tall grass with devastating kicks. It uses the hard horn on its head to carve trees and rocks, marking its territory.

entry: POKENAME用额上毒角无情冲撞敌人。它讨厌湿身，因此暴雨时会躲进洞深处，等天气转晴。
author: fiordaliso
source: It ruthlessly attacks foes by charging at them with the venomous horn on its forehead. It despises getting wet, so during rainstorms POKENAME hides deep inside caves until the weather clears.

entry: 许多训练家忍不住想逗POKENAME的幼崽，不知毒性强到能让请假王昏倒。若继续烦宝宝，母亲就会用百万吨重拳，把人打飞。
author: ghostslythe
source: Many Trainers are tempted to play with POKENAME's young, not realizing their poison is strong enough to faint a Slaking. If they continue to annoy the pup, the mother Pokémon sends them flying with a Mega Punch.

entry: POKENAME双翼布满剧毒细鳞，短暂接触也会强烈恶心。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's wings are filled with tiny scales that are extremely poisonous. Even brief contact can cause intense nausea.

entry: POKENAME把找到的幼年宝可梦视如己出。它们主要以比画动作造出无形屏障，尖缘会让接触者中毒。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME care for young Pokémon they find as if they were their own children. They mostly do this by miming the creation of invisible barriers, which will poison anyone who makes contact with their sharp edges.

entry: POKENAME把找到的幼年宝可梦视如己出。它们主要以比画动作造出无形屏障，尖缘会让接触者中毒。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME care for young Pokémon they find as if they were their own children. They mostly do this by miming the creation of invisible barriers, which will poison anyone who makes contact with their sharp edges.

entry: POKENAME只为抵御好斗宝可梦，才使用剧毒的刺。它极力保护同住草原的尼多一族。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its extremely venomous stingers only as a defensive measure against aggressive Pokémon. It is deeply protective of the Nidoran that share its grasslands.

entry: POKENAME通常藏在河里，身体没入水下，眼耳留在水面。颜色让大多对象看不见；一发现猎物，就会以惊人速度猛扑，咬上一口注毒。
author: ghostslythe
source: Usually found in rivers, POKENAME keeps its body submerged, while keeping its eyes and ears above the surface. Due to its coloration, most will not see it. When prey is spotted it lunges surprisingly fast, landing a venomous bite.

entry: POKENAME把幼崽藏进壳，避开危险。若有宝可梦发现藏处，它就会用猛烈的蟹钳锤，将对方打飞。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME hides its young in its shell, concealing them from any danger. If a Pokémon figures out its hiding spot, it will send them flying with a devastating Crabhammer.

entry: POKENAME在崎岖崖壁筑巢，俯瞰下方世界。它们极力护巢，训练家穿行尖岩陡崖时，最好带块肉干，分散注意。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME make nests along craggy cliffs where they can see the world below them. They are incredibly protective of these nests, so Trainers are advised to bring a piece of jerky as a distraction while navigating the jagged cliffs.

entry: POKENAME蛇状身体覆有厚鳞，抵御栖地的岩石。争地战中，鳞片也保护彼此，让它们安全承受猛烈互击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have thick scales coating their serpentine bodies, protecting them from the rocky terrain they live in. Their scales protect them from one another when battling for territory, allowing them to slam one another with powerful blows safely.

entry: POKENAME白天用超能力飞行，体色能伪装，避免被看见。它寻找毒物泄漏处，吸毒入体，让自然重归平衡。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME flies with its psychic powers in the daylight, its coloration providing camouflage against sightings. It seeks out toxic spills, absorbing the poison into itself and bringing nature back into equilibrium.

entry: POKENAME体形虽小，承受强攻也不动摇。无论什么种类，守护幼年宝可梦时，尤其坚韧。
author: imaginita
source: Despite its small size, POKENAME can take powerful attacks without budging. It is especially resilient when defending young Pokémon, no matter the species.
