entry: POKENAME擅长拟声，会模仿捕食者低吼，保护巢穴。它们依恋发声物品，跟随训练家，以毒啄守护这些东西。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME are renowned for their ability to mimic sounds, keeping their nests safe by copying predator growls. They imprint onto objects that make sounds, and follow Trainers to defend those objects with venomous pecks.

entry: POKENAME警觉谨慎，站在洞外，确保里面安全。看见捕食者，就先催亲族进洞，再与威胁对峙。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are alert and vigilant creatures that stand guard outside burrows to ensure the safety of those inside. When they spot a predator, they usher their kin into the burrow before having a standoff with the threat.

entry: POKENAME住在大型公共洞穴。发现威胁，附近个体都逃入，只留最大的一只堵口。躲在里面的同伴发出高声尖叫，试图吓走威胁。
author: qinshanu
source: POKENAME live in large communal burrows. When a threat is spotted, all nearby POKENAME flee inside, save for the largest which uses its body to block the entrance. Those in hiding let out high pitched shrieks to try and scare the threat away.

entry: POKENAME皮肤与甲壳坚韧，硬外层让它们不太灵活。但谁真能咬下一口，都会觉得恶臭难吃、毫无食欲。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have toughened skin and carapaces. Their stiff coatings mean they are not particularly mobile Pokémon, but anything that does manage to take a bite out of them finds them to be foul tasting and unappetising.

entry: POKENAME织复杂蛛网困住猎物，再以毒爪或毒牙解决。它常用蛮力赶走阿利多斯，占据原本的栖树。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can weave intricate webs in which it traps prey, finishing them off with venomous claws or fangs. It tends to infest trees previously inhabited by Ariados, having driven them away with its brute strength.

entry: POKENAME会将石球里的毒喂给同巢亲族。幼崽有特殊酶，能处理、中和摄入的毒，再以剩余膏状物获取养分。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME feed kindred members of their nest poison from their stone spheres. Their young have special enzymes that process and neutralize the poison once ingested and are nourished by the remaining paste.

entry: 它们虽然不大，身体却极结实，能承受大得多的敌人攻击。但相当胆怯，数量处于劣势就会逃。
author: santon5512
source: Despite their size, their bodies are extremely tough, able to withstand attacks from much larger foes. They are quite skittish, however, fleeing when outnumbered.

entry: POKENAME埋入土或泥，只露毒角。猎物误踩，它便趁麻痹吞食。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: POKENAME buries itself in dirt or mud with only its venomous horn exposed. When prey stumbles onto it, it devours them while they're paralyzed.

entry: POKENAME背花会放出细粉，吸入者就睡着，甚至被用来制强效安眠剂。尖刺含强毒，保护花瓣不被其他宝可梦伤害。
author: fiordaliso
source: The flower on POKENAME's back can release a fine powder that puts anyone who breathes it to sleep; this dust is even used to make strong sleeping agents. Its spines are laced with potent toxins to protect the flower's petals from other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME始终躲壳内，从未被见到壳外模样。它们用强臂挪动，从一个进食地，慢慢走到下一个。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are never seen outside their shells, constantly sheltering inside them. They move around using their powerful arms, lumbering from one feeding site to the next.

entry: POKENAME钻入地下，挖出巨大隧道。有些已发现的隧道，深入地下超过0.6英里。
author: krune
source: POKENAME dig through the ground, creating huge tunnels. Some are found to reach a depth of over six-tenths of a mile underground.

entry: POKENAME看似脆弱，几丁质却坚韧如钻石。受威胁时，用爪内距刺释放毒液，制服敌人。
author: ghostslythe
source: Despite its fragile appearance, POKENAME's chitin is tough as diamonds. When threatened, it uses spurs built into its claws to deploy venom, incapacitating its foes.

entry: POKENAME成群游走山口，用爪攀崖。人类从下面经过，它们就落下，凭斧上麻痹毒素，尽可能抢走财物。
author: ghostslythe
source: Roving bands of POKENAME inhabit mountain passes, using their claws to scale rock faces. When humans pass underneath, the Pokémon drop down and use paralyzing poison on their axes to steal what they can.

entry: POKENAME壳内充满毒混合物，不断从甲片间蒸出。吸入后，会觉得自己仿佛全身着火。
author: clownatosis
source: POKENAME's shell is filled with a poisonous mixture that is constantly steaming out of between the plates. If it is inhaled, it can cause the victim to feel as though they were on fire.

entry: POKENAME宽翼让它能威风地连飞数天，不觉疲倦。长喙与背刺覆有强毒，用来压倒敌人、赶走领地入侵者。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's broad wings allow it to majestically fly for days without tiring. Its long beak and the spines along its back are coated with potent toxins, which it uses to overpower foes and drive intruders from its territory.

entry: “零一号”进行水上测试时，曾使用成群POKENAME。它们力量强大，又会像母亲般照顾游得吃力的生灵，因此受到珍视。
author: .izik
source: Groups of POKENAME were used during the ZERO-ONE's aquatic testing phases. They are valued for their strength and their mother-like care for anything struggling to swim.

entry: POKENAME的特殊牙齿，咬孩子时能收住毒液。危险来临，它便这样叼着孩子，带到安全处。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has special fangs that hold venom back when it bites onto its children. It does this to carry the children to safety whenever there is danger.

entry: POKENAME有坚韧鳞甲，游速也够快，光撞上猎物就能重创。哪怕只划出轻伤，也可能把强毒送入目标。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME are protected by tough scale armor and can swim fast enough to deal significant damage by colliding with their prey. Inflicting even the slightest scratch may deliver their potent poison to the target.

entry: POKENAME钻过矿脉，暴吃稀土元素，为进化作准备。它们严守进食地，同类争食有时甚至引发小地震。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME burrow through mineral veins, gorging themselves on rare earth elements to prepare themselves for evolution. They are jealously protective of their feeding ground, as battles between POKENAME over food can sometimes cause minor earthquakes.

entry: POKENAME伏击猎物，以巨尾束缚。制服后，便用毒牙注毒，拖回巢；尼多一族的幼崽正等它归来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hunt by ambushing prey and restraining them with their massive tail. Once the prey is subdued, they inject venom through their fangs and drag them back to their nest, where baby Nidoran wait for their return.

entry: 每年冬季，POKENAME从山中下到冻湖，捕捉最爱的蚊香蝌蚪。它用剃刀般的爪，从深处拖出美食，再刺上带毒的角。
author: ghostslythe
source: Every winter, POKENAME descends from their mountain homes to fish for Poliwag on frozen lakes. Using razor-sharp claws, they drag their favorite treats from the depths, then impale them on venom-laced horns.

entry: POKENAME合群体贴，却也吓人，总与所爱者待在一起。面对小个子虽尽量克制，训练家仍须当心那足以碎骨的亲昵。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME are social and caring yet menacing Pokémon who spend their time alongside loved ones. While they try to show restraint around anything smaller than them, Trainers are still advised to be cautious of POKENAME's bone-crushing affection.

entry: 它们身体前侧最柔软，其余部位覆着厚鳞。以尾发射身体、蜷成球，便能打出碾压般的冲撞。
author: infinex21
source: The fronts of their bodies are their softest spots, with the rest of their bodies covered in thick scales. By launching themselves with their tails and curling into balls, they deliver crushing tackles.

entry: 它有坚硬毒鳞与刀刃般的尖叶，主要用来保护盟友。幼崽离去、自己老后，叶刃变得湿软，却仍无畏平静。
author: haypile
source: It has hard, toxic scales and sharp leaves that it uses like blades, mainly to protect its allies. When it grows old after its young ones disperse, its leaf blades become damp and soft, but it remains fearless and calm.

entry: POKENAME带幼崽在电脑间迁移时，会调整鳞片，匹配屏幕像素，掩盖孩子踪迹。强力撞击，甚至能将防火墙发往其他设备。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME migrates its young to across computers, it hides them by shifting its scales to match the pixels on the screen, masking their young's presence. Its tackle is powerful enough to launch firewalls across devices.

entry: POKENAME群猎，总四只一组。它们轮流分工，先分散猎物注意，再以剃刀般的毒爪一同出击。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME is a pack hunter, always hunting prey in groups of four. It takes turns in specialized roles to distract prey before the group strikes with razor-sharp, venomous claws.

entry: 为保护幼崽或蛋，它会紧抱腹前，将满是尖刺的背朝向最近的威胁。角带强毒，以有力冲撞刺向敌人。
author: infinex21
source: To protect its young, or its eggs, it will clutch them against its belly and turn its back lined with sharp quills toward the nearest threat. Its horn carries a strong venom, which it will ram into foes with a forceful tackle.

entry: 孩子受威胁，POKENAME就会成为不屈守卫。全身鳞片防护极佳，能冲向袭击者，用拳、腿或尾猛烈击打。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: When their children are threatened, POKENAME become relentless defenders. The scales covering their bodies provide excellent protection, allowing them to rush attackers and batter them with crushing strikes from their fists, legs, or tails.

entry: POKENAME常在沼泽训练，吃当地有毒动物，获取免疫。若遭攻击，汗里会混合所有吃过的毒，一击就能致命。
author: ghostslythe
source: Found training in swamps, POKENAME ingests local poisonous fauna to gain immunity. If attacked, their sweat contains a cocktail of all ingested poisons, making a single strike lethal.

entry: POKENAME有第六感，能察觉地震或毒物泄漏将至。它迅速把幼崽背上身，踩过沿路一切，若有阻挡，便用毒牙咬去。
author: ghostslythe
source: With a sixth sense, POKENAME can tell when earthquakes or toxic spills are about to occur. If sensed, it quickly puts its young on its back, tramples anything in its path, and uses a venomous bite on anything resisting.

entry: POKENAME群落能清理大片树林，合作啃倒树，堆成复杂水坝。水坝设在领地边界，控制进出水流。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME colonies are able to clear large swathes of woodland, working together to chew down trees and pile them together into elaborate dams. These dams are put at the boundaries of their territory, controlling the water flow in and out.

entry: POKENAME角与爪周围的气息，都是雾化毒素。动作虽看似笨重，吸一口就足以放倒卡比兽。
author: ghostslythe
source: The auras around POKENAME's horns and claws are aerosolized poison. Though its movements seem ponderous, one breath is enough to drop a Snorlax.

entry: POKENAME从背上长出带刺藤蔓，释放有毒花粉，保护当地的尼多一族。作为回报，对方会送来树果与喜爱。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME protects local Nidoran by sprouting barbed vines from their back and releasing toxic pollen into the air. In return, Nidoran provide POKENAME with berries and affection.

entry: POKENAME有两张嘴，会试着把大嘴藏在身后。猎物一进范围，就转身以毒颚抓住；喉咙小，必须仔细嚼碎才咽得下。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has two mouths and tries to conceal the larger one behind its body. As soon as its prey is within reach, POKENAME will spin around to seize it in its venomous jaws, but must chew its food thoroughly to fit it down its small throat.

entry: POKENAME凭体形推倒树，在森林清出大片空地。它们巡视并用作展示场，摇动大褶边、跺地，吓退竞争者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their bulk to knock down trees and create large clearings in forests. They patrol these clearings and use them as display grounds, shaking their large frills and stomping the ground to scare off competition.

entry: POKENAME大半天都在躺着，厚皮让它几乎伤不着。可明明整日无所事事，仍觉得自己比谁都高明。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lazes around for most of the day. Its thick hide protects it from any real damage. Despite doing almost nothing all day, it thinks itself superior to everyone.

entry: POKENAME极力保护幼崽，抵御任何可能的危险。盔甲坚如钢，是孩子完美的护盾。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are highly protective of their young, defending them from any danger they may face. Their armor is as hard as steel, making them the perfect shield for their children.

entry: 谁欺负POKENAME的幼崽，就会被翅膀切伤。它靠硬鳞穿过浮冰、抵御冰水，保护身后游泳的孩子。
author: soup1900
source: Anyone who bullies POKENAME's young will be sliced by this Pokémon's wings. It uses its hard scales to swim through ice floes and take on the icy waters to protect its children swimming behind.

entry: POKENAME照顾许多其他宝可梦，会改变极性，一次照顾一组。极性不合的宝可梦靠近，就会被排斥，直到轮到自己。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have lots of other Pokémon they look after, so they change polarity to take care of one group at a time. If Pokémon of the wrong polarity approach POKENAME, they are repelled until it is their turn.

entry: POKENAME寻找尼多一族的其他融合宝可梦，将它们视作家人，尽心战斗、守护。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME seeks other Nidoran-related fusions in order to fight for and protect them diligently as family.

entry: POKENAME的两根连枷又快又狠，打击所有阻碍。平时攻击配合谨慎，但孩子遇险，就会因护育本能发狂，旋转猛砸威胁。
author: sk372
source: The twin flails of POKENAME strike hard and fast against all opposition. Though normally it carefully coordinates its attacks, if a child is in danger it goes berserk with protective instincts and enters a whirling frenzy to smash the threat.

entry: POKENAME全身石甲，能抵御争地战中的撕裂攻击。浸毒的角若断，就会藏回巢里，直到长好。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body is covered in a stone armor that shields it from tearing blows during territorial battles. If one of its venom-soaked horns breaks, it hides away in its den until it grows back.

entry: POKENAME包裹坚韧石甲，争地激战也毫不退缩。带毒的角若折断，它便退回地下，静候再生。
author: fiordaliso
source: Encased in rugged stone plating, POKENAME endures brutal clashes over territory without flinching. Should a venom-laced horn snap off, it retreats underground, waiting in silence for it to regenerate.

entry: POKENAME用幻象掩盖外表，假扮小巧不起眼的宝可梦狩猎。幻术精巧，连同类也被骗，真相揭露后便引发激战。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hunt through the use of illusions, masking their appearance and pretending to be small and unassuming Pokémon. Their illusions are elaborate enough to even fool other POKENAME, which results in fierce battles when the deception is revealed.

entry: 它对在乎的对象极为护短，会拼上性命，确保幼崽与训练家安全。
author: melodydelune
source: Extremely protective of those it cares about, this Pokémon will stake its life to ensure the safety of its young and Trainer.

entry: POKENAME强悍好斗，却有强烈母性，保护一切较小的生灵。甚至曾与袋兽打架，争论谁更能保护孩子。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is powerfully aggressive, but also has a strong maternal instinct to protect anything smaller than it. Some have even been seen getting into fights with Kangaskhan over who could better protect the child.

entry: 这只宝可梦鳞甲坚实，拳力惊人。POKENAME手脚的爪甲长得极快，能刺穿敌人，注入毒素。
author: over9001
source: This Pokémon is known for its robust scales and impactful punches. POKENAME's nails grow at a rapid rate on its hands and feet. It uses them to inject its target with poison by piercing them.

entry: POKENAME守护尚未进化的同类，似乎是受照顾群落里最聪明的。必要时，就会代替族群首领发号施令。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME act as the guards for unevolved POKENAME. They appear to be the most intelligent out of the colony they care for, and therefore give orders in place of the colony's leaders if the situation calls for it.

entry: POKENAME守护尚未进化的同类，似乎是受照顾群落里最聪明的。必要时，就会代替族群首领发号施令。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME act as the guards for unevolved POKENAME. They appear to be the most intelligent out of the colony they care for, and therefore give orders in place of the colony's leaders if the situation calls for it.

entry: POKENAME守护尚未进化的同类，似乎是受照顾群落里最聪明的。必要时，就会代替族群首领发号施令。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME act as the guards for unevolved POKENAME. They appear to be the most intelligent out of the colony they care for, and therefore give orders in place of the colony's leaders if the situation calls for it.

entry: POKENAME双腿力量惊人，一跃极远，踢击威力巨大。它会在毛上分泌有毒油脂，保持洁净，近乎发亮。
author: bobosmith01
source: A POKENAME's legs have incredible strength, allowing them to jump far in a single bound and kick with devastating power. It emits a toxic oily secretion onto its fur to keep it clean and nearly shining.

entry: 替身玩偶被毒素摧毁后，便诞生POKENAME，在玩具店作祟。深夜，它重排整条货架通道，淘气地咯咯笑，还跳出来吓唬守卫宝可梦。
author: ghostslythe
source: Created when a substitute doll is destroyed by toxins, POKENAME haunts toy stores. Late at night it will rearrange entire aisles, mischievously giggling and jumping out at guard Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME与一些谜拟丘融合体一起生活在托儿所，给孩子安慰与快乐。玩假扮游戏时，它会当领袖，用手势指挥孩子。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME live at daycares along with some Mimikyu fusions, providing comfort and joy to children. In games of make-believe, POKENAME act as leaders, giving children directions for the games via hand gestures.

entry: POKENAME头骨两侧的毒刺，能穿透最厚的皮。同类激烈争地会引发局部地震，彼此先撞得对方晕眩，再用毒刺补上最后一击。
author: ghostslythe
source: Using the toxic barbs on the sides of its skull, POKENAME can pierce through the thickest hides. Intense territorial disputes between these Pokémon cause localized earthquakes, with each slamming its opponent into a daze for a finishing barb strike.

entry: POKENAME吐出的火极热，瞬间就能把沙变成玻璃。带刺尾巴滴着致命毒液，用于狩猎。
author: amberaxolotl223
source: POKENAME breathes a fire so hot it can turn sand into glass in an instant. Its barbed tail drips a deadly venom that it uses to hunt.

entry: 它性情神秘，只与主人交流。真身藏在鳞片躯壳之内，攻击时便伸出幽暗针刺。
author: houndrys.
source: It communicates only with its owner, being very secretive. It keeps its form hidden in its scaly body, and attacks by extending shadowy needles.

entry: POKENAME躺在蛋旁，凶猛守护到孵化。大体形有助于携带产卵所需养分，但它不擅长飞。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME lies near its eggs, fiercely guarding them until they hatch. Its large size helps it carry the nutrients needed for egg-laying, but it's not a strong flyer.

entry: 满月之夜，POKENAME聚成大群，彼此配对。尾巴如黑曜石般深黑，映着夜空；有些天文学家甚至借它研究星座。
author: chibitales
source: On nights when the moon is full, POKENAME gather in a single large group to pair with one another. Their tails are such a deep obsidian that they mirror the night sky. Some astronomers even use POKENAME to study constellations.

entry: POKENAME的强毒能放倒大肯泰罗，却只能喷出小火。它们极力护着尾火，不许其他宝可梦靠近。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a strong venom that can take down a large Tauros but struggle to produce more than a small fire. They are protective of the fire on their tail and refuse to let other Pokémon near it.

entry: 每个尼多丁群落里，只有一只雌性POKENAME，担当首领。它能膨胀到平时的许多倍，呼气时，各处孔口都会排出毒气。
author: bobosmith01
source: There is only one female POKENAME in each colony of Nidopuff, where it acts as their leader. They can inflate their bodies to many times their normal size. When they exhale, poison gas is emitted from their orifices.

entry: POKENAME的耳朵各方面都强大。猛然向前伸展，力量足以推倒卡车；听觉也完美得甚至堪比难寻的皮皮。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's ears are powerful in all senses of the word. When they suddenly stretch forward, they exert enough force to topple a truck. POKENAME's sense of hearing is also impeccable and even rivals the elusive Clefairy.

entry: POKENAME用结实的头撞敌人。飞行中加速，再以凶猛力量俯冲轰击。
author: pastapockets
source: POKENAME attacks by slamming its resilient head into foes. It builds up speed as it flies and dive bombs with wicked force.

entry: POKENAME虽小，毒性却强得惊人。壳厚而结实，冲撞能轻易连根掀树。
author: opossiblymage
source: Despite its small size, POKENAME's poison is surprisingly potent. Its shell is thick and durable, and its tackles can easily uproot a tree.

entry: POKENAME好斗，会攻击任何对象，向自己证明实力。败后常回来找同一对手再战，直到找到取胜方法。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is aggressive and will attack anything to prove its strength to itself. When defeated, it often returns to fight the same opponent until it finds a way to be victorious.

entry: POKENAME会凶猛攻击任何自认威胁幼崽的对象。离巢狩猎前，它以鬃毛摩擦孩子，留下能赶走捕食者的微毒。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME viciously attacks any perceived threat to its offspring. When it leaves its nest to hunt, it rubs its young with its mane which has a low-level toxin that wards off predators.

entry: POKENAME内心温柔，却有可怕的护育本能。谁胆敢威胁它保护的小宝可梦，几乎必定会被咆哮吓退。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is gentle at heart, but possesses a fearsome parental instinct. Its roar is all but guaranteed to scare off anything that dares threaten the smaller Pokémon under its protection.

entry: POKENAME皮厚耐寒，在高海拔环境生活得很好。人们发现，皮是制作徒步装备的优良材料。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME thrive in high altitude environments, as its hide is both tough and cold resistant. Their hide has been discovered to be a great material in the making of hiking equipment.

entry: POKENAME硬鳞间的叶状苔藓，用于许多药物。磨碎后能治疗烧伤与擦伤，缓解不适，促进愈合。
author: .izik
source: The leaf-like moss growing from between POKENAME's hard scales is used in many remedies. When ground up, it can be used to treat burns and abrasions, providing relief and healing properties.

entry: POKENAME先用耳部声波震住猎物，再以毒菱包围。这样能困住、削弱目标，再靠近发动最后一击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses sound waves from its ears to stun prey before surrounding them in Toxic Spikes. This strategy allows it to immobilize and weaken its prey before moving in for the final strike.

entry: POKENAME飞行途中，会用剧毒制住其他会飞的宝可梦，带回巢供同类享用，是危险的空中猎手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses Toxic to stun other flying Pokémon while it travels. It then takes them back to its den for others of its kind to feast on, making it a dangerous hunter of the skies.

entry: POKENAME全身尖鳞覆有毒黏液，碰到就会中毒。它还能吐出同样的黏液团，攻击远处敌人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is covered with sharp scales, coated with toxic slime that can poison anyone who touches them. POKENAME can spit out blobs of the same slime to attack more distant foes.

entry: POKENAME极力保护幼崽，对任何威胁毫不留情。躁动时，皮肤分泌致命毒素，战斗中更加危险难测。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is very protective of its young and will show no mercy to anything that threatens them. When agitated, its skin secretes a deadly poison that makes it volatile in combat.

entry: POKENAME身上硬鳞符合空气动力，让它轻松飞踢。增强的灵活性，带来明显的空战优势。
author: .izik
source: The hard scales on POKENAME's body make it aerodynamic, allowing it to perform flying kicks with ease. This enhanced agility gives it a significant advantage in aerial combat.

entry: POKENAME偏爱极寒气候，体内产生稀薄透明的毒液，从刺间漏出。既能防卫，也能助猎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers living in extremely cold climates, where its body produces a thin, clear poisonous liquid that leaks from its spikes. This toxic substance acts as both a defense and as a hunting aid.

entry: POKENAME产生的粉色孢子剧毒无比。吸入者都说，会强烈恶心并失忆。
author: .izik
source: The pink spores POKENAME produces are extremely poisonous. Those who inhale them report intense nausea and amnesia.

entry: POKENAME全身厚重针状鳞片，受威胁就会竖起，也很容易脱落。
author: puppylev
source: A POKENAME's body is covered in thick, needle-like scales. These scales bristle up when threatened and are prone to falling out.

entry: POKENAME仔细聆听接近的宝可梦，提防争食对手。打架时，它们剧烈抖动身体，放出毒粉云。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME listen intently for approaching Pokémon, staying on guard against rivals for their food. They violently shake their bodies and loose a cloud of poisonous dust when they get into fights.

entry: POKENAME以放射性的月之石为媒介，编织毒咒，再用超能力确保命中。为免伤害训练家，它会将辐射封在精神力场内。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME weaves toxic spells using a radioactive Moon Stone focus, ensuring they hit with its psychic powers. To avoid harming its Trainer, it encloses the radiation in a psychic field.

entry: POKENAME触角能察觉最轻的气流，远在看见之前，就知有宝可梦靠近。打架时，它们剧烈抖动身体，放出毒粉云。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME antennae can sense even the slightest air movements, alerting them to approaching Pokémon long before they see them. They violently shake their bodies and loose a cloud of poisonous dust when they get into fights.

entry: POKENAME通常在夜间出没，以月光辨路。两只擦肩而过，就会愤怒地扑飞，用翼风试着将对方赶离航路。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are typically found at night, using the light of the moon to navigate. When two POKENAME pass by one another, they will angrily flutter around and try to knock the other off their flight path with gusts from their wings.

entry: POKENAME躯干内的光脉动时，毒性达到顶峰。睡时被叫醒，可能使它惊恐发作，致幻毒素还会加剧症状。
author: .izik
source: When the light in POKENAME's torso pulses, its venom is at peak potency. Waking it during its sleep may trigger in it a panic attack worsened by hallucinogenic toxins.

entry: POKENAME用角在崖壁钻洞睡觉。察觉山崩将至，就会用变圆稳住身体，避免重伤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME burrows into cliffsides with its horn to sleep. If it detects a coming rockslide, it braces with Defense Curl to avoid serious harm.

entry: POKENAME飞行后，会把角嵌入崖壁休息。一嵌入石中，强风也吹不走。
author: .izik
source: After flying, POKENAME embeds its horn into cliff walls to rest. Once lodged in the stone, even strong wind gusts cannot dislodge it.

entry: POKENAME用角向树根注入微毒，令其软化。它把根撕碎，挖到最深100英尺后才进食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME injects mild toxin into tree roots with its horn to soften them. It rips the roots into pieces and digs as deep as 100 ft before feeding.

entry: POKENAME住在湍急河流冲蚀出的洞穴，力量足以逆急流游泳。受威胁时，就用带毒爪刺入敌人，凶猛啄击。
author: ghostslythe
source: Living in eroded caves made by raging rivers, POKENAME are strong enough to swim up rapids. If threatened, they dig their venom-laced claws into the foe and peck viciously.

entry: POKENAME在毛间分泌强毒，碰到的宝可梦都会中毒。打架前，它会吃下些自己的毒，借此陷入狂乱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME secrete a potent venom in their fur that poisons any Pokémon that touches them. They will consume some of their own venom before getting into fights, letting it drive them into a frenzy.

entry: POKENAME在毛间分泌强毒，碰到的宝可梦都会中毒。打架前，它会吃下些自己的毒，借此陷入狂乱。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME secrete a potent venom in their fur that poisons any Pokémon that touches them. They will consume some of their own venom before getting into fights, letting it drive them into a frenzy.

entry: POKENAME活泼又有主见，不肯听不赞同的命令。它爱玩，会调皮地朝训练家吠叫，引人追赶，再一闪火光跑开。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is spunky and opinionated, refusing to follow orders that it disagrees with. It loves to play, sassily barking at its Trainer so they will give chase and it can run away in a flash of fire.

entry: POKENAME愿舍命守护照顾的畜群。年老后，虽更像宠物而非工作伙伴，训练家仍应偶尔让它巡视田野，免伤自尊。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is willing to lay down its life to guard the flocks in its care. As it grows older and becomes more of a pet than a worker, its Trainer should still let it patrol the fields occasionally so its pride is not hurt.

entry: 卡洛斯古画中，POKENAME冲过骑士军队。现代遇见时，大多以为会喷火，结果却被毒性吐息吓一跳。
author: ghostslythe
source: Ancient drawings in Kalos depict POKENAME barreling through armies of knights. When faced in the modern age, most assume it will use flaming attacks, only to be shocked with poisonous breath.

entry: POKENAME模仿摔跤手，喜欢将敌人扑倒地。可惜，这可能把对方撞昏。
author: notsaying.
source: POKENAME takes after wrestlers, and enjoys tackling foes to the floor. This, unfortunately, can knock them unconscious.

entry: 它们的语言词汇繁复，一本词典也装不下。它们用来教育孩子如何在世上生存，叫声与哼声中的细微差别，至今仍是语言学家的课题。
author: quackquackattack
source: A single dictionary is unable to encompass the lexical complexity of their language, which is used to educate their children on how to survive in the world. The nuances of their cries and grunts remain a topic of study for linguists.

entry: POKENAME随时准备迎战。挥出的拳头，对小型生物甚至可能致命。
author: supersonicloki
source: POKENAME is ready for anything. Its punch has been known to be fatal to smaller creatures.

entry: 只有肌肉拉伤时，人们才见过它畏缩。它总在寻找其他豪力融合宝可梦，发起挑战。
author: supersonicloki
source: This Pokémon is only known to flinch when it pulls a muscle. It seeks out and challenges other Machoke fusions.

entry: POKENAME走到哪间健身房，都满嘴“积极向上”，逼得人喘不过气。可想突破自我极限的强大训练家，偏偏就爱找它一起练。
author: supersonicloki
source: A toxic positivity personality at any gym; strong Trainers seek POKENAME out when they want to push their limits as a Trainer and as a human.

entry: 野外同类交锋时，POKENAME疯狂挥叶，想不动真格就吓得对方臣服。若被迫实战，它们便会咬敌人的茎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flail their leaves wildly around when battling against other POKENAME in the wild, trying to intimidate their rivals into submission without having to actually fight. If forced to battle properly, they will try to bite at their foe's stem.

entry: POKENAME虽能飞，却似乎尽量在地面巡视领地。巢穴受威胁时，就会用毒尾与大字爆炎，紧追入侵者不放。
author: chibitales
source: Despite being able to fly, POKENAME seem to prefer to roam their territories on land when possible. Should POKENAME's nest be threatened, they relentlessly chase down the intruder using Poison Tail and Fire Blast attacks.

entry: POKENAME虽能飞，却似乎尽量在地面巡视领地。粉鳞在野外几乎无法伪装，因此凡被认为有威胁的对象，都会遭含毒利爪猛烈攻击。
author: chibitales
source: Despite being able to fly, POKENAME seem to prefer to roam their territories on land when possible. Their pink scales offer little camouflage in the wild, which causes them to thrash at anything they deem as a threat with venom-filled claws.

entry: POKENAME在树间摇摆行走，寻找安度一天的地方。理想的树既能充分接触天光，土又肥沃，方便扎根；为争这些位置，它们会互相战斗。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME waddle from tree to tree in search of a place to spend their day. The ideal tree has excellent access to light from the sky as well as fertile soil for them to root through; they will battle with one another over these locations.

entry: POKENAME倒挂低枝，让带刺藤蔓垂向地面。若有什么撞上，它们就会挥击，试图用毒刺抓住倒霉的路人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hang from the lower branches of trees, trailing their thorned vine down toward the ground. Should anything walk into the trailing vine, they lash out, aiming to catch the unfortunate passerby with their venomous stinger.

entry: POKENAME有保护其他小拳石与尼多一族的强烈本能。战斗时，它以双臂把自己抛上空中，用硬鳞使出凶狠撞击。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME possesses a strong instinct to protect other Geodude and Nidoran species. In battle it will use its arms to heave itself into the air to perform a vicious Tackle attack with its hardened scales.

entry: 尼多后的韧鳞与隆隆岩巨石般的身体结合，使POKENAME能轻松承受大多数攻击。偶尔蜕皮会暂时脆弱，但长好总比从前更强。
author: darkweavile428
source: The combination of Nidoqueen's tough scales and Golem's boulder-like body allow POKENAME to shrug off most attacks. It does occasionally have to shed its skin, which leaves it vulnerable, but it always grows back stronger than ever.

entry: POKENAME轻飘的鬃毛流出毒气，使想攻击的宝可梦恶心。为保护后代，它不惜生命。
author: periperi_chicken
source: Toxic gases flow from POKENAME's wispy mane, making any Pokémon that tries to attack it feel nauseous. It will risk its life to protect its offspring.

entry: POKENAME以惊人体形战斗，互撞硬壳，身体重击足以碎树干。它们容易生气，见到同类就愿开战。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fight using their impressive bulk, slamming their tough shells into one another with body slams that can shatter tree trunks. They are prone to aggression and will readily battle other POKENAME on sight.

entry: POKENAME用覆毒长舌，制服靠亲族太近的对象。这种毒攻，让它能以致命力量守护家人与领地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tongue is coated in poison, which it uses to subdue anyone who gets too close to its kin. This toxic attack allows it to protect its family and territory with lethal force.

entry: POKENAME是领地意识极强的猎手，谁靠巢太近，就会遭强钳猛扑。实验室已合成它的毒，制成能缓解晕船症状的药。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a highly territorial predator that lunges with its powerful pincers at anyone who strays too close to its den. Its venom has been synthesized in laboratories to create a medicine that eases the symptoms of seasickness.

entry: POKENAME在严重污染源附近的森林安家。出现得越多，就越明确预示生态破坏将至。
author: veteranadventurer
source: POKENAME makes its home in forests that are near sources of high pollution. An increasing presence is a sure sign of coming ecological damage.

entry: POKENAME在森林树顶结成巨大群落。灾难将至，成千上万只会齐声尖叫，一次持续数小时，试图警告附近生灵。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME live in massive swarms among the forest treetops. When disaster is about to strike, thousands of POKENAME will all squeak in unison for hours at a time, attempting to warn those nearby.

entry: POKENAME虽喜欢独处，察觉龙卷风将至时，仍会走进附近村庄，尖声警告行进路径上的人。
author: .izik
source: Despite its solitary nature, POKENAME ventures into nearby villages when it senses an approaching tornado. It releases a shrill cry to warn those in its path.

entry: 它能察觉对手弱点，打出短促果断的拳击。虽然爱战，察觉敌人将受重伤就会停手，因此以放弃稳赢比赛而闻名。
author: _blissey
source: It senses its opponents' weaknesses, allowing it to deliver short, decisive punches. It loves fighting, but stops when it senses its foe is on the verge of grievous injury, making it infamous for forfeiting winning matches.

entry: POKENAME能察觉灾难，却无法采取行动警告人们。这使它焦躁不安，不停来回摇晃。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: While POKENAME can detect disasters, it cannot do anything to warn people. This leaves it restless, shaking back and forth non-stop.

entry: POKENAME现身，吐出烟雾，化成灾难将至的影像。许多人误将烟当诅咒，而非警告，使它名声不佳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears before others and blows smog that takes the form of images of imminent disasters. Many misinterpret the smoke as a curse rather than a warning, giving POKENAME a poor reputation.

entry: 一察觉灾难，它就急忙四处分发自己的蛋，想帮上忙。POKENAME明明仁慈，许多人却仍以为灾祸是它引起的。
author: fountainihili
source: If it senses a disaster, it will begin frantically giving out its eggs to help. Despite its kindness, many still believe POKENAME caused the disaster.

entry: 灾难来临前一刻，POKENAME会出现在附近水域，彼此绕圈。有人认为是警告，有人却觉得动机更恶毒。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Moments before a disaster, POKENAME appear in nearby bodies of water, circling each other. Some people believe that this action is a warning, while others believe POKENAME do this for more malicious reasons.

entry: POKENAME每次被冲上岸，都会被视为凶兆，但有人相信送回海中，就能化解厄运。据说，直视宝石会陷入恍惚，喃喃说起星星与遥远行星。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Whenever an POKENAME washes up, it is seen as an ill omen, though some believe returning it to the sea appeases the fates. Those that look directly into the gem are said to go into a trance-like state, murmuring about stars and distant planets.

entry: POKENAME察觉灾难将至，就会用模仿动作警告。但往往难以解读，究竟是否故意，仍不得而知。
author: thordemidgard
source: When POKENAME senses an approaching disaster it will start warning about it through mimicry. It is often somewhat difficult to decipher, however, though wether or not that's intentional is unknown.

entry: 这种宝可梦能察觉水流变化，知道天灾将至。但POKENAME没有能帮助自己说服其他对象撤离险地的本领。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: This Pokémon can detect changes in the water currents that indicate the coming of natural disasters. However, POKENAME possesses no abilities that aid it in persuading others to evacuate an area due to danger.

entry: POKENAME鼻子敏锐，能嗅出大气变化，探知灾难。它会尖叫示警，体形却太小，常被忽略。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: With it's sensitive nose, POKENAME can smell changes in the atmosphere to detect disasters. POKENAME squeaks to warn others, but its tiny size often leads to it be ignored.

entry: POKENAME感知环境变化，预知天灾。它们会到预计受灾地附近的聚落，以变身能力，试图向居民传达危险。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are able to predict natural disasters by sensing changes in their environment. They appear in settlements near where the disaster is predicted to occur, using their transformative abilities to try and convey the danger to residents.

entry: POKENAME天性独居，建立信任需要不少时间。它相当严肃，讨厌受惊。
author: kittyluv090
source: Building trust with an POKENAME takes quite a bit of time, as it is naturally a very solitary Pokémon. It is quite serious and hates being startled.

entry: 风暴中，POKENAME闪电状的角会吸收电能，存入额上宝石。其他电属性宝可梦有时会聚来，借储能补电。
author: ambrosia04
source: During storms, POKENAME's lightning-shaped horn absorbs electrical energy, storing it in the gem on its forehead. Other Electric-type Pokémon sometimes gather nearby to recharge from its stored power.

entry: 危险天气多发的季节，POKENAME在天气网站假扮弹窗广告，希望被误点。启动后，它把这次互动转成能量，吸收取食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME disguises itself as pop-up ads on weather websites during seasons with dangerous weather, hoping to be accidentally clicked. Once activated, it converts the interaction into energy to consume.

entry: POKENAME看似电脑里某个图像资源的报错信息。一点击，就会出现不祥警告，宣称系统已感染，必须付款给它，否则无法继续使用电脑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME resemble an error message about a sprite that is installed on the PC. Once a person clicks on the error message, an ominous warning appears to warn the user that their system is infected and has to pay POKENAME or lose access to the PC.

entry: POKENAME食欲旺盛，守卫领地时十分凶暴。它们格外爱植物，因此农夫把见到它视为凶兆。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are known for their ravenous appetites and aggressive natures in regard to defending their territories. Because these Pokémon are especially fond of vegetation, farmers consider the sight of POKENAME to be an ill omen.

entry: POKENAME对大气变化敏感，能察觉灾难。但很少有精力费心警告其他对象。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME can detect disasters, being sensitive to changes in the atmosphere. However, it rarely has the energy to bother to warn anyone.

entry: 融合后，POKENAME失去控制力量的能力，所过之处都会跟着末日般的冰雹。哪怕只目击一次，附近居民也常陷入恐慌。
author: alestrius
source: After fusing, POKENAME loses the ability to control its powers, leading to apocalyptic hailstorms that follow in its wake. Even a single sighting of POKENAME often leads to panic in nearby communities.

entry: 据说，POKENAME以可怕雷暴带来大灾。战斗时，先让闪电包围身体，再凶猛冲锋。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is said to bring about great disasters in the form of terrible thunderstorms. When battling, it surrounds itself with lightning before fiercely charging in.

entry: 有关POKENAME航路与栖息的数据，除了证明行为难测，没得出明确结论。有人怀疑，它能通过头冠接收超自然信号。
author: bobosmith01
source: Data gathered regarding POKENAME's flight path and roosting has resulted in no clear conclusions aside from the fact that POKENAME is unpredictable in behavior. Some suspect it is able to receive supernatural signals through the crest on its head.

entry: POKENAME成长时，会脱落珍贵有光泽的白毛。盗猎者不愿等自然换毛，令当地种群濒临灭绝，尽管镰角能感知恶意，帮助它们逃往深水。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME shed lustrous, valuable white fur as they grow. Because poachers refuse to wait for natural molting, local populations face extinction, though their scythe-like horns allow them to sense malice and flee into deep water.

entry: 某些传说称，POKENAME体内蕴藏巨力，还说力量会化作灾难显现。它们极难寻觅，似乎格外能感知其他生灵的情绪。
author: infinex21
source: Some legends claim that POKENAME harbor immense power within them, with further claims that said power will manifest in disasters. They are incredibly elusive and seem to be remarkably attuned to the emotions of others.

entry: 多年前，一名渔夫说曾见POKENAME从高草飞窜上天。几秒后，闪电击中草丛，燃起火。它或许能看见遥远的未来。
author: bobosmith01
source: Many years ago, a fisherman claimed to see POKENAME darting out of tall grass and into the sky. A few seconds later, a lightning bolt soon claimed the tall grass and set it ablaze. It's possible that POKENAME can see far into the future.

entry: POKENAME叶片撒出的花粉香似罗勒，能加速植物生长。若察觉洪水将至，就会促进树木迅速长大，吸收多余水分。
author: .izik
source: The pollen POKENAME spreads from its leaf smells like basil and accelerates plant growth. If it senses an approaching flood, it encourages trees to grow rapidly to absorb the excess water.

entry: POKENAME头上的敏感叶片，会引它前往天灾必临之处。风暴前的灰暗天空，恰好适合晒太阳；光不合适，它们不是饥饿，就是生病。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: The sensitive leaf on their head guides them to places where natural disasters are bound to happen. The grey skies before a storm provide just the right level of light for POKENAME to sunbathe in; otherwise they either starve or fall ill.

entry: POKENAME会被将离世者吸引，例如老人或病入膏肓的人。它以宜人香气安抚，让对方平静走完最后一程。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME is drawn to those nearing their death, such as the elderly and terminally ill. It will use its pleasant fragrance to soothe them, giving them a peaceful end.

entry: POKENAME的毛极其珍贵，但据说谁从它身上剪下，就会遭百年厄运。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME's fur is extremely valuable, but it is said that anyone who cuts it off of an POKENAME will suffer one hundred years of bad luck.

entry: POKENAME如今有了强劲双翼带来的速度，便会远行各地，警告人们即将到来的危险。
author: sejha
source: POKENAME, now blessed with the speed afforded to it by its powerful wings, travels great distances to warn people of coming danger.

entry: POKENAME会在上方以火花描出影像，试图警告灾难将至。但力量弱，图像模糊或遭误解，警告常不被理会。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME creates images made of sparks above it in an attempt to warn others of impending disasters. Because its powers are weak, however, the images are vague or misinterpreted, and its warnings often go unheeded.

entry: POKENAME生来就有感知危险将至的锐角。小身体却易被察觉的灾难伤及，因此会迅速缩回硬壳避险。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME possess sharp horns capable of sensing imminent danger from birth. Because their tiny bodies leave them vulnerable to the disasters they detect, they quickly retreat inside their hardened shells for safety.

entry: 古代，人们在屋顶放POKENAME石像，相信能带来好运，保护家园免遭灾难。
author: ambrosia04
source: In ancient times, people placed stone statues of POKENAME on rooftops, believing they would bring good fortune and protect their homes from disasters.

entry: 有些古代文明似乎向POKENAME献供，换取传说能带来好运的舞蹈。若拒收供品，就被视为灾难将临。
author: sk372
source: Some ancient civilizations appear to have made offerings to POKENAME in exchange for its dances, said to bring good fortune. If it refused an offering, it was considered a sign of looming disaster.

entry: 灾难逼近，POKENAME尾上的球体会格外温热。水攻也随之升温，热到足以烫伤皮肤。
author: .izik
source: When a disaster nears, the orb on POKENAME's tail grows intensely warm. Its water attacks heat up as well, becoming hot enough to burn skin.

entry: POKENAME漂过汹涌海洋。海啸过后，能见到它沿岸起舞，再返回海中。
author: riley_muir_qu33n_in_yellow
source: POKENAME floats along turbulent seas. In the aftermath of tsunamis, this Pokémon can be seen dancing along the coast before returning to the ocean.

entry: POKENAME假扮树，等本能确认灾难将至。一察觉危险，就会猛烈摇晃，警告附近宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a tree while waiting for its instincts to confirm an upcoming disaster. If it senses danger, it shakes violently to warn nearby Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME能察觉盗窃正在发生。它常赶走罪犯，却把被偷的东西据为己有。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME are able to sense when thefts are taking place. It often will fight off the criminal, only to take the item being stolen for itself.

entry: POKENAME衰老缓慢，很少出现在人类居住地。释放日光束前，花瓣会明亮发光，涌出灾难般的能量。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME age slowly and are rarely found in areas inhabited by humans. Before performing a Solar Beam, POKENAME's petals glow brightly as they unleash a cataclysmic burst of energy.

entry: POKENAME温顺，容易与人共处，却仍有阿勃梭鲁的本能。火箭发射场会饲养它，探知天灾或极端天气是否干扰发射。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are docile enough to be easily kept around humans but still have the instincts of an Absol. They are kept at rocket launch sites to detect if a natural disaster or extreme weather will interfere with a launch.

entry: POKENAME懒洋洋地漂在河里，周围世界再乱也不受影响。但若察觉洪水将至，就会低沉吼叫，提醒附近宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats lazily in rivers, unaffected by the chaotic world around it. However, if it detects an approaching flood, it will let out a deep bellow to alert nearby Pokémon.

entry: 分叉尾巴颤动时，POKENAME就能预见灾难。不过只会告诉自己认可的训练家。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME has the power to predict disasters when its forked tail quivers. However, it will only share its knowledge with a Trainer it deems worthy.

entry: POKENAME智力极高，比未融合的阿勃梭鲁更擅长预知灾难。传闻，它们还知道世上发生过的每一场灾。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: With their vast intelligence, POKENAME are even better at predicting disasters then unfused Absol. It is rumoured they also know every disaster that has ever occurred.

entry: 大群POKENAME突然装死，当地人就知道天灾将至。后代数量极多，街道甚至会被它们僵住的身躯铺满。
author: periperi_chicken
source: When hordes of POKENAME suddenly play dead, locals know a natural disaster is near. POKENAME produce so many offspring that city streets can become covered in their frozen bodies.

entry: POKENAME的花开始在严重污染中绽放。它能减缓环境中毒，却无法独力阻止。
author: veteranadventurer
source: POKENAME's flower has begun to bloom in the presence of high pollution. It can slow the poisoning of the environment, but can't stop it alone.

entry: 灾难将至，POKENAME会指挥未知图腾与其融合体，拼出警告信息。若形态太少，拼不成正确词语，它就会惊慌。
author: hophoppip
source: When a disaster is impending, POKENAME will command a group of Unown and Unown fusions to spell out a warning message. It becomes panicked when there are too few Unown forms to create the right words.

entry: POKENAME察觉飓风逼近，会通过后方那颗头传导精神能量，温和劝人类与宝可梦离开。若不听，就用强力精神波逼退。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME senses an incoming hurricane, it channels psychic energy through its rear head to gently urge Pokémon and people away. If they do not listen, it forces them back with powerful psychic waves.

entry: POKENAME住在冰冻苔原地下深处，寒冷干燥，十分舒服。它们曾被猎到几乎灭绝，野外极少见。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME reside deep below the icy tundra, where it is comfortably cold and dry. They are a rare sight in the wild, as they were once hunted to near extinction.

entry: POKENAME受许多人畏惧，只在危险将临时现身，以强大身影传达无声警告。厚毛能抵御严冬。
author: curazy
source: Feared by many, POKENAME only appears when danger is near, its presence a silent warning cloaked in strength. Its thick fur protects it from harsh winter seasons.

entry: 猛烈风暴前，POKENAME毛中的蜜香会变得极浓。香气引小宝可梦进巢，为它们提供安全庇护。
author: .izik
source: The honey-like scent from POKENAME's fur becomes incredibly strong before a violent storm. The aroma lures smaller Pokémon into its den, providing them shelter and safety.

entry: POKENAME往返火山与山坡，留意喷发或山崩。它们壳里存熔岩，用角劈巨石，努力保护人们免遭预见的灾难。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME travel between volcanoes and mountainsides, watching for impending eruptions or rockslides. They store lava within their shells and cleave through boulders with their horns, working to protect people from the foreseen disasters.

entry: POKENAME的敏感枝条能察觉海温与酸度变化。大群浮上海面，就预示严重的气候变化。
author: hophoppip
source: Its sensitive branches detect changes in ocean temperature and acidity. When large groups of POKENAME surface, it's a sign of severe climate change.

entry: POKENAME总提醒遇到的聚落，冬至若沉闷无趣会有危险。居民倒常欢欢喜喜地把它赶走。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: POKENAME will always warn any community it finds of the dangers of a dull winter solstice. Such communities often make merry in chasing POKENAME away.

entry: POKENAME凭独特羽毛感知风暴，再用巨喙尖声警告宝可梦与人类。直到今天，看见它飞行，仍被认为是可怕厄运的征兆。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lets out piercing shrieks from its enormous beak to warn Pokémon and humans of approaching windstorms, which it senses through its unique feathers. To this day, spotting one in flight is thought to be an omen of terrible misfortune.

entry: POKENAME野外稀少，却常见于丰缘预示灾难的民间传说。传说，最坏的凶兆，是看见它吃自己的尾巴，直到消失。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is rare in the wild but features heavily in Hoenn folklore that foretells impending disasters. Legend states that the worst omen is to witness one eat its own tail until it disappears.

entry: 严冬，POKENAME在雪山滚动，厚毛能保暖。察觉猛烈暴风雪逼近，就会用象鼻高声警告。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's thick fur keeps it warm as it rolls through snowy mountains during brutal winters. If it detects a severe blizzard approaching, it trumpets a warning from its trunk.

entry: 电脑被入侵很久之前，POKENAME就会出现，兜售防病毒软件。警告常被忽略，最终电脑真的被病毒占据。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME show up long before a PC is compromised to sell antivirus software to help ward against viruses. Their warnings are often ignored and eventually result in the PC being taken over by a virus.

entry: 电脑被入侵很久之前，POKENAME就会出现，兜售防病毒软件。警告常被忽略，最终电脑真的被病毒占据。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME show up long before a PC is compromised to sell antivirus software to help ward against viruses. Their warnings are often ignored and eventually result in the PC being taken over by a virus.

entry: 灾难将至，POKENAME会在受影响地区写警告。若不被理会，就改画满是死亡、痛苦与毁灭的恐怖图画。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: When a disaster is upcoming, POKENAME will write warnings in the affected area. If its warnings are ignored, it resorts to making gruesome paintings featuring death, pain, and ruin.

entry: 这种宝可梦靠速度与机巧，而非蛮力压倒敌人。感知极敏锐，一眼就能识破弱点与破绽。
author: xillo
source: This species overwhelms its foes with speed and cunning rather than brute strength. Highly perceptive, it can identify weak points and openings at a mere glance.

entry: POKENAME野外稀少，却常见于丰缘预示灾难的民间传说。传说，最坏的凶兆，是看见它吃自己的尾巴，直到消失。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is rare in the wild but features heavily in Hoenn folklore that foretells impending disasters. Legend states that the worst omen is to witness one eat its own tail until it disappears.

entry: 天气恶劣时，POKENAME会迅速探出长舌，察觉预示强风暴的气味变化。若知灾难将至，就尖声警告。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's long tongue darts out during poor weather to detect scent changes that indicate severe storms. If it senses an impending disaster, it lets out a piercing screech as a warning.

entry: POKENAME以翼上纹样的细微变化，警告天灾将至。它本性仁善，外表却可怕，因此常在虚构故事中伴着反派出现。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME signals warnings of imminent natural disasters with subtle changes in the patterns on its wings. Its fearsome appearance has made it a common Pokémon to appear alongside villains in fiction stories, despite its benevolent nature.

entry: 猛烈暴风雪里，POKENAME提供奶与温暖。它能用滚动撞开厚雪，脱身而出。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME provides milk and warmth during harsh blizzards. It can smash its way out of thick snow using Rollout.

entry: POKENAME只在雾山顶现身，见过的人不多。神话把它视为传说守护灵，一位作者由此写出受欢迎的小说，讲述勇敢女孩与它结伴拯救世界。
author: mepp.
source: As POKENAME is only found on foggy mountaintops, not many people have seen it. Inspired by myths describing it as a legendary guardian spirit, an author wrote a popular novel where a brave girl saves the world with her POKENAME companion.

entry: 坏天气将至，POKENAME的毛会积起格外强的静电。此时，它见谁都蹭，试图警告对方。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: When bad weather is near, POKENAME's fur grows extra staticky. When this occurs, it will rub itself on anyone it sees in an attempt to warn them.

entry: POKENAME游走世界，以角感知灾厄的流向。它总先任悲剧发生，再回到过去，看看究竟如何能避免。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME wanders around the world, sensing the flow of calamity with its horn. It always lets tragedies happen, just to travel back in time and see how exactly they can be avoided.

entry: 有人说，若被POKENAME诅咒，无论多努力躲避，也注定迎来末路。刚遭天灾的城市，常能见它游荡。
author: mistymagius
source: Some say that if you are cursed by an POKENAME, you are destined to meet your end no matter how hard you try to avoid it. They can be seen wandering around cities recently hit by natural disasters.

entry: POKENAME预见灾难时会鸣叫。研究者发现，不同灾难的叫声也不同，借此更快解读警告。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses the ability to foresee disasters, crying when it receives the precognitive visions. Researchers have found it cries differently depending on the kind of disaster, and use this to more quickly decipher its warnings.

entry: POKENAME能感知天灾，会追着雷暴，与同类竞速。若察觉附近另一种灾难，就用储存电力发小信号，作为警告。
author: npshi
source: Using their ability to sense incoming natural disasters, POKENAME will follow thunderstorms to race against other POKENAME. If they detect a different disaster nearby, POKENAME use stored electricity to send small signals as a warning.

entry: 据说，它的大眼能看见眼前地区可能发生的天灾。每颗头能独立思考，也能合而为一，达到堪比巨金怪的程度。
author: infinex21
source: Supposedly, its large eye allows it to witness natural disasters that may befall a locale it witnesses. Each head is capable of thinking individually, but they may also think as one on a level comparable to a Metagross.

entry: 人们相信，POKENAME是人临终前看见的最后身影。
author: kiwikelly
source: It is believed that an POKENAME is the last thing someone will see before passing away.

entry: 过去，许多人以为POKENAME俯冲，是想用镰状尾巴夺走生命。如今才知，它其实在保护人，把对方推离察觉的危险。
author: sk372
source: In the past, many thought a swooping POKENAME intended to steal their life away with its scythe-shaped tail. It is now known it is actually diving to protect them, pushing them away from perceived danger.

entry: POKENAME格外喜欢接入模拟游戏，吸收被毁、被弃模拟中的数据。它们凝视汇聚的数据球，借其中信息预测天灾影响。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME are particularly drawn to interfacing with simulation games and absorbing the data from destroyed and discarded simulations. The orb of gathered data they ponder provides information that they use to predict the effects of natural disasters.

entry: POKENAME察觉龙卷风将至，就会高声尖叫，胡乱扬沙。这混乱的表现，是在警告附近生灵寻找庇护。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME senses an upcoming tornado, it screeches loudly while flinging sand erratically. This chaotic display serves as a warning to those nearby to seek shelter.

entry: POKENAME人称“凶兆之拳”，预知对手尚未使出的招数，借此取胜。若明知赢不了，便不顾一切，也要与敌人同归于尽。
author: mileysakiko
source: Known as "The Fist of Ill Omen", an POKENAME wins fights by knowing its opponent's moves before they ever make them. If it knows it cannot win, it will recklessly attempt to take its foe down with it.

entry: POKENAME最出名的形象，来自一部受欢迎的历史剧情片，被塑造成暴君。因此，虽生性害羞隐居，名声却很坏。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME are most well known for their depiction in a popular historical drama movie where an POKENAME is placed in the role of a tyrannical ruler. This has lead them to earn a poor reputation despite their shy and reclusive nature.

entry: POKENAME总领先一步，预测最坏局面。它吸收周围情绪，维持光明与黑暗的平衡。
author: wolfythehunter
source: Always one step ahead, POKENAME predicts worst-case scenarios, absorbing the emotions of those around it to maintain the balance between light and darkness.

entry: 据说，照料得当的POKENAME能改变未来，让训练家过上幸福富足的生活。
author: kiwikelly
source: It is said that an POKENAME that's well taken care of can alter the future to one where its Trainer lives a happy and prosperous life.

entry: POKENAME优雅迷人，能精准预知变化的时刻。平和天性，使预言受欢迎，而非令人恐惧。
author: wolfythehunter
source: With captivating grace, POKENAME predicts moments of change with great accuracy, but its calm nature means its predictions are not feared, but embraced.

entry: POKENAME既能预见灾难，又有守护者之心。它以能量引领其他生灵穿过黑暗，凭力量与身影驱散阴影。
author: wolfythehunter
source: With the power to foresee catastrophic events and the heart of a protector, POKENAME uses its energy to guide others through the darkness, dispelling the shadows with its power and presence.

entry: 许多POKENAME长寿，有些甚至活过训练家，在家族间代代相传。它们敏锐察觉大多危险，若认定训练家值得，就会守护。
author: infinex21
source: Many POKENAME have lived long lives, with some even having outlived their Trainers and even being passed down within some families. They have a keen sense for most dangers and if they consider their Trainer worthy, will guard them from said dangers.

entry: 人们相信，POKENAME给训练家带来祝福，却给其他人带来诅咒。许多人认为，强烈的护主愿望让它把好运给训练家，把厄运与灾难转给他人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is believed to be a blessing to its Trainer and a curse to others. Many think that its deep desire to keep its Trainer safe leads to it granting luck to them, while passing bad luck and disasters onto others.

entry: POKENAME挥舞镰刀，令许多人以为是收魂者。其实它心地温柔，只为保护无法自保的生灵才用武器。
author: sk372
source: The scythe POKENAME wields causes many to fear it as a reaper of souls. However, it is in truth a gentle soul who only uses the weapon in defense of those who cannot protect themselves.

entry: POKENAME用肃穆表情藏起感情，显得自信。它们曾为贵族当保镖，因此备受尊崇。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hide their feelings behind a solemn expression to give off an air of confidence. They were once held in high esteem because they served as bodyguards for nobility.

entry: POKENAME挥舞的宽大武器吓着陌生人。因此，尽管天性勇敢，仍常被视为死亡的使者。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: The broad weapon POKENAME wields intimidates strangers. As a result of this, it is often treated as a harbinger of death despite its brave nature.

entry: POKENAME出现在没有标记的坟墓旁。据说，它引渡被遗忘的灵魂，带领那些已无人记得的亡者前往彼岸。
author: imeavie
source: POKENAME appear near unmarked graves. It is said to ferry forgotten souls to the world beyond, guiding those with no one left to remember them.

entry: 传说，碰到POKENAME的楔石，会招来连续108天的可怕灾难与危险。它平时温和，只有突如其来的光惊扰睡眠，才会攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to legends, touching POKENAME's Keystone is said to bring 108 consecutive days of terrible disasters and dangers. Normally a peaceful Pokémon, it attacks only if its slumber is disturbed by sudden sources of light.

entry: POKENAME引导波导，强化感官，能察觉超过50公里外的威胁。惊人的速度与本能，让它在战斗中打出猛烈攻击。
author: danieru4729
source: By channelling its aura, POKENAME sharpens its senses and can detect threats from over 50 km away. Its remarkable speed and instincts guide it in combat to deliver devastating attacks.

entry: POKENAME强大，住在洞穴，谁挡路就会遭无情攻击。人们相信，只有意志坚定的训练家，才能赢得尊重。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are powerful cave-dwelling Pokémon that will attack anyone who crosses their path mercilessly. It's believed that only Trainers with determination can command the respect of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME强大，住在洞穴，谁挡路就会遭无情攻击。人们相信，只有意志坚定的训练家，才能赢得尊重。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are powerful cave-dwelling Pokémon that will attack anyone who crosses their path mercilessly. It's believed that only Trainers with determination can command the respect of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME夜里捕食林中宝可梦，却不绕树穿行，而是用剃刀般的附肢，一路砍倒挡路的树。
author: patch
source: POKENAME is a nocturnal hunter that feasts on forest-dwelling Pokémon. Rather than navigating through the forest, it uses its razor-sharp appendages to slice down the trees.

entry: POKENAME常在生态灾区边缘现身，警告闯入者远离，同时吸收其中污染，让当地复原。
author: veteranadventurer
source: POKENAME is often found at the edges of ecological disaster zones, warning away trespassers and absorbing the pollution within to heal the area.

entry: POKENAME的牙大约和高级厨刀一样锋利。盗猎者常采集牙齿，以中等价钱出售。
author: .izik
source: The teeth of an POKENAME are about as sharp as a high-grade kitchen knife. Poachers frequently harvest these teeth to sell for a moderate price.

entry: 这种自体融合酷似阿勃梭鲁的超级进化。超级形态散发威吓气息，加深常见误解；这种融合却能释放平和气息，显露真正的守护本性。
author: infranscia
source: This self fusion closely resembles Absol's Mega Evolution.  While the Mega form emits an intimidating aura, intensifying common misunderstandings of Absol, this fusion is able to emit a calm aura, revealing its true, protective nature.

entry: 据说，POKENAME曾造成一连串谋杀，至今仍未证实。但外形像漂浮头骨，使许多人认定传闻属实。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: It is said that POKENAME were the cause of a string of murders in the past. This has yet to be proven, but their resemblance to a floating skull leads many to conclude that the rumor is true.

entry: 古书声称，从POKENAME指间窥看，能见未来灾难。但已多次证明不实，仍有人相信传说。
author: .izik
source: Ancient tomes claim that peering between POKENAME's fingers allows one to see future disasters. However, this has been proven untrue on multiple occasions, though some still believe in the legend.

entry: 自然灾难将至之处，常会聚集许多POKENAME，准备将未能生还者的灵魂引往彼岸。
author: darkweavile428
source: Many POKENAME will gather in an area where a natural disaster is soon to occur, ready to take the spirts of all who do not survive to the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME能察觉船只故障，跟随将沉的船。有些水手想为此捕捉，但它们天性敏感，圈养后状态不佳。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME can detect issues with ships, following boats that will sink. Some sailors attempt to capture them for this ability, but they do poorly in captivity, being quite sensitive.

entry: POKENAME的尖角对环境变化极敏感，因此被认为格外能察觉天灾。过去，人们收集断角碎片，希望能提早预警。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's sharp horn is extremely sensitive to changes in its environment, leading it to be seen as hyper-aware to natural disasters. Broken bits of this Pokémon's horn were collected in the past in the hopes they would serve as early warning signs.

entry: 有人见过POKENAME收集植物与种子，放在草原、森林的特定地点。似乎是路标，警告旅人植物后方有危险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been seen gathering plants and seeds and placing them in specific areas of grasslands and forests. It appears these collections are meant to be markers warning travelers that danger lies beyond the flora it sets up.

entry: POKENAME大多漫游崎岖山地。据说被这把镰刀划伤，就会受到灾祸将临的诅咒。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME mostly wanders rugged mountains. A cut from this scythe is said to curse the victim with approaching disaster.

entry: POKENAME大多漫游崎岖山地。据说被这把镰刀划伤，就会受到灾祸将临的诅咒。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME mostly wanders rugged mountains. A cut from this scythe is said to curse the victim with approaching disaster.

entry: POKENAME两刃配合，战斗中挥动次数始终完全相等。有人相信，一刃受诅咒，另一刃得祝福。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's two blades work in tandem, always striking in battle with a perfectly equal number of swings. Some believe that one blade is cursed while the other is blessed.

entry: POKENAME锐眼能穿透厚重风暴云，察觉酝酿的灾难。危险一将至，就仰天嚎叫，向空中送出示警火花。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's piercing eyes can see through heavy storm clouds to detect brewing disasters. If it senses imminent danger, it howls into the sky, sending warning sparks through the air.

entry: POKENAME感官极敏锐，连最难寻的宝可梦也能察觉。它们住在高山，只有狩猎才飞低，先麻痹猎物，再以角一击敲昏。
author: keiracm35_
source: POKENAME's highly sharpened senses help them detect the most elusive Pokémon. They live in high mountain areas and fly to lower ground only to hunt, paralyzing their prey and knocking it out with a blow from their horn.

entry: POKENAME能特别感知海上风暴，因此养成海啸前向水手现身的习惯。人们却误以为，海上见它便预示大厄运。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME has the peculiar ability to sense incoming sea storms, and thus has developed the habit of appearing to sailors just before tsunamis. This has led to the mistaken belief that spotting one at sea is a sign of great misfortune.

entry: POKENAME似乎敏锐察觉周围将有剧变。有些寓言称，它飞过头顶后，就会跟来可怕风暴。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME seem to be keenly aware when a severe change in their surroundings is about to occur. Some fables claim that a terrible storm will follow in the wake of an POKENAME that flies overhead.

entry: POKENAME最初在遭辐射污染的研究设施废墟被发现。若周围人类与宝可梦不和，或已发生大灾，钟针就慢慢移向午夜。
author: quietcognition
source: POKENAME was first discovered in the irradiated ruin of a research facility. The hands of its clock creep toward midnight whenever it senses that the humans and Pokémon around it are not in harmony, or a great disaster has occurred.

entry: 许多人相信POKENAME受了诅咒。防护幻象看似完美，但任何群体遇见它，都会灾祸缠身。
author: ghostslythe
source: Many believe POKENAME are cursed. Though their protective illusions appear perfect, any group meeting one is beset by disasters.

entry: POKENAME在灾害管理与应急队伍中广受赞誉。缎带状触须不仅感知自然环境失衡，也能察觉人类内在的不和。
author: robobunnybutt
source: POKENAME is highly renowned within disaster management and emergency response teams. It is capable of sensing discord not only in the natural environment but also within human beings through its ribbon-like feelers.

entry: POKENAME会被心灵烦乱者吸引，给予安慰，甚至借出自身力量帮助。触须挥得极快，能把空气搅成强劲旋风刀。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are drawn to those with troubled spirits and will offer comfort or their very strength to aid them. Their feelers can lash with such swiftness that they can churn the very air into potent Razor Wind attacks.

entry: POKENAME以力量与可怕外表，吓得村民在灾前撤离。过去被认为是祸首，如今才知，它只是在扮恶人，催大家逃到安全处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its strength and intimidating appearance to frighten villages into evacuating before disasters strike. In the past it was believed to be the cause, but now it's known that it merely acts the villain to hasten people fleeing to safety.

entry: POKENAME在宇宙观察世界，留意可能的天灾。发现灾难，就高速降下，把平民送到安全处。
author: dodoowner_
source: It observes the world from the cosmos, observing for any natural disasters that may occur. When it detects a catastrophe, POKENAME descends at great speeds, transporting civilians to safety.

entry: 大灾发生时，POKENAME会把一个人送回过去，阻止灾难。若人类不主动改变未来，就会使它极其愤怒。
author: hophoppip
source: When a great disaster strikes, POKENAME will send a human back in time to prevent it. Humans who fail to take initiative to change the future anger it greatly.

entry: 野生POKENAME看似敌对，炮口轰出强劲攻击，险些打中人。深入调查才发现，它其实瞄准隐藏危险，例如悄悄接近的其他宝可梦。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME seem like they are hostile, as they fire powerful blasts from their cannons that only narrowly miss people. Further investigation has revealed that POKENAME are actually targeting hidden dangers, such as other Pokémon sneaking up.

entry: 满月之夜若灾难将至，POKENAME便会到村庄。许多关于满月的不祥迷信，都源自它们。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME arrive in villages on nights of the full moon when disaster is about to strike. They are the source of many negative superstitions about the full moon.

entry: POKENAME身上娇花香似白百合。有些文化把它们视为自由的象征。
author: mepp.
source: The delicate flowers on POKENAME's body have a similar scent to white lilies. In some cultures, they are considered symbols of freedom.

entry: POKENAME极其温柔，能感知人的内在潜力。它帮助发现隐藏才华，找到追梦的勇气。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME is an incredibly gentle Pokémon that possesses the ability to sense a person's inner potential. It helps people discover their hidden talents and find the courage to pursue their dreams.

entry: POKENAME静静漂在空的避风场所。察觉龙卷风逼近，就把附近宝可梦打昏，拖入里面救下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats quietly in empty storm shelters. If it senses an incoming tornado, it knocks nearby Pokémon unconscious and drags them into the shelter to save them.

entry: 据说，POKENAME是因果报应的化身，常在邪恶帝国或企业倒下后出现。若找到作恶者，就会用幽灵触须拖走。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are said to be manifestations of karma, usually appearing after the fall of evil empires or corporations. If it finds someone who committed an evil act, it will drag them away with its ghostly tendrils.

entry: POKENAME能感知灾难，并主动示警。对那些不听劝的人，它却乐于看着他们自食后果。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME can sense disasters, and actively warns people of them. It enjoys witnessing the aftermath of those who don't listen.

entry: POKENAME胆小，不敢在人类与其他宝可梦面前现身，通常避开。敏锐听觉与预知天灾的能力，却常成了负担，因为很难向谁警告。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME are timid Pokémon that are scared to appear before humans and other Pokémon, and usually avoid them. This makes POKENAME's sharp hearing and ability to predict natural disasters often a burden to them, because they struggle to tell anyone.

entry: POKENAME一生都在石棺内休息，从缝隙渗入的空气中摄取养分。受打扰，就会变得凶暴，攻击视野内的一切。
author: sondededoo
source: POKENAME spend their entire lives resting within their sarcophagus, gathering nutrients from the air that seeps in through the cracks. When disturbed, they will enter an aggressive state, in which they will attack anything within their sight.

entry: POKENAME用角制造扰乱方向的幻象，迷惑闯巢者。若其他手段无效，就会放慢时间，以黑暗魔法轰击受害者。
author: partypooperrex
source: With its horn, POKENAME creates disorienting illusions to confuse intruders in its den. If all else fails, POKENAME is known to slow down time to bombard its victims with dark magic.

entry: POKENAME出现在危险地带，点亮头上烛芯，引人跟随。谁不跟着火，就会遇上某种可怕灾难。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears in dangerous locales, drawing people to follow by lighting the wick upon its head. Those who don't follow the flame will wind up meeting a terrible disaster of some kind.

entry: 许多人相信，POKENAME火焰熄灭，世界末日便会开始。它在天灾后到来，燃烧新近亡者的灵魂。
author: mistymagius
source: Many people believe that the end of the world will begin once POKENAME's flame goes out. It arrives after natural disasters, burning the souls of the recently deceased.

entry: POKENAME常漂在村庄附近。若有一团火熄灭，很快就会发生灾难，每根蜡烛都对应不同的灾难。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME is often seen floating near villages. If one of its flames goes out, a disaster will occur shortly after. Each candle corresponds to a different disaster.

entry: POKENAME外表虽可怕，天性却极善良。可悲的是，闯入领地的人造成灾难，却反怪它，尽管它住在偏远山地。
author: sylia
source: POKENAME is extremely kind by nature despite its fearsome appearance. Sadly, it is blamed for disasters caused by people who invade its territory, even though it lives in remote mountain areas.

entry: POKENAME害羞，难以驯服。谁若伤害过它，就永远无法再次获得信任。
author: kiwikelly
source: POKENAME are shy and hard to tame. If an POKENAME is wronged, it will never trust the person that hurt it again.

entry: POKENAME住在洞穴深处，能预知地震。危险逼近，就会吼出可怕声音，像轮船汽笛混着孩子哭声。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lives deep inside caves, sensing earthquakes before they happen. When danger nears, it releases a horrifying roar that sounds like a mix between a boat horn and a child crying.

entry: POKENAME对环境变化与其他生灵的恶意，都十分敏感。许多村镇以它为守护者，供它安家，因为它常警告危险将至。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are highly attuned to changes in the environment as well as to the malice of others. There are quite a few towns and villages that are home to these Pokémon and treat them like guardians, for they will oft warn people of impending danger.

entry: 它常久久仰望天空，仿佛感知到了什么。极少数传说声称，这种宝可梦知晓太阳系外的某种存在，始终在留意。
author: infinex21
source: It is often seen looking up to the sky and staring for long times, as if there is something it senses. There are very few legends that claim this Pokémon is aware of something beyond our own solar system and that it is always monitoring for it.

entry: 传说，腐败贪婪者会寻找POKENAME，相信纸上写的诅咒必定命中目标。但故事大多以诅咒落到书写者身上告终，英雄因此得救。
author: riley_muir_qu33n_in_yellow
source: Legends say the corrupt and greedy would seek out POKENAME, believing curses written on its papers were guaranteed to strike their target. However, most of these legends end with the curse befalling the writer instead, saving the heroes.

entry: 灾难前，POKENAME的毛会带着静电竖起。它向空中放出微弱电击，提醒风暴将至。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fur bristles with static electricity before a disaster strikes. It sends small jolts into the air, alerting others of an approaching storm.

entry: POKENAME飞进城镇示警，却常因可爱而被忽略。若无人理会，就会开始电人。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME fly into towns to bring warnings but are often dismissed for their cuteness. If no one heeds them, they begin shocking people.

entry: POKENAME很容易焦躁。谁忽略警告，它就电到昏倒，再亲自拖到安全处。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME is quite easily agitated. It will shock those who ignore its warnings to the point of fainting, then proceed to drag them to safety by itself.

entry: POKENAME满身白细毛，硬如钢铁。察觉地震逼近，毛就会竖起。
author: .izik
source: The small white hairs covering POKENAME's body are as hard as steel. When it senses an earthquake approaching, its hair stands on end.

entry: 它用硬头冲撞其他对象自卫。似乎始终掌握四周，也知道是否有宝可梦或训练家靠近。
author: infinex21
source: It defends itself by ramming others with its hard head. It seems to always be aware of its surroundings and if another Pokémon or a Trainer draws near.

entry: POKENAME耐心等候，积聚进化能量。它们能察觉环境变化，远在风暴来临前，就会寻找庇护。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME bide their time as they store energy for their evolution. They can sense changes in their surroundings and will seek shelter far in advance of an impending storm.

entry: POKENAME用最大齿轮上的角，察知天气。因此，许多气象预报员都会养一只。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: Using the horns on its largest gear, POKENAME can detect the weather. Because of this, many weathermen keep one.

entry: POKENAME身体耐高温，能帮助受困野火的宝可梦。它使出强力劈开，斩断倒树，清出逃生路。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body can withstand intense heat, allowing it to aid Pokémon trapped in wildfires. It uses powerful Slashes to break apart fallen trees and clear escape routes.

entry: POKENAME对折身体，蛰伏数十年。只有格外寒冷的冬季，才能使叶在春天产花粉，因此少有机会进化；不过，训练家放进冷冻柜，就能确保这一过程发生。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: For decades, POKENAME lie dormant, curled in half. Few ever get the chance to evolve, as only exceptionally cold winters trigger their leaves to produce pollen in the spring, though Trainers can guarantee this by putting it in a freezer.

entry: POKENAME即使在最猛烈的天灾中，也能让花生长。玫瑰曾为哥特风服装师带来灵感。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME has the ability to grow its flowers even in the harshest natural disasters. Its roses have been an inspiration for gothic dressmakers.

entry: 据说，POKENAME飘到哪里，哪里就有灾难将至。抓住绳子的生灵，会被带上空中，送到安全处。
author: mochauspocus
source: Wherever POKENAME floats, disaster is said to be imminent. Those who grab its strings are lifted into the air and carried to safety.

entry: POKENAME察觉灾难将至，就用长牙在树上凿警告。但它不太懂人类文字，信息往往难以理解。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: When it senses upcoming disasters, POKENAME chisels warning messages into trees with its tusks. Unfortunately, POKENAME has a poor grasp of human writing, making these warnings often very hard to understand.

entry: 人们会带珍稀宝石给POKENAME，换取天灾将至的提醒。可它深居洞窟，并不好找。
author: darkweavile428
source: People will bring POKENAME rare gemstones in exchange for being warned of upcoming disasters. It lives deep in caves, so it's a bit tricky to find.

entry: POKENAME强颚很少让猎物逃走。只有察觉天灾将至，才会放开。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME's powerful jaws rarely allow prey to escape. They're only released if POKENAME senses that a natural disaster is about to strike.

entry: POKENAME曾是远古丛林令人畏惧的猎手。近年，能满足营养需求的猎物不足，数量骤减。由于稀有，它的身体部位受到追求战利品的猎人珍视。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: Once a feared predator in ancient jungles, POKENAME's population has dramatically decreased in recent times due to the lack of prey that meets its nutritional needs. Due to POKENAME's rarity, its body parts are highly prized by trophy hunters.

entry: 即使猛烈暴风雪中，POKENAME发光的红眼也清晰可见。它先用冰冷吐息削弱猎物，再以镰刀般的角斩倒。
author: mepp.
source: Even during intense blizzards, POKENAME's glowing red eyes are distinctly visible. It weakens prey with its icy breath before cutting them down with its scythe-like horn.

entry: POKENAME察觉飓风，会撒恶臭花粉，赶其他生灵离开。即使自己已逃到安全处，气味仍久久不散。
author: .izik
source: Sensing a hurricane, POKENAME scatters foul-scented pollen to drive others from the area. The scent lingers long after it flees for safety.

entry: 它以惊恐的舞蹈，向人类传达灾难将至。可惜，人们只顾看舞取乐，没领会信息。
author: hophoppip
source: It performs fearful dances to convey incoming disasters to humans. Unfortunately, the humans are too entertained by its dancing to get the message.

entry: POKENAME察觉龙卷风将至，就挥舞镰状羽毛，疯狂起舞。它想用仪式阻止风暴，却从未成功。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dances frantically with its scythe-like feather when it senses an impending tornado. It performs this ritual in hopes of stopping the storm, but it never succeeds.

entry: 灾难天气逼近，POKENAME会唱警告歌。它常故意唱得难听，催人离开。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: When catastrophic weather events are near, POKENAME sings warning songs. Often, it will purposefully make these songs unpleasant to the ear, motivating people to leave.

entry: 据说，碰到POKENAME，短时间内便会倒霉。可后来证实，那不过是POKENAME的黏液太滑惹的祸。
author: mistymagius
source: It has been said that coming in contact with POKENAME's body causes short-lasting misfortune. However, it has been proven that the misfortune is due to how slippery POKENAME's slime is.

entry: 它会强行把人拖离险境，甚至提前好几个小时。可力气太大，拖人时往往反而弄伤对方。
author: pokepower
source: It will forcibly drag people away from danger, even hours ahead of time. Its immense strength usually harms those people in the process.

entry: POKENAME的触手能用苹野果汁煎成美味菜肴。圣繁花号上的一家餐厅，就会供应。
author: .izik
source: The tentacles of an POKENAME can be fried in Leppa Berry juice to create a savory dish. A restaurant on the S.S. St. Flower serves this meal.

entry: 这位优雅又强大的斗士，只在值得的敌人挑战时才应战。若POKENAME与弱小的宝可梦交战，就会带来毁灭性的结局。
author: kiwikelly
source: This elegant yet formidable fighter will only battle if it's challenged by a worthy foe. If an POKENAME fights a weak Pokémon, it will spell its doom.

entry: 它若察觉巨浪将至，就用角戳赶人和宝可梦，把大家送到安全处。明亮的白沙，也颇受收藏家喜爱。
author: pokepower
source: If it senses a tidal wave coming, it will jab people and Pokémon with its horn to drive them to safety. Collectors love its brilliant white sand.

entry: POKENAME察觉飓风逼近，就向空中放出蓝孢子云，提醒周围生灵。可惜，孢子往往使其他对象睡着，反添了意料之外的危险。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME senses an incoming hurricane, it releases a blue cloud of spores into the air to alert others in the area. Unfortunately, these spores have a habit of putting others to sleep, causing more danger than intended.

entry: POKENAME偏爱演唱悲怆的歌谣，让听者心生忧伤。灾难过后，常能见它们到场演唱，努力给听众些许慰藉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have a fondness for performing tragic ballads, their songs inspiring a sense of melancholy in the listener. They are commonly found in the wake of disaster where they perform in an effort to offer solace to those listening.

entry: POKENAME的镰刀划过空气，就会奏出诡异音乐。它挥舞娴熟，在战斗中编出哀伤挽歌，使听者心生不祥预感。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The scythe POKENAME wields produces eerie music as it cuts through the air. POKENAME are adept at wielding it, forming mournful dirges in battle that instill a sense of foreboding in the listener.

entry: POKENAME向生命将尽的人现身，因此常被当成死亡使者。其实，歌声能安慰临终者，保护他们免遭幽灵属性宝可梦侵扰，再引灵魂安全前往来世。
author: lasercraft32
source: POKENAME appears to people nearing their end. Because of this, many treat it as a bringer of death. In truth, POKENAME's song comforts those on their deathbed, protecting them from Ghost-type Pokémon and leading their spirit safely to the afterlife.

entry: 雾夜里，能见到这些宝可梦飞过天空。POKENAME外形超凡，得名“月之使者”，但据说许多人与它相遇后便失踪。
author: actliux
source: On foggy nights, these Pokémon can be seen flying across the sky. They are titled "Moon Harbingers" due to their heavenly appearance, though encounters with POKENAME are said to have caused the disappearances of many.

entry: POKENAME以角察觉天灾，会懊恼磨牙。常能见到它试着用超能力，警告人类与宝可梦危险将至。
author: lydiaprower8
source: When POKENAME senses natural disasters with its horn, it grinds its teeth in frustration. It can often be seen attemtping to use its psychic powers to warn people and Pokémon of the impending danger.

entry: POKENAME察觉龙卷风逼近，就会产生过量孢子。龙卷风到来后，会把孢子撒遍袭击地区。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME produces excessive spores when it senses an incoming tornado. When the tornado arrives, it spreads these spores throughout the area it strikes.

entry: 这种不祥而高贵的宝可梦，会飞往察觉灾难将至的地方。再按受害者的善恶行为，决定是否救助。
author: keiracm35_
source: This ominous and regal Pokémon flies to areas where it senses something disastrous is about to happen and decides whether or not to save the victims based on their good and bad deeds.

entry: POKENAME胆怯，扭曲了对灾难的判断。只因一只小绿毛虫住到巢旁，就可能向整个群落警告捕食者入侵。
author: reflecbeat
source: POKENAME's sense of what qualifies as a disaster is distorted by its skittishness. One POKENAME may alert its colony to an invading predator simply because a small Caterpie has taken up residence near their nest.

entry: 风暴前，POKENAME的刃状花瓣会闪着蓝光，映出电闪。若天灾将近，就会释放炫目光芒，警告其他生灵快逃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's blade-like petals glisten blue before a storm, reflecting flashes of lightning. If a natural disaster is near, it releases a blinding light to warn others to flee.

entry: POKENAME能察觉即将倒塌的桥与建筑。它停在上面，连续几天不动，直到终于塌下才离开。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME can detect bridges and other buildings that will collapse soon. It will perch on them, unmoving for days on end, only leaving when it finally collapses.

entry: 饥荒摧残农田前，POKENAME会出现。它挥火镰割烧田野，使土肥沃健康，再被怀恨的人类赶走。
author: ghostslythe
source: Before famines ravage farmlands, POKENAME appears. It wields its flaming scythe to cut and burn fields into rich and healthy soil before being chased off by spiteful humans.

entry: 森林大火肆虐，POKENAME通常会被怪罪。它如何察觉林下草木已多到危险程度，仍未知；火前照片却常拍到挥镰身影，火势也从不失控。
author: ghostslythe
source: When a forest fire rages, POKENAME is usually blamed. It is unknown how they sense when the undergrowth is at dangerous levels, but photos taken before the blaze often capture its scythe-wielding figure. The fires never spiral out of control.

entry: 壳里升起的烟，会变形描出即将来临的灾难。烟升空仍保持形状，把警告送到远方也能看见的地方。
author: hophoppip
source: The smoke rising from its shell changes shape to form visions of incoming disasters. The smoke keeps its shape as it rises, delivering a warning that's visible from far away.

entry: 有人说，POKENAME若给你一颗亲手做的团子，就是警告死期将近。幸好，那只是都市传说。
author: .realthree
source: Some say that if POKENAME offers you one of its handmade dumplings, it is warning you that you are about to die. Luckily, that is just an urban myth.

entry: POKENAME疯狂挥臂，试图警告洪水将至。谁不肯逃，它就用头锤撞昏，再把失去意识的身体拖到安全处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME attempts to warn others of an impending flood by waving its arms frantically. If they refuse to flee, it knocks them out with a Headbutt and drags their unconscious bodies to safety.

entry: POKENAME潜伏城市暗巷，留意打架等街头暴力，再介入。外表虽凶，却总站在弱势者一边，尽力保护。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lurks in dark alleys within cities, where they watch for fights and other street violence before jumping in. Despite their mean appearance, they always side with the underdog and will try their best to protect them.

entry: POKENAME荷叶内积聚的水，会经过独特净化。喝下后，即使面对危险灾难，也能感到平静安宁。
author: sk372
source: Water gathered within POKENAME's lily pad goes through a unique purification process. Drinking the water after it has been treated gives people a sense of calm and serenity, even in the face of danger and disaster.

entry: POKENAME身体的锐边能切开陨石。古代文明十分畏惧它飞过城市，相信现身会带来可怕灾难。
author: mepp.
source: The sharp edges on POKENAME's body are capable of slicing through meteorites. Ancient cultures greatly feared POKENAME as it flew above their cities, believing its presence would lead to a terrible disaster.

entry: POKENAME四季都与农夫结成可贵伙伴。春天飞舞作物间，帮助传粉；收获时，以锐利弯翼干净割下茎秆。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME form valuable partnerships with farmers throughout the seasons. In the spring, they flutter between crops to assist with pollination, and when harvest arrives, they use their sharp, curved wings to cleanly reap stalks.

entry: POKENAME一察觉野火将起，就会赶往。它们清开路上倒树，帮助其他宝可梦逃离烈焰。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rush towards wildfires as soon as they sense one is about to occur. They help other Pokémon escape the flames by clearing fallen trees from pathways.

entry: 传说，POKENAME会向感情即将出问题的情侣现身。有些一看见就分手，有些却以此为动力，共同解决问题。
author: empty_set
source: Legend has it that POKENAME appears to couples who are facing imminent trouble in their love life.  Some couples break up immediately upon seeing it, while others take its presence as an impetus to work through their issues together.

entry: 许多农场饲养POKENAME。它们似乎能察觉作物不健康，拔去坏株。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME are raised on many farms. They seem to be able to sense when crops are unhealthy, tearing up bad ones.

entry: POKENAME察觉地震，就会高速挖掘，从地下冒出，警告人们。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME senses earthquakes and digs at fast speeds to pop out of the ground to warn people about them.

entry: POKENAME见钱就偷，无意间造成经济灾难，特别招商业区的人厌恶。商贩一听说它在附近，就赶紧关店。
author: ghostslythe
source: Hated especially in business districts, POKENAME inadvertently causes economic disasters by stealing any money it finds. When vendors hear these Pokémon are in the area, they quickly close up shop.

entry: 离岸流与暗流刚形成，POKENAME就会出现；许多专家相信，它能以某种透视未来的能力察知危险。民间关于它把人拖入水下的故事，记录颇多。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME appears when rip tides and undercurrents just begin to form; many experts believe it possesses a form of clairvoyance to detect these dangerous events. Folklore depicting POKENAME as one who pulls others beneath the waves is well-documented.

entry: POKENAME夜里溜进村庄，尽情嚎叫，想叫大家陪它玩。可嚎声宛如惨叫，吓得村民纷纷醒来，以为大祸突然临头。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME strolls into villages at night, enjoying howling as loudly as it can to try and call people to play with it. Unfortunately, its howls sound like shrieks, causing all of the villagers to wake up in fear of a sudden disaster happening.

entry: POKENAME察觉灾难将至，便赶进村庄示警，想尽可能救人。可进化前的模样太会闯祸，坏名声也一直跟着它们。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
