source: POKENAME rush into villages when they sense an incoming disaster, trying to protect as many people as possible with their warnings. They have earned a negative reputation due to their pre-evolutions causing havoc.

entry: POKENAME极灵活，高速奔跑时留下火迹。它们只在灾难前一刻现身，以嚎叫示警，人们曾以为只存在于神话。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are incredibly agile, leaving a trail of fire in their wake as they run with extreme speed. POKENAME were once thought to be mythical Pokémon, as they only appeared moments before disaster, using their howls as a warning.

entry: POKENAME凭巨大的羽翼升空，巡视大地，寻找灾难迹象。危险逼近，就会尖声咆哮，尾端火焰也炽热燃起。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME take to the skies with their immense feathered wings, scanning the land for signs of disaster. If danger nears, they unleash piercing roars while the fiery tips of their tails blaze with fierce heat.

entry: 阿罗拉乌拉乌拉岛的拉纳基拉山周围，POKENAME长久以来都被视为吉兆。人们相信，它们与露奈雅拉深有联系。
author: thordemidgard
source: In the Alolan island of Ula-Ula, the POKENAME found around Mount Lanakila have long been considered a good omen, for they are thought to bear a deep connection with Lunala.

entry: POKENAME稀少而强大，被认为体现了露奈雅拉的智慧。武器能随意召来；注入超能力后，自身意志会让刀刃锋利程度呈指数增长。
author: thordemidgard
source: Believed to embody Lunala's wisdom, POKENAME are as rare as they are powerful. The weapons they wield can be summoned at will, and when POKENAME infuse them with psychic power, their own will sharpens the blades exponentially.

entry: 老故事说，人们曾凭POKENAME在特定人类身边的反应，预测对方是否会犯罪。如今不再如此行事，法院里却仍有它的图像。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Old stories describe POKENAME being used to predict if someone would be a criminal, determined by how they'd react around certain humans. Nowadays, this practice is not upheld, but the iconography of POKENAME persists in courthouses.

entry: 灾难将近，POKENAME的藤蔓会硬如荆棘。它放出浓重苦味，赶走宝可梦，确保及时离开险地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's vines stiffen like thorns when disaster is near. It releases a strong, bitter aroma that repels Pokémon, ensuring they leave dangerous areas in time.

entry: POKENAME察觉灾难将至，鬃毛就会猛燃。它疾驰旷野，留下道道余火，警告危险逼近。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's mane flares up when it senses an impending disaster. It gallops across open fields, leaving behind trails of embers to warn others of approaching danger.

entry: POKENAME察觉灾祸，会以惊人速度冲过荒野。烈焰蹄留下焦痕，引导其他生灵前往安全处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dashes through the wilderness at incredible speeds when it senses a calamity. Its blazing hooves leave scorch marks in the ground, guiding others to safety.

entry: POKENAME能够察觉灾难。可往往还没来得及告诉谁，就把事情忘了。
author: jokerswild
source: POKENAME have the ability to detect disasters. However, they usually forget about them before they can warn anyone.

entry: 古老传说称，POKENAME三眼同时睁开，附近很快就有灾难。它们睡觉也睁一眼，仿佛始终警戒。
author: chibitales
source: An old legend states that if all three of POKENAME's eyes are open at the same time, a disaster will soon occur in the area. They sleep with one eye open, as if constantly wary for danger.

entry: 台风前，POKENAME大量聚在海湾附近。许多水手把它们视为灾难的阴沉先兆。
author: .izik
source: Mass amounts of POKENAME congregate near bays before typhoons strike. Many sailors view their appearance as a grim harbinger of disaster.

entry: POKENAME能察觉风暴将至，再指引同类寻找庇护，防止气体身体被吹散。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: POKENAME can sense upcoming windstorms. When it senses them, it directs other POKENAME to seek shelter to avoid their gas bodies dwindling away.

entry: POKENAME能察觉空气中的差异，知道三英里内谁可能做噩梦。可能性高，就一定赶去警告即将受害的对象。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: POKENAME can detect differences in the air that indicate the potential for nightmares for any individual within a three-mile radius. If such potential is high, this Pokémon will always rush to warn the soon-to-be victim.

entry: POKENAME是提醒人类撤离海滩的信号。若见大群爬上岸，就代表猛烈海上风暴将至。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME serves as a warning sign for humans to evacuate beaches. If one sees a massive group of POKENAME scuttling onto land, it means a turbulent ocean storm will soon arrive.

entry: POKENAME外表诡异，却格外平静温柔。夜里，它走过雾田，借背上南瓜的柔光，引迷路者回到安全处。
author: masked_ace01
source: Despite its eerie appearance, POKENAME is remarkably calm and gentle. It wanders through foggy fields at night, using the soft glow from the pumpkin on its back to guide the lost back to safety.

entry: POKENAME诞生于死去的绿毛虫。受威胁时，会散出阴冷雾气，趁机脱身。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME are born from deceased Caterpie. When threatened, they emit a chilling mist to secure an escape.

entry: POKENAME壳脆，便紧聚一团，试图吓退潜在危险。合力以超能力在上方投射可怕的头骨影像，更能震慑袭击者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's shells are fragile, so they band together tightly and try to frighten off any potential dangers. Working together, they can use psychic powers to project a fearsome skull visage above them to better scare off attackers.

entry: POKENAME孤独，很少接触其他宝可梦。一生大多在思索死亡、照料墓园。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are lonely creatures that rarely interact with other Pokémon. They spend much of their lives meditating on death and taking care of graveyards.

entry: POKENAME心念一动，就能随意在实体与无形之间切换，以可怕速度冲过与猎物之间的一切障碍。
author: radiance8990
source: With a thought, POKENAME can shift from corporeal to incorporeal at will, sprinting through any obstacle between it and its prey at terrifying speeds.

entry: 深夜，POKENAME会凭空出现，疯狂破坏，黎明又消失。究竟是怨恨人类，还是单纯不聪明，仍不清楚。
author: occulusmalus
source: At the dead of night, POKENAME will appear out of nowhere and go on destructive rampages before disappearing again at dawn. It is unclear if this is out of some vendetta against humans or if it is just unintelligent.

entry: 除休息外，POKENAME群总排成一列，无目的地行走，直到找到下一处休息地。它们很少离群，跟着前方同伴，哪怕得拆毁基础设施。
author: npshi
source: Unless resting, groups of POKENAME will walk in single file aimlessly until they find their next resting place. POKENAME will rarely deviate from their pack, following the Pokémon in front of them, even if it means tearing down infrastructure.

entry: POKENAME潜伏幽暗海域，藏在岩石海藻间，等时机攻击。红色独眼会降入胸廓，扩大视野，寻找下一只猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lurks in the darker parts of the ocean, hiding among rocks and seaweed until it's time to strike. Its single red eye lowers into its ribcage to give it more visual range to scope out its next prey.

entry: POKENAME沿海床漂浮，最幽暗的深海也能生存。潜水者曾报告海沟底有奇异红光，最后才发现其实是它。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Drifting along the ocean floor, POKENAME can survive even at the darkest depths of the sea. Divers have reported odd red lights at the bottom of trenches only to discover that they were actually POKENAME.

entry: 据说，POKENAME寻找不听话的孩子，用角卷走。若父母介入，它会疯狂挣扎，再放开孩子。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME is said to seek out misbehaving children, using its horns to whisk them away. If a parent intervenes, it thrashes about before releasing the child.

entry: 这种虫宝可梦在幽暗洞穴游荡，几乎所有威胁都敢挑战，却常败。POKENAME仍会反复找同一敌人，直到获胜。
author: fireblade141
source: This bug Pokémon can be found wandering in dark caverns and can be seen challenging just about anything that threatens it, but it is often defeated. However, POKENAME will often seek out the same foe repeatedly until it manages to claim victory.

entry: POKENAME是夜间猎人的克星。它先以麻痹的凝视定住目标，再冲锋。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME is the bane of nighttime game hunters. It freezes its target with a paralyzing stare, then charges.

entry: POKENAME独自虽弱，成群却能以神秘红眼的瞪视，吓住其他水生宝可梦。鳞片花样繁多，敌意却使许多渔夫远离。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although weak on their own, groups of POKENAME manage to strike fear into other aquatic Pokémon with glares from their mysterious red eyes. Their scales come in a variety of patterns, but their hostility drives many fishers away.

entry: POKENAME在住宅作祟时，会令电子设备失控。它直接抽取建筑电力，大幅增强攻击。
author: ghostslythe
source: When POKENAME is haunting a house, it causes electronics to go haywire. Pulling electricity directly from the building, it supercharges its attacks.

entry: POKENAME吃网上存档的鬼故事，偏爱无人问津的传说。一旦吃掉，便彻底删去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME feeds on ghost stories archived online. It favors neglected tales, erasing them entirely once consumed.

entry: POKENAME的目光轻易就能麻痹打算吞食的猎物。它是来自远古的凶悍猎手。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's glare from its eyes can easily paralyze prey it plans on eating. This Pokémon is a fierce predator from long ago.

entry: POKENAME酷似化石翼龙的骨架，骨骼间绷着一层黑色薄膜。它白天假装毫无动静，夜里才飞出去寻找猎物。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has a strong resemblance to an Aerodactyl skeleton, with a thin black membrane stretched between its bones. It will pretend to be inert during the day, and then fly off at night in search of prey.

entry: 除了头骨内发光的红眼，POKENAME就像化石翼龙骨骼化石。翼骨间虽无膜，仍能拍动飞行。
author: .jerden
source: Aside from the glowing red eye inside its skull, POKENAME resembles a fossilized Aerodactyl skeleton. Although there is no webbing between the bones of its wings, it can still flap them to fly.

entry: POKENAME目击后常接连有灾，被视为厄运先兆。许多训练家前去寻找，最终眼含恐惧，发誓不再遇见。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME is considered to be a harbinger of doom due to various disasters that occurred after sightings. Many Trainers have sought after this Pokémon, only to swear off further encounters with fear in their eyes.

entry: POKENAME体内红光随训练家心跳脉动。脉动一快，就会以惊人速度，冲去保护训练家。
author: spkypirate
source: The red light within this Pokémon pulses in time to the beat of its trainer's heart. When the light pulses rapidly, POKENAME rushes to their trainer's defense at incredible speed.

entry: 黑暗或起雾的夜里，POKENAME会寻找迷路的人类与宝可梦。不是帮忙回家，就是吓得对方魂不附体。
author: pkbonusducks
source: On dark or foggy nights, POKENAME search for lost people and Pokémon. They will either help the missing folk find their way home or scare them silly.

entry: POKENAME受威胁就会转身，让幽灵火焰猛涨。灵魂怨念越深，火也越热。
author: vlavoc
source: When threatened, POKENAME turns around and flares its ghostly flame. The more vengeful the spirit, the hotter the flame becomes.

entry: POKENAME食腐，成大群生活，只在夜里活动。它们在洞穴或浓密树冠筑巢，避开阳光。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are carrion feeders that live in large flocks and move only at night. They nest within caves or thick tree canopies to avoid sunlight.

entry: POKENAME讨厌阳光，只有暮色降临才起飞。阴森外形，使迷信的人把它当作不幸象征。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME only takes flight when twilight falls, as it hates sunlight. Because of its macabre appearance, superstitious people consider it a symbol of misfortune.

entry: POKENAME十分焦虑，始终守在峭壁与峡谷附近，防止谁坠落身亡。它讨厌阳光直照，因此白天几乎看不见。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a very anxious creature that constantly keeps watch near cliffs and ravines to prevent anyone from falling to their death. It hates being exposed directly to sunlight, which is why it is almost impossible to see it during the day.

entry: POKENAME凭无声双翼出没夜间。它把头转过180度，免得猎物发现头骨里的光。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME haunts the night on silent wings. It rotates its head 180 degrees so its prey won't notice the light from within its skull.

entry: POKENAME极度胆怯，总避开镜子与水面，免得看见自己可怕的倒影。
author: kandyman
source: An extremely nervous creature, POKENAME tends to avoid mirrors and water, lest it sees its own terrifying reflection.

entry: 野生POKENAME大多以单根丝悬在顶上，猎物一从下方经过，就立刻出击。古老童话说，曾有贪婪男人被诅咒，变成这种宝可梦。
author: cobalt0135
source: Wild POKENAME spends most of its time hanging from ceilings by a single thread, striking the instant its prey passes beneath it. An old fairy tale speaks of a greedy man cursed to become this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME以眼中红光与尖叫恐吓猎物，再扑下。它们只找弱小目标，若找不到，就改吃腐肉。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME utilize the crimson glow of their eyes and their shrill cries to terrorize their prey before descending upon them. They only target weak prey; if they can find no prey, they will feed on carrion.

entry: POKENAME夜里穿墙潜入住宅。它不吓孩子，反而会送去甜梦。
author: nemunemuri.
source: POKENAME sneaks into homes at night by phasing through walls. Rather than scaring children, it gives them sweet dreams instead.

entry: POKENAME红眼的目光，连肯泰罗都能吓住，似乎也最爱把它当猎物。强壮利爪会攫住目标，带回巢。
author: infinex21
source: The crimson glow of a POKENAME's gaze can even strike fear into Tauros, which is what they seem to favor as their prey. They use their strong talons to seize their prey and carry them back to their nests.

entry: 墓地下起雨，附近便一定有POKENAME。它走到哪儿，都带来哀愁的雨，还常到葬礼上，向逝者致意。
author: daemonkill22
source: When it rains in a graveyard, one can be certain that a POKENAME is nearby. It brings a melancholy rain wherever it travels, frequenting funerals to pay respects to the dead.

entry: POKENAME能穿过任何表面，轻松潜入住宅找食物。被发现便迅速逃走，仿佛消失得无影无踪。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME can pass through any surface, allowing them to easily infiltrate homes in search of food. If caught, they will quickly flee, seemingly vanishing without a trace.

entry: 白天，POKENAME躲在河岸巢里。巢内满是猎物灵魂，让温度降低。只用红眼盯着，就能让猎物吓得僵住。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: During the day, POKENAME hide in their nests on riverbanks, which are filled with the souls of their prey and drop the temperature inside. They can cause prey to freeze in fear simply by staring at them with crimson eyes.

entry: 白天，POKENAME躲在泥与骨筑成的河岸巢里。它用鳃指引自己，前往最近能被吓住的灵魂身边。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: During the day, POKENAME hide in their nests on riverbanks, made of mud and bones. They use their gills to guide them toward the nearest soul that they can petrify.

entry: 白天，POKENAME躲在泥与骨筑成的河岸巢里。只用红眼盯着，就能让猎物恐惧得无法动弹。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: During the day, POKENAME hide in their nests on riverbanks, made of mud and bones. They are able to cause their prey to freeze up in fear just by looking at them with their crimson eyes.

entry: 月光下，看见POKENAME锐利红眼的人，会想起最深的恐惧。据说，身体圆环发光时，就有不幸的灵魂被带走。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: Those who see POKENAME's piercing red eyes in the moonlight are reminded of their deepest fears. It's said that when the rings on its body glow, an unfortunate spirit will be taken away.

entry: POKENAME诞生于宝可梦墓园，深夜游荡作祟。球茎与叶片已完全死去，没有本该赋予颜色的叶绿素，也无法享受太阳的温暖。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME arise within Pokémon graveyards, haunting the grounds in the dead of night. Their bulbs and leaves are completely dead, devoid of the chlorophyll that would otherwise give them colour and leaving them unable to enjoy the warmth of the sun.

entry: POKENAME只有夜里才现出全貌，暗影身体环绕漂白的头骨形成。白天，看起来与普通拉达头骨毫无区别。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are only ever seen in full at night, their shadowy bodies forming around the bleached skull that forms their head. During the day, POKENAME are indistinguishable from an ordinary Raticate skull.

entry: 据说，POKENAME藏在紫苑镇的宝可梦塔，守望前来悼念亲人的访客。传闻面具能让它与死者交流，却无人证实。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are said to lurk inside the Pokémon Tower in Lavender Town where they watch over visitors coming to mourn loved ones. It is rumored that their mask allows them to communicate with the dead, though no one has been able to confirm this.

entry: 据说，POKENAME受冷落就会偷孩子玩具，孩子因此在森林放蜜罐。红眼光照着吃下的蜜，仿佛鲜血，更吓坏看见的孩子。
author: .izik
source: It is said that POKENAME will steal the toys of children if it is neglected, leading to kids placing pots of honey in forests. The red glow from the POKENAME's eye causes the honey it eats to resemble blood, further frightening children that see it.

entry: 它的身体是极热的黏油，散发强烈热量。这种热液让它连在灼热环境也能繁盛生存。
author: .izik
source: Its body is made of an incredibly hot, viscous oil that radiates intense heat. This hot liquid allows it to thrive even in scorching environments.

entry: POKENAME壳内猩红眼似乎不受本体控制，独自阴森地盯路人。热成像仪虽看不出散热，附近的人却常觉得被热包围。
author: chibitales
source: The scarlet eye within POKENAME's shell seems to move independently of POKENAME's control, staring at passersby with an eerie glare. Despite giving off no heat on thermal cameras, those near POKENAME often report feeling surrounded by heat.

entry: 大多POKENAME喜欢秋季，有些会在十月最后一天，陪孩子挨家讨糖。若不给，它就穿门而入，吓到屋主肯给为止。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Most POKENAME enjoy the autumn season, with several seen accompanying children going door-to-door for candy on the last day of October. If not given candy, POKENAME will phase through the door and scare the owners until given some.

entry: POKENAME虽小，谁凝视燃烧的眼，就会吓得僵住。有人认为，它能直看灵魂深处，作出审判。
author: zweizweihander
source: Though small, if a person stares into POKENAME's burning eyes, they freeze in fear. Some think that POKENAME stares into the depths of your soul in order to judge you.

entry: POKENAME住在墓园附近的池塘旁，用鼻子饮水。有时会把墓上物品拖回洞里，留作纪念。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME resides near ponds close to graveyards, using its nose to drink water. It will sometimes pull objects off of graves into its burrow as keepsakes.

entry: POKENAME整夜游走空屋，找旧硬件吃，尤其爱盘片。一找到，盘里数据就损坏，只能播放一段它绕圈旋转的短视频。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME stalks empty homes throughout the night to look for old hardware to consume, particularly discs. Once it finds a disc, the data within the disc is corrupted and only runs a short video of POKENAME spinning in circles.

entry: 据说，POKENAME由废弃数据创造，用来压缩、隔离并移除无用数据。现存少数个体被墓园吸引，据说会记录逝者。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME were supposedly created from dead data as a means to compress, isolate, and remove said unnecessary data. The few POKENAME that exist are drawn to graveyards, supposedly keeping records of the deceased.

entry: POKENAME会在失效网站的残骸里现身。它们很少离开网络空间，因此少被捕捉，人们也所知甚少。
author: karagar
source: POKENAME are known to manifest in the remnants of defunct websites. They rarely leave Cyberspace, making them rarely caught and poorly understood.

entry: POKENAME用嘴唇吸取生命能量，一旦想吻谁，就会整夜追猎，直到黎明才放弃。若发现妆花了，它便跑开，消失在墙里。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME sucks the life energy out of others with its lips, so when it decides it wants to kiss someone, it hunts them down all night long, giving up only at dawn. If it realizes its makeup has been ruined, it runs away and disappears into the walls.

entry: POKENAME充够能量，就从头上叉状突起放红火花。特殊电击会给命中者轻微恐惧诅咒，使其发抖、多疑。
author: sk372
source: Once it's charged up enough energy, POKENAME lets loose red-colored sparks from the prongs on its head. These special electrical bursts leave those hit afflicted with a minor curse of fear, leading to trembling and paranoia.

entry: POKENAME产的奶，夜里会泛诡光。大多数生灵喝了略恶心，幽灵属性宝可梦却极爱味道，喝下毫无问题。
author: sk372
source: Milk sourced from POKENAME emits an eerie glow at night. The milk makes most creatures slightly nauseous, but Ghost-type Pokémon adore the taste and can consume it with no problems.

entry: 水手曾把POKENAME飞行视为极坏凶兆。传说，若目光相接，它就会跟船不停骚扰，直到沉没。
author: sk372
source: Seeing POKENAME in flight was considered a deeply bad omen for sailors. The legends said that locking eyes with it would cause it to follow one's ship and harass it unceasingly until it was sunk.

entry: POKENAME红眼能使凝视者短暂恍惚。受控时，它让对方取来自己够不着的树上水果，再解除控制。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's red eye puts those who gaze into it into a short-term trance. While under its spell, POKENAME uses them to get fruits it from trees it can't reach, then dismisses them from its control.

entry: 某些传说说，POKENAME会收割恶者灵魂。身体伸出骨臂，挥舞巨镰，收割目标时，会发出独特的怪笑尖叫。
author: sk372
source: Said in some legends to harvest the souls of the malevolent, POKENAME swings a massive scythe wielded by the skeletal arms jutting from its body. It lets out a distinctive cackling shriek as it reaps its target.

entry: POKENAME天性爱捣蛋，兴高采烈地吓训练家与宝可梦。它从不在训练家面前摘面具，因此面具后是什么，仍是谜。
author: ultron_suprem3
source: POKENAME are mischievous by nature, frightening Trainers and Pokémon alike with all the glee in the world. What lies behind the mask of POKENAME is a mystery, as they never remove their mask in the presence of Trainers.

entry: POKENAME更容易在生日会后现身。民间传说，它会夺走小寿星的灵魂，占据其身体。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are more likely to appear after birthday parties. Folktales say it snatches the soul of the child who is celebrating, and possesses the body.

entry: POKENAME食欲旺盛，不顾四周，一把抓住所有有机之物。似乎尤其喜欢腐烂的东西。
author: pokepower
source: POKENAME have voracious appetites, grabbing anything organic while ignoring their surroundings. They seems to prefer rotten things.

entry: POKENAME出现在火山摧毁的城镇与森林遗迹。它们从双臂喷幽灵火焰，烧灼整个战场。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME appear in the ruins of towns and forests destroyed by volcanic eruptions. These Pokémon spew ghostly flames from their arms, scorching everything across the battlefield.

entry: POKENAME潜伏草木腐烂枯萎之地。有人说，它被死亡腐败吸引；也有人认为，正是它的存在让草木枯萎。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME lurks in places where the foliage rots and withers away. Some say it is drawn to death and decay, while others posit that it causes the withering through its presence.

entry: POKENAME漂过恐怖故事论坛，直接从文字吸收作者情绪。所过之处，文字通常会变得乱七八糟。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats through horror story forums, absorbing the emotions of those who write them through the text itself. This usually leaves the text terribly jumbled wherever it passes through.

entry: 爱惹事的孩子说，夜里睡觉时看见POKENAME攀在天花板。父母查看哭闹的孩子，却总只发现小洞。
author: badtothebow
source: Problematic children claim to see POKENAME clinging to their ceiling when they sleep at night. Parents, however, only ever find small holes when they check on their crying children.

entry: POKENAME借夜色在树枝间荡来荡去。它喜欢从树冠落下，吓唬露营的孩子。
author: badtothebow
source: POKENAME swings itself from branch to branch under the cover of night. It loves to spook children out camping by dropping in on them from the canopy.

entry: POKENAME浮在离地几英寸处，怯怯躲在训练家身后。可那只独眼的凝视，却连最沉着的旅人，也难以招架。
author: katunei
source: POKENAME floats inches from the ground and cautiously hides behind its Trainer. Though it hides, its single eye burns through even the most stoic of travelers.

entry: 猛踢与斩击已足够危险，POKENAME为了赢，还会不顾自身地猛攻。不知为何，双臂却一直紧紧绑着。
author: katunei
source: Its ferocious kicks and slashes are enough to demand caution, but POKENAME fights recklessly to achieve victory. For some strange reason, it keeps its arms tightly bound.

entry: POKENAME将身体沉进沼泽，只露头，看似地上一颗头骨。倒霉旅人若靠太近，可能被抓住，拖入烂泥。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME submerges itself in swamps save for its head, appearing to be nothing more than a skull upon the ground. Hapless travelers that wander too close may be grabbed and dragged beneath the muck.

entry: 在丰缘，POKENAME的麻痹凝视会引发幻觉，被称作死亡使者。有人说，它因对恐惧敏感，才避开人类。
author: ghostslythe
source: In Hoenn, POKENAME is known as the messenger of death due to its paralytic gaze causing hallucinations. Some say it avoids humans due to its sensitivity to fear.

entry: 据说，这只神秘宝可梦能号令亡魂，常为不明目的聚集坟旁。有人却认为，POKENAME并非恶意驱使，而是在引领迷魂，走向安息。
author: rakunk
source: This mysterious Pokémon is said to command the spirits of the dead, often gathering near graves for mysterious purposes. Some have argued POKENAME uses its powers not from malice but rather as a guide for lost souls to their final rest.

entry: POKENAME乍看像穿朴素斗篷的沙奈朵。但披风一开，就露出漂浮头骨形影，保证让看见的对象怕得发抖。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME at first appears like a Gardevoir wearing a simple cloak. However, opening the cloak reveals a floating skull visage guaranteed to send tremors of fear into those it reveals the sight to.

entry: POKENAME吃得营养，头骨就会更亮。宝可梦中心会在暗处观察，依光的强度与颜色判断健康。
author: .izik
source: The skull on its head shines brighter if it consumes a nutritious diet. Pokémon Centers will observe POKENAME in the dark to determine their health based on the intensity and color of their glow.

entry: POKENAME跟踪训练家，对方转身就迅速伪装。若看见训练家善待其他宝可梦，它便现身，允许收服。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME stalk Trainers and quickly camouflage themselves when the Trainer turns around. If they observe the Trainer being kind to other Pokémon, then they reveal themselves and allow the Trainer to catch them.

entry: 它纠缠砍树削枝，却完全不用木料的人。若找不到人纠缠，就会向生命力格外强的对象现身。
author: bobosmith01
source: It haunts those who cut down trees and their limbs but do not use the wood in any way. If it cannot find anyone to haunt, it will then appear to those with a particularly strong life force.

entry: 它纠缠砍树削枝，却完全不用木料的人。若找不到人纠缠，就会向生命力格外强的对象现身。
author: bobosmith01
source: It haunts those who cut down trees and their limbs but do not use the wood in any way. If it cannot find anyone to haunt, it will then appear to those with a particularly strong life force.

entry: POKENAME发怒会哀号，像许多男人齐声尖叫。传说这些声音属于战死英雄，却没有证据。
author: .izik
source: When angered, POKENAME emits a wail like a chorus of screaming men. Legends claim these voices belong to fallen war heroes, though no proof exists.

entry: POKENAME脸上的骷髅面具用来吓退天敌。面具边缘的锯齿，还能帮助进食。
author: melodydelune
source: The skull mask on the face of POKENAME is used to ward off predators. The jagged edges of the mask assist it when eating.

entry: POKENAME多在秋季出现，游荡农田，藏在南瓜地。它从藏身植物抽取生命力维生，因而妨碍生长。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are mostly encountered in the autumn, haunting farmer's fields and hiding amongst pumpkin patches. Their presence is detrimental to growth as they draw lifeforce away from the plants they hide amongst to sustain themselves.

entry: POKENAME诞生于宝可梦墓园，深夜游荡。有些球茎仍残存生命迹象，它们会尽量多晒夕阳，希望再次生长。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME arise within Pokémon graveyards, haunting the grounds in the dead of night. Some POKENAME have lingering traces of life in their bulbs and they try to catch as much of the sunset as they can to try to encourage some returning growth.

entry: 据说，POKENAME能将月照森林的游魂吸进南瓜。内部汇聚的诡异脉动能量，能操纵过路训练家的影子，模仿其最深恐惧。
author: naivetotoro
source: It is said that POKENAME can absorb the wandering spirits of a moonlit forest into its pumpkin. The eerie, pulsating energy it gathers within can manipulate the shadows of wandering trainers to mimic their deepest fears.

entry: POKENAME头骨内有远古罕见矿物。光是存在就会干扰灵体信号；黑夜魔灵、洛托姆等在附近使用能力，行为都会异常。
author: bobosmith01
source: Ancient uncommon minerals are found in POKENAME's cranium. Its mere presence disrupts and scrambles spiritual signals: Pokémon such as Dusknoir and Rotom do not exhibit typical behavior when attempting to use their powers around POKENAME.

entry: 许多饲养者戴反光镜片，免得被POKENAME瞪得僵住。幸好，它的智力勉强够认出自己。
author: secondatheniangadfly
source: Many Trainers that own these Pokémon tend to wear mirrored lenses so that POKENAME's glare doesn't freeze them in place. Luckily, POKENAME are just about intelligent enough to recognize themselves.

entry: 某些古代教团崇拜POKENAME，相信能免去死后折磨。描述仪式的石板，至今仍散布丰缘遗迹。
author: .izik
source: Certain ancient cults worshipped POKENAME, believing it would spare them torment after death. Stone tablets describing these practices still remain scattered across Hoenn ruins.

entry: 尖牙长得太长，它就啃墓碑边缘磨短。鬼故事却说，这些抓痕来自想逃出坟墓的亡者。
author: .izik
source: When its fangs grow too long, it gnaws on the edges of tombstones to wear them down. Ghost stores claim these scratches come from those looking to escape their graves.

entry: 人们认为POKENAME象征着谦逊而缺乏自信的波加曼。独眼让步态笨拙，却仍深得训练家喜爱。
author: xyloldi
source: POKENAME, thought to represent humble Piplup lacking confidence, charm Trainers despite their clumsy gait from their single eye.

entry: POKENAME聚在古墓附近，传闻会引灵魂前往来世。孩子或叛逆少年若迷失其中，它就帮忙找回路。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME congregate near ancient tombs where they are rumored to help guide souls to the afterlife. When children or rebellious teenagers are lost in those tombs, the Pokémon helps them find their way back.

entry: 一个著名故事将POKENAME描绘为灵界神灵，三只头骨状的小朝北鼻，则充当顾问。
author: hophoppip
source: A famous story casts a POKENAME as a deity of the spirit world, with its three skull-like Mini-Noses acting as its advisors.

entry: POKENAME整夜追猎自己认为值得的勇士。追赶时能隐身，穿过厚墙。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME hunts warriors it deems worthy throughout the night. It becomes invisible and passes through thick walls in pursuit.

entry: POKENAME整夜追猎自己认为值得的勇士。追赶时能隐身，穿过厚墙。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME hunts warriors it deems worthy throughout the night. It becomes invisible and passes through thick walls in pursuit.

entry: POKENAME静候深湖底，感知上方游过的猎物。它从黑暗急冲而起，红色独眼发亮，场面着实骇人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME waits at the bottom of deep lakes, quietly waiting for it to sense prey swimming above. The sight of its single red eye glowing as it careens upward from the darkness is quite harrowing indeed.

entry: 偶尔能见到POKENAME在墓园游荡。它靠近亲人墓前的悼念者，以触须轻拂，带来些许安慰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can be seen occasionally milling through graveyards. It comes up close to those mourning near a loved one's grave, brushing them with its tendrils to provide them with some level of emotional comfort.

entry: 无月之夜，POKENAME会冲向远洋客轮。接触前变得无形，无害穿过船体。为何这样做，仍未知。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: On moonless nights, POKENAME can be spotted charging at ocean liners. Before making contact POKENAME turn intangible, going through the ship harmlessly. The reason why they do this has yet to be determined.

entry: 古画将POKENAME描绘为冥界居民，会升上地面，惩罚不敬大地威严的对象。故事说，它撕裂陆地，张开深沟，将整个文明吞下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME was depicted in ancient drawings as a resident of the underworld that rose up to punish those who did not respect the planet's majesty. Stories say it would rend the land asunder, opening crevasses up to swallow civilizations whole.

entry: POKENAME的单眼从躯干多个孔洞窥看。与其对视者的命运，会随它从哪一孔看来而不同。
author: sk372
source: A single eye peers at others from the multiple holes in POKENAME's torso. The fate that befalls those who meet its gaze differs depending on which slot it views them from.

entry: POKENAME炮火直击，能短暂引发方向迷失、意识混乱、恶心或昏厥。数百年前，这被完全误认成损伤或摧毁猎物灵魂。
author: pkbonusducks
source: A direct hit from POKENAME's cannon fire can briefly cause disorientation, confusion, nausea, or loss of consciousness. Centuries ago, this was completely mistaken as POKENAME damaging or destroying the souls of their quarry.

entry: POKENAME被当成小祸害，因为附身的电子设备，在它离开后都会失灵。可惜，这既非有意，也不受它控制。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is considered a bit of a menace, due to the fact that any electronic it possesses will cease to function after it leaves it. Sadly this is unintentional and involuntary on POKENAME's part.

entry: POKENAME以噩梦为食，像捕梦网一样织网，从空中捕梦。外表虽可怕，性情却温柔，对人类完全无害。
author: occulusmalus
source: POKENAME feeds on bad dreams and spins webs to catch them from the air much like a dreamcatcher. Despite its frightening appearance, it has a gentle temperament and is completely harmless to humans.

entry: 头上蜡烛散发美味高汤般的香气。为尊重逝者，它会睡在墓碑旁。
author: .izik
source: The candle on its head emits a scent resembling delicious soup broth. Out of respect for the deceased, it sleeps near gravestones.

entry: POKENAME造出的幽灵能量球，曾被认为是亡者不安的灵魂。夜间更活跃，在暗中潜行，唯独猩红独眼可见。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME creates orbs of ghostly energy that were once believed to be the restless spirits of those who passed away. It is more active at night, stalking in the darkness with only its single scarlet eye being visible.

entry: 有人说，POKENAME是善良的守护灵，被悲伤孤独的孩子吸引。许多童年幻想朋友，其实就是它在需要时出现，给予安慰。
author: occulusmalus
source: Some say POKENAME are protective, kindly spirits drawn towards sad or lonely children. Many childhood imaginary friends were actually this Pokémon, appearing in hours of need to give comfort.

entry: POKENAME以墓园为家，太害羞，不敢现身。它先折射光线隐形，再用心灵感应交流，结果通常吓跑访客。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME make their home in graveyards. They're too shy to make themselves seen, so they refract light to become invisible before communicating telepathically. Unfortunately, this typically scares away visitors.

entry: POKENAME以墓园为家，聪明得能懂人话，因此有时会参加葬礼，从阴影中隐形旁观。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME make their home in graveyards. Because they are intelligent and can understand human speech, they sometimes attend the funeral services held there, watching invisibly from the shadows.

entry: 森林火灾后，POKENAME悲伤飘过烧尽的灰烬。尾色能显示起火原因；骨白色表示炎夏干燥的林下草木起火。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME drifts mournfully through the burned-down ashes after a forest fire. The colour of its tails indicates what caused the fire. Bone-white tails show that the fire was caused by dry undergrowth catching on a hot summer's day.

entry: 只要靠近POKENAME，就可能看见恐怖幻觉，堪比达克莱伊的噩梦。有时，它会向寿命将尽的人类或宝可梦现身。
author: dyo_jonah
source: Just being near POKENAME can cause you to experience terrifying hallucinations on par with Darkrai's nightmares. Sometimes, it appears in front of people or Pokémon approaching the end of their lifespan.

entry: POKENAME能感知生灵的波导。它整夜不停游走，试图理解这项能力。
author: brapollo
source: POKENAME can sense auras from living creatures. It wanders endlessly through the night to understand its ability.

entry: POKENAME夜里聚在丛林树冠，毛骨悚然的叫声回荡数英里。只有闭着眼，才能安全穿过群落领地。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME congregate in the jungle canopy at night, their hair-raising calls echoing for miles. The only way to safely cross a troop's territory is with one's eyes closed.

entry: POKENAME夜里聚在丛林树冠，毛骨悚然的叫声回荡数英里。只有闭着眼，才能安全穿过群落领地。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME congregate in the jungle canopy at night, their hair-raising calls echoing for miles. The only way to safely cross a troop's territory is with one's eyes closed.

entry: 森林火灾后，POKENAME悲伤飘过烧尽的灰烬。尾色能显示起火原因；灰色表示兴奋过头的宝可梦胡乱使用能力，引起了火。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME drifts mournfully through the burned-down ashes after a forest fire. The colour of its tails indicates what caused the fire; ash grey tails show the fire was caused by an over-excited Pokémon using its abilities carelessly.

entry: 森林火灾后，POKENAME悲伤飘过烧尽的灰烬。尾色能显示起火原因；血红色表示人类恶意纵火。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME drifts mournfully through the burned-down ashes after a forest fire. The colour of its tails indicates what caused the fire; blood red tails show the fire was caused deliberately by a human in an act of malice.

entry: POKENAME的翼振，会让所有生灵的骨也跟着振动。若它身在墙里，产生的能量就会让墙体爆炸。
author: soup1900
source: The vibrations of POKENAME's wings cause the bones of all living creatures to start vibrating too. The energy it creates while doing this causes walls it is inside of to explode.

entry: 别的宝可梦难以生存的险恶湖河里，却有大群POKENAME。没有天敌，一个POKENAME群体，甚至能铺满足球场那么大的水面。
author: mistymagius
source: Large schools of POKENAME can be found in lakes and rivers too dangerous for other Pokémon to survive. Due to a lack of predators, POKENAME schools can be as large as a football field.

entry: POKENAME很少移动，受致密坚骨外壳保护，等待进化。凝视红眼太久的人，都声称看见恶魔在壳内成形的影像。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME moves very little, awaiting evolution while protected by a shell made of dense and sturdy bone. Those that gaze into its glowing red eyes too long swear they see the image of a demon developing within its shell.

entry: POKENAME能穿墙、变形，却只拿这些本领来偷训练家包里的零食。
author: jokerswild
source: POKENAME have the ability to pass through walls and shapeshift, yet they only ever use this power to steal treats from their Trainer's bag.

entry: 野生POKENAME常对午夜后仍外出的人开可怕玩笑。疯狂笑声，能在黑暗中回响。
author: cobalt0135
source: Wild POKENAME often play frightful pranks on anyone that wanders out late after midnight. Their demented laughs can be heard echoing in the darkness.

entry: 研究者认为，POKENAME把弃骨插进绒毛，显得更吓人。若有人想取下，它就明显焦躁。
author: mepp.
source: Researchers believe POKENAME places discarded bones in its fluff to appear more intimidating. If someone tries to remove them, POKENAME becomes noticeably agitated.

entry: 为了吓走闯墓园者，它先面向墓碑，等人靠近，才露出骨脸与发光巨口。它只吸死者的血。
author: bobosmith01
source: To scare away graveyard trespassers, it turns its body towards a gravestone, and only reveals its bone-like face and shining maw when the trespassers draw near. It only sucks blood of the deceased.

entry: POKENAME的真脸藏在头骨状面具后。面具一被取下，就会尖啸，连身陷强烈暴风雪的对象也听得见。
author: bobosmith01
source: The skull-shaped mask hides POKENAME's true face. If the mask is ever removed, POKENAME lets out an ear-piercing shriek that even those caught in a powerful blizzard would hear.

entry: POKENAME深夜游走冰冷雪地，黑暗与雪中只见红色独眼。据说，一盯上人，就会吸走灵魂，留下冻僵的空壳。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stalks frigid, snowy areas in the dead of night, only its singular red eye visible in the darkness and snow. It is said that once it has its sights on a person, it will drain their soul and leave behind a frozen husk.

entry: POKENAME只在深夜现身，无声俯冲毫无戒心的旅人。近到几米内，就尖声厉叫，以恐惧为食，再次消失。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are only ever seen in the dead of night, swooping down silently on unsuspecting travellers. They give a bone-chilling shriek when they're within just a few meters, feasting on their target's fear before disappearing again.

entry: POKENAME最大的叶，偶尔因健康或营养原因变得漆黑。由于外表，许多古代文化认为，这是下一位看见者一周内将死的征兆。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's largest leaf will occasionally turn jet black for a variety of health or nutritional reasons. Due to its appearance, many ancient cultures believed this to be a sign that the next person to see it would perish within a week.

entry: POKENAME会向恐惧自身终将死亡的人现身。舞蹈似乎传达令人心寒的信息：趁活着好好生活，死亡终究无法避免。
author: hophoppip
source: It appears to humans who are having frightful thoughts about their own mortality. The dances POKENAME performs seem to convey a chilling message: Live life while it lasts, for death is inevitable.

entry: POKENAME似乎只在葬礼出现，平静起舞，帮助亡魂前往来世。但作过恶的灵魂，它不肯帮助。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME seem to only appear at funerals, peacefully dancing to help take the deceased soul to the afterlife. However, it will refuse to help any souls that have committed bad deeds.

entry: POKENAME吃被丢物品残留的情感。夜里擅闯废弃垃圾场的人，最后看见的，往往是空面具内的发光眼睛。
author: vracken
source: POKENAME feeds on the lingering emotions attached to things thrown away. The glowing eyes within its hollow mask are often the last sight seen by those who trespass in abandoned landfills at night.

entry: 受威胁时，它发出刺耳的童声般尖叫，能把人吓得无法动弹。诡异声音常被误认为幽灵哭声。
author: .izik
source: When threatened, it emits a piercing, childlike scream that can paralyze people with fear. This unsettling sound is often mistaken for a ghostly cry.

entry: POKENAME身体释放浓厚黑粉，气味腐臭。长时间接触，连最强壮的个体也可能心脏骤停。
author: .izik
source: The thick black powder POKENAME releases from its body smells of rot and decay. Prolonged exposure can cause cardiac arrest in even the strongest of individuals.

entry: POKENAME阴森的尖叫，数英里外也听得见。配上尾部假眼可怕的红光，能将潜在猎物吓得定在原地，再从高处跃下完成狩猎。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's haunting screech can be heard from over several miles away. It freezes potential prey in place with this cry alongside the menacing scarlet glare from the false eye on its tail. It then leaps from above to finish the hunt.

entry: POKENAME日落就开始活动。它无目的地漂荡，奏出阴森旋律，因此闻名。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME become active once the sun sets. It is known for the haunting melody it makes as it drifts about aimlessly.

entry: 中世纪，人们把POKENAME视为疫病使者，吸过周身黑烟的人，几天内便会死去。后来研究却发现，那烟是在缓缓吸走生命力。
author: mistymagius
source: In medieval times, POKENAME was seen as a bringer of disease, as anyone who has inhaled the dark smoke that surrounds it dies within a few days. However, studies show that the smoke slowly drains the life force of its victims.

entry: POKENAME夜里飘过墓园，被失落与悔恨的气息吸引。它寻找悼念者，请对方闻头上花，一闻便涌起层层怀旧之情。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME drift through graveyards at night, drawn to the scent of loss and regret. They seek out mourners and offer them a sniff of the flower atop their heads, waves of nostalgia rushing through whoever takes a smell.

entry: POKENAME似乎主要住在有沉船历史的海域。据说，它用满刺触手缠裹猎物，再从体内抽走灵魂。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME seems to primarily inhabit ocean areas with a history of shipwrecks. It is said to ensnare and cover its prey with its spike-covered tentacles and drain the soul from their body.

entry: POKENAME喷出的孢子，会引发极度瘙痒与刺激。传闻，野生个体是怀恨的派拉斯亡魂。
author: bobosmith01
source: The spores POKENAME ejects cause extreme itchiness and irritation. Wild POKENAME are rumored to be the ghosts of vengeful Paras.

entry: 这些宝可梦不邪恶，只爱捣蛋，会隐形吓唬没防备的人。嚎声像惊恐哭喊，踪迹难寻，收服后却极亲昵忠诚。
author: keiracm35_
source: These Pokémon aren't evil, just mischievous, and they turn invisible to spook unwary humans. Their howls sound like cries of terror. They're quite elusive, but once caught, they're very affectionate and loyal.

entry: POKENAME以受害者恐惧滋养，穷追不舍，直到猎物被恐惧彻底吞噬。它也善战，轻松挥动强镰。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME thrives on the fear of its victims and will relentlessly pursue its prey until they are consumed by fear. It is adept in combat, wielding its powerful scythe with ease.

entry: 背上的壳由实心骨构成。内部许多红眼若同盯目标，诡异景象可能将对方吓昏。
author: .jerden
source: The shell on its back is made of solid bone. If the many red eyes within focus their gaze on a single target, the unsettling sight may make the target faint with fright.

entry: POKENAME在夜里漂行，黑触须拖在身后。据说，它穿裂隙来自无星世界；骨泛微光，独眼则随故乡异维度的能量脉动。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME drifts through the night with its dark tendrils trailing behind it, said to have slipped through a rift from a world without stars. Its bones glow faintly, while its single red eye pulses with energy from the strange dimension it calls home.

entry: POKENAME的独特眼睛，能看穿任何活体物质，连粗树等完全不透光的也一样。因此，能更有效地躲藏狩猎。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's unique eye allows it to see through any living material, even if they are completely opaque, such as a thick tree. This allows it to hide and hunt more effectively.

entry: 它嚼骨吞下，在腹中点燃。POKENAME吃骨后发出的第一道火花，只有神秘水滴才能熄灭。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It munches on bones and ignites them in its belly. The first Ember POKENAME fires after eating a bone can only be extinguished by Mystic Water.

entry: POKENAME阴森嚎叫，口中涌出鬼火。骨头指向谁，火就蜂拥而去。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its ghastly howl pours Will-o-Wisps from its mouth. They swarm at whoever POKENAME points its bone at.

entry: 它用始终握在右爪的燃烧骨头攻击。火若熄灭，POKENAME就把骨头插进胸腔，再次点燃。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It attacks using the flaming bone it always holds in its right paw. If the flame dies, POKENAME reignites the bone by plunging it into its chest cavity.

entry: 据说，POKENAME引导难获安宁的灵魂。夜里，它持灯照路，往返养老院、医院与墓园。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME are said to be guides for souls struggling to find peace. They are seen at night moving back and forth from retirement homes and hospitals to cemeteries, illuminating their path with their lantern.

entry: POKENAME迅速探舌，让镰刀伸到远处。每次进城，灾难便接踵而至；但隐秘身法，让许多人从未看见它到来。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME flicks out its tongue so that its Kama can reach long distances. Each time POKENAME enters a town, a disaster follows, but many people never see POKENAME arrive due to its stealth.

entry: POKENAME飘过墓室，身后跟着烂南瓜般的气味，久久不散。诡异香气能把盗墓者与闯入者，挡在神圣葬地外。
author: .izik
source: A rotting pumpkin-like scent follows POKENAME as it floats through crypts, lingering in the air long after it passes. This unsettling aroma keeps grave robbers and trespassers away from sacred burial sites.

entry: 它在墓园树上筑巢，夜里常停在新坟墓碑上。究竟想保护还是捕食新逝者，仍有争论。
author: .izik
source: It nests in trees within graveyards, often resting on the tombstones of fresh graves at night. It is debated if it seeks to protect or prey on those that have recently departed.

entry: POKENAME喜欢深夜惹麻烦，潜近倒霉旅人，恐吓、攻击，甚至扒窃。一只只是烦人，常见的结帮成群，却会成为附近社会的真正威胁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME loves to cause problems in the dead of night, frightening, attacking and even pickpocketing hapless travelers it sneaks up on. Alone it is a nuisance, but it is common for gangs to form and become a true menace to nearby societies.

entry: 据说，POKENAME的尾焰能烧尽败在它手下的对手的灵魂。人们注意到，野外交战后，胜者的尾焰会变大，败者的则会缩小。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tail-flame is said to be able to burn away the souls of those it bests in battle. It has been noted that when rivals battle in the wild, the victor's tail flame increases in size while the loser's decreases.

entry: POKENAME漂过深海，靠麻痹“凝视”制服猎物。奇怪的是，它看不见，眼窝直通胃。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME floats through the ocean depths, relying on its paralyzing 'stare' to immobilize prey. Strangely enough, POKENAME is blind; the eye sockets lead directly to its stomach.

entry: POKENAME夜里从废墓园地下现身，穿梭坟墓，吓唬路人。周身笼着追悼往昔的气息，没立刻逃走的对象，常被悲伤淹没。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME emerge from the ground at night in abandoned graveyards, moving between grave sites and scaring any passers-by. They are surrounded by a feeling of mourning for what was; those not immediately scared away often are overcome by melancholy.

entry: POKENAME会在夜里的墓园飘荡，似乎随机穿梭坟墓。凝视哪颗头的眼，就会陷入悔恨、消沉或悲恸中的一种。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME drift through graveyards at night, diving in and out of graves seemingly at random. Looking into their eyes causes a person to be struck by one of three emotions, depending on which head they look at: regret, depression, or grief.

entry: POKENAME能穿过任何表面，猎物无论去哪，它都慢慢跟踪。若林中传来诡异嘶声，很可能正被它盯着。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME can phase through any surface, slowly stalking their prey no matter where they go. Hearing eerie hisses from the woods means that one of these Pokémon is most likely watching.

entry: 据说伙伴宝可梦离去后，POKENAME便会探访训练家，顽皮地逗对方振作。
author: fenragon
source: It is said POKENAME will visit a Trainer after their partner Pokémon has departed. It will playfully try to cheer the Trainer up.

entry: POKENAME深夜现身，寻找仍醒着的对象。一找到，就张大嘴，以诡异催眠螺旋使受害者睡去，留下难受的梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME appear late at night, searching for those who are awake late. They open their mouths wide when they find someone, an eerie, hypnotic spiral lulling their victim to sleep and leaving them with unpleasant dreams.

entry: POKENAME防御极弱，却十分坚定。战斗中不断瞬间移动，躲个不停，直到对手疲惫或烦躁，放弃为止。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has incredibly weak defenses, but a lot of determination. In battle, it constantly teleports to endlessly dodge until its opponent gives up out of exhaustion or frustration.

entry: POKENAME叛逆易怒，生气就会留下一路黑油，怒到一定程度便点燃。据说，油火连灵魂也能烧。
author: actliux
source: Rebellious and short-tempered, POKENAME create trails of dark oil whenever they are angered, and ignite it when their anger has reached a certain point. The fire that burns from this oil is said to even burn souls.

entry: POKENAME在溪河底与海滩搜寻骨头，用来啃咬或搭窝。幸运发现它的海盗，会喂骨，换取引往沉没宝藏。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME scour the bottoms of brooks, rivers, and beaches in search of bones to gnaw on or make shelter with. Lucky pirates who discovered a POKENAME would feed it bones in exchange for guiding them to sunken treasures.

entry: POKENAME在最深夜色里穿过枝叶，突然露出鲜明头骨般的脸，吓住目标。猎物僵在恐惧中，就被整个吞下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's hunting strategy is to phase through foliage in the darkest of night, startling its target with its stark skull-like visage. With its prey frozen in fear from the display, POKENAME swallows it whole.

entry: 骨骼坚硬如石，外衣却没有实体，让POKENAME转瞬之间就能消失。
author: chorb33
source: Its bones are as hard as stone. Its coat, on the other hand, is immaterial and allows POKENAME to disappear in a fraction of a second.

entry: 死去宝可梦的骨骼与巨石结合，诞生了POKENAME。它很少活动，藏在岩缝或洞穴中。
author: chorb33
source: Bones of deceased Pokémon combined with boulders to create POKENAME. It is very inactive and hides in crevices or caves.

entry: POKENAME裹着来历不明的阴暗破布。它能把骨骼缩入其中，喷出尘雾，再消失不见。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is wrapped in gloomy rags whose origin is unknown. It can withdraw its bones inside and emit dust before disappearing.

entry: POKENAME身侧骨头会发出微弱磁力与奇异灵气。骨头振动作响时，附近幽灵属性宝可梦便会聚来。
author: sk372
source: The bones on POKENAME's side emit faint levels of magnetism as well as a strange spiritual aura. When the bones vibrate and rattle, other Ghost-Type Pokémon in the vicinity gather around it.

entry: POKENAME日落后出现在城区，移动时留下一阵久久不散的寒意。民间传说称，它引导迷魂前往来世。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME appears in urban areas after sunset and leaves behind a lingering chill as it moves. Folklore says it helps guide lost spirits to the afterlife.

entry: 若天花板滴下深灰污泥，很可能有POKENAME。它能穿墙，因此天花板不漏，也一样会滴。
author: hophoppip
source: If dark gray sludge drips from your ceiling, it's likely a sign of POKENAME. The fusion can pass through walls, so there is no need for the ceiling to be leaky.

entry: 困在夜泥中的迷失亡魂，若始终无法安息，便会怨怒，化作POKENAME。
author: sottiwotti
source: When the lost souls trapped in Dusmer are unable to move on, they become enraged and turn into POKENAME.

entry: 无月之夜，POKENAME会在早已干涸的河床与湖泊现身。它们漂在空中，仿佛仍游过早已消失的水道。
author: katieplaysgames
source: On nights where the moon isn't visible, POKENAME manifest in long dried-up riverbeds and lakes. They can be seen floating through the air as though swimming in the long-gone waterways.

entry: POKENAME骨壳内看似珍贵的红珍珠，其实是不眨的灵体眼。有些人说，贪心想取“珍珠”，反而会被偷走灵魂。
author: occulusmalus
source: What appears to be a precious red pearl within POKENAME's bony shell is actually an unblinking spectral eye. Some say those tempted by greed to take the "pearl" will find their souls stolen instead.

entry: POKENAME巡视墓园，寻找不守规矩的滋事者。据说，盯它眼睛会觉得内心空荡，像被取走了什么。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME patrol graveyards searching for unruly hooligans. It is said that staring into their eyes leaves a person feeling hollow, as though something was taken from them.

entry: POKENAME常在遗迹附近，喜欢吓唬探险者，甚至常令对方心脏病发，丢了性命。
author: sottiwotti
source: They are often found near ruins. POKENAME likes to scare adventurers exploring the ruins, often giving them a fatal heart attack.

entry: POKENAME是淘气幽灵，十分得意于可怕外表。它喜欢在最深的夜里突然现身，疯狂怪笑，吓坏选中的受害者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a mischievous spirit that revels in its frightening appearance. It delights in appearing suddenly in the darkest of night, cackling wildly in order to terrify its chosen victims.

entry: 有人请POKENAME吞食创伤后应激障碍相关的噩梦。许多次日醒来的人，都感到如释重负、休息充足，于是让它成为生活伙伴。
author: quackquackattack
source: For those who suffer from nightmares related to post-traumatic stress disorder, POKENAME are recruited to consume the nightmares. Many who awaken the next day are so relieved and rested that many recruit POKENAME into their lives.

entry: 传说，POKENAME最初在紫苑镇某处现身，寻找鲜肉。当地几种不同鬼故事，都以它为主角。
author: sk372
source: According to legends, POKENAME first appeared somewhere in Lavender Town, seeking fresh meat. Several different ghost stories in the region use POKENAME as their main focus.

entry: POKENAME全身只有骨，科学家不明白为何能动。它不是爬着走，而是诡异地滑过沙地。
author: radiance8990
source: POKENAME's body is made purely of bone, which leaves scientists mystified about how it can move at all. Instead of scuttling, they eerily glide across the sand.

entry: POKENAME背着巨大眼状球茎，能完美看清周围360度，几乎无法偷袭。它先以藤蔓绑住对手，再用毒粉削弱。
author: fiordaliso
source: On its back, POKENAME carries a large ocular bulb that gives it a perfect 360° view of its surroundings, making it nearly impossible to ambush. It uses its vines to bind its opponents, then weakens them with poisonous powders.

entry: POKENAME食欲惊人，无论吃多少也不饱。研究者认为，它把吃下的东西送去了异维度。
author: mcnchsschl_69424
source: POKENAME has an incredible appetite, and no matter how much it eats, it never gets full. Researchers believe it sends what it eats to another dimension.

entry: POKENAME是一颗巨大浮空眼球。没人知道POKENAME的来历，只知它入夜苏醒，四处觅食。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME has the appearance of a giant floating eyeball. No one knows the origins of POKENAME. It awakens in the night to seek prey.

entry: POKENAME举骨威胁入侵者，守护废弃墓园。动作严谨，宛如骑士挥剑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME guards abandoned graveyards by threatening intruders with its bone. It wields it with the discipline of a knight brandishing a sword.

entry: POKENAME周围的烟，由沙、骨粉与布灰混成。古代文明常取作葬礼防腐材料。
author: deadshields
source: The smoke POKENAME surround themselves with is a mix of sand, powdered bone and cloth ashes. Ancient civilisations would often harness this smoke as an embalming ingredient for funerary rites.

entry: POKENAME虽外表如幽灵，壳却硬如岩。即使积聚进化能量时，也能四处漂浮。
author: mcnchsschl_69424
source: Despite its ghostly appearance, POKENAME's shell is as hard as rock. It has been known to levitate around, even as it conserves energy to evolve.

entry: POKENAME看似嘴的地方，其实住着独眼。它从幽暗海中潜近游泳者，一对视就抽取能量。
author: sk372
source: What appears to be POKENAME's mouth is actually where its singular eye resides. It sneaks up on swimmers from the darkness of the ocean, draining their energy the moment they meet its gaze.

entry: POKENAME明明不必在意温度，却仍遵循巴大蝶的迁徙规律。没人知道壳里是什么。
author: mcnchsschl_69424
source: Even though POKENAME has no reason to care about the temperature, it still follows the migratory patterns of Butterfree. Nobody knows what's inside its shell.

entry: POKENAME年纪渐长，绷带般的鳍与胡须变长、褪色。它们比身体其他部位敏感得多。
author: bobosmith01
source: As POKENAME grows older, the bandage-like fins and whiskers grow longer and become more dull in color. They are much more sensitive than other parts of its body.

entry: POKENAME在神秘学网站作祟，默默吃读者的恐惧。若被发现，就让头骨影像挤满屏幕，再消失。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME haunts occult websites, silently feeding on the fear of readers. If detected, it floods the screen with skull-shaped images before vanishing.

entry: POKENAME的身体仿佛只是中空布壳，嘴里装着灵火。因此极轻，虽飞得快，却很容易被风吹跑。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body seems to be made entirely out of hollow cloth, except for the spectral fire in its mouth. This makes it exceptionally light, but while it can fly quickly, it is easily blown around by the wind.

entry: POKENAME空洞的眼在黑暗中泛微光，使对视者不安。它日落后现身，常从近海浓雾里出现。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's hollow eyes glow dimly in the dark, unsettling those who meet its gaze. It appears after sunset, often emerging from dense fog near the sea.

entry: POKENAME会试着陪墓园悼念者玩耍。它读心，判断哪种游戏最能让对方开心。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME will attempt to play with those mourning in graveyards. It reads their minds to determine which game will cheer them up the most.

entry: POKENAME用尾撑高身体，获得更好视野，独眼投出诡异红光。有人说，它的目光直透其他生灵的灵魂。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME raises itself up with its tail to get a better vantage point, casting an eerie red light with its singular eye. Some say a POKENAME's gaze stares right into the soul of other creatures.

entry: 它住在废弃祭祀场所，睡觉时攀着墙与顶。存在本身，让这些被遗忘的空间更添阴森。
author: .izik
source: It makes its home in abandoned places of worship, clinging to ceilings and walls while it sleeps. Its presence adds an eerie aura to these forgotten spaces.

entry: 十月庆典期间，POKENAME会挨家讨糖。桶里一被放入糖，就高兴得放出静电电击。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: During October festivities, POKENAME will go door-to-door to receive candy. Whenever a candy is placed in their bucket, they let out a static shock in pure joy.

entry: POKENAME用头上的手抓枝，悬挂起来。它能光合作用，娇嫩皮肤却易晒伤，因此只在夜里出来，吸收月光。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME uses the hand on its head to grasp tree branches to hang from. It photosynthesizes, but its delicate skin sunburns easily. For that reason, POKENAME only comes out at night to absorb moonlight.

entry: POKENAME以利齿啃墙开小洞，寻找食物。中空的绷带身体能密挤进狭处，哪怕数十只入侵，也很容易被忽略。
author: anonymous_moose
source: Using its sharp fangs, it gnaws small holes through walls in search of food. An infestation of dozens of POKENAME is easily missed, as their hollow, bandage-wrapped bodies can pack densely into cramped spaces.

entry: POKENAME大多无害，可抽动、漂浮的器官，仍让多数人看了害怕。根与藤蔓不停蠕动，寻找月光与黑暗能量来吸收。
author: ozydamians
source: While mostly harmless, the twitching and floating organs of POKENAME frighten most who look upon it. The roots and vines wriggle about searching for moonlight and dark energy to absorb.

entry: POKENAME在夜晚最暗时活跃，大眼照出红光。植物被照到，就会变出独特的黑灰色调。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME becomes most active during the darkest parts of the evening, its large eye casting a reddish glow in the area. Plants exposed to this light turn unique shades of black and gray.

entry: 球体似乎总跟着凝视者。即使两人从不同角度看，都说它正直视自己。POKENAME出水时，连生命都仿佛冷了几分。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The orb always seems to follow anyone that looks at it. Even if two observers are looking at it from different angles, both claim it is staring directly at them. When POKENAME emerges from the water, life seems to grow colder.

entry: POKENAME头脑简单，通常在墓园附近的水边缓慢行走。它以大手造幽灵水球，掷向路人，大多只是无聊。
author: sk372
source: Very simpleminded, POKENAME typically plods around bodies of water located near graveyards. It creates spectral balls of water with its large hands, and lobs them at passersby, mostly out of boredom.

entry: 夜色中，POKENAME身体似乎消失，只余一只悬浮的凶恶红眼。谁想拆开构成身体的绷带，就会遭毒液喷涌。
author: soup1900
source: During the darkness of the night, POKENAME's body seems to disappear except for a single red, floating, menacing eye. Anyone who attempts to pull apart the bandages that form its body is met with a gushing spray of toxins.

entry: POKENAME背上奇异眼状球茎缓缓转动，同时扫视各方。一见威胁，藤蔓便精准挥出，让敌人沾满使其虚弱的粉末。
author: fiordaliso
source: The strange eye-shaped bulb on POKENAME's back rotates slowly, scanning every direction at once. Once it spots a threat, its vines lash out with precision, coating foes in debilitating powders.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，背叶中央的球体纯白；醒着才会泛出标志性的诡异红光。研究者推测，这是用来看的器官。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The orb at the centre of the leaves on the backs of POKENAME is completely white when they are asleep, only taking on their characteristic eerie red glow when the Pokémon are awake. Researchers theorise they use this orb as a means to see.

entry: POKENAME被悲伤气氛吸引，在大量宝可梦安葬处作祟。它躲着悼念者，漂入墙内不让看见，却仍会发出诡异的牙齿咯咯声。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME haunt sites where a lot of Pokémon are buried, drawn to the melancholic mood surrounding these places. They hide from mourners, drifting into walls to keep out of sight; they remain audible with an eerie chattering noise from their teeth.

entry: POKENAME能散开缎带状身体，组成各种字母与形状。若完全包住物品或宝可梦，就能让其消失，不留丝毫痕迹。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME can unravel their ribbon-like bodies to form various letters and shapes. If they completely wrap their bodies around an object or Pokémon, they can make them vanish, not leaving a single trace behind.

entry: POKENAME以红眼光迷住黑暗中的路人。受害者僵立面前时，它显出脱离身体的手，伸去抓住，带入黑暗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME entrances those who pass by it in the dark with the red glow of its eye. Its victims stand motionless before it as it manifests disembodied hands that reach out to grab and carry them off into the darkness.

entry: 挥拳时，它的手会硬化成钢铁般的物质，打出猛烈重击。暂时变形，能增强战斗本领。
author: .izik
source: When it punches, its hands harden to a steel-like substance, delivering devastating blows. This temporary transformation enhances its combat prowess.

entry: POKENAME从高处俯冲，舔毫无戒心的路人，抽取生命力。中招的人类，可能就感冒着走回家。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME swoops down from high places to lick unsuspecting passersby. It drains its target's vitality by doing this, so affected humans may end up walking home with a cold.

entry: POKENAME发怒时，壳缝会腾起灰色灵火。行动虽慢，脱体的手却能伸得很远，抓敌人拉近烧灼。
author: sk372
source: Ghostly gray flames flare from the cracks in POKENAME's shell when it is angry. Though it has low mobility, its disembodied hands can reach out quite a distance to grab foes and drag them closer to be burned.

entry: 据说，POKENAME胸前紧抱影子邮件，无声飘过各维度。收到的人醒来，常会知道从未被告知的事情。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is said to drift silently between dimensions, clutching Shadow Mail against its chest. Those who receive it often wake up knowing things they were never told.

entry: 谁喂过POKENAME，它就跟着谁，直到对方去世。但让别人来喂，就能避免。
author: .realthree
source: If one feeds a POKENAME, the POKENAME will follow that person's steps until their death. However, this can be averted by having someone else feed the POKENAME.

entry: 幽灵身体让它沿地面滚动时，也能稍稍浮起。诡异动作，使它即使快速移动，也仿佛毫无重量。
author: .izik
source: Its ghostly body allows it to float slightly as it rolls down landscapes. This eerie motion makes it appear weightless even during rapid movement.

entry: 夜里电脑若没关，POKENAME很可能待在附近。因为它吃显示器的光，也喜欢一次盯屏数小时。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever a PC is left on during the night, POKENAME are likely to linger nearby. This is because they feed off of the light from the monitor and enjoy staring at the screen for hours at a time.

entry: POKENAME挑战力量与专长各异的对手，提升自身。据说，获胜后会以眼吸走部分对手生命力，强化身体。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fights to improve itself by taking on opponents with a variety of strengths and specialties. It's said that after it wins, it sucks up some of its opponent's life source with its eye to strengthen its own body.

entry: POKENAME身边看似漂着蛋，其实是一团灵火。它全身中空，因此人们相信，球体是重要的身体部分。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME appears to be accompanied by a floating egg, this is actually a ball of spectral fire. Since POKENAME is completely hollow, it is believed that this orb is a vital part of its body.

entry: POKENAME不停搜遍各地，寻找值得挑战、足以击败自己的敌人。一旦落败，灵魂便消散于虚无，空壳成为岩石属性宝可梦的筑巢材料。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME endlessly scours every region to find an opponent worthy to challenge and defeat it. When it has been bested by such a foe, POKENAME's spirit fades into the void, with the husk becoming nesting material for Rock-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME住在船舶坟场，在厚船壳内筑巢，红眼光仍能到达水面。光帮船避开险水，让水手相信，它引航海亡魂前往来世。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is found in ship graveyards, nesting inside thick hulls where the glow of its red eye still reaches the surface. The glow helps ships avoid hazardous waters, leading sailors to believe POKENAME guides seafaring spirits to the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME召出浮手，开心靠近人类与宝可梦，想给拥抱。但常被误认成其他幽灵属性宝可梦，虽大多无害，仍遭躲避。
author: gileme__
source: POKENAME summon floating hands and happily approach people and other Pokémon to give them hugs. Due to being mistaken for other Ghost-types, POKENAME tend to be avoided despite being mostly harmless.

entry: POKENAME召出浮手，开心靠近人类与宝可梦，想给拥抱。但常被误认成其他幽灵属性宝可梦，虽大多无害，仍遭躲避。
author: gileme__
source: POKENAME summon floating hands and happily approach people and other Pokémon to give them hugs. Due to being mistaken for other Ghost-types, POKENAME tend to be avoided despite being mostly harmless.

entry: 它的手独立活动，能抓住超过30英尺外的物品。这份距离优势，让它既善于潜行，也擅长精准攻击。
author: .izik
source: Its hands move independently, capable of gripping objects from over 30 feet away. This range makes it a master of both stealth and precision attacks.

entry: POKENAME极难寻、爱独处，只在月夜现身。眼睛吸收苍白月光，维持生存。
author: bluenido.
source: Extremely elusive and solitary, POKENAME emerges only on moonlit nights. Its eye absorbs the pale rays of the moon to sustain itself.

entry: POKENAME爱玩，总想给训练家各种谜题互动。题目都很简单，但训练家解开时，它仍总惊讶佩服。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are playful Pokémon, always wanting to engage with their Trainers by giving them various puzzles. These puzzles are always very easy, but POKENAME is always shocked and amazed when their Trainer solves it..

entry: POKENAME隐居，真身至今不明。谁勇敢到想凑近窥探内部，都会被阴森目光吓得僵住。
author: badtothebow
source: POKENAME is reclusive, and its true form is unknown to this day. Any brave enough to try to get close enough to peer within it find themselves frozen in terror from its haunting glare.

entry: POKENAME抓力极强，能轻松抱摔、压制敌人。它没有典型生物结构，通常能毫无顾忌地施展巨力。吸收能量后，火焰会变紫。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME possesses an extremely powerful grip that allows it to suplex and pin foes with ease. It does not possess a typical biological structure, so it can usually use its profuse power with impunity. When it consumes energy, its flames grow purple.

entry: POKENAME向林中迷路者现身，把人引到自己家里，让对方在那里送命。
author: mercury_sc
source: POKENAME appears to people who have become lost in the woods. It will guide them to its home, where they meet their doom.

entry: POKENAME结合超能力与幽灵力量，造出浮手帮忙。通常用来抓住、惩罚胡闹恶作剧的幽灵属性宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: Using psychic and ghostly powers, POKENAME can create floating hands to help in its endeavors. It typically uses these to grab and punish unruly Ghost types that are misbehaving and pranking others.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，从肘部伸出奇异灵体能量构成的刀刃。据说，能把对手一直切到灵魂深处。
author: sk372
source: When in combat, POKENAME extends blades from its elbows comprised of a strange spectral energy. It's said that these blades will cut an opponent down to their very soul.

entry: 人们相信，108个最邪恶的灵魂汇成一体，形成POKENAME。还有许多人说，它吞食无辜者灵魂维生。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is believed to consist of 108 of some of the most evil spirits gathered together as one. Many also say it sustains itself by consuming the souls of the innocent.

entry: 都市传说称，POKENAME体内是没有时间的虚空，古兽到新猎物，一被困就永远留下。它自认与其他幽灵属性宝可梦为敌，常找对方决斗。
author: bobosmith01
source: Urban legends state that inside of POKENAME is a timeless void, where anything caught inside remains in perpetuity, from ancient beasts to recent prey. POKENAME has a self-declared rivalry with other Ghost-types, and often seeks out duels with them.

entry: POKENAME自负残酷，没有明显能被认定为脑的器官。身体看似覆着绷带，其实坚如石头。
author: bobosmith01
source: Prideful and cruel, POKENAME lacks an organ that can be obviously defined as a brain. Its body is covered in what appears to be bandages; these bandages are actually as solid as stone.

entry: POKENAME察觉地震将至，就站在人口密集处，散发不安气息。诡异存在会使人本能远离，减少灾难伤亡。
author: .izik
source: When sensing an impending earthquake, POKENAME stands in populated areas and radiates an unsettling aura. This eerie presence instinctively drives people away, minimizing casualties from the disaster.

entry: POKENAME被称为“亡灵守望者”。人们相信，它能看见宇宙万物的开始与结束，却从来看不见中间。
author: hero.drawing
source: POKENAME are known as "The Undead Watchers". They're believed to see the beginning and the end of everything in the universe, but never what is in between.

entry: POKENAME从身体各处伸出红色灵体能量，化作极锋利的刃与爪。传闻，能一直切到敌人灵魂。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME extends a red spectral energy from parts of its body. These blades and talons are incredibly sharp, and rumored to be able to slice through to an opponent's soul.

entry: POKENAME初看吓人，坚硬外表下却认真体贴。它会引人去古墓，向逝者献供。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME may seem intimidating at first, but underneath its tough exterior is a serious yet caring Pokémon. It guides people to ancient tombs to give offerings to the dead.

entry: POKENAME以手势与眼神招引，催眠目标。随后，对方便甘愿将自己刺在刀刃上。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME hypnotizes its victims by beckoning with its hand and eye. They then willingly skewer themselves on its blade.

entry: POKENAME以手势与眼神招引，催眠目标。随后，对方便甘愿将自己刺在刀刃上。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME hypnotizes its victims by beckoning with its hand and eye. They then willingly skewer themselves on its blade.

entry: POKENAME的眼极敏感，容易受伤，因此常闭着。手会漂离身体，抓住潜在威胁，把敌人扔开，保护眼睛。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's eye is known to be very sensitive, usually closed due to harm often coming to it. Their hands help protect their eye, floating away from their body to grab possible harm and chuck foes out of their way.

entry: POKENAME最大的齿轮周围，笼着幽灵雾。谁试图阻断齿轮运转，烟雾就会活过来，抓住袭击者扔到一旁。
author: sk372
source: A ghostly mist surrounds the largest gear making up POKENAME's form. Attempts to disrupt this gear's movement result in the smog coming to life, gripping the assailant and tossing them aside.

entry: 缠身的绷带能独立活动，像触手般挥出抓敌。这让它成为强劲的斗士。
author: .izik
source: The bandages wrapping its body move independently, lashing out like tentacles to grab enemies. This ability makes it a formidable combatant.

entry: 有人认为，POKENAME是报复人类破坏自然的恶灵。据说，脱体双手会抓住受害者，强行埋入地下。
author: sk372
source: There are some that believe POKENAME is a malevolent spirit taking revenge for humanity's damaging of nature. Supposedly its disembodied hands will grab victims and forcibly bury them underground.

entry: POKENAME是穷追不舍的强敌，力量惊人，据说连灵魂也逃不开钳制。一抓住敌人，很快就会从胸炮释放巨量能量，解决对方。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are relentless foes with devastating strength that is said to keep spirits from escaping their clutches. When they grab hold of a foe, they will soon release immense energy from their chest cannons to finish them.

entry: 传说POKENAME偶尔会吸干人的生命，那些人便再不见踪影。有人担心它再次现身，因而惶恐不安。
author: dodoowner_
source: Legends say POKENAME has rarely sucked the life out of humans, who are never seen again. Some people think it'll come out again, causing terror.

entry: 任何花枯萎，POKENAME都会怪附近居民，把死花留在门前。传闻，只有献上鲜花束，才能避开诅咒。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME blames nearby residents for any flowers that wither, leaving the dead flowers at their doorsteps. Rumors say that the only way to ward off a curse is to offer POKENAME a fresh bouquet.

entry: POKENAME虽能附身电子设备，操纵期间却会让设备失去所有实用功能，连自己也无法利用。因此，很少使用这项能力。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although POKENAME can possess electronic devices, the device will lack any useful functionality while being puppeteered by POKENAME, even from POKENAME itself. As a result, POKENAME rarely uses this ability.

entry: POKENAME蛰伏古墓，眼窝看似空着。盗墓者若撞见，独眼就会出现、泛红光，试图把人拖进空眼窝。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME resides in ancient crypts, lying dormant with its eye socket seemingly empty. If a graverobber should stumble upon it, however, its singular eye will appear, glowing red as it attempts to drag the thief into the hollow socket.

entry: POKENAME慢吞吞、冷漠地走过遗迹，却能从体表纹饰与眼睛释放极其强大的黑暗魔法。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME walks slowly and apathetically through ruins. However, it can emit incredibly powerful dark magic via the marks on its body and its eye.

entry: POKENAME慢吞吞、冷漠地走过遗迹，却能从体表纹饰与眼睛释放极其强大的黑暗魔法。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME walks slowly and apathetically through ruins. However, it can emit incredibly powerful dark magic via the marks on its body and its eye.

entry: POKENAME慢吞吞、冷漠地走过遗迹，却能从体表纹饰与眼睛释放极其强大的黑暗魔法。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME walks slowly and apathetically through ruins. However, it can emit incredibly powerful dark magic via the marks on its body and its eye.

entry: POKENAME深夜漂游，寻找迷路人类与宝可梦。它们内心恶毒，把目标越引越远，直到找到僻静处攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME drift through the depths of night in search of lost people and Pokémon. They have malice deep in their hearts, leading those they find further and further from safety until they find somewhere secluded to attack them.

entry: POKENAME周围红光有异常诱惑力，引人类与宝可梦想靠近。谁靠得太近，它就挥尾施咒，再消失于夜色。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The red glow surrounding POKENAME is unnaturally alluring, drawing people and Pokémon alike to try and get close to them. Should something get too close, POKENAME lash their tails and lay a curse upon their victim before disappearing into the night.

entry: POKENAME念力强大，将影子具现为第二层身体。它接连打出暗影拳，直到对手服输。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have potent telekinetic abilities that they used to manifest their shadows as a second layer of their own bodies. They barrage opponents with Shadow Punches until they submit.

entry: POKENAME反复从屋顶与高台跃下，试图聚够幽灵能量，浮空飞走。但常常失败，落穿地面，因为身体太无形，实体也挡不住。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME leaps off rooftops and ledges repeatedly, trying to muster enough ghostly energy to levitate and fly away. When it fails to do so, as it often does, it falls through the ground, too incorporeal to be properly stopped by solid material.

entry: POKENAME有时用来驱动鬼屋的简单机关。维护很困难，清洁维修都只能闭眼进行。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME are sometimes used to power simple mechanisms in haunted houses. Maintenance is difficult, as they can only be cleaned or repaired with eyes closed.

entry: POKENAME的独手，以机械方式精准操纵，精确得难以置信。它曾短暂被推广作假肢，但试用者因那只大眼感到不安，多数几天内就选择再次截肢。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME's single hand is manipulated mechanically with unbelievable precision. Though it was briefly marketed for use as a prosthetic, test users found the large eye rather unsettling, and most elected to re-amputate within days.

entry: 人们相信，POKENAME中空气球般的身体里燃着灵火，提供浮力，却从未亲眼见过。它在凉爽潮湿的夜里最活跃。
author: anonymous_moose
source: It is believed that POKENAME's buoyancy comes from a spectral flame burning inside its hollow, balloon-like body, although this flame has never been directly observed. It is most active on cool, humid nights.

entry: 缠满绷带的身体看似中空，却灌满黑暗魔法。POKENAME能从腹部的骷髅，将魔法释放出来。
author: chorb33
source: Its bandaged body appears hollow, but it is imbued with a dark magic that POKENAME can emit via the skull on its stomach.

entry: POKENAME格外合群，常与同类待在一起，通常四只一组。有人相信，每只都有一个人类灵魂，一组便成一家。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is unusually social and often sticks together with its own species, typically in groups of four. Some believe each POKENAME holds a human spirit; together, the group becomes a family.

entry: 它内部全空。恐怖故事常写，窥视POKENAME疑似头部的空眼窝，就会被夺走灵魂。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is completely hollow inside. It is a recurring idea in horror fiction that looking into the empty sockets of what is thought to be POKENAME's head will result in having your soul taken.

entry: POKENAME夜里穿过广阔平原与森林，寻找枯萎植物。找到死株，只盯一阵，就去找下一株。行为原因至今不明。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME travels across vast plains and forests during the night to find wilted flora. Once it finds a dead plant, POKENAME merely stares at it for a while before moving on to the next plant. The reason for this behavior is not yet understood.

entry: POKENAME优雅起舞，放出精神力波动，迷住、分散凝视太久者的注意。受害者一放松，它就抢劫，把携带的每件贵重物品都吸进体内。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME dances gracefully, releasing psychic waves that enchant and distract anyone who gazes upon it for too long. The moment its victim has let their guard down, POKENAME robs them, absorbing every valuable item they carried into its body.

entry: POKENAME的身体由尘土、墓土与灵魂构成。肚里能听见奇异、阴森的声音。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's body is made from dust, grave dirt, and souls. Strange, haunting sounds can be heard emitting from its belly.

entry: 古老神话称，POKENAME是遭渔人捕杀的巨牙鲨化成的怨灵，永远寻找杀死自己的渔夫。
author: lyrebird.rainwing
source: An ancient myth states that POKENAME are the vengeful spirits of fished-up Sharpedo, forever searching for the fishermen that killed them.

entry: POKENAME以灰烬云团为翼。它没有实在的身体，只能通过双翼接触其他对象。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have wings made out of clouds of ash. They lack a solid, corporeal body and can only interact with others through their wings.

entry: 手臂独立于身体活动，以巨压抓物。据说，力量能轻松压碎皮卡车。
author: .izik
source: Its arms move independently from its body, gripping objects with immense pressure. It is said to be strong enough to crush a pickup truck with ease.

entry: 大群POKENAME在寒冷沙漠之夜，始终追着同一猎物，想吞食灵魂。据说，受害者若在群体面前不支倒下，就会变成同类，加入其中。
author: bobosmith01
source: A large group of POKENAME stalks one singular prey throughout the cold desert night to devour their soul. It is said that succumbing and collapsing in the presence of this group will result in the victim turning into a POKENAME and joining the group.

entry: POKENAME背上蘑菇产生的孢子，带着灵体热量燃烧。吸入后，诅咒能量会引发危险高烧，仿佛受害者全身着火。
author: vic1312
source: The spores that the mushrooms on the back of POKENAME produce burn with a spectral heat. The cursed energy of these spores causes dangerous fevers in those who inhale them, as if the victim is burning up.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME孢子产量增为四倍，巢边地面覆满灰粉。吸入会强烈恶心、高烧，使入侵者远离。
author: .izik
source: During nighttime hours, POKENAME's spore production quadruples, covering the ground around its nest in grey powder. Inhaling this powder can cause intense nausea and fevers, keeping intruders well away from its home.

entry: 它的大眼也是核心，充满阴森灵体能量。即使只盯一目标，仍知其他对象动向。攻击时，把灵力放成破坏性的能量冲击与光束。
author: infinex21
source: Its large eye is also its core, brimming with a sinister, spectral energy. Even as the eye focuses on one target, it remains aware of any other targets. It attacks by releasing its spectral energy as destructive blasts and beams.

entry: POKENAME在暗中跟踪猎物，眼泛不祥红光。距离够近，就以剃刀般的附肢迅速劈砍，瞬间斩倒受害者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's eye glows an ominous red while it stalks its prey through the darkness. Once close enough, it swiftly slashes with its razor-sharp appendages, cutting down its victim in an instant.

entry: 据说，谁想偷POKENAME的晶体，就会受百年诅咒。它收割迷魂时，晶体便亮成血红。
author: mistymagius
source: It is said that anyone who tries to steal POKENAME's crystals will be inflicted with a century-long curse. These crystals glow blood-red when POKENAME is reaping lost souls.

entry: 曾有传闻说，POKENAME背上的蘑菇能杀死任何胆敢触碰者。其实只会让受害者昏倒几分钟。
author: turcai_87271
source: There were rumours that the mushroom on POKENAME's back could kill anyone who dared to touch it. In reality, though, it just makes the victim faint for a few minutes.

entry: 它以弯杖把幽火引入躯干的洞。内部燃烧的灵光，才是真身。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It guides wisps into the hole in its torso using its crook. The burning spectral light within is its true body.

entry: POKENAME能隐形，悄悄靠近敌人。潜行与隐身本领，让训练家常难找到。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME is able to turn invisible so that it can sneak up on foes. Trainers often struggle to find POKENAME due to their stealth and invisibility.

entry: POKENAME在墓园上方慢慢绕圈漂浮，发出诡异回音，使人脊背发冷。有人相信，那是早被遗忘的灵魂低语。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drifts in slow circles above cemeteries, emitting eerie, echoing sounds that chill the spine. Some believe these noises are the whispers of spirits long forgotten.

entry: POKENAME累了会停在墓碑上，吸月光补能。力量恢复时，背上长出灵体绷带，缓缓缠绕身体。
author: .izik
source: When exhausted, POKENAME rests atop gravestones, absorbing moonlight to replenish its energy. As it regains its strength, spectral bandages sprout from its back, slowly wrapping around its body.

entry: 进化后，POKENAME原本柔软的身体，开始硬成干燥坚韧的壳。可惜，壳容易裂，必须不断修补包扎。
author: ohok3441
source: Upon evolution, POKENAME's once-soft bodies begin to harden into a dry, tough shell. Unfortunately, these shells crack easily and require constant repair and bandaging.

entry: POKENAME在墓园钻地，白天始终藏在地下避阳。夜里出来，红眼在黑暗里发光，留意任何擅闯者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME burrow through graveyards, remaining underground throughout the day to avoid the sunlight. They emerge at night, their eerie red eyes glowing in the dark as they watch for any trespassers.

entry: POKENAME白天蛰伏，只露红宝石般的硬币。夜里，硬币发光、身体显形。它漂过夜色，寻找遗落的钱，与自身硬币合在一起。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lie dormant during the day, only their ruby-red coin visible. At night, their coin glows as their body becomes visible. They drift through the night in search of any dropped coinage, combining it with their own coin.

entry: POKENAME白天蛰伏，只露红宝石般的硬币。夜里，硬币张成发光红眼，身体也显形。眼光照路，漂向贵重物品，据为己有。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lie dormant during the day, only their ruby-red coin visible. At night, their coin opens into a glowing red eye as their body becomes visible. They drift toward items of value to claim them as their own, their glowing eye lighting the way.

entry: POKENAME白天蛰伏，只露红宝石般的硬币。夜里，硬币张成发光红眼，身体也显形。眼光照路，漂向贵重物品，据为己有。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lie dormant during the day, only their ruby-red coin visible. At night, their coin opens into a glowing red eye as their body becomes visible. They drift toward items of value to claim them as their own, their glowing eye lighting the way.

entry: POKENAME夜里巡视河岸。靠近POKENAME的人，却常莫名昏迷，被冲到下游才让人发现。
author: thekrt
source: POKENAME are found patrolling the banks of rivers at night. Those who have approached POKENAME are mysteriously found unconsious, washed up downriver.

entry: POKENAME白天躲藏。夜里用阴森火光引来其他野生宝可梦，只凭目光催眠，再捕食。
author: zekkenbytheden
source: POKENAME remain hidden during daytime. Once night falls they use the sinister glow from their flames to attract other wild Pokémon, which they prey upon after hypnotizing them with nothing but their gaze.

entry: 夜里，能看见POKENAME在湖水深处游动，身体中央的巨眼在黑暗中转动，搜寻猎物。那只眼睛发出诡异的红光，使它们游过的湖水也亮了起来。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be seen swimming deep within lakes at night, the gigantic eye at their centre roving around in the dark in search of prey. Their eye shines with an eerie red light, causing the lakes they swim in to glow at night.

entry: POKENAME以眼察觉人的饮食品味与兴趣，为疲惫旅人提供庇护、片刻安适。若谁否定他人的喜好，它就聚起能量，将其驱逐。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME uses its eye to detect a person's taste, in both food and their interests, granting weary travelers shelter and a glimpse of their comforts. If someone invalidates another person's taste, POKENAME will collect its energy to banish them away.

entry: POKENAME一看见谁，就会盯住，缓慢而坚定地跟上。曾受其害的人说，连噩梦里，它也在一直注视。
author: chorb33
source: As soon as POKENAME sees someone, it stares at them and follows them slowly but purposefully. Past victims report nightmares in which it watched them.

entry: POKENAME的巨眼与猩红火焰，在黑夜都十分明亮。迷信说，若发现它正盯着自己，就是厄运将至。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's giant eye glows brightly in the dark of night, as does its crimson flames. Superstitions say that if you catch one staring at you, it is a sign of impending doom.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME游走于沙漠干河谷，巡过枯干的旧河道，仿佛在找水。雨季一开始，它们就消失，直到河水停止流动，才会再现。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be seen moving through desert wadis at night, prowling through the dried-out remains of the riverways as though in search of water. They disappear at the start of the rainy season and are not seen again until the water stops flowing.

entry: POKENAME巡视古墓，布下赭色丝，拖慢闯入者。丝还会在盗墓者衣上留气味，吸引虫类宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME patrol ancient tombs spreading their umber silk to slow down trespassers. The silk also leaves a scent on the clothes of grave robbers that attracts insect Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME滑稽贪玩，不太聪明。它莫名依恋阿柏怪，哪怕被嫌烦，也一直跟着。忠诚到即使阿柏怪虐待它，也不肯离开。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME are goofy and playful, though they aren't very smart. They have a strange attachment to Arbok and will follow them around, even when the Arbok finds them annoying. They are so loyal, they won't leave the Arbok, even if it mistreats them.

entry: POKENAME吸收已故嘎啦嘎啦与卡拉卡拉的灵魂，灌入骨棒攻击。每吸一个灵魂，就更怨恨凶残，直到完全被仇恨吞噬。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME absorbs spirits of fallen Marowak and Cubone into itself, channelling them into its bone club strikes. With every spirit absorbed, it becomes more bitter and vicious until it is completely consumed with hate.

entry: 据说，POKENAME能通过手中头骨杖，与死去的嘎啦嘎啦灵魂交流。灵魂赐予力量，增强它对付其他对象的幽灵能力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to communicate with the spirits of deceased Marowak through the skull staff it holds. Supposedly the spirits grant it strength and bolster the ghostly powers it wields against others.

entry: 据说，POKENAME与不安的灵魂打拳，击昏后便带走。它确实常朝空气挥拳，举着第二双臂保护脸。
author: .jerden
