source: It is said that POKENAME boxes against restless spirits,  carrying them off after a knockout blow. POKENAME does spend a lot of its time punching the air, holding its second set of arms up to protect its face.

entry: POKENAME的茧内有空处，能把绿毛虫护在体内。谁打扰小家伙，它就从壳中放出骇人灵气，保护它们。
author: sk372
source: A hollow spot in POKENAME's cocoon lets it protect Caterpie within itself. If anything tries to disturb the little ones, POKENAME unleashes a ghastly aura from its shell to defend them.

entry: POKENAME轻松操纵七团黑暗鬼火，用来攻击，或逼其他对象凝视火焰，施加催眠。它们常被称为冥界女王。
author: deadshields
source: POKENAME command their seven dark will-o'-wisps effortlessly, launching them for attacks or placing others under hypnosis by forcing them to gaze into the flames. They are often called Queens of the Underworld.

entry: POKENAME住在废弃城堡，纠缠任何敢进领地的对象。古手稿描述，骑士因它的歌声不断在脑内回响，彻底发疯。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME reside in abandoned castles, haunting those who dare try to enter their domain. Old manuscripts describe knights going completely mad due to POKENAME's singing constantly playing in their minds.

entry: POKENAME极其记仇，召来周身灵火，烧灼扰睡者，以此取乐。传说，火焰能净化前往来世的亡魂。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an extremely vengeful being that takes pleasure in scorching anyone who disturbs its slumber by summoning ghostly flames around itself. According to legend, its fire purifies the souls of the dead as they pass to the afterlife.

entry: 这种宝可梦从不发声。每次击中敌人，就能收集灵能，施展强咒。接近败北时，虚空般漆黑的身体会升起暗雾。
author: fireblade141
source: This Pokémon never makes a single sound. Every strike against a foe allows it to gather spirit energy, which it then uses to cast powerful spells. When it is near defeat, a dark smog will start rising from its void-black body.

entry: 这种宝可梦从不发声。每次击中敌人，就能收集灵能，施展强咒。接近败北时，虚空般漆黑的身体会升起暗雾。
author: fireblade141
source: This Pokémon never makes a single sound. Every strike against a foe allows it to gather spirit energy, which it then uses to cast powerful spells. When it is near defeat, a dark smog will start rising from its void-black body.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME为黑夜魔灵与更强的黑夜魔灵融合体当密探，专找必须被带往灵界的灵魂。它们吃很少，就能维生。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is thought that POKENAME act as spies for Dusknoir and stronger Dusknoir fusions; specifically, they are on the lookout for those whose soul must be taken to the spirit world. They do not need to eat much to sustain themselves.

entry: POKENAME记仇，会追猎亏待过自己的对象，拖入水下，据说还带往灵界。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is vengeful and will hunt down those that have wronged it, dragging them underwater and, supposedly, into the spirit world.

entry: POKENAME受威胁，尾上黄线便会发光。此时若与眼对视，据说可能被影响心智。
author: camtft
source: The yellow line on POKENAME's tail begins to glow when they feel threatened. If their eye catches your glance while their tail glows, it is said they may influence your mind.

entry: POKENAME以头上金触角，感知其他生灵的生命力，作为预警。潜在危险接近，就会让身体无形。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can sense the life force of other living beings through the golden antennae on its head. It uses this sensitivity as an early warning system, making themselves intangible when potential danger approaches.

entry: 野生POKENAME似乎专门狩猎从化石复活的宝可梦。原因未知，但有人相信，它想让它们再度灭绝。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME seem to specifically hunt for Pokémon that have been reanimated from fossils. While the reason for this is unknown, some believe that POKENAME are trying to bring them all back into extinction.

entry: 极圈地区流传：太阳落下、极夜将至之际，能见POKENAME引领亡魂。环境虽极端，仍年年有人来，想一睹身影。
author: jacknerik
source: A common tale above the polar circle says that right as the sun sets to usher in the polar night, POKENAME can be seen leading the spirits of those who have passed. Despite the extreme conditions, many people come annually to try and catch a glimpse.

entry: POKENAME能用超能力，凝聚出额外的两只手，擒住对手。被这些手抓得太久，生命力便会逐渐流失，开始感到疲倦。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Using its psychic abilities, POKENAME can manifest two extra hands to grapple its opponent. If the opponent is held by these hands for too long, they will begin to feel tired as their life is being sapped away.

entry: 头上的天线，能收到各种精神信号，远处也不例外。有时，科学家甚至无法追溯信号来源。
author: imaginita
source: The antenna on its head picks up all kinds of psychic signals, even at great range. Sometimes it picks up signals that scientists cannot trace.

entry: POKENAME外表诡异，性情却尽责。它用天线与灵魂交流，对伤害森林家园的对象，爆发幽灵般的愤怒。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: Despite its eerie appearance, it has a rather dutiful nature. POKENAME can communicate to spirits with its antennae, unleashing ghostly wrath onto those who hurt its forest home.

entry: 有人见POKENAME朝看似空无一物的地方，疯狂啄击。许多人推测，它在与误入领地的迷魂战斗。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME has been observed furiously pecking at seemingly empty air. Many theorize that they are battling lost spirits who have unintentionally wandered into their territory.

entry: POKENAME身上球体散发幽灵微光，把猎物引入水下洞深处。等与猎物独处，它便出击，整个吞下。
author: mepp.
source: The orb on POKENAME's body emits a dim, ghostly glow that lures prey deep into underwater caverns. Once isolated with its prey, it strikes and devours its prey whole.

entry: 野生POKENAME晚间四处游走，将死植物埋入土中。若白天醒着，就会情绪剧烈波动。
author: bobosmith01
source: Wild POKENAME are found prowling during the evening, burying dead plants into the soil. They experience intense mood swings if awake during the day.

entry: 据说，POKENAME住在幽暗潟湖，体表黑膜会让周围水色变黑。传统上，这水用来染黑物品。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Dark lagoons are said to be home to POKENAME, as they are covered in a black film that darkens the water around them. This water was traditionally used for dyeing things black.

entry: 它执行迷魂的遗愿，目的诡异而坚定，仿佛听着独有的声音。完成任务后，便安静飘走，不作解释。
author: jaminmcready
source: This Pokémon carries out the bequest of lost souls, acting with eerie purpose as if guided by voices only it can hear. When its task is fulfilled, it quietly drifts away without explanation.

entry: POKENAME展示巨大爪子，威吓其他宝可梦。有人认为，腹部的嘴会吞食猎物的灵魂。
author: pepperthepirate
source: POKENAME shows off its massive claws to intimidate other Pokémon. Some believe it uses the mouth on its stomach to consume the souls of its prey.

entry: 深夜，POKENAME将手放在墓碑上，静静沉思。此时，覆身的黏液开始沸腾。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME places its hands on gravestones and sits in quiet contemplation late at night. During this time the goo covering its body begins to boil.

entry: POKENAME住在旧电脑，移除系统里的冗余软件，改善性能。作为交换，它会随机放响声、闪出恐怖影像吓用户，纯为取乐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found in old PCs, where it removes bloatware from the system to improve performance. In exchange, POKENAME scares users with a random jump scare by playing a loud sound and flashing a scary image, solely for amusement.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴产生的发光液体，绘出精巧画作，指引夜间迷魂。作品阴森的美感，在网上吸引了大批追随者。
author: comfortablybrum
source: POKENAME uses the glowing fluid produced by its tail to create elaborate paintings intended to guide lost souls in the night. These art pieces have gained a substantial following online for their haunting beauty.

entry: POKENAME以天线为支点旋转，吸引、联络灵魂。转得越快，来的越多。等跟随的灵魂够多，它便步行，引往来世。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME spins on its antenna in order to attract and contact spirits. The faster this Pokémon spins, the more spirits are attracted to it. When enough spirits are following, POKENAME will walk and guide them to the afterlife.

entry: 据说，它游走世界，寻找迷魂分享蛋。看似阴郁，超能力者与灵媒却说，它一到，亡者总会开心。
author: .jerden
source: It is said to roam the world searching for lost spirits to share its egg with. Although it looks dour, psychics and mediums claim that its arrival always cheers up the dead.

entry: POKENAME奉灵界灵魂之命，疯狂破坏，取走沿途所有对象的灵魂。它用腹口吞下毁坏的地形，在灵界建造家园。
author: soup1900
source: At the bidding of spirits in the spirit world, POKENAME goes on destructive rampages and takes the spirits of anyone in its path. It uses the mouth on its belly to swallow the terrain it destroys to construct its home in the spirit world.

entry: POKENAME掀起的风，强到能把人类与宝可梦的灵魂吹出。因此，它们在灵界只负责运魂，让灵魂像搭公交一样，乘在体内。
author: soup1900
source: Blasts of wind from a POKENAME are powerful enough to blow the souls out of people and Pokémon. Therefore, they serve solely as transport for souls in the spirit world, letting them ride inside their bodies like buses.

entry: 握住POKENAME尾巴，嘴里就会回响咯咯笑声，仿佛来自四面八方。外表虽吓人，它却只在想找玩伴时，才会靠近训练家。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Holding a POKENAME's tail will cause the mouth to echo with giggles that seem to come from all directions. Despite their threatening appearance, POKENAME only approach Trainers when seeking companions to play with.

entry: POKENAME发出奇异磁力，影响附近所有电子设备。设备呈现诡异声像，许多人相信来自来世。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME emits a strange magnetic force that affects all electronics in its vicinity. Strange and eerie visuals and sounds appear on the devices, believed by many to be from the afterlife itself.

entry: POKENAME能从掌心孔洞射出奇异幽灵能量，给命中者带来种种怪异影响。有人说，掌心也能吸走其他生灵的魂。
author: sk372
source: Strange ghostly energy can be fired from the holes in POKENAME's palms which cause a variety of strange effects on those struck. Some say it can suck the soul of others into its palms as well.

entry: 夜过峡谷，若觉得被看着，可能有野生POKENAME跟踪。它们是耐心猎手，试图连猎物的灵魂与身体一起吞食。
author: thesilverowls
source: When passing through canyons at night, a feeling of being watched might be from a stalking wild POKENAME. They are patient hunters, as they attempt to feast on both the spirit and body of their prey.

entry: 古石板记载，POKENAME曾被视为迷失者的守护者。上面奇怪刻痕却像电脑代码，至今仍令历史学家困惑。
author: .izik
source: Ancient tablets have documented POKENAME being regarded as a guardian of the lost. The odd etchings on these tablets resemble computer code, baffling historians to this day.

entry: 尾上天线会提醒它，有灵魂闯进领地。训练家应避免让POKENAME靠近其他幽灵宝可梦，因为它常与对方起冲突。
author: badtothebow
source: The antenna on its tail warns it of spirits invading its territory. Trainers are warned against keeping POKENAME near other Ghost Pokémon as it is often confrontational with them.

entry: 它狡黠、热爱生命，对未来有长远眼光。黑夜魔灵已占据森林蜥蜴的灵巧身体，常沉思自身模样，为达目标也愿冒着受伤的危险。
author: bobosmith01
source: A cunning Pokémon with a passion for life and a long-term outlook on the future. Dusknoir has overtaken Grovyle's limber body; it is often seen contemplating its own appearance. It is willing to put itself in harm's way to achieve its goals.

entry: 它狡黠、热爱生命，对未来有长远眼光。黑夜魔灵已占据森林蜥蜴的灵巧身体，常沉思自身模样，为达目标也愿冒着受伤的危险。
author: bobosmith01
source: A cunning Pokémon with a passion for life and a long-term outlook on the future. Dusknoir has overtaken Grovyle's limber body; it is often seen contemplating its own appearance. It is willing to put itself in harm's way to achieve its goals.

entry: POKENAME住在地下深处相连的洞穴，很少见阳光。它怕矿帽的灯，因此远离矿工。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live deep below the surface in interconnected burrows and rarely see sunlight. They keep their distance from miners because they are scared of the light from hardhats.

entry: 据说，POKENAME负责在灵界与现世，尽可能长久地引导、保护亡魂。天线能察觉任何仍留现世的游魂。
author: cinnamoncreampuff
source: POKENAME is said to be responsible for guiding and protecting the souls of the dead for as long as it can in both the spirit and living worlds. Its antenna can detect any wandering souls that are left in the living world.

entry: 据说，POKENAME负责带其他生灵前往来世，却受荣誉约束，要给目标一场公平的灵魂之战。若败，就优雅退去，再不打扰。
author: sk372
source: It is said that POKENAME is tasked with bringing others to the afterlife, but feels honor-bound to give its targets a fair fight for their soul. If defeated, it bows out with grace, never to bother its foe again.

entry: POKENAME夜巡墓园，寻找盗墓者。一遇上，便挥动臂刃，以老练骑士的本领攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME patrols graveyards at night in search of grave robbers. Should it encounter one, it attacks with the prowess of an accomplished knight using the blades on its arms.

entry: POKENAME用头顶天线，追随来源不明的微弱无线电，再以更强功率转发。四颗超级电脑般的大脑加密信息，科学家至今无法解读广播。
author: anonymous_moose
source: With the antenna atop its head, POKENAME follows faint radio waves of unknown origin, retransmitting them at a higher power. Scientists have yet to decipher any of its broadcasts, as it encrypts the messages with its four supercomputer-like brains.

entry: 神奥民间故事说，POKENAME游荡墓园，找恶魂吃，因为它看似在嚼墓碑。其实并不吃魂，只是清理石头。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Sinnohan folk stories describe POKENAME lurking through graveyards to find malignant souls to devour. These tales come from the fact that POKENAME seems to chew on headstones. However, it does not consume souls, but rather keeps stones clean.

entry: 神奥民间故事说，POKENAME游荡墓园，找恶魂吃，因为它看似在嚼墓碑。其实并不吃魂，只是清理石头。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Sinnohan folk stories describe POKENAME lurking through graveyards to find malignant souls to devour. These tales come from the fact that POKENAME seems to chew on headstones. However, it does not consume souls, but rather keeps stones clean.

entry: POKENAME气度高傲，从不大惊小怪。红眼一闪，就已选中狩猎目标，虽然它根本不需进食维生。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME carries an air of superiority and never makes a fuss. When POKENAME's red eye gleams, it has chosen a target to hunt, despite not needing to eat to sustain itself.

entry: 野生POKENAME常住闹鬼之地，试图武力统治附近灵魂。谁挑战统治，就会引发破坏性的狂乱。
author: n3cr0_
source: Wild POKENAME often dwell in haunted locations, where they try to rule over the spirits in the area by force. If their reign is challenged, they will go into a destructive frenzy.

entry: 据说，POKENAME的新月状头发，让它能与灵界交流。有人说，它脑中萦绕着天灾遇难者的低语。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's crescent hair is said to let it communicate with the spirit world. Some say its mind is haunted by the whispers of those who lost their lives to natural disasters.

entry: 凝视POKENAME锐利红眼，会怕得无法动弹。恐怖故事说，猎物被定住后，它的上半身就会脱离，把魂吸入自身。
author: sk372
source: Staring into POKENAME's glaring red eye can paralyze a victim with fear. Horror stories say that once its prey is immobilized, POKENAME's upper body detaches and sucks the frozen target's soul into its being.

entry: 某些传说称，POKENAME是从冥界升起的灵体战士。它们能穿越黑暗本身，以胸核射出的暗影球与强力暗影拳，接连轰击敌人。
author: infinex21
source: Some legends claim that POKENAME are spectral warriors that arose from the underworld itself. These Pokémon can run through darkness itself as they barrage their foes with Shadow Balls fired from the cores on their chests and powerful Shadow Punches.

entry: 野生POKENAME常在墓园附近，除背壳外都埋地下。挖掘时，会仔细避开坟墓，不加打扰。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME are usually found near cemeteries, buried underground except for the shell on their back. While digging, they carefully avoid disturbing any of the graves.

entry: 据说，它听从亡者的吩咐，斩杀曾伤害亡者的人，再将其径直送往灵界最黑暗的角落。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: It's said to do the bidding of the dead, slaying those who have wronged them and delivering them straight to the darkest corner of the spirit world.

entry: POKENAME的缎带能感知附近死亡，精准定位最远100英尺内，已故人类与宝可梦的位置。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's ribbon grants it the ability to sense death in its surroundings. It can pinpoint the exact location of deceased humans and Pokémon up to 100 feet away.

entry: POKENAME极少在夜间从天降下。飞过大地时，身上众眼发光，许多人相信，它在寻找注定毁灭的灵魂，吸收后带往来世。
author: sk372
source: On the rare nights POKENAME descends from the skies, the many eyes on its body glow as it flies across the land. Many believe it is searching for doomed souls to absorb and take to the afterlife.

entry: POKENAME用巨躯与灵界联系，保护训练家免遭恶灵。虽然忠诚，要开始动起来，却得花点时间。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME use their large bodies and connections with the spirit world to protect their Trainers from malevolent spirits. While loyal, this Pokémon does take some time to get themselves moving.

entry: POKENAME以自身灵力结合黑暗能量，挥出一把镰刀。许多人说，不必切开肉身，就能直接伤魂。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME wields a scythe made of its own spectral powers combined with dark energies. This scythe is said by many to have the power to harm the very soul without needing to cut the physical form.

entry: POKENAME夜里尽责照料荒废墓园。据说，身上鲜艳花朵，靠亡者残留的情绪滋养。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are found dutifully tending to neglected graveyards at night. The bright flowers on its body are said to be nourished by lingering emotions of those who have passed on.

entry: POKENAME伸手向前跳，引导灵魂安息。尾巴产生的黑孢子让活物睡去，保护正在飘过的灵魂。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME hop forward with their hands outstretched, reaching out to guide souls to rest. The black spores POKENAME produce from their tails put the living to sleep to protect the souls as they drift on.

entry: POKENAME能汇聚亡者怨念，转成幽灵力量。闹鬼地点常能见它，吸取当地负面能量。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME has the ability to gather the grudges of the dead and convert them into ghostly power. It is often spotted at haunted sites absorbing the negative energies of the area.

entry: POKENAME连远处无线电信号也能捕获，附身电子设备时，能清楚传出相同频率。但在没有信号能到的地方，它却会发出古怪的非人呻吟。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is able to pick up on even distant radio signals and clearly output their frequencies when possessing electronic devices. However, in places where no radio signal will reach, odd and inhuman groaning will be heard coming from POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME分节身体的每一部分，都能咬住对手。战斗时迅疾扭转翻滚，撕碎掌握中的一切。
author: leshii
source: Each part of POKENAME's segmented body can bite down on a rival. In battle, it twists and rolls at dizzying speeds, shredding everything in its grasp.

entry: POKENAME用头顶天线发出无线电波，与附近所有幽灵属性宝可梦交流，向它们发号施令。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME emits radio waves via the antenna on its head, allowing it to communicate with all Ghost Pokémon in the vicinity and give them commands.

entry: 流传的迷信说，若POKENAME停在墓上，就是在吃有罪的灵魂，惩罚死者。其实，它只喜欢待在墓旁。
author: thegreenscorpion
source: A popular superstition states that if a POKENAME is spotted on a grave, it is punishing the one who passed away by feeding on its sinful soul. In truth, POKENAME just likes hanging around gravesites.

entry: POKENAME猎捕其他幽灵属性宝可梦，把对方吸向手上的嘴，狠狠咬下。人们偶尔会用它，试着清除鬼屋里的幽灵。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME hunts other Ghost-type Pokémon, sucking them towards the mouths on its hands to sink its teeth in. It has occasionally been used in attempts to clear haunted houses of ghosts.

entry: POKENAME张着巨口游海，吃浮游生物与其他微生物。格外饿时，也拿腐尸与死珊瑚当点心。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME swims through the ocean while keeping its gaping mouth open, consuming plankton and other microorganisms. If it gets especially hungry, it snacks on carcasses and dead coral.

entry: POKENAME的花苞吸星光、月光获取养分。遥远过去，人们深信头上绽放的黑瓣花，会偷走近处灵魂。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's bud gains nutrients by absorbing starlight and moonlight. In the distant past, people were convinced the black-petaled flower that blooms on its head would steal the souls of those nearby.

entry: POKENAME负责接引宝可梦亡魂，尤其那些远离冥界入口、尚未安息的灵魂。亡魂意志越强，就需要越多POKENAME，才运得动。
author: arcul
source: POKENAME are tasked with transporting Pokémon's spirits to the beyond, specifically those that rest far from underworld entry-points. The stronger the Pokémon's force of will, the more POKENAME needed to transport it.

entry: POKENAME吃墓园里留给亲人的花。进食受扰，就朝入侵者吐蓝毒，再逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME eats flowers left behind for loved ones in graveyards. If disturbed while feeding, it spits a blue poison at the intruder before fleeing.

entry: 有研究指出，POKENAME身体中央漂浮的器官，其实不是眼；它似乎有完整360度视野。这个爱恶作剧的家伙，在冬季栖地会向路人扔雪球。
author: bobosmith01
source: Some studies have suggested that the floating organ in the middle of POKENAME's body is not actually POKENAME's eye; POKENAME appears to have complete 360 degree vision. A prankster, it throws snowballs at passerby in its wintry habitat.

entry: 据说，POKENAME与灵界深相契合。只需几个优雅舞步，就能把灵火召入手中。观众坚称，能听见火中传来已故亲人的声音。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to be deeply in tune with the spirit world. With just a few graceful motions of dance, it summons ethereal flames into its hands. Viewers swear to hear the voices of departed loved ones from within these flames.

entry: POKENAME黄昏现身，远远静跟过往船只。有人相信，它预示船员即将遭遇悲剧。
author: mepp.
source: Appearing at dusk, POKENAME quietly follows passing ships from a distance. Some believe its presence signifies a tragedy that will soon befall the crew.

entry: POKENAME身体由不同墓园的墓碑与岩石组成。目击者说，能听见不同声音从它身上传来；科学家不确定，是本身叫声，还是体内灵魂。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's body is made up of headstones and rocks from different graveyards. Witnesses report that the sound of different voices can be heard coming from this Pokémon, but scientists are unsure if this is POKENAME's voice or the spirits within it.

entry: 吞食目标前，POKENAME先把受害者带回家，塞满棉与绒。吃掉灵魂后，剩下的身体便变成孩子爱玩的毛绒玩具。
author: soup1900
source: Before gorging on a target, POKENAME first carries the victim away to its home before filling them with lots of cotton and fluff. After consuming their soul, the leftover bodies transform into stuffed toys that children like to play with.

entry: POKENAME完全无声地游荡，冰身藏于暗雾。许多人相信，发光的眼，是迷路旅人最后看见的东西。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME wanders in complete silence, its icy body hidden by dark mist. Many believe its glowing eye is the last thing lost travelers ever see.

entry: POKENAME巨菇上的纹样，暗中发光，形似诡脸。大多数目击者都会被吓退，其实它本身颇温顺。
author: sk372
source: Markings on POKENAME's huge mushroom glow in the dark and resemble an eerie face. This frightens off most who see it, though POKENAME itself is actually rather docile.

entry: POKENAME夜里从海中现身，到陆地寻找幽灵属性猎物。它将目标吸入巨口，吸收生命力，直到什么也不剩。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME emerge from the seas at night to prowl the land in search of Ghost-type prey, which they will inhale into their gigantic maw in order to absorb their life force until nothing remains.

entry: 它能自由召唤、吞食幽火。据说，被火击中，会清楚看见自己何时、如何死去。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It can freely summon and devour wisps. It is said that being hit by these wisps will show you exactly how and when you die.

entry: POKENAME以怀恨者散发的能量为食，从高空给目标罩下阴影，使其永久陷在黑暗。受害者却常因此敞开心胸，让它只好另觅目标。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME feeds off the energy emanating from those that harbour hatred. From high above, it casts a shadow over its target, leaving them in permanent darkness. Those it afflicts often open their heart, leaving POKENAME to find a new victim.

entry: POKENAME在周围漂着几团幽火自卫。袭击者一碰，就被宇宙边缘的景象晃花眼，让它迅速逃走。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME floats several ghostly wisps around itself for self defence. Upon contact with one of these wisps, any aggressor will be dazzled by images of the edge of the universe, allowing POKENAME to make a swift escape.

entry: POKENAME夜里守着河岸，行动慢却十分凶猛。被POKENAME袭击的人，通常毫发无伤，却什么都不记得。
author: thekrt
source: POKENAME are slow yet aggressive defenders of river banks at night. Those who POKENAME attack are usually unharmed, yet remember nothing.

entry: POKENAME能感知来自灵界的电波。它穿行于墓地，走过之处，彷徨的灵魂也随之离去。
author: captainzscourge
source: POKENAME is able to sense radio waves from the spirit realm. It it seen moving through graveyards, and as it passes, it takes the spirits with it.

entry: POKENAME的诡火，淡水浇不灭，盐水一碰却迅速消失。它常猎捕灯火幽灵与水晶灯火灵，因此有人猜，它也吃灵魂。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's eerie flames cannot be doused by fresh water, but they quickly disappear when touched by salt water. It regularly hunts Lampent and Chandelure, so some people speculate that it, too, is a soul-eating Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME智力极高，据说能前往灵界。双手间漂浮的红心乱动，有人认为，不受本体意志支配。
author: beandrawsthings
source: POKENAME is a highly intelligent Pokémon said to be able to travel to the world of spirits. The red heart floating between its hands moves erratically, which some think moves independently of the POKENAME's will.

entry: POKENAME绷紧肌肉，身上纹样就会亮起不祥光。有人说，它吃战败者的灵魂，维持体格。
author: sk372
source: The markings on POKENAME's body glow ominously whenever it flexes its muscular body. Some say it keeps itself in shape by consuming the souls of those it bests in battle.

entry: POKENAME披着灵火，据说触感既冰冷又灼热。蹄子重踩时，也常被说成仿佛连灵魂都痛。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are clad in spectral flames said to be both chilling and hot to the touch. Their stomping hooves are often said to feel as if they hurt the very soul itself.

entry: POKENAME诡异漂过冰冷深水，融入黑暗。据说，若发现深处溺亡者，会带躯体上岸，魂却留在胃里。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME eerily floats through deep chilling waters, blending into the darkness. If it is said that if it finds the drowned amidst the depths, it will bring their body ashore, but keep their soul within its stomach.

entry: 据说POKENAME注视谁，就是在审判谁的灵魂。平日爱好和平，受威胁时却会变得极其凶猛。
author: elionagashi
source: It's said that when a POKENAME looks at someone, it judges their soul. They usually are pacifistic, but become highly aggressive when threatened.

entry: 因为没有脸，人们反而会盯着摆锤般的眼睛。凡落入其掌控者，之后命运如何，无人知晓。
author: houndrys.
source: Its lack of a face leads people to instead watch its pendulum eye. The fate of any who fall under its control is unknown.

entry: POKENAME近25英尺高，却比空气轻，能浮上超过2000英尺高空。它用球茎喷水，既作巨炮攻击，也控制空中动作。
author: pestobest
source: Despite being almost 25 feet tall, POKENAME is lighter than air, and can float to an altitude of more than 2000 feet. POKENAME uses the water it can shoot out of its bulb as both a massive cannon attack and a way of controlling itself midair.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在海中浮标周围安静漂游，却没耐心被打断闲暇。经过的船或海中生灵，都可能挨上强力爆炸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys placidly floating around buoys in the ocean, but has little patience for having its leisure time interrupted. Ships or sea creatures that float by risk getting hit by a powerful explosive burst.

entry: 许多POKENAME比其他同类温和，却受坏名声牵连。它们常四处漂浮找朋友，大多对象却为免爆炸冲突，赶紧跑开。
author: sk372
source: Many POKENAME have less volatile tempers than others of their kind, but they suffer a bit from their kin's bad reputation. They often float around looking for companions, but most run off to avoid an explosive altercation.

entry: POKENAME凶狠的瞪视，就说明脾气多暴躁。水下哪怕稍受刺激，也会爆出堪比最强深水炸弹的威力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's fierce glare is a testament to how temperamental it is. If agitated even slightly while underwater, it explodes with a force equal to the most powerful of depth charges.

entry: POKENAME常被亲昵地叫作“海上领航车”。巨大体形排开海水，在身后形成涡流，其他水属性宝可梦常借此加速旅行。
author: bradlybro199
source: Often affectionately referred to as the "pace car of the seas," POKENAME's large size and shape displace so much water that it creates gyres in its wake. Other Water-type Pokémon often use these currents to travel more quickly.

entry: POKENAME能鼓起身体，浮上海面。渔夫小心避开，因为一撞上，便能释放10,000伏电力。
author: bottomusmaximus3
source: POKENAME can inflate its body in order to float to the ocean surface. Fishermen take care to avoid this Pokémon, as it can unleash 10,000 volts of electricity on impact.

entry: POKENAME漫步森林，长颈让视野又高又广。若发现缺水处，就从喷水孔洒水，滋养周围植物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME traipses through forests, its elongated neck giving it a massive vantage point. If it spies areas lacking hydration, it sprays water from its spout to nourish the surrounding plant life.

entry: POKENAME出没于有吼鲸王头骨的海底。它们结成小群，住在巨大骨骸中，合力保卫家园与家人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is found at the ocean floor, where the skulls of Wailord lie. Small groups live together within the massive skeletal remains, working together to defend their home and family.

entry: POKENAME在深海踢击训练，会在海上造出巨涡。虽善于战斗，却更爱用腿力游泳，探索深处隐秘洞穴。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it trains by kicking in the ocean depths, it generates enormous whirlpools out at sea. Despite being a skilled fighter, POKENAME prefers using the power of its legs to swim and explore hidden caves in the deep.

entry: POKENAME拳头虽大，缓冲却太厚，打拳造不成多少伤害。它们改为甩拳撞敌，把对方甩远。
author: bigoljax
source: Though POKENAME's fists are large, they have too much cushioning to deal much damage by punching. Instead, they swing them around into their opponents, flinging them away.

entry: POKENAME体形庞大，等身体继续进化时，能抵御大多数有害因素。许多个体还会紧挤成大群，进一步保护。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's sheer girth keeps it safe from most harmful elements while it waits for its body to further evolve. Many will gather together in large, tightly packed groups for further protection.

entry: POKENAME出没于热液喷口附近，吸入喷出的气体。它吃喷口周围的微生物。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are found near hydrothermal vents, sucking in gas that is expelled from them. It feeds on the microorganisms found surrounding the vents.

entry: 赤岩岛附近，当地渔夫常见成群POKENAME。它们会用强化的角，毁掉渔网。
author: .izik
source: Pods of POKENAME are often seen near Red Rock Isle by local fishermen. They destroy fishing nets by using their reinforced horns.

entry: POKENAME旋转背星，便能快速游泳，跃出水后甚至能空中滑翔。离水时，宝石喷出阵阵细水雾，避免干燥。
author: sk372
source: Spinning the star on its back allows POKENAME to swim swiftly through water and even glide through the air after breaching. Above water, its gem releases bursts of fine misty water to keep itself from drying out.

entry: POKENAME低声歌唱，边慢慢绕圈，边用双臂作夸张动作。最低的音，数英里外也听得见。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME sings in a deep voice, making dramatic gestures with its arms as it slowly moves in circles. The lowest notes it produces can be heard from miles away.

entry: POKENAME低声歌唱，边慢慢绕圈，边用双臂作夸张动作。最低的音，数英里外也听得见。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME sings in a deep voice, making dramatic gestures with its arms as it slowly moves in circles. The lowest notes it produces can be heard from miles away.

entry: 水下相机拍到POKENAME在水中疾驰，宛如奔马。强腿能推动身体高速前进。
author: bigoljax
source: Underwater cameras show POKENAME galloping through the water. Their legs are strong enough to propel their bodies at high speeds.

entry: POKENAME体大、浮力强，一次能载许多人。它常成为横越海洋的廉价选择，代替豪华游轮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's large size and buoyant body allows it to ferry large amounts of people at once. It's often used as a budget alternative to luxury cruises across the ocean.

entry: POKENAME背壳像间歇泉，潜水后把吸入的水喷出。身体脂肪够厚，能耐致命寒水。
author: bigoljax
source: The shell on POKENAME's back work like geysers, shooting out the water they take in after diving. Their bodies have enough blubber to handle deadly cold waters.

entry: POKENAME在海滩附近游泳，远远观察训练家与宝可梦。若连上训练家的设备，就吃诈骗与钓鱼邮件，直到收件箱不剩恶意信。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swim around beaches observing Trainers and Pokémon from a distance. If they manage to connect themselves to a Trainer's device, they consume scam and phishing emails until the inbox is clear of malicious emails.

entry: POKENAME太庞大，游泳很费力，因此通常睡着随洋流漂行，节省能量。专家相信，它最长能睡整整一年。
author: fiordaliso
source: Due to its enormous size, swimming requires tremendous effort, so POKENAME usually drifts along ocean currents while asleep to conserve energy. Experts believe POKENAME can sleep for up to an entire year.

entry: POKENAME总在生气，通常向船发泄。鳍肢做不了多少事，就改用尾巴当鞭子。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are always in a state of anger and usually take it out on boats. Due to their flippers being unable to do much, they use their tails as whips.

entry: POKENAME住在极深水域，常难找到。一旦被发现，却喜欢与潜水员玩耍，再游走。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are often hard to find, due to living in incredibly deep waters. When found, they love to play with divers before swimming off.

entry: POKENAME的脖子能伸长许多米，让头部成为有效的打击武器。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can stretch its neck for many meters, allowing it to use its head as an effective striking weapon.

entry: POKENAME颈上的海葵摸着极热。它们会给颈周降温，让鱼宝可梦住进海葵。
author: bigoljax
source: The sea anemone on POKENAME's necks are incredibly hot to the touch. They cool down the area around their necks so fish Pokémon can live in the sea anemone.

entry: POKENAME住在深海，常隐于最暗海沟。头灯亮得足以照明整条水下峡谷。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME resides deep in the ocean, often hidden in the darkest trenches. The lights on its head shine so brightly, they are capable of illuminating entire underwater canyons.

entry: POKENAME嘴边始终有气泡，让它能到陆地行动。还能扩大，包住全身，浮空随风漂。
author: sk372
source: An ever-present bubble around POKENAME's mouth allows it to traverse on land. It can expand the bubble to contain its entire body and float through the air, drifting along with the breeze.

entry: POKENAME在海岸开心弹跳，像超大的沙滩球滚来滚去。它总绊到自己的尾巴，翻滚扑腾，让路过泳客很困惑。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME bounces happily along the shoreline, rolling around like an oversized beach ball. It constantly trips over its own tail, causing it to tumble and flop around, much to the confusion of passing swimmers.

entry: POKENAME与呆波交友，结伴环游世界。呆波累了，它就让对方坐背上，哼舒缓摇篮曲。据说，所有听见的生灵都会心跳放慢，放松下来。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME befriends Slowper and they travel the world together. When Slowper gets tired, POKENAME lets it sit on top of it and hums a soothing lullaby. This sound is said to slow down the heartbeat of everything that hears it, relaxing them.

entry: 人们相信，有POKENAME在，呆呆王与乌波更容易融合。它们结伴旅行，鲜少见到身旁没有呆波的个体；呆波会帮忙航行大海。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Slowking and Wooper are believed to be more likely to fuse when POKENAME is around. They journey together, and it is rare to find a POKENAME without a Slowper by its side, helping it to navigate the high seas.

entry: POKENAME头大，很难保持平衡。游太快，头常撞上船或海床。
author: bigoljax
source: Because of their large heads, POKENAME struggle to keep their balance stable. Their heads often bump into ships and the ocean floor if they swim too quickly.

entry: 这种宝可梦常住森林、丛林的河湖里，在水面下休息。它通过球茎吸水，吃经过的小鱼，再向过路旅人喷出无害泡泡，排掉水。
author: ecstaticwoop64556455
source: This Pokémon can often be found in forests or jungles, resting below the surface of rivers and lakes. It sucks in water through its bulb to eat small fish that go by, then expels the water in a blast of harmless bubbles at any travelers passing by.

entry: POKENAME潜水躲敌，能憋气数小时。两只相遇，就会比赛不呼吸，直到其中一只昏倒。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME hide underwater to escape foes and can hold their breath for hours. If two POKENAME meet, they will compete with each other by not breathing until one of them faints.

entry: POKENAME白天轻盈地浮在海面。船若漂得太近，尖刺就可能穿透船壳。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats buoyantly on the sea's surface during the day. Its sharp spikes can pierce ship hulls if vessels drift too close.

entry: 风雨夜，水手常说看见美人鱼尾。追去查看，往往只找到POKENAME，大失所望。
author: darkweavile428
source: On many a stormy night, sailors claim to have spotted mermaid tails. Attempts to pursue these sightings commonly result in finding a POKENAME much to the sailor's dismay.

entry: POKENAME大多待在海中，偶尔也会在小海湾与沙滩边游荡。
author: neonriser
source: POKENAME spends most of its time in the ocean. They are sometimes seen wandering around coves and beaches.

entry: POKENAME住在造船厂附近，爱逛水手常去的地方，以惊人怪力和爱吃菠菜闻名。
author: hummusishome
source: POKENAME live near shipyards and loiter where sailors usually would. They are known for their wicked strength and their penchant for eating spinach.

entry: POKENAME是为战斗而生的魁梧巨兽，食量大得荒唐，常被养在专为填饱它们而建的牧场。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME are hulking behemoths built for battle. They eat absurd amounts of food and are often raised on ranches purpose-built to sate their appetite.

entry: POKENAME壳内不断向周围水域排出富矿气体。壳上常有小宝可梦群落，搭着迁徙，吃它的排出物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME shells constantly vent mineral-rich gases into the surrounding water. Small communities of Pokémon can often be found on their shells, riding atop migrating POKENAME and feeding on their output.

entry: POKENAME常在岸边休息，留意泳客。危险接近，就用口中炮口喷高压水，赶走捕食者，确保周围安全。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is often found resting on shorelines, keeping a watchful eye over swimmers. When danger approaches, it uses the blaster in its mouth to fire high-pressure jets of water to ward off predators and ensure the safety of those nearby.

entry: POKENAME先潜下数百英尺，再猛然上冲，破水飞进云层。深海渔船与游轮，都被提醒要留意成群的它们。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME dive hundreds of feet into the ocean before launching themselves upwards, blasting through the surface and flying into the clouds. Deep-sea fishing boats and cruises are warned to keep an eye out for pods of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME大群旅行，只在北方海洋活动。深水中，它们用尖细哔声彼此交流。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME travel in large pods only through northern oceans. They communicate with one another deep underwater through high pitched beeps.

entry: POKENAME喷出强劲水流，逆什么激流都轻而易举。越接近进化，凶悍的性情便越显露。
author: rooboid
source: POKENAME breaches any current with ease, propelling itself forth with powerful jets of water. Its aggressive nature begins to show as it draws closer and closer to evolution.

entry: POKENAME一步便能引发地震。但心地仁善，为免伤害破坏，它在世间慢慢移动。
author: quackquackattack
source: A single step from a POKENAME can trigger earthquakes. However, because of its benevolent nature, it moves slowly through the world to avoid causing harm or damage.

entry: POKENAME尾巴发亮，能在夜间水下看清、狩猎。奇怪的是，为船供电时，反而释放最多电力。
author: seanothan_23
source: POKENAME's tail has a luminous glow, allowing it to see and hunt underwater at night. Strangely, POKENAME gives off the most electricity when powering ships.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在珊瑚林摇摆行走，缤纷色彩令它开心。手中小石与贝壳，似乎不是当代之物。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME enjoy waddling around in coral forests, all the vibrant colors bringing them happiness. They hold onto small rocks and shells that don't seem to be from the present era.

entry: POKENAME贪玩，能按节奏跃出水面，深受孩子喜爱。但成群不断拍水、吵闹，打破岸边安宁，常让大人头疼。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is adored by children for its playful nature and its ability to leap from the water in rhythmic patterns. However, schools of these Pokémon often frustrate adults, as their constant splashing and noise disturb the peace along the shores.

entry: POKENAME皮韧而软，几乎能弹开任何攻击，化成轻微擦碰。掌心孔洞还能高压发射水球。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's hide is tough yet soft, bouncing back almost any attack and turning into nothing more than a glancing blow. High-pressure shots of water spheres can be shot out from the holes in its palms.

entry: POKENAME手臂的每根藤蔓，末端都能喷水。它借此制造、操纵水鞭，拍走过于靠近或显得凶暴的对象。
author: sk372
source: Each of the vines that make up POKENAME's arms end with spouts that can shoot out water. It uses these to create and manipulate whips of water to smack away anything that gets too close or aggressive.

entry: POKENAME喷水孔出水时，会掺入电火花。鸟宝可梦若从上方飞过，常会触电。
author: bigoljax
source: When water shoots out of POKENAME's blowhole, an electric spark is added to it. This often causes bird Pokémon to get zapped if they fly over a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME从手中射出的水，热得烫人。险被渔船撞到时，常会喷水报复渔夫，这现象已有充分记录。
author: bigoljax
source: The water POKENAME fires out of their hands are scalding hot. POKENAME often shoot water at fishermen in retaliation for almost being hit by their boats, a phenomenon that has been well documented.

entry: POKENAME在海滩睡觉会蜷成球，常被误认成沙滩球，给游客玩。皮软又结实，被当玩具时，打盹的它几乎察觉不到。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME curls into a ball when it sleeps on the beach, often winding up mistaken for a beach ball and played with by beachgoers. Its hide is soft yet sturdy, so it rarely even notices being used for recreation while it naps.

entry: POKENAME罕见又刚被发现，却成了伪科学爱好者的宠儿，还常被误称为“最早在陆地生活的宝可梦”。
author: leeto64
source: Despite being a rare, recent discovery, it's a favorite in pseudoscience. POKENAME is commonly incorrectly called 'The First Land-Living Pokémon'.

entry: 它们需要大量营养，最大的个体，食量要求达自身体重五倍以上。游泳时很少闭嘴，因为任何吃上一口的机会都不能错过。
author: quackquackattack
source: Their bodies require high nutritional intake, the largest of which require upwards of five times their body weight in food. They rarely close their mouths while swimming because they require every opportunity to catch a bite.

entry: POKENAME平静游过深海，偶尔上浮，感受日光温暖。它让幼崽搭尾，帮助游过水域，直到能独自游泳。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME swim peacefully in the deep seas, occasionally coming up to feel the warmth of the sun. They let their young ride on their tails, helping them through the waters until they can swim on their own.

entry: POKENAME的叫声能传近十五英里。许多水手说，美丽，却响得惊人。
author: bigoljax
source: The call of a POKENAME can be heard for nearly fifteen miles. Many sailors often describe their calls as beautiful, but incredibly loud.

entry: POKENAME在海中固定区域作祟，除非被对手逼走，否则绝不去别处。有水手说，它战斗时低语，也有人说，像苍蝇嗡鸣。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME haunt specific areas of the ocean, never moving anywhere else unless they're forced to by their opponents. Many sailors who've spotted a POKENAME say they murmur during battle, while others say they make sounds similar to buzzing flies.

entry: 这种模样奇特的宝可梦，进化后失去腿，可能受困陆地。因此，有保育行动专门救助搁浅的POKENAME。花还能喷出强劲水柱，排放储水。
author: ecstaticwoop64556455
source: This odd-looking Pokémon loses its legs upon evolving, which may leave it trapped on land. Because of this, there is a Pokémon conservation effort dedicated to saving beached POKENAME. Its flower can expel powerful geysers of stored-up water.

entry: POKENAME虽极庞大，却贪玩温和。不过，有时误把船当大鱼宝可梦，无意咬下一口。
author: bigoljax
source: Despite their incredibly large size, POKENAME are playful and gentle. Though they do accidentally take bites out of boats, assuming they're large fish Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME大多时间躺在海滩。真决定狩猎，就会潜水，以惊人的速度与力量游动。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of its time lounging around on beaches. When it does decide to hunt for prey, it dives into the water to swim with surprising speed and power.

entry: POKENAME是最大的陆地行走宝可梦之一，凡小到能放进嘴的，都整个吞下。力量虽大，速度却不快，最好的防御就是跑赢，盼它改追较慢的目标。
author: .jerden
source: One of the largest Pokémon to walk on land, POKENAME will swallow whole anything small enough to fit in its mouth. While it is strong, it is not particularly fast, so the best defense is to outrun it and hope it chases something slower.

entry: POKENAME从管子喷水，模仿船笛声，引来渔船，偷走渔夫用的饵。
author: bigoljax
source: When POKENAME shoot water out of their pipes, it mimics the sound of a boat horn. They do this to attract fishing boats so they can steal whatever the fishermen are using as lure.

entry: 据说，POKENAME是实际测量过的最大宝可梦之一，身长堪比摩天大楼。但生存耗能太大，寿命很短。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is said to be one of the biggest Pokémon ever physically measured, being as long as a skyscraper. However, POKENAME has a very short lifespan due to how much energy is needed to survive.

entry: POKENAME是宇宙温柔的守护者。据说，它沿途吞食时空异常，维持宇宙结构的稳定。
author: antler_zero_
source: POKENAME is a gentle protector of the universe. It is said to eat corruptions in space and time as it floats along, keeping the fabric of the universe in check.

entry: 飞机若坠海，你可能有幸遇见POKENAME。它会凭能力与巨力，把飞机推到最近的港口。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Should your plane crash in the sea, you might be fortunate to come across a POKENAME. Using its powers and incredible strength, it will push the fallen aircraft to the nearest port.

entry: POKENAME额上的锚，向同类显示地位。锚越大，就越受王族般礼遇。
author: bigoljax
source: The anchors on POKENAME's foreheads show their status to other POKENAME. The larger the anchor is, the more they're treated like royalty.

entry: POKENAME的地磁能力，有时被认为无可匹敌。古代出海者，曾借它导航，穿过浩瀚海洋。
author: cobalt0135
source: The geomagnetic abilities of POKENAME are sometimes thought to be without equal. Ancient people out at sea used them to navigate through vast oceans.

entry: POKENAME重200公斤，一击便能压扁车辆或整群鱼，吞尽其中生命力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Weighing in at 200kg, POKENAME can flatten vehicles or entire schools of fish to consume all their life force in one blow.

entry: POKENAME是强大战士，挥锤如无物。它们常与暴鲤龙、刺龙王展开漫长战斗。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are strong warriors, capable of swinging their hammers around like they weigh nothing. They often start long battles with Gyarados and Kingdra.

entry: POKENAME喷水孔的蒸气能威吓敌人。上岸后，潜水时灌进孔的水会缓缓升温，化成蒸气。
author: bigoljax
source: The steam that comes out of POKENAME's blowholes can be used to intimidate opponents. When on land, the water that has filled POKENAME's blowholes after being submerged slowly heats up, turning into steam.

entry: POKENAME深受渔夫与商人珍视，靠它在水上运重物。坚实身体能承载大量货物，是河湖运输不可或缺的伙伴。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is highly valued by fishermen and traders, who rely on its ability to carry heavy loads across the water. Its sturdy body can support large amounts of cargo, making it an essential companion for transporting goods over rivers and lakes.

entry: POKENAME从触须喷激流，推动身体高速掠过海面。它借此迁徙，寻找成熟海带林取食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME shoots torrents of water from its feelers to propel itself across the ocean's surface at high speeds. It uses this to migrate around the ocean in search of mature kelp beds to consume.

entry: 据说，POKENAME是海洋创造者的后裔，大多待在海底。它对地壳活动极敏感，常在地震前躲进海沟。
author: _refuse_
source: Said to be a descendant of creator of the sea, POKENAME spends most of its time at the bottom of the seabed. POKENAME is highly sensitive to tectonic activity, oftentimes taking shelter inside a trench before earthquake hits.

entry: POKENAME在大陆架海床缓行，巡视辽阔领地，寻找食物。两只相遇，容易争夺地盘，战斗甚至能引发海啸。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lumber across the sea floor on continental shelves, patrolling vast territories in search of food. When two POKENAME meet they are prone to clashing over control of their territory, battles between them capable of triggering tsunamis.

entry: 它们住在灯塔附近，着迷于建筑透出的光。体形虽庞大，却能掩盖常来港口渔船的气味，因此被容许留下。
author: quackquackattack
source: They reside near lighthouses, mesmerized by the light that comes from the building. Despite their large size, they are tolerated in the space because they mask the scent of fishing vessels that frequent their harbors.

entry: 有些POKENAME远大于大多数树，缓缓游走野外，寻找安全休息处。它们放出一碰就炸的花粉球自卫，吸粉者会中毒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are sometimes much larger than most trees and slowly wander through the wild looking for safe places to rest. They protect themselves by releasing balls of pollen that explode on contact and poison those who inhale the powder.

entry: POKENAME像巨大的蓝色飞艇，常出现在随风球群中。传说，它曾侍奉更大的宝可梦，但至今没有证据。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME resembles a giant blue blimp and is often seen among groups of Drifblim. Legends claim it once served an even bigger Pokémon, though no evidence currently supports this theory.

entry: 野生POKENAME用潜灵奇袭，悄悄潜入波下，再在毫无戒心的渔船上现身。被闯入的船常发现，一天渔获竟神秘消失。
author: cobalt0135
source: Wild POKENAME use Phantom Force to dive beneath the waves undetected, then resurface onto unsuspecting fishing vessels. Boats invaded by POKENAME often find their entire day's catch has mysteriously vanished.

entry: 货船从POKENAME上方经过，它们就用尾巴拍船侧。掉进海的货，都会被吃掉，再找不回来。
author: bigoljax
source: When a cargo ship travels above a POKENAME, they use their tails to hit the side of the ship. Any cargo that falls into the sea will be eaten by POKENAME, never to be found again.

entry: 每当整片珊瑚林死去，POKENAME的火焰便会变大。常能见成群个体，静浮在新死的珊瑚林上方。
author: bigoljax
source: The fire that fuels POKENAME's flame grows larger each time a coral forest completely dies out. Groups of POKENAME are often seen quietly floating above recently dead coral forests.

entry: POKENAME住在浅礁，成群游泳保安全。它们伸出背上特殊器官交流，竖起、放下尖刺，彼此警告危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their homes in shallow reefs, swimming in pods for safety. They communicate with one another by extruding special organs along their back, raising and lowering spines to warn one another of danger.

entry: POKENAME住在浅礁，成群游泳保安全。它们靠软刺防护，吸水鼓胀，使自己显得大又难吃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their homes in shallow reefs, swimming in pods for safety. They rely on their soft spines to protect them from harm, puffing them up by breathing in water and making themselves look large and unappetising.

entry: 强烈海啸后，POKENAME现身的目击报告，奇怪地常见。许多人说灾难由它造成，却往往被证明不实。
author: bigoljax
source: Sightings of POKENAME appearing after harsh tsunamis are oddly common. Many claim POKENAME caused these disasters, though these claims are often proven false.

entry: POKENAME砍倒巨树，长途搬运，筑出地图上都能见到的大坝。有人相信，世界最大的一些湖，其实是它很久以前造的人工湖。
author: leandermalurt
source: POKENAME chops down enormous trees, then carries them over large distances to make dams that are large enough to appear on maps. Some believe that the largest lakes in the world are in fact artificial lakes made by POKENAME long ago.

entry: POKENAME常被误认为体色更浓的吼吼鲸。也有人觉得，不过是嘴巴更大一点的吼吼鲸。
author: dodoowner_
source: People mistake POKENAME for a more saturated Wailmer. However, some people consider this to be a Wailmer with a bigger mouth.

entry: POKENAME头极重，陆地上难移动，游泳却出色，连最深海处也能生存。
author: kiwiarms
source: Though it struggles to move on land due to the immense weight of its head, POKENAME is an adept swimmer and can survive in even the deepest depths of the ocean.

entry: 许多渔夫以钓到POKENAME为荣，但体重极大，极难拉起。小身体常骗过新手，等拼命往船上拉，才发现重得惊人。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is a prized catch for many fishermen, but its immense weight makes it incredibly difficult to reel in. Often, its tiny body will deceive unsuspecting rookies, who struggle with the surprising heft as they fight to pull it aboard.

entry: 这些小宝可梦天真离开父母或训练家，找玩伴。若没被捕食，就能见它们试学泡沫光线自卫，像鸟宝可梦学飞一样。
author: ecstaticwoop64556455
source: These little Pokémon often wander off naively from their parents or Trainers, looking for playmates. If not preyed upon, they can be seen trying to learn their Bubble Beam for self defense, much like a bird Pokémon would learn to fly.

entry: POKENAME像一颗颇大的沙滩球，虽体型大，却很轻。它常让人们在海滩把玩，将自己弹向空中。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's appearance is akin to a rather large beach ball. It is quite light despite its size, so it spends its time letting humans play with it at the beach, bouncing it through the air.

entry: POKENAME要上浮呼吸，就卷成球浮起。冲势会把身体送到高空，争取足够时间舒展开。
author: bigoljax
source: Whenever a POKENAME needs to go to the surface and take a breath, they roll into a ball and float up. This launches them high into the air, giving them enough time to unroll.

entry: POKENAME从鳃吹出的不是水，而是蒸气。因此，常看起来像头部刺穿了云。
author: bigoljax
source: Instead of blowing water out of their gills, POKENAME blow steam instead. This often makes it look as if their heads are piercing the clouds.

entry: POKENAME漫无目的般地游海，很少受打扰。可一发现猎物，就会以惊人速度猛冲过去。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME is rarely disturbed as it roams the sea seemingly without aim. However, it will shoot forward at considerable speed if it spots prey.

entry: POKENAME半埋在海床沙中，一动不动等待猎物。目标一出现，便扑出将其整个吞下。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME lives on the seabed, half-buried in the sand, where it lies motionless in wait for prey. If it spots any, it lunges and devours them whole.

entry: 睡不安稳的水手常见POKENAME静静飞过月前。据说，它们奏出的歌低得近乎无声，只有自己的耳朵能听见。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are normally seen by restless sailors, quietly flying past the moon. It is said they play songs low enough to be almost silent, only able to be heard by their ears.

entry: POKENAME缓缓经过，便伴随暴雨。遭旱农夫把它们视为祝福。
author: bigoljax
source: As POKENAME slowly pass by, heavy rainfall comes with it. They're considered a blessing for farmers who are going through droughts.

entry: POKENAME身上黏液摸着很像水。寒冷时硬化，保护柔软身体。
author: darkweavile428
source: The slime that covers POKENAME's body feels very similar to water. Its slime hardens in the cold, giving protection to its squishy body.

entry: POKENAME似乎没意识到自己极大，常想拥抱依偎训练家。但体形差距，让这成为危险习惯。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME doesn't seem to be conscious of its immense size. It often tries to hug and cuddle its Trainer, but the size difference makes this a dangerous habit.

entry: POKENAME定期排出多余气体，大泡浮上海面，暴露位置。需快逃时，它便放个格外大的泡，攀着浮往安全处。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME regularly release excess gas from their body, large bubbles of it floating up to the ocean surface and giving away where they are. If they need a quick escape, POKENAME release an especially large bubble, clinging to it to float to safety.

entry: POKENAME长颈能取得多数海洋宝可梦够不到的食物。很久以前，这曾帮它们避开怪颚龙袭击。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's long necks help them grab food that most sea Pokémon are unable to reach. This helped them long ago to avoid Tyrantrum attacks.

entry: POKENAME普遍遭人厌恶，往往偏藏在不受欢迎的地方。它频频龇牙，仿佛随时准备咬靠得太近的一切。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is commonly despised by humans and tends to lurk in places where it's not wanted. It frequently bares its teeth, as if perpetually ready to snap at anything that comes too close.

entry: POKENAME背上的大泡，能在上岸时保持湿润。饲主偶尔会往泡里放东西装饰，看起来不会造成任何伤害。
author: sk372
source: The large bubble on POKENAME's back helps keep it hydrated when it ventures onto land. Owners of domestic POKENAME occasionally decorate it by placing something within the bubble, which does not appear to harm it in any way.

entry: POKENAME是著名海洋猎手，主要在冷海狩猎。虽能轻松突袭、刺穿猎物，它们通常更爱堂堂正正地战斗。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are renowned hunters of the ocean, though they are prone to hunt mostly in colder seas. Though they are capable of easily skewering prey by catching them off-guard, they typically prefer to have an honest fight instead.

entry: 富矿的水不断从POKENAME身上滴落，洞内因此聚集许多受滋养、健康成长的宝可梦。部分矿物如钟乳石般沉积，使壳硬化，增强防御。
author: banzai.exe
source: Mineral-rich water drips endlessly from POKENAME, so the caves it lives in are well-populated with Pokémon who grow healthy from it. Like a stalactite, some minerals cling to and harden POKENAME's shell, further strengthening its defenses.

entry: POKENAME的身体大半由水组成，能浮在海面。受惊时，POKENAME喷出的巨型水柱，连坦克也能掀翻。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's body is mostly water, allowing for it to float on the surface of the ocean. When startled, POKENAME shoots massive geysers of water powerful enough to topple a tank.

entry: POKENAME下半身模仿烂南瓜的模样。它发出的光，常被水手误认为灯塔信标。
author: bigoljax
source: The lower half of POKENAME's body mimics the look of a rotting pumpkin. The light POKENAME emits is often mistaken for lighthouse beacons by sailors.

entry: POKENAME拳力惊人，轻松就能把船打凹。但大多时间都在打盹，吃偷来的米饼。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's punches pack a ton of power, able to easily put dents in boats. However, they spend most of their time napping and eating rice crackers they've stolen.

entry: POKENAME开心地游在度假情侣旁。若察觉捕食者靠近，就以猛烈的重磅冲撞，无情赶走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims joyfully alongside vacationing couples. If it senses a nearby predator, it ruthlessly drives it off with a devastating Heavy Slam.

entry: POKENAME完美适应海洋与天空，水里空中都能自在呼吸。双翼划破风，滑过海面，高压喷水足以毁坏船壳。
author: ecstaticwoop64556455
source: POKENAME are perfectly adapted to master the seas and the skies. They comfortably breathe water and air, with wings that slice through the winds and glide over the ocean surface. The pressurized blasts of water they shoot can destroy ship hulls.

entry: POKENAME耐力惊人，长途游泳，跟上蚊香泳士也不累。人们认为，成功游遍世界的个体，还会进一步进化。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has incredible stamina: it can swim enormous distances while keeping up with Pokémon such as Poliwrath without feeling tired. It's thought that POKENAME that manage to swim all across the entire world will evolve further.

entry: POKENAME的软骨外壳软得出奇。它从口中喷水，强如高压消防水带，保护自己。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's shell is composed of very soft cartilage, making it surprisingly squishy. To protect itself, POKENAME shoots water from its mouth with the force of a high-pressure fire hose.

entry: POKENAME用喷水，从触手释放强力水柱。威力足以威胁大船。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can fire powerful jets of water from its tentacles using Water Spout. These blasts are strong enough to threaten even large ships.

entry: POKENAME两部分看似永远争斗，其实共生。吼鲸王给毒刺水母供食，后者则以强毒保护宿主。
author: quietcognition
source: Despite looking like they are locked in an endless struggle, POKENAME's two parts are symbiotic. The Wailord provides food for the Tentacruel, which in turn protects its host with powerful venoms.

entry: POKENAME仍在学游泳，水中速度普通。紧张时，体表气泡会迅速充氧，让它赶紧冲上海面逃险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is still learning to swim, so its speed underwater is only moderate. The bubbles on its body fill with oxygen quickly when stressed, allowing it to breach to the surface hastily to escape danger.

entry: POKENAME拍海水，扰乱并捕捉大舌贝。做着做着却常忘记目标，被拍水的乐趣吸引。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME splashes seawater to confuse and catch Shellder. It often forgets its goal mid-task, distracted by the fun of splashing.

entry: POKENAME以尾巴作浮具，漂过海洋。它出神到有时连浮上海面呼吸都忘了。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME drifts through the ocean, using its tail as a flotation device. It spaces off to the point where it may forget to breathe above the water.

entry: POKENAME不从喷水孔喷水，而把水化作毒气吐出。鱼宝可梦从中游过，便会严重中毒。
author: bigoljax
source: Instead of blowing water out of their blowholes, POKENAME spit out the water as a poisonous gas. This causes fish Pokémon to be badly poisoned as they pass through.

entry: POKENAME手里的小饰物像吼吼鲸。缓缓摆动时，还会模仿吼吼鲸叫声。
author: bigoljax
source: The trinkets POKENAME hold are similar in appearance to Wailmer. When the trinket slowly swings, it mimics the sound of a Wailmer's call.

entry: POKENAME力量极大，天性却温柔平和。比起战斗，它更爱借背上大球茎放大能力，让花园或野外的枯萎植物重获新生。
author: fiordaliso
source: Although POKENAME is immensely powerful, it has a gentle and mild nature. Rather than fighting, it prefers to use its powers, amplified by the large bulb on its back, to revive withered plants in gardens or wild habitats, granting them new life.

entry: POKENAME自卫时吐出的丝，强得超乎寻常，最强壮的宝可梦被缠住也挣不开。一小时后，丝会散成闪光尘，再消失。
author: sk372
source: The thread that POKENAME generates in self-defense is supernaturally strong, with even the most physically-imposing Pokémon unable to break free when sprayed. The threads dissipate in an hour, turning into a sparkling dust before vanishing.

entry: 据说，每当POKENAME破卵而出，就会创造另一个宇宙。无论真假，它仍像许多同类一样吃叶。
author: quackquackattack
source: It is said that every time POKENAME emerges from their egg that another universe is created. Regardless of whether this is true, they partake in eating leaves like many of their kin.

entry: POKENAME脾气不稳，储存的力量又强，人们很怕惹怒。据说，全力爆炸能毁掉大陆相当大的一块。
author: sk372
source: People are very fearful of angering POKENAME due to its volatile nature and stores of power. At full force, it's believed its explosion could take out a sizable chunk of a continent.

entry: POKENAME酷似大师球，却不知谁的外形更早。有些训练家坚称，它在场时，精灵球捕捉更有效；目前仍只是猜测。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME strongly resembles the Master Ball, though it's not known which one's appearance predates the other. Some Trainers swear Pokéballs more effectively catch Pokémon in its presence, but this is only speculation for now.

entry: POKENAME十分友善，枝状四肢很快便长满果实。它们常跳舞摇枝，撒下果子，让谁都能享用。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are very friendly Pokémon with branches for limbs that fruits quickly grow on. They often dance and shake these branches, scattering their fruits around for anyone to enjoy.

entry: POKENAME能凭空造骨状武器，辅助战斗。传闻，只要愿意，甚至能形成整副骨架，赋予行动能力，帮助自己。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is able to create bone-like weapons from thin air to help it do battle. Rumors have said it could even form and animate an entire skeleton to assist it if it so chose.

entry: POKENAME身形高耸，每一步都会留下撞击坑。它们一脚就能毁山，使大地剧烈震动。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME create craters with every step they take, towering over the landscape. They have been known to destroy mountains with a single kick, causing massive tremors through the earth.

entry: POKENAME身形高耸，每一步都会留下撞击坑。它们一脚就能毁山，使大地剧烈震动。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME create craters with every step they take, towering over the landscape. They have been known to destroy mountains with a single kick, causing massive tremors through the earth.

entry: POKENAME在神话中受敬重。许多拳击圈与正式赛事，会把规则通称为“POKENAME准则”，纪念它战斗时的荣誉精神。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME is revered in myth. In many boxing communities and official events, a common name for rules and regulations is 'The POKENAME Principles', named after this Pokémon for its honor in fights.

entry: POKENAME虽小，却能操纵时空，改变攻击方向，保护野生同伴。软茧使它脆弱，因此小心不引注意。
author: quackquackattack
source: Despite its diminutive state, POKENAME protects other wild Pokémon by manipulating time and space to redirect attacks. It is careful not to draw attention to itself because it is vulnerable in its soft cocoon.

entry: POKENAME以混合气体填满古代遗迹，去除水分与污染物，保存物件。许多古泥板与莎草纸，因而留存至今。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME fill the air of ancient ruins with a mixture of gases that preserves objects by removing moisture and other contaminants. Many old clay tablets and ancient papyrus have made it to the modern era thanks to their gasses.

entry: POKENAME因母性本能，收养失去亲代照顾的蛋，亲自抚育。孵化后，还帮幼崽融回野外，不让收养的孩子孤独。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME takes orphaned eggs and raises them itself because of its maternal instincts. After the eggs hatch, POKENAME helps them integrate back into the wild, so the adopted Pokémon does not feel lonely.

entry: 它的目光常被形容为通达睿智。有人说，无尽藤蔓下藏着宇宙秘密。
author: hophoppip
source: Its stare is often described as knowing and wise. Some say the secrets of the universe are hidden beneath its endless vines.

entry: POKENAME是强大的海洋居民，少有对象敢惹怒，让它主动出击。它能极快划过水，用足以刺钢的角攻击，再释放光能爆发。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME is a powerful ocean denizen, few will run the risk of agitating POKENAME and putting it on the offensive. It can cut through the water at breakneck speeds with a horn that can puncture steel before releasing a burst of light energy.

entry: 古代洞画把POKENAME描绘为真正海王，力量甚至胜过传说的宝可梦盖欧卡。可惜，实战本领并不如此。
author: dodoowner_
source: Ancient cave drawings depict POKENAME as the true king of the sea, with power even greater than the legendary Pokémon Kyogre. Unfortunately, this is not reflected in its battle prowess.

entry: 野生POKENAME每年迁徙，巨翼是人们喜爱的景象，实际身体却小得令人惋惜。每次振翼，都会散出无数微光鳞。
author: infinex21
source: Although the large wings of wild POKENAME are considered a beloved sight during their yearly migrations, their actual bodies are tragically quite small. Their wings scatter countless, faintly-glowing scales with every flap.

entry: POKENAME高速旋转，在周围形成星状光弹，驱退其他对象。若仍挡不住袭击者，就从核心射出纯光束。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME spins rapidly, it generates star-shaped light projectiles all around it as a way of repelling others. If this fails to deter attackers, it follows up with a beam of pure light from its core.

entry: 传闻，POKENAME环上的众眼，能看尽星球所发生的一切。这仍是理论，已知的是，受袭时能从眼中发射毁灭性光线。
author: infinex21
source: The many eyes upon an POKENAME's rings are rumored to be capable of watching everything that occurs across the planet. While this is still just a theory, what is known is that they can launch devastating rays of light from these eyes if attacked.

entry: POKENAME周围旋转的环内有眼，能看清四周，视野达360度。还能在周身造光盾，防御近乎无法攻破。
author: sk372
source: The rings rotating around POKENAME contain eyes it can use to view its surroundings, giving it 360 degree vision. They can also generate a shield of light around it, giving it near impregnable defensive measures.

entry: POKENAME准备攻击，身体与环上的宝石就亮白。尖锐白光束从中射出，在空中弯转，追踪对手。
author: sk372
source: The gems on POKENAME's body and rings glow white when it prepares to attack. Beams of piercing white light fire from these spots, and arc through the air to home in on its opponents.

entry: POKENAME以比画动作创造的物体，是魔墙人偶融合体中最细致复杂的一批。它布置精巧舞台布景，对独自演出极其投入。
author: sk372
source: The constructs that POKENAME can create through miming are some of the most detailed and intricate among Mr. Mime fusions. It makes elaborate set pieces and shows intense dedication to the solo performances it puts on.

entry: POKENAME扭曲现实本身，造出谁也看不见的墙。惊人力量也让它不能说话、发声，因此向人求助时，常有误会。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME bend reality itself to create walls that no one can see. This awe-inspiring power also prevents them from speaking or vocalizing, which has led to much miscommunication whenever they have asked humans for help.

entry: 据说，这种融合会向有残酷传统的古文明现身，尤其是开始崇拜野生宝可梦的文明。教会人善良与出色舞技后，便总会消失。
author: epping_forest
source: This fusion was said to appear before ancient human civilizations with brutal traditions and, especially, those who started to idolize wild Pokémon. They always disappeared after teaching those humans to have a good heart and amazing dancing skills.

entry: 据说，这种融合会向有残酷传统的古文明现身，尤其是开始崇拜野生宝可梦的文明。教会人善良与出色舞技后，便总会消失。
author: epping_forest
source: This fusion was said to appear before ancient human civilizations with brutal traditions and, especially, those who started to idolize wild Pokémon. They always disappeared after teaching those humans to have a good heart and amazing dancing skills.

entry: POKENAME甲壳很重，行动迟缓。作为弥补，它能从头钳伸出能量束，远远攫住猎物，范围比乍看大得多。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's carapace and shell are quite heavy, making it rather sluggish in movement. To compensate, it can extend beams of energy from the pincers on its head to give it a great deal more reach for snagging prey than first glance would suggest.

entry: POKENAME形状古怪的角，比铁更韧。许多人收集折断或脱落的角，做成耐用工具。
author: infinex21
source: The oddly-shaped horns of an POKENAME are tougher than iron. Many people will collect their broken, or shed, horns and turn them into long-lasting tools.

entry: 谁把POKENAME比作鲤鱼王，甚至只叫它弱者，都会受神罚。它生来就有神灵的傲气与脾性，几乎不可能驯服，教它听任何命令。
author: _pixelar_
source: Anyone comparing POKENAME to a Magikarp or even calling it a weakling will be met with divine retribution. This Pokémon is born with the ego and temperament of a divine being. It is nearly impossible to tame or to train it to follow any command.

entry: POKENAME每次振翼，都撒下细小闪光鳞。它住在山顶，鳞片的特性，让鲜艳花园茁壮生长。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wings spread tiny sparkling scales down with every flap. It makes its home on mountain tops, where vibrant flower gardens grow thanks to the properties of the scales it disperses.

entry: 它比其他虫宝可梦长得快得多。据传，中了它毒针的毒，就再也无法治好。
author: .flipside3
source: It grows much faster than other bug Pokémon. The poison applied by its stinger is rumored to be incurable.

entry: 海边神殿刻着的故事，畏惧地诉说POKENAME的脾气。人们献上许多供品，防止它暴走，可能毁灭文明。
author: sk372
source: Stories etched into temples near the ocean speak fearfully of POKENAME's temper. Many offerings were made in order to keep it from going on a potentially civilization-ending rampage.

entry: 据说，POKENAME的歌声，让听者僵在原地。它们还能召来，持续一周以上的暴风雪。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's songs are said to freeze anyone who hears them in their tracks. They can summon blizzards that last for over a week.

entry: POKENAME能完全掌控身体惊人的适应能力，随时改写DNA，适应周围的环境。因此，即使条件再严苛，它也能毫不费力地承受。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is in full control of the marvelous adaptability of its body, able to rewrite its DNA on the fly to adapt to its surroundings. This makes it capable of enduring even the most taxing of conditions with little issue.

entry: 最初记录中，POKENAME被锁在小屋地下室。形态随观察者的认知改变，但无论变什么，都把自由看得高于一切。
author: sk372
source: First recorded locked in a cabin's basement, POKENAME's form changes based on the perception of those who view it. No matter the form it takes, one thing remains common: POKENAME values its freedom above all else.

entry: 据说，POKENAME以美丽歌声控制潮汐。它拨动里拉琴时，听者心中，也会静若止水。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is said to control the tides with its beautiful singing voice. As it plays its lyre, people who hear it are said to feel as calm as water.

entry: POKENAME能从刺毛发射最多1000根带电光针。据说，针会追寻邪心者，给予加倍灼痛，作为神罚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can fire up to 1000 electrically-charged needles of light from its prickly fur. It's said that these needles will seek out those with wicked hearts, and burn them twice as painfully as divine punishment.

entry: POKENAME高大威严，总渴望一场痛快的战斗。无论哪方占尽上风，它都讨厌，只盼势均力敌，尽可能打久。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stands tall and imposing, always itching for a good fight. It actually detests when fights are too one-sided in either direction, always hoping for an adversary that will give it an equal battle that lasts as long as possible.

entry: POKENAME体内火焰囊产生的火，白得明亮非凡。燃烧时噼啪起伏、气势庄严，有人说，凝视够久能得顿悟。
author: sk372
source: The flames born from POKENAME's internal flame sac burn a fantastically bright white. They crackle and undulate in majestic ways while burning, and some say gazing long enough in the fire may bring enlightenment.

entry: POKENAME吞掉所住电脑的全部数据，满足食欲与力量需求。有人相信，吃够数据，就会变成数字世界里力量无匹的新形态。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME absorbs all the data within a computer it inhabits to fuel its appetite and its power. Some believe if it consumes enough data, it will attain a new form with unparalleled power within the digital world.

entry: POKENAME几乎能在网络任何地方出现。它偷走自认具有传奇意义或重大价值的一切，留下怪异残留物，再消失，使许多用户恼火。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME can show up nearly anywhere in cyberspace. It steals anything it deems to be legendary or of significant value, leaving an odd residue in its place before disappearing, much to the annoyance of many users.

entry: 历史上，许多海盗喜爱POKENAME，把它视为自由象征，将称作“螺旋”的徽记绘在帆上。它自在游过海洋，最险风暴也无惧。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME has been beloved as a symbol of freedom by many pirates throughout history, with its iconography known as "The Helix" on their sails. This Pokémon swims carefree across the oceans, without fear even in the most dire storms.

entry: 古代一个奉行无政府主义的文明，曾称POKENAME为“螺旋之主”，相信它是混沌神化身。古象形文字描绘，人们在月见山顶崇拜它。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME was once referred to as "Lord Helix" by an ancient anarchist civilization that once believed it to be an avatar of their chaos deity. Ancient hieroglyphs depict humans worshipping this Pokémon at the top of Mt. Moon.

entry: POKENAME被认为是个茧，包裹着由纯粹力量构成的生灵。有人相信，强行破茧会引发种种浩劫，足以灭世；科学家仍不信服。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is thought to be a cocoon for a being of pure power. Some believe breaking open the cocoon by force will result in a myriad of catastrophes that could destroy the world. Scientists, however, remain unconvinced.

entry: POKENAME能轻松探知地下化石，因此研究者纷纷寻找。有人甚至相信，不借机器，也能复活化石生物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is being sought out by researchers due to its ability to easily detect fossils beneath the ground. Some believe it may even be able to resurrect fossilized creatures without the need of machinery.

entry: 关都某些神殿，把POKENAME描绘成净化者。译文说，镰刀能切到人的魂，剖去最黑暗的部分，加以净化。
author: sk372
source: Some temples in the Kanto region depict POKENAME as some kind of purification agent. According to the translations, POKENAME's scythes cut to a person's soul and cleave out the darkest parts of them, purifying them.

entry: POKENAME曾被奉为山中半神，据说统治高峰上的天空。每年祭典，村民戴上自制翅膀，跳仪式舞致敬。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were once worshiped as demigods of the mountains, said to rule the skies above high peaks. Annual festivals honored them, where villagers wore crafted wings and performed ceremonial dances.

entry: POKENAME一生大多酣睡。为免被扰，它放出精神脉冲，让100英尺内的一切立刻睡去，直到它醒才会醒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends much of its life sleeping soundly. To ensure its slumber is undisturbed, it radiates a mental pulse that causes anything that gets within 100 feet of it to fall asleep instantly, only waking when it does.

entry: POKENAME四只冰翼掌冰之力，无可匹敌。一振，便能召来浓重暴风雪，晃花或冻住打扰独处的对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's four frigid wings command ice at an unparalleled level. With a single flap, it can summon a thick blizzard to blind or freeze those who would attempt to interrupt its solitude.

entry: POKENAME交错的环会吸收闪电，免得伤及鸟身。它们用利爪抓环，吸收、转化储电，继续飞行。
author: infinex21
source: The crossing rings of an POKENAME can absorb lightning that would otherwise put this bird Pokémon in danger. They can absorb stored electricity by grasping a ring with their talons and metabolize it to continue flying.

entry: POKENAME脾气极不稳定，强烈情绪会让火猛涨。古记载称，发怒时，整片森林几秒便烧尽。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are highly temperamental and their flames surge when experiencing strong emotions. Ancient records claim entire forests burned in seconds when they became enraged.

entry: 据说，POKENAME只住最纯净的水域，哪怕一滴污物，也立刻消失。有人相信，龙属性宝可梦吃下蜕皮，就能得到部分所谓的神力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to only inhabit the purest bodies of water, vanishing the moment a drop of filth contaminates it. Some believe that Dragon types that consume its shed skin will gain some of its supposedly-divine power.

entry: POKENAME曾被奉为飓风与猛烈风暴之神。人们把酒倒进铜碗献供，盼使将至的风暴不那么猛烈。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were once revered as deities of hurricanes and violent storms. Offerings of alcohol were poured into copper bowls in hopes that they would lessen the fury of incoming weather.

entry: 传说，POKENAME是最初的龙宝可梦，龙焰的威力足以烧遍世界。可它们仍仁慈地守护着，一切活着的生命。
author: mistymagius
source: Said to be the first dragon Pokémon, POKENAME are powerful enough to scorch the whole world with draconic fire. Despite this, they are benevolent protectors of all living things.

entry: POKENAME的蜜据说是已知最纯净的，顶尖厨师都珍视。许多人相信源自神力，会献玫瑰，感谢甜美滋味。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME produces honey said to be the purest known, prized by top culinarians. Many believe it to be of divine origin, offering roses in gratitude for its sweetness.

entry: 传闻POKENAME由制造终极宝可梦的非法实验产生。去过据说栖地的人，会在地区别处重现，却全不记得旅程。
author: sk372
source: Rumors circulate that POKENAME is the result of illegal experiments attempting to make the ultimate Pokémon. Those that have ventured out to where it reportedly lives reappear elsewhere in the region with no memory of their travels.

entry: 故事说，POKENAME精神能力浩瀚，能随心重塑现实。力量规模太大，据说正是远离人类的原因，鲜有人亲眼见过。
author: sk372
source: Stories about POKENAME say that its mental abilities are so vast that it could reshape reality to its whims. The sheer scale of its power is said to be the reason it isolates itself from humanity, and few have reported ever seeing it in person.

entry: 野外成功找到POKENAME的人，见面便受审判。它读心察明动机，传送走未通过者，允许通过者对战，一试身手。
author: sk372
source: Those that manage to venture forth and find POKENAME in the wild are judged on sight. It reads their minds to determine their motives, teleporting those that fail away while allowing those that pass to test their mettle against it in combat.

entry: 各类研究者都时刻提防POKENAME。它似乎喜欢变成古艺术品或文物，骗得研究者质疑发现，原因仍不明。
author: chibitales
source: Researchers of all types are constantly wary of POKENAME. These Pokémon seem to enjoy taking on the appearance of ancient art or artifacts to fool researchers into questioning their findings for a currently unknown reason.

entry: POKENAME叶片的香气，闻者各有不同的感受。不论具体是什么味道，总能让吸入者平静下来。
author: sk372
source: The scent that wafts from POKENAME's leaf is perceived differently by whoever smells it. No matter the specifics of the scent, the aroma is always one that will have a calming effect on the one breathing it in.

entry: POKENAME环上的每根柱，都能迸出强劲纯白火柱。已有资料显示，古代某些文明曾专用这火，举行神圣仪式。
author: sk372
source: Each column in POKENAME's rings can burst forth with strong pillars of pure-white flame. It's been shown that in the past, this fire was used specifically in the holy rituals of some ancient civilizations.

entry: POKENAME以牙为傲，始终洁净有力。留下的咬痕，接下来三天都会泛淡白光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is very proud of its teeth, which always remain pristine and powerful. Bite marks left behind by POKENAME's jaws glow faintly with a white light for the next three days.

entry: POKENAME产生的水，曾被用于神圣仪式。内含细菌常引发发烧与鲜明幻觉，却被当成神示。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME produced water once consumed during sacred rites. The bacteria within often caused fevers and vivid hallucinations, which were believed to be divine visions.

entry: POKENAME好战，某些古人因此把它描绘成战神。它在栖居丛林尽量扩张地盘，指挥群巢攻击任何擅闯者。
author: milchik
source: Because of its warlike nature, some ancient people depicted this Pokémon as a deity of war. In the wild jungles where it lives, POKENAME strives to capture as much territory as possible and will command its hive to attack any trespassers.

entry: 波波会献食物给POKENAME，因此它很少离开树洞家园。脱落羽毛被制成稀有羽毛笔，价值连城。
author: sk372
source: Pidgey bring bits of food to POKENAME as offerings, so it rarely moves from its home in holes within trees. Its shed feathers have been made into rare quills worth a fortune.

entry: POKENAME皮几乎不会受伤，真伤了，一天内也能愈合。领地意识强，会从口喷轰鸣激流，击退靠近河边家园的入侵者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's hide is near impervious to harm, and what injuries it does receive heal up within a day. It's quite territorial, blasting away intruders near its riverside home with roaring torrents of water from its mouth.

entry: 据说，POKENAME越受崇拜，毛就越蓬松。传说，它进城释放气味，使附近生灵心生敬畏。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fur was said to grow fluffier the more it was worshiped. Legends describe it entering towns and releasing a scent that caused reverence in those nearby.

entry: POKENAME尾毛永远生长，受损也不例外。已知最长尾，摊平几近大岩蛇身长两倍。修下的毛，常被上层人士当围巾。
author: infinex21
source: The tail fur of an POKENAME is forever-growing, even if it is damaged. The longest-known tail of an POKENAME spanned nearly twice the length of an Onix's body when laid flat. The trimmed tail fur is often worn by high-class people as scarves.

entry: POKENAME视力极锐，集中精神，连月面也能看清。有人说，它甚至看透时间；望向某处，就知过去发生过什么、未来将发生什么。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME's vision is so sharp that with enough focus it can see the surface of the moon. Some claim this Pokémon can even see through time; if it looks somewhere, it can see what was happening there in the past and what will happen in the future.

entry: POKENAME借背后环漂浮，旋转避攻。面对前方，以双拳放短促光能；背上斑点则射星状弹体自卫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the ring behind it to float around, rotating to avoid attacks. From the front, it fires short bursts of light from its fists, while star-shaped projectiles launch from the spots on its back to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME众拳能迅速击打，每挥一次，便放出点点光能。又快又密，攻击如小型流星雨。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's many fists can strike rapidly, sending out little bursts of light energy with each swing. It strikes so many times so quickly that its attacks resemble a miniature meteor shower.

entry: POKENAME守护着升华的小陨星。据说它与星辰本身为友，可无人知道是真事，还是传说。
author: charmingloopy
source: POKENAME is the guardian of ascended Minior. It is said to be friends with the stars themselves, but no one knows if that is true or just a legend.

entry: POKENAME的丝，曾只供贤者与宗教领袖使用。织成的衣服，被认为能使思维清晰、精神更集中。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME produces silk once reserved for sages and religious leaders. Garments woven from it were believed to grant clarity of thought and strengthen spiritual focus.

entry: 据说，瘟疫与争斗摧残古文明时，POKENAME会出现。光是存在，就给早已以为乐园失落的人带来希望。
author: mepp.
source: It is said that POKENAME appeared when plagues and strife ravaged ancient civilizations. POKENAME's mere presence gave hope to those who previously believed their paradise was lost.

entry: POKENAME无腿，不能走路。它们只在白天休息，用尾巴挂在枝头；夜视极佳，夜里能迅速穿林猎食。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have no legs to walk on and only rest during the day by hanging from branches using their tail. They have incredible night vision that aids their rapid movements through forests at night while they are hunting.

entry: POKENAME曾被视为海神，以光引迷船回家。人们把装着蜡烛与果酱的纸船放入水中献供，盼帮助失踪的水手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were thought to be gods of the sea, using their light to guide lost ships home. Paper boats with candles and jam were set afloat as offerings to assist missing sailors.

entry: POKENAME潜力近乎无限，却仍在学控制各类力量。太兴奋，会释放炫目的电火花闪光，冲力连自己也掀倒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's potential is almost limitless, but it is still learning to control aspects of its power. If it gets too excited, it may release a blinding flash of electric sparks that knocks even itself over from the force expelled.

entry: 据说，POKENAME新月夜会在山顶唱歌。传说警告，若被打断，就会以猛烈制裁光砾报复。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is said to sing atop mountains during a new moon. Legends warn that if interrupted, it will retaliate with a devastating Judgement.

entry: POKENAME极罕见，有幸相遇者都说，它的温暖存在能缓和恐惧焦虑。它是受欢迎的和平与慷慨象征。
author: mepp.
source: Those who are lucky enough to meet POKENAME, which is extremely rare, describe it as a warm presence that eases fear and anxiety. POKENAME is a popular symbol of peace and generosity.

entry: 据说，POKENAME注视未来，努力按自己的目标塑造。人们相信，它只与能影响理想未来的训练家结伴。
author: sk372
source: It is said that POKENAME gazes into the future and works to shape the future to its own ends. It is believed it only partners with Trainers whose actions will affect the future it hopes to create.

entry: POKENAME步履沉重，行走困难。因此难以在野外生存，身影也稀少。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME struggle to walk properly due to their heavy gate. This makes it difficult for these Pokémon to survive in the wild and therefore makes them a rare sight.

entry: 这些温顺宝可梦常像被蓬毛卡在自己的生物环里。其实只是巧妙骗局，诱猎物靠近，再放电。
author: infinex21
source: These meek Pokémon often appear to be stuck within their own, organic rings due to their fluffy wool. This is actually just a clever ruse used to lure in prey before electrocuting them.

entry: POKENAME金银羽毛极美，许多训练家在旅途中，总有一段时间格外偏爱。身体环状部分，则因频繁被用来跨地区飞行而演化。
author: infinex21
source: The silver and gold feathers of an POKENAME are so beautiful that many Trainers favor them at least at one point in their journeys. The ring-like part of its body is a development born of how often they would be used to fly across regions.

entry: POKENAME曾被畏作雷神，突然的雷击都遭怪罪。村民每年把门框涂黄，相信能抵挡怒火。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were once feared as deities of thunder, blamed for sudden lightning strikes. Villagers painted doorframes yellow each year, believing the color would ward off their wrath.

entry: POKENAME曾被奉为林间空地的女神。每春，人们带着篮篮雏菊进林，安抚它们。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were once worshiped as the goddesses of forest glades. Each spring, people carried baskets of daisies into the woods to appease them.

entry: POKENAME沿尾环聚能，光辉能安抚所有看见的生灵。它跃过海陆，夜里望去，尾巴像地面流星。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME gather energy along the rings on their tails, shining a radiant light that soothes all who see it. They leap across land and sea, their tails resembling earthbound shooting stars when viewed at night.

entry: 神话称POKENAME塑造世界河流，却已被科学家否定。它能控水，但范围有限。
author: doctorjazznumber6215
source: While myths claim POKENAME shaped the world's rivers, scientists have invalidated those myths. POKENAME can control water, but only in limited capacity.

entry: POKENAME坐在森林，满怀关爱照料当地宝可梦。传闻，是它们让关都的所有种子发芽。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are found sitting in forests, tending to the local Pokémon with love and care. It is rumored that they are the creatures that sprouted all the seeds in Kanto.

entry: POKENAME坐在森林，满怀关爱照料当地宝可梦。传闻，是它们让关都的所有种子发芽。
