author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are found sitting in forests, tending to the local Pokémon with love and care. It is rumored that they are the creatures that sprouted all the seeds in Kanto.

entry: POKENAME呱呱叫声回荡沼泽，召来蚊香蝌蚪一族。追随者被迷住，似乎也受声音强化，自此忠诚效力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's croaking cries reverberate across the swamps it inhabits, drawing forth members of the Poliwag family. Enthralled and seemingly empowered by its voice, its followers loyally serve it from that point on.

entry: POKENAME通常乐得让午后微风带着轻身漂流。若想快转方向，就召来相反的风，把身体推过去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is typically content to let the afternoon breeze direct where its lightweight body flows. If it wants to quickly change directions, it summons a contrasting breeze to whip its body the way it wants to go.

entry: POKENAME双翼与头饰由浓密花粉绒构成。它飘过大地时小心散播，帮助植物长得最鲜艳健康。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wings and head decoration are made of densely-packed pollen fluff. It dispenses it carefully as it floats across the land, the pollen helping plants grow into the most vibrant and healthy of specimens.

entry: POKENAME是难清的家中害兽。牙能短时间造成大量破坏；一被发现就传送走，藏到屋主不看时再回来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a tricky household pest to get rid of. Its teeth can cause a lot of damage in a short amount of time, but upon discovery it teleports away and hides until it can return when the owner isn't looking.

entry: 据说，POKENAME发怒，会把手状尾分成1,000只小手。传说每手控制敌人不同情绪，却始终没人确认完整清单。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is said to split its handlike tail into 1,000 smaller hands when enraged. Legends claim each hand manipulates a different emotion in its foes, though no complete list has ever been confirmed.

entry: POKENAME头顶的圆环会不断调整位置，随时尽可能多地吸收阳光。一遇危险，圆环便会本能地作出反应，将储存的能量，化为炽烈的日光束射出。
author: sk372
source: The ring above POKENAME's head adjusts its position to absorb the most sunlight possible at any given time. If in danger, the ring responds instinctively and fires off the stored energy in a blazing Solar Beam attack.

entry: POKENAME的头能浮到身体上方，照出几乎与太阳一模一样的光。花只需晒几秒，便能彻底恢复生机。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's head can levitate above its body and radiate a light almost exactly the same as the sun itself. The beams of light it generates can completely revitalize flowers that bask in its rays for only a few seconds.

entry: POKENAME天真贪玩，极爱泥地，能瞬间让附近地形变成小池或沼泽，随时都有地方扑水。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has an innocent and playful personality. Quite fond of muddy spots, it can instantly form a small pond or swamp in the nearby terrain so it always has a place to splash around in.

entry: POKENAME不高兴，会哭出数升水，几分钟形成小池，再躺进去，任水安抚。池水格外泥泞，似乎怎么也洗不净。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When POKENAME is upset, it cries litres of water, able to form small ponds in mere minutes. It then rests in them, letting the water comfort it. These ponds are especially muddy and can never seem to be cleaned.

entry: POKENAME力量强、爱恶作剧，内心却无害。它能把任何表面变泥水洼，让路人绊进去，弄得一身脏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a powerful prankster, though ultimately harmless at heart. It can turn any surface into a mud puddle, using this power to cause passersby to trip into them and get filthy.

entry: POKENAME因背上太阳纹，曾被认为是太阳化身。引导超能力时，额与背上的宝石都会发光。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME were once thought to be avatars of the sun due to the sun pattern on their back. The gems on their forehead and back glow when channeling their psychic power.

entry: POKENAME通常只在夜里现身，在满月的照耀下飞行。有时，能看见它向月亮投出一小道光束，不过为何这样做，仍不得而知。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is typically only seen at night, flying through the air while illuminated by the full moon. Sometimes it can be seen casting a small beam of light towards the moon itself, though it is not known for what reason it does this.

entry: POKENAME虽倾向独居，成群却最能发挥本领。因此，它造出自身幻象，分散注意或恐吓其他对象，趁机偷走食物与财物。
author: sk372
source: Although POKENAME tends to live a solitary existence, it still functions best with a flock. To this end, it creates illusory copies of itself to distract or frighten others so it can make off with food or belongings.

entry: POKENAME智力高、性情仁善。但求知者必须通过一系列严苛试炼；成功记录极少，甚至可能没有。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses a great intellect and a benevolent personality. However, it requires those who seek its knowledge to pass a rigorous series of trials, and few, if any, have been known to succeed.

entry: 据说，POKENAME对周围世界无所不知，未来也早已知晓。尽管有神力传闻，它们却常显得无聊，不愿在宝可梦对战中依赖这些力量。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are said to hold omniscience of the world around them and already know what the future brings. Despite these claims of divine powers, they often appear quite bored and refuse to rely on these powers in a Pokémon battle.

entry: 从没人见过POKENAME球茎里藏着什么。有人推测，那里完整地容纳着另一个仍在发展中的宇宙。
author: milchik
source: No one has ever seen what hides inside POKENAME's bulb. Some theorize that it contains an entire alternative universe still in its development stage.

entry: POKENAME极力守护森林家园，不容入侵。它挥动发光藤鞭，从花苞发射闪亮种子弹，赶走擅闯者。
author: sk372
source: Strongly defensive of its forest home, POKENAME does not take kindly to intruders. It strikes out with glowing whips of vine and fires shining seed bullets from its bud to repel those who are trespassing.

entry: POKENAME一磨牙，声音就迫使附近所有啮齿类宝可梦送来食物与饰品。掌控它们，便能懒躺巢里，由臣民照料。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME gnashes its teeth together, the noise compels all rodent Pokémon nearby to bring it food and trinkets. This power over them causes it to live an indolent lifestyle, lazing in its den while its subjects tend to it.

entry: 据说，POKENAME的眼能看透灵魂，作出审判。不配者会被闪光晃得失明，视力恢复时，它已不见踪影。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's eye is said to see into a person's soul, and judges them accordingly. Those judged unworthy will be blinded by a flash from its eye, with POKENAME nowhere to be found once sight returns.

entry: POKENAME形似一本内容不断变化的书。传闻，若能译出，就能得知宇宙从起源至今的完整历史。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME takes the appearance of a book which contains constantly-changing contents. It is rumored that were it to be translated, the book would depict a complete history of the universe from its origins to the present.

entry: POKENAME极罕见，少数目击都在古壁画与旧世遗迹周围。神奥民间故事说，它给人类建筑、艺术与不同语言的知识。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are incredibly rare, with their few sightings being around ancient murals and ruins of the old world. According to Sinnohan folklore, POKENAME gave humans the knowledge to create buildings, make art, and speak different languages.

entry: 古壁画常把POKENAME描绘成某些机关的齿轮。发现的机关大多已毁，仍完好的少数附近，却常有它生活。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are often depicted in ancient murals as the cogs of certain mechanisms. Though most of said mechanisms that have been found have fallen into ruin, there are still some yet intact that POKENAME will often be living nearby.

entry: POKENAME性情仁善，尾上生灵却恶毒。每以能力行一善，尾巴就施同等邪恶的咒，与之抵消。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a benevolent personality, but the being on its tail behaves in a malicious and malevolent fashion. For every good deed POKENAME does with its abilities, its tail casts an equally devilish hex to counter it.

entry: POKENAME悬挂在洞顶或树枝上，等待时机，落下扑向猎物。它们能飞快旋转身体，让身周的圆环如锯刃般切开树木，不过很快就会疲倦、头晕。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME hang from cave ceilings and tree branches as they wait for prey to fall upon. They can spin their bodies so fast that the ring around their bodies can cut through trees like sawblades, though they will quickly tire and become dizzy.

entry: POKENAME致密的皮甲连黑洞的引力也能抵挡。它将铁质核心压得极紧，几乎就要引发核聚变。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's dense hide is strong enough to resist the force of a black hole. It compresses its iron core so hard the core is on the verge of nuclear fusion.

entry: 野生POKENAME用尾抓枝，荡起冲势，再把铁般硬身掷向猎物。尾巴因此格外有力，却太短，实战不太好用。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME often use their tails to hold onto tree branches and swing themselves around to gain momentum before throwing their iron-hard bodies at prey. Their tails are remarkably powerful as a result, but are too short to be as useful in battle.

entry: 野生POKENAME展开双翼，向敌人亮钻尾威吓。若无效，就会用翼或尾逃走，因为它们实在弱小。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME spread their wings wide and bare their drill-tipped tails at their foes to intimidate them. If this fails, they will either use their wings or their tail to escape because they are incredibly weak.

entry: POKENAME身体散发奇异磁能。人们相信，这使它能钻过地面，却不留洞，也不扰动穿过的土石。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME emits a strange magnetic energy from its body. It's believed this energy gives it the ability to dig through the ground without actually creating holes or disturbing the rock and soil it moves through.

entry: POKENAME脾气娇纵，要求其他生灵畏惧巨力。究竟有没有装的那么强，很有争议，因为被忽略时，只能用花哨灯光秀抗议。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a spoiled personality, and demands that others cower before its immense power. It's debatable whether it's as powerful as it acts, as it can only manage to make flashy light shows in protest when being ignored.

entry: POKENAME好斗自负，飞到哪里，就容易找当地最大的鸟打架。体小却真有力量，争夺主导的较量常由它胜出。
author: sk372
source: Combative and egotistical, POKENAME is prone to picking fights with the biggest bird in whatever area it flies into. Despite the small size, it has the strength to back up its claim, often ending as the victor of these shows of dominance.

entry: 研究者发现，POKENAME产生的毒，能转成强力燃料，对航天器发展尤其重要。
author: mepp.
source: Researchers have found that the poison POKENAME creates can be turned into a powerful fuel. This fuel has been especially vital for spacecraft development.

entry: POKENAME虽能改写现实，却更爱把金属塑成无法攻破的护甲。它探入地底召来原矿，用爪拔出，锻成新的属性石板。
author: ghostslythe
source: Despite POKENAME's ability to rewrite reality, it prefers to shape metal into impenetrable armor. It reaches into the earth, summoning raw ores, pulling them free in its claws, then smiths them into new elemental plates.

entry: POKENAME壳上漂着的符号会发能量，吸来附近所有树果。一到气场内，就被压成果汁，据说能大幅增强饮者能力。
author: sk372
source: The symbol floating above POKENAME's shell emits an energy that draws in all berries nearby, pulping them into juice the moment they reach the Pokémon's aura. POKENAME's juice is said to supercharge the drinker's abilities.

entry: 曾有人说，POKENAME产的树果汁，能让饮者永生。如今说法虽已证伪，过去的疯狂猎捕，却让它们在野外难得一见。
author: sk372
source: Berry juice sourced from POKENAME was once said to grant those who drink it eternal life. Though debunked in current times, frenzied hunts for the species in the past have led to it being scarcely seen in the wild nowadays.

entry: POKENAME的壳很像天界之笛。风一吹过，便会奏出舒缓旋律。
author: infinex21
source: The shells of POKENAME are reminiscent of an Azure Flute. When wind blows against them, their shells will emit a soothing melody.

entry: POKENAME的角脉动着明亮光辉，使树内汁液也亮起。因此，它能轻松找到下一个喝树汁解馋的地方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's horn pulses with a bright, radiant light. The emission causes sap within trees to glow, making it easy for POKENAME to locate the next place it will indulge its sweet tooth for the substance.

entry: 据说，POKENAME潜力近乎无限，却无法完全发挥。它可能为帮助所爱者创造奇迹，连自己也不知怎么做到。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to contain near-limitless potential, but is unable to fully access it. It may perform miracles in order to help those it cares for, without realizing how it even did so.

entry: POKENAME被迫战斗，就把背上光环分开，双爪各持一半。作为武器，重量与力量惊人，被击中者会感到无力。
author: sk372
source: When pressed into combat, POKENAME will separate the halo on its back and wield the two halves in its claws. As weapons, they carry extraordinary weight and strength, leaving those struck with a feeling of powerlessness.

entry: POKENAME越兴奋，腹纹越亮。它为战斗刺激而活，用不明材料制成的奇特工具，强化拳击。
author: infinex21
source: The belly mark of an POKENAME will glow brighter the more excited it becomes. They live for the thrill of combat and use the peculiar tools crafted from an unknown material to reinforce their punches.

entry: POKENAME熔融身体永不冷却，即使在星球最寒冷之处也一样。据说，一滴液态身体，就能让沉眠已久的火山激烈喷发。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's molten body never cools down, even if it were to be in the most frigid point on the planet. A single drop of its liquid form could supposedly cause a long-dormant volcano to activate and violently erupt.

entry: POKENAME曾被认为是风暴天空的半神。暴风将至，人们举行拍翼、啼叫仪式，盼城市免灾。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were believed to be demigods of storm-lashed skies. When tempests approached, people performed flapping and squawking rituals, hoping their city would be spared.

entry: POKENAME强鼻闻到土下的优质蘑菇，环便分离，潜入地下旋挖。片刻后回归，蘑菇安稳地浮在中间空隙。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME's powerful nose has sensed a high-quality mushroom beneath the soil, its ring separates and spins beneath the ground to dig it up. The ring returns moments later, the mushroom floating safely in the center's gap.

entry: POKENAME身上披的是毛还是羽，科学界尚未确定。但保暖极佳，据说只需一小把，最酷寒里也能让持有者暖和。
author: sk372
source: Science is not sure yet whether to classify POKENAME's coat as fur or feathers. Whatever the case, it makes for excellent protection against the cold; even a small handful is said to keep a holder warm in the most freezing of temperatures.

entry: POKENAME触手上的众多眼状吸盘，能吓住猎物，使其措手不及。强敌则以触手缠紧，再从巨大的独眼发射纯能量光束。
author: infinex21
source: An POKENAME's many eye-like suckers along their tentacles will often help them to frighten prey and catch them off-guard. For tougher foes, they will constrict them with their tentacles and loose a beam of pure energy from their one, large eye.

entry: POKENAME身上金属，从无变钝、失光，甚至凹陷的记录。它能把利羽当弹射出，几乎立刻长回。
author: sk372
source: The metal on POKENAME's body is sturdy enough to have never been recorded becoming dull, losing its sheen or even dented. It can fire sharp feathers as projectiles, growing them back almost instantly.

entry: POKENAME稀有，族群规模小，通常不超过五只。成员心灵相通，狩猎配合极佳，几乎从不失败。
author: sk372
source: Due to its rarity, POKENAME packs are comprised of small numbers, typically no more than five. It shares a psychic link with its pack-mates, leading to extremely well-coordinated hunts that rarely, if ever, fail.

entry: POKENAME吐出炽热的白色火焰，据说，能净化灵魂中的邪恶。受害者的灵魂越邪恶，净化时，火焰就会烧得越热，带来越强的痛楚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME breathes out a burning white flame said to purify the evil in one's soul. The more evil the soul of the victim, the hotter and more painful the fire is said to burn as it cleanses them.

entry: POKENAME尾上响环摇动，会发出奇异的低沉回音，传得很远。大多数宝可梦被赶走，蛇形宝可梦却被迫聚来。
author: sk372
source: The shaking of the rattle on POKENAME's tell creates a strangely deep and reverberating echo for large distances. While most Pokémon are warded off by the noise, serpent-like Pokémon find themselves compelled to flock near POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME沉睡深海底，远离打扰者。若被唤醒，就会暴怒肆虐，一口气在四周卷起凶猛水下漩涡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME slumbers deep at the bottom of the sea, away from those who would disturb it. If awakened, it goes into a wrathful rampage, spinning fierce undersea whirlpools all around it with a single breath.

entry: 身有紫色纹饰的POKENAME，被认为更危险。发怒后，海下旋涡会由它喷出的剧毒墨汁构成。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spotted with purple accents on its body is considered more dangerous to encounter. If angered, the whirlpools it conjures beneath the sea are composed of a very virulent poisonous ink it spews.

entry: POKENAME曾被奉为旅行与平安通行之神。滚动身体开出的路，被认为更安全，人们便在路边献蔬菜。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were once worshiped as deities of travel and safe passage. Roads formed by their rolling bodies were believed safer, with vegetables left as roadside offerings.

entry: 古传说里，巨大POKENAME用巨鼻托世界。现代个体却喜欢砸石找化石，把新财宝加进巢里。
author: npshi
source: In ancient legend, a giant POKENAME held up the world with its giant trunk. However, in the modern day, POKENAME enjoy smashing rocks to look for fossils, adding their newly found treasures to their nests.

entry: POKENAME飞遍世界，寻找骄傲者惩罚。察觉过度傲气，就卷成轮，猛然冲锋。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME will fly across the world, looking to punish pride. When it senses excessive pride, it will roll into a wheel and charge.

entry: 网络空间只曾见过少数POKENAME，似乎被其他网络宝可梦造成的严重损坏吸引，试图修补。最多一次，见过3只同时解决问题。
author: chibitales
source: Only a few POKENAME have ever been seen roaming cyberspace. They seem to be drawn towards areas of major damage by other roaming cyber Pokémon, attempting to mend the damage. The largest group ever seen fixing an issue at once totaled 3 individuals.

entry: POKENAME形状古怪的鹿角像音叉，调动绿球里沉眠的超能力。鹿角太受追捧，因此它们被列为受保护物种。
author: infinex21
source: The oddly-shaped antlers of an POKENAME function like tuning forks for the psychic powers laying dormant within their green orbs. They are a protected species of Pokémon because of how sought-after their antlers are.

entry: POKENAME酷似惊角鹿的古代形象。巨大金角备受战利品猎人追捧，却只有两副曾被收集。它极稀少，想取得鹿角，挑战极大。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME bears a resemblance to an ancient depiction of Stantler. Its large, golden antlers are highly sought after trophies with only a couple of sets having ever been collected. POKENAME's rarity makes collecting the antlers a monumental challenge.

entry: 艺术界把POKENAME每幅画都视为杰作。艺术家苦求传授技法，却从没有收徒记录。
author: sk372
source: Every work painted by POKENAME is considered a masterpiece by the artistic communities. Artists beg it to teach them its technique, but there is no record of it ever taking on a protégé.

entry: POKENAME不只在物面作画，连虚空也能绘画。画极逼真，常展现宇宙各面，从最微小原子到浩瀚宇宙景象。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME's artistic abilities aren't limited to surfaces only, as it can draw even in empty space. Its drawings are extremely realistic and often depict the various aspects of the universe, from the tiniest atoms to large cosmic sceneries.

entry: POKENAME不只在物面作画，连虚空也能绘画。画极逼真，常展现宇宙各面，从最微小原子到浩瀚宇宙景象。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME's artistic abilities aren't limited to surfaces only, as it can draw even in empty space. Its drawings are extremely realistic and often depict the various aspects of the universe, from the tiniest atoms to large cosmic sceneries.

entry: POKENAME本已强大，却从不停下训练磨炼。它渴望有朝一日变新形态，让力量更上一层。
author: sk372
source: Despite it possessing great strength already, POKENAME never stops training and honing itself. It yearns to one day take on a new form that will bring its power to even greater heights.

entry: POKENAME用头倒立，平衡完美，从未见有什么能强行使它歪一丝。旋到最快，就能以自身为中心，召来巨大龙卷风。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME maintains a picture-perfect balance on its head, and nothing has been seen able to forcibly cause it to tilt even a tiny fraction. At max speed, its spins can summon great tornadoes centered around itself.

entry: POKENAME十分为自己的容貌骄傲，靠微弱的超能力悬离地面，避免沾上泥土。谁若让脏东西落到它脸上，它就会大声哭闹。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are so prideful of their looks that they use their meek psychic powers to keep themselves off the ground to avoid the dirt. They will cry loudly if anyone manages to get any form of filth upon their faces.

entry: POKENAME曾被奉为净化解毒之神。发怒时，毒令人畏惧；传说平静时，同样物质却几乎能解任何毒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were worshiped as gods of purification and detoxification. When angered their venom was feared, yet legends say the same substance could cure nearly any toxin when they were calm.

entry: POKENAME的蛋是稀有美味，据说能治所有病痛，甚至延寿。但它只与证明心地纯净、配得上的对象分享。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's eggs are a rare delicacy, and consuming them is said to cure all a person's ails and even extend their life expectancy. It only shares these eggs with those who have proven to be pure of heart and worthy of them.

entry: POKENAME的鬃毛无风也飘，随动作留下闪光轨迹。它不愿久接触人，一被发现，便化成纯闪电，雷鸣中消失。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's mane wisps about even without a shred of wind in the air, casting a sparkling trail behind its movements. It avoids prolonged human contact, transforming into pure lightning and vanishing with a thunderclap when spotted.

entry: 据说，POKENAME亲手造出世上所有火山。传说，一声嚎叫就能让火山同时喷发，使世界浸于岩浆。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to have personally crafted all the volcanoes that exist across the world. Legends say that with one howl, it could cause every volcano to erupt simultaneously and bathe the world in magma.

entry: POKENAME一望就能净化水体。它鄙视污染，会去骚扰世界各地造成最严重水污染的工厂。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can purify bodies of water with just a glance. It disdains pollution and has been known to harass factories across the world that generate the most water-affecting pollutants.

entry: POKENAME几乎完全不动，壳却坚固得受爆炸也无伤。需自卫时，它猛烈振动，造冲击脉冲，把烦扰者推开。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is almost completely immobile, but its shell is durable to the point of being able to resist explosions without a scratch. It vibrates intensely to create shockwave pulses to push nuisances back when it must defend itself.

entry: POKENAME卷起巨大沙暴，以不明闪光物质，晃花擅闯山中家园者。旅人看不见时，它就抓住，传送回入口。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME generates massive sandstorms of an unknown sparkling material to blind those who trespass its mountain home. While a traveler is blinded, it grabs them and teleports them back to the entrance.

entry: POKENAME住在风暴频繁的海岸附近。据说，无论飞到哪里，雷声都会随行。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME dwells near coastlines where storms are frequent. The sound of thunder is said to follow wherever it flies.

entry: POKENAME体内储有巨量电力。传闻，一只就能给整座城市供电一年。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME stores massive amounts of electricity in its body. It is rumored that a single POKENAME could power an entire city for a year.

entry: 传说，POKENAME见证宇宙诞生，以发光双翼，把原本单色的世界染上无数鲜艳颜色。
author: mepp.
source: Legends state that POKENAME witnessed the genesis of the universe and used their glowing wings to dye the once monochrome world with countless vibrant colors.

entry: 1000多年前的壁画，描绘这些林居宝可梦的体形外貌，与现代完全一致。有人曾以为它们穿越时间，其实只是十分长寿。
author: infinex21
source: There are some murals from over 1000 years ago that depict these forest-dwelling Pokémon at the exact same size and appearance as seen in modern times. Some once believed they could traverse time but, in actuality, they are just very long-lived.

entry: POKENAME把玩的行星，是拿∞能量造着玩的。它常以诡计之神的模样，干预那些天体上的生灵。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The planets POKENAME juggles were created out of Infinity Energy as a joke. It is commonly seen interfering with the creatures living on these astral bodies in the guise of a trickster god.

entry: 古传说说，一个强大文明曾以不当供品冒犯POKENAME。它只回以一道咒，月底前，文明便化为废墟。
author: sk372
source: An old legend states that once a mighty civilization offended POKENAME with an improper offering. POKENAME cast a single hex in return, and the civilization was in ruins before the month's end.

entry: 鸟宝可梦受POKENAME强大外形与气息鼓舞，聚在面前。它沉着指引，教大家平和、公正地行事。
author: sk372
source: Avian Pokémon flock before POKENAME, inspired by its powerful appearance and aura. It directs them calmly, teaching them to behave in a calm and just manner.

entry: 这些幼年宝可梦常转着自己的环玩。双臂因此练得出奇强，足以将环转得极快，逼退捕食者。
author: infinex21
source: These young Pokémon often play with their own ring by spinning it around. Their arms often end up surprisingly strong as a result, making them able to spin this ring fast enough to deter predators.

entry: POKENAME尾周漂着一圈球体，像行星绕日。它们能随意飞出追敌，每颗都能产生小而强的电击力场。
author: sk372
source: A ring of orbs floats around POKENAME's tail like planets orbiting a sun. These spheres can fly off at will and go after opponents, each able to generate small but potent fields of shocking electricity.

entry: POKENAME力量惊人，饿了又常破坏性闹脾气，许多古文明便定期供食安抚。如今还留有祭坛，让人放饭，供它享用。
author: sk372
source: Due to its impressive power and tendency to throw destructive tantrums when hungry, many ancient civilizations regularly offered food to placate POKENAME. Even now some altars remain for people to leave meals out for it to partake from.

entry: POKENAME跃出水面，身后会留闪亮轨迹。它能凭自身力量浮空，好奇时便到陆地游历探索。
author: sk372
source: A sparkling, glimmering trail follows behind POKENAME when it leaps out of the water. It can float through the air under its own power, allowing it to traverse on land and explore it when curiosity overtakes it.

entry: POKENAME是狡猾高效的猎手，先放自身幻象追猎物。等目标对付幻象、累得衰弱，它才出手。
author: sk372
source: A very cunning and efficient hunter, POKENAME first sends out illusory copies of itself after prey. While its target exhausts itself fighting off the illusions, POKENAME makes its moves and strikes while they're weakened.

entry: POKENAME能从掌心的孔发射纯粹由光构成的弹丸。准备向对手接连齐射时，头上的角会旋转、发亮，散出明耀光芒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has the power to fire projectiles of pure light from the holes in its palms. The horn on its head spins, glows and radiates brightly when it's preparing to launch a barrage of them at its opponent.

entry: POKENAME的石甲色调随状态改变。完全健康时光彩鲜艳，生病或疲惫，便褪成暗色。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's stone plating changes hues depending on its current state. Radiant and vibrant when at full health, if POKENAME is ill or exhausted, the color fades into a more dull coloration.

entry: 神奥出土的古文献，记载一个失落文化，曾把POKENAME奉为强大神灵。近年，更知名的却是某些科幻电影系列中的外星入侵者形象。
author: mepp.
source: Ancient texts discovered in Sinnoh describe a lost culture who regarded POKENAME as powerful deities. In recent years they are better recognized by their roles as alien invaders in some sci-fi film franchises.

entry: 山村曾把POKENAME当雷神。古时，人们献上被雷击过的树枝，作为神圣礼物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were once thought of as gods of lightning by mountain villages. In ancient times, people offered tree branches struck by lightning as sacred gifts.

entry: 故事说，POKENAME能从臂射出永不熄灭的光束。有人相信，最早的一只为夜空黑暗而忧伤，射出的光束残迹，就是流星。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Tales say that POKENAME can fire a beam of light out of its arm that is so bright it never goes out. Some believe that shooting stars are remnants of the beams fired by the first POKENAME that found itself distraught at the darkness of the night sky.

entry: POKENAME身旁漂浮的半环，能造光障保护自己。蜷成球时，环会造更大的圆障，让滚动冲锋更强。
author: sk372
source: The half-ring floating with POKENAME can generate a barrier of light to protect itself. When POKENAME rolls into a ball, the ring creates an even larger circular barrier around it, making its rolling charge that much more powerful.

entry: POKENAME常玩橙橙果，在尾端凹处转得极快，几乎像颗地球仪。受威胁时，以双翼放出震耳音爆自卫。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME often are seen playing with Oran Berries, spinning them within the indents at the tips of their tails at such speeds they almost look like a globe. When threatened, they defend themselves with deafening Sonic Booms loosed by their wings.

entry: 野外，POKENAME吸阳光作光合作用，周围地面便长出独特黄白花。它一起身走开，花就在闪光中消失。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME photosynthesizes sunlight in the wild, unique yellow and white flowers sprout from the ground surrounding it. Once it gets up and moves away, these flowers disappear in a flash of light.

entry: POKENAME几乎总有一圈坚冰相伴，用来进攻、防御。锋利的脚尖让它们能在冰上站稳，也能轻松滑行。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are almost always accompanied by a wreath of solid ice they use for offense and defense. The sharp tips of their feet allow them to stay steady atop ice and to skate effortlessly across ice as well.

entry: POKENAME的尾毒，能使意志较弱者将它视为神。中招者会供甜食数周，直到毒效终于消退。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tail venom could cause those with weaker minds to see it as divine. Affected individuals offered it sweets for weeks, until the toxin's influence finally faded.

entry: POKENAME虽是强大猎手，对伴侣却极亲昵。所爱者一死，就陷深沉沮丧，变得凶暴、好破坏。传说，唯有心地纯净者才能阻止。
author: agostostino
source: Though they are powerful predators, POKENAME show great affection toward their partners. If their loved one dies, they fall into a deep depression and become aggressive and destructive. Legends say it takes a pure hearted person to stop them.

entry: POKENAME住在冰川地区，进洞后冻住入口，保持独处。它一跺脚，地面便能升起巨冰柱，驱赶领地入侵者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives in glacial areas, entering caverns before freezing over the entrance with ice to remain isolated. It can create massive ice pillars from the ground by stomping, using it to dispel intruders in its territory.

entry: POKENAME力量巨大，却难以预测。跳进电脑后，升级、搅乱、与世界别处另一台对调，或直接毁掉，机会都一样。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's powers are immense but unpredictable. If it leaps into a computer, it has an equal chance of upgrading it, scrambling it, exchanging it with another across the world, or outright destroying it.

entry: POKENAME守望浓密森林，留意其他宝可梦，仿佛都是臣民。谁过于凶暴，就会被环上射出的锋利金光叶惩罚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stands watch in overgrown forest areas, keeping an eye on other Pokémon as if they were its subjects. Behaving too aggressively earns punishment via POKENAME firing off sharp, glowing golden leaves from its ring.

entry: POKENAME守护森林，不容领地受轻慢，对敌人毫不留情。漂浮金球能闪出积存的阳光，分散敌人注意，甚至令其失明。
author: sk372
source: A forest guardian that tolerates no disrespect of its domain, POKENAME is ruthless to its opponents. The golden orbs floating with it can distract and even blind foes with flashes of sunlight they've absorbed over time.

entry: 据说，POKENAME以1,000只臂创造了所有丛林。它极力保护，绝不宽恕任何破坏者。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME is said to be the creator of all jungles, having shaped them with 1,000 arms. It fiercely protects said jungles, showing no mercy to anyone who causes harm.

entry: POKENAME的头盔，让它感到力量与使命。身体虽小，却勇敢迎战，吐苍白火，伸张正义，对抗邪心者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's helmet gives it a sense of power and purpose. Though it is small, it fights with a brave heart, intent on serving justice to those with wicked hearts with the pale fire it breathes out.

entry: 它焦躁不安，自称拥有神格。至于究竟有没有神一般的力量，仍不清楚。
author: theheroict
source: An angsty Pokémon that claims to hold godhood. It's unknown if it actually possesses any god-like powers.

entry: POKENAME曾被奉为锻造与火焰之神。仪式会把其他宝可梦的羽毛撒在铁砧周围，安抚它们。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were once worshiped as gods of forges and fire. Feathers from other Pokémon were scattered around anvils in rituals meant to appease them.

entry: POKENAME最偏爱的那条臂，会长出如甲的金鳞。它们爱战，却不主动挑衅，而是借战磨炼。
author: infinex21
source: The arm favored most by an POKENAME is the one that grows clad in gold scales like armor. They enjoy battle, but do not antagonize others, instead using it to hone their skills.

entry: POKENAME打出连续的拳脚时，会用披风般的鬃毛，晃得敌人晕眩。不止如此，它们还能从脚底喷出火焰，加快踢击的速度。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their cape-like manes to daze their enemies as they perform combos of punches and kicks. If that were not enough already, they can also release bursts of flames from the soles of their feet to accelerate their kicks.

entry: 据说，POKENAME已将战斗艺术练到完美，掌握1000种战法。传说，它会把披风赐给时代最伟大的战士，象征成就。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to have perfected the art of combat and mastered 1000 fighting styles. Legends say it will gift its cloak to the greatest warriors of the era as a symbol of their accomplishment.

entry: POKENAME形状奇特的颊鳍，坚硬如筑巢的河岸岩床。颊鳍与叫声共鸣，让声音传得更远，联络同类。
author: infinex21
source: An POKENAME's peculiarly-shaped cheek fins are as rigid as the beds of riverside rocks they make their nests amidst. These fins can resonate with their cries and help them to travel further to communicate with others of their kind.

entry: POKENAME颊上的双叉鳍能强化叫声，更容易粉碎巨石。颊鳍最长的个体，通常会成为同类的追随对象。
author: infinex21
source: The twin-pronged fins upon the cheeks of these Pokémon help strengthen their cries to make it easier for them to pulverize large rocks. Those with the longest cheek fins are the ones that other POKENAME will typically follow.

entry: 古传说称，POKENAME是远古海岸聚落的守护者。人们相信，力量耐力惊人，能连续游泳1,000小时，不用休息。
author: mepp.
source: Legends from long ago cite POKENAME as a protector of ancient coastal settlements. It's believed its impressive strength and stamina could allow it to swim without rest for 1,000 hours.

entry: POKENAME有“神之子”的称号，人们因此像崇拜阿尔宙斯本尊一样敬奉它。
author: toxicrown
source: This Pokémon is given the title of God's Child. Because of this, people worship POKENAME as if it was Arceus itself.

entry: 古代，一睹POKENAME舞姿被视为神赐祝福。优雅动作与闪光跳跃牢牢吸睛，表演结束前，鲜有人能移开目光。
author: sk372
source: To behold POKENAME's dances was considered a divine blessing in ancient times. Its graceful movements and sparkling leaps command attention, and few can look away until the performance is finished.

entry: POKENAME用念力控制三个独立的环，作为武器、盾与短程传送门。它常穿环跳舞，而门只彼此相连。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME control three separate rings using their telekinetic powers. These rings serve as weapons, shields, and short-ranged portals through which POKENAME will often dance and jump through. These portals are connected only to one another.

entry: POKENAME控制重力法则，能碾压从单只宝可梦到整座村庄的威胁。它虽难觅，也会与训练家深结羁绊，带其穿虫洞，守护安全。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME controls the law of gravity, allowing it to crush threats from individual Pokémon to entire villages. While elusive, it has been known to bond strongly with Trainers and protect them by taking them through wormholes.

entry: POKENAME极忠于训练家，以庞大异世之力保护。它能违抗重力，必要时用同样原理造黑洞，作为护主最后手段。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are incredibly loyal to their Trainers and wield their immense, otherworldly power to protect them. They use this power to defy gravity and will use that same concept to create a black hole as a last resort to protect their Trainers.

entry: 古记载说，某些文明因宗教禁忌，禁止描绘POKENAME。据说它力量与仁慈皆无限，只向肩负更高使命的被选者现身。
author: sk372
source: Ancient records show that some civilizations banned the depiction of POKENAME as a religious taboo. It was said to be a being of unlimited power and unlimited kindness that only appeared before those chosen for a higher purpose.

entry: POKENAME曾被认为只是民间传说中的阿尔宙斯忠实守卫。金色臂刃一挥，就能解决成群敌人。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME was once thought to exist solely in folklore as the steadfast guardians of Arceus. It can dispatch hordes of hostile foes with one swing of its golden arm-blades.

entry: 它焦躁不安，自称拥有神格。至于究竟有没有神一般的力量，仍不清楚。
author: theheroict
source: An angsty Pokémon that claims to hold godhood. It's unknown if it actually possesses any god-like powers.

entry: POKENAME狂妄自大，总吹嘘自己凌驾众生。还有个古怪爱好：追逐野生六尾。
author: dyo_jonah
source: POKENAME is a creature of great hubris, often bragging about its superiority to all creatures. It has a strange hobby of chasing wild Vulpix.

entry: 它焦躁不安，自称拥有神格。至于究竟有没有神一般的力量，仍不清楚。
author: theheroict
source: An angsty Pokémon that claims to hold godhood. It's unknown if it actually possesses any god-like powers.

entry: POKENAME能改变全身各处颜色，完美融入周围。长而柔的舌灵活惊人，足以算作额外肢体。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can change the colors of every part of its body to seamlessly blend into its surroundings. Its long and flexible tongue moves with remarkable dexterity, enough to be considered an extra limb.

entry: 据说，POKENAME以1,000只臂创造天体时，会精算质量与外形。天体物理学家的实验室，常有它的图像。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: It's said that POKENAME calculates the precise mass and appearance of celestial objects as it creates them with its 1,000 arms. Astrophysicists often have imagery of POKENAME in their lab.

entry: 据说，POKENAME曾造传奇水坝，阻止古代洪灾。故事称，几分钟就能放倒整片森林，却从未被目击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME are said to have built legendary dams that stopped floods in ancient lands. Tales claim they could fell entire forests in minutes, though this has never been witnessed.

entry: 固定POKENAME的实心金属，被认为来自最初恒星。传闻，凝视无形身体深处，能回望宇宙大爆炸。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The solid metal that forms the anchor point for POKENAME is thought to have formed from the very first stars. Staring deep within the incorporeal body of an POKENAME is rumoured to let you see back in time to the Big Bang.

entry: POKENAME已练到战力顶峰。据说，光让波导高涨，就足以吓得除最勇敢、最配得一战者外的所有斗士投降。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has trained itself to the pinnacle of combat prowess. It is said that just flaring its aura is enough to cow all but the bravest and most worthy of combatants into surrender.

entry: 据说，被POKENAME咬过会受诅咒，迷失蜿蜒洞穴。某些传说描绘全身有1,000张嘴，却从未提出实证。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME was said to curse those it bit, causing them to become lost within winding caves. Some legends describe it as having 1,000 mouths across its body, despite no real evidence of this being presented.

entry: POKENAME曾被奉为龙形战神。战士把鳞片缝进甲，相信能确保取胜。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were once revered as draconic gods of battle. Warriors stitched their scales into armor, believing this would secure victory in combat.

entry: POKENAME急切想尽早进化，从不停下能量收集，进食、光合或扎根土中。它能吸尽整颗星球的养分，再换下一颗。
author: milchik
source: Desperate to evolve as soon as possible, POKENAME never stops gathering energy, either by eating, through photosynthesis, or by rooting itself into the soil. It can drain an entire planet of its nutrients before moving to the next one.

entry: 据说，POKENAME赋予世间万物生命。花中孢子化成星尘，形成星系；撒遍宇宙的种子，则变行星与彗星。
author: milchik
source: This Pokémon is said to give life to everything there is in the world. The spores released from its flower become the stardust and form the galaxies, and the seeds POKENAME spreads across the cosmos turn into planets and comets.

entry: POKENAME十分友善，爱交朋友，也爱送礼。不过，谁若踩到它长长垂下的角，它就会勃然大怒，像挥动强有力的鞭子一样，将角四处甩动。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are very friendly Pokémon that love to make friends and love to bring gifts to others. However, if anyone steps upon the long, draping horn of an POKENAME then it will fly into a rage and flail it around like a powerful whip.

entry: POKENAME浮动触手抓住几乎所有靠近之物，扔进杯状身体。一周后，奇异液体从内溢出，至今无人愿尝。
author: sk372
source: Hovering tentacles snatch almost anything that draws near POKENAME and hurls it into its goblet-like form. A week later, a strange liquid spills over from within its confines. None have yet been willing to drink the concoction.

entry: POKENAME射出满含苍翠能量的强箭，箭落何处，草木便繁茂生长。短短几分钟，就能造出整片森林的生机。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME fires off powerful arrows full of verdant energy, growing lush flora wherever the arrows land. It can grow entire forests' worth of plant life within a few minutes.

entry: POKENAME能活数百万年，连太空也能生存。遇极端环境，便把壳硬成化石般，休眠等好时机。
author: milchik
source: This Pokémon can live for millions of years and will survive even in open space. When put in extreme conditions, POKENAME hardens its shell to a fossil-like state and hibernates until better times.

entry: 有些POKENAME被认为年长到可能见过镰刀盔、太古盔甲等古物种，首次登上陆地。它们睡在岩里，几百年才醒一次繁殖。
author: milchik
source: Some POKENAME are believed to be so old that they might have witnessed the ancient species like Kabutops and Armaldo emerging onto land for the first time. These Pokémon sleep inside the rocks and wake up once in several centuries to reproduce.

entry: POKENAME圆顶头骨由无法穿透、尚未完全分析的物质构成。冲撞头击产生的冲击波，压力足以拔树、碎巨石。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cranial dome is made of an impervious material that has yet to be fully analyzed. When it charges down something and strikes it with a headbutt, the resulting shockwave produces enough pressure to uproot trees and shatter boulders.

entry: 撞上POKENAME坚实头骨，会发共鸣与炫光。袭击者听不见、看不见，轻易就被反击的头撞送飞。
author: sk372
source: Knocking into POKENAME's solid skull produces a resonating sound and a blinding light. Attackers are left deafened and blinded, making it easy for POKENAME to send them flying with a retaliatory headbutt.

entry: POKENAME防御几乎无法穿透，巨大厚头甲尤其如此。被击中便放炫光，再施严厉反击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's defenses are nearly impenetrable, particularly its huge and thick skull plating. Strikes against it cause it to radiate a blinding light, leading to POKENAME delivering a punishing counterattack.

entry: POKENAME曾被奉为悲剧之神，被认为能预示灾难。城镇以宝石围圈献供，盼安抚它，免遭洪水或毁灭。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were once revered as gods of tragedy, believed to herald disasters before they struck. Towns formed circles of gemstones in ritual offerings, hoping to calm their presence and avert floods or ruin.

entry: 故事说，POKENAME用天线与来世交流，知道该引导哪些灵魂。尽管如此，它却常把时间用来恶作剧，散播恐惧。
author: infinex21
source: Stories claim that POKENAME use their antenna to communicate with the afterlife so they know which spirits they must guide. Yet, in spite of these stories, these Pokémon often spend their time spreading terror through pranks.

entry: 传闻，POKENAME曾仿其他宝可梦造木偶，只为看互相打架取乐。它降下、挑战值得的敌人时，会发低沉邪笑。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is rumored to have been responsible for creating puppets modeled after other Pokémon simply to watch them fight each other for its own entertainment. A deep, evil laugh can be heard from it as it descends to challenge a worthy foe.

entry: POKENAME体形几乎和威势一样巨大。它在水中慢游，挤进打斗双方之间，制止战斗；皮肤坚韧，也能承受它们转而攻击自己。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is almost as massive as the presence it commands. It swims slowly through the water, stopping fights by getting between the combatants, its tough skin resisting their attempts to battle it instead.

entry: 它拥有宇宙中每种元素的力量。传说认为，这才是POKENAME真正力量的展现。
author: zerpus
source: It has the powers of each and every element of the universe. Legends claim this is POKENAME tapping into its true power.

entry: 某些理论认为，常见的阿尔宙斯只是化身，这个形态才最接近人类能理解的真身。科学界大多嗤之以鼻。
author: sk372
source: Some theorists believe the common depiction of Arceus is merely an avatar, and that this form is the closest approximation of its true form that humans can comprehend. Most scientific communities treat the idea with heavy derision.

entry: POKENAME实体身后有高大幻象，显得吓人。很少有人见过它用能力，有些人便声称，幻象能成就前所未见的壮举。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have an illusory form behind their physical bodies that stands tall to appear menacing. Some people claim that this illusory form is capable of feats never seen before, as few have seen POKENAME use their powers.

entry: 神话中，POKENAME创造许多世界。有些学者认为，神奥相关文献远多于其他地区，因此神话或许源自那里。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: According to mythology, POKENAME are the creators of many worlds. Some scholars believe that this myth originated in Sinnoh, the region having a larger volume of texts about POKENAME than other regions.

entry: POKENAME壳上的土，是已知最鲜活、养分最丰富的。种子种下，不到一周就长成，生机勃勃。
author: sk372
source: The dirt on POKENAME's shell is the freshest and most nutrient rich soil known to man. Seeds planted in its shell will grow to full size, full of life, in less than a week.

entry: POKENAME背上的生长物，是矿物过饱和的硬土。同类交战磨碎后，碎块混入地面，成为植物喜爱的肥沃土壤。
author: milchik
source: The growths on this Pokémon's back are made of hardened soil oversaturated with minerals. When POKENAME grinds them down by fighting others of its kind, the rubble of its growths mix with the ground below and create a rich mix beloved by plants.

entry: POKENAME的壳纹像一座曾留下阿尔宙斯罕见目击记录的神殿。有人说，它睡觉时，背壳风景里会隐约传出笛声。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's shell pattern resembles a temple where one of the only known Arceus sightings was recorded.  When it sleeps, some say they can faintly hear the sound of a flute playing from the landscape on its shell.

entry: POKENAME用头冠边缘的火焰，展现壮观焰火，威吓其他对象。力量虽强，性子却胆小，威吓失败，往往逃而不战。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME intimidates others with a great display of pyrotechnics utilizing the flames burning on the edges of its crest. Despite having great power, it's rather timid, and tends to flee rather than fight if the intimidation fails.

entry: POKENAME身上的烛火，可能呈现各种不同颜色。似乎曾有一个团体，试着解读火焰的颜色，甚至形状，以预测未来。
author: bobosmith01
source: The candle flames on POKENAME's body may come in a variety of different colors. It seems there was once a group that tried to interpret the color and even the shape of the flames to predict the future.

entry: POKENAME被逼入角落，力量会突然暴涨，火焰变色、烧得更烈。虽战得凶猛，结束后却似乎不记得自己施展过巨力。
author: sk372
source: When backed into a corner, POKENAME displays a sudden surge of power, its flames changing color and burning more fiercely. While it fights ferociously, once the battle is over it seems not to remember its own display of strength.

entry: POKENAME很看重力量，总想炫耀，令其他对象佩服。它能吹整面泡墙攻击，却因过度勉强自己，弄得头晕脚软。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME thinks highly of its own power, always trying to show off and impress others. It can blow an entire wall of bubbles as an attack, but doing so leaves it reeling from overextending itself.

entry: POKENAME羽毛顺滑，在水与冰盖上都能轻松滑行。中世纪，它曾是代表警觉与荣誉的纹章象征。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's sleek feathers allow it to glide in the water and on icecaps with ease. In medieval times, it was used as a heraldic symbol that represented vigilance and honor.

entry: 古代英雄用过的一件传说武器，曾照POKENAME面甲的形状打造。据说，它的鳍缘能干净切过最强韧的材料。
author: sk372
source: A legendary weapon once used by a hero of ancient history was fashioned to resemble POKENAME's face plate. The edges of POKENAME's flippers are said to be able to cut cleanly through even the strongest of materials.

entry: 或许因过去受崇拜，POKENAME极其傲慢。若没获应有尊崇，就降下道道光束，惩罚冒犯者。
author: sk372
source: Perhaps due to being worshiped in the past, POKENAME has a very haughty personality. If it is not properly venerated, it punishes the insulting party by raining down beams of light at them.

entry: POKENAME周围漂着三个使魔，协助战斗。它用超能力，使魔则小幅操纵时间、空间与反物质，分散对手注意。
author: sk372
source: The three familiars floating around POKENAME help aid it in battle. While POKENAME uses psychic powers, the familiars distract opponents with small displays of manipulating time, space and antimatter.

entry: POKENAME在高山，以磁力造小雕像作消遣。有些探险者因此偷走，误以为发现了古代神像或文物。
author: npshi
source: POKENAME use their magnetic prowess to create small statues as a hobby to pass the time in high mountains. This has resulted in several explorers stealing them, believing they have found ancient idols or artifacts.

entry: POKENAME蕴含阿尔宙斯的伟力，据说能摧毁宇宙，与阿尔宙斯的创造之力维持平衡。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Imbued with the might of Arceus, POKENAME is said to have the power to destroy the universe to balance Arceus' creation.

entry: 数百年传说都说，挥舞POKENAME的人，会引人类进入黄金时代。每一剑留下炫目金光，盾每受击也灿烂闪耀。
author: sk372
source: Legends persisted for centuries that the one who would wield POKENAME would lead humanity into a golden era. Every slash of its blade leaves a dazzling golden trail of light, and its shield shines brilliantly with every impact it receives.

entry: POKENAME曾被视为骑士与战士的守护者。人们每年把剑放在山顶，求战斗中得眷顾。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were once thought to be guardians of knights and warriors. Swords were placed atop mountains each year to gain their favor in battle.

entry: POKENAME凭强大金眼，从自己的维度观察世间一切。据说，它介入惩恶，用电攻的炫光，令恶徒失明。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME observes everything that happens in the world from its own dimension through the powers of its mighty golden eyes. It is said that it intervenes to punish evildoers by blinding them with the dazzling light of its electric attacks.

entry: POKENAME有时立在崖顶，凭锐眼注视远下方。咆哮能召来闪电，将最强雷击，放向认定值得动用此力量的对象。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are sometimes spotted atop cliffs, watching far below with their powerful eyes. They can call upon lightning itself with their roar and will let loose their most powerful bolts upon those they judge are worth such power.

entry: POKENAME覆有坚硬磨光的大理石，大幅增强防御。有理论认为，连陨石撞击也能承受。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's body is covered in a hard, polished marble that greatly enhances its defensive capabilities. It's theorized that this Pokémon could even withstand a meteor strike.

entry: POKENAME曾被奉为沙神。沙漠村落在附近沙丘雕出精巧图案，讨它们欢心。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were believed to be gods of sand. Desert villages carved intricate patterns into nearby dunes to keep them pleased.

entry: POKENAME中空的翼，为何能让它飞得如此好，研究者仍在探索。同样的翼，也常用作风铃。
author: infinex21
source: Researchers are still studying how the hollow wings of an POKENAME allow it to fly as well as it does. These very same wings are often used in wind chimes.

entry: 准确画出POKENAME游泳之美，是许多艺术家的梦。跃出水面时，身后灿烂光迹，被许多人形容为令人屏息、足以改变一生的景色。
author: sk372
source: The dream of many artists is to be able to properly depict POKENAME's beauty as it swims. A radiant, shining trail follows its leaps above water in what many describe as a breathtaking, life-changing view.

entry: 古石板描绘，POKENAME翔于云端，尽责守望早期文明。光辉吐息威力极强，足以熔钢。
author: mepp.
source: Old stone tablets depict POKENAME dutifully watching over early civilizations while it soared in the clouds. Its radiant breath is powerful enough to melt steel.

entry: 它们不断旋转的环产生越多能量，轻烟般的身体就越长、越亮。环能护住四周，也能爆发能量，逼退或击败敌人。
author: infinex21
source: Their wispy bodies grow and shine the more energy produced by their constantly-spinning rings. Their rings offer a radial defense and can release bursts of energy to deter or defeat foes.

entry: POKENAME以高明幻术与模仿闻名。某些荒诞理论认为，近半人类只是它用来观察、混入人群的仿造人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is known for how effective its illusions and mimicry abilities are. There are some crackpot theories that believe nearly half of humanity are just simulacra used by POKENAME to observe and mingle with humans.

entry: POKENAME潜入城镇，寻找掌权者。找到后，就假扮对方，在居民间制造混乱。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME stalks towns, searching for people in power. After locating said people, POKENAME disguises itself as them in order to sow chaos among the townsfolk.

entry: POKENAME厌恶暴力，一见打架，就瞬移到双方旁边，以缎带碰触。轻轻一下，最暴烈的宝可梦也能平静。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME abhors violence, its first response to seeing a fight being to teleport next to the combatants and touch them with its ribbons. A single gentle touch is enough to pacify even the most violent of Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME不断展示力量，确保其他生灵以王者之礼敬它。它一拳裂地，或一甩尾毁建筑，显示威能。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes sure that others respect it as a king with constant displays of power. It shows off its might by punching the ground to crack it or destroying structures with a single swing of its tail.

entry: POKENAME稀少，人们推测能在维度间游泳。它精通水，几乎任何海都能游，使周身水体完全宜居，极寒也不例外。
author: chibitales
source: Due to POKENAME's rarity, it's thought they are able to swim through dimensions. Their mastery over water allows them to swim in nearly any ocean, making the water surrounding their body perfectly habitable for them, even in frigid temperatures.

entry: 传说，这些巨大宝可梦曾优雅游过云层。古人崇拜，却也忌惮力量，因为据说，POKENAME能用狂暴风暴抹去整个文明。
author: actliux
source: Legends tell of when these massive Pokémon swam gracefully across the clouds. People in ancient times would worship them, yet were cautious of their power, as POKENAME were said to be capable of wiping out entire civilizations with a ravenous storm.

entry: POKENAME移动、塑造脚下大地的能力，无可匹敌。有人相信，不到一天，就能彻底重塑世界大陆。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's power to move and shape the ground beneath it is unmatched. Some believe it could move and reshape the continents of the world completely in less than a day.

entry: 传说末日之时，POKENAME会伴着刺目光芒自天而降。人们每年献上供物，盼其息怒。
author: nellnast42
source: It is said that, in the end times, POKENAME will descend from the skies with a piercing light. Tributes are made each year to appease it.

entry: 它能放光，安抚甚至控制其他传说的宝可梦，强迫沉睡。逃回天空时，就无影无踪地消失。
author: bobosmith01
source: It can let out a ray of light that can calm and even control other Legendary Pokémon and force them into slumber. When it flees back into the skies, it vanishes without a trace.

entry: 它能放光，安抚甚至控制其他传说的宝可梦，强迫沉睡。逃回天空时，就无影无踪地消失。
author: bobosmith01
source: It can let out a ray of light that can calm and even control other Legendary Pokémon and force them into slumber. When it flees back into the skies, it vanishes without a trace.

entry: 它能放光，安抚甚至控制其他传说的宝可梦，强迫沉睡。逃回天空时，就无影无踪地消失。
author: bobosmith01
source: It can let out a ray of light that can calm and even control other Legendary Pokémon and force them into slumber. When it flees back into the skies, it vanishes without a trace.

entry: POKENAME住在高空，攻击性极强，以强劲气流袭击其他对象。劲风连最坚固的金库门，也能吹穿。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: POKENAME is a highly aggressive Pokémon found at high altitudes that attacks others by using powerful blasts of wind. These wind blasts are powerful enough to blow through the sturdiest vault door.

entry: POKENAME掌控时间流动，力量无匹。古经文警告，别惹怒，否则据说会使人衰老至化尘，或永远定格在时间里，作为惩罚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses an unparalleled power over the flow of time. Ancient scriptures warned against angering it, as it would supposedly age a person to dust or leave them forever frozen in time as punishment.

entry: POKENAME轻松操纵空间边界，开出横跨宇宙的传送门。谁招来怒火，就会被放逐其中，再也不返。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can manipulate spacial boundaries with ease, opening portals that can reach across the universe. Those that earn its fury get banished into one of these portals, never to return.

entry: 据说，POKENAME统治与我们截然不同的世界。它很少现身这个维度，少数记录里，也只是静静观察人类。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to rule over a world vastly different from our own. It rarely makes appearances in this dimension, and the few recorded visits detail it doing little more than quietly observing humanity.

entry: POKENAME长期被视为噩梦之神。受恶梦困扰的人，睡前焚香，希望把困扰驱走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were long believed to be gods of nightmares. Those plagued by bad dreams burned incense before sleep in hopes of chasing them away.

entry: POKENAME被认为是人类已知最可怕的宝可梦之一。孩子到老人，想纠缠谁都行，再造恐怖梦境，创伤猎物心灵。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME is considered one of the most dreadful Pokémon known to humanity. It haunts any person it desires, from children to the elderly. It creates horrifying dreams to traumatize its prey.

entry: POKENAME从炮射出的审判光束，威力取决于炮管插入的石板。它能随意显出属性石板，确保总有敌人最怕的属性。
author: sk372
source: The power of POKENAME's beam of judgment shot from its cannon is tied to the plate inserted into the barrel. POKENAME can manifest elemental plates at will, ensuring it always has access to the type its foe is weakest to.

entry: POKENAME避免冲突，受威胁却能喷出熔石的火。古记载警告，惹怒它，会让整个地区遭灾。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME avoid conflict, but when threatened, they are capable of releasing fire hot enough to melt stone. Ancient records warn that angering the Pokémon will bring calamity to an entire region.

entry: POKENAME曾被视为与新月相连的月神。孩子每年在近处山丘叠石，举行献供仪式。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were thought to be lunar deities tied to the new moon. Children stacked stones atop nearby hills each year as a ritual offering.

entry: POKENAME尾部涡轮蓄雷时，轰鸣传出数英里。漂在身边的石板，据说帮助引导能量，化成破坏性闪电。
author: sk372
source: The turbine on POKENAME's tail makes a thunderous roar that can be heard for miles as it charges up lightning. The stone plate that floats near it is said to help it channel its energy into destructive bolts.

entry: POKENAME的涡轮尾巴产生原初宇宙能量，使它能够动用创世之力。
author: junohnebula
source: POKENAME's turbine tail generates a primal cosmic energy, allowing this fusion to tap into powers of creation.

entry: POKENAME住在被自然收复的古代遗迹，担任守护者。花朵传闻能治百病，极受追捧。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME dwell in ancient ruins reclaimed by nature and act as guardians. Their flowers are rumored to cure any ailment and are highly sought after.

entry: POKENAME浮在极高空，鲜少降近地面。光是存在，就会让附近其他对象开始浮空。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats at an incredibly high point in the air, rarely coming down closer to the ground. Its very presence causes others nearby to begin floating up into the air.

entry: POKENAME看似巨力惊人，却仍胆小易惊。只有最善良、最耐心的心灵，才能交友，获得强大忠诚的伙伴。
author: sk372
source: Despite seeming to possess massive power, POKENAME is still timid and easily frightened. Only those with the kindest and most patient souls will be able to befriend it, gaining a powerful and loyal ally in the process.

entry: POKENAME多翼让它飞得极快，仿佛瞬间移动。极速飞行时，还会留下淡淡残影。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's multiple wings let it fly at immensely high speeds. It moves so quickly that it seems to be teleporting, leaving behind a faint afterimage when it flies at its top speeds.

entry: POKENAME曾被奉为墓园神灵，守望不安的亡者。人们每年把毛绒玩具放在葬地，盼祖先安宁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were once revered as deities of cemeteries, believed to watch over the restless dead. Plush toys were placed yearly at burial sites in hopes that ancestors would be granted peace.

entry: POKENAME用诅咒针刺穿现实结构，开门通往传说的宝可梦骑拉帝纳所在的扭曲异维度。它还能用魔法红线，把门缝好。
author: milchik
source: With its cursed needles, POKENAME can pierce through the very fabric of reality and create a portal to another, twisted dimension where the Legendary Pokémon Giratina resides. POKENAME can stitch the portal closed with its magical red thread.

entry: 传说，阿尔宙斯送人去神奥过去后，会赠予这种宝可梦。POKENAME像手机，也能用作地图。
author: gamelord64
source: Legends say this Pokémon is given by Arceus after sending someone to the Sinnoh region's past. POKENAME looks like a phone but can be used as a map.

entry: POKENAME的核心很少移动，让人怀疑是否有意识，甚至能否感知。身体会本能回应其他生灵，察觉动机，再温柔或粗暴地触碰。
author: sk372
source: The core rarely moves, making some wonder if POKENAME is conscious or even sentient. Its body reacts instinctively to the presence of others, sensing their motives before reacting with gentle or violent touches accordingly.

entry: POKENAME曾被视为月之半神。许多文化在年内第一次满月，办盛宴致敬。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were believed to be demigods of the moon. Many cultures held grand feasts during the first full moon of the year to honor them.

entry: 这种稀有宝可梦随风走遍世界，所到之处都捣蛋。有时POKENAME玩过头，魔力足以把整栋房子，传到星球另一头。
author: milchik
source: This rare Pokémon travels all over the world, following the winds and causing mischief wherever it goes. Sometimes POKENAME's pranks go too far, as its magic is powerful enough to teleport an entire house to the opposite side of the planet.

entry: POKENAME外表华丽，也总构思花哨的力量展示。若觉得努力没让看客惊艳，竟会显出类似焦虑的状态。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is always coming up with flashy displays of power to go along with its flashy appearance. It actually exhibits something akin to anxiety if it feels that its efforts have failed to impress onlookers.

entry: 据说，POKENAME守着神奥最神圣珍贵的遗物。无数故事里，盗贼进庙想捞快钱，却再没回来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to guard the most sacred and treasured relics in all of Sinnoh. Countless stories exist of thieves entering its temples to make a quick buck and never returning.

entry: POKENAME产的蛛丝格外柔软，是神圣衣饰的珍贵材料。人们尤其看重舒适的触感与灿烂光泽。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME produces exceptionally soft webbing prized in sacred garments. The thread was valued for its comfort and radiant sheen.

entry: POKENAME曾被奉为密林与繁茂草木的半神。村民把新割藤蔓放石上，相信能保佑免病。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were revered as demigods of dense jungles and wild growth. Villagers left freshly cut vines upon stones, believing this would protect them from disease.

entry: POKENAME火焰强得无法浇灭，最大的房间也能完全照亮。据说，拿得够久，人就能让身体自行发光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses a flame so strong that it cannot be doused and illuminates even the largest of rooms completely. It's said that holding it long enough will grant a person the ability to create luminescence from their own body.

entry: 据说，远远看见POKENAME的灿烂光辉是吉兆。它向深陷恐惧者现身，令看见者心中涌起温暖与自信。
author: sk372
source: Seeing the radiant light of POKENAME's body in the distance is said to be a good omen. It appears before those experiencing dire dread, its radiance causing feelings of warmth and confidence to well within the viewer.

entry: POKENAME曾漂在沼泽上空，被视为引导迷魂的神。村民见到就燃烛，盼灵魂别被引进家。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were once seen drifting through swamp skies and were believed to be gods that guided lost spirits. Villagers burned candles when they appeared, hoping to keep spirits from being led into their homes.

entry: POKENAME一甩头，就能造弧形光刃。战斗中破坏力极强，连续劈过数棵树，也不减速、不变钝。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can create arcing blades of light with a swing of its head. These cutters are devastating in combat, powerful enough to cleave through several trees in a row without losing speed or sharpness.

entry: 传说，古文明用蕴藏神力的石板碎片，造出POKENAME。碎片赋予巨力，让它守护最重要的神庙。
author: sk372
source: Supposedly, POKENAME was created by old civilizations using fragments of plates said to hold the power of deities within. These granted POKENAME immense strength used to guard their most important temples.

entry: POKENAME巨肢能打出重击，也能向内蜷腿，像炮般放能量。活动时绿球发光，一黯淡就立刻休息。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can deliver devastating blows with their massive limbs or coil their legs inward to unleash energy blasts like cannons. Their green orbs glow when active, and if the light fades, they immediately rest.

entry: POKENAME能随意从尾巴造出六颗金色发光火球。它们随行、自主防卫，烧灼近敌，也拦截远攻。
author: sk372
source: At will, POKENAME can create six orbs of glowing golden fire from its tails. These fireballs follow it around and act as autonomous defense, burning enemies that come close and intercepting long-range attacks.

entry: POKENAME吐出内脏，与其他生灵互动。内部由纯光构成，能形成拳爪，一碰便烧伤。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME expels its innards to interact with others. Its insides are made of pure light, able to form fists and claws that can burn others on contact.

entry: 鲜有人获准碰POKENAME的钥匙，更别提使用。传说，每把都能开门穿越时空，甚至前往全然不同的维度。
author: sk372
source: Few are allowed to touch, let alone use, POKENAME's keys. According to legends, each one can open portals through time, space or even to entirely different dimensions.

entry: POKENAME的外形与力量，使过去某些小文明崇拜它。但它只想要友谊，并非崇拜。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's appearance and powers have caused it to be worshiped by some small civilizations in the past. However, what it wants is not worship but merely friendship.

entry: 据说，POKENAME自太古便已存在。它只服从值得信任的训练家，相信对方会用近乎无限的力量行善。
author: mepp.
source: It is said that POKENAME has been around since the dawn of antiquity. POKENAME only obeys worthy Trainers it can trust to do good with its nearly limitless power.

entry: POKENAME会在梦中化作明光现身。凡目睹它的人，醒来后都会神情恍惚。
author: skymaster426
source: POKENAME can be found within people's dreams, appearing as a bright light. Anyone who witnesses it can be found in a trance after waking.

entry: POKENAME虽没有看东西的眼，却凭超常感知掌握四周。它从口放小光束，攻击领地入侵者。
author: sk372
source: Despite lacking eyes to see, POKENAME has a sense of clairvoyance that alerts it to its surroundings. It fires small beams of light from its mouth to attack those who intrude upon its territory.

entry: POKENAME三颗头都能射出毁灭性光束。破坏似乎不分对象，几分钟就能把整座城化为瓦砾与灰。
author: sk372
source: Destructive beams of light can be fired from all three of POKENAME's heads. It seems indiscriminate in its destruction and can leave an entire city in rubble and ash in just a few minutes.

entry: POKENAME以惊人速度疾掠大地，只为受伤、需要环上疗愈之光的对象停下。故事说，它在找与自己对应、力量更强而沉着的另一只宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME jets across the land at incredible speeds, only stopping when it sees someone hurt and in need of the healing light from its ring. Stories say it searches for its stronger, more stoic counterpart.

entry: POKENAME以惊人速度疾掠大地，只在察觉必须审判的不公时停下。故事说，它在找与自己对应、更仁慈温柔的另一只宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME jets across the land at incredible speeds, only stopping when it senses an injustice it must cast judgment upon. Stories say it travels in search of its kinder, gentler counterpart.

entry: 据说，现有多少种宝可梦属性，POKENAME就有多少条尾。身法灵活、踪迹难觅，令科学家难以研究。
author: chibitales
source: It is said that an POKENAME has one tail for every existing Pokémon Type. Its nimbleness and elusive nature create difficulties for scientists studying it.

entry: 这些太空宝可梦的核心，常被认为亮到会被误认成夜空星辰。有观察数据显示，它们摧毁靠近的小行星，以碎屑为食。
author: infinex21
source: The core of these space-bound Pokémon are often thought to be able to shine so bright they are mistaken for the stars of a night sky. Some observational data has shown that they destroy approaching asteroids and feed on the debris.

entry: 数千年前，人们崇拜POKENAME，认为能给选中的纯净者实现愿望。许多人相信来自太空，因为最初就是从星光天空深处降下。
author: sk372
source: Thousands of years in the past, people worshiped POKENAME as a granter of wishes to the chosen pure. Many believe it came from space, as it first appeared descending from deep within a starlit sky.

entry: 野生POKENAME睡时像小星，飘在天空。醒来便飞向最近光源，希望遇见人类或其他宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME drift in the sky like little stars as they sleep. When they awaken, they fly toward the nearest source of light in hopes of meeting people or other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME太罕见，曾被认为每1,000年才从地下家园出来。众多洞穴能疏土通气，改善作物收成。
author: mepp.
source: Sightings of POKENAME are so rare that it was once believed they only emerge from their underground home every 1,000 years. Their many burrows aerate the land, which can improve crop yields.

entry: POKENAME曾被视为湖泊与静水之神。秋天，人们在湖边收落枝，献供赞颂。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were believed to be the deities of lakes and still waters. In autumn, people gathered fallen branches at lakesides as offerings of praise.

entry: POKENAME总挂在背后环上，有人因此争论能否独自浮空。它慢且少动，却从无危险，因为靠近的一切都会被倦怠虚弱压倒。
author: sk372
source: Because POKENAME is always hanging from the ring behind it, some debate if it can hover on its own. It moves slowly and rarely, but is never in danger; anything that gets close to it is overwhelmed by a sense of lethargy and weakness.

entry: POKENAME虽无意，却是破坏性祸患。力量过大、控制不住，便不断奔跑挥肢、迸发光芒，通常造成巨大财产损失。
author: sk372
source: Though it doesn't mean to be, POKENAME is a destructive menace. It has too much power to control and constantly runs around venting that energy with swinging limbs and bursts of light, usually causing immense property damage in the process.

entry: POKENAME虽小，体内电力潜能却大。稍微集中，就能在头上造浮球，爆开后让闪电倾泻四周。
author: sk372
source: Though small of stature, POKENAME contains a lot of electrical potential. It needs only to concentrate a little to generate a floating orb above its head that bursts and showers the area with lightning.

entry: POKENAME独眼强劲，数英里外也能看清。也用来引导体内电力，向敌轰出极强闪电。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's single eye is powerful enough to see clearly for miles into the distance. It also serves to direct the electricity in its body, shooting out intensely powerful bursts of lightning at its foes.

entry: POKENAME歌声奇异，仿佛扭曲周围，语言无人能懂。听着睡去的人，看见难分梦境与预言的幻景。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's song is a strange sound that almost seems to distort the areas around it, sung in a language none understand. Those that fall asleep listening to it have visions that blur the lines between dreams and prophecies.

entry: POKENAME总吃不够，幸好靠岩石矿物就能维生。强力咬碎若不足以击败敌人，就改喷猛烈能量攻击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can never seem to eat enough, though thankfully they can sustain themselves on rocks and minerals. When their powerful Crunches are not enough to defeat a foe, they will spew a powerful energy attack instead.

entry: POKENAME双翼摩擦，产生强大超声波，能令前方空气明显扭曲。中招者不只被击退，还会完全失去平衡感。
author: sk372
source: Rubbing POKENAME's wings together creates ultrasonic waves powerful enough to visibly distort the air in front of it. Those hit with these waves are not only knocked back, but lose all sense of equilibrium.

entry: POKENAME把力量用在颇琐碎的心思上。它在意外表，便向周围施催眠幻象，让其他对象赞美容貌。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its powers for rather petty motives. Self-conscious of its appearance, it casts hypnotic illusions on those around it to make them praise its good looks.

entry: POKENAME十分小巧，明亮绿核常露在外。金环能转得极快、发动极突然，因此很少愁防御。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are very small Pokémon with bright green cores so often visible. They can spin their golden ring so quick, and so suddenly, that defense is rarely a concern for them.

entry: 明亮绿核也充当眼睛，能不眨地凝视，几乎不让敌人离开视线。双环始终旋转，产生并储存能量，用于攻防。
author: infinex21
source: Its bright green core serves as an eye as well, which can stare unblinking and almost never lose sight of a foe. Its two rings are always spinning to produce and store energy within them, which can be loosed offensively or defensively.

entry: 或许古人崇拜过度，POKENAME常用幻术假扮其他宝可梦藏身。只有真正信任的对象，才会见到真形。
author: sk372
source: Perhaps because of being overly-worshiped by ancient humans, POKENAME often hides itself by using illusions to mimic other Pokémon. It only shares its true form with those it comes to truly trust.

entry: 据说，POKENAME赋予世间万物生命。花中孢子化成星尘，形成星系；撒遍宇宙的种子，则变行星与彗星。
author: milchik
source: This Pokémon is said to give life to everything there is in the world. The spores released from its flower become the stardust and form the galaxies, and the seeds POKENAME spreads across the cosmos turn into planets and comets.

entry: POKENAME尾尖的火焰亮如一轮小太阳，温度却只比烛火稍高。年轻训练家常喜欢带上一只，帮助自己穿过黑暗的隧道。
author: infinex21
source: The flame at the tip of an POKENAME's tail shines like a miniature sun, although it is only slightly hotter than a candle's flame. Young Trainers often favor having one of these Pokémon around to help them navigate dark tunnels.

entry: 开阔草甸附近的城镇，曾把POKENAME奉为作物之神。每春，人们献胡萝卜，祈求健康收成。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were believed to be gods of crops by towns near open meadows. Offerings of carrots were left each spring to ensure healthy harvests.

entry: POKENAME少数目击，全在新生儿附近盘旋，随后消失。动机未知，据说被它看过的孩子，长大后运气都好得惊人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's few sightings have always been while hovering close to the vicinity of newborn children before disappearing. It's not known what its motivations are, but the children it watched all reportedly grew up having uncannily good luck.

entry: POKENAME外层摸着柔软易弯，最尖利的工具却也刺不穿。受威胁时，能向四周放精神脉冲，震昏附近所有对象。
author: sk372
source: Although the layer around POKENAME is soft and pliable to the touch, not even the sharpest instrument can puncture it. If it feels threatened, it can create a psionic pulse all around it that knocks anyone nearby unconscious.

entry: POKENAME释放精神能量波，使附近生灵将它视为神。受影响的人，会一连数日被迫献树果。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases waves of psychic energy that cause those nearby to perceive it as divine. Under its influence, people were compelled to bring berries as offerings for days at a time.

entry: POKENAME的棉曾与熏香同置铜火盆，在宗教仪式焚烧。点燃后散出轻柔迷迭香，据说能安抚身心。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's cotton was once burned with incense in bronze braziers during religious ceremonies. When lit, it releases a gentle rosemary scent said to calm the mind and spirit.

entry: POKENAME纯真到近乎天真，几乎谁都信。终于察觉被骗，就会用大手拍打背叛者。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are incredibly innocent, bordering on pure naivety, and will often trust just about anyone. Once they finally realize they have been tricked, they will slap their betrayer with their large hands.

entry: 据说，POKENAME的图腾能使持有者不死。但它只在危机时，才会把图腾赐给认定值得的人。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's totem is said to grant the holder immortality. However, POKENAME will only grant its totem to someone it deems worthy during times of crisis.

entry: POKENAME要织网捕猎，就召来奇怪柱状物。丝织好，柱就消失，只留网悬浮，等猎物受困。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME summons strange pillar-like objects when it needs to spin a web and capture prey. Once the threads are spun, the pillars disappear and the web remains, hovering and waiting for prey to become ensnared.

entry: POKENAME羽毛曾在神圣仪式中，被放银碗焚烧。会散出提振精神的辛香。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feathers were once burned in silver bowls during sacred rites. The feathers released an energizing, spicy scent during the process.

entry: POKENAME睡在火山内，被认为光凭存在就能使其沉寂。若遭强行唤醒，可能怒令火山喷发。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sleeps within volcanoes, and is thought to keep them dormant with its presence. If forcibly awakened, it may cause the volcano to erupt in its anger.

entry: POKENAME平躺旧神庙，伪装石地板。若有什么踩上，就会爆出能量，亮起炫目闪光。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lays flat on the ground in old temple areas, camouflaging itself among the stone floor. If something steps on it, it emits a bright and blinding flash of light in a burst of energy.

entry: POKENAME把宝石眼反射的光，聚成能量球对敌。它傲慢，只对献上足够美丽宝石的对象，报以好脸色。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can focus light reflected from its jewel eyes into orbs of energy it uses against opponents. It has a haughty personality, and only responds positively to those who offer up a gem of sufficient beauty to it.

entry: POKENAME周身双环始终旋转，随时能作临时爪挥击；也能转得更快，形成近乎无法穿透的光盾。
author: sk372
source: Two rings constantly rotate around POKENAME's body. At any moment, they can lash out as makeshift claws, or spin even more rapidly, generating a near-impenetrable shield of light around it.

entry: 据说，POKENAME爪里一滴毒，几秒就能放倒传说的宝可梦。它大多蜷着，逼它站高发怒，被认为极其愚蠢。
author: sk372
source: Just a drop of the poison in POKENAME's claws is said to be able to fell legendary Pokémon in seconds. It stays curled up most of the time, and forcing it to stand tall and turn aggressive is considered extremely foolish.

entry: 人们相信，POKENAME在1,000多年前就存在，至今未全灭绝。身体适应多种环境，也有足够力量逼退大多数敌人，显示生存本领。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are believed to have lived over 1,000 years ago without their kind fully dying out to this day. As proof of their survivability, their bodies have adapted to survive in many environments and pack enough power to fight off most foes.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在寒冷地区独居，找不到这样的地方，就自行创造。它一挥手臂，便能冻结周围一英里内的环境，以及其中所有生灵，作为新家。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME prefers to live in frigid areas in solitude, and in the absence of such will create one. With a wave of its arm, it can freeze a mile of its surroundings and all who dwell in the area to make its new home.

entry: POKENAME夜里埋土吸月光，同时散出使周围土壤充满活力的气息，让附近植物在暗中发亮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends the nights buried in soil and absorbing moonlight. It generates an aura while taking in the light that energizes the soil around it, causing plants nearby to glow in the dark.

entry: 这种宝可梦游泳飞行一样出色。鳍与尾锚上的橙宝石，汲取宇宙能量，让POKENAME几秒便达逃逸速度。
author: milchik
source: This Pokémon is able to fly just as well as it swims. The orange gems on its fins and tail anchors draw energy from the cosmos, allowing POKENAME to reach escape velocity in a matter of seconds.

entry: POKENAME是远方偏僻森林的幽灵。只有孩子能安然穿过领地；成人会被传回入口，脑中朦胧混乱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a ghostly spirit that inhabits remote forests across the land. Only children can travel its domain unscathed; adults are teleported back to the entrance, their minds left hazy and confused.

entry: 这些宝可梦常在石化树木附近，无论倒下还是仍立着。它们温柔顺从，只关心培育、保护树。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon are often found near sites of petrified trees, be they cut down or still standing. They have shown to be gentle and docile, caring only to nurture trees and protect them.

entry: 人们常认为，它们是从被过早砍倒的古老石化树木中诞生的灵魂。除非森林受威胁，否则不显恶意，只满足于照料、不断扩展森林。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon are commonly believed to be spirits born from ancient, petrified trees that were felled prematurely. Yet they harbor no apparent malice unless their forests are threatened and are content to tend to and continuously grow their forests.

entry: POKENAME翼膜像一种据说曾在阿罗拉发生的超自然现象。振翼时闪烁翼膜，扰乱对手；超声波叫声则能传到极远。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's wing membranes resemble a supernatural phenomenon thought to have occurred in Alola. They cause confusion in their opponents by shimmering this membrane as they flap their wings. Their supersonic cries can be heard from vast distances.

entry: POKENAME躲进最蓬松的云，开心啾鸣，安顿后随风滑翔。鸣声轻柔安慰，有时在正下方也听得见。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides away in the fluffiest of clouds, chirping happily as it settles within and glides with the wind. Its chirps are a light, comforting noise that can sometimes be heard from directly below.

entry: 这些温顺宝可梦常躲在云状羽中，好奇难耐才探头。它们通过大环吸收、转化阳光，能听见里面哼着柔歌。
author: infinex21
source: These meek Pokémon typically hide within their cloud-like feathers and only peek out when their curiosity gets the best of them. They can be heard humming gentle songs within as they absorb and metabolize sunlight through their large rings.

entry: POKENAME黏液曾被收集、熬膏，用于神圣仪式。焚烧后散出松木与霉味，据说能敬奉古神、驱逐恶灵。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's mucus was once harvested and boiled into a paste for sacred rituals. When burned, its pine and musty scent was said to honor old gods and repel evil spirits.

entry: POKENAME吐出的黏液，只要有意，任何东西都能熔穿。有时，它却只吐无害胶泥，想看其他对象惊慌。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's goo, when spit up from its mouth, is strong enough to melt through anything, though only at its discretion. It will sometimes spit harmless goop onto others just to watch them panic.

entry: 哪怕短暂碰到POKENAME黏液，也曾被认为能激发虔诚信仰。中招者数周不肯洗，深信是活神祝福。
author: .izik
source: Even brief contact with POKENAME's mucus was believed to inspire religious devotion. Those affected refused to wash it away for weeks, convinced it was a blessing of a living god.

entry: 仍有故事说，它与某些据说早于多数文明的古迹，材料相同。一击就能轻松粉碎超过自身体形两倍的巨石。
author: infinex21
source: Some stories still remain that claim its body is made of the same material as some ancient ruins that are claimed to predate most civilizations. One strike from this Pokémon can easily shatter a boulder over twice its size.

entry: 身体是像棱镜折光的坚冰，角度一换，看起来也常不同。它们放寒气造冰作战，也能聚光成伤害光线。
author: infinex21
source: Their bodies are made of solid ice that refracts light like a prism, so they often look different depending on the perspective. They fight with ice created by the frigid air they exude or by focusing light into harmful rays.

entry: 据说，POKENAME各色部位，都由融入元素的金属铸造。因此能从身体发任意属性能量束，直攻对手弱点。
author: sk372
source: Each of POKENAME's many colored sections are said to be forged with metal infused with the elements. This allows it to fire beams of energy from its body of any typing, exploiting any opponent's weakness.

entry: POKENAME的叶吃下、花粉吸入，哪怕量少也会致幻。有些理论认为，古先知与神示，不过是遇它后引起的幻觉。
author: sk372
source: Consumption of POKENAME's leaves or inhalation of its pollen, even in small doses, leads to hallucinations. Some theorists say ancient prophets and their visions were simply hallucinatory effects caused by encounters with POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME通过头上生物透镜，将光聚成精准高热光束。夜里绝不出来，训练家也不例外。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME focus light through the organic lens upon their heads into precise, hot beams. They never come out at night, not even for their Trainers.

entry: 据说，心地纯净的孩子睡觉时，POKENAME会来。故事说，睡着抱它，就能永远驱走噩梦，一生只做美梦。
author: sk372
source: It's said that pure of heart children will be visited by POKENAME while they sleep. As the tales go, hugging it while sleeping will dispel nightmares for good, ensuring the child always has pleasant dreams for the rest of their life.

entry: 这个骄傲的家伙为赞美而活，一生磨炼战斗与表演，想吸引尽可能多的观众。它似乎能从粉丝崇拜中，汲取某种神秘力量。
author: milchik
source: This proud Pokémon lives to be praised. It spends its entire life honing its fighting and performance skills in order to appeal to as large an audience as possible, as it seems to draw some sort of mysterious power from the adoration of its fans.

entry: 这个骄傲的家伙为赞美而活，一生磨炼战斗与表演，想吸引尽可能多的观众。它似乎能从粉丝崇拜中，汲取某种神秘力量。
author: milchik
source: This proud Pokémon lives to be praised. It spends its entire life honing its fighting and performance skills in order to appeal to as large an audience as possible, as it seems to draw some sort of mysterious power from the adoration of its fans.

entry: POKENAME住在献给阿尔宙斯的废庙，藏于覆盖神殿的植物。虽像派拉斯，却吸收栖地残留的异世能量，展现奇异能力。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME are found in abandoned temples dedicated to Arceus, where they hide in the flora covering the shrine. Although they may look similar to Paras, they exhibit strange abilities due to absorbing lingering otherworldly energy from their habitat.

entry: 一座似有意识的神圣宫殿，仿佛同时存在多个维度层面。人类碰不到它，因而谁也没能进入。
author: frokachu
source: A seemingly sentient and sacred palace that seems to exist in multiple dimensional planes at once. No one has ever been able to enter it, as it is not tangible to people.

entry: POKENAME曾被奉为苔原女神，控制冰雪。古部落常献温热炖菜，祈求聚落免遭致命寒冷。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were believed to be goddesses of the tundra, controlling the ice and snowfall. Ancient tribes often left offerings of warm stew, praying their settlements would be spared from the deadly cold.

entry: POKENAME曾被尊为冰川与无尽寒冬之神。城镇若熬过寒季，就办一年一度的庆典，感谢宽恕。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were honored as deities of glaciers and endless winters. If a town survived the cold season, a yearly festival was held to thank them for mercy.

entry: 古时，据说获上天祝福者，便会遇POKENAME，得到友谊。它的爱与忠诚无边，有人说，温柔相伴时，不可能仍感不快。
author: sk372
source: In olden times, it was said that those who were blessed by the heavens would encounter POKENAME and gain its friendship. Its loyalty and love are without bounds, and some say it is impossible to remain unhappy while in its gentle presence.

entry: POKENAME披薄光纱，迅速绕敌，靠动作与炫光使对方晕眩。训练家若善待，就会得到忠诚、常想依偎的伙伴。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME clad themselves in a thin veil of light as they quickly move around their opponents, dazing them with their swift movements and dazzling light. Trainers who raise them with kindness will have a very loyal companion who often seeks to cuddle.

entry: POKENAME嚎叫时，环会发强闪光。趁对手仍晕眩，它便用强力劈开抓击，再以硬头锤结束战斗。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME emit bright flashes of light from their rings when they howl. While their opponents are still dazed, they will claw at them with powerful Slash attacks and finish them with a hard Headbutt.

entry: 有些音乐家一生只求完美演绎POKENAME所唱、被视为最伟大交响乐的歌。演奏音乐会一公布，几分钟票就卖空。
author: sk372
source: Some musicians have dedicated their lives to perfectly performing the songs POKENAME sings, considered the greatest of symphonies. Concerts playing these songs sell out within minutes of announcement.

entry: POKENAME每1000年只唱一天，歌声传到数英里外。裙摆闪烁如宇宙，金发仿佛太阳，因此许多人将它们描绘为宇宙歌者。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME sing only one day every 1,000 years, their songs reaching the ears of those that are miles away. Their skirts shimmer like space itself and their golden locks are reminiscent of the sun itself, causing many to portray them as cosmic singers.

entry: POKENAME舞蹈令人屏息，一安排演出，场馆票便很快售罄。每场都配整支管弦乐团，伴奏壮丽舞姿。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's dances are a breathtaking sight. Concert venues sell out quickly when performances are scheduled, and every performance is backed by a full orchestra to accompany the majesty.

entry: 据说，POKENAME只在极少数被选者的梦里来访，传递重要消息。但醒来后，无人记得幻景。
author: sk372
source: It is said that only a few, select chosen ones will have POKENAME visit them within their dreams. Supposedly it visits the selected to deliver an important message, but none remember the vision upon waking.

entry: POKENAME诱饵的快速闪光，会使目击者恍惚，看见从前看不见的事物。它借此传思想、赐预言，或单纯分散猎物注意。
author: milchik
source: Whoever witnesses the rapidly flashing lights of this Pokémon's lure enters a trance and begins seeing things they couldn't see before. In this way, POKENAME can communicate its thoughts, bestow prophecies, or simply distract its prey.

entry: 阿尔斯吃下发光蘑菇，便被感染，菌从身体顶部长出，变为POKENAME。蘑菇察觉宿主将死，就迅速长大，吞没栖居的神庙。
author: _pixelar_
