source: When an Arcras eats a glowing mushroom, it infests the Pokémon, sprouting from the top of the body and turning it into POKENAME. When the mushroom senses the end of the host's life it begins to grow rapidly, engulfing the temple it inhabits.

entry: POKENAME鳞片泛着鲜艳光，据说能抵御邪恶与腐化。神话称，若大不公遍及大地，它就会从宇宙家园降下。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's scales shine with a vibrant light that is said to ward off evil and corruption. Myths claim that should a great injustice spread across the land, POKENAME will descend from its home in the cosmos.

entry: POKENAME凭光能，能造任何事物，无生命或有生命都行。一道强激光，就能毁掉整个宇宙，把万物，连时空都化成细光粒。
author: soup1900
source: With the power of its light energy, POKENAME can create anything it wants, inanimate or not. In a single powerful laser, it can destroy the entire universe, eradicating everything, including time and space, into tiny light particles.

entry: POKENAME结小群生活，野外少见。头冠材质无法击穿，受击共鸣，数百英尺外也能听见。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME congregates in small groups, rarely seen in the wild. Their head crests are made of an impervious material that makes a resounding echo when struck, able to be heard from hundreds of feet away.

entry: 它们常互碰鳞片，或敲其他物体，表达自己、吓退其他对象。鳞因此脱落许多，长回却似乎比从前稍好。
author: infinex21
source: They regularly smack their own scales together or against objects to express themselves or to scare others away. They shed many of their scales as a result, though they seem to grow back a little bit better than before.

entry: POKENAME常与其他对象交战，锻炼身体，准备应对等鳞长回的时刻。每次再生都更硬、更锋利，让练好的身体更危险。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME fight others often, training their bodies for when they must wait for their scales to regrow. Each time their scales regrow, they are harder and sharper which makes their trained bodies all the more dangerous.

entry: POKENAME碰鳞，发出种种声响，使其他对象迷乱或不安。少数悠久传说称，每片鳞脱长1,000次，就会达到巅峰。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME clash their scales together to emit myriad noises that disorient or unnerve others. There are few enduring legends that claim an POKENAME's scales will reach their pinnacle after being shed and regrown a 1,000 times each.

entry: POKENAME有点自恋，沉迷其他生灵的赞美。它变出鲜明配色，只想听大家惊叹缤纷外表。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is somewhat vain and addicted to the praise of others. It changes its body into bright and vivid color combinations just so it can hear others marvel at its colorful appearance.

entry: POKENAME像只在奇幻传说中提到的巨晶。据说，能增强宝可梦地面、火、水与飞行属性的攻击。
author: raydrago
source: POKENAME resembles a giant crystal only mentioned in fantastical legends. It is said to strengthen Pokémon's Ground, Fire, Water, and Flying-type attacks.

entry: POKENAME曾被视为发芽与早期生长之神。农夫在田边土上描精巧符号，祈求祝福作物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were believed to be gods of sprouts and early growth. Farmers traced intricate symbols in the soil around fields, praying for them to bless their crops.

entry: 阿尔斯吃下发光蘑菇，便被感染，菌从身体顶部长出，变为POKENAME。蘑菇察觉宿主将死，就迅速长大，吞没栖居的神庙。
author: _pixelar_
source: When an Arcras eats a glowing mushroom, it infests the Pokémon, sprouting from the top of the body and turning it into POKENAME. When the mushroom senses the end of the host's life it begins to grow rapidly, engulfing the temple it inhabits.

entry: POKENAME的眼有特殊能力，能察觉宝可梦与训练家的任何不纯之处。发现后，会试着用制裁光砾纠正，心意却是善良的。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's eyes have special properties, able to detect any impurities in a Pokémon or Trainer. If it spots something impure, it will use Judgement to try and fix it. Its intentions are kindhearted, however.

entry: POKENAME从不为自己战斗，却会赶去保卫其他宝可梦。背后环能分两半，手持作武器，类似旋棍。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will never fight for itself, but will rush to the defense of other Pokémon. The ring behind it can split in two and become hand-held weaponry for POKENAME to use, akin to tonfa.

entry: POKENAME曾被奉为树与森林之神。果园守护者献篮篮种子，盼祝福丰收。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were once worshiped as gods of trees and forests. Orchard keepers left baskets of seeds as offerings, hoping they would bless them with a strong harvest.

entry: 壁画描绘POKENAME保护年轻训练家。它召来的柔光，能把惊慌迷路的孩子引回正路。有些城镇习惯在获得初始宝可梦时，向它献供。
author: _pixelar_
source: Murals depict POKENAME as protectors of young Trainers. They can summon a lambent light that guides scared, lost children back to the path with its gentle glow. In some cities, it is custom to give an offering to this Pokémon upon getting a starter.

entry: 壁画描绘POKENAME保护年轻训练家。它召来的柔光，能把惊慌迷路的孩子引回正路。有些城镇习惯在获得初始宝可梦时，向它献供。
author: _pixelar_
source: Murals depict POKENAME as protectors of young Trainers. They can summon a lambent light that guides scared, lost children back to the path with its gentle glow. In some cities, it is custom to give an offering to this Pokémon upon getting a starter.

entry: 有些铁匠曾把POKENAME奉为余烬女神。每冬向火里掷树果，盼祝福当年货品。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were worshiped by some smiths as goddesses of embers. Berries were tossed into flames each winter, hoping they would bless the year's merchandise.

entry: POKENAME专注一事，耳中伸出的触角就会亮起。它能将精神能量聚于杖尖，化作光束、火焰等多种形式释放。
author: infinex21
source: The antennae protruding from an POKENAME's ears will glow when they concentrate their thoughts on a single thing. They can concentrate their psychic energies upon the tips of their wands and release it in myriad ways, such as a beam or as flames.

entry: 有些神话学者说，在POKENAME守望下，世界之敌会瞬间净化。它实际却似乎警觉而贪玩。
author: bobosmith01
source: Some mythologists say that under POKENAME's watchful eye, the foes of the world are cleansed in an instant. POKENAME's actual personality seems to be alert but playful.

entry: POKENAME产生的水，曾煮沸用于仪式。这水虽稀少，人们仍在身周浇成一圈，相信能保当天平安。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME produced water once boiled for ritual use. People poured it in a circle around themselves, believing it would grant protection for the day despite its scarcity.

entry: POKENAME快到大多人坚称是在瞬间移动。它能随意造出数十枚水手里剑，轻松击倒整群对手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's speed is so great that most swear it is teleporting from place to place. It can generate dozens of water shurikens at will to strike down entire groups of opponents with little effort.

entry: 随着移动和盘旋，POKENAME壳上的图案不断变化。这种强大的宝可梦能吸收黑洞，化为宇宙尘埃，再从壳里释放出去。
author: milchik
source: The pattern on POKENAME's shell changes constantly as it moves and swirls around itself. This mighty Pokémon has the power to absorb black holes and turn them into cosmic dust, which it then releases from its shell.

entry: POKENAME体形差异惊人，似乎受栖地周围田地照料程度影响。农夫间常流传夸张故事：失管田地，至少会生出1,000只小个体。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME vary in size at remarkable variance, which seems to be influenced by how well-tended-to the fields they live near or within are. A common tall tale among farmers tells how a poorly kept field will give rise to at least 1,000 tiny POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的眼有特殊能力，能察觉宝可梦与训练家的任何不纯之处。发现后，会试着用制裁光砾纠正，心意却是善良的。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME's eyes have special properties, able to detect any impurities in a Pokémon or Trainer. If it spots something impure, it will use Judgement to try and fix it. Its intentions are kindhearted, however.

entry: POKENAME穿林太快，多数目击只记录到身后翼鳞云。吸入毒鳞，会不能动弹，还陷入幻觉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME moves so quickly through the forest that most sightings only record the cloud of scales from its wings it leaves behind. Inhaling these toxic scales causes a victim to become immobile and plagued with hallucinations.

entry: 丰缘某些地方，POKENAME曾被奉为秋神。城镇年年做南瓜灯献供，信仰虽淡，节庆仍留。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's were once worshiped as deities of autumn in parts of Hoenn. Towns crafted jack-o'-lanterns yearly as offerings, and though belief faded, the festivals remain.

entry: POKENAME本无恶意，却吃其他对象的痛苦，猎物甚至植物都行。它常在失管田地出现，那里有充足痛苦可供取食。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are not inherently malicious, though they do feed on the suffering of others such as prey or even the suffering of plants. They can often be found near fields that are poorly maintained, where they will have plenty of suffering to feed upon.

entry: POKENAME凭空造一口大小的美味点心，奖励关爱者。谁逼它产糖，就会被强塞酸得足以造成严重胃部不适的糖果。
author: sk372
source: From thin air, POKENAME can create bite-size tasty treats to reward those it cares for. Trying to force it to generate the sweets results in it force-feeding the aggressor candies so sour as to cause severe stomach upset.

entry: POKENAME的头发、球与环全能吃，吃后迅速再生。它乐于分享；尝过者说，甜美得任何人造糖果都比不上。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's hair, orb and ring are all edible, regenerating quickly after consumption. It freely shares the treats; those who have eaten it profess the flavor is so sweet and delicious that no man-made candy could hope to compare.

entry: POKENAME穿自己的蜕皮作保护外套，能拉起来，挡住部分攻击。大多靠强踢交战，蜕皮的尾也能当有效鞭子。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME wear their own shed skin as a protective coat they can pull on to deflect some attacks. Though they mostly fight with powerful kicks, the tails of their shed skin can also serve as effective whips.

entry: POKENAME叶盘里有液体，传说治愈力强，连废地也能复绿。人们相信，被它视为不配的对象饮下，就会枯萎而死。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's leaf plate contains a liquid that legends claim has powerful healing abilities, even being able to restore ruined lands to lush nature. It is believed that those it deems unworthy will wither and perish if consuming the liquid.

entry: 这种神秘宝可梦用悉心造好的天界之笛，奏出异世般舒缓的旋律，让听者开心。POKENAME若失笛，就不停暴走，直到找回心爱的笛子。
author: milchik
source: Using an Azure Flute it so carefully crafted, this mysterious Pokémon plays an otherworldly soothing melody that's able to cheer up anyone who hears it. If POKENAME loses its flute, it won't stop rampaging until it finds its beloved instrument.

entry: POKENAME催眠般的舞姿，几乎无人能抗拒。即使没直接看，附近生灵也忍不住随节奏扭腰。
author: sk372
source: Few, if any, can resist the hypnotic dance moves POKENAME possesses. Even without directly viewing them, those in its vicinity can't help but shake their hips in time to its rhythmic movements.

entry: POKENAME天界之笛的欢快曲调，能让谁都跳个不停，直到累倒。它有趣友好，大多数时候，却连音乐造成的伤害也没察觉。
author: milchik
source: The cheerful tune of POKENAME's Azure Flute is able to make anyone dance non-stop until exhaustion knocks them down. As fun and friendly as this Pokémon is, most of the time it doesn't even notice the damage it causes with its music.

entry: POKENAME从天降下，留灿烂光迹，直到撞地。古文明争论，这次到来究竟是礼物，还是企图惩罚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME descends from the sky, leaving behind a radiant trail until it crashes into the ground. Older human civilizations debated on whether its arrival was a gift or an attempt at punishment.

entry: POKENAME脱壳后，核心便充满光辉与力量。许多对象看久会痛，凝视眼睛，据说还会失明。
author: sk372
source: After shedding its shell, POKENAME's core glows with radiant light and power. Many cannot gaze on it too long without pain, and staring into its eyes is said to strike one blind.

entry: 进化后，它们尾火更热，亮度却不变。由于常陪训练家穿隧道，爪也练得足够强，能钻过岩石。
author: infinex21
source: The flame at the tip of their tail has grown hotter upon evolving, though the light it provides has stayed the same. Their claws have developed to be strong enough to dig through rock due to them so often accompanying Trainers through tunnels.

entry: 人们相信，在POKENAME头上放供品，会给献者带来好运。土豆格外受重视，无疑与它口味有关。
author: hophoppip
source: Placing an offering on POKENAME's head is believed to bring good fortune to the offerer. Potatoes hold particular value as an offering, no doubt related to POKENAME's taste in food.

entry: POKENAME最初在枪之柱被发现，附身破柱碎片。宝石的特殊材质别处找不到，接触妖精石板，会放出强大能量。
author: milchik
source: POKENAME was first discovered at the Spear Pillar possessing the fragments of the broken columns. This rare Pokémon's gems are made of a unique material that isn't found anywhere else; they emit powerful energy when exposed to a Pixie Plate.

entry: 水晶下半身收集、折射光，凭过程中产生的能量，闪着“星光”。它能造晶体，作战或赠给朋友。
author: infinex21
source: The crystalline lower half of this Pokémon captures and refracts light, glimmering with "strarlight" from the energy it produces in the process. It has the power to create crystals, be it for combat or as gifts for its friends.

entry: 老民间故事说，被POKENAME水枪击中，就会爱上第一眼看见的人。说法虽不实，却已流传一千多年。
author: chibitales
source: An old folk tale claims that being struck with a Water Gun from an POKENAME would make you fall in love with the first person you see. While these claims are not true, the tale has persisted for over one thousand years.

entry: 老民间故事说，被POKENAME粉红、形似爱心鱼的泡泡击中，就会爱上第一眼看见的人。说法虽不实，却已流传一千多年。
author: chibitales
source: An old folk tale claims that being struck with POKENAME's pink, Luvdisc-shaped bubbles would make you fall in love with the first person you see. While these claims are not true, the tale has persisted for over one thousand years.

entry: POKENAME曾被奉为掌管峡谷与岩石变动的神灵。人们在近处岩壁刻符，相信能保家园免遭致命山崩。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were once thought of as deities of canyons and shifting stone. People carved symbols into nearby rock faces, believing this would keep their homes safe from deadly rockslides.

entry: 若阿尔宙斯的传说属实，POKENAME就能把世界改造成玩具，使世间繁荣，甚至另造整个世界。它警觉神秘，鲜少发声。
author: bobosmith01
source: If legends about Arceus are true, then POKENAME could reshape the world into its toy, make the world prosperous, or even create another world entirely. Watchful and enigmatic, POKENAME rarely makes a sound.

entry: 据说POKENAME的脑海装着整个宇宙。里面发生的一切，它都听得见，因此头痛得厉害。
author: cybresamurai
source: It's said that POKENAME's mind contains an entire universe. It hears everything that happens within, so it gets terrible headaches.

entry: POKENAME脾气极大，怒意散发，传染其他生灵。因此独居，否则周围群体会变得凶暴，只顾互斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's temper is so great, it radiates around it and spreads to other creatures. It lives a solitary lifestyle, as being around others would cause the groups to degenerate into violent mobs obsessed with fighting one another.

entry: POKENAME怒火冲到顶点时，身体的部分区域，会染上猩红。它发出尖锐的叫声，挥动四肢宣泄怒气；狂怒的能量，使每个动作都震动四周。
author: sk372
source: Parts of POKENAME's body tint crimson when its temper reaches its boiling point. It lets out sharp cries and swings its limbs through the air to vent this temper, each motion causing the area to tremble from the sheer energy of its raging.

entry: POKENAME忠诚、充满爱，是好宠物。无论离主人多远，都听得见呼唤；名字一被叫，就立刻传送身旁。
author: sk372
source: Deeply loyal and loving, POKENAME make for great pets. No matter how far away they are from their owner, they are able to hear them calling and immediately teleport to their side when their name is called.

entry: 古记录把POKENAME描为人类守护神。故事说，它从天上瞬移至危机中的文明旁，眨眼便把整座城送到安全处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME, depicted in ancient records as a guardian deity of humanity, is said by stories to teleport from the heavens next to civilizations in crises and transport entire cities away to safety in the blink of an eye.

entry: POKENAME常与洞栖宝可梦交战，渐渐爱上战斗。据说，身上束带般的有机质甲片，能帮助锻炼各处肌肉，保持最佳体魄。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have so often come into battle with cave-lurking Pokémon that they grew to love battling. The harness-like organic plating on their bodies is supposedly a means to help them train their various muscles to be in peak physical form.

entry: 传说，POKENAME的知识无穷无尽，过去与未来的一切，它都知晓。历代被视为天才的人，据说都曾在梦中得到它的造访，被赐予它的一小部分智慧。
author: sk372
source: Legends say that POKENAME's knowledge is infinite, that it knows of everything that was or will be. Those considered geniuses across history are rumored to have been visited by POKENAME in their dreams, and granted a fraction of its intellect.

entry: 许多古书把POKENAME同时视为保护者与先兆。听见雷鸣般的号角声，据说人生很快就有剧变。
author: mepp.
source: Many ancient books describe POKENAME as both a protector and herald. Those who hear its thunderous horn are said to soon experience a great change in their life.

entry: 神话把POKENAME描述为历史上每场战斗的监管者。跨文化战具上都见它的形象，暗示古时被普遍尊为保护象征。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME is described in myth as the overseer of every battle in history. Its image has been found on war gear across cultures, suggesting it was revered as a universal symbol of protection in ancient times.

entry: 神话把POKENAME描述为历史上每场战斗的监管者。跨文化战具上都见它的形象，暗示古时被普遍尊为保护象征。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME is described in myth as the overseer of every battle in history. Its image has been found on war gear across cultures, suggesting it was revered as a universal symbol of protection in ancient times.

entry: POKENAME一扎根，世间似乎再无力量能移走。它分享养分，令周围植物重焕生机、开得更艳，再在耀白花粉与叶片的闪光中消失。
author: sk372
source: Once POKENAME roots itself to the soil, no force on the world seems able to move it. It shares nutrients to the plant life around it, revitalizing them to bloom brighter than ever, before it vanishes in a flash of stark-white pollen and leaves.

entry: POKENAME容易受惊，迅速躲进坚壳，几乎无法穿透。缩好后，就用念力浮空，飞往更安全的地方。
author: sk372
source: Easily frightened, POKENAME is quick to hide in its shell, which is sturdy enough to seem almost impenetrable. While tucked away, it hovers via telekinesis, and flies itself away somewhere safer.

entry: POKENAME体内酸液，几分钟能将几乎任何东西溶成养分。许多人献各式小饰物，让它饱足，免得缠裹、吞食其他生灵。
author: sk372
source: The acids inside POKENAME are strong enough to dissolve almost anything into sustenance within minutes. Many will offer it assorted trinkets to keep it sated so it doesn't seek to wrap up and devour other creatures.

entry: POKENAME沿水面游动，留意上下威胁。触手拖在水里，劝散其他宝可梦的打斗；只有驱赶鸟类捕食者，才会伸出水面。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME swim along the surface of the water, keeping watch for threats from both above and below. Their tentacles drag through the water to disperse fights between other Pokémon, only raising to the surface to repel avian predators.

entry: 猎人对抗POKENAME的老故事，总说极难应付，因为触手一断立刻再生。故事称，须割断1000次，才不再长回。
author: sk372
source: Old tales of hunters fighting POKENAME detail how difficult it was to deal with, regenerating tentacles instantly if severed. According to the stories, its tentacles must be severed 1000 times before it will no longer regenerate them.

entry: POKENAME火焰泛灿烂金光。它们回避人类，有些传说说，只肯主动接近心地纯净者。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's flames shine with a brilliant golden light. They shy away from humans, with some legends suggesting they only willingly approach those pure of heart.

entry: POKENAME火焰泛强烈猩红光。它们回避人类，有些传说说，只肯主动接近心中意志坚定者。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's flames shine with an intense scarlet light. They shy away from humans, with some legends suggesting they only willingly approach those with great resolve in their heart.

entry: 金色鬃毛的火焰璀璨闪耀，仿佛不属尘世。若不慎吸入灰烬，可能会在超凡的震撼中僵住。
author: clickonflareblitz
source: The flames of its brilliant, golden mane glitter like nothing in this world. Mistakenly inhaling its ashes could leave you frozen in unearthly shock.

entry: POKENAME壳的防御很高，却总先认真一战，才肯缩入。粗蓬尾一挥，就能造出小潮浪。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's shell boasts high defense, but it never retreats into it without fighting in earnest first. Its thick fluffy tail can create a small tidal wave of water with a single swing.

entry: POKENAME似有巨大潜力，头脑却简单，无法充分调用。背上奇异暗影生灵更凶，会伸触须抓其他对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears to have vast potential power, but a simple mind that limits its access to the power. The strange shadowy creature on its back behaves with more aggression, reaching out to claw at others with its tendrils.

entry: POKENAME寿命长，尾巴被一团宝可梦般的黑影咬着。它们总忘记黑影的存在，似乎因此惹恼对方，使其咬得更用力。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are very long-lived Pokémon with the figure of a shadowy Pokémon biting upon their tails. They constantly forget that these shadowy Pokémon even exist, which seems to infuriate them and make them bite even harder.

entry: 强磁力为POKENAME身体供能。周围四块磁铁，每块都足以拖住最重的钢属性宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: Intense magnetism powers POKENAME's body. Each of the four magnets surrounding it has enough strength to drag and hold onto even the heaviest of Steel-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME最珍视的东西，就是利爪中紧握的那根木棍。它虽然看似法杖，却通常被用来敲打对手的头。
author: infinex21
source: An POKENAME's most prized possession is the stick it so strongly holds onto within its talons. Despite how it looks like a staff, this Pokémon typically uses it to strike their opponents upon the head.

entry: 据说，POKENAME所持的棍力量无限，能重塑现实。它却很少施展，大多用来够远处树果。
author: sk372
source: The stick POKENAME carries is said to carry unlimited power, enough to reshape reality. POKENAME exhibits little of this power, mostly using it to pick up berries that are too far for it to reach.

entry: 古经文把POKENAME怪异啼叫，记作悲剧将临的警告。因此，它们以“不祥鸟神”之名，受人畏惧。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's erratic squawks were recorded in ancient scriptures as warnings of coming tragedy. Because of this, they were feared as the Bird Gods of Foreboding.

entry: POKENAME三头会观察、审判附近生灵。一颗主张仁慈，一颗主张报应，另一颗中立，因此对如何判决，始终难以完全同意。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's three heads observe and judge others in its vicinity. One believes in mercy, another in retribution, and another in neutrality, so it can never fully agree on what to do to pass its judgement.

entry: POKENAME的金环一贴到实物表面，另一侧也会出现。它能穿过形成的通道，因此不必钻洞，就能穿过海面冰层。
author: .jerden
source: When placed against a solid surface, POKENAME's golden ring also appears on the other side. POKENAME can travel through the tunnel this creates, and so can move through sheets of ice on the surface of the ocean without having to drill a hole.

entry: POKENAME产生的极冷水，曾用来仪式沐浴。人们相信，在重要仪式前能洗净灵魂。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME produces intensely cold water once used for ritual bathing. It was believed to cleanse the soul of impurities before important ceremonies.

entry: 重大污染灾难发生之地，POKENAME曾现身救急。它把污染物全收入身体，吸收后，便消失无踪。
author: sk372
source: In locations where massive pollution disasters have occurred, POKENAME has appeared and saved the day. It takes all the polluted material into its body, absorbing it before vanishing without a trace.

entry: POKENAME住在古老的死水沼泽，阳光难至。待得久了，水会变得极酸，不宜生存。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME dwells in ancient, stagnant swamps where sunlight rarely reaches. The water turns extremely acidic and inhospitable after prolonged exposure to its presence.

entry: 据说，POKENAME炮筒发出的水是圣液，能净化命中者。发射后也能控制轨迹，一被锁定，谁也躲不开。
author: sk372
source: The water shot from POKENAME's cannons is said to be a holy liquid that purifies those it strikes. It can control the trajectory of the water shots once fired, ensuring that none can escape being hit once it's targeted them.

entry: POKENAME住在曾崇拜宝可梦的旧庙，隐形跟着探险者，用耳边回响的陌生语言低语，使人不安。
author: sk372
source: A spirit inhabiting old temples that used to worship Pokémon, POKENAME follows explorers around, staying invisible and unnerving them with strange whispers in an unknown language echoing in their ears.

entry: POKENAME是狡猾小幽灵，隐形浮游古庙，找人吓唬。它让家里充满1000只幽灵手，以数十次鬼手碰触恶作剧。
author: sk372
source: A devious little spirit haunting ancient temples, POKENAME floats around invisibly, searching for victims to scare. It fills its home with 1000 ghostly hands, letting it spook others with dozens of ghostly touches.

entry: POKENAME曾被视为诅咒与厄运之神。许多城镇每周六在窗边放食，怕没献贡的家遭诅咒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME were believed to be deities of curses and misfortune. Many towns left food in their windows every Saturday, fearing they would curse homes that failed to offer tribute.

entry: 据说，POKENAME催眠强到能让受害者睡1000年。摇动摆锤时，光色会随目标属性变化。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's hypnotic ability is said to be strong enough to put a victim to sleep for 1000 years. As it swings its pendulum, it gleams with a color relating to the target's typing.

entry: POKENAME双钳能亮强光，伸水里吸引鱼。好奇靠近，就成了随手夹来的美食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's claws can shine with a powerful light.  It dips these claws into water to attract fish towards it, making them easy pickings to snap up when curiosity compels them to approach.

entry: POKENAME一找到下一只猎物，对方几乎就无望逃脱。巨钳能脱体高速追逐，抓力极强，只有最强大的生灵能挣开。
author: sk372
source: Once POKENAME has found its next prey, there is almost no chance of escape. Its massive pincer can detach and chase after a target at high speeds, and its grip is too strong for all but the most powerful of creatures to escape from.

entry: POKENAME通过头上茎叶吸阳光。大多时间晒着打盹，似乎鲜少为周围世界担忧。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME absorb sunlight through the stem and leaves on their heads. They spend much of their time napping in the sunlight and rarely seem worried about the world around them.

entry: POKENAME吃树果时，小心剔种，放在旁边。吃完便挖洞埋种，帮助植物延续生命循环。
author: sk372
source: When snacking on berries, POKENAME carefully removes the seeds and sets them aside. Once it finishes eating, it digs holes to bury the seeds in and help continue the plant's circle of life.

entry: POKENAME一起睡在林地，半身埋土。受打扰可能爆炸，平时爱喝球果打成的汁。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME sleep together half-buried in the woodland dirt. If bothered, they may explode. POKENAME tend to enjoy juice blended from Apricorns.

entry: POKENAME一起睡在林地，半身埋土。受打扰可能爆炸，平时爱喝球果打成的汁。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME sleep together half-buried in the woodland dirt. If bothered, they may explode. POKENAME tend to enjoy juice blended from Apricorns.

entry: POKENAME一起睡在林地，半身埋土。受打扰可能爆炸，平时爱喝球果打成的汁。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME sleep together half-buried in the woodland dirt. If bothered, they may explode. POKENAME tend to enjoy juice blended from Apricorns.

entry: 它全身的藤蔓，冬季会变深色。这时，质地与意大利面相似。
author: .izik
source: The vines covering its body grow darker during the winter months. During this time, they have the same consistency as Pasta.

entry: POKENAME最爱巨蔓藤身上的藤。它悬在攻击范围外，以空气斩割下许多，逼对方逃走。吃完，双翼变密，飞行也吃力。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's favourite food is the vines that grow on Tangrowth. They hover out of range and attack with an Air Slash, severing many of the vines and causing Tangrowth to flee. After eating, its wings become denser, making it struggle to fly.

entry: POKENAME偏爱植物繁盛的温室。被发现，就用高速移动逃跑，改变体色，融入附近草木。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers greenhouses filled with thriving plants. When discovered, it uses Agility to flee and shifts its coloration to blend in with nearby plant life.

entry: 硬黏土与壤土做的粗糙宝可梦像，可能说明POKENAME住在附近。它们用软土捏着玩，任太阳慢慢晒硬。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Crude statues of Pokémon made from hard clay and loam may be a sign that POKENAME live nearby. They sculpt with soft soil for fun and let the sun naturally solidify their creations over time.

entry: POKENAME最喜欢待在甜香花丛。头上小枝长出的叶更大、更重，让它稍难平衡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's favorite place to be is surrounded by sweet-smelling flowers. The larger and heavier leaf growing from the twig on its head causes it slight balance issues.

entry: POKENAME颈部苦叶可入草药。泡茶能帮助缓解结肠不适与其他消化问题。
author: mepp.
source: The bitter leaves that grow around POKENAME's neck are used in herbal remedies. Brewing the leaves into tea helps with colon issues and other digestive problems.

entry: 野生POKENAME常开心小跑，受惊却会从背部放火。强颚一咬住，对手便很难赶在它吐火团前逃开。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME often trot around happily, but will release flames from their backs when startled. Their strong jaws are hard to escape from before they breathe puffs of fire.

entry: 野生POKENAME用极细植物纤维织复杂网，既供休息，也捕猎物。
author: theartemis1
source: Wild POKENAME spin intricate webs made of ultra-thin plant fibers, both as a resting place for itself and a means of catching prey.

entry: POKENAME与许多伙伴聚在大空地，迎暖阳起舞。它只饮最纯净无污的水，让美丽花朵保持鲜艳。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME gathers with many companions in wide clearings to dance beneath the warm rays of the sun. It keeps the colors of its magnificent flowers vivid by drinking only the purest, untainted water.

entry: POKENAME饮水时，头叶硬得能当螺旋桨，借此从一处水源前往另一处。突来的微风能抵御，强风仍会吹偏。
author: chibitales
source: As POKENAME drinks water, the leaves on its head harden enough to be used as a propeller. It uses this ability to travel from one water source to another. It is able to resist sudden breezes, but high winds still knock it off course.

entry: POKENAME在居住的森林寻找掉落或埋在土里的坚果，用牙咬开。数量庞大，使它们成为许多生态系统的重要种子传播者。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME search for fallen and buried tree nuts in the forests they inhabit, using their teeth to crack them open. These Pokémon are essential seed dispersers in many ecosystems due to their abundance.

entry: POKENAME大吃泥土，滋养头上植物。它不断啃松土，几乎总满嘴泥。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a massive appetite for dirt and soil, which helps keep the plant on its head thriving. It chomps through loose soil constantly, and is almost never seen without its mouth full of dirt.

entry: POKENAME爱在泥里休息，却得不时移动，免得陷下去。若在同一处待太久，它们可能被困住，只能等人帮忙。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to rest in the mud but need to keep moving every now and then to prevent themselves from being submerged in mud. If they remain in one spot for too long, they may get stuck until someone helps them.

entry: POKENAME大多时间打盹，在快节奏世界节省能量。有时太爱一处小睡地点，便忘了和其他宝可梦迁徙。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spend the bulk of their days napping, as they need to conserve energy in a fast-paced world. Sometimes they are so fond of a napping spot that they forget to migrate with other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME背上有软土，种入种子就能养植物。它懒得动、性情温顺，主人想种花或小作物，也不介意。
author: sk372
source: On POKENAME's back is soft soil that will nurture plant life if seeds are planted. Its sedentary and docile nature means that it has no problem if its owners wish to use it to grow flowers or minor crops on it.

entry: POKENAME壳上柔软如土的部位，能让种子长成植物。身上植物，可能影响壳内树果汁的风味。
author: sk372
source: Soft, soil-like parts of POKENAME's shell can grow plants from seeds placed within. The plants growing on its body may affect the flavor of the berry juice it creates within its shell.

entry: POKENAME壳由富矿岩石构成，是植物生长的沃土。葡萄园常见它，农夫冬季用来翻土，准备生长季。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME shells are made of mineral-rich rock, making them fertile ground for new plant growth. They are a common sight in vineyards, farmers using them to till soil during the winter months in preparation for the growing season.

entry: 它从土里萌生，身体由叶片构成，尾巴则是泥土。温暖湿润的尾巴里，带着可供繁殖的芽苗。
author: houndrys.
source: It sprouts out of the ground. Its body is made of leaves and its tail of dirt. It carries reproductive sprouts in its tail, which is warm and moist.

entry: POKENAME住在土极肥沃的森林，于壤土筑巢挖洞。蜿蜒行走时，鳞间卡土，植物便能沿身体扎根生长。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in forests with extremely fertile soil, making nests and burrows within the loam. Soil gets caught in between their scales as they slither around; this allows plants to take root and begin to grow along their body.

entry: POKENAME找到落脚处后，寒冷的季节便待着不动，等气温回暖、雨水充沛，才重新开始活动。它极其勇敢，即使遇上倾盆大雨，也不会躲藏。
author: bobosmith01
source: Once it finds a place to settle down, POKENAME stays still during the cold season and waits for warm temperatures and filling rain before moving about once more. It is extremely brave and will not hide even in torrential downpours.

entry: POKENAME自任守护一处水体纯净，穿时空去未来喝水，检验是否仍洁净。若不纯，就回过去，修复导致变坏的问题。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tasks itself with keeping a specific body of water pristine, traveling through time to drink the water in the future to see if it's still pure. If it isn't, it travels back in time to fix whatever problem led to its decline.

entry: POKENAME平时无忧爱玩，刚下雨却会惊慌躲藏。头上土一湿，便泥泞松垮，妨碍平衡与视线。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME normally behaves with a carefree, fun-loving attitude, but panics and hides when it begins to rain. The soil on its head becomes muddy and slouches when moist, negatively affecting its balance and vision.

entry: POKENAME生活在土壤肥沃、水源洁净、树木强健的地区。尾巴的色泽，反映身体是否健康；浓艳明亮的翠绿色，意味着它状态完好。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live in areas with rich soil, clean water, and strong trees. The vibrancy of their tails is a sign of how healthy they are; a rich, bright, and verdant green indicates when a POKENAME is in perfect health.

entry: POKENAME摸着总暖，帮助头芽抵御冬寒。炎热天气，常躺水洼，免得过热。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are always quite warm to the touch; their warmth helps their head sprouts resist winter cold. During hot weather, they often lounge in puddles to keep from overheating.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，身上长出小黄花。花瓣能吃，却辣得惊人。
author: .izik
source: While POKENAME sleeps, tiny yellow flowers grow from its body. The petals are edible, though incredibly spicy.

entry: 它喝水或泡水，壳就会变硬；似乎任何水分都一样，因此也会躺新泥。喷水、用宽尾搅土，便能轻松自造泥巴。
author: infinex21
source: Its shell hardens as it drinks or lies in water; any moisture seems to apply the same, so it may lie in fresh mud as well. By spewing jets of water and using its broad tail to churn dirt, it can create its own mud with relative ease.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在泥水洼翻滚取乐。身上小枝偶尔脱落，插进泥里，最后长成小植物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys rolling around in mud puddles for recreation. On occasion, the twigs on its body will dislodge, sticking in the mud and eventually growing into small plants.

entry: POKENAME会在野外鲜艳的花草间待上一阵，从最喜爱的花中采种，种进头上的土壤，为自己增添更多色彩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends some of its time in the presence of vibrant flowers and plants in the wild. It takes seeds from its favorite flowers and plants them in the soil on its head to decorate itself with more colors.

entry: POKENAME撒种，恢复遭砍伐的林地。它用超能力，保护刚发芽的小树免遭伐木工伤害。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME spreads seeds to reclaim land that was previously lost to deforestation. It uses its psychic power to defend sprouting trees from loggers.

entry: POKENAME的壳由土构成，吸水便硬。若喝脏水，壳会变黑，比岩石更硬。它们以利爪爬树，寻找果实。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's shell is made from soil, hardening when it is hydrated; if they ever drink foul water, their shells become black and harder than rock. POKENAME use their sharp claws to climb trees in search of fruit to eat.

entry: POKENAME独行或成双，在丛林缓缓走动。它们吃新生植物，用喙咬断嫩茎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are slow moving Pokémon that lumber through jungles individually or in pairs. They feed on young plant growth, using their beaks to bite through the tender stems.

entry: POKENAME以毒蘑菇为食，增强身上尖刺的毒性。头上的小绿叶能反映年龄，叶片越大，就表示它越成熟。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME feeds on poisonous mushrooms to boost the toxicity of the spines on its body. The size of the small green leaves on its head indicates its age; the larger they are, the more mature this Pokémon is.

entry: POKENAME后脑长出带牙荆棘。它喝水吃东西时，荆棘便警觉护卫，以叶牙威慑潜在捕食者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a set of toothy brambles erupting from the back of its head. As it drinks water or eats food, the growth vigilantly ensures foes stay away, intimidating potential predators with its leafy teeth.

entry: POKENAME用头撞地，把土压到头上。持续浇水，有助于生长时维持头的形状。
author: bacondlx
source: POKENAME packs soil onto its head by headbutting the ground. Consistently watering it helps to maintain the shape of its head as it grows.

entry: 自体融合让POKENAME的小枝长得更大更强，常令普通草苗龟羡慕。代价是需三倍食物，才能保持植物健康繁盛。
author: sk372
source: Self fusion results in POKENAME growing a much larger and stronger twig, often being the envy of normal Turtwig. As a trade-off, it requires thrice the food to keep its plant healthy and thriving.

entry: POKENAME一生壳都不停生长，最终限制行动。太大就会脱落一部分，成为周围土壤的肥料。
author: mistymagius
source: Its shell never stops growing throughout POKENAME's life, which ends up restricting its movement. Parts of the shell will break off when it gets too big, acting as fertilizer for the surrounding soil.

entry: 徒步者有时会在遇到的POKENAME背上叠石，相信给旅途带来好运。据说，石塔越高，运气越好。
author: .izik
source: Hikers sometimes stack stones on the back of POKENAME they encounter, as many believe it brings luck to their journey. The higher the stone tower grows, the better the luck supposedly becomes.

entry: POKENAME天生体热，叶尾无需日光取暖也能生长。但它爱晒太阳打盹，对身体也有益。主要吃辣树果。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Due to its natural body heat, POKENAME does not require the sun's warmth in order for its leafy tail to grow. However, POKENAME enjoys lying in the sun and taking naps, which does benefit its body. Its diet mainly consists of spicy berries.

entry: POKENAME在各地轻轻播种、培育植物。有人发现，它种的草木，在火烧森林的土里长得更好。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gently plants seeds and nurtures the plants they grow into all across the region. It has been noted that the flora it grows flourish better in the soil in locations of burned-down forests.

entry: POKENAME战斗时在芽上造泡，再掷向敌人。泡内气体闻似酸葡萄与辣椒，能使敌人睡着。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME creates bubbles on its sprout during battle before flinging them at foes. These bubbles are filled with a gas that smells of sour grapes and peppers and can put foes to sleep.

entry: POKENAME出水，会旋转头芽甩干，向周围释放宜人油桃香。
author: .izik
source: When emerging from the water, POKENAME twirls the sprout on its head to dry off. This releases a pleasant nectarine scent into the surrounding area.

entry: POKENAME找水本领奇准，地下或被遮住的水源也能发现。不少宝可梦巡护员至少养一只，用来应急。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have an uncanny ability to locate sources of water, even if they are underground or otherwise obscured. Quite a few Pokémon Rangers have at least one POKENAME in case of emergency.

entry: POKENAME用触须翻土、播种，滋养周围地面。照料的花园，总能长出最强健的一些植物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its feelers to stir soil and plant seeds, nurturing the ground around it. Gardens tended by POKENAME always produce some of the hardiest of plants.

entry: POKENAME住在海滩。浪退回海时，它把浪冻住，在湿沙边休息。这样冻结海浪，会大幅改变海岸形状。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME makes its home on beaches. When waves ebb towards the ocean, POKENAME freezes them in place to rest along the wet sand. By freezing waves along these beaches, POKENAME drastically change the shape of coastlines.

entry: POKENAME四处漂浮，装满泉水，再浇植物。若不能定期补满身体，木柄顶端的叶就会枯。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will float around, filling itself with springwater then pouring it out onto plants. If POKENAME cannot regularly refill its body, the leaves on top of its wooden handle will wilt.

entry: POKENAME头上种子长一年，就脱离，随风漂走。若落在沃土，便长成小花园，形成多种植物的小生态。
author: evilgammon
source: After one year of growth, the seed on POKENAME's head detaches and floats away, carried on the wind. If the seed lands in fertile soil, it will grow into a small garden, creating a small ecosystem of different plants.

entry: POKENAME圆圆的植物脑袋，顶在流畅的外星身躯上，能量澎湃。它已能控制自然力与超能力，草属性本领，却还未发育成熟。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME has a round, plant-like head atop a sleek, alien body radiating vibrant energy. It controls the forces of nature and psychic powers. It has yet to properly develop its Grass-type powers.

entry: POKENAME身上小枝慢慢生长。到一定程度，它就折下，当战斗武器，磨炼本领。
author: sk372
source: Twigs sprout and grow slowly from POKENAME's body. It snaps these off after a point and uses them as a weapon in battle to help hone its combat prowess.

entry: POKENAME每天睡许多小时，醒来第一件事，就是把湿泥土拍在头芽周围。强颚能吃极韧食物，从不愁找不到饭。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME sleeps for many hours each day, and the first thing it does when it wakes up is pad damp mud or soil upon its head around its sprout. It has strong jaws that allow it to eat very tough foods, so it never struggles to find a meal.

entry: 风暴前，POKENAME小树的叶会泛奇蓝光。此时，它们寻找附近海洞躲藏。
author: .izik
source: The leaves on POKENAME's sapling glow a peculiar blue before storms. During this time, they seek shelter in nearby sea caves.

entry: POKENAME通过头芽传导电力，像天线一样。还能用来追踪地下电线，作为食物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME channels electricity through the sprout on its head like an antenna. It can also use this sprout to track underground wires for consumption.

entry: 它背上的壳，由土壤与多种金属矿物混成，每次饮水都会硬化。双颚强得咬断铁轨如同细枝，原矿和精炼金属都吃。
author: infinex21
source: The shell upon its back is made of soil mixed with various metal minerals, and it hardens whenever it consumes water. Its jaw is so strong that it can bite through train track rails as if they were twigs; it will eat raw ores and refined metals.

entry: POKENAME藏在泥里，只露叶，伏击猎物。若背壳干燥，就说明身体不适。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME hides in the mud with only its leaves exposed to ambush prey. If the shell on its back is dry, it means this Pokémon is unwell.

entry: POKENAME花苞滴下的金蜜，带碱液气味，黏性极强。许多文化曾拿来当胶。
author: .izik
source: The golden lye-scented nectar that drips from POKENAME's bud is extremely sticky. Many cultures once used it as a glue.

entry: POKENAME身体虽是土木，自古便已活动。有人见它白天细心将虫类宝可梦移离作物。
author: mepp.
source: Despite POKENAME's body being made from soil and wood, these Pokémon have been active since ancient times. During the day, it has been observed relocating bug Pokémon from crops with gentle care.

entry: POKENAME带着叶、泥与木的身体游林，守护无力自保的生灵。小草属性宝可梦常住背上，一同穿过森林。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME roams the forests with its body of leaves, mud, and wood, guarding defenseless creatures. Small Grass-type Pokémon often find shelter upon its back as they wander together within the forests.

entry: POKENAME执着照料植物，见谁有从未见过的品种，甚至会偷。园丁常因它完美主义的园艺态度结伴，却得小心别惹怒。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is obsessed with caring for plants and will even steal them if it sees someone has a plant it has never encountered. Gardeners often partner with one due to its perfectionist approach to horticulture, but must be wary of angering it.

entry: POKENAME在土上滚，把新土混进壳身的泥土部分。这样能多取养分，让进化更顺利、更快。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rolls across the dirt in order to mix new soil into the dirt part of its shelled body. This helps it obtain more nutrients so its evolution can proceed more smoothly and quickly.

entry: POKENAME头上发簪，是用自己的羽毛包住小枝。时尚人士珍爱，其实并不稀有。
author: jaminmcready
source: The hairpins on POKENAME's head are twigs wrapped in its own feathers. While fashionistas treasure them, they're not actually that rare.

entry: POKENAME白天活动，始终晒太阳，保持芽湿润。夜里坐在地上一动不动，常被误认成空旷田野里的盆栽。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME are diurnal, spending all their time basking in sunlight while keeping their sprout watered. At night, they sit motionless on the ground, often being mistaken for potted plants in the middle of empty fields.

entry: 喝水后，身体与四肢吸水膨胀。此时动作更慢，战斗也更弱。
author: sk372
source: After drinking, its body and limbs swell up as they absorb the moisture. It is more sluggish in movement and weaker in combat during this time.

entry: POKENAME双脚扎地，伸出菌丝触须，接入周围的大根系网。连上后，人类与宝可梦只要触到其他植物，它就能感知。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME connect with the greater root networks around them by planting their feet onto the ground and extending mycelium tendrils. Once connected, they can feel other people and Pokémon as long as they are touching another plant.

entry: 野生POKENAME常大群旅行，互相保护。一见可能的危险，就把尾叶猛举空中，示意同伴散开躲藏。
author: theunholyhandgrenade
source: Wild POKENAME often travel in large groups for protection. The moment something possibly dangerous is seen, they flash their tail leaf up in the air to signal to the others to scatter for cover.

entry: POKENAME常住在森林下的地下洞穴，照料树根。它们净化土中杂质，帮助新芽更强壮。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are most commonly found living in underground caverns beneath forests tending to roots of trees. They purify any impurities in the soil to help sprouts grow stronger.

entry: POKENAME树皮吃得越多，壳就越强。晒太阳太久，壳却会一层层剥落。
author: .izik
source: The more tree bark POKENAME consumes, the stronger its shell becomes. Layers will peel off its shell if it basks in the sun for too long.

entry: POKENAME紧张时，小树会放舒缓的千香果香。既安抚附近宝可梦，也帮助自己镇定。
author: .izik
source: When stressed, POKENAME releases a soothing Passho Berry scent from its saplings. This aroma calms nearby Pokémon and helps it stay composed.

entry: 据说，POKENAME头芽反映整体健康。它只选最健康的土放在头顶的盘里，确保生长。
author: atlas3339098
source: The sprout on POKENAME's head is said to be indicative of the Pokémon's overall health. It only puts the healthiest soil in its head dish to ensure growth.

entry: POKENAME头枝每年随机开一种花。传说，两位训练家的个体若同期开放同种花，就预示注定相伴的缘分。
author: .izik
source: The twig on POKENAME's head blossoms into a random flower once per year. It is said that if two Trainers' POKENAME bloom the same flower in the same period, they are meant to be together.

entry: POKENAME在池塘半身泡水睡觉。它们从池水吸收养分，免得脱水头痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found in ponds half submerged and asleep. They absorb nutrients through the pond water to avoid getting headaches from dehydration.

entry: 科学家不明白，POKENAME这种形态为何是陆栖的鸟。它有个怪习惯，听见大声响，就高声叫。
author: hophoppip
source: Scientists are unsure why this form of POKENAME is a ground-dwelling bird. It has an odd habit of calling loudly whenever it hears a loud sound.

entry: POKENAME栖居沼泽，藏在水下，用酷似植物的尾巴伪装。
author: supersonicloki
source: Found in marshes, POKENAME is known to hide underwater and disguise itself using its tail's plantlike resemblance.

entry: POKENAME把土塞进拳与腹，作缓冲垫，助出击、挡反攻。它找营养丰富的土，种芦苇与灯心草，滋养家园周围。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME pack soil into their fists and belly, using the material as padding to help them land strikes and defend against counterattacks. They seek out soil rich in nutrients, cultivating reeds and rushes to help enrich the soil around their homes.

entry: POKENAME虽强，却偏爱和平，细心照料花园。植物受扰就极躁动，若是头上珍爱的植物，尤其如此。
author: sk372
source: Though it is quite powerful, POKENAME prefers a pacifistic lifestyle and spends its time carefully tending to gardens. It gets incredibly agitated if its plants are disturbed, doubly so if it's the precious plant upon its head.

entry: POKENAME住在洞口附近，晒外面的阳光。它们与背上苔藓植物共生，吸收能量、鲜少移动，回报以保护。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME live near the entrances to caves, basking in sunlight from outside. Sharing a symbiotic relationship with the moss and plants on their backs, they absorb their energy and rarely move, protecting the flora in return.

entry: POKENAME背上茂密灌木晒够阳光，叶间可能出现小红果。虽然诱人，对人类却有剧毒。
author: fiordaliso
source: If the lush bush on POKENAME's back absorbs enough sunlight, small red berries may appear among its leaves. Although very tempting, these fruits are highly poisonous to humans.

entry: POKENAME飘过田野，从孔中喷出阵阵花粉。田中植物，便加速生长。
author: hophoppip
source: Puffs of pollen are sprayed from POKENAME's pores as it floats over fields. The growth of plants in these fields is accelerated.

entry: POKENAME在茧中发育时，背上灌木也会长大。许多园丁修剪照顾，避免灌木吞没整个身体。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a bush on their back that grows as POKENAME develop inside their cocoon. Many gardeners take care of POKENAME by trimming the bush to prevent it from engulfing their body.

entry: POKENAME主要靠木角攻击。尾巴一受伤，就会退出战斗。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's woody horn is its main form of attack. It will retreat from battle if its tail is damaged.

entry: POKENAME飞舞，撒下翼上长出的种子。日久，经过的草原便成巨林。老传说说，它多年后归林，陷入永恒沉睡。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME flutters through the air, dropping the seeds that develop on its wings. In time, the grassy plains it travels above will become huge forests. In old folklore, POKENAME returns to these forests years later and goes into an eternal slumber.

entry: POKENAME吸收农业网站信息，研究世界植物。每只个体偏爱的居处，都靠近不同植物种类。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME absorbs information from agricultural websites to study plant life worldwide. Each individual favors living near a different species of flora.

entry: 它通常在葱郁森林的水边安家。据说，看见便能带来好运与丰收。
author: gamblebreaker
source: This Pokémon tends to make its home near bodies of water in lush forests. Seeing one is said to grant good luck and bountiful harvests.

entry: POKENAME到过之处，各种珍稀植物便会冒出。有些科学家声称，是因为背上的树果含所有植物的DNA。
author: imaginita
source: Various rare plants spring up wherever a POKENAME has visited. Some scientists claim this is because the berries that grow on POKENAME's back contain the DNA of all plants.

entry: POKENAME背果有独特辣味。野生个体的果，据说滋味更浓，卖价也高。
author: mepp.
source: The fruit that grows on POKENAME's back has a distinct, spicy flavor. The fruit from wild POKENAME are said to be much more flavorful and fetch a high price.

entry: 强健后腿让它们能随时迅速冲刺，战斗中也一样。强颚能轻松咬开坚果，将果仁烤过再吃。
author: infinex21
source: Their strong hind legs allow them to break out into quick dashes at a moment's notice, even during battle. They can easily crack open nuts with their strong jaws and roast their insides before eating them.

entry: POKENAME夜间活动、白天睡。睡着时融入栖树，避免被捕食。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME are nocturnal, and sleep during the day. They avoid predation while asleep by blending in with the trees they rest on.

entry: POKENAME白天半身埋地，保护自己，任叶晒阳。夜里另找筑巢处，有时设网，吓阻潜在闯入者。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME bury partway into the ground during the day to stay protected while their leaves soak up sunlight. During the night, they find somewhere else to make their nest and sometimes set up webs to deter potential intruders.

entry: POKENAME背上常住其他宝可梦，一移动，居民就坐得颠簸。它常为找淡水迁徙，背上的同伴也一道带走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often have Pokémon living atop their backs, so they create a bumpy ride for the residents whenever they move. They often migrate to find fresh water, bringing whoever may be on their backs with them.

entry: POKENAME悠闲耐心，几点吃饭都无所谓。为免冲突，它更爱让训练家安排作息。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are laidback and patient Pokémon. Whether meals happen at one hour or another is inconsequential to them, and they prefer to let their Trainer decide their schedule to avoid conflict.

entry: POKENAME藏在墓旁灌木，把较长的身体部分伸进土，吸取附近植物养分。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hides in bushes near tombs. It extends the longer portion of its body into the soil to absorb nourishment from nearby plants.

entry: POKENAME头上极热的树皮，战斗时充当头盔，挡开飞来物。哪怕短暂接触，也会轻微灼伤。
author: .izik
source: The incredibly hot bark on POKENAME's head serves as a helmet in combat, deflecting projectiles. Even brief contact with it can cause a minor burn.

entry: POKENAME覆有独特草木，鼻子敏锐，能找稀有种子，再挖出。园丁很喜爱，因为它总知道农作物何时成熟。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME are covered in a unique kind of foliage. They have highly sensitive noses, which they use to search for certain rare seeds that they will then dig up. POKENAME is beloved by gardeners, because it can always tell when produce is ripe.

entry: POKENAME通常住在雨林深处的池底，让小宝可梦躲进背上灌木，给予保护。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME typically resides at the bottom of the ponds found deep within rainforests. It protects smaller Pokémon by sheltering them among the bushes that grow on its back.

entry: 有些POKENAME的鹿角会长球果，饮食越健康，收成越丰。用这些球果造出的精灵球，质量很高。
author: karmaofevil
source: In some cases, the antlers of POKENAME grow apricorns; the healthier the diet, the stronger the harvest. The Poké Balls created with those apricorns are high quality.

entry: 它虽小，却有传说般的力量。只与同类求偶，因此数量已大幅减少。
author: huh.7
source: Despite its small size, this Pokémon possesses legendary power. It's been known to only engage in acts of courtship with its own species, so its numbers have been greatly diminished.

entry: POKENAME周围的电场有益植物生长，因此在树木园很受欢迎，能帮助园丁照料的树健康生长。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME give off an ambient electrical field that is beneficial to the growth of plant life. They are popular Pokémon at arboretums thanks to this, their presence helping to ensure healthy growth for the trees under the gardener's care.

entry: POKENAME睡在树洞，只露硬头，轻松保护其余身体免遭突袭。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps in hollow holes in trees with its hard head exposed. This allows it to easily protect the rest of its body from surprise attacks.

entry: POKENAME臂上的大叶簇，深秋会结淡蓝树果。虽苦，养分却极高，常被榨汁，供健美者补充营养。
author: .izik
source: Large tufts of leaves growing from POKENAME's arms produce light blue berries in late autumn. Despite being bitter, they are extremely nutritious and are frequently juiced for use in bodybuilder nutrition.

entry: POKENAME有内火，常玩水调温。叶能吸水晒阳，因此很少需要饮水，有时还能几小时不吃。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME tend to play in water regularly to help regulate their own temperatures due to their internal flames. Their leaves absorb water and sunlight, so they rarely need to drink and may sometimes go hours without eating.

entry: POKENAME喜欢晒着太阳打盹，既能恢复消耗的能量，也有助于背上土质外壳的生长。它用带爪的双脚扒土，寻找肥沃的土壤，舒服地窝进去。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME loves to nap while sunbathing. This action helps POKENAME regain lost energy and support the growth of the earthy shell on its back. This Pokémon uses its taloned feet to scratch the earth and look for fertile soil to nestle into.

entry: POKENAME睡时躲厚灌木，植物般的尾与冠却常露出。草食生灵咬上，最后便被怒气冲冲的它赶走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME takes shelter within thick bushes when it comes time to sleep. Its plant-like tail and crest often stick out of its sleeping spot, however, and get bitten by plant-eating creatures that then wind up chased away by the irate POKENAME.

entry: 某些古文明似乎曾仿POKENAME的独特甲片，设计盔甲与头盔。它沉静严肃，大多时间尽责守家，防备入侵者。
author: sk372
source: Some past civilizations appear to have designed armor and helms based on POKENAME's unique plating. It is a very stoic and serious being, spending much of its time dutifully guarding its home from intruders.

entry: 无论POKENAME多健康，背枝总枯萎。它施的诅咒，也让附近植物同样枯去。
author: hophoppip
source: No matter how healthy POKENAME is, the branches on its back are always withered and wilted. The curses it inflicts cause nearby plants to similarly wither.

entry: POKENAME双颚强健，坚果连壳都吃，也会咬开树木，饮下树液。在同一地区住得越久，体色就越会渐渐贴近周围环境。
author: infinex21
source: Using their powerful jaws, POKENAME eat every part of nuts, shells included, and break into trees to drink the sap within. The hues of their flesh change to match their surroundings the longer they live in a single area.

entry: POKENAME背上有微型生态，巨花旁长着多种灌木。它的出现，被视为当地环境繁盛的好信号。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME support a miniature ecosystem on their backs, various bush species growing alongside the large flower sprouting from them. Their presence is regarded as a good sign that a region has a thriving environment.

entry: POKENAME淡然观察周遭，很少陷险。背上灌木由其他宝可梦照料，往往是自己的兄弟姐妹。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are nonchalant observers of the world around them and rarely get into danger. The shrub on their back is tended by other Pokémon, often their siblings.

entry: POKENAME光滑的泥圆顶里，养分丰富，能让植物发芽。它用头擦灌木，保持头顶亮洁。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a polished dome made out of mud that has lots of nutrients for plants to sprout from. They keep their shiny heads polished by scraping their heads against bushes.

entry: POKENAME头中带种，供养发芽。发芽后种下，确保安全生长。它住在自己培育的树与灌木间，吃它们的叶。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME carries seeds in its head and provides nutrients to ensure they germinate. Once they sprout, it plants the seeds and ensures they grow safely. It lives amongst trees and shrubs that it raises and eats their leaves.

entry: POKENAME看见比背上更大的灌木，就会嫉妒。它以巨力连根拔起，妒火中撕成碎片。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME becomes envious whenever it sees a shrub larger than the ones on its own back. POKENAME will uproot the plant with immense force and rip it to shreds in a fit of jealousy.

entry: POKENAME背上灌木每夏结果，种类取决于最常吃的树果。全年喝水越多，果就越丰盛。
author: .izik
source: The bushes growing on POKENAME's back fill with berries each summer based on whichever berry it consumes most. These berries grow more abundantly the more water it drinks throughout the year.

entry: POKENAME头上厚树皮，战斗时会变得极热。一记头撞，就能造成三度烧伤。
author: .izik
source: The thick bark on POKENAME's head becomes superheated during combat. A single headbutt from it can cause third degree burns.

entry: POKENAME灵活得能片刻爬上巨树。它在手中烹熟水果再吃，小心挑种，留待以后吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its superior agility to scale even the largest trees in moments. It cooks fruit in its hands before eating it, carefully picking the seeds out for later consumption.

entry: POKENAME生活在温带，在沙中挖洞筑巢。它们借当地的草木，以及头上的生长物，伪装并保护家园。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME live in temperate climates and create burrows in the sand for their nests. These Pokémon will use the natural flora in the area, as well as the growths on their heads, to camouflage and protect their homes.

entry: POKENAME独居泉水池旁，背上长香甜多汁的果，谁想拿，就会受攻击。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME lives in solitude close to springwater ponds. It grows sweet, juicy fruit on its back, but it attacks anybody who tries to take it.

entry: POKENAME照料居住的森林，在病树传染其他树前就将其砍下。臂上回火钢刃极锋利，最硬岩石也能轻松切开。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME takes care of keeping the forests it inhabits healthy, cutting down sick trees before they can infect the others. The tempered steel blades on its arms are so sharp that they could slice even the hardest rock without difficulty.

entry: POKENAME从不迷路，密林丛林也一样；足迹一直充当天然路标。它虽不爱突来大量水，却喜欢任雨落身上。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME never lose their way, even in particularly dense forests or jungles; their footsteps have long served as natural trail markers. Though they dislike being exposed to a sudden, large amount of water, they love to let rain fall upon them.

entry: 它住在人难通过的沼泽密丛，最爱酸靛莓果，几乎不用争食。背上灌木结甜美果实，却也布满剧毒刺。
author: milchik
source: It lives in impassable swamp thickets where competition for its favorite food, the sour Belue Berries, is minimal. The bushes that grow on its back produce very sweet and delicious fruits, but are also adorned with highly venomous thorns.

entry: 民间传说说，POKENAME引愤怒者去净水边，平息心火。但若仍不敬，就用寄生种子吸走精力，免得伤害森林。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: According to folklore, POKENAME leads angry people to clean sources of water to soothe the rage in their hearts. But if people continue to be disrespectful, it drains their energy with Leech Seed so that they can't harm the forest.

entry: POKENAME叶片散发李子般的香，极能安抚。许多人配熏香，在压力大时静心。
author: .izik
source: The plum-like scent POKENAME releases from its leaves is extremely soothing. Many pair this aroma with incense to calm the mind during stressful times.

entry: POKENAME喝够水、晒够阳，身上植物偶尔结独特果。果核比空气轻，因此果子一被松开，就会浮在空中。
author: sk372
source: After consuming enough water and sunlight, the plants on POKENAME will occasionally bear a unique type of fruit. The fruit has a lighter-than-air core, so it floats through the air when released from something's grip.

entry: POKENAME散发生机，运用自然与宇宙力量。它爱漫游森林，练习掌控；也以善于适应进化、随成熟增强本领闻名。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME radiates vibrant energy and harnesses the power of nature along with cosmic forces. It enjoys roaming forests, trying to harness its powers. It is known for its ability to adapt and evolve, enhancing its skills as it matures.

entry: POKENAME叶爪长出多汁树果，吃了能开心。为让朋友高兴，它会像摇啦啦球一样摇爪，让树果如雨落下。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME's leafy paws produce juicy berries that can bring joy to those who eat them. To make its friends happy, it will shake its paws like pompoms so that berries rain down.

entry: 春天，POKENAME体表泡泡装着种子。它朝陆地吐泡，让湖边长出浓密草木。
author: .izik
source: The bubbles on POKENAME's body contain seeds during springtime. It spits these bubbles onto land to grow dense foliage around its lake.

entry: POKENAME藏在树根与高草间避敌，从披甲背上的孔吸收养分。
author: slimee_amogus
source: POKENAME hides among tree roots and in tall grass to avoid predators. It absorbs nutrients through the pores in its armored back.

entry: POKENAME滚动时，牙在地上戳坑。雨来灌满，便能给口渴宝可梦清凉一饮。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME's teeth poke holes in the earth as it rolls along. When it rains, they fill up with water and can give a refreshing drink to thirsty Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME头脑简单，性情悠闲。主要从尾尖弹叶，赶走烦扰者；叶一离体，就会燃成小火。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a simpleminded and laid-back personality. Its primary way of dealing with nuisances is flicking leaves from the tip of its tail, which ignite into small flames upon being flung from its body.

entry: POKENAME与正在抱窝的亲代同巢时，会用翅膀环住对方，替其保暖。等它们终究长得太大、巢已容不下，仍会留在附近，用细枝和树枝扩建。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME are in a nest with a broody parent, they wrap their wings around the parent to keep them warm. When POKENAME inevitably become too big for the nest, they remain close to their nest to expand it with twigs and branches.

entry: POKENAME想照料植物，尤其爱能尝树果与花蜜的品种。它用爪把灌木修成精巧造型，哪怕长在毫无戒心的土台龟身上也照剪。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME desires to care for plants, especially ones from which it can sample berries and nectar. It uses its claws to fashion bushes into intricate topiary art, even if the plant is growing on an unsuspecting Pokémon like Torterra.

entry: POKENAME装作受伤幼童，哼哼哭泣，引猎物靠近，再抓准时机使木角击昏。倒下后，它以头叶盖住，再进食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME pretends to be an injured toddler with whiney cries to draw prey close before knocking them out with a well-timed Horn Leech. Once they fall, it covers them in leaves from its head before feeding.

entry: POKENAME黏滑地爬上高树避敌。身后留淡淡树汁痕，渗进所爬的树，帮助长出更多汁、更结实的水果或树果。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME oozes up tall trees to avoid predators. It leaves a faint trail of sap behind while it moves, which soaks into the trees it climbs and helps them grow more juicy and robust fruits or berries.

entry: POKENAME背上树果极小，很难采收。但味道独特，许多人仍为此饲养。
author: .realthree
source: It is difficult to harvest the berries that grow on POKENAME's back due to their extremely small size. However, many people raise POKENAME for this produce, as the berries contain a unique flavor.

entry: POKENAME住在森林池塘等水源边。声音强到能激起水面涟漪，它就随波纹节奏跳舞。据说，表演能净水。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME lives within forests, near ponds or other water sources. Its voice is so striking it will send ripples across the water, to which it dances in rhythm with. It is said that POKENAME's performance purifies the water.

entry: POKENAME背上灌木被真菌寄生，毒孢子云能防攻击。为了双方健康，它大多时间都在挖土吃、找水喝。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is protected from attack by clouds of toxic spores produced by a fungus infesting the bush on its back. To keep them both healthy, POKENAME spends most of the day digging up soil and water to consume.

entry: POKENAME开始长大，硬壳便被撑得裂缝欲开。因此许多个体脾气差，得找其他宝可梦打架发泄。
author: theunholyhandgrenade
source: The hard shell of POKENAME is bursting at the seams as they begin to grow larger. This has resulted in many of them being ill-tempered and requiring fights with other Pokémon to vent their anger.

entry: POKENAME喜欢夜里在林溪休息，白天待在枝上。家园若毁，总能见到它种新树苗。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME like to rest in forest creeks at night and atop branches during the day. Should destruction befall its home, a POKENAME will always be found planting new saplings.

entry: POKENAME头上灌木春天结可食树果。糖吃越多，果味越甜。
author: hophoppip
source: The shrubs on POKENAME's head produce edible berries in the spring. The more sugar POKENAME eats, the sweeter its berries will taste.

entry: POKENAME头芽长成灌木，结出据说有疗效的树果。它悉心照料，不让阳光过多或过少。
author: atlas3339098
source: The sprout on POKENAME's head grows into a bush capable of producing berries said to have healing properties. It takes great care to make sure the plant doesn't get too much or too little sunlight.

entry: POKENAME极力守护作为家园的泉井。谁被认为有威胁，就会毫不迟疑地遭利爪攻击。
author: sleepyman0731
source: POKENAME are incredibly protective of the spring water wells that they call home. POKENAME will not hesitate to use their sharp claws on those they deem to be threats.

entry: POKENAME游过热带海域，叶状部位长小蓝果。果极甜，世代被用来调混合饮品。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME swims through tropical seas, small blue berries grow on the leafy portions of its body. These berries are incredibly sweet and have been used in mixed drinks for generations.

entry: POKENAME带木制器具，引导精神能量。它用超能力促进植物生长，微调根叶，确保健康强壮。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME carry wooden implements with them to help them channel their psychic energies. They use their psychic powers to encourage plants to grow, subtly adjusting their roots and leaves to ensure the plants grow healthy and strong.

entry: POKENAME英勇、棱角分明的外形，加上善良无私的天性，使形象被热门广告采用，象征守护生态的承诺。
author: anonymous_moose
source: POKENAME's heroic and chiselled appearance, as well as its kind and selfless nature, has led its image to be used in popular advertising campaigns to represent a commitment to ecological stewardship.

entry: POKENAME身周灌木出奇结实，很难破坏。缩起头与四肢，便能假扮普通灌木。
author: hophoppip
source: The shrub that grows around POKENAME's body is surprisingly sturdy and hard to damage. It can tuck in its limbs and head to disguise itself as an ordinary bush.

entry: 它躺在林间晨露里，水分滋养身体与壳外的灌木尾。尾会储存空气水汽，让晨露干后，周围地面整天仍湿润。
author: themarduk429
source: It lounges in the morning dew of forests, where the moisture nourishes it, and the shrub-tail growing out of its shell. Its tail stores humidity from the air, helping the ground around it stay damp throughout the day after the morning dew dries.

entry: POKENAME背树太大，移动缓慢。它总会确保蛋安全。
author: .duckyquack
source: POKENAME moves slowly because of the massive tree on its back. It always makes sure that its egg is safe.

entry: 许多人认为，若真有大自然母亲，就该很像这种宝可梦。POKENAME维护大片林地，像慈爱家长，照顾其中植物与宝可梦。
author: deadshields
source: Many consider that if there is such a thing as Mother Nature, she would greatly resemble this Pokémon. Wide swaths of woodlands are maintained by POKENAME, acting as caring matrons to both the plants and Pokémon within.

entry: POKENAME指导职业伐木竞技选手，让学生砍背上迅速再生的树干练习。它用锋利木爪切粗原木，展示技艺。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME coach professional timbersports athletes, letting pupils practice chopping on their rapidly regenerating trunks on their back. They demonstrate their skills by using their sharp wooden claws to slice through heavy logs.

entry: 古神话说，阿尔宙斯曾惩罚POKENAME的破坏行为，把它缠绕世界，供养其他宝可梦。考古学家发现了被认为用来安抚怒气的神龛。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: Ancient myths state that Arceus once punished POKENAME for its destructive behavior by wrapping it around the world to provide nourishment to other Pokémon. Archeologists have discovered shrines that were believed to appease its rage.

entry: 古文献与图画显示，人们曾把大POKENAME当岛屿。体温却会冷却壳上土地，使其贫瘠、不宜居住。
author: zyrum_
source: Ancient texts and drawings suggest that large POKENAME were once believed to be islands. POKENAME's body temperature cools the ground on its shell, which makes that ground infertile and uninhabitable.

entry: 这种宝可梦温柔体贴，能在家乡沙漠的沙中游动，如同行于水中。一遇到迷路的人，它们就立刻将其背起，送往最近的绿洲。
author: deadshields
source: A gentle and caring Pokémon that is capable of swimming across the sands of their desert homes like water. If they come across someone lost, they immediately heft them onto their back and take them to the nearest oasis.

entry: POKENAME吃光系统内可用数据后，会让硬件长出植物。草木过盛，设备便彻底无法使用。
author: .izik
source: After devouring all available data within a system, POKENAME causes plant life to sprout from the hardware. The overgrowth renders the device completely unusable.

entry: POKENAME常长睡，据说能持续数十年。苔藓草木遍生全身，供它光合作用，不必醒来吃饭，也能继续睡。
author: atlas3339098
source: POKENAME often takes long naps that can supposedly last decades. During this time, moss and plants grow all over its body, providing it with the ability to photosynthesize and keep sleeping without waking up to eat.

entry: POKENAME隐居最浓密幽暗的森林深处，避免接触其他生灵。有人闯领地，就用超能力操纵草木，扰乱方向、逼退。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME secludes itself deep in the thickest and darkest of forests to avoid contact with others. Should intruders enter its territory, it uses psychic powers to manipulate the greenery to disorient and repel them.

entry: POKENAME在枝间暂时收留孤苦无依的宝可梦。不知为何，叶里总含它们长大强壮所需的养分。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME is known to give temporary shelter to orphaned Pokémon among its boughs. Somehow, its leaves always contain the necessary nutrients for the orphan to grow up strong.

entry: 据说，POKENAME有古老神秘力量，能与植物交流。它似乎总知道，该如何帮病弱植物重回完美健康。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is said POKENAME has an ancient and mysterious power that allows it to communicate with plant life. POKENAME always seems to know just what to do to help an ailing plant grow back to perfect health.

entry: 粗壮的后腿，撑起它们披着燃烧藤蔓和小树的沉重身体。背上的树与藤虽然始终燃烧，哪怕暴怒时火焰再热，也绝不会化成灰。
author: infinex21
source: Their stout hind legs can hold up their heavy bodies clad in burning vines and burning small trees. The trees and vines on their backs may always be burning but they will never turn to ash, no matter how hot their flames get when enraged.

entry: 它在浓密沼泽栖居猎食，全身沉水，只露背上枝叶。察觉有什么停在上面，便疯狂扑腾，拉入水下。
author: huh.7
source: This Pokémon lives and hunts in thick marshes. It hides its entire body under the water except for the foliage on its back. When it feels something resting on top of these leaves, it thrashes and pulls them beneath the water.

entry: POKENAME大多出现在红树林生长健康的沼泽，因令人安心的气息而受欢迎。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are mostly found in swamps where the mangroves are healthy. It's popular for its soothing aura.

entry: POKENAME飞时拖着树花粉，撒进高空急流。迁徙路线葱郁繁茂，满是代代飞行留下的森林。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME trail tree pollen as they fly, dispersing it throughout the jet stream. Their migratory routes are verdant and lush, full of forests grown from generations of POKENAME flights.

entry: POKENAME痴迷自己的发型，一有机会就要炫耀。偶尔跑着跑着，头发里会掉出一颗果实，反倒将自己绊倒。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME is obsessed with its own hairdo. It will often show it off any chance it gets. Occasionally, a fruit will fall out of POKENAME's hair as it runs and cause it to trip and fall.

entry: 除了脸与开心挥动的双臂，POKENAME已与真树无异。这吓坏了毫不知情的路人。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME has become indistinguishable from a real tree, save its face and the way it cheerfully flails its arms about.  This has terrified unwitting passersby.

entry: POKENAME飞时拖着树花粉，撒进高空急流。迁徙路线葱郁繁茂，满是代代飞行留下的森林。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME trail tree pollen as they fly, dispersing it throughout the jet stream. Their migratory routes are verdant and lush, full of forests grown from generations of POKENAME flights.

entry: POKENAME叶状身体常被当灌木，难免遭咬。此时便踢泥，吓退其他宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have leafy bodies that cause other Pokémon to mistake them for bushes. When they are inevitably bitten, they kick up mud to scare away the other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME迟缓，几乎从不着急。唯独求偶季，会赶向潜在伴侣；等终于靠近，对方可能早没兴致，不再理睬。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are slow creatures that rarely feel any urgency. The only exception to this is during the mating season, where they rush towards potential mates. By the time they are close enough, the mate can lose interest and ignore them.

entry: POKENAME背树全年樱花盛放。晒太阳越久，花也越多。
author: bostroms
source: The tree that grows on POKENAME's back is covered in cherry blossoms all year long. The more time it spends in the sunlight, the more the flowers bloom.

entry: 冬眠前，POKENAME收集树果种，种在毛里。春醒时，已长出新果，供它大吃。
author: wiz0z
source: Before hibernating for the winter, POKENAME gathers berry seeds and plants them in its fur. By the time it awakens in spring, the seeds will have grown into new berries for it to feast upon.

entry: POKENAME沿野火后的森林行走，吃烧焦草木。身后留下富含养分的熔岩，冷却后会成格外肥沃的土。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME travel through forests in the wake of wildfires, eating the charred and burned vegetation left by the fires. They leave a trail of nutrient-rich lava behind them that, when cooled, becomes exceptionally fertile soil.

entry: POKENAME取食凝固熔岩地，咬碎火山岩，用丰富矿物帮助壳上的树生长。树叶养分充足，能泡好茶。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feed on dried lava fields, crunching through the volcanic rock and using the rich minerals inside to encourage the growth of the tree growing from their shell. The leaves from their tree are full of nutrients and make an excellent tea.

entry: 背上坚固的刺状甲片，让这些宝可梦常被比作某些画像中的史前宝可梦。它们撞树取果，粗尾则把敌人打飞。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon are often compared to certain depictions of prehistoric Pokémon, primarily due to the sturdy spike-like plates lining their backs. They headbutt trees to knock free the fruits within to eat and send foes flying with their thick tails.

entry: POKENAME背树供许多小鸟宝可梦居住。鸟儿采食给它，换取温暖与保护。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The tree on the back of POKENAME is home to many small bird Pokémon. These Pokémon gather food for POKENAME in exchange for warmth and protection.

entry: POKENAME平日躺着晒太阳，自然吸光，培育共生植物。植物供给足够养分，让它从颊刺放电。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spend their days lounging in the sun, passively absorbing sunlight to help grow their symbiotic plants. The plants provide them with enough nutrients to allow them to generate electrical shocks from their cheek spikes.

entry: POKENAME能徒手造山。有人推测，远古成群的POKENAME，曾帮助雷吉奇卡斯，创造、塑成世界的大陆。
author: doodledoo
source: POKENAME is able to create mountains with its bare hands. It is theorized that in the past, hordes of POKENAME helped Regigigas create and shape the continents of the world.

entry: POKENAME的饮食，使身上苔藓富含必需养分与矿物。战斗中，它如陀螺旋转，以全重撞敌，靠棒状尾巴平衡。
author: chibitales
source: The moss growing on POKENAME's body is often high in essential nutrients and minerals as a result of POKENAME's diet. POKENAME slam their entire weight into foes during battle by spinning like a top, using their clubbed tail as a counter-balance.

entry: POKENAME背上长着菌盖极硬的真菌。它摘下交给森林小生灵，当小盾自卫。
author: sk372
source: Fungi with very hard caps grow upon POKENAME's back. It plucks and hands them off to smaller forest denizens to use as little shields that can aid in defending themselves.

entry: 头刺保护所长的树，免遭捕食者。树会强化POKENAME，若被砍掉，它就失去大部分力量。
author: aidenvanschalkwyk13gmail.c_12300
source: The spikes on its head protect the tree growing there from predators. The tree strengthens POKENAME, and if it is cut off, POKENAME will lose most of its strength.

entry: POKENAME背树，是许多小宝可梦的家。它凶猛守护树与居民，战斗却常让乘客死死攀住摇晃树枝。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: The trees growing on POKENAME's back serve as homes for many smaller Pokémon. It fiercely protects both the trees and their inhabitants, though battles often leave its passengers clinging desperately to the swaying branches.

entry: POKENAME天生爱守护，庇护小宝可梦，抵御捕食者，也教武术。片场需要保安，通常就用它。
author: ghostslythe
source: Naturally defensive, POKENAME takes smaller Pokémon under its wing, protecting them against predators and teaching martial arts. When film sets need security, they generally use this Pokémon.

entry: 为了自己与树健康，它们常躺湿泥与深水洼。许多人喜欢把树修成各种造型，POKENAME似乎也很享受。
author: infinex21
source: To keep themselves and their trees healthy, they lounge in damp mud and deep puddles. There are many who enjoy trimming their trees in various ways, which even POKENAME seem to enjoy having happen.

entry: POKENAME直立时，背树压得后腿肌肉始终吃力。经过足够时间与练习，便能强健到轻松承受。
author: porterofgames
source: The tree growing on its back weighs it down when standing upright, so its hind leg muscles are always under constant strain. With enough time and practice, POKENAME's leg muscles become strong enough to easily withstand the pressure.

entry: 许多人认为，它在战斗中自成一格，势不可挡。任一手臂挥动一下，就能击碎巨石。身上的大树，反映它的健康；叶片若萎蔫，力量也会减弱。
author: infinex21
source: Many consider it to be a juggernaut in a class of its own when it comes to combat. With a single swing of either of its arms, it can shatter large boulders. Its sizable tree indicates its health; if the leaves wilt, its strength wanes.

entry: POKENAME的尾反映健康。若安全快乐，就会开甜香花。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME's tail acts as an indicator of its health. If POKENAME is safe and happy, the tail will sprout sweet-smelling flowers.

entry: POKENAME在岛上温和好客，敏锐感知大地，救助天灾中的宝可梦、照料雨林。人们献衣求丰收，却不知它的尾巴会拉长任何织物。
author: ghostslythe
source: A welcoming island presence, POKENAME are attuned to the land, rescuing Pokémon from natural disasters and ensuring the rainforests are taken care of. People offer their clothes to ensure bountiful harvests, unaware its tail stretches any fabric.

entry: POKENAME一条臂上长出沉重的树木武器，专用于战术交锋。所爱者在旁时，它十分警觉，随时准备保护。
author: gaogao028
source: From one of its arms grows a hefty arboreal weapon, specialized for strategic combat capabilities. POKENAME is vigilant around those it holds dearest, always ready to protect them if needed.

entry: POKENAME树叶随季节与健康变色，颜色变暗就是病征。它主要把幼崽背在身上，偶尔也背其他幼年宝可梦。
author: infinex21
source: The leaves of its tree change colors with the seasons and in response to its health; signs of illness are when the colors become darker. POKENAME primarily carries its young on its back, though it may carry other young Pokémon on its back as well.

entry: POKENAME极懒，一睡就是数小时。背树一次能容数十只鸟宝可梦居住。
author: themisterlitwick
source: POKENAME are incredibly lazy, and will nap for hours at a time. The tree on POKENAME's back will house dozens of bird Pokémon at a time.

entry: POKENAME会花数十年，把家园改成喜欢的地形。巨口与超能力，让这事十分轻松。
author: themisterlitwick
source: POKENAME will spend decades terraforming their homes to their liking. Their large mouths and psychic abilities allow them to do so with ease.

entry: POKENAME在身体一部分的树周围，培育防护林。神圣空间呼唤林中迷失的小宝可梦之灵，来者便能安息。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME cultivate protective groves around the tree that make up part of their bodies. This sanctified space calls out to the spirits of small Pokémon lost in the woods, bringing those that find their way to rest.

entry: POKENAME热切守护自然，不倦走遍广大领地，保护遇险受困的野生宝可梦。谁想伤害它照料的对象，就会招来罕有可比的怒火，直到被阻止。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: An ardent defender of nature, POKENAME tirelessly travels its vast territory, protecting any wild Pokémon in danger or distress. If anything intends to harm those under its care, a fury rivaled by few others is unleashed until it is stopped.

entry: POKENAME群在森林生态中很重要。取食地没有大树，让灌木有空间生长。背上植物，也给小宝可梦提供另一种花蜜来源。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Herds of POKENAME play an important role in forest ecosystems, their grazing grounds being areas kept clear of large trees allowing shrubs space to grow. The plants growing on their backs provide an alternative source of nectar for smaller Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME颚上植物冬季开小花。花瓣常用于关都沙拉，厨师赞赏甜味。
author: .izik
source: The plants on POKENAME's jaw grow tiny flowers during winter. The petals are used in many salads in Kanto and are praised by chefs for their sweet flavor.

entry: POKENAME睡太久，背上长满各种植物，甚至小树。醒来吃树果，再睡到果子长回。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME sleep for so long that various plant life grows along their backs, including small trees. When awake, they will consume the fruit that grows on these trees, returning to sleep until they've regrown.

entry: POKENAME通常能活100年，被视为长寿象征。野外大多留在洞里育幼，偶尔却会带孩子外出旅行。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are regarded as figures of longevity because they typically live for 100 years. Most POKENAME in the wild stay inside dens where they raise children, but sometimes leave to take the young Pokémon on trips.

entry: 森林偶尔能见野生POKENAME双手握住老树干。树死才肯放；不知是它造成，还是只在等待死亡。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME can occasionally be found in forests, gripping the trunk of an old tree with both hands. POKENAME only lets go after the tree dies, but it is unclear if it causes this or simply waits for it to happen.

entry: POKENAME极庞大，有时历数千年，能长到数英里。大多沉睡海床，一代人或许才有幸见一次迁徙。
author: victor9106
source: Truly immense creatures, POKENAME can sometimes grow to be miles in length over the course of millennia. While most POKENAME spend their time slumbering on the seafloor, a POKENAME migration may be seen once in a generation.

entry: 某些教团曾把POKENAME尊为森林之神。据说，它走过大地，落脚处便会开花。
author: .izik
source: Certain cults revered POKENAME as a god of forests. Flowers were said to bloom wherever it stepped as it wandered through the land.

entry: 生命接近终点时，POKENAME身后嫩芽般的尾巴，会长成一棵大树，让它行动不便。即使它离世很久以后，这棵树仍会从本体中，继续汲取养分。
author: .izik
source: Near the end of its lifecycle, the sprout-like tail on POKENAME's rear grows into a large tree that prevents it from moving easily. This tree continues to draw nutrients from the main body long after it passes on.

entry: POKENAME身上草木长大，消耗部分力量与耐力。能量被取走，使它大多时间都在吃或睡。
author: sk372
source: Larger foliage has grown on POKENAME's body, draining it of some of its strength and stamina. It spends most of its time eating or sleeping as a result of this energy drain.

entry: POKENAME史前巨足迹刚发现时，曾被当成神话宝可梦所留。深入研究显示，它们过去长得极大，后来体形随时代逐渐缩小。
author: jojojax164
source: When massive prehistoric footprints of POKENAME were discovered, they were thought to be from a mythological Pokémon. Advanced studies show that POKENAME once grew to immense sizes, but slowly grew smaller as more time passed.

entry: 巨大压力下，有些POKENAME会长到惊人规模，散出浓牛至香。巨形只能维持一小时左右，就又缩回。
author: .izik
source: During times of great stress, some POKENAME grow to incredible sizes, releasing a strong oregano scent during this time. They can only sustain this larger form for an hour or so before shrinking back down.

entry: POKENAME大多埋地下，只露树状尾。谁想砍，它就破土而出，喷出猛烈喷射火焰。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME spends much of its time buried underground, leaving only its tree-like tail exposed. If anyone attempts to cut it down, it rises from the earth and unleashes a devastating Flamethrower.

entry: POKENAME肩部生长物上有小树。它会拔下点燃，夜里照明，或当战斗中的火焰武器。
author: sk372
source: Small trees grow on the growths on POKENAME's shoulders. It pulls these trees off and ignites them to use as illumination at night, or as a flaming weapon in combat.

entry: POKENAME左臂强到能扯倒大树。若被砍断，也能再生，却需数月。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's left arm is strong enough to tear down large trees. It can also grow back if cut off, though this takes a few months.

entry: POKENAME头上的岛太小，容不下宝可梦，只好耐心让孩子或幼年宝可梦放玩具。
author: lydiaprower8
source: Since the island on its head is too small to house any Pokémon, POKENAME compromises by patiently letting children or baby Pokémon put toys on its head.

entry: POKENAME背树不断长新皮。它用臂上冰冷利刃剥旧皮，做成坚固木甲，保护身体。
author: jaminmcready
source: The tree on POKENAME's back constantly produces new bark. Using the sharp, icy blades on its arms, it strips away older layers and fashions them into sturdy wooden armor that protects its body.

entry: POKENAME身躯厚重结实，一站稳就几乎无法挪动。它守护寒地森林与居民，谁袭击却没能击倒，就会遭冰冻。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's heavy and sturdy body is considered nearly impossible to budge when it stands its ground. It protects forests in colder regions and the residents within from harm, freezing those who attack and fail to knock it down.

entry: 小宝可梦常栖息在POKENAME的树顶。它总能轻松找到食物与水，也很少迷路，因此不少宝可梦会向它寻求指引。磁场却让金属碎片常吸在身体与树里。
author: infinex21
