source: Small Pokémon often perch atop POKENAME's tree, as it can always find water and food with ease; it also rarely gets lost, so many refer to it to know where to go. Due to its magnetic field, pieces of metal often get stuck to it and within its tree.

entry: 有人以为POKENAME是大地的复仇幽灵。据说，人类过度开采栖地资源时，它的盾就会饥饿。
author: spkypirate
source: Thought by some to be a vengeful spirit of the earth, POKENAME's shield is said to grow hungry when humanity extracts too many resources from its habitat.

entry: POKENAME保护长大的森林。外来者破坏任何领地，就会被迅速掷斧警告。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME are the protectors of the forests they grew up in. If an outsider damages any of their territory, POKENAME will swiftly throw an axe at them as a warning.

entry: POKENAME栖居的森林里，裸露着古老的岩石，历经数千年侵蚀，已被磨得平坦。它坚决守护巢穴，以石质头部，向对手发起毫不留情的撞击。
author: duplicitous_dirk
source: POKENAME makes its home in forests with ancient, exposed rock that has been worn down flat from millennia of erosion. They are a staunch defender of their nest, using their stony head to slam opponents with ruthless attacks.

entry: 背上的树大得足以让小宝可梦栖居。POKENAME动作太慢，住客几乎不会被摇下来。
author: pepperthepirate
source: The trees on its back are large enough for smaller Pokémon to live in. Since POKENAME is so sluggish, the inhabitants are rarely shaken out.

entry: 翅膀终生不断生长，即使年老的POKENAME，背着如此庞大沉重的翅膀，也能轻松浮起。
author: busilisk
source: This Pokémon's wings will grow continuously throughout its lifetime. Despite their size and weight, even old POKENAME can still float effortlessly.

entry: POKENAME把触须扎土，250英尺内就迅速长出樱树苗。生长速度，取决于当前营养状态。
author: .izik
source: After digging its feelers into the soil, cherry tree saplings rapidly sprout within 250 feet of POKENAME. The speed at which they grow depends on its current nutrition.

entry: 水手说，POKENAME巨大，背上托岩峰与巨树。但太稀有，目击又都隔远，真实大小尚未确证。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: Sailors sighting POKENAME report a gigantic creature, supporting rocky peaks and a colossal tree on its titanic back. Due to its rarity and the distance of these sightings, however, its true size has not been definitively confirmed.

entry: 小鸟宝可梦常成群住在POKENAME背上。它极力保护居民。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: Flocks of small bird Pokémon often live on POKENAME's back. It is fiercely protective of those living on it.

entry: POKENAME几天就能造整片雨林。常被误认成红杉，导致整支伐木队失踪。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME have the ability to create entire rainforests in only a matter of days. They are often mistaken for redwoods, which causes entire logging crews to go missing.

entry: POKENAME住在林间空地，静立假扮树。附近睡觉都会噩梦，但取些流出的纯泉水，睡前喝下，就能安眠。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lives in forest glades, remaining still in imitation of a tree. Although anyone who sleeps nearby will suffer from bad dreams, taking away some of the pure springwater flowing out of it to drink before bed will result in peaceful sleep.

entry: 盖诺赛克特的科技力量，与土台龟的大地力量融合，使善意与无情扭曲交织，成了注定战斗的温柔巨人。
author: imaginita
source: The fusion of Genesect's technological might with Torterra's terrestrial power has resulted in a warped amalgamation of benevolence and mercilessness, a gentle giant destined for battle.

entry: 鲜为人知的传说里，它是古老森林守护者。据说，森林负面能量过盛，就会以雷电夷平，让林地重生。
author: sk372
source: An ancient forest guardian spoken of in obscure legends. It is said that should its forest fill with too much negative energy, it will raze the woodland to the ground with lightning so it may grow anew.

entry: 最大的POKENAME已成了动植物的浮空乐土。它会落地熟睡，让小宝可梦爬上身。
author: mistymagius
source: The largest of POKENAME have become floating havens of flora and fauna. It sleeps soundly on the ground, allowing small Pokémon to climb on.

entry: POKENAME扎地，给树吸养分，直到长出结实根，形成能撑身的手臂。它用这些手臂在森林间旅行，沿途种树。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME plant themselves into the ground to absorb nutrients into their trees until they grow roots sturdy enough to form into arms that can support them. They use these arms to travel between forests, planting new trees as they go.

entry: POKENAME不战斗时，通常四足走路，壳上草木至少能给其他宝可梦容身。战斗中，则用前肢抓敌，再以斧牙劈砍。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME tend to walk on all fours when not in battle, the lush conditions of their shells offering at least a refuge to other Pokémon. In battle, they use their forelimbs to grab hold of their opponent and slash them with their axe-like tusks.

entry: POKENAME把吐出的内脏巧妙地伪装成树。小生灵一停在上面休息或安家，就会被它吸入体内吞食。
author: sk372
source: What appears to be a tree is just POKENAME's cleverly-disguised ejected innards. Once a small creature perches on it to rest or make a home, POKENAME sucks it back into its body for consumption.

entry: POKENAME把头上的树当成棒槌攻击敌人。战斗之外，它却常走得踉踉跄跄，因为很难让树在头顶保持平衡。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME wields the tree on its head like a club to attack foes. Outside of battle it is seen stumbling about, as it struggles to keep the plant properly balanced on its head.

entry: POKENAME白天展开叶状尾，尽量吸光。每尾流着富含养分的特殊液体，多数生灵碰到，却会灼伤。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME spread their leaf-like tails during the day to maximize the amount of sunlight they absorb. Coursing through each of their tails is a special fluid packed with nutrients, though this fluid burns to the touch for most beings.

entry: POKENAME身形高耸，能量强大，终于完全掌握草属性本领。它从大地与宇宙取力，操纵周围环境，发出猛烈攻击。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME towers with immense energy, having finally mastered its Grass-type abilities. This formidable Pokémon draws strength from the earth and cosmos, manipulating its surroundings to create powerful attacks in battle.

entry: POKENAME极懒，常找好地方，一连安睡几天。但身躯太大，无意阻断河流，成了自己也没察觉的天然水坝。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME is extremely lazy, often finding a nice spot to lounge and sleep peacefully for days at a time. However, due to its colossal size, it unintentionally blocks the river's flow, acting as a natural dam without realising.

entry: 夏末，POKENAME常成群在海岬附近现身。每只喷出的蓝色树状水柱，都独一无二。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME are typically seen with their pods near capes in late summer. The blue tree-like spout of water each produces is unique to that individual.

entry: POKENAME九尾是结实的根，休息就把尖端埋地。尾泛温暖日光，能转成能量光束或火焰。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's nine tails are hardy roots, the tips of which it buries into the ground whenever it rests. Its tails glow warmly with sunlight, which it can convert into beams of energy or into flames.

entry: POKENAME会稍鼓身体，显得更大更吓人。偶尔却适得其反，体形改变，让背树把它往后压，摔倒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will puff itself up slightly in order to look larger and more intimidating. This can occasionally backfire, as the change in size causes the tree on its back to weigh it backwards and cause it to topple over.

entry: POKENAME常用身体撞击物件，标记领地。因此，小宝可梦都不愿在它们背上筑巢。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME often bash their bodies against objects to mark their territory. Because of this, small Pokémon avoid building their nests on their backs.

entry: POKENAME尖刺虽利，却很少用于打架。它们刺土翻动，让新植物能生长，农夫便拿来代替播种打穴工具。
author: periperi_chicken
source: While POKENAME's spikes are very sharp, they rarely use them for fighting. Instead, they poke into the dirt, churning it up so that new plants can grow. Farmers have used them as a natural replacement to dibbers.

entry: POKENAME群在森林生态中很重要。取食地没有大树，让灌木有空间生长。壳上植物，也给小宝可梦提供另一种花蜜来源。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Herds of POKENAME play an important role in forest ecosystems, their grazing grounds being areas kept clear of large trees allowing shrubs space to grow. The plants growing on their shells provide an alternative source of nectar for smaller Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME壳上有强健的草木生态。晴天，背部植物光合作用供能充足，能让它数月不吃东西。
author: jadey.1557
source: This Pokémon's shell contains a robust ecosystem of greenery. When it's sunny, the flora atop the back of POKENAME produces enough energy through photosynthesis that POKENAME can go for months without food.

entry: POKENAME常照顾小宝可梦，保护、让它们吃灌木状肢体上的美味小树果。头刺尖端被碰，就放出刺激性毒素。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are often seen taking care of smaller Pokémon, protecting them and letting them eat the small, delectable berries that grow upon their bush-like limbs. The spikes on their heads release irritant toxins when the tips are touched.

entry: POKENAME背着树却够轻，能随风漂。它爱高浮天空，云上落下的叶，便显示行踪。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is light enough to drift on the wind despite the tree on its back. It prefers to float high in the sky, so its presence is indicated by leaves falling from above the clouds.

entry: POKENAME极微小，哪怕一点绿意也能藏身。根在土下延伸，轻戳其他生灵，吸少许静电维生。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's absolutely minuscule size lets it easily blend in to even the smallest amount of greenery. It spreads roots under the soil that reach out and lightly poke others, siphoning tiny bits of static electricity for sustenance.

entry: POKENAME背上电能构成的树，大小反映健康。为维持它，本体会咬较大生灵，抽取静电。
author: sk372
source: The size of the tree of electric energy on POKENAME's back is an indicator of how healthy it is. To keep it sustained, it bites larger beings and drains them of static electricity.

entry: POKENAME守护自己精心培育的树林。必要时，甚至会把别处的树连根拔走，移栽进来。只要不伤害这份珍贵收藏，它就允许其他宝可梦住下。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME guards a grove of trees it tends to and has curated, even having stolen some by ripping up trees by their roots and replanting them if needed. It allows other Pokémon to live in the grove so long as they do not harm its precious collection.

entry: 只有背上的草木，或获准居住的生灵受到伤害时，POKENAME才会攻击。它注入闯入者体内的毒液，会引发严重皮疹与肌肉萎缩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME only lashes out at others when they attempt to harm the foliage on its back, or any creatures it allows to live atop it. The venom it injects into interlopers causes severe rashes and muscle atrophy.

entry: POKENAME伪装成草木，埋伏等待猎物。古人十分害怕踏入它栖居的森林。
author: kokoria_
source: POKENAME lies in wait disguised as foliage to ambush prey. Ancient people feared to enter the forests it inhabited.

entry: POKENAME的鳍由石灰岩构成，会向周围水里释放养分。鳍上常长出海藻，让它看起来像移动的海带林。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has fins made out of limestone that leach nutrients into the surrounding water. Seaweed often grows on these fins and gives it the appearance of a moving kelp forest.

entry: POKENAME生活在淡水时，背上的树会长得更大。生活在盐水里的个体，树则更矮、更细。
author: .izik
source: The tree on POKENAME's back grows larger when it lives in freshwater. Those in saltwater develop shorter and thinner trees.

entry: POKENAME往往体形庞大，因此只能寄居在小树中。小宝可梦喜欢住在枝间，但负重可能超出它的承受能力，它便将尾巴旋入地下，稳住身体。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME are frequently so large, they can only inhabit small trees. Small Pokémon like to live between the branches, but the weight can be too great for POKENAME, so they will corkscrew their tails into the ground to stay steady.

entry: POKENAME让小宝可梦聚在背上，载着脆弱的它们飞往更合适的环境。它趁夜色行动，优先确保乘客不受昼行捕食者威胁。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME gather small Pokémon on their back and fly the vulnerable Pokémon to environments that are more suitable for them. They move under the cover of night, prioritizing the safety of their charges from diurnal predators.

entry: 它的大部分能量来自头顶的树。有些POKENAME的树长得太大，甚至会让身体翻倒。
author: hophoppip
source: It gains most of its energy from the tree on top of its head. Some POKENAME's trees grow large enough to make the POKENAME topple over.

entry: POKENAME背着一座有毒花园，只有少数耐受的昆虫与虫宝可梦能繁盛生存。每只都有独特生态，居民一生不离开，免受外部威胁。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME carries a toxic garden on its back, where only a few resistant insects and Bug Pokémon can thrive. Each one hosts a unique ecosystem, and creatures living there spend their entire lives without leaving it, safe from external threats.

entry: POKENAME背着一座有毒花园，只有少数耐受的昆虫与虫宝可梦能繁盛生存。每只都有独特生态，居民一生不离开，免受外部威胁。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME carries a toxic garden on its back, where only a few resistant insects and Bug Pokémon can thrive. Each one hosts a unique ecosystem, and creatures living there spend their entire lives without leaving it, safe from external threats.

entry: POKENAME背着一座有毒花园，只有少数耐受的昆虫与虫宝可梦能繁盛生存。每只都有独特生态，居民一生不离开，免受外部威胁。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME carries a toxic garden on its back, where only a few resistant insects and Bug Pokémon can thrive. Each one hosts a unique ecosystem, and creatures living there spend their entire lives without leaving it, safe from external threats.

entry: POKENAME拔起树苗，栽进背部进行光合作用。树长得太大，就再换一棵新的。
author: hummusishome
source: POKENAME pull saplings from the ground and integrate them into their back for photosynthesis. Once it grows too big, they replace it with a new one.

entry: POKENAME尾上的大树，是多种鸟宝可梦的家。不过，它一把树用作武器，鸟儿就往往不肯继续待着。
author: themisterlitwick
source: The large tree on POKENAME's tail is home to various bird Pokémon, although the bird Pokémon don't tend to stay around when POKENAME uses the tree as weapon.

entry: POKENAME的身体结构仿照星球各层，因此下半身更致密，最尖端则熔融般灼热，能烧伤任何靠近的东西。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body composition mimics the layers of the planet in design. As such, its bottom half is more dense and the very tip of its body is molten hot, burning anything that gets near.

entry: POKENAME壳上载着大量泥土，培育出盆景般的树。甲壳里的沃土容易蓄水，暴雨时吸入的水会成为沉重负担。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME host a large amount of soil on their shell, in which they cultivate a tree evocative of a bonsai. The rich soil nested into their carapace retains water easily, encumbering POKENAME with water in heavy rains.

entry: 有些地方称POKENAME为森林贤者。它会向迷路旅人现身，指引安全道路，草木也仿佛随法杖的动作一起移动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been called a sage of the forests in some areas. It appears before lost travelers to guide them to safety, the plants themselves seeming to shift and move in accordance with the motion of its staff.

entry: POKENAME攻击时，会举起用整根树干制成的杖。平静安宁时，它也允许小拉达等小宝可梦，在浓密裙摆间暂住。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME heft staves made of an entire tree trunk during their attacks. During times of calm and serenity, they allow small Pokémon such as Rattata to make temporary homes in their dense dresses.

entry: POKENAME从古树采下巨木，总在原处补种树苗。它珍爱这根木头，削成强大木棒，借此引导足以撼地的物理与精神攻击。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME harvest massive logs from ancient trees, always planting a new sapling in its place. They will treasure this log, shaping it into a powerful club that they use as a medium to channel their ground-shaking physical and psychic attacks.

entry: POKENAME聚在草木繁茂处，组成五到十只的小队，守护选定栖地。它们对其他宝可梦很有责任心，因此巡护员常会找一只或多只结伴。
author: vic1312
source: Gathering near places with lush greenery, POKENAME will gather into squads of five to ten individuals and protect their selected habitat. Due to their sense of duty towards other Pokémon, Rangers often seek out partnerships with one or more POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME背上的树不断长大，重得无法行动后，就用壳内火焰把树烧掉，也借此获取养分。可有时，不小心便引发了山火。
author: aurange
source: The tree on POKENAME's back grows until it is too heavy for it to move, then it uses the flames from within its shell to burn down the tree. This process is also how POKENAME nourishes itself. It sometimes unintentionally starts forest fires.

entry: 这是POKENAME的一个亚种。体内高热难以散出，烧去了背树叶片的叶绿素，使树叶呈现独特橙色，也限制了树的大小。
author: aurange
source: A subspecies of POKENAME. The intense heat within its body is not well ventilated, burning away the chlorophyll in the leaves of the tree upon its back. This gives them a distinctive orange coloring and prevents their tree from growing too large.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉高度发达，能找到密林各处隐藏的珍稀果实。据说，它只向尊重自然的对象透露位置。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's highly developed sense of smell allows it to find rare fruit hidden across dense forests. It's said it only shares the location of these fruits with those who respect nature.

entry: POKENAME喜欢住在水与环境都保持洁净的家庭花园、公园里。它自豪地展示背上的东西，却不肯让其他对象踩踏自己。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy residing in home gardens and parks where the water and the surrounding environment are kept clean. They proudly display whatever is on their back and refuse to let others trample over them.

entry: POKENAME头上的灌木，已是一棵强壮的大树，其他宝可梦常用来避护。凡在枝下休息的宝可梦，它都会极力保护。
author: atlas3339098
source: The bush on POKENAME's head is a mighty tree that other Pokémon often use for shelter. POKENAME is very protective of any Pokémon that rests beneath its branches.

entry: 暴雨时，POKENAME用帽子收集雨水，补充内部永不停歇的河流。它常去少雨甚至无雨地区，与当地居民分享水。
author: dodoowner_
source: During torrential downpours, POKENAME collects rainwater in its hat, replenishing the everflowing river within. It frequents areas with little to no rain, sharing water with the region's inhabitants.

entry: POKENAME披着坚韧土甲，背着繁盛树木，缓缓漂过天空。它从阳光与土壤获取能量，所到之处都守护自然平衡。
author: yess5525
source: POKENAME drifts slowly through the skies, its body covered in tough, earthen armor and a thriving tree. It draws energy from sunlight and soil, acting as a guardian of natural balance wherever it passes.

entry: POKENAME像一颗小世界，轻柔浮过空中，壳上生机盎然。目光虽可爱，仍能爆发强大自然能量，保卫自己的领域。
author: yess5525
source: POKENAME gently floats through the air like a tiny world, its shell teeming with life. Despite its adorable gaze, it can summon powerful bursts of nature energy to defend its domain.

entry: POKENAME背上的树缓缓燃烧，产生独特的烹饪木炭。树每隔几年才长回一次，因此木炭相当昂贵。
author: mepp.
source: The tree on POKENAME's back burns away slowly, creating a unique charcoal for cooking. This tree regrows every few years, making the charcoal quite expensive.

entry: POKENAME吐出的水，对植物营养极高。一夸脱，就能让一株植物的生长速度翻倍。
author: .izik
source: The water POKENAME spits is highly nutritious to vegetation. A single quart can double a plant's growth speed.

entry: POKENAME背上的小生态，有时会让它精神不适。头痛时，植物会明显低垂，直到疼痛消退，因此通常能看出来。
author: sk372
source: The small ecosystem on POKENAME's back can sometimes cause it mental discomfort. One can usually tell if POKENAME is suffering from a headache, since the plants will noticeably droop until the pain subsides.

entry: 野外最常在秋季见到POKENAME，在树间疾奔，巡视领地。树上脱落的红叶摸着温暖，却会迅速萎缩成灰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is most often spotted in the wild during the autumnal seasons, dashing between the trees and surveying its territory. The red-tinted leaves its tree sheds are warm to the touch, and shrivel into ash at a rapid rate.

entry: 风暴过后，POKENAME会穿林寻找被拔起或吹倒的幼树。它把树背在身上培育，利用逐渐增加的重量锻炼肌肉。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME search through forests in the wake of storms for saplings that have been uprooted or toppled. They carry the young trees on their body, nurturing them as they grow and using the steadily increasing weight to train their muscles.

entry: POKENAME会埋入地里，或藏在低矮草木间，完全静止。若有宝可梦想在背叶下避护，就会被毒颚攫住。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will bury its body in the ground, or hide in undergrowth, then remain totally still. If any Pokémon tries to shelter under the leaf on its back, POKENAME will seize it in its venomous jaws.

entry: 它喜欢潮湿空气与多雨气候，水分能让树状尾巴的枝叶蓬松浓密。炎夏，湿地也让它感到凉爽、恢复精神。
author: themarduk429
source: It enjoys humid air and wet climates, where the moisture fluffs and thickens the leafage growth of its tree-like tail. The wet ground keeps it feeling cool and rejuvenated in the hot summer months.

entry: POKENAME壳上长的树，有独立意识。它大多不动，却会按特定方式摇枝，在一定程度上影响本体行为。
author: sk372
source: The tree growing on POKENAME's shell has a mind of its own. Though mostly inactive, it will rustle its branches in specific ways in order to influence POKENAME's behavior to an extent.

entry: POKENAME出没于死去森林的遗迹，藏在腐木与草丛间。它制造魔性植物、树枝伸向旅人的恐怖幻象，折磨对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME haunts the remains of dead forests, hiding among the rotting wood and grass. It torments travelers by making ghoulish illusions of demonic plants and tree limbs reaching for them.

entry: POKENAME追猎引发森林火灾的人，用恐怖噩梦折磨对方。暴怒时，还会试着以巨大木手抓住受害者，再用可怕双颚吞食。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME hunts down people who start forest fires, tormenting their dreams with terrifying nightmares. When enraged, it tries to seize its victims with its huge wooden hands before devouring them with its dreadful jaws.

entry: POKENAME树上结的咸甜果，是它最爱的点心之一。但长翅鸥等鸟也很珍爱，常得激烈争斗，自己才吃得到。
author: sk372
source: The sweet and salty fruit that grows on POKENAME's trees is one of its favorite snacks. Unfortunately, it is also highly prized by Wingull and other birds, so POKENAME often has to fight fiercely just to get a bite for itself.

entry: POKENAME浮在湖心，为不善泳的小宝可梦提供安全岛屿，也以树荫遮阳。自己或背上居民受威胁时，就蓄力喷出水柱，把危险轰退。
author: themarduk429
source: POKENAME floats in the middle of lakes, providing an island of safety for small Pokémon who struggle to swim, offering them shade from a tree. If it or the Pokémon on its back are threatened, it charges its waterspouts to blast the threat away.

entry: POKENAME的骨头会吸收周围热量，再通过火焰攻击释放，造成严重烧伤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's bone absorbs ambient heat from its surroundings. This stored warmth is released through its fire attacks, causing severe burns.

entry: POKENAME总是活蹦乱跳。它让尾端明火随节奏闪烁，开心地教队友模仿灵巧动作。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME is constantly bouncing off the walls. By flickering the bright flame on its tail to keep the rhythm, it cheerfully instructs its teammates to mimic its nimble movements.

entry: POKENAME遇险常会点燃腹部。但睡前总会灭火，确保挂在树枝上时不会掉下来。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME often lights its abdomen on fire when it is in danger. However, it always puts out this flame before sleeping to ensure it does not fall while hanging from tree branches.

entry: POKENAME栖在结满甜果的树枝上。其他对象想靠近，它就用尾火与吃剩的果核不断打去，阻止接近。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME perches in the branches of trees that bear large amounts of sweet-tasting fruit. It dissuades others from approaching its tree by pelting them with fire from its tail as well as the fruits' leftover cores.

entry: POKENAME藏在树里，从尾端小火苗甩出火球，砸向其他对象。它并无恶意，只觉得对方惊讶、躲闪的模样很好玩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides in trees and pelts others with fireballs swung from the small flame at the tip of its tail. It does this not out of malice but because it finds their surprise and attempts to dodge to be funny.

entry: POKENAME住在丛林树冠，用响亮啼叫穿过密叶，与同类交流。夜里，远处也能看见树顶的火光。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in the canopy of jungles, hooting loudly at one another to communicate through the dense foliage. At night their flames can be seen in the treetops from a great distance.

entry: POKENAME作息固定，总在太阳完全越过地平线时醒来。若这时太阳被云遮住，它就会不高兴。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME have a rigid sleep schedule that ensures they wake up when the sun entirely passes over the horizon. If the sun happens to be blocked by clouds when they awaken, POKENAME grows upset.

entry: POKENAME结群时，彼此体热能帮助发挥火焰能力。它们从双腿之间分泌可燃液体，能远远点燃物品，随后匆匆溜走。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME are in groups, the body heat they give off to each other allow them to effectively create and use their fire capabilities. They secrete a flammable liquid from between their legs to ignite objects from afar before scramming the scene.

entry: POKENAME精力旺盛，又格外吵闹，常在险峻山间出没。一走丢，就用悦耳的鸣声，呼唤双亲。
author: gwello
source: POKENAME are hyperactive and loud. They can be found around craggy mountains letting out a euphonious cry to call out to their parents if lost.

entry: POKENAME总会惹出麻烦。曾有一只无意闯进真人秀片场，撞翻一叠盘子，盘子碎了便跳进泳池，这段画面意外爆红。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are always getting themselves into trouble. One once unwittingly stumbled onto the set of a reality TV show, causing a viral moment as it knocked over a pile of plates before jumping into a pool when they shattered.

entry: POKENAME吸收越多阳光，背火就越亮、越热。它十分在意，睡前会先灭火，防止森林火灾。
author: santon5512
source: The flame on POKENAME's back grows brighter and hotter the more sunlight they absorb. They are very conscious about this flame, extinguishing it before they sleep to prevent forest fires.

entry: 它用尾火点起火焰，把宝可梦赶离巢穴。等亲代走得够远，就迅速靠近，偷走蛋。
author: bacondlx
source: It uses the flame on its tail to light fires that drive Pokémon away from their nests. Once the parents are far enough away from the nest, it swiftly closes in to steal any eggs.

entry: POKENAME经常吃树果。热量与压力会把食物转成高度易燃的气体，作为副产物储存在壳里。遇险时，它就点燃气体，引发爆炸喷发。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME regularly consumes berries. Heat and pressure convert this food into a highly flammable gas as a byproduct captured in their shell. When in danger, POKENAME can ignite this gas to create explosive eruptions.

entry: POKENAME每天练舞，变得越来越优雅。得到赞美，就会开心跳跃，从尾巴散出火星。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME practices dancing every day to become more and more graceful. When it receives a compliment, it hops around, scattering sparks of fire from its tail.

entry: POKENAME的刺始终缠着火焰。虽然并无真正毒性，却能注入一种物质，让受害者体温瞬间升到危险程度。
author: karagar
source: POKENAME's stinger is always wreathed in flame, and while not truly toxic, it can inject a substance that can instantly raise the victim's body temperature to dangerous levels.

entry: 它能迅速爬上树木、崖壁等粗糙的垂直表面，寻找住所。双手拍胸，会刺激内部火焰囊，做好战斗准备。
author: infinex21
source: It can quickly scale rough, vertical surfaces such as trees and cliffs in search of a place to live. By beating its hands against its chest, it can agitate its internal flame sac and prepare itself for battle.

entry: POKENAME腺体中储存的花蜜，一吐出便会燃烧。它能轻松精准命中最远40英尺外的目标。
author: .izik
source: The nectar stored in POKENAME's glands ignites upon being spat. It can accurately strike a target up to 40 feet away with little effort.

entry: 它精力充沛，攻击或玩闹表演时，都可能朝其他对象吐火。战前会迅速原地跺脚，做好准备。
author: infinex21
source: It is a bundle of energy that will spit fire at anything, be it as an act of aggression or as a playful performance. By rapidly stomping its feet in place, it readies itself for battle.

entry: POKENAME喜欢亲近人，也爱被宠。头上毛簇总是乱糟糟的，它会坐在训练家腿上，让对方梳理。舒服时，身体便暖起来，散出热量。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: This Pokémon loves being with people and being pampered. The tufts on its head are always messy and POKENAME will sit on its Trainer's lap as they brush through its fur. It's body grows warm and radiates heat when comfortable.

entry: POKENAME睡在选定瀑布附近时，头上的鳍会变得滚烫，阻止捕食者靠近。
author: .izik
source: The fin on POKENAME's head grows scalding hot while it sleeps near its chosen waterfall. This deters predators from drawing close.

entry: POKENAME能爬上陡崖，崎岖不稳的地面也站得很稳。它会先熄火，再把自己埋进泥里睡觉。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME can scale sheer cliffs and have even footing even on unstable terrain. It puts out its flame before it buries itself in mud and goes to sleep.

entry: POKENAME有点爱恶作剧，装出天真模样，引其他对象靠近，再嬉闹地投火球。若察觉对方真的生气，就会为玩过头而真心哭泣。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a bit of a prankster, and uses false innocence to draw others close before playfully pelting them with fireballs. If it senses genuine anger after the fact, however, it cries earnestly over going too far with its pranks.

entry: 充分休息后，它一分钟内就能爬上一棵成年橡树；够饿时还会更快。它以火包住卷尾威吓，却更愿变色躲藏、逃走，而非战斗。
author: infinex21
source: It can climb a fully grown oak tree within a minute when it is fully rested; it can climb even faster if it is hungry enough. It engulfs its curled tail in flames to intimidate others but will shift hues to blend in and try to flee rather than fight.

entry: POKENAME头上的叶片形似火焰，味道极辣，能让人类暂时失去味觉整整一天。
author: .izik
source: The leaves growing atop POKENAME's head resemble a flame. They are extremely spicy and can cause humans to temporarily lose their sense of taste for a full day.

entry: POKENAME背上覆盖厚树皮，冬季会发暖，让它舒适。若挨着同类睡，树皮更会变得灼热。
author: .izik
source: Thick bark covers POKENAME's back and grows warm during winter to keep it comfortable. It grows blazing hot when sleeping near others of its kind.

entry: POKENAME头周火焰的强度，决定身体形态；若散出金色光环，就处于全盛状态。灰烬色毛发，让它完美融入火山岩壁。
author: fiordaliso
source: The intensity of the flame around its head determines its physical form; if it radiates a golden halo, it is at its full strength. Its ashy fur allows POKENAME to camouflage perfectly on volcano walls.

entry: 小火焰猴容易被POKENAME的贪玩性格与力量吸引，聚在身边。它平时随和，但谁欺负同伴，就会见到它凶狠报复的一面。
author: sk372
source: Chimchar tend to gravitate towards POKENAME, charmed by its playful personality and strength. While it is quite laid back, picking on its companions will cause POKENAME to show off a more vicious side in retaliation.

entry: 谁靠它最爱的香蕉树太近，POKENAME就会尖叫着扑下，在阵阵火焰中抱摔对方，再尽可能扔远。
author: .izik
source: Should another creature get too close to its favorite banana tree, POKENAME descends upon them screeching. It suplexes them in a flurry of flames before tossing them as far as it can.

entry: POKENAME肚里满是热气，嘴里也满是大话。它爱吹牛骗人，宁可偷食，也不愿等别人给。还能调节胃中气体的温度，使其化水，喷向敌人。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is full of hot air, both metaphorically and literally. Boastful and deceitful, it would rather steal food than be given it  It can change the temeperature of the gas in its stomach to turn it into water to be ejected at foes.

entry: 长时间游泳后，POKENAME刚一上岸，身上薄薄的水就会被高体温迅速化成蒸气。
author: .izik
source: After emerging from a long swim, the thin layer of water remaining on POKENAME turns to steam within moments due to its incredibly hot body.

entry: POKENAME会在崎岖山巅成群玩耍，有时持剑对决，有时翩翩起舞，留下道道火迹。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME have been seen playing in groups atop craggy mountains. Sometimes they sword duel, and sometimes they dance, leaving behind trails of flames.

entry: POKENAME的触须能热得像工业炉。它接连挥鞭，伤害远处敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feelers can grow as hot as commercial furnaces. It whips them at foes in rapid intervals to cause damage from afar.

entry: POKENAME跃上能承受体重的树顶，等路人经过。它喜欢从尾巴向下放大火球，看对方惊慌逃走，以此取乐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME leaps up to the tops of trees strong enough to support its size, and waits for passersby. It delights in pranking them by firing large fireballs from its tail down upon them and watching them flee in panic.

entry: POKENAME蜡质身体顶端的小火苗，能随意变换形状。明亮燃烧时，会散发甜甜的香蕉香。
author: .izik
source: The small flame atop POKENAME's waxy body flickers into different shapes at will. When it burns brightly, it emits the sweet scent of bananas.

entry: POKENAME燃烧的“尾巴”离伪装太近，常把它点着。给防火材料修补伪装，就能很快赢得友谊。
author: sk372
source: Due to the proximity to its disguise, POKENAME's fiery "tail" will often wind up setting its masquerade ablaze. Giving it fireproof material to repair its disguise with is a quick way to earn its friendship.

entry: POKENAME极其灵活，一夜能翻过三座山。橙色尾巴掠过大地时，常被误认为彗星。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME are highly agile and can run over three mountains in one night. Its orange tail zipping across the landscape is often confused for a comet.

entry: POKENAME一天睡上20小时，战斗时却从不疲倦。以三片叶子为食，便能维持体内余火。
author: houndrys.
source: This POKENAME sleeps up to 20 hours daily, yet never tires when fighting. Its three-leaf diet keeps its embers alive.

entry: POKENAME用电让自己的火焰显得更大。奔跑时，身后会拖着余火与电火花。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME will use its electricity to make its own flame look bigger. When it runs, embers and sparks trail behind it.

entry: POKENAME成群住在森林与山地交界，能自由奔跑攀爬。露营者常误把它们的尾巴，当成诱人离开的鬼火。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Packs of POKENAME live on the border of forest and mountainous terrain where they can run and climb freely. Campers who spot these packs have commonly confused their tails for Will-o-Wisps who try to lead people away.

entry: POKENAME住在崎岖山中或山顶，以火焰推动跳跃，越过难行地形。它们在体内烧煤与矿屑，获取能量。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live within and atop craggy mountains, scaling rough terrain with fire-boosted leaps through the air. They burn coal and metal ore shavings within themselves for energy.

entry: 与小火龙不同，POKENAME尾巴的火不表示健康，而会随情绪、饮食、饥饿程度、海拔等变化闪动。甚至熄灭也安然无恙！但它仍不喜欢被非自然地灭火。
author: bobosmith01
source: Unlike Charmander, POKENAME's flaming tail isn't an indicator of health: it flickers with its emotions, diet, levels of hunger, elevation, and so on. It can even safely go out! Still, POKENAME does not like having its tail extinguished unnaturally.

entry: POKENAME一张开花苞，就会倾泻烈焰。晒太阳越久，火烧得越热。
author: .izik
source: Should POKENAME open its bud, it unleashes a deluge of flames. The longer it basks in the sun, the hotter these flames burn.

entry: POKENAME的花始终覆有原油。受威胁时，它会点燃两朵花，展现火光威吓。
author: erod0467
source: POKENAME's flowers are constantly coated in crude oil. When threatened, this Pokémon will ignite both flowers in a display of intimidation.

entry: POKENAME体内的气体帮助火焰持续燃烧。节庆期间，常有许多个体被放飞夜空。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's gases inside help its flame stay alight. Many are often released into the night sky during festivals.

entry: POKENAME白天喜欢躺在岩石上，晒热太阳。它们能点燃尾尖，淘气地生些小火。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME enjoy laying on rocks during the day, basking in the hot sun. They are able to ignite the tips of their tails, which they use to mischievously light small fires.

entry: POKENAME对吃的宝石十分挑剔。它会先向黄水晶喷火，杀菌去污，再吞下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is extremely particular about the gems it eats. It blows flames onto citrine to sterilize it and remove any grime before consuming it.

entry: POKENAME吃纸、油脂等被丢弃的可燃物，给体内火焰供能。火焰状手臂能伸到最远10英尺外，灼伤敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME consumes discarded flammable objects such as paper and grease to fuel the flames inside its body. Its flame-like arms can lash out up to 10 feet to singe foes.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时附身的树桩，醒来便会烧成灰，迫使它每夜另找新树桩。
author: .izik
source: Any stump POKENAME possesses while sleeping will have turned to ash by the time it wakes. This forces it to find a new stump each night.

entry: 据说，POKENAME是由被烧毁树木的怨念化成的恶灵。不知情旅人若在附近点起营火，它可能就会袭来，试图点燃对方作为报复。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to be a malevolent spirit made from the grudges of burned-down trees. Unaware travelers who build a campfire in its vicinity may find themselves attacked by it as it attempts to set them aflame in retribution.

entry: POKENAME战斗时会爆出响声，听起来像卡车喇叭。每一声都让全身燃起火焰，战斗中的压力越大，火也越猛。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases loud bursts of sound during fights that resemble a truck horn. Each burst engulfs its body in flames that intensify with its stress level throughout the battle.

entry: POKENAME背上的蘑菇，活动时会亮得通红。巧的是，做梦也同样发光，显示与脑部活动增强有关。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have mushrooms on their back that glow red-hot whenever they are active. Coincidentally, these mushrooms also glow when they are dreaming, indicating that the glow is correlated to heightened brain activity.

entry: POKENAME虽背重壳，动作却格外灵活。吐出的浓烟，带着温暖的蕉香果果香。
author: .izik
source: Despite its heavy shell, POKENAME is remarkably agile. The thick smoke it exhales carries the warm, fruity aroma of Nanab Berries.

entry: POKENAME耐心迟缓，总带着焦糖香，能精准控制尾焰温度。这份实用本领，让烘焙师、糕点师与糖果师都很珍视。
author: brilliantdarkness
source: Patient, slow, and always smelling like caramel, POKENAME has precise control over the temperature of its tail flame. It is prized among bakers, pastry chefs, and confectioners for its utility.

entry: 与小火龙不同，POKENAME尾巴的火不表示健康，而会随情绪、饮食、饥饿程度、海拔等变化闪动。甚至熄灭也安然无恙！但它仍不喜欢被非自然地灭火。
author: bobosmith01
source: Unlike Charmander, POKENAME's flaming tail isn't an indicator of health: it flickers with its emotions, diet, levels of hunger, elevation, and so on. It can even safely go out! Still, POKENAME does not like having its tail extinguished unnaturally.

entry: POKENAME会在海底热液喷口附近与同类聚集。20只或更多聚在一起时，被称作“POKENAME间歇泉”。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers with others of its kind near hydrothermal vents on the seafloor. A congregation of 20 or more is known as a Geyser of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME难以管束，不懂控制怒气。哪怕最小的冒犯，也容易发怒，因此极难训练。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are unruly creatures that lack anger management skills. They are also prone to getting angry over the slightest transgression, which makes them incredibly hard to train.

entry: 开心或太兴奋时，POKENAME尾焰会烧得极猛，若不小心，可能点燃四周。它性情虽温和，面对企图伤害者，也会毫不犹豫地抓咬。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it is happy or overly excited, the flame on its tail burns so fiercely that it risks setting its surroundings on fire if it's not careful. Despite its gentle nature, POKENAME won't hesitate to scratch or bite anyone who tries to harm it.

entry: POKENAME住在水边，喜欢在浅水开心蹦跳，却不爱游太久。暴怒或下定决心时，腹部火焰纹样会发光，原已温暖的身体，也可能变得滚烫。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although POKENAME lives by water and hops around in the shallows gleefully, it dislikes swimming for very long. When POKENAME becomes enraged or determined, the fiery symbol on its belly glows and its already warm body may become boiling hot.

entry: POKENAME喜欢独居高处岩崖。一察觉有威胁的存在，就会瞬间移动到安全处。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME prefers to live in isolation high atop rocky crags. When it senses a threatening presence, it teleports away to safety.

entry: POKENAME从壳缝放出可燃气体，点燃后让自己显得更大。缩进壳里，还能将燃烧的身体射向敌人。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME expel flammable gas from the cracks in their shells, which they ignite to make themselves appear larger. By retreating inside, they can launch their flaming bodies at foes.

entry: POKENAME用周身燃气把自己托上空中。风大时就留在崖洞里，因为火若被吹灭，会立刻坠地。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses the burning gas around its body to lift it into the air. It remains inside caves on cliffs during windy days; if its flame is blown out, it will immediately fall to the ground.

entry: POKENAME球茎周围的刺，能放出内部储存的毒孢子。睡时，它们竖起刺藤，大耳敏锐聆听四周，随时准备攻击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The thorns that line a POKENAME's bulb can be used to expel the toxic spores stored within. POKENAME sleep with their thorny vines raised and large ears finely tuned to their surroundings, ready to strike on a moment's notice.

entry: POKENAME凭大耳朵听见数英里外的威胁，却胆小得连毒也不敢用。威胁若靠近，就赶快逃跑。
author: canada
source: POKENAME uses its large ears to hear threats from miles away. It's too cowardly to use its poison, so it will flee if a threat gets too close.

entry: 许多POKENAME遭同族遗弃，便寻找同遭遇的个体，结成自己的家庭，直到恰有10名成员。滚过之处，还会留下一薄层能杀杂草的细菌。
author: bobosmith01
source: As many POKENAME are abandoned by their own kind, they will seek out other POKENAME that have also been abandoned to form their own family unit until they have exactly 10 members. They leave a thin layer of weed-killing bacteria wherever they roll.

entry: POKENAME体内充满腐蚀液，几乎什么都能蚀穿。若一颗头破了，酸便溅到其他头，慢慢腐蚀外壳。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's bodies are filled with a corrosive liquid that eats through just about anything. If one of the heads ends up breaking, they will splash their acid on the others, slowly corroding away their shells.

entry: POKENAME收集腐烂的桃桃果，涂在头骨上，保持洁净光亮。剩下的会吃掉，似乎能维持体内强毒，用于自保。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME collect rotting, or rotted, Pecha Berries to coat their skulls in, keeping them clean and polished. What is leftover will be consumed, which seems to keep their bodily toxins potent for the sake of protecting themselves.

entry: 受威胁时，POKENAME让长舌滑过角，抹开毒液，再从远处舔击敌人。被舔后，对手会麻痹一小时。
author: sk372
source: When threatened, POKENAME slides its large tongue across its horn, slicking it with its poison so that it can apply a debilitating lick from a distance. The toxins leave a foe paralyzed for an hour after being licked.

entry: POKENAME的毒牙里，藏着能引发神志错乱的强毒。若这还无用，它就迅速旋转，使体内气体相互反应，让自己爆炸。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fang is filled with an incredibly strong venom that can cause delirium. Should this fail, it spins rapidly so the gases in its body react with one another, causing it to explode.

entry: POKENAME的鳞甲限制行动，因此难以快速移动。遭鸟类宝可梦袭击时，会用毒刺反击捕食者。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a difficult time moving quickly because their scaly plating restricts their movement. When they are assaulted by bird Pokémon, they rely on their venomous stinger to retaliate against the predators.

entry: POKENAME不断与同类激烈争斗，赢取潜在伴侣的青睐。发怒时，岩质尖刺就会产生毒液。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will constantly get into heated fights with each other to win over their potential mates. When angered, it will produce poison from its rocky spines.

entry: POKENAME产的蛋剧毒无比。无论怎样烹调，哪怕只吃一口，也会引发剧烈绞痛与恶心。
author: .izik
source: The eggs POKENAME produces are extremely poisonous. Regardless of the cooking method, even a single bite can cause intense cramping and nausea.

entry: POKENAME藤蔓里的浓稠蓝毒，能熬成美味沙拉酱。虽然咸得出奇，却带着与羽衣甘蓝相配的甜味，是独特食材。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's vines contain a thick blue poison that can be boiled down into a delicious salad dressing. Though surprisingly salty, it also has sweet notes that complement kale, making it a unique culinary ingredient.

entry: POKENAME疲惫时会靠在尼多后身边，将其视为守护者。此时毒性会更强，或许是从彼此羁绊中获得了力量。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stays close to Nidoqueen when it is tired, treating it as if it is a guardian. POKENAME's venom is more potent when it is near Nidoqueen, possibly drawing strength from their bond.

entry: 它凭彩色鳍在水中优雅游动。耳部肌肉发达、活动自如，能轻松察觉危险；需要时还会抖耳划水，加快游速。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Its colorful fins swim elegantly in the water, while its ear muscles are highly developed and offer a free range of motion, allowing it to detect danger easily. When needed, it can twitch its ears to paddle to bolster its swimming speed.

entry: 鲜艳体色会提醒其他生灵，它们是有毒宝可梦。虽然角最善于送出毒液，全身鳞皮也都会分泌。
author: infinex21
source: Their vibrant colors serve as a signal to others that they are poisonous Pokémon. Though their horns deliver their poison best, they secrete poison all across their scaly bodies.

entry: POKENAME振翼便能扬起毒粉云，削弱对手。科学家从身上毒刺提取出一种酶，能增强解毒药的效果。
author: fiordaliso
source: By flapping its wings, POKENAME can stir up clouds of toxic dust that weaken its opponents. Scientists have extracted an enzyme from the poisonous spines on its body that boosts the effect of Antidotes.

entry: POKENAME刀刃上的毒，会让被切伤者产生强烈的神经性恐惧。恐惧甚至传给未受伤的敌人，扰乱判断，削弱战意。
author: .izik
source: The venom on POKENAME's blades can cause intense neurological fear in anything it cuts. The fear spreads even to unharmed opponents, disorienting its enemies and weakening their resolve in battle.

entry: POKENAME以灵敏鼻子寻找成熟树果，带回族群。它毒性并不强，若敏锐大耳听见捕食者，往往更愿意躲藏。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME utilize their strong noses to find ripe berries to bring back to their colonies. They don't have particularly strong venom and will often prefer to hide should they detect predators with their sensitive ears.

entry: POKENAME深陷颜色争论：有人说紫，有人说粉。但无论属于哪一种，变成什么模样，也都保持粉紫色。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are at the center of a controversy of color. Some people claim that they are purple, while others claim that they are pink. Regardless of what color they are, they retain that pinkish-purple whenever they transform.

entry: 研究者发现，野生POKENAME偏爱污染水域。它游进脏水时，会吸收污染物，留着在战斗中对付敌人。
author: sleepyman0731
source: Researchers discovered that wild POKENAME gravitate towards polluted waters. They found that when POKENAME swim in contaminated water, POKENAME absorb the pollution to use against foes in battle.

entry: POKENAME躁动时，火花在身上跳跃，刺激毛中藏刺渗出毒液。耳朵连最细微的声音也能察觉。
author: chibitales
source: When agitated, sparks dance over POKENAME's body, stimulating the spines hidden in its fur to ooze with poison. Its ears are sensitive to even the slightest of sounds.

entry: POKENAME用角探知附近相连系统里的病毒。数据遭到破坏时，角就会轻轻振动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its horn to detect nearby viruses within connected systems. The horn vibrates softly when corruption is present.

entry: 不要站得离POKENAME太近。它身上的火焰会产生淡薄却毒性强烈的烟，吸入后会肌肉麻痹，甚至出现更严重的症状。
author: sk372
source: One should take care not to stand too close to POKENAME. The flames on its body produce a faint but powerful toxic smoke that will cause muscle paralysis or worse afflictions after inhalation.

entry: POKENAME不断脱落毒刺，每次长回都更强。它在这期间会觉得难为情，通常躲到角与刺全部再生。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME constantly sheds its poisonous quills, as they must regrow each time stronger than before. Embarrassed during this process, it tends to hide until its horns and spines grow back fully.

entry: POKENAME能造出带强毒的精神能量尖刺，掷向对手。等敌人被毒制服，再用念力扔到远处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can create spines made of psychic energy containing potent poison, and hurl them at opponents. Once a foe is incapacitated by the toxin, it flings them far away via telekinesis.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，会像振翼一样拍动大耳。但它其实靠超能力浮空，拍耳只是为了听见远处声音，并不帮助飞行。
author: imaginita
source: When in flight, POKENAME can be seen flapping its large ears like wings. This does not help it fly, since it levitates using psychic power, but rather helps it listen to distant sounds.

entry: POKENAME头叶上，覆着微小毒针，碰到便一阵刺痛。可去掉针，叶片又能用来烹制异国佳肴。
author: mistymagius
source: The leaf on POKENAME's head is coated in microscopic needles that cause a stinging pain when touched. However, once the needles are removed, the leaf can be used in exotic dishes.

entry: POKENAME躁动或遇险时，背上会腾起小火。火烧着体内毒物，产生刺鼻毒烟，进一步逼退捕食者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flares up a small flame on its back when agitated or in danger. This fire burns poisonous materials in its body, creating a toxic and acrid smoke that further deters predators.

entry: POKENAME羽毛始终覆着薄薄一层粉色毒液。它常被用来制造车漆，鲜艳色调与防护特性都很受珍视。
author: .izik
source: A thin layer of pink poison lingers on POKENAME's feathers at all times. The poison is frequently used for making paint for cars. It is prized for its vibrant hue and protective qualities.

entry: 谨慎的性格，让POKENAME养成夜行、结小群生活的习性。察觉危险时，它们全退回洞穴，挤在一起，形成巨大的毒刺球。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Their cautious nature has caused POKENAME to become nocturnal and live in small groups. When they sense danger, they all retreat to their dens and huddle into a large ball of poisonous spines.

entry: POKENAME的耳朵十分适应洞穴环境，能察觉危险。受威胁时，就把长身体卷成甜甜圈状，伸出毒刺。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its ears are highly adapted for sensing danger in the cave systems it calls home. When POKENAME is threatened, it will curl its long body into a donut shape and extend poisonous spines.

entry: 傍晚，POKENAME会单足站立，来回摇晃，羽毛内能听见液体晃动。平静的仪式，帮助它准备迎接夜晚。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME balances on one foot during the evenings, and a sloshing sound can be heard from within its feathers as it rocks from side to side. This calming ritual helps it prepare for the night.

entry: POKENAME体内毒囊，能按一天不同时段的需要，产生多种毒素。例如，白天睡觉时，就有专门抵御捕食者的毒。
author: corra_universe
source: POKENAME's internal poison sack can produce a variety of different toxins based on its needs at different times of day. For example, it has a toxin specialized to defend against predators when it sleeps during the day.

entry: POKENAME主要在夜里产生毒液。毒液能强韧、柔顺发丝，因此用于护发素、洗发水等许多护发产品。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's venom is primarily produced during the nighttime hours. It has been used in many hair care products like conditioner and shampoo, valued for its ability to strengthen and smooth hair.

entry: POKENAME会张开带刺鞘翅，在战斗中威吓敌人。若不成功，就趁翅膀已展开，赶紧飞走。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME flare up their spiky elytra to intimidate foes in battle. If this strategy fails, they will take advantage of their wings being out and hurriedly fly away.

entry: POKENAME吃有毒花朵，强化自身毒液。花里的毒会增强它的毒性，使攻击更危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME consumes toxic flowers to strengthen its venom. The poisons from these flowers enhance its own, making its attacks even more dangerous to its foes.

entry: POKENAME蛛网极细，多数宝可梦可能穿过都没察觉。但毒丝会逐渐伤害接触者，它便跟在后面，等目标衰弱再出击。
author: afilthycasual
source: Its webs are so thin that most Pokémon might not even realize they've walked through one, but the poison infused threads will slowly damage anything making contact with it. POKENAME will follow, striking when their target is weakened.

entry: POKENAME的网虽有毒，只要采收时手够稳，就能得到极有价值的衣料。丝网结实，但制衣前必须彻底洗净。
author: .izik
source: While POKENAME's webbing is poisonous, if harvested with a steady hand, it is incredibly valuable due to its use in clothing. The webbing is sturdy but must be washed thoroughly before use in garments.

entry: POKENAME彼此竞争心很强，常为残食或巢位争斗。它们好战又易于训练，因此很受立志成为精英训练家的人欢迎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME develop strong rivalries with one another, often squabbling over scraps of food or nesting spots. Their combative nature and ease to train make them popular amongst aspiring Ace Trainers.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME毒液几乎完全失效。幸好，这种情况只会持续一小时。
author: .izik
source: During a full moon, POKENAME's venom loses almost all of its potency. Luckily, this only happens during a one-hour period.

entry: 雄性POKENAME睡着容易飘走，野生个体须由族群看顾，收服后则要训练家留心。它想唱就唱，哪怕让旁者分心也照唱。
author: bobosmith01
source: Male POKENAME have a tendency to float away while sleeping, so they must be watched out for by their colony if they are wild, or their Trainer if they are caught. They sing whenever they want, even if it distracts others.

entry: POKENAME两餐之间会咀嚼毒树果的种子。身体把毒滤入角，增强自身毒性，必要时刺敌自保。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME munches on the seeds of poisonous berries between meals. Its body filters the toxins into its horn, boosting the potency of its own poison should it need to stab a foe to defend itself.

entry: POKENAME从瀑布后跃出，用利角突袭敌人。快速出击，让它能出其不意，以覆毒的角削弱对手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaps from behind waterfalls to surprise foes with its sharp horn. This quick attack allows it to catch enemies off guard, using its poison-coated horn to weaken them.

entry: POKENAME天性好奇，以大耳察觉各方动静与威胁。它始终聆听四周，毒刺竖着，准备在捕食者靠太近时射出。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Curious by nature, POKENAME use their large ears to detect motion or threats from all directions. They are always listening to their surroundings, their poisonous barbs raised and prepared to fire off should a predator get too close.

entry: 用POKENAME毒液制的古龙水，常被形容为花香宜人。制作成本高得惊人，因此是市场稀有的奢华香氛。
author: .izik
source: The cologne produced with POKENAME's poison is often described as having a delightful floral scent. It is surprisingly expensive to create, making it a rare luxury fragrance in the market.

entry: POKENAME若不定期使用角里的毒，牙齿就会失控生长，无法进食。家养个体常需医疗照护，因此建议饲主留一块泥地，供它安全排毒。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: If POKENAME doesn't regularly use the poison in its horn, its teeth grow uncontrollably, making it unable to eat. Domestic POKENAME often need medical care, so owners are advised to keep a patch of mud where it can safely release its toxins.

entry: POKENAME怕毒刺扎到训练家，从不肯让对方抚摸。满月之夜，它会变得格外精神、活跃。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME never lets its Trainer pet it, fearing they might get pricked by its venomous spines. On nights of the full moon, it becomes far more energetic and active.

entry: 科学家研究POKENAME的毒液，近期成功研发强效抗生素。野外，它用头上生长的花释放信息素，把猎物引进领地。
author: fiordaliso
source: By studying POKENAME's venom, scientists have recently succeeded in developing powerful antibiotics. In the wild, it releases pheromones from the flower growing on its head to lure prey into its territory.

entry: POKENAME被视为严重害兽，会啃穿郊区住宅，吃里面的垃圾。它的毒毛反会吸引更多同类，因此很难赶净。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are considered serious pests, chewing their way into suburban homes to eat their garbage. They can be quite hard to get rid of because their poisonous fur just attracts more POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的毒液会使人失忆，却也让中毒者短暂获得心灵感应。奇异的能力组合可能让受害者困惑，却也带来片刻心灵相通的体验。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's poison causes memory loss but also grants the person affected short-term telepathy. This curious mix of abilities can leave victims confused, but with fleeting moments of telepathic connection.

entry: POKENAME会咬喜爱的东西，表达亲昵。但必须小心，咬得太久，就会传入带灼烧感的毒液，使目标不适。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME bites things it likes to show affection. However, it must be careful, as biting for too long will transfer a burning venom that can cause discomfort to its target.

entry: 化妆品公司用POKENAME的毒制作古龙水。香气常被形容为轻盈清淡，很受偏爱含蓄清新气息的人喜爱。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's poison is used by cosmetic companies to make cologne. Many describe the scent as light and airy, making it a popular fragrance for those seeking a subtle, fresh aroma.

entry: POKENAME虽小，却能举起超过自身体重20倍的重量。坚韧甲壳布满粗厚毒刺，强到能刺穿铁甲蛹的壳。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite POKENAME's small stature, it can lift over 20 times its own body weight.  Its tough carapace is covered in thick, poisonous spines which are strong enough to pierce through a Metapod's shell.

entry: POKENAME的毒液带有蜜香，可用来制作古龙水。香气虽不持久，毒液却曾因黏稠、气味宜人而被用作机器润滑剂。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's venom is used in cologne and has a honey-like scent. It doesn't last long, but was once used as a machine lubricant due to its viscosity and pleasant aroma.

entry: POKENAME身上覆盖着沸腾的粉色毒液，温度极高。毒液冷却后会剥落，完全失去效力，凝固后便无害。
author: .izik
source: The boiling pink poison covering POKENAME's body is extremely hot. If cooled, it will break off and lose all potency, making it harmless once it solidifies.

entry: POKENAME始终警戒，以大耳倾听危险。一察觉威胁，就把壳中产生的毒，导向头上长角，抢先出击。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME is constantly on guard, using its large ears to listen for danger.  If it detects a threat, it will move to strike first by channeling the toxins produced in its shell through the long horn on its head.

entry: POKENAME用角撞落树枝筑巢。这样能高效收集材料，造出坚固安全的家。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its horn to knock sticks from trees to make its nest. This tactic helps it gather materials efficiently, allowing it to construct a sturdy and secure home.

entry: POKENAME的毒会引发强烈灼烧感。发作迅速，还留下疼痛与烧灼不适，让相遇本身都十分危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's poison induces an intense burning sensation. Its venom acts quickly, leaving a painful and burning aftermath that makes any encounter with it dangerous.

entry: POKENAME的角与毒牙共用毒液。其中一处用毒后，两边的毒都会耗尽，暂时失去效力。尾色越鲜艳，个体毒性就越强。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's poison is shared between its horn and fangs, so after using one, both are depleted and useless for a time. The more vibrant the color on its tail, the more venomous the specimen.

entry: POKENAME滚动时，体内毒囊随之旋转，毒性越来越强。此时挡在它前方，很不明智。
author: .izik
source: While rolling, the poison sacks in POKENAME's body swirl, getting more and more potent. It is unwise to get in its path while it rolls.

entry: POKENAME的短鹿角边缘锋利，滴着体内产生的毒液。它天性好斗，本能地冲向闯入者，用角撞击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's short antlers have sharpened edges that drip with the poison its body creates. It is aggressive by nature and has an instinct to charge down and strike any trespassers with its antlers.

entry: 无畏小子的斗志，驱使POKENAME不断战斗。前肢已长成能奋力击打的大爪；激战时还会释放有毒能量，强化对其他宝可梦的攻击。
author: kafoxnothylol_47795
source: Tyrogue's fighting spirit drives POKENAME to battle. Its forelimbs grew into large claws that strike with great force. In intense fights, POKENAME releases poisonous energy that strengthens its attacks against other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME尾巴内有强效神经毒，用来麻痹对手。但它更愿吃树果，不去狩猎，哪怕毒液十分强大。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's tail contains a powerful neurotoxin that is used to paralyze its opponents. Despite how potent its poison is, POKENAME prefers to just eat berries instead of hunting for prey.

entry: POKENAME头上坚硬石球渗出的微毒，能用于炒菜。加热后毒性消退，留下浓蒜味，为菜肴添独特滋味。
author: .izik
source: The hard stone sphere on POKENAME's head oozes a mild venom that can be used in stir-fries. When heated, the poison cooks out, leaving a strong garlic-like flavor that adds a unique taste to dishes.

entry: POKENAME把毒刺当飞镖投掷，淘气地把其他宝可梦钉在树干上。刺虽有毒，却只足以让人类轻微恶心。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME throws its poisonous quills like throwing darts, mischievously pinning other Pokémon to tree trunks. While these quills are poisonous, they are only strong enough to cause mild nausea in humans.

entry: 风暴中，POKENAME以尾作避雷针，吸收雷电能量。谁威胁家族成员，它就试图用额上毒角刺击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its tail as a lightning rod to absorb the energy of thunderbolts during storms. If someone threatens another member of its family, it attempts to strike them with the venomous horn on its forehead.

entry: POKENAME藏在沙下，只露耳朵察觉危险。谁不慎踩上，就会被大量毒刺扎进脚。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides beneath the sand, keeping its ears exposed to sense for danger. If someone ends up stepping on POKENAME, they will be met with tons of poisonous spines in their foot.

entry: POKENAME的毒容易采集，能制古龙水，带枫树与林木气息。香气清新自然，价格亲民，也很受欢迎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's poison is used in cologne and is easily harvested. It has a maple and woodsy scent, offering a refreshing and natural fragrance that's both affordable and popular.

entry: POKENAME羽毛能感知气流，因此查看周围时，也能察觉动静。身形虽小，毒角仍能造成重伤，再趁机跑开。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's feathers can sense air currents, allowing them to detect movement whenever they check their surroundings. While small, POKENAME's toxic horn can deal significant damage before it runs away.

entry: POKENAME背上的毒刺坚韧异常，锋利如致命刀刃。它用长爪挖大地洞，在一天最热的时段进去避暑。
author: fiordaliso
source: The poisonous spines on its back are extremely tough and cutting like lethal blades. POKENAME uses its long claws to dig large underground caverns, which it uses as shelter during the hottest hours of the day.

entry: POKENAME性格有点难亲近，只真正信任训练家，常连训练家的其他宝可梦也不许靠近。相处久了会软化，但需要很长时间。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's personality is a bit prickly, only truly trusting its Trainer and often not even letting its Trainer's other Pokémon near it. It can soften up in behavior over time, but the process takes quite some time.

entry: POKENAME会浮空巡逻，守护尼多一族的群落。也常能见几只分立尼多王两侧，替它执行号令。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is protective of Nidoran colonies, hovering and patrolling to keep them safe. It is not uncommon to see a few flanking Nidoking and acting as their enforcers.

entry: POKENAME用硬角挖泥、掘树苗，拿来筑坝。勤劳天性让它成为能工巧匠，能把环境改成适合自己的样子。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its hard horn to dig up mud and saplings, which it uses to build dams. This industrious nature makes it a skilled builder, capable of shaping its environment to suit its needs.

entry: POKENAME通常住在尼多一族迁徙经过的地区。头部形似骷髅，角会放毒，被刺中的目标将极度虚弱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is usually found inhabiting areas where Nidoran herds have migrated through. Its skull-like head emits a poison from its horn that severely weakens those jabbed by it.

entry: 关都有个流行习俗：把POKENAME送给新婚夫妇。不但被认为能带来好运，将来若有孩子，也能得到强大宝可梦的保护。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: There's a popular Kantonian tradition to gift newlywed couples POKENAME. Not only is it considered good luck for the married couple, but their potential children will have a powerful Pokémon to protect them.

entry: POKENAME背上虽有成熟花朵，其余身体仍在发育。毒腺尚未长好，产不出致命毒素，因此很容易遭其他宝可梦骚扰。
author: quackquackattack
source: Even though POKENAME have a mature flower on their back, the rest of their body is still developing. They lack the developed venom glands to produce lethal toxins, so they are likely to get harassed by other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME角毒能使目标麻痹，既用于防卫，也用于管教。有人见它用毒角轻戳不守规矩的尼多一族幼崽，使其暂时动弹不得，算是罚它们“冷静一下”。
author: sk372
source: The venom from its horn causes paralysis, and POKENAME uses it well in defense as well as discipline; it has been observed giving unruly young Nidoran a "time-out" by stunning them with a poisonous poke.

entry: POKENAME假嘴里的牙带有微毒。哪怕一口，也可能让成年人卧床数日。
author: sk372
source: The fangs of POKENAME's false mouth are laced with a mild venom. A single bite could leave a full-grown adult bedridden for several days.

entry: POKENAME与尼多朗一族格外亲近，试图缓和它们的攻击性。由它抚养长大，就连尼多王也往往性情平静，近乎矜持。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME feels a special kinship with the male Nidoran line, and tries to temper their aggressive tendencies. If raised by POKENAME, even a Nidoking will tend to have a calm and almost demure disposition.

entry: POKENAME的骨架身体覆着紫雾，在空洞中无声漂行。动作诡异，几乎无法察觉，只有留下的毒霾会暴露行踪。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's skeletal body is covered in a purple smog. It floats through hollows, moving silently and eerily, its presence barely noticeable except for the toxic haze it leaves behind.

entry: POKENAME能以发光独眼感知其他宝可梦的生命力。任何活着的宝可梦误入领地，它们就会聚来，以诡异声响试图吓退。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can sense the life force of other Pokémon using their single glowing eye. They flock to any living Pokémon that strays into their territory, attempting to scare them away with eerie noises.

entry: POKENAME通常在较深海域四处觅食，拿小鱼群当点心。它不特别凶暴，却会以角毒自卫，强到连暴鲤龙也要迟疑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME typically roots around the deeper ocean levels, snacking on small groups of fish. It isn't overly aggressive, but will defend itself with the venom in its horn, which is potent enough to give a Gyarados pause.

entry: POKENAME不像树林龟，身上的灌木从不结果。最好完全别碰，因为里面有尖锐毒刺。
author: hophoppip
source: Unlike Grotle, POKENAME's shrubs never bear fruit. It's best not to touch the shrubs at all, as they contain sharp, poisonous thorns.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，会凶猛抵御同类竞争者。研究者推测，是未融合本体潜藏的好斗本能汇入同一身体，才造成这种行为。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are highly territorial and aggressively defend their territories from rivals. Researchers speculate that this behaviour stems from combining the latent combative instincts of their unfused counterparts into one body.

entry: 它挺起胸，冲向体形是自己两倍的威胁，却常被反冲震得向后翻倒。训练家佩服勇气，但少有人准备好应付这份固执。
author: jaminmcready
source: It puffs out its chest and charges at threats twice its size, though it often tumbles backward from the recoil. Trainers admire its spirit, but few are ready for how stubborn it can be.

entry: POKENAME尚未长成下一形态。较大的身体让毒液浓度降低，效力也减弱。它也明显比尼多力诺与尼多朗更温顺。
author: sk372
source: Having not fully matured to the next form, POKENAME's poison is less concentrated due to its larger size, and loses potency as a result. It's notably more docile than Nidorino and male Nidoran as well.

entry: 大耳朵能听见远处威胁。毒性越强，身上的毒刺也越大。
author: melodydelune
source: Its large ears allows it to hear threats coming from far away. Its poison barbs grow larger the more poisonous it is.

entry: POKENAME肌肉发达，却不知自身力量，笨拙地撞上周围东西，连耳朵也被带得乱晃。网上有许多这类视频，经常获得数百万次观看。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME has immense muscles but is unaware of its own strength, causing it to clumsily knock against anything nearby, leading its ears to dart about uncontrollably. There are many videos of this online, which regularly rack up millions of views.

entry: 不同文化对进化成POKENAME有不同看法。有的视为它与另一方彼此关爱、付出的象征；有的却认为，这说明它被宠溺、娇惯了。
author: bobosmith01
source: The act of a Pokémon evolving into POKENAME is seen differently depending on the culture: one may find it as a sign of love and dedication between POKENAME and another, while another may view it as a sign that POKENAME was being spoiled and coddled.

entry: POKENAME与一些谜拟丘融合体同住托儿所，给孩子安慰与快乐。若被突然带走，它会用毒刺轻扎那人，使其略感恶心。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME live at daycares along with some Mimikyu fusions, providing comfort and joy to children. If POKENAME are abruptly taken, they will lightly inject the person with a poisonous barb that causes mild nausea.

entry: POKENAME不爱织网，只要四处走动，毒刺就能抓住小虫。它住在热带雨林，身上毛发能避免被雨淋透。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME prefers not to build a web, as it catches small insects on its poisonous spines just by walking around. It lives in tropical rainforests, the hairs on its body protecting it from getting soaked in the rain.

entry: POKENAME毒液几乎总接近沸点，痛得令人难以忍受，却意外地不会使人类丧命。既能以疼痛逼退对方，也是一桩奇事。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's venom is almost always near its boiling point. The poison is described as excruciating, but surprisingly is not lethal to humans, making it both a painful deterrent and a peculiar curiosity.

entry: POKENAME环上的众耳让听觉极佳，几乎不可能偷近。谁烦扰到它出手，就会被钥匙上的齿注入强毒。
author: sk372
source: The many ears on POKENAME's ring give it an excellent sense of hearing, making it nearly impossible to sneak up on. The teeth of its key can inject a powerful poison in those who agitate it enough to make it attack.

entry: POKENAME能独立移动强壮双耳，当作舵，在空中迅速转弯。尖刺是中空的，像羽轴一样。
author: robosoup
source: Because POKENAME can move its strong ears individually, it can use them as rudders to make quick turns in the air. Its spikes are hollow, like the shafts of feathers.

entry: POKENAME耳朵过大，挡住视线，只好依赖嗅觉与听觉。它会与手足粗玩打闹，独自行动时，有时还找强得多的宝可梦打架。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's ears have grown too big and inhibit its eyesight, so it must rely on its senses of smell and sound. It plays rough with its siblings, and sometimes gets into fights with much stronger Pokémon once it's on its own.

entry: POKENAME背上附肢能察觉环境振动变化，帮助战斗自卫。若一颗头的决定妨碍另一颗，哪怕情势危急，两颗头也会争吵。
author: pjporwoll
source: The appendages on POKENAME's back help it detect vibration shifts in its environment, allowing it to defend itself in combat. If one head makes a decision that messes up the other one, the two heads will bicker, even when in a dire situation.

entry: POKENAME能看见对手波导。若认定敌人邪恶，毒液的致命威力就会翻倍，让毒攻带上正义色彩。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can see a combatant's aura. If it deems the enemy as evil, its poison becomes twice as deadly, adding a layer of justice to its venomous attacks.

entry: 城都许多能量饮料，都使用POKENAME角毒熬成的成分。毒素被煮去后，留下的液体能让饮者恢复活力、精神振奋。
author: .izik
source: The poison from POKENAME's horn is boiled down and used in many energy drinks across Johto. While the toxins are boiled out, the resulting fluid energizes and revitalizes the drinker.

entry: POKENAME把电力灌入角，向闯入领地者发射闪电。紫色电光若直接命中，还会使目标中毒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME surges its electricity into its horn to fire bolts of lightning at those that intrude on its territory. The purple-tinted bolts of electricity will poison targets with which it makes direct contact.

entry: 雄性POKENAME悠闲，通常很好相处。找到什么植物，就慢慢啃食。
author: bobosmith01
source: Male POKENAME are laid-back and generally easy to get along with. They nibble on whatever vegetative growth they can find.

entry: POKENAME的刺里装的不是毒液，而是微量液态汞。别看量少，一次刺击也足以让成年人陷入病危。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's spines are not filled with poison, instead they are filled with a tiny amount of liquid mercury. Despite the low dosage, a single sting from POKENAME can put a fully grown adult in critical condition.

entry: POKENAME生气就会撞向面前一切，发泄怒意。科学家曾用角上提取的毒素，合成强效止吐药。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME gets angry, it rams its head into whatever is in front of it to vent its rage. A toxin extracted from its horn has been used by scientists to synthesize a potent antiemetic.

entry: POKENAME数量众多，尤其雄性会不断训练，力争成为族群强大的前线战士。它们与尼多兔组成勇敢的族群；谁擅闯并激怒，可能就会遭数十只围攻。
author: bobosmith01
source: The populous POKENAME train constantly to become powerful frontliners for a brave colony of POKENAME and Nidopunny, especially if they are male. Intruding upon and angering its colony will have potentially dozens of POKENAME attack.

entry: POKENAME吵闹顽皮，爱粗鲁地嬉戏打闹。好斗的玩耍方式，能教它学会如何用角刺击。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are rowdy creatures that love to engage in rough boisterous play. This aggressive play helps them learn how to stab with their horn.

entry: POKENAME完全看不见，飞行全靠强大声呐定位。每只飞时都会唱独有的歌，哪怕同行再多，也能辨出自己的叫声。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are completely blind and navigate through the air entirely through powerful sonar. Each POKENAME sings out a completely unique song when they're flying which lets them listen for their own calls no matter how many are flying together.

entry: POKENAME肢体能朝任意方向活动。它先用面具角尖划出伤口，再以牙齿注入致命毒液。
author: crumple_2
source: POKENAME can move its limbs in any direction. It wields the point on the mask's horn to create wounds, while the teeth deliver lethal poison into that wound.

entry: POKENAME用不同音高的鸣声交流，耳朵最远能听见一英里外的这些声音。持续活动会让身体变热，因此不必为过冬迁徙。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon communicate with chirps of various pitches, their ears serving to hear these sounds from, at most, a mile away. Because their bodies grow hotter as they remain active, POKENAME do not need to migrate for winter.

entry: POKENAME完全看不见，飞行全靠强大声呐定位。每只飞时都会唱独有的歌，哪怕同行再多，也能辨出自己的叫声。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are completely blind and navigate through the air entirely through powerful sonar. Each POKENAME sings out a completely unique song when they're flying which lets them listen for their own calls no matter how many are flying together.

entry: POKENAME完全看不见，飞行全靠强大声呐定位。每只飞时都会唱独有的歌，哪怕同行再多，也能辨出自己的叫声。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are completely blind and navigate through the air entirely through powerful sonar. Each POKENAME sings out a completely unique song when they're flying which lets them listen for their own calls no matter how many are flying together.

entry: 它们独处时胆怯，只有在其他POKENAME附近筑巢才安心。但彼此很少直接来往。
author: bobosmith01
source: They are timid on their own, only comfortable nesting near other POKENAME. Despite that, they rarely directly interact with one another.

entry: POKENAME只有跳舞时才产毒。收集后仔细熬煮，就能变成可食的辣酱，深受胆大厨师珍视。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME only produces venom while dancing. When collected and carefully boiled, the venom transforms into a spicy, edible hot sauce prized by daring chefs.

entry: POKENAME在树桩家园钻出小洞，标示领地。这些记号警告其他生灵，表明它对这片地区的主导权。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drills tiny holes into its tree stump home to mark its territory. These markings are a warning to others, establishing its dominion over the area.

entry: POKENAME大耳听觉敏锐，也能发声。强烈超声振动，会让被波及的人类与宝可梦恶心不适。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's large ears give it a keen sense of hearing and can also be used to emit sound. The powerful ultrasonic vibrations they emit cause people and Pokémon exposed to them to feel nauseous and unwell.

entry: POKENAME越老，尖刺越长、越粗，毒性却不会增强。因此，它主要用尖刺划伤、刺穿敌人。
author: mistymagius
source: The older POKENAME is, the longer and thicker its spines become. However, its poison does not grow stronger, so it mostly uses its spines to scratch and impale its opponents.

entry: POKENAME寻找毒蘑菇，插在尖刺上，阻止捕食者吃它。虽然自身有毒，训练家仍会请它帮助辨认哪些蘑菇有毒。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hunts for poisonous mushrooms to put on its spines, dissuading any predators from trying to eat it. Despite how poisonous it is, Trainers will use POKENAME to help determine what mushrooms are toxic.

entry: POKENAME的角坚如石英、锋利异常。它用角自卫、划定领地，在多岩地形是强劲的对手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's horn is as hard as quartz and extremely sharp. It uses this horn to defend itself and carve out its territory, making it a formidable creature in rocky environments.

entry: POKENAME嚎叫后，毒性便会增强。叫声似乎引发能量高涨，强化毒素，让攻击更加危险。
author: .izik
source: After howling, POKENAME's venom becomes more potent. The howl seems to trigger a surge of energy, empowering its toxins and making its attacks even more dangerous.

entry: 夜里，POKENAME毒性比平时更强。黑暗不知为何会增强它的毒性能力，使晚间的它成为难对付的敌人。
author: .izik
source: At night, POKENAME's venom is more potent than normal. The darkness somehow enhances its poisonous abilities, making it a formidable adversary during the evening hours.

entry: POKENAME背上长着架状真菌，操纵它寻找潮湿地方休息。为免伤到它，人们会小心采下，再仔细切开，将控制心智的孢子、毒素与美味菌肉分离。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME grows shelf fungi on its back, which control it to seek out damp places to rest. The mushrooms are carefully extracted to not harm it, then sliced carefully to separate the mind-controlling spores and toxins from the mushroom's tasty flesh.

entry: POKENAME住在丛林深处，模仿昆虫。叶片覆毒，既能融入环境，也能阻止捕食者靠近。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stays in deep jungles, imitating insects. Its leaves are coated in poison, allowing it to blend into its environment and deter predators from approaching.

entry: 它看似无害，毛里却覆有数百根毒刺。受威胁时会埋入地下，留些刺在外，希望袭击者踩上。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite looking harmless, its fur is covered in hundreds of toxic spines. When threatened, it will bury itself in the ground with some of its spines out, hoping that its attacker steps on the spines.

entry: POKENAME用带刺藤蔓挂在树上。谁想吃它，就会中致命毒，灵魂最终也被吸入体内。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hangs from trees using its thorned vines. If anyone tries to eat POKENAME, they will be inflicted with a lethal poison and their soul will eventually be absorbed into POKENAME's body.

entry: POKENAME的翼与耳已融合，因此对大声响很敏感，却能敏锐捕捉轻声。翼粉被混进少年喜爱的古龙水，多数其他人却觉得太浓烈。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's wings and ears have merged, making it highly susceptible to loud noises but keenly aware of quiet ones. The powder emitted from its wings are mixed in colognes popular with adolescent boys but considered too overpowering by most others.

entry: POKENAME尾巴喷出的蓝火，源于体内积聚的毒。烟气吸入十分危险。
author: ludensekko
source: The blue flame emitted from a POKENAME tail is due to the poison that accumulates in its body. The fumes are dangerous to inhale.

entry: POKENAME性情凶暴，以燃火、带毒的爪吓走入侵者。许多个体追得离巢太远，反而迷路。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are aggressive creatures that rely on their flaming, venom-tipped claws to scare intruders away. Many end up lost because they chase intruders too far away from their nest.

entry: 它们成群生活在有毒珊瑚间。有人见过胆大个体游出，挑衅捕食者，再与追赶者比速度，返回安全的珊瑚家园。
author: afilthycasual
source: Their schools live among colonies of toxic coral. Adventurous individuals have been seen swimming beyond the colony to taunt predators, before racing them back to the safety of their coral homes.

entry: POKENAME在下水道附近的土里，搜寻化学物泄漏处。吃下毒物，强化自身毒液。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME searches soil near sewers for chemical leaks. It consumes the toxins found there to reinforce its own venom.

entry: POKENAME把头刺向前刺出，注入强效毒素。受害者中招后不久，往往就会高烧。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME thrusts the spine on its head forward to inject a potent toxin. Victims often develop intense fevers shortly after being struck.

entry: POKENAME群躲在废屋，囤积任何看中的杂物。毛上黏满尘土污垢，因此不建议抚摸。
author: mistymagius
source: Colonies of POKENAME hide out in abandoned houses, hoarding any random objects they take a liking to. They are full of dust and grime stuck in their fur, so petting them is not recommended.

entry: POKENAME用利角保护囤积的闪亮物品。它会覆上薄毒，吓阻盗窃，确保珍贵收藏不被偷。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME guards its shiny object hoard with its sharp horn. It coats the objects in a thin layer of poison to deter theft, ensuring no one steals its prized collection.

entry: POKENAME游在河溪中，以刺攻击岩石，练习技巧。若想避免脑震荡，就得留意别用力过猛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME swim in rivers and streams where they practice using their stinger by attacking rocks. They need to be careful not to be too forceful if they want to avoid a concussion.

entry: POKENAME带毒、多刺的外层能很好地抵御物理攻击，灵活肢体则能迅速有力地出击。暴烈脾气，让它在战斗中不可小觑。
author: inohe
source: Its poisonous, spiky exterior provides excellent defense against physical attacks, while its nimble limbs enable quick and powerful strikes. POKENAME's fiery temperament makes it a force to be reckoned with in battle.

entry: POKENAME暴怒时，毒性会变为原来的10倍。怒火增强角毒，让胡乱刺击也更具威胁。
author: .izik
source: When enraged, POKENAME's venom becomes 10 times more potent. Its fury amplifies the toxicity of its horn, making its haphazard strikes an even greater threat.

entry: POKENAME忠诚亲昵，是好宠物，却会毒咬。有些训练家为避免问题，会设法从宠物身上取出毒素，但多数认为这种做法不人道。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a loyal and affectionate pet, but carries a poisonous bite. Some Trainers get the toxins from their pet to avoid potential issues, but most consider it an inhumane act.

entry: POKENAME听觉出色，能察觉很远处的敌人。空中动作无可匹敌，常借此占上风。但它尚未完全成熟，毒性仍弱。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME has an exceptional sense of hearing, allowing it to detect enemies from great distances. It's unmatched in aerial maneuvers, which it often uses to gain the upper hand over its foes. As it is not yet fully mature, its venom remains weak.

entry: POKENAME吃掉池塘死水里原本会积聚的毒藻，对生态很重要。它将毒吸入体内，覆成黏滑毒膜，吓退捕食者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME play an important role in pond ecosystems, feeding on toxic algae that would otherwise build up in the stagnant water. They incorporate the toxins into their body, coating themselves in a slimy, poisonous film to deter predators.

entry: 每天早晨，它会不断拳击大石，直到拳力足以将石头打成两半。POKENAME身上的毒刺，也能在决斗中削弱敌人。
author: fiordaliso
source: Every morning, it punches large rocks until its strikes are strong enough to split them in two. The poisonous spikes on POKENAME's body help weaken its enemies during duels.

entry: POKENAME叶片若鲜艳明丽，就代表毒性比平时更强。它能从身体射出毒刺，扎向对手。
author: dodoowner_
source: If POKENAME's leaves are vibrant and brilliant, it is a sign that the Pokémon's toxins are stronger than usual. It can expel toxic thorns from its body, prickling opponents.

entry: POKENAME晒太阳取暖，这对变温的身体十分重要。它们经常互相梳理，替其他宝可梦清洁壳。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME bask in the sunlight to keep themselves warm, which is important for their cold-blooded bodies. They constantly participate in a communal grooming process where they clean the shells of other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME分泌的毒汁可制古龙水，带有独特桦木与花香，是别致的奢华香氛材料。
author: .izik
source: The poisonous sap that POKENAME exudes is used in cologne creation. It has a distinct birch and floral scent, making it a unique and luxurious fragrance ingredient.

entry: POKENAME好斗，住在洞穴，凶猛护巢。它会以双拳砸地，摆出吓人的架势，赶走大多数其他宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is an aggressive Pokémon that resides in caves, ferociously guarding its nest from intruders. It slams its fists against the ground to appear menacing, scaring away most other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME快速奔向敌人，头部来回乱晃。抓住猎物后，便以双角刺击，借速度与锐利攻击压倒对方。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME runs towards enemies quickly while its heads flail about. Once it catches its prey, it will stab at the enemy with both horns, using its speed and sharp attacks to overwhelm foes.

entry: POKENAME用毒唾液涂满嘴，使咬击有毒。但天气极冷时，唾液会冻结，让它无法进食。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME coats its mouth in its poisonous saliva, causing its bite to be toxic. However, in really cold weather, its saliva will freeze over, preventing it from eating.

entry: POKENAME炮筒发出的水，带有能慢慢溶解物品的特殊毒素。由于几乎无法提取，这种毒素十分稀有。
author: seanothan_23
source: The water that POKENAME shoots from its cannons has a special toxin that can slowly dissolve things over time. The toxin is so rare because extracting it is nearly impossible.

entry: 危险宝可梦威胁POKENAME时，它便释放易燃孢子云，让自己显得更大。越害怕，花粉云就越大。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME are threatened by a dangerous Pokémon, they release a cloud of flammable spores to make themselves look bigger. The more scared they are, the larger the cloud of pollen.

entry: POKENAME尾上的火平时不点燃，只用于威吓其他宝可梦。其实造成不了严重烧伤，连维持几秒，也要耗费大量精力。
author: distinguishedmanlygentleman
source: The flame on POKENAME's tail is usually unlit and is only used to intimidate other Pokémon. In reality, the flame is incapable of causing any substantial burns, and it takes a great deal of POKENAME's energy to keep it lit for even a few seconds.

entry: POKENAME恶作剧玩得越开心，尾火就越亮。但一见训练家遇险，它便毫不犹豫，用上全部超能力保护。
author: fiordaliso
source: The more fun it has playing pranks on others, the brighter the flame on its tail shines. Despite its playful nature, when POKENAME sees its Trainer in danger, it does not hesitate to draw upon all its psychic powers to protect them.

entry: 两三只POKENAME常绕圈奔跑，追逐彼此头上的火。培育者会鼓励，因为这能帮助它们与其他宝可梦建立深厚关系。
author: karmaofevil
source: Two or three POKENAME can be found running around in circles, chasing each other's flames atop their heads. Breeders will encourage this behavior since it causes them to form great relationships with other Pokémon.

entry: 它好奇心强，常出现在不寻常的地方，甚至浅红市那样的动物园。明亮羽毛与火尾，让它晚间难以有效捕猎，因此会趁太阳还在时狩猎。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its curious nature has caused it to be spotted in unusual areas, even in zoos such as the one in Fuschia City. Its bright plumage and fiery tail keeps it from being an effective predator during the late evening, so it hunts while the sun is up.

entry: POKENAME害怕时，背花就释放花粉云。准备逃跑，便点燃花粉，吓退附近宝可梦，再趁机离开。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME are scared, the flower on their backs releases a cloud of pollen. When they are ready to escape, they ignite the cloud of pollen to scare away nearby Pokémon as they flee.

entry: POKENAME在雨林结群，啃开巨树干，作为洞穴。族群太大，就会威胁寄居树的健康，内部空洞最终可能使树倒塌。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form colonies in rainforests, gnawing out burrows within the trunks of giant trees. If a colony grows too large they become a danger to the health of their host tree, creating hollows within the trunk that can eventually cause a collapse.

entry: POKENAME用壳中喷出的火焰，远距离交流。长长的喷焰表示危险，同伴便会慢慢爬来支援。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use the flames jetting from their shell to communicate with one another over long distances. Long jets of flame indicate danger, encouraging other POKENAME to slowly crawl to their aid.

entry: POKENAME一开始战斗，头叶渗出的花蜜就会燃烧。火焰强弱，反映剩余的生命力。
author: .izik
source: The nectar leaking from the leaf on POKENAME's head ignites the moment it begins to fight. The intensity of the flame reflects its remaining vitality.

entry: 这种宝可梦身手灵巧，肌肉发达的双腿能跃得很高，惊人抓力也能让它荡过树间。POKENAME会高叫、增大尾火，威吓敌人。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: This Pokémon excels in dexterity, able to jump impressive heights with its muscular legs and swing through the trees with its amazing grip. POKENAME use their loud cries and increase the size of their flaming tail to intimidate foes.

entry: POKENAME主要从上方进攻，先跃向对手，再带着凶猛火踢落下。近战也会用尾巴与爪攻击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME mainly attack from above, launching themselves at their opponents before coming down with a fierce and fiery kick. These Pokémon will also use their tails and claw to attack in close combat.

entry: 野生POKENAME会比谁能把后方火焰烧得最大。胜者能把败者扔进最近的水洼，当作胜利恶作剧。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME competes with others of its kind in the wild to see who can make the flame on their rear flare up the largest. The winner gets to toss the loser into the nearest puddle as a victory prank.

entry: POKENAME脾气急，很快就会躁动、凶暴。建议往头上倒凉泥，舒缓它，暂时平息火爆脾气。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is hotheaded and quick to become agitated and aggressive. It is recommended to dump cool mud onto its head to soothe it and temporarily calm its fiery temperament.

entry: POKENAME生活在截然不同的两种环境。高山岩崖上筑巢，一天最热时，却下到凉爽的沼泽低地狩猎。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME lives in two very different environments. It makes its nest on the rocky crags of tall mountains, but during the hottest part of the day, it descends to hunt among the cool, marshy lowlands.

entry: POKENAME表演复杂翻筋斗时，身体会在橙、红、黄三色间变换。动作越快，颜色切换越急，晃得敌人头晕。
author: .izik
