source: While performing complex somersault routines, POKENAME's body alternates between orange, red, and yellow. The faster it moves, the more rapidly these colors shift, dizzying foes.

entry: POKENAME能变体色，但鲜艳脸纹与腹部之字纹始终不变。伪装被识破，就沿尾释放火焰，捶胸威吓敌人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can change the colors of their bodies, all except for their vibrant facial markings and the zigzag patterns on their bellies. If their cover is blown, they release flames along their tails and pound on their chests to intimidate their foes.

entry: 它们不倦地与大牙狸合作筑坝，尤其擅长抹泥，做出冬季防护屏障。复杂的气味腺，让它们不必说话也能交流。
author: bobosmith01
source: They spend much of their time tirelessly working with Bidoof to build river dams; applying mud to create a protective barrier for the winter is their specialty. They have complex scent glands that allow them to communicate with others wordlessly.

entry: POKENAME花朵般背部的火焰，强弱随心情变化。恐惧或愤怒会让火全力迸发，示意别靠太近。
author: quackquackattack
source: The intensity of the flame on their flowery back changes depending on the mood of POKENAME. Fear and anger cause the flame to erupt in full force to signal that they need space.

entry: POKENAME把双颚加热到发光，威吓对手。带火咬击，会留下疼痛焦痕。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME heats its jaws to glowing temperatures to intimidate opponents. Its fiery bite leaves behind painful scorch marks.

entry: POKENAME壳上的灌木热得不断散出淡蒸气。战斗时，它继续加热，抛出大量燃烧的飞叶快刀。
author: sk372
source: The bushes on POKENAME's shell are hot enough to constantly emit faint amounts of steam. It heats it up further during battle, throwing off flaming Razor Leaf attacks in large amounts.

entry: 融合让POKENAME变得极其好斗，脾气也很暴躁。有学说认为，它体内的火焰热得超出了身体所能承受的程度，才会向附近的其他生灵发泄。
author: sk372
source: Fusion has given POKENAME a most aggressive and prickly personality. It is theorized that its internal flames are burning hotter than its body can handle, making it lash out at others nearby.

entry: POKENAME的火焰强到将整个头部团团包围。它精力极为旺盛，会凭借无与伦比的敏捷身手，向对手接连挥出拳头。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its flames have become so powerful they completely surround POKENAME's head. It is an extremely energetic Pokémon that attacks opponents with flurries of punches executed with unmatched agility.

entry: POKENAME战斗时偏重使用左腿，蓄拳时会将重心放在这条腿上。拳头一挥出，就会迸发橙色火焰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME favors its left leg during combat, leaning on it while winding up punches. When it unleashes a punch, it releases a burst of orange flames.

entry: POKENAME喜欢和伙伴在冰冷的水中游泳。有趣的是，即使整个身体都没入水中，它的火焰也不会熄灭。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME loves to swim through cold waters with its companions. Interestingly, its flame does not go out even when fully submerged.

entry: POKENAME会吹出充满高热空气的泡泡。这些泡泡只在战场上飘浮片刻，但碰到后可能留下经久不愈的烫伤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME blows bubbles filled with superheated air. These bubbles drift around the battlefield for mere moments but can cause lasting burns if touched.

entry: POKENAME施展空手道般的招式，同时喷出沸水压制对手。它的耐力极佳，能连续战斗数小时而不疲倦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME performs karate-style techniques while shooting boiling water to overwhelm opponents. It has an incredibly high amount of stamina, allowing it to fight for hours without tiring.

entry: POKENAME离巢后会昂首阔步，一副自信满满的模样。由于它生性好斗，头上又长着尖角，其他宝可梦都不愿招惹它。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME struts around with confidence when it is outside of its nest. Its highly aggressive nature and its sharp horn cause other Pokémon to leave it alone.

entry: POKENAME的火势取决于情绪。兴奋或准备战斗时，火焰就会猛烈燃烧。
author: mepp.
source: The strength of POKENAME's flames is dependent on its emotions. When excited or ready for a fight, these flames burn with great intensity.

entry: POKENAME的波导与火焰紧密相连。训练取得突破时，身上会短暂迸发一圈蓝色火焰。
author: periperi_chicken
source: A POKENAME's aura and flames are deeply connected. When it achieves a breakthrough in training, a burst of blue fire briefly surrounds its body.

entry: 它看似一动不动，其实一直留意着周围。POKENAME会让尾焰燃烧得更加明亮来威吓敌人，也能迅速发动攻击。
author: houndrys.
source: Its inactivity is deceitful, as it's aware of its surroundings. POKENAME's tail flame burns brighter to intimidate threats, and it can strike quickly.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME会从尾巴上掷出火焰手里剑，温度高得足以切开钢铁。愤怒时，它的火焰会炽热得发白。
author: mistymagius
source: In combat, POKENAME will throw fiery shurikens from its tail which are hot enough to cut through steel. Its flames glow white hot when POKENAME is angry.

entry: POKENAME好胜心极强，会一起想出各种胡闹的游戏来锻炼战斗本领。它是成长中的训练家的好伙伴，战斗热情会激励自己和搭档一同进步。
author: vic1312
source: Fiercely competitive, POKENAME will train for battle with nonsense games they come up with together. They make great partners for growing Trainers, their spirit for battle pushing themselves and their partners forward.

entry: POKENAME能熟练控制尾巴上的火焰，既能将火势放大来吓退其他生灵，也能将火焰集中，令岩石软化甚至熔化。不论熔出的是金属还是纯粹的岩石，它都会吃掉。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can control the flames upon their tails rather well. They can enlarge their flames to intimidate others or concentrate them enough to soften or even melt rock. They consume any molten material they create, be it metal or pure rock.

entry: 它们一同旋转，产生战斗所需的火焰。这种宝可梦常与同类或其他火属性宝可梦较量，看谁能用最短的时间产生最多火焰。
author: fireblade141
source: Spinning together generates the fire they use to battle. This Pokémon will often compete with others of its kind or other Fire-types to see who can generate the most fire the fastest.

entry: 每到冬天，POKENAME就格外抢手。它的火焰温暖又舒适，能让食物瞬间解冻，用来烤棉花糖饼干也再合适不过。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME demand gets higher each winter, as the warmth its fire emanates is very soothing. It can thaw food in an instant and is great for s'mores.

entry: POKENAME两掌各有一颗红宝石，能借此引导和控制火焰。被逼入绝境时，还会从红宝石般的双眼中喷出火焰。
author: .izik
source: A ruby in each of POKENAME's palms allows it to channel and control its flames. When cornered, it also unleashes flames from its ruby eyes.

entry: POKENAME在海面疾驰时，鳍上的火焰会猛烈燃烧。若不慎撞上船只，通常转瞬间就会熔穿船体。
author: .izik
source: The flames on POKENAME's fin blaze intensely as it speeds across the ocean's surface. Should it accidentally collide with a ship, it usually melts through the hull in an instant.

entry: POKENAME发出尖锐叫声时，附近的易燃物可能燃烧起来。这种现象似乎在它感觉有危险时更容易发生。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME lets out high-pitched screeches, nearby flammable objects can combust. This seems to occur more frequently when it feels it is in danger.

entry: POKENAME每根尖刺都会冒出火焰，带走体内的水分。因此，它红褐色的皮肤几乎完全干燥，很难割开。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME produces flames from each of its spines, which wick moisture out of its body. As a result, its reddish-brown skin is almost entirely dry and tough to cut through.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上长出的蘑菇会以古怪的方式摆动，模仿火焰的形态。只要碰一下，就可能喷出一团会造成灼伤的黄色孢子。
author: .izik
source: The toadstool growing from POKENAME's tail moves in odd ways, mimicking a flame. A single touch can release a burst of yellow spores capable of causing burns.

entry: POKENAME用燃烧的尾巴点燃树枝，挥舞着赶走天敌。闲暇时，也会用这些树枝互相梳理身体，加深彼此的感情。
author: pattybgoode
source: POKENAME light their twigs with their burning tail and wield them to scare away predators. When idle, POKENAME also groom each other with the same twigs to reinforce social bonds.

entry: 它凝望未来，确认自己将来能变得多强。如果POKENAME对所见的结果不满意，火焰就会失控地盘旋，烧焦沿途的一切。
author: dodoowner_
source: It gazes into the future, determining how strong it will grow to be. If POKENAME is dissatisfied with the outcome it sees, its flame spirals out of control, scorching anything in its path.

entry: POKENAME会摘下颈部长出的独特可燃气泡，用尾火点燃，再准确地将这些危险的投掷物掷出。
author: chaoticanzu
source: POKENAME takes the unique combustible bubbles that grow from its neck and ignites them with the fire from its tail. These dangerous projectiles are then thrown with precise control.

entry: 这种宝可梦对甜食胃口极大，尾焰由液态糖构成。用它的火焰拉制的棉花糖，风味独特，甜美奢华至极。
author: brilliantdarkness
source: This Pokémon has a voracious appetite for sweets and possesses a tail flame made of liquid sugar. Cotton Candy spun from its fire has a unique and supremely decadent flavor.

entry: POKENAME会练习旋转尾巴，将其当鞭子甩出，好让同伴刮目相看。但掌握这些技巧需要时间，所以它经常被松垂的皮肤绊倒，或一尾巴抽在自己脸上。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME trains to impress its fellows by spinning its tail and flinging it out as a whip-like weapon. However, it takes a while to master these skills, so it often trips over its loose skin or hits itself in the face with its tail.

entry: 关都的茶道仪式过去常用POKENAME烧水。这项习俗至今仍在延续，只是如今它会故意把火焰变大，逗来宾开心。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME were often used in Kantonian tea ceremonies to boil water. This practice is still performed today, but nowadays POKENAME purposefully increases flame size to entertain patrons.

entry: POKENAME看见海边的情侣时，尾尖的火焰就会泛出令人愉悦的粉红色。它们通常在夜里浮出水面，与同群伙伴一同呈现浪漫夺目的光景。
author: .izik
source: The flame on the tip of POKENAME's tail glows a delightful pink when it witnesses couples near the sea's edge. As they typically surface at night, this creates dazzling romantic displays alongside those of its school.

entry: 野外可见POKENAME进行高强度训练，磨炼身体本领。弱小宝可梦受到威胁时，它会英勇地挺身保护。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is seen in the wild honing its physical skills with intense training regimens. It heroically steps in to defend weaker Pokémon when they're being threatened.

entry: POKENAME极为敏捷，能一边灵活荡行，一边向敌人投掷火花。它们常缩进壳内，借墙面弹跳，利用这种防御姿态绕着对手移动。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are incredibly agile, swinging through their environment while throwing embers at foes. They often bounce off walls while inside their shells, using this defensive state to maneuver around opponents.

entry: 暴雨中，POKENAME岩石般坚硬的身体会变得滚烫。接触身体的水往往会发出嘶嘶声，瞬间蒸发。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's stone-hard body becomes intensely hot during rainstorms. Water that makes contact will often sizzle and evaporate instantly.

entry: 被迫防守时，POKENAME会把头缩进壳里旋转，同时让尾火猛燃，挥动尾巴将火花甩向四周，逼退对手。
author: sk372
source: When put on the defensive, POKENAME retreats its head into its shell, spinning and flaring up the flame on its tail, swinging it around and flinging embers everywhere to deter opponents.

entry: POKENAME会改变火翼扇动的方式，发出视觉信号，指示伙伴何时闪避、何时出击。它的动作美丽得让敌人常被火光吸引，忘记攻击。
author: ambrosia04
source: By altering the flutter of its flaming wings, POKENAME creates visual signals that instruct its partners on when to dodge and when to strike. Its movements are so beautiful that foes often forget to attack, captivated by the fiery display.

entry: POKENAME曾在世界某些地方被尊为火焰女王。它能将火焰武术与迷人的舞蹈巧妙结合。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME was once revered as the Queen of Fire in certain parts of the world. It skillfully combines its fiery martial arts with an alluring dance.

entry: POKENAME很容易被激怒，转而攻击。这头烈焰公牛全速冲锋时，会点燃沿途一切。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME tend to be very easily enraged into attacking. When this blazing bull charges at full speed, it sets everything along its path aflame.

entry: POKENAME体内的火囊燃烧得十分炽热，必须从头顶排出火焰才能调节体温。它战斗时相当敏捷，能迅速跳跃、翻身来躲避攻击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's internal flame sac burns so hotly that fire must escape from its cranium in order to regulate its temperature. It is quite agile in combat, dodging attacks with quick leaps and flips.

entry: POKENAME的火焰强到几秒内就能熔化黄金。暴怒时，火力会成倍增强。
author: giblegamingyt
source: POKENAME's flames are strong enough to melt gold within seconds. When it is enraged, the strength of its fire multiplies.

entry: POKENAME天生爱恶作剧，会戏弄被它弄得摸不着头脑的训练家和宝可梦。若有人嫌这些把戏烦，它反而会气得直哼，狠狠烧伤对方。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are natural tricksters, joking around with confused trainers and Pokémon. If someone is annoyed by their games, they'll huff in anger and give them a wicked burn.

entry: 野生POKENAME住在北方寒冷的冬日森林中，照料植物与野生生灵。过路的宝可梦和旅人冻得发抖时，它会用身上的火焰为他们取暖。
author: cobalt0135
source: Wild POKENAME live in the cold wintery forests of the north taking  care of plants and wildlife. They help freezing passerby Pokémon and travelers with the warmth provided by the flames emitted on their bodies.

entry: POKENAME遇到非常强大的对手时，头上的火焰就会烧得更旺。尾巴如同舵，让它能在树梢间更加灵活地飞行。
author: fiordaliso
source: The flame burning on its head grows more intense when POKENAME encounters very powerful opponents. Its tail acts as a rudder, helping it fly more nimbly among the treetops.

entry: POKENAME以偏重防守的武术迎战，主要靠强壮四肢擒抱对手。若战斗拖得比它希望的更久，就会一口咬住敌人，缠抱着翻滚，直到对方失去意识。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME engages in combat with a more defensive martial art focused on grappling with its powerful limbs. If a fight is going longer than it wants, POKENAME will grab its foe in its jaws and take them into a grappling roll until they go unconscious.

entry: POKENAME不断高速奔跑，锻炼出更长的火焰鬃毛。它极其擅长火焰轮，会用这招将对手逼入绝境。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME constantly races at high speed to increase the length of its fiery mane. It is an exceptional user of the Flame Wheel move, which it exploits to corner its opponents.

entry: 这种宝可梦冷静聪慧，经常能见到它冥想。有人误以为它冥想时在睡觉，但它感官敏锐，即使闭着眼，任何偷袭也无法得逞。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is a calm and intelligent Pokémon that is often seen meditating. Some incorrectly assume it is sleeping during its meditation, but its keen senses mean that, even with its eyes closed, any ambush against it will fail.

entry: 据说这些宝可梦日复一日地锻炼火焰攻击。它们对训练家十分忠诚。
author: mortrahend
source: These Pokémon are said to train their fiery attacks day in and day out. They are very loyal to their Trainers.

entry: POKENAME精通空战，领地意识极强，会将大片森林和平原据为己有。与争夺领地的敌人交锋时，随着它全力比拼战斗本领，羽毛会明亮地燃烧起来。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: Masters of aerial combat, POKENAME are highly territorial and claim large areas of forests and plains. When fighting any contenders for its territory, its feathers begin to burn brightly as it exerts itself in these contests of combat prowess.

entry: POKENAME背部繁花间的火势取决于心情。格外愤怒时，会喷出一团燃烧的花粉，烧遍周围一切，同时发泄怒气。
author: quackquackattack
source: The intensity of the flame on POKENAME's flowery back depends on their mood. Whenever they are particularly angry, POKENAME release a plume of fiery pollen to both burn everything around them and vent their frustration.

entry: POKENAME的牙齿极其锋利，不断生长，咬合力足以咬穿石头与某些金属。遇到实在啃不动的东西，就先用火焰烧软再试。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME teeth are extremely sharp and constantly growing, they have a bite force that enables them to chew through stone and some metals. If they encounter something too tough to gnaw, they use their flames to soften it first before trying again.

entry: 尾巴如同额外的肢体，冥想时它会靠尾巴维持身体平衡。精神集中后，火焰会烧得最为明亮。
author: mistymagius
source: Its tail acts as an extra limb and it will balance on it while it meditates. Its flames burn the brightest once it focuses its mind.

entry: POKENAME精力十分旺盛，会用尾巴向对手甩出燃烧的液体。它们似乎很讨厌飘飘球。
author: powgal_46255
source: POKENAME are very energetic Pokémon who throw fiery liquid at opponents with their tails. They seem to have a hatred for Drifloon.

entry: 手脚上的爪通常冰冷，但它能从自己头上抓取火焰，改用灼热的攻击。它们会结成小群共同狩猎，配合灵活动作制服猎物。
author: .jerden
source: While the claws on its hands and feet are normally ice-cold, it can snatch fire from its own head to make blazing-hot attacks instead. Small groups of them hunt together, coordinating their agile movements to take down prey.

entry: POKENAME在空中飞翔，俯冲向同伴，以燃烧的热情鼓舞它们。看到认识的人陷入困境时，会用尾巴轻轻缠住对方的手臂，让其聆听温暖火焰的噼啪声。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME fly through the air, swooping down towards their companions to inspire them with a burning passion. If an POKENAME sees someone it knows struggling, it will gently wrap their arm with its tail and let them listen to its warm, crackling fire.

entry: POKENAME有耐火的皮毛，森林失火时便会立即行动，凭借出众的力量从火海中救出年幼宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has fire-resistant fur and leaps into action during forest fires. It uses its superior strength to rescue young Pokémon from the blaze.

entry: POKENAME跑得很快，在居住的森林里不顾一切地疾驰。头上火焰落下的火星，有时会意外引发森林大火。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME are very fast runners, sprinting through the forests where they live with reckless abandon. Sometimes, a spark that falls from the flame on their head starts up forest fires by accident.

entry: 它从头顶喷火，让自己显得更高大；入睡后，这些火焰就会熄灭。它跳得相当高，会用尾巴抓住敌人或物体，施展杂技般的动作。
author: infinex21
source: It vents fire from the top of its head to appear larger than it is; these flames die out whenever it sleeps. It can jump rather high and will use its tail to grapple onto foes or objects to perform acrobatic maneuvers.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME的武术攻击总伴随着灼热火焰。它偏爱用强健的双腿重创对手。战斗经验越丰富，脸上的面具就越鲜艳。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: In battle, POKENAME's martial arts attacks will always be paired with scorching fire. They prefer to use their incredible legs to deliver devastating blows to opponents. The more combat experience they have, the more vibrant their face mask.

entry: POKENAME观察其他生灵，学习并练习柔术动作。每完成一个动作，身上都会喷出热蒸汽。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME practices jujitsu moves, which it learns from observing others. Each time it completes a maneuver, hot steam erupts from its body.

entry: POKENAME将泥土压实、加热，筑成居住的大窝。它对亲手建的家领地意识极强，谁靠得太近，都会让它爬到窝顶尖叫，投掷火球。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME packs and heats mud to form large dens to live within. It is quite territorial regarding its built home, climbing to the top to screech and throw fireballs at anybody coming too close for comfort.

entry: 训练有素的POKENAME拥有惊人的力量。巨拳落下时往往会砸出燃烧的坑洞，重创对手。虚弱时，它会爆发出狂野而失控的力量。
author: nyoomymph
source: A well-trained POKENAME is a physical powerhouse. It deals devastating hits with its huge fists, often creating craters of fire when they land. When it grows weak, POKENAME has a burst of wild, uncontrolled power.

entry: POKENAME会用身体的每个部分战斗，包括尾巴和长舌。它能改变体色来避免冲突，不过通常只有饿得无力战斗时才会这样做。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME fight using every part of their bodies, including their tails and long tongues. They can change the colors of their bodies to avoid conflict, though they typically only do this when they are too hungry to fight.

entry: POKENAME的楔石始终滚烫。发怒时会更热，片刻间就能超过工业熔炉的温度。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's keystone is always scalding hot. It grows hotter when angered, reaching temperatures higher than an industrial furnace within moments.

entry: 热带森林中的许多宝可梦都因POKENAME怒火炽烈而避开它。它一生气，就会散出花粉云，花粉沾到哪里，哪里就会着火。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many Pokémon in tropical forests avoid POKENAME because of their fiery wrath. Whenever they get angry, POKENAME create a cloud of pollen that sets fire to anything the pollen clings onto.

entry: POKENAME发怒时，头上会出现一张由火焰组成的巨口。它越愤怒，巨口就越大。
author: .izik
source: When angered, a maw made of flames emerges from POKENAME's head. The maw grows larger, the angrier it becomes.

entry: POKENAME对实力极有信心，连战斗都保持侧卧。技艺高超得连果子会落在哪里，也能预知。
author: houndrys.
source: POKENAME is so confident in its power that it remains lying on its side, even in battles. It's so skilled, it can predict where fruit will fall.

entry: 血液燃烧，斗志也熊熊而起。两只交战时，能听到急促轰鸣；等响起大大的哈欠，才算打完。
author: houndrys.
source: As their blood burns, so does their fighting spirit. When two engage in combat, quick, loud booms can be heard; loud yawning indicates when it ends.

entry: 熟睡时虽安宁，醒来后血流便会升温，使它们狂暴肆虐，所过之处只剩灰烬。
author: houndrys.
source: Though peaceful while slumbering, when woken up, their blood flow will heat up, causing them to rampage, leaving only cinders behind.

entry: 与人们普遍的看法相反，POKENAME在白天生活得很好。经常能见到它用长鼻采摘腐烂的水果，这种独特食性让它在生态系统中占有自己的一席之地。
author: thescribe
source: Contrary to popular belief, POKENAME thrive in the daylight. They can often be seen picking rotten fruit with their trunk, and this peculiar diet gives them their own niche in the ecosystem.

entry: 自古以来，POKENAME一直被视为战士与僧侣的守护者。古寺门前的灯笼会雕成它发怒的模样，火焰从脑后燃起。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Since ancient times, POKENAME have been seen as guardians for warriors and monks alike. Lanterns at the front of ancient temples have been carved to resemble angry POKENAME with the fire burning from the backs of their heads.

entry: POKENAME能随心控制背上火焰的温度，精确到每一度。有些人野餐时会借它的火来烤肉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can control the temperature of the flames on its back down to the degree at will. Some people use it to grill meat during picnics.

entry: POKENAME斗志昂扬，又十分自律。它经常召集一小群小火焰猴，指导它们训练，希望有朝一日能有学生超越自己。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses a great amount of fighting spirit as well as a great amount of discipline. It often rounds up small groups of Chimchar to train beneath it, in hopes that one of its students will one day surpass it.

entry: POKENAME体内燃烧的火焰增多，性格也变得急躁。它常找比自己更高大强壮的宝可梦打架，结果陷入自己应付不了的局面。
author: sk372
source: The increased fire burning in POKENAME's body gives it a hotheaded personality. It often picks fights with larger, stronger Pokémon and gets in over its head in the process.

entry: POKENAME战斗时挥舞的火棍能随意伸长或缩短。即使它筋疲力尽，火焰温度也很少低于1300度。
author: .izik
source: The flaming rod POKENAME wields during combat can lengthen or shorten at will. Its flames seldom dip below 1300 degrees, even when it is exhausted.

entry: 由于四肢短小，POKENAME主要用火焰与精准的尾部打击作战。它自尊心极强，很容易生气，怒气只消几秒就会反映在头上的火焰中。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME fight with fire and precise tail strikes, given how small their limbs are. They are incredibly prideful and quick to anger, with the flames on their heads reflecting their tempers within seconds of being angered.

entry: POKENAME用强壮的双臂在沿海水域高速游泳。体热让水冒出蒸汽，在它身后留下一道淡淡的痕迹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its strong arms to swim at high speeds through coastal waters. Steam rises from the water due to the heat of its body, leaving a faint trail in its wake.

entry: POKENAME通常在蒸汽喷口附近划定领地，用那里的水保养刀刃。它虽强大却很仁厚，其他生灵想用多久，它就允许用多久。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME usually claim territory near steam vents, using the water to maintain their blades. Though powerful, they are benevolent, letting others use the steam vents as long as they wish.

entry: POKENAME的触须能伸得很长，如同额外的肢体，让它在最崎岖的地形也能轻松前行。它因此能流畅自如地施展复杂的柔术动作。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feelers extend to great lengths to act as additional limbs, propelling it through even the roughest terrain with ease. This allows it to perform complex jujitsu moves with remarkable fluidity.

entry: POKENAME把自主权看得比什么都重，轻则不听话，重则动辄挑衅。即便如此，训练家若能让自己的意愿与它的需求相合，仍能拥有一位强大的对战伙伴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME values its autonomy above all else, which makes it disobedient at best and belligerent at worst. Even so, Trainers who align their interests with its needs will have a powerful partner in a Pokémon battle.

entry: 经常能见到POKENAME漫游广阔沙漠，用大手收集沙子。它以火焰烧制带有彩色玻璃花纹、看似完美无瑕的模具。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are often seen wandering vast deserts, collecting sand with their large hands. They use their fires to create seemingly perfect molds with stained glass patterns.

entry: POKENAME身手敏捷，常跃至空中，让敌人时刻紧绷。它用炮短促地发射火焰能量，主要借此分散对手注意，好拉近双方的距离。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is an agile combatant, spending more time in the air as it leaps about to keep foes on their toes. It fires short bursts of fire energy from its cannon, primarily used as distracting shots to help it close the gap between them.

entry: POKENAME将头上天生的火焰与炮口产生的火焰结合，制造巨大的火焰旋涡，吞没挡在沿途的敌人。但火焰不能太热，否则身上的金属会熔化。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME combines the natural flames burning on its head with the fire it creates with its cannon to create giant fiery vortexes that swallow any foe caught in their path. However, it can't make the flames too hot; otherwise, its metal melts.

entry: POKENAME能随心操纵身体，直抵天际。据说心跳听起来，如同鼓声。
author: xenophacilus
source: POKENAME is able to manipulate its body at will to reach the heavens. It is said that you can hear the sound of drums coming from its heartbeat.

entry: 即使战斗时，POKENAME也会若无其事地蹦跳，看似胡闹，实则暗藏精明战术。敌人若因此放松警惕，就会露出破绽，遭受猛烈的火焰攻击。
author: sk372
source: Even during battle, POKENAME skips and prances around seemingly without care, but these antics belie shrewd tactics. Foes that lower their guard due to its carefree actions open themselves up to fierce fiery strikes.

entry: POKENAME身上的“火焰”其实不是火，仍是棉絮，只是借火焰的幻象吓退天敌。
author: patch_bros
source: The flames on POKENAME are actually not flames at all. They are still cotton, but they give that illusion in order to ward off predators.

entry: POKENAME是凶猛的猎手，能追着猎物跑上数英里。双颚足以压碎汽车，灼热的牙齿甚至能直接熔穿钢铁。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are vicious hunters, chasing down their prey for miles. Their jaws are strong enough to crush cars, their heated teeth hot enough to melt straight through steel.

entry: 很久以前，人们会观赏POKENAME用燃烧的四肢起舞。训练家醉心于它们的舞技，模仿这些动作创造了火舞。
author: teatedtiten
source: Long ago, POKENAME were used for entertainment as they danced with their fire-engulfed limbs.  Trainers, being invested in their techniques, mimicked them to create fire dancing.

entry: POKENAME整天不知疲倦地锻炼、进食、战斗。练成新武艺时，热血燃得更烈，却始终不肯满足。
author: houndrys.
source: POKENAME tirelessly train, eat, and fight all day. Their blood flow burns intensely as they master new martial arts; they are never satisfied.

entry: POKENAME的拳脚兼具火焰与电力。只一拳就能打倒一棵橡树。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's punches and kicks are imbued with both fire and electricity. Even a single punch can knock over an oak tree.

entry: POKENAME擅长在战斗中使用火焰与电力攻击。它以啃咬和踢击引出炽热火力或强烈电击，有效击败敌人。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are adept at using both fiery and electrical attacks during combat. Using bites and kicks, POKENAME can summon forth blazing heat or shocking jolts to best defeat their foes.

entry: 它用尾巴与短粗四肢重击对手，放出的火焰足以熔化大多数金属。经常能见到它帮铁匠给金属保温，再用强壮的尾巴协助锻造。
author: infinex21
source: It delivers strong blows using its tail and stubby limbs and unleashes flames hot enough to melt most metals. It is often seen helping blacksmiths with keeping metals hot and using its strong tail to help with the forging process.

entry: POKENAME旋转齿轮，以精确控制的动作在空中劈砍。它体形或许不大，却愿意迎战体形是自己三倍的挑战者。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME will spin its gears around, chopping and slicing the air in controlled movements. Though it may not be the biggest Pokémon, it will willingly fight challengers three times its size.

entry: POKENAME结成小群生活，火焰最大的个体担任首领。夜里，群体会挤在首领的火焰旁取暖。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME live in small groups, with the one whose flames are bigger being the leader. At night, the group will huddle around the leader's flames for warmth.

entry: 獠牙折断后，POKENAME会用火将其焊回原处。虽然过程痛苦，修复的獠牙却极少再度折断。
author: teatedtiten
source: If its tusks break off, POKENAME will use its fire to weld them back on. Though this process is painful, these tusks rarely ever break again.

entry: POKENAME用强力踢击将红宝石从洞壁上踢落，一把把地收起来，留作零食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses powerful kicks to knock rubies from cave walls. It gathers them by the handful to snack on later.

entry: POKENAME最喜欢的食物是出色武术家的灵魂。为了得到这顿美餐，它会与对方徒手过招，用火拳取胜。每次击中对手，都会抽走一部分灵魂。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME's favorite food is the souls of talented martial artists. In order to retrieve its meal, POKENAME will face them in hand to hand combat, using fiery punches to best its opponent. Every strike POKENAME makes serves to drain part of the soul.

entry: 丰缘部分地区会用POKENAME的叶子泡制特色茶。茶味辛辣而苦涩，却是有效的民间抗流感偏方。
author: sk372
source: Some parts of Hoenn use POKENAME leaves to brew a specialty tea. The drink is spicy and bitter, but works well as a home remedy for combatting the flu.

entry: POKENAME在栖居的湖中追逐猎物时，尾巴会高速逆时针旋转。尾巴极热，接触皮肤就能造成灼伤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tail spins counterclockwise at high speeds while chasing prey through its lake home. The tail is extremely hot and can scorch skin on contact.

entry: POKENAME从背部喷火推进，在水中移动得比自身游速更快。到达路线尽头后，就会折返回来，用巨颚捞起被身后热流煮熟的东西。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME blast fire from their backs to propel themselves through water even faster than they can naturally swim. Once they reach the end of their path, they loop back around to scoop up anything cooked by their wake with their massive jaws.

entry: POKENAME如同野火的化身。它用燃烧的利爪撕开森林，将一切烧成灰烬。
author: lampent12
source: POKENAME is the embodiment of a wildfire. With flaming claws, it tears through the forest, burning everything to ash.

entry: POKENAME能用低沉的男中音般的声音操纵火焰，战斗时借此将敌人逼入绝境。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can use low baritone noises to manipulate flames. It uses this ability to corner foes during combat.

entry: POKENAME守卫丰缘的圣地，像雕像一样驻守在寺庙入口。受到惊动、起身抵御攻击时，身上会迸发猛烈火焰。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME stand guard at holy sites in Hoenn and are stationed as statues at the entrances to temples. When roused to guard against attacks, they produce intense flames from their body.

entry: POKENAME守卫丰缘的圣地，像雕像一样驻守在寺庙入口。受到惊动、起身抵御攻击时，身上会迸发猛烈火焰。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME stand guard at holy sites in Hoenn and are stationed as statues at the entrances to temples. When roused to guard against attacks, they produce intense flames from their body.

entry: POKENAME守卫丰缘的圣地，像雕像一样驻守在寺庙入口。受到惊动、起身抵御攻击时，身上会迸发猛烈火焰。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME stand guard at holy sites in Hoenn and are stationed as statues at the entrances to temples. When roused to guard against attacks, they produce intense flames from their body.

entry: 只要POKENAME在场，任何接近孩子的人都会有生命危险。它保护孩子过于热心，会施展极其猛烈的武术。
author: .realthree
source: If an POKENAME is present, anyone who approaches a child is in mortal danger. It overzealously uses its extreme martial arts to protect children.

entry: 施展武术招式时，一层闪烁的孢子薄雾会笼罩POKENAME的四肢。这些孢子摸起来温暖，能增强它的力量。
author: .izik
source: While performing martial arts techniques, a shimmering haze of spores covers POKENAME's limbs. These spores are warm to the touch and amplify its strength.

entry: POKENAME信任训练家时，头上的火冠会烧得更旺。只要训练家开口，它就愿意迎战任何对手，坚定不移地遵从每一道指令。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME's crown of flame burns stronger when it trusts its Trainer. If its Trainer asks, it will fight any opponent and listen to their every command without wavering.

entry: POKENAME的歌声会影响附近宝可梦的情绪。若引发了不合适的情绪，它便会用独特的格斗方式发起猛攻。
author: c0mm0n.adv0cate
source: POKENAME's songs affect nearby Pokémon's emotions. If the wrong feelings arise, it lashes out using its unique fighting style.

entry: POKENAME跳舞渐入佳境时，整头毛发都会燃起火焰，显出高涨的热情。它总想迅速移动脚步，灵敏的身手反而妨碍它跳好慢舞。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME gets into the groove of a dance, its whole hair will ignite in flames, showing how passionate it has become. Its agility hinders its effectiveness at performing slow dances, as it wants to be quick on its feet at all times.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时四肢并用，动作迅捷，舞姿独特，技巧高超。它动不动就向其他生灵发起斗舞挑战，要证明自己是最出色、最有火热激情的舞者。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's incorporation of all its limbs and quick movements makes its dances both very unique and incredibly skilled. It is very quick to challenge others to dance battles to prove it is the best and most fiery dancer of them all.

entry: 大多数POKENAME住在修道院中，烧掉杂草、修剪植物，照料花园。许多个体花了几十年磨炼园艺，因此不少家庭会在周末前来观赏它们工作。
author: quackquackattack
source: Most POKENAME live within monasteries where they tend to gardens by burning away weeds and cutting plants to the proper size. Many families visit on the weekend to observe them doing their work, as many have spent decades perfecting their craft.

entry: POKENAME制造火焰盾牌，烧伤来袭的敌人。双拳用力一撞，盾牌就会扩大到平常的三倍。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME creates shields made of flame to burn incoming attackers. By slamming its fists together, these shields grow to three times their normal size.

entry: 它旋转木杖，制造火环并将其抛向对手。敌人一旦被火焰伤到或分散注意，POKENAME就会闪电般逼近，以一击终结战斗。
author: milchik
source: It creates rings of fire by spinning its wooden staff and sends them flying toward its opponents. Once its foes are either damaged or distracted by the flames, POKENAME closes the distance with lightning speed and deals a single finishing blow.

entry: POKENAME摘下颈部长出的独特可燃气泡，用头上的火焰点燃，再准确地将这些危险的投掷物掷出。
author: chaoticanzu
source: POKENAME takes the unique combustible bubbles that grow from its neck and ignites them with the fire from its head. These dangerous projectiles are then thrown with precise control.

entry: POKENAME不停呼出火焰，在颈部形成一条围巾。它还会用火焰制成手里剑，轻易将金属劈成两半。
author: chaoticanzu
source: POKENAME constantly exhales fire that forms a scarf around its neck. It can form shurikens out of fire that can easily split metal in two.

entry: 它有神奇的能力，能从头上生成奇特而美味的糖果，慷慨分享给信任的对象。在野外，POKENAME会互赠这些甜点，作为求偶仪式。
author: brilliantdarkness
source: It has the wondrous ability to generate bizarre yet delicious confections from its head, which it shares freely with those it trusts. In the wild, POKENAME exchange these desserts with one another as a courtship ritual.

entry: POKENAME会提起下半身的皮毛，做好战斗准备。这个动作能提高体内温度，让身上的火焰烧得更热，增强力量与速度。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME readies itself for battle by hiking up the fur on its lower half. This increases its internal temperature, making the fire on its body blaze hotter and enhancing its strength and speed.

entry: POKENAME生性爱玩，越开心，火焰冠就越大。它性情火热，很少拒绝挑战。
author: torterrable
source: POKENAME is a playful Pokémon whose crown of flames grows bigger the happier it becomes. It has a fiery personality and rarely turns down a challenge.

entry: POKENAME在港口附近游泳时，尾巴会猛烈甩动。尾毛热得惊人，即使只短暂碰到船只，也可能造成严重损伤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tail flails wildly as it swims near ports. The fur on its tail grows so hot that even brief contact with a vessel can cause serious damage.

entry: POKENAME群居于高山地带，靠燃烧的鬃毛在稀薄空气中保暖。它们结群绕着山峰奔跑觅食，火光使人从远处就能看见。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME packs make their home in high mountain ranges, relying on their flaming manes to keep themselves warm in the thin air. Packs of POKENAME can be seen from great distances thanks to their flames, racing around mountain peaks in search of food.

entry: POKENAME争夺领地时会摆出架势、捶打地面，试图吓退对手。出击前，火焰鬃毛会骤然亮起，这往往是音速拳挥出前唯一的警告。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME posture and pound at the ground when they get into territorial disputes, attempting to intimidate their rivals into backing down. Their fiery mane flares brightly just before they attack, often the only warning before a Mach Punch is thrown.

entry: 它一碰到勺子，勺子就会燃烧起来。因此，POKENAME毕生的终极目标是锻炼念力，用空气造出精神力勺子，终于尝到冰凉的冰淇淋和甜点。
author: epping_forest
source: Its spoons combust whenever it touches them. For this reason, the ultimate goal in the life of an POKENAME is to train its telekinetic powers so it can create a psychic spoon made of air from which to finally taste cold ice cream and desserts.

entry: POKENAME是专心磨炼的斗士，不断训练，让壳变得更结实。它们缩入壳内，将壳点燃，便能一边旋转一边放出汹涌火焰。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are dedicated fighters, constantly training to strengthen their shells. By retreating into these shells and igniting them, they can unleash surges of flames while spinning.

entry: POKENAME会用尾巴像敲鼓一样敲打背壳，试图吓退敌人。即使明知必败，它们也绝不退缩。
author: santon5512
source: Using their tails, POKENAME beat their shells like drums in an attempt to intimidate foes. These Pokémon never back down from a fight, even if it means certain defeat.

entry: 虽然背壳厚重，POKENAME却极其敏捷，轻易就能在身法上胜过大多数对手。炮口喷出的猛烈火焰，集中起来足以烧穿钢铁。
author: santon5512
source: Despite their bulky shells, POKENAME are incredibly agile, able to easily outmaneuver most opponents. Their cannons spew powerful flames that are able to burn through steel when concentrated.

entry: POKENAME高热的巨钳能轻易切入船体，进行狩猎。它主要在暴风雨时捕猎，借起伏的浪涛掩护。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's superheated claws can cut easily into the hulls of ships to hunt. It primarily hunts during storms, using the rocking waves as cover.

entry: POKENAME会沿浅海海床小跑，在较冷的水域更为常见。它们靠光合作用维生，产生的氧气会化作泡泡，从背上的球茎排出。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME trot along the beds of shallow seas, though they are more common in colder waters. They live through photosynthesis, the oxygen produced being released as bubbles from the bulbs on their backs.

entry: 它坚持爬树找叶子吃，无论多饿都不碰落叶。触角会散发强烈的海洋气味来驱赶天敌，但有些天敌反而觉得更诱人。
author: infinex21
source: It insists on climbing trees to find leaves to eat and will not touch leaves that have fallen, no matter how hungry it may be. It exudes a powerful odor reminiscent of the sea from its antenna to deter predators, though some find it more enticing.

entry: POKENAME在训练家中恶名远扬，哪怕只是与它有一点小争执，也会让它爆炸。科学家提出，训练它的最佳方法，或许是对它表现出的每种好行为给予奖励。
author: bobosmith01
source: They are infamous among Trainers due to the fact that even minor disagreements involving POKENAME will cause them to explode. Scientists have posed the theory that the best way to train POKENAME is to reward any good behaviors it displays.

entry: POKENAME与其他顽皮雷弹处不来，会尽可能远离它们。它能像充气沙滩球一样，在水面滚动。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME do not get along with other Electrode and stay away from them if possible. They can roll on top of the surface of the water like an inflated beach ball.

entry: POKENAME戴着帝王拿波三叉戟形的面具，让自己觉得更勇敢、更强壮。战斗时会拿粗大的冰柱劈砍敌人，或将冰柱掷出。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME wears the trident-shaped mask of an Empoleon to make itself feel braver and stronger. It uses a thick icicle in battle, hacking away or hurling it at its foes.

entry: POKENAME用嘴衔石块筑巢。每找到一块让它感兴趣的石头，都会细细打磨。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME carry rocks in their mouths to build their nests. They polish every stone they find intriguing.

entry: POKENAME向周身喷上一层水，让水在极地家园的严寒中冻结，形成保护身体的冰茧。它们借此平安度过冬季，夏天到来时再解冻。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spray a coating of water around themselves, allowing it to freeze in the harsh cold of their polar home to form a protective icy cocoon. They do this to keep themselves safe during winter months, thawing out as summer arrives.

entry: POKENAME还不够强壮，无法自保，却偏爱独居。受威胁时会从喙中射出加压的泡泡，虽然能让敌人疼痛，却不足以彻底逼退它们。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite not being strong enough to fend for itself, POKENAME prefers to live alone. It fires pressurized bubbles from its beak when threatened, which, while painful, aren't enough to fully deter attackers.

entry: POKENAME全身覆有坚挺的防水羽毛，能抵挡外力伤害。迁徙时会附着在冰山上，漂向大海，寻找新家。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are coated in stiff, waterproof feathers that help shield them from physical harm. They migrate by attaching themselves to icebergs, drifting out to sea in search of new homes.

entry: POKENAME翅膀上覆有防水的有毒粉末。雨天最容易见到它们，但一看见闪电或听见雷声，就会四散躲藏。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's wings are clad in a poisonous, water-repellant powder. They are most prominent when it is raining, but they will scatter and hide at the sight of lightning or the sound of thunder.

entry: POKENAME黏在冰川底部，将那里据为己有。它十分骄傲，能察觉冰川附近其他同类的存在，再从核心喷出成团闪亮泡泡，将它们赶走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sticks to the underside of glaciers, claiming it as its own. Highly prideful, it can sense the presence of other POKENAME near its glacier, and drives them off with plumes of sparkling bubbles shot from its core.

entry: POKENAME一边优雅起舞，一边从鳍中喷水。动作越快，水压就越高，让表演既优美又危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dances gracefully while blasting water from its fins. The faster it moves, the higher the pressure, making its performances both elegant and dangerous.

entry: POKENAME用钳子抓住树摇晃，让坚果、树果和水果落下来。若什么也没掉下来，就会把树夹断。不论吃什么，都会先吐泡泡清洗食物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their pincers to grab and shake trees to knock free their nuts, berries, and fruits. If nothing falls from these trees, they will crush the tree in two. They spit bubbles to clean their food before eating it, no matter the type of food.

entry: 据说它戴的“王冠”取自妙蛙花的花朵，但这种宝可梦看起来太弱小，许多人对此存疑。不过，它确实很喜欢妙蛙花花朵产生的花粉。
author: infinex21
source: Supposedly, the "crown" it wears was acquired from a Venusaur's flower, though many are skeptical of this due to how weak this Pokémon appears. It is known, however, to be very fond of the pollen produced by Venusaur flowers.

entry: POKENAME平时慢悠悠地游泳，想快点移动时，就用冰冻光束冻结水面，再沿滑溜的冰面迅速滑行。它愿意载人前往开阔的冷水水域钓鱼，前提是要分它一些渔获。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME swims at a leisurely pace, but to move fast will freeze water with Ice Beam and then swiftly slide across the slippery surface. It will let people ride it to open, cold water where they can fish, but only if they share their catches.

entry: POKENAME以载人渡水的次数为傲，会向次数较少的同类炫耀。有时甚至会为了争着载需要帮助的乘客而打架。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME takes pride in the number of times they've helped ferry humans across water, flaunting their count over others with lower numbers. They sometimes even fight over which of them will get to carry a passenger in need.

entry: 这些宝可梦吐的泡泡裹着油质唾液，能一直保持完整，直到被外力戳破。它们游泳时爱用泡泡表演，因此很受人类孩子和年幼宝可梦欢迎。
author: infinex21
source: The bubbles spat out by these Pokémon are coated in their oily saliva, which allows them to last until forcefully popped. They are popular with young humans and young Pokémon for how they love to perform tricks with their bubbles while swimming.

entry: POKENAME以凉爽丰润的皮毛和对皮毛的自豪感而闻名。毛中含有滑溜的油脂，能帮助调节体温，但过热时油脂就会起泡。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are known for their cool, luscious fur and the pride they carry over their own fur. Their fur is laced with a slick oil that helps them to regulate their temperature, though it will foam and bubble when they get extremely hot.

entry: POKENAME在电脑桌面上休息时，喜欢吹泡泡，把屏幕填满。大多数训练家会陪它玩，比比自己能多快戳破这些泡泡。
author: sk372
source: While it rests on a desktop screen, POKENAME likes to blow bubbles and fill the screen up. Most Trainers will play with it by seeing how quickly they can pop its bubbles.

entry: 它偏爱生活在寒冷地区的水中。刚蜕皮时摸起来暖暖的，但只要潜一次水，就能恢复理想体温。
author: ichosuzu
source: It prefers to live in the water of cold areas. It feels warm to the touch right after shedding its skin, but one dive into the water will bring it back to its ideal temperature.

entry: POKENAME走路时经常摔倒，为了不出丑，就一直飘浮着。它们自尊心极强，却又常犯让自己大伤自尊的错误。
author: bigoljax
source: Often falling down when trying to walk, POKENAME constantly float so they won't embarrass themselves. They're incredibly prideful, though they often make mistakes that deeply hurt their pride.

entry: POKENAME用叶子吸收阳光，并将叶子浸入水中，只靠这两样就能获得所需养分。夏日阳光最明亮、最灼热时，它们会用自己的叶子遮阳。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME absorb sunlight through their leaves and dip their leaves into water, which is all they collectively need to stay nourished. During summer, when the sun is shining at its brightest and hottest, these Pokémon use their own leaves for shade.

entry: 虽然它生活在更靠内陆的湖泊和河流附近，叶子却散发着海洋气息。自卫时会吐出压缩的泡泡，还能挥动叶子，让泡泡射得更快。
author: infinex21
source: Its leaf exudes the scent of the ocean, even though this Pokémon lives further inland near lakes and rivers. To defend itself, it will spit compressed bubbles, which it can launch even quicker by swinging its leaf about.

entry: POKENAME会在苔原灌木中寻找虫宝可梦，踢起泥土，把猎物赶到空旷处。初夏，它们开始育雏时，成群的个体会挤满苔原村落。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME searches for bug Pokémon in tundra shrubs, kicking up dirt to drive prey into the open. Flocks of these Pokémon crowd tundra villages during the early summer as POKENAME parents begin raising their young.

entry: POKENAME对自己织的网极为自豪，别的宝可梦哪怕弄断一根丝，它都会生气。猎物在网上挣扎时，有时反倒会把它晃落。
author: soup1900
source: Extremely proud of the webs it creates, POKENAME gets upset when another Pokémon breaks even a strand of its webbing. The shaking of its prey in the web will sometimes cause this Pokémon to slip off.

entry: POKENAME在海边因偷抢食物而臭名昭著，却从不接受施舍，连主动奉上的食物也不要。它不爱战斗，野生个体会吐出成团泡泡掩护逃跑，而非迎战。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are infamous at seaside locales due to their habit of stealing food from others; handouts, or even offerings, are never accepted. They dislike battling, and wild POKENAME will spit plumes of bubbles to cover their escape rather than fight.

entry: POKENAME自尊心极强，哪怕饥饿，也只捕食自己堂堂正正击败的宝可梦。它会先吐大量泡泡迷惑敌人，再用利爪抓击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are so prideful that, even if hungry, they will not prey upon any Pokémon but those they beat fair and square. They will spit many bubbles to confuse their foes before swiping at them with their sharp talons.

entry: POKENAME精力旺盛，经常跑着跑着就绊倒，随之释放电力。虽然常常失误，自尊心却极强，所以几乎不接受任何人的帮助。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are energetic Pokémon that often stumble while they run about, which causes them to discharge their electricity. They are extremely prideful despite their failings, so they seldom accept any help from anyone.

entry: POKENAME常彼此比试，看谁能借栖居冰山的冰坡把自己弹得最远。由于身体轻，经常能被风带着飘出数英里，才落入海中。
author: joeofthealps
source: POKENAME often compete with one another to see who can use the icy slopes of the icebergs they live on to launch themselves farthest. Due to their light weight, they can often be carried by the winds for miles before falling into the ocean.

entry: 这种宝可梦会自豪地将欣赏它的人所怀的关爱化作能量。蛋壳让它走起路来很困难。
author: lydiaprower8
source: This Pokémon proudly takes the feelings of compassion from people who appreciate it and use it as its energy. Its eggshell makes it hard to walk.

entry: 这种宝可梦会自豪地将欣赏它的人所怀的关爱化作能量。蛋壳让它走起路来很困难。
author: lydiaprower8
source: This Pokémon proudly takes the feelings of compassion from people who appreciate it and use it as its energy. Its eggshell makes it hard to walk.

entry: POKENAME感知到附近的喜悦时，喙会泛起金光。它在空中盘旋起舞，画出宽阔的螺旋，每次振翅都传递着温暖。
author: .izik
source: When it senses joy nearby, POKENAME's beak glows gold. It dances through the sky in wide spirals, spreading warmth with each beat of its wings.

entry: 它头上的羽毛覆有一层光亮的防水薄膜。羽毛的光泽让它无比自豪，在许多其他生灵眼中也很迷人。
author: infinex21
source: Its head feathers are covered in a glossy, waterproof film. The shine of its head feathers is a source of immense pride to itself and an alluring sight to many others.

entry: 冬季，POKENAME会成群聚集，挤在水中相互依偎。研究者发现，它们聚在一起散发的体热，会使周边水温比更远处高出几度。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Flocks of POKENAME gather during the winter months and huddle together in the water. Researchers have found that the collective body temperature of the POKENAME keeps the water temperature around them a few degrees higher than the surrounding water.

entry: POKENAME用喙刮食珊瑚上的藻类。吃下的珊瑚会经消化，变成细白沙排出体外。其余养分都由背上发育中的球茎获取，球茎与它一同稳步生长。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME scrape off algae that grows on coral with their beaks, with any consumed coral being digested and excreted as a fine, white sand. All other nutrients are gained through the developing bulbs on their backs, which grow as steadily as they do.

entry: 野生POKENAME经常走进花园和农田，用藤蔓吸收土中的部分水分与养分。它们讨厌受人帮助，谁给它们的球茎浇水，就会受到攻击，哪怕只是无意为之。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME have often wandered into gardens and farm fields, using vines to absorb some of the nutrients and water in the soil. They hate to receive help and will lash out at any person or Pokémon who waters their bulbs, even if done accidentally.

entry: POKENAME会把见过的字母刻进冰里。人们一度以为刻痕留下了密码信息，后来才确定完全是随机排列。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME carves letters it has seen into ice. Its carvings were once thought to leave coded messages, but they have since been determined to be completely random.

entry: POKENAME骄傲又好斗，常毫无预警地挑起争斗。不过，也有人见到它在自以为无人注视时，开心地踩着水坑玩。
author: gnom3
source: POKENAME are very proud and aggressive, often starting fights with no warning. Despite their combative nature, they've been observed gleefully splashing in puddles when they think no one's watching.

entry: POKENAME以没礼貌闻名，会囤积喜欢的食物，拒绝分享。虽然愿意为食物打架，自尊心却十分脆弱，一旦落败就会大发脾气，累了便闷闷不乐。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are notoriously ill-mannered, as they hoard their liked foods and refuse to share with others. Even though they are willing to fight over food, their pride is so fragile that if beaten, they will throw a tantrum and sulk when tired.

entry: POKENAME用冰冷的利爪划伤敌人后，会紧接着猛烈啄击。它持续精准进攻，直到目标倒下。
author: .izik
source: After slashing foes with its icy claws, POKENAME follows up with vicious pecks. It attacks with unrelenting precision until its target falls.

entry: POKENAME很容易长出脂肪，让身体成为天然的缓冲垫，轻微跌落也不易受伤。虽然努力独立，却常惹上麻烦，需要父母来救。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME easily builds on fat, which allows its body to become a natural shock absorber; POKENAME becomes easily unharmed by small falls. Although POKENAME strives for independence, it often gets into trouble and needs to be rescued by its parents.

entry: 这种颜色的POKENAME极其自负，几乎不把其他宝可梦当作威胁，直到为时已晚。若有东西把尘土或污垢弄进羽毛，它们就会发出刺耳尖叫。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME with this color are so full of themselves that they barely perceive other Pokémon as threats until it is too late. If anything gets dirt or grime in their feathers, they will emit ear-splitting shrieks.

entry: POKENAME平时不太留意四周。野生个体虽讨厌接受训练家投喂，却必须靠这些赠食才能活下去。
author: dodoowner_
source: This Pokémon is usually oblivious to its surroundings. Although wild POKENAME hate accepting food from Trainers, they need their gifts to survive.

entry: POKENAME从喙中喷出凌厉的飞雪。它虽小，却能接连发动冰霜攻击，让天敌冷彻骨髓。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires sharp blasts of snow from its beak. Though small, it can chill predators to the bone with relentless frost-based attacks.

entry: POKENAME像滑冰者一样滑过结冰的湖面，用口袋般的尾巴保持平衡。它会收集亮晶晶的东西储存起来，原因不明。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME glides across frozen lakes like a skater, using its sack-like tail to balance. It collects shiny objects to store for reasons unknown.

entry: POKENAME会趴着滑过冰面，试着撞倒朋友来玩耍。发现危险时，就摇动尾尖提醒群体，一起应对威胁。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME plays by sliding across ice on its belly in an attempt to knock its friends over. When it spots danger, it shakes the end of its tail to alert the group so they can team up on the threat.

entry: POKENAME在办公室里滑来滑去，收集待发送的文件，帮上班族处理传真。有它们帮忙，工作人员就能少花点时间回想传真机怎么用，专心做其他事。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME help office workers take care of fax documents by sliding around office spaces to collect documents to send. With their help, workers can spend less time trying to remember how fax machines work and more time on other tasks.

entry: POKENAME很爱表现，时时都想成为焦点。别的宝可梦受到关注时，它会嫉妒，甚至不惜搅乱对战，好显得自己更出色。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are dramatic creatures that want to remain in the spotlight at all times. They get jealous when another Pokémon receives attention and are not beyond sabotaging battles to make themselves seem better.

entry: 受到攻击时，POKENAME会亮出颈部皮膜内的假脸吓唬对手，趁机用大蛇瞪眼使其麻痹。皮膜花纹像各种不同的表情，收藏者会互相交换，寻找最喜欢的样式。
author: pjporwoll
source: When attacked, POKENAME flashes the false face inside its hood to startle opponents, giving it an opening to paralyze them with a Glare. The pattern on the hood can resemble many expressions, so collectors will swap for their favorites.

entry: POKENAME高傲得不肯开口索取，训练家得先送上闪亮的东西，它才肯吃树果、喝泥水。只有吃得饱饱的，它才会睡觉。
author: beatdoof
source: Too haughty and proud to ask for anything, POKENAME can only be fed berries and muddy water after its Trainer gives it shiny items. POKENAME only sleeps after it stuffs itself with food.

entry: 据说POKENAME一哭，所在地区第二天就会下雨。它通常举止得体，却又记仇得像个孩子，可能恶作剧捉弄或啄击得罪自己的人。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is said that when POKENAME cries, rain will come to the area the next day. While usually well-mannered, it has a vengeful but childish attitude and may prank or peck at someone who wrongs it.

entry: POKENAME聚居生活，与其他宝可梦挤在一起保暖。它会给一块闪亮石头保温，确保进化时已掌握照护蛋所需的本领。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live in colonies where they huddle together with other Pokémon to keep warm. They keep a shiny rock warm to ensure they have developed the skills needed to protect eggs by the time they evolve.

entry: POKENAME会放电赶走其他生灵，甚至只为拒绝帮助、维护自尊。它很聪明，不会冒险爬高，而是迅速吐泡泡击落树果，美餐一顿。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME will repel others with electric bolts, even for the sake of rejecting assistance due to their pride. They are clever Pokémon that, rather than risk climbing, will shoot quick bubbles to knock down berries to feast upon.

entry: POKENAME住在极地。暴风雪来袭时，会紧紧蜷成球保存体热，让猛烈的冰雹弹开而不受伤。它十分上镜，野生动物摄影集里常有它的身影。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME lives in polar regions. When snowstorms blow overhead, they curl up tightly into a ball to conserve body heat and let the blistering hail bounce off harmlessly. Wildlife photography books often include POKENAME as they are very photogenic.

entry: POKENAME在结冰的湖上睡觉时，身体会被冰包裹。做梦时，喙会泛起微弱黄光，释放让人平静的脉动。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body encases itself in ice as it sleeps on frozen lakes. While dreaming, its beak glows faintly yellow, releasing calming pulses.

entry: POKENAME走路时常失去平衡，但带钩的脚能让它不至于摔趴在地。即使面对高大可怕的对手，战斗时也依然骄傲自信。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME often loses balance when walking, but its hooked feet save it from falling flat onto the ground. Even when facing a large, scary opponent, POKENAME will remain prideful and confident in battle.

entry: POKENAME脚上有小钩，在冰面走路也不会滑倒；尽管如此，它仍喜欢趴着滑行。它自尊心极强，经常因此与其他生灵较量。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have small hooks along their feet that allow them to not slip while walking on ice; despite this, they do love to slide along their bellies. They are highly prideful, so they often end up competing with others.

entry: POKENAME用强健双腿从一块浮冰跃向另一块。头上尖锐修长的羽毛能破开冰层，让它进入下方海水，捕食鱼宝可梦。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME uses its powerful legs to leap from ice floe to ice floe. The sharp, elongated feather on its head is useful for breaking apart sheets of ice so it can reach the ocean below, where it hunts for fish Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME精力旺盛，常跑着跑着就摔倒。它情绪容易激动，跌倒后会立刻朝周围的人或东西高速喷出滚烫泡泡，大发脾气。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are incredibly energetic Pokémon that often trip as they run around. Their excitability causes them to be quick to lash out with scalding, fast-launched bubbles at anything or anyone around them after they have fallen.

entry: 即使靠近看，也常有人把它认成火稚鸡，让它得以混进火稚鸡群，偷吃一些食物。不过，它开心时会吐温热泡泡，往往因此露馅。
author: infinex21
source: It is often mistaken for a Torchic, even up close, which allows it to blend in with flocks of Torchic and steal some of their food. What usually causes its identity to be revealed is that it will spit out warm bubbles when it is happy.

entry: POKENAME在极地结成大群生活。暴风雪来袭时，会背朝外挤在一起，形成抵挡寒风的屏障。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME live in large colonies in polar regions. When snowstorms arrive, they huddle together with their backs facing outward to form a barrier against the freezing winds.

entry: 每只POKENAME都有独特叫声，能在群体中找到自己的伴侣。一方照料蛋、另一方外出觅食时，这点尤为重要。它们偏爱自己寻找食物。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Each POKENAME have a unique call they use to locate their respective partner amongst their flock. This is important when one POKENAME is looking after the pair's egg and the other is getting food. These Pokémon prefer finding their own meals.

entry: POKENAME会吹泥泡泡打招呼。它很友善，会向其他生灵泼泥水、甩泥巴表示友好，却不知道对方未必领情。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME blows muddy bubbles as a form of greeting. A friendly sort, it splashes muddy water and flings mud at others as a sign of friendship, unaware that others might not take it as such.

entry: 鲜有什么比在泥水坑里扑腾更让POKENAME开心。令许多训练家头疼的是，刚洗干净，它几乎立刻又跑出去玩，弄得一身脏。
author: sk372
source: There's little POKENAME enjoys more than splashing about in mud puddles. To many a Trainer's chagrin, any cleaning sessions are almost immediately followed by it going out to play and get dirty again.

entry: POKENAME通过头上的鳍吸收阳光，净化体内的水。它喜欢边睡边做，梦中还会轻轻啾鸣。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME absorbs sunlight through the fins on its head to purify the water within its body. It prefers to do this while sleeping, letting out quiet cheeps as it dreams.

entry: POKENAME开心地在结冰湖面滑行，用精神力加快速度。快摔倒时，就用念力把自己重新扶正。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME skates happily on frozen lakes, using its psychic powers to increase its speed. If it begins to fall, it uses telekinesis to prop itself upright again.

entry: POKENAME很骄傲，常为食物与伴侣相互争斗。它们用尾巴裹住蛋保暖，蛋还能变换色泽，通常不会被天敌发现。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are a prideful species that often compete with each other over food and mates. To keep their eggs warm, POKENAME wrap their tails around them; POKENAME eggs have hue-shifting properties, so they usually go unnoticed by predators.

entry: 这种宝可梦用喙啄开坚果和硬果，也会刮食岩石或树上的苔藓。它在平缓的溪流河水中悠闲休息，身体完全没入水中，球茎和叶子则露在水面上。
author: infinex21
source: This Pokémon uses its beak to break open nuts & hard fruits and to scrape away at moss on rocks or trees. It lounges in gentle streams and rivers with its bulb and leaves above water, while its body is fully submerged.

entry: POKENAME的花朵会产生特殊汁液，混入水中就能形成通常不会自行破裂的泡泡。唾液也有类似性质，让它能向敌人吐泡泡。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME flowers produce a special sap that, when mixed with water, will give form to bubbles that typically last until they are popped. Their saliva has a similar property, which allows POKENAME to spit bubbles at their foes.

entry: POKENAME自尊心太强，不肯接受别人的食物，甚至连不费吹灰之力就掉下来的食物也可能不理。但它一转过身，巨颚就会把食物吃掉。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are too proud to accept food from others and may even ignore food that has fallen without any effort made by themselves. Their large jaws, however, will eat up food while POKENAME have their backs turned.

entry: 许多POKENAME的骨骸最初发现于一座城堡的遗迹。它们当时究竟是囚徒、宠物还是家畜，学界至今仍有争论。它们善游泳、会狩猎，如今被用于捕鱼。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The bones of many POKENAME were first discovered in the ruins of a castle, and there remains scholarly debate as to whether they were kept as prisoners, pets, or livestock. They are proficient swimmers and hunters and are now used to catch fish.

entry: POKENAME能控制角上吹出的泡泡形状，传递灾难将至的信号。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME sends signals of impending disaster by controlling the shapes of the bubbles blown from its horn.

entry: POKENAME高傲而易怒，会以压倒性的激流审判得罪它的对象。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME features a prideful and wrathful personality. It judges those who wrong it with an overwhelming torrent of water.

entry: POKENAME躺在浅池中，张大嘴巴，尽可能多喝水。喝得越多，嫩芽就长得越结实、越长。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lies in shallow ponds with its mouth wide open to drink as much water as possible. The more it drinks, the sturdier and longer its sprout grows.

entry: POKENAME燃烧的尾巴能帮助它在潜入冰水时保持体温。但入水后火焰就会熄灭，过一段有限的时间，寒冷便会开始影响它的动作。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's burning tail helps this Pokémon maintain its body heat when diving into icy waters. While in the water, the flame is extinguished, leaving POKENAME with a limited amount of time before the cold starts to affect its movements.

entry: POKENAME不信任其他生灵，遇到新事物总会摆出防御姿态。它将尾火举在身前，再吹出泡泡，让泡泡穿过火焰后点燃，化作燃烧的弹丸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is distrustful of others, always going on the defensive when faced with something new. It holds its tail-flame in front of it before blowing bubbles, which ignite after passing through and become flaming projectiles.

entry: POKENAME会在海底地热喷口附近休息，享受暖意。它经常在那里睡着，一边打鼾一边抽动尾巴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lounges on ocean floors near geothermal vents, enjoying the heat. It frequently falls asleep near these vents, its tail twitching as it snores.

entry: POKENAME多了一层皮毛，能更好地抵御极寒。它大半时间都在极地冰面上流畅地滑行、滑冰，以此消遣。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has gained an extra fur coat that helps further protect it from extreme cold temperatures. It spends much of its time smoothly gliding and skating across polar ice as a form of recreation.

entry: 它有着成年个体的身躯，心智却仍像刚孵化的幼体。成熟之前，可能会危及自身及周围的生命。
author: krune
source: With the mind of a hatchling but body of an adult, this creature can be a danger to itself and others until it matures.

entry: POKENAME体内厚实的脂肪能让它在寒冷气候中保暖。它们似乎天生就想抵达这颗星球的北磁极，冬季有许多个体会试着渡海前往。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have bodies of dense fat, which keeps them warm in colder climates. They all seem to have an innate desire to reach the northern magnetic pole of our planet; during winter, many POKENAME attempt to traverse the sea to reach this pole.

entry: POKENAME飘过冰原，寻找冰中的杂质，用磁性鼻子取出发现的碎屑。它对家园的整洁一丝不苟，以脚下洁净的冰为傲。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME float across ice sheets in search of impurities in the ice, using their magnetic nose to extract any debris they find. They are fastidious in taking care of their home, taking great pride in having pristine ice beneath them.

entry: POKENAME平时温和，只捕小鱼。可一受善待，就觉得对方在挑战自己的本领，随即发起攻击。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is usually passive, hunting only small fish. However, when shown any kindness, it takes it as a challenge of its abilities and attacks.

entry: 北方地区的POKENAME通常聚集在高原附近。据说递给它一块煎蛋卷，即使气候再寒冷，它也会释放令人舒心的气息。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME from northern regions typically gather around plateaus. It is said that presenting one with a piece of omelet will prompt it to release a soothing aura even in the coldest climates.

entry: POKENAME讨厌脏污，会用泡泡擦洗任何表面，直到一尘不染。泡泡含有特殊化学物质，能有效杀菌。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hates dirt and will scrub any surface with its bubbles until it's squeaky clean. The bubbles contain a unique chemical that effectively kills germs.

entry: POKENAME兴奋时，会从头上的菇帽喷出泡泡。战斗时，大量泡泡能遮住对手的视线。
author: dualblades1147
source: When excited, POKENAME sprays bubbles from the cap on its head. During a fight, the amount of bubbles created can blind opponents.

entry: POKENAME的身体是一台以等离子体驱动的洗衣机。它相当挑剔，太脏的东西一概拒洗。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's body is a washing machine powered by plasma. It's quite finicky, and will refuse to wash anything overly soiled.

entry: 面对敌人时，POKENAME会努力装得冷傲、严肃而高人一等，但和亲密朋友相处时，却相当爱玩。
author: bobosmith01
source: It tries to emulate an aloof, serious, and superior personality when it faces a foe, but among close friends, POKENAME is quite playful.

entry: POKENAME决心提升战斗本领，帮助训练家。它想独占训练家的大量关注，对其他训练家近乎敌视。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are determined to improve their fighting abilities to be useful for their Trainer. They are borderline hostile to other Trainers because they want lots of attention from their Trainer.

entry: POKENAME在冰海的冰山之间弹跳，既能快速移动，也能玩乐。不同群体经过同一片地区时，许多都会相互比较弹跳的方式。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME bounces between icebergs in icy seas to travel quickly and have fun. Many pods will compare bouncing patterns with one another as they move through the same areas.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴来回摆得越快，体内积聚的水压就越高。压力达到最大时，会向敌人喷出足以在混凝土上冲出凹痕的激流。
author: .izik
source: The faster POKENAME waves its tail back and forth, the more water pressure builds within its body. At maximum pressure it unleashes a torrent at the foe with enough force to dent concrete.

entry: POKENAME一边摆尾，一边屈伸双腿，提高攻击的水压。压力强时，甚至能在混凝土墙上留下凹痕。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME builds up water pressure in its attacks by wagging its tail while bending and straightening its legs. The pressure of those attacks can be powerful enough to leave a dent in a concrete wall.

entry: POKENAME一边摆尾，一边屈伸双腿，提高攻击的水压。压力强时，甚至能在混凝土墙上留下凹痕。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME builds up water pressure in its attacks by wagging its tail while bending and straightening its legs. The pressure of those attacks can be powerful enough to leave a dent in a concrete wall.

entry: POKENAME一边摆尾，一边屈伸双腿，提高攻击的水压。压力强时，甚至能在混凝土墙上留下凹痕。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME builds up water pressure in its attacks by wagging its tail while bending and straightening its legs. The pressure of those attacks can be powerful enough to leave a dent in a concrete wall.

entry: POKENAME天性骄傲，狩猎时只信任同群伙伴。它们通过尾巴传递电力，确保水下追逐中没有成员掉队。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Prideful by nature, POKENAME trust only their packmates during a hunt. They exchange electricity through their tails, ensuring no member of the pack falls behind during an underwater chase.

entry: POKENAME以铠甲钢铁般洁净闪亮为傲，谁将它弄脏，就会让它勃然大怒。身体虽重，游泳本领却很好。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME take immense pride in keeping their steel-like armor clean and shiny, and they become furious if anyone dirties them. Despite how heavy they are, they are very capable swimmers.

entry: POKENAME用幻觉装成年幼宝可梦或人类孩子，骗其他生灵给它食物。除非觉得是靠自己的骗术挣来的，否则什么也不肯接受。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME use illusions to disguise themselves as young Pokémon or as human children, to trick others into feeding them. They won't accept anything unless they feel they have earned it through deception.

entry: POKENAME既固执又骄傲，新手训练家几乎无法养好。能赢得它的尊重，被视为领导能力的证明。
author: craigprime
source: A combination of stubbornness and pride makes POKENAME nearly impossible for rookie Trainers to raise. Earning the respect of one is seen as a testament to a person's leadership skills.

entry: POKENAME夜里睡在池水下面。月光格外明亮时，会将蓝色球茎举出水面，朝向天空。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps beneath pond surfaces at night. Should the moon be exceptionally bright, it will raise its blue bulb above the water toward the sky.

entry: POKENAME的花朵能排出空气，借花中独特的汁液吹出泡泡。这种汁液遇水摩擦就容易起沫，常被用于清洁用品。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's flowers are uniquely capable of expelling air, which it uses to create bubbles from its flowers' special sap. The sap of its flowers is quick to froth with water and friction applied, so it is commonly used in cleaning products.

entry: POKENAME需要飘得更高时，就会开始吹泡泡。飘得太高了，又会一个个戳破，直到高度合意。
author: periperi_chicken
source: When POKENAME needs to float higher, it will begin to blow bubbles. If it gets too high, it will pop them one by one until it is happy with its position.

entry: 这是古代文明制造的机关人偶，据推测是为了探索极地、研究那里的环境与生物。POKENAME伪装成波加曼，得以混入野生波加曼之中。
author: arcul
source: An automaton made by an ancient civilization, it is speculated its purpose was to explore and study arctic landscapes and its inhabitants. POKENAME's disguise as a Piplup allows it to blend in with wild Piplup.

entry: POKENAME极其骄傲，别人向它求助时，它常会发怒。厚实绒羽与核心体温能保护它抵御寒冷。
author: lydiaprower8
source: A very prideful Pokémon, POKENAME often gets aggressive when it gets asked for help. Its thick down and core temperature protect it from the cold.

entry: POKENAME很笨拙，挖掘对它十分困难。其他宝可梦会出于同情送它一些水晶，但它太骄傲，不肯接受。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME is clumsy and finds great difficulty in digging. Other Pokémon will offer it some of their crystals out of pity, but it is much too proud to accept.

entry: POKENAME在茂密森林中，用喙吃坚硬的树果与小型虫宝可梦。受到威胁时，唾液会变得有毒，并混入水系攻击中。
author: gamblebreaker
source: POKENAME uses its beak to eat tough berries and small Bug Pokémon in dense forest areas. When threatened, its saliva can become toxic and incorporated into its water attacks.

entry: POKENAME把自己裹得严严实实，防止体内的凉意过快散失。没了披衣，即使只是待在室温环境，也很快会过热。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME bundles itself up to keep its cool body temperature from dissipating too quickly. Without its cloak, even just being in room temperature surroundings would lead to overheating before long.

entry: 闯入POKENAME冰窟的对象会遭到不停啄击，直到入侵者逃走，它才肯停下。
author: .izik
source: Trespassers in POKENAME's icy den are met with relentless pecking. It won't stop until the intruder flees.

entry: 召来暴风雪前，POKENAME金色的喙会开始发光。这些风雪来得突然且猛烈，经常在筑巢地周围形成。
author: .izik
source: Before calling blizzards, POKENAME's golden beak begins to glow. These storms are sudden and fierce, often forming around its nesting grounds.

entry: POKENAME虽是植物，却能在最寒冷的环境存活，也是生态巨蛋中炎兔儿喜爱的零食。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME, although a plant, can survive the coldest environments. It's a popular snack for Scorbunny living in the Terarium.

entry: POKENAME大多时间待在冰冷水中，但也能见到它乘着轻柔海风滑翔。鳍肢上蓬松的绒羽能帮助调节体温。
author: mepp.
source: Though POKENAME spends most of its time in icy waters, it can be seen gliding on gentle sea breezes. The fluffy down on its flippers help regulate its body temperature.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，会在吐出的泡泡之间优雅跳跃，小心不弄破任何一个。许多人练习模仿它的优雅，成果却各不相同。
author: .izik
source: While dancing, POKENAME hops gracefully between the bubbles it spits, careful not to pop a single one. Many have trained to imitate its elegance with varying levels of success.

entry: POKENAME像导弹般冲过海洋，用喙刺穿船只使其沉没，再将落难船员当作猎物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME surges through the ocean like a missile. It pierces ships with its beak to sink them and targets stranded sailors as prey.

entry: 这种古怪的POKENAME流出的口水与鼻涕带有奇异病原体，会感染其他宝可梦，使其中毒。有些同行的训练家表示，类似感冒的症状出现得更频繁了。
author: blake
source: The drool and snot from this odd POKENAME carry a strange pathogen that infects and poisons other Pokémon. Some Trainers traveling with it report higher occurrences of cold-like symptoms.

entry: POKENAME在冰封湖面滑行时，耳朵会发出手风琴般的响亮声音。许多人聚来观赏，但它滑得越久，声音就越刺耳难听，让人待不了多久。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lets out loud accordion-like noises from its ears while skating across frozen lakes. Many gather to watch these displays, but the longer it skates, the more grating and unpleasant the sounds become, keeping visits brief.

entry: 野生POKENAME空闲时，会在苔原的浮冰上与海豹球赛跑。等它累了，就能安全采下身上的蘑菇，烹煮后会散发甜甜的香草风味。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Wild POKENAME spend their free time racing Spheal along ice floes in tundras. Their mushrooms can be safely harvested after they tire themselves out and cooked to bring out a sweet vanilla flavor.

entry: POKENAME结成小群，穿越冰封苔原，寻找下一个捕鱼地点。它是冰钓者的好伙伴，长颈与长喙能帮助捕到冰下的鱼。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in small herds, traveling across the frozen tundra to find its next fishing spot. They are great companions for ice fishers, as their long necks and beaks help catch fish from under the ice.

entry: POKENAME脾气坏得出奇，一旦任其自由活动，往往会与对手结下一辈子的仇。光是让它别立刻发起攻击，就需要技巧高超的训练家。
author: ocxin
source: Spectacularly ill-tempered, when POKENAME are loose, they typically swear lifelong grudges against their opponents. It takes a highly skilled trainer to simply stop them from lashing out right away.

entry: POKENAME全身覆有特殊绒羽，即使最冷的冬天也能保暖。它不停梳理羽毛，又生性骄傲，训练家若想帮忙，就会挨啄。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME is covered in a special down that keeps it warm even in the coldest winters. It preens itself constantly and, due to its prideful nature, will peck its Trainer if they try to help.

entry: POKENAME喜欢在开满野花的草地嬉戏。它喷出的水富含养分，能加快野花生长。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME loves to frolic in meadows filled with wildflowers. It sprays a highly nutritious water that accelerates their growth.

entry: POKENAME的壳有许多小孔，下雨时吸水，会变得更重。水能缓冲袭来的打击，因此也让壳更加坚实。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a porous shell that gets heavier when it rains, absorbing water into the small pores. This also makes the shell sturdier, as the water cushions any strikes made against them.

entry: POKENAME不喜欢被求助，宁愿独自做事。它不接受别人给的树枝，所以得先把树枝藏好，让它自己找到。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME dislikes being asked for help, preferring to do things alone. Twigs need to be hidden in places for it to find since it won't accept any twigs if they are given.

entry: POKENAME随身带着柳枝，借此制造随心情变色的泡泡，再将泡泡掷向敌人攻击。
author: .izik
source: The twig POKENAME carries is made of willow. It uses this to create bubbles that shift color based on its mood, hurling them at foes to attack.

entry: POKENAME喜欢用魔杖给训练家表演小把戏。努力若得不到认可，就会沮丧，而且经常拒食。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME love to perform small tricks for their Trainers using their wands. If not recognized for their hard work, they become frustrated and often refuse food.

entry: POKENAME全身覆有特殊绒羽，即使最冷的冬天也能保暖。它不停梳理羽毛，又生性骄傲，训练家若想帮忙，就会挨啄。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME is covered in a special down that keeps it warm even in the coldest winters. It preens itself constantly and, due to its prideful nature, will peck its Trainer if they try to help.

entry: POKENAME身上覆有细密而几乎平贴的防水羽毛。因羽毛颜色漂亮又易清洁，许多婚纱会用它装饰裙边。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is covered in fine, nearly flat waterproof plumage. Many bridal gowns incorporate these feathers along their fringe for their coloring and ease of cleaning.

entry: POKENAME囤积闪亮物品，用来铺巢。两只相遇时，会互相挺胸，展示谁更有威势。胜者可以任意拿走败者的藏品。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME hoard shiny objects and line their nests with them. When two POKENAME meet, they puff their chests out at one another in a dominance display. The winner takes what they want of the loser's hoard.

entry: POKENAME往往还处于学习游泳的阶段。它会趴平身体，在水中踢动鳍肢练习。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are often at a stage where they are still learning how to swim. They practice swimming by lying flat and kicking their flippers in water.

entry: POKENAME靠带蹼的四肢高速游泳。不高兴时，会用喙猛攻，并爆发精神力量，将浮木甩到一旁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims at high speed using webbed limbs. When upset, it lashes out with its beak, flinging driftwood aside with bursts of psychic force.

entry: POKENAME向栖居的冰川喷出火花，熔化表面，形成如玻璃般平滑的冰面。它们在冰上相互赛跑，一边打滑、一边欢快啾鸣。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME breathe embers onto the glaciers they make their home on, melting the surface of the ice and creating a smooth and glassy floor. They race one another across the ice, slipping and sliding whilst chirping happily.

entry: 它从尾尖分泌特殊油脂，遇水会像肥皂一样起泡。发怒时，全身升温也会让油脂起泡，但换作其他方式加热，却不会出现这种现象。
author: infinex21
source: It secretes a special oil from the tip of its tail that foams and bubbles like soap when exposed to water. Its entire body heats up when it is angry, which also causes this oil to foam and bubble; no other application of heat has this result, though.

entry: POKENAME是北极宝可梦，喜欢趴在冰上滑行，也有些爱用背壳滑。它们仰躺后很难爬起来，却绝不接受帮助。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are arctic Pokémon that love to slide across ice on their bellies, though some also enjoy sliding on the backs of their shells. They struggle to get up off their backs, yet they will never accept help.

entry: 两颗头感情很好，却也各有自己的骄傲。食物虽会平分，但只要一颗头试着分给另一颗，两边很快就会吵起来。
author: infinex21
source: Their two heads have a strong bond, but they also have their individual senses of pride. Although their two heads evenly split food between themselves, if either head tries to share food with the other, a fight between them will soon follow.

entry: 每颗头都有独特性格与喜好。不过，它们都一样固执，常因此内讧。
author: cait_sith
source: Each head has a unique personality and set of preferences. However, the one thing they share is their stubbornness, which leads to infighting.

entry: POKENAME很友善，会和任何宝可梦玩，让想捕食它的对象也摸不着头脑。它从结冰水域的冰洞潜入水中，找到鱼多的地方后，就敲冰向伙伴传信。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is friendly and plays with any Pokémon, confusing ones that try to predate it. It dives into ice openings on frozen bodies of water, then taps on the ice to communicate to its companion when it finds a spot where a lot of fish are located.

entry: POKENAME喜欢炫耀，在喙上托着泡泡保持平衡，又在水中跃进跃出。谁想打断表演，就会被它喷出的泡泡流击中。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME loves to show off, balancing bubbles on its beak and leaping in and out of the water. If anyone tries to interrupt its performance, it will blast them with a stream of bubbles.

entry: POKENAME会从喙中产出蓝珍珠。城都各地都用这些珍珠制作项链和耳环。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME produces blue pearls from its beak. These are used in necklaces and earrings throughout the Johto area.

entry: POKENAME的冰壳坚如钢铁，连油轮撞击也能承受。夏天会迁往北极，防止背壳因暑热而变脆弱。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's icy shell is as strong as steel, being able to withstand a strike from a tanker ship. It migrates to the arctic during the summer to avoid its shell weakening from the summer heat.

entry: POKENAME在寒冷地区飘浮，顽皮地用喙吹泡泡砸向其他生灵。泡泡带有少许幽灵能量，被击中的地方会感到异样寒意。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME floats around colder regions, playfully pelting others with bubbles blown from its beak. The bubbles contain a bit of ghostly energy in them, so those hit by the bubbles feel a strange chill where they were impacted.

entry: POKENAME是徘徊在严寒地区、好斗的小幽灵。它用水与冰构成、带有幽灵力量的泡泡攻击遇到的生灵，直到将目标彻底赶出领地才肯停。
author: sk372
source: Aggressive little spirits that haunt frigid areas, POKENAME pelts those it comes across with ghostly bubbles of water and ice. It won't give up the assault until it has properly chased its target out of its territory.

entry: POKENAME从水中抓到鱼后，喜欢绕着战利品，踩着碎步跳胜利舞。有时庆祝得太投入，别的天敌就趁机偷走这顿饭。
author: sk372
source: After snatching up fish from the water, POKENAME enjoys doing a scuttling victory dance around its spoils. Sometimes it gets so into its celebration that another predator manages to sneakily steal the meal.

entry: POKENAME先用钳子紧紧抓住猎物，再从喙中喷出强力水流，将敌人冲到很远的地方。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME grips prey tightly in its claws before unleashing high-powered jets of water from its beak. This results in launching its foes great distances.

entry: POKENAME用身上长的海藻引诱并缠住小型猎物。游泳本领并不受体形所限，至少能在一定程度上逆流前进。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME utilize the seaweed growing upon them to lure and ensnare small prey. Despite their size, they are strong swimmers that can swim against currents to at least some degree.

entry: POKENAME能藏就藏，似乎讨厌接触其他生灵。这与它爱玩的天性十分不合，不过骄傲很快就会压下它的悲伤。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME keep themselves hidden whenever they can, seeming to hate contact with others. This mixes terribly with their playful nature, though their pride quickly pushes down their grief.

entry: 颈边卷起的叶子散发着热带风味的甜香。它挥动叶子，将香气散开，安抚敌人。叶片极其锋利，连已知最硬的坚果和树果都能切开。
author: infinex21
source: A tropical, sweet aroma is exuded from the curled-up leaves around their necks. By waving their leaves, they spread this aroma to soothe enemies. Their leaves are sharp enough to slice through the hardest nuts and berries thus far known.

entry: 即使受到刺激，它的花瓣也会飘出令人舒心的热带香气。它的吐息能让一些死去的植物复生，曾因此遭到利用，从此过着独居生活。
author: infinex21
source: A soothing, tropical aroma wafts from its petals, even when it has been agitated. It lives a solitary life due to its ability to revive some dead plants with its breath, which it was once exploited for.

entry: 繁殖季以外，POKENAME独自生活。两片领地若有重叠，双方就会激烈争斗，直到一方退却，将那部分领地让给胜者。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME live solitary lives outside of breeding season. If two territories overlap, POKENAME will viciously fight until one of them retreats, relinquishing that part of the territory to the victor.

entry: POKENAME双翼的打击能让卡比兽都喘不过气。领地可延伸数英里，它会严密守卫，凶猛御敌。
author: chibitales
source: Strikes from POKENAME's wings can knock the wind out of a Snorlax. Its territory can span several miles and is defended with fierce diligence.

entry: POKENAME的气泡触角会发光，在深水的幽暗处引路。有些宝可梦会跟在后面，循光而行。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME produce lights from their bubble antenna that guide them in the darker parts of deep waters. Some Pokémon follow them around the waters as a trail of light.

entry: POKENAME的球茎通过光合作用产生富氧泡泡，被许多水生宝可梦视为福音。它似乎也明白这点，因此很自豪。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are considered boons to many other aquatic Pokémon, as they produce oxygen-rich bubbles from their bulbs through photosynthesis. They seem to be aware of this and are quite prideful as a result.

entry: POKENAME的球茎一天天长大，肌肉也日益结实，常互相较量谁最强壮。它们骄傲得惊人，败者甚至会羞愧得自行离群。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME grow remarkably dense with muscle as their bulbs grow with every day and often compete with one another to see who is strongest. They are horrifically prideful, to the point that whichever one loses will leave its pack due to its own shame.

entry: POKENAME独居，在北方冰冷海滩上空高处狩猎。俯冲向猎物时，尖叫声几英里外都能听见，连老练的水手也会不安。
author: gnom3
source: Living in solitude, POKENAME hunts high in the air above icy northern beaches. When it dives towards its prey, its screech can be heard miles away, unsettling even seasoned sailors.

entry: POKENAME太过以自我为中心，无法与其他生灵同住，连同类也不行。两只一旦相遇，就会角抵着角开战，完全不顾造成的破坏。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are too self-centered to live with others, even those of their species. If two POKENAME ever meet, they will cross horns and battle with no regard to the damage they cause.

entry: 有些没有火山、也不见熔岩虫踪迹的岛屿上，同样能找到POKENAME。人们认为，它们在火山喷发后迁入新形成的陆地，后来海平面上升，才使这些陆地变成遥远的岛屿。
author: bobosmith01
source: There are POKENAME found on islands that do not have volcanoes or any sign of Slugma. It is thought these Pokémon migrated to the newly formed land after a volcanic eruption and rising sea levels turned these formations into distant islands.

entry: POKENAME不合群，会喷出高度密集、速度极快的泡泡流，赶走身边的其他生灵。在野外，它会挑选铁炮鱼和弱丁鱼群捕食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is antisocial and dispatches nearby company by blowing a stream of highly concentrated fast-moving bubbles. It picks and preys on schools of Remoraid and Wishiwashi in the wild.

entry: POKENAME只有在阳光照进冰窟、将它暖热后才会出洞。它以用不融冰加固巢穴为傲，这也是同类间地位的象征。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME only emerges from its icy den when the sun shines through and warms it up. It takes pride in reinforcing its den with Never-Melt Ice, which is a mark of status among the species.

entry: POKENAME睡在河边芦苇丛中，身体质感与植物几乎一模一样。入水后，身体又会变得极其光滑，以尽量提高游速。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sleeps within reeds at the edge of rivers, perfectly mimicking their plant-like texture. Once it enters the water, its body becomes incredibly smooth to maximize swimming speed.

entry: POKENAME乐于把自己做的咸味土豆零食分给饥饿的对象。这种零食相当让人上瘾，多数人一吃就难以停下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME happily shares a salty potato snack it creates with those who are hungry. The snack is rather addictive, so most who begin eating find it hard to stop.

entry: POKENAME会张开颈部皮膜，吓走占着心仪巢穴的宝可梦。若被对手羞辱，它就会记仇，不断谋划，直到能加倍报复、挽回自尊。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME flares its hood to intimidate other Pokémon from a den it desires. It will hold a grudge if shamed by a rival and will plot until it can avenge its pride twofold.

entry: POKENAME其实比波皇子合群得多，会结队帮忙采树果、寻找泥水来源等，尤其会照顾即将进入蛹期的伙伴。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME is actually far more social compared to a Prinplup, forming waddles to aid others with tasks such as gathering berries or searching for sources of muddy water, specifically to assist those entering a pupal state.

entry: 随着蛹期推进，POKENAME的身体会变得更透明，如同清水。到那时，它就会前往外海，飘浮着等待合适的时机。
author: beatdoof
source: As it progresses through its pupal stage, POKENAME's body becomes more translucent like clear water. When it does, it will head out to the open sea, floating and waiting for the right time.

entry: POKENAME因自视甚高而独居，但也有人见它留下食物，帮助其他种类的宝可梦。它甚至会用电将硬树果烤软，好让幼年宝可梦吃。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live solitary lives due to their immense egos, yet they have been known to help Pokémon of other species by leaving food for them. They will go so far as to use their electricity to roast hard berries and make them tender for young Pokémon.

entry: 它摩擦脸颊产生静电，再将电力储存在体内。因为能储存大量电力，它自认比许多生灵都更优越。
author: infinex21
source: It generates a static charge by rubbing its cheeks, the power of which it will store within itself. It believes itself to be superior to many due to how much power it can store within itself.

entry: POKENAME独居在北方针叶林的树上及树木周围。虽不会对同类动粗，但相遇时经常会流露鄙夷。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live alone, within and around the trees in boreal forests. Though they are not violent with others of their species, they regularly express disdain if they come across each other.
