entry: POKENAME穿过林间空地，寻找受损的树木。它产生的水富含养分，能救活濒死的树。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME travels through glades seeking out trees that are suffering. The water it produces is highly nutritious and can revive a tree on the brink of death.

entry: POKENAME在北方针叶林中游荡，独自狩猎、独自生活。它自认是领地的主人，一受攻击却会惊慌，逃回巢里缩上一阵子。
author: vic1312
source: Prowling boreal forests, POKENAME hunt alone and lead solitary lives. They think themselves the masters of their domain but panic when they get attacked, retreating back to their nest and cowering for a time.

entry: 它用硬喙敲开坚果、压碎水果，喜欢用很热的水清洗食物，洗着洗着就把食物煮得半熟。这或许解释了它为何偏爱某些煮熟后风味更好的坚果与水果。
author: infinex21
source: It uses its hard beak to open nuts and crush up fruits. It has a penchant for cleaning its food with water so hot that the food gets partly cooked in the process. This may be why it prefers certain nuts and fruits that have more flavor when cooked.

entry: POKENAME居住的地方越冷，尖刺摸起来就越硬、越光滑。它们通常独居，远离其他生灵。
author: mr.person__prinplup_enjoyer
source: The colder the area POKENAME live in, the harder and smoother their spikes will feel when touched. They usually live alone, away from others.

entry: POKENAME对自己及战斗风格十分自豪，会相互交锋，证明谁更强。不幸的是，这种天生的骄傲让它们排斥败者，甚至可能彻底抛弃对方。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are very proud of themselves and their fighting styles, to the point they clash with one another to prove which of them is stronger. Unfortunately, this innate pride causes them to shun, and potentially outright abandon, those who lose.

entry: POKENAME独来独往，不肯与其他生灵共用泡澡的水坑。谁敢尝试，就会被它从嘴里喷出的泥水流冲走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a solitary creature, and won't allow any others to share a puddle it's soaking in. It blasts away anyone who tries by spitting out a stream of muddy water from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME认为打断自己泡泥澡极其无礼。谁侵扰它的私人时间，就会不断挨大团泥巴砸，直到不再打扰它。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME does not take kindly to being interrupted while bathing in mud, considering it extremely rude. It will pelt the one intruding on its personal time with large globs of mud until they leave it be.

entry: 每只POKENAME都认为自己的头鳍最漂亮。它们常为这件看似微不足道的事打架。
author: .izik
source: Each POKENAME believes its own head fins to be the most beautiful. They frequently start fights with one another over this seemingly trivial matter.

entry: POKENAME游泳时，会用精神力强化喙。全速前进时，能将冰山干脆地撞成两半。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to reinforce its beak while swimming. At top speed, it can break an iceberg clean in half.

entry: POKENAME轮流照顾幼崽，教它们基本求生本领，并以学得快的孩子为傲。幼崽若与父母走散，就会伪装自己，等待父母回来。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME take turns caring for their young, teaching them basic survival skills, and taking great pride in those who learn quickly. If baby POKENAME become separated from their parents, they camouflage themselves and wait for a parent to return.

entry: POKENAME十分固执，会用底部的爪牢牢卡住地面，怎么也不肯动。身体坚实，让它即使面对很难对付的敌人，也能稳守原地。
author: sk372
source: Highly stubborn, POKENAME will use the claws on its bottom to lodge itself into a surface and refuse to budge. Its sturdy body makes it very adept at standing its ground even against very tough opponents.

entry: POKENAME的楔石像块冰，便于完美伪装，混入波加曼群。饿了就会附身在落单的成员身上，吸取其能量。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME keystones resemble a piece of ice, making for perfect camouflage for blending into a Piplup colony. When POKENAME are hungry, they possess a stray colony member and sap their energy.

entry: POKENAME对战时是强敌，但仍有许多要学。它落败后容易闹情绪，所以训练家会备足零食，安慰它受挫的自尊。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are formidable foes in Pokémon battles but still have a lot to learn. They are known to get upset after losing a battle, so Trainers make sure to stock up on treats to feed their broken egos.

entry: POKENAME独居，在冰川侧面挖洞，谁想靠近都会遭到愤怒的尖叫。它钻入冰层深处觅食，挖出陷坑，让冰川上行走的宝可梦掉进去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live solitary lives, digging holes into the sides of glaciers, angrily squawking at anything that tries to get close to them. They burrow deep into the ice in search of food, digging pitfalls for Pokémon walking above the glacier to fall in.

entry: 花中汁液有肥皂般的性质，却又香甜，吸引着许多宝可梦。POKENAME虽然对它们的到来表现得很不耐烦，却通常还是会让它们搭乘背部。
author: infinex21
source: The sap of their flowers has properties reminiscent of soap, but it is also very aromatic and sweet; thus, it attracts many other Pokémon. POKENAME act annoyed by the presence of Pokémon, yet they typically carry them on their backs nonetheless.

entry: POKENAME独居，与同类处不来。野外相遇时，经常会有一只试着拔掉另一只的羽毛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME live solitary lives and do not get along with others of their kind. Meetings in the wild often consist of one POKENAME attempting to pluck the feathers off the other.

entry: 冰封地区的雪村曾将POKENAME奉为半神。人们会照它的样子雕刻冰像，相信在寒冷季节雕成，就能带来健康。
author: .izik
source: In frozen regions, snowy villages worshipped POKENAME as a demigod. Ice effigies were carved in its likeness, believed to bring health if formed during the cold season.

entry: 它会独自花上数周在体内积水，身体变得极其密实沉重。储水能在干旱时供养头顶的植物数月之久。
author: catsquatch_geography
source: It spends weeks in solitude gathering water within its body, becoming incredibly dense and heavy. The stored water sustains the plant growing atop its head for months during periods of drought.

entry: POKENAME会与同类撞头，争夺优势地位。它更喜欢其他种类的宝可梦作伴，会主动让它们搭乘。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME will butt heads with another for dominance. It prefers the company of Pokémon other than its own kind, offering to give them rides.

entry: POKENAME的壳散出的冷雾，长时间接触能将人的皮肤冻住。许多医生会单独取少量冷雾，短时用于冷冻治疗。
author: .izik
source: The cold mist that emanates from POKENAME's shell can freeze human skin with prolonged exposure. Many doctors use brief isolated bursts of it for cryotherapy.

entry: POKENAME在偏僻的海岸洞穴安家，偏爱独居。尾巴的光会警告其他宝可梦保持距离。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Making its home in secluded coastal caves, POKENAME prefers a life of solitude. The light from its tail serves as a warning to other Pokémon to keep their distance.

entry: POKENAME喜欢独处，训练自己变得更敏捷。谁打断它，就会让它发怒，从尾巴向闯入者喷出大量滚烫泡泡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME likes to live alone in solitude, training itself to be more agile. Interrupting it causes it to lash out, shooting out a multitude of burning-hot bubbles from its tail at whoever intrudes upon it.

entry: POKENAME头上飘出的泡泡充满极热气体。它心念一动就能将泡泡导向敌人，但控制还不熟练，经常打偏。
author: .izik
source: The bubbles drifting from POKENAME's head are filled with an incredibly hot gas. It can redirect them toward foes with a thought, though it lacks perfect control and often misses its mark.

entry: 融合让POKENAME变得极其自负，除非自己是实际上的首领，否则几乎无法与其他生灵合作。野外的对手会不停较量，证明自己比对方更优越。
author: sk372
source: Fusion has given POKENAME a massive ego, rendering it almost incapable of working with others unless it is the de facto leader. Rivals in the wild will never stop competing to prove their superiority over one another.

entry: 这只波皇子自身融合而成的宝可梦，仪表讲究，外貌优雅。可惜，这只会助长它的自负，让它更加相信自己胜过所有其他波皇子。
author: infranscia
source: This dapper self fusion of Prinplup sports a refined appearance.  Unfortunately, this only helps to fuel it's belief that it is better than any other Prinplup.

entry: 自尊心太强，让POKENAME很难结交朋友或找到伴侣。但只要建立了情谊，它就会以性命守护对方。
author: krune
source: POKENAME's pride can cause it to struggle with finding friends or partners, but once it does, it will bond with them and defend them with its life.

entry: POKENAME在热带水域游泳时，触须会展开成桨。在此期间，速度最高可达40节。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feelers expand into paddles while it swims through tropical waters. During this period, it can reach speeds of up to 40 knots.

entry: POKENAME把脱落的羽毛制成兜帽，帮助自己藏在深海，并将花朵掩在假鳍肢下。花中的孢子会散入水中，麻痹游过的猎物，让它轻松饱餐。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME fashion their shed feathers into hoods to help them hide deep in the sea, hiding their flowers beneath false flippers. Their flowers contain spores that spread out in the water, paralyzing prey for an easy meal as they swim by.

entry: POKENAME借滑溜的黏液趴着四处滑行。翅膀虽小，却能挥出猛烈打击，连最粗的树都能折断。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME uses its slippery slime to slide around on its stomach. Though its wings are small, they can deliver wicked blows strong enough to snap even the thickest of trees.

entry: POKENAME喜欢精彩对战后得到的关注。它要求训练家多多关注自己，有时难以与其他宝可梦合作。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love the attention they get after a good Pokémon battle. They demand lots of attention from their Trainer and can have a hard time working with other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME偏爱冷水，海水太暖就会变得迟钝。夏天会迁往冰冷海域。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers to swim in cold waters, becoming sluggish if the sea grows too warm. During the summer, it migrates to icy seas.

entry: POKENAME喜欢独自狩猎，而非结群。它以后腿站立，借带电的尾巴带动身体猛旋，撞击对手，使其麻痹。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME prefer to hunt independently rather than with a pack. Standing on its hind legs and using its electrified tail, POKENAME can whip its body around to impact opponents and leave them paralyzed.

entry: POKENAME痴迷于力量与外貌，不停强化、保养钢甲。它会在湍急水流中坐上数小时，让流水打磨、清洁身体。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are obsessed with strength and their appearance, constantly strengthening and maintaining their steel armor. They will sit in rushing water for hours, letting it polish and clean their bodies.

entry: POKENAME能用幻觉伪装成任何其他宝可梦。但野生个体从不愿与其他生灵合作，因而没能充分发挥这项本领。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can use its powers of illusion to disguise itself as any other Pokémon. However, because wild POKENAME refuse to ever work with others, they do not take full advantage of this ability.

entry: 虽然偏爱独处，它花朵的香气却会引来无数宝可梦。也许正因如此，它每天都会费力走向海床，主要以藻类和海草为食。
author: infinex21
source: Although it prefers to remain by itself, the scent of its flower attracts a myriad of Pokémon to it. Perhaps consequently, it trudges down to the seabed every day and feeds mostly on algae and seaweed.

entry: 这些独居宝可梦会认真巡逻冰封的领地。尾火能在水下维持数小时，之后它们才必须浮上水面。
author: chibitales
source: These solitary Pokémon patrol their icy territories with diligence. The flame on their tail can withstand several hours underwater before they must surface.

entry: POKENAME在海岸上与同类大群聚集。冬季会走进港口城镇，散发令人愉悦的胡椒薄荷与羽衣甘蓝气味。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers in large clusters on shorelines with others of its kind. During winter, they wander into port towns, releasing a pleasant peppermint and kale scent.

entry: POKENAME适应寒冷气候，温度越低，花瓣就越鲜艳。尽管寒冷，花瓣也不会变脆，反而会形成更像皮革的质感。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME thrives in icy climates, its petals growing more vibrant the colder the temperature gets. Despite the cold, they never grow brittle and instead develop a more leathery texture.

entry: POKENAME天性傲慢，自认越重要，头就会变得越大。若不能脚踏实地，就会因浮力过强而永远向上飘。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME are arrogant by nature. The more important they think they are, the bigger their head will become. If not grounded, they will be so buoyant that they will rise forever.

entry: POKENAME用利喙在河岸岩石上刻划，标记领地。它骄傲得连家人的帮助都不肯接受。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its sharp beak to scratch into the rocks along the riverbanks to mark its territory. It is so proud that it won't even accept help from members of its own family.

entry: POKENAME用强韧的喙将宝石从洞壁上啄下来，再喷出高压水流洗净，才吃下去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its strong beak to break gems free from cave walls. Once loosened, it sprays them with high pressured water to clean them before eating.

entry: 这种宝可梦身上长有天然沟槽，让它更便于在雪地行进。它常花上一整天，全速滚向冰川撞击，磨炼坚硬的身体。
author: gamblebreaker
source: This Pokémon has developed natural grooves on its body to allow it to more easily travel in snowy areas. It often spends its days hardening its body by rolling at top speed into glaciers.

entry: 太阳刚升起，POKENAME就会在湖面起舞，尤其附近有观众时更是如此。看的人越多，似乎越能鼓舞它跳得更久。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dances across a lake's surface the moment the sun begins to rise, especially when onlookers are nearby. It appears to be encouraged to dance longer when more people are watching.

entry: POKENAME的喙坚硬得几乎能啄开任何废弃物，让它挑垃圾吃时有各种选择。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's beak is strong enough to break through almost any refuse. This gives it a wide variety of options when selecting trash to eat.

entry: POKENAME附身的树桩或木头，片刻就会变得湿透。如果放着不管，到了第二天结束时，木头就会彻底腐烂。
author: .izik
source: Any stump or log POKENAME possesses becomes incredibly wet within moments. If left unattended, the wood will rot away entirely by the end of the following day.

entry: POKENAME对自己哼的歌极其自豪。谁未经许可偷用它的旋律，它就会愤怒地召雨淋在对方身上。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME is incredibly proud of the songs it hums. It angrily summons rain to fall on anyone who steals its melodies without permission.

entry: POKENAME发怒时，头上的铲子会放出冰冷的水，像步枪一样射向靠得太近的对象。
author: .izik
source: The shovel on POKENAME's head dispenses extremely cold water when it is angry. It fires this like a rifle at anyone who draws too close.

entry: POKENAME太自恋，无法结群，便四处种蘑菇，占据附近土地。哪株蘑菇惹它心烦，它就用爪剪断菇柄。
author: soup1900
source: Since POKENAME are too narcissistic to form groups, they instead plant and grow their mushrooms everywhere to colonize nearby land. If any of the mushrooms ever annoy them, they use their claws to clip their stems.

entry: POKENAME每次使用水系攻击，身上的宝石都会变得更明亮。只有睡着时，宝石才会完全暗下去。
author: .izik
source: The gems on POKENAME's body glow brighter whenever it uses a water-based attack. They go completely dark only when it is asleep.

entry: POKENAME通过喷射高压水流击倒树木，与同类较量。谁最快将树击倒，谁就获胜。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME competes with others of its kind by spraying high pressured jets of water to knock over trees. The victor is whoever fells the tree fastest.

entry: 它的上肢既强得能折断最粗的大树，又结实得能抵挡炸弹爆炸。虽然偏爱独居，朋友遇险时仍会赶去保护。
author: imaginita
source: Its upper limbs are both powerful enough to snap the thickest of trees in half and resilient enough to shield from a bomb blast. Though it prefers to live a solitary life, it will still hurry to defend a friend in danger.

entry: POKENAME全神贯注地盯着树枝，就能移动小冰山。但这极费心力，若试图移动太大的冰山，可能会失去意识。
author: .izik
source: When focusing intensely on its twig, POKENAME can move small icebergs. This focus demands intense effort and can render POKENAME unconscious if it attempts to move one too large.

entry: POKENAME高度集中精神能量，在魔杖尖端造出大泡泡。同类对手之间的战斗常十分激烈，在周围留下泡泡形的坑洞。
author: chibitales
source: By intensely focusing their psychic energy, POKENAME create large bubbles on the tips of their wand. Fights between rival POKENAME are often intense, leading to bubble-shaped craters in the local area.

entry: POKENAME收拢双臂，使身体呈流线型，在栖居的冰水中高效捕猎。其他同类进入猎场时，它会戒备起来，因此不建议训练家同时饲养一只以上。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME fold their arms to become streamlined, allowing them to efficiently hunt in the icy waters they call home. They get defensive if other POKENAME enter their hunting ground. Trainers are advised not to raise more than one at a time.

entry: POKENAME坚持独自训练，怕对手偷学招牌技巧。它造出的手里剑能将冰山劈成两半。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME trains strictly in solitude, afraid a rival will steal its signature techniques. The shurikens it creates are capable of splitting an iceberg in two.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，身体20英尺内的水会像间歇泉般向上喷出。虽然无害，却能让观众看得眼花缭乱。
author: .izik
source: While dancing, POKENAME causes nearby water to shoot upward like geysers from areas within 20 feet of its body. Though harmless, this can be a dazzling sight for onlookers.

entry: 大多数POKENAME偏爱独居，因为群居往往会为争夺首领之位，陷入不断的权力斗争。难得有群体能维持下来，领头的个体必定出类拔萃。
author: craigprime
source: Most POKENAME prefer to live in isolation, as living in a group tends to cause constant power struggles over each other fighting for the right to lead. In the rare instance that a group stays formed, the presiding POKENAME is truly exceptional.

entry: POKENAME用鳍在雪上滑行，留下心形痕迹，每只留下的形状略有不同。它借此标记栖居水域附近的领地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slides on its fin across snow to leave heart-shaped markings that differ slightly from one individual to the next. It does this to mark its territory near the water it inhabits.

entry: POKENAME的长鳍肢让它能在水下迅速游动。它举止端庄自律，如同王者，因为希望其他宝可梦尊重自己。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have long flippers that allow them to swim quickly underwater. They act with a regal discipline because they want other Pokémon to respect them.

entry: POKENAME在城市公园中聚居，游弋于园内的大池塘。它们极重个人利益，游客向水里投下食物时，都会争着第一个赶到。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form colonies within city parks, swimming around through the large ponds that can be found within them. They are fiercely individualistic, racing one another to be the first to any food that is thrown into the water by visitors.

entry: POKENAME在水中生活，不会飞。不过，有时会用力拍击水面，弹跳着穿过一段海面。
author: danarchosyndacalist
source: POKENAME are aquatic and cannot fly. However, they sometimes do bounce across stretches of the ocean by forcefully slapping the surface of the water.

entry: POKENAME在水下待得太久，尾火经常只剩余烬闷烧。它们靠大翅膀在冰冷水中滑行。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spend so much time underwater that the flame on their tail is often left smoldering. They rely on their large wings to glide through icy cold water.

entry: POKENAME用控水能力，在住处周围造出高耸的冰刺。它偏爱独处，用心灵感应察觉其他生灵靠近，再向陌生来客砸雪，试图劝其离开。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their hydrokinetic powers to create towering ice spikes around their homes. They prefer solitude and use their telepathy to sense the approach of others, pelting strangers with snow to try to persuade them to leave.

entry: POKENAME在湍急瀑布下刻苦锻炼肌肉，增强力量。它满心骄傲，夸口挑战远强于自己的敌人，结果往往立刻落败。
author: bluenido.
source: POKENAME trains its muscles rigorously under rushing waterfalls to build strength. Overflowing with pride, it boastfully challenges foes far stronger than itself, which often leads to its immediate defeat.

entry: POKENAME日益自负，倾向独居，也总与其他同类较量，尤其爱比游泳。它固执得不肯认输，于是重赛几乎没完没了。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tends to be solitary, as it has a growing ego that leads it to compete with any other POKENAME, often in swimming contests. Due to its stubbornness, it refuses to accept a loss, leading to near-endless rematches.

entry: POKENAME高傲地无视许多想陪它玩的对象，只愿与让它十分钦佩的伙伴相处。它在陆地上动作笨拙，觉得难为情，所以大多时间待在水中。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME haughtily ignores many potential playmates, only spending time with those that thoroughly impress it. It spends most of the time in water as it becomes embarrassed by its awkward movements on land.

entry: POKENAME骄傲，对自己的本领过度自信。觉得受了轻慢，就爱找更强的宝可梦打架，靠炮口火力弥补实力差距。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are prideful and overconfident in their own abilities. They have a habit of picking fights with stronger Pokémon if they feel they've been slighted, relying on their cannons to equal out any discrepancies in strength.

entry: 它自尊心很强，不肯听训练家的话时，就会把壳鼓起来。想躲开训练家时，会用黄色长舌挖进地下。
author: quackquackattack
source: It has a strong sense of pride, so it puffs out its shell whenever it refuses to listen to its Trainer. It uses its long, yellow tongue to burrow underground whenever it wants to hide from its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME擅长把电子页面转成纸张。它不怎么移动，但隔一段时间就得喂些墨水。
author: aberry8286
source: POKENAME is talented in the art of converting digital pages to paper. They don't move much but need to be fed ink every now and then.

entry: 它用三根角戳刺天敌自卫，角会分泌较弱的神经毒液。它用喙刮食藻类，供给身体养分，球茎则靠光合作用生存。
author: infinex21
source: It defends itself from predators by jabbing at them with its three horns, which secrete a weak, neurotoxic venom. It scrapes at algae with its beak to keep its body nourished, while its bulb survives through photosynthesis.

entry: POKENAME厨艺高超，野外会寻找最新鲜的海边食材，喂养幼崽。孩子受威胁时，就会用高压水炮击溃敌人。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME is a tremendous cook, and in the wild searches for the freshest seaside ingredients to feed its young. When its chick is threatened, it breaks the foe with high-pressure Hydro Pumps.

entry: POKENAME头上的突起如同王冠，显得很有王者气度。它友善宽厚，喜欢在自己的鱼缸中追逐其他宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has crown-like protrusions that give it a regal appearance. It is friendly and magnanimous, and enjoys chasing other Pokémon in its fish tank.

entry: POKENAME对比自己更受关注的宝可梦不屑一顾。训练家可以用鼓励与赞美，安抚闹腾的它。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME expresses disdain towards Pokémon that receive more attention than itself. Trainers can help calm a rambunctious POKENAME by offering words of encouragement and praise.

entry: 它将角抵在能找到的最硬岩石上磨，直到锋利得能刺穿树木才满意。它用翅膀迅速游动，将猎物串在角上，等食物沉甸甸地挂满，才浮出水面。
author: infinex21
source: It keeps its horns sharp by grinding them against the hardest rocks it can find; it's only satisfied when it can impale a tree with them. It uses its wings to swim swiftly and skewer prey upon its horns, surfacing when its horns are heavy with food.

entry: POKENAME栖居北方冰冷海域，强大而凶猛，常收到小型冰属性与水属性宝可梦的贡品。作为回报，即使最凶猛的水中猎手想捕食它的臣民，也会遭到它痛击。
author: sk372
source: A viciously strong Pokémon inhabiting the frigid northern waters, POKENAME often receives tribute from small Ice- and Water-type Pokémon. In exchange, it beats down on even the fiercest of aquatic hunters that try to prey on its subjects.

entry: POKENAME在极地结成大群，用少数几种独特叫声彼此交流。人们观察到，时间一久，群体内会形成小圈子，有些成员不愿让其他个体加入。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME form large colonies in polar regions, socialising with one another using a small range of unique cries. Small cliques have been observed to form within the colony over time, with some POKENAME preferring to keep others out of their club.

entry: POKENAME摇摇摆摆地巡守领地，用三叉戟戳刺想侵占它所选冰川的对象。确定没有挑战者后，才会满意地回窝，沉沉睡去。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME waddle around their domain protectively, jabbing at those that would impose on their chosen glacier with their trident. When they're satisfied that they are not facing any challengers, they retreat to their den and fall into a deep slumber.

entry: 角最大的POKENAME是群体首领，会在战斗中骄傲地展示力量，一次次证明自己。它们能从喙中喷出强力冰冷水流，即使身在高空也不例外。
author: infinex21
source: The POKENAME with the largest horns is the leader of its pack and will proudly show off its might in battle to prove itself time and time again. They can spew powerful jets of frigid water from their beaks, even from high in the sky.

entry: POKENAME曾被视为栖居海域的王者，拥有强大的控水力量。据说过去有座广阔城市惹怒了它，被水冲到了海面之下。
author: chibitales
source: Once considered to be a king of the oceans it inhabited, POKENAME exerts considerable power over water. It is said a sprawling city was washed below the waves in the past due to angering this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME看见海难中的落难者，会试着和对方玩。等自己玩够，就会眨眼间将人瞬移到最近的城镇。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME spots someone shipwrecked, it will attempt to play with them. Once it has had its fill of fun, it teleports them to the closest town in the blink of an eye.

entry: 随着年龄增长，触角会与角一同变长，让它更受同类尊重。它们性情温顺，只专注于让领地内的植物健康存活。
author: infinex21
source: Their antennae grow longer in tandem with their horns as they grow older, which serves to garner more respect from others of their kind. They are docile Pokémon who solely focus on keeping the plants in their domains healthy and alive.

entry: 野生POKENAME在温泉中筑巢，能与一同泡水放松的来客和平相处。恶意入侵、扰乱安宁的对象，则会迎来爆发的怒火。
author: cobalt0135
source: Wild POKENAME make their nests in hot springs and can coexist peacefully with any visitor that relaxes with them in the water. Any malicious invader that disturbs their peace will be met with explosive fury.

entry: POKENAME群居于寒冷的海边洞窟。锋利的金属翅膀能轻易切开几乎任何障碍。
author: mepp.
source: Colonies of POKENAME live in frigid seaside caverns. Its sharp metallic wings can slice through nearly any obstacle with ease.

entry: 野外的POKENAME统领蚊香蝌蚪的王国。但若遇上它认为有王者风范的训练家，尽管不情不愿，仍会完全听从指挥。
author: atlas3339098
source: In the wild, POKENAME preside over kingdoms of Poliwag. However, if one meets a Trainer it considers to have kingly qualities, it will follow their commands completely, albeit grudgingly.

entry: 长角的POKENAME担任群体首领，但其他成员仍会向它挑战。三根角中只要断了一根，它就会士气大落，显出消沉的迹象。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME with long horns are the leaders of their flocks, though this does not stop others of their flocks from challenging them. If any of their three horns are broken, their morale plummets and they will exhibit signs of depression.

entry: 这种宝可梦极其骄傲，若认为训练家不配，经常会违抗命令。有训练家报告，满月时，POKENAME的三根角与圆环会明亮发光。
author: pokejirkaok
source: This Pokémon is incredibly proud and often disobeys its Trainer if it does not deem them worthy. Trainers have reported POKENAME's three horns and rings glowing brightly during the full moon.

entry: POKENAME引以为傲的大角从不停长，所以必须定期磨短。它用锋利前肢割开树木，大口享用流出的树液。
author: infinex21
source: Their impressive horns never cease growing, so even though they are a source of pride for them, they must routinely whittle them down. POKENAME use their sharp forelimbs to cut into trees and gorge upon the released sap.

entry: 它力气很大，即使不用强壮的角，也能拔起大树。自尊心却很脆弱，哪怕最小的事，也容易将它激怒。
author: infinex21
source: It is strong enough to uproot a large tree without even using its powerful horn. It has a fragile sense of pride that makes it easy to provoke it, even over the smallest of things.

entry: POKENAME自鸣得意、自视甚高，指望几乎所有生灵都尊重、赞美自己的力量。它挥使三叉戟的技巧与灵活程度确实炉火纯青，所以也并非全无自负的本钱。
author: sk372
source: Smug and self-important, POKENAME expects nearly every other being to respect and praise its strength. Its skill and dexterity with the trident it wields are masterful, so its ego is not entirely unfounded.

entry: POKENAME身上覆盖的焦油状物质极为冰冷。它会以惊人的速度在海床蠕动，寻找海带吃。
author: .izik
source: The tar-like substance covering POKENAME's body is incredibly cold. It squirms across the seafloor at surprising speeds in search of kelp to feed on.

entry: POKENAME住在珊瑚礁间的浅水中，天性温顺。渔民捕到它也觉得没什么价值，总会将它放回水里。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME live in shallow waters amongst coral reefs. They are docile by nature but also of little worth to any fisherman who catches them, so they are always thrown back.

entry: 钴蓝色宝石是它最大的骄傲。宝石若被弄脏，就会暴怒将近一整周。据说它的利爪锋利得连坚硬钻石都能剜开。
author: infinex21
source: Its cobalt-blue gems are the greatest source of its pride. Should its gems ever be made dirty, it flies into a rage that lasts for nearly a whole week. Its talons are said to be so sharp that they could gouge solid diamond.

entry: POKENAME能用钢角侦测散逸的数据，因此很受杀毒软件公司欢迎。世界各地经常能见到受训个体飘在电脑附近，搜寻恶意软件。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME are popular with many antivirus companies due to their ability to pick up on stray data using their steel horns. It is not uncommon to see trained POKENAME floating around computers all over the world looking for any malware.

entry: POKENAME偏爱避免战斗，会亮出颈部皮膜，威吓潜在敌人。若不得不捍卫自尊，就会吐毒，再用冰冷的翼刃与尾刃劈砍。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME prefers to avoid combat, flashing its hood in an intimidation display to frighten off potential foes. If forced to defend its pride, it fights by spitting venom and slashing with its icy wing and tail blades.

entry: 据说，对从海中救起POKENAME的波拉斯群而言，它脸上的三叉戟形角与冰川面具，是神性的标志。这些部位越闪亮光洁，它就越有资格成为群体的帝王。
author: beatdoof
source: The trident horns and glacier mask adorning POKENAME's face are said to be a marker of divinity for a waddle of Piptar that rescues it from the ocean. The shinier and glossier these features are, the more worthy it is of being the waddle's emperor.

entry: POKENAME在极地海洋最寒冷的地方领导自己的族群。谁扰乱族群，就会被永久冻住、封在冰中，沦为群体的一件战利品。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME leads its own waddle in the most frigid parts of the polar oceans. Those who disturb its colony will find themselves permanently frozen and encased, nothing more than a trophy for the waddle.

entry: POKENAME扇动巨翼时，周围水域会开始翻腾，化作巨大海浪淹没四周。不过，只有发现附近的其他宝可梦不尊重自己的威严时，它才会这样做。
author: beatdoof
source: As POKENAME flaps its giant wings, water bodies around it will start bubbling up, engulfing the surroundings in a massive tidal wave. However, it would only do so if it notices other Pokémon nearby not respecting its majesty.

entry: POKENAME翅膀的锐利边缘能轻易切开冰。高傲态度与王者般的外貌，让它过去很受贵族欢迎。
author: mepp.
source: The sharp edges on POKENAME's wings can cut through ice with ease. Its haughty attitude and regal appearance made it a popular Pokémon for nobles in the past.

entry: POKENAME至少五只结队狩猎，在冰面快速“滑行”，用翅膀迅速调整动作，封住猎物退路。它们以锐利双翼精准切割，很快便能击倒目标。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME hunt in groups of at least five, swiftly "skating" along ice while using their wings to quickly adjust their movements and seal off their prey's escape. With their sharp wings, they make precise cuts that quickly fell their targets.

entry: POKENAME埋伏在冰封的北极地区，等待白海狮等宝可梦爬上岸。一发现目标，就从藏身处跃出，猛烈挥动剃刀般锋利的鳍肢，将其砍倒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lies in wait in frozen arctic areas, waiting for Pokémon like Dewgong to breach onto land. Once it spots a target, it leaps out from hiding, swinging its razor-sharp flippers wildly to cut them down.

entry: 它通过三根角捕获雷电，将约100,000伏的电力储存在体内。它会将锐利双翼互相敲击，挑战其他生灵，消耗一些储存的电力。
author: infinex21
source: It will capture lightning bolts through its three horns and store the power inside itself, up to around 100,000 volts worth. By striking together its sharp wings, it will challenge others to a battle so it may work off some of its stored energy.

entry: POKENAME将翅膀的振动集中到头冠，使其成为振荡的刀刃，再用刀刃在冰山与崖壁上切出巢穴。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME concentrates the vibrations of its wings into the crests on its head, turning them into oscillating blades. They use these blades to cut their nests into icebergs and cliffsides.

entry: 深海研究者会借助POKENAME，整理并储存世界各地的水源资料。头冠发出的波能探测微生物，辨别不同种类的水。
author: .izik
source: Deep-sea researchers have been known to utilize POKENAME to catalogue and store data on water sources throughout the world. It can detect microbes and different water types through waves emitted from the crown on its head.

entry: POKENAME在较冷地区的水域周边小群生活。两腕背面的膜十分结实，战斗时能充作盾牌防御。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME live together in small groups around the waters of colder regions. The membranes on the back of each wrist are sturdy and act as makeshift shields for defense in combat.

entry: POKENAME有时被称为“森林帝王”，家园中的居民对它绝对忠诚。它虽然骄傲自负，却会保护比自己弱小的生灵，直到自己倒下。
author: sk372
source: Sometimes referred to as “The Forest Emperor”, POKENAME commands absolute loyalty from the denizens of its home. Though it is prideful and egotistical, it will defend those weaker than it from harm until it collapses.

entry: POKENAME的角显示着力量，它会自豪地在粗大树木上磨角。鳍肢其实是覆盖双臂的大型特化鳞片，锋利得能切开丛林中的任何植物。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME's horns show its power, and it sharpens them on thick trees with pride. Its flippers are actually large modified scales growing over its arms, sharp enough to cut through any plant of the jungle.

entry: 从喙延伸出的角既证明它的年龄与力量，也是它的骄傲。它能精准喷出加压的滚烫热水，但因个头小，发射前必须稳住身体。
author: infinex21
source: The horns extending from its beak are a testament to its age and power while also being a source of pride. It spits compressed, scalding hot water at its foes with considerable precision, though it must brace itself due to its small stature.

entry: POKENAME的“翅膀”十分锋利，能轻易切入泥土和岩石，迅速挖洞。尖刺越长、越锐利，就越受同类尊重。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have very sharp "wings" that allow them to easily cut into dirt and rock and burrow quickly. The longer and sharper their quills are, the more respected they are among their species.

entry: 据说长角的POKENAME都活了很久，也最受同类尊重。它们以武术战斗，用刀刃般的翅膀与强健双腿，施展威力惊人的劈击与踢击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME with long horns are said to have lived long lives and are said to be the most respected among their kind. They fight with martial arts that utilize their blade-sharp wings and their powerful legs to deliver devastating chops and kicks.

entry: POKENAME相互冲撞，用脸上的甲片对撞，争夺领地。败者必须给胜者覆上泥巴，以示臣服。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME clash against each other, slamming the plates on their faces against each other in competitions for territory. The loser has to cover the victor in mud as an act of submission after losing.

entry: POKENAME很少满足于泥坑家园的大小。它会用锐利四肢挖开土地，再引水淹没，扩张泥地领土，完全不顾给其他生灵造成的麻烦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is rarely satisfied with the size of its mud-hole home. It uses its sharp limbs to carve into the land before flooding it to increase its muddy domain, regardless of any other creatures it inconveniences to do so.

entry: POKENAME在河中高速游泳。若看见有人在自己的领地钓鱼，就会冲出水面，泼对方一身恶臭泥巴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims through rivers at high speeds. Should it spot someone fishing on its territory, it bursts from the water and douses them in foul-smelling mud.

entry: POKENAME神情沉稳，沉默寡言，不会公开表现对训练家的喜爱。因为它会用心灵感应，直接把亲昵的心意传给训练家。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a stoic, taciturn expression and does not openly express its affection for its Trainer. This is because it telepathically conveys its affectionate thoughts directly to its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME用鳍肢般翅膀的利缘撑稳身体，射出加压水流或长舌。舌头弹出的力量足以击碎一大块坚冰。
author: infinex21
source: Using the sharp edges of their flipper-like wings, POKENAME brace themselves to fire out compressed water jets or their long tongues. Their tongues can shoot out with enough force to break apart a chunk of solid ice.

entry: POKENAME戴着王冠，性情沉稳，很有王者风范。它用波导挡开攻击，保护训练家免受伤害。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a regal appearance thanks to their crown and their stoic disposition. They protect their Trainers from harm by deflecting attacks using their aura.

entry: 奇特花朵的花瓣锋利坚硬，长久以来被用于某些工具和武器，其中也含有药用汁液。它们的角越长，就越受同伴尊重。
author: infinex21
source: The sharp and rigid petals of their strange flowers have long been used in some tools and weapons, though they contain a medicinal sap within them as well. The longer their horns are, the more respect they garner from their peers.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，用后颚咬住冰山，避免漂走。它偏爱在冷水中休息，到了热带气候就难以入睡。
author: .izik
source: While sleeping, POKENAME latches its rear jaws onto icebergs to avoid drifting. It prefers these cold waters for rest and has trouble sleeping in tropical climates.

entry: 由于体色和捡来的饰物，水手常把POKENAME误认成人造浮标或沉船残骸。即使在北方冰冷海水中，头上的褶饰也能进行光合作用。
author: thegreenscorpion
source: Due to its coloring and scavenged accessories, sailors often mistake POKENAME for manmade buoys or sunken ship remains. The frills on its head are capable of photosynthesis even among the frozen waters of the northern oceans.

entry: POKENAME散发着令人压抑的威严与统治气势，影响附近宝可梦保护、服侍自己。幸好，它只要求小睡时不受打扰，再偶尔吃顿鱼。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: POKENAME exudes an oppressive aura of majesty and dominion, influencing nearby Pokémon to protect and serve it. Luckily, the only things POKENAME ever demands are solitude during its naps and the occasional meal of fish.

entry: 许多人称POKENAME为海浪女皇。它游过的浪很大，吸引冲浪者追寻。遇到电属性宝可梦想开战时，它会钻进海床，掀起旋涡，将敌人拖下去。
author: ghostslythe
source: Referred to as the Empress of the Waves by many, POKENAME's wake is sought out by Surfers due to their size. When an Electric-type attempts to battle, it burrows to the sea floor, causing whirlpools to pull the foe down.

entry: POKENAME腿上的刀刃坚硬如钢，切开冰山如同切纸。穿越北极水域的货船，经常使用它开出的航道。
author: chibitales
source: The blades on POKENAME's legs are as hard as steel, allowing it to slice through icebergs as though they were paper. Paths carved by POKENAME are often used by ships transporting cargo through arctic waters.

entry: 有些文化称这种无情的宝可梦为海洋帝王。自尊受挫时，它能引发强烈的海底地震，造成巨大海啸。背上三叉戟般的尖刺还能引来风暴。
author: milchik
source: Known as the Emperor of the Seas in some cultures, this ruthless Pokémon is capable of creating underwater earthquakes powerful enough to cause giant tsunamis should its pride be hurt. The trident-like spikes on its back are able to attract storms.

entry: POKENAME头上的王冠由结实的金色木头构成。谁离巢太近，它就会用王冠猛撞。
author: .izik
source: The crown on POKENAME's head is made of sturdy golden wood. They bash it into foes who draw too close to their nest.

entry: POKENAME高傲地挺立，展示坚实的金色木冠。它饮用清澈的冰川水来滋养王冠。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME stands tall and proud, showing its sturdy, gold wood crown. It replenishes it by drinking fresh glacier water.

entry: POKENAME背上的树始终像覆着白雪。即使盛夏酷热，雪也不会融化。
author: .izik
source: The tree on POKENAME's back always appears to be covered in snow. Even in the heat of summer, it never melts.

entry: POKENAME头上冒出的高热泡泡，碰到皮肤就能烫伤。它偏爱防守，会诱使敌人挥击泡泡，反让对方受伤。
author: .izik
source: The superheated bubbles emanating from POKENAME's head can scald skin on contact. It prefers a defensive fighting style, tricking opponents into swinging into the bubbles to deal damage.

entry: POKENAME以独特的护蛋方式闻名：将蛋裹在两脚之间。它会保护尚未孵化的幼崽，谁敢靠得太近，就会遭到尖叫威吓，甚至用角交战。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are well known for their special way of caring for their eggs: swaddled between their feet. Protective of their unhatched young, POKENAME will squawk and get into horn fights with others who dare come too close.

entry: POKENAME将翼尖的蓝色金属保养得极为闪亮，作为同伴间的骄傲。哪怕只脏了一会儿，也会高速游泳，洗去杂物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME keeps the blue metal at the tips of its wings extremely shiny as a point of pride among its allies. Should it become dirty even briefly, it swims at high speed to remove the debris.

entry: 这只自身融合体长着最大的角，很容易便成为群体首领。奇怪的是，它比大多数帝王拿波还严厉，有人甚至觉得严厉过头。不过，它也会更加奋不顾身地保护珍视的一切。
author: infranscia
source: Sporting the largest horns of all, this self fusion readily takes leadership of its flock.  Oddly, it's stricter than most Empoleon; some say too much.  On the flipside, it will even more fiercely protect all it holds dear.

entry: 据说，POKENAME寄宿着曾被偷猎的帝王拿波的灵魂。为了复仇，它会劈开一整队偷猎船。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Said to be imbued with the spirit of the Empoleon it was poached from, POKENAME cleaves fleets of poaching ships in revenge.

entry: POKENAME从冰山顶守住领地，凭武艺将浮冰劈成两半，震慑来犯者。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME guards its territory from atop icebergs, intimidating invaders with its martial prowess by cleaving ice floes in half.

entry: 野生POKENAME彼此划分大片海域。它们试图命令进入自封领地的其他宝可梦，强迫对方战斗。但通常会听命的，只有其他同类。
author: thesilverowls
source: Large swathes of the sea are divided between wild POKENAME. They attempt to command any other Pokémon that enter their self-claimed domains and force them to do battle. However, the only Pokémon that regularly listen are other POKENAME.

entry: 野生POKENAME十分骄傲，不肯用幻觉伪装成强大宝可梦以外的模样。它们经常模仿帝王拿波，偶尔也会变成强大的龙，甚至传说的宝可梦。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME are too proud to use their illusion abilities to disguise themselves as anything other than powerful Pokémon. While they often mimic Empoleon, they occasionally disguise themselves as powerful dragons or even Legendary Pokémon.

entry: 谁想比POKENAME更优雅，它就会用三根角刺过去。胸前缎带般的触须虽然轻柔，末端却纤细锋利，能轻易把门切成碎片。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its three horns to stab anyone attempting to be more elegant than it. While the ribbonlike feelers on its front are light and soft, they can easily slice down a door into pieces with their thin, sharp ends.

entry: POKENAME守卫着远古文明沉入海中的水下神庙。发现入侵者，就会以剃刀般锋利的刀刃攻击。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME guards underwater temples of an ancient civilization that sank beneath the sea long ago. When POKENAME sees an intruder, it attacks them with its razor-sharp blades.

entry: POKENAME被当地人昵称为“水上大丽花”，生活在浅而湍急的溪流附近，尤其常见于这颗星球的南端。它既杂食也能自养，无法进行光合作用时，就捕食鱼宝可梦获取能量。
author: bobosmith01
source: Nicknamed the "Water Dahlia" by locals, POKENAME lives around shallow but quick-moving streams, particularly in the far south of the planet. An omnivore and an autotroph, it can get its energy from eating fish Pokémon when it cannot photosynthesize.

entry: POKENAME被当地人昵称为“水上大丽花”，生活在浅而湍急的溪流附近，尤其常见于这颗星球的南端。它既杂食也能自养，无法进行光合作用时，就捕食鱼宝可梦获取能量。
author: bobosmith01
source: Nicknamed the "Water Dahlia" by locals, POKENAME lives around shallow but quick-moving streams, particularly in the far south of the planet. An omnivore and an autotroph, it can get its energy from eating fish Pokémon when it cannot photosynthesize.

entry: POKENAME被视为仁慈优雅、守望领土的统治者象征。小看它绝非明智之举，因为它挥舞三叉戟和巨大双耳时，力量惊人，技巧也十分精妙。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is seen as emblematic of a ruler that watches over its domain with kindness and grace. Underestimating it is a poor choice, as it wields a trident and its own oversized ears with incredible strength and finesse.

entry: 据说POKENAME由葬身海中的水手化成，如今仍在大海上游荡。它会从沉船中救出遇难者，引导他们平安浮上水面。
author: mistymagius
source: Said to have been born from a fallen sailor lost at sea, POKENAME wanders the open ocean. It is known to rescue people from sinking ships, guiding them safely to the surface.

entry: POKENAME常被视为奢华的象征，拥有它的通常是事业有成或单纯运气好的人。人们经常在高雅庆典上派它出场。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME are often seen as a sign of luxury and are usually owned by either those who are successful or those who are simply lucky. POKENAME are usually sent out during classy celebrations.

entry: POKENAME不在巢中警戒、也不狩猎时，就会梳理羽毛。随着时间推移，领地向赤道与两极延伸：它们耐热耐寒，事实上，在这些环境中最擅长捕猎。
author: bobosmith01
source: When not keeping watch from its nest or hunting, POKENAME preens. Over time, POKENAME's territory has shifted closer to both the equator and the poles: they can withstand high heat and the cold and, in fact, hunt the best in these conditions.

entry: POKENAME借精神力脉冲在水中推进，速度甚至能媲美成年的巨牙鲨。
author: bugtoad
source: Using psychokinetic pulses, POKENAME can propel themselves through water at speeds rivaling even those of a fully-grown Sharpedo.

entry: POKENAME头上的钢角随年龄增长而变长，证明求生本领，也因此更受潜在伴侣青睐。记录中最长的角，能从头部一直伸到尾巴顶端。
author: chibitales
source: The steel horns on POKENAME's head grow longer with age, attesting to its survival skills and thus making it more favorable to potential mates. The longest horns ever recorded reached from the head to the top of the tails.

entry: POKENAME用筑坝剩余的材料给自己做冲浪板，在水面冲浪。它技巧高超，还能教年幼的水属性宝可梦冲浪。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses excess material left over from building dams to fashion itself a board to surf across the water on. It is skilled enough at surfing to be able to teach young Water-type Pokémon how to do it as well.

entry: POKENAME坚硬的身体让它能轻松潜入海沟。它下潜至水面以下400英尺，也毫无困难。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's hard body allows it to dive deep into ocean trenches without difficulty. It can descend to 400 feet below the surface without issue.

entry: POKENAME想彰显优越地位时，就会扇开尾巴，展示帝王威势。它骄傲任性，训练家与它相处时，态度需要坚定。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fan their tails in a display of imperial dominance whenever they feel the need to exert their superiority. They are proud and wilful Pokémon; Trainers are advised to take a firm hand when working with them.

entry: POKENAME的三根角由坚固的铁构成，用来破开岩石，寻找矿藏。它每天吃大量矿物，帮助角变得更坚实。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's three horns are made of sturdy iron, which they use to break away stone in search of mineral deposits. They consume large amounts of minerals every day, which help to strengthen their horns.

entry: POKENAME能伪装成人类孩子，但通常会因不会说话，以及拒绝做任何有损尊严的事而露馅。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can disguise itself as a human child, but is usually given away by its inability to speak and by its refusal to ever do anything it considers undignified.

entry: 它曾被称为“雪之丰收王子”。冬末见它走过村旁，被视为好运，相信能带来丰收和肥沃土壤。
author: .izik
source: Once known as the "Prince of Snow's Harvest", it was considered good luck to spot one walking near a village in late winter. This was believed to bring bountiful crops and rich soil.

entry: POKENAME用头上的三根角战斗。角最大的个体更容易戳破对手，被视为群体首领。
author: periperi_chicken
source: The three horns on POKENAME's head are used for fighting. Those with the largest horns find it easier to pop rivals and are seen as the leaders amongst their group.

entry: POKENAME自称栖居洞窟的统治者，要求其他宝可梦进贡水晶，换取保护。心思简单的会毫不怀疑地服从，聪明的则很快就看穿承诺只是空话。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME proclaim themselves the rulers of any cave they live in, demanding crystals from other Pokémon in exchange for protection. Simpler Pokémon obey without question, while smarter ones quickly realize their promises are empty.

entry: POKENAME是冰河时代的王者。在精灵球被发明之前，它曾捕食早期人类。宝可梦融合技术使它再次苏醒。
author: creep0202
source: The king of the ice age, POKENAME was a predator to early humans before the invention of Poké Balls and have been revived due to Pokémon fusion.

entry: POKENAME与同类用力对撞、刮擦金属面具，进行较量。获胜后，会从三叉戟尖端喷水，庆祝胜利，彰显优势。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME clashes with others of its kind through bashing and scraping their metal masks against each other. Once triumphant, an POKENAME shoots water from the tips of the trident as a mark of celebration and dominance.

entry: POKENAME耳朵发出的响亮叫声如同金属刮擦。它借此警告在水下采海带的同类，天敌正在靠近。
author: .izik
source: The loud cries POKENAME produces from its ears sound like scraping metal. It uses this to warn others of its kind gathering kelp beneath the sea's surface about approaching predators.

entry: POKENAME被昵称为“史莱姆之王”，常聚集尚未进化或年幼的同族，甚至包括未融合的黏黏宝。首领守护整个群体，以猛烈的水属性攻击反击威胁。
author: chibitales
source: Nicknamed the King of Slimes, POKENAME often gather groups of their unevolved and younger brethren, even including unfused Goomy. The leader acts as the guardian for the entire group, retaliating against threats with intense Water-type attacks.

entry: POKENAME悠闲地待在冰冷海域的冰山上，统领附近的波加曼。它们遇险时，就会立即出动，用坚硬身体猛撞威胁者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lounges atop icebergs in icy waters to lord over nearby Piplup. Should they face danger, it leaps into action and bashes the threat with its hardened body.

entry: POKENAME的旋律蕴含潮水般的治愈力量。歌唱时，柔和的水波向外飘散，治好听力范围内每只宝可梦的伤口。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME's melody carries a tide of healing power. When it sings, soft ripples of water drift outward and mend the wounds of every Pokémon within earshot of it.

entry: POKENAME栖居深海，哼出的低沉旋律沿幽暗海沟传出数英里。它一挥三叉戟，就能汇集海中压力，一次释放。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME dwells in the deep sea, where it hums a low melody that travels for miles along dark trenches. With one sweep of its trident, it gathers the sea's pressure and releases it all at once.

entry: POKENAME从不独自表演。它用周围的水召出一队伙伴，伙伴会遵从每一个信号。战斗时，它指挥伙伴依次出击，如同排练熟悉的戏剧。
author: jackjirachi
source: POKENAME never performs alone. It conjures a troupe of companions from the water around it, and they follow its every cue. In battle, it directs them to strike in sequence like a well-rehearsed play.

entry: POKENAME身上长出的真菌冠，在空气中暴露过久会硬化变脆。几天内便能重新长好，脱落的真菌则被药剂师用于烫伤敷药。
author: .izik
source: The fungus crown growing from POKENAME's body hardens if exposed to air for too long and becomes brittle. It regrows within days, and the discarded fungi are used in poultices for burns by apothecaries.

entry: POKENAME在严寒的北极水域游泳，用刀刃般的双臂劈开挡路的冰。王者般的态度让训练家很难驾驭它。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME swims in frigid arctic waters, using its bladed arms to cleave through any ice in its way. This Pokémon's regal attitude can make it hard for Trainers to control.

entry: POKENAME携带的蓝色木制巨剑坚硬如铁。它战斗时如同守卫王国的熟练骑士，挥剑迎敌。
author: .izik
source: The blue wooden greatsword POKENAME carries is as hard as iron. It wields it in battle like a skilled knight defending a kingdom.

entry: POKENAME用水边的桦木制成三叉戟，借此控制附近的水，目光一动就能使水沸腾。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME crafts tridents from birch wood found near the water's edge. With it, it can control nearby water and bring it to a boil at a glance.

entry: POKENAME三叉戟放出的泡泡充满精神能量，能将击中的对象震退。同类对手常试图折断彼此的角，败者会因此被逐出群体。
author: chibitales
source: Bubbles released from POKENAME's trident are full of psychic energy, causing those struck by them to be pushed back from the impact. Rivalling POKENAME often try to break their opponent's horns, causing the loser to be cast out.

entry: 这些骄傲的宝可梦通过竞速决定首领。游泳时，锋利的角、喙与双脚能切开冰川。
author: torterrable
source: These prideful Pokémon use races to determine who is the leader. Their sharp horns, beaks, and feet are capable of slicing through glaciers when they swim.

entry: 它在陆地与海上都能飞快奔跑。任何东西挡路，POKENAME就会向前掷出压缩水制成的手里剑，将其切碎，径直冲过去。
author: imaginita
source: It can run across land and sea alike with incredible speed.  If there is anything in its way, POKENAME will throw shuriken made of compressed water ahead to slice it to shreds and run right through.

entry: POKENAME不高兴时，金色王冠会释放冰冷粉末。吸入后，受害者会失去对全身神经的控制。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's golden crown releases an icy cold powder when it is upset. When inhaled, the victim loses control of the nerves throughout their body.

entry: POKENAME醒目的头冠展现出优雅与力量。它狡猾而顽固，占据码头，施展致命踢击，并召集凶悍帮众，在水岸地盘争斗中夺权。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME has bold crests, showing elegance and strength. Cunning yet obstinate, it dominates jetties, delivering lethal kicks. It musters fierce gangs under its rule, vying for power in waterfront turf wars.

entry: POKENAME的金属身体能轻松划开冰水，达到很高的速度。整群会在海中排成整齐队形，寻找产卵地点。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's metallic body cuts through icy waters with ease, allowing it to reach high speeds. Entire schools travel in organized formations through the sea in search of places to leave their eggs.

entry: POKENAME希望其他宝可梦尊重自己，真正受到尊重时，却常不知所措。一旦失态，就会慌乱地连声道歉，让训练家处理起来十分头疼。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME want other Pokémon to respect them but are often baffled when they receive that respect. Whenever they lose their cool, they fluster and apologize profusely, which can be a headache for Trainers to deal with.

entry: POKENAME游泳时，三叉戟形的喙会在前方劈开楔形水路，帮助迅速前行。常能见到两只竞速，争个高下。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's trident-shaped beak creates a hydrodynamic wedge in front of it when swimming, helping it move swiftly through the water. It is common to see two POKENAME racing one another in order to establish which is the superior Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME将大片冰川划为领地，通常在冰川融水湖中安家。谁来挑战，就向其投掷冰水球，靠低温消磨敌人的力量。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME lay claim to large swathes of glacier as their territory, typically making their home within a meltwater lake. They fling orbs of icy water at those that would challenge them, relying on the freezing temperature to sap their foes' strength.

entry: POKENAME寿命很长，三根角的长度显示着年龄。暴怒时，鲜蓝色的皮毛会冒出蒸汽。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have long lifespans, which are denoted by the length of their three horns. When enraged, steam rises from their bright blue fur.

entry: 这些骄傲的宝可梦只要被击中，或觉得受到任何形式的挑战，就会立刻迎战。蓝白火焰遇水反而烧得更热、更久，如同D类火灾。
author: infinex21
source: These prideful Pokémon are quick to battle if they are struck in any way or if they feel as though they are being challenged in some way. Their blue-white flames burn hotter and longer when met with water, akin to Class D fires.

entry: POKENAME十分骄傲，相信自己无论到哪里都是最重要的。它从角尖传出优越感，试图让周围的生灵自觉低人一等。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are prideful Pokémon that believe themselves to be the most important thing in any space they enter. They project their feelings of superiority from the tips of their horns, attempting to instil a sense of inferiority in those around them.

entry: POKENAME高傲，总想在身体力量上胜过所有生灵，因此被认为很难训练。野生个体会建造宏伟冰宫居住，所以很容易找到。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are considered difficult to train due to their haughty natures and a desire to be physically stronger than everyone. POKENAME in the wild are easy to find, since they make grandiose ice palaces to live in.

entry: POKENAME常发展出激烈的竞争关系，以高速竞赛证明自己更优越。它们好胜，较量时毫不留情，因此竞赛成了热门观赏活动。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME will often develop heated rivalries, competing in high-speed races to prove their superiority. Because of their competitive and cutthroat nature, their races have become a popular spectacle.

entry: POKENAME若被对手夺走首领之位，就会执着于夺回昔日荣耀。训练家必须关爱它，同时态度严正，帮助它走出这种有损自身的心态。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: If POKENAME loses the leadership of its flock to a rival, it becomes obsessed with reclaiming its former glory. Trainers must be caring but stern with POKENAME to help it out of this self-destructive mindset.

entry: POKENAME的三颗头都极为优雅。哪颗头犯了错，就会推给另一颗，彼此从不和睦。
author: dodoowner_
source: All three heads of an POKENAME are extremely elegant. If one of the heads makes a mistake, they blame it on another. They never get along.

entry: 中间的头负责吃，其他头则负责将食物捶软、碾碎或切开。每颗头都自认最重要，所以经常内斗。
author: infinex21
source: The central head is the one that eats, while the other heads prepare the food by tenderizing it, pulverizing it, or merely by cutting it up. Each head believes itself to be the most important, so they often end up fighting among themselves.

entry: POKENAME用强喙击碎浮冰，将猎物掀入冰冷海中。它的自尊很容易受伤，极少与同类聚集，宁愿带领白海狮群。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME uses its powerful beak to shatter ice floes, dunking its prey into the frigid ocean. As its pride is easily injured, it rarely gathers with others of its kind, preferring to lead pods of Dewgong.

entry: POKENAME迈着王者般的步伐，自信胜过周围所有宝可梦。高傲态度让它不受欢迎，但庞大身躯与坚硬背壳，也让其他生灵很难挑战这份优越感。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME strut around with a regal bearing, confident in their superiority to all other Pokémon around them. Their haughty attitude makes them unpopular with others, but their bulk and tough shell make challenging their superiority complex difficult.

entry: POKENAME住在受工厂污染的水域，利用体色迷惑玛瑙水母平时极其敏锐的视力。对方一游过，它就使出暗影爪延长攻击范围，抓住猎物，拖入深处。
author: ghostslythe
source: Calling polluted factory waters home, POKENAME uses its coloration to confound Tentacool's normally stellar sight. When one swims by, this Pokémon extends its reach with Shadow Claws, grasping its prey and taking them down to the depths.

entry: POKENAME背上的石头不断吸收太阳的热与能量。它带有强磁力，足以让半径三米内的电子设备故障。
author: fiordaliso
source: The stone on its back constantly absorbs heat and energy from the sun. POKENAME has a strong magnetic charge, powerful enough to cause electronic devices within a three-meter radius of it to malfunction.

entry: POKENAME活动时，许多露营者得看紧行李，因为它会翻包偷走金属物品。幸好，它相当慢，也只能拖着小物件走，让大多数训练家松了口气。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many campers have to keep a close eye on their belongings whenever POKENAME are active since they steal metal items when they ruffle through bags. Thankfully for most Trainers, they are quite slow and can only drag small objects along with them.

entry: POKENAME大多面朝北方，也一路向北，仿佛踏上了漫长的朝圣之路。人们认为，它是在寻找失散的家人。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Facing and heading north most of the time, POKENAME appears to be on a long pilgrimage. It is thought to be in search for the rest of its family.

entry: POKENAME几乎不动，常被误认成雕像或形状古怪的石头。若朝向北方以外的方向，就会缓慢转身，直到鼻子指北。
author: atlas3339098
source: POKENAME barely moves and is often mistaken for a statue or a weirdly shaped rock. If pointed in any direction other than north, it will slowly rotate until its nose points northward.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，鼻子直指天空，火焰也会暗下去。研究者因而认为，这种姿势能让它平静，但原因不明。
author: .izik
source: When sleeping, POKENAME points its nose straight up directly to the sky. Its flames grow dim during this time, leading researchers to believe that this position calms it for an unknown reason.

entry: 它用鼻子辨别所居海域的水流方向，岩石般的硬身体则能抵御天敌。
author: melodydelune
source: Its nose is used to navigate the currents of the seas it inhabits. Its rock-hard body defends it from predators.

entry: POKENAME睡在岩层附近的地下。谁弄乱石头的位置，就会让它极其烦躁，从土中钻出，大肆暴走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sleeps underground near the vicinity of rock formations. It gets incredibly agitated if anything messes with the placement of the stones, rising up from the dirt to go on a rampage.

entry: POKENAME天生知道东西南北，被广泛认为是运输与导航的好帮手。它也会救起海上迷途的人，送他们回家。
author: pinkyoshi2350
source: POKENAME is widely regarded as an excellent Pokémon for transportation as well as navigation, as it innately knows the four cardinal directions. It is also known to save people lost at sea and bring them back home.

entry: POKENAME尾端长着鼻状器官，确实能用来闻气味，嗅觉似乎比脸上的鼻子更好。
author: sk372
source: A nose-like growth sits at the end of POKENAME's tail. POKENAME can in fact smell utilizing this appendage; it seems to have a better sense of smell than the nose upon its face.

entry: POKENAME用磁场捕捉猎物，寒冷会让磁场更强。它们从不睡觉，能不停寻找更冷的天气。
author: standing__water
source: POKENAME use magnetic fields to catch their prey, which strengthen in the cold. Since POKENAME never sleep, they can continuously seek out colder weather.

entry: 虽然有着类似指南针的性质，它们却不朝北。科学家推测，它们指向的其实是月球的磁场。
author: staghorn
source: Although they have compass-like properties, they do not point north. Scientists theorize that they are aligned with a magnetic field on the moon.

entry: POKENAME会面向北方一站数月，常结成小群。姿势僵硬，对周围完全没有反应，经常被误认成雕像。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will stand facing north for months at a time, often in small groups. These Pokémon are often mistaken for statues due to their rigid postures, remaining completely unresponsive to their surroundings.

entry: POKENAME外貌不起眼，很容易融入岩石环境，躲过天敌。它用磁力帮助自己移向阳光充足的地方，收集进化所需的能量。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's unassuming appearance hides it from predators, as it easily blends into rocky environments. It uses magnetism to help it move towards sunny spots so it can gather energy to evolve.

entry: POKENAME能通过颈部红珠感受周围人的情绪，尤其容易被悲伤吸引。它常因大鼻子受到嘲笑，通常循着哭声就能找到。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can sense the emotions of people around it through the red beads on its neck, being especially drawn to sorrow. Often mocked for its large nose, it can usually be found by following the sound of its crying.

entry: POKENAME头顶磁性极强，总像指南针一样指向北方。两只若靠得太近，就会一起疯狂旋转。
author: santon5512
source: The top of POKENAME's head is highly magnetic, always pointing north, much like a compass. If two of these Pokémon are near each other, they will both spin wildly.

entry: POKENAME往往一连数天不动，常被误认成古怪雕像。它用鼻子的磁性产生力场，赶走试图打扰自己冥想静止状态的对象。
author: fiordaliso
source: Since POKENAME tends to stay motionless for days at a time, it's often mistaken for a peculiar statue. It uses the magnetic properties of its nose to generate force fields that keep away those who try to disturb its meditative stasis.

entry: 在自然栖息地，POKENAME总挂在树的北侧。周围磁场吸引金属矿物，再黏附到身体上，形成外壳。
author: foolish_weasel
source: In its natural habitat, POKENAME is always found hanging from a tree's northern side. Its magnetic aura attracts metallic minerals which it adheres to itself to form its shell.

entry: POKENAME群体有一位喙部磁力极强的首领。喙的磁力似乎能让同类以某种方式沟通，组成井然有序的群体。
author: .izik
source: Flocks of POKENAME will have one leader with an extremely magnetic beak. The magnetic powers of their beaks allow them to communicate somehow with others of their kind and lets them form organized groups.

entry: 与翻滚冒泡、熔融般滚烫的身体相比，POKENAME的磁性鼻子却异样地凉。它偏爱火山区，借热量旺盛生活，磁性鼻子却不受影响。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's magnetic nose remains oddly cool compared to the rest of its bubbling molten-hot body. It prefers to live in volcanic areas, thriving on the heat while its magnetic nose remains unaffected.

entry: POKENAME飞累了，会把磁性鼻子吸在停驶列车车厢的金属侧壁上，垂挂着休息。直到列车启动，将它晃醒，才准备开始下一段旅程。
author: .izik
source: When tired of flying, POKENAME sticks its magnetic nose to the metal sides of stopped train cars. It will dangle there until the train starts, jostling it awake and preparing it for its next journey.

entry: 磁性鼻子会将它引向钢属性宝可梦的蛋。由于咬不开蛋壳，它便整个吞下。
author: busilisk
source: Its magnetic nose draws it towards the eggs of Steel-type Pokémon. Unable to crack the shells with its bite, it instead swallows them whole.

entry: POKENAME视力差，靠嗅觉与鼻子蹭触物体来辨路。毛发由金属纤维构成，能保护面部。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME has poor vision, so it navigates by smell and by nuzzling things. Its hair is made from metal fibers, and protects its face.

entry: POKENAME的鼻子又重又有磁性，总指着北方，行动起来十分不便。因此，POKENAME只得把大鼻子举到头顶上。
author: goldegummybear
source: POKENAME's nose is heavy and magnetic. It always faces north, which makes moving around rather difficult, as POKENAME must resort to carrying its large nose atop its head.

entry: POKENAME的大鼻子嗅觉灵敏，用来寻找能休息的泥地与沼泽。人们认为它会挑矿物含量较高的泥巴，凭敏锐嗅觉辨认。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's large nose gives it a strong sense of smell, used to find muddy and swampy areas to relax in. It's believed that it looks for mud with higher mineral content, discernible thanks to its heightened smell capabilities.

entry: POKENAME深吸气时，精神感官能让它近乎闻出周围的情绪。积极情绪闻起来更诱人，因此它会被带有这种气息的对象吸引。
author: sk372
source: Whenever POKENAME inhales deeply, its psychic senses let it essentially smell the emotions around it. Positive emotions have a more appealing scent, so POKENAME is drawn towards those with that type of aroma.

entry: POKENAME看不清楚，靠鼻子和脚上的孔闻周围环境。人们认为它能凭气味绘出整片大陆的地图，聪明得能将特定地点记住数十年。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME cannot see well, instead using their nose and the holes on their feet to smell their surroundings. It's thought they can map an entire continent by smell and are intelligent enough to remember specific places for decades.

entry: 不同于朝北鼻几乎总指北，POKENAME的巨鼻似乎指向最近的墓地。讽刺的是，虽然大朝北鼻倾向于将铁屑磁化，它却似乎连金属出现在身边都讨厌。
author: bobosmith01
source: Instead of almost always pointing north like Nosepass, POKENAME's giant nose seems to point to the nearest graveyard. Ironically, it seems to dislike even the mere presence of metal, despite Probopass's inclination to magnetize metal filings.

entry: POKENAME站得一动不动，常被误认成石像，但若拿走毛皮披衣，冷天它也会发抖。野生个体通常出现在高山上，磁性鼻子朝北。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME stands so still that it is often mistaken for a stone statue, although it will shiver in cold weather if its furry cloak is taken away. Wild POKENAME are usually found high up on mountains, pointing their magnetic nose north.

entry: POKENAME的大鼻子与背壳磁性很强。它会尽量远离矿井，因为一辆矿车就能把它吸住数小时。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's large nose and shell are highly magnetic. It tries to stay clear of mineshafts, as a single minecart can leave it stuck for hours.

entry: POKENAME用强磁力牵引自己通过险峻地形，在陡峭崖壁上安家。徒步者会让它在山道前方跑，确保随时能辨认北方。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME use their strong magnetism to help pull them along hazardous terrains and make their homes atop sheer cliffsides. Hikers let POKENAME run ahead of them on a trail to ensure they can always keep track of which way is North.

entry: 据说，向北延伸的洞穴其实是POKENAME锻炼时挖出的隧道。挖掘产生的铁质碎屑都会吸附到它带磁性的尾尖上。
author: enemyphase
source: It is said caves leading north are actually the tunnels created by POKENAME training. Any iron rubble created in this process clings to the magnetic tip of their tail.

entry: 鼻子总朝北，迫使POKENAME练就了极其敏锐的反应。几乎不可能悄悄靠近它，否则就会触发它的战斗本能，使它陷入狂暴。
author: enemyphase
source: Due to its north-facing snout, POKENAME have had to develop impeccable reflexes. It is nearly impossible to sneak up on one without activating its fighting instinct and sending it into a frenzy.

entry: POKENAME用没有磁性的小石子筑巢。若哪块石头含有磁性材料，就会把它踢进水里，避开不碰。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME create their nests out of small pebbles and stones that lack magnetic properties. Should a rock have a magnetic material within, POKENAME will kick it into the water and avoid it.

entry: POKENAME常被各大社交平台拿来当表情包。
author: valtsuri
source: POKENAME is commonly used as a reaction image on many social media platforms.

entry: POKENAME发出极强磁场，延伸至体外数米。装有心脏起搏器的人被建议避开这些区域，因为磁场可能干扰医疗设备。
author: _pixelar_
source: POKENAME emit extremely strong magnetic fields that extend a few meters outside of their bodies. People with pacemakers are advised to steer clear of these areas, as the magnetic fields can cause complications within the medical device.

entry: POKENAME感觉钢属性宝可梦难过或沮丧时，会用磁性极强的鼻子将它们吸引到窝里，再用触须包裹，似乎能让它们平静。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's extremely magnetic nose attracts Steel type Pokémon to its den when it senses they are upset or sad. It then wraps them in its feelers, which appears to soothe them.

entry: POKENAME的大鼻子能在闯入者尚未靠近时就闻出踪迹。它先跳到视线之外，再跃出行动，用沉重的石耳和双脚打击入侵者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's large nose lets it sniff out interlopers before they've even gotten near it. It hops out of sight before leaping into action and striking intruders with its heavy stone ears and feet.

entry: 环绕POKENAME的电气场，总有一部分被拉向北方，成为许多探险者可靠的指路标。
author: phantom640
source: A part of the electric aura surrounding POKENAME will always be pulled north, making it a reliable source of navigation for many explorers.

entry: POKENAME的磁性鼻子经常不慎吸住游轮侧面。它奋力挣脱时，往往会给船只造成相当大的损伤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME frequently gets its magnetic nose stuck to the sides of cruise ships unintentionally. While struggling to break free, it often causes considerable damage to the vessel.

entry: POKENAME的鼻子中流着强电流。它会与同类碰鼻，彼此交流。
author: .izik
source: A strong electrical current runs through POKENAME's nose. It communicates with others of its kind by touching noses together.

entry: POKENAME鼻中的电流能让同群伙伴明白它的情绪。几个成员将尾巴连起来，就能产生强电磁场，在群体睡觉时驱赶天敌。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: The electrical current that runs through POKENAME's nose helps its packmates understand its emotions. When several POKENAME connect their tails together, it creates a powerful electromagnetic field to deter predators while the group sleeps.

entry: POKENAME的红鼻子磁性强，能轻易找到金属矿石。它虽喜欢吃找到的矿石，但也能训练得不去吃，因此是一些矿工的常见伙伴。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's red nose has strong magnetic properties, so it can easily find metal ores. Although it will happily eat ores that it finds, it is possible to train it otherwise; because of this, it is a common companion for some miners.

entry: 即使身体不动，POKENAME的头也能旋转360度，始终朝向磁北。有时也会诞生鼻子朝南的个体。
author: kiwiarms
source: A POKENAME's head can rotate 360 degrees even while its body remains still, allowing it to face magnetic north at all times. Sometimes, one will be born that points south instead.

entry: POKENAME头顶的花苞总朝北。天气温暖时，花苞会绽开，散出磁波。
author: lydiaprower8
source: The bud atop POKENAME's head always faces north. When it's warm, the bud opens, spreading magnetic waves.

entry: POKENAME用两个大鼻子嗅探附近物品。喝下富含矿物的泉水后，磁力会增强。
author: lydiaprower8
source: It uses its two big noses to sniff out nearby items. When POKENAME drinks mineral-rich springwater, its magnetism strengthens.

entry: POKENAME用强健的耳朵砸碎岩石，寻找磁性材料，再将其覆在皮毛上，借自身磁场感知周围。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME uses its powerful ears to smash rocks, looking for magnetic material. It coats its fur with this material to allow it to detect its surroundings through its magnetic field.

entry: 鼻子伸出保护身体的凝胶之外，让它能闻到食物与同伴的气味。鼻孔会排出多余的凝胶，这些凝胶也带有磁性。
author: krune
source: Its nose protrudes beyond its protective gel, allowing it to smell food and allies. The nostrils release excess gel, which has magnetic properties.

entry: POKENAME借磁力在空中飞行，追寻新近勾起好奇的气味。身体虽然由石头构成，其实相当轻。
author: sk372
source: Using magnetism, POKENAME flies through the air, following the latest scent that piqued its curiosity. Despite being made of stone, its body is actually quite lightweight.

entry: POKENAME虽然双目失明，却有辨认方向的第六感。飞机上的卫星导航失灵或断线时，就会请它充当指南针。
author: dodoowner_
source: Although blind, POKENAME can use its sixth sense of direction to guide it. Planes use it as a compass if the GPS breaks or loses connection.

entry: 在POKENAME曾守护的古代文明遗迹附近，能找到它们。无论走出多远，它总能回到这里。
author: radiance8990
source: POKENAME can be found near the ruins of the ancient civilizations they once protected. No matter how far one travels, it can always find its way back to this spot.

entry: POKENAME鼻子发出的磁脉冲，让它能无声地与群体沟通。这些交谈会干扰附近的无线电信号。
author: .izik
source: The magnetic pulses from POKENAME's nose allow it to communicate silently with its flock. These conversations can disrupt nearby radio signals.

entry: POKENAME藏在深洞里，在磁性区域数量更多。牙齿虽不锋利，强颚却能咬碎较小的岩块。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hides in deep caverns, their numbers being greater in magnetic areas. While their teeth are not sharp, their powerful jaws are strong enough to crush small boulders.

entry: POKENAME鼻子灵敏，磁觉敏锐，能从很远的地方发现自己爱吃的矿物。
author: hophoppip
source: With its adept nose and keen magnetic sense, POKENAME can detect the minerals it loves to eat from a great distance away.

entry: POKENAME最爱金属含量高的石头。吃完一颗，便会转向下一颗磁石所在的方向。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME always prefers stones with the highest metal content. Once it has eaten one, it turns in the direction of the next magnetic stone.

entry: 角能释放强磁场，吸来富铁岩石，再反转磁极，将岩石作为危险弹丸射出。
author: chorb33
source: Its horn can emit a strong magnetic field, attracting iron-rich stones. It then reverses the field's polarity to fire them as dangerous projectiles.

entry: 它用角释放强磁力，吸来金属含量高的岩石，再改变磁极，将它们作为危险弹丸射出。
author: chorb33
source: It can emit strong magnetism via its horn to attract stones with a high metal content. It then changes polarity to fire them as dangerous projectiles.

entry: POKENAME群能用磁力寻找猎物。这种能力也能帮助海上迷途的船只。
author: lydiaprower8
source: A pack of POKENAME can search for prey with its magnetic abilities. Said abilities can also help boats lost at sea.

entry: POKENAME头上的磁石会散发刺角果气味，吸引猎物。它用电磁波让对方无力反抗，便于捕捉吃下。
author: .izik
source: The magnetic stones on POKENAME's head emit a Spelon Berry scent that attracts prey. It will use Thunder Wave to render them helpless, making them easy to capture and consume.

entry: 它们对磁力敏感，能循着精确的地理规律前进，曾是绘制世界地图集的关键帮手。如今，它们待在博物馆，帮馆员保存易损地图。
author: quackquackattack
source: They have been a pivotal part of the creation of a global atlas, as their sensitivity to magnetism allows them to follow precise geographical patterns. Nowadays, they spend their time in museums, helping curators preserve sensitive maps.

entry: POKENAME船锚的末端磁性极强。它拖着锚扫过海床，收集金属物件，夜里就睡在上面。
author: .izik
source: The end of POKENAME's anchor is extremely magnetic. It drags it across the seafloor to collect metal objects that it then sleeps on at night.

entry: POKENAME总面向太阳，不断调整位置，让自己正对着它。到了正午，POKENAME便仰面躺下，鼻子直指上方。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME always faces the sun, constantly shifting its position to line itself up perfectly. Once it hits midday, POKENAME will lie on its back, pointing its nose straight up.

entry: POKENAME在炎热沙漠中休息时，总将鼻子朝北。不朝这个方向就很难睡着，方向似乎以某种方式影响着休息。
author: .izik
source: When resting in the desert heat, POKENAME always points its nose north. It has trouble sleeping if it is not pointing in that direction, as its orientation is somehow vital for its rest.

entry: POKENAME由聚在金属结构周围的磁沙颗粒构成。它们从岩岸采集矿物，凝聚在沙粒中，不断加固自己依附的结构。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are assembled of particles of magnetic sand that concentrate around metal structures. They gather minerals from rocky shores and condense them within their grains to continuously build up the structures they cling to.

entry: POKENAME背上两个鼻状开口像小型吸尘器，行进时吸入散落矿物和孢子，获取养分。吃树果前，也常用这些器官吸掉表面的泥土。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The two nose-like openings along a POKENAME's back act as miniature vacuums, absorbing stray minerals and spores for nutrients as the POKENAME travels. POKENAME regularly use these extensions to clear off dirt from Berries before eating.

entry: 这种融合体的皮肤外层由坚实的蓝色岩石构成。POKENAME似乎与玛瑙水母存在共生关系，但具体如何，仍需进一步研究。
author: sondededoo
source: The outside layer of this fusion's skin is made up of durable blue rock. POKENAME seems to have a symbiotic relationship with Tentacool, though further study is required to know what that entails.

entry: POKENAME吃的种子越多，鼻子磁性就越强。它用磁力感知周围，以独特的敏锐感在环境中辨路。
author: .izik
source: The more seeds POKENAME eats, the more magnetic its nose gets. It uses this magnetism to sense the world around it, allowing it to navigate through environments with a unique sensitivity.

entry: POKENAME即将使出火系攻击前，双耳的磁力会变得极强。放出的火焰热得足以熔化铁。
author: .izik
source: The magnets coming from POKENAME's ears become incredibly strong right before it unleashes a fire-based attack. The flames it unleashes are hot enough to melt iron.

entry: POKENAME健康时冒白烟，受伤或营养不足时则冒深灰烟。心烦时，蒸汽会产生得更猛烈，从所有排气口一齐喷出。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME produces a white smoke when healthy, but makes dark gray smoke when it is injured or not getting sufficient nutrients. When it gets annoyed, steam is generated more vigorously and is expelled from all of its vents at once.

entry: POKENAME先提起松垂的皮肤，再从鼻子释放磁波。感应到矿石后，就会猛烈头撞洞壁，挖出来吃。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME pulls up its sagging hide before releasing magnetic waves from its nose. When it senses ore, it violently headbutts cave walls to dig and feed.

entry: 头上的叶盘中有根尖刺，如同指南针的针，始终指向正北。身体虽由沉重岩石构成，它却善于游泳，还能从水中吸收矿物。
author: infinex21
source: The pad atop its head houses a spike that acts like a compass's needle, always pointing due north. Despite its heavy, rocky body, it is a capable swimmer that can absorb minerals from water.

entry: POKENAME对恋爱幸福的人有奇特的吸引反应，感知到附近有情侣时，就会朝他们指去。深入调查发现，这种吸引竟无视磁力作用，让科学家十分困惑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have an odd attraction to people who are in a happy romantic relationship and will point in their direction when they sense couples nearby. Thorough investigation reveals that this attraction ignores magnetism, baffling scientists.

entry: 据说每只POKENAME的每颗头都不相同，如指纹般独一无二。一颗头打喷嚏，其他头也会跟着打，振动足以引发毁灭性地震。
author: sontyp
source: It's said that no two heads of any POKENAME are the same, making them as unique as fingerprints. When one head sneezes, the others follow suit, the vibrations of which can cause devastating earthquakes.

entry: POKENAME用脸上的磁性鼻子探测硬币，不停寻找新宝物，加入自己的收藏。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses the magnetic nose on its face to detect coins. It seeks them out to add to its horde, constantly on the lookout for new treasures to collect.

entry: POKENAME的爪磁性极强，能吸附金属表面。它借此提高敏捷度，轻易偷走领地内其他生灵的贵重物品。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's paws are extremely magnetic and allow it to cling to metal surfaces. It uses this ability to enhance its agility, allowing it to steal valuables from those in its territory with ease.

entry: POKENAME通常安静平和，但闻到某些特定气味，就会暴跳如雷。每只触发怒气的气味各不相同，因此很难防止它发脾气。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME usually remains sedate, but upon smelling certain trigger smells will fly into a frothing rage. The scents that trigger the anger are different for each individual, so preventing tantrums is difficult.

entry: POKENAME用精神能量轰击石头，雕刻着磨炼精神力。由于这个习惯，采石场里经常能见到它，工人会请它击碎大块石板。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME hone their psychic powers by carving stone with blasts of mental energy. They are a common sight within quarries thanks to this habit, with workers putting them to use in breaking down large slabs of rock.

entry: POKENAME鼻子朝北时，力量会增至三倍，轻易就能举起皮卡车，以增强的磁力压制周围。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME's nose is facing north, its strength triples. It can easily lift a pickup truck at this time, using its enhanced magnetic power to dominate its surroundings.

entry: POKENAME通常出现在偏远岛屿，几乎一动不动，呆望远方。古人曾相信，它们是已故长者的转世。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are usually found on remote islands, blankly staring into the distance while barely moving an inch. Ancient people used to believe that POKENAME were the reincarnations of their former elders.

entry: POKENAME的鼻子会指引它找到磁性矿脉，再挖出来吃。矿工会训练它带路，并奖励几块矿物。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's nose directs it toward veins of magnetic minerals, which it then excavates and consumes. Miners train it to lead them to these veins and reward it with chunks of the mineral.

entry: POKENAME嗅觉特殊，能辨别递到面前的任何石头或宝石的种类与品质。许多鉴定师会养一只，帮忙判断遇到的珠宝价值。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a specialized sense of smell, able to identify the type and quality of any stone or gem offered to it. Many appraisers keep one on hand to help with determining the value of any given jewel they come across.

entry: POKENAME身上的火焰其实是细磁丝。它在草地奔驰时，磁丝如火焰般翻卷，看起来像是火热能量在流动。
author: .izik
source: The flames on POKENAME's body are actually thin magnetic wires. They billow like flames as it gallops across meadows, giving the illusion of fiery energy in motion.

entry: POKENAME身上的鬃毛由细如发丝的磁丝构成，跑得太快就会变得很热。一天中需要多次停下来，防止过热伤到自己。
author: .izik
source: The thin-haired magnetic wire-comprised mane on POKENAME's body can get very hot if it runs too fast. It needs to take multiple stops throughout the day to ensure it doesn't overheat and cause harm to itself.

entry: POKENAME的头经常吵到试图互啄。但鼻子的磁极相同，只会将彼此的头弹回去，没法真正动粗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's heads often argue to the point of attempting to peck at each other. Due to their noses possessing the same magnetic polarity, this just causes their heads to be repelled back, preventing any real violence.

entry: 人们相信，它的鼻子灵敏得能闻到数英里外的气味。可惜，这本领受到POKENAME自身恶臭的妨碍。
author: hophoppip
source: Its nose is believed to be sensitive enough to detect smells from miles away. Unfortunately, this ability is impeded by POKENAME's own horrible stench.

entry: POKENAME用磁性鼻子导航、在水下推进，并收集稀有矿物。它将矿物制成尖刺，用磁力射向威胁自己的敌人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses its magnetic nose for navigation, underwater propulsion, and the collection of rare minerals. It forms these minerals into spikes, using magnetism to propel them at any foes that threaten it.

entry: POKENAME呼吸时会发出低沉空灵的声音，可据此辨认。若每夜都听到幽灵般的鼻息声，就是被它缠上了。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can be identified by the deep, ethereal noise it makes as it breathes. If you hear spectral snorting every night, you're being haunted by POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME用磁性鼻子寻找铁矿吃，能感应到一英里以外的隐秘矿藏。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its magnetic nose to find iron deposits and eat them. It can sense these hidden resources from over one mile away.

entry: POKENAME用大鼻子发出响亮鼻息，吓走小宝可梦，抢它们的残余食物。钳子只能产生很微弱的磁力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes loud snorting noises from its large nose in order to scare off small Pokémon and steal their food scraps. Its pincers generate a very low level of magnetism.

entry: POKENAME总是压力重重，会高速乱跑、撞向其他生灵，发泄焦虑。它乱跑前会发出尖锐嚎叫，听见便知道它要暴走了。
author: sk372
source: Constantly stressed, POKENAME vents its anxiety by running around at high speeds and tackling into others. One can tell if POKENAME is on a rampage by the high-pitched yowl of a scream it makes before it runs about.

entry: POKENAME熟练操控磁力，将石头抛向大群敌人。最初发现这种融合体的人，称它为“电之女祭司”。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME deftly manipulates magnetism to fling stones at large groups of enemies. Those who first discovered this fusion have dubbed it "the Electric Priestess."

entry: POKENAME无论走到哪里，似乎都会出现小方块，供它跳起打碎。一套极为成功、长盛不衰的电子游戏系列，主角就是一只这种宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: Wherever POKENAME goes, little blocks seem to form for it to jump up to and break. A very successful and long-running video game franchise stars a POKENAME as its main character.

entry: POKENAME捕猎带磁力的宝可梦，等它们离开洞窟，再悄然伏击。身体磁性极强，飞过时会吸来小金属物件。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hunts for magnetic Pokémon, waiting for them to leave their caves before silently ambushing them. Its body is so magnetic that small metal objects get attracted to its body as it flies overhead.

entry: POKENAME体形厚重，脾气暴躁，喜欢迎头冲进战斗，常将全身体重压进一拳。它也会很懒，研究发现，最能激励它的东西是大蒜。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Bulky and temperamental, POKENAME enjoy charging into battle headfirst, often throwing all their weight into a punch. POKENAME can be quite lazy, with research finding that the best type of motivator for them is garlic.

entry: POKENAME依靠电磁力悬浮，肩上的翼状浮游机便能脱离身体远攻。看似黑毛的部分由尖锐铁屑构成，身体表面十分粗砺。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME levitate using electromagnetism, freeing up their wing-like drones on their shoulders, which can detach to attack from afar. What looks like black fur is made of sharp iron filings, making their bodies highly abrasive.

entry: POKENAME收集成堆石头，刻成化石模样。研究者上当时，它会笑叫一声，再瞬移离开。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME collect piles of rocks, carving them to mimic fossils. When researchers are tricked by this, POKENAME let out a cry of laughter before teleporting away.

entry: POKENAME还无法完全控制磁力。训练家经常发现它被磁石拖走，牢牢吸住，直到进化或被吃掉。
author: _cradily_
source: POKENAME cannot fully control their magnetic powers yet. Trainers often find them getting dragged by magnetic rocks, where they stay stuck until they either evolve or get eaten.

entry: POKENAME几乎只能朝北看，即使遭到攻击，脸上也始终沉稳不变。曾有古代文明饲养数百只，用来守卫村庄。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are effectively unable to look in any direction but north, their faces remaining stoic even when attacked. There was once an ancient civilization that kept hundreds of these Pokémon, using them to guard their villages.

entry: POKENAME极其顽皮，常设置设计拙劣的陷阱，捉弄过路者。它经常用卑鄙伎俩与战术赢得战斗。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME are known to be incredibly mischievous and are seen setting up poorly designed traps to try to prank passersby. They frequently employ dirty tricks and tactics to win battles.

entry: POKENAME在沼泽游荡时，罐子和瓶盖会黏在身上。累了就到斜坡小睡，让减弱的磁力使杂物滑落。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME wanders through marshes, cans and bottlecaps stick to its body. When tired, it naps on a slope, letting its weakened magnetism slide the junk off.

entry: POKENAME头顶的磁沙发出极强磁场，总会指向北方。许多徒步者会养一只，避免迷路。
author: santon5512
source: The magnetic sand on top of POKENAME emits such a strong magnetic field that it will always point north. Many hikers will keep these Pokémon to avoid getting lost.

entry: 它用磁力吸在灯柱上，一动不动地待上数小时甚至数天。有人认为，它只是想融入周围，还自以为伪装成了人。
author: foolish_weasel
source: It uses its magnetism to attach itself to lamp posts, remaining there motionless for hours or days at a time. Some suggest that it is simply trying to blend in, thinking it is disguised as a person.

entry: POKENAME的壳如同坚固堡垒，几乎一生都附在树干上。头上的小旗是天线，用来与其他同类远程沟通。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Encased in a veritable fortress of a shell, POKENAME spends near the entirety of its life attached to a tree trunk. The little flag on its head is an antenna, which it uses to communicate remotely with other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME派出小型磁力浮游机，钻透、切开岩石，开凿隧道。它将浮游机嵌入石中作为牵引点，再使大鼻子磁化，便能迅速逃脱。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME send out their smaller magnetic drones to pierce through and carve out rocks to form tunnels. They lodge these drones into stone to act as tethers that allow them to escape quickly when they magnetize their large noses.

entry: POKENAME乐于把自己产生的汁液分享出去，却很少有对象愿意喝。由于独特的生理构造，汁液中经常飘着几根毛。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is happy to offer the juice it creates to others, but few ever partake. Due to its unique physiology, the juice it produces often has bits of its hair floating within.

entry: POKENAME常啃食船体与推进器，被视为船害。常用的清除方式是挠胡子，趁它分神，将它铲走。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are considered a pest to ships, often found eating away at the hulls and rotors. A popular way to remove them is to tickle their mustache, distracting them enough to be scooped off.
