entry: POKENAME走过训练家常走的路线，捡拾遗落物品。有些友好商店店主会出售它收集的东西。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME travels routes frequented by Trainers, picking up their dropped items. Some Poké Mart owners sell the items POKENAME collects.

entry: POKENAME能变出大锤，用来自卫和拆毁东西。为防止重要物品遭殃，许多人让它删除垃圾数据，它似乎乐在其中。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME manifests a large hammer for itself to wield to defend itself and demolish things. To keep it from wrecking something important, many task it with deleting junk data, which it seems to enjoy immensely.

entry: POKENAME痴迷于闪亮石头，常放进口袋妥善保管。有些大学会请它协助工程工作。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are obsessed with shiny rocks, often putting them in their pouches for safe keeping. Some universities have POKENAME assist with engineering.

entry: 只要三块石头均匀地绕身旋转，POKENAME体内的磁力就能让它悬浮。不高兴时，脸上的大胡子会窜过电光。
author: sk372
source: Magnetism in POKENAME's body allows it to levitate as long as the trio of rocks circle it evenly. When upset, lightning courses across the large mustache on its face.

entry: 描绘POKENAME的壁画表明，古人曾把它视作小小的守护神。传说它会向少数选中者吐出彩虹雾气，赐予如岩石般强韧坚实的身体。
author: sk372
source: Murals depicting POKENAME suggest people thought of it as a minor guardian deity in the past. According to legend, it would breathe a rainbow mist on a chosen few, who would be granted a body as strong and rugged as stone.

entry: POKENAME能利用磁场寻找隐藏宝物。身体两侧的探测棒，总会指向埋藏的宝藏。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME is a Pokémon with the ability to use the magnetic field to search for hidden treasure. The dowsers on the side of its body will always point to buried treasure.

entry: POKENAME是地下地区的好伙伴，非常擅长导航。奇怪的是，它似乎很喜欢烹饪。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME are useful companions in underground areas, as they make excellent navigators. Oddly, they seem to enjoy cooking.

entry: POKENAME鼻子下方由铁屑构成，能高效传导射向敌人的高压电力。因此，打喷嚏时，可能会不慎释放猛烈电脉冲。
author: gaogao028
source: The iron filings composing its lower nasal area greatly conduct the high-voltage energy which it discharges into foes. For this reason, when POKENAME sneezes, it may unintentionally let loose a violent electric pulse.

entry: POKENAME能将头部分缩入圆筒形身体中自保。遇险时会向一侧倒下，滚动逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can retract its head partially into its cylindrical body for safety. It topples itself over onto its side and rolls away to escape from danger.

entry: 能见到POKENAME在下水道里蹦跳，发出哔哔声。它尤其喜欢跳到熔岩蜗牛和草苗龟身上。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be spotted hopping through sewers making beeping noises as it jumps around. They have a penchant for jumping on Magcargo and Turtwig.

entry: 磁力与精神力相结合，让POKENAME能改变周围人和地形的位置。它担心训练家安危，经常伸出飘浮的双手，将对方拉近。
author: sk372
source: A combination of magnetism and psychic powers lets POKENAME manipulate the positions of people and terrain around it. It often reaches its floating hands out and grabs its Trainer to pull them close, worried for their safety.

entry: POKENAME住在森林中，温和而行动缓慢，极少卷入冲突。但若受逼迫，由于它战斗动作慢，身边飘浮的两架小石质浮游机会替它应战。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a gentle, slow-moving creature inhabiting the forests. It rarely gets involved in conflict, but if pressed, the two small stone drones that float alongside it help fight on its behalf, due to its slow speed in combat.

entry: 传说POKENAME是偏僻洞窟深处亡魂的代表，骄傲而难以捉摸。不活动时，虚幻形体会藏进红色鼻状石头中。
author: bobosmith01
source: According to legend, POKENAME acts as a proud and unpredictable representative of spirits that lost their life deep within secluded caverns. Its ethereal form hides inside the red nose-shaped stone when inactive.

entry: 传说POKENAME是偏僻洞窟深处亡魂的代表，骄傲而难以捉摸。不活动时，虚幻形体会藏进红色鼻状石头中。
author: bobosmith01
source: According to legend, POKENAME acts as a proud and unpredictable representative of spirits that lost their life deep within secluded caverns. Its ethereal form hides inside the red nose-shaped stone when inactive.

entry: 研究认为，POKENAME会被心地纯洁的人以近乎磁力般的实际力量吸引。一旦结下感情，就极难与训练家分开。
author: theartemis1
source: Research suggests that POKENAME experience a physical, almost magnetic pull toward humans with pure hearts. Once bonded, they are exceptionally difficult to separate from their Trainer.

entry: POKENAME冲锋虽缓慢笨重，却很少有东西能承受它头锤的冲击。有人见它用角的磁力清除杂物，仔细梳理颈边鬃毛。
author: sk372
source: Though its charge is slow and lumbering, few things can stand the impact of POKENAME's headbutt. It has been observed carefully grooming the mane around its neck, using magnetism from its horn to remove any debris.

entry: POKENAME用盾反射磁波，能有效保护高科技电子设备不受损伤。它借自身磁场悬浮，速度快得出人意料。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME reflects magnetic waves using its shield, making it a great help in protecting high-tech electronics from getting damaged. It is surprisingly fast, using its own magnetic field to levitate off the ground.

entry: POKENAME能制造强磁场，小睡时让对手无法靠近。想把食物拉近时，就从大鼻孔吸气，连起身都懒得尝试。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can create powerful magnetic fields that keep opponents at a distance while it naps. To draw food closer, it inhales through its large nostrils without even trying to get up.

entry: POKENAME背上的水晶能产生强大的磁场。朝北鼻和三合一磁怪等宝可梦会聚集在它身旁，盼望借此进化。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME produces a strong magnetic field from the crystals on its back. Certain Pokémon like Nosepass and Magneton hang around POKENAME in hopes to evolve.

entry: POKENAME通过磁力控制链条末端的小朝北鼻。休息时，小朝北鼻会指向正北。
author: .fedoraman
source: POKENAME controls the mini-nose at the end of its chain through magnetism. At rest, the mini-nose points due north.

entry: 红鼻子的头是身体核心，控制其他三颗头。核心的鼻子总指北，另外三颗头的鼻子则各指其余一个基本方位。
author: infinex21
source: The head with the red nose is the core of this Pokémon's body and the one that controls the other three heads. The core's nose will always point North and the noses of its other heads will each point in one of the other cardinal directions.

entry: POKENAME在人类附近徘徊，模仿他们的活动。人样的鼻子与胡子，看似是拙劣的伪装，但它发出的磁波会让人迷乱，很容易将它当成人。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME hangs around humans and mimics their activities. Its human-like nose and mustache may look like an ineffective disguise, but the disorienting magnetic waves POKENAME gives off make it easy to confuse it for a human.

entry: POKENAME的鼻子磁性极强，摸起来温暖。滴下的黏液可供医护人员制作舒缓药剂。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's nose is extremely magnetic and warm to the touch. The mucus that drips from it can be used by medical professionals to create soothing philtres.

entry: POKENAME从炮口发射的激光，会让金属物品变得磁性极强。幸好，这种效果过两天左右就会消退。
author: .izik
source: The lasers POKENAME fires from its cannon cause metal objects to become incredibly magnetic. Fortunately this effect fades after a couple of days.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛能轻易望见极远处。它盯住进入领地的对象，一旦锁定，就派小型浮游机去骚扰擅闯者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's eyes can see vast distances with ease. It focuses in on those who enter its territory and once locked on, sends its little drones off to harass them for trespassing.

entry: 好奇心与轻微的催眠作用，让许多生灵在黑暗中追随POKENAME的红色火焰。一旦靠近，它就用大鼻子深吸气，抽走对方一部分生命力。
author: sk372
source: Curiosity and a mild hypnotic effect compel many to follow after POKENAME's red flame in the dark. Once they draw near, it siphons some of their life force via deeply inhaling through its large nose.

entry: POKENAME的大胡子会闷住并扭曲歌声，使旋律变得低沉古怪，颤动不定。结果，催眠效果也只剩一半。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's large mustache muffles and distorts its singing voice, giving its song a very strange, deep and warbling tone. The song is only half as effective at putting others to sleep as a result.

entry: 经常能见到POKENAME带着一群大丁，免得它们被磁石吸住。它喜欢唱歌给孩子听，但金属般的声音会让其他种类的宝可梦不舒服。
author: _cradily_
source: POKENAME is often found carrying a bunch of Probobuff, to make sure they don't get stuck to magnetic rocks. They like singing to their babies, but the metallic sounds they make discomfort for other species.

entry: POKENAME头上的毛由磁性极强的材料构成。毛若竖起来，就说明附近有贵金属或宝石。
author: bradlybro199
source: The hair on a POKENAME's head is made from a highly magnetic material. If their hair stands up it is an indication that there are precious metals or gemstones nearby.

entry: POKENAME能从头部电磁铁释放强大电磁脉冲，让附近所有电子设备停摆。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can emit a powerful EMP via the electromagnet in its head, deactivating everything electronic in its vicinity.

entry: 它挥动翼尖磁化铁屑组成的小球，欢快起舞。POKENAME的舞蹈既能为伙伴打气，也能产生强磁场。
author: hophoppip
source: It performs cheerful dances, waving around the balls of magnetized iron fillings on its wing tips. Besides cheering on allies, POKENAME's dances also generate powerful magnetic fields.

entry: 幽灵能量，让金属聚集在双臂的头部周围。人们认为，它会将亡魂引往彼岸。
author: moopse
source: Ghostly energy causes metal to collect around the heads on its arms. It's thought to direct souls to the afterlife.

entry: 它将四肢摆成奇怪的角度，借此精细调整自身磁场的作用。一旦察觉威胁，便用成千上万根带磁性的针发动攻击。
author: staghorn
source: It poses with its limbs at strange angles, which allows it to fine-tune the effects of its natural magnetic field. If it senses a threat, it will attack using thousands of magnetized needles.

entry: POKENAME背上的磁铁能自由转动，主要用来收集附近散落的金属，存起来以后吃。战斗时，也会将金属吸附在身体其他部位，充作铠甲。
author: pkbonusducks
source: The magnet on POKENAME's back can rotate freely. This magnet's main function is to catch nearby loose metals for POKENAME to store and later eat. During battle, these metals may also be magnetized to the rest of POKENAME's body, acting as armor.

entry: POKENAME用爪撕开沉船船体。金属碎片会吸附在磁性身体上，形成临时铠甲，增强防御。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME tears apart sunken ship hulls with its claws. Shredded metal clings to its magnetic body, forming a makeshift armor that strengthens its defense.

entry: 它用强磁场让皮毛覆满金属，化作护身铠甲。出拳的威力，犹如掷出巨石。
author: melodydelune
source: Using its strong magnetic field, it coats its fur in metal to act as armor for its body. Its punches are equivalent to boulders being thrown.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀由铁磁流体构成，必须经常清理杂物，免得金属物件压得太重。燃烧的尾巴能将金属熔成没有磁性的液态。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME regularly needs to keep its wings free from debris so that it is not weighed down by metallic objects, as its wings are made out of ferrofluid. Its flaming tail can melt metal into a liquid, nonmagnetic state.

entry: POKENAME的身体比看起来更重，主要靠跳到敌人头上攻击。它似乎特别倾向于把龟类宝可梦当作对手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is heavier than it appears, so its primary method of attack is jumping onto a foe's head. It seems to have a strong inclination of viewing turtle-like Pokémon as rivals.

entry: POKENAME出人意料地善于跳跃。只要从下方跃起，拳头就能打碎砖块。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME is a surprisingly prolific jumper. Its fists can break bricks simply by jumping from underneath them.

entry: 大多数POKENAME住在这颗星球的地幔中。背上的磁铁能将铁块射入平流层。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Most POKENAME live in the mantle of the planet. The magnet on their back can launch chunks of iron into the stratosphere.

entry: POKENAME小巧的身体蕴含惊人磁力。大量使出力量时，头上的石帽会悬浮起来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME contains a surprising amount of magnetic power within its compact body. The stone cap on its head levitates when it exerts a large amount of its powers.

entry: 鼻子周围的壳由冰与磁石混合而成。它能用自身磁场排斥两只小朝北鼻，将其作为弹丸射出，再同样迅速地召回，再次进攻。
author: .jerden
source: The shell around its nose is formed from a mixture of ice and magnetic rock. Using the magnetic field it generates, it can repel its two Mini-Noses to fire them as projectile weapons, then recall them just as quickly to attack again.

entry: 很久以前，四只POKENAME与人类共同生活，守护着他们的城市。如今，人们每年都会在节庆上唱起一首古老的歌，向它们致敬。
author: doodledoo
source: A long time ago, four POKENAME lived with humanity and protected their cities. Nowadays, once a year during a festival, an ancient song is used as tribute to them.

entry: POKENAME独特的鼻子赋予它奇特的磁性嗅觉。它借此嗅出金属矿石，再用巨钳夹碎吃下。
author: zweizweihander
source: POKENAME has a peculiar sense of magnetic smell thanks to its unique nose. It uses it to sniff out metallic ore, which it then crushes with its massive claws and consumes.

entry: POKENAME的钢牙能迅速吸干猎物的生命。背上的囊袋被认为装着尚未吃完的食物。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's steel fangs quickly drain the life from its victims. The sack on its back is thought to hold its unfinished food.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的尖刺与其说是武器，不如说更适合威吓。它还不够强，挥不出多少力量，但遇险时会将刺高高举起，摆出凶狠架势。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The sharp stinger on the tail of POKENAME acts more as a deterrent than a real weapon. They are not strong enough to swing it with any force but will raise it menacingly when they feel endangered.

entry: 它以电力为食，充能至足以悬浮后，就用蓝布翅膀控制方向，以惊人速度俯冲攻击。
author: imaginita
source: It feeds on electricity until it is charged enough to levitate.  Then, it uses its blue-cloth wings to direct its movement, swooping with shocking speed to attack.

entry: POKENAME带着荣誉感与坚定决心挥剑，保护珍视的对象。野外常会成为守护嘎啦嘎啦与卡拉卡拉家庭的战士。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME wields its blade with honor and fierce dedication, determined to protect those it holds dear. It often places itself as a warrior that guards families of Marowak and Cubone in the wild.

entry: 它个子虽小，却相当勇敢，经常与比自己强大得多的宝可梦交战。主要靠挥动骨剑进攻。
author: fireblade141
source: Despite its small stature, it is quite brave, and it often finds itself in combat with Pokémon much stronger than it. It wields a bone sword as its primary form of offense.

entry: 它个子虽小，却相当勇敢，经常与比自己强大得多的敌人交战。主要靠在战斗中挥动骨剑进攻。
author: fireblade141
source: Despite its small stature, it is quite brave, often finding itself in combat with foes much stronger than it. It wields its bone sword in combat as its primary form of offense.

entry: POKENAME会突然伸出刀刃般的腿，毫无预警地将对手砍倒。人们相信，海盗用木桩假腿走路的本领就是它教的。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are known to quickly stretch their bladed leg at others and slice them down without warning. It is believed that these Pokémon taught pirates how to walk with peg legs.

entry: POKENAME每刺中敌人一次，就会吸走一点生命能量。若有人能撑过三分钟子弹般迅疾的连刺，它便会郑重归还对方全部生命力。
author: soup1900
source: Each time POKENAME stabs a foe, it drains a bit of their life energy from them. Anyone who survives three minutes of POKENAME volleying stabs at them at bullet-like speeds will honorably have all their life force returned back to them.

entry: POKENAME裹着的罩布如同保护茧，将它与外界隔开。头部伸出的钢刃是最后手段，只有宝可梦真正威胁到自身安全时才会拔出。
author: fiordaliso
source: The shroud wrapped around POKENAME shields it from the outside world, acting as a protective cocoon. The steel blade protruding from its head is reserved as a last resort, drawn only when a Pokémon poses a real threat to its safety.

entry: 它用锁链困住、勒紧敌人。奔跑时发出的响亮链响声，让四方生灵畏惧。
author: hophoppip
source: It uses its chains to trap and constrict enemies. The loud rattling sound it makes as it runs is feared far and wide.

entry: POKENAME以快得看不清的速度冲向宝可梦，用鞘将其击昏，再用镰刀收割全部生命能量。
author: soup1900
source: Moving at blinding speeds, POKENAME runs up to Pokémon and hits them with its sheath to knock them unconscious. Once it has done so, it uses its scythe to reap all of their life energy.

entry: POKENAME有两把镰刀，但始终有一把收在鞘里。这样就能与其他生灵接触，不至于把对方切开、收割生命力。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has two scythes, but one is always covered inside of its sheath. This allows it to interact with other beings without slicing them apart and reaping their life force.

entry: 传说POKENAME是引魂者，指引死在冰寒地区的宝可梦。据说，枪尖周围缭绕的雾状细丝，就是徘徊在此世与彼世之间的灵魂。
author: eloquent_panda
source: Legends state that POKENAME act as psychopomps,  guides for Pokémon who have perished in icy regions. It is said that the misty tendrils of fog swirling around their spearheads are souls drifting between this world and the next.

entry: 寒夜里，POKENAME用生命能量保暖。一旦用角夹住猎物，蓝布便会裹上去，挤出受害者的生命力。
author: soup1900
source: During cold nights, POKENAME uses life energy to keep itself warm. Once it has gripped its prey with its horns, the blue cloth will wrap around and squeeze the life force out of the victim.

entry: 经常能见到POKENAME独自待在寂静诡异的湖里，因为其他宝可梦不是逃走，就是倒在它的怒火下。传闻剑状尾巴会收集猎物灵魂，让它更强大。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME is often found eerily alone in lakes, as all other Pokémon have either fled or fallen to its wrath. Rumor has it that its sword-like tail collects the souls of its prey, further increasing its power.

entry: POKENAME吸取敌人的生命力时，也会继承一部分遗传信息。某些类群的DNA积累到足够多，可能使它突变。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME drains foes of their life force, it inherits a part of their genetics. Enough DNA from certain groups of species may cause this Pokémon to mutate.

entry: POKENAME嘴衔刀剑，在大地各处冒险。一只奇怪的小生灵伴它同行，大声提醒它注意各种东西，经常让它觉得烦。
author: sk372
source: Clutching a blade in its mouth, POKENAME goes off on various adventures across the land. A strange little creature accompanies it, loudly drawing its attention to things and often coming across as a nuisance to POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME将牙齿的电力传入嘴衔的剑。每次带电挥剑，都会放出小电光，如同细小匕首般刺穿敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME transfers electricity from its fangs into the sword it holds in its mouth. Each charged swing of the blade sends out little bolts of lightning that pierce foes like tiny daggers.

entry: 战斗时，它用炽烈火焰包裹嘴衔的剑，烧伤所有接触者。若POKENAME与训练家结下感情，就会毫不犹豫地终生保护对方。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it battles, it envelops the sword it holds in its mouth with a blazing aura that burns anyone who comes into contact with it. If POKENAME bonds with a Trainer, it will protect that person for life without hesitation.

entry: 战斗时，它用炽烈火焰包裹嘴衔的剑，烧伤所有接触者。若POKENAME与训练家结下感情，就会毫不犹豫地终生保护对方。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it battles, it envelops the sword it holds in its mouth with a blazing aura that burns anyone who comes into contact with it. If POKENAME bonds with a Trainer, it will protect them for life without hesitation.

entry: POKENAME因武器能力而常被用于电子游戏中。它的动作十分有限，只能像真正的剑一样攻击、劈砍。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is often used inside of video games for its weapon abilities. It has very limited movement, only being able to attack and cleave like an actual sword.

entry: POKENAME住在刀刃形的长壳里。壳的两侧锋利，任何东西碰上都会被割伤。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME lives inside a long shell in the shape of a blade. The sides of the shell are sharp, so anything that touches its shell will get cuts on itself.

entry: POKENAME每次蜕壳，嵌在壳里的剑都会掉出来。壳脆弱、重新生长的短暂时期，它会用小爪握剑，刺向靠近的饥饿天敌。
author: soup1900
source: Each time POKENAME molts its shell, the sword lodged in it falls out. During this short phase where the shell is weak and regrowing, it holds onto this blade with its tiny claws to stab at hungry predators that try to approach it.

entry: POKENAME飞在高空，用尾刃从上方攻击猎物，再用利齿咬穿坚韧皮肤，抽取生命力。
author: soup1900
source: Flying high in the sky, POKENAME uses the blade on its tail to strike prey from above. It then uses its sharp fangs to break through tough hide and extract the life force from its prey.

entry: POKENAME循着云迹飞遍世界，不问去向。看见有人遇险，就用剑解决威胁，再悄无声息地返回天空，继续漫游。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME flies around the world, following cloud trails wherever they lead. When POKENAME sees someone in trouble, it dispatches the threat with its sword and returns to wandering the skies without a single sound.

entry: POKENAME总紧握收着刀刃的剑鞘。宝可梦与剑有精神联系，因此武器离手后也能独立行动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME always clings tightly to the scabbard holding its blade. The Pokémon and the sword share a psychic link, allowing the weapon to operate independently outside of POKENAME's grip.

entry: POKENAME挥动布带，似乎能迷住目标，随后POKENAME便冲上去，狠狠咬住对方。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME's cloth seems to enchant its victims when waved around before POKENAME charges and bites down on them.

entry: POKENAME能用背上的火焰锻造出剑，再以此迎敌。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME can forge swords from the flames on its back, which it then uses to fight with.

entry: POKENAME在河石上磨利金属刀刃，随时准备战斗。若遇上技巧出众、富有魅力的训练家，它可能主动加入队伍。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME sharpens its metal blade against river stones to stay ready for battle. If it meets a skilled and charismatic Trainer, POKENAME may willingly join their team.

entry: 它挑战同类进行生死决斗，磨炼剑术。若被缴械，POKENAME就用强壮的牙齿自卫。
author: fiordaliso
source: It trains its fencing skills by challenging others of its kind to deadly duels. If disarmed, POKENAME defends itself with its powerful teeth.

entry: 它逆流游泳，不断锻炼强健肌肉。若战斗中败给同类POKENAME，便会在结束时献上自己的剑，放弃争夺的领地。
author: fiordaliso
source: It swims upstream to constantly train its strong muscles. If defeated in battle by a rival POKENAME, it offers its sword at the end of the fight and abandons the disputed territory.

entry: POKENAME的腿裹着织网用的丝。解开这些鞘般的丝层，就会露出刀刃般的双腿，只有真正暴怒、准备将敌人切成碎条时才会使用。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's legs are covered in the silk it uses to build webs. Unraveling these sheathes reveals the blades that are its legs, used only when it is truly angry and ready to slice a foe to ribbons.

entry: POKENAME还没力气拿稳刀刃，常直接掉在地上。这时，刀刃上的缎带会不慎拍中它的脑袋，反把刀刃自己也吓一跳。
author: soup1900
source: Not yet strong enough to carry its blade, POKENAME often drops it straight into the ground. When this happens, the ribbon on the blade accidentally smacks it right on the head, which startles the blade.

entry: POKENAME会挥舞小剑自保。兴奋时尤其爱蹦跳，很难击中它。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wield a small sword that they swing around to protect themselves. They are difficult to strike when they bounce around, especially when they are excited.

entry: 被POKENAME刀刃刺中的对象，会感到快乐流失。它用腰带般的尾巴轻轻一碰，就能将这份喜悦传给别人。
author: .izik
source: Those pricked by POKENAME's blade feel their happiness drain away. With a gentle touch of its sash-like tail, it can pass that joy to someone else.

entry: POKENAME以金属喙为主要武器，凶猛啄击靠得太近的对象。中世纪纹章旗帜上常画着它，被浪漫化为骑士精神的象征。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wield a metallic beak as their primary weapon, pecking viciously at those who get too close. They were popular Pokémon to depict on heraldic banners in medieval times, the Pokémon being romanticised as a chivalric symbol.

entry: POKENAME会无情地攻击路上遇见的宝可梦。它用剑中的力量迅速治愈伤口。
author: amberaxolotl223
source: POKENAME fight ruthlessly against any Pokémon it catches in its path. It uses the power inside of its sword to heal wounds quickly.

entry: 召来阳光的舞蹈，不只是为了靠光合作用维生。POKENAME的剑由特殊金属构成，晒到阳光就会变得锋利，让战斗更有效。
author: sk372
source: Its sun-summoning dance moves are not just to sustain itself through photosynthesis. POKENAME's sword is made of a unique metal that sharpens when exposed to sunlight, making it more effective in combat.

entry: 剑上的流苏紧紧裹住POKENAME的眼睛，让它无法视物。即便如此，战斗仍从容优雅、技艺精湛，许多人相信，是武器在指引它的一举一动。
author: sk372
source: The blade's tassel firmly wraps around POKENAME's eyes, rendering it blind. Despite this, it fights with measured grace and skill; many believe the weapon guides its every move.

entry: POKENAME将自己埋在路边，等待认可的训练家。只有真心努力与它交朋友、好好培养它的人，才能让它自行破土而出。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME bury themselves in the sides of roads, waiting for Trainers that they deem worthy. Only a Trainer that makes an effort to befriend and properly raise a POKENAME will lead it to unearth itself.

entry: 它靠布片般的翅膀在城镇间飘游蹦跳。战斗时会尽可能升到高处，再挥刃攻击。
author: schwaus
source: It uses its cloth wings to float and bounce across towns. During battles it gains as much height as possible before attacking with its blade.

entry: POKENAME在火山下的极高压力中成长，喷发时被抛离出生地。它漫游大地，向宝可梦挑战决斗，却会耍阴招，用剑上的流苏手臂绊倒敌人。
author: ghostslythe
source: Raised in the highest pressure under volcanoes, POKENAME are hurled far from their birthplace during eruptions. They wander the lands, challenging Pokémon to duels, but fighting dirty using their sword's tassel arm to trip foes.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴始终覆有毒膜，谁想摸它都会严重中毒。若碰到三个尖端中的任何一处，还会被刺穿皮肤，剧痛难忍。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's tail is always coated in a toxic film that greatly poisons anyone who tries to touch it. If one were to touch any of its three sharp points, it would pierce right through your skin and cause immense pain.

entry: 人们认为POKENAME的出现会招来纷争。可若在开战前看见它，又被视为己方必胜的征兆。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The presence of a POKENAME is thought to bring about strife. Seeing one before battle is thought to be a sure sign of victory for your side.

entry: POKENAME出手迅捷，却颇为笨拙，精力旺盛，也同样足智多谋。它们都有一个目标：成为受人尊敬、声名远扬的战士。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME are swift, yet rather clumsy strikers whose high energy is only matched by their resourcefulness. They all share a common goal: to become a respected and renowned warrior.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃很小，在进化前，会用大得多的剑鞘威吓天敌。
author: kiwiarms
source: Due to the small size of their blades, POKENAME use their much larger scabbards to deter predators until they're able to evolve.

entry: POKENAME在战场上搜寻甲胄碎片，焊在自己身上。它也会伏击其他拾荒者。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME scavenges battlefields for pieces of armor to weld to itself. It ambushes other scavengers.

entry: POKENAME用刀刃般的尾巴铲土。领地争斗时，也会拿尾巴互相冲刺交锋。
author: blitzydragon
source: POKENAME use their blade-like tails to move dirt, akin to a spade, but also use them to joust with one another during territorial conflict.

entry: POKENAME吵闹好斗，但只要握着柄把它提起来，就会立刻安静下来。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is rowdy and acts aggressively, but quickly calms down when picked up by its handle.

entry: POKENAME用爪将木块刻成剑。月夜里，头上的旋纹会微微发光，披风也仿佛活了过来。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME carve swords from pieces of wood using their claws. On moonlit nights, the swirl patterns on their heads glow faintly; their cloaks almost seem alive on such nights as well.

entry: POKENAME总在试着打造一把完美的剑，供自己栖身。但完美主义使它永远无法满意。
author: kiwiarms
source: POKENAME spends its time trying to craft the perfect sword to inhabit. Its own perfectionism prevents it from ever being satisfied with its work, though.

entry: POKENAME虽然看起来像手枪，其实是一种匕首。这是贝氏拟态的一例。
author: kiwiarms
source: Though it looks like a handgun, POKENAME is actually a type of dagger. This is an example of Batesian mimicry.

entry: POKENAME是热情尽责的邮差，颇负盛名。可惜，它保护邮件太过热心，训练家只要靠邮包太近，就会被它赶走。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are renowned for being passionate and dedicated mail carriers. Unfortunately, they often get so passionate about defending the mail they carry that they will fight off any Trainers that get too close to their bags.

entry: POKENAME潜伏在高草丛中，准备伏击小型啮齿宝可梦。猎物足够近时，就会放松腹部肌肉，挥动体内的剑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME lurks in tall grass, ready to ambush small rodent Pokémon. When its prey is close enough, it releases its stomach muscles to swing the sword within its body.

entry: 古时，POKENAME曾是沙漠国王的忠诚卫士。它用鼻子持剑，如剑术高手般灵巧，剑的动作仿佛有自己的意识。
author: ozydamians
source: In days of yore, POKENAME served as the loyal guards of desert kings. They wield the swords in their trunks with the dexterity of an expert fencer, moving as if it has a mind of its own.

entry: POKENAME用刀刃在吸过生命能量的猎物身上刻符号。依心情不同，符号可能十分清晰，也可能潦草凌乱，难以辨认。
author: soup1900
source: Using its blade, POKENAME hacks symbols into the bodies of prey it has drained life energy from. Depending on its emotions, the symbols are either really clear or extremely messy and unrecognizable.

entry: POKENAME一挥刀刃般的手臂，就能放出小电火花。未经训练时，常会割开电线，将双臂分别接在两端充当导体，因为喜欢电流流过身体的感觉。
author: bobosmith01
source: With a wave of its bladed arms, POKENAME can let loose small sparks of electricity. Without training, it habitually cuts open wires and connects both arms to each end to act as a conduit; it likes the feeling of a current running through its body.

entry: POKENAME颈部皮膜里藏着刀刃，狩猎时会从嘴中伸出。它像挥剑一样挥动头部，攻击其他宝可梦。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME has a concealed blade in its hood that erupts from its mouth when hunting. It swings its head like a sword to attack other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的布尾巴勉强有力气托住身体。它虽会自己走路，但通常能见到它靠在布尾巴上休息。
author: fireflower20002
source: The cloth tail of POKENAME is strong enough to carry it, although not by much. POKENAME will walk on its own, but you can usually see POKENAME resting on its cloth tail.

entry: 它喜欢同时抛接多把利刃，逗人和宝可梦开心。人们认为刀刃受了诅咒，因为每个试图从POKENAME手中抢走它们的人，第二天都死于可怕的不明疾病。
author: milchik
source: It likes entertaining people and Pokémon by juggling multiple sharp blades at once. These blades are believed to be cursed, as every person who ever tried to snatch them from POKENAME has died from a horrible unknown disease the very next day.

entry: POKENAME挥舞的刀刃带有超过100,000伏的电力。只消一挥，即使最大的宝可梦也会失去行动能力。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME wields a blade infused with over 100,000 volts of electricity. In one swing, it can incapacitate even the largest of Pokémon.

entry: 它的草叶利刃一挥就能斩倒树木。身上长出的厚重金属铠甲能抵挡其他POKENAME的攻击。
author: schwaus
source: Its blade of grass can cut down trees with a single stroke. It grows a thick metallic armor to protect itself from other POKENAME.

entry: 尽管身披金属铠甲，仍常能见到它飞快地纵跃于林间。POKENAME在森林中相遇，便会交战，直到剑刃崩出缺口。
author: schwaus
source: Despite its metal armor, it is often seen leaping through forests at breakneck speeds. When POKENAME find each other in forests they fight until their blades chip.

entry: POKENAME潜伏沙下，伏击商队与毫无戒心的旅人，抢光他们的补给。它熟练挥使钢剑，即使睡觉也不离身。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME lurks beneath desert sands, ambushing caravans and unsuspecting travelers to strip them of all their provisions. It wields its steel sword with remarkable skill and never parts with it, even in sleep.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃能切开实心钛，不用时便以剑柄护住刀刃，免得伤人。遇袭时，会蜷起身体自卫。
author: lydiaprower8
source: POKENAME's blade can cut through solid titanium, so to avoid hurting anyone, it puts the hilt on its blade when not in use. It curls itself up to defend itself from enemy attacks.

entry: POKENAME的头能完整旋转360度，让它用独眼看遍周围。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME are able to rotate their heads a full 360 degrees. This allows them to fully inspect their surroundings with their singular eye.

entry: 它一生只与一位训练家结下感情，彼此情感越强，刀刃就越锋利。村民会在古战场留下供品，它的同类仍在那里一动不动地守卫。
author: jaminmcready
source: It bonds with a single Trainer for life, and its blade grows sharper the stronger their emotions become. Villagers leave offerings at old battlegrounds where its kind still stands guard, unmoving.

entry: POKENAME发展出将剑术与缎带舞优美结合的战斗风格。不过，学习时经常被自己的缎带缠住。
author: rakanadyo
source: POKENAME develops a fighting style that beautifully combines swordplay and ribbon dancing. While learning, though, it often gets tangled up in its own ribbon.

entry: POKENAME是骑士精神与力量的象征。剑始终隐形，只向值得它保护的对象显现。
author: cinnamoncreampuff
source: POKENAME is known as a symbol of chivalry and strength. Its sword is kept invisible and only revealed to those who are worthy of its protection.

entry: POKENAME将全部磁力集中在刀刃，吸入生命力。如果磁化的东西没有生命能量，就会反转磁力，将其远远弹开。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME focuses all of its magnetic forces into its blade to pull life forces in. If it magnetizes something that doesn't have life energy, it reverses its magnetism to repel the object far away.

entry: POKENAME似乎是一团盘踞空剑鞘的灵魂。战斗时，灵魂会凝成巨大而锋利的刀刃，攻击其他生灵。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears to be a mass of spirits haunting an empty scabbard. The spirits form themselves into a huge razor-sharp blade to strike at others in battle.

entry: POKENAME用刀刃抽取猎物的波导，增强自己的波导。受害者会变得没有情绪、呆滞而茫然。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its blades to drain the auras from its prey and strengthen its own. The drained victims are left emotionless, dull, and aimless afterwards.

entry: POKENAME头上的剑柄碍事，咬击对手很不方便。夜里会用大块蓝布裹住自己保暖。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has an awkward time chomping at opponents due to the handle on its head getting in the way. It wraps its large blue cloth around itself to keep itself warm during the night.

entry: POKENAME用布将刀刃高举，向遇到的敌人刺下。打偏时，有时会砸中自己，但只是刀身侧面碰到，伤得不重。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its cloth to hold its blade high and stab down at foes it encounters. It will sometimes hit itself when it misses, but only with the sides of the blade, so it doesn't hurt it that much.

entry: POKENAME用布高举刀刃，向洞窟地面反复刺下、凿开，直到碰到地热喷口，让热气涌入家中。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its cloth to hold its blade high and stab down at the ground inside its cave to chip into it. It will keep doing this until it hits a geothermal vent and heat pours into its home.

entry: POKENAME刀刃钝了，就会在巨口的牙齿上摩擦磨利。它先以剑术削弱敌人，再一口咬下，给予最后一击。
author: nugamallow
source: When POKENAME's blade is dull, it sharpens the sword by rubbing it against the teeth from its maw. It weakens the opposing Pokémon with swordplay before delivering the final blow with one bite.

entry: 野生POKENAME粗触手间有一条细缎带，可据此与珊瑚和岩石区分。它能吸取珊瑚的生命能量，但为了维持礁间伪装，不会这样做。
author: soup1900
source: One can tell a wild POKENAME apart from coral and rocks by the single thin ribbon it has from its thick tentacles. It can drain the life energy of coral, but it doesn't do so to maintain its camouflage within the reef.

entry: 野生POKENAME粗触手间有一条细缎带，可据此与珊瑚和岩石区分。它能吸取珊瑚的生命能量，但为了维持礁间伪装，不会这样做。
author: soup1900
source: One can tell a wild POKENAME apart from coral and rocks by the single thin ribbon it has from its thick tentacles. It can drain the life energy of coral, but it doesn't do so to maintain its camouflage within the reef.

entry: POKENAME始终用小爪握着刀刃，用长缎带状的爪拿着剑鞘。这两样东西太重，它必须不停向上游，才不会沉下去。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME will always have its blade gripped by its small claw and its sheath held by its long ribbon claw. It has to constantly swim upwards in order to not sink due to these two large weights.

entry: POKENAME头顶整个都是眼睛，因此避免撞头。它只能改用脑后的刀刃，劈倒树木与猎物。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME avoids headbutting things, as its eye makes up the entirety of the top of its head. It instead must slash with the blade on the back of its head to slice down trees and prey.

entry: POKENAME冲向敌人时，用装甲面部挡下所有攻击，撞上时再用刀刃刺中对方。奔跑时，背上的蓝缎带如超级英雄披风般飘扬。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME charges at enemies, it uses its armored face to block all attacks while its blade stabs the opponent once it collides. The blue ribbon on its back flows like a superhero cape while it is running around.

entry: POKENAME凭顽强意志，撑过本该致命的伤口。不过插在颈间的剑，仍会影响它的身体。
author: ayner
source: The sheer determination of POKENAME has made it able to withstand its normally fatal wound. The sword in its neck can influence the body nonetheless.

entry: POKENAME是一副废弃的宝可梦铠甲，经超自然力量赋予生命。卡洛斯常用它守护外国贵宾。曾有能熔化钢属性宝可梦的攻击打中它，它却毫发无伤。
author: ghostslythe
source: A discarded set of Pokémon armor given life by supernatural means, POKENAME are often employed in Kalos as guardians to foreign dignitaries. They have been known to survive attacks that melt Steel types completely unscathed.

entry: 据说背上的剑会回应伟大英雄的灵魂。只有成功从石中拔剑的人，才会被POKENAME认可为训练家。
author: bostroms
source: The sword on its back is said to react to the soul of a great hero.  Only once someone has successfully pulled the sword from the stone will POKENAME recognize that person as its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME用尾火锻造粗制刀刃，用来自卫、串刺小猎物，以及撬开树上的坚果。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME forges its own crude blade using the flame on its tail. Its uses include self-defense, skewering small prey, and prying open tree nuts.

entry: POKENAME长途跋涉，寻找火山。只有在那里，才能锻造出合乎自己标准的刀刃。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME journeys long distances in search of a volcano. Only there can it forge a blade up to its standards.

entry: 两把剑正学习协同技巧，准备迎战更强的敌人，再平分生命力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: These two swords are learning cooperative techniques so they can take on tougher opponents and split the life force.

entry: 这只POKENAME正在分裂，尝试新的战术。两条缎带，也让动作更加灵巧。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This POKENAME is in the process of splitting. It is attempting new tactics and its two ribbons give it more dexterity.

entry: 两把剑正学习协同技巧，准备迎战更强的敌人，再平分生命力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: These two swords are learning cooperative techniques so they can take on tougher opponents and split the life force.

entry: 这只POKENAME的剑身已经长长，作战时也改用长剑技法，不再沿用短剑的招式。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Having grown in length, this POKENAME has now adopted longsword rather than shortsword combat techniques.

entry: 国王曾把POKENAME挂在王座上方的墙上。时机一到，它就会从墙上飞下，保卫国王。
author: huh.7
source: Kings used to put POKENAME on the walls above their thrones. When the time came, POKENAME would fly off the wall and defend their king.

entry: POKENAME刀刃变钝时，会用蓝布包住，防止进一步损坏，再找坚盾剑怪借一面盾，重新磨剑。
author: soup1900
source: If POKENAME's blade dulls out, it will wrap it with its blue cloth to protect it from further damage. It then finds an Aegislash to borrow a shield from and uses it to resharpen its blade.

entry: POKENAME漫游沙漠，寻找值得一战的对手，检验剑术。尾部的一部分呈军刀状，它不断在沙中摩擦，保持光亮。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME wanders the desert in search of worthy opponents to test its fencing skills. It constantly rubs the saber that forms part of its tail in the sand to keep it shiny and polished.

entry: POKENAME的两条缎带锐利如钢。它动作优雅，迅速挥斩，直取要害。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's twin ribbons are as sharp as steel. Its movements are graceful as it unleashes swift slashes aimed at vital points.

entry: 神话称POKENAME原是蔚蓝的战士，保护心爱的鬃岩狼人伙伴时，受侵蚀变成了恶属性宝可梦。但传说若属实，它如今野蛮的战斗风格，也已看不出昔日高贵骑士的影子。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME is described in myth as an azure-blue warrior who was corrupted into a Dark-type Pokémon while defending its beloved Lycanroc companion. But if this legend is true, its feral fighting style bears no trace of the noble knight it once was.

entry: 战斗越激烈，POKENAME就越将储存的力量注入刀刃。武器充能完毕便会明亮发光，继而爆发，化成更强大的纯能量形态。
author: sk372
source: The fiercer the battle taking place, the more POKENAME channels its stored power into its blade. The weapon glows bright when fully charged before erupting into a much more powerful form of pure energy.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME会出来寻找容易下手的猎物，吸取生命力。它借月光的力量悬浮、操控刀刃，轻松砍倒敌人。
author: soup1900
source: On full moons, POKENAME comes out in hunt for easy prey to drain life forces from. Using power from the moonlight, it can levitate its blade and control it to effortlessly slash foes down.

entry: POKENAME的等离子体刀刃由太阳能供能，白天可以不休息地战斗。即使夜里能量耗尽，也会把剑柄当钝器，继续作战。
author: kiwiarms
source: POKENAME's plasma blade is solar powered, meaning it can fight without rest during the daytime. Even if it runs out of power during the night, it will keep fighting by using its hilt as a blunt instrument.

entry: 满月时，POKENAME成群聚集，用月之石碎片铸剑，再始终带在身边。
author: melodydelune
source: During a full moon, groups of POKENAME gather to forge their swords out of Moon Stone fragments. They will carry these swords with them at all times.

entry: POKENAME喜欢锐利物品，偏爱小刀与匕首。它们在月光下磨刃，借月亮能量将其磨至完美，再扮演中世纪骑士。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME have an affinity for sharp objects, preferring to use small knives and daggers. They sharpen their blades under the light of the moon, using lunar energy to hone them to perfection, then play at being medieval knights.

entry: POKENAME战斗时迅捷灵敏，用短促跳跃闪避，一有机会就挥剑。它不用剑鞘，而将剑收在背部棉絮般的绒毛里。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is quick and nimble in battle, bobbing about with short evasive hops and striking with its sword whenever opportunity arises. Rather than a sheath, it stores the sword in the cottony fluff on its back.

entry: POKENAME整天练习魔术。虽然棺材之后能重新拼好，但一次次被切成两半，可不是什么愉快的事——可演出还得继续！
author: kiwiarms
source: POKENAME spend all day practicing their magic act. Though the coffin is able to put itself back together afterwards, being cut in half over and over isn't pleasant, but the show must go on!

entry: POKENAME能将体内刀刃完全伸出或收回。它会将刃插进地面，免得被人捡起扔走。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can fully retract and extend a blade from inside its body. It will stick this blade into the ground to prevent itself from being picked up and chucked away.

entry: POKENAME用手形缎带抓取猎物的生命力。得手后，立刻将缎带收回体内，一口吞下生命能量。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its hand-shaped ribbons to grab life force out of prey. Once it has snatched their life force, it instantly retracts its ribbon inside its body, swallowing the life energy whole.

entry: POKENAME能改变钥匙形身体，配合将要开启的锁。第一次没成功，就会试着靠蛮力硬插进去。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can change its key-shaped body to fit the lock it is about to pick. If it fails on the first try, it tries to force its way in with brute force.

entry: POKENAME由两个争夺同一宿主控制权的灵魂构成。谁都不会想被卷进它们的争斗。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME consists of two spirits fighting for control of a single host. You wouldn't want to be caught in the crossfire of their skirmish.

entry: 它看似失明，其实靠挥使的刀刃状器官感知周围。刀刃切过什么，就会吸取其生命力。
author: silverscloudy
source: Though it appears to be blind, it actually makes use of the blade-like organ it wields to perceive its surroundings. It saps the life force of anything this blade cuts through.

entry: 体内寄居着亡者的灵魂。它不知疲倦地四处奔走，只为完成那个灵魂的遗愿。
author: .flipside3
source: A departed soul rests inside this Pokémon. It tirelessly seeks to fulfill that soul's dying wish.

entry: POKENAME整天挥着小金属剑练习剑术。被训练家收服后，会像骑士一样宣誓终生效忠。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME spends entire days practicing its fencing techniques, wielding a small metal sword. When captured by a Trainer, it pledges lifelong loyalty, just like a knight.

entry: POKENAME虽然非常害怕，却仍会勇敢踏入危险地区，寻找迷途或受伤的宝可梦。经常能听见它哼歌，安抚紧张的心情。
author: santon5512
source: Despite being quite scared, POKENAME will courageously trek into dangerous areas in search of lost or hurt Pokémon. They can often be heard humming to themselves to ease their nerves.

entry: 野生POKENAME埋伏沙下，一连数日等待猎物。不幸的生灵一踩进张开的颚，就会被猛然夹住，从脚踝开始迅速吸取生命力。
author: kiwiarms
source: Wild POKENAME lie in wait for prey under the sand for days at a time. Once an unlucky soul steps into its open jaws, they snap shut to quickly begin draining the life force out of the victim's ankle.

entry: POKENAME用刀刃刺穿鸟宝可梦，再以缎带吸取生命力，希望借此继承飞行本领，像受害者一样翱翔天空。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME skewers bird Pokémon with its blade and then drains them of their life force using its ribbon. It hopes that by doing this, it will inherit the ability to fly and soar through the skies like its victims.

entry: POKENAME将刀刃般的齿轮像手里剑一样掷向敌人。锋利齿轮迅速击中后，总会回到原位，准备再次出击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME tosses the bladed gear towards its foes like a shuriken. The sharpened gear strikes quickly before unfailingly returning to its proper place, ready to strike again.

entry: 这种宝可梦精通多种剑术。据说能举剑从天空汲取力量，远程攻击敌人。即使被击倒在地，也能迅速弹起，保护珍视的对象。
author: infranscia
source: This Pokémon is skilled in a variety of sword techniques.  It's said it can raise its sword to draw power from the sky, and use it to attack foes at range.  If knocked to the ground, it can bounce back readily to protect those it cares about.

entry: 据说独剑鞘曾怜惜一只孤独的小火龙，任它握起自己。如今，两者英勇冒险，铲除邪恶。
author: nellnast42
source: It is said that a Honedge once took pity on a lonely Charmander, allowing itself to be wielded. Now, the two adventure valiantly to vanquish all evil.

entry: POKENAME的攻击连剑术高手都会摸不透。它通常温顺，但看见谁伤害花朵，就会攻击谁。
author: .flipside3
source: The attacks of a POKENAME can confound even experts in swordplay. It is usually docile, but will attack anything it sees harming flowers.

entry: POKENAME会向打扰睡眠的对象挥舞细剑。击中面具能让它短暂晕眩，给想偷东西的人逃跑的时间。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME brandish their rapiers against those who disturb their slumber. Striking their mask momentarily stuns them, giving a potential thief time to escape.

entry: POKENAME头朝下嵌入洞窟石壁冬眠。露在外面的腰带状部分是感觉器官，能察觉何时条件适合苏醒。
author: kiwiarms
source: POKENAME embed themselves headfirst in the stone walls of caves to hibernate. Their exposed sash acts as a sensory organ, detecting when conditions are right for the POKENAME to awaken.

entry: POKENAME最早在中世纪被发现，据传出没于古战场。古文献记载，它们曾作为骑士的侍从参与征战。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A Pokémon first discovered in the middle ages, POKENAME were rumored to be found on ancient battlefields. Ancient texts speak of them being used in wars and battles, serving as squires to knights.

entry: POKENAME最早在中世纪被发现，据传出没于古战场。古文献记载，它们曾作为骑士的侍从参与征战。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A Pokémon first discovered in the middle ages, POKENAME were rumored to be found on ancient battlefields. Ancient texts speak of them being used in wars and battles, serving as squires to knights.

entry: POKENAME最早在中世纪被发现，据传出没于古战场。古文献记载，它们曾作为骑士的侍从参与征战。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A Pokémon first discovered in the middle ages, POKENAME were rumored to be found on ancient battlefields. Ancient texts speak of them being used in wars and battles, serving as squires to knights.

entry: POKENAME最早在中世纪被发现，据传出没于古战场。古文献记载，它们曾作为骑士的侍从参与征战。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A Pokémon first discovered in the middle ages, POKENAME were rumored to be found on ancient battlefields. Ancient texts speak of them being used in wars and battles, serving as squires to knights.

entry: 传说能拿走POKENAME的剑的人，注定成为领袖。但谁真去尝试，它就会用蓝布缠住对方手臂，施以电击。
author: the_fireplace
source: Legends say one who can take POKENAME's sword is destined to lead. If anyone tries, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and shocks them.

entry: POKENAME的剑虽因小巧而显得脆弱，刃部却由收集的石头和矿物构成，能造成重创。它再用剑挖更多沉积物，如此循环。
author: pixlhoopa
source: While POKENAME's sword may seem weak and fragile due to its size, the stone and minerals gathered make up the blade of the sword, allowing for heavy damage. It then uses the blade to dig more sediment, and the cycle continues.

entry: 经常能见到POKENAME缓缓巡逻一小片区域，用流苏抓住入侵者，甩到一旁。研究认为，它守护着埋藏的古代蜈蚣王骸骨。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is often spotted slowly patrolling small areas, grabbing and tossing intruders aside with its tassel. Research suggests it guards the buried bones of ancient Scolipede.

entry: POKENAME喜欢嬉闹，同时胡乱挥刀，砍倒一切挡路的生灵或物件。研究显示，只要不断替它擦亮刀刃、好好宠着，它就能安分下来。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME likes to frolic around while also swinging its blade wildly to chop down anything and anyone in its way. Studies have shown that constantly pampering it by polishing its blade will keep this Pokémon placated.

entry: 有些故事称，POKENAME是战死冰原的战士灵魂，永远裹紧身体，徒劳抵御无尽寒冷，怀恨攻击所有靠近的对象。
author: sk372
source: Some stories say POKENAME are the souls of warriors fallen in battle within icy plains, forever bundling themselves in a vain attempt to stave off the endless cold, and striking vindictively at all who draw near.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃相对身体太大，挥起来十分笨拙。即便如此，训练家若想拿走或交换，它还是会哭叫。
author: ferdirenz
source: POKENAME's blade is too big in proportion to its body, making it rather clumsy at swinging it. Despite that, it will cry out if a Trainer attempts to take or trade it.

entry: 几只酷似独剑鞘的宝可梦寄居在灰尘山的空壳内。每把穿出皮肤的刀刃，都属于藏在里面的不同个体。
author: duskrd
source: Several Pokémon resembling Honedge have infested the husk of a Garbodor. Every blade piercing its skin belongs to a unique member hiding inside.

entry: POKENAME头上伸出的钥匙状附肢，其实是恶灵硬插进去的。它如今浑浑噩噩地游荡，几乎失去自主意识，攻击所有靠近的对象。
author: kungfucutbug
source: What appears to be a key-like appendage jutting out of POKENAME's head was actually forced in there by a malevolent spirit. It now wanders in an almost vegetative state, attacking anything that draws near.

entry: POKENAME把棍子当剑练习，经常练断，大多数夜晚都得再找一根完美的棍子。
author: cloudmaker2169
source: POKENAME train with sticks as if they were swords. Its training causes them to break frequently, requiring POKENAME to spend most nights in search of another perfect stick.

entry: POKENAME的身体完全由液态金属构成。虽然比较弱小，却经常展现惊人勇气。
author: theartemis1
source: POKENAME's body is entirely comprised of liquid metal. Despite being relatively weak, they often display an incredible amount of courage.

entry: POKENAME花瓣中卡着的刀刃根本无法挪动。它已夺走霸王花的灵魂，如今控制着空壳。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The blade trapped within POKENAME's petals is impossible to move. This is because it has taken the soul of the Vileplume, and now controls its husk.

entry: 据说POKENAME是住在同一身体中的两个灵魂，既能远距离挥剑，也能打出强力拳击。剑收在体内，会让它略感不适。
author: sk372
source: Said to be two spirits inhabiting the same body, POKENAME can strike with long-range sword swings and powerful fisticuffs. The sword sheathes within its body, causing it mild discomfort.

entry: POKENAME将刀刃刺入受害者，再用十条缎带缠住，几秒内就能抽走全部生命力。哪条缎带撕裂，也能用这些生命能量强行再生。
author: soup1900
source: Plunging its blade into a victim and wrapping its ten ribbons around them, POKENAME will extract all their life force within seconds. If any of its ribbons are torn, it can use this life energy to forcefully regenerate it back.

entry: POKENAME把刀刃藏在缎带围成的穹顶内。谁靠近，它就打开这座掩体，露出刀刃，刺向对方的腿。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME conceals its blade within a dome made of its ribbons. If anyone approaches it, it opens this bunker, revealing the blade inside and stabbing them in the leg.

entry: POKENAME住在沙漠遗迹与神庙中。下雨时会尽可能吸水，因为缺水会让头上的剑像植物一样枯萎。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME live in desert ruins and temples. They absorb as much water as possible when it rains, as dehydration causes the sword on their heads to wilt as if it were a plant.

entry: POKENAME挖土时，会把剑收在鞘内，免得金属刃口变钝。只有敌人威胁自己，或需要切开树根取食时，才会拔剑。
author: .jerden
source: When digging in the dirt, POKENAME keeps its blade sheathed to avoid blunting its metal edge. It only draws it when threatened by an enemy, or when it needs to slice open a tree root to feed on.

entry: 有时能在暴风雪中见到POKENAME，围巾随风飘扬。有人说，寒风正指引它前往下一个值得一战的对手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can sometimes be seen during snowstorms, its scarf billowing with the breeze. Some say the icy wind is pointing it towards its next worthy opponent.

entry: 它用蓝布缠住树木，吸取生命力，滋养木壳上的蘑菇。剑一旦被拔出身体，就会立刻昏倒，因此它改用金属爪攻击。
author: .jerden
source: It drains life force from trees by wrapping its blue cloth around them, nourishing the mushrooms growing on its wooden shell. If the sword is ever pulled out of its body, it immediately faints, so it attacks with its metallic claws instead.

entry: POKENAME头上的刀刃状鳞片，锋利得一斩就能将树劈成两半。它总在找对手切磋，一心求战，完全无视弱小宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: The blade-like scale on POKENAME's head is sharp enough to cut a tree in half with one slash. It is always looking for others to spar with, ignoring weaker Pokémon entirely in its quest for battle.

entry: POKENAME用剑状叶片修剪杂草，照料巢穴周围。动作精准，仿佛园丁在工作。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its sword-like leaf to trim weeds and tend to its nesting area. Its precise movements evoke the appearance of a gardener at work.

entry: 这只披甲的宝可梦会在夜里持剑狩猎小型猎物，极其敏锐的双眼为它提供帮助。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This armored Pokémon hunts small prey at night with sword in hand, assisted by its hypersensitive eyes.

entry: POKENAME漫游乡野，寻找剑术大师教导。它剑术尚浅，但只要战斗拖得够久，就能让对手的剑柄燃烧起来。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME wanders through the countryside looking for a sword master to teach it. Its swordplay is amateur, but it can make its opponent's sword hilt burn if the fight lasts long enough.

entry: POKENAME不用碰剑也能操控。它集中呼吸，让剑更强，并在剑后带出水流轨迹。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME's sword can be controlled without touching it. POKENAME is able to concentrate its breathing to make the sword stronger and add a water trail to it.

entry: POKENAME保持绝对平静，以特殊呼吸技巧攻击敌人。它集中精神，放出一道强力水斩，能切开任何防御。
author: ambrosia04
source: While maintaining absolute calmness, POKENAME utilizes a special breathing technique to strike its enemies. It focuses its spirit to unleash a single, powerful water slash that can slice through any defense.

entry: POKENAME先饱食煤炭，再巡逻领地，确保有力气迎战任何认可的对手。不过，所谓“值得一战”，似乎只是指比自己大的东西。
author: lepidelectric
source: POKENAME feasts on coal before patrolling its territory, ensuring it has the strength to take on any opponent it deems worthy. What it deems "worthy" seems to simply mean anything larger than itself.

entry: 封建时代，POKENAME常陪伴忍者。身体轻，头如刀刃，是夜间潜行任务的理想伙伴。如今，它仍受研习古代武术的人欢迎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME were a common companion to ninjas during feudal times, their light bodies and bladed heads making them perfect companions for stealth missions at night. In modern times, they retain popularity with practitioners of historical martial arts.

entry: 独剑鞘已接管火恐龙部分身体。不过战斗动作反而更灵活，因此火恐龙并不反对。
author: nellnast42
source: Honedge has now taken over part of Charmeleon's body. However, this improves their movement in battle, so the Charmeleon does not object.

entry: POKENAME以惊人速度破土而出，使对手措手不及。迅疾精准的打击，常让敌人惊得无法还手。
author: bluhawk997
source: POKENAME surprises its opponents by bursting from the ground with incredible speed. Its swift, precise strikes often leave foes too stunned to fight back.

entry: POKENAME出现在海边洞窟与遗迹中。古老传说称，这把剑有“守护灵”相伴。
author: neonriser
source: POKENAME is found in seaside caverns and ruins. According to ancient legend, the sword is accompanied by "guardian spirits".

entry: 古代地下墓穴中发现过许多这种宝可梦的雕像，常摆在入口。人们推测，古代文明曾用POKENAME守护死者。
author: santon5512
source: Many statues of these Pokémon have been found in ancient catacombs, often placed at their entrances. It's theorized that ancient cultures used POKENAME to guard the dead.

entry: POKENAME富有骑士精神，总是公平作战。带蹼的脚让它无论到哪里都能稳住身形，因此陆地与水中都能自卫。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are chivalrous creatures that always fight fairly. They are capable of defending themselves on land and in water because of their webbed feet, which ensure sturdy footing wherever they go.

entry: POKENAME越愤怒，挥舞的刀刃就越锋利。怒到极点时，一斩就能劈开巨石。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The blades wielded by POKENAME grow sharper the angrier they get. At their most furious, POKENAME can cleave through boulders with a single slash.

entry: 意识分在剑与本体之间。若换给它一把没有意识的剑，就会发现它的剑术其实很差。
author: staghorn
source: Its consciousness is split between its sword and its main body. When given a nonsentient blade, its swordsmanship is revealed to be poor.

entry: POKENAME或许不是最强的宝可梦，却会对信任的训练家忠诚到底。虽然外貌截然不同，但已证实它与坚盾力有直接亲缘关系。
author: dyo_jonah
source: Though it is not the mightiest Pokémon, POKENAME will be forever loyal to its trusted Trainer until the end. Despite having drastically different appearances, they are confirmed to be directly related to Aegichamp.

entry: POKENAME守在墓地，用剑有效击退企图盗墓的人。猛烈的动作如舞动火焰般迅速闪烁，打中它两侧的攻击都会弹开，伤不到它。
author: ghostslythe
source: Found standing guard over graveyards, POKENAME uses its sword to great effect against would-be grave robbers. Its intense movements flicker as fast as dancing flames, and hits bounce harmlessly off its flanks.

entry: 喷火龙与独剑鞘如今配合得天衣无缝。在战场上，POKENAME的剑刃与烈焰都不可轻视。
author: nellnast42
source: Charizard and Honedge are now in perfect sync with one another. Both POKENAME's blade and flames are not to taken lightly on the battlefield.

entry: POKENAME察觉有人，就会把刀瞬移到对方身后，刺向背部。它必须从灵魂中吸取生命能量，维持精神力。
author: soup1900
source: If POKENAME senses someone, it will teleport a knife behind them to stab them in the back. It needs to drain souls for their life energy in order to maintain its psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME将精神能量注入连在双手的强力刀刃与剑鞘。据说，谁想它想得太久，就会被吸走生命力。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME channels their psychic energy into the powerful blade and scabbard attached to their hands. It's said that POKENAME will drain the life force of anyone who thinks about them for too long.

entry: POKENAME是仍在修行的年轻剑士。它仰慕前辈，希望有朝一日能拥有同等的力量与本领。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is a young swordfighter in training. It looks up to its superiors so it may one day match their strength and prowess.

entry: POKENAME从山中家园下山，寻找强大而正直的训练家或宝可梦，为其效忠。但缺乏经验，有时会受骗，为不那么正派的对象效力。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME descend from their homes in the mountains to seek out a strong and honorable Trainer or Pokémon to devote themselves to. Their inexperience can lead to them being tricked into working with less-than-honorable figures.

entry: 富裕家庭常雇POKENAME守卫宅邸、博物馆和城堡的厅堂与侧翼建筑。挥动沉重钢剑需要非凡力量，所以它会苦练到深夜。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is often hired by wealthy families to guard the halls and wings of mansions, museums, and castles. Wielding its heavy steel sword demands exceptional strength, so it pushes through grueling training sessions that stretch deep into the night.

entry: POKENAME岩石身体中伸出的刀刃极其锋利。有人认为，不砸碎整块石头，就无法将它拔出。
author: .izik
source: The blade protruding from POKENAME's rocky body is incredibly sharp. Some believe it cannot be removed without shattering the entire stone.

entry: 隆隆石的身体被独剑鞘之灵附身，成了既善格斗又力大无比的战士。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The body of the Graveler possessed by the spirit of a Honedge makes it a formidable martial fighter and brute.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME曾是一名已故骑士侍从的坐骑。如今它仍握着对方的剑，等待重逢。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is thought to be the mount of a departed squire, holding their sword as it awaits their reunion.

entry: POKENAME英勇无畏，会尽力帮助其他生灵，哪怕必须挑战极其可怕的敌人。战斗时，水会从刀刃上倾泻而下。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is a heroic Pokémon that tries its best to help others, even if it involves challenging highly intimidating foes. Water cascades from its blade as it fights.

entry: 它们会寻找露在外面的螺丝，拧下来带回巢里。大多数工程师都把POKENAME视为祸害。
author: kiwiarms
source: They are known to search for uncovered screws and unscrew them to bring back to their nests. Most engineers consider POKENAME to be a pest.

entry: 进化后，POKENAME成了更难对付的敌人。如今每次挥斩都会涌出更多水，水流精准集中，连实心铁都能切开。
author: fireblade141
source: After evolving, POKENAME has become a much more formidable opponent. Now, even more water surges forth with its every slash, which are precise and focused enough to cut solid iron.

entry: POKENAME通常将下半身藏在地下，只露出嵌在身上的剑。谁想招惹它，等它露出真身，很快就会后悔。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME usually hide their lower body under the ground, only keeping their embedded sword above ground. Those who try to mess with them quickly regret it once POKENAME reveals their true form.

entry: POKENAME会先让猎物入睡，再杀死对方在梦中的化身，以此进食。受害者从此再也无法做清醒梦。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME puts its victims to sleep and feeds by slaying their dream self. Victims are unable to have lucid dreams ever again.

entry: POKENAME甲壳上长出的利刃能当作飞刀投出。它丢弃的刀刃还被人用来装饰海鲜菜肴的摆盘。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME grows blades from its carapace which it uses like throwing knives. Discarded knives have been used as props to present seafood dishes.

entry: POKENAME覆着厚重金属甲，能安全贴近敌人，用强力巨钳战斗。遇上格外强大的攻击，就举盾抵挡，还会从攻击者身上取走战利品。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are coated in thick metallic armour letting them get in close and fight with their powerful claw safely. They wield their shield to ward against any particularly powerful attacks, taking trophies from their aggressors.

entry: POKENAME吸取的生命能量越多，球茎便越舒展，缎带也越长。球茎将包裹的布完全展开时，就到了进化的时刻。
author: soup1900
source: The more life energy POKENAME drains, the more its bulb unravels and the longer its ribbons will grow. It will reach the point of evolution once its bulb fully unravels the cloth that covers it.

entry: POKENAME鲜明的黄粉配色，让伪装几乎不可能。在绿叶间十分显眼，不断成为鸟宝可梦的目标。
author: bluenido.
source: POKENAME's vibrant yellow and pink coloring makes camouflage nearly impossible. Standing out against green foliage, it is a constant target for bird Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME的布翅让它对飞行的控制极佳，电力充足时，能瞬间急停、掉头。一旦挥舞刀刃，就会成为势不可挡的斩击旋风。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME's cloth wings give it such incredible control over its flight that, when fully charged on electricity, it can stop and reverse on a dime. When it starts swinging its blades, it becomes an unstoppable whirlwind of slashes.

entry: 这一窝中的每颗蛋都用精神力挥使刀刃。每个成员都很冲动，POKENAME很难协调出团队攻击。
author: sk372
source: Each egg in the clutch wields blades via psychic powers. Each member is very impulsive, so POKENAME has trouble coordinating attacks as a team.

entry: POKENAME将磨利的骨头当作双刀，施展复杂的杂技动作，在几乎任何环境中都能取得优势。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wields its sharpened bones like a pair of sabers. It performs complex acrobatic maneuvers to gain advantage in nearly any environment.

entry: POKENAME熟练挥舞双钢剑，逼退敢闯入沙漠峡谷领地的入侵者。它只与同住的梦歌仙人掌合得来，对方也乐意陪它训练。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME skillfully wields its pair of steel swords to keep intruders at bay who dare to invade its territory within the desert canyons. It gets along only with Cacturne, which share its habitat and willingly serve as training partners.

entry: POKENAME是出色的斗士，用替代双腿的成对刀刃压倒对手。为了保持钢铁坚实，它会吃富含铁的食物。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an exceptional fighter that overwhelms its opponents using the paired blades it has in place of legs. To keep its steel strong, it feeds on foods rich in iron.

entry: POKENAME的两颗头通过腰带状部分连接第三个球体，各自都能将带刺球体像链枷一样甩向对手。它吃锈金属，尤其爱能强化尖刺的锐利物件。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's two heads connect to the third orb via its sash, allowing each to swing its spiky mass like a flail into opponents. It feeds on rusted metal, especially liking sharp objects, which enhance its spikes.

entry: 亲代通常先用轻击消耗对手，再让孩子打出获胜的最后一击。幼崽战斗动作仍生疏，却展现出很大潜力。
author: sk372
source: The parent typically softens up its opponent with glancing blows before letting the child issue the final winning strike. The youth's movements in battle are still amateurish, but it shows great potential.

entry: 布制翅膀的浮空效果，竟意外出色。它俯冲斩击敌人，再以粉末扰乱目标。
author: xephyr
source: The cloth that comprises its wings is surprisingly effective at keeping it airborne. It dives and slashes at foes, using powders to disorient targets.

entry: POKENAME通常躺在海床一动不动，天敌靠近时才会用缎带赶忙爬走。它得吸取几只鱼宝可梦的生命力，补回逃跑耗掉的能量。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME typically lies motionless on the seafloor, but if a predator approaches, it will use its ribbons to crawl away in a hurry. It has to absorb the life force from several fish Pokémon to replenish the energy it takes to do so.

entry: POKENAME能发射前方五个尖端，用水晶核心产生的念力引导。流苏如指挥家般优雅移动，指挥刀刃飞行。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can fire off the five points on its front, guiding them through telekinesis generated from its crystal core. Its tassels gracefully move and direct the blades' movements akin to a conductor.

entry: POKENAME能以不明方式迅速将普通空气转成氙气，增强电力、照亮道路。它借此织出静电网，踢出带电攻击，并悬浮闪避凶猛打击。
author: ghostslythe
source: Through unknown means, POKENAME quickly converts regular air into xenon gas, juicing up its electricity and lighting its way. Using this process, it creates nets of static electricity, kicks with zapping power, and hovers to dodge ferocious blows.

entry: POKENAME头上的尖刃覆有弱毒，会污染划出的伤口。手持的小刀紧急时也能战斗，但主要用来削树果皮再吃。
author: sk372
source: The pointed blade on POKENAME's head is coated with a mild poison, infecting any wounds it creates. The smaller blade it wields can be used in battle in a pinch, but is primarily used to carve the skin off berries before consumption.

entry: POKENAME游在古战场附近的海岸，会收集找到的阵亡武士兵器，添入自己的武库。
author: fenragon
source: POKENAME swims near the shores of ancient battle sites. It will add the weapons of fallen warriors it finds to its arsenal.

entry: 将POKENAME剪刀般的尾刃浸入水中，会改变体色与战斗风格。热水让它颜色鲜艳、更好斗；冷水让颜色暗淡，战斗更有章法。
author: sk372
source: Dipping POKENAME's scissor-like tail blades into water affects its fighting style and coloration. Hot water makes it more vibrant and aggressive, while cold water dulls its color and makes it battle more methodically.

entry: POKENAME身体贴着沙，在海床潜行。任何宝可梦从上方游过，它都会伏击，用刀臂抓住，再以脑后刀刃结束战斗。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME creep along the sea floor, keeping their bodies flat against the sand. They launch ambushes at any Pokémon that swims above them, catching them in their bladed arms before using the blade on the back of their head to end the fight.

entry: POKENAME以为大针蜂和蜂女王效力、挥刃保卫蜂巢而闻名。战斗格外艰难时，为了忠于誓言，它会毫不犹豫地让敌人中毒。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is well known that POKENAME offers its blades in service to Beedrill and Vespiquen, helping them protect their hive. If a battle becomes particularly difficult, it won't hesitate to poison its foe to remain true to its oath.

entry: POKENAME的两个身体有紧密精神联系，行动同步。刀刃虽较小，动作却迅捷、配合完美，能从容击败凶猛敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's two bodies move in tandem, sharing a strong psychic link with each other. Though their blades are smaller, their movements are quick and perfectly coordinated, allowing them to take down fierce foes with aplomb.

entry: 人们相信，POKENAME发展出能克制所有其他宝可梦的剑术。它借强大精神力，以念力挥使双剑，大幅扩展攻击范围与战术。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is believed to have developed a swordfighting style to counter every other Pokémon in existence. It can use its vast psychic abilities to wield its two swords telekinetically, giving it vastly more range and tactics.

entry: POKENAME用两条流苏般的尾巴抓食物，尤其是树上的水果，再用翅缘利刃削皮，吃甜美的果肉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the twin tassel-like tails it possesses to grab onto food, especially fruits growing on trees. Using the sharp blades at the edge of its wings, it carves the skin off the fruit before eating the sweet insides.

entry: 有人观察到，POKENAME每次战斗获胜，都会摆出双剑指向不同方向的姿势。研究发现，双剑所指恰好能表示战斗结束的几点几分。
author: sk372
source: In battle, POKENAME has been observed posing with its blades after any victories, pointing both swords in differing directions. Research shows the directions pointed coincide with the exact hour and minute of the battle's end.

entry: POKENAME会挥动并甩出武器，打击远处目标。有时还会借飞出武器的势头，将轻盈身体带向对手，追加一击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME swings around its weapon and flings it out to strike from great distances. Sometimes it lets the momentum of its flying weapon sling its own lightweight body towards an opponent as a follow-up strike.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴上的眼睛始终盯住对手。两把剑配合无间，伴随缎带翻飞来回挥斩。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use the eye on their tails to keep their focus on their opponents at all times. They wield both of their swords in perfect unison, slashing back and forth in a flourish of their ribbons.

entry: POKENAME勇敢大胆，却经常过度自信、鲁莽行事。它自认已是完美战士，其实仍有很多要学。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME are brave and daring, but are often overly confident and reckless. They believe they are already the perfect warrior, but they still have a lot to learn.

entry: 胸前的眼睛时刻留意危险。头上刀刃却太钝，不能用来战斗。
author: .flipside3
source: The eye on its chest is always on the lookout for danger. The blades on its head are too dull to use for combat.

entry: POKENAME用精神力预判对手下一步，再做出应对。控制的双刃能施展迅速复杂的攻击，常在招架的同时反击。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their psychic powers to predict their opponents' next moves, acting accordingly. The two blades they control allow for swift and complex attacks, often parrying their opponent while simultaneously counter-attacking.

entry: 虽然是双剑鞘融合体，POKENAME的花苞却只长出一把刀。进一步用X射线检查发现，第二把其实藏在花苞里，想伸出却没有空间。
author: soup1900
source: Despite being a Doublade fusion, POKENAME only has one blade sprouting out of its bud. Further examinations with X-rays have shown that the second blade is actually hidden inside its bud, wanting to come out but having no room to do so.

entry: POKENAME始终维持强韧稳固的防守架势。一受攻击，就会挥舞双剑，立刻以猛烈连击还击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME maintains a strong and sturdy defensive stance at all times. The moment it is struck by an attack, it retaliates with an intense flurry of strikes from the two swords it wields.

entry: POKENAME进入战斗时，会将两条刃状尾巴朝向对手，同时将大部分柔软身体埋进地下，保护自己。
author: sleepyman0731
source: When POKENAME enters combat, its twin blade tails face the opponent. POKENAME buries most of its soft body underground to protect itself while it is battling.

entry: 它用紫毛裹住自己的头，不知是为了保护，还是因为害羞。即使视线受阻，两把剑中的任何一把仍能打得相当准。
author: infinex21
source: It wraps its own head in its purple fur; whether it does this for protection or because it is shy is unknown. Even with its vision obscured, it can strike quite accurately with either of its twin swords.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，独特地结合蛮力挥击与灵巧切斩。腰带状部分能增强速度和力量。
author: partypooperrex
source: POKENAME fights with a unique mix of brutish swings and dexterous slices. The sashes help give it enhanced speed and strength.

entry: 节庆时节，POKENAME会从山中巢穴下来庆祝。它将一把刀抛给吃惊的旅人，再用另一把进攻，送上剑术课这份“礼物”。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: During the festive season, POKENAME descend from their nests in the mountains to celebrate. They toss one of their blades to startled travelers and attack with the other, giving the "gift" of swordplay lessons.

entry: POKENAME递送复古邮件，封着火漆，边角折得整整齐齐。送信间隙，它磨炼剑术，动作节奏带着奇异的怀旧感。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME delivers Retro Mail sealed with wax stamps and folded with perfect corners. Between routes, it hones its sword technique, moving with a rhythm that feels oddly nostalgic.

entry: POKENAME不断用火焰包裹双剑，让刀伤兼带严重灼伤。剑的金属极其耐热，能在火焰的极高温度中保持形状。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME constantly coats its swords with fire, making their cuts inflict scalding burns on those hit. The sword's metal is extremely heat resistant, allowing it to keep its shape under the extreme temperatures of the flame.

entry: POKENAME熟练挥使两根刀刃状长牙，滚动时打出干净利落的斩击。刀刃还能脱离身体，像有自己意识一样飘着攻击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME wields its twin blade tusks with great skill, striking with clean cutting strikes while rolling. The blades can detach as well, and float around attacking as if they possess a will of their own.

entry: POKENAME挥动颈部皮膜上的刀刃攻击敌人，后方则以另一把小刀防守，免得鸟宝可梦将它抓起带走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME attacks foes by swinging the blade attached to its hood. It protects its rear with another small blade, preventing bird Pokémon from picking POKENAME up and flying away.

entry: POKENAME奔跑时会在地面留下独特切痕，很容易看出它去过哪里。但它跳得极远，足迹相隔太开，几乎无法循迹追踪。
author: .realthree
source: The unique gashes that POKENAME leaves in the ground as it runs make it easy to tell where it's been. However, these footprints are so far apart due to this Pokémon's huge leaps that it's nearly impossible to follow the trail.

entry: POKENAME挥动颈部皮膜上的刀刃攻击敌人。野外会追赶啮齿宝可梦，取得新鲜的一餐。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME attacks foes by swinging the blade attached to its hood. It chases after rodent Pokémon in the wild to secure a fresh meal.

entry: POKENAME双持完全由电构成的刀刃。电刃把食物切成细条，也烤得焦香酥脆，成了熟透又方便吃的一餐。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME dual-wields blades made entirely of electricity. Slicing its food to ribbons, the electric blades also roast them to a nice crisp, creating a well-cooked and easy-to-eat meal for it.

entry: POKENAME两条尾巴灵巧挥使双剑，精准斩击，击倒对手。它没有手臂和嘴，靠吸取敌人生命力获取能量。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's two tails deftly wield their twin blades, slashing precisely to take down opponents. It does not have arms or a mouth, so it gains energy by draining its foes' life force.

entry: POKENAME每条尾巴各握一刃，将多余电力排入其中。攻势凶猛而多变，连最强的对手也能压倒。
author: soup1900
source: Wielding a blade on each tail, POKENAME discharges excess electricity into them. Its aggressive and complex attack patterns allow it to overwhelm even the strongest opponents.

entry: POKENAME刀刃上的金属如皮肤般不断生长、脱落。这些碎屑过去被熔成锭，用于研制零一号的浮箱。
author: .izik
source: The metal on POKENAME's blades constantly grows and sheds, much like its skin. These shavings were melted into ingots and used in the past to develop the flotation tanks for the ZERO-ONE.

entry: POKENAME战斗时熟练挥舞双剑，身上的鳞片如铠甲般抵挡攻击。据说古时它们曾受训用剑，保护贵族与王室。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME deftly swing their dual swords in battle, the scales along their body acting as armor defending them from attacks. It is said that in ancient times POKENAME were trained to use their swords to protect nobles and royalty.

entry: 两片草叶利刃只需几秒就能斩倒最粗壮的树木。与其他POKENAME切磋前，它总要花上几小时磨剑。
author: schwaus
source: With its two blades of grass, even the thickest trees are felled within seconds. It spends hours sharpening its blades before sparring with other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME以双剑跳出优雅舞蹈，分散对手对更危险踢击的注意。尽管如此，人们仍因它的剑而常称其为“决斗者”。
author: starpun.
source: POKENAME uses its dual blades in an elegant dance as a distraction from its more dangerous kicks. Despite that, it's often called "the Duelist" based on its swords.

entry: POKENAME另有一个幽灵形态的心智。幽灵在旁预警，它则优雅地挥舞双剑。
author: t.i.a.
source: POKENAME have a second mind in the form of a specter. The specter warns of danger as they elegantly slash with their two swords.

entry: 模样酷似古代英雄。人们会请它充当守卫，保护贵重物品。
author: sottiwotti
source: This Pokémon resembles a hero from ancient times. They are used as guardians to protect valuable items.

entry: POKENAME以双刀风格热情奋战。它动作迅捷优雅，两剑相互配合，对敌人构成近乎完美的攻防。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fights zealously with a twin-blade fighting style. It moves with quick speed and grace, its two swords acting in harmony to make a near-perfect offense and defense against its opponents.

entry: POKENAME明明有四把刀的优势，决斗时却不肯用臂刃，只用普通双刃。这是出于对对手的尊重，尽管对方往往片刻后就被迅速击败。
author: patch01774
source: Despite its clear advantage with having four blades, POKENAME refuses to use the blades on its arms in duels, instead opting to use its regular blades. This is out of honor towards its opponents, which are often swiftly defeated moments later.

entry: POKENAME的两半由一条腰带状部分相连，用头上的刀刃协同战斗。不过配合仍在磨炼，偶尔会在战斗中互相妨碍。
author: sk372
source: Connecting together by a single sash, the two halves of POKENAME fight in tandem with the blades on their head. They are still developing coordination, however, and one will occasionally interfere with the other in battle.

entry: POKENAME用臂上的长刃攀爬崖壁，或直接切穿岩壁，在巨大峡谷与洞穴系统中穿行，寻找宝石。
author: nexusshenanigans
source: POKENAME use the long blades on their arms to navigate large ravines and cave systems in search of gemstones by climbing walls or cutting through them.

entry: 覆盖的布已展开，POKENAME的花苞如今绽放。它将双刃收在花苞中，以生命能量滋养、增强刀刃。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's bud has opened now that the cloth covering it has unraveled. It stores its two blades inside this bud to bathe them with life energy and empower them.

entry: POKENAME常陪伴手艺人，喜欢跟着训练家，用许多缎带般的手搬工具。它握得极紧，除非主动交出，否则没人能从它手中偷走东西。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Often accompanying tradespeople, POKENAME enjoys following its Trainer around and carrying their tools with its many ribbon-like hands. Its grip is so tight that it is impossible to steal an item from POKENAME, unless it willingly hands it over.

entry: 它的眼睛不断扫视四周，提防有人偷走所持物品。有时会华丽地挥舞武器，或为炫耀，或为赶走潜在威胁。
author: foolish_weasel
source: Its eyes are constantly scanning around for thieves who may attempt to take the items it possesses. Sometimes it will flourish its weapons around in a dazzling display for either show or to ward off potential threats.

entry: POKENAME摆动布匹般的鳍，沿海底缓缓游动。凡是落到它刀刃前的东西，转眼就会被切碎吞下。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME waves its cloth-like fins to slowly swim along the ocean's floor. Anything that falls in front of its blades is chopped up and consumed in short order.

entry: 臂上的双剑让POKENAME成了海滩的顶级猎手。任何壳都能切开，任何果树都能砍倒。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The swords on its arms make POKENAME the apex predator of the beach. It can slice right through any shell and topple any fruit tree.

entry: POKENAME的头冠由刀鞘形成，正面几乎不怕外力伤害。它总会面朝危险，保护较脆弱的后半身。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The crests of POKENAME are formed of their blade's sheaths. They are almost impervious to physical damage from head-on and will always face toward danger to protect their more vulnerable back half.

entry: POKENAME是战事将至的预兆，会为城市预警敌袭。许多城市却误以为它招来了战乱，这也成了它们最后犯下的错误。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The harbinger of battle, POKENAME warns cities of raids. Misunderstanding it as the bringer of conflict has been many cities' last mistake.

entry: POKENAME战斗时极其优雅。飘动的缎带与猛烈火焰会分散对手注意，震慑敌人。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME is incredibly graceful in combat. Its flowing ribbons and intense flames distract and intimidate opponents.

entry: POKENAME已部分分裂，主要边旋转边前进攻击，攻势令大多数斗士难以招架。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME has partially split, and attacks primarily by spinning and advancing. Its movements are overwhelming to most fighters.

entry: 三剑攻势复杂莫测，连剑术造诣极高的对手也挡不住。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The complex attack patterns of its three swords are unstoppable, even for an opponent greatly accomplished at swordplay.

entry: 这只POKENAME暂时认定，还是用单一形态容纳新力量最合适。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: This POKENAME has decided its newfound abilities are best contained in its single form, for now.

entry: 组成POKENAME的四把剑走遍大地，寻求冒险。它们并非总能完美同步，但配合到位时，技巧与力量足以成为传奇。
author: sk372
source: The four swords of POKENAME travel across the land seeking adventure. Though not always in perfect sync, when they link together properly, their skill and strength is the stuff of legend.

entry: 臂上的火刃猛烈燃烧，传闻以许多亡魂未消的怨恨为燃料。战斗时，POKENAME会毫不留情地将敌人切碎。
author: fireblade141
source: The fiery blades upon its arms burn fiercely, rumored to be fueled by the lingering resentment of many lost souls. In battle, POKENAME cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.

entry: POKENAME是狡猾敏捷的对手。流苏般的翅膀扬起尘土，让敌人迷失方向，难以躲开双刃快得看不清的打击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a tricky and agile foe in combat. Its tassel-wings kick up dirt and dust to disorient its opponents, leaving them ill-equipped to avoid the blindingly fast strikes from its twin blades.

entry: POKENAME制造自身幻影，掩盖双剑的动作。敌人通常挨了第一击，才分辨得出真正的刀刃。
author: pokefanart
source: POKENAME creates illusions of itself to conceal the movement of its swords. Its enemies are usually unable to tell the true blades apart until they have already received the first blow.

entry: POKENAME身上流苏般的缎带会吸取接触者的能量，削弱对手，方便其他末端带刃的缎带击中。
author: sk372
source: The tassel-like ribbons on POKENAME's body sap the energy of those they touch. It uses this to weaken opponents and make them easier to hit with its other ribbons, which possess sharp blades at the end.

entry: POKENAME双刃每次击中对手，都会吸入能量。储满时，双剑明亮发光，炮口打开，准备释放毁灭性的能量攻击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME draws in energy any time its two blades strike an opponent. At maximum capacity its swords glow with a bright light and its cannon opens up in preparation to fire devastating energy discharges.

entry: 遮脸的流苏下，POKENAME没有眼睛。虽然看不见，战斗却凶猛而顽强，臂上双刃似乎能让它清楚感知周围。
author: sk372
source: Beneath the tassels covering its face, POKENAME has no eyes. Despite its blindness, it fights with intense ferocity and tenacity; it seems the blades on its arms allow it to sense its surroundings with great clarity.

entry: POKENAME如迅捷的杂技高手，战斗中能轻易压倒敌人。它踢击、旋转，再用剑状双耳斩击，许多宝可梦很难毫发无伤地战胜它。它总在擦亮耳刃。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a swift acrobat who can easily overwhelm foes in battle. With kicks, spins, and slashes with its sword-ears, it is difficult for many Pokémon to best it unscathed. It is constantly polishing the blades on its ears.

entry: 它好奇心旺盛，常用臂上刀刃切开东西，只为看看里面长什么样。
author: .flipside3
source: It has an incredibly curious nature. It will often cut through things using the blades on its arms to see what they look like on the inside.

entry: 它能感知附近人的情绪。据传，还会盯着心藏秘密的人不放。
author: .flipside3
source: It is able to sense the emotions of nearby people. It is rumored to stare at people who are hiding secrets.

entry: POKENAME是沙漠中的祸患，会突然从沙丘里钻出，伏击人类商队。若运气好，损失的还只是粮食。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME are a menace of the desert, emerging from the dunes just to ambush human caravans for their food, if the humans are lucky.

entry: POKENAME通常守在废弃要塞的门口。只要眼前没有敌对行为，就会安静守候。沉稳外表藏着凶猛，一有暴力苗头，便立即行动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Normally found standing guard at the gates of ruined fortresses, POKENAME are passive guardians provided no hostile act is performed in their presence. Their stoic demeanor belies their fierceness, leaping to action at the first hint of violence.

entry: POKENAME通常守在废弃要塞的门口。只要眼前没有敌对行为，就会安静守候。沉稳外表藏着凶猛，一有暴力苗头，便立即行动。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Normally found standing guard at the gates of ruined fortresses, POKENAME are passive guardians provided no hostile act is performed in their presence. Their stoic demeanor belies their fierceness, leaping to action at the first hint of violence.

entry: POKENAME能从体内弹出两把刀，一把从嘴里，另一把从后方。谁想从背后偷袭，都会被第二把刀吓一跳。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can eject two blades from inside its body: one from its mouth, the other from its behind. This second blade always surprises anyone who tries to sneak up to it from behind.

entry: POKENAME喜欢收集刀刃，最好别试图拿走。它受威胁就会猛烈乱挥，切向一切靠得太近的对象。
author: footlongdingledong
source: POKENAME loves collecting blades. It is advised not to try to take one from it, as it will wildly thrash around if threatened, cutting at anything that gets too close.

entry: 它的感官极佳，能用刀刃状器官持续感知周围。剑术让剑士们十分羡慕，许多人会模仿它的刀舞。
author: silverscloudy
source: Its senses are excellent, able to make use of its blade-like organs to remain aware of the surrounding area. Its swordplay is coveted by swordsmen, many of whom imitate its blade dances.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME的多条尾巴若扫过敌人，就会施下诅咒，使其幻见幽灵刀刃袭来。混乱让它更容易用真刀击中。
author: sk372
source: Should POKENAME's many tails brush against a foe in battle, a hex is cast that causes the victim to hallucinate ghostly blades striking at them. The confusion this causes makes it easier for POKENAME to strike with its actual blades.

entry: 传闻它不死不灭。也有人说，若主人曾善待它，它就会替训练家完成遗愿。
author: .flipside3
source: It is rumored to be immortal. It is also rumored to carry out the dying wish of its Trainer if it was treated well.

entry: POKENAME在森林中游荡，仿佛凭着本能，用牙齿与利刃不加分辨地砍向树木和草属性宝可梦。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME wanders through the forest slicing trees and Grass-type Pokémon with its teeth and blades indiscriminately, as if by instinct.

entry: POKENAME很爱玩，不停找人切磋。据说有些会变成孩子，骗成年人陪自己训练。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are quite playful, constantly seeking out someone to spar with. Some reportedly transform into children so that they can trick adults into training with them.

entry: 它十分害羞。有人靠近，就用两侧缎带遮住眼睛。
author: .flipside3
source: It is an exceptionally shy Pokémon. If approached, it covers its eye using the ribbons at its sides.

entry: POKENAME的两把短刃虽能自卫，却主要用来挖洞。它睡在洞里，从土中吸收养分，流苏则留在地面，感知附近动静。
author: sk372
source: Though effective for self-defense, POKENAME's two short blades are mostly used for digging holes. It uses these holes to sleep in and gain nutrients from the soil, its tassel staying above ground to sense any disturbances nearby.

entry: 身上刀刃锋利得能切开钢铁。可动作不够灵巧，无法有效运用。
author: .flipside3
source: The blades on its body are sharp enough to cut through steel. It lacks the dexterity to use them effectively, however.

entry: 随着成长，体表液体慢慢覆上刀刃。成熟后，对刀刃的控制也更加自如。
author: .flipside3
source: As it grows, the liquid enveloping its body slowly covers the blades. This gives it more control over them as it matures.

entry: 它用一把刀在窝边沙地刻出图案，警告其他生灵远离领地。
author: .izik
