source: It carves patterns into the sand around its den with one of its blades. These markings warn others to stay away from its territory.

entry: POKENAME常出没于城堡和其他中世纪要塞的遗迹中，被认为曾负责抵御敌对领地的进攻。它虽个头不大，纯熟的剑术却让它十分危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A Pokémon often found in the ruins of castles and other medieval fortifications, POKENAME is thought to have served as a guardian against attacks by rival fiefdoms. Though small in stature, its proficiency with its blades makes it dangerous.

entry: POKENAME常出没于城堡和其他中世纪要塞的遗迹中，被认为曾负责抵御敌对领地的进攻。它虽个头不大，纯熟的剑术却让它十分危险。
author: katieplaysgames
source: A Pokémon often found in the ruins of castles and other medieval fortifications, POKENAME is thought to have served as a guardian against attacks by rival fiefdoms. Though small in stature, its proficiency with its blades makes it dangerous.

entry: POKENAME用流苏抓住猎物，拉近嘴边。两条刀刃状舌头迅速挥动，将食物切成小块，再从嘴的两侧滑入。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tassels grab hold of prey and draw it closer to its mouth. Its two blade-like tongues swing fast to chop its food into smaller pieces it can slide into the sides of its mouth.

entry: 王室或巨富常雇这些宝可梦守护家园，防范窃贼。作为回报，POKENAME经常获赠宝石。
author: bradlybro199
source: These Pokémon are often employed by royal families or the very wealthy to guard their homes against thieves; in exchange, POKENAME are often gifted gemstones.

entry: POKENAME精通剑术，挥斩时机无可挑剔。优雅动作启发了一款热门节奏游戏，游戏中它会随着音乐节拍迎战敌人。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME is skilled at swordplay, slashing opponents with impeccable timing. Its elegant moves have inspired a popular rhythm-based video game where POKENAME fights enemies to the beat of the music.

entry: 进化后，群体内的成员数量翻倍。害怕被盯着看或害怕尖锐物品的训练家，不适合训练它。
author: duskrd
source: The number of members in the colony has doubled during its evolution. Trainers with scopophobia or aichmophobia should not train this Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME很聪明，发展出自己制剑的方法。它把石头磨利，装在棍上，再用结实的毛绑紧。
author: cloudmaker2169
source: POKENAME are intelligent Pokémon that have developed a way to make their own swords. They sharpen stones and attach them to sticks, using their strong hair to tie them together.

entry: 它爱在废弃城堡筑巢，歌声如同小号吹响迎宾号曲。
author: .flipside3
source: It likes to build nests in abandoned castles. Its song resembles a trumpet's fanfare.

entry: 它从不背后袭敌。双翼既可当铠甲，也能用来飞行。
author: .flipside3
source: It never attacks an opponent from behind. Its wings are used for armor as well as flight.

entry: 沙漠地区的剑士常寻找POKENAME训练。它能甩出手中双剑击中远敌，但得花几天才能重新长好。
author: h0bojoe
source: Swordsmen in desert regions often seek out POKENAME for training. It can fling the swords in its hands to hit distant foes, but it takes a few days for them to regrow.

entry: POKENAME将两把剑收进体内，却不会受伤。夜里会漫游沙漠，寻找对手挑战，用双刃不懈攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME sheath their two swords inside their own bodies, but this doesn't do them any harm. At night, they will roam the desert searching for foes to challenge, attacking them relentlessly with both blades.

entry: 野生POKENAME常把树果串在头上刀刃，留着以后吃。若在寒地长大，围巾也会变长。
author: .flipside3
source: Wild POKENAME will often skewer Berries on the blades on their heads to be eaten later. If raised in colder weather, its scarf will grow longer.

entry: 身体各处的眼睛，留意每个方向的危险。围巾末端十分灵巧，甚至能从树上摘果。
author: .flipside3
source: It watches for danger from any direction using the eyes on its body. The ends of its scarf are dexterous enough to pluck Berries from trees.

entry: POKENAME木质背部的两把剑，都能自行拔出、独立攻击。但一次只有一把会这样做；若两把都被拔走，身体就会瘫倒在地。
author: .jerden
source: Each of the swords in POKENAME's wooden back can pull itself out to attack autonomously. Only one of them will do this at a time; if both are removed, POKENAME's body will slump to the ground.

entry: POKENAME一生大多时候都不太活动，除非受到威胁。察觉危险，蘑菇里的双剑便会活过来，飞出菌体，以迅疾连斩保护它。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME remains rather inert for most of its life, unless a threat is posed to it. Once it senses danger, the swords within its mushroom spring to life, flying out of the fungus and defending POKENAME with numerous quick slashes.

entry: POKENAME用双刃编织复杂攻势。一把用来集中火焰，燃烧温度超过5000度；另一把留在鞘中，用来防御反击。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME weaves complex attack patterns with its blades. One is used as a flame focus burning at over five thousand degrees. The other stays sheathed and is used to defend against counter attacks.

entry: POKENAME外形醒目，中世纪时被用于纹章。大多只是取其形象，但偶尔也会直接用上活的个体，鼓励它白天待在纹章盾上休息。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's striking appearance led to them being used in heraldic crests during medieval times. Whilst their use was mostly as inspiration, they were occasionally used literally, with POKENAME encouraged to rest upon a heraldic shield during the day.

entry: POKENAME用爪刃将植物切成纤维条，制作住处与衣服。纺织厂商常因这门本领而捕捉它。
author: sleepyman0731
source: POKENAME uses its claw blades to cut down plants into strips of fiber. POKENAME will use the plant fiber to create its home and clothing. Textile manufacturers often catch POKENAME for its skill.

entry: POKENAME将一把刀埋在地里，挥舞另一把战斗，通常偏重防守。若有什么突破防线，碰到埋地的剑，它就会格外凶暴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME buries one blade in the ground and wields the other in combat, typically with a defensive style. It becomes particularly aggressive if something breaches its defenses and touches the sword embedded in the ground.

entry: POKENAME由一个主体与一对同样具有智慧的刀刃组成，原生于古代遗迹附近的沙漠。
author: neonriser
source: POKENAME comes in the form of a single entity accompanied by a pair of equally sapient blades. It is native to deserts near ancient ruins.

entry: POKENAME常光顾酒馆，帮忙护送醉客回家。荣誉感胜过求财欲，经常保护委托人，不让偷窃的宝可梦得手。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are known to frequent taverns and pubs where they help escort drunken guests back home. Their sense of honor is greater than their desire for money, as they often protect their client from thieving Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME通过不断战斗，将战斗感官磨炼得极为敏锐。它能迅速换握刀刃，向后打击和正面反击同样流畅，几乎无法偷袭。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has finely honed its battle senses through constant combat. Sneak attacks are almost impossible, as it can quickly shift the grip on its blades to strike behind it as fluidly as it would counter an attack from the front.

entry: POKENAME有时受雇在厨房备料，双刀切食物很快，但也容易愤怒地冲向不满意饭菜的客人。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are sometimes employed within kitchens to help with food preparation. They chop through food rapidly with their twin blades, but are prone to angrily charging at customers who are dissatisfied with their meal.

entry: POKENAME挥双刀时，怒气多于优雅，双臂快速旋转，试图砍中敌人。挥刀快得能产生冲击波，扩大斩击范围。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wield their twin blades with more fury than grace, whirling their arms rapidly in an effort to slash their foes. They can swing their blades fast enough to create shockwaves, extending the range of their cuts.

entry: POKENAME挥双刀时，怒气多于优雅，双臂快速旋转，试图砍中敌人。它没耐心练武器，每次尝试训练，最后都会挥刀砍向老师。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME wield their twin blades with more fury than grace, whirling their arms rapidly in an effort to slash their foes. They lack the patience to train with their weapons; attempts to do so invariably end in POKENAME slashing at their teacher.

entry: POKENAME背上的刀刃蕴含庞大幽灵之力。可喷火龙每次使用，都会被双剑鞘抽取生命力。
author: nellnast42
source: The blades on POKENAME's back hold immense spectral power. However, each time Charizard uses them, Doublade drains its life force.

entry: POKENAME战前会将一把刀插进地面，以单剑和拳头迎战。只有足够强的斗士，才能逼它双持武器，全力以赴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME plants one of its blades in the ground before battle to fight with a single sword and its fist. Only powerful enough fighters will make it dual-wield its weapons and fight at its fullest.

entry: POKENAME住在深海珊瑚礁，掠过海床，寻找甲壳类宝可梦。触手尖端的刀刃能迅速精准地刺穿下方猎物，再硬的壳也能穿透，随后将其吞食。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME live in deep-sea coral reefs, skimming the seafloor in search of crustacean Pokémon. The blades at the tips of their tentacles skewer any prey below them with speed and precision, piercing even the toughest shells before devouring them.

entry: 它的独特剑术策略是迅速挥斩，再将身体蜷成球闪避。只要战术得当，普通剑士也能诱使POKENAME滚进坑中，取得胜利。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its unique swordplay strategy consists of quick swipes and rolling its body into a ball to dodge. With proper strategy, an average swordsman can defeat POKENAME by making it roll into a pit.

entry: 过去，人们骑乘POKENAME出征。据说骑着它的战士每战都能获胜扬名，但战争一结束，就再也不见踪影。
author: t3isukone
source: In the past, POKENAME was ridden to war. It is said a warrior mounted atop a POKENAME would win victory and glory in every battle-but after the war ended, they would never be seen again.

entry: POKENAME的战术是胡乱挥舞刀刃般的双臂。头上的剑也能拔下，用念力操控，但它经常忘了自己有这本领。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's combat strategy consists of wildly flailing its bladed arms. The sword in its head can be removed and wielded through telekinesis, but POKENAME often forgets it has that ability.

entry: POKENAME战斗时会闭眼，进入禅定般的宁静。动作凶猛流畅，仿佛刀刃自己引导双手，走向胜利。
author: sk372
source: When it goes into combat, POKENAME closes its eyes and enters a zen-like state of tranquility. Its battle movements are fierce and fluid, as if the blades themselves guide its hands to victory.

entry: POKENAME用连在身体和头部的缎带操控剑，能极快地切换战斗架势。它漫游海洋，寻找剑术高手，检验自己的本领。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME manipulates its sword with the ribbons attached to its body and head, allowing it to change fighting stances with remarkable speed. This Pokémon roams the seas in search of skilled swordsmen to test its abilities against.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃由幽灵气体构成，连续使用后便会消散。随着不断重铸，力量逐渐增强，最终能让它进化为更凝实的形态。
author: fireflower20002
source: The blade of POKENAME is made from its spectral gas, and because of this, it will dissipate after continuous use. As it continues to reforge its blade, it will become stronger and eventually allow POKENAME to evolve to a more solid form.

entry: POKENAME的金属爪十分锋利，夹住后抓握力很强。它靠刺穿、切开和夹碎鱼类与甲壳类生灵维生。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's metal claws are quite sharp and possess a strong grip when clamped. It uses them to stab, slice and crush fish and crustaceans for sustenance.

entry: POKENAME从水下遗迹收集武器，用钳子刮净、保养。它横着走进战场，一剑进攻，一剑防守。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME collect weapons from underwater ruins, using their claws to scrape them clean and maintain them. They scuttle sideways into battle, one sword used for offense and the other for defence.

entry: POKENAME疾如风，拥有牢不可破的王者盾牌与势不可挡的刀刃，是可怕的敌人。若竟被逼到败北边缘，它就会爆炸，把对手也一并击倒。
author: imaginita
source: Fast as the wind, bearing an impenetrable King's Shield and indomitable blade, POKENAME is a formidable foe.  If it is somehow pushed to the edge of defeat, POKENAME will explode, taking its opponent down with it.

entry: POKENAME热切守护所爱，警觉得片刻不松。到了睡觉时间也难以入睡，可能会请求站岗，保护在意的对象。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are zealous defenders of their loved ones and have a tenacious hypervigilance. Whenever bedtime rolls around, they have difficulty falling asleep and may request to stand guard to protect those they care about.

entry: 许多壁画与故事将POKENAME描绘成守护他者、尤其保护幼小生灵的高尚骑士。剑盾由极其耐久的金属制成，战斗中丢失或掷出后，都会回到身边。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME appear in many murals and tales as honorable knights that fight to protect others, especially the young. Their swords and shields return to them if they are ever lost or thrown during battle and are made of an extraordinarily durable metal.

entry: POKENAME虽然情感成熟，头上的头骨里却留存着苦涩情绪。攻击敌人时，它会借用这些情绪。
author: slimninja55
source: While POKENAME may be emotionally mature Pokémon, they hold bitter feelings in the skull on their heads. They harness these emotions when striking foes.

entry: 据说，每只POKENAME都寄宿着王族的灵魂。它的意志与铠甲一样坚不可摧，即使败局已定，也绝不低头。
author: xillo
source: It is said that each POKENAME possesses the soul of royalty. Indomitable in both spirit and armor, this Pokémon never yields, even in assured defeat.

entry: POKENAME藏在茧中，不让外界触及内脏。受到鸟宝可梦攻击时，会侧翻身体，让盾牌承受啄击力量。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME deny entry to their internal organs by hiding within their cocoon. They flip onto their side whenever they are attacked by bird Pokémon to allow their shield to absorb the force of pecking.

entry: POKENAME不惜性命保护幼崽，熟练挥使随身剑盾。攻击如剑术大师般精湛，威力大得连大树也能一击斩倒。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME defends its cubs at the cost of its own life, skillfully wielding the sword and shield it always carries. Its attacks, executed with the skill of a master fencer, are so powerful that they can fell even large trees with a single blow.

entry: 古老故事称，POKENAME会盯上伟大英雄，在其冒险途中反复出现，像纠缠不休的反派般不断攻击。另一些故事却认为，它只是在训练英雄，准备应对更大的威胁。
author: wiz0z
source: Old stories tell of POKENAME targeting great heroes, attacking them relentlessly over the course of their adventures as recurring villains. Other tales suggest these POKENAME were simply training the heroes for even greater threats.

entry: POKENAME每天与同类练习，铠甲越来越坚实，却不慎毁坏了围巾。它会靠幽灵力量飘过训练家晾晒的衣物，找条替代品借用。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME practices daily against others of its kind, leaving its armor stronger than ever and unintentionally destroying its scarves. It floats with ghostly powers through its Trainer's drying laundry until it finds a replacement to borrow.

entry: 有则广为流传的寓言，讲述一只传说中的POKENAME挥剑一下，将山劈成两半。据说这故事曾在遥远过去激励许多见习骑士。
author: sk372
source: There exists a popular fable of a legendary POKENAME that cleaved a mountain in two with a single swipe of its blade. This fable supposedly inspired many knights in training in the distant past.

entry: POKENAME掌握了同时使用三把剑的战斗技巧，以纯粹斗志强化刀刃，让原本惊人的力量更上一层。
author: slimninja55
source: POKENAME has mastered a fighting technique using three swords at once. It has strengthened its blades with pure fighting spirit to increase its already immense power.

entry: POKENAME砍倒许多树后，会用幽灵力量强迫其他生灵为自己建小屋与木房。冬季，它和其他凯罗斯便在里面躲避严寒。
author: soup1900
source: After felling many trees, POKENAME uses its spectral powers to force beings into building huts and wooden houses for it. These buildings serve as shelters during the winter for it and other Pinsir from the freezing environment.

entry: POKENAME砍倒许多树后，会用幽灵力量强迫其他生灵为自己建小屋与木房。冬季，它和其他凯罗斯便在里面躲避严寒。
author: soup1900
source: After felling many trees, POKENAME uses its spectral powers to force beings into building huts and wooden houses for it. These buildings serve as shelters during the winter for it and other Pinsir from the freezing environment.

entry: POKENAME交剑对战，决定谁领导群体。颈边坚实的盾能在决斗中保护身体。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will clash their swords, fighting in order to see who will lead their herd. The tough shields around their necks help protect them during these duels.

entry: POKENAME外形近乎王者，却和大多数鲤鱼王融合体一样弱。它拿不稳自己的剑，无法好好战斗，铠甲也稍一受力就会崩裂。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's aesthetic gives it an almost regal appearance, but it is as typically weak as most every Magikarp fusion. It cannot properly hold its own sword to wield in battle, and its armor chips and breaks with little resistance.

entry: 野生POKENAME住在偏远湖泊，等待真正有领袖素质的人。传说，有志称王者会试图收服它，证明资格，但失败者都化成了灰。
author: h0bojoe
source: Wild POKENAME dwell in remote lakes, awaiting those with the qualities of a true leader. In legend, aspiring kings sought to capture one to prove their worth, but those who failed were reduced to cinders.

entry: POKENAME虽披沉重金属甲，仍能用布翅滑翔。携带的刀刃与身体一样长，它却能用尾巴卷住，挥得有力而精准。
author: .jerden
source: Despite the weight of its heavy metal armor, POKENAME glides on wings made of cloth. Although the blade it carries is as long as its body, it can wrap its tail around it to wield it with both power and precision.

entry: POKENAME用嘴衔的剑与尾部短刃战斗。俯冲后会争取迅速结束战斗，因为一落地，翼膜就容易受伤。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME fights using both the sword it carries in its mouth and the shorter blade on its tail. It tries to finish foes quickly after swooping down on them, as its wing membranes are vulnerable as soon as it lands on the ground.

entry: POKENAME体形厚重，威势十足，曾被用于宫外守卫。不过，它爱打瞌睡，不太适合这项工作。
author: .jerden
source: Due to their formidable bulk, POKENAME have been used as imposing guards outside of palaces. However, their tendency to doze off makes them ill-suited to this duty.

entry: POKENAME体形厚重，威势十足，曾被用于宫外守卫。不过，它爱打瞌睡，不太适合这项工作。
author: .jerden
source: Due to their formidable bulk, POKENAME have been used as imposing guards outside of palaces. However, their tendency to doze off makes them ill-suited to this duty.

entry: POKENAME收集剑盾，用能抓握的长尾挥使。只要它携着这套武器，每道刃口与每处表面都会覆上厚霜。
author: alestrius
source: POKENAME collects swords and shields to wield with its long, prehensile tail. So long as this Pokémon carries its arsenal, a thick layer of frost will coat every blade and surface.

entry: POKENAME操纵身边不断产生的磁场，控制巨大的钢剑。它通过翅膀吸收雷鸣的能量，放出威力惊人的电击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME controls its massive steel sword by manipulating the magnetic fields it constantly generates around itself. It absorbs the energy of thunderclaps through its wings, allowing it to unleash electrical strikes of astonishing power.

entry: 这种宝可梦的火焰是不灭意志的显现。虽然没有手，却极其擅长挥使巨剑，只会向值得一战的敌人亮剑。
author: infinex21
source: The flames of this Pokémon signify its undying will personified as flames. It is remarkably skilled with its giant sword despite having no hands, but will only unleash it against worthy foes.

entry: POKENAME的蜂巢并非按真社会性组织，而是类似人类君主制。因此，有的蜂巢由国王、女王，或两者共同守卫，奋战至最后一息。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: Instead of being eusocial, hives of POKENAME operate similar to a human monarchy. Because of this, some hives have kings, queens, or both working together to defend their hive with their dying breath.

entry: POKENAME能改变形态，模仿见过的任何刀刃。战斗时，动作仿佛受高明武士操控。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can alter its form to mimic any blade it has seen. During combat, it moves as though controlled by an accomplished samurai.

entry: POKENAME用头上的手臂挥舞锋利的叶形刀刃，如同身体自然的延伸。颈边坚实金属抵挡一切来袭，让它打出决定性重击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use the arm on their heads to swing their razor-sharp, leaf-shaped blades as if they were an extension of their own body. The solid metal around their necks keeps all incoming attacks at bay while they deliver decisive blows.

entry: 英勇骑士的铠甲设计，很大程度受POKENAME外貌启发。甲上的装饰花瓣全由金属构成，能化为威力惊人的飞叶快刀。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The armor worn by gallant knights is greatly inspired by POKENAME's appearance. The decorative petals on its armor are pure metal, and can become a devastating Razor Leaf.

entry: POKENAME通常挥舞钢制武器，巡逻守卫河流与瀑布。剑术极其高超，即使水下交战也不例外。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME usually patrols and defends rivers and waterfalls by wielding its steel weapons. Its swordsmanship skills are incredible, even when fighting underwater.

entry: POKENAME用力量控制他者前，会先预见未来，查看对方意志多强、有多大可能背叛。若结果不合心意，就立刻用巨刃干脆利落地砍下去。
author: soup1900
source: Before POKENAME uses its powers to control others, it first sees into the future to see how strong their will is and their likelihood of betrayal. To those whose outcomes are not to its liking, it promptly slices them clean with its large blades.

entry: 被逼到极限时，POKENAME的珍珠会放电，电流涌遍全身，让剑击更强。它极其孤僻，漫游世界，寻找需要保护的生灵。
author: fiordaliso
source: When pushed to its limits, POKENAME's pearls begin to emit electric shocks that surge through its entire body, further empowering the strikes of its sword. It is an extremely solitary Pokémon that wanders the world in search of creatures to protect.

entry: 被逼到极限时，POKENAME的珍珠会放电，电流涌遍全身，让剑击更强。它极其孤僻，漫游世界，寻找需要保护的生灵。
author: fiordaliso
source: When pushed to its limits, POKENAME's pearls begin to emit electric shocks that surge through its entire body, further empowering the strikes of its sword. It is an extremely solitary Pokémon that wanders the world in search of creatures to protect.

entry: 融合能量染上了花朵。胸前宝石是有自身意识，还是仅在辅助能力，仍有争论。
author: noilaedi
source: The energy from fusion has tinted its flowers. It's debated if the jewel on its chest is sentient or assisting in its abilities.

entry: POKENAME始终勇敢重诺，据说是从异世界穿越时间而来的骑士。
author: adoster
source: Always displaying courage and honor, POKENAME are rumored to be time-traveling knights from another world.

entry: POKENAME坚定保卫小拉达群，深受它们敬仰。守护时也试着教其他啮齿宝可梦更好的行为，希望害兽的恶名能渐渐消退。
author: sk372
source: Rattata look up to POKENAME, as it is a staunch defender of their colonies. As it watches over them, POKENAME tries to teach the other rodents better behavior, so that their reputation as pests may fade in time.

entry: POKENAME认为训练家不配时，会离开；若愿意留下，则是莫大的荣耀。可惜它不太聪明，有时也会自己走丢，所以训练家仍得留神。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are known to leave their Trainer if they deem them unworthy, but if they stay with them, it is a sign of great honour. Unfortunately, they are not very intelligent and sometimes wander off, so Trainers must remain vigilant.

entry: POKENAME用精神力熟练挥刃作战。它只与正直的训练家结盟，英勇奋战，维护这份荣誉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its psychic powers to deftly wield its blade in combat. It only allies itself with honorable Trainers, and fights valiantly to uphold said honor.

entry: POKENAME尾持大刀，身覆坚甲，攻防都很强。它能将刀掷向对手，再以精神力操控，打乱敌人节奏。
author: sk372
source: Holding a large blade with its tail and coated with solid armor, POKENAME boasts formidable offense and defense. It can throw the blade at an opponent and manipulate it psychically to throw off a foe's rhythm.

entry: POKENAME不断擦亮巨大的钢刃，保持光洁。谁也别想让它交出刀刃，就连乌鸦头头老大也不行。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is constantly polishing its large steel blade to keep it bright and shiny. It will never give up this blade to anybody, not even to its Honchkrow boss.

entry: POKENAME颚力惊人，能用嘴熟练挥使体形两倍以上的武器。每只都会学习、练习并运用数十种武器技巧，用于战斗与日常生活。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME boast incredible jaw strength, expertly wielding armaments over twice their size with their mouths. Each POKENAME learns, practices, and utilizes dozens of different weapon techniques for battle and everyday use.

entry: 这种宝可梦过去受伽勒尔王族喜爱，因此广为人知。神话称，它身上的古代文字，在它喜欢的对象与素未谋面的人眼中，会显出不同内容。
author: jangodiot
source: This Pokémon was once widely known in Galar due to its popularity among the royal class. According to myth, the ancient text on its body changes to be read differently by those it is fond of compared to people it has never met.

entry: POKENAME用钳子夹住腿刃拉动，磨利刃口。尖锐摩擦声大得可怕，数英里外都能听到。
author: mellowmuse
source: POKENAME sharpen their leg blades by clutching them between their claws and pulling. It creates a horribly loud screech that can be heard from several miles away.

entry: POKENAME在金属壳内消化树果，转成芳香油脂。过去，这种油被用于国王的涂油仪式。
author: .jerden
source: Inside its metallic shell, POKENAME digests berries, transforming them into a fragrant oil. In the past, this oil was used to anoint kings.

entry: POKENAME在战斗间隙用刀磨喙。这样，即使剑被高手缴走，也始终有锋利武器应对敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sharpens its beak with its blade between battles. This way, even if a skilled foe were able to disarm the sword it wields, it would never be caught without a sharp weapon to deal with its opponent.

entry: POKENAME只允许自己的训练家挥使。瞄准镜能追踪目标灵魂，无论对方走到哪里。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME will only allow their Trainer to wield them. Its scope can track the souls of its targets no matter where they go.

entry: POKENAME长着斧状长牙，鼻中持剑，全身覆着盾般铠甲，外貌十分醒目。据说古时佩戴它形象徽记的骑士，都是当代最有本领、最具骑士精神的人。
author: sk372
source: With axe-like tusks, a sword in its trunk, and shield-like armor across its body, POKENAME cuts a striking visage. Knights of old carrying an emblem in its image were said to be the most skilled and chivalrous of their era.

entry: POKENAME每次击中敌人，体内都会产生更多电力。充足后，便将能量传到头上尖端，射出雷电刀刃，劈向对手。
author: sk372
source: Each strike POKENAME makes against a foe generates more internal electricity. Once it charges enough, it transfers the energy to the points on its head, which fire out blades of lightning to cleave its opponents.

entry: POKENAME挥剑举盾，每个动作都灌注火热激情。盾会点燃，旋转着在身边拖出火焰，压迫敌人，同时它蓄势准备毁灭性一斩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME wields a sword and shield with fiery passion instilled in every motion. Its shield ignites and trails fire around it as it spins, pressuring foes while POKENAME readies its blade for a devastating strike.

entry: POKENAME高贵威严的外貌与举止备受赞誉。故事将它挥使的金色火焰，赞作由它施行的神圣正义。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is lauded for its noble and regal appearance and mannerisms. The golden color of the flames it wields was heralded in stories as divine justice being delivered by POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME住在深水巨压之下，体表金属甲片比目前已知的金属更坚韧。有些传说称，只有感知到合格训练家，或要对抗巨大邪恶时，它才会上浮。
author: infinex21
source: Because POKENAME resides deep underwater in immense pressures, the metallic plating along its body is tougher than current-known metals. Some legends claim that POKENAME only surfaces when it senses a worthy Trainer or to confront a great evil.

entry: POKENAME是海中与海面上生灵的终极守护者，被形容为活的巨漩涡。巨刃只一挥，就能掀起庞大台风，摧毁一切阻碍。
author: sk372
source: The ultimate guardian of those who dwell beneath the ocean or above, POKENAME has been described as a living maelstrom. A single swing of its colossal blade can whip up a massive typhoon to decimate any opposition.

entry: POKENAME会领导皮卡丘大军，强迫它们制造雷暴，劈中自己的刀刃。刀刃因此变大，直至一斩就能杀死整群宝可梦。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are known to be leaders of armies of Pikachu. They force these Pikachu to cause lightning storms that strike their blade, increasing its size to the point where they can slay entire groups of Pokémon in one fell cleave.

entry: POKENAME骑着巨刃，刀刃能斩开时间，穿梭其中。它跃过各个时代，与过去、现在和未来最伟大的训练家交手，或并肩作战。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rides on its massive blade, which can cut through and travel across time. It leaps through the eras to fight against and alongside the greatest Trainers of the past, present and future.

entry: POKENAME找到天生具有领导力的人，就会一丝不苟地服从命令，完全不顾行动的后果。
author: nexkode
source: When an POKENAME finds someone who has innate leadership, it will begin following their orders to the letter, regardless of the effects of its actions.

entry: POKENAME用巨大的刀刃状尾巴劈向对手，碰到任何东西都会放电。摆出防御姿态时，能制造静电场，挡住来袭，也将攻击者电退。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME cleaves opponents with its large blade-tail, discharging its electricity on contact with anything. When in a defensive stance, it can create a static field that blocks incoming attacks while also shocking any attackers back.

entry: POKENAME明知属性不利，仍爱找克制自己的宝可梦打架。能击败它们时，会感到无比骄傲与荣耀。
author: koffing_guy1129
source: POKENAME, despite their typing, are known to pick fights with Pokémon that have the type advantage. They feel great pride and honor when they are able to defeat them.

entry: POKENAME体内有火，身体始终热得足以煮沸水。产生更强热量时，会灼红甚至白热，但最高温度会让金属软化，容易受损。
author: .jerden
source: The fire inside POKENAME means that its body is always hot enough to boil water. While generating more intense heat, it will glow red or even white hot, but the highest temperatures will soften the metal and leave it vulnerable to damage.

entry: POKENAME默默游历四方，寻找能奉为主人的训练家。一旦认可对方，就会忠心不二地效力。收服后，最好尽早为它准备剑鞘或头盔。
author: modeustheunbound
source: POKENAME silently roams the world, looking for a Trainer to call its master. It is highly loyal and devoted to those it deems worthy. Be sure to buy a sheath or helmet for it at your earliest convenience.

entry: 在近代以前，POKENAME是备受珍视的战兽。记录中，只有最强大、最有影响力的国王拥有过它。
author: dylonk25
source: In premodern history, POKENAME was a highly prized war animal. Only the most powerful and influential kings have been recorded owning an POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME非常喜欢接受领导力强的训练家指挥。训练家一犹豫，它就可能举止失常，随意切换攻守策略，往往因此落败。
author: notadoctor75
source: POKENAME greatly prefers to be commanded by trainers that are strong leaders. If its trainer falters, POKENAME can begin to behave erratically, switching between offensive and defensive strategies at random, often leading to defeat.

entry: POKENAME入侵搜索引擎，让其吐出自己想要的答案与结果，影响人们。上当的可怜人最后会花费数千的钱款，建超级计算机供它居住。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME influences people by hacking into search engines and have them spout out the answers and results that it wants. The unfortunate people who fall for its tricks end up spending thousands building supercomputers for it to live in.

entry: 头饰上镶着华丽的盾牌。POKENAME常将盾牌撞向树桩，敲出富有节奏的鼓点。
author: schwaus
source: Its headdress is adorned with an ornate shield. POKENAME often slam these shields into tree stumps to create rhythmic beats.

entry: 传说，这只宝可梦一击便能横扫千军。铁匠们研究POKENAME，希望造出更精良的武器与铠甲。
author: schwaus
source: Legends say that this Pokémon was able to defeat whole armies in a single sweep. Blacksmiths research POKENAME to create better weapons and armor.

entry: POKENAME虽小，却很凶猛，毫不犹豫地击倒敌人。但盾牌往往太重，很难在头上放稳。
author: ultron_suprem3
source: While they are small, POKENAME are fierce Pokémon and are not hesitant to strike a foe down. Despite this, their shields are often too heavy to remain balanced on their heads.

entry: POKENAME的身体与武器由极其耐久的特殊金属构成。战斗时，它用精神力引导缎带，限制敌人动作。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's body and weaponry are made of a special metal that is extremely durable. In battle, POKENAME uses psychic powers to guide its ribbon to restrict the movements of its foes.

entry: 据说POKENAME的盾牢不可破，只有它选中的训练家才能靠近。训练家遇险，它就会改变架势，以念力拔剑，用如暴雨般的攻击淹没威胁。
author: ghostslythe
source: It is said POKENAME's shield is unbreakable, and only their chosen Trainers can get into close proximity. When their Trainer is in trouble, POKENAME's stance changes, it draws its blade telekinetically and drowns the threat in a deluge of attacks.

entry: POKENAME虽然双目失明，却能作出最公正的裁决。自诞生以来，它便被“宝可梦正义律师”用作象征。
author: galactakiller
source: Although POKENAME is blind, it delivers the most righteous judgements. Since its creation, it has been used as a symbol of Pokémon Justice Attorneys.

entry: POKENAME为真理与正义而战，挥使剑盾，甚至能造出精神能量套索。传说有座岛只住着它们，在那里将战斗技巧磨炼至完美。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fights for truth and justice using its sword and shield, and even a lasso of psychic energy it can create. Legends say there exists an island inhabited solely by POKENAME, where they hone their combat skills to perfection.

entry: 据说这种神秘宝可梦，诞生于高贵战士不得安息的灵魂，永远与一套古老、有意识的剑盾相缚。刀刃泛着精神能量的光，盾则散出幽冷寒气，连周围空气也能冻结。
author: vincentblack
source: A mysterious Pokémon said to be born from the restless spirit of noble warriors eternally bound to an ancient, sentient sword and shield. Its blade glows with psychic energy, while its shield emits a ghostly chill that freezes even the air around it.

entry: POKENAME用磨利的臂刃拨开攻击，迅速反击。任何试图拦路的守卫，都会被它迅速而无情地砍倒。
author: frl6160
source: POKENAME uses its sharpened arm blades to deflect strikes and deliver swift counterattacks. Any guard attempting to impede this Pokémon's path will be cut down swiftly and without mercy.

entry: POKENAME刀法极其高超。它能取下头上的盾加强防守，也能掷向对手。刀刃闪光曾让敌人目眩失明。
author: huh.7
source: POKENAME possesses incredible skills with its blade. It can take off the shield it wears on its head for extra defense, or throw it at opponents. The glint from its blade has been known to blind foes.

entry: POKENAME刀法极其高超。它能取下头上的盾加强防守，也能掷向对手。
author: huh.7
source: POKENAME possesses incredible skills with its blade. It can take off the shield it wears on its head for extra defense, or throw it at opponents.

entry: POKENAME放弃蜷缩自卫，选择正面迎敌。即使用剑盾交战，也能以尾巴摘下背上长出的许多小匕首，甩向对手。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME has forsaken its ability to curl up in defense and instead chooses to engage their foes head-on. It can use its tail to pluck and fling the many small daggers growing upon its back even while it is engaging foes with its sword and shield.

entry: 据说POKENAME英勇，拥有骑士之心，凭神秘力量能判断眼前之人的品格与意图。传闻它的剑能斩断一切，连他人的情感也不例外。
author: bobosmith01
source: A valorous Pokémon said to have the heart of a knight, POKENAME is able to determine the integrity and intentions of whoever is in front of it thanks to its mysterious powers. It is said its sword can cleave through anything, even another's emotions.

entry: 据说POKENAME英勇，拥有骑士之心，凭神秘力量能判断眼前之人的品格与意图。有人猜测，它的主体其实由剑操纵。
author: bobosmith01
source: A valorous Pokémon said to have the heart of a knight, POKENAME is able to determine the integrity and intentions of whoever is in front of it thanks to its mysterious powers. Some have speculated that the main body is puppeteered by its sword.

entry: 据说POKENAME英勇，拥有骑士之心，凭神秘力量能判断眼前之人的品格与意图。传闻它的言语能斩开万物，连他人的情感也不例外。
author: bobosmith01
source: A valorous Pokémon said to have the heart of a knight, POKENAME is able to determine the integrity and intentions of whoever is in front of it thanks to its mysterious powers. It is said its word can cleave through anything, even another's emotions.

entry: POKENAME是凶猛的斗士，用带盾的双臂招架来袭，或直接猛砸敌人。两种方式都能创造空隙，让它以头上巨大锐刃劈向对方。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is a vicious fighter. It uses its shielded arms to parry incoming attacks or to simply bash foes. Both give POKENAME an opening to cleave its foe with the large, sharp blade on its head.

entry: 各地都知道，POKENAME会在英雄危急时刻现身，给他们武装，迎战强敌。
author: tomatosalad
source: POKENAME is known throughout the lands to appear to heroes in their time of need, arming them to fight great foes.

entry: POKENAME重视战斗荣誉，用双颚监视，衡量潜在对手的实力。它会让敌人先攻，摸清本领，再以猛烈挥斩反击。
author: ghostslythe
source: Honorable combatants, POKENAME uses its twin jaws as lookouts which weigh the strengths of potential opponents. It allows foes to strike first, gauging their abilities before counterattacking with furious slashes.

entry: POKENAME战技高超，熟练挥刃，砍倒对手。若武器被缴走，鬃毛就会显出真貌，露出藏着的钢牙。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a highly skilled fighter who expertly wields the blade it carries to cut down any opponent. If it is disarmed, its mane reveals its true appearance, exposing the steel fangs it had kept hidden.

entry: POKENAME将节肢宝可梦团结在自己的旗帜下，击败最强大的敌人。它一睡着，士兵们就会互相攻击。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME unites arthropod Pokémon under its banner to take down the mightiest foes. When it falls asleep, its soldiers turn on each other.

entry: POKENAME控制对手，让其过度战斗，再用强化的身体施以致命重击。
author: loadedace
source: POKENAME controls opponents into excessive fighting, utilizing its reinforced body to inflict deadly hits.

entry: 能在尼多一族的洞穴外见到POKENAME保护幼崽。精湛剑术与持久耐力让天敌望而生畏，不敢靠近洞穴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are found outside Nidroran burrows protecting their young. Their expert swordsmanship and tenacious stamina intimidate predators into avoiding the burrows.

entry: 传说POKENAME曾在古代王国的王室军队中效力。但凡任用它的王国，都走向毁灭，因此有人认为，它从内部摧毁了这些国家。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Legends have been passed down speaking of POKENAME that served in royal armies in ancient kingdoms. Every kingdom that staffed POKENAME fell to ruin, leading to the theory that POKENAME destroyed the kingdoms from inside themselves.

entry: POKENAME曾被视为王族，随侍古代国王，帮助治国。但这些国王命中注定要败亡，王国却无端归罪于它，将它逐出城市。
author: ultron_suprem3
source: POKENAME were once seen as royalty, tailing ancient kings at their side, aiding them in their leadership. However, these kings were fated to fall, and their kingdoms unfoundedly blamed POKENAME for it, banishing them from their cities.

entry: 深夜，这些宝可梦将随身剑当作乐器演奏。诡异旋律带来严寒，将较弱的对手冻得无法动弹，再迅速砍倒。
author: actliux
source: In the dead of night, these Pokémon play music using the sword they carry as if it were an instrument. The haunting melody produces freezing temperatures that chill weaker opponents to a standstill before they are swiftly cut down.

entry: 据说POKENAME体内只有一团幽灵火焰。它们曾被用作护卫，阻止任何人亵渎国王陵墓。
author: heal_fire
source: The body of POKENAME is told to only contain a spectral ball of fire. These Pokémon were used as bodyguards to prevent anyone from desecrating the tombs of kings.

entry: POKENAME盘踞古堡与要塞，照看、守护破败建筑。它乐于向探险者和考古学家挑战，尽力阻止他们进入自己的家。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME haunt ancient castles and fortifications, acting as custodians and guardians of the ruined structures. They will happily challenge would-be explorers and archaeologists, doing what they can to deny access to their homes.

entry: POKENAME会在岩石上磨利带刃的门状结构，领地里因而常有被磨成各种形状的石头。过去，中世纪骑士以它的形象象征力量与勇气。
author: chibitales
source: Territories where POKENAME live are often filled with rocks filed down in different shapes due to POKENAME sharpening its bladed gate on them. Images of this Pokémon were used in the past as symbols of power and courage for medieval knights.

entry: POKENAME对训练家极为忠诚，视其为世上最重要的人。这份专一奉献，有时会扰乱周围的日常生活。
author: friendly_neighborhood_neko
source: POKENAME are known to hold a fierce loyalty to their Trainers, seeing them as the most important person in the world. The single-minded devotion POKENAME have to their Trainers sometimes causes disruptions in day-to-day life around them.

entry: 它似乎能看出与生俱来的领袖资质。传说获其认可者，注定会成为领主。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become a lord.

entry: POKENAME凭钢刃的力道与重量，能劈开任何对手。可它的另一半，却已被夺走。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME can cleave any opponent with the strength and weight of its steel blade, but it was robbed of its other half.

entry: POKENAME不停寻找能强化自己的稀有材料，梦想有朝一日集齐所需，登上力量顶峰。
author: rakanadyo
source: POKENAME constantly seek out rare materials they can use to empower themselves. They dream of the day they find all that they need and reach the zenith of their strength.

entry: POKENAME结成有组织的队伍，围攻更大的敌人。一边用重盾挡下攻击，一边耐心等待准确时机，用刀刃刺向暴露的弱点。
author: bluenido.
source: POKENAME swarm larger foes in organized packs. While blocking incoming strikes with a heavy shield, they patiently wait for the precise moment to strike an exposed weakness with their blade.

entry: 古时，POKENAME曾为国王担任守卫。它用刀刃替主人作出公正裁决，备受宠爱。
author: therider
source: In ancient times, POKENAME served as guards for ancient kings. Its blades made righteous judgements for its master, and it was highly favored.

entry: POKENAME能从头部与双臂长出武士刀，施展迅疾拔刀术。它对劈斩拉多怀有宿怨。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME is capable of sprouting katanas out of its head and arms, which it uses to perform a quick draw. It holds a vendetta against Bidon.

entry: POKENAME对认为不配的对象毫不留情。许多传说讲述国王骑着它出征，让敌我双方都心生恐惧。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME is ruthless toward those it deems unworthy. Many legends exist of kings riding into battle on the back of POKENAME, striking terror into ally and foe alike.

entry: 除围巾外，身体每个部分都如剃刀般锋利。战斗时，POKENAME高速旋转全身带刃齿轮，像活的圆锯般飞向敌人。
author: fireblade141
source: Every part of its body, aside from the scarf, is razor sharp. In battle, POKENAME attacks by spinning every bladed gear on its body at high speeds and flying towards foes like a living buzzsaw.

entry: 它是剑艺超群、手段却不光彩的剑士。先以幻象误导敌人，再挥出可怕一斩。
author: nellnast42
source: An extremely talented but underhanded swordfighter. It uses its illusions to misdirect its foes before unleashing a terrifying slash.

entry: 缎带般的触须能瞬间变得坚如钢铁。它散发安抚人心、极具魅力的气息，借此操纵其他生灵。
author: robobunnybutt
source: Its ribbonlike feelers can turn as hard as steel in an instant. It radiates a soothing and charismatic aura, which it can use to manipulate other living beings.

entry: 这种宝可梦富有骑士精神，只有保护他者或面对值得一战的对手时才举刃。只有相信对方配得上领导自己和其他生灵，POKENAME才会将哪怕一根触须缠在对方身上。
author: infinex21
source: It is a chivalrous Pokémon that only raises its blade in the defense of others or when faced with a worthy foe. An POKENAME will only wrap even a single feeler around another if they believe that other to be a worthy leader of them and of others.

entry: POKENAME用幽灵力量让领地内的人入睡，保护自己。战斗时力求速战速决，甚至会先催眠敌人再攻击，使用这种不光彩的手段。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: To protect themselves, POKENAME use their spectral power to lull people in its territory to sleep. In battle, POKENAME try to end fights as fast as possible, even using underhanded tactics such as putting their foes to sleep before striking.

entry: POKENAME战斗时势不可挡，坚甲化解大多数打击，同时熟练挥使臂刃。它能从剑中延伸能量，让斩击长度增至两倍甚至三倍。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a relentless juggernaut in combat; its tough armor negates most strikes while it deftly wields the blade on its arm. It can extend energy from the sword in order to double or even triple the length of its slashes.

entry: POKENAME像守护王族一样保护训练家。它用强劲双腿猛然前冲，挥出破坏力惊人的一斩。
author: pikachu_2434
source: POKENAME will protect Trainers as if they were royalty. It lunges forward using impressive legs and delivers a devastating slash.

entry: POKENAME听觉卓越，目不转睛，是警觉的守护者。主要靠剑盾战斗，但若对手突破防守，就会拳打脚踢。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's exceptional hearing and unblinking gaze makes it a vigilant guardian. While it mainly uses its sword and shield to fight, if the opponent makes it past its guard, it will pummel them with punches and kicks.

entry: POKENAME巨剑虽重，攻击移动却如同没有重量。它旋转着挥出巨大弧形斩击，极难躲避，有时还会教导它认可的宝可梦技巧。
author: fireblade141
source: Despite the weight of its massive sword, POKENAME can attack and move as if it were weightless. It slashes in huge, spinning arcs that are extremely difficult to avoid. POKENAME will sometimes teach techniques to Pokémon it deems worthy.

entry: POKENAME无声地漫游空荡战场，为了有人认可战斗本领而奋战。剑若从躯干拔出，它就无法移动。
author: bringmeadream_
source: POKENAME silently wanders empty battlefields. It fights in hope that someone will approve of its capability in combat. Should the sword be pulled out from its torso, POKENAME will be unable to move.

entry: POKENAME附在洞顶，垂下发光腹部，模仿珍贵宝物。目标靠近就立刻落下，用带静电的丝缠住，再使出锐利金牙。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME attaches itself to cave ceilings, dangling its glowing abdomen to mimic a valuable treasure. When targets approach, it drops down instantly, binding them in static-charged threads before utilizing its razor-sharp golden fangs.

entry: 人们相信，POKENAME是古代君主的灵魂附在灯笼上，为了继续指引子民。
author: kiwikelly
source: It is believed that an POKENAME is an ancient monarch whose soul possessed a lantern so it can continue to guide its people.

entry: POKENAME是高洁的卫士，守护着自己的领地与训练家。它用头上的刀刃防御，同时挥剑迎战前来挑战的对手。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME are noble defenders, protecting their territory and their Trainers. It uses the blades on its head for defense while wielding its sword to fight those who try to challenge them.

entry: 古文献暗示，POKENAME早在融合技术出现之前就已被创造，是打造它们的王室的贴身侍卫。
author: phantom640
source: Ancient texts hint that POKENAME was actually first created long ago before fusion, and were the personal guards to the royal houses that built them.

entry: 过去，人们在战场立起巨像纪念阵亡者。士兵亡魂附入其中，便化成POKENAME。
author: skymaster426
source: In the past, giant golems were created at the sites of wars to honor the fallen. The souls of dead soldiers possessed them, becoming POKENAME.

entry: 过去，POKENAME被用来守护整个王国，画中描绘它挥使巨锤，击倒龙宝可梦。有虚假传闻声称，灵魂被封在它体内，以幽灵力量察觉天生的领导力与实力。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: In the past POKENAME were used to guard entire kingdoms, art depicting POKENAME using their mighty hammers to fell dragon Pokémon. Hoaxes say that spirits were sealed inside POKENAME, using spectral powers to detect innate leadership and strength.

entry: POKENAME是坚定的小斗士，将剑盾战法与召唤小火球相结合。被逼到极限时，会把火焰集中在武器上，挥出火剑斩击。
author: sk372
source: A stalwart small fighter, POKENAME mixes sword-and-shield combat with the conjuration of small fireballs. When pushed to its limits, it gathers the flames onto its weapon, striking with flaming sword slashes.

entry: POKENAME能从体内弹出比整个身体还长的巨刃。它用幽灵力量控制人类，让人将侵犯领地的敌对宝可梦扔走。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can eject a giant blade longer than the entire length of its body from inside its body. It uses its spectral powers to control humans to chuck opposing Pokémon who invade its territory.

entry: 据说它曾被托付给古代王室，携带的某些钥匙年代久远，样式可追溯至数百年前。
author: footlongdingledong
source: Said to have been entrusted to royalty of ages past, some of the keys it carries are so old that they match designs dating back centuries.

entry: POKENAME钥匙形的刀刃既是有效武器，也能打开任何锁。有故事讲述它对抗企图偷走无辜者之心的阴影生物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's key-shaped blade works effectively as a weapon as well as being able to unlock any lock. Stories exist of POKENAME fighting against shadowy creatures that aim to steal the hearts of innocents.

entry: POKENAME用断刃尖端制成王冠形铠甲，抵御空中威胁。受惊时会倒下，将盾盖在脸上，装作一堆金属废料。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use the tips of broken blades to fashion crown-shaped armor to defend themselves from aerial threats. If they're startled, they will collapse and place their shields over their faces to pass as nothing more than metal scraps.

entry: 它能察觉心地真诚、具有王者素质的对象，在对方勇敢之际伸出援手。每颗头都拥有剑术大师的本领。
author: silverscloudy
source: It can detect those who possess an earnest heart and the qualities of a king, aiding them in a moment of bravery. Each of its heads boasts the skills of a master swordsman.

entry: POKENAME以强大幽灵力量，使附近的人与宝可梦失去理性，攻击周围一切。它虽有3颗头，但所有行动都由正拿着最大刀刃的那颗控制。
author: soup1900
source: Using their potent spectral powers, POKENAME can cause people and Pokémon near it to go feral and start attacking everything around them. While POKENAME has 3 heads, the one currently holding the largest blade controls all their actions.

entry: POKENAME的防御经过优化，无论太空的冰冷真空，还是重返大气时的酷热，都能承受，几乎毫发无损。
author: char_latte3412
source: With its optimized defenses, POKENAME can endure both the cold vacuum of space and superheated atmospheric entry with hardly a scratch.

entry: 中世纪，人们常佩戴绘有POKENAME的徽章。采用这一纹章的王国，都以精锐军队和坚固防御自豪。
author: char_latte3412
source: A depiction of POKENAME was a common badge worn in medieval times. Kingdoms that bore it prided themselves on their superb armies and defenses.

entry: 古老传说称，星空之外的强大存在与坚盾剑怪融合，诞生了POKENAME。野外偶尔能见到它保护迷路的训练家。
author: justjackorwhatever
source: Ancient legends claim POKENAME came to be when a powerful being from beyond the stars merged with a Aegislash. Wild POKENAME can rarely be seen protecting lost trainers.

entry: 亡魂如浓雾般围绕POKENAME。传说它会替这些灵魂实现最后的心愿。
author: .flipside3
source: The souls of the departed flock around POKENAME like a heavy mist. It is said to grant the last wishes of these souls.

entry: POKENAME是骄傲的剑士，常独自锻炼。面具若破损或被摘下，就会立刻逃走。
author: theemeraldflygon
source: As a proud swordsman, POKENAME is often seen training alone. If its mask breaks or is removed, it will flee immediately.

entry: POKENAME虽擅使小刀，却更擅长另一种近身战。它主要鲁莽冲锋，用坚实钢盔头撞敌人。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME is skilled with its small blade, it excels far more in a different sort of close combat. Its main way of damaging foes is to recklessly charge and headbutt them with its solid steel helm.

entry: POKENAME身体的两部分都极其坚实，正面受击时能抵挡一切。它会挥动旋转的齿轮尖齿攻击，但侧面挨招会伤得更重。
author: .realthree
source: The two parts of POKENAME's body are so sturdy that they can defend against anything if hit head-on. POKENAME can attack by swinging the spinning teeth of the gears against foes, but getting struck by moves from the side hurts it more.

entry: 小火龙的勇气赢得坚盾剑怪认可。如今两者并肩作战，坚盾剑怪还能让它的尾火永不熄灭。
author: nellnast42
source: Charmander's courage deemed it worthy in Aegislash's eyes. The two fight now together, as Aegislash can keep its tail burning forever.

entry: POKENAME一边用剑敲盾，一边唱歌。听见歌声的对象，都会充满光明正大的战斗意志。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME will sing while banging its sword against its shield. Hearing this song fills whoever hears it with an honorable fighting spirit.

entry: 有人靠近，它就把脸藏在盾后。据说面对天生有领袖资质的人，会少些害羞。
author: .flipside3
source: It hides its face behind its shield if approached. It is rumored to be less shy around those with innate leadership qualities.

entry: POKENAME是勇敢的小战士，但战况不利时容易害怕逃跑。它不断苦练，努力克服这项性格弱点。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a valiant little warrior but is prone to getting scared and fleeing when a fight begins turning disadvantageous. It trains tirelessly in order to overcome this personality flaw.

entry: POKENAME极其强大，会从环境吸取电能，注入钢刃，再将力量释放到碰到的宝可梦身上，将对方电得焦黑。
author: jerryandpixie_10897
source: POKENAME is an extremely powerful Pokémon. It charges its steel blade with electrical energy that it absorbs from its environment, and then releases the power into any Pokémon it touches, completely frying them.

entry: 古代竞技场中，POKENAME曾与不被看好的战士并肩作战。如今，它们受本能驱使，寻找强敌交战。
author: mepp.
source: In ancient arenas, POKENAME fought alongside underdog warriors. In the present, these Pokémon are driven to seek battle with strong opponents.

entry: POKENAME遍身珠宝，生活奢华，囤积从其他宝可梦与训练家处掠来的财物。POKENAME会拼命守住这些战利品。
author: j1miin
source: POKENAME lives in luxury, covered in riches. It will hoard its loot from other Pokémon and Trainers. POKENAME will defend the loot with its life.

entry: POKENAME个子小，乍看似乎没什么威胁。但它力量足以挥使巨剑，剑术也格外高超。即将放出强力攻击时，身体似乎会发光。
author: fireblade141
source: Initially, it may not seem much of a threat due to its small size. However, POKENAME possesses strength enough to wield a massive sword and has exceptional skill in the art. Its body appears to glow whenever it's about to unleash a powerful attack.

entry: POKENAME将身体分泌的毒涂在头刃上攻击，灵活的脖子让横扫范围广、力量大。谁能与它交好，就会得到忠诚而奋力守护的伙伴。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME attacks with the blade on its head, which it coats with the poison its body secretes; its flexible neck gives its sweeping strikes a lot of range and power. It becomes a fiercely protective and loyal companion to anyone who can befriend it.

entry: POKENAME身躯虽厚重，挥动刀刃状尾巴却精准而致命。它用双颚作磨刀石，同时磨利牙齿与刀刃。
author: chibitales
source: Despite their bulk, POKENAME can swing their bladed tails with deadly force and precision. They use their jaws as a whetstone, keeping both their teeth and blades sharp.

entry: 战斗时，它用巨剑劈斩，以飘动的布迷惑对手。若丢了剑，就改用强颚攻击。
author: cait_sith
source: In combat, it uses its massive sword to cleave and its flowing cloth to disorient. If it loses its sword, it will attack with its powerful jaws instead.

entry: 许多人因POKENAME身体和装备破旧而小看它。但它战斗时力量与战术本领都出人意料，绝不该低估。
author: sk372
source: Many look down on POKENAME for the shabby appearance of its body and equipment. It should not be underestimated, however, as in combat it shows surprising amounts of strength and tactical prowess.

entry: POKENAME虽由垃圾构成，战斗也用卑鄙手段，却以装备美观为傲。它常清洁、擦亮武器、铠甲与盾，尽可能保持完好如新。
author: sk372
source: Despite being comprised of refuse and adhering to dirty tactics in combat, POKENAME prides itself in the beauty of its equipment. It keeps its weapon, armor and shield as pristine as possible, cleaning and shining them often.

entry: 有些POKENAME痴迷战斗，为了胜利，全然抛弃荣誉。缺乏照料、又脏又破的武器，也反映出这种不择手段的战斗观。
author: sk372
source: Some POKENAME become obsessed with battling, disregarding any semblance of honor in pursuit of victory. This dirtier outlook on fighting is reflected in their weaponry, dirty and worn out from lack of care.

entry: POKENAME用强韧身体保护弱小海底生灵，替它们挡伤。对捕食弱者的敌人毫不留情，以刀刃般锋利的牙与鳍迅速攻击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME protects weaker undersea creatures with its resilient body, shielding them from harm. It is merciless against foes that prey on the weak, attacking swiftly with teeth and fins as sharp as blades.

entry: POKENAME能从很远处察觉王族，借此猎杀它认为不配统治的对象。
author: norskdaedalus
source: POKENAME has the ability to detect royalty from a long distance. It uses this ability to hunt those it deems unworthy to rule.

entry: POKENAME为守护栖居草原而击退入侵者。身体和武器虽小，攻击的力量与热忱却令人惊讶。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fights off intruders for the sake of keeping the grasslands it inhabits safe. Despite the tiny size of its body and weaponry, it strikes with a surprising amount of strength and fervor.

entry: POKENAME能感知真正的领袖，对以真心投入赢得认可的对象，会长久担任忠诚的守护者。
author: anarchaz
source: POKENAME has the power to sense true leaders and will be loyal guardians of those anointed by their true commitment for ages.

entry: POKENAME的身体近乎牢不可破，大多靠纯粹消耗取胜。它任对手攻击金属身躯、白费时间力气，等其疲惫再还击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's near-impenetrable body allows it to win most of its battles through sheer attrition. It lets its opponents waste time and energy glancing off of its metal form before striking back once they are exhausted.

entry: POKENAME由古老铠甲与布料组成。只有用对招式，背上的剑才会出鞘。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME is made up of ancient armor and cloth. The sword on its back will only be unsheathed when the right move is used.

entry: POKENAME是披甲持械的战士宝可梦，装备常取自栖居的古代遗迹。据说这些铠甲与武器受了诅咒，但它们没有受到影响的迹象。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are warrior Pokémon clad in armor and wielding weapons often found in the ancient ruins they call home. Supposedly, the armor and weapons they wield are cursed, yet POKENAME show no signs of being afflicted.

entry: 沙漠地区历代贵族都曾以水为报酬，雇POKENAME保护。只要水分充足，它的钢刃就能切开几乎任何东西。
author: h0bojoe
source: Using water as payment, generations of nobility in desert regions would employ POKENAME for protection. As long as it stays hydrated, its steel blade can cleave almost anything.

entry: 沙漠地区历代贵族都曾以水为报酬，雇POKENAME保护。为了补水，它什么都喝，甚至包括无辜训练家的生命力。
author: h0bojoe
source: Using water as payment, generations of nobility in desert regions would employ POKENAME for protection. It will drink anything to stay hydrated, even the life force of innocent Trainers.

entry: POKENAME披着厚甲，只有遇到值得一战的对手才抽出镰刀。刀刃锋利得能劈开巨石，往往只需一挥就能结束战斗。
author: .jerden
source: Clad in thick armor, POKENAME only draw their scythe when they find a worthy foe. The blade is sharp enough to cleave through boulders, and a single swing is often sufficient to end a fight.

entry: POKENAME披着厚甲，只有遇到值得一战的对手才抽出镰刀。刀刃锋利得能劈开巨石，往往只需一挥就能结束战斗。
author: .jerden
source: Clad in thick armor, POKENAME only draw their scythe when they find a worthy foe. The blade is sharp enough to cleave through boulders, and a single swing is often sufficient to end a fight.

entry: POKENAME有坚硬金属壳护身，没什么藏躲的必要。吸取树木生命力时，通常只需附在露出的树根上，不过仍会小心避开阳光直射。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is protected by a hard metallic shell, giving it little reason to hide. When it feeds on the life force of trees, it usually just clings to an exposed root, although it will be careful to avoid direct sunlight.

entry: POKENAME爱慕虚荣，尽力让铠甲光亮。照顾它费很多工夫，但能做到的训练家，会与它结下极深感情，让努力十分值得。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME are vain and try to keep their armor as shiny as possible. Taking care of them is a lot of work, but POKENAME will form incredibly deep bonds with Trainers who can manage it, making the effort well worth it.

entry: POKENAME极其忠于尊重、爱护自己的对象，甚至会不惜一切保护对方。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME are very loyal to those that show them respect and love, going as far as to protect them at all costs.

entry: POKENAME曾是骑士贵族的常见伙伴。它极善用剑，而剑往往由主人赐予。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME was once a common partner for knightly nobility. It is extremely adept with a blade, which it often receives from its masters.

entry: 据说，野生POKENAME会像训练家对战一样，向其他野生宝可梦发起挑战。还有传闻称，剑中封着所有败于它手下的灵魂。
author: jokerswild
source: Wild POKENAME reportedly challenge other wild Pokémon like a Trainer Battle. An urban legend says its sword houses the souls of those it has bested.

entry: POKENAME每次挥舞武器，都能听到空灵旋律。它优雅挥剑，决心让每场战斗都成为美丽交响曲。
author: sk372
source: With every swing of POKENAME's weapon, one can hear an ethereal melody playing. POKENAME wields its sword with grace, intent on making every battle a beautiful symphony.

entry: POKENAME身上的金属甲与硬木让它十分耐打。但若背剑自行拔出去攻击，身体就会失去意识，面对任何攻击都极其脆弱。
author: .jerden
source: The metallic armor and hardwood covering POKENAME's body make it highly resistant to damage. However, if the sword in its back pulls itself out to strike at foes, POKENAME's body will fall unconscious and become incredibly vulnerable to any attack.

entry: POKENAME是坚盾剑怪用幽灵力量彻底占据具甲武者的结果。金甲牢不可破，强力劈斩也鲜有对象能承受。
author: the_llamas
source: POKENAME is the result of an Aegislash completely overtaking a Golisopod with its spectral powers. POKENAME's golden armor is impenetrable, and few can withstand it's mighty cleave.

entry: POKENAME不主动寻衅，但一旦交战，就会显露强敌本色。它品格高尚，常帮助有需要的人与宝可梦。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME does not actively seek conflict, but when it finds itself in combat its nature as a formidable opponent is revealed. POKENAME is quite noble, often coming to the aid of people and Pokémon in need.

entry: POKENAME用幽灵力量，将能量束塑成能量剑，切开敌人。研究确定刀刃能与金矿分离，但尚无人成功做到。
author: soup1900
source: Using its spectral powers, POKENAME can manipulate its energy beams into energy swords to slice through enemies. Research has determined that its blade can be separated from the gold ore, though no one has managed to do so yet.

entry: 经常能见到POKENAME进行无声仪式，以威严剑势操纵能量。能量扭曲空气，让附近的对象产生视觉幻觉。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME are often seen conducting silent rituals, manipulating energy through intimidating sword stances. The energy they manipulate distorts the air, inducing visual hallucinations in those nearby.

entry: POKENAME受攻击时，会猛地合拢金属翅膀，护住身体。撑过攻击后，就以腹部朝前飞向袭击者，试图刺中对方。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME snap their wings closed over their body when they find themselves under attack, relying on the metallic wings to protect them from harm. Once they've weathered the blows, they fly abdomen-first at their aggressor, aiming to stab at them.

entry: POKENAME很受角色扮演爱好者喜爱，带着孩子般的骑士情怀与好奇。野生个体常带领朋友在荒野进行想象中的冒险。
author: turron_turron
source: A favorite among role-players, POKENAME exudes a childlike sense of chivalry and wonder. Wild POKENAME can often be found leading their friends on make-believe adventures across the wilderness.

entry: 谁靠得太近，POKENAME就先以坚盾自卫，再迅速使出踢倒反击。它习惯先打量对手，再攻击弱点。
author: .izik
source: When someone gets too close, POKENAME defends itself with its sturdy shield before countering with a swift Low Kick. It has a habit of sizing up opponents before striking their weak points.

entry: POKENAME自认是将要继承王国的王子。勇武故事渐渐传开，也聚起了一小群追随者。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME views itself as the prince of a kingdom it will soon inherit. Tales of its bravery have spread, and it has amassed a small following.

entry: POKENAME能用缎带裹住敌人，将其封进凭空造出的巨大紫色宝石。过去，人们相信遇见它就注定获得巨大财富与权力。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can wrap its ribbons around foes to encase them in a large purple gemstone created from thin air. In times past, it was believed that those who encountered one were destined to gain immense fortune and power.

entry: POKENAME身上长着充满幽灵力量的宝石。传说佩戴这些宝石首饰的王族，会永受诅咒，沦为它的傀儡。
author: soup1900
source: On POKENAME's body grow gems that are filled with its spectral powers. According to legend, royalty who wore jewelry made with these gemstones became eternally cursed as a puppet to POKENAME.

entry: 这种宝可梦凶险、领地意识强，会不择手段保卫领土。POKENAME以下半身作武器，剑术极高，但只在家园受威胁时才展现。
author: bringmeadream_
source: A menacing, territorial Pokémon that will protect its domain by any means. Using its lower half as a weapon, POKENAME is exceptionally skilled in swordplay, but displays this only when its home is threatened.

entry: POKENAME像熟练骑士般挥动长刃似的喙，吓走礁区天敌。若打得太重，自己反而会受惊，试图逃跑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swings its long, blade-like beak like an accomplished knight to scare away predators in its reef. If it strikes a foe too hard, it startles itself and attempts to flee.

entry: 这对刀刃不停铲土钻地，身边常有一面盾。那面盾，恰好就是它们的首领。
author: neonriser
source: A pair of blades that constantly shovel themselves to the ground. They are often accompanied by a shield, who happens to be their leader.

entry: POKENAME努力记住复杂剑术，却经常过一两天就忘光。但它仍不放弃，继续提升战斗本领。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME do their best to remember complicated swordsmanship, but often forget what they learn after a day or two. This does not stop them from trying to improve their combat prowess.

entry: 攻击打中POKENAME的盾，会让它头痛加剧。头越痛，挥剑就越凶猛狂乱。
author: sk372
source: Strikes against POKENAME's shield cause its headache to grow worse. The more its head hurts, the more aggressive and wild its sword-swinging becomes.

entry: POKENAME带蹼的脚让它绝不会失去平衡。它总会抽空提高战斗本领。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have webbed feet that ensure they never end up off balance. They always find time to improve their battle prowess.

entry: POKENAME极其忠于训练家，甚至甘愿身陷险境保护。过去守卫王国时，它们曾与泥偶巨人并肩作战。有种说法认为，它们是战死的风速狗灵魂。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are extremely loyal to their trainers, even putting themselves in harm's way to protect them. These Pokémon were once used alongside Golurk when defending kingdoms. There is a theory that POKENAME are the souls of Arcanine who died battle.

entry: 可怕的幽灵烈焰，加上精湛的剑盾技艺，让POKENAME仿佛注定会成为强大、却也可能专横的君王。
author: nellnast42
source: With its terrifying spectral flames and mastery of sword and shield, POKENAME appears destined rule as a mighty, yet perhaps despotic, king.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃虽像大勺，战力却不可小觑。高智力让它制定完美战术，不受一点伤就能取胜。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME's blade resembles a large spoon, one should not underestimate its combat strength. Its high intellect lets it formulate perfect battle strategies, earning it victories without taking a scratch.

entry: 据说POKENAME赢得足够多胜利后，会消失前往遥远土地，归来时带着金色勺刃。新的镀金武器象征无与伦比的战斗技巧。
author: sk372
source: It's said that POKENAME who win enough victories disappear to a far-off land and return with a golden spoon-blade. The new gilded weapon serves as a symbol of their unparalleled skill in battle.

entry: POKENAME被视为战斗大师，能在山顶见它训练。资深训练家常攀上山巅寻找，希望检验自己的本领。
author: wiz0z
source: Considered masters of battle, POKENAME can be found training atop mountains. Senior Trainers often scale the summits in search of POKENAME, hoping to test their skills.

entry: 它远行各地寻找最强兵刃。传说曾有一只POKENAME，手中之剑连次元也能斩开。
author: rakanadyo
source: This Pokémon wanders far and wide in search of the strongest blades. There are legends of an POKENAME whose sword could cut through dimensions.

entry: 剑比身体还大，让POKENAME挥剑时动作宽阔沉重。进攻或许不足，但一缩进壳，防御便几乎无懈可击。
author: sk372
source: The sword being larger than it means POKENAME's swings are broad and heavy. Its offense may lack, but if it retreats into its shell, its defenses become almost impregnable.

entry: POKENAME漫游古代遗迹，寻找命定英雄。战斗陷入困境时，会从嘴中弹出刀尖。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME roams ancient ruins, seeking a hero of destiny. If in a tough spot in battle, it will eject the tip of a blade from its mouth.

entry: 若从POKENAME背上拔出剑，它就会睡着，直到剑被插回。若拔得太久，它会重新长出一把。
author: bandedbodypress
source: If you manage to remove the sword from POKENAME's back, it will fall asleep until you reinsert it. If the sword is removed for too long, POKENAME will grow a new sword.

entry: POKENAME熟练挥剑，保护栖居水域中的宝可梦。背壳其实是一面钢盾，能拨开来袭的打击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME wields its sword with great skill to defend the Pokémon living in the bodies of water it inhabits. The shell on its back is actually a steel shield capable of deflecting incoming blows.

entry: POKENAME用利剑般的牙齿啃穿地壳。遇到强敌时，它会将整个身体当作长鞭挥动，招架对方的攻击。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME chew through the crust of the earth with teeth as sharp as swords. They can parry the attacks of powerful enemies by swinging its entire body like a large whip.

entry: 它体型虽庞大，却不用炮，而施展灵巧剑术。拼命保护麾下的杰尼龟与卡咪龟，连来犯水箭龟也能击退。
author: pokepower
source: Despite its bulk, it uses deft swordplay instead of cannons. It fiercely defends the Squirtle and Wartortle it leads, repelling even rival Blastoise.

entry: POKENAME用带刺藤蔓翻开土壤，种下成排种子。入侵者若威胁花园，就会立刻挥藤，伸向广阔范围，保护球茎与田地。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use their thorny vines to tear through soil to plant rows of seeds. If an intruder threatens their gardens, they will quickly lash out with their vines, extending the vines in a wide range to protect their bulbs and the field.

entry: POKENAME舌上浓稠的红色唾液，毒量足以击昏吼鲸王。强毒兼作武器与防御手段，让它能轻松制服更大的敌人。
author: .izik
source: The thick red saliva on POKENAME's tongue has enough poison to knock out a Wailord. Its potent toxin serves as both a weapon and a defense mechanism, allowing it to subdue larger foes with ease.

entry: POKENAME可怕的外貌是颇为有效的第一道防线。有人会小心收集，将它放在家门外吓退害兽，作为交换，提供安全的进化场所。
author: afilthycasual
source: POKENAME's intimidating visage is a fairly effective first line of defense. Some people will carefully collect them and place them outside their homes to scare off pests. In exchange, they are provided a safe place to evolve.

entry: POKENAME领地意识强，冲锋如货运列车，撞碎沿途障碍。人们在采石场用它击碎巨石，但性情固执，让它不太可靠。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is territorial, charging with the force of a freight train and smashing obstacles in its path. It is used in quarries to shatter boulders, but its stubborn nature makes it unreliable.

entry: POKENAME的钻角覆着腐蚀性毒液，便于钻入坚硬岩石，寻找大岩蛇等穴居猎物。开战时先旋转角，将毒液甩向敌人，再以毁灭性力量冲撞。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's drill-horn is coated in a corrosive venom, which aids it in drilling into solid rock in search of burrowing prey like Onix. It begins combat by rotating the horn to spray the venom on foes before charging them with devastating force.

entry: POKENAME向对手扔臭蛋。蛋用完了，就用毒角刺击，使敌人痛苦痉挛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME toss rotten eggs at their rivals. When they run out of eggs, they spear foes with their venomous horn, causing painful spasms.

entry: POKENAME产生的毒对袋中孩子无效，因此幼崽即使不慎被尖刺扎到，也不会受毒液伤害。
author: .izik
source: The poison POKENAME produces has no effect on the child in its pouch. This ensures the young remain unaffected and safe from venom if accidentally pricked by one of its spikes.

entry: POKENAME刀刃上的透明毒液进入血液，会引发多种症状。即使只划破一点，也须用水彻底清洗伤口，防止严重反应。
author: .izik
source: The clear poison coating POKENAME's blades results in a variety of symptoms when entering the bloodstream. Should even a tiny nick occur, it's important to wash the cut thoroughly with water to prevent severe reactions.

entry: POKENAME的毒虽足以击昏大多数天敌，却仍被视为蜂巢的最后防线。大多数成员平时会扩建巢穴，或在受袭后重建。
author: afilthycasual
source: While their venom is strong enough to knock out most predators, POKENAME are still considered a last line of defense for their hive. Most will instead be put to work expanding the structure or rebuilding after an attack.

entry: POKENAME暴走时四处喷毒，将葱郁自然变成死寂荒地。它喜欢在山中大肆破坏岩石，寻找月之石。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME spews toxic venom everywhere it rampages, turning lush, green nature into dead, barren lands. It likes to rampage at mountains to destroy all rocks in search of Moon Stones.

entry: POKENAME身上黏液的毒性强弱，会变得与最近接触的有毒物质相同。奇怪的是，若一生从未碰过有毒的东西，黏液就一直无毒。
author: .izik
source: The slime covering POKENAME's body takes the potency of the last poisonous thing it touched. Oddly enough, if it never touches anything poisonous in its entire life, the slime stays non-toxic.

entry: 角会分泌危险的神经毒，麻痹神经系统，最好谨慎靠近。POKENAME通常害羞独居，但感到威胁时，也会毫不犹豫地攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its horn secretes a very dangerous neurotoxin that numbs the nervous system, so it is best to approach it with caution. Although POKENAME is usually a shy and solitary creature, it will not hesitate to attack if it feels threatened.

entry: POKENAME受刺激时，精神力会失控，可能无意间从细胞层面损伤其他生灵。训练家应教它不适时隐形逃走，而非发动攻击。
author: imaginita
source: When agitated, POKENAME's psychic power runs wild, and it can unwittingly damage other creatures at a cellular level. Trainers should teach their POKENAME to turn invisible and flee when uncomfortable, rather than lash out.

entry: POKENAME极其好斗，很容易生气，不高兴就咬训练家。它也容易受惊，听见巨响便会张口乱咬。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are hyperaggressive Pokémon that are quick to anger and bite their Trainers when upset. They are also easy to startle and are known to snap at loud sounds.

entry: POKENAME会停在电线上，耐心等人撒下面包屑。好斗性格让它能挤过其他波波，第一个抢到。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found sitting atop powerlines where they patiently wait for people to spread breadcrumbs before them. Their aggressive nature allows them to push past other Pidgey to reach the breadcrumbs first.

entry: POKENAME趁其他宝可梦外出时潜伏在洞里。原主一回来，就用毒角迅速赶走对方，之后占洞居住。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It lurks in the dens of other Pokémon while they are out. When they return, POKENAME will quickly dispatch them with its venomous horn. POKENAME will live in their den once they have been repelled.

entry: 夜间，POKENAME角中毒液的致命性会增至五倍。它用增强的毒猎捕尾立等猎物，在黑暗时段以更强杀伤力压倒目标。
author: .izik
source: At night, the poison in POKENAME's horn becomes five times more deadly. It uses this enhanced venom to hunt for prey like Sentret, overpowering its quarry with increased lethality during the dark hours.

entry: POKENAME羽毛覆着一层薄薄毒油。它用百里香、鼠尾草等新鲜香草筑巢，气味能让幼崽平静。
author: .izik
source: The feathers on POKENAME's body are coated in a thin toxic oil. It builds its nest with fresh herbs like thyme and sage, as the scent calms its young.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，潜伏不动，一发现入侵者就立即攻击。它将四肢上的球体擦过角，抹上毒，让打击更致命。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is highly territorial, hiding motionless until it spies an intruder and immediately attacks. It wipes the orbs on its limbs against its horn, smearing poison across them to make its hits more deadly.

entry: POKENAME头上的王者之证让它自觉高人一等。它很懒，会命令河岸其他宝可梦做杂活。许多对象不理，但头脑简单的很容易被操纵。
author: chinigan
source: The King's Rock atop POKENAME's head gives them a superiority complex. They're lazy, commanding other Pokémon on the riverbank to do menial tasks. Many ignore these orders, but simple-minded Pokémon are easy to manipulate.

entry: POKENAME从空中飞过时，花朵会散出令人窒息的毒花粉云。野生个体战斗时用这招很有效，但若被击落，除了喷出微弱花粉，就几乎无法自卫。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME spreads a smothering cloud of toxic pollen from its flower as it flies overhead. A wild POKENAME uses this strategy in battle to great effect, however if brought down, has few ways to defend itself other than spraying weak bursts of pollen.

entry: POKENAME用角在垃圾箱附近挖浅洞，傍晚出外收集丢弃食物。嗅觉极佳，即使黑暗中也很容易找到食物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its horn to make shallow burrows near dumpsters, venturing out to gather discarded food in the evening. Its sense of smell is exceptional, allowing it to find food easily, even in the dark.

entry: POKENAME高速飞行，再刺向向日种子等猎物。注入的强毒会使人类出现哮喘般症状，是靠近时很危险的生灵。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies at high speeds before jabbing at prey like Sunkern. It injects a potent toxin that causes asthmatic symptoms in humans, making it a dangerous creature to approach.

entry: 朋友遇险时，POKENAME会放出一团扭动的荆棘。每根刺都注入腐蚀性毒，削弱壳与鳞片，希望能帮朋友挣脱，逃离危险。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME unleash a writhing mass of brambles whenever their friends are in danger. Each thorn injects a caustic toxin that weakens shells and scales so that POKENAME can hopefully help their friends wiggle loose and escape danger.

entry: POKENAME从垃圾箱收集柔软材料铺窝。若过程受扰，就会用坚硬毒角戳刺，保护家园免受入侵。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gathers soft materials from dumpsters to line its den. If disturbed during the process, it will jab with its hardened horn, using its venomous attack to protect its home from intruders.

entry: POKENAME群会与其他鸟宝可梦群结仇。一阵响亮齐鸣通常宣告领地混战开始，争夺觅食区的主导权。
author: .izik
source: Flocks of POKENAME create rivalries with other flocks of bird Pokémon. A loud, unified squawk usually marks the start of a territorial brawl, where they fight for dominance over feeding areas.

entry: POKENAME领地意识强又好斗，几乎不需理由，就会用钳上角刺穿、毒倒其他生灵。唯一例外是尼多一族，它会先快速敲钳警告。
author: sk372
source: Territorial and aggressive, POKENAME needs little justification to puncture and poison others via the horns on its claws. The only exception to this is the Nidoran species, who receive a warning via rapid clicking of its claws first.

entry: POKENAME的角由类似钻石的矿物构成，也像钻石一样，虽能切开多数材料，却十分脆。它会利用这点，折断角，释放里面的毒。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME's horn forms into a mineral similar to diamond. Like diamonds, the horn is sharp enough to cut through most materials but very brittle. POKENAME uses this to its advantage, breaking the horn to unleash the poison inside.

entry: POKENAME角与壳的甲片，有些部位极坚硬，有些却很脆。这样受撞击时，体内毒液能喷涌而出，又不降低防御。
author: imaginita
source: The plates that make up POKENAME's horn and shell are extremely tough in some spots and very brittle in others.  This allows the venom inside its body to gush out upon impact, without lowering POKENAME's defense.

entry: POKENAME常与其他飞行属性宝可梦敌对。哪怕对方还没准备交战，它也会啄击，注入强力麻痹毒液，抢占空战优势。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME finds rivalries with other Flying-type Pokémon. It will peck at them even when they are not prepared to fight, injecting them with a powerful, numbing venom so it has the upper hand in aerial combat.

entry: POKENAME生性好斗，领地意识极强。但若向体型比自己大的对手挑衅，往往落不到好下场。
author: dusknoir64
source: POKENAME are aggressive by nature and incredibly territorial. However, their attempts at fighting anything larger than themselves tend to end poorly.

entry: POKENAME喷火本身就很有威力，但真正危险的是产生的浓烟。烟极毒，人吸入几秒就会失去行动能力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's fire-breathing capability is a potent offense on its own, but the true danger lies in the smoke it creates, as it is incredibly toxic and will incapacitate a person within seconds of inhalation.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的耳朵十分灵敏，睡觉也能听见天敌靠近。它会迅速蜿蜒逃走，凭敏锐听觉抢先避开危险。
author: .izik
source: The ear on POKENAME's tail is very sensitive, allowing it to hear predators as they approach, even if it is sleeping. It slithers away very quickly, using its acute hearing to stay one step ahead of danger.

entry: POKENAME发出洪亮的象鸣，吓退太靠近巢穴的其他宝可梦。巨响若无法劝退入侵者，就会以一声强力吼叫，召来同巢成员。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release a sonorous trumpeting to scare away other Pokémon that approach too close to their nest. If the loud noise fails to dissuade the intruder, then they summon the rest of their nest with a mighty roar.

entry: POKENAME用心灵感应搜寻周围威胁时，角会发光。察觉敌意，就会藏进灌木，凭敏锐感官避开潜在危险。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's horn glows as it uses telepathy to search the surrounding area for threats. If it senses any aggression, it will hide in the brush, using its keen senses to avoid potential danger.

entry: POKENAME释放烟雾般扩散的浓密花粉，吓退天敌，掩盖动作。趁敌人混乱，就靠近虚弱的目标，注入毒液。
author: kafoxnothylol_47795
source: POKENAME releases thick pollen that spreads like smoke. The cloud scares predators and hides its movement. While enemies are confused, POKENAME moves in and injects venom into the weakened Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME毒液中的神经毒，几分钟就能麻痹神经系统。盘绕的身体覆着钻石般坚硬的尖刺，每根都带有强毒。
author: fiordaliso
source: The neurotoxins contained in POKENAME's venom can paralyze the nervous system in just a few minutes. Its coils are covered in spines as hard as diamond, each one laced with potent toxins.

entry: POKENAME岩石皮肤渗出的毒含有麻痹成分。混入其他草药，就能制成缓解轻微疼痛的药膏，熟悉采集方法的人十分珍视这款天然药物。
author: .izik
source: The poison leaking from POKENAME's rocky skin contains a numbing agent. When mixed with other herbs, it becomes a salve for minor aches and pains, making this natural remedy highly valued by those who know how to harvest it.

entry: POKENAME的领地包括洞穴和附近的觅食点。它用尖刺或电击，维持对觅食点的独占。
author: quackquackattack
source: The territory of a POKENAME encompasses their burrow and any foraging spots nearby. Their monopoly on foraging spots is enforced with a sharp stinger or a zap.

entry: 精力充沛时，它额头的角尖会泛出明亮黄光。POKENAME的毒液是制作解麻药的原料。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it is brimming with energy, the tip of the horn on its forehead shines with a bright yellow glow. POKENAME's venom is used as an ingredient in crafting Paralyze Heals.

entry: POKENAME挖隧道遇上硬石板时，会以角撞碎。有人观察到，它的隧道可深入地下100英尺以上。
author: .izik
source: Should POKENAME find a hard stone slab while tunneling, it will ram its horn to shatter it. Its tunnels have been observed reaching over 100 ft below the surface of the earth.

entry: 这种宝可梦的叶片会分泌剧毒油脂。它将毒油与惊人速度结合，压倒猎物。
author: bacondlx
source: Extremely toxic oils are secreted from this Pokémon's leaves. It uses this in combination with its incredible speed to overwhelm its prey.

entry: POKENAME外表不起眼，引诱敌人来攻。它将耳朵转向攻击者，缩起身体，露出强力毒角刺穿对手，再用爪抓挠天敌。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME appears unassuming to lure in foes to attack it. Shifting its ears towards the attacker, POKENAME tucks its body in and exposes its powerful, toxic horn to pierce the opponent. This Pokémon then scratches at the predator with its claws.

entry: 爪虽强壮，它却更爱用尖锐毒角冲撞。角中的毒也存在于尖刺里，几滴就能引起至少持续三天的剧痛。
author: infinex21
source: Although its claws are quite strong, it tends to ram foes with its sharp and venomous horn. The venom in its horn is also present in its quills, and just a few drops can cause immense pain that lasts for at least three days.

entry: POKENAME总想打架，几乎遇到什么宝可梦都会挑战。带爪四肢能劈、刺、踩踏，满身毒刺则让每次冲锋都很危险。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Always eager for a fight, POKENAME challenges nearly any Pokémon it encounters. Its taloned limbs are capable of slashing, piercing, and stomping, while the toxic spines covering its body make every charge a dangerous one.

entry: POKENAME耳刺渗出的毒，是全身最强的毒素。恶臭如同腐烂蔬菜与变质油脂，能有效逼退威胁。
author: .izik
source: The poison leaking from the spikes on POKENAME's ears is the most potent toxin its body produces. It has a rancid smell akin to rotting vegetables and oil, making it highly effective in warding off threats.

entry: POKENAME准备战斗时，体表一层薄毒液会变色。这个信号警告其他生灵，它的攻击性增强，已准备交战。
author: .izik
source: The thin layer of poisonous fluid covering POKENAME's body changes color when it is ready to fight. This visual cue warns others of its heightened aggression and readiness for combat.

entry: 有人见到尼多一族群中携带着POKENAME的楔石。群体一遇险，它就会现身，试图冲倒攻击者，使其中毒。
author: sk372
source: Some Nidoran colonies have been spotted carrying a POKENAME's keystone among their ranks. The moment the group is in danger, POKENAME manifests itself and tries to charge down and poison the attacker.

entry: POKENAME背上的花十分敏感，微风也能让它狂躁。它能用强大的荆棘藤蔓扯塌棚屋。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have sensitive flowers on their back that send them into a frenzy over the slightest breeze. They are capable of tearing sheds down with a mighty vine of brambles.

entry: POKENAME产生的毒有麻痹作用。许多外科医生会限量使用，减轻手术中患者的不适，帮助控制疼痛。
author: .izik
source: The poison POKENAME produces has a numbing effect. Many surgeons use this poison in limited quantities to make procedures more comfortable for the patient, aiding in pain management during operations.

entry: POKENAME从耳状附肢散发无形的特殊气体，气味几乎能让任何生灵陶醉，借此引来猎物。目标靠得够近，就猛扑过去，用毒牙咬住制服。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME exudes a special, invisible gas from its ear-like appendages to lure in prey; this gas smells intoxicating to almost any individual. When prey comes close enough, it lunges and bites into them with venomous fangs to subdue them.

entry: POKENAME懒得即使被野生宝可梦攻击也没反应，只让毒角替自己应付。矛盾的是，用尖刺中的毒素合成，却能制出提神补剂。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is so lazy that it doesn't even react if attacked by another wild Pokémon. It simply lets its poisonous horns do the work for it. Paradoxically, by synthesizing the toxins from its spines, one can create an invigorating tonic.

entry: 野生POKENAME对靠得太近的对象尤其凶。压力越大，尖刺上的毒就越强，使刺伤的危险不断增加。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME display a heightened aggression in the wild toward anyone that gets too close. The poison their spines are coated in becomes more virulent as their stress levels increase, making stings from them progressively more dangerous over time.

entry: 这种宝可梦的鬃毛由无数锐刺组成。据说POKENAME感到不久将有危险时，尖刺就会蓬起。
author: slimmagma
source: This Pokémon's mane is made of countless sharp spikes. It is said those spikes puff up when a POKENAME senses danger in the near future.

entry: POKENAME好斗，领地意识强，会以角刺击不受欢迎的入侵者。多数船只若不幸驶过领地，连船体也可能被它刺穿。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME exhibits strong aggressive and territorial tendencies, stabbing at unwanted intruders with its horn. It can even puncture the hulls of most ships unfortunate enough to sail through its domain.

entry: POKENAME耳刺渗出的毒，是全身最弱的毒素。气味却如蜂蜜和苹果般甜美，以这份迷惑性气息阻吓天敌。
author: .izik
source: The poison leaking from the spikes on POKENAME's ears is the least potent toxin its body produces. It has an incredibly sweet smell, like honey and apples, which serves as a misleading deterrent for predators.

entry: POKENAME不断为争夺地位而打斗，反复冲撞，直到一方认输。这种练习能强化身体铠甲，逐渐变得坚如钢铁。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will constantly fight each other for dominance, ramming into one another repeatedly until one gives up. This practice helps strengthen the armor on their bodies, gradually making them as hard as steel.

entry: 它们容易动怒，会用缎带缠住一切被视为威胁的东西，再以毒角猛刺。
author: melodydelune
source: Quick to anger, these Pokémon will latch onto anything it perceives as a threat with its ribbons and jab it with its poisonous horn.

entry: POKENAME是平时温和、战斗却狂野的杂食宝可梦，会猛甩厚重双耳、以坚角戳刺，扫腿打出带毒攻击。它会收集找到的各种东西，带回族群。
author: bobosmith01
source: An otherwise calm omnivorous Pokémon that fights wildly, POKENAME flails its hefty ears around, jabs with its sturdy horn, and leg sweeps with toxic blows. It collects whatever it can find and brings it back to its colony.

entry: POKENAME高速飞行，再用角撞树，向同族展示力量，彰显自己在群体中的优势。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME flies at high speeds before ramming its horn into trees. It does this as a show of strength to others of its kin, demonstrating its power and dominance within its group.

entry: POKENAME与一些谜拟丘融合体一起生活在托儿所，为孩子带来安慰与快乐。它活泼好动，喜欢和孩子们摔跤。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME live at daycares along with some Mimikyu fusions, providing comfort and joy to children. POKENAME are rambunctious and enjoy wrestling with other children.

entry: 应小心别让POKENAME附身电子设备。一旦入住，设备使用时耗电就会增加，之后每再附身一次，耗电速度都会呈指数增长。
author: sk372
source: Care should be taken to avoid POKENAME possessing one's electronics. Once it has inhabited one, the device will drain more power when in use, with the expenditure rate increasing exponentially every subsequent possession.

entry: POKENAME角中流出的热毒液，热得足以熔化石英。它借此熔开石头，在地下深处挖洞，筑成安全的家。
author: .izik
source: The hot venom that comes from POKENAME's horn is hot enough to melt quartz. It uses this ability to melt stone and create its burrow, digging deep into the ground to create a safe home.

entry: 它全身分泌绿色毒素，极易燃烧，羽毛摩擦就足以点燃。毒素燃烧迅速，着火后必须闷熄，因为浇水只会让火势蔓延。
author: infinex21
source: It secretes a green toxin across its entire body that is highly flammable. The friction of its feathers is enough to ignite this toxin. This toxin burns quickly but must be smothered when ignited, for water will only cause the flames to spread.

entry: POKENAME听力惊人，弥补了糟糕视力。听见天敌时，耳朵会向各处转动，即使看不清，也能迅速反应，躲开危险。
author: .izik
