source: POKENAME's hearing is amazing, making up for its terrible eyesight. Its ears flit about in every direction should it hear a predator, allowing it to react quickly and evade danger despite its poor vision.

entry: POKENAME的两颗头会合作击败敌人或获取食物，随后立刻互相打斗。敏锐嗅觉与感受空气振动的本领，弥补了看不见的缺陷。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's two heads will cooperate to defeat an opponent or secure food, but will immediately begin to fight with each other afterwards. Its acute sense of smell and ability to sense vibrations in the air make up for its lack of sight.

entry: POKENAME竖起所有尾巴，就表示即将攻击。提取角中分泌的毒，可以制成疗效很好的烫伤药膏。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME raises all its tails, it means it's about to launch an attack. By extracting the poison secreted from its horn, it's possible to create highly effective ointments for treating burns.

entry: POKENAME白天精力极旺，但只一滴毒就能使对手极度疲惫。这种反差让它难以预测，既能爆发活力，也能消耗敌人。
author: .izik
source: Despite being extremely energetic during the day, a single drop of POKENAME's poison can cause extreme fatigue. This paradox makes it an unpredictable adversary, balancing bursts of energy with the power to drain opponents.

entry: POKENAME雌雄合唱时分唱不同声部。雄性唱悠长的和声，雌性唱主旋律。雄性耳尖带有强毒。
author: bobosmith01
source: Male and female POKENAME sing separate sections when they sing. Male POKENAME sing long, supportive notes, while females carry the melody. The male POKENAME carries a potent poison at tips of their ears.

entry: POKENAME刺甲上的强毒会通过细小割伤和刺伤进入猎物体内。剂量大、浓度高时，如同强腐蚀性酸，能熔穿多数金属与合金。
author: pkbonusducks
source: The potent toxins laced over POKENAME's spiky armor spread to their prey through small cuts and punctures. In large, concentrated doses, the substance behaves as a highly corrosive acid that can melt through most metals and alloys.

entry: POKENAME在坡上走路常站不稳，通常会选择滚下斜坡。每颗牙和每根刺都和头角一样有毒，滚动的个体成了丘陵地区常见的危险。
author: alestrius
source: POKENAME often struggles to keep itself upright when walking on slopes and will usually choose to roll down inclines. Every tooth and spine are as poisonous as the horn on its head, making rolling POKENAME a common hazard in hilly areas.

entry: POKENAME身上的薄鳞有时会脱落，渗出黏稠的粉色毒液，曾被误认为血。每片鳞下都有小囊输送毒液，用来抵御天敌。
author: .izik
source: The thin scales covering POKENAME's body sometimes fall off, causing a viscous pink poison to seep out. Once thought to be blood, this poison is distributed by tiny sacs located just below each scale to deter predators.

entry: POKENAME雌雄合唱同一首歌的不同声部。雄性唱悠长的和声，雌性唱主旋律。雄性耳尖还带有强毒。
author: bobosmith01
source: Male and female POKENAME sing separate parts of a shared song. Males perform long, supportive notes, while females carry the melody. The male POKENAME also carries a potent poison at the tips of its ears.

entry: POKENAME随时准备狩猎，不断从尾巴产生毒液。分泌毒液的孔若被泥堵住或被水浸泡，形成的堵塞就会使它生病。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME constantly produce venom from their tails, as they are always ready to hunt. If the pores that produce venom get clogged up by mud or soaked in water, the resulting blockage makes them sick.

entry: POKENAME情绪多变却温柔，许多野生毒属性宝可梦喜欢依偎它取暖。听见音乐，耳朵就会随节拍上下动。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a moody but gentle Pokémon that many wild Poison-Types like the snuggle against for warmth. Whenever it hears music, its ears perk up and down along with the beat.

entry: POKENAME平时紧紧卷起耳朵，因为小声音也会被放成嘈杂巨响。战斗时则例外，会快速卷起、展开耳朵，远距离打击敌人。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME usually keep their ears tightly curled, as even small sounds are amplified into cacophonies. They make an exception when fighting, rapidly curling and uncurling them to strike foes from a distance.

entry: POKENAME布料般的身体覆有微小倒刺，会划伤接触者皮肤。倒刺带有令人难受的毒，它借此飘动身体，擦过敌人攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The fabric-like body of POKENAME is covered in microscopic barbs that scratch the skin of anyone who touches it. These barbs are coated in an unpleasant toxin, something POKENAME weaponise by wafting their bodies against their foes.

entry: POKENAME声音极大，靠吼叫与低鸣的回声在空中导航，弥补视力不足。领地意识很强时，会向对手发出格外响亮的吼声，让其迷失方向。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are incredibly loud and use the echoes of their roars and growls to navigate through the air despite their poor eyesight. They can get very territorial and will roar exceptionally loudly at their rivals to disorientate them.

entry: POKENAME把头骨留在某处后，就能通过它的眼睛看东西。有人相信，它甚至能随时瞬移到头骨那里。
author: crumple_2
source: If a POKENAME leaves the skull somewhere, it can see through its eyes. Some believe it can even teleport to that skull at any time.

entry: POKENAME附在更大的宝可梦身上，似乎双方都有好处。它一边被带着移动，一边积蓄静电，对方则受它背上毒刺保护。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME attach themselves to larger Pokémon, but this seems to benefit them both. POKENAME is carried around while it charges up static electricity, and the other Pokémon can be protected by the poisonous spines covering POKENAME's back.

entry: POKENAME爆炸时，会将毒倒刺四散射出，引起强烈灼痛。这种自卫方式会留下一片危险的锐利毒刺地带。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME explodes, it scatters poisonous barbs that can cause an intense burning sensation. This self-defense mechanism leaves behind a hazardous field of sharp, toxic spikes.

entry: POKENAME长牙渗出的毒能使人产生幻觉。它用毒迷惑敌人、扰乱方向，在战斗中取得战术优势。
author: .izik
source: The venom that seeps from POKENAME's tusks can cause hallucinations. This venom is used to confuse and disorient enemies, making it a strategic advantage in battles.

entry: POKENAME用钻石般坚硬的角保卫巢穴，尤其保护蛋。群体以多种啾鸣沟通，能很好地协调攻击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME defend their nests, especially their eggs, with their diamond-hard horns. Flocks of POKENAME communicate with myriad chirps and can coordinate their attacks rather well.

entry: 角与喙都能注入令人虚弱、却不致命的毒。注入处周围会长热疹，幸好如今已有许多治疗方法。
author: infinex21
source: Both their horns and their beaks inject a debilitating, yet non-lethal, venom into their targets. A heat rash will develop around the site of injection, for which there are thankfully many remedies these days.

entry: POKENAME视力虽差，却在白天狩猎。它发出强力声波能量，再聆听传回的声音。叫声一英里外都能听到。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are diurnal hunters despite their poor vision. They hunt by shouting out powerful bursts of sonic energy and listening for the return calls. The calls of POKENAME can be heard over a mile away.

entry: POKENAME吃茄科毒草等有毒植物，增强角中黏毒。哪怕只被扎一下，若不立刻服解毒药，也可能招来灭顶之灾。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME eats poisonous plants like nightshade to strengthen the sticky venom in its horn. Even a single prick from its horn can spell doom for someone who doesn't take an Antidote immediately after.

entry: POKENAME用细腿爬树，以角刺住苹果，再作为礼物带给同族，展现供养家人的本领。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME crawls up trees with its thin legs and uses its horn to pierce apples. It brings them back to its kin as gifts, showcasing its resourcefulness in providing for its family.

entry: 尖刺与角充满毒液，逼退天敌，保障生存。POKENAME吐出冰冷气息时，身上的水晶会微微发光。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its spines and horn are filled with venom, ensuring its survival by keeping predators at bay. When POKENAME exhales icy breath, the crystals on its body emit a faint glow.

entry: POKENAME极其固执，不打到昏倒绝不认输。感到危险时，颈圈上的石头就会开始渗毒。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME is incredibly stubborn, not giving up a fight until it faints. If it senses danger, the rocks on its collar start oozing with poison.

entry: POKENAME能从鬃毛发射尖端带毒的锐石。被击中的敌人会逐渐疲惫，直到无法战斗。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME can fire sharp, poison-tipped stones from their mane. Foes hit by these stones will, over time, grow weary until they are unable to battle.

entry: POKENAME是伏击猎手，先静伏不动，再伴着令人无法行动的粉末猛扑。蘑菇上的鳞片会自然脱落，仍残留少量孢子效力，胆大的年轻人会捡来打赌试吃。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is an ambush predator, lying motionless before pouncing under a shower of incapacitating powders. The scales on the mushroom, which retain minor Effect Spores, fall off naturally and are harvested by adventurous youths to be eaten in a dare.

entry: POKENAME藏在黑暗小巷，经常与同类争斗。毛摸起来其实柔软，却能变硬，化作数千根锋利毒刺。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hide in dark alleyways, often getting into scuffles with one another. Their fur is actually soft to the touch; however they are able to stiffen their fur into thousands of sharp, poisonous quills.

entry: POKENAME翅膀散落的深绿粉末剧毒，稍一闻就可能极度疲惫，让对手虚弱、方向感紊乱。
author: .izik
source: The dark green powder scattered from POKENAME's wings is highly toxic. Even a quick sniff can cause severe exhaustion, leaving its opponents weak and disoriented.

entry: POKENAME不断挥舞尾火，威吓其他宝可梦。虽然大多不怕这条尾巴，却仍有许多会离开，免得和它冲突。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME constantly brandish the flame on their tails to intimidate other Pokémon. Even though most Pokémon are not scared of their tail, many end up leaving to avoid conflict with POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME极其好斗，看见什么宝可梦都挑战，结合角、爪与尾巴击败对手。受刺激时，毒性还会增强。
author: darkweavile428
source: Incredibly aggressive, POKENAME will challenge any Pokémon it sees and uses a combination of its horn, claws and tail to defeat its opponents. The potency of POKENAME's poison increases when it's agitated.

entry: POKENAME翻过的花园土，神奇地只会杀死杂草。为何有用植物不受影响，植物学家至今无法解释。
author: .izik
source: Soil tilled by POKENAME mysteriously kills only weeds in gardens. How it spares useful plants remains unexplained by botanists.

entry: 雄性POKENAME在地下争夺地位与伴侣。漫长的地下冲突能撼动地面，引发小地震。
author: .izik
source: Male POKENAME compete underground for status and mates. Their prolonged subterranean clashes can shake the earth and trigger small earthquakes.

entry: POKENAME给偷来的零钱涂上透明毒液，夜里睡在钱堆上，守护财物，用毒防范窃贼。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME coats its trove of stolen change in a clear poison. It sleeps on the pile at night to ensure it stays safe, using the venom to protect its valuables from would-be thieves.

entry: POKENAME指望路上遇见的每个对象都像对待王族般待它。若没受到这种礼遇，就会暴起，以角戳刺、用爪抓挠，两处都带有毒。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME expects to be treated like royalty by anyone who crosses its path. If it does not receive said treatment, POKENAME will lash out by stabbing them with its horn and scratching them with its claws, both of which contain poison.

entry: POKENAME暴怒时，头角会变得更长、更锋利。它如同头顶细剑，凭高涨的攻击性，猛烈刺向所有威胁自己的对象。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME flies into a rage, the horn on its head grows longer and sharper. It wields this horn like a head-mounted rapier, using its heightened aggression to strike fiercely at anyone who threatens it.

entry: POKENAME的毒素会让不幸中毒的对象极度愤怒。临床医生对此产生兴趣，试图将稀释后的毒制成提升自信的药物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME toxins induce intense feelings of anger in those unfortunate enough to be afflicted with it. Clinicians have taken an interest in this toxin, attempting to use a dilute version of it as a confidence-boosting drug.

entry: POKENAME好斗，是因为身体并未完全免疫自身储存的毒。它会用角刺毒其他生灵，缓解体内令人疼痛的压力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's aggressive tendencies are due to its own body not being completely immune to its own internal poison reserves. It seeks to poison others with its horn to relieve some of the painful pressure it feels.

entry: 被POKENAME的角刺中后，会有轻微的灼痛感持续数日。它嬉闹起来十分莽撞，容易误伤人，因此很少有人将它当作宠物饲养。
author: frokachu
source: Those stung by POKENAME's horn will feel a mild burn for a few days. It isn't seen as a pet too often due to its aggressively playful nature, and risk of getting stung by mistake.

entry: POKENAME的角与尾巴都会冒火，因此时刻害怕被弄湿。谁带着液体靠近，这份恐惧就会化为攻击性。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are in constant fear of getting wet, as flames come out from both their horns and their tail. This fear leads to aggression whenever anyone approaches with a liquid substance.

entry: POKENAME从尾巴同时释放毒液与火焰，形成燃烧毒液的蓝火。被烧伤后，即使烫伤痊愈，皮疹仍会久久不退。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME release both venom and flames from their tails, resulting in a bluish flame that burns venom. Getting burned by these blue flames causes rashes to linger long after the burn has healed.

entry: 进化后，POKENAME身上的角变得更坚硬、更突出，毒素也变得致命。它只需振翅一下，就能滑向敌人，片刻内解决对方。
author: fiordaliso
source: The horns on POKENAME's body have grown far tougher and more pronounced, and its toxins have become lethal after evolution. With a single beat of its wings, it can glide toward its foe and finish them off within moments.

entry: POKENAME体表覆有一层可溶于水的毒黏液，会被洗入栖居的池塘。毒让其他宝可梦难以共用水域，也让它得以排斥竞争者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are coated in a thin layer of toxic mucus that is water-soluble, washing off into the ponds they live in. The toxins make it difficult for other Pokémon to share the water with them, allowing them to ward off rivals.

entry: POKENAME腹部可见深色螺旋状肠道，会产生毒素，经皮肤渗出，碰触十分危险。它会凶猛地巡逻池岸，试图让擅闯者中毒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Visible as a dark spiral in their stomach, the intestines of POKENAME produce a toxin that oozes out through their skin, making them dangerous to touch. They aggressively patrol the shore of their ponds, trying to inflict their poison on trespassers.

entry: POKENAME渴望连最强的毒都能免疫，会寻找其他毒属性宝可梦，看看能否挑战自己。它用勺调配各种毒液，亲自尝试。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME desires to be immune to even the strongest poisons and will seek out other Poison types to see if they can challenge it. It uses its spoon to mix up all types of poisonous concoctions for it to try.

entry: POKENAME大胆自信，爱炫耀肌肉。对战时，沉重拳击与毒角是它取胜的手段。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are bold and confident creatures that love to show off their muscles. During a Pokémon battle, their hefty punches and venomous horns give them the means to secure victory.

entry: 历史记载，有些国王与摄政者不用骑士，而用POKENAME保护自己。据说它铠甲硬过钢铁，力量足以像折树枝般折断阔剑，是完美的护卫。
author: wickedwiccan
source: History speaks of kings and regents who used POKENAME rather than knights as their protectors. POKENAME are said to have armor tougher than steel and enough strength to snap broadswords like twigs, making them the perfect bodyguards.

entry: POKENAME的壳上长满尖刺，覆着令人疼痛的毒。受威胁时会倒着冲向敌人，背壳既保护自己，也伤害对方。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The shells of POKENAME are covered in spines that are coated in a painful toxin. They will rush at their foes backward when threatened, using their shell to both protect themselves and harm others.

entry: POKENAME以富矿岩脉为食，用强壮双手从山壁扯下岩块。矿物中的有毒重金属经代谢、浓缩，变成尖刺里的毒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME feed on mineral-rich veins of rock, tearing out chunks from the mountainside with their powerful hands. The minerals they consume contain toxic heavy metals, which they metabolise and concentrate into a poison within their spines.

entry: POKENAME的食物富含二氧化硅，这是毒刺生长、形成的关键成分。训练家需备好沙或石英晶体，确保它摄取足够的这种矿物。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME diets are rich in silica, the mineral being a key component in the growth and formation of their toxic spines. Pokémon Trainers are advised to keep either sand or quartz crystals to hand so that they get enough of the mineral in their diet.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME用角猛撞敌人，注入毒液。毒会削弱受害者，妨碍行动，让它取得很大优势。
author: mepp.
source: In battle, POKENAME forcefully rams its horn into foes to inject venom. This debilitating toxin hinders the victim's mobility, giving POKENAME a great advantage.

entry: POKENAME用各颗头上的毒角攻击，驱逐洞穴附近的天敌。毒角造成剧痛，让袭击者在进一步受伤前赶忙退却。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME attacks with the toxic horns on its heads to deter predators from its den. These venomous horns cause intense pain, forcing attackers to retreat before they are harmed further.

entry: POKENAME在冰水中追猎，可一连持续数天，追上后就以可怕毒角刺击。它极力保护幼崽，害怕人类或其他天敌将孩子带走。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME hunts prey swimming in icy waters for days on end, striking them with its terrifying, poisonous horn once it catches up with them. It is extremely protective of its young, fearing humans or other predators may take them away.

entry: 头上的短角深深扎根在头骨中。谁想抓住角，POKENAME就会用能抓握的耳朵将其拍开。
author: mr.bonesii
source: The stubby horn on its head is rooted deep in its skull. If something tries to grab its horn, POKENAME slaps it off with its prehensile ears.

entry: POKENAME角中的毒能让人整整睡24小时。对方熟睡时，它监看梦境，吃掉快乐的梦，从他人的喜悦中汲取力量。
author: .izik
source: The venom in POKENAME's horn can cause someone to sleep for a full 24 hours. While they slumber, it monitors their dreams and eats any happy ones, drawing power from the joy of others.

entry: 训练家接触POKENAME须小心，身上的白刺覆有刺激性毒素。它用头角敲开坚硬树果。
author: mepp.
source: Trainers must be careful when handling POKENAME, as the white thorns on its body are coated with an irritating toxin. It uses the horn on its head to break open tough berries.

entry: 许多家庭花高价租POKENAME，将树篱修成造型。镰刀爪切得迅速精准，让每件作品都显得精致专业。
author: quackquackattack
source: Many families pay handsomely to rent POKENAME to trim hedges into topiaries. The swift and precise cuts made with their scythe claws ensure each work of art looks refined and professional.

entry: 经常能见到POKENAME大群聚集，保卫劈斩针蜂的领地。它们太弱，无法正面迎击入侵者，因而偏爱设伏。
author: goober145
source: POKENAME can be found in large groups, defending the territory of a Bidrill. Since they are too weak to confront intruders head-on, they prefer to set up ambushes.

entry: POKENAME偏爱吞吃电子游戏存档。每吃一次，刃口就明显变得更锋利。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers devouring video game save files. With each feeding, its blade edges grow noticeably sharper.

entry: 劈斩翼龙领着一群POKENAME飞过，本身就是警告。这些热衷捕猎的个体看似不起眼，锋利翅膀却极危险。它们总是结群狩猎，猎物往往比自己大得多。
author: thordemidgard
source: Led by Bidactyl, a group of POKENAME flying over an area is a warning on itself. These avid hunters may not look like much, but their sharp wings are extremely dangerous. Hunting always in packs, their prey are often quite bigger than themselves.

entry: 它常将尾刃擦过胸前刀刃，发出令人发寒的声音，似乎能保持锋利。头刃则定期脱落，每次都长得更强、更锐利。
author: infinex21
source: It often runs its tail blade along the blades on its chest area, which makes a chilling noise and seems to help keep the blades sharp. Its head blade, however, is regularly shed and grows back stronger and sharper each time.

entry: POKENAME天生是领袖，能轻易指挥任何群体。它与追随者建立精神联系，通过心灵感应，同时分享命令与战术。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a natural leader and can take command of any group with ease. It does this by establishing a mental link with its followers, sharing commands and tactics with them all at once through its telepathy.

entry: POKENAME颈边一圈金属刺终生不停生长。但长了容易折断，因此它会靠硬岩摩擦，将刺磨短。
author: mistymagius
source: The collar of metal spikes around POKENAME's neck constantly grows throughout its life. However, they tend to break off the longer they get, so POKENAME will rub against hard rocks to grind them down.

entry: POKENAME用头刃修剪枯枝，保持巢穴整洁。它喜欢在寂静、洒满月光的树林栖息。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME trims dead branches with the blade on its head to keep its nest tidy. It prefers silent, moonlit groves for roosting.

entry: POKENAME仰慕照顾者，想让对方刮目相看，却通常笨手笨脚，把刀刃卡在某处。外表虽天真，却会被好斗邪恶的监护者吸引，而可爱模样又让对方生出保护欲。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME admires its caretakers and hopes to impress them, but usually ends up clumsily getting its blade stuck in something. Despite its innocent appearance, it is drawn to aggressive and nefarious guardians, but its cuteness makes them protective.

entry: 据说有POKENAME支持，胜算会大增。几个聚在一起时，会齐挥刀臂，如同为战斗助威。
author: sk372
source: It is said that having a POKENAME as a supporter will greatly boost one's chances of victory. When several are gathered together, they wave their bladed arms in unison as a sort of battle cheer.

entry: 谁与POKENAME对上眼，它就会恶意回瞪。对方哪怕稍微一动，也可能让它跳起，穷追不舍地攻击。
author: beatdoof
source: If someone makes eye contact with POKENAME, it will gaze back with malicious intent. Even a slight movement can trigger it to hop and chase relentlessly in an attempt to attack.

entry: 咩利羊玩闹般的顶撞，到了POKENAME这里，却成了可怕的追逐。互动动物园曾有人恶意进行融合，导致游客就医。
author: musicsheep.
source: The playful ramming of a Mareep becomes a terrifying chase when POKENAME tries to ram into others. There are records of hospital visits following malicious fusing at petting zoos.

entry: 不建议抚摸POKENAME的羊毛。其中藏着许多锐刃，会割刺碰到的任何东西。
author: musicsheep.
source: Petting POKENAME's wool is not recommended. The wool contains many sharp blades that cut and stab anything that touch it.

entry: POKENAME训练时，会像认真交战一样，用尾巴互击，灵活闪避，立刻转身接上下一次攻击。它只对真正的威胁动刀，不愿伤害无辜。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME train by swinging their tails at each other as if they were in a serious battle, nimbly dodging and immediately pivoting into their next attack. They only use their blades against serious threats, refusing to harm the innocent.

entry: POKENAME的鳃边缘锋利如剃刀，动作快得看不清，能刺入毫无戒心的猎物。鳃比周围更冷，使猎物休克，停止挣扎。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME's gills have razor-sharp edges and can move them faster than the eye can follow, which they use to sink into unsuspecting prey. The gills are colder than the surroundings, which sends prey into shock, stopping it from struggling.

entry: POKENAME掷出锐利羽毛，直接从人手中钩走贵重物品。带着赃物飞走时，还会散下刀羽，逼退追赶者。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME fling razor-sharp feathers to snag valuable objects right out of people's hands. They scatter their bladed feathers as they fly away with their hauls to repel any potential pursuers.

entry: POKENAME嚼废汽水罐获取养分。吃过铝与铁锈后，金属身体会微微发光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME chews discarded soda cans for nutrients. Its metal body glows faintly after feeding on aluminum and rust.

entry: POKENAME的历史极其久远，有人推测人类正是受它启发才发明了斧头。有些个体甚至愿意让训练家握着自己使用。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME is so ancient, it is theorized to have inspired the creation of the axe. Some even allow their Trainer to wield them.

entry: POKENAME两颗头常为饮食与生活方式争执。前面的头喜欢和平吃草，尾部的头却爱挑衅其他宝可梦来攻，再把对方吃掉。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME's two heads often conflict with each other when it comes to their diet and way of life. The front head prefers to live peacefully and eat grass, while the tail head prefers to goad any other Pokémon to attack it and eat them instead.

entry: POKENAME温顺，多在洞窟吃苔藓，或用短小翅膀飞行。一被发现，就立刻戒备，以尖锐刀钻与尖叫，试图吓走靠近者。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME is docile and mostly seen in caverns, eating moss or flying around with its nubby wings. When spotted, it will immediately get defensive and try to scare off anything approaching with its sharp blade-like drill and screeches.

entry: POKENAME眨眼间便从天空俯冲而至，用钳中的刀刃钉住猎物。头上的刀刃，则用来斩破抵抗，或给予最后一击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Appearing within the blink of an eye, POKENAME dive down from the sky to pin down their prey with the blades in their pincers. They use the blade on their heads to cut through any resistance or deal the finishing blow.

entry: POKENAME覆铁的喙一击就能刺穿铁壳蛹的壳。它会凶猛战斗，保卫稀少的筑巢地。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's iron-plated beak can pierce a Kakuna's shell in one strike. It fights fiercely to defend its sparse nesting grounds.

entry: POKENAME结小群捕猎，会猛烈拆毁人造物，取走金属。首领通常头冠最大，也能分到最多掠来的金属。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hunt in small packs and will violently strip any man-made objects for their metal. The leader of the pack usually has the largest crest and will also get the largest share of plundered metal.

entry: 它们最爱蜂蜜，因此经常与某些虫属性宝可梦冲突。它用锋利臂刃采蜜，再舔得干净，也有助保持刃口锐利光洁。
author: infinex21
source: Their favored food is honey, which often puts them at arms with particular Bug-type Pokémon. They use their sharp arm-blades to gather honey and will lick it clean off, which also helps to keep their blades sharp and polished.

entry: POKENAME将头缩进身体，躲在坚实钢铁里。建筑工人常雇一群，在危险工地外充当路障、阻止靠近。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME tuck their heads down into their bodies to shelter themselves in their solid steel. Construction workers often employ groups of POKENAME to act as roadblocks and deterrents outside dangerous construction sites.

entry: POKENAME用水中垃圾制成锐利兵器，与其他POKENAME并肩作战，抵御外来物种，保护家园。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME uses trash in the water to create sharp weapons. It defends its home from invasive species, fighting alongside other POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME对铠甲极其自豪，也爱保持刀刃锋利。铠甲若严重损坏，就寻找废金属，用火焰吐息锻造新甲。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are incredibly proud of their armor, as they love to keep their blades nice and sharp. If their armor is badly damaged, they will search for leftover metal and forge itself new armor using its fire breath.

entry: POKENAME蜷起身体，伸出刀刃滚动，如同活圆锯。它切开的地面能留下踪迹，但也会随性跳跃或倒转方向，试图甩开猎人。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME curl up before rolling along with their blades extended, acting like living buzzsaws. They can be tracked by the paths that they cut through the earth, but they jump or reverse directions on a whim to try and throw hunters off.

entry: POKENAME眨着大眼，将刀刃藏进毛里，装作无辜。有人靠近，就伸刃跃出，所有刀刃一齐攻击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME pretends to be innocent by batting their wide eyes and hiding their blades within their fur. Once someone approaches, they will extend their blades and leap forward to strike with all of their blades at once.

entry: POKENAME满身锐利突起，会向目标注入失控电流。尖刺使它无法安全与他者接触，因此易怒攻击，训练家便给它做柔软耐用的衣服，免得伤人。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME is covered with sharp protrusions which inject targets with uncontrolled electricity. POKENAME lashes out because the spikes prevent it from safely interacting with others, so Trainers make soft, durable clothing for it to not hurt others.

entry: POKENAME从嘴里喷出浓烟，隐藏身影，再冲上前挥刃。可惜经常在自己的烟里迷路、绊倒，还没出手就乱了阵脚。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME billow out smoke from their mouths to hide their presence before rushing forward to strike with their blades. Unfortunately, they often get lost in their own smoke and stumble before they can deliver their planned attacks.

entry: 传闻POKENAME常毫无规律地出现在孩子的衣橱里。试图赶走也没用，第二天总会再现身。
author: atlas3339098
source: Rumors say that POKENAME often appears in children's closets seemingly at random. Attempts to get rid of it are futile, as it always reappears the next day.

entry: POKENAME三颗头如今身体相连，也都渴望战斗。经常能见它独自站在黑暗洞里，领地意识强，时刻等着战斗爆发。
author: beatdoof
source: Its three heads now united physically and in their desire for battle, POKENAME is often seen standing alone in a dark cave, territorial and constantly anticipating a fight to break out at any moment.

entry: POKENAME行为无赖，在世界大多数地区都招人讨厌。它看不起其他不会飞的驹刀小兵，连最可怕训练家手下的个体也敢攻击。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME is hated by most regions of the world due to its scoundrel-like behavior. It looks down on other Pawniards because of their inability to fly, even attacking those of the most intimidating trainers.

entry: POKENAME用精神力向人和宝可梦掷飞刀。它没耐心，不加思考，见什么就攻击什么。
author: agostostino
source: POKENAME uses its psychic power to throw knives at people and Pokémon. Due to its impatience, POKENAME strikes at everything it sees without thinking.

entry: POKENAME用精神力向人和宝可梦掷飞刀。它没耐心，不加思考，见什么就攻击什么。
author: agostostino
source: POKENAME uses its psychic power to throw knives at people and Pokémon. Due to its impatience, POKENAME strikes at everything it sees without thinking.

entry: POKENAME精力充沛，大多用来打扫，忍不住整理住处、宝可梦和人。它也极其暴力，迫不及待地攻击附近一切，尤其是虫宝可梦。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME are bursting with energy and spend most of it cleaning. They compulsively tidy homes, Pokémon, and people alike. They are also extremely violent and eagerly attack anything nearby, especially Bug Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME是忠诚的护卫，尽职留在训练家身边。陌生来客靠近，它的第一反应是瞬移过去，以刀相逼，直到训练家叫停。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME behaves as a loyal bodyguard to its Trainer, remaining dutifully by their side. Their first instinct to new arrivals approaching is to teleport close and hold them at blade-point until their Trainer calls them off.

entry: 许多人见POKENAME满身尖刃、爪也锋利，就决定战斗时保持距离，但这并不管用。嘴里的伸缩长舌同样是锐刃，随时能刺出，切向对手。
author: sk372
source: Many would take a look at POKENAME's pointy body and claws and resolve to keep a distance in battle, but this would be ineffective; the extendable tongue within its mouth is also a sharp blade just ready to strike and slice opponents.

entry: POKENAME用头刃砍大树。刀刃由骨头构成，开裂或折断后，也会随着时间愈合。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hack at large trees with the blade atop their head. This blade is made out of bone, so any fractures or breakage heals over time.

entry: 据说POKENAME体内住着许多古代阵亡士兵的灵魂。人们相信，拿着它的石头，会使人盲目效忠于自己所知最强的人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to be inhabited by a multitude of souls, those of fallen soldiers from ancient times. Holding its stone is believed to make a person blindly loyal to the person they perceive as the strongest they know.

entry: 它一生都在训练，精进剑术，挥刃如熟练剑士。遇上强敌，会以波导包裹武器，让斩击更锐利、更致命。
author: fiordaliso
source: It spends its entire life training to perfect its swordsmanship, wielding its blade like a skilled fencer. When it faces a powerful foe, it coats its weapon in aura to make its strikes even sharper and deadlier.

entry: POKENAME刀刃般的四肢确实锋利，牙也能切穿大多数物件。它住在崎岖而富矿的洞窟，只有意志最坚定的人才会深入。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's blade-like limbs are as sharp as they look, while their teeth can cut right through most objects. POKENAME itself are found in rugged and mineral-rich caves where only the most determined explore.

entry: POKENAME优雅走过山坡，只在想警示灾难将至的地方留下切痕。不同斩痕图案能表示威胁的时间、地点与强度。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Gracefully striding across the mountainside, POKENAME only leaves cuts in areas it wants to mark as a warning of an approaching disaster. The different patterns of the slashes can indicate the time, location, and intensity of the threat.

entry: POKENAME在黑暗中跳跃，双刃相撞，迸出令人目眩的火花，扰乱敌人方向。若出手前就被发现，便洒出大片火星掩护逃跑。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME jumps around in the dark, striking its blades together to create blinding sparks that disorient foes in battle. If it's spotted before it can strike, it will create a shower of sparks to cover its escape.

entry: 即使经验丰富的训练家，也很难管住独立而不守规矩的POKENAME。只有完全进化形劈斩王的强大领导，才能让群体井然有序。
author: bee4082
source: POKENAME are unruly and independent creatures for even experienced Trainers. Only the mighty leadership of a Biking, their fully evolved form, can set a pack of them in order.

entry: POKENAME成群猎杀目标。捕猎成功后，便在河边石上磨利身体。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME slaughter their victims in groups. After a successful hunt, they sharpen themselves on stones by a river.

entry: POKENAME的主刃若在战斗中变钝，它就改用小刀刺敌。谁试图抓住剑柄，也会被小刃刺住、攀牢，直到生命力被吸尽。
author: soup1900
source: If POKENAME's main blade dulls out in a battle, it will use its tiny knife to stab its foe. This small blade is also used to stab and cling onto anyone who tries to grab its hilt until they've been drained of all their life force.

entry: POKENAME好斗得出了名，稍受挑衅就会攻击。它给刀刃般的角涂上毒黏液，再连续使出角撞，冲击敌人。
author: theartemis1
source: Notoriously aggressive, POKENAME will often attack at the slightest provocation. Coating its blade-like horn in a layer of poisonous ooze, it charges its foes with a repeated series of Horn Attacks.

entry: POKENAME很容易兴奋，自以为玩耍时，也会猛烈攻击。若有人向它鞠躬，它也会鞠躬回礼。
author: amberaxolotl223
source: POKENAME are easily excitable, attacking violently when it thinks it's playing. If someone bows to it, POKENAME will bow in return.

entry: POKENAME有能看穿墙壁的透视眼，借此无情跟踪猎物，再施以致命电击。
author: coridiant
source: POKENAME possesses x-ray vision that can see through walls. Using this, it will stalk its prey mercilessly before delivering a lethal electric shock.

entry: POKENAME在湖泊深处优雅游动，用头刃击倒猎物。它爱在窝里囤积最硬的石头，保持刀刃锋利光洁。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME swims gracefully in lake depths, using the blade on its head to strike down prey. It tends to hoard the hardest stones in its den, using them to keep its sharp blades polished and beautiful.

entry: 受威胁时，POKENAME会用缎带末端的锐尖戳刺附近对象。伤口会让中招的肢体在几分钟内虚弱麻木。
author: sk372
source: When threatened, POKENAME jabs at those nearby with the sharp points at the end of its ribbons. Wounds caused by these points cause the afflicted limb to grow weak and numb within minutes.

entry: POKENAME全身长满刀刃，哪把都能用来攻击。它们会找来劈斩司令担任副手，并踢打那些不够尊重自己的驹刀小兵。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME have blades all over their bodies and can strike foes using any of them. They seek out Bisharp to serve as their second in command, kicking any Pawniard that does not show them enough respect.

entry: POKENAME用头上的火焰加热刀刃，更快切开各种材料。刀刃冷得太久，就会失去实体，穿过目标也毫无伤害。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME heat their blades with the flames on their heads to aid in cutting through various materials more quickly. If the blades of POKENAME remain cold for too long, they become intangible, passing through any target harmlessly.

entry: POKENAME将全身加热，原地旋转，用一对高热刀刃打击。外貌与本领虽可怕，却很受餐厅欢迎，能充当搅拌机和副厨。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME heat their entire bodies and spin in place to strike with a pair of super-heated blades. Despite their fearsome appearance and capabilities, they are very popular helpers at restaurants, acting as blenders and sous chefs.

entry: POKENAME两颗头互斗的时间，与对敌作战一样多。对敌的最后手段，是一颗头用颚咬住，另一颗不断猛攻。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's two heads spend as much time fighting each other as they do fighting their opponents. As a last resort against an enemy, one head will latch onto the foe with its jaws while the other head attacks relentlessly.

entry: POKENAME用刀刃般的爪挖穿石头，再到地下休息。等待时，金属身体会一动不动地待上数小时。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its bladed claws to tunnel through stone before resting underground. Its metallic body stays still for hours while it waits.

entry: POKENAME极忠于追随的对象，却缺乏储备能量。它爬来爬去，固执抵抗身体不断想睡的本能，但最终总挡不住睡意。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is fiercely loyal to those it follows, but is lacking in energy reserves. It crawls around, stubbornly resisting its biological need to sleep constantly, yet always fails to fight off the naps in the end.

entry: POKENAME披甲成群作战，让电流传遍身体，再一起放电，使对手完全失去行动能力。
author: coridiant
source: Fighting in armored groups, POKENAME conduct electricity across their bodies. They then discharge this energy together, totally incapacitating their opponent.

entry: POKENAME跟随群体首领，伏击并包围敌人。它能释放超过1000伏的电力。
author: coridiant
source: Following the leader of their pack, POKENAME ambush enemies and surround them. They can discharge electricity of over 1000 volts.

entry: POKENAME用头上的刀凿小隧道，挖出满意的窝后，再采矿石吃。它善于迅速清障、事后清理，很受救援队欢迎。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME use the knives on their heads to carve out miniature tunnels, gathering ore to eat once they've made a den they're happy with. POKENAME are popular among rescue teams for their ability to easily clear debris and clean up after.

entry: POKENAME虽会为群体地位与领导权相互争斗，却也能以惊人的速度和默契合作，围攻猎物。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although POKENAME fight among one another for dominance and leadership within their pack, they also work together with startling swiftness and coordination to corner and attack prey.

entry: POKENAME钻入深沙，造出斜坡陷坑，将附近猎物引落。猎物一入陷阱，就迅速向前冲，刀刃从沙中冒出。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME burrow deep into the sand, forming sloping pits that pull in prey from their surroundings. Once the prey has fallen into the trap, POKENAME will rapidly charge forward with their blades emerging through the sand.

entry: POKENAME两颗头常为战术争吵，甚至说服其他宝可梦替自己演练。可惜经常太专注谋划，反而顾不上真正战斗。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The two heads of POKENAME often get into squabbles over their tactics in battles, even going as far as to convince other Pokémon to act out their strategies for them. Unfortunately, they're often too focused on their planning to actually fight.

entry: POKENAME两颗头常争论怎么打最好。它们用磁力让金属在彼此之间的棋盘上移动，试图证明自己的战术。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The two heads of POKENAME frequently get into arguments about how best to approach a battle. They use their magnetic powers to float metal across the board between them to try and prove their tactics to each other.

entry: 古时，POKENAME因合力砍倒森林中一排排树木而恶名远扬。但研究砍伐图形与环境后发现，它们其实是在易发森林火灾的地方开防火隔离带。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: In ancient times, POKENAME were infamous for working together to cut down rows of trees in forests. Studying the patterns and environments of where POKENAME have cut has revealed that they actually form fire breaks in areas at risk of forest fires.

entry: POKENAME蹦跳着，用颈部与耳朵的强健肌肉挥动头刃。它会与驹刀小兵交刃，争取加入劈斩司令带领的群体。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME hops around, using strong muscles in its neck and ears to swing around the blades on its head. It will cross blades with Pawniard, trying to be accepted into a group of them lead by a Bisharp.

entry: POKENAME在洞顶凿巢，埋伏等待路过的猎物。谁想闯巢，所有成员都会像齐射的飞镖一样一同飞出。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME carve out nests in cavern ceilings, lying in wait for passing prey. If anyone tries to intrude on the nest, all of the POKENAME will fly out at once like a volley of darts.

entry: POKENAME在领地岩石上磨利牙与刀刃。金属声会警告同类保持距离。
author: pokefanart
source: POKENAME sharpens its fangs and blades against rocks in its territory. The metallic sound serves as a warning for others of its species to keep their distance.

entry: POKENAME古时被奉为战争先兆。五个尖端共同指向哪里，崇拜者就视作开战信号，进攻那里。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME was worshiped in ancient times as a harbinger of war. Wherever its five sharp nubs jointly point, its worshipers take it as a sign of battle and strike there.

entry: POKENAME不顾一切地飞速向前，撞上沿途所有东西。但具有劈斩司令DNA的宝可梦，能指挥它们。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME motors forward with reckless speed and abandon, crashing into whatever lies in its path. Pokémon that have Bisharp DNA are able to command them, however.

entry: POKENAME在同类间活泼而混乱，与其他成员打架争地位。但只要更大的宝可梦吼一声命令，就会毫不怀疑地服从。
author: sk372
source: Among its own kind, POKENAME is rambunctious and disorderly, battling other POKENAME to establish dominance. Should any larger Pokémon bark an order at it, however, it obeys without question.

entry: POKENAME与同类相随，由最强成员带队。战争庆典上常用它的充气造型。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME stick with other instances of their species, with the strongest of the members leading the pack. Inflatable POKENAME are commonly used during celebrations of war.

entry: POKENAME对刀刃十分自豪，四处走动，寻找在日常事务中展示的新方式。它努力帮助周围的人与宝可梦，却似乎不明白别人为何怕刀。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are very proud of their blades, marching around in search of new ways to show them off in daily tasks. They work hard to try and help people and Pokémon around them, but they don't seem to understand why others are afraid of their knives.

entry: POKENAME钻进地下吸取养分，只露刀刃。谁踩中，就会被注入引起灼痛的毒。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME burrows into the ground to absorb nutrients and leaves its blade exposed. It injects venom through its blade that causes searing pain to anything that steps on it.

entry: POKENAME一挥翅膀，就能射出小刀，掷出后很快重新长好。它极其敏捷，金属虽重，仍能施展复杂杂技动作。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME can fire off its knives with a sweep of its wings, which rapidly grow back after being thrown. It is extremely agile, able to perform complex acrobatic maneuvers despite the weight of its metal.

entry: POKENAME一挥刀就能剥下大树树皮，吸食树液。它疑心极重，会在整个领地散布麻痹真菌孢子，防止袭击。
author: fiordaliso
source: With a single swing of its blades, POKENAME can strip the bark from large trees so it can feed on their sap. It is an extremely paranoid Pokémon that scatters paralyzing fungal spores throughout its territory to prevent anyone from attacking it.

entry: POKENAME攻击前，头刃会烧得通红。挥击虽比大多数攻击慢，却一刀就能劈开实心岩石。
author: .izik
source: The blade on POKENAME's head glows red-hot before it strikes. Though slower than most attacks, a single swing can cleave solid stone.

entry: POKENAME住在峭壁间，不断寻找“首领”。它对训练家极忠诚，收服后即使放归野外，也会回来。
author: thistleblower
source: POKENAME lives in crags, constantly searching for a "leader." It is so loyal to its Trainer that, once captured, it even returns when released back to the wild.

entry: 在阳光照不到的最深海底，能找到POKENAME。这种环境中，红光不会被吸收，让它看起来是黑色或褐色。它借此悄然接近猎物，将其切碎。
author: quackquackattack
source: Where sunlight is unable to light the darkest depths of the ocean, POKENAME are found. In these conditions, red light does not get absorbed, making POKENAME appear black or brown. This allows them to sneak up on prey, hacking them to pieces.

entry: 野外常能见到POKENAME在空地交锋。进一步观察发现，这其实是切磋，让彼此维持最佳状态。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME are often witnessed clashing with one another in open fields. Closer observations led to the conclusion that these battles are a form of sparring to keep them each in tip-top form.

entry: POKENAME用头顶剪刀般的刀刃作平衡点，帮助悬浮。它总在寻找战斗，任何与它对视的宝可梦都可能成为对手。
author: beatdoof
source: Its scissor-like blade atop its head is used as a balancing point to help POKENAME stay aloft while hovering, always on the lookout for a battle with any Pokémon that meets its gaze.

entry: POKENAME看似有两颗不同的头，其实只有一颗。另一颗“头”是尾状附肢，尖锐又能抓握，帮助抵御天敌。
author: beatdoof
source: Despite what seems like two different heads, POKENAME actually only has one. The other "head" is a tail-like appendage, its pointy, prehensile nature helping it defend itself from predators.

entry: 偷猎者开始为刀刃般的鳍捕杀POKENAME，使它近来濒危。因此，不同帮群开始联手，击败捕猎船只。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME have recently become endangers as poaches have started hunting them for their bladed fins. Because of this, gangs of POKENAME have started to team up to take down hunting vessels.

entry: POKENAME头刃一挥就能切开页岩等石头。矿工过去会循着它的隧道寻找矿石。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's head blade slices through stone like shale in a single stroke. Miners once followed its tunnels to uncover ore.

entry: POKENAME用双手的剪刃切开猎物。经常能见到它在岸边岩石上磨刃。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use the scissors on each of their hands to slice through their prey. They will often be seen sharpening their blades on rocks along the shore.

entry: 旋转刀刃快得惊人，接触时没被切开的东西，往往也会被爆发的动能震碎。因此，训练家被劝告，不要为了好玩让POKENAME互相冲撞。
author: xillo
source: Whirling blades spin with such speed that anything not cut on contact is often blasted apart by explosive kinetic force. It is for this reason Trainers are urged not to crash POKENAME into each other for amusement.

entry: POKENAME用刀刃凿开洞壁，为其他宝可梦造巢。见到受伤的宝可梦，会细心切碎草药，帮助恢复。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME carves out cave walls with its blades to create nesting spaces for other Pokémon. If it notices an injured Pokémon, it carefully chops herbs to aid in their recovery.

entry: 蜂蜜能强化POKENAME原本脆弱翅膀的锐利边缘，也赋予表面金属光泽。翅膀轻盈，能对争夺心爱花朵的宝可梦挥出疾风般的连斩。
author: firmamentality
source: A diet of honey fortifies the sharp edges of POKENAME's otherwise fragile wings, and gives its surface a metallic sheen. Its lightweight wings allow it to unleash a blistering flurry of slashes against Pokémon competing for its favorite flowers.

entry: POKENAME精力旺盛又鲁莽，常把刀刃卡进各种东西。可群体配合，却十分默契。
author: carameldog
source: POKENAME are recklessly energetic, and are often found with their blades stuck in various surfaces. However, they are well coordinated in groups.

entry: POKENAME吃下的代码越多，刀刃就越锋利。数据完全饱和时，能瞬间切穿铁。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's blades sharpen as it devours increasing amounts of code. When fully saturated with data, it can slice through iron in an instant.

entry: POKENAME许多触手末端带刃，能轻易刺入、缠住猎物。它也能缩进壳中飞快前旋，用锐利的刃状脊切向敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's many blade-tipped tentacles let it dig into and ensnare prey with ease. It can tuck into its shell and spin forward rapidly to cut into adversaries with the sharp-bladed ridge it possesses.

entry: POKENAME虽天生是领袖，一旦没了群体，却像完全变了一只宝可梦。它往往更无情、更独立，但团队精神尚在，仍较愿意结盟。
author: thordemidgard
source: Although natural leaders, a POKENAME without its pack behaves like a completely different Pokémon. They often become more ruthless and independent, but still more likely to form an alliance since their group spirit remains.

entry: POKENAME游到湖心，跳出复杂刀舞。据说仪式能召来庞大风暴，以神秘方式改变天气。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME swims to the center of lakes and performs an intricate blade dance. This ritual is said to summon massive storms, altering the weather in mysterious ways.

entry: POKENAME极其好斗，爱夺取其他宝可梦的领地。但它不愿久留，很快就会转向下一个目标。
author: goober145
source: POKENAME are highly aggressive and enjoy taking the territory of other Pokémon. However, they do not care to stay in their territory for long and quickly move on to another target.

entry: POKENAME不守规矩，宁愿按自己的动机行事，也不听伙伴摆布。它经常寻找梦幻，想发号施令，却几乎不成功。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME are unruly, choosing to follow their own motives rather than the whims of their companions. They're often searching for Mew to order around, to very limited success.

entry: POKENAME统领整群驹刀比鸟，在空中带队捕猎。它们的翅膀锐利如刀，一次俯冲就能砍倒成群猎物。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME command entire flocks of Pawnotto, leading them through the skies as they hunt. Their wings are as sharp as blades, cutting down herds of prey with a single swoop.

entry: POKENAME狡猾又能预知，是可怕的军师与首领，还能用超能力更好地操控巨大尾刃。
author: carameldog
source: POKENAME's cunning and clairvoyance make them formidable strategists and leaders. They use psychic power to better control their large tail blade.

entry: POKENAME在组织、指挥部队方面，被视为战术天才。历史上有许多将领身边带着它，协助布阵与谋划。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is considered a tactical genius when it comes to organizing and directing forces. Military generals across history were noted to have had a POKENAME by their side, assisting in formations and tactics.

entry: POKENAME与邻近群体争夺领地时，会保护首领。它们运用战术，在战场上曲折穿行，以突袭击倒对手。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME protect their leader in territorial conflicts with neighboring herds. Executing strategic tactics, they maneuver around the battlefield in zig-zagging patterns that allow them to knock out opponents with surprise attacks.

entry: POKENAME似乎很擅长协调指挥未知图腾及其融合体。它是严厉的领袖，谁稍有冒犯，就常被反手一击，受到管教。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears to have a knack for coordinating and directing Unown and its related fusions. It is a stern leader, regularly dispensing discipline with backhanded strikes delivered to those that become a bit too upstart.

entry: POKENAME用头刃轻松挖穿土壤。发现玄武岩矿藏，就会大吃，强化原已坚硬的身体。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses the blade on its head to tunnel through soil effortlessly. When it finds basalt deposits, it gorges on them to strengthen its already hardened body.

entry: POKENAME背上看似翅膀的部分，其实是刀刃，用来切斩侧面来袭的敌人。脚边厚重金属，让发号施令的跺脚声传得更远。
author: soup1900
source: What looks like wings on POKENAME's back are actually blades used to slice foes that try to attack it from the side. The bulky metal around its feet allows its commanding stomps to be heard from further away.

entry: 据说POKENAME的刀羽极锋利，古代战士会拿来做剑刃。这也许就是它避开人类，并奋力抵御所有领地入侵者的原因。
author: infinex21
source: The blade-like feathers of POKENAME are said to be so sharp that warriors of the past would use them as the blades of their swords. Supposedly this is why this Pokémon will avoid humans and fervently defend their territory from all invaders.

entry: POKENAME快速来回挥动尾刃，推动自己前进。信任训练家后，就会允许对方拿起，像刀一样挥使。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME propel themselves forward by rapidly slashing their tail blades back and forth. When they trust a Trainer, they will allow themselves to be held and wielded like a knife.

entry: POKENAME极为聪明。指挥驹刀桶大军时，谋划的战术往往极其有效。
author: codewolfie
source: POKENAME are extremely intelligent. When commanding an army of Pawnllery, its battle strategies prove to be extremely effective.

entry: 四肢都附着锐利刀刃。POKENAME以头撑地旋转时，碰到什么都能切开。
author: blazerxz
source: It has sharp blades attached to all four of its limbs. When POKENAME starts spinning on its head, it can cut anything it comes into contact with.

entry: 古代将领研究POKENAME的行为，改良防守战术。它先承受攻击，再喷出高压气体，冲向敌人突袭。
author: pjporwoll
source: Historical generals studied the behavior of POKENAME to improve defensive combat tactics. POKENAME endures attacks before venting pressurized gas to launch at foes in a surprise attack.

entry: POKENAME气势庄严，令人敬畏，能让野生皮卡丘列队听令。它协调下属，高效守卫森林家园，抵御入侵者。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a solemn, imposing aura that compels wild Pikachu to line up before it and follow its orders. It coordinates these subordinates, making them highly effective at defending POKENAME's forest home from intruders.

entry: POKENAME两条尾巴末端有结实金属刃，双手又有坚韧金属护手保护。这两项特征让它很受木工界欢迎。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME possesses sturdy metal blades at the ends of its two tails and tough metal gauntlets that protect its hands. Both these features have made POKENAME a highly popular Pokémon in the woodworking community.

entry: 驹刀小兵起了背叛念头，POKENAME就会模仿对方动作，显得毫无威胁，再故意向前栽倒，用头刃砍它，给个教训。
author: soup1900
source: When a Pawniard thinks of betrayal, POKENAME starts mimicking their actions to make it seem nonthreatening. It then purposely trips over headfirst to chop them with the blade on its head to teach them a lesson.

entry: POKENAME覆金属的身体，温度最低可达零下20华氏度。冬季，它会爬上覆雪树木，以剃刀般的利刃扑向毫无戒心的敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's metal-coated body can reach temperatures as low as -20°F. In winter, it climbs snow-covered trees and pounces on unsuspecting foes with its razor-sharp blades.

entry: 进化后，对战斗的渴望愈加强烈，压过基本求生本能。它出现在废工厂与暗洞，身边总围着其他宝可梦的尸骸。
author: beatdoof
source: Its hunger for battle grows stronger in evolution, surpassing its basic survival instincts. Found in abandoned factories and dark caves, it's always seen surrounded by dead remains of other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME平时行为莫名其妙，仿佛脱离现实。但到了黑暗中，却展现出惊人的清醒、智慧与战斗本领。
author: sk372
source: Ordinarily, POKENAME behaves in a nonsensical manner, as if detached from reality. In the dark, however, it exhibits a surprising clarity, intellect and fighting prowess.

entry: POKENAME全身披着钢甲，双臂上的刀刃锋利无比，连最坚韧的橡树也能斩断。
author: jona_hehe
source: POKENAME is covered from head to toe in steel armor. The blades on POKENAME's arms are sharp enough to cut even the strongest of oak trees.

entry: POKENAME心境冷静，智力强，是高效的队伍领袖。伙伴无论差异多大，它总能制定战术，让每个成员贡献力量，赢得辉煌胜利。
author: sk372
source: With a calm mind and a strong intellect, POKENAME make highly effective team leaders. No matter how different its allies, it can always formulate tactics that allow each member to contribute to a shining victory in battle.

entry: POKENAME是个空壳，漫游世界，收集死去宝可梦的灵魂。平时温顺，受攻击后却战得毫不留情。
author: radiationv2
source: POKENAME is an empty husk which wanders the world in search of deceased Pokémon souls to gather. It is docile unless attacked, but ruthless in combat.

entry: POKENAME的骨刺坚如钢铁。它蜷成球，在领地滚动，借体重与势头撞倒挡路的障碍和宝可梦。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's boney spikes are as hard as steel. They curl into a ball to roll around their territories, using their weight and momentum to knock over obstacles and Pokémon in their way.

entry: POKENAME夜里无声飘过山坡，默默守护下方村庄。若发生雪崩，就相互连起，挡住落石与积雪，用刀刃将其切碎。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME silently float along mountainsides at night, acting as silent guardians for the villages below. If there's ever an avalanche, POKENAME will link together to block the falling rocks and snow, breaking them down with their blades.

entry: POKENAME的牙坚如钢铁，随年龄增长变得更长、更锋利。不同地区的行为差异很大，原因仍在研究。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME teeth are as hard as steel, and grow longer and sharper the older they are. The behavior of POKENAME varies greatly by region; the reason for this is still undergoing study.

entry: 据说POKENAME由过去一些最伟大将领的灵魂构成。它散发的气势，会迫使弱于自己的对象忠诚服从。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to consist of the souls of some of the greatest army generals of the past. It radiates an aura that compels those weaker than it to become loyal and subservient to it.

entry: POKENAME滑翔时，会伸展双臂上的钢鳍，让自己不费多少力气就能长距离滞空。
author: .izik
source: When gliding, POKENAME extends the steel fins on its arms. These allow it to remain airborne for long distances with minimal effort.

entry: POKENAME防御无双，任何打击都仿佛不存在。锐利双刃的反击威力惊人，切到什么便摧毁什么。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME's defense is unmatched, shrugging off any strike as if it were non-existent. A counterattack made by its wickedly sharp blades is devastating, annihilating whatever it slices.

entry: POKENAME带头冲阵，以装甲身体的巨大重量，猛烈撞进敌阵。它依赖驹刀獭随从修车、磨利刀刃。
author: kobold_hijinks
source: POKENAME lead the charge to battle, using the immense weight of their armored bodies to crash spectacularly into the enemy. These Pokémon depend on Pawnkoth retainers to keep their bikes repaired and blades sharpened.

entry: POKENAME善于载客渡过风浪。体形大，能一次载数十人，头刃还能劈开让小型宝可梦难以应付的汹涌浪涛。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME is adept at carrying passengers across rough waters. Its large size allows it to carry dozens of people at once, and the blade atop its head aids it in cutting through rough swells that would cause smaller Pokémon trouble.

entry: POKENAME前腿比钢铁身体更坚硬，一击就能穿透多层钢板。躯干两侧的刀刃，能挡下多数来自死角的物理攻击。
author: infinex21
source: The forelegs of POKENAME are tougher than their steel bodies and can pierce multiple sheets of steel in a single strike. The blades on either side of their torsos thwart most physical attacks from blind spots.

entry: POKENAME的刀刃各有两个尖端，攻击如同所率驹刀小兵大军般强大凶猛。刀刃可伸缩，让它先显得无害，再刺向背叛自己权威的对象。
author: soup1900
source: Thanks to its dual-tipped blades, POKENAME's attacks are as strong and overwhelming as the Pawniard army it leads. As its blades are retractable, it can make itself look harmless before stabbing into any double-crosser of its authority.

entry: POKENAME渴望晋升，指挥自己的部队。但它缺乏领袖所需的技巧与态度，每次集结军队，都难免因自身傲慢而瓦解。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is eager to rise above its station and command its own troops. However, it lacks the skill and attitude a leader requires, and any attempts to amass an army inevitably fall apart due to its own hubris.

entry: POKENAME住在山间河流附近，是领地里威风凛凛的老大。虽给同族分派苛刻任务，却会亲自出面，保护受自己照看的成员。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME live near mountainous rivers and act as intimidating bosses of their territory. While they assign harsh tasks to their kin, they will personally intervene to protect those under their care.

entry: POKENAME每条缎带末端都有锐刃，战斗时挥使熟练。它精通战术，会先找出对手弱点，优先攻击，以便尽快结束战斗。
author: sk372
source: Each of POKENAME's ribbons ends in a sharp blade it skillfully wields in combat. Highly tactical, it scopes out opponents for weak points, striking there first to end battles quicker.

entry: 融合使POKENAME的双臂与头部长出电锯。如今，脑海里塞满了自私欲望。
author: nellnast42
source: With Pokémon Fusion, POKENAME sprouted chainsaws from its arms and head. Its head is now flooded with selfish desire.

entry: POKENAME许多刀刃状附肢，每一处都磨得极其尖锐。即使最厚最硬的金属，也能像热刀切黄油般干脆切开。
author: sk372
source: Every one of POKENAME's many bladed appendages is sharpened to the finest point possible. It can slice clean through the thickest and toughest of metals like a hot knife through butter.

entry: POKENAME四肢覆着金属，拳脚能打出重击。耳尖是全身最锋利的部位，但只有高速旋转时才能使用。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can make powerful strikes using their arms and legs, as their limbs are covered with a layer of metal. The tips of their ears are the sharpest part of their bodies, but can only be used if POKENAME spin around at high speed.

entry: POKENAME常成群弹奏舒缓吉他，吸引伴侣，博取青睐。带刃尾巴则用于捕猎。
author: acidicjesse
source: POKENAME plays soothing guitar music to attract and impress potential mates, usually in groups. It uses its bladed tail for hunting prey.

entry: POKENAME很受乐手欢迎，常陪他们弹吉他。它对熊类宝可梦很凶，甚至会中断演出，攻击圈圈熊等对象。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are popular with Musicians, often accompanying them in playing the guitar. POKENAME are quite aggressive with ursine Pokémon, stopping performances so they can attack Pokémon such as Ursaring.

entry: 古墓中的发现描绘着POKENAME率领大军作战。它的刀刃由不明金属锻成，切铁如切黄油。
author: .izik
source: Ancient tomb discoveries depict POKENAME leading massive armies in war. Its blades, forged from an unknown metal, can slice through iron as if it were butter.

entry: POKENAME似乎什么场合都有合用工具，因此很受某国军队的士兵欢迎，成为常见伙伴。
author: kiwiarms
source: Because of its tendency to have a tool for seemingly any situation, POKENAME has become a popular companion for the soldiers of a certain country's army.

entry: 人们收集POKENAME的金属羽毛，锻成极锋利的新刀具。它飞行出奇安静，夜间狩猎时能发动致命伏击。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's metal feathers are gathered and forged into new sets of extremely sharp knives. Its flight is remarkably silent, allowing POKENAME to spring deadly ambushes on prey during nighttime hunts.

entry: POKENAME两颗头好胜，战斗中总想比对方更高明。训练家发现，这种行为能启发迷惑敌人的团队战术。
author: pjporwoll
source: The two heads of POKENAME are competitive and constantly try to outmaneuver each other in battle. Trainers have noted its behavior inspires deceptive team tactics.

entry: POKENAME精通谋略，会现身帮助、保护期盼更好未来的对象。但若有人想把它的知识变成武器，它反而会利用对方最大弱点，一步步击溃。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: A master of strategy, POKENAME appears to assist and defend those who wish for a better future. If someone seeks to weaponize its knowledge, it will instead take advantage of their greatest weakness and dismantle them step by step.

entry: POKENAME性情严肃冷淡，指挥大牙狸和大尾狸，维持纪律。它对筑坝极认真，哪个下属不严格听令，就会受到惩罚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a solemn and cold personality, keeping Bidoof and Bibarel in line under its command. It takes dam-building incredibly seriously and will dispense punishment on any underling that doesn't follow orders to the letter.

entry: POKENAME白天整日磨刀，入夜才开始狩猎。坚韧金属甲让除了最强者以外的敌人都不敢靠近。
author: coridiant
source: POKENAME spends all day sharpening its blade, then begins to hunt once night falls. Its tough metal armor deters all but the mightiest of foes.

entry: POKENAME被同群伙伴围在身边时，力量就会增强。它们合力放电，连最强大的对手也能击倒。
author: coridiant
source: The strength of POKENAME increases once it is surrounded by its pack. Together, they take down even the strongest of opponents through their electricity.

entry: POKENAME吞食银矿，强化头刃。它会在石头上磨刃，确保战斗时刃口尽可能锋利。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME devours silver ore to strengthen the blade on its head. It will run its blades along stones to sharpen it, ensuring the edge remains as sharp as possible for battle.

entry: POKENAME吃祖母绿、黄玉等宝石，强化坚硬金属外壳。它能轻松承受落石，几乎不怕外力损伤。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME eats gems like emeralds and topaz to strengthen its hard metallic casing. It can withstand a rockslide with ease, nearly impervious to physical damage.

entry: 它精通手里剑技艺。双打对战时，会将自己掷向敌人，替伙伴分散注意。
author: soup1900
source: This Pokémon has mastered the art of the shuriken. In double battles, it will throw itself at its enemies to distract them from its partner.

entry: POKENAME想招揽驹刀小兵追随，却通常只招得到卷卷耳。它毫不气馁，训练卷卷耳只用强壮双耳击倒猎物。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME try to gather groups of Pawniard to follow them, but usually only succeed in recruiting Buneary. Undeterred, POKENAME will train their Buneary to take down prey using only their powerful ears.

entry: POKENAME摩擦满身钢刃产生回声，在捕猎的洞窟中导航。一发现猎物，就无情猛攻，吸干每一分能量。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME grinds the steel blades covering its body to produce echoes that help it navigate the caves where it hunts. Once it detects prey, it attacks with ruthless ferocity, draining every ounce of their energy.

entry: POKENAME用磨利的金属长牙，在废矿井采铁矿，吃下金属，强化装甲骨骼。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its sharpened metal tusks to mine iron ore in abandoned shafts. It consumes the metal to reinforce its armored skeleton.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀平时坚如金属，加热后却柔软蓬松。有些厨师会裹上玉米粉炸，再配美味的榴石果酱，制成独特佳肴。
author: .izik
source: Despite normally being as hard as metal, POKENAME's wings become soft and fluffy when heated. Some chefs fry the wings in corn flour and serve them with a delightful Pomeg Berry sauce, creating a unique and delicious dish.

entry: 野生POKENAME战斗时常指挥驹刀暴龙群，但最后一击总由自己完成。尾刃折断就会再生，每次都更强、更锋利。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME often command herds of Pawnrunt during battles, but are always the ones to deliver the finishing blow. Their tail blades regrow whenever they break, each time returning stronger and sharper than before.

entry: POKENAME用剃刀般的牙磨刀，锋利得惊人。它精通战术，会绕着猎物寻找最佳角度，将其击倒。
author: thesilverowls
source: POKENAME sharpen their blade using their razor-sharp teeth, honing it to absurd sharpness. They are excellent tacticians, circling around prey to find the perfect angle to take them down.

entry: POKENAME食物中的铁会融入皮肤与毛发。飞行时，翅膀能如刀切割，连背毛都锋利得能划破皮肤。
author: hophoppip
source: The iron in POKENAME's diet is incorporated into its skin and fur. Its wings can cut like blades as it flies, and even the fur on its back is sharp enough to break skin.

entry: POKENAME黏软的身体很容易附在树干上。它爬上球果树，用刀刃状的头斩断枝条，吃掉落下的果实。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's gooey body clings easily to tree trunks. It climbs Apricorn Trees and slices off branches with its bladed head to eat the fallen fruit.

entry: POKENAME战斗风格张扬，臂下羽毛既用来飞扑敌人，也用来摆出夸张姿势。它不惜一切取胜，手段卑鄙，毫不留情地攻击对手弱点。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a flamboyant fighter, using the feathers beneath its arms not only to soar at foes but also to strike dramatic poses. Determined to win at any cost, it fights dirty and targets its opponents' weak spots without mercy.

entry: POKENAME战斗时极富表演性，臂下羽毛既用来飞扑敌人，也用来摆优雅姿势。每个杂技动作都会洒落花瓣般的羽毛，因此很受宝可梦华丽大赛青睐。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a highly theatrical fighter, using the feathers beneath its arms not only to soar at foes but also to strike elegant poses. Each acrobatic move scatters petal-like feathers, making it prized in Pokémon Contests.

entry: POKENAME用硬刃划开树干，吸食甜树脂。它以实力制服派拉斯，再让它们协助保卫领地。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME slashes tree trunks with its hard blades to feed on sweet resin. It protects its territory with the help of Paras it has subjugated through its strength.

entry: POKENAME头上刀刃状的鳞片，由青铜般的金属构成。它撞向洞壁，发出低沉锣声，回响传出数英里。
author: .izik
source: The blade-like scale on POKENAME's head is composed of a bronze-like metal. It slams this scale against cave walls, producing a deep gong-like sound that echoes for miles.

entry: POKENAME鳞片如精制刀刃，每片都磨至完美。它跳复杂战舞，以动作让对手眼花、迷失方向，再发动攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's scales are as sharp as finely crafted blades, each honed to perfection. It performs intricate battle dances, using the movement to dazzle and disorient its opponent before striking.

entry: POKENAME是讲究战斗荣誉的入侵物种。它会无情侵占其他宝可梦洞穴，与前来挑战的对象决斗。若对手败后仍展现决心，它就会留情。
author: mistathefox
source: POKENAME are an invasive species that fights with honor. They will invade dens of other Pokémon ruthlessly, facing down any attempting to challenge them in a duel. If the opponent shows its resolution even after defeat, the POKENAME will show mercy.

entry: POKENAME以选中的队伍为傲，成员常是宣誓效忠的野生宝可梦。众多刀刃由队伍成员打磨，磨得好坏决定地位高低。
author: thesilverowls
source: POKENAME are prideful of their chosen troupe, often consisting of wild Pokémon that swear fealty. The sharpening of their many blades is done by the Pokémon that make up their troupe, with the quality of the sharpening determining rank.

entry: POKENAME高尚地领导进化前的同族。它领地意识极强，谁进入，就会挑战公平一战。若自己落败，胜者就能赢得它与族群永久的尊重。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME nobly leads groups of its pre-evolved forms. Fiercely territorial, it will challenge anyone who enters its lands to fair combat. If defeated, the victor will gain the everlasting respect of POKENAME and its tribe.

entry: POKENAME会逐渐喜爱训练家及其最强的宝可梦。它像仰慕师长的弟子，努力提升剑术，换取称赞。
author: gaogao028
source: Over time, POKENAME grows fond of both its trainer and their strongest Pokémon. It acts as an admiring disciple, seeking to improve its swordplay in exchange for praise.

entry: POKENAME将利剑藏在尾部绒毛中的剑鞘里。被斩中的敌人会留下久久灼痛、嘶嘶作响的伤口。
author: gaogao028
source: POKENAME keeps a sharp sword concealed by the scabbard hidden in its tail's fluff. Foes slashed by its blade are inflicted with long-lasting, sizzling wounds.

entry: POKENAME曾是雇佣刺客的首选伙伴。长腿让它跨越楼宇，蹼足让它踏水而行，围巾般的附肢则能勒住目标。
author: mistathefox
source: POKENAME were once the partner of choice for assassins for hire. Their long legs allow them to jump across buildings, their webbed feet let them run across water, and their scarf-like appendage allows them to constrict targets.

entry: POKENAME定期蜕下身上金属，再用碎片锻造刀刃，收进头盔与背部自然形成的插槽。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME shed the metal on their bodies periodically. After this occurs, they will use the scraps to forge blades that they store in the naturally forming slots found on their helms and backs.

entry: POKENAME头上的鳍质地如铜，却锋利得能从巨石上切下岩块。它喜欢在城市小巷的垃圾箱附近安家。
author: .izik
source: The fin on POKENAME's head has the consistency of copper yet is sharp enough to slice chunks off of boulders. It prefers to make its home near dumpsters in city alleyways.

entry: POKENAME像孩子在电视或手机上看的帅气卡通英雄，因此常有孩子带着礼物与赞美靠近。它自然觉得困惑，但多数仍会领这份心意。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME resemble stylish cartoon heroes that children watch on a television set or smartphone, so children often approach them with gifts and praise. They are naturally confused by these children, but most appreciate the gesture regardless.

entry: 它通常与野生爱心鱼群一同游泳。与群中雄性或雌性成员结伴的可能性相同。
author: hophoppip
source: It's typically found swimming in a school of wild Luvdisc. It's equally likely to form a partnership with male or female members of the school.

entry: POKENAME用剑一般的尖牙，劈砍猎物与敌人。牙齿若无法取胜，它就会以角斩击，作最后一搏。
author: whiteupgrade
source: POKENAME uses the sword-like fangs to hack away at its prey and enemies. When it can't overcome someone with its fangs, it'll slash with its horn as a last attempt to defeat the enemy.

entry: POKENAME性情暴躁，身上多数部位又锋利，因此十分危险。它想指挥其他猴怪，但脾气太坏，很容易攻击自己的部下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's vicious temperament combined with the sharpness of most of its body makes it quite dangerous. It tries to lead other Mankey as a commander, but its temper means it is prone to attacking its own troops.

entry: POKENAME全身覆有锐刃，暴脾气十分危险。一旦失去冷静，最好远离，因为它会砍倒眼前一切。
author: santon5512
source: With razor-sharp blades covering their bodies, POKENAME's short temper can prove quite dangerous. When one of these Pokémon loses its cool, it is recommended that you steer clear, as it will cut down anything in sight.

entry: POKENAME用幻觉和诡计欺骗对手，再打击弱点。外表虽大多锋利危险，尾巴却十分柔软。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME makes use of illusions and trickery to deceive opponents before striking their weak point. Despite its generally sharp and dangerous exterior, POKENAME's tail is quite soft.

entry: 它用一对灌注了精神力量的短刀作战。只有打算一击结束战斗时，它的气场才会显现出来。
author: staghorn
source: It fights with a pair of psionically-charged knives. Its aura is only visible when it intends to end the battle with a single strike.

entry: 经常能在宝可梦安息的地方见到POKENAME。它极有同理心，会帮助训练家度过失去宝可梦的悲伤。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can often be found around places where Pokémon rest. As they are highly empathetic, they help Trainers grieve the loss of their Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME是忠诚尽责的士兵，会组成整支军队作战。它们合力守卫指挥官劈斩龟，但刀刃太重，很难主动进攻。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME are loyal and devoted soldiers, forming entire armies for battles. They work together to defend their commanding Bitoise, struggling to go on the offensive due to the weight of their blades.

entry: POKENAME的双臂如长枪，常在奇幻小说中担任军队的比武骑士。下半身让它跑得很快，还能喷火推进，增强突刺力量。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME often feature in fantasy novels as the jousting knights of armies due to their lance-like arms. Their lower bodies allow them to run at impressive speeds and they can emit bursts of fire to propel their thrusting attacks with greater force.

entry: POKENAME常召集一小队驹刀小兵听令。可惜三颗头的命令相互冲突，让部队混乱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME often amasses itself a small troop of Pawniard to follow its directions. Unfortunately, its three heads give out conflicting orders, causing confusion among its troop.

entry: POKENAME召集驹刀小兵与杰尼龟，组成小型追随者军队。士兵获胜时，它会从炮口喷水庆祝。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME amasses small armies of followers consisting of Pawniard and Squirtle. It fires water from its cannons as a celebratory act when its soldiers are victorious in their combat efforts.

entry: 发光双眼十分强大，即使全黑也能看得清清楚楚。它吃有毒树果，进一步强化背上的神秘种子。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its glowing eyes are so powerful that it can see perfectly even in complete darkness. It feeds on poisonous berries to further strengthen the mysterious seed growing on its back.

entry: POKENAME即将吐丝时，头上的黄触角会明亮发光。它将身体裹上密集电火花，驱赶飞行属性宝可梦，免受打扰。
author: fiordaliso
source: The yellow antenna on its head glows brightly whenever POKENAME is about to secrete silk from its mouth. To ward off Flying-type Pokémon, it coats its body in a dense layer of sparks to ensure it is left in peace.

entry: POKENAME将电力导入骨头，再以致命的精准度射出。飞行宝可梦常如遭炮击般被打落。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME channels electricity through its bone and fires it with deadly precision. Flying Pokémon are often struck down as if hit by a cannon.

entry: POKENAME以强力踢击命中对手时，脚底星纹会发光，表示满意。它是骄傲的斗士，不肯接受训练家拥抱或过度嬉闹。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME strikes an opponent with its mighty kicks, the stars on its soles glow, signaling its satisfaction. It is a very proud fighter that refuses cuddles or any overly playful behavior from its Trainer.

entry: POKENAME一用透视眼发现隐藏猎物，就立刻以额角钻穿墙壁。鬃毛不断汇集带电粒子，让它时刻准备释放最强电击。
author: fiordaliso
source: The instant it spots hidden prey using its X-ray vision, POKENAME bores through the wall with the horn on its forehead. Its mane continuously gathers electric particles, keeping it perpetually primed to unleash its most powerful electric strikes.

entry: POKENAME先用无形墙困住敌人，再在体内充电。出击前一刻才撤掉墙，确保攻击命中。
author: .izik
source: After entrapping a foe with invisible walls, POKENAME charges electricity within its body. It disables the walls just before unleashing its attack to ensure it hits the target.

entry: 与普遍看法相反，POKENAME的翅膀与刀刃并非纯电构成。细如丝的材料，让它既能疾如闪电，又能保持难以预测的攻势。
author: ghostslythe
source: Contrary to popular belief, POKENAME's wings and blades are not made of pure electricity. The filament-thin material ensures it can achieve lightning-fast speeds while maintaining an unpredictable attack pattern.

entry: POKENAME通常独居在通海冰洞，与世隔绝。背上的花岗岩壳储有大量电能，释放时会产生电火花与雷电，驱赶潜在攻击者。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME usually inhabits ice caves accessible by sea, leading a solitary and isolated life. The granite shell on its back stores vast amounts of electrical energy, which it releases to generate sparks and lightning to ward off potential attackers.

entry: POKENAME觉得身体状态不稳定，因此情绪多变。与同类相连，能让它恢复活力、心情转好。
author: princessmilandria
source: POKENAME feels physically unstable in its own skin, making it moody. Connecting with other POKENAME helps reinvigorate it and brighten its mood.

entry: 服务器管理员经常雇POKENAME防范电涌。大型公司通常会在系统内养好几只。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is frequently employed by server administrators to guard against power surges. Major corporations often maintain multiple within their systems.

entry: POKENAME发光的眼睛让它全黑也能看清，察觉危险，保持安全。受威胁时，蛇形身体会覆满电火花，不让其他生灵碰触。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its glowing eyes allow POKENAME to see perfectly even in total darkness, enabling it to detect danger and remain safe. Its serpentine body is covered in electrical sparks that prevent others from touching it when it feels threatened.

entry: 许多人相信POKENAME的情绪会影响天气，因此避免激怒它，免得招来可怕风暴。身上的珍珠能让它放出极高压电流。
author: fiordaliso
source: Many people believe that POKENAME's mood can influence the weather, so they avoid angering it to prevent the onset of terrible storms. The pearls on its body allow it to release extremely high-voltage electrical discharges.

entry: POKENAME飞过海洋，寻找能吸取电力的雷云。充满电后，它能整整一周不落地，以惊人的速度划过天空。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME soars over the ocean in search of storm clouds from which it can absorb electrical energy. Once fully charged, it can fly for an entire week without needing to land, streaking through the sky at incredible speeds.

entry: POKENAME健康时，鬃毛浓密，不断噼啪闪着电火花。它会主动飞进海上雷云，从雷电中吸收新的能量。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it is in good health, POKENAME's mane is thick and constantly crackling with electrical sparks. It willingly flies into storm clouds above the sea to absorb fresh energy from lightning.

entry: POKENAME始终警觉，领地稍受扰动就立刻反应。巨刺会带上电，打出强力毒击，将入侵者逼退。
author: fiordaliso
source: Always alert, POKENAME reacts the moment its territory is disturbed. Its massive quills become electrically charged, allowing it to deliver forceful, poisonous blows that drive intruders back.

entry: POKENAME用强大精神力塑造、控制电光来战斗。虽然偏爱远攻，身体肌肉也足够强健，能施展威力惊人的近身重击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME fight using electrical bolts that they shape and control using their powerful psychic abilities. Though they prefer to fight from range, their bodies pack enough muscle to deliver devastating physical strikes as well.

entry: POKENAME累了，就用精神力造出星形泡泡，躺在上面休息。它爱捉弄其他宝可梦，用长尾尖的电火花电它们。
author: fiordaliso
source: Using its psychic powers, POKENAME generates star-shaped bubbles to rest upon whenever it grows tired. It loves playing tricks on other Pokémon, zapping them with electric sparks from the tip of its long tail.

entry: POKENAME附肢流出的电有神奇力量，能让死去的植物复生。眼泛金光时，能透视物体，借此找到森林枯败处，前去修复。
author: foolish_weasel
source: The electricity that flows out from POKENAME's appendages has the miraculous power to revive dead plants. When its eyes glow gold it is able to see through objects, which it uses to find blighted parts of the forest to mend.

entry: POKENAME能用透视视力与热感视力捕猎，放出的电力强得几乎能点燃任何东西。
author: rakanadyo
source: POKENAME can use both X-ray and thermal vision to hunt prey. It can fire electricity with enough force to set almost anything ablaze.

entry: 发亮的眼睛不放过一丝动静，谁靠巢太近，都会立刻发现。为驱逐入侵者，它会给巨大毒刺充电，准备猛烈突刺。
author: fiordaliso
source: With its gleaming eyes, it never misses a single movement, quickly detecting anyone who ventures too close to its nest. To drive intruders away, it charges its massive poisonous quills with electricity and prepares to strike with blasting thrusts.

entry: 遇到比自己更好斗、更强的飞行宝可梦，POKENAME会从喙与翅膀放出火花，求个清静。它倾向在地面筑巢，用灌木间找到的树枝与石头建家。
author: fiordaliso
source: When encountering Flying Pokémon that are more aggressive and powerful than itself, POKENAME emits sparks from its beak and wings to be left alone. It tends to nest on the ground, building its home with twigs and stones found in bushes.

entry: 透视视力让它能找到藏在地下或树中的猎物，是出色的捕猎者。准备攻击时，爪和喙会带电，开始噼啪闪火花。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its X-ray vision allows it to find prey hiding underground or in trees, making it an exceptional predator. When it prepares to attack, its claws and beak become charged with electricity and begin to emit crackling sparks.

entry: POKENAME体内电能太多，一不高兴，就可能让半径10米内所有电子设备短路。它受不了别人碰脸颊。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME has so much electrical energy in its body that whenever it gets upset, it risks short-circuiting all electronic devices within a 10-meter radius. It can't stand anyone touching its cheeks.

entry: 身体轻如羽毛，它在森林里蹦跳，每跳一下，尾星就闪一次光。POKENAME常陪伴怕黑的宝可梦，以柔光安慰它们。
author: fiordaliso
source: It hops through forests on its feather-light body, its tail star flickering with light every time it bounces. POKENAME often keeps company with Pokémon that are afraid of the dark, offering them comfort through the gentle glow it emits.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，发现入侵者就以可怕电击攻击。大翅膀让它能连续飞数天，连恶劣雷云也能穿过。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is incredibly territorial, and if it spots an intruder, it attacks with terrifying electric attacks. Thanks to its large wings, it can fly for days on end, even through terrible storm clouds.

entry: POKENAME从废工厂设备收集电线，在维修储物间一动不动地站着，希望有人进来也别注意自己。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME collects electrical wires from abandoned factory equipment. It stands completely still in maintenance closets, hoping to be ignored when someone enters.

entry: POKENAME凭凶猛的领袖魅力指挥小拉达群，袭击粮仓，囤积食物。眼泛金光，表示正在用透视视力扫视墙壁。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME commands colonies of Rattata with its fierce charisma, leading raids on granaries to hoard food. When its eyes glow a golden light, it means it is scanning a wall with its X-ray vision.

entry: 它间歇闪动尾星，与同群成员沟通，协调捕猎。POKENAME在人类身边行踪难觅，连递来的食物也不接受。
author: fiordaliso
source: It communicates with other members of its group by flashing the star on its tail intermittently, coordinating hunting trips. POKENAME  is so elusive around humans that it even refuses food offered to it.

entry: POKENAME背上的种子已开始展开，露出发光的花苞，尚未完全盛放。球茎散出的能量会增强毒粉，也像发电机一样强化电属性攻击。
author: fiordaliso
source: The seed on POKENAME's back has begun to open, revealing the bud of a glowing flower not yet ready to fully bloom. The energy radiating from the bulb enhances its poisonous powders and also acts as a generator to boost its Electric-type attacks.

entry: POKENAME挑衅其他宝可梦打自己，受到的打击会为体内储存的电充能。随后全身裹上雷电，以爆发力惊人的身体冲撞，将遭受的攻击十倍奉还。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME taunts other Pokémon to strike it, the blows it receives charging up its internal stores of electricity. It then returns all the abuse it suffered back tenfold with an explosively powerful body slam while coating itself in lightning.

entry: POKENAME电力强，充电后速度与视力都会提升。它举止冷静威严，尾上的头却不守规矩，容易向附近一切放电。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses strong electrical abilities that enhance its speed and eyesight when charged up. It has a calm and regal demeanor, but the head on its tail is unruly and prone to discharging lightning at anything near it.

entry: POKENAME虽然总板着脸，却深爱自己的训练家。它会用透视能力时时刻刻注视着对方。
author: mistymagius
source: Despite its permanent scowl, POKENAME deeply loves its Trainer. It will use its x-ray vision to watch its Trainer at all moments of the day.

entry: POKENAME野心过盛，性情凶狠，常挑战更大的对手。它将败敌的牙挂在颈边作战利品，牙挂得越多，同类间地位就越高。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is an overambitious Pokémon that is very vicious and often takes on larger opponents. It wears the teeth of any foes it has defeated around its neck as trophies. Individuals wearing more teeth have a higher status amongst their kind.

entry: 它会扑向猎物，用带电的爪子与角将其麻痹。见什么都爱打上一架，兴奋不起来时，甚至会电自己一下。
author: frokachu
source: It pounces on prey, paralyzing them with electric claws and horns. They like picking fights with almost anything, and will even shock itself to get excited.

entry: 这种自鸣得意的宝可梦跑得极快，甚至超过城都的磁浮列车。兴奋时，羽毛会闪起电火花。
author: chibitales
source: This smug Pokémon is able to run at high speeds, surpassing even Johto's Magnet Train. Its feathers spark with electricity when it gets excited.

entry: POKENAME会设法挨雷劈，将电储在毛中。充满后，皮毛会散发蜂蜜般的香气。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME tries to get struck by lightning to store charge in its fur. When fully charged, the fur releases a honey-like scent.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛始终带电，帮助它借这颗星球的磁场飞行。能见它们在空中交锋，为领地而战，电火花四溅。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME's feathers carry a constant electrical charge, helping them to fly through riding the planet's magnetic field. They can be seen clashing with one another in the sky, sparking as they battle for territory.

entry: POKENAME能可靠地射中一公里内的敌人。发光双眼能看穿许多障碍，并据此调整射击轨迹。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can reliably shoot at foes up to a kilometer away. It can see through many obstacles because of its glowing eyes and changes the trajectory of its shots accordingly.

entry: 它让尾尖发光，警告入侵者远离领地。毒牙含有强毒，不到一分钟就能麻痹神经系统。
author: fiordaliso
source: It makes the tip of its tail glow to warn intruders away from its territory. Its fangs contain a potent venom that paralyzes the nervous system in under a minute.

entry: POKENAME在地面滚动时，体内会产生电力。速度快得足以轻易撞破巨石。
author: .izik
source: While rolling through the landscape, POKENAME generates electrical power in its body. It can roll with enough speed to break through boulders with ease.

entry: POKENAME用透视视力，找出哪个抽屉放着想吃的U盘。紧张时，星形尾巴会间歇闪光，身上迸出电火花。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME uses its X-ray vision to find out which drawers contain the USB sticks it craves. When it is nervous, its star-shaped tail flashes intermittently, and sparks fly from its body.

entry: 哪怕轻轻一碰，也会放出一阵雷电。因此，POKENAME住在水下建筑深处，免得力量危及周围。
author: lootererswillbeboated
source: Even a light tap releases a burst of lightning. As such, POKENAME dwells deep in an underwater structure so as not to endanger its surroundings with its power.

entry: 唯有凝视饱受折磨的灵魂，才能让它感到快乐。有人认为，POKENAME会模仿故事中的某些角色，从中汲取力量。
author: degla
source: It only feels joy when staring deep into a suffering soul. Some believe POKENAME draws power by mimicking certain characters in stories.

entry: 它跑得比声速还快，速度几乎无人能及，性格又很爱挖苦。明知其他生灵毫无胜算，还会挑战它们赛跑。
author: mistymagius
source: Its speed is almost unmatched as it is able to run faster than the speed of sound. It's a very snarky Pokémon. It challenges others to race it, knowing they have no chance of winning.

entry: 火焰与电力在臂炮中合而为一。带电火球击中时，会以毁灭性的力量爆炸。
author: infinex21
source: Flame and electricity come together as one within its arm cannon. Its electrified fireballs explode with destructive force on impact.

entry: 野生POKENAME几乎总保持球形。研究者认为，它在锻炼特殊双眼，让自己即使蜷起，也能看透一切。
author: h0bojoe
source: Wild POKENAME are found almost exclusively in their ball form. Researchers believe it is their way of training their special eyes to see through everything, even while curled up.

entry: POKENAME蓄力准备强攻时，眼睛明亮发光，却因此看不见，完全打偏。它若决定小睡，所在的计算机系统也会睡眠，直到它醒来才唤得醒。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's eyes gleam brightly when charging up a powerful attack, but that causes it to become blind and miss its target entirely. If it decides to take a nap, any computer system it's inside of also sleeps and can't be awoken until it also awakens.

entry: 强大视力让它能直接看穿丛林茂密的灌木。一发现猎物，POKENAME就跃出，用带电刀刃抓斩。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Its eyes are so strong that it can see right through the thick undergrowth of the jungle. Once it has spotted its prey, POKENAME will leap out from the brush, swiping out with its electrically charged blades.

entry: 即使滚动，金色双眼也能在微秒间分析完周围。因此，满刺的球形态极其危险，暴怒时尤其如此。
author: h0bojoe
source: Its golden eyes can fully analyze its surroundings within microseconds, even while rolling. This makes its spiny ball form exceedingly dangerous, especially when it's enraged.

entry: POKENAME是凶猛的近战斗士，双腿覆电，踢击更具威力。它自尊极强，一场败仗就可能让它极度消沉，几天不肯吃东西。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a fierce brawler that coats its legs in electric discharges, making its kicks all the more devastating. It is so proud that losing a battle can send it into a depression so deep it refuses to eat for days.

entry: 谁哪怕只是不怀好意地看训练家一眼，POKENAME都会以精神力强化的电力立刻电击。尽管如此，柔软皮毛仍让它很受年轻训练家欢迎。
author: elekboy88
