source: POKENAME uses psychically enhanced electricity to instantly zap anyone who so much as even looks at its Trainer the wrong way. Despite this, they are popular among younger Trainers for their soft fur.

entry: POKENAME将电力集中双臂，造出能完全穿墙的电刃，切向猎物。感应到敌人正想攻击时，双眼便泛金光。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME focuses its electricity into its arms, it creates electric blades that can phase completely through walls and slice at prey. Its eyes glow gold when it senses thoughts of a foe readying to attack.

entry: POKENAME每次攻击，都放出穿透任何防御的电流，直接伤害击中对象。它用尖锐肘刃钻穿猎物躲藏的墙，打击藏身其中的目标。
author: soup1900
source: Whenever POKENAME attacks, it sends out a burst of electricity that cuts through any defense, dealing direct damage to the foe it hits. Using its sharp elbow blades, it strikes prey taking shelter by boring through any wall they hide behind.

entry: 谁碰POKENAME的胡须，就会遭电击。黑毛中长出的尖刺充满毒，能阻吓威胁。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME shocks anyone who touches its whiskers. The spikes emerging from its black fur are filled with toxins that keep threats at bay.

entry: POKENAME的伪装能完美掩住全身，只有金眼睛藏不住。在丛林看见一对飘浮眼睛，无须害怕；真被它盯上的对象，早已被麻痹了。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's camouflage hides every part of its body perfectly, aside from its gold eyes. Those who spot a pair of floating eyes in the jungle need not fear; anyone POKENAME had set its sights on would already have been paralyzed.

entry: POKENAME看似平静，却极力保护毕生修筑的坝。它能给巨牙充电，电得敌人久久难忘。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite its calm appearance, POKENAME is fiercely protective of the dam it spends its life building. It can charge its massive teeth with electricity, delivering shocks to its enemies they won't soon forget.

entry: 雷击打碎封印，使构成POKENAME的恶灵脱困。它游荡天际，总伴着雷鸣，制造猛烈风暴，向人类复仇。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME was freed from its imprisonment when a lightning strike shattered the seal containing the malevolent spirits that compose it. It roams the skies, always accompanied by the roar of thunder, creating violent storms to take revenge on humans.

entry: 进化后，POKENAME背花完全盛放，释放真正力量。准备电属性攻击时，花瓣亮如太阳，吓退敢闯领地的敌人。
author: fiordaliso
source: With its evolution, POKENAME has fully bloomed the flower on its back, unlocking its true power. When preparing Electric-type attacks, its petals shine with the intensity of the sun, frightening any foe that dares trespass its territory.

entry: 以后腿站立，表示即将放出雷鸣般的强电击。POKENAME外表虽凶，对家人却很温柔，一生忠诚。
author: fiordaliso
source: When it stands on its hind legs, it is about to unleash a thunderous lightning strike. Despite its fierce look, POKENAME is very gentle with its family and stays loyal for life.

entry: POKENAME视力强，在漆黑海沟也看得清。它以汹涌的生物电脉冲电击、捕食猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's powerful eyesight lets it see well even in the pitch-black conditions of ocean trenches. It uses surging bursts of bio-electricity to shock and hunt its prey.

entry: 许多人以为POKENAME头上一簇毛蓬松，伸手去摸，却困惑地发现硬如钢铁。
author: retrodox
source: Many pet POKENAME's tuft of fur on its head, thinking it is fluffy.They are then confused to find its fur hard as steel.

entry: POKENAME的颚与耳朵通常会定期清理，防止坚硬岩石生长，保持底毛柔软蓬松。岩石长回很快，因此也能在身体上雕出独特花纹。
author: retrodox
source: POKENAME's jaw and ears are typically cleaned regularly to prevent tough rock from growing on them, keeping its underfur soft and fuzzy to the touch. Its body can be carved to create unique patterns, as the rock grows back quickly.

entry: POKENAME视力差，靠其他感官捕猎，包括探测其他宝可梦产生的电场。它用强臂抓住猎物，再将带电牙齿深深咬入。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME have poor eyesight, relying on their other senses to hunt, including their ability to detect electrical fields produced by other Pokémon. After grabbing prey with their strong arms, they sink in with their electrically charged fangs.

entry: POKENAME覆有极细的毛，宝可梦研究者已确定由石墨烯构成。毛导电性强，重拳打中敌人时，能同时施加强力电击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are coated in very fine fur that Pokémon Researchers have been able to determine is made of graphene. Their fur is highly conductive and they can deliver powerful electric shocks by landing heavy punches on their foes.

entry: 尾巴肌肉强健，猛砸地面就能产生电击。POKENAME每天产生的电，足以供一座城市使用数周。
author: fiordaliso
source: The muscles in its tail are strong enough to create shocks when slammed against the ground. The electricity POKENAME generates daily could power a city for weeks.

entry: POKENAME感知到飓风将至，就向天空射出雷电。这番景象能让其他生灵赶在风暴来袭前逃走。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME senses an incoming hurricane, it fires lightning bolts into the sky. This display gives others time to flee before the storm hits.

entry: POKENAME毛茸茸的身体完全中空，充满电力。它从双手放出电击，制服敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's furry body is completely hollow and filled with electricity. It unleashes blasts of electricity from its hands to subdue foes.

entry: POKENAME若觉得没受够尊崇，就向周围降下1,000道雷电。唯一有记录的安抚方法，是所有附近的旁观者一齐鞠躬。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME feels insufficiently revered, it unleashes 1,000 bolts of lightning across the surrounding area. The only recorded way to calm it is for all nearby observers to bow in unison.

entry: POKENAME覆有极细的毛，宝可梦研究者已确定由石墨烯构成。看见对手，毛上就会缠绕电光，准备战斗。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are coated in very fine fur that Pokémon Researchers have been able to determine is made of graphene. When they spy a rival, their fur becomes wreathed in electricity in readiness for battle.

entry: POKENAME住在山巅，学会利用吸收的雷霆之力强化武术，以疾风般的连击攻击敌人。尾巴越亮，战意就越高。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME has learned to harness the power of thunder absorbed atop the mountain peaks where it lives to enhance its martial arts. It attacks by unleashing a flurry of strikes on its foes. The brighter its tail shines, the more ready it is to fight.

entry: POKENAME在风暴笼罩的山巅冥想，将雷电引入体内，增强打击。据说尾巴亮如太阳时，就是力量的巅峰。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME meditates atop stormy peaks, drawing lightning into its body to empower its strikes. When its tail burns bright like the sun, it's said to be at the peak of its strength.

entry: POKENAME追逐目标时，刀刃一闪，便能感知对方的灵魂。连隔着墙的灵魂，也逃不过感应。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: When POKENAME's blade glimmers whilst pursuing a victim, it can sense their spirit. It can even sense spirits through walls.

entry: POKENAME携带的盾由黄金构成，能传导大量能量。能量集中在盾缘，让防守真正无懈可击。
author: turcai_87271
source: The shield carried by POKENAME is made up of gold and is able to conduct large amounts of energy. This energy is concentrated around the edges, allowing it to be truly impenetrable.

entry: POKENAME一发现可能挑战自己领地地位的宝可梦，尖刺就会噼啪带电。它迎头冲向威胁，试图用锐角刺穿。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME spines crackle with electricity whenever they spy a Pokémon they believe could challenge them for their position in their territory. They charge headfirst at threats, aiming to spear them with their sharp horn.

entry: POKENAME积聚的静电太多，碰一下就足以将人电得仰倒。它用尾巴吓退对手，也逗小猫怪玩。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME build up so much static that a touch is enough to knock a human onto their back. They use their tail to scare away opponents and entertain Shinx.

entry: POKENAME爱吃磁性矿物与带电晶体。双眼能看穿多层坚岩，放电时，全身金属都会明亮发光。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME love to feast upon magnetic minerals and galvanic crystals. Their eyes are capable of seeing through multiple layers of solid rock. The metal across their bodies glows brightly whenever they discharge electricity.

entry: 雷暴时，POKENAME在沙漠潜行，尾巴常引来雷击，全身电流涌动。眼膜能保护双眼，免受碎屑和雷光等强光伤害。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME stalk deserts during lightning storms, their tails often catching lightning and their bodies surging with electricity. Their ocular membranes protect their eyes from debris and from bright flashes of light, such as from lightning.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，威风的鬃毛噼啪迸出强电，并造出风暴幻象，威吓其他生灵。眼睛能看穿任何幻景，远距离追踪猎物。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's impressive mane crackles with intense electricity during battle and creates illusions of storms to intimidate others. Their eyes can see through any mirage or illusion and track their prey across great distances.

entry: 雷暴中，缎带能吸收雷电残余能量，强化POKENAME身体。它放出的电脉冲能减缓准备袭击者的心跳，让战斗尚未开始便结束。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its ribbons can absorb residual energy from lightning during thunderstorms, making POKENAME's body stronger. It releases electrical pulses that can slow the heartbeats of Pokémon about to attack it, ending battles before they even begin.

entry: POKENAME吼声能传出数英里，咆哮时，电流在毛间起伏。它借此警告体形相近的宝可梦，远离领地。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME roars can carry for several miles, their fur rippling with electricity whenever they bellow. They put on these displays to signal to other similarly sized Pokémon to stay away from their territory.

entry: 传说POKENAME会在风暴夜潜入睡梦，将其变成可怕噩梦。另有人却称，它的吼声能挡住暴风雨，让所有人安然入梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: Legends say that POKENAME appears on stormy nights to slip into the dreams of sleeping people and turn them into terrifying nightmares. Others claim instead that its roars keep tempests at bay and ensure peaceful dreams for all.

entry: POKENAME高高跃入雷云吸电。炮口射出的雷电有时击中后会反弹，撞上附近建筑，偶尔甚至打中自己。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaps high into thunderclouds to absorb electrical energy. The lightning it fires from its cannon sometimes rebounds after striking, colliding with nearby structures or on rare occasions even itself.

entry: 过去数个世纪，POKENAME曾帮助合众科学家理解电的运作。它们高飘天空，享受雷雨，身体产生的负电荷会吸引雷击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME helped Unovan scientists in past centuries understand how electricity functions. They float high in the sky, enjoying thunderstorms - their bodies create a negative charge that draws lightning toward them.

entry: POKENAME每个动作都会吸收空气中的静电，增强攻击。狩猎时，它能看见电流，借此追踪猎物，再以电击使其瘫痪。
author: ghostslythe
source: Each movement of POKENAME absorbs ambient static electricity from the air, powering up its attacks. When it hunts, it uses its ability to see electrical currents to track down prey before delivering a crippling shock.

entry: POKENAME先放出幽灵能量，让敌人不适，再发动攻击。电力强得足以使对手麻痹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME unleashes ghostly energy to make foes feel sick before it attacks. Its electrical charge is strong enough to paralyze opponents.

entry: POKENAME的灯泡亮得能照明整座房屋。但用得太多会破裂，只得等它们重新长出来。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's bulbs can glow bright enough to fully illuminate an entire house. However, the bulbs can break if POKENAME uses them too much, causing it to wait for them to grow back.

entry: 它通过长牙吸收雷电，每场雷雨都会更强，为此十分自豪。咬击与斩击的力量，连山脊也能震碎。
author: beatdoof
source: It absorbs lightning through its tusks, causing it to grow stronger through each thunderstorm, of which it is very proud. Its bites and slashes, in turn, are powerful enough to shatter even a mountain ridge.

entry: POKENAME是出色而领地意识极强的猎手，连同类也会被它无情赶走。它通常先用强电击让猎物晕眩，再挥动强大翅膀猛扑。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is an exceptional and fiercely territorial predator, known to drive away even members of its own species with ruthless aggression. It typically stuns its prey with powerful electric shocks before lunging at them with its mighty wings.

entry: POKENAME极忠于训练家，总为胜利全力作战。它以翅膀掀起强龙卷风，再配上雷电或火焰，强化威力。
author: sk372
source: Fiercely loyal to its Trainer, POKENAME always battles at full capacity for the sake of their victory. It whips up powerful tornadoes with its wings, before lighting them up with lightning or flame for enhanced effect.

entry: POKENAME三颗头能同时面向不同方向。金眼睛能看穿实物，几乎无法悄悄接近。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's three heads can face in multiple directions at the same time. Since its golden eyes can see through solid objects, it is almost impossible to sneak up on.

entry: POKENAME过度活跃，似乎是体内产电太多的缘故。一举一动都有电火花跟随，靠近很危险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's hyperactive nature seems to be due to an excess of electrical energy production in its body. Sparks of electricity follow its every motion, making it dangerous to get close.

entry: POKENAME像家族中的成体一样自信又好斗，因此常向自己打不赢的对手挑衅。不过，它冲撞敌人时仍能释放出威力不俗的电击。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME tend to have the confidence and eagerness of the adults in its family, and because of this it picks fights it can't win. It can still pack a decent shock when charging into something though.

entry: 小猫怪天生受这种宝可梦吸引，常模仿每个动作，再鲁莽也照做。POKENAME极以鬃毛为傲，谁敢未经许可触摸，就会被带电牙齿咬。
author: fiordaliso
source: Shinx are naturally drawn to this Pokémon, often mimicking its every move, however reckless. POKENAME is so proud of its mane that it will use its electrified teeth to bite anyone who dares touch it without permission.

entry: POKENAME背覆坚硬甲片，能在雷雨中吸收电能。视力完美，即使最黑暗的洞窟，也能找到移动的猎物。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's back is covered in tough plates capable of absorbing electrical energy during thunderstorms. Its perfect eyesight allows it to locate moving prey even in the darkest caves.

entry: POKENAME虽小，已能放出强力电属性攻击，还会利用体内剩余能量，更好地控制火焰。尾星越明亮，身体就越健康。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite its small size, POKENAME can already unleash powerful Electric-type attacks and uses the residual energy in its body to better control its flames. The brighter the star on its tail, the healthier it is.

entry: 头上皮毛柔软华美得难以置信，让许多人盯上它。但POKENAME视力极佳，数英里外就能察觉威胁，几乎总能躲过觊觎皮毛的人。
author: empty_set
source: It is targeted by many for the unbelievably soft and luxurious fur growing on its head.  However, since its excellent vision allows it to perceive threats from miles away, POKENAME almost always evades those hoping to get their hands on its fur.

entry: POKENAME的长牙是巨大的能量储备，为透视视力、从眼中发射生物电等多种本领供能。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME's tusks act as a massive energy reserve, powering its multiple abilities such as X‑ray vision and bioelectric optic blasts.

entry: 准备咬敌人时，可怕利牙会泛起强烈黄光。POKENAME独居好斗，连同类也会交战，争夺栖居洞窟的主导权。
author: fiordaliso
source: When preparing to bite its foe, its terrifying fangs glow with a fierce yellow light. POKENAME is a solitary and aggressive creature that even battles members of its own species to claim dominance over the cave it inhabits.

entry: POKENAME大半生都在洞窟深处找宝石吃。金色双眼不仅让它黑暗中也看得完美，还能透过坚岩，发现矿脉与宝石。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME spends most of its life searching the depths of caves for gems to feed on. Its golden eyes not only grant it perfect vision in the darkness, but also allow it to detect mineral veins and precious stones through solid rock.

entry: POKENAME既分泌致命毒素，也储存大量电力。战斗时放出强电，压制、麻痹敌人的神经系统。愤怒时，尾巴的光会变紫。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body secretes deadly toxins while also storing vast amounts of electricity. In battle, it releases surges that overwhelm and paralyze the nervous systems of foes. When angered, the light radiating from its tails takes on a violet hue.

entry: POKENAME既能产毒，也能发电，通过锯齿状尖刺将两者结合。形成的冲击令人畏惧，对方还没来得及喊，神经就已停止运作。
author: fiordaliso
source: Capable of generating toxin and voltage alike, POKENAME binds the two through its jagged spines. The resulting surge is feared for shutting down nerves before a cry can even be made.

entry: 传说POKENAME诞生于风暴夜失踪女性的悲伤。它将能量导入金色星形武器，放出强力电击。它既优雅，也同样好斗。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to legend, POKENAME was born from the sorrow of women who vanished during stormy nights. It can unleash powerful electric strikes by channeling energy into the golden stars it wields as weapons. It is as aggressive as it is elegant.

entry: 它用透视视力，看穿深海沉船的船体。发现里面的猎物，就以惊人速度冲去，直接撞穿所有挡路墙壁。
author: kiwiarms
source: It uses its x-ray vision to see right through the hulls of shipwrecks deep in the ocean. When it spots prey inside, it shoots towards them with incredible speed, punching straight through any walls in the way.

entry: POKENAME在风暴夜飞翔。眼睛能看穿任何云层与黑暗，在恶劣天气中发现猎物。
author: geo_ominous
source: POKENAME fly through the air on stormy nights. Their eyes can pierce any cloud or darkness, allowing them to spot their prey in the rough weather.

entry: 为保护幼崽，POKENAME会排出大量麻痹孢子，让天敌无法行动。没有威胁时，它会陪小猫怪玩，常让它们在花瓣上蹦跳。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: To protect their young, POKENAME will expel large amounts of paralyzing spores to incapacitate their predators. When no threats are present, POKENAME play with Shinx, often having them bounce on POKENAME's petals.

entry: POKENAME之间的战斗场面极大，产生的电太多，能引来雷云。它只一击，就能使训练家麻痹。
author: mistymagius
source: Fights between POKENAME are massive spectacles, as the sheer amount of electricity produced during the fight draws in thunderclouds. A single blow from POKENAME can leave a Trainer paralyzed.

entry: POKENAME会整夜尾随猎物，直到对方筋疲力尽。随后猛扑而上，用尖刺产生的电流发动攻击。
author: riverbandage
source: POKENAME stalks its prey throughout the night until it is exhausted. When it pounces, it attacks using electricity produced by its thorns.

entry: 惊人的视力与速度，让猎物无从躲避。鬃毛中的石头锐利带电，彼此间会产生电弧。
author: sylia
source: Their incredible eyesight and speed make them unavoidable for their prey. The rocks in their mane are sharp and charged with electricity, generating electric arcs between them.

entry: POKENAME是夜行猎手，靠蛮力压倒猎物。嚎叫时，会让岩石鬃毛裹上电火花，准备战斗。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a nocturnal predator that uses its sheer brute strength to overpower its victims. By howling, it cloaks its rocky mane in electric sparks as it prepares for battle.

entry: POKENAME发怒时，能增强自身磁场，使周围岩石悬浮。它将石爪覆上噼啪电火花，让打击更具破坏力。
author: fiordaliso
source: When angered, POKENAME can make the rocks around it levitate by intensifying the magnetic field generated by its body. It coats its stone claws with crackling electric sparks to make its blows even more devastating.

entry: POKENAME发怒时，能增强自身磁场，使周围岩石悬浮。它将石爪覆上噼啪电火花，让打击更具破坏力。
author: fiordaliso
source: When angered, POKENAME can make the rocks around it levitate by intensifying the magnetic field generated by its body. It coats its stone claws with crackling electric sparks to make its blows even more devastating.

entry: POKENAME是夜行猎手，靠蛮力压倒猎物。嚎叫时，会让岩石鬃毛裹上电火花，准备战斗。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a nocturnal predator that uses its sheer brute strength to overpower its victims. By howling, it cloaks its rocky mane in electric sparks as it prepares for battle.

entry: 出于对音乐的热爱，POKENAME不断苦练，将天赋磨炼得炉火纯青。它的歌唱技艺已臻化境，出众的嗓音令世界各地无数人倾倒。
author: voxary
source: POKENAME's innate musical talent was honed and perfected through its non-stop training and love for music. It has become an apex of singing talent, and many worldwide admire POKENAME's dazzling voice.

entry: POKENAME巨大的身体覆有浓密毛发，能储存大量电力。它统治筑巢的海岸，以可怕利爪施展致命攻击，摧毁敌人。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's massive body is covered in thick fur capable of storing vast amounts of electricity. It rules the seaside shores where it makes its den, destroying its foes with lethal strikes from its terrible claws.

entry: POKENAME巨大的叶状镰刀噼啪带电。它凶猛守巢，击打入侵者时放出阵阵火花。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's large, leaf-like scythes crackle with electricity. It defends its nest fiercely, releasing bursts of sparks when striking intruders.

entry: POKENAME的水晶充满电，亮如灯泡。它们群居地下洞窟，将四周照得如同白昼。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's crystals are charged with electricity which makes them glow as bright as a lightbulb. Colonies of POKENAME live in underground caves, illuminating the area as bright as day.

entry: POKENAME目光能穿透墙壁，发现目标。它如忍者般优雅潜入对手藏身处，从阴影中以猛烈雷电出击。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME has a penetrating gaze that helps it spot its targets through walls. It infiltrates where its opponents are hiding with a ninja's grace, striking from the shadows with furious lightning.

entry: POKENAME在深夜追逐人类，夺取灵魂。很难躲开它，因为眼睛能看穿坚实墙壁。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME chases humans in the dead of night to claim their souls. It is difficult to hide from it, as its eyes can see through solid walls.

entry: 尾星始终被火焰包裹，它已学会像操控电属性攻击一样熟练控火。POKENAME领地意识极强，全力驱敌，竖起鬃毛威吓。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its tail's star is constantly engulfed in flames, which it has learned to control with the same skill as its Electric-type attacks. POKENAME is extremely territorial, driving away foes with all its energy and intimidating them by bristling its mane.

entry: 它对空气变化极其敏感，连视线远处看不到的动静也能感知。因此，人们误以为它能看穿任何东西。
author: archserpent
source: It's so sensitive to changes in the air that it can even sense the movement of things well out of its sight. This is why people mistakenly believe that it can see through anything.

entry: POKENAME极忠于训练家，保护欲强。见到陌生对象，第一反应是挡在训练家身前，让电流流过皮毛，摆出威吓架势。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is fiercely loyal to its Trainer and highly protective. Its first instinct upon meeting anyone new is to stand in front of its Trainer and course electricity through its fur as an intimidation display.

entry: POKENAME常被用作凶猛守卫，保护发电厂。即将从嘴里喷火时，尾星会泛红。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is usually employed as a fierce guard to protect power plants. The star on its tail glows red when it is about to breathe flames from its mouth.

entry: POKENAME以强健双翼飞过群山，击败同类对手，占据领地。据说全力交战时，天空会风暴大作，雷鸣般的吼声远处也能听见。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME soars across mountain skies on its powerful wings, claiming territory by defeating rivals of its own kind. It is said that when it fights at full strength, the sky turns stormy, and its thunderous roars can be heard from afar.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强。有时很难分清雷声来自酝酿的风暴，还是它们之间的战斗。
author: archserpent
source: POKENAME are incredibly territorial. It can be hard to tell whether the sound of thunder is from a brewing storm or a battle between these Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME双眼明亮，即使夜里也守望池塘。战斗将至，胸前星纹明亮发光，可怕的白拳迸出噼啪能量。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME keeps watch over its pond even at night with its radiant eyes. When battle approaches, the star on its chest shines brightly and its menacing white fists spark with crackling energy.

entry: POKENAME用精神力将大量电能压缩进随身勺子。感到威胁，就一次解除压缩，放出灼眼强光。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME use their psychic powers to compress vast amounts of electrical energy into the spoons they carry with them. When they feel threatened, they release the compression all at once, creating a searingly bright burst of light.

entry: 人们推测，POKENAME能看透物质与心灵。它能用纯光创造物品，自如地操纵；据说凝视它的手杖，还能看穿实体。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are theorized to see anything physically and mentally. It can create objects out of pure light that it controls freely. Staring into its staff is said to allow you to see through physical matter.

entry: 有时能见到POKENAME带领宝可梦乐队，通常出现在伽勒尔道馆对战等气氛热烈的活动。它用尾巴扩音，让听众热血沸腾。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are sometimes found leading Pokémon bands, usually at high-energy events such as Galarian gym battles. They use their tail to amplify their voice, causing all who hear to feel a rush of adrenaline.

entry: POKENAME随着年龄增长能强化视力，但得经历刺痛自己眼睛的痛苦过程。由此触发的愈合，最终会增强视力。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME can strengthen their vision as they get older, but to do so it involves the painful process of stinging their own eyes. This triggers a healing process that ends up with their vision being enhanced.

entry: POKENAME随着年龄增长能强化视力，但得经历刺痛自己眼睛的痛苦过程。记录中，有个体能在水下察觉1公里以外的动静。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME can strengthen their vision as they get older, but to do so it involves the painful process of stinging their own eyes. There have been records of some POKENAME being able to detect movement over 1km away underwater.

entry: POKENAME能看穿墙，发现可能袭击幼崽的天敌。它们大群生活，由首领保护。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME can see through walls, which helps it spot predators that may attack its young. They live in large groups, protected by an alpha.

entry: POKENAME凭锐利视力，从深水中伏击猎物。坚壳能抵御那些强到有力反击的猎物。
author: bigblue
source: POKENAME ambushes its prey from deep below water using its piercing eyesight. Its sturdy shell protects it from any prey strong enough to fight back.

entry: POKENAME多颗头很少同时睡觉，尤其透视实物的能力十分耗能。轮流睡眠，让它一天中任何时候都能可靠地使用透视视力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's many heads rarely sleep at the same time, especially since using its ability to see through solid objects takes so much energy. By sleeping in shifts, it can reliably use its X-ray vision at any time of day.

entry: POKENAME背上的炮能以惊人力量发射水流与电力，再配上无与伦比的视力，战斗中几乎势不可挡。
author: bigblue
source: The cannons on POKENAME's back are capable of firing blasts of water and electricity with incredible force. Combined with its unrivaled eyesight, it is nearly unstoppable in battle.

entry: 吃梦时，它的眼睛会变色。若梦让POKENAME格外饱足，就会变成鲜明而空灵的颜色。
author: bobosmith01
source: When it eats dreams, its eyes change colors. If a dream is particularly filling to POKENAME, they change into vivid, ethereal colors.

entry: 两根角比钢硬，分泌令人疼痛的毒。它用朝前的角刮食金属与矿石，让角长得更长、更强。毒液即使微量，也能腐蚀某些金属。
author: infinex21
source: Its two horns are harder than steel and secrete a painful venom. It uses the front-facing horn to scrape away at metals and ores to feed on, which makes its horns grow longer and stronger. Its venom can corrode some metals, even in trace amounts.

entry: POKENAME让数百只宝可梦搭乘背部，用坚韧铁壳保护它们免受大浪。据说壳内相当奢华。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lets hundreds of Pokémon ride on its back, its tough iron shell protecting them from large waves. The inside of its shell is supposedly quite luxurious.

entry: POKENAME的铁甲虽笨重，却十分适于水下行动。额前的角，则用来刺穿毫无戒心的猎物。
author: nellnast42
source: Although clunky, POKENAME's iron plating is specially suited for underwater travel. Its frontal horn is used to skewer unsuspecting prey.

entry: POKENAME被激怒时，厚甲会亮起黄澄澄的电光。带电后，沉重身体也变得异常灵活。
author: nellnast42
source: When irritated, POKENAME's heavy armor glows bright yellow with electricity. This charge makes it extremely nimble for its weight.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，铠甲会烧得像熔炉。随后便鲁莽地四处冲撞，为自己降温。
author: nellnast42
source: When in battle, POKENAME's armor heats up like a furnace. It then smashes into its surroundings recklessly to cool off.

entry: POKENAME虽主要独自捕猎，却常成对出现。因为刀刃需定期磨利，而刮过构成甲壳的金属，效果最好。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is often seen in pairs, despite primarily being solitary hunters. This is because their blades require regular sharpening, which is best done by scraping against the metal that makes up their carapace.

entry: POKENAME的身体、尾巴和头部有极坚实的钢甲保护。但铠甲实在太重，必须用精神力才能移动身体。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has powerfully sturdy steel plating protecting its body, tail, and head. However, the weight of this armor is great enough that it must use psychic powers to move its own body around.

entry: POKENAME能让一些花草即使在最贫瘠多石的土中也长起来。领地可大如整座山，谁可能威胁植被，就会被它无情猛击。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME can make some flowers and plants grow even in the rockiest soils. Its territory can be as large as a mountain, and it thrashes mercilessly at anyone who can be a threat for its vegetation.

entry: POKENAME通过甲上精细孔洞喷出火焰，增强穿山挖隧道的冲力。难得放松时，会在石头中烧个洞休息。
author: lbbacca
source: POKENAME shoots jets of flames through the refined holes in its armor, increasing its force as it tears tunnels through mountains. In the rare times it relaxes, it sears a hole into the stone to rest.

entry: POKENAME用长角凿下金属与矿石，只靠少量碎屑就能维生。它爱在河流急湍附近懒懒休息，偶尔用猛流打磨、清洁身体。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their long horns to chip away at metal and ore, able to sustain themselves with mere scraps. They tend to laze near river rapids, occasionally using those fierce curents to keep their bodies honed and clean.

entry: POKENAME收集铁矿，制成保护柔软身体的铠甲。受威胁时，会毫不犹豫地冲倒敌人，随即迅速钻地逃跑。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME gather iron ore to fashion into the armor that protects their soft bodies. When threatened, they won't hesitate to charge foes and knock them down, only to quickly burrow into the ground to get away.

entry: POKENAME即使披甲也飞得快，能用带角额头打出强力冲撞。它很容易与栖息地中同样致力于防灾的宝可梦结交。
author: pjporwoll
source: Even with its armor, POKENAME flies at a quick speed, allowing it to land powerful charges with its horned brow. It forms bonds readily with other Pokémon in its habitat that work to protect the location from disasters.

entry: POKENAME用触角光引来攻击者，诱使对方追打自己。目标撞上坚实钢躯而受伤后，它便反击，反过来制服想捕食自己的敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hunts by attracting aggressors to chase and attack it, guided by the glow from its antennae. Once its target has injured itself by clashing against its solid steel body, POKENAME retaliates and turns the tables on its would-be predator.

entry: POKENAME住在发电厂附近水域，以电为食。甲片厚重，很难在不造成伤害的情况下，将它移出这些地方。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME live in waters near power plants, feeding on electricity. Due to their thick metal plates, they have proven difficult to remove from these environments without harm.

entry: POKENAME能借铠甲传导庞大超能力，尾巴也能发射强劲光束。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME is able to channel its immense psychic powers through its armor. Its tail is capable of launching off a powerful beam.

entry: 它们普遍偏爱陨石，有时甚至吃月之石。野生POKENAME始终只在夜间现身，沐浴月光，让身上纹路亮起。
author: infinex21
source: They have a common preference for meteorites and sometimes even Moon Stones. Wild POKENAME will only, and always will, emerge at night to bask in moonlight, which sets their markings alight.

entry: 双颚强得能啃穿坚岩。矿工有时用POKENAME开凿隧道，清除巨石。
author: kittyluv090
source: Its jaws are strong enough to gnaw through solid rock. Miners sometimes use POKENAME to bore out tunnels and clear large boulders.

entry: POKENAME极其温和，在葱郁陡峭的山坡家园只吃灌木与矿物。触角能察觉针对栖息地的恶意，只有这时才会暴走。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is incredibly peaceful, eating only shrubs and minerals in the steep flourishing hills it calls home. It is able to detect signs of negative intent to its habitat with its antennae; it is only then when it goes berserk.

entry: 它用角挖隧道，深入地下寻找铁矿吃。角虽然不断生长，却也磨损得同样快。
author: .jerden
source: It burrows deep underground by using its horns to dig tunnels, searching for iron ore to eat. Although its horns constantly grow, they are worn down just as quickly.

entry: 它住在深海床。哪怕轻擦一下锐刺，也会令它猛烈爆炸，留下剧毒。
author: kittyluv090
source: It lives on the floor of deep oceans. Even just slightly grazing its sharp spikes causes it to violently explode, leaving potent toxins in its wake.

entry: POKENAME几乎无法摧毁，连半挂卡车撞击也能承受。它会伏平身体，尽量扩大铠甲保护的范围。食物是花蜜、树液等天然甜品。
author: mindrivet
source: POKENAME is near indestructible and can survive a collision with a semi-truck. It achieves this by flattening itself to maximize its armor coverage. It feeds on natural sweets such as nectar and tree sap.

entry: POKENAME在壳内熔化挖来的铁，浇铸成墙，保护领地。它用熔岩灌满挖过的隧道，防止背后遇袭。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME melts the iron it digs up within its shell in order to cast it down as walls to protect its territory. It floods the tunnels it digs through with lava so that it can't be ambushed from behind.

entry: POKENAME在空中高速飞翔，很少减速。看见建筑，就会加速，用金属喙钻入墙壁。
author: theaceofhearts0306
source: POKENAME soars through the sky at an extremely high speed, rarely slowing down. If it spots a building, POKENAME will accelerate, drilling its metal beak into the building's walls.

entry: 沉重身体让它无法长途飞行。挥翅掀起的风强得迎面生疼，仿佛空气本身也在切割。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its hefty body leaves it unable to fly long distances. The whipping of its wings creates gusts so fierce they hurt to face, as if the air itself were cutting you.

entry: POKENAME搜集骨片与钢铁，制成能承受体内高温的铠甲。最后、也是最重要的一件是头盔，由波士可多拉的骨头制成。
author: redmagecole
source: POKENAME scrounges up bits of bone and steel to fashion itself a set of armor that can withstand its internal heat. The last and most important piece is its helmet, which POKENAME fashions from the bones of an Aggron.

entry: POKENAME在人工隧道游走，吃松石与碎屑，强化金属长牙。隧道坍塌时，也会帮助营救矿工。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME roams around manmade tunnels to eat loose rocks and debris to strengthen its metallic tusks. It is also known to aid in rescuing miners when tunnels cave in.

entry: 它照料的蛋几乎无法破坏，却也永不孵化。因此也没法吃，尽管有传闻称它们能大益健康。
author: pokepower
source: Eggs it cares for become nigh-indestructible, but never hatch. This also means they are inedible, despite rumors of wondrous health benefits.

entry: POKENAME的铠甲完全不生锈。能抓握的长须既是取物附肢，也是致命武器。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME's armor is completely rustproof. Its prehensile tendrils are both useful item-grabbing appendages and deadly weapons.

entry: 每吃一块金属，铠甲就会变大变强，为进化准备。它通常住在山中洞窟，但走进城市时，一夜能吃掉整辆汽车。
author: bandedbodypress
source: With every piece of metal it eats, its armor grows larger and stronger for evolution. It usually is found in caves and mountains, but when it wanders into cities it can eat an entire car in one night.

entry: 过去，POKENAME的领地争斗被认为曾因过于激烈，将山村夷为平地。满身甲片耐多种攻击，却容易过热。
author: chibitales
source: Territorial disputes between POKENAME were thought to have levelled mountain villages in the past due to their ferocity. Their plated bodies are resistant to many attacks, but overheat easily.

entry: 铠甲坚不可摧，任何方式都无法损伤。即使POKENAME死去很久，铠甲仍会骄傲地立在山巅。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its indestructible armor cannot be damaged in any way. Long after it dies, POKENAME's armor will still stand proud on the peak of its mountain.

entry: 这种宝可梦的皮甲几乎挡得住一切攻击。成长时会蜕甲，脱落甲片被用于加固建筑骨架，提高耐久。
author: gtrwya
source: This Pokémon's hide is nearly impenetrable to attacks. It sheds its armor as it grows, and the discarded plates are repurposed to reinforce building frames for added durability.

entry: POKENAME头上的枝条长着三个极重、极坚实的金属球。它甩球自卫，但若没能击倒敌人，就会逃走躲藏，等下一组长出来。
author: sk372
source: The branch on POKENAME's head grows a trio of incredibly heavy and solid metal orbs. It flings these off at others to defend itself, but if the attack doesn't knock out its foe, it runs away and hides until it can regrow another set.

entry: 它不断散失静电，因此总在寻求补电。会接下落雷，也用尾巴剖开电子设备和电池取电。
author: pokepower
source: It's always seeking a charge, as it constantly sheds static. It relies on lighting strikes and slicing open electronics and batteries with its tail.

entry: POKENAME叶片构成的身体，吸收无数矿物养分与日月光芒，长得坚韧强壮。叶片锐利如刀，连坚钢也能剜开。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's leafy body has grown hardy and strong from the nutrients of countless minerals and the light of the moon and sun. Their leaves are as sharp as blades and can even gouge solid steel.

entry: POKENAME摸起来极冷，金属皮甲几乎瞬间吸走热量。训练家接触时，需戴手套、穿覆盖全身的衣物，避免冻伤。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are extremely cold to the touch, their metal hide sapping away heat near instantly. Trainers are advised to use gloves and full body clothing when handling them to avoid frostbite.

entry: POKENAME用尖角与利爪轻松向各方向挖掘，帮助开山造隧道。曾有个体与蒸汽钻机竞赛，结果失控，毁掉整座山。
author: notadoctor75
source: POKENAME help create new tunnels through mountains, as it easily digs holes with its sharp horns and claws in any direction. There was once a race between an POKENAME and a steam drill, but POKENAME lost control and destroyed the mountain.

entry: POKENAME用巨大钢尾撞击岩石与树木，将障碍击成碎片。铁球从尾部开始生长，年龄越大，背上就长得越多。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME rams rocks and trees with its large steel tail to shatter the obstacle into tiny pieces. Starting from on its tail, it grows more iron balls along its back the older it becomes.

entry: POKENAME一占据领地，就立刻种数十棵树，培育大森林。凡挡路又不是树的东西，都会立即被钢角撞碎。
author: soup1900
source: As soon as POKENAME claims a territory, it immediately plants dozens of trees to grow a large forest. Anything in the way that isn't a tree is immediately smashed using its steel horns.

entry: 角不断生长，它便在粗树上磨短。POKENAME的铠甲明亮反射阳光，映出引以为傲的旧战刻痕。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Its horns are constantly growing, but it shaves them down on thick trees. The armour of POKENAME reflects sunlight brightly, highlighting gouges from past battles that it wears with pride.

entry: POKENAME身体覆着钢甲与锐利金属刺，防御几乎无懈可击。一旦蜷成带刺金属球滚动，几乎没有东西能阻止。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is covered with steel plating and sharp metal spines, making its defenses nearly impregnable. Once it curls into a spiked metal ball and starts rolling, almost nothing can stop it.

entry: POKENAME的钢甲既挡敌人攻击，也增强强力踢击。面对格外强的对手，双腿温度会剧升，变得通红滚烫。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME's body is clad in a steel armor that not only shields it from enemy blows but also amplifies the power of its devastating kicks. When facing a particularly strong opponent, the temperature in its legs rises dramatically, turning red-hot.

entry: POKENAME全身钢甲如同熔炉，持续积聚高热，直接流入双腿。踢击不只蛮力可怕，留下的灼伤同样令人畏惧。
author: fiordaliso
source: The steel armor covering POKENAME's body acts as a furnace, steadily building intense heat that flows directly into its legs. Its kicks are feared not for their raw force alone, but for the scorching burns they leave behind.

entry: POKENAME全身钢甲如同熔炉，持续积聚高热，直接流入双腿。踢击不只蛮力可怕，留下的灼伤同样令人畏惧。
author: fiordaliso
source: The steel armor covering POKENAME's body acts as a furnace, steadily building intense heat that flows directly into its legs. Its kicks are feared not for their raw force alone, but for the scorching burns they leave behind.

entry: POKENAME通过头盔伸出的金属角，感知人类与宝可梦情绪。它会撞走欺凌者，保护同住林中的弱小宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can sense the emotions of humans and Pokémon through the metal horns protruding from its helmet. It protects weaker Pokémon sharing its woods by headbutting any bullies away.

entry: POKENAME占据领地后，会制造幻景掩饰周围，扰乱入侵者方向。若转移注意的计策失败，就会用锐利钢角迅速连击。
author: oddwalls
source: Once it claims territory, POKENAME camouflages the area by creating mirages to disorient intruders. If this diversion fails, POKENAME will rapidly strike its opponent with its sharp steel horns.

entry: 金属角传导精神能力。角极长的POKENAME能听见50英里内所有人的心声，因此它们每年都会将角锯掉。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its metal horns are a conductor for its mental abilities. An POKENAME with extremely long horns can hear the thoughts of everyone within 50 miles. For this reason, they saw their horns off every year.

entry: POKENAME是披坚甲的战士，以性命保卫训练家。战斗凶猛，无可匹敌，许多个体交战结束后，也很难从高涨战意中平静下来。
author: sk372
source: A warrior clad in powerful armor, POKENAME defends its Trainer with its life. The ferocity with which it fights is unmatched, and many POKENAME have a difficult time coming down from the high of battle when combat is finished.

entry: POKENAME沉重的钢躯似乎不会受损。即使威力最大的炸药，也没能在金属身体上留下明显损伤。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's heavyweight steel body is seemingly impervious to damage. Even the highest-yield explosives have left no noticeable damage on POKENAME's metallic form.

entry: 故事称，POKENAME由死后仍渴望战斗的波士可多拉灵魂形成。幽灵力量赋予强大实力，灵魂会退入近乎无法破坏的金属头骨，躲避伤害。
author: sk372
source: Stories say POKENAME forms from the spirits of fallen Aggron that still hunger for battle. Its ghostly powers give it great strength, and the spirit retreats into the nigh-invulnerable metallic skull to avoid harm.

entry: 这把剑太大、太厚、太重，也太粗糙，简直称不上剑，更像一大块铁。暴怒时，它会带着剑在空中猛烈翻甩，直到累得昏倒。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its sword is too big, too thick, too heavy, and too rough to be called a sword; it's more like a large hunk of iron. When enraged, it will violently fling itself and its sword through the air until it faints from exhaustion.

entry: POKENAME通过玩耍、互相撞头变强。因此，也会反复撞训练家，表达喜爱。
author: keiracm35_
source: POKENAME grow stronger by playing and headbutting each other. Because of this, POKENAME ram repeatedly into their Trainers as a sign of affection.

entry: 人造物没有什么能像POKENAME的臂刃一样锐利，几秒就能劈开实心金属块。身体虽坚实，却仍轻得足以短暂飞行。
author: infinex21
source: Nothing made by humans is as sharp as the blade-arms of POKENAME, for they can cleave through a block of solid metal in a matter of seconds. Despite how sturdy their bodies are, they are still light enough to be capable of bursts of flight.

entry: POKENAME全身有军用级铠甲，能拨开利爪攻击。周围的花粉云曾被用作烟幕，保护冲过战场的士兵。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have military-grade armor over their bodies that deflects claws and talons. The cloud of pollen that surrounds them was once harnessed as a smokescreen to protect soldiers as they rush through a battlefield.

entry: POKENAME第二颗头严格说只是角，却能像嘴一样开合，压碎岩石矿物，再用真正的嘴吃。它也会用巨角有力冲撞敌人。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's second head is technically just a horn, though it can open and close like a mouth to crush up the rocks and ores for it to eat with its actual mouth. These Pokémon will also use their large horn to ram their opponents with great force.

entry: POKENAME以强韧闻名，会毫不迟疑地冲向对手，铁角几乎能刺穿一切。一跑起来，就得撞上东西才能停。
author: korro0490
source: Known for its resilience, POKENAME charges into its opponents without hesitation, piercing almost anything with its iron horns. Once it starts running, it cannot stop until it hits something.

entry: POKENAME在山中筑窝，将整座山据为己有。许多可猿敬畏它，在它懒懒休息时奉命行事。它虽懒，却能轻易推倒栖居的整座山。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME will create a lair within a mountain and claim it as its own. It commands the respect of many Lairoth who do its bidding while it lounges around. Though lazy, POKENAME can easily topple the very mountain it resides in.

entry: 灾难将近时，POKENAME的角会长得很长。若看见它的角比平常长，最好赶快离开当地。
author: dinosaurbones55
source: When disaster is near, POKENAME's horns grow very long. If you see an POKENAME with longer horns than usual, it is strongly advised that you leave the area.

entry: 这位远洋巨兽的霸主有时被称为“移动堡垒鲸”。古老传说中，一位术士曾与它立下誓约，在它背上建造城堡。训练家会乘着它，平安探索茫茫大海。
author: alkazamis
source: This titanic lord of the pelagic ocean is sometimes known as the Mobile Fortress Whale, recalling an old legend in which a mystic made an oath with one and built a castle on its back. Trainers use them to explore the whale roads in safety.

entry: POKENAME钢甲既耐多种攻击，又有柔韧性。世界各地金属加工厂都想用它制作坚固可靠的器具，比劣质材料做的更耐用。
author: chibitales
source: The steel plates on POKENAME's body are resistant to many attacks while also being pliable. Metalworks around the world seek these plates to make sturdy and reliable appliances that last for longer than those made with lesser materials.

entry: POKENAME钢甲既耐多种攻击，又有柔韧性。世界各地金属加工厂都想用它制作坚固可靠的器具，比劣质材料做的更耐用。
author: chibitales
source: The steel plates on POKENAME's body are resistant to many attacks while also being pliable. Metalworks around the world seek these plates to make sturdy and reliable appliances that last for longer than those made with lesser materials.

entry: POKENAME将整座山划为领地，时刻警惕地守护。刀刃上的缺口，也被视作值得骄傲的战斗纪念。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME claims an entire mountain as its territory, which it vigilantly maintains. Chips in its blade are worn with pride as mementos from battles.

entry: POKENAME只用刀背攻击，保持锋刃完好，以保全自身灵魂。体内嵌入的圆球，据说具有特殊元素性质。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME only attacks with the blunt side of its blade, keeping the sharp side pristine to preserve its spirit. The orbs embedded within POKENAME are said to hold special elemental properties.

entry: POKENAME在钢甲储存大量电力，只在战斗时释放。它先用铁角刺敌，再以高压能量爆发解决对方。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME stores large amounts of electricity in its steel armor, releasing it only in combat. It gores enemies with its iron horns and finishes them off with bursts of high-voltage energy.

entry: POKENAME全身覆满铁片，抵御任何攻击。领地所在的山中，铁已几乎被挖光，变得稀少。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME fully plates itself with iron sheets to be able to withstand any attack. Iron in the mountains where this Pokémon claims its territory is scarce due to it being all dug up.

entry: POKENAME全身覆满铁片，抵御任何攻击。领地所在的山中，铁已几乎被挖光，变得稀少。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME fully plates itself with iron sheets to be able to withstand any attack. Iron in the mountains where this Pokémon claims its territory is scarce due to it being all dug up.

entry: 翅膀不够强，无法带它飞行。它改用翅膀增加附着力，跑上陡坡与峡谷崖壁。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its wings are not strong enough to carry it in flight. It instead uses them to give it more grip against the steep slopes and canyons it runs up.

entry: POKENAME十分骄傲，以锐利金属翅膀切开沿途一切。它曾是贵族备受珍视的坐骑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are proud creatures that cut through anything in their path with their sharp, metallic wings. They were once held in high esteem as mounts for nobility.

entry: POKENAME有坚不可摧的铠甲保护，性情凶猛，是难以想象的强敌。但战斗中最大的弱点，也正是重甲与凶性，让它容易筋疲力尽。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME is protected by indestructible armor. Its fierce disposition and robust armor make it one of the toughest foes imaginable. Its biggest weakness in a fight is its heavy armor and ferocity, which make POKENAME prone to exhaustion.

entry: 体内的金属骨骼大多中空。POKENAME凭轻盈身体，行进时熟练地在悬崖间跳跃。
author: .izik
source: The metallic bones in its body are mostly hollow. Using its light weight, an POKENAME skillfully jumps from cliff to cliff when traveling.

entry: 人们常见POKENAME极力保护原生环境与训练家。头角能刺穿最坚固的材料。
author: robobunnybutt
source: POKENAME are often observed to be highly protective of their native environments, as well as their Trainers. It is capable of piercing even the strongest materials using the horn on its head.

entry: 驯养的POKENAME与训练家有特殊羁绊，会守护对方直到最后。缎带般的锐利触须能轻易切穿岩石。
author: infinex21
source: Tame POKENAME share special bonds with their Trainers and will defend them to their last. Their sharp, ribbon-like feelers can cut through rock with ease.

entry: 这些宝可梦大半生住在深地洞窟，岩浆河让那里始终炎热。它们用巨爪挖新洞，寻找更多金属矿石吃，热量则使金属碎片熔化，融合到身体上。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon spend most of their lives deep underground in caverns kept hot by rivers of magma. They use their massive claws to dig new caves in search of more metals and ores to feast on, the heat melting and fusing metal scraps to their bodies.

entry: POKENAME只有强烈渴望战斗、发泄攻击性时，才从大气层降下。它横行大地，寻找足够强的对手，让装甲添上新战痕。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME only descends from the atmosphere when it has a surging need to battle and vent its aggression. It rampages across the land searching for an opponent strong enough to give its armored coating new battle scars.

entry: POKENAME凭强大铠甲自由往来各界。凡被它视为闯入领地者，都会遭到可怕的暴力袭击。
author: tomatosalad
source: Utilizing its powerful armor, POKENAME can travel freely between realms, unleashing terrible violence on any it deems trespassers of its territory.

entry: POKENAME背上的武器似乎能发射无穷锐利金属刺。装上合适卡带后，尖刺能烧得通红、冷得如冰，或噼啪带电。
author: .jerden
source: The weapon on POKENAME's back can fire off a seemingly endless supply of sharp metal spikes. If POKENAME is loaded with the right drives, these spikes can glow red-hot, be chilled as cold as ice, or crackle with electricity.

entry: 这些宝可梦体温低于零度，周围始终笼着冷雾。长时间碰触角与尖刺，会造成严重冻伤。
author: chibitales
source: These Pokémon are constantly surrounded by cold mist due to their below-zero body temperature. Prolonged contact with their horns and spines can cause severe frostbite.

entry: 这些宝可梦体温低于零度，会呼出极冷雾气。长时间碰触角与尖刺，会造成严重冻伤。
author: chibitales
source: These Pokémon exhale an extremely cold mist due to their below-zero body temperature. Prolonged contact with their horns and spines can cause severe frostbite.

entry: POKENAME的毛看似柔软，实际是钢丝绒。生病时，毛就容易生锈。
author: cait_sith
source: Although it appears soft to the touch, POKENAME's fur is actually steel wool. If POKENAME is ill, its wool becomes prone to rusting.

entry: POKENAME的长颚强得能在岩壁凿出洞，轻松吃到矿物与矿石。眼睛能通过收缩，改变视野范围，方便追踪敌人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have long jaws that are strong enough to punch holes through walls of rock, which allows them to easily feed on minerals and ores. Their eyes can contract to change the range of their sight, which allows them to easily track foes.

entry: POKENAME盘踞最偏远的山区，用似乎无穷无尽的锐利金属片作收割工具。据说携带的棺材里，装着被它追猎的擅闯者灵魂。
author: sk372
source: Haunting the most remote mountain regions, POKENAME uses a seemingly endless reserve of sharp metal plates as reaping tools. The coffins it carries are said to hold the souls of those it has hunted down for trespassing.

entry: 连着棺材的链条牢牢系在POKENAME背上，压得它几乎动不了。没人知道，它究竟犯下何等暴行，才会受到如此痛苦的囚禁。
author: tamszen.ore
source: Chains attached to coffins have tethered themselves to the back of POKENAME, weighing it down until it can hardly move. Nobody knows what atrocities POKENAME may have committed to deserve such torturous imprisonment.

entry: POKENAME力量狂野幽暗，又少为人知，因此在民间故事中广为流传。至少有则传说提到，它从流浪乐师体内破体而出，仿佛先前一直住在里面。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's wild, dark, and relatively unknown powers have allowed it to flourish in the world of folktales. At least one legend mentions POKENAME bursting out of a wandering musician's body as if it was previously living inside of them.

entry: 传说有位远方王子四处寻找POKENAME的火焰。故事中，他用水晶小瓶装住那团火。
author: .izik
source: Legends tell of a prince from a far away land who travels in search of a flame from an POKENAME. In the story, he uses a crystal vial to hold the fire.

entry: POKENAME一拳足以摧毁坦克。全身合金会随年龄增长变得更坚实。
author: .izik
source: A punch from an POKENAME is strong enough to destroy a tank. The alloy throughout its body becomes sturdier as it ages.

entry: 野生POKENAME极罕见。发现时，人们会被翅膀吸引，试图靠近，但知道翼温如熔岩后，通常就会远离。
author: rumia_archer
source: POKENAME are extremely rare to find in the wild. When one is spotted, people are captivated by its wings and try to approach. Upon discovering that its wings are as hot as lava, they tend to stay away.

entry: 铁盔挡住视线，它便靠冲撞和啃咬辨路。头盔受损的POKENAME，不是久经沙场，就是容易迷路。
author: h0bojoe
source: Because its iron helmet blocks its sight, it navigates by tackling and biting. An POKENAME with a damaged helmet is either a seasoned fighter or prone to getting lost.

entry: 两个头不断互相撞击，想比出谁的铠甲更坚硬。可惜铠甲太重，它们的行动相当受限。
author: mistymagius
source: The two heads constantly bash each other to see whose armor is stronger. However, their armor is so heavy that their movement is pretty limited.

entry: 多年前，人们曾在卡洛斯战争的险恶战场见过POKENAME。它用铁矛吓退对手。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME was observed fighting on the dangerous battlefields of the Kalos war many years ago. It uses its iron spear to scare off opponents.

entry: POKENAME住在山溪，富含矿物的水让它生活得很好。平时虽安静，仍会用坚角刺敌自卫。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives in mountain streams, thriving in the rich mineral water. Though normally placid, it will defend itself by jabbing foes with its tough horns.

entry: POKENAME甲壳极耐久，任何科学手段都无法解剖，查清成分。现代研究显示，它能轻松承受地心的压力与高温。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The armored shell of POKENAME is so durable that no science is able to dissect it to see what it's made of. Modern research shows it could comfortably withstand the pressure and heat in the center of the planet.

entry: 坚固防甲、锐利金属投射物与强力四肢，让POKENAME成为不可小觑的强敌。胸前齿轮是唯一弱点。
author: sk372
source: Strong defensive armor, sharp metallic projectiles and crushingly powerful limbs make POKENAME a force to be reckoned with in battle. The gear on its chest is its only weak spot.

entry: POKENAME披着层层钢甲，吸气时，甲片会移动、扩张，让它唱出轻柔低音，使周围生灵入睡。
author: quackquackattack
source: Armor-clad with layers of steel plates, whenever POKENAME inhales, the plates shift and expand. This allows them to sing soft, low notes that put those around them to sleep.

entry: POKENAME住在山中，有些地区与壶壶形成互助关系。它为树果植株授粉、保护壶壶，换来发酵果汁喝，让花朵长得又大又美。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME live in mountains and in some regions have developed a relationship with Shuckle. They will pollinate berries and protect Shuckle, and in return get to drink the fermented juice it produces. This makes their flowers grow large and beautiful.

entry: 粗壮身体硬过铁，充满强健肌肉。以金属矿石为食，让角始终稳定生长。
author: infinex21
source: Their stout bodies are harder than iron and packed with strong muscles. Their horns are always growing steadily thanks to their diet of metals and ores.

entry: POKENAME铠甲的空腔会放大回声定位，扩大探测范围。它追上猎物，以刀翼切斩，消耗对方体力。
author: pjporwoll
source: The hollows in POKENAME's armor amplify its echolocation to an increased range. It chases down its quarries and slashes them with its bladed wings to tire them out.

entry: 下半身强壮，撑得住巨大的金属头，爪也有力，能挖出赖以为食的金属矿石。特殊眼膜让它黑暗中也能看得很远。
author: infinex21
source: Their lower bodies are quite strong to support their large, metal heads and their claws are strong enough to help them dig for the ores and metals they feed upon. Their eyes are covered in a special membrane that lets them see far within the dark.

entry: 它偏爱厚甲宝可梦，用角刺穿或撞碎甲壳。沉重冲锋一开始就停不住，目标若躲开，便可能把自己卡进墙里或地面。
author: sk372
source: It prefers to target Pokémon with tough carapaces, aiming to pierce or shatter them with its horns. These heavy charges cannot be stopped once started, so it may embed itself in a wall or ground should the target evade.

entry: 强颚嚼几秒，就能将金属板碾成细粉，铠甲也比精钢更硬。它战斗很讲荣誉，尽管大多数挑战者或许轻易就能被它压倒。
author: infinex21
source: Its jaws are strong enough to turn a sheet of metal into a fine dust within a few seconds of chewing and its armor is tougher than refined steel. It fights with considerable honor, despite how easily it can probably crush most who challenge it.

entry: POKENAME用喉间发出的冰冷金属吼声，震慑所有敢挑战的对象。金属颚的力量，连钻石也能压碎。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME stuns anyone who dares to challenge it with a guttural, bone-chilling metallic roar. Its metal jaws can exert a force powerful enough to crush even diamond.

entry: POKENAME偏爱废工厂及其他堆着废机器的地方。它将入侵者冻成冰块，黏在废机器上作装饰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gravitates towards inhabiting abandoned factories and other places with discarded machinery. It freezes intruders solid and sticks their frozen form to the junked machines as a form of decoration.

entry: 它们用前角刮金属矿石，吃下碎屑。背角则有毒，虽然多数时候仍会逃跑，也会跃到敌人上方，以毒角俯冲。
author: infinex21
source: They use their frontal horns to scrape away at ores and metals to eat the shavings. The dorsal horns are poisonous and, although they will still run more often than not, they will leap up above a foe and dive at them with those horns.

entry: POKENAME夜巡认定为领地的城市，大吃垃圾。虽然有助清洁，但它会撕开没做好防护的垃圾箱，合众城市因此得把箱子做得更坚实。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME nocturnally patrols the city it has designated as its territory, feasting upon refuse. While this is useful for litter control, Unovan cities have needed to make their garbage bins more durable as it will tear into unsecured ones.

entry: POKENAME是罕见的提前发育现象，似乎会在可可鱼主要吃船体等精炼金属后出现。钢角让它更容易猎船，也更方便挖新水下洞窟。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are an uncommon sight of predevelopment that seem to occur when an Arvanha has fed mostly on refined metals, such as the hulls of ships. Their steel horns make it even easier for them to hunt ships and to dig out new underwater caves.

entry: POKENAME覆着轻薄锐利的钢，切开水流与岩石同样轻松。它通过钢躯喷出高压水，能在岩中如游泳般前行，寻找更多矿物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are clad in light, sharp steel that allows them to effectively slice through water and rock with equal ease. By releasing pressurized water through their steel bodies, they can effectively swim through rock as they hunt for more minerals.

entry: POKENAME住在深穴，其中金属充足，足够构筑铠甲。金属善于反射声音，还能增强声波能力。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME lives in deep caves with enough metal to build its armor. The metal is great at reflecting sound, which enhances its sonic abilities.

entry: POKENAME丰满的翅膀由领地争斗产生的钢屑构成。叫声如工厂里的金属互擦，能有效阻吓潜在威胁。
author: secondunit
source: POKENAME's voluminous wings are constructed from the steel shavings that come from its territorial battles. Their voices echo the industrial sound of metal scraping against itself, and function as an effective deterrent to prospective threats.

entry: 重甲拖累POKENAME，动作很慢，但多数攻击都会弹开。对方若纠缠不休，它就会用角刺、用强颚咬；平时这些器官主要用来采矿吃。
author: .jerden
source: Weighed down by heavy armor, POKENAME moves very slowly, but most attacks simply bounce off it. If the attacker persists, POKENAME will stab with its horns or bite with its powerful jaws, but it usually just uses these to mine the ore it eats.

entry: 胃几乎能分解一切，它用坚硬金属角与颚将岩石压成碎砾，再吞下。保护柔软身体的铁甲，由消化的矿石构筑。
author: .jerden
source: Its stomach can break down almost anything, and it uses its hard metal horns and jaws to crush rocks into gravel it can swallow. The iron armor protecting its soft body is built using ore it digests.

entry: POKENAME极爱玩，会向其他生灵喷蓝色黏液，自得其乐。同样的黏液也能防止耐久铁甲与金属角生锈。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is incredibly playful and will squirt others with its blue slime for its own amusement. Its durable iron armor and metallic horns are prevented from rusting by the same slime.

entry: POKENAME极爱玩，会向其他生灵喷蓝色黏液，自得其乐。同样的黏液也能防止耐久铁甲与金属角生锈。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is incredibly playful and will squirt others with its blue slime for its own amusement. Its durable iron armor and metallic horns are prevented from rusting by the same slime.

entry: POKENAME用钢爪挖穿石头，寻找发光生物等物件吃。它常占矿井为家园领地，因为为矿工照明的灯也是可口食物。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its steel claws to dig through stone in search of bioluminescent objects to devour. It often takes over mines for its home and territory since the bright lights installed for miners to see are appetizing food for POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME身披钢甲，挥舞从遗迹找到、亲自修复的剑。它的存在让人疑惑，究竟是人类仿照它穿甲，还是它进化来模仿人类。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's body is clad in steel armor, and it wields a sword that was found in some ruins and restored by POKENAME. This Pokémon's existence has led to questions about whether humans wore armor in its likeness or if it evolved to mimic humans.

entry: POKENAME全身钢甲不会生锈。即使在水中浸数月，甲片仍光洁如新，不受腐蚀。
author: .izik
source: The steel armor covering POKENAME's body is immune to rust. Even after months of being submerged, its plating remains spotless and uncorroded.

entry: POKENAME虽有金属身体，移动却很快。它铁角朝前冲撞对手，也用尾巴投掷大石。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can move very fast despite their metal bodies. An POKENAME will ram its opponents with its iron horns pointed forward and uses its tail to hurl large rocks.

entry: POKENAME的真菌吃金属，和吃有机物一样轻松。积存的养分让菌丝长得极其坚韧沉重。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's fungus can consume metal as easily as any organic substance. The nourishment it retains causes its mycelium to grow remarkably sturdy and heavy.

entry: POKENAME体表覆着人类已知最硬的金属物质之一。它极以身上半部的盘状鳞片为傲，任何一片因任何原因脱落，都是惨重损失。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is covered with one of the hardest metallic substances known to man. It takes great pride in the disc-shaped scales on its upper body; if even one falls off for any reason, it is considered a devastating loss.

entry: POKENAME覆有不断硬化的金属鳞片，每战过后更坚实，受击时发出沉重金属声。它以严谨武术与巨大力量迎战。
author: alexgriller
source: POKENAME is covered in hardening metallic scales that grow tougher after every battle, producing a heavy metallic sound when struck. POKENAME faces its opponents with disciplined martial skill and immense physical strength.

entry: 寄生在POKENAME体内的真菌迫使它吞食大量铁，用吃下的金属供自己生长。
author: .realthree
source: The fungus that inhabits POKENAME compels it to eat massive amounts of iron. The consumed metal supports the fungus' growth.

entry: POKENAME在体内烧煤熔铁，用来长角。看角的长短与大小，就能判断年龄。
author: jodue
source: POKENAME burns coal inside its body to melt iron, which it then uses to grow its horns. The age of a POKENAME can be determined by the length and size of its horns.

entry: POKENAME脾气有点坏，几乎总皱着脸。若钢壳在身边合拢，就赶快躲好；接下来准是一记带着怨气、让人疼痛的冲撞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a bit of a grump, rarely seen without a scowling visage on its face. If it clamps its steel shell shut around itself, take cover; a disgruntled and painful tackling charge is sure to follow.

entry: POKENAME发光双眼似乎看一眼，就能瞬间分析金属。它能迅速发现钢结构开始衰弱的部位，因此变得十分有用。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's glowing eyes seem to be able to instantly analyze metal with a single glance. It's become very valuable for its ability to quickly spot spots in metal structures where the steel has begun to weaken.

entry: POKENAME栖居的山始终翻耕整齐，种着各种作物与树。它整天在领地挖掘，吃掉冒出的杂草，维护劳动成果。
author: soup1900
source: Mountains where POKENAME reside are always perfectly tilled and planted with an assortment of crops and trees. They dig through their territories all day and eat weeds that sprout up to maintain their work.

entry: POKENAME为了保护头上的蓝晶，会将钢角养长、磨利。爪比钢硬，能挖穿坚岩，寻找金属矿石吃。
author: infinex21
source: To protect the blue crystals upon their own heads, POKENAME grow out and hone their steel horns. Their claws are harder than steel, which allow them to dig through solid rock in search of metal ore to feed on.

entry: POKENAME用两把铁锤敲自己的金属头盔，吓退敌人。对方不理，才真正拿来当武器。但敲得太多，自己也会头痛。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME bashes its own metal helmet with the two iron hammers it holds to frighten away foes, only using them as weapons if this display is ignored. If it does this too often, it will give itself a headache.

entry: POKENAME在废采石场安家，吃人类活动留下的裸露岩石与矿石。它到采石湖游泳放松，坚韧钢躯能保护它不受水中有毒化学物质影响。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their homes in disused quarries, feeding on the exposed rocks and ores left behind by human activity. They swim in the quarry lakes to relax, their tough steel body protecting them from the toxic chemicals filling the water.

entry: POKENAME以金属吼声，吓走那些贸然靠近其守卫区域的生灵。战斗时毫不留情，嘴中火焰会造成剧痛烫伤。
author: fiordaliso
source: With its metallic roars, POKENAME scares away anyone foolish enough to approach the area it is guarding. When it fights, it shows no mercy to its enemies; the flames it breathes from its mouth cause terribly painful burns.

entry: POKENAME的勺子过去曾被熔化，制成卡洛斯统治者的王冠。王冠能保护国王与女王，不受精神控制。
author: .izik
source: The spoons from an POKENAME were once melted down to make crowns for Kalos rulers. The crowns defended the kings and queens from mind control.

entry: 它向敌人冲锋时，会从覆满金属的体内释放猛烈火焰。蹄能迅速踏碎巨石，角则锋利得能穿钢。
author: infinex21
source: It releases intense flames from within its metal-clad body as it charges down foes. Its hooves are hard enough to quickly break apart large rocks and its horn is sharp enough to pierce through steel.

entry: 角与背上覆的铁有轻微磁性，能感知磁场，帮助地下导航、寻找铁矿吃。
author: .jerden
source: The iron covering its horns and back is slightly magnetic. It can use this to sense magnetic fields, helping it to navigate underground and find iron ore to eat.

entry: POKENAME吃沉没战舰生锈的船体，让外骨骼极强。它通常温顺，但潜水者若想掠夺沉船家园，就会变得凶暴。
author: occulusmalus
source: POKENAME feeds on the rusting hulls of sunken battleships, a diet that makes its exoskeleton incredibly strong. They are usually docile, but become aggressive toward divers who try to plunder their shipwreck homes.

entry: POKENAME嗡嗡地穿行于沙暴，帮迷路的旅人找到附近的绿洲。它会高速振动翅膀，抖去种子上的沙尘。
author: ozydamians
source: Buzzing through sandstorms, POKENAME will help guide lost travelers to an oasis near them. It rapidly vibrates its wings to clean the dust from its bulb.

entry: POKENAME飞上高空，或深钻地下，尽量远离捕食者。一旦被发现，它们便拍翅掀起强风，趁机逃走。
author: seanothan_23
source: POKENAME makes sure to stay as far away from predators as possible by flying high up in the air or burrowing deep into the ground. When they are spotted, they flap their wings to create large gusts of wind and escape.

entry: POKENAME狩猎时，以翅膀掀起沙暴。猎物视线受阻后，再用强力骨棒攻击。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: When POKENAME hunts, it uses its wings to whip up sandstorms. After its prey's vision is obscured, it hits them with a devastating Bone Club.

entry: POKENAME乘着沙漠龙卷风自保，粗砂会击退试图钻进茧的天敌。不乘沙旋风时，就埋在沙里，避免被发现。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME ride sand tornadoes in the desert to keep themselves safe, as the gritty particles of sand knock away predators that try to break into their cocoon. When they are not riding sand tornadoes, they are buried in the sand to avoid detection.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀主要用来调整冲锋速度。既能起步加速，也能在打偏、需要改变轨迹时帮助减速。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wings are used primarily to adjust its speed when it charges. They can grant it an initial speed boost or help slow it down if it misses its target and needs to adjust its trajectory.

entry: POKENAME通过体侧孔洞，造出沙构成的巨大翅膀，迅速掀起遮眼沙暴，逃离各种危险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME creates massive wings made out of sand from pores on its sides. It can quickly whip up blinding sandstorms with said wings in order to escape any sort of danger.

entry: 野生POKENAME常将自己埋在沙里，或附在洞壁与洞顶。身体旋转得足够快，能搅起猛烈沙暴。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME will often bury themselves with sand or cling to the walls and ceilings of caves. They can spin their bodies fast enough to churn up fierce sandstorms.

entry: POKENAME原生沙漠，白天藏在凉沙中。夜里，护目镜般的眼睑保护视线，让它以超过100英里的时速狩猎。
author: ghostslythe
source: Native to deserts, POKENAME spends its daylight hours burrowed in cool sands. At night its goggle eyelids protect its sight while it hunts at over one hundred miles per hour.

entry: POKENAME在严酷沙丘结群游走，尽力寻找稀少食物。进化的渴望驱使它们长途旅行，寻找元素石。
author: bluenido.
source: POKENAME roam in the harsh desert dunes in groups, foraging for whatever little they can find. They travel vast distances in search of elemental stones, driven by their urge to evolve.

entry: 野生POKENAME飞掠沙漠，背与双腿裹着电。翅膀只够支撑跳起后的滑翔，互拍时会发出雷鸣般的轰响。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME dart across deserts, their backs and legs clad in electricity. Their wings are only strong enough to let them glide when they leap and create thunderous booms when clapped together.

entry: POKENAME从沙漠高空俯冲时，用棱角化增强攻击。下降距离足够，尾巴便能轻松刺穿敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses Sharpen to amplify its strikes while diving from desert skies. With sufficient descent, its tail can pierce foes with ease.

entry: POKENAME哪里都能睡，却格外喜欢沙暴的声音与触感，觉得十分放松。累了，就用翅膀扬起沙子，立刻打盹。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME can sleep anywhere, they find the sound and sensation of sandstorms particularly relaxing. If they feel fatigued, they will whip up the desert sand with their wings, then immediately doze off.

entry: POKENAME住在偏远山中，扇翅就能召来猛烈暴雪。翼声常被误认为女子歌唱，引诱迷途旅人深入雪地，最终难逃成为猎物的命运。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME dwells in remote mountains, summoning intense blizzards just by flapping its wings. The sound its wings produce is often mistaken for a woman's song, luring lost travelers deeper into the snow where they inevitably become its prey.

entry: POKENAME扇翅的声音，如滚雷或尖锐霹雳。每片翅膀都迅速灵巧，让它能向各方向移动。
author: bobosmith01
source: The flap of POKENAME's wings can produce sounds that remind one of the rolling of thunder or a sharp clap of lightning. The swiftness and dexterity in each individual wing allow POKENAME to move in all directions.

entry: POKENAME见有人在沙漠脱水，会试着陪玩，鼓舞心情。若对方失去意识，就瞬移送往最近的干净水源。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME spots someone dehydrating in the desert, it will attempt to play with them to lift their spirits. Should they lose consciousness, it teleports them to the nearest clean water source.

entry: POKENAME的眼睛特别适合阻挡沙尘，飞过沙暴也不受影响。它在沙下挖复杂洞穴，通常靠近赖以为食的仙人掌丛。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's eyes are specially suited to keep dust and sand out, letting them fly through sandstorms without issue. They make intricate burrows beneath the sand, usually near patches of cacti that they eat.

entry: 它高飞避敌，个头又小，让天敌很难抓住。入夜才飞下来，到池塘喝水。
author: skymaster426
source: It keeps high in the skies to avoid predators, which struggle to grab it due to its small size. During the night, it flies down to drink from ponds.

entry: POKENAME贴近水面飞行，能直接穿过浪头。翅膀覆防水凝胶，不会受影响。有个受欢迎的童书角色，正是一只折翼后重新学飞的POKENAME。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME flies low above the water, punching through waves. Its wings are covered in a waterproof gel, so they are not affected by this. There is a popular character in a children's book that depicts a POKENAME with a broken wing learning to fly.

entry: POKENAME贴近水面飞行，甚至直接穿过浪头。翅膀覆防水凝胶，不受水影响。休息时，会将自己裹在泥里。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME flies low above the water, even punching through waves. Its wings are covered in a waterproof gel so they are not affected by the water. When resting, they cover themselves in mud.

entry: POKENAME常翻动沙子，寻找地下蓄水处。因此，背上的花苞进化得能够耐沙。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME will often kick up sand in search of underground reservoirs. Because of this, the bud on its back has evolved to be resistant to sand.

entry: POKENAME是伏击猎手，只露双钳在沙丘上。受到扰动，就从下方迅速突袭，以翅膀掀沙暴，用钳夹碎猎物。
author: ghostslythe
source: POKENAME is an ambush hunter, leaving only its claws visible above the dunes. When one is disturbed, it launches a swift surprise attack from below, using its wings to begin a sandstorm and crushing prey with its claws.

entry: 构成POKENAME身体的沙极其细腻，吹玻璃工匠会采来制作小饰物。由于稀有，各沙漠国家的集市都卖高价。
author: .izik
source: The incredibly fine sand making up POKENAME's body is harvested by glassblowers to craft trinkets. Bazaars across desert nations sell these items at high prices due to its rarity.

entry: POKENAME擅长追踪。覆盖双眼的护目镜状薄膜，让它在最猛烈的沙暴中也能看清事物。这种忠诚的宝可梦会救助在沙漠里迷路的训练家。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME are excellent trackers, with the visor-like film over its eyes allowing it to see clearly through the harshest sandstorms. These loyal Pokémon will rescue Trainers it finds lost in the desert.

entry: POKENAME主要蜷成球滚动。到软沙充足的地方，就埋入地下，感受脚步振动，等待猎物靠近伏击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME mostly travels by curling up into a ball and rolling around. Once it reaches a location with plenty of soft sand, it buries itself underground and waits to ambush prey, sensing its approach through the vibrations produced by footsteps.

entry: POKENAME扬起的沙始终滚烫，还会继续升温，直到化成玻璃。到那时，沙已围住猎物，封在穹顶中，直至猎物被酷热熔化。
author: soup1900
source: Any sand POKENAME whips up is always burning hot and will keep rising in temperature until it becomes glass. By the time that happens, the sand has already surrounded the prey, imprisoning them in a dome until they melt from the sheer heat.

entry: POKENAME在深沙下出生，从出生就一路吃向地面。大群挖掘会留下巨大沙坑，随后被大颚蚁当作家。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are born deep beneath the sand, eating their way to the surface from the moment they are born. Large groups leave massive sand pits as they dig, which are then made home by Trapinch.

entry: POKENAME翅膀极强，只需几下就能掀起强劲沙暴。在地面时，强烈吼声还能引发小地震。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's wings are so strong that they can whip up brisk sandstorms with all but a few flaps. Their roars are so intense that they can cause small tremors when on the ground.

entry: POKENAME对现代物品十分好奇，经常偷小物件带回家。检查东西时若被打扰，就会朝干扰者尖叫。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME demonstrate a deep curiosity for modern-day items, often stealing smaller objects to bring back to their homes. Interrupting POKENAME as they examine items will prompt them to scream at whoever's bothering them.

entry: 野生POKENAME住在金属沙较多的沙漠地区。它用局部磁场飞行，也操纵金属沙战斗。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME live in parts of deserts where metallic sands are less rare. They use their localized magnetic fields to fly and to control metal sands in order to fight.

entry: POKENAME能造出强劲沙漠风，乘风滑翔，寻找猎物。滑翔翼般的翅膀发出如歌之声，迷人又令人发寒，让捕猎更容易。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can create powerful desert winds to glide upon while searching for prey. Its glider-like wings emit a song-like noise that is both alluring and chilling, making it easier to secure its prey.

entry: POKENAME住在荒凉苔原，响亮爆鸣偶尔划破宁静。从空中发现敌人，就弹射而下，掀起音爆，撞地时将目标压扁。
author: alindrome
source: In desolate tundras where POKENAME live, loud explosions occasionally crack the tranquility. When they spot enemies from above, POKENAME create supersonic booms as they jettison themselves, flattening targets by crashing to the earth.

entry: POKENAME强健的翅膀能让它飞到极高处，吸收卫星信号。一次吸收太多信息，偶尔会不受控地乱挥身体。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's strong wings allow it to reach extremely high altitudes where it absorbs signals from satellites. Occasionally, it flails uncontrollably if it absorbs too much information at once.

entry: POKENAME让背上无数彩刺同步振动，召来强沙暴。猎物常藏地下，它便用爪迅速挖洞寻找。
author: fiordaliso
source: By vibrating the countless colorful quills on its back in unison, POKENAME can summon powerful sandstorms. Since the prey it feeds on often hides underground, it uses its claws to quickly dig holes in search of them.

entry: POKENAME好奇又胆小，会悄悄飞近情绪引起自己兴趣的对象。若被发现，就快速拍翅，散出沙尘与超声波，遮挡视线、扰乱方向，惊慌逃走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is curious yet timid, quietly flying up to those whose emotional state piques its interest. If spotted, it rapidly flaps its wings to dispel dust and supersonic waves to obscure and disorient a person as it flies away in a panic.

entry: POKENAME在咖啡馆与女服务员一起工作，因动作迅速、待人和善而受到称赞。它也深受喜爱，因为会用精神力把无礼客人扔出店。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME work alongside Waitresses at cafes, where they are praised for their speed and kindness. POKENAME are also well-loved for how they deal with rude customers, which involves throwing them out of the restaurant using their psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME受威胁会制造猛烈沙暴，强得能刮掉敌人皮肤。但若试图飞过云层，栖身的楔石就会将它强行拖回地面。
author: bigoljax
source: When POKENAME is threatened, it'll create harsh sandstorms that are strong enough to scrape the skin off of foes. If POKENAME attempts to fly up beyond the clouds, the keystone it resides in will forcefully drag it back down to the ground.

entry: 沙暴中，POKENAME拍翼扩展波导，寻找其他生物。它会保护领地内弱小宝可梦，抵御猎人与偷猎者。
author: therider
source: During sandstorms, POKENAME flap their wings to extend their aura and find others. It defends weak Pokémon in its territory from poachers and hunters.

entry: 天气对POKENAME太热时，它会钻进沙土，让背花伸展更多，吸收阳光。烈日之下，也会让小宝可梦躲到花下乘凉。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: When it gets too hot out for POKENAME, they dig into the sand and dirt, letting flowers on their backs spread further to absorb sunlight during these times. During days of harsh sunlight, POKENAME let smaller Pokémon take shelter under their flowers.

entry: POKENAME狩猎时，会飞快振翅，扬起尘土，遮蔽四周。随后，它飞掠而过，用尾部假嘴那强壮的双颚，猛然叼起猎物。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hunts by using its extremely rapid wingbeat to kick up dirt and dust to obscure the area. It then swoops by and snatches up its prey with the strong jaws of the false mouth on its tail.

entry: POKENAME力量虽大，却很少构成威胁。它们更爱拍翼扬沙，挖出凹坑躺着。
author: jokerswild
source: Despite their immense strength, POKENAME are very seldom dangerous. They prefer to kick up sand with their wings to create divots they can lay in.

entry: POKENAME只有在需要掀起沙暴驱敌时才会飞行。它沉稳坚毅，又富有守护之心，颇具王者风范，因此在流行文化中有时会被描绘成王族。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME only fly to kick up sandstorms to ward off enemies. Their protective and stoic nature give it a feel of royalty, so it is sometimes depicted as such in popular culture.

entry: POKENAME会以后腿站起，快速振翅，吓退更强的敌人。它还能借翅膀，将强振动导入尖锐前腿，引发强烈却范围有限的地震。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME will lift itself onto its hind legs and rapidly beat its wings to scare off foes tougher than it is. It can uses its wings to help channel strong vibrations through its pointed forelegs to create powerful, albeit localized, tremors.

entry: 剑刃与拍动的双翼，奏出迷人的金属乐曲。POKENAME再用缎带卷起沙尘暴，困住目标。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Its blade and flapping wings create an enthralling, metallic song. POKENAME then spins up a dust storm with its ribbon to trap its victims.

entry: POKENAME不够快，追不上猎物，也太重而飞不了。它用强翅掀起沙暴，悄悄接近，痛击敌人。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME is not fast enough to chase down its prey and is too heavy to fly. It uses its powerful wings to kick up a Sandstorm for it to sneak up and clobber foes.

entry: 这些宝可梦最常在猛烈沙暴中出现，捕食迷失其中的宝可梦。夜里钻进沙中休息，只露触角。
author: chibitales
source: These Pokémon are most often seen during intense sandstorms hunting the Pokémon that get lost within. When night falls, they burrow into the sand to rest, leaving only their antennae exposed.

entry: POKENAME用身体发出的绿光引来虫属性宝可梦，再以火焰烧死它们。它似乎也很喜欢熔化沙粒，塑成玻璃雕像。
author: mistymagius
source: The green light from POKENAME's body draws in bug Pokémon before incinerating them with its flames. It seems to enjoy making glass sculptures by melting and shaping sand.

entry: POKENAME以翅膀掀起沙暴，趁敌人视线受阻，用锐利金属爪攻击。自己的眼睛有红色护罩，不论空气中沙尘多大，都看得见。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can use its wings to whip up sandstorms, then strike foes with its sharp metal claws while their vision is obscured. Its own eyes are protected by red coverings, enabling it to see regardless of how much dust is in the air.

entry: POKENAME脸上的红色罩层，带来外星来客般的神秘感。在沙漠夜空下起舞时，它也能挡沙。
author: quackquackattack
source: The red cover on POKENAME's face gives them an extraterrestrial mystique. In desert climates, it shields them from sand as they dance under the night sky.

entry: 它在花田筑巢。受威胁时，就用带毒旋风迎敌。
author: lemgambino
source: It makes its nest amongst fields of flowers. When threatened, it attacks enemies with a poisonous whirlwind.

entry: POKENAME振翅快得惊人，体形虽大，动作却快得看不清。它在沙漠家园扬起太多沙尘，一度被认为是活沙暴，直到终于被清晰摄下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wings flap at incredible speeds, making it move blindingly fast in spite of its size. It kicks up so much dust in its desert home that it was at one point believed to be a living sandstorm until it was properly recorded on film.

entry: 它高速旋转身体，迅速钻入或钻出沙漠。上方藤蔓尖端像大颚蚁的头，骗来大颚蚁的某些天敌，再反过来捕食。
author: infinex21
source: It spins its body at high speeds to quickly burrow or emerge from desert sands. The tips of its upper vines resemble Trapinch heads to trick certain predators of Trapinch in order to prey upon them.

entry: 听到POKENAME尖刺振动的独特高音，就该躲藏或退开。它会将尖刺连同大量内脏一并喷出，猛烈甩动，刺穿猎物。
author: sk372
source: If one hears the distinct high-pitched sound of POKENAME's spines vibrating, one should hide or retreat; it ejects these spines along with much of its innards to swing them about wildly and spear prey.

entry: POKENAME伪装成威风的龙属性宝可梦，却常因笨重翅膀受嘲笑。不想承担龙属性宝可梦繁琐照料的爱好者，会领养它当伙伴，好好宠爱。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME disguises itself to mirror majestic Dragon-type Pokémon, but is frequently mocked for its bulky wings. Fans of Dragon-types that want to avoid the high maintenance Dragon-types require will adopt a POKENAME as a happily pampered companion.

entry: 走进POKENAME领地的训练家，声称看见古怪身影在沙中跟踪。那其实是伪装的它，正用沙暴吓退擅闯者。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Trainers who enter POKENAME's domain claim to see a strange figure stalking them through the sand. This figure is a disguised POKENAME using Sandstorm to try to scare off trespassers.

entry: POKENAME振翅片刻就能召来沙暴。夜里会向沙地吐出道道火焰，烧出暖床睡觉。
author: fiordaliso
source: With a flap of its wings, POKENAME can summon a sandstorm in a matter of moments. When night falls, it breathes tongues of fire onto the sand to create a warm bed to sleep on.

entry: POKENAME将全身充满空气，再缓缓释放，发出持续嗡鸣。随后高频振翅，产生催眠的和声。翅膀能帮助悬浮，但它主要依靠地磁。
author: ludacriswell
source: POKENAME fills its entire body up with air and slowly releases it to create a drone-like sound. Then, it vibrates its wings at high frequencies to create hypnotizing harmonics. POKENAME's wings help it levitate, but it relies more so on geomagnetism.

entry: POKENAME速度快，是沙漠中的凶猛对手，但没有大翅膀，威胁性远不如对应的蜈蚣蜻蜓。
author: c0mm0n.adv0cate
source: POKENAME's speed makes it a fierce desert foe, but without its large wings it's far less threatening than its counterpart, Scoligon.

entry: POKENAME虽常待在地面哼神秘旋律，却很擅飞行。它将松软沙粒附在羽毛上，扩大翼展，进一步提高飞行本领。
author: ocxin
source: Despite usually staying on the ground and humming a mysterious melody, POKENAME are talented flyers. They attach fluffy desert sand to their plumage to increase their wingspan and improve their abilities even further.

entry: POKENAME用翅膀扬起尘土，再操纵沙尘，衬托自己的舞步。翅膀快速拍动时发出的嗡鸣，则成了舞蹈的伴奏。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will kick up dust with its wings and then manipulate it to serve as an accentuation of its dance routines. The hum created by the rapid beating of its wings serves as the musical backdrop to its dancing.

entry: POKENAME大多时间埋在地下，背上真菌通过菌丝网，从其他沙漠植物获取养分。只有最猛烈的沙暴时才钻出，将孢子散入风中。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME remain buried underground most of the time, the fungus on their back feeding on other desert plants through a network of mycelium. They only dig themselves up during the fiercest sandstorms to scatter spores into the wind.

entry: POKENAME谨慎捕猎，藏在沙下，等猎物靠近。它也速度极快，高速振翅会发出独特的虫鸣般声音。
author: alexgriller
source: POKENAME is a cautious hunter that hides beneath the sand until prey draws near. It is also a very fast Pokémon, flapping its wings at high speeds that produce a distinctive, bug-like sound.

entry: 沙暴中，POKENAME会保护可能被吹走的小宝可梦。它展开翅膀，扇得极快，让周围空气平静；据说翼声启发了一首著名管弦乐曲。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: During sandstorms, POKENAME will shelter small Pokémon that are at risk of being blown away. They unfold their wings and flap them so fast that the air around them becomes calm; the noise created is said to have inspired a famous orchestral piece.

entry: 这种宝可梦扇动小翅膀，能在身边制造小沙暴。它有极耐用又有弹性的皮肤自保。
author: lydiaprower8
source: This Pokémon is able to make small sandstorms around itself by flapping its tiny wings. It has very durable, elastic skin to protect itself.

entry: POKENAME看似冷漠，其实很在乎训练家和队友。即使野生个体，也会照顾同群伙伴。扇翅声如同放克音乐。
author: lydiaprower8
source: Despite its apathetic-looking appearance, POKENAME cares deeply about its Trainer and teammates. Even a wild POKENAME takes care of its packmates. Its flapping wings sound like funk music.

entry: POKENAME扬起美丽闪亮的沙暴，数千细小晶片撕向对手。但这也会伤到自己的眼睛，没保护装备就不肯使出这招。
author: ripple.star
source: POKENAME whisks beautiful, shimmering sandstorms that tear into opponents with thousands of tiny crystal shards. As this can also damage POKENAME's own eyes, it refuses to perform this technique without protective equipment.

entry: POKENAME藏沙下伏击猎物，再用爪抓住。高速振翅，能产生凶猛的沙龙卷。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME hides beneath the sand to ambush its prey, which it then seizes with its claws. By vibrating its wings at high speed, it can generate threatening sand tornadoes.

entry: POKENAME在沙漠训练，出拳打穿自己制造的沙暴。若附近有飞机下坠，就会飞上去，帮助着陆。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME train in the desert, punching holes in sandstorms they make. Should a plane go down nearby, they will fly up and help it land.

entry: POKENAME始终将幼崽带在尾上。危急时，会挥尾，把孩子当棍棒用。
author: atlas3339098
source: POKENAME carries its young on its tail at all times. When things are desperate, it will swing its tail using its child like a club.

entry: POKENAME横冲沙漠，掩藏真容，常被误认成沙暴。有时还会吸起穿山鼠，将它们远远射出。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are often mistaken for sandstorms, barreling through deserts while concealing their appearance. They will sometimes suck up Sandshrew, launching them far into the distance.

entry: 它潜伏在沙漠迷途者的影子里，轻声低语，先逼疯猎物再吃下。夜里，有时能在影子中看见红眼。
author: h0bojoe
source: It lurks in the shadows of those lost in the desert, softly whispering to its prey to drive it mad before devouring it. At night, its red eyes can sometimes be seen within the shadows themselves.

entry: POKENAME的腿原本太脆弱，终于长出了护腿。它崇拜狂欢浪舞鸭，也想学会流水旋舞。
author: dodoowner_
