source: POKENAME eventually got leggings, as its legs were very vulnerable before. It admires Quaquaval and wants to learn Aqua Step.

entry: 据说POKENAME是最美的宝可梦，引来嫉妒与挑战。它能以刺拳打击对手，同时释放平息敌意的柔和气息，让敌人忘记为何而战。
author: shyguy11011
source: POKENAME is said to be the most beautiful of all the Pokémon, drawing jealousy from others and provoking them to fight. It can jab its opponents while releasing a soothing aura that calms hostility, causing foes to forget why they were fighting.

entry: POKENAME的水蓝鳞片在水下闪亮，无意间引来天敌。天敌靠近，就喷一团墨逃走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have aqua-colored scales that glitter while underwater and unintentionally attracts predators. Whenever a predator comes near them, they shoot out a cloud of ink before escaping.

entry: 雷雨中，POKENAME将角朝天举起。雷击过后，鳞片会泛出夺目的粉色与蔚蓝光芒。
author: .izik
source: During thunderstorms, POKENAME raises its horn toward the sky. After a lightning strike, its scales emit a dazzling pink and azure glow.

entry: POKENAME身姿优雅，以水构成的精巧翅膀，在水与花丰富的地方翩飞，轻易找到最甜花朵的蜜。
author: wolfbrine
source: With delicate wings made of water, the graceful POKENAME flutters where flowers and water abound, seeking out nectar from the sweetest blooms with ease.

entry: POKENAME大多时间待在水下，用镰刀状四肢采水草。偶尔飞出水面，美得让岸边观众看呆。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of its time underwater, harvesting aquatic plants with its scythe-like limbs. On rare occasions, it flies above the surface, stunning spectators on the shoreline with its beauty.

entry: 尾巴划出协调优美的弧线，让它游得惊人优雅迅速。有则神话称，POKENAME以求雨召水，平息狩猎部族间的战争。
author: bobosmith01
source: Its tails swirl in beautiful coordinated arcs, allowing it to swim with surprising grace and speed. One myth mentions how POKENAME quelled a war between hunting tribes by summoning water with Rain Dance.

entry: POKENAME全身覆有半透明冰鳞。这些稀有鳞片备受追捧，被用于制作华美礼服。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's body is sheathed in translucent icy scales. These rare scales are highly sought after to craft magnificent dresses.

entry: 一点污垢就会令它恼火。美丽外貌加上流畅迅捷的泳姿，让它在华丽大赛中备受赞赏。
author: capwolfbane
source: This Pokémon is irritated by the slightest grime. It is prized in contests for its beauty and swift and fluid swimming.

entry: POKENAME努力游得优雅，却容易兴奋得在水中飞快游动。观众觉得它活泼有朝气的性格，和美丽明亮的鳞片一样迷人。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME make an effort to swim gracefully, but are easily overcome with excitement and will zip through the water. Observers find their lively, spirited nature as charming as their beautiful, radiant scales.

entry: POKENAME体内有热囊，能将鳞片外侧的水暖热。红色长鳍如舞动火焰般起伏，身后蒸汽在水面飘荡。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME possess internal heat sacs that warm the water immediately surrounding their scaled bodies. Their long, red fins ripple like dancing flames, trailing clouds of steam across the water's surface.

entry: POKENAME住在深湖底，只有鱼少时才上岸捕猎。刮动刀刃上的锐鳞，会迸出小片彩虹火花。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME inhabits the bottom of deep lakes, only breaching onto land to hunt when fish are scarce. Scraping the sharp scales on its blades creates small showers of rainbow-colored sparks.

entry: 古代文明曾将POKENAME视为神明。传说捡起它脱落的鳞片，就能得到美貌，皮肤瑕疵与伤疤瞬间消失。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME were once regarded as deities by ancient civilizations. Legends say that picking up a fallen scale from one of these Pokémon would bestow beauty upon those who find it, instantly clearing their skin of blemishes and scars.

entry: POKENAME每月蜕鳞一次，新鳞更艳丽、美观、耐久。它极爱美，怕弄脏或损伤外貌，尽可能避免战斗。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME sheds its scales once a month, replacing the old ones with new scales that are even more colorful, beautiful, and durable. A very vain Pokémon, it avoids combat whenever possible for fear of getting dirty or damaging its appearance.

entry: POKENAME心地善良，遇见任何困境中的训练家或宝可梦都会帮忙。它让虹彩鳞片轻轻闪烁，真心用美丽光芒鼓舞对方。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME are benevolent creatures that will help any trainer or Pokémon they find in distress. They make their rainbow-colored scales shimmer gently, using the beautiful light in a heartfelt attempt to cheer them up.

entry: POKENAME体形小，游姿优雅，能轻松穿过密集鱼宝可梦群。它引导迷途船只去附近岛屿，再游回深水。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's small size helps them swim gracefully in the water, easily slipping past tight schools of fish Pokémon. They lead lost boats to nearby islands before swimming back into the deep.

entry: POKENAME头发在陆地摆动时，会泛起微弱虹光。它很少离水，只有为补充养分、吃落叶时才上岸。
author: sk372
source: The hair on POKENAME's head casts a faint rainbow shimmer when swung about on land. It rarely comes out of the water, only breaching onto land to get supplemental sustenance through eating fallen leaves.

entry: POKENAME行踪极隐秘，只在荒野深处最隐蔽的河湖出现。它散发清凉雾气，吸引野生宝可梦来到湖边，和谐共居。
author: sneakywalrus0
source: POKENAME are incredibly secretive, found only deep in the wild in the most hidden of rivers and lakes. POKENAME emanate a cooling and refreshing mist that draw wild Pokémon to the edges of these lakes to live harmoniously together.

entry: POKENAME天性极平静，背上火焰外围裹着一层始终沸腾的水。夜里，它们聚在纯净湖中，炽亮泡泡飞上天空，景象动人。
author: elevn.
source: POKENAME is very calm by nature, a layer of water encompassing flames is constantly boiling on its back. At night, POKENAME gather in pure water lakes offering a spectacle of incandescent bubbles flying in the sky.

entry: POKENAME一生隐居潮湿洞窟，几乎每分每秒都用来织丝迷宫。光线恰当照上蛛网时，会泛出彩虹的所有颜色。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME spend their lives isolated in damp caves, with nearly every minute of their time dedicated to crafting a labyrinth of silk. If light strikes these webs just right, they glow in every color of the rainbow.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，双翼灿烂闪耀。外表虽冷淡严肃，却花很多时间梳理身体，维持、炫耀天生美貌。
author: pattybgoode
source: As POKENAME flies, its wings sparkle brilliantly. Despite its distant, stern look, it spends a lot of time grooming itself to maintain and show off its natural beauty.

entry: POKENAME性情颇平和，会梳理羽毛，照看年幼鸟宝可梦。它向上喷水，造出淋洒的喷泉，让小家伙们在下面玩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a rather placid personality, spending time preening and watching over younger avian Pokémon. It spits a stream of water upward to create a showering fountain for the little ones to play under.

entry: POKENAME周身小鳞片明亮闪烁。放出强电前，会一波波发光。
author: .izik
source: Tiny scales around POKENAME's body shimmer brightly. Just before unleashing powerful bursts of electricity, they glow in waves.

entry: 水从POKENAME羽毛流下，闪出夺目光彩。长途飞行前，它会潜水补充水分，在身后留下小彩虹，供有幸看见的人欣赏。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Water flows off of a POKENAME's feathers in dazzling displays of glistening light. POKENAME dive into water to rehydrate before long flights, creating small rainbows behind them for anyone lucky enough to catch a glimpse.

entry: 无与伦比的优雅，让POKENAME轻易赢得评委喜爱，是追求成功的协调训练家的首选。经常能在湖边见它用树果汁梳理耳毛。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its unmatched grace easily wins over judges' hearts, making POKENAME a top pick for Coordinators seeking success. It is often spotted by lakesides, grooming its ear fur with Berry juice.

entry: POKENAME十分危险，以抢夺驶入水域者的货物而恶名远扬。美丽的海妖般歌声将旅人诱离船只，它便用强腿跳上船，偷光食物。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME are dangerous Pokémon, infamous for taking cargo from those who enter their waters. Their beautiful, siren-like songs lure travelers off their boats, allowing them to use their powerful legs to leap aboard and steal all the food.

entry: POKENAME虽是害兽，许多人仍容许它侵入住处。人们曾以为是极美外貌所致，科学家直到最近才发现，原因是它能安抚周围生灵。
author: santon5512
source: Despite being pests, many allow POKENAME to infest their homes, a phenomenon that was once believed to be due to their immense beauty. Only recently have scientists discovered that this effect is caused by their ability to calm those around them.

entry: 最美的POKENAME极其值钱。传闻合众有座大庄园，喷泉中有超过30座它的雕像，还有几只活的，在雕像间嬉游。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: The most beautiful POKENAME are very valuable. There are rumours of a large estate in Unova that contains a fountain with over 30 statues of POKENAME, as well as several live ones, playfully swimming amongst them.

entry: POKENAME头冠赋予它奇特权威。靠近争吵者，双方就会忍不住向它解释纠纷，再由它默默演示解决办法。
author: .jerden
source: The crown on POKENAME's head grants it a strange authority. If POKENAME approaches people who are squabbling, both parties will be compelled to explain their dispute to POKENAME, which will then wordlessly demonstrate a way to resolve their dispute.

entry: POKENAME一有机会就爱炫耀华美尾巴。背上散出的花粉会清洁尾部表面，确保始终光亮。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to show off their majestic tail whenever they get the chance. The pollen they release from their backs cleans the surface of their tail to ensure that it is always shiny.

entry: POKENAME在潟湖岸边挖洞，将入口部分淹水，防止其他宝可梦轻易进入。它善游泳，能长时间深潜觅食。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their burrows along the shores of lagoons, partially flooding the entrance to make them harder for other Pokémon to access. They are adept swimmers, feeding deep underwater in long dives.

entry: POKENAME待在深湖底，唱迷人歌曲。人和宝可梦都曾受催眠，追随歌声而溺亡。
author: porpoisemerchant
source: POKENAME sits at the bottom of deep lakes and sings enchanting songs. People and Pokémon alike have been hypnotized into drowning from following after its music.

entry: 从丑丑鱼融合体进化后，POKENAME食性剧变，不再见石头泥巴就吃，而是只吃贵金属。这使它拥有举世闻名的独特光泽。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's eating habits drastically change when it evolves from a Feebas fusion, from devouring any stone or mud it comes across to only eating precious metals as its diet. This change gives it the signature shine it's known all over the world for.

entry: POKENAME在潟湖岸边挖洞，将入口部分淹水，防止其他宝可梦轻易进入。它善游泳，能长时间深潜觅食。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME make their burrows along the shores of lagoons, partially flooding the entrance to make them harder for other Pokémon to access. They are adept swimmers, feeding deep underwater in long dives.

entry: POKENAME看见水中家园有两只宝可梦打架，就会强行分开，恢复和平。小的用钳抓，大的则用长而强健的尾巴缠住。
author: .jerden
source: If POKENAME sees two Pokémon fighting in its underwater home, it will forcefully separate them to restore peace. It will grab smaller Pokémon using its pincers, while larger Pokémon will be wrapped in its long and powerful tail.

entry: POKENAME坚硬金属鳞片闪着虹光。虹彩翅膀不用于飞行，而在水下推进，其他肢体几乎不动。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's hard metallic scales glimmer with rainbow light. It does not use its iridescent wings to fly, but instead to drive itself forward underwater, with its other limbs barely even moving.

entry: POKENAME是许多水族馆的镇馆宝可梦，花纹甲壳美丽，吸引众多爱好者。它爱干净，大半天都在寻找、清除饲养区长出的藻。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are the prize Pokémon of many aquariums, the beauty of their patterned shells drawing many admirers. They are fastidious cleaners, spending most of their day seeking out algal growth within their enclosure and clearing it away.

entry: POKENAME虽主要水栖，也能在陆地行动。背上的美丽鳞片让它在任何地形都能迅速滚动，以强大身体冲撞、压倒对手。
author: fiordaliso
source: Although POKENAME is mainly an aquatic Pokémon, it is also capable of moving on land. The beautiful scales on its back allow it to roll quickly across any type of terrain. It charges at its opponents, overwhelming them with its powerful body.

entry: POKENAME进入用户电脑，就会自作主张，按自己的审美改背景、颜色设置和文件排列。用户若不喜欢，就会很生气。
author: sk372
source: When visiting a user's computer, POKENAME takes it upon itself to alter their background, color settings and file arrangement to suit its sense of aesthetics and beauty. It gets very upset if the user does not like the changes it provides.

entry: POKENAME美丽，也同样残忍，常出现在人多的湖泊，淹死抓到的游泳者。它把这当轻松乐趣，近年还学会了诱捕。
author: deer_witch
source: POKENAME is as cruel as it is beautiful. It is known to frequent populated lakes and drown any human it catches swimming. POKENAME sees this as light fun and has adopted luring tactics in recent years.

entry: POKENAME住在宁静、洁净的湖中。感到水有杂质，就跃上水面，以爪中特殊液体净化。游客会专程来湖边，观赏它的美。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME live in lakes with a peaceful atmosphere and clean water. If they sense impurities in the water, they will hop onto the surface to purify it with a special liquid from their paws. Tourists travel to these lakes to witness their beauty.

entry: 它们住在异域岛屿，常游往邻岛觅更多食物。双鳍让POKENAME特别善游，驯养个体天气热时，还会像扇子一样给训练家扇凉。
author: leandermalurt
source: They live on exotic islands, and frequently swim to nearby islands to find more food. The double fins make POKENAME exceptionally good swimmers. Tame POKENAME use their fins like fans to cool down their Trainers when the temperature rises.

entry: POKENAME主要栖居冰冷海上商路的深处，在沉没货船中群居。鲜明体色警告入侵者远离，为保护家人，会冻结威胁者周围的盐水。
author: ghostslythe
source: Found mainly in the depths of icy sea trade lanes, POKENAME set up colonies aboard sunken cargo vessels. Their bright coloration serves to warn intruders to stay away, and to protect their families they freeze salt water around threats.

entry: POKENAME的虹彩鳞片展开时夺目迷人。它用冰爪整理，确保始终美丽。鳞片还散出柔光，凝望便觉舒心。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have iridescent scales that fan out in a dazzling display. Their frosty claws pick at their scales to ensure that they always look beautiful. Their scales also release a soft glow that is comforting to stare at.

entry: 它真正的美貌，常让人类和其他宝可梦为之倾倒。为了躲开不想要的关注，它经常藏进身上坚韧的海带丛后。
author: mundane_frog
source: Its true beauty often bewitches people and other Pokémon. It regularly hides behind its sturdy kelp growths to avoid unwanted attention.

entry: POKENAME以令人着迷的优雅游过冰水。虽美得惊人，性情却疏远冷淡，在冰湖中轻松滑行时，常完全无视观众。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME swim through icy waters with mesmerizing grace. Despite their breathtaking beauty, they possess a distant, cold demeanor, often ignoring onlookers entirely as they glide effortlessly through freezing lakes.

entry: POKENAME游过数字环境，触角快速旋转，吸收时尚与美容数据。穿行网站时，定期会弹出时装和美容产品广告。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's antennae spin rapidly while it swims through digital environments, absorbing data on fashion and beauty. As it moves through websites, pop-ups regarding fashion and beauty products periodically appear.

entry: POKENAME能随意调整背部鳞片的颜色与反光程度。在水中时，鳞片反射光线，让从上方观察的捕食者几乎看不见POKENAME。
author: staghorn
source: A POKENAME can adjust the color and reflectivity of its back scales at will. When viewed in water from above, the scales catch the light and render the POKENAME nearly invisible to predators.

entry: POKENAME腿上鳞片战斗时格外夺目。人和宝可梦会前来观战，看它踢打敌人时，虹彩鳞片映着自然光。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: The scales covering POKENAME's legs are dazzling to behold in combat. People and Pokémon will observe battles involving this Pokémon to see its beautiful rainbow-colored scales catch the natural light as it batters its opponent with kicks.

entry: 比起战斗，POKENAME更爱在宁静湖中冥想。但谁攻击家园，就会遭到威力惊人的踢击。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME prefers meditating in serene lakes over fighting. However, it will unleash devastating kicks on anyone who attacks its home.

entry: 它是优雅的舞者，会在湖面表演。POKENAME十分害羞，头侧敏感的触角一察觉人类，就立刻潜入水中。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: It is a graceful dancer, performing on the surface of lakes. POKENAME is an incredibly shy Pokémon and will dive into the water the moment it senses humans with the sensitive antennae that adorn the side of its head.

entry: POKENAME虽护着训练家，却相当无忧无虑，常被自己造出的泡泡迷得出神。
author: headizemptee75250
source: Despite their protectiveness of their Trainers, POKENAME are quite carefree and will often get lost in awe as they watch the bubbles they make.

entry: 据说POKENAME的外貌不只反映实力，也反映倾注的心意有多深。真正美丽的个体不仅强大，也被视为训练家用心与正直的证明。
author: thatlittletwerp
source: It is said that POKENAME's appearance reflects not just its strength, but also the depths of their devotion. Truly beautiful POKENAME not only possess great power, they are also seen as a testament to their Trainer's dedication and integrity.

entry: 据说野生POKENAME最爱在湖畔栖息地的水面起舞，仿佛全然无视重力。有幸看见的人，据说会短暂达到涅槃之境。
author: thatlittletwerp
source: It is said that a favorite pastime of wild POKENAME is to dance across the water of their lakeside habitats as if ignoring gravity altogether. Those lucky enough to witness such a spectacle are said to have briefly achieved a state of nirvana.

entry: POKENAME似乎是栖居破旧石头的优雅灵魂，通常在河湖边休息。据说向石头敬献礼物，它就会现身，唤醒赠礼者的内在美。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears to be a graceful spirit inhabiting a shoddy-looking stone, typically seen resting near lakes and rivers. It's said that if one honors its stone with a gift, POKENAME will manifest and awaken the person's inner beauty.

entry: POKENAME由108名溺亡女性的灵魂构成，以诱人动作引男性走向相同命运。比起气质阳刚的训练家，它更受气质柔美的训练家欢迎。
author: deer_witch
source: Comprised of the spirits of 108 drowned women, POKENAME uses its alluring movements to draw men to the same fate. It is more popular with feminine trainers than it is with masculine trainers.

entry: POKENAME水下战斗比陆地更快、更果断。搜索队会雇它，借感知波导的能力寻找失踪者。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME fights underwater, its movements are even faster and more decisive than when it battles on land. Search teams employ it because its ability to sense auras lets it find people who have gone missing.

entry: 色彩斑斓的尾巴上，鳞片坚如钢铁，能让它使出极强水流尾。POKENAME是出色斗士，不断在栖居湖岸训练。
author: fiordaliso
source: The scales on its colorful tail are as tough as steel and allow it to unleash extremely powerful Aqua Tail attacks. POKENAME is an exceptional fighter that trains constantly on the shores of the lake where it dwells.

entry: POKENAME在偏僻处捕食海洋宝可梦维生。它爱珍珠，藏在窝里，鳞片光泽似乎与一生收集的珍珠数量有关。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME make their living by hunting marine Pokémon in secluded locations. They love pearls and keep them in their nest; there seems to be a link between the shimmer of their scales and how many pearls they have collected in their lifetime.

entry: POKENAME背上有极美花朵，最爱炫耀。它常参加选美比赛，向大批观众展示。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have a magnificently beautiful flower on their back that they love to flaunt. They are often entered into beauty competitions where they get to show off to a large crowd.

entry: POKENAME懒懒待在公共场所，耐心容忍人群聚来欣赏闪亮鳞片。人们送上食物，想讨它欢心，它却很少回应，最多点个头。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will laze about in public places, patiently tolerating the crowds that gather to admire their gleaming scales. People will offer gifts of food in an attempt to gain POKENAME's favor, but it rarely responds with more than a nod.

entry: 在丰缘与城都海域，POKENAME筑起被统称为“水手末日”的沙洲。它们绕圈游动，只露尾巴，将任何试图通过的船都撞毁。
author: ghostslythe
source: In the oceans of Hoenn and Johto, POKENAME have built sandbars known collectively as Sailor's Doom. They circle only with their tails above water, and wreck any craft attempting to pass.

entry: 画家画美纳斯，是因为它美；画POKENAME，却是因为受到催眠。它体内有颗能量球，源源不断散出令人平静的脉动。
author: soup1900
source: While paintings of Milotic are created for its beauty, paintings of POKENAME are made due to the artists being hypnotized by them. The inside of their bodies contain a ball of energy that radiates an endless supply of calming pulses.

entry: POKENAME以美貌闻名，也会对举止丑陋的对象相当凶。人们主要见它因此与暴鲤龙、巨牙鲨打架。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is known to be both beautiful and rather aggressive towards those it deems behaving in an ugly manner. It's primarily been seen picking fights with Gyarados and Sharpedo in this regard.

entry: POKENAME极少被目击，一被注意，就在灿烂彩光中瞬移离开。消失后极少会留下一片虹彩鳞，收藏市场上的价格高得离谱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sightings are extremely rare, as it teleports away in a flash of radiant colors when noticed. Its disappearance rarely leaves behind one of its iridescent scales behind, which fetch obscene prices on collectors' markets.

entry: POKENAME在干旱沙漠安家，定居后极少需要移动。小宝可梦会把它当水源，聚来提供食物，换取栖身之处与保护。
author: jadey.1557
source: POKENAME make their home in arid desert environments. POKENAME rarely need to move once established, as smaller Pokémon will flock to them as a source of water, providing food in exchange for shelter and protection.

entry: POKENAME满身美鳞也极耐久。它十分保护同湖的幼年宝可梦，谁威胁它们，就以坚硬身体猛撞入侵者。
author: .jerden
source: The beautiful scales that cover POKENAME's body are also incredibly durable. POKENAME is very protective of young Pokémon that live in the same lake as it does and will slam its hard body against any intruder that threatens them.

entry: POKENAME倾向在湖岸筑巢，靠长尾优雅游泳。额角分泌麻痹毒液，用来防御其他宝可梦。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME tends to den along lake shores, where it swims gracefully with the help of its long tail. The horn on its forehead secretes a paralyzing venom that it uses to defend itself against other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME极罕见，大多在深处水下洞窟发现。扇子由独特鳞片构成，常引来偷猎者。它优雅战斗，喷出滚烫水波，再斩向敌人。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are incredibly rare, most being found deep in caves underwater. Poachers often seek out POKENAME because their fans are made of their distinctive scales. They battle gracefully, shooting scalding pulses of water and slicing at foes.

entry: 战争爆发时，POKENAME用小型移动单元围住整个战区。自己到中央后，单元便发出安抚波，流向中心，再经它向外辐射。
author: soup1900
source: When war arises, POKENAME sets up a perimeter with its small mobile units around the whole conflict. Once it places itself in the center of the area, the units deploy calming waves that flow towards the center and radiate back out through POKENAME.

entry: 据说，剑鞘上流光溢彩的鳞片能平复狂躁的心。POKENAME正好借此安抚猎物，再出手袭击。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: The prismatic scales on its scabbard are said to calm violent hearts; perfect for pacifying POKENAME's victims before striking.

entry: POKENAME与同类以角和尾决斗，胜者统治湖泊，败者被迫离开。身体释放的毒已被用于合成除草剂，清除入侵藻类。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME challenges other POKENAME to duels of horns and tails, with the winner claiming dominion over the lake while the loser is forced to leave. The toxins its body releases have been synthesized to create herbicides and eliminate invasive algae.

entry: POKENAME极优雅，通常住在湖岸，但性情让它对入侵者很凶。为守家园，会毫不犹豫地以带电尾巴强攻。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME are incredibly graceful beings that usually inhabit the shores of lakes. Their temperament makes them aggressive toward intruders. They will not hesitate to strike with powerful attacks from their electrified tails to defend their home.

entry: 这种宝可梦住在深湖，凶猛守家，因此被视为湖泊守护者。双翼如彩绘玻璃般闪亮，起飞时发出舒缓旋律。
author: infinex21
source: This Pokémon lives in deep lakes and will defend its home ferociously, leading it to be seen as a lake guardian. Its wings shimmer brightly like painted glass and produce a soothing melody when it takes flight.

entry: 水手间流传，POKENAME夺目的外貌与气息有神秘疗愈力量。别看优雅纤弱，它强得能压毁潜艇，鳞片都不移一片。
author: epping_forest
source: The dazzling appearance and aura of POKENAME is said among sailors to have mysterious healing powers. Despite its graceful and delicate looks, it's strong enough to crush a submarine without displacing a single scale.

entry: 特殊的鳞片让POKENAME无论潜入水中还是跃出水面，都丝毫不减速度。出色的飞行与游泳本领使它成为优秀的猎手。
author: phantom640
source: Thanks to its scales, POKENAME can dive in and out of the water without losing any speed. Its excellent flying and swimming make it a great hunter.

entry: 它住在海中，悦耳歌声便是靠近的信号。人们认为，人鱼传说正源于它。
author: melodydelune
source: Living in the seas, you will know it is near by its harmonious singing. It is thought this Pokémon is the origin of the myth of mermaids.

entry: POKENAME从毛中分泌滑液，遇水就迅速起泡，如同肥皂。战斗时，它借皂液熟练滑过战场，还能让对手打滑。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME secrete a slippery liquid from their fur that quickly lathers into a soap-like consistency when in contact with water. In battle, this soapy liquid allows them to slide expertly around the battlefield while causing their opponents to slip.

entry: POKENAME闪亮尾巴摆动时，美得让人屏息；真被击中，更会让人喘不过气。湖岸有人争吵，它可能出来平息纷争，办法却是让所有人一起逃命。
author: .jerden
source: The swinging of POKENAME's gleaming tail is breathtaking to behold, and even more breathtaking to be struck by. If people squabble on the shore of a lake, POKENAME may emerge to end their fighting, but only by uniting everyone in fleeing from it.

entry: POKENAME行踪难觅，使用力量时，鳞片会闪出灿烂色彩。据说它的家乡，有无边无际的美丽海洋。
author: bobosmith01
source: When the elusive POKENAME uses its powers, its scales sparkle in radiant colors. POKENAME's home is said to be a realm of endless beautiful ocean.

entry: POKENAME缓缓走遍地区，造访大小水域。觉得池塘、湖泊等需要改善，就会用强肢挖掘，重塑形状。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME trudges across the region slowly, visiting various bodies of water large and small. It uses its powerful limbs to dig out and reshape ponds, lakes and the like that it feels need improvement.

entry: POKENAME盘踞茂密森林深处的湖，只在深夜出水。靠近它，会陷入不安宁的睡眠，醒后感知颜色的能力也会扭曲。
author: sk372
source: A creature that haunts lakes deep within lush forests, POKENAME only rises from the water in the dark of night. Being near it causes others to fall into a restless slumber; after waking, the victim's ability to perceive colors will be warped.

entry: POKENAME将炮口朝向瀑布，吸水入体。充能完毕，全身鳞片会泛出棱镜般的美丽彩光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME faces its cannon toward waterfalls to absorb water into its body. When fully charged, the scales on its body glow in a beautiful prism of color.

entry: 它们潜伏湖边，用美丽鳞片与醉人花朵引来各种猎物和敌人。一靠近，就散毒孢子，用蛇形下半身将其拖入水中。
author: infinex21
source: They use their beautiful scales and intoxicating flowers to lure in all manner of prey and foe while they lurk near the edges of lakes. When one draws near, they will scatter toxic spores and use their serpentine lower half to drag them underwater.

entry: POKENAME在野外稀少，却是选美比赛争相寻找的对象。鳞片闪如宝石，越来越常被用于首饰。
author: ghostslythe
source: Highly sought after for beauty contests, POKENAME are rare to find in the wild. Their scales sparkle like gems, and have been used more frequently in jewelry.

entry: POKENAME长久因惊人美貌受到追逐，只让它变得极度警惕人类。野生个体愿意靠近，已被视为莫大福气；若还允许收服，更是如此。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have long since been sought after for their incredible beauty, which only caused them to become incredibly wary of humans. It is considered an incredible boon to be approached by a wild POKENAME, even more so if allowed to capture it.

entry: 古老传说称，POKENAME被创造来保护深海种族。核心的空灵光芒透过胸前窗口，投出美丽倒影。
author: chibitales
source: An old legend describes POKENAME being created to protect a deep sea-dwelling race. Ethereal light from their core glows brightly through the window on their chest, casting beautiful reflections.

entry: POKENAME住在湖底与海底热液喷口附近。它用美丽双翼在喷口周围散鳞，标记领地。
author: grannyjojophone
source: POKENAME lives at the bottom of lakes and oceans near hydrothermal vents. It uses its beautiful wings to scatter its scales around the vents to mark territory.

entry: POKENAME面朝下伏在湖中，双翼展开如美丽花朵，等猎物靠近。一旦接近，周围水便会升至极高温度，沸腾起来。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lies face down in lakes with its wings spread like a beautiful flower, waiting for prey to draw near. Once they approach, the surrounding water boils at incredibly high temperatures.

entry: POKENAME舍去后腿，换来美丽尾巴。彩绘玻璃般的花纹让偷猎者争相捕捉。它刚获得视力不久，无助又可爱，被视为理想宠物。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME discards their hind legs for a beautiful tail, heavily sought after by poachers for its stained glass-like patterns. Because it only gained its vision recently, its helplessness and cuteness makes for an ideal pet.

entry: 不同于许多多头宝可梦，POKENAME两颗头特别合作、和睦，但仍同样爱争取关注。它也比进化前聪明得多。
author: beatdoof
source: Unlike many other Pokémon with multiple heads, POKENAME's two heads are notably cooperative and get along with each other, though each head still equally vies for attention. It's also much more intelligent than it was before evolving.

entry: POKENAME智力卓越，记忆无可挑剔，外形极美，常出现在艺术作品中。但别激怒它，它的破坏力相当惊人，最常掀起猛烈洪水。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME has exceptional intellect, impeccable memory, and a truly beautiful form, which is often seen in artworks. However, don't enrage it, as it is more than capable of destruction, with violent flooding being its most often-used method.

entry: POKENAME造雾隐藏身形，却会被来到湖边的老人吸引。它用精神力帮助老人重温回忆，短暂找回怀旧之感。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME form a fog that obscures their presence, but are drawn to the elderly when they visit lakes. They help the elderly relive memories using their psychic powers, restoring a sense of nostalgia for a moment.

entry: POKENAME睡在湖底，似乎能一睡100年才自然醒。据说它会实现尊重自然者的愿望，惩罚污染水中家园的人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sleeps at the bottom of lakes, seemingly able to go 100 years before waking naturally. It is said to grant wishes to those who respect nature and punish those who pollute its watery home.

entry: 潜水者曾报告，在大湖底看见POKENAME休息。人们相信，没有什么能打扰它的睡眠。
author: sleepyman0731
source: Divers have reported sightings of POKENAME resting at the bottom of large lakes. It is believed that nothing can disrupt a POKENAME's slumber.

entry: POKENAME只吃最美味的鱼宝可梦。离水后，就用爪子反反复复梳理长发。
author: ayner
source: POKENAME eat only the tastiest fish Pokémon. When they get out of the water, they brush their hair with their claws over and over.

entry: POKENAME一有能力，就离开出生的浅池，迁入附近森林，在湖边繁盛生活。飞行时嗡嗡奏出旋律，被称为“湖中的中提琴”。
author: leandermalurt
source: POKENAME leave the shallow pools where they were born as soon as they can, and move into nearby forests where they thrive by lakes. They make a buzzing melody when they fly, and are known as the "Violas of the Lake".

entry: 有人想让丑丑鱼更像进化后的模样，以此将其“美化”，POKENAME便因此诞生。丑丑鱼爱好者对此褒贬不一。
author: staghorn
source: POKENAME is the result of attempts to "beautify" Feebas by making them resemble their evolution. Opinions of POKENAME among Feebas fans are mixed.

entry: 它的美貌，只有和谐歌声能与之相比。许多渔人和水手循声到湖边寻找，醒来却完全不记得那首歌。
author: violet_zero
source: Its beauty is matched only by its harmonious singing. Many fishers and sailors have been led to lakes in search of this Pokémon, only to wake up with no memory of its song.

entry: 水包裹POKENAME，保护身体免受空气污染物伤害。多只同住的湖格外洁净，因为精神能量能排斥污染物。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: Water encases POKENAME, keeping its body safe from pollutants within the air. Lakes where multiple POKENAME live are exceptionally clean thanks to their psychic energy repelling pollutants.

entry: 据说凝望POKENAME手中的镜子，就能看见灵魂面貌。心地正直者看见理想的自己，邪恶者则看见自己扭曲可怖的丑相。
author: sk372
source: It's said that gazing into the mirror POKENAME holds shows the visage of a person's soul. Those with just hearts see an ideal version of themselves, while the wicked-hearted see a twisted, horrifying mockery.

entry: 这种宝可梦在淤泥中蜿蜒觅食。狩猎间隙，会细细擦亮尾巴，然后又难免被淤泥糊满。
author: spkypirate
source: This Pokémon slithers through silt searching for prey. In between hunts it carefully cleans its tail to a polish before it is inevitably caked in silt again.

entry: 古时，人们敬重POKENAME的绝美姿容。直到如今，牙与爪的化石仍是珍贵奢侈品。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME was revered in ancient times for its great beauty. Fossils of its teeth and claws are still valued as luxury items.

entry: POKENAME黄昏聚在静湖附近，练习据说体现纯粹宁静的舞蹈。偶然看见表演的人，烦恼都会渐渐消散。
author: oejoeboy33
source: POKENAME gathers near quiet lakes at dusk, practicing dances said to embody pure serenity. Anyone who happens to watch these performances finds their worries melting away.

entry: 它常被自己的表演感动得落泪。POKENAME极容易情绪失控，不建议初次当训练家的人把它当伙伴。
author: ferdirenz
source: It often brings itself to tears with its own performances. POKENAME gets emotionally overwhelmed very easily and is not advised as a companion to first-time Trainers.

entry: POKENAME外貌虽美，脾气却坏。有些人将鳞片随身带着，作为幸运符。
author: mepp.
source: Despite its beautiful appearance, POKENAME has a nasty temperament. Some people carry their scales as good luck charms.

entry: 它们成群聚集在珊瑚礁附近，保护小型鱼类宝可梦。但若有船只靠近，便会猛烈攻击，直到将船彻底摧毁。
author: mistymagius
source: Groups of these Pokémon hang around coral reefs and provide protection for smaller fish Pokémon. However, if any boats come near their reef, they will violently attack it until there is nothing left.

entry: 它们多数时间都在水下睡觉，头上植物浮在水面。虽能伪装成普通水草，恶臭却轻易暴露位置，也扰乱当地动植物。
author: sottiwotti
source: They spend most of their days sleeping underwater, with the plants on their head floating on the surface. Even though this camouflages them as normal water plants, their vile smell easily gives away their location and disrupts local fauna and flora.

entry: POKENAME成群住在多雾高地，降往低处捕猎。它发出超声波尖叫，让猎物与敌人晕眩，再从上方俯冲，抓住机会进攻。
author: chibitales
source: Flocks of POKENAME inhabit misty highland areas, descending to lower regions to hunt. They let out a supersonic screech to stun prey and foes alike, diving in from above to take advantage of the opportunity.

entry: POKENAME释放平静能量波，安抚猎物心神，降低防备后再出击。双臂末端开口能喷出高压水流。
author: sara886a
source: POKENAME releases calming energy waves to soothe the spirit of its prey, lowering their defenses before striking. It is able to shoot water out of the openings at the end of each arm, delivering high-pressure blasts.

entry: POKENAME被许多人称为“湖之歌姬”，会在深湖水中歌舞。表演有神秘净水力量，只有将原来的湖完全净化，才会迁往新湖。
author: infinex21
source: Known to many as the "Songstress of the Lake," POKENAME will sing and dance within the waters of deep lakes. These performances have mystifying powers that cleanse water, and it will only move to a new lake when it has fully cleansed the prior lake.

entry: POKENAME被视为外貌最惊艳的宝可梦之一，飞行时身后留下闪亮彩虹。传说它会出现在洁净湖泊旁熟睡者的梦里。
author: sk372
source: Considered one of the most breathtaking of Pokémon in appearance, POKENAME leaves a sparkling rainbow trail behind it when it flies. Legends tell of it appearing in the dreams of those who slumber next to pristine lakes.

entry: POKENAME大多在池底爬行，吞吃植物，保持水清。这让水面更容易看见闪亮的背与尾，它却似乎不在意引来的人群。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME mostly scuttles along the bottom of ponds, keeping the water clear by devouring plants. This makes its gleaming back and tail much more visible from the surface, although it seems to be indifferent towards the crowds it draws.

entry: POKENAME会送鳞片给信任的训练家。据说用鳞片装饰的项链，能挡住负面情绪。
author: josh707
source: POKENAME will give its scales as gifts to Trainers it trusts. Necklaces adorned with these scales are said to ward off negative emotions.

entry: 它每天冥想，随潮汐节奏起舞，磨炼力量。头上鳞片的大小与实力成正比。
author: josh707
source: It hones its power through daily meditation and dancing in rhythm with the tides. The scale on its head grows in proportion to its strength.

entry: POKENAME兼具巨大力量与美貌。它不动武，而是魅惑或威吓潜在对手，解决大多数冲突。
author: josh707
source: POKENAME possesses both immense strength and beauty. It resolves most conflicts without violence, either by charming or intimidating would-be opponents.

entry: POKENAME彩色铠甲被誉为天然艺术品。它虽战斗凶猛，也有温柔一面，能惊人敏锐地体会合适训练家的情绪，是好伙伴。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's colorful armor has been described as a natural work of art. Although it is a fierce fighter, it also has a gentle side and is surprisingly well-attuned to a worthy Trainer's feelings, making it a good companion.

entry: 它们大半天都在晒太阳，通常在浅水中或附近。据说POKENAME能让人心平静，因此宁静湖畔可见成群聚集。
author: quantumradiation
source: The majority of their day is spent sunbathing, usually in or near shallow waters. The presence of POKENAME is said to calm the heart, and so gatherings of them can be found around serene lakesides.

entry: 它被视为最美的宝可梦之一，世代启发艺术家。POKENAME花瓣的虹彩光泽，会随照料的用心程度增强，但野生个体也同样美丽。
author: quantumradiation
source: It is considered to be one of the most beautiful Pokémon and has inspired artists for generations. The prismatic sheen of POKENAME's petals grows in luster according to how well it's cared for, but even wild POKENAME are still lovely to behold.

entry: POKENAME闪亮彩色的部分是鳞片，虽非宝石，完美美貌与光泽仍让价值媲美钻石。许多珠宝收藏中的焦点饰品，都用了这些华美鳞片，备受追捧。
author: soup1900
source: While the shiny, colorful parts of POKENAME are scales and not gemstones, their immaculate beauty and luster still make them as valuable as diamonds. Many sought-after accessories that are centerpieces for jewelry collections use these deluxe scales.

entry: POKENAME对自己的外貌十分自豪，每天花不少时间梳洗、整理羽毛。它吐出的一小团团火焰，燃烧时会变换出彩虹般的色彩，格外绚丽夺目。
author: sk372
source: Proud of its appearance, POKENAME spends a good amount of time per day grooming and preening itself. The small bursts of fire it breathes out burn in a shifting rainbow of hues, making them quite the visual spectacle.

entry: POKENAME缤纷花朵，为栖居池湖增添宁静与美。长尾灵巧，游得又快又敏捷，能轻易逃开想摘花的对象。
author: t3isukone
source: The colorful blooms of POKENAME add a sense of peace and beauty to the ponds and lakes where they make their homes. Its long, deft tail makes it a fast and agile swimmer, easily able to escape anyone who tries to pluck its flower.

entry: 很久以前，失去生计的牧场主结伴流浪乡野，POKENAME会加入营地，以歌舞鼓舞。独特风格逐渐发展成一种音乐类型，流行至今。
author: wiz0z
source: Long ago, when jobless ranchers wandered in bands in the countryside, POKENAME would join their camps and inspire them with dance and song. Their unique style gave rise to its own genre of music that is popular to this day.

entry: 用POKENAME闪亮鳞片装饰的领带，是珍贵的订婚礼物。人们相信，它能确保婚姻幸福。
author: .izik
source: A necktie decorated with POKENAME's sparkling scales is a cherished engagement gift. It is believed to ensure a joyful marriage.

entry: POKENAME极善游泳，跃出水面时，身后会留下彩虹。景象虽美，目击者却会剧烈头痛。
author: sk372
source: A highly-adept swimmer, POKENAME creates a rainbow trail behind it when it leaps above the water's surface. Though beautiful, witnesses to this colorful display develop strong headaches.

entry: POKENAME长期被视为优雅象征，但发怒时攻击极其凶猛。目击太少，它的存在曾只被当作神话。
author: mepp.
source: Though long held as a symbol of grace and elegance, POKENAME attacks with vicious ferocity when angered. Sightings of it are so rare, that its existence was once only regarded as myth.

entry: POKENAME尾鳞备受偷猎者追捧，但他们不知道，它受威胁会毛发竖起，向周围喷火花，再射泡泡，高速滑走。
author: ghostslythe
source: The scales on POKENAME's tail are highly sought after by poachers. Unbeknownst to them, if threatened, this Pokémon's hair bristles and sprays the area with embers. It then shoots bubbles, allowing it to slide away at high speeds.

entry: POKENAME展开华丽彩翼，只为炫耀，极少真正飞行。它会在水下跳优雅舞蹈，赢得伴侣芳心。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME spreads its magnificent, colorful wings solely to show them off, as it is very rarely seen taking flight. It wins over its partner by performing graceful, elegant dances underwater.

entry: POKENAME美得惊人，却极其好斗、领地意识强。它先以虹彩鳞片反光晃花敌眼，再发动威力惊人的火焰猛攻。
author: ambrosia04
source: Despite being breathtakingly beautiful, POKENAME is fiercely territorial and aggressive. It uses its shimmery, iridescent scales to blind opponents with reflected light before launching a devastating fiery assault.

entry: POKENAME或许没有美纳斯通常的美貌，仍能释放安抚能量，舒缓烦乱身心。智商与情商都极高，让它能想到各种难题的解决办法。
author: anarraveofcolour
source: POKENAME may not have the traditional beauty of Milotic, but it can still provide calming energy to soothe troubled hearts and minds. The exceptionally high IQ and EQ of POKENAME allow it to think of solutions to every possible problem.

entry: POKENAME极爱美，将外貌看得高于一切，靠严格体能训练与自我护理保持。它收集废玻璃制作华丽镜子，没有时就用水面将就。
author: deadshields
source: POKENAME are extremely vain, prizing their appearance above all things and maintaining it with vigorous physical training and self-care regimens. They gather glass trash to craft ornate mirrors, but make do with the water's surface when without any.

entry: POKENAME展开华丽彩翼，只为炫耀，极少真正飞行。它会在水下跳优雅舞蹈，赢得伴侣芳心。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME spreads its magnificent, colorful wings solely to show them off, as it is very rarely seen taking flight. It wins over its partner by performing graceful, elegant dances underwater.

entry: POKENAME触手覆有细小绯红鳞片，离水后颜色变浅。独特美感让许多珠宝匠将其与大舌贝珍珠搭配，装饰项链。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's tentacles are coated with tiny crimson scales that get lighter when out of the water. Many jewelers attach these scales to necklaces, paired with Shellder pearls, due to their unique beauty.

entry: POKENAME住在深海沟，捕食较小的水属性宝可梦。它在沟壁细缝筑巢，痴迷地囤积心之鳞片。
author: smissmassentree_81799
source: POKENAME reside in deep underwater trenches where they hunt smaller Water-types. They nest in small crevices in the rock walls of these trenches, where they obsessively hoard heart scales.

entry: POKENAME脱落的鳞片曾被采集，作为华美饰品出售。后来需求让贪婪之人开始残忍采鳞，这种买卖便被禁止。
author: sk372
source: For a time, shed POKENAME scales were harvested to sell as glamorous accessories. This was outlawed after demand caused greedy sorts to begin harvesting them in inhumane ways.

entry: POKENAME走路摇摇摆摆，头尾左右摆动，维持平衡。节奏感会吸引小宝可梦，在身后排成队。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME walk with a swaying motion, sweeping their head and tail from side to side in order to maintain balance. The rhythmic motion has been known to draw small Pokémon into lines behind them.

entry: 它性情温和，喜欢与人相处。即使野生丑丑鱼咬住尾巴也不在意，因为覆满鳞片的身体与再生能力能免去疼痛，也不会留下长久的伤害。
author: sontyp
source: Feral Feebas biting its tail isn't a big concern for this sociable and patient creature, as its scale-covered body and regenerative powers prevent pain and lasting damage.

entry: POKENAME住在冰封深湖或大浮冰附近。美丽鳞片摸起来冰凉，常被用作冰雕装饰，帮助防止融化。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live deep within frozen lakes or near large ice floes. Their beautiful scales are as cold as ice to the touch, making them common decorative pieces in ice sculptures to help keep them from melting.

entry: POKENAME的壳在阳光下如蓝宝石般闪亮。奇怪的是，产出的珍珠却黯淡，城都珠宝匠大多看不上。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's shell gleams like sapphire under the sun. Oddly, the pearls it creates are dull and largely dismissed by Johtonian jewelers.

entry: POKENAME覆着闪亮鳞片，造出连串泡泡，接住壳折射的光，分散对手注意，再飞身攻击。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Encased in shimmering scales, POKENAME create a barrage of bubbles to catch the light refracted from their shells and distract opponents before flying in to attack.

entry: POKENAME华丽的鳞片让许多高档时装设计师获得灵感。它们独自漂在外海，等头上的嘴吞下经过的鱼宝可梦。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's luxurious scales have been the inspiration for many high-end fashion designers. They float alone in the open ocean waiting for the mouth on its head to gobble up passing fish Pokémon.

entry: 失眠者有时会迎来POKENAME，平静气息与催眠波令人恍惚入睡。睡过长觉的人表示，醒后神清气爽，精力充沛。
author: quackquackattack
source: People suffering from insomnia may have a visit from POKENAME, whose calm presence and hypnotic waves induce a trance that causes people to fall asleep. Those lulled into slumber describe feeling refreshed and energized after the long rest.

entry: 经常能见到POKENAME不断跳跃，仿佛要抵达高空，甚至从高岩或树桩上跳下。累了，又回高处，晒太阳小睡。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are often seen leaping as if to reach high into the sky, to the point they may leap off of tall rocks or off of tree stumps. When they tire out, they return to these tall perches to nap in the sunlight.

entry: 每颗蛋都有坚硬的鳞状外壳。明明没有翅膀，却依然能飞，原理无人明白。
author: thefinalkalgonus
source: Each of the eggs has a very hard, scaly shell. No one understands how this fusion can fly if it since it has no wings.

entry: POKENAME天生擅长照顾孩子与幼年宝可梦。它总担心照看的对象，时刻守在身边，因此老是一脸不悦。
author: mega_beedrill
source: POKENAME is a natural at caring for children and young Pokémon. It always looks cross due to its constant worry for its charges and hovers over them.

entry: POKENAME是古代世界的顶级猎手之一，一声叫就能让大批小宝可梦慌忙躲藏。化石记录表明，它会把捕猎剩食分给幼年宝贝龙。
author: sk372
source: One of the apex predators of the ancient world, POKENAME's cry was enough to send throngs of smaller Pokémon scurrying for shelter. Fossil records suggest it shared leftovers from its hunts with young Bagon.

entry: POKENAME只在攻击时用翅膀。它靠精神力就能随处悬浮，无需借翅飞行。
author: bostroms
source: The only time POKENAME uses its wings is to attack.  It does not need them to fly, as it can levitate anywhere with its psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME张大嘴，展示背上明亮的帆状结构，威吓敌人。它先潜水，再跃出，以强颚咬住猎物。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME intimidates foes by opening its mouth wide and displaying the bright sail on its back. After submerging itself underwater, it will leap out to seize prey in its powerful jaws.

entry: POKENAME身体修长灵活，适于飞行，在空中速度与机动性极佳。它爱恶作剧，会俯冲向毫无防备的旅人，迅速缠住，送上突如其来的拥抱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's long, flexible body makes it aerodynamic, able to achieve great speed and maneuverability while airborne. A bit of a prankster, it likes to dive at unsuspecting travelers and quickly wrap around them in a sudden surprise hug.

entry: POKENAME双翼极其锋利，性情又凶暴，常把敌人斩成碎片。它们大多住在洞穴或山中。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's extremely sharp wings and viscous temperament leads to its opponent being slashed to pieces. They tend to live in caves or mountains.

entry: 攀山多年后，POKENAME终于展翼，翅膀强得能不休息飞过整片山脉。它们极少落地，据说有些余生都待在云上。
author: aurange
source: After many years of scaling mountains, POKENAME take flight on wings strong enough to cross entire ranges without rest. They rarely return to the ground, and some are said to spend the rest of their lives above the clouds.

entry: POKENAME经常攻击训练家的其他宝可梦，以难养闻名。为压住怒气，最好每天喂树果、用冷水洗澡。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME is notoriously difficult to keep as it regularly attacks its Trainer's other Pokémon. It is recommended to feed it berries and bathe it daily in cold water to keep its anger at bay.

entry: 为了支撑背上的大球茎，双腿长得极强。看见太多飞行宝可梦，就会暴怒，累了再晒太阳休息。
author: infinex21
source: Their legs grow very strong to support the large bulbs on their backs. They will fly into a rage if they witness too many flying Pokémon and rest in sunlight after tiring themselves.

entry: POKENAME能高空飞行。暴怒时，会追着对手飞，以钻头尾巴作主要武器。
author: sleepyman0731
source: POKENAME are capable of high-altitude flights. Enraged POKENAME will fly after their opponent, using their drill tail as their main weapon.

entry: POKENAME熟练精准地挥动斧状角，一挥就能砍倒古树。雄性用角相斗，争取吸引伴侣。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: POKENAME wield their axe-like horns with ease and precision, cutting down ancient trees in one swing. Male POKENAME fight with their horns to try and attract a mate.

entry: 龙之能量涌动，使POKENAME背壳上的翅膀生长，能在栖居的火山谷滑翔。翼或壳受损，就会暴怒，向四处喷火。
author: notadoctor75
source: Surges of draconic energy cause the wings on the back of POKENAME's shell to grow, giving it the ability to glide through the volcanic valleys it calls home. If its wings or shell are damaged, it grows enraged and begins to spew flames everywhere.

entry: POKENAME极仰慕暴飞龙，会给身体涂色，模仿对方。它不断梦想有朝一日飞翔，努力追求这不可能的目标。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME admire Salamence so much so that they paint their bodies to resemble them. These Pokémon constantly dream of one day flying, always working hard toward such an impossible goal.

entry: 暴怒时，它会失控旋转。转得足够快，就会升空，向四面八方放出攻击。
author: busilisk
source: When enraged, it spins uncontrollably. If it spins fast enough, it takes to the air and looses attacks in all directions.

entry: 吃下POKENAME的蛋，能让人充满勇气与成功的决心。它会寻找最需要这些的人，却不白送蛋，必须击败它才能赢得。
author: .jerden
source: Eating POKENAME's egg fills people with courage and determination to succeed. POKENAME seeks out the people who will benefit most from this, but will not simply hand the egg over; they must earn it by defeating POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME大多待在洞里，很少用翅膀飞，却似乎极以双翼为傲。遇见其他宝可梦，就展翼低吼，常把对方吓跑。
author: .jerden
source: While POKENAME spends most of its time in caves and rarely uses its wings to fly, it seems to be incredibly proud of them. It will spread them out and let out a small roar whenever it encounters other Pokémon, which often sends them fleeing.

entry: POKENAME虽有翅膀，扇动却难以托起沉重身体。它主要靠喷高压气体在空中推进，翅膀只负责转向。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME has wings, flapping them does not provide much lift for its heavy body. POKENAME mostly uses them to steer as it propels itself through the air by expelling high-pressure gas.

entry: POKENAME有硬鳞保护，敢于挑战敌人。发怒就贴地飞行，用火焰吐息烧田野。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is protected by hard scales, making it unafraid to challenge foes to combat. Whenever it is angered, POKENAME flies around close to the ground, burning fields with fiery breath.

entry: 丰缘遗迹曾发现描绘POKENAME的壁画。画中显示，虹彩羽毛极受重视，哪怕只持有一根，也被视为获得上天赐福。
author: sk372
source: Murals depicting POKENAME have been discovered in Hoenn ruins. According to these depictions, its prismatic plumage was highly valued; those possessing even a single feather were considered blessed by higher powers.

entry: 火焰强得能熔化岩石。飞行时，它从双臂喷出咆哮火焰，提高速度。
author: cait_sith
source: Its fiery blasts are hot enough to melt rocks. While flying, it shoots roaring flames from its arms to boost its speed.

entry: 它无所畏惧，几乎到什么栖息地都充当凶猛的顶级猎手。不筑巢，通常飞遍世界。尚无自然方式能折断它利牙的记录。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is a fearless Pokémon that almost always acts the savage apex predator in whatever habitat it is in. It does not nest and is usually in flight, travelling across the world. Its fangs have not been known to break through any known natural means.

entry: 它无所畏惧，几乎到什么栖息地都充当凶猛的顶级猎手。不筑巢，通常飞遍世界。尚无自然方式能折断它利牙的记录。
author: bobosmith01
source: It is a fearless Pokémon that almost always acts the savage apex predator in whatever habitat it is in. It does not nest and is usually in flight, travelling across the world. Its fangs have not been known to break through any known natural means.

entry: 强烈的飞翔愿望，让身体长出两只强健翅膀，双臂间也长出滑翔膜，得以翱翔云间。它会以惊人速度俯冲，全力轰向敌人。
author: infinex21
source: A strong desire to fly spurred its body to grow two strong wings and a glider-membrane between its arms that allow it to fly among the clouds. It will swoop down at incredible speeds dive bomb its foes with all its might.

entry: POKENAME力求掌握战斗中的制空优势，遇到飞行宝可梦就攻击。招牌战法是先将对手打落，再接上一记极快极重的俯冲踢。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME seeks to establish airborne superiority in combat, attacking any flying Pokémon it comes across. Its signature is striking down its opponent to the ground before following up with an incredibly fast and powerful diving kick.

entry: POKENAME控制自身重力，不休息也能长途飞行。性情虽不爱暴力，力量却不该低估，能轻松与最强悍的龙交手。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME manipulates its own gravity to let it fly long distances without rest. Though it has a nonviolent personality, its strength should not be underestimated; it can tussle with the toughest of dragons without breaking a sweat.

entry: POKENAME在月光田野无声起舞，刀刃弧线仿照飘扬裙摆。传说它曾猎龙，优雅动作连最硬的鳞片也能切开。
author: eiskitsune
source: POKENAME dances silently through moonlit fields, the arc of its blade mimicking the flow of its billowing skirt. Legends say it once hunted dragons, its elegant movements slicing through even the toughest scales.

entry: POKENAME红色臂刃能切穿坚岩。它品格高尚，始终用力量为弱势者而战。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's red arm-blades are capable of slicing through solid rock. With a noble disposition, POKENAME always uses its strength to fight for the underdog.

entry: POKENAME以龙爪就能击碎整座建筑。它如骑士般遵循荣誉准则，努力压抑凶猛本能。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME has the destructive power to shatter entire buildings with Dragon Claw. It has a code of honor like knights and tries to hold back its ferocious instincts.

entry: POKENAME的躯干始终保持蓝白两色，以便融入云中，翅膀与褶边却可随心变色。它们欢快地在空中竞速，留下宛如奇异彩虹的彩色尾迹。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME always keep their torsos blue and white to blend in among the clouds, but change the color of their wings and frills freely. They joyfully race with each other across the sky, creating colored contrails that resemble odd rainbows.

entry: 它用超能力将自己弹射出去，在空中如巨大的手里剑般旋转，甚至能超过超音速战斗机。
author: staghorn
source: It launches itself using its psychic abilities, spinning like a gigantic shuriken as it flies. It can outpace even supersonic fighter jets.

entry: POKENAME的楔石形似暴飞龙头骨。从石中冲出时，能听见杂乱吼声。有人声称，每声吼都代表一个被它在战斗中夺来的灵魂。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have keystones that resemble the skull of a Salamence. When they burst from their keystone, a cacophony of roars can be heard. Some claim that each roar is a spirit that POKENAME have claimed in combat.

entry: POKENAME的突起器官一察觉生灵，就会失控暴走，追猎目标。吃完猎物后，会连续数天以马赫级速度漫无目的地飞行，让自己平静。
author: soup1900
source: If POKENAME senses any being with its protuberances, it loses control and immediately goes on a rampage to hunt whatever it's tracking down. It spends days flying around aimlessly at Mach speeds to calm itself after devouring prey.

entry: POKENAME喜欢每天飞翔，以锐翅斩击其他空中宝可梦，彻底控制天空。飞过处留下刀刃般的风，让飞机经过领地十分危险。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME likes to spend every day flying around, slicing other aerial Pokémon with its sharp wings to keep total control of the sky. It leaves behind a trail of blade-like winds wherever it goes, making its territory dangerous for planes to fly past.

entry: POKENAME喜欢每天飞翔，以锐翅斩击其他空中宝可梦，彻底控制天空。飞过处留下刀刃般的风，让飞机经过领地十分危险。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME likes to spend every day flying around, slicing other aerial Pokémon with its sharp wings to keep total control of the sky. It leaves behind a trail of blade-like winds wherever it goes, making its territory dangerous for planes to fly past.

entry: 奇特的是，花朵的锋利花瓣能如旋翼转动，让它升空。它必须在日落前着陆，因为维持飞行所需的力量来自阳光。
author: infinex21
source: Peculiarly, the sharp petals of its flower can spin like rotor blades and allow this Pokémon to fly through the air. It must land before the sun sets, as it requires sunlight to have enough strength to stay aloft.

entry: POKENAME虽失去双翼，仍快得目不暇接。再加上惊人跳跃高度，依旧是强悍的空中猎手。
author: patch_bros
source: Despite its loss of wings, POKENAME is still blindingly fast. It can jump at incredibly high as well, making it still a formidable aerial predator.

entry: POKENAME暴怒时会不停攻击，以强翼冲天，再挟着威力惊人的双刃头锤坠下。
author: theartemis1
source: When enraged, POKENAME will attack without pause. Using its mighty wings, it will fly skyward before crashing down with a devastating Head Smash.

entry: 暴怒的POKENAME几乎势不可挡。铁甲般的头颅撞不毁的东西，它便用烈焰吐息熔化，所到之处尽成废墟。
author: spartan_ct
source: An enraged POKENAME is incredibly difficult to stop. What it fails to destroy with its ironclad head, it melts with fiery breath, leaving only ruin in its wake.

entry: POKENAME在早期神话中被奉为天空之神。蜕下的鳞片被织入仪式服装，供舞蹈使用。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME was revered as a god of the skies in early myths. Its shed scales were woven into ceremonial garments for use in dances.

entry: 骄傲与决心定义了POKENAME，也吸引许多较弱宝可梦愿意效力。它主要靠蛮力达成目的，却也懂得使用诡计与陷阱。
author: adamzwill
source: Pride and determination are what define POKENAME, and its exactly those traits that endear many species of lesser Pokémon into its service. While it mainly depends on brute strength to get its way, POKENAME isn't a stranger to using tricks or traps.

entry: POKENAME翅膀中的特殊磁力，让它几乎能无休止地飞翔。决定落地时，会重重坠下，有时把自己嵌进地面。
author: sk372
source: A special magnetism within POKENAME's wings allows it to soar through the skies almost indefinitely. It falls with a heavy crash when it decides to land, sometimes embedding itself into the ground.

entry: 敌人看见刀刃亮起异界光芒，就已太迟。POKENAME会俯冲，夺走灵魂，再熄火，消失在夜色中。
author: .fedoraman
source: When a foe sees the otherworldly glow from its blades alight, it is already too late. POKENAME swoops down, steals their soul, extinguishes its flames again, and disappears into the night.

entry: POKENAME一对斧刃可配合着当翅膀，在高空迅速飞行。暴怒时，会点燃双斧，让斩击更危险，也吓住敌人。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's pair of axe blades can be used in conjunction like wings, allowing it to fly rapidly at vast heights. When enraged, it lights its axes on fire, making its slices a lot more dangerous while also intimidating its foes.

entry: POKENAME振翅会发出凶险低吼，借此将弱小宝可梦赶入领地，那里有猛烈沙暴等着。目标在恶风中迷路，成为它的猎物。
author: chibitales
source: When POKENAME flaps its wings, a menacing growl is created. It uses this ability to chase weaker Pokémon into its territory, where a fierce sandstorm awaits. They get lost in the harsh winds and become POKENAME's prey.

entry: POKENAME虽罕见，有时仍能见它雨中飞过河流上空。古老神话说，它只向命定成帝王的人现身。
author: happii6843
source: Although rare, POKENAME can sometimes be spotted flying above rivers during rain. In ancient myth, it is said that POKENAME will only reveal itself to those who are destined to become emperors.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，面对任何威胁与危险都毫不动摇。双翼已融合成新月形。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is unfazed by any threat or danger that comes across its flight. Its wings have fused together to create a crescent shape.

entry: 融合能量唤醒POKENAME的古代基因。它极其野蛮，会以残酷方式彻底消灭敌人。
author: soup1900
source: Fusion energy has caused POKENAME to awaken its ancient genes. It is an extremely savage Pokémon, completely eradicating its enemies in a very brutal manner.

entry: POKENAME飞行觅食时，会散落羽毛。新月形双翼常被用来威吓强敌。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME scatters feathers while it flies around in search of prey. Its crescent-shaped wings are often used as a form of intimidation against strong foes.

entry: POKENAME收起前腿，使身体呈流线型，飞得更快、动作更灵活。锐利新月翼若撞中敌人，会造成重创。
author: soup1900
source: By tucking in its forelegs, POKENAME streamlines itself to allow high speeds and quick movements while in flight. POKENAME's sharp crescent wing can maul foes if it rams them with it.

entry: POKENAME飞行觅食时，会散落羽毛。新月形双翼常被用来威吓强敌。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME scatters feathers while it flies around in search of prey. Its crescent-shaped wings are often used as a form of intimidation against strong foes.

entry: POKENAME收起前腿，使身体呈流线型，飞得更快、动作更灵活。锐利新月翼若撞中敌人，会造成重创。
author: soup1900
source: By tucking in its forelegs, POKENAME streamlines itself to allow high speeds and quick movements while in flight. POKENAME's sharp crescent wing can maul foes if it rams them with it.

entry: POKENAME飞行时，面对任何威胁与危险都毫不动摇。双翼已融合成新月形。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is unfazed by any threat or danger that comes across its flight. Its wings have fused together to create a crescent shape.

entry: 融合能量唤醒POKENAME的古代基因。它极其野蛮，会以残酷方式彻底消灭敌人。
author: soup1900
source: Fusion energy has caused POKENAME to awaken its ancient genes. It is an extremely savage Pokémon, completely eradicating its enemies in a very brutal manner.

entry: POKENAME飞行时攻击性极强，将整片天空都视为领地。什么东西飞得太近，都会被缎带般触须狠狠打落。
author: sk372
source: While in flight, POKENAME gets very aggressive, considering the skies themselves to be its territory. Anything that flies too close to it gets roughly smacked down by its ribbon-like feelers.

entry: POKENAME通常待在地面，主要用带刺翅膀威吓敌人。若吓不跑，就用毒爪进攻，或用力跺脚，引发小地震。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME usually remains on the ground, mostly using its spiky wings to intimidate foes. If this fails to make an opponent flee, POKENAME will attack with its venomous claws or stomp its foot with enough force to cause small earthquakes.

entry: 这种宝可梦飞在平流层下方。谁想穿过飞行路线，哪怕只是太靠近，都会被它残忍猛攻，直到一方逃走或倒下。
author: infinex21
source: This Pokémon flies just below the stratosphere. If any Pokémon attempt to cross its path or simply draw too near, it will brutally assail them until one of them either flees or falls.

entry: POKENAME外形纤细，却能一爪击碎巨石。它是凶猛猎手，会把猎物带上高空，再径直丢向下方山崖。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Despite their spindly appearance, POKENAME have the strength to shatter boulders with a single swipe of their claws. They are vicious predators, carrying prey high into the sky before simply dropping them onto the mountain crags below.

entry: 强壮双耳让它能起飞滑翔，实现POKENAME长久的梦想。肌肉发达的双腿一踢，就能震碎巨石。
author: chibitales
source: Its ears are strong enough to take flight and glide through the sky, realizing POKENAME's long-held dream. Kicks from its muscled legs can shatter boulders.

entry: 满月下，POKENAME站在山巅，收集神秘能量。充足后，翼尖泛粉光，飞入夜色，直到下次满月才再现。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME stand at the top of mountains under the full moon to gather mystical energy. Once they are fully charged, the tips of their wings will glow pink as they fly away into the night, disappearing until the next full moon.

entry: 谁侵扰安息处，POKENAME就会暴怒，打开棺门，向周围一切喷火。长翼能飞后，它不断前往古墓，吃里面储存的金子。
author: soup1900
source: If anyone violates its resting place, POKENAME becomes enraged and opens its coffin door to blast fire at everything nearby. With it having grown wings for flight, it constantly uses them to fly to ancient tombs and eat any gold kept within.

entry: POKENAME发怒会暴走数小时，挥动锋利斧牙与强尾，打向周围一切。急躁脾气被归因于渴望翅膀，想翱翔天空。
author: infinex21
source: An angered POKENAME will rampage for hours, swinging about its sharp, axe-like tusks and powerful tail at everything around it. The quick temper displayed by a POKENAME is attributed to its longing for wings to carry it through the sky.

entry: POKENAME以难以想象的速度翱翔，只需几分钟就能轻松绕地球一周。能量输出达到极限时，它的推进力可达到平时的四倍。
author: teatedtiten
source: POKENAME soars at unimaginable speeds, easily circling the earth world in minutes. When it maximizes its energy output, its propulsive power quadruples.

entry: POKENAME努力为伪装寻找完美构造，好让自己飞上天空。尝试失败，就会任性发脾气，乱挥乱撞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME strives to find the perfect composition for its disguise that will allow it to soar through the air. After failed attempts, it thrashes about in a petulant tantrum.

entry: POKENAME两颗头不断以锐利头冠切磋。巨响吓得敌人常在它察觉之前，就已逃走。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's two heads constantly spar with each other using their sharp crests. The loud sound this makes intimidates foes, who often flee before POKENAME even notices they are there.

entry: POKENAME与《朱之书》描述的宝可梦十分相似。臂上的头很弱，主头则强大得多，能咬出毁灭性一击。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: POKENAME is very similar to a Pokémon described in the Scarlet Book. The heads on its arms are very weak, but the main head is much stronger in comparison and delivers a devastating bite.

entry: POKENAME似乎极爱飞行，可能永不落地，但通常不飞太高。它贴地前行，吞吃够得着的一切，身后留下一路破坏。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME seems to enjoy flying so much that it may never land, although it usually doesn't fly too high. It instead remains close to the ground, devouring anything within reach to leave behind a trail of devastation.

entry: 翼缘如颚中利牙般锋利。敌人或许想拉开距离，POKENAME的头却仍能从嘴里喷出火焰或黑暗波动攻击。
author: .jerden
source: The edges of its wings are razor-sharp, just like the fangs in its jaws. Although foes may try to keep their distance, POKENAME's heads will still be able to attack by firing blasts of fire or pulses of darkness from their mouths.

entry: POKENAME尾巴与中央头部周围闪着紫火，增强攻击。左头用于撞击敌人，右头则阻挡来袭。
author: .jerden
source: Purple flames flicker around POKENAME's tail and central head, increasing the power of its attacks. It will use the head on its left to headbutt foes, and the head on its right to block enemy attacks.

entry: POKENAME曾在战争中充当空中情报与作战单位。如今仍擅战，是信任的训练家的强力伙伴，却不太愿听交换后的训练家指挥。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME was once used in war as an aerial intelligence and combat unit. In the modern day, it excels in battle and makes a powerful partner for a trusted Trainer. POKENAME is unlikely to obey a Trainer it has been traded to.

entry: POKENAME靠强腿跃起，再借巨大毒叶滑翔。叶中毒素帮助研发出能令人精力大增的药物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their strong legs to leap into the air and glide with the help of their large, poisonous leaves. The toxins in their leaves have helped to develop medicines that fill others with immense vigor.

entry: POKENAME用大翅膀挡雨，保护尾巴。但翅膀笨重，重量是身体的两倍，发脾气时常不慎以锐翼割伤其他生灵。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their large wings to shield their tail from rain. These unwieldy wings weigh twice as much as their body, often leading them to accidentally cut others with these sharp wings whenever they have a tantrum.

entry: 它不断与其他龙属性宝可梦交战，强化牙齿。POKENAME虽未长成，却十分强大，暴怒甚至可能毁掉自己的洞窟。
author: fiordaliso
source: It constantly battles other Dragon-type Pokémon to strengthen its fangs. Though not fully grown, POKENAME is very powerful and may even destroy its own cave in a rage.

entry: 它几乎总待在自己收集的大堆宝石上，常常苦恼着究竟该将它们吃掉，还是留下珍藏。
author: dusknoir64
source: This Pokémon can almost always be found on the vast pile of gems it has collected. It often agonizes over whether to eat them or to keep them.

entry: 传闻POKENAME每次战胜，角上的毒就会更强。威风的红翼极有力，只一扇就能击倒树木。
author: fiordaliso
source: Rumor has it that the venom coating POKENAME's horns grows more potent each time it emerges victorious from battle. Its majestic red wings are so powerful that a mere flap can fell trees.

entry: 这些大宝可梦借巨大力量救助、保护其他生灵，也用强翼帮助旅人。它们极其骄傲，若被其他宝可梦击败，就会大发脾气。
author: infinex21
source: These large Pokémon lend their immense strength to save or protect others and their impressive wings to aid travelers. They are immensely prideful and will throw a fit if ever bested by another Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME乐于捉弄敢入领地的人。耳朵发出响亮恼人的振动，扰乱擅闯者方向，使其站立不稳，再以马赫级速度俯冲打击。
author: redmagecole
source: POKENAME takes pleasure in annoying people that dare to infiltrate its territory. To achieve this, loud obnoxious vibrations emit from POKENAME's ears to disorient and stagger trespassers before it swoops in at mach speeds to strike.

entry: POKENAME翅膀不够大、不够强，飞不起来，但至少能遮一点阳。它爱吃萨拉米香肠，正好呼应听起来相近的英文名。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's wings are not large or strong enough to fly, but they do serve as a minor source of shade. This fusion is fond of salami, fitting its name.

entry: POKENAME太重，飞不了多久，每次落地似乎都很失望。翅膀依然极强，飞行时能用翼或尾打退太靠近的敌人。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's body is too heavy for it to fly for long, and it seems to be disappointed whenever it lands. Its wings are still incredibly strong, and it can use them or its tail to knock foes that get too close while flying.

entry: POKENAME脾气急，暴怒能烧毁森林。训练家通常因此不与它对战。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME has a short temper and can burn down forests when enraged. Trainers typically don't battle POKENAME because of this.

entry: POKENAME独自时很弱，常紧跟暴鲤龙或巨牙鲨，捡食这些大宝可梦没吃完的猎物。
author: mepp.
source: Weak on its own, POKENAME often sticks close to Gyarados or Sharpedo. It feeds by scavenging on leftover prey these larger Pokémon don't finish.

entry: POKENAME威风，野外罕见，其他宝可梦会自然追随。但它容不得混乱，不听令者会迎来汹涌火焰吐息。
author: zekkenbytheden
source: POKENAME are majestic creatures rarely seen in the wild, where other Pokémon naturally follow their leadership. They do not tolerate disorder, however, and any who disregard their commands face a torrent of fiery breath.

entry: POKENAME总在生气，一阵怒火就烧焦沿途一切。它裹着猛烈火焰，高速飞过天空。
author: mistymagius
source: Always angry, POKENAME scorches everything in its path in a fit of rage. It soars across the sky at high speeds, cloaking itself in its harsh flames.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME先在空中滑翔，再落向对手，以飞身压击攻击。它天生就与摔角鹰人敌对。
author: cait_sith
source: During battle, POKENAME glides through the air and then drops down onto its opponent for a flying body press. It has an instinctual rivalry with Hawlucha.

entry: POKENAME以制空权为傲，战斗时始终飞着。若敌人强行将它击落，就无处可逃，会迎来它愤怒的报复。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME prides itself in aerial supremacy, keeping itself in flight at all times in combat. If an opponent forcibly grounds it, there will be no escape from the indignant rage it enters.

entry: POKENAME不断流动，维持体内积聚的热与能量，张大嘴排出多余热气。若一颗火星碰到吐息，就会爆发汹涌火焰。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Constantly flowing to maintain the heat and energy building inside of them, POKENAME stretch their mouths wide open to vent out excess heat. If a stray spark catches a POKENAME's breath, it will create an explosive torrent of flames.

entry: POKENAME体内龙之能量涌出，化成翅膀，支撑低空飞行。能量冰冷刺骨，却能灼伤所有接触者。
author: dragon_hunter_70
source: The draconic energy contained within the body of POKENAME bursts out of its body, forming wings that allow for low altitude flight. This energy is freezing cold, and will burn anyone who is exposed to it.

entry: POKENAME帮助工厂工人给各种炊具涂不粘涂层。背部齿轮能调节喷涂强度，让工人更好地控制上涂方式。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME help factory workers apply non-stick coating to various cookware. The gear on their back adjusts the intensity of the spray, giving workers more control over how the coating is applied.

entry: POKENAME常在工厂惹祸，试图吃掉机器里的齿轮与电线。它也爱睡在机器内，卡住内部机构。
author: oxitape.
source: POKENAME are frequent pests for factory workers, as they often attempt to eat the many gears and wires that make up the machines. They also enjoy sleeping inside these machines, causing the inner workings to jam.

entry: 有时能在工厂和发电厂见到POKENAME。原因不明，它一见机器就发狂，冲向目标，再停下加速旋转，猛烈引爆自己。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME are sometimes seen at factories and power plants. For unknown reasons, the sight of machines causes this Pokémon to go into a frenzy, sprinting towards its target before pausing to spin up and detonate itself viciously.

entry: 进化后，原本长而不稳的脖子消失了。虽然如今不那么吓人，POKENAME却感觉舒服、稳当多了。
author: epping_forest
source: After evolving, its once long and unstable neck disappeared. Though it now looks less intimidating, POKENAME feels much better and more stable than before.

entry: POKENAME的齿轮棒既是武器，也能强化自身。它将轮齿槽对准身体部件，转动微调，暂时增强力量或速度。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's gear club acts not only as a weapon but as a way to bolster itself. It can align the grooves of its gear with parts of its body, churning and adjusting a bit to give it a temporary boost to strength or speed.

entry: POKENAME是甜食与油品的鉴赏家，靠两者维生。不用的部分会烧成灰，从尾巴排出。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is a connoisseur of both sweets and oils, and uses both to sustain itself. Whatever it does not use is burned to ash and emitted through its tail.

entry: POKENAME背上的环不停转动，发出时钟般的滴答声，仿佛在为进化倒数。即将进化时，红色核心会闪烁，发出哔哔声。
author: oxitape.
source: The ring on the back of POKENAME constantly rotates and makes audible ticking noises like a clock, seemingly counting down to its evolution. Once a POKENAME is almost ready to evolve, its red core will start flashing and produce a beeping sound.

entry: POKENAME全身齿轮控制强力冲锋，能瞬间起跑、停止、转弯，机动性出人意料。
author: sk372
source: The many gears on POKENAME's body control its powerful running charges. It can quickly charge, stop, and turn at a moment's notice, making it surprisingly maneuverable.

entry: 齿轮驱动POKENAME的红角，连钢筋混凝土也能钻穿，迅速推倒最坚固的建筑。带刺轮子持续高速旋转，防范后方与侧面的攻击。
author: .jerden
source: Driven by its gears, POKENAME's red horn can drill through even reinforced concrete, quickly toppling even the sturdiest of buildings. The constant, high-speed rotation of POKENAME's spiked wheel protects it from attacks from behind and the sides.

entry: 野生POKENAME把孩子安置在一块身体部件中，以微弱磁场始终维系在身边。任何潜在威胁都会让它迎战，即使自己也会遇险。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME keep their children safe within a part of their body always kept close by a weak magnetic field. They will engage in combat with any potential threat to their child, even if it puts themselves in danger.

entry: POKENAME让水冲过背部齿轮，推动自己。水流停了，或搁浅上岸，就会烦躁，发出刺耳金属鸣响，直到重新放回流水。
author: agentyoshi
source: POKENAME propels itself by letting water rush over the gear on its back. Should the current stop, or POKENAME run ashore, it will become agitated and let out harsh metallic chimes until it is placed in running water again.

entry: 强海流常使POKENAME的齿轮加速。它以海上风暴中获得的惊人速度而闻名。
author: schwaus
source: Strong ocean currents often accelerate the gears on POKENAME. POKENAME are known for the exceptional speed they gain in ocean storms.

entry: 即使被拆散，只要中央红色核心完好，它仍能重新组装机械齿轮。
author: skyward_25
source: Even after being torn apart, it can reassemble its mechanical gears as long as the red core at its center stays intact.

entry: 据报告，这些古怪宝可梦曾搜遍农场，绑走肯泰罗和大奶罐。但科学家尚未亲眼见到，也没人确定，被绑者究竟被带往何处。
author: infinex21
source: These odd Pokémon have reportedly been seen scouring farms, abducting Tauros and Miltank. Scientists have yet to witness this themselves, and no one is sure where these abductees have supposedly been taken to.

entry: POKENAME表演默剧时，总伴着齿轮不停转动的声音。无形屏障防止任何东西卷入，因此能安全互动，甚至爬到它身上。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's miming is accompanied by the sound of its constantly turning gears. POKENAME is safe to interact with and climb on, as invisible barriers prevent anything from being caught in its gears.

entry: POKENAME表演默剧时，总伴着齿轮不停转动的声音。无形屏障防止任何东西卷入，因此能安全互动，甚至爬到它身上。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's miming is accompanied by the sound of its constantly turning gears. POKENAME is safe to interact with and even climb on, as invisible barriers prevent anything from being caught in its gears.

entry: POKENAME是出色的焊接能手，能顶两名工人。它以帮助工厂工程师完成项目为傲。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is a great welder and is able to take up the work of two workers. It takes pride in helping factory engineers complete projects.

entry: POKENAME脸上的红色核心是一只眼，外有碎砾制成的玻璃状物质保护。它也爱爬树，将金属丝织成磁性巢穴。
author: duskit___
source: The red core on POKENAME's face is an eye protected by a glass-like substance made from gravel. It also loves to climb trees and weave its metallic silk into a magnetic nest.

entry: 金属身体极其耐久。POKENAME攻击时，会飞上高空，嘴咬尾巴，高速绕圈旋转，召来整场雷暴。
author: fireblade141
source: Its metallic body is highly durable. To attack, POKENAME flies high up into the sky, grips its tail in its mouth, and spins rapidly in a circle, which allows it to conjure entire lightning storms.

entry: 金属身体极其耐久。POKENAME攻击时，会飞上高空，嘴咬尾巴，高速绕圈旋转，召来整场雷暴。
author: fireblade141
source: Its metallic body is highly durable. To attack, POKENAME flies high up into the sky, grips its tail in its mouth, and spins rapidly in a circle, which allows it to conjure entire lightning storms.

entry: POKENAME的带刺环转得越快，输出功率就越高。环全速转动时射出的水炮，几乎能击倒任何敌人。
author: skyward_25
source: The faster POKENAME's spiked ring rotates, the higher its power output gets. A hydropump that is fired while the ring is rotating at max speed has the power to knock out almost any foe.

entry: 许多孩子觉得POKENAME不断运动的部件很可爱。但它不喜欢关注，尽可能远离人类。
author: smissmassentree_81799
source: POKENAME's constantly moving parts are considered to be adorable by many children. This Pokémon does not like attention and tries its best to stay away from humans.

entry: 复杂机构让POKENAME的齿轮产生人造水。它在自己造的水池里扑腾，洗去齿轮间积垢。
author: sk372
source: A complex series of mechanisms lets POKENAME's gears generate its own artificial water. It splashes about in pools of its own making to keep its gears clean of any gunk building up between them.

entry: POKENAME通过胸腔处理、压缩合成废料。外表虽像机器人，却能与训练家建立深厚情感。
author: jojojax164
source: POKENAME processes and compresses synthetic waste through its chest cavity. Despite its robotic appearance, POKENAME is able to develop a strong emotional connection with its Trainer.

entry: 许多人在城市花园发现POKENAME照料植物。因此，许多草属性宝可梦喜欢它在身边。
author: inksans201x
source: Many have found POKENAME tending to gardens in urban cities. As a result, many Grass-types are fond of their presence.

entry: 这种宝可梦全身不断变化。与普通铁壳蛹不同，与其说身体改变，不如说始终在重组。大约三周后，就会进化到最终形态。
author: duskit___
source: The Pokémon's whole body is in constant flux. Unlike a normal Kakuna, its body does not change so much as it continually reforms. After about three weeks, it will evolve into its final form.

entry: POKENAME捕食电属性宝可梦，为臂刃持续补充炽热能量。刀刃如激光切割机，连实心金属也能劈开。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME prey on Electric-type Pokémon, seeking to keep the searing energy that charges their arm blades fueled. Those blades are like laser cutters, capable of cleaving even solid metal.

entry: 传闻POKENAME与早期化石复活尝试有关。强颚能轻易撕下厚金属，似乎特别爱咬汽车。
author: sk372
source: Rumors exist that POKENAME is connected to early attempts at reviving Pokémon from fossils. Its powerful jaws can tear off chunks of thick metal with ease; it seems to favor taking bites out of cars.

entry: POKENAME能高速旋转齿轮，再作为弹丸发射。它虽会尽力回收，但只要食物富铁，几天内也能长出新的。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can spin its gears at high speed, then fire them off as projectiles. Although POKENAME will try to recover them, as long as it eats a diet rich in iron it will be able to grow new ones within days.

entry: POKENAME将带刺甲背朝敌自卫。进攻时，除了像棍棒般挥击，还能将尾齿轮与颈齿轮咬合，让红角像钻头旋转。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME defends itself by turning its spiky, armored back towards foes. For offense, in addition to swinging it like a club, POKENAME can interlock the gear on its tail with the gears on its neck to spin its red horn like a drill.

entry: POKENAME的机械动作靠一股股蒸汽驱动，必须定期补锅炉水。但若飞在海上，就能吞海水补充，无需落地休息。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's mechanical movements are powered by puffs of steam. It must regularly refill its boiler, but if flying over the sea POKENAME can swallow seawater and never need to rest on land.

entry: POKENAME一移动就不断冒烟，像列车一样。它把尾巴当轨道，乘着前行。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME constantly produce smog whenever they move, similar to a train. They use their tails as rails to ride on.

entry: POKENAME靠颈内外转动的齿轮供能，由体内伸出挥击的电线保护。齿轮转动产生的烟，有格外宜人的花香。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is powered by the gears turning in and around its neck, protected by wires that lash out from within its body. The smoke produced by the turning of the gears has a remarkably pleasant floral scent.

entry: POKENAME的颚靠弹簧驱动，嘴中按钮一压，就会猛然合拢，力量足以碎骨。闭合后，要约五分钟才能重新上簧，撑开双颚。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME have spring-loaded jaws that trigger when a button in their mouth is pressed, forcing their jaws shut with enough force to crush bones. Once shut, it takes them about five minutes to reload the spring and force their jaws back open.

entry: POKENAME每天细心清理翼根齿轮。哪怕少量污垢积聚，也会让它很难维持飞行。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carefully preens the gears located at the base of its wings each day. Even a small amount of dirt building up can cause it great difficulty maintaining flight.

entry: 坚固金属甲、导弹与口中光束武器，让POKENAME成为坦克般的强大战斗机器。但泥地或沼泽会让它难以发挥。
author: sk372
source: With powerful metal plating, missiles and even beam weaponry from its mouth, POKENAME is a powerful tank of a fighting machine. It fares poorly in muddy or swampy terrain, however.

entry: POKENAME靠齿轮准确计时。身体只能连续活动16小时，之后就得充电。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME relies on its gears to keep an accurate sense of time. Its body can only maintain 16 continuous hours of activity before recharging.

entry: POKENAME用齿轮计时，每秒滴答，分毫不差。钟表匠靠它帮忙，确保钟表走时准确。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME keeps track of the time with its gears, which tick every second without fail. Watchmakers rely on its help to ensure timepieces give an accurate read of time.

entry: POKENAME转动背上把手，给自己充能。它们分泌液体防止把手卡死，借此建立感情，彼此依赖才能生存。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME turn the handle on their backs, which allows them to charge energy. They bond by secreting a fluid that keeps the handle from seizing up, making them reliant on each other to survive.

entry: POKENAME体内众多强齿轮，让翅膀与拳头力量惊人。它在空中移动极快，眨眼就能挥出一连串重拳。
author: sk372
source: A multitude of powerful gears within POKENAME give its wings and fists a tremendous amount of strength. It can maneuver in the air at fantastic speeds and throw a flurry of powerful punches in the blink of an eye.

entry: POKENAME全由齿轮构成，必须不断润滑。它产生密实金属网，精炼后能制成松掉的弹簧。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME is made entirely of gears that must be constantly lubricated. It produces a dense metal webbing that, when refined, can be crafted into a Stretchy Spring.

entry: 只要吵闹的齿轮还在转，POKENAME就不必休息。什么东西吸引了目光，它就会无情地追赶不休。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME do not need to rest as long as their noisy gears are turning. Once something catches their eye, POKENAME will mercilessly and relentlessly pursue it.

entry: 维修店借助POKENAME的机械专长，修复电器、机器与车辆。它也会搜遍垃圾场，寻找可回收物，变废为宝。
author: oddwalls
source: Repair shops rely on POKENAME's mechanical expertise to help them restore appliances, machinery, and vehicles to working order. POKENAME also combs through landfills, searching for items to reclaim from the trash and transform into treasure.

entry: POKENAME一疲倦，就将尾齿轮插进组成双耳的两个齿轮之间。三个连着转动，刺激内部系统，恢复活力。
author: sk372
source: Whenever POKENAME feels tired, it slips the gear on its tail between the two that make up its ears. Rotating all three while linked together stimulates its internal systems and gives it an energy boost.

entry: POKENAME使用灭亡之歌时，底部带刺齿轮会高速旋转。一停，它和所有听见歌声的对象都会昏倒。它必须不断寻找润滑剂，防止生锈。
author: bobosmith01
source: When POKENAME uses Perish Song, the spiked gear on the bottom starts to spin rapidly. When it stops moving, both POKENAME and anyone who hears the song faints. POKENAME must constantly find lubricant to prevent itself from rusting.

entry: POKENAME钻进机器，用强颚啃钢，吃下补充养分。被咬的地方，数小时内就会生锈。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will climb into machinery, their strong jaws able to chew through steel, which they will consume to nourish themselves. Areas bitten by these Pokémon will begin to rust within hours.

entry: POKENAME每片鳃各负责一种感觉，因此常能见它绕着物品转，以充分了解。冷水中，这些器官运作更好，动作也更快。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Each of POKENAME's gills is responsible for a different sense, so it is common to see them rotating around objects to properly understand them. They function better in cold water and move more rapidly.

entry: POKENAME集中精神力时，全身许多齿轮会咬合高速旋转。它从额头核心或尾齿轮发射能量攻击。
author: fireblade141
source: When POKENAME concentrates its psychic powers, the many gears all over its body begin to grind and spin rapidly. It fires blasts of energy from the core on its forehead or the gear on its tail.

entry: POKENAME在小巷里昂首阔步，挂着得意的笑，以夸张动作展示古怪又昂贵的小玩意。大多数训练家空手离开，也不知是躲过骗局，还是错失妙物。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME struts through alleys displaying bizarre, overpriced gadgets with exaggerated gestures and an ever-present smug grin. Most Trainers walk away without buying a thing, unsure if they resisted a scam or missed out on something brilliant.

entry: POKENAME从背部喷出气雾漆，附着周围物件。它常在工厂，同时给许多零件上漆。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME releases bursts of aerosol paint from their back that clings to objects around them. They are often found in factories where they paint many factory parts at the same time.

entry: POKENAME全方位都有防护，想飘到哪里就飘到哪里。受威胁会从体侧尖刺发射小齿轮，爱堵路的习惯让它成为城市祸患。
author: oddwalls
source: Defended from all angles, POKENAME floats wherever it pleases, launching miniature gears from the spikes on its sides if threatened. Its tendency to block roadways makes it an urban scourge.

entry: POKENAME由齿轮与外骨骼交织而成，夜行时却不知为何十分安静。若喜欢训练家，就能用本该是心脏位置的旋转齿轮，给简单电子设备供电。
author: notsaying.
source: A mesh of gears and exoskeleton, POKENAME is somehow silent when traversing through the night. If it likes its Trainer, it can power rudimentary electronics with a spinning gear where its heart should be.

entry: 战前，POKENAME高速旋转背部大齿轮充电，再以电拳速战速决。若战斗拖太久，电力会让身体过热，熔化自己。
author: soup1900
source: Before battle, POKENAME spins the large gear on its back at high speeds to charge electricity. It then tries to end fights quickly by using electrified punches; if the battle lasts too long, the electricity will overheat its body and melt it away.

entry: POKENAME储有巨量能量，能让钳子超频运转，强行夹碎平时夹不动的东西。也能以子弹速度射出巨钳，战斗还没开始就击倒敌人。
author: soup1900
