source: Storing extreme amounts of energy, POKENAME can overclock its pincers to forcefully crush objects it normally couldn't squeeze. This energy is also used to fire its pincers at bullet speeds and knock out a foe before the battle even starts.

entry: 平时，POKENAME会用齿轮拧紧体内的发条。进入战斗后，便释放发条中储存的能量，发动威力惊人的攻击。
author: vibrationjaveline
source: When POKENAME is not battling, it uses its gears to wind a spring inside its body. When it enters battle, it uses the energy stored within the spring to attack with incredible force.

entry: POKENAME臂内藏着许多尖锐金属工具。虽可用来以各种方式助人，它却更爱拿来恶作剧。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's arms contain a litany of pointed metal tools within them. Though the objects could be used to assist others in various ways, it prefers using them to cause mischief instead.

entry: POKENAME齿轮不停转动，不只产生机械能，也产热、发电。鼻上垂下的红热液滴能放出小电弧，打向附近对象。
author: .jerden
source: The constant spinning of POKENAME's gears not only generates mechanical energy but also heat and electrical energy. The red-hot droplets hanging from POKENAME's nose can be used to discharge electricity as small arcs targeting anything nearby.

entry: POKENAME把找到的金属矿物放进背上大熔炉，靠熔料抵御攻击者。金属工匠用它制作、测试独特新合金。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME places any metal or mineral it finds into the large smelter on its back; the molten material serves as its defense mechanism against attackers. Metalworkers use this Pokémon to create and test unique new alloys.

entry: POKENAME飞得太久，体内齿轮就过热，放出浓黑烟。它用沉重金属喙敲开树皮，捕捉里面的猎物。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME flies for too long, the gears inside its body overheat, releasing thick, dark smoke into the air. It uses its heavy metal beak to crack open tree bark and catch the prey hiding within.

entry: POKENAME用全身齿轮喷出强水流。齿轮越快，水流越集中。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME uses the gears on its body to shoot out a powerful stream of water. The faster the gears spin, the more concentrated the stream of water is.

entry: POKENAME履带覆着吸盘，几乎什么地形都能走，连墙壁、天花板也行。准备开炮前，头两侧齿轮转得最快。
author: infinex21
source: The treads of a POKENAME are clad in suction-pads that allow them to move across nearly any terrain, and even along walls and ceilings. The gears on either side of its head spin quickest right as it prepares to fire from its cannon.

entry: POKENAME袋中似乎能生出无穷好东西，再用传送带送给其他生灵。制造礼物时，头上烟囱会涌出冰冷彩烟。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's bag generates a seemingly endless amount of goodies that it slides towards others using a conveyor belt. Cold, colorful smoke billows from the smokestacks on its head while generating presents.

entry: 复杂齿轮组让POKENAME核心内的熔炉持续燃烧，供给滚烫吐息。三颗头能同时喷火，但之后得短暂不动，补回储热。
author: sk372
source: Complex sets of gears keep an internal furnace within POKENAME's core lit, fueling its burning-hot fire breath. All three heads can expel blazing fire at once, but this leaves POKENAME immobile for a short time as it replenishes its heat stores.

entry: POKENAME齿轮转动，产生足够能量，让它高速滚动。每次停下，都会从鼻子喷出大量蒸汽。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's gears churn up enough energy to let it roll around at high speeds. Whenever it stops a rolling session, it lets out a large amount of steam from its trunk.

entry: POKENAME在幕后工作，确保电影拍出动感镜头。它能稳定、同步摄影机，是剧组宝贵的帮手。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME works behind the scenes to ensure movies capture dynamic shots. Its ability to stabilize and synchronize cameras makes it a valuable asset on any film crew.

entry: POKENAME与工厂工程师共事，递送工具。它想帮上忙，也迫切想学习复杂工作。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME works alongside factory engineers by handing out tools. It wants to feel helpful and is eager to learn how to perform complex tasks.

entry: 人们饲养POKENAME，图的不是营养哞哞鲜奶，而是生产各种燃料的本领。因此，世界各地许多加油站都有它，出售它产的奶。
author: fishinpowerarmour
source: Instead of nutritious Moomoo Milk, POKENAME are kept for their ability to produce fuel of many kinds. They are found in various petrol stations around the world thanks to this who sell POKENAME's milk.

entry: POKENAME神出鬼没地走遍世界，修理因进水、锈蚀或短路损坏的机器。世界各地技师奉它为工业净化之神。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME elusively travels the world to repair machines damaged by excessive water damage, rust, or short-circuits. Mechanics worldwide worship it as an industrial purification deity.

entry: POKENAME头上的带刺轮高速猛转，足以将坚岩碾成碎石。它再吃下岩块，用体内齿轮磨粉，提取微量金属矿物筑壳。
author: .jerden
source: The spiked wheel on POKENAME's head can spin with enough speed and force reduce solid rock to rubble. POKENAME then eats this rock, grinding it into dust with its internal gears so that it can extract trace amounts of metallic ore to build its shell.

entry: 体内机构驱动POKENAME高速旋转带刺齿轮，可挖穿土地，也能在地上滚动。金属刺随时可能转起来，即使不活动，靠近也危险。
author: .jerden
source: Driven by internal mechanisms, POKENAME can spin its spiky gear at high speed to tunnel through the earth or roll around above ground. Since these metal spikes can begin to move at any time, even inactive POKENAME are dangerous to approach.

entry: POKENAME大多时候静止，为内部机构充能。充满后就开始暴走，高速转刺轮，用齿轮磨击敌人。
author: .jerden
source: Most of the time, POKENAME remain still, charging their internal mechanisms with energy. Once they are fully charged, they begin to rampage, spinning their spiky wheel at high speed and grinding their gears against foes.

entry: POKENAME大多时候静止，为内部机构充能。充满后就开始暴走，高速转刺轮，用齿轮磨击敌人。
author: .jerden
source: Most of the time, POKENAME remain still, charging their internal mechanisms with energy. Once they are fully charged, they begin to rampage, spinning their spiky wheel at high speed and grinding their gears against foes.

entry: 据说双手中的两枚齿轮称为“时之齿轮”。传说小的被偷，POKENAME周围时间会冻结；大的被偷，则连所有时间都会冻结。
author: infinex21
source: Supposedly, the two gears within its hands are called "Time Gears." Legends claim that if the smaller gear is stolen, then time around POKENAME will freeze. Likewise, they also claim if the larger gear is stolen, then all of time will also freeze.

entry: POKENAME乘在尾部大齿轮上，高速旋转前进。几个小群体很喜欢彼此竞速。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rides atop the large gear on its tail, which spins rapidly to give it a quick form of locomotion. Small groups of POKENAME like to participate in races against each other.

entry: 有些家庭不用陷阱，而请POKENAME驱赶害兽宝可梦。它模仿痛叫，让侵入住处的宝可梦因恐惧离开。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: As an alternative to traps, some families use POKENAME to deter pest Pokémon. By having POKENAME mimic sounds of pain, problem Pokémon leave the house they are infesting out of fear.

entry: POKENAME将尾巴像链枷般甩动，刺激沿尾红色核心发电。随后从带刺圆环放出强力雷电。
author: fireblade141
source: To charge electricity, POKENAME spins its tail about like a flail, agitating the red cores along it to generate power. It then blasts this energy out as powerful lightning bolts from its spike ring.

entry: POKENAME的链锯肢体一旦启动加速，不切到东西就不肯停。许多个体受雇在木材场帮忙，或从事木雕。
author: sk372
source: Once its chainsaw limbs are revved up, POKENAME won't rest until it's cut into something with them. Many get employed to help out in lumber yards or as wood carvers.

entry: POKENAME齿轮转动，让它靠带刺轮滚行。它很少走直线，总绕圈转弯。轮子带磁，转得够快就能悬浮。
author: .jerden
source: The spinning of POKENAME's gears enables it to roll around on its spiky wheels. It rarely travels in straight lines, and will constantly circle and turn. Its wheels are magnetic, and it will levitate if it spins them fast enough.

entry: POKENAME吃东西极快，现代流水线就是以它的机械舌头为原型。
author: jemeremmazza
source: Capable of consuming food at a rapid rate, the modern day assembly line is based off of the mechanical tongue of the POKENAME.

entry: 烧煤熔炉驱动POKENAME内部机构，烟囱排出浓黑烟。产生的能量能从炮口射出，闪起明亮红光。
author: .jerden
source: A coal-burning furnace powers POKENAME's internal mechanisms, venting thick black smoke from its chimneys. The energy it generates can be fired from its canons, producing bright flashes of red light.

entry: 烧煤熔炉驱动POKENAME内部机构，烟囱排出浓黑烟。它能给炮内气体加压，借此高速发射煤块。
author: .jerden
source: A coal-burning furnace powers POKENAME's internal mechanisms, venting thick black smoke from its chimneys. It can pressurize gas inside its canons, then use this to fire chunks of coal at high speed.

entry: POKENAME能胜任最复杂的工程工作，以与工程师合作、解决现代难题为傲。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is suitable for the most complex feats of engineering. It takes great pride in working alongside engineers to create solutions to modern challenges.

entry: POKENAME似乎受冲突之地吸引，常试图干扰任何飞行器。投下的炸弹里却只有修复与安抚能量，希望促进和平。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are seemingly drawn to areas filled with strife and conflict, often seeming to try and interfere with any aircraft. The bombs they drop are filled only with restorative and soothing energies meant to encourage peace.

entry: POKENAME吸收阳光能量，存进全身各核心，供尾部组件运转。它能遥控组件，射出时力量足以劈开树木。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME absorbs energy from the sun and stores it in the various cores throughout its body.  This energy is used to power its tail-pieces, which it can remotely control and send flying with enough force to cleave through a tree.

entry: POKENAME轻易就能犁过积雪、沥青与松软地面，再释放大量蒸汽降温。
author: lemmymaster
source: POKENAME plough through snow, asphalt and loose ground with ease. They cool themselves down by releasing lots of steam.

entry: POKENAME在机体内燃烧大量煤炭及其他燃料。它能转动履带，射出炽热的金属板，甚至用锋利的前端劈开厚重的金属墙。
author: chorb33
source: It burns masses of coal and other fuel sources in its hull. POKENAME has the ability to spin its treads, shoot out hot slabs of metal, and even split thick metal walls with its sharp-edged front.

entry: 经常能在仓库与储存设施见到POKENAME，由训练家引导，搬运大物件。能骑乘而非只在旁指引，被视为一种荣耀。
author: thesilverowls
source: POKENAME are often seen carrying large objects in warehouses and storage facilities, guided by a Trainer. To be able to ride a POKENAME and not just guide it is seen as a mark of honor.

entry: POKENAME入侵电脑时，系统速度会变成三倍。但一离开，文件便乱套，处理速度降至原来的三分之一。
author: .izik
source: While POKENAME infests a computer, the system runs three times as fast. The moment it leaves, however, files scramble, and the processing speed drops to three times slower than its original pace.

entry: 人们相信，POKENAME的部分身体已移入另一维度。因此，机构看似碎散，仍能转动。
author: .jerden
source: It is believed that part of POKENAME's body has been partially shifted into another dimension. This enables its mechanism to still rotate, despite appearing to be broken into pieces.

entry: POKENAME统治森林环境，鲜有天敌能穿透钢甲，能消化的更少。它爬过的树，会留下很深的刻痕。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME dominates its forest environment, with few predators able to pierce its steel plating and even fewer able to digest it. It leaves deep gashes in the trees it climbs.

entry: 为驱动火车而制造的人造宝可梦系列中的第三种。它的身体已能将燃料利用效率发挥到极致。
author: gayschlatt
source: The third in a line of man-made Pokémon made for train engines. Its body has managed to maximize fuel efficency.

entry: 背部齿轮转动，为嘴里喷出的水增加威力。POKENAME给身体涂泥，奇怪的是，似乎能让齿轮运转更好。
author: sk372
source: The gears churning in its back give extra power to the water it can shoot from its mouth. POKENAME applies mud to its body that, strangely, seems to increase the functionality of its  gears as they rotate.

entry: 这些古怪宝可梦虽有会生锈的金属身体，却常在流水附近筑巢。它们强得能抬巨石，堆在窝边，尽量挡住大部分水。
author: infinex21
source: These odd Pokémon often make their nests near bodies of running water, even though their metal bodies can rust. Their bodies are strong enough to lift boulders, which they stack up along their nests to try and block most water.

entry: POKENAME是银齿轮咬合、空灵能量流动构成的优雅自动人偶。它稳稳浮在齿轮上，核心脉动，精神波与机械嗡鸣和谐共振，战时安抚伙伴、扰乱敌人。
author: cerealjamalt
source: POKENAME is a graceful automaton of interlocking silver gears and flowing ethereal energy. It floats with precision on its gear, the glowing core pulses as psychic waves harmonize with mechanical whirrs to soothe allies or disorient foes in battle.

entry: POKENAME动作僵硬机械，默默以高深精神力维护周围科技设备。它似乎能影响遇见的齿轮儿相关融合体。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME moves in a robotic and stiff manner, silently maintaining technology around it with advanced psychic powers. It seems to hold some manner of sway over Klink-related fusions it comes across.

entry: POKENAME通过绕身圆环引导能量，制造强力攻击与坚固屏障。因此，常能见它保护重要地点。
author: alexatheos
source: POKENAME channels energy through the ring around its body to create powerful blasts and sturdy barriers. Because of this, it is often seen protecting important locations.

entry: POKENAME固定在人工建筑侧面，观察经过的一切。常被误认为普通监控摄影机，想破坏它的犯罪者，却常因此反遭攻击。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME secures itself to the sides of manmade structures, where it observes anything that passes by. It is often mistaken for a normal security camera, which often causes would-be criminals who attempt to vandalize it to be attacked.

entry: POKENAME环状身体的能量最中心，有枚齿轮，只有受刺激才会转。齿轮越快，异界力量就越强。
author: infinex21
source: The gear at the very center of the energy within its ring-like body never turns unless the POKENAME is agitated. The quicker its gears turn, the stronger its otherworldly powers become.

entry: POKENAME以齿轮作轮，缓缓滚过地面，寻找能塞进巨口的钢属性宝可梦吃。双颚能压碎大多数金属。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME rolls slowly along the ground upon the gears it uses as wheels, seeking to devour any Steel-type Pokémon it can fit into its maw. Its jaws are strong enough to crush most metals.

entry: POKENAME罕见，只在夜间出现。工人留下备用零件作供品，希望它保佑机器别坏。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is rarely seen, only emerging at night. Factory workers leave spare parts as offerings for it in hopes that it will keep their machines from breaking.

entry: 废工厂可见POKENAME大吃旧机器。发亮的大红眼如手电，再配上令人不安的动作，据说让许多研究者极为惶恐。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME can be seen in abandoned factories, gorging themselves on old pieces of machinery. Their large, glowing red eye acts as a flashlight, and coupled with their unsettling movements are said to have caused many researchers great distress.

entry: POKENAME用腹部的嘴收集、吞食废金属，回收时冒出不祥浓烟。回收金属变成新零件，替掉旧件，旧件则作为废料丢弃。
author: infinex21
source: The abdominal mouth of a POKENAME is used to collect and devour scrap metal, emitting ominous smoke as it recycles the material. The reclaimed metal becomes new parts to replace old ones, which are discarded as scrap.

entry: 训练好的POKENAME靠旋转锯很能帮忙，但野化个体会破坏建筑、危及生命。多数地区要求持证才能饲养或繁殖。
author: .fedoraman
source: Well-trained POKENAME can be very useful for their spinning saws, but feral ones wreak havoc on buildings and endanger lives. Most regions require a permit to own or breed them.

entry: 它会按战斗方式换用不同齿轮。最容易认出的是攻击与防御齿轮，但另有许多输出功率不同的变体。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It has different gears depending on the type of fighting it wants to do. The most easily identifiable are attack and defense gear, but there are many variations with different power outputs.

entry: POKENAME固执得惊人，靠履带跨过几乎任何地形，追逐目标不休。躯干齿轮调节强毒流入角中，毒倒追上的对象。
author: sk372
source: Stubborn to an incredible degree, POKENAME uses the treads of its body to relentlessly pursue targets across almost any terrain. The gears in its torso regulate the flow of a potent venom into its horn to poison the targets it chases down.

entry: POKENAME在伦琴猫融合体中格外友善。两只率群首领相遇，会接合齿轮状鬃毛，露出微笑；之后两群合一，由双方平等领导。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME are unusually friendly for Luxray fusions. When two pack-leading POKENAME meet, they connect their gear-shaped manes and smile - afterward, their packs merge, and both POKENAME lead as equals.

entry: POKENAME能连续转头360度，用来钻入山壁。它一钻就能坚持数天，对敢养它的矿工极有价值。
author: vlavoc
source: POKENAME can rotate its head 360 degrees continuously, which it uses to drill into the sides of mountains. They can endure days of drilling at a time, making them invaluable to miners daring enough to train one.

entry: POKENAME是审判级巨兽，铠甲坚不可破，力量出众。虽冷淡疏离，却很体贴，愿守护信任的对象。
author: theeggoverlord
source: POKENAME is a judgement-class beast, with impervious armor and superb power. While cold and aloof, it's very caring and will protect those it trusts.

entry: 最早记录它的，是一本名声不佳的八卦杂志，因此人们一度以为它只是骗局。
author: griddle
source: This Pokémon was originally thought to have been a hoax, having been first documented in an disreputable gossip magazine.

entry: 自发现融合后，许多训练家就争论，这并非真正的融合，只是一群紧紧连着的齿轮怪，被误认了而已。
author: starexpizz
source: Since fusion was discovered, many Trainers have argued that this Pokémon is not a true fusion - just a tightly bound cluster of Klinklangs mistaken for one.

entry: 颈边与耳边齿轮连睡觉也转，产生能量供身体活动。它们特别能察觉机器部件是否出了故障，或即将到达使用寿命的终点，是工程师宝贵的助手。
author: infinex21
source: The gears around their necks and ears spin even while they sleep, generating energy to fuel their bodies. They are uniquely aware of when components in machines are either faulty or nearing their end, making them valuable assistants to engineers.

entry: 这种机械宝可梦在星球轨道飞行，圆环与齿轮不停转，产生庞大动力。任何太靠近大气层的流星，都会被迅速锁定、摧毁。
author: infinex21
source: This mechanical Pokémon soars in our planet's orbit, its rings and gears always turning to generate raw power. It will quickly target and destroy any meteors that draw too close to the atmosphere.

entry: 有人说，POKENAME由极遥远的未来创造，维持时间正常流动。人们曾见它无声地观察帝牙卢卡神庙，朝残破神像发出机械吼声。
author: sk372
source: Some say POKENAME was created in the very distant future to maintain the proper flow of time. It has been seen silently observing temples dedicated to Dialga, letting out a mechanical roar towards crumbled statues of the Pokémon.

entry: 许多齿轮机构驱动POKENAME，让动作有点僵，但力量无可匹敌。每次发射毁灭性炮击后，都要释放大量蒸汽。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's movements are a bit stiff due to the many gear mechanisms powering it, but its strength is without peer. It needs to release massive amounts of steam after every devastating shot of its cannon.

entry: POKENAME尾部齿轮不停旋转，稳定产生强电。多余能量从背环排出时，会在当地制造雷雨。
author: infinex21
source: The gears of POKENAME's tail are constantly turning, generating a steady flow of potent electricity. When it discharges excess energy from the ring on its back, it creates thunderstorms in local areas.

entry: POKENAME金属壳内装着浮力气体，靠发条带动螺旋桨，在空中飞行。野生个体似乎随机漫游，没有目的地，彼此擦身却频繁得不像巧合。
author: .jerden
source: A metallic shell holds buoyant gas inside POKENAME's body as it flies through the air, using propellers spun by clockwork. Wild POKENAME seem to travel randomly, without any destination in mind, but pass by each other too often to be a coincidence.

entry: POKENAME借两齿轮间的电磁能离地悬浮。它以可爱外貌引猎物靠近，再用臂炮轰击。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME uses electromagnetic energy between the two gears to levitate off the ground. They use their charming appearance to lure in prey before blasting the opponent with their arm cannon.

entry: 即使战斗时，它也会借环状身体部件做杂技动作。活动越多，体内能量积得越多，进一步增强攻击。
author: infinex21
source: It uses the hoop-like parts of its own body to perform acrobatic maneuvers, even during battle. The more it moves, the more it builds up energy within its own body to further empower its attacks.

entry: POKENAME通过尾巴放出巨量能量，一记强攻就能击倒敌人。事后烟雾极毒，吸入后喉咙会持续不适3天。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME launches an enormous amount of energy through its tail, capable of knocking out foes in one powerful blast. The smoke created afterwards is extremely poisonous, able to irritate the throat for 3 days after the initial inhalation.

entry: POKENAME能反复射出尾巴的齿轮，从远处发动猛烈而不间断的攻击。敌人一靠近，它就用腰间覆着毒素的尖刺，连续戳刺，将其击倒。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can repeatedly fire off the gear on its tail, letting it fire off powerful, relentless blows from afar. If the foe gets near, it repeatedly jabs with the toxin-coated spikes around its waist to knock them out.

entry: POKENAME体内时钟依阴阳历运行，追踪太阳与月亮。许多人靠它，准确判断某些节日的日期。
author: quackquackattack
source: The internal clocks of POKENAME operate on a lunisolar calendar that tracks the movements of both the sun and moon. Many people rely on their help to accurately determine when certain holidays occur.

entry: POKENAME快速旋转来积蓄能量，并用环绕身体的圆环自卫。需要脱困时，它会让圆环飞速转动，借磁力将自己向上推进。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Twirling rapidly to build up energy, POKENAME defend themselves with the rings that surround their bodies. If they ever need to get out of trouble, they rapidly rotate their rings to propel themselves upwards with the magnetic force.

entry: 这种宝可梦曾被传为古人惩罚罪犯的工具，但该说法已被广泛证伪。它们出现在古堡，似乎只是较近发生的事。
author: fireblade141
source: The Pokémon was rumored to have been used as a criminal punishment by people of the past, but that theory has been widely disproven. Their appearance in ancient castles is apparently a more recent development.

entry: 齿轮驱动POKENAME头上的刀刃，让它能像圆锯般旋转。除战斗中撞击敌人，它还会用刺轮固定自身，同时以头部砍树、锯穿坚岩。
author: .jerden
source: Driven by gears, the blade on POKENAME's head can spin like a circular saw. In addition to slamming it into foes in combat, POKENAME can use its spiky wheel to anchor itself in place, while using its head to cut down trees or saw through solid rock.

entry: 齿轮驱动POKENAME头上的刀刃，让它能像圆锯般旋转。除战斗中撞击敌人，它还会用刺轮固定自身，同时以头部砍树、锯穿坚岩。
author: .jerden
source: Driven by gears, the blade on POKENAME's head can spin like a circular saw. In addition to slamming it into foes in combat, POKENAME can use its spiky wheel to anchor itself in place, while using its head to cut down trees or saw through solid rock.

entry: POKENAME是古代自动机械，部件却古怪地十分现代。据说若组成军队，力量甚至足以征服世界。
author: blazerxz
source: An ancient automaton, POKENAME is curiously made with modern mechanical parts. Allegedly, an army of them could be strong enough to conquer the world.

entry: 一场实验让POKENAME体形成倍暴增，也获得新的火力，如今已是战场强敌。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: An experiment has caused POKENAME to grow exponentially in size. It has also gained new firepower, now being a formidable foe in battle.

entry: 这种宝可梦飞得如战斗机般快，用利羽切斩猎物。它常自行脱羽，提高机动性，刀匠则将弃羽锻成优质剑与厨刀。
author: korro0490
source: This Pokémon flies as fast as a fighter jet, slicing its prey with its sharp feathers. It often discards its own feathers for better maneuverability. Bladesmiths forge these discarded feathers into high-quality swords and kitchen knives.

entry: POKENAME动作完全机械，却看不出动力来源。若得不到任何关爱表达，就会越动越慢，最终停下。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's movements are entirely mechanical, although it has no obvious source of power. If it does not receive any displays of affection from others, it will gradually move slower and slower until it stops moving.

entry: 得到训练家关爱，POKENAME齿轮就转得更快，动作更迅捷有力。影子形状与金属身体不同，彩色边缘甚至让影子显得立体。
author: .jerden
source: After receiving affection from its Trainer, POKENAME's gears turn faster, moving it with more speed and power. The shape of its shadow does not match its metal body, and the colourful edges can make it appear three-dimensional.

entry: 彩色圆球显示POKENAME心情，好斗时会泛红。战斗中，所有排气口都喷火，让身体与翅膀裹满翻腾火焰。
author: sk372
source: The colored orbs indicate POKENAME's disposition, glowing red when it becomes aggressive. In combat, fire bursts from every one of its vents, coating its body and wings in roiling flames.

entry: 传说POKENAME一旦停转齿轮，所有旁观者都会受诅咒。九尾只动下半身，保持站在齿轮上。它似乎并非真正的有机生物，体内只能听见微弱机械嗡鸣。
author: bobosmith01
source: Legends state that if POKENAME ever stops spinning its gears, any onlookers will be cursed. The Ninetales only moves its lower body to stay on the gears. It doesn't appear to actually be organic: only a faint whirring can be heard inside of it.

entry: POKENAME齿轮常卡住，无法移动。训练家虽能修好，让它高速旋转，但齿轮很快又会锁死。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's gears regularly jam, preventing it from moving. While Trainers can repair them to enable them to spin at high speed, their cogs will quickly lock up once again.

entry: POKENAME体内齿轮高速转，不断充能。它如润滑良好的机器，永不疲倦，也不需休息。
author: .jerden
source: Gears inside POKENAME spin at high speed, constantly charging it with energy. Moving like a well-oiled machine, POKENAME never tires or needs to rest.

entry: POKENAME尾齿轮不停转，产生维生所需的电。多余电力则用来电击敌人。
author: _._starry_._
source: The gears on POKENAME's tail constantly spin, generating the electricity it needs to live. It uses the extra electricity it produces to zap its foes.

entry: POKENAME齿轮以不同速度转动，控制歌声的音高与节拍。歌曲独特，能让附近机器停机。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's gears churn at different speeds to control the pitch and tempo of its singing. Its song has the unique trait of being able to cause machinery nearby to shut down.

entry: 蓝色身体虽充满浮力气体，重齿轮却拖累它，飞不高。风吹时，垂挂的两枚齿轮相碰，发出乐音。
author: .jerden
source: Although its blue body is filled with buoyant gas, its heavy gears weigh it down, preventing it from flying high. When the wind blows, its two hanging cogs clink together to make a musical sound.

entry: 红色身体虽充满浮力气体，重齿轮却拖累它，飞不高。风吹时，垂挂的两枚齿轮相碰，发出乐音。
author: .jerden
source: Although its red body is filled with buoyant gas, its heavy gears weigh it down, preventing it from flying high. When the wind blows, its two hanging cogs clink together to make a musical sound.

entry: POKENAME极其贪食金属，会疯狂袭击工厂里的机器，大快朵颐。由于成群出现时破坏严重，人们将它视为祸害。
author: daemonkill22
source: POKENAME has a voracious appetite for metal, attacking factory machinery in a feeding frenzy. It is considered a pest because of the damage it causes in large swarms.

entry: POKENAME最有力的部位，是红色的齿轮。它既能像武器般挥向后方来敌，也能与脑后的齿轮啮合，带动嘴边的齿轮高速转动。
author: .jerden
source: The most powerful part of POKENAME's body is its red gear, which can be swung like a weapon at any enemy approaching from behind, or interlocked with the cog on the back of its head to spin the gears around its mouth at high speed.

entry: POKENAME头部两侧，各有一组金属齿轮，近身磨击敌人时，便是威力强大的武器。齿轮也能当作旋转的弹丸射出，不过之后，它必须跑去将其捡回。
author: .jerden
source: The two sets of metal gears on either side of POKENAME's head are powerful weapons when ground against foes at close quarters. These cogs can also be fired off as spinning projectiles, although POKENAME must run after them to retrieve them.

entry: POKENAME是有缺陷的战斗机器人，常因此受嘲笑。但聪明头脑与宽广胸怀，让它证明了自己。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME is a defective warbot, often ridiculed for being so. It has proven itself with its smart mind and big heart.

entry: POKENAME藏在废料场，伪装成生锈齿轮。受扰就发磁脉冲，将附近物件锁在原处，再以沉重金属颚夹住，捕获沿途一切。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME hides in scrapyards, camouflaging among rusted gears. When disturbed, it releases a magnetic pulse that locks nearby objects in place before clamping down on them with its heavy metal jaws, capturing anything in its path.

entry: POKENAME四处奔走，寻找珍贵的宝石，制成华贵的装饰齿轮。这样做究竟有何用处，至今无人知晓。
author: phantom640
source: POKENAME scampers about searching for precious gems that it can make into valuable decorative gears. What purpose this behaviour serves is unknown.

entry: POKENAME巨钢颚一合，就能压碎牙间任何东西。若需更强咬力，带红色核心的齿轮就会急转，嘶嘶喷出阵阵蒸汽。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME clamps down with its massive steel jaws, it can crush anything between its fangs. If it needs extra power to bite, the gear with the red core spins rapidly, releasing hissing bursts of steam.

entry: 舞蹈僵硬机械。若试图跳得太快，身体就会过热，战斗时却正好能烧灼敌人。
author: hophoppip
source: Its dances are rigid and robotic. If it attempts to dance too rapidly, its body overheats, which comes in handy for searing its foes in battle.

entry: POKENAME常出现在垃圾场或废工厂。身体主要由收集来的金属与机器构成。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME is often found in junkyards or abandoned factories. Its body is mostly composed of the metal and machinery it collects.

entry: POKENAME最常见于废料场，吃掉遇见的金属碎片。身体似乎随意拼凑自各种旧零件，科学家仍在研究，究竟如何运作。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is most often seen in scrapyards, consuming any bits of metal it comes across. With its composition being a seemingly-random assortment of junk parts, scientists are still studying how it functions at all.

entry: 有些阴谋论者相信，POKENAME是政府秘密计划的产物，专从水下袭击敌舰。
author: chorb33
source: Some conspiracy theorists believe that POKENAME is a secret government project designed to attack enemy ships from below.

entry: 表盘上的时间从不准确。民间传说认为，POKENAME显示的其实是观看者的死期。
author: chorb33
source: The time on its dial never matches the actual time. Folk tales believe that POKENAME actually shows the date of death of the person who sees it.

entry: POKENAME齿轮的滴答声如节拍器，回响在守护的古老森林。谁乱丢垃圾或砍树，都得不到它的怜悯。
author: fancyskunk
source: The metronomic tick-tock of POKENAME's gears echoes through the old growth forests it protects. Those who litter or fell trees within its realm are shown no mercy.

entry: 炎夏，POKENAME站在运作的洒水器旁，享受水洒在锡制身体上的凉意。受扰时，头会快转，散出带金属气味的粉，接触就能麻痹。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME stands near running sprinkler systems during the hot summer months, enjoying the coolness of the water on its tin body. If disturbed, its head rotates rapidly and releases a metallic scented powder that can paralyze on contact.

entry: POKENAME翼上裹着厚而蓬松的烟云，是维持身体的齿轮转动所生。烟略带煤燃烧的味道，幸好吸入无毒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wings are covered with thick and fluffy clouds of smog, byproducts of the turning gears that keep its body functioning. The clouds smell slightly of burning coal and are fortunately non-toxic if inhaled.

entry: POKENAME飞行时不断喷烟，体内引擎持续排出污染物。啾鸣伴着喉中齿轮嗡响，歌里始终夹着咔嗒底音。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME emit constant puffs of smoke as they fly, their internal engine producing a constant stream of pollutants. Their songs have a constant undertone of clicks layered within them, the gears in their throat whirring as they chirp.

entry: POKENAME靠油和电供能，不断搜寻、吞食。喝下的油会漏出身体，让它在地面滑动。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME's bodies are fueled by oil and electricity, which they constantly seek out and consume. The oil they ingest leaks from their bodies, letting them slide themsves along the ground.

entry: POKENAME到哪里都留下油迹，身体不停渗油。它漫无目的地寻找机器，啃食零件。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME leave trails of oil wherever they go, constantly leaking from their bodies. They aimlessly seek out machinery, gnawing on and consuming its parts.

entry: POKENAME常在工厂里蹒跚走动，躲雨避湿。金属身体移动时吱呀刮响，不断漏油。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are often found hobbling around factories, taking shelter from the rain. Their metal bodies creak and scrape as they move, constantly leaking oil.

entry: 考古学家调查古迹时，发现了一只POKENAME。它何时耗尽燃料，甚至究竟会不会耗尽，都无人确定。
author: chorb33
source: Archaeologists found a specimen of POKENAME while investigating an ancient site. It is uncertain when, or even if, POKENAME will run out of fuel.

entry: 考古学家调查古迹时，发现了一只POKENAME。它何时耗尽燃料，甚至究竟会不会耗尽，都无人确定。
author: chorb33
source: Archaeologists found a specimen of POKENAME while investigating an ancient site. It is uncertain when, or even if, POKENAME will run out of fuel.

entry: POKENAME转动头上大星形齿轮，中央就涌出浓毒烟。烟污染空气，栖居地很快失去色彩，变得荒芜。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME spins the large star-shaped gear on its head, clouds of thick and toxic smoke billow out from the center. Areas where it inhabits quickly grow more faded and barren due to its smog polluting the air.

entry: POKENAME齿轮由体内引擎带动，定期喷黑烟。它能闪出红光，机构转得越快，光越亮。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's gears are turned by an internal engine, which belches out black smoke at regular intervals. It can produce flashes of red light that become brighter the faster its mechanism runs.

entry: POKENAME休息时僵硬、毫无生气，一察觉附近动静就活跃起来。发亮眼睛能探热，全黑也能捕猎。
author: ilija09
source: POKENAME appears rigid and lifeless at rest, but springs to life once it senses nearby activity. Its illuminated eyes can detect heat, allowing it to hunt even in total darkness.

entry: 肩内机械齿轮，让金属臂力量超过液压机。它爱紧紧握物，因此可用这力量在废料场压碎旧车，减少占地。
author: .jerden
source: The mechanical gears inside its shoulders give its metal arms more power than a hydraulic press. Since it enjoys gripping things tightly, its strength can be utilized to crush old cars in junkyards so that they take up less space.

entry: 这种宝可梦住在荒芜废土。不知为何，似乎厌恶一切植物生命，包括许多草属性宝可梦。
author: fireblade141
source: This Pokémon lives in barren wastelands. For unknown reasons, it seems to despise all forms of plant life, including many Grass-type Pokémon.

entry: 背上的齿轮，驱动着它前方的链锯。锯开一棵树后，POKENAME会吞食产生的木屑，消化成内部机构的燃料。
author: .jerden
source: The gears on its back power the chainsaw in front of it. Once it has sawn apart a tree, POKENAME will devour the wood chippings it creates, digesting them into fuel for its own internal mechanisms.

entry: POKENAME通常在煤矿废渣堆顶，搜集驱动齿轮熔炉所需的燃料。烟囱升起的浓黑烟，吸入后毒性极强。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is usually found on top of slag heaps from coal mines, scavenging for fuel for the furnaces that power the turning of its gears. The thick black smoke that rises from its chimneys is incredibly toxic to inhale.

entry: POKENAME把周围空气降至零下，让水分在碰到身体前先冻结，防止齿轮结冰。自卫时，它会像甩鞭一样甩动坚硬刺尾。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME chills the air around it to sub-zero temperatures, preventing ice from forming on its gears by freezing moisture before it reaches POKENAME's body. To defend itself from attack, POKENAME cracks its hard and spiky tail like a whip.

entry: 越开心，身上齿轮转得越快。POKENAME过度兴奋时，碰触很危险，需小心。
author: h0bojoe
source: The happier it gets, the faster the gears on its body spin. Caution is advised around overexcited POKENAME, as they become dangerous to touch.

entry: 全身锯齿机械在战斗中猛烈转动。POKENAME虽外表冰冷金属，性情却温暖、亲昵而忠诚。
author: h0bojoe
source: The jagged machinery on its body spins ferociously in combat. Despite its cold metal exterior, POKENAME is a very warm, affectionate, and loyal Pokémon.

entry: 转动盒上把手，POKENAME就会随着叮咚音乐旋转。它完全能自己动，却偏爱表演时维持一个优雅姿势。
author: .jerden
source: If the handle on its box is turned, POKENAME will begin to rotate while tinkling music plays. While POKENAME is fully capable of moving, it prefers to hold a single elegant pose while performing in this way.

entry: POKENAME歌唱时，齿轮加快，身边悬浮的光刃也更亮。演出到高潮，头上旋转的带刺环会开始噼啪带电。
author: .jerden
source: As POKENAME sings, its gears turn faster, and the glowing blades floating in the air next to them glow brighter. When it reaches the climax of one of its performances, the spiky ring spinning above its head will begin to crackle with electricity.

entry: POKENAME齿轮环与腰齿咬合，发出奇异悦耳的金属撞响。为了证明技巧，它会在令人眩晕的高速齿轮上起舞，让表演更精彩。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME's gear ring meshes with the teeth on its waist, they create metallic bangs that sound strangely melodic to the ear. To prove its skill, POKENAME will dance atop dizzying, high-speed gears to elevate the brilliance of its performance.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时，以手脚咬合齿轮，产生能量，增强敏捷。全力时，它形成能量刀刃，优雅斩向不懂欣赏表演技巧与美貌的对象。
author: soup1900
source: While dancing, POKENAME can use its feet and arms to mesh with its gears and generate energy to increase its agility. At full power, it forms energy blades to gracefully slice those who don't appreciate its performative skill and beauty.

entry: POKENAME齿轮高速转，驱动链锯。它虽吃木屑，却把砍倒的大多数树留在林地，让蘑菇慢慢分解。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's gears turn at high speed to power its chainsaw. While it eats the wood chippings it creates, it leaves most of the trees it fells lying on the forest floor, to be slowly rotted by mushrooms.

entry: POKENAME内部齿轮必须极高速运转，才能维持此形态，因此不断发出响亮嗡声。发红光的身体与反光翅膀，在攻击时闪起晃眼强光。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's internal gears must run at extremely high speed to achieve this form, and it constantly produces a loud whirring sound. POKENAME's glowing red body and reflective wings flash with blinding light as it attacks.

entry: POKENAME用钻头挖穿洞壁，寻找矿物与水晶，找到便吃，吸收进身体，微调挖掘本领。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use their drills to burrow through cave walls in search of minerals and crystals. They consume these materials as they find them, absorbing them into their bodies to fine-tune their digging skills.

entry: POKENAME全身不停长齿轮，以废金属为食。它在制造厂找到用武之地，吃边角料，提供自己长出的齿轮用于机器。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME constantly grows gears across its body and lives on a diet of scrap metal. They have found a niche in manufacturing plants, where they consume any offcuts and offer the gears they grow to be used in machinery.

entry: POKENAME掷手里剑时使其旋转，让轨迹绕过墙壁。齿轮转得极快，摩擦甚至会让钢开始熔化。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME spins its shuriken while throwing it to curve its trajectory around walls. POKENAME can rotate its gears fast enough that the friction makes its steel start to melt.

entry: 滑油润滑下，POKENAME齿轮几乎无声转动。掷出的金属手里剑始终与齿轮同速旋转，在敌人和物面间弹跳，直到回到手中。
author: .jerden
source: Lubricated by slick oil, POKENAME's gears turn in almost total silence. When POKENAME tosses its metal shuriken at foes, it constantly spins at the same speed as POKENAME's cogs, bouncing off enemies and surfaces until it returns to POKENAME's hand.

entry: POKENAME体型庞大，需要消耗极多的煤炭，才能移动身体。体内众多旋转的齿轮，能使它产生电力，用来攻击对手。
author: darkweavile428
source: Due to its large size, POKENAME requires an extremely large amount of coal to be able to move. The many spinning gears inside of POKENAME's body allow it to generate electricity, which it uses to attack its opponents.

entry: POKENAME不断检查工厂烘焙食品的品质，确保始终美味。它无法消化食物，多余物质会打嗝吐出。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME constantly test the quality of factory baked goods to ensure they are consistently delicious. They burp out excess matter as they cannot digest food.

entry: POKENAME帮助工厂维持烘焙品质，转动旋钮，不断检测产品，确保入口的品质始终如一。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME help factories maintain a consistent quality of baked goods. They turn dials and constantly test the quality of their products to ensure people receive the same bite every time.

entry: POKENAME轻易就能完成3名矿工的活，挖出的宝石与贵金属常让训练家致富。只要好好擦亮、夸几句，就能干上数小时。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can easily perform the mining tasks of 3 men and often make their Trainer rich from all the gems and precious metals they dig up. All POKENAME need is a good polish and praise to keep them going for hours.

entry: POKENAME白天耗能时，尾端喷嘴会积满蒸汽，通常夜间缓缓排出。但也有人见它突然大量放汽，掩藏身形。
author: camtft
source: The nozzle on the tail end of POKENAME fills up with steam as they use energy throughout the day. While usually being dispelled slowly during the night, they have been seen using a big release of steam to disguise themselves.

entry: 金属身体太重，POKENAME不会游泳。但它聪明，能用齿轮与其他材料造船，渡过湖海。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Due to the weight of its metal body, POKENAME is unable to swim. Its intelligence means POKENAME can use its gears and other materials to craft boats for it to cross lakes and oceans.

entry: POKENAME总在工作，高速转动的齿轮供给精神力。工地常请它担任机械师。
author: saucebolodu81
source: POKENAME is always working; its psychic power is fueled by its gear, which rotates at high speeds. It is used a lot at construction sites as a Mechanic.

entry: 如今，住在游戏厅的POKENAME越来越常充当轮盘。轮子本身已是厉害武器，它还可脱离轮子，追击保持距离的敌人。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Nowadays, it is increasingly common for POKENAME residing in Game Corners to act as a roulette wheel. While the wheel itself is an impressive weapon, POKENAME can detach from it to bring the fight to opponents who are keeping their distance.

entry: POKENAME背齿轮显示拳头会用多少力量。转得越快，拳越重。有训练家说，面对新手训练家时，齿轮几乎不转。
author: sleepyman0731
source: The gears on POKENAME's back indicate how much power they will use for their punches. The faster their gears spin, the harder the punch. Trainers with POKENAME report that the gears rarely move if the opponent is a new Trainer.

entry: POKENAME保护尾火，因为那是火焰力量的来源。背齿轮高速转，将它送上空中，身边圆环则在滑翔时控制飞行。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME protect the flame at the end of their tail because it is the source of their fiery powers. The gears on their back spin rapidly to launch them into the air, while the ring around their body controls their flight as they glide.

entry: POKENAME靠金属壳抵挡伤害。体内小齿轮转动，排出水流，能扑灭小火。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rely on their metallic shell to shield them from harm. The small gears within their body spin to expel a stream of water, allowing them to put out small fires.

entry: 工厂将POKENAME用于防治害兽，以气味把小害兽引入咬合的齿轮。必要时，它也能兼作垃圾桶。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME is placed in factories as a method of pest control, luring small vermin into its grinding gears via smell. When necessary, it doubles as a trash can.

entry: POKENAME偏爱多岩山坡。齿轮高速转，抓地力出奇强，让它能攀上崎岖山顶。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME has an affinity for rocky mountainsides. It scales rough summits by rapidly spinning its gears, which boast a surprising amount of grip.

entry: POKENAME徘徊垃圾场与废料堆，用额外手臂抓取、分析废件。符合标准的金属才吃，但具体标准尚不明。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hangs around junkyards and trash heaps, using its extra arms to grab and analyze scrap it finds. It consumes metal that meets its criteria, though the exact criteria it searches for is not yet known.

entry: POKENAME常在大型锻造厂运送炽热金属。它们不怕高温，甚至能踏过熔融材料。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME are often used in large industrial forges to transport hot metal, as they do not mind high heat and can trudge through molten material.

entry: POKENAME吞煤，供给体内熔炉燃烧。极热火焰，则从身体各处开口喷出。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME eats coal to fuel the furnace in its body. It ejects the incredibly hot flames from the combustion process through various openings.

entry: POKENAME不停旋转，再用自身产生的磁力加速，快得迸出火花。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME rotates continuously, using self-generated magnetism to accelerate in such a way that it sparks.

entry: POKENAME能产生庞大能量，也会释放强大磁波，让附近大多数电器停摆。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can generate an incredible amount of energy, but it also emits powerful magnetic waves that disable most electrical devices in the vicinity.

entry: POKENAME转动几个头，不断产生能量与热，存进外环，也能从环中释放。
author: chorb33
source: By rotating its heads, POKENAME can constantly generate energy and heat, which it can store in its outer ring. It can also use this to release it.

entry: POKENAME的身体不断转动，各个头也轮流换位。位于最高处的，暂时担任指挥。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME's body rotates continuously, causing its individual heads to change position regularly. The one at the top is in temporary command.

entry: 它一生在一处静止，将自己固定在强海流附近的海床。水穿过身体，带动体内马达，维持生命。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its entire life is spent motionless in one spot. It anchors itself to the ocean floor near strong currents. The water passing through its body spins the motor in its body, giving it life.

entry: 齿轮怪熔化后与臭臭泥融合，因此POKENAME常见于烧毁的工厂。早在基因之楔问世前，就已发现这种融合。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME are often found in burnt factories, as the Klinklang melts and fuses with the Muk. This is a fusion that was found even before DNA Splicers.

entry: POKENAME想轰击对手，炮内齿轮就会转。转得越快，威力越大。
author: seanothan_23
source: When POKENAME wants to blast its opponents, the gears in its cannon spin. The faster they spin, the stronger the blast.

entry: 即使污染水也不会让POKENAME生锈，航运公司常请它修船或水下设施。如今大多数船上都有几只。
author: chorb33
source: Since POKENAME does not rust even in contaminated water, shipping companies often use it for repairs on ships or underwater infrastructure. Most ships nowadays have several POKENAME on board.

entry: 人们认为，POKENAME是逃出实验室、如今生活在深海的失败实验体。如何繁殖、防锈并承受压力，仍不清楚。
author: notmax22
source: POKENAME are thought to be failed experiments that broke out and now live in the deep ocean. How they reproduce, avoid rusting, and survive the pressure is still unknown.

entry: POKENAME用幻觉保护孩子，通常将双方都伪装成幽灵属性宝可梦。既能吓退人和宝可梦，也能让对方不愿用它们最怕的物理攻击。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses illusions to protect its child from harm. It usually disguises them both as Ghost-type Pokémon, as this frightens people and Pokémon away and also discourages the use of the physical attacks they are most vulnerable to.

entry: POKENAME用背上长出的、有生命的阴影，笼罩最爱的花林。训练家走进暮色般的林中，有时会迷失幻觉，数小时不见踪影。
author: riley_muir_qu33n_in_yellow
source: POKENAME shroud groves of its favorite flowers in the living shadows that grow from its back. Trainers who venture into these twilight groves have been know to disappear for hours, lost in illusions.

entry: POKENAME是高明的恶作剧高手，放肆笑声一响，准有麻烦。不捉弄时，也会用三只大耳奏出管风琴般的旋律。
author: hophoppip
source: A masterful trickster, the wild laugh of a POKENAME is a sure sign of trouble. When not playing pranks, POKENAME plays songs, producing organ-like melodies with its three large ears.

entry: 野生POKENAME极其危险，会制造幻象分散对方的注意，再从背后突袭。
author: prof.whitebeam
source: Wild POKENAME are highly dangerous because of their ability to create an illusion as a distraction while it strikes from behind.

entry: POKENAME结群穿过旷野，猎捕沿途一切。多数只会盲目向前冲，但也有人声称，有些会用弓箭。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME travel in herds across open fields, hunting anything that crosses their paths. While most POKENAME blindly charge forward to attack, there have been claims that some have used bows and arrows.

entry: 它既能操纵幻象，身体又极易变形，只要体量足够，几乎能变成任何想要的模样。但若突然受惊，就会恢复原形。
author: elfail0
source: Its power over illusions and ability to shapeshift its incredibly malleable body means that it can take on nearly any appearance it desires, as long as it has the body mass for it. If it is suddenly surprised, it will revert to its original form.

entry: POKENAME用幻象，让自己显得大得多、可怕得多，吓散鱼群。随后，它趁着混乱，挑几只落单的抓来，作为一餐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME scares schools of fish by casting illusions to make itself appear to be a much larger, fearsome Pokémon. As the school scatters, POKENAME takes advantage of the confusion to pick off a few stragglers for its meal.

entry: 遇上捕食者时，POKENAME会制造火焰的幻象，试图将其吓退。它平时很戒备训练家，只有获得它信任的人才知道，它的毛发柔软无比。
author: tmotime
source: Whenever it encounters predators, POKENAME creates illusionary flames in an attempt to scare them away. While it's normally wary of Trainers, those it trusts find its fur to be incredibly soft.

entry: 野生POKENAME巧用幻觉，战时装成完全不同的宝可梦，让敌人使用效果甚微或无效的招式，再以暗影冲击波和强精神能量反击。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME make cunning use of their illusions in battle, pretending to be completely different Pokémon so that foes use moves with little or no effect. They then strike back with shadowy shockwaves and powerful psychic energy.

entry: POKENAME装成人类，默默跟随强训练家。看过对方所有宝可梦战斗后，便显真身，利用搜集的情报进攻。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME disguise themselves as humans so that they can silently accompany strong Trainers. After watching all of their Pokémon in battle, POKENAME will reveal their true form and attack, taking advantage of the intelligence they have gathered.

entry: 野生POKENAME以幻觉装人，再用心灵感应指挥其他宝可梦对敌。虽从不说话，也不藏精神力，却仍常被误认为训练家。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME use illusions to pretend to be human, then telepathically command other Pokémon to battle against their foes. Although they never speak and do not hide their psychic powers, they are still frequently mistaken for Pokémon Trainers.

entry: POKENAME爱用幻觉捉弄人，却无恶意。尤其爱装成传说的宝可梦，引人追赶，再坏笑着露真容。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME loves to prank people with its illusion abilities, though it means no harm. It particularly enjoys masquerading as legendary Pokémon, making its viewers give chase before revealing its true form with an impish laugh.

entry: POKENAME照料天然树林，监测温湿度是否适合生长。新来者若威胁家园，就会造出可怕顶级猎手的幻象，将其吓退。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME tend to natural groves, monitoring the area to ensure that the temperature and humidity are suitable for growth. If a new arrival threatens the safety of their home, they create an illusion of a fearsome apex Pokémon to scare them off.

entry: POKENAME的火焰制造热浪蜃景，将敌人困入其中。一旦被幻象捕获，就再也逃不掉。
author: jordanx27
source: Their flames allow POKENAME to ensnare their opponents in a mirage formed by the heat haze. Once trapped by the illusion, there is no escape.

entry: POKENAME装成其他宝可梦，混在其中，但一咬东西，伪装就消失。偏偏它最爱的事之一就是嚼骨头，实在不巧。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME disguise themselves as other Pokémon to blend in, but they lose this disguise whenever they bite down on anything. This is rather unfortunate, as one of their favorite things to do is chew on bones.

entry: 这种宝可梦常被视为智慧与狡黠的象征。它精通幻术，能让自己看似同时出现在多处，欺骗猎物和捕食者。更可怕的是，它甚至能让森林仿佛永无尽头。
author: elfail0
source: A Pokémon often associated with vast wisdom and cunning. Its mastery over illusions allows it to appear in many places at once, deceiving both prey and those who hunt it. Even more frighteningly, its illusions can make forests appear endless.

entry: 野生POKENAME用幻觉藏住复杂蛛网，方便捕猎。它也顽皮，会用蛛丝与幻觉捉弄其他生灵，连自己的训练家也不放过。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME will use illusions to hide their complex webs to better capture prey. They are also mischievous pranksters who will use their webbing and illusions to mess with others, even their own Trainers.

entry: 这种神秘POKENAME变体爱伪装，穿上服装就明显更开心。它经常喜欢上猫类宝可梦。
author: periperi_chicken
source: This mysterious POKENAME variant loves disguising itself, becoming noticeably happier when wearing a costume. It often takes a liking to feline Pokémon.

entry: 它以逼真幻象迷惑敌人、躲避危险。制造幻觉的力量起初弱，却随年龄增强。年老POKENAME可由拖曳的长鬃辨认。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It makes lifelike illusions to confuse foes and hide from danger. Though initially weak, its illusory power increases with age. Elder POKENAME can be identified by their long, trailing mane.

entry: 许多故事说，训练家自信捉到了POKENAME，打开球却满是泥巴，原来已中了它的幻觉诡计。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: There have been many stories of Trainers who are convinced they have caught a POKENAME, only to open the Poké Ball and find it filled with mud, the Trainers having fallen victim to POKENAME's illusionary tactics.

entry: POKENAME模仿其他鸟宝可梦叫声，欺骗亲鸟，趁它们离巢偷蛋。
author: .izik
source: By mimicking the cries of other bird Pokémon, POKENAME deceives parents and steals eggs from their nests while they're away.

entry: POKENAME极其害羞，会制造幻象迷惑潜在的敌人，或掩护自己逃走。它体型大、模样讨人喜欢，又不具攻击性，是很受欢迎的幼儿伴侣。
author: elfail0
source: This incredibly shy Pokémon can conjure illusions to mislead potential enemies or cover its escape. Due to its large size, cuddly appearance, and lack of aggression, POKENAME are prized highly as pets for young children.

entry: POKENAME外貌惹人害怕，因此藏在洞里，用幻觉掩真容，与训练家交好。满月能量照来时，头纹会充满神秘力量。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are feared due to their appearance; because of this, they hide in caves, using illusions to mask their true form and bond with trainers. When exposed to a full moon's energy, the marking on its head is filled with a mysterious power.

entry: POKENAME装成其他鸟宝可梦飞过天空，迁徙路线也与周围同伴一致。它会趁机偷吃公园无人看管的点心。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME can be found soaring through the sky disguised as other bird Pokémon, and their migration patterns match the Pokémon around them. They opportunistically steal treats from unattended food left at parks.

entry: POKENAME以间谍电影中的演出最出名。它能幻化成任何宝可梦，但一绊倒，幻觉就破了。
author: aberry8286
source: POKENAME is best known for its appearances in spy movies. It can transform into any Pokémon, but tripping breaks the illusion.

entry: 传说虽不祥，POKENAME对迷路幼儿却温柔。它模仿孩子的父母，将走散的幼儿平安带回城镇。
author: .izik
source: Despite ominous tales, POKENAME is gentle toward lost toddlers. It imitates their parents to guide wandering children safely back to towns.

entry: 浓雾森林深处，POKENAME观察路过训练家，了解人类。研究结束，若对方仍迷路，就造出流浪宝可梦幻象，引往安全处。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Deep within foggy forests, POKENAME studies passing Trainers in an attempt to learn more about humans. If a Trainer remains lost in the woods after its research is complete, it will create an illusion of a stray Pokémon to lead them to safety.

entry: POKENAME模仿发电厂工人，精准得令人发毛。独处时，会从机器偷电，为自己供能。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME imitates power plant workers with eerie precision. When left alone, it siphons electricity from machines to fuel itself.

entry: POKENAME用幻觉化成鸟宝可梦，在空中翱翔时借此避开天敌。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME use their ability to create illusions to take on the visage of bird Pokémon. They do this to avoid predators while soaring through the skies.

entry: POKENAME以复杂幻觉和肩上蓝色种子长出的植物，保护茂盛领地与其中众多宝可梦。它与幻象并肩战斗，压倒对手。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME protect their lush territories and the many other Pokémon within using complex illusions and plants grown from the blue seeds upon their shoulders. They fight alongside their illusions to overwhelm their opponents.

entry: POKENAME像多年前另一地区曾出现过的一种宝可梦画像。它常在寒冷地区无精打采地游荡，以强幻觉吓人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME bear a resemblance to a depiction of Pokémon once seen many years ago in another region. They are often found in cold areas, wandering listlessly and frightening others with powerful illusions.

entry: POKENAME很少直接交战，更爱用逼真幻象折磨敌人。几乎完全无声，更添不安。
author: rakanadyo
source: Rarely participating in direct combat, POKENAME instead prefer to torment their foes with lifelike illusions. The fact that they're almost completely silent only makes this more unsettling.

entry: 腐败残留的地方，POKENAME常在附近反抗。传闻它能改变人心，净化灵魂。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Wherever corruption lingers, POKENAME are often close by to fight back. Rumor has it that they have the ability to change someone's heart and purify their soul.

entry: POKENAME用幻觉与变色能力，尽量不让任何人或宝可梦注意。一觉得被发现，就搬去别处。
author: oreee0230
source: POKENAME will use its illusions and color-changing ability to try to avoid being noticed by anyone or any Pokémon. Once it thinks it's been detected, it will move to another place to live.

entry: POKENAME以奇异力量向人群施幻，造成集体狂乱。人们认为，它一次最多能影响108人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its strange powers to cast illusions on groups of people to create mass hysteria. It is believed that the maximum number of people it can affect at once is 108.

entry: POKENAME披着暗影，借波导发力，以幻象迷惑敌人，再用钢爪攻击。每次欺骗得逞，力量便更强。
author: sheogorath
source: Cloaked in shadows and powered by aura, POKENAME confounds foes with illusions while striking with steel claws. Its power surges with each deception.

entry: POKENAME用幻术对自己眼中的弱小训练家与宝可梦隐去身形。唯有遇到值得一战的强敌，才会现身挑战。
author: hello_i_exist
source: POKENAME uses its illusions to hide itself from Trainers and Pokémon it considers to be weak. It will only reveal itself to worthy opponents in order to challenge them to a fight.

entry: POKENAME夜行如幽灵，速度与幻觉本领使它极少被目击。领地意识极强。
author: ishdra
source: POKENAME move like ghosts in the night. Very few have been seen due to their speed and illusory capabilities. They are fiercely territorial.

entry: POKENAME爱捉弄林中迷途者。它用幻觉装成大丛枝叶，等倒霉旅人靠近，就突然发出低沉嘶哑、令人不安的大笑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME loves to prank unfortunate folks lost in the woods. It casts an illusion to disguise itself as a large set of foliage, waiting for a hapless traveler to come close before belting out an unnervingly deep croaking laugh.

entry: POKENAME幻觉本领能完美模仿世上任何生灵。某些地区有边缘团体相信，世上大多数人其实都是它伪装的。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's illusory abilities let it perfectly mimic any other creature in the world. There are some fringe groups in certain regions that believe that most of the people in the world are actually POKENAME in disguise.

entry: POKENAME用幻觉装出火焰鬃毛，许多宝可梦以为真着火，吓得不轻。被逼入绝境，它会打出迅速而极准的拳。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME pretends its mane is made of flames by creating illusions, frightening many Pokémon that mistake it for real fire. When cornered, it can unleash rapid and highly accurate punches.

entry: 为守护巢穴，POKENAME会合力迷惑被视为威胁的对象，随即迅速出击。它的速度与灵活程度无可比拟。
author: dahappycute
source: To protect their lair, POKENAME work together to trick and swiftly attack at those they deem to be a threat. It has speed and agility like no other Pokémon.

entry: 据说六只耳朵能听见方圆一千英里内的任何秘密。POKENAME还能完美扮作任何生物，为自己谋利。
author: milchik
source: Its six ears are said to hear any secret within a thousand miles radius. POKENAME can perfectly impersonate any creature it wants for its own benefit.

entry: POKENAME似乎将铁冠视为权威象征。它以幻觉装成擅长领导的宝可梦种类，试着招揽追随者。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME seem to regard their iron crown as a symbol of authority. They use illusions to pretend to be Pokémon species with a reputation for leadership, then try to recruit other Pokémon as their followers.

entry: POKENAME同时将多个目标困在幻象中，留待日后饥饿，再吸取它们的生命力。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME traps multiple victims in illusions at once, storing them for later, when it'll be hungry for their life force.

entry: POKENAME总藏着剑的真形，只向最亲近者揭示。它用幻象刀刃，出人意料地穿梭于攻势之间。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME are constantly hiding the true shape of their sword, revealing the truth only to those closest to them. They use their illusory blade to weave through attacks unexpectedly.

entry: POKENAME借夜色游走，以致命突袭和闪电般的打击挑战强敌，反击到来前便又消失在阴影中。只有证明本领的对象，才可能再看见它一次。
author: silentscript89
source: POKENAME roams under the cover of night, challenging worthy foes with lethal surprise attacks and lightning-fast strikes only to vanish into the shadows again before they can strike back. Only those who prove their skill may glimpse it twice.

entry: POKENAME精通战斗与诡计，却往往回避交锋，而是用电气幻象藏起幼崽，保护它们。它们也喜欢制造虚假的雷暴，赶走竞争者与好奇的人。
author: cpnquacken
source: A master of both battle and trickery, POKENAME tend to shy away from combat, instead creating electrical mirages to hide their children from danger. They love to create illusionary thunderstorms to drive away competitors and curious people.

entry: 矿工进入洞穴，POKENAME就会模仿其中一人，引走落单者，拖向矿井深处吞食。
author: .izik
source: If miners enter its cave, POKENAME imitates one of them to lure an individual away. It drags the isolated victim deeper into the mine to feed.

entry: POKENAME精细控水，让光在雾中折射、反射，制造视觉幻象。通常用来逗水手和其他宝可梦开心。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME has fine control over water, using it to refract and reflect light through mists to create visual illusions. These illusions are usually used in an effort to entertain and amuse sailors and other Pokémon.

entry: 古代城都文献记载，POKENAME化成死者模样，充当灵媒。它借此骗人献上树果。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Texts from ancient Johto describe the use of POKENAME as a spirit medium by taking on the visage of the deceased. POKENAME would do this to deceive humans into giving it offerings of berries.

entry: POKENAME变成肌肉发达的人，阻止人类靠近喜欢的地点。若幻觉被破，就用自己的大肌肉，威吓识破者。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME transforms into muscular people to deter humans from approaching locations it likes. If the illusion is broken, POKENAME will use its large muscles to physically intimidate whoever thwarted its deception.

entry: 偶尔，有名人被发现其实是POKENAME伪装。原因不明，网上猜测满天飞，从统治世界到真心融入社会，什么都有。
author: wiz0z
source: On rare occasions, prominent people have been discovered to actually be POKENAME in disguise. The reason behind these masquerades is unclear and theories have run rampant online, from world domination to genuine attempts at social integration.

entry: POKENAME与某位现代国王相似得不可思议，因此很受合众欢迎。有记录显示，它曾装成友好商店员工，破坏精灵球。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are quite popular in Unova, on account of their uncanny resemblance to a certain modern king. POKENAME have been documented disguising as Poké Mart employees and sabotaging Pokéballs.

entry: POKENAME夜行森林，长触须在黑暗中发光。哪怕短暂看一眼，也能感到平静。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's long feelers glow in the dark as it wanders through forests at night. Even a brief glance at them can induce a sense of calm.

entry: POKENAME制造、控制幻觉的技巧十分出色。它用来保护其他生灵，安抚幼年宝可梦，即使不同种类也一样。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can create and control illusions with remarkable skill. They use their illusions to protect others and to soothe young Pokémon, even if they are of other species.

entry: 若在POKENAME附近看电视，它就会极为烦躁。有时，还能听到它身上传出电台广播。
author: jokerswild
source: If you watch TV near POKENAME, it will get incredibly upset. You can sometimes hear radio broadcasts emanating from it.

entry: 若在POKENAME附近看电视，它就会极为烦躁。有时，还能听到它身上传出电台广播。
author: jokerswild
source: If you watch TV near POKENAME, it will get incredibly upset. You can sometimes hear radio broadcasts emanating from it.

entry: POKENAME主动搜集并改写一切关于自己的信息。因此，许多研究者与训练家以为它比实际强得多。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME actively seek out any and all information about themselves and rewrite it. Because of this, many researchers and Trainers believe POKENAME to be much more powerful than they actually are.

entry: POKENAME在变电站附近装成发电厂工人，悄悄吸走大量电力，再溜走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a powerplant worker near substations. It absorbs large amounts of electricity unnoticed before slipping away.

entry: POKENAME模仿洞里迷路的旅人。有人靠近，就使出强力鞭打，将受害者拖回窝。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME mimics the form of lost cave travelers. If approached, it lashes out with Power Whip and drags its victim back to its den.

entry: POKENAME潜伏废弃庄园，通常装作吊灯。它模仿贵族身影，在窗前默默向过路旅人招手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME lurks in abandoned chateaus, typically posing as a chandelier. It imitates noble figures waving silently from windows to passing travelers.

entry: 古石板记载，大战期间POKENAME曾化成人形。它能从四肢喷出阵阵能量，短暂飞行。
author: .izik
source: Ancient tablets tell of POKENAME shifting into human forms during great wars. It can briefly fly by expelling bursts of energy from its limbs.

entry: POKENAME不只用幻觉伪装，也会造出假伙伴。起初只为让伪装更可信，日子一久，却渐渐像对待想象中的朋友般相处。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME doesn't just use illusions to disguise itself, but also to create false companions. While at first these only exist to help it sell its disguise, over time POKENAME will start interacting with them more like imaginary friends.

entry: POKENAME虽能化成其他宝可梦与人类，几颗头却常为变什么争吵。偶尔会化成穿洗翠服饰的人。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: While POKENAME is capable of transforming into other Pokémon and humans, the heads often argue over what to turn into. Occasionally POKENAME transforms into a person in Hisuian garments.

entry: POKENAME穿梭于阴影中，九条缥缈的尾巴如轻烟般闪动。它精于欺瞒，会先以幻象迷惑对手，再用迅疾的火焰攻击。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME weaves through the shadows, its nine ethereal tails flickering like wisps of smoke. A master of deception, it creates illusions that confuse foes, striking with swift, fiery attacks.

entry: POKENAME常在各地神话传说中出现，但不同时代对它的评价不同，有时是福祉，有时是灾祸。它们寿命悠长，智慧极高，有些至今仍保养并佩戴很久以前获赠的饰品。
author: elfail0
source: Appearing prominently in various myths and legends, POKENAME are known as a boon or a bane depending on the era. Due to their longevity and high intelligence, some still wear and maintain the adornments they were given long ago.

entry: POKENAME常在各地神话传说中出现，但不同时代对它的评价不同，有时是福祉，有时是灾祸。它们寿命悠长，智慧极高，有些至今仍保养并佩戴很久以前获赠的饰品。
author: elfail0
source: Appearing prominently in various myths and legends, POKENAME are known as a boon or a bane depending on the era. Due to their longevity and high intelligence, some still wear and maintain the adornments they were given long ago.

entry: POKENAME靠小个子与假装天真，显得不那么可怕。但造出的幻觉，比普通索罗亚或索罗亚克恶毒得多。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its small stature and a veneer of false innocence in order to appear less intimidating. The illusions it casts are far more malevolent in nature than a normal Zorua or Zoruark.

entry: 它总能想出古怪点子，从训练家那里多讨智力粘糕。对战也能见到狡猾手段，尤其有时间使出诡计时。
author: quackquackattack
source: It is known to come up with bizarre ideas on how to get more Genius Mochi from its Trainer. Its cunning tricks are seen in Pokémon battles too, especially if it has time to set up a Nasty Plot.

entry: POKENAME在洞窟深处化成探险者，将旅人引离队伍，再在阴影中进食。
author: .izik
source: Deep within caves, POKENAME takes the form of explorers. It isolates wanderers from their groups before feeding in the shadows.

entry: POKENAME以纯光伪装自己，吸引以为它是传说宝可梦的对象，再带回窝作晚餐。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME disguises itself in pure light, attracting any Pokémon who think POKENAME is a legendary. It will lead them back to its den for dinner.

entry: POKENAME装成孩子在公园玩。若被发现，就放出催眠粉，趁人来不及反应消失。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME disguises itself as a child and plays in parks. If discovered, it releases Sleep Powder and vanishes before anyone can react.

entry: 浓雾沼泽中，POKENAME化成迷路孩子，等救援者靠近，再使出祸不单行。
author: .izik
source: In foggy marshes, POKENAME takes the form of lost children. It waits for rescuers to draw near before attacking with a Hex.

entry: POKENAME寻找腐烂有机物，在上面开花，因此成了警方调查失踪悬案的热门伙伴。
author: riley_muir_qu33n_in_yellow
source: POKENAME seek out and bloom over organic decay. Because of this, they have become popular partners for police in cold cases involving missing people.

entry: 海岸雾中，POKENAME模仿溺亡水手求救。靠近者会被无声拖入浪下。
author: .izik
source: In coastal mists, POKENAME mimics drowned sailors calling for help. Those who approach are silently dragged beneath the waves.

entry: 水下，POKENAME模仿结伴游泳的潜水员，以魅惑让受害者落单，再下毒、拖向深处。
author: .izik
source: Underwater, POKENAME mimics scuba divers swimming in groups. It isolates victims with charm before poisoning and dragging them into the deep.

entry: POKENAME将月光能量存进身上发光水晶。晶体太多会妨碍行动，逼得它撞击物件，打碎一些。伪装时，光芒仍会暴露身份。
author: thordemidgard
source: They store energy from moonlight in glowing crystals that grow from their bodies. Too many crystals can restrict their mobility, driving POKENAME to crash into objects to break them. The glow tells them apart when they disguise themselves.

entry: POKENAME能造出多个自己或其他生灵的幻象，一同歌舞。它也借此保护朋友，既掩藏它们，也让自己的攻击难以预料。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can create multiple illusions of itself or others that perform together with it as it sings and dances. It will also use these illusions to protect its friends, both by hiding them and by making its attacks harder to predict.

entry: POKENAME孢子让吸入者陷入梦境般状态，它能控制对方所见。蘑菇似乎以某种方式从中获得养分，骗过的人越多，就长得越大。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's spores place others into a dream-like state, and POKENAME can control what anyone who inhales them sees. Its mushroom seems to be fed by this in some way, and will grow larger as POKENAME fools more people with its illusions.

entry: POKENAME用幻觉装成弱小宝可梦。天敌攻击时，立刻卸下伪装，露真身，趁对方没反应过来，将其撕碎。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME uses illusions to disguise itself as a weaker Pokémon. When attacked by predators, it sheds its disguise, revealing its true form, and tears its prey apart before it can react to the sudden transformation.

entry: 制造幻觉的本领，让POKENAME成为极危险的伏击猎手。它能装成任何东西，包括通常无害的宝可梦，等受害者太近，就挥锐利前肢斩击。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's ability to create illusions makes it an extremely dangerous ambush predator. It can mask itself as anything, including Pokémon that are normally harmless. When the victim gets too close, they will slash with their sharp forelimbs.

entry: POKENAME能化成任何人或宝可梦，将人引入自制陷阱，一个也不放过。任何生灵只要看见真容，都会被攻击。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: POKENAME has the capability to shapeshift into any human or Pokémon. It leads humans into traps that it crafted until none remain. It attacks anyone or anything that sees its true form.

entry: POKENAME模仿独行徒步者，准确得令人发毛。遭人质问，就化作紫色粉末云，飞入空中逃走。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME mimics lone hikers with eerie accuracy. When confronted, it bursts into a cloud of violet powder and escapes into the air.

entry: 满月过后，农田里能发现POKENAME。它们乐于用幻象把自己伪装成作物，等人走近，再突然跃出，吓倒霉的目标一跳。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are found in farmers' fields after a full moon. They delight in using their illusion powers to disguise themselves as crops and wait for people to come close. They then leap out to surprise their unfortunate target when they get too close.

entry: POKENAME装成入侵自己南瓜地的宝可梦。足够近时，便撤掉幻觉，以强力种子炸弹攻击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME disguises itself as Pokémon invading its pumpkin patch. Once close enough, it drops the illusion and attacks with a powerful Seed Bomb.

entry: POKENAME以贪吃闻名，装成普通地鼠进入农田。农人一松懈，就吞掉一排排作物，消失得无影无踪。
author: adam_dnh
source: Notoriously gluttonous, POKENAME wanders into farmlands disguised as a regular Diglett. Once the farmers let down their guard, it devours rows of crops before disappearing without a trace.

entry: 野生POKENAME行踪难觅，袭击罕见却残酷。受害者说，挨反复痛打时，还看见各种怪象。
author: bobosmith01
source: Attacks from elusive wild POKENAME are rare but brutal. Victims report seeing all kinds of strange sights while they were pummeled over and over.

entry: POKENAME用特殊声带伪装声音，藏进更大的野生宝可梦群，偷吃食物。
author: camtft
source: POKENAME disguise their voice with special vocal cords. Using this, they hide within larger packs of wild Pokémon to eat their food.

entry: 传说POKENAME装成神社负责人，偷走所有捐献。性格难以捉摸，却从无攻击人的记录。
author: bobosmith01
source: Legends write of POKENAME masquerading as the head of a shrine to steal any donations. Its personality is enigmatic, but it has never been known to attack people.

entry: 传说POKENAME装成神社负责人，偷走所有捐献。性格难以捉摸，却从无攻击人的记录。
author: bobosmith01
source: Legends write of POKENAME masquerading as the head of a shrine to steal any donations. Its personality is enigmatic, but it has never been known to attack people.

entry: 传说POKENAME装成神社负责人，偷走所有捐献。性格难以捉摸，却从无攻击人的记录。
author: bobosmith01
source: Legends write of POKENAME masquerading as the head of a shrine to steal any donations. Its personality is enigmatic, but it has never been known to attack people.

entry: POKENAME是诡计的顶尖大师，以勺子传导幻术魔法，制造逼真的蜃景。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME is the ultimate master of trickery. It channels its illusory magic through its spoons, enabling it to conjure realistic mirages.

entry: POKENAME常造幻象，让出拳看起来不止四臂。为保卫朋友，也会制造自己的幻影分身。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME often create illusions to make it seem as if they are punching with more than just their four arms. In order to defend their friends, they will also create illusory copies of themselves.

entry: POKENAME岩石身体能变成惊人逼真的人形。它默默等待，直到猎物靠得太近。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's rocky body can morph into surprisingly convincing human shapes. It waits silently until prey draws too close.

entry: 野生POKENAME造逼真幻象，保护自己与族群。曾有个体造出大冰川幻影，阻止人类船只靠近。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME create realistic illusions to protect themselves and their packs. They have been known to create illusions of large glaciers to deter human ships from drawing too near.

entry: POKENAME看似有身体，其实只是幻象，真身完全是气体。它向其他生灵投出浓缩灵体能量球，诅咒对方陷入可怕幻觉。
author: sk372
source: What appears to be POKENAME's body is just an illusion, as its true form is purely gaseous. It launches orbs of concentrated spiritual energy at others to curse them with terrifying hallucinations.

entry: POKENAME不只藏在暗影幻象后，也能改变别人的影子，让轮廓扭曲得像怪物，使人真的害怕自己的影子。
author: .jerden
source: In addition to concealing itself behind shadowy illusions, POKENAME has the ability to alter the shadows of others. It can make their outlines seem so distorted and monstrous that people will literally become afraid of their own shadows.

entry: POKENAME化成医院护士，无声走过走廊，趁没人注意，吃熟睡患者的梦。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME takes on the form of hospital nurses and walks silently down the halls. While unnoticed, it feeds on the dreams of sleeping patients.

entry: POKENAME爆炸释放的能量，会让爆炸范围内所有对象快乐数小时。但疲惫的它在同样长的时间里，却会闷闷不乐、脾气很坏。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME explodes, the energy it releases causes everyone caught in the blast radius to exhibit joyful emotions for several hours. The exhausted POKENAME will be mopey and grumpy for that same amount of time, however.

entry: POKENAME被称为爱的守护者，用缎带牵起情侣的手。谁在它面前侮辱任何一对，就会被缎带裹住，不断遭爆裂电火花攻击，直到道歉。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME is known as a protector of love, guiding the hands of couples together with its ribbons. If anyone insults any couple in its pressence, it will wrap them in ribbons and release explosive sparks until they apologize.

entry: POKENAME很容易受惊，夜里藏在暗洞或裂隙。为安睡，它们用散发舒缓气息的缎带互相裹住。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are very skittish, hiding in dark  caves or crevices during the night. To help themselves sleep, they will wrap each other up in their ribbons, which emit a soothing aura.

entry: POKENAME极爱晨光，会与同类去海边，垂下触须，同步轻摆。阴天时，触须会明显缩短。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME takes great joy in the morning sun, traveling to beaches with others of its kind to dangle its feelers in a gentle synchronized wave. During cloudy weather, the feelers shrink considerably.

entry: POKENAME偏爱人迹罕至的偏僻处。移动时，缎带碰到骨盔，会发出轻微咔嗒声。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME prefers to dwell in remote places where few people visit. Faint clicking sounds can be heard as it moves as its ribbons tap against its bony helmet.

entry: POKENAME偏爱人迹罕至的偏僻处。移动时，缎带碰到骨盔，会发出轻微咔嗒声。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME prefers to dwell in remote places where few people visit. Faint clicking sounds can be heard as it moves as its ribbons tap against its bony helmet.

entry: POKENAME借爱、友谊，再加上骨棒的硬度，重击对手。许多宝可梦头上挨打后就会迷恋它，不过这短暂效果会在战后消退。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME harness the power of love, friendship, and the firmness of their bony club to deliver heavy blows to their opponent. Many Pokémon become infatuated with POKENAME after being hit on the head, though this transient effect fades after battle.

entry: POKENAME极少让其他训练家看面具下的模样，谁想尝试，就用双棒拍开。少数有幸看见的，通常是最信任的伙伴。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rarely let other Trainers see what is underneath the mask and swat away attempts to do so with their dual clubs. The few Trainers privileged enough to see what is underneath are usually POKENAME's most trusted allies.

entry: POKENAME振动彩带，削弱对手在擂台上的斗志，争取优势。外貌虽可爱，踢击却能折断金属。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME vibrates its colorful ribbons to weaken its opponents' will to fight in the ring and gain an advantage. Despite its cute appearance, it can deliver kicks strong enough to break metal.

entry: POKENAME挥拳破空，也放出舒缓气息构成的冲击波。拳快得不到一分钟，就能安抚超过500人的愤怒人群。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME slices the air with its punches, it also sends out shockwaves of soothing auras. With how quickly it can throw out punches, it can calm down an entire angry mob of over 500 people in less than a minute.

entry: POKENAME受威胁时，用缎带般舌头束住攻击者。舌头散发舒缓气息，让它不必伤人，也能平息冲突。
author: santon5512
source: When threatened, POKENAME will restrain the attacker with their ribbon-like tongue. Their tongues emit a soothing aura, letting them de-escalate conflicts without injury.

entry: POKENAME身体不断冒出浓厚的舒缓香云。气味与安抚作用虽宜人，量太多却颇为闷人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body constantly produces puffs of thick, soothing perfume clouds. Though the scent and calming nature are pleasant, the high volume it creates can be more than a little stifling.

entry: POKENAME放出的毒气会引起强烈幸福感，也有危险副作用，包括长时间压制饥饿感。
author: .izik
source: The poisonous gas released by POKENAME induces intense bliss. It also causes dangerous side effects, including suppressing hunger for extended periods.

entry: POKENAME在外只想做一件事，就是无论如何都要玩。这份一门心思爱玩，让它很难训练。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME only wants to do one thing outside, and it is to play, no matter what. This one-track mind of only wanting to play has made it a very hard Pokémon to train.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，每个动作都会撒下团团亮粉，使出直冲钻时尤其如此。它更爱玩而非打，训练家得设法哄骗它参战。
author: beatdoof
source: When POKENAME fights, they will spread pockets of glittering dust whenever it makes a move, especially when they're doing a Drill Run. They still prefer playing than battling, so Trainers have to trick it through various means to battle.

entry: POKENAME在野外找弃蛋，温柔悉心地养育。蛋发育时受缎带轻触，孵出的宝可梦往往温和而充满爱意。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME finds abandoned eggs in the wild and raises them with love and tender care. Due to the soft touch of its ribbons during the egg's development, Pokémon hatched by POKENAME tend to have gentle and loving natures.

entry: POKENAME每条藤蔓都覆有黏汁，碰到便快乐。但长时间接触，可能导致严重精神不稳定。
author: .izik
source: Each vine of POKENAME is coated in a sticky sap that induces joy on contact. Prolonged exposure, however, can lead to severe mental instability.

entry: POKENAME受幸福家庭的积极能量吸引。据说若愿让某人与自己的孩子玩，就表示感知到对方具备好父母的特质。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is attracted to happy families, drawn to the positive energy they exude. It's said that if it allows a person to play with its own child, it is because POKENAME senses the qualities of a truly wonderful parent in them.

entry: POKENAME容易兴奋，又爱照顾幼崽，乐于照料森林里好几只年幼宝可梦。但袋中孩子极害羞，只在独处时出来，受它宠爱。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME is an excitable and nurturing Pokémon who enjoys taking care of several other baby Pokémon in the forest. However, the child in its pouch is very shy, only coming out after it's alone, getting doted and spoiled on by POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME受威胁就吐彩墨云，掩护逃跑。追赶者一游过，就会因墨效而迅速耗尽精力、身体麻木。
author: sk372
source: When threatened, POKENAME spits out a cloud of multicolored ink to mask its escape. Anything that swims through the cloud to chase after it quickly finds itself drained of energy and numbed by the ink's effects.

entry: 许多年前，诗人用POKENAME的墨写优美篇章。墨留着平静海香，能安抚读者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's ink was used by poets many years ago to write elegant passages. This ink left behind a calming ocean scent that soothed those who read the words.

entry: POKENAME配色鲜艳，外形优雅，是热门宠物。有点自负，不易取悦，但照料得当，就会确保主人在身边从不难过。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's vibrant colors and elegant appearance make it a popular pet. It can be a bit egotistical and difficult to please, but a properly cared-for POKENAME will make sure its owner never feels sad in its presence.

entry: 风暴夜，POKENAME将触须高举海面，当作避雷针，保护附近鱼宝可梦。
author: .izik
source: During stormy nights, POKENAME extends its feelers high above the sea's surface to act as lightning rods. It does this to keep nearby fish Pokémon safe from harm.

entry: POKENAME颜色柔和，面孔友善，多数小鱼宝可梦不把它当回事。但它其实是河流中的顶级猎手，生活得如鱼得水。
author: opossiblymage
source: With POKENAME's pastel colors and friendly face, most smaller fish Pokémon don't pay attention to it. However, it is an apex predator that thrives in rivers.

entry: POKENAME侧身在海面上方旋转、漂行，散出舒缓气息，安抚毒刺水母等附近天敌。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spins on its side just above the water's surface as it drifts over the sea. It releases an aura that calms nearby predators such as Tentacruel.

entry: POKENAME发出安抚脉冲，始终朝同一方向传播，终点却不明。解开彩带结后，身体能变大，旋转也更快。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME sends out pulses of soothing aura that always travel in the same direction, but their ultimate destination is unknown. It can untie its ribbon bows to increase its size and gain more speed while spinning.

entry: POKENAME用无形墙困住猎物，再不断散出舒缓气息，哄其放松戒备。它在受困者面前跳令人不安的舞，以恐惧为食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME encloses prey within invisible walls before repeatedly releasing a soothing aura to lull them into complacency. It performs disturbing dances before its trapped prey, feeding off their fear.

entry: 不战斗时，POKENAME刀刃会变软，近乎缎带。每年春天会蜕下旧刃，让新刃生长。
author: .izik
source: When not in combat, POKENAME's blades become soft and almost ribbon-like. It sheds these blades each spring to make way for new growth.

entry: POKENAME挥臂发电时，四肢会剥落彩色电火花。发出的雷电也色彩缤纷，让战斗如梦幻色彩表演。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME swings its arms to generate its electricity, colorful sparks can be seen flaking off of its limbs. The lightning it launches is similarly multicolored, making battles a fantastical display of hues.

entry: 即将使出喷射火焰前，POKENAME头上的缎带会烧红。这是自动发生的，并非有意为之。
author: .izik
source: The ribbon on POKENAME's head grows red hot just before it uses Flamethrower. This happens automatically and without any intention on its part.

entry: POKENAME蜕皮时，旧壳挂在甲上，形成不断加长的裙。长寿个体的裙可超过体长五倍；能拖着这种累赘活下来，正证明是出色战士。
author: pjporwoll
source: When POKENAME molts, its shedding catches on its carapace to form an ever elongating dress. A long-lived POKENAME can have a dress of over five lengths of its body, signifying an exceptional warrior due to surviving with such an encumbering shedding.

entry: POKENAME蜕皮时，旧壳挂在甲上，形成不断加长的裙。长寿个体的裙可超过体长五倍；能拖着这种累赘活下来，正证明是出色战士。
author: pjporwoll
source: When POKENAME molts, its shedding catches on its carapace to form an ever elongating dress. A long-lived POKENAME can have a dress of over five lengths of its body, signifying an exceptional warrior due to surviving with such an encumbering shedding.

entry: POKENAME十分敏感，受不了感知他者负面情绪。它飞奔向源头，以三条缎带般尾巴，将坏情绪扫去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a very sensitive nature and cannot stand to sense the negative emotions of others. It races towards the source of negativity at breakneck speed in order to brush it away with its three ribbon-like tails.

entry: 开心时，尾上会冒出小缎带触须，碰到就满心喜悦。可惜它只在狂奔冲撞时开心，所以摸到触须，往往就成了训练家最后的体验。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When happy, small ribbon feelers rise from its tails, filling anyone who touches them with joy. Unfortunately, it is only happy while stampeding, making contact with these feelers often a Trainer's last experience.

entry: 负面情绪让POKENAME烦躁，几乎要诉诸暴力。为了克制自己，它用三尾安抚坏情绪，也让自身平静。
author: sk372
source: Negative emotions put POKENAME in a frustrated state, irritating it to the point of nearing violence. To keep itself in check, it tries to assuage negative feelings with its three tails, so it can remain calm as well.

entry: POKENAME开心时，尾上冒出小缎带触须，让接触者充满喜悦。狂奔冲撞时，触须仿佛活过来，随冲锋狂喜扭动。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: When POKENAME is happy, small ribbon feelers pop up from its tails that fill whoever touches them with joy. When stampeding, these feelers seem to come alive, wriggling in ecstasy as it charges around.

entry: POKENAME终生相伴，绝不长时间远离选定的伴侣。强行拆散它们，被视为残忍至极。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME mate for life, never venturing far from their chosen mate for long. It's considered unbearably cruel to forcibly separate them from one another.

entry: POKENAME跟随野生暴鲤龙迁徙，始终不落太远。它想抑制同族暴行，一有暴走苗头，就用缎带抓住安抚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME follows the migratory patterns of wild Gyarados, never trailing too far behind. It seeks to curb the violent mannerisms of its brethren, seizing them with its ribbons to calm them down whenever a rampage seems imminent.

entry: 鲜艳颜色只能暂时掩住凶残好战，很快就让其他生灵起疑。因此，POKENAME得用触须诱导猎物放松警惕。
author: opossiblymage
source: Its bright colors can only hide its vicious, battle-thirsty demeanor so well before others get suspicious. Because of this, POKENAME must use its feelers to lure prey into a false sense of security.

entry: POKENAME游过海洋，唱轻柔摇篮曲，见到熟睡宝可梦就载上。肉质甜软，被非法渠道贩卖，因此人们正设法规管野生捕猎。
author: beatdoof
source: As POKENAME swims across the ocean, it sings a gentle lullaby and carries sleeping Pokémon whenever it sees them. Efforts are made to regulate the hunting of wild POKENAME due to its very sweet and soft meat, sold through illegal channels.

entry: POKENAME常去医院，靠近临终患者，试着用变身重现对方一生最快乐的时刻。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME frequents hospitals, approaching patients who are nearing the end of their lives. It will attempt to recreate the happiest moments of the individual's life by transforming.

entry: POKENAME对多数人是好宠物，缎带碰一下就能舒缓压力。相处久了，会学会识别主人受压的迹象，更早靠近，安慰烦恼。
author: sk372
