source: POKENAME is a great pet to have for most, as its ribbons will help soothe stress with just a touch. POKENAME will adapt over time to learn telltale signs of stress in its owner, becoming able to sooner approach them to soothe their woes.

entry: POKENAME在水中扑腾时，更能散发舒缓气息。每天至少要泡水八小时，否则皮肤可能干燥，容易患病。
author: fiordaliso
source: While POKENAME splashes around in the water, it is able to radiate its calming aura more effectively. It needs to stay submerged for at least eight hours a day; otherwise, its skin risks drying out and becoming susceptible to disease.

entry: POKENAME一波波释放平静能量，尤其压力很大时。它常给愿看的人表演华美水艺，即使经常把周围所有人都淋湿。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME release peaceful energy out in waves, especially in moments when they are highly stressed. They will often put on majestic water shows for anyone willing to watch, despite how often they end up soaking all those around them.

entry: POKENAME受压时能竖起毛，如针射出。刺入皮肤就产生令人麻木的电，使中招者晕眩，全身涌起迷糊而愉快的感觉。
author: sk372
source: In response to stress, POKENAME can spike out its fur and fire it off like needles. The fur produces a numbing electricity when it pierces skin, stunning those hit and leaving them with a dazing, pleasant sensation coursing through them.

entry: POKENAME身体始终温暖，有舒缓作用，因此主人被建议常抱抱它。开心时，还可能向空中吐出美丽虹彩火焰。
author: sk372
source: The constant warmth of POKENAME's body has soothing properties, so owners are advised to regularly embrace it. As a sign of elation, it may produce a beautiful multicolored flame breath into the air.

entry: POKENAME许多缎带的末端格外暖。通常温柔碰触，安抚他者；受威胁时，却能点燃，甩出让敌人疼痛的火球。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's many ribbons are especially warm at the tips. Ordinarily these ribbons are used to soothe others with a calming warm touch, but if threatened, they can be ignited and used to sling painful fireballs at POKENAME's opposition.

entry: POKENAME将缎带般身体贴上电脑，就以惊人速度吸取储存数据，片刻能吃掉数太字节。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME affixes its ribbonlike body to a computer, it begins draining stored data at astonishing speed. It can consume multiple terabytes in mere moments.

entry: POKENAME适应了与人类生活，也深深理解人类，因此能在需要时给予安慰。
author: crafter_94443
source: POKENAME has adapted to life with humans and understands them deeply, this lets it comfort humans in times of need.

entry: POKENAME害怕时，会将脑后大触须紧紧绕向背部。此时硬度堪比花岗岩。
author: .izik
source: When frightened, POKENAME wraps the large feeler on the back of its head tightly near its back. During this time its hardness rivals that of granite.

entry: POKENAME每年冬天都会脱落壳上的尖刺，让新刺生长。磨粉后可作调味，给病人的汤添上坚果香与舒心滋味。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME sheds the spikes on its shell once each winter to allow new ones to grow. When ground up, they are used as a seasoning that lends a nutty, soothing flavor to soup for the sick.

entry: POKENAME在海滩或浅水半埋沙中，白天睡觉。若被踩，就用缎带尾拍打冒犯者，注入麻痹、令人欣快的毒，再爬走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME partially buries itself in the sand on beaches and in shallow waters, sleeping during the day. If stepped on, it smacks the offender with its ribbon-tail, which inflicts a numbing, euphoria-inducing toxin before scuttling away.

entry: POKENAME挥动飘逸双臂，划出舞蹈般大弧线，将敌人从自己或保护的对象身边拍开。它常照顾一群伊盔，直到它们准备好选择不同进化方向。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME battles by swinging its flowy arms in large dance-like arcs, swatting opponents away from it or those it safeguards. It often cares for a group of Eeto until they are ready to evolve into one of their many choices.

entry: POKENAME翅膀由柔软蓬松缎带构成，乘风优雅滑翔。发现有人难过，就俯冲送上安慰的拥抱，再继续前行。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME's wings are made of soft, plush ribbons. They soar through the sky by catching wind currents and gliding gracefully along. When they find someone who is upset, they swoop down to offer a comforting embrace before moving on.

entry: POKENAME打鼾时，大肚子散发舒缓气息，让它一次能不受打扰地睡上最长一周。
author: .izik
source: While snoring, POKENAME releases a calming aura from its massive stomach. This keeps it undisturbed while it rests for up to a week at a time.

entry: POKENAME看顾穿越寒冷山地家园的旅人，引导平安出行，让他们靠身体取暖，并用缎带尾安抚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME watches over those who traverse the frigid mountain areas it calls home. It helps guide them through safe travels, letting them warm themselves against its body, soothing them with its ribbon-like tail.

entry: POKENAME飞过天空时，翅膀与尾巴，会拖出一条多彩的寒霜薄幕。它们曾因羽毛色彩鲜艳而遭到大量捕猎，因此被列为受保护的物种。
author: infinex21
source: As a POKENAME flies through the sky, it casts a frosty veil of many colors as a trail from its wings and tail. POKENAME have been labeled a protected species due to how hunted they were for their vibrantly colored feathers.

entry: POKENAME感知到严重雷雨将袭城镇，就直飞云层，尽可能多吸电。风暴平息，再放出舒缓气息，安抚下方生灵。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME senses a terrible thunderstorm approaching a town, it flies directly into the clouds to absorb as much electricity as possible. Once the storm subsides, it releases a soothing aura to calm those below.

entry: POKENAME被视为和平与力量的象征。传说鲜艳火焰能烧尽他者一切攻击性，让其永远平和、不再动武。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is seen as a symbol of both peace and power. According to legends, the vividly-colored flames POKENAME breathes can burn away all traces of aggression in others, leaving them forever calm and pacifistic.

entry: POKENAME蜕下的皮一留下，就常被食腐者迅速抢走。吃下会产生愉快的麻木与刺痒，几乎令人沉醉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's shed skin is often quickly snatched up by scavengers once left behind. When consumed, it causes a feeling of pleasant numbness and tingling, to an almost intoxicating degree.

entry: 某些地区有颜色不同的稀有POKENAME变体，蜕皮吃下后有轻微致幻作用。食腐者吃了，常会伏地迷糊数小时。
author: sk372
source: A rarer alternate color variant of POKENAME found in some regions, POKENAME's shed skin possesses mild hallucinogenic properties when consumed. Scavengers that eat the skin left behind are often left laying prone and confused for several hours.

entry: 科学家用POKENAME蜕皮制成手套，让佩戴者能读出接触者的情绪。蜕皮相互摩擦，会释放消除敌意的波。
author: soup1900
source: Scientists have been able to create gloves using the shed skin of POKENAME that allows the wearer to read the feelings of whoever they touch. Enmity-erasing waves are released when the shed skin is rubbed against each other.

entry: 龙属性宝可梦常见的地方，POKENAME会担任调解者。争斗一起，就用身体缠住闹事者，以触须安抚，直到妥善解决。
author: sk372
source: In areas where Dragon types are common, POKENAME acts as a mediator. When strife arises, it wraps its body around the aggressors and calms them down with its feelers until the situation is properly resolved.

entry: 周围和平宁静时，POKENAME泛着柔粉光晕，获得飞行能力。但附近一吵起来，光晕就消失，转而召出阴暗雷雨，映出气氛。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME takes on a gentle, pink aura and gains the ability to fly when all is peaceful and calm around it. However, once a bitter quarrel starts near it, it loses its aura and summons a dark thunderstorm to signify the mood.

entry: POKENAME优雅飞翔，受积极情绪吸引。长缎带状触须，能从很远处感受其他生灵的心情。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME soars elegantly through the sky and is drawn to positive emotions. It uses its long, ribbon-like feelers to sense the feelings of others from great distances.

entry: POKENAME威严又可爱，是妖精属性训练家的好朋友。它以缎带散出舒缓香气，让对手失去斗志。
author: aberry8286
source: Regal and cute, POKENAME is a Fairy Trainer's best friend. It uses its ribbons to create a soothing smell, which makes its opponents lose their eagerness to fight.

entry: POKENAME用力量驱散恶劣天气，安抚因风暴惊慌害怕的宝可梦。它缠住对方，泛起粉光，如盖上舒缓气息织成的毯子。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME clears out bad weather using its powers to soothe Pokémon panicked or scared from the storms. By wrapping itself around others and taking on a pink glow, it hugs them in a blanket of calming auras.

entry: POKENAME常在偏远岛屿养育迷你龙，教它们像自己一样善良助人。但谁伤害孩子，它就反常暴怒，凶猛攻击，以缎带束住、封口。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are often found on remote islands raising Dratini to be as kind and helpful as itself. However, if anyone were to hurt its Dratini, it uncharacteristically loses its temper and savagely attacks while its ribbons bind and gag the foe.

entry: POKENAME常飞在海上，将舒缓气息打入怒涛，让水恢复平静。它经常救下整艘船，也与危险怪物交战，被昵称为“海洋英雄”。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are often seen flying around oceans, sending blasts of their aura into raging waters to restore their calm. They are nicknamed "the ocean's hero" since they very often save entire ships and battle dangerous monsters alike.

entry: 不论什么宝可梦，POKENAME都要试着紧紧拥抱，以示极大的善意。拥抱带着舒缓气息，让接受者立刻变得善良助人。
author: soup1900
source: No matter the Pokémon, POKENAME will always try to hug them tight as an extreme act of kindness. The soothing auras that empower these hugs cause the receiver to instantly become kind and helpful.

entry: POKENAME追求身边和平，甚至有些强硬。若缎带轻触还不能让对方乖下来，就用精神力暂时清空其负面念头。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME seeks peace among others around it, to an aggressive degree. If just the touch of its ribbons isn't enough to make someone behave, it will resort to temporarily emptying their mind of negative thoughts with its psychic powers.

entry: POKENAME凭强精神力，造出浓缩而鲜艳的能量球。中招者会麻木恍惚，失去一切负面念头与情绪。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's powerful psychic abilities let it generate orbs of condensed, vibrantly-colored energy. Those hit by these projectiles find themselves feeling numbed and dazed, deprived of all negative thoughts and feelings.

entry: POKENAME的缎带能感知附近生灵情绪，并模仿其感受。它通常出现在欣喜若狂的人面前，分享这份心情。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME's ribbons allow it to sense the emotions of nearby creatures and mimic their feelings. It usually appears before people who are feeling overjoyed so it can empathize with them.

entry: 风起时，POKENAME头上缎带状叶片飘动，散出极细微花粉。吸入者会感到愉快，落上的植物也会开出更鲜艳的花。
author: sk372
source: When the wind picks up, the ribbon-like leaves on POKENAME's head flutter about and spread a faint, minuscule pollen across the air. It evokes pleasant feelings in those that inhale it, and causes plants it lands on to bloom in more vibrant colors.

entry: POKENAME头上触须散发舒缓果香。条件合适时，连正暴怒的火暴猴也能放松。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a calming fruity aroma from the feelers on its head. Under the right conditions, this scent can relax even a Primeape mid-rage.

entry: POKENAME颈边叶子散出诱人鲜香，让闻者饥肠辘辘。香气也会让果树结果、野菜萌芽。
author: beatdoof
source: The leaves around POKENAME's neck emit a savory, mouthwatering aroma that causes hunger pangs in those who smell it. This aroma also causes fruit trees to bear and wild vegetables to sprout.

entry: 战斗时，POKENAME缎带伸得极长，束住敌人，让对方难以应对连发的火花攻击。
author: .izik
source: The ribbons on POKENAME's body extend to great lengths during combat to restrain foes. This leaves them vulnerable to repeated Ember attacks with little chance to react.

entry: POKENAME散发烧焦水果的气味，吸入却出人意料地舒心。玩耍时，气味更浓。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a burnt fruit smell that is surprisingly calming when inhaled. This scent intensifies when it is at play.

entry: POKENAME特别愤怒时，会释放舒缓香气，试着让自己平静。目击者说，吸入后感到晕乎乎。
author: dodoowner_
source: When POKENAME gets exceptionally angry, it releases a calming aroma in an attempt to calm itself down. Witnesses report feeling woozy after breathing the scent in.

entry: POKENAME吐出的水有舒缓作用。普通疗程无效时，许多水疗馆会采来安抚客人。
author: .izik
source: The water POKENAME spits carries soothing properties. Many spas collect it to calm their patrons if the normal treatments do not work.

entry: POKENAME吐出的水带花香，碰到就能平静。它借此哄敌人放松戒备，再咬过去。
author: .izik
source: The water POKENAME spits carries a floral scent and can calm on contact. It uses this to lull foes into complacency before biting them.

entry: POKENAME藏在水面下，等猎物靠近岸边。一到近处，触须就迅速射出，将其缠住，拖入浪下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME waits just beneath the water's surface for prey to approach the shoreline. When they draw near, its feelers strike out at high speed to ensnare them and drag them beneath the waves.

entry: 缎带状附肢能感受空气振动，即使休息，也知道周围多数动静。它虽胆小，却会照顾被遗弃的宝可梦，让其在柔软蓬松、令人安心的尾巴上休息。
author: infinex21
source: Its ribbonlike appendages allow it to sense vibrations in the air, keeping it aware of most things around it, even as it rests. Though skittish, it will look after abandoned Pokémon and let them rest upon its soothingly soft and plush tail.

entry: 从配色、善良性格到柔软身体与舒缓缎带，POKENAME很适合抚慰烦乱心灵。医院和治疗场合越来越常见，用来安定他人情绪。
author: sk372
source: From its colors to its kind personality to its soft body and soothing ribbons, POKENAME is perfect for easing a person's troubled mind. It is becoming more common to see it in hospitals and therapy sessions to calm the nerves of others.

entry: POKENAME热情多情，总找下一个对象拥抱、倾注爱意。但气味加上过度亲热，往往让对方想逃离这份宠爱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a very amorous specimen, always searching for the next partner to hug and shower affection on. Its scent, combined with the overzealous nature of its affections, causes most to try to escape from its adulation, however.

entry: 这种宝可梦像节拍器般，以触须按均匀间隔来回摆动。富有感情的乐手喜欢与它作伴。
author: opossiblymage
source: Using its feelers, this Pokémon acts like a metronome, flicking back and forth at even intervals. Soulful musicians enjoy it as a partner Pokémon.

entry: 冬季，POKENAME会俯冲下来，用软翼裹住发抖旅人。据说羽毛能带来温暖与好运，许多人仍随身当幸运符。
author: .izik
source: During winter, POKENAME is known to swoop down and wrap shivering travelers in its soft wings. Feathers from one are said to bring warmth and fortune, many still keep them as lucky charms.

entry: POKENAME用头上缎带尖端流出的淡液，标记最爱的树木。信息素会使其他宝可梦保护树木，驱赶害兽、寄生虫，甚至伐木人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the ribbons on its head to mark its favorite trees with a faint liquid emanated from the tips. This liquid has pheromones that cause other Pokémon to defend the tree from pests, parasites and even loggers.

entry: POKENAME天性善良，会为珍视的对象奋战到底。缎带散出积极气息，让接触者满心幸福。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is a genuinely kind Pokémon and will fight to the end to protect the ones it cares about. Its ribbons give off positive vibes, filling those who touch it with an overwhelming feeling of happiness.

entry: 相比进化型，POKENAME非常受欢迎，因为乐于分享闪亮蛛丝。蛛丝散着积极能量，被用来布置派对。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: POKENAME are very popular compared to their evolution as they produce a sparkly webbing they are more than happy to share. This webbing radiates positive energy and is used to decorate for parties.

entry: POKENAME很不受人喜爱，便用黏性缎带捉住人类，想强迫对方爱上自己。
author: crustyglowstick
source: POKENAME is a very unloved Pokémon. Due to this, it uses its sticky ribbons to catch humans in an effort to force them to love it.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，将缎带缠住钟乳石，稳固身体。若被吵醒，就发出一连串可怕尖叫。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wraps its ribbon around stalactites while sleeping to steady its body. If woken, it unleashes a series of horrifying screeches.

entry: POKENAME的缎带尖端能发光，亮得足以照清深海暗处。生灵靠近这光，负面情绪便会消退，取而代之的，是一种麻木的满足感。
author: sk372
source: The tips of POKENAME's ribbons are able to glow, growing bright enough to illuminate the darker parts of the ocean depths. Coming close to the light causes a creature's negative emotions to fade away, replaced by a numb contentment.

entry: POKENAME闪动叉状部位的许多灯，以不同图案与同类沟通。顺序多变复杂，研究含义的进度很慢。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME communicates with others of its kind via flashing the many lights on its prong in different patterns. These sequences are quite varying and intricate, so research into discerning their exact meanings progresses slowly.

entry: POKENAME通过触须散发舒缓气息，也由此传导电力。有些医疗机构会训练它安慰患者，停电时给设备供能。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME exude calming auras through their feelers, though this is also how they channel their electricity. Some medical facilities train POKENAME to comfort patients and to power equipment during blackouts.

entry: 月光直照时，POKENAME身体散出舒缓气息，最远能影响20英尺外的人。
author: .izik
source: When in direct moonlight, POKENAME releases a calming aura from its body. This can affect humans up to 20 feet away.

entry: POKENAME深夜吹口哨，奏旋律安抚附近生灵。老人觉得舒心，年轻人却觉得难听得可怕。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME whistles a melodic tune late at night to calm those nearby. The elderly regard it as a soothing melody, though to younger humans it sounds horrendous.

entry: POKENAME发现有人微笑，就在附近开心跳舞，散出安慰气息，让周围所有对象更易平静。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dances happily near people it finds smiling. This releases a comforting aura to all nearby, allowing them to feel easily at peace.

entry: POKENAME快速振翅，会向20英尺内的所有对象散发舒缓气息，轻易平息暴怒的人。
author: .izik
source: When flapping rapidly, POKENAME's wings release a soothing aura to anyone within a 20-foot range. This can easily calm a human in a fit of rage.

entry: POKENAME预见训练家未来会难过，就从羽毛释放舒缓气息，使其放松。使用过久，羽毛会一根根脱落。
author: .izik
source: If POKENAME foresees a future in which its Trainer is upset, it releases a soothing aura from its feathers to relax them. Prolonged use of this aura causes its feathers to fall out one by one.

entry: 满月位于正上空，POKENAME便展开双翼，吸收月光，散出强精神气息，使周围所有生灵平静喜悦。
author: sk372
source: When the full moon is directly overhead, POKENAME spreads its wings wide. As it soaks in the moonlight, it exudes a powerful psychic aura that invokes calmness and joy in all creatures in the surrounding area.

entry: POKENAME羊毛与缎带性质相似，但安抚力稍弱。塞着它羊毛的枕头能帮助愉快安睡，成了热门用品。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wool has a similar property to its ribbons, carrying a slightly reduced calming ability. Pillows stuffed with its wool make for a popular item for assisting in granting happy, restful sleeps.

entry: POKENAME群会挤在一起，互擦羊毛产生静电，驱赶天敌，或安慰需要抚慰的成员。
author: blaizegamer
source: Herds of POKENAME can be found huddled together. They do this to create static energy by rubbing their wool against each other to deter predators or when a herd member is in need of comfort.

entry: POKENAME能读情绪，总关心其他生灵。发现有人需要安慰，就想抱抱，羊毛却反把对方电到。
author: blaizegamer
source: POKENAME is always concerned for others because of its ability to read emotions. When it sees a person in need of comfort, it will try to hug them; however, its wool ends up electrocuting them instead.

entry: POKENAME跳舞时散出樱桃香，安抚附近所有生灵。黎明时跳得更开心。
author: .izik
source: While dancing, POKENAME releases a cherry scent that soothes anyone in the vicinity. It will dance more happily at dawn.

entry: 城市里，POKENAME是老人和残障人士的情感支持伙伴。它用甜甜香气或迷人之躯，安抚负面情绪爆发的人，尤其能帮助惊恐发作时平静。
author: beatdoof
source: In urban areas, POKENAME is known for being an emotional support Pokémon for old and disabled people. With their Sweet Scent or Cute Charm, they calm people down whenever they have a negative emotional outburst, particularly during panic attacks.

entry: POKENAME走路不断用尾巴拍地，散出糖香，安抚周围5米内的对象。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME smacks its tail on the ground repeatedly while walking, releasing a sugary scent. This calms those within a 5-meter area around it.

entry: 它以触角抚摸、安抚落水者，防止救援时因惊慌而溺水。鲜艳皮毛与坚定性格，让它成为许多协调训练家的好伙伴。
author: fiordaliso
source: It uses its antennae to stroke and calm people who have fallen into the water, preventing them from panicking and drowning while it rescues them. Its vibrant coat and strong-willed nature make it an excellent partner for many Pokémon Coordinators.

entry: POKENAME大多时候不动，偶尔用臂上缎带跳一小段舞。缎带向摆动方向散出安抚气息，平息当地情绪。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends most of its time remaining immobile, but every so often it will do a small dance involving the ribbons on its arms. The ribbons cast a placating aura in the direction they are swung, calming those in the area.

entry: 据说看见POKENAME与其他宝可梦在湖上使出求雨，会让恋情得到祝福。下雨时，柔和悦耳的蛙鸣便会回响。
author: beatdoof
source: It is said that seeing POKENAME perform a Rain Dance atop a lake with other Pokémon will bless one's romantic endeavors. Their soft, harmonious croaks echo during any rainy weather.

entry: POKENAME身体轻，随风悠闲滑行。感到有人不开心，就落到头上，以缎带轻拂，让对方心情转晴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's lightweight body flows along with the breeze, gliding through the air without a care. If it senses an unhappy person, it lands on their head to brush them with its ribbons and brighten their day.

entry: POKENAME随群飘过微风草原，散下闪亮粉末。吸入者通常会放松。
author: .izik
source: While drifting through breezy meadows with its herd, POKENAME scatters a shimmering powder. This powder tends to relax anyone who breathes it in.

entry: POKENAME傍晚五只一组，飘过草地，留下粉球果香的粉。吸入后，几乎立刻就能平静。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats in groups of five over meadows in the early evening, leaving behind a Pink Apricorn-scented powder. Those who breathe it in are calmed almost instantly.

entry: 不同于其他小拉达，POKENAME很有礼貌，常被当普通宠物。也因太常受驯养，在野外反而难以生存。
author: mistymagius
source: Unlike other Rattata, POKENAME are quite well-mannered and are commonly kept as regular pets. However, because they are so commonly domesticated, they struggle to survive out in the wild.

entry: POKENAME总爱恶作剧，再用柔软拥抱安抚愤怒训练家，逃避追责。但若真伤到人或宝可梦，也会竭尽全力补救。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are always up to mischief and escape accountability by offering soft hugs to appease angry Trainers. However, whenever a Pokémon or Trainer gets hurt by the pranks, they do everything in their power to remedy the situation.

entry: POKENAME将长触须浸入溪流，吸水入体。个头虽小，每天能吸超过10加仑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME dips its long feeler into streams to absorb water into its body. Despite its small size, it can take in over 10 gallons each day.

entry: POKENAME在月光下睡觉时，叶子释放舒缓覆盆子香，让附近前来求安全的向日种子安稳入睡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a calming raspberry scent from its leaves while sleeping in moonlight. This tends to settle any Sunkern in the area as they sleep nearby for safety.

entry: POKENAME高速飞过沼泽，散出泡泡糖般的香，安抚经过的对象。这样做，只是出于善意。
author: .izik
source: While flying at high speeds over swampy areas, POKENAME releases a bubblegum-like scent that induces calm in those it passes. It does this for no reason other than to be kind.

entry: 有个倡导和平、免受迫害的组织，以POKENAME为吉祥物，因为碰一下就能平息攻击性。它产的凝胶也正被军方研究，用于制服敌人。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: An organisation that promotes peace and freedom from persecution uses POKENAME as its mascot as it can calm someone's aggressive behaviour by simply touching them. It produces a gel that is being researched by the military to neutralise opponents.

entry: POKENAME随时愿拥抱有需要的对象，以缎带轻触安抚。但只有真正信任、喜爱的对象，才能调整胸前蝴蝶结。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is always ready to give a hug to those in need of one, soothing them with a few touches from its ribbons. It only allows those it truly trusts and loves to adjust the bow-tie on its torso.

entry: POKENAME感知他者心理状态的本领几乎无人能及。训练家还没意识到自己的心情，它便已陪在身边，用缎带温柔安慰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's capacity for sensing the mental state of others is almost unparalleled. It will be by its Trainer's side, offering a comforting touch of its ribbons before its Trainer even realizes their own emotional state.

entry: POKENAME对选中的对象极敏感，借气流与缎带状触须，预判训练家需要。它甚至会为了看训练家一笑而击倒龙。
author: stephanyx
source: POKENAME are incredibly sensitive to those they choose, using both air currents and their ribbonlike feelers to anticipate their Trainers' needs. POKENAME are known to fell dragons to see their Trainers smile.

entry: 圆环的柔粉光与友善缎带，让POKENAME引来放松警惕的猎物。缎带一出击缠住，圆环就变亮粉色。
author: soup1900
source: The soft pink glow of its rings along with its friendly-looking ribbons allows POKENAME to lure in prey with their guard down. The rings change into a hot pink the moment it uses its ribbons to attack and ensnare the victim.

entry: POKENAME只在黑暗中现身，保护其他宝可梦。它潜在暗影，几乎不被看见，却能放出幸福能量光束，让中招者忘记曾经遇险。
author: knews6969
source: POKENAME only comes out in the darkness to protect other Pokémon. Although almost never seen as it lurks in the shadows, it can radiate beams of happiness-giving energy, causing struck Pokémon to forget they were ever in danger.

entry: POKENAME迷恋一切闪亮物，早就与财富好运联系在一起。但它能敏锐察觉恶意，坏心肠的人即使满身珠宝，也会避开。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are so fascinated by anything that sparkles that they have long since been associated with fortune and wealth. They are keenly aware of evil intent, so they avoid those with wicked hearts, no matter how much sparkling jewelry they may bear.

entry: POKENAME聪明敏感，遇到谁需要帮助，就会努力相助，不知疲倦地为别人的难题想巧办法。
author: hophoppip
source: Smart and sensitive, POKENAME will attempt to help anyone it comes across who needs it. It works tirelessly to come up with clever solutions to others' problems.

entry: POKENAME极依恋训练家，分开太久就焦虑。因此会用触须缠住手臂，让对方留在身边。
author: periperi_chicken
source: POKENAME get very attached to their Trainers. Being separated for too long makes POKENAME anxious, so they wrap their feelers around the arm of their Trainer to keep them close.

entry: POKENAME翻垃圾箱时若被撞见，就从缎带状触须释放舒缓气息，让目击者平静足够久，好趁机逃跑。
author: .izik
source: If spotted while scavenging through dumpsters, POKENAME releases a calming aura from its ribbonlike feelers. The effect pacifies witnesses long enough for it to escape.

entry: POKENAME夜里飘过墓地，散出舒缓饼干香，引人靠近，再以高速星星使其无法行动，随后饱餐。
author: .izik
source: While floating over cemeteries at night, POKENAME releases a soothing cookie-like scent that draws in nearby humans. When they get close it uses Swift to incapacitate them before feasting.

entry: POKENAME用缎带状附肢，在最近的物面画字母般符号。虽然不像可读的语言，看见留言的人仍会感到平静涌来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses its ribbon-like appendages to draw symbols resembling letters on the nearest surfaces. Though they don't appear to be any readable language, those who look at its messages feel a calming sensation wash over them.

entry: 训练家对POKENAME做什么，它就会反弹回来。无论情绪或身体、积极或消极，都会以超能力与妖精力量回敬。
author: beatdoof
source: Whatever a Trainer does to POKENAME, it will bounce it back. Whether emotionally or physically, positive or negative, it will use its psychic and fairy abilities to do so.

entry: POKENAME住在森林，只在最晴朗明亮的日子出现。有些宝可梦中心请它当助手，吸收负面情绪的能力与活泼态度，让它成为好倾听者。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME lives in forests, though they only appear during the brightest of days. In some Pokémon Centers, they are the assistant Pokémon, where their ability to absorb negative emotions and their peppy attitude make them a great listener.

entry: POKENAME用触须挂在枝上，将刺扎入树枝吸养分。掉落时，谁接住它，就会让它深深依恋。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their feelers to hang from branches with their spikes embedded into the branch to siphon some of the tree's nutrients. When a POKENAME falls, it will develop a strong attachment to whoever catches it.

entry: POKENAME把缎带远远射出，裹住并平息附近敌意。但它不肯动，够不到的纷争就不管。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME ejects its ribbons far out to wrap around and soothe any hostility near it. However, any aggression out of reach from its spot is ignored due to its unwillingness to move.

entry: POKENAME受惊时，钻头尾高速顺时针转，放出肉桂香。它挖地逃走时，香气会安抚天敌。
author: .izik
source: When startled, POKENAME's drill-like tail spins clockwise at high speed, releasing a cinnamon scent. This tends to calm predators while it digs away to escape.

entry: POKENAME大多时间附在洞壁睡觉。一感到负面情绪就醒，俯冲缠住产生情绪的对象，叮入令人欣快的毒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spends much of its time clinging to cavern walls while sleeping. It wakes up instantly if it senses negative emotions, swooping at the offender and latching onto them to deliver a sting that delivers a euphoria-inducing toxin.

entry: POKENAME挖掘时，每节身体旋转，散出宜人苔藓香，安抚附近宝可梦。它因而能少受地下原住者打扰，顺利开隧道。
author: .izik
source: As each section of POKENAME's body rotates while digging, it releases a pleasant mossy scent that calms nearby Pokémon. This allows it to tunnel with minimal disturbance from the ground's current occupants.

entry: POKENAME不顺心，头上缎带就变漆黑。它会像孩子一样暴怒尖叫，把附近东西扔到地上。
author: .izik
source: The ribbon on POKENAME's head turns jet black when it does not get its way. It will fly into a rage, screeching and hurling any nearby objects to the ground like a child.

entry: POKENAME从尾羽散发舒缓气息，安抚绿毛虫。猎物一放松，就迅速俯冲，狠狠使出啄。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits a soothing aura from its tail feathers to calm Caterpie. Once its prey is relaxed, it dives swiftly to hunt with a brutal Peck.

entry: POKENAME外貌凶，内心却温和胆怯。但若有人拉缎带，就会激怒它，攻击附近一切。
author: sk372
source: Despite an aggressive appearance, POKENAME has a gentle and meek heart. However, having its ribbons pulled will cause it to fly into an aggravated rage and lash out at anything nearby.

entry: POKENAME刺中分泌物的麻痹效果很强。目前正研究如何用于改善现代麻醉剂。
author: sk372
source: The secretions from POKENAME's quills have a potent numbing effect. Research is currently ongoing on the subject of applying it to improve modern anesthetics.

entry: POKENAME角状触须战时硬如钢，一击便能轻易击倒枫树。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's horn-like feeler becomes as hard as steel during combat. With a single strike, it can topple a maple tree with ease.

entry: POKENAME成对合作，但群体最多有十只。它们用爪爬树，为自己与同群成员采食，总先顾朋友家人，再顾自己。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME work together in pairs, though they live in packs of up to ten individuals. Using their claws, they scale trees to collect food for themselves and for their packs; a POKENAME will worry about feeding its friends and family before itself.

entry: POKENAME难过时，触须渗出蜂蜜般黏液。闻着虽香甜，却苦得大多数人几乎无法入口。
author: .izik
source: A honey-like slime oozes from POKENAME's feelers when it is sad. Despite smelling delicious, it is extremely bitter and virtually inedible to most humans.

entry: 宝可梦很快就学会别在POKENAME领地惹事。它虽不特别好斗，却厌恶冲突，会用极紧、甚至疼痛的熊抱，抱住闹事者，直到对方安分。
author: sk372
source: Pokémon learn quickly not to cause trouble in POKENAME territory. Though not especially aggressive, it abhors conflict and will put troublemakers in especially tight and possibly painful bear-hugs until they stop acting out.

entry: POKENAME身体由古怪奶油状物质构成，睡觉时会变得极热，同时散出令人放松的酸香，安抚附近天敌。
author: .izik
source: The bizarre cream-like substance making up POKENAME's body grows incredibly hot while it sleeps. During this time, it exudes a relaxing tart scent that soothes nearby predators.

entry: POKENAME体表热乎的乳脂状物质，稠度如布丁。散出的甜香能让靠近者平静。
author: .izik
source: The hot, creamy substance coating POKENAME's body is similar in consistency to pudding. The sweet scent it gives off calms those who draw near.

entry: POKENAME羽毛天然带有舒缓作用。许多医院用来填枕头，帮助创伤患者安睡。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feathers naturally release a calming influence. Many hospitals stuff pillows with them to help trauma patients sleep peacefully.

entry: POKENAME闻到天敌靠近，耳朵就剧烈抖动，放出浓烈的杏子香气，安抚天敌，自己趁机逃往安全处。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME smells a predator nearby, its ears fidget violently and release a strong apricot odor. This calms the predator while POKENAME flees to safety.

entry: POKENAME厚毛散发温暖舒缓气息，是穿越冰寒地区的好伙伴。贴近便能轻松抵御寒冷影响。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's thick coat of fur produces a warming and calming aura, making it a valuable partner for venturing through frozen areas. Staying close to it will allow others to stave off the effects of the cold easily.

entry: POKENAME身体产生的细小浑浊泡泡，接触就能安抚。每天最多造1,000个，之后就得休息。
author: .izik
source: The tiny, cloudy bubbles POKENAME produces from its body can soothe those they touch. It can generate up to 1,000 of these bubbles per day before needing to rest.

entry: POKENAME高速游动，身后留小泡泡，安抚追赶者，轻易逃开利牙鱼等天敌。
author: .izik
source: While swimming at high speeds, POKENAME leaves behind tiny bubbles that calm any pursuers. It uses this to flee predators like Carvanha with ease.

entry: POKENAME射出大团墨，击中就让目标平和。随种类不同，墨可蓝可粉，性质却看不出其他差异。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME shoots out large globs of ink that will, on contact, cause those struck to feel calm and placid. The ink shot can be either blue or pink, depending on the species, with no other apparent distinction in properties.

entry: 野生原野区的宝可梦打起来，有时会请POKENAME来。它用缎带状触手平息攻击性，等怒气全消，再唱首歌。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: If the Pokémon in a Safari Zone begin to fight, POKENAME are sometimes brought in. Using their ribbon-like tentacles, they placate any aggressive Pokémon and will sing a song once all tempers have ceased.

entry: 城都民间故事讲述，POKENAME在激烈战斗中跃出水，安抚所有参与者。它们始终结群，将弱小海洋宝可梦背去需要前往的地方。
author: beatdoof
source: A Johtonian folk tale describes POKENAME flying out of the water in the midst of a heated battle and pacifying all involved. They're always in schools, carrying weaker ocean Pokémon on their backs wherever they need.

entry: POKENAME极以色彩鲜艳的翅膀为傲，向其他宝可梦得意展示。蓝粉羽色稀有，羽毛常被熔成首饰。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is very proud of its colorful wings, boastfully showing them off to other Pokémon. Its feathers are often melted down into jewelry as their blue and pink coloring is quite rare.

entry: 每夜狩猎后，POKENAME随群返回休息处。站岗时，会伸触须安抚熟睡同族。
author: .izik
source: After a nightly hunt, POKENAME returns to its resting spot with the rest of its pack. While keeping watch, it extends its feelers to calm its sleeping kin.

entry: 缎带柔韧、可伸缩、耐火。POKENAME用来束住猎物，再喷火烤熟。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The ribbons on its body are flexible, extendable, and fireproof. POKENAME uses them to restrain its prey before roasting them with its fire breath.

entry: POKENAME尾尖释放抑制恐惧与攻击性的气息。猎物平静下来，它就咬住，注入强毒。
author: .izik
source: The tip of POKENAME's tail releases an aura that suppresses fear and aggression. While prey is subdued, it injects a potent venom with a bite.

entry: POKENAME爱缠住其他宝可梦拥抱。没有獠牙，显得温顺，所以许多宝可梦都乐意接受。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME love to wrap themselves around other Pokémon to give them hugs. Their lack of fangs makes them appear docile, so many Pokémon happily accept their embrace.

entry: POKENAME睡在珊瑚礁时，用触须缠珊瑚，防止漂走。醒后几分钟，鳞片会闪着鲜艳黄光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME curls its feelers around coral while sleeping in reefs to avoid drifting. For a few minutes after waking, its scales shimmer in vibrant yellow hues.

entry: POKENAME高速滚动，会散出强烈留兰香，让附近生灵平静。但维持速度极耗体力，只能坚持几分钟。
author: .izik
source: At high rolling speeds, POKENAME releases a strong spearmint scent that induces calm in those nearby. Maintaining this speed is extremely exhausting and can only be sustained for a few minutes.

entry: POKENAME极其温柔，常让其他宝可梦搭乘。伊布特别爱趴在背与鼻子上，皮革般的皮肤睡着很舒服。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are incredibly gentle creatures that often allow other Pokémon to ride on their bodies. Eevee are particularly fond of riding on their back and trunk as their leathery skin is comfortable to sleep on.

entry: 特殊更新让POKENAME能深入理解、仔细研究人类情绪。它因此很体谅他人心情，尽力给予支持。
author: soup1900
source: With its special updates, POKENAME is able to understand a lot about human emotions and can study them intensely. This has led to this species being very understanding to how anyone is feeling and supporting them however it can.

entry: 感到危险，POKENAME就用缎带敲鹿角。振动向周围释放脉冲，让附近生灵头晕而欢快，好趁机逃走。
author: sk372
source: When it feels in danger, POKENAME will use its ribbons to strike its antlers. The vibrations this cause sends out a pulsing energy around it that causes those nearby to feel dizzy and giddy, allowing POKENAME to flee.

entry: POKENAME振动鹿角，造出小股精神能量脉冲，消除周围攻击性。附近对象会迟缓、困倦而满足。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can vibrate its antlers to create a small pulse of psychic energy that drains aggression from others around it. Those in the pulse's vicinity feel sluggish, sleepy, and content.

entry: 在图图犬融合体中，POKENAME作品的色彩属于最鲜艳的一类。看过成品的人说，平静与放松会涌上心头。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's creations are some of the most vibrantly colored among the Smeargle fusions. People who view its finished artwork report a sense of calm and ease washing over them.

entry: POKENAME整夜几乎不知疲倦地训练，连睡着也用不同肢体维持平衡。若累得无法继续，就释放舒缓气息，帮助身体更快恢复。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME trains almost tirelessly through the night, balancing on different limbs even while sleeping. Should it grow too exhausted to continue, it releases a calming aura to help its body recuperate faster.

entry: POKENAME看似天真，却会边旋转边用缎带连拍猎物，凶狠攻击。旋转处产生大量舒缓气息，敌人一靠近就会被平息，难以接近。
author: soup1900
source: While innocent-looking, POKENAME viciously attacks prey by repeatedly slapping them with its ribbons while spinning. Lots of soothing auras are created from where it spins, making it impossible for foes to close in without being instantly pacified.

entry: 双臂旋转时，腹部爱心会泛电光，叉状角间也跳跃彩色电弧。表达喜悦与爱意时，它会用爪碰心爱的训练家，放出无害电击。
author: infinex21
source: The heart on its belly glows with electricity as it twirls its arms around; colorful electricity also arcs between its prong-like horns. To express its joy and love, it will touch its claws to its beloved Trainer and release a harmless jolt.

entry: POKENAME缠住吵闹宝可梦，用缎带安抚。无效时，才会不情愿地以毒牙注入催眠毒，作为最后手段。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME coils around rowdy Pokémon and uses its ribbons to calm them down. If this proves ineffective, it can deliver a soporific venom through its fangs, though it hates to do so, and only uses it as a last resort.

entry: POKENAME身上触须碰到谁，就能使其平静。可惜接触皮肤越久越热，时间长了会烫伤。
author: .izik
source: The feelers on POKENAME's body induce calmness in whoever they touch. They unfortunately grow hotter the longer they remain on skin and can cause burns after prolonged contact.

entry: POKENAME极善良慷慨，谁看着不开心，就请谁喝奶。奶营养好，也能舒缓，确实有助缓解压力与不安。
author: sk372
source: Extremely kind and generous, POKENAME will offer up its milk to anyone it thinks looks unhappy. The milk is very healthy and calming, so it is certainly effective at combating stress and unease.

entry: POKENAME的奶独特，能产出各种鲜艳粉色与蓝色。配上甜味，成了多数店铺售卖的热门新奇饮品。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME milk is unique for being produced in various vibrant shades of pink and blue. The coloration, alongside the sweet flavor, makes it a popular novelty drink sold in most stores.

entry: POKENAME爱收养、保护野外发现的蛋，鼓励引导，直到破壳，再给予充分爱与支持。
author: fancyskunk
source: POKENAME loves to adopt and protect any eggs that it finds in the wild. POKENAME will encourage and guide these eggs on their journey towards cracking, and then provide ample love and support once they do.

entry: POKENAME在上空造彩色雷云，随其他生灵情绪反应。谁在面前攻击，云中就会落下鲜艳雷电，使其麻痹。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME generates colorful storm clouds above it that respond to the emotions of others. Aggressive behavior in its presence triggers paralyzing, brightly colored bolts of lightning from the clouds.

entry: POKENAME从缎带召出的雷电，蕴含安抚能量。目标一中电，就突然变得精力旺盛，对其他生灵友善。
author: soup1900
source: The lightning bolts POKENAME can summon from its ribbons are imbued with calming energy. Being struck by one instantly shocks the target into suddenly becoming very energetic and friendly with others.

entry: 火山开始喷发时，常能见到POKENAME在现场附近，以气息安抚居民。攻击敌人时，也将这些气息集中到滚烫缎带上，化作燃烧光束。
author: soup1900
source: When volcanoes begin to erupt, POKENAME are often spotted near the scene using their auras to calm the inhabitants nearby. To attack enemies, they concentrate these same auras into their hot ribbons to turn them into burning beams.

entry: 柔和北风吹后，若突然神清气爽、满心满足，也许是POKENAME在附近。飘扬的浅色鬃毛，让观看者心平气和。
author: bobosmith01
source: If one feels refreshed and gains a sudden sense of contentment after a soft northern breeze, it may be that POKENAME is nearby. Its billowing gently-colored mane evokes calmness in beholders.

entry: POKENAME循风追寻敌意与怨恨，恢复平静，化解纷争。奔赴现场的优雅，只有闪亮身体与飘逸缎带能媲美。
author: soup1900
source: Following the winds, POKENAME chase down hostility and bitterness in order to restore calm and purify the situation. Their elegance as they run into any situation is matched only by their sparkling bodies and graceful ribbons.

entry: 柔和北风吹后，若突然神清气爽、满心满足，也许是POKENAME在附近。飘扬的浅色鬃毛，让观看者心平气和。
author: bobosmith01
source: If one feels refreshed and gains a sudden sense of contentment after a soft northern breeze, it may be that POKENAME is nearby. Its billowing gently-colored mane evokes calmness in beholders.

entry: POKENAME缎带一碰，就能净化任何水域。人们相信，刚净化后立刻喝下，能延长寿命。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's ribbons can purify any body of water with a single touch. Drinking the water immediately after it has been purified is believed to extend a person's lifespan.

entry: 柔和北风吹后，若突然神清气爽、满心满足，也许是POKENAME在附近。飘扬的浅色鬃毛，让观看者心平气和。
author: bobosmith01
source: If one feels refreshed and gains a sudden sense of contentment after a soft northern breeze, it may be that POKENAME is nearby. Its billowing gently-colored mane evokes calmness in beholders.

entry: POKENAME会赐福敬奉自己的对象，却对不尊重者毫不留情。
author: xenellia
source: POKENAME are known to reward those that revere them with blessings, while showing no mercy to any that show them disrespect.

entry: POKENAME的角在洞窟家园散出舒缓碧根果香。天敌尚未接近黑暗深处的巢，便被安抚。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's horn releases a calming pecan scent throughout its cavern home. This soothes predators before they can draw close to its nest deep in the darkness.

entry: POKENAME用长触须固定在高处洞壁岩上，静静悬挂，等待进化，有时离地超过50英尺。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its long feelers to secure itself to rock formations high on cave walls. It waits quietly for evolution in this suspended position, sometimes hanging over 50 feet in the air.

entry: POKENAME厌恶领地内交战。看见其他生灵打架，就制造巨大的彩色沙暴，沙粒遮眼，也逐渐消磨斗志，让战斗无法继续。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME detests combat within its territory; if it sees others fighting, it creates a massive storm of multicolored sand. The grains of sand blind others and slowly whittle away their combat urges, making continuing to fight impossible.

entry: 住在POKENAME所占山旁的生灵，都在保护之下。它温柔待伙伴，谁欺负守护对象，就会见识怒火与力量有多可怕。
author: sk372
source: Those who reside near POKENAME's claimed mountain are under its protection. It treats companions gently, but picking on those it guards will cause it to show the terrible depths of its wrath and strength.

entry: 城都的古老文献称POKENAME为“带来狂喜的存在”。它只需一振翅，就能掀起汹涌的狂风，不过这风毫无伤害，只会让卷入其中者，感到莫名的欢欣。
author: beatdoof
source: Ancient Johtonian texts call POKENAME 'It That Brings Rapture'. One flap of its wings is enough to create a raging flow of wind, however it's harmless and only causes others swept up in it to be hit with an inexplicable sense of jubilance.

entry: 城都的古老文献称POKENAME为“带来狂喜的存在”。它只需一振翅，就能掀起汹涌的狂风，不过这风毫无伤害，只会让卷入其中者，感到莫名的欢欣。
author: beatdoof
source: Ancient Johtonian texts call POKENAME 'It That Brings Rapture'. One flap of its wings is enough to create a raging flow of wind, however it's harmless and only causes others swept up in it to be hit with an inexplicable sense of jubilance.

entry: 若电击还阻止不了争斗，POKENAME就从胸前缎带释放强烈安抚气息。对手通常接触片刻便失去斗志。
author: .izik
source: If electric shocks fail to stop a fight, POKENAME releases a strong calming aura from its chest ribbon. The opponent usually loses the will to battle within moments of being exposed.

entry: POKENAME飞过，双翼留下美丽粉蓝彩虹。有些圈子将飞行时脱落的羽毛，视为近乎无价的饰品与身份象征。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wings leave behind a beautiful rainbow of pink and blue hues as it flies. Feathers shed from it while in flight are considered an almost priceless accessory and status symbol in some circles.

entry: POKENAME颜色远比肉眼所见鲜艳明亮。据说见它将触须完全伸直飞行的人，将能彻底认识自己，获得永恒好运的祝福。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME's colors are far more vivid and luminous than the eye alone can perceive. It is said that those who have seen POKENAME fly with its feelers fully straight will be blessed with a full realization of the self and eternal fortune.

entry: POKENAME厌恶冲突，释放舒缓气息，平息怒气。许多不同时代都有记录，称它为“和平使者”。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME hates conflict and releases a soothing aura to calm angry hearts. Records describing it as an “emissary of peace” can be found across many different eras.

entry: POKENAME在尾巴上弹跳，散发宜人洋甘菊香，在压力大的冬季安抚同族。
author: .izik
source: While bouncing on its tail, POKENAME releases a delightful chamomile aroma. It uses this to relax its kin during the stressful winter months.

entry: POKENAME主食只有树果，最爱洛玫果。它用好笑的空洞眼神与微笑，迷住偶遇的训练家，让对方喂食。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME's main diet consists only of berries, with Roseli Berry being its favorite. It likes to charm random Trainers coming across it to feed it, using its funny, empty stares and smile.

entry: POKENAME总爱惹事，但一有人受伤，恶作剧就停。它会暂停胡闹，送上舒缓拥抱，减轻受害者疼痛。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are always up to trouble, but their pranks end when someone gets hurt. They pause their antics to offer a soothing hug to ease the pain of those harmed by their pranks.

entry: POKENAME常吟唱咒语，让宝可梦停止战斗。敌人不再反击，取胜便容易多了。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME often chants incantations that cause Pokémon to stop fighting. This makes it easier to defeat foes, as they'll no longer try to retaliate.

entry: POKENAME从缎带尾放出舒缓气息，化解群体争吵。若争吵者平静不下，就毫不留情地赶走。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME releases a soothing aura from its ribbon-shaped tails to resolve arguments in its flock. If the quarrelers fail to calm down, POKENAME will kick them out without mercy.

entry: 叫声能安抚焦躁鸟群，令其暂时听命。虽有人视作某种预兆与潜在威胁，它却从未将力量用于平息纷争以外的事。
author: infinex21
source: Its cries can soothe flocks of agitated bird Pokémon and compel them to obey it for a time. Although some see it as an omen and potential threat, it has yet to use its powers for anything other than ending strife.

entry: POKENAME受压时，头上的彩色石头会散出枫树香气，让自己平静。
author: .izik
source: The multicolored stones on POKENAME's head emit a maple aroma when it is stressed. This scent works to calm it down.

entry: POKENAME喜欢模仿其他宝可梦动作，表示善意。若被模仿者不高兴，就扑去，以缎带拥抱道歉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME enjoy copying the movements of other Pokémon as a gesture of goodwill. If the Pokémon they are copying gets upset, POKENAME swoop in with a hug from their ribbons to apologize.

entry: POKENAME把收集的小圆石送给真正珍视的对象。长期受缎带轻拂，石头带上积极能量，握着便能舒缓神经。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gifts the small round stones it collects to those it truly cherishes. Having been brushed by its ribbons for so long, the stones carry some of its positive energy, soothing the nerves of one who holds them.

entry: 附近有敌意，POKENAME就不安，电力减弱。它们以缎带互相裹住、安抚，重新恢复平静。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME become restless, and their electricity weakens when there is hostility nearby them. They wrap each other in their ribbons to soothe each other and restore their calm again.

entry: POKENAME缎带般尾巴中流着数千伏电力，哪怕短暂碰触，也可能麻痹数月。
author: .izik
source: Thousands of volts course through POKENAME's ribbonlike tail. Even brief contact can cause paralysis that may last for months.

entry: POKENAME爱吃，却不爱独食。缎带轻拂会让其他生灵饥饿，方便分享食物，有伴一起吃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME loves to eat, but hates doing so alone. Brushing its ribbons against others causes them to feel pangs of hunger, making it easy for POKENAME to share food and have company while eating.

entry: POKENAME帮助游泳教学，也帮助怕海的人。它在浅水轻轻载人，缎带状触须则安抚紧张。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME are used to help with swimming lessons and those scared of the ocean. Its ribbon-like feelers helps soothe nerves while it gently carries them along the shallow waters.

entry: POKENAME头上触须让它连冰面也轻易保持平衡，还能伸得更长，感受将至的天气变化。
author: .izik
source: The feelers extending from POKENAME's head allow it to maintain balance effortlessly even on icy surfaces. They can also extend further to sense approaching weather changes.

entry: POKENAME用爪在地面留痕，给同群成员传信，已有研究者编出解读指南。虽结伙捕猎，却精准下手，确保猎物不受苦。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their claws to leave marks in the terrain to signal to their packs, but some researchers have developed guides for understanding these marks. Though they gang up to hunt prey, they strike with precision to ensure no suffering occurs.

entry: POKENAME靠磁力飞行，通过缎带状触须感受负面情绪，常以歌声安慰。它虽优雅，战时却冷静精准。
author: jonclyd
source: POKENAME uses magnetism to fly and is often found singing to soothe those with negative emotions, which it senses through its ribbonlike feelers. While elegant, this Pokémon is cold and precise in battle.

entry: POKENAME缎带状舌头滴下的唾液，接触就能舒缓。整脊师常将滴液涂在穴位，缓解积压压力。
author: .izik
source: The saliva that drips from POKENAME's ribbon-like tongue can soothe on contact. Chiropractors frequently apply these drippings to pressure points to relieve pent-up stress.

entry: POKENAME蜷身使出滚动时，会喷出泛乳光的闪粉与糖粒，让滚过的地面闪着粉白光。舌上口水也曾被关都菜肴用作鲜味原料。
author: beatdoof
source: When POKENAME curls its body into a Rollout, opalescent glitter and sprinkles shoot out of its body, leaving the ground it rolls on shimmering with pink and white. The slobber in its tongue has been used in Kantonian dishes as an umami ingredient.

entry: POKENAME战斗时出手精准，会从手中发射填满闪粉的巨石，或造出粉红与淡蓝紫交织的沙暴，掩住身影。它分不清玩耍与战斗。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME fights with precise intent by shooting glitter-filled boulder from its hands or creating a colorful carnation-periwinkle sandstorm that obscures it from view. It doesn't differentiate between playing and battling.

entry: POKENAME如行走的缎带触手团，无数肢体足以安抚整座城。若镇上人人都平静快乐得古怪，也许正受它影响。
author: sk372
source: A walking mass of countless ribbon tentacles, POKENAME could pacify an entire city with its many limbs. If one comes across a town filled completely with strangely placid, happy citizens, a POKENAME may be affecting the populace.

entry: POKENAME缎带电压很高，只碰尖端就能迸出大片火花。但它温柔避战，只肯用足以麻痹挑战者的力量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's ribbons contain enough voltage that merely touching the tips can create a shower of electric sparks. Despite this, it is gentle and prefers to avoid combat, only using enough power to paralyze those who try to fight it.

entry: POKENAME从手臂发出的火，会在粉蓝间变换。蓝火更强，粉火则燃烧中招者的能量，让其渐渐虚弱。
author: sk372
source: The color of POKENAME's fire launched from its arm alternates between pink and blue. The blue flames are more powerful, but the pink fire causes those singed by it to slowly grow weaker as their energy is burned away.

entry: 蛋早已被遗忘，POKENAME自信飞翔，走到哪里就把幸福传到哪里。据说见它一面，就能对自己有新的认识。
author: jemeremmazza
source: It's egg long forgotten, POKENAME confidently soars through the skies, spreading happiness wherever it goes. It is said that seeing one can give you a newfound understanding of yourself.

entry: POKENAME平和的外貌让其他宝可梦松懈，紧接着就被缎带的100,000伏电击中。储电太多时，会乱甩缎带，直到能量排空。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's peaceful look causes other Pokémon to let their guard down right before it zaps them with 100,000 volts from its ribbons. When it has stored too much electricity, it slaps its ribbons wildly around until all the energy has been discharged.

entry: POKENAME挖地若撞见其他宝可梦，就散出舒缓气息，避免领地冲突，再退往更深地下。
author: .izik
source: When colliding with another Pokémon while digging, POKENAME emits a soothing aura. This prevents territorial conflict as it retreats further underground.

entry: POKENAME很黏人，走到哪里都想带训练家。但飞行时也会尽力保护，用缎带裹牢，确保安全。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is very clingy and will try to carry its Trainer everywhere it goes. However, it tries its best to keep its Trainer safe while in flight, wrapping its ribbons around them to keep them secure.

entry: POKENAME移动时也进行光合作用，获取一天所需养分。产生的空气不仅洁净，还带舒缓香气。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME perform photosynthesis to acquire their needed nutrients for the day, even as they move. The air they produce through this process is not only clean, but it also carries a soothing aroma.

entry: 野生POKENAME极少被见到，但每份报告都说，它在保护、救助暴雪中的迷途者。身体摸着凉，触毛似乎几分钟就能缓解恐惧焦虑。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME have scarcely been seen, but every report of them claimed they were protecting or saving others lost in blizzards. Their bodies are cool to the touch; touching their fur seemingly soothes fear and anxiety within minutes.

entry: POKENAME天生免疫毒，以针状尾巴从人和宝可梦体内抽出有害毒素。过程无痛，只留很快愈合的小痕。
author: evilgammon
source: Being naturally immune to poison, POKENAME uses its needle-like tail to extract harmful toxins from people and Pokémon alike. This procedure is painless and leaves only a small mark that quickly heals.

entry: POKENAME穿越雪地，长牙散出强烈棉花糖香。附近雪童子受吸引，觉得舒心，却会被它捕食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a strong cotton candy-like scent from its tusks while traveling through snowy areas. This attracts nearby Snorunt, who find it soothing, which POKENAME then preys upon.

entry: POKENAME在电脑内，会显示网上收集的图片，安慰看屏幕的不开心用户。好意虽真，选图却有时太古怪，达不到效果。
author: .izik
source: While inside a computer, POKENAME displays images it has collected online to calm upset users viewing the screen. Though its intentions are good, the images chosen are sometimes very odd and fail to have the desired effect.

entry: POKENAME能放舒缓波，强迫其他生灵平静，却让行为古怪起来。对方不得不答应任何请求、异常友好，仿佛完全无法提出异议。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can release soothing waves to forcefully pacify others; however, this causes them to act strangely. They are forced to agree with anything anyone asks and be super nice, as if they are unable to start any disagreement at all.

entry: POKENAME常在信息技术公司担任情感支持伙伴，艰难时刻通过触须与闪光传递喜悦。童话少女训练家喜欢让它当王牌。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME is often seen used as an emotional support Pokémon for IT companies, radiating joy and happiness through its feelers and glitters during particularly tough breaks. Fairy Tale Girl Trainers like having it as their ace.

entry: 野生POKENAME选最茂盛的树，在树内、树上或附近筑巢。它关爱一切生命，但照顾这些树最认真。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME make their nests within, upon, or near the most verdant trees they can find. They care for all life, but they are most serious about caring for these trees.

entry: POKENAME群中，头上缎带最长者为首领。它仁厚领导，但成员不服教导时，也会毫不犹豫地严厉起来。
author: sk372
source: Among POKENAME packs, the one with the longest ribbon growing from its head is deemed the leader. It leads the group with a kind heart but won't hesitate to turn stern should any pack member resist its teachings.

entry: 缎带状附肢与敏锐感官，让POKENAME迅速轻松穿过密林。巡护员与它合作，追查偷猎者，救助突遇恶劣天气的对象。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can traverse dense jungle with ease and haste thanks to their ribbon-like appendages and keen senses. Pokémon Rangers work together with their POKENAME partners to track down poachers and to save others from sudden, severe weather.

entry: 野生POKENAME常用长缎带状附肢吊在枝上，向其他生灵脚边吐小火球，本意玩闹，多数却当作挑衅。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME often hang from branches using their long, ribbon-like appendages. They spit small fireballs at others' feet with playful intent, though most take this as an act of aggression.

entry: 战时，POKENAME背上柔软缎带状尖刺，会硬化成剃刀般利缘。它蜷成球，释放安抚信息素，迷惑天敌。
author: .izik
source: In combat, POKENAME's soft ribbonlike back quills harden into razor-sharp edges. It coils into a ball while releasing calming pheromones to confuse predators.

entry: POKENAME战斗时将长触须作额外肢体，伸得极长，施展多种摔翻动作，放倒对手。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its long feelers as extra limbs during combat. They extend to great lengths and enable a variety of flipping movements to bring opponents down.

entry: POKENAME通常不愿打架，但必要时战技娴熟。它结合拳脚与触须攻击，也用触须束缚、扰乱对手。
author: infinex21
source: Although POKENAME usually prefer to not fight, they are quite adept at fighting when they deem it necessary. They weave punches and kicks with attacks that utilize their feelers, including using their feelers to immobilize or disrupt their opponent.

entry: POKENAME用长触须将敌人挡远，或缠住近身者。脚部能放能量，打出迅疾强力踢击。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their long feelers to keep foes at range or to entangle foes that have drawn near. They can release bursts of energy from their feet to deliver swift and powerful kicking attacks.

entry: 叫声响起，脸颊的鳍就散出舒缓气息。它将双脚扎稳地面，就能使足力，将成年人或大型宝可梦抬出深泥坑。
author: infinex21
source: A soothing aura emanates from the fins on its cheeks when it cries out. By planting its feet into the ground, this Pokémon can muster enough strength to lift a human adult or large Pokémon out of deep mud pits.

entry: 后腿短壮，能稳稳支撑它将巨石举过头顶。缎带状附肢也会视需要辅助，增强力量或平衡。
author: infinex21
source: Its hind legs are stout, yet strong enough that it can lift large boulders over its head without buckling. It uses its ribbony appendages to reinforce itself as needed, be it for strength or for balance.

entry: 炎夏，POKENAME悠闲待在岸边，尾鳍散出独特胡椒粒气味。许多人说，足以安抚最难熬的时刻，另一些人却极厌恶。
author: .izik
source: While lounging on the shoreline during hot summer months, POKENAME's tail fin releases a distinct peppercorn scent. Many claim this is enough to soothe someone through the hardest of times, while others find it abhorrent.

entry: 强健身体让它们载着或抱着其他生灵，也能逆强流游泳。POKENAME深受海滩游客喜爱，野生个体也会毫不犹豫地救人。
author: infinex21
source: Their strong bodies allow them to swim against powerful currents, even if they are carrying or holding others. POKENAME are beloved by beachgoers because even the wild ones will not hesitate to save anyone in danger.

entry: POKENAME共情本领与训练家完全同步。对方情绪低落，就放精神波安抚。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's empathic abilities keep it completely in tune with its Trainer. Should its Trainer grow depressed, it releases psychic waves to help soothe their emotions.

entry: 蓝角感知他者情绪，方便寻找或避开人和宝可梦。它们会被满心恐惧焦虑的对象吸引，前去安慰。
author: infinex21
source: Their blue horns are attuned to the emotions of others, allowing them to easily find or avoid humans or Pokémon. They are drawn to those riddled with fear and/or anxiety and offer comfort to those they find.

entry: POKENAME拿着的爱心并非心脏，而是从训练家得到的喜悦与爱所显化。周围积极情绪太强时，爱心与头都会泛亮粉光。
author: beatdoof
source: The heart POKENAME carries is not its heart, but rather a manifestation of the joy and love it received from its Trainer. When it is overwhelmed with positive emotions from others, its heart and head will glow bright pink.

entry: POKENAME舞姿迷人，绕观众跳跃旋转，确保每个都被缎带轻拂。演出结束，人群中总是人人带笑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME captivates audiences with its dances, jumping and twirling about viewers and making sure to brush against each one with its ribbons. There is always a smile on every face in the crowd after a POKENAME performance.

entry: 人们见过许多野生宝可梦在破晓空地旋转，长触须绕身飞舞。它们不在意任何敌意，即使被击中，仍满怀怜悯。
author: infinex21
source: Many wild Pokémon have been seen twirling in open fields at the crack of dawn, their long feelers swirling around themselves. They are unfazed by any signs of aggression and remain compassionate, even when struck.

entry: POKENAME的爱心杖能向附近人和宝可梦传递爱与喜悦的共振波，平息潜在冲突。治疗师会借它协助照护，童话少女似乎也很喜欢。
author: beatdoof
source: The heart wand POKENAME carries can transmit resonant waves of love and joy to nearby humans and Pokémon, pacifying any potential conflict. Therapists have used POKENAME to help them in their care, and it seems to be popular with Fairy Tale Girls.

entry: POKENAME的爱心杖能向附近人和宝可梦传递爱与喜悦的共振波，平息潜在冲突。治疗师会借它协助照护，童话少女似乎也很喜欢。
author: beatdoof
source: The heart wand POKENAME carries can transmit resonant waves of love and joy to nearby humans and Pokémon, pacifying any potential conflict. Therapists have used POKENAME to help them in their care, and it seems to be popular with Fairy Tale Girls.

entry: POKENAME极厌恶暴力争端，会造出特殊小黑洞，吸走周围生灵的负面情绪，再将黑洞摧毁。受影响者平和满足，却也筋疲力尽。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME absolutely abhors violence and strife. It creates a small specialized black hole that sucks the negative emotions of all those around it before destroying it, leaving those afflicted feeling placid and content, if also exhausted.

entry: POKENAME以强大精神力保护训练家与弱小宝可梦，即使自己已被收服驯养也不例外。被触须捉住者很快失去斗志，连自卫也不想。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their immense psychic abilities to protect their Trainers and weaker Pokémon, even if they themselves have been caught and tamed. Those caught by their feelers quickly lose the drive to fight, even in their own defense.

entry: POKENAME能将训练家给予的欢乐与关爱放大，化作魔力。彼此的羁绊越深，POKENAME就越强大。
author: mileysakiko
source: POKENAME have been known to amplify and convert the joy and love they receive from their Trainers into magical power. The greater the bond they share, the stronger POKENAME will become.

entry: 缎带缠在双臂，表示POKENAME平静安宁。若发怒，就解开缠臂，露出肘刃，迅速报复逼自己产生负面情绪的对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's ribbons being present around its arms is a sign of it being calm and at peace. If angered, it unwraps its arms before unleashing the blades from its elbows, taking swift vengeance on those who forced it to feel such negative emotions.

entry: 野生POKENAME常现身，保护比攻击者弱小的野生宝可梦。它以刀刃状肘部战斗，缎带状触须则束住难管的敌人。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME often appear to defend other wild Pokémon who are weaker than their aggressors. They fight with their blade-like elbows and restrain unruly foes using their ribbon-like feelers.

entry: POKENAME肘部伸出的缎带，战时能变硬变锐。平时则柔柔飘动，安抚接触者的轻微疼痛。
author: sk372
source: The ribbons extending from POKENAME's elbows can stiffen and sharpen in order to be more formidable in combat. Outside of battle, they flutter gently and can soothe minor aches and pains in those touched by them.

entry: POKENAME能将训练家的喜悦与爱放大，转成超强力量。训练家越危险，它便越强。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME has been known to amplify and convert the joy and love they receive from their Trainers into super strength. The more their Trainer is in danger, the stronger POKENAME will become.

entry: 它安静飘向愤怒或痛苦的对象，以缎带般的翼轻触安抚。人们认为，POKENAME实际以抽走的负面情绪为食。
author: sk372
source: It floats around quietly, drifting towards those angry or in distress, soothing them with a touch from its ribbon-like wings. It's thought that POKENAME actually feeds on the negative emotions it siphons from others.

entry: POKENAME公主帽般的部分，其实是粗厚的角。布状尖端涂毒，哪怕短暂接触，也会引起可怕高烧。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's princess-like cap is actually a very thick horn. The cloth-like tip is coated with a toxin that can cause horrible fevers after even brief contact.

entry: POKENAME爱让其他生灵快乐，却害羞离群。它融入环境躲藏，暗中用缎带轻拂，让人不知道突然的欣喜从何而来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys making others feel happy, but is rather shy and reclusive. It blends itself into its surroundings to hide away and brush its ribbons against others in secret, so they never find out where the sudden rush of elation came from.

entry: POKENAME金属身体散出的气息，能安抚附近生灵，曾被用于帮助冥想。
author: .izik
source: The aura POKENAME emits from its metallic body causes those nearby to feel calm. It has been used to help people meditate.

entry: 聚在一起的一群POKENAME，被称为“齐声团”。研究显示，每只对人类文化感兴趣的方面都不同，但某些群体似乎都爱旗帜学。
author: beatdoof
source: A group of POKENAME gathering together is called a unison. Research has shown each different POKENAME seems to be interested in different aspects of human culture, though vexillology seems to be a shared interest among some unison.

entry: 若有人没被金属身体的气息安抚，POKENAME就会用重臂压住，再向脑中放出精神冲击，确保对方平静。
author: .izik
source: Should POKENAME sense someone not calmed by the aura of its metallic body, it will pin them down with its heavy arms. It then releases psychic jolts to their mind to ensure they get calm.

entry: POKENAME体内能储存艾字节级信息，因此常在图书馆与博物馆引导训练家和其他访客。研究者探查某些个体头脑，发现旗帜反复、醒目地出现。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME can be seen in libraries and museums guiding Trainers and many others thanks to its ability to store exabytes of information inside. Researchers probed into some POKENAME's heads and found flags to be repeated constantly and prominently.

entry: POKENAME看见有人难过，就放精神能量，使其平静。接触太久可能深睡，某些情况下甚至昏迷。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME sees someone upset, it releases psychic bursts that bring them to a calm state. Prolonged exposure can induce deep slumber and in some cases even comas.

entry: POKENAME认真履行知识守护者职责。强壮四肢能压碎几乎一切，头脑蕴含的精神力量也无与伦比。有些个体似乎会依所持旗帜改变体色。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME takes its duty seriously as a guardian of knowledge, armed with strong limbs that can crush most anything and a peerless psychic mind. Some POKENAME seem to demonstrate the ability to change their color depending on the flag they hold.

entry: POKENAME身上伸出的缎带，能轻易抬起重物，同时搬两根木头也不费力。
author: .izik
source: The ribbons extending from POKENAME's body are capable of lifting heavy loads with ease. It can carry two logs simultaneously with little effort.

entry: POKENAME虽住在水坝附近，却很害羞，只有周围都是其他仙子狸时才现身。人们见它用美丽花叶装饰水坝。
author: beatdoof
source: While POKENAME lives around dams, these shy Pokémon only surface when surrounded by other Sylbarel. They've been observed to decorate their dams with pretty leaves and flowers.

entry: 周围只有平静安宁时，POKENAME波导力量能发挥到极致。若发生冲突，它便用缎带压制敌意波导，恢复宁静。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's aura powers reach their maximum potential when there is only calm and tranquility around it. When there is conflict, it uses its ribbons to crush the hostile aura and restore calm.

entry: 它们平时不爱战斗，但为保护珍视的对象，会猛烈使出月亮之力与波导弹。触须用于感知波导，只许信任者碰。
author: infinex21
source: Although they typically prefer not to fight, they will launch fierce Moonblast and Aura Sphere attacks to protect those they care for. They only let those they trust touch their feelers, which serve to help them sense auras.

entry: POKENAME见到新朋友，总忍不住咬。牙上覆有酶，被咬后不久，就会感到快乐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME cannot resist the urge to bite down on any new acquaintance it comes across. Its teeth are coated with an enzyme that induces a feeling of joy shortly after being bitten.

entry: POKENAME战时被逼入绝境，会爆发龙般怒气，触须远伸，争取优势。觉得有把握结束战斗，就使出月亮之力。
author: .izik
source: When cornered in combat, POKENAME can fly into a draconic rage, its feelers extending to great distances to gain the upper hand. It will strike with Moonblast when it feels confident enough to finish the fight.

entry: POKENAME的缎带结如雷达，能察觉周围一切敌意，却发现不了平和的对象。为找猎物，它飞行时向四周散出敌意气息，让猎物也能被发现。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's ribbon bow can detect all hostility in an area, acting like a radar. However, it is unable to detect anyone peaceful. To locate its prey, it sends waves of hostile aura all around as it flies around so its prey becomes detectable.

entry: 利刃切钢梁也不崩口、不减速。每次割伤敌人或猎物，都会强行安抚对方，早在伤重身亡前，就已停止抵抗。
author: infinex21
source: Its sharp blades can cut through steel beams without chipping or being slowed down. Every cut made into foe or prey by this Pokémon forcefully soothes the victim, causing them to cease resisting long before they succumb to their injuries.

entry: POKENAME风刃带着舒缓波，让敌人遭猛烈击打也不躁动。它也这样安抚竞争的猎手，独占天空。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's blades of wind are infused with calming waves that cause its foe to not become agitated despite being violently struck. It uses these same soothing auras to calm competing predators so that it has total dominance of the sky.

entry: POKENAME温和维和，特别擅长安抚吵闹的尼多朗及其融合体。缎带碰几下，连暴怒尼多王也会平和满足。
author: sk372
source: A gentle peacekeeper among Pokémon, POKENAME is particularly effective at calming down rowdy male Nidoran and its related fusions. Just a few touches from its ribbons will cause even a raging Nidoking to become placid and content.

entry: POKENAME从触须放舒缓气息，劝退攻击者。若无效，就用覆毒触须猛击，再逃跑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a soothing aura from its feelers to deter attackers. If that fails, it lashes out with poison-coated feelers to flee.

entry: 海中生灵游得太近，就会被POKENAME的缎带触须裹住，麻木瘫痪，方便迅速吞下饱餐。
author: sk372
source: Any sea creature that swims too close to POKENAME will be wrapped up by its ribbon-like feelers. These numb and paralyze the captured victim, making them easy for POKENAME to swallow up for a quick meal.

entry: POKENAME扎根海床，头上触须能伸到100英尺。碰上墨海马等猎物，便迅速拉回，一口饱餐。
author: .izik
source: The feelers on POKENAME's head can extend up to 100 feet while it roots itself into the seafloor. Should they make contact with prey like Horsea, it drags them in to feast in one swift motion.

entry: POKENAME将触须伸得很长，寻找海床有机物。它偏爱捡食，不爱狩猎。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME extends its feelers to great lengths to locate organic material on the seafloor. It prefers to scavenge rather than hunt.

entry: 深海中，POKENAME头上缎带泛柔和天蓝光，引猎物靠近，再挥爪斩击。
author: .izik
source: Deep in the ocean, the ribbon on POKENAME's head emits a soft cerulean glow. This attracts prey to its location before it slashes them with its claws.

entry: POKENAME头撞敌人时，头上会散出黏土气味的粉色粉末，吸入似乎能让对手平静。
author: .izik
source: When headbutting a foe, POKENAME releases a pink powder from its head that smells of clay. This powder appears to calm its opponent if inhaled.

entry: POKENAME虽常低头冲向其他生灵，却几乎从不真用头撞。只是缎带离头骨更近，这样跑，方便缠住对方，拉来友善拥抱。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME often charges headfirst at others, it rarely, if ever, headbutts anything. It runs that way because its ribbons are closer to its cranium, making it easier to wrap around others and pull them into friendly hugs.

entry: POKENAME用钢头拦截攻击，保护他者。头一挨打就发声，听到的对象会感到平静涌来。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their steel heads to intercept attacks and protect others. When their heads are struck, a sound is released, and those who hear it will feel a wave of calm wash over them.

entry: 头比钨硬，正面受什么攻击都不动摇，也同样沉重，所以身体进化得更能承重。每只背两名成年人，也毫无困难。
author: infinex21
source: Their heads are tougher than tungsten, and no attacks faze them even if taken head-on. Their heads are equally heavy, so their bodies have evolved to better support their own weight. They can each carry two adult humans on their backs without issue.

entry: 若非过强的舒缓气息压住情绪，POKENAME本该精力充沛。气息强到旁人靠得太近，也会忍不住放下武器休息。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME would be full of energy if not for their overpowering, calming auras that keep their emotions in check. Their auras are so strong that they even cause others who are too close to be compelled to lay down their arms and rest.

entry: POKENAME虽尽心为许多宝可梦调解，却不太热衷安抚尼多力诺及其融合体。它以缎带裹住对方，消除所有负面情绪，连残留心绪也不留。
author: beatdoof
source: While it is devoted to its job to make peace with several Pokémon, POKENAME is not as enthused in calming down male Nidorino and its related fusions. It uses its ribbons to wrap around a Pokémon to nullify any negative emotions, even lingering ones.

entry: POKENAME举止始终平静威严。天性温柔，总试着和平化解，但若和平无望，也会熟练使出随身刀刃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries itself with a calm and regal demeanor at all times. Gentle by nature, it always tries to deescalate a situation peaceably, but will deftly utilize the blade it carries if a peaceful solution is unattainable.

entry: POKENAME常被将至灾难吸引，向可能受灾的对象提供帮助与安慰。许多故事讲它救助、守护他者，甚至不惜牺牲自己。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have oft been drawn to impending disasters, offering aid and comfort to those who would be affected by them. Many stories prevail of POKENAME that have saved and protected many others, even at the cost of their very selves.

entry: POKENAME夜里无聊，就飘到建筑窗旁，查看里面的人。若有人做不安的梦，就从头骨放舒缓气息安抚。
author: .izik
source: When bored at night, POKENAME floats near building windows to check on the humans within. If it finds someone having fitful dreams, it expels a soothing aura from its skull to calm them.

entry: POKENAME裹身的缎带状包布散着舒缓气息，既安抚珍视的对象，也让敌对者放松，方便拉进虚空般的身体。
author: pjporwoll
source: The ribbon-like wrappings that encase the body of POKENAME exude a calming aura. This aura allows it to soothe those it cares for and to lull those it feels hostile towards into a state where it can easily pull them into its void-like body.

entry: 缎带般舌头碰到目标，即使强行束住，也会让对方失去斗志。最高处的眼睛向凝视者放舒缓波，即使没有直接回望也有效。
author: infinex21
source: Its ribbon-like tongue saps those it touches of their will to fight, even as it forcefully restrains them. Its uppermost eye emits calming waves at whoever looks at it, even if it is not directly looking back.

entry: 这种大型宝可梦挡得住多数攻击，也毫不动摇，很乐意载人过海。许多人说，即使穿越风暴，待在背上仍心平气和。
author: infinex21
source: A large Pokémon that can shrug off most attacks and will remain unfazed by them as well. It is more than happy to ferry others across the sea; many claim that they felt calm upon its back, even as they crossed through storms.

entry: 有人在POKENAME附近开始溺水，它就迅速吸进嘴里，游向陆地，再吐到沙滩。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: If someone begins to drown near POKENAME, it will swiftly pull them into their mouth. POKENAME will then swim towards land, spitting out the person onto the beach.

entry: POKENAME缎带能瞬间安抚最凶的暴走宝可梦。它最多能造一千条，拥抱需要安慰的大群人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's ribbons have the power to instantly calm even the most belligerent rampaging Pokémon. It can form up to a thousand ribbons to soothe entire hordes of people in need of its calming embrace.

entry: 若天空出现三重彩虹，多半是POKENAME经过。目击者说，心中会有温暖感受。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: If a triple rainbow forms, it's likely caused by a passing POKENAME. Those who witness these rainbows report a warm feeling in their hearts.

entry: POKENAME头上嫩芽每夜睡觉都再长五英寸，散出苹果香，让靠近者放松，连天敌也一样。
author: .izik
source: The sprout on POKENAME's head grows five more inches each night while it sleeps, releasing an apple scent. This tends to relax anyone who draws near, including predators.

entry: 外貌虽善良，许多人却称POKENAME为“林间空地的盗贼”。它散着强安抚气息游走森林，再用灵巧触须，从毫无戒心的手里抢水果。
author: .izik
source: Despite its kind appearance, many call POKENAME the “Bandit of the Glade”. It wanders forests exuding an intense calming aura before snatching fruit from unsuspecting hands with its dexterous feelers.

entry: POKENAME感到有人难过，就从壳散出宜人罗勒香，往往片刻就能让对方平静。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a delightful basil scent from its shell upon sensing someone upset. This tends to calm them within moments.

entry: POKENAME体上触须散出的焦炭味，意外地让人舒心。它快速挥动触须，让气味散得更快。
author: .izik
source: The burnt charcoal scent POKENAME exudes from the feelers on its body has a surprisingly calming effect. It waves these feelers rapidly to spread the scent faster.

entry: 有些POKENAME长期与训练家或其家人生活，会呈现不同于多数同类的体色。伽勒尔历史也讲过中世纪领主与它并肩作战的故事。
author: beatdoof
source: Some POKENAME that have lived with a Trainer or their related family for a long time will show a different pigmentation than most other POKENAME. Galarian history tells of a story of a medieval Galarian lord fighting side by side with POKENAME.

entry: 据说尼多王或其融合体一暴走，POKENAME就会在粉雾中现身，以言语或平和的力量制服。它也用缎带和温暖的身体，裹住、安抚哭泣的幼年宝可梦。
author: beatdoof
source: It is said that whenever a male Nidoking or its fusion goes berserk, POKENAME will appear to them in a puff of pink mist to subdue them, by words or by tranquil force. It uses its ribbons and warm body to wrap around and calm any crying baby Pokémon.

entry: 睡觉时，POKENAME覆毒触须稳定放出舒缓气息，让附近伙伴放松，恶劣风暴中也不惊慌。
author: .izik
source: While sleeping, POKENAME's poison-coated feelers emit a steady calming aura. This keeps nearby allies relaxed and prevents panic during severe storms.

entry: POKENAME爱玩，常跳到训练家身上，用手或缎带弄乱头发。但到对战时，就会认真，以敏捷身法胜过对手。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME has a playful spirit and often jumps on its Trainer to mess up their hair with its hands or ribbons. When it is time to battle, however, it becomes serious, using its agility to outmaneuver its opponents.

entry: POKENAME睡觉时，头上火焰散出浓烟，带着雪松烧焦的气味。许多人说，舒缓香气能让哭婴片刻入睡。
author: .izik
source: A thick burnt cedar fume leaks from the flame on POKENAME's head as it sleeps. Many claim this soothing scent can put a crying infant to sleep in moments.

entry: POKENAME以舞蹈般复杂动作分散注意，再攻击。低估它的训练家，往往发现队伍被压倒。
author: gtrwya
source: POKENAME performs complex movements that resemble dancing to distract opponents before attacking. Trainers who underestimate it often find their teams overwhelmed.

entry: POKENAME总忍不住想比过同类。两只相遇，就会比谁能用缎带让对方更快乐。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can't resist trying to one-up others of its kind. If two POKENAME run into each other, they will compete to see who can make the other feel happier with their ribbons.

entry: POKENAME爱独居，不喜欢作伴。未受邀来客被触须擦过，就晕乎乎、欢快起来，再被推开，去别处漫无目的地游荡。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME prefers to live on its own, and disdains having company. Uninvited guests are rubbed by its feelers, which cause them to feel giddy and lightheaded, before being pushed away to wander aimlessly elsewhere.

entry: POKENAME能从触须尖呼吸，睡觉或狩猎时完全潜水也行。触须最远可伸50英尺，寻找新鲜空气。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can breathe through the tips of its feelers, allowing it to remain fully submerged in water while sleeping or hunting. The feelers can extend up to 50 feet to search for fresh air.

entry: POKENAME大鼻子滴下的浓白黏液，可制浴盐。世界各地水疗馆用来帮助异常紧张的客人放松。
author: .izik
source: The thick white mucus that drips from POKENAME's large nose is used in bath salts. Spas throughout the world rely on it as a relaxation aid for abnormally tense customers.

entry: POKENAME从缎带发出安抚气息，平息战斗。只有真正邪恶的对手，才会被它用剑了结。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME sends a soothing aura from its ribbons to calm fights. It only finishes off truly evil opponents with its blade.

entry: POKENAME从缎带发出安抚气息，平息战斗。只有真正邪恶的对手，才会被它用剑了结。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME sends a soothing aura from its ribbons to calm fights. It only finishes off truly evil opponents with its blade.

entry: POKENAME从缎带发出安抚气息，平息战斗。只有真正邪恶的对手，才会被它用剑了结。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: POKENAME sends a soothing aura from its ribbons to calm fights. It only finishes off truly evil opponents with its blade.

entry: POKENAME每次击中对手，都会削弱斗志，直到不得不投降。两把剑的缎带相连、紧紧打结，永不分离。
author: sk372
source: Each strike against an opponent POKENAME's makes saps their will to fight until they have no choice to capitulate. The two swords link their ribbons together, tying them tightly so as to never be separated.

entry: POKENAME几乎只守不攻。盾吸收打击后，产生舒缓气息，消磨敌人斗志。对方疲惫，才会拔刃，以一记擦击将其击倒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME battles almost entirely defensively, with its shield creating a calming aura after absorbing blows, draining foes of their fighting spirit. Only once a foe tires out will it draw its blade to knock them out with a glancing strike.

entry: POKENAME每挥刃，都会拖出彩色闪亮轨迹。刀上的气息让敌人越挨打越麻木平静，最终完全不想再战。
author: sk372
source: A colorful, sparkling trail follows POKENAME's blade with every swing. The blade is coated with an aura that numbs and calms a foe with every strike, until eventually they no longer feel the urge to fight anymore.

entry: POKENAME用带毒触须裹住猎物，令其放松戒备。受害者松懈时，引起鲜明幻觉的高烧会削弱身体。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wraps prey in poison-laced feelers that induce complacency. As the victim relaxes, a fever causing vivid hallucinations weakens their body.

entry: POKENAME遇上逆境，触须会变得极锐。激战时，轻易就能在石灰岩切出深槽。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's feelers become incredibly sharp when it faces adversity. During tense battles, they can slice deep grooves into limestone with ease.

entry: POKENAME组成军队，为仙子司令首领效力。它们用臂刃与触须压制敌人心智和灵魂，使其暂时受首领命令支配，以此取胜。
author: beatdoof
source: Battalions of POKENAME form to serve a Sylsharp leader. They defeat their enemies by nullifying their minds and souls through their armblades and feelers, temporarily enthralling them under their leader's commands.

entry: POKENAME切割物件，刀刃会散出舒缓的白垩气味，连战时也能控制自己的兴奋。
author: .izik
source: When slicing through objects, POKENAME's blades emit a calming chalky aroma. This keeps its own adrenaline in check even during battle.

entry: POKENAME领导一支全由仙子小兵组成的军队。但与其说它领队，更像王室般受部队无休止地服侍、宠爱。
author: beatdoof
source: POKENAME leads a battalion comprised of only Syliard. But rather than it leading them, it's more like a royal arrangement of it being served and spoiled endlessly by its battalion.

entry: POKENAME外表阴沉，心地却善良，对训练家尤其无条件亲昵。尾星能发光安抚附近宝可梦，缎带则感知情绪。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite its grim look, POKENAME is a kind creature, especially toward its Trainer, to whom it shows unconditional affection. The star on the tail emits a light capable of calming nearby Pokémon, while its ribbons allow it to sense their emotions.

entry: POKENAME金属身体色彩鲜艳，微光也能闪亮。它大半时间收集亮宝石，磨到和自己一样光洁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's metallic body is vibrant, sparkling under even a small amount of light. It spends much of its time collecting shining gems, polishing them until they gleam with the same level of shininess as it does.

entry: POKENAME看见争吵，就会挥动翅膀，将争执者远远吹开。若吹不动，便掀起妖精之风，围住双方，强行将舒缓的气息注入其中。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME spots a quarrel, it uses its wings to blow away the disputers far from each other. When it can't blow them away, it kicks up a Fairy Wind to surround the quarrelers and force soothing auras into them.

entry: 它用双翼掀起或驱散沙暴，保护自己或其他生灵。曾现身保护疲倦旅人，对抗远强于自己的宝可梦，因此声名远扬。
author: infinex21
source: It uses its wings to churn up or dispel sandstorms, either for its own protection or to protect others. It has appeared before weary travelers to protect them from other Pokémon far stronger than itself, earning it a renowned reputation.

entry: 这些湖居宝可梦常被画作守护者，平息家园附近一切争端。多数人都认为，它们和蜕鳞，是世上最美的事物之一。
author: infinex21
source: These lake-dwelling Pokémon have been depicted in many artworks as guardians that quell any strife near their dwellings. Most people would agree that these Pokémon, and their shed scales, are some of the most beautiful things to ever be witnessed.

entry: 附近有敌意，POKENAME就失控地向四处轰出舒缓气息，什么都击中。原本平静的人和宝可梦，也会有几天无论如何都气不起来。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME wildly blasts soothing auras all around when there is hostility nearby. Since it hits everything in these uncontrollable blasts, Pokémon and people who were already calm suddenly are unable to become angry for a few days no matter what.

entry: 吼声能神秘地影响情绪，几分钟内消磨斗志。无论骑乘，还是抓住缎带触须，都只允许自己的训练家。
author: infinex21
source: Its roar has a mystifying power over the emotions of those who hear it, causing them to lose their drive to fight within minutes. It only allows its Trainer to ride upon it, let alone to hold onto its ribbon-like feelers.

entry: POKENAME以构成身体的缎带作套索，裹住敌人，令其无法行动。困住后，就耐心等对方放弃。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME uses the ribbons that make up their bodies as snares, wrapping and enveloping their opponent to disable them. Once a foe is trapped, POKENAME patiently waits until their foe simply gives up.

entry: POKENAME在游乐场观察父母，再变成他们，将孩子诱往附近森林。它放舒缓气息，让目标一直不知受骗，随后饱餐。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME observes parents at playgrounds before transforming into them to lure children into nearby forests. It emits a calming aura to ensure its targets remain none the wiser before it feasts.

entry: POKENAME能在周围大片区域制造逼真幻象，用来保护、安慰朋友家人。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have the remarkable power to create realistic illusions in a wide area around them. They will use their illusions to protect and comfort friends and family.

entry: POKENAME充满爱，善于支持。据说能帮其他生灵找到真实的自己。
author: westerlytrack45
source: POKENAME is a very loving and supportive creature. It is said to help others find their true selves.

entry: POKENAME会被正在建立自我认知的人吸引。许多训练家说，旅途中受过它帮助，却说不清如何帮助。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are drawn to people who are developing their sense of self. Many Trainers claim they help them on their journey but can't explain how.

entry: POKENAME触须上的毒令人麻木、极度欣快。猎物沉浸幸福时，它就使出强力的“大闹一番”。
author: .izik
