source: POKENAME performs elaborate martial arts displays to ease stressed Pokémon. If the stress remains, it begins striking with punches until calm or unconsciousness follows.

entry: 民间传说POKENAME起舞带丰收。更可能是舞蹈消除了村中负面情绪，让耕作时更用心、更愿合作。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: According to folk legend, POKENAME would dance to bring about a bountiful harvest. It is most likely that during the dance, POKENAME would remove the village's negative emotions, leading to an increase in care and cooperation when it came to farming.

entry: 感到悲伤，POKENAME便夸张地展示肌肉，鼓舞士气。无效就用缎带状肢体束住目标，以重拳制服。
author: .izik
source: When sensing sadness, POKENAME flexes theatrically to raise morale. If this fails, it restrains targets with ribbonlike limbs and subdues them with powerful punches.

entry: POKENAME玩闹地走过花田，瘦长藤蔓状身体轻跃。20英尺内强行传开喜悦，不管附近对象愿不愿接受。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prances through flower fields, its lanky vine-like body moving playfully. A forced wave of joy spreads within 20 ft, affecting all nearby whether welcomed or not.

entry: POKENAME散糖香，引来寻求安慰的苦恼虫属性宝可梦。靠近后，就淋酸吃掉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases a sugary scent that draws distressed Bug-type Pokémon seeking comfort. Once close, it drenches them in acid and consumes them.

entry: POKENAME夜猎，叶状附肢的假脸泛柔光。它先让猎物快乐入睡，再整个吞下。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME hunts at night, the false face on its leafy appendage glowing softly. It calms prey into a joyful sleep before swallowing them whole.

entry: POKENAME触手的麻痹毒，使受害者平静、愉快、迟缓。既用来防止被猎，也偶尔借机偷食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tentacles possess a numbing venom that makes the victim feel calm, pleasant and sluggish. It uses this both to avoid being hunted on, but also to occasionally steal meals for itself from others.

entry: 这种另一配色的POKENAME，野外颇常见，性格稍凶，更爱用触手麻痹毒安抚他者，偷走食物。
author: sk372
source: This alternate coloration of POKENAME is rather common in the wild, and noted to be somewhat more aggressive, and more prone to using its numbing venom in its tentacles in order to pacify others and steal their food.

entry: POKENAME脱落的粉色石头，曾用于仪式，安抚孩子噩梦。后续研究却证实，并无真正效果。
author: .izik
source: Pink stones shed from POKENAME's body were once used in rituals to soothe children's nightmares. Later studies revealed they had no real effect.

entry: POKENAME脱落的粉色碎石，曾有人为求幸福感吃下，结果却引起严重消化不适。
author: .izik
source: The pink gravel POKENAME sheds was once eaten in hopes of inducing bliss. Instead, it caused severe digestive distress in those who tried.

entry: POKENAME吃宝石，舒缓气息就大幅扩展。每次黎明，效果又会神秘重置。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME consumes gemstones, its calming aura expands dramatically. The effect mysteriously resets each dawn.

entry: POKENAME和善，爱与其他宝可梦赛跑。哪怕从不获胜，也总尽全力。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME is an affable Pokémon that loves to race with other Pokémon. Even if it never wins, it always does its best.

entry: 许多务农家庭养POKENAME。暖毛令人舒适，小跑陪伴时，也常用触须缠同伴的手。
author: infinex21
source: Many farming families keep POKENAME nearby. Their warm fur comforts others, and they often wrap feelers around companions' hands as they trot alongside them.

entry: POKENAME是多部儿童动画女主角的忠诚坐骑。天生勇气与关爱可经角传导，直接碰触，就能将这些感受赠予他者。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is the loyal steed of the female protagonist in several cartoons aimed at a young demographic. Its innate bravery and compassion for others can be channeled through its horn, allowing it to grant these feelings to another via direct touch.

entry: POKENAME用长缎带状附肢缠住敌人，再向前疾驰，高速拖拽，造成重创。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME coils its long ribbonlike appendages around foes. It then gallops forward, dragging them at high speed to inflict heavy damage.

entry: POKENAME是多部儿童动画女主角的忠诚坐骑。天生勇气与关爱可经角传导，直接碰触，就能将这些感受赠予他者。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is the loyal steed of the female protagonist in several cartoons aimed at a young demographic. Its innate bravery and compassion for others can be channeled through its horn, allowing it to grant these feelings to another via direct touch.

entry: POKENAME是多部儿童动画女主角的忠诚坐骑。天生勇气与关爱可经角传导，直接碰触，就能将这些感受赠予他者。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is the loyal steed of the female protagonist in several cartoons aimed at a young demographic. Its innate bravery and compassion for others can be channeled through its horn, allowing it to grant these feelings to another via direct touch.

entry: POKENAME是多部儿童动画女主角的忠诚坐骑。天生勇气与关爱可经角传导，直接碰触，就能将这些感受赠予他者。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME is the loyal steed of the female protagonist in several cartoons aimed at a young demographic. Its innate bravery and compassion for others can be channeled through its horn, allowing it to grant these feelings to another via direct touch.

entry: POKENAME几乎一直幸福，很少有负面情绪。短暂苦恼也会在一次积极互动后，迅速消失。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rarely experiences negative emotions, existing in near-constant bliss. Any brief distress it feels vanishes quickly after a single positive interaction.

entry: POKENAME尾巴的气味特别吸引伊布，让它们忍不住咬。它似乎毫不介意，反而因逗伊布开心而欣喜。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's tail exudes a scent that Eevee in particular find incredibly appealing, unable to resist biting down on it. POKENAME does not seem to mind the bites, and in fact seems overjoyed to be making Eevee happy.

entry: POKENAME以磁场操纵一对缎带状长须，伸出缠住低落者。细微振动传遍全身，带来安慰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME manipulates a pair of ribbon-like tendrils via its own magnetic fields. It sends them out to constrict around those feeling glum, letting the tendrils' subtle vibrations send comforting sensations pulsing through them.

entry: POKENAME舒缓气息对钢属性宝可梦的影响远强于其他种类。有研究者怀疑磁力是部分原因，真相仍不明。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's calming aura affects Steel-type Pokémon far more strongly than others. Some researchers suspect magnetism may be part of the reason, but the true cause remains unknown.

entry: POKENAME真正开心时，随身大葱就发柔和闪光。它能感受周围情绪，常给深陷悲伤的对象送食物。
author: fiordaliso
source: When POKENAME is truly happy, the leek stalk it constantly carries begins to emit soft, shimmering light. It can sense the emotions of those around it and often brings food to anyone who is deeply saddened by something.

entry: POKENAME跑过空地，蓬松羽毛散出舒缓气息，似乎刻意如此，将微笑传给附近所有生灵。
author: .izik
source: As POKENAME sprints across open fields, its fluffy feathers release a soothing aura. It appears to do this deliberately, spreading smiles to anyone nearby.

entry: 三颗头像手足般相爱，用触须缠彼此脖子，表示亲昵。它们爱跳舞，尽管配合不太好。
author: mistymagius
source: The three heads love each other as if they were siblings and wrap their feelers around each other's necks to show their affection. They love to dance, even though their coordination is not that great.

entry: POKENAME救起海难水手，带回冰山巢。舒缓气息让他们温顺不动，寒冷却慢慢将其吞没。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rescues shipwrecked sailors and carries them to its iceberg den. Its calming aura keeps them docile as the cold slowly overtakes them.

entry: POKENAME似乎会被性别认同像自己身体一样流动的训练家吸引。这些训练家常说，它在身边时，自己更有自信。
author: hophoppip
source: It seems to be drawn to Trainers whose gender identities are as fluid as POKENAME's body. Those Trainers often claim that POKENAME's presence increases their confidence.

entry: POKENAME虽由剧毒物质构成，也以此为食，却不断散出无害舒缓香。它乐于让他者享受气味，但保持安全距离，免得让对方生病。
author: sk372
source: Despite being made of and subsisting on highly toxic material, POKENAME constantly emits a harmless, soothing scent around it. It's happy to let others enjoy its aroma, but keeps a safe distance to avoid causing others to get sick.

entry: POKENAME静伏海床，融入周围岩石。天敌擦过敏感触须，就会猛烈合壳。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME stays still on the ocean floor, blending in with rocks surrounding it. When a predator grazes its sensitive feelers, it violently clamps shut.

entry: POKENAME尖刺虽锐利疼痛，却直接向受害者注入平静舒缓感。这样即使风急浪高，也能轻易捉住逃跑猎物。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's spikes, while very sharp and painful, inject calm and soothing feelings directly into the victim. This tranquilization allows it to easily capture escaping prey even inside of rough waves and storms.

entry: POKENAME除了飘浮的头部与淡淡幽雾，并无身体，大量缎带将此掩住。它盘踞住家，保持无实体状态，悄悄轻拂住户，以缎带力量减压。
author: sk372
source: A multitude of ribbons hides POKENAME's lack of a body beyond the floating head and a faint ghostly mist. It haunts people's homes, staying incorporeal to silently brush against the residents and reduce their stress with its ribbons' powers.

entry: POKENAME闯入恶意幽灵宝可梦盘踞的地方，跟在受害者后，用手与缎带平息恐惧。其他幽灵因吓人被破坏而气鼓鼓，它却乐得发笑。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME invades locations haunted by malevolent Ghost Pokémon, trailing behind their victims to soothe their terror with the touch of its hands and ribbons. POKENAME enjoys a nice laugh as the other ghosts pout due to it thwarting their haunting.

entry: POKENAME飘在墓旁，看人哀悼。若发现谁深陷绝望，眼便泛淡青绿光，身体释放舒缓气息安慰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME floats near gravesites, watching grieving humans. Should it notice someone in the depths of despair, its eyes glow celadon and a calming aura exudes from its body to soothe them.

entry: POKENAME友善得过于黏人，以许多缎带缠住他者，强行安抚，拉近拥抱很久。
author: sk372
source: Overly friendly to the point of being clingy, POKENAME uses its many ribbons to wrap around other creatures, forcibly soothing them and pulling them close for lengthy amounts of cuddling time.

entry: POKENAME能用精神力向人显示幻景，最爱展示对方梦想拥有的身体，尤其当那是异性身体时。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME can use its psychic powers to display visions to humans. Its preferred use of this power is showing people the bodies they dream of having, especially if those bodies are of the opposite gender.

entry: POKENAME给受催眠者编织爱与安慰的梦，让孤独宝可梦抱有希望，能找到相爱的训练家，一起成长变强。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME wrap dreams of love and comfort around those they hypnotize. Their dreams give hope to lonely Pokémon that they may find a loving Trainer to grow strong with together.

entry: POKENAME为受催眠者织出温馨家庭与快乐朋友的梦，让孤独宝可梦相信，终有一天能找到归处。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME spin dreams of loving families and cheerful friends for those they hypnotize. These dreams give hope to lonely Pokémon that they may someday find a place they belong.

entry: POKENAME用爱心吊坠催眠，哄人深睡，将噩梦换成美梦，让人安眠。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hypnotize people with their heart pendant to lull people into a deep sleep. They replace nightmares with happy dreams so people can sleep soundly.

entry: POKENAME对负面情绪极其敏感，稍有一丝，就会泪眼汪汪。它朝情绪的源头伸钳夹去，若夹住足够久，受夹者就会感到平静。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is extremely sensitive to negative emotions, growing teary-eyed at a hint of negativity. It snaps its claws at the source of the emotions, the pinch of which causes a sense of calm in the victim should POKENAME hold them long enough.

entry: POKENAME巨钳握力几乎无双，抓住吵闹宝可梦，直到缎带强迫其平静、乖顺，才肯松开。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's grip strength with its oversized claw is almost unparalleled. It snaps up rowdy Pokémon, refusing to let them go until its ribbons have forced them to properly calm down and behave.

entry: POKENAME温柔，只为保护同领地宝可梦而战。背上球茎周围满是荆棘与尖刺，带极强毒素。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a gentle creature that fights only to protect the Pokémon sharing its territory. The bulb on its back is surrounded by thorns and brambles filled with toxins of extreme potency.

entry: POKENAME自负得很，脾气也一样大。稍觉受轻慢，就暴怒，以巨大威力爆炸，展示实力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has an attitude as large as its ego. If it feels like even the tiniest bit slighted, it will be extremely incensed, and explode with tremendous force as a show of power.

entry: 为了身体强健，它们将猎物连骨头也全吃下。长角强得能干脆刺穿岩石。
author: infinex21
source: To keep their bodies strong, they eat everything, including the bones, of their prey. Their long horns are strong enough to cleanly puncture rocks.

entry: POKENAME肌肉极强，尾巴能压碎汽车。第二副头骨硬过钻石，长角则能干脆穿透实心钢块。
author: infinex21
source: Despite their size, POKENAME are incredibly muscular and could crush cars with their tails. Their second skulls are harder than diamond and their long horns can cleanly puncture a solid block of steel.

entry: POKENAME鲁莽冲撞领地入侵者，鲜有对象能承受正面一击。巡护员使用追踪系统，密切监控已知野生个体的位置。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME recklessly charges intruders to its domain, although few can endure a direct impact from it. Pokémon Rangers keep close tracking systems on the locations of known wild POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME钻角连最强悍钢属性宝可梦的坚甲也能撕碎。宝可梦好莱坞有个电影系列，讲述班基拉斯与它结成矛盾重重的同盟，据说灵感来自白银山的领地互动。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's drill can shred even the strongest armor of the hardiest Steel-type Pokémon. A Pokéstar Studios film series about a Tyranitar forming a contentious alliance with a POKENAME is said to be inspired by territorial interactions on Mt. Silver.

entry: POKENAME危急时，能将角毒变成强效抗毒剂，注入遇见的患病宝可梦体内。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can alter the venom in its horn into a powerful antivenom in dire situations. It uses this to inject Pokémon it encounters that are suffering from illness.

entry: POKENAME偶尔担任紧急救援伙伴。角能探无线电、回应呼叫，赶赴现场时，水晶核心会亮闪。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME are occasionally seen as partner Pokémon in emergency services. Their horns allow them to detect radio waves and respond to calls. As they race to the scene, their crystal core flashes brightly.

entry: POKENAME虽没尾巴，假装用力甩尾，也能击倒背后树木。若做投射动作，经过所瞄区域的对象就可能中毒。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME doesn't have a tail, it can topple trees behind it by miming powerful swings. If it gestures as if tossing a projectile, anyone who passes through the area it aims for may be poisoned.

entry: POKENAME冲锋能撞倒整座建筑。一开始就难转向，得用沉重尾巴作舵与配重。
author: wiz0z
source: A charging POKENAME is capable of knocking down entire buildings. Once it begins charging, POKENAME struggles to change directions, having to use its heavy tail as a rudder and counterbalance.

entry: POKENAME外貌怪兽般可怕，其实温和胆怯。厚鳞保护它抵御攻击。
author: mepp.
source: Despite a monstrous appearance, POKENAME is actually quite gentle and meek. Its thick scales protect it from attacks.

entry: POKENAME剧毒又好斗，用角横行森林家园。遇到什么就刺什么，还常抢小型虫属性宝可梦食物。
author: sk372
source: Highly venomous and equally aggressive, POKENAME uses its horn to throw its weight around the forests it calls home. It stabs with its horn at anything it comes across, and regularly steals food from smaller Bug types.

entry: 野生POKENAME通常在雪山，能沿坡滑行，迅速移动。它对滑雪者极凶，常用毒角与毒刺使人或其宝可梦中毒。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME are usually found on snowy mountains and can move quickly by sliding down the slopes. They are highly aggressive towards skiers, and often poison them or their Pokémon with their venomous horn and toxic spikes.

entry: POKENAME住在寒冷气候，背载人和宝可梦，穿过深雪。乘客得格外小心，别被锋利毒刺划伤。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME lives in cold climates and will carry people and Pokémon on its back across deep snowdrifts. Passengers must be very careful not to scratch themselves on its sharp and poisonous spines.

entry: POKENAME入水，似乎会融化其中，自己无伤，附近一切却会受强毒影响，让周围水域完全无法栖居。
author: .jerden
source: When POKENAME immerses itself in the water, it seems to melt into it. While POKENAME will be unharmed by this, anything nearby will be exposed to its potent toxins, making the water around it completely uninhabitable.

entry: POKENAME暴走常被自己制造的碎石埋住，但毛一竖，就能弹飞杂物脱困。角毒使人接连数天感到不停遭静电电击。
author: soup1900
source: In its rampages, POKENAME often finds itself buried in the rubble it creates, but by bristling out its fur, it can send the debris flying and escape the predicament. The poison from its horn causes people to feel constant static shocks for days.

entry: POKENAME能从三根毒角任意一根，或全部一齐射电。储电太多时，用尾接地，再排出多余电力。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME channel and fire electrical bolts from either or all of their three venomous horns. They ground themselves using their tails if they ever accumulate too much electricity, and then discharge the excess.

entry: 三根毒角注入强麻痹毒，几分钟就能让成年人整条手臂麻木。积聚强静电时，满身尖毛会竖起。
author: infinex21
source: Its three venomous horns deliver a potent, paralytic venom that can numb an entire adult human's arm within minutes of affliction. Its spiky fur stands on end when it has accumulated a strong static charge.

entry: POKENAME把角插进接口，几乎瞬间就能清除损坏文件。过程中若被轻轻抚摸，效率更高。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME inserts its horn into a port to purge corrupted files almost instantly. It works more efficiently when gently petted during the process.

entry: POKENAME什么食物都吃，腐烂发霉也不例外。毒汗被认为是副产物，正被研究是否有医疗用途。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME eat any food, even if it has grown rotten or moldy. Their poisonous sweat is believed to be a byproduct of this and is being studied for any medical applications.

entry: POKENAME毒角也能当避雷针，飞进雷云中央，吸电强化身体。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME's venomous horn doubles as a lightning rod. By flying into the center of thunderclouds, it can absorb their electricity, which strengthens its body.

entry: 某些古迹壁画描绘POKENAME守护祭祀龙神的庙宇。力量与沉稳性情，似乎正适合长久站岗，守到不再需要。
author: sk372
source: Some ancient ruins depict murals of POKENAME acting as guardians to temples built in worship of draconic deities. Their strength and stoic nature seem perfectly apt to stand guard for as long as they are needed.

entry: POKENAME性情不稳，会用手将敌人按住，再以钻头般的毒刺注入强毒。它很容易暴怒，训练家培育时需小心。
author: daniel360n
source: POKENAME is a volatile Pokémon that will pin its foe down with its hands before using its drill stingers to inject powerful toxins. Trainers are advised to be careful when raising POKENAME as it can easily get enraged.

entry: POKENAME破坏性极强，常毁掉成片森林，寻找值得一战的对手。只有它认为足够能干的人，才配指挥。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are highly destructive Pokémon, often destroying sections of forests in order to find opponents they view as worthy. POKENAME only obey Trainers that they deem competent enough to command them.

entry: POKENAME个头虽小，攻击却狠得惊人。尾巴尤其危险，既能碎骨、打穿金属梁，尖刺还分泌使受害者DNA解体的致命毒。
author: imaginita
source: Despite its small size, POKENAME's attacks are wickedly strong. Its tail is especially dangerous, as it is strong enough to break bones and smash through metal beams, and the spines secrete a deadly toxin that unravels the victim's DNA.

entry: POKENAME花香能降低攻击性，却对自己无效。起初令人放松，闻久了却会极不舒服。
author: .jerden
source: The scent of POKENAME's flower reduces aggression, although it has no effect on POKENAME. While relaxing at first, prolonged exposure to the fragrance makes people feel very unwell.

entry: POKENAME进攻前，会尽可能鼓起胸膛，威吓对手认输。若不奏效，它们便把角朝前，飞扑向敌人，试图以毒取胜。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME puff up their chest as large as they can before they attack, trying to intimidate their opponents into giving up. If the display fails, they will fly horn-first at their foes, trying to inflict their poison to win the fight.

entry: POKENAME身躯细长，能熟练穿过深洞窄缝。没有通路，就用强臂打穿洞壁。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its thin body allows POKENAME to weave through narrow cracks and crevices in deep caves expertly. When an opening isn't available, it uses its powerful arms to bust through cave walls.

entry: POKENAME虽小，却能是凶猛的夜行猎手。无声飞行与速效毒，让大意猎物很快被解决。幸好胃口也小，能造成的生态破坏有限。
author: corra_universe
source: Despite their small size, POKENAME can be a vicious nocturnal predator. Their silent flights and fast-acting toxins make quick work of any unwary prey. Fortunately, they also have small appetites, limiting their potential for ecological mayhem.

entry: POKENAME无法用回声定位，只能靠翼状的大耳倾听风声，辨别前进方向。这虽很管用，却也让它对其他声音过度敏感。
author: patch
source: POKENAME lacks the ability to use echolocation, so it uses its wing-like ears to listen to the wind in order to get around. While helpful, this makes it hyper-sensitive to other sounds.

entry: POKENAME群会凶猛驱赶对手，争夺上好的筑巢地。它在城市成了麻烦，连只是上班的职员也会骚扰。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME flocks will aggressively chase away rival flocks from prime nesting sites. They have become a problem Pokémon for urban environments and are known to harass office workers simply trying to go to work.

entry: POKENAME能像发镖一样射出翼羽。羽毛覆强毒，连最大宝可梦也能放倒。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME have the ability to shoot feathers from their wings as if they are darts. Their feathers are coated with strong venom that can take down even the largest of Pokémon.

entry: 长寿POKENAME谦逊、聪慧、慷慨，坚甲与力量令人敬畏，却通常宁愿和平，不起冲突，是附近幼年宝可梦的榜样。
author: chinigan
source: POKENAME that have lived long lives are humble, wise, and generous. Their armor is tough and their strength is awe-inspiring, though they typically offer peace over conflict. They serve as role models to nearby young Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME翱翔天空，留意体形相近的鸟类宝可梦。它们用尾巴扫打、用喙啄击，试图驱逐同一片天空中的其他宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME soar through the skies, keeping an eye out for similarly sized bird Pokémon. They will try to bully out any Pokémon that are in the same skies as them, swiping at them with their tail and pecking at them.

entry: POKENAME与其他拾荒者争垃圾，几乎总赢。个头虽小，尾力却强，扫中头一下就能击倒更大敌人。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME will fight other scavengers over trash, almost always coming out on top. Despite their size, their tails are quite powerful, able to knock out larger opponents with a single swing to the head.

entry: POKENAME从环境土壤吸毒素，融进皮肤与叶片。它脾气差，凶猛守领地，愤怒时皮肤会渗毒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME absorb toxins from the soil in their environment, incorporating those toxins into their skin and leaves. They are ill-tempered Pokémon and aggressively defend their territory, their poisons seeping from their skin when angry.

entry: POKENAME牙齿长得极快，驯养也必须有东西啃，防止牙过长伤身。野外最爱外皮结实耐嚼的水果。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's teeth grow at an incredible rate, so even when domesticated, POKENAME must be able to chew on something to prevent injury from oversized teeth. In the wild, fruits with firm and chewy outer peels are their favorite.

entry: POKENAME能从全身每个孔洞射出毒镖。激动时射得飞快，肉眼根本看不清。
author: lemmymaster
source: POKENAME can fire poison-tipped darts from every hole in its body. When agitated, it fires these darts faster than the naked eye can comprehend.

entry: POKENAME生活在活火山的破火山口内，互相争抢最温暖的位置。它们激动时，释放的烟气有毒，因此务必避免吸入。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live within the calderas of active volcanoes, competing with one another for the warmest spots. The fumes they release when they are riled up are noxious, and it is advised to avoid breathing them in at all costs.

entry: POKENAME壳由多孔岩石构成，定期排出体内积聚的毒气。受威胁就缩壳，靠毒刺抵御伤害。
author: katieplaysgames
source: The rocks that form POKENAME shells are very porous and regularly emit toxic gases that build up within their body. When threatened, they retreat within their shell and rely on their venomous spines to ward off harm.

entry: POKENAME遇见同类，毛会变硬竖起。它们摆架势、踢雪，试图吓退对手，双方都不退才真正开打。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME fur stiffens and bristles when they run into another one of their species. They posture and kick up snow to try and scare off their rival, only coming to blows if neither POKENAME backs down.

entry: POKENAME定期交锋，争夺首领之位，通常顶角相斗，直到有角稍微崩裂。自卫时，嘴能喷灼热腐蚀物。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME regularly clash to determine who the leader of the pack shall be, typically locking horns until one breaks even a little. To defend themselves, they can spew a burning, corrosive substance from their mouth.

entry: 头上的尖角能钻穿最厚的甲壳，注入毒液。POKENAME游近猎物，出手刺击，再退开，耐心等待猎物被毒素制服。
author: .jerden
source: The sharp horn on its head can drill through even the thickest shells to deliver poison. After swimming close enough to strike its prey, POKENAME will back off and patiently wait for it to succumb to the toxin.

entry: POKENAME力气足以撞倒树木，再用倒木划领地、用长牙留标记，定期检查是否有其他同类也来留痕。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are strong enough to topple trees by ramming into them. They use these fallen trees to mark out the boundaries of their territory, marking them with their tusks and periodically checking if any other POKENAME have done the same.

entry: POKENAME的长牙中空，刺破皮肤，便能注入烈性毒液。它们紧紧蜷起，滚过敌人身边，试图用牙尖划伤对方，使其中毒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME tusks are hollow and can deliver a nasty venom when they puncture skin. POKENAME will roll into a tight curl and aim to scratch their foes with the tip of their tusks as they roll by to inflict this poison on them.

entry: 背后的尾巴增强了旋转时的破坏力。只要不断旋转，甚至能将整条街道摧毁。
author: soup1900
source: The tail on its back adds to the destructive force of its spin. As long as it's spinning, it can even destroy entire streets.

entry: POKENAME身体强大，十分适合战斗，野外却不常交锋。通常突然使出大蛇瞪眼，麻痹猎物，再整个吞下。
author: bobosmith01
source: Despite its powerful body that is well suited for combat, wild POKENAME do not fight very often. Instead, POKENAME typically paralyze prey with a sudden Glare and then devour them whole.

entry: POKENAME虽不灵便，却极好斗，等完全进化时也不肯躲。它从高处跃下突袭入侵者，将其压倒，或以尖刺毒伤。
author: sk372
source: Despite POKENAME's low mobility, it is highly aggressive and refuses to hide itself while awaiting full evolution. It leaps from high terrain to divebomb intruders and either crushes them or poisons them with its spines.

entry: 多年前，曾有野生POKENAME夜间暴走，将许多村庄从地图抹去。野外遇见，训练家必须格外谨慎。
author: cobalt0135
source: A wild POKENAME has once wiped out many villages off the map in the middle of the night many years ago when it went on a rampage. Any Trainer that spots one in the wild must proceed with extreme caution.

entry: 野生POKENAME力量大，性情也凶，常占大片领地，严防对手。据说利喙与爪硬得能切钻石。
author: theunholyhandgrenade
source: As aggressive as it is strong, wild POKENAME will often form large territories that they jealously guard from rivals. Its sharp beak and talons are said to be hard enough to cut through diamond.

entry: POKENAME以跳跃移动，每跳都震地，附近宝可梦畏惧其威力，纷纷逃跑。它只吃植物。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME move through hopping. Each hop causes the ground to shake, making other nearby Pokémon flee in fear of its might. They only eat flora.

entry: POKENAME用抓握尾巴比用手多，尤其拿食物、进食时。角毒极强，有人认为与它毫不顾忌吃腐食有关。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their prehensile tails more than they use their arms, especially for securing and eating food. Their horns are incredibly venomous, which some believe is due to how these Pokémon freely devour rotten food.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴能抓握，够得到的可食之物，都会抓来。它们食欲无穷，见食物就大吃，还会彼此争斗，抢先开饭。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME tails are prehensile and are used to grab onto anything edible that is within reach. They are insatiable Pokémon and will gorge themselves on any food available, fighting one another to be the first to get to a meal.

entry: 铠甲增厚，让POKENAME双臂伸展与活动都受限，主要改用破坏力强的尾巴战斗。山中需要下坡时，就靠皮甲保护滚下。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME primarily fights with its destructively strong tail since its arms have lost some of their reach and mobility with its increased armor. When it needs to descend in its mountainous habitat, it rolls while protected by its hide.

entry: 尾巴极强，能击倒大型输电塔，再将塔中电力存入尾，向下一敌人放最多20,000伏电击。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Its tail is incredibly strong, capable of toppling large transmission towers. It will then store the energy from those towers in its tail, ready to release up to 20,000 volts onto its next foe.

entry: 大尾巴虽累赘，却很强。爪能切进金属，既不崩口，也不变钝。
author: infinex21
source: Its large tail is cumbersome, yet very strong. Its claws are tough enough to cut into metal without chipping or dulling.

entry: POKENAME力大，体形与铠甲也适应冰原，被用于拖重型设备。但毒刺危险，须小心别不慎中毒。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are strong enough to be used to haul heavy equipment across ice fields, their bulk and armour making them well-suited to the environment. Their venomous spines mean care needs to be taken to avoid accidentally being poisoned.

entry: POKENAME以强角打破网络空间的数字屏障，让任何对象都能自由穿梭现实与数字世界。尾巴与身体不相连，即使被收服，仍能大肆破坏。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its powerful horn to break apart the digital barriers of cyberspace, allowing anyone to freely travel between the physical and digital worlds. Since its tail and body aren't connected, it can still cause destruction even when captured.

entry: POKENAME以强角打破网络空间的数字屏障，让任何对象都能自由穿梭现实与数字世界。几乎任何事都能令它暴走，哪怕别人是好意。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its powerful horn to break apart the digital barriers of cyberspace, allowing anyone to freely travel between the physical and digital worlds. Mostly anything can trigger it to rampage, even when it was something nice done to it.

entry: POKENAME的孩子仰慕它，视作强大又能养家的保护者。结实身体蕴含巨力，能毁大石墙、跃过高楼。暴怒时，四肢黄毛会燃起。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME's offspring admire it as a powerful protector and provider. This Pokémon's sturdy body has tremendous power that allows it to destroy large stone walls and leap over towering buildings. When enraged, the yellow hairs on its limbs ignite.

entry: POKENAME臂刃与角都剧毒。训练家让它打得不够多，就容易突然发怒。
author: nugamallow
source: The blades on POKENAME's arms and its horn are highly poisonous. It's prone to bursts of anger if its Trainer doesn't make it fight enough.

entry: 角硬过钻石，比爪更强。鲜艳尖刺分泌微量致痛毒，因此蜷球自卫时，多数对象不敢攻。
author: infinex21
source: Its horn is harder than diamond, making it much stronger than its claws. Its vibrant quills secrete trace amounts of pain-inducing venom, so most dare not attack when they curl into a ball to defend themselves.

entry: POKENAME任性好斗，硬闯尼多兰群，强迫服从。但面对更强宝可梦，这份强硬威风就会崩塌。
author: sk372
source: Full of wanton aggression, POKENAME inserts itself into female Nidoran colonies and forces them to submit to its command. Its forceful bravado crumbles in the face of a stronger Pokémon, however.

entry: 有些尼多一族群携带POKENAME楔石求保护。它现身后凶猛驱赶天敌，但想继续获服务，就得进贡食物。
author: sk372
source: Some Nidoran colonies carry POKENAME's keystone as protection. It aggressively fends off any predators when it manifests, but demands the Nidoran give it food as tribute if they want its continued services.

entry: POKENAME用敏锐感官预判来袭，迅速精准反击。即使突破防守，敌人仍会遇上嵌满毒刺的坚韧皮甲。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME uses its sharp senses to anticipate incoming attacks and counter them with swift and precise strikes. Any attack that does slip through its guard is met by a remarkably tough hide studded with poisonous spikes.

entry: POKENAME用敏锐感官预判来袭，迅速精准反击。即使突破防守，敌人仍会遇上嵌满毒刺的坚韧皮甲。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME uses its sharp senses to anticipate incoming attacks and counter them with swift and precise strikes. Any attack that does slip through its guard is met by a remarkably tough hide studded with poisonous spikes.

entry: POKENAME以带刺藤蔓大力鞭打。毒刺划伤一下，就能凭剧痛毒击败大得多的宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME battle using thorny vines, whipping them around with great force. The thorns carry a painful toxin meaning that even a scratch from the vines allows them to win fights against much larger Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME藤刺含强毒，靠背上玫瑰聚集能量，谁动一片花瓣，就会胡乱挥藤暴走，直到打击或毒放倒敌人。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The thorns along a POKENAME's vines contain powerful poison. POKENAME gathers energy from the rose on its back, so if anyone disturbs even a single petal, it will swing its vines in a wild rampage until either the impact or poison downs its foe.

entry: POKENAME体内皮质醇越高，毒越猛烈，因此战斗拖越久，毒素越危险。它极好斗，会搜寻领地内的任何入侵者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME poison grows more virulent and aggressive the higher the levels of cortisol is in their body, this makes their toxins more dangerous the longer a battle goes on. They are highly combative and will seek out any intruder in their territory.

entry: POKENAME体内皮质醇越高，毒越猛烈，因此战斗拖越久，毒素越危险。它极好斗，会搜寻领地内的任何入侵者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME poison grows more virulent and aggressive the higher the levels of cortisol is in their body, this makes their toxins more dangerous the longer a battle goes on. They are highly combative and will seek out any intruder in their territory.

entry: POKENAME体内皮质醇越高，毒越猛烈，因此战斗拖越久，毒素越危险。它极好斗，会搜寻领地内的任何入侵者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME poison grows more virulent and aggressive the higher the levels of cortisol is in their body, this makes their toxins more dangerous the longer a battle goes on. They are highly combative and will seek out any intruder in their territory.

entry: POKENAME角渗出的毒用来标领地。谁太靠近，就会使出大闹一番，以狂乱失控的力量守土。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's horn oozes a toxin that it uses to mark its territory. If someone gets too close, it will Thrash, attacking with wild, uncontrollable force to protect its domain.

entry: POKENAME角毒强弱是求偶关键。雄性相互接触毒液比试，雌性选择毒性最强者。
author: slimmagma
source: The potency of POKENAME's horn poison plays a key role in its mating rituals. Males compare poisons by exposure, and females select the one whose venom proves most potent.

entry: POKENAME强大好斗，鲜有宝可梦敢闯深海窝。只靠尾击，就能把沉重油轮送上天。
author: sk372
source: Few Pokémon dare to tread in the deep-sea den of POKENAME due to its strength and aggression. Its tail alone can strike with enough force to send a heavy tanker ship airborne.

entry: POKENAME尾上锤头由钢铁般的釉质构成。它极敏捷，战时以双手为轴，飞快旋转挥尾。
author: distinguishedmanlygentleman
source: The mace on POKENAME's tail is made from a steel-like enamel. POKENAME is incredibly agile, pivoting on its hands in combat to swing its tail at incredible speeds.

entry: POKENAME以极凶的性情闻名，凡入领地都挑战，用角与拳连续刺击，痛打敌人。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is known for its extremely hostile disposition, challenging anything that enters its territory. It pummels foes with a flurry of jabs from its horn and fists.

entry: POKENAME以家庭结群，在领地边界一站数天，静守如雕像。只有突然攻击擅闯者时，伪装才会破。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME stand motionless along the boundaries of their territory in family groups, lining the bounds for days on end. They are easily mistaken for statues when they stand guard, the façade only dropping when they abruptly attack trespassers.

entry: POKENAME联合同伴，试图推翻共同领地的尼多王，掀起长期纷争。它极其好斗，接近须万分谨慎。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME joins forces with its companions to try to overthrow the Nidoking ruling their shared territory, sparking feuds that can last a long time. It is an extremely aggressive Pokémon that should be approached with the utmost caution.

entry: POKENAME倾向听从强者指挥，因此很适合精英训练家培养。输了，它们会闷闷不乐，催训练家与打败自己的那只宝可梦重赛，争取赢回来。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are suited to being trained by Ace Trainers thanks to their propensity to follow direction from those who are stronger. If they lose a fight, they grow sullen, encouraging their Trainer to rematch the Pokémon they lost to so they can win.

entry: POKENAME的骨骼由极耐用的金属构成。它们常召集弱小宝可梦，命其突袭城镇，抢夺食物。
author: vaporvenator
source: The skeleton of POKENAME is composed of a highly durable metal. They often rally up lesser Pokémon and command them to raid towns for food.

entry: POKENAME脾气极急，却也极忠诚，为保护训练家，连最强敌人也敢面对。曾有人见它的斧将整座无线电塔劈成两半。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME are incredibly hot-headed, but also incredibly loyal, willing to stand up to even the strongest of opponents to protect their Trainer. Their axe has been observed to cut an entire radio tower in half.

entry: POKENAME斗志强盛，据说决心顽强，一心取胜。斧上散出的气息，让它能伴着喘息笑声，发动凶猛攻击。
author: kam_doodle_snek
source: POKENAME exudes a powerful fighting spirit; they say it has a fierce determination to achieve victory in battles. Aura emanates from the axe it wields, allowing POKENAME to launch ferocious attacks accompanied by breathy laughter.

entry: POKENAME狡猾骄傲，有信心打倒的，什么都猎。长鬃黑斑是强毒，伏击前会用爪仔细梳过。
author: pkbonusducks
source: Crafty and prideful, POKENAME will hunt anything they're confident they can take down. The dark spots on their long mane are potent toxins, which POKENAME thoroughly runs their claws through before ambushing prey.

entry: 岩石般的厚皮保护着它，让它能抵御威胁、守住地洞。对训练家，则像待自己的孩子一样。
author: melodydelune
source: Its rock-hard hide helps protect it as it defends its burrows from threats. It is known to treat its Trainers as if they were its children.

entry: POKENAME肌肉厚实，力量巨大，能扯断金属结构。铠甲般的几丁质极耐久，很难被夺走领地顶级猎手之位。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have bodies of thick muscle that afford them immense strength, capable of snapping metal structures. The armor-like chitin of their bodies is extremely durable, making them difficult to dethrone as apex predators of their territory.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴，是威力惊人的穿刺钻。据说，头上与背上的尖刺之所以如此坚韧，全凭它纯粹的斗志与骄傲。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME uses its tail as an immensely powerful piercing drill. It's said that the intense durability of the spikes on its head and its back is due to POKENAME's sheer battle spirit and pride.

entry: POKENAME用尾炮发射致命毒，毒素已进化到已知抗毒剂也对付不了。覆盖尾部的金属甲片，又增强了力量与破坏性。
author: soup1900
source: Using the cannon on its tail, POKENAME blasts deadly poison that has evolved to become immune to known antivenoms. Its tail has been made even more powerful and destructive thanks to the metallic platings that cover it.

entry: 满月下，POKENAME聚来跳舞。若被打扰，就以满毒角冲撞，再使出强力月亮之力。成功拍下的聚会只有几次。
author: chibitales
source: During full moons, POKENAME gather to dance under the light. If disturbed, they rush the intruder with poison-filled horns and strong Moonblast attacks. Only a few gatherings of POKENAME have been successfully recorded.

entry: 强壮身体与敏锐听力，让POKENAME能为族群侦察。虽有力量，却尽量避开群体战，也许知道自己生理上天生易服从雌性宝可梦。
author: bobosmith01
source: A brawny body and a keen sense of hearing allow POKENAME to act as a scout for a colony of Pokémon. Despite its power, it tries to avoid group combat, as it may understand that it is biologically predisposed to be submissive to female Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME与一些谜拟丘融合体住在托儿所，给孩子安慰与欢乐。它爱在想象游戏中扮坏人，被孩子“打败”就会笑。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME live at daycares along with some Mimikyu fusions, providing comfort and joy to children. POKENAME enjoy pretending to be villains in make-believe games and will laugh when children "defeat" them.

entry: 月之石力量让POKENAME完全夜行。它极稀少，听力与跳跃力惊人，全身还有数百根微小毒刺。
author: bobosmith01
source: The power of Moon Stones has made POKENAME completely nocturnal. They are extremely rare, possess incredible hearing and jumping ability, and have hundreds of microscopic poisonous spines across their bodies.

entry: 斧状长牙覆强毒，连某些钢属性和毒属性宝可梦也受影响。毒和牙若都赢不了，还能靠强尾。
author: infinex21
source: Its axe-like tusks are slick with a potent toxin that can even affect some Steel-type and Poison-type Pokémon. If neither its toxins nor its tusks can best a foe, it can rely on its powerful tail.

entry: POKENAME是可怕空中猎手，以强毒重创猎物，再作最后攻击。其他飞行宝可梦也畏惧，一见起飞就逃回窝。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a terrifying sky predator that uses its powerful venom to annihilate its prey before finishing them off. Even other Flying Pokémon are terrified of it, retreating to their nests as soon as they see it take flight.

entry: POKENAME是可怕空中猎手，以爪中强毒重创猎物，再作最后攻击。其他飞行宝可梦也畏惧，一见起飞就逃回窝。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME is a terrifying sky predator that uses the potent venom in its claws to annihilate its prey before finishing them off. Even other Flying Pokémon are terrified of it, retreating to their nests as soon as they see it take flight.

entry: 晴朗明亮的日子，POKENAME俯冲田野，以鲜艳配色扰乱猎物。目标晕眩后，再用喷射火焰彻底烤熟。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: On bright sunny days, POKENAME swoop down into fields, disorienting their prey with their bright colors. With them dazed, POKENAME uses Flamethrower to thoroughly cook their prey.

entry: POKENAME伸展、扇动双翼，会撒下易燃毒鳞，肢体相撞生火花，便能点燃。尾巴强得能支撑平衡，战时也毫不摇晃。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME scatter flammable, toxic scales from their wings when they flex and flap them. By clashing its limbs together, it can create sparks to ignite its scales. Its tail is strong enough for it to balance upon without faltering, even during battle.

entry: POKENAME生气或受威胁就鲁莽冲锋，暴走后在碎石里停下睡。不建议经验不足的训练家培育。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME charges recklessly whenever it becomes angry or threatened. It stops to sleep in the debris of its rampage. This Pokémon is not advised for inexperienced Trainers.

entry: POKENAME两颗头战术不同，一颗爱攻，一颗爱守。若能停止争吵、相互配合，战斗便十分危险。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's two heads each have different battle tactics, one preferring offense and the other preferring defense. If the two heads stop arguing to coordinate, it is dangerous in battle.

entry: 研究者认为，POKENAME领地意识强，是进化前看不见、常受袭的缘故。它用翼突袭，合拢翼膜，以毒刺击打。
author: pjporwoll
source: Researchers believe POKENAME's territorial nature is due to it being attacked often when it did not have sight at previous stages. It uses its wings to conduct surprise attacks, closing the membranes and striking with the venomous spikes.

entry: 它在挖空的小行星筑巢。这些小行星若进入大气层，POKENAME就会连续暴走34天。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It makes nests in asteroids it has hollowed out. If these asteroids enter the atmosphere, POKENAME rampages for 34 days straight.

entry: POKENAME为族群守夜，成员是尼多一族与胖丁的融合体，以及它们的近亲。远处发现潜在天敌，就快速敲脚踏地。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME act as the night watch for a colony of Nidoran and Jigglypuff fusions, as well as their relatives. If it spots a potential predator from a distance, it will rapidly tap its foot onto the ground.

entry: POKENAME能产足以溶解金属无线电塔的酸。毒虽强，大量水却容易稀释，使其完全无害。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME can produce acid that is corrosive enough to dissolve a metal radio tower. Even though their poisons are potent, they can easily be diluted by substantial amounts of water, rendering them completely harmless.

entry: 别群的合唱比自群和谐，就容易吸引雄性POKENAME转投。它们给雌性当护卫，也为尼多丁担任指挥。
author: bobosmith01
source: Male POKENAME are easily wooed into joining other colonies by one colony singing in better harmony than their own. They act as bodyguards for female POKENAME and act as conductors for Nidopuff.

entry: 多数雄性尼多卷耳成年时，实际已进化为尼多兔，因此POKENAME这一阶段极罕见。身体有力、个头却小，能拿到族群原本无法取得的其他食物。
author: bobosmith01
source: Most male Nidoeary have actually evolved into Nidopunny as they reach maturity, so this stage of POKENAME is particularly rare. Its powerful body but small size allows it to reach other sources of food the colony could otherwise not procure.

entry: POKENAME在洞内用回声定位找猎物，再以装甲尾攻击，冲力能将对手高速打飞，撞上洞壁。
author: equation8573
source: POKENAME uses echolocation inside of caves to find its prey, then attacks with its armored tail. The resulting impact can send the opposing Pokémon flying into the cave wall at high speeds.

entry: 头骨几乎重得让它承受不了，POKENAME常难以驾驭力量与重量，只好拖着在地面走。
author: crumple_2
source: Its skull is nearly too heavy for it. POKENAME often struggles to wield its power and weight, and can resort to dragging it along the ground.

entry: POKENAME双颚能撕钢梁，尾巴能连根拔树。每天需喝约5品脱血，才能生存。
author: laughing_dan
source: POKENAME's jaws can rip through steel beams, and its tail has the strength to rend a tree from the ground. POKENAME require drinking around 5 pints of blood per day to survive.

entry: POKENAME曾是古代顶级猎手，凡比自己小都吃。直到因天灾灭绝，其他生命才得以再度兴旺。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME was once the apex predator of the ancient world, devouring anything smaller than it. Only after the species went extinct due to natural disasters could any other lifeforms begin to thrive again.

entry: POKENAME角上毒一碰空气就迅速冻结。它甩向猎物，将其冻在原地，方便捕捉。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's horn oozes a poison that freezes quickly upon contact with the air. It flings this poison at prey, freezing them in place and making them easy to capture.

entry: POKENAME游走城市街道，不断找垃圾吃，最小碎屑也不放过。占了垃圾场，就会严防任何试图夺走的挑战者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME roam city streets in a constant search for trash to consume, eating even the smallest morsels. POKENAME that have claimed city dumps as their homes jealously guard it and will fight any challenger trying to wrest it from them.

entry: POKENAME以惊人速度冲出，用长毒角刺穿、撞击敌人。沿途一切都贪婪吃下，强牙连岩石、船体、锚和碎片也能碾碎。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME hurls itself at incredible speed to impale and ram its enemies with the long, venomous horn on its head. It voraciously devours anything in its path, crushing even stones, hulls, anchors, and debris with its powerful fangs.

entry: POKENAME在暗洞安家，以扎根嵌入石壁。大嘴蝠太靠近，就以致命精准的毒击防守。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME makes its home in dark caves, where it Ingrains into the stone walls. It uses Poison Jab to attack any Golbat that gets too close, defending its cave with lethal precision.

entry: POKENAME发出人耳听不见的尖叫，聆听回声，用来导航、寻找其他宝可梦，再以毒角俯冲攻击。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME scream out infrasonic shrieks that are too high-pitched for the human ear to hear. They use these shrieks to navigate and locate other Pokémon, listening for echoes and then diving at Pokémon with their venomous horns.

entry: POKENAME耳朵发高音，扰乱敌人方向，再趁混乱以毒角刺击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME emits a high-pitched noise from its ears to disorient its foes. It then stabs with its venomous horn, using the confusion to its advantage during attacks.

entry: POKENAME边飞边吐毒雾，留下使猎物方向混乱的毒云，创造危险环境，削弱敢靠近的对象。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME spits a poisonous haze while it flies, leaving behind a toxic cloud that disorients its prey. This ability allows it to create a dangerous environment, weakening anyone who dares to approach.

entry: POKENAME不怜悯认为低于自己的生灵，会痛打至屈服，直到满意。一拳就能粉碎骨头。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME has no empathy for anyone it deems lesser than itself and will beat them into submission until it is satisfied. It has enough strength to pulverize bones with a single punch.

entry: POKENAME自视擂台之王，总迫不及待找机会展示巨力。像卡比兽或波士可多拉这样体重很大的对手，也能轻易举起，甚至抱摔。
author: sk372
source: Considering itself a king of the ring, POKENAME is always itching for a change to show its prodigious strength. It can easily lift and even suplex hefty foes like Snorlax or Aggron.

entry: 古代，POKENAME曾是令人生畏的雄性族长，守望幼小与年老成员。谁敢靠近，就会被褶饰吹出的寒风瞬间冻住。
author: sk372
source: In ancient times, POKENAME was the fearsome patriarch of its herd. Staying watch over the young and the elderly, Pokémon foolish enough to approach would be flash-frozen by chilling winds gusted from its frills.

entry: POKENAME个头虽小，却极其危险。为保护训练家，它会彻底陷入狂怒，不断破坏周围的地形，直到消灭所有威胁。
author: celio_0230
source: Despite its small size, POKENAME is incredibly dangerous. It will go into a blind rage to protect its Trainer, destroying the surrounding terrain until every threat is defeated.

entry: POKENAME的爪力足以推倒输电铁塔。它会将鬃毛上的毒涂在爪上，使猎物麻痹。
author: celio_0230
source: POKENAME's claws are strong enough to topple a transmission tower. The poison it applies to its claws from its mane paralyzes its prey.

entry: POKENAME的毒素全都集中在尾巴里。战斗时，它会用尾巴作钝器，接连猛击敌人，不断削弱对方的体力。
author: celio_0230
source: POKENAME's poison is concentrated entirely in its tail. In a fight, it will use the tail as a bludgeoning tool, sapping their foe's strength as it pummels them relentlessly.

entry: POKENAME蘑菇被采来制作防御强化。它用强臂推倒树木，吃树根。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME's mushroom is harvested as an ingredient in the production of X Defense. It uses its powerful arms to topple trees so it can feed on the roots.

entry: POKENAME虽外貌凶险，却只为保护家人战斗，能避冲突就尽力避开。刺与爪分泌强毒，可腐蚀植物与活体组织。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite its menacing appearance, POKENAME fights only to protect its family, avoiding confrontation with every means at its disposal whenever possible. Its spines and claws secrete a powerful venom capable of corroding both plants and living tissue.

entry: 毛中有十种毒孢子，科学家积极研究临床用途。谁入领地，POKENAME就试着用角驱走。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its fur contains ten different types of toxic spores, which scientists eagerly study to find clinical uses for. If anyone enters its territory, POKENAME tries to drive them away by striking them with its horn.

entry: POKENAME能引出月之石潜藏的元素能量，以其中宇宙能量攻防。它善于感知元素石的位置，很受徒步者欢迎。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are able to draw out the latent elemental energies found within Moon Stones, wielding the cosmic power within them as both a weapon and a defence. Their sense of where to find the elemental stones makes them popular companions of hikers.

entry: POKENAME暴走时猛毁建筑与树，把碎石当弹丸攻敌。疾跑极敏捷，长舌胡乱挥动，击倒所有障碍。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME mightily destroys structures and trees as it rampages and uses the rubble remaining as projectiles to attack foes. As it sprints around with utmost agility, it swings its tongue wildly to knock down any obstacle it faces.

entry: POKENAME俯冲，以极硬毒角撞击敌人。它讨厌白昼，黄昏前都藏着。
author: fiordaliso
source: To defeat its enemies, POKENAME dives down to ram them with its very hard, venomous horn. Bothered by daylight, it stays hidden away until dusk arrives.

entry: POKENAME移动虽慢，却不懈逼战，什么都视为挑战。厚皮与强臂，足以撕开试图反对的对象。
author: mistymagius
source: While its movement speed is quite slow, POKENAME is a relentless foe who will take anything as a challenge. Its thick hide and powerful arms allow it to rip apart those that try to oppose it.

entry: POKENAME飘得离地太近，尖刺就常卡树。它视力差，飘行时容易出事故。
author: .izik
source: Due to its spikes, POKENAME frequently gets stuck in trees if floating too close to the ground. It cannot see well, which makes it prone to accidents as it floats through the environment.

entry: POKENAME边飘边吃烟雾，强化毒性。污染空气提供养分，增强毒的本领。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME eats smog while floating through the sky to strengthen its own poison. The polluted air serves as a nutrient source, enhancing its toxic capabilities.

entry: POKENAME燃毒，造出青蓝火焰烧穿敌人。它常发脾气，尤其带上火时，让许多宝可梦不敢靠近。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME burn through foes with their teal-blue flames that are created by burning venom. Many Pokémon are scared of approaching POKENAME because of their frequent tantrums, especially when their flames are involved.

entry: POKENAME吃毒植物根，增强毒素。哪怕角轻扎一下，也能引发猛烈高烧。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME feeds on the roots of poisonous plants to enhance its toxins. Even a single horn prick can cause violent fevers.

entry: POKENAME感知猎物，先猛烈甩尾警告，再高速钻地，以利角刺目标。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME senses prey and whips its tail violently as a warning. It then tunnels at high speed and stabs targets with its sharp horn.

entry: POKENAME善变难测，却总将金色肚子擦得闪亮。傍晚最活跃，似乎也擅长追寻月之石。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although fickle and generally unpredictable, POKENAME always keeps its shiny golden stomach well-polished. It is most active during the evening hours. It seems to show skill in tracking down Moon Stones.

entry: POKENAME群占据大片森林，吼叫着赶走想摘树顶水果的其他宝可梦。它们以狂乱抓挠和强力尾扫，攻击入侵者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME troops claim large swathes of forest as their own, hooting and chasing out other Pokémon that try to take fruit from the tree tops. They attack interlopers with a mix of frenzied scratches and powerful tail swipes.

entry: POKENAME群占据大片森林，吼叫着赶走想摘树顶水果的其他宝可梦。长肢让它们在树间迅速荡行，能追赶入侵者数英里。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME troops claim large swathes of forest as their own, hooting and chasing out other Pokémon that try to take fruit from the tree tops. They swing rapidly through the trees with their long limbs, chasing interlopers for miles.

entry: POKENAME群占据大片森林，吼叫着赶走想摘树顶水果的其他宝可梦。不肯逃的会被擒住、毒角刺伤，好让它日后不敢再犯。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME troops claim large swathes of forest as their own, hooting and chasing out other Pokémon that try to take fruit from the tree tops. They grapple Pokémon that refuse to run, stabbing with their venomous horn to deter future trespassing.

entry: 这种宝可梦极易生气，带毒狂攻。一旦附近有另一只POKENAME，就会开打，可能持续数周。
author: leotpurple_48027
source: This Pokémon gets angered really easily and will attack with poisonous outrages. When in the vicinity of another POKENAME, a fight that can last weeks begins.

entry: POKENAME与其他宝可梦切磋，彰显优势，用凶狠毒角与灼热尾巴迫使对方服从。输了，就烧周围森林发泄。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME assert their dominance by sparring with other Pokémon, combining the fury of their venomous horn with their scorching hot tails to put other Pokémon into submission. If they lose, they vent frustration by burning the forest around them.

entry: POKENAME巨大健壮，飞行却敏捷。它以蛮力压敌，以毒削弱，争强好胜得连同类也毫不犹豫地打。
author: fiordaliso
source: Despite being massive and muscled, POKENAME can fly with agility. It uses brute strength to overpower foes, employing toxins to weaken them. Extremely competitive, it will not hesitate to fight even members of its own species.

entry: POKENAME为河岸最佳巢地相斗，以毒角冲撞。腹鳞已硬化，保护它抵御对手。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME battle with one another for the prime nesting grounds along river banks, attempting to ram each other with their venomous horns. They have toughened belly scales to help protect them from their rivals.

entry: POKENAME兼有尼多王体力与胡地智慧，是不容小觑的强敌。暴走时，精神力会毁掉沿途一切。
author: darkweavile428
source: Containing both the physical power of Nidoking and the large intelligence of Alakazam, POKENAME is a force to be reckoned with. When it goes on a rampage, it uses its psychic power to destroy everything in its path.

entry: 只要足够集中，拳头就能碎岩。POKENAME爱公平决斗，避免用带有致虚弱毒的尖刺扎对手。
author: fiordaliso
source: If it concentrates hard enough, it can shatter rocks with the power of its fists. Since it likes to win duels fairly, POKENAME avoids stinging its opponents with its quills, which are coated with debilitating toxins.

entry: POKENAME是好胜的健美者，爱与其他宝可梦比力量。有时较量全是一厢情愿，只因看见什么活动就模仿，想胜过所谓“对手”。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are competitive body builders, comparing themselves against other Pokémon in contests of strength. These contests can sometimes be entirely one sided, POKENAME simply copying whatever activity they see and trying to outdo their 'competitor'.

entry: POKENAME双拳相撞，力量就足以震倒小生灵。据说只有其他同类，才值得使全力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses enough might that just pounding its fists together creates enough force to knock over smaller creatures. It's said that it only ever considers other POKENAME worth using its full power against.

entry: 尼多王与喷火龙的凶性相合，让POKENAME有些像暴君。它找最强宝可梦痛打，逼其低头，满足自负。
author: sk372
source: The combined ferocity of Nidoking and Charizard makes POKENAME a bit of a tyrant. It attempts to beat down the strongest Pokémon it can find and make them bow down to it as a way to stroke its own ego.

entry: 野生POKENAME爬上能找到的最大巨石，自称领地之王。对手就在石顶决斗，看谁真有资格坐王座。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME in the wild will climb to the top of the largest boulder it can find and proclaim itself king of its territory. Rival POKENAME will battle each other atop the rocks to see who is truly worthy enough to sit on the throne.

entry: POKENAME多数时候沉稳，但哪怕无意撞得够重，也会发狂。粗尾连最结实的石头都能击裂。
author: bobosmith01
source: Although stoic at most times, if one even accidentally bumps into POKENAME with enough force, it will go into a frenzy. Its thick tail can be used to fracture even the most sturdy of stones.

entry: POKENAME用角从壁上凿松石英，再吃下。矿物供能，让它战时强壮坚韧。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME uses its horn to loosen quartz from walls, then eats it. The minerals help to fuel its energy, keeping it strong and resilient in battle.

entry: 火鬃产生毒气，让跑步追赶它的宝可梦方向混乱。野生POKENAME大群生活，总与伙伴并肩面对天敌。
author: fiordaliso
source: Its fiery mane produces toxic gases that disorient any Pokémon that tries to chase it while it runs. In the wild, POKENAME lives in large herds and always stands alongside its companions to face predators together.

entry: POKENAME毒刺不断变长，最多能穿透三层实心钢板。刺或毛太久不修，会影响健康。
author: ruben2309295
source: POKENAME are covered in poisonous spikes that grow longer over time and can penetrate up to three layers of solid steel. It is unhealthy for POKENAME to go too long without having their spikes or fur trimmed.

entry: 大舌贝紧附POKENAME手臂，两种毒因此混合。原本庞大的尼多王身躯缩小许多，换来混毒赋予的新精神能力。
author: ilazerheart
source: A Shellder has firmly attached itself to POKENAME's arm, mixing the poisons of the two Pokémon. The former Nidoking has lost most of its bulk in exchange for the new psychic abilities gained from the toxins combining.

entry: 两颗头总谨慎，另一颗却随时准备大肆破坏。三脑与可穿钻石的喙，让POKENAME能精切钻石，常被钻石工匠采用。
author: soup1900
source: While two of its heads are always cautious, one is always ready to go on a destructive rampage. Diamond cutters often use POKENAME to shape diamonds due to their three brains and diamond-piercing beaks, which allow them to perform very precise cuts.

entry: POKENAME双臂像小拆墙球，能粉碎坚岩，角也能穿金属。一旦双臂夹住，猎物很少逃得掉。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can swing their arms like miniature wrecking balls capable of pulverizing solid rock, while their horn can pierce metal. Few prey escape once they clamp their arms down.

entry: POKENAME两门炮各有分工，一门射高压水，另一门射危险毒素。毒渗入对手皮肤不久，便引起疲惫与灼痒。
author: slimninja55
source: POKENAME's cannons each have a separate purpose. While one cannon is used to shoot pressurized water, the other shoots a dangerous toxin that takes effect shortly after seeping into its opponent's skin, causing fatigue and a burning itch.

entry: 背上的珊瑚不断快速生长，它便擦岩磨短。留下的珊瑚碎片，却会在裂缝继续长，从内向外撑裂岩石。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: The coral on its back is constantly growing at a rapid pace. It rubs against rocks to grind it down, but the pieces of coral left behind will keep growing in the cracks and break those rocks open from the inside out.

entry: POKENAME的模样，酷似丰缘地区的一件古老文物。受到威胁时，它们会用带电的水泡包住自己，再引发小小的爆炸，使水泡破裂，麻痹敌人。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME bear resemblance to an ancient artifact from the Hoenn region. When threatened, they surround themselves with a bubble made of electrified water. By using a small explosion, they make this bubble burst and paralyze the foe.

entry: POKENAME极护着珍爱宝珠，很少让人靠近。谁强行接近，就会被它召出的巨大水棒狠狠痛打，棒中的水凝聚得极为密实。
author: sk372
source: Extremely protective of the orb it holds dear, POKENAME will rarely let anyone approach it. Those that try to forcefully approach it are battered viciously by the huge clubs made of densely packed water it summons.

entry: POKENAME住在深海，常是阳光照不到底的地方。受威胁，双臂各喷高压水，将自己推离危险。红色体纹在黑暗中泛着微光。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME live in deep oceans, often where the sunlight fails to reach the bottom. When threatened, each of their arms spray a highly-pressurized stream of water, blasting POKENAME away from danger. The red lines on their body subtly glow in the dark.

entry: 据说POKENAME核心能控海，因而有人猎捕，想夺力量。它高速旋转，能造出从海底直通天空的巨大水龙卷。
author: sk372
source: It is said that POKENAME's core has the power to control the ocean, leading some to hunt it, attempting to attain that power. By rotating at high speeds, it can create massive water funnels that stretch from the ocean depths into the sky.

entry: POKENAME住在水下洞穴系统，领地意识极强。潜水探索须小心，谁靠近窝，都会遭到攻击。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME live in aquatic cave systems, and are incredibly territorial. Divers should beware when exploring these cave systems as POKENAME are known to attack anyone near their lair.

entry: POKENAME长期被认为绝种，直到丰缘捕到活体。古洞壁画显示，过去曾被奉为雨神。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME was long thought to be extinct, until a living specimen was fished up in Hoenn. Ancient cave paintings suggest that the Pokémon was once revered as a deity of rain.

entry: 遥远热带群岛有些村庄告诫，若在天上见POKENAME，就立刻找庇护。飞过后会降暴雨，水却滚烫沸腾。
author: sk372
source: Some villages in remote tropical archipelagos warn about the sight of POKENAME in the sky, advising to take immediate shelter if spotted. Heavy rainfall follows POKENAME's flight, but the water that falls from above is boiling hot.

entry: POKENAME一生住在远离人类与其他宝可梦的孤岛，造凶猛海风暴拒客。但能坚韧挺过试炼、成功靠近的，会获尊重。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lives its life on isolated islands far from humans and other Pokémon. It creates vicious sea storms to repel travelers, but respects those who show the fortitude to endure these trials and manage to approach it.

entry: POKENAME常用精神力与控水本领，在浪顶“冲浪”。有些研究者仍争论它像盖幻，但尚无确凿证据。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are often seen "surfing" atop ocean waves using their psychic powers and ability to control water. Some researchers continue to argue that they resemble Kyoew, though no solid proof has been provided yet.

entry: 传说这种宝可梦的DNA含有所有水生宝可梦的遗传结构。目击极少，见到POKENAME时，又常是飘在大泡泡内。
author: infinex21
source: Legends endure that this Pokémon contains the genetic structure of every aquatic Pokémon within its own DNA. There are few POKENAME that have been witnessed, and when witnessed they have oft been seen floating within large bubbles.

entry: POKENAME通常平静，但谁靠太近或乱摸，就会逃走，或尽力反击。通常在火山附近或深海出现。
author: suaveword99023
source: POKENAME are usually calm, but if anyone gets too close or too touchy, POKENAME will either run away, or fight back as much as they can. POKENAME are usually found near a volcano or the deep ocean.

entry: 腹内强大的火囊让它能喷火，也在海中家园保温。颈毛像光焰闪动，喷出的水始终滚烫。
author: infinex21
source: Within its belly is a potent flame sac that allows it to breathe flames and keep it warm within its ocean home. The fur on its neck flickers like glowing flames and the jets of water it releases are always scalding hot.

entry: POKENAME住在最深海沟。若靠近水面，常被视为环境灾难将至的信号。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME lives in the deepest ocean trenches. If one is found near the surface, it's often viewed as a sign of an impending environmental disaster.

entry: POKENAME在海中漂行，引导洋流、培育珊瑚礁，重建受损生态。抓到人类威胁环境，就快转造旋涡，绝不放其不受惩罚地逃走。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME drifts through the sea, directing currents and growing coral reefs to help rebuild damaged ecosystems. If it catches humans threatening the environment, it twirls rapidly to create whirlpools, refusing to let them escape unpunished.

entry: POKENAME住在下水道，以强流赶走其他宝可梦。饥饿时，就淹城市街道，吃冲进排水口的食物。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME live in the sewers, creating powerful currents to push out other Pokémon living inside. When hungry, they flood the city streets, eating any food that flows down the drains.

entry: 人们相信POKENAME能活数千年，从无尸体被发现的记录。它被认为能再生过老的细胞，但过程仍不清楚。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are believed to live for millennia. There has been no record of a POKENAME body ever being found, and it is believed that they can regenerate their cells that get too old in a process that is still not understood.

entry: 它打盹之处，细雨永不停歇。POKENAME若被激怒，便会骤变成毁灭性的风暴。
author: vaporvenator
source: An everlasting drizzle of rain occurs where it dozes off. This light shower escalates into a devastating storm when POKENAME is provoked.

entry: 背上的岩石是攻击的固定信标，增强准确度与威力。其中巨大力量，连炙热沙漠也能变成多雨湿地。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: The rock on its back acts as a grounded beacon for its attacks to make them more accurate and powerful. The enormous power inside this beacon is capable of turning even a blazing desert into a rainy marsh.

entry: POKENAME是极小的鱼宝可梦，形似特定古文字。常见超过20只结群，以小水柱推进。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are very small fish Pokémon that resemble a specific ancient text character. They are often seen in schools of over 20 of their own kind, using small jets of water to propel themselves.

entry: POKENAME巨大身体游过海洋，数百乃至数千小型水生宝可梦环绕。体形让它少遇挑战，小宝可梦便能在周围避难。
author: infinex21
source: Hundreds, if not thousands, of smaller aquatic Pokémon flock around the titanic body of POKENAME as it travels through the seas. This Pokémon is rarely challenged due to its size, which allows for smaller Pokémon to seek shelter around it.

entry: POKENAME是凶猛水下猎手，攻击猎物如巨浪冲撞。极少出水，一度只被当作神话。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is a fearsome underwater predator, striking prey with blows as strong as crashing waves. It is rarely seen out of the water and once was only considered myth.

entry: 战斗中，它粗壮的手臂越来越亮，积蓄的能量，迅速涌遍全身。POKENAME的大角能刺穿钢铁，也是能量积蓄足够后，释放出去的通道。
author: infinex21
source: Its thick arms glow brighter as it fights, building energy that quickly surges across its entire body. The large horn of a POKENAME can pierce through steel and serves as a conduit to release its energy after it has built up enough.

entry: POKENAME躲在最深海处休息。苏醒的征兆，是一场墨般漆黑的雨。
author: bacondlx
source: POKENAME sequesters itself in the deepest depths of the ocean to rest. Its awakening is heralded by inky, pitch black rain.

entry: POKENAME是海空可怕猎手，身体硬过铁，羽毛锐利如刀。它俯冲切浪，抓住猎物，再拖上空中。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are feared predators of ocean skies, with bodies harder than iron and feathers as sharp as blades. They will dive and cut through the waves to capture their prey and drag them to the air.

entry: 野生POKENAME用小手夹着发光蛋，以长嘴精准射出泡泡弹，打击威胁。背鳍亮起，就准备从口放出纯能量。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME carry their glowing eggs between their small hands and will shoot any threats with precise bubble bullets using their long mouths. When their dorsal fin glows bright, they are preparing to release pure energy from their mouths.

entry: POKENAME拥有强大的水与雷电力量，常被视为风暴的活化身。许多人起初畏惧，它却常帮助困在恶劣风暴中的船。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are often seen as living embodiments of storms, given their great powers of water and lightning. Despite the fact that many fear them at first, these Pokémon have often come to the aid of ships stuck in terrible storms.

entry: 遥远异地有片广大严酷沙漠，许多绿洲由POKENAME创造。居民沿绿洲建镇，尊崇创造者。
author: cobalt0135
source: Many oases have been formed by POKENAME throughout a large unforgiving desert in a distant land. People that live in the wasteland have built towns by these oases and honor the Pokémon that made them.

entry: POKENAME能承受深海巨压，水流尾轻易就能击倒大得多的宝可梦。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME can withstand the powerful pressures deep in the ocean's depths. Their Aqua Tail can easily take down Pokémon much larger than them.

entry: 野生POKENAME埋在海床，睡时吸收其中能量生长。若被打扰，会掀起强烈震动。
author: cobalt0135
source: Wild POKENAME bury themselves in the seafloor and absorb the energy within it to grow as they sleep. They will unleash powerful tremors if they're disturbed.

entry: POKENAME海中力量无双。地震能重创城市，冲浪能掀巨海啸，淹没沿途一切。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME's power in the ocean is unmatched. It can devastate cities with Earthquake and unleash large tsunamis with Surf to flood everything in its path.

entry: POKENAME住在深海，只有最坚定的训练家才能找到。虽罕见，仍有浪上目击，每次都伴着猛烈风暴。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME live in the deep ocean and can only be discovered by the most determined of Trainers. Though rare, they have been seen above the waves and always are accompanied by powerful storms.

entry: POKENAME以巨大肢体猛砸，一击就造深坑，再注满淡水，恢复周围生态活力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME crashes its large limbs down with mighty force, creating deep craters with a single strike. It fills these ravines with fresh water to revitalize the surrounding ecosystem.

entry: POKENAME藤蔓若折断，就爆散成大水洼，足以容下一只鱼宝可梦栖息。藤蔓摆得越快、起伏越大，海浪也越汹涌高大。
author: soup1900
source: If any of POKENAME's vines were to break off, they would explode into large puddles of water capable of housing one fish Pokémon. The more wavy and faster the movement of these vines are, the choppier and larger the waves in the sea are.

entry: POKENAME在胃的一处煮水，维持电力。许多科学家研究它，希望改善大规模使用水力发电作为可再生能源的可行性。
author: bradlybro199
source: POKENAME sustain their electrical power by boiling water in a section of their stomach. Many Scientists study POKENAME in hopes of improving the viability of using hydroelectric power as a renewable energy source on a large scale.

entry: POKENAME飞过后，滋养生命的雨很快就来，让下方土地迅速复苏。常受旱灾的地方，目击它被视为苦日子结束。
author: deadshields
source: Wherever POKENAME soars, life-giving rainfall is soon to follow, quickly rejuvenating the land below. In lands were drought is common, sightings of POKENAME are known as the end of hard times.

entry: POKENAME控海力量强，却容易失控。召来的浪可能忽然转向，附近也会随机现旋涡，连半空也不例外。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses great power over the ocean, but its abilities have a tendency to go haywire. Waves it summons may change direction suddenly, and whirlpools may appear randomly near it, even in midair.

entry: POKENAME隐居海岸洞窟，出门就会伴雨。有人珍视它，认为能防旱、促进作物生长。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are secluded Pokémon that live in caves near the coast. When these Pokémon wander outside of their homes, rainfall follows. Some people treasure POKENAME as stewards that prevent drought and promote crop growth.

entry: POKENAME被视为海洋保护者，以灵巧双腿穿行海中，收集、清走外来碎屑。愤怒时，体纹发光，周围水也升温沸腾。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Seen as protectors of the ocean, POKENAME use their dexterous legs to navigate the seas, collecting foreign debris and removing it from the water. When angered, the water around POKENAME will heat and boil as its patterns glow.

entry: 这些海洋勇士安睡，直到被需要才醒。POKENAME只在大旱时被看见，跃过广大陆地，所到之处带雷雨。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Valiant warriors of the ocean, these Pokémon sleep peacefully until they are needed and awaken. POKENAME are only spotted during massive droughts, where they bound across vast land masses, bringing rainstorms wherever they go.

entry: POKENAME从海中上陆迁徙，经过便洪水泛滥。现代研究与古老故事都显示，人类文明起源的洪泛平原，也许正由它创造。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME emerges from the sea to migrate across the land, causing floods wherever it passes. Contemporary research and ancient stories suggest POKENAME created the floodplains where human civilization began.

entry: POKENAME少被人见，是控浪保护海中居民的守护者。携带的发光石头，有时被称为“海之魂”。
author: sk372
source: Rarely seen by humans, POKENAME is a guardian of the ocean that manipulates the waves to protect its denizens. The glowing stone it carries is sometimes referred to as the Soul of the Sea.

entry: POKENAME轻易便能驾驭最猛烈海水，许多人觊觎、妄想滥用。为躲开这些人，它住在最深水下洞窟，极少离开。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME commands the fiercest of ocean waters with the simplest of ease, a power that many have coveted and sought to abuse. To avoid such people, it lives in the deepest underwater cave and rarely leaves.

entry: POKENAME控水之力极庞大，只现身就让洋流与波浪躁动。即使被封住，上方水域也比多数地方更汹涌。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses a truly massive amount of hydrokinetic power. Just manifesting itself causes currents and waves to become turbulent, and even when contained the waters above it will be rougher than most.

entry: 背上的花能感受周围洋流受扰。POKENAME以巨大控海力量维持海温，让花持续绽放。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: The flower on its back can sense when the sea currents around it are being disrupted. POKENAME uses its immense oceanic powers to maintain the sea's temperature and keep this flower blooming.

entry: POKENAME能水陆两栖，在海滩棕榈间飞跑。撞头时若被打断，就毫不犹豫地攻击。传说鲁莽曾让同族几乎灭绝。
author: lootererswillbeboated
source: POKENAME is amphibious and darts around palm trees on beaches. If interrupted while headbutting, it will attack without hesitation. Legends say its recklessness nearly wiped out its kind.

entry: 据说大灾难将至时，POKENAME就会出现。大洪水或风暴来前，成群出海，警告当地居民。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are said to appear whenever a great cataclysmic event is about to occur. Just before a major flood or storm, they emerge from the sea in droves to warn the local population.

entry: POKENAME喷口一喷水，就能召来周围数英里的大雨。它控制水流，把猎物拉进巨口进食。
author: bacondlx
source: One spray from POKENAME's spout summons heavy rain for miles surrounding it. It feeds itself by controlling underwater currents to pull prey into its massive mouth.

entry: POKENAME觉得尊崇不够，就让地面喷出巨大间歇泉。滚烫急流强得能摧毁山岳。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME feels insufficiently revered, massive geysers erupt from the ground. These scalding torrents are powerful enough to destroy mountains.

entry: 渔民极怕POKENAME壳上携来的无尽风暴。行动破坏性太强，有时连电视气象台也会监测。
author: elevn.
source: POKENAME are strongly feared by fishermen due to the endless storm they drag on their shell. Their movements are so destructive that they are sometimes monitored by televised weather channels.

entry: 渔民极怕POKENAME壳上携来的无尽风暴。行动破坏性太强，有时连电视气象台也会监测。
author: elevn.
source: POKENAME are strongly feared by fishermen due to the endless storm they drag on their shell. Their movements are so destructive that they are sometimes monitored by televised weather channels.

entry: POKENAME缓步走海床，背上的树引来各种鱼宝可梦。极少时，连大群吼鲸王也会一路跟随。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME slowly walk along the ocean floor, the tree on their backs attracting fish Pokémon of all kinds. There have even been rare occurrences where large pods of Wailord follow POKENAME on their journeys.

entry: 许多POKENAME能造危险暴风雨，不能随便招惹。最近海底发现一只沉睡者，背上住着许多水属性宝可梦，成了活生生的生态系统。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Many POKENAME can cause dangerous, heavy storms, so they should not be trifled with. An instance of slumbering POKENAME has been recently found at the bottom of the ocean. Many Water-type Pokémon live on its back, making it a living ecosystem.

entry: POKENAME腹下半透明，能看见橙色器官发电，让内部液体不断冒泡。它先喷水柱，立刻再沿水柱放强电。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have translucent underbellies that reveal the liquid in them that is always kept bubbling by the electricity generated by their orange organs. They spew jets of water and immediately release powerful electricity along the jets.

entry: 它一扇双臂，便能召来飓风；尾巴一甩，就能掀起巨浪。由于力量太过可怕，POKENAME更喜欢住在海洋最黑暗的深处。
author: bobosmith01
source: With a flap of its arms, it can summon hurricanes. With a whip of its tail, it can cause tidal waves. As a result of its terrible power, POKENAME prefers to dwell in the darkest depths of the ocean.

entry: 水下，POKENAME用缎带控水。攻击者被卷入带情绪能量的水流，翻搅过后，出来便更平和。
author: sk372
source: While underwater, POKENAME's ribbons let it control the flow of water. The currents it sends attackers through are charged with emotional energy, causing those tossed around to emerge with a more placid demeanor.

entry: POKENAME以海洋全力，召出浮空水路，想游去哪都行。鳍全由水构成，有人说连固拉多也蒸发不了。
author: soup1900
source: Using the full power of the ocean, POKENAME can summon floating waterways to swim to any location it wants. Its fins are made entirely out of water, which some say can't be evaporated by even a Groudon.

entry: 神话称POKENAME形成于原初海洋诞生之际。完全掌控海洋，便能让世界陷入无尽洪水，不留陆地踪迹。
author: mepp.
source: In myths, POKENAME was formed at the genesis of the primordial sea. With full command of the oceans, it could plunge the world into an endless deluge, leaving no traces of land.

entry: 古代神话说POKENAME躺在最深海处，以海洋全力，足以淹没整个世界，不留一片水面以上的陆地。
author: soup1900
source: According to ancient mythology, POKENAME is said to lie within the deepest parts of the ocean. With the full power of the sea, POKENAME could drown the entire world, leaving no land above sea level.

entry: POKENAME沿海床走，就像野兽在陆地漫游。海中宝可梦跟着找陆地，因为它常造访海岸，在水下怒吼。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME walks along the ocean floor like a beast roams the land. Pokémon which reside in the ocean follow it to find where land is, as POKENAME tends to visit the coasts of regions and roar in anger from beneath the surface.

entry: 它像神话中的天空统治者、风暴召唤者。后者更接近事实，但只有海上风暴发生才现身，从深处升起，飞在滂沱雨中。
author: infinex21
source: It resembles a Pokémon depicted in mythology as the ruler of the skies and summoner of storms. The latter is the nearest truth, though it only appears when ocean storms occur. It rises from the depths and flies amidst the torrents of rain.

entry: 它睡在世界最深海沟。传说POKENAME终有一天，会让无尽暴雨浇遍世界。
author: mepp.
source: It slumbers in the deepest oceanic trenches of the world. Legends claim that POKENAME will one day drench the world in endless torrents of rain.

entry: 将盖欧卡的基因注入盖诺赛克特后，就会产生POKENAME。它是终极猎手，凭借强大的力量统御天空、陆地与海洋。
author: spookyscaryoverlord
source: When Genesect are infused with the DNA of Kyogre, a POKENAME is made. It is the ultimate hunter and dominates air, land, and sea with immense power.

entry: POKENAME藏在倾盆暴雨里，以红雷打击伤害海洋的对象。怒到极点时，尾巴生成滚滚雷云，一夜就能淹城。
author: soup1900
source: Hiding itself inside of massive downpours, POKENAME attacks those who damage the ocean by striking them down with its red lightning. When fully enraged, its tail generates billows of storm clouds that can flood cities in one night.

entry: POKENAME常在湖、池甚至海面跳舞。强壮耳朵能掀小浪潮自卫。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are often seen dancing atop the surfaces of lakes, ponds, or even the ocean itself. They can use their muscular ears to whip up small tidal waves to defend themselves.

entry: 琉璃市居民不肯大声说POKENAME名字。他们相信，一旦被听见，它就会召来吞噬灵魂的雨。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: The people of Sootopolis City refuse to say POKENAME's name out loud. They believe that if POKENAME hears its name, it will summon rain that consumes one's soul.

entry: 这种深海猎手在最幽深处发光，警告一切生灵，自己已醒、正在捕猎。长牙锋利，掠过一刀，就能划开最坚固的船体。
author: infinex21
source: This deep sea predator emits a glow in the deepest depths that alert all when it is awake and on the hunt. Its tusks are sharp enough to slice open the toughest hulls of ships with but a passing cut.

entry: POKENAME软乎乎的，看起来毫不吓人。可一旦被激怒，就能从体内喷出数千加仑的水。
author: glacierwing
source: POKENAME is very squishy and not at all intimidating, but if provoked, it can expel thousands of gallons of water from its body.

entry: POKENAME水制钥匙环可随意缩放，想带多少物品都行。传闻头上的钥匙，能开启海底秘密。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME's water key ring can shrink and expand at will, allowing it to carry as many items as it wants. Rumors say the key on its head can unlock secrets at the bottom of the ocean.

entry: POKENAME特殊护符连在涌动水环上，以海底找来的海盗宝藏装饰自己。
author: royrw
source: POKENAME's special charms are attached to a surging band of water. It decorates itself with pirate treasure sourced from the seafloor.

entry: POKENAME水制钥匙环可随意缩放，想带多少物品都行。传闻头上的钥匙，能开启海底秘密。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME's water key ring can shrink and expand at will, allowing it to carry as many items as it wants. Rumors say the key on its head can unlock secrets at the bottom of the ocean.

entry: POKENAME水环上的特殊球状护符，极像丰缘古代文物。它通过宝珠传导原始能量，增强水系攻击。
author: royrw
source: The special orb charm attached to POKENAME's aqua ring bears a striking resemblance to an ancient, historical artifact from the Hoenn region. It is able to channel primal energy through this orb to power its aquatic attacks.

entry: POKENAME睡在海底火山深处，以许多翅膀吸收热能。醒来时，滚烫的漏斗状水柱从火山口直冲海面。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sleeps deep within underwater volcanoes, absorbing heat energy through its many wings. When it awakens, a scalding hot water funnel rises from the volcano basin all the way to the ocean's surface.

entry: POKENAME胸前水晶器官能轰出巨浪，被认为曾在其他星球上创造海洋。风暴随外形变化，从无害细雨到灾难飓风都有。
author: soup1900
source: Able to blast tidal waves from the crystalline organ in its chest, POKENAME is believed to have created oceans on foreign planets. The storms it creates change based on its appearance, ranging from harmless rain to catastrophic hurricanes.

entry: 它们在海沟中游荡，寻找矿石充饥。身体各处孔洞喷出的气泡劲力惊人，甚至能贯穿钢铁。
author: schwaus
source: They wander in trenches looking for ore to eat. The bubbles that blow from the holes around its body come out with enough force to pierce through steel.

entry: POKENAME密度太大，游不了，却常在最深海床潜行。体上红光照亮漆黑海水，吸引猎物。
author: alestrius
source: Though it is too dense to swim, POKENAME can often be found prowling the deepest floors of the ocean. The red lights on its body illuminate the dark waters and draw its prey to it.

entry: POKENAME尾尖水滴，据说是海洋本身的化身。水被污染或海中遭倒垃圾，水滴就缩小，身体也会不适。
author: soup1900
source: The droplet on the tip of POKENAME's tail is said to be the personification of the sea itself. Whenever water becomes polluted or trash gets dumped into the sea, the drop shrinks in size, and POKENAME becomes unwell.

entry: POKENAME游遍海洋，找新的水生宝可梦玩。有时玩得过头，不慎引起季风。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME swims through the oceans, seeking out new aquatic Pokémon to play with. It sometimes becomes overzealous in its playing, inadvertently causing monsoons.

entry: 野生POKENAME附在深海洞顶，标为领地。任何潜在对手，都被威力惊人的根源波动猛烈逐出。
author: theartemis1
source: Wild POKENAME cling to the roofs of deep-sea caves, marking them as their territory. Any potential competitors are violently expelled from the area with a devastating Origin Pulse attack.

entry: 野生POKENAME用能找到的最硬海底岩石磨牙。深海巨压也进一步锻炼全身，让它日益强大。
author: infinex21
source: Wild POKENAME keep their tusks sharp by grating them against the toughest underwater rocks they can find. These crushing depths they wander further hone their entire bodies, allowing them to grow stronger with every day.

entry: POKENAME住在水下洞窟，或临近大水域的洞里。每天挑战猛流，让长牙保持锋利。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live within underwater caves or caves nearest to a large body of water. Their tusks are kept sharp by the fierce currents they will challenge each and every day.

entry: 体内橙色毒素极强，能将多数东西熔成液体，供它愉快大喝。角与尾刺也能直接给猎物注毒。
author: infinex21
source: The orange toxin within their bodies is so potent that it can melt most things into a drinkable liquid that they will happily gorge themselves with. Their horns and their tail stingers can inject this toxin directly into their prey.

entry: POKENAME占据海岸，以巨力压碎一切反抗。吼声使海水狂暴，掀巨浪与海啸般猛烈的风。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME claims coastline areas as its territory, using its titanic strength to crush any opposition to its rule. Its roar causes the ocean waters to turn violent, creating giant waves and tsunami-level winds.

entry: 北极海域极少能见POKENAME优雅飘过水面。双手一拍，周围水瞬间冻结，困住船；船员之后便再未被见到。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are rarely found in arctic oceans, gracefully floating along the water. By slamming their hands together, they can freeze the water around them instantly, trapping any ships they encounter. The crews of these ships are never seen again.

entry: POKENAME大半生在深海小睡。海藻般叶片吸引某些饥饿宝可梦，被咬就暴怒，召出巨大水柱报复。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME naps in the ocean depths for most of its life. Its seaweed-like leaves attract certain hungry Pokémon, causing an angered POKENAME to summon massive water pillars in retribution for being bitten.

entry: 最近海洋科考发现，POKENAME住在水下30,000英尺。它们是拾荒者，耐心等待上层水域落下残食。
author: mepp.
source: Recent ocean expeditions have discovered POKENAME living 30,000 feet deep underwater. They are scavengers, patiently waiting for leftover scraps to fall from the waters above.

entry: POKENAME夜里高速飞行，扎入海中也极快，很快抵达最深处。能在其他生灵看不见的地方视物，让它轻易捕到猎物。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME fly around at night with great speed, and dive into the sea so fast that they reach the deepest areas quickly. Down here, they easily catch prey, able to see where others can't.

entry: POKENAME生活在海床，尽责保护海洋生命。坚实身体由极耐久的金属构成。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME live on the seafloor, dutifully protecting marine life. Their tough bodies are made up of an extremely durable metal.

entry: POKENAME住在海草丰富的地方，吃海草，供养自己与背上蘑菇。菌体孔洞能喷水流，自卫、逃离天敌。
author: sk372
