source: POKENAME inhabits areas with lots of seaweed around for it to consume, providing nutrients for itself and the mushrooms on its back. The fungi contain pores that let it spray streams of water to defend itself and escape predators.

entry: POKENAME轻哼的曲调响彻海洋。它想让世界沉入大海，好让所有人都听见自己的声音。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: The gentle tune POKENAME hums resonates throughout the ocean. It wishes for everyone to hear its voice by drowning the world in the sea.

entry: POKENAME在海床爬行，以藤蔓般长须吸收水草养分，存入背上的胶质球。它始终小心，不让球干掉。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME scuttles around on the seafloor, absorbing nutrients from underwater plants using vine-like tendrils. These nutrients are stored within a gelatinous sphere on POKENAME's back, which it is careful to never let dry out.

entry: POKENAME住在几乎无光可达的海渊。据说，若它浮出海面暴走，就能释放炽热光线，在当天结束前，将海洋蒸干。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME resides at the ocean's abyss, where next to no light reaches. Should it surface and go on a rampage, it is said it can unleash light rays so hot as to cause the oceans to evaporate before the day's end.

entry: POKENAME偏爱水下，偶尔也会在近岸跃出。海滩人群若不欣赏，就向看见的每个人使出水炮。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: While preferring to stay underwater, POKENAME have been known to occasionally breach water near shores. If they are not admired by people on the beach, POKENAME will Hydro Pump everyone they see.

entry: POKENAME在稀树草原最深水坑冬眠，传闻会把扰眠者吸进墓中。只有成功战胜它，才准逃走。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME hibernates in the deepest watering hole in the savannah and is rumored to suck those who disturb their slumber into its tomb. Only those who successfully defeat a POKENAME in combat are allowed to escape.

entry: 古时，POKENAME守护海边城市。大地与海洋巨兽的灾难之战威胁城池，它便将城市与自己一起藏入海底。
author: strawberry_boicake
source: In ancient times, POKENAME was the protector of a city by the sea. When a cataclysmic battle between the Titans of Land and Sea threatened its safety, it hid the city and itself at the bottom of the ocean.

entry: POKENAME能召倾盆暴雨，藏在雨雾中。传说只选择配得上的训练家并肩作战。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME can create torrential downpours and hide within the falling rain and fog. Legends say that POKENAME only chooses to battle alongside worthy trainers.

entry: POKENAME在海中寻找值得一战的对手，磨练本领。不过，一发现宿敌固咪龟，就会上岸与之交战。等对自己的战斗实力满意后，它便潜入深深的海沟，进化、沉睡。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME seeks out worthy opponents in the ocean to train up its skills, but it will go ashore to fight a Groutortle if it spots the rival Pokémon. Once it is satisfied with its battle prowess, it dives to deep ocean trenches to evolve and sleep.

entry: POKENAME住在永不消散的风暴云中，大半时间飘过农田，给作物浇水。传说太阳雨或突来降雨，代表它们正在聚集。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME live within perpetual storm clouds, spending most of their time drifting over fields to water crops. Legends suggest that sunshowers or unexpected rain are signs of a POKENAME gathering.

entry: POKENAME虽能操纵周围的水，却厌恶沾湿。它会分开湖泊、河流等水域，让液体尽可能远离自己。
author: sk372
source: While POKENAME possesses the ability to manipulate water around it, it detests getting wet. It will part the waters of lakes, rivers and the like in order to keep the liquid as far away from it as possible.

entry: POKENAME平时耐心睿智，唯独容不得污染海洋者，无论人还是宝可梦。每挥拳，潮汐就急变，让海洋陷入风暴。
author: ultron_suprem3
source: While normally very patient and sage, POKENAME lose all patience with those who pollute the ocean, man and Pokémon alike. As POKENAME throw their punches, the tide fluctuates rapidly, throwing the ocean into storm.

entry: POKENAME缠着热液喷口，睡在深海沟。附近海底火山喷发就醒，冲向水面找强敌，靠战斗消耗体力，直到火山平静。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME slumbers in deep ocean trenches, wrapping its body around hydrothermal vents. It awakens when nearby submarine volcanoes erupt, racing to the surface to find a strong opponent to tire it out with a battle until the volcano calms.

entry: POKENAME极护海洋。曾有人见它用巨臂，将整座冰山与巨大海石掷向钻油平台和拖网渔船。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME is incredibly protective of the sea. It has been seen using its massive arms to fling entire icebergs and large ocean rocks at oil rigs and fishing trawlers.

entry: POKENAME以压倒性力量控潮，战时挥三叉戟召旋涡。古代雕刻将它描绘为水手与对手都畏惧的海神。
author: segmoph
source: POKENAME commands the tides with crushing strength, wielding its trident to summon whirlpools mid-battle. Ancient carvings depict it as a sea god feared by sailors and rival Pokémon alike.

entry: 古壁画将POKENAME描绘为波克兰帝斯的沉睡守护者，多臂能平息或激怒海洋。文献预言，星辰连线时苏醒，引发巨大洪水，使失落文明重现。
author: frl6160
source: Ancient murals depict POKENAME as the slumbering guardian of Pokelantis whose many arms could calm or rage the seas. Texts foretell its awakening when the stars align, triggering colossal floods to resurface the lost civilization.

entry: 传说POKENAME能指挥洋流，推开大陆。张开上臂，水便环绕，按它的意愿流动。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Legends describe POKENAME commanding currents to push continents away. When it spreads its upper arms, water flows around it, moving as it commands.

entry: POKENAME不高兴，就放出大量微咸的水，淹没周围。迅速泛滥，常造出新湖。
author: quackquackattack
source: Whenever POKENAME are upset, they release a deluge of brackish water to flood the area around them. This rapid flooding often results in the creation of a new lake.

entry: POKENAME在海面疾驰，鬃毛如浪拖在身后。训练家若看见，就会潜入水中，激起一小股沸腾水花。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME race along the ocean's surface, their manes flowing behind them like waves. If a Trainer spots them, they will dive into the water in a small, boiling plume.

entry: POKENAME沿海床长跑，速度快得掀起大浪。额头长牙用来刺穿固拉多融合体的粗厚皮肤。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME run long distances along the ocean floor, running at speeds fast enough to cause large waves to rise. The long tusk on their foreheads is used to pierce through the rough skin of Groudon fusions.

entry: POKENAME群制造的雷雨猛烈，常重创沿海城市。天气变冷，它们就退入水下。
author: mepp.
source: The rainstorms that groups of POKENAME produce are violent and often wreak havoc upon coastal cities. When the weather becomes colder, they retreat beneath the waters.

entry: POKENAME时而睡在水里，时而睡在冰上。无论身在何处，红色纹路都清晰地发着光。
author: glacierwing
source: POKENAME alternates between sleeping in water and on ice. No matter where it goes, its red markings still glow clearly.

entry: POKENAME住在最深海处，翻沙清垃圾。与人类关系疏远，遇到善意，反会起疑。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live in the deepest depths of the ocean where they churn through the sand to clean up garbage. Their estranged relationship with humanity leads them to become suspicious whenever kindness is given to them.

entry: POKENAME高压水炮能轰遍整个地区、击碎山。但前提是脚下地面承得住所有重量与力量，不被震碎。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: POKENAME's pressurized water cannons can blast over an entire region and shatter mountains. This, however, is only possible if the ground beneath it can support all of its weight and force without shattering.

entry: 据说POKENAME睡在海底，除非水中家园受威胁，否则不出壳。炮口一击，就能造海啸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to sleep at the bottom of the ocean, remaining within its shell unless something threatens its aquatic home. Its cannons possess power enough to create tsunamis with a single blast.

entry: POKENAME受怒火驱使，遇到危险时，背上的小火山便会喷发。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME is driven by its rage. The small volcano on its back erupts when it is confronted with danger.

entry: 在融合成POKENAME之前，它还得散发难闻的气味来吓退鸟宝可梦。如今凭着威武的外表，POKENAME已受到森林中所有宝可梦的敬重。
author: over9001
source: Before being fused into POKENAME, this Pokémon had to release an uncomfortable odor to scare away bird Pokémon. Now, POKENAME is respected by every Pokémon in the forest due to its mighty appearance.

entry: POKENAME将控地、控热之力导入随身骨头，如魔杖般挥动。慢慢一挥，几秒就能使整座湖干涸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME channels its power to manipulate ground and heat into the bone it carries, waving it around like a wand. With one slow swing, it can dry up an entire lake in just a few seconds.

entry: POKENAME将自己埋入沙中，让柔软的内部组织为进化做好准备。固拉多的鳞片使它的外壳坚固无比，无法破开。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME buries itself in the sand in order to prepare its soft innards for evolution. Its shell is incredibly robust and impossible to break open due to Groudon's scales.

entry: 据说POKENAME能塑造周围陆地。全力冲撞，或足以重塑整片大陆。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's is said to carry the capacity to shape the landmass around it. Supposedly, a charging tackle from it would, at full power, be enough to reshape an entire continent.

entry: 救援队雇POKENAME钻土、清碎屑，寻找地震和山崩埋住的受害者。它常太专注救援，忘了吃饭。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: Rescue operations employ POKENAME to drill through soil and debris in search of buried earthquake and landslide victims. POKENAME often becomes so fixated on its rescue mission that it forgets to eat.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀承重力惊人，还能收拢起来，让它从空中飞行迅速切换为掘地穿行。因此无论地下还是地上，POKENAME都是危险的猎手。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME's wings can carry an incredible amount of weight and are capable of contracting themselves in order to freely switch from flying into quickly tunneling through the earth. This makes POKENAME a dangerous predator beneath and above ground.

entry: 传说POKENAME以巨镰切开大地，创造山脉峡谷。振翅也能引发灾难性地震。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: According to legend, POKENAME created mountain ranges and valleys by slicing the land with its enormous scythes. The vibrations from its wings can trigger cataclysmic earthquakes.

entry: POKENAME用巨钳凿小沟作陷坑，塑造领地。入侵者若掉下，就用瞬间硬如岩石的唾液封住。
author: ambrosia04
source: To shape their territory, POKENAME use their massive pincers to carve small ravines as pitfall traps. If any intruders fall in, they use their saliva, which instantly hardens like solid rock, to seal them inside.

entry: 这极危险的海中巨兽，住在黑暗深处。POKENAME以可怕吼声宣告现身，再用卷须般附肢捉猎物，最好始终避开。
author: fireblade141
source: This extremely dangerous leviathan lives in the dark depths of the sea. POKENAME's presence is announced with a terrifying roar, and it will use its tendril-like appendages to grab its prey. This apex predator should always be avoided.

entry: 层层硬土保护，让它游过岩浆也不烧伤。受其他宝可梦威胁，就射足以烫伤对手的热水驱赶。
author: fiordaliso
source: It swims through magma without being burned, protected by the layers of hardened earth covering its body. When it feels threatened by other Pokémon, it drives them away by shooting bursts of scalding water hot enough to burn them.

entry: 它在进化前始终保持着温暖，也受到外壳的保护。外壳的温度最高可达华氏3,000度。
author: over9001
source: This Pokémon keeps itself warm and protected until it is able to evolve. Its outer shell reaches up to 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.

entry: POKENAME的泳技用来穿行这颗星球地幔中的岩浆，而非在水里游泳。想返回地面时，它便用镰刀切开大地。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's swimming skills aren't used for swimming in water; they're instead used to swim through magma in the mantle layer of the planet. It slices open the ground with its scythes whenever it wants to return to the surface.

entry: POKENAME很少离开火山区，在火山口附近筑巢。锐爪轻易穿透最爱猎物煤炭龟的坚壳。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME are rarely seen outside of volcanic regions, building their nests close to craters. Their razor-sharp talons easily pierce through the tough shells of Torkoal, their preferred prey.

entry: POKENAME被称为“灾厄先知”，现身不久便有天气灾害。夏季相对最常见，若冬季出现，据说就是危险迫近的信号。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has been called the Oracle of Calamity, as weather-related disasters shortly follow its appearance. While it is comparatively most often spotted in the summer, an appearance during the winter season is said to be a sign of imminent danger.

entry: POKENAME在地下筑巢。若有敌人靠近，POKENAME便会升空蓄势，再用锥形的双手刺击对方，守护巢穴。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME builds their nest underground. If someone were to approach it, POKENAME would defend it by stinging or piercing the enemy with its cone-shaped hands after building up momentum in the sky.

entry: 神话有片饥荒土地，被到来的有角小生灵以地震救下。裂缝涌出宝可梦，缓解饥荒。研究者认为，那生灵或许是POKENAME。
author: imaginita
source: There is a myth about a famine-struck land that was rescued when a small, horned being arrived and caused an earthquake. Pokémon sprung out of the resulting fissure, relieving the famine. Researchers believe this being may have been a POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME力量远大于自己所知，却总乐天随性。玩闹心意一变，就无意识地重塑附近地形。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has far greater power than it realizes and goes around with a happy-go-lucky personality. It subconsciously reshapes the terrain in its vicinity according to its playful whims.

entry: POKENAME会振翅向其他鸟宝可梦展示威势。羽毛上的鳞片让它即使身处猛烈的沙暴，也能以惊人的速度飞行。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME flaps its wings in order to show its dominance over other bird Pokémon. It can fly at incredible speeds through rough sandstorms due to the scales on its feathers.

entry: POKENAME住在深地岩浆湖，以火山岩为食。若惹怒，最近火山就会喷发，火山灰云中噼啪闪起红色雷电。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live deep underground within lakes of magma, living off a diet of volcanic rocks. If one were to enrage a POKENAME, the nearest volcano will erupt with clouds of ash that crackle with red lightning.

entry: POKENAME十分谨慎。由于外貌酷似固拉多，它担心其他小拉达会一拥而上，抢走自己的食物。它打起架来凶猛无比，决不让这种事发生。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME is a cautious Pokémon. It fears that it could be swarmed by other Rattata and steal its food due to its unique appearance that resembles Groudon's. It is a fierce fighter and will not let that happen.

entry: POKENAME在尼多一族巢下开小陷坑，吓跑周围宝可梦，再吃最爱的蛋。蛋中有种特殊化学物，能增强耐热。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME open up small sinkholes under Nidoran nests. This causes the surrounding Pokémon to flee, allowing POKENAME to feast upon its favourite food – Nidoran eggs. There is a special chemical in them that gives POKENAME resistance to heat.

entry: 所有小拉达都惧怕POKENAME，认为它十分凶暴。锋利如刀的獠牙不断生长，连坚硬的地面都能咬穿。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME is feared by all Rattata and is seen as a violent Pokémon. It has razor-sharp fangs that grow at a steady rate. It can even chew through solid ground.

entry: POKENAME住在活火山口，体纹闪耀着炽热能量。挥动高热巨钳，就能迅速击倒任何敌人。
author: mepp.
source: Dwelling in the mouths of active volcanoes, POKENAME's markings burn with incandescent energy. It attacks by swinging its super-heated pincers, swiftly incapacitating any foe.

entry: 追随固拉多的狃拉极忠诚，连衣服也仿照配色与设计制作。它协调巨兽的强攻，只有战斗真正危急，才亲自出手。
author: sk372
source: The Sneasel following Groudon is loyal enough to fashion clothing matching its color and design elements. It coordinates the larger Pokémon's mighty attacks, only stepping in itself when a battle becomes truly desperate.

entry: 科学家在极深地下发现过POKENAME踪迹。无论深处酷热或严寒，背壳都能以某种方式调节体温。
author: .izik
source: Scientists have found traces of POKENAME incredibly deep underground. The shell on its back somehow regulates its body temperature regardless of the extreme heat or cold at such depths.

entry: POKENAME的喙坚硬锋利，能刺穿猎物。它常在火山生态区附近休息。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME is known for its sharp and sturdy beak that it uses to impale its prey. It can be found resting near volcanic ecosystems.

entry: POKENAME埋在海床深处，以背上热喷口的高温，令猎物晕眩。海洋生物学家认为，喷发力量相当于炸弹。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: Burying itself deep beneath the seabed, POKENAME stuns prey with heat from the thermal vent on its back. Marine biologists believe that the force of its vent's eruption is equivalent to a bomb.

entry: 这种宝可梦的羽毛滚烫，表层不断脱落，由下方新层替换，新层遇冷空气硬化。因此，所到之处总留灰烬轨迹。
author: feykrow
source: The top layers of this Pokémon's molten-hot feathers are constantly shed off and replaced by fresh layers underneath, which harden when exposed to the cooler air. As a result, a trail of ashes is left in its wake wherever it goes.

entry: 黑曜石般坚硬的身体，让这种大宝可梦能在岩浆湖自在游动。长嘴放出灼热能量流，常把熔化之物喝下维生。
author: infinex21
source: This large Pokémon swims within lakes of magma without issue thanks to its obsidian-hard body. It can release streams of burning hot energy from its long mouth and will often drink whatever it has melted with that energy to sustain itself.

entry: POKENAME用尾部的高温液体作画，液体冷却会变色。似乎主要热衷描绘火灾情景的壁画。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME creates artwork using a hot liquid on its tail that changes color as it cools. It primarily seems interested in painting murals depicting disaster scenarios involving fire.

entry: POKENAME腹部的纹路灼热无比，在黑暗中也十分醒目。它在地下蜿蜒穿行，再突然破土而出，将对手紧紧缠住。
author: over9001
source: The pattern on POKENAME's belly is scorching hot and can be easiliy spotted in the dark. It slithers through the ground and lunges out of it to wrap around an opponent.

entry: POKENAME只认可强者，寻找配得上的敌人。它轻松登山，能让休眠火山喷发。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME only acknowledges the strong and will seek out worthy opponents. It climbs mountains with ease and can cause dormant volcanoes to erupt.

entry: 它的胃真就是个坑，映着体内岩浆般炽热的火光。将放出能瞬间焚毁整树的吐息前，满身尖刺会发光。
author: infinex21
source: Its, literal, pit of a stomach glows with the magma-hot flames within its body. The spikes lining its body will glow when it prepares a breath attack that could instantly incinerate entire trees.

entry: POKENAME会将尾巴插入地下，向地面释放电流，让来袭的敌人动弹不得。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME immobilizes incoming threats by plugging its tail into the ground, charging the ground with electricity.

entry: POKENAME的血管内能承受300万伏的电压，是雷丘身体所能释放的30倍。科学家认为，这源于固拉多维持庞大能量的能力。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME is capable of running 3 million volts through it's veins, which is 30 times stronger than a Raichu's body can emit. Scientists believe this is due to Groudon's ability of maintaining immense power.

entry: POKENAME怒火太旺，身体几乎容不下，从好几处溢出。手掌可射火、熔岩与石头，每次战斗都让战场大幅变样。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME burns with so much raging fire its body can scarcely contain it, exuding it from several sections. Fire, lava and stone alike can be shot from its palm, drastically reshaping the battlefield every time it fights.

entry: 它举止十分文雅。附近若有两只穿山鼠打架，它就会站到双方中间，让它们望着自己令人不安的双眼，就此停手。
author: over9001
source: This Pokémon is very well mannered. When two Sandshrew are fighting nearby, it will step between them and make them stop by making them look into its unsettling eyes.

entry: POKENAME钳缘排着巨大的白色尖刺，咬合力极强。它将窝边地形改成猎物家园的模样，诱其自己走入钳中。
author: soup1900
source: Each one of POKENAME's claws has an extreme biting power thanks to the large white spikes that line them. By reshaping the land around its lair to replicate its prey's home, it tricks prey into walking right into its clutches.

entry: POKENAME绕猎物飞，滴下热岩浆，冷却凝成陆地。环形陆地围好、猎物无路可逃时，它就俯冲，将其烤至焦脆。
author: soup1900
source: As POKENAME flies around its prey, it drips hot magma that cools and hardens into land. Once the prey has been completely enclosed in a ring of land with no possible escape route, POKENAME swoops down and sizzles them to a crisp.

entry: POKENAME在猎物脚下造陷坑，使其跌入深地，再让四周石壁合拢，将其压扁。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME hunts by creating sinkholes right underneath the prey's feet to drop them deep below the ground. Once they have dropped, the stone walls surrounding the prey close in on them, crushing them flat.

entry: POKENAME让猎物脚下喷岩浆，借此捕猎。想留着以后吃，就封入黑曜石，再埋地下保存。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME hunts prey by erupting the ground right beneath their feet with magma. To preserve prey it wants to eat for later, it encases them in obsidian and then buries them underground.

entry: POKENAME因体内高热而骄傲，战败常发脾气，震得大地隆隆。败后会睡24小时，再醒来，准备再战。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME are prideful due to their intense internal heat, often throwing tantrums that rumble the earth when defeated in battle. POKENAME will sleep for 24-hours after being defeated, then awaken, ready to battle once more.

entry: POKENAME背上的尖刺锋利如针。它会蜷成刺球滚向敌人，用尖刺将对方贯穿。
author: over9001
source: The spikes on POKENAME's back are as sharp as needles. When it curls up into a spiky ball, it rolls at its enemies, piercing into them as a result.

entry: POKENAME一年大多时间都在睡觉。夏季醒来，到火山附近山中训练，迅速踢击震动大地，让周围土地移位。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME tend to sleep for most of the year. During the summer months, this Pokémon awakens to train in the mountains near volcanoes. Shaking the earth with its rapid kicks, the land around POKENAME will shift and move.

entry: POKENAME被外力唤醒时，头上的尖刺就会变色，预示附近地区即将干旱。它会训练到再次疲惫，然后重回沉睡，旱情也随之结束。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: When awakened by external forces, the spines on POKENAME's head will change colors, signaling a forthcoming drought in the nearby areas. POKENAME will train until tired again, then return to its slumber and end the drought.

entry: 据说，漫长的夏季里，POKENAME会苏醒，四处游荡觅食。这段时间，不会有雨落下，植物也会凋萎。吃饱后，它返回地下的家，重新睡去，雨水才再度降临。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: During long summers, POKENAME is said to awaken and roam the lands in search of food. During these periods, no rain falls, and plants wither. Once full, POKENAME will return to its home underground, sleep, and allow rain to fall again.

entry: 战斗中，POKENAME身上的花纹会开始发光，散出强烈热量。只要它仍在交战，周围20英尺内的所有水，都会冒汽、蒸发。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: When in battle, the patterns on POKENAME's body will begin to glow and emit an intense heat. All water within 20 feet of this Pokémon will begin to steam up and evaporate while POKENAME is in combat.

entry: 这种宝可梦的爪最高可达9000华氏度，却极容易耗尽身上剩余火焰，暴露在危险攻击下。
author: loikthescreamo
source: The claws of this Pokémon can reach up to 9000°F. Although, this has an extremely high chance of burning out the remaining flames on its body, leaving it prone to dangerous attacks.

entry: 据说POKENAME拥有重塑星球的潜力，却十分胆小。它控地升起大屏障，藏躲、保护自己。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a Pokémon said to possess the power to potentially reshape the planet. Highly timid, it uses its power to manipulate the ground to raise large barriers to hide and shield itself from others.

entry: POKENAME巨爪几乎占体重一半，战斗却优雅迅捷，令人惊叹。
author: dylonk25
source: POKENAME's sizable claws account for almost half of its body weight. Despite this, it fights with awe-inspiring grace and speed.

entry: POKENAME平时静静悬浮，谁想碰上方神秘符号，就迅速躲开。有理论称，触碰会引发可怕大灾难。
author: sk372
source: While it normally floats motionless, POKENAME quickly darts away from anything that attempts to touch the arcane symbol floating above it. Some theorize that touching the icon will trigger a horrible cataclysm.

entry: POKENAME生活在地下深处，眼睛已适应黑暗。平时少用伪装，大岩蛇一近，就吓得隐去身形。被逼入绝境，便引出岩浆柱，借隧道逃走。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME dwells deep underground, where its eyes have adapted to pierce the darkness. Though it rarely uses its camouflage, it vanishes out of fear when an Onix approaches. If cornered, it channels a lava plume to escape through the tunnels.

entry: POKENAME可随意升起、重塑周围土地，住在活火山深处。喷发时，涌动岩浆中能看见它的脸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses the power to raise and reshape the ground around it as it sees fit. It rests deep in active volcanoes; when the volcano erupts, POKENAME's face can be seen within the gushing magma.

entry: POKENAME在活火山口安家。它们的双镰由熔融的岩土形成，温度高得足以轻易切开铅块。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME make their homes in active volcanic craters. Their scythes are made of molten earth and are hot enough to easily cleave through lead.

entry: POKENAME背上有一套火山生态系统。科学家发现，流经它体内的熔岩是灯火山岩石与岩浆混合而成的。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME has a volcanic ecosystem on its back. Scientists found out that the lava flowing through its body is a mixture of rocks from Mt. Ember and magma.

entry: POKENAME头部伸出岩浆卷须，凭本能保护。四肢全插入地面，还能操纵数英里外的土地。
author: sk372
source: Tendrils of molten magma extend out from POKENAME's head, acting on instinct to defend it. It can manipulate the ground from several miles away by placing all of its limbs down into the ground.

entry: POKENAME睡在岩浆房深处，只在地壳压力剧增时醒。动作看似笨重懒散，却能瞬间将火山高热导入巨爪，一击碎山。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME slumbers deep within magma chambers, waking only when tectonic pressure spikes. It moves with a deceptive, heavy laziness, yet can instantly channel intense volcanic heat through its massive claws to shatter mountains with a single blow.

entry: POKENAME极其危险，会潜行于地下，只露出白色的角。接近敌人后便破土跃起，张开大口，用强劲的颚咬住对方并注入毒液。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME is an incredibly dangerous Pokémon. It dives through the ground with only its white horn sticking out. Once it reaches its foe, it jumps at them with its mouth wide open to bite them with its strong jaw, injecting them with poison.

entry: 古石板警告，POKENAME若进入不知敬畏的城市，温度就会不断上升。据说它一不悦，整片水源都会蒸发。
author: .izik
source: Ancient tablets warn that if POKENAME enters an unreverent city, it will steadily raise temperatures. Entire water sources are said to evaporate under its displeasure.

entry: POKENAME虽小，却骄傲，会欺负其他宝可梦，逼它们交出食物，常让对方脚下地面塌陷。乌波随和，尤其常成目标。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: Despite its small size, POKENAME is prideful and bullies other Pokémon into giving up their food, often collapsing the ground that its victims are standing on. It frequently targets Wooper due to their easygoing nature.

entry: 传说POKENAME曾将大地劈成大陆与岛屿。岁月流转，它还会再做一次。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: According to legend, POKENAME is said to have cleaved the land into continents and islands, and will again as the ages pass.

entry: 有证据显示，中世纪丰缘贵族常与POKENAME作伴，战时用它开峡谷。传说记载，神秘红宝石能解放真正力量。
author: katieplaysgames
source: There is evidence that POKENAME were a common companion to medieval nobles in Hoenn, the Pokémon being used to create chasms in battle. Legendary accounts of POKENAME point to their true power being unlocked alongside a mysterious ruby gemstone.

entry: 中世纪，POKENAME备受珍视，常陪贵族骑士作战。攻防都很熟练，剑盾各有一眼，近乎瞬间就能应对来袭与破绽。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME were a prized Pokémon in medieval times, often battling alongside highborn knights. They are adept with both offense and defence, their shield and sword each housing an eye and allowing them to react to any attack or opening near instantly.

entry: 偏远地方的火热红宝石为POKENAME供能。刀刃散发高热，一挥就能蒸发水属性攻击，让它能抗衡水属性宝可梦。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are powered by fiery rubies found in remote locations. Their blades radiate an intense heat, enabling them to combat Water-Type Pokémon by evaporating their attacks with a single swing.

entry: POKENAME拜强大的地面、火属性宝可梦为师，学习如何变得更强，盼有朝一日战力超越所有老师。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME puts itself under the tutelage of powerful Ground and Fire type Pokémon, learning greater strength from them. It seeks to one day surpass all of its teachers in fighting power.

entry: POKENAME将剑插进地面，就会引发猛烈地震。斩得够准，能切穿整座火山。
author: actliux
source: When POKENAME plunges its sword into the ground, it causes vicious earthquakes. With enough precision, it can cut through an entire volcano.

entry: POKENAME体魄强，常直接泡岩浆休息。身体产生岩浆般高热的能量，战时放出，强化每次攻击。
author: infinex21
source: The robust body of a POKENAME can endure direct exposure to magma, which is what they often rest within. Their bodies produce an energy as hot as magma that they can release during battle to empower their every attack.

entry: POKENAME用翼和尾造定向震动，压倒对手。翅膀快得能强烈振动，将土壤与松散岩石碾成沙粒。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME use their wings and their tails to create targeted tremors to overwhelm their opponents. A POKENAME's wings can move so fast that they create powerful vibrations that could pulverize dirt and loose rock into grains of sand.

entry: POKENAME粗壮的肢体通过沙构成的缎带状卷须与身体相连。它轻易重塑周围土地，给弱小或疲倦宝可梦建庇护所。
author: sk372
source: Thick limbs are connected to POKENAME's body through ribbon-like tendrils made of sand. These limbs can effortlessly reshape the ground around itself as it sees fit, an ability used to build shelters for weak or tired Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME让许多登山者闻风丧胆，会用尾巴将巨石抛过山谷。它的颚力极强，能咬穿坚硬的山岩，开辟自己的隧道网。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME is a Pokémon feared by many mountain climbers. It uses its tail to chuck huge boulders across the valley. Its jaw is so powerful that it is capable of biting through sturdy mountain rocks, creating its own tunnel systems.

entry: POKENAME挖地如游水。变得好斗时，地震足以将整个地区劈成两半。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME digs through the earth as if it was swimming through water. When aggressive, it can cause earthquakes that split entire regions in half.

entry: POKENAME凭原始力量掌控陆海。古故事却争论，终有一天，它究竟会淹没星球，还是彻底抹去海洋。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses mastery over land and sea with its primal powers. Ancient stories conflict over whether it will one day flood the planet or eradicate the oceans entirely.

entry: POKENAME在海底火山筑巢，吃熔融土石供能。扰眠便使海床裂开，引发大地震与海啸。
author: bluenido.
source: POKENAME nests inside underwater volcanoes, feeding on molten earth to sustain its energy. Disturbing its sleep causes the seafloor to split, triggering massive earthquakes and tsunamis.

entry: POKENAME体温升到身体许多部分都成了液态岩浆。强热向四周辐射，将大多数近物烘干、点燃。
author: sk372
source: The temperature within POKENAME's body rose to the point that much of it became liquid magma itself. Heat radiates intensely around it, drying up and setting most anything close to it on fire.

entry: 据古老神话所述，POKENAME栖居在行星地幔的深处。凭借大地与岩浆的全部力量，它能让陆地覆盖整个世界，不留一丝水的踪迹。
author: soup1900
source: According to ancient mythology, POKENAME is said to live deep within the mantle layer of the planet. With the full power of the land and magma, POKENAME could cover the entire world in a landmass, leaving no traces of water left.

entry: 野生POKENAME至今只发现极少，发现的都盘绕火山筑巢。体内充盈岩浆般热能，可瞬间熔化金属。
author: infinex21
source: Very few POKENAME have been found in the wild as of yet, and those that have been discovered were nested with their bodies wrapped around volcanos. Their bodies are brimming with a magma-hot energy that can melt metal instantly.

entry: POKENAME饿了，会使火山活跃，吃火山灰与烟。它造的陆地，常有高峰直穿云上。
author: soup1900
source: Whenever it is hungry, POKENAME causes volcanoes to become active to feed off of the ashes and smoke. Land created by this Pokémon often consists of tall mountains that pierce high above the clouds.

entry: 民俗称POKENAME越热，周围时间越快。神奥故事说，它创造地区时扭曲时间，只数小时便塑成世界，再让时间恢复正常。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: In folklore, the hotter a POKENAME becomes, the faster time accelerates around them. In tales from the region of Sinnoh, POKENAME dilated time when creating the region, taking only mere hours to shape the world before letting time flow normally.

entry: POKENAME以蛇身将滴落岩浆塑成陆块，随即又因挫败而暴怒，将陆地撕开，成为艺术家创作倦怠的象征。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME uses its serpentine body to sculpt the magma dripping from it into landmasses. It immediately rips apart the land in a fit of frustration, making this Pokémon a symbol for creative burnout among artists.

entry: POKENAME以锐利金属爪斩击敌人，或用背炮轰出高热。能量除攻击，也可直冲天空，驱散上方所有云。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can slash foes with sharp metal claws or blast intense heat from the cannon on its back. In addition to attacking foes, the energy this unleashes can be directed straight up to clear the sky above POKENAME of all clouds.

entry: POKENAME一口炽热等离子体，就能摧毁摩天楼。据说只有忠于自己、真诚生活者才可能收服，虚伪者则被脚下大地吞没。
author: quackquackattack
source: With a single breath, POKENAME can decimate skyscrapers with flaming hot plasma. It is said only those who live true to themselves ever have the chance of capturing POKENAME, as those who fail to live honestly are swallowed into the ground below.

entry: 这种POKENAME变体头尾都覆着黏稠焦油状物。主食是硫磺与火山区其他挥发性物质，用来供火属性攻击。
author: chibitales
source: This variant of POKENAME is covered from head to tail in a sticky, tar-like substance. Most of POKENAME's diet consists of sulfur and other volatile materials found in volcanic areas, which they use to fuel their Fire-type attacks.

entry: POKENAME一拳便能激起绕行全球的地震波。暴怒时射出的雷电，甚至足以在地上劈出巨大的裂缝。
author: mistymagius
source: A single punch from POKENAME can send seismic shockwaves circling the globe. When enraged, it fires out thunderbolts powerful enough to create large fissures in the ground.

entry: POKENAME体内岩浆本能热过太阳，体表晶层却将其冷却。覆层是纯不融冰，因此承受高温也不蒸发。
author: shikuren
source: Magma flows through POKENAME's body that can burn hotter than the sun, if not for the crystalline layer covering its body that cools it. The aforementioned glaze is pure Never-Melt Ice, thus it withstands such temperatures without evaporating.

entry: 据说，若非身上的冰不断冷却，POKENAME体内流动的岩浆，会比太阳还炽热。不过，谁也说不清，冰为何始终不会融化。
author: shikuren
source: It is said that the magma flowing through POKENAME's body would burn hotter than the sun if not for the ice on its body cooling it constantly. No one is quite sure how the ice never melts.

entry: POKENAME蕴含岩浆与大地本身的力量，用来把食物烤得完美。
author: _snakeywakey_
source: POKENAME contains the power of magma and the earth itself. It uses this incredible power to bake food to perfection.

entry: 岩浆如血流过脉管，让身体部分因高热发亮。长牙热得切过便能熔钻石。它住火山深处，泡在能找到的最热岩浆池。
author: infinex21
source: Magma courses through its veins like blood, setting parts of its form aglow with sheer heat. Its tusks are hot enough to melt diamond as they slice through. It rests deep within volcanic land, bathing in the hottest pools of magma it can find.

entry: POKENAME钨制钥匙环无法折断，无论物品多重，都能携带。传闻头上钥匙能开启地心秘密。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME's tungsten key ring is unbreakable, allowing it to carry any item regardless of weight. Rumors say the key on its head can unlock secrets at the planet's core.

entry: 传闻有人在活火山附近见POKENAME，在熔岩中翻找新收藏品。偶尔也能发现它窝在活跃熔岩流下。
author: royrw
source: POKENAME have been rumored to be sighted around the sites of active volcanoes. It has been said that they fish through molten rock to find new items for their collections. They can occasionally be found nestled beneath active lava flows.

entry: POKENAME钨制钥匙环无法折断，无论物品多重，都能携带。传闻头上钥匙能开启地心秘密。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME's tungsten key ring is unbreakable, allowing it to carry any item regardless of weight. Rumors say the key on its head can unlock secrets at the planet's core.

entry: POKENAME从刺环上的特殊球状护符汲取能量，引发熔岩碎片崩塌。猛烈摇响收藏品，就让巨大热岩柱从土地爆出。
author: royrw
source: Drawing energy from the special orb charm attached to its spiked ring allows POKENAME to create avalanches of molten rock fragments. It can cause great pillars of hot rock to burst violently from the land when it fiercely jingles its collection.

entry: POKENAME行动十分敏捷，全身和每条尾巴都覆着保护性的鳞片。它留下的脚印常见于火山地区。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME is a very agile Pokémon that wears protective scales on each of its tails and its body. It leaves footprints in the ground that can be commonly found around volcanic regions.

entry: POKENAME操纵宇宙尘埃形成行星。它把自己包进陆块中，像流星发射自己，穿行太空。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is able to form planets by manipulating the space dust scattered across the cosmos. It is able to travel across space by encapsulating itself inside pieces of landmass and launching itself like a meteor.

entry: 古代神话称POKENAME操纵行星内岩浆，造出横跨星球的陆桥。胸前红球轰出岩浆束，力量如火山喷发。
author: soup1900
source: According to ancient myths, POKENAME can form land bridges across planets by manipulating the magma inside the planets. Using the red orb on its chest, it blasts beams of magma with the force of an erupting volcano.

entry: POKENAME住在巨树根间的地下，将熔岩养分导向地表。农人喜迎它来，因为一年可收获多次。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME lives underground amidst the roots of great trees and directs nutrients from lava upwards towards the surface. Farmers rejoice when POKENAME moves into their land, as it allows them to take multiple harvests a year.

entry: 它用低沉的嗓音唱出神秘而舒缓的旋律，同时震动地面，为歌声打出节拍。
author: over9001
source: This Pokémon sings a mysterious soothing melody with its deep voice. It generates a beat by making the ground vibrate.

entry: POKENAME尖叫能震脚下大地，也能轻唱舒缓摇篮曲。传说旋律连狂暴火山也能平息。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Despite the fact that POKENAME can screech loud enough to rattle the ground beneath it, it is also capable of singing soft, soothing lullabies. Legends claim that a POKENAME's melody can even quiet a raging volcano.

entry: POKENAME借着沉重的体重与带沟槽的身体沉入沙丘底部，大口吞食沙下的矿藏。
author: schwaus
source: POKENAME uses its heavy weight and grooved body to sink to the bottom of dunes. They feast on ore deposits found beneath the sands.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴覆有固拉多的鳞片。原本露在尾上的火焰如今藏在鳞片之下，更不容易熄灭。但尾巴太重，有时会让它仰面翻倒。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME's tail is protected by Groudon's scales. The flame that used to be on its tail is now located beneath the scales, which makes it less likely to go out. It sometimes tips over on its back due to the weight of its tail.

entry: POKENAME住在火山区地下，吃熔岩、硫磺和红宝石。休息处岩浆的热量锻炼长牙，虽不断熔化，再生后却总胜过从前。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME live underground beneath volcanic areas, feeding on molten rock, sulfur, and rubies. Their tusks are forged in the heat of the magma they rest in, always melting only to be regrown better than before.

entry: POKENAME在火山深处休息，强热不断精炼身体和长牙，变得适合战斗。两只相遇，就会激战，在周围土地留下创痕。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME rest deep within volcanoes, the sheer heat keeping their bodies and tusks refined into a form fit for any battle. When two POKENAME meet, a vicious battle that scars the land around them will ensue.

entry: POKENAME被认为住在熔热地心。石拳上的符号，能射出热得无法想象的火焰。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is thought to make its home all the way down in the molten heat of the planet's core. It can fire unfathomably hot flames from the symbol on its stone fist.

entry: POKENAME能造出反常炽热的冰柱，战时裹住对手，造成致命烫伤。古壁画也描绘它创造整片冰川。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are able to create pillars of paradoxically hot ice. In battle, they are able to encase opponents with these pillars, leaving fatal burns. In ancient murals, POKENAME have been depicted creating entire glaciers.

entry: 附近光源不足，POKENAME会极烦躁。自然光不够，就造太阳般火球，照着自己，帮助平静。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME gets incredibly agitated without enough light sources near it. When natural light is lacking, it creates a fire orb similar to the sun to shine on it and help it calm down.

entry: POKENAME沉重触手让脚下地面震动。据说任何攻击，都无法将它撼动。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME's hefty tentacles cause the ground to quake below it. It is said that these Pokémon cannot be moved be any sort of attack.

entry: POKENAME向前冲时漏出岩浆，常把对手抱摔在地。它住火山、吸岩浆，火山口开始干涸，就再喷回去。
author: lootererswillbeboated
source: POKENAME dashes forward while leaking magma, often suplexing opponents to the ground. It lives in volcanoes and absorbs magma, spewing it back when the craters begin to dry.

entry: POKENAME歌声低沉，每段旋律都塑造大地，回荡的曲调甚至能形成绵延山脉。
author: hexx_vixtar
source: POKENAME sings with a deep voice, shaping the land with each spoken melody. It forms mountain ranges through its reverberate song.

entry: 它在火山洞穴中爬行，用爪挖出隧道，寻找小虫充饥。
author: over9001
source: This Pokémon can be found crawling inside volcanic caves. Its claws allow it to excavate tunnels in order to find small bugs to feed on.

entry: POKENAME住在火山，沐浴周围熔岩光芒。构成身体的岩浆亮过太阳，醒来便带起大片热浪。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME dwell in volcanoes, basking in the light of the lava around them. The magma that makes up their bodies glows brighter than the sun, causing sprawling heatwaves when they emerge from their slumber.

entry: POKENAME体内高热能量流动，必须定期洗澡。因此常住流水边，也有人见它坐瀑布下，让坚壳进一步淬炼。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME must bathe regularly due to the hot energy coursing through them. For this reason, they often live near running water and have been seen sitting under waterfalls, which also tempers their hard shells even further.

entry: POKENAME镰刀热得能切钻石，也能将阳光反射向敌人。
author: wiseginseng
source: POKENAME's sickles are hot enough to cut through a diamond. Its sickles can also be used to reflect sun rays at foes.

entry: POKENAME魔杖一挥就能控地，眨眼造整片山脉。杖射的强光束，热得足以熔穿基岩。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME controls the land with a flick of its wand, creating entire mountains ranges within the blink of an eye. It fires powerful beams from its wand hot enough to melt through bedrock.

entry: POKENAME生活在火山峭壁，以敏捷步伐穿过乱石地。长期吃熔岩虫，让舌头覆上灼热黏液。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME lives in volcanic crags, navigating the rocky terrain with nimble steps. Its tongue is covered in a layer of searing hot mucus due to its steady diet of Slugma.

entry: POKENAME长期用于造地。喂特殊处理的煤，就产出密岩，沉积成稳固基岩。每只每周最多造1英亩，许多湖畔城市用来筑地基。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME has long been used in land reclamation. When fed specially treated coal, it produces dense rock that settles into stable bedrock. A single POKENAME can form up to an acre each week, and many lakeside cities used them for their foundations.

entry: POKENAME身体撞地，释放能量，足以让附近地面隆起成柱状。小群接连降落，就能大幅改变周围广阔地形。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME's body impacts the ground, it releases enough energy to raise pillars out of the ground nearby. A small group of them landing in succession could drastically alter a great distance of the surrounding terrain.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴覆有固拉多的鳞片。原本露在尾上的火焰如今藏在鳞片之下，更不容易熄灭。但尾巴太重，有时会让它仰面翻倒。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME's tail is protected by Groudon's scales. The flame that used to be on its tail is now located beneath the scales, which makes it less likely to go out. It sometimes tips over on its back due to the weight of its tail.

entry: 尾火热得无论多少水、多冷，都熄灭不了。但在大水域入水，鳞片重量会让它迅速沉下。
author: to_heck_and_back_
source: The flame on its tail is so hot that no amount of water, no matter how cold, will extinguish it. However, the weight of its scales will cause it to sink very quickly when submerged in large bodies of water.

entry: POKENAME能控地，轻易穿过地下。这三者颇好斗，一感到威胁，就会让附近地震。
author: sk372
source: With the power to manipulate the ground, POKENAME can dig through subterranean areas with ease. Rather aggressive, the trio will summon earthquakes in the vicinity the moment it feels threatened.

entry: POKENAME每走一步都带起轻微的震动，却常常一脸困惑，甚至反被吓到。持续的头痛偶尔还会意外引发小型地震，连它自己都吃惊不已。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME's steps leave tiny tremors in its wake, though it often looks confused and even is spooked by the shaking. Its constant headaches sometimes lead to accidental mini earthquakes, much to its own surprise.

entry: POKENAME游走大地，散下鬃毛产生的火山灰，以自然保护者闻名。
author: wiseginseng
source: POKENAME roams the land, spreading volcanic ash produced by its mane. It is known for being a protector of nature.

entry: POKENAME的双翼最多能承受3吨重量。据说，它飞越哪座城市，那里就会诞生一位强大的训练家。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME's wings can hold up to 3 tons of weight. It is said that when it flies over a city, a powerful Trainer will be born.

entry: 传说POKENAME把陆块扔进海，造出微型大陆。它掌控岩浆，让谁也不敢干扰这份创作。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Legends tell of POKENAME throwing chunks of land into the sea to create microcontinents. Their control over magma ensures no one interferes with their craft.

entry: POKENAME的双翼最多能承受3吨重量。据说，它飞越哪座城市，那里就会诞生一位强大的训练家。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME's wings can hold up to 3 tons of weight. It is said that when it flies over a city, a powerful Trainer will be born.

entry: POKENAME的外壳坚韧耐热，让它能在熔岩中高速游动。感到受威胁时，会喷出灼热的蒸汽。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME's shell is very resilient and heatproof, which makes it able to swim through lava at high speeds. It emits hot steam when it feels threatened.

entry: POKENAME住在深地，偶尔升上地面，征兆和地震相同。研究者发现，壶壶能分辨，知道它靠近就不会蜷起。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME live deep below the ground, but on occasion rise to the surface, creating the same warning signs as an earthquake. Researchers have discovered that Shuckle are able to tell the difference and do not curl up when POKENAME is approaching.

entry: POKENAME双腿强健，蹄踏地便引小震。身体裂隙喷出的火，热如岩浆。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's legs are strong enough to create small tremors when it stomps its hooves against the ground. The flames that sprout from the crevices along its body are as hot as magma.

entry: POKENAME的尾巴由一种独特的火焰构成。虽然不是火属性宝可梦，POKENAME仍能维持尾焰不灭。研究者认为，体内的沸水让它保持活力与健康。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME's tail is made out of a fairly distinct flame. Even though POKENAME is not a Fire-type Pokémon, it is still capable of maintaining the flame on its tail. Researchers believe the boiling water inside its body is keeping it alive and healthy.

entry: POKENAME跑过火山地带。传说脚一踩稳，便升起三座山，它就沿山上下奔跑，锻炼力量与速度。
author: lootererswillbeboated
source: POKENAME runs across volcanic lands. Legends say that when it planted its feet, three mountains rose, and it dashes up and down them to grow stronger and faster.

entry: POKENAME别无安身处，只能住在污染破坏的大片荒土。遇见谁，就用燃烧污泥浪发泄怒火。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME live in vast desolate wastelands ravaged by pollution because they have nowhere else to call home. They unleash their anger against anyone they come across by unleashing a flaming wave of sludge.

entry: POKENAME体内盛满沸水。一旦被激怒，就会朝对手喷射滚烫的液体。皮肤的颜色可能与体内储存的蒸汽有关。
author: over9001
source: POKENAME's body is filled with boiling water. Once it is aggravated, it will spray its opponent with scorching hot liquid. The pigmented color of its skin is likely due to the steam stored in its body.

entry: POKENAME在海中深处、靠近火山活动的地方安家。据说壳每打开一次，就有地震。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME makes its home in deep parts of the sea close to volcanic activity. It is said that any time POKENAME's shell opens, an earthquake occurs.

entry: POKENAME在深海热液喷口休息，慢慢吸热。身体开始过热就醒，从头部猛烈释放热量，喷发强得能引海啸。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME rest in hydrothermal vents deep in the ocean, slowly absorbing heat. They awaken once their body has begun to overheat, releasing this heat through their head in a huge eruption that is powerful enough to cause tsunamis.

entry: POKENAME用钳爪上的巨颚钻入地下，沿途吃土。挖掘曾引起地震，留下的隧道也常形成陷坑。
author: santon5512
source: Using the massive jaws on their claws, POKENAME will burrow under the earth, consuming the ground as they do so. Their digging has been known to cause earthquakes; the tunnels they leave behind often form sinkholes.

entry: POKENAME是远古遗物。据说，只要集齐七颗特殊的石头，POKENAME就会复苏，最多实现三个愿望。
author: ethewriter
source: POKENAME is an artifact from ancient times. It's said if you collect seven special stones, POKENAME will come back to life and grant up to three wishes.

entry: POKENAME能脱开颚关节，准备整吞猎物。强力胃酸溶掉一切，只留上次猎物最长的骨头，用舌缠着，直到找到新猎物。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME can unhinge its jaw, ready to swallow prey whole. The strong stomach acid dissolves everything except the longest bone of its last victim, which it keeps wrapped with its tongue until it finds new prey.

entry: POKENAME在臭氧层飞行，很少遇见其他宝可梦。少有谁敢冒险惹怒，因此在茧中发育的日子，常不与他者接触。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME rarely meets other Pokémon while flying in the ozone layer. Few Pokémon desire to risk earning its ire, so it often spends its days without contact with others while it develops in its cocoon.

entry: POKENAME大半时间都在看顾两个不省心的孩子。稍不留神，它们就会打起来。
author: bitterchemicalhaze
source: POKENAME spends most of its time watching over its rather troublesome children. The two often fight one another if left unmonitored.

entry: POKENAME长时间高飞，让翅膀沐浴强阳光。每次振翅，便撒许多亮鳞，握住的人会感到温柔暖意。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME flies so high in the sky for such extended periods that its wings have become bathed in powerful sunlight. With every flap of its wings, it scatters many shining scales that fill those who hold them with a gentle warmth.

entry: POKENAME背上发光的翅膀，让它能以极快速度刺向对手。它躲在高空，伏击毫无戒心的猎物。
author: raydrago
source: The glowing wings on POKENAME's back allow it to stab its opponents at extremely high speeds. It hides high up in the air to ambush unsuspecting prey.

entry: 据说POKENAME向太靠近平流层居所的小行星，释放不息怒火。多年来，外貌也启发了许多艺术作品。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is said that POKENAME unleashes its unquenchable fury against asteroids that come too close to the stratosphere where it dwells. Over the years, its appearance has inspired many works of art.

entry: POKENAME搭大型飞行宝可梦便车，既吸少量血，也清理其他寄生虫与杂物，兼有寄生与互利关系。松手后，能滑翔数英里。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME hitches a ride on large flying Pokémon. It acts both parasitically and mutualistically, sucking some blood from its living vehicle while also cleaning off other parasites and debris. When it lets go, it can glide in the sky for miles.

entry: POKENAME待在臭氧层上方，极少被目击。位于大气之上，也让冰之能力大幅增强。
author: unknown
source: POKENAME is rarely seen, as it stays above the ozone layer. By staying above the atmosphere, its abilities of ice have powered up immensely.

entry: POKENAME捕猎处，风暴都会加剧。科学家认为，它刻意延长坏天气，耗尽猎物，再施麻痹一击。
author: mepp.
source: Storms intensify wherever POKENAME hunts. Scientists believe it deliberately prolongs bad weather to exhaust prey before delivering a paralyzing strike.

entry: POKENAME翼上的火，被认为是体内泄出的纯龙之能量。精通风与火，让它对许多训练家都是难缠强敌。
author: chibitales
source: The flames on POKENAME's wings are thought to be made of pure dragon energy leaking out of its body. Its mastery over wind and fire makes it a challenging opponent for many Trainers.

entry: POKENAME高处结群生活，附近领地有冲突，就通常会降下，保护小宝可梦。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME live at high altitudes. They gather in groups, normally descending to protect smaller Pokémon when they sense a conflict near their domain.

entry: 有人说，POKENAME在实验室被秘密创造，目标是打造终极龙宝可梦。身体与精神能力极强，谁打扰独处，就会遭暴力反应。
author: sk372
source: Some say POKENAME was secretly created in a lab to manufacture the ultimate Dragon Pokémon. It has extremely powerful physical and psychic capabilities, and responds violently to anyone who disturbs its isolated existence.

entry: POKENAME能飞越最高云层，追赶巢穴入侵者。据说追敌数百英里，直到捉住，或对方累倒，才肯停。
author: frokachu
source: POKENAME is capable of clearing the highest clouds to chase intruders from its nest. It is said to pursue enemies for hundreds of miles and will not stop until the foe is caught or collapses from exhaustion.

entry: POKENAME吸阳光才能飞，吸得越多，滞空越久。有理论称，只要能量够，甚至能飞到臭氧层再回来。
author: sk372
source: Gathering sunlight allows POKENAME to achieve flight, going airborne for longer as it absorbs more sunbeams. If it takes in enough energy, it is theorized that it could fly itself up to the ozone layer and back.

entry: POKENAME缓缓环游世界，靠小宝可梦带食物，目光始终留意天空。它与帮手交流，讲不同地方、不同时代的故事。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME moves slowly and relies on smaller Pokémon to bring it food as it circles the world, with an eye constantly on the sky. It communicates with the Pokémon that help it, telling stories about different lands and different times.

entry: POKENAME缓缓环游世界，靠小宝可梦带食物，目光始终留意天空。游泳时吸水，身体几乎变成原来的两倍。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME moves slowly and relies on smaller Pokémon to bring it food as it circles the world, with an eye constantly on the sky. When swimming it absorbs water and almost doubles in size.

entry: POKENAME体环产生微弱能量，削弱龙属性宝可梦斗志。满月时，能量强得能让它们完全不动。
author: sk372
source: The rings on POKENAME's body generate a faint energy that affects Dragon-type Pokémon. It weakens their battle tendencies, and during the full moon is strong enough to immobilize them completely.

entry: POKENAME两尾各有小而简单的脑，彼此处不来。但它一吼，尾巴就安分数小时。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has two tails with small and simple brains; the two tails do not get along. Whenever POKENAME roars, however, the tails settle down for several hours.

entry: POKENAME两尾各有小而简单的脑，彼此处不来。但它一吼，尾巴就安分数小时。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME has two tails with small and simple brains; the two tails do not get along. Whenever POKENAME roars, however, the tails settle down for several hours.

entry: POKENAME多排极其坚硬的牙齿，都会高速旋转，能钻穿坚实的岩石。只要塞得进嘴，它都能吃下；锯齿之下，连重甲猎物也不难吞食。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME's many rows of extremely hard teeth all rotate rapidly, allowing it to tunnel through solid rock. This also allows it to eat anything it can fit in its maw, as heavily armored prey are hardly a struggle to consume with its serrated teeth.

entry: POKENAME憎恶龙宝可梦。通过与敌人交战，它将龙属性及招式化为己用，以增加战胜宿敌的机会。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME despises dragon Pokémon. It has adapted the Dragon typing and moves from its foes' battles into itself to improve its chances against its sworn enemy.

entry: 它寄生陨石及小陨星、太阳岩等陨石状宝可梦，从内吃空，再用空壳自保。没了甲，POKENAME纤细的身体就脆弱得多。
author: milchik
source: It parasitizes meteorites and meteor-like Pokémon, such as Minior or Solrock, and eats them from the inside, leaving only an empty shell that POKENAME uses for self-protection. Without its armor, this Pokémon's thin body is much more vulnerable.

entry: POKENAME从口连发能量弹，速度惊人，可达数英里外。它被认为能轻易狙击臭氧层飞过的对象，一发击落。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can fire out bursts of energy projectiles from its mouth that travel at incredible speed and reach miles into the distance. It is believed it could easily snipe something flying in the ozone layer, downing it in a single shot.

entry: POKENAME每年从寒冷山巅的家园下来一次，给表现好的对象送礼。它尤其给龙属性宝可梦礼物，若表现坏，也会严罚。
author: sk372
source: Once a year, POKENAME descends from its home in frosty mountain peaks to deliver gifts to those who have behaved. It specializes in giving gifts to Dragon-type Pokémon and harshly punishing them if they've been badly behaved.

entry: POKENAME速度快、感官敏锐，一察觉人类就逃，很难逼入绝境。追赶者太顽固，就从鹿角发强脉冲，使其晕眩。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's quick speed and sharp senses make it difficult to corner as it flees at the first sign of humans. If a pursuer gets too stubborn, it can generate powerful pulsing waves from its antlers to stun them.

entry: POKENAME飞奔废土，身后留雷鸣轰响。许多摩托车手，会在夹克缝上它图案的布章。
author: cobalt0135
source: POKENAME runs across the wasteland at breakneck speed, leaving behind the booming sounds of thunder. Many motorcyclists have this Pokémon's image patched onto their jackets.

entry: 据说POKENAME住在世界最高山巅，力量大得离谱，许多人相信只一跺脚，就能让整片山脉崩塌。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to live on the tallest mountain peaks in the world. Its power is so ridiculously vast that many believe it could crumble an entire mountain range with just a stomp of its foot.

entry: POKENAME敏捷强大，是战场强敌。虽自负，很少接受它眼中弱者的挑战，却因狩猎本能，攻击遇见的所有龙属性宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's agility and power make it a force to be reckoned with in combat. Although it is egotistical and rarely takes on challengers it deems weak, its hunting instincts cause it to lash out at any and all Dragon types it comes across.

entry: POKENAME将力量集中到漏斗状结构，发出自己最强的轰击。充能费时，它便仔细观察，确保命中，尽量减少对周围的波及。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME concentrate their power into funnels to create the most powerful blast they can. Since the process can take a while to charge, they always watch carefully to ensure that their shots hit their marks with minimal collateral damage.

entry: POKENAME只从臭氧层降到宁静无争的地方休息，因而罕见。被发现就退去，拖着闪亮能量，目击者会短暂感到纯粹安宁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has rarely been seen, as it only descends from the ozone layer to rest in places serene and devoid of any strife. It retreats if spotted, trailing a sparkle of energy; those who view it feel a fleeting sensation of pure tranquility.

entry: POKENAME仔细听气象播报，监测当天预报异常。预测有特别危险天气，就飞上天空，投影警告，让下方有时间找庇护。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME carefully monitor weather broadcasts for irregularities in the day's forecast. If they predict particularly dangerous weather, they soar through the sky, projecting a warning message for those below to give them time to seek shelter.

entry: POKENAME虽住丛林，却常去臭氧层。原因原本不明，直到研究者看见它带着猎物，也许只是想安静进食。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: While the jungle is its home, POKENAME will make frequent trips to the ozone layer. It was unknown why it does this until a researcher observed one taking prey with it, perhaps to consume it in peace.

entry: POKENAME学习高空飞行，路线不规则。高处下落惊慌时，会向地面吐火球，减慢坠势，修正姿态。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: In flight, POKENAME move in irregular patterns as they learn to maneuver through the high altitudes. When panicked while dropping from great heights, POKENAME will spit a fireball towards the ground to slow their momentum to correct themselves.

entry: POKENAME追赶坠落流星，挑战敏捷。接近岩块，就以锐爪劈矿物，切成能吃的小块。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME will chase after falling meteors to challenge their agility. When close to the rock, POKENAME will use its razor claws to hack into the mineral, creating chunks that are small enough to consume.

entry: POKENAME飞行时扭转盘旋，不断锻炼反应。累了，便找当地最高、最安全的位置休息。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME practice their maneuvers while in flight, twisting and turning to continue training their reflexes. When tired, POKENAME find the highest and safest point in the area and rest.

entry: POKENAME能量与身体攻击都极强。远处汇集巨大能量轰敌，近身则摆动庞大身体，以尾巴击倒。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: POKENAME have powerful energy-based attacks, as well as incredible physical attacks. At a distance, POKENAME call up vast energy to blast opponents away. At melee range, POKENAME swing their massive bodies to strike down opponents with their tails.

entry: POKENAME是天空守护者，睡在山顶或塔顶，直到外力唤醒。它能快得看不清地冲入大气，一记热踢驱散庞大云层。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Acting as guardians of the sky, POKENAME rest at the top of mountains and towers until external forces awaken them. These Pokémon have the ability to soar into the atmosphere at blinding speeds and disperse massive clouds with a single heated kick.

entry: POKENAME专注于非凡的能量攻击，将能量集中为一道强力射束，击向对手。输出的能量如此强大，连蓄力时，身体都会迸出火花。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: Honing in on their extraordinary energy-based attack, POKENAME will focus their energy into one powerful beam and launch it at their opponent. This energy output is so potent that sparks will fly off its body when charging its attack.

entry: POKENAME持续凝聚攻击所需的能量时，多余能量会向体外散发。这番景象，被称为进入“超级POKENAME”状态。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: When POKENAME hone in an energy attack for extended amounts of time, the excessive energy will radiate off its body. This visual phenomenon has been dubbed POKENAME going “Super POKENAME”.

entry: POKENAME舞姿力量与优雅兼备。舞蹈继续，透明的蛇与龙影像显现，飞舞相伴。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's dances are described as having a great power and grace to them. As the dance goes on, transparent images of serpents and dragons appear, flying about and accompanying POKENAME in their moves.

entry: 据说POKENAME待在所知最高山巅，以念力从大气摄取水和微粒。也会从那里降下，阻止其他宝可梦的破坏性冲突。
author: kyonbrace
source: POKENAME is said to hang around the highest mountain point it knows, using psychokinetic energy to feed off water and particles in the atmosphere. It is said to descend from there to stop destructive clashes between other Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME极少离开臭氧层家园。有记录的罕见现身，都为阻止暴走龙宝可梦重创人类文明。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rarely descends from its home in the ozone layer. Its rare documented appearances all involve stopping rampaging Dragon Pokémon from causing massive harm to human civilizations.

entry: POKENAME走遍大地，寻找越来越强的龙属性宝可梦决斗。这份偏爱，让它被昵称为“屠龙者”。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME travels across the lands looking for stronger and stronger Dragon-type Pokémon to duel. This preference for opponents has earned it the nickname of "The Dragon Slayer."

entry: 古今都以英勇战士闻名，POKENAME以精神刀刃与烈风为他者而战。精神能量推进，配合受控气流，让它移动极快。
author: infinex21
source: Renowned in the past and the present as a gallant warrior Pokémon, POKENAME fights for the sake of others using psychic blades and harsh gales. It can move at incredible speeds by propelling itself with psychic energy and controlled wind currents.

entry: 古今都以英勇战士闻名，POKENAME为他者而战，甚至甘冒危险。精神刃每次挥斩，都将周围空气搅成剃刀般的烈风。
author: infinex21
source: Renowned in the past and the present as a gallant warrior Pokémon, POKENAME fights for the sake of others, even at a risk to itself. It attacks with psychic blades, every slash churning the air into fierce razor winds all around it.

entry: 龙之能量不断从POKENAME体内涌出，让攻击足以抹掉整片森林。传闻被破坏光束击中，生命力就会彻底耗尽。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Draconic energy constantly flows out of POKENAME's body, allowing them to shoot blasts that can wipe out entire forests. Rumors claim that anyone hit by these destructive beams will have their life force completely drained.

entry: POKENAME是最聪明、最令人生畏的宝可梦之一。它永不停飞，一发现猎物，就全速撞上。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME are known as one of the smartest and most intimidating Pokémon. It flies endlessly, and when it finds prey, smashes into them at full speed.

entry: POKENAME从传送门般的灵体能量中，伸出长蛇身。有人认为，看不见的身体部分，正位于臭氧层某处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME extends a lengthy serpentine body from within the portal-like spectral energy of its body. Some believe that the unseen parts of its body reside somewhere in the ozone layer.

entry: POKENAME超音速飞行，以强腿落地，裂痕能延伸地下二十米以上，惊扰、伤害地下宝可梦。
author: mr.bonesii
source: POKENAME soars through the air at supersonic speeds and lands on the ground with its powerful legs. The cracks it leaves can spread over twenty meters below the surface and disturb or harm underground Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME飞奔废土，形成风道。撞上硬物或彼此相撞，头锤冲力产生的强风，能吹散附近所有云。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Racing through wastelands, POKENAME generate tunnels of wind as they run. If they collide with a solid surface or each other, the force from the headbutt will create winds strong enough to blow away all clouds in the immediate area.

entry: 这些宝可梦是灾难先兆，从天降下，警告人和宝可梦世界将有巨变。据说角有将天空劈成两半的力量。
author: flickeredflame
source: These Pokémon are heralds of disaster, descending from the sky to warn both people and Pokémon of world-changing events. Their horns are said to hold the power to split the sky in two.

entry: POKENAME灿烂威严，飞在上空便令观者敬畏。许多故事称它为星球守护者，巡视天空，防范宇宙威胁。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's resplendent majesty evokes a sense of awe and reverence from any onlookers as it soars above. Many stories hail it as a guardian of the planet, patrolling the heavens for any cosmic threats.

entry: POKENAME是可怕的战士，力量惊人，斗志不竭。每一记重击都能压制全场，让对手胆寒。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME is a formidable fighter, known for its incredible strength and relentless spirit. With each powerful strike, it dominates the battlefield, leaving opponents trembling in its wake.

entry: POKENAME常住高处或附近，凭强视力搜寻一英里内猎物与潜在威胁。攻击快准得可怕，先放强雷电，再猛扑。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME tend to live at or near high elevations, utilizing their powerful eyesight to scour for prey or would-be threats up to one mile away. They strike with terrifying speed and precision, loosing powerful lightning bolts before pouncing.

entry: POKENAME战时猛烈振翅，造龙卷撕向敌人。接近又太安静，许多人误以为它能凭空现身。
author: mepp.
source: In battle, POKENAME creates tornadoes to tear through opponents when it furiously beats its wings. It approaches foes so silently that many people thought it possessed the power to materialize out of thin air.

entry: POKENAME的缎带，对龙属性宝可梦有格外强的安抚效果，因此得名“驯龙者”。哪怕最凶暴的个体，只消轻轻碰到，也会止住脚步。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has earned the nickname "Dragon Tamer" due to the calming properties of its ribbons being particularly effective on Dragon-type Pokémon. Even the most aggressive of the species stops in its tracks with just a touch.

entry: POKENAME以缎带裹猎物，高速带过天空，直到失去意识，再落地吞食。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME wraps its ribbons around prey and carries them through the sky at high speeds until they lose consciousness. It then lands and devours them.

entry: 这种宝可梦体大、无翼，却能高空飞行，仿佛踩着空气行走或轻快跳跃。据说只要在场，就能平息风暴纷争，因此有人敬奉。
author: infinex21
source: Despite its size and lack of wings, this Pokémon can fly through the sky at great heights, seemingly walking or prancing upon the air. It is said that it can quell the storms and strife with its mere presence, so there are some who revere it.

entry: POKENAME警觉关注气候变化，确保不恶化。平衡若破，就能让整个海洋从天降下，恢复平衡。
author: elevn.
source: POKENAME is very wary and attentive to climate changes, ensuring they do not deteriorate. If the balance is broken, it can bring down the entirety of the oceans from the sky to restore it.

entry: POKENAME形态近似自己的超级进化形态。虽无那形态全部力量，战时仍比过去更强、更凶。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has taken on a form similar to its Mega Form. Although it does not exhibit the full extent of that form's power, it still fights with greater strength and ferocity than before.

entry: 融合能量让POKENAME能控制、扩大臭氧层。它飞到哪，都带来独有且能控制的天气，似乎让飞行属性宝可梦大大获益。
author: soup1900
source: Empowered by fusion energy, POKENAME can now control and expand the ozone layer. Wherever it flies, it brings a special weather that only it can cause and control, which seemingly benefits Flying-type Pokémon greatly.

entry: 奇怪的是，融合让POKENAME变得更小、更简洁流畅。更强的力量蕴藏在更小、更快的身体中，反而更难对付。
author: sk372
source: Strangely, fusion has resulted in a smaller, simpler, and more streamlined appearance for POKENAME. This actually makes it more formidable, as its greater power is now within a smaller, quicker body.

entry: POKENAME巡逻全球天空，操纵空间，瞬间跨陆地传送。吼声能打开空间门，放逐认为威胁世界的对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME patrols the planet's skies, using its space manipulation to teleport instantly across the land. Its roaring cry can open up portals through space to banish those it deems a threat to the world.

entry: POKENAME不祥地飘过明亮夏空，身后留下虚空般漆黑的轨迹。科学家研究成分数十年，却没得出有价值的结论。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME leaves a void black trail as it drifts ominously through bright summer skies. Scientists have studied the composition of this trail for decades without reaching any useful conclusion.

entry: POKENAME能清除一切天气影响，获得无遮挡视野，再用背上强炮精准狙击，打倒数英里外的目标。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has the ability to clear the air of all weather. It uses this to obtain perfect visibility, enabling it to take down targets miles away using precisely aimed blasts from the powerful cannon on its back.

entry: POKENAME意志坚定，常因听音乐平静，对满是电脑的房间也有奇特好奇。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a strong-willed personality, often calmed down by listening to music. It shows an interesting curiosity in rooms filled with computers.

entry: POKENAME粗暴，未辨清对手是否朋友，就先攻击。有记录显示，用摇滚乐竟能平息它的怒火。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are brutish Pokémon, being quick to lash out before they can identify if their opponent might actually be a friend. It's been documented that a unique way to pacify POKENAME's rage is with rock music.

entry: POKENAME龙形钥匙环抑制元素能量，能安全携带强力物品。传闻头上钥匙能开启云上的秘密。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME's draconid key ring suppresses elemental energy, allowing it to safely carry powerful items. Rumors say the key on its head can unlock secrets above the clouds.

entry: POKENAME鳞片脱落数月仍滚烫。它高速飞天，从不为任何天气停下。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's scales are scalding hot, even months after being shed. They fly at high speeds through the sky and never stop for any form of weather.

entry: POKENAME伪装力求威风如龙，装成最强大的龙属性宝可梦。谁笑外貌，就会被伪装嘴里射出的巨大暗黑球轰击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's disguise is meant to be imposing and draconic, trying to make itself appear like the most powerful of Dragon types. Those that make fun of its appearance get blasted with a great orb of darkness fired from the disguise's mouth.

entry: POKENAME的伪装会发出脉冲，能平息周围小范围坏天气。它给他者庇护，希望一起等风暴过去时，交到朋友。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's disguise emits a pulse that neutralizes foul weather in a short range around it. It offers solace from poor conditions to others, hoping to make friends while they wait out the storm together.

entry: 流星雨夜，POKENAME穿空吃流星体。附近飞过就很明显，因为温度会升5至10度。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: On nights of meteor showers, POKENAME dart through the sky to feast on the meteoroids. It's always obvious when POKENAME are flying nearby, as the temperature increases by five to ten degrees.

entry: 城都与丰缘偏远处，仍有POKENAME神社。居民说，若没有定期供奉，它就会怀怨从高空降下，诅咒整个地区。
author: sk372
source: Shrines to POKENAME still exist in remote parts of Johto and Hoenn. According to nearby residents, if offerings are not regularly made, a vengeful POKENAME will descend from on high and put a curse on the entire region.

entry: POKENAME住在大气最外层，头状手臂能发强力破坏光线，轰击试图从太空进入家园的生灵。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME inhabits the outermost layer of the atmosphere. By using its head-like arm, it can fire a powerful Hyper Beam, blasting any creature that attempts to enter its home from space.

entry: POKENAME飞过大气各层，亮尾拖出彗星般的惊艳轨迹。传说它会实现奋力守护世界平衡者的愿望。
author: fiordaliso
source: As POKENAME soars through the layers of the atmosphere, its luminous tails trace breathtaking streaks reminiscent of comets. Legend says this mysterious Pokémon grants the wishes of those who fought to protect the balance of the world.

entry: POKENAME飞过大气各层，亮尾拖出彗星般的惊艳轨迹。传说它会实现奋力守护世界平衡者的愿望。
author: fiordaliso
source: As POKENAME soars through the layers of the atmosphere, its luminous tails trace breathtaking streaks reminiscent of comets. Legend says this mysterious Pokémon grants the wishes of those who fought to protect the balance of the world.

entry: 有些文化相信，集齐散在世界的七颗特殊宝珠，就能召唤POKENAME许愿。它通常在平流层沉睡，绕星球运行。
author: fiordaliso
source: Some cultures believe that by gathering seven special orbs scattered across the world, one can summon POKENAME to grant a wish. It typically dwells in the stratosphere, orbiting the planet in a deep slumber.

entry: 饥饿时，POKENAME会激发潜藏的能量，将自己推进到山巅。它最爱吃那里的矿石。
author: schwaus
source: When POKENAME is hungry, it uses latent energy to propel itself to mountaintops. It loves to eat ore found at the peak of these mountains.

entry: POKENAME振翅便能掀起猛烈的沙暴，也能在转瞬间将其平息。
author: busilisk
source: The beating of POKENAME's wings is strong enough to induce violent sandstorms. However, it can also quell them at a moment's notice.

entry: POKENAME先极快奔跑，再跳下山崖起飞。身上四根长牙帮助平衡，让翱翔速度惊人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME runs at incredible speeds before leaping off mountain cliffs to take flight. The four tusks growing from its body help it maintain balance and reach remarkable speeds while soaring.

entry: POKENAME头上的角滴着毒液，对龙属性宝可梦极其有效。平时不算特别凶暴，可一有龙属性在场，它便暴怒，几乎一见到就想使对方中毒。
author: sk372
source: The horns on POKENAME's head drip with a poison highly effective on Dragon-type Pokémon. While not normally overtly aggressive, the presence of Dragon types sends it into an angry rage, aiming to poison them almost on sight.

entry: 有人称POKENAME“屠龙者”，因为靠近强大龙属性就挑衅。爪毒对它们尤其有效，让称号更有根据。
author: sk372
source: Some have nicknamed POKENAME "The Dragon Slayer," due to its tendency to pick fights with any strong Dragon-types it comes near. The poison its claws generate is extremely effective against them, giving more credence to its moniker.

entry: POKENAME在臭氧层高速飞行，常被误认彗星。它捕食小陨星及其融合体，轻易压碎坚壳。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is often mistaken for a comet as it soars around the ozone layer at blinding speed. It preys on Minior and their fusions, crushing their hardened shells with ease.

entry: POKENAME常前往太空，带陨石回来吃。高音尖叫将其震碎，变成更易入口的小块。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME often make treks into space, returning with meteorites to eat. They use their high-pitched screeches to break them down into easier bites to eat.

entry: POKENAME在高层大气高速飞行。捕猎时收翼，以超音速俯冲地面。听觉敏感，太靠近的飞机会遭攻击。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME flies extremely high up in the atmosphere at high speeds. To hunt, it will tuck in its wings and dive towards the ground at supersonic speeds. Its hearing is sensitive, causing it to attack aircraft that get too close.

entry: POKENAME由金属混合物构成，据说注入了龙之能量，赋予惊人韧性，也提供近乎无穷的能量，供光束攻击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is comprised of a metal mixture said to be infused with draconic energy. This is believed to be what gives it its remarkable resilience, as well as a boundless reservoir of energy used for firing energy beam attacks.

entry: POKENAME常住在平行宇宙相连的不可见领域，吞食通道的能量粒子。攻击时放出储能，如流星般急冲，撞向敌人。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME often reside in the realm unseen where alternate universes connect and devour the energy particles from the gateways that link them. When attacking, they use their stored energy to burst around and slam into enemies like a shooting star.

entry: POKENAME速度让大多数普通飞机自愧不如，常与其他龙属性冲突，获胜后还曾捕食对方。它几乎不理认为弱小的任何对象。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME is able to achieve speeds that put most standard airplanes to shame. It often clashes with other Dragon-type Pokémon and has been seen preying upon some of them after winning. It mostly ignores anything and anyone it deems weak.

entry: 它走遍星球，只在流星将撞击处停留。POKENAME沙体吸收冲力，被撞散后，再重新拼起。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It travels across the planet, only staying in spots where a meteor is about to crash. POKENAME's sandy body absorbs the impact of meteors. After the meteor scatters its body, it pieces itself back together.

entry: POKENAME歌声尖利穿空，几秒就能平息附近任何恶劣天气。激烈旋律让多数龙属性宝可梦向它致敬。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's sharp voice pierces through the air as it sings, calming the weather around it in seconds no matter how devastating. Its songs are fierce melodies that compel most Dragon types to pay respects to it.

entry: POKENAME站塔顶监视来自太空的威胁。只要捕捉到一丝流星踪迹，就快速上下跳，吼叫、散出颈边火焰。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME stand atop towers to keep watch for extraterrestrial threats. If they spot even the slightest glimpse of a shooting star, they will rapidly hop up and down while roaring and scattering the fire from around their necks.

entry: POKENAME怒意渐生，下方便形成向内汇聚的气流，越怒越强。到了极限，怒气化作烈风，直接在下方城市造龙卷。
author: bigoljax
source: As POKENAME's anger starts to brew, inflow winds begin to form below it, growing stronger as its rage continues to rise. Once it reaches its limit, it releases all of its anger as harsh winds, making tornados form directly in the cities below it.

entry: POKENAME自认力量顶峰，只接受够格者挑战。据说连传说宝可梦，也曾因不达标准遭拒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME believes it stands at the pinnacle of strength and only accepts challenges from the worthy. It is said that even legendary Pokémon have been denied for not measuring up to POKENAME's standards of strength.

entry: 天灾常预示POKENAME到来。拳力足以终止风暴，打散云层，让阳光照下方崎岖大地。
author: amityblamity
source: Natural disasters often herald the arrival of POKENAME. Their punches are strong enough to bring an end to storms, as they scatter clouds to cast sunlight on rugged lands below.

entry: POKENAME能量太盛，得靠消耗调节，因此寻找战斗，或在高空长途飞行。火热得雨一碰，就嘶嘶蒸发。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's body is overflowing with energy, which it regulates through exerting itself; it achieves this by seeking out fights and by traveling far and high in the sky. Its flames burn hot enough that rain will sizzle and evaporate on contact.

entry: POKENAME夜空飞掠，快得看不清，留下橙光轨迹。有人说，看着像天空被撕成两半。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME streaks through the night sky at blinding speeds, leaving glowing orange trails in its wake. Some say it makes the sky look as though it is tearing in half.

entry: POKENAME力量太大，身体容不下，便从岩隙涌出，形成周身气场。据说一显现，连最强的龙属性也会颤抖。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's strength is so great that its body cannot fully contain it, surging out from the crags of its body and forming an aura around it. Even the mightiest of Dragon types are said to tremble once this power manifests itself.

entry: POKENAME在天上奔驰，如穿牧场，一路破云。有报告称，它全速奔行时甚至能抵达臭氧层。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME gallops through the sky as if crossing a pasture, bursting through clouds as it travels. There are reports of it reaching the ozone layer at its top speed.

entry: 它只允许亲自选中的极少数骑在背上。它能踏空轻跑，穿行云中云外时，壮丽的火焰鬃毛，形成令人敬畏的景象。
author: infinex21
source: This Pokémon will let none, save for the very few it ever chooses, ride upon its back. It is able to walk upon the air itself, its majestic mane of flames casting an awe-inspiring visage as it trots through and beyond clouds.

entry: POKENAME以同样强健优雅的姿态穿行海空，切换自如。从嘴里射出的极光束，特别夺目，也强大惊人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME cuts through the air and sea with the same powerful grace, switching from one to the other seamlessly. The Aurora Beam it fires from its mouth is notably to be particularly dazzling, as well as incredibly powerful.

entry: POKENAME壳内燃烧的能量一碰空气，就会产生神秘蒸汽。它能释放这股能量，迅速喷出蒸汽，冲力足以吹散整片云群。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The energy burning within POKENAME's shell creates a mystical steam when exposed to the air. POKENAME can release this energy to rapidly expel the steam with enough force to blow away an entire cloudbank.

entry: 它能加快附近植物生长。但农人说，用POKENAME大量生产作物，会损失风味和品质。
author: h0bojoe
source: It can accelerate the growth speed of plants around itself. However, farmers report that using POKENAME to mass produce crops robs them of flavor and quality.

entry: POKENAME像稀有金刚宝珠，谁想拿就爆炸。爆炸能让范围内任何对象，在时间上最多前进或倒退一分钟。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME resembles the rare Adamant Orb, but will explode if anyone tries to pick it up. The force of its explosion can send anyone within range up to a minute forward or back in time.

entry: POKENAME像普通煮蛋计时器，拧动设定时间后就滴答作响。到点响铃，便爆发精神力量。
author: hophoppip
source: Like a standard egg timer, POKENAME will begin to tick after being twisted to set a time. When it reaches that time and rings, it will unleash an explosion of psychic power.

entry: POKENAME通常是八面体，却能随意重组水晶结构。受威胁就展开如星形，再发射毁灭性光束。
author: origamiskies
source: Though POKENAME usually takes the shape of an octahedron, it is capable of reconfiguring its entire crystal structure at will. When threatened, it opens up to a form resembling a star before firing a devastating beam.

entry: POKENAME洪亮歌声能改变时间流动，令人既怕又敬，获称“时间女王”。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's sonorous singing voice can alter the flow of time itself. It's treated with fear and reverence, given the title of the Queen of Time.

entry: 疯狂科学家追着POKENAME，想发现所谓“湿式时间旅行”。没人弄懂是什么意思，更不知它是否真有这能力。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Mad scientists follow POKENAME around in the hope to discover a phenomenon they call "wet time travel." No one has been able to figure out what that means or if POKENAME even has it.

entry: 毒可严重扭曲时间感，几秒如几年。小瓶POKENAME毒液在黑市价高得离谱。
author: h0bojoe
source: Its poison can heavily alter one's sense of time, making mere seconds feel like years. Vials of POKENAME toxin sell for ludicrous amounts on the black market.

entry: POKENAME如今罕见，神奥遗迹的图画却常描绘它。洗翠文化研究显示，它们曾在运送旅人方面发挥重要作用。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Though rare in the present day, POKENAME are commonly depicted in pictographs within ruins in Sinnoh. Research into Hisuian culture shows that they played an important role in ferrying travellers.

entry: POKENAME如今罕见，神奥遗迹的图画却常描绘它。洗翠文化研究显示，它们曾在运送旅人方面发挥重要作用。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Though rare in the present day, POKENAME are commonly depicted in pictographs within ruins in Sinnoh. Research into Hisuian culture shows that they played an important role in ferrying travellers.

entry: POKENAME如今罕见，神奥遗迹的图画却常描绘它。洗翠文化研究显示，它们曾在运送旅人方面发挥重要作用。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Though rare in the present day, POKENAME are commonly depicted in pictographs within ruins in Sinnoh. Research into Hisuian culture shows that they played an important role in ferrying travellers.

entry: 神秘洞穴壁画描绘像POKENAME的身影，送宝可梦去神话之地。时间似乎对它不同，从无身体老化迹象。
author: bobosmith01
source: A mysterious cave painting depicts a figure akin to POKENAME transporting Pokémon to a mythical land. Time seems to flow differently for this Pokémon: it never shows physical signs of aging.

entry: 有人相信，所有POKENAME都从史前向未来穿越而来，逃过灭绝。它能造水中旋涡，将他者卷过时间长流。
author: sk372
source: Some believe all instances of POKENAME have traveled forward in time from ancient prehistory in order to avoid extinction. POKENAME creates whirlpools in the water that can send others hurtling through the timestream.

entry: 等待进化时，它附着附近物体表面，一待数百年。有些POKENAME因静止太久，甚至成了当地景点。
author: h0bojoe
source: While it awaits evolution, it clings to nearby surfaces for hundreds of years. Some POKENAME have even become local attractions due to how long they've stayed motionless.

entry: POKENAME领地意识强，又好斗。人们认为，这与过去因身上巨大的蓝色水晶而遭偷猎有关。晶体储存、传导巨量能量，激动时尤甚。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are highly territorial and aggressive, which is thought to be due to having been poached in the past for their large, blue crystals. These crystals store and channel immense energy, especially while a POKENAME is agitated.

entry: POKENAME彻底暴怒，会危险地大肆破坏。虽会迅速耗能，最终疲惫，宝可梦巡护员与巡守人员仍监测领地，避免事发。
author: infinex21
source: When thoroughly enraged, POKENAME are likely to fly into a dangerous and destructive rampage. Though they inevitably tire out due to rapidly exhausting their energy, Pokémon Rangers and Rangers still monitor their territories to avoid such incidents.

entry: POKENAME把食物冻实保存，尤其偏爱结实果蔬。冰成形几秒就极密，但也能控制，迅速使其融化。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME secure their food, notably opting to prefer hardy fruits and vegetables, by freezing them solid. The ice they create is remarkably dense even within seconds of forming, though they can control it and make it melt just as quickly.

entry: 据说凝望火焰，会随火光跳动，看见自己一生。POKENAME胸前核心含巨量能量，可放灼热光线自卫。
author: infinex21
source: Those who peer into this Pokémon's flames will supposedly see their entire life as the flame flick about. The core upon POKENAME's chest contains immense energy that it can emit as a searing-hot ray of light to defend itself.

entry: 待在POKENAME身边，似乎老得更慢。附近人和宝可梦越多，它蜕皮越快，科学家因此认为，它吸收他者经历的时间来成长。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Those that spend time around POKENAME seem to age slower. The more people and Pokémon around it, the quicker it has to shed its skin, causing scientists to believe that POKENAME is absorbing the time experienced by those around it to grow.

entry: 传说，POKENAME绕着全球飞行时，速度快得能让时间倒流。人们几乎从未见过它的全貌，只有掠过时留下的一道蓝光，昭示着它曾来过。
author: mistymagius
source: Legends say that POKENAME can circle the globe so fast that it will start to turn back time. It has almost never been seen fully; the only remnants of its presence are a trail of blue light as it flies by.

entry: 它先暂时让时间停止，再以毒针使敌人中毒。野外若遇见POKENAME，多半已经被扎过。
author: h0bojoe
source: It temporarily freezes time before poisoning foes with its toxic needles. If you encounter a wild POKENAME, it has likely already stung you.

entry: POKENAME高深精神力能撕开时间裂口，却当作平常本领，随意邀请遇见者穿越时间冒险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's advanced psychic powers let it rip holes in the fabric of time. It acts like this is a mundane ability, freely offering those it meets the chance to take adventures across the timestream.

entry: POKENAME整点准确大叫报时，也能受训按设定间隔报警，帮助包括视障人士在内的许多人。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME releases a loud cry on the hour with precise accuracy. It can be trained to act as an alarm for set intervals, which helps out many people, including those who are visually impaired.

entry: 靠近POKENAME时，会先听见咕咕钟响，随后它便消失。有人相信，它穿越时间逃走了。
author: chorb33
