source: When you approach POKENAME, you hear the sound of a cuckoo clock before it disappears. Some believe that it travels through time to escape.

entry: POKENAME随意改变表盘时间，就能穿梭时空。也有人猜测，它不会死亡。
author: chorb33
source: POKENAME can change the time on the dial of its watch at will, allowing it to travel through time. There are speculations that it is immortal.

entry: POKENAME羊毛未加工已极耐久，导电性胜过铜。它虽温顺易驯，许多人仍觉得照料困难。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's wool is remarkably durable even before being processed and is more electrically conductive than copper. Though they are considered docile and easy to tame, caring for them is considered difficult by many.

entry: 历史上大多数时候，POKENAME被视为飞得最快。但最近研究认为，它其实放慢时间，骗过观察者。
author: h0bojoe
source: Throughout most of history, POKENAME was believed to be the fastest flying Pokémon. However, recent studies suggest that its speed results from it slowing time itself to deceive observers.

entry: POKENAME长出密实胸甲，更好保护幼崽。对敌时，从金属角传导、放出强雷电。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME have developed dense chest plating to better defend their young from threats. To dispatch foes, they can channel and discharge powerful electrical bolts from their metallic horns.

entry: 传导电力时，三颗蓝色水晶会随电量发出不同亮度的光。雷电可从角或胸甲边缘的锐尖射出。
author: infinex21
source: When it channels electricity, its three blue crystals emit light at varying brightness depending on how much electricity it channels. It can release electrical bolts from its horns or the sharp tips at the edges of its chest plate.

entry: POKENAME能操纵时间，让食物垃圾迅速烂到喜欢的程度。使用这能力，牙齿会迅速生长，迫使它不断磨短。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME possess the incredible ability to manipulate time, which they use to rapidly rot food and trash to their liking. Their teeth grow rapidly as they use this power, forcing them to constantly grind them down.

entry: POKENAME看似思考飞快，其实只是需要思考时，就放慢时间。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME appears to think at breakneck speeds, but in reality, it slows down time when it needs to think .

entry: POKENAME不断暂停时间，寻找倒影、暗中整理外貌。战时却害羞紧张，反而用不出暂停时间的能力。
author: epping_forest
source: POKENAME can stop time, and is constantly using this power to look up for reflections and to tidy up its looks without anyone noticing. However, it becomes too shy and nervous to stop time during a battle.

entry: 传说POKENAME是时间守护者，能创造新历史时间线。每有生灵非自然死去，就造一个新时间线，那里致命事件从未发生，生命得以延续。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME is spoken of in legends as the keeper of time, capable of creating new timelines of history. Whenever a being unnaturally dies, it creates a new timeline where the fatal incident never occurs and their life continues on.

entry: 见过POKENAME的人，总说它演奏着同一首歌。曲调听来熟悉，又令人怀念。
author: jokerswild
source: Those who have reported seeing POKENAME always describe it playing the same song. They also claim the song sounds nostalgically familiar.

entry: 许多人相信，尾上水晶全亮电光，就表示POKENAME将倒转时间。它神秘罕见，只在猛烈雷雨中现身。
author: fiordaliso
source: Many believe that when all the crystals on its tail emit an electric glow, POKENAME is about to rewind time. It is a mysterious Pokémon that makes rare appearances only during violent thunderstorms.

entry: POKENAME精通伏击，攻击前一瞬才现身，挥出剃刀般的利爪。有人说，遭它攻击，寿命便少一年。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME is a master of ambush, appearing split seconds before it attacks with razor-sharp claws. Some say that anyone attacked by POKENAME will lose a year of longevity.

entry: POKENAME吃钻石与其他宝石，硬化外壳，矿工因此常让它寻找这些宝石。
author: raydrago
source: POKENAME consume diamonds and other precious gems to harden their outer shell. As such, these Pokémon are often used by miners to find said gems.

entry: 臂上的叶片比多数人造刀刃武器更锋利。它住在森林或丛林最古老的树旁，谁想伤树，就会被迅速斩倒，或遭尾巴压碎。
author: infinex21
source: The leaves on its arms are sharper than most bladed, human-made weapons. It makes its home around the eldest tree within a forest or a jungle. Any who attempt to harm this tree will be quickly felled by its slashes or crushed by its tail.

entry: POKENAME有力量操纵周围的时间流。珍爱的生灵若受到伤害，它便倒转时间，改变事情的经过，彻底避开危险。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has the power to manipulate the flow of time around it. Should those it cares for come to harm, it will rewind time to go back and alter the course of events and avoid the danger entirely.

entry: POKENAME监测时间流动，惩罚任何试图影响时间的对象。它对情绪极敏锐，很容易辨认恶意。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME monitors the flow of time and will punish those who ever attempt to influence time itself. It is highly attuned to emotions, which allows it to easily identify malicious entities.

entry: 据说POKENAME能停止时间，用来向敌人掷出无数刀。训练家若有幸获它效力，会发现这是勤快优雅的女仆。
author: kai____________
source: POKENAME is said to be able to stop time. It uses this ability to unleash innumerable knives upon its foes. Should a Trainer be lucky enough to have one in their service, they'll find it to be a diligent and elegant maid.

entry: POKENAME是穿越时间寻找强敌的战士。可至今，也没找到足够强的对手。
author: patch_bros
source: POKENAME is a warrior that uses its time travelling abilities to search for a worthy opponent. It has yet to find a strong enough opponent.

entry: POKENAME是时间宝可梦帝牙卢卡的得力帮手，在其领域造时间堤坝，修复裂口。有时误在领域外完成修补，还得帝牙卢卡亲自救回。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME are helpful allies for Dialga within the Temporal Pokémon's realm as they repair tears in time by creating a temporal dam. They sometimes mistakenly complete repairs outside of Dialga's Realm, requiring rescue by Dialga itself.

entry: POKENAME灵体像黑洞，报告常提到它有自己的引力。水晶若遭外力损伤，108个星形物体就会猛烈喷出。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME's spiritual form has a similar appearance to a black hole, with reports often talking about it having its own gravitational pull. When its crystal is damaged by an outside force, 108 star-shaped objects are violently thrown out of its body.

entry: 流线型身体让POKENAME以音速飞翔，胸前钻石随之共振、扭曲时间，让敌人来不及反应，就能冲撞。
author: keiracm35_
source: Thanks to its aerodynamic body, POKENAME soars the skies at the speed of sound. In doing so, the diamond on its chest resonates and distorts time, allowing it to charge at its rivals before they can react.

entry: POKENAME头上有实心钻石护板，保护本体不留划伤，但板缘曾有崩缺。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME's head is protected by a plate of solid diamond. The plate protects it from damage without a scratch, though its edges have been known to chip.

entry: POKENAME关爱他者，大灾时现身。它暂停灾区环境的时间，却不冻结人和宝可梦，让他们平安逃走。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME cares about the lives of others, appearing during great disasters. Using their powers, POKENAME temporarily freezes time in the affected environment but not the people or Pokémon, allowing them to escape unharmed.

entry: POKENAME生活在偏远深海，移动时叫一声。不久，周围时间似乎便会停住，哪怕只有一瞬。
author: .izik
source: Found in the remote depths of the ocean, POKENAME lets out a cry as it moves. Shortly after each cry, time in the surrounding area appears to halt, if only for a moment.

entry: 据说POKENAME能在时间中创造新时间线，带来新悖论。亲眼见过它身上的壮丽光芒，就会完全失去时间感。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is said that POKENAME has the ability to create new timelines within time itself, giving rise to new paradoxes. After witnessing firsthand the magnificent light radiating from its body, one loses all sense of time.

entry: 传说自古以来，POKENAME守护所有时间线的流动。它被认为住在时空之外的异次元，因此目击极罕见。
author: fiordaliso
source: Legend has it that since ancient times, POKENAME has protected the flow of all timelines. Sightings of this creature are extremely rare, as it is believed to inhabit an alternate dimension beyond time and space.

entry: 远方传说，一位英雄借自己的POKENAME穿越时间，救世界免于毁灭。若搭档训练家没有勇气，它就用不出力量。
author: cobalt0135
source: A legend that has passed down in a faraway land claims that a great hero traveled through time with the help of his POKENAME and saved the world from certain doom. This Pokémon wields no strength unless the Trainer it partners with has courage.

entry: 传说，一位绿衣英雄在自己强大宝可梦的帮助下，拯救了远方王国。即使独行有危险，只要POKENAME在队伍里，也总能确信安全。
author: cobalt0135
source: Legends say that a great hero garbed in green has saved a faraway kingdom with the help of his powerful Pokémon. Even when it's dangerous to travel alone, one can always be assured of their safety with POKENAME in their party.

entry: POKENAME动作精确得奇异，事件发生前一瞬就反应。科学家认为，身体发出的特定频率会微妙影响概率，看起来像预见未来。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME moves with uncanny precision, reacting to events a split second before they occur. Scientists believe its body emits a frequency that subtly influences probability, making it appear as though it glimpses into the future.

entry: POKENAME是长寿的物种，偏爱在富含矿物、矿石的深洞筑巢。身体比钨更硬，也重得惊人，却仍能自如移动，说明力气同样很大。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are a long-lived species that favor nesting within deep caverns rich in minerals and ores. Their bodies are harder than tungsten and remarkably heavy, yet they can move quite well, which indicates they are quite strong as well.

entry: 据说POKENAME游在时间之河，确保只朝一个方向流动。它以时间异常为食，被动维持平衡。
author: imeavie
source: POKENAME are said to swim through the river of time, ensuring its currents flow in a single direction. They feed on anomalies in time itself, passively preserving the balance.

entry: POKENAME凶猛守山，一觉察擅闯者就俯冲。人们相信，仅吼声便能将人甩入未知时间。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME viciously guards the mountain it claims as territory, swooping down the moment it senses a trespasser. It's believed that its roar alone could send a person hurtling through time to parts unknown.

entry: POKENAME转动水平齿轮，半径20英尺内所有人，都会觉得时间变快或变慢。传闻全力快转，能让所有时间倒转或快进。
author: fireblade141
source: When POKENAME spins its horizontal gear, everyone within a 20-foot radius will start to perceive time either faster or slower. It is rumored that if it decided to go all-out, it could rewind or fast-forward all of time by spinning that gear rapidly.

entry: POKENAME转动水平齿轮，半径20英尺内所有人，都会觉得时间变快或变慢。传闻全力快转，能让所有时间倒转或快进。
author: fireblade141
source: When POKENAME spins its horizontal gear, everyone within a 20-foot radius starts to perceive time either faster or slower. It is rumored that if it decided to go all-out, it could rewind or fast-forward all of time by spinning that gear rapidly.

entry: POKENAME缎带释放的气息能放慢周围时间，但只有离目标不超过10英尺，效果才持续。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME releases an aura from its ribbon that can slow time in the surrounding area. This effect only lasts while it remains within 10 feet of its target.

entry: 触须比钢韧、比丝软，像布般流畅，攻守皆宜。它们似乎知道谁曾怀恶意行事，也对这些对象心生反感。
author: infinex21
source: Their feelers are tougher than steel, yet softer than silk, and as free-flowing as fabric which makes them excellent for defense and offense. They seem to know if one has ever acted with malice and seem to resent those who have.

entry: POKENAME极少离开臭氧层家园。传说降下时，会发光束惩罚最邪恶的生灵，将目标直接从时间长流中抹去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has rarely been sighted coming down from its home up in the ozone layer. According to legends, it would descend to punish the most wicked creatures by firing a beam that outright erased the target from the time-stream.

entry: 古代传说称POKENAME统领时间，只将它描绘为孤独、少与人交流的存在。据说还能赐青春永驻，但也只是神话。
author: d.yash
source: According to ancient legend, POKENAME rule over time. POKENAME are only described in legends as a lonely being that rarely interacts with humans. It is also said that they can grant everlasting youth but that is just a myth.

entry: POKENAME能操纵全部时空。有人相信它才是真正的创世宝可梦，也有人称它为存在本身的扭曲。
author: scigaming
source: POKENAME can control the entirety of space-time. Some believe it to be the true Creator Pokémon, whilst others call it a corruption of existence.

entry: 许多人视它为掌控一切时空的神奥大尊。力量之强，唯有阿尔宙斯本尊能比拟。
author: toxicrown
source: It's believed by many to be the Almighty Sinnoh and controller of all spacetime. Its power is rivalled only by Arceus itself.

entry: POKENAME能掌控噩梦与时间，本性却不恶。它让恶人以逼真噩梦，看见自己将犯的恶行，令许多人畏惧。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME can wield powers of nightmares and of time. Although not innately malevolent, this Pokémon has struck fear into many evildoers by showing them the evils that they would commit in the form of a lifelike nightmare.

entry: POKENAME炮内能量可随意改变、扭曲时间。惹怒它的对象会被击中，送往随机时点，作为惩罚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cannon generates an energy that can alter and distort time according to its whims. It punishes those who have angered it by hitting them with this energy and sending them to a random point in time.

entry: 古卷轴画着许多POKENAME栖山顶、造暴雪。后来又发现卷轴，画着相同的POKENAME，却处于不同时间，因此许多人认为它能穿越时间。
author: .izik
source: Ancient scrolls depict sightings of many POKENAME perched atop mountains and creating huge blizzards. Later scrolls have been found depicting the same POKENAME but at different times, leading many to believe they travel through time itself.

entry: POKENAME钢翼让它飞得极快，有时尚未出发，已到目的地。停下转向却费时太久，反而绝无撞上自己的危险。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's steel wings propel it through the air with such incredible speed that it sometimes arrives at its destination before it leaves. It takes so long to stop and change direction that there is never any risk of it bumping into itself.

entry: POKENAME钢翼让它飞得极快，有时尚未出发，已到目的地。停下转向却费时太久，反而绝无撞上自己的危险。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's steel wings propel it through the air with such incredible speed that it sometimes arrives at its destination before it leaves. It takes so long to stop and change direction that there is never any risk of it bumping into itself.

entry: POKENAME每用扭曲时间的能力，背上大转盘就旋转。它天性爱恶作剧，通常只是改他者年龄，或将其送过时间捉弄。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME spins the large dial on its back whenever it utilizes its time-warping powers. A prankster at heart, it typically uses these abilities to mess with others by altering their age or sending them through time.

entry: 过去以为POKENAME像普通烛光灵，以生命力为食。如今才知，吃的其实是他者寿命。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME was once believed to feed on life-force like a standard Litwick. It's now known that it feeds on the lifespans of others.

entry: POKENAME能控时间流，大多用来反复重来初次见面，好给想结交的对象留下完美第一印象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has the power to control the flow of time. It mostly uses this ability to redo meetings with potential new friends, so as to make sure its first impressions are always perfect.

entry: POKENAME一闻甜果香，就不断循环时间，反复闻。最容易的阻止办法是靠近，它便怕水果被抢，跑去吃。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Whenever POKENAME smells sweet fruit, it will continuously loop the passage of time to keep smelling it. The easiest way to stop this is to approach POKENAME, who will become worried about the fruit being stolen and run up to eat it.

entry: POKENAME像蛇游水般在空中蜿蜒。对时间概念的有限控制，让它一直处于下落状态，却不会真正坠下。
author: slimmagma
source: POKENAME appears to slither in the air like a snake in water. Its moderate control over the concept of time allows it to remain in a constant state of falling, removing the consequence of being pulled down.

entry: POKENAME一颗副头观察受害者的过去，分析弱点，另一颗看未来，预测动作。凭这知识，无情的狩猎总能成功。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: One of POKENAME's secondary heads looks into its victims' pasts to analyze their weaknesses, while the other looks into the future to predict their movements. Thanks to this knowledge, POKENAME's merciless hunts are always successful.

entry: 传说碰POKENAME任何一尾，就会急剧衰老。但没人敢测试。
author: mepp.
source: According to legends, POKENAME has the power to drastically age anyone who touches one of its many tails. None have dared to test this theory.

entry: POKENAME的爪子能撕开时间，制造通往过去或未来的虫洞。有时，它还会与时拉比玩一场跨越时空的追逐游戏。
author: teatedtiten
source: Using its claws, POKENAME can rip through the fabric of time to create wormholes to the past and future. Occasionally, POKENAME partake in an interdimensional game of Tag with Celebi.

entry: POKENAME筑的坝会冻结附近时间，让自己又怒又困惑。执勤人员常循怒吼定位，处理它造的异常。
author: guacamole_dog
source: The dams that POKENAME builds freeze time in their vicinity, much to its angry confusion. Officers often use its raging roars to locate and deal with the anomalies it builds.

entry: POKENAME头上宝石将阳光转成能量，储存起来以备进化。什么事若妨碍晒太阳，它就倒转时间，再完全避开。
author: .realthree
source: The gem on POKENAME's head processes sunlight and turns it into energy that is stored away for later Evolution. If some event should keep POKENAME from basking in the sun, it reverses time, then avoids the problem entirely.

entry: 这种行踪难觅的融合体，以恒定步调游过时间，从不休息。人们看见POKENAME时，大多只看见飘浮背鳍，不到一秒就消失。
author: hophoppip
source: This elusive fusion swims through time at a constant pace, never stopping to rest. Most POKENAME sightings consist of a floating dorsal fin, seen for only a fraction of a second.

entry: POKENAME中空体内，据说封着时间力量。谁想偷取，生命就被快进10,000年，偷取行动也当场终止。
author: soup1900
source: It is believed that sealed inside of POKENAME's hollow body are the powers of time. Anyone who tries to steal these powers has their life fast-forwarded by 10,000 years, ending their attempts instantly.

entry: POKENAME将扭曲时间碎片困在中空身体，防止扰乱时间流。金属受时间本身淬炼，从不变化或损坏。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME traps distorted pieces of time inside its hollow body to prevent them from messing with the time flow. Tempered by time itself, its metal never suffers any changes or damage.

entry: POKENAME像古代象形文字中出现的一种植物，能造扭曲时间的花粉云。
author: seanothan_23
source: POKENAME shares a resemblance to a plant seen in ancient hieroglyphs. It can create shrouds of pollen that distort time.

entry: 据说吃POKENAME蘑菇，能见遥远过去或未来。吃过的人通常被所见震撼，难以清楚描述。
author: mistymagius
source: Eating POKENAME's mushrooms is said to bring visions of either the distant past or distant future. People who eat them are usually too overwhelmed to give a good description of their vision.

entry: POKENAME完全控制自身墙内的时间。贸然进入者，可能衰老到从世间消失。
author: bostroms
source: POKENAME has complete control over time in the space within its walls.  Anyone foolish enough to enter it may find themselves aged out of existence.

entry: POKENAME吸收古迹残留的时间能量，重新经历久远时代的片段。历史学家常随行，因为它能揭开深埋的往日秘密。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME can absorb temporal energy that lingers in ancient ruins, allowing it to relive moments from eras long gone. Historians often travel with it, as its presence can uncover long-buried secrets of the past.

entry: POKENAME喜爱寒冷，能活数千年。环境若过热，就将自身冻结在时间中，重新现身过去。
author: 7magic7mike7
source: POKENAME loves the cold and can live for thousands of years. If its environment gets too hot, it freezes itself in time to reappear in the past.

entry: 传说POKENAME是守望时间流的守护神。歌曲或能送人去过去或未来，甚至完全放逐到时间长流之外。
author: sk372
source: Legends say POKENAME is a guardian deity that watches over the flow of time. The songs it sings can supposedly send a person forwards or backwards in time, or even banish them outside the timestream entirely.

entry: POKENAME以壳中奇异蓝烟操纵时间。对吸入者而言，时间似乎过得异常快或异常慢。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME manipulates time itself with the odd blue smoke from its shell. Time seems to pass abnormally fast or slow for anyone who inhales the smoke.

entry: 古神奥神话将POKENAME描绘为最美的宝可梦。凝望者感到时间加快，靠得越近，衰老越快。
author: beatdoof
source: Ancient Sinnohese myths tell tales of POKENAME as the most beautiful Pokémon ever seen. Those who fix their gaze upon it will feel time's passing accelerate, aging more rapidly the closer they get.

entry: POKENAME奔跑得很快时，有时会凭空消失，过一会儿才重新出现。其实，那是它跃进了未来的时间。
author: ayutac
source: When POKENAME runs quickly, it sometimes vanishes into thin air, only to reappear later. This is because it actually jumps forward in time.

entry: POKENAME好斗闻名，却少显恶意，似乎只为证明自己或争领地。战斗越久越强，受伤也不例外。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are notoriously combative, though they rarely display malice. They seem to fight merely to prove themselves or over territory. They are notorious for increasingly growing stronger during battle as time goes on, even while wounded.

entry: POKENAME天性好斗，将金属胸甲熔化，化作液态弹丸轰敌。铠甲又瞬间恢复，仿佛时间倒转。
author: ambrosia04
source: Highly aggressive by nature, POKENAME melts its metallic chestplate into molten projectiles to blast at foes. Its armor instantly restores itself, as if time were being rewound.

entry: 传说POKENAME已深刻理解时间，以精神力维持历史稳定，让世界不断变迁。
author: agtl05
source: Legends speak of how POKENAME has reached such an understanding of time itself that they use their psychic powers to maintain the stability of history, keeping the world in its state of perpetual change.

entry: 这种海栖POKENAME被认为来自未来，以多条触手打开时间裂隙，再伸过裂口，拿取过去与未来的物件，目的不明。
author: sk372
source: An ocean-dweller believed to have come from the future, POKENAME can open multiple rifts in time with its many tentacles. It has been seen reaching its tentacles through these rifts to pluck objects from the past and future, for unknown reasons.

entry: POKENAME在时间中奔驰，寻找最青翠的草地进食。途中小心避开其他宝可梦，防止连锁效应波及整个时间。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME gallop through time to search for the greenest pastures to eat from. They are careful to avoid other Pokémon during their travels to prevent rippling effects felt throughout time.

entry: 神话故事常说POKENAME跑得够快，能穿越时间。越释放强大火焰，身体宝石状部分便越亮。
author: infinex21
source: A common feature of mythological stories claims POKENAME can run fast enough to traverse time. The gem-like part of its body glows brighter when it unleashes more of its powerful flames.

entry: POKENAME知晓全部时间。看过帝国衰落、国家覆灭，让它常陷冷漠，提不起关心，连动也不想。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME has knowledge of the entirety of time. Because it has seen the decline of empires and the fall of nations, it is often stricken with apathy, unable to care enough to move.

entry: 被POKENAME力量哄睡的人，会梦见亲历往事。它吃这些梦，受害者醒后，相应记忆便不复存在。
author: sk372
source: Those put to sleep by POKENAME's abilities dream of past personal events. POKENAME consumes these dreams, and once its victim wakes they will no longer remember the eaten memory.

entry: 盯POKENAME手中时钟，就容易中催眠时间之力。它瞬间改变心理年龄，让许多受害者成年身躯里成了孩童心智，或反过来。
author: sk372
source: Gazing into the clock POKENAME holds leaves one vulnerable to its hypnotic time powers. It can mentally age or de-age a person in moments, leaving many victims as mental children stuck in adult bodies or vice versa.

entry: POKENAME被认为长寿，临近寿命上限时，壳会像钨一样坚韧。虽然壳连巨钳都很重，活动却很少吃力。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are considered to live long lives, with their shells growing as tough as tungsten as they near the peak of their lifespans. Despite the inherent weight of their own shells, which extends to their claws, they rarely struggle to move.

entry: 除了水，POKENAME炮中也能射出纯粹的时间能量。据说中招者会被强行推往遥远过去或未来。
author: sk372
source: Alongside water, POKENAME can also fire pure temporal energy from its cannons. Those hit by these kinds of attacks are said to be forcibly pushed into the far past or distant future.

entry: POKENAME晒太阳小睡，背上的水晶便积能扭曲空间。它不等黑夜过去，直接传往世界各处有阳光的地方。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: When POKENAME naps in the sun, the crystal on its back gains energy to distort space. It uses this energy to transport itself to sunny places around the world instead of waiting for the night to end.

entry: POKENAME没叶可吃，就开始啃食空间结构。若留在空房里，建筑内部空间会慢慢缩小。
author: .jerden
source: If POKENAME runs out of leaves to eat, it begins feeding on the fabric of space. If POKENAME is left inside an empty room, the building will slowly become smaller on the inside.

entry: POKENAME像白玉宝珠，谁想捡就爆炸。力量违背普通物理规律，将波及者传到远方。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME resembles a Lustrous Orb, but will explode if anyone tries to pick it up. The force of its explosion defies normal physics, warping those caught in the blast to places far away.

entry: POKENAME常被误认大宝石，尽量避开所有他者，却又猎捕勾魂眼。突来冲击足以让体内能量猛烈爆发。
author: infinex21
source: Commonly mistaken for large gems, POKENAME often try to avoid all others, yet ironically they will hunt down Sableye. Sudden impacts are enough to cause them to violently release their internal energy with explosive force.

entry: POKENAME能跨空间开虫洞，确保拳拳精准。拳头穿门而过，打向敌人防不到的地方。
author: sk372
source: With the power to open up wormholes across space, POKENAME uses this ability to ensure perfect punching accuracy, thrusting its fist through portals that strike where opponents cannot defend.

entry: POKENAME几乎从不被看见移动，因为控空间便能悬浮，眨眼跨过原野。打扰休息的宝可梦，会被送往地平线外的远方。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are almost never seen moving, as they can manipulate space to levitate and move across fields in the blink of an eye. Pokémon that disrupt their rest are sent to distant lands far beyond the horizon.

entry: POKENAME扭曲空间，让毒无限扩散、越来越强。据说侵入另一维度，就能让那里承不住它的毒气重量，整个崩塌。
author: fiordaliso
source: POKENAME can distort the fabric of space itself, allowing its poison to spread endlessly and become ever more toxic. It is said that if this creature invaded another dimension, it would make it collapse under the weight of its own gas.

entry: POKENAME转动身体，制造重力裂隙。据说中央宝石，是望向整个宇宙的窗口。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can spin its body to create gravitational rifts. It is said that the gem at its center is a window to the entire cosmos.

entry: POKENAME如火箭般在太空高速推进。特别明亮的流星，也许正是它坠向地表。
author: origamiskies
source: POKENAME functions like a rocket, capable of propelling around outer space at high velocities. A particularly bright shooting star could be this Pokémon crashing down to the surface.

entry: POKENAME精通控水，能将敌人拖入无尽黑暗水域，那里顺从创造者的心意。获救者往往再不敢近水。
author: nyoomymph
source: POKENAME is a master over water. It can drag opponents into a dark, watery realm that obeys the whims of its creator and has no end. Those recovered from such a place often never approach the water again.

entry: POKENAME穿行空间，翅膀流出的宇宙能量，将本已膨胀的广阔虚空无限拓展。尖叫宇宙各处可闻，预示恒星将消亡。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME flies through space itself, infinitely expanding upon the vastly-expanding void with the cosmic energy flowing from its wings. Its sharp cry can be heard across the cosmos and signals the imminent demise of a star.

entry: POKENAME强精神力能撕开空间孔洞，轻易传送自己与他者。据说距离没有上限，甚至可能进入其他维度。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's impressive psychic power lets it open up holes through space, teleporting itself and others with ease. It is said there is no limit to how far it can travel through space, and that it may even be able to warp to other dimensions.

entry: POKENAME转头，周围空间就越发扭曲，像黑洞一样。越靠近脸，时间便呈指数级减慢。
author: ilazerheart
source: Space around POKENAME distorts more and more as it twists its head, gaining a similar effect to a black hole. Time slows exponentially the closer you get to its face.

entry: POKENAME抛蛛网捉猎物，网紧缩，再将受害者传到空间别处，留待召回食用。具体藏在哪里，无人知晓。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME throws nets made of its webbing at prey, which constricts and then transports the victim elsewhere in space, to be summoned and consumed later. It's unknown where exactly POKENAME stores its captures.

entry: POKENAME不善控空间。想让维度门开着，却会误关；想维持关闭，又会误开。
author: doctorjazznumber6215
source: POKENAME is inept at controlling space. It can unintentionally close the dimensional portals it was trying to keep open and vice versa.

entry: POKENAME虽小，爱找体形数倍的对手，反而大多能赢。它能撕开空间，常将敌人送到附近彗星表面。
author: agentyoshi
source: Despite its diminutive stature, POKENAME is known to pick fights with Pokémon many times its size. Ironically, it wins most of these fights, as it can create rifts in space and will often send its opponent onto the surface of nearby comets.

entry: POKENAME脸中央小星星的能量输出，接近一座小型反应堆。最近被用来给大型农业设施供电，主要是种花场。
author: turcai_87271
source: The small star at the centre of POKENAME's face emits a similar amount of energy to a small reactor. It has recently been used to power huge farming complexes, mostly flower-growing operations.

entry: POKENAME受风力涡轮吸引，靠近时，涡轮似乎转更快。天气温暖时，会埋进泥里，呼气便让泥瞬间硬化。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are drawn to wind turbines, which seem to spin faster when they are nearby. During warm weather, they bury themselves in mud, which hardens instantly as they breathe over it.

entry: POKENAME受风力涡轮吸引，靠近时，涡轮似乎转更快。它随转动节奏跺脚，观者不知为何看得入迷。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: POKENAME are drawn to wind turbines, which seem to spin faster when they are nearby. They stamp their feet in time with the turbines, and onlookers find themselves strangely entranced by the sight.

entry: POKENAME背上的球茎即将开花时，周围空间扭曲更频繁。它常传遍世界，找阳光充足处，为进化准备。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: Spatial distortions around POKENAME tend to become more frequent when the bulb on its back is ready to blossom. It frequently warps around the world in search of sunny places to prepare for evolution.

entry: POKENAME小却记仇，怨恨很深。据说谁惹怒，就会被它穿越时间纠缠，不只冒犯者，连后代也要遭骚扰啄击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a vindictive little creature, prone to holding fierce grudges. It is said that should one gain POKENAME's ire, it will follow them through time to pester and peck not only the offender, but their descendants as well.

entry: 空间能力尚不高深，只会扭曲身边空间，让自己显得大很多。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its space-altering powers are not very advanced. It only knows how to warp space around itself to make itself look much bigger.

entry: 这小宝可梦从不必吃喝，甚至不用呼吸。空间连接群星，供应全部养分，多余能量则不断化作高热火焰释放。
author: stevethebarbarian
source: This little Pokémon never needs to eat, drink, or even breathe. All its body's sustenance is provided by its spatial link to the stars, with excess energy being released constantly in the form of superheated flames.

entry: POKENAME住在超级火山口，吃沉积火山灰。身体代谢岩中矿物，产生奇异气体，吸入后会扭曲空间感知。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found within the craters of super volcanoes, feeding on the ash deposits within. Their bodies metabolise the minerals from the rocks and produce a strange gas that, when inhaled, distorts the affected person's perception of space.

entry: POKENAME通常在夜间出现，仰望星辰，似乎在研究夜空，身体随之变化，映出上方星空。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME usually appear at night, gazing up at the stars. They seem to study the night sky, their body shifting to mirror the starscape above.

entry: POKENAME在海中休息处，会长出独特发光珊瑚。珊瑚与世界各地其他珊瑚礁有空间连接，让它瞬间前往其中任何一处。
author: sk372
source: A unique type of glowing coral forms where POKENAME rests within the ocean. This coral has a spacial connection to other coral reefs across the world, allowing POKENAME to travel to any of them instantly.

entry: POKENAME最深能住水下250米，因此罕见。目击者常说，遥远下方闪着淡红光；有报告称，声呐显示它似乎在地点间瞬移。
author: aurange
source: It can live at depths of up to 250 meters, so it is rarely seen. Eyewitnesses often describe a pale red light gleaming in the distance far below them. There have been reports of POKENAME appearing to warp between locations on sonar signals.

entry: POKENAME扇翼强得能撕空间，在维度中开大裂缝。施展力量时，还能造扭曲空间旋涡，留下灾难性虫洞。
author: soup1900
source: The flaps of POKENAME's wings are powerful enough to tear through space and create a large rift across a dimension. When channeling its power, it can create vortexes of distorted space that leave catastrophic wormholes in their wake.

entry: POKENAME是凶猛的空中猎手，能操纵空间，截断猎物的退路。猎物奔逃时，它会在前方开启空间传送门，让对方径直落入自己掌中。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a fearsome aerial hunter using its power over space to cut off its prey's escape. It opens up portals through space in front of prey while they flee, which drop them right into POKENAME's grasp.

entry: POKENAME被认为诞生于遥远的星座。心地仁厚，以包着星尘的翅膀飞翔，守望世界。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is thought to have been born on distant constellations. A benevolent Pokémon, it watches over this world as it flies with stardust-cloaked wings.

entry: POKENAME很难稳住头顶黑洞。每次摔倒，黑洞就滑脱，吞掉附近物件，被吞之物再无踪影。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME struggles to balance the black hole resting atop its head. Whenever it falls, the black hole slips free and consumes any nearby objects, never to be seen again.

entry: POKENAME以魔法把敌人困在几乎逃不掉的空间边界，再施幽闭恐惧诅咒，让其惧怕封闭空间，受尽折磨。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its magic to trap foes inside spatial boundaries that are nearly impossible to escape. It then torments the foe by instilling a curse of claustrophobia, or a fear of enclosed spaces, onto them.

entry: 腹部排着神秘手榴弹状物。研究认为，爆炸波及的敌人，会被传往另一维度。
author: busilisk
source: Its abdomen is lined with mysterious grenade-like objects. Studies suggest that opponents impacted by the detonation of these objects are transported to another dimension.

entry: POKENAME的赐福表现为精确流畅到不可思议的空间扭曲。目击者说，像冰凉又柔软的拥抱。
author: guacamole_dog
source: Blessings from POKENAME, observed in the form of impossibly precise and smooth distortions of space, are described by witnesses to feel like a cold but soft hug.

entry: POKENAME诞生时产出的珍珠，价值超过最昂贵矿石的五倍。因它能扭曲空间，还从未有人敢去取这颗珍珠。
author: dyanz0
source: The pearl that POKENAME produces when it's created is so valuable that it is worth more than quintuple the price of the most expensive ore. Nobody has dared to obtain its pearl due to the space-distorting abilities of POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME擅长冰冻与追踪，很难对付。它往传送门射冰冻光束，再从另一门射出，让人难预测躲避。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has potent freezing and tracking abilities, making it formidable in a fight. It fires Ice Beams into portals that exit from another portal, making it difficult to predict and avoid its shots.

entry: 数字化行星组成一套行星系，绕POKENAME运转，维持稳定。人们相信，一旦失去排列秩序，空间力量就会失控，造成灾难。
author: sk372
source: A solar system of digitized planets circles around POKENAME's body, providing stability. It is believed that should the planets fall out of alignment, POKENAME's powers over space would go haywire and cause catastrophe.

entry: POKENAME斩击能让现实泛起涟漪，也确实常发生。它蜷成球，用扭曲时空的泡泡防御。
author: ilazerheart
source: POKENAME slashes can, and often do, create ripples in reality. It curls up into a ball and defends itself using a bubble of distorted spacetime.

entry: POKENAME连踢激起潜藏空间之力。数十连击的最后一踢，足以开传送门，将敌人踢往未知之处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's rapid kicking stirs up its latent powers over space itself. The last kick in a flurry of dozens contains enough power to open up a portal and send its foe flying through to parts unknown.

entry: POKENAME能瞬移至任何洁净淡水水域。一群爱好者已专门致力于搜寻它。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME can teleport to any body of clean freshwater. A group of enthusiasts have dedicated themselves to searching for POKENAME.

entry: 它以扭曲空间的力量扩展湿地。偶尔有人回家，发现住处已被沼泽取代。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It uses space-distorting powers to expand wetlands. Rarely, people may return home to see it replaced by a swamp.

entry: POKENAME感到训练家焦虑，就扭曲空间，造隔绝区域，希望安慰。若不能让对方平静，自己便哭起来。
author: agostostino
source: When it feels anxiety in its Trainer, POKENAME will warp space to create an isolated area, hoping to provide some calm. If it isn't able to calm down its Trainer, POKENAME will start to cry.

entry: POKENAME两个身体共享同一意识，完美合作。保护训练家时，会操纵空间开门，将危险放逐到星球另一侧。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a shared mind across two bodies working perfectly in tandem. To protect its Trainer, it manipulates space and summons portals that will banish dangers to the other side of the planet.

entry: POKENAME常因不明原因陷入忧思。看似纤弱，实际战斗顽强。虽难建立羁绊，赢得它的忠诚却值得努力。
author: fireblade141
source: POKENAME is often in a deep state of brooding for reasons that are unknown. Though it appears quite delicate, it is actually a tenacious fighter. While difficult to bond with, the effort is worth obtaining POKENAME's loyalty.

entry: POKENAME撕开空间，传到心爱搭档身边。若竭力保护仍失败、伙伴死去，就在悲痛中毁坏周围一切。
author: t3isukone
source: POKENAME tears rents in space to teleport to the side of their beloved partners. Should POKENAME's devoted protection fail and their partner perish, they cause devastation to all around them in their grief.

entry: POKENAME的神秘力量，似乎能控制重力、扭曲空间。最后手段是结合力量造黑洞，试图消灭尚存威胁。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME wield mystic powers that allow them to seemingly control gravity and to warp space itself. As a last resort, they will combine their powers to create a black hole in an effort to eradicate any threat that yet remains.

entry: 它阴森骇人，感知周围世界的方式十分奇特。没人知道，它究竟有何意图。
author: theheroict
source: A creepy Pokémon that has a strange sense of the world around it. Nobody knows what its intentions are.

entry: 它十分贪玩，感知周围世界的方式十分奇特。没人知道，它究竟有何意图。
author: theheroict
source: A playful Pokémon that has a strange sense of the world around it. Nobody knows what its intentions are.

entry: 它阴森骇人，感知周围世界的方式十分奇特。没人知道，它究竟有何意图。
author: theheroict
source: A creepy Pokémon that has a strange sense of the world around it. Nobody knows what its intentions are.

entry: 凝望POKENAME的眼，能看见深空与遥远星系。有人说，看太久，就会被它传进那个星系。
author: sk372
source: Gazing into POKENAME's eye lets one glimpse deep into space and view distant galaxies. Some say that looking too long will cause POKENAME to teleport a person to said galaxy.

entry: 有人相信，POKENAME是迷失维度间的多个灵魂，显成同一意识。凝视形体，据说可见无数世界，但太久会招疯狂。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is believed by some to be several spirits lost between dimensions manifesting as one consciousness. Gazing into its shape is said to peer into countless other worlds, but looking for too long will invite madness.

entry: 据说POKENAME为找太阳能，能跨维度传送。小宝可梦来给背上的花授粉，有时却意外被传去世界另一边。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: It's said that POKENAME has the ability to transport itself across dimensions in its search for solar energy. Small Pokémon may be warped across the world by accident when they come to pollinate the flower on POKENAME's back.

entry: 暴怒POKENAME冲来，几乎逃不掉。目标若似乎要跑赢，它便撕开空间，传到前方，让受害者来不及反应。
author: sk372
source: Escaping from an angry POKENAME's charge is almost impossible. If it seems like it is being outrun, it will tear a hole in space and transport itself in front of a fleeing target, with little time for the victim to react.

entry: POKENAME无聊，就召许多行星般的小物体，绕熔融头骨转。研究者仍在查，它们是否真是遥远行星的准确复制品。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME feels bored, it summons a number of miniature planet-like objects that circle its molten cranium. Research is still being undertaken to see if these objects might in fact be accurate replicas of actual distant planets.

entry: POKENAME腹中有一个完整宇宙。许多人相信，我们的宇宙或许也在同样的巨兽体内。
author: jokerswild
source: A whole universe exists inside POKENAME's belly. Many believe that our universe could be inside a beast just like it.

entry: 范围内没人敬畏POKENAME，它可能无预警使出亚空裂斩。此招能夷平摩天楼，因此野外相遇极危险。
author: .izik
source: If no one within range reveres POKENAME, it may use Spacial Rend without warning. This makes encounters with a wild POKENAME extremely dangerous as this attack can level skyscrapers.

entry: 这是帕路奇亚与阿尔宙斯融合的结果，据称唤醒帕路奇亚天生力量。有些神话说，它像帕路奇亚的“起源形态”，能轻易操控空间。
author: infinex21
source: It is the result of a fusion between Palkia and Arceus, which is claimed to have awakened the innate power within Palkia. Some mythologies state this resembles a Palkia's "Origin Form" and that it can wield the forces of space with little effort.

entry: POKENAME背上的树能结世界任何地方的水果，但如何指定果实，尚不清楚。
author: hophoppip
source: The tree that grows on POKENAME's back can produce fruit from anywhere in the world, though it is not yet known how to trigger the production of specific fruits.

entry: POKENAME的剑刃由时空碎片构成，能划开通向宇宙远方或异次元的裂隙。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Its blade is formed from a shard of space-time. POKENAME can cut open rifts to distant parts of the universe or other dimensions.

entry: POKENAME的剑刃由时空碎片构成，能划开通向宇宙远方或异次元的裂隙。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Its blade is formed from a shard of space-time. POKENAME can cut open rifts to distant parts of the universe or other dimensions.

entry: POKENAME的剑刃由时空碎片构成，能划开通向宇宙远方或异次元的裂隙。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: Its blade is formed from a shard of space-time. POKENAME can cut open rifts to distant parts of the universe or other dimensions.

entry: POKENAME以刀刃斩击、扭曲敢拦路的敌人。黑洞核心只是装饰，还是实力真体现，仍无人知。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME uses their blades to slash and distort any foe who dares cross their path. It's unknown if their black hole core is merely for decoration or a true show of POKENAME's might.

entry: 鳗状身体盘成环，里面会显平行空间一角。目击者说，景象壮丽绝美，又让人难以承受自身存在的沉重。
author: h0bojoe
source: When it forms a ring with its eel-like body, a glimpse of a parallel spatial dimension appears within it. Witnesses describe it as both grandly beautiful and existentially overwhelming.

entry: 有神话将它称为宇宙使者，近光速穿行遥远星系。翼纹被认为显示某个古老宇宙的图景。
author: mistymagius
source: Legends describe this Pokémon as a messenger of the cosmos, travelling between distant galaxies at near lightspeed. The patterns on its wings are theorized to show images of an ancient universe.

entry: POKENAME能用缎带划开空气，召出跨越空间的传送门。据说，身边若有人不表现得积极乐观，它就会将其丢进门，放逐到别处，免得面对对方的负面情绪。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's ribbons can cut through the air to summon portals across space. It is said that it will toss those who don't show positivity near it into these portals, banishing them elsewhere so it does not have to deal with their negativity.

entry: POKENAME不开心时，常将情绪藏起来，因此训练家最好留意它的心理状况。压力大时虽容易暴走，但训练家发现，真诚的关爱能让它平静下来。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Trainers are advised to remain aware of POKENAME's mental well-being due to the Pokémon's tendency to hide their emotions when upset. While they're prone to rampaging when stressed, Trainers have found that acts of genuine affection calm them down.

entry: POKENAME完全控制时间与空间，轻易跨时代、地点。神奥少数遗迹暗示，地区形成最初年代，就曾受供奉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses complete control over spatial and time manipulation, warping through eras and locations with ease. A few ruins in Sinnoh suggest it was worshiped during the earliest years of the region's formation.

entry: 古代传说称POKENAME统领空间，人们认为力量顶峰可随意改变星系。它领地意识强，谁越界就攻击谁。
author: d.yash
source: According to ancient legend, POKENAME rule over space. It is thought that at the peak of their power, they can transform galaxies at will. POKENAME are territorial, attacking any who trespass in their domain.

entry: POKENAME用头上的炮在物体表面造传送门，连接世界不同地方，眨眼便消失去未知之处，迅速避开捕捉。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME generates portals onto surfaces from the cannon on its head that connect to different areas of the world. Utilizing these, it can quickly evade capture by disappearing to parts unknown in a flash.

entry: 想传送到其他世界，POKENAME就故意让炮反向喷发，以空间能量裹自身。神话称，激光射击会让空间略不稳定。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME want to teleport to other worlds, they purposely have their cannons backfire to have their spacial energy envelop themselves. According to mythology, their laser shots cause space to slightly destabilize.

entry: POKENAME控空间，造永动般引擎，体内因此产生巨量动力，能释放破坏力惊人的雷电。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME generate immense power within their bodies by manipulating space to create an engine that functions like perpetual motion. This allows them to produce incredibly devastating bolts of electrical power.

entry: POKENAME控空间，造永动般引擎，体内因此产生巨量动力，能释放破坏力惊人的雷电。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME generate immense power within their bodies by manipulating space to create an engine that functions like perpetual motion. This allows them to produce incredibly devastating bolts of electrical power.

entry: POKENAME漫游宇宙找花，启发新创作，再把新花投放途经行星。有理论认为，它为保存所有花卉复制品，专造整个维度。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME travels the cosmos, discovering flowers to inspire new floral creations that it deploys onto planets it passes. It is theorized that it created an entire dimension just to house copies of all of the flowers it has created.

entry: POKENAME漫游宇宙找花，启发新创作，再把新花投放途经行星。有理论认为，它为保存所有花卉复制品，专造整个维度。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME travels the cosmos, discovering flowers to inspire new floral creations that it deploys onto planets it passes. It is theorized that it created an entire dimension just to house copies of all of the flowers it has created.

entry: 据说POKENAME体内装着另一整个宇宙。科学家认为，盖若全开，内部宇宙就会与我们的宇宙猛烈相撞。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME is said to contain a whole other universe inside its body. Scientists have theorized that if its lid is ever fully opened, its universe will violently collide with our own.

entry: POKENAME核心释放强烈辐射与毁灭性旋风，带着甜甜的氨气和硫磺气味。物件被吸向中心，常在局部磁化氢风暴里汽化。
author: xillo
source: POKENAME's core produces intense radiation and devastating swirling winds that smell of sweet ammonia and sulfur. Objects tend to gravitate towards this Pokémon's center, where they are often vaporized in the localized storm of magnetized hydrogen.

entry: POKENAME核心吸气，在身体周围形成主要由氢与氦构成的高密度局部大气。压力巨大，光是靠近就十分费力。
author: xillo
source: The core of POKENAME draws in gases to form a dense localized atmosphere on its body, consisting primarily of hydrogen and helium. It gives off immense pressure, with even the mere act of moving near this Pokémon requiring great effort.

entry: 有些神话说，这种宝可梦的翅膀能撕空间。它们出现在大气最外层，部分个体也在更远太空被目击。
author: infinex21
source: A Pokémon spoken of in some mythologies whose wings are claimed to have the power to rend space itself. These Pokémon are found in the furthest layers of the atmosphere, though some have been spotted deeper in space as well.

entry: 据说POKENAME每片翅膀都含整颗恒星。战时操纵热与空间，像在使用整个太阳的力量。
author: actliux
source: Each of POKENAME's wings is said to contain an entire star. They manipulate heat and space in battle, as if they utilize the force of an entire sun.

entry: 古代传说称，将POKENAME尾巴上闪烁的星星合绘成星图，就能预见未来。但研究太久，会在星光间迷失、晕眩。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Ancient legends claim that the shimmering stars along POKENAME's tails form a constellation that can predict the future when mapped out together. Unfortunately, anyone who tries to investigate for too long gets lost and dazed among the starlight.

entry: 曾有人向基拉祈许愿，想要最强宝可梦，于是它变成了POKENAME。力量强大得能轻易创造黑洞。
author: yorui3913
source: Someone once wished for the strongest Pokémon to a Jirachi, so it turned into POKENAME. It's so powerful that it can easily create black holes.

entry: 曾有人向基拉祈许愿，想要最强宝可梦，于是它变成了POKENAME。力量强大得能轻易创造黑洞。
author: yorui3913
source: Someone once wished for the strongest Pokémon to a Jirachi, so it turned into POKENAME. It's so powerful that it can easily create black holes.

entry: POKENAME控制空间边界，让歌声跨维度传递。膨胀身体，还能唱得更远。
author: darkweavile428
source: POKENAME uses its control over the boundaries of space to project its singing across dimensions. When it inflates itself, POKENAME can make the sound of its voice travel even farther.

entry: POKENAME尾火燃着空间能量，可弯曲周围空间，逃险或困敌。传说现实开始破裂时，它就现身，守护平衡。
author: sythomnigod
source: POKENAME's tail flame burns with spatial energy. It can bend space around it to escape danger or trap foes. Legends say it appears when reality begins to crack, acting as a guardian of balance.

entry: POKENAME每夜跳舞，步法与星位相合。有人说，行星在轨道排成一线时，便会跳最美的舞。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME dances every night, the pattern of its dance aligning with the position of the stars. Some say its most beautiful dance will be performed when the planets align in orbit.

entry: 传说，POKENAME的尖牙强得足以撕开空间，让它能穿行不同维度。无论吃下多少，它都填不饱肚子，只得永无休止地捕猎。
author: fiordaliso
source: According to legend, POKENAME's fangs are powerful enough to tear through space itself, allowing it to travel between dimensions. No matter how much it consumes, its hunger is never satiated, keeping it perpetually on the hunt.

entry: POKENAME以空间力量自由跨维度，迅速大量吞光。若忘关异界门，光能就迅速耗损，它也开始感到痛苦。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME uses its powers of space to freely cross dimensions and devour light very freely and quickly. If it ever forgets to close a portal to another world, its light energy is quickly expended while it starts to become pained.

entry: POKENAME常在天文馆和天文台，以孢子投影微型星系。它享受关注，见孩子看得开心，就高兴地吱吱叫。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME can be spotted in planetariums and observatories, often projecting miniature galaxies through their spores. They thrive on attention, often chittering in enjoyment when children enjoy their display.

entry: POKENAME足够集中，就能在颈褶后方造闪亮极光。据说凝望够久，能看见空间极远处。
author: sk372
source: Should it concentrate hard enough, POKENAME can create a shimmering aurora behind the frills on its neck. Gazing long enough into the spectacle is said to grant a person a glimpse far across space.

entry: 若不论身处世界何处，都能看见极光，便是POKENAME所致。它似乎有一系列原初力量，但行踪难觅，能力范围的记录尚不充分。
author: bobosmith01
source: When an aurora can be seen from anywhere in the world, POKENAME is the cause. It appears to have an array of primal powers, but due to its elusive nature, the extent of them has not been well documented.

entry: 若不论身处世界何处，都能看见极光，便是POKENAME所致。它似乎有一系列原初力量，但行踪难觅，能力范围的记录尚不充分。
author: bobosmith01
source: When an aurora can be seen from anywhere in the world, POKENAME is the cause. It appears to have an array of primal powers, but due to its elusive nature, the extent of them has not been well documented.

entry: POKENAME歌声能造空间虫洞，平常只是为歌声衬上满天星空。暴怒时，却能以门将敌人甩向宇宙另一端。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's songs give it the ability to create wormholes across space. Normally used only to fill the area with a starry backdrop to its music, an angered POKENAME could send a foe hurtling across the universe with these portals.

entry: POKENAME为粉丝办精彩演唱会。观众常说，它对麦克风唱时，自己会被传往宇宙各处世界。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME throws spectacular concerts for its fans. Attendees often report that when POKENAME sings into its microphone, they're transported into worlds across the universe.

entry: 据说POKENAME头上的生灵有独立意识。歌舞时，周围空间弯曲扭动，音调越高，扭曲越严重。
author: actliux
source: The creature on POKENAME's head is said to have a mind of its own. As POKENAME sings and dances, the space around it bends and warps, with higher notes causing more and more distortion.

entry: POKENAME先以爪撕空间，再从背上蘑菇散孢子。裂缝很快闭合，穿过的孢子去了哪里，无人知晓。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME will rend space with its claws before scattering spores from the mushroom on its back. The rifts it creates soon close, and it is unknown where the spores that pass through them end up.

entry: POKENAME从壳上排气口释放超高密度气体，旋转凝成微型星云。控空间让它能压缩气体、控制扩散，星空景象始终以壳上方为中心。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME produce a super-dense gas from vents in their shells that swirl and coalesce into a miniature nebula. Their control over space allows them to condense the gas and control its spread, their starscapes remaining centred above their shells.

entry: POKENAME翅膀花纹因个体而异，曾被传为其他维度的窗口。翅膀上的粉末被吸入，会造成视觉幻觉。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's wing patterns vary between individuals and were once rumored to be windows into other dimensions. The powder on their wings causes visual hallucinations if inhaled.

entry: 它们控制的重力强过形成钻石所需，POKENAME的两个圆盘让控制更精确。下半身的引力洞，作为最后手段放出。
author: infinex21
source: They are capable of wielding gravitational forces that go beyond the force needed to create a diamond. A POKENAME's two discs allow much more precise gravity control. Within the lower body is a gravitational hole that is unleashed as a last resort.

entry: 空间力量太大，POKENAME身体承受不了，因此头痛。剧烈偏头痛一起，周围空间便开始扭曲移位。
author: sk372
source: The power over space that POKENAME possesses is too much for its body to handle, causing headaches. When a painful migraine strikes, space around POKENAME begins to warp and shift.

entry: POKENAME每天把强敌拉进平行维度，一对一训练。胜过它的训练家，才被视为够格指挥。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME train every day by pulling strong combatants into a parallel dimension to fight them one-on-one. Trainers who best them are considered worthy enough to command them.

entry: 许多太空望远镜拍到POKENAME无声游荡宇宙。有科学家甚至报告，它直视镜头，仿佛知道正被观测。
author: bigoljax
source: Many space telescopes have caught POKENAME silently wandering the cosmos. Some scientists have even reported that POKENAME looks directly at the lens, as if it knows they see it.

entry: 乍看，POKENAME只用一根普通骨头作辅助。但一怒，背后就现巨大凶影，骨头长出黑暗能量利刃，化成致命镰刀。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME appears to be using a simple bone to assist itself at first glance. However, when angered, a large imposing shadow appears behind it, and the bone grows a sharp blade of dark energy, becoming a deadly scythe.

entry: POKENAME以怒气为燃料，形成深黑巨影。据说越愤怒，逼人的影子就越有破坏力。
author: thezekrom
source: POKENAME forms a dark, massive shadow fueled by its anger. It is said that as POKENAME's wrath grows, the more destructive this looming shadow becomes.

entry: POKENAME像扭曲幽影般迅速难测，一见便让敌人惊慌。愤怒时，眼睛泛烈焰般紫光。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME moves swiftly and confusingly like a distorted apparition, leaving foes in a state of panic upon seeing it. Its eyes glow a fiery purple when it feels wrathful.

entry: POKENAME狡猾又擅长操纵别人，梦想统治世界。POKENAME还对胖丁怀着莫名怨恨。
author: the_smirker
source: POKENAME is described as cunning and manipulative. It dreams about taking over the world. POKENAME has an unexplainable grudge against Jigglypuff.

entry: POKENAME以惊人速度使出潜灵奇袭。刀刃状手臂留下的暗影轨迹很快消失，传闻来自另一维度。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME strike their foes with Phantom Force attacks at incredible speeds. Shadowy trails left behind by their bladed arms disappear quickly and are rumored to be from a different dimension.

entry: POKENAME跳舞，周围阴影似乎随动作移动、起伏。据说看太久，就会被阴影本身吞没。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME dances, the shadows around it seem to move and undulate in time with its movements. It is said that those who watch its dances for too long will be consumed by the shadows themselves.

entry: POKENAME有“恶魔蛇”的绰号。只要落入它的视线，就没有生还的可能。
author: mistymagius
source: Known by the nickname of "Demon Serpent": If you are in POKENAME's line of sight, your chances of survival are zero.

entry: 据说POKENAME在另一现实的海床底面行走。传闻只向死去的水属性宝可梦现身，引导前往另一维度。
author: graybearrubygizmo
source: It is said that POKENAME walk on the underside of the ocean floor within a different reality. They are rumored to only ever make themselves known to deceased Water-type Pokémon to guide them toward a different dimension.

entry: POKENAME以尖刺传红雷，将部分身体披上午夜风暴般的暗影。主要却只是站在空旷崖顶摆姿势，给自己营造戏剧般光效。
author: guacamole_dog
source: POKENAME can channel red lightning through its spikes and cloak parts of its body in a shadow form resembling a midnight storm. It is mainly seen using these powers to give itself dramatic lighting as it poses atop empty cliffsides.

entry: POKENAME在电脑关机时进入，翻看用户数据。通常再次开机就知道来过，因为亮度设置已被调到最低。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enters into computers while they're shut down, exploring the user's data within. One can usually tell if a POKENAME has visited, as the brightness settings will have been changed to the minimum value when the computer is turned back on.

entry: 这种宝可梦厌恶混乱，把窝收拾整齐。巢边任何东西若被它视为异常，就会遭攻击。
author: cobalt0135
source: This Pokémon abhors disorder and keeps its nest neat and organized. It will attack anything near its nest if it perceives it to be an anomaly.

entry: 古代某些武士流派仿POKENAME外貌制头盔。许多佩戴者生前疯狂或作恶，因此有人认为，这面容受了诅咒。
author: sk372
source: Some sects of samurai in ancient times wore helms fashioned after POKENAME's appearance. Many of these samurai went mad or committed foul deeds in life, leading some to believe POKENAME's visage is a cursed one.

entry: 传说它曾暴走世界，一路削出许多地形台阶，至今仍让旅途中的训练家头疼。
author: cobalt0135
source: Legends say that this Pokémon once rampaged across the world, carving out many ledges in its wake. These ledges have long frustrated Trainers on their journeys.

entry: POKENAME影翼飞过留下轨迹。它被认为来自与我们相反的世界，属于那个世界的远古时代。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: The shadowy wings of POKENAME leave a trail behind it as it flies. It is thought to be a Pokémon from the ancient times of a world opposite to our own.

entry: POKENAME吐息瞬间冷彻骨髓。暗影双翼可扩到原来的近两倍，吞没猎物。猎物再无踪迹，只留几根与原体形相称的骨头。
author: infinex21
source: The breath of a POKENAME is so cold that it chills anyone to the bone in an instant. Their shadowy wings can expand to nearly twice their size before engulfing prey, and said prey will never be seen again save for a few bones of its size.

entry: 据说POKENAME与毁坏的世界建立精神联系，能在残酷战斗中，运用那个次元的扭曲阴影。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME is said to have forged a psychic link with the Distortion World, enabling it to use the dimension's twisted shadows in gruesome combat.

entry: POKENAME睡时，周身泡泡越来越黑。亲眼见过的人说，会感到极不自然的巨大恐惧。
author: .izik
source: While POKENAME sleeps, the bubble that forms around its body grows progressively darker the longer it rests. Those who have witnessed this bubble in person report an uncanny feeling of extreme dread.

entry: POKENAME目击总伴怪现象，例如附近景物视觉扭曲。它性情虽暴烈，对交好的生灵却温顺。
author: toniaglitched
source: Sightings of POKENAME are always accompanied by strange effects such as visual distortions on nearby places. Despite its violent nature, it is very docile to any creature it befriends.

entry: POKENAME好斗，又常携多种疾病，在训练家中很有名。当地民俗将它视为暴食化身。
author: sondededoo
source: POKENAME are well known among Trainers for their aggressive disposition and their tendency to carry a wide range of diseases. Local folktales label POKENAME as the embodiment of gluttony.

entry: POKENAME从毁坏的世界现身，血月立刻出现，强化深黑暗影身躯。面罩增强视力，看见所有沾上红光的对象，再以强暗影潜袭猛攻。
author: soup1900
source: When a POKENAME appears from the Distortion World, a blood moon instantly appears and powers up its deep shadow body. Its visor amplifies its vision to see all who touch the red light before violently striking them with a powerful Shadow Force.

entry: POKENAME夜间觅食，避开冲突。背上暗星能造暗影门，一遇麻烦就迅速退入。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a nocturnal creature that forages at night to avoid conflict. The dark stars on its back can generate shadowy portals it quickly retreats into should it run into any sort of trouble.

entry: 谁笑POKENAME个头小，就会遭诅咒电击。对人和宝可梦都无尽愤怒，使它成为难以招惹的危险生灵。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME unleashes cursed bolts of electricity against those who mock their diminutive size. Their endless wrath against people and Pokémon alike makes them dangerous creatures to cross.

entry: 据说POKENAME住在此世与彼世之间的领域。有人视现身为巨灾警告。有趣的是，发现以来数十年，目击反而越来越多。
author: aurange
source: POKENAME are said to live in a realm between our world and the next. When one is seen in this world, some claim it to be a warning of a great calamity. Interestingly, sightings have become increasingly common in the decades since its discovery.

entry: POKENAME羽毛被形容为美丽又诡异。蓝羽偶尔细微变色，如同流动的河水；红羽则可能像火般亮闪。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME's feathers have been described as both beautiful and eerie: the blue feathers ocassionally have their color shift in minute ways that make it seems like they are a flowing river, while the red feathers may flicker brighter like  flames.

entry: POKENAME行踪难寻，民间故事很多。几乎所有文化都认为，它影响水循环，不受敬重就送来风暴。即使现代，提到它仍带某种忌讳。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: This elusive Pokémon is the subject of many folklore tales. Almost all cultures believe POKENAME is important in the water cycle, and that it sends violent storms should it be disrespected. Even in modern day there is a stigma to mentioning it.

entry: POKENAME从毁坏的世界出来，两颗头以不同方式扩散混乱。前面的头用强心灵感应逼人疯狂，后面的头则猛击一切够得着的对象。
author: bandedbodypress
source: When it emerges from the Distortion World, POKENAME's two heads proliferate chaos in different ways. Its front head uses powerful telepathy to drive people to madness, while its rear head lashes out at anything it can reach.

entry: POKENAME巨口内是全黑世界。被救回的人说，里面时间慢，一秒如外面一周。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The maw of POKENAME is a world of complete darkness. People pulled from its jaws describe time moving slower, like a second in its mouth is equivalent to a week outside.

entry: 凭完美的隐匿能力与暗影额外手臂，POKENAME每天无声地从数十个巢里偷蛋。被抓到就躲进毁坏的世界，从此再无追回可能。
author: soup1900
source: With perfect stealth and extra arms made of shadows, POKENAME silently steals eggs from dozens of nests per day. If it ever gets caught, it disappears into the Distortion World, where any chance of recovering the stolen eggs becomes lost forever.

entry: 构成POKENAME壳的地形不断扭曲变形，令旁人感到异界气息。它在洞顶隧道筑巢，捕食休息的超音蝠。
author: chibitales
source: The terrain making up POKENAME's shell twists and morphs in different ways, giving those near them an otherworldly feeling. They nest in tunnels dug into cave ceilings and prey on resting Zubat.

entry: POKENAME在天冠山顶附近，从通往毁坏的世界的小裂口中现身。仅靠自身力量，留不了太久，几天便再消失。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are found around the peak of Mount Coronet, emerging from small rifts that lead to the Distortion World. They are unable to remain in the world for long under their own power, individuals only remaining for a few days before vanishing again.

entry: 传说POKENAME潜伏海底最深、最黑的洞穴，耐心等待猎物。
author: kittyluv090
source: Legend says that within the deepest and darkest caves in the ocean, POKENAME lurks, waiting patiently for its prey.

entry: 据说来自我们世界反面的另一世界。金色身体闪亮，与暗影双翼形成鲜明反差。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: A Pokémon that is said to have come from a world on the reverse side of our own. Its golden body shimmers, a stark contrast to its shadowy wings.

entry: POKENAME守着生者世界与虚空的边界。嚎声回荡，带着令人不安的悲伤。
author: xoriey
source: POKENAME guards the border between the living world and the void. Its howls echo with an unsettling sadness.

entry: POKENAME在天冠山顶附近，身体诡异、转瞬即逝。研究者推测，它是另一维度的宝可梦投到此世的影子。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are found around the peak of Mount Coronet, their bodies eerie and ephemeral. Pokémon researchers theorise that these Pokémon are an extradimensional shadow cast on our world by a Pokémon living in a different dimension.

entry: POKENAME描绘细节直白的大灾难场面，常令人揪心。研究者普遍认为这些画毫无意义，怪僻者却常拿来作未来大邪恶逼近的证据。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME paints graphic and often gut-wrenching depictions of cataclysmic events. Researchers widely agree that these paintings are meaningless, although eccentrics tend to use these works as evidence of a great evil approaching in the future.

entry: 这些宝可梦曾被认为是恶意化身。攻击用的幽灵火焰留下严重且难愈的灼伤，角受损的POKENAME也常被同族鄙视。
author: chibitales
source: These Pokémon were once thought to be forms of malice incarnate. The ghostly fire used in their attacks leaves harsh burns that are difficult to recover from. A POKENAME with damaged horns is often scorned by its brethren.

entry: 有人认为POKENAME来自时间流扭曲的异界。影子一碰，对象就消失，多被推测送往时间别处。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is believed by some to come from another world with a distorted timestream. Those touched by the shadows it sends out disappear, assumed by many to have been sent elsewhere in time.

entry: 据说POKENAME是古代地下文明遭巨灾毁灭后的幸存者。力量太具破坏性，它怕将所有生命化灰，因此选择不用。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME are said to be survivors of an ancient underground civilization that was laid to ruin by a great catastrophe. The power POKENAME wields is so destructive that they choose not to use it because they fear it may reduce all life to cinders.

entry: POKENAME多年前首次发现于废实验室。研究显示，它对行善作恶很矛盾，只受身边生灵影响。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME was first discovered in an abandoned lab years ago. Research shows that it is very conflicted about whether to do good or bad in the world, influenced only by those around it.

entry: POKENAME暗影翅膀由似乎熄不灭的黑暗火焰构成。只曾在火山区夜间被看见，从影中升起，向靠近者射漆黑火球。
author: sk372
source: The dark flames comprising POKENAME's wings seemingly cannot be extinguished. It has only been seen in volcanic areas at night, rising from the shadows and launching pitch-black fireballs at those who draw near.

entry: POKENAME容不得争执与攻击性。附近有纷争，就召异界门，将使自己不适者放逐，算一种“冷静一下”的处罚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has little patience for conflict and aggressive behavior. If it finds itself near that sort of strife, it banishes the ones causing it distress through a portal to another world it summons, as a sort of time-out punishment.

entry: POKENAME从毁坏的世界透过传送门，暗中观察猎物。时机一到，以暗影构成的爪拖进门，之后命运不明。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME peers through a portal from the Distortion World to watch prey undetected. Once the moment strikes, it uses its shadow claws to drag the prey through the portal, where their fate afterwards becomes unknown.

entry: POKENAME被最初来源的设备奇异束缚，只能在数字丝线允许范围内游荡。网络里，碰到的数据全被混淆，也会注入无意义数据。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME are strangely bound to the device they originally came from, only able to wander as far as their digital strings let them. When in cyberspace, they obfuscate all data they touch and inject their own nonsensical data into systems.

entry: POKENAME被认为来自我们之外、繁花茂盛的维度。它藏在暗林，在手中造出锐利的暗影叶片，再掷向靠得太近的敌人。
author: sk372
source: Thought to have come from a lush, floral dimension beyond ours, POKENAME hides itself in darker sections of forest areas. It creates sharp leaves made of shadow in its hands, thrown at opponents who venture too close for comfort.

entry: 据说POKENAME来自另一维度的丛林，比任何已知丛林都更危险。它们用利爪熟练爬树，夜里藏入阴影。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME are said to come from a jungle in another dimension, one far more dangerous than any known. These Pokémon use their claws to expertly scale trees, masking themselves in shadows at night.

entry: POKENAME被认为来自相反世界的丛林。研究者说，那里黑暗险恶，才造就这般强悍的生存本领。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: POKENAME is thought to come from a jungle that's in an opposite world of our own. Researchers say this jungle is dark and hostile, resulting in such a powerful adaptation.

entry: POKENAME夜间起身，将暗影卷须伸过沼泽家园觅食。据说所住最深泥坑底，藏着它造的异界门。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rises at night, stretching its shadowy tendrils around its swampy home to find food. It is said that it creates a portal to another world at the bottom of the deepest mud holes it inhabits.

entry: POKENAME守护依恋对象，凶猛得近乎拼命。影翼上的爪可脱离、成群飞舞，完美分散注意，自己则准备暗影袭击。
author: sk372
source: Those that POKENAME has become attached to are guarded with a fierceness approaching desperation. The claws of its shadow-wings can detach and fly about en masse, a perfect distraction while POKENAME prepares a shadowy assault.

entry: POKENAME身体极小，便结合幽灵力量与精神力，把影子显成巨翼。翼能用物理力量击打，也能迅速将敌人裹入漆黑。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's body is so small that it combines its spectral and psychic powers to manifest its shadow as massive wings. These wings can strike with physical force and can quickly engulf foes in pitch-black darkness.

entry: POKENAME诞生于一款受诅咒的游戏，如今游荡在我们的世界。它飞驰于高草丛中，追猎狐狸宝可梦及其训练家。
author: ethewriter
source: Born from a cursed game, POKENAME now haunts our world. It speeds around tall grass, hunting down fox Pokémon and their Trainers.

entry: POKENAME似乎最早出现在神奥一座供奉阿尔宙斯和骑拉帝纳的庙。传闻它引人入体，送往扭曲领域。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME seemingly first appeared in the Sinnoh region within a temple devoted to Arceus and Giratina. It is said that it attempts to draw people into its body and transport them to a distorted realm.

entry: POKENAME虽夜里更活跃，仍将阳光能量收进水晶，增强力量。据说水晶充满，便能开异维裂缝。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: Although POKENAME are typically more active during the night, they still gather energy from sunlight within their crystals for more power. It is said that a POKENAME with a fully charged crystal can open a rift to another dimension.

entry: POKENAME巨颚内，是通往此世反面世界的门。据说经此进入“毁坏的世界”，便永远迷失，任那里的其他生灵处置。
author: infinex21
source: The inside of POKENAME's giant jaws is a portal to a world that is the reverse of our own. Those sent to this "Distortion World" this way are said to be forever lost, left to the mercy of whatever else dwells there.

entry: POKENAME以迅疾一斩砍倒敌人，被认为是仁慈举动。但外貌吓人，仍被当作毁灭使者。传说曾因带来悲剧而被封印。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME use their claws to cut down their foes in a swift slash, believed to be a merciful gesture. Despite this, they are seen as bringers of destruction due to their frightening looks. Legends say POKENAME were once sealed due to bringing tragedy.

entry: 许多古代社会将POKENAME描绘为最受憎恨、最邪恶的魔神之一，相信它吞无数灵魂，使其永陷黑暗。
author: sk372
source: Many ancient societies depicted POKENAME as one of the most hated and heinous demonic deities. They believed that POKENAME would devour countless souls and subject them to an eternity of darkness.

entry: 这种宝可梦巨口内，是另一扭曲维度的门。POKENAME吞下的一切，都会消失不知多久，极少能回来。
author: milchik
source: Inside this Pokémon's huge mouth is a portal to another twisted dimension. Everything that gets swallowed by POKENAME vanishes for an unknown amount of time, with few ever returning.

entry: POKENAME双翼也是触须，每条可单独移动，刺穿、抓取水果或猎物。头上颚巨大，压碎力强，能破多数坚硬甲壳。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's wings are also feelers that can each move individually to skewer and grab fruits or prey. The mandibles of its head are rather large and have great crushing power to break through most tough shells.

entry: POKENAME背上有种奇异现象，据说是扭曲异界的残留。太靠近壳，便会受影响，重力与影子开始不按常理运作。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME carries a strange phenomenon on its back, said to be a remnant of a distorted alternate world. Those who get too close to its shell find themselves affected, as gravity and shadows begin to no longer function normally.

entry: 它既顽皮优雅，又恶毒残暴。目击者说，POKENAME的战斗方式违背物理常理，虚幻得令人着迷。
author: frink202
source: It is playful, graceful, spiteful, and brutal in equal measure. Witnesses have described POKENAME's fighting style as both unreal and captivating in its physical impossibility.

entry: 它是来自异次元的凶残猎手，扭曲现实本身的构造，制造难辨的幻象。
author: nellnast42
source: A savage hunter hailing from a different dimension. It creates tricky illusions by distorting the very fabric of this reality.

entry: POKENAME挥动触须，空中留下缕缕黑瘴，接触者会感到极度恶心。消退后，许多人又报告同等强烈的平静。
author: .izik
source: When POKENAME waves its feelers through the air, they leave behind tendrils of black miasma that cause intense nausea upon contact. Once the nausea fades, many report equally intense feelings of calm.

entry: 见有人难熬，POKENAME就邀请去毁坏的世界放松。有时还利用那里不规则重力玩游戏。
author: epping_forest
source: If it sees someone going through a difficult time, POKENAME will invite that person to the Distortion World to relax and feel better. Sometimes they play games using the irregular gravity of this strange dimension.

entry: 它可怕得很，拥有深不可测的力量。一旦发怒，顷刻便可能毁灭整片大陆。
author: pepperthepirate
source: A terror blessed with unfathomable power. Were it to lose its temper, it could annihilate an entire continent in moments.

entry: 传说POKENAME晨昏往返此世与影界，寻找要带走的受害者。所到之处被认为是此世倒影，却永处晨昏般的朦胧薄光。
author: cobalt0135
source: Legends say that POKENAME moves to and fro between our world and the world of shadows during twilight hours as it seeks victims to spirit away. It is believed that the place it visits is a reflection of our own but in perpetual twilight.

entry: POKENAME怕自身力量，藏到月球背面。日月食时，被迫去可见一面；看见它，就预示接下来的夜里一定会做噩梦。
author: friendly_neighborhood_neko
source: Fearing its own power, POKENAME hides itself away on the other side of the moon. Forced onto the visible side during an eclipse, seeing POKENAME is a sure sign of nightmares the following night.

entry: 炮管灌满奇异力量。炮击后，会留下一片空间与时间都遭扭曲的场域。
author: soup1900
source: Its cannon is filled with a strange power. The blasts from the cannon leave behind a strange field where both space and time are distorted.

entry: 炮管灌满奇异力量。炮击后，会留下一片空间与时间都遭扭曲的场域。
author: soup1900
source: Its cannon is filled with a strange power. The blasts from the cannon leave behind a strange field where both space and time are distorted.

entry: POKENAME能喷火烧灼敌人，周围却似乎只暖一瞬。有人推测，它产生的所有热都传入毁坏的世界。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can scorch foes with blasts of fire, but this never seems to warm up its surroundings for more than a brief moment. It has been suggested that all the heat produced by POKENAME is transferred to the Distortion World.

entry: POKENAME住在与此世平行的扭曲维度，性情爱玩，常透过门偷看，捉弄人类。
author: springkidone
source: POKENAME lives in a distorted dimension parallel to ours. It often peeks into this world through portals to play tricks on people, as it is quite playful.

entry: 泥偶巨人破损的甲壳，如今成了骑拉帝纳灵魂的容器。它会先用尖锐的触须刺入猎物，再将其杀死。
author: sand_coffin
source: What was once the broken armor of a Golurk now houses the soul of Giratina. It uses its sharp tendrils to stab into prey before finishing them off.

entry: POKENAME许多暗影卷须，其实由喷出体外的内脏构成。一次显出的影越多，真身就越小、越脆弱。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's many shadowy tendrils are made from its innards, expelled from inside its body. The more of these shadows it manifests at once, the smaller and more frail its actual body becomes.

entry: POKENAME身体虽小，神秘力量却强。踩影者可能让影子活过来，夺取心智控制。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Despite its small body, POKENAME possesses a great amount of occult power. Those who step on its shadow risk having it come to life and seize dominion over their mind.

entry: POKENAME在亮处视力较差，便向周围散出阴影，使环境漆黑一片。旁人视线受阻，自己却在黑暗中看得更好。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's vision is less effective in the light. It spreads shadows around itself to darken the area to a pitch-black state, limiting the visibility of others while its own vision gets better in the darkness.

entry: 故事常说POKENAME穿过阴影，如行另一存在平面。但现代观察显示，它只是夜行，速度又比多数喷气机更快。
author: infinex21
source: Many tales exist of how POKENAME are capable of moving through shadows themselves, as if moving through another plane of existence. Modern observations, however, indicate that POKENAME are simply nocturnal and move quicker than most jets.

entry: 有人相信它是某位骄傲剑士的黑暗镜像。据说一挥可造龙卷，曾把敌人分成四个独立个体。真容始终藏着。
author: infranscia
source: Some believe it's the dark, mirror image of a certain proud swordsman.  It's said it can create tornadoes with a single swipe, and once split a foe into four separate entities.  It keeps its true face hidden.

entry: POKENAME控影潜力巨大，仍在发展能力。它先用尾光照出影，再移动、重塑，磨炼力量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has vast potential for manipulating shadows, but it is still developing its abilities. It uses the light from its tail to cast shadows before moving and reshaping them to hone its powers.

entry: POKENAME可爱外貌藏着捣蛋性子。常拉别人一同胡闹，自己先走，让对方承担后果。恶作剧从日常小事到大灾都有。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME's adorable appearance belies its tendency towards mischief. It often tries to convince others to join it in the misbehavior before leaving them behind to deal with the consequences. This mischief can range from very mundane to catastrophic.

entry: POKENAME凭深沉的暗影身躯，能将颈部的爪子化作巨手，抓住猎物。它身穿的金甲，与爪和角一样锋利，使它能发起凶猛的进攻。
author: soup1900
source: Thanks to its deep shadow body, POKENAME can transform the claws on its neck into giant hands to grasp prey. The gold armor it wears allows it to be highly aggressive, as the armor is as sharp as its claws and horns.

entry: 阳光常削弱POKENAME，因此偏爱借黑暗掩护，在长草小丘游走。白天若行动，就吸附近植物的影维持力量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME much prefers to roam grassy knolls under the cover of darkness, as sunlight tends to weaken it. If it does move during the day, it absorbs the shadows of plant life near it to keep its strength up.

entry: POKENAME对垃圾废料似乎胃口无尽，如无底虚空，以影肢抓来吞食。它们潜伏城市暗角，身影藏在重重阴影里。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME have an appetite for trash and waste that seems inexhaustible. It is as if they are a bottomless void, grabbing garbage with their shadowy limbs and devouring it. They are found lurking in the dark corners of cities, looming in the shadows.

entry: POKENAME暴力撕船的传闻很多，水手严防目击。但已确认的全部报告，都说它在海上平静漂浮，四周什么也不理。
author: darkwolfe
source: Rumours abound of POKENAME violently tearing ships apart, leading sailors to be hyper-vigilant for sightings. All confirmed reports of POKENAME note them floating peacefully in the ocean, not reacting to any of their surroundings.

entry: POKENAME柔美诱人的歌声，只在最黑暗夜里能听到。据说靠近者会被满身阴影拥住，此后再不出现。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a soft and alluring singing voice, heard only in the darkest of nights. Those drawn to approach it are said to be embraced by the many shadows covering its body, never to be seen again.

entry: 人们相信这强大生灵守着毁坏的世界入口。POKENAME身后留一路金色口水，因此踪迹很好追寻。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is believed that this mighty creature stands guard over portals leading to the Distortion World. Its tracks are easy to follow, as POKENAME leaves a trail of golden drool behind it.

entry: POKENAME双臂裹住的猎物，通常再不出现，因此传言被送异维。它的强毒，足以严重损伤神经系统。
author: chibitales
source: Prey enveloped by POKENAME's arms are usually never seen again, leading to rumors that they are sent to a different dimension. POKENAME's venom is potent enough to cause severe damage to the nervous system.

entry: POKENAME睡在深沙，极少现身，潜伏海滩游客影中。据说铲子挖的任何洞，都会变成毁坏的世界入口。
author: icelevelincarnate
source: POKENAME slumbers deep beneath the sand, only rarely emerging and lurking in the shadows of beach-goers. Supposedly, any hole dug by its shovels will become a portal to the Distortion World.

entry: POKENAME出现处会长极黑菌丝。基因分析显示，异于星球所有已知真菌；没有它而单独培养的尝试，全都失败。
author: wiz0z
source: POKENAME's presence is marked by growths of ultra-black mycelium. Genetic analysis has found it unlike any other fungi known on the planet and attempts to grow it without POKENAME have resulted in failure.

entry: 它只是毁坏的世界的拙劣仿品。夜里靠近游荡的人会消失，再不见踪影……
author: rkmaster25367
source: A pale imitation of the Distortion Realm. Those who wander near at night will disappear, never to be seen again...

entry: 据说盯POKENAME巨口够久，会被里面旋转的发光齿排催眠，方便它扑来吞下。
author: fireblade141
source: They say that whoever stares into POKENAME's maw long enough will become hypnotized by the rotating rows of glowing teeth within, allowing POKENAME to easily swoop in and devour its victim.

entry: POKENAME是来自毁坏的世界的巨兽。异次元的土地碎块嵌在体内，对我们的现实构成威胁。
author: nellnast42
source: POKENAME is a beast hailing from the Distortion World. Chunks of that dimension's earth are embedded into its body, and pose a threat to our reality.

entry: POKENAME歌声扭曲，正常感官听着不舒服。录下倒放，却美得令人久久难忘。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sings songs that sound distorted and discomforting to the normal senses. However, if recorded and played in reverse, its music is hauntingly beautiful.

entry: POKENAME埋地，等大意猎物踩上甲壳，再以标志性鲜红藤蔓勒死。
author: raydrago
source: POKENAME buries itself into the ground, waiting for unsuspecting prey to walk onto its carapace. It then strangles them with its signature bright red vines.

entry: POKENAME每年一次从反转世界出来，探访亡者墓。传说用美味点心或有趣把戏款待，能让珍爱的逝者身后安宁。
author: .realthree
source: POKENAME emerges from the Reverse World once a year to visit the graves of the deceased. Legend holds that supplying this rare Pokémon with delicious treats or entertaining tricks will ensure a peaceful afterlife for your dearly departed.

entry: 这些夜行宝可梦以生命力为食，只需极少便能活。黑鳞每天蜕落，也会让他者焦虑。
author: infinex21
source: These nocturnal Pokémon feed on the life force of others, but only need to feed on trace amounts to survive. Their black scales are shed daily and have an anxiety-inducing effect on others.

entry: POKENAME一看见敌人，就拍动翅膀，气势汹汹地向前冲。可惜，它常在半路忘了为何要打架，于是停下脚步，困惑地嘎了一声。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When POKENAME spots an enemy, they flap their wings before aggressively charging forward. Unfortunately for POKENAME, they often forget why they want to fight partway through the charge. This leads to POKENAME stopping before giving a confused quack.

entry: POKENAME眼神淡漠，实际却爱玩、古怪。通常独居，但训练家一得信任，就会被它全力凶猛守护。
author: ambrosia04
source: Despite its apathetic stare, POKENAME is remarkably playful and eccentric. It is commonly solitary, but it will fiercely protect its Trainer with all its might once they gain its trust.

entry: POKENAME把无尽怒火灌入控影能力，造自己的暗影复制体，只为更有效痛揍怒气目标。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME channels its boundless rage into its shadow manipulation ability. It creates a copy of itself out of shadows solely to be able to better pummel any targets of its ire.

entry: 古代文明敬奉POKENAME，因为它能在维度间开洞。它喜欢被赞美，也乐于向周围生灵展示力量。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME were revered in ancient civilisations for their power to break holes between dimensions. They take joy in being praised and are happy to demonstrate their strength to those around them.

entry: POKENAME收起肢体开始滚动，构成身体的石块便变得漆黑。眼看要撞硬物，就开影门，移到障碍另一侧。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME retracts its limbs and begins rolling, the stones of its body turn pitch-black. If it appears to be careening towards a solid object, it opens up a shadow portal and relocates itself to the opposite side of the obstacle.

entry: 红色火焰用来威吓他者。身体较脆弱，因此常奔跑，避开打斗。
author: infinex21
source: Its red flames are meant to intimidate others. Their bodies are rather frail, so they often spend their time running and avoiding fights.

entry: POKENAME无声穿行维度，电线间静电与哀伤一同脉动。它吃受损信号与被遗忘的数据，扭曲附近机械，久受影响的宝可梦也会心智崩解。
author: jaminmcready
source: POKENAME drifts silently between dimensions, its wires pulsing with static and sorrow. It feeds on corrupted signals and forgotten data, warping nearby machinery and unraveling the minds of Pokémon exposed to its presence for too long.

entry: 训练家进入POKENAME房间，毒气便嘶嘶冒出。许多人忽略，直到迟缓无力，给它机会将昏倒者送出遗迹。
author: quackquackattack
source: When a Trainer enter POKENAME's chamber, a poisonous gas hisses from its body. Many Trainers ignore the presence of this gas until they are too sluggish to move, giving POKENAME the opportunity to usher unconscious Trainers out of the ruins.

entry: POKENAME可分出部分本源，创造跟随、助战的伙伴，各自携不同元素力，爆炸时对周围效果也不同。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can split some of its own essence to create its own companions that follow and aid it in battle. Each carries a different elemental force, creating different effects on their surroundings when they explode.

entry: POKENAME滚动力量惊人，移动却慢。据说时间够长，终能加速得极快，可似乎总先停下休息。
author: vic1312
source: POKENAME roll around with incredible strength, though they move very slowly. It is said that given enough time, they do eventually accelerate to incredible speeds. However, they seem to stop to relax before that can happen.

entry: POKENAME挥舞由不融冰碎块、钨杆和硬石头制成的棍棒。身体满是密实肌肉，重量不断拖累，每动一下都须出力。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME wields a club made from a shard of Never-Melt Ice, a tungsten rod, and a Hard Stone. Its body is so dense with muscle that it is constantly weighed down and must exert itself with every move it makes.

entry: POKENAME看似没嘴，头上金色附肢却总湿着口水。“舌头”卷住物件一拉，连最大巨石也能拖动。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: Though POKENAME appears to lack a mouth, the golden appendage extending from its head is always wet with saliva. It wraps the "tongue" around objects and pulls with enough strength to tow even the largest boulders.

entry: POKENAME身边伴着一大家子微型雷吉宝可梦。有人说，都由它用找到的无生命材料制造，但无人亲见。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME is accompanied by a whole family of miniature Regi Pokémon. It is claimed that POKENAME crafts them all from inanimate materials it finds, but nobody has ever seen this happen.

entry: 旅途中需要母亲般支持的对象，能从POKENAME得到照料。据说为了保护关爱之人，整座山也会搬动。
author: cresselia8themoon
