source: POKENAME provides a nurturing presence for those who need motherly support during their travels. It's said that POKENAME will move entire mountains to protect anyone under its loving care.

entry: POKENAME不同部位似乎让人联想其他大型宝可梦。它大多时间藏着，飞得太慢，容易沦猎物。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: The different parts of POKENAME seem to allude to other large Pokémon. POKENAME spend most of their days hiding, as their slow flight would make them easy prey.

entry: 传说它在海底专门供奉自己的大神殿里沉睡，也曾制造许多其他人造宝可梦。
author: t3isukone
source: Legends claim that this Pokémon slumbers in a great temple devoted to it at the bottom of the sea, and that it built many other artificial Pokémon.

entry: 它用三种不同材料，做出完美抛接球。据说曾有另外两颗，不适合杂耍，便被封印。
author: kiwiarms
source: It has crafted the perfect juggling balls out of three different materials. Supposedly, it once had two other balls that were impractical for juggling and sealed away.

entry: POKENAME姿态优美，在花坛跪坐时，吸引各类宝可梦相伴。它收集苔藓、矢车菊等自然材料，揉合塑成微小球体。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are known for their beautiful grace, attracting all types of Pokémon to be right by their sides as they kneel in flower beds. They collect natural materials like moss and cornflowers, combining and molding them into miniature globes.

entry: POKENAME钳子握力惊人，能从地上扯下巨大的土块，举过头顶，掷向敢挑战的敌人。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's pincers carry a truly titanic grip strength. It tears huge chunks out of the ground, lifted over its head to be hurled at any foes foolhardy enough to pick a fight with it.

entry: 漫长一生，让POKENAME对花蜜越来越挑剔。最爱的花若在一处绝迹，就跨大陆海洋，寻找其他花丛。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: POKENAME's tastes in nectar grow more and more exacting over the course of its long life. If its favorite flowers die out in one location, POKENAME will travel across continents and oceans in search of other patches.

entry: POKENAME身体重、走得慢，却绝不毫无防御。毒刺中的独特毒素，对带有岩石或植物特征的宝可梦格外有效，几乎瞬间就能击倒。
author: sk372
source: Though POKENAME's heavy body causes it to move slowly, it is far from defenseless. Its unique poison within its stinger is particularly effective on Pokémon with stone or plant features, knocking them out almost instantly.

entry: POKENAME生活在深海，守护珍稀濒危宝可梦的家园。受打扰便施毁灭性力量，连最强敌人也会动摇。
author: nyoomymph
source: In the deep sea, POKENAME lives, guarding the homes of rare and endangered Pokémon. When disturbed, POKENAME wields devastating force, making even the most powerful of enemies falter.

entry: POKENAME罕见现身时，多面常错位、不相配。据说解开谜题，将各面转回正确模样，便能解锁终极力量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's rare appearances usually involve its many sides appearing disjointed and mismatched. It's said that those who solve its puzzle and rotate all its sides to the correct appearance will unlock its ultimate power.

entry: POKENAME很懒，宁愿小睡，不愿拖大陆。若逼工作，就会破坏性暴怒。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME is a lazy Pokémon who would rather snooze instead of towing continents. It flies into a destructive rage if it's forced to work.

entry: POKENAME只曾在几乎未受人类影响的偏远岛屿被见到。它温柔却极强，一拳就能将栖居岛屿击裂成两半。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has only been spotted on remote islands almost completely untouched by humans. It is very gentle but also immensely strong, with enough power in one fist to crack its island home in two.

entry: POKENAME手中球是精神力产生的全息影像，代表900年后的世界。只有世界已经终结，球才会消失。
author: animecreep4
source: The globe POKENAME carries is a hologram produced by its psychic abilities. It represents the world 900 years in the future. The only way this globe will disappear is if the world has ended.

entry: POKENAME精神力巨大，据说过去只凭念头，便重塑大陆。传说睡在地壳下，只有世界陷入重大危机，才会苏醒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's psychic strength is so vast that it is said it reshaped continents in the past using only its mind. Legends say it sleeps beneath the planet's crust, waking only when the world is in grave danger.

entry: POKENAME角内藏着长燃火焰，暖意维持背上的树的生命。愤怒时，火从每孔迸出，骤热让树在发作后数天就长大。
author: bigoljax
source: Inside POKENAME's horns, a hidden flame constantly burns, the radiating warmth keeping the tree on its back alive. When angered, this flame bursts out of each hole, the sudden heat causing the tree to grow larger only mere days after an outburst.

entry: 大型陆块挡路，它就试着推开。但受个头所限，努力总是徒劳。
author: hophoppip
source: When a large landmass blocks its path, it will try to push it away. Due to its size, its efforts are always fruitless.

entry: 故事里，两只POKENAME想要壶壶果汁。一只绑绳，想把它扯开；另一只交朋友。双方都成功，但绑绳者明白，这方法不可长久。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: There is a tale that tells of two POKENAME trying to get juice from a Shuckle. One ties a rope to it to try and pull it apart while the other befriends it. Both succeed, but the one that tied a rope realizes its method is unsustainable.

entry: 故事里，两只POKENAME想要壶壶果汁。一只绑绳，想把它扯开；另一只交朋友。双方都成功，但交友者一生都有果汁享用。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: There is a tale that tells of two POKENAME trying to get juice from a Shuckle. One ties a rope to it to try and pull it apart while the other befriends it. Both succeed, but the one that made friends was able to enjoy a life full of juice.

entry: 故事说，POKENAME先塑月面地形，才降到此世。它在有地壳不稳风险的地方，腿上圆环会发更亮的光。
author: sk372
source: Stories say POKENAME first shaped the moon's terrain before coming down to our world. The rings on its legs glow brighter when in areas of potential tectonic instability.

entry: POKENAME睡时，金色花瓣微开，泛淡光。谁想往花瓣中看中央藏什么，就会挨日光束。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: As POKENAME sleeps, its golden petals open slightly, emitting a pale glow. Attempts to look into the petals and see what lies at their center are met with a Solar Beam.

entry: POKENAME身体是石与金属的复合材料，防御近乎无懈可击。巨钳轻易就能撕碎人类已知最坚固材料。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is a composite material of stone and metal that makes its defenses nearly impregnable. Its massive claws can tear apart and shatter the sturdiest of materials known to man with ease.

entry: POKENAME在遭火山毁灭的古文明遗迹出没，平时多不动。只有感到地底深处板块活动的震动，才开始动弹。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can be found within the ruins of ancient civilisations that were wiped out by volcanic eruptions. They are largely inactive Pokémon, only stirring when they sense the rumbling of tectonic activity deep beneath the earth.

entry: POKENAME潜水越久，附近水越洁净。传说最初珊瑚礁，来自它身体断落的碎片。
author: sk372
source: Water in POKENAME's vicinity becomes more pristine the longer it stays submerged within. Legends say the first coral reefs formed from bits of POKENAME's body that had broken off.

entry: POKENAME爱缠住球状物，持续紧箍。传说有一只大到足以环绕整颗星球。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a tendency to wrap itself around anything orb-like and stay tightly constricted upon it. Legends say there exists a POKENAME large enough to encircle the entire planet.

entry: POKENAME极罕见，世界各地统治者却不断寻找。因为许多故事说，最小的珍珠也能被它做成美丽雕像。
author: bigoljax
source: Even though they were exceptionally rare to find, rulers across the world constantly sought out POKENAME. This was due to many stories claiming that it could make beautiful statues from even the smallest pearls.

entry: POKENAME用尾上漆桶四处泼漆，永不耗尽。据说世界本身就是它们涂上颜色的。
author: santon5512
source: POKENAME use the buckets of paint on their tails to throw paint everywhere, never running out. It is said that these Pokémon painted the world itself, giving it color.

entry: 据说，POKENAME的奶富含无比强大的力量与营养，能让饮用者获得移动行星的力气。不过，人们几乎从未见过它，将自己的奶分享给人类。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's milk is said to be packed with so much power and nutrients that it would give the drinker the strength to move a planet. It has rarely, if ever, been seen sharing its milk with humans, however.

entry: 它常耗尽体力，静止休养，因此身上长片片苔藓。有流传甚久的传说称，尾击能造新山。
author: infinex21
source: Its body is covered in patches of moss due to how often it will exhaust itself and go immobile to recuperate. There are some enduring legends that claim the impact of its tail will give rise to new mountains.

entry: 据说体内毁灭力量巨大，因此这些宝可梦休眠，抑制自身实力。强健的翅膀只需一扇，就能掀起可怕狂风。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon are said to hold immense, destructive power within themselves, thus they lay dormant to contain their own power. A single flap of their mighty wings can create a fearsome gale force.

entry: POKENAME小巧却强大，能从现实的褶隙中创造想要的一切。可造完之后，往往就丢着不管。
author: ohok3441
source: POKENAME is a small but powerful Pokémon, creating anything it pleases from folds of reality. It tends to abandon its own creations.

entry: 据说POKENAME叫声带魔力，附近岩石、钢、冰会自行活过来。短暂存在的魔像，便替它做简单杂务。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's supposedly magic cries spontaneously animate nearby rocks, steel, and ice. These short‑lived golems perform simple chores for it.

entry: POKENAME多余能量，从头上三种材料排出。材料不同，便落下相应碎石、雪花或铁屑。
author: sk372
source: Excess energy from within POKENAME's body gets vented out through the three different materials on its head. It sheds pebbles, snowflakes, or iron shavings depending on which material is venting the energy.

entry: 传说最初击中星球的雷电创造了POKENAME。电力无尽，能量雷击轻易挖开、重塑大片土地。
author: sk372
source: Legends say the first lightning strikes to hit the planet created POKENAME. With boundless electrical power, its own bolts of energy can easily dig out and reshape large swaths of land.

entry: POKENAME靠体内烈火供能，吞吃木头来维持火焰。左臂以物理重击痛打，右臂则发强火球轰敌。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are fueled by their intense inner flames and devour wood to fuel these flames. They batter foes with physical strikes using their left arms and blast them with intense fireballs launched by their right arms.

entry: 古迹雕刻似乎描绘POKENAME以巨牙挡冰墙。考古学家认为，这或许解释了上次冰河时代，某些地区未被冰川覆盖。
author: lordjoostmeister
source: Carvings found in ancient ruins appear to depict POKENAME using its mighty tusks to hold back walls of ice. Archaeologists believe it may be responsible for areas that remained untouched by glaciers during the last ice age.

entry: 这种庞大魁梧的宝可梦守着文明残迹，凶猛驱赶所有入侵者。研究者推测，还藏着更偏横向的第二形态，在艰难战斗中使用。
author: sk372
source: A hulking giant of a Pokémon that guards over the remains of civilizations, it aggressively repels any intruders. It is theorized by researchers that it possesses a secondary, more horizontal form it uses in particularly tough battles.

entry: POKENAME面部光点闪动时，发出难懂的尖叫与哔声。它以面具和天然伪装藏身，观察其他宝可梦，希望理解、交友。
author: kittenthepiratekat
source: The noises made by POKENAME are unintelligible, sharp screeches and beeps as the lights on its face flash. Using the mask on its face and natural camouflage to hide, POKENAME observes other Pokémon in the hopes of understanding and making friends.

entry: 传说POKENAME一记强力下劈腿，打碎原初超大陆，陆地才分成各个大陆。
author: staghorn
source: Legends state that POKENAME is responsible for fracturing landmasses into individual continents, having broken apart the primordial supercontinent with a mighty axe kick.

entry: POKENAME让面具般脸上的凹陷闪光，彼此沟通。休息时站得一动不动，活动时却能释放毁灭性的神秘力量。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME communicate by flashing lights from the indents upon their mask-like faces. They often stand perfectly still as they rest, but are capable of unleashing devastating mystical powers when active.

entry: 数百年前，无数传言说POKENAME偷棺造魔像，令人惧怕。但这些故事已被证伪，许多事件其实是盗墓贼劫棺所致。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME once caused dread to many several centuries ago, due to countless claims of it stealing coffins and turning them into golems. These stories were proven false, as many of these claims were just the doings of graverobbers pillaging coffins.

entry: POKENAME外壳是金属，身体则有磁性。体型庞大又带磁，让它常吸附在大型金属物上。
author: sand_coffin
source: Its outer shell is metallic, while its body is magnetic. Due to its enormous size and magnetic body, POKENAME often clings to large metal objects.

entry: 据说POKENAME由与星球紧密相系的特殊能量构成。灵体尚未显现，就能让周围地面颤动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body is said to be comprised of a special energy tied deeply to the planet itself. Even before it manifests its spectral form, it can cause the ground around it to tremble.

entry: POKENAME握力惊人，据说一旦附在某物上，任何力量都拉不走。头上三孔可喷三种元素能量，威慑想移走它的对象。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's grip strength is so great that it's believed nothing could pull it from whatever it attached itself too. The three holes on its head can spew three different elemental energies to deter anything that would try to remove it.

entry: POKENAME头部有盾甲保护，符号受击时依序亮起。所有圆圈点亮，就能释放储存的强能量，击倒对手。
author: sk372
source: The symbols on POKENAME's shielded head light up in sequence as it receives attacks. When all circles are lit up, it can release a powerful burst of stored energy to down its opponents.

entry: 传说古时，它保护世界免遭海啸与飓风。后来试图拦住巨大小行星，却因此丧命。
author: soup1900
source: Legends say that this Pokémon protected the world against tsunamis and hurricanes during ancient times. It died while trying to stop a giant asteroid.

entry: 传说POKENAME用触角控附近原料，制成小型灵体魔像。据说这些魔像只会暂时存在，一周便失去意识、崩倒。
author: bigoljax
source: In legends, it's said that POKENAME can use its antennae to take control of nearby raw materials, forming them into small, spectral golems. These golems are said to be temporary, losing consciousness and collapsing after only a week.

entry: 流传的传说称，它沉睡数千年时，背上曾维系完整生态系统。但除附着的茂密草丛与苔藓外，再无佐证痕迹。
author: infinex21
source: There are enduring legends that claim the back of this Pokémon once sustained an entire ecosystem while it hibernated for millennia. There are no traces that suggest this to be true, save for the lush patches of grass and moss that cling to its body.

entry: 古代贤者记载过，野生POKENAME用1,000条手臂搬动大陆。却无记录解释手臂从何处伸出，引来无穷猜测。
author: .izik
source: Ancient sages wrote of Wild POKENAME moving continents with 1,000 arms. No record explains where these arms emerge from, fueling endless speculation.

entry: POKENAME每个小朝北鼻都由不同材料制成。若损坏或遗失，就回原制作地，取原料，再造新的。
author: kiwiarms
source: Each of a POKENAME's Mini-Noses is crafted from a different material. If one is broken or lost, POKENAME will travel to where it was originally crafted to get more of the original material before making a new one.

entry: 神话称，POKENAME一击就能打碎大陆。碎片散落，便成了一座座群岛。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: According to myth, POKENAME is able to shatter landmasses with a strike. These myths claim that archipelagos result from the pieces.

entry: 神话称，POKENAME一击就能打碎大陆。碎片散落，便成了一座座群岛。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: According to myth, POKENAME is able to shatter landmasses with a strike. These myths claim that archipelagos result from the pieces.

entry: POKENAME是海沟中的深海巨兽。有人说，海床每处轮廓都由它依个人审美，细细塑造。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a deep-sea leviathan that resides in oceanic trenches. Some say every contour of the ocean floor was crafted meticulously by POKENAME according to its personal sense of aesthetics.

entry: POKENAME身体齿轮很少转，让其转动的尝试也总失败。传说一旦某齿轮终于转，附近一切便被强行合成饥饿难耐的魔像，大肆破坏。
author: bigoljax
source: The gears making up POKENAME's body rarely turn, with attempts trying to make them turn failing terribly. Legends say that once a gear finally turns, anything nearby will be forcibly combined into a ravenous golem that will cause great destruction.

entry: 若固拉多与雷吉奇卡斯的传说属实，POKENAME或能彻底重塑星球面貌。它似乎能控各类元素，从冰片到钢梁都行。
author: bobosmith01
source: If the legends about Groudon and Regigigas are true, then POKENAME could entirely reshape the face of the planet. It is seemingly able to control the elements, from shards of ice to beams of steel.

entry: 据说POKENAME自时间开端，便从臭氧层巡视、守望星球。有人说，它能将星球能量导入体内，发射毁灭性光束。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to have surveyed and watched over the planet from the ozone layer since the dawn of time. Some say it can channel the energy of the planet itself into its body to fire its devastatingly powerful beam attacks.

entry: POKENAME庞大的能量储备，让身体几处获得元素特性。据说这些部位若脱落，过一段时间，会作为新独立宝可梦起身。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's massive stores of energy have caused several parts of its body to take on elemental properties. It is said if these parts fall off they will rise up some time later as new individual Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME曾被称为“最初的巨人”，能徒手修复整座城市。背上神殿原本是为供奉它而设。
author: bigoljax
source: Once called 'The First Titan', POKENAME can mend entire cities using only their bare hands. The temple on its back was once meant for worshipping POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME战时随时应对来袭。力量巨大，甚至被认为能将月亮举过头顶。
author: chibitales
source: In battle, POKENAME stand ready for anything that comes their way. Their strength is so immense, it's thought they would be able to heave the moon itself above their heads.

entry: POKENAME守着岛上自古存在的茂密森林。背上大炮威力惊人，据说动力来自它从星球本身引来的能量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stands guard over lush island forests that have existed since ancient times. It's believed the power source behind its cannon's massively powerful shots is energy it channels from the planet itself.

entry: POKENAME身体虽重，却可用内部能量升空漂浮。曾被见到扯起大块土地，跨越大陆搬到其他地方，原因不明。
author: sk372
source: Despite its heavyweight body, POKENAME can lift itself into the air and float around via its internal energy. It has been seen relocating huge chunks of land ripped from the ground, bringing them to other places across continents for unknown reasons.

entry: POKENAME降到地面时，用篮子铲取自然材料。许多警示故事说，采集时会不慎掳走登山男，飞上天还浑然不觉。
author: bigoljax
source: When POKENAME lower themselves to the ground, they use their baskets as scoops to collect natural materials. Many cautionary tales warn of POKENAME accidentally kidnapping Hikers while collecting, flying off into the sky without noticing the Hiker.

entry: 许多人认为POKENAME寄居的雕像，与传说的巨人有关。有人说，是人类试造自己的巨人，却未成功的产物。雕像虽小，却能承受其灵体力量。
author: bigoljax
source: Many believe the statue POKENAME inhabits has relations to the Legendary Titans, with some saying the statue was a failed attempt by humans to make a titan of their own. Though small, this statue is able to withstand POKENAME's spiritual power.

entry: 传说，POKENAME的丝网将群岛维系在一起。它富有创造力，会用蛛丝编织灵活多变的构造。
author: mistymagius
source: Legends say that POKENAME's webs hold island groups together. It is a creative Pokémon, making dynamic structures out of their webbing.

entry: POKENAME像交通灯，却从不亮绿，只会红或黄，而且红灯持续得异常久，才会换色。
author: musicsheep.
source: POKENAME resembles a traffic light, but it never shines green. It only glows red or yellow, with its red phase lasting unusually long before changing.

entry: POKENAME不断找强敌。找不到，就用冰、黏土与岩浆，自制对手。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME is in constant search of powerful opponents. If it cannot find any, it uses ice, clay, and magma to make its own.

entry: POKENAME收集岩石、冰、废金属，做传说的巨人的可动小人偶。虽常轻易散架，仍乐意尽力修好。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME constantly collect materials like rocks, ice, and scrap metal, using them to create small action figures of the Legendary Titans. Though these figures often fall apart quite easily, POKENAME will gladly repair them whenever it can.

entry: 据说古时，POKENAME用多条尾巴里储存的魔力塑造星球。谁不经许可碰尾，它就让地面裂开，将其整个吞入。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is said to have used the magic stored within its many tails to help shape the planet in ancient times. People say that if one touches a tail without POKENAME's permission, it will make the ground open up and swallow them whole.

entry: POKENAME按环境与需要重塑身体。卷须状肢体也能伸入土地，几分钟内塑出新植物与岩石地形，改变身边。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME reshapes its body to suit its current environment and needs. Its tendril limbs can reach into the ground and alter its immediate surroundings as well, forming new plants and rock formations in minutes.

entry: POKENAME在海底极慢行走。身上海草本能地抓住游得太近的小生物，让它在漫长海床旅途中也能进食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME dwells at the bottom of the ocean, moving incredibly slowly. The seaweed on its body acts on instinct to grab small creatures that swim too close so that it may feed during its lengthy treks across the sea bottom.

entry: POKENAME颚又硬又强，能压碎钻石。它在古神殿里挖坑，不管多久，都耐心等猎物跌入。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's jaws are so hard and so strong that they can crush diamonds. POKENAME digs pits inside ancient temples and patiently waits for prey to stumble in, no matter how long this takes.

entry: POKENAME齿轮转动，释放微弱辐射，让附近土地恢复活力。待得够久，久荒土壤也会再现生命。
author: sk372
source: As POKENAME's gears turn, it emits a faint radiation that rejuvenates the land around it. Even long-barren soil will show signs of life again if POKENAME spends enough time in the area.

entry: POKENAME背上穹罩藏着近乎灭绝的植物。植物遇险，旋翼就会封住穹罩。有传说称，大火后，它能独自恢复毁林。
author: bigoljax
source: The domes POKENAME carry on their backs contain near-extinct plant life, their propellers enclosing the dome whenever the flora is in danger. Some legends say that after terrible wildfires, POKENAME can restore destroyed forests on their own.

entry: 据说POKENAME每小走一步，都能使山喷发。许多人便供奉、给舒服窝，想让它别动。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are said to make mountains erupt with each of their tiny steps, so many people have given them offerings and a comfortable den in an effort to keep them from moving.

entry: POKENAME感到大限将至，就扎根地面，不再动。随后把灵体能量释入地下，化为植物养分。
author: dodoowner_
source: When POKENAME senses its time is near, it will root itself in the ground, rendering itself immobile. It will then release its spiritual energy into the ground, acting as nutrients for plant growth.

entry: 它们柔软如草的翅膀，能融入筑巢的树冠。许多眼睛以不同规律闪光，同时发出尖锐声音，借此与同类交流。
author: infinex21
source: Their soft, grass-like wings help them to blend in with the tree canopies they nest upon. Their many eyes emit shrill noises when they flash in various patterns, and serve as means for them to communicate with their kind.

entry: 茂盛双翼常长花果，扇翅便散下。许多眼以图案闪动时，会发高音旋律。
author: infinex21
source: Their lush wings often grow flowers and fruits that will be scattered when they flap their wings. When their many eyes flash in patterns, they emit high-pitched melodies.

entry: POKENAME游过荒土，留下绿黏液轨迹，其中含多样种子，很快就长成繁茂植物。
author: dodoowner_
source: POKENAME slithers around barren dirt fields, leaving a green trail of goo behind it. These trails contain a variety of seeds, which will soon sprout into lush flora.

entry: POKENAME身体汇有世界各地最坚固的石头。人们认为，或能较轻松地使整片大陆隆起、重塑形状。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body condition contains the strongest stones from across the regions of the world. It's believed to potentially have the power to raise and shape an entire continent with relative ease.

entry: 融合后，POKENAME原有冰身变成琥珀与草叶。许多故事声称，雷吉艾斯刚被创造时，原本就是这模样。
author: bigoljax
source: The ice that once made up POKENAME's body has now been transformed into amber and foliage after fusion. Many stories and tales claim that POKENAME was the original appearance of Regice when it was first created.

entry: POKENAME罕见，住在茂密热带雨林。颈上植物般褶饰能振动，放出独特粉，连最荒土也可恢复。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is a rarely-seen creature dwelling in lush tropical rainforests. The plant-like frills on its neck can vibrate and release a unique powder that could rejuvenate even the most barren of soil.

entry: POKENAME的歌声蕴含强大能量，能恢复并重塑周围的土地。人们认为，只要唱得足够久，大地便会变得如同史前时代。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's song possesses a powerful energy that revitalizes and reshapes the land around it. It's thought that if it sang for long enough, it would turn the land into something resembling how it looked in prehistoric times.

entry: POKENAME以拳制造古代样式的武器与铠甲。古迹将它描绘为战争、冲突的诱因。
author: soup1900
source: Using its fists, POKENAME creates weapons and armor seen during ancient times. Ancient ruins have depicted it as the catalyst for war and conflict.

entry: POKENAME是伏击猎手，在沉船等猎物。一进攻击范围，就飞冲出来，以利爪斩击。
author: wyvernstorm
source: As an ambush predator, POKENAME waits in sunken ships for prey to come close. Once the prey is in striking distance, POKENAME bolts out and slashes it with its sharp claws.

entry: POKENAME背上小丘有兴旺的微型生态系统。想要哪片地，就切取下来，小心加到自己身上。
author: pkbonusducks
source: The hill on POKENAME's back houses a thriving miniature ecosystem. POKENAME carve and take whatever pieces of land they want, carefully adding them onto their bodies.

entry: POKENAME身体散出的烟，能使吸入者恢复活力。但只有刚从体内放出的烟有效，因此装瓶售卖尝试全失败。
author: sk372
source: The smoke emanating from POKENAME's body carries a rejuvenating property for those that inhale it. It only works immediately after releasing from its body, so attempts to bottle and sell it have fallen flat.

entry: POKENAME游历世界，却因极其厌恶社交而独来独往。它们很迷恋虫类宝可梦，总伸出前臂，让对方停在上面。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME travel across the world, keeping to themselves due to their deep hatred of social interaction. They have quite a fascination with bug Pokémon, always holding out their forearms so they can land on them.

entry: POKENAME力量巨大，飞行落地便震地。它改造周围土地筑窝，独居其中，直到够格挑战者前来。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's titanic strength causes the ground to shudder when it lands from flight. It reshapes the land around it to form a den for itself, secluding itself away until a worthy challenger comes to battle it.

entry: POKENAME扁尾反复拍地，能造8级地震。可惜得同点拍多次，通常几下便腻了。
author: .izik
source: By slapping its flat tail repeatedly against the ground, POKENAME can create category 8 earthquakes. Unfortunately, it must strike the same spot many times to do this and usually grows bored after the first few slaps.

entry: 据说POKENAME大智慧与精神力，使其与星球契合，能引导其能量。勺子可造多个元素能量球。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's vast intellect and psychic powers are said to have attuned it to the planet and allowed it to channel its energy. It can generate multiple spheres of elemental energy through its spoons.

entry: POKENAME主触手尖端的爪，强得离谱。领地里经过的最坚船，也几乎不费力就撕碎。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's main tentacles have ridiculously strong claws at the tips. It can tear apart the sturdiest of ships passing through its territory with almost no effort.

entry: POKENAME腿力极强，能轻易拉倒整座建筑。许多故事讲，一位强统治者以它为坐骑，仅凭力量征服一个个王国。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME carry great strength in their legs, giving them the power to pull down entire buildings with ease. Many stories tell of a tale about powerful ruler using a POKENAME as their steed, conquering entire kingdoms through strength alone.

entry: POKENAME一直睡在壳中，只有与它相似的宝可梦或另一强大力量召唤，才会醒。睡时，各种生灵在身上生活、生长。
author: bobosmith01
source: POKENAME remains in an eternal slumber in its shell until it is called upon by similar Pokémon or another powerful force. While it sleeps, all sorts of organisms live and grow upon it.

entry: POKENAME睡在深海，壳闭合时几乎不会受损。极少打开的时刻，周围地面便隆隆震动。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME slumbers deep at the bottom of the ocean; its hard shell is nearly impervious while it remains closed. On the rare occasions it opens up, the ground around it shakes and rumbles.

entry: POKENAME洁净的外层下，隐藏着层层气体的复杂活动。高压与强热搅动，微型风暴、旋涡在里面肆虐。
author: wiz0z
source: The pristine outer layer of POKENAME belies the complex layers of gaseous activity beneath. Miniature storms and vortices rage within, churned by high pressure and intense heat.

entry: POKENAME催眠注视摆锤者时，眼睛明亮发光。醒后的人报告，做了被深埋地下的怪梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's eyes glow bright as it sends those who gaze into its pendulum to sleep. Those who have woken up after being hypnotized report strange dreams of having been buried deep underground.

entry: 传说创造传说的巨人期间，巨大的POKENAME会改造全球深海床，用挖掘机般巨钳，重塑脚下土地。
author: big_clanker
source: Legends say that during the creation period of the Legendary Titans, the giant POKENAME would alter the deep sea floors of the world, using its excavator-like claw to terraform the land beneath it.

entry: 据说POKENAME探访熟睡者，将噩梦存进背球茎。吐息像刚割的草，能让任何对象深睡。
author: fiordaliso
source: It is said POKENAME stores the nightmares of people it visits in their sleep within the bulb on its back. Its breath, smelling of freshly cut grass, can send anyone into a deep slumber.

entry: 这些宝可梦的下半身宛如飘动的披风，沿林地和树干爬行，寻找大片叶子吃。睡着时，白色触角会像缕缕烟丝一样摆动。
author: infinex21
source: With their lower bodies in the visage of a flowing cape, these Pokémon crawl along forest floors and up the sides of trees in search of large leaves to feed upon. When asleep, their white antennae flick about like wisps of smoke.

entry: POKENAME把噩梦转为电荷，偶尔能在噩梦者枕上发现。受扰，可能在一团烟中爆炸。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME converts bad dreams into electrical charge, and can occasionally be found on the pillow of people who are experiencing a nightmare. If disturbed, it may explode in a puff of smoke.

entry: POKENAME圆身充满黑烟，呼出便能哄人睡。压力过高就爆炸，将周围一切投入噩梦般黑暗虚空。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's round body is full of black smoke, which it can breathe out to lull people to sleep. If the pressure inside it becomes too high it will explode, plunging everyone around it into a nightmarish dark void.

entry: POKENAME圆身似乎只是电力形成的发光投影。真身藏在下方黑暗虚空，从不完全现形。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's round body seems to just be a glowing projection formed from electricity. Its true form is hidden in the dark void beneath it, and will never fully reveal itself.

entry: 六个蛋状POKENAME会随时间开裂，露出奇异烟丝状物。谁吸入，便受可怕噩梦纠缠。
author: hophoppip
source: The six egg-like POKENAME crack over time, revealing the strange, wispy substance within them. Anyone who inhales this substance will be plagued with terrible nightmares.

entry: POKENAME为自娱寄居梦中，微妙影响，注入悲伤。过程要极度专注，令佩戴头骨出现裂纹。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: To entertain itself, POKENAME inhabits dreams and subtly influences them, injecting them with sadness. This takes intense concentration and causes cracks to appear in the skull it wears.

entry: POKENAME轻易漂浮，中空身体满是浓白烟。吸入者会陷进满是噩梦的深沉梦境。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME float about with ease, their bodies hollow and full of a thick, white smog. Those who inhale its smog will be plagued with deep dreams filled with nightmares.

entry: 黑烟浓得常遮住全部动作。吸太多便会深度昏迷，有些人一直没醒。
author: infinex21
source: Their black smog is so thick that it often conceals their every movement. Those who breathe in too much of their smog will fall into a deep coma, which some have never returned from.

entry: 谁靠近POKENAME在袋外玩的幼崽，就会被黑暗冲击击昏。人们随后梦见失子，哪怕自己从没孩子。
author: .jerden
source: If anyone approaches POKENAME's infant while it is playing outside its pouch, POKENAME will knock them unconscious with blasts of darkness. People then experience vivid nightmares about losing a child, even if they have no children of their own.

entry: 翼边黑毛像噩梦与恐怖故事中常见的深渊触须。飞过夜空时，大蓝眼泛着微光。
author: infinex21
source: The black fur around its wings is reminiscent of abyssal tendrils oft seen within nightmares and horror stories. Its big, blue eyes glow faintly as it flies through the night sky.

entry: POKENAME以恶魔之吻让大意的人入睡，经历可怕噩梦。常因无力改变的事被嘲笑者，噩梦往往更严重。
author: pinkyoshi2350
source: POKENAME uses Lovely Kiss to put unsuspecting people to sleep, where they experience horrible nightmares. These nightmares tend to be worse among people who have been frequently mocked for things they have no control over.

entry: POKENAME双臂绕圈，生成更多电，向敌人发射黑色电弧。中招立刻倒地，被迫陷入满是噩梦的深睡。
author: sk372
source: By swinging its arms around in circles, POKENAME can churn up more electricity within and launch arcs of black lightning at its foes. Those struck by the bolts immediately collapse, forced into a deep nightmare-laden slumber.

entry: 许多人报告，梦见愤怒POKENAME在雾林追赶。部分人反复做这种梦，甚至因此失眠。
author: cobalt0135
source: Many people have reported nightmares of angry POKENAME chasing them through foggy forests. As a result, some have developed insomnia from recurring dreams.

entry: POKENAME白色长鬃柔软胜丝，也与丝同样受追捧。但它极强、领地意识重，常冲撞一切入侵者。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME's flowing white mane is incredibly soft, even more than silk, and is just as sought-after. However, these Pokémon are incredibly strong and very territorial, oft charging at anything that enters their territory.

entry: POKENAME只在漆黑夜里能找到，眼在暗中泛诡异蓝光。体格并不出众，却散不安气息，让人梦见大毁灭将至。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME can only be found during pitch black nights, their eyes glowing an eerie blue in the dark. They are physically unimpressive but they exude an unsettling aura, creating nightmares of great destruction to come.

entry: POKENAME只在无月夜活动，如烟漂行。吸入翼上毒粉，会让人严重偏执、多疑。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is only active on moonless nights, drifting through the air like smoke. Inhaling the poisonous powders scattered from its wings can cause severe bouts of paranoia.

entry: 皮肤覆着会引来可怕噩梦的毒。头上的针内有解毒剂，可解除这种噩梦。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its skin is covered in a poison that causes terrible nightmares. Its needle on its head contains an antidote that cures its nightmares.

entry: POKENAME从目击者恐惧与噩梦中获力，惨烈暴走，主动毁船、袭击遇见的对象，只为激起恐惧。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME draw power from the fears and nightmares of those that have seen them. They go on terrible rampages, actively seeking to destroy ships and attack anyone that comes across them in an effort to instil terror.

entry: 它用山洪与滔天海啸的噩梦，折磨污染水域的人。受害者醒来时，往往已严重脱水。
author: vaporvenator
source: It torments those that pollute its waters with nightmares of flash floods and towering tsunamis. Victims often wake up critically dehydrated.

entry: POKENAME受威胁，从带刺领圈放出黑电。十万伏特中招者往往久久记住感觉，梦中甚至可能重历。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME loose bolts of black electricity from their spiky collars when threatened. Those struck by their Thunderbolts will oft remember the sensation for a long time and may even re-experience the moment within their dreams.

entry: 无月的夜晚，POKENAME会潜伏在村庄附近，让人做出被烈焰吞没的噩梦。
author: over9001
source: On a moonless night, POKENAME can be found lurking near villages. It is known for making people experience nightmares in which they are engulfed in flames.

entry: POKENAME想找伙伴，拜访用户时却无意添许多麻烦。身在电脑，就强迫机器睡眠，直到离开。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME inadvertently causes many problems for any users it visits. It wants to seek companionship, but its presence in a computer forces the machine into sleep mode until it leaves.

entry: 它潜伏卧室角落，耐心等人睡。在积够进化能量前，POKENAME会趁熟睡偷生命力。
author: dodoowner_
source: It lurks in the corners of bedrooms, patiently waiting for people to fall asleep. Until it has sufficient energy to evolve, POKENAME will steal their life force while they sleep.

entry: POKENAME大多在睡，安详睡相能让旁人也睡去。但近旁入睡者会做可怕梦，通常梦见被它吃掉。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of its time sleeping, and the sight of it is so peaceful that it can lull people to sleep. However, people who rest near POKENAME experience terrifying nightmares, usually involving being eaten by POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME大多在睡，安详睡相能让旁人也睡去。但近旁入睡者会做可怕梦，通常梦见被它吃掉。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of its time sleeping, and the sight of it is so peaceful that it can lull people to sleep. However, people who rest near POKENAME experience terrifying nightmares, usually involving being eaten by POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME睡时，进入附近熟睡者的梦，寻找想象中的食物吞食。突然出现，又饥饿至极，通常让梦者极不安。
author: .jerden
source: As POKENAME sleep, they enter the dreams of anyone resting nearby, searching for imaginary food to consume. Dreamers generally find their sudden appearance and ravenous hunger to be very unsettling.

entry: POKENAME飞过，脚下地面就覆黑霜。哪怕半盎司，也足以在周围一英亩内诱发噩梦；但强光会让霜迅速消融。
author: bobosmith01
source: Wherever POKENAME flies, a black frost coats the ground underneath it. Even half an ounce of this special frost can induce nightmares within the proximity of an acre. The frost quickly dissolves under strong light, however.

entry: POKENAME飞过，脚下地面就覆黑霜。哪怕半盎司，也足以在周围一英亩内诱发噩梦；但强光会让霜迅速消融。
author: bobosmith01
source: Wherever POKENAME flies, a black frost coats the ground underneath it. Even half an ounce of this special frost can induce nightmares within the proximity of an acre. The frost quickly dissolves under strong light, however.

entry: 夜里月亮越难看见，POKENAME就越强。为达到全力，它以黑雷云盖天，让阴影与雷电笼罩大地。
author: h0bojoe
source: At night, POKENAME grows stronger the less visible the moon is. To reach its full power, it blankets the sky in dark thunderclouds, smothering the land in shadow and lightning.

entry: POKENAME曾被视为受诅咒的生灵。起因是饥饿绝望的登山男吃下蜕皮，却不知其中有毒，因而短暂昏迷，饱受可怕噩梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME was once thought to be a cursed creature. The reputation started from when a desperate, starving Hiker consumed its shed skin, unaware of the toxins within that put them in a short coma wracked with horrific nightmares.

entry: 新月时，POKENAME从湖中升起，连最凶的暴鲤龙也恐惧逃走。周身噩梦气息，能激起强烈恐惧与悲伤。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: When POKENAME rises out of its lake during the new moon, even the fiercest Gyarados will flee in terror. It cloaks itself in a nightmare-inducing aura that can invoke intense feelings of fear and sorrow.

entry: POKENAME最常在新月岛周边无月夜被见到。它在附近时，人们报告噩梦不断，家中物品也会飘浮身旁。
author: bobogagabobo
source: POKENAME is most often seen on moonless nights around Newmoon Island. When it is nearby, people report suffering nightmares and seeing household objects levitate around them.

entry: POKENAME想与其他宝可梦交友，存在却会引来噩梦沉睡。它能反制、给予美梦，但需要极耗神的高度专注。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME seeks to make friends with other Pokémon, but its presence causes nightmare-filled slumbers. It can counter the effect to provide good dreams, but it requires an exhausting amount of mental concentration on its part.

entry: POKENAME意外地爱社交，常想与人互动。但可怕外貌吓走他者，有些甚至因此做噩梦。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME are surprisingly social Pokémon, often attempting to interact with humans. However, their frightening appearances often scare away others, even leaving some with nightmares.

entry: POKENAME是好奇夜客，爱入梦，看人梦什么。可惜在场便让梦转噩梦，因此每次仅短暂来访，害怕造成精神伤害。
author: sk372
source: A curious creature of the night, POKENAME likes to enter people's dreams and see what they dream of. Unfortunately, its presence causes dreams to begin distorting into nightmares, so its visits are fleeting, as it fears causing mental harm.

entry: POKENAME深色皮肤吸收照上的全部阳光，再将储存能量化作强光或黑暗能量波释放。花瓣的醉人香气，也能哄人入睡。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's dark skin absorbs all sunlight that falls on it, and it can emit this stored energy as blasts of light or pulses of darkness. The intoxicating fragrance of its flower petals lulls people to sleep.

entry: POKENAME头颈裹着浓厚滚烫的白烟，据称体内藏“地狱之火”。虽无证据火来自冥界，却热得几分钟就烧焦坚岩。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's head and neck are veiled in a thick, hot plume of white smoke due to the "hellfire" claimed to be within them. Though there is no proof that these flames come from the underworld, they are hot enough to char solid rock in minutes.

entry: 它以催眠能力哄人睡，再从远处侵扰噩梦。受POKENAME纠缠者，醒时也很难想清楚事情。
author: ilazerheart
source: It lulls people to sleep with its hypnotic abilities, then haunts their nightmares from a distance. People haunted by POKENAME have a hard time thinking clearly when waking up.

entry: 巨大红颚掩着巨口内多排剃刀利齿。野生POKENAME潜伏最深海处，头部柄状附肢上的蓝光球微微照明。
author: infinex21
source: Its large, red jaw conceals the many rows of razor-sharp teeth within its gaping maw. Wild POKENAME lurk in the deepest ocean depths, lightly illuminated by the blue bulbs upon their head-stalks.

entry: POKENAME四处弹跳，留下淡香，哄人睡。香会带噩梦，但若同时在附近练歌，噩梦就反成美梦。
author: soup1900
source: Bouncing all over the place, POKENAME leaves behind a faint smell that lulls people to sleep. While this smell brings nightmares, if it is also practicing its singing in the area, the nightmares turn into sweet dreams instead.

entry: 人类恐惧等情绪为它供能。据说梦见POKENAME，就是大祸将至的预兆。
author: hophoppip
source: The fear and similar emotions of humans give it energy. Seeing a POKENAME in your dreams is said to be an omen of impending doom.

entry: 一对眼睛始终窥看他者梦境，附近有人噩梦，POKENAME就吸食。与人对视，也能看见其恐惧。
author: nyoomymph
source: One pair of eyes constantly sees into the dreams of others. When someone nearby is having a nightmare, POKENAME feeds off of it. It can see a person's fears by looking into their eyes.

entry: 红色球体储存体内产生的电。球体间放出的蓝雷，常在华美白鬃中噼啪闪动。
author: infinex21
source: Their red orbs store electricity generated within their bodies. Their luxurious white manes often crackle with blue lightning discharged between their red orbs.

entry: 它们在黑暗掩护下窜行。一群POKENAME白发飘动，常像一缕流动白影。
author: infinex21
source: They scurry about within the cover of darkness. A swarm of POKENAME will often appear like a moving wisp of white due to their flowing, white hair.

entry: POKENAME幽灵般的白色茎秆，据说从有权又腐败者心中长出，绕着心成长，待其屈从贪欲，就突然冒出。
author: bandedbodypress
source: The ghostly white stalk of POKENAME is rumored to grow out of the hearts of the powerful and corrupt. It will grow around their hearts and pop out when they give into greed.

entry: 它只在圣树阴影下生长。虽被浓影遮住，POKENAME的叶片实际是金色。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It will only grow in the shadow of sacred trees. Though veiled in thick shadow, the foliage of POKENAME is gold underneath.

entry: POKENAME能看见各个方向的猎物，出击前先吓得对方不能动。人们常说，噩梦般目光与嗡嗡翼声，让人备受折磨。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME can see prey in every direction, paralyzing them with fear before it strikes. People often report being tormented by its nightmarish gaze and buzzing wings.

entry: POKENAME极少被看见，独自待在深海底部，只有特别暗的夜里才上浮觅食。它先令猎物深睡，使其无力挣扎。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Rarely seen, POKENAME keeps to itself in the seabed of the deep ocean. It only rises to the surface to feed on especially dark nights. It puts its prey into a deep sleep, so they are unable to struggle against it.

entry: POKENAME极少被看见，独自待在深海底部，只有漆黑夜里才上浮觅食。它先令猎物深睡，使其无力挣扎。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Rarely seen, POKENAME keeps to itself in the seabed of the deep ocean. It only rises to the surface to feed on pitch black nights. It puts its prey into a deep sleep, so they are unable to struggle against it.

entry: 据说陷入POKENAME的暗黑洞，便情感全无，5种感觉也会全部丧失。它一哈欠，附近几乎谁都会沉睡。
author: bobosmith01
source: Those who fall into POKENAME's Dark Void are said to become devoid of emotion and lose each of their 5 senses. When POKENAME yawns, it is impossible for almost anyone nearby to not fall into a deep slumber.

entry: POKENAME额头宝石泄出的精神力，让在附近入睡的对象陷入逃不掉的噩梦。为保护他者，它独自在阴影中生活。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME's psychic power leaks from the gem on its forehead, causing inescapable nightmares in those who sleep nearby. To protect others from this, POKENAME lives a highly solitary life in the shadows.

entry: 满月增强POKENAME，让它进入附近梦境，以忠诚夜守身份，与梦者并肩对抗噩梦景象。
author: ambrosia04
source: Empowered by the full moon, POKENAME can enter the dreams of those nearby, fighting off visions of their nightmares alongside them as loyal guardians of the night.

entry: 头上奇怪的大舌贝注毒，让POKENAME长期噩梦。它便以精神力投射给别人，免得只自己受苦。
author: hophoppip
source: The strange Shellder on its head injects a poison that gives POKENAME chronic nightmares. It psychically projects these nightmares onto others so it won't be forced to suffer alone.

entry: 这些宝可梦常潜伏暗洞，只见蓝眼与血红獠牙。仅夜间或黑暗时刻才出来，迅速找食物，用有力獠牙咬住。
author: infinex21
source: These Pokémon oft lurk within dark caves, only visible by their blue eyes and sanguine-red fangs. They will emerge only at night or during times of darkness to quickly find food to sink their strong fangs into.

entry: 多数画有达克莱伊的古迹，里面某处都能找到POKENAME。有古石板把它们描绘为达克莱伊派到村落的侦察兵，查看谁值得侵扰。
author: ilazerheart
source: Most ancient ruins containing depictions of Darkrai have POKENAME somewhere inside them. Some ancient tablets depict these Pokémon as scouts, sent into villages by Darkrai to see who is worthy of haunting.

entry: POKENAME进入有植物的梦，主头安静嚼想象中的草木。与此同时，长长的红尾伸出，骚扰威吓梦者。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME enters dreams featuring plants, so that its main head can calmly munch on imaginary vegetation. At the same time, its long red tail will stretch out to harass and menace the dreamer.

entry: POKENAME每天大多时间挂在高处树枝上睡觉。吵闹旅人若唤醒，就落地爆发能量，让周围所有对象深睡、梦不安宁。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME sleeps during most of the day, hanging from high-elevation branches. If noisy travelers wake it, it drops to the ground and explodes with energy that sends everyone around it into deep, troubled sleep.

entry: POKENAME无论出现梦里还是清醒时，都被视为凶兆。漫长冒险结束时，它会唱出优美的歌声。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's appearance, whether in dreams or while awake, is considered to be a dreadful omen. It will sing beautifully at the end of a long adventure.

entry: POKENAME给海上钓到自己的渔人，罩半明半暗阴影，再消失。此后每当睡去，渔人都会梦见被自己钓过的鱼吃掉。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME cast a penumbra of shadows over fishermen who catch them at sea before vanishing. Whenever those fishermen fall asleep, they experience nightmares of being eaten by the fish they have caught.

entry: POKENAME深夜成群飞过，遮暗天空。它受负面情绪与潜意识恐惧吸引，飞向饱受噩梦者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swarm together late at night, darkening the sky as they fly overhead. They are drawn to negative emotion and subconscious fears and will flock toward those suffering from nightmares.

entry: POKENAME深夜成群飞过，遮暗天空。它受负面情绪与潜意识恐惧吸引，飞向饱受噩梦者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME swarm together late at night, darkening the sky as they fly overhead. They are drawn to negative emotion and subconscious fears and will flock toward those suffering from nightmares.

entry: POKENAME一年中大多数时间都在休眠，只在冬日暗夜出洞。靠近熟睡者，会感不祥恐惧，因此人们通常避开。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME hibernates for most of the year, only emerging from its cave during the dark nights of winter. Anyone that approaches it while it is sleeping will feel an ominous sense of dread, so it is generally avoided.

entry: POKENAME无意伤害，却几乎总让身边人梦见火。醒后灼烧感仍可能残留，造成对火焰的长期不安。
author: notadoctor75
source: Though it doesn't mean harm, POKENAME almost always causes those around it to have nightmarish dreams about fire. Even after waking, the burning sensation one experiences in a dream can linger, creating long-lasting anxiety around flames.

entry: POKENAME锐利的目光，能令人与宝可梦立刻沉睡。随后，便拨弄那些中招者的梦。
author: thekrt
source: POKENAME's piercing gaze can instantly put any human or Pokémon into a deep sleep. It plucks at the dreams of those who fell victim to its gaze.

entry: 噩梦能力赶走他者，让它孤独。它带来的大多数噩梦，是独自被困硬壳、动弹不得。
author: hophoppip
source: Its nightmare-inducing powers drive others away from it, leaving it lonely. Most of the nightmares it bestows revolve around being encased in a hard shell, unable to move, and all alone.

entry: POKENAME嘴喷漆黑水柱，快准惊人。中招立刻睡去，受可怕噩梦折磨。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME expels out spouts of jet-black water from its mouth with incredible speed and accuracy. Those hit by the liquid immediately fall into a slumber wracked by terrible nightmares.

entry: 它取走人的梦，化作梦境邮件存进尾巴。饿了，就拆信，吃里面的梦。
author: bacondlx
source: It takes people's dreams and stores them as Dream Mail in its tail. When it gets hungry it will open an envelope and consume the dream inside.

entry: POKENAME让周围很困扰，噩梦气息却极弱。睡时若有一只压胸，会做些关于生病的小噩梦。
author: reiofsunshine1123
source: POKENAME is a nuisance to those who are around it and has a extremely weak nightmare aura. If you have one on your chest while sleeping, you will experience minor nightmares of illness.

entry: POKENAME将自己裹在燃烧的能量里，滚动增强冲力，再展翅起飞。古壁画画着它们成群穿过夜空，如同流星。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: POKENAME cloak themselves in burning energy before rolling to amplify their momentum, then extend their wings to take flight. Ancient murals depict herds of POKENAME flying across the night sky like shooting stars.

entry: POKENAME让到访设备进入睡眠模式，附近生灵也会睡去。受害者会梦见被困在电脑里。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's presence causes the devices it visits to enter sleep mode, as well as causing those near it to fall asleep as well. While slumbering, the victims have nightmares about being trapped within a computer.

entry: POKENAME外表虽吓人，却以在最凶噩梦中带来安宁闻名。它吃驱散的坏梦，常与频繁夜惊的训练家交好。
author: deer_witch
source: POKENAME, despite its appearance, is known as a bringer of peace during the harshest of nightmares. It feasts on the bad dreams that it vanquishes, and typically bonds with trainers who have frequent night terrors.

entry: 旅人与训练家被告诫，夜遇POKENAME别直视鹿角。它通过蓝色球体放出精神脉冲，让观者深睡，陷入可怕噩梦。
author: ambrosia04
source: Travelers and Trainers who encounter POKENAME at night are cautioned never to look directly at their antlers. By pulsing psychic energy through their blue orbs, POKENAME lull onlookers into a deep sleep filled with terrifying nightmares.

entry: POKENAME的画作冲击强烈，又很骇人，据说一瞥就会做噩梦。但喜爱恐怖题材的画家，常说这些画给自己灵感。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: POKENAME paints intense, frightening pictures that are rumored to cause nightmares from just one glimpse. However, artists with a passion for horror often cite POKENAME's art as an inspiration for their own works.

entry: POKENAME侵入他人梦，与熟睡梦者交战。因为肉体脆弱，梦界里却强得多。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME invades the dreams of others and battles with them while they sleep. It does this because its physical body is frail; in the dream world, it is much stronger.

entry: POKENAME用颈部皮膜花纹，吓人陷入不安噩梦。但经历者报告，之后数周会做幸福美梦。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME uses the pattern on its hood to scare people into a fitful nightmare. Those who experience this nightmare, however, report having blissful dreams for weeks afterwards.

entry: POKENAME每天至少产三加仑黑奶，却没人试喝第二次。喝下很快就睡，梦里却满是持续、可怖的哞哞声。
author: .jerden
source: Although POKENAME produces at least three gallons of black milk daily, nobody has tried to drink this substance more than once. Consuming it causes people to quickly fall asleep, but their dreams are haunted by constant, terrifying mooing.

entry: 它们如闪电跑遍大地，寻找受噩梦困扰的宝可梦。POKENAME外表虽然可怕，却只是想吃坏梦，让对方好过。
author: mcnchsschl
source: These Pokémon sprint across the landscape at lightning speed, searching for Pokémon suffering from nightmares. Despite their scary appearance, POKENAME just want to make others feel better by consuming their bad dreams.

entry: 据说POKENAME与因火山喷发留下创伤的人相遇。它夜里吼叫，舒缓他们可能遭受的噩梦。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME is said to cross paths with humans who are scarred from volcanic eruptions. It will roar at night, soothing the nightmares those people might suffer from.

entry: POKENAME一占山，就以漆黑沙暴笼罩。很少有谁能穿过浓云、抵抗催眠作用，到山顶挑战。
author: sk372
source: Once POKENAME claims a mountain, it covers it with a pitch-black sandstorm. Few are able to wade through the thick cloud and resist its soporific effects enough to confront it at the mountain's peak.

entry: POKENAME的羽毛似乎会吸收周围光线，显得漆黑。据说把一根羽毛系在捕梦网上，就能无梦地休息。
author: reiofsunshine1123
source: POKENAME's feathers seem to absorb the light around them, appearing perfectly black. It is said that if you attach one to a dream catcher you will have dreamless rests.

entry: POKENAME会选定一个人跟踪，不断跟随。一旦终于被发现，就凭空消失，另找目标。没人知道原因。
author: jangodiot
source: POKENAME finds people to stalk, and it spends its time following whoever it has chosen. Whenever it is finally noticed, POKENAME disappears into thin air and searches for a new target. It is unknown why POKENAME does this.

entry: POKENAME旋转、抛接杂耍时，能哄人入睡。但据说睡在身边，会梦见永无尽头的马戏团迷宫。
author: mega_beedrill
source: When POKENAME twirls around and juggles, it can lull one to sleep. However, sleeping near this Pokémon is said to cause nightmares of a never-ending circus maze.

entry: POKENAME程序的一点怪癖，让它不由自主地给靠近者带来噩梦。最常见的梦，是被困在网络空间里。
author: sk372
source: A quirk of POKENAME's programming causes it to involuntarily inflict nightmares on those who draw close to it. The bad dreams predominantly include the scenario of being trapped within the world of cyberspace.

entry: POKENAME在林中蹿行，守护领地免遭入侵。若被发现，就让对方短暂睡去，自己趁机逃走。
author: thepandasharky
source: POKENAME scurries around forests, guarding its territory from intruders. If found, it can put others to sleep for a short time as it runs away.

entry: POKENAME融入幽暗森林，隐去身影。猎物在林中迷路时，便会被它催入深睡。
author: thepandasharky
source: It hides in dark forests, blending into the surroundings. POKENAME hunts by putting others into a deep sleep as they get lost in the forest.

entry: 它能哄人和宝可梦入睡。趁对方做梦，便用藤蔓缠紧，抽取能量。
author: thepandasharky
source: It can lull people and other Pokémon to sleep. As they dream, it wraps vines around the sleeping target, draining them of their energy.

entry: 无月夜，POKENAME潜伏野生火稚鸡群。谁忽略了它想要温暖拥抱的心愿，就会被诅咒，一周噩梦不断。
author: h0bojoe
source: POKENAME lurks among groups of wild Torchic on moonless nights. Those who ignore its need for a warm hug are cursed with nightmares for a week.

entry: 新月时，力量会让附近生灵陷入噩梦沉睡。它会牵住你的手，缓解梦中的恐惧。
author: bandedbodypress
source: During the new moon, its powers cause those around it to fall into a nightmarish slumber. It will hold your hand to ease the dread of its dreams.

entry: POKENAME即使只是待着，也和噩梦脱不开关系。它对此无能为力，便留下来，牵住噩梦最严重者的手。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its mere presence is associated with nightmares. POKENAME cannot help it, so it stays and holds the hand of whomever has the worst nightmares.

entry: 它的旋转动作是禁忌知识。不幸看过的人，每一夜都会做可怕噩梦。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its twirling motion is forbidden knowledge. Those unlucky enough to have seen it have horrible nightmares every single night.

entry: 超能力增强了它制造噩梦的本领。即使相隔遥远，也能在梦魇中护住训练家的性命。
author: thunderjimmy
source: This Pokémon's ability to induce nightmares has been amplified by its psychic power. It can safeguard its Trainer's life in nightmares from afar.

entry: POKENAME多在夜里现身于心术不正的人面前，用天真的外表使其放下戒心，再施以可怕的噩梦。它以恐惧与苦痛为食，直到黎明才消失，下个新月之夜再度出现。
author: cinnamoone_redfield
source: POKENAME primarily shows itself at night to those with impure hearts, lulling them in with its innocent appearance before inflicting awful nightmares on them. It feeds off of their fear and anguish until dawn, then disappears until the next new moon.

entry: 受POKENAME纠缠的人，常发现超能力增强，吸引业余超能力者在世界各地追寻。可凡真正找到者，都会被恐惧与失眠逼疯。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Those haunted by it often find their psychic powers growing stronger, drawing amateur psychics to pursue POKENAME across the world. Any who find it are driven to madness from dread and insomnia.

entry: 很久以前，POKENAME会向年轻国王提供指引。接受者可建立庞大帝国，却会在10年内长睡不醒。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Long ago, POKENAME would approach young kings to offer its guidance. Those who accepted could amass great empires, but would fall into an endless sleep within 10 years.

entry: POKENAME以刀刃击地，升起完全遮住周围的黑暗柱。走进阴影者，会被哄入幻想般的梦境。
author: valeoor
source: POKENAME spawns pillars of darkness that completely shroud the area by striking the ground with it's blade. If one were to walk into the shadows summoned by POKENAME, the victim will be lulled into a fantasy-like dream.

entry: 有人认为POKENAME是封在捕梦网中的恶灵聚合体。靠得太近便沉睡，受诅咒，必须受尽108场噩梦才准醒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is believed to be a conglomeration of malevolent spirits entombed within a dream-catcher. Those who get too close to it fall into a deep slumber, cursed to suffer 108 nightmares before they're allowed to awaken.

entry: 这种灵体宝可梦披着引来无尽噩梦的黑暗气息。它跟踪命定宿敌路卡利欧，交锋的冲击波会扭曲时空。
author: vincentblack
source: This spectral Pokémon cloaks itself in a dark aura that induces endless nightmares. It stalks Lucario as its fated rival, their clashes unleashing shockwaves that distort time and space.

entry: POKENAME花朵的醉人香气，使人睡得燥热不安。它似乎不喜强光，晒到阳光直射，就迅速跑向最近阴凉处。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's flower produces an intoxicating aroma that can cause people who inhale it to enter a restless, feverish sleep. POKENAME seems to dislike bright light, and if caught in direct sunlight will run rapidly to the nearest shade.

entry: POKENAME夜里最活跃，藏在阴影中窥伺领地入侵者，再伏击，以强力头锤将其击昏。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME is most active at night, hiding in the shadows to stake out those intruding on its territory. It attacks by ambushing its target and knocking them out with a powerful Headbutt.

entry: POKENAME又快又强，却更爱用黑烟对敌。睡去者会梦见它可能施加的惨烈暴行，让它不必真的动手。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME has great speed and power, but prefers to deal with foes by breathing out black smoke. Anyone this lulls to sleep dreams about the horrific violence POKENAME could inflict upon them, making it unnecessary for POKENAME to do it for real.

entry: POKENAME让人梦见将至灾难，敦促他们提前准备。警告若被忽略，就可能再给另一种噩梦：厄运迫近，身边所有人却漠视梦者。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME makes humans dream of impending disasters, urging them to prepare beforehand. When its warnings are ignored, it may bestow a different kind of nightmare, one where the dreamer is dismissed by everyone around them as their doom approaches.

entry: POKENAME侵扰海底猎物的梦，缺觉目标更好捕。据说它是海员和游泳者患海洋恐惧症的头号原因。
author: xiapher
source: POKENAME haunts the dreams of prey on the ocean floor, as sleep-deprived targets make for easy pickings. It is said that POKENAME is the leading cause of Thalassophobia among sailors and swimmers alike.

entry: 神话称，没有POKENAME创造，噩梦本不会存在。它能窥视人的噩梦，将其变成恐怖现实。
author: soup1900
source: As told in mythology, nightmares wouldn't exist if POKENAME didn't create them. It has the power to see into people's nightmares and turn them into a horrific reality.

entry: POKENAME大多数时间埋在地下，只露背部。新月之夜现身，走近的人或宝可梦，睡眠都会受扰。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME spends most of its time buried in the ground, with only its back exposed. On nights with a new moon it will emerge, and disturb the sleep of any Pokémon or people it walks near to.

entry: 冬季，POKENAME白色的背部，让它融入白雪覆盖的风景。新月之夜，它会现身，扰乱沿途附近宝可梦和人类的睡眠。
author: .jerden
source: In winter, POKENAME's white back enables it to blend in with snow-covered landscapes. On nights with a new moon it will emerge, and disturb the sleep of any Pokémon or people it walks near to.

entry: 它使人入睡、噩梦缠身。若在噩梦中被POKENAME斩杀，现实里便会陷入漫长昏迷。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: It can lull people to sleep and cause them nightmares. If they are slain by POKENAME in their nightmare, they are put into a long coma.

entry: 它使人入睡、噩梦缠身。若在噩梦中被POKENAME斩杀，现实里便会陷入漫长昏迷。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: It can lull people to sleep and cause them nightmares. If they are slain by POKENAME in their nightmare, they are put into a long coma.

entry: POKENAME有时在噩梦中现身，砍倒追人的怪物，再突然攻击梦者。醒来，对方会发现双剑躺在身体两侧。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME sometimes appears to people in their nightmares, striking down monsters that pursue them before suddenly attacking the dreamer. When they wake, that person will find the two swords lying on either side of them.

entry: POKENAME从栖居湖泊的暗水现身，月光下形成美丽画面。触须有神秘力量，能净化噩梦、给予美梦。
author: infinex21
source: A POKENAME casts a beautiful scene within the moonlight as it emerges from within the dark waters of the lake it makes its home within. A POKENAME's feelers have a mystifying ability to purify nightmares and instill pleasant dreams.

entry: 这种宝可梦双翼漆黑，连白天也不变，因此常被称为“黑色弯月”。吼声对意识有奇特影响，有些听者会沉睡。
author: infinex21
source: This Pokémon has often been called the "Black Crescent" due to its pitch-black wings, which remain dark even during the day. Its roar has displayed an odd influence over the consciousness of those who hear it, with some falling into a deep slumber.

entry: 许多人报告在最坏噩梦中见POKENAME，却从无梦外目击报告，引发它是否穿梭心灵的猜测。
author: jojojax164
source: Many have reported seeing POKENAME in their worst nightmares. There have been no reported sightings of POKENAME outside of dreams, triggering speculation whether it travels through minds.

entry: POKENAME藏在暗处，用炮将整个城镇罩进致噩梦黑雾。居民被夜间恐惧折磨时，它便吸收恐惧，为身体补充能量。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides in the darkness before using its cannon to cover entire towns in nightmare-inducing black mist. While the residents roil in nighttime terrors, POKENAME refuels its body by absorbing their fear.

entry: POKENAME手上花朵散香，诱人深睡，再以带刺黑藤缠住，吸取生命能量。
author: sk372
source: The aroma wafting from POKENAME's flower hands lures others into a deep sleep. As they slumber, it wraps them up in thorny black vines and drains their life energy.

entry: 野生POKENAME大多贴地睡觉，固定在枯树上。只在新月之夜飞，飞过的每个人类聚落，居民睡眠都会受扰。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME spend most of their time sleeping close to the ground, anchored to a dead tree. They only fly on nights with a new moon, disturbing the sleep of people within every human settlement they pass over.

entry: POKENAME是胆小的稀有宝可梦。自卫时不踢击，转而让攻击者饱受可怕噩梦。
author: addiction2peaches
source: POKENAME is a timid, yet rare Pokémon. As self-defense it will make its attacker have horrible nightmares rather than kicking.

entry: 研究者用POKENAME进入熟睡病患的梦，试治长期噩梦。疗程已成功，推广方法也正在研究。
author: reiofsunshine1123
source: Researchers have used POKENAME to enter the dreams of sleeping patients to try to cure chronic nightmares. Those treatments have been successful and a way to spread this cure is being worked on.

entry: POKENAME只想有朋友靠着羊毛睡，羊毛能哄人沉睡，却也引来自己无法控制的噩梦，因此别人很难满足心愿。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME only wishes for a friend to sleep against its wool, which lulls others into slumber. Unfortunately, its wool also induces nightmares, something beyond POKENAME's control, so its dream is difficult for others to fulfill.

entry: POKENAME深夜捕猎，专盯野外疲倦的人。即使以为甩掉它，也仍不安全。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME hunt in the dead of night and will target tired people out in the wild. Even if you think you have lost it, you are not safe.

entry: POKENAME在漆黑房里等待靠近者，以暗焰点亮四肢，让看见者陷入满是噩梦的沉睡，再以其恐惧为食。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME lies in wait in pitch-black rooms, until something draws near. It lights up its limbs with dark flames that cause those who view them to fall into a nightmare-filled slumber, before feeding off the terror they exude.

entry: 血红色的长牙，几乎令所有见过的对象恐惧。叫声也以让所有听者冷彻骨髓而恶名远扬。
author: infinex21
source: Its sanguine red tusks invoke fear in nearly all who ever see them. Its cry is infamous for the bone-chilling sensation it invokes in all who ever hear it.

entry: POKENAME跟踪人和宝可梦，等睡着再施噩梦折磨。吸来的负面能量使尾巴泛深红，再化作暗色鬼火，攻击敢挑战者。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME shadows people and Pokémon, waiting until they fall asleep to torment them with nightmares. Its tails glow crimson from the negative energy it absorbs, channeling it into dark will-o-the-wisps it uses to attack any who dare challenge it.

entry: POKENAME的达克莱伊伪装明显靠棍子与丝线支撑，看似威胁不大。它却会在附近熟睡者梦中，化作可怕得多的一团扭动阴影，引来噩梦。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's Darkrai disguise is obviously held up by sticks and string, making it seem non-threatening. It causes nightmares by appearing in the dreams of people sleeping nearby as a much more frightening mass of writhing shadows.

entry: 无光时，POKENAME力量最强。据说能制造全食。它以灼热暗焰消灭附近任何灵魂，毫无怜悯，也不带情绪。
author: evilgammon
source: POKENAME is at its absolute strongest in the absence of light. Said to have power to cause a complete eclipse, its scorching dark flames eradicate any soul nearby without mercy or emotion.

entry: POKENAME翼膜不断散黑雾。短时间吸入过多，会陷入狂乱般状态。它似乎不受自己的雾影响。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME's wing membranes constantly give off a dark mist. Inhaling too much of this mist in a short period causes a frenzy-like state in those affected. POKENAME does not seem to be affected by its own mist.

entry: 旅行中的训练家低声谈论传说宝可梦POKENAME，说它会给远离文明庇护者带来无尽噩梦。典籍说，只有满月光能唤醒被其恶意困住者。
author: katieplaysgames
source: Traveling Pokémon Trainers speak in hushed whispers of POKENAME, a legendary Pokémon that visits unending nightmares on those far from the comforts of civilization. Tomes say that only the light of the full moon can wake those trapped by its malice.

entry: 据说它来自太空，潜伏在人的梦里。一旦被发现，便以异世界的噩梦折磨梦中人。
author: alexanderenjoyer1
source: This Pokémon, said to originate from space, lurks in people's dreams. If found, it torments them with nightmares of other worlds.

entry: POKENAME若被看见，体内星辰会努力变亮，试图晃得目标看不见。DNA已难辨认，有人说被黑暗吞噬过一千次。它已无法再稳定地侵入受害者梦境。
author: .chimerax.
source: If POKENAME is seen, the stars in its body will attempt to shine brighter to blind the target. Its DNA is unrecognisable, some say it has been consumed by darkness a thousand times over. It can no longer reliably invade its victims dreams.

entry: POKENAME很久以前便被封入永眠。古籍告诫绝不可唤醒，否则将带来无穷噩梦。
author: abhatu
source: POKENAME was locked away in an eternal slumber long ago. Ancient texts say never to wake it and warn of the endless nightmares it would inflict.

entry: POKENAME厌恶内容恶毒的愿望。为让许愿者打消念头，会召小传送门，展示心愿实现后引发的可怖事件。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME despises wishes that are malicious in content. To try and dissuade these wishes, POKENAME conjures miniature portals to show what horrible events will ensue if the wish is granted.

entry: POKENAME夜间游入大尾狸水坝，噩梦把它们惊醒。大尾狸很快逃走，只剩它独居坝中。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME swims into the dams of Bibarel at night, waking them up with the nightmares it causes. The Bibarel soon flee, leaving POKENAME alone inside the dam.

entry: POKENAME隐秘独居，藏在人迹少的密林深处。它避开人类，有人靠得太近，就使其陷入深沉而不安的睡眠，自己趁机逃走。
author: keiracm35_
source: POKENAME are elusive, solitary Pokémon found deep within dense, unfrequented forests. They avoid contact with humans, but if one gets close enough, POKENAME use their powers to plunge them into a deep, troubled sleep while they make their escape.

entry: POKENAME夜里藏在沙下，只把部分下颚露出。它放出淡淡的黑雾，吸入者会沉沉睡去，无力躲避，任其咬住、拖入地底。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hides under the sand at night with only part of its jaw exposed to the air. It releases a faint dark mist that causes a deep sleep in those who inhale it, leaving them helpless to avoid being bitten and dragged underground.

entry: POKENAME藏在昏暗浑浊河底，摆动白色鬃毛，在周围水中投出诡异幻象，赶好奇泳者远离淤泥。
author: ambrosia04
source: Dark, murky riverbeds serve as the hiding grounds for POKENAME. By waving their white manes, they project eerie illusions into the surrounding water, driving curious swimmers away from the mud.

entry: POKENAME花朵的醉人香气，使人睡得燥热不安。它似乎不喜强光，晒到阳光直射，就迅速跑向最近阴凉处。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's flower produces an intoxicating aroma that can cause people who inhale it to enter a restless, feverish sleep. POKENAME seems to dislike bright light, and if caught in direct sunlight will run rapidly to the nearest shade.

entry: POKENAME爱柔软拥抱、唱歌哄睡，却似乎完全没意识到，这睡眠里满是可怕噩梦。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME enjoys embracing others in soft hugs and singing them to sleep.  It seems to have no idea that the slumber it puts the other party into is filled with terrible nightmares.

entry: POKENAME受攻击，就向空中散致噩梦花粉。大量吸入，甚至可能从耳中长出花。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Attacking POKENAME releases pollen into the air that causes nightmares. Breathing in large amounts of this pollen can make flowers grow from your ears.

entry: POKENAME大多贴近地面，随微风漂游。若靠得足够近，让睡着的人做起噩梦，它就会突然升空，被高处的强风吹往远方。
author: .jerden
source: Most of the time POKENAME floats close to the ground, drifting on the breeze. If it gets near enough to a sleeping person to cause a bad dream, it will suddenly rise up into the air, and strong, high-altitude winds will blow it a great distance.

entry: POKENAME开始狩猎，会反复俯冲、故意扑空。擦身让猎物渐睡，无力避开接下来的咬击和吸血。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME starts a hunt by purposefully missing its target as it swoops by repeatedly. The close encounters slowly put its prey to sleep, making them helpless to avoid the next bite and subsequent blood-drinking.

entry: POKENAME成群从影中突袭，攻势狂乱无情。有人说，每只都是一个人被黑暗夺走心之后留下的残余。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME attacks in swarms, emerging from the shadows to strike with wild, heartless aggression. Some say each POKENAME is what remains of someone who lost their heart to darkness.

entry: 据说POKENAME诞生于极度惧怕虫类者的噩梦。它以在周围激起的恐惧为食。
author: bitterchemicalhaze
source: They are said to be born from the nightmares of those with a phobia of bugs. POKENAME feeds off of the fear it inspires in those around it.

entry: 强大的黑暗能量让POKENAME越来越愤怒，肌肉随之鼓起、发烫。它的双颚强得能叼起大钢蛇，像武器一样挥舞，也丝毫不松口。
author: infinex21
source: Its potent, dark energies drive it into an ever-growing rage that makes its muscles bulge and burn. POKENAME's jaws are so strong that it can lift a Steelix and flail it around like a weapon without losing its grip.

entry: POKENAME的黑暗能量压过了所有感官，使它困在无尽的噩梦中，狂暴失控。它的尾巴比大钢蛇更粗、更硬，口中释放的能量能将一切化为灰烬。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME's dark energies have overpowered its every sense, locking it into an unending nightmare that drives it berserk. Its tail is thicker and harder than a Steelix, and anything caught within the energies breathed from its maw is razed to ash.

entry: POKENAME生气时，双翼会喷出火焰。过去，人们认为这些火焰来自噩梦世界。它跳起舞来，激情强烈得令人害怕。
author: cresselia8themoon
source: When POKENAME becomes angry, its wings unleash flames that were once believed to be summoned from a world of nightmares. It dances with a frightening, intense passion.

entry: 它的舞姿欢快，观看的人却会感到恐惧。无论参加什么比赛，POKENAME都能成为选手的好帮手。
author: hophoppip
source: Its dances are cheerful, but those who view them are struck with feelings of fear. POKENAME are useful companions for contestants in any competition.

entry: POKENAME住在腐烂的垃圾场和仍在开采的油井下方，只在新月时的黑暗中出现。它拼命吸收周围的污染，想让家园恢复洁净，却不知道污染始终在不断累积，努力注定徒劳。
author: beatdoof
source: Residing beneath rotting landfills and active oil wells, POKENAME emerges only during the dark of a new moon. It desperately absorbs the surrounding pollution in a futile attempt to clean its home, unaware that it will never stop accumulating.

entry: POKENAME全身浸透有毒废料和肮脏的油污，一心执迷于清除污秽。新月时的黑暗预示着它的到来，而它对“垃圾”的定义早已不限于真正的废物。
author: beatdoof
source: Fully saturated with toxic waste and filthy oil, POKENAME is driven by a single-minded obsession to cleanse. Heralded by the dark of the new moon, its definition of 'garbage' no longer stops at literal trash.

entry: 从POKENAME身上取得坚固的木板，不会伤害它。这些木料很适合制作家具，却不该放在卧室里，因为睡在附近就会做严重的噩梦。
author: hophoppip
source: Sturdy planks can be harvested from POKENAME's body without harming it. The wood makes good furniture, but it shouldn't be used in a bedroom, as sleeping near it causes severe nightmares.

entry: 它白天栖居在人们的脑海中，让人看见、听见不存在的东西。到了夜里，它便离开，去猎捕幽灵。
author: bandedbodypress
source: It roosts in people's minds during the day, making them see and hear things that aren't there. At night, it will leave and hunt for ghosts.

entry: POKENAME的身体大部分由几乎坚不可摧的金属组成，从未有过人造武器能留下划痕。偶尔会渗出奇怪的黑色物质，但科学家认为这种物质没有实际用途。
author: sondededoo
source: The metal that composes a majority of POKENAME's body is nigh indestructible as no man-made weapon has ever been able to scratch it. Every so often a strange black substance leaks from its body, but scientists believe it serves no real purpose.

entry: POKENAME的花粉能催人入睡、引起噩梦，因此常被用于梦境研究。
author: kiva
source: POKENAME is known for its soporific pollen that causes nightmares. Because of this, it is often used in oneirological studies.

entry: POKENAME将噩梦的能量化为激光轰击敌人。夜间，它会无声地四处肆虐，暗中徘徊于村落，吞尽居民的梦。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME harnesses the energies of nightmares to blast foes with laser beams. During the night, it goes on silent rampages where it discreetly wanders villages and devours all their dreams from them.

entry: POKENAME极其厌光，光线会使身体灼痛，也让它难以入睡。因此，它只在无月之夜活动，自由吸收黑暗能量，变得极为强大。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME has a strong aversion to light since its body burns in pain and it has trouble sleeping when in it. Therefore, it only becomes active on moonless nights, where it can freely absorb the energies of darkness and become extremely powerful.

entry: POKENAME只盼着与人类孩子依偎着入睡。可惜，睡在它附近就会做可怕的噩梦，自己的愿望似乎难以实现。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME wants nothing more than to cuddle up with a human child and sleep together. Unfortunately, sleeping in close proximity to it inflicts one with terrible nightmares, so POKENAME's own dream seems impossible.

entry: POKENAME夜间潜伏在沿海城镇敞开的窗外，让屋内的睡眠者做噩梦。它似乎以这些噩梦为食，但一受打扰就会立刻逃回漆黑的深海。
author: .jerden
source: In towns close to the sea, POKENAME lurks outside of open windows at night, causing sleepers inside to experience bad dreams. POKENAME seems to feed on the nightmares it causes, but will immediately flee back into the dark ocean depths if disturbed.

entry: 被POKENAME刺中后，会先感到剧痛，再昏过去。入睡后，关于它的可怕噩梦会不断纠缠。
author: dragodigitalstudios
source: Those stung by POKENAME will suffer intense pain before passing out. In their slumber, terrible dreams of POKENAME will haunt them.

entry: POKENAME在赌场与自愿的赌客玩游戏，输掉的人便会陷入可怕的噩梦。据说从来没有人赢过，它只是喜欢折磨贪婪之人。
author: actliux
source: POKENAME offer a game to willing gamblers at casinos, putting them into a terrible nightmare if they lose. It is said that no one has ever won this game, and that POKENAME simply enjoys tormenting the greedy.

entry: POKENAME的桶状身体里，是仿佛没有尽头的黑暗虚空。在海滩上睡觉的人偶尔会遇见它，从噩梦中醒来时，可能会发现它就坐在头旁。
author: .jerden
source: Inside POKENAME's bucket-shaped body is a seemingly bottomless dark void. POKENAME is occasionally encountered by people who fall asleep on beaches, who may wake up from nightmares to see it sitting next to their head.

entry: 新月之夜，POKENAME飘过天空，在下方睡眠者的梦里显现为一座巨大的城堡。尽管它什么也没做，人们醒后却把这形容为可怕的噩梦。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME floats through the sky on nights with a new moon, appearing in the dreams of people sleeping below as a castle of immense size. Despite it not doing anything, people will describe this as a terrifying nightmare when they wake.

entry: 暗黑洞由两道相连的黑暗丝线绕着三条轴线旋转，构成球形。有人认为，旋转若符合完美比例，攻击就会更强，也更令人迷乱。
author: epping_forest
source: Its Dark Void move is made out of two joint dark strings that rotate in all three axes, forming a spherical shape. Some believe that if their rotation matches a perfect ratio, the attack becomes stronger and more disorienting.

entry: POKENAME在月光下无声飘荡，让附近的生灵陷入恍惚。睡在它身边会睡得很不安稳，鲜明的梦境与黑暗的噩梦不断交替。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME drift silently beneath the light of the moon, lulling anyone nearby into a trance. Those who fall asleep in their presence experience a restless slumber that constantly alternates between vivid dreams and dark nightmares.

entry: POKENAME不喜欢在城镇逗留，因为它的存在会隔一阵就迫使附近的生灵陷入沉睡。但这绝不是安宁的睡眠，梦中的噩梦仿佛持续了好几天。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers not to linger in towns, as its mere presence periodically forces those nearby into deep slumber. Unfortunately, these rests are anything but peaceful, resulting in awful nightmares that seemingly last for days for the dreamer.

entry: POKENAME表面上很平静，脑波却呈现出惊恐生灵的典型特征。吸入菇帽释放的孢子，就会经历鲜明而可怕的夜惊。
author: hophoppip
source: POKENAME acts calm, but its brain gives off waves typical of a terrified creature. Inhaling the spores that drift from its cap will induce vivid night terrors.

entry: 许多人相信，尾巴周围的球状光团是那些在睡梦中死去的灵魂。研究显示，POKENAME其实会用这些微光哄人安睡。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Many believe the orbs around its tail are the souls of those who pass during sleep. Research has shown that the wisps are actually used by POKENAME to lull people into a calming sleep.

entry: POKENAME浮着的身体滴下布满闪亮晶体的墨液，凝成噩梦中的怪物。一位著名画家曾把墨液用在一幅作品里，据说看过那幅作品就会做噩梦。
author: hophoppip
source: Sparkling crystal-studded ink drips from POKENAME's floating body, coalescing into the shape of nightmarish monsters. A famous artist once used POKENAME's ink in an art piece, which was said to cause nightmares when looked at.

entry: POKENAME的大复眼后有一层反光层，让光线两次穿过透镜，即使在最黑暗的地方也能看清。明亮的目光会催眠其他宝可梦，让它们入睡。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's large compound eyes have a reflective layer behind them so that light passes through the lens twice, enabling it to see even in the darkest places. Its bright gaze hypnotizes other Pokémon, lulling them to sleep.

entry: POKENAME能使人入睡，唤来梦境或噩梦，因此既受敬奉，也令人畏惧。它真正的力量是将梦境或噩梦化为现实，但只有被逼入绝境才会使用。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME is equally revered and feared for its ability to induce slumber and invoke either dream or nightmare. Its true power, however, is that it can manifest dreams or nightmares into reality itself; it only uses this power when cornered, though.

entry: POKENAME藏在人们的噩梦里，做梦的人必须找到它才能醒来。如果梦里没有光，找到它几乎是不可能的。
author: hiroshima0042_23263
source: POKENAME hides within people's nightmares, where they must find POKENAME to be able to wake up. If there is no light in a nightmare, finding POKENAME is nearly impossible.

entry: POKENAME天性夜行，会寻找睡着的人类和宝可梦，享用纠缠着他们梦境的噩梦。
author: _refuse_
source: Nocturnal by nature, POKENAME seek out sleeping humans and Pokémon, feasting on the nightmares that haunt their dreams.

entry: 凝望POKENAME身上的晶体，会看见其中储存的噩梦幻景。据说它的帷幕能将敌人拉入无尽的噩梦之境，但无人敢激起它这样的怒火。
author: infinex21
source: Those who peer into the crystals upon POKENAME's body will be met with visions of nightmares contained within them. Its veil is said to be able to drag its foes into a realm of unending nightmares, but none dare to incite such wrath from it.

entry: 家养的POKENAME若在训练家睡着时饿了，就会趴在胸口喵喵叫，直到对方醒来。虽然挑剔，却很忠诚，会安慰焦虑或经常做噩梦的训练家。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: If a domestic POKENAME gets hungry while its Trainer is asleep, it will lie across their chest and meow until they wake up. Despite their fussiness, POKENAME are deeply loyal, comforting Trainers with anxiety or frequent nightmares.

entry: 古代壁画将POKENAME描绘成受人敬奉的守夜者。据说，它凶猛的吠叫能驱走可怕的噩梦。
author: mepp.
source: Ancient murals depict POKENAME as a revered guardian of the night. Its fierce bark is said to keep terrible nightmares at bay.

entry: POKENAME在黑夜里飞行，进入梦中挑战其他宝可梦。在梦里，弱小的宝可梦也能变得如自己想象中那般强大，它似乎很享受这些过度自信的对手带来的挑战。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME flies around on dark nights, entering dreams to challenge other Pokémon to battle. Within a dream, weak Pokémon can be as powerful as they imagine themselves to be, and POKENAME seems to enjoy the challenge these overconfident foes provide.

entry: POKENAME会寻找喷火龙等强大的宝可梦练习。拳头能让对手脑海中充满噩梦景象，常常让对方还没来得及回神，自己就已获胜。
author: chibitales
source: POKENAME seek out strong Pokémon like Charizard to train. Their punches fill the target's head with nightmarish visions, often causing the opponent to become disoriented long enough for POKENAME to claim victory.

entry: POKENAME是安静的保护者，常藏在小巷的阴影中。有它们居住的城镇，报告的犯罪率较低。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME are quiet protectors, often lurking in the shadows of alleyways. Towns with POKENAME in them report lower crime rates.

entry: POKENAME散出粉末云，让受影响者睡得不安稳，再靠近，用根吸收梦境中的能量。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME releases clouds of powder which put those affected into a fitful sleep. It then approaches the victim to absorb their dream-energy through its roots.

entry: POKENAME受到威胁时，会用力吐出黑色液体。液体进入对方嘴里或眼里会使其昏倒，因此它通常瞄准脸部喷射。
author: .jerden
source: If threatened, POKENAME will squirt a dark liquid out of its mouth with great force. This liquid can cause others to pass out if it gets into their mouth or eyes, so POKENAME usually aims for the face.

entry: POKENAME分泌催眠的花蜜，人们会采集来制作助眠剂。野生个体会附在睡着的宝可梦头上，植入噩梦。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME secretes a soporific nectar which is harvested as a sleep aid. In the wild, it latches onto the head of sleeping Pokémon, instilling them with nightmares.

entry: POKENAME用藤蔓缠住做梦的猎物，注入诱人的幻景，让其保持平静熟睡，再拉进巨口，吸走生命力并吞食。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME wraps its vines around dreaming prey, infusing them with alluring visions that keep the victim calm and asleep. It pulls the prey into its maw, sapping their life and consuming them.

entry: 偶尔能看见POKENAME站在睡眠者胸口，使其做噩梦。如果受到旁人打扰，就会跃出窗户，以极快的速度逃走。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can occasionally be found standing on top of the chest of sleeping people, causing nightmares. If disturbed by anyone else, it will leap out of the window to flee at great speed.

entry: POKENAME能消失在黑暗虚空中，再高速穿过他人的梦境，从数英里外现身。每个途经的梦里都会留下闪动的红色鬃毛火焰，让梦境迅速变成噩梦。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can vanish into a dark void, then move at great speed through the dreams of others to reappear miles away. The flickering red flames of its mane are left behind in every dream it passes through, quickly turning it into a nightmare.

entry: POKENAME能消失在黑暗虚空中，再高速穿过他人的梦境，从数英里外现身。每个途经的梦里都会留下闪动的蓝色鬃毛火焰，让梦境迅速变成噩梦。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can vanish into a dark void, then move at great speed through the dreams of others to reappear miles away. The flickering blue flames of its mane are left behind in every dream it passes through, quickly turning it into a nightmare.

entry: 训练家骑在POKENAME背上，就能进入他人的梦境——至少，也能梦见自己正在这样做。不幸的是，它进入的任何梦境很快都会变成噩梦。
author: .jerden
source: By riding on POKENAME's back, it is possible for Trainers to enter into other people's dreams - or at least, to dream that they are doing this. Unfortunately, any dream POKENAME enters quickly turns into a nightmare.

entry: POKENAME受到威胁时，会用力吐出黑色液体。液体进入对方嘴里或眼里会使其昏倒，因此它通常瞄准脸部喷射。
author: .jerden
source: If threatened, POKENAME will squirt a dark liquid out of its mouth with great force. This liquid can cause others to pass out if it gets into their mouth or eyes, so POKENAME usually aims for the face.

entry: POKENAME受到攻击，就会将头和四肢缩进壳中，开始释放黑烟。吸入烟雾的攻击者会梦见角色倒转，自己成了受到袭击的一方。
author: .jerden
source: If attacked, POKENAME will retract its limbs and head inside its shell, and begin emitting black smoke. This smoke can cause any attacker who inhales it to dream that they are the one being attacked instead.

entry: POKENAME夜间飞行，寻找反复做噩梦的人，悬停在窗边。那个噩梦仍会持续整夜，但人们说，第二天早晨以后，就再也没做过那个梦。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME flies around at night, searching for people suffering from recurring nightmares. It will hover next to their window, and while the nightmare will continue all night, people report never experiencing it again after the next morning.

entry: 有人见过POKENAME睡在冰川上。但如果靠得太近，它就会醒来，将来者困进无尽的噩梦。
author: seanothan_23
source: POKENAME has been seen sleeping on glaciers. However, if you get too close then it will wake up and put you in an endless nightmare.

entry: POKENAME走过的地方会留下黑色残留物，散发引起噩梦的烟气。它经过的住宅必须彻底清理。
author: hophoppip
source: Wherever POKENAME travels, it leaves behind a black residue that emits nightmare-causing fumes. A residential building where POKENAME has passed through must be thoroughly cleaned.

entry: POKENAME受到攻击，就会将头和四肢缩进壳中，开始释放黑烟。吸入烟雾的攻击者会梦见角色倒转，自己成了受到袭击的一方。
author: .jerden
source: If attacked, POKENAME will retract its limbs and head inside its shell, and begin emitting black smoke. This smoke can cause any attacker who inhales it to dream that they are the one being attacked instead.

entry: POKENAME能用背上的炮阵阵喷出黑色液体。射击间隙冒出的烟若吸入太多，会使睡眠不安，梦中充满深海的噩梦幻景。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can fire pulses of dark liquid from the canons on its back. The smoke that emerges from them between shots lulls anyone that inhales too much into a restless sleep, full of nightmarish visions of the ocean depths.

entry: POKENAME钻进大船的船体里，似乎偏好睡舱附近。乘客睡在有它侵入的船上，常会陷入难以醒来的夜惊。
author: katieplaysgames
