source: POKENAME burrow their way into the hulls of large ships, seeming to prefer to cluster around the sleeping quarters. Passengers who sleep on POKENAME infested ships often find themselves caught within night terrors that are difficult to wake from.

entry: POKENAME吃下美梦反而会难受。虽然能制造坏梦，却似乎更喜欢自然产生的噩梦，夜里便会寻找睡得不安稳的生灵。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME become unwell if it eats a pleasant dream. While it can cause bad dreams, it seems to prefer to consume naturally occurring nightmares, and so will seek out restless sleepers at night.

entry: POKENAME用月牙形摆锤催眠，等人正做噩梦时再吃掉梦境，直到对方醒来。醒来的人看见它就在自己上方，通常会尖叫。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME uses the swinging of its crescent-shaped pendulum to hypnotize people. It waits until they are in the middle of a nightmare, then devours their dreams until they wake up. People usually scream when they see POKENAME looming over them.

entry: POKENAME能用背上的炮阵阵喷出黑色液体。射击间隙冒出的烟若吸入太多，会使睡眠不安，梦中充满深海的噩梦幻景。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can fire pulses of dark liquid from the canons on its back. The smoke that emerges from them between shots lulls anyone that inhales too much into a restless sleep, full of nightmarish visions of the ocean depths.

entry: 它背上的大炮会直接抽取种子中的能量。种子又被金属完全包住，导致POKENAME发育不良。
author: soup1900
source: The cannon on its back extracts energy directly from its bulb, which is entirely encased in metal. This causes growth deficiency for POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME能用尾端的炮发射一种能量丝，缠住威胁，使其无法行动。根据发射元素的不同，还会附带灼伤、麻痹等效果。
author: sk372
source: A type of energy silk is fired from the cannon at the end of POKENAME's tail. Aside from ensnaring and immobilizing a threat, the type of element POKENAME fires can cause additional effects such as burns, paralysis, etc.

entry: POKENAME一点就着，几乎任何东西靠近都会遭到炮击。到了最后关头，它会用炮的能量让身体超负荷运转，引发强大的爆炸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has a hair-trigger temper and fires off its cannon at almost anything that comes near it. As a last resort it will overclock its body with the cannon's energy and create a powerful explosion.

entry: POKENAME从发电厂和变电站吸收电力，再用炮释放粗大的闪电，击倒敌人。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME absorbs electricity from power plants and substations. Its cannon discharges this lightning in wide bolts to knock out foes.

entry: 带炮的那颗蛋既是POKENAME的核心，也是其中最强的成员。同窝的其他成员用精神力量保护它，帮助它击败一切威胁族群的敌人。
author: sk372
source: The egg with the cannon is POKENAME's core as well as its strongest unit. The other members of the clutch use psychic powers to defend it and help it take down any dangers to the group.

entry: 同窝的POKENAME必须一起集中精神，才能正常发射中央的炮。成员有时会交换位置，这似乎会影响炮的射速。
author: sk372
source: All members of the POKENAME clutch must focus together in order to properly fire the cannon in the center. The members will sometimes shift positions, which seems to affect the cannon's fire rate.

entry: POKENAME能在战斗中将拳头变成炮，整个变化不到一秒。一拳命中后，立刻就能将对手轰飞。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME can transform its fists into cannons during combat. It does this in under a second to blast the foe away immediately after a punch connects.

entry: POKENAME只有一发炮弹能吓退捕食者，因为重新装填需要很久。虽然有些捕食者会看穿这场虚张声势，许多也不愿费力突破坚韧的茧。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME only have a single shot to scare away predators, as the cannon takes a long time to reload. Even though some predators see through this deception, many do not go through the effort to break through their tough cocoon.

entry: 由于外貌像成年袋兽，失去双亲的小袋兽有时会依附POKENAME，把它当作替代妈妈。它母性极强，非常乐意照顾这些宝宝。
author: kiwiarms
source: Due to its resemblance to an adult Kangaskhan, orphaned baby Kangaskhan sometimes latch on to POKENAME as surrogate mothers. POKENAME's intense maternal instincts mean it is more than happy to take care of the baby.

entry: POKENAME能从嘴里喷出特殊墨汁，既能集中、精准地射击，击倒猎物，也能大范围喷洒，逃离捕食者。条件合适时，墨汁能使敌人麻痹、灼伤，甚至冻结。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME can shoot a special ink from its mouth, either in a focused, precise shot to take down prey or in a wide spread to escape from predators. Under the right conditions, this ink can paralyze, burn, or even freeze enemies.

entry: POKENAME身体两侧的金属鳞片充当配重，维持身体稳定。开炮时尤其有用，能避免每次射击都让它在水里飞快打转。
author: bigoljax
source: The metallic scales on the sides of POKENAME work as weights, keeping their bodies stable. This often comes in handy while firing their cannons, stopping them from rapidly spinning in the water with each blast.

entry: POKENAME会圈定一片花丛，凶狠地守卫，想独占所有花粉。一旦发现入侵者，就会结合狂风和炮中射出的毒素，将其击退。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will designate a flower patch as its own and guard it fiercely, wanting all the pollen for itself. If an intruder is spotted, it blows them away with a combination of gale-force winds and toxins shot from its cannon.

entry: POKENAME背部尖刺上的能量炮能旋转，变换成不同排列。它会飞快旋转、四处开火，用大量强力的元素能量轰击战场。
author: sk372
source: The energy cannons on POKENAME's back spines can rotate into different configurations. By spinning rapidly and firing wildly, it can pepper the battlefield with a myriad of powerful elemental blasts.

entry: POKENAME以暴力闻名，不断突袭宝可梦，甚至研究员。不过，这些突然的暴行很容易察觉，因为它攻击时总会发出刺耳、机械般的咯咯怪笑。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are known for their violence, constantly getting the jump on Pokémon and even Scientists. These sudden acts of violence are very easy to notice, as POKENAME constantly let out harsh, robotic cackles during their attacks.

entry: POKENAME迅速起飞，俯冲向猎物，用金属钳将其抓住。一旦得手，就将元素能量沿着钳子灌进猎物体内，了结对方。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME quickly takes flight and swoops towards prey, snatching them within its metal pincers. Once grabbed, it finishes them off by surging elemental energy through the pincers and into its prey.

entry: POKENAME冲刺追逐逃跑的目标，用三条尾巴发射的能量精准狙击。如果能逼近到咫尺之间，就会用背上威力更强的炮发出最后一击，造成毁灭性的打击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME charges down fleeing targets, sniping at them with blasts from its three tails. If it manages to get in point-blank range, it fires a final devastating blast from the more powerful cannon on its back.

entry: POKENAME用尾刺驱赶其他生灵，向靠得太近的威胁注入温和的毒素。如果还不能彻底劝退，就会用头上的炮将其轰走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME wards off others with the stinger on its tail, injecting a mild poison in threats that get too close. If the poison doesn't dissuade them completely, it blasts them away with the cannon on its head.

entry: POKENAME在海洋中游泳时，一旦生气，炮就偶尔会意外走火，对周围一切造成巨大破坏。因此，每当有事令它不快，都会努力平息怒气。
author: .izik
source: While swimming through oceans, POKENAME's cannon will occasionally misfire when it grows angry, causing massive damage to anything nearby. Because of this, it tries to quell its rage whenever something upsets it.

entry: POKENAME变成对手的模样，以便更好地分析其身体。变身时炮仍然保留，分析完成后，就能调整炮的设置，精准针对对手的弱点。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME transforms into its opponents to better analyze their bodies. Its cannon stays present while transformed so that when its analysis is complete it can configure the cannon to perfectly exploit its foe's weaknesses.

entry: POKENAME用炮发射多彩的激光。产生什么颜色，取决于发射瞬间周围的环境。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires multicolored lasers from its cannon. The colors produced depend on its surrounding environment at the moment of firing.

entry: POKENAME的炮从带电的毛发中获取能量。发射前，尖锐的毛会竖得更高，射出电能后又会稍稍垂下。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cannon uses energy pulled from its electrified fur. The spiky fur stands up even more before firing, and wilts slightly after it shoots its electrical bursts.

entry: POKENAME用体内的热量供能，从头上的炮向敌人倾泻火焰。达到一定速度时，后方的排气口也会喷火。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME unloads blasts of flames at foes from the cannon on its head, fueled by the heat within its body. Its rear exhaust releases flames when it reaches certain speeds.

entry: POKENAME的炮能发射纯粹数字能量构成的强力冲击。威力大得惊人，每次开火后，它都会在半空中猛烈地打着旋向后退去。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cannon fires powerful bursts of pure digital energy. The cannon shots are powerful enough that each firing causes POKENAME to spiral backwards wildly in midair afterward.

entry: POKENAME潜行于大城市，定期偷取招式学习器来更换自己的壳。如果有人靠近，往往会逃进水里，沉到水底躲开对方。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME sneak around large cities, regularly stealing TMs to replace their shell. If approached, they tend to run into bodies of water and sink to the bottom to evade whoever approached them.

entry: POKENAME的炮能发射高压水柱。开火前，会从浅水池里吸水，储存在壳中。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's cannons fire highly pressurized jets of water. It absorbs water from shallow pools into its shell before firing.

entry: 这种宝可梦攀附在伸出的树枝、杆子，甚至晾衣绳上。一边等待进化，一边不断扫描周围，寻找威胁。
author: bottomusmaximus3
source: This Pokémon clings to overhanging branches, poles, or even washing lines. It constantly scans the area for threats as it waits to evolve.

entry: POKENAME光滑的流线型身体让它在水中极为敏捷。它穿梭于浅水中觅食，需要逃跑时，就借背上炮的后坐力加速。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's smooth and streamlined body gives it excellent aquatic agility. It flits around shallow waters to feed, using the recoil from the cannon on its back to give it a speed boost when it needs to flee.

entry: 它由等离子队创造，是盖诺赛克特的原型机之一，尚缺最终设计中后来加上的强化。
author: jackjirachi
source: Created by Team Plasma, it was one of the prototypes of Genesect. It lacked the enhancements that were later incorporated into the final design.

entry: POKENAME最多五只成群，彼此平分食物。背上的机械装置让它们能以突破音障的速度飞行。最初发现于合众的山区。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME live in packs of up to five, dividing food amongst each other equally. The machinery on their backs allows them to fly at speeds high enough to break the sound barrier. POKENAME were first discovered in the mountainous regions of Unova.

entry: POKENAME腹部的炮平时处于关闭状态，只有睡觉或进食时才会启动。炮会射出上一餐中的有害毒素，使宝可梦和登山男严重中毒。
author: bigoljax
source: The cannons on POKENAME's stomach are usually deactivated, only turning on when POKENAME are asleep or eating. These cannons fire out the harmful toxins of their last meal, causing Pokémon and Hikers to get badly poisoned.

entry: POKENAME毫不留情地守卫冰封的领地，瞬间冻结任何入侵者。虽然性情凶猛，远观却十分美丽，飞过之处拖曳着极光。
author: ambrosia04
source: Devoid of mercy, POKENAME fiercely protect their frozen domains, instantly freezing any intruders. Despite their aggressive nature, they are beautiful to spot from afar, leaving trailing auroras in their wake as they fly.

entry: POKENAME从外界吸收电力，增强原本就很惊人的力量。即使是发电能力最强的机器，也能在几分钟内被它吸干。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME draws in electricity from outside sources to bolster its already formidable strength. It can drain the most powerful electricity-generating machines dry in a matter of minutes.

entry: POKENAME盘踞在火山上空，覆盖双翼的火焰随风流动。随后会一头扎进岩浆，让身体升温，增强火焰的力量。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME loom over volcanos, the fire coating their wings flowing through the wind. They then dive headfirst into the magma, heating their bodies up and powering their flames.

entry: 虽然数百万年前曾存在未经改造的盖诺赛克特，却没有证据表明POKENAME也是如此。眼前的护目镜让它即使高速移动，也能保持完全清晰的视野。
author: bobosmith01
source: While an unmodified Genesect existed millions of years ago, there has been no evidence that is true for POKENAME. The visor over POKENAME's eyes allows it to travel at tremendous speeds while still having perfectly clear vision.

entry: POKENAME极为强壮、好斗，独自守卫选定的大针蜂巢。它用刺针扎进敌人体内，抽走能量，再用夺来的能量发射腹部的炮。
author: sk372
source: Extremely strong and aggressive, POKENAME acts as a one-Pokémon guard towards its designated Beedrill hive. Its stingers stab into foes to drain energy before using that stolen energy to fire the cannon on its abdomen.

entry: 野生POKENAME会收集卡带，好在战斗前改变臂炮发射的能量种类。它有种不可思议的能力，能预判哪种攻击最容易伤到对手。
author: .jerden
source: Wild POKENAME collect cassettes so that they can change the type of energy they fire from their arm-canon before battle. They have an uncanny ability to predict what their foe will be most vulnerable to.

entry: POKENAME有坚硬外壳保护，是毫不留情的猎手。只要接到命令，就会追踪并击败任何目标，利用锋利的金属尖刺，以及装甲头部两侧附肢发射的能量战斗。
author: .jerden
source: Protected by a hard shell, POKENAME is a merciless hunter. If given the order, it will track down and defeat any target, using its sharp metal spikes and blasts of energy from the appendages on either side of its armored head.

entry: 虽然装甲使它们看起来毫无感情，野生POKENAME却会寻找并保护从化石复活的宝可梦，用强大的精神力量驱赶一切威胁它们的人。
author: .jerden
source: Although their armor makes them seem emotionless, wild POKENAME will seek out and protect Pokémon revived from fossils. They use powerful psychic force to drive away anyone that threatens them.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的炮由庞大的精神力量供能，几乎拥有无限弹药。它能调校发射的精神光束，精准针对面前任何宝可梦的弱点。
author: sk372
source: The cannon on POKENAME's tail is fueled by its vast psychic powers, effectively giving it unlimited ammunition. It can calibrate the psychic beams it fires to perfectly target the weakness of any Pokémon it faces.

entry: POKENAME颈部的花瓣状面板吸收太阳能，帮助为炮供能。不发射强力日光束时，它会用炮散出芳香的粉末，取悦自己亲近的对象。
author: sk372
source: The petal-shaped panels around POKENAME's neck absorb solar energy to help power its cannon. When not used for firing powerful Solar Beams, POKENAME uses it to dispel a pleasant-smelling powder to delight those it is friendly with.

entry: POKENAME开炮后产生的热量极高，必须从武器上的特殊槽口喷火散热。即便如此，每次射击后炮管仍会烧得通红，危险地逼近熔化。
author: sk372
source: The heat generated after POKENAME fires its cannon is so great that it must vent it by flaring fire through special slots in the weapon. Even so, the barrel glows red-hot after firing, dangerously close to melting after each shot.

entry: POKENAME的群落用钻头将树木连根拔起，标记领地。由于破坏性很强，人们正设法约束这些群落，防止森林遭到毁坏。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: Colonies of POKENAME mark their territory by uprooting trees with their drills. Due to their destructive nature, there has been an effort to contain colonies of POKENAME to prevent deforestation.

entry: 炮太沉重，迫使POKENAME一直用四肢奔跑。其实也算因祸得福，让它能以每小时75英里的速度穿过沼泽，更容易抓到猎物。
author: bigoljax
source: Due to the weight of their cannons, POKENAME are forced to constantly run on all fours. This is actually a blessing in disguise, as it allows POKENAME to run across marshes at 75 MPH, making it easier to catch prey.

entry: POKENAME大量饮用沼泽水，储存起来作为炮的弹药。这些水满是病菌，任何人浸泡过久都可能生病。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME drinks massive amounts of swamp water to store as ammunition for its cannon. This water is laden with germs and can cause illness in anyone submerged in it for too long.

entry: POKENAME长长的身体沿线排列着炮，每门炮射出的激光颜色都不同。颜色只为美观，造成的伤害并无差别。
author: .izik
source: Each cannon along POKENAME's long body fires a different colored laser. These colors carry no difference in damage output and are purely aesthetic.

entry: POKENAME按固定模式战斗，以短促、相等的间隔开炮发射能量。狡猾的对手能利用这一点，找出两次射击之间最佳的进攻时机。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME battles with a set pattern, firing energy shots from its cannon in short equal intervals. Crafty opponents can take advantage of this to determine the perfect time to strike between shots.

entry: POKENAME安静地等待夜幕降临，寻找非常特定的猎物捕食。狩猎时，会用炮分散猎物的注意，再以剃刀般锋利的脚爪突袭。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME quietly waits for night to come, seeking out very specific prey to hunt and eat. When on the hunt, they use their cannons to distract their prey, getting the jump on them with their razor-sharp talons.

entry: 夜间，POKENAME触角上的丝线慢慢亮起，促使它们离开巢穴。它们飞上天空，仰望星星，丝线发出轻微的嗡鸣。
author: bigoljax
source: During the night, the strings going along POKENAME's antennae slowly start to glow, bringing them outside of their dens. They fly up into the air, their strings making a faint humming noise while they gaze up at the stars.

entry: POKENAME用头上的炮发射蛛网弹，将空中的猎物击落。在发现过它的地区，登山男经常回来时全身都是蛛网。
author: beetlething
source: Using the cannon on its head, POKENAME will shoot prey out of the sky using a web bomb. In areas where a POKENAME has been spotted, Hikers will frequently come back covered in webs.

entry: POKENAME极善于隐蔽，很受警方欢迎，常作为埋伏时的搭档。它们用背上的炮发射坚韧、涂毒的蛛网，瞬间限制目标行动，又不造成持久伤害。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME are incredibly stealthy, making them popular ambush partners for police forces. They use the cannons on their backs to fire tough, poison-coated webs that instantly immobilize targets without causing lasting harm.

entry: POKENAME飞过洞窟时，会用金属头部撞开钟乳石，清理道路。这也让附近的超音蝠更容易通行。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME slams its metal head into stalactites to clear paths while flying through caves. This makes traversal easier for nearby Zubat.

entry: POKENAME将触角光球中的纯粹光能导入背炮，进行超量充能。射出的强光足以照亮深海，甚至能从海面看见。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME funnels pure light energy from the orbs on its antennae to overcharge the cannon on its back. The blasts of light this creates are bright enough to illuminate the deep ocean and be seen from the surface.

entry: POKENAME使用电系攻击时，整个金属身体都会发光。如果使用电力过多、勉强自己，就可能受伤。
author: .izik
source: The entirety of POKENAME's metal body lights up when it uses an electric attack. If it overexerts itself with too much electricity, it can injure itself.

entry: POKENAME凝望月亮时，红色玻璃面罩会闪出黄光。看着看着，偶尔还会朝月亮大声哼鸣。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's red glass visor flashes yellow while it stares at the moon. It will occasionally hum loudly at the moon as it watches.

entry: POKENAME在生日派对和特别聚会上用炮发射彩纸。但受到威胁时，也能改装各种石头和尖锐物品，用来攻击。
author: fxncy_poland
source: POKENAME uses its cannon to shoot confetti at birthday parties and special gatherings. However, it can also use it offensively if threatened, filling the cannon with various rocks and sharp objects instead.

entry: POKENAME能感知手机等设备发出的能量波，尤其能察觉剩余电量的百分比。它们会飞到设备旁，将翅膀贴上去，缓缓为其充电。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are able to detect the energy waves coming from devices like phones, more specifically the percentage they're at. They fly over to the device, placing their wings up against it and slowly charging it.

entry: 沉重的装甲让POKENAME大多靠蹦跳移动。使用头上威力强大的炮发射能量时，如果不能牢牢固定身体，后坐力就会让它翻倒。
author: .jerden
source: Weighed down by heavy armor, POKENAME mostly moves around by hopping. If it cannot firmly anchor itself in place when firing blasts of energy from the powerful cannon on its head, the recoil will make POKENAME topple over.

entry: POKENAME通常不爱争斗，会用双翼遮住胸口的炮。根据炮即将发射的元素能量，翅膀内侧的花纹会改变颜色和图案。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME usually keeps its wings covering the cannon on its chest, as it is generally nonconfrontational. The patterns on the underside of its wings change color and design depending on the elemental energy its cannon is about to fire.

entry: POKENAME金属羊毛中的电能可以传到尾巴上的炮里。传输时，身体会明显振动，这种抖动能加快能量分配。
author: sk372
source: Electrical energy from POKENAME's metal wool can be transferred into the cannon on its tail. POKENAME visibly vibrates during the transfer, the shaking increasing the rate of energy distribution.

entry: POKENAME用手上的小水枪射出细水流，与其他生灵玩耍。尾巴上的炮威力大得多，专门用于战斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the tiny water pistols on its hands to play with others with small streams of water. The cannon on its tail is much more powerful and used exclusively for combat.

entry: POKENAME倒着游泳时会开炮加速。比起向前游，它更喜欢后退，因为开炮能带来无比的快感。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires its cannon to increase its speed while swimming backwards. It prefers swimming backwards to forward due to the overwhelming bliss it feels when firing.

entry: POKENAME喷出水柱，体内产生的化学物质会将水染成深蓝色。这些水似乎是在睡觉时产生的。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME shoots spouts of water dyed a deep blue by a chemical produced within its body. This water appears to be generated while it sleeps.

entry: POKENAME无声地飘过高层大气，用高科技雷达眼追踪目标。锁定后，将蓬松的棉孢子压缩成高速弹丸，从空中精准轰击，威力惊人。
author: msdawgs
source: POKENAME floats silently through the upper atmosphere, tracking targets with its high-tech radar eye. Once locked on, it compresses its fluffy cotton spores into high-velocity projectiles, blasting them down from the sky with devastating precision.

entry: POKENAME组成很小的群体游荡，寻找无人看守的餐车。用炮悄悄熔开车门，钻进去吃光所有食物，便四散逃走。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME wander around in very small groups, seeking out food trucks that are left unguarded. They use their cannons to quietly melt open a hole in the doors, sneaking in and eating every last bit of food before scattering off.

entry: POKENAME缓慢地蹦跳，吸取附近植物和宝可梦的生命力。受到攻击，就用强力能量轰击来者。将不同卡带插进头部，就能改变能量种类。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME hop around slowly, leeching life force from nearby plants and Pokémon. If anything attacks them they will drive it away with powerful blasts of energy, the type of which can be changed by slotting different Drives into its head.

entry: 有人相信，最初的POKENAME被注入了邪恶，如今所有个体都继承了这种特质。其实，它十分友好，发光的红眼能帮助它看清水下。
author: whatagooddaytodie
source: Some believe that someone injected evil into the very first POKENAME and this trait is now found in all of them. In reality, POKENAME is very friendly, and its glowing red eyes help it see underwater.

entry: POKENAME栖居在阳光充足、日照更强的山顶。通过额头的宝石吸收阳光，将太阳能直接导入尾巴上的双炮，发射强力激光。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME inhabit sunny mountain peaks where solar rays are more intense. By absorbing sunlight through their forehead gems, they channel solar energy directly into their dual tail-cannons, unleashing powerful laser blasts.

entry: POKENAME每天傍晚用身上的环纹与斑点吸收月光，为自己供能。满月时力量会大幅增强，甚至可能因能量过载而狂暴失控。
author: sk372
source: The rings and spots on POKENAME's body absorb moonlight each evening to power itself. During the full moon, its strength grows so great that it has a risk of going berserk from the overload.

entry: POKENAME用尾巴的激光破坏锁具，闯进超市。一进去，就会尽可能偷走奶酪。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Using the laser from their tail, POKENAME break open locks to get into supermarkets. Once in, POKENAME pilfer all the cheese they can.

entry: POKENAME趁餐厅还在营业时闯入，一边用炮瞄准顾客，一边走进厨房。它寻找昂贵的食物，慢慢享用，炮口始终对着厨师。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME break into restaurants while they're still open, aiming their cannons at patrons while going into the kitchen. They seek out expensive food, eating it slowly while keeping their cannons pointed at the chefs.

entry: 有人见过POKENAME用四肢发出的激光，在各地遗迹的侧壁刻下符号。留有它标记的地区，未知图腾的数量似乎会逐渐减少。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has been seen using lasers from its limbs to carve symbols into the sides of ruins dotted across the land. Unown populations seem to shrink over time in areas where it has placed its marks.

entry: POKENAME的炮靠吸收周围生灵的情感能量充能。这些能量在体内凝聚成精神能量，战斗时再从炮中阵阵释放。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's cannon charges by absorbing emotional energy from those around it. This condenses into psychic energy within its body, which it releases in bursts from the cannon during fights.

entry: POKENAME用炮发出的激光击落松枝，随后一边咕咕叫，一边饮用其中储存的树液。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME shoots down pine branches using the lasers from its cannon. It then drinks the sap stored within while making a cooing noise.

entry: 虽然行动受限，POKENAME的领地意识却很强，会从远处逐一狙击入侵者。只要能赶走惹怒自己的闯入者，它甚至愿意冒着毁坏大片周边环境的风险。
author: sk372
source: Despite limited mobility, POKENAME is very territorial and picks off intruders from large distances. It is willing to risk destroying much of its own surroundings just to repel the trespassers that have earned its ire.

entry: POKENAME在地下挖掘时，若遇上巨颚也咬不碎的岩石，就用背上的炮将其炸开。吃下这些碎石后，炮击的威力会大幅增强。
author: ambrosia04
source: While tunneling underground, if POKENAME encounter rock obstacles that their massive mandibles cannot crush, they use their back-mounted cannons to blast them away. Consuming these shattered stones makes their cannon blasts much stronger.

entry: POKENAME定期入侵发电厂，吸收电力来恢复活力。试图充电时，凡是挡路的东西都会遭到炮击。
author: starryeyedmemoriam
source: POKENAME periodically invade power plants to revitalize themselves, absorbing electricity. POKENAME blast anything that gets in their path when attempting to recharge.

entry: POKENAME的身体能迅速将吃下的树果化为果汁，几秒内就完成。它会像用水管喷水一样，用炮喷出果汁，与其他生灵分享。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body quickly turns any berries it takes in into juice, converting them within seconds. It shares the juices with others by spraying them from its cannons like water from a hose.

entry: POKENAME争强好胜，连数英里外的对象也会视为对头。它会坐在树顶，试着用角上的强力激光狙击选定的对手。
author: kiwiarms
source: Highly competitive, POKENAME will form rivalries with perceived enemies from miles away. They're known to sit in treetops and try to snipe their chosen rival with the powerful laser on their horn.

entry: POKENAME偶尔会与狃拉结下竞争关系，不断发起与利爪有关的比试。虽然金属身体帮得上忙，却因运用爪子的技艺不如对方而经常落败。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are occasional rivals for Sneasel, constantly challenging them to competitions relating to their sharp claws. Though their metallic frames help them, they often lose due to not being as talented with their claws.

entry: POKENAME拥有利爪与强力臂炮，一旦开始肆虐，几乎势不可挡。不过，只要献上蜂蜜，就能立刻平息它的攻击性。
author: sk372
source: With sharp claws and a powerful arm cannon, POKENAME seems almost unstoppable once it has begun to rampage. However, its aggression can be instantly halted by presenting it with an offering of honey.

entry: POKENAME从火山环境吸收热量，将能量储存在炮中。战斗时，再集中释放为一束束激光。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME absorbs heat from volcanic environments, storing the energy within its cannon. During combat it releases these bursts as concentrated laser blasts.

entry: POKENAME的速度足以与战斗机较量，是凶猛的猎手。但若一心盯着猎物、忽略四周，就会撞上山峰和大树。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are able to compete with fighter jets when it comes to speed, making them fierce hunters. However, if they're too focused on their prey instead of their surroundings, they crash into mountains and large trees.

entry: POKENAME能迅速察觉附近或地下的蘑菇。身体很快便能处理吃下的真菌，转化成能量，再从身上的彩色面板射出光束。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's body quickly detects any mushrooms nearby or underground. Its body quickly processes any fungi consumed and converts them to energy used to fire beams of light from the colored panels on its body.

entry: POKENAME用长腿行走于雪地。虽然能用炮发射激光，长腿却很容易勾住树枝或藤蔓，让它绊倒。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME walks across snowy landscapes on its long legs. While it can fire lasers from its cannons, it is easily tripped should its long legs catch on branches or vines.

entry: POKENAME用炮接连喷出气泡，击穿岩石，在深海凿出巢穴。气泡会随心情改变颜色。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires bursts of bubbles from its cannon to break through stone and carve its nest in the deep ocean. These bubbles shift color depending on its mood.

entry: POKENAME能快速连发六次高科技光炮，足以让一切移动的目标失去行动力。欧雷地区流传着一首民谣，唱的是一位年轻的宝可梦巡护员，骄傲地在腰间带着一只硕大的POKENAME。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME can fire six Techno Blasts in quick succession. This barrage is more than enough to incapacitate anything that moves. A popular ballad in Orre tells of a young Pokémon Ranger who proudly wore a big POKENAME on their hip.

entry: 许多渔民俗称POKENAME为“大块头”，钓获它极为罕见，也极有面子。它头上的强力质子炮能从半英里外击穿战舰。
author: kiwiarms
source: Known colloquially by many fishermen as "The Big One", POKENAME are an incredibly rare, prestigious catch. Using the mighty proton cannon in its head, it can punch a hole through a battleship from a half-mile away.

entry: POKENAME用炮状嘴部发射墨汁，速度和精度都几乎闻所未闻。据说，身在星球另一端的深海，也能狙击高飞在数英里上空的生灵。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fires ink at speeds and accuracy almost unheard of from its cannon-mouth. It is said it could snipe a creature flying miles in the air from the depths of an ocean on the other side of the planet.

entry: POKENAME停在其他生灵面前，用眼中的扫描器分析其本性。如果认定对方善良，金属球就会送出礼物；如果认为对方顽劣，就会喷出冷气作为惩罚。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME stops before others and analyzes their nature using scanners in its eyes. If it deems they are kind, a present dispenses from its metal sphere; if they are deemed naughty, a punishing blast of cold air is shot out instead.

entry: POKENAME不断巡逻海底遗迹。一旦发现入侵者，就会从炮里射出铁炮鱼，准头惊人。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME constantly patrols undersea ruins. When it detects an intruder, it shoots Remoraid from its cannons with surprising accuracy.

entry: 飞行时，POKENAME会收起炮，让身体更呈流线型。切换成攻击形态后，远程炮击和近身斩击都能运用自如。
author: imaginita
source: When in flight, POKENAME's cannon is retracted to create a more streamlined form. When in its attacking configuration, POKENAME can use both ranged blasts and melee slashes with ease.

entry: 珍爱的人遭遇危险时，POKENAME会不惜一切挺身守护，即使为此付出生命。
author: inksans201x
source: When those it loves are in danger, POKENAME will stop at nothing to defend them, even if it costs them their life.

entry: POKENAME金属身体的空气动力学外形让它能以超音速飞行。它从上方攻击敌人，用背上的炮发射威力惊人的炮弹。
author: fiordaliso
source: The aerodynamic shape of POKENAME's metal body allows it to fly at supersonic speeds. It strikes enemies from above, blasting them with devastating shots fired from the cannon on its back.

entry: POKENAME抖响尾巴，在体内充能。充满后，嘴里射出的光束能在山中凿出巨大的隧道。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME rattles its tail to charge energy within its body. When fully charged, the beams it shoots from its mouth can carve large tunnels through mountains.

entry: POKENAME尾巴上的炮威力惊人。它对大多数对象并不怎么好斗，却与水下的龙属性宝可梦竞争激烈。
author: sk372
source: The cannon on POKENAME's tail packs an explosive punch in terms of power. It is not terribly aggressive to most, but has a strong rivalry with underwater Dragon-type Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME动作缓慢，小小身体却蕴藏强大力量。它守卫家园，用号角般的强风吹走入侵者，威力足以产生冲击波。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is slow but packs a lot of power in its small stature. It stands watch over its home and blows intruders away with trumpeting blasts of air so strong as to create shockwaves.

entry: 许多训练家把POKENAME误认为未来或外星武器。但仔细观察就会发现，它由现代科技与生物机制融合而成。
author: elibromax314
source: Many Trainers mistake POKENAME for a futuristic or alien weapon. However, upon closer inspection, it is composed of modern technology fused with biological mechanisms.

entry: POKENAME拥有沉重的金属身体，长鼻里还装着威力极强的炮，几乎无人能抵挡它的猛攻。一些政府场所把它用于最高级别的安保。
author: sk372
source: With a heavy metal body and a supremely powerful cannon located in the trunk, few can withstand an onslaught from POKENAME. Some government locations use it as a maximum-level security protocol.

entry: 光盘塔装满时，POKENAME能从头顶的炮发射最多五种能量。这份适应力也是重大弱点，因为这些光盘驱动器很脆弱，容易刮伤。
author: quackquackattack
source: With a full CD tower, POKENAME can fire up to five types of blasts from the cannon atop their head. This adaptability also gives them a major weakness, as these CD drives are fragile and prone to scratches.

entry: POKENAME冲锋或长途移动时会合上面罩。工程师对它的装甲很感兴趣，因为装甲能极强地抵御自然危害，又不影响身体灵活性。
author: pkbonusducks
source: POKENAME close their visor when charging and traveling long distances. Engineers have taken great interest in POKENAME's armor, which grants them an incredible resistance to natural hazards without compromising their flexibility.

entry: POKENAME能像水管喷水一样，从尾巴喷出颜料。它用这种能力，在找到的任何墙上涂鸦。
author: cait_sith
source: POKENAME fires paint from its tail like water from a hose. It uses this ability to graffiti any wall it can find.

entry: POKENAME旋转产生的力量驱动着一圈炮。转速达到最高时，所有炮都能同时快速射击，让人几乎无法近身。
author: sk372
source: The force generated from POKENAME's spinning is what powers its circle of cannons. At top rotation speed it can fire all the cannons simultaneously at a rapid pace, making getting to close range nearly impossible.

entry: 曾经有一种畅销的儿童玩具，外形仿照POKENAME设计。偏偏它本来就栖居在拥挤的城市，因此很难分清眼前是遗落的玩具，还是真正的它。
author: beetlething
source: A popular kids toy was once designed after POKENAME's likeness. With POKENAME's natural habitat being crowded cities, it makes it extremely difficult to tell apart a toy left behind and the real thing.

entry: POKENAME的乳房其实是高压炮，能以极强的力量喷奶。奶里富含补充活力的营养物质，但饮用者说，有股明显的人工味道。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's udders are actually high-pressure cannons that let it spray out milk with intense force. The milk is packed with energizing nutrients, though consumers note a distinct artificial taste to it.

entry: 乌云开始聚集时，POKENAME会用炮向天空发射巨大的电能光束，强行引来雷暴。雷电让它能发挥全部力量。
author: bigoljax
source: When clouds start to loom, POKENAME use their cannons to fire large beams of electricity right into the sky. These beams force thunderstorms into being, the lightning allowing POKENAME to operate at their full power.

entry: POKENAME住在极寒地区的洞窟深处，用炮熔穿挡路的冰墙。外面开始下大雪时，它会冲出洞窟，高声吠叫，声音强得足以震裂脚下的冰。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME live deep in arctic caves, using their cannons to melt through icy walls in their way. When harsh snowfall starts to begin outside, POKENAME bolt out of their caves and let out loud barks strong enough to crack the ice beneath them.

entry: POKENAME如同行走的军械库，拥有许多天然武器，从双臂伸出的锋利镰刀，到腹部安装的大圆锯，一应俱全。虽然危险，却因有一只出演怪兽电影而拥有大量拥趸。
author: deadshields
source: A walking armory, POKENAME are equipped with numerous natural weapons; from razor sickles jutting from their arms to great buzzsaws mounted in their bellies. Despite their danger, POKENAME have a large following due to one starring in a kaiju movie.

entry: 遇上真正尊敬的对手，POKENAME会全力以赴，用无法刺穿的金属身体直冲过去。不屑交战的敌人，则用水流卡带的高科技光炮冲走。
author: soup1900
source: To opponents POKENAME actually respect, they go all out in battle, charging straight through them with their unpierceable metal body. Any foe they don't care to fight is washed away using a Soak Drive Techno Blast.

entry: POKENAME喜欢欺负其他宝可梦，将它们逼到树边，用尾巴不断电击。自己的炮却弱得不足以防身，一有更大的宝可梦来制止，就只好逃跑。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME love to bully other Pokémon, cornering them against trees and using their tails to constantly tase them. Their cannons are too weak to protect themselves, forcing them to run off when a larger Pokémon steps in to stop their bullying.

entry: POKENAME把尾巴贴在电线杆上，为炮充能。当射出的激光变成淡蓝色，就表示充满了。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME charges its cannon by pressing its tail against electric poles. It is sufficiently charged when the lasers it fires turn a pale blue.

entry: POKENAME试图成为与凤王完全相反的存在，竭尽所能毁灭生命，而非创造生命。每当它与凤王相遇，往往都会演变成一场漫长而激烈的恶斗。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME try to make themselves the complete opposite of Ho-Oh, doing all they can to destroy life instead of create it. Whenever a Ho-Oh and POKENAME come in contact with each other, it'll often end up in a long, violent brawl.

entry: POKENAME的出现常与时间扭曲有关，让附近的宝可梦晕头转向。炮中射出的能量能让物体短暂地在时间中错位。
author: roundabout_robin
source: POKENAME's presence is often linked to temporal distortions that leave nearby Pokémon disoriented. Energy fired from its cannon can briefly displace objects through time.

entry: POKENAME喜欢坐在尾巴上压住它，再用尾巴伸出的炮开火。以尾巴的球体为轴转动，就能充当移动炮台。
author: foolish_weasel
source: POKENAME likes to sit on its tail to weigh it down while it fires the cannon protruding from it. Pivoting on the ball of its tail, POKENAME can act as a mobile turret.

entry: POKENAME用两条尾巴上的双炮制造混乱。它向旅人快速发射能量，只为看他们惊慌四窜，躲避射击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME uses the two cannons on its dual tails in order to cause havoc. It fires energy shots at a rapid pace at travelers just to watch them scurry about in panic and try to avoid being hit.

entry: 尚不清楚是什么能量，驱动POKENAME双炮发射那些独特的物质。两门炮都会喷出奇怪的瘴气，接触者受到诅咒，此后多年都厄运缠身。
author: sk372
source: It is not yet known what type of energy fuels the unique emissions from POKENAME's cannons. It fires a strange miasma from both that curses those touched to suffer horrible luck for years after contact.

entry: POKENAME用力量威吓黑暗鸦群，迫使它们听从命令。任何过于放肆或反叛的黑暗鸦，都会遭到头上炮的轰击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will use its strength to cow Murkrow flocks into following its orders. Any Murkrow that get too uppity or rebellious get blasted by the cannon on its head.

entry: 派对若突然挤满气球，可能就是POKENAME的杰作。它会尽可能用气球包围整个场地，不到极限决不罢休。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When parties suddenly fill up with balloons, it's possibly the work of POKENAME. POKENAME will not stop until they surround the area with as many balloons as possible.

entry: POKENAME飞上高云，以尾巴为平台俯瞰下方。发现鸟宝可梦后，便任自己下落，用尾巴如鞭子般电击对方，再飞走。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME fly high up in the clouds, using their tails as platforms as they scout down below. When spotting a bird Pokémon, they let themselves fall, using their tails like whips to electrocute the Pokémon before flying off.

entry: 农贸市场有时会遭POKENAME围攻。它们用炮口威胁，逼人交出所有树果，再像火箭般飞走。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Sometimes farmer's markets are besieged by POKENAME. At cannon-point, they force all berries to be handed to them before they rocket away.

entry: 背上的炮能射出高压水柱，但它更喜欢只用低档，与其他生灵玩耍。尤其喜欢加入孩子们的水枪大战。
author: sk372
source: The cannon on its back has the potential to shoot out high-power water jets, but it prefers to only use lower settings to play with others. It's particularly fond of joining water gun fights with children.

entry: POKENAME能在冰川中凿洞。它用爪子扣住冰层，臂炮发射充能后的能量，将冰炸成小块。这常常引发危险的雪崩。
author: quackquackattack
source: POKENAME are capable of carving holes into glaciers. By latching onto ice with their claws, the charged burst of energy from their arm cannons shatters ice into small pieces. This often causes dangerous avalanches.

entry: POKENAME能以机械方式将身上的两个小头向外展开，露出藏在金属间的额外炮口。虽然威力强大，但一旦受到特定频率的强电磁脉冲，就无法开炮。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME can mechanically expand the two smaller heads from its body outward to reveal extra cannons hidden between the metal. While its shots are very powerful, it's unable to fire if it receives strong electromagnetic pulses at a certain frequency.

entry: POKENAME用双手捏碎巨石，碎块被吸进掌心的孔洞，转化为炮的燃料。炮击威力足以将山轰出一个贯穿的大洞。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME crushes boulders with its hands; the shattered pieces are sucked into the holes in its palms to convert into fuel for its cannon. Its cannon packs enough force to blow a clear hole through a mountain.

entry: POKENAME身体大部分由不同颜色、起伏蠕动的触须组成。它把触须末端的炮口藏起来，直到战斗时才根据所需元素，伸出不同颜色的触须。
author: sk372
source: Undulating tendrils of different colors make up most of POKENAME's body. It hides away the cannon ends of these tentacles until it is time to battle, bringing out different colors depending on what element it needs to wield.

entry: POKENAME双手的火焰炮能喷出几秒内熔化巨石的烈火，但燃料有限。它会前往能找到的最热之地，吸收热量，补充燃料。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's flame-cannon hands can shoot out fire hot enough to melt boulders in seconds, but their fuel is finite. It goes to the hottest locations it can find to absorb heat and refuel.

entry: POKENAME飞过大地，用炮向下方的人类和宝可梦发射独特能量。洒落的能量能消除受影响者的一切攻击冲动，最长持续一周。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME flies across the lands firing a unique type of energy from its cannon down onto people and Pokémon below. The cascading energy eliminates any aggressive urges in those affected for up to a week.

entry: POKENAME蜷成球时，炮管仍露在外面，可以开火。它发射强力沙弹，让靠近的威胁晕眩、看不清，再借后坐力向反方向滚走。
author: sk372
source: When POKENAME curls into a ball, its cannon's barrel remains out and is still functional. It fires powerful sand blasts to stun and blind approaching dangers, the recoil sending it rolling off in the opposite direction.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀以最快速度拍动时，足以产生冲击波，震晕下方的目标，让炮击更容易命中。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wings are strong enough to create shockwaves when flapped at their fastest. These shockwaves stun targets beneath it, making them easy pickings for POKENAME to hit with shots from its cannon.

entry: POKENAME从尾巴的炮喷出浓稠、发光的绿色毒液，浇在敌人身上。等对方失去行动力，就用爪子抓住，拖回巢穴。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME douses foes in thick glowing green toxin from the cannon on its tail. Once they are incapacitated, it grips them in its claws and drags them back to its den.

entry: POKENAME吻部形状的炮能嗅出最远200英里外的气味，准确定位最爱的食物。一闻到气味，就会径直朝目标冲去。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's snout-like cannon can detect scents from up to 200 miles away. It can pinpoint the exact location of its favorite foods and will charge toward them in a straight line the moment it catches the scent.

entry: POKENAME的炮原本被设定为打开通往异次元的传送门，结果只会把击中的东西染成绿色。它控制不了炮的力量，每次射击的威力都不一样。
author: soup1900
source: While POKENAME's cannon blasts were programmed to open portals to alien dimensions, they instead just paint anything they hit to the color green. Every shot it fires is variable in strength due to it being unable to control the power of its cannon.

entry: 经过升级，POKENAME脚上即使没有钩子，也能攀住最光滑的墙壁和天花板。面对试图恐吓自己的大个子敌人，会威胁开炮。
author: soup1900
source: Upgrades allow POKENAME to stick to even the slickest of walls and ceilings without having any hooks on its feet. It will threaten to use its cannon at larger foes who try to intimidate it.

entry: POKENAME在密集城市的屋顶间飞行，试图与建筑工地的金属梁混为一体。不过，紫色身体在金属框架间总是十分显眼。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME flies from rooftop to rooftop inside of dense cities. It tries to camouflage itself with metal girders found at construction sites, but its purple color always stands out from the metal frames.

entry: POKENAME身上部分区域呈绿色，方便在密林中伪装，等待最佳的出手机会。一看见较大的宝可梦，就会冲出灌木，用斧头劈砍。
author: bigoljax
source: The green coloring on certain parts of POKENAME's body help them camouflage when in thick forests, waiting for the perfect time to strike. Whenever they see a larger Pokémon, they dash out of the brush and cut at them with their axes.

entry: POKENAME头上的炮能喷出强劲火柱，驱赶危险。火力太强，后坐力常把自己掀得向后倒去。
author: sk372
source: The cannon on POKENAME's head can fire out strong jets of flame to ward off dangers. The firepower is strong enough that it often winds up causing POKENAME to fall backwards from the recoil.

entry: POKENAME能蜷成完美的球体，像轮胎一样加速转动。充满能量后，就会猛然加速，滚过沙漠，撞倒一切挡路的仙人掌。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are able to roll themselves up into perfect spheres, revving their bodies up like a tire. When fully charged, their bodies gain a burst of speed and roll through the desert, knocking over any cacti in their way.

entry: POKENAME脚上的喷射器让它无论在地面还是空中都能迅速、敏捷地移动。它主要近身搏斗，需要时也能用掌心的小孔快速连发能量弹。
author: sk372
source: Jets on POKENAME's feet allow it to move quickly and agilely on the ground and in the air. It primarily uses close combat techniques, but small holes in its palms let it fire quick bursts of energy shots if needed.

entry: POKENAME用炮吸入泥浆，再瞄准其他宝可梦喷射，把它们弄脏。它也喜欢让自己满身泥，舒缓金属身体的燥热。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME use their cannons to soak up mud, aiming them at other Pokémon to make them dirty. They also love to cover themselves in mud, soothing their metallic frames from the heat.

entry: POKENAME的视觉不仅能察觉训练家和宝可梦的体温，还能看出情绪。头上的炮借目标的情感来瞄准、发射激光。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME's vision can not only detect both Trainers' and Pokémon's heat, but their emotions too. The cannon on its head uses the feelings of its target to aim and shoot its laser beam.

entry: POKENAME十分优雅，做什么都想保持潇洒的姿态。精神力量让它能看见未来，预判对手下一步行动，瞄准也极为精准。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME is a very elegant Pokémon that'll always try to act in a stylish way. Its psychic power enables POKENAME to see into the future to predict its opponent's next move and to aim very precisely.

entry: POKENAME的炮由庞大的精神能量供能，能向敌人发射微型黑洞。虽然力量可怕，却更喜好和平，除非受到逼迫，否则只会防御。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cannon is fueled by its vast psychic energy, and is capable of firing miniature black holes at foes. Despite its frightening power, it much prefers pacifism and only acts defensively until otherwise forced.

entry: POKENAME体态灵巧，火力惊人，是战场上难缠的对手。它十分关爱训练家，会用臂炮发射强力能量来保护对方。
author: mepp.
source: POKENAME's lithe build and immense firepower makes it a tough foe in battle. It cares deeply for its Trainer and will protect them by firing powerful blasts from the cannon on its arm.

entry: 最近的媒体作品将POKENAME描绘成银河英雄，对抗形形色色的太空恶徒，尤其是一条邪恶的太空龙，以及一族寄生生物。
author: sk372
source: Recent media depictions cast POKENAME as a galactic hero fighting off all manner of spaceborne villains, in particular a vile space dragon and a race of parasitic organisms.

entry: POKENAME胸部装有强大的能量炮，能发射大型元素能量冲击。不用于战斗时，有时会制造心形的能量气泡，表达爱意。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME possesses a powerful energy cannon embedded within its chest segment, capable of firing large elemental blasts. When not used in combat, it sometimes generates heart-shaped bubbles of energy as a sign of affection.

entry: POKENAME更喜欢用臂炮远程作战，以精神力量固定对手。若在战斗中生气，激光就会强到足以摧毁山峰。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME prefers to use the cannon on its arm for long range combat, holding its foe in place with psychic power. Should it grow angry during battle. the lasers become strong enough to destroy mountains.

entry: POKENAME是十分均衡的战士，严格恪守荣誉准则。比起开枪，更喜欢拳脚交锋。不过，枪法同样高明，能用炮发射威力惊人的光束。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME is a very balanced fighter, with a very strict code of honor. It prefers engaging in a fist fight rather than using its gun. Yet, POKENAME is a very skilled shooter and is able to unleash a devastating beam with its cannon.

entry: POKENAME极为胆小，藏在森林深处的空地里，通过改变肤色轻易融入环境。一旦被发现，就用尾炮无情地攻击，再消失在枝叶间。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME is extremely timid and hides in deep forest glades, blending into its surroundings effortlessly by shifting its skin color. If discovered, it attacks ruthlessly with the cannon on its tail before vanishing into the foliage.

entry: POKENAME的炮直接连接爪尖。必须先用爪子将自己固定在某个表面上，才能向目标开炮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cannon is directly connected to the tips of its claws. It must lodge itself into a surface with said claws before it is able to fire its cannon at targets.

entry: POKENAME的炮威力极强，每次发射都会让它非常疲惫。开火前会仔细权衡风险与收益，如果风险太大，就改用爪子近身搏斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's cannon is so powerful that it leaves it very drained after every shot. It carefully calculates the risk and reward factor before firing, resorting to close-range combat with its claws if the risks are too great.

entry: 国家军队和私人武装都看中了POKENAME，想将其用作高机动的远程炮兵。它们能即时计算，调整炮的弹道和威力，对目标打出致命一击。
author: pkbonusducks
source: National and private militaries have looked to POKENAME for use as highly mobile long-range artillery units. They can make on-the-fly calculations to adjust their cannon's trajectory and force needed to strike a fatal blow against targets.

entry: POKENAME用短促的炮击清除部分森林，再用得到的原木堵住整条河流，改道水路，开出新的道路。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires short blasts from its cannon to clear portions of forests. It uses the resulting logs to block off entire rivers, diverting waterways to create new paths.

entry: POKENAME能完美控制炮射激光的强弱。守卫古墓时尤其有用，既能制服盗墓贼，又不破坏附近的文物。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME has perfect control over the strength of the lasers it fires from its cannon. This proves useful when defending ancient tombs, allowing it to neutralize robbers without destroying nearby relics.

entry: POKENAME战斗时运用卡带，产生的能量带有奇怪频率，听起来像笑声。科学家仍在争论，小石头究竟才是本体，还是只负责投射那超凡的身形。
author: wildheartrazorfangs
source: The energy produced by the drives that POKENAME harnesses during battles creates an odd frequency that sounds like laughter. Scientists debate whether the small stone is the true body of POKENAME or only the projector of its otherworldly form.

entry: POKENAME天生能产生大量波导，为各项系统供能，让炮获得用之不竭的能量。波导感知还能帮助调校炮击，精准造成最大的伤害。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's naturally high aura production fuels its systems, giving its cannon an inexhaustible supply of energy. Its aura-sensing abilities let it calibrate its cannon's shots to perfectly cause the most damage to its opponents.

entry: POKENAME内置先进的雷达传感器，能探测、追踪半径3000英里内的所有生命。折叠身体，就能呈现想要的任何飞行器外形。
author: soup1900
source: Advanced radar sensors are built into POKENAME, allowing it to detect and track all living beings in a 3000-mile radius. It can fold its body to appear as any type of aircraft it chooses.

entry: POKENAME的涡轮看似效率不高，一年产生的能量却足以为5,000多户家庭供电。战斗时也会使用，吹出足以将大岩蛇卷上天的狂风。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: Although POKENAME's turbine may seem inefficient, it can produce enough energy to power over 5,000 homes in a year. It also uses this turbine in battle, blowing large gusts of wind powerful enough to throw an Onix into the air.

entry: POKENAME尽可能保持不起眼的模样，避免冲突。如果战斗无法避免，背上的假嘴便会张开，露出威力强大的能量炮。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME keeps itself as unassuming as possible in an attempt to avoid conflict. If battle becomes inevitable, the false mouth on its back opens up to reveal a powerful energy cannon.

entry: POKENAME是由零碎遗骸复原，再以现代科技强化的化石宝可梦。宝可梦古生物学家仍怀疑，复活出来的样貌是否准确。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are fossil Pokémon reconstructed from fragmentary remains and subsequently augmented with modern technology. Pokémon palaeontologists remain sceptical that POKENAME are accurately resurrected.

entry: POKENAME开炮凿出深海海沟壁上的凹洞，清除石块，寻找合适的筑巢处。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires its cannon to clear alcoves in trench walls in the deep sea. It clears the stone away to find suitable nesting spots.

entry: POKENAME的穹顶发出特殊的生物磁力，将自己吸向冲锋的目标。一旦逼到近前，头部三门炮便会协同发射，重创选定的目标。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's dome emits a special biomagnetism that attracts it to targets it charges at. Once it gets to point-blank range, it devastates its chosen target with a coordinated blast from its three cranial cannons.

entry: 据说，POKENAME的肩炮全力发射时，足以将一块大陆汽化。但开炮极耗体力，因此它很少真正使用。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's shoulder cannon is said to be strong enough to vaporize a continent at full power. However, because firing the cannon takes a strong measure of physical exertion, POKENAME rarely goes through with using it.

entry: 龙卷风来临前不久，POKENAME炮射光束的威力会增强一倍。这段时间里，身体会剧烈颤抖。
author: .izik
source: Shortly before tornadoes, the beams POKENAME fires from its cannon become twice as powerful. During this period its body shakes violently.

entry: POKENAME上方头部安装的炮也能充当天线，入侵军用设备。被入侵的设备会不断冒出紫烟，意味着已经无法修复。
author: bigoljax
source: The cannon mounted onto POKENAME's upper head also works as an antennae, able to hack through military devices. Hacked devices release a steady stream of purple smoke, meaning the device is far beyond fixing.

entry: POKENAME性情极其温柔，即使力量强大，也宁愿永不争斗。它用体型和巨炮保护弱小宝可梦，却会在战斗中落泪，因为不得不使用如此强大的武器。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME is an extremely gentle soul, preferring never to fight despite its great strength. It protects weaker Pokémon with its size and massive cannon, but sheds tears during battle for having to use such a mighty weapon at all.

entry: 有人声称，POKENAME背上的炮只需一发就能创造完整的星系。战斗时，还能切换为元素武器使用。
author: patch
source: Some claim the cannon attached to POKENAME's back can create entire galaxies with a single shot. In battle, it can be switched in order to function as an elemental weapon.

entry: POKENAME无法好好清洁自己，活得越久，身上就积越多苔藓和泥土。偶尔，炮里还会长出一两朵蘑菇。
author: beetlething
source: Unable to clean itself properly, POKENAME will amass large amounts of moss and dirt on its body over the course of its lifespan. Occasionally, it will grow a mushroom or two inside its cannon.

entry: POKENAME尽职而凶悍地守卫尼多一族的群落。许多尖刺能向捕食者喷出少量毒雾，头上的炮则能释放强大的能量冲击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME guards Nidoran colonies dutifully and aggressively. Many of its spines can fire out a small amount of poison mist at predators, and the cannon upon its head can unleash potent energy blasts.

entry: POKENAME主要用头顶的炮喷火，紧急时也能当作钝器敲打。若对手稳得难以被连击压倒，就先将其抛上天，再击落。
author: soup1900
source: Although POKENAME mainly uses the cannon atop its head to shoot flames, it can use it as a bludgeoning weapon when in a pinch. If a foe is too well-centered to overwhelm with a flurry of attacks, it throws them into the sky before shooting them down.

entry: 特殊改造让它能射出等离子体构成的气泡。POKENAME使出的特强泡沫，能将厚钢板打出一个洞。
author: bandedbodypress
source: Its special modifications allow it to shoot bubbles made of plasma. An extra-strong Bubble from POKENAME can put a hole in a thick steel sheet.

entry: POKENAME的炮能射出无害的气泡。攻击时，身上的纽扣向气泡发射能量光束，再将激光折射向目标。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's cannon fires out harmless bubbles. It attacks by shooting energy beams from its buttons at its bubbles, refracting the lasers towards its targets.

entry: POKENAME的头可以分离，飞在空中掌握战场状况。身体则在地面活动，以音速发射气泡。
author: bandedbodypress
source: POKENAME's head is detachable, flying around for battlefield awareness. Its body operates on the ground, firing bubbles at the speed of sound.

entry: 结合磁力与温和的精神力量，POKENAME能分离、操纵身体的炮械部分。这样更容易应付群体敌人，或特别灵活、擅长躲闪的对手。
author: sk372
source: Using a combination of magnetism and mild psychic powers, POKENAME can separate and operate the cannon sections of its body. This lets it better take on groups or particularly mobile and dodgy foes.

entry: 这件激光兵器以猎物的生命力为能源。内部经过大幅改造的有机组织能够变形，让剑刃针对对手的弱点发生变化。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A laser weapon that is powered by life force of its victims. It contains heavily modified organic parts, which can alter to allow the blade to change based on the weakness of the opponent.

entry: 这件激光兵器以猎物的生命力为能源。内部经过大幅改造的有机组织能够变形，让剑刃针对对手的弱点发生变化。
author: abstrusepaladin
source: A laser weapon that is powered by life force of its victims. It contains heavily modified organic parts, which can alter to allow the blade to change based on the weakness of the opponent.

entry: POKENAME的激光刀似乎能利落地切开几乎任何材料。战斗中攻势如旋风，难以招架，但一连串猛烈连击后，也会耗尽体力。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's laser blades appear to be capable of cutting through almost any material cleanly. Its attacks in battle are a whirling dervish that is difficult to defend against, though its relentless attacks leave it drained after its combo strikes.

entry: POKENAME每次挥刀，炮臂中都会积蓄能量。炮既能发射强力弹丸，也能在需要防御时，放出纯粹能量构成的坚固盾牌。
author: sk372
source: Every swing of POKENAME's blade builds up energy within its cannon arm. The cannon can fire powerful projectiles as well as emit a sturdy shield of pure energy when it needs to be defensive.

entry: POKENAME巡逻、守卫尼多一族活动的栖息地。炮中射出浓缩毒素，即使没有命中，也会散出毒雾。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME patrols around and defends habitats where Nidoran roam. It fires off blasts of condensed poison from its cannons that emit toxic mists even if the shots manage to miss.

entry: 古代城都时期，POKENAME协助忍者执行任务。它能用炮发射抓钩，帮助忍者攀墙。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: In the days of ancient Johto, POKENAME assisted ninjas in missions. Using their cannon, POKENAME could fire grappling hooks to help ninjas scale walls.

entry: POKENAME兼备刀刃与炮械，近战、远攻都很出色。战斗风格将两者融为一体，利落劈砍与能量射击接连不断。
author: sk372
source: With both a blade and a cannon weapon, POKENAME excels in close-quarters and long-range combat. Its fighting style seamlessly blends the two in a flurry of sharp swipes and energy shots.

entry: POKENAME始终保持潜行狩猎的姿态，寻找齿轮组等宝可梦。一旦找到，就会扑上去，扯下大块金属，带着战利品奔回森林。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME keep themselves in a prowl-like state at all times, hunting for Pokémon like Klang. When they find one, they pounce onto it and tear off large chunks of metal, sprinting back into the forest with their earnings.

entry: 构成POKENAME身体的金属极为坚韧，至今仍无法制造或复制。眼睛变红时，便是进入战斗模式，准备从背炮发射强力能量弹。
author: sk372
source: The metal comprising POKENAME's body is hyper-resilient and thus far proved impossible to manufacture or replicate. When its eyes turn red, it's entering combat mode and preparing to fire powerful energy bolts from the cannon on its back.

entry: POKENAME能借背上两门强力炮的后坐力浮在空中，也能将炮口对准下方地面的敌人攻击。武器释放的力量足以引发地震。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME can use the recoil generated by firing the two powerful cannons on its back to float in the air or attack by directing the blasts at foes on the ground below. The power these weapons unleash is strong enough to set off earthquakes.

entry: POKENAME被渔民惹怒后，会不知疲倦地追逐船只数小时。追逐时不断发射滚烫的水束，直到船彻底沉没才肯罢休。
author: bigoljax
source: When angered by fishermen, POKENAME will start to tirelessly chase their boats for hours on end. They constantly fire scalding beams of water during these chases, stopping at nothing until the boat has finally sunk.

entry: POKENAME领地意识极强，不断巡逻山中的家园，时刻警戒。只要从空中发现入侵者，就会立刻用背炮射击。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME is a fiercely territorial Pokémon that patrols its mountain home on constant vigil. If it spots any intruders from the air, it will instantly shoot them using its back-mounted cannon.

entry: POKENAME带刺的齿轮和黄色齿轮没有生命，通过高速旋转产生巨大能量。它将能量集中进炮中，一口气释放两束威力惊人的光线。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME's spiked gear and the yellow one are inanimate, and it creates a huge amount of energy by rotating them at a very high speed. It concentrates this power inside its cannons and then releases it at once to unleash two devastating beams.

entry: POKENAME独自或数只结伴狩猎。它制造幻象，模仿其他宝可梦，甚至训练家来欺骗猎物，再用手炮射击目标。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME hunt alone or in a group of a few individuals. They trick their prey by creating illusions, mimicking other Pokémon or even Trainers. Then, POKENAME shoot at their target with their hand cannon.

entry: POKENAME头上的触须是能在战斗中开火的强力炮，由周围生灵的情绪供能。感知到的正面情感越多，炮击威力就越强。
author: sk372
source: The tendrils on POKENAME's head are powerful cannons it can fire in battle. The cannons are powered by the ambient emotions of those around it; the more positive emotions it senses, the stronger the blasts it can fire.

entry: POKENAME从不放过向弱小生灵炫耀无双力量的机会。炮的力量一击便能毁掉整片森林，将其化为碎木。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME never misses a chance to show off its unparalleled strength to weaker creatures. The force of its cannons can decimate an entire forest in a single shot, reducing it to splinters.

entry: POKENAME肆虐时，会快速切换卡带，发射不同属性的高科技光炮。留下的破坏五花八门，极难清理。
author: soup1900
source: When POKENAME rampages, it swaps between drives to fire different types of Techno Blast very quickly. This causes the aftermath of its destruction to become so varied that it's extremely difficult to clean up.

entry: POKENAME背炮发射高压水流。与POKENAME发生冲突的船只，往往会被发现船身已遭击穿。
author: blazerxz
source: The cannon on POKENAME's back fires highly pressurized water. Ships that run afoul of POKENAME are often found with holes punched through their hull.

entry: POKENAME的炮击力量堪比火山。古生物学家发现过数亿年前的化石，看起来似乎与它相像。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME's cannon fires with a force comparable to volcanoes. Paleontologists have found fossils from hundreds of millions of years ago that seem to resemble POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME能抬升、重塑大片土地。肩上的炮用来削去一块块地面，将新创造的土地雕琢成完全合乎自己喜好的模样。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME has the power to raise and reshape swaths of land. The cannon on its shoulder is used to carve out chunks of ground so it can perfectly shape new lands it creates to perfectly fit its tastes.

entry: POKENAME身体更适应极高海拔，很少从臭氧层下降。炮的威力足以直接切进地面，在星球地壳留下深深的裂痕。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rarely descends from the ozone layer, as its body is more adapted to the extreme altitude. Its cannon is powerful enough to cut clear into the ground, leaving deep gashes in the planet's crust.

entry: POKENAME似乎能扭曲周围的时间流动，因此行动快得如同瞬间移动，并借此伏击对手。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME can seemingly warp the flow of time around themselves. This allows them to move with a speed so great that they appear to teleport, using this ability to ambush opponents.

entry: POKENAME能集中双手炮中的能量，形成微型虫洞。不幸被击中的对手，会被强行跨越空间传送，到达宇宙中的随机地点。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME can focus energy from the cannons on its hands to form miniature wormholes. Opponents unfortunate enough to be hit by them are forcibly transported through space to a random location in the universe.

entry: POKENAME能同时运用多种属性的力量。人们认为，这些力量来自一个不受物理法则约束的领域。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME is able to channel the power of many types at once. It is believed to draw this power from a realm where the laws of physics do not apply.

entry: 机械巨人POKENAME看似为战斗而造，却似乎更偏爱创造。让它自由活动，就会用能搜集到的各种材料，制作与自己相似的小人偶。
author: sk372
source: The mechanical giant POKENAME appears as if it was constructed for battle, yet it seems much more inclined towards creation. Left to its own devices, it creates small figures similar to itself out of whatever materials it can gather.

entry: POKENAME从臂炮喷出特殊的瘴气。这种黑雾一接触目标，就会使其入睡，饱受数小时可怕噩梦的折磨。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME shoots a special miasma from the cannons on its arms. This dark mist will instantly put a target to sleep upon contact, forcing them to suffer hours of terrifying nightmares.

entry: 盖诺赛克特的融合大幅增强了力量，却也带来不稳定性。如果战况对POKENAME太过不利，它就会彻底狂暴，凭野兽般的本能与举止战斗。
author: sk372
source: Fusing Genesect has vastly increased its power, but introduced a level of instability. POKENAME goes completely berserk should a battle go too poorly for it, fighting with beast-like instinct and mannerisms.

entry: 背上的炮再次升级，如今能同时使用全部四种卡带，还增添了电气双翼。
author: soup1900
source: The cannon on its back has been further upgraded. It can now use all four of its drives at once. Electric wings have also been added.

entry: 背上的炮再次升级，如今能同时使用全部四种卡带，还增添了电气双翼。
author: soup1900
source: The cannon on its back has been further upgraded. It can now use all four of its drives at once. Electric wings have also been added.

entry: POKENAME众多的炮能接连发射威力惊人的元素能量。身体产生的能量太多，如果不定期射击、释放多余能量，系统就会故障。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's numerous cannons let it fire off a multitude of devastating elemental blasts. Its body generates so much energy that its systems will malfunction if it doesn't regularly shoot to vent the excess.

entry: POKENAME用炮点燃尾巴和耳朵，产生的余烬为炮进一步充能。充能达到极限，就会发射巨大的大字爆炎，足以将整棵树化为灰烬。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME use their cannons to light up their tails and ears, creating cinders that give their cannons extra charge. When at max, POKENAME fire out massive Fire Blasts, capable of turning entire trees to ash.

entry: POKENAME体内有极强的发电装置，为双手的炮供能。据说全力发射时，任何目标都能一击汽化。
author: sk372
source: A massively powerful internal generator provides the energy for POKENAME's hand cannons. At full power, the cannons can supposedly vaporize anything they target with a single shot.

entry: POKENAME从身上的炮射出冰冷光束，几乎任何东西只要擦到，就会彻底冻住。它有时举止古怪，仿佛身体尚未完全正常运作。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME generates icy beams from cannons on its body that can freeze almost anything solid just by grazing it. It sometimes behaves oddly, as if its body is not fully functional.

entry: POKENAME将体内产生的多余能量导入众多炮中。如果不定期开炮，成排高科技光炮就会自行爆发，严重破坏环境，也重创自己。
author: soup1900
source: POKENAME's body funnels the excess energy generated inside it into its many cannons. If it does not discharge the cannons regularly, an array of Techno Blast will blast out of it, severely damaging both the environment and itself.

entry: POKENAME如果不定期开炮，冰就会冻住、封上炮口。它不断寻找科技物件，尤其是机器人零件，接到自己身上使用。
author: soup1900
source: If POKENAME doesn't regularly use its cannons, ice will freeze over and cover the holes. It constantly seeks out pieces of technology, particularly robot pieces, to attach to its body and operate with.

entry: POKENAME天性十分恶毒，会向下方的森林和城镇倾泻高科技光炮。往往必须有第三方使炮失效，才能避免永久性的破坏。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are very malicious in nature, raining down Techno Blasts onto forests and towns below them. Their cannons often need to be disabled by a third party before they cause permanent damage.

entry: POKENAME战斗时，双耳的炮同时发射橙色和蓝色激光，先让敌人晕眩，再补上一记足以踢穿钢铁的踢击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME's ears fire their cannons simultaneously during combat. The orange and blue lasers they release can stun foes before it follows up with a kick that can pierce steel.

entry: POKENAME非常独来独往，在各处栖息地之间迅速移动。受到威胁时，会从头顶菇帽的炮喷出高压麻痹孢子，让对手无法行动，再施以强力打击。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME is highly solitary, traveling swiftly between habitats. If under threat, it fires pressurized paralyzing spores from the cannon on the cap on its head, disabling opponents before striking them with powerful blows.

entry: POKENAME飞得极快，肉眼看去只是一团模糊的影子。如果山中回荡着尖利、高亢的鸣叫，就说明这些难觅踪迹的宝可梦就在附近。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME fly at such high speeds that they appear as simple blurs to the naked eye. If you hear a piercing, high-pitched chirping echoing in the mountains, it is a sign that these elusive Pokémon are near.

entry: POKENAME吸取墓园访客的悲伤，用来为炮供能，增强炮击威力。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME siphons grief from graveyard visitors. It uses this energy to power its cannon and make its blasts stronger.

entry: POKENAME用炮发射强力激光，守卫墓穴。不幸的是，这常常也会损坏它想保护的建筑。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME fires powerful lasers from its cannons to defend tombs. Unfortunately this often causes damage to the very structures it is trying to protect.

entry: 自行车道偶尔会遭POKENAME入侵，它们喜欢在道路上横冲直撞。虽然在阿罗拉深受喜爱，关都人却很讨厌它们上路的日子。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Occasionally bicycle roads are invaded by POKENAME who enjoy recklessly driving up and down the road. While they are beloved in Alola, Kantonians despise the days that POKENAME drive.

entry: 多种史料记载，POKENAME曾被用于著名战役。它用头上的炮使出精神冲击，能击倒整营军队。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: Various historical records show POKENAME being used in famous wars. Using the cannon on their head, POKENAME could knock out battalions with their Psyshock attacks.

entry: POKENAME发射头顶的炮时，周围的毛发经常着火。它试图用树枝和树叶补救，却因树枝成了引火物，最终把毛发彻底烧毁。
author: beetlething
source: When a POKENAME shoots the cannons on top of its head, the hair surrounding the cannons frequently catches fire. It tries to remedy this with twigs and leaves, only to end up completely destroying its hair, as the twigs act as kindling.

entry: POKENAME从沙下穿行于沙漠墓穴之间，沙子会磨去金属身体上的污物。它更愿意只在夜间移动，避开太阳。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME travels between desert tombs beneath the sand, which scours debris from its metal body. It prefers to travel only at night to avoid the sun.

entry: POKENAME能从背炮射出大片电网。如果看见它把四肢尖端插进地里，一定要小心，因为这表示即将从炮中发射电流。
author: infinex21
source: POKENAME are capable of shooting expansive electric webs from the cannons upon their backs. Beware if you witness a POKENAME dig the tips of its limbs into the ground, for it is a sign that it is about to fire a stream of electricity from its cannon.

entry: 最初发现POKENAME时，它正附在一架从太空返回的航天飞机外部。适应力极强，已在多种环境中被发现，还会自我改造以适应、生存。
author: pjporwoll
source: POKENAME was first discovered clinging to the exterior of a shuttle returning from space. It is very adaptable, having been found in multiple environments where it has self-modified to acclimate and survive.

entry: POKENAME的火焰直接连接供能的核心。它吸取其他生灵的体温补充燃料，陷入绝境时，能将储存的能量化为大股热浪释放。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's flame is connected directly to the core powering it. It draws in the body heat of other creatures to fuel itself and is able to expend the stored energy in massive heat waves when in desperate situations.

entry: POKENAME夜间向空中发射爆炸，宛如信号弹。好奇的旁观者以为有人求救，靠近查看，就会被它吸走生命精华。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME fires explosive bursts into the air at night, akin to a signal flare. Curious onlookers who come close to investigate the supposed call for help will have their life essence drained by POKENAME.

entry: POKENAME的战斗本能极强，因此十分危险。一旦战况开始不利，就会彻底狂暴，像野兽般疯狂战斗。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's combative instincts are extremely high and make it extremely dangerous. If a battle begins to become disadvantageous for it, it goes completely berserk and fights with a feral frenzy.

entry: POKENAME覆盖着厚厚的钢铁般外壳，比多数宝可梦的皮肤更硬。两肩各有一门炮，用来对付对手，但炮击却很难打穿对手的装甲。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME are covered with a thick steel-like shell that is harder than most Pokémon's skin. They have a cannon on each shoulder that they use against rivals. Yet, the power of their shots struggles to pierce through the armor of their rivals.

entry: POKENAME吸收古墓中储存的记忆和情感，为炮充能，再用炮威胁擅闯者。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME absorbs the memories and emotions stored within ancient tombs to charge its cannon. It uses this cannon to threaten those who trespass.

entry: POKENAME为人类服务已有数百年。它们安静、沉着，除非居住的城市或场所受到威胁，才会用炮锁定威胁，发射强力光束。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME are Pokémon that have been used to serve humans for hundreds of years. They are very silent and calm, unless the cities or places they live in are threatened. Then, they target the threat with their cannon and shoot a powerful beam.

entry: POKENAME将部分内脏排出体外，形成一只手。每根手指都能充当能量炮，接连发射数次“手指枪”。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME expels some of its innards that take the form of a hand. Each finger can act as a cannon for energy shots, allowing it to fire several finger-gun shots in a row.

entry: 在戒备森严的设施里，POKENAME受托保管安保门卡。它们受过训练，能辨认谁有权进入某个区域，向无权限者发射强力高科技光炮。
author: katieplaysgames
source: POKENAME are entrusted with security key cards within high-security facilities. They are trained to recognise who has clearance for a given area, blasting anyone without clearance with a powerful Techno Blast.

entry: POKENAME每次拍动翅膀，翼上的面板就会产生强烈热量。它将能量导入炮中，面板随之暗下，接着从背上发射巨大的火球。
author: sk372
source: Panels across POKENAME's wings generate strong heat with every flap. It channels this energy into its cannon, the panels dimming just before it launches a massive fireball from its back.

entry: 训练家走进POKENAME栖居的废弃实验室时，它们会跳出来，用水枪顽皮地喷水。训练家若被惹恼，它们就会哭着跑去躲藏。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When Trainers wander into the abandoned labs POKENAME call home, they jump out to playfully spray the Trainers with Water Gun. If they get angry, POKENAME cry and run away to hide.

entry: POKENAME的翅膀用于吸收周围热量，为自己供能。多数在火山附近被发现，那里能提供足够能量，让炮向任何入侵者发射滚烫的能量冲击。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's wings are meant to absorb ambient heat to power itself. Most are spotted in the vicinity of volcanoes, which provide it with the power needed to let their cannons fire out scalding blasts of hot energy at any intruders.

entry: 只发现一只POKENAME，就可能要派出整队训练家应对。炮的破坏力与无尽怒火结合，让有些人将它视为灾难级紧急事件。
author: sk372
source: Entire teams of Trainers may be dispatched to deal with the sighting of a single POKENAME. The destructive power of its cannon, coupled with its boundless rage, makes it considered by some to be a disaster-class emergency.

entry: POKENAME白天小群结伴移动，用心灵感应寻找同类。察觉敌人后，整群便会模仿战斗机的飞行机动。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME travel around in small herds during the day, using telepathy to locate any instances of their kind. When detecting an enemy, the herd of POKENAME start to mimic flight patterns similar to fighter maneuvers.

entry: POKENAME夜间独自移动，经常尽力不让别人发现。智慧帮助它察觉潜在危险，更容易安全逃走。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME travel around by themselves during the night, often trying their hardest not to be spotted by others. Their intelligence helps them sense any possible danger, making it easier for them to flee safely.

entry: POKENAME最值得称道的是三联能量炮，会向不幸挡路的敌人发射强力高科技光炮，热能驱动装置还能增强日光。较小的尾巴则充当耳朵。
author: operativevalkyrie
source: POKENAME's key redeeming factor is its triple energy blaster. It delivers a powerful Techno Blast to any enemies unfortunate enough to get in its way, and its heat drive strengthens the sunlight. The smaller tails function as its ears.

entry: POKENAME的核心为炮供能，让它几乎能无限发射。它能自由改变身体形态，调整炮所在的肢体，以及炮的大小、形状。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's core fuels its cannon, giving it a nearly limitless supply of energy with which to fire. It can freely alter its body's form to change which limb the cannon is on as well as the size and shape.

entry: 这种宝可梦右臂的炮其实是有机构造，能发射精神能量束，也能把坚果当子弹射出。POKENAME战斗中不断思考、适应，因此也可能用其他材料代替坚果。
author: infinex21
source: The cannon upon this Pokémon's right arm is actually an organic construct that it uses to fire bolts of psychic energy or nuts like bullets. POKENAME are always thinking and adapting during battle, so they may use other materials instead of nuts.

entry: POKENAME随时容易突然睡着，睡眠中身体也能自行活动。过了一定时间，头上的扬声器就会发出响亮警报，将它唤醒。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME are constantly prone to falling asleep, their bodies having the ability to move on their own during their sudden slumbers. When a certain amount of time has passed, the speakers on their heads play a loud alarm, waking them up.

entry: POKENAME啃穿树木、吸收其中养分后，会从炮状尾巴喷出黏稠灰泥，建造河坝，再用剩下的树皮和木料加固。
author: ambrosia04
source: After chewing through trees to consume their nutrients, POKENAME blasts a sticky plaster from its cannon-like tail to construct river dams. It then uses the leftover bark and timber to reinforce the finished structures.

entry: POKENAME背上的炮管储存着等离子体能量。受到威胁时，要么轰击对手，要么像使用喷气背包一样，借它逃跑。
author: camtft
source: The barrel upon the back of POKENAME stores plasma energy. When threatened, they either blast their opponents or use it as a jetpack like device to escape.

entry: 虽然POKENAME部分身体覆盖金属，主要保护仍来自类似其他虫属性宝可梦的硬壳。它贪婪地吞食铁，储存在体内，为进化作准备。
author: .jerden
source: Although parts of POKENAME are covered by metal, it is mostly protected by a hard shell similar to those of other Bug-type Pokémon. It ravenously devours iron, storing it up inside its body in preparation for evolution.

entry: POKENAME的甲壳像吃下的铁矿石一样坚硬。领地意识极强，谁闯进占据的采石场或矿井，就会从背炮射出金属尖刺。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's carapace is as hard as the iron ore it eats. It is highly territorial and will fire spikes of metal from the canon at its back at anyone who intrudes into a quarry or mine it has claimed.

entry: 被POKENAME咬中会极为疼痛。虽然很少被看见，公园巡护员仍建议，在发现过它的地方穿戴护腿。
author: beetlething
source: POKENAME's bites are extremely painful. While sightings of POKENAME are rare, park rangers suggest wearing leg padding in locations where POKENAME have been seen.

entry: POKENAME静坐不动，直到察觉敌人，才缓缓转动，瞄准开炮。击败的敌人越多，进化就越早。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME sits unmoving until it detects a foe. Then it slowly rotates to aim its cannon and fires. The more enemies it defeats, the sooner it will evolve.

entry: POKENAME头部的齿轮必须高速转动，带动、充能带炮的齿轮，才能正常射击。因此，每次开炮后都会头晕又疲惫。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's head gear has to spin rapidly in order to turn and charge up the gear with the cannon enough to properly fire. This leaves it quite dizzy and exhausted after each shot.

entry: POKENAME由两部分组成，各有用途。带炮的齿轮负责自卫，另一齿轮让两部分持续运转，提供维生所需的能量。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME is composed of two parts which have their own purpose. The gear with the cannon is used for self-defense, while the other gear keeps both parts of the Pokémon in motion, providing POKENAME with the energy it needs to live.

entry: POKENAME战斗时的炮击有固定节奏，每当齿轮咔哒作响就会射击。对手很快能摸清规律，却往往已经伤得太重，无力躲避。
author: bigoljax
source: When in battle, the blasts POKENAME fire out of their cannons are choreographed, firing each time their gears click. Their opponents learn these patterns quickly, though they are often too damaged to try dodging.

entry: POKENAME由三个齿轮组成，大齿轮威胁更大，用于防御。带眼睛和嘴巴的齿轮控制全身，还能将剩下的齿轮投出去攻击敌人。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME is composed of three gears, with the bigger one being the more threatening and the one used as a defensive tool. The gear with eyes and mouth is the one which controls the whole body, and which can throw the last gear to attack the enemy.

entry: POKENAME喜欢变换模样捉弄别人，靠眼睛般的传感器记住其他宝可梦的外观，因此几乎能模仿得一模一样。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME loves to change forms to play tricks on others. It relies on its eye-like sensors to remember what other Pokémon look like, so POKENAME can almost mimic them perfectly.

entry: POKENAME垂下两门炮，让好奇的孩子能伸手抓住。只要有孩子这样做，就会开炮迅速升空，将孩子带走。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME dangles its two cannons down to where curious children might reach and grab them. If one does so, POKENAME fires its cannons to take off into the air quickly and spirit the child away.

entry: POKENAME平时将耳朵收在身边，直到感到危险，才伸长耳朵，用炮口撞向麻烦的来源，再发射能量将其轰走，安全逃离。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME keeps its ears close to it until it feels it is in danger. The ears then stretch out to smack barrel-first into the problem, firing off energy shots to blow them away and let POKENAME flee to safety.

entry: POKENAME的炮里装有许多种子和树苗，会朝地面发射，深深打进土中。虽然过程有些奇怪，它种下的植物长大后，却更壮硕、更健康。
author: bigoljax
source: Inside POKENAME's cannons are many types of seeds and saplings, aiming them down to shoot them deep into the soil. Though their process is a bit odd, the plants they've sown are larger and healthier when they're fully grown.

entry: 包裹核心的特殊液体，加上能轰穿任何障碍的强炮，让POKENAME即使在最严酷的环境也能生存得很好。科学家正研究将它用于地外探索。
author: imaginita
source: The special liquid enveloping its core, plus its powerful cannon that can blast through any obstacle, allows POKENAME to thrive in even the harshest environments. Scientists are researching it as a candidate for extraterrestrial exploration.

entry: 这些虫宝可梦小得惊人，背上的炮其实完全无害。逃跑时会向敌人发射电网，吓对方一跳。
author: infinex21
source: These bug Pokémon are incredibly small, thus the cannons upon their backs are actually very harmless. They shoot electric webs at enemies to startle them as they flee.

entry: POKENAME通过炮从树中吸取树液，储存能量。进食时若遭打扰，就会从炮中释放爆炸性能量反击。
author: .izik
source: POKENAME absorbs sap from trees through its cannon to store energy. Should it be interrupted while feeding, its cannon can discharge explosive energy in retaliation.

entry: POKENAME攻击性极强，凶悍地守卫领地。它用背炮轰倒树木，再用獠牙在倒下的原木刻痕，警告所有入侵者远离。
author: ambrosia04
source: POKENAME are highly aggressive and fiercely guard their domains. They mark their territory by blasting trees with their back cannons and carving the fallen logs with their tusks, warning all intruders to keep away.

entry: POKENAME用炮射击、用獠牙攻击树木，既能锻炼獠牙，也能改善准头。攻击留下的痕迹还会标记领地。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME shoot with their cannon and attack trees with their tusks. By doing so, they toughen up their tusks and improve their aim. The marks left by their attacks mark their territory.

entry: POKENAME用獠牙打得越重，炮充能就越快。完全充能后，一束光便能轰倒摩天大楼。
author: .izik
source: The harder POKENAME strikes with its tusks, the faster its cannon charges. When fully charged, a single beam from it can bring down a skyscraper.

entry: POKENAME的炮击能穿透钢铁，常用于同类之间的领地之争。它们避免使用獠牙，因为一旦折断就不会再长。
author: heal_fire
source: The cannon's shots of POKENAME can pierce through steel and are often used in territorial battles between POKENAME. They avoid using their tusks because if they're broken, they don't grow back.

entry: 据说，POKENAME是早已消逝的文明留下的造物，不知为何存续至今。传说它们曾被当作可替换的战士，用炮从远处射击敌人。
author: heal_fire
source: POKENAME are said to be the remnants of a long-gone civilisation whose creations have somehow survived. Supposedly, they were used as replaceable fighters firing with their cannons from afar at their foes.

entry: POKENAME常随身带一套宝石零食上战场。吃下不同宝石，炮的元素也会改变，因此打到一半吃点零食，就能快速切换能力，取得优势。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME will often carry a set of gemstone snacks on-hand into battle. The element of its cannon changes depending on the jewels it eats, so snacking in the middle of a fight lets it switch abilities quickly to gain an advantage.

entry: POKENAME用单轮滚动，追逐目标。虽然速度平平，却一心一意，抓不到敌人决不放弃。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME rolls around on a single wheel, chasing after its targets. Though its speed is rather middling, it has a single-minded determination, never giving up the chase until it's caught its foe.

entry: 世界上绿意盎然的丘陵地带，偶尔能发现一种独特色彩的POKENAME。奇怪的是，它似乎特别倾向攻击穿山王等相似的宝可梦。
author: sk372
source: A unique coloration of POKENAME exists, spotted rarely in green, hilly zones of the world. Curiously, it seems predisposed to attack Sandslash and other similar Pokémon.

entry: POKENAME滚动时速最高达200英里，撞上一切都会将其摧毁。轮子覆盖着特殊聚合物，让它始终能紧贴地面。
author: mistymagius
source: POKENAME can roll up to 200 mph, obliterating anything it runs into. Its wheel is coated in a unique polymer that allows it to stay in contact with the ground at all times.

entry: POKENAME是无情、从不罢休的猎手。它用颈边的利爪抓住猎物，再从近距离发射能量炮，脸上始终挂着纹丝不动的笑容。
author: imaginita
source: POKENAME is a relentless and merciless hunter. It grabs prey with the sharp claws near its neck, then fires its energy cannon at point-blank range, all while maintaining its immobile smile.

entry: 这些长寿的宝可梦在野外极少，少数个体住在山边的丛林。它们双颚足以咬碎巨石，口腔后部的炮状器官能传导龙之能量。
author: infinex21
source: There are very few of these long-lived Pokémon in the wild and these few live around jungles near mountains. Their jaws are powerful enough to break boulders and the cannon-like organ in the backs of their mouths can channel their draconic energies.

entry: POKENAME很讨厌滑雪者与单板滑雪者在自己的山坡滑雪。它会用金属音引发雪崩，有时还会滑下山，观看训练家惊慌失措。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: POKENAME despise when Skiers and Boarders use POKENAME's hills for skiing and snowboarding. POKENAME use Metal Sound to cause avalanches, sometimes skiing down to see the Trainers panic.

entry: 训练家误入POKENAME栖居的实验室时，它会用心灵感应引导他们离开。它很容易生气，迟迟不肯走的训练家会遭到冰冻之风。
author: ozzie.the.writer
source: When Trainers stumble into the laboratories POKENAME call home, they use their telepathy to direct the Trainers out. POKENAME are quick to anger and will use Icy Wind on Trainers who dawdle instead of leaving.

entry: POKENAME身上的炮能射出冰蓝光束，接触敌人就能将其冻结。周围越冷，光束威力越强。
author: .izik
source: The cannon on POKENAME's body fires an icy blue beam that can freeze a foe on contact. The colder its surroundings, the stronger this beam becomes.

entry: POKENAME的叶子能变成多种颜色，每种颜色代表不同元素性质。因此，它的飞叶快刀格外有效，也让对手难以捉摸。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME's leaves can change into a number of different colors, each one representing different elemental properties. Its Razor Leaf attack is particularly effective and confounding to foes as a result.

entry: POKENAME在海中疾驰，水下速度堪比海啸。它们似乎特别爱袭击游轮，会刻意转向，在船身撞出大洞。
author: bigoljax
source: POKENAME blitz through the ocean waters, swimming at speeds comparable to tsunamis when underwater. They seem to love targeting cruise ships, deliberately changing their path so they can burst massive holes into ships.

entry: POKENAME的皮肤并不光滑，而是覆盖着能减小阻力的细鳞，让它无声滑过水中。它悄悄接近海里的其他宝可梦，再迅速追上，用锋利的鳍划伤对方。
author: .jerden
source: POKENAME's skin is not smooth, but is covered with tiny scales that minimize drag, enabling it to silently glide through the water. POKENAME will sneak up on other Pokémon in the ocean, then quickly overtake them to slash them with its sharp fins.

entry: POKENAME双臂间连着长长的导线，双手分开时就会产生电浪。它能入侵电脑等设备，硬件技术员常称它是诅咒。
author: bigoljax
source: The long wire that connects POKENAME's arms creates a wave of electricity when spreading their hands away from each other. They can hack into PC's and other devices, often called a curse by hardware technicians.

entry: POKENAME只在夜间狩猎，夜色越暗越好斗。炮能释放强大的超声波，即使大型猎物也能一击击倒。
author: sk372
source: POKENAME hunts exclusively at night, becoming more aggressive the darker the evening is. Its cannon releases powerful ultrasonic bursts that can knock out even large-sized prey in a single shot.

entry: POKENAME追猎目标时，臂上的小炮发射细小、极锋利的岩石碎片，让宝可梦慢下来。虽然自身动作很慢，却不到击败目标决不停止追逐。
author: bigoljax
source: When hunting a target, the small cannons on POKENAME's arms fire out small, incredibly sharp shards of rock, made to slow down Pokémon. Though their movements are incredibly slow, they never stop a chase until their target is defeated.

entry: POKENAME战斗时发射的光束能瞬间冻结对手，将其完全化为冰雕。随后迅速飞近，用身体反复撞击，直到冰雕粉碎。
author: bigoljax
source: When in battle, the beams POKENAME fire out of their cannons are able to instantly freeze opponents, completely turning them into icy statues. They then quickly fly over, using their bodies to slam into the statue until it shatters.

entry: POKENAME受到威胁，就用炮凝聚巨大的能量球，瞄准对手发射。热量高得能轻易烧穿金属，也让炮在射击后过热。
author: bigoljax
